templates.title: Epic fantasy battle scene of Sun Wukong

templates.prompt: A hyper-realistic, epic fantasy illustration, featuring the protagonist as {argument name="main character" default="Sun Wukong, the Monkey King"} He was depicted in a dynamic combat stance. He wore exquisitely crafted golden armor, his red cloak billowing in the wind, and long pheasant feathers extended from his head. He had a fierce monkey face and was powerfully swinging a glowing, intricately carved golden cudgel downwards to strike a group of enemies.{argument name="enemy type" default="Heavenly Soldiers"} The celestial soldiers, clad in heavy, exquisitely crafted golden armor, were violently repelled by the onslaught. Sparks from explosions, glowing embers, and shattered stone fragments filled the area around the battle. The backdrop was a majestic, cloudy landscape.{argument name="setting" default="Heaven"} Towering, ornate pillars and traditional Chinese temple architecture appear and disappear in the hazy, dramatic sky. Transform the figures in the sketch into realistic images of two smiling Japanese business professionals (a man and a woman in suits) looking at a silver laptop in a bright office. Add [something] in the top left corner.{argument name="brand name" default="KAWAISALES"} The logo, along with the tagline "A new business support tool that utilizes AI." Map the text bubbles in the wireframe as follows: Replace the top bubble with one containing blue text.{argument name="main copy" default="Wouldn't you like to take your sales team to the next level with AI?"} The white oval shape; replace the middle bubble with {argument name="sub copy" default="From lead generation to closing, AI provides powerful support for your sales activities!"} Replace the bottom CTA box with a bright orange pill-shaped button with the text "..."{argument name="cta text" default="Experience a free demo now >"} In the bottom right center, add a blue 3D-style bar chart with an upward arrow, a target icon displaying three user silhouettes, and a white UI card with four checkmarks. The background is a clear blue sky with scattered white clouds. To her right is a rusty brick building with a large, weathered red sign on its roof, faintly displaying the words "..."{argument name="sign text" default="RED R"} Next to it is a red rocket sculpture. templates.prompt: An anime illustration depicting two characters sitting{argument name="setting" default="A cozy study overlooking the sea, at sunset."} At a desk. In the foreground, a young man wearing a dark knitted sweater sits with his back to the viewer. Facing him is a young woman with {argument name="female character hair" default="Golden hair"} and{argument name="female character eyes" default="Striking glowing blue eyes"} She wore an elegant navy blue and white Victorian-style dress and a sapphire brooch. Four luminous holographic spheres connected by thin lines floated between them, showcasing…{argument name="hologram theme" default="Cosmos and Futuristic Scenes"} A rotating galaxy, a golden energy tree, a futuristic control room, and a planet bursting with energy. On the desk sits an open astronomical journal, a steaming starry-themed mug, a glowing brass lamp, a pocket watch, and a pen. The warm sunset light contrasts sharply with the magical blue and gold holograms.

On the right bank, a picturesque European village nestles at the foot of lush green hills, boasting a prominent steeple church and traditional houses. templates.title: Museum Style Infographic Breakdown

titleLocalized.zh: 博物馆风格信息图解拆解

templates.prompt: Please refer to [Theme:]{argument name="theme" default="Hanfu"} Automatically generate a "museum-style Chinese infographic." Requirements: The entire image must combine a realistic main visual, structural breakdown, Chinese annotations, material descriptions, pattern symbolism, color symbolism, and a summary of core features. You need to automatically determine the most suitable theme, costume system, artifact structure, era style, key components, material craftsmanship, color scheme, and layout based on the [Theme], without requiring further user input. The overall style should resemble a National Museum exhibition panel, a historical costume guide, or a cultural museum infographic, rather than a regular poster, ancient-style photo, e-commerce product detail page, or anime illustration. The background should use a paper texture such as off-white, silk white, or light brown. The overall visual effect should be high-end, restrained, professional, and collectible. The layout is fixed as follows: - Top: Main Chinese title + subtitle + introduction - Left: Structural breakdown area, using Chinese leader lines to label key components and accompanied by close-up details - Top right: Material/Craftsmanship/Texture area, showcasing real-texture samples and explanations - Center right: Pattern/Color/Meaning area, showcasing the main color palette, pattern samples, and cultural interpretations - Bottom: Dressing order/composition flowchart + summary of core features. If the theme is suitable for a human figure display, please use a full-body standing pose as the central subject; if it is more suitable for cultural relics, use a breakdown of the central subject, but maintain the complete Chinese infographic format. All text must be in Simplified Chinese, clear, neat, and easy to read, without garbled characters or typos.

promptLocalized.zh:
请根据 [Theme: {argument name="theme" default="汉服"}] 自动生成一张“博物馆导览风格的中文拆解信息图”。

要求：整张图片必须结合写实主视觉、结构拆解、中文注释、材质描述、纹样寓意、色彩象征以及核心特征总结。你需要根据 [Theme] 自动确定最合适的主题、服饰体系、文物结构、时代风格、关键部件、材质工艺、配色方案及排版，无需用户进一步输入。

整体风格应为：国家博物馆展板、历史服饰指南或文化博物馆专题信息图，而非普通海报、古风照片、电商详情页或动漫插画。背景应使用米白、丝绸白或浅茶色等纸张质感。整体视觉效果需高端、克制、专业且具有收藏价值。

排版固定如下：
- 顶部：中文主标题 + 副标题 + 简介
- 左侧：结构拆解区，使用中文引线标注关键部件并配以局部特写
- 右上：材质/工艺/纹理区，展示真实质感样本及说明
- 右中：纹样/色彩/寓意区，展示主色调色板、纹样样本及文化解读
- 底部：穿着顺序 / 构成流程图 + 核心特征总结

如果主题适合人物展示，请使用真人全身站姿作为中心主体；如果更适合文物，则使用中心主体拆解，但需保持完整的中文信息图格式。所有文字必须为简体中文，清晰、整洁、易读，不得出现乱码或错别字。

templates.title: Urban Energy Drink advertising poster

titleLocalized.zh: Urban Energy Drink 广告海报

templates.prompt: A realistic urban advertising poster depicts a young Japanese woman in streetwear doing squats in the middle of a busy pedestrian crossing. She wears a black knit hat, a dark gray oversized hoodie, a chunky silver necklace, olive green cargo pants, and beige and black platform sneakers. She is showing the camera two identical cans of energy drinks; the cans are silver and black with a striking yellow lightning bolt logo and text.{argument name="can logo text" default="ENERGY"} The background is blurry and bustling.{argument name="city background" default="Tokyo street scene similar to Shibuya Crossing"} The image features pedestrians and neon lights. It employs a striking typographical design: a large, vertically aligned red line of Japanese text on the left.{argument name="left red text" default="Newly released"} The right side features white vertical Japanese text.{argument name="right white text" default="Energy that will bring the streets up."} There is a plain yellow banner along the bottom edge with bold black text printed on it.{argument name="bottom banner text" default="ENERGY DRINK"} It is accompanied by smaller Japanese text and a small black hand icon on the far right. It uses a dynamic wide-angle perspective with a shallow depth of field effect.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实风格的城市广告海报，画面中一位身穿街头服饰的日本年轻女性正在繁忙的人行横道中央做深蹲。她戴着黑色针织帽，身穿深灰色超大款连帽衫，佩戴粗款银色项链，下身穿着橄榄绿工装裤，脚蹬米色与黑色拼接的厚底运动鞋。她正向镜头展示两罐一模一样的能量饮料；罐身为银黑配色，印有醒目的黄色闪电标志和文字 {argument name="can logo text" default="ENERGY"}。背景是模糊且熙熙攘攘的 {argument name="city background" default="类似涩谷十字路口的东京街景"}，伴有行人与霓虹灯。图像采用醒目的排版设计：左侧为巨大的红色竖排日语文字 {argument name="left red text" default="新登場"}，右侧为白色竖排日语文字 {argument name="right white text" default="ストリートま上げてく エナジー。"}，底部边缘有一条纯黄色横幅，上面印有粗体黑色文字 {argument name="bottom banner text" default="ENERGY DRINK"}，旁边配有较小的日语文字以及最右侧的一个小型黑色手部标志。采用动态广角视角，具有浅景深效果。

templates.title: Summer beach drinks commercial photography

titleLocalized.zh: 夏季海滩饮品商业摄影

templates.prompt: A bright, summery commercial product photograph showcases a refreshing drink placed on a weathered wooden table. In the clear foreground, a stemmed glass holds a golden, bubbly, chilled beverage, garnished with a lemon slice and a sprig of rosemary; next to it is a silver aluminum can covered in condensation. The can prominently displays English text below a small gold star logo.{argument name="product name" default="TOKYO HIGHBALL"} The can is accompanied by an image of the drink itself, with the Japanese phrase "Alcohol 7%" printed near the bottom. To the right of the can, on a table, are two slices of lemon. Against a softly blurred background, a sunny beach scene unfolds, with shimmering azure water and a clear sky. To the left of the background stands a young woman with long brown hair, wearing a white sleeveless top and a light blue skirt, gazing at the sea. Above the scene, Japanese text floats elegantly in the sky.{argument name="catchphrase" default="This is perfect for summer."} The overall lighting is bright and inviting, with shimmering bokeh and lens flare highlighting the perfect cool and refreshing summer atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张明亮、充满夏日气息的商业产品摄影照片，展示了放置在风化木桌上的清爽饮品。在清晰的前景中，放着 1 只高脚杯，杯中盛满金黄色、带有气泡的冰镇饮料，装饰有 1 片柠檬和一枝迷迭香；旁边是 1 只覆盖着冷凝水的银色铝罐。罐身在金色小星星标志下方醒目地展示了英文文本 {argument name="product name" default="TOKYO HIGHBALL"}，并配有饮品本身的图案，底部附近印有日文“アルコール分 7%”。罐子右侧，桌上放着 2 片切好的柠檬角。在柔和虚化的背景中，展现了阳光明媚的海滩场景，碧蓝的海水波光粼粼，天空晴朗。背景左侧站着 1 位留着棕色长发的年轻女性，身穿白色无袖上衣和浅蓝色裙子，正望向大海。场景上方天空中优雅地漂浮着日文文本 {argument name="catchphrase" default="夏、これがいい。"}。整体光线明亮诱人，闪烁的焦外成像和镜头光晕突显了完美夏日清爽、冰凉的氛围。

templates.title: Photorealistic Blu-ray disc cover portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 照片级逼真蓝光光盘封面肖像

templates.prompt: A highly realistic Blu-ray disc cover features a portrait of a young Japanese woman. She has a messy black bob and wears large, round, thin-rimmed metal glasses. She wears a thick, textured, deep red knit sweater. Her expression is soft and captivating, looking directly at the camera. The background is a softly blurred, warm-toned interior environment, seemingly in a café, with a white coffee cup and tray faintly visible on the table to the right. The warm, cinematic lighting accentuates her facial features and the texture of her sweater. The image is framed within the standard blue border of a Blu-ray disc case, with the Blu-ray Disc logo prominently displayed at the top center, upper right, and lower left corners. On the left side are striking and elegant vertical Japanese characters…{argument name="main title" default="Witch's House Ringo"} Next to it is the phonetic alphabet "majo no ieringo", and it is decorated with delicate glowing pink lines and star/pentagram patterns. The lower right corner contains smaller Japanese characters "{argument name="subtitle" default="Like a witch, she will enchant you."} The letter “RINGO” and “MAJYONOIE” are printed below it.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度逼真的蓝光光盘封面，主体为一位年轻日本女性的肖像。她留着凌乱的黑色短波波头，戴着一副大而圆的细金属框眼镜。她身穿一件厚实、有质感的深红色针织毛衣。她的表情柔和而迷人，直视着镜头。背景是柔和模糊的暖色调室内环境，看起来像是在咖啡馆里，右侧桌上隐约可见一个白色咖啡杯和托盘。光线温暖且具有电影质感，突显了她的面部轮廓和毛衣的纹理。图像被框在标准的蓝色蓝光光盘盒边框内，顶部中央、右上角和左下角均配有蓝光光盘（Blu-ray Disc）标志。左侧有醒目且优雅的竖排日文文字“{argument name="main title" default="魔女乃家 林檎"}”，旁边配有注音假名“まじょのいえ りんご”，并装饰着精致的发光粉色线条和星星/五角星图案。右下角有较小的日文文字“{argument name="subtitle" default="魔女のように、あなたを魅了する。"}”，下方印有英文字母“R I N G O”和“M A J Y O N O I E”。

Solution: This series is a geometric series, where a = 1/3 and r = -1/3. Since |r| < 1, the infinite geometric series converges. S = a / (1 - r) = (1/3) / (1 - (-1/3)) = (1/3) / (4/3) = 1/4. The sum of the series is 1/4." (Slide footer displays...){argument name="professor name" default="Dr. Larson"} "、"{argument name="course name" default="Calculus II"} ", "November 14, 2024" and "7/35". The right panel displays vertically.{argument name="right game" default="Minecraft parkour game screen"} The screen displayed floating wooden blocks above a grassy landscape, with a TikTok watermark in the lower right corner. templates.title: Oriental Fantasy City Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 东方奇幻城市海报

templates.prompt: Flat illustration, high-end Eastern fantasy style city poster design, 9:16 vertical composition. The layout uses a diagonal line extending from the lower left to the upper right, plus an S-shaped flow. The background is a deep black gradient to a rich dark red, creating a strong contrast between warm and cool colors and spatial depth, with subtle stardust and grainy textures. At the center of the image, a flowing golden energy line meanders like a flame, extending from the bottom upwards, presenting a fluid texture, particle effects, and gradient highlights, accompanied by delicate energy fragments and volumetric light. Within the golden flow {argument name="city" default="Guangzhou"} Landmark buildings emerge layer by layer: the Canton Tower, as the visual core, stands out in proportion, surrounded by the Zhujiang New Town skyline, the Liede Bridge, and modern Lingnan architectural elements. The buildings are rendered using a technique of "fine lines outlining + golden luminous blocks," resulting in clear outlines and rich details, seemingly suspended in a golden halo above the void. A slight haze in the background creates a surreal sense of spatial layering. At the bottom of the image is an Eastern woman with white hair, her hair flowing like mist, naturally connecting and blending with the golden light. Her hair exhibits a semi-transparent gradient effect; her posture is elegant, her eyes slightly closed, her expression serene, holding a bouquet of colorful flowers adorned with shimmering particles, symbolizing the spiritual connection between humanity and the city's energy. The details of the figure are appropriately simplified to highlight the overall design. Light and shadow are concentrated on the golden lines, the building outlines, and the figure's silhouette, creating a strong contrast and visual focus. The overall atmosphere is grand and mysterious, full of Eastern mythology, and possesses a subtle sense of healing. The color scheme is based on black and dark red, with dazzling gold as the main visual focus. Gold, with its rich tonal variations, is complemented by small areas of highly saturated floral colors, maintaining a refined and restrained aesthetic. Text and layout integration: The top is centered and uses Song typeface, displaying "..."{argument name="city" default="Guangzhou"} "China", followed by smaller text "China"{argument name="date" default="2026/04/20"} "and"{argument name="author" default="LIYUE"} The text is rendered in a light gold or soft warm white, harmonizing with the overall lighting. High-quality details, cinematic lighting effects, rich volume and particle detail, clean and noise-free image, ultra-high-definition 8K resolution, commercial-grade poster quality.

promptLocalized.zh:
扁平化插画，高端东方奇幻风格城市海报设计，9:16 竖构图。布局采用从左下向右上延伸的对角线加 S 型流线。背景为深黑色渐变至浓郁的暗红色，营造出强烈的冷暖对比和空间深度，并带有淡淡的星尘与颗粒质感。画面中心，一条流动的金色能量线如火焰般蜿蜒穿过，从底部向上延伸，呈现出流体质感、粒子特效和渐变高光，伴有细腻的能量碎片和体积光。

在金色流线中，{argument name="city" default="广州"} 的地标建筑层层浮现：广州塔作为视觉核心，比例突出，周围环绕着珠江新城天际线、猎德大桥以及现代岭南建筑元素。建筑采用“细线勾勒 + 金色发光块面”的渲染方式，轮廓清晰且细节丰富，仿佛悬浮在金色光晕中的虚空之上，通过背景的轻微雾化营造出超现实的空间层次感。

画面底部是一位东方白发女性形象，发丝如雾般飘逸，与金色光芒自然衔接并融为一体。她的头发呈现半透明的渐变光效；姿态优雅，双目微闭，神情宁静，手中捧着一束点缀着闪烁粒子的彩色花束，象征着人与城市能量的精神联结。人物细节经过适度简化，以突出整体设计感。

光影集中在金色流线、建筑和人物轮廓上，营造出强烈的明暗对比和视觉焦点。整体氛围宏大、神秘，充满东方神话色彩，且带有淡淡的治愈感。配色以黑、暗红为基底，以璀璨的金色作为主要视觉重点。金色具有丰富的明暗层次，辅以小面积高饱和度的花卉色彩，保持了精致且克制的审美。

titleLocalized.zh: 东方美学水墨海报

templates.prompt: A modern Chinese ink wash landscape poster, 9:16 vertical composition, featuring an oriental minimalist aesthetic. Extensive use of white space, the overall color scheme evokes a spring morning (cyan-green, hazy blue, light gray, and pale ink), low saturation, clear and soft, with a sophisticated feel. The main subject is the majestic mountains rising abruptly from both sides of a lake, occupying the left and right sides of the image. The mountains are rendered using ink wash techniques, showcasing rich variations in shade and dryness, with touches of pale green to evoke the feeling of spring. The peaks are shrouded in a soft, moist morning mist, layered and blending into the pale blue-gray sky, creating an atmospheric perspective and spatial depth. The lake surface is like a mirror, reflecting a faint cyan, mirroring the mountains and sky, presenting a soft-focus and diffused mist effect, enhancing the moist and dreamy spring atmosphere. In the middle ground, a small wooden boat with a curved canopy floats slowly, its oars lightly touching the water, creating naturally spreading ripples, maintaining the overall sense of tranquility. On the boat sits a small, red-clad fisherwoman (from a distant view), simplified as a pale ink-wash silhouette. She wears a low-saturation vermilion traditional dress (not bright red), the color softened by the mist. No facial details are shown, only her silhouette and posture (such as gently touching the boat's awning or holding an oar). The red hue forms a faint reflection on the water, becoming the only warm visual focal point. The shore is dotted with sparse woods and new spring vegetation, rendered with light ink and pale green, combining realism and abstraction to enhance rhythm and vitality. A few birds fly across the distant horizon, their sparse distribution adding depth and dynamism to the space. At the top center is a vertical line of calligraphy:{argument name="title" default="Eastern aesthetics"} The calligraphy employs a traditional handwritten running or cursive style (reminiscent of Wang Xizhi), with natural brushstrokes, clear transitions, and an ink-bleed effect, avoiding the look of digital fonts. The calligraphy color is a deep ink blue or soft black, consistent with the overall design. Style: A fusion of ink painting and modern minimalist design, evoking a Zen-like springtime atmosphere, ethereal and moist, tranquil, with restrained contrasts of warm and cool tones, cinematic lighting, high-end art poster quality, and 8K ultra-high-definition details.

湖面如镜，泛着淡淡的青色，倒映着山峦与天空，呈现出柔焦与雾化扩散效果，增强了湿润梦幻的春日氛围。中景处，一艘带曲形篷的小木船缓缓漂浮，船桨轻触水面，泛起自然扩散的细微涟漪，保持整体静谧感。船上有一位红衣渔女，比例较小（远景视角），简化为带有淡彩的水墨剪影。她身着低饱和度的朱砂红传统服饰（非大红），色彩被雾气晕染得柔和。无面部细节，仅保留剪影与姿态（如轻扶船篷或执桨）。红色在水面形成淡淡倒影，成为唯一的暖色视觉焦点。

岸边点缀着疏林与新春植被，运用淡墨与浅绿点染，虚实结合以增强节奏感与生命力。远方天际有几只飞鸟掠过，分布疏朗，提升空间层次与灵动感。顶部居中处为竖排书法：“{argument name="title" default="东方美学"}”，采用传统手写行书或草书风格（王羲之神韵），笔触自然，转折清晰，带有墨迹晕染效果，避免数码字体感。书法颜色为深墨蓝或柔黑色，与画面统一。风格：水墨与现代极简设计融合，春日禅意，空灵湿润，氛围宁静，克制的冷暖对比，电影级光影，高端艺术海报品质，8K 超清细节。

templates.title: Character Relationship Chart Poster Generator

titleLocalized.zh: 角色关系图海报生成器

templates.prompt: Please refer to{argument name="theme" default="Demon Slayer"} Generate a highly designed character relationship diagram poster. This image should not be just a simple illustration, but a character relationship diagram that combines information visualization, narrative structure, poster design aesthetics, and stylistic accuracy. Please automate the following steps: - Identify the relevant works and core settings. - Extract 6–12 key characters, up to 15 if necessary. - Identify and display key character relationships, including blood ties, love, friendship, allies, enemies, master-disciple, etc. - Automatically select the composition method based on the characteristics of the work, such as protagonist-centric, dual-core opposition, faction-based, family tree, or timeline evolution. - Automatically extract the stylistic DNA of the work, including color, worldview symbols, texture, atmosphere, typography, and representative elements. - Transform these stylistic elements into the overall visual design of the relationship diagram, rather than simply copying the official poster. - Use different colors, line types, and arrows to distinguish different relationships, ensuring clear lines and distinct layers to avoid clutter. - Make the core characters stand out, followed by secondary characters, and weaken subordinate characters to form a clear visual hierarchy. - Ensure that each character's name is clear and easy to read, and label their identity or faction if necessary. The final product should meet the following requirements: - Allow for immediate understanding of the character hierarchy and key relationships. - Highly consistent with the original work's style and setting. - Combine the clarity of an infographic with the sophisticated design of a poster. Consistent, refined, and complete, suitable for social media sharing or poster display - avoid cheap flowchart feel, cluttered piling up, and information overload.

promptLocalized.zh:
请根据 {argument name="theme" default="鬼灭之刃"} 生成一张高设计感的角色关系图海报。这张图像不应只是简单的插画，而是一张结合了信息可视化、叙事结构、海报设计感以及风格还原度的角色关系图。

请自动完成以下内容：
- 识别与主题对应的作品及核心设定
- 提取最具代表性的 6–12 位关键角色，必要时不超过 15 位
- 识别并展示关键角色关系，包括血缘、爱情、友情、盟友、敌对、师徒等
- 根据作品特点自动选择构图方式，例如主角中心式、双核对立式、阵营式、家族树式或时间线演变式
- 自动提炼作品的风格 DNA，包括色彩、世界观符号、质感、氛围、排版及代表性元素
- 将这些风格元素转化为关系图的整体视觉设计，而非简单复制官方海报
- 使用不同的颜色、线条类型和箭头来区分不同关系，确保线条清晰、分层明确，避免杂乱
- 使核心角色最突出，次要角色次之，从属角色弱化，形成清晰的视觉层级
- 确保每个角色名称清晰易读，必要时标注身份或阵营标签

最终成品应满足：
- 能立即理解角色层级和关键关系
- 与原作的气质和设定高度契合
- 兼具信息图表的清晰度与海报的高级设计感
- 统一、精致、完整，适合社交媒体分享或海报展示
- 避免廉价的流程图感、杂乱的堆砌以及信息过载。

templates.title: Museum artifact illustrations and disassembly

titleLocalized.zh: 博物馆文物图鉴拆解

templates.prompt: Please refer to{argument name="subject" default="Qing Dynasty Emperor's Dragon Robe"} Automatically generate a "museum-style illustrated Chinese infographic". The final image must include a realistic main visual, structural breakdown, Chinese annotations, material descriptions, pattern symbolism, color meanings, and a summary of core features. You need to automatically determine the most suitable subject matter, clothing system, artifact structure, era style, key components, material craftsmanship, color scheme, and layout structure based on the main subject, without requiring additional information from the user. The overall style should resemble a national museum exhibition project, historical costume illustration, or cultural heritage themed infographic, rather than a regular poster, ancient-style portrait, e-commerce product detail page, or anime illustration. The background should use textures such as off-white, silk paper white, or light brown to create a high-end, understated, professional, and collectible appearance. The fixed layout is as follows: - Top: Main Chinese title + subtitle + introduction - Left: Structural breakdown area, using Chinese leader lines to mark key parts, with close-up details - Top right: Material/Craftsmanship/Texture area, showcasing realistic texture samples with explanations - Center right: Pattern/Color/Symbolic meaning area, showcasing the main color palette, pattern samples, and cultural interpretations - Bottom: Dressing order/Composition flowchart + Summary of core features If the theme is suitable for showcasing figures, please use a full-body standing pose as the central subject; if it is more suitable for cultural relics or a single structure, change it to a breakdown diagram of the central subject, while maintaining a complete Chinese infographic format. All text must be in Simplified Chinese, clear, standardized, and easy to read, avoiding garbled characters, typos, English, or pinyin. Emphasize realistic structure, material differences, cultural interpretation, and illustrative style. Avoid: poster-like, studio-like, e-commerce-like, anime-like, cosplay-like, incorrect labeling, structural errors, blurry text, false materials, or excessive decoration.

promptLocalized.zh:
请根据 {argument name="subject" default="清代皇帝龙袍"} 自动生成一张“博物馆插画风格的中文拆解信息图”。

最终图像必须具备写实的主视觉、结构拆解、中文标注、材质说明、纹样寓意、色彩含义以及核心特征总结。你需要根据主体自动确定最合适的题材、服饰制度、文物结构、时代风格、关键部件、材质工艺、配色方案及排版结构，无需用户提供额外信息。

整体风格应为：国家博物馆展览项目、历史服饰插画或文化遗产主题信息图，而非普通海报、古风人像、电商详情页或动漫插画。背景采用米白色、丝绸纸白或浅茶色等质感，使整体外观高端、内敛、专业且具有收藏价值。

固定排版如下：
- 顶部：中文主标题 + 副标题 + 简介
- 左侧：结构拆解区，使用中文引线标注关键部位，并配有局部特写
- 右上：材质 / 工艺 / 纹理区，展示真实质感样本并附带说明
- 右中：纹样 / 色彩 / 象征意义区，展示主色调色板、纹样样本及文化解读
- 底部：穿着顺序 / 构成流程图 + 核心特征总结

如果主题适合展示人物，请使用真人全身站姿作为中心主体；如果更适合文物或单一结构，则改为中心主体拆解图，同时保持完整的中文信息图格式。所有文字必须为简体中文，清晰、规范且易读，避免乱码、错别字、英文或拼音。强调真实的结构、材质差异、文化解释及插画气质。

避免：海报感、影楼感、电商感、动漫感、Cosplay 感、标注错误、结构错误、文字模糊、材质虚假或过度装饰。

templates.title: Encyclopedia-style infographic generator

titleLocalized.zh: 百科全书风格信息图生成器

templates.prompt: Please refer to{argument name="theme" default="animals"} Generate a high-quality, vertical "science encyclopedia image." This image is not a typical poster or simple illustration, but a modular science infographic with a "picture book feel, encyclopedia feel, structured information, and collectible value." The overall style should be a combination of high-end natural history illustrations, modern encyclopedia pages, everyday knowledge cards, and infographics that are easy to share on social media. The image should include: - A clear and aesthetically pleasing main visual image - Enlarged details of several local features - Multiple rounded-corner modular information areas - Clear heading hierarchy and key tags - Concise yet rich content descriptions - Visual ratings, key point summaries, or Top 5 module content sections should automatically adapt to the theme, prioritizing the following: basic overview, classification information, appearance characteristics, habits/ecology, formation mechanism/structure, growth or usage conditions, care or maintenance suggestions, risks and precautions, applicable audience or scenarios, advantages and disadvantages comparison, and quick rating cards. Visual Requirements: Light, clean background; soft color scheme; subtle shadows; delicate icons; rounded corner information boxes; clean layout; high information density without being cluttered; and a good reading experience. The final result must resemble a real science encyclopedia card, suitable for publishing, reading, collecting, and serialization, not an advertisement. Please do not create it as a typical commercial promotional poster. Emphasize the characteristics of "knowledge organization + modular information + illustration-style presentation".

promptLocalized.zh:
请根据 {argument name="theme" default="animals"} 生成一张高质量的竖版“科普百科全书图片”。

这张图片不是普通的海报或简单的插画，而是一个具有“绘本感、百科全书感、信息结构化和收藏价值”的模块化科普信息图。整体风格应参考高端自然历史插画、现代百科全书页面、生活知识卡片以及易于在社交媒体分享的信息图的结合体。

画面中请包含：
- 清晰且美观的主体视觉形象
- 若干局部特征的放大细节
- 多个圆角模块化信息区域
- 清晰的标题层级和关键标签
- 简洁而丰富的内容说明
- 视觉评分、要点总结或 Top 5 模块

内容栏目应根据主题自动适配，优先从以下方向选择：基本概况、分类信息、外观特征、习性/生态、形成机制/结构、生长或使用条件、护理或维护建议、风险与注意事项、适用人群或场景、优缺点对比以及快速评分卡。

视觉要求：
浅色简洁背景，柔和的配色方案，轻微的阴影，精致的小图标，圆角信息框，布局整洁，信息密度高但不拥挤，阅读体验良好。最终效果必须看起来像一张真实的科学百科卡片，适合发布、阅读、收藏和系列化制作，而不是广告。

请不要将其制作成普通的商业宣传海报。突出“知识组织 + 模块化信息 + 插画风格展示”的特点。

templates.title: Epic concept/movie poster generator

titleLocalized.zh: 史诗级概念/电影海报生成器

templates.prompt: GPT-Image-2 Prompt: Please refer to{argument name="theme" default="Ranking of Chinese Emperors Throughout History"} This theme requires the AI ​​to automatically generate a top-tier concept poster or infographic-style movie poster. The AI ​​must automatically derive and uniformly design the following visual system based on this theme, without requiring additional specifications from me: - Core subject (automatically determine if it is suitable to be represented as a person, product, building, artifact, symbol, scene, or abstract image) - Bottom support structure - Floating symbols or spiritual totems at the top - Scene wrapping elements - Metaphorical system - Color hierarchy - Material contrast - Light and shadow logic - Main title, subtitle, and auxiliary text - Brand sense and high-end texture expression. Final visual requirements: A stunning, precise, unified, cinematic-quality concept poster with extremely rich details, suitable for high-end printing. [Overall Style] Hyper-realistic 3D commercial CGI rendering, integrating cinematic lighting, luxurious visual language, futuristic concept design, and epic composition. The image must have a "single core visual focus," rejecting clutter, collage-like appearance, and the style of ordinary e-commerce posters. [Automatic Derivation Rules] AI must automatically determine the following based on the [Theme]: 1. Core visual metaphor 2. Subject type and posture 3. Supporting structural form 4. Floating element form 5. Scene shell and spatial atmosphere 6. Primary color, secondary color, and accent color 7. Material combination 8. Text style and typography [Composition Rules] - Absolutely high-end texture - Strong sense of central order, overall unity - Allows axial symmetry or epic compositions around a central axis - Clear visual center of gravity, forming a clear top-to-bottom hierarchy - Clean and restrained white space at the edges, with a sense of breathing [Visual Quality] - Ultra-high detail - Clear volumetric light - Realistic material texture - Natural reflection, refraction, shadow, fog, and depth of field effects - Overall standards benchmarked against high-end brand event main visuals / luxury invitation posters / concept editing posters [Typography System] - Overall 90% visual, 10% text - AI automatically generates the most matching main title and subtitle based on the [Theme] - Titles must be concise, sharp, and powerful - The text should be as concise and accurate as possible; avoid piling up words. [Author Attribution Requirements] The author's name should be naturally added in the bottom corner: @a9quant

promptLocalized.zh:
GPT-Image-2 提示词：请根据 {argument name="theme" default="中国历代皇帝排名"} 这一主题，自动生成一张顶级概念海报或信息图风格的电影海报。

要求 AI 在无需我额外指定的情况下，基于该主题自动推导并统一设计以下整套视觉系统：
- 核心主体（自动判断其是否适合表现为人物、产品、建筑、文物、符号、场景或抽象意象）
- 底部支撑结构
- 上方悬浮符号或精神图腾
- 场景包裹元素
- 隐喻系统
- 色彩层级
- 材质对比
- 光影逻辑
- 主标题、副标题及辅助文案
- 品牌感与高端质感表达

最终画面要求：一张震撼、精准、统一、具有电影质感且细节极其丰富的概念主视觉海报，适用于高端印刷。

[整体风格]
超写实 3D 商业 CGI 渲染，融合电影级光影、奢华视觉语言、未来感概念设计及史诗级构图。画面必须具备“单一核心视觉焦点”，拒绝杂乱，拒绝拼贴感，拒绝普通电商海报风格。

[自动推导规则]
AI 必须根据 [主题] 自动决定：
1. 核心视觉隐喻
2. 主体类型与姿态
3. 支撑结构形式
4. 悬浮元素形式
5. 场景外壳与空间氛围
6. 主色、辅色及强调色
7. 材质组合
8. 文字气质与排版风格

[构图规则]
- 绝对的高级质感
- 强烈的中心秩序感，整体统一
- 允许轴对称或围绕中心轴的史诗级构图
- 视觉重心明确，形成清晰的自上而下的层级
- 边缘留白干净、克制，具有呼吸感

[视觉质量]
- 超高细节
- 清晰的体积光
- 真实的材质感
- 自然的反射、折射、阴影、雾气及景深效果
- 整体标准对标高端品牌活动主视觉 / 奢华邀请函海报 / 概念编辑海报

[排版系统]
- 整体 90% 视觉，10% 文字
- AI 根据 [主题] 自动生成最匹配的主标题与副标题
- 标题必须简洁、犀利且有力
- 文字应尽可能精简准确；切勿堆砌词汇

[署名要求]
在底部角落自然添加作者署名：@a9quant

templates.title: Doodle and sketch style AI Builder generator

titleLocalized.zh: 涂鸦速写风格 AI Builder 生成器

templates.prompt: Expressed in a doodle sketch style [{argument name="subject" default="a powerful AI builder"} The overall visual effect is that of a quick sketch, free deformation, improvisation, and draft. Lines are casual, exaggerated, and vary in thickness, appearing slightly chaotic yet rhythmic and expressive, emphasizing generalization, exaggeration, fun, and spontaneity rather than rigorous realism or fine detail. Colors are rendered with bold, dry brushstrokes, retaining uneven application, brushstrokes, dry brush, and overlapping. Colors automatically adapt to the theme/subject, but the overall style remains graffiti, sketch, and generalization. There is no transparent watercolor wash, no delicate watercolor transitions, no paper texture, no soft mist, and no dreamlike quality. The background is predominantly white, maintaining simplicity, ease, a sense of unfinishedness, and design. A small number of auxiliary symbols, arrows, marks, circles, repeating lines, handwritten text, or other graffiti elements can be added to enhance the visual language of the sketchbook or doodle, but these should not be overly crowded or disrupt the white space and atmosphere. Image content does not need to be pre-defined;{argument name="subject" default="a powerful AI builder"} It will automatically deduce and generate the most suitable main image, action, related elements, symbols, or simplified scene. It maintains a consistent doodle/sketch style and exaggerated, generalized expression, avoiding complex realistic backgrounds and excessive detail. It naturally incorporates a unique signature.{argument name="signature" default="BlanPlan"} As part of the image, place it discreetly and clearly in the lower left corner, lower right corner, or near the title. The style should be consistent with the overall layout, like an artist's signature or design inscription; the signature font should be exquisite, restrained, and sophisticated, not too large, not disrupting the main composition, and not appearing abrupt or cheap.

promptLocalized.zh: 以涂鸦速写风格表现 [{argument name="subject" default="a powerful AI builder"}]，呈现出快速草图、自由变形、即兴手绘和草稿般的整体视觉效果。线条随意、夸张、粗细多变，略显杂乱但富有节奏感和表现力，强调概括性、夸张感、趣味性和自发性，而非严谨的写实或精细的细节。色彩采用粗犷的干笔块面表现，保留不均匀的涂抹、笔触、飞白和重叠感。色彩会自动适应 [theme/subject]，但整体表现仍保持涂鸦、速写和概括的风格。无透明水彩晕染，无细腻的水彩过渡，无纸张纹理，无柔和雾化，无梦幻感。背景以留白为主，保持简洁、轻松、未完成感和设计感。可添加少量辅助符号、箭头、标记、圆圈、重复线条、手写文字或其他涂鸦元素，以增强速写本或随笔般的视觉语言，但不应过于拥挤或破坏留白的主体和氛围。图像内容无需预先设定；[{argument name="subject" default="a powerful AI builder"}] 将自动推导并生成最合适的主体图像、动作、相关元素、符号或简化场景。整体保持统一的涂鸦速写风格和夸张的概括性表达，避免复杂的写实背景和过度细化。自然地将独特的签名 "{argument name="signature" default="BlanPlan"}" 作为图像的一部分，低调而清晰地放置在左下角、右下角或标题附近。风格应与整体布局统一，如同艺术家的签名或设计铭文；签名字体应精致、克制且高级，不宜过大，不破坏主体构图，且不显得突兀或廉价。

templates.title: Urban Street Style Characters Study

titleLocalized.zh: 都市街头风格人物研究

templates.prompt: This scene is a medium close-up shot, using a level perspective, focusing on {argument name="subject" default="young women"} She is seated three-quarters turned to the side, leaning slightly forward, with her hips pushed back and her legs naturally crossed, left leg in front of right, knees slightly bent. Her upper body turns to the right and rear, her head facing the camera, striking a classic "looking back" pose, her eyes direct and clear, with a hint of playfulness. Her hairstyle is {argument name="hairstyle" default="Fluffy brown shoulder-length short hair"} She sports natural bangs and slightly curled hair. Her makeup is light and natural, with subtle eyeliner and a natural nude pink lip. The overall image uses a natural daylight filter, with light entering from the upper left, creating a soft backlit silhouette. The face and right side of her body are illuminated by warm golden light, while the left side has a natural shadow transition, enhancing the sense of depth. The lighting effect is bright natural light with a slight lens flare, creating an afternoon sun atmosphere. From a level perspective, the composition places the subject in the right-center of the frame, with the pedestrian crossing and road markings in the background serving as natural leading lines to the subject. The background is a city street, including roads, pedestrian crossings, green belts, and distant vehicles; the background is moderately blurred, but elements such as trees, guardrails, and parked scooters are still clearly discernible. The composition uses the rule of thirds, placing the subject in the right third to balance the image. The subject is wearing {argument name="clothing" default="Army green camouflage hooded sweatshirt"} She paired the outfit with black shorts, white high-top sneakers, and white mid-calf socks. Her backpack was black with orange-yellow decorative stripes and an orange plush charm, made of canvas and leather. The overall style was casual streetwear; her body language was relaxed, and her expression was curious and playful, presenting the image of a carefree, young, and energetic urban girl.

promptLocalized.zh: 此场景为中近景镜头，采用平视视角，聚焦于 {argument name="subject" default="年轻女性"}。她呈现四分之三侧身，坐姿微倾，臀部后推，双腿自然交叉，左腿在前右腿在后，膝盖微屈。她上半身向右后方转动，头部面向镜头，呈现经典的“回眸”姿态，眼神直视且清澈，透着一丝俏皮。她的发型为 {argument name="hairstyle" default="蓬松的棕色齐肩短发"}，配有自然刘海和微卷的发梢。妆容清透自然，带有淡淡的眼线和自然的裸粉色唇妆。整体画面使用自然日光滤镜，光线从左上方射入，营造出柔和的逆光轮廓。面部和身体右侧被温暖的金色光线照亮，左侧则有自然的阴影过渡，增强了立体感。光效为明亮的自然光，带有轻微的镜头光晕，营造出午后阳光的氛围。从平视角度来看，构图将主体置于画面的中右侧，背景中的人行横道和道路标线作为自然的引导线指向人物。背景为城市街道，包括道路、人行横道、绿化带和远处的车辆；背景经过适度模糊处理，但树木、护栏和停放的踏板车等元素依然清晰可辨。构图采用三分法，将人物置于右侧三分之一处以平衡画面。主体身着 {argument name="clothing" default="军绿色迷彩连帽卫衣"}，搭配黑色短裤和白色高帮运动鞋及白色中筒袜。背包为黑色，带有橙黄色装饰条纹和一个橙色毛绒挂件，材质为帆布和皮革。整体风格为街头休闲风，肢体语言放松，表情好奇且俏皮，呈现出一位随性、年轻且充满活力的都市女孩形象。

templates.title: Philosophical concept infographic manuscript

templates.prompt: A stunning and incredibly complex conceptual worldview infographic masterpiece, themed "{argument name="theme" default="The fundamental differences between Confucianism, Taoism and Buddhism"} The overall design is inspired by ancient Eastern mythological manuscripts. Background: Pure white vintage textured canvas with a light beige, aged parchment base, featuring slightly worn edges and water stain effects. Core Layout: The central visual employs a grand "vertical egg-shaped layered structure," with Buddhist, Taoist, and Confucian layers from top to bottom. Edge Details: The four corners are decorated with exquisite miniature illustrations themed around ancient observation notes, ritual objects, and runes. Color Scheme: Primarily low-saturation sage green, light gold, and off-white tones, creating a bright and soft overall effect without glaringly high-saturation colors. Details: Architectural lines, landscape brushstrokes, lotus patterns, and cloud layers are clearly visible, rendered with exceptional delicacy. Seamless Integration: The natural transition between the three layers is achieved through clouds and flowing water, seamlessly connecting the Buddhist light, Taoist Tai Chi cloud patterns, and Confucian scholarly atmosphere. Style:{argument name="art style" default="Classical ink painting line art + low-saturation watercolor by number"} It possesses a light and airy feel reminiscent of ancient Chinese manuscripts. Text annotations: Pure traditional Chinese characters, using a weathered ancient Song typeface. Each annotation includes a short title and a line of poetic description, connected to details by a thin, deep gold line, with no repetition. Aspect ratio: 3:4. Vertically independent and complete units. Title area (top): `Confucianism, Buddhism, Taoism: Fundamental Differences`. Central layered annotations: Top layer "Buddhism": `Buddhism`, `The Relationship Between Self and Self`, `Selflessness, Healing the Mind, Letting Go`. Middle layer "Taoism": `Taoism`, `The Relationship Between Self and All Things`, `Non-Action, Healing the Body, Humility`. Bottom layer "Confucianism": `Confucianism`, `The Relationship Between People`, `Selflessness, Governing the World, Taking Responsibility`. Side auxiliary annotations: Left side: `Purity: Clearing the Mind and Brightening the Eyes, Eliminating Troubles`; `Tranquility: Following Nature, Returning to One's True Self`; `Reverence: Reverence for Responsibility, Actively Engaging in the World`. Right side: "60+ years old: Cultivating the mind: Taking gains and losses lightly, returning to one's inner self"; "35-55 years old: Being a person: Balancing work and rest, following the rules"; "7-35 years old: Striving forward, achieving success". Bottom summary: "The balance between detachment and engagement with the world is the highest wisdom of life".

promptLocalized.zh: 一张令人惊叹且极其复杂的概念性世界观信息图杰作，主题为“{argument name="theme" default="儒家、道家与佛家的根本差异"}”，整体设计为古代东方神话手稿风格。背景：纯白复古纹理画布，浅米色陈旧羊皮纸底色，带有轻微的磨损边缘和水渍效果。核心布局：中心视觉采用宏大的“垂直蛋形分层结构”，从上至下分别为佛家、道家和儒家层。边缘细节：四个角落装饰有以古代观察笔记、礼器和符文为主题的精细微型插画。配色：以低饱和度的鼠尾草绿、浅金和灰白色为主调，整体明亮柔和，无刺眼的超高饱和度色彩。细节：建筑线条、山水笔触、莲花纹样和云层清晰可见，渲染极其细腻。无缝融合：通过云朵和流水实现三层之间的自然过渡，将佛家之光、道家太极云纹与儒家书卷气息无缝连接。风格：{argument name="art style" default="古典水墨线条艺术 + 低饱和度数字水彩"}，带有轻盈的中国风古籍手稿质感。文字标注：纯繁体中文字符，采用斑驳的古宋体，每处标注包含一个短标题 + 一行诗意描述，通过深金色的细线连接至细节处，无重复指向。长宽比：3:4 垂直独立完整单元。标题区域（顶部）：`儒释道：根本差异`。中心分层标注：顶层“佛家”：`佛家`，`自我与自我的关系`，`无我、治心、放下`。中层“道家”：`道家`，`自我与万物的关系`，`无为、治身、虚怀`。底层“儒家”：`儒家`，`人与人的关系`，`无我、治世、担当`。侧边辅助标注：左侧：`清净：清心明目，断除烦恼`；`静谧：顺应自然，回归本心`；`敬畏：对责任的敬畏，积极入世`。右侧：`60+ 岁炼心：看淡得失，回归内心`；`35-55 岁做人：张弛有度，遵循法度`；`7-35 岁做事：砥砺前行，建功立业`。底部总结：`出世与入世之间的平衡，是人生的高级智慧`。

templates.title: Attitude and Lighting Analysis Graph Converter

titleLocalized.zh: 姿态与光影分析图转换器

templates.prompt: [Core Task] Convert the provided input image into a pose and lighting analysis diagram. This is not a finished character illustration. This is not a costume design drawing. This is not a redraw that preserves aesthetics. This is a conversion of a white line sketch human body model. [Main Objective] Extract and visualize only the following: - Pose structure - Body balance - Camera angle - Body line flow - Inferred light source position - Illuminated area and light intensity [Input Character] Use the provided image as a strict anchor point for the following: - Pose - Camera angle - Body tilt - Center of gravity distribution - General lighting conditions Do not retain: - Facial rendering - Hairstyle rendering - Clothing details - Accessories - Weapon details - Background architecture - Character identity - Emotional expression [Character Transformation] Single, rough human model White body outline White internal construction lines Simple model Head No face No eyes No mouth No eyelashes No personality No individual identity The human model should be presented as: - Rough pose model - Anatomical proxy model - Line-based body guide - Structural sketch - White line Rough model Retain: - Pose readability - Outline flow - Head tilt - Torso direction - Pelvis direction - Limb position [Background] Pure black background Negative style Dark field No scene No props No architecture No environmental narrative [Line style] Rough white line drawing, simple yet sketch-like; structural lines visible, anatomical guide lines visible, joint flow visible; emphasizes body contours; not a detailed illustration. [Light and Shadow Estimation] Predict possible light source locations based on the input image; visualize light sources and illuminated areas using only green halos. Use varying green light intensities: - Strongest green: Direct light - Medium green: Wrapping light - Soft green: Reflected or diminished light. Use labels and arrows to mark estimated light sources, such as: - Main Light - Rim Light - Fill Light - Floor Bounce - Back Light. Use only where appropriate. Important note: Do not fabricate light sources; infer lighting from the original input image. If lighting is blurry, keep labels simple and reasonable. [Green Light and Shadow Visualization] Display green halos in the following areas: - Head/Skull plane - Neck - Shoulders - Chest plane - Thoracic direction - Pelvic edge - Thigh plane - Knee contact point - Floor contact reflection (if applicable) The use of green light and shadow is not for decoration, but as information for light and shadow analysis [pose priority]: 1. Preserve pose structure; 2. Preserve camera angle; 3. Preserve body balance; 4. Preserve head-to-body relationship; 5. Visualize possible lighting directions; 6. Show the lit areas through readable green intensity variations [negative hints]. Finished character, cute girl, detailed face, hair rendering, clothing rendering, weapon emphasis, beautified anatomical structure.

promptLocalized.zh:
[核心任务]
将提供的输入图像转换为姿态与光影分析图。

这不是成品角色插画。
这不是服装设计图。
这不是保留美感的重绘。

这是一个白线草图人体模型转换。

[主要目标]
仅提取并可视化以下内容：
- 姿态结构
- 身体平衡
- 摄像机角度
- 身体线条流向
- 推断的光源位置
- 受光区域与光照强度

[输入角色]
将提供的图像作为以下内容的严格锚点：
- 姿态
- 摄像机角度
- 身体倾斜度
- 重心分布
- 大致的光照情况

请勿保留：
- 面部渲染
- 发型渲染
- 服装细节
- 配饰
- 武器细节
- 背景建筑
- 角色身份
- 情绪表达

[人物转换]
单一粗略的人体模型
白色身体轮廓线
白色内部构造线
简单的模型头部
无面部
无眼睛
无嘴巴
无睫毛
无个性
无个人身份

人体模型应呈现为：
- 粗略的姿态模型
- 解剖学代理模型
- 基于线条的身体指南
- 结构草图
- 白线粗糙模型

保留：
- 姿态的可读性
- 轮廓流向
- 头部倾斜
- 躯干方向
- 骨盆方向
- 四肢位置

[背景]
纯黑色背景
负片风格暗场
无场景
无道具
无建筑
无环境叙事

[线条风格]
粗略的白线绘图
简洁但具有草图感
构造线感
可见解剖引导线
可见关节流向
强调身体轮廓
非精细插画成品

[光影估算]
根据输入图像预测可能的光源位置
仅使用绿色光晕可视化光源和受光区域

使用具有变化的绿色光照强度：
- 最强绿色：光线直射处
- 中等绿色：包裹光
- 柔和绿色：反射光或减弱的光

使用标签和箭头标记估算的光源，例如：
- 主光 (Main Light)
- 轮廓光 (Rim Light)
- 补光 (Fill Light)
- 地面反光 (Floor Bounce)
- 背光 (Back Light)
仅在合适时使用

重要提示：
不要随意编造光源
根据原始输入图像推断光照
如果光照模糊，请保持标注简单且合理

[绿色光影可视化]
在以下部位显示绿色光晕：
- 头部 / 头骨平面
- 颈部
- 肩部
- 胸部平面
- 胸腔方向
- 骨盆边缘
- 大腿平面
- 膝盖接触点
- 地面接触反光（如适用）

使用绿色光影不是为了装饰，
而是作为光影分析信息

[姿态优先级]
1. 保留姿态结构
2. 保留摄像机角度
3. 保留身体平衡
4. 保留头身关系
5. 可视化可能的光照方向
6. 通过可读的绿色强度变化展示受光区域

[负面提示]
成品人物，
可爱女孩，
精细面部，
头发渲染，
服装渲染，
武器强调，
美化后的解剖结构

templates.title: Retro Pomegranate Growth Chart

titleLocalized.zh: 复古石榴生长图谱

templates.prompt: Create a richly detailed retro-style scientific botanical infographic poster on warm ivory paper, inspired by 19th-century natural history atlases, but optimized with modern, minimalist typography. The main subject is a complete pomegranate plant, labeled as follows:{argument name="plant name" default="Pomegranate"} /{argument name="latin name" default="Punica granatum"} Presented in a centered, vertical sectional style, the poster offers an unobstructed view from crown to roots. It depicts a slender, woody trunk with abundant branches, glossy green leaves, several orange-red flowers, unopened buds, young fruit, ripe fruit, and a large, split-open pomegranate revealing dense, ruby-like seeds. Below, the sprawling root system is fully visible. The poster is rendered with exquisite watercolor and ink, featuring realistic plant anatomy, precise lines, subtle dark brown shading, fine leading lines, arrows, and small numbered circles. The main title is located in the upper left corner of the poster.{argument name="headline text" default="Plant life path profile"} Below is the English subtitle:{argument name="subtitle text" default="BOTANICAL GROWTH ATLAS"} Add a brief bilingual introductory text below the title. The tall, elongated educational poster, in a 9:16 aspect ratio, centers on the plant surrounded by illustrative charts. Eight numbered educational sections surround the plant, each with a prominent Chinese title and a smaller English translation, arranged in a graphic style: 1. Seed Structure—A large cross-section of the seed, labeled with internal parts, accompanied by a smaller illustration of a cell cross-section. 2. Germination Mechanism—The left-hand sequence, comprising five stages, showing seed swelling, splitting, germination, radicle emergence, and early seedling morphology. 3. Root System and Substrate Intelligence—The lower left shows a large, bare root system, accompanied by two circular magnified illustrations of root details, showing branching structure and root hair/network texture. 4. Stem, Leaf, and Vascular System—The right-center area, containing two anatomical circular cross-sections and a separate leaf illustration, labeled with xylem, phloem, epidermis, and related tissues. 5. Photosynthesis and Energy Conversion – The lower right biology panel contains three green microscopic structural diagrams, including leaf tissue/cell-like sections, and simple chemical flow lines indicating the conversion of CO2 + H2O into sugars and O2. 6. Bud Formation and Flowering – The upper right flowering section contains two large flower anatomy diagrams (side view and longitudinal section), labeled with stamens, petals, ovary, and pollen structures. 7. Pollination and Fruiting Pathway – The right-hand developmental bar contains five stages of pomegranate fruit development from bud to maturity, along with an illustration showing a bee approaching the flower for pollination. 8. Fruit Maturation and Seed Cycle – The lower right life cycle section contains three fruit illustrations showing a complete fruit, a split fruit, and a split fruit revealing seeds, plus three diagrams of seedling growth. At the bottom edge, a long growth documentary strip contains 19 small step illustrations, each numbered 1 to 19, showcasing the plant life cycle from dormant seed to germination, root growth, seedling emergence, sapling development, flowering, fruit setting, maturity, seed dispersal, and cyclical renewal. A small environmental factors panel is added to the lower left, with icon-based indicators for light, temperature, water, nutrients, and air. Bilingual labeling is used throughout, with Chinese titles highlighted and English translations in a smaller serif font. The overall aesthetic should present an academic, elegant, museum-quality feel with a dense sense of information, complemented by refined classical typography, a soft beige background, realistic red and green tones, and a balanced and clean graphic layout.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张细节极其丰富的复古科学植物信息图海报，采用暖象牙色纸张，风格仿照 19 世纪自然历史图谱，并结合现代简洁的排版优化。主体为一株完整的石榴植株，标注为 {argument name="plant name" default="石榴"} / {argument name="latin name" default="Punica granatum"}，以垂直剖面风格居中展示，从树冠到根部一览无余。描绘一根纤细的木质树干，带有繁茂的分枝、油亮的绿叶、几朵橙红色的花朵、未开的花蕾、幼果、成熟果实，以及一个裂开的硕大石榴，露出密集的红宝石般种子，地下则是完全可见的蔓延根系。采用精致的水彩和墨水渲染，具备写实的植物解剖结构、精准的线条、微妙的深褐色阴影、精细的引导线、箭头以及小型编号标注圆圈。海报左上方设有总标题：{argument name="headline text" default="植物生命路径剖面"}，下方紧跟英文副标题：{argument name="subtitle text" default="BOTANICAL GROWTH ATLAS"}。在标题下方添加一段简短的双语风格介绍文本。构图为 9:16 的高长教育海报，植株位于中心，周围环绕说明性图表。

在植株周围包含 8 个编号的教育板块，每个板块均配有醒目的中文标题和较小的英文翻译，按图谱风格排列：
1. 种子结构 — 一个大型种子剖面图，标有内部零件，并附带一个较小的细胞横截面插图。
2. 发芽机制 — 左侧序列，包含 5 个阶段，展示种子膨胀、裂开、发芽、胚根出现及幼苗早期形态。
3. 根系与基质智能 — 左下方展示大型裸露根系，配有 2 个圆形放大根部细节插图，显示分支结构及根毛/网络纹理。
4. 茎、叶与维管系统 — 右中部区域，包含 2 个解剖学圆形横截面和 1 个独立的叶片插图，标注木质部、韧皮部、表皮及相关组织。
5. 光合作用与能量转换 — 右下方生物学面板，包含 3 个绿色微观结构图，包括叶片组织/类细胞切片，以及简单的化学流动线，指示 CO2 + H2O 转化为糖分和 O2。
6. 花蕾形成与开花 — 右上方开花部分，包含 2 个大型花朵解剖图（侧视图和纵剖面），标注雄蕊、花瓣、子房和花粉结构。
7. 授粉与结果路径 — 右侧发育条，包含 5 个从花蕾到成熟石榴的果实发育阶段，并附带一个展示蜜蜂接近花朵的授粉插图。
8. 果实成熟与种子循环 — 右下方生命周期部分，包含 3 个果实插图，展示完整果实、裂开果实及露出种子的开裂果实，外加 3 幅幼苗生长过程图。

在最底边缘，包含一条长长的生长纪实带，内含 19 个小型步骤插图，每个均按 1 到 19 编号，展示从休眠种子到发芽、根系生长、幼苗破土、树苗发育、开花、坐果、成熟、种子散播及循环更新的植物生命周期。左下方添加一个小型的环境因素面板，配有光照、温度、水分、养分和空气的图标式指示器。全程使用双语标注，中文标题更为突出，英文翻译采用较小的衬线字体。整体美学应呈现出学术、优雅、博物馆级品质及信息密集感，并辅以精致的古风排版、柔和的米色背景、写实的红绿色调以及平衡整洁的图谱布局。

templates.prompt: A highly detailed, cinematic wide-angle lens showcases a world with{argument name="atmosphere" default="Dark Fantasy"} A magnificent, dark Gothic hall of aesthetics. At its center stands a figure dressed in {argument name="clothing" default="White robe"} The figure kneels on the highly reflective stone floor, facing a magnificent golden altar illuminated by a row of lit candles. To the right of the kneeling figure is placed a{argument name="floor object" default="wooden violin"} The spacious room was constructed of massive, dark stone pillars, which were covered with {argument name="accent color" default="Glowing blue"} Ethereal cracks and textures. Dozens of them hang from the high ceiling.{argument name="floating objects" default="White porcelain theatrical mask"} Hanging from thin lines, they filled the upper half of the space, creating a memorable, surreal atmosphere. The lighting was dramatic and emotional, employing a rich color scheme of deep black, dark gold, and cool blue tones. Format: 16:9.

A large main title read, "{argument name="main title" default="The villainous prince, who has abandoned his good ways, distances himself from the white rose saint."} The text uses an artistic font with a gold-blue gradient. templates.title: Gothic mystery movie poster

titleLocalized.zh: 哥特悬疑电影海报

templates.prompt: A dark, gothic suspense movie poster with a cinematic feel. In the center of the image, a man in a trench coat and fedora, with his back to the viewer, gazes up at a magnificent yet oppressive Gothic clock tower. The clock face glows, the surrounding structure is collapsing, and dark fragments scatter and fall. The scene is set in a misty, damp cobblestone square on a nighttime day, illuminated by warm yellow streetlights and light filtering through the surrounding European-style buildings. A full moon pierces through the clouds. Three crows are depicted: one perched on a stone tablet on the left, and two flying in the sky. The stone tablet on the left is inscribed with the words "VERITAS IN UMBRA, TEMPUS NEMINI PARET". On the right is a wooden signpost with three directional signs: "Marktplatz", "Uhrenturm", and "Alte Gasse", next to which lies a newspaper with the words "Die Uhr steht." and "Wer lügt?". The poster uses an elegant, slightly worn serif Japanese font. The horizontal slogan at the top reads:{argument name="top tagline" default="At midnight, time stops, and lies begin to move."} The vertical slogan in the upper left corner is:{argument name="side tagline" default="The sound of that bell buried the truth."} The main title in the center below is {argument name="main title" default="The Clock Tower Murders"} Below the title is a smaller tagline, "Who deceived me?", followed by a realistic credits list including the director, actors, and crew members. The release information is displayed at the very bottom.{argument name="release date" default="Coming to theaters nationwide in Fall 2025"} The website URL and rating are displayed alongside the image. The entire poster is decorated with a delicate, ornate gold border.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影质感的暗黑哥特悬疑电影海报。画面中心，一名身穿风衣、头戴软呢帽的男子背对观众，仰望着一座宏伟且压抑的哥特式钟楼。钟面发出亮光，周围的建筑结构正在崩塌，黑暗的碎片四散坠落。场景设定在雾气弥漫、潮湿的夜晚鹅卵石广场上，被温暖的黄色路灯和周围欧式建筑中透出的光亮所照亮。一轮满月穿过云层。画面中共有 3 只乌鸦：一只停在左侧的石碑上，两只在天空中飞翔。左侧的石碑上刻有文字“VERITAS IN UMBRA, TEMPUS NEMINI PARET”。右侧是一个木制路标，带有 3 个指向标，分别写着“Marktplatz”、“Uhrenturm”和“Alte Gasse”，旁边靠着一份报纸，上面写着“Die Uhr steht.”和“Wer lügt?”。海报采用了优雅且略带磨损感的衬线日文字体。顶部横向标语为 {argument name="top tagline" default="真夜中、時は止まり、嘘が動き出す。"}。左上方垂直标语为 {argument name="side tagline" default="その鐘の音が、真実を葬った。"}。下方中心位置的主标题为 {argument name="main title" default="時計塔の殺人"}。标题下方是一行较小的标语“時を欺いたのは、誰だ。”，随后是一段包含导演、演员和剧组成员名字的逼真电影演职员表。最底部显示发布信息 {argument name="release date" default="2025年 秋 全国ロードショー"}，旁边附有网站 URL 和评级标志。整张海报由细致的华丽金边框装饰。

At the top center, the series title {argument name="series title" default=""Charlotte the Cyber ​​Chair Detective""} Presented in small white text, within a large main title written in an elegant serif font.{argument name="main title" default=""Angel's Tears""} Above. Below the main title is the slogan.{argument name="subtitle" default="All records began with this encounter."} At the bottom center of the poster is the text "This is the first record of Charlotte and Watson," followed by a striking, stylized title.{argument name="bottom text" default="シャルロット & W.A.T.S.O.N."} At the very bottom, it is labeled "Original Story / Screenplay / Director noriyang". The overall atmosphere is mysterious, high-tech, and epic.

In the background, two other girls are also present: one with a brown ponytail, carrying firewood; the other with short silver hair, holding a blue mug. The scene is set in a sunny outdoor barbecue area, featuring a large black smoking grill with a sign hanging above it.{argument name="background grill sign" default="LONE STAR BBQ"} The signboard. In the upper left corner was a large, cute, and vibrant cartoon logo with the words:{argument name="anime title" default="もくもく すもーく ガールズ"} It features smoke and barbecue graphics. There's one in the bottom left corner.{argument name="credits text block" default="Production staff list block containing names and positions"} The small text box in the bottom right corner lists the names of the four characters. templates.prompt: A cinematic sci-fi animated movie poster depicts a heavily armored, cylindrical deep-sea submarine anchored on a rocky seabed. The submarine features a central porthole emitting a bluish glow, a ring of small lights, two bright downward searchlights, and the words "..." printed on its side.{argument name="hull text" default="NEREIS-01"} The word "" was faintly visible behind it.{argument name="creature type" default="Giant bioluminescent anemone-like entity"} Its tentacles radiated a bluish light. The deep blue abyss was dotted with luminous seabed plants. The text in the upper left corner included the Japanese title.{argument name="main title" default="Abyssal Horizon"} ",subtitle"{argument name="english subtitle" default="ABYSS HORIZON"} "and slogans"{argument name="tagline" default="Darkness is not the end. It is a new beginning for humanity."} The technical footnotes at the bottom read "INTERNATIONAL DEEP SEA TREATY ORGANIZATION" on the left and "IDTO-AB-013300-ALPHA" on the right. The design is rich in detail, with dramatic lighting effects, and features an industrial mecha aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影质感的科幻动画电影海报，画面中是一艘重装甲圆柱形深海潜水艇，停靠在岩石嶙峋的海底。潜水艇拥有一个发着青色光芒的中央舷窗、一圈小型灯光、两个明亮的向下探照灯，侧面印有“{argument name="hull text" default="NEREIS-01"}”字样。在它身后，隐约浮现出一个 {argument name="creature type" default="巨大的生物发光海葵状实体"}，其触手末端放射着青色的光芒。深青色的深渊中点缀着发光的海底植物。左上角的文字包括日文标题“{argument name="main title" default="深淵の地平線"}”、副标题“{argument name="english subtitle" default="ABYSS HORIZON"}”以及标语“{argument name="tagline" default="暗黒は、終わりじゃない。人類の新しい始まりだ。"}”。底部的技术性脚注文字左侧为“INTERNATIONAL DEEP SEA TREATY ORGANIZATION”，右侧为“IDTO-AB-013300-ALPHA”。细节丰富，光影效果极具戏剧性，工业机甲设计。

templates.prompt: An anime-style promotional illustration depicts three characters running dynamically in a joyful painting scene under a bright blue sky and white clouds. On the left is a young blonde woman in an elegant white ruffled dress and gloves, smiling brightly and holding a paintbrush dripping with pink paint. In the middle is a young black-haired man in blue overalls and a black T-shirt, looking excited, holding a roll of masking tape and a green roller brush. On the right is an older man laughing heartily, wearing dark traditional Japanese work clothes with a white towel around his neck. Colorful paint splatters in the air, surrounded by two paint buckets, two paintbrushes, and two rolls of masking tape. A stylized title logo is displayed at the top.{argument name="main title" default="The young lady doesn't know anything about painting."} It is decorated with paint splatter effects. Below is a banner ribbon that reads {argument name="subtitle" default="A refined young lady × A painting man"} At the bottom is a striking promotional slogan:{argument name="bottom tagline" default="In this unknown world, the distance between the two of them begins to shrink...!"} The overall style features vibrant colors and the aesthetic appeal of light novel covers.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张动漫风格的宣传插画，描绘了 3 位角色在明亮的蓝天白云下，于欢乐的绘画场景中动态奔跑的画面。左侧是一位身穿优雅白色荷叶边连衣裙、戴着手套的金发年轻女性，她笑容灿烂，手中拿着一支滴着粉色颜料的画笔。中间是一位身穿蓝色背带裤和黑色 T 恤的黑发年轻男子，他神情兴奋，手中拿着一卷美纹纸胶带和一个绿色滚筒刷。右侧是一位开怀大笑的年长男子，身穿深色日式传统工作服，脖子上围着一条白毛巾。五彩斑斓的颜料飞溅在空中，周围漂浮着 2 个油漆桶、2 把画笔和 2 卷美纹纸胶带等道具。顶部是一个风格化的标题 Logo，显示为 {argument name="main title" default="お嬢様は塗装を知らない"}，并装饰有颜料飞溅效果。下方是一条横幅丝带，写着 {argument name="subtitle" default="清楚なお嬢様 × 塗装男子"}。底部是一句醒目的宣传标语：{argument name="bottom tagline" default="未知の世界でふたりの距離が縮まっていく…！"}。整体风格呈现出鲜艳的色彩和轻小说封面的美感。

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫轻小说封面插画

templates.prompt: An anime-style light novel cover illustration depicts two anime characters in an intimate pose. On the left is a young woman with short, dark hair and purple eyes. She wears a white hat, a white ruffled dress with a pink bow tie, white gloves, and two white flower hair clips. She gently touches the chin of the man beside her with a loving yet playful smile. On the right is a man with a middle parting {argument name="man's hair color" default="red"} An adult male with violet hair, purple eyes, and a light goatee. He wears a black shirt, his expression slightly agitated and reluctant, a bead of sweat clinging to his cheek. The image uses soft, romantic lighting, with out-of-focus purple petals in the foreground corner. The image contains several Japanese text elements: a large, stylized main title at the bottom.{argument name="main title" default="ちかつば"} Below is the subtitle.{argument name="subtitle" default="—That doting love is the flip side of possessiveness.—"} There is vertical text in the upper left corner.{argument name="left quote" default="Being cute isn't enough."} There is vertical text in the upper right corner.{argument name="right quote" default="Direct that bad mood only towards me."} .

promptLocalized.zh: 一张动漫风格的轻小说封面插画，描绘了两个姿态亲密的动漫角色。左侧是一位留着深色短发、有着紫色双眸的年轻女性，她戴着白色帽子，身穿带有粉色领结的白色荷叶边连衣裙，戴着白色手套，并佩戴着两枚白色花朵发卡。她带着深情而调皮的微笑，正轻轻触碰身旁男性的下巴。右侧是一位留着中分 {argument name="man's hair color" default="红色"} 头发、有着紫色双眸且留着浅浅山羊胡的成年男性。他身穿黑色衬衫，表情略显烦躁和不情愿，脸颊上挂着一滴汗珠。画面采用柔和的浪漫光影，前景角落处有失焦的紫色花瓣。图像包含多处日文文本元素：底部是一个大型风格化的主标题 {argument name="main title" default="ちかつば"}，下方是副标题 {argument name="subtitle" default="ーその溺愛、独占欲の裏返し。ー"}，左上角有竖排文字 {argument name="left quote" default="可愛いだけじゃ、許さない。"}，右上角有竖排文字 {argument name="right quote" default="その不機嫌、俺だけに向けろよ。"}。

templates.prompt: A highly detailed, realistic anime-style portrait depicts a young woman crouching low and looking slightly downwards at the camera. She has long, flowing hair.{argument name="hair color" default="Gray Gold"} Her hair swayed gently in the breeze; her skin was fair; and her eyes were large and expressive. She wore {argument name="outfit" default="Japanese school uniform, paired with a light gray cardigan, white shirt, dark plaid bow tie, dark plaid pleated skirt, dark knee-high socks, and black leather loafers."} Her arms were casually draped over her knees. The background was bright.{argument name="sky condition" default="A clear blue sky, dotted with a few white clouds."} The bottom is faintly visible and blurry.{argument name="background setting" default="Barbed wire fence and green trees"} The lighting creates a campus atmosphere. The light is bright natural sunlight with soft, cinematic shadows, highlighting the realistic texture of clothing and skin.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度精细、写实风格的动漫肖像，描绘了一名年轻女性从低角度蹲下并微微俯视镜头的画面。她有着一头长长的、飘逸的 {argument name="hair color" default="灰金色"} 秀发，在微风中轻轻飘动，皮肤白皙，双眸大而富有表现力。她身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="日本校服，搭配浅灰色开衫、白色衬衫、深色格纹领结、深色格纹百褶裙、深色过膝袜以及黑色皮质乐福鞋"}。她的双臂随意地搭在膝盖上。背景是明亮的 {argument name="sky condition" default="万里无云的蓝天，点缀着些许白云"}，底部隐约可见模糊的 {argument name="background setting" default="铁丝网围栏和绿树"}，营造出校园的氛围。光线为明亮的自然日光，带有柔和的电影感阴影，突显了衣物和皮肤的写实质感。

templates.title: Anime Music Romance Movie Posters

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫音乐爱情电影海报

templates.prompt: An anime-style movie poster features a bright, energetic high school girl in the foreground and a quiet high school boy in the background. The girl has long, dark purple hair adorned with ribbons and musical note hair clips, and wears a white short-sleeved school uniform shirt, a dark plaid skirt, and a striped tie. She smiles warmly, extending her hand to the viewer with a piece of paper on it.{argument name="paper text" default="I want to share this song with you in the future...♡"} In the background, a boy sits at a desk, resting his chin on his hand, his expression indifferent. He has messy dark hair, wears a white hoodie under a dark suit jacket, and headphones around his neck. The scene is set in a brightly lit music production studio, complete with dual computer monitors displaying audio waveforms, microphones, and keyboards. The visuals are rendered with bright, cinematic lighting effects, featuring lens flare and flickering. Striking text overlays include a large pink and blue vertical slogan on the left.{argument name="vertical text" default="Billions of views, Secret, First Love, Song of Destiny"} A large, stylized main title at the bottom center{argument name="main title" default="After-School Million Note"} It features a shimmering gradient effect, with a subtitle below.{argument name="subtitle" default="~Only the aspiring singer-singer girl knows that I, an introverted guy, am a Vocaloid producer with hundreds of millions of views~"} At the very bottom is a dense credits list of the film's cast and crew, next to which is written {argument name="studio logo" default="STELLA FILM THEATER"} The logo.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张动漫风格的电影海报，前景是一位明亮、充满活力的女高中生，背景是一位安静的男高中生。女孩留着深紫色长发，装饰着丝带和音符发夹，身穿白色短袖校服衬衫、深色格纹裙和条纹领带。她温暖地微笑着，向前伸出手，递给观众一张纸，上面写着 {argument name="paper text" default="この歌、あなたと、未来で届けたいです…♡"}。背景中，男孩坐在书桌前，单手托腮，表情冷淡。他留着凌乱的深色头发，白色连帽衫外搭深色西装外套，脖子上挂着耳机。场景设定在一个阳光明媚的音乐制作室，配有显示音频波形的双电脑显示器、麦克风和键盘。画面呈现出明亮的电影级光效，带有镜头光晕和闪烁效果。醒目的文字叠加包括左侧巨大的粉色和蓝色垂直宣传语 {argument name="vertical text" default="億再生 秘密 初恋 運命の歌"}，底部中央巨大的风格化主标题 {argument name="main title" default="放課後ミリオンノート"}，并带有闪烁的渐变效果，下方是副标题 {argument name="subtitle" default="〜陰キャの僕が億再生ボカロPだと、歌い手志望のお嬢様だけが知っている〜"}。最底部是一块密集的电影演职员表，旁边是写有 {argument name="studio logo" default="STELLA FILM THEATER"} 的标志。

templates.prompt: A realistic 3D paperback mockup stands at a slight tilt against a pure off-white background, showcasing the cover and spine. The cover features a minimalist and serene illustration depicting a white archway leading to a bright, soft sunrise over a calm sea. A woman in a flowing white dress stands at the archway, gazing at the horizon. On either side of the archway are elegant vertical Japanese characters in Mincho font, containing the following text:{argument name="main title" default="Once I stopped enduring it, my life started to move forward."} There is smaller horizontal text in the upper left corner.{argument name="subtitle" default="7 Steps to Reclaiming Your Life"} The bottom third of the book is wrapped in a light pink dust jacket. The dust jacket features a prominent horizontal advertising slogan.{argument name="obi catchphrase" default="You no longer have to live your life based on other people's expectations."} The small print above, separated by dotted lines, mentions work, interpersonal relationships, love, and anxieties about the future. On the right side of the waistband is a white circular badge with a small crown icon and the text {argument name="sales badge text" default="Total sales surpass 200,000!"} The bottom of the book jacket features four small rectangles containing keywords related to self-esteem, time management, mental organization, and an ideal future, followed by the text "Everything will change!" The spine is white and displays the main title, subtitle, author's name placeholder, and publisher placeholder.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个逼真的 3D 平装书样机，以微倾斜角度直立在纯净的米白色背景上，展示了封面和书脊。封面采用极简且宁静的插画，描绘了一扇白色的拱门，门外是平静海面上明亮的柔和日出，一位身穿飘逸白裙的女性站在拱门处望向地平线。拱门左右两侧是优雅的竖排日文大字，采用明朝体（Mincho），内容为 {argument name="main title" default="我慢をやめたら、人生が動き出した。"}。左上角有较小的横排文字 {argument name="subtitle" default="自分の人生を取り戻す 7つのステップ"}。书的底部三分之一处包裹着淡粉色的腰封。腰封上印有醒目的横排宣传语 {argument name="obi catchphrase" default="もう、他人軸で生きなくていい。"}，上方通过虚线分隔的小字提到了工作、人际关系、爱情和未来焦虑。腰封右侧是一个带有小皇冠图标的白色圆形徽章，文字为 {argument name="sales badge text" default="累計 20万部 突破!"}。腰封最底部有 4 个小矩形框，包含关于自尊、时间管理、心理整理和理想未来的关键词，随后是文字 "Everything will change!"。书脊为白色，展示了主标题、副标题、作者名占位符以及出版社占位符。

The upper left corner displays prominent calligraphic characters.{argument name="main title" default="Chongqing"} Below is the English text "".{argument name="english subtitle" default="CHONGQING"} The image also includes smaller Chinese text reading "Mountain City, Foggy City, River City, Chongqing" and a red seal. templates.title: Cyberpunk-style melancholic cityscape

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克风格忧郁城市景观

templates.prompt: An illustration with a strong cinematic feel and atmosphere depicts a young woman with short black hair standing on a wet city street at night. She wears a dark jacket and looks to one side. Above her, an elevated railway track diagonally cuts across the street, and a yellow train roars past. The city is filled with skyscrapers, some adorned with neon signs featuring Japanese characters. The rain-soaked streets reflect the warm, soft lights of the city and the train. The overall color scheme, dominated by dark brown, tan, and soft yellow, creates a melancholic, dystopian, or cyberpunk atmosphere. The dim, diffused lighting evokes a typical scene of a rainy night in a metropolis.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具电影感和氛围感的插画，描绘了一位留着黑色短发的年轻女性站在夜晚潮湿的城市街道上。她身穿深色夹克，目光看向一侧。在她上方，一条高架铁轨斜穿过街道，一列黄色列车正呼啸而过。城市中高楼林立，部分建筑上悬挂着带有日文字符的霓虹灯牌。街道被雨水打湿，倒映着城市和列车温暖而柔和的灯光。整体色调以深褐色、棕色和柔和的黄色为主，营造出一种忧郁、反乌托邦或赛博朋克的氛围。光线昏暗且弥散，呈现出大都市雨夜的典型景象。

The central area showcases a vibrant, brightly lit modern metropolis, equipped with {argument name="modern landmark" default="A futuristic cluster of skyscrapers connected by sky bridges"} A wide river with boats, a red suspension bridge, and cable cars suspended in the air. The poster's left side features elegant typography: striking gold-textured Chinese characters reading "{argument name="city name chinese" default="Chongqing"} Below is the English text "",{argument name="city name english" default="CHONGQING"} Below is a text in a simple serif font: "".{argument name="season and year" default="SPRING 2026"} The design is complemented by smaller, vertically arranged Chinese text and a traditional red seal. templates.title: Anime female warrior wielding a whip sword

templates.prompt: A highly dynamic and action-packed anime/fantasy illustration featuring a protagonist who {argument name="hair color" default="jet black"} Long hair, with sharp{argument name="eye color" default="Bright blue"} A young female warrior with striking eyes. The image employs a dynamic low-angle close-up to mid-range composition, showing her wielding a long, segmented metal whip-sword, drawing a wide, circular arc around her body. Her thick, long hair billows violently in the wind, its sharp, glossy strands meticulously detailed. Her expression is focused and fierce, staring directly at the viewer over her shoulder. She wears magnificent black, silver, and gold-trimmed armor, complete with a fitted breastplate, gauntlets, shoulder armor, and leg armor, along with a short, multi-layered skirt adorned with flowing blue and white fabric and metallic embellishments. The weapon forms a bright spiral in the foreground and upper right corner of the composition, exhibiting a reflective steel texture, motion blur, and shimmering highlights. Small rocks and debris float in the air due to the impact of the attack. The background is set in an abandoned stone battlefield or castle courtyard, with cracked ground and broken bricks, several blue flags standing in the background, and a sky filled with dark clouds. templates.title: Fitness SaaS landing page UI

titleLocalized.zh: 健身 SaaS 着陆页 UI

templates.prompt: Design a modern, high-end{argument name="app type" default="Fitness app"} Landing page and product UI, brand name is{argument name="brand name" default="PulseFit"} Create a clean web design mockup that resembles a legitimate SaaS fitness platform and its accompanying mobile app. The design should convey a premium feel, be motivating, and easy to use; the UI/UX should benchmark against top-tier health and fitness apps. Includes: - Homepage: Features a striking title, concise subtitle, a strong call-to-action (CTA) button, and an app preview. - Dashboard UI: Displays daily activity, calories burned, consecutive workout days, heart rate, steps, and a progress bar. - Workout Plan Cards: Covers strength, cardio, flexibility, and recovery training. - Nutrition Tracking: Includes macronutrient analysis and hydration tracking. - Progress charts and analytics components. - Coach/Community: Includes profile cards and user reviews. - Pricing and app store download guide. - Mobile App Interface: Presented alongside the web design, showcasing a unified product ecosystem style: - Stylish, minimalist, and modern interface. - High-end fitness brand aesthetics. - Comfortable spacing, clear hierarchy, rounded cards, and soft shadows. - Dark mode UI with energetic accent colors like electric blue, neon green, or vibrant orange. - Clear typography, realistic charts, elegant buttons, and a beautiful onboarding experience. - Highly detailed, Dribbble-compliant, startup-level product design. - Authentic UX. Case study presentation, non-cartoon or illustration style: - Complete website homepage mockup - Multiple UI sections presented in a sophisticated showcase - Product display perspective using micro-perspective or frontal views - Simple background with subtle gradients and professional lighting effects - High-resolution detail, crisp text rendering, and visually balanced layout: A stunning and realistic fitness app website and dashboard UI/UX design concept that looks ready for development. It resembles a genuine Figma product design demo for a high-end startup.

promptLocalized.zh:
设计一个现代、高端的 {argument name="app type" default="健身应用"} 着陆页及产品 UI，品牌名称为 {argument name="brand name" default="PulseFit"}。

创建一个简洁的 Web 设计模型，使其看起来像一个真实的 SaaS 健身平台及配套移动端应用。设计风格应体现高端感、激励性且易于使用，UI/UX 风格需对标顶级健康与健身应用。

包含内容：
- 首屏板块：包含醒目的标题、简短的副标题、强有力的行动号召（CTA）按钮以及应用预览
- 仪表盘 UI：展示每日活动、消耗卡路里、锻炼连续天数、心率、步数及进度环
- 锻炼计划卡片：涵盖力量、有氧、灵活性及恢复训练
- 营养追踪板块：包含宏量营养素分析及饮水量记录
- 进度图表与分析组件
- 教练/社区板块：包含个人资料卡片及用户评价
- 定价板块及应用商店下载引导
- 移动端应用界面：与 Web 设计并列展示，呈现统一的产品生态系统

风格导向：
- 时髦、极简、现代的界面
- 高端健身品牌美学
- 舒适的间距、清晰的层级、圆角卡片、柔和阴影
- 深色模式 UI，搭配电光蓝、霓虹绿或活力橙等充满能量的强调色
- 清晰的排版、真实的图表、精致的按钮、美观的引导页体验
- 高度细节化、符合 Dribbble 标准、具备初创公司水准的产品设计
- 真实的 UX 案例研究展示，非卡通或插画风格

构图：
- 完整的网站首页模型
- 在一个精致的展示中呈现多个 UI 板块
- 采用微透视或正视的产品展示视角
- 简洁的背景，带有微妙的渐变与专业灯光效果
- 超高细节、清晰的文字渲染、视觉平衡的布局

输出：
一个令人惊艳、逼真的健身应用网站及仪表盘 UI/UX 设计概念，看起来已达到可开发标准。

使其看起来像是一个针对高端初创公司的真实 Figma 产品设计演示。

Layered ships, surging waves, and whirlpools run through the foreground, midground, and background. Multiple ships collide and tilt at different spatial levels, sails tear, and flags flutter. The foreground is filled with narrative elements: treasure chests, coins, maps, barrels, ropes, lanterns, and a bounty poster featuring a smiling pirate. All atmospheric elements are presented in a paper-cut style: waves, splashes, smoke, fragments, and moving lines, reinforcing the sense of chaos and dynamism. The main subject is located in the middle layer, with elements interacting across layers, expressing movement through overlap and spatial relationships. Soft light from a single direction creates clear interlayered shadows. The overall finish is matte paper-like, with no glow, no soft edges, and no volumetric lighting. Octane rendering, 8K, clear details --ar 3:4 --stylize 450

promptLocalized.zh:
使用附带的角色，生成以下内容：

# 指令
为 {argument name="user input" default="[用户输入]"} 创建一张极简主义剧院风格的竖版海报，使用单色 + {argument name="accent color" default="一种强调色"}。

# 布局要求
- 将标题大字置于底部 1/4 区域，日文标题最大化，英文副标题紧随其下，字号较小。
- 在顶部中心放置一句宣传语（1-2 行）。
- 在左上角垂直堆叠 3-4 个奖项/官方认证徽章。
- 沿右侧边缘放置一句竖排宣传语（2-3 行）。
- 将主角以背影剪影形式置于中心偏左位置。
- 在背景中以剪影形式呈现奇幻元素（浮岛、巨型生物）。
- 在底部以小字水平行排列演职员表、上映日期和发行信息。
- 在右下角用大字体突出显示上映日期。

# 设计要求
- 保持背景为单色（黑色至灰色渐变）。
- 仅使用一种强调色（例如：鲜艳的钴蓝色或金色）。
- 结合剪影和细线条艺术风格。
- 标题文字使用白色 + 强调色进行强调。
- 整体营造电影感和艺术氛围。
- 避免使用彩色背景、过多的装饰或大量的渐变效果。
- 格式：竖版，长宽比 2:3，高分辨率。

templates.title: Abstract, chaotic style character art

titleLocalized.zh: 抽象混乱风格角色艺术

templates.prompt: # An artwork depicting a character's facial features through a chaotic collection of notes and symbols --- ## Style - The paper is covered with notes, formulas, symbols, and random lines written in black ink. - The paper has a graffiti-like chaotic feel scattered throughout. - Use{argument name="accent color" default="Red ink"} (Lines, fills, and marker-like color blocks) are used as scattered embellishments. - It has a texture that simulates notebook doodles. --- ## Composition - Random notes and symbols cover the entire image. - The density of black ink lines and characters is concentrated on the "character's face." - Therefore, the facial contours and expressions of a given character vaguely emerge from the chaos. - The face is not realistic, but rather a collection of chaotic fragments. --- ## Tone - Primarily monochrome (black and white).{argument name="accent color" default="Red ink"} Scattered accents for emphasis. - Low saturation, emphasizing the texture of simulated paper and ink. --- ## Expression Elements - A mix of semi-readable Japanese, English, and numerical strings. - Mathematical symbols, arrows, dots, diagonal lines, crosses, and ink drops. - The outlines of the face, eyes, and hair emerge from the "negative space" and "shadows" of the symbol arrangement. --- ## Prohibited Items - Directly realistic portraiture. - Neat geometric patterns after digital processing. - Colorful or oversaturated expressions. - Logos, watermarks, or artificial CG aesthetics. --- ## Definition of DoD - The overall work presents itself as a "chaotic collection of notes and symbols." - The provided character's face emerges naturally from the chaotic density and arrangement. - Colors limited to monochrome +{argument name="accent color" default="Red accents"} - Preserve the hand-painted texture of the paper and ink.

promptLocalized.zh:
# 通过混乱的笔记与符号集合呈现角色面部特征的艺术作品

---

## 风格
- 纸面上布满了黑墨水书写的笔记、公式、符号和随机线条。
- 纸张各处散布着涂鸦般的混乱感。
- 使用 {argument name="accent color" default="红色墨水"}（线条、填充、记号笔般的色块）进行零星点缀。
- 具有模拟笔记本涂鸦的质感。

---

## 构图
- 随机的笔记和符号覆盖整个画面。
- 黑墨水线条和字符的密度集中在“角色面部”的位置。
- 因此，给定角色的面部轮廓和表情会从混乱中隐约浮现。
- 面部并非写实风格，而是由混乱的碎片集合而成。

---

## 色调
- 以单色（黑白）为主。
- {argument name="accent color" default="红色墨水"} 零星点缀作为强调。
- 低饱和度，强调模拟纸张和墨水的质感。

---

## 表现元素
- 混合了半可读的日语、英语和数字字符串。
- 数学符号、箭头、点、斜线、十字和墨水滴。
- 面部、眼睛和头发的轮廓从符号排列的“负空间”和“阴影”中显现出来。

---

## 禁止事项
- 直接的写实肖像。
- 数字处理后的整齐几何图案。
- 多彩或过度饱和的表现形式。
- 徽标、水印或人工 CG 美学。

---

## 完成定义 (DoD)
- 整体作品呈现为“混乱的笔记与符号集合”。
- 所提供的角色面部能从混乱的密度和排列中自然浮现。
- 颜色仅限单色 + {argument name="accent color" default="红色点缀"}。
- 保持纸张和墨水的手绘质感。

templates.title: Cowboy Chameleon Magazine Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 牛仔变色龙杂志封面

templates.prompt: A photorealistic scene depicting the editorial lifestyle, shot from a slightly elevated three-quarter angle, shows a glossy magazine tilted at an angle on a warm, medium-brown wooden table. The magazine is the clear visual focus, occupying most of the frame. The cover background is a deep cobalt to navy blue, featuring a large close-up portrait of a bright green chameleon facing left, with clearly visible macro details—scale textures, bright eyes, and wearing a tan suede cowboy hat with a brown leather belt and small silver studs. The magazine title at the top is displayed in an elegant white large serif font.{argument name="magazine title" default="Convergence"} On the left side of the cover, a prominent stacked white sans-serif title is displayed.{argument name="headline text" default="CHATGPT IMAGES 2.0"} The magazine includes seven smaller cover text blocks: three brief feature summaries in a column below the title on the left, and four compact preview summaries at the bottom edge. Small, realistic magazine details are added to the upper right corner, including the price, date, and short lines of code, all in extremely small white font. The scene should evoke a snapshot of a casually arranged desktop in natural afternoon sunlight, with soft shadows of leaves and windows casting patterns on the wood and parts of the magazine. Around the magazine are four desktop elements: a partial view of a potted plant extending into the upper left corner, a partial view of an orange plate or bowl at the upper right edge, a multifaceted glass with a truncated right edge, and a piece of paper with handwritten text in the lower right corner.{argument name="sticky note text" default="SOTA"} The pale yellow sticky notes emphasize the authentic print quality, subtle cover reflections, the thickness of the paper on the magazine spine and bottom, warm shadows, and a sophisticated, modern product photography style.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张照片级逼真的编辑生活方式场景，采用略微抬高的四分之三俯视角度拍摄，展示了一本光面杂志斜放在温暖的中棕色木质桌面上。杂志是清晰的视觉焦点，占据了画面的大部分空间。封面背景为深钴蓝色至海军蓝，主体是一只鲜绿色变色龙的大幅特写肖像，它面向左侧，微距细节清晰可见，鳞片纹理分明，眼睛明亮，戴着一顶带有棕色皮带和小银铆钉的棕褐色麂皮牛仔帽。杂志顶部的刊名以优雅的白色大号衬线字体显示为 {argument name="magazine title" default="Convergence"}。在封面左侧，醒目的堆叠式白色无衬线标题显示为 {argument name="headline text" default="CHATGPT IMAGES 2.0"}。包含 7 个较小的封面文本块：标题下方左侧一列有 3 个简短的专题简介，底部边缘有 4 个紧凑的预告简介。在右上角添加细小的真实期刊细节，包括价格、日期和简短的代码行，均采用极小的白色字体。场景应呈现出自然午后阳光下随意摆放的桌面快照感，柔和的叶片窗影投射在木头和杂志的部分区域。在杂志周围，包含 4 个桌面元素：左上角伸入的盆栽植物局部、右上角边缘的橙色盘子或碗局部、右侧边缘被截断的多面玻璃杯，以及右下角一张写有手写文字 {argument name="sticky note text" default="SOTA"} 的淡黄色便签。强调真实的印刷质感、微妙的封面反光、杂志书脊和底部的纸张厚度、温暖的阴影，以及精致的现代产品摄影风格。
