templates.title: Retro Malta travel poster

titleLocalized.zh: 复古马耳他旅行海报

templates.prompt: A retro travel poster illustration, with the theme of{argument name="destination" default="malta"} The design style references mid-20th-century Mediterranean travel advertisements, featuring an elegant painterly realism and a slightly grainy, printed poster texture. A large headline is placed at the top center.{argument name="headline text" default="MALTA"} Use oversized cream-colored serif capital letters; immediately below is the subtitle.{argument name="subtitle text" default="MEDITERRANEAN PARADISE"} The image uses smaller, dark navy blue sans-serif capital letters. It shows Valletta's sunny coastal road winding along the rocky waterfront, positioned slightly above and behind a classic 1960s white sedan driving out of the frame in the lower left foreground; the license plate is displayed as {argument name="license plate" default="MTA 1964"} Across the harbor, warm honey-colored limestone buildings climb the hillside, including a large domed church, a soaring, narrow church spire, rows of historic townhouses (with multiple brightly colored enclosed wooden balconies), and distant city walls extending to the opposite shore. In the bay, three brightly colored (blue, yellow, red, green) traditional Maltese fishing boats are included, along with two small white sailboats in the distance. Four white seagulls soar against a bright turquoise sky, dotted with soft white clouds. The entire composition is framed by dark, lush trees and abundant bright magenta bougainvillea arching from the top and right edge, with more flowers in the lower right corner, forming a verdant border around the scene. A palm tree is added to the seaside buildings, and a spiky agave plant is placed in the lower left foreground. The use of warm golden sunlight, saturated coastal colors, a romantic holiday poster composition, and clear, legible typography creates a nostalgic and idealized Mediterranean atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张复古旅行海报插画，主题为 {argument name="destination" default="马耳他"}，设计风格参考 20 世纪中叶的地中海旅游广告，具有优雅的绘画写实感和轻微的印刷海报颗粒质感。在顶部中央，放置大号标题 {argument name="headline text" default="MALTA"}，使用超大号奶油色衬线大写字母；下方紧邻副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="MEDITERRANEAN PARADISE"}，使用较小的深海军蓝无衬线大写字母。画面展示瓦莱塔阳光明媚的沿海公路，沿着石质海滨蜿蜒，视角略高于并位于一辆经典的 1960 年代白色轿车后方，轿车正驶离画面，位于左下角前景；车牌显示为 {argument name="license plate" default="MTA 1964"}。在港口对面，描绘爬满山坡的暖蜂蜜色石灰岩建筑，包括 1 座大型圆顶教堂、1 座高耸狭窄的教堂尖塔、成排的历史联排别墅（带有多个色彩鲜艳的封闭式木制阳台），以及延伸至对岸的远方城墙。在海湾中，包含 3 艘色彩鲜艳（蓝、黄、红、绿）的传统马耳他渔船，以及远处 2 艘微小的白色帆船。在明亮的绿松石色天空中，加入 4 只飞翔的白色海鸥，并点缀柔软的白云。整个构图由深色枝叶茂密的树木和从顶部及右侧边缘拱起的繁茂亮洋红色三角梅框架，右下角也有更多花朵，在场景周围形成郁郁葱葱的边框。在海滨建筑群中加入一棵棕榈树，并在左下角前景处放置一株尖刺状的龙舌兰植物。运用温暖的金色阳光、饱和的海岸色彩、浪漫的度假海报构图、清晰易读的排版，营造出一种怀旧且理想化的地中海氛围。

Use a third-person perspective composition, with a seated figure in the foreground.{argument name="character description" default="A young man with short, dark hair and fair skin was wearing a plain black T-shirt and printed swim trunks."} He sits casually on the light-colored sand, his body slightly turned to one side, as if the player's perspective has stopped beside him. Positioning him slightly off-center on the left side of the screen, occupying a large proportion, his posture is natural and relaxed. Behind him, a high-end beach club is depicted, with three white pavilions with flowing curtains clearly visible on the beach, planted with several tall palm trees. To the left is turquoise water, and to the right is a row of Art Deco hotels with soft-toned exteriors and neon decorations. The beach is filled with 12 people in swimwear in the background: some are standing and chatting, some are walking along the shore, and two are sitting at a table on the right enjoying a meal. The scene includes white casual furniture and parasols, creating a sophisticated social party atmosphere. A realistic game HUD interface is added: in the lower left corner is a sign {argument name="map label" default="GPS route"} The small square map displays weapon and control icons in the bottom right corner and the amount in the top right corner.{argument name="money amount" default="$45,670"} The money counter. The overall look is similar to screenshots from the next-gen game *Grand Theft Auto VI*, with a cinematic feel and a distinct in-game texture. It boasts rich detail, realistic shadows, vibrant color gradations, and a lively coastal atmosphere, while also possessing {argument name="city setting" default="Vice City"} The subtle irony of luxurious beaches.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超逼真的开放世界犯罪类电子游戏截图，风格参考现代迈阿密风格的海滩俱乐部任务场景，画面呈现于明亮的午后阳光下，天空湛蓝。采用类似第三人称游戏视角的构图，前景中坐着 {argument name="character description" default="一位留着深色短发、肤色白皙的年轻男子，身穿纯黑色 T 恤和印花泳裤"}，他随意地坐在浅色沙滩上，身体微微侧向一旁，仿佛玩家视角在他身旁停下。将他置于画面左侧偏中心位置，占据较大比例，姿态自然放松。在他身后，描绘一个高档海滩俱乐部，沙滩上清晰可见 3 个带有飘逸窗帘的白色凉亭，种植着多棵高大的棕榈树，左侧是绿松石色的海水，右侧是一排具有装饰艺术风格的酒店，外墙呈柔和色调并带有霓虹装饰。海滩上布满了 12 位身着泳装的背景人群：有人站着聊天，有人在岸边行走，另有 2 人坐在右侧的餐桌旁享用餐饮。画面包含白色休闲家具、遮阳伞，营造出精致的社交派对氛围。添加逼真的游戏 HUD 界面：左下角是一个标有 {argument name="map label" default="GPS 路线"} 的方形小地图，右下角显示武器和控制图标，右上角显示金额为 {argument name="money amount" default="$45,670"} 的金钱计数器。整体观感应类似于次世代《Grand Theft Auto VI》的游戏截图，具有电影感且呈现出明显的游戏内质感，细节丰富、阴影真实、色彩分级充满活力的海岸气息，并带有 {argument name="city setting" default="罪恶都市"} 中那种微妙的奢华海滩讽刺感。

titleLocalized.zh: 海滩俱乐部开放世界游戏截图

templates.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic screenshot of an open-world crime game, inspired by a modern Miami-style beach city. The image showcases {argument name="character description" default="A stylish young man with short black hair and a neatly trimmed beard, wearing aviator sunglasses and a dark blue Hawaiian shirt printed with large pink and orange flowers."} Standing at the bar of an outdoor beach club, holding a tropical cocktail garnished with fruit, the player character is positioned in a third-person game cinematic perspective, shot from behind the bartender. The player character is centered to the left, facing a bartender in a light blue polo shirt, separated by a white stone bar counter. The scene is set in the warm afternoon sun, a lively beach party, featuring one bartender, one main playable character, and approximately 12 partygoers dancing and socializing on the sand and deck behind. The background includes tall palm trees, the horizon, beach umbrellas, bottles on the bar counter, and an Art Deco club building with a glowing neon sign that reads…{argument name="club name" default="VICE BEACH CLUB"} And a circular neon palm tree logo. This creates a luxurious, sun-drenched "Sin City" atmosphere with long shadows, mist, reflections, and saturated tropical colors. Overlaying realistic video game HUD elements: a small circular map in the lower left corner and a circular weapon selection wheel in the lower right corner with eight slots, clearly displaying icons for pistols, submachine guns, shotguns, rifles, melee weapons, throwables, and empty/inactive slots. The imagery should have the quality of a high-quality AAA console game screenshot, with extremely rich detail, realistic skin and fabric textures, natural crowd dynamics, shallow depth of field, and subtle lens flares.

templates.title: Anime Martial Arts Dojo Showdown

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫武术道场对决

templates.prompt: A dynamic anime-style illustration depicts two young female martial arts practitioners battling in a traditional Japanese wooden dojo. The fighter on the left, in the foreground, is a black-haired girl with a neat bun tied with a yellow ribbon. She wears a sleeveless yellow Chinese kung fu top with black trim, loose black pants, and black cloth shoes. She crouches low on the wooden floor, one hand pulling back while the other punches forward, a bright red energy trail swirling around her body and sweeping across the entire frame. Water splashes violently at her feet, as if her movements are skimming across shallow water. The fighter on the right, in mid-ground, is a fair-skinned girl with light purple double buns. She wears a black and white striped short cheongsam-style combat outfit with gold trim, black sheer pantyhose, and black shoes. She is executing a flying kick, a vibrant blue energy spiral swirling around her. The collision of their forces causes the wooden floor on the right side to crack and explode, sending fragments and wood chips flying outwards, while dust and smoke billow in the lower right corner. The dojo's interior features exposed wooden beams, tatami mat edges, and shoji-style windows, with warm natural light streaming in from the left. Above them hangs a wooden plaque with Chinese text.{argument name="sign text" default="Binance vs OKX"} It employs dramatic wide-angle compositions, strong perspective shortening, cinematic motion blur, strong speed lines, high-detail anime rendering, glossy highlights, clean line art, vibrant battle choreography, and exquisite poster-quality textures. It adds two visible fighters, a wooden sign above their heads, a cracked floor impact point, a red energy effect surrounding the fighter on the left, and a blue energy effect surrounding the fighter on the right. An optional subtle watermark-style text can be placed in the lower right corner, containing the following text:{argument name="watermark text" default="UM YouMind"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满动感的动漫动作插画，描绘了两名年轻武术少女在传统的日式木质道场内对战的场景。左侧的格斗者位于前景，是一位黑发少女，扎着整齐的发髻，系着黄色丝带，身穿无袖黄色中国功夫上衣，配黑色滚边、宽松黑裤和黑色布鞋。她正以低姿势蹲在木地板上，一手后拉，另一手向前出拳，身体周围环绕着明亮的红色能量轨迹，并横扫整个画面。水花在她脚下剧烈飞溅，仿佛她的动作掠过了浅浅的水面。右侧的格斗者位于中景的半空中，是一位皮肤白皙的少女，留着淡紫色双丸子头，身穿黑白相间的短款旗袍风格战斗服，配金色滚边、黑色透肉连裤袜和黑色鞋子。她正在施展飞踢，一道鲜艳的蓝色能量螺旋呈圆形环绕着她。两人力量的碰撞使得中右侧的木地板开裂并炸开，碎片和木屑向外飞溅，尘土和烟雾在右下角翻滚。道场内部有裸露的木梁、榻榻米边缘、障子风格的窗户，温暖的自然光从左侧射入。在她们上方悬挂一块木牌，上面写着中文文本 {argument name="sign text" default="币安 vs OKX"}。采用戏剧性的广角构图、强烈的透视缩短、电影级的动态模糊、强烈的速度线、高细节的动漫渲染、光泽高光、干净的线条艺术、充满活力的战斗编排以及精致的海报级质感。添加 2 名可见的格斗者、1 块头顶木牌、1 个开裂的地板撞击点、1 个环绕左侧格斗者的红色能量特效，以及 1 个环绕右侧格斗者的蓝色能量特效。可选择在右下角放置一段微妙的水印式文本，内容为 {argument name="watermark text" default="UM YouMind"}。

templates.title: Low-angle street photography of women running

templates.prompt: A realistic candid street photo, in which {argument name="subject" default="A young Russian woman"} He was rushing to school, running towards the camera, one hand on his chest, and mouth {argument name="prop" default="Holding a slice of toast"} She was wearing{argument name="dress style" default="A light beige printed long-sleeved fitted waist flowy dress"} Flat shoes, skirt swaying with her movements. Shot from an extremely low, insect-eye perspective, against a backdrop of a rough roadside in a simple urban neighborhood, making her appear against a vast, unobstructed view.{argument name="sky color" default="Deep cobalt blue"} Against the backdrop of the sky, it appears exceptionally tall. A dense network of crisscrossing overhead power lines and poles spans the upper half of the frame, creating a strong geometric tension. The intense midday sunlight casts clear, deep shadows on the dusty ground. The image includes four slightly blurred figures in the background, walking away or crossing the street, along with several cars in the distance and low-rise buildings on either side of the road. The composition should convey a chaotic, youthful, cinematic, and frozen-in-a-moment visual effect, employing a wide-angle lens, high-fidelity realism, fine film grain, strong contrast, and a slightly nostalgic color palette.{argument name="film look" default="Fujifilm Classic Negative"} Its aesthetic style.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实的抓拍街头照片，画面中 {argument name="subject" default="一位年轻的俄罗斯女性"} 正匆忙赶往学校，向镜头方向奔跑，一只手放在胸前，嘴里 {argument name="prop" default="叼着一片吐司"}。她穿着 {argument name="dress style" default="一件浅米色印花长袖收腰飘逸连衣裙"} 和平底鞋，裙摆随动作飘动。采用极低角度的虫眼视角拍摄，背景是简朴城市社区的粗糙路边，使她在巨大的、无遮挡的 {argument name="sky color" default="深钴蓝色"} 天空映衬下显得格外高挑。密集的交叉架空电线和电线杆横跨画面上半部分，营造出强烈的几何张力。使用正午强烈的阳光，在尘土飞扬的地面上投下清晰、深邃的阴影。画面中包含 4 名背景行人，略显模糊，正走远或穿过街道，此外还有几辆远处的汽车和道路两侧的低矮建筑。构图应呈现出混乱、青春、电影感和定格瞬间的视觉效果，采用广角镜头、高保真写实风格、细腻的胶片颗粒感、强烈的对比度、略带怀旧的色彩渲染，以及 {argument name="film look" default="Fujifilm Classic Negative"} 的美学风格。

templates.title: Review point cloud portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 审查点云肖像

templates.prompt: A minimalist monochrome portrait, composed entirely of millions of tiny white dot clouds against a pitch-black background, depicts a half-length portrait of an adult male from the chest up, wearing a formal dark suit jacket and a light-colored collared shirt. The subject is slightly right-centered, facing forward with a subtle two-thirds turn, sporting neatly combed short hair, and a visible ear clearly outlined by dense, lidar-like particles. The figure is rendered as a combination of raw 3D scan data and topological contour logic: ultra-dense dots, precise geometric points, subtle contour structures, and clear depth sculpting in the hair, suit lapel, collar, neck, and shoulders. The face is deliberately occluded by a large, vertical rectangular review block ranging from dark gray to black, perfectly centered in the facial area from the forehead to below the nose, creating a striking privacy mask effect. The rendering uses a matte finish, sharp edges, sharp focus, high contrast, and is free of halos, blooms, neon, fog, motion blur, chromatic aberration, and brushstrokes. Add a small, light gray four-pointed star icon to the bottom right corner. The overall image should have a mathematical, forensic, and futuristic feel, like an 8K resolution LiDAR scan portrait.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极简主义的单色肖像，完全由漆黑背景上数百万个微小的白色点云颗粒组成，展示了 1 位成年男性从胸部以上的半身像，身穿正式的深色西装外套和浅色翻领衬衫。主体略微偏右居中，正面朝向并带有微妙的三分之二侧转，梳理整齐的短发，一只可见的耳朵由致密的激光雷达式粒子清晰勾勒。将人物渲染为原始 3D 扫描数据与拓扑轮廓逻辑的结合：超致密的点画、精确的几何点位、微弱的等高线结构，以及在头发、西装翻领、衣领、颈部和肩部呈现清晰的深度塑形。面部由 1 个位于深灰色至黑色的大型垂直矩形审查块刻意遮挡，该遮挡块完美居中于从前额到鼻下方的面部区域，营造出鲜明的隐私遮罩效果。使用哑光质感、清晰的边缘、锐利对焦、高对比度，无光晕、无泛光、无霓虹、无雾气、无动态模糊、无色差，无绘画笔触。在右下角添加 1 个浅灰色的小型四角星形图标。整体图像应具有数学感、取证感和未来感，如同 8k 分辨率的激光雷达扫描肖像。

templates.prompt: A{argument name="city" default="London"} High-resolution overhead satellite map with the city center as its core, closely focused on{argument name="landmark" default="Big Ben"} And the area surrounding Westminster Palace on the banks of the Thames. Presented as a realistic aerial orthophoto, reminiscent of a modern digital map or satellite image, it includes detailed rooftops, streets, trees, shadows, and the brownish-brown river water. The long, narrow Westminster Palace complex is placed vertically on the right side of the image, adjacent to the west bank of the river, with Big Ben located in the northeast corner of the palace near the riverbank. A building labeled {argument name="bridge name" default="Westminster Bridge"} The bridge spans the river from left to right at the bottom of the image. A total of 6 visible map tags are included.{argument name="label 1" default="Westminster Abbey"} ,{argument name="label 2" default="Parliament Square"} Big Ben, Palace of Westminster, Westminster Bridge, and the Horse Guards Parade are all included. Whitehall is also marked as a road, vertically displayed on the left side of the palace area. Surrounding details should include Westminster Abbey in the upper left quadrant, Parliament Square above the palace, the Horse Guards Parade in the lower left quadrant as a large, sand-colored rectangle, the dense city blocks and roads in the left half, the Thames River occupying the entire right side, the embankments on both banks, a few boats on the river, and tree-lined streets and parks. Natural satellite imagery colors and clear map annotations are used to create an enlarged online map screenshot effect.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张以 {argument name="city" default="伦敦"} 市中心为核心的高分辨率俯视卫星地图，紧密聚焦于 {argument name="landmark" default="大本钟"} 及泰晤士河畔威斯敏斯特宫周边区域。呈现出现代数字地图或卫星图层般的逼真航拍正射视角，包含详细的屋顶、街道、树木、阴影及棕褐色的河水。将长条形的威斯敏斯特宫建筑群垂直放置在画面中右侧，紧邻河流西岸，大本钟位于宫殿东北角靠近河岸的位置。一座标注为 {argument name="bridge name" default="威斯敏斯特桥"} 的桥梁在画面底部从左至右横跨河流。总共包含 6 个可见地图标签：{argument name="label 1" default="威斯敏斯特教堂"}、{argument name="label 2" default="议会广场"}、大本钟、威斯敏斯特宫、威斯敏斯特桥和骑兵卫队阅兵场。同时将白厅作为一条标注道路，垂直显示在宫殿区域左侧。周边细节应包括左上象限的威斯敏斯特教堂、宫殿上方的议会广场、左下象限作为大型沙色长方形场地的骑兵卫队阅兵场、左半部分密集的城市街区与道路、占据整个右侧的泰晤士河、两岸的堤岸、河上的少量船只以及绿树成荫的街道与公园。采用自然的卫星图像色彩、清晰的地图标注叠加层，呈现出放大后的在线地图截图效果。

promptLocalized.zh: {"type":"技术飞机剖面信息图海报","subject":{"title":"{argument name=\"headline text\" default=\"极限结构：飞机解剖档案\"}","aircraft":"宽体商用客机侧面剖视图，机头朝左，机尾朝右，起落架放下，可见一个大型翼下发动机，内部客舱和系统完全暴露","style":"超精细航空工程蓝图与建筑档案图板结合，精确的横截面绘图，密集的标注线，清晰易读的微型文字，柔和的水墨渲染，米白色陈旧纸张纹理，蓝灰色石墨线条，微妙的棕褐色和钢色点缀"},"layout":{"format":"单张大型横向海报","background":"全页工程示意图，带有分层正投影轮廓、测量标记、引出线、技术说明和淡淡的绘图网格","centerpiece":"一架巨大的飞机横截面，横跨页面几乎全宽，展示了驾驶舱、乘客座椅排、服务舱、内部管道、货舱、结构框架和尾部系统","sections":[{"title":"驾驶舱","position":"左上","count":1,"labels":["1"],"description":"驾驶舱内部插图，包括飞行员座椅、仪表盘、窗户和周围的航空电子设备"},{"title":"厨房与餐车","position":"左上驾驶舱下方","count":1,"labels":["2"],"description":"服务厨房插图，包括储物架、烤箱、餐车、橱柜和狭窄的过道"},{"title":"卫生间模块","position":"左中厨房下方","count":1,"labels":["3"],"description":"小型洗手间插图，包括马桶、洗手池、墙板和门"},{"title":"环境控制系统","position":"右上","count":1,"labels":["6"],"description":"机械系统插图，包括管道、涡轮机和圆柱形设备"},{"title":"燃油系统","position":"右中","count":1,"labels":["8"],"description":"紧凑型机械插图，展示了油箱、泵和管道系统"},{"title":"航空电子设备","position":"左下","count":1,"labels":["4"],"description":"电子设备舱插图，包括布线、机柜、设备架以及附近的起落架"},{"title":"起落架舱","position":"左下偏中","count":1,"labels":["5"],"description":"起落架舱插图，重点展示轮组、支柱和周围结构"},{"title":"卫生间核心区","position":"底部中央","count":2,"labels":["LAVATORY CORE","LAVATORY CORE"],"description":"2 个独立的服务核心插图，展示了暴露的圆柱形水箱、管道和内部支撑系统；右侧插图带有标签编号 7"},{"title":"后部服务区","position":"右下","count":1,"labels":["8"],"description":"后部技术舱插图，带有大型蓝色圆柱形单元、管道、服务入口和结构框架"}],"additional_labels":[{"text":"货舱","position":"下中偏左"},{"text":"结构框架","position":"下中"}],"legend":{"position":"底部中央","count":9,"labels":["驾驶舱","客舱","厨房","航空电子设备","货舱","结构框架","卫生间核心区","环境控制系统","燃油系统"]}},"composition":{"camera":"正投影侧视图","poster_margins":"整张纸周围有细边框","text_density":"非常高，页面上分布着许多微小的注释、箭头和零件标签","lighting":"平面的档案插图照明，非摄影风格，针对可读性进行了优化","finish":"清晰的 4K 信息图打印质量，无乱码文字，正宗的排版，严谨的线条精度"}}

templates.title: Screenshot of VINCO editing style project

titleLocalized.zh: VINCO 编辑风格项目截图

templates.prompt: Create a 4:5 editable fashion catalog project for use in a format called{argument name="brand name" default="VINCO"} The fictional brand. The images employ a dark, screenshot-style aesthetic, with a large, rounded charcoal gray text panel at the top and a 2x3 six-image fashion/editing grid in the lower left quadrant. The overall aesthetic blends Italian archival graphic design with late 1990s Southern California streetwear, mixing natural wine culture, skateboarding pragmatism, and sun-faded documentary fashion photography. It features rough yet precise art direction, midday outdoor lighting, slightly chaotic yet rigorous typography, and uses real people rather than glamorous fashion models. The top text panel displays a long, white sans-serif creative direction paragraph describing the shoot, containing multiple lines of text, much like AI prompts or design briefs displayed on a near-black background within rounded dark gray bubbles. The image grid contains six tiles: Tile 1 shows a young man in an oversized, faded olive green T-shirt and dark trousers standing against a poster-like gray-white background, with a striking {argument name="logo text" default="VINCO"} Brand logo, barcode graphic, and small-print edited text; Tile 2 is a close-up still life of a dark wine bottle with a minimalist white label that reads {argument name="bottle label" default="VINCO"} Shot in warm sunlight, it has a realistic paper texture and shadows; Tile 3 shows a person with their back to the camera, wearing a washed olive green long-sleeved shirt with a prominent but understated brand logo on the chest or back, paired with white shorts, and a yellow hangtag or sticker element in the upper right corner, against a background of light-colored walls with blue stripe details and editorial typography text; Tile 4 shows a skateboarder crouching or gliding, shot from behind, wearing a white T-shirt with a large black graphic on the back and dark shorts, on a pavement in golden sunlight; Tile 5 is a printed flat lay of wine-related merchandise, using cream-colored paper and a light yellow-green label or brochure, with the words {argument name="product text" default="Vino Naturale"} The six images, featuring grape illustrations, small bold text, and layered paper scraps, include a white T-shirt with a race number "97" printed on the chest, a fluorescent yellow-green hat with small branding text, and an outdoor palm tree and bright sky in the background. The overall design maintains a slightly imperfect, collage-like feel, as if extracted from an event plan or saved reference material. Earth tones are used throughout: olive green, cream, charcoal gray, sun-bleached white, asphalt gray, and soft browns, with a fluorescent yellow-green repeated as an accent in the details. A visible interface frame surrounds the composition: a dark applied background, a left-aligned lower image grid, a rounded gray "Edit" button in the lower left corner, and a small circular icon in the lower right corner to emphasize that this is a screenshot of a generated project, not a clean standalone poster.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个 4:5 的编辑时尚画册项目，用于名为 {argument name="brand name" default="VINCO"} 的虚构品牌。图像采用深色界面截图风格，上半部分是一个大型圆角炭灰色文本面板，左下象限是一个 2x3 的六图时尚/编辑图像网格。整体美学融合了意大利档案图形设计与 20 世纪 90 年代末南加州街头服饰，混合了自然酒文化、滑板实用主义和阳光褪色的纪实时尚摄影。采用粗犷但精准的艺术指导、正午户外光线、略显混乱但严谨的排版，并使用真实人物选角而非精致的时尚模特。在顶部文本面板中，显示一段长篇白色无衬线创意指导段落，描述拍摄内容，包含多行文案，就像显示在近乎黑色的背景上、圆角深灰色气泡内的 AI 提示词或设计简报。在图像网格中，包含 6 个图块：图块 1 展示了一名身穿超大号褪色橄榄绿 T 恤和深色长裤的年轻人，站在类似海报的灰白色背景前，带有醒目的 {argument name="logo text" default="VINCO"} 品牌标识、条形码图形和小字编辑文本；图块 2 是一个深色酒瓶的特写静物，带有极简主义白色标签，上面写着 {argument name="bottle label" default="VINCO"}，在温暖的阳光下拍摄，具有真实的纸张质感和阴影；图块 3 展示了一个背对镜头的人，穿着水洗橄榄绿长袖衬衫，胸部或背部有醒目但低调的品牌标识，搭配白色短裤，右上角有黄色吊牌或贴纸元素，背景是带有蓝色条纹细节的浅色墙壁和编辑排版文本；图块 4 展示了一名滑板手蹲着或滑走，从背后拍摄，穿着背面有大块黑色图形的白色 T 恤和深色短裤，在金色阳光下的路面上；图块 5 是印刷的葡萄酒周边平铺图，使用奶油色纸张和浅黄绿色酒标或小册子，上面写着 {argument name="product text" default="Vino Naturale"}，带有葡萄插图、小字黑体文本和分层纸张碎片；图块 6 展示了一个面向镜头的人，穿着白色 T 恤，胸前印有类似比赛号码牌的“97”字样，戴着荧光黄绿色帽子，上面有小字品牌文本，背景是户外棕榈树和明亮的天空。保持这六张图像略显不完美且具有拼贴感，就像从活动方案或保存的参考资料中提取的一样。通篇使用大地色调：橄榄绿、奶油色、炭灰色、阳光漂白后的白色、沥青灰、柔和的棕色，并在细节处重复使用一种荧光黄绿色作为点缀。在构图周围包含可见的界面框架：深色应用背景、左对齐的下方图像网格，以及左下角的一个圆角灰色“编辑”按钮，右下角还有一个小圆形图标，以强调这是一张生成的项目截图，而非干净的独立海报。

templates.title: Historical Invention Timeline Grid

titleLocalized.zh: 历史发明时间轴网格

templates.prompt: Create a square infographic-style illustration to showcase a{argument name="grid size" default="15×15"} The invention timeline grid is rendered as a collection of miniature isometric stereoscopic models on aged parchment bricks. The image should resemble a meticulously curated historical poster, spanning from {argument name="starting year" default="1000 BC"} arrive{argument name="ending year" default="2026"} Each brick showcases a unique invention, with no repetition. A 5x5 visible portion of a larger grid displays a total of 25 labeled bricks, neatly arranged with thin, dark borders between rows and columns. Each brick contains a unique, world-changing invention, depicted as a small, handcrafted 3D model with era-defining materials, colors, and background details. Ancient and medieval inventions use warm, antique tones, early modern inventions use sepia-toned technical documentation, and modern digital and biotechnology inventions use cool, neon blue lighting. The grid is surrounded by old map borders and subtle historical cartographic textures, gradually merging into a subtle modern network graphic in the lower right corner. Each visible brick is labeled with a small beige tag in bold black text. The 25 visible inventions are listed in reading order from top left to bottom right: 1){argument name="first tile label" default="1000 BC"} 1) Bricks, displaying iron plows and simple hand tools in a farmland, labeled "Iron Plows and Tools"; 2) "The Concept of Zero," displayed as parchment-style bricks with engraved zero symbols and blue hourglasses; 3) "Water Clock," displayed as a wooden timekeeping device; 4) "Catapult," displayed as a wooden siege weapon; 5) "Antikitra Mechanism," displayed as a complex bronze gear mechanism in a stone niche; 6) "Concrete," displayed as a wheelbarrow filled with wet cement or mortar; 7) "Wheeler," displayed as a simple wooden unicycle; 8) "Windmill," displayed as a traditional mill in a meadow; 9) "Gunpowder," displayed as a wooden barrel and a pile of black powder emitting smoke; 10) "Printing Press," displayed as a wooden printing press under a classical cylindrical frame; 11) "Mechanical Clock," displayed as an ornate standing clock; 12) "Telescope," displayed as an early brass telescope on a tripod, accompanied by sketch-style scientific notes; 13) "Steam Engine," displayed on blue blueprint-style bricks with an early locomotive engine; 14) 15) "Battery," displayed on a blueprint-style brick with two cylindrical battery cells and wiring; 16) "Telegraph," displayed as a Morse key on technical paper; 17) "Light Bulb," displayed emitting a warm light on a neutral base; 18) "Automobile," displayed as an early red car against a workshop planning background; 19) "Airplane," displayed as a miniature commercial jet; 20) "Transistor," displayed as a black microchip on a glowing project brick; 21) "Personal Computer," displayed as a beige desktop computer with a CRT monitor and keyboard; 22) "World Wide Web," displayed as a glowing blue globe above digital circuitry; 23) "Smartphone," displayed as a stylish modern mobile phone against a neon technology background; 24) "CRISPR-Cas9," displayed as a DNA double helix structure in a biotechnology blue display brick; 25) "Reusable Rocket," displayed as several rockets launching vertically with exhaust plumes; 26) "AI (LLMs)," displayed as a giant glowing letter AI in a holographic technology cube; "Brain-Computer Interface" is presented as a glowing hologram of the brain on a blue platform; 27) "Advanced Neural Interface (Implant)" is presented as a transparent profile of a human head with a glowing brain implant, topped with a small label "2026". Maintain a highly organized, poster-like, and visually dense composition, with each element clearly defined. Use subtle isometric perspective, clean lines, painterly shadows, and refined editorial illustration quality. The overall feel should combine elements of museum posters, educational timelines, and imaginative historical and technological 3D model art.

promptLocalized.zh:
创建一个方形信息图风格的插图，展示一个 {argument name="grid size" default="15×15"} 的发明时间轴网格，渲染为陈旧羊皮纸砖块上的微型等轴测立体模型集合。图像应看起来像一张精心策划的历史海报，跨度从 {argument name="starting year" default="公元前 1000 年"} 到 {argument name="ending year" default="2026 年"}，每个砖块展示一项发明，且不重复。显示较大网格中 5 乘 5 的可见部分，总共 25 个带有标签的砖块，排列整齐，行与列之间有细深色边框。每个砖块都包含一项改变世界的独特发明，描绘成带有时代特征的材料、颜色和背景细节的小型手工立体模型。古代和中世纪发明使用温暖的古董色调，早期现代发明使用棕褐色技术文档色调，现代数字和生物技术发明使用冷色调的霓虹蓝灯光。网格周围环绕着旧地图边框和微妙的历史制图纹理，右下角逐渐融入淡淡的现代网络图形。

用醒目的黑色粗体文字为每个可见砖块贴上米色小标签。按从左上到右下的阅读顺序，包含以下 25 项可见发明：1) {argument name="first tile label" default="公元前 1000 年"} 砖块，展示农田里的铁犁和简易手工工具，标签为“铁犁与工具”；2) “零的概念”，展示为带有雕刻零符号和蓝色沙漏的羊皮纸风格砖块；3) “水钟”，展示为木制计时装置；4) “投石机”，展示为木制攻城器械；5) “安提基特拉机械”，展示为石龛中复杂的青铜齿轮装置；6) “混凝土”，展示为装满湿水泥或砂浆的手推车；7) “独轮车”，展示为简单的木制单轮车；8) “风车”，展示为草地上的传统磨坊；9) “火药”，展示为木桶和一堆带有烟雾的黑色粉末；10) “印刷机”，展示为古典圆柱框架下的木制印刷机；11) “机械钟”，展示为华丽的立式钟；12) “望远镜”，展示为三脚架上的早期黄铜望远镜，配有素描风格的科学笔记；13) “蒸汽机”，展示在蓝色蓝图风格的砖块上，带有早期火车头引擎；14) “电池”，展示在蓝图风格的砖块上，带有两个圆柱形电池单元和线路；15) “电报”，展示为技术纸张上的莫尔斯电报键；16) “灯泡”，展示在中性底座上发出温暖的光；17) “汽车”，展示为车间规划背景下的早期红色汽车；18) “飞机”，展示为微型商用喷气式飞机；19) “晶体管”，展示为发光项目砖块上的黑色微芯片；20) “个人电脑”，展示为带有 CRT 显示器和键盘的米色台式电脑；21) “万维网”，展示为数字电路之上发光的蓝色地球仪；22) “智能手机”，展示为霓虹科技背景下时尚的现代手机；23) “CRISPR-Cas9”，展示为生物科技蓝色显示砖块中的 DNA 双螺旋结构；24) “可重复使用火箭”，展示为几枚竖立发射并带有尾气的火箭；25) “AI (LLMs)”，展示为全息科技立方体中发光的巨大字母 AI；26) “脑机接口”，展示为蓝色平台上的发光大脑全息图；27) “高级神经接口 (植入物)”，展示为带有发光大脑植入物的透明人头侧影，顶部带有小标签“2026 年”。

保持构图高度组织化、海报感强且视觉密集，每个砖块一目了然。使用轻微的等轴测透视、清晰的线条、绘画般的阴影和精致的编辑插图质量。整体感觉应结合博物馆海报、教育时间轴和富有想象力的历史科技立体模型艺术。

templates.title: Elegant Anime Female Swordsman 4-Panel Concept Art

titleLocalized.zh: 优雅动漫女剑士 4 格设定图

templates.prompt: An exquisite anime/fantasy illustration, presented in a 2x2 grid layout, showcases four scenes of the same elegant female swordsman. The character is a young woman with extremely long platinum-white hair, tied in a high ponytail with a large, deep navy blue bow. Her hair is soft, curly, and flowing, her skin is fair, her features delicate and refined, and her eyes are bright reddish-pink. She wears a magnificent white and blue gothic aristocratic dress: a white high-necked ruffled blouse with lace trim and gold embroidery, a large navy blue bow adorned with a ruby ​​brooch at the chest, puff sleeves with ribbon cuffs, a deep navy blue corset with gold details, and a voluminous navy blue skirt decorated with gold patterns, layered ruffles, and a satin sheen. She carries a katana with a dark hilt and gold embellishments. The first panel is a close-up portrait from the chest up, her body slightly turned to the side, her hair dramatically outlined against a dark, shimmering night sky. The second frame is a dynamic upper-body shot, showing the character drawing or displaying her sword horizontally, her hair flying wildly in the wind, against a cinematic, blurred cityscape background surrounded by glowing petals. The third frame is a full-body fashion portrait, where she stands elegantly in a brightly lit hall surrounded by towering, luminous buildings, showcasing the full silhouette of her dress, bow-adorned high heels, and the sword at her side. The fourth frame is a three-quarter view of her back taken at sunset or dawn on a shimmering beach, with the character looking back against a warm, soft-toned sky and sparkling water, cherry blossom petals falling in the wind. The game employs ultra-detailed anime rendering, achieving light novel cover-level image quality, with delicate fabric textures, glossy highlights, gold accents, soft halos, dramatic backlighting, floating petals, shimmering particles, an elegant and romantic atmosphere, and a harmonious color scheme of navy blue, white, gold, and pale pink.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的动漫奇幻插画设定图，采用 2x2 网格布局，展示了同一位优雅女剑士的 4 个画面。角色为一位年轻女性，拥有一头极长的铂金白发，扎成高马尾并系有深海军蓝色的巨大蝴蝶结，发丝柔软卷曲且飘逸，皮肤白皙，五官精致细腻，双眸呈现明亮的红粉色。她身着华丽的白蓝配色哥特贵族裙装：带有蕾丝花边和金色刺绣的白色高领荷叶边衬衫，胸前饰有镶嵌红色宝石胸针的巨大海军蓝蝴蝶结，泡泡袖配有丝带袖口，深海军蓝色束腰紧身胸衣带有金色细节，蓬松的海军蓝色裙摆装饰着金色花纹、层叠的荷叶边，并带有缎面光泽。她携带一把带有深色剑柄和金色装饰的武士刀。第 1 格为胸部以上的特写肖像，身体微侧，在深色闪烁的夜空背景下，头发呈现出戏剧性的轮廓光。第 2 格为动态的上半身动作镜头，角色正横向拔剑或展示剑身，头发随风狂舞，背景为电影感的城市夜景虚化效果，周围环绕着发光的花瓣。第 3 格为全身时尚肖像，她优雅地站在高耸发光建筑环绕的明亮反光大厅中，展示了裙装的完整轮廓、带蝴蝶结的高跟鞋以及身侧的佩剑。第 4 格为日落或黎明时分在波光粼粼的海边拍摄的四分之三背影，角色回眸，背景是温暖的柔和色调天空和闪烁的水面，樱花花瓣随风飘落。采用超精细动漫渲染，轻小说封面级画质，细腻的织物纹理，光泽高光，金色装饰，柔和光晕，戏剧性背光，漂浮花瓣，闪烁粒子，优雅浪漫的氛围，以及海军蓝、白、金、淡粉色的和谐配色。

templates.title: Golden Hour Cafe Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 黄金时刻咖啡馆人像

templates.prompt: A warm, candid portrait of a street café editor. A relaxed young woman sits alone at a small round table on a narrow European cobblestone street, basking in the afternoon sun. She wears an oversized cream-colored knit V-neck sweater and loose light blue jeans. Her dark brown hair is casually tied into a messy bun, with a few strands falling loose. She sits casually, one knee raised, one hand holding a small white espresso cup, the other resting on a saucer on the table. Six items are clearly visible on the table: a terracotta potted plant on the left edge, a glass sugar jar with a metal lid in the foreground, a black smartphone, an open paperback book, a white saucer with a small spoon, and a white espresso cup with a delicate red logo. To the left of the café is the shop window, and to the right is a row of outdoor tables and chairs extending into the background. Pedestrians and buildings in the distance are blurred. promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实的室内镜面自拍，画面中一位身材苗条的年轻女性站在光线温馨的现代公寓客厅里，身穿一件修身的象牙白单肩紧身中长裙，躯干和臀部带有褶皱设计。她留着深棕色中分齐肩直发，佩戴极简首饰，包括 2 枚戒指、一只银色手镯和一对精致的小耳环。她用一只手举着手机自拍，手机壳为黑色，饰有红色云纹，遮住了她的脸部。她身体微微侧转，姿态放松，一只手臂自然下垂，展现出自然的女性轮廓。画面采用竖构图，呈现出休闲社交媒体穿搭镜面自拍的视角。她身后是一张米色布艺沙发，上面放着 1 个灰色几何图案靠垫和 1 个灰褐色皮质手提包。背景包括一面质感十足的古铜棕色装饰墙、光亮的奶油色瓷砖地面、左侧昏暗的走廊（挂有 3 幅装裱艺术画）以及温暖的嵌入式天花板射灯。柔和的傍晚环境光，自然的肤色，写实的织物张力和褶皱，镜面中细腻的反射，整洁的高档公寓美学，高写实度，照片级皮肤纹理，智能手机拍摄视角。

templates.title: Realistic Aliens in the Deep Valley

titleLocalized.zh: 深谷中的写实外星人

templates.prompt: A cinematic full-body portrait depicts a deeply unsettling humanoid alien standing alone in a dark, rocky canyon. Centered, facing the camera directly, its posture is neutral and upright, arms hanging naturally. The creature is extremely tall and slender, with long limbs, narrow shoulders, a sunken torso, clearly visible ribcage, taut muscles, long forearms, enormous hands with slender fingers, and long, digitigrade feet firmly planted on the damp, black ground. Its hairless, smooth, greyish-beige skin with a brownish, fleshy undertone possesses a semi-organic and biomechanical texture, with a moist sheen, leathery grain, stretched membranes, tendons, grooves, and subtle vascular stripes. The neck and upper chest merge into a disturbing organic structure with tentacle-like folds and open passages extending from the collarbone area upwards to the head. The head is broad, mushroom-shaped or hammer-shaped, with a ridged crown and outward-spreading lateral lobes, presenting a non-human silhouette; the face should appear elusive and exotic, rather than cute or familiar. Place the subject in a narrow canyon formed by dark, eroded rock, framed by two massive rocks on either side of the foreground, with a hazy, misty cliff in the background. Use cool, desaturated lighting, soft mist, damp surfaces, shallow depth of field atmospheric haze, and a somber monochromatic palette composed of charcoal, slate, ash, and soft flesh tones. The overall atmosphere should create a grotesque, realistic, oppressive, and biologically logical feel, like a still from a high-end science fiction horror film. Ultra-realistic style, clear creature textures, subtle depth of field effects, dramatic natural backlighting from above, no clothing, no tools, no background creatures, no blood, no text.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影级的全身肖像，描绘了一个令人极度不安的人形外星人，它独自站在黑暗的岩石峡谷中。主体居中，正面朝向镜头，姿态中立挺拔，双臂自然下垂。该生物身材极高且消瘦，四肢修长，肩膀窄小，躯干凹陷，肋骨结构清晰可见，肌肉线条紧绷，前臂长，手掌巨大且手指细长，长长的趾行式足部稳稳地踩在潮湿的黑色地面上。其皮肤无毛，光滑，呈灰米色并带有棕色肉质底色，外观呈现半有机与生物机械的质感，带有湿润的光泽、皮革般的纹理、拉伸的薄膜、肌腱、沟壑以及细微的血管状条纹。颈部和上胸部融合为一种令人不安的有机结构，带有触手状的褶皱和从锁骨区域向上延伸至头部的开放通道。头部宽大，呈蘑菇状或锤状，带有脊状冠和向外张开的侧叶，呈现出非人类的轮廓；面部应显得难以捉摸且充满异域感，而非可爱或熟悉。将主体置于黑暗侵蚀岩石构成的狭窄峡谷中，前景左右两侧各有一块巨大的岩石作为框架，背景是若隐若现的雾气悬崖。使用冷色调的去饱和光线、柔和的雾气、潮湿的表面、浅景深的大气霾，以及由炭色、板岩色、灰烬色和柔和肉色组成的阴郁单色调。整体氛围应营造出怪诞、写实、压抑且符合生物逻辑的感觉，如同高端科幻恐怖电影剧照。超精细写实风格，生物纹理清晰，微妙的景深效果，来自上方的戏剧性自然背光，无衣物，无工具，无背景生物，无血腥，无文字。

templates.title: Luxury indoor mirror selfie portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华室内镜面自拍人像

templates.prompt: A realistic indoor mirror selfie featuring a slender, glamorous young woman. She stands in a softly lit upscale living room or hotel suite, shot in a vertical composition from head to knee. She wears a fitted cream or ivory midi dress with elegant pleats and gathers, featuring an asymmetrical neckline with a single shoulder strap across her chest, revealing one shoulder. She has long, slightly wavy, dark brown hair parted in the middle or side, falling naturally over her shoulders. She holds a smartphone in her right hand, partially obscuring her face, with the phone facing the mirror on the wall; the phone has a dark case with a red cloud pattern. Her left arm hangs naturally at her side. Adding delicate jewelry: a delicate necklace with a small pendant, a silver bracelet or bangle on her right wrist, and a ring on the finger holding the phone. The design emphasizes the realistic female silhouette, smooth skin, soft, warm ambient lighting, and a sophisticated, editorial social media photography style. The background should include a beige sofa behind her, a brown leather handbag to her right, a textured stone or concrete accent wall behind the mirror, and a warm hallway to her left with two wall art pieces. The design utilizes natural interior shadows, delicate skin textures, realistic fabric folds, and a sculpted waist and hips to create a luxurious apartment aesthetic, characterized by a simple composition and rich details.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张逼真的室内镜面自拍，拍摄对象为一位身材苗条、充满魅力的年轻女性。她站在光线柔和的高档客厅或酒店套房内，采用从头部到膝盖以下的竖构图拍摄。她身穿一件修身的奶油色或象牙白紧身中长裙，裙身带有优雅的褶皱和抽褶设计，不对称领口设有一条斜跨胸前的单肩带，露出另一侧肩膀。她留着一头深棕色长发，发丝微卷，中分偏分，自然垂落在双肩。她右手持智能手机置于脸部前方，部分遮挡面部，手机朝向墙上的镜子；手机配有带有红色云朵图案的深色手机壳。左臂自然垂在身侧。添加精致的首饰：1 条带有小吊坠的细项链，右手腕佩戴 1 只银色手镯或手环，持手机的手指上佩戴戒指。强调逼真的女性轮廓、细腻的皮肤、柔和的暖色环境光，以及精致的编辑级社交媒体摄影风格。背景应包括她身后 1 张米色沙发，沙发右侧放着 1 只棕色皮质手提包，镜子区域后方为 1 面质感石材或混凝土装饰墙，左侧为温暖的走廊，可见 2 幅挂墙艺术品。运用自然的室内阴影、细腻的皮肤纹理、逼真的面料褶皱以及腰部和臀部的紧致感，营造奢华公寓美学，构图简洁，细节丰富。

templates.title: Bizarre full-body alien portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 诡异的全身体外星人肖像

templates.prompt: A hyper-realistic full-body alien portrait taken in a studio, depicting a disturbing humanoid alien standing alone against a dim, smoky, dark blue-black background. The creature is extremely tall and slender, with long limbs, a narrow waist, and long, thin fingers. Its enormous bare feet tread on the dimly lit studio floor. Its skin is smooth yet leathery, with subtle wrinkles, a deep charcoal blue with cool gray highlights, clearly outlining ribs, sternum, collarbone, tendons, and the taut muscles of the chest, abdomen, shoulders, and neck. The torso is hairless and emaciated, possessing a bizarre anatomical realism that seems biologically plausible yet unsettlingly unsettling. The head is bald, large, and slightly spherical, with a classic alien silhouette, connected to an unusually long neck; the face remains blurred, unreadable, and extremely eerie, rather than expressionless. The alien stands facing forward, slightly at a three-quarter angle, with its arms hanging naturally at its sides, its posture upright yet subtly predatory, its entire body centered in the frame. Employing understated, cinematic lighting, complemented by subtle cool-toned rim lighting and soft top illumination, the artist sculpts every wrinkle and contour while maintaining the overall scene's dark, oppressive, and somber atmosphere. Low-saturation tones, ultra-fine skin textures, realistic creature designs, sharp focus, high contrast, a sinister ambiance, no clothing, no props, and no other environmental details except for the shadowed studio backdrop.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超写实的全身体外星人摄影棚肖像，画面中一个令人不安的人形外星人独自站在昏暗、烟雾缭绕的蓝黑色背景前。该生物身材极高且消瘦，四肢修长，腰部狭窄，手指细长，巨大的赤脚踩在昏暗的摄影棚地面上。其皮肤光滑但呈皮革质感，带有细微褶皱，呈现深炭蓝色并伴有冷灰色高光，清晰地勾勒出肋骨、胸骨、锁骨、肌腱以及胸部、腹部、肩部和颈部紧绷的肌肉线条。躯干无毛且干瘪，具有一种生物学上看似合理却令人不安的诡异解剖真实感。头部光秃、肥大，呈略微球状，具有经典的外星人轮廓，连接着异常修长的脖子；面部保持模糊、不可读且极度诡异，而非具有表情。外星人呈正面站立，略带四分之三侧角，双臂自然垂在身体两侧，姿态挺拔但带有微妙的掠食感，全身居中于画面。采用低调的电影级布光，辅以微弱的冷色轮廓光和柔和的顶部照明，雕刻出每一处褶皱和轮廓，同时保持整体场景的阴暗、压抑和沉重感。低饱和度色调，超精细皮肤纹理，写实生物设计，焦点清晰，高对比度，氛围阴森，无衣物，无道具，除阴影笼罩的摄影棚背景外无其他环境细节。

templates.prompt: A cinematic, dark fantasy photograph depicts a weathered, marble-like woman with her back to the camera in a ruined garden at sunset, the composition focusing on her upper back. Her face is slightly turned behind her shoulder, but mostly hidden in shadow. She evokes an ancient Greco-Roman style, with pale, stone-like skin, a classically styled updo, and an aged ivory-colored one-shoulder robe that appears cracked, dusty, and partially fused to her body like an eroded sculpture. Her bare back and arms are adorned with delicate, plant-like tattoos, and faded blue floral mosaics are embedded in the shoulder blade area. The overall atmosphere is melancholic, memorable, and elegant. Two tall, shadowy stone pillars stand to the left of the background, flanked by dense, dark trees and vegetation, with clusters of small, pale flowers dotting the garden below. Using the luminous amber-orange sunset glow as a strong backlight, the soft contour lighting outlines her shoulders and hair. The foreground shadows are deep, the depth of field shallow, the contrast rich, the earth tones soft, and the ultra-fine textures of cracked plaster, aged fabric, and stone are revealed. An art-editing photographic style, hyperrealistic, mysterious, melancholic, with the quality of an 85mm lens.

templates.title: Jinwan City Romantic Scenery

titleLocalized.zh: 金湾城市浪漫风景

templates.prompt: A grand and romantic landscape painting depicts a view of the wide bay from a high hillside.{argument name="city skyline" default="San Francisco"} City skyline. In the foreground, five massive stone ruins or broken bricks are scattered along an ancient rocky path, dotted with dark shrubs and windswept trees in soft earthy browns and deep greens. The midground presents a calm, reflecting water surface, with three small sailboats scattered on the bay. To the left, a long suspension bridge spans the bay, its four towers clearly visible, extending towards the city. In the distance, a bright, modern skyline rises along the waterfront, including a towering central cone-shaped skyscraper and a spire-shaped pyramidal tower. Above, dramatic swirling clouds disperse around a brilliant, low-hanging sun, casting warm golden rays across the sky and water. The painting is presented as a grand, cinematic masked painting, blending 19th-century landscape aesthetics, atmospheric perspective, luminous mist, soft brushstrokes, monumental scale, serene atmosphere, and subtle cloud dynamics.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅宏大且浪漫的风景画，描绘了从高处山坡俯瞰宽阔海湾的 {argument name="city skyline" default="旧金山"} 城市天际线。前景中，一条古老的岩石小径上散落着 5 块巨大的石制废墟或破碎的砖石块，周围点缀着深色的灌木和被风吹拂的树木，色调为柔和的土褐色与深绿色。中景呈现出平静且具有倒影的水面，海湾上散布着 3 艘小帆船。左侧是一座横跨海湾的长悬索桥，4 座桥塔清晰可见，向城市方向延伸。远处，明亮的现代天际线沿水岸升起，包括一座高耸的中央锥形摩天大楼和一座尖顶金字塔形塔楼。上方，戏剧性的漩涡云层在灿烂的低垂太阳周围散开，将温暖的金色光芒洒向天空和水面。画面呈现为宏大的电影级遮罩绘画，融合了 19 世纪油画风景美学、大气透视、发光的雾气、柔和的笔触、纪念碑式的规模、宁静的意境以及细腻的云层动态。

templates.title: Three beautifully designed mobile landing pages

titleLocalized.zh: 三款精美移动端落地页

templates.prompt: A sophisticated promotional mockup showcases three elongated smartphone screens side-by-side in a vertical triptych layout, each displaying a landing page for a modern beauty brand's lip products. The overall composition is editorial, minimalist, and sophisticated, designed specifically for mobile web design presentations on social media. The left panel, set against a soft gradient background from pale purple to blush pink, displays a black-bezeled phone with a screen featuring {argument name="brand name" default="Kosas"} A beauty website featuring cream-toned blushes. At the top of the panel, elegant small serif fonts read {argument name="left headline" default="Fresh Pout."} The top of the phone screen displays a cropped close-up image of a beauty product, with the prominent headline "Lips in their fullest expression." (The word "fullest" is in italic serif style), accompanied by a rounded, dark call-to-action button, a row of three lip close-up thumbnails, three effect labels labeled "Plumps," "Tingles," and "Shines," and a row of five shade or effect icons below. The middle panel, set against a gradient background from light to dark purple, showcases a second phone with a black bezel, whose landing page has a more sophisticated layout. The serif font above reads {argument name="middle headline" default="Claude Code"} The top of the screen features a cropped portrait image, a striking black stacked headline "LIP PULSE.", below which is a line of pink italicized handwritten text "is here.", a rounded dark button, a dark area containing the phrase "Lips in their fullest expression.", and a product grid near the bottom containing six color code cards (arranged in 2 rows and 3 columns). The right panel, set against a deep navy blue textured background, showcases a third phone with a black bezel, its page featuring a pink-toned e-commerce style. At the top center, in uniform white font, is the text {argument name="right headline" default="GPT Images 2.0"} The screen prominently displays the product's homepage area, featuring the brand name "Kosas," the large headline "The Lip Pulse," a pink lip gloss tube tilted to the right, small function icons, a row of six lip swatches near the center, and a promotional section below with images of more pink products. Maintaining a symmetrical layout, exactly three phones are positioned vertically, one on each panel, all fully visible. It employs high-end cosmetics advertising aesthetics, clean spacing, a stylish web typography with a mix of serif and bold sans-serif fonts, a soft pink and cream UI color scheme, subtle shadows, and a fashionable product design suitable for showcasing an AI-generated mobile website concept.

promptLocalized.zh: 一套精致的宣传样机，以垂直三联画布局并排展示了 3 个修长的智能手机屏幕，每个屏幕都呈现了一个现代美妆品牌的唇部产品落地页。整体构图具有编辑感、极简且高级，专为社交媒体上的移动端网页设计展示而设计。左侧面板位于柔和的淡紫色到腮红色的渐变背景上，展示了一款黑色边框手机，屏幕上是 {argument name="brand name" default="Kosas"} 的奶油色调腮红美妆网站。在该面板顶部，优雅的小号衬线字体写着 {argument name="left headline" default="Fresh Pout."}。手机屏幕顶部展示了一张裁剪过的美妆特写图片，醒目的大标题写着“Lips in their fullest expression.”（其中“fullest”采用斜体衬线样式），配有一个圆角深色行动号召按钮、一排 3 个唇部特写缩略图、3 个标注为“Plumps”（丰盈）、“Tingles”（清凉）、“Shines”（光泽）的功效标签，以及下方一排 5 个色号或效果图标。中间面板位于淡紫色到深紫色的渐变背景上，展示了第二款黑色边框手机，其落地页更具排版设计感。上方衬线字体写着 {argument name="middle headline" default="Claude Code"}。屏幕顶部包含一张裁剪过的人像图片，一个非常醒目的黑色堆叠大标题“LIP PULSE.”，下方配有一行粉色斜体手写风格文字“is here.”，一个圆角深色按钮，一个包含短语“Lips in their fullest expression.”的深色区域，以及底部附近包含 6 张色号卡片（排列为 2 行 3 列）的产品网格。右侧面板位于深海军蓝纹理背景上，展示了第三款黑色边框手机，其页面采用粉色调的电商风格。上方居中处，等宽白色字体写着 {argument name="right headline" default="GPT Images 2.0"}。该屏幕显著展示了产品首屏区域，包含品牌名称“Kosas”、大标题“The Lip Pulse”、一个向右倾斜的粉色唇彩管、小型功能图标、中间附近的一排 6 个唇部试色，以及下方包含更多粉色产品图像的促销板块。保持布局对称，恰好 3 部手机，每面板一部，均完全可见且垂直放置。采用高端化妆品广告美学、整洁的间距、混合衬线与粗体无衬线字体的时尚网页排版、柔和的粉色与奶油色 UI 配色、微妙的阴影，以及适合展示 AI 生成的移动端网站概念的时尚产品设计呈现。

templates.title: Portrait of Tech Giants in a Golden Moment of Confrontation

titleLocalized.zh: 黄金时刻科技巨头对峙肖像

templates.prompt: A low-angle snapshot shows two adult men standing in front of a traditional East Asian wooden building, against a backdrop of warm brown wooden frames and repeating green lattice windows. Taken during the golden hour, the strong, warm sunlight casts deep shadows. The man on the left, closer to the camera and partially cropped, wears a black zip-up jacket with a prominent white OpenAI logo on the chest and grey trim on the cuffs. His arm is extended directly towards the lens, holding a cigarette, positioned very close to the foreground, causing his hand and cigarette to occupy the lower left corner of the frame, slightly blurred due to the shallow depth of field. The man on the right, positioned further back, wears a loose black T-shirt with a prominent white "xAI" logo on the chest, one hand raised near his mouth, as if smoking or contemplating. Both men's faces are obscured by smooth rectangular blur blocks to maintain anonymity. Employing a realistic, documentary-style street photography aesthetic, the image showcases natural skin tones, subtle distortions from a wide-angle lens, cinematic contrast, rich sunset lighting, and a casually contrasting composition emphasizing clothing brands and a cigarette reaching towards the viewer. The image must include two men, with a cigarette, a black jacket bearing the OpenAI logo, and a black T-shirt bearing the xAI logo visible in the foreground.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张低角度抓拍照片，两名成年男子站在一座传统的东亚木质建筑前，背景是温暖的棕色木框架和重复的绿色格子窗棂。拍摄于黄金时刻，强烈的暖色阳光投下深邃的阴影。左侧男子距离镜头较近，处于部分裁剪状态，身穿黑色拉链夹克，胸前印有醒目的白色 OpenAI 标志，袖口带有灰色拼接。他的手臂直接伸向镜头，手中夹着一支香烟，位于画面极近的前景，使手部和香烟占据左下角，并因浅景深效果呈现出轻微的虚化。右侧男子站位较靠后，身穿宽松的黑色 T 恤，胸前印有醒目的白色“xAI”风格标志，一只手抬起靠近嘴边，仿佛正在抽烟或思考。两名男子的面部均被平滑的矩形模糊块遮挡，以保持匿名。采用写实纪实街拍美学，呈现自然的肤色、广角镜头带来的细微畸变、电影级对比度、浓郁的日落光影，以及强调服装品牌和伸向观众的香烟的随意对抗式构图。画面需包含 2 名男子，前景可见 1 支香烟，1 件带有 OpenAI 标志的黑色夹克，以及 1 件带有 xAI 标志的黑色 T 恤。

templates.title: Santorini Luxury Dress Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 圣托里尼奢华礼服人像

The soft, pleated fabric draped over her knees. Her long, wavy hair was {argument name="hair color" default="gold"} The hair is naturally draped over the shoulders. She wears layered, delicate necklaces, including a small pendant and a silver cross, and a bracelet or watch on her wrist. A classic white Greek church is placed in the upper right corner of the background, with bright {argument name="dome color" default="blue"} The dome, with vibrant blooms dotting the right side of the image.{argument name="flower color" default="Magenta"} Bougainvillea. The lighting is bright Mediterranean midday sunlight, with sharp highlights and a soft glow on the skin. The natural depth of field makes the subject clear, while the background buildings and ocean appear slightly softer. The composition is vertical, elegant and appealing, with the subject slightly right-centered, showing her upper body and flowing skirt. The beautiful coastline stretches across the left half of the image. Small black text is added to the upper left corner.{argument name="corner text" default="GPT V2"} Photorealistic luxury vacation aesthetics, high detail, natural colors, and an editor-quality Instagram travel style.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张迷人的旅行时尚人像，画面中是一位 {argument name="woman" default="金发女性"} 坐在希腊圣托里尼俯瞰火山口的阳光石台上，背景是向深蓝色大海延伸的白色悬崖建筑以及远处的崎岖火山岛。她身穿一件飘逸的象牙白挂脖连衣裙，领口深 V 设计，侧面镂空，腰部有褶皱和圆环细节，柔软的褶皱面料覆盖在膝盖上。她的长发呈波浪状，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="金色"}，自然地披散在肩头。佩戴层叠的精致项链，包括一个小吊坠和一枚银色十字架，手腕上配有手链或手表。背景右上角放置一座经典的白色希腊教堂，配有明亮的 {argument name="dome color" default="蓝色"} 圆顶，画面右侧点缀着盛开的鲜艳 {argument name="flower color" default="洋红色"} 三角梅。光线为明亮的地中海正午阳光，高光清晰，皮肤呈现柔和光泽，景深效果自然，使人物主体清晰，同时背景建筑和海洋略显柔和。构图为竖版，优雅且令人向往，人物略微偏右居中，上半身至飘逸裙摆可见，风景优美的海岸线横跨画面左半部分。左上角添加小型黑色文字 {argument name="corner text" default="GPT V2"}。照片级逼真的奢华度假美学，高细节，自然色彩，编辑级 Instagram 旅行风格。

templates.title: Gear 5 Blackboard Classroom Mural

titleLocalized.zh: Gear 5 黑板教室壁画

templates.prompt: A photorealistic classroom interior scene, centered on a massive green blackboard adorned with a stunning chalk mural of Monkey D. Luffy from One Piece, wearing Gear 5. The artwork dominates the entire piece: rendered in a dynamic, low-angle perspective, it depicts a giant foot reaching towards the viewer, fists raised, wild, curly white hair, an exaggerated, maniacal laugh, wide-open eyes, an open white coat revealing a scarred, muscular chest, loose white trousers, and a flowing purple belt. A white, smoky halo, rendered in impressionistic chalk strokes, surrounds the figure. To the right of the blackboard are two chalk-written text elements: a vertically arranged Japanese phrase, “太阳の神” (Sun God), and a prominent English label, “GEAR 5,” near the lower right corner. The chalk drawing exhibits layered textures of white, gray, tan, and purple chalk, with noticeable smudges, dust, and hand-drawn shadows. The entire blackboard border, chalk tray, and realistic classroom environment with beige walls and a small speaker above the blackboard are also showcased. In the foreground is a worn-out wooden teacher's desk covered in chalk dust. Five items are clearly visible on the desk: an open box of colored chalk, three scattered pieces of chalk, and a black rectangular eraser. Two additional small erasers are placed to the left of the chalk tray. Soft, natural indoor lighting, a symmetrical composition, and high detail create a realistic classroom photograph with striking anime-style blackboard art.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张照片级真实的教室内部场景，画面中心是一块巨大的绿色黑板，上面绘有精美的《海贼王》中 Gear 5 蒙奇·D·路飞的粉笔壁画。画作占据了整个项目：采用动态的低角度透视，一只巨大的脚伸向观众，双拳高举，狂野的卷曲白发，夸张的狂笑表情，圆睁的双眼，敞开的白色外套，露出布满伤痕的肌肉胸膛，穿着宽松的白色长裤，系着飘逸的紫色腰带。周围环绕着以写意粉笔笔触绘制的白色烟雾状光环。在黑板右侧，包含 2 个用粉笔书写的文字元素：1 个竖排日语短语“太陽の神”，以及右下角附近 1 个醒目的英文标签“GEAR 5”。粉笔画呈现出分层的白色、灰色、棕褐色和紫色粉笔质感，带有明显的涂抹痕迹、粉尘和手绘阴影。展示完整的黑板边框、粉笔槽，以及带有米色墙壁和黑板上方小型扬声器的真实教室环境。前景中放置一张布满粉笔灰的破旧木制教师办公桌，桌上清晰可见 5 件物品：1 个打开的彩色粉笔盒，3 支散落的粉笔，以及 1 个黑色长方形黑板擦。在粉笔槽左侧额外放置 2 个小黑板擦。柔和的自然室内光线，正面对称构图，高度细节化，呈现出带有震撼动漫黑板艺术的真实教室照片。

templates.title: Astronauts and the "Living Earth"

titleLocalized.zh: 宇航员与“生命地球”

templates.prompt: This is a cinematic, surreal space scene. An astronaut floats in the vastness of space, with a massive Earth beside him. Earth occupies the left side of the image, while the astronaut is on the right, his legs bent and floating backward, one arm outstretched towards the Earth. The astronaut wears a realistic white EVA-style spacesuit, complete with a dark reflective visor, backpack, and red, yellow, and green epaulets. Earth is presented from an Atlantic perspective, with North and South America clearly visible. Against a deep, dark, star-studded background, the Earth's edges emit a cool blue halo. On the continents and even the oceans, faintly visible organic, branching root systems or neural pathways spread across the surface, particularly dense in North America and extending into South America, creating a dark, biomechanical feel or an effect of a "living planet." The composition employs dramatic, low-key lighting, strong contrast, melancholic shadows, photorealistic textures, ultra-refined cinematic realism, a quiet and oppressive atmosphere, and a wide-angle composition with large areas of negative space.

promptLocalized.zh: 这是一幅电影级的超现实太空场景，画面中 1 名宇航员漂浮在广袤的太空中，身旁是巨大的地球。地球占据了画面的左侧，宇航员位于右侧，双腿弯曲向后漂浮，一只手臂伸向地球。宇航员身穿写实的白色 EVA 风格宇航服，配有深色反光面罩、背包装置以及红、黄、绿三色的肩章。地球呈现大西洋视角，南北美洲清晰可见，在深邃黑暗、繁星点点的背景下，地球边缘散发着冷蓝色的光晕。在各大洲乃至海洋上，隐约可见有机分支状的根系或神经脉络结构蔓延在表面，在北美洲尤为密集并延伸至南美洲，营造出一种黑暗的生物机械感或“生命星球”的效果。采用戏剧性的低调照明、强烈的对比度、忧郁的阴影、照片级的纹理、超精细的电影写实感、安静而压抑的氛围，以及带有大面积留白的广角构图。

templates.title: Japanese-style classroom drawing with Gear 5 chalk

titleLocalized.zh: 日式教室 Gear 5 粉笔画

templates.prompt: A photorealistic shot of a Japanese classroom interior, filmed in soft sunlight, from a slight angle to the left front, shows an old green blackboard dominating the wall. On the blackboard is a large hand-drawn chalk drawing depicting a wildly cheerful anime pirate boy inspired by the Gear 5. He has fluffy, cloud-like white hair, swirling white smoke around his body, and is laughing heartily. He wears a loose white jacket and shorts with fur trim, a purple belt, one leg extended towards the viewer, the other bent forward, drawn with colored chalk and a distinctly sketch-like texture. To the right of the blackboard are two lines of large chalk text: the vertically written Japanese phrase "太阳の神" (Taiyou no Kami), and below that, the English "GEAR 5". The foreground of the room should include a wooden teacher's desk with a blackboard eraser, an open box of colored chalk, and three scattered pieces of chalk. Add realistic classroom details: a chalk tray spanning the blackboard, a window letting in natural light on the left, beige worn walls, ceiling fluorescent lights, and a wall-mounted speaker above the blackboard. This makes it look like a stunning real-life photograph of a chalk drawing fan art piece taken in an empty school classroom, with a clean composition, natural perspective, and subtle wear and dust effects—highly realistic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张照片级逼真的日式教室室内镜头，在柔和的日光下拍摄，从左前方以微小角度俯瞰，一面陈旧的绿色黑板占据了墙面。黑板上有一幅大型手绘粉笔画，描绘了一位受 Gear 5 启发、姿态狂野欢快的动漫海盗男孩，他有着蓬松如云朵般的白发，身体周围环绕着旋转的白烟，张嘴大笑，穿着白色宽松夹克和带有毛绒边的短裤，系着紫色腰带，一只脚向观众方向伸出，另一条腿向前弯曲，以彩色粉笔绘制，带有明显的素描质感。在黑板右侧，包含两行大型粉笔字：垂直书写的日文“太阳の神”，下方是英文“GEAR 5”。房间前景应包含 1 张木制教师办公桌，桌上放有 1 个黑板擦、1 盒打开的彩色粉笔和 3 支散落的粉笔。添加逼真的教室细节：横跨黑板的粉笔槽、左侧引入自然光的窗户、米色磨损的墙壁、吸顶荧光灯以及黑板上方 1 个壁挂式扬声器。使其看起来像是一张在空荡的学校教室里拍摄的、令人惊叹的粉笔画同人作品实拍照片，构图整洁，视角自然，带有细微的磨损和灰尘感，高度写实。

templates.title: Anime Samurai Game Advertisement Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫武士游戏广告海报

templates.prompt: Create a highly impactful vertical mobile game advertisement poster, employing a glossy anime action style to present a dramatic cyberpunk samurai fantasy aesthetic, along with a compact and sophisticated gacha RPG promotional composition. The main image features two young male warriors, dressed in modern black business suits, crouching in an offensive stance in the foreground, each drawing their katana. Both have stylish blond hair, sharp facial features, and are handsome, wearing white shirts and blue ties. Their poses are full of tension, with their hands and swords dominating the lower foreground. A blue ribbon is tied near the hilt of one of the swords. Behind them, in the center, is a massive armored mech samurai with ornate golden horns, layered metallic blue-black armor, glowing blue eyes, and a sheathed sword across its back, resembling a guardian deity. The background features a vibrant neon city and energy burst effects, with electric blue, violet, magenta, and gold as the main colors, complemented by beams of light, sparks, petals, slashing effects, and ink-wash explosion textures. A vertical black brushstroke banner is added to the upper right corner, bearing the striking white Japanese characters "この刃で、未来を斬り拓け。" (This blade cuts through the future). In the lower center, a large gold Japanese calligraphy title, with a heavy brushstroke texture and black shadow, reads "切り捨て御免" (Cut off and be spared), spanning almost the entire width of the screen. In the bottom left corner, a screenshot panel with a gold border is embedded, showcasing a night battle scene in front of a red Japanese temple courtyard. A playable swordsman is fighting, surrounded by multiple enemies. Floating damage numbers include 5324, 5329, and 6132. A virtual joystick is located on the left, and five character portraits are arranged at the bottom and sides. There are three circular skill buttons on the right, and the top HUD displays a timer of approximately 01:28 and WAVE 3/3. In the bottom right corner, a large black and white QR code is placed within a white square. Below and to the side, the Japanese text "今すぐダウンロード" (Imasugu Down Road) is added in bold white font with a blue outline. At the very bottom, there are two official-style app store logos: App Store on the left and Google Play on the right. Overall appearance: ultra-refined and exquisite key visuals, dynamic perspective, metallic highlights, sharp cel animation rendering, high-end mobile game marketing posters, strong action energy, cinematic lighting and shadows, and a layered, richly layered UI promotional layout.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张具有高冲击力的竖版手游广告海报，采用光泽感动漫动作风格，呈现极具戏剧性的赛博武士幻想美学，以及紧凑、高级的抽卡 RPG 推广构图。主画面展示了 2 名年轻男性战士，他们身穿现代黑色商务西装，在前景中呈进攻姿态蹲伏，每人都在向观众拔出武士刀。两人均留着时尚的金发，五官轮廓分明、英俊帅气，身穿白色衬衫，系着蓝色领带，动作姿势充满张力，近大远小的手部和剑身占据了下方前景。其中一把剑的护手附近系着一条蓝色丝带。在他们身后居中位置，放置 1 个巨大的装甲机甲武士，它拥有华丽的金色犄角、层叠的金属蓝黑色盔甲、发光的蓝色眼睛，背部横跨着一把收鞘的剑，宛如守护神一般。背景采用生动的霓虹城市和能量爆发效果，主色调为电光蓝、紫罗兰、洋红色和金色，并辅以光束、火花、花瓣、斩击特效和水墨爆炸纹理。在右上角添加 1 个竖向黑色笔触横幅，上面用醒目的白色日文写着「この刃で、未来を斬り拓け。」。在中下部区域，放置 1 个巨大的金色日文书法标题，带有厚重的笔触质感和黑色阴影，写着「切り捨て御免」，几乎横跨整个画面宽度。在左下角，嵌入 1 个带有金色边框的游戏截图面板，展示了红色日本寺庙庭院前的夜战场景，1 名可操作的剑客正在战斗，周围有多个敌人，漂浮的伤害数字包括 5324、5329 和 6132，左侧设有虚拟摇杆，底部及侧边共排列 5 个角色头像，右侧有 3 个圆形技能按钮，顶部 HUD 显示计时器约为 01:28 和 WAVE 3/3。在右下角，放置 1 个巨大的黑白二维码，置于白色方框内。在其下方和侧面，添加带有蓝色描边的白色粗体日文「今すぐダウンロード」。在最底部，包含 2 个官方风格的应用商店徽标：左侧为 App Store，右侧为 Google Play。整体外观：超精细、精致的关键视觉图、动态视角、金属高光、锐利的赛璐珞动漫渲染、高级手游营销海报、强烈的动作能量、电影级光影以及层级丰富的重 UI 推广布局。

templates.title: Realistic McDonald's selfie portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 逼真的麦当劳自拍肖像

templates.prompt: A highly realistic smartphone selfie taken inside an Asian McDonald's restaurant features a half-body portrait of a young man seated at a table. The camera is held at arm's length, slightly above the table, creating a natural frontal selfie perspective, with one forearm extending towards the lens. The subject wears a black T-shirt with a small white Tesla logo on the left chest, has short, straight black hair, and thin-rimmed black glasses are faintly visible. One hand lightly supports his chin, his posture relaxed. His face is completely obscured by a large, solid rectangular blur, preserving his privacy while maintaining the visibility of his hair, ears, jawline, and the temples of his glasses. A white McDonald's paper beverage cup with a lid and a white straw is placed in the lower left foreground, cropped at the edge of the image. The background showcases the restaurant counter area with warm ambient lighting; to the left is a large red wall panel featuring the yellow McDonald's arches logo and the white slogan "I'm lovin' it" with Chinese text below; above hang four illuminated digital menu items displaying burgers, fries, combo meals, prices, and Chinese text; near the counter are two people, one with their back to the camera carrying a backpack, and the other partially visible behind the cashier. Use natural color balance, subtle interior grain, realistic reflections, shallow to medium depth of field, and the casual feel of an unstaged social media snapshot.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张在亚洲麦当劳餐厅室内拍摄的高度逼真的智能手机休闲自拍，构图为一名年轻男子坐在桌前的半身肖像。相机以手臂长度从略高于桌面的高度持握，营造出自然的正面自拍视角，一只前臂向镜头延伸。拍摄对象身穿黑色 T 恤，左胸处印有白色 Tesla 小标志，留着黑色直短发，隐约可见细黑框眼镜，一只手轻托下巴，姿态放松。他的面部中心被一个大型实心矩形模糊块完全遮挡，在保护隐私的同时，保留了头发、耳朵、下颌边缘和眼镜腿的可见度。左下角前景处放置着 1 个带有杯盖和白色吸管的白色麦当劳纸质饮料杯，被画面边缘裁切。背景展示了餐厅柜台区域，配有温暖的环境光；左侧是一块大型红色墙板，上面印有黄色麦当劳拱门标志和白色标语“i’m lovin’ it”及其下方的中文字样；顶部悬挂着 4 块发光的数字菜单项目，显示着汉堡、薯条、套餐、价格和中文字样；背景柜台附近还有 2 人，一人背对着镜头背着背包，另一人部分身影出现在收银台后。请使用自然的色彩平衡、轻微的室内颗粒感、逼真的反射效果、浅至中等的景深，以及未经摆拍的社交媒体快照的随性观感。

templates.title: Realistic Sam's Club shopping snapshots

titleLocalized.zh: 写实的 Sam's Club 购物快照

templates.prompt: A highly realistic snapshot taken with a mobile phone inside a bustling Sam's Club warehouse store in China. The composition centers on a young East Asian man, half-length, standing upright facing the camera, his face obscured by a rectangular blurred block for privacy. He wears a plain black short-sleeved T-shirt with a small white Tesla logo on the left chest, and carries a large bag of red apples in his left hand, tied with a blue cable tie. A white tag on the bag reads "envy," with smaller Chinese characters below. Behind him is the brightly lit retail interior, with high industrial ceilings, warehouse shelves, shoppers, shopping carts, and stacks of produce. The blue Sam's Club wall sign is prominently displayed in the upper left corner, reading "Sam's CLUB" and "Sam's Club Membership Store"; behind him is a large blue banner that reads "A Better Life at Sam's" and "Life is Better in the Club." A tall white vertical banner hangs in the upper right corner, proclaiming "Great Products, Great Prices" and adorned with blue and green geometric decorations. The background includes numerous slightly out-of-focus customers to create a realistically crowded shopping atmosphere. Lighting should be bright and even from retail overhead lighting; colors should be natural; the perspective should be eye-level; the aesthetic should have a documentary snapshot feel; the foreground subject should be sharp, while the background should be slightly softened; and the composition should be portrait-like.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张在中国繁忙的 Sam’s Club 仓储式商店内拍摄的、高度写实的手机抓拍照片。构图中心为一名年轻的东亚男性，半身像，直立面向镜头，为了隐私保护，他的脸部被一个矩形模糊块遮挡。他身穿一件纯黑色短袖 T 恤，左胸前有一个小的白色 Tesla 标志，左手提着一大袋透明塑料袋装的红苹果，袋口用蓝色扎带系住。苹果袋上贴有一张白色标签，上面写着“envy”，下方有小字中文。他身后是明亮的零售店内部，有高大的工业天花板、仓储货架、购物者、购物车和堆叠的农产品陈列。左上方显著展示蓝色的 Sam’s Club 墙面标志，文字为“Sam’s CLUB”和“山姆会员商店”；他身后有一条巨大的蓝色墙面横幅，上面写着“更好的生活尽在山姆”和“Life is Better in the Club”。右上方悬挂着一条高大的白色垂直横幅，上面写着“优质优价”和“Great Products Great Prices”，并带有蓝色和绿色的几何装饰。背景中包含许多略微失焦的顾客，以营造真实拥挤的购物氛围。光线应为明亮、均匀的零售顶灯；色彩自然；视角为平视；具有纪录片快照的美感；前景主体清晰，背景略微柔化；肖像构图。

templates.title: Retro Chinese Childhood Memory Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 复古中国童年记忆海报

templates.prompt: A document about{argument name="theme title" default="Memories of the 80s and 90s"} This nostalgic Chinese-style retro collage poster combines the design of worn scrapbook pages with hand-drawn memory maps. It features a vertical composition and a warm color palette of dark brown, grey-red, faded orange, and the beige of aged paper. The background consists of old, cracked paper, yellowed magazine clippings, and worn, vintage printing textures. In the upper right corner, a realistic figure holds a black fountain pen with a gold nib, as if writing these memories on the page. At the center of the poster is a large, irregularly shaped wooden plaque or scrapbook project containing eight numbered memory scenes, each embedded like a miniature 3D model, accompanied by a handwritten Chinese title and brief key points. Scene 1, labeled "1 Slingshot," shows a young boy crouching beside an outdoor stone wall and tree, aiming a slingshot; Scene 2, labeled "2 Rolling Hoops," shows two children running and pushing hoops in an alley; Scene 3, labeled "3 Firecrackers," shows two children crouching beside lit firecrackers, accompanied by smoke and red paper scraps; Scene 4, labeled "4 Supply and Marketing Cooperative," shows an old-fashioned community supply and marketing cooperative counter with a salesperson and a young customer, with shelves full of goods behind them; Scene 5, labeled "5 Market Day," shows a bustling rural market with many adults, chickens, agricultural products, baskets, and a vendor on a bicycle; Scene 6, labeled "6 Stage," shows a rural stage with four actors in traditional costumes performing under a red curtain, and an audience sitting below; Scene 7, labeled "7 Bird's Nest Raid," shows two boys beside a tree, one climbing the tree or reaching into a bird's nest, while the other watches from below; Scene 8, labeled "8 The "Motorcycle" exhibit showcases two riders on a vintage motorcycle cruising down an old street at sunset. Surrounding the main exhibit are ten nostalgic items: an old children's handbook tied with a red ribbon in the upper left corner, two glass marbles next to it; a vintage comic book or magazine in the center right; a small blue illustrated booklet in the lower left corner; a green tin frog toy in the lower left corner; a small wooden chair along the lower left edge; an enamel mug with red Chinese characters printed on it in the lower right corner, two colored pencils next to it; and a school workbook labeled "Exercise Book" in the lower right corner. At the top is a prominent, bold Chinese title.{argument name="headline text" default="Memories of the 80s and 90s"} It uses an aged red and blue font, with a smaller, handwritten-style subtitle below.{argument name="subtitle text" default="Those simple, lively, and bright days"} To the right of the central project, add the handwritten text "This page was just finished." At the bottom, add a large red banner with the main quote.{argument name="bottom quote" default="Life wasn't fast-paced back then, but it was full of happiness."} Below is a line of smaller text{argument name="bottom subquote" default="Many things are old, but they still shine when you think about them."} The overall image should be rich in detail, cinematic, tactile, and emotional, and deeply rooted in Chinese childhood memories from the 1980s to the 1990s, blending illustration, miniature realism, poster design, scrapbook layers, and editorial nostalgia.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张关于 {argument name="theme title" default="8090的记忆"} 的怀旧中国风复古拼贴海报，设计风格如同磨损的剪贴簿页面与手绘记忆地图的结合。采用竖构图，色调为温暖的深褐色、灰红色、褪色的橙色以及陈旧的纸张米色。背景为老旧的裂纹纸、泛黄的杂志剪报和磨损的复古印刷纹理。在右上角，展示一只写实的人手握着一支金尖黑色钢笔，仿佛正在页面上书写这些记忆。海报中心是一个巨大的不规则木质牌匾或剪贴项目，其中包含 8 个编号的记忆场景，每个场景都像微型立体模型一样嵌入其中，并配有手写的中文标题和简短的要点说明。场景 1 标注为“1 弹弓”，展示了一个小男孩蹲在户外石墙和树旁瞄准弹弓；场景 2 标注为“2 滚铁环”，展示了 2 个孩子在巷子里推着铁环奔跑；场景 3 标注为“3 鞭炮”，展示了 2 个孩子蹲在地面点燃的鞭炮旁，伴有烟雾和红色纸屑；场景 4 标注为“4 供销社”，展示了一个老式社区供销社柜台，有 1 名售货员和 1 名小顾客，身后货架上摆满了商品；场景 5 标注为“5 赶集”，展示了一个热闹的农村集市，有许多大人、鸡、农产品、篮子和一位骑自行车的商贩；场景 6 标注为“6 戏台”，展示了一个乡村戏台，4 名身着传统戏服的演员在红幕下表演，台下坐着观众；场景 7 标注为“7 掏鸟窝”，展示了 2 个男孩在树旁，其中 1 人正在爬树或伸手掏鸟窝，另 1 人在下方观看；场景 8 标注为“8 摩托车”，展示了 2 名骑手骑着复古摩托车在日落时分行驶在老街上。在主项目周围环绕 10 个怀旧物品：左上角有一本系着红丝带的旧儿童手册，旁边有 2 颗玻璃弹珠，中右侧有一本复古漫画或画报，左下角有一本蓝色小插画手册，左下方有一个绿色铁皮青蛙玩具，左下边缘有一把小木椅，右下角有一个印有红色中文的搪瓷杯，杯旁有 2 支彩色铅笔，右下角有一本标有“练习簿”的学校练习册。在顶部，放置醒目的粗体中文标题 {argument name="headline text" default="8090的记忆"}，采用做旧的红蓝字体，下方配有较小的手写风格副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="那些简单、热闹、发亮的日子"}。在中心项目右侧，添加手写文字“这一页，刚刚写完。”在底部，添加一个红色大横幅，写有主引语 {argument name="bottom quote" default="那时候日子不快，但快乐很满。"}，下方附带一行较小的文字 {argument name="bottom subquote" default="很多东西都旧了，可一想起来还是会发亮。"} 整体画面应具有丰富的细节、电影感、触感、情感色彩，并深深植根于 1980 年代至 1990 年代的中国童年记忆，融合了插画、微型写实、海报设计、剪贴簿图层和编辑怀旧感。

templates.title: Dreamy landscape silhouette of a woman

titleLocalized.zh: 梦幻山水女子剪影

templates.prompt: A dreamlike, East Asian ink-wash style fantasy illustration blends a woman's profile with a vast landscape, presented in a vertical poster format. Her flowing, dark hair extends outwards like swirling brushstrokes and clouds, transforming into mountain ridges, clouds, and decorative ink-wash scroll patterns. Within the silhouette and hair, a refined classical Chinese landscape is depicted, featuring layered verdant peaks, gentle waterfalls, floating clouds, and four traditional pagodas nestled among cliffs. Four white cranes fly in the upper left and center of the sky. Five clusters of blooming cherry blossoms are distributed along her hair, shoulders, and lower body, with scattered petals drifting across the image. In the lower center of the picture, an arched stone bridge spans a tranquil river, beneath which sits a small wooden boat carrying a lone traveler. The upper right corner features a warm, golden sunlit sky in pale peach and cream parchment hues, contrasting with cool tones of cyan, slate blue, and ink-black mountains. The woman's profile should face right, elegant and serene, with minimal facial detail, retaining only the clear outlines of the forehead, nose, lips, neck, and shoulders. The overall style should present {argument name="art style" default="Ethereal Chinese ink and watercolor"} Highly detailed, atmospheric, poetic, and surreal, it features delicate lines, soft clouds, bright highlights, paper textures, and a balance between negative space and dense detail. A vertical calligraphic inscription was added to the lower right corner.{argument name="calligraphy text" default="Mountains and rivers like a dream"} And stamp it with two small red seals below it. Main color scheme:{argument name="main color palette" default="Cyan, warm gold, cream, light pink, and charcoal."} Compositional focus:{argument name="composition focus" default="A silhouette of a woman composed of mountains, water, and flowing long hair."} Atmosphere:{argument name="mood" default="Tranquil, majestic, romantic, dreamlike"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅梦幻般的东亚水墨风奇幻插画，将女性侧影与广阔的山水景观融为一体，采用竖版海报构图。她飘逸的深色长发如旋涡状的笔触与云雾般向外延展，幻化为山脊、云朵和装饰性的水墨卷草纹。在剪影与发丝内部，描绘一个精致的中国古典山水世界，包含层叠的青绿山峰、柔和的瀑布、漂浮的云雾，以及悬崖间错落有致的 4 座传统宝塔。在左上方及中心天空中加入 4 只飞翔的白鹤。在发丝、肩部和下半身分布 5 簇盛开的樱花枝，并有零星花瓣飘散在画面中。在画面中下部，放置一座横跨平静河流的拱形石桥，桥下有一艘载着 1 位独行者的小木船。右上角采用温暖的金色阳光天空，呈现淡桃色和奶油色羊皮纸色调，与冷色调的青色、板岩蓝及水墨黑山峦形成对比。女性侧影应朝向右侧，优雅而宁静，无需面部细节，仅保留额头、鼻子、嘴唇、颈部和肩部的清晰轮廓。整体风格应呈现为 {argument name="art style" default="空灵的中国水墨与水彩"}，高度精细、富有氛围感、诗意且超现实，具备细腻的线条、柔和的云雾、明亮的高光、纸张纹理，并平衡留白与密集的景物细节。在右下角添加竖排书法题字 {argument name="calligraphy text" default="山水如梦"}，并在其下方盖上 2 枚红色小印章。主色调：{argument name="main color palette" default="青蓝色、暖金色、奶油色、淡粉色和炭墨色"}。构图重点：{argument name="composition focus" default="由山水与飘逸长发构成的女性剪影"}。氛围：{argument name="mood" default="宁静、雄伟、浪漫、梦幻"}。

templates.title: Cyberpunk Web3 AI Profile Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克 Web3 AI 个人资料海报

templates.prompt: A vertical sci-fi personal brand poster with a cinematic feel, featuring a deep blue cyberpunk style, designed as {argument name="profile name" default="Meta_wu"} The futuristic profile infographic centers on the back and partial profile of a young Asian man confidently wearing a glossy black futuristic jacket with glowing blue accents and the words "META_WU" and "WEB3 × AI" printed on the back. His face is deliberately obscured by a rectangular blurred block. The background is a magnificent outer space scene, with a giant glowing Earth filled with stars above and a futuristic nighttime metropolis skyline with neon-lit tracks below. A small spaceship is positioned in the center left. At the very top, a large metallic, crystalline title is placed, written in bold, beveled silver lettering: "{argument name="main title" default="Meta_wu"} The character is depicted with a blue-edged glow. Two lines of centered Chinese text are added directly below: the first line is the character's tagline, "BTC Miner | Binance Sharp Ratio No.1 Trader | Programmer | Focused on Web3 + AI Cross-Sector," and the second line is "Investment Observation - Cryptocurrency & US Stocks & A-Shares." A transparent, dark glass, glowing holographic HUD panel surrounds the character with a cyan neon border. Four stacked panels are created on the left: Panel 1 is the "About Me" card, containing four lines of personal information: "Technology | Hong Kong 🇭🇰," "github.com/Ferwoo," "Born May 1, 1999," and "Joined October 2016"; Panel 2 is the social data card, containing three key metrics: "1,950 Following," "3,906 Followers," and "1 Pinned Tweet"; Panel 3 is the "BTC MINER" card, showcasing a giant golden Bitcoin and a scene of a server mining rack; Panel 4 is the "Trading Philosophy" card, containing three lines of text: "Data-Driven × The design incorporates phrases like "rational decision-making," "long-termism × value investing," and a glowing upward candlestick chart. On the right, six stacked panels are created: Panel 1 displays a globe icon and "Followed by 1 Global KOL"; Panel 2 displays a group icon and "Followed by 93 Chinese KOLs"; Panel 3 displays a chart icon and "Global Influence Ranking 62,434 / 200K"; Panel 4 displays a trophy icon and "Chinese Language Influence 5,053 / 10K"; Panel 5 is a "TRADER" card with the subtitle "Binance Sharpe Ratio No.1," featuring a gold upward line chart and the small print "SHARPE RATIO TOP 1"; Panel 6 is a "DEVELOPER" card containing code-like text lines such as "// Code is law," "// Web3 is future," "// AI x Crypto," "function build() {," "return change_the_world();," and "}," along with GitHub-style icons. At the bottom center, a prominent Chinese slogan is added in large, glowing white text:{argument name="slogan text" default="Exploring the intersection of the future"} Below this is a smaller subtitle: "Building Value and the Future in the Wave of Web3 and AI." The bottom contains three horizontally aligned rectangular category cards: Card 1 is labeled "Cryptocurrency," featuring a Bitcoin icon and a miniature market chart; Card 2 is labeled "US Stocks," featuring Tesla and Apple logos; Card 3 is labeled "A-Shares," featuring rising bar and line charts. At the very bottom center are four Chinese keywords separated by vertical lines: "Technology | Investment | Freedom | Influence," below which are the corresponding English words: "TECHNOLOGY · INVESTMENT · FREEDOM · INFLUENCE." The design employs a high-contrast blue-silver color scheme, accented with subtle gold, featuring an ultra-refined sci-fi UI, clear and accurate typography, volumetric lighting effects, reflective surfaces, dramatic edge lighting, sophisticated poster design, clean layout symmetry, and a clear focus, presenting a refined, high-end GPT-image-2 futuristic promotional aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影质感的竖版科幻个人品牌海报，采用深蓝色赛博朋克风格，设计为 {argument name="profile name" default="Meta_wu"} 的未来感个人资料信息图。构图中心是一位年轻亚裔男性的背影及部分侧脸，他自信地穿着一件带有发光蓝色装饰的亮面黑色未来感夹克，背部印有“META_WU”和“WEB3 × AI”字样。他的面部被一个矩形模糊块刻意遮挡。背景是壮丽的外太空场景，上方背景是一个巨大的发光地球，布满繁星，下方是未来感十足的夜间大都市天际线、霓虹灯路轨，左中位置有一艘小型飞行飞船。在最上方，放置一个巨大的金属冰晶质感标题，以粗体斜面银色字母书写“{argument name="main title" default="Meta_wu"}”，并带有蓝色边缘光。正下方添加两行居中的中文文本：第一行是角色标语“BTC矿工｜币安夏普比率No.1交易员｜程序员｜专注web3+AI交叉”，第二行是“投资观察-加密货币&美股&A股”。在人物周围环绕透明深色玻璃材质的发光全息 HUD 面板，并配有青色霓虹边框。左侧创建 4 个堆叠面板：面板 1 是“关于我”卡片，包含 4 行个人资料信息，“科技｜Hongkong 🇭🇰”、“github.com/Ferwoo”、“出生于 1999年5月1日”和“2016年10月 加入”；面板 2 是社交数据卡片，包含 3 个大指标，“1,950 正在关注”、“3,906 关注者”和“1 置顶推文”；面板 3 是“BTC MINER”卡片，展示一枚巨大的金色比特币和服务器挖矿机架场景；面板 4 是“交易哲学”卡片，包含 3 行文本，“数据驱动 × 理性决策”、“长期主义 × 价值投资”以及一个发光的向上 K 线图。右侧创建 6 个堆叠面板：面板 1 显示地球图标和“被全球KOLs关注 1”；面板 2 显示群组图标和“被中文KOLs关注 93”；面板 3 显示图表图标和“全球影响力排名 62,434 /200K”；面板 4 显示奖杯图标和“华语影响力 5,053 /10K”；面板 5 是“TRADER”卡片，副标题为“币安夏普比率 No.1”，配有金色上升折线图，以及小字“SHARPE RATIO TOP 1”；面板 6 是“DEVELOPER”卡片，包含类似代码的文本行“// Code is law”、“// Web3 is future”、“// AI x Crypto”、“function build() {”、“return change_the_world();”、“}”以及 GitHub 风格图标。在下方中心，添加一句醒目的中文口号，使用巨大的发光白色文字：“{argument name="slogan text" default="探索未来的交叉点"}”。在其下方添加一行较小的副标题：“在web3与AI的浪潮中，构建价值与未来”。底部包含 3 个水平对齐的矩形分类卡片：卡片 1 标记为“加密货币”，带有比特币图标和微型市场图表；卡片 2 标记为“美股”，带有特斯拉和苹果标志；卡片 3 标记为“A股”，带有上升的柱状和折线市场图。在最底部中心，放置 4 个由竖线分隔的中文关键词：“科技｜投资｜自由｜影响力”，下方是对应的英文单词“TECHNOLOGY · INVESTMENT · FREEDOM · INFLUENCE”。采用高对比度的蓝银配色方案，点缀微妙的金色，超精细的科幻 UI，清晰准确的排版，体积光效果，反射表面，戏剧性的边缘照明，高级海报设计，整洁的布局对称性，焦点清晰，呈现出精致的高端 GPT-image-2 未来感宣传美学。

templates.title: Futuristic Mumbai sunset skyline

titleLocalized.zh: 未来主义风格孟买日落天际线

templates.prompt: A cinematic, ultra-detailed wide-angle cityscape image will{argument name="city name" default="Mumbai"} Reimagined as a futuristic megacity at sunset, the viewpoint is an overview of the coastline. The skyline is dominated by dozens of futuristic skyscrapers of varying silhouettes, including six particularly striking supertall towers with sleek glass facades, sharp geometric shapes, and neon accents, interwoven with the dense urban mid-rise below. To the right, a long, dramatic bridge reminiscent of the Bandra-Worli Sea Link stretches dramatically from the foreground to the calm coastal waters in the distance, its traffic converging into flowing ribbons of headlights and taillights. The sun hangs low near the horizon above the Arabian Sea, casting golden rays across the water and bathing the entire scene in rich shades of orange, amber, pink, and magenta, with layers of clouds adding depth. In the lower left foreground, a grand, warmly lit domed building inspired by historic South Mumbai architecture contrasts sharply with the futuristic skyline; above it, a suspended, circular UFO platform illuminated in blue light is added. In addition, place two visible illuminated billboards in the lower left and right-center urban areas: a large sign reading "MUMBAI," "मुंबई," and "THE CITY OF DREAMS," and a smaller sign reading "NAVI MUMBAI." Add a small aircraft or drone near the central tower. Place prominent, clean white lettering in large capital letters at the top center.{argument name="top text" default="CHATGPT"} The overall atmosphere is grand, ambitious, glossy, and rich in detail, presenting a conceptual art style full of atmospheric haze, glowing windows, glass reflections, and sharp contrasts, belonging to the science fiction urban fantasy genre.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影级、超精细的广角城市景观图，将 {argument name="city name" default="Mumbai"} 重新构想为日落时分的未来主义超级城市，视角位于海岸线上方的俯瞰点。天际线密布着数十座轮廓各异的未来主义摩天大楼，其中包括 6 座格外显眼的超高层塔楼，它们拥有光滑的玻璃幕墙、锐利的几何造型和霓虹灯点缀，与下方密集的城市中层建筑交织在一起。在右侧，一座类似于班德拉-沃里海湾大桥（Bandra-Worli Sea Link）的长跨海大桥从前景戏剧性地延伸至远方平静的海岸水域，桥上车流汇聚成流动的头灯和尾灯光带。太阳低悬在阿拉伯海上方的地平线附近，在水面上投射出金色的光辉，使整个场景沐浴在浓郁的橙色、琥珀色、粉色和洋红色的光影中，云层层次丰富。在左下角前景处，加入一座受南孟买历史建筑启发、灯光温暖的宏伟圆顶建筑，与未来主义天际线形成鲜明对比；在其上方，添加一个带有蓝色灯光的悬浮圆形 UFO 平台。此外，在左下角和中右侧的城市区域放置 2 个可见的照明广告牌：一个大型标志，上面写着 "MUMBAI"、"मुंबई" 和 "THE CITY OF DREAMS"，另一个较小的标志写着 "NAVI MUMBAI"。在中央塔楼附近添加 1 个小型飞行器或无人机。在顶部中央放置醒目、整洁的白色大写文字 {argument name="top text" default="CHATGPT"}。整体氛围宏大、充满抱负、光泽感强、细节丰富，呈现出充满大气霾感、窗户发光、玻璃反射、对比鲜明且精致的概念艺术风格，属于科幻城市幻想题材。
