templates.title: AI chat screenshots and anatomical posters

titleLocalized.zh: AI 聊天截图与解剖学海报

templates.prompt: A screenshot of a portrait-oriented AI chat application interface shows a clean, iOS-style white screen. A hamburger menu is located on the top left, with a blue "Thinking" title and a small arrow in the center. Two icons on the right are for creating new content and adding more options. Near the top is a rounded, light gray user message bubble containing the Japanese phrase: “Attention机构を人类に喩えて细かくラベルを付けて。醫醫書の精致な插絵風に.” (Please compare the attention mechanism to the human body and provide detailed annotations. Use the style of exquisite illustrations in medical books.) Below this is the light gray system text “Thought for 5s” and “畫畫が作成されました”. The lower half of the screen displays the generated image: a detailed anatomical poster in the style of a medical textbook. The poster presents a realistic three-quarter view of an adult woman's back, from head to upper thigh. Her head is slightly turned to the left, and her dark brown hair is tied in a messy bun. Most of the skin and outer tissue of the body has been removed, exposing muscles, nerves, blood vessels, and fibrous structures, presented in an extremely delicate retro medical illustration style against a warm, beige paper background. A rectangular incision obscures the center of the face from the forehead to the jaw, creating a blank space in the facial area that is being scrutinized. Subtle, glowing network lines and nodes superimposed on the exposed brain and body visualize the attention mechanism as an anatomical system. Surrounding the figure are six numbered explanatory panels and two additional text blocks, all densely filled with Japanese and English bilingual labels, formulas, arrows, and diagrams. The main title in the upper left corner of the poster is "The Anatomy of the Attention Mechanism," and the subtitle is "The Anatomy of the Attention Mechanism." The top right corner features a flowchart labeled "Overall Flow of Attention," containing five interconnected boxes describing the process from input to output. To the left are three stacked explanatory sections containing equations and mapping tables. To the right are three more numbered sections, each with technical explanations and small diagrams or matrices; the visible small diagrams include a purple heatmap matrix, a blue bar chart, and a multicolored cube. At the bottom are five small brain illustrations with explanatory text, showcasing the various stages of the information flow. The overall aesthetic should be presented as a highly polished AI-generated screenshot, documenting a surreal scientific illustration request with a clean UI, numerous tiny, readable labels, and a perfect blend of Transformer attention diagrams and classical anatomical design.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张竖屏的 AI 聊天应用界面截图，显示了简洁的 iOS 风格白色屏幕。顶部栏左侧有一个汉堡菜单，中间是蓝色的“Thinking”标题及一个小箭头，右侧有两个图标分别用于新建和更多选项。顶部附近有一个圆角浅灰色用户消息气泡，内容为日语：“Attention機構を人体に喩えて細かくラベルを付けて。医学書の精緻な挿絵風に。”（请将注意力机制比作人体并进行详细标注。采用医学书籍中精致插图的风格。）下方有浅灰色的系统文字显示“Thought for 5s”和“画像が作成されました”。屏幕下半部分展示了生成的图像，这是一张详尽的医学教科书风格解剖学海报。海报展示了一名成年女性从头部到大腿上部的逼真四分之三背影，她头部微向左转，深棕色头发扎成凌乱的发髻。身体大部分的皮肤和外层组织被移除，露出肌肉、神经、血管和纤维结构，以极其细腻的复古医学插图风格呈现在暖色调的米黄色纸张背景上。一个矩形切口遮挡了从前额到下颌的面部中心，在面部区域形成了一个被审查的空白块。细微的发光网络线条和节点叠加在暴露的大脑和身体上，将注意力机制可视化为一种解剖系统。人物周围有 6 个带编号的解释面板和 2 个附加文本块，全部密密麻麻地填满了日语和英语双语标签、公式、箭头和图表。海报左上角的主标题为“アテンション機構の解剖学的構造”，副标题为“The Anatomy of the Attention Mechanism”。右上角是一个标有“Overall Flow of Attention”的流程图，包含 5 个相连的方框，描述了从输入到输出的过程。左侧是 3 个堆叠的解释部分，包含方程式和映射表。右侧是另外 3 个带编号的部分，每个部分都有技术说明和小型图表或矩阵；可见的小型图表包括 1 个紫色热力图矩阵、1 个蓝色柱状图和 1 个多色立方体图形。底边有 5 个带有说明文字的小型大脑插图，展示了信息流的各个阶段。整体美学应呈现为一张经过高度润色的 AI 生成截图，记录了一个超现实的科学插图请求，具有清晰的 UI、大量微小可读的标签，以及 Transformer 注意力图表与古典解剖图设计的完美融合。

templates.title: Gothic anime girl by the amusement park railing

titleLocalized.zh: 游乐场栏杆旁的哥特风动漫少女

templates.prompt: A richly detailed anime-style illustration depicts a fair-skinned gothic girl in a brightly colored urban amusement park. The image is shot in a close-up to medium shot; she leans forward, biting a horizontal metal railing, her expression mischievous and slightly rebellious. She has long, straight hair, the color of which is {argument name="hair color" default="pitch black"} She has bangs, bright red eyes, and a delicate face with her small mouth lightly pressed against the railing. Three geometric hair clips adorn the right side of her hair: a red triangle, a blue angular one, and a small gold hoop. She wears multiple earrings, including several studs and dangling industrial-style earrings. She's dressed in a black, functional gothic outfit, comprising five key pieces: a short black jacket with red and blue stripes, a black choker, a black belted top or dress with a front clasp, a wide belt with metal hardware, and a hanging waist chain. Her sleeves are wide and long, with white striped detailing on one forearm. Her hands grip the railing tightly, one close to her mouth, the other extending to the side, creating a pose that is both intimate and confrontational. The background is an amusement park with brightly colored facilities, including blue pillars, red connectors, yellow and red climbing poles, and a rubber surface composed of bold geometric blocks of blue, red, yellow, white, and black. The background features dark green trees and a dramatic, graphic sky with large, flat shapes in red, orange, blue, black, and white, as well as circular sun-shaped dots, giving the scene a poster-like pop art style. A vertical warning sticker with Japanese text and small warning icons is located on the blue pillar on the left. The composition employs crisp celluloid shadows, sharp lines, subtle glitch textures, oversaturated colors, high contrast, a melancholic cyberpunk gothic atmosphere, and a dynamic composition focusing on the girl's intense gaze and the metal railings.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张细节丰富的动漫风格插画，描绘了一位皮肤白皙的哥特少女身处色彩鲜艳的城市游乐场中。画面采用近景中景镜头，她身体前倾，咬住一根横向金属栏杆，表情调皮且略带叛逆。她留着一头笔直的长发，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="漆黑"}，留着齐刘海，拥有一双鲜红色的眼睛，精致的面容上，小嘴轻压在栏杆上。她的右侧头发上装饰着 3 个几何发夹：1 个红色三角形发夹、1 个蓝色角形发夹和 1 个金色小圆环发夹。她佩戴着多个耳饰，包括几枚耳钉和悬垂的工业风耳环。她身穿一套黑色机能风哥特装束，包含 5 个明显的关键单品：1 件带有红蓝条纹装饰的黑色短款夹克、1 个黑色颈圈、1 件带有前扣的黑色绑带上衣或连衣裙、1 条带有金属配件的宽腰带，以及 1 条悬挂的腰链。她的袖子宽大且修长，其中一只前臂上有白色条纹细节。双手紧握栏杆，一只靠近嘴部，另一只向侧面延伸，营造出一种亲密而又充满对抗感的姿势。背景是游乐场，设施色彩鲜艳，包括蓝色立柱、红色连接件、黄红相间的攀爬杆，以及由蓝、红、黄、白、黑等大胆几何色块组成的橡胶地面。背景中有深绿色的树木和戏剧性的图形化天空，天空中有红色、橙色、蓝色、黑色和白色的大型扁平形状，以及圆形太阳状圆点，使整个场景呈现出海报般的波普艺术风格。在左侧蓝色立柱上包含 1 张带有日文和小型警示图标的垂直警告贴纸。采用清晰的赛璐珞阴影、锐利的线条、轻微的故障纹理点缀、超饱和的色彩、高对比度、忧郁的赛博哥特时尚氛围，以及聚焦于少女强烈眼神和金属栏杆的动态构图。

templates.title: Japanese jungle theme park parody poster

titleLocalized.zh: 日式丛林主题公园恶搞海报

templates.prompt: This is an incredibly detailed Japanese-style parody theme park advertisement poster. Using a vertical format, the design blends dramatic summer tourism advertising with luxury attraction promotion. The background is a tropical jungle with a clear blue sky above, dotted with scattered clouds. A blazing sun hangs in the upper right corner, and palm leaves droop from the top edge. A large 3D stone-textured Japanese title is placed at the top of the poster.{argument name="headline text" default="Jankiria Okinawa"} Below is a line of small white Japanese text: "— やんばるの自然に包まれた、超本格ジャングル・テーマパーク—". In the center of the image is a modern smartphone, upright and slightly tilted, occupying the visual focus. The screen displays a beige ticket lottery waiting screen, with a jungle silhouette at the top, and the prominent bold Japanese text "整理票抽选" (ticket lottery results are being processed) in the middle, accompanied by a circular loading icon. At the bottom, smaller text reads "结果発表まで30分" (Results have been posted 30 minutes ago) and "※この屏を闭じずにお待ちください" (Please wait for this screen to close). The phone's status bar shows the time as 10:00. To the left rear of the phone is a Tyrannosaurus Rex bursting out of the jungle vegetation, its mouth wide open, a realistic and menacing image. To the right is an ornately decorated golden entrance gate, intricately carved, with a sign above reading "Premium Pass Entrance," leading to a VIP passageway carpeted in red. The foreground and midground show long queues of tourists stretching into the distance, dressed in casual summer attire, wearing hats, carrying towels and backpacks, and holding parasols, fans, and water bottles, conveying their weariness in the sweltering heat. The faces of several figures closer to the frame are blurred. On the far left stands a large, weathered stone monument with the striking red Japanese inscription "Waiting Time 180 Minutes." In the bottom left corner are three stacked, rustic-style wooden items: the top sign has a blue parking icon and the text "Parking lot 2,000 yen"; the middle sign has a smartphone icon and the text "App must down road!"; and the bottom sign has a dinosaur silhouette and the text "You're the chosen one." Along the edge in the bottom right corner is a very prominent vertical white calligraphy-style Japanese text: "Wait, you're the chosen one." Contains 3 near the lower right corner A small round icon is marked with a brief Japanese slogan: "The person who chooses the lottery is the one who is the best, the fear is the dragon will be the one who will be the best." "きる前に、梦はstartまる" and "プレミアムなNearly道も、ご意しました", the icons respectively imply dinosaurs, mobile phone battery and VIP. aisle. A black disclaimer bar was added to the center of the bottom with small white Japanese text reading: "このポスターは空空のパロディ広报です". The overall style pursues hyper-realism, cinematic feel, high contrast, and satire, and is as exquisite as a high-end commercial poster. The core humor lies in the exaggerated hype of the theme park, the oppressive heat, and the absurd queuing-style adventure.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超精细的日式恶搞主题公园广告海报，采用竖版构图，设计风格融合了戏剧性的夏季旅游广告与奢华景点宣传。背景为热带丛林，上方是湛蓝的天空，点缀着零星云朵，右上角悬挂着烈日，棕榈叶从顶部边缘垂下。海报顶部放置一个巨大的 3D 石质纹理日文标题 {argument name="headline text" default="ジャンキリア沖縄"}，下方配有一行较小的白色日文标语：“— やんばるの大自然に包まれた、超本格ジャングル・テーマパーク —”。画面中央是一部竖立且略微倾斜的现代智能手机，占据视觉中心。手机屏幕显示着一个米色的门票抽签等待界面，顶部有丛林剪影，中间是醒目的粗体日文“整理券抽選中”，配有一个圆形加载图标，底部显示较小的文字“結果発表まで30分”和“※この画面を閉じずにお待ちください”。手机状态栏显示时间为 10:00。手机左后方是一只从丛林植被中冲出的霸王龙，张着大嘴，形象逼真且极具威胁感。右侧是一个装饰华丽的金色入口大门，带有精细雕刻，上方挂着写有“プレミアムパス入口”的牌子，通向一条铺着红毯的尊享通道。前景和中景展示了长长的游客排队队伍，一直延伸到画面深处，游客们穿着休闲夏装，戴着帽子、毛巾、背包，手里拿着遮阳伞、扇子和水瓶，表现出酷暑下的疲惫感。靠近画面的几个人物面部模糊处理。最左侧立着一块巨大的风化石碑，上面写着醒目的红色日文“待ち時間 180分”。左下角有 3 块堆叠的乡村风格木制项目：顶部的牌子带有蓝色停车图标和文字“駐車場 2,000円”；中间的牌子带有智能手机图标和文字“アプリ必須 ダウンロードしてね!”；底部的牌子带有恐龙剪影和文字“当選者だけが冒険へ”。右下角沿边缘放置了非常醒目的竖排白色书法风格日文文案“待つこと、それが冒険だ。”。右下角附近包含 3 个小型圆形图标标注，配有简短的日文宣传语：“抽選に選ばれし者だけが、恐竜に会える。”、“スマホの充電が尽きる前に、夢は始まる。”以及“プレミアムな近道も、ご用意しました。”，图标分别暗示恐龙、手机电量和 VIP 通道。底部中央添加了一条黑色免责声明栏，上面写着小号白色日文：“このポスターは架空のパロディ広告です”。整体风格追求超写实、电影感、高对比度、讽刺性，并像高端商业海报一样精致，核心笑点在于夸张的主题公园炒作、压抑的酷暑以及荒诞的排队式冒险。

templates.title: Low-angle anime bunny girl in the ruins

titleLocalized.zh: 废墟中的低角度动漫兔女郎

templates.prompt: A dynamic, anime-style illustration from a low angle depicts two young women wearing rabbit-themed bodysuits. The perspective is from below, as if the camera is tilted upwards, and they are looking slightly down at the viewer. The girl on the left has {argument name="hair color" default="blonde"} The girl on the right has short, curly pigtails, wears large red rabbit ears, and a shiny red high-slit bodysuit with puff sleeves, long opera gloves, a heart-shaped front panel, and four round silver button-like discs. The girl on the right has long, straight brown hair, wears light-colored rabbit ears, and a similarly designed shiny white and light pink bodysuit with puff sleeves, long gloves, a heart-shaped front panel, and four round silver discs. Both are slender with long legs and expressive, large anime eyes, their expressions slightly surprised and curious, their gazes meeting and glancing slightly at the audience. Their hands hang naturally at their sides, almost touching at the center. Imagine them in front of a vast, ruined cathedral or a dilapidated, magnificent stone building, with a background of broken arches, skeletal metal frames, shattered windows, and collapsed rubble, rendered in a soft, anime-style atmosphere. The dramatic Dutch angle and strong perspective create a sense of tilt in the architecture, making the characters appear tall and close to the camera. Behind the ruins lies a clear blue sky and vast white clouds. The characters are rendered with clean cel-shaded backgrounds, rich in detail and painterly quality, with sharp lines and vibrant yet slightly weathered colors, resulting in a cinematic composition. Three text elements are added in the upper right corner as a graphic design overlay: the small uppercase text "ARINKO AGENTS," the large bold Japanese characters "Heiwajima," and a large white handwritten signature-style font overlaid on the background.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满动感的动漫风格低角度插画，画面中两名年轻女性身着兔主题连体衣，视角从下方仰视，仿佛摄像机向上倾斜，而她们正微微低头看向观众。左侧女孩留着 {argument name="hair color" default="blonde"} 的短双马尾，发尾卷曲，戴着巨大的红色兔耳朵，身穿亮面鲜红色高叉连体衣，配有泡泡袖、长款歌剧手套、心形胸前拼接设计，正面饰有 4 枚圆形银色纽扣状圆盘。右侧女孩留着长直棕发，戴着浅色兔耳朵，身穿同款设计的亮面白色与浅粉色连体衣，同样配有泡泡袖、长手套、心形胸前拼接设计和 4 枚圆形银色圆盘。两人身材苗条，双腿修长，拥有富有表现力的动漫大眼，神情略带惊讶与好奇，目光交汇并微微看向观众。她们的手自然垂在身体两侧，在中心位置几乎相触。将她们置于一座广阔的废墟大教堂或破败的宏伟石建筑前，背景包含破碎的拱门、骨架般的金属框架、破碎的窗户和坍塌的瓦砾，渲染为柔和的动漫背景风格。采用戏剧性的荷兰式倾斜角（Dutch angle）和强烈的透视效果，使建筑随镜头倾斜，让角色显得高大且贴近镜头。废墟后方是湛蓝的天空和巨大的白云。角色采用干净的赛璐珞阴影，背景细节丰富且具有绘画感，线条清晰，色彩鲜艳但略带风化感，构图极具电影感。在右上角添加 3 个文本元素作为平面设计叠加：小号大写字母文本“ARINKO AGENTS”、大号粗体日文“平和島”，以及一个覆盖在背景上的大型白色手写签名式字体。

templates.prompt: A high-quality anime illustration depicting a{argument name="character type" default="Cat-eared female student"} The scene depicts her leaning against the metal railing of the school rooftop at sunset, shot from a slightly upward-looking, three-quarter profile. She has flowing hair.{argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown"} She has long hair with a soft sheen, bright and reflective grey-brown eyes, and wears round, thin-rimmed glasses. Two fluffy cat ears peek out from her hair. Her expression is quiet, melancholic, and slightly shy; her lips are slightly parted, and her gaze gently falls upon the audience. She wears a Japanese sailor school uniform, the top of which is soft {argument name="uniform color" default="pink"} She wears long sleeves with a grey sailor collar and white stripes, tied with a bright red bow tie, and a plaid skirt is faintly visible. A dark backpack strap is slung over her shoulders. The scene is bathed in dramatic golden-moon backlighting, with her hair, ears, shoulders, and cuffs shimmering with intense warm-toned contour lighting. A bright halo of sunlight hangs in the lower left, and the sky is painted with rich orange and peach clouds. The background shows a two-story Japanese school building with a red-tiled roof, its windows shimmering in the setting sun. The design emphasizes the nostalgic feel of key visuals from high-end anime in the early 2000s: delicate lines, bright eyes, finely detailed hair, cinematic composition, soft depth of field, vibrant warm colors, subtle shadows, and a serene emotional atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高质量的动漫插画，描绘了一位 {argument name="character type" default="猫耳女学生"} 在日落时分倚靠在学校金属天台护栏上的场景，采用略微仰视的近景四分之三侧面视角。她留着一头飘逸的 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 长发，带有柔和的高光，有着明亮且富有反光的灰褐色双眸，佩戴着圆框细边眼镜，发间露出两只毛茸茸的猫耳。她的表情安静、忧郁且略带羞涩，双唇微启，目光温柔地向下注视着观众。她身穿日本水手校服，上衣为柔和的 {argument name="uniform color" default="粉色"} 长袖，搭配灰色水手领及白色条纹，系着鲜艳的红色领结，隐约可见格子裙，双肩背着深色书包带。场景沉浸在戏剧性的黄金时刻逆光中，她的头发、耳朵、肩膀和袖口边缘闪烁着强烈的暖色轮廓光，左下方有明亮的太阳光晕，天空绘有丰富的橙色和桃色云彩。背景展示了一座带有红色瓦片屋顶的二层日本教学楼，窗户在夕阳下闪烁着光芒。强调 2000 年代初高端动漫关键视觉图的怀旧质感、细腻的线条、明亮的双眸、精细的发丝、电影级的构图、柔和的景深、鲜艳的暖色调、精致的阴影以及宁静的情感氛围。

templates.title: Steampunk Retro Video Platform UI

titleLocalized.zh: 蒸汽朋克复古视频平台 UI

templates.prompt: Create a full-screen fictional video platform homepage in a richly detailed steampunk Victorian style, designed with an antique brass and wood web interface featuring a dark bronze metal border, carved decorations, rivets, pipes, exposed gears, glowing Edison light bulbs, and a brown texture throughout. At the top center, a large embossed title is displayed as {argument name="site name" default="ElectroVid"} The logo features a bold gold serif font on a dark plaque, below which is a smaller subtitle plaque that reads "THE FUTURE IN MOTION". In the upper left corner, a modern brand logo is overlaid, displaying "Pollo AI" and "GPT Image 2" in a clean, contemporary font, contrasting with the vintage interface. A circular analog gauge is added in the upper right corner. Below the header is a navigation bar containing six items: a homepage icon, "TRENDING", "INNOVATIONS", "DOCUMENTARIES", "ENTERTAINMENT", and a display {argument name="search placeholder" default="Search ElectroVid..."} The layout features a search box and a search icon. The main layout is a two-column design: a narrow left sidebar and a larger main content area. In the left sidebar, a section titled "POPULAR CHANNELS" is added, containing three vertically stacked channel cards, each with a circular logo, channel name, number of subscribers, and a "SUBSCRIBE" button: "THE PATENT OFFICE" with "27.4K SUBSCRIBERS," "THE ROYAL SOCIETY" with "18.7K SUBSCRIBERS," and "GENERAL ELECTRIC" with "35.1K SUBSCRIBERS." In the main content area, a large central video player is positioned, framed by an ornate brass border. The paused video feed is a sepia-toned historical scene: two men in suits debating in front of a blackboard labeled "AC vs. DC" and a lightning bolt sketch; one points, the other gestures, both faces softly blurred. The bottom edge of the player includes a video progress bar and controls, along with a timestamp displayed as "08:47 / 22:31". Below the player, the title is displayed in a large serif font.{argument name="featured video title" default="The Truth About AC vs. DC: The Final Debate"} This is followed by the channel metadata for "The Electrical Age," "142K views," "3 days ago," and "LIKE" buttons labeled "LIKE" and "5.8K" on the right. Below this, create a section titled "LATEST VIDEOS" and display three thumbnail cards on the same line. Card 1 shows a sepia-toned portrait of Thomas Edison holding a glowing light bulb, duration "10:12," title "My New Incandescent Bulb," metadata "Thomas Edison," "89K views," "5 days ago." Card 2 shows a dramatic sepia-toned image of the Tesla Coil Tower under an electric arc, duration "15:36," title "The Wonders of the Wardenclyffe Tower," metadata "Nikola Tesla," "120K views," "1 week ago." Card 3 shows an antique car on the street, duration "12:08," title "The Automobile Revolution," metadata "Henry Ford," "110K views," "1 week ago." Below the line, center a button that reads "VIEW ALL VIDEOS." At the bottom center, a copyright plaque is added that reads "© 1893 ElectroVid, Ltd. All rights reserved." The interface is symmetrical and meticulously crafted, featuring realistic depth, embossed typography, soft warm lighting, old parchment panels, Victorian engraving aesthetics, and a sophisticated cinematic sepia tone composed of brass, copper, dark wood, black steel, and antique gold.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个全屏的虚构视频平台主页，采用细节丰富的蒸汽朋克维多利亚风格，设计成古董黄铜与木质网页界面，带有深青铜金属边框、雕刻装饰、铆钉、管道、外露齿轮、发光的爱迪生灯泡以及贯穿始终的棕褐色纹理。在顶部中央，一个巨大的浮雕标题显示为 {argument name="site name" default="ElectroVid"}，采用华丽的金色衬线字体刻在深色牌匾上，下方有一个较小的副标题牌匾，写着“THE FUTURE IN MOTION”。在左上角，叠加一个现代品牌标志，以简洁的现代字体显示“Pollo AI”和“GPT Image 2”，与古董界面形成对比。在右上角添加一个圆形模拟仪表。在页眉下方，放置一个包含 6 个项目的导航栏：一个主页图标、“TRENDING”、“INNOVATIONS”、“DOCUMENTARIES”、“ENTERTAINMENT”，以及一个显示 {argument name="search placeholder" default="Search ElectroVid..."} 的搜索框和一个搜索图标。主布局为双栏式：一个窄左侧边栏和一个较大的主要内容区域。在左侧边栏中，添加一个标题为“POPULAR CHANNELS”的部分，包含 3 个垂直堆叠的频道卡片，每张卡片都有一个圆形徽标、频道名称、订阅者数量和一个“SUBSCRIBE”按钮：“THE PATENT OFFICE”及“27.4K SUBSCRIBERS”、“THE ROYAL SOCIETY”及“18.7K SUBSCRIBERS”以及“GENERAL ELECTRIC”及“35.1K SUBSCRIBERS”。在主要内容区域，设置一个由华丽黄铜边框包裹的大型中央视频播放器。暂停的视频画面是一个棕褐色的历史场景，两名穿着西装的男子在写有“AC vs. DC”及闪电草图的黑板前辩论，一人指点，另一人做手势，两人的脸部均有柔和模糊的遮挡块。在播放器底部边缘包含一个视频进度条和控件，以及显示为“08:47 / 22:31”的时间戳。在播放器下方，以大号衬线字体显示标题 {argument name="featured video title" default="The Truth About AC vs. DC: The Final Debate"}，随后是“The Electrical Age”的频道元数据、“142K views”、“3 days ago”，以及右侧标注为“LIKE”和“5.8K”的点赞按钮。在此下方，创建一个标题为“LATEST VIDEOS”的部分，并在同一行显示 3 张缩略图卡片。卡片 1 显示托马斯·爱迪生手持发光灯泡的棕褐色肖像，时长“10:12”，标题“My New Incandescent Bulb”，元数据“Thomas Edison”、“89K views”、“5 days ago”。卡片 2 显示特斯拉线圈塔在电弧下的戏剧性棕褐色图像，时长“15:36”，标题“The Wonders of the Wardenclyffe Tower”，元数据“Nikola Tesla”、“120K views”、“1 week ago”。卡片 3 显示街上一辆古董汽车，时长“12:08”，标题“The Automobile Revolution”，元数据“Henry Ford”、“110K views”、“1 week ago”。在行下方居中位置，添加一个写有“VIEW ALL VIDEOS”的按钮。在底部中央，添加一个版权牌匾，写着“© 1893 ElectroVid, Ltd. All rights reserved.”。使用对称、精心制作的界面，具有逼真的深度、浮雕排版、柔和的暖光、旧羊皮纸面板、维多利亚时代的雕刻美学，以及由黄铜、铜、深色木材、黑钢和古董金组成的精致电影感棕褐色调。

templates.title: Korean sports drink celebrity advertisement poster

titleLocalized.zh: 韩式运动饮料名人广告海报

templates.prompt: A distinctive Korean-style beverage advertisement poster, employing a glossy commercial photography style. The main subject of the image is {argument name="spokesperson" default="Donald Trump stand-in"} He was dressed in a dark navy blue business suit, a white shirt underneath, and a bright blue tie, facing the camera directly. The background was a highly saturated bright blue sky, dotted with a few soft white clouds, and to the right, a modern city skyline was faintly visible, including a towering skyscraper resembling the Empire State Building. In his left hand, he held a bottle of chilled beverage {argument name="product name" default="POCARI SWEAT"} The bottle, with its exaggerated perspective extending towards the camera, appears enormous in the foreground, while the person is positioned slightly behind. The transparent bottle, adorned with condensation droplets, features a white cap and reveals the liquid inside. A dark blue label prominently displays the white "POCARI SWEAT" lettering, with smaller "ION SUPPLY DRINK" text above. Vibrant splashes and droplets of icy water are added around the bottle, the hand, and the foreground below to emphasize the refreshing and hydrating feel. The brand logo is placed in the upper left corner: white "POCARI SWEAT" lettering with a curved underline below. A large, distressed white Korean title is added to the top of the poster, slightly tilted and occupying most of the upper half.{argument name="headline text" default="갈증 해소? 이걸로 끝! 포카리스웨트!"} Add a striking line of italicized white and blue Korean quotation in the lower right corner, where the suit is located:{argument name="quote" default="WINNING은 수분 싸움! 포카리스웨트로 리프레시!"} The bottom left corner features three vertically arranged circular benefit icons, each accompanied by a short Korean label: a water droplet icon with "수분보충" (hydration replenishment), a lightning bolt icon with "전해질보충" (electrolyte replenishment), and a running figure icon with "빠른흡수" (rapid absorption). The high-contrast blue and white color scheme, combined with dramatic advertising lighting, keeps the bottle and hand clearly in focus while slightly softening the focus on the face and background, resulting in a vibrant and high-quality advertising poster aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张风格鲜明的韩式饮料广告海报，采用光泽感商业摄影风格。画面主体为 {argument name="spokesperson" default="唐纳德·特朗普替身"}，身穿深海军蓝商务西装，内搭白色衬衫，系着鲜艳的蓝色领带，正面对着镜头。背景是饱和度极高的亮蓝色天空，点缀着几朵柔和的白云，右侧隐约可见现代城市天际线，包括一座类似帝国大厦的高耸摩天大楼。他左手拿着一瓶冰镇塑料瓶装的 {argument name="product name" default="POCARI SWEAT"}，以夸张的透视效果伸向镜头，使瓶身在前景中显得格外巨大，人物则略微靠后。瓶身透明且带有冷凝水珠，配有白色瓶盖，瓶内可见液体，深蓝色标签上印有醒目的白色“POCARI SWEAT”字样，上方有较小的“ION SUPPLY DRINK”文字。在瓶身、手部及下方前景周围添加充满活力的冰冻水花和水滴，以强调清爽与补水感。品牌 Logo 放置在左上角：白色的“POCARI SWEAT”字样及下方的弧形下划线。海报顶部添加巨大的做旧风格白色韩文标题，略微倾斜并占据上半部分的大部分空间：{argument name="headline text" default="갈증 해소? 이걸로 끝! 포카리스웨트!"}。在右下方西装位置，添加一行醒目的斜体白色与蓝色韩文引用语：{argument name="quote" default="WINNING은 수분 싸움! 포카리스웨트로 리프레시!"}。左下角垂直排列 3 个圆形益处图标，并配有简短的韩文标签：水滴图标配“수분 보충”（水分补充）、闪电图标配“전해질 보충”（电解质补充）、奔跑人物图标配“빠른 흡수”（快速吸收）。采用高对比度的蓝白配色，运用戏剧性的广告布光，瓶身和手部焦点清晰，面部和背景焦点略微柔化，整体呈现出充满活力的优质广告海报质感。

templates.title: Retro-style Korean seaweed rice roll recipe poster

titleLocalized.zh: 复古风韩式紫菜包饭食谱海报

templates.prompt: Create a retro-style Korean food poster with a background of slightly stained and textured aged beige parchment, bordered with a dark decorative border, using a traditional hand-painted ink and watercolor illustration style. The poster is a single, vertically arranged infographic with the theme of {argument name="dish name" default="정통 한국 김밥"} The top is decorated with elegant large Korean calligraphy, and below it is an arched ribbon banner with the text {argument name="subtitle text" default="Traditional Korean Gimbap"} At the top center, a beautifully crafted porcelain plate is displayed, piled high with 12 slices of kimbap (seaweed rice rolls). Each slice clearly shows the filling of white rice, yellow egg, orange carrot, green spinach, and dark seaweed. To the right of the plate is a small bowl of kimchi, accompanied by a short handwritten Korean note: “간단한보여도정성이들어간한국의맛! ♥”. A small red stamp with Korean characters is added near the upper right corner. In the center, add an ingredient section with the ribbon title "재료" (Jewelry), with six ingredient sections arranged horizontally: 1. 김 (건김) showing stacked seaweed sheets, 2. 밥 (양념밥) showing a bowl of rice, 3. 계란 (지단용) showing sliced ​​hard-boiled egg strips, 4. 당근 (채썰어볶기) showing sliced ​​carrot shreds, 5. 시금치 (데쳐서무치기) showing seasoned spinach, and 6. 단무지 (김밥용) showing yellow pickled radish strips. Below, add another ribbon title, "만드는순서," and display six bordered step sections arranged in two rows and three columns, connected from left to right by an arrow. Step 1 is labeled "1 밥간하기," showing a bowl of rice with sesame oil and salt next to it, captioned "밥에참기름소금으로간하기." Step 2 is labeled "2 속재료준비하기," showing eggs, carrots, spinach, and a knife on a cutting board, captioned "재료볶아속재료준비하기." Step 3, labeled "3 김과밥펴기", shows the seaweed on the bamboo mat and the rice laid out, captioned "김에밥얇게펴기". Step 4, labeled "4 속재료얹기", shows the fillings arranged horizontally on the rice, captioned "속재료를차례로얹기". Step 5, labeled "5 단단하게말기", shows the action of tightly rolling up the bamboo mat with both hands, captioned "김밥을단단하게말기". Step 6, labeled "6 썰어완성하기", shows a chef slicing the kimbap roll with a knife, accompanied by the caption "먹기좋게썰어완성!". A wide banner with prominent Korean calligraphy is added at the bottom.{argument name="bottom slogan" default="정성 가득한 한 줄의 행복!"} Add a small heart. Decorate the bottom corner with a floral pattern and add a red square stamp engraved with the Chinese character "福" (Fu, meaning good fortune) in the bottom right corner. Use soft shades of dark brown, tan, cream, olive green, and faded red, combined with finely sketched outlines, soft watercolor shading, and an authentic print poster composition. Add a small, modern overlay logo in the top left corner with the text "[Text missing]".{argument name="brand text" default="Pollo AI GPT Image 2"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张复古风格的韩国美食海报，背景为带有轻微污渍和纹理的做旧米色羊皮纸，配有深色装饰性边框，采用传统手绘水墨与水彩插画风格。海报为单张垂直排列的信息图，主题为 {argument name="dish name" default="정통 한국 김밥"}，顶部饰有优雅的大号韩文书法，下方配有弧形丝带横幅，文字为 {argument name="subtitle text" default="Traditional Korean Gimbap"}。在上方中心位置，展示一个堆满 12 片紫菜包饭切片的精美瓷盘，每片切片清晰可见白米饭、黄色鸡蛋、橙色胡萝卜、绿色菠菜和深色海苔包裹的馅料。在盘子右侧，放置一小碗泡菜，并配有一段简短的手写韩文便签：“간단한 보여도 정성이 들어간 한국의 맛! ♥”。在右上角附近添加一枚带有韩文的小红印章。在中间位置，添加一个带有丝带标题“재료”的食材区，横向排列 6 个食材板块：1. 김 (건김) 展示堆叠的海苔片，2. 밥 (양념 밥) 展示一碗米饭，3. 계란 (지단용) 展示切好的熟鸡蛋条，4. 당근 (채썰어볶기) 展示切好的胡萝卜丝，5. 시금치 (데쳐서 무치기) 展示调味菠菜，6. 단무지 (김밥용) 展示黄色腌萝卜条。下方添加另一个丝带标题“만드는 순서”，并展示 6 个带边框的步骤板块，分两行三列排列，中间用箭头从左到右连接。步骤 1 标注为“1 밥 간하기”，展示一碗米饭及旁边的香油和盐，配文“밥에 참기름 소금으로 간하기”。步骤 2 标注为“2 속재료 준비하기”，展示砧板上的鸡蛋、胡萝卜、菠菜和一把刀，配文“재료 볶아 속재료 준비하기”。步骤 3 标注为“3 김과 밥 펴기”，展示竹帘上的海苔及铺好的米饭，配文“김에 밥 얇게 펴기”。步骤 4 标注为“4 속재료 얹기”，展示在米饭上横向排列的馅料，配文“속재료를 차례로 얹기”。步骤 5 标注为“5 단단하게 말기”，展示双手紧紧卷起竹帘的动作，配文“김밥을 단단하게 말기”。步骤 6 标注为“6 썰어 완성하기”，展示厨师刀将紫菜包饭卷切成片，配文“먹기 좋게 썰어 완성!”。在底部添加一个宽横幅，上面印有醒目的韩文书法 {argument name="bottom slogan" default="정성 가득한 한 줄의 행복!"} 和一颗小爱心。用花卉图案装饰下角，并在右下角添加一枚刻有汉字“福”的红色方形印章。使用柔和的深褐色、棕色、奶油色、橄榄绿和褪色的红色调，结合精细的素描轮廓、柔和的水彩阴影以及地道的印刷海报构图。在左上角添加一个小型的现代叠加标志，文字为 {argument name="brand text" default="Pollo AI GPT Image 2"}。

templates.title: Korean-style sweet rice pudding parody advertisement poster

titleLocalized.zh: 韩式甜米露恶搞广告海报

templates.prompt: Create a bold, Korean-style beverage advertisement poster with a warm, golden liquid splash effect in the background and dramatic commercial lighting. The image should feature a {argument name="celebrity spokesperson" default="Older male politicians like Donald Trump"} The bust depicts a man in a navy blue suit, white shirt, and bright red tie, with a small American flag badge on his collar, confidently promoting a product to the camera. His face is obscured by a flat, skin-colored rectangular mask. His left hand, using forced perspective, extends towards the camera, holding a yellow aluminum can of Korean sweet rice drink. The can is prominently labeled in Korean, with red stripes on the top and bottom, and the main product text reading "비락식혜" and "Since 1993." Smaller Korean instructions, a picture of sweet rice drink on the bottom, and the capacity reading "238 ml (120 kcal)" are also printed on the can. His right hand is giving a thumbs-up. The composition employs a vibrant retro-commercial style, with splashes of sweet rice drink and droplets in the background, highlighted with shimmering gold, and framed from a slightly upward, heroic angle. At the top, there are three striking headlines: in the upper left corner is a handwritten black slogan, “전통의맛, 한국의DRINK!”; in the center is a large, distressed, bold Korean headline in dark brown and black text reading “걸죽는땐?”; in bright red text reading “비락식혜!”; and in the upper right corner is the brand logo “비락”, with the small red text “Since 1993” below. Two additional badges are added: on the left is a yellow circular stamp with a miniature crown icon, reading “대한민국국민음료No.1”; on the right is a white speech bubble containing the handwritten Korean “한국이만든맛있는전통!” and the red English “I LOVE IT!”. At the bottom foreground, place two food elements: on the left is a brass bowl filled with sweet rice porridge and floating rice grains, and on the right is a wooden bowl piled high with white rice. In the lower center, add two lines of large, calligraphy-style promotional text: the first line in white reads “달콤하게! 시원하게!”, and the second line in alternating white and yellow reads “속까지시~원하게!”, underlined with a vibrant yellow. At the very bottom, there are three circular function icons with Korean descriptions: “국내산쌀엄선된재료”, “시원하게갈증해소”, and “부드러운단맛속편한식혜”. In the bottom right corner, add a tiny disclaimer: "연출된이미지입니다". The overall visual effect should be glossy, exaggerated, humorous, and as convincing as a viral parody print ad.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张风格大胆的韩式饮料广告海报，背景为温暖的金色液体飞溅效果，并采用戏剧性的商业灯光。画面展示一位 {argument name="celebrity spokesperson" default="类似唐纳德·特朗普的年长男性政客"} 的半身像，他身穿海军蓝西装、白衬衫，系着鲜红色领带，衣领上别着一枚小小的美国国旗徽章，正对着镜头露出自信的推销表情。他的面部被一个肤色的扁平矩形遮挡块遮住。他左手以强制透视法伸向镜头前方，手中拿着一罐黄色的韩国甜米露铝罐，罐身显著标注韩文，顶部和底部带有红色条纹，主产品文字为“비락 식혜”以及“Since 1993”。罐身上还印有较小的韩文说明、底部的甜米露图案以及容量文字“238 ml (120 kcal)”。他的右手竖起大拇指。

采用充满活力的复古商业构图，背景中有飞溅的甜米露和液滴，带有闪耀的金色高光，并使用略微仰视的英雄式取景。在顶部，包含 3 组醒目的标题文字：左上角是一句手写风格的黑色标语“전통의 맛, 한국의 DRINK!”，中央是巨大的做旧粗体韩文标题，深棕黑色文字写着“걸죽는 땐?”，鲜红色文字写着“비락 식혜!”，右上角是品牌标志“비락”，下方附有红色小字“Since 1993”。添加 2 个标注徽章：左侧是一个带有微型皇冠图标的黄色圆形印章，文字为“대한민국 국민음료 No.1”；右侧是一个白色对话气泡，内含手写韩文“한국이 만든 맛있는 전통!”和红色英文“I LOVE IT!”。

在底部前景处，放置 2 种食物元素：左侧是一个盛满甜米露和漂浮米粒的黄铜碗，右侧是一个堆满白米的木碗。在下部中间位置，添加 2 行大型毛笔风格的促销文字，第一行白色文字为“달콤하게! 시원하게!”，第二行白色与黄色相间的文字为“속까지 시~원하게!”，并配以充满活力的黄色下划线。在最底部，包含 3 个圆形功能图标，配有韩文说明：“국내산 쌀 엄선된 재료”、“시원하게 갈증해소”以及“부드러운 단맛 속 편한 식혜”。在右下角，添加微小的免责声明文字“연출된 이미지입니다”。整体视觉效果需呈现出光泽感、夸张、幽默，并像病毒式传播的恶搞印刷广告一样令人信服。

templates.title: Retro ChatGPT Images 2.0 Space Poster

titleLocalized.zh: Retro ChatGPT Images 2.0 太空海报

templates.prompt: A vintage medieval space race poster, affixed to a rough white plaster wall, is photographed directly in natural light. Slightly wrinkled, creased, and weathered, with worn edges and small tears, the poster presents a realistic, aged paper texture. The design employs a limited vintage color palette of deep navy, faded cream, soft reddish-orange, and grayish-blue. A prominent headline in the upper left corner dominates the design:{argument name="headline text" default="ChatGPT Images 2.0"} The text features "ChatGPT" in an oversized cream-colored sans-serif font, with "Images 2.0" below in bold reddish-orange. On the right, a towering vintage rocket stands vertically, launching upwards through cream-colored smoke, accompanied by vertical lettering on its fuselage.{argument name="rocket text" default="OpenAI"} The color is reddish-orange. A thin orbital trajectory line runs from left to right across the upper half of the poster, encircling the rocket. Slightly to the left of center, a small, detachable spacecraft floats along the trajectory path. The lower left shows the Earth's curved horizon, presented in a retro illustration style, with cyan oceans and cream-colored land. At the bottom is a long, solid reddish-orange bar containing evenly spaced small cream-colored text.{argument name="tagline text" default="EXPLORING TOMORROW"} The design should include four visible stars or celestial objects in a dark sky: two tiny starbursts, one small cream dot, and one larger cream dot. The overall composition should evoke the feel of a 1950s-1960s science fiction travel poster or Soviet/American space age advertising print, featuring silkscreen textures, subtle creases, nostalgic typography, and a cinematic retro-futuristic atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张贴在粗糙白色石膏墙上的复古中世纪太空竞赛宣传海报，在自然光下进行正拍。海报略显褶皱、有折痕且饱经风霜，边缘磨损并带有细小撕裂，呈现出真实的陈旧纸张质感。设计采用了深海军蓝、褪色奶油色、柔和红橙色和灰青色的有限复古色调。左上方醒目的大标题文字占据主导地位：{argument name="headline text" default="ChatGPT Images 2.0"}，其中“ChatGPT”采用超大号奶油色无衬线字体，“Images 2.0”位于下方，使用粗体红橙色。在右侧，一枚高耸的复古火箭垂直矗立，正穿过奶油色的烟雾向上发射，垂直的机身文字 {argument name="rocket text" default="OpenAI"} 为红橙色。一条细细的轨道轨迹线从左向右横跨海报上半部分，环绕着火箭。在中心偏左处，一个小型分离式太空舱沿着轨道路径漂浮。左下方展示了地球的弯曲地平线，以复古插画风格呈现，配有青色海洋和奶油色陆地。底部是一条纯红橙色长条，包含间距均匀的小号奶油色文字 {argument name="tagline text" default="EXPLORING TOMORROW"}。在深色天空中包含 4 颗可见的星星或天体点：2 个微小的星爆、1 个小奶油色圆点和 1 个较大的奶油色圆点。整体构图应呈现出 1950 年代至 1960 年代的科幻旅行海报或苏联/美国太空时代广告印刷品的质感，具有丝网印刷纹理、细微的折痕、怀旧的排版以及电影般的复古未来主义氛围。

templates.title: Realistic X profile page model

titleLocalized.zh: 逼真的 X 个人资料页面模型

templates.prompt: Create a highly realistic dark mode social media interface mockup, closely replicating the French layout of the desktop X/Twitter, presented as a full browser screenshot with a black background and subtle dark gray dividing lines. The left sidebar contains 11 vertically arranged navigation items with white icons and labels: "Accueil" (Home), "Explorer," "Notifications" (with a small blue badge displaying the number 3), "Messages," "Grok," "Signets," "Communities," "Premium," "Organisations certifiées," "Profil," and "Plus." Place a white X logo at the top of this sidebar, add a large circular white button labeled "Poster" slightly below, and display Martin Dubois's compact login account bar at the bottom, including his username @martindubois and a small circular avatar. The middle bar is {argument name="profile name" default="Martin Dubois"} The main profile page features a back arrow, the name "Martin Dubois," and a blue verification badge at the top, with "1,248 posts" displayed below. Below this is a wide panoramic cover photo showcasing the breathtaking scenery of the misty Alps, forests, and lakes. Overlaid on the lower left of the banner is a circular portrait of a young man in dark clothing, his face slightly blurred or obscured against a light background with a thin border. To the right of the profile header are three small circular action buttons and a prominent light-colored, rounded button labeled "Éditer le profil" (Edit profile). Below the portrait are the display name Martin Dubois, the blue verification badge, the account @martindubois , and a French bio: "Créateur de contenu • Passionné de tech, de design et de productivité." (Content creator • Passionate about technology, design, and productivity.) Next, add a row containing metadata for four items: location "Lyon, France", website "martindubois.com", and "A rejoint X en janvier 2021". This is followed by a row of followers showing "320 abonnements" and "12,4k abonnés". Add a horizontal tab bar with five labels: "Posts", "Replies", "Featured Tweets", "Media", and "Likes", with "Posts" active and underlined in blue. Below the tabs, display a feed containing three visible posts by Martin Dubois. The first post is pinned, marked "Épinglé" (pinned), dated "12 mai" (May 12th), and contains the French text "10 leçons que j'ai apprises en construisant mon projet pendant 2 ans" (10 lessons I learned in 2 years of building this project) with an emoji. The interaction count includes five figures: 24 replies, 142 retweets, 1,000 likes, 85,000 views, and a bookmark/share area. The second post is dated "2h" (2 hours ago), and contains the French text "Le meilleur moment pour commencer était hier. Le deuxième meilleur moment, c'est maintenant." (The best time to start was yesterday. The second best time is now.) It has 12 replies, 37 retweets, 256 likes, and 8,000 views. The third post, dated "1j" (1 day ago), reads in French, "Un week-end à Chamonix, toujours ressourçant" (A weekend in Chamonix is ​​always revitalizing) and includes a mountain emoji along with a large embedded image of a snow-capped mountain peak bathed in soft sunlight. Each post uses a circular avatar on the left and is separated by thin lines. A rounded search box with the placeholder "Chercher" (search) is at the top of the right sidebar. Below this is a card titled "Vous pourriez aimer" (You might be interested in), listing three suggested profiles to follow, each with an avatar, display name, account, blue verified badge, and a white rounded "Suivre" (follow) button: "Théo Catarino" @theocatarino , "Aurélie Martinez" @aurel_martinez , and "Ulrich Rozier" @ulrichrozier . A "Voir plus" (see more) link is added at the bottom of the card. Below, create a trending card titled "Tendances: France," listing four trends by ranking, including category and number of posts: 1. "#RolandGarros" with "32,100 posts," 2. "#FêteDesMères" with "18,400 posts," 3. "Mbappé" with "45,200 posts," and 4. "#LundiMotivation" with "12,300 posts." Add a "Voir plus" link below the trend list. At the very bottom, place a compact footer containing several small gray legal links and "© 2024 X Corp." The overall image should look almost identical to a real desktop screenshot: clean typography, authentic spacing, realistic UI proportions, delicately rounded card corners, black and white text on a dark background, blue accent color, refined anti-aliased icons, and a clean, modern product design aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个高度逼真的深色模式社交媒体界面模型，外观需高度还原桌面端 X/Twitter 的法语布局，以全浏览器截图形式呈现，背景为黑色，配有细微的深灰色分隔线。左侧边栏包含 11 个垂直排列的导航项，配有白色图标和标签：“Accueil”（首页）、“Explorer”（探索）、“Notifications”（通知，带有一个显示数字 3 的蓝色小徽章）、“Messages”（消息）、“Grok”、“Signets”（书签）、“Communautés”（社区）、“Premium”、“Organisations certifiées”（认证组织）、“Profil”（个人资料）以及“Plus”（更多）。在此侧边栏顶部放置白色 X Logo，在偏下方位置添加一个大的圆形白色按钮，标签为“Poster”（发布），底部显示 Martin Dubois 的紧凑型登录账户栏，包含账号 @martindubois 和一个小圆形头像。中间栏为 {argument name="profile name" default="Martin Dubois"} 的主个人资料页面，顶部栏显示返回箭头、“Martin Dubois”名称及蓝色认证徽章，下方显示“1 248 posts”（1248 条帖子）。下方包含一张宽幅全景封面照片，展示阿尔卑斯山脉云雾缭绕的壮丽景色及森林湖泊。在横幅左下方重叠放置一张年轻男性的圆形头像，身着深色服装，面部略微模糊或遮挡，背景浅淡，带有细边框。在个人资料标题栏右侧放置三个小型圆形操作按钮和一个显眼的浅色圆角按钮，标签为“Éditer le profil”（编辑个人资料）。在头像下方显示显示名称 Martin Dubois 及蓝色认证徽章、账号 @martindubois，以及一行法语简介：“Créateur de contenu • Passionné de tech, de design et de productivité.”（内容创作者 • 热衷于科技、设计与生产力）。随后添加一行包含 4 个项目的元数据：地点“Lyon, France”（法国里昂）、网站“martindubois.com”以及“A rejoint X en janvier 2021”（于 2021 年 1 月加入 X），紧接着是关注者行，显示“320 abonnements”（320 个关注）和“12,4 k abonnés”（1.24 万粉丝）。添加一个包含 5 个标签的水平选项卡栏：“Posts”（帖子）、“Réponses”（回复）、“Tweets marquants”（精选推文）、“Médias”（媒体）和“J’aime”（喜欢），其中“Posts”处于激活状态并带有蓝色下划线。在选项卡下方，展示一个包含 3 条 Martin Dubois 可见帖子的信息流。第 1 条帖子为置顶，标注“Épinglé”（置顶），日期为“12 mai”（5 月 12 日），法语文本为“10 leçons que j’ai apprises en construisant mon projet pendant 2 ans”（我在构建项目 2 年中学到的 10 课）并附带表情符号，互动行包含 5 个数值：24 条回复、142 次转发、1 k 次喜欢、85 k 次浏览，以及书签/分享区域。第 2 条帖子日期为“2h”（2 小时前），法语文本为“Le meilleur moment pour commencer était hier. Le deuxième meilleur moment, c’est maintenant.”（开始的最佳时间是昨天。第二个最佳时间是现在。），互动数值为 12 条回复、37 次转发、256 次喜欢和 8 k 次浏览。第 3 条帖子日期为“1j”（1 天前），法语文本为“Un week-end à Chamonix, toujours ressourçant”（在霞慕尼度过的周末，总是令人恢复活力）并附带山脉表情符号，包含一张柔和日光下雪山峰顶的大型嵌入式图片。每条帖子左侧使用圆形头像，帖子之间使用细分隔线。右侧边栏顶部为一个圆角搜索框，占位符为“Chercher”（搜索）。下方包含一张标题为“Vous pourriez aimer”（你可能感兴趣）的卡片，列出 3 个建议关注的个人资料，每个包含头像、显示名称、账号、蓝色认证徽章和一个白色圆角“Suivre”（关注）按钮：“Théo Catarino” @theocatarino、“Aurélie Martinez” @aurel_martinez 和“Ulrich Rozier” @ulrichrozier。在该卡片底部添加“Voir plus”（查看更多）链接。下方创建一个标题为“Tendances : France”（趋势：法国）的趋势卡片，按排名列出 4 个趋势，包含类别和帖子数量：1. “#RolandGarros” 附带 “32,1 k posts”，2. “#FêteDesMères” 附带 “18,4 k posts”，3. “Mbappé” 附带 “45,2 k posts”，4. “#LundiMotivation” 附带 “12,3 k posts”。在趋势列表下方添加“Voir plus”（查看更多）链接。最底部放置一个紧凑的页脚，包含多个小型灰色法律链接和“© 2024 X Corp.”。整张图像应看起来与真实的桌面端截图几乎无异：清晰的排版、地道的间距、逼真的 UI 比例、细腻的圆角卡片、深色背景上的黑白文字、蓝色强调色、精致的抗锯齿图标，以及简洁现代的产品设计美学。

templates.title: Realistic X-style French profile interface

titleLocalized.zh: 逼真的 X 风格法文个人资料界面

templates.prompt: A highly realistic screenshot mockup of a smartphone app showcases a social media interface almost identical to X/Twitter, displayed on a full-screen iPhone-style display with rounded corners and a dark blue-black background. The top status bar displays the time 9:41 on the left and cellular, Wi-Fi, and battery icons on the right. (Screen display){argument name="profile name" default="Marie Dubois"} The French profile page features a large cover image at the top: the Eiffel Tower and the Seine River against a dramatic orange-blue sky at sunset. A circular portrait partially obscures the face, positioned in the lower left corner of the header. A dark, semi-transparent circular back arrow button is located in the upper left corner, and a matching circular three-dot menu button is in the upper right corner. Below the header is the profile name, displayed with a blue verification badge.{argument name="profile name" default="Marie Dubois"} ,account{argument name="handle" default="@MarieDubois"} The feed includes a French description: the first line displays "Journaliste | Paris," the second line displays "✨ Curieuse & voyageuse," and below it displays "Rejoint en mai 2012." Follower statistics are displayed in French: "1,245 Abonnements" and "32,8k Abonnés." A tab bar with four labels—"Publications," "Reponses," "Médias," and "J'aime"—is added, with "Publications" selected and underlined in blue. The feed contains three visible posts. The first post is by {argument name="profile name" default="Marie Dubois"} Released with a blue certification badge and a French title.{argument name="post caption" default="Balade matinale le long des quais de la Seine ☀️ #Paris #Promenade"} The first post is followed by a collage of four images: 1) The Eiffel Tower at Golden Hour along the river, 2) A riverside promenade in Paris with bridges and autumn leaves, 3) A cozy terrace café overlooking the Eiffel Tower, and 4) A cup of coffee next to an open laptop by the water. Below are interaction icons and counts: 258 replies, 642 retweets, and 3,1k likes. The second post comes from the verified news account "Le Monde" ( @LeMonde ), with a profile picture of a black circle with white letters. The French text reads: "Dernières infos : Le nouveau gouvernement français a été annoncé 📰 Tous les details ici ↓", followed by a blue link "lemonde.fr/article123"; below are counts of 187, 512, and 2,7k. The third post, from "Thomas Lefevre" ( @Thomas_Lf ), reads "Juste incroyable! 😍 Le Mont-Saint-Michel vu du ciel 📷," followed by a wide-angle aerial photo of Mont Saint-Michel. The bottom features an iOS-style navigation bar with five elements: a home icon, a search icon, a notification bell marked with a red number 4, a message envelope marked with a red number 4, and a large blue floating post button with a white quill icon. A slim, black iPhone home screen indicator is added at the very bottom center. The design utilizes clean, modern UI typography, subtle gray dividing lines, realistic spacing, authentic X-style icons, beautiful mobile app rendering, and near-photographic screenshot realism.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度逼真的智能手机 App 截图模型，展示了几乎与 X/Twitter 一致的社交媒体界面，呈现于带有圆角的 iPhone 风格全屏显示器上，背景为深蓝黑色。顶部状态栏左侧显示时间 9:41，右侧显示蜂窝网络、Wi‑Fi 和电池图标。屏幕显示 {argument name="profile name" default="Marie Dubois"} 的法文个人资料页面，顶部为一张埃菲尔铁塔与塞纳河在日落时分、橙蓝色戏剧性天空下的巨幅封面图。圆形头像覆盖在页眉左下方，部分遮挡了面部。左上角有一个深色半透明圆形返回箭头按钮，右上角有一个匹配的圆形三点菜单按钮。页眉下方显示带有蓝色认证徽章的个人资料名称 {argument name="profile name" default="Marie Dubois"}，账号 {argument name="handle" default="@MarieDubois"}，以及法文简介：第一行显示“Journaliste | Paris”，第二行显示“✨ Curieuse & voyageuse”，下方显示“Rejoint en mai 2012”。以法文显示关注者统计数据：“1 245 Abonnements”和“32,8 k Abonnés”。添加一个包含 4 个标签的选项卡栏，标签分别为“Publications”、“Réponses”、“Médias”和“J'aime”，其中“Publications”处于选中状态并带有蓝色下划线。在信息流中，包含 3 条可见帖子。第 1 条帖子由 {argument name="profile name" default="Marie Dubois"} 发布，带有蓝色认证徽章和法文标题 {argument name="post caption" default="Balade matinale le long des quais de la Seine ☀️ #Paris #Promenade"}，后接一行 4 张图片的拼贴：1) 黄金时刻河畔的埃菲尔铁塔，2) 带有桥梁和秋叶的巴黎河畔步道，3) 可俯瞰埃菲尔铁塔的舒适露台咖啡馆，4) 水边打开的笔记本旁的一杯咖啡。下方显示互动图标及计数：回复 258，转发 642，点赞 3,1 k。第 2 条帖子来自认证新闻账号“Le Monde”，账号为“@LeMonde”，头像为白色字母的黑色圆形图标，法文内容为：“Dernières infos : Le nouveau gouvernement français a été annoncé 📰 Tous les details ici ↓”，后接蓝色链接“lemonde.fr/article123”；下方显示计数 187、512 和 2,7 k。第 3 条帖子来自“Thomas Lefevre”，账号为“@Thomas_Lf”，内容为“Juste incroyable ! 😍 Le Mont-Saint-Michel vu du ciel 📷”，后接一张圣米歇尔山的宽幅航拍照片。底部包含一个 iOS 风格的导航栏，共有 5 个元素：主页图标、搜索图标、带有红色数字 4 标记的通知铃铛、带有红色数字 4 标记的消息信封，以及一个带有白色羽毛笔图标的大型蓝色悬浮发布按钮。在最底部居中添加细长的黑色 iPhone 主屏幕指示条。使用清晰的现代 UI 排版、微妙的灰色分割线、逼真的间距、地道的 X 风格图标、精美的移动端 App 渲染效果，以及近乎摄影级的截图真实感。

templates.title: Dark Forest Horror Novel Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 暗夜森林惊悚小说封面

templates.prompt: An emotionally charged graphic novel-style book cover illustration, set against a backdrop of a snow-covered coniferous forest at night, using deep blue tones with cinematic contrast. In the foreground, four figures stand behind a low striped roadblock: three adults and one child. The middle adult is a tall, broad-shouldered man in a dark winter coat, cradling a sleeping or limp child in his arms; the child is dressed in a {argument name="child coat color" default="Purple"} The image shows a man in a snowsuit. To his left stands a teenage or young man with a backpack, next to a dark SUV faintly visible at the edge of the frame. To his right stands an adult woman in a dark hooded winter coat, holding a flashlight and projecting a warm beam of light onto the snow and roadblocks. All faces should be mostly in shadow, unrecognizable, to emphasize mystery and danger. Place two prominent artificial warning elements in the foreground: a red and white striped gate blocking the road, and a deer silhouette warning sign with a red prohibition circle and diagonal stripe atop a wooden post. In the midground and background, fill with tall black pine trees, a narrow snow-covered road or clearing, and the shape of a partially buried animal carcass in the snow on the right. In the distance, show a rugged, snow-covered mountain range under a starry sky. From behind the mountain, a narrow, vertical blue beam of light shoots into the sky as the visual focus. The composition should be vertical, dramatic, and poster-like, suitable as a {argument name="book title" default="La Réserve"} Covers of thriller or survival graphic novels. Style: Delicate Faber-style/realistic comic book drawing with ink outlines, rich brushstroke texture, a cold nighttime atmosphere, subtle rim lighting, high contrast, full of ominousness and suspense.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满情绪感的图像小说风格书籍封面插画，背景设定在夜晚的针叶雪林中，采用深蓝色调，具有电影般的对比度。在前景中，展示 4 个人物站在低矮的条纹路障后：3 名成年人和 1 名幼童。中间的成年人是一名身材高大、肩膀宽阔的男子，身穿深色冬装外套，怀里抱着一个正在睡觉或瘫软的孩子；孩子穿着一件 {argument name="child coat color" default="紫色"} 的雪服。在他左侧站着一名背着背包的少年或青年男性，旁边是一辆在画面边缘隐约可见的深色 SUV。在他右侧站着一名身穿深色连帽冬装外套的成年女性，手中拿着手电筒，将一束温暖的光锥投射在雪地和路障上。所有人的面部应大部分处于阴影中，无法辨认，以强调神秘感和危险感。在前景中放置 2 个明显的人造警示元素：1 个阻挡道路的红白条纹门，以及 1 个立在木柱上、带有红色禁止圆圈和斜杠的鹿形剪影警示牌。在中景和背景中，填充高大的黑松树、一条狭窄的积雪道路或空地，右侧雪地里半掩埋着一个动物尸体形状。在远方，展示一座在星空下布满积雪的崎岖山脉。从山后，一道狭窄的垂直蓝色光束直冲云霄，作为视觉焦点。构图应为垂直、具有戏剧性和海报感，适合作为 {argument name="book title" default="La Réserve"} 的惊悚或生存类图像小说封面。风格：细腻的法比漫画 / 写实漫画绘画风格，带有墨线轮廓，笔触质感丰富，寒冷的夜间氛围，微妙的轮廓光，高对比度，充满不祥与悬疑感。

templates.title: The cover of the book "The Mysterious Forest Forbidden Zone"

titleLocalized.zh: “神秘森林禁区”书籍封面

templates.prompt: A dark, cinematic graphic novel-style book cover illustration, set in a snowy mountain forest at night, employs cool blue tones and a dramatic vertical composition. In the foreground, four figures stand behind a red and white fence blocking a forest path. The first is an adult man in heavy dark winter clothing, cradling a sleeping little girl in his arms; the girl wears a pink cotton snowsuit and light-colored winter boots, her head resting on his shoulder. Beside him stands an adult woman in a winter coat with a fur collar, holding a flashlight whose beam tilts downwards, its warm light slicing through the snow. Next to her stands a boy or young man in a dark hooded winter coat, gazing at the forest. In the right foreground, a weathering warning sign mounted on a wooden post displays a silhouette of a black pedestrian within a red prohibition circle and diagonal lines. In the left midground, partially obscured by trees, is a dark-colored SUV parked on the snowy roadside. In the right midground, on the ground among the bushes, lies a dead deer with visible antlers. In the distance, nestled between tree trunks, are two blurry, eerie human silhouettes standing motionless in the forest. Towering pine trees frame the scene on either side, against a backdrop of snow-capped, steep peaks and a starry sky. From the upper right, a bright, pale blue-white beam of light descends vertically, piercing the forest and illuminating the mist, hinting at some mysterious anomaly. The atmosphere is tense, taboo, supernatural, and filled with a sense of existential crisis, as if foreshadowing the title {argument name="title text" default="La Réserve"} The cover designs are for thriller or science fiction graphic novels. The highly detailed realistic painting style is combined with comic book lines, with subtle rim lighting, deep shadows, a realistic winter texture, and a cinematic sense of suspense. There are no visible facial details, and the composition is vertical.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张黑暗、电影质感的图像小说风格书籍封面插图，背景设定在夜晚的雪山森林中，采用冷蓝色调和戏剧性的垂直构图。前景中，4 个人物站在阻挡林道的红白相间栏杆后。第一位是一名穿着厚重深色冬装的成年男子，怀里抱着 1 个正在熟睡的小女孩；女孩穿着粉色棉质雪服和浅色冬靴，头靠在他的肩膀上。他身边站着 1 位穿着带毛领冬装大衣的成年女性，手里拿着手电筒，光束向下倾斜，温暖的光线划过积雪。她旁边站着 1 位穿着深色连帽冬装的少年或年轻男子，正注视着森林。在右侧前景处，放置 1 个安装在木柱上的风化警告标志，标志上显示一个红色禁止圆圈和斜杠内的黑色行人剪影。在左侧中景处，被树木部分遮挡，包含 1 辆停在雪地路边的深色越野 SUV。在右侧中景处的树丛地面上，放置 1 只可见鹿角的死鹿。在树干之间的远景中，包含 2 个静止站在森林里的模糊、诡异的人形剪影。高耸的松树在两侧构成了场景框架，背景是积雪覆盖的陡峭山峰，天空繁星点点。从右上方的高空，一道明亮的淡蓝白色垂直光束从天而降，射入森林，照亮了薄雾，暗示着某种神秘异常现象。氛围紧张、禁忌、超自然且充满生存危机感，仿佛是为标题为 {argument name="title text" default="La Réserve"} 的惊悚或科幻图像小说设计的封面。高度细腻的绘画写实风格与漫画线条相结合，带有微妙的轮廓光、深邃的阴影、逼真的冬季质感、电影般的悬疑感，无可见面部细节，纵向构图。

templates.title: Steampunk style ElectroVid homepage design draft

titleLocalized.zh: 蒸汽朋克风格 ElectroVid 首页设计稿

templates.prompt: Create a full-screen fictional video streaming website homepage with a richly detailed steampunk Victorian retro-futuristic style, designed with an interface reminiscent of antique brass and wooden machinery. The page includes a main title bar, a top navigation bar, a left sidebar, a featured video panel, a latest videos section with three thumbnails, a central call-to-action button, and a footer. The overall color scheme is dark bronze, aged brass, tan, blackened steel, and parchment beige, complemented by warm amber lighting, sculpted borders, pipes, gears, rivets, decorative filigree, and analog instrument details. In the upper left corner, a modern brand logo displays "Pika".{argument name="brand tag" default="AI"} Above or beside it is labeled "GPT Image 2," contrasting with the antique interface. A large, embossed, gold-metal-style website title is centered on a dark plaque.{argument name="site name" default="ElectroVid"} Below this is the subtitle "THE FUTURE IN MOTION". A glowing Edison light bulb is added to the upper left, and a circular pressure gauge or clock face to the upper right. Below the title is a horizontal navigation bar containing six elements: a homepage icon, "TRENDING", "INNOVATIONS", "DOCUMENTARIES", "ENTERTAINMENT", a search box with placeholder text "Search ElectroVid...", and a search button. In the left sidebar, a framed area titled "POPULAR CHANNELS" is added, vertically stacking three channel cards. Each card contains a circular logo, channel name, number of subscribers, and a subscribe button: "THE PATENT OFFICE" and "27.4K SUBSCRIBERS", "THE ROYAL SOCIETY" and "18.7K SUBSCRIBERS", "GENERAL ELECTRIC" and "35.1K". "SUBSCRIBERS". The main content area features a large, curated video player playing sepia-toned clips of two early electrical pioneers debating in front of a blackboard marked "AC vs. DC" and a lightning bolt symbol; their faces are obscured by soft rectangular blurs. A realistic video player control bar includes a play icon, progress bar, volume, settings, full-screen mode, and a timestamp "08:47 / 22:31". Below the player, the title is displayed in large serif font.{argument name="featured title" default="The Truth About AC vs. DC: The Final Debate"} Below this is the channel line for "The Electrical Age," featuring a small circular avatar, "142K views," and "3 days ago," with a brass button on the right that says "LIKE 5.8K." Below that is a section titled "LATEST VIDEOS," containing three video cards: 1) "My New Incandescent Bulb" by "Thomas Edison," "89K views," "5 days ago," duration "10:12," thumbnail showing a man holding a glowing light bulb with a blurred face; 2) "The Wonders of the Wardenclyffe Tower" by "Nikola Tesla," "120K views," "1 week ago," duration "15:36," thumbnail showing the Tesla Tower under storm clouds; 3) "The Automobile Revolution" by "Henry Ford," "110K views," "1 week ago," duration "12:08," thumbnail showing early vintage cars on city streets. Below the cards, centered, is a sign that says "VIEW ALL." A metal "VIDEOS" button. At the bottom, add a dark, engraved footer with the text "© 1893 ElectroVid, Ltd. All rights reserved." Frame the entire composition with decorative brass edges, pipes, gears, screws, and small gauges to make it resemble a functional Victorian industrial dashboard. The image should have a sophisticated, cinematic website design quality, symmetrical and highly sharp, with realistic textures, depth of layering, subtle dirt effects, and a high-quality, poster-like rendering.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个全屏的虚构视频流媒体网站首页，采用细节丰富的蒸汽朋克维多利亚复古未来主义风格，设计成类似古董黄铜与木质机械的界面。页面包含 1 个主标题栏、1 个顶部导航栏、1 个左侧边栏、1 个精选视频面板、1 个包含 3 个缩略图的最新视频区、1 个中央行动号召按钮以及 1 个页脚铭牌。整体色调为深青铜色、陈旧黄铜色、棕褐色、发黑的钢色和羊皮纸米色，配以温暖的琥珀色灯光、雕刻边框、管道、齿轮、铆钉、装饰性花丝和模拟仪表细节。在左上角，放置一个现代品牌徽章，显示“Pika {argument name="brand tag" default="AI"}”，在其上方或旁边标注“GPT Image 2”，与古董界面形成对比。在深色铭牌上居中放置浮雕衬线金金属风格的大型网站标题“{argument name="site name" default="ElectroVid"}”，下方配以副标题“THE FUTURE IN MOTION”。在左上方添加一个发光的爱迪生灯泡，右上方添加一个圆形压力表或时钟表盘。在标题下方，包含一个水平导航栏，包含 6 个元素：一个主页图标、“TRENDING”、“INNOVATIONS”、“DOCUMENTARIES”、“ENTERTAINMENT”，以及一个带有占位符文本“Search ElectroVid...”的搜索框和一个搜索按钮。在左侧边栏中，添加一个标题为“POPULAR CHANNELS”的框架区域，垂直堆叠 3 张频道卡片，每张卡片包含一个圆形徽标、频道名称、订阅者数量和一个订阅按钮：“THE PATENT OFFICE”及“27.4K SUBSCRIBERS”、“THE ROYAL SOCIETY”及“18.7K SUBSCRIBERS”、“GENERAL ELECTRIC”及“35.1K SUBSCRIBERS”。在主要内容区域，展示一个大型精选视频播放器，播放棕褐色调的视频片段，内容为两位早期电气先驱在写有“AC vs. DC”及闪电图案的黑板前辩论；用柔和的矩形模糊块遮挡两人的面部。包含一个逼真的视频播放器控制栏，带有播放图标、进度条、音量、设置、全屏以及时间戳“08:47 / 22:31”。在播放器下方，以大号衬线字体显示标题“{argument name="featured title" default="The Truth About AC vs. DC: The Final Debate"}”。在其下方，显示“The Electrical Age”的频道行，包含一个小圆形头像、“142K views”和“3 days ago”，并在右侧放置一个写有“LIKE 5.8K”的黄铜按钮。下方创建一个标题为“LATEST VIDEOS”的区域，包含 3 张视频卡片：1) “Thomas Edison”发布的“My New Incandescent Bulb”，“89K views”，“5 days ago”，时长“10:12”，缩略图显示一名男子手持发光灯泡，面部模糊；2) “Nikola Tesla”发布的“The Wonders of the Wardenclyffe Tower”，“120K views”，“1 week ago”，时长“15:36”，缩略图显示风暴云下的特斯拉塔；3) “Henry Ford”发布的“The Automobile Revolution”，“110K views”，“1 week ago”，时长“12:08”，缩略图显示城市街道上的早期复古汽车。在卡片下方居中放置一个写有“VIEW ALL VIDEOS”的金属按钮。在底部，添加一个深色雕刻页脚板，文字为“© 1893 ElectroVid, Ltd. All rights reserved.”。用装饰性的黄铜边角、管道、齿轮、螺丝和小型仪表框住整个构图，使其看起来像一个功能性的维多利亚工业仪表盘。图像应呈现出精致的电影级网站设计稿质感，对称且高度清晰，具有逼真的纹理、分层深度、细微的污垢感以及高级海报般的渲染质量。

templates.title: Handwritten French poems on paper

titleLocalized.zh: 纸上的手写法语诗歌

templates.prompt: A lifelike 16:9 close-up photograph shows a slightly textured sheet of white paper lying diagonally on a medium-brown wooden table, shot from a shallow downward angle. On the paper is a short French poem neatly handwritten in elegant cursive script, using vibrant ink.{argument name="ink color" default="blue"} Ink. The title at the top is centered.{argument name="poem title" default="Pigeon"} Below are four lines of handwritten text, centered and evenly spaced:{argument name="poem line 1" default="Oiseau à la grise robe,"} ,{argument name="poem line 2" default="Dans l'enfer des villes"} "À mon regard tu te dérobes" and "Tu es vraiment le plus agile." The handwritten font should be elegant, clear, and natural, presenting a texture like pen writing, rather than printed font. Soft indoor warm light, subtle shadows on the edges of the paper, clearly visible paper texture, simple and bright composition, completely focused on the handwritten poem.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张 16:9 的逼真特写照片，展示了一张略带纹理的白纸斜放在中棕色的木桌上，以浅俯角拍摄。纸上用优雅的草书整齐地手写着一首简短的法语诗，使用的是鲜艳的 {argument name="ink color" default="蓝色"} 墨水。顶部的标题居中写着 {argument name="poem title" default="鸽子"}。下方是 4 行手写文字，居中且间距均匀：{argument name="poem line 1" default="Oiseau à la grise robe,"}，{argument name="poem line 2" default="Dans l'enfer des villes"}，“À mon regard tu te dérobes” 以及 “Tu es vraiment le plus agile。” 手写字体需保持优雅、清晰且自然，呈现出如同钢笔手写般的质感，而非印刷字体。柔和的室内暖光，纸张边缘带有细微阴影，纸张纹理清晰可见，构图简洁明快，完全聚焦于手写的诗歌。

templates.title: Cinematic Women in a Retro Library

titleLocalized.zh: 复古图书馆中的电影感女性

templates.prompt: A cinematic half-length portrait depicts an elegant woman in an old-fashioned library, her body slightly turned to the left, sitting or standing close to the camera, her face centered and partially shrouded in soft shadow. She has {argument name="hair color" default="Golden yellow"} Her hair was styled in an elegant Edwardian or early 20th-century updo, voluminous on top with loose curls cascading down the sides. She wore a high-necked dress.{argument name="dress color" default="Creamy Gold"} A lace dress with delicate floral patterns and fine trim is worn, paired with a clearly visible pendant earring. The background is a warm and private study with two tall wooden bookshelves filled with old books in shades of brown, green, and soft blue. On the far left is a window letting in soft light, with sheer curtains hanging beside it, and a framed painting on the wall. The composition utilizes golden hour indoor lighting, amber highlights, shallow depth of field, rich wood tones, soft cinematic contrast, and realistic skin and fabric details to create a tranquil, historical drama atmosphere. The 16:9 aspect ratio and mid-range close-up are realistic, luxurious, and detailed, possessing an oil painting quality rather than an illustration style.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影感的半身肖像，描绘了一位优雅的女性身处老式图书馆中，身体略微向左转，坐着或站立在靠近镜头的位置，面部居中且部分处于柔和的阴影中。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="金黄色"} 的头发，梳成优雅的爱德华时代或 20 世纪初风格的发髻，头顶蓬松，两侧有松散的卷发垂下。她身穿一件高领的 {argument name="dress color" default="奶油金色"} 蕾丝连衣裙，带有精致的花卉纹理和细腻的饰边，并佩戴着一只清晰可见的吊坠耳环。背景是一个温暖而私密的书房，有 2 个高大的木制书架，摆满了棕色、绿色和柔和蓝色调的旧书；最左侧是一扇透着柔和光线的窗户，窗边挂着薄纱窗帘，旁边还有 1 幅装裱好的墙面挂画。采用黄金时段的室内光线、琥珀色高光、浅景深、浓郁的木质色调、柔和的电影质感对比度、逼真的皮肤和织物细节，营造出安静的历史剧氛围。构图采用 16:9 画幅，中景特写，写实、奢华、细腻，且具有油画质感，而非插画风格。

templates.title: Women at elegant bar coffee tables

titleLocalized.zh: 优雅酒吧咖啡桌旁的女性

templates.prompt: A candid, realistic vertical photograph captures a woman seated at a rustic wooden table in an elegant upscale bar/café. Centered in the foreground, she leans forward, one elbow resting on the table, her hand supporting her chin, creating a relaxed, intimate, and editorially-inspired atmosphere. She has long, dark brown, wavy hair parted in the middle and cascading over her shoulders, and wears a fitted white ribbed long-sleeved round-neck top. Three items are clearly visible on the table in front of her: a pink cocktail in a wide-mouthed champagne glass on the left, a blue and white floral ceramic mug on the right, and a small clear glass vase containing a few dried flowers on the far right. Behind her is a warmly lit, elegant bar with marble or stone finishes, ornate classical ceiling details, shelves overflowing with bottles and glassware, soft backlighting, and a bartender in a white shirt and dark apron, slightly out of focus. The image includes dark bar stools beside the bar, and the overall color scheme is rich amber, cream, and brown. Employing shallow depth of field, the interplay of soft indoor natural light and warm bar lighting creates realistic skin and fabric textures with a delicate cinematic quality. The high-detail luxury hotel photography style, shot at eye level with a smartphone or portrait lens and in a vertical composition, creates a comfortable atmosphere that blends Parisian cafes and hotel bars.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张抓拍风格、写实的竖构图照片，展现了一位女性坐在优雅高档酒吧咖啡厅的质朴木桌旁。她位于前景中心，身体前倾，一只手肘撑在桌上，手托着下巴，营造出一种轻松、亲密且具有编辑感的生活方式氛围。她留着深棕色的长波浪卷发，中分发型垂在双肩两侧，身穿一件修身的白色罗纹长袖圆领上衣。她面前的桌上清晰可见 3 件物品：左侧是一杯装在宽口香槟杯中的桃色鸡尾酒，中右侧是一个蓝白相间的花卉陶瓷马克杯，最右侧是一个装有少量干花枝的小型透明玻璃瓶花瓶。她身后是一个灯光温暖、格调高雅的酒吧，配有大理石或石材饰面、华丽的古典天花板细节、摆满酒瓶和玻璃器皿的货架、柔和的背光照明，以及一名身穿白衬衫、系着深色围裙、处于虚焦状态的调酒师。画面包含吧台旁的深色高脚凳，整体色调为浓郁的琥珀色、奶油色和棕色。采用浅景深，柔和的室内自然光与温暖的酒吧灯光交织，呈现真实的皮肤和织物纹理，带有细腻的电影质感，高细节的豪华酒店摄影风格，以智能手机或人像镜头平视拍摄，竖构图，营造出巴黎咖啡馆与酒店酒吧相融合的舒适氛围。

templates.title: Found-Footage: Horror Snapshots of the Office

titleLocalized.zh: Found-Footage 办公室恐怖快照

templates.prompt: A raw, found-footage style horror photograph, taken at night in a dimly lit, cramped security office, using a direct flash from an on-camera setup, resulting in a slight film grain effect. In the foreground are two young women, both partially cropped, their faces blurred into rectangular blocks of color for privacy. The woman on the left has long, dark hair, wears a black top, and is slightly turned away from the camera. The woman on the right has long, platinum blonde hair, wears a low-cut black top, and holds a black flashlight in her right hand. Below them, in the foreground, is a small black metal table fan with a visible circular grille. In the background, a narrow door in the center of the image is half-open, leading to an almost completely dark space. Deep within that doorway stands the silhouette of a terrifying electronic rabbit doll, with glowing eyes, long, upright ears, a huge, toothy grin, and faintly visible metallic body details, appearing and disappearing in the shadows. The office walls are grayish-white and worn, with black and white checkered stripes and a thin red line running across them. On the left wall hangs a brightly colored "CELEBRATE!" poster featuring an electronic anime character, next to which is a smaller drawing sheet of the character. A black walkie-talkie sits on the table. A silver desk lamp shines near the door. On the right wall, two sheets of paper are clipped together, and a gray filing cabinet is in shadow. The door is ajar, revealing the handle. The composition should evoke the feeling of a party snapshot instantly transforming into a horror scene, with the foreground subject illuminated by a strong flash, contrasting with a deep black background. The overall effect should be characterized by simulated noise, low-saturation colors, and an unsettling realism, with the monster hidden in the center of the background serving as the central element of the horror.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张粗粝的 Found-Footage 风格恐怖照片，拍摄于夜晚昏暗狭窄的安保办公室内，采用机顶闪光灯直闪，带有轻微的胶片颗粒感。前景中共有 2 名年轻女性，两人均被画面部分裁切，且面部因隐私保护被模糊处理成矩形色块。左侧女性留着深色长发，身穿黑色上衣，身体略微背向镜头。右侧女性留着白金长发，身穿低胸黑色上衣，右手向上握着一支黑色手电筒。两人之间的下方前景中央有一个小型黑色金属台式风扇，可见圆形格栅。背景中，画面中央的一扇窄门半掩，通向几乎完全黑暗的空间。在那扇门的深处，站着一个恐怖的兔子电子玩偶剪影，它有着发光的眼睛、长长的竖耳、巨大的露齿笑容以及隐约可见的金属身体细节，在阴影中若隐现。办公室墙壁呈灰白色且陈旧，墙面横贯着黑白格纹条纹和一条细红线。左侧墙上贴着一张色彩鲜艳的“CELEBRATE!”海报，上面印有电子玩偶角色，旁边还钉着一张较小的角色绘画纸，桌面上立着一个黑色对讲机。门附近有一盏银色台灯。右侧墙上夹着 2 张纸，阴影中有一个灰色文件柜。门半开着，可以看到门把手。构图应呈现出一种派对抓拍瞬间转变为恐怖场景的感觉，前景主体由强烈的闪光灯照亮，背景则是深邃的黑色阴影，整体带有模拟噪点、低饱和色彩、令人不安的写实感，并将背景中央隐藏的怪物作为核心惊悚点。

templates.title: Aerial view of Çanakkale's "little planet"

titleLocalized.zh: 恰纳卡莱的“小星球”航拍视角

templates.prompt: A visually striking ultra-wide-angle aerial photograph of a "small planet," taken in Turkey.{argument name="city name" default="Çanakkale"} The image uses a 360-degree panoramic stereoscopic projection, merging the city and seaside into a compact spherical world surrounded by blue skies and white clouds. The shooting perspective is high above the coastline, presenting a bright daytime effect with clear light, true colors, and rich photographic detail. [The last part, "Will be written...", appears to be an unrelated fragment and is left untranslated.]{argument name="landmark sign text" default="Çanakkale"} A large, prominent slogan on a hillside is positioned at the center of the miniature planet. In the upper left quadrant, a towering, light-colored stone clock tower, topped with a red Turkish flag, is surrounded by densely packed red-tiled city blocks and mid-rise buildings. To the right, a vast blue harbor unfolds, with two white passenger ships moored along the shore, and a long coastline stretching into the distance. In the lower right quadrant, a magnificent dark wooden Trojan horse statue stands in a circular plaza. In the lower left quadrant, a large rectangular concrete monument sits within a green park. The planet's surface is covered with winding walkways, lawns, trees, and landscaped gardens, with city streets and a seaside promenade visible at the edges. The composition employs a highly realistic drone photography style, featuring deep depth of field, sharp textures, and a slight, exaggerated fisheye distortion due to the "mini-planet's" projection. The overall composition presents a grand, poster-like feel, emphasizing the stark contrast between the green park, historical landmarks, and the shimmering sea.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具视觉冲击力的超广角“小星球”航拍照片，拍摄地点为土耳其的 {argument name="city name" default="恰纳卡莱"}。画面采用 360 度全景立体投影，使城市与海滨融合成一个紧凑的球形世界，周围环绕着蓝天白云。拍摄视角位于海岸线上方的高空，呈现明亮的日间效果，光线清澈，色彩真实，摄影细节丰富。将写有 {argument name="landmark sign text" default="恰纳卡莱"} 的大型山坡标语醒目地置于微型星球的中心。在球体左上方，展示一座高耸的浅色石制钟楼，顶部悬挂着一面红色土耳其国旗，周围环绕着密集的红瓦屋顶城市街区和中层建筑。右侧呈现一片湛蓝的港口，两艘白色客轮停靠在岸边，长长的海岸线向远处延伸。在右下象限，展示圆形广场上那座宏伟的深色木制特洛伊木马雕像。在左下象限，包含坐落在绿地公园中的大型长方形混凝土纪念建筑。星球表面覆盖着蜿蜒的人行道、草坪、树木和景观花园，边缘处可见城市街道和海滨长廊。采用高度逼真的无人机摄影风格，具有深景深、锐利的纹理，以及由“小星球”投影带来的轻微夸张鱼眼畸变。整体构图呈现宏伟的旅游海报风格，强调了绿色公园、历史地标与波光粼粼的大海之间的鲜明对比。

templates.title: Dark Fantasy Cliff Outpost

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑奇幻悬崖前哨站

templates.prompt: A dark fantasy-style matte painting depicts a desolate mountaintop camp overlooking a vast, cursed wasteland at dusk. In the left foreground, a tattered banner, hand-painted in large black letters, reads "The Pale Lodge Outpost," anchored to a wooden pole, weathered by wind and rain. Beside it stands a tall, carved totem pole topped with a black raven, adorned with bones, skulls, and tattered ornaments. Inside the camp, four canvas tents are visible: two large central tents, one medium-sized tent on the left, and one small tent on the right, all made of dirty beige fabric painted with mysterious black symbols, supported by ropes, stakes, and crooked poles. Around the tents stand five humanoid figures in dark robes and hoods, standing silently like sentinels or cultists. Near the center left, a small campfire emits a faint orange glow. In the right foreground, two astronomical or ritual instruments, made of brass and iron, sit on stone pedestals, resembling armillary spheres or astrolabes. The ground is jagged black rock at the edge of a cliff, scattered with wooden stakes, lanterns, banners, and ceremonial pillars. Beyond the outpost stretches a desolate, ashen-colored plain valley, with winding pale waterways, jagged rock spires, and the silhouette of mountains in the distance. On the horizon, slightly to the right of center, a sinister black castle rises abruptly from a solitary mountain. The sky is filled with massive, turbulent storm clouds, and in the distance, the silhouettes of three flying creatures or birds cast cold, morbid light through the gaps in the clouds, illuminating the entire landscape. The painting employs a somber, painterly, and highly detailed style, using soft shades of dark brown, charcoal, ochre, and gray to create a strong sense of atmospheric perspective, cinematic composition, and an unsettling, fantastical atmosphere of a outpost on the edge of a desolate world.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅暗黑奇幻风格的哑光画作，描绘了黄昏时分俯瞰广袤被诅咒荒原的荒凉山顶营地。左侧前景中，一面破烂的悬挂横幅上用黑色大字手绘着“The Pale Lodge Outpost”，横幅固定在木杆上，经受着风吹雨打。旁边立着一根高大的雕刻图腾柱，顶部是一只黑色的乌鸦，上面挂满了骨头、头骨和破烂的装饰物。营地内可见 4 顶帆布帐篷：2 顶大型中央帐篷，左侧 1 顶中型帐篷，右侧 1 顶小型帐篷，均为脏兮兮的米色织物，上面绘有黑色神秘符号，由绳索、木桩和歪斜的杆子支撑。帐篷周围有 5 个身穿深色长袍、戴着兜帽的人形身影，像哨兵或邪教徒一样静静站立。左中位置附近有一堆小篝火，散发出微弱的橙色光芒。右侧前景放置着 2 个黄铜与铁制成的天文或仪式仪器，位于石基座上，类似于浑天仪或星盘。地面是悬崖边缘崎岖的黑色岩石，散落着木桩、灯笼、横幅和仪式柱。前哨站外延伸着一片荒凉的灰烬色平原山谷，蜿蜒着苍白的水道，矗立着锯齿状的岩石尖塔，远处是山脉的轮廓。在地平线上，中心偏右处，一座阴森的黑色城堡从孤山上拔地而起。天空中布满了巨大的湍流风暴云，远处有 3 只飞行的生物或鸟类剪影，云层裂开处投射出冰冷、病态的光芒，照亮了整个景观。采用阴沉、油画质感、高度细腻的风格，运用柔和的深褐色、炭色、赭色和灰色调，营造出强烈的空气透视感、电影般的构图，以及死寂世界边缘那令人不安的奇幻前哨站氛围。

Utilizing a vertical poster layout with rounded corners and a cream-colored border. Simultaneously, a blooming cherry blossom branch with clusters of pale pink flowers extends from the left. In the upper right corner, a stamp is included, featuring a dark red silhouette of the pagoda, partially obscured by a circular postmark that reads "KYOTO JAPAN," with the Chinese characters "京都" (Kyoto) at the center, extending to the right with several wavy postmark lines. A centered, retro-style footer in serif capital letters is added at the bottom, containing the following text:{argument name="footer text" default="DISCOVER TRADITION. EMBRACE KYOTO."} The overall appearance should convey a romantic, collectible quality, with a slightly worn look, like classic Japanese travel prints from the 1950s or 60s.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张复古旅行海报，主题为 {argument name="destination name" default="KYOTO"}（日本），采用怀旧的 20 世纪中期旅游风格设计，带有褪色的纸张质感、轻微磨损的边缘以及温暖的岁月色调。使用带有圆角的竖版海报布局，并配以奶油色边框。顶部放置醒目的大标题 {argument name="headline text" default="KYOTO"}，采用超大号优雅红色衬线字体；下方居中放置深蓝色衬线字体的“JAPAN”，并配有细长的装饰分割线。下方添加斜体标语 {argument name="tagline text" default="Timeless Beauty. Endless Memories."}。主体画面应展示一个极具张力的低角度视角，呈现一座鲜艳朱红色的传统日本五重塔，配有深色木质屋檐和黑色栏杆，矗立在石基上，前景为木质走道。塔周围环绕着绿色的树木繁茂的山丘、明亮的蓝天和柔和的奶油色云朵。左侧包含一个垂直的红色标签，上面印有白色日文字符“京都、日本”。同时，从左侧伸入一枝盛开的樱花，带有簇簇淡粉色的花朵。在右上角，加入一枚邮票，上面有暗红色的塔影，部分被一个圆形的邮戳覆盖，邮戳上写着“KYOTO JAPAN”，中心为汉字“京都”，并向右延伸出几条波浪形的邮戳线。底部添加居中的复古页脚标语，采用衬线大写字母，内容为 {argument name="footer text" default="DISCOVER TRADITION. EMBRACE KYOTO."}。整体外观应呈现出浪漫、具有收藏价值、略带磨损感，如同 20 世纪 50 年代或 60 年代的经典日本旅游印刷品。

templates.title: Revenge Action Movie Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 复仇动作电影海报

templates.prompt: A high-contrast, cinematic vertical poster for a revenge thriller, titled "{argument name="movie title" default="DEADLINE VENGEANCE"} The main subject of the composition is a tough-guy figure in the foreground, a middle-aged man with short black hair and a rugged stubble, wearing a black leather jacket or tactical jacket. He is aiming a semi-automatic pistol directly at the viewer from the left side of the image, the strong perspective making the gun appear large and close to the lens. His face is partially hidden in shadow, creating a mysterious and dangerous atmosphere. The background is a dark nighttime modern city skyline, with storm clouds overhead. A helicopter is visible in the upper right corner of the sky, and a huge fireball explodes near a building on the right, scattering smoke, sparks, and debris. At the very top of the poster is a line of small red capital letters:{argument name="top tagline" default="REVENGE IS HIS MISSION"} In the center left area, add four stacked lines of white capital letters:{argument name="left tagline" default="THE PAST TOOK EVERYTHING. HE'LL TAKE EVERYTHING BACK."} The poster features two short blocks separated by a thin red line. The main title spans the lower middle section, divided into two words: the first word in a large, distressed, metallic white block font, and the second word in a slightly smaller, bold red capital letter. In the lower third of the poster, a lone male figure stands in the middle of a wet, reflective street, holding a pistol and facing the burning city. Four police cars surround him, two on each side, flashing their lights; two helicopters are also visible on the distant horizon, bringing the total number of helicopters in the poster to three. The lower two corners are decorated with flames, wreckage, smoke, embers, and the silhouettes of several armed men in the distance. Red text indicating the release is added at the bottom center.{argument name="release text" default="COMING SOON"} Below is smaller white text.{argument name="format line" default="EXPERIENCE IT IN IMAX"} At the very bottom, add a dense, fictional credits list and a film rating box. Color scheme: black, charcoal gray, steel gray, orange flame, and deep red. Style: Exquisite Hollywood blockbuster key visual, dramatic contour lighting, photorealistic feel, ultra-high detail, strong contrast, anamorphic widescreen action lighting, smoky atmosphere, explosive urban chaos, high-end theatrical poster design.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高对比度、电影质感的复仇惊悚片竖版海报，标题为 {argument name="movie title" default="DEADLINE VENGEANCE"}。构图主体是一位身处前景的硬汉，中年男性，短黑发，留着粗犷的胡茬，身穿黑色皮夹克或战术夹克。他从画面左侧直接向观众瞄准一把半自动手枪，通过强烈的透视效果使枪支看起来巨大且靠近镜头。他的面部部分隐藏在阴影中，营造出神秘而危险的氛围。背景是夜间黑暗的现代城市天际线，上方笼罩着风暴云，右上角天空有 1 架直升机，右侧建筑物附近有 1 团巨大的火球爆炸，烟雾、火花和碎片四散。海报最上方，有一行红色小号大写文字：{argument name="top tagline" default="REVENGE IS HIS MISSION"}。在左中区域，添加 4 行堆叠的白色大写标语：{argument name="left tagline" default="THE PAST TOOK EVERYTHING. HE'LL TAKE EVERYTHING BACK."}，样式为由细红线分隔的 2 个短块。主标题横跨中下部，分为 2 个单词：第一个单词采用巨大的做旧金属白色块状字体，第二个单词采用稍小一些的粗体红色大写字母。在海报下三分之一处，展示 1 个孤独的男性背影，他站在湿漉漉的反光街道中央，手持手枪，面对着燃烧的城市。他周围共有 4 辆警车，左右各 2 辆，闪烁着警灯；远方地平线附近还有 2 架直升机，使整张海报中共有 3 架直升机。下方的两个角落点缀着火焰、残骸、烟雾、余烬以及远处几个武装人员的剪影。底部中央添加红色的发行文字 {argument name="release text" default="COMING SOON"}，下方配有较小的白色文字 {argument name="format line" default="EXPERIENCE IT IN IMAX"}。最底部添加一行密集的虚构制作人员名单和电影分级框。配色方案：黑色、炭灰色、钢灰色、橙色火焰和深红色。风格：精致的好莱坞大片主视觉，戏剧性的轮廓光，照片级真实感，超高细节，强烈的对比度，变形宽银幕动作照明，烟雾缭绕的氛围，爆炸性的城市混乱，高级院线海报设计。

templates.title: Solar System Ice Cream Cone

titleLocalized.zh: 太阳系冰淇淋甜筒

templates.prompt: A whimsical and realistic food photograph showcasing eight ice cream cones arranged in a row on a matte black rectangular stand, each cone designed to resemble a different planet in the solar system. Shot at eye level with a shallow depth of field, the background features soft, blurred cityscape lighting, creating a gentle, sunlit atmosphere reminiscent of an outdoor street or café. From left to right, the eight cones are: a water planet with grey spots, a gold planet with yellowish-brown swirls, a blue-green Earth sphere with white cloud-like patterns and small blue droplets, a deep red Mars sphere with dark marble patterns and red melting droplets, a striped Jupiter sphere with large red spots, a light brown Saturn sphere surrounded by thin rings, a light ice-blue Uranus sphere with blue droplets, and a vibrant cobalt blue Neptune sphere with a glossy texture and blue melting droplets. The use of crisp waffle cones highlights realistic melting details, a glossy frozen surface, sophisticated studio lighting, and a centered, symmetrical composition. To ensure the planet's altitude is clearly visible while presenting a realistic ice cream texture, a black stand spans the width of the image, and the background is softly blurred.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满奇思妙想、产品风格的写实美食照片，8 个冰淇淋甜筒在哑光黑色长方形支架上排成一列，每个冰淇淋球都被设计成太阳系中不同行星的模样。场景采用平视角度拍摄，具有浅景深效果，背景为柔和的城市虚化光斑，营造出户外街道或咖啡馆的柔和日光氛围。从左到右依次展示 8 个甜筒：灰色斑点的水星球、黄褐色漩涡的金星球、带有白色云纹和蓝色小滴的蓝绿色地球球、带有深色大理石纹和红色融化液滴的深红色火星球、带有大红斑纹理的条纹木星球、环绕着细环的浅棕色土星球、带有蓝色液滴的浅冰蓝色天王星球，以及具有光泽质感和蓝色融化液滴的鲜艳钴蓝色海王星球。使用酥脆的华夫饼甜筒，呈现逼真的融化细节、光泽的冷冻表面、考究的摄影棚级布光以及居中的对称构图。确保行星高度可辨认，同时呈现出逼真的冰淇淋质感，黑色支架横跨画面宽度，背景经过柔和虚化处理。

templates.title: Surreal Octopus Burger High-End Food Photography

titleLocalized.zh: 超现实章鱼汉堡高级餐饮摄影

templates.prompt: A dimly lit, emotionally charged photograph of a high-end restaurant scene, taken with a direct flash, carries a slightly unsettling, surreal, and eerie tone. At the center of the composition is an exquisitely plated, delicious sandwich whose filling resembles a lifelike octopus: a glossy, enticing golden-brown sesame bun atop a fleshy, pinkish-purple octopus body, detailed with clearly defined veins, pores, suckers, wrinkled skin, and several tentacles extending from the sides and front. The creature appears both cooked and unsettlingly alive, with a spherical eyeball-like structure visible on the left and dense pores and textures on the right, creating an eerie, organic appearance. The sandwich sits on a large, round, white ceramic plate with a pool of yellow, buttery or oily sauce at the bottom, mixed with a few drops of red liquid. A small dish containing a pat of butter is placed in the background on the left foreground. Six visible drinking glasses must be precisely placed on the table: two large red wine glasses, three stemmed white wine or champagne glasses, and a dark beer glass on the right edge. A small, lit candle is placed in a gold candlestick in the center of the background, along with a small, clear vase filled with white flowers. A white tablecloth is used, the ambient lighting is very dim with a warm candlelight glow, and the glassware reflects strong camera flashes. The casual, snapshot-style shallow depth of field composition creates a whimsical, hyper-detailed, realistic, and visually striking high-end restaurant atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张昏暗、情绪化的高级餐厅场景照片，采用直接闪光灯拍摄，带有略显不安的超现实恐怖基调。构图中心是一份摆盘精致的美味三明治，其内馅看起来像是一只逼真的章鱼：顶部是光泽诱人的金棕色芝麻汉堡胚，下方是肉质粉紫色的章鱼躯体，细节包括清晰的静脉、毛孔、吸盘、褶皱的皮肤，以及从两侧和前方伸出的几条触手。生物看起来既像是烹饪过的，又带有令人不安的生命感，左侧可见一个球状眼球状结构，右侧则有密集的孔洞和纹理，营造出一种诡异的生物有机外观。三明治放置在一个大型圆形白色陶瓷盘中，盘底有一滩黄色黄油状或油状酱汁，酱汁中混有几滴红色液滴。在左前景的背景处放置一个小碟子，里面盛着一块黄油。餐桌上必须准确摆放 6 个可见的饮用杯：2 个大型红酒杯，3 个高脚白葡萄酒或香槟杯，以及右边缘的 1 个深色啤酒杯。在后方中心放置 1 个金色烛台中的点燃小蜡烛和 1 个插有白色花朵的小型透明花瓶。使用白色桌布，环境光非常昏暗，带有温暖的烛光，玻璃器皿上有强烈的相机闪光反射，采用随意的快照式浅景深构图，呈现出一种怪诞、超细节、写实且极具视觉冲击力的高级餐厅氛围。
