templates.title: Owl Nebula in Deep Space

titleLocalized.zh: 深空中的猫头鹰星云

templates.prompt: A majestic deep-space scene: an owl-shaped nebula floats in the darkness of a star field. Using a central composition, cosmic gas and dust naturally form the clearly defined owl's face. Two large, luminous, round eyes possess bright electric blue nuclei, a pointed beak composed of amber light, and long, upward-reaching ear clusters formed by pillars of burnt orange and golden-brown nebulae. The body is composed of translucent clouds layered in warm copper, dark brown, ivory, and cool smoky blue, with softly glowing edges and intricate filamentous textures. Surrounding the main body are numerous sharp stars of varying sizes, including several bright blue-white stars with subtle diffraction. The owl's shape is clearly discernible, yet entirely composed of astronomical nebula structures, presenting a realistic, photographic aesthetic with strong contrasts, incredibly rich detail, and an ethereal glow, inspired by {argument name="cosmic subject" default="nebula"} Formed{argument name="animal silhouette" default="owl"} The color tone is{argument name="primary glow color" default="amber and blue"} The vertical composition, centered and symmetrical, has a cinematic, stunning effect.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅雄伟的深空场景，一只猫头鹰形状的星云漂浮在漆黑的星场中，采用中心构图，宇宙气体和尘埃自然形成了清晰的猫头鹰面部。两只巨大的发光圆形眼睛拥有明亮的电蓝色星核，中间是一个琥珀色光芒构成的尖细喙，以及由焦橙色和金棕色星云柱组成的向上延伸的长耳簇。身体由温暖的铜色、深褐色、象牙白和冷烟蓝色层叠的半透明云团构成，边缘散发柔和光芒，并带有复杂的丝状纹理。主体周围环绕着许多大小不一的锐利恒星，包括几颗带有细微衍射光芒的亮蓝白色恒星。猫头鹰的形状清晰可辨，但完全由天文星云结构组成，呈现逼真的太空摄影美感，对比强烈，细节极其丰富，散发空灵光芒，灵感源自于由 {argument name="cosmic subject" default="nebula"} 形成的 {argument name="animal silhouette" default="owl"}，色调为 {argument name="primary glow color" default="amber and blue"}，纵向构图，居中且对称，具有电影般的震撼效果。

templates.title: Surrealist archers and birds and beasts

titleLocalized.zh: 超现实主义射手与飞禽走兽

templates.prompt: An outdoor portrait in the style of a surrealist film depicts a masked archer standing in a dry meadow under a deep, clear sky. The composition is wide and horizontal, with the frame extending approximately from the knees up. The central figure is a woman in a vintage prairie-style dress and matching headscarf, aiming a simple wooden longbow at the left side of the frame, the arrow fully drawn to her cheek. Her face is completely obscured by a soft, rectangular blur or blocky occlusion, creating a strange sense of anonymity. The dress is sage green with long, puffy sleeves, a belted waist, and a small red and white floral pattern. Beneath the green headscarf, red fabric or a scarf covers the lower half of her face and neck. Around her are twelve animals: eight white birds soaring at varying distances in the sky, two larger white birds standing on the ground to the right, a deer head peeking in from the lower left foreground, and a sheep head from the lower right foreground. A red-crested crane, visible in profile, is added at the far right edge. The image should evoke a dreamlike, whimsical, and symbolic atmosphere, rather than realism, featuring bright midday sunlight, rich colors, subtle film grain, and a slightly retro editorial feel. Use low-angle perspective, creating tension and dynamism through dynamic diagonals formed by arrows and layered animal arrangements. Hay is visible at the bottom edge, but the background is mostly open sky. The image should showcase highly detailed fabric folds, natural bird wing postures, and a balanced surreal composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超现实主义电影风格的户外肖像，描绘了一位站在深邃晴空下干草地里的蒙面射手，采用宽幅横向构图，取景范围约为膝盖以上。中心人物是一位身着复古草原风连衣裙、佩戴同款头巾的女性形象，她正手持一把简易木制长弓瞄准画面左侧，箭已拉满至脸颊处。她的面部被一块柔和的矩形模糊或块状遮挡物完全遮盖，营造出一种离奇的匿名感。连衣裙为鼠尾草绿，配有长泡泡袖，腰部有系带收腰，并带有细小的红白相间碎花图案。绿色头巾下方，红色的布料或围巾包裹着她的下半张脸和颈部。她周围共有 12 只动物：8 只白色飞鸟在不同距离的天空中翱翔，2 只较大的白色鸟类站在右侧地面，1 个鹿头从左下角前景探入，1 个羊头从右下角前景探入。在最右侧边缘增加 1 只侧面可见的红头鹤类鸟。画面应呈现出梦幻、怪诞且具有象征意义的氛围，而非写实风格，并具备明亮的中午阳光、浓郁的色彩、细腻的胶片颗粒感以及略带复古的编辑摄影质感。使用低角度透视，通过弓箭形成的动态对角线以及分层的动物布局来营造张力和动感。底部边缘可见干草，但背景大部分为开阔的天空。画面需呈现高细节的织物褶皱、自然的鸟类翅膀姿态以及平衡的超现实构图。

templates.title: Apple macOS redesigned promotional mockup

titleLocalized.zh: Apple macOS 重新设计宣传样机

templates.prompt: A beautifully crafted Apple-style macOS promotional desktop mockup, presented as a full-screen screenshot. The wallpaper features a soft, pastel dawn theme, depicting layered purple-blue rolling hills under a pale peach and lavender sky. At the top center is a large, minimalist title: "macOS," with the subtitle "Redesigned." Below that is a smaller line of text: "More clarity. More focus. More you." The top system menu bar spans the entire screen: on the left are the Apple icon, Finder, File, Edit, Show, Go, Window, and Help; on the right are Wi-Fi, Battery, Search, a colored user icon, and the date and time: "Monday, June 10th, 9:41 AM." On the left, four semi-transparent, rounded-corner widgets are stacked vertically: a weather widget displaying "Sonoma, CA," "65°," "Sunny," high/low temperatures "H:72° L:55°," and hourly temperatures from 10 AM to 3 PM; a "Next" schedule widget displaying "Design Review" and "Lunch with Sophie" and their times; a "Focus" widget displaying "Do Not Disturb" mode and "On until 10:00 AM"; and a "Notes" widget containing a "Website redesign" note and the time "3:30 PM." A Finder window with rounded corners and a light frosted interface, titled "iCloud Drive," is placed in the left-center foreground. The left sidebar contains 10 items: Favorites includes "AirDrop," "Recently Used," "Applications," "Desktop," "Documents," and "Downloads" (6 items); iCloud includes "iCloud Drive" and "Shared" (2 items); and Location includes "Macintosh HD" (1 item). The Finder main area displays eight files in a grid: the top row contains four folders labeled "Work," "Personal," "Projects," and "Presentations," while the bottom row contains four documents labeled "Brand Guidelines.pdf," "Project Brief.docx," "Research.png," and "Moodboard.key." The title bar includes the standard macOS traffic light window button and small view/search controls. A three-column layout of the Mail application window overlaps on the right. The left-hand mail list bar, titled "Inbox," displays "1237 emails" and five visible sender/email summaries: "Design updates" from "Antonio Manriquez," "Re: Team lunch" from "Jenny Court," "Q3 Planning" from "Heather Lee," "Re: Feedback" from "Nisha Kumar," and "Offsite ideas" from "Simon Pickford." The reading pane displays the selected email from Antonio Manriquez, with the subject "Design updates." The body contains an attached mockup of the new features, along with a file attachment card labeled "Mockups.zip" and "12.4 MB." It employs a clean SF Pro-style font, subtle shadows, a translucent glass-like panel, soft ambient lighting, and a high-end Apple Keynote aesthetic. At the bottom center is a glossy, translucent macOS Dock containing 15 icons: Finder, Launchpad, Safari, Messages, Mail, Calendar displaying "June 10th," Photos, Notes, Reminders, TV, Music, News, App Store, System Settings, and Trash. The overall composition is balanced, transparent, realistic, and highly refined, resembling an official Apple macOS redesign announcement.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的 Apple 风格 macOS 宣传桌面样机，以全屏截图形式呈现。壁纸采用柔和的淡彩晨曦风格，描绘了淡桃色与薰衣草色天空下层叠的紫蓝色连绵山丘。顶部中央是一个巨大的极简主义标题“macOS”，下方副标题为“Redesigned.”，再下方是一行较小的文字：“More clarity. More focus. More you.”。顶部系统菜单栏横跨整个屏幕：左侧依次为 Apple 图标、Finder、文件、编辑、显示、前往、窗口、帮助；右侧为 Wi‑Fi、电池、搜索、彩色用户图标以及日期时间“6 月 10 日周一 上午 9:41”。左侧垂直堆叠 4 个半透明圆角小组件：一个显示“Sonoma, CA”、“65°”、“晴天”、最高/最低气温“H:72° L:55°”以及上午 10 点至下午 3 点每小时气温的天气小组件；一个显示“Design Review”和“Lunch with Sophie”及其时间的“接下来”日程小组件；一个显示“勿扰模式”及“开启至上午 10:00”的“专注”小组件；以及一个包含“Website redesign”笔记和时间“下午 3:30”的“备忘录”小组件。在左中前景处放置一个带有圆角和轻盈磨砂界面的 Finder 窗口，标题为“iCloud Drive”。左侧边栏包含 10 个项目：个人收藏包含“隔空投送”、“最近使用”、“应用程序”、“桌面”、“文稿”、“下载”6 个项目；iCloud 包含“iCloud Drive”和“共享”2 个项目；位置包含“Macintosh HD”1 个项目。Finder 主区域以网格形式显示 8 个文件：顶行是标记为“Work”、“Personal”、“Projects”、“Presentations”的 4 个文件夹，底行是标记为“Brand Guidelines.pdf”、“Project Brief.docx”、“Research.png”、“Moodboard.key”的 4 个文档。标题栏包含标准的 macOS 交通灯窗口按钮及小型视图/搜索控件。右侧重叠一个三栏布局的“邮件”应用窗口。左侧邮件列表栏标题为“收件箱”，显示“1237 封邮件”及 5 条可见的发件人/邮件摘要：“Antonio Manriquez”的“Design updates”、“Jenny Court”的“Re: Team lunch”、“Heather Lee”的“Q3 Planning”、“Nisha Kumar”的“Re: Feedback”以及“Simon Pickford”的“Offsite ideas”。阅读窗格显示选中的 Antonio Manriquez 发给你的邮件，主题为“Design updates”，正文内容关于新功能的附件样机，并附有一个标记为“Mockups.zip”和“12.4 MB”的文件附件卡片。采用简洁的 SF Pro 风格字体、微妙的阴影、半透明的玻璃拟态面板、柔和的环境光以及高端的 Apple Keynote 美学。底部中央包含一个光泽半透明的 macOS 程序坞，内含 15 个图标：Finder、启动台、Safari、信息、邮件、显示“6 月 10 日”的日历、照片、备忘录、提醒事项、TV、音乐、新闻、App Store、系统设置和废纸篓。整体构图平衡、通透、写实且高度精致，宛如 Apple 官方发布的 macOS 重新设计公告图。

templates.prompt: A super-detailed, high-quality collectible trading card illustration, with the foreground center being {argument name="hero name" default="Kamen Rider Decade"} He strikes a powerful pose against a backdrop of a futuristic city battlefield amidst the dramatic cosmic night sky. The armored hero, clad in a bright magenta, black, and white suit of armor and a segmented helmet, faces the audience with his enormous green compound eyes gleaming. One arm extends forward towards the camera, a character card held between the fingers of a black glove, its clarity enhanced by forced perspective; his other hand confidently raises a thumb. His belt is prominently displayed. Eight minor characters and monsters are scattered around the hero, distributed across the rubble and mid-air battle scene: a blue and red armored knight crouches in the lower left foreground; a red and gold armored knight is in the midground on the right; two small knight figures are in the center of the background; two flying characters are in the upper background; and two monster enemies are located on the right-center and lower right corners, respectively. The environment is filled with collapsed buildings, broken concrete, sparks, smoke, debris, and cinematic motion effects. The entire image is rendered as a luxurious holographic SSR card, featuring a gorgeous prism foil border, shimmering rainbow refraction, metallic gold wire trim, and a layered collectible card UI. A large embossed title text is printed at the top center.{argument name="title text" default="KAMEN RIDER DECADE"} Above it is the smaller text "MASKED RIDER". In the upper right corner is a large metal badge that reads {argument name="rarity label" default="SSR"} Below are five gold stars. There are two circular magenta heraldic symbols in the upper left and lower right corners. At the bottom center is a gold cursive signature.{argument name="signature text" default="NickZág"} The bottom border features four labeled UI areas: the left panel displays "CARD TYPE" below "CHARACTER," the central nameplate reads "KAMEN RIDER DECADE" along with the Japanese subtitle "仮面ライダーディケイド," and a barcode panel is located below it; the right panel displays "RARITY" below "SSR." A small footer text is added below the barcode.{argument name="footer text" default="DECADE COMPLETE 21"} Style: Ultra-detailed tokusatsu hero art, cinematic realistic armor texture, highly dramatic, explosive action composition, high-end gacha design, holographic foil printing effect, clear focus on the main hero and cards, and highly exquisite game card promotional artwork.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超精细的优质收藏级集换式卡牌插画，前景中心为 {argument name="hero name" default="假面骑士 Decade"}，他摆出强有力的姿势，背景是充满戏剧性宇宙夜空的废墟未来城市战场。这位身披铠甲的英雄穿着亮面洋红色、黑色和白色相间的战衣，戴着分段式头盔，巨大的绿色复眼闪烁着光芒，正面对着观众。他的一只手臂向前伸向镜头，黑色的手套指间夹着一张角色卡，通过强制透视法使卡牌清晰可见；另一只手则自信地竖起大拇指。腰间的腰带装置十分显眼。英雄周围散布着 8 个次要角色和怪物，分布在瓦砾和半空中的战斗场景中：左下角前景蹲着 1 个蓝红配色的装甲骑士，右侧中景有 1 个红金配色的装甲骑士，远景中心有 2 个小型骑士人偶，背景上方有 2 个飞行角色，右侧有 2 个怪物敌人，分别位于中右侧和右下角。环境充斥着倒塌的建筑、破碎的混凝土、火花、烟雾、碎片以及电影级的动作光效。将整张图片渲染为奢华的全息 SSR 卡牌，带有华丽的棱镜箔边框、闪烁的彩虹折射、金属金丝镶边以及分层的收藏卡 UI。顶部中心印有巨大的浮雕标题文字 {argument name="title text" default="KAMEN RIDER DECADE"}，上方有较小的文字 "MASKED RIDER"。右上角是一个巨大的金属徽章，写着 {argument name="rarity label" default="SSR"}，下方有 5 颗金星。左上角和右下角各有 2 个圆形的洋红色纹章图标。下部中心有金色的草书签名 {argument name="signature text" default="NickZág"}。底部边框设有 4 个带标签的 UI 区域：左侧面板 "CARD TYPE" 下方为 "CHARACTER"，中心铭牌为 "KAMEN RIDER DECADE" 及日语副标题 "仮面ライダーディケイド"，下方附有条形码面板，右侧面板 "RARITY" 下方为 "SSR"。在条形码下方添加微小的页脚文字 {argument name="footer text" default="DECADE COMPLETE 21"}。风格：超精细特摄英雄艺术、电影级写实铠甲质感、极具深度的戏剧性、爆炸性的动作构图、高级抽卡设计、全息箔印刷效果、主体英雄与卡牌聚焦清晰、高度精致的游戏卡宣传原画。

templates.prompt: A highly detailed illustration for a premium holographic trading card game, featuring the main character as {argument name="hero name" default="Kamen Rider 1"} The design style references ultra-rare tokusatsu collectible cards, featuring a gorgeous vertical full-frame border. The central figure is a classic masked hero, dynamically stretching forward, occupying most of the composition (above the thighs). One gloved hand reaches towards the viewer, while the other holds a small matching card. He wears a dark green armored chestplate, a black bodysuit, silver segmented gloves and forearm armor, a red scarf dramatically flowing to the right, a red belt around his waist with a large, round red buckle, and a metallic insect-shaped helmet with two long silver antennae and two oversized, multifaceted, deep red compound eyes. The background is a chaotic post-apocalyptic city night battle scene, including ruined buildings, smoke, sparks, dazzling explosions, and a starry cosmic sky. The background and corners should include 10 smaller knight figures: two flying figures in the sky at the top right, one climbing or jumping figure on the ruins at the center left, three background fighting figures at the right center, two small figures at the bottom right, one figure with blue decorations at the bottom left, and one partially visible figure at the far left edge. The art style should be bold, with an oil painting-like texture, metallic feel, and cinematic quality. The entire image should be covered with dense glitter particles, rainbow foil reflections, gold filigree lines, and prism-like holographic highlights. The card borders should use luxurious black, gold, and iridescent foil, and have a trading card game style. The text "MASKED RIDER" should be placed at the top center, below which is a large serif font {argument name="title text" default="KAMEN RIDER"} "and huge golden numbers"{argument name="card number" default="1"} A circular badge displaying the masked knight's face is placed in the upper left corner. A large badge with the words "..." is placed in the upper right corner.{argument name="rarity" default="SSR"} Below it are five gold stars. A panel in the lower left corner reads "CARD TYPE" and "CHARACTER". At the bottom center is the text "KAMEN RIDER 1" and below it "仮面ライダー1号", along with a barcode-like strip that reads "RIDER LEGEND 1971". A large gold cursive signature is added to the lower right corner.{argument name="signature" default="NickZag"} This gives the card the feel of an ultra-premium rare card, with dramatic perspective effects, exquisite details, strong contrast, glowing embers, the energy of a shattered city, and a luxurious holographic foil texture.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超精细的高级全息集换式卡牌插图，主角为 {argument name="hero name" default="假面骑士 1 号"}，设计风格参考超稀有特摄收藏卡，带有垂直全画幅华丽边框。中心人物是一位经典的蒙面英雄，采用动态向前伸展的姿势，占据了构图的大部分（大腿以上），一只戴手套的手伸向观众，另一只手拿着一张同款的小型卡牌。他身穿深绿色装甲胸甲、黑色紧身衣，佩戴银色分段式手套和前臂护甲，一条红色围巾向右侧戏剧性地飘动，腰间系着红色腰带，带有巨大的圆形红色带扣，头戴金属质感的昆虫状头盔，配有 2 根长银色触角和 2 只超大的多面深红色复眼。背景是混乱的末日城市夜战场景，包含废墟建筑、烟雾、火花、流光溢彩的爆炸以及繁星点点的宇宙天空。背景和角落处需包含 10 个较小的骑士形象：右上角天空中有 2 个飞行形象，左中废墟上有 1 个攀爬或跳跃形象，中右侧有 3 个背景战斗形象，右下角有 2 个小型形象，左下角有 1 个带有蓝色装饰的形象，最左侧边缘有 1 个部分可见的形象。艺术风格粗犷、具有油画质感、金属感且充满电影感，整张图像覆盖着密集的闪光颗粒、彩虹箔反射、金色花丝线条以及棱镜般的全息高光。卡牌边框应采用奢华的黑色、金色和虹彩箔片，并具备集换式卡牌游戏的风格。顶部中心放置文本“MASKED RIDER”，下方为大型衬线字体“{argument name="title text" default="KAMEN RIDER"}”以及巨大的金色数字“{argument name="card number" default="1"}”。左上角放置一个显示蒙面骑士面部的圆形徽章。右上角放置一个大徽章，写有“{argument name="rarity" default="SSR"}”及其下方的 5 颗金星。左下角放置一个面板，写有“CARD TYPE”和“CHARACTER”。底部中心放置文本“KAMEN RIDER 1”及其下方的“仮面ライダー1号”，以及一条类似条形码的带状区域，写有“RIDER LEGEND 1971”。右下角添加一个巨大的金色草书签名“{argument name="signature" default="NickZag"}”。使整张卡牌呈现出超高级珍稀卡的感觉，具备戏剧性的透视效果、极致的细节、强烈的对比度、发光的余烬、破碎城市的能量感以及奢华的全息箔片质感。

His battle suit is clearly divided in two: the left half is a vibrant metallic green, while the right half is a glossy black, featuring large, shimmering red compound eyes, a silver V-shaped crown, segmented insect armor, a flowing white scarf, and a highly detailed transformation belt with red mechanical components. The card in his hand should display a smaller image of the hero and match the design of a high-end collectible. Eight background knights or enemies are positioned around him, distributed across the destroyed city battlefield, in dynamic combat poses: two flying figures near the upper background, three mid-ground combatants on the right, one blue-gold figure in the lower right, one red-blue knight in the lower left, and one partially visible warrior near the left edge. The environment, filled with shattered rubble, damaged skyscrapers, sparks, smoke, debris, and energy flows, creates a chaotic post-apocalyptic battle scene. The entire image utilizes strong prism holographic effects, rainbow diffraction, flashes, lens flares, starbursts, and reflective foil textures. The artwork is framed as an SSR rarity game card and includes visible text elements: the top center title "KAMEN RIDER," a large "W" below, and a shield emblem displayed in the upper right corner.{argument name="rarity label" default="SSR"} It features 6 stars, a green and purple circular "W" badge in the upper left corner, "CARD TYPE" and "CHARACTER" displayed on the lower left panel, "KAMEN RIDER DOUBLE" and "仮面ライダーW(ダブル)" on the bottom center plaque, a barcode below, "CYCLONE JOKER XTREME 09" in small print at the bottom, and a large gold handwritten signature in the lower right corner.{argument name="signature text" default="NickTag"} This makes the entire card look like a luxurious, gold-plated, ultra-rare, and officially licensed tokusatsu collectible card, with extremely sharp details, rich metallic highlights, dense particles, and extreme dramatic contrast.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超精细的高端日本集换式卡牌插画，采用超稀有特摄收藏品风格，垂直构图，带有华丽的全息箔边框和爆炸性的电影级动作场面。画面中心为身穿装甲的英雄 {argument name="character name" default="Kamen Rider Double"}，采用戏剧性的低角度全身姿势，在废墟城市战场中向前冲刺，左手向观众展示一张集换式卡牌。他的战衣从中间清晰地一分为二：左半部分为鲜艳的金属绿，右半部分为光亮的黑色，拥有巨大的闪烁红色复眼、银色 V 型冠饰、分段式昆虫装甲、飘逸的白色围巾，以及带有红色机械组件的高度精细变身腰带。他手中的卡牌应展示该英雄的较小图像，并与高端收藏品设计相匹配。在他周围布置 8 位背景骑士或敌人，分布在被摧毁的城市战区中，处于动态战斗姿势：上方背景附近有 2 个飞行身影，右侧有 3 个中景战斗人员，右下方有 1 个蓝金配色身影，左下方有 1 个红蓝配色骑士，左侧边缘附近还有 1 个部分可见的战士。环境充满破碎的瓦砾、受损的摩天大楼、火花、烟雾、碎片和能量流，营造出混乱的末日战斗场景。整张图像使用强烈的三棱镜全息效果、彩虹衍射、闪光、镜头光晕、星芒和反光箔纹理。将艺术作品框定为 SSR 稀有度游戏卡牌，并包含可见的文字元素：顶部中心标题“KAMEN RIDER”，下方有一个巨大的“W”，右上角盾牌徽章显示 {argument name="rarity label" default="SSR"} 并带有 6 颗星，左上角为绿色和紫色的圆形 W 徽章，左下角面板显示“CARD TYPE”和“CHARACTER”，底部中心铭牌显示“KAMEN RIDER DOUBLE”和“仮面ライダーW(ダブル)”，下方有条形码，底部小字显示“CYCLONE JOKER XTREME 09”，右下角有巨大的金色手写签名 {argument name="signature text" default="NickTag"}。使整张卡牌看起来像一张奢华、烫金、超稀有且获得官方授权的特摄收藏卡，细节极其锐利，金属高光丰富，粒子密集，并具有极致的戏剧性对比。

templates.title: Panoramic map of immortal sects

titleLocalized.zh: 仙侠宗门全景地图

templates.prompt: A grand, ultra-wide, cinematic-quality map of a fantasy world unfolds, showcasing an incredibly detailed panorama of Chinese cultivation sects, viewed from a high vantage point above a sea of ​​clouds. The scene depicts a magnificent mountain range comprised of numerous steep, rocky islands, featuring waterfalls, mist-shrouded valleys, floating boulders, ornate bridges, and layered traditional Chinese palace architecture, all bathed in a mysterious, glowing blue energy. At the center stands the grand main sect complex, labeled "Xuantian Sword Sect," perched atop the highest, glowing peak, adorned with a crystalline glow of interwoven white and blue light, towering pagodas, terraces, and ethereal aura; a smaller label nearby reads "Sect Main Hall." Nine additional marked locations are distributed around the panorama: the far left is a purple cliff area labeled "Sword-Asking Cliff," with a smaller note below stating "Place for Disciples' Training"; the middle left is a cultivation platform island shrouded in blue mist, labeled "Enlightenment Peak," with a smaller note below stating "Place for Disciples' Enlightenment"; the upper left is a solemn complex of palaces labeled "Scripture Repository," with a smaller note below stating "Collection of Supreme Techniques"; the upper right is a jagged iceberg sword formation labeled "Sword Tomb," with a smaller note below stating "The final resting place of successive generations of sword cultivators"; the middle right is a bright ceremonial building complex labeled "Martial Arts Arena," with a smaller note below stating "Sharpening the Disciples' Character"; the lower right is the Alchemy Pavilion area labeled "Alchemy Room," with a smaller note below stating "Alchemy Therapy"; the far right is a pink flower sea valley sanctuary labeled "Hundred Flowers Valley," with a smaller note below stating "A Mystical and Beautiful Secret Realm"; the lower right is the outer building complex labeled "Outer Gate," with a smaller note below stating "New Disciples' Residence." Add an inscription in the upper left corner, reading "Xuantian Sword Sect" in large gold characters, below which is a line of smaller poetry and a red seal. Employing an elegant painterly concept art style, the design features grand proportions, highlights in pale gold and ice blue, soft volumetric mist, a dramatic sky after rain, ethereal lighting, and exquisite blend of Chinese ink painting and digital landscape aesthetics. The foreground contains no figures or modern elements, presenting only a vast, legendary sect environment; the design resembles a promotional illustration for its world-building.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅宏大的超宽幅电影级仙侠世界地图，呈现为细节极其丰富的中国修真宗门全景，视角从云海之上的高空俯瞰。场景展现了一个由众多陡峭岩石岛屿组成的壮丽山界，包含瀑布、云雾缭绕的山谷、漂浮的碎石、华丽的桥梁，以及层叠的中国传统宫殿建筑，并伴有发光的神秘蓝色能量。在中心位置，放置宏伟的主宗门建筑群，标注为“玄天剑宗”，建在最高处发光的山峰上，配有白色与蓝色交织的晶莹光芒、高耸的宝塔、露台以及仙气；附近添加较小的标注“宗门大殿”。在全景中环绕分布另外 9 个标注地点：最左侧为紫色调的悬崖区域，标注为“问剑崖”，下方附带较小注释“弟子历练之地”；左中为蓝色云雾缭绕的修炼平台岛屿，标注为“悟道峰”，下方附带较小注释“弟子悟道之地”；左上方为庄严的殿宇群，标注为“藏经阁”，下方附带较小注释“典藏无上功法”；右上方为锯齿状的冰山剑阵，标注为“剑冢”，下方附带较小注释“历代剑修终寝之地”；右中为明亮的仪式建筑群，标注为“演武场”，下方附带较小注释“磨砺弟子心性”；右下方为炼丹阁区域，标注为“炼丹房”，下方附带较小注释“炼丹疗法”；最右侧为粉色花海山谷圣地，标注为“百花谷”，下方附带较小注释“入神绮艳秘境”；右下角为外围建筑群，标注为“外门”，下方附带较小注释“新弟子居所”。在左上角添加一处题字，以金色大字书写“玄天剑宗”，下方配有一行较小的诗句及一枚红色印章。采用优雅的绘画概念艺术风格，宏大的比例，淡金与冰蓝色的高光，柔和的体积雾，雨过天晴的戏剧性天空，空灵的灯光，以及精致的中国水墨与数字绘景美学。前景无人物，无现代元素，仅呈现一个广阔的传奇宗门环境，设计如同一幅世界观宣传插画。

The background is a moonlit lake shore covered in fresh snow; to the right, bare winter trees; to the left, across the water, a traditional pavilion or shrine; a bright full moon hangs in the deep indigo sky, studded with stars, and snowflakes drift lightly down. Emphasizing cinematic lighting and shadows, an ethereal atmosphere, ultra-fine fabric textures, dynamic fluidity, magical shimmering effects, elegant composition, and a dreamlike celestial ambiance. High-quality anime key visuals, vertical composition, intricate details, striking highlights, no text, and no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅令人惊叹的奇幻动漫插画，描绘了 {argument name="character name" default="一位天界巫女"} 在雪夜景观中的身影，她以优雅的全身舞姿伫立在波光粼粼的湖畔。她拥有极长的飘逸 {argument name="hair color" default="玫瑰粉色"} 秀发，从背面和侧面部分可见，发间饰有精致的金色花卉发饰和垂坠链条。她的面部大部分被角度遮挡。她身着灵感源自十二单的华丽多层日本宫廷和服，袖口宽大，层叠的衣襟交织着深红、纯白、紫色、绿色、金色和柔粉色，装饰着花卉锦缎、刺绣花朵、金属饰边和闪烁的图案。她优雅地抬起双臂，仿佛在引导两条巨大的半透明虹彩丝带或魔法绸带，丝带在她身周盘旋成发光的圆环，捕捉着如同肥皂膜极光般的彩虹高光。丝带散发着棱镜般的反射光和细小的火花，将她衬托在天幕之下。背景是覆盖着新雪的月下湖岸，右侧是光秃秃的冬树，左侧水对面有一座传统的小亭子或神社，深靛蓝色的天空中悬挂着明亮的满月，繁星密布，雪花轻盈飘落。湖水倒映着月光和闪烁的微粒。强调电影级光影、空灵氛围、超精细的织物纹理、动态的流动感、魔法闪光效果、优雅的构图以及梦幻般的天界意境。高质感的动漫关键视觉图，竖构图，细节复杂，高光亮眼，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Future Photonics Journal Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 未来感光子学杂志封面

templates.prompt: This is a meticulously crafted cover for a French science magazine, featuring a bold, mainstream newsstand publication style. The entire page is vertically laid out, with a dramatic glossy print, a black background accented by strong neon lighting, and saturated highlights in red, blue, purple, green, and orange. At the very top is a wide red masthead bar, displaying the magazine title in large, white-lined capital letters.{argument name="magazine title" default="SCIENCE & VIE"} It features subtle bevels and a metallic sheen; tiny white text in the upper right corner indicates the issue number details. The upper left corner has a bright yellow and black special label with the text {argument name="special tag" default="SPÉCIAL PHOTONIQUE"} Featuring a red arrow pattern. The main title occupies most of the upper half of the space, using large white blocky capital letters with a red halo and subtle 3D shadows.{argument name="main headline" default="LA PHOTONIQUE RÉVOLUTIONNE TOUT !"} Below are three lines of smaller white text serving as a cover introduction, with some keywords highlighted in yellow, discussing ultrafast light-speed chips, the French record-breaking computer named Lucy, and light captured for millions of cycles for energy-efficient AI. The central image: a futuristic, square photonic processor chip, slightly tilted and suspended in space, featuring extremely fine circuitry, metal screws in the corners, glowing lines, and a label {argument name="chip name" default="Lucy"} The chip features a bright cyan-blue core display; beams of light radiate outwards from the chip, intersecting and flowing fiber optic trails in electric blue, magenta, orange, and purple, spreading outwards across the page. The background behind the chip shows two glowing server wall corridors, red on the left and green on the right, gradually fading into darkness, hinting at a high-tech data center. At the bottom is a curved horizon as seen from space, with a soft blue atmospheric halo and scattered city lights. A total of four sidebar labels are added: two stacked on the left and two stacked on the right, each with a yellow title and white text, using a magazine cover layout hierarchy. Left Box 1, titled "EXCLUSIF," introduces Lucy as the world's most powerful French photonic quantum computer, containing a few lines of brief bullet points and highlighting "12 qubits" in yellow. Left Box 2, titled "RECORD MONDIAL," discusses the millions of cycles of light captured within the chip and highlights "millions of cycles" in yellow. The first right-hand box features a yellow title area with a striking red percentage "+300%" and text about the rise of French gem company Soitec thanks to photonic AI and its role in saving data centers during the energy crisis. The second right-hand box, titled "ENQUÊTE," discusses the end of high-power GPUs, featuring highlighted yellow figures such as 100x cost reduction and 1,000x speed increase. Near the bottom center is a small white text indicating the image source. At the bottom of the page is a thick black banner with a red square containing a white plus sign on the left, along with a white and red teaser text.{argument name="bottom feature text" default="DOSSIER COMPLET Photonique & IA : les 10 avancées qui vont transformer votre quotidien"} At the very bottom, three small, circular red icons are added, accompanied by brief white titles covering topics such as earthquake fiber optics, next-generation LiDAR and AR, and the ongoing European sovereignty movement. The bottom right corner contains a white barcode box and a short white text about this issue's release. Overall aesthetics: sensational, high-end, futuristic, glossy, information-dense, sharp editorial layout, dramatic science news covers, cinematic lighting, high contrast, photorealistic 3D chip illustrations combined with premium magazine graphic design.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超精细的法国科普杂志封面，采用大胆的主流报刊亭出版物风格，全页垂直布局，戏剧性的光面印刷设计，黑色背景配以强烈的霓虹灯光，以及饱和的红、蓝、紫、绿和橙色高光。最上方是一条宽大的红色刊头栏，以巨大的白色衬线大写字母展示杂志标题 {argument name="magazine title" default="SCIENCE & VIE"}，带有微妙的斜角和金属光泽；右上角有微小的白色文字，标注期号详情。左上角是一个明亮的黄黑相间特殊标签，文字为 {argument name="special tag" default="SPÉCIAL PHOTONIQUE"}，带有红色箭头图案。主标题占据了上半部分的大部分空间，采用巨大的白色块状大写字母，带有红色光晕和轻微的 3D 阴影：{argument name="main headline" default="LA PHOTONIQUE RÉVOLUTIONNE TOUT !"}。下方有 3 行较小的白色文字作为封面导读，部分关键词以黄色高亮显示，讨论超快光速芯片、名为 Lucy 的法国记录级计算机，以及为节能 AI 而被捕获数百万周期的光。中心图像：一个未来感十足的方形光子处理器芯片，以轻微的角度倾斜悬浮在太空中，具有极其精细的电路、角落处的金属螺丝、发光的线路，以及一个标有 {argument name="chip name" default="Lucy"} 的明亮青蓝色核心显示屏；芯片向外辐射出交叉的光束和流动的光纤光迹，呈现电光蓝、洋红色、橙色和紫色，向页面四周扩散。芯片背后的背景展示了 2 条发光的服务器墙走廊，左侧为红色，右侧为绿色，逐渐隐入黑暗，暗示着高科技数据中心。底部是地球从太空中看到的弯曲地平线，带有柔和的蓝色大气光晕和零星的城市灯光。总共添加 4 个侧边标注框：左侧堆叠 2 个，右侧堆叠 2 个，每个框都有黄色标题和白色正文，采用杂志封面排版层级。左侧框 1 标题："EXCLUSIF"，介绍 Lucy 作为世界上最强大的法国光子量子计算机，包含几行简短的项目符号，并以黄色强调 "12 qubits"。左侧框 2 标题："RECORD MONDIAL"，关于光在芯片中被捕获数百万周期，并以黄色强调 "millions de cycles"。右侧框 1 标题区域为黄色，带有醒目的红色百分比 "+300 %"，以及关于法国宝石公司 Soitec 得益于光子 AI 而崛起，并在能源危机期间拯救数据中心的文字。右侧框 2 标题："ENQUÊTE"，关于高功耗 GPU 的终结，包含黄色高亮显示的数字声明，如成本降低 100 倍，速度提升 1,000 倍。靠近底部中心处有微小的白色图片来源文字。页面底部有一条厚实的黑色横幅，左侧有一个包含白色加号的红色方块，以及一段白色和红色的专题预告文字：{argument name="bottom feature text" default="DOSSIER COMPLET Photonique & IA : les 10 avancées qui vont transformer votre quotidien"}。在最底部，添加 3 个小的圆形红色图标说明，配有简短的白色标题，内容涉及地震光纤、新一代 LiDAR 和 AR，以及正在推进的欧洲主权。右下角包含一个白色条形码框和一小段关于本期发售的白色文字。整体外观：轰动、高端、未来感、光泽感、信息密集、锐利的编辑排版、戏剧性的科学新闻封面、电影级灯光、高对比度、照片级真实的 3D 芯片插图与高级杂志图形设计相结合。

templates.title: World War II Normandy landings movie poster

titleLocalized.zh: 二战诺曼底登陆电影海报

templates.prompt: A high-quality World War II movie poster, using a vertical single-page layout, with a design style reminiscent of modern high-budget war film advertisements. Two lines of compressed capital letters are displayed at the top center of the poster:{argument name="top tagline" default="Courage. Brotherhood. Sacrifice."} and{argument name="second tagline" default="The price of victory."} The main composition features four American World War II soldiers in dark olive-colored uniforms and large-mesh M1 helmets: a dominant central soldier in a half-length portrait facing forward, flanked by three slightly smaller soldiers on each side (one on the left and two on the right). Their faces are shrouded in shadow, covered in dirt and grime, showing the effects of battle, with strong light and shadow effects and smoky backlighting. The background is a gloomy sky filled with smoke, sparks, embers, and two groups of aircraft: three in the upper left and five in the upper right. A line of small text is centered in the middle of the image:{argument name="based on text" default="Based on true events"} Below is a huge, bold, blocky, distressed headline:{argument name="movie title" default="D-DAY"} The two D's are separated by an asterisk. Below the title is a line of red compressed dates:{argument name="date text" default="June 6, 1944"} The lower half shows the Normandy landings from the inside of an open landing craft, framed by two dark metal ramps. Eight soldiers, carrying rifles and backpacks, wade towards the shore amidst the spray, surrounded by Czech hedgehog-like barricades, surging water, smoke, distant fires, and a bombed-out coastline. At the very bottom is a dense, tiny credits list, below which is a striking red line announcing the release date.{argument name="release text" default="Coming Soon"} Following this is a smaller line of white text: "In tribute to their sacrifice." The color scheme is charcoal gray, steel blue, and mud brown, accented with red lettering. This ultra-refined, realistic, high-contrast, emotional, epic, historical, and dramatic cinema poster design features authentic film grain, volumetric smoke, aged textures, and symmetrical composition, making it a top-tier visual art piece for blockbuster films.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满质感的二战电影海报，采用垂直单页布局，设计风格如同现代高规格战争片广告。海报顶部居中显示两行压缩大写标语：{argument name="top tagline" default="勇气。兄弟情。牺牲。"} 和 {argument name="second tagline" default="胜利的代价。"}。主体构图为 4 名身着深橄榄色制服、佩戴大网眼 M1 头盔的美国二战士兵：1 名占据主导地位的中央士兵半身像面向前方，两侧各有 3 名略小的士兵，左侧 1 名，右侧 2 名。他们的面部笼罩在阴影中，布满污垢，饱经战火，光影效果强烈，伴有烟雾缭绕的背光。背景是战火纷飞的阴沉天空，充斥着浓烟、火花、余烬以及 2 组飞机：左上方 3 架，右上方 5 架。画面中部有一行居中的小字：{argument name="based on text" default="根据真实事件改编"}。下方是巨大的粗体块状做旧标题：{argument name="movie title" default="D-DAY"}，两个 D 字母之间用星号分隔。标题下方是一行红色的压缩日期：{argument name="date text" default="1944 年 6 月 6 日"}。下半部分展示了从敞开的登陆艇内部视角看到的诺曼底登陆场景，两侧由两扇深色金属斜坡墙框住。在浪花中，共有 8 名士兵背着步枪和背包向岸边涉水前进，周围布满了捷克刺猬型路障、汹涌的海水、烟雾、远处的火光以及遭受轰炸的海岸线。最底部是一条密集的微小制作人员名单，下方是醒目的红色上映日期行：{argument name="release text" default="即将上映"}，紧随其后是一行较小的白色文字：“致敬他们的牺牲。”。色调为炭灰色、钢蓝色、泥棕色，并配以红色强调字体。超精细、写实、高对比度、情绪化、史诗感、历史感、戏剧性的影院海报设计，具有真实的胶片颗粒感、体积烟雾、做旧纹理、对称构图，是顶级大片的主视觉艺术。

templates.title: Cosmic Ink Dragon Roar

titleLocalized.zh: 宇宙墨龙吟

templates.prompt: A dramatic vertical close-up showcases the roaring head of a cosmic dragon in profile, rendered with bold ink splatter and brushstrokes against a pure white background. The creature possesses sharp, elongated horns, a sharply defined, armored face, and eyes that gleam with a white-green light. Its enormous mouth is wide open, revealing jagged teeth. Deep within its mouth and throat, instead of flesh and blood, there is a swirling, galactic void, filled with luminous light.{argument name="energy color" default="violet"} With the glow of a magenta nebula, shimmering stars and dust erupt like cosmic fire. The dragon's body is primarily black and deep indigo, with a glossy sheen, while the neck and scales are adorned with iridescent emerald reflections. The composition employs expressive, ink-painting-inspired high-contrast brushstrokes, splattered paint textures, torn abstract edges, and explosive particle effects concentrated on the eyes, mouth, and top of the head. The composition should have the head tilted upwards, emitting a wild roar, filling the entire frame, with tight cropping for maximum visual impact, devoid of environment or other subjects, presenting only primal abstract energy, ink blots, and celestial fragments.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的垂直特写，展示了侧面咆哮的宇宙龙首，采用强烈的墨迹飞溅与笔触风格，背景为纯白色。生物长有尖锐的长角、棱角分明的装甲面部，眼睛闪烁着白绿色的光芒，巨大的嘴巴张开，露出参差不齐的牙齿。在口腔和喉咙深处，没有血肉，取而代之的是如星系般旋转的虚空，充满发光的 {argument name="energy color" default="violet"} 和洋红色星云光芒，闪烁的恒星与尘埃如宇宙之火般喷涌而出。龙身主要为黑色和深靛色，带有光泽感，颈部和鳞片上点缀着虹彩般的翡翠色反光。运用富有表现力、受水墨画启发的高对比度笔触、飞溅的颜料质感、撕裂的抽象边缘，以及集中在眼睛、嘴部和头顶的爆炸性粒子特效。构图应使头部向上倾斜并发出狂野的咆哮，填满整个画面，紧凑裁剪以达到极致的视觉冲击力，无需环境或其他主体，仅呈现原始的抽象能量、墨迹与天体碎片。

templates.title: Hardcore style Evangelion Unit-01 poster

titleLocalized.zh: 硬核风格 Evangelion Unit-01 海报

templates.prompt: A hardcore, vertical anime mecha poster, featuring an aged silkscreen printing style, inspired by vintage military archives and Evangelion's key visual art. The main element is {argument name="mecha unit name" default="EVANGELION: UNIT-01"} A massive side profile close-up occupies two-thirds of the right side of the composition, facing left, jaws agape, emitting a wild roar. The head is a sharply defined biomechanical structure, featuring deep purple armor, olive green trim, a black metallic internal structure, a long horn extending diagonally upwards to the left, sharp teeth, and a narrow, glowing eye. The surface is covered in scratches, chips, and weathering marks, accented with heavy, comic-book style lines. The background is a deep navy blue blueprint, filled with eight clearly visible technical diagrams, white schematics, anatomical overlays, cross-sections, labels, measurement marks, and interface graphics. A streak of vibrant red paint sweeps diagonally across the upper center and left side of the image, with additional red dripping effects on the mech's mouth area. In the lower left corner, a small, boyish figure huddled on a gray equipment case: wearing a short-sleeved white shirt, dark trousers, and white sneakers, elbows resting on his knees, head bowed, staring at a glowing device in his hands, conveying a sense of loneliness and anxiety. Add layered poster layout and warning graphics to the border: a tattered yellow warning sign in the upper right corner with Japanese warning text and "CAUTION NERV ONLY"; a long strip on the left sidebar with "01", barcode-like squares, danger icons, and red and black labels; huge, distressed white Chinese characters stacked vertically above the mech's torso; below the Chinese characters are large, spaced-out red capital words.{argument name="main title" default="ESCAPE"} Below is a small black label that reads "PILOT:"{argument name="pilot name" default="IKARI, SHINJI"} The bottom right corner features the NERV logo; the footer includes a confidential document marker and a top-secret stamp. The blueprint area contains six clearly identifiable English technical labels: "TEST TYPE," "BIOLOGICAL CONSTRAINT," "AT FIELD," "MAGI SYSTEM," "INTERNAL," and "CLASSIFIED MATERIAL." Japanese archival text blocks are added as realistic graphic textures. The color palette is limited to deep indigo, black, deep red, purple, olive green, dirty beige, and off-white. High contrast, torn paper collage details, halftone textures, ink splatters, cracked paint, and worn printing edges. A cinematic, oppressive, chaotic, collector's edition poster design—ultra-refined, sharp, and textured, rejecting a clean, modern aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张硬核风格的竖版动漫机甲海报，采用做旧丝网印刷风格，灵感源自复古军事档案和 Evangelion 关键视觉艺术。主体是 {argument name="mecha unit name" default="EVANGELION: UNIT-01"} 的巨大侧面特写，占据了构图右侧三分之二的位置，面朝左侧，下颚大张，发出狂野的咆哮。头部呈棱角分明的生物机械结构，拥有深紫色装甲、橄榄绿装饰板、黑色金属内部结构、一根向左上方斜向延伸的长角、锋利的牙齿以及一只狭长的发光眼睛。表面布满划痕、缺口和风化痕迹，并配有厚重的漫画风格线条。背景为深海军蓝色的蓝图，布满了 8 组清晰可见的技术图表、白色示意线条、解剖叠层、横截面、标签、测量标记和界面图形。一道狂暴的红色油漆斜向划过画面上部中心和左侧，机甲嘴部区域还有额外的红色滴落效果。在左下角，1 个小小的少年人影蜷缩在灰色设备箱上：他穿着短袖白衬衫、深色长裤和白色运动鞋，手肘撑在膝盖上，低头看着手中的发光设备，传达出孤独与焦虑感。在边框处添加分层海报排版和警示图形：右上角有一张破损的黄色警示标志，印有日文警告文字和“CAUTION NERV ONLY”；左侧长条边栏印有“01”、条形码状方块、危险图标以及红黑标签；机甲躯干上方垂直堆叠着巨大的做旧白色汉字；汉字下方是间距拉开的红色大写单词 {argument name="main title" default="ESCAPE"}；下方有一个黑色小标签，写着“PILOT: {argument name="pilot name" default="IKARI, SHINJI"}”；右下角印有 NERV 标志；页脚处包含机密文件标记和绝密印章。在蓝图区域包含 6 个清晰可辨的英文技术标签：“TEST TYPE”、“BIOLOGICAL CONSTRAINT”、“AT FIELD”、“MAGI SYSTEM”、“INTERNAL”和“CLASSIFIED MATERIAL”。添加日文档案文本块作为真实的图形纹理。色调限制为深靛蓝、黑色、深红色、紫色、橄榄绿、脏米色和灰白色。高对比度，撕纸拼贴细节，半色调纹理，墨水飞溅，裂纹漆面，磨损的印刷边缘。电影感、压抑、混乱、收藏级海报设计，超精细，锐利，富有质感，拒绝干净的现代感。

templates.title: Dark comic book style monster poster

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑漫画风怪物海报

templates.prompt: A dark, monochrome, comic-style horror illustration against a pure black background, presented in a vertical poster format. At the bottom center of the image is a lonely, short-haired boy sitting on the ground, knees tucked to his chest, head slightly bowed, conveying fear, isolation, and helplessness. Above him, a massive bio-mechanical demon or armored monster head swoops down, with a long, angular, skull-like face, a sharp chin, narrow, empty eye sockets, layered helmet-like armor plates, and a jagged, gaping maw. Two enormous skeletal claws, one on each side, encircle the boy like a cage; each hand has long, segmented metal fingers with sharp, inward-curving tips, exuding a menacing aura. The overall design uses rough, white, slashed lines and heavy, intersecting hatching, creating a strong contrast against the deep black background, evoking the tension of seinen manga. Vibrant neon purple liquid splatters and long drips are added to the monster's face, claws, and the ground, converging around the boy and becoming the only strong color accents in the image. Add the vertical Japanese text "逃げちゃダメだ" to the upper right corner, and below it, add the English text "EGO BORDER: ACTIVE" in small white text. The overall atmosphere is oppressive, psychological, claustrophobic, and nightmarish, resembling a dark anime poster about inner fear and mental breakdown.

templates.title: Chaotic Road Trip Comedy Poster

templates.prompt: A bright, chaotic movie poster for a theatrical comedy, in the sophisticated style of a Hollywood single-page poster, with a vertical composition. A vintage yellow Mini Cooper speeds toward the viewer along a sun-drenched, palm-lined city street. The car is crammed with five vacationing friends: two visible in the front, two squeezed into the back, and a man sprawled on the roof rack, grinning and dramatically pointing ahead. Everyone is dressed in brightly colored casual vacation wear, including tropical prints, loose shirts, and sun hats. The scene is boisterous, reckless, and full of fun. Suitcases and travel bags are piled on the roof. A police car with flashing lights is chasing them from the right rear. To the left is a crooked wooden road sign with three signs: “BEACH,” “MOUNTAINS,” and “WHAT COULD GO WRONG?” A screeching seagull perches atop the sign. On the right is a giant roadside donut shop sign that reads "DONUT," with a folded paper map fluttering in the air. The street is filled with a sense of motion blur, dust, debris, and the energy left by tires, above which is a saturated blue sky and fluffy clouds. At the very top are the names of the four actors, in black compressed capital letters: "DAVE JOHNSON," "LILY WANG," "KEVIN HARTLEY," and "AMY CHEN." Below this is a stacked slogan in bold capital letters: "THEY CAME. THEY SAW." in deep navy blue, and "THEY MESSED EVERYTHING UP." in red. The main title occupies the upper center in a huge, playful 3D font:{argument name="movie title" default="VACATION MODE"} The title is highlighted in bright yellow for "VACATION" and white for "MODE" with a heavy blue shading. The letter "O" is replaced by a simple smiley face wearing sunglasses. Small yellow doodle-style emphasis marks are added around the title. A slanted bright pink banner is placed to the lower right of the title, reading "A COMEDY ABOUT BAD IDEAS & GOOD TIMES," accompanied by a hand-drawn curved arrow pointing downwards. The license plate reads "NO PLAN ALL FUN." Near the bottom, a glowing yellow quote is added: "LAUGH-OUT-LOUD FUNNY!", below which reads "- MOVIE BUZZ." At the bottom center, the release information "ONLY IN THEATERS" is added, followed by "..."{argument name="release date" default="JUNE 20"} The logo is presented in bold yellow capital letters. A small legal notice is added to the bottom edge, along with small production company logos in the corners, including "GOOD TIME FILMS" in the bottom left corner and "NO PLAN ALL FUN" in the bottom right corner. The design employs high-contrast lighting, exaggerated perspective, a glossy commercial poster texture, vibrant summer colors, and a quirky road trip comedy tone.

templates.title: Dragon Riding Scrolls Scholar

templates.prompt: An ancient portrait in the style of Chinese ink painting, painted on aged brown parchment, is composed like a classical hanging scroll. An East Asian scholar, dressed in a flowing grey-blue robe, rides sideways on the back of a long Chinese dragon weaving through the clouds. His face is deliberately obscured by a blurred rectangular block of brown parchment. He has short, dark curly hair and wears a multi-layered traditional robe with ornate lace trim, tied with a dark belt; his clothing cleverly incorporates two modern OpenAI knot-shaped badges: one imprinted on his chest, the other on the round fan held upright in his right hand. His left hand is close to the dragon's mane, as if stabilizing its body. The dragon is massive and richly detailed, with blue-green scales, a pale belly, reddish-brown mane and fin-like decorations, antler-like horns, whiskers, exposed teeth, and a fierce and vivid face in the lower left foreground, its body spiraling upwards to the upper right. The figure is surrounded by mist, stylized clouds, and steep mountains fading into the background. Add a column of black Chinese calligraphy in the upper left corner, and three red seals below the title area. The color palette is soft, aged, and full of antiquity: parchment beige, faded cyan, moss green, smoky gray, dark brown, and rust red. The overall atmosphere is mythical, scholarly, solemn, and slightly surreal, blending classical Chinese scroll painting with subtle modern AI icons. The brushstrokes are delicate, the paper texture is mottled, the composition is elegant, and it is a borderless, full-frame vertical artwork.

templates.prompt: A surreal and exquisitely detailed fantasy illustration depicts a colossal, weathered human skull rising from dark waters. The skull opens like a base, supporting a massive, transparent glass sphere. Within the sphere stands an intricate, luminous tree, composed of twisted golden branches and roots, with a single trunk. Dozens of tiny, warm, glowing spheres are embedded among the branches and foliage, adorned with numerous bronze-like metallic leaves. The roots extend from the bottom of the sphere's interior, winding around a small ladder on the trunk. In the lower left of the sphere's interior, a semi-transparent seated human figure is depicted, lost in thought, knees bent, head resting on one hand, the other holding a luminous flower or crystal blossom. In the lower right of the sphere's interior, a miniature, tower-like structure with a delicate golden frame is included. Surrounding the sphere and in the background is a magnificent network of branches, adorned with crystal decorations, multifaceted gems, suspended water droplets, circular glass forms, and metallic leaves, the overall composition symmetrical and organic. The skull is highly realistic, featuring deep-set eye sockets, detailed teeth, cracked bone texture, and fine copper pipes and circuits extending from both sides near the temples. Within the right eye socket, a luminous, mechanical, celestial-like light source structure is displayed. The entire composition is placed in a dreamlike seascape at dusk, with a background of calm, reflecting water, distant rocky spires, soft clouds, and a sky transitioning from blue to gold. Utilizing cinematic lighting, high contrast, sharp focus, and a mysterious atmosphere, combined with luxurious gold and bronze filigree work and crystal transparency, the color palette employs deep cyan, midnight blue, ivory, warm amber, and metallic gold. It creates a symbolic metacognitive sense—a consciousness imprisoned in death—blending dark surrealism, Baroque decoration, and ethereal science fiction fantasy.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅超现实、极致细节的奇幻插画，画面中心是一个巨大的风化人类头骨，从深色水域中升起。头骨顶部像底座一样打开，支撑着一个巨大的透明玻璃球。球体内矗立着一棵错综复杂的发光树，由扭曲的金色枝干和根系组成，拥有 1 根主干，枝叶间嵌入了数十个微小的温暖发光球体，并点缀着许多青铜质感的金属叶片。根系在球体内部底部蔓延，并缠绕在树干上的一架小型梯子上。在球体内部左下方，描绘 1 个半透明的坐姿人形，姿态沉思，双膝蜷缩，头部靠在一只手上，另一只手拿着一朵发光的小花或水晶花。在球体内部右下方，包含 1 座由精致金框架构成的微型建筑塔状结构。球体周围和背景是华丽的树枝网络，挂着水晶装饰、多面宝石、悬浮的水滴、圆形玻璃形态和金属叶片，整体布局对称且有机。头骨高度写实，具有深邃的眼眶、细致的牙齿、开裂的骨骼纹理，以及从太阳穴附近两侧延伸出的精细铜管和电路。在头骨的右眼眶内，展示 1 个发光的机械式天体仪状光源结构。将整个构图置于黄昏时分的梦幻海景中，背景是平静的反射水面、远处的岩石尖塔、柔和的云层以及从蓝色过渡到金色的天空。采用电影级光效、高对比度、清晰对焦、神秘氛围，结合奢华的黄金与青铜花丝工艺、水晶透明度，色调采用深青色、午夜蓝、象牙骨色、暖琥珀色和金属金色。营造出一种象征性的元认知感，即禁锢在死亡之中的意识，融合了黑暗超现实主义、巴洛克装饰和空灵的科幻奇幻风格。

templates.title: Ancient Scroll Google DeepMind Vision

titleLocalized.zh: Ancient Scroll Google DeepMind Vision

templates.prompt: A dark brown ancient Chinese scroll painting has been reimagined as a visionary propaganda scene. At the center stands a scholar-like figure in a flowing blue-grey Hanfu (traditional Han Chinese clothing) adorned with ornate trim, lecturing to eight followers, primarily shown from behind, in the foreground. The sage's face is deliberately blurred with a solid-color rectangle, as are the faces of three other members of the crowd. The central figure makes a lecturing gesture with one hand and holds a luminous, geometrically multifaceted crystal in the other. Behind him hangs a large banner or plaque displaying the Google DeepMind logo and the words "Google DeepMind." The background is a richly detailed traditional landscape, including layered mountains, clouds, trees, rock formations, and a pagoda on the right. In the upper right corner, vertical Chinese calligraphy titled "Demis Vision" is added, followed by several lines of elegant classical text, a smaller vertical signature, and two red seals. Employing aged paper textures, soft brown inks, faded mineral pigments, delicate lines, and compositions reminiscent of traditional Chinese hanging scrolls or literati paintings, the work subtly incorporates modern AI symbolism within a sense of temporal displacement. The overall atmosphere is solemn, sacred, intellectual, and ironic, seamlessly blending traditional East Asian art with corporate AI graphics.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅深褐色调的中国古代卷轴画，被重新构想为具有愿景感的宣传风格场景。画面中央站着一位学者模样的长袍人物，造型如同帝国圣贤或哲学家，身着饰有华丽镶边的飘逸蓝灰色汉服，正对着前景中 8 位主要以背影示人的追随者讲学。圣贤的面部被刻意用一个纯色矩形模糊处理，人群中也有 3 位成员的面部呈现同样的矩形模糊。中央人物一手做出教导的手势，另一只手托着一颗发光的几何多面体水晶。在他身后是一面巨大的悬挂横幅或牌匾，上面展示着 Google DeepMind 的标志和“Google DeepMind”字样。背景是细节丰富的传统山水景观，包含层峦叠嶂、云雾、树木、岩石构造以及右侧的一座宝塔。在右上侧，加入以“德米斯願景圖”为标题的竖排中文书法，随后是几列优雅的古典风格文字，外加一行较小的竖排签名和 2 枚红色印章。采用陈旧的纸张纹理、柔和的棕色墨水、褪色的矿物颜料、细腻的线条，以及历史悠久的中国挂轴或文人画构图，但融入了微妙的时代错位现代 AI 象征意义。整体氛围庄重、神圣、知性且具有讽刺意味，将东亚传统艺术与企业 AI 图像学融为一体。

templates.title: Ancient Scholars AI Security Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 古代学者 AI 安全海报

templates.prompt: A delicate sepia-toned illustration, blending the style of ancient Chinese scholar portraits with modern AI branding elements, is presented on aged parchment with a distinct texture and ink-wash feel. At the center is a half-length portrait of a Democritus-inspired male scholar with curly hair, seated behind a wooden table in a layered traditional robe in soft blue-grey and brown hues, with delicate trim. His face is obscured by a flat rectangle in a brownish-skin tone, creating a sense of anonymity or censorship. He holds a brush vertically in his right hand, while his left hand rests flat on the table. In the upper right of the image is the Claude logo, comprising a rust-orange sunburst emblem and the word "Claude" in dark serif font. In the upper left corner, a large vertical Chinese title, "Demistu," is added, alongside a smaller vertical Chinese calligraphy text: "Using language as a medium, understanding as a vessel, aiding insight, promoting collaboration, benefiting humanity, ensuring safety and trustworthiness, and leading to a better future." A smaller vertical signature, "Written in the Spring of Jia Chen Year," is added on the far left, with two red seals below. The background displays a classical Chinese landscape painting, featuring distant mountains, a pavilion on a cliff, and clouds; the upper right and right edges are adorned with lush bamboo leaves, while the lower left corner features dark pine branches. A wooden table occupies the lower third of the image, on which are arranged eight different items: on the left is a pen holder with four calligraphy brushes, a stack of four bound books with the titles "Introduction to Artificial Intelligence," "Principles of Machine Learning," "Responsible AI," and "Alignment and Values" written on their spines; in the center left is an inkstone or ink dish; in the center is a parchment diagram; in the lower left corner is a small, dark square seal engraved with Chinese characters; on the right is a framed sign; and in the lower right corner is a scroll. The tabletop surface displays a clear wood grain. The central parchment diagram should show a circular node labeled "AI Safety," connecting to six surrounding nodes labeled "Accuracy," "Reliability," "Benefit," "Transparency," "Alignment," and "Privacy," surrounded by delicate cloud patterns. The framed sign on the right should be titled "AI Safety Principles" and list four key points in Chinese: "Reduce Catastrophic Risks," "Respect Human Values," "Ensure System Controllability," and "Promote Long-Term Well-being." The scroll in the lower right corner should display the inscription "Creating the future with caution." It employs a balanced composition, a scholarly, serene atmosphere, highly refined ink lines, subtle watercolor washes, antique museum printing aesthetics, and a restrained color palette comprised of parchment tan, dark brown, faded blue, and soft charcoal gray. The overall impression should be that of an informative tribute poster that blends classical East Asian literati painting, philosophical portraiture, and contemporary AI security themes.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张精致的棕褐色调插画，风格融合了中国古代学者肖像与现代 AI 品牌元素，呈现于带有明显纹理和水墨质感的陈旧羊皮纸上。画面中央是一位受德谟克利特启发的卷发男性学者半身像，他坐在木桌后，身着层次分明的传统长袍，色调为柔和的蓝灰色与棕色，并带有精致的镶边。他的面部被一块棕色皮肤色调的扁平矩形遮挡，营造出一种匿名或被审查的视觉效果。他右手垂直握着一支毛笔，左手平放在桌面上。在画面中上部偏右处，放置 Claude 标志，包含一个铁锈橙色的太阳光芒徽章，以及深色衬线字体的“Claude”字样。在左上角，添加一个巨大的竖排中文标题“德米斯图”，旁边配有一列较小的竖排中文书法文字：“以语言为媒，理解为舟，助人洞见，推动协作，造福人类，安全可信，通往更美好的未来。”在最左侧添加一行较小的竖排落款“甲辰春写”，下方盖有两枚红色印章。背景展示了一幅中国古典山水画，包含远山、悬崖上的小亭、云雾，右上角和右侧边缘由茂密的竹叶点缀，左下角则有深色的松枝。

木桌占据了画面的下三分之一，桌上摆放着 8 组不同的物品：左侧有一个插着 4 支毛笔的笔筒，一叠 4 本装订成册的书籍，书脊上分别写着“人工智能概论”、“机器学习原理”、“负责任的 AI”和“对齐与价值观”，左中位置有一个砚台或墨碟，中央有一张羊皮纸图表，左下角有一个刻有汉字的小型深色方块印章，右侧有一个带框的告示牌，右下角有一个卷轴，桌面表面呈现出清晰的木纹。中央的羊皮纸图表应显示一个标有“AI 安全 Safety”的圆形节点，连接着周围 6 个分别标有“准确”、“可靠”、“有益”、“透明”、“对齐”和“隐私”的节点，图表周围环绕着精致的云纹。右侧的带框告示牌应以“AI 安全原则”为标题，并列出 4 条中文要点：“减少灾难性风险”、“尊重人类价值观”、“确保系统可控”和“促进长远福祉”。右下角的卷轴应展示“以谨慎之心 创造未来”字样。

采用均衡的构图、学者般沉静的氛围、高度精细的墨线、微妙的水彩渲染、古董博物馆印刷美学，以及由羊皮纸棕褐色、墨棕色、褪色蓝和柔和炭灰色组成的克制色调。整体感觉应是一张融合了东亚古典文人画、哲学肖像画和当代 AI 安全主题的知识性致敬海报。

templates.title: Ancient Chinese scholars integrating XAI themes

titleLocalized.zh: 融合 XAI 主题的中国古代学者

templates.prompt: A delicate Chinese ink-wash portrait, painted on aged parchment, is composed in the style of a classical literati hanging scroll, its color palette a soft blend of dark brown, tan, charcoal gray, and faded indigo. At the center stands a scholar, clad in flowing dark blue-black Hanfu, adorned with exquisite gold patterns and wide beige inner sleeves, standing upright with a solemn expression. His face is deliberately obscured by a rectangular, blurred area; his hair is jet black and wavy, neatly combed. He holds a traditional thread-bound book, its cover bearing the prominent Latin letters "XAI" vertically, below which are four columns of Chinese characters. His other hand rests on an ornate armillary sphere on a carved base in the lower left. The background is a magnificent landscape, featuring a mountain range, layered clouds, rugged peaks, and drifting clouds, rendered with masterful brushstrokes. In the upper right sky area, a striking modern "XAI" logo is placed, with a stylized emblem above the letters; on the far right, a slender rocket is depicted lifting off from a launch tower, smoke billowing into the clouds, blending futuristic aerospace imagery into a classical scene. In the upper left, a set of vertically arranged black ink calligraphy titles is added, along with a smaller vertical signature and two red seals below. The overall effect aims to merge portraits of ancient Chinese scholars with space-age technology and AI symbolism, rich in detail, elegantly balanced, and slightly ironic, presenting the texture of antique paper and the composition of a museum-quality scroll painting.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅精致的中国水墨风格肖像，绘制于陈旧的羊皮纸上，构图仿照古典文人挂轴，色调为柔和的深褐色、棕褐色、炭灰色和褪色的靛蓝色。画面中央站立着一位学者，身着飘逸的深蓝黑色汉服，饰有精致的金色纹样和宽大的米色内袖，正面站姿，神态庄重。他的面部被一个矩形模糊块刻意遮挡，头发乌黑且呈波浪状，梳理得整整齐齐。他怀中抱着一本线装传统书籍，封面垂直印有醒目的拉丁字母“XAI”，下方配有 4 列中文字符。他的另一只手搁在左下方雕花底座上的华丽浑天仪上。背景是宏伟的山水景观，包含 1 座山脉、层叠的云雾、嶙峋的山峰和漂浮的云朵，以大师级的细腻笔触呈现。在右上方的天空区域，放置 1 个醒目的现代“XAI”标志，字母上方带有风格化的徽标；在最右侧，包含 1 枚细长的火箭正从发射塔旁升空，烟雾缭绕至云间，将未来感的航空航天意象融入古典场景中。在左上方，添加 1 组垂直排列的黑色水墨书法标题，外加 1 行较小的垂直签名和下方的 2 枚红色印章。整体效果旨在将中国古代学者肖像与太空时代科技及 AI 象征意义融合，细节丰富、优雅平衡且略带讽刺意味，呈现出古董纸张的质感和博物馆级卷轴画的构图。

templates.title: Surreal Moon Rider

titleLocalized.zh: 超现实月球骑手

templates.prompt: A surreal black and white photograph, depicting a horse{argument name="horse color" default="white"} A horse rides on the back of an astronaut on the moon. He is dressed in bulky clothing.{argument name="spacesuit color" default="white"} An astronaut in an EVA spacesuit lies prone on all fours on the dusty lunar surface, serving as his mount. A horse, in a human-like riding posture, stands upright on the astronaut's back, its forelegs raised and bent, as if for balance. The horse is equipped with a saddle and reins, which dangle towards the astronaut. The astronaut's helmet features a dark, reflective visor, and he is slightly turned to the right, his hands and knees pressed into the lunar soil. The background is a desolate lunar landscape, scattered with rocks and low hills, under a pitch-black sky devoid of stars. Strong directional lighting creates sharp shadows and high contrast, mimicking the style of Apollo-era lunar documentary photography. Placing these two subjects at the center of the mid-ground composition conveys a realistic texture, a dry, absurd humor, photorealistic detail, and a vintage monochrome film look.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超现实的黑白照片，画面中一匹 {argument name="horse color" default="white"} 的马骑在月球上的一名宇航员背上。身穿笨重 {argument name="spacesuit color" default="white"} EVA 宇航服的宇航员四肢着地趴在布满尘埃的月球表面，充当坐骑，而马则以类似人类的骑姿直立在宇航员背上，前腿抬起并弯曲，仿佛在保持平衡。马身上配有马鞍和缰绳，缰绳垂向宇航员。宇航员的头盔带有深色反光面罩，人物略微朝右，手膝压在月壤中。背景是荒凉的月球地形，散布着岩石和低矮的丘陵，天空漆黑一片，看不见星星。强烈的定向光营造出清晰的阴影和高对比度，模仿了阿波罗时代的月球纪实摄影风格。将这对主体置于中景构图的中心，呈现逼真的质感、冷幽默的荒诞感、照片级的细节以及复古单色胶片外观。

titleLocalized.zh: 粉色可爱偶像口红肖像

templates.prompt: A highly detailed, glossy portrait of an anime idol, presented in a vertical composition, showcasing a cute half-body portrait of a young girl, exhibiting a dreamy, adorable pink aesthetic. She possesses {argument name="hair color" default="Soft pink"} Her hair was styled in a super long and voluminous high ponytail, with soft bangs and flowing curls, decorated with multiple small heart-shaped hair clips and crisscrossing hairpins. Her eyes were big and bright, displaying a vivid {argument name="eye color" default="Emerald"} The color, with star-like highlights, long eyelashes, and a slightly dewy sheen. She had soft blush and small, moist lips, applied with {argument name="lipstick color" default="Bright pink"} Her expression is full of love as she applies the lipstick, gently holding the tube to her lips with both hands. She wears a black and pink Gothic Lolita idol dress adorned with lace, ribbons, bows, hearts, and a shimmering texture. She also wears a black lace bow headband with a pink gemstone heart, three hair accessories visible in her bangs, a pair of heart-shaped pendant earrings, and a black choker with small heart pendants. The character is surrounded by a glowing, glittery, candy-pink background, filled with light spots, glitter, soft neon effects, and an idol fan atmosphere. Add 5 around the character A glowing hand-drawn Japanese love bubble text, the content of which is: "かわいすぎてごめん...♡", "PUSH してくれてありがとうっ♡", "ずーっとだいすきっ♡", "世界でいちばんのPUSHしになってね…♡" and "ずっと一丝だよ? RESTRAINT...♡". Include a small decorative photo card or poster of the same girl in the upper right corner background. Super exquisite illustrations, rich glitter, romantic light and shadow, glossy highlights, complex lace details, soft focus background, saturated pink tones, and cute idol poster texture.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度精细的亮面动漫偶像肖像，采用竖构图，展示了一位可爱的少女半身像，呈现出梦幻般的粉色可爱美学。她拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="柔和粉色"} 的头发，梳着超长且蓬松的高马尾，配有柔软的刘海和飘逸的卷发丝，并装饰着多个小爱心发夹和交叉发卡。她的眼睛又大又闪亮，呈现生动的 {argument name="eye color" default="祖母绿"} 色，带有星状高光、长睫毛和微微湿润的光泽。她有着柔和的腮红、娇小水润的双唇，在涂抹 {argument name="lipstick color" default="亮粉色"} 口红时表情充满爱意，双手轻柔地将口红管举在嘴边。她身穿一件带有蕾丝、丝带、蝴蝶结、爱心装饰和闪亮质感的黑粉色哥特洛丽塔偶像裙，佩戴 1 个带有粉色宝石爱心的黑色蕾丝蝴蝶结发箍、刘海上可见 3 个发饰、1 对心形吊坠耳环以及 1 条带有小爱心吊坠的黑色颈圈。角色周围环绕着发光的、充满闪粉的糖果粉色背景，布满光斑、闪光、柔和的霓虹灯效果和偶像粉丝氛围。在角色周围添加 5 个发光的手绘日文爱心气泡文字，内容为：“かわいすぎてごめん…♡”、“推してくれてありがとうっ♡”、“ずーっとだいすきっ♡”、“世界でいちばんの推しになってね…♡”以及“ずっと一緒だよ？約束ね…♡”。在右上角背景中包含一张同一女孩的小型装饰照片卡或海报。超精致插画，浓郁闪光，浪漫光影，亮面高光，复杂的蕾丝细节，柔焦背景，饱和的粉色调，可爱的偶像海报质感。

templates.title: Malaysia Tourism Poster 2026

titleLocalized.zh: 2026 年马来西亚旅游海报

templates.prompt: A for{argument name="destination" default="Malaysia"} This luxurious travel poster, designed in a vertical art style, features a clean ivory-white textured background with delicate embossed decorative patterns. The composition revolves around a flowing red and gold batik ribbon, spiraling diagonally across the page to form an elegant S-curve, cleverly connecting a dreamlike collage of landmarks, cultural elements, and natural landscapes. In the upper left corner, warm golden sunlight bathes misty tropical mountains and rainforests, with waterfalls cascading down. Beside lush palm trees, a giant hornbill perches among hibiscus and white tropical flowers. Above, in the center, the Kuala Lumpur skyline rises from the mist, with the Petronas Twin Towers as the main feature, and the KL Tower and several modern skyscrapers faintly visible. Near the upper right corner, a brightly colored traditional moon kite (Wau kite) floats, standing out against the white background. To the left center is a magnificent mosque nestled among palm trees and smoke, boasting multiple domes and minarets. The right side features the historic Sultan Abdul Samad Building, showcasing its bronze dome and clock tower. The lower left depicts a red and silver elevated train traversing the city. At the bottom center, an ornate Chinatown archway bearing the inscription "Jalan Petaling" is displayed, adorned with red lanterns and bustling pedestrians. The lower right depicts the Batu Caves area, including a towering golden Mulugan statue and a steep, rainbow-colored staircase leading to a limestone cliff, surrounded by crowds. The lower right corner features a landscaped city park with a turquoise lake and fountain. Purple orchids and tropical flowers are interspersed throughout the ribbons and foreground. The far right corner shows a traditional dancer in red and gold attire, twirling the end of a ribbon. The entire collage should present a bright, highly detailed, grand, and celebratory atmosphere, combining realistic architecture with a painterly travel poster style, complemented by soft clouds, atmospheric haze, and luminous highlights. Add elegant poster typography to the lower left: the main title is {argument name="headline text" default="VISIT MALAYSIA 2026"} Smaller location rows are displayed as{argument name="location text" default="KUALA LUMPUR"} The blue handwritten tourism slogan is{argument name="tagline" default="Malaysia Truly Asia"} Below is a neat little subtitle:{argument name="subheading" default="Where Diversity Converges\nKuala Lumpur, City of Wonders\nThe Heart of Asia"} Employing a sophisticated color scheme of gold, deep red, ivory, emerald green, sky blue, and tropical green, the design presents exquisite editorial-level composition and high-end destination brand aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh: 一款为 {argument name="destination" default="马来西亚"} 设计的奢华旅游海报，采用竖版艺术旅行广告风格，背景为干净的象牙白纹理，并带有精致的浮雕装饰图案。画面构图围绕一条飘逸的红金相间蜡染丝带展开，丝带呈对角线螺旋贯穿页面，形成优雅的 S 型曲线，巧妙地串联起如梦似幻的地标、文化与自然景观拼贴。左上角，温暖的金色晨曦洒在云雾缭绕的热带山脉和雨林之上，瀑布飞流直下，茂密的棕榈树旁，一只巨大的犀鸟栖息在木槿花和白色热带花卉间。上方中央，吉隆坡天际线在薄雾中升起，以双峰塔（Petronas Twin Towers）为主体，隐约可见吉隆坡塔（KL Tower）及多座现代摩天大楼。右上角附近漂浮着 1 只色彩斑斓的传统月亮风筝（Wau kite），在留白的背景中格外醒目。中左侧包含 1 座坐落在棕榈树与烟雾中的宏伟清真寺，拥有多个圆顶和尖塔。中右侧包含历史悠久的苏丹阿都沙末大厦（Sultan Abdul Samad Building），展现其铜制圆顶与钟楼。左下方包含 1 列穿行于城市中的红银相间高架列车。底部中央展示 1 座装饰华丽的唐人街牌坊，标有“Jalan Petaling”字样，点缀着红灯笼和熙熙攘攘的行人。右下方描绘了黑风洞（Batu Caves）区域，包括 1 座高耸的金色姆鲁干神像和 1 条通往石灰岩悬崖的陡峭彩虹阶梯，周围人群攒动。右下角点缀着 1 座景观城市公园，配有绿松石色的湖泊与喷泉。紫色兰花和热带花卉穿插在丝带与前景的多处。最右下角展示 1 位身着红金服饰的传统舞者，正舞动着丝带的末端。整幅拼贴画应呈现出明亮、超细节、宏伟且充满庆典感的氛围，将写实建筑与绘画感旅行海报风格相结合，辅以柔和的云雾、大气层薄雾和发光高光。左下方添加优雅的海报排版：主标题为 {argument name="headline text" default="VISIT MALAYSIA 2026"}，较小的地点行显示为 {argument name="location text" default="KUALA LUMPUR"}，蓝色的手写体旅游标语为 {argument name="tagline" default="Malaysia Truly Asia"}，下方附带一行精致的小副标题：{argument name="subheading" default="Where Diversity Converges\nKuala Lumpur, City of Wonders\nThe Heart of Asia"}。采用金色、深红、象牙白、祖母绿、天蓝和热带绿的高端配色方案，呈现出精美的编辑级构图与高端目的地品牌美学。

templates.title: Retro Chinese style SpaceX promotional poster

titleLocalized.zh: 复古中国风 SpaceX 宣传海报

templates.prompt: A retro socialist propaganda poster in the style of mid-20th-century China, printed on old paper with a warm brown hue, possessing an aged texture, faded ink, and slightly worn edges. The composition is vertical and heroic. The right half of the poster shows a half-length portrait of a male worker or revolutionary, wearing a dark hat and a dark practical jacket, his face slightly turned to the left, his expression resolute and determined. In the center left, a white reusable rocket is rising, its engine spewing bright flames, symbolizing the yearning for technological progress; the word "SPACEX" is vertically printed on the rocket, and landing gear is visible at the base. Behind the rocket, dramatic cream-colored radiating rays spread outwards against a soft blue background. In the lower left, a group of factory workers or citizens (six in total) are depicted cheering, waving and celebrating, with a large red flag waving beside them. Subtle industrial city elements and the silhouette of a launch tower are added behind the crowd. At the bottom, a large text area is reserved, with two lines of striking red Chinese font that read: "Recover rockets today, build interstellar homes tomorrow!" The poster adopts a screen-printed style, possessing a painterly realism. The color palette is limited to gray-blue, cream, brick red, and dark olive, presenting a strong ideological poster composition, an atmosphere of victory, and a retro-futuristic symbolism of the space race.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张 20 世纪中叶中国风格的复古社会主义宣传海报，印在带有暖棕褐色调的旧纸张上，具有做旧质感、褪色的油墨和略微磨损的边缘。构图呈垂直且具有英雄主义色彩。海报右半部分展示了一位男性工人或革命者的半身肖像，他戴着深色帽子，穿着深色实用夹克，面部略微向左，表情坚毅果敢。左中位置，一枚白色的可回收火箭正向上升起，引擎喷射出明亮的火焰，象征着对技术进步的向往；火箭箭身上垂直印有“SPACEX”字样，底部可见着陆支架。火箭后方，戏剧性的奶油色放射状光芒在柔和的蓝色背景上向四周扩散。左下方描绘了一群正在欢呼的工厂工人或市民（共 6 人），他们身穿蓝灰色制服，挥手庆祝，身旁飘扬着一面巨大的红旗。在人群后方加入淡淡的工业城市元素和发射塔剪影。底部预留一个宽大的文字区域，用两行醒目的红色大号中文字体写着：“今天回收火箭，明天建设星际家园！”。采用丝网印刷海报风格，具有绘画般的写实感，色调限于灰蓝色、奶油色、砖红色和深橄榄色，呈现出强烈的意识形态海报构图、胜利的氛围以及复古未来主义的太空竞赛象征意义。

templates.title: Epic Senna vs. Prost Gladiator Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 史诗级 Senna 对决 Prost 角斗士海报

templates.prompt: An epic, cinematic poster in deep gold and bronze tones blends the style of mythological gladiator movie posters with retro Formula 1 elements. The upper half features mirrored profile portraits of two legendary rivals: the left inspired by Ayrton Senna, and the right by Alain Prost. Both are depicted as valiant Roman gladiators, clad in weathered bronze armor, dramatic shoulder armor, and capes representing their respective racing colors. The left figure is accented with green, yellow, and blue, while the right figure features blue, white, and red. Their faces are mostly in shadow, illuminated by strong backlighting piercing through storm clouds, creating a solemn and grand atmosphere. Behind each driver hangs two vertical flags: the left flag is dark green with a large gold "S," the words "SENNA," "#12," and a handwritten signature; the right flag is dark blue with a large gold "P," the words "PROST," "#1," and a handwritten signature. At the top center, the words "DEUX LÉGENDES. UN SEUL TRÔNE." are elegantly written in serif French, below which is a small gold F1 logo and a laurel wreath. In the central sky, two lines of stacked French text are added: "RIVAUX SUR LA PISTE." and "LÉGENDES POUR TOUJOURS." The main title appears in a large metallic serif font in the center of the poster:{argument name="headline text" default="SENNA vs PROST"} The title "vs" is separated by a sword-shaped vertical separator. The subtitle below reads "LE COMBAT ULTIME DE LA F1" in French. The lower half depicts a magnificent Roman Colosseum, its stands packed, flags fluttering, arches towering, dust and smoke billowing, dramatic perspective lines converging at the center. A huge victory banner stands in the very center of the arena, bearing the words "VICTOIRE GLOIRE HONNEUR" in gold. In the foreground, two late 1980s F1 cars race towards the audience across the dusty arena. The car on the left, associated with Senna, features a red and white Marlboro-style livery, the Shell logo, the number 12 on the nose, and a yellow helmet on the driver. The car on the right, associated with Prost, also features a red and white Marlboro-style livery, the Shell logo, the number 1 on the nose, and a white helmet on the driver. At the very bottom, the number "1988" is added. "1989. 1990." Below this is written "L'HISTOIRE S'ÉCRIT À PLUS DE 300 KM/H." The last line contains a small decorative laurel wreath. The design features ultra-fine textures, dramatic storm clouds, crepuscular rays, swirling dust, strong contrasts, symmetrical composition, exquisitely beautiful poster design, heroic grandeur, and a timeless, legendary atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张史诗般的电影感海报，采用深金铜色调，融合了神话角斗士电影海报风格与复古一级方程式赛车（Formula 1）元素。海报上半部分为两位传奇宿敌的镜像侧脸半身像，左侧灵感源自 Ayrton Senna，右侧灵感源自 Alain Prost，两人均被描绘为英勇的罗马角斗士，身着历经风霜的青铜盔甲，佩戴戏剧性的肩甲，并披着代表各自赛车颜色的斗篷。左侧人物带有绿、黄、蓝点缀，右侧人物带有蓝、白、红点缀。他们的面部大多处于阴影中，被穿过风暴云层的强烈背光照亮，营造出庄严而宏伟的氛围。每位车手身后各悬挂 1 面垂直旗帜，共 2 面：左侧旗帜为深绿色，印有巨大的金色“S”、文字“SENNA”、“#12”以及手写签名；右侧旗帜为深蓝色，印有巨大的金色“P”、文字“PROST”、“#1”以及手写签名。顶部中央位置，用优雅的衬线法文书写“DEUX LÉGENDES. UN SEUL TRÔNE.”，下方配有小型金色 F1 标志和月桂花环图案。在中央天空中，添加 2 行堆叠的法文：“RIVAUX SUR LA PISTE.”和“LÉGENDES POUR TOUJOURS.”。海报中部以巨大的金属衬线字体呈现主标题：“{argument name="headline text" default="SENNA vs PROST"}”，中间使用剑形垂直分隔符隔开“vs”。下方副标题为法文“LE COMBAT ULTIME DE LA F1”。下半部分展示了一座宏伟的罗马斗兽场，观众席座无虚席，旗帜飘扬，拱门林立，尘土与烟雾弥漫，戏剧性的透视线条汇聚于中心。竞技场正中央矗立着 1 面巨大的胜利旗帜，上面用金色写着“VICTOIRE GLOIRE HONNEUR”。前景中，2 辆 20 世纪 80 年代末的 F1 赛车正冲向观众，在尘土飞扬的竞技场地面上疾驰。左侧赛车与 Senna 相关，采用红白相间的 Marlboro 风格涂装，带有 Shell 品牌标识，车鼻印有数字 12，车手佩戴黄色头盔。右侧赛车与 Prost 相关，采用同样的红白相间 Marlboro 风格涂装，带有 Shell 品牌标识，车鼻印有数字 1，车手佩戴白色头盔。最底部添加一行“1988. 1989. 1990.”，下方写着“L’HISTOIRE S’ÉCRIT À PLUS DE 300 KM/H.”。最后一行下方包含一个小巧的装饰性月桂花环。采用超精细纹理、戏剧性的风暴云、耶稣光、飞扬的尘土、强烈的对比度、对称构图、极致精美的海报设计、英雄般的宏大比例以及永恒的传奇氛围。

templates.title: Disco Ball Chameleon

titleLocalized.zh: 迪斯科球变色龙

templates.prompt: A highly polished, studio-quality photograph featuring a creature entirely covered in tiny mirrored disco ball tiles.{argument name="animal" default="chameleon"} It perches atop a giant, mirrored disco sphere. Facing right, it has a curled tail, four clearly visible legs gripping the sphere, a prominent crest on its head, round, glossy black eyes, and a row of delicate scales along its jawline. The mosaic tiles should reflect highlights of silver, pale blue, and cool white, creating a shimmering mirror effect on the animal and sphere's surfaces. A soft, captivating disco atmosphere is employed, paired with a smooth, cyan-blue gradient background with a shallow depth of field, scattered with circular bokeh. Soft, diffused light creates bright flashes on the mirrored surface; the ultra-fine texture, realistic materials, and centered composition present an elegant and fantastical luxurious aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具动感的竖版高奇幻动漫插画，展现了 4 位英雄角色悬浮在充满发光云层、蓝色水晶碎片和漂浮青色羽毛的暴风雨天空中。画面中心，一位灵感源自北欧神祇的高大男性装甲战士作为核心焦点，他留着棕色长发，头戴金青色尖角头盔，深绿色与蓝色的披风在风中飘扬，身着华丽的黑、青、金三色铠甲，胸口敞开露出肌肉，胸前有一个发光的亮青色狼形纹章。他一只手向上举向头顶上方发光的圆形魔法符文，另一只手握着一把长矛，矛头为蓝色水晶材质。在他周围，有 3 只狐狸与狼形态的伙伴生物，身着配套的冰晶铠甲。画面下方前景处，1 只巨大的凶猛橙色狼正张嘴咆哮着冲向观众，巨大的爪子伸出，拥有白色鬃毛、蓝色水晶头盔、背部和腿部的蓝金装甲板，以及一条巨大的蓬松尾巴。左上方，1 只矫健的橙色狐狸战士正身穿棱角分明的蓝色水晶铠甲，背负巨大的多面蓝色翅膀在半空中向前跃起，姿态如同快速的空中突击者。右侧，1 只可爱的小型 Q 版狐狸伙伴正快乐地漂浮着，有着大大的蓝眼睛、灿烂的笑容，身穿带有发光青色纹路的蓝色短袍，头戴水晶王冠。使用鲜艳饱和的色彩，特别是电光青、蓝宝石色、青色、金色和橙色。氛围史诗、神圣且充满魔法感，具有强烈的动感线条、戏剧性的透视缩短、发光高光、细腻的毛发与羽毛质感、精致的水晶纹理，以及电影级奇幻集换式卡牌插画的品质。

templates.prompt: A realistic front page of a Spanish sports newspaper, adopting the style of a mainstream daily newspaper, with a simple white background and striking red and black typography, showcasing the editorial layout and high-resolution paper scan quality. At the very top, a large red masthead reads {argument name="newspaper name" default="MARCA"} The price is printed in small black text in the upper right corner, almost spanning the entire width of the page.{argument name="price" default="2,50€"} Below the masthead is a small line of black publication details, including Tuesday's date, website, year, and issue number. The main title, occupying most of the page on the left, is in large, bold, compressed black capital letters, divided into two lines:{argument name="main headline" default="ARBELOA, DESTITUIDO"} Below is a red subheading in bold, stating that Real Madrid sacked their coach after 100 days in charge and are searching for a successor for the remainder of the season. A smaller line of black explanatory text below mentions that the decision was made after Champions League elimination and the loss of their La Liga lead. The main image occupies most of the lower left corner of the cover: a football coach in a dark blue suit, white shirt, and dark tie stands in a stadium with blue seats, one hand on his forehead, looking stressed or disappointed. The Bernabéu stadium environment is visible in the background, with "Real Madrid CF" written on the sidelines. At the bottom of the main image, a line of smaller text explains that the coach left the Bernabéu after learning of the decision. On the far left and at the bottom center are two narrow columns of black text, in the style of a Spanish newspaper. On the right is a vertical sidebar containing two secondary articles separated by a red dividing line. The top sidebar features a red tagline reading "NBA PLAYOFFS," with a bold black headline proclaiming the Lakers have forced a Game 7. It includes a rectangular photo of two basketball players, one of whom, wearing a purple #77 jersey, is dribbling against a Nuggets defender. A short caption below mentions Doncic's 42 points in Denver. The lower sidebar features another red tagline reading "TENIS · MUTUA MADRID OPEN," with a bold black headline about Alcaraz's dominant performance at Caja Mágica. It also includes a rectangular photo of a player in a light purple jersey hitting a forehand tennis ball against a bright blue background. Near the bottom right corner is a quotation box marked with large red quotation marks and bold black text, containing the following:{argument name="pull quote" default="Agradezco al club la oportunidad de mi vida"} The overall composition should present an authentic, dramatic sports front page feel: sharp typography, a rigorous newspaper grid, realistic news photography, heavy black headlines, red accents, and modern Spanish media design.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张逼真的西班牙体育报纸头版，采用主流日报的大报风格，白色背景简洁，搭配强烈的红黑排版，呈现编辑印刷布局及高分辨率的纸张扫描质感。在最上方，一个超大的红色报头写着 {argument name="newspaper name" default="MARCA"}，几乎横跨整个页面宽度，右上角印有黑色小字价格 {argument name="price" default="2,50€"}。报头下方是一行细小的黑色出版详情，包含周二日期、网址、年份和期号。左侧占据页面大部分空间的主标题采用巨大的粗体压缩黑色大写字母，分为两行：{argument name="main headline" default="ARBELOA, DESTITUIDO"}。下方是一个红色副标题，以粗体句式说明皇家马德里在教练执教 100 天后将其解雇，并正在寻找赛季末的继任者。下方一行较小的黑色解释性文字提到，该决定是在欧冠出局及西甲领先优势丧失后做出的。主图占据封面左下角的大部分区域：一位身着深蓝色西装、白衬衫、深色领带的足球教练站在蓝色座椅的体育场内，一只手摸着额头，神情压力巨大或失望，背景可见伯纳乌球场环境，场边护栏上写着 Real Madrid C. F.。在主图底部，一行小字说明教练在得知决定后离开伯纳乌。最左侧和中心底部是两列狭窄的黑色文章正文，采用西班牙报纸风格。右侧是一个垂直侧边栏，包含两篇由红色分割线隔开的次要报道。顶部侧边栏报道有一个红色栏目标签写着 NBA PLAYOFFS，粗体黑色标题写着湖人队将比赛拖入第七场，配有一张两名篮球运动员的矩形动作照片，其中一名身穿紫色 77 号球衣的湖人球员正持球对抗掘金队防守者，下方短说明提到东契奇在丹佛砍下 42 分。下方侧边栏报道有一个红色栏目标签写着 TENIS · MUTUA MADRID OPEN，粗体黑色标题关于阿尔卡拉斯在魔术盒球场（Caja Mágica）的统治级表现，并配有一张身穿浅紫色球衣的球员在明亮的蓝色背景下击出正手的矩形网球照片。在右下角附近，包含一个由大红色引号和粗体黑色文字标记的引语框，内容为 {argument name="pull quote" default="Agradezco al club la oportunidad de mi vida"}。整体构图应呈现出地道的戏剧性体育头版感：锐利的印刷字体、严谨的报纸网格、写实的新闻摄影、厚重的黑色标题块、红色点缀以及现代西班牙媒体设计。

templates.prompt: A satirical front page of a Spanish sports newspaper, designed like a tabloid cover, is full-page and entirely frontal, printed on slightly worn off-white newsprint with a subtle paper texture, faint stains, and a narrow black border. A bright yellow banner spans the top of the masthead, featuring a large red "SPORT" logo. The upper right corner contains a small promotional box with a picture of a football player and the Spanish text: "ENTREVISTA CUBARSÍ 'ESTOY PARA COSAS GRANDES'". Below the masthead is a long yellow bar with the bold black text "EXCLUSIVA MUNDIAL" and a small red lightning bolt icon. The main headline occupies the center of the page in large, compressed black capital letters, divided into two lines: "LAMILE FICHA POR LA PEÑA DEL BINGO". Below this is a black italic Spanish subheading: "El crack pide dorsal el 10 y bocadillo de calamares en el contrato". The main photo occupies the left-center and lower-middle sections of the page: a young football player, primarily shown from behind, wearing a blue and red striped Barcelona home jersey with the large yellow letters "LAMILE" and the number "10" printed on it, stands amidst a celebratory stadium scene filled with confetti, bright lights, and blurred images of fans and crowds. He holds or displays a giant bingo board with "BINGO" written at the top and "BINGO!" at the bottom. On the right, create a vertical sidebar containing four stacked content blocks: the first is a photo of a squid sandwich on a plate with the caption "El motivo del fichaje" (The motivator of the squid sandwich); the second is a red information box listing three humorous transfer facts in yellow and white text: "EDAD: muy joven" (Early Bird), "FICHAJE: 4 cartones" (Fish Sandwich), and "CLÁUSULA: una partida de parchís" (Park Sandwich); the third is a quote bar containing three stacked small items, each with a small portrait and a Spanish caption: "XAVI: 'No me lo esperaba, pero respeto'" (XAVI), "LAPORTA: 'Renegociaremos en el próximo bingo'" (LAPORTA: Renegociaremos en el próximo bingo') and "EL VESTUARIO: Le preparan línea y bingo de bienvenida" (Vestuary: The prepared línea y bingo de bienvenida); the fourth is a small racing teaser at the bottom, with driver images and the text "FÓRMULA 1 ALONSO SUEÑA CON EL PODIO EN" (FÓRMULA 1 ALONSO SUEÑA CON EL PODIO EN). "YEDA". Along the bottom strip are three small teaser panels: one featuring a female soccer player holding a trophy, captioned "CHAMPIONS FEMENINA LA REINA AITANA QUIERE OTRA CORONA"; one basketball panel featuring two Barcelona players, captioned "BÁSQUET EL BARÇA, A UN PAS DE LA FINAL FOUR"; and an F1 racing teaser panel integrated into the right edge. Tiny Spanish-language newspaper metadata, including issue number, date, and price, is added to the lower left of the masthead, such as "Nº 16.743 MIÉRCOLES 22 DE ABRIL DE 2026 2,00 EUROS". The overall style should be hyper-realistic print newspaper cover photography and typography, featuring authentic magazine layout, strong black headlines, saturated sports photo colors, a comedic transfer rumor parody tone, and a seamless and believable print design.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张设计成小报封面的讽刺风格西班牙体育报纸头版，全画幅且完全正面视角，印在略显陈旧的米白色新闻纸上，带有细腻的纸张纹理、淡淡的污渍和细窄的黑色边框。报头顶部横跨一条亮黄色横幅，印有巨大的红色“SPORT”标志。右上角包含 1 个小型采访推广框，内含一名足球运动员的头像，以及西班牙语文本块：“ENTREVISTA CUBARSÍ ‘ESTOY PARA COSAS GRANDES’”。在报头下方，添加一条带有粗体黑色文字“EXCLUSIVA MUNDIAL”的黄色长条，并配有一个红色小闪电图标。主标题以巨大的黑色压缩大写字母占据页面核心位置，分为 2 行：“LAMILE FICHA POR LA PEÑA DEL BINGO”。在其下方，添加斜体黑色西班牙语副标题：“El crack pide dorsal el 10 y bocadillo de calamares en el contrato”。主照片占据页面左中及中下部：一名年轻足球运动员背影为主，身穿蓝红条纹的巴塞罗那主场球衣，球衣上印有大号黄色字母“LAMILE”和数字“10”，站在充满纸屑、强光、模糊球迷及人群的庆祝球场场景中。他手持或展示着一张巨大的宾果游戏项目，顶部写有“BINGO”，底部写有“BINGO!”。在右侧，创建一个包含 4 个堆叠内容块的垂直侧边栏：第一部分是一张盘中鱿鱼三明治的照片，配文“El motivo del fichaje”；第二部分是一个红色信息框，列出 3 条幽默的转会事实，文字为黄色和白色，内容为：“EDAD: muy joven”、“FICHAJE: 4 cartones”以及“CLÁUSULA: una partida de parchís”；第三部分是一个引语栏，包含 3 个堆叠的小项目，每个项目都有一个小肖像和西班牙语说明：“XAVI: ‘No me lo esperaba, pero respeto’”、“LAPORTA: ‘Renegociaremos en el próximo bingo’”以及“EL VESTUARIO: Le preparan línea y bingo de bienvenida”；第四部分是底部的一个小型赛车预告，配有车手图像和文字“FÓRMULA 1 ALONSO SUEÑA CON EL PODIO EN YEDA”。沿底部长条，包含 3 个小型预告面板：1 名手持奖杯的女足运动员，配文“CHAMPIONS FEMENINA LA REINA AITANA QUIERE OTRA CORONA”；1 个篮球面板，包含两名巴萨球员，配文“BÁSQUET EL BARÇA, A UN PAS DE LA FINAL FOUR”；以及已整合在右边缘的 F1 赛车预告面板。在报头左下方添加微小的西班牙语报纸元数据，包括期号、日期和价格，例如“Nº 16.743 MIÉRCOLES 22 DE ABRIL DE 2026 2,00 EUROS”。整体风格应为超写实的印刷报纸封面摄影和编辑排版，具备地道的杂志排版、强烈的黑色标题、饱和的体育照片色彩、喜剧性的转会传闻恶搞基调，以及天衣无缝且可信的印刷设计。
