Keep the app UI clearly legible on the phone screen and place it in a realistic life scenario: a vineyard worker in the foreground holding a smartphone displaying the app, with rows of vineyards, mountains, and several workers working in natural light in the background. Design the entire page as a Spanish-language magazine cover with sophisticated agricultural business aesthetics, using green, cream, and earth tones. Add a prominent masthead at the top with the text "REVISTA CAMPO FUTURO," above which is a thin subheading bar containing three items separated by vertical lines: "Especial Viñas de Chile," "Innovación agrícola," and "Abril 2026," and add a subheading below the masthead: "Agricultura, innovación y gestión rural." Add a green tab on the left, “TECNOLOGÍA AGRÍCOLA,” and a bold, stacked main cover title: “La app con IA que está revolucionando el campo,” followed by a brief introduction on how Kimün replaces traditional notebooks and provides real-time management for vineyards and agricultural businesses. Add a circular badge mentioning a feature article on Kimün as a smart AI field notebook. Include two teaser images at the bottom: one is a close-up of a worker holding a phone in a vineyard, labeled “p.18” with explanations about field diagnostics and phone alerts; the other is a small scene of three people viewing the application together, labeled “p.24” with explanations about connected field teams, voice, recording, and instant costs. In the right sidebar, add three preview articles with icons and page numbers: one about bidding farewell to paper and ushering in a new era of smart field notebooks (p.30), one about achieving more efficient vineyard management through data-driven decision-making (p.36), and one about Water Resources Management 4.0 and smarter, more profitable irrigation (p.42). Add a footer with five category tags: “AGRICULTURA”, “FRUTALES”, “VIÑAS”, “GANADERÍA”, and “SUSTENTABILIDAD”, along with barcodes and prices. Make it look like a beautifully photographed magazine cover and editorial layout, rather than a flat application screenshot.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的移动应用屏幕参考图，将其转换为关于农业创新的高端杂志封面样机。保持手机屏幕上的应用 UI 清晰可辨，并将其置于真实的生活场景中：前景中一名葡萄园工人手持显示该应用的智能手机，背景为葡萄园行、山脉及几名在自然光下工作的工人。将整页设计为一份具有精致农业商业美感的西班牙语杂志封面，采用绿色、奶油色和大地色调。在顶部添加醒目的刊头，文字为“REVISTA CAMPO FUTURO”，上方有一条细长的副标题栏，包含 3 个由竖线分隔的项目：“Especial Viñas de Chile”、“Innovación agrícola”和“Abril 2026”，并在刊头下方添加一行副标题：“Agricultura, innovación y gestión rural”。在左侧添加一个绿色的版块标签“TECNOLOGÍA AGRÍCOLA”，以及粗体的堆叠式主封面标题：“La app con IA que está revolucionando el campo”，随后附上一段关于 Kimün 如何取代传统笔记本并为葡萄园及农业企业提供实时管理的简短介绍。添加一个圆形的标注徽章，提及关于 Kimün 作为智能 AI 田间笔记本的专题报道。包含 2 张底部的预告图片：一张是工人手持手机在葡萄园中的特写，标注“p.18”及关于田间诊断和手机警报的说明；另一张是 3 人共同查看应用的小型场景，标注“p.24”及关于互联田间团队、语音、记录和即时成本的说明。在右侧栏中，添加 3 个带有图标和页码的专题预告：一篇关于告别纸质化、开启智能田间笔记本新时代（p.30），一篇关于通过数据驱动决策实现更高效的葡萄园管理（p.36），以及一篇关于水资源管理 4.0 和更智能、更具盈利能力的灌溉（p.42）。添加一个包含 5 个类别标签的页脚条：“AGRICULTURA”、“FRUTALES”、“VIÑAS”、“GANADERÍA”、“SUSTENTABILIDAD”，并附上条形码和价格。使其看起来像是一张精美的杂志封面摄影作品和编辑排版，而非平面的应用截图。

templates.title: Minimalist Saint Augustine book cover

titleLocalized.zh: 极简主义圣奥古斯丁书籍封面

templates.prompt: A minimalist, classic book cover with a vertical composition, set against a warm ivory or parchment background. At the top center, the title is formatted in two lines in an elegant, large, dark navy blue serif font:{argument name="title text" default="La Ciudad de Dios"} Below this, leave ample space and center a small gold phi symbol. In the upper-middle area, draw a delicate, fine-lined gold illustration depicting a sturdy, circular heavenly city with eight clearly visible outer towers or gate structures, crenellated walls, and compact classical architecture within (including a central dome). From the center of the city's base, a soft, vertical beam of gold extends downwards. In the lower-middle area, draw classical ruins on the ground in deep navy blue fine lines: the Roman Colosseum on the left, a large Greek or Roman temple with a triangular pediment and long rows of columns on the right, with a broken, collapsed column, a small stone, and an arched ruin structure spanning the lower left. Maintain symmetry and openness in the composition, leaving ample white space to achieve a delicate editorial balance and create a subtle contrast between the golden heavenly imagery and the deep navy blue secular architecture. At the bottom center, place the author's name in a matching deep navy blue serif font.{argument name="author name" default="San Agustín de Hipona"} The design is simple yet sophisticated, imbued with a sacred philosophical aesthetic, devoid of extraneous text, heavy textures, or photographic elements.

promptLocalized.zh: 一款垂直构图的极简主义古典书籍封面，背景为温暖的象牙色或羊皮纸色。在顶部中央，以优雅的大号深海军蓝衬线字体分 2 行排版标题：{argument name="title text" default="La Ciudad de Dios"}。在其下方，留出宽裕的间距并居中放置一个小型金色 phi 符号。在中上区域，绘制一幅精致的细线条金色插图，描绘一座坚固的圆形天国之城，拥有 8 座清晰可见的外塔或城门结构、雉堞城墙以及内部紧凑的古典建筑（包括一座中央圆顶）。从这座城市的底部中央，向下延伸出一道柔和的垂直金色光束。在中下区域，用深海军蓝细线条绘制地上的古典遗迹：左侧为罗马斗兽场，右侧为一座带有三角形山花和长排立柱的大型希腊或罗马神庙，前方有一根断裂倒塌的立柱、一块小石块，以及横跨左下方的拱形遗迹结构。保持构图对称且通透，留出大量空白，实现精致的编辑平衡，并形成金色天国意象与深海军蓝世俗建筑之间的微妙对比。在底部中央，以匹配的深海军蓝衬线字体放置作者姓名：{argument name="author name" default="San Agustín de Hipona"}。简洁的高级文学设计，神圣的哲学美学，无额外文字，无厚重的纹理效果，无摄影元素。

templates.title: The City of God: Classical Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 《上帝之城》古典风格封面

templates.prompt: A minimalist and elegant retro book cover design, using warm ivory textured paper, suitable for {argument name="book title" default="La Ciudad de Dios"} The title is placed at the top center in a large, classic serif font in a deep navy blue, with meticulous spacing, exuding a literary feel. A gold eight-pointed star is placed directly below the title. In the upper center, a sacred city floating in the clouds is depicted using exquisite gold line art: a symmetrical holy city comprising a central domed cathedral, numerous surrounding towers, spires, walls, and gates, surrounded by soft clouds, with radiating rays of sunlight spreading outwards from behind. From the central gate of this heavenly city, a slender, vertical golden beam of light shines downwards, reaching the lower half of the cover. In the bottom third, a landscape of ancient Rome is depicted in delicate blue-grey ink lines: five major architectural remains and monuments are arranged horizontally, including a long arcade on the left, a classical columned temple in the left center, a domed building in the center, a bell tower and surrounding ruins in the right center, and the ruins of an amphitheater-like structure on the far right, along with a broken column drum and scattered shrubs and ground textures in the right foreground. Maintain an ethereal, symmetrical, and thought-provoking composition, leaving ample negative space between the sky and the ground. (The author's name should be included.){argument name="author name" default="SAN AGUSTÍN DE HIPONA"} Centered at the bottom, it uses a small, uppercase serif font with moderate spacing in a deep navy blue. The entire image contains only three visible text elements: the title, the author's name, and no subtitle. The color scheme is limited to ivory, gold, and deep navy blue, presenting a precise engraving feel and a sacred, eternal, and classical theological atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一款极简、优雅的复古书籍封面设计，采用暖象牙色纹理纸张，适用于 {argument name="book title" default="La Ciudad de Dios"}。将书名置于顶部中央，使用大型古典衬线字体，深海军蓝色，字间距考究，富有文学气息。在书名正下方放置 1 枚八角星，金色。在中上部，绘制一座漂浮在云端的圣洁城池，采用精致的金色线条艺术：一座对称的神圣之城，包含 1 座中央圆顶大教堂、多座簇拥的塔楼、尖顶、城墙和城门，四周环绕着柔和的云朵，背后散发出向外扩散的放射状太阳光芒。从天国的中央城门处，向下投射 1 道垂直的细长金光柱，直达封面下半部分。在底部三分之一处，用细腻的蓝灰色墨水线条描绘一幅古罗马大地景观：水平排列 5 处主要建筑遗迹和纪念碑，包括左侧的长拱廊、左中部的古典立柱神庙、中间的圆顶建筑、右中部的钟楼及周边遗迹，以及最右侧类似斗兽场的废墟，外加右侧前景中一根断裂的柱鼓和零星的灌木与地面纹理。保持构图空灵、对称且引人深思，在天与地之间留出充足的负空间。将作者名 {argument name="author name" default="SAN AGUSTÍN DE HIPONA"} 居中置于底部，使用间距适中的小型大写衬线字体，深海军蓝色。全图仅包含 3 处可见文本元素：书名、作者名，无副标题。配色仅限象牙白、金色和深海军蓝，呈现出精准的雕版线条感以及神圣、永恒、古典的神学氛围。

templates.title: High-end futuristic AI workspace

titleLocalized.zh: 高端未来感 AI 工作空间

templates.prompt: A futuristic control room workspace with a cinematic feel, employing a dark, high-tech aesthetic. The perspective is from behind a single person sitting at a stylish desk, with a floating, transparent holographic interface wall directly in the foreground. The scene is illuminated by electric blue and cyan light against an almost entirely black background. Slightly above the desk at the center of the composition is a radiant AI core or neural sphere, radiating dozens of branching, glowing data streams, connecting each screen like a digital nervous system. The figure in the image is a silhouette of a professional in dark attire, seated in a modern office chair; the symmetrical composition emphasizes scale and immersion. On the desk are three main monitors displaying code and technical dashboards, an open laptop on the left, a slender task lamp on the right, a coffee cup, and a few minimalist office accessories. Surrounding the figure are 10 large floating UI windows: one vertical profile/navigation panel on the left, containing a circular avatar and name.{argument name="character name" default="ALEXANDER"} And menu items; 1 item information card in the upper left corner, titled "..."{argument name="project name" default="PROJECT CHRONOS"} A top-central code editor window, titled "CODE SYNTHESIS," displays dense programming text; a middle-right assistant panel, titled "AI ASSISTANT," features glowing waveforms and brief chat text; a middle-right data window, titled "DATA STREAM"; a middle-left media generation panel, titled "GENERATING VISUAL ASSET," displays a dramatic sci-fi landscape with towering rock spires and multiple thumbnail previews below; a small central progress card, titled "EXECUTING WORKFLOW," with a progress bar; a middle-right world map analysis panel, titled "GLOBAL NETWORK," with glowing connectors; a lower-left engineering rendering panel, titled "3D MODEL RENDER," displays futuristic mechanical engines or spacecraft components; and a lower-right dashboard, titled "SYSTEM MONITOR," with circular percentage charts and graphs. In addition, it includes two smaller side panels: a lower left voice panel titled "VOICE INTERFACE" with waveform visualizations; and a narrow right panel titled "ACTIVITY LOG" with status entries. Scattered between the main windows are several tiny floating microcards and image thumbnails connected by light trails, hinting at multi-tasking AI orchestration. The interface design should present an exquisitely refined, glass-like, transparent, edge-glowing, and high-end feel, complete with thin neon borders, subtle grid lines, small icons, and sophisticated sci-fi UI fonts. It employs dramatic wide-angle compositions, deep depth of field, sharp details, volumetric lighting effects, reflective surfaces, and a balanced, symmetrical layout centered on the glowing AI core. The overall atmosphere is visionary, luxurious, and intelligent, as if {argument name="headline text" default="the future of creative AI interfaces"} This will become a reality, integrating software engineering, generative design, global connectivity, and autonomous workflow management to create immersive scenarios.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影质感的未来主义控制室工作空间，采用深色高端科技美学。视角位于一名坐在时尚办公桌前的单人身后，画面中心前景处，正对着一整面悬浮的透明全息界面墙。场景由近乎全黑背景上的电光蓝和青色光线照亮，构图中心略高于桌面处有一个光芒四射的 AI 核心或神经球体，向四周辐射出数十条分支状的发光数据流，如同数字神经系统般连接着每一块屏幕。画面中的人物为身着深色服装的专业人士剪影，坐在现代办公椅上，对称的构图强调了规模感与沉浸感。桌面上摆放着 3 台显示代码和技术仪表盘的主显示器、左侧 1 台打开的笔记本电脑、右侧 1 盏纤细的任务灯、1 个咖啡杯以及少量极简办公配件。人物周围环绕着 10 个大型悬浮 UI 窗口：1 个左侧垂直个人资料/导航面板，包含圆形头像、名称 {argument name="character name" default="ALEXANDER"} 以及菜单项；1 个左上方项目信息卡片，标题为 {argument name="project name" default="PROJECT CHRONOS"}；1 个顶部中央代码编辑器窗口，标题为 "CODE SYNTHESIS"，显示密集的编程文本；1 个中右上方助手面板，标题为 "AI ASSISTANT"，带有发光波形和简短聊天文本；1 个右上方数据窗口，标题为 "DATA STREAM"；1 个中左侧媒体生成面板，标题为 "GENERATING VISUAL ASSET"，显示带有高耸岩石尖塔的戏剧性科幻景观，下方有多个缩略图预览；1 个小型中央进度卡片，标题为 "EXECUTING WORKFLOW"，带有进度条；1 个中右侧世界地图分析面板，标题为 "GLOBAL NETWORK"，带有发光连接点；1 个左下方工程渲染面板，标题为 "3D MODEL RENDER"，显示未来机械引擎或航天器组件；1 个右下方仪表盘，标题为 "SYSTEM MONITOR"，带有圆形百分比图表和图形。此外包含 2 个较小的侧面板：1 个左下方语音面板，标题为 "VOICE INTERFACE"，带有波形可视化效果；1 个右侧窄面板，标题为 "ACTIVITY LOG"，带有状态条目。在主窗口之间散布着几个微小的悬浮微卡片和图像缩略图，由光迹连接，暗示着多任务 AI 编排。界面设计应呈现出极致精美、玻璃拟态、透明、边缘发光且高端的质感，配有细霓虹边框、微妙的网格线、小图标以及高端科幻 UI 字体。采用戏剧性的广角构图、深邃的景深、清晰的细节、体积光效果、反射表面，以及以发光 AI 核心为中心的平衡对称布局。整体氛围充满远见、奢华且智能，如同将 {argument name="headline text" default="the future of creative AI interfaces"} 变为现实，将软件工程、生成式设计、全球连接和自主工作流管理融为一体，打造出沉浸式场景。

templates.title: Brown-toned indoor seated portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 棕色调室内坐姿肖像

templates.prompt: A realistic indoor portrait of a young East Asian woman, seated in a simple black folding chair. The composition is vertical, framing the image from her thighs to her head. She has {argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown"} Her hair was parted in the middle and tied into a low ponytail, with a few soft strands framing her face. She wore delicate earrings, her skin was fair and smooth, and her posture was calm and natural, with her hands clasped together between her knees. She was wearing a {argument name="top color" default="Dark chocolate brown"} A fitted ribbed zip-up cropped top with a pointed collar and three-quarter sleeves; the zipper is slightly open to create a deep neckline. Pair it with bottoms in the same color family.{argument name="pants color" default="warm brown"} High-waisted straight-leg trousers. The overall look uses a monochromatic brown color scheme, showcasing the delicate fabric texture and natural body contours. The background is a softly draped off-white fabric with gentle pleats, and the lighting uses soft natural window light to create a clean and gentle editorial-style interior visual effect. Realistic style, shallow depth of field, soft shadows, understated fashion portrait, minimalist setting, centered subject, relaxed sitting posture, high detail in skin and fabric texture.

templates.title: Multiplication Dominoes Classroom Activity

titleLocalized.zh: 乘法多米诺骨牌课堂活动

templates.prompt: A realistic, documentary-style photograph captures a scene of a math activity in an elementary school classroom. About ten children in blue-green school uniforms sit around a makeshift wooden table, actively playing a brightly colored multiplication domino game. The camera is positioned at the children's eye level, tilted slightly downwards, pointing at the main table in the foreground. At the center of the scene is a square educational project labeled in Portuguese, with the title "DOMINÓ DA MULTIPLICAÇÃO" printed on the bottom edge and "TREINANDO AS TABUADAS" in the center, surrounded by brightly colored domino-shaped multiplication blocks. Four children are intently focused on this main project: one is placing a yellow domino into the project, another holds a stack of colored dominoes, one watches from the left, and another, wearing blue sleeves, organizes the dominoes at the bottom edge. Two light-colored wooden boxes labeled "JOGO DE DOMINÓ" are also present, one in the center left and the other in the lower right corner, containing colorful rectangular dominoes. School supplies are casually scattered on the desks: three pencils, two sheets of worksheets, a water bottle, a pencil case, a notebook, and extra play cards. In the background, the rest of the classroom is softly out of focus, showing other students sitting at desks, bookshelves, a corkboard covered with children's drawings, and a large multiplication table poster on the left wall that reads "TABUADA DE MULTIPLICAÇÃO". Bright natural light streams in from the high window on the right, creating a warm, lively, and authentic school atmosphere. Educational items and cards should use vibrant classroom colors such as yellow, blue, pink, green, and orange. Faces should be blurred or softened, emphasizing hands-on learning, collaboration, and the multiplication domino activity. A vertical composition, a highly realistic photograph, capturing a genuine classroom moment with clear foreground details and a soft depth of field in the background.

templates.title: Colorization of World War II historical photos

titleLocalized.zh: 二战历史照片上色

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference images, recreate the original WWII paratrooper black-and-white photographs with realistic and historically accurate color reproduction. Preserve the original composition, poses, equipment, weapons, cropped facial areas, background, and framing. Add natural and period-appropriate colors: khaki/tan uniforms and parachute gear, olive green backpacks, brown leather boots and straps, wooden rifle stocks, dark metal rifle bodies, soft earth tones for dirt roads and buildings, green for trees, and a soft pale blue for the sky. Ensure the 82nd Airborne Division's shoulder insignia are historically accurate, featuring a single, clearly visible red, white, and blue insignia. The final result should be a restoration faithful to the documentary era, not a modern redraw.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图像，将原始的二战伞兵黑白照片进行写实且符合历史事实的色彩还原。保留原有的构图、姿势、装备、武器、面部裁剪区域、背景以及摄影取景。添加自然且符合时代特征的色彩：卡其色/棕褐色制服和跳伞装备、橄榄绿背包、棕色皮革靴子和绑带、木质色调的步枪枪托、深色金属枪身，泥土路和建筑使用柔和的土色调，树木呈现绿色，天空为柔和的淡蓝色。确保第 82 空降师的肩章符合历史事实，即 1 个清晰可见的红、白、蓝三色肩章。最终效果应呈现为忠实于纪录片时代的修复作品，而非现代风格的重绘。

templates.title: Blindfolded Sorcerer's Victory Pose

titleLocalized.zh: 蒙眼术士胜利姿势

templates.prompt: A striking illustration in a shonen manga style depicts a powerful white-haired sorcerer, dramatically laughing with his head thrown back in a low, full-body pose, mouth agape. He wears a black high-necked uniform and a black eyepatch. His left hand extends towards the viewer in a peace sign gesture, the strong perspective making the hand appear exceptionally large in the foreground, while his right hand hangs naturally at his sides. Explosive {argument name="energy color" default="Electric Blue"} Supernatural energy, accompanied by wild, brush-like halos, splattering fragments, sparks, and wavy streams of light spanning the frame. The background is a dark, abstract burst of chaotic energy, punctuated by glowing blue fragments and dynamic lines, creating an overwhelming sense of power. A bold cel-shaded anime rendering style is employed, combining painterly highlights, sharp lines, strong contrasts, and glossy folds on black clothing. On the right side of the image, a large, jagged white comic book speech bubble with a thick black outline is added, containing…{argument name="speech bubble text" default="The Luddites are doomed to defeat!"} The lettering uses large, distressed black capital letters. The vertical composition, a dynamic action poster layout, conveys a confident and victorious stance, embodying modern dark fantasy anime aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具冲击力的少年漫画风格插画，描绘了一位强大的白发术士，他正以极具戏剧性的低角度全身姿势仰头大笑，嘴巴张开，身穿黑色高领制服，双眼蒙着黑色眼罩。他的左手向观众伸出，做出剪刀手姿势，通过强烈的透视效果使手部在前景中显得格外巨大，右手则自然下垂。周围环绕着爆炸性的 {argument name="energy color" default="电光蓝"} 超自然能量，伴有狂野的笔触式光晕轨迹、飞溅的碎片、火花以及横跨画面的弯曲流光。背景为深色抽象的混沌能量爆发，点缀着发光的蓝色碎片和动态线条，营造出一种压倒性的力量感。采用大胆的赛璐珞动漫渲染风格，结合绘画感的高光、锐利的线条、强烈的对比以及黑色服装上富有光泽的褶皱。在画面右侧，添加 1 个带有粗黑色轮廓的巨大锯齿状白色漫画对话气泡，其中包含 {argument name="speech bubble text" default="卢德分子必败无疑！"} 字样，使用巨大的做旧黑色大写字母。竖构图，动态动作海报构图，自信且胜利的姿态，现代暗黑奇幻动漫美学。

templates.title: Anime Pop Art Protest Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫波普艺术抗议海报

templates.prompt: A striking anime pop art poster features a tall, white-haired male sorcerer in a dark navy turtleneck jacket. He is depicted in half-length, facing the camera with a confident pose, his left hand making a peace sign near the lens. His face is partially obscured by a rectangular blurred/occluded block around his eyes and nose, while his spiky, silver-white hair dramatically spreads outwards above a dark eye mask or goggles. A large cartoon speech bubble is placed at the top, containing the exact text.{argument name="headline text" default="LUDDITES ALWAYS LOSE!"} Use a heavy, all-caps black sans-serif font. A vibrant blue background is used, filled with dense, radiating red and orange speed lines bursting outwards from behind the character, creating a dynamic comic book cover feel. Emphasis is placed on bold ink outlines, cel-shaded anime-style rendering, poster-like contrast, and a slightly distorted retro comic book print look. The composition should be vertical, compactly cropped, energetic, rebellious, graphic, and memetic, and {argument name="character hair color" default="silver white"} hair,{argument name="coat color" default="dark navy"} coat and{argument name="background color" default="bright blue with red-orange radial lines"} The background color is the main color.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张醒目的动漫波普艺术海报，主角是一位身材高挑、留着白发的男性术士，身穿深海军蓝高领外套，半身像，正面对镜头，姿态自信，左手靠近镜头比出剪刀手。他的脸部被一个位于眼睛和鼻子区域的矩形模糊/遮挡块部分遮住，尖刺状的银白色头发在深色眼罩或护目镜上方戏剧性地向外散开。在顶部放置一个巨大的漫画对话气泡，其中包含确切文本 {argument name="headline text" default="LUDDITES ALWAYS LOSE!"}，使用粗重的黑色全大写无衬线字体。使用鲜艳的蓝色背景，背景中充满了从角色身后向外爆发的密集红色和橙色放射状速度线，营造出动态的漫画封面感。强调粗犷的墨水轮廓、赛璐珞风格的动漫渲染、海报化的对比度以及略微扭曲的复古漫画印刷外观。构图应为竖版、紧凑裁剪、充满活力、叛逆、图形化且具有模因感，并以 {argument name="character hair color" default="silver white"} 的头发、{argument name="coat color" default="dark navy"} 的外套和 {argument name="background color" default="bright blue with red-orange radial lines"} 的背景色为主色调。

templates.title: Leonardo da Vinci painted the Mona Lisa.

titleLocalized.zh: 列奥纳多绘制《蒙娜丽莎》

templates.prompt: Inside a Renaissance-era art studio with a cinematic feel, soft, warm light streams in. On the left, an elderly painter bearing a striking resemblance to Leonardo da Vinci sits before his easel, painting the Mona Lisa using a live model. The painter has long, gray hair and a thick gray beard, wears a dark vintage hat, and a heavy, dark robe. In the foreground, a wooden easel displays the composition of the Mona Lisa; on the right, a female model maintains her signature pose, hands clasped, wearing a dark Renaissance-style long dress and veil-like folds. The overall atmosphere is intimate, tranquil, and painterly, with rich browns and amber tones, employing dramatic chiaroscuro. The background is an old stucco wall, and on the left, a glass window with lead strips. Behind the model, a wooden table holds brushes and studies. In the background behind the model, two portrait sketches are pinned or leaned against. In the lower right foreground, a cluttered painter's workbench is displayed, featuring a palette, several small dots of paint, a few brushes stuck in a cup, and several shallow bowls. The scene is framed like a realistic historical photograph, capturing the moment of a masterpiece's creation. The medium-wide-angle lens, shot slightly over the painter's shoulder from behind, reveals extremely fine textures, presenting the artistic atmosphere of a classical master. The background is blurred and soft, devoid of any modern objects.

promptLocalized.zh: 一间电影质感的文艺复兴时期艺术工作室内部，柔和温暖的窗光洒入。画面左侧展示了一位长相酷似列奥纳多·达·芬奇的老年画家，他坐在画架前，正以真人模特为原型绘制《蒙娜丽莎》。画家留着灰白长发和浓密的灰胡须，头戴深色复古帽，身穿厚重的深色长袍。画面中央前景处立着一个木制画架，上面展示着《蒙娜丽莎》的构图；右侧是一位真人女性模特，她保持着标志性的姿势，双手交叠，身着深色文艺复兴风格长裙和面纱般的褶皱布料。整体氛围亲密、宁静且富有绘画感，色调为浓郁的棕色和琥珀色，运用了戏剧性的明暗对照法，背景是老旧的灰泥墙，左侧有一扇铅条镶嵌的玻璃窗，后方木桌上摆放着画笔和习作。在模特身后的背景中，钉着或靠着两幅肖像草图。右下角前景处展示了一张杂乱的画家工作台，上面有 1 个调色板、多个小颜料点、杯中插着几支画笔以及几个浅碗。将场景构图为一张写实的历史照片，捕捉杰作创作瞬间，中景广角镜头，从画家身后略微越肩拍摄，纹理极其细腻，呈现出古典大师的艺术氛围，背景虚化柔和，无任何现代物品。

templates.title: Cute Rabbit Hiragana Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱兔子平假名海报

templates.prompt: Create an adorable Japanese preschool hiragana poster in a soft watercolor picture book style with a warm textured parchment background. The overall composition is a vertical educational chart with a whimsical spring border made of grass, flowers, mushrooms, butterflies, and chicks, resembling a children's classroom worksheet. Place a wooden sign at the top with brightly colored, rounded Japanese characters.{argument name="headline text" default="Rabbit Hiragana Chart"} The sign is decorated with two white rabbit mascots, one sitting on the left and the other peeking out from the right, and small flowers and leaves adorn the surrounding area. Below the title, a neat 5x8 grid of 40 square cells is arranged, each outlined in thin brown lines on a cream background. In each cell, a large, brightly colored hiragana character is placed at the top, below which is a small, cute rabbit illustration, each rabbit either performing or holding an item associated with the text below. Different cheerful colors, including red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple, are used for the many hiragana characters, and a hand-drawn, rounded font is used. Keep the text and illustrations exactly as follows, arranged in rows from left to right: Row 1 has 8 cells, marked as あ, い, う, う, え, え, お, お, and the corresponding words are あめ, No. 2 Row has 8 cells, marked as か, き, く, け, せ, せ, そ, そ, and the corresponding words are きくら,たま,サベツン,ケーキ,せんせい,そう,そう,しょうこう; 3rd Row has 8 cells, marked as た, ち, ち, つ, て, て, と, と, and the corresponding words are たまご, No. 4 Row has 8 cells, marked as な, に, ぬ, ふ, め, ね, の, ほ, and the corresponding words are まな, ひこうき, みんきう, ふたう, てつ, へびす, ようこ, ほし; No. 5 The row has 8 cells, labeled ま, み, む, る, れ, れ, ろ, ん, and the corresponding words are わた, まくら, みかん, むぎぎ, めがみ, もも, ろうた, ん. The rabbit illustrations should be diverse and adorable: for example, holding an umbrella, hugging grapes, drawing with a pencil, eating rice balls, sitting under a cherry blossom tree, standing under an umbrella, holding fruit, eating cake, dressed as a teacher, holding flowers, sleeping under a blue blanket, carrying eggs, hugging tomatoes, holding strawberries, blowing bubbles, wearing a blue hat, holding oranges, sitting next to cotton, taking a bath in a wooden tub, and holding candy. Maintain soft pastel tones, gentle shadows, round faces, rosy cheeks, and delicate ink lines. The overall feel should be nostalgic, charming, educational, and highly detailed, making it ideal as a cute slide cover for kindergarten wall charts or Japanese learning presentations.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张可爱的日语学前班平假名海报，采用柔和的水彩绘本风格，背景为温暖的纹理羊皮纸。整体构图为垂直教育图表，带有由草地、花朵、蘑菇、蝴蝶和小鸡组成的奇幻春日边框，设计风格如同儿童教室的学习单。在顶部放置一个木质招牌标题，上面写着色彩鲜艳的圆润日语文字 {argument name="headline text" default="うさぎのひらがな表"}，并装饰有 2 只白色兔子吉祥物，一只坐在左侧，另一只从右侧探出头来，招牌周围点缀着小花和叶子。在标题下方，排列一个 5 行 8 列的整洁网格，共 40 个方形单元格，每个单元格在奶油色背景上用细棕色线条勾勒。在每个单元格中，顶部放置一个大的亮色平假名字符，下方放置一个小的可爱兔子插图，每只兔子都在表演或拿着与下方文字相关联的物品。为许多平假名字符使用不同的欢快颜色，包括红色、橙色、黄色、绿色、蓝色和紫色，并使用手绘圆润字体。保持文字和插图完全如下，按行从左到右排列：第 1 行有 8 个单元格，标记为 あ、い、う、う、え、え、お、お，对应单词为 あめ、いい、いい、うさぎ、えんぴつ、えんぴつ、おやすり、おにぎり；第 2 行有 8 个单元格，标记为 か、き、く、け、せ、せ、そ、そ，对应单词为 きくら、たま、サベツン、ケーキ、せんせい、そう、そう、しょうこう；第 3 行有 8 个单元格，标记为 た、ち、ち、つ、て、て、と、と，对应单词为 たまご、たまご、ちびこ、つと、てんとうむし、てしなを、とうこ、ほしい；第 4 行有 8 个单元格，标记为 な、に、ぬ、ふ、め、ね、の、ほ，对应单词为 まな、ひこうき、みんきう、ふたう、てつ、へびす、ようこ、ほし；第 5 行有 8 个单元格，标记为 ま、み、む、る、れ、れ、ろ、ん，对应单词为 わた、まくら、みかん、むぎぎ、めがみ、もも、ろうた、ん。兔子插图应多样且可爱：例如拿着雨伞、抱着葡萄、用铅笔画画、吃饭团、坐在樱花树下、站在伞下、拿着水果、吃蛋糕、打扮成老师、拿着花、在蓝色毯子下睡觉、搬运鸡蛋、拥抱番茄、拿着草莓、吹泡泡、戴着蓝色帽子、拿着橘子、坐在棉花旁、在木桶里洗澡以及拿着糖果。保持柔和的粉彩色调、柔和的阴影、圆圆的脸蛋、红润的脸颊和细腻的墨线。整体感觉应怀旧、迷人、具有教育意义、高度细致，非常适合作为幼儿园墙面图表或日语学习演示文稿的可爱 Slides 封面。

templates.title: Xiaomi SU7 exploded view chat screenshot

titleLocalized.zh: 小米 SU7 爆炸图聊天截图

templates.prompt: A screenshot of a stylish Chinese social media interface in a deep charcoal black, featuring a minimalist yet sophisticated design. A large, rounded rectangular image card is placed in the lower left center, while a small, rounded chat bubble appears in the upper right corner. The overall canvas has ample white space, creating a clean and technologically advanced feel. In the upper left of the main area, bold white Chinese text reads: "If we were to use Xiaomi cars, I would create a more sophisticated, exploded view of the entire vehicle, more like a product launch presentation." In the upper right corner, a gray, rounded bubble contains the white Chinese text: "Xiaomi Car Product Teardown Diagram." Below is a poster-style, rounded infographic card with a glossy black background. The inside of the card is turquoise.{argument name="car model" default="Xiaomi SU7"} A stunning, exploded-down product presentation of the electric sedan is created, employing a highly stimulating 45-degree front-view perspective. The body is disassembled into multiple components, floating around the chassis. The hood is open, the trunk lid is raised, the four side doors are removed and float outwards, the front bumper and fascia are separated, the headlights are displayed independently, the interior is visible, and the main mechanical and structural modules are neatly layered and arranged below and around the body. The visual style should resemble slides from a high-end launch event: cinematic studio lighting, realistic reflections, sharp details, a dark background, subtle blue highlights, and precise technical composition. In the upper left corner of the infographic card, three lines of large white Chinese titles are placed: "Xiaomi Auto SU7," "Product Teardown Diagram," and "Technological Leap, Human-Car Unity." An orange square Xiaomi-style logo is added to the upper right corner of the card. Fourteen Chinese labels surround the car, connected by thin white lines, indicating visible components and systems. The left side features six functional labels, including the integrated closed front fascia, LED headlights, front trunk design, high-voltage battery, front motor assembly, front double wishbone suspension, and Brembo four-piston brake calipers. The right side features eight functional labels, including the power tailgate, continuous taillights, frameless doors, hidden door handles, rear motor assembly, rear motor parameters, all-aluminum chassis, five-link rear suspension, and Michelin high-performance tires. Beneath the exploded, disassembled body, the battery pack, front and rear drive units, suspension subframe, wheel assemblies, braking components, front and rear seats, center console parts, chassis skid plates, and structural floor elements are clearly displayed, all meticulously organized in an explosive, floating arrangement. At the bottom of the infographic card, a horizontal information bar is added, divided into five columns of small Chinese text, titled Vehicle Dimensions, Power Performance, Driving Range, Intelligent Driving, and Safety Structure. A bold white Chinese label "Edit" is placed in the lower left corner of the card. A circular downward arrow icon is located at the bottom center, and a share/export icon is in the lower right corner. The overall composition should look like a real screenshot from a Chinese AI chat app, showcasing automatically generated car disassembly infographics with modern UI spacing, clear typography, and a luxurious black and blue color scheme.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张采用深炭黑色界面的时尚中文社交媒体风格截图，设计简约且高端，左下中心位置放置一张大型圆角矩形图片卡片，右上角有一个小型圆角聊天气泡。整体画布留白较多，营造出简洁的科技展示感。在主区域左上方，显示一行加粗的白色中文字符：“换成小米汽车，我做一张更像发布会级别的整车爆炸分解图。” 在右上角，包含一个灰色的圆角气泡，内含白色中文字符：“小米汽车的产品拆解图”。下方展示一张海报风格的圆角信息图卡片，背景为亮黑色。在卡片内部，为绿松石色的 {argument name="car model" default="Xiaomi SU7"} 电动轿车制作一张精美的爆炸分解式产品展示图，采用极具张力的前侧 45 度视角，车身分解为多个组件，悬浮在底盘周围。引擎盖开启，后备箱盖升起，四个侧门拆卸并向外悬浮，前保险杠和前脸分离，大灯独立展示，内饰可见，主要的机械和结构模块整齐地分层排列在车身下方和周围。视觉风格应类似于高端发布会的 Slides：电影级摄影棚灯光、逼真的反射、锐利的细节、深色背景、微妙的蓝色高光以及精确的技术构图。在信息图卡片的左上方，放置三行大型白色中文标题：“小米汽车 SU7”、“产品拆解图”、“科技跨越，人车合一”。在卡片右上角添加一个橙色方形的小米风格 Logo。在汽车周围环绕 14 个中文标注，通过细白色引线连接，标示出可见的部件和系统。左侧包含 6 个功能标注，例如一体化封闭式前脸、LED 大灯、前备箱设计、高压电池、前电机总成、前双叉臂悬架和 Brembo 四活塞制动卡钳。右侧包含 8 个功能标注，例如电动尾门、贯穿式尾灯、无框车门、隐藏式门把手、后电机总成、后电机参数、全铝合金底盘、五连杆后悬架和米其林高性能轮胎。在爆炸分解的车身下方，清晰展示电池包、前后驱动单元、悬架副车架、轮毂组件、制动部件、前后座椅、中控台零件、底盘护板和结构地板元件，所有部件均经过精心组织，呈爆炸式悬浮排列。在信息图卡片底部，添加一个水平信息条，分为 5 列小型中文规格文本，标题分别为车辆尺寸、动力性能、续航里程、智能驾驶和安全结构。在卡片左下角，放置一个加粗的白色中文标签“编辑”。在底部中心包含一个圆形向下箭头图标，右下角包含一个分享/导出图标。整体构图应看起来像是一张来自中国 AI 聊天 App 的真实截图，展示自动生成的汽车拆解信息图，具有现代化的 UI 间距、清晰的排版以及奢华的黑青色调。

templates.title: Foreign shop assistants in mobile phone stores in county towns

titleLocalized.zh: 县城手机店里的外国店员

templates.prompt: A realistic, documentary-style smartphone photograph, taken inside a small mobile phone shop in a county town in China, showcases a genuine sales interaction scene at the counter. A tall foreign man, approximately {argument name="shop clerk nationality" default="Russians"} A salesperson, wearing a black jacket and a blue employee lanyard with a name tag, stands behind a glass counter, holding a smartphone in both hands, seemingly introducing it to a customer. His face is deliberately blurred with a soft rectangular mosaic to protect his privacy. In the foreground, a middle-aged Chinese male customer in a black jacket has his back to the camera and is slightly turned to the side, facing the salesperson. The store is narrow and well-lit, visually filled with authentic retail details. Behind them are large smartphone brand posters and lightbox advertisements, including ads for the two major mobile phone brands, Vivo and Oppo. Four prominent Chinese promotional signs are visible in the image: a red banner about purchasing mobile phones and carrier services, a blue vertical installment payment sign mentioning "0 down payment, 0 interest," a blue sign mentioning a "1000 yuan" trade-in subsidy, and a small counter stand promoting a Xiaomi model priced at 6999 yuan. Several display phones are displayed inside the glass counter, with four vertical demo units clearly visible, and brochures and accessories scattered below the glass. The background consists of densely packed shelves filled with boxed accessories and hanging decorations. The composition is slightly cluttered, the interior lighting is harsh, and there is a slight lens distortion, giving it a rough, unedited, and realistic feel, like a snapshot taken with a mobile phone. The overall atmosphere should be ordinary and down-to-earth, with a touch of surrealism, because the foreign shop assistant seems to have completely blended into this ordinary Chinese mobile phone store.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实的纪实风格智能手机照片，拍摄于中国某县城的一家小型手机店内，展示了柜台前真实的销售互动场景。一位身材高大的外国男性，大约 {argument name="shop clerk nationality" default="俄罗斯人"}，身穿黑色夹克，佩戴着带有工牌的蓝色员工挂绳，站在玻璃柜台后，双手拿着一部智能手机，仿佛正在向顾客介绍。他的面部被刻意处理成柔和的矩形马赛克以保护隐私。前景中，一位身穿黑色夹克的中年中国男性顾客背对镜头并略微侧身，正面对着店员。店内空间狭窄、灯光充足，视觉上充满了真实的零售细节。他们身后是大型智能手机品牌海报和灯箱广告，包括 vivo 和 oppo 这两个主要手机品牌的广告。画面中可见 4 个醒目的中文促销标识：一条关于购买手机和运营商服务的红色横幅、一个提到“0 首付 0 利息”的蓝色垂直分期付款标志、一个提到“1000 元”以旧换新补贴的蓝色标志，以及一个推广小米机型且标价 6999 的小型柜台立牌。玻璃柜台内陈列着多部展示机，其中 4 部立式演示机清晰可见，玻璃下方还散落着宣传册和配件。背景是摆满盒装配件的密集货架和悬挂的装饰物，构图略显杂乱，室内灯光较硬，带有轻微的镜头畸变，呈现出手机随手抓拍的那种粗粝、未经修饰的真实感。整体氛围应显得平凡、接地气，且带有一丝超现实感，因为这位外国店员看起来完全融入了这家普通的中国手机店。

templates.title: Comparison posters of the two eras of the navy

titleLocalized.zh: 双时代海军对比海报

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic Japanese naval contrast poster, employing a highly detailed, realistic conceptual art style. The color palette is a warm amber sunset, complemented by dramatic clouds, luminous backlighting, and a layout combining a high-quality cinematic poster with technical reference tables. The composition is divided vertically into two main areas. At the top, in the "Heroes" section, display two large, semi-transparent portraits of officers turned inwards. The left officer wears a navy uniform from the old imperial era, while the right officer wears a modern Maritime Self-Defense Force-style dress uniform. Both wear peaked caps and dark dress coats against a backdrop of a vibrant sunset sky. A large serif English title is placed centered between the two figures.{argument name="headline text" default="Fog of Two Eras"} Below is a smaller Japanese subtitle, "Futatsu no Jidai no Kū" (The Fog of the Ages), with two lines of Japanese text above it. Below the title, on the sea at its prime, two warships are shown sailing forward, their course slightly converging: on the left is a massive World War II battleship with numerous large turrets, a tower-like superstructure, a weathered dark hull, and white bow spray; on the right is a modern gray guided-missile destroyer, its hull number 115 visible at the bow, featuring a streamlined radar superstructure and foamy wakes. Four helicopters are added to the sky, two on each side, with a suspension bridge and a distant modern city skyline above the horizon. The reference table area below divides the page into two vertical panels: the left for historical ships and the right for modern ships. Each panel is designed as a parchment-textured military specification item, with dark blue and dark red title bars, fine dividing lines, embedded image frames, and Japanese labels. The left panel should display a large perspective rendering of a battleship, three orthographic views of the ship below, a row of five small, tagged equipment/detail thumbnails, four small portraits of officers in uniform, four full-body rotating views of male naval officers, and a scaled silhouette of the ship and officers at the bottom (marked with 20 meters). The right panel should display a large perspective rendering of a modern destroyer, three orthographic views of the ship below, six small, tagged equipment/detail thumbnails arranged around the ship's reference image, four small portraits of officers in uniform, four full-body views of the formation (including a female officer wearing a white hat and dark uniform), and a scaled silhouette of the ship and officers at the bottom (marked with 20 meters). Prominent Japanese titles and labels should be used throughout, including the historical title area on the left and the title area on the right that names the ship "貴貴あさつ(DDG-115)". The image possesses the quality of a combination of museum exhibition posters, military design drawings, and key visuals from a high-quality historical science fiction drama, featuring ultra-clear details, realistic metallic textures, ocean reflections, aged paper panels, symmetrical balance, and exquisite typography.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影质感的日式海军对比海报，采用高度精细的写实概念艺术风格，色调为温暖的琥珀色夕阳，配以戏剧性的云层、发光的背光，以及高级电影海报与技术参考表结合的布局。构图在垂直方向上分为 2 个主要区域。在顶部的英雄区，展示 2 幅向内侧身的大型半透明军官肖像，左侧为旧帝国时代海军制服，右侧为现代海上自卫队风格礼服，两人均佩戴大檐帽并身着深色礼服大衣，背景为绚烂的夕阳天空。在两人中间居中放置一个大型衬线体英文标题 {argument name="headline text" default="Fog of Two Eras"}，下方配有较小的日文副标题“ふたつの時代の霧”，标题上方有 2 行日文标语。在标题下方，于黄金时刻的海面上，展示 2 艘正向前航行的军舰，航向略微汇合：左侧是一艘巨大的二战时期战列舰，拥有许多大型炮塔、塔式上层建筑、风化的深色船体和白色的舰首浪花；右侧是一艘现代灰色导弹驱逐舰，舰首可见舷号 115，拥有流线型雷达上层建筑和泡沫状航迹。在天空中添加 4 架直升机，左右两侧各 2 架，地平线上方添加一座悬索桥和遥远的现代城市天际线。在下方的参考表区域，将页面分为 2 个垂直面板，左侧为历史舰船，右侧为现代舰船，每个面板设计成羊皮纸质感的军事规格项目，配有深蓝色和深红色的标题栏、精细的分割线、嵌入式图像框和日文标签。左侧面板应呈现 1 张战列舰的大型透视渲染图、下方 3 张正投影舰船视图、一行 5 个带标签的小型装备/细节缩略图、4 张小型头像制服肖像、4 张男性海军军官全身转体视图，以及底部 1 个舰船与人物对比的比例剪影（带 20 米标记）。右侧面板应呈现 1 张现代驱逐舰的大型透视渲染图、下方 3 张正投影舰船视图、环绕舰船参考图排列的 6 个带标签的小型装备/细节缩略图、4 张小型头像制服肖像、4 张全身角色阵容视图（包括一名戴白帽、穿深色制服的女性军官），以及底部 1 个舰船与人物对比的比例剪影（带 20 米标记）。通篇使用醒目的日文标题和标签，包括左侧的历史标题区和右侧将舰船命名为“护卫舰 あさつ (DDG-115)”的标题区。使整张图像呈现出博物馆展览海报、军事设计图纸与精品历史科幻剧关键视觉图相结合的质感，具备超清晰的细节、逼真的金属纹理、海洋反射、陈旧的纸张面板、对称的平衡感以及精致的排版。

templates.title: Fake screenshot of Lao Gan Ma's live stream on Douyin

titleLocalized.zh: 伪造抖音老干妈直播间截图

templates.prompt: A realistic mobile screenshot model of a Chinese short video live-streaming e-commerce interface in dark mode, with a charcoal black background. In the upper right corner of the canvas, a rounded dark chat bubble containing Chinese text is placed.{argument name="request text" default="Please generate a screenshot of Elon Musk promoting Lao Gan Ma on Douyin."} The right side features two small interface icons for copying and editing. In the lower left corner, an iPhone-style live stream screen with a black border and rounded corners is displayed, showing the time as 20:30. The live stream is from the Laoganma official flagship store, including a Chinese profile name, a blue certification badge, a red follow button, and a status bar at the top displaying three circular avatars, 100,000+ viewers, a close icon, and a "More Live Streams" button. Ranking text such as "No. 1 in Overall Sales Ranking" and "No. 1 in Popularity" is added near the top. The main video screen displays {argument name="host identity" default="Elon Musk"} In a dimly lit, warm-toned studio resembling a high-end product livestream, a man in a black shirt holds a large bottle of Lao Gan Ma chili sauce in his right hand and points to it with his left. His face is blurred with rectangular mosaics. Behind him is a neon sign emitting a reddish-orange glow that reads "Lao Gan Ma / National Chili Sauce," several bottles of the sauce are displayed on a shelf, a framed portrait logo is shown, and a dark-leaved plant is on the right. Typical livestream UI elements are overlaid: on the left, there are two floating gift/comment bubbles with usernames and x66 and x88 counts; below is a purple capsule-shaped icon displaying 35 and "Joined the Livestream." A scrolling comment section with five lines of visible chat history is added, including Chinese usernames and a line from {argument name="comment name" default="Elon Musk"} The English review reads, "It's awesome! Very delicious!", followed by a Chinese review stating that he buys it every day. In the upper right corner of the video area, a pink promotional banner mentions "Douyin 618 Shopping Festival" and "618 Yuan Coupon." In the lower right corner, a product card with the tag "Hot Selling x9999+" showcases three bottles of Lao Gan Ma chili sauce and a bowl of chili seasoning, titled "Lao Gan Ma Flavored Black Bean Chili Oil 280g*3 Bottles," with a small guarantee label, a large price of ¥39.9, and a red buy button. At the bottom of the phone screen, there are five navigation/operation areas: an edit-style button on the left, text input prompts, a shopping cart icon, a pair of heart/gift icons, and a share arrow icon. Overall style: ultra-realistic app screenshots, believable Chinese e-commerce live-streaming UI, high detail, cinematic warm lighting in the video stream, a clean and modern mobile interface, and visually convincing social e-commerce screenshots.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张深色模式下中国短视频直播带货界面的逼真手机截图模型，背景为炭黑色。在整体画布的右上角，放置一个圆角深色聊天气泡，其中包含中文文本 {argument name="request text" default="帮我生成一张马斯克在带货老干妈的抖音直播间截图"}，其右侧带有 2 个用于复制和编辑的小型界面图标。在左下角区域，显示一个带有黑色边框和圆角的 iPhone 风格直播屏幕，时间显示为 20:30。直播间来自老干妈官方旗舰店，包含中文个人资料名称行、蓝色认证徽章、红色关注按钮，以及顶部显示 3 个圆形头像、10 万+ 观看人数、关闭图标和“更多直播”按钮的状态栏。在顶部附近添加排名文本，如“带货总榜第 1 名”和“人气第 1 名”。主视频画面显示 {argument name="host identity" default="Elon Musk"} 在一个类似高端产品直播间的昏暗暖色调摄影棚中，身穿黑色衬衫，右手拿着一大瓶老干妈辣酱，左手指向它。他的脸部经过矩形马赛克模糊处理。在他身后，包含一个发着红橙色光的霓虹灯牌，写着“老干妈 / LAO GAN MA / 国民辣酱”，货架上摆放着几瓶辣酱，一个带框的肖像标志，右侧还有一株深色叶片植物。叠加典型的直播 UI 元素：在左侧，有 2 个带有用户名和 x66、x88 计数的悬浮礼物/评论气泡；下方是一个显示 35 和“加入了直播间”的紫色胶囊状图标。添加一个包含 5 行可见聊天记录的滚动评论区，其中包括中文用户名，以及一行来自 {argument name="comment name" default="Elon Musk"} 的英文评论：“It's awesome! Very delicious!”，随后跟着一行表示他每天都买的中文评论。在视频区域的右上角，添加一个粉红色促销横幅，提及“抖音 618 好物节”和“618 元消费券”。在右下角，放置一个带有“热卖 x9999+”标签的产品卡片，展示 3 瓶老干妈和一碗辣椒调料，产品标题为“老干妈 风味豆豉油辣椒 280g*3 瓶”，带有小型保障标签，以及一个 ¥39.9 的大价格和红色购买按钮。在手机屏幕底部，包含 5 个导航/操作区域：左侧的编辑风格按钮、文本输入提示、购物车图标、心形/礼物图标对，以及分享箭头图标。整体风格：超逼真的 App 截图，可信的中国电商直播 UI，高细节，视频流中电影般的暖色调灯光，简洁现代的移动界面，视觉上令人信服的社交电商截图。

templates.title: Boxing Impact Chat Screenshot

titleLocalized.zh: 拳击冲击聊天截图

templates.prompt: A realistic screenshot of a Chinese dark mode chat interface on a mobile phone. The style is minimalist and modern, featuring a charcoal black background with ample white space. Near the upper right corner is a rounded, dark gray message bubble containing white Chinese characters.{argument name="message text" default="The moment the boxer was hit"} A large, rounded-corner image is embedded in the lower left corner of the screen. The embedded photo shows the moment a boxer lands a powerful punch on his opponent's face during a professional boxing match. Two shirtless, muscular, and sweaty male boxers are positioned in the ring under the arena lights. The boxer on the right is primarily shown from the back, his right arm fully extended across the frame; his back and shoulder muscles are clearly defined, he has short, dark hair, and tattoos on his arms. He wears a white boxing glove with blue trim and is violently striking the boxer on the left in the face. The boxer on the left is thrown back by the impact, his head swinging to the side, sweat and water droplets splashing around his head. He has large tattoos on his left arm and chest, a black glove raised near his torso, and wears black shorts with the prominent gold lettering "VICTOR" on his belt. The ring ropes are red and white, displaying brand logos such as PBC, against a blurred, dark arena background with a bright sign that reads "RODRIGUEZ VS". This action photo should capture the frozen moment of high-speed motion, with a dramatic, clear, and highly realistic image. Each boxer's face should be covered with a rectangular mosaic blur. Add subtle mobile UI overlay details to the image: a white Chinese "Edit" icon in the lower left corner and a circular share/upload icon in the lower right corner. The overall composition should look like an AI-generated image casually shared in an instant messaging app—simple, believable, and highly realistic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张逼真的中文深色模式聊天界面手机截图，风格简约现代，采用炭黑色背景，留白充足。右上角附近有一个圆角深灰色消息气泡，内含白色中文字符 {argument name="message text" default="拳击手被击中的瞬间"}。下方左侧嵌入一张占据屏幕左下半部分的大图，图片圆角处理。嵌入的照片展示了职业拳击比赛中，一名拳手重拳击中对方脸部的瞬间。两名赤裸上身的男性拳手肌肉发达、汗流浃背，置身于竞技场灯光下的拳击台内。右侧拳手主要呈现背侧面，右臂完全伸展横跨画面；其背部和肩部肌肉线条分明，留着深色短发，手臂有纹身。他戴着带有蓝色饰边的白色拳击手套，正猛烈击中左侧拳手的脸部。左侧拳手因冲击力向后仰，头部向侧面甩动，汗水和水珠从头部周围飞溅而出。他左臂和胸部有大面积纹身，躯干附近抬起一只黑色手套，穿着黑色短裤，腰带处印有醒目的金色字母 VICTOR。拳台围绳为红白相间，可见 PBC 等品牌标识，背景是模糊的深色竞技场，带有写着 RODRIGUEZ VS 的明亮标识。这张动作照片应呈现出高速运动摄影的定格感，画面戏剧性、清晰且高度逼真。两位拳手的脸部各覆盖一个矩形马赛克模糊遮挡块。在图片上添加细微的移动端 UI 叠加细节：照片左下角有白色中文字符“编辑”，右下角有一个圆形的分享/上传图标。整体构图应看起来就像在即时通讯应用中随手分享的 AI 生成图片，简洁、可信且极具真实感。

templates.title: Advertisement for the popular chicken stew with mushrooms

titleLocalized.zh: 爆款小鸡炖蘑菇广告

templates.prompt: Create a vertical food advertisement against a pure black background, similar in style to a high-end ingredient disassembly poster, to showcase a sumptuous Chinese-style chicken stew with mushrooms. Employ a simple, top-down, explosive composition, suspending the ingredients above the finished dish. Each ingredient group is clearly separated and illuminated with glossy commercial food photography lighting. At the top is a cluster of mixed hazel mushrooms and other fresh mushrooms. Below are two sets of spices: a bunch of red goji berries, a small bunch of scallions, and two thick slices of ginger. Further down are two sets of main ingredients: several pieces of raw chicken with skin, and a bundle of dried vermicelli. Next are two sets of vegetables: peeled potato chunks and thick carrot slices. Below these are a clear glass bowl filled with rich, golden chicken broth, with four shiitake mushrooms, finely chopped herbs, a small amount of oil, and wisps of steam visible on the surface. A dark brown ceramic casserole with a side handle sits at the bottom, containing the stewed dish: chicken pieces, shiitake mushrooms, translucent vermicelli, potato chunks, carrot slices, scattered goji berries, chopped scallions, and a glossy golden broth. Drizzling droplets, crumbs, and small decorative particles are added between the layers to emphasize movement and richness. A light steam rises above the stew, and a bright star-shaped highlight is added to the right rim of the casserole. Seven bilingual (English and Chinese) labels surround the ingredients, each accompanied by a thin, curved arrow pointing to the relevant ingredient. These seven labels are: “Hazel Mushrooms & Shiitake,” “Savory Mushrooms,” “Goji Berries & Aromatics,” “Chicken & Vermicelli,” “Potatoes & Carrots,” “Rich Chicken Broth,” and “Finished Stew.” Add an extra bilingual text description near the vegetables or central area: "Rich Ingredients". This will give the image a hyper-realistic, enticing, high-contrast, and extremely sharp effect, with cinematic highlights, deep shadows, high-end packaging advertising aesthetics, and a balanced, centered layout suitable for posters or social media ads.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张以纯黑为背景的竖版美食广告，风格类似于高端食材拆解海报，用于展示丰盛的中式小鸡炖蘑菇。采用简洁的自上而下爆炸式构图，将食材悬浮在成品菜肴上方，每组食材清晰分离，并使用光泽感十足的商业美食摄影灯光进行照明。顶部展示一簇混合的榛蘑及其他鲜美蘑菇。下方展示 2 组香料：一堆红枸杞，以及一小捆青葱和 2 片厚姜片。再下方展示 2 组主料：几块带皮生鸡块，以及一捆干粉条。接着展示 2 组蔬菜：去皮土豆块和厚胡萝卜片。在它们下方，放置 1 个装满浓郁金黄色鸡汤的透明玻璃碗，表面可见 4 个香菇、细碎香草、少量浮油和淡淡蒸汽。底部放置 1 个带有侧把手的深褐色陶瓷砂锅，锅内盛放着炖好的成品：鸡块、香菇、透明粉条、土豆块、胡萝卜片、散落的枸杞、葱花点缀，以及油亮的金黄色汤汁。在各层之间添加飘落的液滴、碎屑和细小的装饰颗粒，以强调动感和丰富度。成品炖菜上方加入淡淡的蒸汽，并在砂锅右侧边缘添加 1 个明亮的星形高光。在食材组周围添加 7 个中英文双语标注，每个标注均配有指向相关食材的细弯箭头。这 7 个标签分别为：“榛蘑&香菇 / Hazel Mushrooms & Shiitake”、“鲜美菌菇 / Savory Mushrooms”、“枸杞&葱姜 / Goji Berries & Aromatics”、“鸡肉&粉条 / Chicken & Vermicelli”、“土豆&胡萝卜 / Potatoes & Carrots”、“浓郁鸡汤 / Rich Chicken Broth”以及“成品 / Finished Stew”。在蔬菜或中部区域附近添加 1 条额外的双语文字说明：“丰富食材 / Rich Ingredients”。使图像呈现超写实、诱人、高对比度、极其锐利的效果，并带有电影级高光、深邃阴影、高端包装广告美学，以及适合海报或社交媒体广告的平衡居中布局。

templates.title: Anime Martial Arts Energy Showdown

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫武术能量对决

templates.prompt: A highly dramatic anime-style action illustration, set in a traditional wooden martial arts hall, is shot from a low angle, creating a strong cinematic perspective. In the foreground, a fierce-looking young female martial artist is charging forward in a crouching fighting stance, one fist aimed directly at the camera.{argument name="hair color" default="black"} Her hair was tied into a messy high bun and secured with a red ribbon. She wore a white Chinese-style kung fu top with red trim and Chinese knot buttons, paired with red wide-leg trousers and black martial arts shoes with red embellishments. Her expression was focused, aggressive, and resolute, her eyes flashing with a sharp red light. Red energy ribbons and oil painting-like streams of light surrounded her body and fists, scattering sparks and embers. In the upper right corner, a second young female warrior was leaping into the air, her body in a half-sideways position, wearing a dark green cheongsam-style combat outfit with ornate gold embroidery, black stockings, and high heels. Her{argument name="second character hair color" default="lavender"} Her hair was styled in two buns, adorned with wispy curls and decorative hair accessories. She extended one hand in a martial arts gesture, surrounded by an arc of luminous blue energy that formed a near-perfect circle around her body. The stark contrast between the red and blue elemental forces foreshadowed an imminent conflict. The setting was the interior of a dilapidated dojo, with cracked wooden floors exploding upwards, dust, sawdust, and debris solidifying in mid-air. Warm beams of light pierced through the wooden structure and windows, intertwining with luminous particles. In the background, large hanging calligraphy plaques were visible, including one inscribed with…{argument name="main sign text" default="Martial Arts Tournament"} The central wooden plaque, and the old paper banner with black Chinese characters. High-detail anime illustrations, dynamic perspective, extreme dynamism, layered effects, rich texture, dramatic contour lighting, the collision of cool blue energy and fiery warm highlights, exquisite conceptual art quality, vertical composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅极具戏剧性的动漫动作插画，场景设定在传统的木质武术馆内，采用低角度拍摄，呈现出强烈的电影透视感。前景中，一位神情凶猛的年轻女武术家正摆出深蹲战斗姿态向前冲刺，一只拳头直击镜头，她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"} 的头发，扎成凌乱的高丸子头，并系着红色丝带。她身穿带有红色镶边和盘扣的白色中式功夫上衣，搭配红色阔腿裤和带有红色装饰的黑色武术鞋。她的表情专注、充满攻击性且意志坚定，双眼闪烁着锐利的红光。红色的能量丝带和如油画般的流光环绕着她的身体和拳头，四散着火花与余烬。在右上角，第二位年轻女战士正跃向空中，身体呈半侧状，身穿深绿色旗袍风格的战斗服，配有华丽的金色刺绣、黑色长袜和高跟鞋。她的 {argument name="second character hair color" default="薰衣草色"} 头发梳成两个丸子头，带有卷曲的碎发和装饰性发饰。她单手伸出做出武术手势，周围环绕着一道弧形的蓝色发光水流能量，在身体周围形成一个近乎完整的圆环。红蓝两种元素力量形成鲜明对比，预示着一场迫在眉睫的冲突。环境为破旧的道场内部，破碎的木质地板向上炸裂，灰尘、木屑和运动碎片在半空中凝固。温暖的光束穿过木质结构和窗户，与发光的粒子交织在一起。背景可见大型悬挂书法牌匾，包括一块写有 {argument name="main sign text" default="武術会"} 的中央木质牌匾，以及带有黑色汉字的陈旧纸质竖幅。高细节动漫插画，动态透视，极致动感，层叠特效，质感丰富，戏剧性的轮廓光，冷色调蓝色能量与火热暖色高光的碰撞，精美的概念艺术品质，竖构图。

templates.title: AI portrait comparison side view

titleLocalized.zh: AI 人像对比侧边展示

templates.prompt: A side-view screenshot shows two nearly identical, AI-generated street portraits against a light cyan background, displayed in two separate macOS-style image viewer windows. The layout comprises two vertical image panels, each within a rounded gray window with a top toolbar. The left window is titled "NanoBanana2," and the right window "ChatGPTImage2." Both panels present the same scene concept: a stylish young woman standing on a city street corner during prime time, framed from mid-thigh to head, her face obscured by soft rectangular blurs. She has long, wavy brown hair, a slender figure, and wears an off-the-shoulder, fitted beige long-sleeved top, high-waisted blue jeans, a delicate pendant necklace, and a large black leather bag with a gold chain slung over one shoulder. One hand holds a black smartphone near her waist. Both panels feature upscale, tree-lined city streets against a backdrop of warm sunlight filtering through the leaves, creating a shallow depth of field. The images include parked and moving vehicles, ancient stone buildings, and green traffic lights visible near the upper left corner of each picture. The two portraits are kept very similar but not identical: the left image has a slightly cooler, softer tone and a centered street perspective; the right image has a slightly warmer, brighter, and clearer tone, with stronger sunlight on the hair and a more dramatic blurring effect. Two viewer windows separated by a narrow vertical gap feature subtle shadows and a clean, technologically-driven contrast, capturing the visual contrast between two image-generating models.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张桌面侧边对比截图，在两个独立的 macOS 风格图像查看器窗口中展示两张几乎相同、由 AI 生成的街头人像，背景为浅青色。布局包含左右两个垂直图像面板，每个面板位于带有顶部工具栏的圆角灰色窗口内。左侧窗口标题以“NanoBanana2”开头，右侧窗口标题以“ChatGPTImage2”开头。两个面板均展示同一场景概念：一位时尚年轻女性站在黄金时段的城市街角，取景范围从大腿中部到头部，面部被柔和的矩形模糊块遮挡。她留着波浪形棕色长发，身材苗条，身穿露肩修身米色长袖上衣、高腰蓝色牛仔裤，佩戴精致的小吊坠项链，单肩背着一个带有金色链条的黑色大皮包。她的一只手拿着黑色智能手机，置于腰部附近。两个面板的背景均为高档绿树成荫的城市街道，温暖的阳光透过树叶洒下，具有浅景深效果，画面中有停放和行驶的车辆、古老的石砌建筑，每张图像左上角附近可见绿色的交通信号灯。保持两张人像非常相似但不完全相同：左侧图像色调稍冷、更柔和且更柔和，采用居中的街道视角；右侧图像色调稍暖、更明亮且更清晰，头发上的阳光感更强，虚化效果更具戏剧性。包含两个由窄垂直间隙隔开的查看器窗口，带有细腻的投影和简洁的科技对比展示效果，如同捕捉两个图像生成模型之间的视觉对比。

templates.title: High-end blueberry product poster

titleLocalized.zh: 高端蓝莓产品海报

templates.prompt: A high-end blueberry e-commerce poster employing a minimalist Chinese product advertising style. The main subject is a box of blueberries in a transparent plastic container, placed diagonally on a folded blue cloth at a slightly downward angle, extending from the lower left to the right. The packaging must remain realistic and consistent: a transparent square container with rounded corners, filled with deep blue blueberries, topped with a large, irregularly shaped circular label in white, light blue, and dark blue, featuring a large blueberry illustration in the center, accompanied by the brand name in elegant Chinese font. The blueberries inside the box should appear larger, fuller, and fresher, covered with fine water droplets, while maintaining a realistic overall arrangement. The background is a translucent ice-blue tabletop with a soft, misty texture, lit by cool-toned sunlight, with a few blueberries scattered around the packaging. A few blurred green leaves are added to the upper right and lower right edges to create a fresh and natural feel. A small embedded image in the upper right corner shows a top view of the original product packaging on a warm brown surface as a reference thumbnail. The left side features a Chinese-style promotional typography, including a large, dark blue calligraphic title.{argument name="headline text" default="决茗新"} Below this are two smaller lines of text:{argument name="subheadline text" default="Fresh Blueberries Natural Selection"} and{argument name="tagline text" default="Each one is a gift from nature."} Below, three function icons are arranged vertically, each with a brief Chinese description: a leaf icon represents natural ripening, a fruit icon represents juiciness, and a heart icon represents rich nutrition. Near the bottom left corner, prominent white calligraphy-style Chinese text is added.{argument name="product name" default="blueberry"} The second line of text{argument name="benefit text" default="Dietary fiber + anthocyanins"} The label also includes the small print "Net weight 125 grams." It features a cool blue tone, creating a crisp commercial lighting effect, with a glossy finish on the plastic lid, showcasing high-end supermarket packaging aesthetics. Rich in detail, it perfectly blends realistic product photography with sophisticated graphic design.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张采用简洁中式产品广告风格的高端蓝莓电商海报。主体展示一盒透明塑料盒装蓝莓，以略微俯视的角度斜向放置在折叠的蓝色布料上，从左下延伸至右侧。包装需保持写实且一致：一个带有圆角的透明方形容器，装满深蓝色蓝莓，顶部贴有大面积不规则圆形标签，配色为白色、浅蓝色和深蓝色，中心绘有一颗巨大的蓝莓插图，并配有优雅的中文字体品牌名称。盒内蓝莓需呈现得更大、更饱满、更新鲜，并覆盖细微的水珠，同时保持蓝莓整体排列的真实感。背景为带有柔和云雾纹理的通透冰蓝色桌面，光线为冷色调日光，包装周围散落着几颗蓝莓。在右上角和右下角边缘加入少量模糊的绿叶，营造清新自然的感觉。在右上角加入 1 张小型嵌入式图片，展示原始产品包装在暖棕色表面上的俯视图，作为参考缩略图。在左侧设计中式促销排版，包含一个深蓝色的大号书法标题 {argument name="headline text" default="决茗新"}，下方跟随两行较小的文案：{argument name="subheadline text" default="新鲜蓝莓 自然之选"} 和 {argument name="tagline text" default="每一颗都是自然的礼物"}。下方垂直排列 3 个功能图标及简短中文说明：叶子图标代表自然成熟，水果图标代表汁水饱满，爱心图标代表营养丰富。在左下角附近，添加醒目的白色毛笔风格中文文本 {argument name="product name" default="蓝莓"}，第二行文案 {argument name="benefit text" default="膳食纤维+花青素"}，以及一行小字“净含量 125 克”。采用冷蓝色调，呈现清脆的商业照明效果，塑料盖上有闪亮的高光，具备高端超市包装美学，细节丰富，将写实产品摄影与精致平面设计完美融合。

templates.title: Minimalist Pelican Bicycle

titleLocalized.zh: 极简鹈鹕骑自行车

templates.prompt: A minimalist vector illustration against a flat, light gray background depicts a pelican riding a bicycle. The illustration is composed of simple geometric shapes with bold, dark charcoal gray outlines. The composition is wide and centered, with the bicycle occupying the lower two-thirds of the image. The bird's head is positioned slightly forward above the handlebars, creating a deliberately abstract, illustrative feel. The bicycle is a simple black road bike silhouette with two large wheels, each with a thick outer rim and four spokes forming a cross. A straight horizontal line runs along the ground beneath the wheels. It features a triangular frame, a short black seat, and simplified crank and pedal details at the rear of the frame. The pelican is composed of simple, abstract elements: a white, round head with a small black round eye; a long, left-open beak composed of two parts: an orange triangle at the top and a pale pink throat pouch at the bottom; a short, dark curve on the top of the head; a small, separate white oval where the neck connects to the body; a large white circle above the bicycle; and an upward-sloping white wing-like shape on the upper back. Add two orange leg shapes, long, narrow rectangles extending from the body down to the frame, suggesting the bird is pedaling. Maintain the deliberate sparseness and slight surrealism of the form, similar to a logo test or simple code editor doodles, with no shadows, gradients, textures, or text, and plenty of negative space.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极简矢量风格插图，背景为平整的浅灰色，展示了一只正在骑自行车的鹈鹕。插图由简单的几何形状构成，并带有粗犷的深炭灰色轮廓。构图宽阔且居中，自行车占据了图像下方的三分之二，鸟头位于车把上方稍靠前的位置，呈现出一种刻意抽象的示意图感。自行车为简单的黑色公路车侧影，拥有 2 个大轮子，每个轮子都有厚实的外圈和 4 条形成十字形的辐条，轮下有一条笔直的水平地面线，配有三角形车架、短小的黑色车座，以及车架后部简化的曲柄和踏板细节。鹈鹕由简洁的抽象部件构成：白色的圆形头部配有一只黑色小圆眼；向左张开的长喙由两部分组成，上部为橙色三角形，下部为淡粉色喉囊；头顶有一道短小的深色曲线；颈部与身体连接处有一个独立的小白色椭圆；身体为位于自行车上方的大型白色圆形；背部上方有一个向上倾斜的白色翅膀状形状。添加 2 个橙色腿部形状，即从身体向下延伸至车架的长窄矩形，暗示鸟儿正在踩踏板。保持形态的刻意稀疏和些许超现实感，类似于 Logo 测试或简单的代码编辑器涂鸦，无阴影、无渐变、无纹理、无文字，并留有大量负空间。

templates.title: Washington Crossing-style Winter Boat View

titleLocalized.zh: 华盛顿横渡风格冬季船景

templates.prompt: A cinematic historical scene depicts a winter crossing of a frigid river at dusk. A crowded wooden rowboat carries 11 colonial-era soldiers and boatmen, navigating the dark, icy water strewn with floating ice. In the center stands a commander, upright and resolute, a heavy dark blue or black cloak draped over his light brown uniform, a black tricorn hat adding to his 18th-century generally bearing. Around him, ten men sit or crouch in the boat, dressed in weathered American Revolutionary War attire: dark coats, wool hats, cloaks, scarves, belts, and tricorn hats; several grip long wooden oars, and a musket is visible angled upwards behind the central figure. The atmosphere is somber, cold, and heroic; clothing is damp with snow, the air thick with pale breath, and the sky a stormy blue-grey. The river is wide and partially frozen, with a dark, wooded coastline in the distance, and a few faint, warm lights shimmering on the opposite bank. The composition employs a frontal perspective, framing a tight view from above the bow of the ship, making the viewer feel as if they are in the midst of this cold crossing. It utilizes low-key lighting, soft and desaturated colors, deep shadows, and a damp texture, pursuing realism and blending the tension of dramatic historical oil painting with cinematic realism to showcase ultra-detailed fabrics, wood grain, ice, and fog.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影感历史场景图，描绘了黄昏时分在冰冷的河流上进行冬季横渡的画面。画面中一艘拥挤的木制划艇上载着整整 11 名殖民地时代的士兵和船夫，正穿行在布满浮冰的深色冰水中。画面中央站着一位指挥官，身姿挺拔且坚定，深蓝色或黑色的厚重斗篷披在浅棕色军装外，头戴黑色三角帽，展现出 18 世纪将军的风范。周围 10 名男子在船中坐着或蹲伏，身着饱经风霜的美国独立战争时期服装：深色外套、羊毛帽、斗篷、围巾、皮带和三角帽；几人紧握长木桨，中央人物身后可见一支斜向上方的火枪。氛围阴郁、寒冷且英勇，衣物湿润，带有积雪，空气中弥漫着苍白的哈气，天空呈现风暴般的蓝灰色。河流宽阔且部分结冰，远处是深色的树木繁茂的海岸线，对岸闪烁着几点微弱的暖光。构图采用正面视角，从船头上方紧凑取景，让观者仿佛置身于这冰冷的横渡之中。采用低调照明，色彩柔和且去饱和，深邃阴影，潮湿质感，追求写实主义，融合了戏剧性历史油画的张力与电影级写实感，展现超细节的织物、木纹、冰块和雾气。

templates.title: Design model on the homepage of a Japanese architecture company's website.

titleLocalized.zh: 日本建筑公司网站首屏设计模型

templates.prompt: Presenting a beautiful presentation style mockup of a Japanese residential construction company website above the fold design concept on a dark charcoal gray background. In the upper right corner, place a large white rounded bubble box with 4 lines of concise sans-serif Japanese bullet points: 　　　　　,　　　　　　　おknowledgeらせを1 piece display", "-FV image は, machine を囲んで商とお客様が语しているところ", "-CTA ボタン setting". In the lower left corner, a realistic desktop website homepage is displayed, set within a large, rounded browser frame. It features a soft forest green theme, reflecting the elegant lifestyle brand image of the Japanese architecture company. The top navigation bar includes a small house logo on the far left, the company name in Japanese in the center, five horizontal navigation links at the top, and a rounded white contact button on the right. The homepage is visually divided into two main sections: the left side features a green textured panel with a layered organic leaf pattern, accompanied by brief introductory text, a multi-line large white Japanese title, a short Japanese body text, and a white rounded CTA button; the right side features a photograph in warm natural light showing two people sitting around a wooden table discussing documents and a small architectural model, with indoor plants and light from a window visible in the background. The entire website card features soft shadows, sophisticated typographic spacing, and rounded bottoms. At the bottom of the website model is a narrow, light gray bulletin board displaying an announcement with a small green icon, date, Japanese announcement text, and a subtle link on the right. A semi-transparent gray circular badge containing the Japanese text "Edit" is overlaid in the lower left corner of the website card. A small circular share/upload icon is added to the lower right corner of the website card. Overall style: High-end Japanese web design concept, realistic UI mockups, exquisite typography, green natural materials for a brand feel, and simple yet elegant composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 在一个深炭灰色的背景上，展示一个精美的演示风格模型，呈现日本住宅建筑公司网站的首屏设计概念。在右上角，放置一个大的白色圆角气泡框，内含 4 行简洁的无衬线日文要点： 「工務店のwebサイトのファーストビューを作成してください。」, 「- 緑ベース」, 「- お知らせを1件表示」, 「- FV画像は、机を囲んで業者とお客様が話しているところ」, 「- CTAボタン設置」。在左下角，展示一个逼真的桌面端网站首屏区域，置于一个大的圆角浏览器框架内，采用柔和的森林绿主题，体现日本建筑公司优雅的生活方式品牌形象。顶部导航栏最左侧包含一个小房子 Logo，中间为日文公司名称，顶部横向排列 5 个导航链接，右侧设有一个圆角白色联系按钮。首屏区域在视觉上分为两个主要部分：左侧为带有分层有机叶片图案的绿色纹理面板，配有简短的介绍文案、多行白色大号日文标题、一段简短的日文正文，以及 1 个白色圆角 CTA 按钮；右侧为一张温暖自然光下的照片，展示 2 人围坐在木桌旁讨论，桌上有文件和一个小型建筑模型，背景可见室内植物和窗外光线。整个网站卡片具有柔和的阴影、高级的排版间距和圆角底部。在网站模型底部，包含一个窄窄的浅灰色公告栏，显示 1 条公告信息，带有小绿标、日期、日文公告文本以及右侧的一个细微链接。在网站卡片的左下角叠加一个半透明的灰色圆形徽章，内含日文文本「編集」。在网站卡片的右下角，添加一个小型的圆形分享/上传图标。整体风格：高端日本网页设计概念、逼真的 UI 模型、精致的排版、绿色自然材质品牌感、简约且优雅的构图。

templates.title: Giant robot and woman on balcony

titleLocalized.zh: 巨型机器人与阳台上的女子

templates.prompt: A cinematic dystopian sci-fi scene, rendered in a widescreen, realistic style: a colossal, weathered humanoid robot dominates the right side of the frame, leaning towards a solitary woman on the balcony of a small, rusty apartment building in the far left. The robot, several stories tall, possesses a round, helmet-like head, a single visible, glowing blue eye, and a dense array of exposed mechanical joints, layered armor plates, cables, pistons, and scratched, white-gray metal covered in rust, grime, and signs of battle. Its massive right arm extends towards the woman, palm open and upward, a gesture of gentle gifting; its delicate metal fingers and enormous forearm occupy the lower center of the frame. In contrast, the woman appears tiny, standing sideways, looking up at the robot with a calm, contemplative expression; she wears a dark green hooded jacket and dark trousers, her dark hair tied in a low ponytail. She is placed on a narrow, corroded balcony with rusty railings, attached to a dilapidated concrete high-rise building; details of two more balconies and ruined, abandoned structures are visible along the left edge. The background depicts a dense, gray, rain-soaked megacity, with closely packed low-rise buildings gradually fading into the distance as modern skyscrapers and hazy mountains appear. Dramatic overcast lighting, heavy storm clouds, soft steel-grey and charcoal black tones, delicate atmospheric perspective, and a light mist create a sense of immense scale, solitude, and an unexpected tenderness between human and machine. Ultra-fine textures, realistic metallic wear, cinematic depth of field, emotional color gradation, high-contrast clouds, and a serious futuristic tone further enhance the effect.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个电影级反乌托邦科幻场景，采用宽画幅、写实风格：一个巨大的风化人形机器人占据了画面右侧，正向左侧远端一个狭小生锈公寓阳台上的孤独女子俯身。机器人高达数层楼，拥有圆形的头盔状头部，一只可见的蓝色发光眼睛，密集的裸露机械关节、分层装甲板、电缆、活塞，以及布满划痕的白灰色金属，覆盖着铁锈、污垢和战斗痕迹。它巨大的右臂向女子伸出，手掌张开并向上，呈现出温柔的馈赠姿态，其精巧的金属手指和巨大的前臂占据了画面下方中心位置。相比之下，女子显得非常渺小，侧身站立，抬头看着机器人，表情平静而沉思；她穿着深绿色连帽夹克和深色裤子，深色头发扎成低马尾。将她置于一个狭窄且腐蚀的阳台上，阳台带有生锈的栏杆，附着在一栋破败的混凝土高层建筑上，左侧边缘可见 2 层阳台及破损废弃的建筑细节。背景展示了一座密集、灰暗、被雨水浸透的超级城市，紧密排列的低层建筑逐渐隐入远处的现代摩天大楼和朦胧的山脉中。采用戏剧性的阴天光照，厚重的风暴云，柔和的钢灰色和炭黑色调，细腻的大气透视，淡淡的薄雾，营造出巨大的尺度感、孤独感以及人机之间意想不到的温柔。超精细纹理，逼真的金属磨损，电影级景深，情绪化的色彩分级，高对比度云层，以及严肃的未来主义基调。

templates.title: AI chat screenshot with ad design grid

titleLocalized.zh: 带有广告设计网格的 AI 聊天截图

templates.prompt: A screenshot of a mobile chat interface in dark mode shows the interaction results of two separate Japanese prompts and AI-generated ad designs. The background is almost black. Two large, rounded light gray chat bubbles are aligned on the right, each containing Japanese text. The first bubble reads: “日本語の幼稚園の広告影像を、トンマナ违いで4種并べて影像生して。プロデザイナーが作ったトレンドのデザインで。アスペクト比は16:9”. Below is a preview of the generated image, a rounded rectangle, showcasing a 2x2 kindergarten ad variation in soft pastel tones. The top-left panel displays a bright and airy advertisement, with a close-up of a toddler's profile on the right, soft sunlight, cream and light green tones, a handwritten Japanese headline on the left, and small circular badges and floral decorations at the bottom. The top-right panel displays a vibrant outdoor advertisement with four children running under a blue sky, a striking Japanese headline, cyan and yellow graphic decorations, and a yellow circular marker. The bottom-left panel shows a modern kindergarten campus with lawns and children playing, a large white bubble-shaped text area on the left, and soft green-beige abstract shapes. The bottom-right panel shows an illustrated large green tree with children and parents beneath it, a sky-blue background, warm family-oriented Japanese text, and soft circular decorative shapes. A small gray circular overlay button labeled "Edit" is added to the bottom left of this preview, and a semi-transparent small circular upload/share icon is added to the bottom right. Below this first preview are four small interface icons side-by-side: copy, like, dislike, and more options. The bottom of the screen displays a second right-aligned light gray chat bubble with the text: "Generate images of Japanese health food advertisements, 4 types combined. The advertisement was created by a designer. The ratio is 16:9." Below this is a preview of the generated image for the second rounded rectangle, showcasing a 2x2 health food advertisement variant. The top left panel displays a simple health advertisement in white and light green, featuring a woman's hand touching her neck, a Japanese headline about inner balance, multiple circular benefit icons, and price text. The top right panel displays a high-end supplement advertisement in black and gold, with dark packaging, glowing gold particles, luxurious serif Japanese text, and a striking red-orange price tag of 980 yen. The bottom left panel displays a soft pink advertisement for a beauty supplement with translucent floral or crystalline textures, pastel packaging, delicate Japanese text, a circular information badge, and a feminine cosmetic style. The bottom right panel displays an advertisement for natural green juice, accompanied by a tall green smoothie against a background of fresh vegetables, a green and white product box, concise Japanese health text, and a yellow circular label. In this second preview, add a small gray circular overlay button labeled "Edit" to the bottom left and a small translucent circular upload/share icon to the bottom right. The overall image should resemble a realistic screenshot of an AI-generated image-based chat app, with ample spacing between conversations, rounded corners, clear Japanese typography, and a high-end, modern UI.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张深色模式的移动端聊天界面截图，展示了两次独立的日语提示词与 AI 生成广告设计的交互结果。背景接近黑色。右侧对齐了 2 个大的圆角浅灰色聊天气泡，每个气泡内包含日语文本。第一个气泡内容为：「日本語の幼稚園の広告画像を、トンマナ違いで4種類並べて画像生成して。プロデザイナーが作ったトレンドのデザインで。アスペクト比は16:9」。下方是一个圆角矩形的生成图像预览，展示了 2x2 的幼儿园广告变体，采用柔和的粉彩色调。左上角面板展示一张明亮通风的广告，右侧为幼儿侧脸特写，柔和阳光，奶油色和淡绿色调，左侧为手写风格的日语标题，底部有小圆形徽章和花卉装饰。右上角面板展示一张充满活力的户外广告，4 名儿童在蓝天下奔跑，醒目的日语标题，青色和黄色图形装饰，以及一个黄色圆形标注。左下角面板展示现代幼儿园校园建筑，带有草坪和玩耍的儿童，左侧有大的白色气泡状文本区域，以及柔和的绿米色抽象形状。右下角面板展示一棵插画风格的大绿树，树下有儿童和家长，天蓝色背景，温馨的家庭向日语文案，以及柔和的圆形装饰形状。在此预览的左下角添加 1 个标有「編集」的小灰色圆形覆盖按钮，右下角添加 1 个半透明的小圆形上传/分享图标。在此第一个预览下方，包含 4 个并排的小界面图标：复制、点赞、点踩和更多选项。屏幕下方显示第二个右对齐的浅灰色聊天气泡，内容为：「日本語の健康食品の広告画像を、トンマナ違いで4種類並べて画像生成して。プロデザイナーが作ったトレンドのデザインで。アスペクト比は16:9」。下方是第二个圆角矩形的生成图像预览，展示了 2x2 的健康食品广告变体。左上角面板展示一张简洁的健康广告，采用白色和淡绿色，一名女性手触颈部，日语标题关于内在平衡，带有多个圆形益处图标和价格文本。右上角面板展示一张黑金配色的高端补品广告，带有深色袋装包装，发光的金色颗粒，奢华的衬线体日语文本，以及一个标有 980 円的醒目红橙色价格标签。左下角面板展示一张柔和的粉色美容补品广告，带有半透明花卉或结晶纹理，粉彩包装，精致的日语文案，圆形信息徽章和女性化化妆品风格。右下角面板展示一张天然绿汁广告，配有一杯高大的绿色果昔，背景为新鲜蔬菜，带有绿白相间的产品盒，简洁的日语健康文案，以及一个黄色圆形标注。在此第二个预览的左下角添加 1 个标有「編集」的小灰色圆形覆盖按钮，右下角添加 1 个半透明的小圆形上传/分享图标。整体图像应呈现为逼真的 AI 图像生成聊天手机应用截图，两次对话之间留有充足的间距，圆角设计，清晰的日语排版，以及高端现代的 UI。

templates.title: The numerical chessboard after e4 and e5

titleLocalized.zh: 1.e4 e5 后的数字棋盘

templates.prompt: A clear, flat, numerically-oriented chessboard is centered in the image. The chessboard is an 8x8 grid, with algebraic coordinates displayed around its edges: letters a through h at the top and bottom, and numbers 8 through 1 on the left and right. A dark charcoal gray is used for the outer background and border, while the chessboard squares alternate between light beige and soft gray-brown. The rendered graphics are simple, high-contrast 2D chess icons, with black pieces at the top and white pieces at the bottom, exhibiting a clean vector style, devoid of wood grain textures, realistic lighting, and superfluous interface elements. Demonstration 1. The precise positions after the opening moves e4 e5: Black's major pieces are located at a8 (rook), b8 (knight), c8 (bishop), d8 (queen), e8 (king), f8 (bishop), g8 (knight), and h8 (rook); Black's pawns are located at a7, b7, c7, d7, f7, g7, h7, and e5; White's pawns are located at a2, b2, c2, d2, f2, g2, h2, and e4; White's major pieces are located at a1 (rook), b1 (knight), c1 (bishop), d1 (queen), e1 (king), f1 (bishop), g1 (knight), and h1 (rook). templates.title: Realistic chess opening photos

titleLocalized.zh: 逼真的国际象棋开局照片

templates.prompt: A realistic indoor photograph shows a wooden chessboard placed on a dark wooden table, viewed from a slightly elevated frontal angle. The pieces, in the Staunton style, are positioned in the mid-opening. The board is composed of light maple and dark walnut squares with a wooden border; the pieces are glossy black and matte ivory. All 32 pieces are shown, with no captured pieces: 16 black and 16 white. The black pieces are at the far end, arranged from left to right in standard rank order: Rook, Knight, Bishop, Queen, King, Bishop, Knight, Rook, with 8 black pawns in front. The white pieces are at the near end, arranged from left to right in standard rank order: Rook, Knight, Bishop, Queen, King, Bishop, Knight, Rook, with 8 white pawns in front. Only two central pawns have been moved: one black pawn has moved two squares forward to e5, and one white pawn has moved two squares forward to e4, facing each other on adjacent central squares. The remaining pieces remain in their initial positions. Using natural window light from the right, the light and shadow are soft, and the background is a warm home environment with beige curtains and wooden cabinets. The shallow depth of field and realistic proportions present a clean digital photography quality. The composition is centered, and the checkerboard geometric structure is accurate.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张逼真的室内照片，展示了放置在深色木桌上的木制国际象棋棋盘，视角为略微抬高的正面角度，棋子采用 Staunton 风格，处于开局中期位置。棋盘由浅色枫木和深色胡桃木方格组成，带有木质边框；棋子为亮面黑色和哑光象牙色。展示全部 32 枚棋子，无被吃掉的棋子：16 枚黑色棋子和 16 枚白色棋子。黑色棋子位于远端，按标准底线顺序从左至右排列：车、马、象、后、王、象、马、车，前方有 8 枚黑色兵。白色棋子位于近端，按标准底线顺序从左至右排列：车、马、象、后、王、象、马、车，前方有 8 枚白色兵。仅移动了 2 枚中心兵：一枚黑色兵向前推进两格至 e5，一枚白色兵向前推进两格至 e4，在相邻的中心格面对面。其余棋子保持初始位置。使用来自右侧的自然窗光，光影柔和，背景为温馨的家居室内环境，配有米色窗帘和木制柜子，浅景深，比例真实，呈现干净的数码摄影质感，构图居中，棋盘几何结构准确。

templates.prompt: Create a futuristic social media ad poster for a beauty product launch with a high-gloss finish and highly saturated colors, similar in style to Canva marketing images. The composition is a centered, widescreen promotional banner with a cyan-to-purple gradient background featuring rounded corners and vibrant neon pink tones. The banner displays a half-length portrait of a young woman against a backdrop of a sci-fi glowing tunnel composed of concentric pink and white halos. Her face is partially obscured by a soft, square blur; her hair is styled in two small buns, adorned with hoop earrings, a multi-layered chain necklace, a metallic silver top, and an iridescent pink holographic jacket. She extends a hand towards the camera, holding a transparent lip balm tube close to the lens, creating a strong sense of close-up perspective. The tube's label reads "GLOW MODE Lip Balm." At the top center, a prominent neon headline reads "GLOW MODE," followed by a handwritten subtitle "Lip Balm," and below that, a smaller line reads "JUICY SHINE. HYDRATING CARE. ZERO STICKINESS." In the top left corner, add a handwritten neon label that reads "NEW!". In the top right corner, place an orange rounded sticker with the white text "gpt-image-2" and a small orange pointer label below it. To the right of the banner, include two circular badges: a pink starburst badge that reads "ONLY $14.99" and a black glowing circular badge that reads "VIRAL ON TikTok 2M+ views". In the bottom right corner, display two product elements: an upright open lip balm tube with its applicator, next to a whole peach and half a mango with green leaves, all placed on a smooth, reflective surface with pink light swirls. At the bottom center, add three labeled icons: a teardrop icon labeled "HYALURONIC HYDRATION", a fruit icon labeled "PEACH MANGO SCENT", and a rabbit icon labeled "100% VEGAN & CRUELTY-FREE". In the lower left corner of the banner, add a vertically stacked row of three social media buttons, each containing a platform icon and account: TikTok account "#GlowMode", Instagram account " @LunaBeatty ", and Snapchat account " @LunaGlow ". Below them is a glowing QR code card with the handwritten text "Shop Now!" and an arrow pointing to the QR code. In the lower left outer corner of the banner, place a slanted cyan rounded label that reads "Canva AI", next to a small cyan paper airplane-style decoration. The overall design incorporates glossy reflections, lens flares, glows, neon outlines, glitter, and a sophisticated advertising style, blending clean commercial product photography with futuristic graphic design.

templates.title: Flower and Chick Trio Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 花卉小鸡三人组肖像

templates.prompt: A whimsical studio portrait showcases three stylized chicks composed entirely of layered petals and flowers. They stand side-by-side against a light gray background, bathed in soft, even light light with subtle shadows on the ground. The chick on the left, cream and ivory, is composed of light-colored petals and small white wildflowers. It has a surprised expression, large, round, comical eyes, a small, light-colored comb, drooping pink wattles, and slender yellow legs. The middle chick is plump and rounded, composed of dense pink petals and flowers in varying shades. It has a serious and slightly disgruntled expression, squinting eyes, a large, light-colored beak, oversized pink wattles, and a pink flower-like comb drooping from its forehead. The chick on the right is bright orange and gold, composed of vibrant orange petals and marigold-like flowers, dotted with a few green leaves and yellow shoots. It has a sleepy and disdainful expression, half-closed eyes, a tall, reddish-orange comb, red wattles, and yellow legs. These three chicks are highly detailed, cute, quirky, and handcrafted, with realistic floral patterns arranged into convincing chicken body structures. The use of centered composition, full-body perspective, and clean, minimalist background presents an exquisite and fantastical editorial photography aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满奇趣的摄影棚肖像，展示了 3 只完全由层叠花瓣和花朵构成的风格化小鸡，它们并排站在浅灰色纯色背景前，光线柔和均匀，地面带有淡淡的阴影。左侧的小鸡呈奶油色和象牙色，由浅色花瓣和白色小野花构成，表情惊讶，有着非常大的圆形滑稽眼睛、小巧的浅色鸡冠、下垂的粉色肉垂和细长的黄色鸡腿。中间的小鸡圆润蓬松，由深浅不一的浓密粉色花瓣和花朵构成，表情严肃且略带不满，眯着眼睛，喙部较大且呈浅色，有着超大的粉色肉垂，以及垂在前额的类似粉色花朵的鸡冠。右侧的小鸡呈亮橙色和金色，由鲜艳的橙色花瓣和类似万寿菊的花朵构成，点缀着几片绿叶和黄色嫩枝，表情困倦且不屑，半眯着眼睛，有着高耸的红橙色鸡冠、红色肉垂和黄色鸡腿。让这 3 只小鸡都具备高度细节，可爱、古怪且具有手工质感，将逼真的花卉纹理排列成令人信服的鸡体结构，采用居中构图、全身视角、干净简约的背景，呈现出精致的奇幻编辑摄影美学。
