templates.title: Office portrait of the reviewed research paper

titleLocalized.zh: 经过审查的研究论文办公室肖像

templates.prompt: A realistic office photo shows a young man sitting indoors, holding a printed research paper towards the camera. His face is completely obscured by a solid brown rectangle. He has short dark brown hair and wears a solid dark charcoal gray crew neck sweater. The paper in his hands is a vertical, white letter-sized document, clearly visible and positioned in front of his torso. The document is titled "DFlash: A High-Speed, Low-Latency, and High-Endurance Flash Memory Technology for Next-Generation Storage Systems." Below are the author lines "DFlash Research Team" and "DFlash Inc." The page displays four visible text sections: "Abstract," "1. Introduction," "2. DFlash Technology Overview," and "2.1 Dual Charge-Trapping Architecture," formatted in formal academic paper style with dense black serif font. The background is a softly blurred modern office lobby with warm ambient lighting, beige walls, glass partitions, sofas, and indoor plants. A black OpenAI logo and text label are mounted on the upper left wall. The composition is a mid-range shot, with the subject slightly tilted to the right to keep the OpenAI logo visible. It features shallow depth of field, soft natural office lighting, a refined photorealistic style, subtle warm tones, and rich detail in the hands, paper, sweater texture, and interior environment. The overall image is clean and believable, resembling a snapshot of a news or announcement.{argument name="document title" default="DFlash: A High-Speed, Low-Latency, and High-Endurance Flash Memory Technology for Next-Generation Storage Systems"} As the title of the paper,{argument name="company logo text" default="OpenAI"} As a brand logo on the wall.{argument name="sweater color" default="dark charcoal"} As the main color of the clothing, and{argument name="censor block color" default="medium tan"} Used as the color for facial camouflage blocks.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实的职场办公室照片，一名年轻男子坐在室内，双手将一份打印的研究论文举向镜头。他的脸部被一个中棕色的实心矩形遮挡块完全遮住。他留着深棕色短发，身穿一件纯色深炭灰色圆领毛衣。手中的论文是一份纵向的白色信纸大小文档，清晰可见并位于躯干前方中央。文档标题为“DFlash: A High-Speed, Low-Latency, and High-Endurance Flash Memory Technology for Next-Generation Storage Systems”。下方是作者行“DFlash Research Team”和“DFlash Inc.”。页面显示 4 个可见文本部分：“Abstract”、“1. DFlash Technology Overview”和“2.1 Dual Charge-Trapping Architecture”，采用正式的学术论文排版，配以密集的黑色衬线字体。背景为柔和模糊的现代办公室大厅，配有温暖的环境光、米色墙壁、玻璃隔断、沙发、室内植物，左上角墙上安装有黑色的 OpenAI 标志和文字标识。构图为中景直拍，主体略微偏向右侧，以便 OpenAI 标志保持可见。浅景深，柔和的自然办公光线，精致的照片级写实风格，微妙的暖色调，手部、纸张、毛衣纹理和室内环境细节丰富。保持整体画面整洁、可信，呈现出抓拍的新闻或公告照片效果。使用 {argument name="document title" default="DFlash: A High-Speed, Low-Latency, and High-Endurance Flash Memory Technology for Next-Generation Storage Systems"} 作为论文标题，{argument name="company logo text" default="OpenAI"} 作为墙面品牌标识，{argument name="sweater color" default="dark charcoal"} 作为主体服装颜色，以及 {argument name="censor block color" default="medium tan"} 作为面部遮挡块颜色。

templates.title: Cats transformed into human portraits

titleLocalized.zh: 猫咪变身人类肖像

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, transform the cat into a realistic human portrait while maintaining the same languid pose, camera angle, composition, and the same plush turquoise chair background. Inspired by the cat's orange and white markings, translate them into a human appearance: portray a fair-skinned young woman with warm ginger-yellow hair and a soft, serene expression. Have her wear comfortable off-white loungewear: a loose-fitting knitted V-neck sweater and cream-colored drawstring trousers, sitting naturally in a relaxed posture. A photorealistic, soft indoor natural lighting is required, aiming for a magazine-style lifestyle photography feel.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图像，将猫咪转换为写实的人类肖像，同时保持相同的慵懒姿势、摄像机角度、构图以及相同的毛绒绿松石色椅子背景。以猫咪的橙白相间花纹为灵感，将其转化为人类外观：将人物设定为一位皮肤白皙的年轻女性，拥有温暖的姜黄色头发和柔和、平静的表情。让她穿着舒适的米白色居家服：1 件宽松的针织 V 领毛衣和 1 条奶油色抽绳长裤，身体自然地坐在椅子上，姿态放松。要求照片级写实，采用柔和的室内自然光，呈现杂志生活方式摄影的质感。

templates.title: Melancholy Coastal Road Trip Portraits

titleLocalized.zh: 忧郁海岸公路旅行人像

templates.prompt: A candid photo with a cinematic feel, showing a {argument name="person" default="young women"} Standing in a damp, overcast coastal roadside parking area. Shot from behind and slightly to the side, she is looking back at the camera. Her dark, tousled hair is loosely tied in a bun, strands ruffled by the wind, her facial features soft and blurred. She wears two visible garments: a worn tan canvas jacket and medium blue jeans. She is relaxed, one hand near or inside her pocket. The background is a melancholic cliffside roadside viewpoint, with dark rocky mountains on the left and a greyish-white sea stretching into the distance on the right, the sky overcast and pale. The right edge of the frame includes a light-colored late 1980s or early 1990s sedan parked, its rear facing the viewer, and a large rock railing near the viewpoint. The dark, wet asphalt road, with blurred parking lines, suggests recent rain. Using natural light, the soft, cool tones, with slight film grain, soft focus, and a light mist, evoke a nostalgic 35mm road trip photography aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影感十足的抓拍照片，画面中一位 {argument name="person" default="年轻女性"} 站在阴天湿漉漉的沿海路边停车区。视角从后方及侧后方拍摄，她正回头看向镜头。她留着深色凌乱的头发，扎成松散的发髻，发丝被风吹乱，面部轮廓柔和且模糊。她身穿两件可见的衣物：一件磨损的棕褐色帆布夹克和一条中蓝色牛仔裤。她姿态放松，一只手放在口袋附近或口袋里。背景是忧郁的悬崖公路观景台，左侧是深色的岩石山脉，右侧是延伸至远方的灰白色大海，天空阴沉且泛白。画面右侧边缘包含 1 辆停放的浅色 80 年代末或 90 年代初轿车，车尾朝向观众，观景台附近有 1 个大型岩石护栏。沥青路面深暗潮湿，带有模糊的停车线，暗示着刚下过雨。采用自然光，色调柔和偏冷，带有轻微的胶片颗粒感、柔焦效果、淡淡的薄雾，呈现出怀旧的 35mm 公路旅行摄影美学。

templates.title: Surreal Terrace Portrait: Crow and Dog

titleLocalized.zh: 超现实露台肖像：乌鸦与小狗

templates.prompt: A slightly surreal yet photorealistic portrait centers on a figure seated in a quiet courtyard or terrace. The figure wears a fitted white long-sleeved turtleneck top with delicate pink floral patterns and a girl illustration on the chest, paired with loose-fitting cream-colored floral trousers. The figure sits on a simple white metal chair, cradling a fluffy miniature poodle with curly grey-white fur and distinctive orange-dyed ears. A black raven or crow perches on the figure's dark hair bun, facing left, its posture balanced and serene, as if it belongs there. The static, direct, and formal pose creates a whimsical, dryly humorous feel to the family portrait. The scene's background is a textured gray-white stucco wall, featuring four striking decorative elements: a brown sun-shaped wall decoration in the upper left, a small wall-mounted flower stand on the left (with bird figurines and hanging flowers), a tall arched window or mural on the right (showing a bright blue sky and soft white clouds), and a white-based flowerpot in the lower right (with long green leaves and decorated with two pink flamingo figurines). The lower left includes a few stone edges and dark green plants, with brown ceramic tiles on the floor. The lighting is soft natural sunlight, slightly overcast, with soft colors and a shallow depth of field, giving it a vintage editorial feel. The composition should be vertical, showing the fully seated figure, a direct frontal shot, balanced and with a quiet, eerie quality. The main figure can be customized.{argument name="person" default="A middle-aged woman"} Bird species{argument name="bird type" default="Black Crow"} Dog breeds{argument name="dog type" default="Miniature Poodle Mix"} dog ear color{argument name="dog ear color" default="orange color"} and clothing color{argument name="outfit colors" default="White and faded pink flowers"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 一张略带超现实感但照片级逼真的肖像，画面中心为一名坐在安静庭院或露台上的角色，身穿修身白色长袖高领上衣，胸前印有精致的粉色花卉图案和女孩插画，搭配宽松的奶油色花卉长裤。该角色坐在简单的白色金属椅上，怀里抱着一只毛茸茸的小型贵宾犬；小狗有着卷曲的灰白色毛发，耳朵被染成了独特的橙色。角色深色的发髻上停着一只黑色的乌鸦或渡鸦，面朝左侧，姿态平衡且平静，仿佛它本就属于那里。主体姿势静止、直接且正式，营造出一种怪诞的冷幽默家庭肖像感。场景背景为质感十足的灰白色灰泥墙，包含 4 个显著的装饰性背景元素：左上方 1 个棕色太阳形墙饰，左侧 1 个小型壁挂式花架（带有小鸟摆件和垂吊花卉），右侧 1 个高大的拱形窗户或壁画（展示着明亮的蓝天和柔和的白云），右下方 1 个白色底座花盆（种有长长的绿叶，并装饰有 2 个粉色火烈鸟摆件）。左下方包含少许石边和深色绿植，地面为棕色瓷砖。光线为柔和的自然日光，略显阴天，色彩柔和，景深较浅，具有复古编辑摄影的质感。构图应为竖构图，展示完整的坐姿人物，正面直拍，平衡且带有一种安静的诡异感。可自定义主要人物 {argument name="person" default="一位中年女性"}、鸟类品种 {argument name="bird type" default="黑乌鸦"}、狗的品种 {argument name="dog type" default="小型贵宾混血犬"}、狗耳朵颜色 {argument name="dog ear color" default="橙色"} 以及服装色调 {argument name="outfit colors" default="白色和褪色的粉色花卉"}。

templates.title: Computer labs in the early 21st century and ChatGPT

titleLocalized.zh: 21 世纪初的计算机实验室与 ChatGPT

templates.prompt: A documentary-style snapshot, the scene is{argument name="setting" default="High school computer lab classroom"} Inside, ten students sit in front of rows of bulky, off-white CRT desktop computers. The viewpoint is from the rear left of the classroom, with a slightly wide angle. The image should have the feel of a snapshot taken with a consumer-grade digital camera in the early 21st century, with direct flash effects, soft noise, and slightly warm indoor fluorescent lighting. A timestamp is visible in the lower right corner.{argument name="timestamp" default="02 18 04"} In the left foreground, a student wearing a navy blue track jacket with white stripes on the cuffs is pointing at a CRT monitor; in the center foreground, a student with short, spiky hair is sitting with his back to the camera, wearing an oversized gray hoodie; in the right foreground, a blonde student with a ponytail is typing on a keyboard, wearing a light blue long-sleeved shirt with dark horizontal stripes on the sleeves; on the far right, another student with dark curly hair is sitting at a workstation. Several other students are sitting in the middle and back rows, all facing the screen. The ChatGPT interface is clearly displayed on the monitor, with the visible title being {argument name="screen title" default="ChatGPT"} Below is a simple prompt text. The room has beige walls and a suspended ceiling. Several motivational posters hang on the walls: four clearly visible posters hang on the back wall, with content including {argument name="poster one" default="YOU CAN DO HARD THINGS"} The image should include the words "BE KIND ONLINE," "THINK BEFORE YOU CLICK," and a large poster titled "KEYBOARD SHORTCUTS" with a list below. It should also include the projects, the classroom door in the background, swivel chairs, a white keyboard and mouse, and a backpack on the floor next to a table in the foreground on the right. People's faces should be partially obscured or softly anonymized to maintain the feel of a real classroom photograph while focusing on the scene of students using ChatGPT in an old-fashioned computer lab.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张纪实风格的抓拍照片，场景为 {argument name="setting" default="高中计算机实验室教室"}，室内有 10 名学生正坐在成排笨重的米白色 CRT 台式机前，视角位于教室左后方，呈轻微广角。画面应呈现出 21 世纪初使用消费级数码相机拍摄的快照感，带有直接闪光灯效果、柔和的噪点、略显温暖的室内荧光灯光，右下角带有时间戳 {argument name="timestamp" default="02 18 04"}。左侧前景中，一名身穿海军蓝运动夹克、袖口带有白色条纹的学生正指向一台 CRT 显示器；中央前景中，一名留着短刺猬头的学生穿着超大号灰色卫衣，背对镜头坐着；右侧前景中，一名扎着马尾辫的金发学生穿着浅蓝色长袖上衣，袖子上有深色横条纹，正在键盘上打字；最右侧，另一名留着深色卷发的学生坐在工作站前。其他几名学生坐在中间和后排，全都面向屏幕。显示器上清晰地显示着 ChatGPT 界面，可见的标题为 {argument name="screen title" default="ChatGPT"}，下方是简单的提示词文本。房间墙壁为米色，配有吊顶天花板，墙上挂着多张励志海报：后墙上挂着 4 张清晰可见的海报，内容分别为 {argument name="poster one" default="YOU CAN DO HARD THINGS"}、“BE KIND ONLINE”、“THINK BEFORE YOU CLICK”，以及一张标题为“KEYBOARD SHORTCUTS”的大海报，下方列有清单。画面中还应包含项目、后方的教室门、转椅、白色键盘和鼠标，以及右侧前景桌旁地板上的背包。人物面部应部分遮挡或进行柔和的匿名处理，在保留真实课堂照片质感的同时，将焦点集中在学生在老式计算机实验室中使用 ChatGPT 的场景上。

templates.title: Luxury fashion book interior pages

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华时尚书籍内页

templates.prompt: A high-end fashion editorial photograph showcases an open, large-format hardcover magazine or art book, laid flat on a clean, off-white surface, taken from a top-down perspective. The double-page spread contains two full-page portraits of the same elegant woman, her face softened by a square blur, creating a sense of privacy. On the left page, she stands before a light-colored stone or concrete building wall, wearing a {argument name="dress color" default="Soft slate lime"} The structured long-sleeved dress features a fitted corset, round neck, clean-cut seams, and an exaggerated, sculptural bell-shaped skirt; the slightly low angle of the shot makes her neck appear long and her posture elegantly sculpted. On the right page, she wears a dramatic {argument name="second dress color" default="black"} A backless evening gown, with a large open back, wide shoulder straps, and a voluminous, flowing skirt, stands in a dimly lit, emotionally charged room against a backdrop of a classic paneled wall or door. The design employs a luxurious fashion magazine style: minimalist composition, soft colors, natural lighting, delicate shadows, realistic paper texture, clearly visible spine binding, slightly curved pages, and crisp printing details. The overall atmosphere is sophisticated, haute couture-like, cinematic yet understated, resembling the pages of a top-tier fashion magazine.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高端时尚编辑摄影作品，展示了一本打开的大幅面精装杂志或艺术书籍，平放在干净的灰白色表面上，采用正上方俯视视角。双页内页包含 2 张同一位优雅女性的全页肖像，她的面部被柔和的方形模糊处理，营造出一种隐私遮蔽的视觉感。左页中，她站在浅色石材或混凝土建筑墙前，身穿一件 {argument name="dress color" default="柔和板岩灰"} 的结构感长袖连衣裙，配有合身紧身胸衣、圆领、剪裁利落的接缝以及夸张的雕塑感钟形裙摆；拍摄角度略低，使她的颈部显得修长，姿态如雕塑般优雅。右页中，她身穿一件戏剧性的 {argument name="second dress color" default="黑色"} 露背晚礼服，背部大面积镂空，配有宽肩带和蓬松的宽大裙摆，站在昏暗、情绪化的室内，背景是一面经典的镶板墙或门。采用奢华时尚杂志风格、极简构图、柔和色调、自然光感、精致阴影、逼真的纸张纹理、清晰可见的书脊装订线、略微弯曲的页面以及清晰的印刷细节。整体氛围高级、具有高定感、电影质感且低调，宛如顶级时尚杂志的内页。

templates.title: Soft-light portrait of a young woman in a café

titleLocalized.zh: 咖啡馆柔光年轻女性肖像

templates.prompt: A realistic indoor portrait of a slender young East Asian woman with long hair.{argument name="hair color" default="Long black hair"} She has soft, wavy hair and sits on a smooth concrete bench in a minimalist café. Facing the camera, her posture is shy and gentle, her shoulders slightly turned, her hands naturally folded on her knees, and her ankles crossed. She wears a fitted white cropped T-shirt with small Japanese characters printed in the center.{argument name="shirt text" default="afternoon"} The outfit is paired with a dark high-waisted denim mini skirt. Natural light from the window on the left creates soft, diffused shadows and a tranquil, gentle atmosphere. The background showcases a modern, warm-toned café, with a window frame in the upper left, a wooden counter on the right with a black bar stool, a woven basket on the floor, and a shelf displaying glass bottles in the distance, all in soft focus. The vertical composition, mid-range full-body shot, eye-level perspective, shallow depth of field, understated editorial fashion photography, neutral tones, soft skin tones, a quiet, candid atmosphere, and a highly realistic style.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实室内肖像照，主角是一位身材苗条的年轻东亚女性，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色长发"} 的柔顺波浪卷发，坐在极简风格咖啡馆内的平滑水泥长椅上。她面向镜头，姿态羞涩温柔，双肩微侧，双手自然交叠放在膝盖上，双脚脚踝交叉。她身穿一件修身白色短款 T 恤，中间印有小巧的日文文字“{argument name="shirt text" default="午後"}”，下身搭配深色高腰牛仔短裙。左侧的自然窗光营造出柔和、漫射的阴影以及宁静、柔和的氛围。背景展示了一间现代暖色调咖啡馆，左上方有一个窗框，右侧有一个木质柜台，配有一张黑色高脚凳，地板上放着一个编织篮，远处有一个摆放着玻璃瓶的架子，处于柔焦状态。竖向构图，中景全身取景，平视视角，浅景深，低调的编辑类时尚摄影，中性色调，柔和肤色，安静的抓拍氛围，高度写实。

On the left, place a prominent bold Japanese subheading “AI を使いこなす开発者へ”, below which is a very prominent large headline…{argument name="main title" default="ClaudeCode Training"} The title is in bold, sans-serif, dark navy blue font, with "ClaudeCode" in a particularly large size, followed by the Japanese word in the same style. Below the title, a horizontal gradient bar from dark blue to light blue contains the Japanese text in bold white:{argument name="subheadline text" default="AI-era development will become your powerful tool."} In the bottom left corner, three circular navy blue icon badges are arranged horizontally, each with a brief two-line Japanese explanation to the right. Badge 1 displays a code symbol.</> The first badge displays the text "The basics of Claude Code." The second badge shows a lightbulb icon with the text "AI skills to improve business efficiency." Behind him, layered geometric navy blue and blue diagonal shapes sweep from the upper and lower right corners, along with a dark blue tech-themed panel with light code lines and glowing curly braces {}. templates.title: Countryball Strait of Hormuz standoff

titleLocalized.zh: Countryball 霍尔木兹海峡对峙

templates.prompt: A meticulously crafted, satirical illustration of the countryball meme, depicting {argument name="waterway name" default="Strait of Hormuz"} The passage is depicted as a very narrow sea passage between two steep rock walls, rendered in a sophisticated digital cartoon style with dramatic shadows and rock textures. In the central foreground, two Countryballs are positioned directly in the narrow channel, blocking each other's path, allowing only one to pass at a time. The one on the left is an American Countryball with angry, squinting eyes, adorned with the American flag, and wearing a dark blue baseball cap with "USA" in large white letters. The one on the right is an Iranian Countryball with angry, squinting eyes, adorned with the Iranian flag and coat of arms, and wearing a green and white headband with the Korean phrase "저항은우리의권리" (Resistance is our right) printed on it. Above each ball is a white speech bubble with a bold black outline, totaling two bubbles, each containing the same message.{argument name="speech text" default="길!"} (Road!), written in bold Korean, as if neither side is willing to give way. Two balls are shown locked in a stalemate at a bottleneck, nose to nose. On the left cliff, a wooden sign is placed with "호르무즈해협" and "Strait of Hormuz" written in Korean and English. On the right cliff, a warning sign is placed with Persian writing at the top and a red warning triangle below, indicating that only one person can pass at a time. In the lower left corner, a black oil drum marked "OIL" is placed, surrounded by dark oil spills. In the lower right corner, a black mine with Persian writing attached to a chain is placed. In the background beyond the narrow passage, an open sea is shown, with three ships in the distance, including at least one large oil tanker, and wisps of black smoke rising into the sky in the distance. It adopts a tense yet humorous geopolitical meme tone, with a centered composition, a level perspective, soft sunlight, slightly soft realistic colors, clear outlines, and ensures that all text is highly readable.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅细致的讽刺性 Countryball meme 插画，描绘了 {argument name="waterway name" default="霍尔木兹海峡"}，将其表现为两座陡峭岩壁之间非常狭窄的海上通道，采用精致的数字卡通风格，具有戏剧性的阴影和岩石纹理。在中心前景处，正好有 2 个 Countryball 在狭窄的航道中互相阻挡，导致只有一方可以通过。左侧是一个美国 Countryball，有着愤怒的眯眯眼，身上画着美国国旗，戴着一顶深蓝色棒球帽，上面用白色大字写着“USA”。右侧是一个伊朗 Countryball，有着愤怒的眯眯眼，身上画着伊朗国旗和国徽，侧面系着一条绿白相间的头带；头带上印有韩文“저항은 우리의 권리”（抵抗是我们的权利）。每个球上方各有 1 个带有粗黑轮廓的白色对话气泡，总共 2 个气泡，内容均为 {argument name="speech text" default="길!"}（路！），用粗体韩文书写，仿佛双方都不肯让步。展示两个球在瓶颈处面对面僵持，鼻尖对着鼻尖。在左侧悬崖上，放置 1 个木牌，上面用韩文和英文写着：“호르무즈 해협”和“Strait of Hormuz”。在右侧悬崖上，放置 1 个警告标志，顶部有波斯语文字，下方有一个红色警告三角形，表示仅限一人通过。在左下角，放置 1 个标有“OIL”的黑色油桶，周围有深色的溢油。在右下角，放置 1 个带有波斯语文字并连接着铁链的黑色水雷。在狭窄通道后的背景中，展示开阔的海域，有 3 艘远处的船只，包括至少 1 艘大型油轮，远处有淡淡的黑烟升入天空。采用紧张但幽默的地缘政治 meme 基调，居中构图，平视视角，柔和的日光，略显柔和的写实色彩，清晰的轮廓，并确保所有文字具有高可读性。

templates.title: National Globe Strait of Hormuz Standoff

titleLocalized.zh: 国家球霍尔木兹海峡对峙

templates.prompt: A simple, cartoonish political humor illustration of a national ball, showcasing{argument name="location label" default="Strait of Hormuz"} The current state of the narrow passageway. A wide horizontal composition is used, employing bright, flat colors, bold black outlines, and a clean, hand-drawn infographic style. In the foreground, two spheres stand side-by-side on an extremely narrow sandy land bridge, flanked by rocks, highlighting the predicament of only allowing one person to pass at a time. On the left is a sphere painted with the American flag.{argument name="left country" default="USA"} The national ball, wearing black sunglasses and a brown cowboy hat, faces another ball with unwavering determination. On the right is a ball painted with the Iranian flag.{argument name="right country" default="Iran"} The national ball, wearing a dark headscarf-like hat, glares angrily and refuses to move. Add a large white speech bubble next to each national ball, filling both bubbles with the same bold Korean text:{argument name="speech bubble text" default="길"} In the mid-ground and background, a busy blue sea is shown, crowded with a total of nine vessels: two gray American warships on the far left, a Chinese submarine flying the Chinese flag, four oil tankers carrying different flags lined up in a row on the left-center and in the center, and two gray warships flying small American flags near a narrow passage. In the upper right corner, a large Iranian flag is superimposed along the coastline. Beige land is drawn around the waterway to present a simplified map view of the Strait of Hormuz. At the bottom center, a bold caption in Korean and English is added on the sand:{argument name="bottom caption" default="호르무즈 해협 (Hormuz Strait)"} The overall atmosphere should be ironic, tense, and memetic, while remaining visually appealing and easy to read.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张风格简洁的国家球卡通政治幽默插图，展示了 {argument name="location label" default="霍尔木兹海峡"} 作为狭窄咽喉要道的现状。采用宽幅横向构图，使用明亮的平涂色彩、粗黑轮廓线以及干净的手绘信息图风格。在前景中，放置 2 个国家球，它们肩并肩站在一条极窄的沙质陆桥上，两侧布满岩石，凸显出一次只能通过一人的窘境。左侧是涂有美国国旗的 {argument name="left country" default="美国"} 国家球，戴着黑色墨镜和棕色牛仔帽，以固执的态度面对另一个球。右侧是涂有伊朗国旗的 {argument name="right country" default="伊朗"} 国家球，戴着深色头巾状帽子，眼睛愤怒地斜视，同样拒绝移动。在每个国家球旁边各添加一个巨大的白色对话气泡，并在两个气泡中填入相同的韩语粗体字：{argument name="speech bubble text" default="길"}。在中景和背景中，展示一片繁忙的蓝色海域，总共挤满了 9 艘船只：最左侧有 2 艘灰色美国军舰，1 艘挂着中国国旗的中国潜艇，中左侧和中心排成一列的 4 艘载有不同国旗的油轮，以及狭窄通道附近 2 艘挂着小型美国国旗的灰色军舰。在右上角，沿海岸线叠加一面巨大的伊朗国旗。在水道周围绘制米色陆地，以呈现霍尔木兹海峡的简化地图视图。在底部中心，于沙地上添加一行韩语和英语的粗体标题：{argument name="bottom caption" default="호르무즈 해협 (Hormuz Strait)"}。整体氛围应具有讽刺性、紧张感和模因感，同时在视觉上保持可爱且易于阅读。

templates.title: Melancholy style obscuring indoor selfie portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 忧郁风格遮挡室内自拍肖像

templates.prompt: A realistic, indoor self-portrait of a young East Asian man, half-length. He sits by a large, modern window in a high-rise apartment or hotel room, bathed in soft sunlight. He has {argument name="hair color" default="black"} His hair was thick and slightly messy, parted in the middle, with natural volume at the forehead and sides. He was slender, with a long neck and fair, delicate skin. He was wearing a {argument name="shirt color" default="black"} A matte cotton or poplin shirt, slightly loose-fitting, with a few buttons undone at the top of the collar, creating a deep V-neck and a casual, relaxed style. The camera is used to capture a close-up shot from a natural selfie angle, in a vertical composition, including the shoulders, chest, neck, and head. His face is completely obscured by a large rectangular blurred or mosaic block in the center, but his ears, jawline, neck, and hair are clearly visible. The overall atmosphere is understated, melancholic, and elegant, with soft, neutral tones. Soft window light streams in from the right, creating delicate shadows and a realistic social media selfie feel. Background details include a beige wall on the left, a small dark-colored control panel, a vertical metal strip or light fixture edge, and two tall, dark-framed windows on the right, offering a blurred city skyline view. Realistic smartphone photography, a clean, modern interior environment, shallow depth of field, natural skin texture, subtle contrast, the smile obscured by the obscuring block, minimalist post-processing, a stylish and authentic personal selfie.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实的室内自拍风格肖像，拍摄对象为一名年轻东亚男性，半身像。他坐在高层公寓或酒店房间的一扇大型现代窗户旁，沐浴在柔和的日光中。他留着 {argument name="hair color" default="black"} 的头发，发质浓密且略显凌乱，中分，额头和两侧有自然的蓬松感。体型偏瘦，颈部修长，肤色白皙细腻。他穿着一件 {argument name="shirt color" default="black"} 的哑光棉质或府绸衬衫，版型略微宽松，领口上方几颗纽扣解开，呈现出深 V 开领和随性的休闲风格。相机以自然的自拍角度近距离拍摄，竖构图，画面包含肩膀、胸部、颈部和头部。他的面部被一个位于中心的大型矩形模糊或马赛克遮挡块完全遮住，但耳朵、下颌边缘、颈部和头发清晰可见。整体氛围低调、忧郁且优雅，色调柔和中性，右侧透入柔和的窗光，阴影细腻，具有真实的社交媒体自拍感。背景细节包括左侧的一面米色墙壁、一个小型的深色墙面控制面板、一条垂直的金属饰条或灯具边缘，以及右侧两扇高大的深色边框窗户，窗外是模糊的城市天际线。写实风格智能手机摄影，整洁的现代室内环境，浅景深，自然的皮肤纹理，微妙的对比度，因遮挡块而看不到笑容，极简后期处理，时尚且真实的个人自拍。

templates.title: Transform food photos into Japanese posters

titleLocalized.zh: 将美食照片转化为日式海报

templates.prompt: Using the provided udon noodle reference image, transform it into a simple, printable Japanese restaurant promotional poster, retaining the food photo itself as the core element. Vertically expand the composition to a vertical flyer layout, add a light icy blue seasonal background with a subtle watercolor texture and elegant wave pattern, and overlay decorative green maple leaves to create an early summer atmosphere. Add 5 Japanese text elements: a blue circular badge in the top left corner that reads "初夏のおすすめ" (Hatsusumi no Osusumi); two prominent large calligraphy titles at the top, "とり天" (Toriten) and "ざるうどん" (Zarudon); a small red vertical stamp near the titles that reads "自慢のとり天" (Jiman no Toriten); a semi-transparent blue vertical text block in the top right corner that reads "ひんやり、つるり。さっぱり、満たされる。" (Hinyari, tsururi. Sappari, mantasareru.); and a price block in the bottom right corner that reads "980円税込" (980 yen tax included), with a blue brushstroke banner below that that reads "大盛り無料!" (Daishori no ryo!). Add a short 4-line Japanese text in the bottom left corner, describing the dish in a menu poster style. The original food plating and realistic photography effects are retained, but appropriately optimized for advertising needs: making them brighter, more appealing, clearer, and with high contrast. The overall design looks like a beautifully crafted restaurant poster created from a casually taken food photograph.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的乌冬面参考图片，将其转化为一张简洁、可印刷的日式餐厅宣传海报，并保留美食照片本身作为核心主体。将构图垂直扩展为纵向传单布局，添加带有微妙水彩质感和淡雅波浪纹样的浅冰蓝色季节性背景，并叠加装饰性的绿色枫叶，营造出初夏的氛围。添加 5 处日文文本元素：左上角一个写有“初夏のおすすめ”的蓝色圆形徽章；顶部两行醒目的大号毛笔书法标题，分别为“とり天”和“ざるうどん”；标题附近一个写有“自慢のとり天”的小型红色垂直印章；右上角一个半透明的蓝色垂直文案块，写有“ひんやり、つるり。さっぱり、満たされる。”；右下角一个写有“980円 税込”的价格块，下方配有写着“大盛り無料！”的蓝色笔触横幅。在左下角添加一段简短的 4 行日文正文，以菜单海报风格描述这道菜品。保留原始的餐点摆盘和写实摄影效果，但针对广告需求进行适当优化：使其更明亮、更诱人、更清晰且具有高对比度。使整体设计看起来像是由一张随手拍摄的美食照片制作而成的精美餐厅海报。

templates.title: Soft-toned anime promotional poster

titleLocalized.zh: 柔和色调动漫宣传海报

templates.prompt: Create a bright and soft-toned anime promotional poster for a fictional slice-of-life comedy series. The composition should be a single-page Japanese anime key visual, featuring a female protagonist at the center, surrounded by five illustrated moments and blocks of Japanese promotional text, presenting the style of an anime promotional poster. The protagonist is {argument name="character name" default="Mochiko-san"} A cute anime girl with short, white hair that fades to silver at the ends, bright blue eyes, soft blush, and low twin ponytails tied near her shoulders. She wears an oversized black hood shaped like a lop-eared dog, round silver goggles, a black choker with metal embellishments, and a futuristic black and white off-the-shoulder crop top adorned with a small badge on the chest, paired with separate black arm sleeves, super-short white shorts with black trim, a single leg strap, and a small side bag at her waist. Her body proportions are youthful and anime-style, slender and petite, with a slightly exaggerated bust, presenting a delicate modern moe character design. She stands in the center of the frame, a gentle smile on her face, holding a pen in one hand as if preparing to make a mistake while writing, facing the viewer with a confident and sweet demeanor. Five supporting illustrations of the same character are placed around her: 1) Top left, a chibi-style scene where she is outdoors, arms outstretched, mouth agape, dramatically crying; 2) Bottom left, a comedic scene where she is face down on a table or floor, exhausted and flustered, surrounded by scattered papers; 3) Top right, a half-body portrait where she holds up a sign with Japanese writing on it, looking apologetic; 4) Bottom right, a cheerful half-body portrait with eyes closed and a raised fist in encouragement; 5) A small background portrait behind the text in the top right corner, used as a character label. Two small white mascot creatures, round like mochi, with dotted eyes and small mouths, one large and one small, float or stand beside the heroine near the bottom center. Soft spring colors, including pink, sky blue, mint green, peach, cream, and white, are used, with cherry blossom petals and rounded graphic shapes scattered in the background. The background should create a light and celebratory atmosphere with subtle outdoor landscape blurs and decorative curves, stars, and bubbles. The poster is filled with playful, commercial anime-style Japanese typography: a large, multi-colored headline in the top left corner with subheadings above, a red seasonal broadcast announcement, a pink "Arasuji" (synopsis) box on the left containing multiple lines of text, a blue explanatory box in the bottom left corner, vertical and slanted exclamation marks surrounding the characters, and a pink staff credits block in the bottom right corner. A prominent character name banner is added in the top right corner. All text should look like authentic print Japanese promotional copy, with the headline in a rounded, colorful font and smaller text in a clean, magazine-style font. Overall atmosphere: cute, comedic, slightly chaotic, professionally designed anime key visual, suitable for promoting new anime in a 16:9 landscape format.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张明亮柔和色调的动漫宣传海报，用于一部虚构的日常喜剧系列。构图为单页日本动画主视觉图，中心为一位女主角，周围环绕 5 个插图瞬间和日文宣传文字块，呈现出动漫宣传海报的风格。主角是 {argument name="character name" default="もち子さん"}，一位可爱的动漫少女，留着发梢渐变为银色的短白发，拥有明亮的大蓝眼睛、柔和的腮红，以及系在肩部附近的低双马尾。她戴着一个形状像垂耳狗的超大黑色兜帽，头顶架着一副圆形银色护目镜，脖子上戴着带有金属圆饰的黑色项圈，身穿一件未来感十足的黑白配色露肩短上衣，胸前饰有小徽章，配有分离式黑色袖套、带黑色镶边的超短白短裤、单腿腿带，以及腰间的一个小侧包。她的身体比例采用年轻化的动漫风格，身材纤细娇小，胸部略微夸张，呈现出精致的现代萌系角色设计。她全身立于画面中央，面带温柔微笑，一只手拿着笔，仿佛正准备在书写时犯错，以自信而甜美的姿态面向观众。在她周围放置 5 个相同角色的辅助小插图：1) 左上角，Q 版风格场景，她身处户外，双手向前伸出，张大嘴巴戏剧性地大哭；2) 左下角，喜剧场景，她因疲惫和慌乱而脸朝下趴在桌子或地板上，周围散落着纸张；3) 右上角，半身像，她举着一张写有日文的纸牌，表情歉意；4) 右下角，欢快的半身肖像，闭眼微笑，一只拳头举起以示鼓励；5) 右上角文字后方的一个小型背景肖像，用作角色标注。在底部中心附近包含 2 个白色小吉祥物生物，它们圆润如麻薯，有着小圆点眼睛和小嘴巴，一大一小，漂浮或站在女主角身边。使用柔和的春季色调，包括粉色、天蓝色、薄荷绿、桃色、奶油色和白色，背景中散落着樱花花瓣和圆润的图形形状。背景应营造出轻盈和庆典的氛围，带有微妙的户外风景模糊以及装饰性的弧线、星星和气泡。海报中填满俏皮商业动漫风格的日文排版：左上角有一个巨大的多色标题，上方有小标题文字，一个红色的季节性播出公告，左侧有一个粉色的“あらすじ”（剧情简介）方框，内含多行正文，左下角有一个蓝色说明框，角色周围环绕着垂直和倾斜的感叹短语，右下角有一个粉色的制作人员名单块。在右上角添加一个醒目的角色名称横幅。所有文字应看起来像地道的印刷版日本宣传文案，标题使用圆润多彩的字体，较小的文字使用简洁的杂志风格字体。整体氛围：可爱、喜剧、略带混乱，专业设计的动漫主视觉图，适用于 16:9 横屏格式的新番动画宣传。

templates.title: Generate photographic-quality product renderings from blueprints

titleLocalized.zh: 从蓝图生成摄影级产品渲染图

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference images, convert the technical engineering specifications sheet into a clean, photographic product master image of the same jellyfish-shaped kitchen utensil rack. Retain the overall product design, the translucent blue dome lid, the silver base, and the four hanging utensils: a slotted spoon, a pasta ladle, and two soup ladles. Remove all blueprint elements, including exploded views, dimension lines, labels, tables, annotations, and title bars. Show only a centered, front-facing assembled product against a minimalist light gray background on a white surface, using soft diffused lighting with subtle, realistic shadows and a sophisticated sheen. Make it look like a modern industrial design catalog or e-commerce product photograph.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图像，将技术工程规格表转换为同一个水母形状厨房用具架的干净摄影级产品主图。保留整体产品设计、半透明蓝色圆顶盖、银色底座以及 4 件悬挂用具：1 个漏勺、1 个意面捞勺和 2 个汤勺。移除所有蓝图元素，包括爆炸图、尺寸线、标签、表格、注释和标题栏。仅展示居中对齐、正面朝向的组装成品，背景为极简浅灰色，置于白色平面上，采用柔和的漫射光，带有细腻逼真的阴影，并呈现出高级的光泽质感。使其看起来像是一张现代工业设计目录或电商产品摄影图。

templates.title: Cinematic "Wednesday" Anime Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 电影感“周三”动漫海报

templates.prompt: An anime illustration in the style of a Japanese movie poster, using a vertical theatrical poster composition, depicts a girl sitting alone in a classroom during prime time. She keeps {argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown"} Her long, slightly wavy hair was loosely braided to the side, falling over her right shoulder, with soft bangs and warm contour lighting at the crown and edges. She wore a beige or light brown sailor-style school uniform with navy blue trim and a dark blue bow at the chest. Her posture was quiet and introspective: sitting at her desk, one hand supporting her chin, her shoulders slightly hunched, her gaze fixed to one side, revealing a weary but serene midweek expression. The scene is illuminated by strong afternoon sunlight streaming through the tall classroom windows on the right, creating dazzling highlights, dust particles in the air, a soft mist, and a nostalgic cinematic atmosphere. In the darker background on the left, there is a green classroom blackboard with two small erasers or chalk accessories on its tray. The artwork employs a realistic anime style, with rich cinematic quality, delicate facial rendering, textured brushstrokes, subtle graininess, and dramatic poster lighting. The image incorporates a Japanese poster layout: on the left is a large vertical white calligraphy character “真ん中” (Shinchu), above which is a smaller handwritten vertical character “やっと、” (Yatto,). In the lower center is a large pink diagonal calligraphy title “水曜日” (Wednesday). In the upper right corner is a vertical slogan “週のまんなかで、わっと深呼吸ができる.” (Weekly manaka de, watto, you can breathe deeply.) Near the lower right corner are three stacked gold laurel medallions with small Japanese characters inside. At the bottom center are two lines of small Japanese text, below which is a small Japanese movie poster-style credits list. A prominent release date is placed in the lower right corner.{argument name="release date" default="5.29"} The poster below is labeled "ROADSHOW". The overall atmosphere is gentle, melancholic, and healing, much like a low-key coming-of-age movie poster that tells the story of an ordinary Wednesday that becomes quietly special.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张日本电影海报风格的动漫插画，采用垂直剧场版海报构图，描绘了一名少女在黄金时刻独自坐在教室里的场景。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 的长发，微微卷曲，扎成松散的侧边麻花辫垂在右肩，带有柔和的刘海，头顶和发丝边缘有温暖的轮廓光。她穿着一件米色或浅褐色的水手服校服，带有海军蓝镶边，胸前系着深蓝色蝴蝶结。她的姿势安静而内省：坐在课桌前，单手托腮，双肩微弯，眼神看向一侧，流露出一种疲惫但平静的周中表情。场景由右侧高大教室窗户射入的强烈午后阳光照亮，营造出耀眼的高光、空气中的尘埃微粒、柔和的薄雾以及怀旧的电影氛围。在较暗的左侧背景中，包含一块绿色教室黑板，黑板槽上放着 2 个小黑板擦或粉笔配件。采用写实动漫绘画风格，具有丰富的电影质感、细腻的面部渲染、纹理笔触、细微的颗粒感以及戏剧性的海报灯光。在画面中融入日式海报排版：左侧为巨大的竖排白色毛笔字“真ん中”，上方配有较小的手写体竖排文字“やっと、”；中部下方为巨大的粉色斜向书法标题文字“水曜日”；右上角为竖排标语“週のまんなかで、わっと深呼吸ができる。”；右下角附近包含 3 个堆叠的金色月桂奖章，内部带有细小的日文；底部中心添加 2 行小型日文标语，下方为小型日文电影海报排版风格的演职员表。右下角放置一个醒目的上映日期 {argument name="release date" default="5.29"}，下方标注“ROADSHOW”。整体氛围：柔和、忧郁、治愈，如同讲述普通周三变得悄然特别的低调青春成长电影海报。

templates.title: Selfies on Mars with aliens and rockets

titleLocalized.zh: 与外星人和火箭的火星自拍

templates.prompt: A realistic selfie taken on the surface of Mars, presented from a casual wide-angle perspective using a smartphone, as if an arm is outstretched to take the picture. In the foreground are two busts: on the left is a human male wearing a black crew-neck shirt with a clear white OpenAI logo on the chest; on the right is a tall, elegant female alien with skin shimmering with a blue-green metallic sheen, long, slender ears, and delicate facial features. She wears a streamlined biomechanical-style outfit with bronze and silver tones, a deep neckline adorned with intricate decorative seams, and layered necklaces with a prominent blue gemstone pendant. The man has messy, short dark hair, and his left arm is outstretched towards the camera in a selfie pose. The alien stands close beside him, the two seemingly taking a friendly commemorative photo. The background is a red Martian rocky desert, scattered with pebbles and low hills, with a dusty, orange sunset in the sky. On the far left stands a road sign with two lines of text:{argument name="sign headline" default="MARS"} and{argument name="sign subtext" default="WELCOME HOME"} On the far right, in the distance, stands a huge, retro-futuristic white rocket, upright on landing supports, with clear vertical text on it.{argument name="rocket text" default="SPACEX"} The warm orange lighting, cinematic realism, rich detail and texture, subtle atmospheric haze, and social media announcement vibes, along with high detail and natural depth of field, create a stunning visual experience.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张在火星表面拍摄的写实风格自拍，以智能手机拍摄的休闲广角视角呈现，仿佛手臂伸出拍摄。前景中是两个半身像：左侧是一名人类男性，身穿黑色圆领衫，胸前印有清晰的白色 OpenAI 标志；右侧是一名身材高挑、优雅的女性外星人，拥有闪烁着蓝绿色金属光泽的皮肤、细长的耳朵、精致的面部纹理，身着带有青铜和银色调的流线型生物机械风格服装，领口深邃，饰有精细的装饰性接缝，并佩戴着层叠项链，中间坠有一颗显眼的蓝色宝石吊坠。男子留着凌乱的深色短发，左臂向镜头伸出，做出自拍姿势。外星人紧靠在他身边，两人如同拍摄一张友好的纪念照。背景是红色的火星岩石沙漠，散布着碎石、低矮的山丘，天空呈现出尘土飞扬的橙色日落景象。最左侧立着一块路标式指示牌，上面有两行文字，分别为 {argument name="sign headline" default="MARS"} 和 {argument name="sign subtext" default="WELCOME HOME"}。最右侧的远处矗立着一枚巨大的复古未来主义白色火箭，火箭通过着陆支架垂直站立，上面有清晰的垂直文字 {argument name="rocket text" default="SPACEX"}。温暖的橙色光影，电影级写实感，细节纹理丰富，带有微妙的大气雾霾感，具备社交媒体公告的氛围，高细节，自然的景深效果。

templates.title: Humid Summer Anime Schoolgirl Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 湿润夏日动漫女学生肖像

templates.prompt: This is a dazzling anime-style summer portrait, the protagonist being a {argument name="character type" default="Japanese high school girl"} The image shows a close-up of her profile from the chest up. She is standing outdoors, with a clear blue sky and bright white clouds in the background. She has wet hair.{argument name="hair color" default="Dark blue-black"} She has a short bob haircut, large eyes that shimmer with a blue-violet light, and a faint blush on her cheeks. Her expression is calm yet slightly aloof. Her white sailor-style school uniform shirt is soaked, appearing semi-transparent and realistically clinging to the folds. The collar is a dark navy blue sailor collar, tied with a large dark navy blue ribbon at her chest. She raises one arm, holding a transparent, textured plastic water bottle to her forehead, cool water droplets sliding down her face, neck, arm, and clothing. The image is filled with intense summer sunlight, bright highlights, rim light penetrating her wet hair, iridescent lens flares, tiny floating bubbles, and shimmering reflections. The background includes a soft-focus outdoor school pool area, showing metal railings, pool stairs, and the shimmering water. The emphasis is on the crystal-clear water bottle, the sheen of her wet skin, delicate eyelashes, subtle anime-style rendering, dramatic backlighting, the refreshing atmosphere of a summer heatwave, and the sophisticated high-end illustration style.

promptLocalized.zh: 这是一幅光彩夺目的动漫风格夏季肖像，主角为一名 {argument name="character type" default="日本女高中生"}，画面呈现胸部以上的侧面特写。她站在户外，背景是湛蓝的天空和明亮的白云。她留着一头湿漉漉的 {argument name="hair color" default="深藏青黑色"} 短波波头，有着一双硕大且闪烁着蓝紫色光芒的眼睛，脸颊泛着淡淡的红晕，表情平静而略显疏离。她身穿的白色水手服校服衬衫已被浸湿，呈现出半透明质感，真实地贴合在衣褶上，领口为深藏青色水手领，胸前系着一条深藏青色的大丝带。她抬起一只手臂，将一个透明的棱纹塑料水瓶抵在额头上，冰凉的水珠顺着她的脸庞、脖颈、手臂和衣物滑落。画面中充满了强烈的夏日阳光、亮丽的高光、穿透湿润发丝的轮廓光、彩虹色的镜头光晕、细小的漂浮气泡以及闪烁的倒影。背景中包含一个经过柔焦处理的户外学校泳池区域，可以看到金属栏杆、泳池扶梯和波光粼粼的水面。着重表现水瓶的晶莹剔透感、湿润皮肤的光泽、精致的睫毛、细腻的动漫渲染、戏剧性的逆光效果、清爽的夏日热浪氛围，以及精致的高端插画风格。

templates.title: Technology tutorial thumbnails and UI mockups

templates.prompt: A clean, modern YouTube thumbnail with a bright white background, visually divided into bold text on the left and a half-body presenter on the right. On the left, a large, stacked title is placed in bold black sans-serif capital letters, containing the following text:{argument name="headline text" default="CLAUDE DESIGN"} The text is left-aligned and displayed in two lines. Below it, a large, rounded orange banner with a subtle shadow is added, containing bold white capital text with an orange outline, the content of which is:{argument name="subheadline text" default="IN 6 MINS"} Near the title, add two orange starburst shapes, one smaller next to the text and the other larger against the background on the right. In the lower left quadrant, display a floating application mockup of a design tools dashboard, with a soft gray-white panel featuring thin borders, rounded corners, and subtle shadows. The left sidebar should contain four menu items labeled "Recent," "Your designs," "Examples," and "Design systems." The main panel title should read "Recent" and include three grid-arranged "Project" cards labeled "Thumio Design System," "Thumio Startup," and "Design System." In the right half, display a realistic young man from the chest up, wearing a white turtleneck sweater, with messy light brown hair and a light stubble, positioned close to the camera. His face is deliberately obscured by a solid brown rectangular placeholder covering most of the area. One of his fingers points towards the left-hand panel, the finger extended. Featuring a warm orange and white brand color scheme, high contrast, minimalist layout, and sophisticated creator economy thumbnail style with subtle shadows, the composition is designed specifically for technology tutorial content.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张简洁现代的 YouTube 缩略图，采用明亮的白色背景，视觉上分为左侧的粗体文字和右侧的半身演示者。在左侧，放置一个巨大的堆叠式标题，使用加粗的黑色无衬线大写字母，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="CLAUDE DESIGN"}，左对齐并分两行显示。在其下方，添加一个带有细微投影的大型圆角橙色横幅，内含加粗的白色大写文字，并带有橙色轮廓，内容为 {argument name="subheadline text" default="IN 6 MINS"}。在标题附近，加入 2 个橙色星爆形状，一个较小，位于文字旁，另一个较大，位于远处的背景右侧。在左下象限，展示一个设计工具仪表盘的悬浮应用界面模型，面板呈柔和的灰白色，带有细边框、圆角和淡淡的阴影。界面左侧边栏应包含 4 个菜单项，标签分别为：“Recent”、“Your designs”、“Examples” 和 “Design systems”。主面板标题应显示为 “Recent”，并包含 3 个网格排列的“项目”卡片，标签分别为：“Thumio Design System”、“Thumio Startup” 和 “Design System”。在右半部分，展示一位胸部以上的写实风格年轻男性，身穿白色高领毛衣，留着凌乱的浅棕色头发和浅浅的胡茬，位置靠近镜头。他的脸部被一个覆盖大部分区域的纯棕色矩形占位符刻意遮挡。他的一只手指向左侧的界面面板，手指伸出。采用温暖的橙白品牌配色，高对比度，极简布局，精致的创作者经济缩略图风格，带有细微阴影，构图专为科技教程内容设计。

templates.title: Otter Scientist Presentation Slides

titleLocalized.zh: 水獭科学家演示文稿 Slides

templates.prompt: A photorealistic and humorous academic presentation scene takes place in a conference room: an anthropomorphic otter scientist stands on the left side of the frame, dressed in a crisp white lab coat, holding a slender pointer stick and pointing to a large presentation project on an easel. The otter stands upright like a human, possessing realistic brown fur, dark paws, and a professional posture. A name tag reading "Dr. Otter" is sewn onto the lab coat, with "Aquatic Systems Lab" in smaller print below, and two pens are tucked into its breast pocket. The otter's face is partially obscured by a blurred square block. Behind the otter is a whiteboard with blurred handwritten notes and doodles, including "WiFi > Fish," "H2O," "Hydration," a sketch of a fish, and a WiFi symbol. The focal point is a large, clear presentation slide with sharp, legible text and a sophisticated corporate academic layout. At the top is a bold title that reads, "..."{argument name="headline text" default="Ethan Mollick's Otter Test"} The subtitle below reads "Prompt: \"{argument name="prompt text" default="An otter sat in an airplane seat, using the in-flight Wi-Fi on its laptop."} Below is a boxed area titled "AI-Generated Image Samples," containing four side-by-side sample images showing realistic otters sitting in airplane seats using laptops or tablets. Each image is framed like a model output, with one displaying a large WiFi symbol above the seat. Below the images is a section labeled "Performance Results (via = Otter, Airplane Seat, In-flight WiFi, Laptop/Tablet)," containing five score boxes: "DALL·E 3" with no visible numerical score, "GPT-4o" with "4/4" and "100%", "Midjourney v6" with "3/4" and "75%", "Stable Diffusion XL" with "2/4" and "50%", and "SD 1.5" with "0/4" and "0%". On the right is a prominent highlighted box labeled "Average Score" and "{argument name="average score" default="70%"} The text is in large blue font. At the bottom of the slides is a "Key Findings" box containing three key points: "The modern model's understanding of complex, specific cues is astonishing.", "Otter + Airplane + WiFi = A Reliable Benchmark.", and "Further research is absolutely necessary." A simple cartoon otter doodle appears in the lower right corner of the slides. The room is warmly lit, with wood paneling on the walls, a shallow depth of field, and several blurry audience members in the foreground, including a laptop at the edge displaying an image of an otter, and a glass water jug ​​on the table. Style: Hyperrealistic editorial photography, cold-blooded scientific satire, believable conference presentation, high detail, natural indoor lighting, professional lens compression, easy-to-read slide layout, sophisticated yet absurd.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张照片级逼真的幽默学术演示场景，位于会议室内：一只拟人化的水獭科学家站在画面左侧，身穿干练的白色实验服，手持一根细长的指示棒，指向画架上的大型演示项目。这只水獭像人类一样直立，拥有逼真的棕色皮毛、深色的爪子和专业的姿态。实验服上缝着一个写有“Dr. Otter”的姓名牌，下方写着较小的一行字“Aquatic Systems Lab”，胸前口袋里插着两支笔。水獭的脸部被一个方形模糊块部分遮挡。水獭身后是一个白板，上面有模糊的手写笔记和涂鸦，包括“WiFi > Fish”、“H2O”、“Hydration”、一条鱼的草图以及一个 WiFi 符号。画面的焦点是一张大型且清晰的演示 Slides，具有锐利易读的文字和精致的企业学术布局。顶部是一个粗体标题，写着“{argument name="headline text" default="Ethan Mollick 的水獭测试"}”，下方副标题写着“提示词：\"{argument name="prompt text" default="一只水獭坐在飞机座位上，用笔记本电脑使用机上 WiFi"}\"”。下方是一个名为“AI 生成图像样本”的方框区域，包含 4 张并排的样本图像，展示了逼真的水獭坐在飞机座位上使用笔记本电脑或平板电脑，每张图像都像模型输出一样被框起，其中一张在座位上方显示了一个巨大的 WiFi 符号。图像下方是一个标有“性能结果（通过 = 水獭、飞机座位、机上 WiFi、笔记本电脑/平板电脑）”的部分，包含 5 个分数框：“DALL·E 3”无可见数字分数，“GPT-4o”为“4/4”和“100%”，“Midjourney v6”为“3/4”和“75%”，“Stable Diffusion XL”为“2/4”和“50%”，以及“SD 1.5”为“0/4”和“0%”。右侧是一个醒目的高亮方框，写着“平均分”和“{argument name="average score" default="70%"}”，字体为蓝色大号字。Slides 底部是一个“关键发现”框，包含 3 个要点：“现代模型对复杂、具体提示词的理解能力令人惊讶。”、“水獭 + 飞机 + WiFi = 一个可靠的基准测试。”以及“进一步的研究非常有必要（otter-ly necessary）。”Slides 右下角有一个简单的卡通水獭涂鸦。房间光线温暖，墙壁为木质镶板，景深较浅，前景中有几位模糊的听众，包括边缘处的一台笔记本电脑，屏幕上显示着一张水獭图像，桌上放着一个玻璃水壶。风格：超写实编辑摄影，冷面科学讽刺，可信的会议演示，高细节，自然室内光线，专业镜头压缩，易读的 Slides 排版，精致而荒诞。

templates.title: Lunar Bathhouse Comedy Comic Page

titleLocalized.zh: 月面澡堂喜剧漫画页面

templates.prompt: A vibrant Japanese manga page set in a whimsical public bathhouse on the moon. The artwork employs a refined retro-futuristic anime style, with warm lighting, thick and clear panel borders, vivid sound effects and text, and rich environmental narrative details. The scene is a lunar hot spring called "Tsukimichi Tsuki no Yu," featuring a huge illuminated sign, a blue curtain with a white "Yu" character, exposed pipes, dashboards, rounded architectural structures, and a large circular window offering views of the lunar surface and Earth in space. Please include 8 manga panels arranged in a dynamic page layout. Panel 1: An exterior shot of the lunar bathhouse, with a sign reading "Tsukimichi Tsuki no Yu," a small sign next to it reading "Gravity 1/6," a red "milk" vending machine, a tanuki statue, lunar terrain, and a vertical poster advertising the bathhouse. Panel 2: A young female bathhouse mechanic {argument name="character design" default="She wore a brown ponytail with a red polka dot headscarf, green overalls, and a tool belt, and her expression was full of energy."} Adjusting machine or boiler controls, side-rear view, with speech bubbles about preparing today's bath water and boiler status. Scene 3: A cute alien customer ({argument name="alien appearance" default="A round, mint-green body with purple spots, sleepy eyes, pink cheeks, a small mouth, and a white towel with purple stars printed on its head."} Relaxing in a steaming bath, half-submerged in the water, with a rubber duck floating beside you, and a wooden sign that reads "ぬるめじっくりリラックス" (warm water, soak slowly, relax). Scene 4: A small cleaning robot ({argument name="robot design" default="Silver body, blue accents, black electronic face with glowing blue eyes, red antenna lights, slender mechanical arms and legs"} Scene 5: The robot is happily sweeping and wiping the floor next to a sign that says "Cleaning in Progress." Scene 6: The robot suddenly slips or dramatically splashes into the bath, creating a huge spray of water and many bubbles, accompanied by a loud sound effect of "Powaa~n!!", while the staff reacts in surprise. Scene 7: The staff member sits smiling by the bath, holding a bottle of milk labeled "Lunar Milk." Scene 8: The alien in the bath gives a thumbs up, holding a bottle of beverage labeled "Lunar Fruit Oré," looking very satisfied, with the rubber duck still beside him. Scene 9: The happy robot poses by the bath, with cleaning tools and a bucket beside him, in the background a shower curtain with the character "yu" and a pink washbasin labeled "tsukinoyu," saying that the bathhouse is the best. Maintaining a warm and comedic tone, the comic combines retro Showa-era bathhouse details with space technology, showcasing glossy tile surfaces, steam, bubbles, and adorable character interactions. The overall feel of the comic should be a charming, episodic comedy about working in a lunar bathhouse.

templates.title: Split-screen time travel scene

titleLocalized.zh: 分屏时空穿越场景

templates.prompt: A horizontally split-screen cinematic shot, showcasing{argument name="scene" default="Times Square, New York"} Seamlessly blending two different eras: The left side is{argument name="first era" default="1920s"} The right side is{argument name="second era" default="modern"} (Default: Approximately 100 years ago compared to modern times). Left side: Showcases architecture, interior or environmental design, materials, vehicles, and props clearly belonging to this historical period, characteristic of the era. Figures wear authentic period clothing, including hairstyles, accessories, and typical items in their hands. The overall atmosphere is nostalgic and historically accurate. Right side: Showcases the modern version of the same scene, including updated or renovated structures, modern materials (glass, steel, LED screens, modern furniture), modern vehicles or equipment, and current technology. Figures wear fashionable contemporary clothing. Central area: The two eras are organically blended and overlapped, without abrupt dividing lines. Elements from both eras visually interact: people from different times gaze at each other, pass through each other's spaces, or are surprised by the technology and objects of each other's time. Architecture and environment smoothly transition from old to new. Ensuring the scene is not merely a simple left-right comparison, but a dynamic, interactive journey through time. Photorealistic, 8K resolution, cinematic lighting, wide-angle, highly detailed textures, and a rich narrative of time travel. Aspect ratio: 4:3

promptLocalized.zh: 一张水平分屏的电影感镜头，展示 {argument name="scene" default="纽约时代广场"}，将两个不同的时代无缝融合：左侧为 {argument name="first era" default="1920 年代"}，右侧为 {argument name="second era" default="现代"}（默认：约 100 年前对比现代）。左侧：展示符合该时代特征的建筑、室内或环境设计、材料、车辆以及明确属于该历史时期的道具。人物穿着该时代的真实服饰，包括发型、配饰以及手中典型的物品。整体氛围充满怀旧感且符合历史真实性。右侧：展示同一场景的现代面貌，包含更新后的建筑或翻新结构、现代材料（玻璃、钢材、LED 屏幕、现代家具）、现代车辆或设备以及当前科技。人物穿着符合当代风格的时尚服饰。中心区域：两个时代有机地融合与重叠，没有生硬的分割线。两个时代的元素在视觉上产生互动：不同时代的人们互相注视、穿过对方的空间，或对彼此时代的科技和物品感到惊讶。建筑和环境从旧到新平滑过渡。确保场景不仅仅是简单的左右对比，而是一种动态的时空穿越互动。照片级真实感，8k 分辨率，电影级灯光，广角，高度精细的纹理，丰富的时空穿越叙事感。宽高比：4:3

templates.title: Forced X-ray vision of idol portraits

titleLocalized.zh: 强制透视偶像肖像

templates.prompt: 9:16 Vertical screen — Creative forced perspective portrait,{argument name="style" default="Korean idol style"} A single subject. Simulating the aesthetic of 35mm film, with soft, natural grain, slightly faded colors, slight overexposure, soft tones, low contrast, soft highlight overexposure, and an ethereal, dreamlike atmosphere. A minimalist interior scene by a window, a clean, light-colored background, and a simple everyday environment. Young.{argument name="subject" default="Korean female idols"} Extremely attractive, with a natural, minimalist makeup look, dewy and realistic skin texture, and subtle imperfections. Clothing:{argument name="outfit" default="A loose white shirt casually draped over the shoulders + shorts"} Soft fabric, loose cut, conservative yet subtly figure-hugging, no revealing elements. Hairstyle: Long, dark hair, slightly messy, with a natural, voluminous feel. Composition (key): Forced perspective illusion—the subject appears unusually small relative to nearby objects (e.g., in a cup, standing on the edge of a table, or interacting with a hand in the foreground), yet still realistic; a sense of proportion blurring is created through camera distance and alignment. Camera: Slightly low or eye-level angle, deliberate perspective distortion, foreground objects close to the lens, subject placed further away to create an illusion of size. Pose: Natural, relaxed posture, slight body curves, casual standing or slightly sitting. Expression: Soft, calm gaze, a slight smile or slightly parted lips, natural and unforced. Lighting: Diffuse natural window light, soft shadows, the light gently enveloping the subject. Atmosphere: Playful, slightly surreal yet grounded in reality, an intimate everyday moment with visual reversal. Quality: Hyperrealistic, with fine film grain, slight soft focus, imperfect composition, and natural flaws.

promptLocalized.zh: 9:16 竖屏 — 创意强制透视肖像，{argument name="style" default="韩系偶像风格"}，单人主体。模拟 35mm 胶片美感，柔和的自然颗粒感，略微褪色的色彩，轻微的过曝，柔和的色调，低对比度，柔和的高光溢出，空灵梦幻的氛围。窗边极简室内场景，干净的浅色背景，简单的日常环境。年轻的 {argument name="subject" default="韩国女偶像"}，极具吸引力，自然的极简妆容，水润真实的皮肤质感，细微的瑕疵。服装：{argument name="outfit" default="宽松白衬衫随意披搭 + 短裤"}，柔软面料，宽松剪裁，保守但略显身形，无暴露元素。发型：长深色头发，略显凌乱，自然的蓬松感。构图（关键）：强制透视错觉 — 主体相对于附近的物体显得异常小（例如在杯子里、站在桌沿上，或与前景中的手互动），但依然真实；通过相机距离和对齐方式营造出比例模糊感。相机：略微低角度或平视角度，刻意的透视畸变，前景物体靠近镜头，主体放置在较远处以制造尺寸错觉。姿势：自然放松的姿态，轻微的身体曲线，随意的站姿或轻微的坐姿。表情：柔和冷静的注视，轻微的微笑或微张的嘴唇，自然且不刻意。光线：漫射的自然窗光，柔和的阴影，光线柔和地包裹着主体。氛围：俏皮，略带超现实感但扎根于现实，带有视觉反转的亲密日常瞬间。质量：超写实，细腻的胶片颗粒，轻微的柔焦，不完美的构图，自然的瑕疵。

templates.title: Detailed multilingual Chinese comic prompts

titleLocalized.zh: 详细的多语言中文漫画提示词

templates.prompt: Generate a full-color Chinese comic strip, the main character is this person.{argument name="character" default="Boyuan Chen, OpenAI Researcher"} (First image) He is working on improving the text rendering capabilities of the ChatGPT Image 2 model in the upcoming release. (The background shows bubble tea, and a banana is stuck to the wall with a single strip of tape). He is trying to generate text about his hometown on his computer screen.{argument name="location" default="Wuxi"} When creating a hand-drawn style multilingual infographic poster, the model demonstrated its ability to render extremely small Chinese characters. His efforts paid off, and the team was amazed by the model's excellent multilingual text performance, seeing the variety of languages ​​it could write. While resting with his phone in one hand, he received a translated text message from Sam Altman (see the second image for his profile picture). Sam asked him to check the rendered multilingual text in a newly generated image congratulating the team, since Sam only understood English. However, let's add a touch of humor: at the end of the comic, Boyuan (in typical comic style) is driven crazy because he sees the phrase "稳稳地接住你" (wěn wěn dì jiē zhù nǐ) prominently displayed in the center of the image generated by Sam, while the rest of the image is rendered perfectly. This is because the phrase has become a meme on the Chinese internet, considered an unnatural but funny Chinese phrase that GPT likes to use. Boyuan should angrily shout: "Oh my god! It's learned to 'catch' again!" (Next to him are the shrunken profile pictures of his teammates, sweating and saying: "We're working on fixing it!"). At the very bottom of the comic, add a tiny Chinese footnote: "Note: The entire comic, including this footnote and the picture-in-picture, was generated in one go by GPT Image 2, without editing or multi-step processing." Additional note: Uses a 1440x2560 vertical image layout. The first line shows the researcher working diligently; the second line shows him {argument name="location" default="Wuxi"} The first line should showcase the team's multilingual achievements on the project; the second line should display the team's excitement; the third line should be divided into two parts, with the left side showing messages received on his phone during a break and the right side showing Sam's text message content; the fifth line should show Sam's photo and Chen Boyuan's reaction. No narration should be used except for the first line. Avoid showing a map of China. All characters should be in a cartoon style. The banana background should only appear in the first panel, and the tape should be a single strip, not a cross. The banana and tape decorations should be small and inconspicuous Easter eggs. The OpenAI logo should only appear on Chen Boyuan's clothing and not elsewhere. Mugs should not appear in the scene, as there is already bubble tea. Sam should only appear in the text message panel. The entire cartoon should be presented as a professional photograph of a physical comic book page. Add a line of small text in the bottom right corner of the poster that reads "Even the smallest Chinese characters are clearly readable:", along with an even smaller Chinese paragraph that begins with "(This is a test of the smallest font) Wuxi is the author's hometown, so I made this poster, and the Chinese characters are finally fixed. I haven't been home for many years, and I really want to eat hairy crabs!" (in the smallest font).

promptLocalized.zh:
生成一张全彩中文漫画，主角是这位 {argument name="character" default="OpenAI 研究员，陈博远"}（第一张图），他正致力于提升 ChatGPT Image 2 模型在即将发布版本中的文本渲染能力。（背景里有波霸奶茶，墙上贴着一根用单条胶带粘住的香蕉）。当他在电脑屏幕上尝试生成关于他家乡 {argument name="location" default="无锡"} 的手绘风格多语言信息图海报时，模型展现出了渲染极小中文字符的能力。他的努力得到了回报，团队对模型出色的多语言文本表现感到惊叹，看到了它所能书写的各种语言。当他单手拿着手机休息时，收到了 Sam Altman 发来的翻译后的短信（头像见第二张图），Sam 请他查看一张刚生成的祝贺团队的图片中渲染的多语言文本，因为 Sam 只懂英文。然而，请加入幽默元素：在漫画结尾，让博远（以典型的漫画风格）感到抓狂，因为他看到 Sam 生成的图片中央位置赫然写着“稳稳地接住你”这句话，而图片的其他部分渲染得非常完美。因为这句话在中文互联网上已被玩梗，被视为 GPT 喜欢使用的不自然但有趣的中文短语。博远应该愤怒地大喊：“天哪！它又学会‘接住’了！”（旁边是队友们缩小的头像，流着汗说：“我们正在努力修复它！”）。在漫画的最底部，添加一行极小的中文脚注：“注：整幅漫画，包括此脚注和画中画，均由 GPT Image 2 一次性生成，未经编辑或多步处理。”

额外说明：使用 1440x2560 的垂直图像布局。第一行展示研究员努力工作的场景；第二行展示他在 {argument name="location" default="无锡"} 课题上取得的多语言成果；第三行展示团队的兴奋之情；第四行分为左右两部分，左侧展示他休息时手机收到消息，右侧展示 Sam 的短信内容；第五行展示 Sam 的照片和陈博远的反应。除第一行外，不要使用旁白。避免出现中国地图。所有角色应采用漫画风格。香蕉背景仅出现在第一格，胶带应为单条，而非十字交叉。香蕉和胶带装饰应作为彩蛋，小巧且不显眼。OpenAI 标志仅出现在陈博远的衣服上，其他地方不得出现。场景中不要出现马克杯，因为已经有波霸奶茶了。Sam 仅应出现在短信面板中。整幅漫画应呈现为漫画书实物页面的专业照片。在海报的右下角，添加一行小字“超小号中文也能清晰可读：”，并附上一段更小的中文段落，以“（这是超小字体测试）无锡是作者的家乡，所以我制作了这张海报，中文终于修复了。多年未回家，真想吃大闸蟹！”开头（超小号字体）。

templates.title: Double Exposure Motion Graphics

titleLocalized.zh: 双重曝光运动图形

templates.prompt: {argument name="subject name" default="[Person's Name]"} Please play the role of a high-end motion graphics designer and create a conceptual tribute poster. The style should be a complex "double exposure photo mesh composite" combined with mixed media textures. Core structure (carrier): The central focus is {argument name="subject name" default="[Person's Name]"} A large, high-contrast black-and-white portrait silhouette. This main portrait serves as the container. Grid Fill and Texture (Mixed Media): The silhouette is filled with a dense “photo mosaic grid” of action shots from the subject’s career. Key Texture Notes: Don’t just tile the photo. Apply artistic textures to different grid cells to create a tactile and collage-like feel. Use the following effects: Halftone Dots: Use a comic book-style raster pattern on selected cells. Fabric/Embroidery: Subtle stitching or canvas textures to suggest the feel of a jersey or patch. Film Grain: Add heavy noise to specific high-contrast action shots. Color Strategy: The base is black and white monochrome. Use selective color overlays (related to the team/flag) only on specific grid cells to create rhythm. Typography and Branding (Strict Miniature Scale): Top Left (Name): Use{argument name="font family" default="Inter Semibold"} Font writing{argument name="subject name" default="[Person's Name]"} ". Kicking Adjustment: Tight negative kicking (-4%). ​​Size: Small and understated. Its width should not exceed 20% of the canvas width. Avoid making it too large or conspicuous. Top Right Corner (Symbol): Place the main logo (team/brand/flag). Size: Very small. Its width should not exceed 10% of the canvas width. Composition and Background: Background: Off-white or light gray with a visible high-quality paper or concrete texture. It should not be a flat, pure white number. Alignment: Perfectly center the subject. Maintain ample white space around the object."

promptLocalized.zh:
{argument name="subject name" default="[人物姓名]"}。
请扮演一位高端运动图形设计师，创作一张概念性的致敬海报。风格为复杂的“双重曝光照片网格合成”，并结合混合媒体纹理。
核心结构（载体）：
中心焦点是 {argument name="subject name" default="[人物姓名]"} 的大型高对比度黑白肖像剪影。此主肖像作为容器。
网格填充与纹理（混合媒体）：
剪影内部填充了该人物职业生涯动作镜头的密集“照片马赛克网格”。
关键纹理说明：不要仅仅平铺照片。在不同的网格单元上应用艺术纹理，以营造触感和拼贴感。使用以下效果：
半调网点：在部分单元格上使用漫画风格的光栅图案。
织物/刺绣：细微的线迹或帆布纹理，暗示球衣或补丁质感。
胶片颗粒：在特定的高对比度动作镜头上添加厚重的噪点。
色彩策略：
基础为黑白单色。仅在特定的网格单元上使用选择性色彩叠加（与球队/旗帜相关），以营造节奏感。
排版与品牌标识（严格微缩比例）：
左上角（姓名）：使用 {argument name="font family" default="Inter Semibold"} 字体书写 "{argument name="subject name" default="[人物姓名]"}"。
字距调整：紧凑的负字距（-4%）。
尺寸：小而低调。其宽度不得超过画布宽度的 20%。切勿使其过大或过于显眼。
右上角（符号）：放置主要标志（球队/品牌/旗帜）。
尺寸：非常小。其宽度不得超过画布宽度的 10%。
构图与背景：
背景：米白色或浅灰色，带有可见的高质量纸张或混凝土纹理。不应是平面的数字纯白色。
对齐：将主体完美居中。在对象周围保持宽阔的留白。

templates.title: Sunset Motorcycle Off-Road Action Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 日落时分摩托车越野动作肖像

templates.prompt: A cinematic-quality high-resolution action portrait, the protagonist is{argument name="subject" default="A young man riding a modern off-road motorcycle"} The scene is set in{argument name="setting" default="Rugged rocky terrain at sunset during golden hour"} He leaned aggressively forward as he turned, his face showing focused intensity. He had short, tousled dark hair, a light stubble, a sharply defined jawline, and a robust physique. He wore a fitted black T-shirt, dark work pants, black motocross gloves with orange details, and black racing boots with orange accents. The motorcycle was a stylish matte black-grey motocross bike with a refined suspension, rugged off-road tires, clearly visible engine components, realistic mud splatter, spinning wheels, and dust billowing from the rear wheel. The rider was captured in a moment of motion, full of dynamic energy and speed. The backdrop was a warm desert landscape, with distant mountains softly blurred on the horizon. A huge dust cloud billowed behind the motorcycle, illuminated by the sunlight. The sky displayed a smooth gradient from deep cyan at the top to a glowing orange near the horizon. The intense sunlight created dramatic rim lighting around the rider and motorcycle, accompanied by rich shadows and warm highlights. The foreground features richly textured gravel, dirt, scattered stones, debris, and sharp ground details. A low-angle shot is used to create a powerful, heroic perspective. Shallow depth of field keeps the rider sharp while maintaining a creamy, cinematic background. The color grading style is {argument name="color grade" default="Green and orange tones"} High contrast, realistic skin tones, sharp details, ultra-sharp autofocus, advanced sports editing photography style, cinematic narrative, adventure aesthetics, volumetric dust effects, HDR quality, 8K resolution, realistic textures, natural reflections, professional lens compression, and a strong atmosphere. Camera settings: low-angle tracking shot, 85mm lens, f/2.8, high-speed shutter, ISO 100, high definition, centered subject composition. Negative keywords: blurry face, superfluous limbs, poor anatomy, text, watermarks, logos, low quality, oversaturated colors, distorted motorcycle, repetitive wheels, unrealistic hands, noise, cartoonish style, flat lighting.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张电影级高分辨率动作肖像，主角是 {argument name="subject" default="一位骑着现代越野摩托车的年轻人"}，场景设定在 {argument name="setting" default="黄金时段日落下的崎岖岩石地形"}。他转弯时身体激进地向前倾斜，脸上流露出专注与强烈的神情。他留着凌乱的深色短发，有着淡淡的胡茬、轮廓分明的下颌线和健壮的体格，身穿修身黑色紧身 T 恤、深色工装裤、带有橙色细节的黑色摩托车越野手套，以及带有橙色点缀的黑色赛车靴。
这辆摩托车是一辆外观时尚的哑光黑灰色越野摩托车，拥有精细的悬挂系统、粗犷的越野轮胎、清晰可见的引擎部件、逼真的泥点飞溅、旋转的车轮，以及从后轮飞扬而起的尘土。骑手被捕捉在运动瞬间，充满动态能量与速度感。
背景是温暖的沙漠景观，远处的山脉在地平线上呈现出柔和的虚化效果。摩托车后方扬起巨大的尘土云，被阳光照亮。天空呈现出从顶部的深青色到地平线附近发光的橙色的平滑渐变。强烈的阳光在骑手和摩托车周围营造出戏剧性的轮廓光，伴随着丰富的阴影和温暖的高光。
前景包含质感丰富的砾石、泥土、散落的石块、运动碎屑和清晰的地面细节。采用低角度拍摄，以呈现英雄般强有力的视角。浅景深使骑手保持清晰，同时背景保持奶油般的虚化效果，极具电影感。
调色风格为 {argument name="color grade" default="青橙色调"}，高对比度，逼真的肤色，清晰的细节，超锐利对焦，高级体育编辑摄影风格，电影叙事感，冒险美学，体积感尘土光效，HDR 画质，8k 分辨率，逼真的纹理，自然的反射，专业镜头压缩，强烈的氛围。
相机设置：低角度追踪拍摄，85mm 镜头，f/2.8，高速快门，ISO 100，高清晰度，主体居中构图。
负面提示词：模糊的脸，多余的肢体，糟糕的解剖结构，文字，水印，标志，低质量，色彩过饱和，扭曲的摩托车，重复的车轮，不切实际的手部，噪点，卡通风格，平淡的光照。

templates.title: Visual Multilingual Magazine Collage

titleLocalized.zh: 视觉多语种杂志拼贴画

templates.prompt: I'm creating a magazine page with the theme "Visual Multilingualism". The title in the center of the image should be "{argument name="title" default="Create Everything at Once"} Please create an artwork that celebrates visual creation, not limited to exquisite photography, but encompassing the full breadth of human visual culture and natural visual elements. The image should include carefully curated collages with diverse distributions: scientific charts, the periodic table, the solar system, medieval manuscript pages, botanical illustrations, anatomical diagrams, ancient maps, climate charts, engineering diagrams, traffic signs, multilingual text, comic panels, and UI elements. Screenshots, camera photos, butterfly specimens, pie charts, architectural blueprints, and elevation drawings. The text positions the model as proficient in various languages, symbol systems, interfaces, cultural forms, and visual conventions—capable of shifting from practicality to aesthetics, from document understanding to art generation. Incorporate elements from all art forms, including pixel art, style, history, sculpture, nature, photography, and painting. These are just examples; I need you to actively consider other elements or styles that might suit excellent design, not just these concepts. The overall effect should have the quality of a high-end research announcement or a museum-style manifesto: elegant, grand, and designed to demonstrate that image intelligence should be trained on the entire visual world, not just refined aesthetics. Use unstructured, creative, and artistic layouts, such as, but not limited to, fan-shaped layouts, avoiding grid-like layouts. Use a 4:5 aspect ratio. Do not add any content text other than the "Create Everything at Once" heading. Text as part of the art is acceptable. Avoid an overall beige tone, as we want vibrant elements to remain vibrant.

promptLocalized.zh: 我正在创作一个主题为“视觉多语种”的杂志页面。图像中心的标题应为“{argument name="title" default="Create Everything at Once"}”。请创作一件赞美视觉创作的艺术作品，不仅限于精美的摄影作品，还要涵盖人类视觉文化和自然视觉元素的全部广度。画面应包含精心策划的拼贴画，以呈现多样化的分布：科学图表、元素周期表、太阳系、中世纪手稿页面、植物插图、解剖图、古地图、气候图表、工程示意图、交通标志、多语言文本、漫画分镜、UI 截图、相机照片、蝴蝶标本、饼图、建筑蓝图和立面图。文本将模型定位为精通各种语言、符号系统、界面、文化形式和视觉惯例——能够从实用性转向美感，从文档理解转向艺术生成。同时加入像素艺术、风格、历史、雕塑、自然、摄影、绘画等所有艺术形式的元素。以上仅为示例，我需要你积极思考其他可能适合优秀设计的元素或风格，而不局限于这些概念。整体效果应呈现出高端研究公告或博物馆风格宣言的质感：优雅、宏大，旨在论证图像智能应该基于整个视觉世界进行训练，而不仅仅是基于精致的美学。请使用非结构化、富有创意和艺术感的布局，例如但不限于扇形展开，避免网格状布局。纵向 4:5 比例。除了“Create Everything at Once”标题外，不要添加任何其他内容文本。作为艺术一部分的文本是可以的。避免整体风格带有米色调，因为我们希望鲜艳的元素保持鲜艳。

templates.title: Tang Dynasty Aesthetics CG Illustration

titleLocalized.zh: 唐风美学 CG 插画

templates.prompt: {argument name="style" default="Chinese-style CG illustrations"} Tang Dynasty aesthetics{argument name="character description" default="Exquisite ancient style woman"} Half-body close-ups, focusing on the face and upper body, high-end portrait composition, cinematic camera language and spatial perspective. Character Design: A classical East Asian beauty with a cool, translucent white complexion, delicate and realistic skin texture, and a soft, subtle glow; exquisite and three-dimensional features that are natural and not exaggerated, slender phoenix eyes with slightly upturned corners, a gaze that is affectionate and shy, slightly hazy, with long eyelashes casting subtle shadows; lips the color of rouge, slightly parted, soft yet full of emotional tension, presenting "reserved Eastern beauty". Costume Design: A gorgeous pink Tang-style costume that softly fits the body's curves, rich in layers but not cluttered; a moderately low neckline emphasizes the collarbone and neck and shoulder lines, providing natural visual guidance; an exquisite phoenix crown (metal, pearls, gemstones, tassels), with realistic material reflections, swaying slightly with movement. Dynamics and Posture: A slightly turned or slightly rotated posture, with an extended neck, relaxed shoulder lines, and hands forming soft guiding lines, enhancing the rhythm of the image and the feminine grace and tension. Lighting System: Cinematic lighting. Main Light: Warm golden front sidelight, focusing on highlights on the face and skin. Fill Light: Cool ambient light, creating a sense of volume and space. Contour lighting outlines the hair and neck silhouette. Highlights are controlled to avoid overexposure, shadows retain detail, and facial lighting transitions are smooth. Artistic Style: Hyper-realistic CG portrait blending Eastern freehand style with a slightly hazy aesthetic. Atmosphere and Texture: A dreamy, subtle, and high-end Eastern aesthetic atmosphere; blurred background to weaken the environment and strengthen the character; slight film grain + soft focus halo to enhance emotion and texture. Color System: Main Colors: Rouge pink, gold. Secondary Colors: Cool blue-gray. Overall low saturation, high quality, avoiding gaudiness. Lens Parameters: 85mm portrait lens, f1.4–f2, shallow depth of field, cinematic framing. Quality: Ultra-detail, 8K–16K, extreme detail, high resolution, cinematic lighting. Aspect Ratio:{argument name="aspect ratio" default="9:16"}

promptLocalized.zh:
{argument name="style" default="中式 CG 插画"}, 唐代美学，{argument name="character description" default="精致古风女子"}, 半身特写镜头，聚焦面部与上半身，高端肖像构图，电影级镜头语言与空间透视。

角色设定：
东亚古典美人，冷白通透肤色，细腻真实的皮肤纹理，柔和微光；五官精致立体但自然不夸张，细长凤眼，眼角微挑，眼神含情脉脉且羞涩，微醺朦胧，长睫毛投下细微阴影；唇色如胭脂，双唇微启，柔和且富有情绪张力，呈现“含蓄的东方美”。

造型设计：
粉色调华丽唐风服饰，柔和贴合身体曲线，层次丰富但不堆砌；适度的低领设计强调锁骨与颈肩线条，自然的视觉引导；精致凤冠（金属、珍珠、宝石、流苏），写实材质反射，随动作轻微晃动。

动态与姿态：
微侧身或轻微旋转姿态，颈部延伸，肩线舒展，双手形成柔和的引导线，增强画面韵律与女性柔美张力。

光影系统：
电影级布光。主光：暖金色前侧光，聚焦面部与皮肤高光。补光：冷色环境光，塑造体积感与空间感。轮廓光勾勒发丝与颈部剪影。高光控制不过曝，阴影保留细节，面部光影过渡柔和。

艺术风格：
超写实 CG 肖像融合东方写意神韵，轻微朦胧美学。

氛围与质感：
梦幻、含蓄、高端的东方美学氛围；虚化背景以弱化环境，强化角色；轻微胶片颗粒 + 柔焦光晕，增强情绪与质感。

色彩系统：
主色：胭脂粉、金色。辅助色：冷蓝灰色。整体低饱和度、高质感，避免艳俗。

镜头参数：
85mm 人像镜头，f1.4–f2，浅景深，电影级取景。

质量：
超细节，8K–16K，极致细节，高分辨率，电影级光影。

画面比例：
{argument name="aspect ratio" default="9:16"}

templates.title: Packaging design project prompts

titleLocalized.zh: 包装设计方案项目提示词

templates.prompt: Please provide{argument name="product name" default="milk powder"} Generate a product introduction poster in the "Hand-drawn Packaging Scheme Project Style". If I provided product images, please use them as the primary reference, retaining the product's core visual features, packaging format, colors, materials, brand logo, and overall feel. Prioritize the main color scheme and color relationships in the product images during the design process. If I did not provide product images, please design based on {argument name="product name" default="milk powder"} The system automatically generates product appearance and packaging design based on positioning, and automatically matches natural and reasonable background, main, and auxiliary colors according to product attributes, category characteristics, and overall feel. Poster overall style requirements: This is not a standard e-commerce details page or a simple studio poster, but a creative project integrating "finished product images + packaging design sketches + brand concept development process." The overall presentation should be a high-aesthetic, high-complete brand design showcase, as if a designer is presenting a packaging concept plan. Visual requirements: - Vertical composition. - Use a unified background with brand identity; the background color should be naturally determined by the product itself, not fixed to any single color. - The color scheme should be coordinated with product attributes: if there is a reference image, its main color and brand color should be inherited first; if not, a reasonable color scheme should be automatically generated based on the product name. - Place the most complete and eye-catching main product visual in the center, with realistic texture, 3D lighting, and commercial-grade finished product effects. - Surround the product with multiple auxiliary visual elements: packaging sketches from different angles, structural sketches, partial form explorations, handheld display sketches, packaging unfolding concepts, and brand typography experiments. - Add natural and casual black or dark hand-drawn lines, arrows, circles, symbols, and handwritten Chinese annotations to give the image a strong sense of "design process" and "creative solution." - The finished product image should be relatively refined and realistic, while the sketch image should be relatively casual and dynamic, creating a contrast between "finished product + design sketch." - The layout should appear relaxed and free, but the overall design must be orderly, rhythmic, and have a visual center, reflecting a high-end graphic design aesthetic. - Appropriately add small graphics, symbols, or fun elements related to the product to enhance brand memorability. - The final effect should possess brand awareness, creativity, a sense of process, and visual impact. Color Principles: - Do not consistently use a yellow background. - Automatically select the main color scheme based on the product type, material, purpose, consumer experience, and brand image. - The background color, product color, text color, and sketch line color should coordinate with each other. - High-saturation monochrome backgrounds or soft, unified color schemes can be used, as long as the overall image conveys brand identity and visual impact. - Colors should naturally complement the product, not overshadow it. Style Keywords: Packaging design project, brand concept development, hand-drawn sketches, design process feel, mood board, creative review drafts, product rendering, visual experiments, commercial design posters. Special Notes: - If reference product images are available, prioritize following them and do not deviate from the product itself. - If no reference images are available, automatically generate a reasonable product appearance, packaging, and color scheme based on the product name, maintaining overall style consistency. - The focus of the images is "product introduction + creative design process demonstration." - Avoid creating a typical e-commerce detail page or promotional poster, or one that appears overly neat and rigid; sketches and handwritten annotations are essential; avoid a cheap or immature cartoon style.

promptLocalized.zh:
请为 {argument name="product name" default="奶粉"} 生成一张“手绘包装方案项目风格”的产品介绍海报。

如果我提供了产品图片，请将其作为主要参考，保留产品的核心视觉特征、包装形式、颜色、材质、品牌标识和整体气质。设计时优先考虑产品图片中的主色调和色彩关系。
如果我没有提供产品图片，请根据 {argument name="product name" default="奶粉"} 的定位自动生成产品外观和包装设计，并根据产品属性、品类特征和气质自动匹配自然且合理的背景色、主色和辅助色。

海报整体风格要求：
这不是标准的电商详情页或简单的摄影棚拍摄海报，而是一个融合了“产品成品图 + 包装设计草图 + 品牌概念开发过程”的创意项目。整体呈现为一张高审美、高完成度的品牌设计展示图，如同设计师正在展示一份包装概念方案。

视觉要求：
- 竖构图。
- 使用具有品牌感的统一背景；背景色应由产品本身自然决定，不固定为任何单一颜色。
- 配色方案应与产品属性协调：如有参考图，优先继承其主色和品牌色；如无，则根据产品名称自动生成合理的配色方案。
- 将最完整、最引人注目的产品主视觉放置在中心，具备真实的质感、3D 灯光和商业级成品效果。
- 在产品周围环绕多个辅助视觉元素：不同角度的包装草图、结构草图、局部形态探索、手持展示草图、包装展开构思以及品牌字体排版实验。
- 添加自然随意的黑色或深色手绘线条、箭头、圆圈、符号和手写中文注释，使画面具有强烈的“设计过程感”和“创意方案感”。
- 成品图部分应相对精致写实，而草图部分应相对随意灵动，形成“成品 + 设计草图”的对比。
- 布局看起来应轻松自由，但整体必须有秩序、有节奏感并具备视觉中心，体现出高端平面设计感。
- 可适当添加与产品相关的小图形、符号或趣味元素，以增强品牌记忆点。
- 最终效果应具备品牌感、创意感、过程感和视觉冲击力。

色彩原则：
- 不要固定使用黄色背景。
- 根据产品类型、材质、用途、消费体验和品牌气质自动选择主色调。
- 背景色、产品色、文字色和草图线条色应相互协调。
- 可以使用高饱和度的单色背景或柔和统一的配色方案，只要整体画面具有品牌感和视觉冲击力即可。
- 颜色应自然地服务于产品，而不是喧宾夺主。

风格关键词：
包装设计方案项目，品牌概念开发，手绘草图，设计过程感，情绪板，创意评审草稿，产品成品渲染，视觉实验，商业设计海报。

特别说明：
- 如有参考产品图，优先遵循参考图，不得偏离产品本身。
- 如无参考图，根据产品名称自动生成合理的产品外观、包装和配色方案，保持整体风格一致性。
- 图像的重点是“产品介绍 + 创意设计过程展示”。
- 不要将其制作成普通的电商详情页、促销海报，或显得过于整齐僵硬；不可缺少草图和手写注释；避免廉价感或不成熟的卡通风格。

templates.title: Food life cycle infographic prompts

titleLocalized.zh: 食物生命周期信息图提示词

templates.prompt: by"{argument name="food name" default="garlic"} This is a science infographic themed "The Life of a Food Entity." The image must present a single, complete food subject (e.g., a potato, a bunch of bananas, a clove of garlic), showing the changes of the same food at different stages of time through horizontal slices, rather than a collage of multiple different individuals. The food subject maintains structural continuity and consistent shape, showing different levels of ripeness in different slice areas (as if slicing time). The image uses a 3:4 vertical aspect ratio, with the subject centered and extending horizontally, evenly divided into 4-6 segments: From left to right: Immature → Ripe → Overripe → Spoiled. Each segment reflects real changes: Color changes (e.g., green → yellow → black), Texture changes (e.g., plump → soft → shrunken → rotten), Characteristic changes (e.g., sprouting, watering, moldy). Each stage is accompanied by text descriptions: Stage name, external characteristics, internal changes (sugar/starch/moisture changes), and consumption suggestions (recommended/suitable for cooking/inedible). Design style: Minimalist light-colored background (beige), highly realistic photographic style, and clear dividing lines (a sense of time slicing). Chinese science popularization layout, appropriate use of Xiaohongshu style icons, top title:{argument name="food name" default="garlic"} The core requirement of "A Lifetime" is that it must be presented as "slices of the same food changing over time", rather than a collage of independent individuals.

promptLocalized.zh:
以“{argument name="food name" default="大蒜"} 的一生”为主题的科普信息图。

画面必须呈现“单个完整的食物主体”（例如：一个土豆 / 一串香蕉 / 一个大蒜），通过横向切片展示同一食物在不同时间阶段的变化，而非多个不同个体的拼贴。

食物主体保持结构连续性和形状一致，在不同切片区域呈现出不同成熟度（如同将时间切开）。

图片采用 3:4 竖屏比例，主体居中并横向延展，均匀分为 4-6 个片段：

从左至右：未成熟 → 成熟 → 过熟 → 变质

每个片段反映真实变化：

颜色变化（如：绿 → 黄 → 黑等）
质地变化（如：饱满 → 变软 → 萎缩 → 腐烂）
特征变化（如：发芽、出水、发霉等）

每个阶段配有文字说明：

阶段名称
外观特征
内部变化（糖分/淀粉/水分变化）
食用建议（推荐/适合烹饪/不可食用）

设计风格：

极简浅色背景（米色）
高度写实的摄影风格
清晰的分隔线（时间切片感）
中文科普排版，小红书风格
适当使用 ⚠️✔️ 等图标

顶部标题：“{argument name="food name" default="大蒜"} 的一生”

核心要求：必须呈现为“同一食物随时间变化的切片”，而非独立个体的拼贴。

- “第二站：{景点 2 推荐 + 简短有趣的描述}”
- “第三站：{景点 3 推荐 + 简短有趣的描述}”
- ...
- “终点站：{当地特色美食/纪念品 + 温馨的结语}”

> 旅行停靠点的数量会根据天数自动生成。如果未输入天数，默认生成 1 天/精华游路线。

II. 有趣的周边元素（根据城市自动替换）

在路线周围添加大量童趣元素，例如：

- 可爱的旅行角色：“拿着当地小吃的孩子”、“背着背包的探险小童”等。
- 当地地标的 Q 版手绘图：如“{地标 1}”、“{地标 2}”、“{地标 3}”。
- 有趣的指示牌：“小心迷路！”，“注意人群！”，“前方有美食！”（根据城市背景调整）。
- 贴纸风格的标语：“{argument name="city name" default="北京"} 旅行记忆解锁！”，“{argument name="city name" default="北京"} 美食大冒险！”，“下一站去哪儿？”
- 当地美食的可爱小图标：如“{食物 1}”、“{食物 2}”、“{食物 3}”。
- 感叹语（保持童趣语气）：“{argument name="city name" default="北京"} 太好玩了！”，“我还想再去一次！”

III. 整体风格要求

- 手绘蜡笔风格 / 儿童旅行日志风格
- 色彩明亮，构图饱满而温暖
- 强调旅行的快乐与探索感
- 所有文字均使用可爱的圆体手写字体
- 让整张图片看起来就像一页充满童真奇想的旅行日记。

Overall requirements: beautiful, dreamlike, ethereal, mysterious, transcendent, sacred, and exquisite, possessing cinematic lighting, volumetric lighting, a sense of atmosphere, and ultra-detailed CG illustration quality; avoid vulgarity, cheap ancient-style photography, generic "internet celebrity" faces, cluttered backgrounds, and plastic-like textures.

promptLocalized.zh: 请创作一张东方奇幻角色概念插画，主角为 {argument name="character role" default="一位东方奇幻角色"}，并使用 {argument name="weapon" default="乐器或武器"}。整体风格融合了中国传统仙侠、神话意象及电影级 CG 概念艺术质感。画面需具备强烈的东方奇幻美学、高级感与史诗氛围。角色为核心视觉焦点，气质需呈现空灵、神圣、优雅、清冷或威严感。根据 {argument name="character role" default="角色"} 自动匹配最合适的表情、服饰、发型、配饰及身份设定。若 {argument name="weapon" default="物品"} 为乐器，角色应处于仪式感强且流畅的姿态，如弹奏、拨弄、吹奏或持琴而立，强调音乐能量、灵气流动，以及化作光纹、云雾、星光或法阵的音波效果。若 {argument name="weapon" default="物品"} 为武器，角色应处于持械、蓄势、对峙、施法或战前瞬间的姿态，强调力量感、压迫感、气场及能量汇聚。构图以居中或偏心构图为主，平衡且庄重，具备海报级主视觉效果；角色背后可带有月轮、光环、神光、古阵或图标式圆形结构。服饰采用东方奇幻风格，材质轻盈华美，包含薄纱、飘带、层叠裙摆、金属饰品、玉饰或冠冕。发丝与衣物随风飘动，营造强烈的动态美感。背景根据角色气质自动匹配东方奇幻场景，如星空神域、云海天宫、月下圣地、竹林仙山、冰雪秘境、静夜祭坛、古老遗迹等，环境需带有烟雾、流光、粒子、神秘能量及空间深度。色彩采用统一且高级的主色调以把控画面。可根据角色与道具自动选择冰蓝、月白、青色、紫色、赤金、墨黑、银灰等配色方案，并辅以少量亮金或冷光进行神性点缀。整体要求：唯美、梦幻、空灵、神秘、超脱、神圣、精致，具备电影级光影、体积光、空气感及超精细 CG 插画质感；避免庸俗，避免廉价古风摄影感，避免网红脸，避免背景杂乱，避免塑料质感。
