The figure should resemble {argument name="character name" default="Luo Yonghao"} Hairstyle is{argument name="hair style" default="Short black hair, neatly combed"} Clothing is{argument name="outfit" default="Minimalist black shirt"} The images need to maintain a realistic feel, but should also have a slightly idealized quality, like a high-end product launch ad, with cinematic contrast, soft edge lighting around the Apple logo, delicate reflections on glass buildings, elegant typographical hierarchy, and a highly persuasive, high-tech advertising feel.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具质感、精美绝伦的中国企业任命海报，采用高端苹果发布会风格，4:5 竖构图。画面主体为一位自信的中年东亚男性，半身像，背景是黄昏时分一座充满未来感的玻璃环形园区建筑，右后方有一个巨大的发光白色苹果 Logo。他身穿极简黑色衬衫，内搭深色打底，姿态沉稳且充满权威感，采用奢侈品牌广告的布光方式。天空呈现深蓝到灰色的渐变，整体色调为深海军蓝、炭灰、银色和柔和的暖白色。在顶部正中央放置一个小巧的白色苹果 Logo，两侧各有一条细横线，下方配有优雅的无衬线中文字样“Apple 新篇章 由此开启”。右上角添加醒目的红色粗体中文：“AI 生成”。在画面中上部，添加巨大的白色粗体中文标题：“{argument name="headline text" default="罗永浩 接任 Apple CEO"}”。在其正下方，添加字间距较宽的白色中文副标题：“用 工 匠 精 神 ， 让 世 界 再 次 惊 叹”。在人物胸部左侧，放置一个引用块，包含一个巨大的左引号和两行深海军蓝色的中文正文：“{argument name="quote" default="我不是来改变 Apple，而是让 Apple 重拾改变世界的勇气。"}”，随后是手写风格的签名行和名字“罗永浩”。在画面中下部，叠加一个深色半透明横条，包含 4 个图标和文字项，从左到右均匀分布：1) 锤子图标，标题“工匠精神”，副标题“极致产品主义”；2) 气泡图标，标题“用户至上”，副标题“体验超越期待”；3) 灯泡图标，标题“创新驱动”，副标题“重新定义未来”；4) 心形轮廓图标，标题“真诚沟通”，副标题“打造人心的科技”。在底部正中央，添加大号白色英文字体：“Think Different. Think Again.”，下方配以较小的白色中文字体：“现在，交给罗永浩。”以及下方的亲笔签名。人物应类似于 {argument name="character name" default="罗永浩"}，发型为 {argument name="hair style" default="黑色短发，梳理整齐"}，服装为 {argument name="outfit" default="极简黑色衬衫"}。图像需保持写实感，但要像高端发布会广告那样略带理想化，具备电影级的对比度、苹果 Logo 周围柔和的边缘光晕、玻璃建筑上的细腻反射、优雅的排版层级，以及极具说服力的高端科技广告质感。

templates.title: Nostalgic family living room photos from 2003

titleLocalized.zh: 怀旧 2003 年家庭客厅照片

templates.prompt: A candid family interior photograph taken in early 21st-century mainland China using a consumer-grade digital camera. The focus is slightly soft, the colors are muted, and there is a slight amount of noise. The lower right corner displays the camera's built-in date stamp.{argument name="date stamp" default="2003.12.28"} The scene depicts a simple living room, with the faces of three figures deliberately blurred: To the left foreground, an adult woman in a light pinkish-purple sweater sits on the edge of a bed or sofa, her body slightly turned towards the camera; in the center of the background, an adult man in dark clothing squats in front of a wooden TV cabinet, adjusting a silver DVD or VCD player; to the right foreground, a little girl in a light pink sweater and dark pants kneels on an intricately patterned red carpet, holding a colorful toy car. Behind them is a bulky silver CRT television, its screen displaying gray static, covered with a lace fabric. The wall behind the television is full of life: above a calendar hangs a large red poster with the character "福" (fortune/blessing), along with several framed family photos and scattered pictures. On the far right is a tall black shelf neatly stacked with VHS tapes or media boxes, books, and topped with a potted plant with cascading green leaves. On the left edge, part of a bed or sofa is visible, furnished with light-colored bedding and red cushions. Add eye-catching red bold Chinese characters to the top left corner.{argument name="headline text" default="AI-generated"} The overall composition presents a genuine and believable family moment, unstaged, featuring authentic household items, a nostalgic realism, natural indoor lighting, and the unique texture of old personal photographs.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张 21 世纪初中国大陆风格的家庭室内抓拍照片，采用消费级数码相机拍摄，焦点略显柔和，色彩柔和，带有轻微噪点，右下角带有相机自带的日期戳，显示为 {argument name="date stamp" default="2003.12.28"}。场景展示了一个朴素的客厅，三个人物的面部被刻意模糊处理：左前方，一位身穿淡粉紫色针织衫的成年女性坐在床边或沙发边缘，身体略微转向镜头；背景中央，一位身穿深色衣服的成年男性蹲在木质电视柜前，正在调试一台银色的 DVD 或 VCD 播放机；右前方，一个小女孩身穿浅粉色毛衣和深色裤子，跪在花纹繁复的红色地毯上，手里拿着一辆彩色玩具车。他们身后是一台笨重的银色 CRT 电视机，屏幕显示着灰色的雪花点，顶部覆盖着一块蕾丝布。电视机后的墙壁充满了生活气息：挂历上方贴着一张写有“福”字的红色大字海报，还有几张装裱的家庭照片和零星张贴的图片。最右侧是一个高大的黑色置物架，上面整齐地堆放着 VHS 录像带或媒体盒、书籍，顶部摆放着一盆垂下绿叶的盆栽。左侧边缘可见部分床铺或沙发，配有浅色床品和红色靠垫。在左上角添加醒目的红色粗体中文字样 {argument name="headline text" default="AI生成"}。整体构图呈现为一个未经摆拍、真实可信的家庭瞬间，包含地道的居家杂物、怀旧写实感、自然的室内光线，以及旧时个人照片特有的质感。

templates.title: Apple-style minimalist presentation cover

titleLocalized.zh: Apple 风格极简演示文稿封面

templates.prompt: Create a high-end, minimalist Keynote-style presentation cover slide with Apple industrial design aesthetics. Use a 16:9 widescreen layout with a deep matte black upper half of the background and a light concrete gray platform occupying the bottom quarter of the image. Place a large, realistic floating rectangular panel in the center foreground on the right, resembling a thin black glass device or a polished obsidian platform with mirrored reflections, beveled chrome edges, and a precision industrial finish. This panel should float above the light-colored surface, casting a soft, elongated shadow directly below it. Add a tall, vertical gray metal wall or column along the far right edge for composition. Employ extremely minimalist, high-end art direction, leaving ample negative space, utilizing cinematic studio lighting, subtle gradients, and a clear contrast between black and silver materials. On the left, set up a clean white sans-serif font and maintain a clear hierarchy: a small heading at the top.{argument name="system label" default="Apple-inspired presentation system"} The title in the middle is a very large, bold heading.{argument name="headline text" default="Clarity At Scale"} Below this is a subtitle in medium font size.{argument name="subtitle text" default="The strongest slides behave like products."} Below it, in a vertical list format, are three numbering principles with thin separators and delicate spacing: "01 |{argument name="principle 1" default="One focal object"} “02 | Binary light / dark rhythm” and “03 | Blue only for signal”. Add a short, thin horizontal line above the list and a tiny blue accent line below the list. Draw an extremely thin horizontal guide line near the top that runs through most of the slides and label the page number “01” in the upper right corner. Repeat the tiny title “Apple-inspired presentation system” again on a light-colored surface at the bottom left. Overall look: luxurious tech presentation, editorial product launch slides, ultra-clean Swiss grid layout, restrained monochromatic color scheme (with only one subtle blue accent), and realistic rendering effects that blend with the presentation design.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个具有 Apple 工业设计美学的高级极简 Keynote 风格演示文稿封面 Slides。使用 16:9 宽屏布局，背景上半部分为深哑光黑色，下半部分为占据画面底部四分之一的浅混凝土灰色平台。在右侧中心前景处放置一个大型逼真的悬浮矩形板，外观类似于薄型黑色玻璃设备或带有镜面反射、倒角铬金属边缘及精密工业饰面的抛光黑曜石平台。该板应悬浮在浅色表面上方，并在其正下方投下柔和的拉长阴影。在最右侧边缘添加一堵高大的垂直灰色金属墙或立柱以构图。采用极其简洁的高端艺术指导，留出大量负空间，运用电影级摄影棚灯光、微妙的渐变，以及黑色与银色材质之间清晰的对比。在左侧，设置干净的白色无衬线字体，并保持清晰的层级：顶部为一行微小的标题“{argument name="system label" default="Apple-inspired presentation system"}”，中间为一行非常大的粗体标题“{argument name="headline text" default="Clarity At Scale"}”，下方为一行中等字号的副标题“{argument name="subtitle text" default="The strongest slides behave like products."}”。在其下方，以垂直列表形式包含 3 条带细分隔线和精致间距的编号原则：“01 | {argument name="principle 1" default="One focal object"}”、“02 | Binary light / dark rhythm”以及“03 | Blue only for signal”。在列表上方添加一条短细水平线，在列表下方添加一条微小的蓝色强调线。在顶部附近绘制一条贯穿大部分 Slides 的极细水平引导线，并在右上角标注页码“01”。在底部左侧的浅色表面上再次重复微小的标题“Apple-inspired presentation system”。整体外观：奢华科技演示、编辑级产品发布 Slides、超干净的瑞士网格布局、克制的单色调配色方案（仅含一处微妙的蓝色点缀），以及融合了演示文稿设计的逼真渲染效果。

templates.title: Thoughtful Systems demo cover

titleLocalized.zh: Thoughtful Systems 演示封面

templates.prompt: Create a sophisticated, editorial-style presentation cover slide using a warm Claude-inspired design system. Use a 16:9 landscape composition with a parchment background featuring delicate paper textures, soft shadows, and layered torn paper collage elements. The overall color scheme should consist of warm ivory, cream, sand, charcoal gray, soft black, and terracotta accents. Place a small label on the left side displaying "..."{argument name="system label" default="Claude-style presentation system"} The title is accompanied by a small terracotta dot and a thin horizontal dividing line. Below it is an oversized, elegant, high-contrast serif heading in black, containing the text "".{argument name="main headline" default="Thoughtful Systems"} The heading, divided into two lines, occupies the main position on the left. Below the heading, add a smaller terracotta-colored serif subheading with the content "{argument name="subheadline" default="Warmth can also be precise."} Below this, create a vertical list containing four design principles, each on a separate line with thin dividing lines and small icons on the left: 1) A rectangular parchment icon with the text "Parchment Canvas"; 2) A serif capital T icon with the text "Serif-dominated hierarchy"; 3) A filled terracotta circle icon with the text "Terracotta for cues"; 4) A chain icon with the text "Organic charts over cold metallic feel". Add a small footer in the bottom left corner with "CLAUDE-INSPIRED PRESENTATION SYSTEM" in widely spaced lowercase letters. In the right half, construct a list of three... A layered collage of paper cards: The first is a tall, off-white art card with a thin border, containing the title "A More Thoughtful Approach," a short text about how complex problems become clearer, a minimalist landscape line drawing with a terracotta sun, and a vertical terracotta plant branch overlaid on the card; the second is a dark charcoal gray rectangular card behind it, with the lowercase title "Thinking Process" and a precise five-step numbered list: "01 Observe," "02 Interpret," "03 Connect," "04 Synthesize," and "05 Act with Care," as well as a delicate circular track diagram with dotted lines and terracotta highlights; the third is a torn-edge off-white sticky note near the bottom front, featuring a hand-drawn overlapping circle diagram, with a crescent-shaped intersection filled in terracotta, next to a handwritten quote:{argument name="quote" default="Clarity becomes apparent when a system is intentionally designed."} Insert an extra light beige strip of paper below the bottom card. Emphasize tactile realism, elegant white space, exquisite printing and editing, soft natural lighting, and a calm, thoughtful, luxurious technological atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个精致的编辑风格演示封面幻灯片，采用温暖的 Claude 风格设计系统。使用 16:9 横向构图，背景为羊皮纸，带有细腻的纸张纹理、柔和的阴影以及分层的撕纸拼贴元素。整体色调应为暖象牙色、奶油色、沙色、炭灰色、柔和黑色以及赤陶色点缀。在左半部分，放置一个小标签，显示“{argument name="system label" default="Claude 风格演示系统"}”，配有一个赤陶色小圆点和一条细水平分割线。在其下方，设置一个超大且优雅的高对比度衬线标题，颜色为黑色，内容为“{argument name="main headline" default="Thoughtful Systems"}”，分为两行，占据左侧主要位置。在标题下方，添加一个较小的赤陶色衬线副标题，内容为“{argument name="subheadline" default="温暖亦可精准。"}”。在此之下，创建一个包含 4 个设计原则的垂直列表，每一项占一行，带有细分割线和左侧小图标：1) 一个矩形羊皮纸图标，文字为“羊皮纸画布”；2) 一个衬线大写字母 T 图标，文字为“衬线主导的层级”；3) 一个填充的赤陶色圆形图标，文字为“赤陶色用于信号提示”；4) 一个链条图标，文字为“有机图表胜过冷峻金属感”。在左下角添加一行微小的页脚说明，以间距较大的小写字母显示“CLAUDE-INSPIRED PRESENTATION SYSTEM”。在右半部分，构建一个由 3 张纸质卡片组成的分层拼贴：第一张是带有细边框的米白色高长艺术卡片，包含标题“更深思熟虑的方法”、一段关于复杂问题如何趋于清晰的简短正文、一幅带有赤陶色太阳的极简风景线条画，以及一张覆盖在卡片上的垂直赤陶色植物枝条；第二张是位于其后方的深炭灰色矩形卡片，带有小写标题“thinking process”和一个精确的 5 步编号列表：“01 Observe”、“02 Interpret”、“03 Connect”、“04 Synthesize”、“05 Act with care”，以及一个带有虚线和赤陶色高光的精致圆形轨道图；第三张是靠近底部前方的一张撕边米白色便签卡，上面有一个手绘的重叠圆圈图，其中一个新月形的交叉区域用赤陶色填充，旁边是一句手写引语：“{argument name="quote" default="当系统被有意设计时，清晰度便会显现。"}”。在底部卡片下方塞入一条额外的浅米色纸条。强调触感真实性、优雅的留白、印刷编辑的精致感、柔和的自然光影以及冷静、深思熟虑的奢华科技氛围。

templates.title: Chinese VPS Review Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 中文 VPS 测评封面

templates.prompt: Create a clean and modern Chinese tech blog cover with a 16:9 widescreen layout, a soft light gray background, rounded corners, and a minimalist dashboard aesthetic. At the top left, place a small, rounded category label with a yellow dot icon, reading "VPS Real-World Testing & Purchase Reference." Below this are two stacked, oversized, dark navy blue Chinese titles: "After DMIT's Price Hike" and "I've Bought Bandwagon Host." Add a short yellow underline below the titles, followed by a medium gray subtitle, "Read the Key Points Before Ordering." The layout should be sophisticated, editorial, and easy to read, with strong contrast and ample spacing. On the right, display a floating desktop application-style server monitoring panel with white cards as the main element, featuring subtle shadows and rounded corners. At the top is a light beige browser bar with three circular window buttons. The panel title should be "BandwagonHost – CN2 GIA," with a smaller line of text below reading "Los Angeles · CN2 GIA" and a green "Running" status label. A small clock icon and the text "Running for 27 days" are located in the upper right corner. The top row of the panel contains five indicator cards, labeled "CPU" (12%), "Memory" (28%), "Hard Disk" (18%), "Bandwidth" (1.2 Mbps), and "Latency (Local)" (156 ms). Each indicator is accompanied by a small cyan icon and a thin cyan progress bar. A large line graph card is placed on the lower left, titled "Stability (Last 7 Days)," with "Availability 99.92%" in the upper right corner. The graph contains a cyan fluctuating curve, with the vertical axis ranging from 97% to 100%, and date labels from "05-13" to "05-19." Add a specifications card titled "Configuration Summary" to the right of the chart, listing five lines: "CPU 2 vCPU", "Memory 2 GB", "Hard Disk 40 GB SSD", "Bandwidth 1 TB/month", and "System CentOS 7.9 64bit". In the lower left corner where the text block overlaps with the dashboard, add a small white rounded-corner recommendation card. The title row contains a yellow bookmark icon with the text "Purchase Reference - Focus on These Items". Inside, four lines are listed: "Line Quality CN2 GIA", "Stability ★★★★☆", "Above-average Price-Performance Ratio", and "Suitable Scenarios: Website Building/Relay/Light Applications". Add soft decorative elements to the background: a light mint green abstract rounded shape in the lower left corner, with a light mint green dot pattern above it, and a light-colored dotted arc extending from the left text area to the top of the dashboard, with a small yellow dot on the curve. Place a yellow rounded nameplate in the lower right corner of the canvas with the text "Xiao Mo Tongxue". The overall design uses a restrained color scheme of deep navy blue, cyan, yellow, white, and light gray, presenting a clear vector-style rendering, delicate shadows, and a spacious composition, creating a professional and exquisite AI-generated VPS review article cover.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个简洁现代的中文科技博客封面，采用 16:9 宽屏布局，背景为柔和的浅灰色，画布采用圆角设计，并呈现极简的仪表盘美学。在左侧顶部放置一个带有黄色圆点图标的小型圆角分类标签，文字为“VPS 实测 · 购买参考”。下方设置两行堆叠的超大号深海军蓝中文标题：“DMIT 涨价之后”和“我把搬瓦工”。在标题下方添加一条短黄色下划线装饰，随后是中灰色的副标题“先看重点再下单”。排版应具有高级感、编辑感且易于阅读，对比度强烈，间距充裕。在右侧，展示一个悬浮的桌面应用风格服务器监控面板，主体为白色卡片，带有细腻阴影和圆角，顶部为浅米色浏览器栏，配有三个圆形窗口按钮。面板标题应为“BandwagonHost – CN2 GIA”，下方有一行较小的文字“洛杉矶 · CN2 GIA”以及绿色的“运行中”状态标签，右上角配有一个小型时钟图标和文字“运行时长 27 天”。面板内顶部一行包含 5 个指标卡片，标签分别为“CPU”显示“12%”、“内存”显示“28%”、“硬盘”显示“18%”、“带宽”显示“1.2 Mbps”以及“延迟（本地）”显示“156 ms”，每个指标配有一个青色小图标和一条细青色进度条。下方左侧放置一个大型折线图卡片，标题为“稳定性（近 7 天）”，右上角标注“可用性 99.92%”，图表内有一条青色波动曲线，纵轴刻度从 97% 到 100%，日期标签从“05-13”到“05-19”。图表右侧添加一个标题为“配置摘要”的规格卡片，列出 5 行内容：“CPU 2 vCPU”、“内存 2 GB”、“硬盘 40 GB SSD”、“流量 1 TB/月”以及“系统 CentOS 7.9 64bit”。在左下角文字块与仪表盘重叠区域，添加一张较小的白色圆角阴影推荐卡片。标题行包含一个黄色书签图标，文字为“购买参考 · 重点看这几项”。内部列出 4 行内容：“线路质量  CN2 GIA”、“稳定性  ★★★★☆”、“性价比  中上”以及“适用场景  建站 / 中转 / 轻应用”。在背景中添加柔和的装饰元素：左下角一个浅薄荷绿的抽象圆角形状，其上方为淡淡的薄荷绿点阵图案，并有一条浅色点状弧线从左侧文字区域延伸至仪表盘顶部，曲线上带有一个黄色小圆点。在画布右下角放置一个黄色圆角名牌，文字为“小墨同学”。整体使用深海军蓝、青色、黄色、白色和浅灰色的克制配色方案，呈现清晰的矢量风格渲染、细腻的阴影、宽敞的构图，打造出专业且精致的 AI 生成式 VPS 测评文章封面。

templates.title: Retro comic page of "Classic of Mountains and Seas"

titleLocalized.zh: 《山海经》复古漫画页面

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference images as layout and style guidelines, refactor them into a retro Chinese mythology illustration story page, instead of the original Sun Wukong page. Maintain the aged textbook/comic book print look, yellowed paper texture, vintage ink wash rendering, and multi-panel comic layout. Replace the original content with a page themed around the *Classic of Mountains and Seas*. Retain the vertical title bar on the left, but change the main title to {argument name="title text" default="Classic of Mountains and Seas"} The design comprises eight content panels: a large title/main image panel at the top left, showcasing mythological figures and a red sun; five medium-sized narrative panels in the middle row, displaying different scenes from ancient mythology; and two wide horizontal panels at the bottom row. Dense Chinese explanatory text is added below each panel, maintaining an old-fashioned printing style. Small numbered labels are added to panels 2 through 8, and a small red stamp-like label is added near the title. The final effect should evoke the feel of a comic book page in a retro children's mythology encyclopedia.

promptLocalized.zh: 以提供的参考图像为布局和风格指南，将其重构为一页复古中国神话插画故事页，而非原有的孙悟空页面。保持陈旧的教科书/漫画印刷外观、泛黄的纸张纹理、复古水墨渲染以及多格漫画排版。将原始内容替换为以《山海经》为主题的页面。保留左侧的竖排标题栏，但将主标题更改为 {argument name="title text" default="山海经"}。共构建 8 个内容面板：左上方设 1 个大型标题/主图面板，展示神话人物和红日；中间行设 5 个中型叙事面板，展示不同的古代神话场景；底部行设 2 个宽幅横向面板。在每个面板下方添加密集的中文说明文字，保持旧式印刷风格，并为第 2 至第 8 个面板添加小型编号标签，在标题附近添加一个小型的红色印章式标签。最终效果应呈现出一种复古儿童神话百科全书中连环画页面的质感。

titleLocalized.zh: 极简风止痒膏海报

templates.prompt: A simple, minimalist vertical product poster with a soft, light gray background tinged with a hint of green, its design inspired by modern Chinese skincare or pharmaceutical advertisements. A [product name/brand] is displayed on the left.{argument name="character type" default="Resembling Charlie Chaplin"} The figure is depicted in a half-length portrait, wearing a black bowler hat, black suit jacket, white shirt, dark tie, and gray waistcoat. His posture is formal, and he holds a bright green object with a white lid in his hands at the center left.{argument name="product name" default="Anti-itch cream"} Plastic jar. Hold the jar by the bottom with one hand and point to the body with the other, presenting a clear product display. The facial expression should be soft and pleasant, but the focus should be more on the clothing, hands, and product than facial details. Place the green brand logo and Chinese brand name in the upper right corner. Below, add a striking and elegant green Chinese title “Soothing Itch Cream” and a smaller English subtitle “ANTI-ITCH CREAM”. On the right side of the jar, add a […].{argument name="herb" default="mint leaves"} The poster features a circular plant graphic with two Chinese efficacy descriptions below it. At the bottom of the poster, an arc-shaped white panel spanning the width of the poster contains three evenly spaced green line icons and Chinese descriptions: a leaf icon for cooling and relieving itching, a water droplet icon for moisturizing dryness and itching, and a shield icon for gentle protection. The product label should be yellowish-green, featuring Chinese text and small herbal illustrations, echoing the overall green brand color scheme. Overall style: sparse, clean, commercial poster-like, with ample white space, high-end pharmacy advertising aesthetics, soft studio lighting, a combination of realistic photography and simple graphic typography, and a green and white color scheme.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张简洁的极简主义竖版产品海报，背景为带有淡淡绿色的柔和浅灰色，设计风格参考现代中式护肤品或药品广告。在左侧展示一位 {argument name="character type" default="酷似查理·卓别林"} 的人物半身像，身穿黑色圆顶礼帽、黑色西装外套、白色衬衫、深色领带和灰色马甲，姿态正式，双手在左中位置捧着一个带有白色盖子的亮绿色 {argument name="product name" default="止痒膏"} 塑料罐。一只手托住罐底，另一只手指向罐身，呈现清晰的产品展示姿态。面部表情应柔和愉悦，但构图重点应更多放在服饰、手部和产品上，而非面部细节。在右上角放置绿色品牌 Logo 和中文品牌名称。下方添加醒目优雅的绿色中文大标题“舒缓 止痒膏”以及较小的英文副标题“ANTI-ITCH CREAM”。在罐身右侧，加入一个带有 {argument name="herb" default="薄荷叶"} 的圆形植物图形，并在其下方列出 2 条中文功效说明。在海报底部，添加一个横跨海报宽度的弧形白色面板，内含 3 个间距均匀的绿色线条图标及中文说明：叶片图标代表清凉止痒，水滴图标代表滋润干痒，盾牌图标代表温和防护。产品罐身标签应为黄绿色，配有中文文字和小型草本插图，与整体绿色品牌色调相呼应。整体风格：稀疏、整洁、商业海报感，留白充裕，高级药房广告美学，柔和的摄影棚灯光，写实摄影与简洁图形排版相结合，采用绿白配色。

templates.prompt: A minimalist, clean poster against a warm, light beige studio background with subtle horizontal lines between the walls and tabletops, ample negative space, and soft, diffused lighting. On the right side of the image stands a figure dressed entirely in retro silent film attire, resembling {argument name="character type" default="Charlie Chaplin"} He wore a black bowler hat, a dark, worn suit, waistcoat, white shirt, and tie, oversized trousers, and old leather shoes. He held a slender, curved cane in one hand and wore a gentle smile. His other arm was outstretched in a gesture of display, pointing to a large jar located in the foreground center of the image.{argument name="product name" default="anti-itch cream"} The jar features a white screw cap, a translucent green body, and a bright yellow-green label with Chinese herbal packaging details, including small Chinese and English characters.{argument name="label text" default="ANTI-ITCH CREAM"} A realistic human hand extends from below, supporting the bottom of the jar, making the product the visual focus. Fresh mint leaves are added to the bottom of the jar and near the figure's feet to emphasize natural herbal elements. The composition should have a modern advertising poster feel: the product is centered and enlarged, with the figure positioned slightly to the right behind it, presenting a clean cutout effect with soft shadows, sharp edges, and an overall soft, neutral color scheme, accented by the green jar as the main color. There is no title, no additional typographical elements, no cluttered content, and no borders. A small four-pointed star icon is added to the lower right corner. The composition is vertical, with a sophisticated commercial photo-compositing style.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极简风格的干净海报，背景为暖浅米色摄影棚背景，带有微妙的墙面与桌面水平线，留白充足，光线柔和漫射。画面中右侧站着一位全身复古默片喜剧演员，外形酷似 {argument name="character type" default="Charlie Chaplin"}，头戴黑色圆顶硬礼帽，身穿深色磨损西装、马甲、白衬衫、领带，穿着超大号长裤和旧皮鞋，一手拿着细长的弯曲手杖，面带温和微笑。他的另一只手臂伸出，做出展示姿势，指向位于画面中央前景处的一大罐 {argument name="product name" default="anti-itch cream"}。该罐子配有白色旋盖，半透明绿色罐身，贴有亮黄绿色标签，标签上印有中药风格的包装细节，包括小号中文字符和英文字符 {argument name="label text" default="ANTI-ITCH CREAM"}。一只写实的人手从下方伸出托住罐子底部，使产品成为视觉焦点。在罐子底部和角色脚边添加新鲜的薄荷叶，以体现天然草本元素。构图应呈现现代广告海报感：产品居中且放大，角色位于其后方稍靠右侧，呈现干净的抠图效果，阴影柔和，边缘清晰，整体采用柔和的中性色调，以绿色罐子作为主要色彩点缀。无标题，无额外排版元素，无杂乱内容，无边框。在右下角添加一个微小的四角星图标。纵向海报比例，精致的商业照片合成风格。

templates.title: Luxury handbags and discount chaos collide in poster

titleLocalized.zh: 奢侈品包袋与折扣乱象碰撞海报

templates.prompt: A 9:16 vertical luxury fashion parody poster, featuring a single handbag as the central product, aims to showcase the stark contrast between an ultra-high-end brand image and the chaotic graphics of Chinese e-commerce discounts. The upper half should present an elegant Hermès-style advertising feel: a warm beige and taupe studio background, soft morning light streaming in from the window, a shallow depth of field effect, exquisite wall decorations, a wooden workbench, and six clearly visible artisan tools around the bag: a pen holder with several paintbrushes on the left, a small ceramic vase on the far left, a leather awl or polishing tool on the left side of the table, a leather knife on the edge of the table, an adjustable lamp on the right, and a spool of thread on the right. A gold luxury logo is placed at the top center, above which is a carriage icon, below which are the words HERMÈS and PARIS, followed by a large serif title: BIRKIN (gold). A large, structured crocodile-patterned Birkin bag is displayed in the center, its color {argument name="bag color" default="warm grayish brown"} The front of the bag features rich leather texture details, polished gold hardware, and a vertical handle. Presented on a table, it's photographed using high-end product photography techniques. A torn paper effect is added across the right side of the bag, revealing an aggressive discount advertisement below; five neon magenta, green, cyan, black, and white digital glitch effects are added around the tear. Three clearly visible Chinese promotional stickers are diagonally stacked in the torn area: a small red sticker reading "Welfare Price," a large red sticker reading "10 Billion Subsidy," and a black sticker with a bright outline reading "100 Million Subsidy." The lower third of the poster should present a boisterous comic book and live-streaming sales-style visual explosion, separated from the luxury area above by the torn paper effect. High-saturation red, yellow, white, black, and cyan colors are used, paired with sharp starburst shapes, speed lines, bold outlines, and flying gold coins. The design includes seven promotional text blocks at the bottom: a large central red banner reading "10 Billion Yuan Subsidy," a red rounded rectangle below with the Pinduoduo logo and the word "Pinduoduo," two partially cropped "Pinduoduo" side banners, two additional yellow and red "10 Billion Yuan Subsidy" pop-up stickers in the lower left and lower center, and a handwritten black calligraphy slogan "Cut it Down" in the lower right corner. An additional handwritten black phrase "Only 9.9 Yuan!" is added in the lower left corner. The overall composition should convey the feeling of an elite, fashionable advertisement being violently invaded by cheap viral marketing, possessing cinematic lighting, strong visual hierarchy, realistic product rendering, sophisticated typography at the top, explosive discount chaos at the bottom, and a deliberate aesthetic contrast between refined and low-cost internet commerce. It should resemble a {argument name="collaboration brand text" default="Pinduoduo × Hermes"} High-end brand collaboration main visual poster, used for promotion{argument name="promo text" default="10 Billion Yuan Subsidy Platinum Pack"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 一张 9:16 竖版奢侈时尚恶搞广告海报，以居中的单只手提包为核心产品，旨在展现超高端品牌形象与混乱的中国电商折扣图形之间的激烈碰撞。上半部分应呈现优雅的爱马仕风格广告质感：温暖的米色与灰褐色工作室背景，柔和的晨光从窗外洒入，浅景深效果，精致的墙面装饰，木质工作台，以及包袋周围清晰可见的 6 个工匠工具元素：左侧放有几支画笔的笔筒，最左侧的一个小陶瓷花瓶，桌面前左侧的皮革锥子或打磨工具，桌面前边缘的一把皮革刀具，右侧的可调节台灯，以及右侧的一卷线轴。在顶部中央放置一个金色奢侈品 Logo，上方为马车图标，下方为 HERMÈS 和 PARIS 字样，随后是一个巨大的衬线字体标题：BIRKIN（金色）。中心位置展示一只大型结构感鳄鱼纹铂金包，颜色为 {argument name="bag color" default="暖灰褐色"}，正面朝向，皮革纹理细节丰富，抛光金色五金件，手柄竖立，置于桌面上，采用高端产品摄影手法拍摄。在包袋中右侧横跨处，添加一个撕纸效果，露出下方极具侵略性的折扣广告；在撕裂处周围添加 5 个霓虹洋红色、绿色、青色、黑色和白色的数字故障特效。在撕裂区域斜向叠放 3 个清晰可见的中文促销贴纸：一个小红色贴纸写着“福利价”，一个大红色贴纸写着“百亿补贴”，以及一个带有亮色轮廓的黑色贴纸写着“亿补贴”。海报下三分之一处应呈现出喧闹的漫画与直播带货式的视觉爆炸，并与上方的奢侈品区域通过撕纸效果隔开。使用高饱和度的红、黄、白、黑和青色，搭配锐利的星爆形状、速度线、粗轮廓线和飞舞的金币。包含 7 个底部的促销文字块：1 个中央的大型红色横幅写着“百亿补贴”，下方 1 个带有拼多多 Logo 和“拼多多”文字的红色圆角矩形，2 个部分被裁切的“拼多多”侧边横幅，左下角和下中部各 1 个额外的黄红相间“百亿补贴”爆炸贴，以及右下角 1 个手写黑色书法标语“砍一刀”。在左下角额外添加一个手写黑色短语“只需 9.9 元！”。整体构图应呈现出一种精英时尚广告被廉价病毒式营销暴力入侵的感觉，具备电影级光影、强烈的视觉层级、写实的产品渲染、上方的高级排版、下方的爆炸性折扣乱象，以及精致与低成本互联网商业之间的刻意美学对比。使其看起来像是一张 {argument name="collaboration brand text" default="拼多多 × 爱马仕"} 的高端品牌联名主视觉海报，用于推广 {argument name="promo text" default="百亿补贴铂金包"}。

templates.title: Luxury x E-commerce Style Clash Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华 x 电商风格对撞海报

templates.prompt: Create a 9:16 vertical luxury marketing poster to showcase a fictional crossover product, namely {argument name="brand one" default="HERMÈS PARIS"} and{argument name="brand two" default="Pinduoduo"} This is a highly subversive collaborative handbag advertisement. The composition employs a striking collage style, with a vertical tear in the paper running through the center of the image, dividing two conflicting aesthetics in two: the left side presents a refined high-end luxury brand style, using Hermès orange and cream-colored paper and elegant editorial minimalism; the right side adopts an aggressive Chinese e-commerce promotional style, based on black and metallic red foil, with eye-catching promotional graphics, confetti, torn stickers, and explosive discount fonts. At the top center, both brands are prominently displayed, accompanied by a striking Chinese collaboration headline; the left logo area presents a classic luxury brand style, using serif fonts and a carriage logo, while the right logo area adopts a striking red Chinese brand style. A large Chinese main headline is added below:{argument name="headline text" default="revolutionary collaboration"} and a bordered subtitle:{argument name="subheadline text" default="10 Billion Yuan Subsidy Platinum Pack"} At the center of the image is a Birkin-style luxury handbag, facing forward and enormous in size, perfectly centered but divided in two by a tear in the middle: the left half is orange pebbled leather with gold hardware, and the right half is wrinkled metallic silver leather with silver hardware, the two halves seamlessly merging into a surreal handbag. Around or above the handbag should be five clearly visible accessory/product elements: an orange keychain hanging on the left, a locked metallic silver strap on the right, a central rotating clasp and padlock, an orange Hermès-style gift box with a dark ribbon in the lower left corner, and a beige dust bag with a small logo near the lower left corner. To the left rear of the handbag are oil-painting-like orange brushstrokes on textured cream paper; to the right rear of the handbag is a crushed red metallic wrapping paper surface with sparkling highlights and falling paper scraps. On the right side, eight aggressive promotional text highlights and stickers are added, arranged diagonally like a shopping festival poster: one huge white Chinese banner reading "Billions in Subsidies, Lowest Price Online," two "Limited-Time Flash Sale!!", three price-tear stickers reading "Subsidized Price ¥999?!", four "Tens of Thousands of Items Sold Out," five "Billions in Subsidies, Official Direct Subsidy," six "Lowest Price Ever," seven large price-tear banners repeating "Subsidized Price ¥999?!" at the bottom, and eight smaller prints reading "Suggested Retail Price ¥1,000,000+." On the left edge, a thin, vertically edited text column containing four grouped text blocks is added, featuring a luxurious layout: one "Limited Release / Global Attention / 2024 LIMITED EDITION," two "HERMÈS PARIS MADE IN FRANCE," three "CRAFTED FOR ELEGANCE," and four "DESIGNED TO DEFY THE ORDINARY." Create a black, app-style information bar at the bottom, containing three functional blocks from left to right: a red brand icon with the words "Pinduoduo," a search bar-style capsule button containing "10 Billion Yuan Subsidy Platinum Bag," two areas with lightning bolt icons and the text "10 Billion Yuan Subsidy Official Subsidy, So Low Price," and three areas with shield icons and the text "Authenticity Guaranteed, Tenfold Compensation for Fakes, 3-Month Interest-Free Installments." Add a small Chinese final slogan at the very bottom. Utilize ultra-refined commercial product photography, high-end graphic design, sharp lighting, embossed textures, foil reflections, paper tearing effects, and strong depth of field. The overall atmosphere must resemble a top art director forcefully merging traditional luxury advertising with chaotic discount promotional posters, creating extreme visual tension, irony, and a high-impact contrast.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个 9:16 的竖版奢华营销海报，用于展示一款虚构的跨界产品，即 {argument name="brand one" default="HERMÈS PARIS"} 与 {argument name="brand two" default="拼多多"} 之间极具颠覆性的联名手袋广告。构图采用强烈的对撞拼贴风格，画面中央有一道垂直贯穿的撕纸裂缝，将两种冲突的美学一分为二：左侧为精致的高端奢华品牌风格，采用爱马仕橙、奶油色纸张及优雅的编辑式极简主义；右侧为充满侵略性的中国电商促销风格，以黑色和金属红箔为基调，配以醒目的促销图形、五彩纸屑、撕裂的贴纸以及极具爆发力的折扣字体。在顶部中央，显著放置两个品牌，并配以醒目的中文联名大标题；左侧标志区呈现经典奢侈品牌风格，使用衬线字体和马车徽标，右侧标志区则采用醒目的红色中式品牌风格。下方添加巨大的中文主标题：{argument name="headline text" default="颠覆性联名款"}，以及一个带边框的副标题：{argument name="subheadline text" default="百亿补贴铂金包"}。画面中心是一只 Birkin 风格的奢华手袋，正面朝向且尺寸巨大，完美居中但被画面中央的撕裂缝一分为二：左半部分为橙色荔枝纹皮革配金色五金，右半部分为褶皱金属银色皮革配银色五金，两半无缝融合为一只超现实主义手袋。手袋周围或上方应包含 5 个清晰可见的配饰/产品元素：左侧悬挂 1 个橙色钥匙扣，右侧悬挂 1 个带锁的金属银色挂带，1 个中央旋转锁扣及挂锁，左下角放置 1 个带深色丝带的橙色爱马仕风格礼盒，以及左下角附近 1 个带有小徽标的米色防尘袋。手袋左后方是纹理奶油纸上的油画感橙色笔触；手袋右后方是带有火花般高光和飘落纸屑的压碎感红色金属包装纸表面。在右半部分，添加 8 个充满侵略性的促销文字爆点和贴纸，像购物节海报一样呈对角线层叠排列：1 个巨大的白色中文标语“百亿补贴 全网最低”，2 个“限时秒杀!!”，3 个写着“补贴价 ¥999?!”的撕裂价格贴纸，4 个“万件疯抢”，5 个“百亿补贴 官方直补”，6 个“直降到底”，7 个底部重复“补贴价 ¥999?!”的大型撕裂横幅，以及 8 个小字“建议零售价 ¥1000000+”。在左侧边缘，添加一列纤细的垂直编辑式文字，包含 4 个分组文本块，采用奢华布局：1 “限量发售 / 全球瞩目 / 2024 LIMITED EDITION”，2 “HERMÈS PARIS MADE IN FRANCE”，3 “CRAFTED FOR ELEGANCE”，4 “DESIGNED TO DEFY THE ORDINARY”。底部创建一个黑色的 App 风格信息栏，从左至右包含 3 个功能块：1 个带有“拼多多”字样的红色品牌图标，以及一个包含“百亿补贴铂金包”的搜索栏式胶囊按钮，2 个带有闪电图标及“百亿补贴 官方补贴 所以低价”文字的区域，3 个带有盾牌图标及“正品保障 假一赔十 3期免息”文字的区域。在最底部添加一行细小的中文最终标语。使用超精细的商业产品摄影、高级平面设计、锐利的灯光、压印纹理、箔片反光、纸张撕裂效果和强烈的景深。整体氛围必须如同顶级艺术总监强行将传统奢华广告与混乱的折扣促销海报融合在一起，产生极端的视觉张力、讽刺感和高冲击力的对比。

templates.title: Retro Beijing travel scrapbook poster

titleLocalized.zh: 复古北京旅行剪贴簿海报

templates.prompt: Create a charming hand-drawn vintage travel scrapbook poster with the theme of{argument name="city name" default="Beijing"} Designed as a warm-toned, worn-out sheet of paper resting on a wooden table, it evokes the effect of a Chinese illustrated travel guide page. The composition is a single, vertical poster, featuring the appearance of a slightly worn notebook page, soft stains, folded corners, tape marks, postmark-like ink, and a casual collage aesthetic. A striking, large black Chinese calligraphy title is placed at the top center.{argument name="city name" default="Beijing"} Below, English words are written in casual blue strokes.{argument name="english city name" default="Beijing"} Near the title, add a small red stamp and a short Chinese text block in the upper right corner describing the city's location in dark blue handwritten Chinese. Below the title are four Polaroid-style travel photos arranged in slightly irregular rows, each with a handwritten English description within a white border. Photo 1: The Forbidden City at sunset, with golden reflections and warm orange light; description about warm golden tones. Photo 2: The Great Wall winding through green mountains against a bright sky; description about the Great Wall landscape and green hills. Photo 3: Beihai Park lake with willow branches, boats, and a white pagoda in the background; description about the tranquil lake view. Photo 4: Traditional hutongs with gray brick walls and hanging red lanterns; description about red lanterns and charming narrow alleys. Use different decorative washi tape patterns above the photos. Arrange the lower two-thirds of the area as an infographic with colorful graffiti and a red and blue handwritten Chinese title. It contains five main sections: a geographical description in the upper right corner; a "Best Time to Visit" section on the left, recommending spring and autumn in Chinese, decorated with leaf doodles and sun icons; a "Major Attractions & Features" section in the middle left, listing three items in Chinese with bullet points: the Forbidden City, the Badaling Great Wall, and Shichahai and Hutongs, accompanied by line drawings of palaces, pavilions, the Great Wall, hutong architecture, and tricycles; a "Must-Try Foods" section in the lower left, listing three foods in Chinese with bullet points: Peking duck, Zhajiangmian (noodles with soybean paste), and Douzhi (fermented mung bean juice), accompanied by cute illustrations of a Peking duck platter, a bowl of noodles with chopsticks, and a surprised expression doodle; and a "Tips" section in the lower middle, containing two suggestions in Chinese, each with a small icon: one suggesting wearing comfortable shoes due to the large size of the attractions, and the other suggesting booking tickets in advance due to holiday crowds. A map of China's outline is added near the middle right, with Beijing marked with a red star and a curved arrow pointing towards it. On the right, a traditional stone lion illustration is placed, accompanied by a cartoon-style handwritten Chinese speech bubble that emphasizes its majesty. A prominent recommendation box with a red fan-shaped outline contains two recommended locations in Chinese: the Temple of Heaven Park (with a note about praying for a bountiful harvest) and Nanluoguxiang; this box is decorated with two architectural illustrations, one of the Temple of Heaven and the other of a traditional gatehouse. At the very bottom, there is a line of dark blue, bold handwritten Chinese quote with red emphasis, next to three doodles: a vintage camera, the Bird's Nest stadium with a small red heart, and the CCTV headquarters building. Overall style: a warm travelogue infographic, hand-drawn pen and ink wash style, slightly childlike sketching, scrapbook collage, cream-colored paper texture, soft red and navy blue color palette, complemented by soft green and warm brown, lively and information-rich layout, clear and easy-to-read mixed typography, clean composition, and a nostalgic travel poster feel.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张迷人的手绘复古旅行剪贴簿海报，主题为 {argument name="city name" default="北京"}，设计成一张放在木质桌面上的暖色调陈旧纸张，呈现出中文插画旅游指南页面的效果。构图为单张竖版海报，具有略显磨损的笔记本页面外观、柔和的污渍、折角、胶带痕迹、邮戳般的墨迹以及随性的拼贴美学。在顶部中心位置，放置醒目的黑色大号中文书法标题 {argument name="city name" default="北京"}，下方用随性的蓝色笔触书写英文单词 {argument name="english city name" default="Beijing"}。在标题附近，添加一枚红色小印章，并在右上角添加一段简短的中文文本块，用深蓝色手写体中文描述该城市的地理位置。

在标题下方，包含 4 张以略微不规则的行排列的宝丽来风格旅行照片，每张照片的白色边框上都有手写英文说明。照片 1：夕阳下的故宫，带有金色倒影和温暖的橙色光线，说明文字关于温暖的金色调。照片 2：蜿蜒在绿色山峦间的长城，背景是明亮的天空，说明文字关于中国长城景观和青山。照片 3：北海公园湖泊，有柳枝、游船和背景中的白塔，说明文字关于宁静的湖景。照片 4：传统的胡同小巷，有灰砖墙和悬挂的红灯笼，说明文字关于红灯笼和迷人的窄巷。在照片上方使用不同的装饰胶带图案。

将下三分之二区域安排成带有彩色涂鸦和红色及蓝色手写中文标题的插画信息图。包含 5 个主要内容板块：右上角的地理描述块；左侧的“最佳旅游季节”板块，用中文推荐春季和秋季，并装饰有叶子涂鸦和小太阳图标；左中部的“主要景点与特色”板块，用中文列出 3 个项目并带有项目符号：故宫、八达岭长城、什刹海与胡同，并配有宫殿亭台、长城、胡同建筑和小三轮车的线条画；左下部的“必吃美食”板块，用中文列出 3 种食物并带有项目符号：北京烤鸭、炸酱面、豆汁，旁边配有可爱的烤鸭拼盘、一碗面条配筷子以及惊讶表情涂鸦的插画；以及中下部的“小贴士”板块，包含 2 条中文建议，每条建议配有一个小图标，一条关于景点很大建议穿舒适的鞋子，另一条关于假期拥挤建议提前预订门票。

在右中附近添加一张中国轮廓地图，北京处标有红星并有指向它的弯曲箭头。在右侧放置一个传统石狮子插画，配有一个漫画风格的手写中文气泡，写着它非常威严。添加一个带有红色扇形轮廓的突出推荐框，内含 2 个中文推荐地点：天坛公园（附带关于祈求丰收的注释）和南锣鼓巷；用 2 个建筑插画装饰此框，一个是天坛，一个是传统大门建筑。在最底部，包含一行深蓝色的粗体手写中文引语，带有红色强调标记，旁边有 3 个涂鸦：一台复古相机、带有红色小爱心的鸟巢体育场以及中央电视台总部大楼。

整体风格：温馨的旅行日志信息图，手绘钢笔淡彩外观，略带稚气的素描风格，剪贴簿拼贴，奶油色纸张质感，柔和的红色和海军蓝调色板，辅以柔和的绿色和暖棕色，布局生动且信息丰富，混合排版清晰易读，构图整洁，具有怀旧的旅游海报感。

templates.title: Soft-toned beach selfie portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 柔和色调海滩自拍肖像

templates.prompt: A realistic, overhead selfie on the beach, showing a young woman standing on bright white sand under the strong midday sun. The photo is taken in portrait mode, framed from above her head to her upper thighs. She has {argument name="hair color" default="black"} Her hair was parted in the middle and tied into two long braids, hanging down on either side. Most of her face was obscured by her raised hand, shielding her eyes from the sun, creating an effortless and slightly mysterious atmosphere. She was wearing a {argument name="top color" default="pale baby blue"} A fitted ribbed deep V-neck short-sleeved crop top, revealing the waist.{argument name="bottom color" default="White"} She's wearing low-waisted bottoms. Her slender figure exudes a soft and captivating fashion photography quality. One arm is extended towards the camera for a selfie, while the other shields her forehead from the sun. The lighting is extremely bright, with soft, pastel tones, showcasing delicate skin highlights, soft shadows, and a clean, translucent summer aesthetic. The background is a minimalist beach, with faint glimpses of the coastline and seawater visible at the top edge; there are no other people, props, or buildings in the frame. The style should evoke a sophisticated social media beach selfie, featuring realistic skin texture, subtle retouching, soft pastel tones, high detail, a natural pose, and a summery atmosphere full of feminine charm and youthful vitality.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实的俯拍海滩自拍，画面中一位年轻女性站在明亮的白沙滩上，正午阳光强烈，采用竖屏手机构图，取景范围从头顶上方至大腿上部。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"} 的中分发型，扎成两条长辫子，垂在两侧。她的脸部大部分被抬起遮挡阳光的手遮住，营造出一种不经意且略带神秘感的氛围。她穿着一件 {argument name="top color" default="淡婴儿蓝"} 的修身罗纹深 V 领短袖露脐上衣，腰间露出 {argument name="bottom color" default="白色"} 的低腰下装。她身材苗条，呈现出柔和迷人的时尚摄影质感。一只手臂伸向镜头进行自拍，另一只手横在额前遮挡阳光。光线极其明亮，带有柔和的淡色调，呈现出细腻的皮肤高光、柔和的阴影以及干净通透的夏日美学。背景为极简的海滩，顶部边缘可见淡淡的海岸线和海水，画面中没有其他人、道具或建筑物。风格应呈现出精致的社交媒体海滩自拍感，具备写实的皮肤纹理、细腻的修图效果、柔和的粉彩色调、高细节、自然的姿态，以及充满女性魅力和青春活力的夏日氛围。

templates.title: Chinese classical poetry and landscape painting scroll

titleLocalized.zh: 中国古典诗词山水画卷

templates.prompt: A classical Chinese ink painting, executed on warm-toned aged Xuan paper, perfectly blends landscape art with calligraphy, featuring a simple and clear composition. A large blank area on the left is used to write the poem's title in vigorous black brush calligraphy.{argument name="poem title" default="Departing from Baidi City at dawn"} Poet's name{argument name="poet name" default="Li Bai"} And four lines of vertically arranged poetry, written with a free and unrestrained style:{argument name="poem text" default="I departed Baidi City amidst colorful clouds at dawn, returning to Jiangling a thousand miles away in a single day. The cries of monkeys on both banks never ceased, yet my light boat had already passed countless mountains."} The right side depicts a traditional landscape painting style, with a sunrise over a river gorge: a soft orange-red sun hangs low above the mist-shrouded, layered mountains, flanked by towering, steep cliffs. In the distance, a thin mist hangs in the air, and the calm water shimmers with a faint golden light. In the lower right foreground, a small wooden boat with a simple canopy and mast is moored. An ancient scholar, dressed in flowing white Hanfu, stands with his back to the viewer on the deck, his hair tied in a high bun, his robe and belt fluttering in the breeze, creating a contemplative atmosphere. A small temple pavilion adorns the cliff top on the right. The painting employs delicate ink lines, elegant ochre, and washes of ink to present the texture of paper, elegant blank spaces, and refined literati painting aesthetics. The overall composition is poetic, tranquil, balanced, and of museum-quality quality, especially the calligraphy, which is clear and legible, seamlessly integrated with the artwork.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅绘制在暖色调陈年宣纸上的中国古典水墨画，将山水艺术与书法完美融合，构图简洁明快。左侧留出大面积空白，以苍劲有力的黑色毛笔书法书写诗歌标题 {argument name="poem title" default="早发白帝城"}、诗人姓名 {argument name="poet name" default="李白"}，以及四行竖排的诗文，笔触洒脱：{argument name="poem text" default="朝辞白帝彩云间，千里江陵一日还。两岸猿声啼不住，轻舟已过万重山。"}。右侧描绘一幅传统山水画卷风格的晨曦江峡：一轮柔和的橙色红日低悬于云雾缭绕的层峦叠嶂之上，两侧是高耸陡峭的悬崖，远处薄雾弥漫，平静的水面泛着淡淡的金光。右下角前景处，停泊着一艘带有简易船篷和竖桅的小木船。一位身着飘逸白色汉服的古代文人背对画面伫立在甲板上，发髻高束，长袍与腰带在微风中轻拂，营造出一种沉思的意境。右侧悬崖顶端点缀着一座小巧的寺庙亭台。运用细腻的墨线勾勒、淡雅的赭石与水墨渲染，呈现出纸张纹理、优雅的留白以及精致的文人画美学。整体画面富有诗意、静谧、平衡且具有博物馆级品质，尤其是书法部分清晰易读，与艺术作品融为一体。

The strong perspective and shortening effect seem to invite the viewer to move closer. She has long, wavy hair.{argument name="hair color" default="light blue"} Her hair cascades from beneath an oversized, glossy green bunny-ear hat, one ear dangling to the upper left and the other to the right. Her face is mostly obscured by her hair and hood, creating a mysterious and shy composition. She wears an exquisite ruffled dress in white, green, and soft pink, adorned with lace, ribbons, and a pink bow at the neckline. Her other arm holds a plush toy: a white bunny doll with pink inner ears, a wide-open mouth, a button-X eye, and a clown-style collar with small bells. promptLocalized.zh: 一张动漫奇幻风格的特写插画，描绘了一位可爱的少女身处类似发光教堂的大厅中，一只手向观众伸出，运用强烈的透视缩短效果，仿佛在邀请观众向前。她留着长长的波浪卷发，{argument name="hair color" default="浅蓝色"} 的发丝从超大号的亮面绿色兔耳帽下倾泻而出，一只耳朵垂在左上方，另一只垂在右侧。她的脸部大部分被头发和兜帽遮住，营造出一种神秘而羞涩的构图。她身穿精致的荷叶边服装，配色为白色、绿色和柔粉色，饰有蕾丝边、丝带和领口的粉色蝴蝶结。她的另一只手臂抱着 1 个毛绒玩具：一只白色兔子玩偶，有着粉色的内耳、咧开的大嘴、一只纽扣 X 型眼睛，以及带有小铃铛的小丑式领圈。背景是一个宏伟的蓝色水晶宫殿内部，拥有高耸的发光拱门、柔和的辉光照明、反光的地面、闪烁的粒子以及梦幻空灵的氛围。高精度的动漫游戏关键视觉图风格，鲜艳的冷色调，柔和的高光，细腻的线条，光泽的织物纹理，电影级的景深，居中构图，胸部以上肖像剪裁，充满奇幻与魔法的氛围。

templates.title: GPT Image 2 Chinese Prompt Document

titleLocalized.zh: GPT IMAGE 2 中文提示词文档

templates.prompt: A clean, screenshot-style image showcases a dark charcoal gray, rounded rectangular panel filled with dense white sans-serif simplified Chinese prompts, presented as a text document or note on a flat, dark background. The composition is a single, full-screen panel with ample white space and subtle shadows, reminiscent of a modern UI card. At the top is a sentence describing the creation of a double-page spread for a high-end tech magazine, accompanied by the English title: "GPT IMAGE 2: From Ideas to Images." Below are multiple paragraphs of left-aligned Chinese text with uniform line spacing, describing the layout proportions, modern editorial design style, and detailed double-page composition. The middle section is a numbered list of six items, labeled 1 to 6, each beginning with an English module name in quotation marks followed by a Chinese explanation. These six module names are: "Photorealism," "Readable Text," "Product Mockup," "Character Consistency," "Storyboard," and "World Knowledge." Below item 2, there are five separate lines of multilingual text in quotation marks as sub-items, namely: “IDEAS → IMAGES”, “思想→ 影像”, “アイデア→ 影像”, “아이디어→ 이미지”, and “فكرة → صورة”. Following this text, add a section clearly specifying the main title and subtitle using clear, legible English quotation marks: “GPT IMAGE 2” and “From Ideas to Images”. In the lower area, add a Chinese description with a subheading in the lower right corner, followed by a precise English quotation mark title: “Typography • Photorealism • Layout • Consistency • Multilingual Text”. At the bottom is a Chinese paragraph outlining visual style requirements, such as high-end advertising quality, Apple-style product photography, Swiss graphic design, soft natural light, refined materials, clear layout, ample white space, and avoiding low-quality textures, blurry text, garbled characters, or distorted finger shapes. The text should be clear and easy to read, with realistic screenshot fidelity, high contrast, and subtle anti-aliased edges. It should not contain illustrations, icons, or photos, and should not have any unnecessary interface elements except for a single dark card. The overall design should present a sophisticated, tech-inspired style.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张简洁的截图风格图像，展示了一个深炭灰色圆角矩形面板，上面布满了密集的白色无衬线字体简体中文提示词，呈现为平坦深色背景上的文本文档或笔记。构图为一个带有充足留白和细微阴影的单幅全屏面板，如同现代 UI 卡片。顶部是一句描述创作高端科技杂志双页跨页海报的句子，并附有英文标题：“GPT IMAGE 2: From Ideas to Images”。下方是多段左对齐的中文文本，行间距统一，描述了布局比例、现代编辑设计风格以及详细的双页构图。中间部分是一个包含 6 个项目的编号列表，标注为 1 到 6，每个项目均以引号括起的英文模块名称开头，后接中文解释。这 6 个模块名称分别为：“Photorealism”、“Readable Text”、“Product Mockup”、“Character Consistency”、“Storyboard” 和 “World Knowledge”。在第 2 项下方，包含 5 行独立的引号多语言文本作为子项，内容如下：“IDEAS → IMAGES”、“想法 → 图像”、“アイデア → 画像”、“아이디어 → 이미지” 以及 “فكرة → صورة”。在文本后段，添加一个明确指定主标题和副标题的部分，使用清晰易读的英文引号行：“GPT IMAGE 2” 和 “From Ideas to Images”。在下部区域，添加一行中文介绍右下角的小标题，后接精确的英文引号标题：“Typography • Photorealism • Layout • Consistency • Multilingual Text”。底部包含一段关于视觉风格要求的中文段落，例如高端广告质感、Apple 风格的产品摄影、瑞士平面设计、柔和自然光、精致材质、清晰布局、充足留白，并避免低质量纹理、模糊文字、乱码或手指变形。文本应清晰易读，具有逼真的屏幕截图保真度、高对比度、细微的抗锯齿边缘，不含插图、图标、照片，除单张深色卡片外不含多余的界面元素，整体呈现出精致的编辑科技风格。

templates.title: Meta Quest 3 Explosion View Poster

titleLocalized.zh: Meta Quest 3 爆炸视图海报

templates.prompt: Create a simple, high-end Japanese-style technology infographic poster for use in {argument name="product name" default="Meta Quest 3"} The image centers on a vertically stacked, white mixed reality headset explosion view, suspended against a soft, pale purple-to-blue gradient background. A blue Meta logo sits at the top, followed by a striking black, bold sans-serif title.{argument name="headline text" default="Meta Quest 3"} Below is a smaller Japanese slogan: "まったく新しい現実を、まったく新しい结构から。". The central element is a highly detailed 3D product rendering, presented in an engineering disassembly format, containing nine numbered layers, each evenly separated from top to bottom, with blue circular numbers 1 to 9 on the left. The nine visible layers are: 1) a white outer shell panel with three front-facing sensor/camera openings, 2) a row of three black tracking camera modules, 3) a main logic board with a chip in the center and a clearly visible Snapdragon XR2 Gen 2 processor graphic, 4) a pair of large pancake lens assemblies with a vibrant purple-blue glass reflection, 5) a black internal frame chassis with optical openings, 6) a battery/electronic component strip with luminous blue accents, 7) two white hinged side strap arms, 8) a white fabric headband loop, and 9) a black soft faceplate pad at the bottom. Add rounded rectangular label boxes with thin white borders and slight transparency on both sides. Each label box is connected to the corresponding layer by a thin white guide line. There are a total of 7 function label boxes: 3 on the left and 4 on the right. The label boxes on the left, from top to bottom, are: "Snapdragon XR2 Gen 2" (with chip icon and small Japanese text), "Adjustable IPD mechanism" (with optical adjustment icon and small Japanese text), and "Headband design" (with headband icon and small Japanese text). The label boxes on the right, from top to bottom, are: "Face Plate" (with a simple panel icon and small Japanese text), "Trucking Camera" (with a camera icon and small Japanese text), "Pan-Camera Lenses" (with a dual-lens icon and small Japanese text), and "High-Performance Battery" (with a battery icon and small Japanese text). The bottom right label box reads "Soft Face Interface Face" (with a soft pad icon and small Japanese text), maintaining overall visual balance and symmetry. A large, white, rounded-corner banner spanning most of the width is added at the bottom. On the left is a striking blue Japanese statement: "体験は、构から进化する。" (Experience is the evolution of structure), with smaller black Japanese explanatory text below. The banner features a blue Meta logo and the word "Meta" on the right. It adopts a stylish product marketing style similar to Apple, with ultra-clear 3D rendering, soft studio lighting, subtle glows, precise shadows, a glossy plastic texture, realistic materials, a minimalist layout, and high-end corporate presentation aesthetics.

templates.title: Chinese live stream of dormitory selfie UI

titleLocalized.zh: 中文直播宿舍自拍 UI

templates.prompt: A realistic vertical smartphone screenshot showcases a Chinese live-streaming interface. In the image, a young female streamer sits in a cozy dormitory bedroom, taking a mid-range selfie from the chest up. Her face is deliberately obscured by a large, softly blurred rectangle in the center. She has long, messy, dark brown hair tied in a loose high bun, with a few wisps of hair falling down her cheeks, and a light-colored butterfly hair clip on her left side. She wears a fitted white round-neck long-sleeved top with delicate lace trim, and a thin necklace with a small pendant around her neck. Her right hand is supporting her chin, a casual and cute pose, creating a soft, intimate, and lifelike atmosphere. The background is a charming student dormitory interior: a loft bed in the upper right corner, white curtains printed with simple blue cartoon characters and stars, bottles and jars and miscellaneous items on the desk, a pink towel draped over a wooden chair, plush toys, cosmetics, and bags on a shelf to the left, and warm lighting throughout the room. Add a complete Chinese live streaming app UI overlay above the image, designed to resemble a screenshot of a real mobile live streaming app. Top status bar: The top left corner displays the time 21:15, and the top right corner displays mobile signal strength, a 5G icon, and 68% battery level. Top creator area: A circular avatar with the streamer's name {argument name="streamer name" default="Doraemon"} A red "Follow" button and a popularity statistic showing "100,000+ likes for this session." A small ranking badge showing "3rd on the hourly leaderboard." Near the top right, there are three small circular user avatars. A dark, rounded popularity capsule showing "100,000+," a close X icon, a purple button labeled "More Live Streams," and a gift progress card showing "Gift Hall 0/24" with a blue "Classic" label are added to the top right corner. A floating gift banner in the bottom left corner features the sender's avatar and the text "Sending Little Hearts to the Stars and the Sea," accompanied by a pink heart icon and x1. The comment section in the bottom left corner contains six semi-transparent chat bubbles with the following content: 1. Cute Little Bear: The streamer looks so beautiful today! 2. Little Sun: Your voice is so nice, where are you from, sister? 3. Cheese Milk Foam: What's the streamer doing? 4. Roasted Chestnuts: Can you sing a song? 5. Cat Head with Mouth: The streamer is so cute! 6. Good Luck: Followed the streamer. Add small blue diamond level badges with the numbers 6, 10, and 21 before the last three comments. Bottom Input Bar: A rounded, semi-transparent text box with the placeholder "Say something...", and four controls on the right: a smiley face icon, a glowing pink heart gift icon, a pink gift box icon, and a gray three-dot icon. Photorealistic mobile shooting style, natural skin and fabric textures, with a slight beauty camera soft light effect, realistic app overlay transparency, and a 9:16 portrait aspect ratio.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张逼真的竖屏智能手机截图，展示了中文直播界面。画面中，一位年轻女主播坐在温馨的宿舍卧室里，采用胸部以上的中景自拍构图。她的脸部被一个居中的大尺寸柔和矩形模糊效果刻意遮挡。她留着深棕黑色的凌乱长发，扎成松散的高丸子头，脸颊两侧有几缕碎发垂下，左侧别着一个浅色的小蝴蝶发夹。她穿着一件修身的白色圆领长袖上衣，内搭精致的蕾丝边，颈间戴着一条带有小吊坠的细项链。她右手托腮，姿势随性可爱，氛围柔和、亲密且充满生活气息。背景是充满少女心的学生宿舍内景：右上角是高架床，白色窗帘上印有简单的蓝色卡通人物和星星，书桌上摆放着瓶瓶罐罐和杂物，木椅上搭着一条粉色毛巾，左侧架子上放着毛绒玩具、化妆品和包包，室内灯光温暖。在图像上方添加完整的中文直播 App UI 覆盖层，设计风格如同真实的手机直播 App 截图。顶部状态栏：左上角显示时间 21:15，右上角显示移动信号、5G 图标及 68% 电量。顶部创作者区域：一个圆形头像，主播名称为 {argument name="streamer name" default="叮当猫"}，一个标有“关注”的红色按钮，以及一行显示“10万+本场点赞”的人气数值。添加一个显示“小时榜第3名”的小型排名徽章。在右上侧附近，包含 3 个小型圆形用户头像。右上角添加一个深色圆角人气胶囊，显示“10万+”，一个关闭 X 图标，一个标有“更多直播”的紫色按钮，以及一个显示“礼物展馆 0/24”并带有“经典”蓝色标签的礼物进度卡。左下侧悬浮礼物横幅：发送者头像及文字“星辰大海 送小心心”，配有一个粉色爱心图标和 x1。左下角评论区：依次排列 6 条半透明聊天气泡，内容如下：1. 萌萌小熊：主播今天好美呀～ 2. 小太阳：声音好好听，姐姐是哪里人呀？ 3. 芝士奶盖：主播在干嘛呢～ 4. 糖炒栗子：可以唱首歌吗～ 5. 嘴当的猫猫头：主播好可爱！ 6. 好运连连：关注了主播。在最后三条评论前添加带有数字 6、10 和 21 的蓝色小钻石等级徽章。底部输入栏：一个圆角半透明文本框，占位符为“说点什么...”，右侧有 4 个控件：一个笑脸图标、一个发光的粉色爱心礼物图标、一个粉色礼盒图标和一个灰色三点图标。照片级逼真的手机拍摄风格，自然的皮肤和织物纹理，带有轻微的美颜相机柔光效果，逼真的 App 覆盖层透明度，9:16 竖屏比例。

Her face is deliberately obscured by a soft rectangular blur. She has shoulder-length dark hair, wears oversized black and pink gaming headphones, and a white hoodie with a cute kitten illustration on the front. She is livestreaming from a tidy, warmly lit dormitory bedroom. Behind her is a light-colored loft bed with safety rails and cream-colored bedding featuring bears and stars, as well as a ladder with orange, green, and blue rungs. Below and to the side of the loft bed are shelves and a wardrobe area, hanging light-colored clothes and a bright yellow hoodie. On the shelves are upright books, small plush toys, bottles, and personal items. A ring light is visible at the right edge of the image. On the desk in front of her are: a smartphone clipped to a stand, a black desktop microphone with faint red accents mounted on a mini tripod, an open notebook and papers, stacks of textbooks, cosmetics including lipstick and makeup brushes, a clear water bottle, a small black rectangular box, and warm-toned string lights scattered across the table. The lighting should feel soft, homey, and inviting, with realistic indoor shadows and a slight phone-camera quality. Seven floating live chat comments are overlaid in the lower left corner, framed with dark, semi-transparent rounded corners and cyan name tags. The comments, from top to bottom, are: "Bullet screen: The streamer is so cute!", "Bullet screen: Go Doraemon!", "Bullet screen: 100,000+ viewers! 🎉", "Bullet screen cat: I'm also at this university", "Bullet screen: Looking for the same headphones", "Bullet screen: Supporting the streamer, love you 💕", "Bullet screen: Welcome newcomer!". The bottom includes a dark comment input field with the placeholder text "Say something...", and a line of live stream operation icons. A vertical like area is added in the lower right corner, with a "Like" label, a red count bubble displaying "98,000", and a large pink heart button. Overall style: Photorealistic screenshots of Chinese social media live streams, believable app UI, detailed dormitory environment, cute young campus streamer aesthetics, natural composition, clear text rendering, and no unnecessary panels.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度逼真的竖屏智能手机截图，展示了中国直播 App 中温馨的大学宿舍直播场景。界面应呈现为真实的 iPhone 屏幕截图效果，顶部包含状态栏，显示中国运营商文字、时间 9:16 以及约 67% 的电量。左上角显示一个圆形卡通头像和一个直播信息徽章，包含主播名“叮当猫”、年龄“18岁”以及“直播中 | 10.2万人在看”的字样。右上角添加用于聊天、菜单和关闭的小图标。主体场景为一位年轻的女大学生坐在书桌前，面向手机摄像头挥手。她的面部被一个柔和的矩形模糊块刻意遮挡。她留着齐肩深色短发，戴着大号黑粉色头戴式游戏耳机，身穿一件胸前印有可爱小猫插画的白色连帽衫。她正在整洁、灯光温暖的宿舍卧室中直播。她身后是一张浅色的高架床，配有安全护栏和印有小熊与星星图案的奶油色床上用品，以及带有橙色、绿色和蓝色横档的梯子。高架床下方和侧面是架子和衣柜区，挂着浅色调的衣服和一件亮黄色连帽衫。架子上摆放着竖放的书籍、小型毛绒玩具、瓶子和个人物品。画面右边缘可见一个环形补光灯。她面前的书桌上放置着：夹在支架上的智能手机、一个带有微弱红色点缀并安装在迷你三脚架上的黑色桌面麦克风、打开的笔记本和纸张、堆叠的教科书、包括口红和化妆刷在内的化妆品、一个透明水瓶、一个小黑色长方形盒子，以及散落在桌面上的暖色调串灯。光线应感觉柔和、居家且具有吸引力，带有真实的室内阴影和轻微的手机拍摄质感。在左下角叠加 7 条浮动实时聊天评论，采用深色半透明圆角框，并带有青色名称标签。评论从上到下依次为：“弹幕： 主播好可爱！”，“弹幕： 叮当猫加油！”，“弹幕： 10万+人了！🎉”，“弹幕猫： 我也在这个大学”，“弹幕： 求同款耳机”，“弹幕： 支持主播，爱你💕”，“弹幕： 欢迎新人！”。底部包含一个深色评论输入栏，占位符文字为“说点什么...”，以及一行直播操作图标。右下角添加一个垂直点赞区域，带有“点赞”标签、显示“9.8万”的红色计数气泡以及一个巨大的粉色爱心按钮。整体风格：照片级逼真的中国社交媒体直播截图，可信的 App UI，细节丰富的宿舍环境，可爱的年轻校园主播美学，自然构图，清晰的文字渲染，无多余面板。

templates.title: Chinese calligraphy and poetry scrolls

titleLocalized.zh: 中国书法诗词卷轴

templates.prompt: A traditional Chinese calligraphy work painted on aged brown Xuan paper, with a horizontal composition, presents the style of a reproduction of an antique literati hanging scroll. The main composition consists of large, bold black cursive script calligraphy, arranged in 10 columns from right to left, with the title of the poem at the top of the rightmost column.{argument name="poem title" default="Rain Bell"} The calligraphy should appear elegant, fluid, and expressive, exhibiting variations in ink density, the texture of dry brushstrokes, transitions in stroke thickness, and natural handwriting spacing, rather than perfect typography. Please use the poem text written in the image, including any typos. The main column on the right begins with: “The cicadas chirp sadly, as evening falls on the long pavilion, the sudden rain has just ceased. At the city gate, the farewell feast is joyless; reluctant to leave, the orchid boat urges departure. Holding hands, we gaze at each other with tearful eyes, speechless and choked with emotion. Thinking of the journey ahead, a thousand miles of misty waves, the twilight deepening over the vast Chu sky. Since ancient times, love has always been associated with sorrowful partings, how much more so on this cold night, when weary and tired after waking from a drunken stupor? On the willow bank, the dawn wind and the waning moon. This journey will last for years, a time of good times and beautiful scenery. Even with a thousand kinds of feelings, to whom can I speak?” Place a narrower column of inscriptions on the far left, containing one line of vertical text.{argument name="signature text" default="Liu Yong's "Rainy Night Bell - The Cicadas' Mournful Cry""} Add a total of four red seals: one oval collector's seal near the upper right edge, and three square seals stacked vertically near the lower left corner. In the lower right corner, add a light monochrome ink wash landscape painting, featuring a weeping willow and a small pavilion by the water, partially integrated into the paper background. The paper should have a warm, aged brown feel, with subtle stains, spots, mold, and worn edges, possessing the texture of a museum photograph. The overall atmosphere should be elegant, poetic, and imbued with a sense of history and scholarly refinement, like a Song Dynasty-style calligraphy artwork photographed under soft, even lighting.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅绘制在陈旧棕色宣纸上的传统中国书法作品，横向构图，呈现出仿古文人挂轴复制品的风格。主体构图为大块粗犷的黑色行草书书法，按从右至左的顺序排列为 10 列纵行，最右侧主列顶部为诗词标题 {argument name="poem title" default="雨霖铃"}。书法应显得优雅、流畅且富有表现力，具有墨色浓淡变化、枯笔质感、笔画粗细过渡，以及自然的手写间距，而非完美的排版。请使用图像中书写的诗词文本，包括其中的笔误，右侧主列开头为：“寒蝉凄切，对长亭晚，骤雨初歇。都门帐饮无绪，留恋处，兰舟催发，执手相看泪眼，竟无语凝噎。念去去，千里烟波，暮霭沉沉楚天阔。多情自古，雷情自古伤离别，更那堪冷冷宵，酒醒倦兼芊？杨柳岸，晓风残月。此去经年良宰，经年，应是良辰好景。便纵有千种风情，更与何人说？” 在最左侧放置一列较窄的落款，包含 1 行纵向题字 {argument name="signature text" default="柳永《雨霖铃·寒蝉凄切》"}。总共添加 4 枚红色印章：右上角边缘附近放置 1 枚椭圆形收藏印，左下角落款区域附近垂直堆叠 3 枚方形印章。在右下角加入一处淡淡的单色水墨山水，包含 1 棵垂柳和 1 座水边小亭，部分融入纸张背景中。纸张应呈现出温暖的棕色陈旧感，带有细微的污渍、斑点、霉斑、磨损边缘，并具有博物馆摄影作品的质感。整体氛围雅致、诗意、充满历史感与书卷气，如同在柔和均匀的光线下拍摄的宋代风格书法艺术品。

templates.title: The Surreal Woman by the Window

titleLocalized.zh: 窗前的超现实女性

templates.prompt: A melancholic surrealist painting depicts a woman leaning out of an old window frame. The composition uses a back view and tight cropping, focusing on her wind-blown hair.{argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown with copper highlights"} Her hair, strands flowing to the left and intertwined, obscured most of her bare shoulders and upper back. Her hands rested on the bottom of an old wooden windowsill, two fingers on each side gripping the edge. Her face was completely hidden by her hair and the angle. The background was a weathered, multi-pane window, arranged in a 3x2 grid, rendered in a cool, greyish-blue hue with dirt, scratches, water stains, and worn edges. The work employed a mixed-media expressionist style, combining charcoal, ink, dry brush, scratched lines, and textured oil paint effects on a rough canvas, overlaid with impressionistic black and white lines on a soft industrial palette. The overall atmosphere was introspective, turbulent, and unforgettable, as if the wind or emotion was tearing the figure apart. Soft, diffused light, subtle contrasts, and a blend of abstract expressionist realism with a square composition further enhanced the effect.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅忧郁的超现实主义画作，描绘了一位女性从旧窗框中探出身子，画面采用背影视角并进行紧凑裁剪，构图聚焦于她被风吹得凌乱的 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色带铜色挑染"} 头发，发丝向左飘散，缠绕成缕。她裸露的肩膀和上背部大半被头发遮住，双手搭在底部的旧木窗台上，每侧各有 2 根手指抓着窗沿。面部完全被头发和角度遮挡。背景是一扇饱经风霜的多格窗户，采用 3x2 的网格布局，呈现出带有污垢、划痕、水渍和磨损边缘的冷灰蓝色调。采用表现主义的混合媒介风格，结合木炭、墨水、干画笔、划痕线条以及粗糙画布上的纹理油画效果，并在柔和的工业色调上叠加写意的黑白线条。整体氛围内省、狂暴且令人难忘，仿佛风或情绪正在将人物撕裂。柔和的漫射光，微妙的对比度，融合了抽象表现主义的绘画写实风格，方形构图。

templates.title: Girl by the window in the rain

titleLocalized.zh: 雨中窗边的女孩

templates.prompt: A digitally illustrated picture book style painting full of emotion, depicting a {argument name="character age" default="little girl"} She sat sideways on the cushioned windowsill of an old-fashioned European attic room, her knees drawn up, gazing at the rain washing over the trees outside. She kept {argument name="hair color" default="chestnut brown"} Slightly messy, shoulder-length short hair, wearing a comfortable oversized cable-knit sweater and soft striped socks, her bare legs curled up beside her body. The composition is intimate and contemplative; viewed from an indoor side viewpoint, the girl is in the lower left foreground, with the rainy city dominating the right side and background. Outside the window are dense, old-fashioned row houses with pointed roofs, chimneys, and crooked roofs. Two tall, vintage streetlights are visible near the window. The sky is overcast, with layers of dense rain clouds, and the rain is clearly visible. The glass is covered with raindrops, watermarks, and wet reflections. The rooftops outside the window are mostly a soft gray, while the left side of the room emits a warm amber light, creating a strong contrast between the cozy interior and the cold storm. The picture includes patterned cushions behind her, a worn-out upholstered bench with delicate floral fabric, dark curtains outlining the left edge, and the soft, painterly textures of the wood, fabrics, hair, and raindrops, rendered with delicate brushstrokes. Color palette: warm browns, beige, soft gold, slate gray, charcoal black, and soft silver. Atmosphere: melancholic, serene, nostalgic, cinematic, fantastical, and emotionally nuanced. Highly detailed, illustrated in a painterly style, with a children's book fantasy realism, dramatic lighting, depth conveyed through layered roofs, no text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅充满情绪的绘本风格数字绘画，画面中一位 {argument name="character age" default="小女孩"} 侧身坐在老式欧洲阁楼房间的软垫窗台上，双膝相拥，凝视着窗外雨水冲刷的景象。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="栗棕色"} 略显凌乱的齐肩短发，穿着一件舒适的超大号麻花针织毛衣和柔软的条纹袜，赤裸的双腿蜷缩在身体旁。构图亲密且富有沉思感，从室内侧向视角观察，女孩位于左下角前景，雨中的城市占据了右侧和背景。窗外是密集的尖顶老式联排房屋、烟囱、歪斜的屋顶，窗边可见 2 盏高大的复古路灯，天空阴沉，层叠的暴雨云层密布，雨水清晰可见。玻璃上布满了雨滴、水痕和湿润的倒影，窗外的屋顶多为柔和的灰色，而室内左侧则散发着温暖的琥珀色光芒，营造出温馨室内与寒冷风暴之间的强烈对比。画面包含她身后的花纹靠垫、带有精致花卉面料的磨损软垫长凳、勾勒左侧边缘的深色窗帘，以及在木材、织物、头发和雨水上呈现出细腻笔触的柔和绘画质感。调色板：暖棕色、米色、柔和金、板岩灰、炭黑色和柔和银色。氛围：忧郁、宁静、怀旧、电影感、奇幻且情感细腻。高度细节化，绘画风格插画，童书奇幻写实主义，戏剧性光影，通过层叠屋顶展现深度，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: The melancholy child by the rainy window

titleLocalized.zh: 雨窗边的忧郁孩童

templates.prompt: A digitally illustrated picture book, full of emotion, depicts a thin, melancholy child huddled on a wooden stool in a dark, gray room, beside a large, rain-streaked window. The child has {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} Disheveled, tousled hair; large, expressive eyes; pale skin with a few freckles; a worried and lonely expression; hands tightly wrapped around their knees. They were wearing oversized clothing.{argument name="pajama pattern" default="Soft blue-grey pajamas with small orange patches or floral patterns"} And soft, worn-out slippers. Outside the window, a desolate city street in the rain is visible, with four leaning old buildings, four trees bent by the wind, a slippery, winding road, and dramatically rolling dark clouds. The overall composition employs an exaggerated, distorted perspective. The composition places the child on the left, with the view outside the window occupying the right, creating an atmosphere of isolation and melancholy. It uses a hand-drawn style, retaining noticeably rough brushstrokes, with a low-saturation blue-gray tone, complemented by soft charcoal shadows. Subtle highlights appear on the wet glass, and the child's clothing is only adorned with faint warm colors. It presents a children's picture book art style reminiscent of dark fantasy, conveying a sense of intimacy, cinematic quality, and the melancholy of a rainy day, with high detail and a square composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅充满情绪感的绘本风格数字绘画，描绘了一个瘦小的忧郁孩童，蜷缩在阴暗灰色房间里的一张木凳上，身旁是一扇布满雨痕的大窗户。孩童有着 {argument name="hair color" default="深褐色"} 凌乱蓬松的头发、一双巨大且富有表现力的眼睛、苍白的皮肤和几点雀斑，表情忧虑而孤独，双手紧紧抱着膝盖。他们穿着超大号的 {argument name="pajama pattern" default="带有橙色小补丁或花朵图案的柔和蓝灰色睡衣"} 和柔软破旧的拖鞋。窗外是凄凉的雨中城市街道，可见 4 栋倾斜的老建筑、4 棵被风吹弯的树、一条湿滑蜿蜒的道路，以及戏剧性翻滚的乌云，整体采用夸张的扭曲透视手法绘制。构图将孩童置于左侧，窗外景色占据右侧，营造出一种孤立与忧郁的氛围。采用具有手绘质感的绘画风格，保留明显的粗糙笔触，色调为低饱和度的蓝灰色，配以柔和的炭笔阴影，湿润玻璃上有细微的高光，孩童的衣物上仅有淡淡的暖色点缀。呈现出类似于暗黑奇幻风格的儿童绘本艺术感，私密、电影感、雨天的忧伤，高细节，方形构图。

templates.title: Gothic girl by the rain window

titleLocalized.zh: 雨窗边的哥特女孩

templates.prompt: A poignant Gothic illustration, rendered in an impasto oil painting style, depicts a lonely little girl huddled on a cushioned windowsill in a dimly lit old house on a rainy night. She has {argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown"} Her messy curly hair, wearing a{argument name="sweater color" default="Rust Red"} She wears an oversized knit sweater, paired with black and beige striped stockings and dark lace-up boots. Her posture is reserved, knees drawn up to her chest, gazing out of a tall, multi-paned window. Outside the glass is a crooked, haunted European village street with steep roofs, spires, glittering windows, slippery cobblestones, and a prominent clock tower, against a backdrop of a gloomy, stormy sky. The image must include one figure walking alone in the rain with an umbrella. The interior should include an industrial chandelier emitting a warm yellow light in the upper left corner, a red ceramic mug on the windowsill, an open sketchbook on a bench (with a drawing of a black cat visible on the pages), two red pillows, and several small framed paintings on the left wall. The color palette should primarily consist of charcoal gray, dark brown, black, and soft amber, contrasting the warm indoor lighting with the cold, damp outdoors. The composition should be slightly tilted and cinematic, with the girl positioned slightly to the left of the center, and the rain-soaked town occupying the right side of the frame. It emphasizes melancholy, loneliness, gothic fantasy, textured brushstrokes, scratches, dramatic window reflections, and a dark fairytale atmosphere within square compositions.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅充满情绪感的哥特绘本插画，采用厚涂油画风格，描绘了一个孤独的小女孩在雨夜里蜷缩在昏暗老屋的软垫窗台上。她有着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 的凌乱卷发，穿着一件 {argument name="sweater color" default="铁锈红"} 的大号针织毛衣，搭配黑米条纹长袜和深色系带靴子。她姿态内敛，双膝抱胸，正凝视着高大的多格窗外。玻璃外是一条歪斜、带有闹鬼气息的欧洲村庄街道，有着陡峭的屋顶、尖塔、闪烁的窗户、湿滑的鹅卵石路以及一座显眼的钟楼，背景是灰暗的暴风雨天空。画面中需包含 1 个在雨中独自撑伞行走的人物。室内需包含左上方 1 盏散发暖黄色光芒的工业吊灯、窗台上 1 个红色陶瓷马克杯、长凳上 1 本打开的素描本（页面可见一幅黑猫画作）、2 个红色枕头，以及左侧墙上几幅小巧的装裱画。色调以炭灰、深褐、黑和柔和的琥珀色为主，温暖的室内光影与寒冷潮湿的室外形成对比。构图略微倾斜且具有电影感，女孩位于中心偏左，雨水浸润的小镇占据画面右侧。强调忧郁、孤独、哥特式奇幻、纹理笔触、刮擦痕迹、戏剧性的窗户倒影以及正方形构图下的暗黑童话氛围。

templates.title: Anime Summer Street Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫夏日街头海报

templates.prompt: A vibrant vertical anime street poster, inspired by a pirate adventure team, is designed like a modern Japanese shopping street's trendy summer promotional visual, against a backdrop of a clear blue sky and fluffy white clouds. The foreground and midground accurately depict eight characters happily eating colorful scoops of ice cream while strolling through the city. Center front: A young man wearing a wide-brimmed straw hat, an oversized red printed T-shirt, blue shorts, and a black fanny pack, holding a mint blue ice cream. Left front: A young man with green hair, wearing an oversized black printed shirt with green lettering and layered necklaces, is eating ice cream. Right front: A mascot character resembling a chibi reindeer, wearing a large pink hat with a white X logo, a black and pink streetwear jacket, and holding a blue and pink ice cream. Right midground: A long-nosed young man wearing a hat and casual streetwear is laughing heartily while holding an ice cream; behind him is a tall skeleton man with a large black afro, wearing a crown-shaped hat, a purple hoodie, and sunglasses, also holding an ice cream. Left-middle shot: A young woman with orange hair, wearing a white cropped tank top and jeans, holds an ice cream cone; in the middle left rear, a young blond man in a blue shirt, relaxed, also holds an ice cream cone; in the middle right, a young woman with dark hair, wearing a purple suit and sunglasses, holds an ice cream cone. The overall atmosphere is cheerful, summery, stylish, and adventurous. The composition should have the quality of a high-end anime travel or retail poster, using a dramatic street perspective with dense city signs, shop windows, hanging signs, and brand poster boards. Add a large white calligraphic title text at the top.{argument name="headline text" default="ONE PIECE"} It was accompanied by a yellow handwritten subtitle.{argument name="subtitle text" default="Straw Hat Crew"} In the upper left corner, stack the poster text blocks, ensuring the content is identical: "STRAW HAT CREW", "2024", and "WE GO! TOGETHER! NEW WORLD!". On the right, add a vertical sign that reads "New World". Include a pink hanging sign that reads "ICE CREAM" with a skull logo. Add pirate skull hat logos to the corners and storefront signs. In the lower left corner, place the white handwritten "Enjoy! Ice Cream" with a small smiley face, and below it, add the smaller, bold text "Let's go eat ice cream!". Add small print on the lower left edge: "I'M GONNA BE KING OF THE PIRATES!". In the lower right corner, add "ONE PIECE 2024", a barcode, and the tiny descriptive text "STRAW HAT CREW SUMMER ICE CREAM". It employs glossy anime illustration rendering, bold cel shadows, crisp line art, rich fabric folds, delicate accessories, vibrant summer light and shadow, cinematic contrast, poster-quality typography, and a sophisticated commercial visual effect. The aspect ratio is 2:3, and it's a portrait layout.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满活力的竖版动漫街头海报，灵感源自海盗冒险团队，设计风格如同现代日本商业街的时尚夏季宣传主视觉图，背景为湛蓝天空与蓬松白云。画面前景和中景需精确展示 8 个角色，他们正开心地吃着色彩缤纷的冰淇淋球，漫步在城市中。正前方中心：一名戴着宽檐草帽的年轻男子，身穿超大号红色印花 T 恤、蓝色短裤，斜挎黑色腰包，手持薄荷蓝色冰淇淋。左前方：一名绿发年轻男子，身穿带有绿色字母的黑色超大号印花衬衫，佩戴叠层项链，正在吃冰淇淋。右前方：一个类似 Q 版驯鹿的吉祥物角色，戴着带有白色 X 标志的大粉色帽子，身穿黑粉色街头风夹克，手持蓝粉色冰淇淋。右中景：一名戴着帽子、穿着休闲街头服饰的长鼻子年轻男子，正拿着冰淇淋开怀大笑；他身后是一个高大的骷髅男，留着黑色大爆炸头，戴着皇冠状帽子、紫色连帽衫和太阳镜，手里拿着冰淇淋。左中景：一名橙发年轻女子，身穿白色短款背心和牛仔裤，手持冰淇淋；中左后方是一名身穿蓝色衬衫的年轻金发男子，姿态放松，手持冰淇淋；中右方是一名深色头发的年轻女子，身穿紫色套装，头上架着太阳镜，手持冰淇淋。整体氛围欢快、夏日感十足、时尚且充满冒险气息。构图需呈现出高级动漫旅游或零售海报的质感，采用街头视角的戏剧性透视，包含密集的城市招牌、商店橱窗、悬挂式标牌和品牌海报板。在顶部添加巨大的白色笔触书法标题文本 {argument name="headline text" default="ONE PIECE"}，并配以黄色的手写副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="Straw Hat Crew"}。在左上方，堆叠排列海报文本块，内容需完全一致："STRAW HAT CREW"、"2024"、"WE GO! TOGETHER! NEW WORLD!"。在右侧，添加一个写有 "New World" 的竖向路牌。包含一个写有 "ICE CREAM" 并带有骷髅标志的粉色悬挂标牌。在角落和店面招牌上添加海盗骷髅帽标志。在左下角，放置白色手写体 "Enjoy! Ice Cream" 并配以小笑脸，下方添加较小的加粗文本 "一起去吃冰淇淋吧！"。在左下边缘添加小字："I'M GONNA BE KING OF THE PIRATES!"。在右下角添加 "ONE PIECE 2024"、条形码以及微小的说明文字 "STRAW HAT CREW SUMMER ICE CREAM"。采用光泽感动漫插画渲染、大胆的赛璐珞阴影、清晰的线条艺术、丰富的布料褶皱、精细的配饰、鲜艳的夏日光影、电影级对比度、海报级排版以及精致的商业主视觉成品效果。长宽比为 2:3 竖版。

templates.title: The Little Prince poster in Shanghai rain

titleLocalized.zh: 小王子上海雨中海报

templates.prompt: A cinematic vertical poster inspired by *The Little Prince*, set against the backdrop of a rainy street in modern Shanghai during a blues moment. In the foreground, a child dressed in Little Prince-style clothing stands sideways to the right, with tousled blonde curls and a long mustard-gold scarf dramatically billowing to the left. He wears a long, belted sage-green coat and holds a single red rose in his hands. The face is rendered simply and softly blurred, lacking detailed features. Neon lights, traffic, and the night sky are reflected in the wet ground. In the background, the Oriental Pearl Tower stands softly in the twilight, shimmering with pink light, surrounded by blurred city buildings, shops, pedestrians, and car lights, creating a dreamlike, blurred urban atmosphere. In the upper right corner, a street sign mounted on a traffic pole is included, with the text {argument name="street sign text" default="Planet Avenue\nPLANET AVE."} Also on the pole is a red pedestrian traffic light displaying a standing human figure. On the left is a large, handwritten, calligraphy-style Chinese quote in a warm, pale yellow.{argument name="main quote" default="What is important cannot be seen with the eyes."} Below that is a smaller signature:{argument name="author text" default="— The Little Prince"} Scattered around the text are several tiny hand-drawn star doodles and a small asteroid doodle. Near the bottom left corner, there is a stylized handwritten title.{argument name="title text" default="Le Petit Prince"} Add three lines of warm yellow Chinese messages at the top. Near the pole on the right, attach a handwritten note in Chinese with the message "What is truly important cannot be seen with the eyes," accompanied by simple doodles. Add a vertical shop sign with the word "Coffee" on the left. The composition should be poetic, nostalgic, gentle, and sophisticated, like an art film poster or a literary inspirational street poster. Color scheme: twilight blue sky, amber streetlights, soft gold lettering, sage green clothing, and vibrant red roses. Shallow depth of field, glossy rain reflections, soft cinematic lighting effects, and highly detailed illustrations blend a realistic urban atmosphere with picture book character design.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张灵感源自《小王子》的电影感竖版海报，背景设定在现代上海蓝调时刻的雨中街道。画面前景中央，一位身着小王子风格服饰的孩童侧身向右站立，留着凌乱的金色卷发，一条长长的芥末金围巾向左戏剧性地飘动，身穿一件腰间系带的柔和鼠尾草绿长款大衣。孩童双手垂直捧着 1 朵红玫瑰。面部处理简约且柔和模糊，没有具体的五官细节。湿漉漉的地面映照出霓虹灯、车流和夜空。背景中，东方明珠塔在暮色中柔和地耸立，闪烁着粉红色的光芒，周围环绕着模糊的城市建筑、店面、行人和车灯，营造出梦幻般的城市虚化氛围。在右上角，包含 1 个安装在交通杆上的路牌，文字为 {argument name="street sign text" default="星球大道\nPLANET AVE."}。同样在杆子上，包含 1 个显示站立人形的红色行人交通灯。在左侧，放置用温暖淡黄色书写的巨大手写毛笔风格中文引语：{argument name="main quote" default="重要的东西，\n用眼睛是看不见的。"}，下方附有一行较小的署名：{argument name="author text" default="—— 小王子"}。在文字周围散落着几个微小的手绘星星涂鸦和 1 个小行星涂鸦。在左下角附近，在 1 个风格化的手写体标题 {argument name="title text" default="Le Petit Prince"} 上方添加 3 行温暖的黄色中文寄语。在右侧靠近杆子的地方，贴着 1 张写有关于“用眼睛看不见真正重要之物”的中文手写便签，并配有简单的涂鸦。在左侧添加 1 个写有“咖啡”的竖式店招。构图应充满诗意、怀旧、温柔且高级，如同艺术电影海报或文学励志街头海报。配色方案：暮色蓝天空、琥珀色街灯光、柔和金色字体、鼠尾草绿服饰、鲜艳红玫瑰。浅景深，光泽感的雨水反射，柔和的电影光效，高度精细的插画，融合了写实的城市氛围与绘本角色设计。

templates.title: Portrait in a Suit and Red Roses in the Sunlight

titleLocalized.zh: 阳光下的西装肖像与红玫瑰

templates.prompt: A minimalist, melancholic portrait: a young man in a black suit, white shirt, and black tie stands before a light beige wall, bathed in the warm afternoon sun. The half-length portrait, slightly turned to the side, obscures most of his face by shadow and composition, highlighting his jawline, neck, ears, and tousled black hair. He gently holds a long-stemmed red rose, its blossoms in full bloom with a few green leaves, against his chest. Strong, directional golden light from the left casts sharp shadows of the man and the rose onto the wall, creating a cinematic, romantic atmosphere. The clean, editorial style, soft, natural skin tones, high contrast between the dark suit and the sunlit wall, shallow depth of field, luxurious and fashionable aesthetics, centered composition, and realistic photographic style all contribute to the overall effect.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极简主义风格的忧郁肖像，一位年轻男子身着黑色正装、白色衬衫并系着黑色领带，站在浅米色的素色墙前，沐浴在午后温暖的阳光中。画面为半身像，略微侧身，面部大部分被阴影和构图遮挡，突显出下颌线、颈部、耳朵和凌乱的黑色短发。他的一只手轻柔地拿着一朵长茎红玫瑰，花朵盛开，带有几片绿叶，置于胸前。来自左侧强烈的定向金色光线将男子和玫瑰的清晰阴影投射在墙上，营造出电影般的浪漫氛围。干净的编辑摄影风格，柔和自然的肤色，深色西装与阳光墙面形成高对比度，浅景深奢华时尚美学，居中构图，写实摄影风格。
