templates.title: Dark martial arts game poster

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑武侠游戏海报

templates.prompt: A highly dramatic dark martial arts action game{argument name="game title" default="Phantom Blade Zero"} This cinematic vertical poster, rendered in an ultra-refined, hardcore concept art style, features realistic textures, somber volumetric fog, and high-contrast lighting. At the bottom center of the image stands a solitary swordsman, presented in a two-thirds profile, primarily from behind. He wears a wide-brimmed hat and a layered black robe, the robe torn into strips by the wind, and pale hair flowing from beneath the hat. His right hand hangs low, gripping a drawn sword, its blade gleaming with a cold, silvery light. The background is a desolate ancient Chinese city, with towering wooden towers and fortress-like structures perched on steep cliffs, accompanied by collapsed buildings, hanging chains, smoke, falling ashes, and rubble. A bright full moon shines from behind dense storm clouds at its apex, outlining the horizon and the warrior. The color palette is almost monochromatic, consisting of charcoal black, steel gray, and moonlight white, accented with sharp, deep red slashes and blood-like stripes that span the composition. At the very top, four huge white, explosive-style calligraphic Chinese characters are placed.{argument name="main Chinese title" default="Shadow Blade Zero"} It spans almost the entire width. A small, elegant serif English subtitle is added directly below it, centered.{argument name="subtitle text" default="PHANTOM BLADE ZERO"} Add a Chinese slogan at the bottom center.{argument name="tagline text" default="The flash of the sword signifies fate; only when the shadow fades can everything return to zero."} The last character is set in red, with a smaller line of Chinese promotional text added below it. A delicate decorative dividing line and a tiny red stamp-like logo are added at the bottom. The overall composition should convey the feel of an official AAA-level key visual poster: epic, ominous, martial arts, supernatural, and highly atmospheric, incorporating dynamic wind, fragments, embers, torn fabric, and the energetic feel of splashed ink.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的暗黑武侠动作游戏 {argument name="game title" default="Phantom Blade Zero"} 电影感竖版海报，采用超精细的硬核概念艺术风格绘制，具备逼真的纹理、阴郁的体积雾和高对比度光影。画面下方中心处站着 1 名孤独的剑客，以背影为主的三分之二侧身姿态呈现，头戴宽大斗笠，身穿层叠的黑色长袍，长袍被风吹得破碎成条状，苍白的散发从斗笠下飘逸而出。他右手低垂握着 1 把出鞘的剑，剑身闪烁着冷冽的银光。背景是一座荒废的中国古城，高耸的木质塔楼和堡垒般的建筑矗立在陡峭的悬崖上，伴随着坍塌的建筑、悬挂的铁链、烟雾、飘落的灰烬和瓦砾。一轮明亮的满月在顶端中心浓密的风暴云后发出光芒，为天际线和战士勾勒出轮廓。色调几乎是单色的炭黑、钢灰和月光白，并点缀着横跨构图的锐利深红色斩痕和血迹般的条纹。在最上方，放置 4 个巨大的白色爆炸式笔触书法汉字 {argument name="main Chinese title" default="影之刃零"}，几乎横跨整个宽度。正下方居中处，添加一行优雅的小型衬线英文副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="PHANTOM BLADE ZERO"}。在底部中心，添加 1 行中文标语 {argument name="tagline text" default="刀光即命运 影尽方归零"}，最后一个字设为红色，并在其下方添加 1 行较小的中文宣传文字。底部加入精致的装饰性分割线和一个微小的红色印章式徽标。整体构图应呈现出官方 AAA 级主视觉海报的质感：史诗、不祥、武侠、超自然且极具氛围感，并融入动态的风、碎片、余烬、撕裂的布料和水墨飞溅的能量感。

templates.prompt: A vibrant, anime-pop style selfie illustration depicts a young person carrying a black pet carrier containing a Sphynx cat, while holding a brown leash aloft in their other hand. The person has messy black short hair, wears round-framed glasses, and a black hoodie or dark oversized jacket; their face is deliberately obscured by a centrally located square blur. The cat is the visual focus at the bottom of the image; it's a light pink hairless Sphynx with large ears, bright blue eyes, delicate skin wrinkles, and wears a comfortable brown knitted sweater. The dynamic, low-angle selfie perspective, with the raised fist and the encircling leash occupying the upper right corner, is used. The background is a bustling amusement park or festival scene, rendered with explosively saturated colors, primarily electric blue, complemented by confetti, paint splatters, stars, cartoon-style stickers, and quirky signs. A large Chinese title is added at the top.{argument name="headline text" default="Take Pizi out to play"} Use an oversized, bold speech bubble font with a thick white outline and multi-colored fill; add a pink paw print icon near the title; add two yellow exclamation marks near the raised hand; add a speech bubble sticker on the left with the text "..."{argument name="left sticker text" default="GO!"} Add one speech bubble sticker on the right side with the text:{argument name="right sticker text" default="YEAH"} Add a paw print speech bubble in the lower left corner; and add two pink heart icons near the cat. The overall composition is vibrant, cute, and slightly chaotic, employing bold cel-shaded outlines, glossy highlights, textured brushstrokes, poster-style lighting, high contrast, and richly detailed neon comic aesthetics.

templates.title: Animated version of "The Last Supper" group portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫版《最后的晚餐》群像

templates.prompt: A dark, cinematic anime-style group portrait, inspired by "The Last Supper," is set in a long stone banquet hall at night. The image employs a wide, symmetrical composition, showing eleven female characters seated side-by-side behind or leaning against a long table. At the very center is a blonde female knight, clad in magnificent blue-silver armor and a royal blue dress, her armored arms resting flat on the table. Before her lies a glowing golden chalice, radiating a warm light that illuminates the faces and hands of the others. Behind them are three tall, arched windows offering views of the twilight landscape, with the silhouette of a large tree silhouetted against the dim sky. Dark wooden beams adorn the ceiling, and several large, shadowy paintings hang on the side walls. These eleven characters should present a crossover feel, representing iconic anime women with diverse silhouettes, hairstyles, and clothing. From left to right: 1) A woman in a shiny red, tight-fitting, futuristic battle suit, leaning forward with one hand on a table; 2) A dark-haired woman next to her, dressed in understated military-style clothing; 3) A pale, gothic-style girl in a black long-sleeved dress, her hands raised, her fingers slender; 4) A short-haired blonde woman in a loose white T-shirt, casual and modern; 5) A tall, red-haired woman in a white shirt, standing slightly behind the others; 6) A blonde female knight in blue armor in the center; 7) A black-haired woman in a black dress, adorned with gold accessories and a headdress, raising one finger; 8) A charming woman in a red embroidered dress with long black hair; 9) A black-haired woman in a low-cut black dress, leaning inward; 10) A virtual idol-style girl with blue twin tails, wearing a sleeveless outfit; 11) A green-haired girl in a light-colored patterned dress sits on the far right, legs crossed, holding a wine glass. All characters should maintain delicate anime-style faces, presenting the elegant temperament of mature young women, rather than an exaggerated comic book style. Eleven sets of tableware should be placed on the table, including eight visible wine glasses, several pieces of bread and scattered bread rolls, plates, silverware, breadcrumbs, and several metal goblets or wine glasses. A warm glow from the Holy Grail should illuminate the central area, while the rest of the room is immersed in somber shadows. Employing a painterly realistic style, highly detailed anime illustrations, and dramatic chiaroscuro, the design uses brown and blue as the main colors, accented with red, to create a solemn yet slightly decadent atmosphere. The ultra-wide panoramic composition demonstrates masterful quality.

promptLocalized.zh:
一幅黑暗、电影质感的动漫群像肖像，灵感源自《最后的晚餐》，场景设定在夜晚长长的石砌宴会厅内。画面采用正面对称的宽幅构图，展示 11 位女性角色肩并肩坐在长桌后或倚靠在桌边。正中央是一位金发女骑士，身穿华丽的蓝银色盔甲与宝蓝色礼服，作为视觉焦点，双臂戴着盔甲平放在桌面上。她面前放着一只发光的金色圣杯，散发出温暖的光芒，映照在众人的脸庞与手上。她们身后是三扇高大的拱形窗，窗外可见暮色景观，一棵巨大的树木剪影映衬在昏暗的天空中。天花板上有深色的木梁，侧墙上挂着几幅巨大的阴影画框。

这 11 位角色应呈现出一种标志性动漫女性的跨界组合感，拥有各异的轮廓、发型与服饰。从左至右依次为：1) 一位身穿亮面红色紧身未来感战衣的女性，身体前倾，单手撑在桌上；2) 一位紧挨着她的深色头发女性，身穿低调的军装风格服饰；3) 一位身穿黑色长袖礼服的苍白哥特风少女，双手抬起，手指纤细；4) 一位身穿宽松白色 T 恤的短发金发女性，休闲且现代；5) 一位身穿白衬衫、站在其他人身后稍远处的红发高挑女性；6) 中央身穿蓝色盔甲的金发女骑士；7) 一位身穿黑色礼服、佩戴金色配饰与头饰的黑发女性，正竖起一根手指；8) 一位身穿红色刺绣礼服、留着黑色长发的迷人女性；9) 一位身穿黑色低胸装、向内侧倾斜身体的黑发女性；10) 一位留着青色双马尾、身穿无袖服饰的虚拟偶像风格少女；11) 一位身穿浅色花纹礼服的绿发少女，坐在最右侧，双腿交叠，手持酒杯。所有角色需保持精致的动漫面孔，呈现成熟年轻女性的优雅气质，而非夸张的漫画风格。

桌上需摆放 11 套餐具，包括 8 只可见的红酒杯、几块面包与散落的面包卷、餐盘、银器、面包屑以及几只金属高脚杯或酒杯。温暖的圣杯光芒应照亮中心区域，而房间其余部分则沉浸在阴郁的阴影中。采用绘画般的写实风格、高细节动漫插画、戏剧性的明暗对照法，以棕色和蓝色为主调，点缀红色，营造出庄重而略带颓废的氛围，超宽全景构图，大师级品质。

templates.title: Anime selfie with a Sphynx cat

titleLocalized.zh: 与斯芬克斯猫的动漫自拍

templates.prompt: A cute anime-style vertical selfie illustration, featuring a smiling young man with {argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown"} A man with short hair, wearing large round glasses, is outdoors carrying a black crossbody bag containing a hairless Sphynx cat. A close-up of the man on the left shows him wearing a black hoodie or jacket, smiling happily with bright, sparkling eyes, as if taking a selfie. His right hand is raised in the upper right corner, holding a yellow leash. The Sphynx cat is in the center of the image, curled up in the crossbody bag, with very large ears, pale pink wrinkled skin, and large, glossy blue-grey eyes, its expression calm yet slightly curious. The cat wears a warm brown sweater with tiny colorful confetti patterns and a yellow collar or harness. The background shows the exterior of a modern transportation hub or large public building, with curved steel beams and glass, and a soft blue sky. A decorative floating sign is added near the top center, framed with the cute Chinese text "Take Pizi out to play." Soft pastel glitter, small hearts, paw print decorations, star shapes, and a subtle lens flare in the lower left corner create a warm and playful atmosphere. With clean, crisp lines, soft shadows, pastel lighting, and glossy glasses and eyes, this illustration presents a healing, everyday anime aesthetic and is highly appealing for social media.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张可爱的动漫风格竖版自拍插画，画面中一位面带微笑的年轻人留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 的短发，戴着圆圆的大眼镜，在户外背着一个黑色斜挎包，包里装着一只无毛斯芬克斯猫。画面左侧为人物特写，他穿着黑色连帽衫或夹克，张嘴开心地笑着，眼睛明亮闪烁，仿佛正在自拍。他的右手举在右上角，拉着一根黄色的牵引绳。斯芬克斯猫位于画面中心，蜷缩在前面的斜挎包里，有着非常大的耳朵、淡粉色的褶皱皮肤、大而有光泽的蓝灰色眼睛，表情平静且略带好奇。猫咪穿着一件温暖的棕色毛衣，上面有细小的彩色五彩纸屑图案，并戴着黄色的项圈或背带。背景展示了现代交通枢纽或大型公共建筑的外部，有着弯曲的钢梁和玻璃，天空呈现柔和的蓝色。在上方中心附近添加一个装饰性浮动标志，框内带有可爱的中文文字“带皮子出去玩”。加入柔和的粉彩闪光、小爱心、爪印装饰、星星形状，并在左下角添加微妙的镜头光晕，营造出温暖俏皮的氛围。线条干净利落，阴影柔和，灯光呈粉彩色，眼镜和眼睛带有光泽感，呈现出治愈系的日常动漫美学，是一幅极具吸引力的社交媒体插画。

titleLocalized.zh: 网红手持悬浮个人资料卡

templates.prompt: A clean lifestyle portrait suitable for a social media cover: A stylish young East Asian woman with long, wavy black hair sits on a light beige sofa in a brightly lit, softly colored living room. She wears a light blue and white tweed coat, paired with a matching skirt featuring pearl buttons, and a white top underneath. Her hands are raised in a gesture of celebration, palms flat, as if holding up a floating rectangular profile card. The card is a large white creator profile panel located on the left side of the image above her hands, containing a circular black-and-white portrait and a line displaying her name (the content of which is...).{argument name="profile name" default="Dan Koe"} ), 1 line account name (content is{argument name="profile handle" default="@DanKoeTalks"} ), 1 line displaying Chinese statistics on the number of subscribers and videos, 1 line of brief personal profile (content is...){argument name="bio text" default="If you want harsh truths, read my letters... 更多"} ), 1 line of website links (content is){argument name="website text" default="letters.thedankoe.com"} The text includes a line of Chinese text displaying a link, and a dark-colored, rounded subscription button (labeled as...).{argument name="button text" default="subscription"} The woman faces the camera, showcasing a refined influencer aesthetic with a neutral and friendly expression. The composition is vertical, centered on her seated posture, with the information card clearly legible and visually balanced above her hands. The background is soft-focused, elegant and sophisticated, with a light blue wall adorned with geometric wall decorations and shelves displaying small plants, bathed in soft natural light. The high-end photography style features bright and clear tones, a Xiaohongshu cover design, minimalist and sophisticated, with realistic skin and fabric textures and a shallow depth-of-field effect.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张适用于社交媒体封面的干净生活方式肖像：一位留着黑色长波浪卷发的时尚东亚年轻女性坐在明亮柔和色调客厅的浅米色沙发上，身穿浅蓝色和白色粗花呢外套，搭配带有珍珠纽扣的同款半身裙，内搭白色上衣。她双手向上呈展示姿势，手掌平摊向上，仿佛在托举一张悬浮的矩形资料卡。卡片是一块位于她双手上方画面左侧的大型白色创作者资料面板，包含 1 个圆形黑白头像、1 行显示名称（内容为 {argument name="profile name" default="Dan Koe"}）、1 行账号名（内容为 {argument name="profile handle" default="@DanKoeTalks"}）、1 行显示订阅者和视频数量的中文数据统计、1 行简短个人简介（内容为 {argument name="bio text" default="If you want harsh truths, read my letters... 更多"}）、1 行网站链接（内容为 {argument name="website text" default="letters.thedankoe.com"}）及一行显示还有一个链接的中文文本，以及 1 个深色圆角订阅按钮（标签为 {argument name="button text" default="订阅"}）。女性面向镜头，展现出精致的网红审美，表情中性而友好。构图为竖版，以她的坐姿为中心，资料卡清晰易读，在双手上方视觉平衡。背景经过柔焦处理，优雅大方，墙面呈淡蓝色，配有几何墙面装饰和摆放小型植物的搁板，自然光柔和。高端摄影风格，明亮通透的色调，小红书封面设计，极简、高级，皮肤和织物纹理真实，浅景深效果。

templates.title: Thumbnail of the Japanese AI Design Webinar

titleLocalized.zh: 日语 AI 设计网络研讨会缩略图

templates.prompt: Create a clean, modern 16:9 widescreen Japanese webinar thumbnail with a corporate tech design style. Use a very light gray background, paired with subtle diagonal translucent panels and striking electric blue geometric accents, including three angular blue and white ribbon shapes on the right side behind the speaker. The composition is divided into two main horizontal sections: a large main visual area at the top and a horizontal information bar at the bottom. In the main visual area at the top left, place a striking, bold sans-serif Japanese title in bright blue, divided into two lines, containing the following text:{argument name="headline text" default="AI x Design: Creating New Businesses"} Below it, add a dark blue rectangular banner with bold white text in the center that reads:{argument name="subheadline text" default="~Employee AI usage rate exceeds 90%・Methods to reduce design costs~"} The right half displays a brightly lit half-length portrait of a person {argument name="speaker name" default="Takuya Kawai"} A man in his thirties, of East Asian descent, with short black hair, wearing a navy blue suit jacket over a white crew neck shirt, arms crossed, leans slightly to the left towards the title. His face is intentionally obscured by a centered, blurred square of skin color. Beside his torso is a white rectangular business card with two lines of smaller black Japanese text above a larger, bold black name.{argument name="speaker title" default="Design Manager/Lecturer at SHIFT AI Co., Ltd."} and{argument name="speaker name" default="Takuya Kawai"} At the bottom, create a white information bar with thin blue vertical dividers, containing four visual components from left to right: 1) a blue gradient angular K logo next to the black KAWAI DESIGN sans-serif brand name; 2) the date 2026/2/9 displayed in large blue font; 3) a blue-filled circle containing the Japanese day of the week "month" in white, followed by the time 21:30-22:30 displayed in large blue font; and 4) a blue-outlined laptop with a chat icon, followed by the blue text "Online." Maintaining bold, highly legible typography with a strong sense of hierarchy, ample white space, precise alignment, and a minimalist layout creates a sophisticated webinar promotional design suitable for business landing pages or social media thumbnails.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个简洁、现代的 16:9 宽屏日语网络研讨会缩略图，采用企业科技设计风格。使用极浅的灰色背景，搭配微妙的对角半透明面板和醒目的电光蓝几何装饰，包括演讲者身后右侧的 3 个角状蓝白丝带形状。构图分为 2 个主要水平部分：顶部的巨大主视觉区和底部的横向信息栏。在左上角的主视觉区，放置一行醒目的粗体无衬线日语标题，颜色为亮蓝色，分为 2 行，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="AI×设计\n创造新业务"}。在其下方，添加一个深蓝色矩形横幅，中间带有白色粗体文字，内容为 {argument name="subheadline text" default="〜员工 AI 使用率超 90%・实现削减设计成本的方法〜"}。在右半部分，展示一张光线明亮的半身肖像，人物为 {argument name="speaker name" default="川合 卓也"}，一位 30 多岁的东亚男性，留着黑色短发，身穿海军蓝西装外套内搭白色圆领衫，双臂交叉，身体略微向左侧向标题方向。他的面部被一个居中的肤色模糊方块有意遮挡。在他的躯干旁边，放置一张白色矩形名片，上面有 2 行较小的黑色日语文字，下方是较大的粗体黑色姓名：{argument name="speaker title" default="株式会社 SHIFT AI\n设计部长/讲师"} 和 {argument name="speaker name" default="川合 卓也"}。在底部，创建一个白色信息栏，带有细蓝色垂直分隔线，从左到右包含 4 个视觉组件：1) 一个蓝色渐变角状 K 标志，旁边是黑色的 KAWAI DESIGN 大写无衬线品牌文字，2) 以蓝色大字显示的日期 2026/2/9，3) 一个蓝色填充圆圈，内含白色日语星期几“月”，后跟蓝色大字显示的 21:30〜22:30 时间，4) 一个蓝色轮廓的笔记本电脑与聊天图标，后跟蓝色文字“在线”。保持排版粗体且高度易读，具有强烈的层级感、充裕的留白、精确的对齐和极简的布局，打造出适合商业落地页或社交媒体缩略图的精致网络研讨会宣传设计。

templates.title: Girls' comic magazine cover

titleLocalized.zh: 少女漫画杂志封面

templates.prompt: The cover illustration of a glossy Japanese shoujo manga magazine, with its compact layout reminiscent of a real weekly romance manga, features a dreamy spring sunset over a city, accompanied by shimmering bokeh and falling cherry blossom petals. The cover primarily features four stylish, modern anime-style high school students. In the foreground, a main female character is positioned slightly to the right, presented in a half-body composition. She has long, wavy blonde hair with pink highlights, wears multiple earrings, and has delicate, soft makeup. Her posture is shy and romantic, with one hand lightly touching her lips. She wears a white shirt with a large pink plaid bow, a pink plaid skirt, and a loose pink cardigan draped over her shoulders, layered necklaces, and a navy blue backpack slung over one shoulder. Behind her stand three supporting students: a tall, handsome boy in a dark school uniform suit with a loose tie; an elegant girl with blonde hair styled in a braided bun, wearing a beige cardigan and school uniform; and a shorter girl with short, dark hair, wearing a school uniform with a bow tie. The background showcases a pedestrian bridge or riverside path illuminated at dusk, brightly lit on both sides, with cherry blossoms in full bloom and the sky displaying a gradient of pink, orange, and purple, exuding a romantic atmosphere. The composition should convey the quality of a high-end manga cover: highly rendered anime illustrations, bright highlights, delicate lines, a glossy printing texture, dense overlapping Japanese cover text, issue number badges, promotional slogans, heart-shaped patterns, shimmering effects, and a barcode in the lower right corner. It includes seven main typographic elements: a large magazine title spanning the entire page at the top (in a large pink bubble-like Japanese font with a white outline), a vertically arranged large pink romantic title on the right (with a large number "3"), two circular promotional badges on the left, a slanted banner in the lower left corner, a list of five serialized story titles and author names in the lower left corner, and another list of five serialized story titles and author names near the lower right corner. Three small publication information elements are added to the upper right corner: a date/price block, a circular issue number badge, and a narrow vertical label. A preview of the complimentary gift poster has been added above the barcode in the bottom right corner. It features ultra-refined shoujo manga cover aesthetics, incorporating elements of romance, style, youth, sparkle, soft lighting, sunset contour lighting, cherry blossom rain, the realism of a printed magazine, complex typographical layers, vibrant pink, and warm gold.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张光泽感十足的日本少女漫画杂志封面插图，像真实的周刊浪漫漫画一样排版紧凑，背景为梦幻般的春日夕阳城市，伴有闪烁的焦外成像光斑和飘落的樱花花瓣。封面主体为 4 位时尚现代动漫风格的高中生角色。前景中，1 位主要女生居于右侧偏中位置，以大半身构图呈现，留着带有粉色挑染的长波浪金发，佩戴多个耳环，妆容精致柔美，姿态羞涩浪漫，一只手轻触唇边。她身穿白色衬衫，系着巨大的粉色格纹蝴蝶结，穿着粉色格纹短裙，肩上披着一件滑落的宽松粉色开衫，叠戴项链，单肩背着海军蓝色的书包。她身后站着 3 位配角学生：1 位身材高挑帅气的男生，穿着深色校服西装，领带松散；1 位优雅的女生，金发梳成编织发髻，穿着米色开衫和校服；以及 1 位个子较矮、留着深色短发的女生，穿着系有领结的校服。背景展示了黄昏时分发光的步行桥或河畔步道，两旁灯火通明，樱花盛开，天空呈现粉橙紫渐变色，充满浪漫气息。构图应呈现出高级漫画封面的质感：高渲染动漫插画、明亮的高光、细腻的线条、光面印刷质感、密集的日文封面文字重叠、期号徽章、宣传语、心形图案、闪光效果以及右下角的条形码。包含 7 组主要的文字排版：顶部横跨整个页面的巨大杂志刊名（采用大号粉色气泡感日文字体，带有白色描边），右侧垂直排列的粉色大号浪漫标题（带有巨大的数字“3”），左侧 2 个圆形宣传徽章，左下角 1 个倾斜的横幅，左下角 1 组包含 5 个连载故事标题及作者名的列表，以及右下角附近 1 组包含 5 个连载故事标题及作者名的列表。右上角添加 3 个小型出版信息元素：日期/价格块、圆形期号徽章和 1 个狭长的垂直标签。右下角条形码上方添加 1 个插页式赠品海报预览。采用超精细的少女漫画封面美学，浪漫、时尚、青春、闪耀、柔光、夕阳轮廓光、樱花雨、印刷杂志真实感、复杂的排版层次、鲜艳的粉色和温暖的金色。

templates.title: Explosive Shonen Manga Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 爆炸性少年漫画封面

templates.prompt: Create an incredibly detailed cover for a Japanese weekly shonen manga magazine, featuring a full bleed design, an explosive and crowded visual, leaving no blank space. Employing a single-panel vertical composition, the cover illustration stacks typographic text, character art, dynamic effects, and a chaotic urban sci-fi feel. At the top is a large, stylized Japanese title in fiery orange-red with a heavy black outline and gold edges, spanning the entire page width; the text reads "Weekly Shonen Break," with a small 40th-anniversary celebration badge integrated into the title. A short Japanese slogan is added to the very top edge. A black magazine information box in the upper right corner, with bright yellow and white text, displays the date "April 22, 2026" and the price "Special Price 380 yen." The main image presents three anime characters in a dynamic triangular composition. In the center foreground, the main heroine charges towards the viewer with a strong perspective shortening effect, one hand reaching towards the camera, almost touching the screen. She is a teenage, gyaru-style action heroine with…{argument name="hair color" default="Light brown with pink highlights"} Her long, wavy hair flew wildly, her sharp, golden-brown eyes gleamed with a confident yet mischievous smile. She possessed a sun-kissed complexion, multiple earrings, and exuded a cool, rebellious street warrior aura. Her black and gold outfit comprised six key visible pieces: a cropped top, a short jacket with metallic trim, shorts, a belt with a dangling chain, a single leg strap, and fingerless gloves. Gold lightning bolt patterns and glossy highlights were added to the clothing. Yellow energy arcs and speed lines were drawn around her hands and body to emphasize impact. To her left in the mid-ground, a white-haired boy, dressed in a black and white futuristic combat suit, crouched in an attack stance, aiming a massive mechanical gauntlet or weapon at the viewer, surrounded by icy blue fragments and sharp, dynamic lines. To her right in the mid-ground, a pink-haired girl, with her hair in pigtails or tied up, wielded a circular bladed weapon, her movements accompanied by vibrant magenta energy trails. In the upper right background, a fourth visual focal point (not a main character) is added: a black-haired boy in a green-black combat suit, aiming diagonally at a glowing sci-fi rifle, partially obscured by text and effects, blending into the background action. The background is a neon-lit, futuristic Japanese nighttime city street, presented from a tilted perspective, featuring towering signs, fragments, sparks, broken debris, electrical stripes, and saturated blues, purples, pinks, and oranges. Extreme contrast, glossy print textures, ink splatter embellishments, a halftone manga magazine style, and high-end anime-style main visual rendering are employed. A striking large Japanese cover text is added to the left stacked blocks, using thick white, yellow, red, and black fonts, including the prominent title "A New Era is Born: A Super-Heat Heroine!!" Add 5 feature annotation boxes on the left, using colored rectangular boxes, with names in bold and subtitles below: Thunder Flash ブレイカー/天城ノア, 空駆けエンジン/南云ハヤト, 魔界デリバリー/ Kurashina Mirage, White Wolf Skylark/Kuse Rika, Super Deep Sea Skylark/Hayase Sky. Add five matching bold feature boxes to the right: Aurora Parette / Narumi Yuto, Kiki Gurafiti / Kono Rei, Ryukotsu Ranner / Hino Atsushi, Oukan no Ragna / Fukamachi Kai, Fuujin Riberion / Shinonome Gaku. Additionally, add three promotional tags to the right, using star-shaped or explosion-shaped tags with large yellow and white text: Header Color, Extra Large Poster Included, New Series Start. This gives the cover the feel of a major first issue of a new era of popular battle manga, full of energy, rebelliousness, dazzling, exquisite, and highly impactful characteristics of a Japanese manga magazine cover.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张细节极其丰富的日本周刊少年漫画杂志封面，全出血设计，画面爆炸且拥挤，不留空白。采用单幅垂直构图的杂志封面插画形式，堆叠了排版文字、角色艺术、动态效果和都市科幻的混乱感。顶部是一个巨大的风格化日文刊名，采用火橙红色，配有厚重的黑色轮廓和金色边缘，横跨页面宽度，文字为“週刊少年ブレイズ”，标题中集成了一个小型的 40 周年庆祝徽章。在最顶端边缘添加一行简短的日文标语。在右上角放置一个黑色期刊信息框，配以亮黄色和白色的文字，显示日期“2026年4月22日号”和价格“特別価格 380円”。主图以动态三角形构图呈现 3 位动漫角色。画面中心前景，主角女英雄向观众猛冲而来，采用强烈的透视缩短效果，一只手伸向镜头前方，几乎触碰到屏幕。她是一位十几岁的辣妹风动作女英雄，拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="浅棕色带粉色挑染"} 的长波浪发，发丝狂乱飞舞，金棕色双眸锐利，带着自信而顽皮的笑容，拥有阳光亲吻般的肤色、多个耳环，散发着炫酷叛逆的街头战士气质。她的服装为黑金配色，包含 6 个关键可见部件：短款上衣、带金属饰边的短夹克、短裤、带垂坠链条的腰带、单腿腿带以及露指手套。在衣服上添加金色闪电图案和光泽高光。在她的手部和身体周围，绘制黄色能量弧线和速度线以强调冲击力。在她左侧中景处，放置一名白发少年，身穿黑白相间的未来主义战斗服，呈攻击姿态蹲伏，正将巨大的机械护手或武器瞄准观众，周围环绕着冰蓝色碎片和棱角分明的动态线条。在她右侧中景处，放置一名粉发少女，扎着双马尾或束发，挥舞着圆形刀刃武器，动作姿态中带有鲜艳的洋红色能量轨迹。在右上角背景中，添加第四个视觉焦点（非主要角色）：一名黑发少年身穿绿黑色战斗服，正斜向瞄准一把发光的科幻步枪，部分被文字和特效遮挡，融入背景动作中。背景是一个霓虹闪烁的未来主义日本夜间城市街道，采用倾斜视角，高耸的招牌、碎片、火花、破碎的残骸、电流条纹，以及饱和的蓝色、紫色、粉色和橙色。运用极端的对比度、光泽印刷质感、墨迹飞溅点缀、半色调漫画杂志风格以及高级动漫主视觉渲染。在左侧堆叠块中添加醒目的大型日文封面文案，使用厚实的白、黄、红、黑字体，包括突出的标题“新時代をブチ抜く 超熱量ヒロイン ここに爆誕!!”。在左侧添加 5 个特征标注框，采用彩色矩形框，配以粗体名称和下方的副标题：雷閃ブレイカー / 天城ノア, 空駆けエンジン / 南雲ハヤト, 魔境デリバリー / 倉科ミツル, 白狼ストライカー / 久世リョウ, 超深海クラッシュ / 早瀬シン。在右侧添加 5 个匹配的粗体特征标注框：極光パレット / 鳴海ユウト, 機巧グラフィティ / 胡野レイ, 龍骨ランナー / 火野アツシ, 王冠のラグナ / 深町カイ, 風神リベリオン / 東雲ガク。此外，在右侧添加 3 个促销标签，采用星形或爆炸形标签，配以大型黄色和白色文字：巻頭カラー, 特大ポスター付き, 新連載スタート。让整张封面呈现出热门战斗漫画新纪元大作首刊的感觉，充满活力、叛逆、炫目、精致，且具有极高冲击力的日本漫画杂志封面特征。

templates.title: Chaotic style shonen manga cover

titleLocalized.zh: 混乱风格少年漫画封面

templates.prompt: This is a vibrant illustration for a Japanese shonen manga magazine cover, with the edges filled with explosive pop art elements and bright candy colors, reminiscent of a weekly manga anthology cover. At the center of the image is a trendy, sexy high school girl, leaning towards the viewer in a dynamic, perspective pose, grinning broadly, one hand pointing directly at the camera, the other holding a pink toy hammer. She has medium-length wavy hair, and her hair color is {argument name="hair color" default="Light brown with gold and pink highlights"} She has warm amber eyes, wears colorful hair clips, earrings, rings, bracelets, and necklaces in the shapes of stars and lightning bolts, sports exaggerated manicures, and dresses in bold streetwear: a bright pink satin bomber jacket, a white crop top, a black belt with gold buckles, and various glamorous accessories. At the top center of the cover is a large red Japanese title with a thick black border and yellow outline; the text reads {argument name="masthead text" default="バクアラ!?"} The magazine features smaller text above the main text, "Weekly Shonen." A striking, explosive headline, "Super Deluxe Edition (Gomi) Included!!!," is added to the top left corner, accompanied by a shocking cartoon trash can mascot. Two large onomatopoeic slogans are placed on the left: "Don!" at the top left and "Banban!" in blue at the bottom left. A large main title is designed on the right, using bold black, yellow, white, and pink Japanese font, reading "Laugh Out Loud, Today's Chaos Unleashed!!" surrounded by smaller promotional phrases such as "All-out attack, I'm collapsing!", "Laughing Out Loud, Warning Reporting in Progress!!", and "A New Laughing Series!". The top right corner contains a magazine issue number box, labeled "April 22, 2026 Issue" and the price "390 yen." Surrounding the central girl are three manga-style supporting characters: on the left, a silver-haired boy wearing goggles, aiming a spiral shockwave at the audience; below, a purple-haired girl holding a dessert and drink, looking cheerful; and in the upper right corner, an orange-haired idol-style girl wearing headphones and making a peace sign. The background and foreground are filled with floating desserts, snacks, toys, doodles, and mascot heads, including donuts, cookies, chocolate bars, candies, puddings, ice cream, popcorn, planets, stars, speech bubbles, and quirky creatures, all with bold outlines and halftone textures. At the bottom, seven small serialized feature boxes are neatly arranged, each containing manga character illustrations and Japanese titles, creating a crowded compilation preview effect. High-saturation bright pink, yellow, orange, red, cyan, and black are used, resulting in extremely high visual density, overlapping text, and a texture reminiscent of manga speed lines, sticker elements, and glossy printed magazine covers. The overall feeling is a messy mix of humor, rebellion, noise, youth, and appeal, like a next-generation Weekly Shonen Jump cover that is both satirical and high-quality.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满活力的日式少年漫画杂志封面插画，画面边缘布满了爆炸性的波普艺术元素和明亮的糖果色，呈现出周刊漫画合集封面的风格。画面中心是一位潮流辣妹高中生，她以动态的透视姿势向观众倾斜，咧嘴大笑，一只手直指镜头，另一只手扛着一把粉色玩具锤。她留着中长波浪卷发，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="浅棕色，带有金色和粉色挑染"}，有着温暖的琥珀色眼睛，佩戴着星星和闪电形状的彩色发夹、耳环、戒指、手链、项链，涂着夸张的美甲，身着大胆的街头风服饰：亮粉色缎面飞行员夹克、白色露脐上衣、带有金色扣环的黑色腰带以及各种华丽的配饰。封面顶部中央是巨大的红色日文标题，带有粗黑边框和黄色描边，文字为 {argument name="masthead text" default="バクアラ!?"}，上方有较小的文字“週刊少年”。左上角添加一个醒目的爆炸式标题“超豪華付録(ゴミ)付き!!!”，并配有一个震惊的卡通垃圾桶吉祥物。左侧放置两个巨大的拟声词风格标语，左上方为“ドーン!”，左下方为蓝色的“バンバーン!”。右侧设计一个超大的主标题，采用粗体的黑、黄、白、粉色日文显示字体，内容为“笑って暴れて今日もカオス全開!!”，周围环绕着较小的宣传语，如“全ページ抱腹絶倒!”、“笑いすぎ注意報発令中ーっ!!”以及“笑撃の新連載!”。右上角包含一个杂志期号框，标有“2026年 4 月 22 日号”和价格“390 円”。在中心少女周围散布 3 个漫画风格的配角：左侧是一名戴着护目镜、正向观众瞄准螺旋冲击波的银发男孩；下方是一名拿着甜点饮料、神情愉悦的紫发女孩；右上角是一名戴着耳机、比着剪刀手的橙发偶像风女孩。背景和前景填满了漂浮的甜点、零食、玩具、涂鸦和吉祥物头像，包括甜甜圈、饼干、巧克力棒、糖果、布丁、冰淇淋、爆米花、行星、星星、对话气泡和搞怪生物，所有元素都带有粗轮廓线和网点纹理。底部整齐排列 7 个小型连载专题框，每个框内都有漫画角色插图和日文标题，营造出拥挤的合集预告条效果。使用高饱和度的亮粉色、黄色、橙色、红色、青色和黑色，视觉密度极高，文字重叠，配有漫画速度线、贴纸元素和光面印刷杂志封面的质感。整体感觉搞笑、叛逆、喧闹、年轻且极具吸引力的杂乱感，仿佛一张既是恶搞又具备高品质的次世代《周刊少年 Jump》封面。

templates.title: Blockbuster-level anime sky fantasy poster

titleLocalized.zh: 大片级动漫天空幻想海报

templates.prompt: A breathtaking Japanese anime movie poster, employing a blockbuster-level cinematic visual style, is rich in detail and emotionally grand, possessing the exquisite and bright skies characteristic of modern high-quality anime films. The image shows two characters with their backs to the camera, standing on a flower-covered cliff, overlooking a coastal fantasy city glowing at sunset and twilight: on the left is a boy in a dark school uniform, his tie loose, his short hair flowing in the wind; on the right is a girl in a long, flowing light-colored dress, with incredibly long, silver-white hair. Both gaze in awe at the horizon. Above them, a vast sky dominates the composition, painted with vibrant deep blue, indigo, violet, magenta, and gold clouds. A brilliant comet-like meteor streaks diagonally across the horizon from the center, while countless stars twinkle and shimmer. A glowing, circular, magical ring constellation appears in the upper right sky. Below, the ocean and city shimmer with reflected light, slender fantasy skyscrapers and towers rise from the coastline, and a brilliant slit of sunlight pierces the center of the horizon. The foreground flowers are saturated in blue and purple with luminous highlights, and white and pink petals drift down from the sky. The design utilizes dramatic rim lighting, cinematic backlighting, lens flare effects, highly detailed anime rendering, crisp lines, atmospheric depth, and a vertical poster composition. Japanese poster typography is incorporated into the design: a large, embossed gold title text spans the top.{argument name="top headline text" default="Box office revenue surpasses 10 billion yen."} There is a gold subtitle block in the upper left corner.{argument name="subheadline text" default="Now showing to great success"} There is a vertical white slogan in the upper right corner.{argument name="tagline text" default="The sky we looked up at that day will change the world."} At the bottom center is a very large, glowing white lavender-colored Japanese movie title.{argument name="movie title" default="Stardust Promise"} Add an elegant small Roman numeral subtitle below the title.{argument name="romanized subtitle" default="Hoshikuzu no Yakusoku"} The bottom border is filled with a dense list of production staff, cast, website text, release notes, and film format logos, presenting an authentic Japanese movie poster layout. A gold laurel wreath logo is added on either side of the top title. This creates the atmosphere of a fictional anime film, as if the film has surpassed 10 billion yen at the box office—grand, romantic, bittersweet, and magical, destined to bring tears to the audience's eyes.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张令人叹为观止的日本动漫电影海报，采用大片级电影主视觉风格，细节丰富，情感宏大，拥有现代精品动漫电影中那种精致而明亮的天空。画面展示了 2 名角色背对着镜头，站在开满鲜花的山崖上，俯瞰着日落与黄昏时分发光的沿海幻想城市：左侧是一位穿着深色校服、领带松开、短发随风飘动的少年，右侧是一位穿着长款飘逸浅色连衣裙、留着超长银白色长发的少女。两人都敬畏地望着地平线。在他们上方，巨大的天穹占据了构图的大部分，绘有生动的深蓝、靛青、紫罗兰、洋红和金色云彩，一道灿烂的彗星状流星从上方中心向地平线斜向划过，繁星点点，微光闪烁，右上方的天空中还有一个发光的圆形魔法环状星座。下方的海洋和城市闪烁着反射光，纤细的幻想摩天大楼和塔楼从海岸线升起，地平线中心有一道灿烂的阳光缝隙。前景的花朵呈现出饱和的蓝色和紫色，带有发光的高光，白粉色的花瓣在空中飘落。运用戏剧性的轮廓光、电影级背光、镜头光晕闪烁效果、高度精细的动漫渲染、清晰的线条、大气深度以及垂直海报构图。设计中融入日文海报排版：顶部横跨巨大的浮雕金色标题文本 {argument name="top headline text" default="興行収入100億円突破"}，左上方有一个金色副标题块 {argument name="subheadline text" default="大ヒット上映中"}，右上角有一行垂直的白色标语 {argument name="tagline text" default="あの日、君と見上げた空が、世界を変える。"}，底部中心有一个非常巨大的发光白薰衣草色日文电影片名 {argument name="movie title" default="星屑の約束"}。在片名下方，添加一行优雅的小型罗马字副标题 {argument name="romanized subtitle" default="Hoshikuzu no Yakusoku"}，并在底边添加密集的制作人员名单、演员表、网站文本、发行文案以及电影格式标志，呈现地道的日本电影海报布局。在顶部标题两侧各添加一个金色月桂花环标志。营造出一种虚构动漫电影的氛围，仿佛该片票房突破了 100 亿日元，宏大、浪漫、苦涩、充满魔力，注定会让观众落泪。

templates.title: Fake Japanese newspapers in the ChatGPT interface

titleLocalized.zh: ChatGPT 界面中的伪造日本报纸

templates.prompt: A realistic screenshot of the ChatGPT Japanese web version on a smartphone, against a clean white background. In the center of the chat interface is a generated image: a photo taken from directly above showing a Japanese newspaper neatly arranged on a dark wooden table, its rounded edges visible. The newspaper dominates the image, looking incredibly realistic, like a fictional yet convincing breaking news front page. The masthead area is compact and traditional, with a striking black bold Japanese headline at the top: "Premier Takaichi Resigns." Below is a large main image showing a politician on a press conference podium, with multiple microphones in front of him; his face is deliberately blurred or obscured against a dark blue backdrop. To the right is a vertical blue newspaper name bar with white Japanese text reminiscent of mainstream national daily newspapers. Next to the main image is a vertical column of Japanese subheadings, hinting at discussions about potential successors. The front page features four clearly visible advertising blocks at the bottom and lower sides, a small portrait of a man in a suit on the left side of the article, a sports news image block in the center below, and a weather or data box on the right. The entire page is filled with dense Japanese text. The newspaper should present a realistic and serious editorial style, with a realistic print quality, slight paper curl, subtle shadows, and believable Japanese typography. Visible ChatGPT UI elements should surround the images: "ChatGPT" in the upper left corner, a Japanese sharing control in the upper right corner, a small circular overlay button labeled "Edit" in the lower left corner of the image, a small share icon in the lower right corner of the image, reaction/action icons below the image, and an input bar at the bottom containing the Japanese placeholder text "质問してみましょう" (What are you asking?) as well as microphone and voice buttons. Overall style: photorealistic screenshots, modern web application interface, fake news newspaper front page, clear and easy-to-read layout, natural lighting and shadows, and minimal perspective distortion.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张逼真的 ChatGPT 日语网页版智能手机截图，背景为简洁的白色。聊天界面中央是一张生成的图片：一张从正上方拍摄的照片，展示了 1 份整齐放置在深色木质桌面上的日本报纸，可见圆润的桌面边缘。报纸占据了画面的主体，看起来非常真实，像是一份虚构但令人信服的突发新闻头版。报头区域布局紧凑且传统，顶部印有醒目的黑色粗体日语标题「高市総理辞任」。下方是一张大型主图，展示了 1 位在新闻发布会讲台上的政治人物，面前有多个麦克风，面部被刻意模糊或遮挡，背景为深蓝色幕布。右侧是 1 个垂直的蓝色报纸名称栏，带有类似日本主流全国性日报的白色日语文字。主图旁有一列垂直的日语副标题栏，暗示了对继任候选人的讨论。报纸头版底部及侧下方包含 4 个清晰可见的广告块，左侧文章中配有 1 张身着西装男士的小型肖像照，下方中间有 1 个体育新闻图片块，右侧有 1 个天气或数据框，整版充斥着密集的日语正文列。报纸应呈现出真实、严肃的编辑风格，具有逼真的印刷质感、轻微的纸张卷曲、细腻的阴影以及可信的日语排版。图片周围应包含可见的 ChatGPT UI 元素：左上角的“ChatGPT”、右上角的日语分享控件、图片左下角标有「編集」的小型圆形浮层按钮、图片右下角的小型分享图标、图片下方的反应/操作图标，以及底部的输入栏，其中包含日语占位符文字「質問してみましょう」以及麦克风和语音按钮。整体风格：照片级真实截图、现代 Web 应用界面、虚假新闻报纸头版、清晰易读的布局、自然光影、极小的透视畸变。

templates.title: Cute Winter Anime Channel Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱冬季动漫频道海报

templates.prompt: A cute, soft-toned anime promotional poster, using a dreamy idol fan club style, with a horizontal composition and a half-body portrait of a horse girl character on the right. She possesses {argument name="hair color" default="Dark chestnut brown"} She has long, flowing hair, with side-swept bangs covering one eye, the other large and bright, a purplish-pink. Her skin is fair with a soft blush, and horse ears stand upright on her head, tied with a large cream-colored bow. Her expression is gentle, shy, and friendly, with a slight smile, her head tilted slightly towards the viewer. She wears a thick red scarf with white horizontal stripes, a cream-colored cable-knit sweater over a navy blue sailor-style collar, and a small red ribbon tied at the chest. The overall color scheme is warm pink, cream, beige, and cocoa brown, complemented by soft winter lighting. The image is designed as a Japanese-style fan content announcement, using layered sticker-style typography, fluffy outlines, hearts, glitter, and snowflake patterns. The background should be a soft-focus, cozy winter café or a warmly lit indoor scene with luminous bokeh and light-colored decorative textures. Add 5 main text areas: At the top is a pink ribbon banner with the Japanese phrase "ライスと一緒に" (Raisu to Ichiso ni); in the center left is a large, rounded, trendy font title that reads "ほのぼの育成" (Honobo no Yusei), where "ほのぼの" is pinkish-white and "育成" is bold brown with white stitching; below is a small, dark ribbon that reads "しよっ♪" (Shiyo♪); to the right is a round, brown badge that reads "初見さん歓迎" (Hatsume-san-han); and in the lower right corner is a logo-like label that reads "ライスシャワーちゃんねる" (Raisusha-chan-neru) with a small horseshoe icon. Add a memo pad in the lower left corner containing 3 lines of lists, each with a pink checkmark: "ストーリー" (Story), "チャンミ" (Chamming), and "まったり雑談" (Mattari Zadan). Add decorative pink hearts around the character, delicate decorative lines near the head, white snowflakes, lace trim, and paper-cut style corner decorations to create a soft scrapbook aesthetic. This makes the entire piece look like a cute and fictional live stream or channel thumbnail designed to welcome new viewers. The image is beautiful, with clean lines, soft shadows, and bright, sparkling eyes, possessing a captivating commercial poster composition.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张可爱的柔和系动漫宣传海报，采用梦幻偶像粉丝俱乐部风格，横向构图，右侧为一名马娘角色的半身像。她拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="深栗棕色"} 的长蓬松秀发，侧分刘海遮住一只眼睛，另一只眼睛又大又亮，呈紫粉色，皮肤白皙，面带柔和红晕，头顶竖立着马耳，两耳之间系着一个巨大的奶油色蝴蝶结。她的表情温柔、羞涩且亲切，带着浅浅的微笑，头部微微向观众倾斜。她戴着一条带有白色横条纹的厚实红色围巾，身穿奶油色麻花针织毛衣，内搭藏青色水手风领口，胸前系着一个小红丝带。整体色调为暖粉色、奶油色、米色和可可棕色，配以柔和的冬季光影。

将图像设计为日系粉丝内容公告图，采用分层贴纸式排版、蓬松的轮廓线、爱心、闪光和雪花图案。背景应为柔焦的温馨冬季咖啡馆或光线温暖的室内场景，带有发光的散景和浅色装饰纹理。添加 5 个主要的文字区域：顶部是一个粉色丝带横幅，写有日文“ライスと一緒に”；左侧中央是一个巨大的圆润流行字体标题，写着“ほのぼの 育成”，其中“ほのぼの”为粉白色，“育成”为加粗棕色并带有白色缝线边缘；下方是一个写着“しよっ♪”的小型深色丝带；右侧是一个写着“初见さん歓迎”的圆形棕色徽章；右下角是一个类似标志的标签，写着“ライスシャワーちゃんねる”并配有一个小马蹄图标。在左下角添加 1 个备忘录，包含 3 行清单，每行都有一个粉色勾选标记：“ストーリー”、“チャンミ”和“まったり雑談”。在角色周围添加装饰性的小粉心、头部附近的细小装饰线、白色雪花、蕾丝边、剪纸风格的边角装饰，营造出柔和的剪贴簿美感。使整张作品看起来像是一张可爱且虚构的直播或频道缩略图，旨在欢迎新观众，画面精美，线条清晰，阴影柔和，眼睛光泽感强，具有迷人的商业海报构图。

templates.title: Cosmic Shattered Powder Compact Album Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 宇宙破碎感粉饼盒专辑封面

templates.prompt: A luxurious square streaming cover illustration for the song.{argument name="title text" default="コスメティック・ラヴ"} The advertisement, styled like a dreamlike cosmic beauty ad, is set on a shimmering table with a deep midnight indigo and black velvet finish, covered in sparkling dust and tiny stars. At the center of the image is a delicate rose gold metal round powder compact, laid flat before the viewer, its vertical mirror top adorned with intricate openwork patterns. The mirror is visibly cracked, riddled with forked fissures and missing several fragments, yet it reflects an incredible, fantastical universe: a glowing purple-pink planet or moon in the upper left, and a luminous crystal city skyline rising in the lower left. Five ethereal butterflies float in the mirror's space, including a large, dazzling pink butterfly and four smaller, purple-blue butterflies on the right. The powder compact tray below also reflects a starlit purple universe, scattered with several broken mirror fragments. To the left of the compact are two cosmetic items: a multifaceted crystal perfume bottle and an open-topped lipstick in a metal casing, the lipstick itself a certain color {argument name="lipstick color" default="Deep rose plum color"} In the lower right foreground, a single, soft pink cosmos flower with a stem lies, surrounded by a few scattered petals. The entire image shimmers with magical particles, suspended star-shaped decorations, hazy nebula swirls, and rich hues of violet, magenta, blush pink, and rose gold highlights. Vertical Japanese text is added to the right side.{argument name="right vertical text" default="コスメティック・ラヴ"} Use a striking, glowing light pink font; add a second, smaller, vertical Japanese text section on the left.{argument name="left vertical text" default="That glow surely isn't real. Yet, the butterfly is drawn in."} Use delicate and refined fonts. The composition should create a romantic, melancholic, charming, mysterious, and sophisticated atmosphere, like a high-end album cover for dark female synth-pop or dream pop, with ultra-detailed presentation, cinematic lighting, shimmering reflections, and an elegant fantasy-realistic style.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张奢华的方形流媒体封面插画，用于歌曲 {argument name="title text" default="コスメティック・ラヴ"}，风格如同梦幻般的宇宙美妆广告。场景设定在深午夜靛蓝色和黑色天鹅绒质感的闪亮桌面上，布满了闪烁的尘埃和微小的星辰。画面中心是一个精致的玫瑰金金属圆形粉饼盒，平铺在观众面前，竖起的镜面顶部装饰着精致的镂空花纹。镜面明显破裂，布满分叉的裂纹并缺失了几块碎片，但镜中映照出的却是一个不可思议的奇幻宇宙：左上方有一颗发光的紫粉色行星或月球，左下方升起一座发光的水晶城市天际线，镜中空间漂浮着 5 只空灵的蝴蝶，包括右侧 1 只巨大的璀璨粉色蝴蝶和 4 只紫蓝色调的小蝴蝶。下方的粉饼托盘同样反射出星光熠熠的紫色宇宙，并散落着几块破碎的镜片。粉饼盒左侧放置着 2 件化妆品：1 个多面切割水晶香水瓶和 1 支金属外壳的开口口红，口红膏体颜色为 {argument name="lipstick color" default="深玫瑰李子色"}。右下角前景处躺着 1 朵带茎的柔粉色波斯菊，周围散落着几片花瓣。整张图片闪烁着魔法粒子、悬挂的星形装饰、朦胧的星云漩涡，以及紫罗兰色、洋红色、腮红粉色和玫瑰金高光的丰富色调。在右侧添加竖排日文文字 {argument name="right vertical text" default="コスメティック・ラヴ"}，使用醒目且发光的淡粉色字体；在左侧添加第二段较小的竖排日文文本 {argument name="left vertical text" default="その輝きは、きっと本物じゃない。\nそれでも、蝶は誘惑されていく。"}，使用精致纤细的字体。构图需营造出浪漫、忧郁、迷人、神秘且高级的氛围，如同暗黑女性向合成器流行乐或梦幻流行乐的高端专辑封面，超细节呈现，电影级光影，闪烁的倒影，优雅的奇幻写实风格。

templates.title: Q-version catgirl in front of Yokohama Stadium

titleLocalized.zh: 横滨体育场前的 Q 版猫娘

templates.prompt: A cute anime chibi-style girl is walking towards the camera, with the background being {argument name="stadium name" default="YOKOHAMA STADIUM"} The pedestrian walkway is shaded by lush green trees. The scene presents a realistic backdrop of a modern Japanese city, with bright midday sunlight and glimpses of blue sky through the leaves. The stadium dominates the upper part of the background, showcasing its massive white structural beams and the words {argument name="stadium name" default="YOKOHAMA STADIUM"} A dark blue sign. Two long, vertical blue flags hang from a lamppost to the right, bearing a stylized "B" logo and the welcome message for Yokohama Stadium. Two smaller, matching blue flags adorn the walkway in the distance. The plaza is wide and open, with two short, black mooring posts visible to the left, flanked by hedges and mature trees. Scattered pedestrians in the distance add to the sense of scale. In the foreground center of the image, a super-deformed catgirl character is naturally composited: petite, chibi-style proportions, a large head, soft anime-style shadows, fair skin, long, slightly messy dark hair with bangs, fluffy cat ears, and a black kitten tail. She wears an oversized {argument name="hoodie color" default="forest green"} She wears a hoodie, the hem of which hangs down like a short skirt, and black low-top shoes. She carries a black crossbody bag with a flap and a small charm. She holds a packaged hamburger or sandwich to her mouth, as if eating while walking. Her posture is slightly pigeon-toed, appearing casual and natural, with her legs crossed, exuding a shy and cute feeling. The imagery utilizes a wonderful contrast between highly realistic street photography and a delicate anime sticker-style character, with clear outlines and subtle shadows on the ground. The face is kept centered but obscured by a large square mosaic blur.

promptLocalized.zh: 一位可爱的动漫 Q 版女孩正朝着镜头走来，背景是 {argument name="stadium name" default="YOKOHAMA STADIUM"} 外绿树成荫的人行步道。画面呈现出逼真的现代日本城市摄影背景，正午阳光明媚，蓝天透过树叶缝隙隐约可见。体育场占据了背景上方，展示着巨大的白色结构梁，以及写有 {argument name="stadium name" default="YOKOHAMA STADIUM"} 的深蓝色标牌。右侧的灯柱上悬挂着 2 面蓝色的垂直长旗，上面印有风格化的 B 标志和横滨体育场的欢迎文字，步道远处还有 2 面较小的配套蓝色旗帜。铺设的广场宽阔开阔，左前方可见 2 根矮小的黑色系缆桩，两侧是绿篱和成熟的树木，远处散布着零星的行人以衬托比例。在画面中心前景处，自然地合成 1 个超变形（super-deformed）猫娘角色：娇小的 Q 版比例，大头，柔和的动漫阴影，白皙的皮肤，长而略显凌乱的深色头发配有刘海，毛茸茸的猫耳，以及一条黑色小猫尾巴。她穿着一件超大号的 {argument name="hoodie color" default="forest green"} 连帽衫，衣摆像短裙一样垂下，脚穿黑色低帮鞋，背着 1 个带有翻盖和挂有小吊饰的黑色斜挎包。她双手拿着 1 个包装好的汉堡或三明治放在嘴边，仿佛边走边吃。她的姿势略带内八字，显得随意自然，双腿交叠，流露出害羞可爱的感觉。利用高度逼真的街头摄影与精致的动漫贴纸风格角色之间的奇妙对比，角色轮廓清晰，地面上有微妙的阴影。保持面部居中，但用一个大的方形马赛克模糊块遮挡。

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克精灵少女全身肖像

templates.prompt: One{argument name="character type" default="Cyberpunk elf girl"} A full-body illustration of an anime character, standing alone against a clean, pure white background, centered and slightly leaning to the left, with a relaxed and natural posture and arms hanging naturally at her sides. She has {argument name="hair color" default="Ice light blue"} She had a short bob haircut, straight bangs, fair skin, pointed elf ears, and bright eyes.{argument name="eye color" default="Glowing red-orange"} Her eyes are calm, her expression slightly serious. Her design blends fantasy and futuristic biomechanical styles: she wears an oversized white functional hooded jacket with a black lining, black straps and zipper details, and red warning-style markings on the sleeves; underneath, she wears a glossy black biomechanical bodysuit with cutouts, cables, and segmented armor plates, and intricate hard-surface cybernetics details around her torso and hips. She has a black leg pouch on her right thigh, mechanical knee pads with two visible circular joints, two external cables extending from below her knees, and thick-soled black combat boots with buckles and subtle red accents. She wears small black earrings and minor industrial-style accessories. The rendering uses highly detailed, exquisite comic-style line art with sharp edges, delicate cel shadows, and glossy highlights on the skin and latex textures, complemented by subtle red accents, presenting an overall high-end sci-fi character concept art feel. Keep the character fully visible from head to boots, with ample white space, and contain no props, backgrounds, text, or shadows other than minimalist ground shadows.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张 {argument name="character type" default="赛博朋克精灵少女"} 的动漫角色全身插画，人物独立站立于干净的纯白色背景前，居中且略微向左侧身，姿态放松自然，双臂自然下垂。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="冰浅蓝色"} 的短波波头，平直的刘海，皮肤白皙，有着尖尖的精灵长耳，以及明亮的 {argument name="eye color" default="发光的红橙色"} 双眼，表情冷静且略显严肃。她的设计融合了奇幻与未来生物机械风格：身穿 1 件超大号白色机能风连帽夹克，内衬为黑色，配有黑色绑带、拉链细节，袖子上带有红色警示风格标记；内搭 1 件亮面黑色生物机械紧身衣，带有镂空设计、线缆、分段式装甲板，躯干和臀部周围有复杂的硬表面控制论细节。她右大腿上系着 1 个黑色腿包，双膝带有 2 个可见圆形关节的机械护膝，膝盖下方延伸出 2 根外部线缆，脚穿 1 双厚底黑色战斗靴，带有搭扣和细微的红色点缀。耳朵上配有小型黑色耳环和微小的工业风配饰。渲染采用高细节的精致漫画风格线稿，边缘清晰，赛璐珞阴影细腻，皮肤和乳胶质感表面带有光泽高光，辅以细微的红色点缀光，整体呈现出高级的科幻角色概念艺术质感。保持人物从头部到靴子完全可见，留有充足的留白，不包含任何道具、背景、文字或除极简接地阴影外的其他阴影。

templates.title: Cyberpunk girl with giant mechanical claws

titleLocalized.zh: 拥有巨型机械爪的赛博朋克少女

templates.prompt: A dark cyberpunk anime illustration depicts a solitary girl with a massive mechanical claw arm standing in a neon-lit alleyway on a rainy night. The dramatic low-angle perspective makes her appear imposing and dangerous. Her face is pale, long, straight black hair partially obscuring her eyes, and faint red irises reveal a cold, indifferent expression. She wears an oversized hooded, tech-inspired winter coat with a huge fur collar and plush cuffs, overlaid with black tactical streetwear with straps and belts. Loose, dark trousers are tucked into heavy boots. Her left arm, replaced by a massive industrial mechanical prosthetic, dominates the foreground, covered in dense gears, pistons, pipes, cables, and exposed mechanical structures, ending in three long, curved claws with sharp tips that gleam with crimson energy. Small stickers, warning labels, and vertical East Asian-style signs are added to the coat and the mechanical components. The setting is a narrow, futuristic city street, surrounded by towering buildings, hanging cables, a thin mist, and numerous vertical neon signs with red and turquoise Chinese characters. The pavement is wet and mirror-like, reflecting the red glow of mechanical claws and the surrounding signs. The game employs a grainy, detailed, and high-contrast color palette, including charcoal black, gunmetal gray, deep crimson, and sickly cyan. The overall atmosphere is cold, melancholic, intimidating, intelligent, and slightly saddening. Highly detailed lines, complex mechanical rendering, cinematic lighting and shadows, rain and fog effects, a dense urban feel, and concept art that blends anime and hard surfaces—a masterpiece of quality.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅暗黑赛博朋克动漫插画，描绘了一位拥有巨大机械爪臂的孤独少女，她站在雨夜中霓虹闪烁的巷子里，采用极具戏剧性的低角度视角，使她看起来威严且危险。她面色苍白，长直黑发遮住部分双眼，微弱的红色双眸流露出冷漠无情的表情。她身穿一件超大号连帽科技风冬装外套，带有巨大的毛领兜帽和毛绒袖口，内搭黑色战术街头服饰，配有绑带、皮带，宽松的深色长裤塞进厚重的靴子里。她的左臂被巨大的工业机械义肢取代，占据了画面前景，上面布满了密集的齿轮、活塞、管道、电缆和外露的机械结构，末端是 3 只弯曲的长爪，尖端锋利，内部闪烁着深红色的能量光芒。在外套和机械上添加小型贴纸、警告标签和垂直的东亚风格标牌。背景设定在狭窄的未来城市街道，周围是高耸的建筑、悬挂的电缆、薄雾以及许多带有红色和青绿色汉字的垂直霓虹灯牌。路面湿润如镜，倒映着机械爪和周围标牌发出的红光。采用颗粒感强、细节丰富、高对比度的色调，包括炭黑、枪铁灰、深绯红和病态青色。整体氛围冷峻、忧郁、令人畏惧、充满智慧且略带伤感。高度精细的线条、复杂的机械渲染、电影级光影、雨雾效果、城市密集感，动漫与硬表面结合的概念艺术，杰作级品质。

templates.title: Cyberpunk Mecha Claw Girl

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克机甲利爪少女

templates.prompt: A dark cyberpunk anime illustration depicts a small, eerie girl standing in a narrow, rain-soaked alleyway at night. The dramatic low-angle composition makes her massive mechanical arm dominate the foreground. She wears a large white hooded jacket covered in printed patches, charts, and industrial logos, the hood casting deep shadows on her face. Her facial features are minimalist and doll-like, with short, straight black hair, pale skin, and pupil-less white eyes that emit a serene and indifferent expression. One of her arms is replaced by a massive, heavy mecha limb, far exceeding the size of her body, extending towards the viewer. The arm is composed of layers of white armor plates, exposed joints, cables, bolts, pistons, and segmented mechanical structures, scratched and grime-covered, conveying a war-torn industrial feel. Four enormous claw-like fingers touch the wet ground, each finger ending in a long, blackish-red claw, with a red internal glow emanating from the gaps in the knuckles, wrist, and forearm. Black cables dangled from beneath her upper arms, with subtle red light leaking around the mechanical devices at her elbows and shoulders. Her other sleeve hung naturally at her side. Underneath her coat, she wore dark shorts or a skirt, and oversized, fluffy white leg warmers covered her calves, her bare feet shimmering on the reflective ground. The alleyway was filled with pipes, conduits, cables, vents, and old signs, with a melancholic green neon sign standing in the background, creating a somber, blue-green backlight. Rain streamed through the scene, puddles reflecting blue and red light, and tiny orange-red sparks scattered on the ground near her claws. The game employs a soft palette of dusty white, charcoal gray, blue, and deep red, combined with cinematic contrast, high-precision lines, a rough texture, atmospheric haze, and a memorable dystopian future. The character is set as…{argument name="character name" default="A mecha-armed girl wearing a hood"} The color of the outer garment is{argument name="coat color" default="Dirty white"} Mechanical lights are{argument name="glow color" default="Dark red"} The neon lights in the alley are [color].{argument name="neon color" default="Blue-green"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 一张暗黑赛博朋克动漫插画，描绘了一位瘦小而诡异的少女站在狭窄且被雨水浸透的夜间小巷中。采用戏剧性的低角度构图，使她巨大的机械手臂在前景中占据主导地位。她穿着一件宽大的白色连帽外套，上面布满了印花补丁、图表和工业标记，兜帽在脸上投下深邃的阴影。她的面部特征简约且如玩偶般精致，留着黑色短直发，皮肤苍白，双眼散发着无瞳孔的白光，表情安静且冷漠。她的一只手臂被巨大的重型机甲肢体取代，其体积远超身体，向观众方向延伸。手臂由层叠的白色装甲板、外露关节、线缆、螺栓、活塞和分段式机械结构组成，带有划痕和污垢，呈现出一种饱经战火的工业质感。手部有 4 根巨大的爪状手指触碰着潮湿的地面，每根手指末端都有长长的黑红色利爪，指关节、手腕和前臂的缝隙处透出红色的内部光芒。上臂下方悬挂着黑色的线缆，肘部和肩部机械装置周围有细微的红色漏光。她的另一只袖子自然垂在身侧。外套下穿着深色短裤或短裙，小腿处套着超大号的蓬松白色腿套，赤脚踩在反光的地面上。小巷中布满了管道、导管、线缆、通风口和旧招牌，背景中竖立着青绿色的垂直霓虹灯牌，营造出一种忧郁的青色背光。雨水穿过场景，水洼反射着青色和红色的光芒，爪尖附近的地面上散落着细小的橙红色火花。采用脏白色、炭灰色、青色和深红色的柔和色调，结合电影级的对比度、高精度的线条、粗糙的质感、大气雾气以及令人难忘的未来反乌托邦氛围。将角色设定为 {argument name="character name" default="一位戴兜帽的机甲手臂少女"}，外衣颜色为 {argument name="coat color" default="脏白色"}，机械灯光为 {argument name="glow color" default="深红色"}，小巷霓虹灯颜色为 {argument name="neon color" default="青绿色"}。

templates.title: Steampunk-style ship cabin interior

titleLocalized.zh: 蒸汽朋克风格船舱内景

templates.prompt: A richly detailed, cinematic steampunk-style interior of a ship's engine room, viewed from standing eye level in a narrow corridor. The scene is crammed with old, polished brass pipes, copper tubing, riveted metal cans, valves, instruments, and dark lacquered wooden cabinets. To the left foreground, a steep wooden staircase with an arched handrail enters the frame diagonally. Heavy antique drawers and mechanical control panels line the corridor, overflowing with small metal instruments, teapots, kettles, and mechanical parts. In the center of the background is a small, square porthole with six visible panes of glass, letting in pale, somber outdoor light and a faintly visible distant industrial skyline. Below the window is a narrow shelf with three open shelves and a small drawer. A round analog clock hangs on the right wall near the window. The walls are made of a bluish-green metallic finish, peeling paint and weathered verdigris. The floor is dark wood, covered with a worn, narrow-striped carpet. The lighting is warm and evocative, with the main light source being an amber-colored industrial wall lamp near the center of the upper left corner, blended with soft, cool sunlight filtering through the porthole. It emphasizes rich material textures: tarnished brass, oxidized copper, peeling paint, dust, a sense of age, and a mechanical atmosphere brimming with life. Symmetrical depth of field, a strong environmental narrative, exceptional detail, a realistic style, cinematic composition, soft contrast yet overall sharp focus, and no human figures in the frame.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅细节极其丰富的电影级蒸汽朋克风格船舱机房内景，视角位于狭窄走廊的站立视平线。场景中挤满了陈旧的抛光黄铜管道、铜管、铆接金属罐、阀门、仪表以及深色清漆木柜。左侧前景处，一段带有弧形扶手的陡峭木楼梯呈对角线进入画面。走廊两侧摆放着沉重的古董抽屉和机械控制台，上面布满了小型金属仪器、茶壶、水壶和机械配件。后方中心处是一个带有 6 块可见玻璃的小型方形舷窗，透出苍白阴沉的室外光线和隐约可见的远方工业天际线。窗下是一个带有 3 层开放式隔板和 1 个小抽屉的窄架子。窗户附近的右侧墙上挂着 1 个圆形模拟时钟。墙壁为青绿色金属材质，漆面剥落，带有风化的铜绿。地面为深色木地板，铺着一条磨损的窄条纹地毯。光影温暖且富有情绪感，主要光源来自左上方中心附近 1 盏发着琥珀色光芒的工业壁灯，并混合了舷窗透入的柔和冷色日光。强调丰富的材质纹理、失去光泽的黄铜、氧化的铜、剥落的油漆、灰尘、年代感以及充满生活气息的机械氛围。对称的景深，浓厚的环境叙事，超高细节，写实风格，电影级构图，对比度柔和但整体清晰对焦，画面中无人。

templates.title: High-end Japanese sake poster

titleLocalized.zh: 高端日式清酒海报

templates.prompt: Create a luxurious Japanese-style poster advertisement for a brand named {argument name="brand name" default="Moon White"} It is accompanied by a Romanized subtitle.{argument name="romanized brand name" default="TSUKISHIRO"} The composition employs an exquisitely designed single-unit studio scene, with a background of deep midnight to navy blue, topped with a shimmering, water-ripple bokeh effect, resembling moonlight reflected on a tranquil surface. On a glossy black lacquered platform, a tall, frosted glass sake bottle is positioned slightly to the left, with a soft, cool white halo behind it. The bottle has an elegant, slender shape, its surface exhibiting a silver-blue, condensed water droplet texture, and bears a light-colored textured paper label with striking black Japanese calligraphy.{argument name="label text" default="Moon White"} The label features the words "Junkei Daiginjo" in small vertical lines along the edge, and the Roman letters "TSUKISHIRO" are printed at the bottom. On the same platform to the right of the bottle, a small celadon sake cup is placed. From the lower right, a realistic plum blossom branch is added; the branch is dark brown with about nine blooming white plum blossoms and eight visible buds, with a few white petals scattered on the platform and the water's surface. The surface below is a glossy, dark water, subtly reflecting the bottle, cup, plum blossoms, and platform. On the right, a strikingly large, luminous brushstroke of Japanese calligraphy is displayed.{argument name="display title" default="Moon White"} The text is arranged vertically, with the serif Romanized spelling "TSUKISHIRO" in well-spaced font below. On the far left, a vertical line of poetic Japanese slogans is added.{argument name="tagline text" default="Intoxicated by the moon, I return to white."} Add the light gray text "Junka Daiginjo" at the bottom center. Add a small white "Pollo.ai" watermark in the upper right corner. The lighting should have a cinematic feel, creating a cool tone, a moonlight effect, and a sense of sophistication, emphasizing minimalism, elegant white space, high-end beverage advertising aesthetics, traditional Japanese refinement, ultra-fine textures, clear and realistic product photography, and a tranquil and poetic atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张奢华的日式海报广告，品牌名为 {argument name="brand name" default="月白"}，并配有罗马拼音副标题 {argument name="romanized brand name" default="TSUKISHIRO"}。构图采用精致的单体摄影棚场景，背景为深邃的午夜蓝至海军蓝，顶部带有闪烁的水波纹焦散效果，宛如月光映照在静谧的水面上。在光亮的黑色漆面平台上，将一个高挑的磨砂玻璃清酒瓶置于偏左位置，瓶后带有柔和的冷白色光晕。酒瓶造型优雅修长，表面带有银蓝色冷凝水珠质感，贴有浅色纹理纸质标签，标签上印有醒目的黑色日文书法 {argument name="label text" default="月白"}，标签边缘处有细小的竖排文字“純米大吟醸”，标签底部印有微小的罗马字母“TSUKISHIRO”。在酒瓶右侧的同一平台上，放置一个小型青瓷清酒杯。从右下方加入一枝写实的梅花枝，枝干为深褐色，带有约 9 朵盛开的白梅和 8 个可见的花苞，平台上和水面上散落着几片白色花瓣。下方的表面为光亮的深色水面，隐约映照出酒瓶、酒杯、梅花和平台的倒影。在右侧，创作非常醒目的巨大发光笔触日文书法 {argument name="display title" default="月白"}，采用竖排布局，下方配有间距适中的衬线体罗马拼音“TSUKISHIRO”。在最左侧，添加一行竖排的日文诗意标语 {argument name="tagline text" default="月に酔い、白に還る。"}。底部居中处添加浅灰色文字“純米大吟醸”。在右上角添加一个微小的白色“Pollo.ai”水印。灯光需呈现电影质感，营造冷调、月光感与高级感，强调极简主义、优雅的留白、高端饮料广告美学、日式传统精致感、超精细纹理、清晰的产品摄影写实度，以及宁静、诗意的氛围。

templates.title: Japan Legal and Tax Services LP Homepage Design

titleLocalized.zh: 日本法律与税务服务 LP 首屏设计

templates.prompt: Create a sophisticated Japanese landing page banner for a fictional general law and tax firm. The style should be clean, professional, and convey a high level of trust. Use soft daylight lighting on a white background with subtle outlines of modern city architecture on the right. Employ a wide, horizontal header layout. At the very top, place a striking navy blue Japanese title.{argument name="headline text" default="Your anxieties will be addressed by our solid professional capabilities."} Below, a smaller Japanese subtitle with gold accents is placed.{argument name="subheadline text" default="One-stop legal and tax support to help you achieve the best solutions."} Below the title, four vertical service cards of equal width are arranged horizontally. Card 1 is for criminal defense, with a circular handcuff icon at the top, a cool blue color scheme, and the main title "Criminal Cases." The accompanying text reads "Protecting Your Future with a Swift Response." The accompanying image shows a professional man in a suit sitting at a desk with his hands folded. The bottom dark blue area lists two key points marked with checkmarks: "Arrest/Detention Response" and "Negotiation/Negotiation for Non-Prosecution." Card 2 is for traffic accidents, with a circular car crash icon at the top, a green color scheme, and the title "Traffic Accidents." The accompanying text reads "Fully Supporting You in Obtaining Reasonable Compensation." The accompanying image shows a bright desktop scene with documents showing two mini-cars colliding. The bottom dark green area lists two key points: "Post-Traumatic Stress/Increased Compensation" and "Handling Negotiations with Insurance Companies." Card 3 is about inheritance tax, featuring a circular house icon at the top, a warm gold tone, and the title "Inheritance Tax." The accompanying text reads "Supporting a successful inheritance and optimal tax strategies." The image shows a desktop scene with a house model, documents, and a calculator. The bottom mustard gold area lists two key points: "Inheritance Tax Filing & Tax Saving Strategies" and "Living Policy & Business Succession Support." Card 4 is about divorce, featuring a broken heart icon at the top, a rose pink tone, and the title "Divorce." The accompanying text reads "For your future, aiming to achieve a satisfactory solution." The image shows a soft, professional consultation scene, with a woman in a white shirt speaking across the table while resting her chin on her hand. The bottom gray-pink area lists two key points: "Parental Rights & Child Support & Property Division" and "Divorce Agreements & Mediation & Court Appeals." At the bottom, the left side includes the firm's logo, with a small line of text "Law Firm & Tax Firm" and a large letter of the firm's name.{argument name="firm name" default="Fence-based comprehensive legal and tax firm"} Below this is a smaller line of text: "One-stop service for lawyers and tax advisors working together." In the center below, there are three compact white function boxes with navy blue line icons and brief Japanese descriptions: Box 1 displays a crowd icon with the text "Experts in various fields respond"; Box 2 displays a handshake icon with the text "Friendly support close to the client"; Box 3 displays a document icon with the text "First consultation 60 minutes free." Below this is a small disclaimer: "※Fees may apply depending on the consultation content." In the lower right corner, a prominent navy blue rounded-corner Call to Action (CTA) panel is created. It includes the small text "Please feel free to contact us," and a large white phone number with a telephone icon.{argument name="phone number" default="03-1234-5678"} And a gold capsule-shaped strip at the bottom with the text "{argument name="business hours" default="Weekdays 9:00-18:00 (Reservations can be made in advance for weekends and public holidays)"} The main title uses elegant Japanese-style font with clear spacing, balanced margins, and subtle shadows, reflecting a high-end legal professional brand image.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个精致的日本落地页首屏横幅，适用于一家虚构的综合律师事务所与税务师事务所，风格简洁专业，具有高度信任感，采用柔和的日光照明，背景为白色，右侧带有淡淡的现代城市建筑轮廓。采用宽幅横向网页页眉布局。在最上方，放置一个醒目的海军蓝日文大标题 {argument name="headline text" default="你的“不安”，由我们以确凿的专业能力守护。"}，下方放置一个带有金色点缀的较小日文副标题 {argument name="subheadline text" default="法律 × 税务一站式支持，助您达成最佳解决方案"}。在标题下方，横向排列 4 张等宽的垂直服务卡片。卡片 1 为刑事辩护，顶部带有手铐圆形图标，采用冷蓝色调，大标题为“刑事事件”，辅助文案为“以迅速的应对，守护您的未来”，配图为一名身着西装的专业男性坐在桌前双手交叠，底部深蓝色区域列出 2 条带勾选标记的要点：“逮捕・拘留应对”和“示谈交涉・争取不起诉”。卡片 2 为交通事故，顶部带有车祸圆形图标，采用绿色调，标题为“交通事故”，辅助文案为“全力支持您获得合理的赔偿”，配图为明亮的桌面场景，文件上有 2 辆微型车碰撞，底部深绿色区域列出 2 条要点：“后遗症障碍・慰问金增额”和“代办与保险公司的交涉”。卡片 3 为遗产税，顶部带有房屋圆形图标，采用暖金色调，标题为“遗产税”，辅助文案为“支持圆满的遗产继承与最优的税务对策”，配图为桌面场景，摆放着房屋模型、文件和计算器，底部芥末金色区域列出 2 条要点：“遗产税申报・节税对策”和“生前对策・事业继承支援”。卡片 4 为离婚，顶部带有破碎的心形图标，采用玫瑰粉色调，标题为“离婚”，辅助文案为“为了您的未来，旨在达成令您满意的解决方案”，配图为柔和的专业咨询场景，一名身穿白色衬衫的女性在桌对面说话时手托下巴，底部灰粉色区域列出 2 条要点：“亲权・抚养费・财产分割”和“离婚协议・调停・裁判应对”。在底部区域，左侧添加事务所标识，包括一行小字“法律事务所・税务师事务所”，一个大字事务所名称 {argument name="firm name" default="架空综合法律税务事务所"}，以及一行较小的字“律师与税务师协作的一站式服务”。在下方中央，放置 3 个紧凑的白色功能框，带有海军蓝线条图标和简短的日文说明：框 1 显示人群图标，文字为“各领域专家应对”；框 2 显示握手图标，文字为“贴近咨询者的亲切支持”；框 3 显示文档图标，文字为“首次咨询 60 分钟免费”。在下方添加一行小字免责声明：“※根据咨询内容，可能收取费用。”在右下方，创建一个醒目的海军蓝圆角行动号召（CTA）面板。包含一行小字“请随时咨询”，一个带有电话图标的白色大字电话号码 {argument name="phone number" default="03-1234-5678"}，以及底部一个金色的胶囊状条带，文字为 {argument name="business hours" default="平日 9:00〜18:00（周末及节假日可提前预约）"}。主要标题使用精致的日文明朝体排版，间距清晰，边距平衡，带有微妙的阴影，体现高端法律专业品牌形象。

templates.title: Elegant Japanese divorce legal services LP homepage design

titleLocalized.zh: 优雅的日本离婚法律服务 LP 首屏设计

templates.prompt: Create a sophisticated Japanese landing page homepage image for a fictional divorce law firm, referencing the design style of high-converting list ad landing pages. Employ a soft, elegant, and feminine legal brand aesthetic, using a white background accented with pale pink, light gray dividing lines, and delicate botanical line art. The layout is a single-column widescreen desktop homepage, divided into left and right sections: the left side features dense text content, while the right side displays lifestyle photos. The law firm's logo and name are placed in the upper left corner: a delicate handwritten "D" adorned with leaf decorations, followed by the firm's Japanese name and a small English subtitle.{argument name="firm name" default="Law Firm D"} And “LAW OFFICE D”. In the upper right corner, there are two rounded contact boxes: the first is a white phone box with a small phone icon and “24h”, with brief Japanese support text above it and a large phone number displayed.{argument name="phone number" default="0120-456-789"} The second is a pink email inquiry button with an envelope icon and Japanese text indicating 24-hour service. The main heading on the left is a three-line statement in large Japanese serif/Mingchu font: “もう一人で悩まないで.” (Don't worry alone anymore.) followed by the pink “新しい一歩を、” (Take a new step.) and then the black and pink-emphasized “一緒に考えます.” (We think with you.) Below this is a short Japanese support paragraph explaining how to support clients struggling with divorce and help them find the best solutions, with one phrase highlighted in pink. On the right, a bright, clear photograph shows a Japanese woman in her thirties with short, dark brown hair, wearing a loose white top, sitting on a sofa by a window, resting her chin on her hand, looking thoughtful; her face is obscured by a large rectangular blur for privacy. Near her shoulder, a light pink circular badge is placed, stating that many female lawyers are employed there, so you can consult with confidence. Below, in the center, are four evenly spaced, rounded white function cards with thin borders and pink line icons. Card 1 displays a speech bubble icon and the text "First Consultation 60 Minutes Free," along with a smaller line explaining that online consultations are also available. Card 2 displays a heart-shaped hand icon and text about handling children's issues with care, along with a smaller line mentioning custody and visitation rights. Card 3 displays a stacked coin icon with a yen symbol, along with text about alleviating cost anxiety through a clear pricing structure, along with a smaller line about installment consultations. Card 4 displays a padlock icon and text about privacy and strict confidentiality, along with a smaller line encouraging secure consultations. At the bottom, a large, curved pink and white call-to-action (CTA) band spans the width of the page. On the left side of the band is a circular telephone icon, small Japanese text encouraging easy access to information and 24/365 service, followed by a repeating large telephone number.{argument name="phone number" default="0120-456-789"} Below this is a smaller text indicating reception hours. To the right of this section is a large pink, rounded-corner email button with an envelope icon, along with Japanese text indicating 24-hour email support. At the very bottom, three slender, footer-style trust points are arranged horizontally: one about focusing on women's divorce counseling, one about welcoming family and friends to act as intermediaries, and one about nationwide and online counseling. The layout features sophisticated Japanese typography, a spacious feel, soft shadows, high-end legal advertising design, and realistic web page layout. All visible text remains in Japanese, except for the small English subheading "LAW OFFICE D".

promptLocalized.zh: 为一家虚构的离婚律师事务所创建一个精致的日本落地页首屏图像，设计风格参考高转化率的列表广告 LP。采用柔和、优雅、女性化的法律品牌美学，以白色为背景，搭配淡粉色点缀、浅灰色分割线和精致的植物线条艺术。布局为单栏宽屏桌面网页首屏，分为左右两部分：左侧为文字密集的内容，右侧为生活方式照片。在左上方放置律师事务所的 Logo 和名称：一个带有叶片装饰的精致手写体字母“D”，后跟日文事务所名称及小型英文副标题，显示为 {argument name="firm name" default="法律事務所D"} 和“LAW OFFICE D”。在右上角，包含 2 个圆角联系框：第一个是带有小型电话图标和“24h”的白色电话框，上方有简短的日文支持文字，并显示大号电话号码 {argument name="phone number" default="0120-456-789"}；第二个是带有信封图标和表示 24 小时接待的日文文字的粉色邮件咨询按钮。左侧的主标题为 3 行大号日文衬线/明朝体声明：“もう一人で悩まないで。”（不要再一个人烦恼了。），接着是粉色的“新しい一歩を、”（迈出新的一步，），然后是混合黑色与粉色强调的“一緒に考えます。”（我们与您共同思考。）。下方添加一段简短的日文支持段落，介绍如何支持有离婚相关困扰的客户并帮助找到最佳解决方案，其中一个短语用粉色高亮显示。在右侧，展示一张明亮、通透的照片，照片中是一位 30 多岁的日本女性，留着深棕色短发，身穿宽松的白色上衣，坐在窗边的沙发上，单手托腮，神情若有所思；为了保护隐私，她的面部被一个大的矩形模糊块遮挡。在她的肩膀附近，放置一个淡粉色圆形徽章，上面写着有许多女性律师在职，可以安心咨询。在下方中部，放置 4 个间距均匀的圆角白色功能卡片，带有细边框和粉色线条图标。卡片 1 显示对话气泡图标和“初回相談 60分無料”（首次咨询 60 分钟免费）的文字，并附有一行较小的文字说明也提供在线咨询。卡片 2 显示心形托手图标和关于谨慎处理儿童问题的文字，并附有一行较小的文字提及监护权和探视权。卡片 3 显示带有日元符号的堆叠硬币图标，以及关于通过清晰的定价结构缓解费用焦虑的文字，并附有一行关于分期咨询的较小文字。卡片 4 显示挂锁图标和关于隐私保护与严格保密的文字，并附有一行鼓励安全咨询的较小文字。在底部，添加一个横跨页面宽度的巨大弧形粉白相间行动号召（CTA）带。在该带的左侧，包含一个圆形电话图标、鼓励轻松咨询和 24/365 接待的小型日文文字，然后是重复的大号电话号码 {argument name="phone number" default="0120-456-789"}，下方是较小的接待时间文字。在该带的右侧，放置一个带有信封图标的大号粉色圆角邮件按钮，以及表示 24 小时提供邮件咨询的日文文字。在最底部，横向排列 3 个细长的页脚式信任点：一个关于专注于女性离婚咨询，一个关于欢迎家人和朋友代为咨询，以及一个关于全国及在线咨询。采用精致的日文排版、宽敞的布局、柔和的阴影、高端法律广告设计和写实的网页 LP 构图。除小型英文副标题“LAW OFFICE D”外，所有可见文字均保持为日文。

templates.prompt: Design a clean, high-end homepage image for a fictional accounting firm specializing in estate tax consulting in Japan. The design should present the visual effect of a modern listing ad landing page, using a widescreen desktop format with a soft ivory and warm white background accented with gentle sage green and gold. The title should use an elegant serif Japanese font to create a calm and trustworthy atmosphere. A refined circular logo should be placed in the upper left corner, featuring a thin gold ring, a large serif letter C, and a small botanical illustration, followed by the firm's name, "Tax Accountant Firm".{argument name="office name" default="C"} "and the English subtitle "TAX ACCOUNTANT OFFICE"{argument name="office name" default="C"} In the upper right corner, add a rounded white contact panel divided into two parts: the left side is the phone number panel, containing a green circular phone icon, the small text "First consultation is free, available on weekends and holidays" and a large number.{argument name="phone number" default="0120-987-654"} The right side features an email section with a gold circular email icon and the text "メールでのお問い合わせ24時時受付中" (Email inquiries are accepted 24 hours a day). The main title on the left should be a prominent Japanese phrase: "相続の不安に、安心という答えを." (Providing reassuring answers to your inheritance anxieties.), with the key phrase "安心という答えを." in sage green. Below, a smaller line of Japanese supplementary explanation is added: “相続税の申告・节税対策を、経験豊富な税理士がご家族の想いに寄り添い、丁宁にサポートします。” (An experienced tax advisor will provide detailed support regarding estate tax filing and tax-saving strategies, taking your family's needs into consideration.) Below this, three rounded rectangular function cards are placed horizontally, with a light background and green line icons: Card 1 displays a document icon and the text “相続税申告実绩1,000件以上” (Over 1,000 estate tax filings), with the smaller text “※累计実绩” (Cumulative performance); Card 2 The chart displays a bar graph icon and the text "Reducing the tax burden through tax-saving measures" (省税対策のご提出で税负を軽减), with the smaller print "※The effect varies depending on the situation" (未情况により效果は异なります). Card 3 displays a group icon and the text "First consultation is free" (初回相谈无料), with the smaller print "Peace of Mind Accounting" (安心の明朗会计). The right half shows a brightly lit consultation scene: in a sunlit office with greenery in the background, three Japanese adults sit around a table, including a male consultant on the right with his back to the camera, wearing a dark blue suit, and two clients facing him (a man in a light beige jacket and a woman in a white shirt). An open laptop sits on the table. Their expressions are calm and focused. A light-colored circular badge with delicate leaf decorations is superimposed on the lower right of the photo, with the text "安心の相続専门サポートわかりやすいご解释ではじめての方も安心" (Professional support for inheritance with peace of mind, easy-to-understand explanations, even for first-time consultations). Below, in the middle, a thin line inviting consultation is added, with the text "相続に关するお悩み、まずはお気軽にご相谈ください" (Please feel free to consult us regarding any concerns about inheritance), flanked by diagonal lines. Below this, four rounded-corner category labels are placed horizontally: "相続税の申告", "生前対策・减税", "遗分分サポート", and "次二相続対策". In the bottom right corner, add a large green rounded corner contact CTA area, divided into two columns: the left column contains a white phone icon, small text "お電話でのお問い合わせ（フリーダイヤル）" (phone inquiry (free hotline)), and large numbers.{argument name="phone number" default="0120-987-654"} The small print reads "Acceptance time 9:00~18:00 (available on Saturdays, Sundays and holidays)"; the right column contains a white email icon, the text "Email inquiries are accepted 24 hours a day" and a rounded white button "Click here to inquire". At the very bottom, create a white safety bar with three horizontally arranged items separated by thin vertical lines: 1) a shield icon and "Secretly guarded, thoroughly protected" (strictly adhering to confidentiality and privacy protection); 2) a clipboard icon and "Clearly priced, reassuring with advance quotes" (transparent pricing, reassuring with advance quotes); 3) a handshake icon and "One-stop service from inheritance experts" (one-stop service from inheritance specialists). Utilizing subtle shadows, rounded corners, and soft natural light, create a professional and highly credible visual effect for this Japanese legal and tax service advertisement.

promptLocalized.zh: 为一家专注于遗产税咨询的虚构会计师事务所，设计一张简洁、高端的日本落地页首屏图像。设计应呈现出现代化列表广告 LP 首屏的视觉效果，采用宽屏桌面格式，背景为柔和的象牙白与暖白色，搭配柔和的鼠尾草绿和金色作为点缀，标题使用优雅的衬线体日文字体，营造出冷静且值得信赖的氛围。在左上方放置一个精致的圆形 Logo，包含细金环、大号衬线字母 C 以及小型植物线条插图，随后是事务所名称“税理士事务所 {argument name="office name" default="C"}”以及英文副标题“TAX ACCOUNTANT OFFICE {argument name="office name" default="C"}”。在右上角，添加一个分为两部分的圆角白色联系栏：左侧为电话栏，包含绿色圆形电话图标、小字“初回相談無料・土日祝も対応”（首次咨询免费，周末节假日均可）以及大号数字 {argument name="phone number" default="0120-987-654"}；右侧为邮件栏，包含金色圆形邮件图标和文字“メールでのお問い合わせ 24時間受付中”（邮件咨询 24 小时受理中）。左侧的主标题应为醒目的日文：“相続の不安に、安心という答えを。”（为您的遗产继承焦虑，提供安心的答案。），其中关键短语“安心という答えを。”使用鼠尾草绿色。下方添加一行较小的日文辅助说明：“相続税の申告・節税対策を、経験豊富な税理士がご家族の想いに寄り添い、丁寧にサポートします。”（经验丰富的税务师将贴近家人的心意，为您提供遗产税申报及节税对策的细致支持。）下方横向放置 3 个圆角矩形功能卡片，背景色浅淡，配有绿色线条图标：卡片 1 显示文档图标及文字“相続税申告実績 1,000件以上”（遗产税申报业绩 1,000 件以上），附带小字“※累計実績”（累计业绩）；卡片 2 显示柱状图图标及文字“節税対策のご提案で 税負担を軽減”（通过节税对策建议减轻税务负担），附带小字“※状況により効果は異なります”（效果因情况而异）；卡片 3 显示群体图标及文字“初回相談 無料”（首次咨询免费），附带小字“安心の明朗会計”（明码标价，安心无忧）。在右半部分，展示一张明亮的咨询场景照片：在阳光充足、背景有绿植的办公室里，3 位日本成年人围坐在桌旁，包括右侧背对镜头、身着深蓝色西装的男性顾问，以及面对他的 2 位客户（一位身穿浅米色夹克的男性和一位身穿白色衬衫的女性）。桌上放着一台打开的笔记本电脑。他们的表情显得冷静且专注。在照片右下方叠加一个带有精致叶片装饰的浅色圆形徽章，文字为“安心の 相続専門サポート わかりやすいご説明ではじめての方も安心”（安心的遗产继承专业支持，通俗易懂的说明，初次咨询也能放心）。在下部中间，添加一行细长的咨询邀请线，文字为“相続に関するお悩み、まずはお気軽にご相談ください”（关于遗产继承的烦恼，请随时咨询），两侧以斜线装饰。下方横向放置 4 个圆角分类标签：“相続税の申告”、“生前対策・節税”、“遺産分割サポート”、“二次相続対策”。在右下角，添加一个大的绿色圆角联系 CTA 区域，分为两列：左列包含白色电话图标、小字“お電話でのお問い合わせ（フリーダイヤル）”（电话咨询（免费热线））、大号数字 {argument name="phone number" default="0120-987-654"} 以及小字“受付時間 9:00〜18:00（土日祝対応可）”（受理时间 9:00-18:00，周末节假日可受理）；右列包含白色邮件图标、文字“メールでのお問い合わせ 24時間受付中”（邮件咨询 24 小时受理中）以及一个圆角白色按钮“ご相談はこちらから”（点击此处咨询）。最底部创建一个白色保障条，横向排列 3 个由细竖线分隔的项目：1) 盾牌图标及“秘密厳守・プライバシー保護を徹底”（严格遵守保密与隐私保护），2) 剪贴板图标及“明朗会計・事前お見積りで安心”（明码标价，事前报价安心），3) 握手图标及“相続の専門家がワンストップで対応”（遗产继承专家一站式服务）。运用微妙的阴影、圆角、柔和的自然光，打造出专业、可信度极高的日本法律税务服务广告视觉效果。

templates.prompt: A landing page banner in the style of Japanese list ads, designed specifically for fictional law and tax firms, presents a striking web ad effect. It features four equally wide vertical panels at the top and a strong call-to-action area at the bottom. The top row contains four service panels, each with a colored title bar, realistic images, and a colored description bar at the bottom. Panel 1 is red, labeled "Criminal Case" at the top, showing a close-up of a pair of hands gripping dark prison bars against a black background; the red description bar at the bottom reads "Arrest/Prosecution Immediately Available!" in bold white Japanese. Panel 2 is blue, labeled "Traffic Accident" at the top, showing a realistic rear-end collision scene of two damaged dark cars on a city street under sunlight; the blue description bar at the bottom reads "Compensation and Discussion Also Available!" in bold white Japanese. Panel 3 is green, with the title "Tax Consultation" at the top. It shows an elderly couple sitting at a table consulting with a professional in a suit, with documents and a small house model visible on the table. The bottom green caption reads in bold white Japanese, "Support for Tax Consultation!" Panel 4 is orange, with the title "Divorce Issues" at the top. It shows a melancholy-looking woman sitting indoors, resting her chin on her hand. The bottom orange caption reads in bold white Japanese, "Resolve Compensation and Divorce Issues!" The four panels should be flush at the edges and separated by clean white lines. Each panel should be the same width, using highly saturated primary colors and a glossy advertising design style. Below the four panels, create a cream or light beige background footer area. On the left, place a small black Japanese subtitle: "Legal Consultation and Tax Consultation." The name of the main agency, in bold Japanese font with a metallic gold gradient and a slight bevel effect, is placed directly below and centered:{argument name="office name" default="XX Law Firm / Tax Accountant Office"} Add a thin black horizontal dividing line above and below the agency name. Place a large, glossy red rounded rectangle button in the lower right corner with a bright gradient effect and white bold Japanese text: "{argument name="button text" default="Free consultations available!"} The overall style should reflect the visual effect of a Japanese legal and tax services LP listing advertisement: corporate, urgency, trustworthy, commercial, photo-based, clean grid layout, eye-catching typography, high contrast, and realistic brochure-level composite effect.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张采用日本列表广告风格的落地页首屏横幅，专为虚构的律师事务所和税务师事务所设计，呈现出醒目的网页广告效果，顶部设有四个等宽的垂直面板，底部设有强力的行动号召区域。顶行包含 4 个服务面板，每个面板均配有彩色标题栏、写实风格的素材图片以及底部的彩色说明栏。面板 1 为红色，顶部标注「刑事事件」，展示了一双紧握黑色背景下深色监狱铁栏的手部特写；底部红色说明栏以醒目的白色粗体日文写着「逮捕・訴訟に即対応！」。面板 2 为蓝色，顶部标注「交通事故」，展示了日光下城市街道上两辆受损深色轿车的真实追尾场景；底部蓝色说明栏以醒目的白色粗体日文写着「慰謝料・示談もお任せ！」。面板 3 为绿色，顶部标注「相続税」，展示了一对老年夫妇坐在桌前咨询身着西装的专业人士，桌上可见文件和一个小型房屋模型；底部绿色说明栏以醒目的白色粗体日文写着「税相続対策をしっかりサポート！」。面板 4 为橙色，顶部标注「離婚問題」，展示了一位神情忧郁的女性坐在室内，单手托腮；底部橙色说明栏以醒目的白色粗体日文写着「慰謝料・親権の悩みを解決！」。四个面板需边缘紧贴，并以干净的白色线条分隔，每个面板宽度一致，采用高饱和度原色及光泽感的广告设计风格。在四个面板下方，创建一个奶油色或浅米色的背景页脚区域。左侧放置一行较小的黑色日文副标题：「法律相談・税務相談なら」。正下方居中放置金属金渐变色、带有轻微斜面效果的粗体日文主事务所名称：「{argument name="office name" default="〇〇法律事務所・税理士事務所"}」。在事务所名称上下方添加细黑色水平分割线。右下角放置一个大型光泽红色圆角矩形按钮，带有明亮的渐变效果，并配有白色粗体日文：「{argument name="button text" default="無料相談受付中！"}」。整体风格应呈现出日本法律与税务服务 LP 列表广告主视觉的效果：企业化、紧迫感、值得信赖、商业化、基于照片、干净的网格布局、醒目的排版、高对比度以及写实的宣传册级合成效果。
