titleLocalized.zh: Epix & Ria 奇幻图书馆海报

templates.prompt: A cinematic fantasy anime poster, using a vertical composition. The image shows two child-like adventurers standing in a magnificent magical library cathedral, with towering Gothic arches and towering bookshelves on either side in the background, pages floating in the air, shimmering with glittering dust. In the center is a grand staircase leading to a window like a teleportation portal, covered with intricate celestial magic circles. The low, dramatic perspective, slightly upward, shows both characters extending a hand to the viewer in an inviting gesture. The character on the left is slightly taller, with short, silver-white hair, smooth bangs, and large leaf-shaped or animal-ear earrings. He wears a navy blue hooded jacket over a warm orange top, dark trousers, sturdy boots, and carries a black crossbody bag; his face is partially obscured by the composition and angle. The character on the right is slightly shorter, with a design that complements the overall style. She has a silver-white bob with greenish tips, large turquoise eyes, and also wears leaf-shaped earrings. She wears a navy blue hooded jacket over orange clothing, dark shorts, boots, and carries a light purple shoulder bag adorned with stars and other small charms. Between their outstretched hands, a bright magical light is created, where two energies converge: a turquoise stream surrounds the character on the left, while a warm pinkish-gold stream surrounds the character on the right, accompanied by sparkling particles and ribbon-like trails. The light and shadow atmosphere is cool blue on the left and warm magenta on the right, merging into a dazzling white light at the center. Rich atmospheric details are added: glowing dust, magical threads, floating paper, and layered architecture, creating a sense of wonder and exploration. An elegant white serif Japanese slogan is added to the center of the top of the poster: "わかることと, sense of じること. 2つの力で世界をひらく." (Understanding and feeling, open the world with dual power.) A huge luminous golden serif title is placed at the bottom of the poster "{argument name="title text" default="Epix&Ria"} The poster features a stunningly detailed and exquisite main visual, showcasing the rich texture, radiant light, and powerful emotions of a fantasy adventure film. It is a masterpiece of top-tier promotional art.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影质感的奇幻动漫海报，采用竖构图。画面展示了两位孩童模样的冒险者，站在一座宏伟的魔法图书馆大教堂中，背景是高耸入云的哥特式拱门和两侧参天的书架，空中飘浮着书页，闪烁着微光尘埃。中央有一座宏伟的楼梯，通向一扇如传送门般、布满复杂天体魔法阵图案的窗户。视角低沉而富有戏剧性，略微仰视，两位角色均向观众伸出一只手，做出邀请的姿态。左侧角色稍高，留着银白色短发，刘海柔顺，佩戴大型叶片状耳饰或动物耳，身穿海军蓝连帽外套，内搭暖橙色上衣，深色长裤，结实的靴子，背着黑色斜挎包；脸部通过构图或角度进行部分遮挡。右侧角色稍矮，设计风格相呼应，留着银白色波波头，发梢带有绿色调，拥有一双青绿色大眼睛，同样佩戴叶片状耳饰，身穿海军蓝连帽外套，内搭橙色衣物，深色短裤，靴子，背着装饰有星星等小挂件的淡紫色单肩包。在他们伸出的双手之间，创造出一团明亮的魔法光芒，两种能量在此交汇：青蓝色光流环绕左侧角色，暖粉金色光流环绕右侧角色，伴随着火花粒子和丝带状轨迹。光影氛围左侧为冷蓝色，右侧为暖金洋红色，在中心交融成耀眼的白光。添加丰富的氛围细节：发光的微尘、魔法丝线、飘浮的纸张、层次分明的建筑，营造出奇迹与探索感。海报顶部居中处加入优雅的白色衬线体日文标语：“わかることと、感じること。2つの力で世界をひらく。”（理解与感受，以双重力量开启世界。）海报底部放置巨大的发光金色衬线体标题 “{argument name="title text" default="Epix&Ria"}”，并采用华丽的电影海报排版。高细节、精致的主视觉图，奇幻冒险电影海报，质感丰富，光芒四射，情感充沛，令人惊叹，顶级插画宣传艺术。

templates.prompt: A simple, anime-style full-body illustration depicts a young woman crouching in the center of a light gray background, with soft studio shadows beneath her feet. She has {argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown"} Her short bob haircut featured neat, straight bangs, slightly messy ends, and a few stray strands of hair near her cheeks. Her expression was {argument name="expression" default="His half-open spiral eyes held a hint of irritation."} She appears tired, melancholic, and slightly annoyed. She wears four visible items: an oversized light gray hoodie with drawstring and ribbed cuffs, dark blue frayed denim shorts, white slouch socks, and black low-top skate shoes with white side stripes, white laces, and white soles. Her pose is a tight squat, knees raised, one elbow resting on her knee, one hand partially covering her lower face or cheek, and the other hanging down near her shoes. The art style is a refined modern comic/anime key visual, with clean, flowing lines, smooth cel rendering, delicate fabric folds, natural skin highlights on the legs, and a slightly oversized hoodie. It emphasizes a casual, melancholic, and introverted atmosphere, with a minimalist composition, presenting a high-quality character-focused illustration.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张简洁的动漫风格全身角色插画，描绘了一位蹲在浅灰色纯色背景中央的年轻女性，脚下带有柔和的摄影棚阴影。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 的短波波头，带有整齐的平刘海，发梢略显凌乱，脸颊旁有几缕碎发。她的表情为 {argument name="expression" default="半睁的螺旋眼，带着一丝烦躁"}，呈现出疲惫、忧郁且略显恼火的神态。她穿着 4 件可见的单品：一件带有抽绳和罗纹袖口的大码浅灰色连帽衫、深蓝色毛边牛仔短裤、白色堆堆袜，以及带有白色侧条纹、白色鞋带和白色鞋底的黑色低帮滑板鞋。她的姿势是紧凑的蹲姿，双膝抬起，一只手肘靠在膝盖上，一只手半遮住下脸或脸颊，另一只手垂在前方鞋子附近。艺术风格为精致的现代漫画/动漫主视觉图，线条简洁流畅，采用平滑的赛璐珞渲染，布料褶皱细腻，腿部带有自然的皮肤高光，连帽衫比例略显宽大。强调休闲、忧郁、内向的氛围，构图极简，呈现高质量的角色聚焦插画。

templates.title: Cinematic Shiba Inu Squat Hero Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 电影感柴犬深蹲英雄海报

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed, cinematic parody poster featuring an anthropomorphic Shiba Inu transformed into an extreme bodybuilding powerlifting hero. At the center of the image, he is in a full-frontal squat position, shouldering a heavy, overloaded barbell. The dog boasts a realistic Shiba Inu head, a calm and confident expression, warm orange-cream fur, erect ears, and a direct, forward-looking gaze. His body exhibits exaggerated muscle definition and human features, with massive deltoids, pectoral muscles, arms, abs, quadriceps, and calves. His fur and skin display a dramatic, glossy sheen and dense texture. He wears only tight black weightlifting shorts and a dark weightlifting belt. His squat is deep and powerful, knees wide open, feet firmly planted on a damp, reflective rooftop or industrial platform at night. The background is a modern city skyline, dotted with luminous skyscrapers, blue mist, and smoke. Two bright stadium floodlights in the upper left and right corners create a strong rim light and a heroic, arena-like atmosphere. The composition should maintain perfect centered symmetry, with the barbell horizontally spanning the frame and numerous large black barbell plates stacked on either side. High-contrast cyan, amber, black, and gold tones, combined with a strong cinematic color grading, ensure the characters are clearly focused, and the lights are surrounded by an atmospheric halo. Add stylized poster typography: at the very top, add a slogan using gold capital letters.{argument name="top tagline" default="NO PAIN. MUCH GAIN. SUCH LEGEND."} Add two small white Japanese text paragraphs on each side of the character, each paragraph arranged in two lines. At the bottom, place a large, cracked stone-textured gold title in capital letters.{argument name="movie title" default="SQUAT HERO"} Below it, add a red capital subtitle.{argument name="subtitle" default="LEG DAY IS DESTINY."} Add a red, stamp-style Japanese label to the lower right of the title. Add a dense, miniature movie poster-style credits at the bottom center, a rating box in the lower left corner, three miniature studio or audio logos in the lower right corner, and release information at the bottom center.{argument name="release text" default="COMING SOON TO A GYM NEAR YOU"} This makes it look like a sophisticated action-comedy sports movie poster, with an absurd epic feel, photorealistic rendering, dramatic shadows, volumetric smoke, reflective ground, and high-end theatrical poster design.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超高细节的电影感恶搞海报，主角是一只拟人化的柴犬，化身为极限健美力量举英雄。画面中心，他正处于全正面深蹲姿势，肩扛沉重的超负荷杠铃。这只狗拥有逼真的柴犬头部，表情冷静自信，毛色为温暖的橙奶油色，耳朵竖立，目光直视前方。身体呈现出夸张的肌肉感和人类特征，拥有巨大的三角肌、胸肌、手臂、腹肌、股四头肌和小腿，毛发和皮肤呈现出光泽的戏剧性高光和致密质感。他仅穿着紧身黑色举重短裤和深色举重腰带。深蹲姿势低沉有力，双膝宽展，双脚稳稳地踏在夜晚湿润反光的屋顶或工业平台上。背景为现代城市天际线，点缀着发光的摩天大楼、蓝色薄雾、烟雾，左上角和右上角各有一盏明亮的体育场泛光灯，营造出强烈的轮廓光和英雄般的体育竞技场氛围。构图应保持完美的居中对称，杠铃水平贯穿画面，两侧堆叠着许多大型黑色杠铃片。采用高对比度的青色、琥珀色、黑色和金色调，配合强烈的电影级调色，角色焦点清晰，灯光周围带有大气光晕。添加风格化的海报排版：在最顶部，使用金色大写字母添加标语 {argument name="top tagline" default="NO PAIN. MUCH GAIN. SUCH LEGEND."}。在角色左右两侧各添加 2 段小型白色日文文案，每段分 2 行排列。在底部，放置一个巨大的裂纹石质感金色大写标题 {argument name="movie title" default="SQUAT HERO"}。在其下方，添加一行红色大写副标题 {argument name="subtitle" default="LEG DAY IS DESTINY."}。在标题右下方添加一个红色印章风格的日文标签。在底部中心添加密集的微型仿电影海报演职员表，左下角放置评级框，右下角放置 3 个微型工作室或音频标志，并在底部中心添加上映信息 {argument name="release text" default="COMING SOON TO A GYM NEAR YOU"}。使其看起来像一张精致的动作喜剧体育大片海报，具有荒诞的史诗感、照片级渲染、戏剧性阴影、体积烟雾、反光地面以及高级院线海报设计。

templates.title: Cyberpunk FPV Drone Racer Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克 FPV 无人机赛手海报

templates.prompt: A hardcore cyberpunk anime illustration, the protagonist is{argument name="character name" default="Miyamoto Iori"} one{argument name="character age" default="19"} A 20-year-old FPV drone racer. The image shows her standing in a vast, dilapidated industrial arena at night, three-quarters of her back in the background. She has messy black hair tied in a high ponytail, fair skin, and wears a glossy black tactical flight suit covered in patches, straps, cables, and sponsor logos. A large hard-shell radio backpack with a long antenna and stickers is slung across her back, and an ID badge hangs from her waist. Her face is mostly hidden in profile, adding to her mystique. The environment is filled with steel beams, catwalks, dangling power lines, broken windows, concrete pillars, damp, reflective ground, and stacked signs. Multiple FPV racing drones traverse the arena, leaving bright arcs of white, cyan, and red light trails that swirl and guide the eye into the frame. The image must contain at least six clearly visible drones, distributed in the background and mid-ground. Add a large weathered sign that reads "SECTION C", "FREEDOM, SPEED, ONLY", and "LAP 07 KEEP FLYING", and add a vertical character information block in the top left corner with text including "{argument name="nameplate text" default="MIYAMOTO IORI"} “AGE:”{argument name="age text" default="19"} The text includes the tagline "FPV DRONE RACER," the Japanese inscription "私は、飛ぶ者だ。," and the English line "I am the one who flies." It also includes a short data list showing "RANKING // 2," "WINS // 11," "PODIUMS // 23," and "STYLE // GHOST." Her clothing and equipment feature clearly visible stickers including "AXIS," "Fly Beyond," "BRX," "IORI 027," and an ID card labeled "PILOT MIYAMOTO IORI." The design uses a dark color scheme dominated by steel gray, black, and soft brown, accented with neon racetrack light trails and tiny white light sources. Cinematic backlighting, rain-soaked reflections, a heavy texture, complex lines, a sense of urban decay, high contrast, and a melancholic atmosphere create a highly refined anime concept art aesthetic, employing a vertical poster composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张硬核赛博朋克动漫插画，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="宫本伊织"}，一位 {argument name="character age" default="19"} 岁的 FPV 无人机赛手。画面呈现她站在广阔且破败的夜间工业竞技场中，呈四分之三背影视角。她留着黑色乱发，扎成高马尾，皮肤白皙，身穿一件覆盖着补丁、绑带、线缆和赞助商标志的亮黑色战术飞行服。背上背着一个巨大的硬壳无线电背包，上面带有长天线和贴纸，腰间挂着一张 ID 证件。她的脸部大部分隐藏在侧影中，显得神秘莫测。环境布满了钢梁、猫道、悬垂的电线、破碎的窗户、混凝土柱、潮湿的反光地面以及层叠的标牌。多架 FPV 竞速无人机正在竞技场中穿梭，留下了白色、青色和红色的明亮弧形光迹，这些光迹在场景中盘旋，引导视线深入画面。画面中需包含 6 架清晰可见的无人机，分布在远景和中景。添加巨大的风化标牌，上面写着“SECTION C”、“FREEDOM, SPEED, ONLY”和“LAP 07 KEEP FLYING”，并在左上角添加一个垂直的角色信息块，文字包括“{argument name="nameplate text" default="MIYAMOTO IORI"}”、“AGE: {argument name="age text" default="19"}”、“FPV DRONE RACER”、日文引言“私は、飛ぶ者だ。”以及英文行“I am the one who flies.”。同时包含一个简短的数据列表，显示“RANKING // 2”、“WINS // 11”、“PODIUMS // 23”和“STYLE // GHOST”。在她的服装和装备上，展示清晰可见的贴纸，包括“AXIS”、“Fly Beyond”、“BRX”、“IORI 027”以及一张标有“PILOT MIYAMOTO IORI”的 ID 卡。使用以钢灰色、黑色和柔和棕色为主的暗色调，并点缀霓虹赛道光迹和微小的白色光源。电影级背光、雨水浸润的反光、厚重的质感、复杂的线条、城市衰败感、高对比度、忧郁的氛围，呈现出高度精细的动漫概念艺术美学，采用垂直海报构图。

templates.title: Cockatiel owner's seed scattered comic

titleLocalized.zh: 玄凤鹦鹉主人种子散落漫画

templates.prompt: This is a Japanese-style single-panel illustration against a light-colored wooden floor background. The illustration employs a soft, delicate, and slightly retro manga/anime style with clear lines and warm, gentle colors. In the center of the image, a young woman kneels on the ground, wearing a grey cockatiel onesie with a white belly and small grey wings. She wears an oversized yellow cockatiel headdress with crest feathers, round black eyes, orange cheek spots, and a beak above her forehead. She clutches the sides of the headdress tightly, her expression shocked, stiff, and filled with guilt. A large rectangular visor covers the center of her face. On the floor in front of her lies a mess of scattered birdseed: a haphazard pile of mixed grains, kernels, husks, and seeds. To the left, an overturned white seed cup overflows; in the lower left corner, a vacuum cleaner head points towards the mess, with part of the hose visible at the lower right edge. Standing on the right is a real cockatiel, small in size, with a curious expression, a yellow face, orange cheeks, a light-colored body, gray wings, and an upright crest, staring at the kneeling woman; next to the bird is a small speech bubble with a question mark. The background is a simple indoor floor, the upper half filled with exaggerated dark vertical pressure lines to enhance the sense of panic. Four Japanese elements incorporating manga fonts are added: a large onomatopoeic word "garn" in the upper left corner, a vertical inner monologue speech bubble on the left that reads "Yacchatta…", a large vertical spike-shaped speech bubble in the upper right corner that reads "Kore…shokuji kakeru no…？無理ゲーすぎる…！", and a beige description box in the lower right corner that reads "Okame-sui, aru aru." The overall atmosphere conveys a comedic awkwardness and family disaster, as if depicting a real mistake that a bird owner often makes.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅日式单格漫画风格插画，背景为浅色木地板，采用柔和、细腻且略带复古感的漫画动画风格，线条清晰，色调温暖柔和。画面中央，一名年轻女子跪在地上，身穿灰色玄凤鹦鹉连体睡衣，腹部为白色，带有小巧的灰色翅膀；她戴着超大的黄色玄凤鹦鹉头套，头套上有冠羽、圆圆的黑眼睛、橙色脸颊斑点和位于额头上方的鸟喙。她双手紧抓头套两侧，表情震惊，姿势僵硬且充满愧疚，脸部中央覆盖着一块巨大的长方形遮挡条。她面前的地板上是一片狼藉的散落鸟食：混合谷物、颗粒、壳和种子杂乱地堆积在一起。左侧倒着 1 个白色的种子杯，内容物倾洒而出；左下角有 1 个吸尘器吸头指向这堆混乱，软管的一部分出现在右下角边缘。右侧站着 1 只真实的玄凤鹦鹉，体型娇小，神情好奇，有着黄色的脸、橙色的脸颊、浅色的身体、灰色的翅膀和竖起的冠羽，正注视着跪着的女子；鸟儿旁边有 1 个写着问号的小气泡。背景是简单的室内地板，上半部分填充着夸张的深色垂直压力线，以增强恐慌感。添加 4 处融入漫画字体的日文元素：左上角巨大的拟声词「ガーン」，左侧 1 个垂直的内心独白气泡写着「やっちゃった…」，右上角 1 个巨大的垂直尖刺状对话气泡写着「これ…掃除機かけるの…？無理ゲーすぎる…！」，以及右下角 1 个米色的说明框写着「オカメ飼い、あるある。」。整体氛围表现出喜剧性的尴尬与家庭灾难，仿佛在描绘一个鸟主人常犯的真实错误。

titleLocalized.zh: Microsoft PowerWordEx 宣传图

templates.prompt: A minimalist corporate promotional image with a very light gray background, horizontally centered. On the left, a 3D glossy stack of four overlapping Microsoft Office-style application icons is created, featuring rounded corners and soft shadows: at the forefront is a large blue PowerPoint icon containing a raised blue square with a bold white capital letter P; behind it is a white-blue Word document icon with a fold-out in the upper right corner and three lines of blue horizontal text; next is a green Excel spreadsheet icon with a white grid; and finally, an orange presentation slides icon with a light pie chart. These icons should be tightly stacked into a compact cluster with modern, smooth gradients, subtle reflections, and a soft sense of depth. To the right of the icon cluster is the black "Microsoft" lettering in a clean sans-serif font, below which is a striking large title "PowerWordEx," visually merging the three product names into one word: "Power" uses an orange-to-red gradient, "Word" uses a dark blue gradient, and "Ex" uses a cyan-to-blue gradient. Maintain a clear and balanced layout with ample white space to present a sophisticated aesthetic for the technology brand, and adopt a wide banner-style composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张简洁的极简主义企业宣传图，背景为极浅的灰色，水平居中。在左侧，创建一个由 4 个重叠的 Microsoft Office 风格应用图标组成的 3D 光泽堆叠，图标采用圆角设计并带有柔和阴影：最前方是一个巨大的蓝色 PowerPoint 图标，其中包含一个带有粗体白色大写字母 P 的凸起蓝色小方块；其后是一个带有右上角折页和 3 行蓝色水平文本的白蓝色 Word 文档图标；再后是一个带有白色网格的绿色 Excel 表格图标；最后是一个带有浅色饼图的橙色演示文稿 Slides 图标。这些图标应紧密堆叠成一个紧凑的集群，具有现代平滑的渐变、微妙的反射和柔和的深度感。在图标集群的右侧，放置黑色的“Microsoft”字样，使用简洁的无衬线字体，其下方是一个醒目的大标题“PowerWordEx”，将 3 个产品名称在视觉上合并为一个词：“Power”采用橙色到红色的渐变，“Word”采用深蓝色渐变，“Ex”采用青色到蓝绿色的渐变。保持排版清晰平衡，留白充足，呈现出精致的科技品牌美感，并采用宽幅横幅式的构图。

templates.title: Anime group movie poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫群像电影海报

templates.prompt: A meticulously crafted poster for a Japanese animated feature film, presented vertically in a single sheet format, rendered with high-end cinematic detail and bright natural light. The composition features a dramatic group portrait of six teenagers against a backdrop of a bright blue sky, soft clouds, distant white birds, shimmering water, and lush vegetation in the foreground. The left side of the background depicts the ruins of a futuristic eco-city, partially covered by vegetation, seamlessly blending nature with advanced science. At the top center, two main characters stand back-to-back, serving as the visual focal point: on the left is a tall boy with messy short white hair, pale skin, a calm and serious expression, wearing a shirt, tie, and white lab coat, turned to the left; on the right is a tall girl with black hair neatly styled in a bun, pale skin, a composed expression, wearing a dark school uniform-style outfit with a white collar and ribbon, turned to the right. In the foreground below them stands a female student with a straight black bob, pale skin, wearing a black uniform with a large dark red bow, facing forward, her expression quiet and reserved. To the left center stands a dark-haired boy, wearing a dark suit and tie, turned to the left. To the right center stands a boy with messy brown hair, wearing a blue hoodie under a dark jacket, turned to the right. To the lower left stands a girl with long, soft light brown hair, wearing a light pink cardigan over a light-colored top, one hand on her chest, her expression gentle yet slightly anxious. The anatomy of each character is consistent and clearly defined, hair is rendered elegantly, clothing folds are delicate, and expressions are restrained yet emotional. Warm rim lighting and soft atmospheric glow, complemented by delicate lens flare and oil painting-like highlights, create an atmosphere full of hope and contemplation. Japanese typography design is incorporated into the poster: the vertical slogan in the upper left corner is "その选択が, the scenery of the future を変える.", and the vertical slogan in the upper right corner is "Natural と, Science と、心をつなぐ路へ", the small characters above the title are "Theatre アニメーション影视", and the large luminous main title is in the center below.{argument name="film title" default="エコテイクノート"} The subtitle is below the title.{argument name="subtitle text" default="— A choice for the future —"} Below the title are three award laurel wreaths displayed horizontally, containing a small Japanese film festival text. Above the cast and crew list at the bottom are six character name tags displayed horizontally. At the very bottom is a dense Japanese cast and crew list, with minimal social media and website information. The release date is prominently displayed in the lower right corner.{argument name="release date" default="8.22 FRI"} Below this is a smaller line of text: "National Roadshow". The overall style maintains the feel of a high-end contemporary animation key visual poster for an emotional ensemble film about science, nature, and growth.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的日本动画剧场版电影海报，采用竖版单张格式，以高端电影级细节和明亮的自然光绘制。构图特色为 6 名青少年组成的戏剧性群像，背景是明亮的蓝天、柔和的云朵、远处的白鸟、波光粼粼的水面以及前景中郁郁葱葱的植被；左侧背景为部分被植被覆盖的未来生态城市废墟，将自然与先进科学融为一体。画面顶部中央，两名主角背靠背站立，作为视觉中心：左侧为一名高挑的少年，留着凌乱的白色短发，肤色苍白，表情冷静严肃，身穿衬衫领带外搭白色实验服，侧身向左；右侧为一名高挑的少女，黑色头发梳成整齐的发髻，肤色苍白，表情沉稳，身穿带有白色领子和颈部丝带的深色校服风格服装，侧身向右。在他们下方的中央前景处，站着一名留着黑色直发波波头的女学生，肤色苍白，身穿带有深红色大蝴蝶结的黑色制服，正面向前，神情安静且内敛。左中位置站着一名深色头发的少年，身穿深色西装打领带，侧身向左。右中位置站着一名棕色乱发的少年，身穿蓝色连帽衫外搭深色夹克，侧身向右。左下方站着一名浅棕色长发、发丝柔软的少女，身穿浅粉色开衫内搭浅色上衣，一只手放在胸前，神情温柔且略显焦虑。确保每个角色解剖结构一致且界限清晰，头发渲染优雅，衣物褶皱细腻，表情克制而富有情感。使用温暖的轮廓光和柔和的大气光晕，辅以细腻的镜头光斑和油画质感的高光，营造出充满希望与沉思的氛围。海报中融入日文排版设计：左上角垂直标语为“その選択が、未来の景色を変える。”，右上角垂直标语为“自然と、科学と、心をつなぐ旅へ。”，标题上方的小字为“劇場アニメーション映画”，下方中央位置为发光的大号主标题“{argument name="film title" default="エコテイクノート"}”，标题下方为副标题“{argument name="subtitle text" default="― 未来への選択 ―"}”，标题下方横排 3 个奖项桂冠，内含小型日文电影节文字，底部演职员表上方横排 6 个角色名称标签，最底部为密集的日文演职员表，极小的社交媒体和网址信息，右下角为醒目的上映日期“{argument name="release date" default="8.22 FRI"}”，下方附带一行较小的文字“全国ロードショー”。整体风格保持为一部关于科学、自然与成长的情感类群像电影的高端当代动画主视觉海报。

templates.title: Cute futuristic platform jumping game scene

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱的未来感平台跳跃游戏场景

templates.prompt: A bright and cheerful 2D side-scrolling platformer scene with a delicate cartoon style. In the lower left foreground, an adorable white, round mascot character stands on a grassy, ​​dirt platform. The character is small and rounded, with a smooth, white body, short legs, large, glossy black eyes (with white highlights), and a smiling mouth, its body slightly turned to the right. The environment is a futuristic sci-fi landscape under a clear blue sky, with large, soft white clouds floating in the air. There are five floating rectangular platforms in the scene, with rounded edges, white tops, orange bottoms, and glowing cyan panels on their fronts; one is located low near the character, one in the lower middle, one in the middle center, one in the upper right center, and the last one in the upper right corner. Above the center of the scene is an arc composed of five glowing rings, alternating between orange and cyan, surrounded by small sparks, with tiny white particles dotting the jump path. The level features three clearly visible grassy platforms, covered in lush green grass on brown soil with rounded edges: one in the far left foreground, one in the lower left center (where the character stands), and one in the far right foreground. The background includes rolling green hills, atmospheric blue mountains, and a fantastical futuristic city dotted with sleek white towers and domed buildings with turquoise windows. The scene also includes three floating islands covered in grass and topped with small domes: one in the left center, one in the right center, and a smaller floating island in the far right. The foreground is decorated with small flowers and bushes. The game uses highly saturated colors, clean vector-style outlines, and soft lighting, with glowing objects surrounded by soft halos, creating a fun mobile game aesthetic reminiscent of a friendly sci-fi platformer's splash screen. It features widescreen cinematic composition, a side view, and no UI or text.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张明亮、欢快的 2D 横版平台跳跃游戏场景，采用精致的卡通风格。画面左下角前景处，一个可爱的白色团状吉祥物角色正站在草地泥土平台上。该角色体型圆润小巧，身体洁白光滑，有着短小的双脚、大而有光泽的黑色眼睛（带有白色高光）以及微笑着的小嘴，身体略微朝向右侧。环境是一个位于湛蓝天空下的未来科幻景观，天空中漂浮着大朵柔软的白云。场景中共有 5 个浮空的矩形悬浮平台，平台边缘圆润，顶部为白色，底部为橙色，正面带有发光的青色灯板；其中一个位于角色附近低处，一个位于中下部，一个位于中中部，一个位于右上中部，最后一个位于右上角。场景中部上方有一道由 5 个发光圆环组成的弧线，圆环颜色交替为橙色和青色，周围环绕着小火花，跳跃路径上点缀着微小的白色粒子。关卡包含 3 个清晰可见的草地平台，由茂密的绿草覆盖在棕色土壤上，边缘呈圆弧状：一个位于左侧远景前景，一个位于左中下部（角色站立处），另一个位于右侧远景前景。背景中加入连绵的绿色山丘、充满氛围感的蓝色山脉，以及一座奇幻的未来城市，城市中点缀着光滑的白色塔楼和带有青蓝色窗户的圆顶建筑。画面中包含 3 个顶部覆盖草地并带有小型圆顶结构的浮空岛：一个位于左中，一个位于右中，还有一个位于右侧远处的小型浮空岛。前景装饰着小花和灌木丛。使用高饱和度色彩、干净的矢量风格轮廓、柔和的灯光，发光物体周围带有柔和的光晕，呈现出类似友好科幻平台游戏启动画面的趣味手游美学。宽屏电影级构图，侧视图，无 UI，无文字。

templates.prompt: A dynamic anime illustration featuring a protagonist who{argument name="character age vibe" default="girl"} Keep long{argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown"} She has twin ponytails tied with two large pink cat-ear-shaped bows at the ends, bright blue eyes, and a confident, serious expression. She strikes an exaggerated, chuunibyou (adolescent delusions of grandeur) pose, one hand dramatically outstretched in front of the camera with a strong sense of perspective, the fingers clearly visible; the other hand gestures towards her eyes, as if casting magic or manipulating the digital realm. She wears a white lab coat over a dark blue school uniform, including a shirt, vest, tie, and pleated skirt. The scene is set in a futuristic neon laboratory or cyberpunk magic room, filled with glowing purple and blue light, floating holographic interface fragments, and a bright horizontal audio waveform running across the background. To the left floats a row of 11 semi-transparent rectangular cards or panels. To the right is a ring of 10 floating cat-face emojis, glowing in pink, purple, and blue, with cute and mischievous expressions. A large glass bottle is added in the lower left foreground. Her long hair flows outwards with her movements, and purple energy ribbons wrap around her body. Employing dramatic, cinematic lighting, high contrast, glossy highlights, detailed finger depictions, strong perspective effects, shimmering particles, and a mysterious cyberpunk style in violet, indigo, and magenta hues, it presents exquisite high-end anime key visual rendering effects.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满动感的动漫插画，主角是一位 {argument name="character age vibe" default="少女"}，留着长长的 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 双马尾，发尾系着两个巨大的猫耳形状粉色蝴蝶结，有着明亮的蓝色双眼和自信严肃的表情。她摆出夸张的中二病姿势，一只手在镜头前戏剧性地张开，呈现出强烈的透视感，五指清晰可见；另一只手则在眼部比划，仿佛正在施展魔法或操控数字领域。她身穿白色实验服，内搭深蓝色校服，包括衬衫、背心、领带和百褶裙。场景设定在一个充满未来感的霓虹实验室或赛博魔法室中，充斥着发光的紫色和蓝色光芒、漂浮的全息界面碎片，背景中横贯着一道明亮的水平音频波形，左侧漂浮着一排 11 张半透明的矩形卡片或面板。右侧是一个由 10 个漂浮的猫脸表情符号组成的圆环，呈现出粉色、紫色和蓝色的光芒，表情可爱且调皮。在左下角前景处增加一个大玻璃瓶。她的长发随动作向外飘散，紫色能量丝带环绕在身体周围。采用戏剧性的电影级布光、高对比度、光泽高光、精细的手指刻画、强烈的透视效果、闪烁的粒子，以及紫罗兰色、靛蓝色和洋红色调的神秘赛博朋克风格，呈现出精致的高端动漫关键视觉渲染效果。

templates.title: Minimalist analog wall clock at 05:29

titleLocalized.zh: 05:29 的极简模拟挂钟

templates.prompt: A minimalist photograph showcases a round analog wall clock mounted on a smooth, light gray wall, centered and from a frontal perspective. The clock features a matte black circular bezel, a simple white dial, black Arabic numerals from 1 to 12, thin black minute markers around the dial, and thicker hour markers at each numeral. It displays all 12 numerals and 60 minute markers. The time is displayed as {argument name="clock time" default="05:29"} The short hour hand is slightly past 5 o'clock, the long minute hand points to the 29-minute mark before 6 o'clock, and the ultra-thin black second hand is located at approximately 31 seconds on the lower half of the dial. Soft, even lighting creates delicate, realistic shadows on the wall, showcasing high-detail product photography quality, a neutral, modern interior aesthetic, no brand logos, no extraneous objects, and a square composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极简主义风格的摄影作品，展示了一个安装在平滑浅灰色墙面上的圆形模拟挂钟，画面居中且为正视视角。挂钟配有哑光黑色圆形边框、简洁的白色表盘、1 到 12 的黑色阿拉伯数字，表盘周围有细长的黑色分钟刻度，每个数字处有较粗的小时刻度。显示完整的 12 个数字和 60 个分钟刻度。显示时间为 {argument name="clock time" default="05:29"}：短时针略微超过 5 点，长分针指向 6 点前方的 29 分钟刻度，极细的黑色秒针位于表盘下半部分约 31 秒的位置。柔和均匀的灯光，墙上带有细腻逼真的阴影，高细节产品摄影质感，中性现代室内美学，无品牌标识，无额外物体，方形构图。

templates.title: Anime girl holding an umbrella in the rain

titleLocalized.zh: 雨中撑伞的动漫少女

templates.prompt: A bright, anime-style close-up portrait depicts a girl standing outdoors in the rain, half-length, holding a transparent plastic umbrella. She has {argument name="hair color" default="Dark blue-black"} Her hair was tied in a low side ponytail with soft wisps and straight bangs. She wore delicate round-framed glasses and had bright, large, purplish-blue eyes. Her expression was calm, with a hint of amazement, as she gazed up at the leaves and raindrops. She wore a soaked white short-sleeved school uniform shirt with a dark blue plaid bow at the collar. The scene was filled with realistic water and light: fine rain fell, raindrops clung to the umbrella ribs, water droplets clung to her hair and shirt, and crystal-clear water droplets hung from the large green leaves in the upper right foreground. In the lower right and foreground, blooming white garden flowers dotted the scene, their dark, glossy leaves covered in raindrops. The use of cool blue and silver tones, complemented by soft pale purple highlights, and a background of diffused sunlight after or during the rain, created a strong sense of transparency, reflection, refraction, shimmering bokeh, and the glossy sheen of wet surfaces. The background should be an out-of-focus city garden or residential walkway, with fences and buildings blurred in the rain, while the girl herself remained clear. The film emphasizes cinematic composition, layered foreground leaves, ultra-fine raindrops, realistic translucent umbrella material, subtle contour lighting on wet hair, and an overall serene and breathtaking atmosphere reminiscent of a summer rain scene.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅明亮的动漫风格特写肖像，描绘了一位站在户外雨中的少女，半身构图，手持一把透明的塑料雨伞。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深藏青黑色"} 的头发，扎成低侧马尾，带有柔和的碎发和直刘海，戴着精致的圆框眼镜，有着明亮的大眼睛，呈紫蓝色，神情平静，带着一丝惊叹，仰望着叶片和雨滴。她穿着湿透的白色短袖校服衬衫，领口系着深蓝色格子蝴蝶结。场景中充满了逼真的水感与光影：细密的雨丝落下，雨滴附着在伞骨上，发丝和衬衫上挂着水珠，右上角前景的大片绿叶上悬挂着晶莹剔透的水滴。右下角及前景处，点缀着盛开的白色花园花卉，深色的光泽叶片上覆盖着雨水。采用冷蓝色和银色调，辅以柔和的淡紫色高光，背景为雨后或雨中漫射的日光逆光，营造出强烈的透明感、反射、折射、闪烁的焦外成像以及湿润表面的光泽。背景应为失焦的城市花园或住宅步道，围栏和建筑在雨中变得模糊，而少女主体保持清晰。强调电影感的构图、层叠的前景叶片、超精细的雨滴、逼真的半透明雨伞材质、湿润发丝上的细微轮廓光，以及整体宁静惊叹与夏日雨景的氛围。

templates.title: Real photos of MIDI piano sheet music

titleLocalized.zh: MIDI 钢琴乐谱实拍图

templates.prompt: A top-down, realistic photograph of a white printed sheet of paper placed on a light-colored wooden desk showcases a computer-generated musical score. The page is horizontally centered with a slight sense of perspective, illuminated by soft natural indoor light with minimal shadows, resulting in a clean, printed document. At the top center of the page, the title is printed in a simple sans-serif font.{argument name="file name" default="kura.mid"} -{argument name="track name" default="CH05 Piano"} Below is a standard black staff system with a treble clef and 4/4 time signature, designed to resemble an automatically converted MIDI score rather than a finely typed score. On the far left of the first line of staff is the instrument name "CH05 Piano". The page should display five lines of horizontal staff, with the starting measure numbers on the left of each line being 18, 21, 25, 29, and 33 respectively. Near the first line of staff is a tempo marker indicating a quarter note equal to 120. The staff is filled with dense, somewhat stiff but logical black notes, accidentals, stems, slurs, and rests. The treble register contains numerous sharps and repeated short note combinations, visually resembling a MIDI-converted piano score. The first three lines of staff should be relatively long and almost fill the entire width; the fourth line should also be relatively long; the fifth... The lines should be short, occupying only the left side of the page. The sheet music must remain legible, but the spacing should have a mechanically generated appearance. Use clean white paper with wide margins, no handwriting, no colored elements, no extra graphics, and simply present a printed sheet music photographed on a desk.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张放置在浅色木质书桌上的白色打印纸俯拍写实照片，展示了一份计算机生成的乐谱。页面水平居中，带有轻微的透视感，光线为柔和的室内自然光，阴影极少，呈现出干净的文档打印质感。在页面顶部中央，用简洁的无衬线字体打印标题“{argument name="file name" default="kura.mid"} - {argument name="track name" default="CH05 Piano"}”。下方是标准的黑色五线谱系统，带有高音谱号和 4/4 拍号，设计风格呈现出 MIDI 自动转换后的效果，而非精细排版的乐谱。在第一行五线谱的最左侧，标注乐器名称“CH05 Piano”。页面上需精确显示 5 行水平五线谱，各行左侧起始小节编号分别为 18、21、25、29 和 33。在第一行五线谱附近，包含一个四分音符等于 120 的速度标记。五线谱中填满密集、略显生硬但合理的黑色音符、变音记号、符干、连音线和休止符，高音区包含大量升号和重复的短音符组合，视觉上类似于 MIDI 转换出的钢琴谱。前 3 行五线谱应较长且几乎占满全宽；第 4 行也应较长；第 5 行应较短，仅占据页面左侧部分。乐谱需保持清晰可读，但间距呈现出机械生成的特征。使用干净的白纸，留有宽边距，无手写痕迹，无彩色元素，无额外图形，仅呈现放置在书桌上拍摄的打印乐谱。

templates.title: Anime working women raise a glass to celebrate at night

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫职场女性夜晚举杯庆祝

templates.prompt: A delicate anime-style night scene illustration, using a 1:2 vertical composition. A young Japanese working woman stands on a riverside promenade at night, facing the viewer, cheerfully raising a large glass of beer in a toast. She wears a fitted dark navy blue business suit, paired with a pencil skirt, white shirt, and red tie, with her company badge around her neck. She has long, straight, dark brown to black hair with soft bangs, and a slender figure, exuding a relaxed and friendly atmosphere after get off work. Due to the perspective, her right hand, which is extended towards the camera, holds an ice-cold beer glass filled with golden lager and foam, making it particularly eye-catching in the foreground. Her left arm hangs naturally at her side. A white, manga-style speech bubble is added to her upper right corner, containing the vertically arranged Japanese text "今日もお疲れさまでした！" (I'm tired today!). The scene is set on a paved waterfront promenade with metal railings, three visible warm-colored lanterns beside it, and a river or canal in the background against a modern city skyline with many bright windows. Above, a clear, deep blue starry sky dominates the space, with the Milky Way extending diagonally from below the center behind the character to the upper right corner, forming a bright band of light. Cinematic lighting effects are used, with cool-toned moonlight contrasting with warm-toned lantern light, clean lines, delicate sheen and shadow on the suits, and rich detail in the starry sky, creating a tranquil yet celebratory after-get off work atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的动漫风格夜景插画，采用 1:2 竖构图。一位年轻的日本职场女性站在夜晚的河畔步道上，面向观众，欢快地举起一个大玻璃啤酒杯进行干杯。她身穿修身的深海军蓝职业套装，搭配包臀裙、白色衬衫、红色领带，脖子上挂着公司工牌。她留着深棕色至黑色的长直发，带有柔和的刘海，身材苗条，展现出下班后轻松友好的氛围。由于透视关系，她伸向镜头的右手中握着装满金色拉格啤酒和泡沫的冰镇啤酒杯，在前景中显得格外醒目。她的左臂自然垂在身侧。在她的右上角添加一个白色的漫画风格对话气泡，其中包含竖排日语文字「今日もお疲れさまでした！」。场景设定在铺设好的滨水步道上，配有金属栏杆，步道旁有 3 盏可见的暖色灯笼，身后是河流或运河，背景为拥有许多明亮窗户的现代城市天际线。画面上方，清澈深邃的蓝色星空占据了大部分空间，银河从角色身后的中心下方斜向延伸至右上角，形成一条明亮的光带。采用电影级光影效果，冷色调的月光与暖色调的灯笼光形成对比，线条清晰，套装上有细腻的光泽阴影，星空细节丰富，营造出一种宁静且充满庆祝感的下班氛围。

templates.title: Anime Girl by the Sea and Her Letter

titleLocalized.zh: 海边的动漫少女与信件

templates.prompt: A bright, anime-style illustration depicts a young woman standing on sun-drenched stone steps in a Mediterranean seaside town, shot from a half-body to three-quarter-body perspective. She has very long, flowing, deep brown hair, strands of which flutter in the wind, adorned with a delicate white flower hair clip on one side. Her face is mostly obscured by her hair and the angle, creating a gentle, dreamy, and mysterious atmosphere. She wears an elegant sleeveless dress.{argument name="dress color" default="Pale lavender white"} The dress features thin straps, lace trim, a fitted waist, and a large bow at the back. The background showcases a narrow stone-paved street lined with ancient buildings and greenery, a deep blue bay, a distant mountain coastline, a lighthouse-like tower, and several small white boats on the sea under a clear sky and soft clouds. The warm midday sun, the shimmering atmosphere, the romantic postcard-like vacation feel, the high-detail anime-style artwork, the soft painterly texture, the vibrant blue ocean, the lush green vegetation, and the elegant female character design all contribute to the overall effect. On the right, a large white sheet of paper serves as a clear overlay, with neat handwritten Japanese in dark ink, including friendly emoticons and flowers—perhaps a heartfelt fan message or thank-you note. The content of the letter should be: "いつも见愿ってくださってありがとうございます😊✨ All of the best日々の小さなLuckyせを大刀にしながら、これからも心を込めて歌や言葉を级けていきますね♪♪🌸 どうか、合さんの心が穏やかであたたかい毎日でありますように…🍀💖 紬紬より🌸”. Letters should be legible, balanced with the characters, and have a clean white background with a slight paper texture. Add a subtle line of signature text in the lower left corner:{argument name="credit text" default="Co-Creation with Motohiko Sato & AI"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 一张明亮的动漫风格插画，描绘了一位年轻女性站在地中海海滨小镇阳光明媚的石阶上，视角为半身至四分之三身位。她留着一头非常长且飘逸的深棕色秀发，发丝随风轻拂，一侧别着精致的小白花发夹。她的面部大部分被头发和角度遮挡，营造出一种温柔、梦幻且神秘的氛围。她身穿一件精致的无袖 {argument name="dress color" default="淡薰衣草白"} 连衣裙，带有细肩带、蕾丝边、修身腰线，背后系着一个大蝴蝶结。背景展示了 1 条狭窄的石阶街道，两旁是古老的建筑和绿植，1 个湛蓝的海湾，1 条远处的山脉海岸线，1 座灯塔状的塔楼，以及在清澈天空和柔和云朵下海面上几艘小巧的白色船只。温暖的正午阳光，闪烁的氛围，浪漫的度假明信片感，高细节动漫绘画，柔和的绘画质感，生动的蓝色海洋，郁郁葱葱的绿色植被，优雅的女性角色设计。在右侧，放置 1 张巨大的白色纸质信笺作为清晰的叠加层，上面用深色墨水书写着整洁的手写体日语，包含友好的表情符号和花朵，仿佛是一封真挚的粉丝留言或感谢信。信件内容应为：「いつも見守ってくださって ありがとうございます😊✨ 皆さんの優しい言葉や応援が、紬の心の支えになっています🌷 日々の小さな幸せを大切にしながら、これからも心を込めて歌や言葉を届けていきますね♪♪🌸 どうか、皆さんの心が 穏やかであたたかい毎日で ありますように…🍀💖 結葉紬より🌸」。信件应清晰易读，与人物保持平衡，背景为干净的白色并带有轻微的纸张纹理。在左下角添加一行细微的署名文字：{argument name="credit text" default="Co-Creation with Motohiko Sato & AI"}。

Adjust the composition to a sophisticated beauty advertisement style, using a luxurious background in deep crimson to black hues, paired with glossy lighting and high-end cosmetics brand aesthetics. Add a lipstick product to the raised hand on the right, and add a large foreground product close-up in the lower left corner, showcasing an open lipstick tube and a separate cap, placed on a reflective surface with a deep red glossy splatter effect. Add Japanese advertising layout elements: In the top left corner, add a small square label that says "新発売" (New Release), a large title "ROUGE," a vertical text block that reads "视見を夺う、ひと涂り." (Take away the view, paint it.), followed by three lines of smaller text: "鲜やかな発色." (Fresh color.), "上品なツヤ." (High-quality color.), "忘れられない印象へ." (Forget the impression.), then "2026 SPRING NEW COLOR" and a badge that says "All 6 colors," next to which are 6 lipstick swatches. In the top right corner, add a luxurious logo with the letters "GB" and the brand name "GUFU BEAUTY." In the bottom right corner, add an advertising block containing a large "NEW" and the text "うるおい続く、密着ルージュ." (Continue with the close-up, rouge.) The overall design features a rich ruby ​​color, gold accents, glossy highlights, and soft shimmer, giving it the feel of a high-end magazine beauty poster.

templates.title: Minimalist futuristic anime girl portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 极简未来感动漫少女肖像

templates.prompt: Against a light gray solid background, create a simple anime-style upper-body illustration. The character is centered, in a calm two-thirds profile, with their face slightly turned to the left. The character is a young, futuristic android or virtual idol.{argument name="hair color" default="Platinum"} Her hair is styled in a thick, braided bun on the left side of her head, with long, straight strands cascading down her shoulders. She wears a geometrically shaped sci-fi headset in her left ear, featuring a glowing cyan rectangular panel and a sharp-edged metal frame. She wears a fitted white bodysuit with black structural straps and trim, a high collar, and delicate, vertically and diagonally arranged glowing cyan lines along her chest and torso. Her arms are fitted with separate white sleeves and black straps, with a small, dark diamond-shaped decoration on her upper arm. The image is presented in a clean, minimalist sketch style, with lines as delicate as pencil drawings, employing subtle celluloid shading, soft pastel tones, and subtle cyan highlights, resulting in a refined conceptual art feel. The composition cuts off from the top of her head to below her chest, leaving ample negative space and omitting any props, text, or complex backgrounds.

promptLocalized.zh: 在浅灰色纯色背景下，绘制一幅简洁的动漫风格上半身角色插图，角色居中，身体呈平静的三分之二侧面，面部微向左转。角色为一位年轻的未来感仿生人或虚拟偶像，拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="铂金色"} 的头发，左侧头部梳有一个厚实的编织发髻，两侧留有长发丝，顺滑的直发垂过肩部。她左耳佩戴着几何形状的科幻耳机，耳机上带有发光的青色矩形面板和棱角分明的金属框架。身穿修身的白色紧身衣，配有黑色结构带和饰边，高领设计，胸部和躯干处有垂直及对角线分布的纤细青色发光线条。手臂配有分离式白色袖套和黑色束带，上臂处有一个小型深色菱形装饰。图像呈现为干净、极简的草图风格，线条细腻如铅笔画，采用轻微的赛璐珞阴影、柔和的粉彩色调、微妙的青色高光，具有精致的概念艺术质感。构图从头顶截取至胸部下方，留有大量负空间，不包含任何道具、文字或复杂的背景。

templates.prompt: A simple, anime-style upper-body portrait depicts a futuristic girl. Centered against a pure light gray background, the portrait employs casual, sketch-like lines and soft pastel colors. She has long, flowing, very pale pinkish-purple hair that falls to her shoulders, light and with a soft sheen. Her face is completely obscured by a centrally located, gray-toned lavender square blur/mosaic block. She wears a wide-brimmed white beret with a deep navy blue brim and two deep navy blue angular decorations on either side, accented with cyan details. On one visible side of her head, she wears sophisticated sci-fi style headphones with translucent cyan luminous elements. She wears a fitted white sleeveless turtleneck jumpsuit with two bright cyan vertical panels on the front, featuring thin, dark seams. Small, angular, deep navy blue armor-style decorations adorn the chest and waist. One upper arm wears a dark armband with four thin, cyan-white stripes. The image shows the body from chest to head, slightly turned to the viewer's left, with a simple and elegant silhouette. It employs a minimalist illustration style with delicate brushstrokes and subtle cel-shading. The main colors are white, cyan, navy blue, and light pink, and there are no background objects or text.

templates.title: Salt damage to reinforced concrete along the coast

titleLocalized.zh: 沿海钢筋混凝土盐害

templates.prompt: A hyper-realistic, documentary-style close-up photograph showcases severe chloride corrosion damage on a coastal reinforced concrete structure, taken from a slightly upward angle at the corner of a cantilever beam or pier. The image reveals a large area of ​​spalling at the outer corner, where the concrete cover has detached, precisely exposing five embedded, rusted horizontal reinforcing bars. The surrounding concrete is rough, cracked, and chipped, with irregular edges revealing the aggregate. Brownish-orange rust extends downwards from the exposed reinforcing bars and spreads along the base of the beam, indicating the long-term effects of salt damage. The concrete surface is light gray, weathered, and matte, with fine pores and construction flaws. The background features a calm blue sea and pale blue sky, with a blurred distant shore near the horizon; the soft blurring further emphasizes the marine environment. Bright natural light, clear weather, and a realistic smartphone photographic composition—no people, tools, safety railings, text, labels, or illustration style—present a credible photograph of a coastal reinforced concrete structure inspected for salt damage.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超写实的纪录片风格特写照片，展示了沿海钢筋混凝土结构上严重的氯化物腐蚀损坏，视角从悬臂梁或桥墩拐角处略微仰视。图像显示外角处有一大块剥落区域，混凝土保护层已脱落，精确露出内部嵌入的 5 根锈蚀水平钢筋。周围的混凝土粗糙、开裂且有缺口，边缘不规则，可见骨料。棕橙色的锈迹从裸露的钢筋处向下延伸，并沿着梁的底部蔓延，显示出长期的盐害影响。混凝土表面呈浅灰色，风化且呈哑光质感，带有细微的孔隙和施工瑕疵。背景处是平静的蓝色大海和淡蓝色的天空，地平线附近有模糊的远岸，柔和的虚化效果进一步强化了海洋环境。明亮的自然光，天气晴朗，真实的智能手机摄影构图，无人物、无工具、无安全护栏、无文字、无标签、非插画风格，仅呈现一张可信的沿海盐害钢筋混凝土工程检查照片。

titleLocalized.zh: 冬季混凝土盐害特写

templates.prompt: A hyper-realistic, documentary-style close-up photograph showcases severe salt damage on a concrete retaining wall weathered in winter. Shot from a low, oblique angle, the wall extends deep into the right side of the frame. A thin layer of snow and frost covers the top, while the ground beside the wall is dark and damp, partially covered in muddy snow. Extensive spalling and flaking are visible on the concrete surface, primarily concentrated in the upper half, with irregular areas exposing coarse aggregate of various sizes embedded in the mix. The damaged areas exhibit a rough, jagged, geographic outline with cracked edges, a pitted texture, and lost cement paste, revealing black and brown gravel. Vertical streaks of moisture and murky runoff extend downwards to the base of the wall. The overall color scheme is a mix of cool gray, charcoal gray, and soft winter white, illuminated by soft, overcast daylight, with a slight haze in the distance, and the surface texture is extremely fine. The composition should present the texture of a civil engineering inspection photo, like a real smartphone or on-site camera shot, with no people, text, labels, or exaggerated artistic processing in the picture.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超写实的纪录片风格特写照片，展示了冬季风化的混凝土护栏墙上严重的盐害。拍摄角度为低位斜角，墙体向画面右侧纵深延伸。顶部压顶覆盖着一层薄薄的积雪和霜，墙侧的地面呈深色且潮湿，部分覆盖着泥泞的积雪。混凝土表面显示出大面积的剥落和脱落，主要集中在上半部分，不规则的剥落区域露出了混合料中嵌入的各种尺寸的粗骨料。受损区域呈现出粗糙、锯齿状的地图形轮廓，边缘碎裂，表面有麻点纹理，水泥浆流失，并露出黑色和棕褐色的砾石。垂直的湿气条纹和污浊的径流痕迹向下延伸至墙基。整体色调为冷灰色、炭灰色和柔和的冬季白色，光线为柔和的阴天日光，远景带有轻微的空气霾，表面纹理极其细腻。构图应呈现出土木工程检查照片的质感，如同真实的智能手机或现场相机拍摄，画面中无人、无文字、无标签，无夸张的艺术化处理。

templates.title: Concrete wall with ASR map-like cracks

titleLocalized.zh: 带有 ASR 地图状裂缝的混凝土墙

templates.prompt: A highly realistic, documentary-style close-up photograph showcases an outdoor, weathered reinforced concrete bridge pier or retaining wall, exhibiting severe alkali-aggregate reaction damage. The wall occupies most of the frame and is shot at a slightly tilted angle, making the front and left edges clearly visible. The concrete surface is gray, rough, aged, and stained, covered with a dense, irregular network of polygonal, map-like cracks, with approximately 18 clearly visible main crack units on the surface. Many crack edges have pale white, gelatinous exudates and powdery deposits, and at several crack intersections, vertical white and brown water stains extend downwards. A horizontal construction joint or baseline is present near the base of the wall, with darker, damp stains below and fine moss or algae discoloration at the edges. The scene is set in a cloudy riverside or drainage ditch environment with sparse winter vegetation, rocks in the lower right corner, and a narrow band of still water along the right edge of the image. The lighting is natural and soft, the color tone is neutral, and the aesthetics of an engineering inspection photograph are evident. The surface texture is clearly defined, and there are no people, tools, text, or annotations.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度逼真的纪录片风格特写照片，展示了户外风化的钢筋混凝土桥墩或挡土墙，呈现出严重的碱-骨料反应损伤。墙体占据了大部分画面，并以微倾斜的角度拍摄，使得正面和左侧边缘均清晰可见。混凝土表面呈灰色，粗糙、陈旧且带有污渍，覆盖着密集的、不规则的多边形地图状裂缝网络，表面上有约 18 个清晰可见的主要裂缝单元。许多裂缝边缘有淡白色的胶状渗出物和粉状沉积物，几处裂缝交叉点处有垂直的白色和褐色水渍向下延伸。墙体底部附近包含一条水平施工缝或基线，下部有较暗的潮湿污渍，边缘处有细微的苔藓或藻类变色。场景设定在阴天的河边或排水渠环境，伴有稀疏的冬季植被，右下角有岩石，图像右侧边缘有一条狭窄的静水带。自然柔和的光线，中性色调，工程检测照片美学，表面纹理清晰，无人物，无工具，无文字，无标注。

Her face is deliberately blurred with soft, rectangular shapes. Three smaller portraits of the same woman, all with the same blurred faces, appear around the machine, totaling four blurred figures. Three plush panda heads are embedded on the left and right sides of the machine. At the top, the prominent, flashing title text reads "CR 冈安モフモフ," followed by a smaller subtitle, "もふもふは、正义。" (Mofumofu wa, Justice). On the left side of the central screen, add the phrase "今日もモフって生きていく。". In the area around the woman's chest, place a black pen-stroke label with gold lettering that reads "冈安モフセフ". On the right, create a bright reward panel with a claw icon that reads "モフモフRUSH". Below in the center, add a circular button-shaped badge that reads "モフモフCHANCE". At the bottom center, create a large, glowing control button with a pink claw icon, labeled "モフモフ". In the lower right display area, add a small embedded image of the woman's pointing gesture, along with the handwritten text "もふるかもふられるか…". The overall atmosphere should be absurd, tacky, over-designed, kitsch, and comical, like a fictional pachinko machine celebrating furry animals and exaggerated spectacles, presented as a high-resolution, product-grade front-facing photograph with sharp reflections, saturated purple highlights, and dense decorative details.

templates.prompt: A highly realistic documentary-style close-up photo shows a seriously {argument name="damage type" default="shear cracks"} The scene depicts a reinforced concrete structural beam. The image shows the bottom of the concrete structure, with a large diagonal crack extending upwards from the lower left to the upper right of the beam. A secondary branch diagonal crack is located near the center on the left, and three thinner, vertical, or slightly irregular micro-cracks are visible on the right side. The concrete surface is rough, weathered, and grayish-white, riddled with pores and aggregate marks. Darker grime and aged stains are present at the ceiling slabs and beam joints. The far left of the image includes a supporting concrete column, with the bottom edge of the beam visible at the bottom edge. Below is a dimly lit industrial background with out-of-focus pipes and structural elements. The lighting is natural and soft, reminiscent of a field inspection photograph taken under a bridge or in a parking lot. The composition is a mid-range close-up of the damaged beam, emphasizing the realistic structural deterioration, lifelike texture, and the accuracy of the engineering inspection. There are no people, safety signs, or overlay text in the image.

The second line has a larger font and is placed above a rough, hand-drawn yellow highlight. Below the headings, add a smaller black Japanese subheading: "注册因证证信息の新しい取扱い" (New Registration Reason Proof Information). Below the subheading, place a centered thin horizontal line. On the far right edge, add a tall, vertical yellow sidebar with the black vertical text "01表紙" (Form Paper). Near the top right corner, place a small black square as a decorative element. In the lower right quadrant, place a 5x5 dot matrix decoration consisting of 25 small black dots. At the far left edge, crop an oversized black Japanese character, making it only partially visible to create a strong graphic border effect. In the lower left corner, place a line of small black Japanese text: “Ministry of Justice Civil 2 No. 1578, December 9, Reiwa 7”. In the lower right corner, right-align two lines of small black Japanese text: the first line “Judicial Scribe Office Ann Road Design Work Shop”, the second line “Judicial Scribe Asano Yuki”. Add a thin diagonal line cutting in from the upper left corner as additional graphic decoration. Overall feel: High-end business presentation, legal seminar title slides, Swiss-style grid layout, bold Japanese typography, clear and print-quality.

templates.title: Japanese-style watercolor fashion magazine cover

titleLocalized.zh: 日系水色时尚杂志封面

templates.prompt: This is an exquisite illustration for a Japanese fashion magazine cover, employing an elegant and modern editorial style with a vertical full-page composition. The cover title is a large, light blue serif font, "AURA," spanning the top. In the upper right corner, there are four stacked lines of issue details: "6," "June 2025," "No. 126," and a label with a small square, "AURA," followed by the price line "Special Price ¥980." The background is a bright, pale blue sky dotted with soft white clouds. At the center of the image is a half-length portrait of a neutral, ethereal young model, wearing a sharply tailored white suit jacket with delicate gold trim, a white shirt, and a vibrant light blue vest or tie layer, adorned with a jewel-like star-shaped brooch at the collar. The character has very long, layered hair that flows in the wind, and the hair color is {argument name="hair color" default="Ice white with a light blue tint"} Her glossy hair cascaded over her shoulders, and her skin was fair and radiant. Most of her face was obscured by a centrally located rectangular masking block, a soft gradient from grayish-blue to pale pink, covering her eyes, nose, and upper cheeks; the lower half of her face revealed soft lips and a delicate chin. One hand was raised near her lips, posing in a thoughtful, fashionable portrait style. The portrait utilizes delicate anime-style lines, light lighting, semi-transparent highlights, and luxurious makeup editing effects. Add 3 Japanese cover introductions to the left column, with cyan titles and smaller black text: the first one is "Transparent Feeling をまとうEarly Summer のスキンケア" with 2 lines of small text below; the second one is "Good Impression をつくる快やかカラー Technique" with 2 lines below it Line small print; the third article is "プロが教える美しい髪のconditions", with 2 lines of small print below. Add a cyan round badge on the right side with 4 lines of white text: "Special Interview", "风と光と," "自分らしさと." and "ソラが语る日とesthetics". At the bottom center, place a small italicized line of English text: "Cover & Special Feature." Above this is a large Japanese main title: "ソラ、という名の透明感。" (Sora, toiu-name no transparent feeling). The first word is in cyan, and the rest are in black. Add two smaller Japanese subtitles below. Along the bottom edge, create three special previews, each with light-colored italicized English category labels and Japanese text below: "Fashion" on the left, "Beauty" in the middle, and "Trend" on the right, each with two short lines of Japanese text. Overall atmosphere: a serene, luxurious, light, and refreshing early summer beauty and fashion cover, using a unified light cyan and white color scheme.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的日系时尚杂志封面插图，采用优雅的现代编辑风格，垂直全页构图。封面标题为巨大的青色衬线字体“AURA”，横跨顶部。在右上角，包含 4 行堆叠的期刊详情：“6”、“June 2025”、“No.126”，以及一个带有小方框的标签“アウラ”，随后是价格行“特別定価 ¥980”。背景为明亮的淡蓝色天空，点缀着柔和的白云。画面中心为一位中性、空灵的年轻模特半身像，身穿剪裁利落的白色西装外套，配有精致的金色滚边、白色衬衫、鲜艳的水青色马甲或领带层，领口处佩戴一枚如宝石般的星形胸针。角色拥有非常长的层次感秀发，随风飘动，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="冰白色带淡水青色调"}，光泽发丝垂落在肩头，皮肤白皙透亮。面部大部分被居中的矩形遮挡块遮住，遮挡块呈柔和的灰蓝色至淡粉色渐变，覆盖了眼睛、鼻子和上脸颊；可见的下半脸呈现出柔和的嘴唇和精致的下巴。一只手抬起靠近嘴唇，呈现出深思熟虑的时尚肖像姿势。使用细腻的动漫风格线条、轻盈的布光、半透明高光以及奢华的美妆编辑渲染效果。在左侧栏添加 3 条日文封面简介，配以青色标题和较小的黑色正文：第一条为“透明感をまとう 初夏のスキンケア”，下方附带 2 行小字；第二条为“好印象をつくる 爽やかカラー術”，下方附带 2 行小字；第三条为“プロが教える 美しい髪の条件”，下方附带 2 行小字。在右侧添加一个青色圆形徽章，内含 4 行白色文字：“Special Interview”、“風と光と、”、“自分らしさと。”以及“ソラが語る 日常と美学”。在下方居中位置，放置一行小的斜体英文“Cover & Special Feature”，上方为巨大的日文主标题“ソラ、という名の透明感。”，其中第一个词为青色，其余为黑色。下方添加 2 行较小的日文副标题。沿底部边缘，创建 3 个专题预告，配以淡色斜体英文分类标签和下方的日文文案：左侧标签“Fashion”，中间标签“Beauty”，右侧标签“Trend”，每项各配 2 行简短的日文。整体氛围：宁静、奢华、轻盈、清爽的初夏美妆时尚封面，采用统一的水青色与白色配色设计。

templates.title: Dark fantasy stage play poster

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑幻想风舞台剧海报

templates.prompt: A dramatically compelling vertical poster for a Japanese stage play, employing a luxurious, dark fantasy anime style. The image centers on a half-length portrait of a young, androgynous actor against a backdrop of a nighttime city skyline with luminous skyscrapers and soft bokeh lighting. The character has long, flowing, jet-black hair with vibrant green highlights and undertones, its glossy strands cascading over his shoulders. He wears an elegant black turtleneck with a delicate brocade texture, paired with a fitted dark coat, black leather gloves, and a diamond-shaped green gemstone pendant set in opulent gold jewelry around his throat. One gloved hand is raised near his collar, striking a graceful theatrical pose. The overall atmosphere is mysterious, romantic, and slightly gothic, with cinematic contour lighting in the backlit areas, creating strong contrasts and punctuated by golden sparkles, making the hair and clothing shimmer. The sophisticated magazine-quality main visual composition, complemented by decorative gold filigree edges, presents a high-end stage play poster layout. Space is reserved to incorporate Japanese typography: The small text in the upper right corner reads "The only star shines in the night sky.", and below it are the names of the lead actors and their names.{argument name="character name" default="Yono Sora"} ", with the small romanized word "SORA YORUNO" at the bottom; the vertically typed quotation "このserviceに、すべてをholdingげる" is printed vertically on the left. Dark さえ, love に変えてみせよう. "; The lower middle part is in small letters "Fantasy ロマン・ステージ", and the top is a huge golden luminous title "{argument name="title text" default="Light trapped in a cage of night"} Below this is a subtitle: "—Even so, I loved you." A dark blue rose pattern and a thorn ring decoration are added near the title. The bottom left corner includes the date "2025 6.20 FRI - 6.29 SUN" and the performance venue "Tenkyo Shore." The bottom right corner includes a bordered ticketing information section: "Ticket general release 5.10 SAT 10:00~." The bottom center lists the production staff: "Original work/script by Mio Kiritsuki," "Director by Tsubasa Nanami," and "Music by Kanade Mizuki." At the very bottom is the promotional tagline: "—Light or darkness—. ​​Love chooses its destiny." —". Color scheme: Midnight blue, black, cyan, fluorescent cyan, and antique gold. Emphasizing sophisticated poster layout, depth, an elegant fantasy theatrical brand feel, and a unified facial feature and atmosphere suitable for stage play promotional activities.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧张力的日式舞台剧竖版海报，采用奢华的暗黑幻想动漫风格。画面中心为一位中性风年轻演员的半身肖像，背景是带有发光高层建筑与柔和散景灯光的夜间城市天际线。角色留着一头顺滑的长发，发色深黑，内层带有鲜艳的青绿光泽与挑染，发丝光泽感强，垂落在肩头。身着优雅的黑色高领服装，带有细腻的锦缎纹理，搭配修身深色外套、黑色皮手套，喉间佩戴着一颗镶嵌在华丽金饰中的菱形青绿色宝石吊坠。一只戴着手套的手抬至领口附近，呈现出优雅的舞台剧姿态。整体氛围神秘、浪漫且略带哥特感，背光处带有电影质感的轮廓光，对比强烈，点缀着金色火花，发丝与服装上的光效熠熠生辉。采用精致的杂志级主视觉构图，配以装饰性的金色花丝边角，呈现高端舞台剧海报布局。预留空间以融入日文排版：右上角小字“夜空に輝く、唯一の星。”，下方为“主演俳優”及演员姓名“{argument name="character name" default="夜乃 宙"}”，下方附带小字罗马音“SORA YORUNO”；左侧垂直排版引语“この役に、すべてを捧げる。闇さえ、愛に変えてみせよう。”；中下部为小字“幻想ロマン・ステージ”，上方为巨大的金色发光标题“{argument name="title text" default="夜の檻に囚われた光"}”，下方附带小标题“—それでも、君を愛した。”；标题附近加入深青色玫瑰图案与荆棘环形装饰。左下角添加日期栏“2025 6.20 FRI - 6.29 SUN”及演出地点“天穹シアター”。右下角添加带边框的票务信息栏“チケット一般発売 5.10 SAT 10:00~”。底部居中处标注制作人员名单：“原作・脚本 霧月 澪”、“演出 七海 翼”、“音楽 深月 奏”。最底部添加宣传语“—光か、闇か——。愛が、運命を選ぶ。—”。配色方案：午夜蓝、黑色、青色、青色荧光及古董金。强调精致的海报排版、层次深度、优雅的幻想戏剧品牌感，以及适合舞台剧宣传活动的统一面部特征与氛围。

promptLocalized.zh: {"type":"四季对比风景拼贴","subject":"同一日本山间温泉小镇街道与河流的四季景象","setting":{"location":"传统的日本河畔温泉小镇","features":["清澈的浅河，可见河底岩石","横跨河流的小型拱形人行桥","铺设石板的河畔步道，配有黑色木质栏杆","右侧为多层木质日式旅馆，透出温暖的室内灯光","背景为森林覆盖的山脉","村庄建筑向山谷延伸"]},"layout":{"format":"2x2 网格拼贴","sections":[{"title":"春","position":"左上","count":1,"labels":["春季"]},{"title":"夏","position":"右上","count":1,"labels":["夏季"]},{"title":"秋","position":"左下","count":1,"labels":["秋季"]},{"title":"冬","position":"右下","count":1,"labels":["冬季"]}],"consistency":"4 个面板的摄像机角度和构图完全一致"},"seasonal_variants":{"count":4,"items":[{"season":"春","trees":"左侧拱起盛开的淡粉色樱花","ground":"干燥的石板路，洒满春日斑驳的光影","atmosphere":"清新、柔和、温和的日光"},{"season":"夏","trees":"茂密生动的绿色枝叶，营造出凉爽的树荫","ground":"阳光照射与阴影交织的石板路","atmosphere":"明亮晴朗的夏日，植被繁茂"},{"season":"秋","trees":"绚丽的红、橙、金三色枫叶","ground":"步道上铺满温暖的琥珀色光芒","atmosphere":"山坡上色彩鲜明的秋景"},{"season":"冬","trees":"光秃的树枝，树木、桥梁、屋顶和栏杆上覆盖着厚厚的积雪","ground":"积雪的河畔小径","atmosphere":"阴天多雪，飘着雪花，带着寒冷的雾气"}]},"human_elements":{"count":4,"description":"每个面板左侧河畔步道上有少量行人，比例自然，作为风景的陪衬"},"signage":{"count":1,"description":"右侧河岸旅馆附近有一块带有日文汉字的竖立石碑"},"style":{"look":"高度细节化的写实旅游摄影","lighting":"自然的季节性光照，电影感，水中真实的倒影","composition":"宽阔的风景视野，步道和桥梁形成引导线，建筑与自然平衡","quality":"超高细节，纹理清晰，逼真的水面、植被、木材、石材和积雪"},"prompt":"创建一个 2x2 的写实对比图像，展示 {argument name=\"location\" default=\"一个传统的日本山间温泉小镇\"} 在四季中的景象，且视角完全相同。场景中心是一条清澈的岩石河流，有一座小型拱形人行桥，左侧是带有黑色栏杆的石板河畔步道，右侧是一座大型木质日式旅馆，窗户透出温暖的灯光。远处添加森林覆盖的山脉和零星的城镇建筑。左上角面板标注“春”，展示樱花盛开的春季；右上角面板标注“夏”，展示郁郁葱葱的夏季绿植；左下角面板标注“秋”，展示鲜艳的红橙色秋叶；右下角面板标注“冬”，展示积雪的冬季树木、桥梁、屋顶和飘落的雪花。在每个面板的左侧步道上加入少量行人。在每个面板的左上角用白色添加季节汉字。强调真实的季节变化，同时保持所有四个面板的建筑、取景和透视完全一致。"}

templates.title: Sunny street scene of Japanese cafes

titleLocalized.zh: 阳光明媚的日本咖啡馆街景

templates.prompt: A bright, hyper-realistic depiction of a Japanese summer street scene, shot from pedestrian level, showcases a wide, clean city sidewalk flanked by dappled sunlight filtering through the trees. The scene presents a modern mixed-use neighborhood on a sunny summer day. On the right is a contemporary café or restaurant with tall floor-to-ceiling windows, dark-framed windows, a stone facade, and a warm-toned wooden ceiling extending to the terrace. Three large beige parasols stand outside the café, beneath which wooden tables and chairs are arranged. Pedestrians move about in an orderly fashion on the sidewalk, with about 14 people scattered in the distance, most dressed in light-colored summer business casual attire, primarily in white, beige, navy blue, and gray. In the foreground center, a cyclist is added with their back to the camera, wearing a short-sleeved white shirt and dark trousers, carrying a shoulder bag. In the foreground on the right, two women are added with their backs to the camera: one wears a white shirt and a long dark floral skirt, holding a round fan; the other wears a white top and a light-colored patterned skirt, carrying a bag. Add two eye-catching freestanding signs outside the café: one a vertical banner with the striking Japanese character "氷" (ice) and an ice-blue graphic; the other a freestanding folding sign with the Japanese phrase "Summer Limited Cold Drink," accompanied by images of two cold drinks: a dark iced beverage and a light lemonade-like drink. On the left, showcase a quiet street with a few vehicles, benches, low concrete flowerbeds, and neatly trimmed shrubs in the distance. The composition should emphasize depth, creating a long vanishing point through the tree-lined avenue, showcasing the bright midday sun, realistic reflections in the windows, and an upscale, tranquil urban atmosphere. Photorealistic architectural photography, natural colors, high detail, wide-angle lens, deep focus.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张明亮、超写实的日本夏季街景，以行人视角的水平高度拍摄，展现了一条宽阔整洁的城市人行道，两侧绿树成荫，投下斑驳的树影。场景呈现了一个晴朗夏日里的现代综合用途街区，右侧是一家现代风格的咖啡馆或餐厅，配有高大的落地玻璃窗、深色边框、石材外立面，以及延伸至露台上方的暖色木质吊顶。在咖啡馆外放置 3 把大型米色遮阳伞，下方摆放着木质桌椅。人行道上行人往来有序，约有 14 名行人分布在远处，大多数人穿着浅色夏季商务休闲装，色调以白色、米色、海军蓝和灰色为主。在画面中心前景处，加入 1 名骑自行车的行人背对镜头，身穿短袖白衬衫和深色长裤，背着单肩包。在右侧前景处，加入 2 名背对镜头的女性，一人身穿白色衬衫和深色长碎花裙，手持圆扇；另一人身穿白色上衣和浅色花纹裙，提着包。在咖啡馆外添加 2 个显眼的立式招牌：一个是带有醒目日文“氷”字和冰蓝色图形的竖幅旗帜，另一个是写有日文“夏季限定 冷たいドリンク”的立式折叠招牌，并配有 2 款冷饮的图片，分别为一杯深色冰饮和一杯浅色柠檬水状饮料。在左侧，展示一条安静的街道，远处有少量车辆、长椅、低矮的混凝土花坛和修剪整齐的灌木。构图应强调纵深感，通过林荫大道形成长远的消失点，呈现正午明媚的阳光、窗户上真实的倒影，以及高端、宁静的城市氛围。照片级建筑摄影，自然色彩，高细节，广角镜头，深焦。

templates.title: Aerial view of a modern transportation hub

titleLocalized.zh: 现代交通枢纽鸟瞰图

templates.prompt: A drone aerial photograph, taken from above, showcases a modern transportation hub in a densely populated mixed-use urban area, rendered with realistic architectural detail in the clear evening sunlight. At the center of the scene is a large multi-track train station diagonally across the frame, showing six tracks, two long-distance passenger trains stopped at the platforms, and the station hall with a glass roof above. A wide pedestrian bridge spans the tracks from left to right, connecting the plazas on either side. Below, a bus hub is visible, with seven buses parked or moving through winding lanes and marked parking spaces. The station is surrounded by tall modern residential buildings, mid- to high-rise office buildings, retail stores, tree-lined streets, bike paths, sidewalks, parked vehicles, and scattered pedestrians. To the left is a striking glass office building with a green roof and a clearly visible corporate logo.{argument name="building sign text" default="innovation"} Add multiple green roofs and rooftop solar panels, especially on the building in the lower right corner. The composition should present a clean, realistic North American transit-oriented development style, using a slanted, bird's-eye view, with extremely high detail, natural colors, sharp focus, and professional urban planning photography standards, without any artistic manipulation.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张从高空俯瞰的无人机航拍照片，展示了密集混合用途城市区域中的现代交通枢纽，在清澈的傍晚阳光下拍摄，呈现出逼真的建筑细节。场景中心是一座斜穿画面的大型多轨道火车站，可见 6 条铁轨、2 列停靠在站台的长途客运列车，以及中上方带有玻璃顶棚的车站大厅。一座宽阔的人行天桥从左至右横跨铁轨，连接两侧的广场。中下方是一个公交枢纽，可见 7 辆公交车停靠或穿行于弯曲的车道和标线泊位中。车站周围环绕着高大的现代住宅楼、中高层办公楼、零售店面、绿树成荫的街道、自行车道、人行道、停放的车辆以及三三两两的行人。左侧包含一栋醒目的玻璃办公大楼，楼顶设有绿化，并带有清晰的企业标志，文字为 {argument name="building sign text" default="innovation"}。增加多个绿色屋顶和屋顶太阳能电池板，特别是在右下方的建筑上。构图应呈现出整洁、写实的北美以公共交通为导向的开发项目风格，采用斜向鸟瞰视角，超高细节，色彩自然，对焦清晰，具备专业城市规划摄影水准，无艺术化处理。

templates.title: Cyberpunk Pink Mecha Angel Girl

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克粉色机甲天使少女

templates.prompt: A dynamic anime cyberpunk action illustration featuring a protagonist with {argument name="hair color" default="Bright pink"} A young female cyborg with twin ponytails floats in a vast, futuristic neon-lit city shaft, surrounded by glowing circuits, holographic reflections, and dense sci-fi architecture. Presented from an extreme perspective, one massive mechanical hand extends forward, pointing directly at the camera, fingers outstretched with long, glossy claws at the tips; the other mechanical arm is bent backward in an attack stance. Her expression is fierce and focused, with glowing green eyes, small, glossy black-magenta horn-like appendages implanted in her head, and long hair flowing in all directions. Her body is encased in a highly detailed reflective chrome alloy and magenta mechanical exoskeleton, featuring a translucent breastplate, segmented armored shoulders, mechanical gauntlets, exposed joint details, thigh armor, and blade-like calf armor. Behind her, two enormous wings of radiant energy, composed of pink crystalline currents and particle streams, burst outward symmetrically. The environment is a vertical futuristic corridor or megacity canyon, filled with layered glass panels, glowing signs, and metal frames, with blue and cyan lights interwoven with dominant bright pink lighting, accompanied by countless sparkling particles, lens flares, and high-density detail. It employs dramatic low-angle compositions, centered characters, aggressive attack stances, glossy surfaces, strong mirror highlights, saturated magenta and cyan color palettes, a cinematic sci-fi atmosphere, ultra-detailed anime rendering, sharp lines, and a strong sense of speed, power, and stunning visual density.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张动态的动漫赛博朋克动作插画，主角是一位留着 {argument name="hair color" default="亮粉色"} 双马尾的年轻女性半机械人，悬浮在广阔的未来主义霓虹城市竖井中，周围充满了发光的电路、全息反射和密集的科幻建筑。她以极端的透视角度呈现，一只巨大的机械手向前伸出，直冲镜头，手指张开，指尖带有修长的光泽利爪，另一只机械手臂则向后弯曲呈攻击姿态。她表情凶狠专注，拥有发光的绿色双眼，头部植入了小型光泽黑洋红色角状物，长发向四面八方飘散。她的身体包裹在高度精细的反射式铬合金与洋红色机械外骨骼中，配有半透明胸甲、分段式装甲肩部、机械护手、裸露的关节细节、大腿装甲以及刀刃状的小腿装甲。在她身后，两对巨大的辐射能量翅膀由粉色结晶电流和粒子流组成，呈对称状向外爆发。环境是一个垂直的未来主义走廊或超级城市峡谷，布满了分层玻璃面板、发光标牌、金属框架，蓝色和青色灯光与主导的亮粉色照明交织，伴随无数火花般的粒子、镜头光晕和高密度的细节。采用戏剧性的低角度构图、居中角色、激进的攻击姿态、光泽表面、强烈的镜面高光、饱和的洋红色与青色调色板、电影级科幻氛围、超精细动漫渲染、锐利的线条，以及强烈的速度感、力量感和令人震撼的视觉密度。

templates.title: Japanese hospital comedy DVD cover

titleLocalized.zh: 日本医院喜剧 DVD 封面

templates.prompt: This is a realistic Japanese DVD cover, designed like those for commercial live-action comedy thrillers. The vertical composition and glossy retail packaging give it a premium feel. The cover depicts the interior of a hospital ward with soft beige walls, curtains on the right, and subtle medical equipment in the background. In the foreground, a young Japanese woman in a loose light blue hospital gown sits on a bed, looking confused and helpless. Around her stand three young Japanese female medical staff: two nurses in light pink uniforms, caps, and name tags, and a doctor in a white coat with a stethoscope. Each of the three standing women holds a smartphone, pointing it at the camera. The screen displays the seated woman's face or body, as if her consciousness has been transferred into the device, creating a "body hijacking" theme. The overall tone is playful, absurd, and slightly eerie, similar to DVD covers for Japanese idol films or hospital comedies. It features sophisticated magazine-quality typography, prominent Japanese text, and vibrant, trendy graphics. At the very top, on the left, is a small blue publisher logo with the text:{argument name="studio name" default="DRILL PRESENTS"} It also features a heart-shaped icon and a blue DVD VIDEO logo in the upper right corner. At the top center, a pink Japanese banner reads "Latest Series!". Below is a large, rounded, glossy, and bubbly pink and blue Japanese main title:{argument name="main title" default="ボディジャック"} Below the title, add a pink Japanese subtitle:{argument name="subtitle" default="~My body has been taken over~"} Add three manga-style speech bubbles near the characters above: one that reads "あなたのカラダ、私たちが使わせてもらうわね", one that reads "これで私たちの思い通り♡", and a yellow startled reaction bubble next to the seated woman that reads "?!". On the left spine area, create a white vertical bar with the title and subtitle repeated in blue and pink Japanese, accompanied by a small pink round label that reads "New Work". At the center of the bottom, there is an eye-catching slogan in Japanese, using a mix of pink, blue, white and yellow with an outline: "人気アイドルのカラダとsoulをめぐる,ドタバタ Hospitalコメディ!", surrounded by small stars and heart-shaped graffiti. In the lower right corner, add a blue circular blast box with yellow and white Japanese text: "Laughing っ て, ドキドキ! 悪ノリ NOTE の Hospital multiply っ take り大作戦♡". Along the bottom edge are four small rectangular preview stills from the film, each bordered like a DVD scene thumbnail, showcasing the same group of hospital characters in different poses. Below each thumbnail is a brief Japanese description, including lines like “計画はバッチリ！”, “え…どういうこと…？”, “さあ、始めましょうか♡”, and “助けて…私のカラダ…！”. At the bottom left edge, in black text, is the DVD packaging metadata, such as the catalog number “DBJ-002,” runtime “120min.”, “COLOR,” and price “¥3,980 (excluding tax),” accompanied by a small blue and pink DRILL logo. The bright, retail-quality composition, realistic character portrayals, and commercial Japanese film cover aesthetics are present, with a slightly exaggerated style, high resolution, and clear printing.

promptLocalized.zh: 一款写实风格的日本 DVD 封面，采用商业真人喜剧惊悚片的包装设计，垂直构图，具有光面零售包装质感。封面展示了一个医院病房内部，墙壁为柔和的米色，右侧有窗帘，背景中有细微的医疗设施。在画面中央前景，1 位年轻日本女性身穿宽松的浅蓝色病号服坐在病床上，表情困惑且无助。她周围站着 3 位年轻的日本女性医护人员：2 位身穿淡粉色制服、佩戴护士帽和工牌的护士，以及 1 位身穿白大褂、挂着听诊器的医生。这 3 位站立的女性每人都拿着一部智能手机对准镜头，手机屏幕上显示着坐着的女性的面部或身体，仿佛她的意识被转移到了设备中，营造出一种“身体劫持”的附身主题。整体基调俏皮、荒诞且略带诡异，类似于日本偶像电影或医院喜剧的 DVD 封套。采用精致的杂志级排版，配以醒目的日文排版和色彩鲜艳的流行图形。在最顶部，左侧放置一个小巧的蓝色发行商标志，文字为 {argument name="studio name" default="DRILL PRESENTS"} 并配有一个心形图标，右上角为蓝色 DVD VIDEO 标志。在顶部中央，添加一条粉色的日文横幅，文字为“シリーズ最新作！”。下方是巨大、圆润、光泽且充满气泡感的粉蓝双色日文主标题：{argument name="main title" default="ボディジャック"}。在标题下方，添加一行粉色的日文副标题：{argument name="subtitle" default="～私のカラダ、乗っ取られました～"}。在上方角色附近添加 3 个漫画风格的对话气泡：一个写着“あなたのカラダ、私たちが使わせてもらうわね”，一个写着“これで私たちの思い通り♡”，以及坐着的女性旁边有一个黄色的惊吓反应气泡，写着“?!”。在左侧书脊区域，创建一个白色垂直条，用蓝色和粉色的日文重复标题和副标题，并附带一个写有“新作”的粉色小圆标签。在底部中央，放置一句醒目的日文宣传语，采用粉、蓝、白、黄混合配色并带有描边：“人気アイドルのカラダと魂をめぐる、ドタバタ病院コメディ！”，周围点缀着小星星和心形涂鸦。在右下角，添加一个蓝色圆形爆破框，内含黄白相间的日文文字：“笑って、ドキドキ！悪ノリ注意の病院乗っ取り大作戦♡”。沿底部边缘，包含 4 张电影的小型矩形预览剧照，每张都像 DVD 场景缩略图一样带有边框，展示了同一组医院角色在不同姿势下的画面；每张缩略图下方配有简短的日文说明，包括类似“計画はバッチリ！”、“え…どういうこと…？”、“さあ、始めましょうか♡”和“助けて…私のカラダ…！”的台词。在左下角边缘，以黑色文字包含 DVD 包装元数据，如目录编号“DBJ-002”、时长“120min.”、“COLOR”以及价格“¥3,980 (税抜)”，并附带一个蓝色与粉色相间的 DRILL 小标志。明亮的零售级构图，人物写实，具有商业日本电影封套美学，略带夸张风格，高分辨率，印刷设计清晰。

templates.title: Japanese eco-community promotional poster

titleLocalized.zh: 日本生态社区宣传海报

templates.prompt: A beautifully designed promotional poster for a Japanese community and sustainable development project. The project's name is {argument name="project name" default="セカイムラ"} The design style resembles a high-end eco-lifestyle brochure. The vertical layout is simple and elegant, using a soft beige paper background to create a bright and visionary atmosphere. The upper half features a large, semi-transparent globe at the center of the composition, with warm sunrise light emanating from the upper right. Inside the globe, a stunning aerial view of a green valley leads to a tranquil blue bay or lake, dotted with villages and farmland below, creating a cinematic and utopian feel. Above the globe, a smaller Japanese slogan is placed.{argument name="tagline text" default="The world will become one village."} Below is the main title in bold, dark navy blue Japanese calligraphy font:{argument name="main title text" default="セカイムラ"} Around a globe, collage eight everyday photographs seamlessly integrated into the landscape: 1) Top left: Two people talking outdoors under a tree; 2) Top left: Several people working together in a rice paddy; 3) Center left: People sitting around a rustic wooden structure at night; 4) Bottom left: Portrait of two people in a natural environment; 5) Top right: A group of people dining at a long table under warm indoor lighting; 6) Center right: One person tending to plants or crops; 7) Bottom right: People holding hands in a line on a ridge at sunset; 8) Bottom right: Close-up portrait of one person eating or holding food. The photographic style should evoke a sense of humanity and community, with a touch of idealism, soft depth of field, natural skin tones, golden hour highlights, and a smooth, poster-like composite effect. The lower half contains three evenly spaced feature cards on a light beige background, separated by subtle vertical dividing lines. The first card on the left, titled "Sekaimura New Moon Party" in dark blue, features a photo of a bonfire circle at night and a brief Japanese description. The second card in the middle, titled "Sekaimura Full Moon Party" in warm gold, features a circular photo of an indoor evening gathering under string lights, surrounded by decorative radiating sunlight, and a brief Japanese description below. The third card on the right, titled "Sekaimura Rice Bowl ga Ima no Ipshi" in green, features a small illustration of rice seedlings next to the title, a circular photo of a bowl of white rice, and a brief Japanese description. Below these cards, a centered line of dark blue Japanese text is added:{argument name="footer slogan" default="Together, we will create a future where people, nature, and culture are connected and harmoniously interconnected."} . Below this, 4 small icons and text items are arranged horizontally, each icon is equipped with a simple thin line icon and two lines of Japanese labels: 1) The character icon is equipped with "つながる中间と出会える"; 2) The house icon is equipped with "まなぶ木らしを学べる"; 3) The sprout icon is matched with "つくる富につくる"; 4) The earth icon is matched with "ひろがる世界にひろげる". The bottom center contains a circular logo, followed by the Japanese project name, and below it is the website URL:{argument name="website URL" default="www.sekaimura.com"} A small QR code is added to the bottom right corner, along with tiny Japanese instructions suggesting details can be found on the website. A sophisticated color scheme of deep navy blue, forest green, gold, beige, and sky blue is used. Overall style: high-end Japanese non-profit organization poster, eco-community branding design, inspiring, harmonious, realistic collage with subtle graphic design elements, balanced typography, soft lighting, and magazine-quality printing.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精美的日本社区与可持续发展项目宣传海报，项目名称为 {argument name="project name" default="セカイムラ"}，设计风格如同高端生态生活方式宣传单。垂直布局，简洁优雅，采用柔和的米色纸张背景，营造出明亮且充满愿景的氛围。上半部分以构图中心的一个巨大半透明地球仪为主体，右上方散发出温暖的日出光芒。地球仪内部呈现出一幅令人惊叹的绿色山谷航拍景观，山谷通向宁静的蓝色海湾或湖泊，下方点缀着村庄和农田，极具电影感和乌托邦色彩。在地球仪上方，放置一行较小的日文标语 {argument name="tagline text" default="世界は1つの村になる。"}，下方是加粗的深海军蓝日文书法字体主标题：{argument name="main title text" default="セカイムラ"}。围绕地球仪，拼贴 8 张自然融入边缘的生活照：1) 左上，两人在树下户外交谈；2) 左中上，几人在稻田里共同劳作；3) 左中，夜晚在质朴木结构建筑内围坐；4) 左下，自然环境中的两人肖像；5) 右上，一群人在温暖的室内灯光下长桌聚餐；6) 右中，一人在照料植物或农作物；7) 右中下，夕阳下人们在山脊上牵手排成一列；8) 右下，一人正在进食或手持食物的特写肖像。摄影风格应体现人文感、社区感，略带理想化，具有柔和的景深、自然的肤色、黄金时刻的高光以及平滑的广告海报合成效果。下半部分在浅米色背景上包含 3 张间距均匀的功能卡片，由细微的垂直分隔线隔开。左侧卡片 1 标题为深蓝色的“セカイムラ 新月会”，配有夜间篝火圆圈照片及一段简短的日文描述文本。中间卡片 2 标题为暖金色的“セカイムラ 満月会”，配有灯串下室内晚间聚会的圆形照片，圆圈周围有装饰性的放射状太阳光线，下方附带简短的日文描述文本。右侧卡片 3 标题为绿色的“セカイムラ 米部が今の一押し”，标题旁有小型稻苗插画，配有一碗白米饭的圆形照片及一段简短的日文描述文本。在这些卡片下方，添加一行居中的深蓝色日文声明：{argument name="footer slogan" default="人・自然・文化がつながり、循環する未来を一緒につくる。"}。在此下方，横向排列 4 个小型图标及文字项，每个图标配有简单的细线条图标和两行日文标签：1) 人物图标配“つながる 仲間と出会える”；2) 房屋图标配“まなぶ 暮らしを学べる”；3) 新芽图标配“つくる 未来を共につくる”；4) 地球图标配“ひろがる 世界にひろげる”。最底部中心处包含一个圆形徽标，后接日文项目名称，下方为网站 URL：{argument name="website URL" default="www.sekaimura.com"}。右下角添加一个小型二维码，并附带微小的日文说明，提示详情请见网站。采用深海军蓝、森林绿、金色、米色和天蓝色的精致配色方案。整体风格：高端日本非营利组织海报、生态社区品牌设计、鼓舞人心、和谐、带有微妙图形设计元素的写实拼贴、平衡的排版、柔和的光晕以及杂志级的印刷质感。

templates.title: A comparison of the fashionable heights of four women.

titleLocalized.zh: 四位女性时尚身高对比

templates.prompt: A minimalist, high-fashion studio photograph showcases four adult East Asian women standing side-by-side against a seamless, light gray background. Full-body shots, from head to toe, are taken from the front, with soft, even lighting creating a sophisticated commercial feel. Above each woman's head, her height is clearly indicated in black serif font: 145cm, 155cm, 165cm, and 175cm. This emphasizes the realistic differences in height proportions while maintaining the women's slender, elegant, and unified style. They have long, soft, wavy hair ranging from dark brown to black and possess neutral expressions. Their faces are obscured by smooth, rectangular blurs. The four women stand close together in a friendly posture, with subtle physical contact; one woman lightly links arms with another. Their clothing features harmonious shades of beige, cream, taupe, and soft pink, paired with sophisticated, feminine casual wear and matching ivory loafers. Woman 1 (145cm): Wears a short-sleeved cream-colored ribbed knit top tucked into high-waisted light beige shorts, with a fabric belt, and carries a small chain-stitched shoulder bag. Woman 2 (155cm): Wears a white long-sleeved shirt with a bow at the collar, paired with a taupe mini skirt with a slight flare, and carries a small light beige crossbody bag. Woman 3 (165cm): Wears a sleeveless pinkish-beige ribbed knit top with a simple ivory mini skirt. Woman 4 (175cm): Wears a flowing white V-neck shirt with rolled-up sleeves, paired with high-waisted taupe belted shorts, and carries a medium-sized taupe shoulder bag. All four women wear cream or ivory horsebit loafers. The composition is vertical, centered, minimalist, fashionable, and realistic, like a fashion catalog image comparing women's heights.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张简洁的时尚对比摄影棚照片，展示 4 位成年东亚女性并排站在浅灰色无缝背景前，全身可见，从头部到鞋子，采用正面拍摄，光线柔和均匀，呈现出精致的商业质感。在每位女性头顶正上方，用黑色衬线字体标注身高，文字需完全一致：145cm、155cm、165cm、175cm。强调身高比例的真实差异，同时保持四位女性身材苗条、优雅且风格统一，留着深棕色至黑色的柔和波浪长发，表情中性。她们的面部被平滑的矩形模糊块遮盖。四位女性站位紧凑，姿态友好，有细微的肢体接触，其中一人轻挽着另一人的手臂。服装采用米色、奶油色、灰褐色和柔粉色的协调色调，搭配干练的女性化休闲装和配套的象牙白乐福鞋。145cm 标签下的女性 1 身穿短袖奶油色罗纹针织上衣，塞进高腰浅米色短裤中，配有织物腰带，并背着一个小巧的链条绗缝单肩包。155cm 标签下的女性 2 身穿白色长袖衬衫，领口系蝴蝶结，搭配灰褐色迷你裙，裙摆微张，背着一个小巧的浅米色斜挎包。165cm 标签下的女性 3 身穿无袖粉米色罗纹针织上衣，搭配简约的象牙白迷你裙。175cm 标签下的女性 4 身穿垂坠感白色 V 领衬衫，袖子卷至前臂，搭配高腰灰褐色腰带短裤，背着一个中号灰褐色单肩包。4 位女性均穿着奶油色或象牙白马衔扣乐福鞋。构图垂直、居中、极简、时尚、写实，如同对比女性身高的时尚目录图片。

templates.title: First-person view of a mirrored bedroom photo

titleLocalized.zh: 第一人称镜面卧室照片

templates.prompt: A lifelike first-person perspective photograph, set in a minimalist bedroom with soft nighttime lighting, as if the viewer is standing in front of a full-length mirror gazing at their own reflection. In the foreground, long, dark hair falls from the top and sides of the image, partially obscuring the viewer's vision; a hand is raised near the left side of the face, as if touching the cheek or hair. In the mirror's reflection, a person with {argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown"} A young woman with long, straight hair is positioned in the center of the image, wearing a loose-fitting ivory or off-white long-sleeved nightgown with delicate tiny floral patterns and wide sleeves. She poses shyly, her hands supporting her chin, elbows tucked in, creating a soft, intimate, and slightly bashful atmosphere. Her face is hidden or obscured, creating a sense of anonymous self-portrait. A mirror with a simple white frame sits on a white dressing table. The background reflected in the mirror is a neatly arranged warm beige bedroom, containing a slightly messy bed with white sheets, a small wooden bedside table or low shelf, a warm-light table lamp with a square white lampshade, and two small decorative items beside the lamp. To the right of the dressing table are two transparent skincare or cosmetic bottles and a small round white container. It employs warm ambient lighting, creamy neutral tones, shallow depth of field, soft realism, smartphone photography composition, comfortable Japanese apartment aesthetics, and a casual home atmosphere, while retaining subtle imperfections rather than studio-quality retouching.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张逼真的第一人称视角照片，场景设定在夜晚光线柔和的极简主义卧室中，仿佛观看者正站在落地镜前注视着自己的倒影。前景中，长长的深色发丝从画面顶部和两侧垂下，部分遮挡了视线；一只手抬起靠近脸部左侧，仿佛正在触碰脸颊或头发。在镜中倒影里，一位留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 直长发的年轻女性位于画面中心，身穿一件宽松的象牙白或米白色长袖睡衣，睡衣带有精致的微小花卉纹理，袖口宽大。她害羞地摆出姿势，双手托在下巴下方，手肘内收，营造出一种柔和、亲密且略带羞涩的氛围。她的面部被隐藏或遮挡，营造出一种匿名视角的自拍感。镜子配有简约的白色边框，放置在白色的梳妆台面上。镜中映出的背景是一个布置整洁的暖米色卧室，内有 1 张铺着白色床品的凌乱床铺、1 个小型木制床头柜或矮架、1 盏带有方形白色灯罩的暖光台灯，以及台灯旁 2 个微小的装饰物。梳妆台右侧放有 2 个透明护肤品或化妆品瓶和 1 个小型圆形白色容器。采用温暖的环境光、奶油色中性色调、浅景深、柔和的写实感、智能手机摄影构图、舒适的日式公寓美学、随性的家居氛围，并保留微妙的瑕疵而非影棚级的精修质感。
