templates.title: One Piece manga color cover

titleLocalized.zh: 《海贼王》漫画彩色封面

templates.prompt: A simple manga coloring test page, adopting the style of official One Piece chapter covers, with a light gray background. At the top is a large black and white ONE PIECE logo, featuring a skull wearing a yellow straw hat with red stripes and incorporating rope elements, with silhouettes inside the letters. Below the logo, centered, is the subtitle text.{argument name="chapter title" default="Episode 1177: Anger"} Use bold black serif italics. Below, create a large, full-color illustration surrounded by a thin black border. The scene features Nico Robin, a woman with long, straight hair.{argument name="hair color" default="black"} A young woman with fair skin and white hair sits curled up in a garden, planting flowers. Her face is partially obscured by a soft, rectangular blur. She wears a loose white short-sleeved shirt and black and white striped knee-high socks, looking casual and slightly playful. Around her are three miniature One Piece characters helping or watching: on the left is Tony Tony Chopper, wearing a straw hat and blue overalls, holding a small shovel beside freshly dug soil; in the foreground on the right is another chibi-style Chopper, wearing a yellow round earmuff and blue hat with the word "MOGO" on it, and pink shorts, his body slightly turned away; near the center left foreground, a miniature assistant wearing goggles and a hat stands beside a flower bed. The garden is whimsical, like something out of a fairy tale: on the left is a towering ancient tree with a thick, twisted trunk; behind the flower bed is a row of white pointed fences; on the right is a crooked, cozy little house with a blue fan-shaped roof, dormer windows, flower boxes, and a round wooden door. The sky was a clear blue, dotted with a few fluffy white clouds. In the flowerbed, three clusters of flowers were displayed: Robin held a cluster of pink blossoms, to her right a cluster of white flowers, and further to her right an orange cluster. Several dug holes were visible in the brown soil, and in the foreground were fallen tree stumps. A title bar was overlaid at the bottom of the illustration, using a capital serif font:{argument name="caption text" default="A reader's letter: "Robin is planting flowers in the flowerbed dug by the mole" — Mrs. Fuji"} Below the image, place a bold, black line indicating the production staff, centered.{argument name="author text" default="Author: Eiichiro Oda"} Below is a line of smaller text{argument name="credit line" default="Translation: STEPHEN PAUL • Subtitles: VANESSA SATONE"} Using clear comic book ink lines, paired with vibrant hand-drawn coloring and slightly textured shadows, it presents an authentic color comic book cover aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张简洁的漫画上色测试页，采用官方《海贼王》章节封面的风格，背景为浅灰色。在最上方，放置巨大的黑白 ONE PIECE Logo，其中骷髅头戴着带有红色条纹的黄色草帽，并融入绳索元素，字母内部带有剪影。在 Logo 正下方，居中添加副标题文本 {argument name="chapter title" default="第 1177 话：愤怒"}，使用加粗的黑色衬线斜体。下方创建一个由细黑边框包围的大型全彩插图。场景展示了妮可·罗宾，一位留着长直 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"} 头发、皮肤白皙的年轻女性，她蜷膝坐在花园里种花。她的脸部被一个柔和的矩形模糊遮挡块遮住。她穿着一件宽松的白色短袖衬衫和黑白横条纹过膝袜，看起来休闲且略带俏皮。她周围有 3 个正在帮忙或观看的小型《海贼王》角色：左侧是戴着草帽、穿着蓝色背带裤的托尼托尼·乔巴，正拿着小铲子在刚挖好的泥土旁；右侧前景是另一个类似 Q 版的小乔巴形象，戴着标有“MOGO”字样的黄色圆耳罩蓝色帽子，穿着粉色短裤，身体略微背对；左中前景附近，有一个戴着护目镜和帽子的微型助手站在花坛旁。花园充满奇幻色彩，宛如童话书：左侧是一棵树干粗壮扭曲的参天古树，花坛后方是一排白色尖桩篱笆，右侧是一座歪歪扭扭的舒适小屋，屋顶铺着蓝色扇形瓦片，设有老虎窗、花箱和圆形木门。天空湛蓝，飘着几朵蓬松的白云。在花坛中，展示 3 簇正在种植的鲜花：罗宾手中拿着 1 簇粉色花丛，右侧有 1 簇白色花丛，更右侧有 1 簇橙色花丛，棕色土壤上有几个挖好的坑，前景还有被砍伐的树桩。在插图底部叠加一个标题条，使用大写衬线字体：{argument name="caption text" default="读者来信：“罗宾在鼹鼠挖出的花坛里种花” —— 藤夫人"}。在图像下方，居中放置加粗的黑色制作人员行 {argument name="author text" default="作者：尾田荣一郎"}，下方是一行较小的文字 {argument name="credit line" default="翻译：STEPHEN PAUL • 字幕：VANESSA SATONE"}。使用清晰的漫画墨线勾勒，搭配鲜艳的手绘填色、略带纹理的阴影，呈现出地道的彩色漫画封面美学。

templates.title: Colored comic romantic comedy page

titleLocalized.zh: 彩色漫画浪漫喜剧页面

templates.prompt: A beautifully illustrated, full-color comic strip in a modern romantic comedy style, presented in a six-panel layout with a clear black border on a white background. The scene is set outdoors in a sunny setting, featuring a blue sky, soft clouds, shady trees, a paved path, and queuing pillars with chain railings. The protagonist is a teenage anime girl with a short, flowing blonde bob, large, golden-brown eyes, and a slight blush. She wears a cream-colored, fluffy, dog-eared hat with blue polka-dot details, a blue school uniform-style cardigan or blazer, a white shirt, and a red patterned tie, and holds a pink spiral soft serve ice cream. A boy in a dark blue sweater and a white collared shirt appears in three panels; his face is softly blurred with rectangles, and he also wears a matching dog-eared hat. The page should contain six panels: two small panels at the top, a large, wide-angle close-up panel in the middle, and three panels at the bottom. Top Left: A boy faces forward, a girl suddenly turns to him, her hair and hat fluttering in the air. The background is an outdoor scene with signs, accompanied by hand-drawn black comic book sound effects. Top Right: A chibi-style girl stands beside a chain railing, her expression a mix of smugness and panic, holding an ice cream cone. A speech bubble reads "THAT'S A LOOK OF ACCOMPLISHMENT." Small floating sound effects appear near her head. Center: A dramatic close-up portrait of a girl facing a blue sky, her hair blowing across her face, a strand brushing her lips, her earmuff hat clearly visible, her gaze calm yet astonished. A vertical speech bubble on the right contains Japanese text, accompanied by a small English sound effect saying "PLOP." Bottom Left: A boy with a blurred face is speaking, a speech bubble reading "I'VE BEEN THINKING THIS FOR A WHILE, BUT...". Bottom middle panel: A girl's profile view, one hand raised to her mouth, the other holding a pink ice cream cone, with a speech bubble reading "THANKS." Bottom right panel: A boy reaches towards the girl's mouth or cheek, as if wiping away cream, with a speech bubble reading "YOU GOT SOME CREAM OVER HERE." Incorporate all visible comic book text and sound effects into the artwork, including "WAH!", "FWSH," and English dialogue. Use exquisite comic book coloring on the ink line art: soft cel shadows, slightly textured watercolor fills, warm skin tones, glossy eyes, delicate hatching details, and expressive lines. Emphasize romantic tension, the dynamism of the wind, and the contrast between chibi-style comedic reactions and dramatic close-ups.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张采用现代浪漫喜剧风格的精美彩色漫画页面，呈现为 6 格漫画布局，白色背景上带有清晰的黑色边框。场景设定在阳光明媚的户外，背景包括蓝天、柔和的云朵、绿树成荫、铺设好的步道以及带有链条护栏的排队立柱。主角是一位十几岁的动漫少女，留着金色短波波头，发丝随风飘动，有着大大的金棕色眼睛、淡淡的红晕，表情严肃且略显尴尬。她戴着一顶带有奶油色绒毛的垂耳狗帽，帽子上有蓝色波点细节，身穿蓝色校服风格开衫或西装外套，内搭白色衬衫和红色花纹领带，手中拿着一个粉色螺旋状软冰淇淋。一名身穿深蓝色毛衣和白色翻领衬衫的少年出现在 3 个分格中，他的脸部被柔和的矩形模糊处理，同样戴着一顶配套的垂耳狗帽。页面应包含 6 个分格：顶部一行 2 个小格，中间一个横跨宽度的特写大格，底部一行 3 个分格。左上格：少年面向前方，少女猛地转向他，她的头发和帽子因动作而飘起，背景是带有指示牌的户外，并配有手绘的黑色漫画音效字。右上格：Q 版风格的少女站在链条护栏旁，表情得意又慌乱，手中拿着冰淇淋，配有气泡对话框写着“THAT'S A LOOK OF ACCOMPLISHMENT.”，头部附近有漂浮的小音效文字。中心格：少女面对蓝天的戏剧性特写肖像，头发吹过脸庞，一缕发丝掠过嘴唇，垂耳帽清晰可见，眼神平静而惊愕地注视前方；右侧包含一个垂直气泡对话框，内有日文，并配有一个写着“PLOP”的小型英文音效字。左下格：脸部模糊的少年正在说话，气泡对话框写着“I'VE BEEN THINKING THIS FOR A WHILE, BUT...”。中下格：少女侧面视角，一只手抬向嘴边，另一只手拿着粉色冰淇淋，气泡对话框写着“THANKS.”。右下格：少年伸手向少女的嘴边或脸颊，仿佛在帮她擦掉奶油，气泡对话框写着“YOU GOT SOME CREAM OVER HERE.”。请将所有可见的漫画文字和音效字融入画面中，包括“WAH!”、“FWSH”以及英文对话。在墨线稿上使用精致的漫画上色：柔和的赛璐珞阴影、略带质感的水彩填充、温暖的肤色、光泽感的眼睛、细腻的排线细节以及富有表现力的线条。强调浪漫张力、风的动感，以及 Q 版喜剧反应与细腻特写戏剧性之间的对比。

templates.title: Colorful Shonen Manga Battle Page

titleLocalized.zh: 彩色少年漫画战斗页面

templates.prompt: A full-color shonen manga action page, presented in a high-energy pirate battle manga style, this single-page comic features four clearly defined panels separated by wide white gaps and slightly slanted borders. It utilizes bold black ink lines, dense hatching, speed lines, cel-shaded coloring, dramatic perspective shortening, and exaggerated impact effects. The scene depicts a muscular, towering giant warrior with bronze skin, a horned helmet, wild black hair and beard, black fur-trimmed clothing, and a wide studded metal belt. He wields a massive, spiked wooden club and is fighting a swordsman dressed in dark blue clothing and wearing an armored headdress. The top panel features an extreme close-up shot of a massive fist swinging towards the viewer with a strong sense of perspective, the giant shouting "GUNGNIR!!!" in a jagged speech bubble, and another speech bubble reading "GWOAH!!!". Large red Japanese onomatopoeia and a small "DOOM!!" impact text are also added. The wide central panel depicts the giant swinging upwards and roaring "IKOKU SOVEREIGNTY!!!", while his blue-clad opponent on the left retreats; it includes a speech bubble that reads "GAH!", along with a large purple Japanese onomatopoeia and a small "WHONK!!". The narrow lower left panel features a cropped close-up of two stacked speech bubbles that read "THREE SWORD STYLE." and "RED OGRE…", with the speaker mostly off-screen and partially obscured. The large lower right panel shows the giant swinging a massive spiked club across the screen, delivering a powerful horizontal strike while shouting "GIANT TROMMA!!!"; it includes smaller impact speech bubbles that read "DWUAH!!!" and "THWAM!!", along with an oversized red Japanese onomatopoeia. The background is predominantly pale sky blue with strong lines of motion and flying debris. It retains the texture of a professional color weekly comic book page: saturated reds, blues, and purples, bronze skin tones, cream fur textures, black shadows, and crisp white speech bubbles with handwritten comic text.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张全彩少年漫画动作页面，采用高能海盗战斗漫画风格，呈现为单页漫画，包含 4 个清晰的分镜，分镜间由宽大的白色间隙隔开，边框略微倾斜。使用粗犷的黑色墨线、密集的排线、速度线、赛璐珞风格上色、戏剧性的透视缩短以及夸张的冲击效果。场景描绘了一位肌肉发达、身材高大的巨人战士，他拥有古铜色皮肤、带角的头盔、狂野的黑色头发和胡须、黑色毛皮镶边服装、宽大的铆钉金属腰带，手持巨大的带刺木棒，正在与一名身穿深蓝色服装、佩戴盔甲式头饰的剑士战斗。顶部面板：极端的特写镜头，巨大的拳头带着强烈的透视感向观众挥来，巨人喊着“GUNGNIR !!!”，气泡框呈锯齿状，另一个气泡框写着“GWOAH !!!”；添加巨大的红色日文拟声词和一个小的“DOOM!!”冲击文字。中间宽面板：巨人向上挥舞并咆哮着“IKOKU SOVEREIGNTY !!!”，左侧的蓝衣对手向后退缩；包含一个写着“GAH!”的气泡框，以及巨大的紫色日文拟声词和一个小的“WHONK!!”。左下窄面板：一个裁剪后的特写铺垫面板，有两个堆叠的气泡框，分别写着“THREE SWORD STYLE.”和“RED OGRE…”，说话者大部分处于画面外且部分被遮挡。右下大面板：巨人挥动巨大的带刺木棒横扫画面，进行猛烈的水平重击，大喊“GIANT TROMMA !!!”；包含较小的冲击气泡框，写着“DWUAH !!!”和“THWAM!!”，以及超大的红色日文拟声词。背景主要为淡天蓝色，带有强烈的运动线条和飞溅的碎片。保留专业彩色周刊漫画页面的质感：饱和的红色、蓝色、紫色，古铜色皮肤色调，奶油色毛皮纹理，黑色阴影，以及带有手写漫画文字的清脆白色气泡框。

templates.title: Sci-fi mech blueprint hangar

titleLocalized.zh: 科幻机甲蓝图机库

templates.prompt: A cinematic, ultra-refined nighttime interior of a sci-fi mecha hangar, presented from a slightly overhead, wide-angle perspective above a massive horizontal holographic planning table. A glowing blue tabletop dominates the foreground and center, showcasing a display labeled {argument name="mech name" default="ARGONAUT"} The complex engineering blueprints for a humanoid combat robot are displayed on a table. The blueprints include three complete large-scale orthographic projections of the mech: front, side, and rear views. There are also numerous smaller component drawings of hands, joints, feet, armor plates, and circular mechanical parts, along with dense engineering annotations, diagrams, measurement lines, and blocks of Japanese annotations interspersed with alphanumeric labels. Around the table, five engineers in light gray industrial jumpsuits are studying the design, leaning over the edge, holding sturdy tablets; their faces are deliberately blurred and partially obscured. In the background, a towering, realistic humanoid mech stands upright on a maintenance gantry, suspended or perched in a vast factory cubicle filled with walkways, scaffolding, pipes, heavy cables hanging from the ceiling, glowing control panels, glass partitions, and a few tiny, distant workers placed to emphasize the scale. The design employs a cool steel and cyan color scheme, dramatic volumetric lighting, reflective metallic surfaces, a slight fog, high-contrast shadows, and a serious military-industrial atmosphere. The environment should appear dense, realistic, and operational, like a secret, advanced robotic facility. Emphasis should be placed on scale, technological complexity, and the contrast between the flat, glowing blueprints and the massive, solid mechs in the background. Rendered in a realistic concept art style, the holographic displays feature sharp lines, cinematic depth of field, and exquisite detail.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个电影级超精细的科幻机甲机库内部夜景，采用从巨大的水平全息规划台上方略微俯视的广角视角。发光的蓝色桌面占据了前景和中心位置，展示着一个标注为 {argument name="mech name" default="ARGONAUT"} 的人形战斗机器人复杂工程蓝图。蓝图在桌面上包含 3 幅完整的大型机甲正投影图，分别为正面、侧面和背面视图，此外还有许多关于手部、关节、脚部、装甲片和圆形机械零件的较小组件图，以及密集的工程标注、图表、测量线和夹杂着字母数字标签的日文注释块。桌子周围有 5 名身穿浅灰色工业连体服的工程师正在研究设计，他们俯身在桌边，手持坚固的平板电脑；他们的面部刻意模糊且部分被遮挡。在深处的背景中，1 台高耸的真实人形机甲直立在维护龙门架上，悬挂或停靠在一个巨大的工厂隔间里，该区域布满了走道、脚手架、管道、从天花板垂下的重型电缆、发光的控制面板、玻璃隔断，以及几个为了衬托比例而设置的微小远景工人。采用冷钢色与青色的配色方案、戏剧性的体积光、反光的金属表面、轻微的雾气、高对比度的阴影以及严肃的军事工业氛围。环境应显得密集、真实且处于运作状态，如同一个秘密的高级机器人设施。强调规模感、技术复杂性，以及扁平发光蓝图与背后巨大实体机甲之间的对比。以写实概念艺术风格渲染，全息显示屏线条清晰，具有电影般的景深和极致的细节。

templates.title: Split-screen sports and leisure style sofa advertisement

titleLocalized.zh: 分屏运动休闲风沙发广告

templates.prompt: Create a simple, square, split-screen commercial image for sportswear and casual wear, requiring a refined advertising photography quality and realistic typography. At the top, place a striking, bold, white headline in heavy sans-serif font:{argument name="headline text" default="BOUGHT FOR THE GYM. USED FOR THE COUCH."} The layout is vertically divided into two equal-sized panels. The left panel displays five garments laid flat against a smooth, light gray studio background with soft directional lighting and subtle shadows: a black hoodie with a drawstring and a small white swoosh logo on the chest; a pair of black athletic shorts with a small white logo near the hem; a pair of white mid-calf socks with a black swoosh logo; and a pair of black running shoes with a white midsole and a white swoosh side label. The clothing should look high-end, minimalist, and meticulously designed like an e-commerce ad campaign. The right panel shows a young man wearing the same black hoodie, black shorts, white mid-calf socks, and black running shoes, lounging lazily on a dark charcoal gray fabric sofa in a dimly lit, comfortable living room, holding a smartphone, looking relaxed but listless. On the dark coffee table in front of him lay six visible casual items: an open pizza box containing pizza; a can of red soda; a large bag of red tortilla chips; a TV remote; a blue chip bowl; and a pink frosted donut faintly visible at the bottom edge. A gray blanket draped over the sofa maintained a humorous and relatable atmosphere. At the bottom center, a line of smaller white descriptive text in a clean sans-serif font was superimposed:{argument name="tagline text" default="Still worth it."} The advertisement features high-end product aesthetics, clear text rendering, lifestyle marketing with brand awareness, realistic materials, and balanced composition, showcasing the subtle contrast between the desire to consume fitness and the actual act of lounging on a sofa.

promptLocalized.zh: 制作一张简洁的正方形分屏运动休闲服饰商业图片，要求具备精致的广告摄影质感和逼真的排版。在顶部全宽处，放置一行醒目的粗体大写白色标题，使用厚重的无衬线字体：{argument name="headline text" default="BOUGHT FOR THE GYM. USED FOR THE COUCH."} 布局垂直分为 2 个等大的面板。左侧面板展示 5 件平铺的服装，背景为光滑的浅灰色摄影棚背景，配有柔和的定向光和细腻的阴影：1 件带抽绳的黑色连帽衫，胸前有白色小勾型标志；1 条黑色运动短裤，下摆附近有白色小标志；1 双白色中筒袜，带有黑色勾型标志；以及 1 双黑色跑鞋，配有白色中底和白色勾型侧标。服装应看起来高端、简约，并像电商广告大片一样经过精心设计。右侧面板展示一名年轻男子，身穿同样的黑色连帽衫、黑色短裤、白色中筒袜和黑色跑鞋，懒散地瘫坐在昏暗舒适客厅里的深炭灰色布艺沙发上，手里拿着智能手机，神情放松且毫无干劲。他面前的深色咖啡桌上摆放着 6 件可见的休闲物品：1 个打开的披萨盒，里面装着披萨；1 罐红色汽水；1 大袋红色玉米片；1 个电视遥控器；1 个蓝色薯片碗；以及底部边缘隐约可见的 1 个粉色糖霜撒糖甜甜圈。在沙发上加一条垂下的灰色毯子，保持幽默且具共鸣的氛围。在底部中心，叠加一行较小的白色说明文字，使用简洁的无衬线字体：{argument name="tagline text" default="Still worth it."} 高端产品广告美学，清晰的文字渲染，具备品牌意识的生活方式营销，逼真的材质，平衡的构图，展现出健身消费愿望与实际沙发瘫坐之间的微妙反差。

titleLocalized.zh: 分屏运动休闲广告

templates.prompt: Create a square, split-screen e-commerce social ad that presents a clean, high-end sportswear brand aesthetic. At the top, use a huge, bold, compressed white all-caps sans-serif font spanning the entire width to place the headline:{argument name="headline text" default="I buy it to work out. I wear it so I can relax."} The image is vertically divided into two equal panels. The left panel displays a neatly laid-out image of four black sportswear items against a soft, light gray studio background with subtle shadows: a black hoodie with a small white swoosh logo on the chest, black athletic shorts with a large white swoosh logo on the calf, and two black running shoes (arranged as a pair) with white swoosh logos and white midsoles. The layout should have a catalog-like cleanliness, minimalism, balance, and sophistication, with realistic fabric textures and clear product photography lighting. The right panel presents a relaxed living room scene in neutral tones: a man wearing the same black hoodie, black shorts, white mid-calf socks, and black running shoes is casually slumped on a beige sofa, leaning back lazily and looking at his smartphone with one hand. His face is softly obscured or blurred and is not the focus. There are four visible snack/living room items around him: a bag of red chips on the sofa, a bag of blue sandwich cookies on the sofa, a sports drink next to the snacks, an open pizza box containing pizza on the foreground coffee table, and a TV remote next to it. Add a framed wall art piece above the sofa and use warm ambient lighting to create a truly homey atmosphere. At the bottom center, overlay smaller white sans-serif text:{argument name="tagline text" default="It's still great value for money."} The overall atmosphere should be humorous, relatable, sophisticated, and highly communicative, like a high-end sportswear advertisement that contrasts the initial motivation for fitness with a relaxed and comfortable feel.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个正方形的分屏电商社交广告，呈现简洁、高端的运动品牌美学。在顶部，使用巨大的粗体压缩白色全大写无衬线字体横跨整个宽度，放置标题：{argument name="headline text" default="买是为了健身。穿是为了躺平。"}。图像垂直分为 2 个等大的面板。左侧面板展示 4 件黑色运动服饰的整齐平铺图，背景为带有细微阴影的柔和浅灰色摄影棚背景：1 件胸前带有白色小勾标志的黑色套头连帽衫，1 条小腿处带有白色大勾标志的黑色运动短裤，以及 2 只带有白色勾标志和白色中底的黑色跑鞋（摆放为一对）。布局应具有目录般的整洁感、极简感、平衡感和高级感，并具备真实的织物纹理和清晰的产品摄影布光。右侧面板展示一个中性色调客厅里的轻松生活场景：1 名穿着同款黑色连帽衫、黑色短裤、白色中筒袜和黑色跑鞋的男子随意地瘫坐在米色沙发上，懒洋洋地向后靠着，单手看着智能手机。他的面部被柔和地遮挡或模糊处理，并非焦点。他周围有 4 件可见的零食/客厅物品：沙发上有一袋红色薯片，沙发上有一包蓝色夹心饼干，零食旁有一瓶运动饮料，前景的咖啡桌上有一个打开的披萨盒，里面装着披萨，旁边还有一个电视遥控器。在沙发上方添加一幅装裱的墙面艺术品，并使用温暖的室内环境光，营造真实的居家氛围。在底部中心，叠加较小的白色无衬线文字：{argument name="tagline text" default="依然物超所值。"}。整体氛围应风趣、有共鸣、精致且极具传播力，就像一个将健身初衷与懒散舒适感形成对比的高端运动休闲服饰直接响应式广告。

templates.title: Pink Idol Anime Lock Screen

titleLocalized.zh: 粉色偶像动漫锁屏

templates.prompt: This is an incredibly detailed anime-style smartphone lock screen wallpaper, using a 9:16 portrait orientation and featuring a dazzling pink idol aesthetic theme. The main character in the image is {argument name="character name" default="Akari"} A lively magical idol girl with super long and fluffy hair{argument name="hair color" default="Soft pink"} She has twin ponytails, bright green eyes, fair skin, and a playful, lively expression. She wears a gorgeous, ruffled stage costume in layers of pink, pale purple, and white, adorned with gold trim, ribbons, heart patterns, lace cuffs, a choker bow, star earrings, and a flower-shaped hair accessory. The background is a dreamy pink mist, embellished with light spots, glitter, and soft glow effects. The design mimics a phone lock screen, featuring a large white lock icon at the top center, a cellular network status icon in the upper right corner, and the date displayed in Japanese as "May 22nd, Thursday." Above this is a large, glowing time display.{argument name="time display" default="22:22"} The image features five representations of the same character: a central half-body figure blinking and playfully touching its lips with a finger; a bust in the upper left corner laughing with its eyes closed; a full-body or three-quarter-body figure in the upper right corner joyfully raising a small magic wand or key-shaped object; a small figure in the lower left corner with its face obscured by a blurred pink rectangle, reaching out; and a crouching figure in the lower right corner, also with its face obscured by a blurred pink rectangle, interacting with a large physical lock. Handwritten Japanese onomatopoeia, including playful exclamations and annotations, are added around the characters. Two iPhone-style message notification banners, both from "メッセージ" and "お兄ちゃん," display the message "今どこ〜？" (What's up now?), one tilted to the left and the other vertically placed on the right. A rounded, semi-transparent slider with the Japanese phrase "スライドでロック解除" (Slide to unlock) and a lock icon is placed at the bottom of the screen. The unlocking concept is materialized by attaching an oversized brass padlock and latch to the slider, with a character in the lower right corner attempting to open it with a key; handwritten Japanese text nearby hints at the lock's removal and a metallic click sound. The lower left corner contains two circular utility icons: a flashlight and a trash can, as well as a manga-style speech bubble that reads "ポイッ!" (Pocky!). The lower right corner features a camera icon within a dark circular button, and at the very bottom is a thin, white home screen indicator. The overall rendering uses a refined, glossy anime illustration quality, with soft lighting, dense flashes, a sense of layered transparency, and a cute, playful atmosphere, as if an idol character has taken over the phone and physically prevented the screen from unlocking.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张细节极其丰富的动漫风格智能手机锁屏壁纸，采用 9:16 竖屏构图，整体采用闪耀的粉色偶像美学主题。画面主角是 {argument name="character name" default="Akari"}，一位活泼的魔法偶像少女，留着超长且蓬松的 {argument name="hair color" default="柔粉色"} 双马尾，拥有明亮的绿色双眸、白皙的皮肤和俏皮生动的表情。她身穿华丽的褶边舞台装，配色为粉色、淡紫色和白色的叠层，配有金色镶边、丝带、心形图案、蕾丝袖口、颈圈蝴蝶结、星星耳环和花朵心形发饰。背景是充满梦幻感的粉色雾气，点缀着光斑、闪光和柔和的辉光效果。设计为仿手机锁屏界面，顶部中央有一个巨大的白色锁图标，右上角有蜂窝网络状态图标，日期显示为日语“5月22日 木曜日”，上方是巨大的发光时间显示 {argument name="time display" default="22:22"}。画面中包含同一角色的 5 个形象：1 个位于中央的半身像，正眨眼并用一根手指抵住嘴唇，做出调皮的姿势；1 个位于左上角的胸像，闭眼大笑；1 个位于右上角的全身或四分之三身位，正欢快地举起一根小魔杖或钥匙状物体；1 个位于左下角的小型形象，脸部被一个模糊的粉色矩形遮挡，正向外伸手；以及 1 个位于右下角的蹲姿形象，脸部同样被模糊的粉色矩形遮挡，正与一把巨大的实体锁互动。在人物周围添加手写风格的日语拟声词，包括俏皮的感叹和注释。展示 2 个仿 iPhone 样式的消息通知横幅，均来自“メッセージ”和“お兄ちゃん”，内容为“今どこ〜？”，一个向左倾斜，另一个垂直放置在右侧。在画面中下部放置一个圆角半透明滑动条，带有日语文字“スライドでロック解除”和一个锁图标。通过在滑动条上附加一个超大的黄铜挂锁和插销装置，将解锁概念实体化，右下角的角色正试图用钥匙打开它；附近添加手写日语文字，暗示锁的移除和金属点击声。左下角包含 2 个圆形实用工具图标：手电筒和垃圾桶，以及一个漫画风格的气泡框，写着“ポイッ！”。右下角有一个深色圆形按钮内的相机图标，最底部有一条细长的白色主屏幕指示条。整体采用精致光亮的动漫插画质量渲染，光线柔和，闪光密集，具有层次透明感和可爱顽皮的氛围，仿佛偶像角色接管了手机并物理阻止了屏幕解锁。

templates.title: Studio portrait of a fluffy blue-eyed kitten

titleLocalized.zh: 毛茸茸蓝眼小猫的影棚肖像

templates.prompt: A centered studio portrait, the subject of which is a fluffy animal.{argument name="cat breed" default="Ragdoll kittens"} It is sitting and looking directly at the camera against a seamless, pure white background. The kitten has two clearly visible ears and two lively paws.{argument name="eye color" default="blue"} With its eyes, small pink nose, and long white whiskers, its expression is gentle and symmetrical, conveying both docility and curiosity. Its fur is predominantly white, with subtle silver-grey shadows on its face, ears, sides, and tail. The fur is fluffy and long, with dense feathering on its chest. The tips of its ears are darker, and there are subtle grey mask-like markings around its eyes. Its thick, bushy tail wraps around its left side to the front. The photograph showcases its entire body from head to paws in a neat, upright sitting posture, with its two front paws visible together. Soft, high-key lighting with minimal shadows highlights the incredibly fine details of its fur, keeping the face sharply focused. The overall effect is realistic, reminiscent of pet photography, with a centered composition and a serene, minimalist aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张居中的影棚肖像，主角是一只毛茸茸的 {argument name="cat breed" default="布偶猫幼崽"}，它正坐着并直视镜头，背景为无缝纯白色。这只小猫有 2 只清晰可见的耳朵、2 只生动的 {argument name="eye color" default="蓝色"} 眼睛、一个小粉鼻子、长长的白色胡须，表情柔和对称，显得温顺而好奇。它的毛发以白色为主，脸部、耳朵、身体两侧和尾部带有淡淡的银灰色阴影，毛发质地蓬松且长，胸前有浓密的饰毛。耳朵尖端颜色较深，脸部双眼周围有微妙的灰色面罩斑纹，尾巴粗壮蓬松，从左侧身体绕到前方。展示从头部到爪子的全身，采用整洁的正向坐姿，2 只前爪并拢可见。使用柔和的高调照明，阴影极少，呈现超精细的毛发细节，面部焦点清晰，具有写实的宠物摄影质感、居中构图以及宁静的极简美学。

templates.title: Looking for Kyle in Seoul Market

titleLocalized.zh: 在首尔市场寻找 Kyle

templates.prompt: A richly detailed vertical travel illustration depicts the bustling alleyways of Seoul's markets. Employing a refined hand-drawn realistic style, it features warm, cinematic lighting, a dense urban narrative, and clearly legible signs. The image is teeming with pedestrians, shoppers, diners, street food customers, musicians, and commuters. The slightly elevated perspective gives the alleyways a layered and vibrant feel. A large illustrated poster in the upper left corner reads "WHERE IS..."{argument name="character name" default="KYLE"} The title, "Can you find Kyle in Seoul?", uses a striking and playful English font, reminiscent of the cover of a "Finding Wally" book. The setting is clearly Seoul, with Namsan Tower visible on the distant horizon, above which are tangled wires, rooftop seating, stacked low-rise buildings, and Korean shop signs. To the right is a subway entrance sign displaying lines 4, 2, 4, 4, and the bilingual text "서울역방면/ To Seoul Station". It includes 15 clearly visible main signs or text panels: 1) "WHERE IS{argument name="character name" default="KYLE"} 1) Poster, 2) “할머니손칼국수”, 3) Hanging vertical sign “낙원상가2F”, 4) A small blue street sign, 5) Vertical sign “이름떡볶이”, 6) Large market archway sign “황진다운시장영”, 7) Orange vertical sign “커피”, 8) Map mural on the wall “남산가는길”, 9) Subway signs “출입구4” and “서울역방면/ To Seoul Station”, 10) Agricultural product sign “경성야채”, 11) Agricultural product sign below “신선한채소”, 12) Handwritten street performer signs, 13) a street food cart sign “호떡·어묵·붕어빵”, 14) a menu item “오늘의추천김밥떡볶이순대튀김”, and 15) the text on a delivery box “빠른배달”. Eight main stalls or activity areas are set up in the alley: 1) a noodle shop under a red and white awning on the left, with seated diners; 2) a vegetable stall piled high with crates of produce; 3) a group of street performers playing guitar and percussion; 4) a street food cart in the middle selling sugar cakes, fish cakes, and crucian carp cakes; 5) a group of customers standing and eating snacks, holding cups; 6) a magic stall in the center below performing card and cup tricks; 7) a painter in front of an easel in the lower left; 8) a group of delivery motorcycles in the lower right. Add 6 Notable background details: 1) Rooftop diners on the upper right terrace; 2) A cat resting on the upper left eaves; 3) Colorful market parasols in the middle distance; 4) Staircases and narrow side alleys; 5) Dense balconies and windows filled with plants and residents; 6) Towers and the skyline in the distance. The crowd should be extremely diverse in age and attire, primarily featuring casual contemporary Korean street fashion, including jackets, hoodies, backpacks, skirts, trousers, and sneakers, interspersed with some office workers and students. A subtle and unique character should be hidden as the target to be found.{argument name="target outfit" default="a young man in a blue hoodie with yellow lettering"} The design seamlessly integrates the image into the central crowd, rather than deliberately highlighting it. It utilizes vibrant yet solid color palettes, including brick red, cyan, forest green, cream, mustard yellow, asphalt gray, and sky blue. Emphasis is placed on intricate lines, legible Korean text, urban observation details, lively human poses, and the playful feel of a high-end "Find Wally" style Seoul search poster. The aspect ratio is 2:3.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅细节极其丰富的竖版旅行编辑插画，描绘了熙熙攘攘的首尔市场小巷。采用精致的手绘写实风格，配以温暖的电影感光影、密集的城市叙事和清晰易读的招牌。画面中挤满了行人、购物者、食客、街头小吃顾客、音乐家和通勤者，视角略微抬高，使整条小巷显得层次分明、充满活力。左上角是一张大型插画海报，上面写着“WHERE IS {argument name="character name" default="KYLE"}？”，副标题为“Can you find Kyle in Seoul?”，采用醒目且俏皮的英文字体，风格类似于“寻找沃利”类书籍的封面。环境应明确为首尔，远处的地平线上可见南山塔，上方有杂乱的电线、屋顶座位、堆叠的低层建筑、韩文商店招牌，右侧有一个地铁入口标志，显示 4、2、4、4 号线以及双语文字“서울역 방면 / To Seoul Station”。包含 15 个清晰可见的主要招牌或文字板：1) “WHERE IS {argument name="character name" default="KYLE"}?” 海报，2) “할머니 손칼국수”，3) 悬挂的竖招牌“낙원상가 2F”，4) 一个蓝色小路牌，5) 竖招牌“이름 떡볶이”，6) 大型市场拱门招牌“황진다운시장 영”，7) 橙色竖招牌“커피”，8) 墙上的地图壁画“남산 가는길”，9) 地铁标志“출입구 4”及“서울역 방면 / To Seoul Station”，10) 农产品招牌“경성 야채”，11) 下方的农产品招牌“신선한 채소”，12) 手写的街头艺人招牌，13) 街头小吃车招牌“호떡·어묵·붕어빵”，14) 菜单项目“오늘의 추천 김밥 떡볶이 순대 튀김”，以及 15) 快递盒文字“빠른 배달”。巷子里设置 8 个主要的摊位或活动区：1) 左侧红白遮阳棚下的面馆，有坐着的食客；2) 堆满农产品板条箱的蔬菜摊；3) 一组吉他和打击乐街头艺人；4) 中间售卖糖饼、鱼饼和鲫鱼饼的街头小吃车；5) 一群站着吃零食、拿着杯子的顾客；6) 下方中心处有一个表演纸牌和杯子的魔术小摊；7) 左下方画架前的画家；8) 右下方的快递摩托车群。添加 6 个显著的背景细节：1) 右上方露台上的屋顶食客；2) 左上方屋檐上休憩的猫；3) 中间远处色彩斑斓的市场遮阳伞；4) 楼梯和狭窄的侧巷；5) 挤满植物和居民的密集阳台与窗户；6) 远处的塔楼和天际线。人群在年龄和着装上应极其多样化，主要是休闲的当代韩国街头时尚，包括夹克、连帽衫、背包、裙子、长裤和运动鞋，其中穿插着一些上班族和学生。隐藏一个微妙且独特的角色作为寻找目标，即 {argument name="target outfit" default="a young man in a blue hoodie with yellow lettering"}，将其自然地融入中心人群中，而不是刻意突出。使用充满活力但扎实的色调，包括砖红、青色、森林绿、奶油色、芥末黄、沥青灰和天蓝色。强调复杂的线条、可读的韩文文本、城市观察细节、生动的人体姿态，以及高端“寻找沃利”风格首尔搜索海报的趣味感。长宽比 2:3。

templates.title: Cute Bunny Garden Neon Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱兔兔花园霓虹场景

templates.prompt: A dreamy 3D kawaii-style rendering showcases a lush garden at night, filled with glowing pink neon graphics and soft shimmer. In the center, a petite, doll-like girl with her back to the camera, her long, flowing blonde hair adorned with a white bow headband, a pink puff-sleeved blouse, and a light blue suspender skirt with white trim, stands gently touching the mouth of a large white rabbit character in front of her. This rabbit has oversized, erect ears, bright black eyes, rosy cheeks, and a cute, fluffy face, wearing a light blue uniform-style jacket with small gold badges. Lush greenery, daisies, and abundant pink flowers in the foreground and background surround the rabbit. A large, glowing Korean neon sign is placed at the top.{argument name="headline text" default="가특하구나~"} It features a bright pink bubble font with a soft glow. It includes 7 additional neon or UI-style decorative elements: a heart-shaped logo in the top left corner with the text {argument name="top sign text" default="CUTE"} A neon star logo on the white cabinet in the upper right corner; a glowing heart outline near the rabbit on the right; a retro pink computer-style floating window on the left with tiny toolbar details and a central heart graphic containing text.{argument name="window text" default="you're so precious"} The bottom left corner features a large, glowing heart-shaped outline; the bottom right corner features a pink handheld virtual pet device displaying a little bunny sprite; and a small, glowing crystal heart is placed near the device. Soft blooms, glossy highlights, magical glitter particles, pink rim lighting, shallow depth of field, a toy photography style, and a retro-cute web aesthetic dominated by pale pink and blue tones.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张梦幻般的 3D 卡哇伊风格渲染图，展现了夜晚郁郁葱葱的花园，充满了发光的粉色霓虹图形和柔和的闪光。画面中央，一个小巧的玩偶般女孩背对镜头，留着柔顺的金色长发，戴着白色蝴蝶结发带，穿着粉色泡泡袖衬衫，外搭淡蓝色背带裙，边缘有白色装饰。她正轻轻伸手触碰面前一只大型白兔角色的嘴部。这只兔子有着超大的竖立耳朵、亮黑色的眼睛、红润的脸颊和可爱的毛绒质感脸庞，身穿带有金色小徽章的浅蓝色制服式夹克。周围环绕着茂密的绿植、雏菊和前景与背景中繁茂的粉色花朵。在顶部放置巨大的发光韩语霓虹文字 {argument name="headline text" default="가특하구나~"}，采用亮粉色气泡字体，带有柔和的光晕。包含 7 个额外的霓虹灯或 UI 风格装饰元素：左上角一个心形标志，上面写着 {argument name="top sign text" default="CUTE"}；右上角白色柜子上的一个霓虹星形标志；右侧兔子附近的一个发光心形轮廓；左侧一个复古粉色电脑风格浮动窗口，带有微小的工具栏细节和中央的心形图形，其中包含文字 {argument name="window text" default="you're so precious"}；左下角一个巨大的发光心形轮廓；右下角一个粉色手持虚拟宠物设备，显示着一个小兔子精灵；以及设备附近的一个小型发光水晶心。添加柔和的泛光、光泽高光、魔法闪光粒子、粉色轮廓光、浅景深、玩具摄影风格，以及以淡粉色和蓝色为主色调的怀旧可爱网络美学。

templates.title: Colored Soccer Comic Page

titleLocalized.zh: 彩色足球漫画页面

templates.prompt: A full-color comic strip, employing a dramatic sports comic style, depicts an intense football match inside a large domed stadium, with the stands presented in a blue and white color scheme. Sharp ink lines, dense hatching, halftone paper textures, dynamic speed lines, and vibrant anime coloring create the effect of a professionally colored black-and-white comic strip. The composition is a three-panel layout: a large main panel occupying most of the page, and two narrow, diagonally recessed panels stacked on the left. The main panel shows a view of the penalty area and goal from a high sideline perspective, presenting a steep, wide-angle view where the green grass is stretched due to perspective and filled with directional hatching. Six players are visible in the main panel: four in blue jerseys, two in white jerseys, and a goalkeeper in a yellow jersey. The most prominent player is located in the lower right center, with his back to the camera, wearing a blue jersey printed with "HUGO" and the number 9, running towards the playing area with one arm outstretched. Near his lower right edge, another player wearing a white jersey with "ISAGI" and the number 11 is shown, also running forward. In the mid-shot, four more players are shown vying for possession: three in blue jerseys and one in white, with one in white diving horizontally towards the center from the right. The goal is located near the center in the upper left, with a yellow goalkeeper poised at the net. Add three speech bubbles to the main storyboard—large white cartoon bubbles with handwritten capital English text: "BUT I WANT TO WIN THE WORLD CUP...", "...AS THE SECOND-BEST AND AS A MID-FIELDER.", and "...THE WORLD RECORD FOR MOST TIMES WINNING THE WORLD CUP...". Create two diagonal storyboards in the left-side embedded area. The upper panel features a close-up of a dark-haired character in a blue jersey, with the face and center of the torso softly blurred by a rectangular blur, accompanied by a small speech bubble that reads "YOICHI ISAGI, DID YOU KNOW...". The lower panel shows a close-up of a red-haired character with large blue eyes, sweat on their face against a light blue background, their expression one of surprise or shock. The overall design maintains bold black panel borders, dramatic perspective shortening, and a high-energy tournament atmosphere. It uses a blue, green, white, and yellow color scheme with strong contrast and authentic comic book page coloring aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张全彩漫画页面，采用戏剧性的体育漫画风格，展示了大型穹顶体育场内激烈的足球比赛，观众席呈现蓝白配色。使用锐利的墨线、密集的排线、网点纸纹理、动态速度线以及生动的动漫配色，呈现出黑白漫画页面经过专业上色的效果。构图为单页 3 分镜：1 个占据页面大部分空间的大型主分镜，以及左侧堆叠的 2 个狭窄对角线嵌入式分镜。在主分镜中，展示从高处边线视角俯瞰的禁区和球门，呈现陡峭倾斜的广角视野，绿茵草地因透视而拉伸，并布满方向性排线。主分镜中可见 6 名球员：4 名身穿蓝色球衣的球员，2 名身穿白色球衣的球员，以及球门前 1 名身穿黄色球衣的守门员。最显眼的球员位于右下中心，背对镜头，身穿印有“HUGO”和数字 9 的蓝色球衣，单臂伸展向比赛区域奔跑。在他右下边缘附近，展示另一名身穿印有“ISAGI”和数字 11 的白色球衣的球员，同样在向前奔跑。在中景处，展示另外 4 名争抢球权的场上球员：3 名蓝色球衣和 1 名白色球衣，其中一名白色球衣球员正从右侧向中心水平俯冲或扑救。球门位于左上方中心附近，黄色守门员在网前严阵以待。在主分镜中添加 3 个对话气泡，即带有手写体大写英文文本的大型白色漫画气泡，内容分别为：“BUT I WANT TO WIN THE WORLD CUP...”、“...AS THE SECOND-BEST AND AS A MID-FIELDER.”以及“...THE WORLD RECORD FOR MOST TIMES WINNING THE WORLD CUP...”。在左侧嵌入区域，创建 2 个对角线分镜。上方嵌入分镜展示一名身穿蓝色球衣的黑发角色特写，脸部和躯干中心部分被柔和的矩形模糊遮挡，配有一个写着“YOICHI ISAGI, DID YOU KNOW...”的小对话气泡。下方嵌入分镜展示一名红发角色的特写，拥有一只巨大的蓝色眼睛，脸上带着汗水，背景为淡蓝色，表情显得惊讶或震惊。保持粗黑的分镜边框、戏剧性的透视缩短效果以及高能量的锦标赛氛围。使用蓝色、绿色、白色和黄色的配色方案，并具备强烈的对比度和地道的漫画页面上色美学。

templates.title: Cyberpunk-style Creative Cloud creative advertising poster

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克风格 Creative Cloud 创意广告海报

templates.prompt: Create a high-energy, futuristic cyberpunk-style advertising poster for {argument name="brand name" default="Adobe"}{argument name="product name" default="Creative Cloud"} The video uses a 16:9 widescreen format, set against the backdrop of a neon-lit, densely populated nighttime metropolis, featuring glowing skyscrapers, holographic billboards, wet, reflective pavement, and a deep purple-blue-black atmosphere. It employs strong synthetic wave colors, including electric magenta, cyan, purple, bright pink, and blue, and incorporates glowing edges, digital glitch effects, scan lines, beams of light, particle sparks, and HUD-style interface embellishments. The Adobe logo and a red [unclear text - possibly a typo or incomplete sentence] are placed in the upper left corner.{argument name="brand name" default="Adobe"} The text was followed by a large, bold, tech-style headline, which read:{argument name="product name" default="Creative Cloud"} It uses luminous white and cyan colors with a magenta halo; below it, add a smaller, all-caps slogan:{argument name="tagline" default="7 APPS. ENDLESS POSSIBILITIES."} Below, a short marketing tagline in a compact, futuristic font reads: “POWER YOUR CREATIVITY WITH INDUSTRY-LEADING TOOLS FOR EVERY IDEA AND EVERY CREATOR.” In the upper right corner, a large, glowing, rounded square app icon is displayed, containing the Adobe Creative Cloud symbol rendered as a dazzling neon hologram with a cosmic texture and orange-pink-blue energy. Next to it is a vertical Japanese neon sign that reads “创造する、無限の力” (Chuangzao suru, Mugen no Rikatsu). Below in the center, seven glowing app cards are arranged horizontally, each a separate, bright panel with beveled sci-fi borders, internal circuitry details, and matching neon hues. Card 1: “Ps,” tagged “PHOTOSHOP,” subtitle “PHOTO EDITING,” with a simple landscape/image icon in cyan. Card 2: “Ai”, tag “ILLUSTRATOR”, subtitle “VECTOR GRAPHICS”, with a pen nib/vector icon, orange-gold. Card 3: “Pr”, tag “PREMIERE PRO”, subtitle “VIDEO EDITING”, with a film frame and play button icon, magenta. Card 4: “Ae”, tag “AFTER EFFECTS”, subtitle “MOTION GRAPHICS”, with a stacked layer shape icon, purple. Card 5: “Id”, tag “INDESIGN”, subtitle “LAYOUT & PUBLISHING”, with a text layout icon, pink. Card 6: “Lr”, tag “LIGHTROOM”, subtitle “PHOTO MANAGEMENT”, with a landscape/photo icon, turquoise. Card 7: “Xd”, tag “XD”, subtitle “UI/UX DESIGN”, with a wireframe/application window icon, bright pink. At the very bottom, add a glowing horizontal footer containing five functional blocks separated by thin neon dividing lines: 1) a cloud icon and "SEAMLESS INTEGRATION", 2) a portrait icon and "BUILT FOR COLLABORATION", 3) a sync/cloud arrow icon and "SYNC ACROSS DEVICES", 4) a graduation cap icon and "LEARN & GROW WITH CREATIVE CLOUD", and 5) a striking closing statement on the far right.{argument name="closing slogan" default="MAKE IT. CREATIVE CLOUD."} Overall style: High-end cinematic technology advertising, ultra-high detail, clear and sharp, symmetrical advertising layout, glossy reflection, dramatic contrast, retro-futuristic game UI aesthetics, and exquisite commercial poster design.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高能量的未来赛博朋克风格广告海报，用于 {argument name="brand name" default="Adobe"} {argument name="product name" default="Creative Cloud"}，采用 16:9 宽屏格式，背景设定在霓虹闪烁的密集夜间大都市，包含发光的摩天大楼、全息广告牌、潮湿的反射路面以及深紫-蓝-黑色的氛围。使用强烈的合成波色调，包括电光洋红色、青色、紫色、亮粉色和蓝色，并加入发光边缘、数字故障效果、扫描线、光束、粒子火花以及 HUD 风格的界面装饰。在左上角放置 Adobe 标志和红色的 {argument name="brand name" default="Adobe"} 字样，随后是一个巨大的粗体科技风标题，显示为 {argument name="product name" default="Creative Cloud"}，采用发光的白色和青色，并带有洋红色光晕；在其下方添加一行较小的全大写标语：{argument name="tagline" default="7 APPS. ENDLESS POSSIBILITIES."}。在下方，以紧凑的未来感字体添加一段简短的营销文案：“POWER YOUR CREATIVITY WITH INDUSTRY-LEADING TOOLS FOR EVERY IDEA AND EVERY CREATOR.”（用行业领先的工具为每一个创意和每一位创作者赋能）。在右上角，展示一个巨大的发光圆角方形应用图标，内含 Adobe Creative Cloud 符号，渲染成带有宇宙纹理和橙-粉-蓝色能量的璀璨霓虹全息图。在其旁边，添加一个垂直的日文霓虹灯牌，文字为“創造する、無限の力”。在下方中部，横向排列展示 7 张发光的应用卡片，每张卡片都是一个独立的亮光面板，带有斜面科幻边框、内部电路细节和相匹配的霓虹色调。卡片 1：“Ps”，标签“PHOTOSHOP”，副标题“PHOTO EDITING”，配有简单的风景/图像图标，青蓝色。卡片 2：“Ai”，标签“ILLUSTRATOR”，副标题“VECTOR GRAPHICS”，配有钢笔尖/矢量图标，橙金色。卡片 3：“Pr”，标签“PREMIERE PRO”，副标题“VIDEO EDITING”，配有胶片框和播放按钮图标，紫洋红色。卡片 4：“Ae”，标签“AFTER EFFECTS”，副标题“MOTION GRAPHICS”，配有堆叠层形状图标，紫色。卡片 5：“Id”，标签“INDESIGN”，副标题“LAYOUT & PUBLISHING”，配有文本排版图标，粉红色。卡片 6：“Lr”，标签“LIGHTROOM”，副标题“PHOTO MANAGEMENT”，配有风景/照片图标，青蓝绿色。卡片 7：“Xd”，标签“XD”，副标题“UI/UX DESIGN”，配有线框/应用窗口图标，亮粉色。在最底部，添加一个发光的水平页脚栏，包含 5 个由细霓虹分割线隔开的功能块：1) 云图标及“SEAMLESS INTEGRATION”（无缝集成），2) 人像图标及“BUILT FOR COLLABORATION”（专为协作打造），3) 同步/云箭头图标及“SYNC ACROSS DEVICES”（跨设备同步），4) 学士帽图标及“LEARN & GROW WITH CREATIVE CLOUD”（通过 Creative Cloud 学习与成长），5) 最右侧是一个醒目的结束语：{argument name="closing slogan" default="MAKE IT. templates.prompt: A darkly humorous, cinematic product advertisement, set in a messy modern living room at night. In the background, a person wearing {argument name="superhero costume" default="Spider-Man style red and blue suit"} A person lies face down on the wooden floor, motionless, one arm outstretched towards the camera, embodying the posture of a defeated superhero. The room is dimly lit, with a somber atmosphere; a gray sofa in the background is out of focus, pillows and blankets are scattered on the floor, and white popcorn is strewn everywhere. A pizza box is cropped into the frame in the left foreground. A huge, upright pizza can sits in the right foreground.{argument name="product name" default="Raid"} The insecticide is prominently featured, clearly focused with exaggerated perspective; the black cap and purple label face directly at the camera. This gives the product a dominant, clean, and commercial feel, with dramatic contour lighting and glossy reflections. Two lines of striking white capital letters are added: the top uses an oversized, compact sans-serif font, and the text reads {argument name="headline text" default="NOT EVEN A SUPERHERO SURVIVES."} The bottom center uses smaller, bolder text with the following content:{argument name="tagline text" default="Raid. Kills bugs dead."} The bottle label features two visible insect illustrations, maintaining a high-end, visually impactful commercial advertising style: realistic photography, shallow depth of field, strong contrast, rough floor texture, and soft gray-blue indoor lighting. The composition makes the insecticide the absolute visual focus, while the fallen hero in the background serves as a humorous and satirical element.

promptLocalized.zh: 一则黑色幽默风格的电影质感产品广告，场景设定在夜晚凌乱的现代客厅中。背景中，一名身穿 {argument name="superhero costume" default="蜘蛛侠风格红蓝战衣"} 的人脸朝下瘫倒在木地板上，一动不动，一只手臂伸向镜头，呈现出超级英雄战败后的姿态。房间光线昏暗，氛围压抑，背景中灰色的沙发处于虚焦状态，枕头和毯子散落一地，地板上撒满了白色爆米花。左侧前景处展示一个被裁剪进画面的披萨盒。右侧前景处放置一罐巨大的、直立的 {argument name="product name" default="Raid"} 杀虫剂作为主角，焦点清晰，透视比例夸张，黑色瓶盖，紫色标签正对镜头。使产品呈现出主导、整洁且商业化的质感，带有戏剧性的轮廓光和光泽反射。添加两行醒目的白色大写广告文案：顶部使用超大号紧凑型无衬线字体，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="NOT EVEN A SUPERHERO SURVIVES."}；底部居中处使用较小的粗体文字，内容为 {argument name="tagline text" default="Raid. Kills bugs dead."}。在瓶身标签上包含 2 个可见的昆虫插图，整体基调保持高端视觉冲击力商业广告风格：写实摄影、浅景深、强对比度、粗糙的地板纹理、柔和的灰蓝色室内光线，构图使杀虫剂成为绝对的视觉焦点，而背景中倒下的英雄则起到幽默讽刺的效果。

templates.prompt: Create a rough-hewn, darkly humorous advertisement for an insecticide product, using a realistic cinematic style. The scene is set in a bright, slightly messy living room with wooden floors. Soft, warm afternoon light streams in through a high window on the left, using a shallow depth of field and a low, ground-level camera angle. In the foreground on the right, place a well-focused bottle of insecticide.{argument name="product brand" default="Raid"} An insecticide spray can stands upright, occupying a large portion of the frame, with its label facing the camera. The can is red and black with a prominent yellow brand logo; the label clearly displays "Raid," "ANT & ROACH," and "KILLS BUGS DEAD." In the mid-range and extending to the left of the room, a superhero in a red and blue spider-themed suit, exhausted, lies face down on the floor, seemingly defeated, with a gloved hand reaching towards the camera. Six clearly visible dead insects are scattered on the floor around the spray can and the superhero. The room should contain four pieces of background furniture: a sofa on the far left, a small side table, a wooden cabinet behind it, and a second storage unit on the right; all furniture is slightly blurred. A prominent, large, distressed white caption is added at the top, stating:{argument name="headline text" default="NOT EVEN A SUPERHERO SURVIVES."} Add a smaller, bold white slogan at the bottom center, which reads:{argument name="tagline text" default="Raid. Kills bugs dead."} It emphasizes the core position of the product, the ironic visual impact, the realistic texture, the dramatic shadows, the composition of commercial advertisements, and the high-end retouched photography effects suitable for e-commerce or social media marketing.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张风格粗粝、带有黑色幽默感的杀虫剂产品广告图，采用写实的电影摄影风格。场景设定在一个阳光明媚、凌乱的客厅，地面为木质，左侧高窗透进柔和温暖的午后光线，采用浅景深效果，摄像机视角处于贴近地面的低位。在右侧前景处，放置一瓶焦点清晰的 {argument name="product brand" default="Raid"} 杀虫剂喷雾罐，罐体直立，在画面中占比很大，标签正对镜头。罐身为红黑配色，带有醒目的黄色品牌标识，可见标签上印有 "Raid"、"ANT & ROACH" 以及 "KILLS BUGS DEAD" 字样。在中景及向房间左侧延伸的区域，展示 1 名身穿红蓝配色蜘蛛主题战衣、精疲力竭的超级英雄，他面部朝下瘫倒在地，仿佛被打败一般，一只戴着手套的手伸向镜头方向。在喷雾罐和超级英雄周围的地板上，散落着 6 只清晰可见的死虫。房间内应包含 4 件背景家具：最左侧的沙发、一张小边桌、后方的一个木质柜子，以及右侧的第二个储物单元，所有家具均略微虚化。在顶部添加一行醒目的大号做旧白色大写标题，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="NOT EVEN A SUPERHERO SURVIVES."}；并在底部居中位置添加一行较小的加粗白色标语，内容为 {argument name="tagline text" default="Raid. templates.title: Symbols drawn with dust on the hood

titleLocalized.zh: 车盖上用灰尘绘制的符号

templates.prompt: A lifelike close-up photograph shows the hood of a dark blue or black car parked outdoors, covered in a thick layer of beige dust and pollen. In the center of the hood, a large, clearly defined emblem shape is drawn with a finger across the dust, revealing the glossy paint underneath. The symbol is a circular mark with a raised dot at the center, surrounded by eight segmented stripes: a wide, curved segment at the top, three horizontal stripe segments on the left and right, and a wide, sloping segment at the bottom. A realistically placed adult hand with grime-covered fingernails rests on the lower right corner of the hood, as if the symbol had just been drawn. Scratches, grime, and finger marks are visible in the dust around the edges of the design. The upper left corner includes part of the windshield and a windshield wiper, with the soft reflections of trees reflected in the glass and paint. The background is a slightly blurred parking lot, showing the road surface, curbs, and three tree trunks illuminated by sunlight. Warm afternoon natural light, shallow depth of field, high-detail reflections on the car's surface, documentary-style composition, and the aspect ratio of a portrait mobile phone photo.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张逼真的特写照片，拍摄的是一辆停在户外的深蓝色或黑色汽车的车盖，上面覆盖着一层厚厚的米褐色灰尘和花粉。在车盖中央，一个大型且清晰的徽章形状是用手指划过灰尘绘制而成的，露出了下方光亮的漆面。该符号是一个圆形标志，中心有一个凸起的圆点，周围环绕着 8 个分段条纹：顶部有 1 个宽大的弧形段，左侧有 3 个水平条纹段，右侧有 3 个水平条纹段，底部有 1 个宽大的倾斜段。一只指甲带有污垢的成年人手真实地放在车盖右下角，仿佛刚刚绘制完该符号。在图案边缘的灰尘中呈现出划痕、污迹和手指留下的纹理。左上方包含部分挡风玻璃和 1 个雨刮器，玻璃和车漆上倒映着树木的柔和影像。背景是稍微模糊的停车场，可以看到阳光照射下的路面、路缘石和 3 棵树干。温暖的午后自然光，浅景深，高细节的汽车表面反射，纪实风格的构图，竖屏手机照片比例。

titleLocalized.zh: 极简主义 9 宫格时尚拼贴

promptLocalized.zh: {"type":"时尚 Lookbook 拼贴","subject":{"gender_presentation":"年轻女性","face_visibility":"每张照片中的面部均刻意模糊且不清晰","hair":{"color":"{argument name=\"hair color\" default=\"浅棕色\"}","style":"直发，齐肩，中分或微侧分"},"body_type":"苗条","aesthetic":"柔和中性韩系街头风格，舒适的秋冬胶囊衣橱"},"layout":{"background":"干净的浅灰色摄影棚墙面","presentation":"九张垂直打印的照片卡片，以精确的 3x3 网格排列，每张卡片顶部用超大号银色回形针夹住，卡片后方有轻微阴影和细微的纸张堆叠效果","count":9,"sections":[{"title":"顶行","position":"上三分之一","count":3,"labels":["米色衬衫搭配围巾和黑色阔腿裤","深棕色羊羔毛领飞行员夹克搭配米色迷你裙和棕色过膝靴","米色泰迪绒夹克搭配白色宽松长裤和棕色单肩包"]},{"title":"中行","position":"中心","count":3,"labels":["露肩深灰褐色针织毛衣搭配橄榄绿工装裤","超大款灰色连帽衫作为迷你裙穿着，搭配白色腿套","修身灰褐色长袖上衣搭配水洗蓝宽松牛仔裤"]},{"title":"底行","position":"下三分之一","count":3,"labels":["白色羽绒服搭配白色宽松长裤和深色手提包","柔和米色拉链开衫搭配深棕色阔腿裤","炭灰色长款风衣叠穿灰色连帽衫和黑色短下装，搭配棕色靴子"]}]},"styling":{"palette":"柔和中性色：米色、浅褐色、灰褐色、灰色、棕色、黑色、橄榄绿、水洗牛仔蓝","footwear":"主要是棕褐色或棕色的休闲鞋和靴子","bags":"多数造型搭配棕色单肩包或手提包","pose_style":"全身时尚姿势，姿态放松，双手插兜或手提包，具有编辑风格但休闲"},"camera":{"angle":"正对平铺墙面展示效果","framing":"整个 3x3 排列垂直居中","lighting":"柔和的漫射摄影棚光线，对比度极低"},"rendering":"照片级真实时尚编辑拼贴，干净的极简主义构图，纸张纹理细腻，面料和叠穿细节丰富","prompt":"创建一个照片级真实的极简主义时尚 Lookbook 拼贴，包含 {argument name=\"number of outfits\" default=\"9\"} 张同一位 {argument name=\"model type\" default=\"年轻女性\"} 的全身服装照片，以打印卡片的形式用超大号银色回形针夹在浅灰色墙面上。使用 3x3 网格，正好 9 种造型。每张图片中的面部保持模糊且无细节。服装风格为 {argument name=\"fashion aesthetic\" default=\"柔和中性韩系街头风格\"}，采用柔和的色调和秋冬叠穿搭配。包含以下 9 种造型：1) 米色衬衫、围巾、黑色阔腿裤、印花托特包；2) 深棕色羊羔毛领飞行员夹克、米色迷你裙、棕色过膝靴；3) 米色泰迪绒夹克、白色宽松长裤、棕色单肩包；4) 露肩深灰褐色针织毛衣、橄榄绿工装裤、深色手提包；5) 超大款灰色连帽衫迷你裙、白色腿套、深色单肩包；6) 修身灰褐色长袖上衣、水洗宽松牛仔裤、深色单肩包；7) 白色羽绒服、白色宽松长裤、深色手提包；8) 米色拉链开衫、深棕色阔腿裤、深色单肩包；9) 炭灰色长款风衣叠穿灰色连帽衫和黑色短下装、棕色靴子、深色手提包。柔和的漫射摄影棚光线，细微阴影，干净的纸张纹理，在简单的中性背景下呈现出时尚目录的质感。"}

templates.title: A calico cat sleeping soundly on a white appliance.

titleLocalized.zh: 白色家电上熟睡的三花猫

templates.prompt: A heartwarming indoor lifestyle photo showcases a fluffy, long-haired calico cat with its eyes closed, its chin gently resting on a smooth, cylindrical white appliance, photographed from tabletop height. The cat boasts thick tricolor fur (orange, black, and white), a white muzzle, a pink nose, and large, pointed ears, giving it a remarkably soft and fluffy appearance. Its body is wrapped around the device, resting on a long, matte black tabletop (with natural light-colored wood edges). The composition is centered, with the device in the foreground and the cat occupying the upper half of the frame. The device features a circular opening with a metal inner ring on the front and a small oval control window near the bottom. The scene is set in a warm, sun-drenched modern home, with a window behind the subject letting in soft sunlight. The background features light-colored walls, warm wooden floors, and a small plant on the windowsill in the upper right corner. The shallow depth of field, soft warm tones, realistic fur detail, natural reflections on the device, and a tranquil, sleeping atmosphere make this a high-resolution candid pet photograph.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张温馨的室内生活方式照片，展示了一只毛茸茸的长毛三花猫，它闭着眼睛，下巴轻轻靠在一个圆柱形的光滑白色家电上，从桌子高度正面拍摄。这只猫有着厚实的三色毛发（橙色、黑色和白色）、白色的口鼻部、粉色的鼻子、大而尖的耳朵，外表看起来非常柔软蓬松。它的身体环绕在设备后方，趴在一张长长的哑光黑色桌面（带有天然浅色木质边缘）上，构图居中，设备位于前景，猫咪占据了画面的上半部分。该设备正面有一个圆形开口，带有金属内环，底部附近有一个小椭圆形控制窗。场景设定在温暖、阳光充足的现代家居室内，主体后方有一扇窗户，柔和的日光洒入，背景是浅色墙壁、温暖的木地板，右上角的窗台上摆放着一盆小植物。浅景深，柔和的暖色调，逼真的毛发细节，设备上的自然反光，宁静的睡意氛围，高分辨率的抓拍宠物摄影。

templates.title: Anime Maid Horror Movie Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫女仆惊悚电影海报

templates.prompt: A highly dramatic anime movie poster employs a high vertical composition, centering on two young women dressed in classic black and white maid outfits, standing back-to-back and facing opposite directions. The maid on the left has a short silver bob with bangs and a white maid headband; the maid on the right has a bright pink bob with bangs and a matching white maid headband. They wear fitted black dresses with puff sleeves, white aprons with ruffles, white collars and cuffs, and black ribbons around their necks. Their poses are confident yet tense, one hand hanging at their side, hinting at mystery and rivalry. They are placed in the center of the foreground, occupying most of the poster's height. Behind them, a two-tone night sky is created: a deep electric blue on the left and a saturated magenta on the right, merging at the center. A bright full moon and a small helicopter with a searchlight are displayed in the upper left. On the horizon and below, there is a glowing city skyline, with blue lights on the left and pink lights on the right. In the center of the background, a Gothic mansion or castle with a spire is placed at the end of a path, illuminated by warm light. In front of the mansion, two smaller, identical maid silhouettes are shown, their backs to the viewer, walking side by side towards the building. Four supporting characters are added around the bottom edge: a dark-haired man in a suit in the lower left corner, a stern-looking older man in a suit in the lower right center, a long-haired young woman in the lower right corner, and two small maid silhouettes in the distance, making a total of six figures visible in the poster. Bright pink petals are scattered throughout the image, as if blown by the wind. The poster employs strong cinematic lighting effects, glossy anime-style rendering, high contrast, sharp lines, luminous rim lighting, and a suspenseful, psychologically thrilling atmosphere. Vertical Japanese slogans are included on both sides, and a striking artistic title is placed at the bottom center.{argument name="title text" default="Re:maid"} Below is a smaller Japanese subtitle, and the bottom left corner contains screening information.{argument name="release date text" default="7.25 [FRI] ROADSHOW"} Add a final line of Japanese text at the bottom. Overall style: High-end anime main visual, suspense and thriller, neon blue and hot pink two-tone color scheme, exquisite poster layout, highly detailed background, dynamic petals, and cinema poster texture.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的动漫影院电影海报，采用高垂直构图，画面中心为两位身着经典黑白女仆装的年轻女性，她们背靠背站立，面向相反方向。左侧女仆留着银色短波波头，配有齐刘海和白色女仆发带；右侧女仆留着鲜艳的粉色短波波头，配有齐刘海和同款白色女仆发带。她们穿着合身的黑色连衣裙，带有泡泡袖、饰有荷叶边的白色围裙、白色领口和袖口，颈部系有黑色丝带。她们的姿态自信而紧张，一只手垂在身侧，暗示着神秘感与竞争关系。将她们置于前景中心，占据海报高度的大部分。在她们身后，营造一片双色夜空：左侧为深电光蓝，右侧为饱和的洋红色，在中心处交融。左上方展示一轮明亮的满月和一架带有探照灯的小型直升机。在地平线和下方两侧，包含发光的城市天际线，左侧为蓝色灯光，右侧为粉色灯光。在背景中心，放置一座带有尖塔的哥特式宅邸或城堡，位于小路尽头，并有暖光照亮。在宅邸前方，展示 2 个较小的、背对观众的同款女仆全身人影，并肩走向建筑。在下边缘周围添加 4 个配角：左下角一名穿西装的黑发男子，右下中心一名神情严厉的年长西装男子，右下角一名长发年轻女性，以及中心远处的 2 个小女仆人影，海报中总共可见 6 个人物。将明亮的粉色花瓣散落在画面中，仿佛被风吹过。采用强烈的电影级光效、光泽感动漫渲染、高对比度、锐利的线条、发光的轮廓光以及悬疑心理惊悚的氛围。在两侧包含垂直的日文标语，底部中心放置一个醒目的艺术化标题 {argument name="title text" default="Re:maid"}，下方配有较小的日文副标题，左下角包含上映信息 {argument name="release date text" default="7.25 [FRI] ROADSHOW"}。在底部添加最后一行日文标语。整体风格：高级动漫主视觉图、悬疑惊悚、霓虹蓝与热粉色双色调、精致的海报排版、高度细腻的背景、动态花瓣以及影院电影海报质感。

templates.title: Japanese-style decorative kimono girl and cat

titleLocalized.zh: 和风装饰感和服少女与猫

templates.prompt: An incredibly detailed anime illustration depicts a seated young woman in an elegant Japanese fantasy-style kimono. The composition is exquisite, with a clean, warm off-white background. She has long, straight hair.{argument name="hair color" default="Black with a dark blue-purple base color."} She had straight bangs, and very long hair on the sides, adorned with red and blue ribbons. Her eyes were bright and large, and their color was {argument name="eye color" default="Dark red"} Her expression was calm, gentle, and slightly melancholic. She wore a magnificent floral headdress on the right side of her head, composed of four main flowers in red, white, light blue, and blue, adorned with dangling gold decorations and tassels. Her attire was an intricately patterned kimono, the colors of which were {argument name="kimono colors" default="Red, black, light blue, cream, and accented with purple"} The painting is adorned with cherry blossoms, stylized flowers, butterflies, knots, bows, and hanging tassels. The sleeves are wide and flowing, revealing details of red knots and floral appliqués. She sits in an elegant, curled-up pose, one hand near her face, her bare legs clearly visible, wearing white tabi socks and delicate red and black platform sandals with bows. Four cats surround her: a black cat sits on a branch to the left, looking upwards; three white cats are positioned to her lower left, right center, and lower right respectively. Two birds are present: a bluebird perches on a branch to the left, and a small red and blue bird perches in the lower right flowerbed. Three butterflies are included: two in the upper left and one near the center below her legs. The composition is surrounded by plum blossom branches, hanging Japanese ornaments, tassels, diamond-shaped hanging ornaments, and long, flowing fabric ribbons. A large circular decorative pattern is added behind her upper body, and a tall, vertical banner-style decoration is added to the right side. The overall color scheme balances vermilion, black, ivory, light cyan, sky blue, and lavender. The style is a refined 2D anime-inspired key visual, with extremely clean lines, delicate textile textures, flat decorative shapes combined with subtle shadows, elegant white space, and a highly decorative yet harmonious composition. It is imaginative and elegant, a vertical full-body character poster.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张细节极其丰富的动漫插画，描绘了一位坐着的年轻女性，身着优雅的日式幻想风格和服，构图精巧，背景为干净的暖米白色。她留着长直发，{argument name="hair color" default="黑色，带有深蓝紫色的底色"}，留着齐刘海，两侧发丝极长，发间编织着红蓝相间的丝带。她的双眼明亮且硕大，颜色为 {argument name="eye color" default="深红色"}，表情平静、柔和且略带忧郁。她头部的右侧佩戴着华丽的花卉发饰，由红、白、浅蓝和蓝色 4 朵主花组成，并配有垂下的金色装饰和流苏。她的服装是一件花纹繁复的和服，颜色为 {argument name="kimono colors" default="红色、黑色、浅蓝色、奶油色，并点缀着紫色"}，上面布满了樱花、风格化花卉、蝴蝶、绳结、蝴蝶结和悬挂的流苏装饰。袖子宽大飘逸，可见红色的绳结和花卉贴花细节。她以优雅的蜷缩姿势坐着，一只手靠近脸庞，裸露的双腿清晰可见，穿着白色的足袋式袜子，脚蹬精致的红黑配色厚底凉鞋，鞋上带有蝴蝶结。她周围环绕着 4 只猫：左侧树枝上坐着 1 只黑猫，正向上看；另外 3 只白猫分别位于她的左下方、右侧中部和右下方。画面包含 2 只鸟：1 只蓝鸟栖息在左侧树枝上，1 只红蓝相间的小鸟栖息在右下方的花丛中。画面包含 3 只蝴蝶：2 只在左上方，1 只在靠近她双腿的下方中心处。构图由梅花枝、悬挂的日式饰品、流苏、菱形挂饰和长条织物飘带环绕。在她上半身背后增加一个大型圆形装饰图案，并在右侧增加一个高大的竖版横幅式装饰。整体色调平衡了朱红色、黑色、象牙白、浅青色、天蓝色和薰衣草色。风格为精致的 2D 动漫主视觉图，线条极其干净，纺织品纹理细腻，扁平装饰形状与微妙的阴影相结合，优雅的留白，构图极具装饰性且和谐统一，充满奇思妙想且格调高雅，竖版全身角色海报。

templates.title: Minimalist cartoon portrait (face obscured)

titleLocalized.zh: 极简主义动漫肖像（面部遮挡）

templates.prompt: A minimalist anime-style half-body portrait of a woman is positioned in the center of the image. Her face is completely obscured by a large, vertically oriented, softly edged gray rectangle, creating a censorship effect. She has extremely long, flowing hair in a two-tone style: one side is deep navy blue, and the other is pale silver-gray, with strands flowing outwards as if blown by a gentle breeze. A few strands of coral pink are added as embellishments. She wears a high-necked, off-white coat or uniform jacket with a deep navy blue inner collar and two small gold buttons, creating a stylish, modern sci-fi feel. Her visible skin is pale, and she wears a small earring in one ear. The painting employs a flat, elegant illustration style with smooth, vector-like shadows, no heavy textures, and a restrained, soft color palette, primarily using powder blue, cream, navy blue, and coral pink. The background is an abstract geometric composition rather than a realistic scene: large cream-colored circles and diagonal shapes are superimposed on a sky-blue background, decorated with five coral-colored circular graphics connected by thin vertical lines or curves, arranged decoratively around the character. The overall composition remains transparent, balanced, and modern, with soft lines and clever use of negative space, presenting a cool and sophisticated editorial aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张简洁的极简主义动漫女性半身肖像，位于画面中央，面部被一个覆盖整个脸部的巨大垂直柔边灰色矩形完全遮挡，形成审查遮盖效果。她拥有一头极长的飘逸秀发，呈现双色调：一侧为深海军蓝，另一侧为淡银灰色，发丝向外飘散，仿佛被微风吹动。在发丝中加入几缕珊瑚粉色的细条纹作为点缀。她身穿一件高领结构的米白色外套或制服夹克，内领为深海军蓝，并配有两颗小金扣，营造出时尚的现代科幻感。可见的皮肤呈苍白色，一只耳朵上戴着一枚小巧的耳钉。采用平涂、优雅的插画风格，带有平滑的矢量感阴影，无厚重纹理，色调克制且柔和，以粉蓝色、奶油色、海军蓝和珊瑚粉为主。背景为抽象几何构图而非现实场景：在天蓝色的底色上叠加大型奶油色圆形和对角线形状，并装饰有 5 个珊瑚色圆形图形，通过细垂直线或曲线连接，围绕角色进行装饰性排列。整体构图保持通透、平衡且具有现代感，线条柔和，留白巧妙，呈现出冷静的编辑海报美学。

templates.title: Soft-toned faceless floral anime portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 柔和色调无脸花卉动漫肖像

templates.prompt: A dreamy, soft-toned anime portrait depicting a person with{argument name="hair color" default="light pink blush"} A young woman with long, wavy hair. The image is a half-length portrait against a clean white background, adorned with scattered small flowers, petals, and soft, ribbon-like swirls. Her face is completely obscured by a centrally located, soft gray-pink vertical rectangle, creating a faceless placeholder effect. Her hair is decorated with two large, semi-transparent ribbon bows (one on each side), with numerous small flowers woven into her hair like a crown. She wears an off-the-shoulder, ruffled dress in extremely soft shades of white, lavender, and pink, featuring puff sleeves, lace trim, floral embellishments, and delicate bow details. She gently holds a small bouquet of flowers to her chest; the bouquet contains flowers in soft shades of pink, cream, white, and light blue. The composition is centered, elegant, and light, employing ultra-soft lines, watercolor-style shading, high detail, subtle shimmer, and a romantic, shoujo manga aesthetic. It utilizes a soft color palette, ethereal lighting, the subtle transparency of ribbons, and a vertical, poster-like composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张梦幻般的柔和色调动漫肖像，描绘了一位拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="淡腮红粉色"} 长波浪卷发的年轻女性。画面为半身像，背景为干净的白色，点缀着零星的小花、花瓣和柔和的丝带状漩涡。她的面部被一个位于中心、颜色为柔和灰粉色的垂直矩形完全遮挡，营造出一种无脸头像占位符的效果。她的头发上装饰着 2 个大型半透明丝带蝴蝶结（两侧各一个），许多小花像花冠一样编织在发间。她身穿一件露肩荷叶边连衣裙，色调为极柔和的白色、薰衣草色和粉色，配有泡泡袖、蕾丝饰边、花卉点缀和精致的蝴蝶结细节。她双手轻轻地将一束小花束捧在胸前；花束包含粉色、奶油黄色、白色和浅蓝色的柔和色调花朵。构图居中、优雅且轻盈，采用超柔和的线条艺术、水彩风格阴影、高细节、轻微闪光以及浪漫的少女漫画美学。使用淡雅的调色板、空灵的灯光、丝带的微妙透明感以及垂直海报式的构图。

templates.title: Soft monochrome anime girl portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 柔和单色动漫少女肖像

templates.prompt: A soft, ethereal anime portrait depicts a refined young woman against a minimalist off-white background, taken from a three-quarter profile view above the chest. She has long, slightly wavy hair.{argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown with gray-brown highlights"} Her hair, light and airy, with bangs and a large black bow tied to one side, is styled beautifully. Her eyes are large and expressive, a light gray, with detailed eyelashes that convey a dreamy and distant look. She rests her chin on her hand, her slender fingers partially obscuring her face, the tips painted with soft gray nail polish. She wears a white off-the-shoulder blouse with puffed cuffs featuring delicate ruffles and pleats, tied with thin black ribbons to create a soft, monochromatic contrast. A single, simple, elegant long gold pearl earring adorns her visible ear. The overall style is clean and minimalist, reminiscent of Japanese anime illustrations, with delicate lines, subtle blush, soft cel-shading, and oil painting-like highlights in her hair. The overall atmosphere is quiet, melancholic, and full of feminine charm, possessing a refined fashion illustration quality, with a color palette limited to white, black, taupe, and gray.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张柔和、轻盈的动漫肖像，描绘了一位精致的年轻女性，背景为极简的米白色，采用胸部以上的四分之三侧面特写视角。她留着长而微卷的 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色配灰褐色挑染"} 头发，发丝轻盈，留着齐刘海，一侧系着一个巨大的黑色蝴蝶结。她的双眼大而有神，呈浅灰色，睫毛细节丰富，流露出梦幻而遥远的表情。她单手托腮，纤细的手指半掩面庞，指尖涂着柔和的灰色指甲油。她身穿白色露肩衬衫，袖口蓬松，带有柔和的荷叶边和褶皱设计，袖子上系着细细的黑色丝带，营造出柔和的单色对比感。在可见的耳朵上增加一枚简约优雅的金色长款珍珠耳坠。采用干净的日漫插画风格，线条细腻，带有淡淡的腮红、柔和的赛璐珞阴影以及如油画般的发丝高光。整体氛围安静、忧郁且充满女性魅力，具有精致的时装插画质感，配色仅限于白色、黑色、灰褐色和灰色。

templates.title: Anime Girls from a Cat's Eye Perspective

titleLocalized.zh: 猫眼视角下的动漫少女

templates.prompt: An ultra-refined, anime-style fisheye peephole portrait depicts a young woman peering extremely close to the camera in a dimly lit, narrow apartment hallway at night. The entire image is framed by the dark, rounded edge of the peephole, creating a strong barrel distortion and an intimate yet slightly unsettling perspective. She leans forward, hands resting on her knees, her face tilted upwards, occupying most of the frame, revealing a large eye and a sly, enigmatic half-smile. Her hair color is {argument name="hair color" default="Vibrant cobalt blue"} Her long hair was slightly disheveled, with layered bangs partially obscuring her face, tied with a black ribbon bow at the back of her head. She wore two striking star accessories: a metal star hair clip near her bangs and a small star brooch on her blue jacket. Her exposed eyes were bright blue, with star-shaped highlights in the iris, rendered with a glossy and detailed effect; her other eye was half-closed, mostly hidden in shadow and hair. She wore a dark top under a shiny blue bomber jacket, and a delicate necklace with a small cross or star pendant, with a chain accessory hanging from the side. Her legs were bare, clad in dark ankle boots. The background was a narrow, dilapidated corridor with a concrete floor, worn walls, and fluorescent lights on the ceiling. A door frame and a small utility box or walkie-talkie hanging on the wall were visible in the background. The cinematic ambient lighting with cool blue-purple tones, deep shadows, and subtle mirror highlights created a slightly eerie yet beautiful atmosphere. Highly detailed digital illustrations, ultra-detailed eyes, soft skin shadows, sharp fabric folds, reflective surfaces, dramatic perspectives, centered composition, and vertical portrait format.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超精细的动漫风格鱼眼门镜肖像，描绘了一位年轻女性在夜晚昏暗狭窄的公寓走廊中，极度靠近镜头窥视的画面。整张图片被门镜深色的圆形边缘框住，呈现出强烈的桶形畸变，营造出一种亲密且略带不安的视角。她身体前倾，双手撑在膝盖上，脸庞向上倾斜看向观众，占据了画面大部分空间，露出一只巨大的眼睛和一抹狡黠、意味深长的半笑。她的头发颜色为 {argument name="hair color" default="鲜艳的钴蓝色"}，长发略显凌乱，层次分明的刘海遮住了部分脸庞，脑后系着一个黑色丝带蝴蝶结。她佩戴了 2 个显眼的星星装饰：刘海附近有一个金属星星发夹，蓝色夹克上别着一枚小星星胸针。她露出的眼睛呈亮蓝色，虹膜中带有星星形状的高光，渲染得光泽且细节丰富；另一只眼睛半闭，大部分隐藏在阴影和头发中。她身穿一件深色上衣，外搭一件亮面蓝色飞行员夹克，佩戴着一条带有小十字架或星形吊坠的精致项链，侧面挂着链条配饰。她双腿裸露，穿着深色短靴。背景是一个狭窄破旧的走廊，地面为混凝土材质，墙壁陈旧，天花板上有荧光灯，背景中可见门框和一个挂在墙上的小型公用设施盒或对讲机。采用带有冷蓝紫色调的电影感氛围光，深邃的阴影，微妙的镜面高光，营造出一种略带诡异但又唯美的氛围。高度精细的数字插画，超细节的眼睛，柔和的皮肤阴影，清晰的织物褶皱，反光表面，戏剧性的视角，居中构图，竖向肖像格式。

templates.title: Eye-catching KFC food advertisement poster

titleLocalized.zh: 醒目的 KFC 食品广告海报

templates.prompt: A striking square fast-food advertisement poster, set in a minimalist studio environment, is designed in a style reminiscent of a high-end KFC promotional event. The composition is perfectly centered, with a white background in the middle and bright red vertical stripes on either side. At the top, three short red vertical lines are evenly distributed, echoing the KFC brand element. Below, a prominent, large, stacked, sans-serif bold headline reads: "THIS IS NOT A FILTER." (black), followed immediately by "IT'S JUST KFC." (bright red). In the foreground, a young man with short, dark curly hair, wearing a dark red crew-neck shirt, leans forward, seemingly smelling the aroma of fried chicken; only his hair, ears, shoulders, and upper body are visible, his face obscured by a rectangular blurred block. In the center of the table sits an oversized bucket of fried chicken, containing six clearly visible, golden-brown pieces coated in crispy batter, steaming hot. The chicken bucket is white with red stripes on the sides and a black KFC-style logo on the front, with the face in the logo obscured by a metallic gray blur. To the left of the table is a red and white striped fries box filled with golden-brown fries, with a few more scattered on the table in front; the fries box also features a KFC-style logo, with the face similarly obscured. To the right is a clear glass of cola filled with ice, condensation visible on the glass, and also features a KFC-style logo with the face obscured. In front of the drinks is a small white dipping bowl filled with appealing red ketchup. At the bottom center is a bold black sans-serif slogan: "Crispy. Juicy. Irresistible." Below this is a small, cursive signature: "Col. Harland Sanders." A small red rectangle adorns the bottom. Employing highly sophisticated commercial food photography lighting, a striking red, white, and black brand color scheme, the food is clearly focused, with realistic textures and a symmetrical layout, presenting a high-end poster advertising style. It is a simple, modern, square-format poster suitable for social media.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张醒目的正方形快餐广告海报，采用简洁的摄影棚布景，设计风格如同高端 KFC 宣传活动。构图完美居中，中间为白色背景板，左右两侧为纯亮红色竖条边框。在最上方，均匀分布 3 条短红色竖线，呼应 KFC 品牌元素。下方添加醒目的大号堆叠式无衬线大写粗体标题：“THIS IS NOT A FILTER.”（黑色），紧接着下方是“IT’S JUST KFC.”（亮红色）。画面中心前景处，一位留着深色短卷发的年轻男子身穿深红色圆领衫，身体前倾，仿佛正在闻炸鸡的香味；仅露出头发、耳朵、肩膀和上半身，面部被一个矩形模糊块遮挡。桌子中央放置着一个超大号炸鸡桶，桶内装有 6 块清晰可见、裹着酥脆面衣的金黄色炸鸡，热气腾腾。炸鸡桶为白色，侧面带有红色条纹，正面印有黑色 KFC 风格标志，标志中的人脸区域被金属灰色模糊块遮挡。桌子左侧放置一个红白条纹薯条盒，里面装满金黄色的炸薯条，前方桌面上散落着几根薯条；薯条盒上也印有 KFC 风格标志，人脸区域同样被遮挡。右侧放置一杯装满冰块的高透明可乐，杯身可见冷凝水珠，印有 KFC 风格标志且人脸区域被遮挡。饮料前方放置一个小白色蘸料碗，里面盛着色泽诱人的红色番茄酱。底部中心添加粗体黑色无衬线标语：“Crispy. Juicy. Irresistible.”，下方配有一行小巧的草书签名式文字“Col. Harland Sanders.”，底部带有一个小型红色矩形装饰。采用高度精良的商业食品摄影布光，鲜明的红白黑品牌配色，食物焦点清晰，质感逼真，布局对称，呈现高端海报广告风格，是一款简洁现代、适用于社交媒体的正方形格式海报。

templates.title: Pepsi vending machine advertisement

titleLocalized.zh: 百事可乐自动售货机广告

templates.prompt: A sophisticated commercial photograph, set against the backdrop of a modern transportation hub or public waiting area, is shot from a frontal, slightly low angle. On the left and in the center of the frame is a giant, illuminated Pepsi vending machine. A young man in a light gray hoodie, black athletic shorts, white mid-calf socks, and white sneakers, with his back to the camera, stretches upwards, attempting to grab a bottle of Pepsi from the top shelf. He stands precariously on four red Coca-Cola cans stacked vertically on the floor, a visually humorous gesture conveying the message that "it's worth the extra steps for Pepsi." The vending machine has ample shelves, with bright, cool white lighting inside: the top shelf displays multiple bottles of Pepsi, the middle shelf showcases various clear, green, yellow, and amber bottled beverages, and the bottom shelf holds rows of red Coca-Cola cans. The vending machine is Pepsi blue, with a large Pepsi globe logo and the word "PEPSI" printed on the left panel, and a payment/control panel on the right. At the top of the image is a large, bold, white sans-serif headline.{argument name="headline text" default="WORTH THE EXTRA STEPS."} Center it on the dark-colored upper wall. Add a simple white sans-serif brand tagline at the bottom center.{argument name="tagline text" default="Choose Pepsi."} On the right wall hangs a framed Pepsi poster with the bold, stacked text "REFRESH RECHARGE REPEAT" and the Pepsi logo printed above it. A simple metal bench sits below the poster. The image employs a bright, reflective surface, sharp focus, a high-quality advertising photography feel, realistic proportions, high dynamic range, and a brand-safe composition that creates a strong contrast between Pepsi blue, Coca-Cola red, and neutral gray.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的商业广告照片，背景位于现代化的交通枢纽或公共候车区，采用正面、略微低视角的拍摄方式。画面左侧和中心是一台巨大的发光百事可乐自动售货机。一名身穿浅灰色连帽衫、黑色运动短裤、白色中筒袜和白色运动鞋的年轻男子背对镜头，正向上伸展身体，试图从最顶层拿取一瓶百事可乐。他摇摇欲坠地站在地面上垂直堆叠的 4 个红色可口可乐罐上，这一视觉幽默传达了“为了百事可乐，多走几步也值得”的含义。自动售货机货架充足，内部灯光为明亮的冷白色：顶层摆放着多瓶百事可乐，中间货架陈列着各种透明、绿色、黄色和琥珀色的瓶装饮料，底层则摆放着一排排红色可口可乐罐。售货机外观为百事蓝，左侧面板印有巨大的百事地球仪标志和“PEPSI”字样，右侧设有支付/控制面板。在画面顶部，放置一行巨大的粗体白色无衬线大写标题 {argument name="headline text" default="WORTH THE EXTRA STEPS."}，居中对齐于深色的上方墙面。在底部中心，添加一行简洁的白色无衬线品牌文案 {argument name="tagline text" default="Choose Pepsi."}。在右侧墙壁上，挂有一张带框的百事可乐海报，上方印有粗体堆叠文字“REFRESH RECHARGE REPEAT”以及百事标志。海报下方放置一张简单的金属长椅。画面采用光亮的地面反射、清晰的对焦、高级广告摄影质感、真实的比例、高动态范围，以及在百事蓝、可口可乐红和中性灰色环境之间形成强烈对比的品牌安全构图。

templates.title: Mysterious Eyes Theme Anime Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 神秘眼眸主题动漫肖像

templates.prompt: A simple, minimalist anime illustration depicts a melancholic young woman in a three-quarter profile, sitting and resting her cheek on her hand. She has long, straight hair.{argument name="hair color" default="blue-black"} Her hair was styled with blunt bangs, her skin was very pale, and her grey-blue eyes held a distant and weary expression. Her face was small and delicate, with a tiny beauty mark beneath one eye, and her eyelashes were fine. She wore a dark, oversized layered outfit in deep navy and charcoal grey: a high-necked black top under a loose, flowing coat or kimono-style overcoat, the fabric adorned with subtle gold lines and tiny eye patterns. Her accessories were elegant and mysterious: multiple ear piercings, a long, dangling earring shaped like an eye with a teardrop pendant, a delicate necklace with a small eye pendant, and several rings on her hands, including an eye-shaped ring on the hand that rested her face on her hand. Her nails were painted a soft slate blue. The background was a flat, warm off-white, meticulously arranged with a series of mysterious eye symbols and hanging decorations. The wall features six precisely chosen eye-themed elements: a framed eye painting in the upper left, a circular eye pendant below it, a small, bullseye-like circular decoration near the upper right, a black pendant with an eye and geometric crystals on the far right, a square panel with radiating eyes on the right center, and a dark rectangular panel with an eye and four teardrop shapes in the lower right. A dark bottle silhouette and a few soft blue-grey leaves are added as secondary decorations on the left. A restrained palette of navy, black, cream, grey-blue, and a touch of soft gold is used. The composition should evoke a quiet, gothic, soft, and introspective atmosphere, employing flat graphic shapes, clean lines, minimal shadows, and an aesthetic reminiscent of modern decorative posters.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张简洁、极简主义的动漫插画，描绘了一位忧郁的年轻女性，呈四分之三侧面，坐着并用一只手托着脸颊。她留着长直的 {argument name="hair color" default="蓝黑色"} 头发，配有齐刘海，皮肤非常苍白，灰蓝色的双眸透着遥远而疲惫的神情。她的脸庞小巧精致，一只眼睛下方有一颗细小的泪痣，睫毛细腻。她穿着深海军蓝和炭灰色的深色超大叠层服装：高领黑色上衣外搭宽松的垂坠外套或和服式外衣，布料上饰有淡淡的金色线条点缀和细小的眼眸图案。她的配饰优雅且带有神秘色彩：多处耳洞，一只长款垂坠耳环，形状为带有泪滴吊坠的眼睛，一条细项链挂着小巧的眼眸吊坠，手上戴着几枚戒指，包括托脸那只手上的眼眸戒指。她的指甲涂着柔和的板岩蓝色。背景为平铺的暖米白色，精心布置着一系列神秘的眼眸符号和悬挂装饰。包含 6 个精准的眼眸主题墙面元素：左上方 1 幅带框眼眸画，其下方 1 个圆形眼眸挂饰，右上方附近 1 个类似靶心的小圆形装饰，最右侧 1 个带有眼眸和几何水晶的黑色挂饰，中右侧 1 个带有放射状眼眸的方形面板，以及右下方 1 个带有眼眸和 4 个泪滴形状的深色矩形面板。左侧添加一个深色瓶子剪影和几片柔和的蓝灰色叶子作为辅助装饰。使用海军蓝、黑色、奶油色、灰蓝色以及少许柔和金色的克制色调。构图应呈现出安静、哥特、柔美且内省的氛围，采用平面的图形形状、清晰的线条、极少的阴影以及现代装饰海报的美学风格。

templates.title: Anime girl walks through the flower bushes

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫少女穿过花丛

templates.prompt: A dreamlike, anime-style low-angle illustration depicts a young female student standing amidst flowers against a bright, clear blue sky. The perspective is near the ground, as if the camera is positioned within the blossoms, looking up at her. She has a light blonde bob with soft bangs, bright blue eyes, fair skin, and a calm yet slightly serious expression. She wears a round, yellow sun hat with a blue ribbon tied at the back, and an oversized light blue cardigan-style dress with a white collar and a badge pinned to her chest.{argument name="name tag text" default="Wu Hua"} She wears designer brands and carries a mustard-yellow crossbody bag. One of her hands is outstretched towards the viewer, palm open, creating a strong close-up perspective. The image should include six striking flowers: two large white cosmos flowers in the left foreground, one large blue flower in the right foreground, one white flower in the upper right background, and two smaller blue flowers near the bottom center. Use soft watercolor textures, delicate lines, light lighting, soft depth of field, and bright, soft colors, primarily sky blue, white, and yellow. The overall atmosphere should be innocent, nostalgic, fresh, and slightly magical, like a combination of children's picture book illustrations and high-end animation artwork.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张梦幻般的动漫风格低角度插画，描绘了一位年轻女学生站在花丛中，背景是明亮清澈的蓝天。视角位于地面附近，仿佛相机正置身于花朵之中仰望她。她留着浅金色短波波头，刘海柔和，有着明亮的蓝色眼睛、白皙的皮肤，表情平静且略带严肃。她戴着一顶圆形的黄色遮阳帽，帽后系着蓝色丝带，身穿一件超大号的浅蓝色罩衫式连衣裙，配有白色领子，胸前别着一个写有 {argument name="name tag text" default="兀華"} 的名牌，并斜挎着一个芥末黄色的挎包。她的一只手向观众伸出，掌心张开，营造出强烈的近景透视效果。画面中需包含 6 朵醒目的花朵：左前景有 2 朵巨大的白色波斯菊，右前景有 1 朵巨大的蓝色花朵，右上背景有 1 朵白色花朵，底部中心附近有 2 朵较小的蓝色花朵。采用柔和的水彩质感、细腻的线条、轻盈的布光、柔和的景深，以及以天蓝色、白色和黄色为主的明亮柔和色调。整体氛围应显得天真、怀旧、清新且带有一丝魔幻感，如同儿童绘本插画与高端动漫原画的结合。

templates.title: Luxury Publishing and Brand Promotion Editing and Layout

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华出版与品牌推广编辑排版

templates.prompt: Create a luxurious Japanese magazine-style PR layout for publishing and branding services, designed as a two-page brochure. The left half features a dark, cinematic portrait scene set in an elegant office lounge: a Japanese businessman in a navy blue bespoke suit, white shirt, dark tie, white pocket square, and wristwatch sits in a leather chair, one hand supporting his chin, lost in thought, with a gleaming wooden table beside him. His face is softly blurred in a rectangular pattern. The lighting is warm and inviting, with reflections from the floor-to-ceiling windows creating a sophisticated executive atmosphere. On this dark left page, a striking and elegant serif English title is placed.{argument name="headline text" default="PUBLISHING BRANDING"} The top left corner features a matte gold finish stacked in two rows. Below this are multiple lines of white Japanese text, including a large subheading and several short, vertically aligned body text paragraphs. Near the bottom left corner is a dark box with a border containing four checkmarked list items with accompanying Japanese text. Page number "02" is placed in the bottom left corner. The right half is a clean white editorial information page, employing sophisticated minimalist typography and ample white space. A striking black Japanese headline is placed slightly to the right of the top center, below which are two short blocks of Japanese text; the upper right corner contains a small image showing four stacked hardcover books and a glass vase near a bright window and greenery. A centered Japanese headline highlighting five key advantages is added to the center of the page, below which are five numbered columns (1 to 5), each containing a short Japanese headline and several lines of smaller Japanese explanatory text. Below, add another centered Japanese workflow title, followed by four horizontally arranged step blocks: STEP 01 with a speech bubble icon, STEP 02 with a pencil icon, STEP 03 with an open book icon, and STEP 04 with a megaphone icon. Each step includes the English word STEP and a two-digit number, a brief Japanese subtitle, and a few lines of smaller Japanese description, connected by small arrows. At the bottom of the right page, place three rectangular photographs side-by-side: a cityscape at an office meeting table, a close-up of someone writing with a pen, and a stack of books near an open book. Below these images, add a striking serif-style Japanese conclusion on the left and a smaller Japanese paragraph on the right. Place the page number "03" in the bottom right corner. A sophisticated color scheme of deep navy blue, black, warm brown, ivory white, and matte gold is used to balance editorial luxury, corporate credibility, and high-end publishing aesthetics. The overall composition should evoke the feel of a genuine magazine advertisement or consulting brochure—refined, realistic, elegant, and credible.

promptLocalized.zh: 为出版与品牌服务创作一份奢华的日式杂志风格公关编辑排版，设计为双页宣传册布局。左半部分为深色电影质感的肖像场景，背景设在精致的办公休息室：一位身着海军蓝定制西装、白衬衫、深色领带、白色口袋巾并佩戴腕表的日本商务人士，坐在皮椅上，单手托腮，姿态沉思，身旁是一张光亮的木质桌子。他的面部经过柔和的矩形模糊处理。灯光氛围感强且温暖，伴有落地窗的倒影，营造出高级行政氛围。在此深色左页上，放置醒目优雅的衬线英文标题 {argument name="headline text" default="PUBLISHING BRANDING"}，以哑光金色分两行堆叠在左上方。下方添加多行白色日文文案，包括一个较大的副标题和几段垂直排列的简短正文。左下角附近包含一个带边框的深色方框，内含 4 个带勾选标记的清单项，并配有日文文本。左下角放置页码“02”。右半部分为简洁的白色编辑信息页，采用精致的极简主义排版和宽裕的留白。顶部中央偏右处放置一个醒目的黑色日文大标题，下方配有两个简短的日文正文块；右上角包含一张小图，展示 4 本堆叠的精装书和一个靠近明亮窗户及绿植的玻璃花瓶。页面中部添加一个居中的日文五大优势标题，下方排列 5 个编号列（1 至 5），每列包含简短的日文标题及几行较小的日文说明文字。下方添加另一个居中的日文工作流程标题，随后横向排列 4 个步骤块：STEP 01 配有对话气泡图标，STEP 02 配有铅笔图标，STEP 03 配有打开的书本图标，STEP 04 配有扩音器图标。每个步骤包含英文单词 STEP 及两位数编号、简短的日文副标题和几行较小的日文描述，步骤之间以小箭头连接。右页底部并排放置 3 张矩形照片：城市景观办公会议桌场景、手持钢笔书写的特写，以及靠近打开书本的一叠书籍。在这些图片下方，左侧添加一段醒目的衬线风格日文结语，右侧添加一段较小的日文段落。右下角放置页码“03”。采用深海军蓝、黑、暖棕、象牙白和哑光金的高级配色，平衡编辑奢华感、企业信任度与高端出版美学。整体构图应呈现出真实杂志广告或咨询手册的质感，精致、写实、优雅且具有公信力。

templates.prompt: A surreal studio portrait features a floating head facing forward, centered against a richly colored blue sky dotted with soft, fluffy white clouds. The face is completely covered by a large, smooth rectangular censor, extending from the forehead to the chin and most of the cheeks. The censor exhibits a subtle gradient from warm brown to soft blue-gray. Only external features are visible: a neatly trimmed buzz cut with dense, dark, speckled hair on top, visible ears, and a rounded chin and jawline. The head wears colored glasses with temples that only cover the sides; the lenses are not visible in the front due to the obscured center. The left temple is light cream with tiny red-gold embellishments, while the right temple is a vibrant red-orange. Two small, rounded protrusions are added near the top edge of the censor, yellow on the left and grayish-white on the right, creating a peculiar, toy-like texture. The rendering effect is a hyper-realistic but slightly eerie 3D illustration with smooth skin, soft sunlight, minimalist composition, and shallow depth of field, presenting a clean and imaginative pop surreal aesthetic.
