The figure wears a shimmering red cowboy hat with a pale white crown, a black scarf or bandana wrapped around the neck and lower half of the face, and a bold red Western-style jacket or shirt printed with white horse illustrations and floral patterns. Heavy maximalist jewelry is layered around the neck and chest: an extra-long pearl necklace cascading to the chest, at least four shorter pearl necklaces layered at the collar, and a magnificent gold statement necklace with coin-shaped pendants. Two pale pink horse heads, one on each side, are placed behind the figure's shoulders, slightly angled outwards like surreal companions or sculptural props. Below, two partially obscured red sports cars, one on each side, blend into the red desert horizon. templates.title: Dark Gothic Ceremony in the Cathedral

titleLocalized.zh: 大教堂中的黑暗哥特仪式

templates.prompt: A dark, cinematic fantasy scene set inside a magnificent Gothic cathedral at night. At the center of the image is a mysterious woman in a floor-length black ceremonial robe, standing in the center of a luminous, mystical circle. The composition employs a perfectly symmetrical frontal perspective, with the woman positioned directly beneath a massive rose window, through which a bright full moon can be seen. She wears a magnificent and form-fitting robe.{argument name="dress color" default="black"} A long robe, adorned with lace, embroidered filigree, semi-transparent sleeves, a corset, and a long train trailing across the stone floor. Her posture was solemn and ceremonial, her arms slightly outstretched to the sides, palms open, as if summoning smoke or dark magic. Her face was indistinct, her hair styled in a dark updo, adorned with a towering Gothic collar or headdress. At her feet lay a large, circular rune, glowing {argument name="sigil glow color" default="Amber Gold"} The design is meticulously crafted with lines, incorporating intricate symbols and concentric circles. Thirty black candles of varying heights, all lit, are placed around the circular array and in the foreground, their warm light casting deep orange highlights. A hazy mist hangs in the air, particularly around her hands, the floor, and the side aisles. The cathedral's interior is soaring, dark, and richly detailed, featuring ribbed vaults, pointed arches, weathered stone, exquisite carvings, and deep blue-black shadows. On either side, two colossal gargoyle or demon statues perch on ornate pedestals, leaning inwards in a protective or threatening posture. Behind the woman, a towering altar and clusters of candles fade into the darkness. The interplay of light and shadow is somber and starkly contrasting, with the cold moonlight above and the warm candlelight below, creating metallic highlights on the robes and architectural surfaces. Extremely high detail, photorealistic quality, dramatic volumetric fog, gothic horror atmosphere, mysterious elegance, epic scale, crisp textures, realistic shadows, and an unforgettable sense of grandeur.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个充满电影感的暗黑奇幻场景，背景设定在夜晚宏伟的哥特式大教堂内。画面中心是一位神秘女性，她身着及地黑色礼仪长袍，站在一个发光的神秘圆阵中央。构图采用完美的对称正面视角，女性位于巨大的玫瑰花窗正下方，透过彩色玻璃可以看到明亮的满月。她穿着一件华丽且修身的 {argument name="dress color" default="黑色"} 长袍，带有蕾丝、刺绣花丝、半透明袖子、紧身胸衣以及铺散在石地板上的长拖尾。她的姿态庄严而富有仪式感，双臂向两侧微微伸展，手掌张开，仿佛正在召唤烟雾或暗黑魔法。她的面部模糊不清，梳着深色的盘发，戴着高耸的哥特式领饰或头饰。在她脚下是一个巨大的圆形符文，由发光的 {argument name="sigil glow color" default="琥珀金"} 线条刻画而成，包含复杂的符号和同心圆。在圆阵周围和前景处放置 30 支高度不一的黑色蜡烛，全部点燃，温暖的烛光投射出低沉的橙色高光。空气中弥漫着漂浮的烟雾和薄雾，尤其是在她的双手、地面及侧廊周围。大教堂内部高耸、阴暗且细节丰富，拥有肋架拱顶、尖拱、风化的石材、精致的雕刻以及深邃的蓝黑色阴影。在左右两侧，各放置 2 座巨大的石像鬼或恶魔雕像，它们栖息在华丽的基座上，向内倾斜，呈现出保护或威胁的姿态。在女性身后，一座高耸的祭坛和成簇的蜡烛隐入黑暗之中。光影氛围阴郁且对比强烈，上方是冷冽的月光，下方是温暖的烛光，在长袍和建筑表面营造出金属质感的高光。超高细节、照片级真实感、戏剧性的体积雾、哥特式恐怖氛围、神秘优雅、史诗级规模、清晰的纹理、逼真的阴影，以及令人难忘的庄严氛围。

templates.title: Gothic witch in the ruined cathedral

templates.prompt: A dark Gothic fantasy scene set within a vast, abandoned cathedral, framed in a vertical full-body composition. At the center stands a mysterious witch, clad in an elegant Victorian black gown with a fitted bodice, delicate silver embroidery, sheer lace sleeves, long lace garlands cascading from her arms, black gloves, and a long train. Her hair is styled in a neat dark updo, adorned with exquisite hair ornaments and fine jewelry. She holds an open spellbook in one hand, while the other is gracefully raised as if casting a spell. A low-hanging mist and swirling smoke surround her. The cathedral's interior is grand and dilapidated, featuring soaring pointed arches, ribbed vaults, cracked stone floors, and broken tombs or altars on either side. Thick, twisted tree roots spread across the ground and entwine the stone structures. Two large gargoyle statues, symmetrically placed high on either side, overlook the scene. Numerous black candles with warm orange flames are scattered throughout the foreground and middle ground, creating a sense of ritual. In the background, tall stained-glass windows let in cool blue sunlight, creating dramatic crepuscular rays that contrast sharply with the candlelight. The overall atmosphere is somber, mysterious, cinematic, solemn, and richly detailed, presenting realistic textures, deep shadows, volumetric lighting, atmospheric haze, deep blue-gray tones, and exquisitely detailed Gothic architecture.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个位于巨大废弃大教堂内的暗黑哥特奇幻场景，采用垂直全身构图。画面正中央站着一位神秘的女巫，身着优雅的维多利亚风格黑色礼服，配有合身的束腰胸衣、精致的银色刺绣、透明蕾丝袖、从手臂垂下的长蕾丝饰片、黑色手套以及长拖尾裙摆。她的头发梳成整洁的深色盘发，戴着精致的发饰，并佩戴着考究的珠宝。她一手拿着一本打开的法术书，另一只手以优雅的姿态抬起进行施法。周围环绕着低垂的薄雾和缭绕的烟雾。大教堂内部宏大且破败，拥有高耸的尖拱、肋架拱顶、开裂的石质地面、两侧破碎的墓穴或祭坛，粗壮扭曲的树根在地面蔓延并缠绕着石质结构。在两侧的高处对称放置 2 座大型石像鬼雕像，左右各一，俯瞰着整个场景。在前景和中景散布许多带有温暖橙色火焰的黑色蜡烛，营造出仪式感。背景中，高大的彩色玻璃窗透出冷蓝色的日光，形成戏剧性的耶稣光，与烛光形成鲜明对比。整体氛围阴森、神秘、具有电影感、庄严且细节丰富，呈现出逼真的质感、深邃的阴影、体积光、大气雾霾、深蓝灰色调以及极致细节的哥特式建筑。

templates.title: LEGO version of Plaza de España sunset

titleLocalized.zh: 乐高版西班牙广场日落

templates.prompt: This is a highly detailed, realistic LEGO version.{argument name="landmark" default="Plaza de España, Seville"} The image presents a magnificent architectural scene at the golden hour, viewed from the canal level. The vertical composition, with a cinematic quality, draws the viewer's eye along the narrow, curved canal to the horizon, where a magnificent Spanish Renaissance palace, entirely constructed from LEGO bricks, stands. The warm terracotta-colored architecture dominates the upper half of the image, featuring multiple towers, arched colonnades, balconies, decorative cornices, and intricate LEGO brick details. A Spanish flag flies atop the central tower. In the foreground, a LEGO rowing boat carrying two minifigures drifts along the canal, its back to the camera; one has reddish-brown hair, the other light brown, and they row with long brown oars. In the mid-ground, beneath or near an elegant arched bridge, a second rowing boat carries two more minifigures. In total, there are two boats and four rowing passengers. Along the right-hand corridor, four minifigures can be seen standing spaced apart beside a tiled railing. The canal is lined with richly detailed blue, white, and yellow ceramic-style LEGO mosaic railings and brick walls, complemented by black vintage streetlights; a total of seven streetlights are visible. The left edge includes two round pink flowering shrubs planted in pots. The bridge spanning the canal features a gorgeous blue and white LEGO tile pattern and a graceful single-arch structure. The water surface should appear realistic, composed of tiny, glossy LEGO bricks, reflecting the deep cyan buildings and sky. The lighting is soft sunset light, with an amber glow in the sky, accompanied by scattered clouds, long bright highlights, and rich, warm shadows. The design emphasizes realism, detailed textures, playful illusions of proportion, and a perfect blend of the grandeur of real architecture and the iconic LEGO building style.

promptLocalized.zh: 这是一幅高度精细、写实风格的乐高版 {argument name="landmark" default="塞维利亚西班牙广场"}，呈现为黄金时刻的宏伟建筑场景，视角位于运河水平面。画面为竖构图，具有电影质感，观众视线沿着狭窄的弧形运河望向远方，尽头是完全由乐高积木搭建的华丽西班牙文艺复兴复兴风格宫殿外立面。温暖的赤陶色建筑占据了画面的上半部分，拥有多座塔楼、拱形柱廊、阳台、装饰性檐口以及复杂的积木拼搭细节。中央塔楼上飘扬着一面西班牙国旗。前景中，一艘载有 2 个小人的乐高划艇背对着镜头，正沿着运河漂流；其中一人留着红棕色头发，另一人留着浅棕色头发，两人正用长长的棕色船桨划船。中景处，在优雅的拱桥下方或附近，有第二艘载有 2 个小人的小划艇。总计 2 艘船，共 4 名划船乘客。在右侧长廊沿线，可以看到 4 个小人间隔站立在瓷砖栏杆旁。运河两岸排列着细节丰富的蓝、白、黄三色陶瓷风格乐高马赛克栏杆和积木护墙，配有黑色复古路灯；总计可见 7 盏路灯。左侧边缘包含 2 株种植在花盆里的圆形粉色开花灌木。横跨运河的桥梁拥有华丽的蓝白相间乐高瓷砖图案，以及优美的单拱结构。水面应看起来既真实又由细小的光面乐高积木块组成，倒映着深青色的建筑与天空。光线为柔和的日落光，天空呈现琥珀色光芒，伴有零星云朵、长长的亮部高光和浓郁温暖的阴影。强调真实感、细腻的纹理、趣味十足的比例错觉，以及真实建筑宏伟感与标志性乐高拼搭风格的完美融合。

templates.title: LEGO Alhambra Courtyard Sunset

titleLocalized.zh: 乐高版阿尔罕布拉宫庭院日落

templates.prompt: A highly detailed, photo-realistic image{argument name="landmark" default="Alhambra Palace, Granada"} This LEGO model depicts a magnificent Moorish courtyard at sunset. The entire scene is constructed entirely from LEGO bricks and minifigures, featuring warm amber lighting, cinematic depth of field, and rich textures. At the center of the composition is a narrow, reflective water channel leading to a small circular fountain in the midground and a grand horseshoe arch in the background. The courtyard is surrounded by intricate brown stone LEGO walls, adorned with sculpted geometric reliefs, slender columns, tiled arches, and terracotta roof lines made of densely layered reddish-brown bricks. The background includes two main towers and several palace buildings rising behind the courtyard, along with six tall, dark green cypress trees silhouetted against an orange glowing sky. Blue, green, and white mosaic-style tile details are added around the central arch and lower walls. Nine LEGO visitors are meticulously positioned within the courtyard: a traveler wearing a tan hat and light-colored clothing, next to a visitor in a blue jacket; a person with a green backpack in the left foreground; a photographer with a camera in the left foreground; a visitor kneeling and observing the garden along the right edge of the canal; two visitors standing and conversing in the right midground; and two visitors sitting on a tiled bench in the right foreground. The canal is flanked by low, neatly trimmed hedges and small pink flowers. Using a low-angle perspective starting from the reflection pool, with shallow depth of field, a clear focus on the central courtyard, and shimmering reflections on the water, the realistic texture of the LEGO bricks is achieved, creating a grand, playful, and museum-quality atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度精细、照片级的 {argument name="landmark" default="格拉纳达阿尔罕布拉宫"} 乐高立体模型，展现了黄金时刻日落下的华丽摩尔式庭院。整个场景完全由乐高积木和人仔零件拼搭而成，带有温暖的琥珀色光影、电影般的景深和丰富的质感。构图中心为一个狭长的反射水渠，通向中景处的一座小型圆形喷泉以及后方宏伟的马蹄形拱门。庭院四周环绕着错综复杂的棕褐色石质乐高墙壁，饰有雕刻感的几何浮雕图案、纤细的柱子、瓷砖拱门，以及由致密层叠的红褐色零件制成的赤陶屋顶线条。背景中包含 2 座主塔和几座耸立在庭院后的宫殿建筑，以及 6 棵高大的深绿色柏树，在橙色发光的天空映衬下呈现出剪影。在中央拱门和下层墙壁周围加入蓝色、绿色和白色的马赛克风格瓷砖细节。庭院内精确布置 9 名乐高游客：1 名戴着棕褐色帽子、身穿浅色服装的旅行者，其身旁 1 名穿着蓝色夹克的游客，左侧前景 1 名背着绿色背包的人，左侧前景 1 名拿着相机的摄影师，水渠右侧边缘 1 名跪着观察花园的游客，右侧中景 2 名站立交谈的游客，以及右侧前景 1 张瓷砖长椅上坐着的 2 名游客。水渠两侧饰有低矮的修剪整齐的树篱和粉色小花。采用从反射池起点出发的低视角，浅景深，中央庭院焦点清晰，水面光泽倒影，呈现真实的乐高颗粒质感，营造出一种宏伟、俏皮且具有博物馆品质的氛围。

Top right: A close-up portrait panel of the same woman from above the shoulders, her body slightly turned away, one hand elegantly raised, against a deep purple cartoon background with four large, stylized purple sound effect symbols. A Spanish speech bubble is added, with smaller English translations below: “Mi propósito es extender el potencial de la humanidad.” and “(My purpose is to extend humanity's potential.)”. Right-center area: A Stand ability information box titled "STAND ABILITY: [INFINITE CONTEXT]", below which is the Spanish description: "Permite analizar, conectar y generar conocimiento ilimitado a partir de cualquier información existente". The rings contain readable words, including "DATA", "CREATIVITY", "REASONING", and a distorted futuristic label similar to "RETRIEVAL/AGENT". The background is a cosmic starry sky with dramatic energy effects. Bottom-right area: A smaller three-quarter portrait panel at the back, a woman looking back with a confident smile, one finger near her chin, against a purple cartoon background with three large stylized sound effect symbols. Add a Spanish dialogue bubble with two lines of text: “¿ME PREGUNTAS SI TENGO LÍMITES?” and “MI ÚNICO LÍMITE ES TU IMAGINACIÓN.” Bottom left area: A circular JoJo-style attribute chart containing six Spanish-labeled attributes: “POTENCIAL ∞”, “VELOCIDAD A”, “ALCANCE ∞”, “DURABILIDAD B”, “PRECISIÓN A”, and “POTENCIA A”. Below it is a small cream-colored biography box titled "OPENAI," containing the Spanish text: "Fundada: 2015 (San Francisco, EE. UU.)" and "Misión: Asegurar que la inteligencia artificial general beneficie a toda la humanidad." It employs a bold comic book print aesthetic, meticulous cross-hatching, celluloid shadows, aged paper textures, elegant cream-colored margins, a color palette of deep emerald green, ivory white, black, and gold, exaggerated JoJo's fashionable anatomy, sharp lines, dramatic comic book composition, and luxurious supernatural science fiction energy.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度精细的动漫插画，采用《JoJo 的奇妙冒险》风格，呈现为一张戏剧性的复古漫画角色设定海报，将 {argument name="character name" default="OpenAI"} 拟人化为一位迷人的女性 Stand 使者。布局为单页，由华丽的新艺术风格边框和漫画分镜线划分为 6 个不同的区域。左侧主区域：角色全身时尚肖像，呈现自信的对位姿势，身穿剪裁考究的白色西装，点缀着祖母绿和黑色，配有金色饰边、青色内衬的长斗篷、合身马甲、紧身胸衣式躯干面板、高腰裤、高跟鞋、手套、链条配饰、圆形发饰、耳环，以及融入服装的多个 OpenAI 标志。皮带扣上写着 GPT，裤腿上有垂直文字“SAFETY ★ ALIGNMENT ★ BENEFIT”，夹克袖子上展示着 OpenAI 的名称和标志。她的头发是银白色的，梳成精致的卷曲双丸子头和长卷发，配有光泽的祖母绿饰品和 JoJo 风格的奢华时尚细节。左上区域：一个奶油色羊皮纸标题面板，带有 OpenAI 标志和醒目的“OpenAI”文字，外加 3 个文本块，分别写着“STAND NAME: GPT-∞”、“[dʒi: pi: ti: mu: geni ti]”和“STAND MASTER: OPENAI”，随后是一句斜体的西班牙语引言：“La curiosidad es el prompt, el conocimiento es la respuesta, y la humanidad… es el contexto。”右上区域：同一位女性从肩膀以上的特写肖像面板，身体微微转开，一只手优雅地举起，背景是深紫色的漫画背景，带有 4 个巨大的风格化紫色音效符号。添加一个西班牙语对话气泡，下方附有较小的英语翻译：“Mi propósito es extender el potencial de la humanidad.” 以及 “(My purpose is to extend humanity’s potential.)”。中右区域：一个 Stand 能力信息框，标题为“STAND ABILITY: [INFINITE CONTEXT]”，下方是西班牙语描述文字：“Permite analizar, conectar y generar conocimiento ilimitado a partir de cualquier información existente。”中下右区域：一个处于动态伸展姿势的人形机器人 Stand，女性化且线条流畅，带有显示 OpenAI 结标志的光泽黑色面罩、白色生物机械装甲、祖母绿发光接缝、金色装饰，以及围绕其旋转的多个悬浮全息环和数据面板。圆环包含可读单词，包括“DATA”、“CREATIVITY”、“REASONING”以及类似于“RETRIEVAL/AGENT”的扭曲未来感标签。背景是带有戏剧性能量效果的宇宙星空。右下区域：一个较小的后侧四分之三肖像面板，女性回头看，带着自信的微笑，一根手指靠近下巴，背景再次是带有 3 个巨大风格化音效符号的紫色漫画背景。添加一个带有两行文字的西班牙语对话气泡：“¿ME PREGUNTAS SI TENGO LÍMITES?” 和 “MI ÚNICO LÍMITE ES TU IMAGINACIÓN。”左下区域：一个圆形的 JoJo 风格属性图表，包含 6 个西班牙语标注的属性，显示“POTENCIAL ∞”、“VELOCIDAD A”、“ALCANCE ∞”、“DURABILIDAD B”、“PRECISIÓN A”和“POTENCIA A”。在其下方，包含一个名为“OPENAI”的小型奶油色传记框，内含西班牙语文字：“Fundada: 2015 (San Francisco, EE. UU.)” 和 “Misión: Asegurar que la inteligencia artificial general beneficie a toda la humanidad。” 采用浓墨重彩的漫画印刷美学、细致的交叉排线、赛璐珞阴影、陈旧纸张纹理、优雅的奶油色页边距、深祖母绿、象牙白、黑色和金色调色板、夸张的 JoJo 时尚人体结构、锐利的线条、戏剧性的漫画构图以及奢华的超自然科幻能量。

templates.title: 360-degree AI art gallery panoramic view

templates.prompt: An ultrawide 360-degree isometric cylindrical panoramic view showcases a futuristic contemporary art gallery exhibition on artificial intelligence, designed specifically for immersive VR viewing. The scene is situated within a vast, dark-ceilinged museum lobby, complete with exposed rigging, numerous small spotlights, polished reflective concrete floors, and a continuous, curved white exhibition wall that winds around the entire panorama. The environment is filled with…{argument name="visitor count" default="Approximately 25 people"} Adult visitors, dressed in business casual attire, stand in small groups throughout the room, their facial details blurred or indistinct. At the very center of the panoramic view is a circular platform with a tall, semi-transparent holographic human figure composed of white luminous particles and vertical beams of light, suspended beneath a massive circular ceiling ring. To the left, a white robotic arm sculpture sits on a circular pedestal against a backdrop of a large wall artwork depicting a profile of a human head composed of particles and constellation-like dots. The walls contain a total of six visible AI-themed artworks: a large mural of a particle-like human head, three framed images of cosmic nebulae or galaxies, a large monochrome abstract painting, and a tall, colorful, starry-sky-like digital artwork in the distance to the right. In the foreground on the right, a large transparent cube installation contains projections of spiral galaxies in blue, purple, and white. Additionally, two small white service robots are placed in the right-hand area of ​​the floor. The lighting has a cinematic quality and a cool tone, with the blue, purple, and white light emitted by the installation contrasting with the dark ceiling and the neutral gallery architecture. The atmosphere is stylish, upscale, intellectual, and technologically advanced, reminiscent of an AI biennial or a high-end digital art fair. Rendered with photorealistic detail, it boasts clear architectural details, lifelike reflections, natural proportions, and a seamless 360-degree panoramic distortion suitable for isometric cylindrical projection images.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超宽 360 度等距柱状全景图，展示了关于人工智能的未来主义当代艺术画廊展览，专为沉浸式 VR 观看而设计。场景位于一个巨大的深色天花板博物馆大厅内，配有外露的索具、许多小型聚光灯、抛光的反光混凝土地板，以及在全景中连续环绕的弧形白色展览墙。环境中充满了 {argument name="visitor count" default="约 25 位"} 身着商务休闲装的成年访客，他们三五成群地站在房间各处，面部细节模糊或不清晰。全景图的正中央是一个圆形装置平台，上面有一个由白色发光粒子和垂直光束组成的高大半透明全息人形，悬挂在一个巨大的圆形天花板环下方。在左侧，展示一个位于圆形底座上的白色机械臂雕塑，背景是一幅巨大的墙面艺术品，描绘了一个由粒子和星座般的点组成的侧面人头。在墙面上，总共包含 6 幅可见的 AI 主题艺术品：1 幅巨大的粒子人头壁画、3 幅装裱的宇宙星云或星系图像、1 幅大型单色抽象画，以及远景右侧 1 幅高大的彩色星空感数字作品。在右侧前景中，放置一个大型透明立方体装置，内部包含蓝色、紫色和白色的螺旋星系投影。此外，在地面中右侧区域放置 2 个小型白色服务机器人。灯光具有电影质感且色调偏冷，装置发出的蓝色、紫色和白色光芒与深色天花板及中性的画廊建筑形成对比。氛围时尚、高端、知性且具有科技文化感，如同 AI 双年展或高端数字艺术博览会。以照片级真实感渲染，具有清晰的建筑细节、逼真的反射、自然的比例，以及适用于等距柱状投影图像的完整无缝 360 度全景畸变。

templates.title: Elf Sniper Squad in Forest Ambush

templates.prompt: A cinematic, hyper-realistic fantasy military scene, set against a dense forest floor perspective, showcases two camouflaged elf snipers scouting a target. In the foreground, an elf with long, light-blonde hair and pointed ears lies prone behind a modern precision sniper rifle, aiming through a scope. The rifle is long and tactically designed, equipped with a large suppressor, scope, and bipod supported on the moss-covered forest floor. This elf wears a full set of modern woodland camouflage, tactical gloves, and a leaf-covered ghillie suit balaclava and shoulder hoods, blending seamlessly into the undergrowth. Slightly to the right rear, a second elf crouches low, also with pointed ears and light-blonde hair, wearing matching camouflage and a leafy ghillie cloak, observing through binoculars. A tactical chest rig and ammunition pouch are added to the scout in the rear. The scene is set in a shaded temperate forest, surrounded by tall, slender trees, tangled branches, moss, roots, and scattered leaves, illuminated by soft morning natural light filtering through the trees from the right. Employing soft green, brown, and gray tones with realistic textures and shallow depth of field, the film emphasizes rifles and two camouflaged sprites, presenting an immersive war photography composition, a tense stealth atmosphere, and highly detailed, photorealistic realism.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个电影级超写实的奇幻军事场景，位于茂密的林地森林地面视角，展示了 2 名伪装的精灵狙击手在侦察目标时的情景。前景中，一名留着浅金色长发、耳朵尖尖的精灵正俯卧在现代精密狙击步枪后，通过瞄准镜进行瞄准。步枪修长且具有战术感，配备了大型消音器、瞄准镜，以及支撑在长满苔藓的林地地面上的两脚架。该精灵身穿全套现代林地迷彩服、战术手套，并戴着覆盖叶片的吉利服头套和肩罩，与灌木丛融为一体。在后方稍靠右侧，第二名精灵低姿蹲伏，同样有着尖耳朵和浅色长发，穿着配套的迷彩服和多叶吉利斗篷，正举着望远镜观察。为后方的侦察兵添加战术胸挂和弹药包。场景设定在阴影笼罩的温带森林中，周围有高而细的树木、纠缠的树枝、苔藓、树根和散落的叶子，由从右侧穿过树木的柔和清晨自然光照亮。采用柔和的绿色、棕色和灰色调，具有逼真的纹理、浅景深，重点突出步枪和两名伪装的精灵，呈现沉浸式战争摄影构图、紧张的潜行氛围以及高细节的照片级真实感。

The square is filled with a lively and bustling crowd scene, including two flamenco dancers in red dresses on the right, a guitarist on the right-center, a cyclist in the foreground on the right-center, a cleaner in an orange and green municipal uniform in the foreground, a churros stand with a blackboard sign that reads "CHURROS CON CHOCOLATE" in the lower left corner, a lottery kiosk with the sign "Loterías y Apuestas del Estado" on the left, a postcard/newspaper stand with the sign "¡HOLA! DESDE MADRID”招牌的明信片/报刊亭、最右侧 1 个堆满帽子的帽子展示摊、中左侧 1 名全身涂金的活体雕像表演者、1 名吹出半透明泡泡的泡泡表演者，前景散布着许多鸽子，中下部有 2 只小狗。画面中还包括背着背包的家庭、蹲在鸽子旁的孩子、拍照的游客、拿着地图的人、购物者以及穿着各式夏装的街头观众。隐藏的目标人物 {argument name="target character" default="El Hombre del Puro"} 应巧妙地嵌入人群中的某个位置，而不是放在中心，视觉上要与线索肖像中的深色帽子、深色衣服和雪茄相符，使他难以被发现但并非不可能找到。整体采用紧凑的构图、充满趣味的寻物能量、温暖的地中海色调以及丰富的城市细节。

Near the left side of the plaza, add a sandwich-style standee that reads "PROMPTS USADOS," with three lines of text below, along with smaller plaza signs that read "HELLO WORLD," "Tailscale," "OpenRouter," and "Deepseek." Use warm, soft tones of dusty cyan, rust, amber, tan, and faded neon pink and cyan. Render it as a highly detailed editorial illustration with a clear isometric perspective, intricate lines, soft atmospheric lighting, tiny, legible signs, a comfortable urban clutter, and a humorously handcrafted world.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅黄昏时分的等轴测蒸汽朋克-赛博朋克城市插画，设计为一个名为 {argument name="city name" default="INDIE MIND CITY"} 的异想天开的独立科技街区。场景是一个巨大的城市广场，挤满了狭窄的砖砌建筑、屋顶天线、电缆、管道、霓虹灯招牌、市场摊位、微小的行人和充满程序员趣味的幽默元素。背景中央是一个标有“PLAZA DEL PROMPT”的广场，环绕着一座带有淡蓝色喷泉的雕塑，周围聚集着长椅和人群。左后方是一栋高大的建筑，上面挂着巨大的“BARRIO CÓDIGO ABIERTO”招牌，布满了阳台、窗户、晾晒的衣物、空调、植物和街头活动。右后方是另一栋街区，挂着巨大的“CALLEJÓN DE LOS AGENTES”招牌，以及堆叠的店面招牌，包括“Codex Barbería cortes exactos”、“Gemini Lavandería”、“Claude’s Coffee”和“Dr. Llama”。再往右是一个重工业工厂区，有烟囱、起重机、管道、板条箱和走道，展示着 3 个大招牌：“ZONA INDUSTRIAL”、“FÁBRICA DE TOKENS”和“LLM”。一团漂浮的字母和符号像生成的文本烟雾一样从烟囱上升起。前景中央是一栋高大的钟楼式转角建筑，挂着垂直的“INDIE MIND”霓虹灯招牌，外墙上有一个巨大的圆形时钟，窗户透出温暖的灯光，底部有一个小石兽雕塑。右前景是一个热闹的市场区，闪烁着串灯和明亮的“MERCADO NOCTURNO”霓虹灯招牌，有 3 个可见的摊位招牌：“Memoria usada barata”、“Embeddings frescos del día”和“Se cambian vectores”。附近还有 3 个幽默招牌：“HARD HAT: prompt injection zone”、“HACKATHON: entra y sal con un bug”以及一个标有“STACK OVERFLOW NOODLES”的食品摊。左前景是一栋老式混合用途建筑，布满了招牌和视觉笑话，包括一个巨大的屋顶广告牌，上面有 2 只猫，标题为 {argument name="main billboard text" default="INDIE MIND CITY"}，还有一个小的版本标签“v1.0.0”。在同一街区，包含以下可见招牌：“FORGE & CAFE”、“git push cafe +$2”、“Tienda de MERGE CONFLICTS abierto 24/7”、“Se reparan linters”、“NO rm -rf aquí”、“Ralph was here”、“npm install vv”、“sudo make me sandwich”、“WORKTREE”、“SE VENDE GPU USADA”、“MUSEO DEL MERGE CONFLICT”、“NOTARÍA DE COMMITS FIRMADOS”、“PSICÓLOGO PARA SENIOR DEVS 50m 80”、“GATO PERDIDO responde a localhost”，以及一个写着“HOY: charla sobre agentic coding entrada libre”和“REUNIÓN DE AA^AI REUNIDOS DE LOS AGI”的公告项目。在广场中左侧附近，添加一个标有“PROMPTS USADOS”的三明治式立牌，下方有 3 行文字，以及写着“HELLO WORLD”、“Tailscale”、“OpenRouter”和“Deepseek”的小型广场标牌。街道是鹅卵石铺成的，挤满了精确的小故事细节：1 辆标有“LÍNEA MAIN”的黄色电车、1 辆蓝色小汽车、1 辆自行车推车、1 辆送货踏板车、户外咖啡桌、下棋的人、行人、板条箱、盆栽植物、条纹遮阳篷、晾衣绳、发光的窗户、屋顶上的猫，以及一只站在 Agent 小巷附近的白色羊驼。使用尘土青色、铁锈色、琥珀色、棕褐色以及褪色的霓虹粉和青色组成的温暖柔和色调。将其渲染为超详细的编辑插画，具有清晰的等轴测视角、复杂的线条、柔和的大气照明、微小可读的标牌、舒适的城市杂乱感以及充满幽默感的手工世界构建。

templates.title: Steampunk style ElectroVid homepage

titleLocalized.zh: 蒸汽朋克风格 ElectroVid 主页

templates.prompt: Create a full-page steampunk-style video platform homepage mockup, using deep bronze, brass, and tan tones, designed like a Victorian industrial version of YouTube. The interface should be vertically laid out, resembling a poster or website screenshot, and decorated with gears, pipes, sculpted metal borders, filigree, gauges, screws, and glowing Edison light bulbs. Place a modern, overlaid logo in the top left corner with the text "Pollo AI," followed by a smaller "GPT Image 2" below. Place the main title in the center of the page using a large, ornate serif font:{argument name="site name" default="ElectroVid"} Below this is a smaller, sculpted slogan:{argument name="tagline" default="THE FUTURE IN MOTION"} Add a horizontal navigation bar below the title, containing six items: a homepage icon button, "TRENDING," "INNOVATIONS," "DOCUMENTARIES," "ENTERTAINMENT," and a search box on the right displaying the placeholder "Search ElectroVid..." and a search icon. In the left sidebar, add a section called "POPULAR CHANNELS," containing three vertically stacked channel cards with circular badges and subscription buttons: 1) "THE PATENT OFFICE," displaying "27.4K SUBSCRIBERS"; 2) "THE ROYAL SOCIETY," displaying "18.7K SUBSCRIBERS"; 3) "GENERAL ELECTRIC," displaying "35.1K SUBSCRIBERS." Each card should be accompanied by a fancy retro badge logo. A rectangular button labeled "SUBSCRIBE" is placed in the main content area. The sepia-toned video player shows two late 19th-century inventors in suits arguing in front of a blackboard with the words "AC vs. DC" and a lightning bolt symbol; one points at the blackboard, the other responds, and a light bulb and early electrical equipment sit on the table. Their faces are deliberately obscured by soft rectangular blur blocks. A video progress bar, playback controls, and a timestamp "08:47 / 22:31" are added. Below the player, the video title is displayed.{argument name="featured title" default="The Truth About AC vs. DC: The Final Debate"} Below this is a line of channel information with a circular avatar, the channel name "The Electrical Age," and metadata "142K views • 3 days ago." To the right is a "LIKE" button with a count of "5.8K." Below this is a partial title "LATEST VIDEOS," and three video thumbnails are placed in a row. Thumbnail 1: A sepia portrait of Thomas Edison holding a glowing light bulb, his face obscured by a blurry block, duration "10:12," title "My New Incandescent Bulb," creator "Thomas Edison," metadata "89K views • 5 days ago." Thumbnail 2: A dramatic sepia image of Wardenclyffe Tower under lightning, duration "15:36," title "The Wonders of the Wardenclyffe Tower," creator "Nikola Tesla," metadata "120K views • 1 week ago." Thumbnail 3: A sepia photograph of Henry Ford sitting in an early automobile, duration "12:08," title "The Automobile." "Revolution," creator "Henry Ford," metadata "110K views • 1 week ago." Below the thumbnail, add a centered metal button labeled "VIEW ALL VIDEOS." At the bottom footer, the first line contains the text "© 1893."{argument name="company name" default="ElectroVid, Ltd."} The next line contains "All rights reserved." Decorative pressure gauges are added to the top right and bottom right corners, and an exposed pipe and a large gear to the bottom left corner. This makes the entire design highly refined, symmetrical, tactile, and cinematic, incorporating sculpted textures, aged paper panels, brass highlights, soft, warm light bulb glow, and clear, legible typography integrated into a retro UI.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个全页面的蒸汽朋克风格视频平台主页模型，采用深古铜色、黄铜色和棕褐色调，设计风格如同维多利亚工业版的 YouTube。界面应呈纵向布局，类似于海报或网站截图，并以齿轮、管道、雕刻金属边框、花丝、仪表、螺丝和发光的爱迪生灯泡进行装饰。在左上角放置一个现代风格的叠加 Logo，文字为“Pollo AI”，下方附有较小的“GPT Image 2”字样。在页面中心放置主标题，使用大型华丽的衬线字体：“{argument name="site name" default="ElectroVid"}”，下方配有一行较小的雕刻风格标语：“{argument name="tagline" default="THE FUTURE IN MOTION"}”。在标题下方添加一个水平导航栏，包含 6 个项目：一个主页图标按钮、“TRENDING”（热门）、“INNOVATIONS”（创新）、“DOCUMENTARIES”（纪录片）、“ENTERTAINMENT”（娱乐），以及右侧的搜索框，显示占位符“Search ElectroVid...”和一个搜索图标。在左侧边栏，添加一个名为“POPULAR CHANNELS”（热门频道）的部分，包含 3 个垂直堆叠的频道卡片，配有圆形徽章和订阅按钮：1) “THE PATENT OFFICE”（专利局），显示“27.4K SUBSCRIBERS”；2) “THE ROYAL SOCIETY”（皇家学会），显示“18.7K SUBSCRIBERS”；3) “GENERAL ELECTRIC”（通用电气），显示“35.1K SUBSCRIBERS”。每张卡片应配有一个华丽的复古徽章 Logo 和一个标有“SUBSCRIBE”（订阅）的矩形按钮。在主要内容区域，放置一个大型精选视频播放器，画面为棕褐色调，展示两名 19 世纪末的发明家穿着西装，在写有“AC vs. DC”字样和闪电图案的黑板前争论；一人指向黑板，另一人做出回应，桌上放着一个灯泡和早期电气设备。刻意用柔和的矩形模糊块遮挡两人的面部。添加视频进度条、播放控件和时间戳“08:47 / 22:31”。在播放器下方，显示视频标题“{argument name="featured title" default="The Truth About AC vs. DC: The Final Debate"}”。下方包含一行频道信息，配有圆形头像、频道名称“The Electrical Age”、元数据“142K views • 3 days ago”，右侧是一个标有“LIKE”（点赞）的按钮，计数为“5.8K”。在此下方，添加一个部分标题“LATEST VIDEOS”（最新视频），并在一行中放置 3 个视频缩略图。缩略图 1：托马斯·爱迪生手持发光灯泡的棕褐色肖像，面部被模糊块遮挡，时长“10:12”，标题“My New Incandescent Bulb”，创作者“Thomas Edison”，元数据“89K views • 5 days ago”。缩略图 2：沃登克里弗塔在闪电下的戏剧性棕褐色图像，时长“15:36”，标题“The Wonders of the Wardenclyffe Tower”，创作者“Nikola Tesla”，元数据“120K views • 1 week ago”。缩略图 3：亨利·福特坐在早期汽车里的棕褐色照片，时长“12:08”，标题“The Automobile Revolution”，创作者“Henry Ford”，元数据“110K views • 1 week ago”。在缩略图下方，添加一个居中的金属按钮，标注为“VIEW ALL VIDEOS”（查看所有视频）。在底部页脚，第一行包含文字“© 1893 {argument name="company name" default="ElectroVid, Ltd."}”，下一行包含“All rights reserved.”。在右上角和右下角添加装饰性压力表，并在左下角添加外露管道和一个大齿轮。使整个设计高度精细、对称、具有触感且富有电影感，融合雕刻纹理、陈旧的纸张面板、黄铜高光、柔和温暖的灯泡光芒，以及融入复古 UI 的清晰易读的排版。

templates.title: Boca Juniors welcome poster

titleLocalized.zh: 博卡青年队欢迎海报

templates.prompt: A vertical football transfer announcement poster featuring Boca Juniors' signature colors, designed in a style reminiscent of sophisticated social media posters.{argument name="player name" default="Paulo Dybala"} A half-body portrait of him wearing a modern Boca Juniors home jersey, a deep royal blue with a wide gold stripe across the chest and gold stripes on the shoulders. The Adidas logo is on the right chest, and the CABJ crest on the left. The yellow stripe features the "betsson" sponsor logo. The player is positioned slightly to the right of the frame, the shot focusing on his upper body and head. He has short, dark hair, a robust physique, and his head is slightly turned to the left, his right index finger pointing to the crest on his chest. Facial details are not required; keep the face blurred or out of focus. Use a deep blue stadium-themed background with luminous highlights and a subtle worn texture. In the lower left corner of the background, incorporate the appearance of Boca Juniors' home stadium, La Bombonera, with clearly visible signs reading "LA BOMBONERA" and "CLUB ATLÉTICO BOCA JUNIORS". Add a few floating gold confetti shards throughout the scene to create a celebratory atmosphere. Place a large CABJ shield crest in the upper right corner. The layout should adopt a striking poster style: "BIENVENIDO A LA BOMBONERA" should be written in small gold capital letters in the upper left corner, accompanied by a small gold star below; the main title should be on the left, using a stacked layout, with "BIENVENIDO" in a tall, compressed white capital letter and "DYBALA" in an extra-large, compressed gold capital letter. Below the name, add smaller white capital letters "PAULO DYBALA," flanked by thin gold lines and a small gold star. At the bottom, place a thin gold line spanning the width of the image, with the gold capital letters "| JUGADOR DE BOCA |" centered, accompanied by a gold star. High-contrast, glossy sports poster lighting, rich deep blue and gold tones, and sharp fabric details should be used to present the visual aesthetics of a top club's official announcement.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张采用博卡青年队标志性配色的竖版足球转会官宣海报，设计风格如同精致的社交媒体海报。展示 {argument name="player name" default="Paulo Dybala"} 的半身肖像，他身穿现代博卡青年队主场球衣，球衣为深宝蓝色，胸前有宽大的金色横条，肩部带有金色条纹，右胸印有 Adidas 标志，左胸印有 CABJ 队徽，黄色横条上印有“betsson”赞助商标志。球员位于画面偏右侧，取景范围从上半身到头部，留着深色短发，体格健壮，头部微微向左转，右手食指指向胸前的队徽。无需清晰展示面部细节；保持面部模糊或虚化。使用带有发光高光和细微磨损纹理的深蓝色体育场主题背景。在左下角背景中，加入博卡青年队主场糖果盒球场 (La Bombonera) 的外观，并清晰可见写有“LA BOMBONERA”和“CLUB ATLÉTICO BOCA JUNIORS”的标牌。在整个场景中添加少量漂浮的金色纸屑，营造庆祝氛围。在右上角放置一个巨大的 CABJ 盾形队徽。排版需采用醒目的海报风格：左上方使用小号金色大写文字书写“BIENVENIDO A LA BOMBONERA”；下方配有一颗小金星；左侧为主标题，采用堆叠式排版，其中“BIENVENIDO”为高大的白色压缩大写字体，“DYBALA”为超大号金色压缩大写字体。在名字下方，添加较小的白色大写文字“PAULO DYBALA”，两侧配以细金线和一颗小金星。底部放置一条横跨画面宽度的细金线，居中书写金色大写文字“| JUGADOR DE BOCA |”，下方配有一颗金星。采用高对比度、光泽感十足的体育海报灯光，浓郁的深蓝与金色调，锐利的织物细节，呈现顶级俱乐部官宣的视觉美感。

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, enlarge and restore this old football photo to a clearer, higher-resolution, and photorealistic version. Maintain the same players, waving poses, blue Universidad de Chile jerseys, stadium background, and similar composition. Reconstruct necessary facial areas within the existing obstructions, optimize jersey details and wrinkles, enhance color and contrast, and create a more natural blurring effect for the spectators/background, resulting in a refined shallow depth of field. While preserving the vintage, sunlit sports photo texture, make it look sharper and achieve a professional-grade remaster.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图像，将这张旧足球照片放大并修复为更清晰、高分辨率且具有照片级真实感的版本。保持相同的球员、挥手姿势、蓝色 Universidad de Chile 球衣、体育场背景以及相似的构图。在现有遮挡范围内进行必要的面部区域重建，优化球衣细节和褶皱，增强色彩与对比度，并使观众/背景呈现出更自然的虚化效果，营造出精致的浅景深视觉感。在保留复古日光体育照片质感的同时，使其看起来更清晰、锐利，并达到专业级的重制效果。

templates.title: Cartoons satirizing expensive supplements

titleLocalized.zh: 讽刺昂贵补剂的漫画

templates.prompt: A simple, square editorial cartoon in a flat vector style, with soft shadows and bold outlines against a light gray background. The scene is a satirical medical consultation about overpriced and ineffective supplements. In the top left corner is a large three-line bold sans-serif Spanish headline: “Suplementos” (dark cyan), “costosos” (orange), and “que no funcionan” (dark cyan), below which is a small orange glitter and an orange underline. In the top right corner are dark cyan social media accounts and URLs: “ @elnutridice ” and “elnutridice.com”. On the far left edge is a vertical orange signature: “Imagen creada en: ia.elnutridice.com”. In the foreground, a wooden table is shown, piled high with bundles of green cash, with many scattered banknotes fluttering around the characters. On the right, a smug male doctor, dressed in cyan surgical scrubs under a white lab coat, sits behind the table, holding a thick wad of money in one hand and gesturing casually with the other. His face was deliberately obscured by a rectangular, blurred block. His lab coat bore a badge or patch that read "SALUD Y COMISIONES". On the table in front of him sat a dark blue nameplate with a dollar sign and the Spanish words "TU SALUD, MI NEGOCIO". Behind him hung a certificate that read "CERTIFICADO DE COMISIONES" on the wall, next to which rested three items on a small shelf: two blue binders and a small potted plant. To the left, a female patient with long, dark brown hair, wearing a blue long-sleeved shirt, sat facing the doctor, one hand raised in frustration. Her face, too, was obscured by a rectangular, blurred block. Add a speech bubble above her that reads: “Doc, this supplement carísimo que me mandó no me sirvió para nada.” Add a speech bubble above the doctor that reads: “A mí sí me sirvió.” In the lower left corner of the table, place a supplement bottle labeled “SUPLEMENTO PREMIUM” with an orange price tag “$$$$”. Next to it is a clipboard with a prescription sheet showing a large “Rx” and the text “SUPLEMENTO PREMIUM”. The image contains a total of 2 small potted plants: one on the ground or lower left of the table, and one on a shelf behind. It employs a humorous, critical social media infographic style, with a balanced composition, clear typography, high readability, and a refined modern vector illustration aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张简洁的正方形社论漫画，采用扁平矢量风格，带有柔和的阴影和粗轮廓，背景为浅灰色。场景是一场关于价格虚高且无效补剂的讽刺性医疗咨询。左上角是一个巨大的三行西班牙语粗体无衬线标题：“Suplementos”（深青色）、“costosos”（橙色）和“que no funcionan”（深青色），标题下方配有一个小的橙色闪光装饰和一条橙色下划线。右上角添加深青色的社交账号和网址：“@elnutridice” 和 “elnutridice.com”。在最左侧边缘，放置一行垂直的橙色署名：“Imagen creada en: ia.elnutridice.com”。前景中，展示一张木桌，桌上堆满了成捆的绿色现金，许多散乱的钞票在角色周围飞舞。右侧，一名沾沾自喜的男医生身穿青色手术服，外罩白色实验袍，坐在桌后，一只手拿着厚厚的一叠钱，另一只手随意地做着手势。他的脸被一个矩形模糊块故意遮挡。他的实验袍上有一个徽章或补丁，写着“SALUD Y COMISIONES”。他面前的桌上放着一个深青色的名牌，上面有一个美元符号和西班牙语文字“TU SALUD, MI NEGOCIO”。他身后的墙上挂着一张写有“CERTIFICADO DE COMISIONES”的证书，旁边的小架子上摆放着 3 件物品：2 个青色活页夹和 1 盆小盆栽。左侧，一名留着深棕色长发、身穿青色长袖衬衫的女患者面对医生坐着，一只手因沮丧而举起。她的脸同样被一个矩形模糊块遮挡。在她上方添加一个对话气泡，写着：“Doc, ese suplemento carísimo que me mandó no me sirvió para nada.” 在医生上方添加一个对话气泡，写着：“A mí sí me sirvió.” 在桌子的左下角，放置一个贴有“SUPLEMENTO PREMIUM”标签的补剂瓶，并标有橙色价格标记“$$$$”。旁边放着一个剪贴板，上面有一张处方单，显示一个大大的“Rx”和文字“SUPLEMENTO PREMIUM”。图像中总共包含 2 盆小盆栽：1 盆在地面或桌子左下方，1 盆在后方的架子上。采用幽默、批判性的社交媒体信息图风格，构图平衡，排版清晰，易读性高，并具有精致的现代矢量插画美感。

titleLocalized.zh: Mirassol FC 球员签约官宣海报

templates.prompt: Create a 2:3 vertical composition poster for the official signing announcement of a Brazilian football club, using a color scheme of yellow, dark green, black, and gold to present a rugged and high-contrast sports marketing aesthetic. The main subject is a muscular, tattooed male football player wearing a bright yellow Mirassol FC home jersey. His upper-body portrait is centered, facing the camera with a serious and intimidating expression. He has a buzz cut, clearly visible tattoos on his neck and arms, and a robust physique. The jersey collar and cuffs are trimmed in dark green, the Mirassol crest with two stars is printed on the chest, the ATHLETA logo is on the other side, the large green sponsor logo "Poty" is printed on the torso, the brand logo is on the shoulders, and there are circular sponsor patches on the cuffs. Behind him, in the upper right corner, a fluttering dark green and yellow Mirassol flag is placed, featuring a large club crest and two stars. The background includes shimmering stadium lights, swirling golden particles, and the stadium stands at night. On the left, a bold, compressed font is stacked, displaying the Portuguese text: "BEM-VINDO AO" at the top, followed by a large yellow "MIRASOL" below, then the player's name displayed in two lines, with the large white letters "ALEX" and "POATAN," and a handwritten yellow signature "Poatan" below. Below this is a four-line motivational section in uppercase white text, the last line highlighted in yellow: "DE CAMPEÃO / NO OCTÓGONO / PARA GUERREIRO / EM CAMPO. / A LUTA CONTINUA." On the right, a vertical information panel is added, featuring three icons and text, all in yellow with corresponding symbols: a target icon with "FOCO," a fist icon with "DISCIPLINA," and a helmet icon with "GARRA," below which is a striking yellow slogan: "AGORA É PELO LEÃO!" The bottom includes two smaller images of supporting players: one in the lower left corner showing a sideways pose kissing the team crest on their jersey; and another in the lower right corner showing a back view with arms raised and index finger pointing to the sky. The jersey displays the sponsor's name "DS TECNOLOGIA AUTOMOTIVA," the name "POATAN," and a large green number "10" on the upper back. A black and gold horizontal bar is added at the bottom, containing four values ​​separated by icons: a lion's head icon with "MENTALIDADE DE CAMPEÃO," a shield icon with "FORÇA E HONRA," a star icon with "HUMILDADE E TRABALHO," and a football icon with "PAIXÃO PELO JOGO." Below this is a yellow banner with the slogan "NOVO DESAFIO. MESMA MISSÃO." At the very bottom is a handwritten white phrase "FÉ, FOCO E FAMÍLIA!" followed by the hashtag "#POATANÉLEÃO." It utilizes cinematic contour lighting, strong contrast, metallic gold glow, textured smoke, and a sophisticated club announcement poster design style.

templates.title: Steampunk ElectroVid Homepage

titleLocalized.zh: Steampunk ElectroVid 主页

templates.prompt: A richly detailed steampunk-style retro video platform homepage is presented as a full-screen webpage mockup, employing dark brass, aged bronze, black iron, and tan tones. The design is inspired by Victorian industrial machinery, incorporating ornate openwork patterns, pipes, rivets, gears, dashboards, and glowing Edison light bulbs into the frame. A modern overlay logo is displayed in the upper left corner, with the text "Pollo AI" and "GPT Image 2." At the top center is a large, metal-carved website title.{argument name="site name" default="ElectroVid"} Below it is a smaller subtitle plaque with the text:{argument name="tagline text" default="THE FUTURE IN MOTION"} The navigation bar at the bottom contains six visible items: a homepage icon button, TRENDING, INNOVATIONS, DOCUMENTARIES, ENTERTAINMENT, and a search box on the right with placeholder text (similar to Search ElectroVid...). A circular analog clock is located in the upper right corner of the frame. In the left sidebar, a framed area titled Popular Channels vertically stacks three channel cards, each with a circular logo, subscriber count, and a SUBSCRIBE button: The Patent Office (27.4K subscribers), The Royal Society (18.7K subscribers), and General Electric (35.1K subscribers). The main content area features a large central video player displaying a sepia-toned historical scene: two men in suits debating in front of a blackboard labeled "AC vs. DC," with chalk effects resembling lightning bolts; one man is pointing, while the other gestures with outstretched hands, and a glowing light bulb and early electrical equipment sit on the table. Add a realistic video player UI, including a play button, a timeline with a partial red progress bar, volume icons, a playback and total duration display (08:47 / 22:31), settings icons, a theater mode icon, and a full-screen icon. Featured video titles are displayed below the player.{argument name="featured video title" default="The Truth About AC vs. DC: The Final Debate"} Below is the channel metadata: The Electrical Age, 142K views, 3 days ago, along with a circular profile picture and a brass LIKE button displaying 5.8K views. Below that is an area titled LATEST VIDEOS, containing a row of three thumbnail cards: 1) My New Incandescent Bulb, showing a man holding a glowing light bulb, 10:12, channel Thomas Edison, 89K views, 5 days ago; 2) The Wonders of the Wardenclyffe Tower, showing the Tesla Tower under an electric arc, 15:36, channel Nikola Tesla, 120K views, 1 week ago; 3) The Automobile Revolution, showing an early vintage car driving on a city street with the driver inside, 12:08, channel Henry Ford, 110K views, 1 week ago. Centered below the thumbnails is a brass button that says VIEW ALL VIDEOS. A nameplate at the bottom center reads "© 1893 ElectroVid, Ltd. All rights reserved." The outer frame is decorated with additional pipes, gears, mechanical connectors, embossed corners, and a circular pressure gauge near the bottom right corner. The UI features a symmetrical, highly polished retro design, cinematic warm lighting, realistic textures, impeccable serif fonts, dense decorative craftsmanship, and a perfect blend of modern streaming layout and 19th-century industrial aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张细节丰富的蒸汽朋克风格复古视频平台主页，呈现为全屏网页界面模型，采用暗黄铜、陈旧青铜、黑铁和棕褐色调，设计灵感源自维多利亚时代的工业机器，框架中融入了华丽的镂空花纹、管道、铆钉、齿轮、仪表盘和发光的爱迪生灯泡。左上角显示一个现代叠加标志，文字为 Pollo AI 和 GPT Image 2。顶部中央是一个巨大的金属雕刻网站标题 {argument name="site name" default="ElectroVid"}，下方配有一块较小的副标题铭牌，文字为 {argument name="tagline text" default="THE FUTURE IN MOTION"}。正下方的导航栏包含 6 个可见项目：一个主页图标按钮、TRENDING（热门）、INNOVATIONS（创新）、DOCUMENTARIES（纪录片）、ENTERTAINMENT（娱乐），以及右侧带有占位符文本（类似于 Search ElectroVid...）的搜索框。框架右上角有一个圆形模拟时钟仪表。左侧边栏中，一个标题为 Popular Channels（热门频道）的框架区域垂直堆叠了 3 张频道卡片，每张卡片均带有圆形徽标、订阅者数量和一个 SUBSCRIBE（订阅）按钮：The Patent Office（27.4K 订阅者）、The Royal Society（18.7K 订阅者）以及 General Electric（35.1K 订阅者）。主要内容区域设有一个大型中央视频播放器，画面为棕褐色的历史场景，两名身着西装的男子在写有“AC vs. DC”的黑板前辩论，黑板上有类似闪电的粉笔特效；一人在指点，另一人摊开双手示意，桌上放着一个发光的灯泡和早期的电气设备。添加一个逼真的视频播放器 UI，包含播放按钮、带有部分红色进度条的时间轴、音量图标、显示为 08:47 / 22:31 的已播放和总时长读数、设置图标、剧场模式图标和全屏图标。播放器下方显示精选视频标题 {argument name="featured video title" default="The Truth About AC vs. DC: The Final Debate"}，下方是频道元数据：The Electrical Age，142K 次观看，3 天前，以及一个圆形个人资料头像和一个显示 5.8K 的黄铜色 LIKE（点赞）按钮。下方是一个标题为 LATEST VIDEOS（最新视频）的区域，包含一行 3 张缩略图卡片：1) My New Incandescent Bulb，展示一名男子手持发光灯泡，时长 10:12，频道 Thomas Edison，89K 次观看，5 天前；2) The Wonders of the Wardenclyffe Tower，展示处于电弧下的特斯拉塔，时长 15:36，频道 Nikola Tesla，120K 次观看，1 周前；3) The Automobile Revolution，展示一辆行驶在城市街道上的早期复古汽车，驾驶员在车内，时长 12:08，频道 Henry Ford，110K 次观看，1 周前。缩略图下方居中处是一个写有 VIEW ALL VIDEOS（查看所有视频）的黄铜按钮。底部中央添加一块铭牌，写着 © 1893 ElectroVid, Ltd. All rights reserved.。外边框装饰有额外的管道、齿轮、机械连接件、浮雕边角，右下角附近还有一个圆形压力表。采用对称、高度抛光的复古 UI 设计，电影级暖光，逼真的纹理，无可挑剔的衬线字体，密集的装饰工艺，以及现代流媒体布局与 19 世纪工业美学的完美融合。

titleLocalized.zh: 莫斯科直升机自拍

templates.prompt: A realistic smartphone-style travel photo taken inside a helicopter cabin. On the left is a seated passenger, while the right side offers a panoramic aerial view of Moscow through a large window. The passenger wears a black zip-up sports jacket with a small white swoosh logo, is strapped in, and wears a metal watch and a large black aviation headset with a microphone mount. Their face is partially obscured by a rectangular blur, and they are giving a thumbs-up to the camera. The helicopter interior is dimly lit, featuring black leather seats and beige trim around the windows. The view outside captures a panoramic view of downtown Moscow on a cloudy day, with the Kremlin walls and towers clearly visible. In the lower right corner, the colorful onion domes of St. Basil's Cathedral are visible, and the vast cityscape stretches into the distance, with a cluster of modern skyscrapers visible on the right side of the horizon. The player in the background is slightly smaller, positioned to the left rear, also in motion, wearing a retro blue jersey with a vintage white collar and the logo of a classic soft drink brand sponsor, evoking early memories of the club. The players' faces should be generic and unrecognizable. A large circular Cruzeiro emblem is placed in the center of the background, against a backdrop of a crowded stadium illuminated in blue, featuring two fluttering flags: the club crest flag in the upper left and a flag with large "Supporters" text in the upper right. Ambient smoke, vignetting shadows, and layered lighting effects are added to create a heroic, celebratory sporting design. The image needs to integrate four Portuguese text elements: on the left is a stylized white font "O INÍCIO DE UM FENÔMENO"; on the right is "O MAIOR DE TODOS" with a small crown icon; and at the bottom center is an oversized white brush font.{argument name="main headline" default="FENÔMENO"} The bottom section contains larger-spaced uppercase text.{argument name="bottom tagline" default="ONTEM UM SONHO. HOJE UMA LENDA."} And highlight the last word in bright blue. Add a handwritten signature below the main title, along with the number.{argument name="jersey number" default="9"} Employing a high-contrast sports poster compositing style, incorporating grainy textures, sharp jersey fabric details, and dramatic contour lighting, it creates an epic fan culture atmosphere suitable for the club's legendary celebrations.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张极具戏剧性的竖版足球致敬海报，采用单色皇家蓝调，适用于 {argument name="club name" default="Cruzeiro"}。前景展示 2 名男性足球运动员，身穿不同时代的蓝色 Cruzeiro 主场球衣。前方的球员体型较大，略微偏右，展示腰部以上，呈现动态奔跑姿势，右手食指上扬，肌肉线条明显，表情严肃而充满胜利感，身穿带有白色肩条的现代蓝色球衣，印有白色赞助商标志，胸前饰有俱乐部白色星形徽章。后方的球员体型稍小，位于左后方，同样处于运动状态，身穿带有复古白色领口和经典汽水品牌赞助商标志的复古蓝色球衣，唤起俱乐部早期的记忆。球员面部应为通用形象，不可辨认。背景中心放置一个巨大的圆形 Cruzeiro 徽章，背景为灯光呈蓝色的拥挤体育场，并包含 2 面飘扬的旗帜：左上方为俱乐部徽章旗，右上方为带有大型支持者文字的旗帜。添加氛围烟雾、晕影阴影和分层光效，营造英雄般的庆祝体育设计感。画面中需整合 4 处葡萄牙语文字元素：左侧为风格化的白色字体 "O INÍCIO DE UM FENÔMENO"；右侧为 "O MAIOR DE TODOS" 并配有一个小皇冠图标；底部中央为超大白色笔刷字体 {argument name="main headline" default="FENÔMENO"}；最底部为间距较大的大写文字 {argument name="bottom tagline" default="ONTEM UM SONHO. HOJE UMA LENDA."}，并将最后一个单词以亮蓝色高亮显示。在主标题下方添加手写签名，并附上数字 {argument name="jersey number" default="9"}。采用高对比度的体育海报合成风格，加入颗粒质感、清晰的球衣织物细节、戏剧性的轮廓光，营造出适合俱乐部传奇庆祝活动的史诗级球迷文化氛围。

templates.title: Anime swordsman in a suit

titleLocalized.zh: 身着西装的动漫剑客

templates.prompt: A dynamic, anime-style illustration depicts a meticulously dressed young man in a dramatically posed, perspective-driven pose. Viewed from above, he appears to be charging towards the camera, his rapier pointing directly at the viewer. He possesses {argument name="hair color" default="Golden yellow"} His hair, neatly styled with a center parting and a soft, slicked-back texture, contrasts beautifully with his fair skin. His face is largely obscured by the camera angle and shadows, creating a mysterious yet stylish atmosphere. He wears a well-tailored, deep navy blue business suit with a subtle sheen, a light blue shirt, a bright blue tie, and polished black leather shoes. One hand, in extreme perspective, dominates the foreground, gripping the hilt of an ornate rapier; the other hand draws the blade, emphasizing movement and tension. The sword features a slender silver blade, an intricately crafted metal guard with interlocking rings, and a carved pommel. The composition is bold and graphic, with the character spanning the frame diagonally against a large inverted triangle filled with pale cyan and turquoise geometric fan-shaped patterns outlined by a delicate warm beige border, all set against a clean, light gray background. High-detail digital painting, glossy anime illustrations, elegant action character art, clear lines, rich fabric folds, dramatic perspective distortion, fashion magazine-like texture, cool blue tones, white space, and centered vertical composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张动态的动漫风格插画，描绘了一位穿着考究的年轻男子，呈现出极具戏剧性的透视动作姿势。从上方俯瞰，他仿佛正向镜头冲刺，并将细剑直指观众。他拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="金黄色"} 的头发，发型整齐，中分且带有柔和的后梳蓬松感，肤色白皙。他的面部大部分被拍摄角度和阴影遮挡，营造出一种神秘而时尚的氛围。他身穿一套剪裁合身的深海军蓝商务西装，带有细腻的光泽，内搭浅蓝色衬衫，系着鲜艳的蓝色领带，脚穿抛光的黑色皮鞋。一只手在极端的透视下占据了前景，紧握着华丽的细剑剑柄；另一只手将剑身拔出，强调了动作与张力。这把剑拥有 1 把纤细的银色剑身、1 个带有交错环状结构的精致金属护手以及 1 个雕刻过的剑首。构图大胆且具有图形感，角色以对角线跨越画面，背景是 1 个巨大的倒三角形，内部填充着淡青色和绿松石色的几何扇形图案，并勾勒着细细的暖米色边框，整体置于干净的浅灰色背景之上。高细节数字绘画，光泽感动漫插画，优雅的动作角色艺术，清晰的线条，丰富的布料褶皱，戏剧性的透视变形，时尚杂志般的质感，冷蓝色调，白色留白，居中垂直构图。

templates.title: Latin American Science and Technology Festival Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 拉丁美洲科技节海报

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed, colorful, isometric illustration depicting a bustling Latin American technology expo in an open city plaza. Dozens of people are shown socializing, coding, giving presentations, dining, recording media, and attending lectures. The overall style should evoke the feel of a high-end editorial cityscape poster: vibrant, content-rich, optimistic, playful, with clear, legible signage, clean lines, a painterly quality, warm sunlight, and a celebratory atmosphere reminiscent of a startup community. The main title text on the large stage in the upper left corner is {argument name="headline text" default="LATAM TECH FEST"} The subtitle is "Aprender para transformar" in Spanish. The stage showcases a live conference illuminated in blue light, featuring a speaker and seated audience members; the stage area includes four vertical icon panels labeled "Educación," "Tecnología," "Innovación," and "Futuro," while three glowing theme icons are added to the back wall, labeled "Código," "Comunidad," and "Impacto." The plaza is constructed as a dense, multi-zone activity map, with 24 clearly marked signs or booths distributed throughout the scene: "Keep Coding Keep Growing", "YO APRENDÍ EN LÍNEA", "Remote Work Zone", "ENGLISH UPGRADE YOUR FUTURE", "STARTUPS BUILD THE FUTURE", "DESIGN THINKING", "HACKATHON 24 HORAS DE IDEAS", "Café con código", "AREPAS CON TODO", "Hechas con código y ♥", "Inspiración", "Networking", "Aprendizaje", "Café", "Baños", "SOMOS LATINOAMÉRICA", "AI LAB", "DATA PEOPLE", "DEVS QUE IMPACTAN", "MARKETING GROWTH & COMMUNITY", "PRODUCT "BUILD WHAT MATTERS", "FINTECH EL FUTURO DEL DINERO", "FOUNDER MODE", and "DEMO DAY LAUNCH · SCALE" are displayed. A circular fountain is placed in the center of the square, with a large green geometric logo sculpture serving as a visual anchor. Tables, laptops, projects, crowds, flowerbeds, and benches surround the fountain. The background features a colorful hillside community with mountains, palm trees, power lines, and exactly two red cable cars spanning the sky; additionally, exactly one small drone is added overhead. A large brand logo is placed on a building in the upper right corner.{argument name="brand name" default="Platzi"} And a green billboard that reads "NUNCA PARES DE APRENDER". The lower and middle foregrounds are filled with miniature scenes: a podcast booth labeled "PODCAST ON AIR", a neon-lit "LIVE STREAM" corner, a startup workspace where people use laptops, a hackathon judging table, a founder pitching area, a fintech project with charts, and a coffee stand equipped with an espresso machine and menu board. Six animal or mascot details are added throughout the scene: an orange cat near the workbench on the left, a capybara in the lower left, a multicolored alpaca piñata in the lower left center, a yellow rubber duck near the bottom center, a small green robot near the bottom right, and a small turtle near the coin at the bottom. Additionally, exactly four vehicle elements are placed: two green scooters in the lower left, a beautifully decorated taco truck with "TACOS AL PASTOR" written on it in the lower right, and a wheelchair user weaving through the crowd. Include additional props to enhance the tech culture: a whiteboard with sticky notes, a project titled "Traction" (with an upward trend chart and key words like "Users," "Revenue," "Retention," and "Love"), a project titled "CAP TABLE" (with percentage lines), Bitcoin-style coins on the floor, microphones, cameras, cables, monitors, smartphones, and branded green merchandise. Clothing should be modern, casual, and entrepreneurial, including hoodies, jackets, backpacks, jeans, sneakers, and conference badges, showcasing diversity across age groups and Latin American identities. Use rich shades of green, cyan, orange, purple, and warm neutrals, and incorporate lush vegetation and vines into the architecture. Make every corner bustling and full of discovery, like a "Where's Willie?" style tech ecosystem celebration, but maintain a clear and engaging composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高度精细、色彩丰富的等距视角节日海报插画，描绘一个位于开放式城市广场中熙熙攘攘的拉丁美洲科技博览会，画面中挤满了数十人，他们正在进行社交、编程、演讲、用餐、录制媒体和参加讲座。整体风格应呈现出高端编辑类城市景观海报的质感：充满活力、内容密集、乐观、俏皮且带有清晰易读的标牌，线条利落，具有绘画质感，阳光温暖，充满创业社区的庆典氛围。左上角大型舞台上的主标题文字为 {argument name="headline text" default="LATAM TECH FEST"}，副标题为西班牙语 "Aprender para transformar"。舞台上展示一场带有蓝色灯光的现场会议，包括一名演讲者和就座的观众；在舞台区域包含 4 个垂直图标面板，分别标注为 "Educación"、"Tecnología"、"Innovación" 和 "Futuro"，并在后墙上添加 3 个发光的主题图标，分别标注为 "Código"、"Comunidad" 和 "Impacto"。将广场构建为一个密集的多区域活动地图，在场景中分布 24 个标注清晰的标牌或展位："Keep Coding Keep Growing"、"YO APRENDÍ EN LÍNEA"、"Remote Work Zone"、"ENGLISH UPGRADE YOUR FUTURE"、"STARTUPS BUILD THE FUTURE"、"DESIGN THINKING"、"HACKATHON 24 HORAS DE IDEAS"、"Café con código"、"AREPAS CON TODO"、"Hechas con código y ♥"、"Inspiración"、"Networking"、"Aprendizaje"、"Café"、"Baños"、"SOMOS LATINOAMÉRICA"、"AI LAB"、"DATA PEOPLE"、"DEVS QUE IMPACTAN"、"MARKETING GROWTH & COMMUNITY"、"PRODUCT BUILD WHAT MATTERS"、"FINTECH EL FUTURO DEL DINERO"、"FOUNDER MODE" 和 "DEMO DAY LAUNCH · SCALE"。在广场中心放置一个圆形喷泉，以一个大型绿色几何 Logo 雕塑作为视觉锚点。周围环绕着桌子、笔记本电脑、项目、人群、花坛和长椅。背景包含一个色彩缤纷的山坡社区，有山脉、棕榈树、电线和正好 2 辆横跨天空的红色缆车；此外，在头顶上方添加正好 1 架小型无人机。在右上角的建筑物上，放置一个大型品牌标志 {argument name="brand name" default="Platzi"} 以及一个写着 "NUNCA PARES DE APRENDER" 的绿色广告牌。在前景的下部和中部填充许多微型场景：一个标有 "PODCAST ON AIR" 的播客展位、一个霓虹灯风格的 "LIVE STREAM" 角落、一个人们使用笔记本电脑的创业工作区、一张黑客松评审桌、一个创始人路演区、一个带有图表的金融科技项目，以及一个配备浓缩咖啡机和菜单板的咖啡摊。在整个场景中添加 6 个动物或吉祥物细节：左侧工作台附近有一只橙色猫，左下方有一只水豚，左下方偏中心处有一个多色羊驼皮纳塔，底部中心附近有一只黄色橡皮鸭，底部中右侧附近有一个绿色小机器人，底部靠近硬币处有一只小海龟。此外，放置正好 4 个车辆元素：左下方有 2 辆绿色滑板车，右下方有一辆装饰精美的塔可餐车，上面写着 "TACOS AL PASTOR"，以及一名穿过人群的轮椅使用者。包含强化科技文化的额外道具：带有便签的白板、一个标题为 "Traction" 的项目（带有向上趋势图和 "Users"、"Revenue"、"Retention"、"Love" 等要点）、一个标题为 "CAP TABLE" 的项目（带有百分比行）、地上的比特币风格硬币、麦克风、摄像机、线缆、显示器、智能手机和品牌绿色周边商品。服装应为现代休闲创业风格，包括连帽衫、夹克、背包、牛仔裤、运动鞋和会议胸牌，展现出不同年龄段和拉丁美洲身份的多样性。使用丰富的绿色、青色、橙色、紫色和温暖的中性色，并将茂盛的植物和藤蔓融入建筑中。让每一个角落都繁忙且充满发现感，如同“威利在哪里”风格的科技生态系统庆典，但要保持构图清晰且引人入胜。

templates.title: Tim Cook MMO Raid Boss Screen

titleLocalized.zh: Tim Cook MMO 团本 Boss 屏幕

templates.prompt: Create an illustration with a cinematic fantasy MMO raid boss loading screen style, complete with a full custom game UI overlay. The scene is set at dusk, with a glass cube Apple Store in the background, featuring a glowing white Apple logo in the center of the building's facade. A massive raid boss version stands in the center of the plaza.{argument name="boss name" default="Tim Cook"} The boss, labeled "The Architect," is dressed in a fitted black turtleneck sweater, dark trousers, and sneakers. He holds a glowing smartphone in one hand, while the other is casually outstretched. His face is blurred or anonymized. The overall tone is epic, satirical, and high-quality, resembling a combination of a World of Warcraft raid encounter interface and corporate tech parody. Around him, 20 fantasy raid players form a semi-circle facing the boss, including armored warriors, rogues, mages, shamans, hunters, and silhouettes of various races such as orcs and humans. Several are casting bright spells, including orange flames, blue lightning, green energy, and purple void magic. Three small robotic adds appear near the boss, each labeled "Supplier Add," with a short, stout, industrial-style body and an Apple logo on the front. In addition, two active combat mechanic bubbles have been added: a blue spherical shield labeled "Margin Shield" to the right of the boss, and a purple circular dome labeled "Closed System" further to the right, trapping a humanoid enemy inside. The imagery is designed to form the complete raid UI. Top left: A large expansion-style title page reading "SIEGE OF THE INFINITE LOOP," with the subtitle "20-MAN HORDE RAID." Far left: A vertical "RAID FRAMES" panel listing the names of 20 players (numbers 1 to 20) with colored health bars. Top center: A boss portrait frame displaying the boss's name.{argument name="boss name" default="Tim Cook"} The subtitle is "Architect," and there's a 100% red health bar. Top right corner: A large skirmish guide panel titled "Skirmishes:..."{argument name="boss name" default="TIM COOK"} – "Architect", comprising 3 phases. Phase 1, titled "Supply Chain Domination (100% – 70%)", includes 3 skills: "Logistics Surge – Summons a wave of supplier minions," "Margin Shield – Reduces damage taken by 40% for 10 seconds," and "Quarterly Pressure – A stacking debuff that explodes if not dispelled." Phase 2, titled "Ecosystem Lockdown (70% – 30%)", includes 3 skills: "Closed System – Isolates 3 players, requiring puzzle-solving to return," "Subscription Drain – Deals continuous damage to the entire raid," and "Device Sync – Gather in the correct formation to avoid spike damage." Phase 3, titled "ONE MORE THING (30% – 0%)", includes 3 skills: "Surprise Launch – Deals massive area-of-effect damage every 20 seconds." "Reality Distortion Field – Briefly reverses control." and "Enrage: Market Collapse – The Boss goes berserk after 3 minutes." Bottom right: A "Potential Loot" panel lists four items with rarity-colored text: "Effective Executive Cloak (Epic)," "Press Conference Blade (Epic)," "Ecosystem Ring (Epic)," and "Investor Favor (Reward – Hard Mode)." Below this is a small red and black badge that reads "HARD MODE," along with the text "Activate 'Investor Conference Call' during combat," the rest of the text is truncated or obscured. Bottom left: A "Chat" box contains four lines of text, including the Boss's taunts and player replies, such as "..."{argument name="boss quote" default="Tim Cook shouted: Innovation. Discipline. Excellence. That's how we win."} "Tim Cook shouts: Our ecosystem is indestructible." "Tim Cook shouts: One more thing..." "Lok'tarbrok: Lok'tar ogar!" Bottom center: A fantasy action bar containing skill icons in 12 decorative slots, some with numbers, some displaying cooldown text, including "2m" and "1m". Utilizing dramatic volumetric lighting, glossy reflections on a wet plaza, realistic environment rendering, highly detailed fantasy characters, exaggerated spell effects, vignetting, clean UI typography, and exquisite AAA-level game key visual composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影级奇幻 MMO 团本 Boss 加载界面风格的插图，并带有完整的自定义游戏 UI 叠加层。场景设定在黄昏时分，背景是玻璃立方体 Apple Store，建筑正面中央有发光的白色 Apple Logo。广场中央站着一个巨大的团本 Boss 版本的 {argument name="boss name" default="Tim Cook"}，标记为“建筑师 (The Architect)”，身穿合身的黑色高领毛衣、深色长裤和运动鞋，一只手拿着发光的智能手机，另一只手自然张开，姿态从容。他的面部经过模糊或匿名化处理。整体基调史诗、讽刺且具有高制作水准，如同《魔兽世界》团本遭遇战界面与企业科技恶搞的结合。在他周围，20 名奇幻团本玩家组成半圆战斗阵型面向 Boss，包括身穿盔甲的战士、潜行者、法师、萨满、猎人以及兽人族和人类等多种种族和剪影。其中几位正在施放明亮的法术，包括橙色火焰、蓝色闪电、绿色能量和紫色虚空魔法。在 Boss 附近加入 3 个小型机器人小怪，每个都标记为“供应商小怪 (Supplier Add)”，拥有矮胖的工业风躯干，正面印有 Apple Logo。此外，加入 2 个活跃的战斗机制气泡：Boss 右侧有一个标记为“利润护盾 (Margin Shield)”的蓝色球形护盾，更右侧有一个标记为“封闭系统 (Closed System)”的紫色圆形穹顶，内部困着一名人形敌人。将图像构建为完整的团本 UI 构图。左上角：一个大型扩展包风格的标题，写着“SIEGE OF THE INFINITE LOOP”，副标题为“20-MAN HORDE RAID”。最左侧：一个垂直的“团队框架 (RAID FRAMES)”面板，列出 1 到 20 号共 20 个玩家姓名，并带有彩色生命值条。顶部中央：一个 Boss 头像框，显示 Boss 名称 {argument name="boss name" default="Tim Cook"}、副标题“建筑师”以及 100% 的红色生命值条。右上角：一个大型遭遇战指南面板，标题为“遭遇战：{argument name="boss name" default="TIM COOK"} – \"建筑师\"”，包含 3 个阶段。第一阶段标题：“供应链主导 (100% – 70%)”，包含 3 个技能：“物流激增 (Logistics Surge) – 召唤一波供应商小怪。”、“利润护盾 (Margin Shield) – 10 秒内减少 40% 所受伤害。”以及“季度压力 (Quarterly Pressure) – 可叠加的减益效果，若未驱散则会爆炸。”第二阶段标题：“生态系统锁定 (70% – 30%)”，包含 3 个技能：“封闭系统 (Closed System) – 隔离 3 名玩家，需解谜才能返回。”、“订阅流失 (Subscription Drain) – 全团持续伤害。”以及“设备同步 (Device Sync) – 在正确阵型中集合以避免尖刺伤害。”第三阶段标题：“还有一件事 (ONE MORE THING) (30% – 0%)”，包含 3 个技能：“惊喜发布 (Surprise Launch) – 每 20 秒造成大规模范围爆发伤害。”、“现实扭曲力场 (Reality Distortion Field) – 短暂反转控制。”以及“狂暴：市场崩溃 (Enrage: Market Collapse) – Boss 在 3 分钟时狂暴。”右下角：一个“潜在掉落 (POTENTIAL LOOT)”面板，列出 4 件带有稀有度颜色文本的物品：“高效执行官斗篷 (史诗)”、“发布会之刃 (史诗)”、“生态系统之戒 (史诗)”和“投资者青睐 (奖励 – 困难模式)”。下方添加一个红黑相间的小徽章，写着“困难模式 (HARD MODE)”，以及一行文字“在战斗中激活 \"投资者电话会议\" 以”，其余文本被截断或遮挡。左下角：一个“聊天 (CHAT)”框，包含 4 行文字，包括 Boss 的嘲讽台词和玩家回复，例如“{argument name="boss quote" default="Tim Cook 大喊：创新。纪律。卓越。这就是我们获胜的方式。"}”、“Tim Cook 大喊：我们的生态系统坚不可摧。”、“Tim Cook 大喊：还有一件事……”、“Lok'tarbrok：Lok'tar ogar！”底部中央：一个奇幻动作条，包含 12 个装饰性槽位中的技能图标，部分带有数字，部分显示冷却时间文本，包括“2m”和“1m”。使用戏剧性的体积光、湿润广场上的光泽反射、逼真的环境渲染、高度精细的奇幻角色、夸张的法术效果、暗角效果、清晰的 UI 排版以及精致的 AAA 级游戏主视觉构图。

templates.title: Future City with Flickering Artifacts

titleLocalized.zh: 带有闪烁伪影的未来城市

templates.prompt: Looking up at a brightly lit, daytime futuristic city street from a pedestrian's perspective, the view flows through a canyon of towering, sleek skyscrapers with blue-toned glass facades, circular balconies, tiered terraces, and an elegant sci-fi architectural style. The scene showcases a bustling pedestrian street, with approximately 12 casually dressed pedestrians walking with their backs to the viewer in the foreground and midground, including a central figure in a grey jacket. In the upper left, a small hovercraft or drone-like aerial taxi is added. The buildings have a high degree of reflectivity and gloss, integrated with greenery: trees line the walkways, and vegetation adorns the edges of terraces. The azure sky and soft sunlight lend the image a pure, optimistic utopian atmosphere. A striking layer of artifacts—dense, colorful shimmering dots and spots—is added to the image, resembling a grid of noisy pixels or flickering digital pollution evenly distributed across the buildings, figures, sky, and street. A semi-realistic painting style with soft focus, bright highlights, vertical composition, and cinematic depth of field is employed.

promptLocalized.zh: 从行人视角仰望明亮的日间未来城市街道，视线穿过由高耸光滑的摩天大楼组成的峡谷，建筑拥有蓝调玻璃幕墙、圆形阳台、层叠露台以及优雅的科幻建筑风格。场景展示了一条熙熙攘攘的城市步行街，前景和中景可见约 12 名行人，他们衣着休闲并背对观众行走，其中包括一名身穿灰色夹克的中心人物。在左上方，加入 1 架小型悬浮飞行载具或类似无人机的空中出租车。建筑具有极高的反射感和光泽度，并融入了绿植：步道旁种植着树木，露台边缘也点缀着植被。天空湛蓝，阳光柔和，赋予画面一种纯净、乐观的乌托邦氛围。在整张图像上，添加一层显眼的伪影，即密集的彩色闪烁点和斑点，如同均匀散布在建筑、人物、天空和街道上的噪点像素网格或闪烁的数字污染。采用具有柔焦、明亮高光、垂直构图和电影般景深的半写实绘画风格。

templates.title: Rainforest clearing with speckled artifacts

titleLocalized.zh: 带有斑点伪影的雨林空地

templates.prompt: A super-detailed wide-angle photograph of a rainforest clearing, shot from an extremely low ground angle, the camera almost touching the edge of a shallow mud puddle. Dense tropical rainforest vegetation forms a ring around the clearing, with intertwined vines, broad, wet leaves, shrubs, and tree trunks thickly covered in green. The foreground consists of slippery brown mud, fallen leaves, and reflective puddles, including a fallen log slanting across the lower right area and a rounded moss-covered rock in the lower left corner. At the center is a patch of low-lying green vegetation, against a backdrop of towering, dense rainforest canopy. Bright midday sunlight streams through the treetops in the upper right, creating strong rays, haze, luminous highlights, and high contrast with the partially cloudy blue-white sky visible through the canopy. The use of dramatic fisheye or ultra-wide-angle lens effects with subtle barrel distortion creates an immersive environmental scale, rich, saturated greens, a moist texture, realistic natural light and shadow, sharp leaf details, and a realistic, documentary-style nature photography style. Adding a faint and unnatural grid-like speckle noise artifact pattern to the image, especially noticeable on dark leaves and muddy ground, simulates quality defects in the image generation process.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超细节的广角雨林空地照片，采用极低的地面视角拍摄，相机几乎贴近浅泥坑的边缘。茂密的热带丛林植被在空地周围形成了一圈环形墙，交织的藤蔓、宽大的湿叶、灌木和树干上覆盖着厚厚的绿植。前景是湿滑的棕色泥水、落叶和反光水坑，包括一根斜穿右下区域的倒木和左下角一块圆润的苔藓岩石。中心处是一片低矮的绿色植物，背景则是高耸的茂密丛林树冠。明亮的正午阳光从右上方的树梢间穿透而下，形成强烈的射线、薄雾、发光高光，并与透过树冠可见的局部多云蓝白天空形成高对比度。使用具有微妙桶形畸变的戏剧性鱼眼或超广角镜头效果，营造沉浸式的环境尺度、浓郁饱和的绿色、湿润的质感、逼真的自然光影、清晰的叶片细节以及写实的纪录片式自然摄影风格。在图像中加入微弱且不自然的网格状斑点噪点伪影图案，在阴暗的叶片和泥泞地面上尤为明显，模拟图像生成过程中的质量缺陷。

templates.title: Dystopian women on the frozen waterfront

titleLocalized.zh: 冰封水岸边的反乌托邦女性

templates.prompt: This is a cinematic, dystopian winter twilight scene, the perspective shifting from a sheltered riverbank foreground to a dark modern city skyline, with hundreds of tiny, warm window lights twinkling in the distance. In the left foreground, a stylish woman with dark curly hair is shown in three-quarter profile, her face deliberately obscured by a soft, rectangular blur, a lit cigarette dangling from her lips. She wears a black lace high-necked sheer dress adorned with delicate floral embroidery and dangling earrings, showcasing a captivating film noir aesthetic. The ground around her is wet and icy, scattered with trash; in the right foreground, gleaming black garbage bags are piled, and debris litters the frozen bank. In the midground, amidst the icy water, sits a large, weathered metal bowl or basin, filled with snow and prominently marked with text.{argument name="headline text" default="USA"} Three tiny human figures stand nearby for scale reference. Bare tree branches form the frame in the upper left corner. The overall tone is cool blue-gray, accented with amber-colored city lights. The image presents a rough, painterly realism with obvious AI image artifacts: the entire scene (especially in the shadows) is scattered with visible tiny glowing spots and noisy meshes, as if it came from a flawed generative model.

promptLocalized.zh: 这是一幅充满电影感的反乌托邦冬季黄昏场景，视角从受遮蔽的河岸前景望向黑暗的现代城市天际线，远处闪烁着数百盏温暖的微小窗灯。左侧前景中，一位留着深色卷发的时尚女性以四分之三侧面示人，她的脸部被一个柔和的矩形模糊效果刻意遮挡，唇边拿着一支点燃的香烟。她身着一件黑色蕾丝高领透视连衣裙，饰有精致的花卉刺绣，佩戴着垂坠耳环，展现出迷人的黑色电影美学。她周围的地面湿冷且结冰，散落着垃圾，右侧前景堆放着光亮的黑色垃圾袋，冰冻的岸边散布着残骸。冰冷水域的中景处坐落着一个巨大的风化金属碗或盆，里面积满了雪，上面显著标有文字 {argument name="headline text" default="USA"}。三个微小的人影站在旁边以作比例参考。光秃的树枝构成了左上方的框架。整体色调为冷蓝灰色，点缀着琥珀色的城市灯光，整张图像呈现出一种粗粝的、绘画般的写实感，并带有明显的 AI 图像伪影特征：整个场景（尤其是在暗部）散布着可见的微小发光斑点和噪点网格，仿佛出自一个有缺陷的生成式模型。

templates.title: Epic FC Barcelona Legacy Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 史诗级 FC Barcelona 传承海报

templates.prompt: Create a vertical football tribute poster with a cinematic feel, employing a mixed-media style that blends artistic portraiture, sports brand elements, textured painting, and high-end editorial layout. The main subject of the image is {argument name="historical figure" default="Rabindranath Tagore"} A half-length portrait of him, reimagined as an iconic figure of FC Barcelona, ​​is depicted with his body slightly turned to the right, sporting flowing silver-grey hair and a long beard, a weathered face, and a composed yet legendary demeanor. He is dressed in the classic FC Barcelona home jersey, featuring deep red and navy blue vertical stripes, a Nike logo on the left, and the FCB crest on the chest. Deep contour lighting and painterly highlights around the hair and shoulders lend the figure a majestic and almost divine appearance. The background employs an abstract brushstroke composition in Barcelona colors, incorporating deep indigo, crimson, burgundy, and soft gold. Behind the portrait are three main graphic elements: a large, faded FC Barcelona crest at the top center, a vertically written Bengali manuscript on the left, and a large line of gold, handwritten signature-style text on the right. In the upper left corner, place five lines of elegant serif font: the first line reads "RABINDRANATH," the second (in a larger font) reads "TAGORE," the third reads "1861-1941," the fourth is the quote "Where the mind is without fear and the head is held high...", and the fifth is the cursive signature "Rabindranath Tagore." In the lower center area, add five lines of centered text in a sophisticated poster layout: "MORE THAN A POET.", followed by a large gold handwritten line "A timeless spirit.", and then "A{argument name="club nickname" default="CULER"} "FOREVER." followed by a thin horizontal red and blue decorative line, below which is a small, centered FCB team logo. The bottom displays a wide-angle view of Camp Nou at dusk, with the stadium lights twinkling, the sunset horizon magnificent, the stands packed, and a large jigsaw puzzle of spectators clearly displayed.{argument name="stadium slogan" default="MES QUE UN CLUB"} A football is placed in the foreground, centered on a wet, reflective pitch, with the Barcelona team crest visible on the ball. The entire image should have the feel of a luxurious, fan-made heritage poster—rich in detail, painterly, emotionally charged, dignified, high-contrast, textured, and epic—ideal for high-end football social media graphics or wall posters. A 2:3 vertical poster composition is used, featuring depth, subtle sparkles, paint brushstrokes, and gold accents. The visible club logo can be optionally replaced with {argument name="football club" default="FC Barcelona"} At the same time, it maintains the same elite-level tribute poster aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张极具电影质感的竖版足球致敬海报，采用混合媒介风格，融合美术肖像、体育品牌元素、纹理质感绘画以及高端编辑排版。画面主体为 {argument name="historical figure" default="Rabindranath Tagore"} 的半身肖像，将其重塑为 FC Barcelona 的标志性人物，身体微向右转，留着飘逸的银灰色长发和长胡须，面容沧桑，神态沉稳且充满传奇色彩。让他身穿经典的 FC Barcelona 主场球衣，球衣带有深红色和海军蓝的竖条纹，左侧可见 Nike 标志，胸前印有 FCB 队徽。运用深沉的轮廓光和围绕头发与肩部的绘画式高光，使人物看起来宏伟且近乎神圣。背景采用 Barcelona 配色的抽象笔触构图，包含深靛蓝、深红、酒红和柔和的金色，肖像后方有 3 个主要的图形元素：顶部中央是一个巨大的褪色 FC Barcelona 队徽，左侧是一块竖排的手写孟加拉语手稿文字，右侧是一行巨大的金色手写体签名风格文字。在左上角放置 5 行优雅的衬线字体：第一行写着 "RABINDRANATH"，第二行（字号更大）写着 "TAGORE"，第三行写着 "1861-1941"，第四行是引言 "Where the mind is without fear and the head is held high..."，第五行是草书签名 "Rabindranath Tagore"。在中下部区域，以精致的海报布局添加 5 行居中文字："MORE THAN A POET."，接着是一行巨大的金色手写体 "A timeless spirit."，然后是 "A {argument name="club nickname" default="CULER"} FOREVER."，随后是一条纤细的红蓝水平装饰线，下方是一个居中的小型 FCB 队徽。底部展示黄昏时分 Camp Nou 的广角视野，球场灯光闪烁，夕阳地平线壮丽，看台座无虚席，巨大的观众拼图文字清晰显示为 {argument name="stadium slogan" default="MES QUE UN CLUB"}。前景中放置 1 个足球，居中于湿润且具有反射感的球场草坪上，球上可见 Barcelona 队徽。整张图片应呈现出奢华的粉丝自制传承海报质感，细节丰富、具有绘画感、情感充沛、庄重、高对比度、纹理感强、史诗感十足，非常适合作为高端足球社交媒体图形或墙面海报。采用 2:3 的竖版海报构图，具有层次深度、细微火花、油漆笔触和金色点缀。可选择将可见的俱乐部标识替换为 {argument name="football club" default="FC Barcelona"}，同时保持相同的精英级致敬海报美学。

templates.title: Summer Coffee Ice Cream Collaboration Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 夏季咖啡冰淇淋联名海报

templates.prompt: A bright and cheerful summer-themed collaborative beverage poster, using a simple Chinese commercial advertising style, showcases {argument name="brand one" default="Mixue Ice Cream"} and{argument name="brand two" default="STARBUCKS"} This is a collaboration between [brand name]. The poster is vertically formatted with a soft blue sky, sunlight-drenched greenery, and an outdoor café atmosphere as the background. Two brand logos are placed side-by-side at the top, followed by a prominent large Chinese title in a playful, hand-drawn artistic font:{argument name="headline text" default="Snow King Meets Star Friends"} Add a green ribbon banner below the title, containing a Chinese subtitle:{argument name="subheadline text" default="Mixue Ice Cream x Starbucks Collaboration Launched"} The image includes a small print that reads "Double the Sweetness, Double the Happiness." It features two circular stamp-like graphics: the left one reads "Limited Edition Collaboration," while the upper right corner resembles a postmark, surrounded by Chinese characters and small drink icons. In the foreground, on an outdoor wooden table, are two iced drinks: the left one is a bright green matcha smoothie in a clear glass, topped with a towering vanilla soft-serve ice cream and green matcha sauce, the ice cubes clearly visible, and the cup bearing a cute Snow King mascot logo; the right one is a clear Starbucks-style iced latte with a milk and green matcha swirl at the bottom, topped with whipped cream and dark cookie crumbs, and the cup bearing a green mermaid logo. In front of the drinks is a cute white Snow King mascot doll, wearing a small crown, with a round body, rosy cheeks, a red cape, and playfully winking, sitting and holding a small coffee takeaway cup. Next to the drinks are two vertical product labels: the left label reads "Snow-Topped Matcha Frappuccino," and the right label reads "Matcha Snow King Oreo." In the mid-ground on the right, a small blackboard sits on a wooden easel, displaying the words "ICE CREAM & COFFEE" and featuring chalk drawings of an ice cream cone and a takeaway cup. A torn-paper style price display in the lower left corner shows a bundle deal, complete with a striking red "¥19.9," green text, and a small green badge that reads "Save ¥6." A "Collaboration Merchandise" display area in the lower right corner showcases four items: a cup sleeve, a character keychain or acrylic pendant, a round badge, and a sticker or token, all themed around the collaboration between the Snow King mascot and coffee. The image utilizes warm sunlight, glossy beverage photography, shallow depth of field, soft tree shadow blur, high-contrast product retouching, and clear packaging details to present a positive and youthful retail promotion aesthetic. Scattered doodle hearts and playful decorative elements adorn the text. Except for the Starbucks logo and the blackboard text, all visible text is in Chinese.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张明亮欢快的夏季联名饮品海报，采用简洁的中国商业广告风格，展示 {argument name="brand one" default="蜜雪冰城"} 与 {argument name="brand two" default="STARBUCKS"} 的联名合作。竖版海报布局，背景为柔和的蓝天、阳光下的绿植和户外咖啡馆氛围。海报顶部并排放置两个品牌 Logo，下方配有醒目的大号中文标题，采用俏皮的手绘艺术字体：{argument name="headline text" default="雪王遇见星朋友"}。标题下方添加一条绿色丝带横幅，内含中文副标题：{argument name="subheadline text" default="蜜雪冰城 × 星巴克 联名开启"}，以及一行小字“甜蜜加倍·快乐翻倍”。包含 2 个圆形印章式图形：左侧印有“联名限定”，右上角类似邮戳，周围环绕中文并带有小型饮品图标。画面中心前景的户外木桌上放置 2 杯冰饮：左侧是一杯高透明杯装的鲜绿色抹茶冰沙，顶部有高耸的香草软冰淇淋和绿色抹茶淋酱，冰块质感清晰，杯身印有可爱的雪王吉祥物 Logo；右侧是一杯高透明的星巴克风冰拿铁，底部有牛奶和绿色抹茶旋涡，顶部覆盖鲜奶油和深色饼干碎，杯身印有绿色美人鱼 Logo。饮品前方放置 1 个可爱的白色雪王吉祥物玩偶，戴着小皇冠，圆滚滚的身体，红润的脸颊，披着红斗篷，俏皮地眨着眼，坐着并手持一个小咖啡外带杯。在饮品旁添加 2 个竖排产品标签：左侧标签为“雪顶抹茶星冰乐”，右侧标签为“抹茶雪王奥利奥”。右侧中景处放置 1 个木质画架上的黑色小黑板，上面写着“ICE CREAM & COFFEE”，并用粉笔画有冰淇淋甜筒和外带杯。左下角设计一个撕纸风格的价格板块，显示组合优惠，配有醒目的红色数字“¥19.9”、绿色辅助文字以及一个写着“立省 ¥6”的小型绿色徽章。右下方添加一个“联名周边”展示区，精确陈列 4 件周边商品：1 个杯套、1 个角色钥匙扣或亚克力挂件、1 个圆形徽章和 1 个小贴纸或代币，均采用雪王吉祥物与咖啡联名主题。画面运用温暖阳光、光泽感饮品摄影、浅景深效果、柔和的树影虚化、高对比度产品修图、清晰的包装细节，呈现出积极向上的年轻化零售促销美学。在文字周围点缀零星的涂鸦爱心和俏皮的装饰元素。除 Starbucks 字标和黑板文字外，其余可见文字均保持为中文。

templates.prompt: A dramatic UFC-style fighting sports promotional poster, themed as{argument name="event title" default="UFC 305"} The image is designed as a high-contrast vertical confrontation, featuring two female MMA fighters facing each other in a standard stance. The fighter on the left is a fit blonde with shoulder-length, tousled wavy hair, a tanned complexion, and wearing a black sports bra, black UFC gloves, and black fighting shorts. The image extends from her upper thighs to her head, with her body slightly turned to the right. The fighter on the right is a fit dark-haired woman with long, straight black hair, a tanned complexion, and wearing a black sports bra, black UFC gloves, and black fighting shorts. The image extends from her upper thighs to her head, with her body slightly turned to the left. She has a large, intricately detailed black-grey tattoo on her right arm, and text tattoos on the inside of her upper arm. Both fighters are covered in sweat, the lighting is intense, and they are positioned close together, fists raised to chest height. The background uses a split design: the left side features fiery red sparks and smoke, while the right side features icy blue-white sparks and mist, with a dark black seam in between. At the top center, a black rectangular logo with a gold border contains gold text.{argument name="event logo text" default="UFC 305"} Below this, the tagline "TWO ICONS. ONE OCTAGON." is added in stacked, compressed white capital letters. Along the far left edge, the large, distressed gold lettering of the surname "SWEENEY" is placed vertically; along the far right edge, the large, distressed silver-grey lettering of the surname "FOXX" is placed vertically. In the center, a large, distressed white compressed sans-serif font is overlaid, stacked opposite the names.{argument name="left fighter name" default="SYDNEY SWEENEY"} Located above the small gold "VS", below is{argument name="right fighter name" default="MEGAN FOXX"} Below this, a small gold subtitle "BANTAMWEIGHT BOUT" is added. At the bottom center, a small, realistic UFC octagon is displayed embedded in the poster, slightly elevated. In front of the octagon, a black date card with a gold border is placed, containing stacked gold text: "JUNE 14", "SATURDAY", "10PM ET / 7PM PT". Below the card, the white text "LIVE ON" and the ESPN+ logo are added. In the lower left corner, small gold and white ticketing text "TICKETS ON SALE APRIL 25" is added, with the Ticketmaster logo below. In the lower right corner, the Rogers Arena logo is added, with white text "ROGERS ARENA" and gold text "VANCOUVER, BC" below. The poster employs a glossy, high-end combat sports poster aesthetic, utilizing cinematic contour lighting, rough texture overlays, metallic fonts, and a strong confrontational composition.

templates.title: Retro bathroom flash mirror selfie

titleLocalized.zh: 复古浴室闪光灯镜面自拍

templates.prompt: A casual, flash-lit mirror selfie taken in a small, retro bathroom, framed vertically with an early 2000s realistic disposable camera aesthetic. A young woman stands in front of a slightly messy mirror, her face softly blurred in a rectangular shape. She holds a smartphone, the bright direct flash creating a strong starburst halo on the right side of the frame. She has dark brown hair with light blonde highlights, styled in a messy shark-hair bun with wispy strands framing her face. She wears small hoop earrings and two stacked silver necklaces. She wears a fitted white cropped T-shirt with faded pink preppy lettering "NANTUCKET" (reflected in the mirror), loose grey-linen sweatpants, and white socks. One knee is casually resting on the sink, giving the pose a relaxed, intimate, candid feel. Her phone case is covered in cute stickers and comes with a round airbag holder featuring a pink cartoon bear or bunny. The lower half of the bathroom wall is tiled in light pink, while the upper half is grayish-white. Seven toiletries and beauty products are cluttered on the sink: four bottles on the left, a black hairbrush on the edge of the sink, and two perfume or cosmetic bottles at the bottom edge of the mirror. A beige towel hangs in the background, and visible stains and dust particles on the metal mirror frame are captured by a flash. The image includes dramatic shadows cast on the left wall and mirror, a soft green light interplay with the intense flash, and features delicate film grain, natural skin texture, and slight lens distortion, creating a realistic and unretouched everyday atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张在小型复古浴室中拍摄的随性闪光灯镜面自拍，采用 2000 年代初期写实的一次性相机美学进行竖构图。一位年轻女性站在略显脏乱的镜子前，面部被柔和的矩形模糊处理遮挡，她手持智能手机，明亮的直射闪光灯在画面中右侧产生了强烈的星芒光晕。她留着深棕色头发，带有浅金色挑染，梳着凌乱的鲨鱼夹盘发，脸颊两侧留有碎发，佩戴着小圆圈耳环和两条叠戴的银色项链。她身穿一件修身的白色短款 T 恤，上面印有褪色的粉色学院风文字“NANTUCKET”（在镜子中呈镜像显示），下身穿着宽松的灰麻色运动裤和白色袜子；她的一只膝盖随意地抬在洗手台上，使姿势呈现出一种放松、亲密的抓拍感。手机壳上贴满了可爱的贴纸，并配有一个带有粉色卡通熊或兔子图案的圆形气囊支架。浴室下半部分铺着淡粉色墙砖，上半部分为灰白色墙面，洗手台上杂乱地摆放着总共 7 件洗漱和美容用品：左侧有 4 个瓶子，洗手台边缘有一把黑色发梳，镜子底部边缘摆放着 2 个香水或化妆品瓶。背景中挂着一条米色毛巾，金属镜框上可见明显的污渍和灰尘颗粒，捕捉到了闪光灯的效果。画面包含投射在左侧墙壁和镜子上的戏剧性阴影，柔和的室内环境绿光与强烈的闪光灯交织，带有细腻的胶片颗粒感、自然的皮肤纹理、轻微的镜头畸变，营造出一种真实且未经修饰的生活照氛围。
