templates.title: Anime heroine promotional poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫女主角宣传海报

templates.prompt: A meticulously crafted, vertically-oriented anime-style main visual poster showcases a futuristic fantasy action series. The composition centers on a young female protagonist, confidently turning her head with a three-quarters back view, her face slightly obscured by the angle and strands of hair. She possesses long, flowing silver-white hair, fair skin accented with cool-toned purple. She wears a sleek combat outfit in black, white, and purple: a short black jacket with a white hood and a cape-like tiered hem, a fitted bodice, a short pleated skirt, a tactical belt and straps, black gloves, a single thigh strap, and delicate star-shaped badge details. In her right hand, she wields a massive, polygonal sci-fi longsword, its blade radiating glowing purple energy lines. The background is a bright blue-white daytime sky, dotted with soft clouds and a few white birds. In the distance lies an elegant white city comprised of towering cathedral-like spires and bridges, creating a grand, utopian atmosphere of a future kingdom. The hair, ribbons, hem, and fabric convey a strong sense of wind. Employing fluid lines and colors, clean anime-style rendering, high-detail cel shadows, crisp lighting, and glossy highlights, the design presents the texture of a high-end game promotional illustration. The layout is a complete Japanese promotional poster. The top left corner features a striking vertical Japanese title, "未来を、自分の手で。" (May the future be our own doing). The central phrase is purple, the rest is black, and a light-colored decorative badge forms the background. A smaller Japanese introduction is added below. A dark vertical sidebar is placed on the right, containing the white Japanese text, "信じてる。だから、私が道を切り開く。" (I believe you will find a way). The bottom left corner features three stacked, tilted rectangular illustrations: a close-up of the female protagonist's face, a shot of her wielding a glowing longsword, and a panoramic view of the city. The dark character information panel below displays the character's name "ルシア" (Lucia) in Romanized form, along with a small badge. This is followed by seven lines of Japanese personal information: "CV: Aoi Yuuki," "Age: 17," "Affiliation: Dawn Knights (Unbreakable Wings)," "Weapon: Double-edged Sword (Repricant)," "Birthday: April 12th," "Height: 165cm," "Favorite Things: Quiet Places, Starry Skies," and a final line listing disliked items. At the bottom center is a large series logo with the text "黎明のリベリオン" (Dawn's Rebelion), followed by the English subtitle "REIMEI NO REBELLION," and then the release date "2025, Start." Color scheme: white, black, dark indigo, electric purple, and sky blue. Overall atmosphere: heroic, elegant, and ambitious, reminiscent of a high-end anime/game or light novel promotional poster.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张精致的动漫风格竖版主视觉海报，展现未来奇幻动作系列。构图中心为一位全身年轻女主角，她以自信的三分之四背影姿态回眸，面部因角度和发丝略微遮挡。她拥有随风飘逸的长银白发，肤色白皙，带有冷色调的紫色点缀。身着黑、白、紫三色相间的干练战斗服：黑色短款夹克搭配白色兜帽及披风式层叠后摆，修身胸衣，短百褶裙，配有战术腰带和绑带，黑色手套，单腿大腿绑带，并有精致的星形徽章细节。右手持一把巨大的多边形科幻长剑，剑身带有发光的紫色能量线。背景为明亮的蓝色白昼天空，点缀着柔和的云朵和几只白鸟，远景是一座由高耸大教堂式尖塔和桥梁构成的优雅白色城市，营造出宏伟的乌托邦式未来王国氛围。头发、丝带、衣摆和布料需体现强烈的风感。采用流畅的线条和色彩，干净的动漫渲染，高细节赛璐珞阴影，清脆的灯光，光泽感高光，呈现出高级游戏宣传插画的质感。

设计为完整的日式宣传海报布局。左上角放置醒目的竖排日文大标题“未来を、自分の手で。”，中间短语为紫色，其余为黑色，背景衬托淡色装饰徽章。下方添加较小的日文简介。右侧放置一个深色竖向侧边栏，内含白色日文文字“信じてる。だから、私が道を切り開く。”。左下角堆叠 3 张倾斜的矩形插图：1 张女主角面部特写，1 张她挥舞发光长剑的动作镜头，以及 1 张城市全景图。在下方的深色角色信息面板中，显示角色名“ルシア”及其罗马音“Lucia”和一个小徽章，随后是 7 行日文个人资料：“CV：悠木 碧”、“年齢：17歳”、“所属：黎明騎士団（不屈の翼）”、“武器：双刃剣（レプリカント）”、“誕生日：4月12日”、“身長：165cm”、“好きなもの：静かな場所、星空”，以及最后一行不喜欢的物品。底部中央放置大型系列 Logo 文字“黎明のリベリオン”，下方附带英文副标题“REIMEI NO REBELLION”，再下方为发布日期“2025年、始動。”。配色方案：白色、黑色、深靛色、电紫色和天蓝色。整体氛围：英雄气概、优雅、充满抱负，呈现出高级动漫游戏或轻小说的宣传海报感。

templates.title: Poster of a female protagonist with a soft anime fantasy style

titleLocalized.zh: 柔和动漫奇幻风格女主角海报

templates.prompt: A vertical promotional poster for a Japanese anime/fantasy game or light novel, using soft pale purple, white, and gold tones, features a dashing young girl against a backdrop of a magnificent aerial city. She is depicted in a dynamic three-quarter full-body pose, her body slightly turned to the left, holding a magnificent staff in her left hand, while her right hand extends backward as if in the wind. Her face is covered by a flat, pale-colored square obscuring her head, but the visible design hints at a refined anime heroine with extremely long, flowing silver-lilac hair, side-swept bangs, loose strands, and a star-shaped hair accessory adorned with a deep indigo ribbon bow. She wears an exquisite magical girl-style dress: a white off-the-shoulder bodice with navy and violet trim and gold star patterns; an asymmetrical, layered skirt in a blend of white, periwinkle blue, violet, and deep indigo; a large, deep blue bow and a gold star-shaped gem at the waist; separate, flowing sleeves; gold chains adorned with tiny star pendants hanging from her hips; white knee-high stockings; and blue star-shaped suspenders on her thighs. Her staff is tall and elegant, its dark shaft framed with gold elements, and a multifaceted blue crystal hangs near the top, decorated with bows and stars. The background is a light, fantastical skyline, featuring white towers, cathedral-like spires, clouds, feathers, and falling pink petals, accompanied by bright, ethereal backlighting and a dreamlike, heroic atmosphere. The composition mimics a sophisticated key visual poster and incorporates rich Japanese typography. The upper left corner features the Japanese tagline “願いが、未来を照らす.” (May the future shine upon you.) followed by two lines of smaller text. The upper right corner displays a star-shaped badge, the large character name “ルミナ”, the subtitle “— Lumina —”, and a line of smaller voice actor information. Three vertically arranged function labels are added to the right, each containing a small icon, a bold Japanese title, and two lines of smaller text below. A Japanese text block is added vertically along the character's side to the left. The lower right corner contains three diagonally stacked small portrait illustrations of the character: one with a calm frontal expression, one with a serious profile expression, and one with a closed-eye smile. The lower left corner features the large Japanese title “星紡ぐレガシア” (Hoshifugu Regasia), followed by the English subtitle “— LEGACIA: Weave the Stars —”. The lower right corner displays the date text “2025. Summer” and a short Japanese tagline below. The bottom left edge contains two small social media or website information blocks, while the right edge features a tiny copyright notice. It employs a high-end, modern anime-style promotional illustration, presenting a bright, soft, and fantastical atmosphere, elegant composition, fluid lines and colors, soft cel shadows, delicate fabric movement, glossy highlights, intricate clothing details, a clean layout, and a refined commercial poster quality.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张竖版日本动漫奇幻游戏或轻小说宣传海报，采用柔和的淡紫色、白色和金色调，以一位英姿飒爽的少女为主角，背景为宏伟的空中之城。她呈动态的三分之四全身姿势，身体微向左转，左手持一柄华丽的法杖，右手向后伸展，仿佛正处于风中。她的面部被一个位于头部的平坦淡色方形遮挡块覆盖，但可见的设计暗示着这是一位精致的动漫女主角，拥有极长的飘逸银丁香色长发、侧刘海、散落的发丝以及带有深靛蓝色丝带蝴蝶结的星形发饰。她身着精致的魔法少女风格连衣裙：露肩白色紧身胸衣，配有海军蓝和紫罗兰色饰边及金色星星图案；不对称的层叠裙摆，色彩融合了白色、长春花蓝、紫罗兰色和深靛蓝色；腰间饰有巨大的深蓝色蝴蝶结和金色星形宝石；配有分离式的飘逸袖子，臀部垂挂着带有微型星星挂饰的金色链条，穿着白色过膝袜，大腿上饰有蓝色星形吊带。她的法杖高挑优雅，深色杖身配有金色框架元素，顶部附近悬挂着一颗多面蓝色水晶，并饰有蝴蝶结和星星装饰。背景是轻盈的奇幻天际线，包含白色塔楼、大教堂般的尖顶、云朵、羽毛和飘落的粉色花瓣，伴有明亮空灵的背光和梦幻般的英雄氛围。构图仿照精致的主视觉海报，并将丰富的日语排版融入画面中。左上方放置日语标语“願いが、未来を照らす。”，下方附带两行较小的文字。右上方放置一个星形徽章、大号角色名“ルミナ”、副标题“— Lumina —”以及一行较小的声优信息。右侧添加 3 个垂直排列的功能标注，每个标注包含一个小图标、一个粗体日语标题以及下方两行较小的短文。左侧添加一个沿角色身侧垂直排列的日语文案块。右下方包含 3 个该角色的斜向堆叠小肖像插图：1 个平静的正面表情、1 个严肃的侧面表情和 1 个闭眼微笑的表情。左下方放置大号日语标题“星紡ぐレガシア”，下方附带英文副标题“— LEGACIA: Weave the Stars —”。右下角添加日期文本“2025. 夏”及下方一行简短的日语标语。最底端边缘左侧包含 2 个小型社交或网站信息块，右侧包含一行微小的版权声明。采用高端现代动漫宣传插画风格，呈现明亮的柔和奇幻氛围、优雅的构图、流畅的线条和色彩、柔和的赛璐珞阴影、细腻的织物动感、光泽高光、复杂的服装细节、整洁的排版布局以及精致的商业海报质感。

titleLocalized.zh: 现代豪华别墅外观

templates.prompt: A realistic architectural rendering showcases a large, modern luxury detached villa, photographed directly from the front entrance with a perfectly centered and symmetrical composition. This two-story modern mansion features smooth, greyish-white stone or stucco walls, complemented by a dark charcoal roof, large black-framed windows, and a grand, recessed entrance with tall, dark double doors under a flat-roofed canopy. To the left is an open garage, clearly showing a white luxury SUV parked inside. To the right are floor-to-ceiling windows in the living room, revealing a black grand piano and subtly glimpsing elegant interior lighting. In the foreground, two tall grey stone pillars frame the entrance, each topped with a classic black lantern (two in total), while a gold plaque engraved with Japanese characters is embedded in the right pillar.{argument name="nameplate text" default="Fujisaki"} A wide, light gray tiled walkway extends from the main gate to the front door, flanked by neatly manicured lawns and lush white rosebeds. Trimmed shrubs, slender cypress trees near the entrance, low hedges, and greenery on the rooftop terrace are added. Lush trees encircle the perimeter of the scene. Bright summer midday sunlight, crisp shadows, a clear blue sky, and a few small white clouds create an ultra-clean look, showcasing high-end residential design, realistic reflections on the glass, and a sophisticated and desirable real estate advertising visual effect.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张逼真的建筑外观渲染图，展示了一座大型现代豪华独栋别墅，从前门正前方视角拍摄，构图完美居中且对称。这是一座两层高的现代豪宅，墙面采用光滑的灰白色石材或灰泥，搭配深炭色屋顶装饰，配有大型黑色边框窗户，以及位于平顶雨棚下、高大深色双开门的宏伟内嵌式入口。左侧是一个开放式车库，清晰可见里面停放着 1 辆白色豪华 SUV。右侧是落地玻璃客厅窗户，可以看到里面摆放着 1 架黑色三角钢琴，隐约可见优雅的室内灯光。前景中，2 根高大的灰色石柱构成了入口框架，每根柱顶各装有 1 盏经典黑色灯笼（共 2 盏），右侧石柱上镶嵌着一块刻有日文的金色铭牌 {argument name="nameplate text" default="藤 咲"}。一条宽阔的浅灰色瓷砖步道从大门延伸至前门，两侧是修剪整齐的草坪和繁茂的白色玫瑰花坛。增加修剪过的灌木、门口附近的细长柏树、低矮树篱以及屋顶露台绿植。在画面边缘环绕着郁郁葱葱的树木。采用明亮的夏季正午阳光、清晰的阴影、湛蓝的天空和几朵小白云，呈现超洁净的材质、高端住宅设计、玻璃上的逼真反射，以及精致且令人向往的房地产广告视觉效果。

templates.title: Japanese character relationship chart poster

titleLocalized.zh: 日文角色关系图海报

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as a character reference, the simple lineup is transformed into a beautifully designed Japanese light novel-style character relationship chart poster. The original 10 characters are retained, and their existing portraits are used as the base visuals, but the layout has been redesigned into a sophisticated infographic. The background uses a soft cream and light blue fantasy style, complemented by decorative borders, glitter, roses, and a small European-style hotel building illustration in the upper left corner. A striking Japanese title, "The Face of the Dominator," is added at the top, with the subtitle "Character Introduction & Related Illustrations," and a dark badge labeled "Netabare Selection Edition" is placed in the upper right corner. The heroine, Tsumugi Ichijo, is placed in the center as the focal point, within a framed character card labeled "Protagonist"; Keiji Hatano is placed in a large framed card on the right as a key corresponding character. Arrange the remaining 8 characters in separate profile cards around them: Kagasaka Sonoha, Kawahara Mio, Kashimura, Tsumugi's mother, Haruka, Kyoko, Mika, and Sakurako. Connect the characters with multi-colored arrows and relationship tags to visualize the relationship network; there are 14 visible relationship tags: "Friend", "Understanding Person", "Understanding the True Voice", "Longing", "Talking", "Planning", "Understanding with Intuition", "Mentor", "Practical Support", "The Existence of a Protector", "Junior Maker", "Supporting Junior Groups", "Junior Awakening/Hope". Simultaneously, add 8 central horizontal relationship markers between Tsumugi Ichijo and Keiji Hatano: "False Melt → Publicly Recognized", "Ribal", "Shared Secret", "Equal Partner", and "Existence of Feelings". Place a pink badge in the center that reads "To Trust from the Opposition", along with 3 lower markers: "Trust", "Press Back for Cooperation", and "Feelings of Fragrance from the Two of Us". Add a gold ribbon tag above the three girls below, which reads "ASTRAL's Accompanying Ones". Add a section at the bottom containing 10 smaller summary cards, one for each character, arranged horizontally. Add two bordered sidebars to the far right, titled "Keywords for the Work" and "Relationship Guide," respectively; the former contains four key points with icons, and the latter contains four key points with icons. Fill each card with dense Japanese profile text and character tags, creating a clean and editorial style, like a relationship guide included with a novel. The overall design should be elegant, easy to read, present a romantic suspense theme, and achieve magazine-quality standards.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 作为角色参考，将简单的阵容转化为精美的日式轻小说风格角色关系图海报。保留原有的 10 位角色，并沿用其现有的肖像画作为基础视觉，但将布局重新设计为精致的信息图表，背景采用柔和的奶油色和淡蓝色幻想风格，配以装饰边框、闪光、玫瑰以及左上角的小型欧式酒店建筑插图。在顶部添加醒目的日文标题「支配人はかりそめの顔」，副标题为「キャラクター紹介＆相関図」，并在右上角放置一个深色徽章，标注「ネタバレ配慮版」。将女主角一条 紬希置于中心作为焦点，放入标有「主人公」的框架角色卡中；将秦野 啓司放入右侧的大型框架卡中，作为关键对应角色。将其余 8 位角色排列在周围的独立个人资料卡中：加賀坂 その葉、川原 澪、樫村、紬希の母、ハルカ、杏子、美果、桜子。用多色箭头和关系标签连接角色以可视化关系网；包含 14 个可见的关系标签：「親友」、「理解者」、「本音を見抜く」、「憧れ」、「相談」、「画策」、「仲直り中」、「直感的理解」、「メンター」、「実務支援」、「保護者的存在」、「後輩　ムードメーカー」、「後輩　グループを支える」、「後輩　明るさ・希望」。同时在一条 紬希和秦野 啓司之间添加 8 个中央水平关系标注：「偽溶み→公認」、「ライバル」、「秘密を共有」、「対等な相棒」、「気になる存在」，并在中心放置一个粉色徽章，写着「反発から信頼へ」，以及 3 个下方的标注：「信頼」、「協力を後押し」、「二人の空気に気づく」。在下方三位女孩上方添加一个金色丝带组标签，写着「ASTRALの仲間たち」。在底部添加一个包含 10 个较小摘要卡的部分，每位角色对应一张，横向排列。在最右侧添加两个带边框的侧边栏，标题分别为「作品のキーワード」和「関係の見どころ」；前者包含 4 个带图标的要点，后者包含 4 个带图标的要点。用密集的日文个人资料文本和角色标签填充每一张卡片，风格简洁且具有编辑感，如同小说附赠的宣传关系指南。整体设计需优雅、易读，呈现浪漫悬疑主题，并达到杂志级品质。

templates.title: Blue Neon "Complete Negation" ASMR Anime Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 蓝色霓虹“全否定” ASMR 动漫肖像

templates.prompt: A delicate, anime-style close-up illustration depicts a young virtual YouTuber leaning towards her audience in a dimly lit blue neon studio, performing a harsh "total negation" ASMR. She has short, fluffy white hair with subtle ice-blue highlights, soft, layered bangs obscuring one eye, revealing a bright, half-open ice-blue eye. Her skin is fair, and her expression carries a hint of arrogance, indifference, and mockery. Her slightly parted lips seem to be whispering criticism into the listener's ear. One hand is raised to her mouth in a whispering gesture. She wears large, futuristic headphones with glowing cyan rings and droplet patterns on the top. She wears a white short-sleeved uniform with dark blue trim and gold buttons, a large dark blue ribbon tied at the collar, and a huge blue bow at the back. The word "shizuku" is clearly visible on the side label. Two blurred black binaural ASMR microphones are added in the lower left foreground to create a strong sense of depth. A glowing holographic vertical panel with Japanese text and wave graphics, including the title, is placed on the left.{argument name="headline text" default="Complete denial of ASMR"} and small brand text{argument name="brand name" default="SHIZUKU"} Below the title are four short, negative Japanese whispers displayed in a semi-transparent cyan UI style. The room behind her is dimly lit and atmospheric, with blurred, cool blue shelves and scattered glowing droplets or spots of light appearing in the background. Dramatic, cinematic lighting, a cool blue and white color scheme, glossy highlights, delicate blush, highly detailed eyes and hair, soft glow, clear cel-shaded anime rendering, intimate composition, and a slight Dutch tilt angle create a sense of presence, as if the character is invading the listener's personal space for an ASMR recording. The character should be presented as {argument name="character name" default="Shizuku"} ,have{argument name="hair color" default="White with light blue highlights"} hair and{argument name="eye color" default="Ice Blue"} The eyes.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的动漫风格近景插图，描绘了一位年轻的虚拟主播少女在昏暗的蓝色霓虹灯工作室中向观众倾身，主题为严厉的“全否定” ASMR。她留着蓬松的白色短发，带有淡淡的冰蓝色挑染，柔软的层次感刘海遮住了一只眼睛，明亮的冰蓝色半睁眼，皮肤白皙，表情带着一丝傲慢、冷漠和戏谑，微张的嘴唇仿佛正在对着听众的耳朵低语批评。一只手举在嘴边，做出低语的姿势。她戴着巨大的未来感头戴式耳机，耳机上有发光的青色圆环和顶部的液滴图案，身穿带有深蓝色镶边、金色纽扣的白色短袖制服，领口系着大大的深蓝色丝带，背后有一个巨大的蓝色蝴蝶结，侧面标签上清晰可见“shizuku”字样。在左下角前景中添加 2 个模糊的黑色双耳 ASMR 麦克风，营造出强烈的景深感。在左侧放置 1 个发光的全息垂直面板，包含日语文字和波形图形，其中包括标题 {argument name="headline text" default="全否定 ASMR"} 和小型品牌文字 {argument name="brand name" default="SHIZUKU"}。在标题下方包含 4 行简短的日语负面低语，采用半透明青色 UI 显示风格。她身后的房间昏暗且充满氛围感，背景中模糊的冷蓝色架子和散落的发光液滴或光斑若隐若现。采用戏剧性的电影级灯光，冷色调的蓝白配色，光泽高光，精致的腮红，高度精细的眼睛和发丝，柔和的辉光，清晰的赛璐珞动漫渲染，亲密的构图，轻微的荷兰式倾斜角度，营造出角色为了 ASMR 录音而侵入听众个人空间的临场感。角色应呈现为 {argument name="character name" default="Shizuku"}，拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="白色带浅蓝色挑染"} 的头发和 {argument name="eye color" default="冰蓝色"} 的眼睛。

templates.title: A desk bathed in sunlight, a white cat, and a laptop.

titleLocalized.zh: 阳光洒满的书桌，白猫与笔记本电脑

templates.prompt: A warm and sunny home office scene, presented in a realistic lifestyle photography style. A white shorthair cat with light green eyes sits calmly and attentively facing the camera on the left side of a warm wooden desk, its tail wrapped around its paws. To the cat's left is a lush indoor planter (in a beige textured pot) and a ceramic mug containing black coffee. In front of the cat is an open spiral notebook filled with handwritten notes, a silver fountain pen resting diagonally on the pages. To the right of the desk is a laptop slightly tilted towards the viewer, its screen displaying a vibrant wallpaper of a turquoise lake and majestic snow-capped mountains against a blue sky. Behind the desk is a large window with soft beige curtains, allowing bright golden morning light to stream in from the right, casting natural shadows on the desk. Two framed paintings are faintly visible on the left wall. The overall atmosphere should be tranquil, efficient, and warmly homey, possessing soft, cinematic lighting, sharp details, shallow depth of field, and a high-end editorial quality.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张温馨且阳光明媚的家庭办公场景，采用写实的生活摄影风格。一只拥有浅绿色眼睛的白色短毛猫端坐在温暖的木质书桌左侧中央，正对着镜头，神情平静而专注，尾巴环绕在两只前爪周围。猫的左侧摆放着 1 盆叶片茂盛的室内盆栽（置于米色纹理花盆中）和 1 个装有黑咖啡的陶瓷马克杯。猫的前方放着 1 本打开的螺旋笔记本，上面写有手写笔记，一支银色钢笔斜放在页面上。书桌右侧是 1 台稍微朝向观众倾斜的笔记本电脑，屏幕上显示着绿松石色湖泊与蓝天下壮丽雪山的生动壁纸。书桌后方是一扇大窗户，挂着柔软的米色窗帘，明亮的金色晨光从右侧射入，在书桌上投下自然的阴影。左侧墙壁上隐约可见 2 幅装裱好的挂画。整体氛围应显得宁静、高效且充满居家温暖感，并具备柔和的电影级光影、清晰的细节、浅景深效果以及高端的编辑摄影质感。

templates.title: Heartwarming Penguin Fantasy Movie Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 温馨企鹅奇幻电影海报

templates.prompt: A heartwarming, fictional movie poster, employing a soft, Japanese-style still-movie aesthetic, was captured at the golden hour with dreamy backlighting and gentle lens flare. In the image, a person wearing a comfortable beige knit sweater is photographed from behind and slightly below, holding a plush penguin toy high towards the bright sunset sky. The plush toy is centered and occupies most of the space: a black, fluffy body, a white belly, a yellow beak, yellow feet, short, outstretched wings, and a face resembling an anime girl, complete with a short brown bob and hair clip, creating an adorable and surreal mascot image. The background is an outdoor field with warm, blurred trees and a dazzling sun hanging low on the horizon, the overall color scheme being creamy beige, honey, peach, and gold. Several white feathers float in the air; five feathers must be clearly visible in the image. The atmosphere evokes a gentle, nostalgic, hopeful, and slightly fantastical feeling, like a family fantasy movie poster. Incorporate Japanese poster typography into the design: the slogan "この出会いが、世界をやさしく変えていく" is in the center of the top; "ずっと、いっしょだよ." is arranged vertically on the left; and there is a huge handwritten luminous title near the bottom center "{argument name="movie title" default="GUGUGAGA"} The lettering uses a warm white neon style font with a small pink heart at the top; below it is an elegant serif capital letter “”.{argument name="subtitle" default="THE MOVIE"} Below this, a pink ribbon banner is placed with the Japanese phrase "ずっと、いっしょだよ." At the very bottom, a small, centered Japanese credits list is added, using a realistic movie poster layout, including the cast and crew list as well as production/distribution information; the last line contains "gugugagaTokyo" and "AI Studio Tokyo." The design employs a vertical single-page poster composition, a sophisticated commercial visual, shallow depth of field, soft cinematic contrast, high-end cinematic lighting, and a sensual fantasy aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张温馨的虚构电影海报，采用柔和的日系电影剧照风格，拍摄于黄金时刻，带有梦幻般的逆光和柔和的镜头光晕。画面中，一名穿着舒适米色针织毛衣的人从后方及略低的角度被拍摄，正将一只毛绒企鹅玩具高高举向明亮的夕阳天空。毛绒玩具位于画面中心并占据大部分空间：黑色毛茸茸的身体、白色肚皮、黄色小嘴、黄色脚掌、向外伸展的短小翅膀，以及一张类似动漫少女的人脸，配有短棕色波波头和发卡，营造出一种可爱且超现实的吉祥物形象。背景是户外田野，带有温暖的树木虚化效果和地平线上低垂的耀眼太阳，整体色调为奶油米色、蜂蜜色、桃色和金色。几根白色羽毛在空中飘浮；画面中需清晰可见 5 根羽毛。氛围营造出温柔、怀旧、充满希望且略带奇幻的感觉，如同家庭奇幻电影海报。在设计中融入日文海报排版：顶部中央为宣传语“この出会いが、世界をやさしく変えていく。”；左侧垂直排列“ずっと、いっしょだよ。”；底部中央附近为巨大的手写发光标题“{argument name="movie title" default="GUGUGAGA"}”，采用温暖的白色霓虹灯风格字体，上方带有一个粉色小爱心；下方紧接着优雅的衬线大写字母“{argument name="subtitle" default="THE MOVIE"}”。在此下方，放置一条粉色丝带横幅，上面写有日文“ずっと、いっしょだよ。”。最底部添加居中的小型日文演职员表，采用真实的电影海报布局，包含演员和工作人员名单以及制作/发行信息；最后一行包含“gugugagaTokyo”和“AI Studio Tokyo”。采用垂直单张海报构图，精致的商业主视觉，浅景深，柔和的电影质感对比度，高级电影灯光，感性的奇幻剧情美学。

templates.title: Japanese automatic folding machine advertisement

titleLocalized.zh: 日式自动折衣机广告

templates.prompt: Create a minimalist Japanese lifestyle advertising poster showcasing a futuristic, compact appliance for automatically folding clothes. The background should be a bright, airy, minimalist Scandinavian-style living room with soft sunlight, white walls, a light-colored wooden table, a sofa, and greenery by the window. The background should be soft-focused to highlight the product. The main product is a rounded-corner rectangular white machine placed on a table, using a 3/4 front view. A neatly folded white T-shirt slides out of the machine from its lowered tray. Add a small digital display on the top front panel showing "04" and sophisticated modern control icons. Place a stack of four folded garments in the lower left foreground: three white shirts and one light blue shirt at the bottom. Use a high-end consumer electronics advertising style, photorealistic product rendering, soft shadows, high-key lighting, light blue-gray tones, a simple composition, and ample white space. Add oversized blue Japanese title text in the upper left corner.{argument name="headline text" default="Just place it down, in 4 seconds."} Add a smaller, dark gray Japanese subtitle below it.{argument name="subheadline text" default="Eliminate the need to fold clothes every day."} Below the subtitle on the left, three rounded rectangular function badges are arranged vertically, each with a blue outline icon and Japanese description: 1) T-shirt icon with "T-shirt/tour-acceptance", 2) Cube icon with "Computer design", 3) Family icon with "You can use your family". At the bottom center, four minimalist blue line icons and labels are evenly arranged: 1) Stopwatch icon with "Shortest 4 seconds", 2) T-shirt outline icon with "Sizes", 3) Folded towel icon with "Save space", 4) Finger snap icon with "Easy to use". In the lower left corner, the product brand name is added in a modern sans-serif font.{argument name="product name" default="Foldy Home 20"} Below is smaller Japanese text.{argument name="product category" default="Fully automatic clothes folding machine"} In the bottom right corner, a prominent blue price is displayed.{argument name="price" default="￥19,800"} It includes small gray text reading "(tax included)". A subtle "Pollo.ai" watermark is added to the upper right corner. The vertical poster format and clear commercial layout present a realistic aesthetic of Japanese home appliance catalogs.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张简洁的日式生活方式广告海报，展示一款用于自动折叠衣物的未来感紧凑型家电。背景采用明亮、通透、极简的斯堪的纳维亚风格客厅，配以柔和的日光、白墙、浅色木桌、沙发以及窗边的绿植，背景需进行柔焦处理以突出产品。主体产品为一台放置在桌面上的圆角长方形白色机器，采用 3/4 正面视角，前置托盘放下，一件整齐折叠的白色 T 恤正从机器中滑出。在顶部前面板添加一个微弱的数字显示屏，显示“04”及精致的现代控制图标。在左下角前景处放置一叠共 4 件折叠好的衣物：底部为 3 件白色衬衫和 1 件淡蓝色衬衫。采用高端消费电子广告风格，照片级产品渲染，柔和阴影，高调照明，淡蓝灰色调，构图简洁并留有大量空白。在左上角添加超大的蓝色日文标题文本 {argument name="headline text" default="置くだけ、4秒。"}。在其下方添加较小的深灰色日文副标题 {argument name="subheadline text" default="毎日の“たたむ”をゼロに。"}。在副标题下方的左侧，垂直排列 3 个圆角矩形功能徽章，每个徽章配有蓝色轮廓图标和日文说明：1) T 恤图标配“Tシャツ・タオル対応”，2) 立方体图标配“コンパクト設計”，3) 家庭图标配“家族みんなで使える”。在底部中心处，均匀排列 4 个极简蓝色线条图标及标签：1) 秒表图标配“最短４秒”，2) T 恤轮廓图标配“サイズぴったり”，3) 折叠毛巾图标配“省スペース”，4) 响指图标配“誰でも簡単”。在左下角，以现代无衬线字体排版添加产品品牌名称：{argument name="product name" default="Foldy Home 20"}，下方配以较小的日文文本 {argument name="product category" default="全自動服たたみ機"}。在右下角，显示醒目的蓝色价格 {argument name="price" default="￥19,800"}，并附带较小的灰色文本“（税込）”。在右上角添加一个隐约的“Pollo.ai”水印。竖版海报格式，清晰的商业排版，呈现写实的日本家电目录美学。

templates.title: Anime schoolgirl on the moon

titleLocalized.zh: 月球上的动漫女学生

templates.prompt: An incredibly detailed anime illustration depicts a beautiful girl sitting on the rocky surface of the moon, against a backdrop of deep, star-studded space, with a giant, glowing blue Earth floating in the upper right corner. She possesses {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} Her hair, extremely long and flowing in the low-gravity breeze, was styled in two rounded buns on either side of her head, with long strands cascading around her body. Her face was covered by a flat, square hood, obscuring all her features. She wore a Japanese school uniform: a crisp white long-sleeved shirt, a dark navy sleeveless knit vest with a turquoise bow at the neckline, a dark short pleated skirt, white knee-high socks, and brown leather loafers. She sat sideways on a rock, her legs outstretched towards the viewer, one hand supporting her body on the rock behind her. The composition, slightly tilted upwards, emphasized her legs and hair. The scene was illuminated by dramatic, cool-toned moonlight and rim lighting from space, creating glossy highlights on her hair, the folds of her clothing, and the dusty lunar rocks. In the background to the right in the distance, three clearly visible lunar base structures were visible: a towering antenna tower, a dish-shaped communication unit, and a cylindrical device. In the lower left foreground, there is a partially visible curved metallic spacecraft or habitat edge. The overall environment creates a cinematic, tranquil, futuristic, and slightly melancholic atmosphere, featuring ultra-detailed textures, shimmering dust particles, sharp lines, soft atmospheric lighting, and top-notch anime-quality visuals.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张细节极其丰富的动漫插画，描绘了一位美丽的少女坐在布满岩石的月球表面，背景是深邃且繁星点点的太空，右上角悬浮着一颗巨大的发光蓝色地球。她拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色"} 的头发，在低重力微风中极长且飘逸，发型为头顶两侧各有一个圆润的双丸子头，长发丝垂落在身体周围。她的脸部被一个位于头部的平整方形遮挡块覆盖，无法看到任何五官。她身穿日式校服：一件挺括的白色长袖衬衫、一件深海军蓝无袖针织背心、领口系着青绿色蝴蝶结、一条深色短百褶裙、白色及膝袜以及棕色皮质乐福鞋。她侧身坐在岩石上，双腿向观众方向伸展，一只手撑在身后的石头上支撑身体，构图采用略微仰视的角度，突出了她的双腿和头发。场景由戏剧性的冷色调月光和来自太空的轮廓光照亮，在她的头发、衣褶和布满尘埃的月球岩石上形成了光泽感的高光。在远处中右侧背景中，包含 3 个清晰可见的月球基地建筑：一座高耸的天线塔、1 个碟状通信单元和 1 个圆柱形装置。在左下角前景中，包含一个部分进入画面的弧形金属航天器或栖息地边缘。整体环境营造出电影般、宁静、未来感且略带忧郁的氛围，具备超精细的纹理、闪烁的尘埃粒子、锐利的线条、柔和的大气光晕以及顶级精美的动漫视觉质量。

templates.title: Anime schoolgirl on the moon

titleLocalized.zh: 月球上的动漫女学生

templates.prompt: A highly detailed anime illustration depicts a girl sitting on the rocky surface of the moon in outer space, viewed from a slightly overhead, three-quarter profile. She possesses very long and flowing hair.{argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} Her hair, styled in two round buns on top of her head, dramatically cascades to the right as if caught in low gravity or a solar wind. Her face is obscured by a soft, beige-gray rectangular occlusion in the center. She wears a Japanese school uniform: a white long-sleeved shirt, a dark blue sleeveless knit vest with a small green bow at the neckline, a gray pleated skirt, white knee-high socks, and brown loafers. She sits on the edge of a lunar rock, one hand behind her back, the other at her side, her legs stretched forward in a relaxed posture. The background is a deep, star-studded black sky, with a glowing Earth in the upper right corner, showcasing the Asia-Pacific region, and a soft beam of sunlight slanting in from the upper right. The lunar surface is a bright gray, covered with craters and jagged rocks, with a strong sense of texture. The image should include three pieces of lunar equipment: two metallic square panels or instrument cases in the foreground and middle ground on the left, and a small lunar rover or antenna-like device in the lower right corner. The lighting has a cinematic quality and a cool tone, with bright rim lighting on the hair edges and soft highlights on the school uniform and legs. It employs a sophisticated, modern anime-style visual style, with extremely clean lines, glossy hair, and subtle depth of field, creating a melancholic sci-fi atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度精细的动漫插图，描绘了一名少女坐在外太空岩石嶙峋的月球表面，视角为略微俯视的三分之四侧面。她拥有非常长且飘逸的 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色"} 头发，头顶有两个圆形的丸子头，发丝如同处于低重力或太阳风中一般向右侧戏剧性地飘散。她的脸部被一个位于正中央、呈柔和米灰色的矩形遮挡块所掩盖。她身穿日式校服：白色长袖衬衫、深蓝色无袖针织背心、领口系着一个小小的绿色蝴蝶结、灰色百褶裙、白色及膝袜以及棕色乐福鞋。她坐在月球岩石的边缘，一只手撑在身后，另一只手放在身侧，双腿向前伸展，姿态放松。背景是深邃且繁星点点的黑色天空，右上角是发光的地球，展示着亚太地区，一束柔和的阳光从右上角斜射进来。月球表面呈明亮的灰色，布满了陨石坑和锯齿状的岩石，质感强烈。画面中需包含 3 件月球设备：前景和中景左侧放置 2 个金属质感的方形面板或仪器箱，右下角放置 1 个小型月球车或类似天线的装置。灯光具有电影质感且偏冷色调，头发边缘有明亮的轮廓光，校服和腿部有柔和的高光。采用精致的现代动漫关键视觉风格渲染，线条极其干净，发丝具有光泽感，景深微妙，营造出一种忧郁的科幻氛围。

templates.title: Epic Gugugaga movie poster

titleLocalized.zh: 史诗级 Gugugaga 电影海报

templates.prompt: A dramatic, fictional movie poster, used for{argument name="movie title" default="GUGUGAGA"} The poster design is reminiscent of an epic film, featuring deep golden-brown cinematic lighting and a serious, award-winning tone. The composition is vertically symmetrical. At the center of the image, a round, black-and-white plush penguin mascot with large, glossy eyes, a yellow beak, and small yellow feet is ceremonially aloft by African tribal warriors. Six warriors surround the penguin, their muscular arms outstretched inwards and upwards to support the mascot, forming a radiating halo of hands and bodies. Their skin appears richly textured under warm highlights, and they wear brightly colored beaded necklaces, bracelets, headbands, and traditional ornaments. The background is a dimly lit ceremonial scene, with warm firelight, earth-toned shadows, fabric banners, and a textured amber halo, lending the scene an ancient and sacred atmosphere. At the top center, the Japanese text reads: "知られざるググガガの诞生秘話" (The Secret Story of the Birth of Knowing Guguga). To the left, the Japanese slogan reads: "モフモフが、世界を変えた" (Mofumofu ga, Sekai wo Heeta). To the right, five stacked gold laurel leaf award blocks are placed, each with Japanese text and decorated with a laurel wreath. These 5 The text of each award is: "The 38th Film Festival Award", "A Film Festival Film Festival", "World "The Most Excellent Prize at the Hikaru Association Award", "The Best Actor Award at the International Sugawara Awards", and "The Best Picture Award at the Hikaru Film Awards". In the lower center of the screen, place a large metallic gold serif title{argument name="movie title" default="GUGUGAGA"} Below is a smaller gold-lined subtitle.{argument name="subtitle text" default="THE MOVIE"} Below this, add a line of small, centered text: STARRING (Sound Performance). The lower area contains five circular actor badges with small laurel leaf borders and labels below. These five actor characters are: a fluffy white Pomeranian-like puppy labeled "Mofferin"; a giraffe labeled "Kawawoson"; an orange tabby cat labeled "Nyanbala"; a blue round toy-like character labeled "Tokutoku Alien"; and a scholar-like baboon or monkey figure labeled "Baobabu-sensei". Below the actor list, add detailed Japanese production information in a poster-style credits format, including director, screenwriter, and composer. At the bottom center, a prominent gold release date is displayed.{argument name="release date" default="7.7 FRI ROADSHOW"} Along the bottom edge are small production and distribution details, reading "Produced by: gugugagaTokyo" and "Distributed by: AI Studio Tokyo." A black-and-white QR code is placed in the bottom right corner. The poster features ultra-refined, photorealistic rendering, dramatic contrasts, gilded typography, a luxurious feel, boutique film marketing design, and a playful parody of Oscar-nominated adventure dramas.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张戏剧性的虚构电影海报，用于 {argument name="movie title" default="GUGUGAGA"}，采用史诗级大片海报设计，具有深金棕色的电影质感光影和严肃的获奖电影基调。构图呈垂直对称。画面中心，一只圆滚滚、有着大而有光泽的眼睛、黄色喙和小黄脚的黑白毛绒企鹅吉祥物，被周围的非洲部落战士以仪式般的方式高高举起。画面中共有 6 名战士围绕在企鹅周围，肌肉发达的手臂向内向上伸出以托举吉祥物，形成一个由手部和身体组成的放射状光环。他们的皮肤在温暖的高光下显得质感丰富，佩戴着色彩鲜艳的串珠项链、手镯、头带和传统饰品。背景是一个光线昏暗的仪式场景，伴有温暖的火光、大地色的阴影、织物横幅和充满质感的琥珀色光晕，赋予场景一种古老而神圣的氛围。在顶部中心，居中书写日语文案：「知られざるググガガの誕生秘話。」左侧垂直书写日语标语：「モフモフが、世界を変えた。」右侧放置 5 个堆叠的金色月桂叶奖项方块，每个方块均带有日语文字并由月桂花环装饰。这 5 个奖项文字分别为：「第38回 モフモフ オブザイヤー 受賞」、「アフリカン タッチ映画祭 グランプリ」、「世界ぬいぐるみ 協会賞 最優秀賞」、「国際もふもふ アカデミー賞 主演賞」以及「ぬいぐるみが 選ぶ映画賞 観客賞」。在画面中下部，放置巨大的金属金色衬线标题 {argument name="movie title" default="GUGUGAGA"}，下方配有较小的金色衬线副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="THE MOVIE"}。在其下方，添加一行居中的小字：STARRING (声の出演)。在下部区域，包含 5 个圆形演员奖章，带有细小的月桂叶状边框和下方的标签。这 5 个演员角色分别是：一只毛茸茸的白色博美犬状小狗，标签为「モフリン」；一只长颈鹿，标签为「カワウーソン」；一只橙色虎斑猫，标签为「ニャンバラ」；一个蓝色圆形玩具状角色，标签为「トゥクトゥク星人」；以及一个学者模样的狒狒或猴子形象，标签为「バオバブ先生」。在演员行下方，添加精细的海报演职员表风格的日语制作信息，包括导演、编剧和音乐。在底部中心，显示一行醒目的金色上映日期 {argument name="release date" default="7.7 FRI ROADSHOW"}。沿底部边缘，包含小型制作和发行信息，文字为「制作：gugugagaTokyo」和「配给：AI Studio Tokyo」。在右下角放置一个黑白二维码。采用超精细照片级海报渲染、戏剧性对比、镀金排版、奢华质感、精品电影营销设计，以及对奥斯卡热门冒险剧情片的戏谑恶搞。

templates.title: Anime schoolgirl floating on the moon

templates.prompt: A delicate anime illustration depicts a slender girl with {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} Her long hair floats calmly in a weightless, seated position on the lunar surface. Her exceptionally long, flowing hair dramatically extends to the right, styled in two round double buns on top of her head, cascading smoothly down to her legs. She wears a Japanese school uniform: a white shirt, a dark navy knit vest with a green bow at the neckline, a charcoal gray pleated skirt, white knee-high socks, and brown loafers. Positioned slightly to the left of center, her body leans slightly to the left, legs bent forward, one hand hanging naturally, she appears to be gently floating in low gravity. The background is the deep black of outer space, with a bright, realistic Earth visible in the upper right corner, radiating a blue-white light. Below, the lunar surface is grayish-white, covered in dust and craters, scattered with rocks, and softly shadowed. On the distant horizon, several small, futuristic lunar base domes and antenna-like structures dot the horizon. Using cool-toned moonlight, delicate contour lighting is outlined on the hair and body edges, with rich details in the hair strands and clothing folds. Soft anime lighting and clear lines are used to create a dreamy sci-fi atmosphere that combines the art of a cute female student character with a realistic space scene.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的动漫插画，描绘了一名身材苗条的少女，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色"} 的长发，在月球表面以平静的坐姿处于失重漂浮状态。她拥有极长的飘逸秀发，向右侧戏剧性地延展，头顶扎着两个圆圆的双丸子头，长发丝顺滑地垂落至腿部下方。她身穿日式校服：白色衬衫、深海军蓝针织背心、领口系着绿色蝴蝶结、炭灰色百褶裙、白色及膝袜和棕色乐福鞋。将她放置在画面中心偏左位置，身体微向左侧，双腿前屈，一只手自然下垂，仿佛在低重力环境下轻轻漂浮。背景是深邃的黑色外太空，右上角可见一颗明亮且写实的地球，散发着蓝白色的光芒。下方的月球表面呈灰白色，布满尘埃和陨石坑，散落着岩石，带有柔和的阴影，远处的地平线上点缀着几个小型未来感月球基地圆顶和类似天线的结构。采用冷色调月光，在头发和身体边缘勾勒出细腻的轮廓光，发丝和衣褶细节丰富，运用柔和的动漫光影、清晰的线条，营造出一种将可爱女学生角色艺术与写实太空场景相结合的梦幻科幻氛围。

templates.title: Movie-level sci-fi action poster

titleLocalized.zh: 电影级科幻动作海报

templates.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic, cinematic action poster against a golden sunset backdrop, depicting a rugged, adult male action hero standing on the edge of shattered glass in a futuristic megacity. Positioned on the left, he strikes a powerful full-body pose, wearing a dark fitted T-shirt, black jeans, and a dark cardigan jacket, with short, wind-blown brown hair. His face is deliberately obscured by a smooth, rectangular blur, as if censored. One hand holds a glowing blue holographic device projecting a transparent sci-fi interface displaying a map, target graphics, and a countdown timer showing 00:18:43. The background is a spectacular skyline of modern towers stretching to the horizon, with the sun low in the right-center sky, bathing the city in warm orange light. The sky is filled with explosive action movie elements: a large helicopter explodes mid-air in the upper right corner, accompanied by flames, smoke, debris, and spinning rotor wreckage; a damaged passenger plane tilts downwards in the lower right corner, trailing flames and black smoke; two fast-flying military jets streak across the sky in the upper left corner, leaving bright missile trails. The addition of flying embers, sparks, floating debris, and intense, voluminous smoke clouds creates a high-risk, disaster-themed atmosphere. A large, metallic 3D movie title is placed in the upper right center, with the content {argument name="title text" default="TIMEFALL"} With a slight tilt, it presents a rugged steel texture and cinematic shadow effects. Below the title, add a simple, eye-catching capitalized slogan:{argument name="tagline" default="ONE MAN. ONE CHANCE. NO LIMITS."} Add a small white brand logo in the upper right corner with the following text:{argument name="logo text" default="Pollo.ai"} It employs an ultra-realistic style, strong contrast, blockbuster poster composition, anamorphic lens flare, clear character details, epic scale, and exquisite Hollywood key visual art style.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张黄金时刻日落背景下的超写实电影级动作海报，画面展示了一位硬汉形象的成年男性动作英雄，站在未来超级城市高空摩天大楼破碎的玻璃边缘。他位于画面左侧，呈现强有力的全身姿态，身穿深色修身 T 恤、黑色牛仔裤和深色开衫夹克，留着被风吹乱的棕色短发。他的面部被一个平滑的矩形模糊块刻意遮挡，仿佛经过了审查。他的一只手拿着一个发光的蓝色全息设备，投射出一个透明的科幻界面，上面显示着地图、目标图形以及显示为 00:18:43 的数字倒计时。背景是延伸至地平线的现代高塔组成的壮观天际线，太阳位于中右侧低空，将温暖的橙色光芒洒满整座城市。天空中充满了爆炸性的动作大片元素：右上角有一架大型直升机在半空中爆炸，伴随着火焰、烟雾、碎片和旋转的旋翼残骸；右下角有一架受损的客机向下倾斜，拖着火焰和黑烟；左上角有两架快速飞行的军用喷气式飞机划过天空，留下明亮的导弹轨迹。加入飞舞的余烬、火花、漂浮的碎片和强烈的体积烟云，营造出高风险的灾难氛围。在右上方的中上部放置一个巨大的金属质感 3D 电影标题，内容为 {argument name="title text" default="TIMEFALL"}，带有轻微的角度倾斜，呈现粗犷的钢材纹理和电影级阴影效果。在标题下方，添加简洁醒目的大写标语：{argument name="tagline" default="ONE MAN. ONE CHANCE. NO LIMITS."}。在右上角添加一个小的白色品牌标志，内容为 {argument name="logo text" default="Pollo.ai"}。采用超精细的写实风格、强烈的对比度、大片海报构图、变形镜头光晕、清晰的人物细节、史诗般的规模以及精致的好莱坞主视觉艺术风格。

templates.title: Dragon Queen under the scorching sun

titleLocalized.zh: 烈日下的龙之女王

templates.prompt: A cinematic, dark fantasy portrait.{argument name="character name" default="A silver-haired dragon queen"} Standing atop black volcanic rubble in the foreground, a colossal black dragon guards her from behind. The woman wears an exquisite, floor-length black gown with armoric details on the chest and shoulders, long, fitted sleeves, a high collar, and a heavy, dark cloak trailing to the right. Her hair is…{argument name="hair color" default="Silver"} The dragon, long and wavy, shimmered faintly in the firelight. Her face was deliberately blurred, lacking defined features. The dragon dominated the background, its massive wings outstretched, framing the image; it possessed dense, charcoal-black scales, numerous sharp horns and facial spikes, glowing amber eyes, and a massive, arched neck above the woman. The background is set in a dilapidated medieval city, flanked by charred stone towers and collapsed buildings, with active flames, floating embers, smoke, and a fiery orange sunset sky with storm clouds. The low-angle, heroic composition, the epic contrast between human and beast, the ultra-detailed textures, the hyper-realistic fantasy style, the dramatic rim lighting, the fiery orange and black color scheme, the melancholic atmosphere, the clear focus on the queen and the dragon, and the cinematic poster aesthetics. A simple white sans-serif font was added near the upper right corner.{argument name="watermark text" default="Pollo.ai"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影级的暗黑奇幻肖像，{argument name="character name" default="一位银发龙之女王"} 站在前景中黑色的火山碎石上，身后是一条巨大的黑龙在守护着她。这位女性身穿一件精致的拖地黑色礼服，胸部和肩部带有盔甲细节，长袖修身，高领设计，厚重的深色斗篷向右拖曳。她的头发是 {argument name="hair color" default="铂银色"}，极长且呈波浪状散落，在火光中微微发亮。她的面部故意模糊处理，没有清晰的五官。巨龙占据了大部分背景，两只巨大的翅膀向外伸展，构成了画面的框架；它拥有浓密的炭黑色鳞片、许多锋利的角和面部尖刺、发光的琥珀色眼睛，巨大的弯曲脖颈在女性上方拱起。背景设定在一座破败的中世纪城市，两侧是烧焦的石塔和坍塌的建筑，地面上有活跃的火焰、漂浮的余烬、烟雾，以及带有风暴云层的炽热橙色落日天空。低角度英雄式构图，人类与野兽之间的史诗级比例对比，超精细纹理，超写实奇幻风格，戏剧性的轮廓光，火橙色与黑色的配色方案，忧郁的氛围，女王与巨龙聚焦清晰，大片海报美学。在右上角附近添加简洁的白色无衬线字体 {argument name="watermark text" default="Pollo.ai"}。

templates.title: Movie-quality fried chicken burger ad

titleLocalized.zh: 电影级炸鸡汉堡广告

templates.prompt: A visually striking, photorealistic close-up of a fast-food highlight showcases a giant crispy fried chicken sandwich and a basket of generously tossed fries, placed on a dark restaurant table. The sandwich, stacked high on the left, sits atop a glossy brioche bun topped with a spicy orange sauce, two crimson onion rings, three pickles, and two tomato slices. Melted cheddar cheese drizzles over the ultra-crispy chicken cutlet, accompanied by curly lettuce. The bottom bun is also drizzled with more creamy orange sauce. On the right, a black wire basket overflows with thick-cut fries, topped with crispy chicken nuggets, white sauce, and a touch of green herbs. The still-frame effect captures the orange sauce splattering upwards and around the burger, with crumbs and condiment particles floating in the air. Warm, cinematic lighting, deep shadows, high contrast, and shallow depth of field create a rich, golden-brown texture, giving the bread and sauce a glossy sheen, while the background is blurred with the ambiance of a high-end casual dining setting. The camera angle is low and close, a three-quarters frontal view, with the burger clearly in focus; the fries are slightly secondary but still rich in detail. A dark stone plate is set on the burger, its surface strewn with breadcrumbs and sauce drops. A simple white accent is added to the upper right corner.{argument name="brand text" default="Pollo.ai"} Logo.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具视觉冲击力的照片级快餐主打产品特写，展示了一个巨大的脆皮炸鸡三明治和一篮配料丰富的薯条，放置在深色的餐厅餐桌上。三明治位于画面中左侧，堆叠得很高，配有光亮的布里欧修面包，顶部面包涂有辛辣的橙色酱汁，放有 2 片紫红色洋葱圈、3 片酸黄瓜、2 片番茄，融化的切达干酪淋在超脆的炸鸡排上，配有卷曲的绿叶生菜，底部面包也淋有更多奶油状的橙色酱汁。右侧放置一个黑色金属丝篮，里面装满厚切薯条，顶部撒有脆炸鸡块、白色淋酱和少量绿色香草装饰。采用定格拍摄效果，橙色酱汁飞溅出水滴，向上方及汉堡周围迸发，空气中漂浮着面包屑和调味料颗粒。使用温暖的电影级灯光、深邃的阴影、高对比度、浅景深，呈现丰富的金棕色质感，面包和酱汁带有光泽感，背景为高档休闲餐厅中模糊的虚化效果。相机角度低且近，呈 3/4 正面视角，焦点清晰地对准汉堡，薯条略微次要但细节依然丰富。深色石板餐盘，表面散落着面包屑和酱汁滴。在右上角添加一个简洁的白色 {argument name="brand text" default="Pollo.ai"} 标志。

templates.title: Epic shonen manga collaboration poster

titleLocalized.zh: 史诗级少年漫联动海报

templates.prompt: A cinematic-quality anime collaboration poster is incredibly detailed, depicting four legendary shonen manga-style heroes charging side-by-side in an epic battle under a dramatic, apocalyptic sky. The scene is grand, symmetrical, and explosive, with intense golden sunlight streaming through a crack in the clouds, enveloping the characters. From left to right: On the left is a blond, ninja-style young hero dressed in orange and black, wearing a headband. He crouches in an attack stance, holding a glowing, spinning energy ball in his hand, surrounded by orange chakra flames, with several black spheres floating behind him; in the center left is a muscular, black-haired martial artist in an orange gi, twisting in mid-air to attack, accumulating a bright blue energy ball in his hand, surrounded by crackling blue halos and arcs of electricity; in the center right is a lean, pirate-style youth wearing a straw hat, a sleeveless red vest, blue shorts, and sandals, grinning as he charges forward, one arm outstretched, white, steam-like energy swirling around him; on the far right is a black-haired swordsman in a black and red checkered haori, drawing or swinging his sword, surrounded by a blazing red-orange energy arc. The background is a chaotic fantasy battlefield, where rubble, sparks, lightning, embers, lava glow, and swirling elemental effects intertwine. Orange flames dominate the left and right edges, while cool-toned blue energy concentrates around the martial artist, and white steam surrounds the pirate hero. It employs extremely high contrast, hypersaturated colors, sharp anime lines, an oil painting texture, dynamic perspective, strong motion blur effects, and top-tier poster-quality rendering. A large title is added to the bottom foreground.{argument name="headline text" default="SHONEN LEGENDS"} The text uses an oversized, distressed brush font, with bright gold accents, heavy black shadows, and rough, torn edges, partially obscuring the characters and fragments. The overall atmosphere is {argument name="franchise theme" default="legendary shonen anime crossover"} The blockbuster-level main visual poster is full of overwhelming energy, a battle between heroes, and an unstoppable momentum.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张细节极其丰富的电影级动漫联动海报，画面中 4 位传奇少年漫风格英雄在末日般戏剧性的天空下，于一场史诗级战役中并肩冲锋。场景宏大、构图对称且充满爆发力，云层顶部中央的裂隙中洒下强烈的金色阳光，笼罩着角色。从左至右：左侧是一位身穿橙黑相间服装、佩戴护额的金发忍者风格少年英雄，他呈攻击姿态蹲伏，手中凝聚着发光的旋转能量球，周身环绕着橙色查克拉火焰，身后漂浮着几颗黑色球体；左中是一位身穿橙色道服、肌肉发达的黑发武术家，他在半空中扭身出击，手中蓄积着明亮的蓝色能量球，周身缠绕着噼啪作响的蓝色光环与电弧；右中是一位戴着草帽、身穿无袖红背心、蓝色短裤和凉鞋的瘦削海盗风格青年，他咧嘴大笑向前猛冲，单臂伸展，白色的蒸汽状能量环绕周身；最右侧是一位身穿黑红格纹羽织的黑发剑士，他正在拔刀或挥剑，周围环绕着一道炽热的红橙色能量弧。背景是混乱的奇幻战场，碎石、火花、闪电、余烬、熔岩光芒与旋转的元素特效交织，左侧和右侧边缘以橙色火焰为主导，武术家周围集中着冷色调的蓝色能量，海盗英雄周围则环绕着白色蒸汽。采用极高的对比度、超饱和的色彩、锐利的动漫线条、油画质感、动态透视、强烈的特效运动模糊，以及顶级的海报级渲染效果。在底部前景添加一个巨大的标题 {argument name="headline text" default="SHONEN LEGENDS"}，使用超大号的做旧笔刷字体，亮黄金色配以厚重的黑色阴影和粗糙的撕裂边缘，部分遮挡角色与碎片。整体氛围如同 {argument name="franchise theme" default="legendary shonen anime crossover"} 的大片级主视觉海报，充满雷霆万钧的能量、英雄间的较量以及势不可挡的气势。

templates.title: Dark anime villain collaboration poster

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑动漫反派联动海报

templates.prompt: A dark, cinematic anime villain poster, employing an ultra-refined gothic horror style, dramatically collages four iconic villains against a backdrop of a ruined, infernal city. The wide, horizontal composition uses black, deep red, and electric purple as its primary colors, incorporating smoke, ash, embers, magical lightning, and chaotic, painterly brushstrokes. The image features four main villains. In the central foreground is a massive pirate emperor, grinning broadly, sporting a wild black beard, his red captain's coat open, revealing a scarred chest and abdomen. He wears multiple necklaces and belts, with several pistols at his waist, and raises two flintlock pistols in a victorious pose. Directly behind and above him is a tall, pink, muscular, demonic humanoid creature with a smooth head and a single, curled tentacle, its arms slightly outstretched, surrounded by a purple halo and lightning. On the left foreground is a long-haired, pale-faced Japanese swordsman in a loose, light-colored robe, his head slightly bowed, with a giant serpent coiled behind him, its mouth gaping open. Add the vertical Japanese text "Orochimaru" near this character, and the vertical text "Majin Buu" near the central character above. On the right is a tall, elegant demon king in layered dark kimonos, his long hair flowing, his posture calm yet malevolent. Above his head are eight smaller, dark red moons and one large full moon, totaling nine moons. Add the vertical Japanese text "Kurohige" near the pirate, and the vertical text "Kibutsuji Muzan" near the right-hand character. The background should depict a hellish, apocalyptic scene, with shattered towers, burning ruins, and shadowy buildings shrouded in smoke. Place a large, aggressively styled title text at the bottom.{argument name="headline text" default="RISE OF VILLAINS"} The image uses a blood-red color with magenta highlights, rough and torn edges, and a luminous texture. The entire image should have the feel of an epic collaboration key visual poster, with extremely high contrast, full of ominous, supernatural, and threatening elements.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张暗黑电影质感的动漫反派海报，采用超精细的哥特恐怖风格，将四位标志性反派以戏剧性的拼贴形式呈现于废墟般的炼狱城市背景中。采用宽幅横向构图，配色以黑色、深红和电光紫为主，融入浓烟、灰烬、余烬、魔法闪电以及混乱的绘画感笔触。画面包含 4 位主要反派角色。中心前景是一位体型庞大的海贼皇帝，咧嘴大笑，留着狂野的黑色胡须，敞开红色船长外套，露出布满伤疤的胸膛和腹部，佩戴多层项链和腰带，腰间别着多把手枪，以胜利者的姿态向外举着两把燧发枪。其后方正上方是一位高大的粉色肌肉恶魔类人生物，头部光滑，长有一根卷曲的头触，双臂微张，周身环绕着紫色光环与闪电。左侧前景是一位长发飘飘、面色苍白的日本剑客，身着宽松的浅色长袍，微微低头，身后盘踞着一条张开大口的巨蛇；在该角色附近添加竖排日文文本“大蛇丸”，并在上方中心角色附近添加竖排文本“魔人ブウ”。右侧是一位高大优雅的魔王，身着层叠的深色和服，长发飘逸，姿态冷静而邪恶，头部上方环绕着 8 轮较小的暗红色月亮和 1 轮巨大的满月，共计 9 轮月亮；在海贼附近添加竖排日文文本“黒ひげ”，并在右侧角色附近添加竖排文本“鬼舞辻無惨”。背景应呈现出地狱般的末日景象，破碎的塔楼、燃烧的废墟以及隐没在烟雾中的阴影建筑。底部放置巨大的、极具侵略性的笔触风格标题文本 {argument name="headline text" default="RISE OF VILLAINS"}，采用血红色搭配洋红色高光，边缘粗糙撕裂，并带有发光质感。整张图像应呈现出史诗级联动关键视觉海报的质感，对比度极高，充满不祥、超自然与威胁感。

templates.title: Dark Anime Legend Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑动漫传奇海报

templates.prompt: A cinematic-quality dark anime crossover poster, titled {argument name="title text" default="DARK LEGENDS"} The image showcases four iconic male anti-heroes standing in the ruins of a gothic, nightmarish city at night, with a massive, blood-red full moon overhead. The composition is a wide, dramatic group portrait, with the characters lined up in the foreground, each facing slightly different directions, displaying confident yet ominous body language. On the far left is a young soldier with short, dark hair, wearing a flowing dark green hooded military cloak, tactical slings and equipment visible at his waist, wielding two downward-pointing steel blades; a winged badge is visible on the back of the cloak. To the left of center is a tall, white-haired man with a spiky hairstyle, wearing a sharp, high-necked black suit, one hand in his pocket, his expression calm and commanding. To the right of center is a slender, brown-haired young man in a wrinkled white shirt, holding a black notebook with the words "Death Note" printed on the cover tightly to his chest, his posture exuding quiet wisdom. On the far right is a pale, white-haired, ghoul-like young man dressed in tattered dark clothing; one eye glows red, and two enormous, bizarre, red-black fleshy tentacles coil around his back and sides. In the background stand towering, ruined cathedral spires and shattered Gothic skyscrapers, many windows emitting a deep red glow. The sky is overcast and almost entirely black, illuminated by a huge red moon hanging high in the center behind the group, creating a backlit halo effect and strong rim lighting. The design employs dark tones of black, charcoal gray, deep crimson, and soft steel gray, with high contrast, a rough texture, subtle blood-red embers, and an ultra-detailed illustration/anime style. A worn, epic serif font is added at the bottom, spelling out…{argument name="headline text" default="DARK LEGENDS"} The font has a massive, cracked stone texture, with a red halo and weathered patterns. The overall atmosphere evokes a sense of apocalypse, fashion, threat, and mythology, like a key visual for a high-end film or game crossover.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影级的暗黑动漫跨界海报，标题为 {argument name="title text" default="DARK LEGENDS"}，展示了 4 位标志性的男性反英雄角色，他们站在夜晚一座哥特式噩梦般的废墟城市中，头顶是一轮巨大的血红色满月。构图为宽幅的戏剧性群像，角色们在前景一字排开，每个人朝向略有不同，展现出自信且不祥的肢体语言。最左侧是一位留着深色短发的年轻士兵，身穿随风飘动的深绿色连帽军用斗篷，腰间可见战术背带和装备，手持两把向下指的钢刃；斗篷背面可见带翅膀的徽章。中左侧是一位身材高大的白发男子，留着尖刺状发型，身穿干练的高领黑色服装，单手插兜，神情从容且充满统治力。中右侧是一位身材苗条、棕色头发的年轻人，身穿褶皱的白色衬衫，将一本封面印有“Death Note”字样的黑色笔记本紧贴胸前，姿态展现出沉静的智慧。最右侧是一位脸色苍白的白发食尸鬼般的年轻人，身穿破损的深色服装；露出一只发光的红眼，身后和身侧盘绕着两团巨大的、怪异的红黑色肉质触须。背景中矗立着高耸的废墟大教堂尖顶和破碎的哥特式摩天大楼，许多窗户透出深红色的光芒。天空阴云密布，几乎全黑，被高悬在群体后方中央的巨大红月照亮，营造出背光光环效果和强烈的轮廓光。采用黑色、炭灰色、深绯红和柔和钢灰色的暗色调，具有高对比度、粗粝的质感、细微的血色余烬，以及超精细的插画动漫风格。在底部添加磨损的史诗衬线字体，拼写出 {argument name="headline text" default="DARK LEGENDS"}，字体呈现巨大的裂纹石质感，带有红色光晕和风化纹理。整体氛围呈现出末日感、时尚感、威胁感和神话感，如同高端电影或游戏跨界的主视觉图。

templates.title: A surreal desert illuminated by two stars

titleLocalized.zh: 双星映照下的超现实沙漠

templates.prompt: A surreal, sci-fi desert landscape at dusk or night, with a vast sand plain covered by low-lying, floating mist, surrounded by dark, jagged rock formations. In the foreground, the lower left corner is framed by rugged rock edges, with steep cliffs on the left and smaller, jagged rocks on the right, and distant mountains drooping low on the horizon. In the center of the sky above the horizon, two enormous, overlapping celestial bodies are placed: the sphere in the back is a bright blue-to-cyan gradient ring, while the sphere in the front, slightly lower, is a partially obscured, luminous turquoise sphere with a soft atmospheric halo effect in its lower half. The sky is deep black, dotted with faint starlight, creating a minimalist cosmic atmosphere. Using cinematic lighting effects, the desert is rendered in warm amber brown tones, while the planets are presented in cool neon blue, combined with the soft mist, high contrast, ultra-high-definition digital rendering, and sharp terrain details, creating a tranquil and otherworldly ambiance.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅黄昏或夜晚的超现实科幻沙漠景观，广阔的沙原上覆盖着低矮的漂浮薄雾，四周环绕着深色的锯齿状岩层。前景中，左下角由崎岖的岩石边缘构成框架，左侧为陡峭的悬崖壁，右侧为较小的嶙峋岩石，远处的山脉低垂在地平线上。在地平线上方的天空中央，放置 2 颗巨大的重叠天体：后方的球体是一个明亮的蓝至青色渐变圆环，前方的球体位置略低，是一个部分遮挡的青绿色发光球体，其下半部分带有柔和的大气晕染效果。天空为深黑色，点缀着微弱的星光，营造出极简主义的宇宙氛围。采用电影级光效，沙漠呈现温暖的琥珀棕色调，行星呈现冷峻的霓虹蓝色，配合柔和的薄雾、高对比度、超清数字渲染、锐利的地形细节，营造出一种宁静而超凡脱俗的意境。

templates.title: Hidden Inscribed Rice Grains

titleLocalized.zh: 隐藏的刻字米粒

templates.prompt: A photorealistic close-up of a tabletop scene showcases a massive pile of raw white long-grain rice spilled onto a warm brown wooden surface, almost filling the entire frame. The camera is positioned slightly high and tilted towards the rice pile, creating a broad dome in the center of the image, with thousands of grains clearly visible and softly illuminated by warm indoor light. Hidden within the rice pile is a small Easter egg: near the lower left corner, a special grain of rice is horizontally rotated, its surface neatly engraved with…{argument name="engraved text" default="GPT Image 2"} The text should be clearly legible. Add a large, circular marker with a bright red outline in the lower left corner to focus on the engraved grain of rice, ensuring the text is clearly visible. Additionally, add a picture-in-picture window in the lower right corner showcasing a casual indoor live stream or interview scene: four people sitting around a round wooden table with an open laptop on it, warm lighting, and slightly blurred faces; this window should be a secondary background thumbnail, much smaller than the main image. Prioritize realistic textures, convincing macro details, natural shadows, subtle ivory variations in the rice grain, and clear, believable engraving on the highlighted grain.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张照片级逼真的桌面特写场景，展示了一大堆倒在温暖棕色木质表面上的生白长粒米，几乎填满了整个画面。相机位置略高并朝向米堆倾斜，使米堆在画面中心形成一个宽阔的圆顶，数千粒米清晰可见，并被温暖的室内光线柔和地照亮。在米堆中隐藏一个小彩蛋：左下角区域附近有 1 粒特殊的米粒，它水平旋转，表面整齐地刻有“{argument name="engraved text" default="GPT Image 2"}”字样，字体清晰易读。在左下角添加一个带有亮红色轮廓的圆形放大标注，聚焦于那粒刻字米粒，使其文字清晰可见。此外，在右下角添加 1 个画中画小窗口，展示一个休闲的室内直播或访谈场景，4 个人围坐在圆木桌旁，桌上放着一台打开的笔记本电脑，环境光温暖，人物面部略显模糊；该小窗口应呈现为次要的背景缩略图，尺寸远小于主图。优先考虑逼真的纹理、令人信服的微距细节、自然的阴影、米粒细微的象牙色变化，以及高亮米粒上清晰且真实可信的刻字。

templates.title: A deer indistinct in the green forest

titleLocalized.zh: 绿林中模糊的鹿

templates.prompt: This impressionistic wildlife photograph, featuring a strong subjective motion blur effect, showcases a deer in a clearing within a lush green forest. The animal stands sideways, slightly to the left of center, facing left. Its body is light brown to cream, with slender limbs, and its head and ears are softly blurred, appearing only faintly through the shadows of the dense foliage. The image exhibits strong diagonal and vertical camera motion blur, creating an impressionistic, dreamlike effect rather than sharp detail. The subject is surrounded by saturated summer greenery: a deep green background of bushes, deep forest shadows in the upper left, and bright, vibrant grass in the foreground. Using natural outdoor sunlight, the predominantly rich green tones and soft contrast create an abstract photographic style, as if capturing a fleeting glimpse of wildlife in motion. No people, text, buildings, or other animals are included in the image.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张具有强烈主观动态模糊效果的写意野生动物摄影作品，展示了茂密绿色森林空地中的 1 只鹿类动物。动物呈侧面站立，位于中心偏左位置，面向左侧，身体呈浅棕色至奶油色，四肢纤细，头部和耳朵轮廓柔和模糊，从茂密枝叶的阴影空隙中隐约显现。整张图像呈现出强烈的对角线和垂直方向的相机动态模糊，营造出一种印象派的梦幻效果，而非锐利的细节。主体周围环绕着饱和的夏季绿植：背景是深翠绿色的灌木丛，左上方是深邃的森林阴影，前景则是明亮鲜艳的草地。采用自然户外日光，色调以浓郁的绿色为主，对比度柔和，呈现出一种抽象的摄影风格，仿佛在移动中捕捉到野生动物转瞬即逝的身影。画面中不包含人物、文字、建筑物或其他动物。

templates.title: Chinese cursive calligraphy scroll

titleLocalized.zh: 中国草书书法卷轴

templates.prompt: A traditional Chinese ink calligraphy artwork, presented on aged beige Xuan paper, is displayed as a clean, flat sweeping image or a single hanging scroll photograph, without a border. The composition is entirely vertical, featuring Chinese cursive script. The deep black ink showcases bold and expressive brushstrokes, exhibiting dynamic variations in strokes, the texture of flying white strokes, dry brushwork, broken strokes, and an elegant rhythm. Please write the complete poem.{argument name="poem text" default="My hair bristles with rage, I lean against the railing as the rain subsides. I raise my eyes, gaze at the sky, and roar with fierce determination. Thirty years of fame and glory are but dust and dirt, eight thousand miles of road are but clouds and moon. Do not idly let your youthful head turn white, only to be filled with empty sorrow. The shame of Jingkang remains unavenged; the hatred of the subjects, when will it be extinguished! I will drive my chariot, shattering the Helan Mountains. With lofty ambition, I will feast on the flesh of the barbarians when hungry, and laughingly drink their blood when thirsty. I will wait to start anew, to reclaim our lost lands, and return to the imperial palace."} The text is arranged in large, vertical characters from right to left, spanning approximately eight columns of the main poems. Each line is written freely, with slight variations in spacing and slant. A large blank space on the left contains three narrower vertical columns of inscriptions: the title and signature.{argument name="inscription text" default="Yue Fei's "Man Jiang Hong" (Full River Red) - A poem written in the year Jia Chen, by a certain Yuan"} The writing style is relatively restrained but still retains the essence of cursive script. Three red seals are added: two square seals are stacked below the inscription in the lower left corner, and a small oval seal is added next to the first line of poetry in the upper right corner. The paper should have delicate warm brown spots, soft fiber texture, subtle signs of age, and natural unevenness in tone. The overall atmosphere is dignified, elegant, and of museum quality, presenting the aesthetics of Chinese calligraphy in the style of the Song Dynasty, with a simple background, rich details, and realistic brushstroke texture.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅传统的中国水墨书法艺术作品，呈现于陈年米色宣纸上，以干净的平扫图或单幅挂轴照片形式展示，无边框。构图为全竖版中国草书，深黑色墨迹展现出大胆且富有表现力的草书笔触，具有动态的笔画变化、飞白质感、枯笔断笔及优雅的韵律。请书写完整诗词 {argument name="poem text" default="怒发冲冠，凭栏处、潇潇雨歇。抬望眼，仰天长啸，壮怀激烈。三十功名尘与土，八千里路云和月。莫等闲，白了少年头，空悲切。\n靖康耻，犹未雪；臣子恨，何时灭！驾长车，踏破贺兰山缺。壮志饥餐胡虏肉，笑谈渴饮匈奴血。待从头，收拾旧山河，朝天阙。"}，采用从右向左排列的大字竖行，页面横跨约 8 列主要诗句，每行书写自由，间距与倾斜度略有变化。左侧留出宽阔的空白，包含 3 列较窄的竖排题跋：标题及落款为 {argument name="inscription text" default="岳飞 满江红 甲辰書月 某元"}，书写风格较收敛但仍保持草书笔意。添加 3 枚红色印章：左下角题跋下方叠放 2 枚方形印章，右上角首行诗句旁加盖 1 枚小型椭圆印章。纸张应带有细腻的暖棕色斑点、柔和的纤维纹理、淡淡的岁月痕迹及自然的色调不均。整体氛围庄重、文雅且具博物馆级品质，呈现出宋代风格的中国书法美学，背景简洁，细节丰富，笔触质感真实。

templates.title: Japanese Eel Competition Logo

titleLocalized.zh: 日本鳗鱼大赛 Logo

templates.prompt: Create a bold, Japanese-style logo on a clean, light gray background for a fictional racing-themed eel character brand. The main text should be prominent Japanese katakana/kanji, and the content should be {argument name="main logo text" default="Una-musume"} Below is a smaller subtitle banner that reads:{argument name="subtitle text" default="ヌルヌルダービー"} Integrate two eel illustrations precisely into the text: the first, a deep navy blue eel, coils around the upper left of the first character, featuring a cute smiley face and light-colored belly markings; the second eel forms a large, curved curl to the right of the last character. Use vibrant aquatic colors, including deep cobalt blue, electric blue, cyan, teal, white highlights, and metallic gold edges. The text should have a thick white inner border, gold outer trim, delicate shadows, and a glossy, energetic arcade mascot style. Add dynamic water splash effects to the lower left and right corners, flowing wave ribbons below the text, six gold star-shaped glitters scattered around the logo, and four small blue diamond-shaped glitter decorations near the center and top. Add a horizontally extending blue and white checkered racing flag pattern after the subtitle. The overall composition should be playful, sophisticated, and fast-paced, combining marine elements with the energy of horse racing or a major competition, presenting a clear vector-style logo art effect with delicate gradients and a strong sticker-style outline.

promptLocalized.zh: 在干净的浅灰色背景上创作一个大胆的日本风格 Logo，用于一个虚构的赛车主题鳗鱼角色品牌。主文字应为醒目的日文片假名/汉字，内容为 {argument name="main logo text" default="ウナ娘"}，下方配有一个较小的副标题横幅，内容为 {argument name="subtitle text" default="ヌルヌルダービー"}。将 2 条鳗鱼插画精确融入文字中：第一条深海军蓝色的鳗鱼盘绕在第一个字符的左上方，带有可爱的笑脸和浅色腹部斑纹；第二条鳗鱼在最后一个字符的右侧形成一个大弧度的卷曲。使用鲜艳的水系配色，包括深钴蓝色、电光蓝、青色、蓝绿色、白色高光以及金属金色边缘。文字应带有厚实的白色内边框、金色外饰边、细腻的投影，并呈现出光泽感强、充满活力的街机吉祥物风格。在左下角和右下角添加动态水花特效，文字下方加入流动的波浪丝带，Logo 周围散布 6 个金色的星形闪光，并在中心和顶部附近添加 4 个小型蓝色钻石状闪光装饰。在副标题后方，加入水平延伸的蓝白方格赛车旗图案。整体构图应兼具趣味性、高级感与快节奏，将海洋元素与赛马或大赛的活力相结合，呈现出清晰的矢量风格 Logo 艺术效果，并带有精致的渐变和强烈的贴纸风格轮廓。

templates.title: Minimalist SaaS poster and pink mascot

titleLocalized.zh: 极简 SaaS 海报与粉色吉祥物

templates.prompt: A bold, minimalist brand poster with a matte black background and a soft, grainy print texture, reminiscent of a startup's landing page graphic. A simple cream-colored logo icon is placed in the top left corner, followed by the brand name.{argument name="brand name" default="Biscuit"} The text uses a refined serif font. Below it, a large, left-aligned typographic block is created, occupying approximately half of the left side of the composition. The main title is {argument name="headline text" default="Built for solopreneurs."} The text uses an oversized, elegant cream serif font with strong contrast and ample line spacing. Directly below it, a second line heading is added, using a vibrant bright pink italic serif font, containing the following content:{argument name="tagline text" default="Backed by simplicity."} Add a smaller white sans-serif text block below, left-aligned, with the following content:{argument name="body text" default="Everything you need to launch, run, and grow—all in one place."} Place the URL near the bottom left corner.{argument name="website text" default="biscuit.so"} The design uses a bold, bright pink sans-serif font. The right half features a cute, abstract mascot: a rounded, irregularly shaped, cloud-like pink blob with scalloped edges, two large, round, cream-colored and black eyes, a tiny, curved, smiling mouth, and two small, rounded hands resting on a large, curved pink shape that rises from the bottom edge, resembling a small mountain or product surface. Dense bright pink splatter-like spots and particles are added to the upper right quadrant, grading towards the center to create a playful cosmic ink splatter effect. The design utilizes a limited color palette of black, cream, white, and saturated pink; high-contrast editorial layout; ample white space; a clean, modern, approachable, and founder-friendly SaaS brand aesthetic; a centered, right-side character; and a vertical poster composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张大胆的极简主义品牌海报，采用哑光黑色背景，带有柔和的颗粒印刷质感，设计风格类似于初创公司的落地页首屏图形。在左上角放置一个简单的奶油色 Logo 图标，后跟品牌名称 {argument name="brand name" default="Biscuit"}，采用精致的衬线字体。在其下方，创建一个大型左对齐的排版块，占据构图左侧约一半的空间。主标题为 {argument name="headline text" default="Built for solopreneurs."}，使用超大号优雅的奶油色衬线字体，具有强烈的对比度和宽裕的行间距。在其正下方，添加第二行标题，使用鲜艳的亮粉色斜体衬线字体，内容为 {argument name="tagline text" default="Backed by simplicity."}。下方添加一个较小的白色无衬线正文块，左对齐，内容为 {argument name="body text" default="Everything you need to launch, run, and grow—all in one place."}。在左下角附近，放置 URL {argument name="website text" default="biscuit.so"}，使用粗体亮粉色无衬线字体。在右半部分，展示一个可爱的抽象吉祥物：一个圆润且不规则的云状粉色团块角色，边缘呈扇贝状，拥有 2 只巨大的奶油色与黑色圆形眼睛、1 个微小的弯曲笑嘴，以及 2 只小巧圆润的手，正搁在一个从底部边缘升起、类似小山或产品表面的巨大弧形粉色形状上。在右上象限添加密集的亮粉色喷溅状斑点和颗粒，并向中心渐变，营造出俏皮的宇宙墨水飞溅效果。使用黑色、奶油色、白色和饱和粉色的有限调色板；高对比度的编辑排版；大量的留白；简洁、现代、平易近人且对创始人友好的 SaaS 品牌美学；角色位于右侧居中；竖版海报构图。

templates.title: Retro newspaper front page generator

templates.prompt: Create the most realistic retro newspaper front page design with the main subject at its center. The layout should resemble an authentic printed newspaper with a cinematic black-and-white aesthetic. The main photograph should be prominently placed in the center with a border, similar to an image in an article headline. The subject in the photograph should remain clear and legible in natural light, with slightly increased contrast to match the eye-catching editorial style. Create a striking and attention-grabbing headline at the top (create a unique headline that matches the mood of the photograph—it can be romantic, mysterious, humorous, or dramatic). Add a smaller subheading below the headline to make it look like authentic newspaper captions. Add realistic newspaper elements: small text columns (in a randomized, pseudo-text style, but with typography like real news); a fictional publication name at the top (e.g., "The Daily Prompts," "AI Times," or similar—get creative based on the image); date, issue number, and location; decorative lines, separators, and retro typography; small supplementary articles or captions related to the main image; optional stamps, doodles, or editorial notes to add personality. Style: Black and white or slightly faded monochrome paper; fine paper texture, graininess, and ink imperfections; subtle shadows and creases mimicking real printed paper; a clean but slightly worn vintage newspaper aesthetic. Atmosphere: Imbues the design with personality, expressiveness, and a sense of narrative, as if the narrative were part of the main article. Aspect Ratio: 4:5 or 1:1; a highly detailed, hyper-realistic blend of editorial photography and print design.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个以主角为核心的最逼真的复古报纸头版设计。布局应采用真实印刷报纸的风格，并具有电影般的黑白美学。主照片应醒目地放置在中心位置并带有边框，类似于文章标题中的图片。照片中的主体应保持不变，在自然光下清晰可辨，并略微增加对比度，以符合引人注目的编辑风格。在顶部创建一个醒目且引人注目的标题（创建一个符合照片意境的独特标题——可以是浪漫、神秘、幽默或戏剧性的）。在标题下方添加一个较小的副标题，使其看起来像真实的报纸说明文字。添加逼真的报纸元素：小字栏（采用乱数假文风格，但排版如真实新闻）；顶部是虚构的出版物名称（例如 “The Daily Prompts”、“AI Times” 或类似名称——根据图片发挥创意）；日期、期号和地点；装饰线、分隔符和复古排版；针对主图的小型附加文章或说明文字；可选的印章、涂鸦或编辑注释以增加个性。风格：黑白或略微褪色的单色纸张；精细的纸张纹理、颗粒感和油墨瑕疵；模仿真实印刷纸张的细微阴影和折痕；干净但略显磨损的复古报纸美学。氛围：赋予设计个性、表现力和情节感，仿佛该情节是主文章的一部分。宽高比：4:5 或 1:1；编辑摄影与印刷设计的高细节、超逼真混合体。

{argument name="story concept" default="一位女性住在一个安静的公寓里，身边有一只紧张且难以预测的老虎。老虎表现得像家猫，但时刻带有危险气息。当她奉上产品（猫粮）时，老虎明显放松下来，并转变为一只平静的家猫。"}

视觉优先级：
- 紧张感（老虎）与放松感（猫）之间的强烈对比
- 每一帧都具备清晰的易读性

The texture conveys a high-resolution, fashion-movie feel with a shallow depth of field. promptLocalized.zh:
主体与构图：

中心人物：{argument name="subject profile" default="一名戴着 1940 年代经典软呢帽、身穿正装的男子的侧脸轮廓"}。

templates.title: Pizza food photography and infographics

templates.prompt: A high-end food photography piece featuring a slice of pizza against a warm, rustic wooden background. The pizza's edges are golden and crispy, the mozzarella cheese is melted and has a distinct stringy texture, and the bottom is covered with rich tomato sauce. Toppings include pepperoni, black olives, green peppers, and herbs. The image is rich in detail, showcasing the sheen of the cheese, the oiliness of the toppings, and the realistic texture of the baked crust. Soft, cinematic lighting creates depth and subtle shadows. Ultra-high-definition focus, high-end food advertising style, hyperrealistic, 8K resolution. Create a hyperrealistic, vertically dissected infographic of a slice of pizza. The top-to-bottom structure is as follows: Melted cheese layer (glossy mozzarella cheese with a stretchy texture) → Toppings layer (Italian pepperoni, olives, and green peppers with natural details) → Herb seasoning layer (lightly scattered oregano leaves and spice granules) → Tomato sauce layer (smooth sauce with a rich color and a subtle sheen) → Crust base (thick, baked crust with crisp edges). All layers must be perfectly centered, evenly spaced, and vertically aligned. Use a warm, rustic background with soft studio lighting and realistic shadows below each floating layer. The overall composition should combine the quality of a high-end food advertisement with a clean infographic layout. Use thin indicator lines to add simple infographic labels with the following content: "Cheese," "Toppings," "Seasoning," "Sauce," and "Crust." Ultra-fine food textures, DSLR macro quality, hyper-realistic, high-end advertising aesthetics, 8K resolution.

创作一张超写实的垂直拆解式美食披萨切片信息图。
从上至下的结构：
融化芝士层（带有拉丝质感的亮面马苏里拉芝士）
→ 配料层（带有自然细节的意大利辣香肠、橄榄、青椒）
→ 香草调味层（轻微散落的牛至叶碎和香料颗粒）
→ 番茄酱层（色泽浓郁且带有微光的顺滑酱料）
→ 饼底层（边缘酥脆的厚实烘焙饼底）
所有图层必须完美居中、间距均匀且垂直对齐。使用温暖的乡村风背景，配合柔和的摄影棚灯光，并在每个悬浮层下方添加逼真的阴影。整体构图应兼具高级食品广告的质感与简洁的信息图布局。
使用细指示线添加简洁的信息图标签，标签内容如下：
“Cheese”（芝士）
“Toppings”（配料）
“Seasoning”（调味）
“Sauce”（酱料）
“Crust”（饼底）

超精细食品纹理，DSLR 微距画质，超写实，高级广告美学，8K 分辨率。

templates.prompt: {argument name="grid layout" default="12-sided grid (4x3)"} Each panel is the same continuous{argument name="environment" default="Forest World"} Each independent, complete, isometric cylindrical 360° panoramic view panel = a complete spherical environment (360° horizontal, 180° vertical). Realistic isometric cylindrical projection with natural distortion: edge stretching, horizon curvature, and vertical compression towards the zenith and nadir. Strict global consistency between panels: identical forest biomes, architectural language, materials, lighting logic, proportions, and color palette; no visual bias. Ultra-fine environment, solid material response (wood, moss, fabric, stone), realistic imperfections, and microscopic detail variations. Large-scale forest environment, integrating massive vertical structures into the trees. Multi-layered platforms, bridges, embedded interior spaces, and organic architectural logic. Lighting: Natural light sources only (lanterns, windows, bioluminescence). Soft volumetric fog interacts with beams; physically correct attenuation, no excessive halo, no artificial flooding. Balanced contrast, cinematic highlights, and deep yet clear shadows. Rich atmospheric perspective, layered depth, subtle particle effects, natural haze, humidity, soft diffusion. Camera (important): Each panel = fixed center capture point of a spherical camera. True 360° capture, no composition, no perspective bias, no cropped view, but with subtle real-world camera characteristics: slight lens softening at the edges, gentle exposure adaptation, natural highlight falloff. Each panel represents a different location within the same world: canopy height, bridge mid-levels, interior spaces, vertical forest clearings, forest ground transitions. The environment is fully presented in all directions: above (canopy, sky gaps, light sources) and below (structure, root system, depth layers). templates.title: Key visual (KV) for luxury skincare brands

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华护肤品牌主视觉 (KV)

templates.prompt: This minimalist, oriental-inspired luxury advertising poster for a high-end skincare brand, "BRAND," exudes a pure and restrained atmosphere, blending technological sophistication with Eastern aesthetics. The centerpiece is a premium serum in a glass bottle with a transparent gradient (transparent at the top → cool turquoise at the bottom), featuring a liquid sheen at the base and a champagne gold metal cap. The product rests on a circular, high-gloss base made of polished stone and metal. The exquisite details make it the undisputed visual focal point. Surrounding the product are delicate golden halos and flowing light bands, forming a subtle S-shaped motion, symbolizing repair and regeneration. The light diffuses outwards to enhance the visualization of efficacy. Slightly behind on the right side of the background is an Eastern woman, turning her head to look back. Her demeanor is composed and elegant, with delicate, natural features and a radiant, cool-toned fair complexion (emphasizing skincare effects). Her low-saturation orange-pink makeup is accented with subtle gold highlights. Her long black hair flows in the wind, with golden specks and faint bands of light woven into the strands. The overall effect is clean and restrained, without excessive embellishment, echoing the product's luminous effect. Dressed in semi-transparent silk attire and a shawl, the figure is light and flowing, the material translucent with delicate gold leaf textures and soft reflections, presenting a high-end feel. The lighting system uses a clean, warm gold main light source (side and rear), with the product as the focal point and the figure as auxiliary light. The edge lighting is soft, with subtle volumetric lighting, and tiny gold particles floating in the air, resulting in clear and unexposed overall lighting. The background features a minimalist gradient of light and shadow (off-white + warm gold transition), with large areas of white space, creating a clean and uncluttered image that allows for ample space for the advertisement's layout. Cool-toned turquoise water ripples or mineral-like elements are added to the bottom (symbolizing pure technology and the source of ingredients), enhancing the brand's "pure technology" feel. The color scheme is strictly controlled: the main colors are gold + off-white, accented with cool turquoise and champagne gold, resulting in an overall low-saturation, sophisticated color palette. The composition uses a stable central composition with a slight S-curve, ensuring clear visual focus and hierarchy (product > light and shadow > figure). Overall style: High-end, pure, restorative, regenerative, and anti-aging technology; the quality of an international high-end skincare advertisement (similar to La Mer/SK-II). Ultra-refined, 8K texture, commercial photography-grade lighting, realistic material representation. Negative keywords: product distortion, typos, excessive decoration, crowded image, cheap gold look, chaotic lighting, overexposure, low resolution.

promptLocalized.zh: 极简东方奢华广告风格，高端护肤品牌 KV 海报，品牌名称为 "BRAND"，整体氛围纯净、克制，将科技感与东方美学相结合。画面中心为一款高端精华产品，玻璃瓶身，呈现透明渐变质感（顶部透明 → 底部冷青绿色），底部带有液体光泽，搭配香槟金金属瓶盖。产品放置在由抛光石材和金属制成的圆形高光底座上。细节精致清晰，作为绝对的视觉中心。产品周围环绕着细腻的金色能量光环和流动的光带，形成轻微的 S 型动势，象征修复与再生能量，光线向外扩散以强化“功效可视化”。背景右侧略微靠后处有一位东方女性，侧身回眸，气质沉稳优雅，五官精致自然，冷白皮透出通透光泽（强调护肤效果），低饱和度橘粉色妆容点缀淡淡金色高光。黑色长发随风飘动，发丝间融入金色光点与微弱光带，整体干净克制，不过度装饰，与产品光效呼应。身着半透明丝绸服饰与披肩，轻盈飘逸，材质通透且带有精细的金箔纹理与柔和反光，呈现出高级质感。灯光系统采用干净的暖金色主光源（侧后方），产品为焦点，人物为辅助光，边缘光柔和，存在微弱的体积光，空气中漂浮着细小的金色光粒，整体光感清晰且不过曝。背景为极简光影渐变（米白色 + 暖金色过渡），大面积留白，画面干净无杂质，为广告排版留出空间。底部加入冷色调青绿色水纹或矿物质感元素（象征纯净科技与成分来源），增强品牌的“纯净科技感”。严格控制色彩体系：主色为金色 + 米白色，点缀冷青绿色与香槟金，整体为低饱和度高级色调。构图采用稳定的中心构图 + 轻微 S 型曲线，视觉焦点与层级清晰（产品 > 光影 > 人物）。整体风格：高端、纯净、修复再生、抗衰老科技，国际大牌护肤品广告质感（类似 La Mer / SK-II 级别）。超精细，8K 纹理，商业摄影级布光，写实材质表现。负面提示词：产品变形、文字错误、装饰过多、画面拥挤、廉价金、灯光混乱、过曝、低分辨率。
