templates.title: Magnificent martial arts palace poster

titleLocalized.zh: 金碧辉煌武侠宫廷海报

templates.prompt: A dramatically dramatic retro Chinese martial arts movie poster, employing luxurious dark gold and amber hues, presents a classic historical epic style. At the center of the composition is a young royal man seated in the foreground, clad in a magnificent black and gold dragon robe, wearing a Qing Dynasty red-tasseled official hat, one hand covering his mouth, his expression sly, confident, and mischievous. Surrounding him are eight beautiful court ladies in layered silk Hanfu and light gauze robes, arranged closely in a captivating harem portrait style, four in the top row and four in the bottom. Each woman wears an elegant updo, adorned with exquisite gold hairpins, floral ornaments, and dangling earrings, her makeup soft and warm; her expressions ranging from alluring and gentle to curious. The women's clothing uses champagne, blush pink, peach, rose, and pale jade fabrics, paired with semi-transparent cuffs, embroidered bodices, and richly textured jewelry. Behind the figures is an old wooden plaque engraved with the golden Chinese characters "鹿鼎记" (The Deer and the Cauldron), above which is a smaller inscription: "Jin Yong's Martial Arts Classic." Add vertically arranged Chinese actor names next to the different characters: "Su Quan" on the far left, "Chen Yuanyuan" at the bottom left, "A Ke" at the top left center, "Princess Jianning" at the top right center, "Mu Jianping" at the top right center, "Fang Yi" in the middle right center, "Shuang'er" at the bottom right center, and "Zeng Rou" at the bottom right center. Add a vertically arranged poetic Chinese slogan at the top left edge: "Small people, great wisdom, roaming the martial world and the imperial court, playing all over the world, winning the heart of a beauty." Incorporate a secondary movie scene at the bottom: an ancient palace gate and courtyard, soldiers and flags forming a grand procession, with a solitary figure in the foreground walking towards the audience. The bottom edge concludes with a narrow Chinese slogan: "A revolutionary heroic legend, a hilarious martial arts myth." The entire image should present a gorgeous, dramatic, romantic, and slightly playful atmosphere, accompanied by smoky dark brown shadows, luminous rim lighting, rich textures, symmetrical poster composition, and exquisite high-end period drama main visual effects.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧感的复古中国武侠电影海报，采用奢华的暗金与琥珀色调，呈现经典历史史诗风格。构图中心为一名坐在前方的年轻皇室男子，身穿华丽的黑金龙袍，头戴清朝红缨官帽，单手掩口，神情狡黠、自信且顽皮。周围环绕着 8 位身着层叠丝绸汉服与轻纱长袍的美丽宫廷女子，她们以迷人的后宫群像风格紧密排列，上排 4 人，下排 4 人。每位女子都梳着优雅的发髻，佩戴精致的金钗、花饰和垂坠耳环，妆容柔和温暖；神情或妩媚、或温柔、或好奇。女子们的服饰采用香槟色、腮红粉、桃色、玫瑰色和淡玉色面料，配以半透明袖口、刺绣胸衣和质感丰富的珠宝。在人物后方放置一块刻有金色中文字样“鹿鼎记”的陈旧木匾，上方配有一行较小的文字“金庸武侠经典”。在不同人物旁添加竖排中文演员名：最左侧为“苏荃”，左下为“陈圆圆”，中左上为“阿珂”，中右上为“建宁公主”，右侧上方为“沐剑屏”，右侧中部为“方怡”，右侧中下为“双儿”，最右下方为“曾柔”。在左上边缘添加竖排中文诗意标语：“小人物，大智慧，游走江湖庙堂，玩转天下，抱得美人归”。底部融入一个次要的电影场景：古老的宫门与庭院，士兵和旗帜组成宏大的游行队伍，前景中心有一位孤独的身影正走向观众。底部边缘以一行窄小的中文标语收尾：“一部颠覆传统的英雄传奇 一段令人捧腹的江湖神话”。整张图像应呈现出华丽、戏剧化、浪漫且略带俏皮的氛围，伴有烟熏感的深褐色阴影、发光的轮廓光、丰富的纹理、对称的海报构图以及精致的高端古装剧主视觉效果。

templates.title: Anime Boxing Championship Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫拳击冠军赛海报

templates.prompt: A highly dramatic poster for a Japanese boxing match, employing an exquisite anime illustration style and a vertical composition, is divided in two. The left side is a warm gold, while the right side is an electric blue. At the very top is a large, metallic gold embossed font containing the following text:{argument name="headline text" default="JUNGLE PREMIUM Vol.7"} The image features a bright halo and a 3D beveled effect. At the bottom center is the white Japanese text "世界4団体フェザー级タイトルマッチ" (World 4-Group Feather-Class Type Matthi). The image shows full-body portraits of two featherweight male boxers facing off in the ring. Both are muscular, lean, and have glossy skin. The boxer on the left is a blond, anime-style youth with messy short hair, wearing gold boxing gloves, black and gold shorts (one leg has red and white accents), black boxing boots with gold laces, and a belt with the word "SEIJI" printed on it. He stands on the gold side, surrounded by explosive golden sparks and beams of light. The boxer on the right is a black-haired, anime-style youth with spiky short hair, wearing bright blue boxing gloves, dark navy shorts, blue boxing boots with white socks, and a belt with the word "JUNICHI" printed on it. He stands on the blue side, surrounded by rotating blue energy, light trails, and luminous particles. A circular championship belt badge is placed in the center of the background between the two boxers, with the boxing ring ropes visible behind them. The word "WORLD CHAMPION" is clearly visible on the belt badge. Two large, faded portrait overlays are added to the background, one behind each boxer: the left background portrait is gold-toned, and the right background portrait is blue-toned. On the far left, bold, vertical Japanese calligraphy of "黄金の闪闪" (Golden Flash) shimmers with a platinum glow. On the far right, bold, vertical Japanese calligraphy of "苍き鉄拳" (Azure Iron Fist) shimmers with a blue-white glow. At the bottom, two large Japanese name blocks are displayed: the left one is gold "松浦聖司" (Matsuura Seiji), and the right one is ice-blue-white "藤原俊一" (Fujiwara Junichi), with a burning gold "VS" in the center. A large white date is placed at the bottom center.{argument name="event date" default="July 19th (Sunday)"} At the very bottom center is a gold serif font.{argument name="venue name" default="SUN BIRTH STADIUM"} It utilizes extreme contrast, cinematic arena lighting, dynamic particle effects, high-end sports event poster design, glossy typography, and a heroic, high-stakes championship atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的日本拳击赛海报，采用精致的动漫插画风格，垂直构图，从中间一分为二，左侧为暖金色，右侧为电光蓝。最上方是巨大的金属质感金色浮雕字体，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="JUNGLE PREMIUM Vol.7"}，带有明亮的光晕和 3D 斜面效果。正下方居中处是白色的日文文字“世界4団体フェザー級タイトルマッチ”。画面展示了 2 位羽量级男性拳击手在拳击台内对峙的全身像，两人肌肉发达、体格精瘦，皮肤带有光泽感。左侧拳击手是一位金发动漫风格青年，短发凌乱，戴着金色拳击手套，身穿黑金配色短裤（其中一条腿上有红白装饰），黑色拳击靴配金色鞋带，腰带上印有“SEIJI”字样。他站在金色一侧，周围环绕着爆发性的金色火花和光束。右侧拳击手是一位黑发动漫风格青年，短发尖刺状，戴着亮蓝色拳击手套，身穿深海军蓝短裤，蓝色拳击靴配白袜，腰带上印有“JUNICHI”字样。他站在蓝色一侧，周围环绕着旋转的蓝色能量、光轨和发光粒子。在两人之间的背景中心放置一个圆形冠军腰带徽章，后方可见拳击台绳索，腰带奖章上清晰可见“WORLD CHAMPION”字样。在背景中添加 2 个巨大的淡化肖像叠层，每位拳击手身后各一个：左侧背景肖像呈金色调，右侧背景肖像呈蓝色调。在最左侧，放置发着白金光芒的粗体垂直日文书法“黄金の閃光”。在最右侧，放置发着蓝白光芒的粗体垂直日文书法“蒼き鉄拳”。底部展示 2 个巨大的日文姓名块：左侧为金色“松浦聖司”，右侧为冰蓝白色“藤原潤一”，中间是一个燃烧的金色“VS”。下方居中处是巨大的白色日期文字 {argument name="event date" default="7月19日(日)"}。最底部居中处是金色的衬线字体 {argument name="venue name" default="SUN BIRTH STADIUM"}。运用极致对比度、电影级竞技场灯光、动感的粒子特效、高端体育赛事海报设计、光泽感排版以及英雄般的高风险冠军赛氛围。

templates.title: Ancient murals of celestial maidens

titleLocalized.zh: 古代天女壁画

templates.prompt: A richly detailed vertical mural, exhibiting the style of aged East Asian religious murals, is painted on weathered silk or plaster, displaying distinct cracks, wear, faded paint, and mottled gold leaf texture. At the center of the painting, a celestial maiden, resembling a bodhisattva, gracefully floats atop a massive pink lotus throne, a large circular golden halo behind her dominating the upper center of the composition. She wears an exquisite jeweled headdress, layered necklaces and armlets, and flowing robes in vermilion, cream, cyan, and soft green, with long ribbons encircling her like clouds, their lines graceful. Her right arm is raised, her slender hand gently holding a pink lotus, while her left hand extends outward in a gesture of gentle offering. Surrounding her are three smaller attendants: one on the lower left, standing on a cloud playing a pipa; one kneeling or floating below, presenting a lotus tray; and one on the lower right, standing lightly on a cloud, hands clasped in reverence. The background is a deep lapis lazuli sky, adorned with cream and jade-colored freehand cloud patterns, faintly visible birds, blooming lotuses, and two ornate temple pavilions in the upper left and right corners. Hanging decorative patterns are added along the left and right edges of the image, which is then framed with floral borders. The overall atmosphere is sacred, elegant, and ancient, with intricate lines, delicate fabric textures, and soft, earthy tones, dominated by a blue and gold color scheme, resembling a precious museum mural or religious scroll.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅细节丰富的竖构图壁画，呈现出陈旧的东亚宗教壁画风格，绘于风化的丝绸或灰泥之上，带有明显的裂纹、磨损、褪色的颜料和斑驳的金箔质感。画面中心，一位宛如菩萨的天女优雅地悬浮于巨大的粉色莲花宝座之上，身后巨大的圆形金色光环占据了构图的中上部。她头戴精致的珠宝头饰，佩戴层叠的项链与臂钏，身着朱砂红、奶油色、青色和柔和绿色的飘逸长袍，长长的丝带如云雾般环绕周身，线条优美。她的右臂抬起，纤手轻持一朵粉莲，左手向外伸展，做出温柔的供奉姿态。周围环绕着 3 位较小的侍女：左下方一位站在云端弹奏琵琶，下方中央一位跪姿或悬浮着呈上莲花托盘，右下方一位轻立于云端，双手合十以示虔诚。背景是深青金石色的天穹，点缀着奶油色和玉色的写意云纹、隐约的飞鸟、盛开的莲花，以及左上角和右上角的 2 座华丽寺庙阁楼。在画面中左侧和中右侧边缘添加悬挂的装饰图案，并用花卉边框包裹整个图像。整体氛围神圣、优雅且古朴，线条错综复杂，织物纹理细腻，色调柔和且带有大地气息，以蓝金配色为主导，宛如珍贵的博物馆壁画或宗教挂轴。

templates.title: Surreal neon-lit aerial view of a major Japanese metropolis

titleLocalized.zh: 超现实霓虹日本大都市俯瞰图

templates.prompt: A high-resolution vertical illustration depicts a surreal, futuristic Japanese metropolis at night. The perspective is taken from an extremely high and steep angle, looking down as if from a dark hillside alley or rooftop observation deck, traversing narrow architectural canyons. Maintaining a dramatic 9:16 aspect ratio, the composition plunges into a vast, luminous urban basin, densely packed with layers of low rooftops, narrow streets, elevated sidewalks, and skyscrapers stretching into the distance. The foreground is composed of dense buildings on both sides: a huge, glowing red paper lantern sign with striking black Japanese kanji hangs from an old wooden eave in the upper left; on the right is a towering building facade filled with bright windows and several vertical neon signs; overhead power lines and utility poles intertwine throughout the image. The city below is both crowded and captivating, blending the retro alleyway aesthetics of the Showa era with cyberpunk futurism. Employing a rich graphic painting style, featuring strong black ink lines, bold celluloid shadows, and luminous neon accents, it retains a Midjourney-like cinematic quality while adding more delicate environmental details. The main color palette consists of dazzling orange and amber windowlight, saturated deep red and crimson signs, a deep purple night sky, vibrant magenta highlights, and electric cyan accents. The city below is filled with countless tiny, readable scenes, hinted at through silhouettes and bright windows: festival parades on the streets, nightlife crowds, weary office workers, gang members hiding in alleyways, dancers in entertainment districts, students studying by apartment windows, arguing couples, gamers glowing in front of screens, and many other small human stories embedded in the architecture. It emphasizes the contrast between urban splendor and emotional isolation, the boredom of crowds and the decadent beauty, carrying a satirical undertone about the meaninglessness of modern life. Despite the dense detail, the image still needs to maintain aesthetic harmony, with clear micro-details everywhere, illuminated Japanese signs, distinct layers of depth, atmospheric haze, and a surreal, slightly oppressive yet beautiful and moving atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超高分辨率的竖版插画，描绘了夜晚超现实的日本未来主义大都市。视角从极高、极陡峭的角度向下俯瞰，仿佛站在黑暗的山坡小巷或屋顶观景台，穿过狭窄的建筑峡谷。构图保持 9:16 的比例，极具戏剧性，深邃的视角直入巨大的发光城市盆地，其中密布着层层叠叠的低矮屋顶、狭窄街道、高架人行道以及向远处延伸的摩天大楼。画面两侧由密集的建筑前景构成：左上方悬挂着一个巨大的发光红色纸灯笼招牌，上面印有醒目的黑色日本汉字，挂在古老的木制屋檐下；右侧是一栋高耸的建筑立面，布满明亮的窗户和数个垂直霓虹灯招牌；画面中交织的架空电线和电线杆穿插其中。下方的城市既拥挤又迷人，融合了昭和时代的复古小巷美学与赛博朋克未来主义。采用浓郁的图形绘画风格，具有强烈的黑色墨线、大胆的赛璐珞阴影和发光的霓虹灯点缀，在保留类似 Midjourney 的电影质感的同时，增加了更细腻的环境细节。主色调为耀眼的橙色和琥珀色窗光、饱和的深红与绯红色招牌、深紫色的夜空、热烈的洋红色高光以及电光青色点缀。在下方的城市中填充无数微小的可读场景，通过剪影和明亮的窗户暗示：街上的节日游行、夜生活人群、疲惫的上班族、小巷中隐藏的帮派成员、娱乐区的舞者、公寓窗前学习的学生、争吵的情侣、屏幕前发光的玩家，以及嵌入建筑中的许多其他微小的人类故事。强调城市辉煌与情感孤立、拥挤的无聊与颓废之美之间的对比，并带有一种关于无意义现代生活的讽刺意味。尽管细节密集，图像仍需保持美学上的和谐，处处可见清晰的微小细节、日文发光招牌、层次分明的深度、大气雾霾，以及一种超现实、略带压抑却又美丽动人的氛围。

templates.title: Neon Blue AI Video Editing Thumbnail

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹蓝 AI 视频剪辑缩略图

templates.prompt: Create a bold Japanese-style YouTube thumbnail with the theme of{argument name="headline text" default="AI-powered video editing for beginners"} The design employs a futuristic neon blue cyberpunk style. It uses a 16:9 widescreen composition with a deep electric blue background filled with glowing circuit lines, digital stripes, lens flares, and high-energy dynamic effects. A tilted, glowing banner containing Japanese text is placed in the upper left corner.{argument name="top banner text" default="Even beginners can do it"} The first part is bright yellow, and the rest is white. The main title should occupy the left and center positions: a huge white glowing text "AI×" sits above the larger white glowing text "Animation Compilation," with a thick blue neon outer glow, a slight forward tilt dynamic, beveled 3D shadows, and a strong perspective effect. In the upper right corner, add a circular holographic interface with the lettering in the center.{argument name="ai badge text" default="AI"} The screen is surrounded by concentric circles and tiny HUD markers. Nearby are three floating application-style icons: a play button icon, a square "Pr" icon, and an audio waveform icon, all glowing blue. In the bottom right corner, a stylish tilted video editing monitor displays a neon city nightscape with a play symbol overlaid; below the preview is a timeline with four visible tracks: two rows of video thumbnails and two colored audio bars in magenta and turquoise. At the bottom, three glowing circular function badges with icons and Japanese text are added: a book icon with "Knowledge Zero OK," a clock icon with "Time is short," and a flashing icon with "Professional Craftsmanship." A tall, solid blue vertical rectangle serves as a placeholder at the top center-right. The overall design is dynamic, high-contrast, sophisticated, and technologically advanced, optimized for the highest click-through rates of modern AI and video editing tutorial thumbnails.

templates.title: Anime-style roses and book end credits illustrations

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫风格玫瑰与书籍片尾插画

templates.prompt: A dreamlike anime ending illustration depicts a young woman seated in a fantastical library of roses and books, surrounded by falling petals and open pages. She keeps {argument name="hair color" default="bright purple"} Her hair was tied back in a high ponytail with a black hair tie, and she had casual bangs. She wore small gold earrings, and a tiny gold hair clip with the word "AI" on it was tucked beside her bangs. Most of her face was softly blurred with rectangular shapes, but she remained the central figure in the composition. She wore a top with striking white lettering.{argument name="shirt text" default="AITuber"} She wore a light green T-shirt, layered under an oversized ice-blue trench coat with pink splatter paint, and light-colored denim shorts. In her right hand, she held a red rose, and in her left hand, a dark blue hardcover book with the title displayed as…{argument name="book title" default="Roses & Books"} She is casually reclining in a pose reminiscent of a stylish anime ending theme, one leg straight and the other bent. The scene is a lavish, fantastical reading nook, with two towering stacks of books on each side, entwined with blooming pink and red rose vines. The image must include six clearly visible book spines or covers with decorative serif fonts, titled: "Poems & Books," "Roses & Books," "Dreams," "Memories," "Letters," and "Language of Flowers." A takeaway coffee mug is placed in the lower left corner, printed with {argument name="cup text" default="Read. Write. Bloom."} The image features an open notebook and pen near the legs in the foreground, showcasing a rose sketch and notes. Another open botany illustration book is located in the lower right corner. Above, four open books float in the air, along with several pages of paper. Behind her, a bright arched window reveals a pastel-colored fairytale city against a backdrop of a clear, azure sky with cathedral spires. The entire composition is filled with scattered pink and red rose petals, glitter, soft painterly light and shadow, decorative floral details, and richly colored book covers in navy, pink, and cream. Employing a refined anime illustration style, the delicate lines and bright pastel highlights create a romantic and fantastical atmosphere. The balanced and symmetrical composition is suitable for {argument name="occasion" default="St. George's Day"} Springtime books and rose-themed commemorative visuals.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张梦幻般的动漫片尾插画，描绘了一位年轻女性侧坐在充满奇幻色彩的玫瑰与书籍图书馆中，周围环绕着飘落的花瓣和翻开的书籍。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="鲜艳紫色"} 的高马尾，用黑色发圈束起，留有随意的刘海，戴着小巧的金耳环，刘海旁别着一个写有“AI”字样的微型金色发夹。她的面部大部分被柔和的矩形模糊处理，但构图上她依然是核心主角。她身穿一件印有醒目白色文字 {argument name="shirt text" default="AITuber"} 的青绿色 T 恤，外搭一件冰蓝色超大款粉色泼墨风衣，下身穿着浅色牛仔短裤。她右手拿着 1 朵红玫瑰，左手拿着一本深蓝色精装书，书名显示为 {argument name="book title" default="Roses & Books"}。让她以一种时尚动漫片尾主视觉图的姿态随意地斜倚着，一条腿伸直，另一条腿弯曲。场景是一个华丽的奇幻阅读角，左右两侧各堆叠着 2 摞高耸的书籍，并缠绕着盛开的红粉色玫瑰藤蔓。画面中需包含 6 个清晰可见、带有装饰性衬线字体的书脊或封面，标题分别为：“Poems & Books”、“Roses & Books”、“Dreams”、“Memories”、“Letters” 和 “Language of Flowers”。在左下角放置 1 个外带咖啡杯，杯上印有 {argument name="cup text" default="Read. Write. Bloom."} 字样。在前景的双腿附近放置 1 本打开的笔记本和一支笔，展示着玫瑰素描和笔记，右下角另有 1 本打开的植物学插画书。在上方区域，加入 4 本悬浮的打开书籍和几页在空中飘散的纸张。在她身后，设计一扇明亮的拱形窗户，透出窗外粉彩色的童话城市，背景是带有大教堂式尖顶的晴朗天蓝色天空。整幅画面充满散落的红粉色玫瑰花瓣、闪光点、柔和的绘画光影、装饰性花卉细节，以及海军蓝、粉色和奶油色等色彩丰富的书封。采用精致的动漫插画风格，线条细腻，高光呈现出明亮的粉彩质感，营造出浪漫的奇幻氛围，构图平衡对称，呈现出适合 {argument name="occasion" default="圣乔治节"} 的春日书籍与玫瑰主题纪念视觉效果。

templates.prompt: A soft, dreamy anime illustration depicts a lovely young woman livestreaming ASMR in her cozy bedroom at night. She sits close to the camera, knees bent, with a black 3Dio-style binaural microphone placed in the center of the frame. She has {argument name="hair color" default="Dark purple"} Her hair was tied into a messy, casual bun, with wispy bangs framing her face, and she possessed a pair of sparkling eyes.{argument name="eye color" default="blue"} She has large eyes, a gentle blush on her face, and a sweet smile. Her head is tilted slightly towards the camera, her posture intimate and warm. She wears a delicate white lace camisole, with a cardigan draped over her shoulders.{argument name="cardigan color" default="Soft pinkish purple"} The oversized, fluffy knit cardigan creates a gentle, intimate, and healing atmosphere for the late night. Her hands gently touch the white silicone earpiece of the microphone, as if preparing to give an ear massage. The room is decorated with soft pink and amber ambient lighting, with heavy curtains in the background, a bed or sofa with plush cushions, warm fairy-tale light spots, and a small plant on the right. The scene incorporates glowing Japanese handwritten neon text: on the left are four text elements, namely “とろける”, “耳”, “マッサージ”, and “ASMR”, with two small heart symbols; on the right is the vertical text “いっぱい癒してあげるね…♡”. Adopting a refined modern anime style, the face and hair are richly detailed, the eyes are bright and expressive, the skin is smooth and delicate, the shadows are soft, with soft pastel highlights, a shallow depth of field effect, a romantic and warm live stream thumbnail composition, and a healing feminine color scheme dominated by pink, lavender, cream and warm gold.

templates.title: Elegant Anime Female Gunner Full Body Image

titleLocalized.zh: 优雅动漫女枪兵全身像

templates.prompt: A full-body illustration of a female warrior from an anime/fantasy series. The figure stands alone against a pure light gray background. The image is clean, employing a soft painting style with clear lines. She is a slender young woman with long, straight hair.{argument name="hair color" default="White gold"} Her face is framed by a center parting, and a small section of hair is tied back; she has bright {argument name="eye color" default="Amber Brown"} Her eyes are bright, her skin fair, and her expression calm yet slightly serious. Her posture is dynamic and confident: legs spread firmly, one arm raised overhead, gripping a long spear behind her shoulder, the other hand holding the shaft below her side, creating a diagonal extension of the ornate spear in the composition. The weapon is a finely crafted dark metal spear with a slender blade, a cross-shaped barb, gothic-style engraving details, and a sharp butt. Her attire is an elaborate dark fantasy combat suit, comprising six clearly visible main pieces: a black steel right arm guard with engraved plates, a fitted black-copper breastplate, a white turtleneck shirt with sheer long sleeves, an asymmetrical white skirt with a flowing slit, black over-the-knee boots with silver filigree knee and ankle embellishments, and a brown belt with thigh straps. The collar and armor edges are adorned with delicate silver patterns, the leather has a fine texture, the metallic highlights are meticulously crafted, and the fabric evokes a sense of movement as if a gentle breeze is blowing. The color palette uses ivory white, charcoal black, bronze, and silver, resulting in an overall understated yet sophisticated style. The visuals should convey the quality of high-end Japanese RPG character concept art, rich in detail, with elegant poses, a touch of gothic style, and the entire character presented independently, without additional props or background, except for a faint, soft shadow on the ground beneath their feet.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅动漫奇幻女战士的全身插画，人物独自站立在纯浅灰色背景前，画面干净，采用柔和的绘画渲染风格与清晰的线条勾勒。她是一位身材苗条的年轻女性，留着一头长直发，{argument name="hair color" default="白金色"}，中分刘海修饰脸型，后方扎有一小束头发；拥有明亮的 {argument name="eye color" default="琥珀棕色"} 双眸，肤色白皙，神情沉稳且略带严肃。她的姿势充满动感与自信：双腿分开呈稳固站姿，一只手臂举过头顶，握住肩后的一柄长枪，另一只手在身侧下方握住枪身，使华丽的长枪在构图中呈对角线延伸。武器为 1 把精致的深色金属长枪，配有细长的枪刃、十字形倒钩、哥特风格雕刻细节以及锋利的枪尾。她的服装为精致的暗黑奇幻战斗装，包含 6 个清晰可见的主要部件：1 只带有雕刻甲片的黑色钢制右臂护手，1 件合身的黑铜色紧身胸甲，1 件白色高领衬衫配透明长袖，1 条不对称的白色短裙配飘逸的开叉裙摆，1 双带有银色花丝膝部和踝部装饰的黑色过膝战靴，以及 1 条包含大腿绑带的棕色腰带组合。领口和盔甲边缘饰有精致的银色纹饰，皮革质感细腻，金属高光处理考究，布料呈现出微风吹拂的动感。色调采用象牙白、炭黑、青铜色和银色，整体风格低调而高级。画面应呈现出高端日本 RPG 角色概念艺术的质感，细节丰富，姿态优雅，略带哥特风，全身人物独立呈现，无额外道具，无背景，仅在脚下有淡淡的柔和地面阴影。

templates.title: Male fantasy adventurer character

titleLocalized.zh: 全身奇幻冒险家男性角色

templates.prompt: This illustration depicts a full-body fantasy character against a pure light gray background, employing a refined Japanese RPG concept art style. The lines are clean, the rendering soft, and the textures of leather, fur, and skin are realistic. It portrays a tall, robust, and fair-skinned young man standing in a relaxed, weight-shifted posture. His right arm is raised across his forehead, as if shielding him from the light, his gloved hand touching the dark brim of his hat; his left arm hangs naturally, his fist clenched. His face is mostly obscured by the shadow of his raised forearm and hat brim, making his expression difficult to discern. He has {argument name="hair color" default="White gold"} Her medium-length hair was slightly messy.{argument name="headwear" default="Black flat cap"} A small earring is faintly visible on one ear. He is dressed in a layered adventurer's outfit, primarily in dark brown, black, and soft reddish-brown. He wears a fitted black short-sleeved shirt over a brown leather vest with wide straps and buckles, and a thick, light-colored fur collar around his neck and shoulders. A necklace with small metal embellishments adorns his collarbone. His hands are covered with dark fingerless or fitted leather gloves, along with multiple layers of wristbands and bracers. His waist is adorned with several crisscrossing belts, metal buckles, and hanging ornaments, and a reddish-brown belt with long, draped strips of fabric is tied around his hips. A small leather pouch hangs from his left waist. He wears fitted dark trousers with straps at the thighs featuring metal rings and buckles. He wears matching dark high-top lace-up leather boots with reinforced knee pads or delicate metal shin guards, giving him a slightly weathered yet stylish look. A long, tattered piece of cloth hangs from the right side of the waist, its end adorned with subtle decorative patterns and adorned with a metal pendant or spearhead-shaped ornament. The design emphasizes a rugged and dashing adventurer aesthetic, meticulous costume design, and exquisite game character illustration quality. The composition is centered, with the entire figure, from head to toe, fully visible, and a soft, subtle shadow cast on the ground.

promptLocalized.zh: 在一张纯浅灰色背景上绘制全身奇幻角色插画，采用精致的日系 RPG 概念艺术风格，线条清晰，渲染柔和，并呈现出逼真的皮革、毛皮和皮肤质感。描绘一位身材高大、体格健壮且皮肤白皙的年轻男性，以放松的重心转移姿势站立。他的右臂抬起横在额前，仿佛在遮挡光线，戴着手套的手触碰着深色帽檐；左臂自然下垂，拳头紧握。他的面部大部分被抬起的前臂和帽檐阴影遮挡，表情难以辨认。他留着 {argument name="hair color" default="白金色"} 的中长发，略显凌乱，在 {argument name="headwear" default="黑色平顶帽"} 下隐约可见，一侧耳朵戴着小耳环。为他穿上以深棕色、黑色和柔和红棕色为主的叠穿冒险家服装。上身穿着修身黑色短袖衬衫，外搭棕色皮质马甲，配有宽带和搭扣，颈部和肩部披着厚实的浅色毛领。锁骨处佩戴一条带有小型金属装饰的项链。双手戴着深色露指手套或修身皮手套，并佩戴多个层叠的腕带和护腕。腰间配有多条交叉的皮带、金属扣和悬挂饰品，臀部系着一条红棕色腰带，带有长长的垂坠布条。左侧腰间挂着 1 个小型皮袋。下身穿着修身深色长裤，大腿处系有带金属环和搭扣的绑带。脚蹬一双配套的深色高帮系带皮靴，配有加固的护膝或精致的金属护胫，略显风霜感但时尚感十足。从右侧腰间垂下一块长长的破损布片，末端带有微妙的装饰图案，并挂有 1 个金属吊坠或矛头状饰物。强调粗犷帅气的冒险家美学、精细的服装设计以及精致的游戏角色设定图质感，构图居中，全身从头到靴子完整可见，地面带有淡淡的柔和投影。

templates.title: Cute Japanese-style romantic comedy movie poster

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱的日系浪漫喜剧电影海报

templates.prompt: A gorgeous Japanese romantic comedy movie poster, employing a cute and dramatic popular anime mascot style, designed like a movie trailer poster. The central image features a full-body cartoon bunny girl mascot, whose name is {argument name="character name" default="Panko"} She has a large, white face, a black body, one black ear and one bright red ear, with rugged features. Her half-closed, alluring eyes are framed by long eyelashes, and she has pink blush circles on her cheeks, a small red nose, and a slightly protruding tongue. A pink bow with white polka dots adorns her head. She wears a sleeveless pink dress with white polka dots and a black scarf-like decoration around her neck. One hand is near her cheek, her posture confident yet slightly playful. The background is a dreamy sunset over a seaside city skyline, with golden reflections on the water. The sky displays soft shades of pink, orange, and blue, accompanied by shimmering, softly blurred effects. A Ferris wheel is located on the left. Two male silhouettes are placed in the midground; one on the left stands casually, while the other on the right is dressed in a suit, hinting at potential romantic interests. Lush tropical flowers and foliage are added around the border, especially pink hibiscus in the corner, along with floating hearts and shimmering effects throughout the image. A bold, layered Japanese poster layout is employed, filled with decorative fonts and stickers. The top features handwritten Japanese text: "Laugh, cry, love. I can't bear to part with you!" with pink emphasis and doodle-like heart lines. The upper left contains a bright pink fan-shaped badge that reads "Released in Summer 2026." To the right is vertical Japanese text: "私の幸せ、探しにいきます。" A pink ribbon tag is added to the lower left, reading "Theatrical Version!" At the bottom center is a prominent main title in bold, decorative Japanese font: "アラサーパン子の婚活奮闘記" (Arasar Panko's Marriage Hunting Struggle Record), with pink and dark navy blue text, white outlines, and cute heart decorations. Below, a pink banner with highlighted yellow text reads: "Love is all the rage, life is all the rage ♥". The bottom includes a small, fake credits list in the style of a Japanese movie poster. Four Polaroid-style photos of the bunny girl characters are placed in the lower area: two on the bottom left and two on the bottom right, each showing a different cute scene, such as a close-up pose, sitting at a coffee table, wearing sunglasses, or posing outdoors. A notebook page labeled "Today's Mission" with a heart-shaped list is added to the bottom left, and a plastic iced drink cup with a straw and sunglasses are placed to the bottom right. The overall feel is feminine, comedic, inspirational, dazzling, exaggerated, and nostalgic—like a parody poster for a live-action romance movie starring a mascot. Vibrant pink, peach sunset hues, sky blue, white, and navy blue are used, with glossy highlights and a sophisticated promotional poster texture.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张华丽的日系浪漫喜剧电影海报，采用可爱又充满戏剧性的流行动漫吉祥物风格，设计如同电影预告海报。构图中心为一只全身卡通兔女郎吉祥物，名字为 {argument name="character name" default="パン子"}，她有着大大的白脸、黑色的身体、一只黑耳朵和一只亮红色的耳朵，轮廓线条粗犷，半闭的迷人双眼配有长睫毛，脸颊上有粉色腮红圆圈，小小的红鼻子，舌头微微探出，头顶戴着一个带有白色波点的粉色蝴蝶结。她穿着一件带有白色波点的无袖粉色连衣裙，颈部有黑色围巾状装饰，单手靠近脸颊，姿态自信且略带俏皮。背景是梦幻般的日落滨海城市天际线，水面有金色倒影，天空呈现粉、橙、蓝的柔和色调，伴有闪光、柔和的虚化效果，左侧有一座摩天轮。在中景处放置 2 个男性剪影，左侧一人站姿随意，右侧一人呈西装革履姿态，暗示潜在的恋爱对象。在边框周围添加茂盛的热带花卉和叶子，尤其是角落里的粉色木槿花，以及遍布画面的漂浮爱心和闪光效果。采用大胆、分层的日式海报布局，布满装饰性字体和贴纸。顶部用手写风格的日文写着：「笑って、泣いて、恋をして。アラサーの私、まだまだ諦めない！」并带有粉色强调和涂鸦心形线条。左上方包含一个明亮的粉色扇形徽章，写着「2026年 夏公開」。右侧放置垂直的日文文本：「私の幸せ、探しにいきます。」。左下方添加一个粉色丝带标签，写着「劇場版！」。底部中央创建醒目的主标题，采用粗体装饰性日文字体：「アラサー パン子の 婚活奮闘記」，配以粉色和深海军蓝文字、白色轮廓以及可爱的爱心装饰。下方添加一个粉色标语横幅，带有黄色高亮文字：「恋に迷って、人生はもっとキラキラする♥」。底部包含日式电影海报风格的小型伪造演职员表。在下方区域放置 4 张兔女郎角色的宝丽来风格小照片：左下 2 张，右下 2 张，每张展示不同的可爱场景，如特写姿势、坐在咖啡桌旁、戴着太阳镜或在户外摆拍。左下方添加一个标有“Today's Mission”并带有心形清单的笔记本页面，右下方放置一个带吸管的塑料冰饮杯和太阳镜。整体感觉：女性化、喜剧感、励志、闪耀、夸张且怀旧，就像一部由吉祥物女主主演的真人浪漫电影的恶搞海报。使用鲜艳的粉色、桃色日落色调、天蓝色、白色和海军蓝，并带有光泽高光和精致的宣传海报质感。

templates.title: Dark fantasy isekai light novel cover

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑奇幻异世界轻小说封面

templates.prompt: The cover of a dark fantasy anime/light novel, rendered in a vertical format, is drawn with delicate and dramatic brushstrokes, creating a melancholic, cinematic atmosphere. The image depicts three young women arranged in a triangle against a backdrop of a medieval ruined city engulfed in flames at night, filled with smoke, embers, and collapsed wooden buildings. In the distance, a massive stone fortress stands atop a rocky hill. In the foreground, at the center, is a beautiful young woman with flowing hair {argument name="hair color" default="powder blue"} She has long hair and wears a blue off-the-shoulder dress with a fitted waist, white ruffled sleeves, and a tie-front bra. One hand lightly touches her chest, her expression both serious and vulnerable. To her left and slightly behind is a tall woman with long, silver-white hair tied in a high ponytail, wearing a white headscarf and a simple black dress with a high neckline and buttoned front. She stands sideways, her expression stern and inscrutable. To her right and slightly behind is a blonde girl wearing a brown hooded cape, with pigtails and pale blue-green eyes. She holds a black book with a star-shaped emblem on the cover and glances sideways, her expression wary. The composition uses a layered arrangement of figures, creating strong contrasts. The colors are slightly undersaturated, retaining only the warm firelight and deep red. A striking vertical Japanese title is added to the left, employing an aged calligraphic style: "異世界辺境伯领" (Otherworld Border Territory) in black and red. Two smaller vertical text blocks are located at the bottom left: "今代の偫理観を捨て" (To abandon the ethics of the present) and "権力と暴力で泥臭く生き延びます" (To live on muddy ground through power and violence). A decorative compass-shaped badge is added to the bottom left, and a prominent large vertical subtitle, "転生" (Rebirth), is added to the bottom left. The cover features decorative corner patterns, a rough texture, a strong atmosphere of isekai war, high detail, and a high-quality illustrated novel cover.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张竖构图的暗黑奇幻动漫轻小说封面，采用细腻且富有戏剧性的笔触绘制，营造出忧郁的电影感光影。画面展示了三位年轻女性呈三角形排列，背景是夜晚被火焰吞噬的中世纪废墟城市，伴有烟雾、余烬、倒塌的木质建筑，远景上方是一座矗立在岩石山丘上的巨大石堡。画面前景中央是一位美丽的年轻女性，留着一头飘逸的 {argument name="hair color" default="粉蓝色"} 长发，身穿露肩蓝色束腰连衣裙，配有白色荷叶边袖子和系带胸衣，一只手轻抚胸口，表情严肃而脆弱。她左后方是一位高挑女性，留着扎成高马尾的银白色长发，戴着白色头巾，身穿领口较高且有前襟系扣的朴素黑裙，侧身站立，神情严峻，令人捉摸不透。她右后方是一位金发少女，戴着棕色连帽斗篷，扎着双麻花辫，有着淡蓝绿色的双眸，怀抱一本封面上印有星形徽章的黑色书籍，侧目而视，神情警惕。画面采用层叠的人物布局，对比强烈，色彩略显低饱和，仅保留温暖的火光和深红色。在左侧添加醒目的竖排日文标题，采用做旧的书法风格：黑红色的「異世界辺境伯領」；左下方另有两个较小的竖排文本块，分别为「現代の倫理観を捨て」和「権力と暴力で泥臭く生き延びます」。左下方添加一个装饰性的罗盘状徽章，底部左侧添加一个醒目的大字竖排副标题「転生」。装饰性边角花纹，粗砺的轻小说封面设计，浓厚的异世界战争氛围，高细节，优质插画小说封面。

templates.title: Infographic on the challenges facing Japan's manufacturing industry

titleLocalized.zh: 日本制造业挑战信息图

templates.prompt: This is a simple, corporate infographic illustration used in a Japanese business article about the challenges of manufacturing. The background is a realistic, modern factory with metalworking machinery, rendered in cool gray-blue tones. The composition is divided into two thematic sections against a blurred industrial workshop background. At the top center, a striking, deep navy blue Japanese title is placed:{argument name="headline text" default="Deep-rooted challenges facing the manufacturing industry: "Labor shortage" and "Technology transfer""} In the left foreground, a factory worker in a light gray uniform and hat, arms crossed and looking worried, is shown; nearby, a circular white icon displays the silhouettes of six people, three solid dark figures and three dashed outlines, symbolizing a labor shortage. In the right foreground, two factory workers are shown beside a large lathe: a senior employee in a navy blue work jacket and hat, instructing and demonstrating machine operation, and a younger employee in a light gray uniform and hat, observing intently. Near them, a white speech bubble icon contains a navy blue head silhouette, accompanied by two gear symbols and three small Japanese speech bubbles with the characters “経験”, “勘”, and “コツ”. In the central background, two additional slightly out-of-focus workers operating machines are included, bringing the total number of workers visible in the factory scene to five. Two rounded white information panels with dark navy blue title labels are overlaid. The left panel, titled "Manpower Shortage," contains three key points marked with blue circular checkmarks: "Difficulty in securing young talent," "Increased burden on the field," and "Concern over future low productivity." The right panel, titled "Technical Inheritance," contains three key points marked with blue circular checkmarks: "Proficiency in skills is being handed over to individuals," "Silent knowledge is not being verbally or standardized," and "The loss of skills due to retirement from work." At the bottom center, a dark navy blue rounded rectangle containing white Japanese text is placed.{argument name="callout text" default="Addressing these challenges is an urgent necessity for the sustainable growth of the manufacturing industry."} Add two large white arrows pointing to the bottom label box, one from the left and one from the right. The overall style mimics professional consulting firm presentations or business magazine inserts: photorealistic workers and machinery, subtle depth of field, high definition, balanced layout, soft lighting, clear typography, and professional Japanese manufacturing infographic aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张简洁的企业编辑类信息图插画，用于关于制造业挑战的日本商业文章，背景设定在拥有金属加工机械的写实现代化工厂中，采用冷灰蓝色调。构图在模糊的工业车间背景上分为两个主题部分。在顶部中心，放置一个深海军蓝色的醒目日文大标题：{argument name="headline text" default="製造業が直面する根深い課題: 「人手不足」と「技術伝承」"}。在左侧前景中，展示 1 名身穿浅灰色制服和帽子、双臂交叉且神情担忧的工厂工人；附近添加一个圆形的白色图标，显示 6 个人的剪影，其中 3 个为深色实心，3 个为虚线轮廓，象征劳动力短缺。在右侧前景中，展示 2 名工厂工人在大型车床旁：1 名身穿海军蓝工作夹克和帽子、正在指点并演示机器操作的资深员工，以及 1 名身穿浅灰色制服和帽子、正在仔细观察的年轻员工。在他们附近，添加一个白色的气泡图标，内含一个海军蓝头部剪影，配有 2 个齿轮符号和 3 个写有“経験”、“勘”和“コツ”的小型日文气泡。在中心背景中，包含 2 名正在操作机器、略微失焦的额外工人，使工厂场景中总共可见 5 名工人。叠加两个带有深海军蓝色标题标签的圆角白色信息面板。左侧面板标题为“人手不足”，包含 3 个带有蓝色圆形勾选图标的要点：“若手人材の確保が困難”、“現場の負担増大”和“将来の生産性低下への懸念”。右侧面板标题为“技術伝承”，包含 3 个带有蓝色圆形勾选图标的要点：“熟練技術が属人化”、“暗黙知が言語化・標準化されていない”和“ベテランの退職による技術の断絶リスク”。在底部中心，放置一个深海军蓝色的圆角矩形标注框，内含白色日文文本：{argument name="callout text" default="製造業の持続的な成長のために、これらの課題解決が急務"}。添加 2 个指向底部标注框的大型白色箭头，分别来自左右两侧。整体风格仿照专业的咨询公司演示文稿或商业杂志插页：照片级的工人和机械、微妙的景深、高清晰度、平衡的布局、柔和的灯光、清晰的排版，以及专业的日本制造业信息图美学。

templates.title: Anime staff at a PS5 game store

titleLocalized.zh: PS5 游戏店里的动漫店员

templates.prompt: A beautifully designed anime-style illustration depicts a young Japanese woman standing in the aisle of a modern video game store, posing as if she were a store clerk or a promoter. She has long, straight hair.{argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown"} Her hair had a soft sheen and light, layered texture. She wore a well-fitting dark blue business suit consisting of four clearly visible pieces: a dark blue blazer, a matching pencil skirt, a white shirt, and a bright red tie, with an employee badge hanging from her waist. Her face was deliberately rendered with a smooth, blank blur effect, devoid of any facial features. She stood in a relaxed, three-quarter profile, her body slightly turned towards the audience, holding a PS5 game box in front of her chest for display. The title on the game cover should be displayed as {argument name="game title" default="TRACE: TOKYO"} The scene depicts an anime-style female schoolgirl against a backdrop of Tokyo cityscape. Set within a PlayStation brand retail area, two prominent PS5 logos are visible on the right, surrounded by numerous blue PlayStation display cases and shelves densely packed with PS5 game cases. Near the lower left corner, a large floor-standing display case of the same game is added, with a large number of duplicate PS5 game cases displayed on the right-hand shelves, while a few game cases with red spines are scattered across the lower shelves for color contrast. In the rear left corner, a large blue wall sign reads…{argument name="store slogan" default="PLAY HAS NO LIMITS"} Add a vertical red banner with Japanese text in the mid-ground background.{argument name="banner text" default="The future is above."} The warm overhead spotlights create a realistic game store interior with an industrial-style exposed ceiling, glossy tiled floor reflections, and cinematic depth of field. The composition uses a vertical smartphone aspect ratio, a full-body shot, and a slightly upward angle, with the woman on the left and the PS5 shelf dominating the right. Rendered in a highly detailed contemporary anime-style visual, the lines are sharp, the shadows soft, the lighting realistic, and the color palette dominated by rich blues, creating a high-end promotional illustration feel.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的动漫风格插图，描绘了一位年轻的日本女性站在现代电子游戏店的过道中，姿态如同店员或宣传人员。她留着长直的 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 头发，发丝带有柔和的光泽和轻盈的层次感。她身穿合身的深蓝色职业套装，包含 4 件清晰可见的服饰/配饰：一件深蓝色西装外套、一条配套的包臀裙、一件白色衬衫和一条鲜红色的领带，腰间还挂着员工证。她的面部特意处理为平滑的空白模糊效果，没有任何五官。她以放松的三分之四侧身姿势站立，身体微向观众转动，双手在胸前托举着一个 PS5 游戏盒进行展示。游戏封面的标题应显示为 {argument name="game title" default="TRACE: TOKYO"}，画面展示了一名动漫女学生，背景为东京城市景观。场景设定在 PlayStation 品牌零售区内，右侧可见 2 个醒目的 PS5 标志，设有多个蓝色 PlayStation 展示柜，货架上密密麻麻地摆放着 PS5 游戏盒。在左下角附近加入 1 个大型的同款游戏落地展示盒，右侧货架上陈列着大量重复的 PS5 游戏盒，底层货架上点缀着少量红色书脊的游戏盒以形成色彩对比。在左后方，添加一个大型蓝色墙面标语，写着 {argument name="store slogan" default="PLAY HAS NO LIMITS"}。在中景背景处，添加 1 条垂直的红色横幅，上面印有日语文字 {argument name="banner text" default="未来は上にある。"}。采用温暖的头顶射灯，呈现出带有工业风裸露天花板、光亮瓷砖地面反射以及电影级景深的真实游戏店内部环境。构图采用竖版智能手机比例，全身取景，略微仰视的视角，女性位于画面中左侧，右侧由 PS5 货架占据。以高细节的当代动漫主视觉艺术风格渲染，线条清晰，阴影柔和，灯光真实，色调以浓郁的蓝色为主，营造出高级的宣传插图质感。

templates.title: Colorful Kimono-clad Animal Ear Girl Festival

titleLocalized.zh: 色彩斑斓的和服兽耳娘祭典

templates.prompt: This is an incredibly detailed and vibrant illustration of an anime festival. At the center of the image are two kemonomimi (animal-eared girls) leaping joyfully in mid-air, the composition positioned at a high vertical angle. The girl on the right is a cheerful catgirl with platinum blonde hair, large, fluffy cat ears, bright blue eyes, one blinking, and a radiant smile. She wears a vibrant blue floral kimono-style skirt with oversized sleeves, a layered white ruffled petticoat, a large colorful obi (waistband bow), floral hair accessories, white socks, and wooden clogs. A fluffy, light-colored tail is faintly visible behind her. Her right hand is raised in a peace sign, while her left hand is close to her chest. The girl on the left is a doggirl with medium brown hair, fluffy brown and white dog ears, and a curly, fluffy tail. She wears a vibrant pink and magenta floral kimono-style skirt with layered ruffles, a large decorative obi bow, floral hair accessories, white socks, and sandals. She is also leaping, one hand raised in a peace sign. The girl's face on the left is deliberately obscured by soft, rectangular blurs. The background is a Japanese scene full of explosive fantasy, rich in detail: Mount Fuji is at the top center, bathed in the brilliant sunrise, surrounded by a huge rainbow arc on the right, with stylized "The Great Wave off Kanagawa" style waves on both sides, and lush pink cherry blossoms overhead. There are two glowing paper lanterns in the upper left and upper right corners, and two more in the lower left and lower right corners. There is also a red arched bridge in the lower left corner. Using saturated candy colors of pink, cyan, blue, gold, orange, purple, and white, almost every surface is covered with confetti-like petals, shimmering particles, paint splatters, and intricate floral patterns. The overall atmosphere is festive, cute, ecstatic, and full of holiday spirit, with dynamic perspective effects, clear lines, glossy highlights, and layered textures, presenting a highly refined gacha game card art style.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅超精细、色彩极其丰富的动漫祭典插画，画面中心是两位正在半空中欢快跳跃的兽耳娘（kemonomimi），构图呈高垂直状。右侧的少女是一位开朗的猫娘，有着白金色的头发、大而蓬松的猫耳、明亮的蓝色眼睛，一只眼睛眨着，笑容灿烂。她身穿一件鲜艳的蓝色花卉和服风格短裙，配有超大袖子、层叠的白色荷叶边衬裙、巨大的彩色腰带蝴蝶结、花朵发饰、白色短袜和木屐，身后隐约可见一条蓬松的浅色尾巴；她的右手举起比着剪刀手，左手靠近胸前。左侧的少女是一位狗娘，有着中棕色的头发、蓬松的棕白相间狗耳和卷曲的蓬松尾巴，身穿一件鲜艳的粉色和洋红色花卉和服风格短裙，配有层叠的荷叶边、巨大的装饰性腰带蝴蝶结、花朵发饰、白色短袜和凉鞋；她也在跳跃，一只手举起比着剪刀手。左侧少女的面部特意用柔和的矩形模糊块遮挡。背景是充满爆炸性幻想色彩的日式场景，细节装饰丰富：背景上方中央是富士山，伴随着灿烂的日出光芒，右侧环绕着巨大的彩虹弧线，两侧是风格化的“神奈川冲浪里”式卷浪，头顶是茂密的粉色樱花，左上角和右上角各有两个发光的纸灯笼，左下角和右下角也各有两个纸灯笼，左下角还有一座红色拱桥。采用粉色、青色、蓝色、金色、橙色、紫色和白色的饱和糖果色调，几乎每一处表面都覆盖着五彩纸屑般的花瓣、闪烁的微粒、油漆飞溅和复杂的碎花图案。整体氛围欢庆、可爱、狂喜且充满节庆感，具有动态的透视效果、清晰的线条、光泽感的高光、层叠的纹理，呈现出高度精致的抽卡游戏卡面风格。

templates.title: Anime and fashion magazine cover

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫时尚杂志封面

templates.prompt: A glossy, modern anime-style fashion magazine cover illustration, its design inspired by the editorial covers of Japanese women's street fashion magazines. The large masthead at the top uses an elegant serif font, displaying {argument name="magazine title" default="MODE"} The magazine is bright pink; the word "TOKYO" is vertically aligned in the upper left corner. The upper right corner displays the magazine issue number, "06," followed by "JUNE 2024" and "vol.218," and then the cover title "COVER GIRLS," followed by the girls' names in Japanese. The main image features two anime girls, shot from a dramatic overhead angle, as if the viewer is looking down from a city alley or stairwell. The background features brick and graffiti textures, strong sunlight, deep shadows, and a vibrant summer atmosphere. The girl on the right is the main character: a cheerful, sporty blonde with bright green eyes, tanned skin, a radiant smile, and messy pigtails or a high side ponytail, her hair flowing freely. She strikes a playful and energetic pose, tilting towards the camera. She wears a light blue lace or sheer ruffled tank top, denim shorts, a black choker, and platform white sneakers. The girl on the left has long, straight hair {argument name="second girl hair color" default="Emerald Green"} She has thick, straight bangs, bright blue eyes, fair skin, and a calm, composed expression. She sits in a lower position in the frame, looking upwards. She wears a casual summer outfit in soft blue-gray tones, an off-the-shoulder design, and platform sneakers. The composition incorporates layered Japanese magazine cover text: on the left are multiple lines of stacked black and pink headlines, including "NEO BASIC STYLE" and "SPORTY × FEMININE"; on the right is a pink circular badge with the white Japanese and English phrase "Trend 7"; the lower half features a striking large pink Japanese main title; near the lower right corner is white handwritten "shine in my style"; and the bottom edge has additional white and pink small-print cover summary. The composition employs sophisticated typography, overlapping fonts, saturated colors, sharp cel-shaded highlights, and a stylish summer look, presenting…{argument name="issue month" default="June 2024"} The quality of a high-end anime magazine cover.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张光泽感十足的现代动漫风格时尚杂志封面插画，设计参考了日本女性街头时尚杂志的编辑封面。顶部巨大的刊头采用优雅的衬线字体，写着 {argument name="magazine title" default="MODE"}，颜色为亮粉色；“TOKYO”一词垂直排列在左上角边缘。右上角是杂志期号板块，显示大号数字“06”，下方有“JUNE 2024”和“vol.218”字样，再下方是写着“COVER GIRLS”的封面标题，随后是日语名字。主体画面展示了 2 位动漫女孩，采用戏剧性的俯视角度拍摄，仿佛观众正从城市小巷或楼梯间向下俯瞰，背景带有砖块和涂鸦纹理，阳光强烈，阴影深邃，充满活力的夏日氛围。右侧的女孩是主导人物：一位开朗、运动风的金发女孩，有着鲜艳的绿色眼睛、小麦色皮肤、灿烂的露齿笑容，凌乱的双马尾或高侧马尾发型，发丝飘逸，摆出俏皮且充满活力的姿势，向镜头上方倾斜。她穿着浅蓝色蕾丝或透明荷叶边吊带上衣、牛仔短裤、黑色颈圈和厚底白色运动鞋。左侧的女孩留着长直的 {argument name="second girl hair color" default="翡翠绿"} 头发，留着厚重的齐刘海，明亮的蓝色眼睛，皮肤白皙，表情冷静沉稳，坐在画面较低的位置向上看。她穿着休闲的夏日装束，色调为柔和的蓝灰色，露肩设计，搭配厚底运动鞋。在整个构图中添加层叠的日语杂志封面文字：左侧是多行堆叠的黑色和粉色专题标题，包括“NEO BASIC STYLE”和“SPORTY × FEMININE”；右侧是一个带有白色日文和英文短语“Trend 7”的粉色圆形徽章；下半部分是一个非常醒目的粉色大号日文主标题；右下角附近覆盖着白色手写体“shine in my style”；底部边缘还有额外的白色和粉色小字封面摘要。采用精致的编辑排版、重叠的字体、饱和的色彩、锐利的赛璐璐高光、时尚的夏日造型，呈现出 {argument name="issue month" default="2024 年 6 月"} 高端动漫杂志封面的质感。

templates.title: Post-apocalyptic ruins at dusk

titleLocalized.zh: 黄昏下的末日废墟

templates.prompt: A melancholic, post-apocalyptic landscape, rendered in deep brown and amber hues, depicts the ruins of industrial or urban buildings beneath a turbulent sky thick with luminous clouds. In the left foreground, a massive, slanted, collapsed metal beam or crane arm extends from the lower left to the upper left, covered in tattered fabric or torn panels and tangled cables. A long cable cuts diagonally across the center of the frame. In the hazy middle ground, slightly to the right, stands a damaged domed tower or observatory-like structure, partially obscured by dust, smoke, and floating debris. The ground is littered with jagged rubble, broken structures, and silhouettes of wreckage. The composition utilizes dramatic backlighting through gaps in the clouds at the horizon, soft volumetric fog, atmospheric perspective, painterly textures, and the epic feel of a ruined world. The composition should be vertical, solemn, desolate, and cinematic, with no one visible in the frame.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅充满忧郁气息的末日电影感景观，采用深褐色与琥珀色调，描绘了在布满浓厚发光云层的动荡天空下，工业或城市建筑的废墟。左侧前景中，一根巨大的倾斜坍塌金属梁或起重机臂从左下角向左上方延伸，上面覆盖着破损的织物或撕裂的板材以及缠绕的电缆。一根长电缆斜向穿过画面中心。在朦胧的中景偏右处，矗立着一座受损的圆顶塔楼或类似天文台的建筑，部分被灰尘、烟雾和漂浮的碎片遮挡。地面布满了锯齿状的瓦砾、破碎的结构和残骸剪影。利用地平线云层缝隙中的戏剧性逆光、柔和的体积雾、大气透视、绘画质感以及废墟世界的史诗基调。构图应呈现垂直感，庄重、荒凉且具有电影感，画面中无人出现。

templates.title: Cute winking female student making a peace sign

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱的眨眼女学生比耶手势

templates.prompt: A simple and cute flat vector illustration featuring a cheerful Japanese female student in the center of a light gray solid background. The image shows her from the mid-thigh upwards in a frontal pose. She has long, straight hair.{argument name="hair color" default="black"} Her hair is styled with a side-swept fringe, she has fair skin, a round face, and pink blush on her cheeks. One eye is open, the other blinking, and she has a small nose and a slightly parted mouth in a smile. She wears a classic Japanese high school uniform, consisting of a dark navy blue blazer, a white shirt collar with a large red bow at the neckline, and a gray pleated skirt. Two gold buttons are visible on the blazer. Her arms are outstretched horizontally to the sides, facing the audience, and she makes a peace sign with her fingers pointing downwards. The design employs bold, simple black outlines, soft, light-colored flat colors, minimalist shadows, kawaii sticker-style proportions, symmetrical composition, and a friendly, playful expression.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张简洁可爱的扁平矢量插画，主角是一位开朗的日本女学生，置于浅灰色纯色背景中心，画面展示从大腿中部以上的正面姿势。她留着长直的 {argument name="hair color" default="black"} 头发，配有侧分刘海，皮肤白皙，圆脸，双颊带有粉色腮红，一只眼睛睁开，另一只眼睛眨眼，小巧的鼻子，嘴巴微张露出笑容。她穿着经典的日本高中校服，包括深海军蓝西装外套、白色衬衫领、领口处系着大红色蝴蝶结，以及灰色百褶裙，外套上可见 2 枚金色纽扣。双臂向两侧水平伸出，面向观众，双手做出比耶手势，手指朝下。采用粗犷简洁的黑色轮廓线、柔和的淡色系扁平色彩、极简阴影、卡哇伊贴纸风格比例、对称构图以及友好俏皮的表情。

templates.title: Post-apocalyptic ruins city streets

titleLocalized.zh: 末日废墟城市街道

templates.prompt: This is a dark, post-apocalyptic city street at night. Looking up from the ground, dilapidated high-rises rise like narrow canyons on either side. The buildings are severely damaged and partially collapsed, displaying jagged outlines, broken facades, and black gothic industrial details blending into the shadows. Thick columns of smoke and storm clouds fill the central sky, backlit by a cold, pale light near the horizon, creating a dramatic, high-contrast visual focal point. The overall color scheme is near monochromatic, dominated by deep navy blue, charcoal gray, black, and soft steel blue, with tiny orange embers scattered throughout the scene. The atmosphere is desolate, eerie, and cinematic, resembling a post-apocalyptic wasteland or a bombed-out city ruin. The digital concept art, with its painterly style, soft atmospheric haze, heavy texture, and subtle film grain, depicts a scene devoid of people, vehicles, or clearly visible signs. The wide-angle composition, rich details of the ruins, the strong vertical composition of the buildings, and the oppressive, smoky sky dominating the upper half create an ominous premonition.

promptLocalized.zh: 这是一条夜晚黑暗的末日城市街道，从地面视角向上仰望，两侧是如峡谷般狭窄的破败高楼。建筑受损严重且部分坍塌，呈现出参差不齐的轮廓、破碎的立面以及融入阴影中的黑色哥特工业风细节。浓重的烟柱和风暴云层充斥着天空中央，地平线附近透出的冷冽苍白光芒为其提供了背光，营造出极具戏剧性的高对比度视觉焦点。整体色调接近单色，以深海军蓝、炭灰、黑和柔和的钢蓝色为主，空气中散布着细小的橙色余烬，在整个场景中飘浮。氛围凄凉、阴森且具有电影感，宛如灾后废土或被轰炸后的城市废墟。绘画风格的数字概念艺术，柔和的大气雾霾，厚重的质感，带有微妙的胶片颗粒感，画面中无人、无车辆、无清晰可见的标志，采用广角构图，废墟结构细节丰富，建筑形成的强烈垂直构图以及占据上半部分的压抑烟雾天空，营造出不祥的预感。

templates.title: Flat-painted style elf girl with ruffled bed

titleLocalized.zh: 平涂风格精灵女孩与荷叶边床

templates.prompt: A soft, flat-color anime illustration depicts a cute elf girl reclining on a pastel-colored bed with ruffles in a bedroom. The composition is slightly weighted to the left, with a large area of ​​cream-colored blank space on the right. She has long, slightly messy hair.{argument name="hair color" default="Bright orange"} Her hair was bright and vibrant.{argument name="eye color" default="blue"} She had large eyes, fair skin, and a clearly visible pointed elf ear adorned with a red flower hair clip. Her expression was gentle, shy, and relaxed; her cheeks were slightly flushed, her hands supporting her chin, and her body was curled up slightly on the bed. She wore a romantic off-the-shoulder dress.{argument name="dress color" default="Sage Green"} A dress with abundant white lace trim, floral embroidery, and four visible red bows is paired with black harem pants (one red bow is visible) and white ankle socks adorned with pink bows. On the bed are a white ruffled pillow, pink cushions (including a round ruffled cushion), and a beige plush rabbit tied with a pink ribbon, sitting at her feet. A small bedside table is shown in the background, featuring a potted plant, a framed photograph, and a lamp with a fabric lampshade. Wall decorations include a hanging floral arrangement and two small framed pictures. Tiny pastel hearts and flowers are scattered in the blank space on the right. The overall effect is a delicate and clean line drawing style, a soft pastel palette, a very light beige background, and minimalist flat shading, creating a light, sweet, and girly atmosphere. It embodies a comfortable bedroom aesthetic, rich in ruffles and fabric details, and features a horizontal composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张柔和的平涂风格动漫插画，描绘了一位可爱的精灵女孩侧卧在粉彩卧室的荷叶边床上，构图重心偏左，右侧留有大面积的奶油色空白。她留着长而微乱的 {argument name="hair color" default="亮橙色"} 头发，有着明亮生动的 {argument name="eye color" default="蓝色"} 大眼睛，皮肤白皙，一只尖尖的精灵耳朵清晰可见，上面装饰着红花发夹。她表情温柔、羞涩且放松，脸颊微红，双手托腮，身体在床上微微蜷缩。她穿着一件浪漫的露肩 {argument name="dress color" default="鼠尾草绿"} 连衣裙，带有丰富的白色蕾丝饰边、花卉刺绣和 4 个可见的红色小蝴蝶结，搭配黑色灯笼裤（可见 1 个红色蝴蝶结）和带有粉色小蝴蝶结装饰的白色短袜。床上放着一个白色荷叶边枕头、粉色靠垫（包括一个圆形荷叶边靠垫），以及一只坐在她腿边、系着粉色丝带的米色兔子毛绒玩具。背景中展示了一个小床头柜，上面有 1 盆植物、1 张相框照片和 1 盏带布艺灯罩的台灯，墙面装饰包括 1 个悬挂式花卉饰品和 2 幅小相框画。在右侧的空白处散落着一些微小的粉彩心形和花朵图案。采用精致干净的线稿风格，柔和的粉彩调色板，极浅的米色背景，极简阴影的平涂上色，轻盈甜美的少女漫氛围，舒适的卧室美学，荷叶边和布料细节丰富，横向构图。

templates.title: Graffiti-style cozy restaurant table photos

titleLocalized.zh: 涂鸦风格温馨餐厅餐桌照片

templates.prompt: A striking photograph of a dark restaurant table, rendered in a stylish, hand-drawn doodle style, taken from a slightly overhead three-quarter angle. The image showcases a wooden table with four main food items: a large white pasta bowl with the words "OLIO E PIU" in black rim, filled with creamy or truffle pasta topped with a glistening raw egg yolk, a spoon resting inside, and gently steaming; a large white plate cropped from the background, holding roasted vegetables and a piece of brown meat seasoned with a light green powder; a partially cropped white wine glass in the lower left corner; and a glass of dark sparkling beverage in the upper right. The very dark, warm, almost black background makes the food and glassware stand out exceptionally in the low ambient light. Add white hand-drawn doodles and Japanese handwritten annotations above the photos: In the top left corner, there's a large, curved title that reads "おいしい時間、しあわせだな〜♡", with a sweeping underline and two small hearts below; above the pasta, there's an annotation that reads "しっとり、たまごとろり", with a dotted arrow pointing to the egg yolk; near the drink in the top right corner, there's an annotation that reads "さっぱり、リフレッシュ！", with a dotted arrow pointing to the glass; near the wine glass in the bottom left corner, there's an annotation that reads "sparkling". "Chotoshita Gohobi. ♡", accompanied by a curved dotted arrow; near the bottom right center is a note that reads "Amakute, yawarakai :) ♡", with a dotted arrow pointing to the food on the plate. In addition to the text, it should include 10 doodle decorations: two wavy lines of steam above the pasta, two small twinkling stars near the wine glass, two small twinkling markers near the lower plate, two tiny water droplet markers next to the drink in the upper right corner, and two hearts near the title. Use thin white chalk lines to create a casual and imperfect stroke, fostering a warm, editorial social media aesthetic. While maintaining a realistic photographic feel in the composition, the doodles should appear playful and hand-drawn.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张氛围感十足的深色餐厅餐桌照片，采用时尚的手绘涂鸦编辑风格，从略微俯视的四分之三角度拍摄。画面展示了一张木桌，上面摆放着 4 种主要的餐饮单品：左中位置是一个带有黑色边缘文字“OLIO E PIU”的大号白色意面碗，盛着奶油意面或松露意面，顶部放着一颗光亮的生蛋黄，碗内放着一把勺子，并冒着柔和的热气；右下角是一个被画面裁切的大号白色餐盘，盛放着烤蔬菜和一块带有浅绿色调料粉的褐色肉类；左下角是一只被部分裁切的白葡萄酒高脚杯；右上角是一只深色气泡饮料的高脚杯。背景非常昏暗且温暖，近乎黑色，使食物和玻璃器皿在低环境光下格外突出。在照片上方添加白色手绘涂鸦和日语手写注释：左上角有一行大的弧形标题，写着“おいしい時間、しあわせだな〜♡”，下方带有扫尾的下划线和 2 颗小爱心；意面上方有一条注释写着“しっとり、たまごとろり”，并有一条虚线箭头指向蛋黄；右上角饮料附近有一条注释写着“さっぱり、リフレッシュ！”，并有一条虚线箭头指向杯子；左下角葡萄酒杯附近有一条注释写着“sparkling. ちょっとした ごほうび。♡”，并有一条弯曲的虚线箭头；右下中心附近有一条注释写着“あまくて、やわらかい :) ♡”，并有一条虚线箭头指向盘中的食物。除了文字外，还需包含 10 个涂鸦装饰：意面上方 2 个热气波浪线，葡萄酒杯附近 2 颗小闪烁星，下层餐盘附近 2 个小闪烁标记，右上角饮料旁边 2 个微小水滴标记，以及标题附近 2 颗爱心。使用纤细的白色粉笔线条，呈现随意且不完美的笔触，营造出温馨的编辑类社交媒体美学，在保持构图真实摄影感的同时，让涂鸦看起来俏皮且具有手绘感。

templates.title: A woman and a tiger shadow under the moonlight

titleLocalized.zh: 月光下的女子与虎影

templates.prompt: A dreamlike, cinematic, fantastical night scene, with a deep indigo starry sky as the backdrop, the calm sea reflecting everything like a mirror. A huge full moon hangs in the upper left, and the Milky Way stretches diagonally across the entire background. In the center of the image, a slender woman with {argument name="hair color" default="black"} Her long, straight hair flowed freely as she walked barefoot across the shallow, mirror-like water, her elegant profile silhouetted against the light. She wore a shimmering, semi-transparent silver evening gown, its tight bodice sparkling, its thin straps creating a flowing, light skirt with a high slit revealing one leg, the hem swaying gently in the breeze. To her right, a curved arc of magical particles formed a crescent-shaped trajectory, composed of glowing white roses, petals, and tiny specks of light, rising from the water near her reflection and swirling upwards beside her. Below her, a fantastical reflection shone on the water: a glowing, transparent white tiger lay on its side, its form like liquid light and stardust, with bright stripes and a softly luminous face. The water, smooth as glass, rippled delicately, clearly reflecting the woman, the moon, the stars, and the magical light. Low, dark islands sat on the distant horizon. At the bottom center, elegant, glowing cursive script was added.{argument name="quote" default="A tiger in the heart, yet a rose in the gentle scent."} Ultra-refined, ethereal, poetic, and realistic fantasy art; soft moonlight, cool color palette, high contrast, soft lighting effect, mysterious atmosphere, and widescreen composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅梦幻般的电影质感奇幻夜景，背景是深靛蓝色的星空，平静的海面如镜面般倒映着一切。左上方悬挂着 1 轮巨大的满月，银河斜向横跨整个背景。画面中央，一位身材修长的女子留着 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"} 的长直发，赤脚走在浅浅的镜面水域上，从左向右行进，呈现出优雅的全身侧影。她身穿一件闪烁的半透明银色晚礼服，紧身胸衣闪闪发光，细肩带设计，裙摆轻盈飘逸，高开叉露出一条腿，裙摆在微风中摇曳。在她右侧，一道弯曲的魔法粒子弧线形成 1 条新月形轨迹，由发光的白玫瑰、花瓣和微小的光点组成，从她倒影附近的水面升起，并在她身旁向上盘旋。在她下方的水面上倒映着一个奇幻的镜像：1 只发光的透明白虎侧卧着，呈现出如液态光芒和星尘般的质感，带有明亮的条纹和柔和光亮的脸庞。水面如玻璃般平滑，带有细微的涟漪，清晰地倒映出女子、月亮、星星和魔法光芒。远处的地平线上坐落着低矮的深色岛屿。在底部中央，添加优雅的发光草书文字 {argument name="quote" default="心有猛虎，细嗅蔷薇"}。超精细、空灵、诗意、写实奇幻艺术，柔和月光，冷色调，高对比度，柔光效果，神秘氛围，宽银幕构图。

templates.title: Anime Concert Interview Magazine Pages

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫演唱会访谈杂志内页

templates.prompt: A visually striking anime-style promotional interview poster, designed as a beautiful double-page spread in a futuristic live music event magazine. The scene depicts a packed, late-night concert venue, with audiences waving neon yellow, blue, and purple glow sticks. The background features a massive, glowing stage, laser beams, light spots, smoke, and a giant triangular play icon screen displaying "AI SUPERLIVE SUMMER 2026." In the foreground center are two anime-style female hosts, presented from a dramatic side-back perspective, both gazing at the stage. The character on the left is {argument name="left character name" default="ソラ"} She wears a dark, oversized hooded jacket with black and lime green accents, large lime green headphones marked "06," and holds a bright yellow glow stick above her head; her face is partially obscured by a rectangular privacy panel. The character on the right is {argument name="right character name" default="ナギ"} With a short, silver-white bob and fair skin, she wore a light-colored, oversized hooded jacket. Bathed in the soft light of the stage lights, she held a blue-white illuminated baton to her chest, her profile captivating as she watched the performance. The use of cinematic contour lighting, richly saturated purple-blue concert colors, reflective fabric highlights, and exquisite anime rendering creates a high-end, editorial advertising feel. The layout mimics the style of Japanese feature interviews, featuring dense text overlays, semi-transparent dark panels, thin neon yellow borders, and striking sans-serif fonts. It contains 8 unique text blocks: a small title tag in the top left corner that reads "/ SPECIAL INTERVIEW /"; a large Japanese title in the top left corner that reads "この夏、AIと音楽の未来がステージで輝く！"; an event logo block in the top right corner that reads "AI SUPERLIVE SUMMER 2026" and "2026.7.18 SAT @ FUTURE ARENA ODAIBA"; three yellow-bordered Q&A panels stacked on the left and right that begin with "Q."; three yellow-bordered Q&A panels stacked on the right and beginning with "Q."; and two character introduction name boxes labeled "ソラ" and "ナギ" near the characters. A striking Japanese closing line is added to the bottom left and center: “AI and music resonate together, a new summer is here. Together, let’s experience the future!” The bottom right corner contains a footer with the event name and date repeating, along with a visible QR code and small print indicating the official website. The overall style blends the characteristics of high-end Japanese event flyers, interview articles, and key visuals, exuding energy, futurism, emotional tension, and a festive atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一款极具视觉冲击力的动漫宣传访谈海报，设计为未来感现场音乐活动的精美杂志双页跨页。场景展示了一个座无虚席的夜间演唱会现场，观众挥舞着霓虹黄、蓝、紫色的荧光棒，背景是巨大的发光舞台、激光束、光斑、烟雾，以及一个巨大的三角形播放图标屏幕，上面写着“AI SUPERLIVE SUMMER 2026”。前景中央是两位动漫风格的女主持人，以戏剧性的侧后方视角呈现，两人都望向舞台。左侧角色为 {argument name="left character name" default="ソラ"}，身穿带有黑色和酸橙绿点缀的深色超大款连帽夹克，佩戴标有“06”的大型酸橙绿耳机，头顶举着一支亮黄色的荧光棒；她的脸部被一个矩形隐私遮挡块部分遮盖。右侧角色为 {argument name="right character name" default="ナギ"}，留着银白色短波波头，皮肤白皙，身穿浅色超大款连帽外套，在舞台灯光的柔和映照下，胸前握着一支蓝白色的发光指挥棒，侧脸表情动人，注视着演出。运用电影级的轮廓光、饱和度丰富的紫蓝色演唱会色调、反光织物高光，以及精致的动漫渲染，呈现出高级的编辑广告质感。排版仿照日本专题访谈风格，包含密集的文字覆盖、半透明深色面板、细霓虹黄边框以及醒目的无衬线字体。包含 8 个独特的文本块：左上角 1 个小型标题标签，写着“/ SPECIAL INTERVIEW /”；左上方 1 个大型日文标题，写着“この夏、AIと音楽の未来がステージで輝く！”；右上角 1 个活动 Logo 块，写着“AI SUPERLIVE SUMMER 2026”和“2026.7.18 SAT @ FUTURE ARENA ODAIBA”；左侧堆叠 3 个以“Q.”开头的黄色边框问答面板；右侧堆叠 3 个以“Q.”开头的黄色边框问答面板；以及人物附近标有“ソラ”和“ナギ”的 2 个角色介绍名称框。在底部左侧和中央添加一行醒目的日文结束语：“AIと音楽が響き合う、新しい夏がはじまる。 一緒に、未来を体験しよう！”。右下角包含一个重复活动名称和日期的页脚块，以及一个可见的二维码和标注官方网站的小字说明。整体风格融合了高端日本活动传单、访谈文章和主视觉图的特色，充满活力、未来感、情感张力与节日氛围。

templates.title: Advertisement for a cute pink kitten escape game

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱粉色小猫逃脱游戏广告

templates.prompt: A Japanese-style mobile game promotional poster in a dreamy pastel style, displayed vertically in a smartphone size. The poster is kawaii and fantastical, super cute and glossy. The main subject is a fluffy white kitten with huge, shimmering purple-blue eyes, a soft blush on its cheeks, a pink nose, and a mischievous smile. It lies on a pink cushion or blanket in the foreground, clutching a baby bottle in its paws. The kitten is extremely fluffy and round, with soft, shiny fur, giving it a plush toy-like texture, and looks especially adorable under the warm, magical lighting. The entire scene is filled with pink hearts, glitter, lace details, soft blurring effects, and candy-colored decorations, creating a healing yet playful atmosphere. The background is a pastel-colored bedroom or nursery, with three plush toys neatly arranged on a shelf: a pink rabbit, a mint blue cat, and a lavender purple bear. Translucent floating soap bubbles are added, containing white bone-shaped icons, as well as small decorative pendants, ribbons, and floral decorations. On the left is a prominent vertical Japanese title in a glossy bubble font, reading "脱出できない" (I can't escape), accompanied by smaller vertical text "かわいくて、" (I'll escape), all in bright pink with a white halo and bold outline. At the top is a circular badge with white lace trim containing the Japanese phrase "もふもふにゃんことおへやから脱出？" (Mofumofunnyanko to Oheyakara Escape?), below which is a pink cat paw print icon. At the bottom is a decorative game logo in large, rounded Japanese characters, "もふふミルクとにゃんこ" (Mofufu Milk to Nyanko), below which is a ribbon banner reading "脱出ゲーム" (Escape Game), using a color scheme of powder blue, cream, and pink with a shimmering outline style. A small, rounded text box has been added to the bottom left corner, reading "Is it unexpected that I'm feeling better...?!", and decorated with small flowers and a hanging baby bottle charm. It adopts a refined indie game promotional visual style, rich in detail, with soft, airbrushed illustrations, glossy typography, and a charming, comfortable, and irresistibly cute aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张梦幻粉彩风格的日式手机游戏宣传海报，采用竖版智能手机尺寸，卡哇伊幻想风格，超萌且具有光泽感。主体是一只毛茸茸的白色幼猫，有着巨大的闪烁紫蓝色眼睛、脸颊上带着淡淡的红晕、粉色的小鼻子和顽皮的微笑，它躺在前景的粉色坐垫或毯子上，爪子里抱着一个奶瓶。小猫极其蓬松圆润，毛发柔软发光，有着毛绒玩具般的质感，在温暖的魔法光影下显得格外可爱。整个场景充满了粉色爱心、闪光、蕾丝细节、柔和的虚化效果和糖果色装饰，营造出一种治愈又俏皮的氛围。背景是一个粉彩色的卧室或育婴室，架子上整齐地摆放着 3 个毛绒玩具：一只粉色兔子、一只薄荷蓝猫和一只薰衣草紫熊。添加半透明的漂浮肥皂泡，泡泡内有白色骨头形状的图标，以及小巧的装饰挂件、丝带和花卉装饰。左侧有醒目的垂直日文标题，采用光泽感的泡泡字体，写着「脱出できない」，旁边配有较小的垂直文字「かわいくて、」，均为亮粉色，带有白色光晕和粗轮廓。顶部是一个白色蕾丝边缘的圆形徽章，内含日文「もふもふ にゃんこと おへやから脱出？」，下方有一个粉色的猫爪印图标。底部放置一个装饰性的游戏 Logo，采用圆润的日文大字「もふふミルクと にゃんこ」，下方配有丝带横幅写着「脱出ゲーム」，配色采用粉蓝、奶油色和粉色，带有闪亮的轮廓风格。左下角添加一个圆润的小文本框，写着「癒されるのに、意外とむずかしい…!?」，并装饰有小花和悬挂的奶瓶挂件。采用精致的独立游戏宣传主视觉风格，细节丰富，柔和的喷绘插画，光泽感的排版，迷人、舒适且令人无法抗拒的可爱。

templates.title: Anime Girl in a Sunny Cafe

titleLocalized.zh: 阳光下的咖啡馆动漫少女

templates.prompt: A dreamlike, anime-style full-body illustration depicts a young woman standing outside the entrance of a sunlit café, emphasizing the details of her facial orientation and gaze. She is slightly turned to the right of the frame, her head tilted to the side, as if looking at the street beyond the camera's view. Her facial features are soft and simple, partially obscured by the bright light, delicate and without harsh lines. She has long, wavy brown hair with warm golden highlights, stray strands catching the sunlight, and a small hair clip on one side. She wears a loose-fitting beige long-sleeved jumpsuit or skirt, cinched at the waist with flowing sleeves, paired with white slouch socks, platform white sneakers, and a small white shoulder bag with a delicate gold chain. She holds a clear plastic iced coffee with a black straw in her hands, positioned in front of her chest. The scene takes place outside a cozy café. To the right are tall glass doors and windows revealing two café signs bearing the words "MOUNT TOKYO," with smaller text below reading "COFFEE, SANDWICH and more..."—one a rectangular wall-mounted sign, the other a black A-frame pedestrian sign in the lower left corner; the A-frame also includes the opening hours in smaller print. A simple wooden bench sits on the left edge. The entire scene is filled with dappled sunlight and dense tree shadows, casting shimmering summer atmospheres on the walls, glass, floor, bench, and women's clothing. The work employs a soft watercolor and gouache style with bright, overexposed highlights. Warm cream, gold, and peach hues complement cool blue shadows, the brushstrokes are textured, and the glass reflects light, creating a nostalgic yet light atmosphere. The vertical composition allows for full-body views, showcasing an elegant and fashionable illustration style with rich environmental details—a café street scene bathed in Japanese sunlight.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅梦幻般的绘画风格动漫全身插画，描绘了一位年轻女性站在阳光明媚的咖啡馆入口外，画面着重表现了她面部朝向和视线的细节。她身体略微转向画面右侧，头部侧倾，仿佛正看向镜头外的街道。她的面部线条柔和简约，部分被明亮的光线遮蔽，五官精致，没有生硬的轮廓线。她留着一头带有温暖金色挑染的棕色长卷发，零散的发丝捕捉着阳光，一侧别着一个小发夹。她穿着一件宽松的米色长袖连体裤或短裙，腰部收紧，袖口轻盈飘逸，搭配白色堆堆袜、厚底小白鞋，以及一个带有细金链条的小白肩包。她双手捧着一杯插着黑色吸管的透明塑料冰咖啡，置于胸前。场景位于一家舒适的咖啡馆外，右侧是高大的玻璃门窗，可以看到两个写有“MOUNT TOKYO”字样的咖啡馆招牌，下方附有较小的文字“COFFEE, SANDWICH and more...”——其中一个是墙面安装的长方形招牌，另一个是左下方的黑色 A 型人行道立牌；A 型立牌底部还包含小字营业时间。左侧边缘放置着 1 张简单的木制长椅。整个场景充满了斑驳的阳光和浓密的树影，投射在墙壁、玻璃、地面、长椅和女性的衣物上，营造出闪烁的夏日氛围。采用柔和的水彩和水粉渲染风格，带有明亮过曝的高光，温暖的奶油色、金色和桃色调与冷蓝色的阴影相得益彰，笔触充满质感，玻璃反射出光泽，呈现出怀旧而轻盈的氛围。竖构图，全身可见，优雅的时尚插画构图，环境细节丰富，日本阳光洗礼下的咖啡馆街景。

templates.title: Urban Men's Portraits on the Overpass

titleLocalized.zh: 天桥上的都市男装肖像

templates.prompt: A natural-style street fashion portrait, featuring a person{argument name="subject" default="Young Japanese men"} Standing on a city pedestrian bridge in the sunlight, the composition is a vertical portrait from mid-thigh to head. He casually leans against the worn green metal railing, one hand in his coat pocket, his body slightly tilted, presenting a relaxed and stylish candid pose rather than standing upright. He has medium-length, slightly wavy, messy hair, and his hair color is {argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown"} He has a natural volume around his ears and forehead, and a slender build. Dress him in a layered, neutral-toned winter outfit: one {argument name="coat color" default="grayish brown"} An oversized wool coat, layered over a {argument name="sweater color" default="off white"} A chunky knit crew neck sweater, with a long striped shirt peeking out from the collar and hem. The overall atmosphere is calm, sophisticated, and modern, like the pages of a Japanese men's fashion magazine. Soft natural light is used to present realistic skin tones, subtle shadows, soft colors, and a shallow depth of field. The background showcases out-of-focus mid-to-high-rise city buildings, bare winter trees, and a bright, light-colored sky, creating a realistic Tokyo urban atmosphere. The realistic style, understated color gradation, delicate fabric textures, magazine-edition composition, lack of dramatic special effects, text overlays, and other passersby are all present.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张自然风格的街头时尚肖像，主体为一位 {argument name="subject" default="年轻日本男性"}，在日光下站在城市人行天桥上，构图为从大腿中部到头部的竖版肖像。他随意地倚靠在磨损的绿色金属栏杆上，一只手插在外套口袋里，身体微微倾斜，呈现出一种放松且时髦的抓拍姿态，而非笔直站立。他留着中等长度的微卷凌乱发型，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"}，耳部和额头处有自然的蓬松感，身材修长。为他穿上叠穿风格的中性色调冬季时装：一件 {argument name="coat color" default="灰褐色"} 的超大款羊毛大衣，内搭一件 {argument name="sweater color" default="米白色"} 的粗棒针圆领毛衣，领口和下摆露出长款条纹衬衫。整体氛围冷静、精致且充满现代感，如同日本男士时尚杂志的内页。使用柔和的自然光，呈现真实的肤色、细腻的阴影、柔和的色彩以及浅景深效果。背景中展示失焦的中高层城市建筑、冬季的枯树以及明亮的浅色天空，营造出真实的东京式都市氛围。写实风格，低调的色彩分级，细腻的织物纹理，杂志编辑级构图，无戏剧性特效，无文字叠加，无其他路人。

templates.title: Light purple blueberry cake anime poster

titleLocalized.zh: 淡紫色蓝莓蛋糕动漫海报

templates.prompt: A dreamy, pale purple illustration of a Japanese movie poster, rendered in a glossy, anime-style aesthetic, is imbued with the chaotic yet softly shimmering feel of blueberry desserts. In the image, a young girl sits on the floor of a cluttered kitchen or baking counter, sporting a short, silver-purple bob with side-swept bangs and a pale purple bow hair clip, dressed in quirky and adorable fashion. Her face is deliberately obscured by a centrally located square pale purple-gray veil. She wears an oversized, semi-transparent pale purple jacket with black ribbon trim on the cuffs, layered over a light purple printed top, adorned with silver necklaces, a purple plaid skirt, loose white slouch socks decorated with pale purple heart patches and black bows, and thick-soled pale purple sneakers with ribbon embellishments. She holds a blueberry to her lips in one hand and a metal mixing bowl smeared with vibrant purple blueberry batter in the other. Before her, a giant golden pound cake dramatically bursts open, spilling dark, glossy blueberries and purple filling onto a cooling rack and tabletop. Blueberries are scattered throughout the image, serving as props for both suspension and stillness, creating a whimsical sense of floating. Baking tools and notebooks are cluttered in the environment: in the upper right corner, there's a spiral notebook page with a blueberry pound cake recipe handwritten in English; in the lower right corner, there's an egg beater; in the lower left corner, there's a small pinned photo with two anime girls drawn on it; and in the lower right corner, there's a handwritten note with Japanese writing and a simple drawing of a rabbit. The overall color scheme uses monochromatic shades of lilac, violet, periwinkle blue, cream, and deep blueberry purple, complemented by bright highlights, soft mist, translucent layers, and romantic glitter. The poster features striking, large Japanese calligraphy text on the left half, arranged vertically and diagonally like a dramatic light novel or movie advertisement; a ribbon banner next to the cake reads "July 2026 Melody Show"; vertical text is on the right; a small credits list the production staff at the bottom; and a final tagline at the very bottom. The overall composition creates a sense of "cute disaster": beautiful yet failed baking, sweet melancholy, stylish messiness, and the tension of a movie poster.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张梦幻般的淡紫色日本电影海报插画，采用光泽感的少女动漫风格，充满了蓝莓甜点带来的混乱感与柔和的闪光。画面中，1 位少女坐在杂乱的厨房或烘焙工作台的地板上，留着银紫色短波波头，侧分刘海，戴着一个淡紫色小蝴蝶结发夹，身穿另类可爱的时尚服饰。她的脸部被一个居中的方形淡紫色灰色遮挡块刻意遮住。她穿着一件超大号半透明淡紫色夹克，袖口有黑色丝带装饰，内搭浅紫色印花上衣，叠戴银色项链，穿着紫色格纹裙、装饰着淡紫色心形补丁和黑色蝴蝶结的宽松白色堆堆袜，以及带有丝带装饰的厚底淡紫色运动鞋。她一只手拿着 1 颗蓝莓靠近嘴边，另一只手拿着 1 个沾满鲜艳紫色蓝莓面糊的金属搅拌碗。在她面前，1 个巨大的金色磅蛋糕戏剧性地裂开，溢出深色光亮的蓝莓和紫色馅料，洒落在 1 个冷却架和桌面上。蓝莓散落在整个画面中，作为悬浮和静置的道具，营造出一种奇妙的悬浮感。环境里杂乱地摆放着烘焙工具和笔记：右上角有 1 页螺旋笔记本，上面用英文手写着蓝莓磅蛋糕的食谱；右下角有 1 个打蛋器；左下角有 1 张别着的小照片，上面画着 2 位动漫少女；右下角还有 1 张写着日文和简笔画小兔子的手写便签。整体采用丁香紫、紫罗兰、长春花蓝、奶油色和深蓝莓紫的单色调，辅以明亮的高光、柔和的雾气、半透明的叠层和浪漫的闪粉。在海报左半部分加入醒目的大号日文书法文字，像戏剧性的轻小说或电影广告一样垂直和对角线排布；蛋糕旁配有 1 条丝带横幅，上面写着日期“2026年7月メロードショー”；右侧配有垂直文案；底部有小字制作人员名单；最底部有一行最终标语。整体构图营造出一种“可爱的灾难”感：美丽却失败的烘焙、甜蜜的忧郁、时尚的凌乱感以及电影宣传海报的张力。

templates.title: Soft anime-style blueberry cake movie poster

titleLocalized.zh: 柔和动漫风蓝莓蛋糕电影海报

templates.prompt: A dreamy, softly animated movie poster illustration is set in a narrow outdoor alleyway covered with a dense mosaic of floral patterns. The image evokes shimmering starlight, soft mist, and a romantic shoujo manga color palette of lavender, pink, periwinkle, and cream. The foreground shows a lovely girl, her back partially obscured in profile, her face mostly hidden. She has a short, silver-lavender bob and wears a large, pale purple bow adorned with small flowers. She wears an oversized, semi-transparent pale purple hoodie with floral appliqués on the sleeves, paired with a layered, soft-toned skirt, and carries a shimmering pale purple backpack adorned with charms, ribbons, pom-poms, badges, and star decorations. She holds a slice of blueberry pound cake, its center dramatically overflowing with glossy, deep purple blueberry filling, thick syrup flowing across the cake and plate. Whole blueberries are scattered around the cake and below in the foreground. Despite the beautiful visuals, the overall atmosphere should be fantastical, sophisticated, and with a touch of comedy. The image is designed like a Japanese movie poster, featuring numerous decorative text overlays and laurel leaf embellishments. At the top, there are three lines of small award descriptions with laurel wreaths. Add a large handwritten Japanese title in a layered pink, white, and purple font with glowing, sticker-like outlines: “冷凍したブルーベリー使ってパウンドケーキ焼いたら中身溢れて失敗した件.” (Translation: The story of how a pound cake made with frozen blueberries failed because the filling overflowed.) Below, add a smaller subtitle: “〜甘くて、ちょっぴり切ない青春のレシピ〜” (Translation: ~A sweet yet slightly bittersweet recipe for youth~). Place a vertical white quote box on the right containing the Japanese phrase: "うまくいかない日だって、人生のスパイスになるんだ。" (Even the worst days are part of life.) In the bottom left corner, add a pink sticky note that reads "Sweet but clumsy," along with a torn-out page from a handwritten Japanese list. Near the cake, add a small speech bubble that reads "Oops!" Near the bottom right corner, add a circular stamp-like seal that reads "Blueberry disaster." At the bottom, add white movie credits-style text, including "A FILM BY YUMEIRO PASTEL," and a large pink and white release date:{argument name="release date" default="2024.6.30(SUN)"} "ROADSHOW". Add the Japanese tagline below: "失敗は、最高の思い出になる。だから、また挑戦しよう。" (Translation: Failure can become the best memory. So, let's challenge ourselves again.) Frame the entire poster with lace, stickers, confetti, and scrapbook-style decorations. The image should be highly detailed, glossy, sensual, cute, and cinematic, deliberately creating an exaggerated effect reminiscent of a coming-of-age movie poster about baking failure.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张梦幻般的柔和动漫电影海报插画，背景设定在一条布满繁密花卉马赛克墙绘的狭窄户外小巷中，画面呈现出闪烁的星光、柔和的雾气，以及薰衣草色、粉色、长春花色和奶油色的浪漫少女漫色彩分级。前景展示了一位可爱的少女，背影呈四分之三侧面，面部大部分被遮挡，留着银薰衣草色的短波波头，戴着装饰有小花的大号淡紫色蝴蝶结发饰。她穿着一件超大号的半透明淡紫色连帽衫，袖子上绣有花卉贴花，搭配层叠的柔和色调短裙，背着一个闪亮的淡紫色双肩包，包上挂满了挂件、丝带、毛绒球、徽章和星星装饰。她手里端着一个切开的蓝莓磅蛋糕，中心戏剧性地溢出了光泽感十足的深紫色蓝莓馅料，浓稠的糖浆流淌在蛋糕和盘子上。在蛋糕周围和前景下方散落着整颗蓝莓。尽管画面精美，但整体氛围要显得奇幻、精致且带有一丝喜剧色彩。将图像设计为日式电影海报，带有许多装饰性文字叠加和月桂叶装饰。在顶部，包含 3 行带有月桂花环的小型奖项说明。添加一个巨大的手写日文标题，采用粉色、白色和紫色的层叠字体，带有发光和贴纸般的轮廓，文字为：「冷凍したブルーベリー使ってパウンドケーキ焼いたら中身溢れて失敗した件。」（译：用冷冻蓝莓烤磅蛋糕结果内馅溢出失败了这件事。）在下方添加一行较小的副标题：「〜甘くて、ちょっぴり切ない青春のレシピ〜」（译：～甜蜜又略带苦涩的青春食谱～）。在右侧放置一个垂直的白色引语框，内含日文：「うまくいかない日だって、人生のスパイスになるんだ。」（译：即使是不顺利的日子，也是人生的调味品。）在左下角，添加一张别着的粉色便签，上面写着“Sweet but clumsy.”，以及一张手写的日文清单撕页。在蛋糕附近添加一个小小的对话气泡，写着“Oops!”。在右下角附近添加一个圆形的印章式封条，上面写着“Blueberry disaster”。在底部，添加白色的电影演职员表风格文字，包括“A FILM BY YUMEIRO PASTEL”，以及一行粉白相间的巨大上映日期：「{argument name="release date" default="2024.6.30(SUN)"} ROADSHOW」。在下方添加日文标语：「失敗は、最高の思い出になる。だから、また挑戦しよう。」（译：失败，会成为最棒的回忆。所以，让我们再次挑战吧。）用蕾丝、贴纸、纸屑和剪贴簿风格的装饰框住整张海报。画面要超精细、有光泽、感性、可爱、具有电影感，并刻意营造出一种关于烘焙失败的青春成长电影海报的夸张效果。

templates.title: Retro Japanese crime movie poster

titleLocalized.zh: 复古日本犯罪电影海报

templates.prompt: A retro Japanese crime film poster from the late 1970s, employing the style of Nikkatsu's single-page theatrical posters. It features a vertical composition against a background of beige old paper with noticeable grain, subtle stains, and faded ink. The main image is positioned in the upper right corner and center.{argument name="lead actor name" default="Yoshio Harada"} A large, melancholic half-length portrait shows him turned to the side, his back to the camera, with thick, dark curly hair, a serious expression, and wearing a wrinkled light gray suit jacket over an open-collared white shirt; most of his face is in shadow. The background is a desolate industrial dock with cranes, low-rise factory buildings, and thick smoke rising into the gray sky. At the lower center of the image is a large, handwritten red Japanese title.{argument name="title text" default="City of Shadows"} Written with slanted and strong brushstrokes, partially obscuring the portraits and the scene below. In the lower half, a second scene is added: a city street in the rain at dusk or night, the pavement wet and reflecting light. On the left is a dark police car with its roof lights flashing red, and six men in suits and trench coats are walking forward, one of whom, a detective in a beige trench coat and loose tie, leads the group. On the far right, there is a vertically arranged row of five embedded portraits of actors, each with a thin border, presenting a somber, cinematic still from different roles. Add vertical Japanese typesetting: the upper right corner is the cast list "Starring Harada Yoshio"; the upper left corner is the two lines of slogan "その男, Criminal." "Justice より, 真実を chase う."; Near the lower right corner of the main image, add another vertical slogan "Who is the enemy, Who is the flavor side. Dark に eliminates the incident の中で, ただひとつの真実を掴むまで—". The bottom contains Japanese credits in dense small type across the entire width, with a prominent release date in the lower right corner.{argument name="release date" default="11.23"} Below it are the words "Nikkatsu Roadshow" and a small studio logo. The color scheme uses soft charcoal gray, dark brown, smoky blue-gray and off-white, with the red title being the only bright color. The overall atmosphere is hard-edged, melancholic, rough and cinematic, like a lost 1970s Japanese detective movie poster.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张 20 世纪 70 年代末的复古日本犯罪电影海报，采用日活（Nikkatsu）院线单张海报风格，纵向构图，背景为带有明显颗粒感、微弱污渍和墨迹褪色的米色旧纸张。主体图像是位于右上角和中心位置的 {argument name="lead actor name" default="原田芳雄"} 的大型忧郁半身肖像，他侧身背对镜头，留着浓密的深色卷发，表情严肃，身穿皱巴巴的浅灰色西装外套，内搭敞领白衬衫；面部大部分处于阴影中。背景是荒凉的工业码头，有起重机、低矮的工厂建筑和升入灰暗天空的浓重烟雾。在画面中下部，放置一个巨大的手写红色日文标题 {argument name="title text" default="影の街"}，以倾斜且强烈的笔触书写，部分覆盖了肖像和下方场景。在下半部分，添加第二个场景：黄昏或夜晚雨中的城市街道，路面湿润且带有倒影，左侧是一辆车顶红灯闪烁的深色警车，6 名身穿西装和风衣的男子正向前走，其中 1 名身穿米色风衣、领带松散的侦探形象走在队伍最前方。在最右侧，包含一列垂直排列的 5 张嵌入式演员肖像，每张都带有细边框，呈现出不同角色的深沉电影剧照。添加垂直日文排版：右上角为演员表“原田芳雄 主演”；左上角为两行标语“その男、刑事。 正義より、真実を追う。”；在主体图像右下角附近，添加另一段垂直宣传语“誰が敵で、誰が味方か。闇に消えた事件の中で、ただひとつの真実を掴むまで—”。底部包含横跨整个宽度的密集小字日文演职员表，右下角标注醒目的上映日期 {argument name="release date" default="11.23"}，下方印有“日活ロードショー”字样及小型制片厂标志。色调采用柔和的炭灰色、深褐色、烟雾蓝灰色和灰白色，红色标题是唯一的鲜艳色彩。整体氛围硬派、忧郁、粗粝且充满电影感，宛如一张失传的 1970 年代日本侦探电影海报。
