Her face is deliberately concealed by a centrally located gray-toned, pale purple square occluder, obscuring her eyes, nose, and most of her mouth. One ear is fully exposed, adorned with two earrings: a small geometric stud and a long, delicate chain earring with a cross-shaped pendant at the end. She wears two necklaces: a slender silver chain and a silver pendant necklace with a faceted, diamond-shaped purple gemstone. She wears a loose, light gray off-the-shoulder top, the collar slipping down to reveal one shoulder, with a small black star logo printed on the chest. Her hair is glossy and layered, elegant strands winding gracefully in the image, the purple highlights creating a strong visual contrast. Delicate decorative celestial art is added to the background, containing seven clearly visible star-shaped or shimmering patterns, their colors echoing the violet and framed with subtle geometric borders, creating a refined, gothic, dreamlike, and modern aesthetic. Soft lighting, delicate lines, a soft neutral color scheme with black and purple as the main colors, highly exquisite anime illustrations, centered composition, square format.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张动漫风格的近景肖像，描绘了一位神秘的年轻女性，她留着一头极长的飘逸黑发，发间穿插着鲜艳的 {argument name="accent color" default="紫罗兰色"} 挑染，半身像，背景简洁明亮。她的面部被一个位于正中央的灰色调淡紫色方形遮挡块刻意隐藏，遮住了眼睛、鼻子和大部分嘴部区域。一只耳朵完全露出，佩戴着两枚耳环：一枚小巧的几何耳钉和一枚末端带有十字架状吊坠的长款精致链条耳环。她佩戴着两条项链：一条纤细的银链和一条带有刻面菱形紫色宝石的银色吊坠项链。她穿着一件宽松的浅灰色露肩上衣，衣领滑落露出单肩，胸前印有一个黑色小星形标志。头发富有光泽且层次分明，优雅的发丝在画面中蜿蜒，紫色的挑染形成了强烈的视觉对比。背景中添加了纤细的装饰性天体线条艺术，包含 7 个清晰可见的星形或闪光图案，颜色与紫罗兰色相呼应，并配有微妙的几何边框，营造出精致的哥特、梦幻且现代的审美感。柔和的灯光，细腻的线条，以黑紫色为重点的柔和中性色调，高度精致的动漫插画，居中构图，方形格式。

templates.title: Selfies transformed into professional studio-quality photos

titleLocalized.zh: 自拍转为影棚级职业照

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference images, transform a casual poolside selfie into a clean, professional half-body studio portrait. Keep the subject and polo shirt, but remove the outdoor vacation background, other people, furniture, the pool, and any other vacation-related elements. Recompose the image with a centered portrait crop, facing the camera and showing the shoulders, and correct the selfie angle for a formal frontal composition. Add a smooth, deep cyan studio background, complemented by subtle vignetting and soft, skin-tone-correcting portrait lighting to create a sophisticated corporate portrait style.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图像，将随意的泳池边自拍转换为干净、专业的半身影棚肖像。保持人物和 Polo 衫不变，但需移除户外度假背景、其他人物、家具、泳池以及所有与度假相关的元素。重新构图为居中的肖像剪裁，使主体面向镜头，露出肩膀，并将自拍角度校正为正式的正面构图。添加平滑的深青色影棚背景，辅以微妙的暗角效果和柔和、修饰肤色的肖像光影，打造出精致的企业形象照风格。

templates.title: Retro red promotional style fighting poster

titleLocalized.zh: 复古红色宣传风格格斗海报

templates.prompt: A bold, retro-style poster, employing a limited color scheme of red, black, and beige, is printed on slightly textured, aged paper. The composition centers on a dramatic action scene involving two women: on the left, a woman with long, wavy red hair, dressed in a white martial arts uniform, is executing a high side kick; on the right, a curvaceous woman in a black cowboy hat and black lace bodysuit recoils and raises her arms in defense as she is kicked. The poster utilizes heavy black shadows, sharp geometric shapes, a screen-print-like ink wash effect, and graphic aesthetics reminiscent of mid-20th-century pulp fiction posters. Behind them, a large red geometric banner extends from the upper left to the lower right, with two black speed lines added to the left and three white speed lines to emphasize the dynamism. In the upper right corner, a circular badge contains a black-and-white screaming monkey or ape face on a red background. At the bottom, an oversized, compressed block font is added to the radical poster layout: the first line of text is…{argument name="headline text" default="SCOTTISH RECIPE:"} (Red and black), the second line of text is{argument name="main title" default="MINCE AND TATTIES"} (Use oversized red, white, and black lettering on a black, diagonal banner.) Maintain an overall look that is ironic, confrontational, retro, and graphic, like a fake exploitation movie poster or an anarchist punk magazine cover.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张大胆的复古宣传风格海报，采用红、黑、米色的有限配色方案，印在略带纹理的陈旧纸张上。构图中心展示了 2 名女性的戏剧性动作场景：左侧是一名留着红色长波浪卷发、身穿白色武术道服的女性，正做出一个极高的侧踢动作；右侧是一名身材曲线优美、戴着黑色牛仔帽并穿着黑色蕾丝连体衣的女性，在受到踢击时向后退缩并举起双臂防御。使用浓重的黑色阴影、锐利的几何形状、类似丝网印刷的油墨覆盖效果，以及 20 世纪中叶低俗小说海报的图形美学。在她们身后，放置一个从左上角延伸至右下角的巨大红色几何横幅，并在左侧添加 2 条黑色速度线，右侧添加 3 条白色速度线以强调动感。在右上角，包含一个圆形徽章，内部是一个红底的黑白风格尖叫猴子或猿猴面孔。在底部，以激进的海报布局添加超大号的压缩块状字体：第一行文字为 {argument name="headline text" default="SCOTTISH RECIPE:"}（红色和黑色），第二行文字为 {argument name="main title" default="MINCE AND TATTIES"}（在黑色斜向横幅上使用超大的红、白、黑三色字母）。保持整体外观具有讽刺性、对抗性、复古感和强烈的图形感，就像一张伪造的剥削电影海报或无政府主义朋克杂志封面。

templates.title: Moroccan restaurant brand project

titleLocalized.zh: 摩洛哥餐厅品牌项目

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image of a North African millet (couscous) dish as the main visual food photo, it was transformed into a dish called {argument name="restaurant name" default="La Casbah"} This is a beautifully designed branding project for a Moroccan restaurant. While maintaining the recognizability of the dishes themselves, the restaurant uses its name as the main visual element in the upper right corner, and builds a complete, high-quality brand presentation around it within a warm beige editorial layout, incorporating sophisticated Moroccan design elements. A brand section is added in the upper left corner, displaying the restaurant name in a large serif font, topped with a small geometric logo and the French phrase "SAVEURS D'AILLEURS, SOURIRES D'ICI." Below this is a brief French brand introduction and a striking closing statement. A structured brand guide grid was then created, comprising nine sections: 1) “LOGO PRINCIPAL”: Displaying the main logo on a light background; 2) “VARIATIONS”: Showcasing three logo variations—a red square, a green square, and a circular stamp version; 3) “TYPOGRAPHIES”: Showcasing three font styles—headings, subheadings, and body text; 4) “PALETTE DE COULEURS”: Showcasing six color blocks, labeled Casbah Red, Sahara Sand, Olive Green, Spice Orange, Mint Green, and Charcoal, with hexadecimal color codes; 5) “INSPIRATION”: Showcasing three image sections—Moroccan arch tiles, colorful spices, and fresh mint leaves; 6) “PACKAGING”: Showcasing three mockups—a paper takeaway bag, a sealed bowl, and a takeaway coffee cup; 7) “MERCHANDISE”: Showcasing three mockups—an apron, a tote bag, and a baseball cap; 8) “RÉSEAUX”: Showcasing… “SOCIAUX”: Showcases 3 social media post designs using food and ingredient images accompanied by brief French marketing copy; 9) “VOIX DE LA MARQUE”: Showcases 4 brand tone characteristics and brief French descriptions. A minimalist quote box is added to the right, stating “BIEN MANGER. SOURIRE. RECOMMENCER.” The presentation concludes with a full-width deep red footer, centered on the logo and adorned with subtle Moroccan geometric patterns. Overall aesthetics: Luxury restaurant brand project, concise agency presentation, unified Moroccan visual identity, elegant typography, realistic mockups, soft, natural textures, and editorial-grade spacing.

promptLocalized.zh: 以提供的北非小米（couscous）菜肴参考图作为主视觉美食照片，将其转化为名为 {argument name="restaurant name" default="La Casbah"} 的摩洛哥餐厅精美单页品牌项目。在保持菜肴本身可辨识度的前提下，将其作为右上角的主视觉元素，并围绕它在温暖的米色编辑布局上构建完整的优质品牌演示，融入精致的摩洛哥风格设计。在左上角添加品牌板块，以大号衬线字体展示餐厅名称，上方配以小型几何徽标，并附上法语标语“SAVEURS D’AILLEURS, SOURIRES D’ICI。”下方包含一段简短的法语品牌介绍和一句醒目的结语。随后创建一个结构化的品牌指南网格，包含 9 个部分：1) “LOGO PRINCIPAL”：在浅色背景上展示主 Logo；2) “VARIATIONS”：展示 3 种 Logo 变体——红色方形版、绿色方形版和圆形印章版；3) “TYPOGRAPHIES”：展示 3 种字体样式——标题、副标题和正文；4) “PALETTE DE COULEURS”：展示 6 个色块，分别标注为 Casbah Red、Sahara Sand、Olive Green、Spice Orange、Mint Green 和 Charcoal，并附带十六进制颜色代码；5) “INSPIRATION”：展示 3 个图片板块——摩洛哥拱门瓷砖、彩色香料和新鲜薄荷叶；6) “PACKAGING”：展示 3 个样机——纸质外卖袋、带封套的餐碗和外卖咖啡杯；7) “MERCHANDISE”：展示 3 个样机——围裙、托特包和鸭舌帽；8) “RÉSEAUX SOCIAUX”：展示 3 个社交媒体帖子设计，使用美食和食材图片并配以简短的法语营销文案；9) “VOIX DE LA MARQUE”：展示 4 个品牌语调特征及简短的法语描述。在右侧添加一个极简主义的引言框，内容为“BIEN MANGER. SOURIRE. RECOMMENCER。”最后以全宽深红色页脚收尾，居中放置 Logo 并点缀微妙的摩洛哥几何图案。整体外观：奢华餐厅品牌项目、简洁的代理商演示、统一的摩洛哥视觉识别、优雅的排版、逼真的样机、柔和的自然质感、编辑级间距。

templates.title: Dogs carrying huge bones on the beach

titleLocalized.zh: 海边载着巨大骨头的狗狗们

templates.prompt: A whimsical oil painting-style illustration depicts a vintage turquoise station wagon traveling along a coastal highway. The image employs a simple side view, with a clear blue sky and a calm horizon as the background. On the roof, four clearly visible brown ropes bind an exaggeratedly large white dog bone; its rough texture, three-dimensional shape, and length even exceeding the length of the vehicle itself. Inside the wagon are four dogs: a golden-brown dog in the driver's seat, one paw resting on the steering wheel; two golden-brown dogs sitting in the middle and rear windows, gazing out; and a white and brown dog at the rear, its head slightly raised. The painting uses thick, expressive oil paint strokes with a soft, impasto texture, presenting a slightly naive, folk-art realism style, full of gentle humor. The composition is minimalist, with the car positioned horizontally in the center of the image. The foreground is a dark road, with a narrow strip of sand near the water's edge. The color palette is dominated by sky blue, sea blue, faded turquoise, cream white, and warm brown. The bright sunlight, the absence of text and extraneous objects, create a tranquil and enjoyable road trip atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅充满奇趣的油画风格插画，描绘了一辆复古绿松石色旅行车行驶在沿海公路上。画面采用简洁的侧面视角，背景是纯净的蓝天与平静的海平线。车顶上用 4 根清晰可见的棕褐色绳子绑着一根极其夸张的巨大白色狗骨头，骨头表面纹理粗糙、造型立体，长度甚至超过了车身。车内共有 4 只狗狗：驾驶座上是一只金棕色狗狗，一只爪子搭在方向盘上；中间和后排车窗各坐着一只金棕色狗狗，正向外张望；车尾还有一只白棕相间的狗狗，头部微微上扬。画面采用厚重且富有表现力的油画笔触，带有柔和的厚涂质感，呈现出略显稚拙的民间艺术写实风格，充满温和的幽默感，构图极简，汽车位于画面水平中心。前景是深色的道路，靠近水边有一条细长的沙带。色调以天蓝色、海蓝色、褪色的绿松石色、奶油白和暖棕色为主。明亮的日光，无文字，无多余物体，营造出宁静而有趣的公路旅行氛围。

templates.title: Anime Fantasy Movie Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫奇幻电影海报

templates.prompt: A cinematic, anime-style poster for a fictional fantasy film, titled {argument name="headline text" default="EL VIAJE DE LA LUNA DE PLATA"} The image employs a vertical composition reminiscent of high-end movie posters. At the center is a half-length portrait of a young anime woman, facing forward with a calm and composed expression. She sports a short, silver bob with softly layered hair and side bangs, fair skin, a black choker, and geometric earrings. She wears a loose-fitting navy blue tracksuit jacket with double gold stripes on the cuffs, over which she wears a white tank top, and carries a dark backpack over one shoulder. Her expression is delicate and natural, stripped of exaggerated details, presenting a more realistic, painterly quality. Behind her, a seamless, magical composition blends various travel destinations: on the left, a brightly lit train platform at dusk, a train pulling in, and a shimmering city skyline in the distance; below, distant mountains and winding valleys; on the right, a sunset over the coast, the sun low on the sea, accompanied by cliffs, a crescent moon, and two seabirds soaring in the sky; in the lower right corner, a winding road winds through brightly lit hills, leading to a town shimmering with lights. Add a wooden road sign on the right with three signs that read "NUEVOS CAMINOS", "VIEJOS RECUERDOS", and "SIN LÍMITES". Add a slogan at the top center.{argument name="tagline" default="CADA DESTINO CAMBIA SU HISTORIA"} The text uses an elegant serif capital font. In the upper left corner, four gold award areas with laurel wreaths are placed: one line of five-pointed stars with the text "GANADORA DE MÚLTIPLES PREMIOS"; one award with "MEJOR PELÍCULA ANIMADA" and smaller festival text below; one award with "PREMIO DEL PÚBLICO" and smaller festival text below; and one award with "MEJOR BANDA SONORA ORIGINAL" and smaller Academy Award text below. At the bottom center, a large, glowing serif film title, in a gorgeous glow-in-the-dark typography, is placed overlaid on the character's torso. Below the title, a short quote is added.{argument name="quote" default="A veces, para encontrarte... tienes que perderte en el mundo."} At the very bottom, there is a list of the production company, cast, and release information.{argument name="release text" default="PRÓXIMAMENTE EN CINES"} (Use a large serif capital font) and add a tiny production company logo at the bottom edge. A rich twilight blue, golden sunset glow, soft magenta clouds, atmospheric mist, reflected highlights, and delicate cinematic lighting create an emotionally rich, adventurous, yet natural and uncluttered, exquisitely illustrated poster style.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影级动漫风格海报，用于虚构的奇幻剧情片，标题为 {argument name="headline text" default="EL VIAJE DE LA LUNA DE PLATA"}，采用高级院线海报的垂直构图。画面中央是一位年轻动漫女性的半身肖像，她正面向前，神情平静而内敛。她留着短款银色波波头，发丝层次柔和且带有侧刘海，皮肤白皙，佩戴黑色颈圈和几何形状耳环，身穿宽松的海军蓝运动外套，袖口饰有双条金线，内搭白色吊带背心，单肩背着深色背包。她的表情细腻自然，去除了夸张的细节，呈现出更具写实感的绘画质感。在她身后，将多处旅行目的地风景融合成一幅无缝的魔法构图：左侧是黄昏时分灯火通明的火车站台，列车进站，远处是闪烁的城市天际线；下方是远山与蜿蜒的河谷；右侧是海岸落日，夕阳低垂于海面之上，伴有悬崖、新月和天空中飞翔的 2 只海鸟；右下角是一条蜿蜒的道路，穿过灯火通明的山丘，通向一座闪烁着灯光的城镇。在右侧添加一个木制路标，上面有 3 个指示牌，分别写着 "NUEVOS CAMINOS"、"VIEJOS RECUERDOS" 和 "SIN LÍMITES"。在顶部中央，添加标语 {argument name="tagline" default="CADA DESTINO CAMBIA SU HISTORIA"}，使用优雅的衬线大写字体。在左上方，放置 4 个带有月桂花环的金色奖项区域：1 行五星标志，文字为 "GANADORA DE MÚLTIPLES PREMIOS"，1 个奖项写着 "MEJOR PELÍCULA ANIMADA" 及下方较小的电影节文字，1 个奖项写着 "PREMIO DEL PÚBLICO" 及下方较小的电影节文字，以及 1 个奖项写着 "MEJOR BANDA SONORA ORIGINAL" 及下方较小的学院奖文字。在底部中央，放置巨大的发光衬线电影标题，采用华丽的夜光排版，叠加在角色的躯干上。在标题下方，添加简短的引语 {argument name="quote" default="A veces, para encontrarte... tienes que perderte en el mundo."}。在最底部，包含一行制片厂演职员表和上映信息 {argument name="release text" default="PRÓXIMAMENTE EN CINES"}（使用大号衬线大写字体），并在底部边缘添加微小的制作公司 Logo。使用浓郁的暮色蓝、金色夕阳余晖、柔和的洋红色云彩、大气雾气、反射高光、细腻的电影级布光，打造出一种情感丰富、充满冒险感且自然而不杂乱的精致插画海报风格。

templates.title: Traditional and modern toothpaste advertisements

titleLocalized.zh: 传统与现代牙膏广告

templates.prompt: for{argument name="brand name" default="Colgate Sensation White"} The luxury goods advertising poster is designed with the image vertically divided into two halves by a narrow, elegant mirror with a bright blue glow in the center. On the left, an elderly African woman is shown three-quarters turned to the side, her arms crossed. She wears a richly patterned indigo and gold traditional batik dress, a matching headscarf, multi-layered gold bead necklace, dangling earrings, and stacked bracelets, holding a traditional chewing stick vertically in her hand. On the right, a young African woman wearing the same indigo and gold dress and gold jewelry stands in the same mirrored pose, holding a modern blue and white toothbrush vertically in her hand. Both figures are elegant and dignified, photographed in half-body style against a warm brown textured studio background, complemented by cinematic gold lighting, high contrast, delicate skin tone processing, and high-end beauty advertising aesthetics. A red circular Colgate logo is added to the upper left corner. A large, elegant cream-colored serif font is overlaid at the bottom center of the image: the text on the left is {argument name="left slogan" default="Depuis toujours."} The text on the right is{argument name="right slogan" default="Pour toujours."} A glowing blue tooth icon is placed in the center of the mirrored dividing line. A smaller, cream-colored serif caption is added to the bottom center:{argument name="tagline text" default="Le meilleur de la tradition, la force de la science"} A box of Colgate Sensation White toothpaste is placed in the lower right corner, slightly angled towards the camera, its texture glossy and realistic. The overall composition aims to convey the fusion of ancestral tradition and modern dental science, showcasing high-end African fashion portraiture, symmetrical balance, editorial-level advertising design, and an international high-end cosmetics advertising style.

promptLocalized.zh: 为 {argument name="brand name" default="Colgate Sensation White"} 设计的奢侈品广告海报，画面被中间一个带有明亮蓝光的精致窄镜垂直分为左右两半。左侧，一位非洲老妇人侧身四分之三面朝镜头，双臂交叉，身穿图案华丽的靛蓝配金色传统蜡染印花裙，佩戴配套的头巾、多层金珠项链、垂坠耳环和叠戴手镯，手中垂直握着 1 根传统咀嚼棒。右侧，一位身穿同款靛蓝配金色裙装并佩戴金饰的年轻非洲女性，以同样的姿势镜像站立，手中垂直握着 1 支现代蓝白配色牙刷。两位人物均优雅端庄，半身像拍摄，背景为温暖的棕色纹理影棚背景，配以电影质感的金色灯光、高对比度、细腻的肤色处理及高端美妆广告美学。在左上角添加 1 个红色圆形 Colgate 标志。在画面中下部叠加大型精致的奶油色衬线字体：左侧文字为 {argument name="left slogan" default="Depuis toujours."}，右侧文字为 {argument name="right slogan" default="Pour toujours."}，镜面分割线中间放置一个发光的蓝色牙齿图标。在底部中央添加一行较小的奶油色衬线标语：{argument name="tagline text" default="Le meilleur de la tradition, la force de la science"}。在右下角放置 1 盒 Colgate Sensation White 牙膏，略微朝向镜头，质感光亮且真实。整体构图旨在传达祖传传统与现代牙科科学的融合，展现高端非洲时尚人像、对称平衡感、编辑级广告设计以及国际化的高级化妆品广告风格。

templates.title: Anime girl's selfie portrait (blurred)

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫少女自拍肖像（已打码）

templates.prompt: A soft, low-saturation anime-style illustration depicts a young woman sitting at an indoor table, taken from a slightly downward close-up perspective, like a casual selfie. Her face is completely obscured by a centered square obscuring block in a warm grayish-brown color. She has long hair, the color of which is {argument name="hair color" default="Medium brown"} Her hair was slightly tousled, with fine strands falling over her shoulders and chest, possessing a natural sheen and creating a soft, layered look. She was wearing an oversized top.{argument name="top color" default="off white"} The wearer is dressed in a sweatshirt with a visible grey collar and a delicate silver necklace with a small pendant. The pose is relaxed and intimate, with one arm outstretched towards the camera, shoulders slightly tilted, and the body turned diagonally within the frame. The background is simple and serene: a beige wall, a dark bench or chair back, and a corner of a wooden tabletop visible in the lower right corner. A brown skirt or folded beige fabric is added near the knee in the lower right corner. The use of soft earth tones, delicate shadows, and painterly lines creates a comfortable everyday atmosphere and presents a clean, modern Japanese illustration aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张柔和、低饱和度的动漫风格插画，描绘了一位年轻女性坐在室内桌前，采用略微俯视的特写视角，如同随意的自拍。她的面部被一个居中的方形遮挡块完全掩盖，遮挡块呈温暖的灰褐色。她留着长发，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="中棕色"}，头发略显蓬松，细碎的发丝垂落在肩头和胸前，带有自然光泽，呈现出柔和的层次感。她穿着一件超大款 {argument name="top color" default="米白色"} 卫衣，内搭可见灰色衣领，并佩戴一条带有小吊坠的细银项链。姿态放松而亲密，一只手臂向镜头方向伸出，双肩微斜，身体在画面中呈对角线转向。背景简洁宁静：一面米色墙壁、一张深色长凳或椅背，右下角可见木质桌面的一角。在右下角膝盖附近加入一条棕褐色裙子或折叠的米色布料。采用柔和的大地色调、细腻的阴影、绘画感的线条，营造出舒适的日常氛围，并呈现出干净的现代日本插画美学。

templates.title: Colgate Traditional and Scientific Advertising

titleLocalized.zh: Colgate 传统与科学广告

templates.prompt: Create a sophisticated square advertising image for Colgate Sensation White. The image is vertically divided into two halves by a luminous dividing line, showcasing the contrast between tradition and modern science. On the left, an elderly African woman sits behind a light-colored marble table against a warm, earthy interior with carved wooden paneling and a ceramic pot. She wears a richly patterned traditional rust-orange and gold-trimmed wrap dress, multi-layered beaded necklaces and bracelets, and has short grey hair. She stands serenely, holding a natural chewing stick close to her mouth. Above her head, the French headline, “Depuis toujours,” is displayed in a striking, warm gold font in an arc. On the right, an African child sits behind the same table against a stylish, modern blue interior with soft lighting and vertical gold accents. The child wears a vibrant blend of traditional and modern attire: a copper-brown tunic with bright blue patterns and gold trim on the front, and neat braids, holding a Colgate toothbrush close to his mouth. Above the child's head, the French title, "Pour toujours," is displayed in a striking, large, bright blue font in an arc. At the bottom center, two slightly misaligned boxes of Colgate Sensation White toothpaste, each with a matching toothbrush, are prominently displayed on a marble tabletop, spanning both sides. The packaging must be clear and realistic, highlighting the red Colgate logo and the blue and white Sensation White branding. A striking white French slogan, "Le meilleur de la tradition, la force de la science," is added at the bottom edge. Cinematic commercial lighting is used to create the realism of high-end product photography, showcasing rich skin tones, balanced symmetry, and a visual story of the collision between tradition and innovation.

promptLocalized.zh: 为 Colgate Sensation White 创建一张精致的正方形广告图像。画面垂直平分为左右两半，中间有一条发光的分割线，展现传统与现代科学的对比。左侧画面中，一位非洲老妇人坐在浅色大理石桌面后，背景是温暖的土色调室内空间，配有雕花木墙板和一个陶罐。她身穿图案丰富的传统铁锈橙色配金色裹身裙，佩戴多层珠串项链和手镯，留着短灰发。她姿态从容庄重，手中拿着一根天然咀嚼棒靠近嘴边。在她头顶上方，用醒目的暖金黄色大号字体呈弧形排列法文标题：“Depuis toujours.” 右侧画面中，一位非洲儿童坐在同一张桌面后，背景是时尚的现代蓝色室内空间，配有柔和的灯光和垂直的金色装饰。孩子身穿鲜艳的传统与现代结合的服饰：铜棕色束腰外衣，正面带有亮蓝色图案和金色镶边，梳着整齐的辫子，手中拿着一支 Colgate 牙刷靠近嘴边。在孩子头顶上方，用醒目的亮蓝色大号字体呈弧形排列法文标题：“Pour toujours.” 在底部中央，横跨左右两半并显眼地放置在大理石桌面上，展示 2 盒略微错位堆叠的 Colgate Sensation White 牙膏，上面放着一支配套的牙刷。包装必须清晰且逼真，突出红色的 Colgate 标志和蓝白相间的 Sensation White 品牌标识。在底部边缘居中添加一句醒目的白色法文标语：“Le meilleur de la tradition, la force de la science”。采用电影级的商业照明，呈现高端产品摄影的真实感，展现丰富的肤色、平衡的对称美，以及传承与创新碰撞的视觉故事。

templates.title: Fashionable photoshoot on a wildflower hill

titleLocalized.zh: 野花山丘上的时尚大片

templates.prompt: A soft, outdoor-chic photograph shows a woman standing in a wildflower meadow during the day. The image shows her back, her body slightly turned three-quarters of the way to the side, her head turning back towards the camera. She has shoulder-length to mid-back hair that is slightly messy.{argument name="hair color" default="Deep gold"} Her hair, strands flowing gently in the wind, was slightly tousled. Her face was completely obscured by a flat, rectangular, warm beige-brown blur. She wore an exquisite white sheer lace suit, consisting of two visible pieces: a long-sleeved, semi-transparent floral lace top (with ruffled cuffs) and a high-waisted white lace bottom. Her posture was relaxed and sensual, one arm hanging naturally, the other resting lightly on her hip. She was surrounded by lush natural grass and blooming wildflowers, with white daisies and small yellow flowers visible in the foreground and midground. The background consisted of rolling green and golden hills, and mountains with dramatic chalky cliff faces and eroded textures. The composition employed expansive landscape views, partially cloudy blue skies, warm natural light, earthy tones, shallow depth of field, cinematic composition, a realistic photographic style, high detail, and soft contrast to create a dreamy bohemian countryside atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张柔和的户外时尚风格摄影作品，展现了一位女性在白天的山间野花草甸中伫立，画面呈现其背影，身体微微侧转四分之三，头部向镜头方向回眸。她留着齐肩至中背部的凌乱 {argument name="hair color" default="深金色"} 秀发，发丝随风飘动，略显蓬松。她的面部被一个暖米棕色的平整矩形模糊块完全遮挡。她身着精致的白色透明蕾丝套装，由两件可见单品组成：一件长袖半透明碎花蕾丝上衣（带有荷叶边袖口）和一件高腰白色蕾丝下装。姿态放松而感性，一只手臂自然下垂，另一只手轻搭在髋部。周围环绕着茂密的天然草丛和盛开的野花，前景和中景可见白色雏菊和黄色小花。背景是连绵起伏的绿色与金色山丘，以及带有戏剧性白垩质感悬崖面和侵蚀纹理的山体。采用广阔的景观视野、局部多云的蓝天、温暖的自然光、大地色调、浅景深、电影级构图、写实摄影风格、高细节、柔和对比度，营造出梦幻的波西米亚乡村氛围。

templates.title: Japanese Roman font sample poster

titleLocalized.zh: 日式罗马字体样本海报

templates.prompt: Create a sophisticated retro-modern style font sample poster to showcase a font called{argument name="typeface name" default="KASEI"} This fictional font aims to achieve an elegant fusion of Roman typeface and Japanese typography. It employs a vertical composition, uses warm ivory textured paper, and features thin gray dividing lines, black lettering, and soft vermilion accents to emphasize the text and seals. At the center of the composition is a large serif Latin wordmark.{argument name="typeface name" default="KASEI"} Below the title are two oversized Japanese kanji characters, “華世”, in a matching high-contrast classical style. Above the title is a smaller title, “INTRODUCING,” adorned with a tiny decorative diamond. To the right of the title area is a vertical Japanese slogan: “经典の美、未来の书体.” (Classical beauty, future calligraphy). Below the main kanji is the subtitle “A ROMAN × JAPANESE TYPEFACE,” and below that is a line of vermilion Japanese text: “ロмаの精神、日本の美.” "(The spirit of Rome, the beauty of Japan)". On the far left, create a narrow sidebar containing stacked English text "A TYPEFACE HARMONIZING ROME AND JAPAN", a small circular badge, Japanese text "制作—MMXXIV" and "CREATED IN KYOTO, JAPAN". The lower two-thirds are structured as a rigorous font sample table with clearly labeled areas. The left sidebar contains two sections: "WEIGHTS" with five items—Light, Regular, Medium, Semibold, Bold; and "POINT SIZES" with nine items—8pt, 10pt, 12pt, 14pt, 18pt, 24pt, 36pt, 48pt, 72pt. The main area contains a section titled "ROMAN CHARACTERS" displaying four lines of samples: uppercase letters A to Z, lowercase letters a to z, and the number 0. Up to number 9, and a line of punctuation/symbols, including forward slashes, commas, semicolons, exclamation marks, question marks, apostrophes, quotation marks, long dashes, parentheses, square brackets, curly braces, ampersands, at symbols, dollar signs, asterisks, swords, and double swords. Below that is a section titled "JAPANESE CHARACTERS," containing 4 lines: 19 kanji “日月山川花鸟风林火水土金木道心时空光梦永”, 23 hiragana “あいうえおかきくけこさしすせそたちつてとなにぬねの”, 21 The first line contains the katakana characters “アイウエオカキクケコサシスセソンタチツテトナニヌネノ”, and a line of symbols including Japanese punctuation, angle brackets, tildes, separators, parentheses, angle brackets, double angle brackets, black-cornered brackets, postal symbols, reference symbols, and reduplicated characters. On the next line, add four compact sample panels: “LIGATURES” with 10 items—Æ, AE, AJ, Œ, KA, KE, KI, KO, KU and “st ct fi fl ft fb”; and “STYLISTIC ALTERNATES” with 12 items—A, A, A, R, R, K, K, a, a, g, g, y, y, J, J, Q, Q, t, t. — The samples are arranged in a neat grid; “SPACING STUDY” displays the word “KASEI” with wide letter spacing, above the kanji “华世永美”; and “NUMERAL STYLES” contains four lines—uniform numerals 0123456789, old-style numerals 0123456789, and small capital letter combinations “H 0123” and “H 0123”. Tiny red Japanese descriptions are added below some sample boxes. At the bottom, three function panels are created. The left panel is titled “WORDS” and contains three entries: “HARMONIA” with red Japanese and English annotations “调和HARMONY”, “VERITAS” with “真実TRUTH”, and “FORTITUDO” with “勇気COURAGE”. The center panel contains a large Japanese quote: “時を越え、美は残る”. "(Beyond Time, Beauty Endures)," the English statement above reads "BEAUTY ENDURES BEYOND TIME," along with a small red signature "— KASEI." The right panel, titled "DETAILS," displays a large Chinese character "永" (yong, meaning eternal), against a background of subtle circular patterns and auxiliary lines, plus four right-aligned Japanese annotations connected by thin dotted lines. Finally, the footer contains four sections: a small badge with "KASEI TYPE FOUNDRY" and "WWW.KASEIFOUNDRY.JP"; a centered language support description "SUPPORTING 200+ LANGUAGES" and "LATIN / GREEK / CYRILLIC / JAPANESE / SYMBOLS"; the right-hand statement "DESIGNED WITH RESPECT CRAFTED FOR THE FUTURE"; and a label bearing the name "华世" (Huashi). A square vermilion seal. The overall style should present the texture of a high-end Japanese typeface foundry sample sheet, balancing the precision of the Swiss grid in the editing style, the classic book layout, the subtle Japanese brand sense, the generous margins, the restrained luxury, and the elegance of a museum poster.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张精致的复古现代风格字体样本海报，展示一款名为 {argument name="typeface name" default="KASEI"} 的虚构字体，旨在实现罗马字体与日式排版的优雅融合。采用竖向构图，使用暖象牙色纹理纸张，配以细灰色分割线、黑色字形以及柔和的朱红色强调文本和印章。构图中心为一个巨大的衬线拉丁文词标 “{argument name="typeface name" default="KASEI"}”，其下方为两个超大的日文汉字 “华世”，采用与之匹配的高对比度古典风格。在标题上方，放置小型标题 “INTRODUCING” 并配以一个微小的装饰性菱形。在标题区域右侧，添加一行垂直的日文标语：“古典の美、未来の书体。”（古典之美，未来之字体）。在主汉字下方，添加副标题 “A ROMAN × JAPANESE TYPEFACE”，并在其下方添加一行朱红色的日文：“罗马の精神、日本の美。”（罗马的精神，日本的美）。在最左侧，创建一个狭窄的侧边栏，包含堆叠的英文文本 “A TYPEFACE HARMONIZING ROME AND JAPAN”、一个小圆形徽章、日文文本 “制作 — MMXXIV” 以及 “CREATED IN KYOTO, JAPAN”。

将下部三分之二区域构建为一份严谨的字体样本表，并设有明确的标注区域。在左侧栏中，包含 2 个部分：“WEIGHTS”（字重）包含 5 个项目 — Light, Regular, Medium, Semibold, Bold；以及 “POINT SIZES”（字号）包含 9 个项目 — 8pt, 10pt, 12pt, 14pt, 18pt, 24pt, 36pt, 48pt, 72pt。在主区域中，包含一个标题为 “ROMAN CHARACTERS”（罗马字符）的部分，展示 4 行样本：大写字母 A 到 Z、小写字母 a 到 z、数字 0 到 9，以及一行标点/符号，包括斜杠、逗号、分号、感叹号、问号、撇号、引号、长破折号、圆括号、方括号、花括号、和号、at 符号、美元符号、星号、剑号和双剑号。在其下方，包含一个标题为 “JAPANESE CHARACTERS”（日文字符）的部分，包含 4 行：19 个汉字 “日 月 山 川 花 鸟 风 林 火 水 土 金 木 道 心 时 空 光 梦 永”，23 个平假名 “あ い う え お か き く け こ さ し す せ そ た ち つ て と な に ぬ ね の”，21 个片假名 “ア イ ウ エ オ カ キ ク ケ コ サ シ ス セ ソ ン タ チ ツ テ ト ナ ニ ヌ ネ ノ”，以及一行包含日文标点、角括号、波浪号、间隔号、圆括号、尖括号、双尖括号、黑隅付括号、邮政符号、参考符号和叠字符号的符号行。

在下一行，添加 4 个紧凑的样本面板：“LIGATURES”（连字）包含 10 个项目 — Æ, AE, AJ, Œ, KA, KE, KI, KO, KU 以及 “st ct fi fl ft fb”；“STYLISTIC ALTERNATES”（风格替换字）包含 12 个项目 — A, A, A, R, R, K, K, a, a, g, g, y, y, J, J, Q, Q, t, t — 排列成整齐的采样网格；“SPACING STUDY”（字距研究）展示单词 “KASEI” 并配以宽字间距，位于汉字 “华世永美” 上方；以及 “NUMERAL STYLES”（数字样式）包含 4 行 — 等高数字 0123456789、老式数字 0123456789 以及小型大写字母组合 “H 0123” 和 “H 0123”。在部分样本框下方添加微小的红色日文说明。

在底部，创建 3 个功能面板。左侧面板标题为 “WORDS”（词汇），包含 3 个条目：“HARMONIA” 附带红色日文和英文注释 “调和 HARMONY”、“VERITAS” 附带 “真実 TRUTH” 以及 “FORTITUDO” 附带 “勇気 COURAGE”。中心面板包含一句大型日文引言 “时を越え、美は残る。”（超越时光，美永存），上方为英文陈述 “BEAUTY ENDURES\nBEYOND TIME.” 以及一行红色的小型签名 “— KASEI”。右侧面板标题为 “DETAILS”（细节），展示一个大型汉字 “永”，背景为淡淡的构造圆和辅助线，外加 4 个通过细虚线连接的右对齐日文注释说明。

最后，在页脚包含 4 个区块：一个小徽章和 “KASEI TYPE FOUNDRY” 以及 “WWW.KASEIFOUNDRY.JP”；一个居中的语言支持说明 “SUPPORTING 200+ LANGUAGES” 和 “LATIN / GREEK / CYRILLIC / JAPANESE / SYMBOLS”；右侧陈述 “DESIGNED WITH RESPECT\nCRAFTED FOR THE FUTURE”；以及一个印有 “华世” 的方形朱红印章。整体风格应呈现出高端日式字体铸造厂样本表的质感，平衡编辑风格的瑞士网格精度、古典书籍排版、微妙的日式品牌感、宽裕的页边距、克制的奢华感以及博物馆海报般的优雅。

templates.title: Futuristic STEM Classroom Filled with Holographic Images

titleLocalized.zh: 充满全息影像的未来感 STEM 教室

templates.prompt: In a bright and futuristic classroom or science museum lab, schoolchildren are interacting with large-scale mixed reality holograms, presenting a cinematic, ultra-realistic photographic effect. The scene, set in a wide-angle indoor perspective under warm afternoon sunlight, features floor-to-ceiling windows, modern tables and chairs, bookshelves, and digital displays, creating a minimalist, high-tech educational atmosphere. Approximately nine children and one teacher are distributed throughout the room, actively exploring science exhibits through gestures and touch controls. In the center of the room, a glowing, translucent holographic human heart floats at chest height, surrounded by three children who curiously reach out to touch it. Above them hangs a giant holographic model of the solar system, with nine planets orbiting a bright sun, complete with glowing orbital paths and a fantastical scientific visualization style. To the left, a child is interacting with a tall, vertical holographic DNA double helix structure. On a table to the left front is a circular desktop hologram showcasing a miniature mountain and river ecosystem, featuring four visible animals: an elephant, a deer, an alpaca (or llama), and a bear. On the left rear table is a circular holographic model of an architecture, showcasing a magnificent classical domed building and its surrounding structure. On the right front table is a giant ball-and-stick molecular model composed of luminous spheres and connecting rods. In the right center and upper right spaces are additional suspended scientific holograms: two geometric polyhedra, two molecular structure diagrams, two spherical energy or data spheres, and one hourglass-like abstract hologram. Children of diverse ethnic backgrounds, casually dressed, are shown engrossed, amazed, and collaboratively observing the different holographic themes. Using soft volumetric lighting to create realistic reflections on the glass and tabletops, the holograms emit a delicate blue-gold glow with a slight atmospheric haze, showcasing a high-end and inspiring STEM education advertising aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一间明亮且充满未来感的教室或科学博物馆实验室，学龄儿童们正在与大型混合现实全息影像进行互动，呈现出电影级的超精细照片写实效果。场景为午后温暖阳光下的广角室内视角，配有落地玻璃窗、现代桌椅、书架、数字显示屏，营造出简洁的高科技教育氛围。约 9 名儿童和 1 名教师分布在房间各处，通过手势和触控积极探索科学展品。房间中央，一颗发光的半透明全息人体心脏悬浮在胸部高度，3 名儿童围在周围，好奇地伸手触碰。头顶上方悬挂着一个巨大的全息太阳系模型，9 颗行星围绕着明亮的太阳旋转，带有发光的轨道轨迹和梦幻般的科学可视化风格。左侧，一名儿童正在与一个高大的垂直全息 DNA 双螺旋结构互动。左前方桌上有一个圆形的桌面全息图，展示了一个微型山川河流生态系统，其中包含 4 种可见动物：大象、鹿、羊驼（或驼马）和熊。左后方桌上有一个圆形的建筑全息模型，展示了一座宏伟的古典圆顶建筑及周边结构。右前方桌上有一个由发光球体和连杆组成的巨大球棍分子模型。在右中和右上方空间，包含额外的悬浮科学全息图：2 个几何多面体、2 个分子结构图、2 个球形能量或数据球，以及 1 个类似沙漏的抽象全息图。孩子们应具有多元的种族背景，穿着休闲，神情投入、惊叹且充满协作精神，正注视着不同的全息主题。运用柔和的体积光，呈现玻璃和桌面上的真实反射，全息图散发出细腻的蓝金色光芒，伴有轻微的大气雾感，展现出高端且富有启发性的 STEM 教育广告美学。

templates.title: Watercolor Fairy Girl in Sunny Bedroom

titleLocalized.zh: 阳光卧室里的水彩精灵少女

templates.prompt: A soft pastel watercolor illustration depicts a young elf girl sitting on a bed in a quiet, sunlit bedroom, viewed from a slightly overhead, three-quarter profile. She possesses {argument name="hair color" default="warm orange"} She has shoulder-length, softly layered hair, large blue eyes, fair skin, and long, pointed ears. A red flower hair clip adorns the left side of her hair. Her expression is serene and dreamy as she gazes at the bright light on the right side of the scene. She wears a loose-fitting sage green chiffon dress with ruffled trim, sheer puff sleeves, and ruffled ribbon details at the chest, over which she wears a black lace camisole and a thin red choker with a small pendant, paired with dark knee-high socks. She sits near the edge of a lavender bedspread, her hands supporting her on the mattress behind her, her legs stretched diagonally to the lower right. The room is exquisitely simple: a bed with two white pillows, a wooden headboard or headboard behind her, a window on the left with a small plant on the windowsill, and flowing lavender curtains. Strong, warm sunlight pours in from the right, creating a large, bright halo and soft, faded highlights. Employing a light, hand-painted watercolor style, it presents visible paper textures, softly blended edges, shadows of pale purple and cream, delicate shimmering paint textures, and a tranquil, fantastical atmosphere.

Mediterranean-style white houses line both sides of the alley, their textured walls adorned with terracotta roofs, black wrought-iron balconies, wall-mounted lanterns, and numerous potted plants and flowers. On the left edge, bright pink bougainvillea flowers in the foreground define the scene. In the distance, the calm sea reflects a warm sunset, the rocky coastline and shimmering horizon appearing particularly enchanting against a soft, peach-gold sky. Warm golden sunlight casts long shadows, making the white walls gleam. An elegant layered typography is added to the upper left, using a refined serif font in a warm brown color: large line readability.{argument name="headline text" default="España,"} Read the italic serif font below.{argument name="quote" default="siempre en mi corazón."} The text is adorned with delicate decorative patterns. A subtle white accent is present in the upper right corner.{argument name="brand name" default="Pollo.ai"} The logo is ultra-refined, photorealistic, and features high-end travel advertising aesthetics, a soft atmospheric fog effect, and natural depth, achieving magazine cover-level quality.

templates.prompt: A dramatic, vertical poster-style mixed-media portrait presents a raw urban editorial aesthetic, reminiscent of concert or personal brand posters. At the center is a middle-aged man, half-body, wearing a black T-shirt, slightly turned to the side, one arm raised, index finger pointing to the top of the image. His face is deliberately obscured by a rectangular blurred block. The poster uses deep black and tan tones, accented with distressed cream and gold, incorporating heavy grunge textures, ink splatters, overlapping scratches, torn paper strokes, dust, and weathered printing effects. A large, soft gold circular halo is placed behind his head and upper body. In the background, a collage of Córdoba's urban landmarks is created: the cathedral facade on the right, and the river, bridges, and low skyline on the left, all elements perfectly integrated into the textured poster composition. An oversized, bold, compressed serif font is added at the top, containing the following text:{argument name="headline text" default="EDU PEREYRA"} The letter "EDU" is a large, distressed gray-white letter, while "PEREYRA" is below in gold. Five smaller text groups are added around the composition, using uppercase handwritten or compressed styles: "MÚSICA PASIÓN VERDAD" in the upper left, "DESDE ADENTRO HACIA AFUERA" in the upper right, "LO QUE SE SIENTE NO NECESITA EXPLICARSE" in the middle right, "AGRADECER SEGUIR CREAR" in the middle left, and "TIERRA DE HISTORIA, CORAZÓN DE GENTE" in the bottom center. A large, expressive brush-style font word is added across the lower foreground.{argument name="city name" default="cordoba"} The poster is off-white, slightly tilted, and finished with a gold underline. It features three small, symbolic graphic embellishments: a tiny crown icon near the top right, a small starburst decoration near the bottom center, and a handwritten signature mark in the bottom right corner. The shirt should include vintage-printed lettering and badge patterns. The lighting is somber and contrasting, creating a striking contrast between the subject and the layered collage background. promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的竖版海报风格混合媒介肖像，呈现出粗粝的城市编辑美学，设计风格类似于演唱会或个人品牌海报。画面中心为一名半身中老年男性，身穿黑色 T 恤，身体微侧，一只手臂向上抬起，食指指向画面顶部。他的面部被一个矩形模糊块刻意遮挡。使用深黑色和棕褐色调，搭配做旧的奶油色和金色点缀，融入厚重的垃圾摇滚纹理、墨迹飞溅、划痕叠加、撕纸笔触、灰尘以及风化的印刷效果。在他的头部和上半身背后放置一个巨大的柔和金色圆形光环。背景中，创作一幅科尔多瓦城市地标拼贴画：右侧为大教堂立面，左侧为河流、桥梁及低矮的天际线，所有元素完美融合在充满纹理的海报构图中。在顶部添加超大号粗体压缩衬线字体，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="EDU PEREYRA"}，其中“EDU”为巨大的做旧灰白色字母，“PEREYRA”位于下方，呈金色。在构图周围添加 5 组较小的文字，采用大写手写或压缩风格：左上角“MÚSICA PASIÓN VERDAD”，右上角“DESDE ADENTRO HACIA AFUERA”，中右侧“LO QUE SE SIENTE NO NECESITA EXPLICARSE”，中左侧“AGRADECER SEGUIR CREAR”，底部居中“TIERRA DE HISTORIA, CORAZÓN DE GENTE”。在下部前景横跨处，添加一个巨大的表现力笔刷字体词汇 {argument name="city name" default="cordoba"}，呈灰白色，略微倾斜，下方带有金色下划线扫尾。包含 3 个小型符号化图形点缀：右上角附近的一个微小皇冠图标，底部中心附近的一个小型星爆装饰，以及右下角的一个手写签名标记。衬衫应包含复古印刷字母和徽章图案。灯光氛围阴郁且对比强烈，主体与分层拼贴背景形成鲜明对比。整体感觉：原始、充满激情、音乐感、精神性、本土自豪感海报，高级做旧印刷设计，具有强烈的视觉冲击力，充满电影感和手工艺术气息。

On the right is a woman in a fitted black dress and a wide-brimmed black hat, leaning back in a defensive stance, one arm raised above her head, the other close to her torso, long black hair flowing behind her. Both figures are rendered as hard-edged geometric shapes with exaggerated limbs, sharp shadows, and faces in a high-contrast film noir style. A radical red diagonal beam sweeps across the background, framing the scene with black architectural lines and abstract constructivist shapes. Aged paper textures, ink wear, and slight misregistration effects are added to create a vintage print feel. A blurred monkey head badge is placed in the upper right corner. Add three large, blocky poster text lines in the bottom left corner: "SCOTTISH RECIPE:", "MINCE AND", and "TATTIES". templates.title: Screenshot of a tweet demonstrating a QR code dice game

templates.prompt: A screenshot of a social media tweet in realistic dark mode, viewed on a desktop interface. The top left corner features a circular profile picture with the name Riley Goodside, a blue verified badge, followed by the account @goodside and a 10h timestamp. The tweet reads: “ChatGPT Images 2.0 generated a game die, but instead of numbers, it provides a QR code for the corresponding Wikipedia article for each number.” Below the tweet is a large embedded image containing two side-by-side panels within a rounded rectangle. The left panel shows a glossy white six-sided die placed on a warm brown wooden tabletop, taken at a slight angle, revealing three faces, each with a different black QR code representing a number; the lighting is soft and realistic, with subtle reflections at the rounded corners of the die. Above the die image is a dark UI title area with the small text “Thought for 1 minute 43 seconds,” and near the top is a cropped speech bubble-like overlay that reads “For the Wikipedia article corresponding to its number.” The right panel is a screenshot of a mobile-style Wikipedia page for the number 1. The background is white with a thin gray border. At the top are the "Entry" and "Discussion" tabs, small interface icons, and the article text beginning with "This entry describes a number. For information on 1 AD and other uses, see One (disambiguation) and Number One (disambiguation)," followed by a box notification about special characters, and the bold opening line "1 (one, unit, uniform) is a number, value, and morpheme." The social media interface surrounding the embedded image uses a near-black background, with standard reply, retweet, like, analysis, bookmark, and share icons at the bottom, displaying 45 replies, 157 retweets, 3.5K likes, and 191K views. The UI layout is clean, resembling a desktop X/Twitter layout, with a realistic screenshot style, high readability, and a subtle sense of compression and screenshot appearance.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张在桌面界面上查看的逼真深色模式社交媒体推文截图。左上角是一个圆形头像，显示名称为 Riley Goodside，带有蓝色认证徽章，后跟账号 @goodside 和时间戳 10h。推文内容为：“ChatGPT Images 2.0 生成了一个游戏骰子，但它上面没有数字，而是为每个数字对应的维基百科文章提供了可用的 QR 码”。推文下方是一张巨大的嵌入式图片，圆角矩形内包含两个并排的面板。左侧面板显示一个光泽的白色六面骰子，放置在温暖的棕色木制桌面上，以微小角度拍摄，可见 3 个面，每个可见面上都有一个不同的黑色 QR 码代替点数；光线柔和逼真，骰子圆角处有细微的反射。骰子图像上方是一个深色 UI 标题区域，有一行小字写着“思考了 1 分 43 秒”，顶部附近有一个裁剪过的类似对话气泡的覆盖层，写着“用于其数字对应的维基百科文章”。右侧面板是数字 1 的移动端风格维基百科页面截图，背景为白色，带有细灰色边框，顶部显示“条目”和“讨论”标签、小型界面图标，以及以“本条目介绍的是数字。关于公元 1 年及其他用途，请见 One (消歧义) 和 Number One (消歧义)”开头的文章正文，随后是一个关于特殊字符的方框通知，以及加粗的开篇行“1（一，单位，统一）是一个数字、数值和字素。”嵌入式图片周围的社交媒体界面使用近乎黑色的背景，底部带有标准的回复、转发、点赞、分析、书签和分享图标，并显示 45 条回复、157 次转发、3.5K 次点赞和 191K 次浏览。清晰的 UI 排版，真实的桌面版 X/Twitter 布局，逼真的截图风格，高可读性，带有细微的压缩感和屏幕截图外观。

She was wearing a {argument name="dress color" default="White"} A sleeveless summer dress with thin straps and a fitted bodice features two bows at the center of the chest and upper torso, forming two teardrop-shaped cutouts. She wears two delicate gold necklaces: a short chain with a small pendant and a slightly longer chain with a small round pendant. Her pose is relaxed and natural, seated on a dark woven outdoor chair, arms hanging naturally in front of her thighs, shoulders relaxed, body facing forward. Bright natural sunlight, a soft summer atmosphere, realistic skin texture, high-end candid editing, subtle highlights in the hair, vibrant green, clean exposure, sharp subject focus, and a relaxed yet luxurious lifestyle aesthetic. A small white "Pollo.ai" watermark is included in the upper right corner.

The poem is as follows:{argument name="poem text" default="between the pages, quiet dreams, where ink becomes the stars, i write what my heart means, and let it heal the scars.

the world may move so fast, but here, time slows its pace. in every line i’ve made to last, i find a softer space.

some days are clouds, some days are sun, but i keep showing up. with every word, i’m not alone— my pen is my cup.

so here’s to thoughts, both big and small, to hopes, to fears, to me. i’ll keep on writing through it all, and set my spirit free."} The handwriting should look natural, slightly uneven, and have a convincing human writing feel, with the texture of a blue ballpoint pen. Add a small flashing icon and the words "Made with AI" in the bottom left corner of the post. Retain the look of a real mobile app screenshot, including realistic spacing, rounded image edges, crisp UI fonts, and subtle screenshot smoothing.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张逼真的深色模式社交媒体帖子截图，采用黑色界面，风格类似于 X/Twitter。左上角是一个模糊的小圆形头像，旁边是显示名称 {argument name="profile name" default="Pratham"} 以及蓝色认证徽章，下方是账号 ID {argument name="handle" default="@Prathkum"}。右上角是一个圆角白色“订阅”按钮和两个小界面图标。推文内容采用大号白色无衬线字体，文字为：{argument name="tweet text" default="ChatGPT Images 2.0 can match your handwriting."} 下方是一张并排对比图，由两张笔记本照片组成，中间由一条窄窄的黑色垂直间隙隔开。两张照片均展示了从上方拍摄的打开的横线笔记本页面，光线为昏暗的室内光，底部边缘有柔和的阴影。左侧笔记本页面大部分为空白，仅顶部有两行整齐的蓝色草书手写字：{argument name="handwriting prompt text" default="match my hanawriting ana write a poem for me.."} 请保留拼写错误和标点符号，确保与原文完全一致。右侧笔记本页面顶部显示相同的前两行手写字，随后是一首用匹配的蓝色草书手写体写成的诗，分 4 个诗节填满页面。诗歌内容如下：{argument name="poem text" default="between the pages, quiet dreams, where ink becomes the stars, i write what my heart means, and let it heal the scars.

the world may move so fast, but here, time slows its pace. in every line i’ve made to last, i find a softer space.

some days are clouds, some days are sun, but i keep showing up. with every word, i’m not alone— my pen is my cup.

so here’s to thoughts, both big and small, to hopes, to fears, to me. i’ll keep on writing through it all, and set my spirit free."} 手写笔迹应看起来自然、略有不均匀，具有令人信服的人类书写感，并呈现蓝色圆珠笔的质感。在帖子左下角，加入一个小闪烁图标和“Made with AI”字样。保留真实移动应用截图的外观，包括逼真的间距、圆角图片边缘、清晰的 UI 字体以及细微的屏幕截图柔和感。

templates.title: Historical sailing ships and Chinese sailing ships

titleLocalized.zh: 历史大帆船与中国帆船

templates.prompt: A highly detailed historical maritime scene, viewed from water level. The image shows two large wooden sailing ships moored close together on calm, reflecting water against a bright blue sky and scattered soft clouds. On the left is a magnificent European sailing ship, presented from its stern, adorned with Baroque carvings in gold, red, blue, and cream, heraldic symbols, multiple stern windows, and a dark hull with warm reddish-brown planks. It features four visible masts (including a scuttler), dense black rigging, a lookout tower, and numerous half-spread, naturally drooping cream-white square sails. On the right is a traditional Chinese sailing ship, slightly to the left, with a large rust-brown slat sail. Its hull is brown, black, and white, with carved stern details, and smaller masts and rigging. In the foreground, a small wooden rowing boat is visible, with a boatman in light-colored clothing and a wide-brimmed hat standing on it, providing a proportional reference between the two large ships. In the background, the outlines of other sailboats are faintly visible near the left horizon. The light is clear sunlight, giving the wood a warm sheen, and subtle reflections are cast in the ripples on the water. The overall style combines painterly and realistic elements, with extremely fine textures, a cinematic composition, a wide aspect ratio, and no modern elements.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅极具细节的历史海洋场景，视角位于水面高度。画面展示了两艘大型木制帆船在平静且具有倒影的水面上近距离停泊，背景是明亮的蓝天和零星的柔和云朵。左侧是一艘宏伟华丽的欧洲大帆船，从左后方船尾视角呈现，船尾装饰着金、红、蓝、奶油色的巴洛克风格雕刻、纹章标志、多扇船尾窗，以及带有温暖红棕色木板的深色船体。船上有 4 根可见的桅杆（包括斜桅）、密集的黑色索具、瞭望台，以及许多半展开并自然下垂的奶油白色方帆。右侧是一艘略微朝左的传统中国帆船，挂着 1 面巨大的铁锈棕色板条帆，船体呈棕、黑、白色，带有雕刻的船尾细节，以及较小的桅杆和索具。画面前景中央包含 1 艘小型木制划艇，船上站着 1 位身穿浅色衣服、戴着宽檐帽的船夫，为两艘大船之间提供了比例参照。远景背景中，左侧地平线附近隐约可见其他帆船的轮廓。光线为清澈的日光，木材上带有温暖的高光，水面波纹中映出微妙的倒影，整体呈现出兼具绘画感与写实感的风格，纹理极其细腻，构图具有电影感，采用宽画幅比例，不包含任何现代元素。

templates.title: Futuristic online skincare product advertisement

titleLocalized.zh: 未来感网络护肤品广告

templates.prompt: An advertisement for a futuristic, luxury skincare product, featuring a cool, icy blue color scheme, is presented in the style of a high-end beauty studio photoshoot. A frosted white pump bottle is placed in the center of the image, labeled {argument name="brand name" default="SECURE-IP"} It is printed with minimalist navy blue lettering.{argument name="product name" default="IP ADDRESS CLEANSER"} Near the bottom are smaller lines of text: “for risk-free connections,” “pour des connexions sans risque,” ​​and “75 ml / 2.5 fl. oz. - Data Stream Purifier.” The bottle is placed vertically on a glossy, reflective surface with realistic water droplets, the translucent circular cap positioned at the rear right. Surrounding the product are sharp, shattered pieces of clear glass and crystal, seemingly suspended in mid-air. Several larger fragments serve as label panels: six text fragments on the left read “TEXTURE” (overlaying a close-up of hydrated skin), “SHIELD” in the upper right, “HYDRATION” on the right (overlaying a close-up of blue eyes and hydrated skin), “SECURITY SHIELD” in the lower left (overlaying a subtle hexagonal honeycomb pattern), “PROTECT” in the lower left, and “CLEANSE” in the lower right. Some fragments incorporate beauty imagery: one shows luminous cheeks and lips, another depicts a woman's eyes with long eyelashes and water droplets on her skin, and yet another showcases a scientific honeycomb barrier pattern. Add a tall, frosted rectangular floating panel at the center above and behind the pump head to create depth. Place two iridescent glass spheres on the wet surface, one in the lower left and one in the lower right corner. Use bright, shimmering highlights, prism-like rainbow refraction, luminous contour lighting, floating mist, microparticles, and a crisp, 4K cosmetic advertising texture. The overall composition should reflect a high-end, clean, protective, and digital skincare theme, perfectly blending hydration science with digital security metaphors.

promptLocalized.zh: 一则采用冷冰蓝色调的未来感奢华护肤品广告，以高端摄影棚美妆大片风格呈现。画面中心放置一个磨砂白泵头瓶，标签为 {argument name="brand name" default="SECURE-IP"}，并印有极简主义海军蓝文字 {argument name="product name" default="IP ADDRESS CLEANSER"}，底部附近有较小的文字行：“for risk-free connections”、“pour des connexions sans risque”以及“75 ml / 2.5 fl. oz. - Data Stream Purifier”。将瓶子垂直放置在带有真实水珠的亮面湿润反射表面上，半透明圆形瓶盖位于瓶子右后方。产品周围环绕着悬浮在半空中、如碎冰般锋利的透明玻璃碎片和水晶碎块。几块较大的碎片作为标注面板：左侧 6 块文字碎片分别写着“TEXTURE”（覆盖在水润肌肤特写上）、右上角“SHIELD”、右侧“HYDRATION”（覆盖在蓝色眼睛和湿润肌肤特写上）、左下角“SECURITY SHIELD”（覆盖在微妙的六边形蜂窝图案上）、左下角“PROTECT”以及右下角“CLEANSE”。在部分碎片中融入美妆图像片段：一块碎片展示了具有光泽感的脸颊和嘴唇，一块展示了带有长睫毛和皮肤水珠的女性眼睛，另一块展示了科学的蜂窝屏障图案。在泵头后方上方中心处添加一个高大的磨砂长方形悬浮面板，以营造层次深度。在湿润表面上放置两个虹彩玻璃球，分别位于左下角和右下角。使用明亮的闪烁高光、棱镜彩虹折射、发光的轮廓光、漂浮的薄雾、微粒，以及清晰的 4K 化妆品广告质感。整体构图应体现高端、洁净、防护和网络护肤主题，将水合科学与数字安全隐喻完美融合。

templates.title: Futuristic cybersecurity skincare advertisement poster

titleLocalized.zh: 未来感网络安全护肤广告海报

templates.prompt: A luxurious, futuristic skincare product advertisement, presented in a vertical 4K poster format. At the center of the image is a suspended matte white spray bottle, placed diagonally and slightly tilted to the right. The cap is a softly cylindrical shape, and the upper part of the bottle is covered with fine condensation droplets. The label on the bottle is printed in a simple, dark blue sans-serif font with the words "..."{argument name="brand name" default="SECURE-IP"} ", printed below{argument name="product name" default="IP ADDRESS CLEANSER"} The bottle is labeled with the smaller subtitles "for risk-free connections" and "pour des connexions sans risque," along with tiny text at the bottom reading "75 mL / 2.5 fl. oz. - Data Stream Purifier." Against the bottle's background, large, semi-transparent serif fonts dominate, displaying the words "..."{argument name="headline text" default="ULTRA-SECURE"} The text, divided into two lines and partially obscured by the product, is set in a deep midnight blue environment. Glowing, semi-transparent, fabric-like liquid ribbons wrap around the bottle from the upper left to the lower right and from the foreground upwards, interspersed with two prominent glass-like tubular arcs and multiple suspended crystalline droplets or bubbles. The lighting is cool and cinematic, with a high-end, glossy finish, bright ice-blue highlights, soft glow, and refraction, presenting a pure, sophisticated beauty advertisement aesthetic. At the bottom center, elegant, well-spaced small capital letters read "..."{argument name="tagline" default="ENCRYPTED BARRIER FORMULA"} Below is a row of four ingredient descriptions, evenly distributed across the width of the image: 1) “CERAMIDE IP-07”, accompanied by the two lines of text “Strengthens” and “Lipid Defence”; 2) “SQUALANE ENCAPSULES”, accompanied by “Reinforces” and “Moisture Lock”; 3) “NIACINAMIDE 5%”, accompanied by “Calms Visible” and “Stress Signals”; 4) “HYALURONIC STACK”, accompanied by “Multi-Layer” and “Hydration Matrix”. At the very bottom center, a small shield icon and the text “DEFEND. PURIFY. PROTECT.” are added. The overall style should combine luxury skincare photography with a cybersecurity brand image, featuring exquisite commercial lighting, shallow depth of field, advanced editing and layout, and an advertising design aesthetic ready for production use.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张奢华的未来感护肤品广告，采用竖版 4K 海报格式。画面中央是一个悬浮的哑光白喷雾瓶，呈对角线放置并向右微倾，瓶盖为柔和的圆柱形，瓶身上部附有细腻的冷凝水珠。瓶身标签以简洁的深蓝色无衬线字体印有“{argument name="brand name" default="SECURE-IP"}”，下方印有“{argument name="product name" default="IP ADDRESS CLEANSER"}”，并配有较小的副标题“for risk-free connections”和“pour des connexions sans risque”，以及底部的微小文字“75 mL / 2.5 fl. oz. - Data Stream Purifier”。瓶身背景中，巨大的半透明衬线字体占据了大部分空间，显示为“{argument name="headline text" default="ULTRA-SECURE"}”，分为两行，部分被产品遮挡。环境为深午夜蓝色，发光的半透明织物状液体丝带从左上角向右下角以及从前景下方向上缠绕瓶身，并混合了 2 个显眼的玻璃质感管状弧线，以及多个悬浮的晶体状水滴或气泡。光影冷峻、具有电影质感、光泽感强且高端，带有明亮的冰蓝色高光、柔和的辉光效果、折射反射，呈现出纯净的高级美妆广告质感。底部中央，优雅且间距适中的小型大写字母文字写着“{argument name="tagline" default="ENCRYPTED BARRIER FORMULA"}”。下方是一排 4 个成分说明，均匀分布在画面宽度上：1) “CERAMIDE IP-07”，配有两行文字“Strengthens”和“Lipid Defence”；2) “SQUALANE ENCAPSULES”，配有“Reinforces”和“Moisture Lock”；3) “NIACINAMIDE 5%”，配有“Calms Visible”和“Stress Signals”；4) “HYALURONIC STACK”，配有“Multi-Layer”和“Hydration Matrix”。在最底部中央，添加一个小盾牌图标和文字“DEFEND. PURIFY. PROTECT.”。整体风格应将奢华护肤品摄影与网络安全品牌形象相结合，具备极致精美的商业布光、浅景深、高级编辑排版以及可直接用于生产的广告设计感。

templates.title: Futuristic megacity panorama at sunset

titleLocalized.zh: 日落时分的未来感超级城市全景

templates.prompt: A vast, cinematic sunset over a sci-fi megacity, viewed from a high observation deck amidst a dark, futuristic cluster of massive buildings, with a dramatic mix of orange-gold glowing sky filled with clouds and mist. The scene showcases a sprawling vertical city stretching into the distance, densely packed with countless towering, needle-like skyscrapers and glowing spires piercing the clouds. In the upper right corner, a massive, richly detailed, dark metallic floating platform city hovers above the horizon, accompanied by smaller towers and structures below. In the lower left foreground, a streamlined, futuristic spacecraft takes off from a terrace, tilted diagonally towards the center, with bright blue engine contrails and reflective metal panels. Several tiny figures stand at the edge of the terrace to emphasize the scale. Scattered across the sky are numerous small flying vehicles and hovercraft at varying distances, creating dense aerial traffic. In the distance below, the city's grid shimmers with warm lights through the atmospheric mist. Employing a grand, panoramic composition, the dark architectural framework contrasts sharply with the brilliant sunset light, showcasing intricate details of technological industry, atmospheric perspective, volumetric clouds, reflective surfaces, and a rich color palette of amber, peach, purple, deep navy, and electric blue. This ultra-refined, epic futuristic concept art features a photorealistic matte painting texture, sharp focus, grand scale, a 4:3 vertical composition, and is devoid of text or logos.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个广阔的电影级科幻超级城市日落景观，从黑暗的未来主义超大建筑群之间的高处观景台俯瞰，巨大的橙金色发光天空中充满了戏剧性的云层和薄雾。场景展示了一座向远方延伸的庞大垂直城市，密布着无数高耸入云的针状摩天大楼和穿透云层的发光建筑尖塔。右上中方是一座巨大的悬浮平台城市，呈深色金属质感且细节丰富，悬浮在天际线上方，下方附带着较小的塔楼和结构。左下角前景中，一艘流线型未来派航天器正从露台起飞，呈对角线向中心倾斜，带有明亮的蓝色引擎尾迹和反光的金属面板。露台边缘站着几个微小的人影以体现比例。天空中散布着许多不同距离的小型飞行载具和气垫船，形成了密集的空中交通。远处的下方，城市网格透过大气薄雾闪烁着温暖的灯光。采用宏大的全景构图，深色建筑框架与灿烂的日落光线形成高对比，展现复杂的科技工业细节、大气透视、体积云、反光表面，以及琥珀色、桃色、紫色、深海军蓝和电光蓝的丰富色彩组合。超精细、史诗般的未来主义概念艺术，照片级写实哑光绘画质感，焦点清晰，规模宏大，4:3 垂直构图，无文字或徽标。

templates.title: Floating futuristic city at sunset

titleLocalized.zh: 日落时分的浮空未来城市

templates.prompt: At sunset, a magnificent, cinematic sci-fi megacity floats above thick, luminous clouds, viewed from a high-altitude perspective. The image showcases a vast futuristic skyline, with dozens of elegant supertall skyscrapers and needle-like towers rising from suspended platforms, interconnected by distant structures and suspended areas. On the right side of the image, a massive floating city hub features multiple luminous glass domes and tiered circular bases, surrounded by several monumental towers, including a particularly soaring central spire with a large circular observation deck near its top. Warm golden sunlight pours down from the left horizon, creating a dramatic sky of orange, peach, and pale purple hues, accompanied by thick clouds and atmospheric haze. The lower half of the image is filled with soft pink and blue clouds reflecting the sunset's afterglow. Multiple flying vehicles are visible: a large, dark metallic spacecraft with bright blue engine contrails is in the lower left foreground; a circular landing platform-like aircraft is in the lower right foreground; two medium-sized spacecraft pass through the midground, leaving blue light trails; and numerous small, distant flying vehicles are scattered across the horizon. Add sophisticated city lighting, reflective metallic surfaces, a grand scale, a serene futuristic grandeur, and a highly detailed conceptual art style. Add white brand text in the upper right corner.{argument name="logo text" default="Pollo.ai"} As a clear overlay.

promptLocalized.zh: 日落时分，一座宏伟的电影级科幻巨型城市漂浮在浓厚且发光的云层之上，采用高空俯瞰视角。画面展现了广阔的未来城市天际线，数十座优雅的超高层摩天大楼和针状塔楼从悬浮平台上拔地而起，由远处的结构和悬浮区域相互连接。在画面中右侧，一个巨大的浮空城市枢纽拥有多个发光的玻璃穹顶和分层圆形基座，周围环绕着数座纪念碑式的塔楼，其中包括一座特别高耸的中央尖塔，顶部附近设有一个宽大的环形观景结构。温暖的金色阳光从左侧地平线倾泻而下，营造出橙色、桃色和淡紫色的戏剧性天空，伴有浓厚的云层和大气雾霾，画面下半部分充满了反射着夕阳余晖的柔和粉色和蓝色云团。可见多架飞行载具：左下角前景处有一架大型深色金属航天器，带有明亮的蓝色引擎尾迹；右下角前景处有一架圆形着陆平台式飞行器；中景处有 2 架中型飞船穿过，留下了蓝色光迹；天际线各处还散布着多个微小的远距离飞行器。增加精致的城市灯光、反光的金属表面、宏大的比例、宁静的未来主义宏伟感以及高度精细的概念艺术风格。在右上角添加白色品牌文本 {argument name="logo text" default="Pollo.ai"} 作为清晰的覆盖层。

templates.title: A cinematic heist mastermind in front of the whiteboard

titleLocalized.zh: 白板前的电影级劫案策划大师

templates.prompt: A cinematic, somber scene depicting the planning of a heist, set in a dimly lit office late at night, shot in a realistic thriller style. A grown man stands with his back to the camera, writing on a large whiteboard covered in tactical notes, architectural sketches, floor plans, arrows, routes, and hand-drawn diagrams. He has dark curly hair and wears a dark olive or charcoal gray casual jacket paired with dark trousers, projecting the image of a master planner. The whiteboard is the visual focal point, containing several readable planning areas: the top left corner is titled "OPERATION NIGHTHAWK"; the left sidebar is divided into three sections, labeled "OBJECTIVE," "TARGET," and "TIMELINE"; the top right corner has two labeled chart areas, "ENTRY PLAN" and "CAMERA NETWORK"; the lower right center has four labeled planning blocks, "TRANSIT," "EQUIPMENT," "HOTEL ROUTE," and "CONTINGENCIES." It includes architectural facade sketches, rooftop access diagrams, loading/unloading area notes, room labels, arrows drawn in black and red markers, and a sketch of a small van near the center at the bottom. The room is warmly lit with deep shadows and amber-colored practical lighting. A desk lamp illuminates a dark wooden desk cluttered with documents on the left, and three black-and-white photographs hang vertically on the wall. The composition is a mid-to-long-range over-the-shoulder shot, with the man positioned slightly to the left center of the frame, and a whiteboard dominating the background. High contrast, a soft cinematic grain, a tense atmosphere, and a realistic texture create an aesthetic reminiscent of a mastermind planning a heist—a refined crime drama aesthetic—but it doesn't depict any specific copyrighted characters. A white "Pollo.ai" watermark is added to the upper right corner.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅电影感十足、氛围阴郁的劫案策划场景，背景为深夜昏暗的办公室，采用写实的惊悚片风格拍摄。一名成年男子背对镜头，侧身站立，正在一块巨大的白板上书写，白板写满了战术笔记、建筑草图、平面图、箭头、路线和手绘图表。他留着深色卷发，身穿深橄榄色或炭灰色休闲夹克，搭配深色长裤，展现出策划大师的形象。白板是视觉焦点，包含多个可读的规划区域：左上角标题写着“OPERATION NIGHTHAWK”；左侧栏分为 3 个部分，分别标注为“OBJECTIVE”（目标）、“TARGET”（目标对象）和“TIMELINE”（时间线）；右上角有 2 个标注的图表区域，分别为“ENTRY PLAN”（进入计划）和“CAMERA NETWORK”（监控网络）；中右下方有 4 个标注的规划区块，分别为“TRANSIT”（交通）、“EQUIPMENT”（装备）、“HOTEL ROUTE”（酒店路线）和“CONTINGENCIES”（应急预案）。包含建筑立面草图、屋顶通道图、装卸区笔记、房间标签、黑色和红色记号笔绘制的箭头，以及下方中心附近的一辆小型货车草图。房间光线温暖且阴影重重，带有琥珀色的实用照明。画面左侧展示了一盏台灯，照亮了摆满散乱文件的深色木质书桌，墙上垂直悬挂着 3 张黑白照片。构图为中远景过肩镜头，男子位于画面偏左中心，白板占据背景主导地位。高对比度，柔和的电影颗粒感，紧张的氛围，写实的质感，呈现出类似于天才策划者准备劫案的精品犯罪剧美学，但不描绘任何特定的受版权保护的角色。在右上角添加白色的“Pollo.ai”水印。

templates.title: Summer Menswear Lookbook Grid

titleLocalized.zh: 夏季男装 Lookbook 网格图

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference images as the basis for the figures and bodies, a minimalist men's summer fashion lookbook was created against a clean, warm beige studio background. While maintaining the subjects' recognizability, faces in each look were blurred, and eight full-body outfit variations were generated, arranged in a 4x2 editable grid. "Handwritten" stylist notes with arrows were added, highlighting key clothing items for each outfit. First row, Outfit 1: Beige knit polo shirt, navy custom shorts, white leather sneakers. First row, Outfit 2: Sage green linen shirt, white linen shorts, brown leather sandals, sunglasses hanging from the shirt. First row, Outfit 3: Off-white ribbed vest, brown pleated trousers, white canvas sneakers, beige canvas tote bag slung over one shoulder. First row, Outfit 4: Light-colored Cuban collar printed shirt, light blue denim shorts, tan suede loafers. Look 5 in the second row: A white printed T-shirt with green "WELLNESS CLUB" lettering, dark green athletic shorts, white running shoes, white mid-calf socks, a light-colored baseball cap, and a canvas tote bag. Look 6 in the second row: A navy blue short-sleeved shirt worn open over a white tank top, beige casual twill trousers, and dark brown boat shoes. Look 7 in the second row: A beige textured knit short-sleeved shirt, light-wash jeans, tan Wallabees shoes, and a light-colored baseball cap. Look 8 in the second row: A black fitted T-shirt, white linen drawstring trousers, black slippers, and a black crossbody bag. This creates a sophisticated fashion guide effect, with realistic proportions, soft and even lighting, minimalist shadows, and elegant handwritten annotations next to each character.

promptLocalized.zh:

第一行造型 1：米色针织 Polo 衫、海军蓝定制短裤、白色皮革运动鞋。
第一行造型 2：鼠尾草绿亚麻衬衫、白色亚麻短裤、棕色皮革凉鞋，衬衫上挂着太阳镜。
第一行造型 3：米白色罗纹背心、棕色百褶长裤、白色帆布运动鞋，单肩背着米色帆布托特包。
第一行造型 4：浅色古巴领印花衬衫、浅蓝色牛仔短裤、棕褐色麂皮乐福鞋。
第二行造型 5：带有绿色“WELLNESS CLUB”字样的白色印花 T 恤、深绿色运动短裤、白色跑步鞋、白色中筒袜、浅色棒球帽、帆布托特包。
第二行造型 6：海军蓝短袖外搭衬衫（敞开穿着，内搭白色背心）、米色休闲斜纹棉布裤、深棕色船鞋。
第二行造型 7：米色纹理针织短袖衬衫、浅水洗牛仔裤、棕褐色 Wallabees 鞋、浅色棒球帽。
第二行造型 8：黑色修身 T 恤、白色亚麻抽绳长裤、黑色拖鞋、黑色斜挎包。

使其呈现出精致的时尚造型指南效果，具备逼真的比例、柔和均匀的灯光、极简的阴影，并在每个人物旁添加优雅的手写注释。

templates.title: A team of red-clad robbers with a cinematic feel inside the bank

titleLocalized.zh: 银行内电影质感的红色劫匪团队

templates.prompt: Inspired by Spanish crime thrillers, this cinematic and raw portrait of a gang of robbers accurately depicts five men standing side-by-side inside a grand historic bank. The scene employs a symmetrical composition, shot from a low-angle, medium-length full-body shot, with the tallest figure, the leader, in the center, flanked by two teammates on each side. All five are dressed in matching deep red hooded jumpsuits, zipped up, with black straps and backpack straps, and their hoods pulled up, creating a menacing and anonymous image. The robbers on the far left and far right have their arms crossed; the second from the left and second from the right have their arms hanging naturally; the robber in the middle faces the camera directly, hands down, exuding a powerful presence. Their faces are deliberately obscured, hidden in shadows and blurring under their hoods, making them unrecognizable. The background is the opulent old bank lobby, complete with dark polished wood, brass safes lining the walls, ornate columns, balcony railings, classical architectural details, and warm spherical lamps. Bright golden overhead light cascades down from the ceiling behind the team, creating dramatic backlighting, rim lighting on the red suits, long shadows, and a tense, high-contrast atmosphere. Color palette: deep red, black, dark brown, brass, and warm gold. Style: hyper-realistic cinematography, suspenseful crime drama poster aesthetics, highly detailed fabric textures, emotional lighting, symmetrical composition, a light haze in the background, and a clear focus on the team. Add a white [image/feature] in the upper right corner.{argument name="watermark text" default="Pollo.ai"} Logo.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张受西班牙犯罪惊悚片启发、具有电影质感且粗粝的劫匪团队群像，画面中准确展示了 5 名劫匪并肩站在宏伟的历史银行内部。场景采用对称构图，通过低角度中景全身镜头拍摄，最高大的人物作为首领居中，两侧各站 2 名队友。5 人均穿着统一的深红色连体连帽衫，前襟拉链拉上，佩戴黑色绑带和背包背带，兜帽戴起，营造出一种充满威胁感的匿名形象。最左侧和最右侧的劫匪双臂交叉；左二和右二的劫匪双臂自然下垂；中间的劫匪正对镜头，双手下垂，姿态强势。他们的面部被刻意遮挡，隐藏在兜帽下的阴影和模糊中，无法辨认。背景是富丽堂皇的旧银行大厅，配有深色抛光木材、沿两侧墙壁排列的黄铜保险箱、华丽的圆柱、阳台栏杆、古典建筑细节以及温暖的球形灯。明亮的金色顶光从团队后方的天花板倾泻而下，营造出戏剧性的逆光效果、红色套装上的轮廓光、长长的阴影以及紧张的高对比度氛围。调色板：深红色、黑色、深棕色、黄铜色和暖金色。风格：超写实电影摄影、悬疑犯罪剧海报美学、高度精细的织物纹理、情绪化布光、对称构图、背景中带有浅薄的雾气，团队焦点清晰。在右上角添加一个白色的 {argument name="watermark text" default="Pollo.ai"} 标志。

templates.title: Pseudo-pixelated crows in the wheat field

titleLocalized.zh: 麦田里的伪像素乌鸦

templates.prompt: A stylized pseudo-pixel art landscape illustration depicting a{argument name="bird species" default="Black Crow"} Standing sideways in a golden wheat field, facing right. When viewed at a reduced scale, the image should initially resemble retro pixel art, but not a completely grid-aligned or pure pixel art based on sprites; instead, it should have a painterly quality that mimics pixel art, with blocky shapes and edges with a soft, irregular feel. Position the bird large, slightly to the left of the foreground, its glossy, near-black feathers tinged with deep navy and indigo, its beak dark, revealing a small amber-brown eye. Surrounded by tall, golden grasses, nine clearly visible purple wildflowers are scattered in the foreground. In the midground, a vast rural plain is shown, with scattered fields and deep green woods, including several tall, narrow conifers on the right. In the distance, add a low mountain range in soft blue-purple tones. Above, create a bright {argument name="sky color" default="Soft blue"} The sky, filled with large cumulus clouds and a few smaller cloud bands, is presented entirely as a limited palette of shimmering blocks of color. Warm evening hues, including gold, blue, lavender, and deep charcoal, create a strong sense of spatial depth and a tranquil, pastoral atmosphere. The full-frame composition, horizontal layout, and thin black borders around the entire image, with sharp, blocky edges, evoke a retro gaming aesthetic. Highly detailed yet simple, it contains no text, no UI, and no other animals.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅风格化的伪像素艺术风景插画，描绘了一只 {argument name="bird species" default="黑乌鸦"} 侧身站在金色的麦田中，面向右侧。当缩小查看时，图像应乍看像复古像素艺术，但并非完全网格对齐或基于精灵图的纯正像素艺术；相反，它应呈现出一种模仿像素艺术的绘画感，块状形状和边缘带有柔和的不规则感。将鸟置于前景偏左的大位置，其光泽的近黑色羽毛带有深海军蓝和靛蓝色的阴影，喙部呈深色，露出一只琥珀棕色的小眼睛。周围环绕着高大的金黄色草丛，前景中散布着 9 朵清晰可见的紫色小野花。在中景处，展示一片广阔的乡村平原，有零星的田地和深绿色的树林，右侧包括几棵高而窄的针叶树。在远处，添加一道柔和蓝紫色调的低矮山脉。上方，创作一片明亮的 {argument name="sky color" default="柔和蓝色"} 天空，布满大块的积云和几条较小的云带，全部以有限色彩的抖动块呈现。使用温暖的傍晚色调，包括金色、蓝色、薰衣草色和深炭色，具有强烈的空间深度感和宁静的田园氛围。全画幅构图，横向布局，整个图像周围有细黑边框，边缘清晰且呈块状，复古游戏背景美学，高度细节化但简洁，无文字，无 UI，无其他动物。

templates.title: Pseudo-pixel art mesh magnification analysis

titleLocalized.zh: 伪像素艺术网格放大分析

templates.prompt: A closely magnified comparison image showcases the rendering effect of pseudo-pixel art. The image presents a magnified view of a low-resolution scene, overlaid with a fine, bright blue square grid across the entire frame. The composition is an abstract close-up of a pixel art-style environment: sandy brown and ochre blocks on the left and center, stepped diagonal blocks in deep navy blue and black on the right, and soft olive green and slate blue shapes above the background, accented with a few brighter gold highlights. At first glance, each edge appears stepped and blocky, but the colors soften and blend within the obvious squares rather than perfectly aligning with the grid, creating a pixel art illusion that doesn't stand up to close scrutiny. A small white crosshair cursor is included near the upper left quadrant, hinting at the image analysis process in the editor. The overall look resembles a screenshot from a graphics program or social media demo, intended to illustrate how AI can mimic the aesthetics of retro game art when it cannot generate truly grid-perfect pixel art; no visible text labels should be included in the image.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张经过紧密放大的对比图像，展示了伪像素艺术的渲染效果。画面呈现了一个低分辨率场景的放大视图，并在整个帧上叠加了细细的亮蓝色方形网格。构图是像素艺术风格环境的抽象局部特写：左侧和中心为沙褐色和赭色的块状形态，右侧为深海军蓝和黑色的阶梯状对角线块，背景上方为柔和的橄榄绿和板岩蓝形状，并点缀着少量较亮的金色高光。乍看之下，每个边缘都呈阶梯状且具有块状感，但颜色在明显的方格内呈现出柔和的模糊与融合，而非与网格完美对齐，从而营造出一种经不起仔细推敲的像素艺术假象。在左上象限附近包含一个小型的白色十字准星光标，以暗示编辑器中的图像分析过程。整体观感应类似于图形程序或社交媒体演示的截图，旨在说明 AI 如何在无法生成真正网格完美的像素艺术的情况下，模仿复古游戏艺术的美学，画面中不应包含任何可见的文字标签。

templates.title: Empty City Strategy

titleLocalized.zh: 空城计

templates.prompt: A cinematic scene from Chinese history depicts the "Empty City Stratagem" at dawn, viewed from outside a massive ancient city gate. In the foreground, a general in dark armor, clad in a black cloak, rides on horseback, his back to the viewer. He, along with several spear-wielding soldiers and a flag bearer, halts, gazing suspiciously at the open gate. The massive wooden gate is wide open, revealing a long, stone-paved street within the city. Six civilians are clearly visible, calmly sweeping the ground, their presence along the street creating an eerie tranquility. Above the gate, on a wooden terrace of a traditional tiled-roof tower, a strategist in a white robe and tall crown sits calmly behind a zither table, incense smoke rising from a burner. Three attendants surround him on the terrace. The city walls are constructed of ancient gray stone, and in the background, soldiers holding spears line the battlements. It employs authentic architectural styles from the Three Kingdoms period, weathered wood, layered tiles, soft earth tones, the warm golden light of dawn, distant hazy mountains, long shadows, atmospheric fog, ultra-fine textures, highly dramatic vertical compositions, an epic sense of historical realism, cinematic framing, and a tense yet tranquil atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅极具电影感的中国历史场景，描绘了黎明时分的“空城计”，视角从巨大的古代城门外望去。前景中，一位身披黑色斗篷的暗甲将军骑在马上，背影示人，他与几名持矛士兵及旗手停下脚步，疑虑地注视着敞开的城门。巨大的木质城门大开，露出城内长长的石板街道。城内清晰可见 6 名平民，他们正从容地扫着地，沿街道分布，营造出一种诡异的平静感。城门上方，在传统瓦顶城楼的木质露台上，一位身着白袍、头戴高冠的谋士正从容地坐在古琴桌后，桌上香炉升起缕缕青烟。露台上还有 3 名侍从环绕在他身边。城墙由古老的灰石砌成，背景中的城垛上排列着手持长矛的士兵。采用真实的三国时代建筑风格、风化的木材、层叠的瓦片、柔和的大地色调、清晨的金色暖光、远处的朦胧山峦、长长的阴影、大气层雾气、超精细纹理、极具戏剧性的纵向构图、史诗般的历史写实感、电影级取景，以及紧张而静谧的氛围。

The peach blossoms overhead form a tunnel of flowers, while in the background, rustic wooden fences and traditional buildings are faintly visible through the spring mist. templates.title: Night Battle of Red Cliffs

titleLocalized.zh: 赤壁之战夜战

templates.prompt: A grand, cinematic historical painting depicts the night of the Battle of Red Cliffs, showcasing the entire ancient Chinese river fleet engulfed in flames. The composition employs a soaring vertical format, viewed from the side of a slightly elevated dock, with the river stretching into the distance towards the center, its surface teeming with burning warships. The lower left corner and central foreground must precisely include three prominent foreground raft-like platforms or deck structures, all made of rough wood and surrounded by flames, with soldiers standing shoulder to shoulder, surrounded by war drums, flagpoles, and red battle flags. The lower right foreground must precisely include two mounted commanders galloping towards the viewer along a wooden dock or bridge: the first rider, clearly visible, wears dark lamellar armor and a deep red cloak billowing in the wind, shouting urgently; the second rider beside him is in shadow and partially obscured. In the mid-ground, dozens of ancient Chinese sailing warships and smaller vessels, many ablaze, showcase traditional hard sails, wooden hulls, siege tower-like superstructures, and collapsed masts. The distant shoreline merges with the fleet into a sea of ​​fire, towering orange flames and dark red smoke filling the sky, countless sparks and ash drifting in the air. The water reflects the lava-like orange glow of the fire, black shadows intertwining between the ships. The scene should be filled with dense details of soldiers, rigging, flags, war drums, weapons, and chaotic battlefield, but the overall visual focus should remain on the fiery river. A deep, dramatic palette of black, ember red, burnt orange, and bronze is employed to create strong, high-contrast firelight, voluminous smoke, an epic scale, ultra-fine textures, dynamism, and the grandeur of a legendary Three Kingdoms scene. The aesthetics of ancient Chinese warfare are depicted in a cold, heroic, catastrophic, and realistic style, devoid of modern elements and text.

templates.title: Borrowing Arrows with Straw Boats

titleLocalized.zh: 草船借箭

templates.prompt: A cinematic historical war scene from the novel *Romance of the Three Kingdoms* depicts the "borrowing arrows with straw boats" maneuver on a wide, gloomy river amidst a raging storm, from a slightly overhead, forward-looking perspective. In the foreground, six long, narrow wooden boats are linked end to end, each tightly wrapped in thick bundles of straw on its sides and bow, forming a rough defensive wall. Hundreds of black-feathered arrows are densely packed into the straw armor, extending in all directions, with more arrows flying diagonally through the storm. The lead boat occupies the center of the image; its cabin is covered with dark blue curtains and a blue ceiling. Inside the foreboard cabin, two ancient Chinese strategists stand calmly, one in a light white robe holding a feather fan, accompanied by a companion in a dark robe. The two appear composed amidst the chaos. To the left of the boat, oarsmen and soldiers in dark ancient costumes are gathered, and several large war drums are visible on the deck. In the background, a massive enemy fleet, shrouded in mist, stretches across the river: dozens of tall wooden warships, watchtowers, and platforms are crammed with soldiers and archers. Multiple military flags bearing the enormous character "Cao" flutter above the fleet, symbolizing Cao Cao's army. The overall atmosphere is austere, low-saturation, and grand, accompanied by dense fog, smoke, rain, surging river water, low-contrast blue-gray tones, and highly detailed and realistic depictions of wet wood, straw, fabrics, and the mist on the river surface. A highly detailed and realistic depiction of an ancient Chinese battlefield, grand in scale, with a somber sense of historical authenticity, presented in a vertical composition.

The main subject is a highly detailed anime mecha high school girl figure, positioned on the left side of the image in a dynamic pose, legs wide open in a battle stance. One mechanical hand holds a katana across the frame, while the other hand makes a peace sign near her face. The character's face is blurred, and she has a messy, dark navy blue bob with a few tufts of hair on the side, adorned with a gold, horn-shaped mechanical hair accessory. Her outfit blends Japanese sailor uniform with hard-surface sci-fi armor: a white armored torso with mechanical panel lines, a red sailor collar, a pleated navy blue skirt, heavy white thigh and calf armor, red and blue accents, gold circular joint details, a dark blue belt or hem fabric, and red mechanical backpack-style attachments at the hips and lower back. The katana features a dark blade and a blue and gold hilt. Render the figure to resemble a professionally photographed collector's item or plastic model kit, with clear material definitions, realistic injection-molded plastic surfaces, a subtle satin sheen, and commercial product photography lighting. Design the page as a figure advertisement/specification, with one large main visual and five smaller detail panels stacked vertically on the right. The five right-side panels must showcase: 1) a close-up of the head and hair accessories, 2) upper body details with a sailor's collar and chest armor, 3) close-ups of the weapons and articulated hands (sword close to the face), 4) waist accessories and skirt/hip armor details, and 5) leg details showing the joints and armor structure. Add thin blue dividing trim around the right-side panel area. Place a striking bold serif-style Japanese title "女子甲生" (Women's Kousei) in the upper left corner, with the central character in dark red and the rest in dark navy blue. Below this, add a smaller Japanese subtitle: "— Meka × Shoujo × Seishun—". Place a simple logo and brand name in the upper right corner.{argument name="brand name" default="TENNEN"} Below this is a small Japanese text tag. A vertical Japanese slogan block is added to the left of the main visual, reading "Sparkling steel, the will of a maiden." The phrase in the middle is in red. Below the five detail panels on the right are Japanese descriptions: "Expression Design," "Upper Body Design," "Armed/Movable Hands," "Waist Attack," and "Leg Design." A framed proportion label is included in the lower left corner.{argument name="scale label" default="1/12 SCALE"} Add the English product text "FULL ACTION PLASTIC MODEL KIT" nearby. Below this, add two lines of Japanese text: "◆ 塗装済み髪パーツ付属" and "◆ マーキングデカール付属". At the bottom, add a dark navy blue footer, centered with the brand logo and "".{argument name="footer brand" default="TENNEN"} Below this is a small Japanese text tag. It employs sophisticated modern model brand aesthetics, Japanese mecha anime collectible packaging design, minimalist white space, clear typography, balanced editorial layout, and realistic studio rendering of the original, non-existent figure. Color scheme: white, navy blue, dark blue, red, gray, black, and metallic gold. Aspect ratio 3:4.

promptLocalized.zh:
在干净的白色摄影棚背景下，创作一张高级日系塑料模型套件产品海报，背景带有微妙的灰色渐变和光亮的地面反射。主体是一个高度精细的动漫机甲女高中生手办，位于画面中左侧，呈动态姿势，双腿大开呈战斗站姿，一只机械手握住武士刀横跨画面，另一只手在脸部附近比出剪刀手。角色面部区域模糊，留着凌乱的深海军蓝短波波头，带有小撮侧发，并佩戴金色的角状机械发饰。她的服装融合了日式水手服与硬表面科幻装甲：白色装甲躯干带有机械刻线，红色水手领巾，百褶海军蓝短裙，厚重的白色大腿和小腿装甲，红蓝配色点缀，金色圆形关节细节，深蓝色腰带或后摆布料，以及臀部和后腰处红色的机械背包式附件。武士刀配有深色刀刃和蓝金相间的刀柄。将该手办渲染成专业拍摄的收藏级模型或塑料拼装套件，具有清晰的材质定义、逼真的注塑塑料表面、轻微的丝缎光泽以及商业产品摄影灯光。

将页面设计为手办广告/规格说明书，右侧垂直堆叠 1 个大型主视觉图和 5 个较小的细节面板。右侧的 5 个面板必须展示：1) 头部和发饰特写，2) 带有水手领巾和胸部装甲的上半身细节，3) 武器和带有可动关节的手部特写（剑靠近脸部），4) 腰部附件和裙子/臀部装甲细节，5) 展示关节和装甲结构的腿部细节。在右侧面板区域周围加入细蓝色的分隔装饰。

在左上角放置一个醒目的粗体衬线风格日文标题“女子甲生”，其中中间的字符为深红色，其余为深海军蓝色。在其下方添加一行较小的日文副标题：“— メカ × 少女 × 青春 —”。在右上角放置一个简洁的标志和品牌名称“{argument name="brand name" default="TENNEN"}”，下方配以小型日文文本。在主视觉形象的左侧添加一个垂直的日文标语块，内容为“鋼に咲く、乙女の意志。”，中间短语为红色。在右侧 5 个细节面板下方分别添加日文说明：“表情造形”、“上半身ディテール”、“武装・可動手”、“腰部アタッチメント”、“脚部ディテール”。在左下角包含一个带框的比例标签“{argument name="scale label" default="1/12 SCALE"}”，并在附近添加英文产品文本“FULL ACTION PLASTIC MODEL KIT”。在下方添加两行日文要点：“◆ 塗装済み髪パーツ付属”和“◆ マーキングデカール付属”。在底部添加一个深海军蓝色的页脚栏，居中放置品牌标志和“{argument name="footer brand" default="TENNEN"}”，下方配以小型日文文本。

采用精致的现代模型品牌美学、日系机甲少女收藏品包装设计、极简的白色留白、清晰的排版、平衡的编辑布局，以及对不存在的原创手办进行逼真的摄影棚渲染。配色方案：白色、海军蓝、深蓝、红色、灰色、黑色和金属金。长宽比 3:4。
