templates.title: Samurai Mecha Girl Figure Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 武士机甲少女手办海报

templates.prompt: Create a high-end Japanese-style figure advertising poster against a clean, off-white background, with subtle light gray brushstroke textures and scattered small gold leaf accents. The layout should resemble a high-end product introduction page for original anime/mecha statues. The center of the image should feature a highly detailed 1/7 scale figure.{argument name="character name" default="Samurai Mecha Girl"} A slender anime girl is in a dramatic crouching attack stance, her body turned sideways to the viewer, one knee bent beneath her, the other mechanical leg extended forward. She holds her katana high above her head, as if about to launch an attack. Her face is deliberately obscured by a soft, square blur. She has long, messy brown hair, adorned with a white headband featuring small mechanical side ornaments, and wears a naval-style Japanese sailor uniform, including a short-sleeved blouse, a red scarf, and a short pleated skirt that exposes her waist. Her limbs are largely mechanical: metallic silver-gray mechanical arms with clearly visible finger joints; heavy armored thighs and calves with realistic pistons, seams, weathering effects, and small orange warning signs. The katana in her hands is polished, featuring a black and white intertwined hilt and metal guard. The statue is rendered as a realistic collectible with studio lighting, contrasting glossy and matte materials, precise shadows, and showroom-quality photographic effects. The page is designed like a commercial figurine brochure, featuring five numbered, detailed areas. On the left, four rectangular close-up panels are stacked vertically, each with a number, a Japanese label, and a brief Japanese description: Panel 1 shows a close-up of the face and hair, labeled "01 Expression"; Panel 2 shows the upper body and uniform, labeled "02 Upper Body"; Panel 3 shows the raised mechanical arm and sword-wielding pose, labeled "03 Mecha Arm & Sword"; Panel 4 shows the mechanical legs, labeled "04 Mecha Leg". In the bottom right corner, a wider rectangular panel, labeled "05 Armed Discreet," is added, horizontally displaying two close-up views of samurai swords, stacked vertically. All panel images should have subtle borders and blend into the overall poster layout. A large, expressive calligraphic title is placed in the top left corner.{argument name="main title" default="Samurai Mecha Girl"} The first word is followed by a watercolor-style circle pattern. Add a minimalist gold logo and the brand name in the upper right corner.{argument name="brand name" default="TENNEN"} Below this is a brief Japanese slogan. An elegant, dark-colored Japanese promotional slogan is placed on the right. In the lower left area, there is a brief Japanese product specification text, strictly adhering to the following product information format: scale, product name, prototype maker, painter, brand, and release date. The scheduling area uses {argument name="release date" default="December 2025"} Add a dark horizontal footer at the bottom, with a gold brand logo on the left, repeating the brand name, a brief Japanese brand statement in the middle, and a tiny legal/disclaimer text on the far right. Overall style: High-end Japanese figurine marketing page, exquisite editing and layout, realistic collector-grade statue photography, elegant platinum packaging aesthetics, a fusion of anime girls and hardcore mecha design, refined and high-end.

promptLocalized.zh:
在干净的米白色背景上创作一张高端日式手办广告海报，背景带有微妙的浅灰色笔触纹理和零星的细小金箔点缀。排版应呈现出原创动漫/机甲雕像的高端兴趣产品介绍页风格。画面中心是一个高度精细的 1/7 比例风格手办 {argument name="character name" default="Samurai Mecha Girl"}，一位身材苗条的动漫少女正处于戏剧性的蹲姿攻击状态，身体侧向观众，一膝弯曲在身下，另一条机械腿向前跨出。她双手将武士刀高举过头顶，仿佛即将发动攻击。她的面部被一个柔和的方形模糊块刻意遮挡。她留着棕色长发，发丝凌乱飞舞，佩戴着带有小型机械侧饰的白色发带，身穿海军风日本水手校服，包括短款长袖上衣、红色领巾、短百褶裙，并露出腰部。她的四肢大部分为机械结构：金属银灰色机械手臂，手指关节清晰可见；厚重的装甲机甲大腿和小腿，带有逼真的活塞、接缝、风化效果和细小的橙色警示标志。手中的武士刀经过抛光处理，配有黑白缠绕的刀柄和金属刀镡。将雕像渲染为具有摄影棚灯光、亮面与哑光材质对比、精确阴影以及展厅级产品摄影效果的逼真涂装收藏品。

将页面设计成商业手办宣传册，包含 5 个带编号的细节标注区域。在左侧垂直堆叠 4 个长方形特写面板，每个面板配有编号、日文标签以及简短的日文描述文本：面板 1 展示面部和头发特写，标注为“01 表情”；面板 2 展示上半身和制服，标注为“02 上半身”；面板 3 展示抬起的机械手臂和握剑姿态，标注为“03 メカアーム&ソード”；面板 4 展示机械腿部，标注为“04 メカレッグ”。在右下角，添加一个更宽的长方形面板，标注为“05 武装・ディテール”，水平排列展示 2 个武士刀特写视图，上下叠放。所有面板图像均需带有轻微边框，并融入海报整体布局中。

在左上角放置一个富有表现力的书法大标题 {argument name="main title" default="Samurai Mecha Girl"}，第一个词后方带有水墨圆圈图案。在右上角添加一个金色极简 Logo 和品牌名称 {argument name="brand name" default="TENNEN"}，下方配有简短的日文标语。在右侧放置一条优雅的深色日文宣传口号。在左下角区域，包含简短的日文产品规格文本，严格按照以下产品信息样式：比例、产品名称、原型师、涂装师、品牌以及发布日期行。在排期区域使用 {argument name="release date" default="2025年12月"}。在底部添加一个深色水平页脚栏，左侧放置金色品牌 Logo，重复品牌名称，中间放置简短的日文品牌声明，最右侧放置极小的法律/免责声明文本。整体风格：高端日式手办营销页，精致的编辑排版，逼真的收藏级雕像摄影，优雅的白金包装美学，动漫少女与硬核机甲设计的融合，精致且高端。

templates.title: Juventus Yamal transfer poster

templates.prompt: Create a highly impactful vertical football poster, featuring [the main character].{argument name="player name" default="Yamal"} Adopting the style of Juventus' official transfer announcement, the graphic boasts ultra-high detail and contrast, with a black and white color scheme accented by metallic gold, presenting a rugged yet sophisticated sports graphic design. The composition includes two portraits of the same young male football player with dark brown skin and short curly hair: the upper one is a large, half-body portrait from the side and rear, occupying the upper half, wearing a shirt printed with {argument name="jersey name" default="YAMAL"} Wearing a glossy white Juventus jersey with the lettering, the head is slightly turned to the left, revealing part of the ear and cheek; the lower center shows a full-body pose with arms outstretched, running or celebrating, wearing a modern Juventus home jersey with black and white vertical stripes, and white shorts with the number printed on them.{argument name="squad number" default="19"} White socks, light-colored sneakers with subtle pink accents on the soles. The facial area remains softly blurred, without detailed treatment. The background uses dark tones, overlaid with architectural images of Turin, including three landmark elements: a domed historical building faintly visible in the midground on the left, a tower resembling the Mole Antonelliana in the lower right, and a shadowed stadium structure spanning the lower center. Three Juventus logos are added: a small white logo in the upper left, a large semi-transparent logo in the background in the upper right, and a medium-sized white logo in the lower right. Striking typographic and editorial layout elements are added: words.{argument name="main vertical text" default="YAMAL"} The large, compressed white sans-serif font is vertically arranged on the left, next to smaller vertical gold text reading "JUVENTUS FOOTBALL CLUB," and gold text is on the right.{argument name="side name text" default="YAMAL"} Above the large gold number "19," below it is a gold signature graffiti, with the stacked gold slogan "FINO ALLA FINE" in the lower left corner, and below that, the smaller white text "JUVENTUS." The coordinates in the lower left corner are "45.0703° N, 7.6869° E" and "TORINO, ITALIA." The jersey for the action figure should include clear sponsor and badge details: the Juventus crest with three stars, the Adidas logo, the Jeep sponsorship, a circular tricolor badge on the chest, and a black armband with "azimut" printed on the cuffs. Add vibrant white paint stripes and brushstrokes to three main areas: the upper right corner, the lower part near the kicking leg, and subtle scratches on the left edge. Include marble-textured black panels, gold star embellishments, subtle V-shaped patterns, and a smoky atmosphere. The lighting should have a cinematic quality, with players outlined in light, and the jersey fabric having a glossy finish and strong contrast, creating a sophisticated transfer poster aesthetic suitable for social media football announcements.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张极具张力的竖版足球海报，主角为 {argument name="player name" default="Yamal"}，采用尤文图斯转会官宣风格，超高细节，高对比度，黑白配色搭配金属金色点缀，呈现粗犷的高级体育图形设计感。构图包含 2 个同一位深褐色皮肤、短卷发年轻男足球员的肖像：上方为半身侧后方大肖像，占据上半部分，身穿印有 {argument name="jersey name" default="YAMAL"} 字样的亮面白色尤文图斯球衣，头部微向左转，露出部分耳朵和脸颊；下方中央为全身动作姿态，双臂张开奔跑或庆祝，身穿现代尤文图斯主场黑白竖条纹球衣，白色短裤印有号码 {argument name="squad number" default="19"}，白色球袜，浅色球鞋鞋底带有微妙的粉色点缀。面部区域保持柔和模糊，不作细节处理。背景采用深色调，叠加都灵的建筑影像，包含 3 个地标元素：左侧中景处隐约可见的圆顶历史建筑，右下方类似安托内利尖塔（Mole Antonelliana）的高塔，以及横跨中下方的阴影体育场结构。添加 3 个尤文图斯标志：左上角一个小白色标志，右上角背景中一个巨大的半透明标志，右下角一个中等大小的白色标志。加入醒目的排版和编辑布局元素：单词 {argument name="main vertical text" default="YAMAL"} 以巨大的白色压缩无衬线字体垂直排列在左侧，旁边是小号垂直金色文字“JUVENTUS FOOTBALL CLUB”，右侧金色文字 {argument name="side name text" default="YAMAL"} 位于大号金色数字“19”上方，下方带有金色签名涂鸦，左下角堆叠金色口号“FINO ALLA FINE”，下方有小号白色文字“JUVENTUS”，左下角坐标文字为“45.0703° N, 7.6869° E”和“TORINO, ITALIA”。动作人物的球衣应包含清晰的赞助商和徽章细节：带有 3 颗星的尤文图斯队徽、Adidas 标志、Jeep 赞助商、胸前的圆形三色徽章，以及袖口印有“azimut”的黑色臂章。在 3 个主要区域添加充满活力的白色油漆条纹和笔触：右上角、下部靠近踢球腿的位置，以及左侧边缘的细微划痕。包含大理石质感的黑色面板、金色星星装饰、淡淡的 V 字纹和烟雾氛围。灯光应呈现电影质感，球员带有轮廓光，球衣面料具有光泽感，对比强烈，打造出适合社交媒体足球官宣的高级转会海报美学。

templates.prompt: A highly dramatic vertical football transfer announcement poster, featuring {argument name="player name" default="Kylian Mbappé"} The design employs a high-end sports social media graphic style. The composition includes two perspectives of the same player: a large half-body silhouette in the upper right corner of the background shows the back of the black and red striped AC Milan jersey, with the player's name and the prominent number 10 printed on the shoulder; the foreground depicts a full-body pose, with the player running towards the audience, one hand raised and index finger pointing upwards. The player is a young, strong-looking Black male athlete with short hair. He wears a modern AC Milan home jersey: a black and red striped shirt, black shorts with the number 10 printed on them, black socks, and dark football boots, clearly showing the Puma logo, the AC Milan crest, and the sponsor's text "Emirates Fly Better" on the chest. The color scheme uses black, deep red, and dark red, creating a strong contrast and a smoky atmosphere, with glowing red mist, scattered sparks, subtle scratches, and cinematic rim lighting near the ground. The background features three main graphic elements: on the left, a silhouette of the red Gothic Milan Cathedral (Duomo di Milano); on the right, a large, glowing circular AC Milan crest with a running figure and a huge, semi-transparent number "10" behind him. The layout is integrated into the poster: "AC MILAN" in the upper left corner, with "1899" and a small crest below; in the center on the left, the name is written in small print above, and the surname "MBAPPÉ" in large, high-serif font below, with a red handwritten signature-style graffiti below; the vertical slogan "SEMPRE SEMPRE MILAN" is placed along the upper right edge. promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的竖版足球转会官宣海报，主角为 {argument name="player name" default="Kylian Mbappé"}，采用高端体育社交媒体图形设计风格。构图包含同一球员的两个视角：背景右上角是一个巨大的背影半身像，展示了黑红条纹 AC Milan 球衣的背面，肩部印有名字及醒目的 10 号数字；前景是一个全身动作姿态，球员正向观众奔跑，单手举起并食指向上。球员为一名年轻的黑人男性运动员，留着短发，体格强壮。他身穿现代 AC Milan 主场球衣：黑红竖条纹上衣、印有 10 号的黑色短裤、黑色球袜、深色足球鞋，清晰可见 Puma 标志、AC Milan 队徽以及胸前赞助商文字“Emirates Fly Better”。色调采用黑色、深红色和暗红色，对比强烈，营造出烟雾缭绕的氛围，地面附近有发光的红色雾气、散落的火星、淡淡的划痕以及电影级的轮廓光。背景中放置 3 个主要的图形元素：左侧是呈现红色的哥特式米兰大教堂（Duomo di Milano）剪影，右侧是一个巨大的发光 AC Milan 圆形队徽，奔跑的人物身后是超大的半透明数字“10”。添加融入海报的编辑排版：左上角放置“AC MILAN”，下方标注“1899”及一个小队徽；左侧中心位置，上方小字书写名字，下方是大号的高衬线字体姓氏“MBAPPÉ”，其下添加红色的手写签名式涂鸦；右上角边缘放置竖排标语“SEMPRE SEMPRE MILAN”。整体风格应体现精英足球海报设计感，呈现转会揭幕活动的艺术效果，光泽感强、风格激进、现代，具备照片级真实感与平面设计合成效果，布料纹理细节丰富，阴影处理富有戏剧性，并具有高端欧冠宣传的美学质感。 --ar 9:16

templates.title: Beacon Hollow Retro Fantasy Postcards

titleLocalized.zh: Beacon Hollow 复古奇幻明信片

templates.prompt: Create a picture about{argument name="location name" default="BEACON HOLLOW"} This is a retro fantasy travel postcard poster, designed with reference to large-print commemorative postcards from the 1950s and 60s. The composition is a single, richly detailed horizontal scene with pronounced paper weathering textures, rounded postcard edges, faded ink, creases, scratches, mold, and worn edges. At the top and center, large, three-dimensional blocky letters spell out "BEACON HOLLOW" in a classic retro postcard style with warm cream outlines and reddish-brown embossed shadows; each letter contains a small landscape illustration of the destination, including mountain peaks, waterfalls, pine forests, a magical manor, glowing towers, and valley landscapes. The upper left corner features deep red hand-drawn cursive text reading "GREETINGS FROM". The upper right corner features a circular black postmark that reads "BEACON HOLLOW / MAY 18 / 1967 / CREATIVE RETREAT," overlaid on a vintage stamp marked "BEACON HOLLOW," "CREATIVE RETREAT," and "7c." The stamp depicts mountains under moonlight and a lighthouse-like beacon tower. Below the title is a small, curved ribbon banner that reads {argument name="tagline" default="a magejosh destination"} The background should depict a magnificent Golden Hour Valley with a winding river, distant snow-capped peaks, and dense evergreen forests. A large, brightly lit, wooden and stone-structured fantasy hut sits atop a cliff on the right, with stairs descending the slope. Subtle magical blue light and faint arcane circular symbols are scattered around the hut and foreground to create an atmosphere where world-building and magic intertwine. In the lower left corner, place three foreground tabletop items: a dark ceramic mug with a compass symbol, an open sketchbook, and a pen resting diagonally on its pages. The left page of the sketchbook is titled "Campaign Ideas," listing three key points: "The Forgotten Vale," "Clockwork Pilgrims," ​​and "Echoes of the First Light," with a small castle drawing below. The right page displays an illustration of trees and the handwritten text "Beery world Hollow." At the bottom center, add an old map spread out on a table, showing mountain icons and hand-drawn map details. Place five foreground elements in the bottom right corner: a closed leather journal embossed with a star compass and the phrase "Ideas Become Legends"; a pile of four multifaceted dice; a rustic wooden signpost with four directional stripes labeled "STORY," "GAME DESIGN," "WORLD BUILDING," and "AI FOR CREATORS"; a glowing glass lamp or tubular device; and a floating arcane bullseye symbol nearby. Slightly to the left of center, attach a handwritten note on an old piece of paper, written in blue cursive: "Wish you were here — building worlds, chasing wonder, and turning ideas into adventures."{argument name="signature name" default="magejosh"} The painting style is rich in detail, with a nostalgic American postcard design, a fantastical artistic concept, warm sunset light and shadow, soft blue sky, dark brown antiquity, and an engaging creative retreat atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张关于 {argument name="location name" default="BEACON HOLLOW"} 的复古奇幻旅行明信片海报，设计风格参考 20 世纪 50 年代至 60 年代的大字纪念明信片。构图为单幅细节丰富的横向场景，带有严重的纸张风化纹理、圆角明信片边缘、褪色的油墨、折痕、划痕、霉斑和磨损边缘。在顶部和中心，巨大的立体块状字母拼写出“BEACON HOLLOW”，采用经典的复古明信片风格，带有温暖的奶油色轮廓和红棕色浮雕阴影；每个字母内都包含目的地的小型风景插画，包括高山峰峦、瀑布、松林、魔法庄园、发光的塔楼和山谷景观。左上角有深红色的手绘草书文字“GREETINGS FROM”。右上角包含一个圆形的黑色邮戳，上面写着“BEACON HOLLOW / MAY 18 / 1967 / CREATIVE RETREAT”，并覆盖在一张标有“BEACON HOLLOW”和“CREATIVE RETREAT”以及“7c”的复古邮票上，邮票描绘了月光下的山脉和灯塔般的信标塔。在标题下方，放置一条弯曲的小丝带横幅，上面写着 {argument name="tagline" default="a magejosh destination"}，并带有微小的罗盘星装饰。主体背景应展示一个壮丽的黄金时刻山谷，有蜿蜒的河流、远处的雪峰、茂密的常绿森林，右侧悬崖上坐落着一座巨大的木石结构奇幻小屋，内部灯火通明，楼梯沿坡而下。在小屋和前景周围散布微妙的魔法蓝光和淡淡的奥术圆形符号，营造出世界观构建与魔法交织的氛围。左下角放置 3 个前景桌面物品：一个带有罗盘标志的深色陶瓷马克杯、一本打开的素描本，以及一支斜放在页面上的钢笔。素描本左页标题为“Campaign Ideas”，列出 3 个要点：“The Forgotten Vale”、“Clockwork Pilgrims”和“Echoes of the First Light”，下方有一幅小城堡画；右页展示了一幅树木插图和手写文字“Beery world Hollow”。在底部中心，添加一张铺在桌上的旧地图，显示山脉图标和手绘地图细节。右下角放置 5 个前景元素：一本压印有星形罗盘和短语“Ideas Become Legends”的封闭式皮革日志、一堆 4 颗多面骰子、一个质朴的木制路标，上面有 4 个方向条，分别写着“STORY”、“GAME DESIGN”、“WORLD BUILDING”和“AI FOR CREATORS”、一个发光的玻璃灯或管状装置，以及附近一个漂浮的奥术靶心符号。在中心偏左处钉上一张写在陈旧纸张上的手写便条，用蓝色草书写着：“Wish you were here — building worlds, chasing wonder, and turning ideas into adventures. — {argument name="signature name" default="magejosh"}”。采用绘画风格，细节丰富，具有怀旧的美国明信片设计感、奇幻概念艺术感、温暖的日落光影、柔和的青色天空、深褐色陈旧感以及引人入胜的创意静修氛围。

templates.prompt: A highly dramatic vertical football transfer announcement poster, themed as{argument name="player name" default="Erling Haaland"} join in{argument name="club name" default="Inter Milan"} The design employs a dark, high-contrast black and electric blue color scheme, presenting a rugged, cinematic sports poster style. The composition includes two layers of portraits of the same player: a large half-body close-up on the upper left, with the player looking upwards in profile, sporting a neat short blond bun with shaved sides; and a half-body posing portrait in the lower center, wearing the club's iconic blue and black striped home jersey, making a victory sign with one index finger pointing upwards. The figure should possess a strong athletic physique and a powerful heroic aura, utilizing contour lighting, deep shadows, detailed skin texture, and glossy hair highlights. The jersey chest should include white sponsor lettering, a small white hook logo, a circular club crest, and a tricolor shield patch. Behind the player, a large, illuminated circular Inter Milan-style crest serves as a background. A total of three visible club logos are added: a small logo in the upper right corner, a large flag logo in the lower left corner, and a badge on the jersey. The bottom center incorporates a nighttime view of a modern football stadium, with bright floodlights interwoven with blue painted smoke and brushstroke effects. The player's surname runs across the center of the image in large, bold, hand-drawn lettering, partially obscured by the figure, and a large handwritten number "9" is placed to the right. Eight text elements are added around the design: the small text "INTER MILAN" at the top center; stacked player names and a blue "9" in the upper left; the slogan "NATO PER SEGNARE" in the middle left; the vertical text "IM INTER" on the right; the slogan "FORZA INTER PER SEMPRE" in the middle right; the city name "SAN SIRO" in the lower right; the small text "MILANO ITALIA" in the lower right; and the small text "1908" and "LA BENEAMATA" in the bottom center. Additionally, a white signature graffiti is added near the portrait in the upper left. The background should be a layered collage of black, decadent textures, blue ink splatters, scratches, smoke, and radiating light, presenting the texture of a high-end social media sports poster with ultra-high detail, sharpness, and vibrancy, ready to be used for football memes or fan transfer announcements.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的竖版足球转会官宣海报，主题为 {argument name="player name" default="Erling Haaland"} 加入 {argument name="club name" default="Inter Milan"}。设计采用深色、高对比度的黑色与电光蓝配色，呈现出粗犷的电影级体育海报风格。构图包含同一球员的 2 层肖像：上方左侧为一个超大的半身特写，侧脸向上仰望，留着利落的金色短发丸子头，两侧剃短；下方中心为一个半身动作肖像，身穿俱乐部标志性的蓝黑条纹主场球衣，单手食指向上做出胜利手势。人物需具备强壮的运动员体格、强烈的英雄气场，运用轮廓光、深邃阴影、细腻的皮肤纹理和亮泽的发丝高光。球衣胸前应包含白色赞助商文字标识、一个小型的白色钩状 Logo、圆形俱乐部徽章以及三色盾牌补丁。在球员身后，放置一个巨大的发光圆形国际米兰风格徽章图形作为背景。总共添加 3 个可见的俱乐部 Logo：右上角 1 个小 Logo，左下角 1 个大型旗帜 Logo，以及球衣上的 1 个徽章。底部中心融入现代足球场的夜景，明亮的泛光灯与蓝色的绘画烟雾及笔触效果交织在一起。画面中心横跨球员姓氏，采用巨大的粗犷手绘字体，部分被人物遮挡，右侧配有一个巨大的手写风格数字“9”。在设计周围添加 8 处文字元素：顶部中心小字“INTER MILAN”；左上方堆叠的球员姓名及蓝色“9”；左侧中部口号“NATO PER SEGNARE”；右侧垂直文字“I M INTER”；右侧中部口号“FORZA INTER PER SEMPRE”；右下方城市名“SAN SIRO”；右下方小字“MILANO ITALIA”；底部中心小字“1908”和“LA BENEAMATA”。此外，在左上方肖像附近添加 1 个白色的签名涂鸦。背景应为黑色颓废纹理、蓝色墨水溅射、划痕、烟雾和放射状光线的层叠拼贴，呈现出高级社交媒体体育海报的质感，超高细节、锐利、充满活力，随时可用于足球模因或球迷转会官宣。

templates.title: Cyberpunk comic book style: Giant mechanical cat

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克漫画风：巨型机械猫

templates.prompt: A richly detailed black-and-white comic page depicts a giant mechanical cat walking through the crowded streets of a Japanese city at night. The page comprises four panels: a large, horizontal panel at the top, two smaller, stacked panels in the lower left corner, and a large vertical panel in the lower right corner. In the top panel, a giant mechanical cat occupies a narrow, neon-lit alleyway, surrounded by towering buildings, tangled wires, vertical shop signs, and small pedestrians looking up in astonishment. The cat possesses realistic feline proportions, but its body is composed of exposed armor plates, rivets, pistons, cables, gears, segmented metal limbs, and a complex internal mechanical structure. A tag bearing the words "Cat God" hangs around its neck. The damp street reflects the city lights. Several Japanese signs are added to the environment, including "Used Bookstore 2F," "Yorozuya B1," and "Sake Shop." Add a large Japanese manga-style speech bubble in the upper right corner of the top panel, reading "Uwak? Deckee!!". In the upper left panel, a close-up of the back and side of a long-haired woman is shown, looking at the creature, with a vertical Japanese speech bubble next to her reading "...What is this place, Konna Monogatari...?". In the lower left panel, a group of startled onlookers is shown from the front, with a young man in the foreground and other shocked pedestrians behind him, accompanied by a vertical Japanese speech bubble reading "Is this the messenger of the god!?". In the lower right vertical panel, a dramatic low-angle close-up of the mechanical cat standing between buildings under the bright moonlight is shown, emphasizing its mechanical chest structure, massive forelimbs, whiskers, and majestic face, with the "Cat God" tag on its neck clearly visible. Add a large Japanese-style onomatopoeic word "カシ…" near the cat. Employing classic seinen manga aesthetics, cinematic panel composition, delicate ink washes, strong contrast, detailed urban textures, and realistic proportions, it creates a cyberpunk atmosphere of awe, mystery, and holiness.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张细节极其丰富的黑白漫画页，展示了一只巨大的机械猫走在拥挤的日本夜间城市街道上。整页共 4 个分镜：顶部是一个横跨全宽的大分镜，左下角是 2 个较小的堆叠分镜，右下角是一个纵向的大分镜。在顶部大分镜中，一只巨大的机械猫占据了狭窄的霓虹灯巷道，周围是高耸的建筑、错综复杂的电线、垂直的店铺招牌，以及抬头惊愕注视的小行人。猫咪拥有写实的猫科动物比例，但身体由外露的装甲板、铆钉、活塞、线缆、齿轮、分段式金属肢体和复杂的内部机械结构组成，脖子上挂着一个写有“猫神”字样的吊牌。潮湿的街道反射着城市灯光。环境中添加多个日文招牌，包括“古書 2F”、“万事屋 B1”和“酒処”。在顶部大分镜的右上角添加一个巨大的日文漫画对话气泡，写着“うわっ？でっけえ!!”。在左上方的分镜中，展示一名长发女性的背影及侧面特写，她正看向这只生物，旁边有一个垂直的日文对话气泡，写着“…何でこんな街にこんなものが…”。在左下方的分镜中，从正面展示一群受惊的围观群众，前景是一名年轻男子，身后是其他震惊的行人，配有一个垂直的日文对话气泡，写着“神様の使いか!?”。在右下方的纵向大分镜中，展示机械猫在明月下耸立于建筑之间的戏剧性低角度特写，强调其胸部的机械结构、巨大的前肢、胡须和威严的面孔，脖子上的“猫神”吊牌清晰可见。在猫咪附近添加一个巨大的日文风格拟声词“カシ…”。采用经典的青年漫画美学，电影般的分镜构图，细腻的墨水排线，强烈的对比度，细致的城市纹理，写实的比例感，营造出一种敬畏、神秘和神圣的赛博朋克氛围。

templates.prompt: A warm and detailed anime-style illustration, set in a cozy yet slightly cluttered independent studio, blending the atmosphere of a bookstore café and a startup studio. Golden afternoon sunlight streams in through a high window on the right, illuminating four black industrial-style pendant lights hanging from the ceiling. The background is adorned with string lights, bookshelves overflowing with books, greenery, and handwritten inspirational slogans. The image depicts five young women standing around a large wooden workbench, framed as a wide-angle group photo. The overall atmosphere is whimsical yet slightly ironic, ambitious yet somewhat chaotic. On the far left is a tall woman with long, wavy hair {argument name="hair color" default="reddish-brown"} The woman, with her hair disheveled, wore a daisy wreath and a rust-brown sleeveless dress with a white sun-patterned emblem, cinched at the waist with a dark belt; she showed the audience a handwritten note that read {argument name="note text" default="Claude is asking for your permission"} On the side table beside her sat a cup of tea, a stack of books, and a small potted plant. Beside her stood a punk-style blonde woman with pigtails tied with black bows, large black headphones around her neck, and a black off-the-shoulder dress with a prominent white X logo on the chest; she stood confidently next to a laptop covered in stickers and bearing the same X logo. In the center of the background, a mysterious, slender girl with extremely long, deep navy blue-black hair and fair skin stood quietly in front of a monitor, its screen shimmering with blue starlight, wearing a gothic-style dark dress. To the right center, an elegant woman wore a fitted red cheongsam-style dress with floral embroidery and a side slit, one hand resting on a wooden table, an open notebook beside her filled with sketches and writing. On the far right, a casually dressed brown-haired woman with her hair messily tied in a bun wore a white T-shirt with a black knotted AI logo, layered under a beige shirt, standing behind a silver laptop with the same logo. Scattered on the main desk are many cozy office supplies: two mugs, an open notebook, a pen, a small black figurine, a stack of books, and several laptops. titleLocalized.zh: 皮克斯风格 AI Web 设计冲刺活动海报

templates.prompt: This creative coding event poster, imbued with a cinematic feel, adopts the design style of Disney-Pixar animated movie posters. Using a vertical composition, it presents a warm, indoor nighttime scene. A large loft window on the left reflects the city skyline at sunset, with exposed brick walls in the background, creating a neon-lit creative studio atmosphere. At the top center, a striking, glossy, 3D typography displays "Disney•PIXAR," below which is a large, bold white 3D headline: "The AI ​​Web Design Sprint." Directly below is smaller, bright text: "BUILD FAST. BREAK RULES. SHARE LOUD." In the foreground, two adult men sit side-by-side at a wooden table with a laptop between them, conveying a relaxed startup founder vibe; one wears a dark hoodie, the other a light-colored sweatshirt and baseball cap, both facing the camera with friendly and promotional poses. Their faces are rendered generically and seamlessly, emphasizing the poster's composition rather than portrait realism. The laptop lid has three visible stickers: a purple code bracket sticker, a black sticker with a white explosion symbol, and a rectangular slogan sticker that reads "BUILD FAST. BREAK RULES. SHARE LOUD." The scene is surrounded by four fantastical animated mascot elements: a floating robotic drone light in the upper left corner with glowing blue eyes, projecting a warm beam of light downwards; a smiling cartoon sun icon in the upper right corner; a small red pixelated character floating nearby; and a glowing blue cat-shaped digital mascot standing in front of the laptop on the table. The right-hand vertical display shows a dark code interface with clearly visible text, including "// Welcome back, Julian!", "Opus 4.6", "Minimal Playground", "Agency 976", "Cyberpunk Cafe", "Surfers (late set)", and a list titled "Sprint Plan" containing four items: "DISCOVER", "IDEATE", "BUILD", and "SHIP". On the left, a handwritten paper sign is pinned with four notices: “4 NIGHTS OF CHAOS & CODE,” “DOORS 7 PM,” “SHOW 8 PM,” and “$10 ADV / $12 DOS.” In the lower left foreground, a white coffee mug reads “THE SOUTH SIDE DIY 218 W. 31ST ST. CHICAGO, IL” with a small skull icon. In the lower right foreground, a terracotta planter contains greenery and is labeled “CREATIVE COLLISION.” At the bottom center, bold text reads “APRIL 27–30,” below which is “LIVE. ONLY ON THE WEB.” A small credits line, reminiscent of a movie poster, is added to the bottom edge, referencing names like Julian Lopez and Harvey Specter, as well as projects such as Minimal Playground, Agency 976, Cyberpunk Cafe, and Surfers, accompanied by playful production titles. Utilizing dramatic warm orange and cool blue lighting, exquisite animated film rendering, soft depth of field, glossy surfaces, rich contrast, and highly refined poster design, the campaign showcases the vibrant energy of a tech startup and delivers the quality of a high-end event advertisement.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满电影感的创意编程活动海报，采用迪士尼-皮克斯（Disney-Pixar）动画电影海报风格设计。采用竖构图，展现了一个温馨的夜晚室内场景，左侧巨大的阁楼窗户映出日落时的城市天际线，背景为裸露的砖墙，营造出霓虹灯点缀的创意工作室氛围。顶部中央，醒目的光泽感立体排版显示“Disney•PIXAR”，下方是巨大的白色 3D 粗体主标题“The AI Web Design Sprint”。正下方是较小的明亮文字：“BUILD FAST. BREAK RULES. SHARE LOUD.”。画面中央前景处，两名成年男子并排坐在木桌旁，中间放着一台笔记本电脑，呈现出休闲的初创公司创始人氛围；一人穿着深色连帽衫，另一人穿着浅色卫衣并戴着棒球帽，两人都面向镜头，姿态友好且具有宣传感。他们的面部应处理得通用且不突兀，重点在于活动海报的构图而非肖像写实感。笔记本电脑盖上有 3 个可见贴纸：一个紫色代码括号贴纸，一个带有白色爆炸符号的黑色贴纸，以及一个写有“BUILD FAST. BREAK RULES. SHARE LOUD.”的长方形标语贴纸。场景周围包含 4 个奇幻的动画吉祥物元素：左上方是一个悬浮的机器人无人机灯，带有发光的蓝色眼睛，向下投射出一束暖光；右上角是一个微笑的卡通太阳图标；附近漂浮着一个小小的红色像素角色；桌上笔记本电脑前站着一个发光的蓝色猫形数字吉祥物。右侧的竖屏显示器上呈现出深色代码界面，文字清晰可见，包括“// Welcome back, Julian!”、“Opus 4.6”、“Minimal Playground”、“Agency 976”、“Cyberpunk Cafe”、“Surfers (late set)”，以及一个标题为“Sprint Plan”的清单，包含 4 个项目：“DISCOVER”、“IDEATE”、“BUILD”、“SHIP”。左侧，一个手写纸质告示牌上钉着 4 条通知：“4 NIGHTS OF CHAOS & CODE”、“DOORS 7PM”、“SHOW 8PM”以及“$10 ADV / $12 DOS”。左下角前景处，一个白色咖啡杯上写着“THE SOUTH SIDE DIY 218 W. 31ST ST. CHICAGO, IL”并配有一个小骷髅图标。右下角前景处，一个陶土花盆里种着绿叶植物，上面写着“CREATIVE COLLISION”。底部中央，醒目的粗体文字写着“APRIL 27–30”，下方是“LIVE. ONLY ON THE WEB.”。底部边缘添加一行仿电影海报风格的微小制作人员名单，引用 Julian Lopez 和 Harvey Specter 等名字，以及 Minimal Playground、Agency 976、Cyberpunk Cafe 和 Surfers 等项目，并附带俏皮的制作职衔。运用戏剧性的暖橙色与冷蓝色灯光、精致的动画电影渲染、柔和的景深、光泽表面、丰富的对比度、高度精细的海报设计，展现出迷人的科技初创公司活力，并呈现出高端活动广告的质感。

titleLocalized.zh: AI 网页设计冲刺活动瑞士风格海报

templates.prompt: Create a bold Swiss modernist style event poster for an AI and web design sprint event. Use a vertical composition with a warm, off-white paper-textured background, contrasted with striking black typography and vibrant red blocks. The composition employs an asymmetrical editorial style, featuring a strong grid effect and ample white space. Place a line of small red capital text in the upper left corner.{argument name="date text" default="LIVE APRIL 27–30"} This is followed by a thin black horizontal line extending to the right. Below this is an oversized stacked heading in a bold black sans-serif font, left-aligned, containing the following content:{argument name="headline text" default="The AI Web Design Sprint"} The text is arranged in four rows, with exaggerated proportions to make it occupy the left side of the poster. In the upper right quadrant, a large solid red rectangle is added as a graphic block. Below this red block, three lines of compact black capital letters are placed as a subtitle:{argument name="tagline text" default="4 DAYS. REAL PROJECTS. SHIP TOGETHER."} At the bottom center, two black-and-white half-body portraits of men are placed side-by-side in a documentary style, slightly covering the layout area; the man on the left has dark slicked-back hair and a short beard, while the man on the right wears a dark baseball cap with embroidered lettering and also has a beard. Two vertical, soft-edged gray rectangles obscure their faces, centered above them. A vertical toolbar is created along the right side, containing four black square icons, each separated by a thin horizontal line and labeled in uppercase. These four items are: a starburst icon labeled "CREATIVE COLLISION," a connector node icon labeled "AI-POWERED WORKFLOWS," a code bracket icon labeled "CODE IN MOTION," and a terminal prompt icon labeled "REAL-TIME DESIGN." Near the bottom, a full-width footer separated by thin black horizontal lines is added. Inside the footer, create four text blocks separated by thin vertical lines: the first block reads "BUILD FAST. BREAK RULES. SHARE LOUD."; the second block lists "MINIMAL PLAYGROUND & AGENCY 976" with a short red line below it saying "LIVE ON THE WEB"; the third block lists "CYBERPUNK CAFE SURFERS (LATE SET)" and below it "4 NIGHTS OF CHAOS & CODE" and "THE SOUTH SIDE DIY"; the fourth block lists ticketing information "TICKETS $10 ADV $12 DOS". Add vertical red text to the bottom right edge.{argument name="location text" default="CHICAGO, IL"} Use a clean, neo-grotesk typeface similar to Helvetica or Akzidenz-Grotesk, with bold headings, compressed uppercase for secondary text, clear alignment, subtle paper texture, and a high-contrast black-red-beige color scheme. The overall visual effect should blend contemporary design conference posters, punk tech culture, and a brutalist editorial branding style.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张大胆的瑞士现代主义风格活动海报，用于 AI 与网页设计冲刺活动，采用纵向构图，背景为温暖的米白色纸张质感，搭配醒目的黑色排版和鲜艳的红色色块。构图采用不对称的编辑风格，具有强烈的网格感和充裕的留白。在左上角，放置一行红色小号大写文字 {argument name="date text" default="LIVE APRIL 27–30"}，随后是一条向右延伸的细黑色横线。下方设置超大号堆叠式标题，使用超粗体黑色无衬线字体，左对齐，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="The AI Web Design Sprint"}，分为 4 行排列，通过夸张的比例使文字占据海报左侧。在右上象限，添加 1 个大型实心红色矩形作为图形块。在该红色块下方，放置 3 行紧凑的黑色大写副标题：{argument name="tagline text" default="4 DAYS. REAL PROJECTS. SHIP TOGETHER."}。在底部中间，包含 2 张半身男士黑白肖像照，并排摆放，纪实风格，略微覆盖排版区域；左侧男子留着深色背头和短胡须，右侧男子戴着带有刺绣字母的深色棒球帽，留有胡须。用 2 个垂直的柔边灰色遮挡矩形遮住两人的面部，矩形居中于面部。沿右侧创建一列垂直功能栏，包含 4 个黑色方形图标，每个图标由细横线分隔，并配有大写标签。这 4 项内容为：星爆图标配标签 "CREATIVE COLLISION"，连接节点图标配标签 "AI-POWERED WORKFLOWS"，代码括号图标配标签 "CODE IN MOTION"，以及终端提示符图标配标签 "REAL-TIME DESIGN"。在底部附近，添加一个由细黑色横线分隔的全宽页脚。在页脚内，创建 4 个由细竖线分隔的文本块：第 1 块写着 "BUILD FAST. BREAK RULES. SHARE LOUD."，第 2 块列出 "MINIMAL PLAYGROUND & AGENCY 976" 并在下方配有一条红色短线，写着 "LIVE ON THE WEB"，第 3 块列出 "CYBERPUNK CAFE SURFERS (LATE SET)" 以及下方的 "4 NIGHTS OF CHAOS & CODE" 和 "THE SOUTH SIDE DIY"，第 4 块列出票务信息 "TICKETS $10 ADV $12 DOS"。在最右下边缘，添加垂直的红色文字 {argument name="location text" default="CHICAGO, IL"}。使用类似于 Helvetica 或 Akzidenz-Grotesk 的简洁新怪诞体（Neo-grotesk），标题使用粗体，辅助文本使用压缩大写，对齐清晰，具有微妙的纸张纹理和高对比度的黑-红-米色调。整体视觉效果应融合当代设计会议海报、朋克科技文化与粗野主义编辑品牌风格。

templates.title: Punk AI Sprint Event Flyer

titleLocalized.zh: 朋克 AI 冲刺活动传单

templates.prompt: Create an original, high-contrast punk rock concert collage poster for a project titled "..."{argument name="event title" default="THE AI WEB DESIGN SPRINT"} The design should evoke the texture of photocopied underground flyers pasted on city walls: rough, torn paper edges, grainy copying, ink smudges, distressed black and white textures, bright magenta paint splatters, DIY magazine aesthetics, and messy, layered scraps of paper secured with tape and tacks. A vertical poster composition is used, with a black background and a slightly tilted, oversized torn white rectangle in the center, filled with a large, compressed, distressed black font as the main title. At the top, a smaller strip of torn black paper is added, with neon magenta handwritten text {argument name="top slogan" default="LIVE PUNK!"} On the left, place a bright pink torn piece of paper with the date written on it in hand-drawn black text.{argument name="event dates" default="April 27-30"} Below, smaller lines of text are stacked, reading "4 NIGHTS OF CHAOS & CODE", "DOORS 7PM", "SHOW 8PM", "$10 ADV", and "$12 DOS". On the right, add a cream-colored torn sticky note with "WITH:" written in magenta at the top and four guest performers listed in black handwriting below: "Minimal Playground", "Agency 976", "Cyberpunk Cafe", and "Surfers (Late Set)". Slightly below center, display two black-and-white photocopy-style punk band members, half-length portraits, standing side-by-side, both wearing patched and badge-embellished leather jackets; the one on the left wears round-framed glasses, and the one on the right wears a baseball cap. Their faces should be blurred, partially obscured in a collage style, keeping the poster's focus on the typography and graphics rather than the portraits themselves. Add a bright pink spiked starburst pattern in the center right, containing a black circle with a simple white radiating symbol. Near the bottom right corner, place a beige masking tape-like scrap of paper with the words "Build Fast. Break Rules. Share Loud" written in bold, handwritten black text. Near the bottom left corner, add a black rectangular area information block labeled in magenta handwriting.{argument name="venue name" default="THE SOUTH SIDE DIY"} The cover features smaller white address text "218 W. 31st Street" and "Chicago, IL," accompanied by a small white skull icon. It includes two silver pins, one near the top left corner and one near the bottom left, and a strip of dark tape along the left edge of the main title page. The bottom edge finishes with a black and white checkerboard stripe spanning the entire width. The overall feel is rebellious, boisterous, youthful, and anarchistic, combining punk street-poster flyers with tech event advertising, featuring strong contrasts, rough halftone noise, silkscreen imperfections, and the energy of hand-collaged collage.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张原始、高对比度的朋克摇滚演出拼贴海报，用于名为 {argument name="event title" default="THE AI WEB DESIGN SPRINT"} 的活动。设计应呈现出贴在城市墙壁上的复印地下传单质感：粗糙的撕纸边缘、复印颗粒感、墨迹污点、做旧的黑白纹理、亮洋红色油漆溅射、DIY 杂志美学，以及用胶带和图钉固定的混乱分层纸屑。采用竖版海报构图，黑色背景，中央放置一个略微倾斜的超大撕裂白色矩形，内填巨大的压缩式黑色做旧字体作为主标题。在最上方，添加一条较小的黑色撕裂纸条，上面用霓虹洋红色手写笔触写着 {argument name="top slogan" default="LIVE PUNK!"}。在左侧，放置一块亮粉色撕裂纸块，上面用手绘黑色文字列出日期 {argument name="event dates" default="April 27-30"}，下方堆叠较小的文字行，内容为“4 NIGHTS OF CHAOS & CODE”、“DOORS 7PM”、“SHOW 8PM”、“$10 ADV”和“$12 DOS”。在右侧，添加一张米白色撕裂便签，顶部用洋红色写着“WITH:”，下方用黑色手写体列出四个助演嘉宾：“Minimal Playground”、“Agency 976”、“Cyberpunk Cafe”和“Surfers (Late Set)”。在中心偏下区域，展示 2 名黑白复印风格的朋克乐队成员，半身像，肩并肩站立，两人都穿着带有补丁和徽章的皮夹克；左侧的人戴着圆框眼镜，右侧的人戴着棒球帽。他们的面部应模糊处理，部分被拼贴风格遮挡，使海报焦点保持在排版和图形上，而非肖像本身。在右中部添加一个亮粉色尖刺星爆图案，其中包含一个带有简单白色放射状符号的黑色圆圈。在右下角附近，放置一张米色美纹纸胶带状的纸屑，上面用粗体手写黑色文字写着“Build Fast. Break Rules. Share Loud.”。在左下角附近，添加一个黑色矩形场地信息块，用洋红色手写体标注 {argument name="venue name" default="THE SOUTH SIDE DIY"}，以及较小的白色地址文字“218 W. 31st Street”和“Chicago, IL”，旁边附带一个小巧的白色骷髅图标。包含 2 枚银色别针，一枚靠近左上角，一枚靠近左下区域，并在主标题纸张的左边缘添加 1 条深色胶带。底部边缘以横跨全宽的黑白棋盘格条纹收尾。整体氛围：叛逆、喧闹、年轻、无政府主义，将街头张贴的朋克传单与技术活动宣传相结合，具有强烈的对比度、粗糙的半色调噪点、丝网印刷瑕疵以及手工拼贴的能量。

templates.title: Cute subscription celebration illustration

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱的订阅庆祝插画

templates.prompt: A warm and charming digital illustration, set against a cozy desktop background, celebrates a new subscription. On the left is a friendly humanoid robot mascot with a glossy black screen displaying pixelated purple LED eyes and a smiling mouth. It wears a black top hat with a purple ribbon, a dark hoodie with a small American flag patch on the sleeve, and "USN VET MSSP" printed on its chest. The robot gives a thumbs-up with one hand and holds a small rectangular sign that reads "Subscribed!" with a purple heart drawn below. On the right is an ecstatic young woman with long, wavy hair.{argument name="hair color" default="gold"} Her hair was disheveled, and she sat at the table, her hands clasped together near her chin in an excited and grateful gesture. She wore a white long-sleeved top with red and blue stripes and a small logo on the chest. Her face was obscured by a simple square smudge. Above them, large, playful handwritten characters read, "{argument name="headline text" default="Nick subscribed to Sharon!"} Below the title is a rounded notification card displaying a circular image of the same robot mascot and its name.{argument name="subscriber name" default="Nick"} , and "Subscribed to{argument name="creator name" default="Sharon Riley"} The text read "", followed by a purple heart. The speech bubble next to the woman read "".{argument name="speech bubble text" default="Thank you!"} The composition features seven pink heart doodles scattered throughout, with a small white glitter added near the center. All elements are placed on a wooden tabletop. On the left side of the table, a black mug with the words "CRYPTO CAN'T BE EVIL" and a gold coin with a Shiba Inu head are placed. In the center of the right front, a white mug with "AI FOR GOOD" and a blue heart is placed. On the far right, three books are stacked, their spine titles clearly visible: "AI & CREATIVITY," "ENTERTAINMENT," and "DREAM BIG" with a heart, next to a small potted plant. A softly blurred home office background is used, including bookshelves, soft-toned decor, and a picture frame with the letter X on the wall. Soft peach and beige lighting, painterly shadows, rounded shapes, a healing-style fan art aesthetic, and exquisite picture book-style digital paintings complete the look.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅温暖可爱的数字插画，背景为温馨的桌面环境，正在庆祝新的订阅。左侧是一个友好的类人机器人吉祥物，它有着光亮的黑色面屏，屏幕上显示着像素化的紫色 LED 眼睛和微笑的嘴巴，头戴饰有紫色带子的黑色高礼帽，身穿深色连帽衫，袖子上有一个小小的美国国旗补丁，胸前印有“USN VET MSSP”字样。机器人一只手竖起大拇指，另一只手拿着一块写着“Subscribed!”的小长方形标牌，下方画着一颗紫色爱心。右侧是一位欣喜若狂的年轻女性，留着长长的波浪形 {argument name="hair color" default="金色"} 头发，坐在桌边，双手合十放在下巴附近，做出兴奋而感激的姿势，身穿带有红蓝条纹装饰和胸前小标志的白色长袖上衣。她的脸被一个简单的方形遮挡块遮住。在他们上方，巨大的俏皮手写文字写着“{argument name="headline text" default="Nick 订阅了 Sharon!"}”。标题下方是一张圆角的通知卡片，显示着同一个机器人吉祥物的圆形头像、名称“{argument name="subscriber name" default="Nick"}”，以及“Subscribed to {argument name="creator name" default="Sharon Riley"}”的文字，后面跟着一颗紫色爱心。女子旁边的对话气泡写着“{argument name="speech bubble text" default="谢谢你！"}”。在构图中散布 7 个粉色爱心涂鸦，并在中心附近添加 1 个白色小闪光。将所有元素放置在木质桌面上。在桌子左侧，放置 1 个印有“CRYPTO CAN'T BE EVIL”文字的黑色马克杯和 1 枚印有柴犬头像的金币。在右前方中心，放置 1 个印有“AI FOR GOOD”字样和蓝色爱心的白色马克杯。在最右侧，堆叠 3 本书，书脊标题清晰可见：“AI & CREATIVITY”、“ENTERTAINMENT”和带有爱心的“DREAM BIG”，旁边放 1 盆小盆栽。使用柔和模糊的家庭办公室背景，包括书架、柔和色调的装饰以及墙上带字母 X 的相框。柔和的桃色和米色灯光，绘画般的阴影，圆润的形状，治愈系主播同人画美学，精致的绘本风格数字绘画。

templates.prompt: A luxury natural skincare product advertisement, shot in a sun-dappled forest clearing, has a style similar to {argument name="brand name" default="WILLOW & ROOT"} A high-end beauty product poster. At the center of the image is a beautiful young woman with sun-kissed skin and loose, golden side-braided hair. She wears a soft beige sundress and sits behind a moss-covered rustic wooden table, holding delicate white wildflowers close to her face. Her face is partially obscured by a simple, warm brown rectangular block of color, creating an artistic effect reminiscent of an anonymous model. On the foreground wood, five exquisite e-commerce products are neatly arranged from left to right: a green glass dropper bottle labeled "Organic Facial Oil" (with a bamboo cap), a round blush with a gray-pink cap, a matte terracotta-colored tinted lipstick, a frosted light green pump bottle labeled "Hydrating Essence" (with a bamboo pump), and a closed bamboo compact powder case engraved with the brand name. Soft white wildflowers and lush green plants adorn the product areas and the edges of the image. Featuring warm, golden-moon backlighting, a creamy blurred background, shallow depth of field, soft lens flare, natural green and beige tones, a high-end botanical aesthetic, photorealistic skin and packaging textures, a centered composition, and a vertical 4:5 layout. An elegant dark serif font is overlaid at the top, displaying a two-line title.{argument name="headline text" default="Rooted in Radiance"} Below it is a smaller sans-serif slogan.{argument name="tagline" default="Nature-Powered. Skin-Loving."} The middle section is separated by a small leaf icon and a thin horizontal dividing line. Add two circular promotional badges: one in the upper left corner with a leaf icon and {argument name="left badge text" default="PLANT-BASED + CRUELTY FREE"} An olive green badge with text; the upper right corner features a {argument name="discount text" default="15% OFF FIRST ORDER"} A beige badge with text. A small white Pollo.ai watermark in the upper right corner. High-end beauty ad, simple yet luxurious design, a modern mobile-first e-commerce marketing campaign.

promptLocalized.zh: 在阳光斑驳的森林空地拍摄的奢华天然护肤品广告，风格类似于 {argument name="brand name" default="WILLOW & ROOT"} 的高端美妆海报。画面中央是一位美丽的年轻女性，她拥有被阳光亲吻过的肌肤和松散的金色侧编发，身穿柔软的米色吊带裙，坐在铺满苔藓的乡村原木桌后，手持精致的白色野花靠近脸部。她的脸部被一个暖棕色的简洁矩形色块遮挡，营造出匿名模特的艺术效果。在前景的原木上，从左至右整齐排列 5 款精致的电商产品：一瓶标有有机面部精油的绿色玻璃滴管瓶（配竹制盖）、一个带有灰粉色盖子的圆形腮红膏、一支哑光陶土色包装的润色唇膏、一瓶标有水润精华的磨砂浅绿色泵头瓶（配竹制泵头），以及一个刻有品牌名称的封闭式竹制粉饼盒。在产品周围和画面边缘点缀柔和的白色野花和茂密的绿色植物。采用温暖的黄金时刻背光、奶油般虚化的背景、浅景深、柔和的镜头光晕、自然的绿色与米色调、高端植物健康美学、照片级真实的皮肤与包装质感、居中构图、竖版 4:5 布局。在顶部叠加优雅的深色衬线字体，显示两行标题 {argument name="headline text" default="Rooted in Radiance"}，下方配以较小的无衬线标语 {argument name="tagline" default="Nature-Powered. Skin-Loving."}，中间由一个小叶子图标和细水平分割线隔开。添加 2 个圆形促销徽章：左上角为一个带有叶子图标和 {argument name="left badge text" default="PLANT-BASED + CRUELTY FREE"} 文字的橄榄绿徽章；右上角为一个带有 {argument name="discount text" default="15% OFF FIRST ORDER"} 文字的米色徽章。在右上角放置一个小型的白色 Pollo.ai 水印。高端美妆广告，简洁奢华构图，现代移动端优先的电商营销活动。

templates.title: Popular punk-style kitten portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 流行朋克情绪风小猫肖像

templates.prompt: A lifelike close-up portrait of a kitten, styled like an early 21st-century pop-punk rock singer. It sits on a dark floor, facing the camera with a calm yet slightly melancholic expression. The kitten has large, round eyes, soft striped fur, and a long, straight "scene-kid" hairstyle.{argument name="hair color" default="Platinum"} A striking strand of hair fell down one cheek.{argument name="streak color" default="pink"} Hair partially obscures its eyes. It wears four striking fashion elements: a black band-style T-shirt with a distressed white pattern, a black and pink striped tie, a black studded bracelet on one of its forepaws, and an exaggeratedly long wig-like hairstyle. The background is a rugged bedroom or rehearsal room wall covered in punk posters and exuding a distressed texture; to the left is a black poster with striking white text.{argument name="poster text" default="AVRIL LAVIGNE"} Below is a pink heart-and-skull logo; to the right is a blurry poster of a person wearing dark clothes and a striped tie. The dim, warm indoor lighting, shallow depth of field, rich hair details, realistic beard, subtle decadent atmosphere, centered composition, nostalgic aesthetic, and studio-level realism.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张逼真的小猫特写肖像，造型模仿 21 世纪初的流行朋克摇滚歌手，它坐在深色地板上，面朝镜头，表情冷静且略带忧郁。小猫有着圆圆的大眼睛、柔软的条纹毛发，以及一头长直的“场景小孩”（scene-kid）风格发型，颜色为 {argument name="hair color" default="铂金色"}，一侧脸颊垂下一缕醒目的 {argument name="streak color" default="粉色"} 发丝，遮住了部分眼睛。它佩戴了 4 个显眼的时尚元素：一件带有做旧白色图案的黑色乐队风格 T 恤、一条黑粉斜条纹领带、一只前爪上戴着黑色铆钉手环，以及那头夸张的长假发式发型。背景是贴满朋克海报且充满做旧质感的粗犷卧室或排练室墙壁；左侧是一张黑色海报，上面印有醒目的白色文字 {argument name="poster text" default="AVRIL LAVIGNE"}，下方是一个粉色的心形骷髅标志；右侧是一张模糊的海报，上面是一个穿着深色衣服、系着条纹领带的人。昏暗的室内暖光，浅景深，毛发细节丰富，胡须逼真，带有微妙的颓废氛围，居中构图，怀旧的情绪美学，影棚级写实效果。

templates.title: Japanese-style video production poster

titleLocalized.zh: 日式视频制作海报

templates.prompt: For a company named{argument name="company name" default="Arks"} A video production company created a simple, high-end Japanese-style corporate poster. It employs minimalist editing and layout, using a beige background with ample negative space. The poster is vertically oriented, close to the size of an A4 sheet of paper. A large, bold, black sans-serif logo is placed in the upper left corner, with the text {argument name="company name" default="Arks"} The width almost spans the entire page. In the top right corner, a small, stacked brand logo is added, using thin capital letters: "VIDEO" on the first line, "PRODUCTION" on the second, and "COMPANY" on the third, accompanied by a small burnt orange geometric decoration. Below the logo, a vertical burnt orange line is added to the left, along with a large, elegant Japanese title in black Mincho font:{argument name="headline text" default="Refine your video skills in four areas."} Following this, a smaller line of Japanese service descriptions is added, separated by slashes: "SNS Operations / Short Drama Production / MV Production / AI Video". The main body is a 2x2 grid containing four service sections, separated by thin light gray lines. Each section is accompanied by a large, black, edit-style number and a Japanese tag. Section 1, tagged "SNS Operations", number "01"; image shows a hand holding a smartphone checking social media analytics data, against a backdrop of an office desk with charts, calendar pages, a pen, and a coffee cup, bathed in warm, natural office lighting; Japanese caption below: "To plan, analyze, and utilize." Section 2, tagged "Short Drama Production", number "02"; image shows two Japanese high school students, one male and one female, standing on an outdoor rooftop or balcony, in a side profile, with soft, overcast sunlight and a cinematic shallow depth of field; Japanese caption below: "A story design with lingering resonance." Section 3, tagged "MV Production", number "03"; image shows a musician playing electric guitar in a dimly lit recording studio, backlit with a soft, misty effect, with a camera monitor showing the same performer in the foreground; Japanese caption below: "Visualizing the world of artists through images." Section 4, tagged "AI Video," with the number "04"; the image showcases the interface of professional AI video generation or image editing software on the monitor, featuring a cinematic scene: a solitary figure standing on a rock against a dramatic cloud background, along with a thumbnail timeline and side control panel; below is the Japanese description: "Transform technology into next-generation video production." In the lower left corner, a three-line capitalized English slogan is placed:{argument name="tagline text" default="CREATE.\nCONNECT.\nLEAVE A MARK."} A small burnt orange stripe decorates the top. The URL is placed in the bottom right corner.{argument name="website" default="arks-vp.com"} The design uses a small serif font with a short black horizontal line. The overall style is a sophisticated combination of bold, modern sans-serif fonts (for the large logo and numbers) and elegant Japanese serif fonts (for headings and labels). The color scheme features black, charcoal gray, warm off-white, light gray lines, and restrained burnt orange accents. The overall style should convey an authentic, sophisticated, and modern Japanese editorial advertising design aesthetic, with accurate Japanese typography and natural image tones.

promptLocalized.zh: 为一家名为 {argument name="company name" default="Arks"} 的视频制作公司创作一张简洁、高端的日式企业海报。采用极简主义的编辑排版，以米白色为背景，留出大量负空间。海报为纵向构图，比例接近 A4 纸。在左上角放置一个超大的粗体黑色无衬线字体 Logo，内容为 {argument name="company name" default="Arks"}，宽度几乎横跨页面。在右上角，添加一个小型堆叠式品牌标识，使用纤细的大写字母：第一行写“VIDEO”，第二行写“PRODUCTION”，第三行写“COMPANY”，旁边配有一个小的焦橙色几何装饰。在 Logo 下方，左侧添加一条垂直的焦橙色线条，并配以黑色明朝体（Mincho）的大号优雅日文标题：{argument name="headline text" default="4つの領域で、映像を磨く。"}。紧随其后，添加一行较小的日文服务说明，使用斜杠分隔：“SNS 运营 / 短剧制作 / MV 制作 / AI 视频”。主体部分为一个 2x2 的网格，包含 4 个服务板块，板块间由细浅灰色线条分隔。每个板块均配有一个大号黑色编辑风格数字和一个日文标签。板块 1 标签：“SNS 运营”，数字“01”；图片展示一只手拿着智能手机查看社交媒体分析数据，背景是办公桌，桌上有图表、日历页、钢笔和咖啡杯，光线为温暖的自然办公光；下方日文说明：“企画・分析・運用を一つの流れで。” 板块 2 标签：“短剧制作”，数字“02”；图片展示 2 名穿着白衬衫的日本高中生站在户外屋顶或阳台上，一男一女，侧面构图，柔和的阴天日光，电影感的浅景深；下方日文说明：“共感が残る、短編の物語設計。” 板块 3 标签：“MV 制作”，数字“03”；图片展示一名音乐人在昏暗的录音室中弹奏电吉他，背光带有柔和的雾气，前景中有一个显示同一表演者的摄像机监视器；下方日文说明：“アーティストの世界観を、映像で可視化。” 板块 4 标签：“AI 视频”，数字“04”；图片展示显示器上专业的 AI 视频生成或图像编辑软件界面，屏幕中是电影感场景：一个孤独的身影站在岩石上，背景是戏剧性的云层，此外还有缩略图时间轴和侧边控制面板；下方日文说明：“技術を表現へ変える、次世代の映像制作。” 在左下角，放置一个三行大写英文标语：{argument name="tagline text" default="CREATE.\nCONNECT.\nLEAVE A MARK."}，上方配有一条小的焦橙色线条装饰。在右下角，放置网址 {argument name="website" default="arks-vp.com"}，使用小型衬线字体，旁边配有一条短黑色水平线。整体采用粗体现代无衬线字体（用于大号 Logo 和数字）与优雅日文衬线体（用于标题和标签）的精致组合。配色方案：黑色、炭灰色、温暖的米白色、浅灰色线条以及克制的焦橙色点缀。整体风格应呈现出真实、精致、现代的日式编辑广告设计感，并具备准确的日文排版和自然的图像色调。

templates.title: Advertising Concept UI Brand Guide

titleLocalized.zh: 广告概念 UI 品牌指南

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference images as a brand style guide, generate a dark-toned creative application interface, displayed in a 2x2 grid format.{argument name="brand name" default="Netflix"} Four billboard concepts were generated. The precise brand color palette and overall visual identity system from the reference images were applied: a deep black background, red accents, white typography, charcoal gray overlays, and a clean, modern sans-serif font style. The reference images were transformed from a static brand setup page into an image generation results screen. The left sidebar contained a model selector with two model cards, and the main canvas displayed four generated concept thumbnails. Each thumbnail should be a cinematic nighttime outdoor billboard model with dramatic lighting, glossy reflections, and a person wearing a VR headset. Eye-catching billboard copy was used, with the content {argument name="headline text" default="NETFLIX VR"} ,{argument name="subheadline text" default="COMING SOON"} as well as{argument name="date text" default="28TH MAY"} Add small UI labels and descriptions on the right to summarize the prompts, and add generation time badges above the four images. Ensure the final result has the quality of a screenshot from a high-end creative tool used for brand ad brainstorming.

promptLocalized.zh: 以提供的参考图作为品牌风格指南，生成一个深色调的创意生成应用界面，以 2x2 网格形式展示 {argument name="brand name" default="Netflix"} 的 4 个广告牌概念。应用参考图中的精确品牌调色板和整体视觉识别系统：深黑色背景、红色点缀、白色排版、炭灰色叠加层以及简洁现代的无衬线字体风格。将参考图从静态的品牌设置页面转变为图像生成结果屏幕，左侧边栏包含 2 个模型卡片的模型选择器，主画布显示 4 个生成的概念缩略图。每个缩略图应为电影质感的夜间户外广告牌模型，具有戏剧性的光影、光泽反射以及佩戴 VR 头显的人物。使用醒目的广告牌文案，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="NETFLIX VR"}、{argument name="subheadline text" default="COMING SOON"} 以及 {argument name="date text" default="28TH MAY"}。在右侧添加小型 UI 标签和说明以概括提示词，并在 4 张图像上方添加生成时间徽章。确保最终效果呈现出用于品牌广告构思的高级创意工具截图质感。

templates.title: J.Crew Mascot Fashion Feature

titleLocalized.zh: J.Crew 吉祥物时尚专题

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference images as a character and color scheme guide, transform them into a sophisticated J.Crew-style fashion catalog featuring the mascot. Replace the infographic/chart layout with a clean 2x2 magazine layout on a creamy white background. Add a large serif font for the brand title.{argument name="headline text" default="J.CREW"} And an italicized subtitle{argument name="subhead text" default="Gritty’s Off Hours: Cool & Casual"} Show four photos of the character, retaining their fluffy orange fur, large eyes, and black helmet, but dressed in modern menswear inspired by the "best" color scheme in the reference images: 1) "CLASSIC CREW" — seated on a stool, wearing a navy blue sweater over a crisp white Oxford shirt and dark jeans; 2) "EASY LAYERS" — casually standing, wearing a cyan overshirt over a white T-shirt and charcoal gray trousers; 3) "POP OF PLUM" — relaxed, wearing a plum cardigan and dark trousers; 4) "MODERN SPORT" — seated, wearing a black track jacket, black trousers, white socks, and white sneakers. Add a short catalog-style description below each section, matching the four headings, with concise, stylish copy. Use soft, natural indoor lighting, a minimalist home-inspired interior setting, high-end catalog photography, and an elegant preppy aesthetic. Add a short closing line at the bottom center:{argument name="footer text" default="TIMELESS STYLE. PLAYFUL SPIRIT."}

promptLocalized.zh: 以提供的参考图作为角色和配色指南，将其转化为一套由该吉祥物担任主角的精致 J.Crew 风格时尚画册。将信息图/图表布局替换为米白色背景下的简洁 2x2 杂志排版。添加一个大型衬线字体品牌标题 {argument name="headline text" default="J.CREW"} 以及一个斜体副标题 {argument name="subhead text" default="Gritty’s Off Hours: Cool & Casual"}。展示 4 张该角色的造型照片，保留其毛茸茸的橙色皮毛、大眼睛和黑色头盔，但让吉祥物穿上灵感源自参考图中“最佳”配色的现代男装：1) “CLASSIC CREW” — 坐在凳子上，身穿海军蓝毛衣，内搭清爽的白色牛津衬衫，下穿深色牛仔裤；2) “EASY LAYERS” — 随意站立，身穿青色外搭衬衫，内搭白色 T 恤，下穿炭灰色长裤；3) “POP OF PLUM” — 姿态放松，身穿李子色开衫，搭配深色长裤；4) “MODERN SPORT” — 坐着，身穿黑色运动外套，搭配黑色长裤、白色袜子和白色运动鞋。为每个板块下方添加一段简短的目录风格说明，与上述 4 个标题相匹配，并配以简洁的时尚文案。使用柔和的室内自然光，采用极简的家居室内专题布景、高级目录摄影风格以及高雅的学院风美学。在底部居中添加一行简短的结束语：{argument name="footer text" default="TIMELESS STYLE. PLAYFUL SPIRIT."}

templates.title: High-end beverage commercial poster

titleLocalized.zh: 高端饮品商业海报

templates.prompt: For high-end{argument name="product" default="Orange juice"} The brand created a striking, high-end commercial poster, shot in a hyper-realistic studio environment, emphasizing freshness, precision, and strong visual appeal. Main composition: A bottle filled with rich, vibrant {argument name="liquid" default="Orange juice"} A transparent, streamlined bottle sits at the center of the image. The label design is minimalist, modern, and high-end, featuring a simple orange graphic and elegant lettering. The bottle cap is matte black with subtle highlights and realistic reflections. Action and narrative: Two hands wearing matte black gloves interact with the product: one hand firmly holds the bottle from above, while the other uses a sharp stainless steel knife to slice a juicy orange, capturing the moment of cutting and showcasing the juicy pulp and fresh citrus texture. A few orange slices are placed slightly scattered at the base, creating a natural yet stylish composition. Lighting and Atmosphere: Background: Deep, rich green gradient with a cinematic decay effect. Surface: Dark matte tabletop with soft, controllable reflections. Lighting: Dramatic studio lighting. Strong key light on one side to add depth. Soft fill light to maintain balance. Sharp highlights on the bottle and blade. Deep, clean shadows to enhance contrast. Typography: Top corner: White, clean, modern brand name (e.g., "VITRA", "FRESCO", or "NATURO"). Bottom area: Small text: "Not your average juice". Large, bold headline:{argument name="headline" default="Pure orange juice, no compromise."} The font should present a modern, eye-catching, and high-end feel with a strong visual hierarchy. The headline uses a rich orange tone, echoing the juice. Visual Style: High-end food advertising aesthetics, cinematic feel, striking and high-contrast, ultra-clear details and textures, high-magazine quality (similar to a global advertising campaign). Simple yet powerful composition. Output requirements: 4K resolution, photorealistic, advertising-grade quality, sharp focus, rich contrast, high dynamic range.

promptLocalized.zh:
为高端 {argument name="product" default="橙汁"} 品牌创作一张醒目、高端的商业海报，在超写实的影棚环境中拍摄，重点突出新鲜感、精准度与强烈的视觉吸引力。

主体构图：
一瓶装满浓郁、鲜活 {argument name="liquid" default="橙汁"} 的透明流线型瓶子位于画面中心。标签设计极简、现代且高端，采用简洁的橙子图案与精致的字体。瓶盖为哑光黑色，带有微妙的高光与逼真的倒影。

动作与叙事：
两只戴着哑光黑色手套的手正在与产品互动：
一只手从上方稳稳握住瓶子
另一只手正用锋利的不锈钢刀切开一颗多汁的橙子
捕捉切开瞬间的动作，展现出多汁的果肉与新鲜的柑橘纹理。底座处放置了几片橙子，略微散落，营造出自然又不失设计感的构图。

灯光与氛围：
背景：深邃、浓郁的绿色渐变，带有电影感的衰减效果
表面：深色哑光桌面，带有柔和、可控的倒影
灯光：戏剧性的影棚布光
一侧强主光以增加深度
柔和补光以保持平衡
瓶身与刀刃上有清晰的高光
深邃、干净的阴影以增强对比度

排版布局：

顶部角落：
白色简洁、现代的品牌名称（例如 “VITRA”、“FRESCO” 或 “NATURO”）
底部区域：
小字行：“Not your average juice”（非凡果汁）

大号粗体标题：“{argument name="headline" default="纯粹橙汁，绝不妥协。"}”
字体应呈现出现代、醒目且高端的质感，并具有强烈的视觉层级。标题使用浓郁的橙色调，与果汁相呼应。

视觉风格：

高端食品广告美学

电影感、醒目且对比强烈

超清晰的细节与纹理

高端杂志大片质感（类似全球性广告活动）

简洁而有力的构图

输出要求：

4K 分辨率

照片级真实感，广告级品质

焦点清晰，对比度丰富，高动态范围

templates.title: Black and white art portrait

templates.prompt: A cinematic black and white portrait, in which {argument name="subject" default="young man"} Sitting{argument name="furniture" default="wooden chair"} He sits in a retro-style interior. He leans slightly forward, his head resting gently on his arms folded over the back of the chair. His posture is relaxed yet weighty, conveying a depth of emotion and a quiet introspection. He gazes down, lost in thought, his expression soft and melancholic. He has slightly disheveled dark hair, fine in texture, with a light stubble or short beard, adding to his realism and personality. A few strands fall naturally across his forehead. He wears a {argument name="clothing" default="A simple and slightly loose white shirt"} The natural folds of the fabric enhance the candid, realistic beauty. The soft, natural light comes from a large window behind or to the side of him. The light gently envelops his face and arms, outlining delicate highlights while casting deep, dramatic shadows throughout the room. The diffused light and shadow, with their sharp contrasts, evoke classic film photography. The setting is a vintage interior—aged wooden furniture, textured walls, and a large window with prominent panes. The background is softened yet still clearly visible, adding depth and context without interfering with the subject. Atmosphere: Sensual, quiet, introspective—capturing solitude, contemplation, and tranquility. Color Grading: Monochrome (black and white), with rich contrast, deep blacks, soft highlights, and a film-like tonal range. Depth of Field: Shallow depth of field, with sharp focus on the subject's face and arms, and a smooth, blurred background. Style: Art photography, cinematic stills, film aesthetics, high dynamic range, subtle graininess, timeless atmosphere. Camera parameters: 50mm or 85mm lens, f/1.8–f/2.2 aperture, natural light photography, strong subject isolation, soft vignetting. Composition: Vertical composition (4:5 or 9:16), subject slightly off-center, using the chair as a compositional element to create a layered narrative composition. The uploaded image was used as a reference to generate the image.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张电影感的黑白肖像，画面中 {argument name="subject" default="年轻男子"} 坐在 {argument name="furniture" default="木椅"} 上，置身于复古的室内环境。他侧身而坐，身体微微前倾，头部轻轻靠在叠放于椅背上的双臂上。他的姿态放松而沉重，传达出情感的深度与静谧的内省。他低头凝视，陷入沉思，表情柔和而忧郁。

他留着微乱的深色头发，发质细腻，带有淡淡的胡茬或短须，增添了真实感与个性。几缕发丝自然地垂在额前。他穿着一件 {argument name="clothing" default="简约且略显宽松的白衬衫"}，布料褶皱自然，增强了抓拍般的真实美感。

光线柔和自然，来自他身后或侧面的一扇大窗户。光线轻柔地包裹着他的脸庞和手臂，勾勒出精致的高光，同时在房间内投下深邃而戏剧性的阴影。光影弥漫且对比鲜明，令人联想到经典的胶片摄影。

环境为复古室内——陈旧的木质家具、富有质感的墙壁以及带有明显窗格的大窗户。背景经过柔化处理，但仍清晰可见，在不干扰主体的情况下增加了深度与语境。

氛围：感性、安静、内省——捕捉孤独、沉思与宁静。

调色：单色（黑白），具有丰富的对比度、深邃的黑色、柔和的高光以及胶片般的色调范围。

景深：浅景深，焦点清晰地聚焦在主体的脸部和手臂上，背景平滑虚化。

风格：艺术摄影、电影剧照、胶片美学、高动态范围、细腻颗粒感、永恒的氛围。

相机参数：50mm 或 85mm 镜头，f/1.8–f/2.2 光圈，自然光摄影，强主体隔离，柔和暗角。

构图：竖构图（4:5 或 9:16），主体略微偏离中心，利用椅子作为构图元素，营造出具有层次感的叙事构图。
使用上传的图片作为参考生成图像

She sits cross-legged on a minimalist floor covered with decorative tiles, wearing a modern dress with a minimalist print.{argument name="top" default="blue sweatshirt"} , pairing{argument name="bottom" default="Loose jeans"} Wearing black Converse sneakers, her expression was serene and subtly confident, a gentle smile playing on her lips, her eyes relaxed, gazing softly at the diffused light. Behind her stood a massive abstract mural depicting her own face, bold and expressive in its use of charcoal gray, white, gold, and soft red. This mural was not a realistic copy, but a stylized and emotionally charged interpretation of her: deep-set eyes, fragmented textures, and broad brushstrokes hinting at movement, ambition, and inner complexity. The mural's scale dominated the background without obscuring the subject, creating a harmonious balance between reality and artistic representation. The lighting was cinematic and captivating, with soft reflections at the edges, the overhead glow outlining her silhouette. Tiny dust particles floated lightly in the air, capturing the shimmering light and enhancing the atmosphere. The scene blended a modern art studio with a dreamlike exhibition space: clean, spacious, and minimalist, yet brimming with emotional tension. Shot with hyper-realistic image quality using a 50mm portrait lens, featuring shallow depth of field, sharp details, and elegant color transitions, conveying themes of creativity, introspection, and personal transformation. templates.title: Pixel Game Asset Gallery Template

titleLocalized.zh: 像素游戏资产图集模板

templates.prompt: Please base your answer on [Game Theme:]{argument name="game theme" default="Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba / Tanjiro"} Create a "Pixel World Asset Atlas" suitable for serialized releases, with high completion and high information density. This is not a typical pixel illustration or a single game scene, but a "2D pixel game asset overview" for game development, art design, level design, and visual proposals. The visuals should be presented as a complete game asset project, [Game Type:]{argument name="game type" default="Side-scrolling action"} The necessary core characters, enemies, items, terrain, scenes, mechanisms, bosses, and decorative elements are systematically organized into a clear, professional, and reusable game asset atlas. [Basic Settings] Theme/Worldview: [Game Theme] Game Type: [Game Type] Historical Setting: [Historical Setting] Protagonist Identity: [Protagonist Identity] Enemy Type: [Enemy Type] Main Scenes: [Main Scene Environment] Overall Style: [Style Direction, e.g.:{argument name="style" default="16-bit retro arcade pixel style"} [Main Color Scheme: [Main Color Scheme]] [Secondary Color Scheme: [Secondary Color]] [Accent Color Scheme: [Accent Color]] [Aspect Ratio: [Horizontal 4:3]] If not specified, the optimal scheme will be automatically matched based on the game theme. [Overall Visual Requirements] Visually, a large horizontal canvas should be used, with a simple or low-obstruction background, presenting the look of a game development asset list or instruction manual-style resource catalog. All elements should be 2D pixel art sprites with uniform pixel density, clear black/dark outlines, limited color gradations, and a retro game texture. Do not generate realistic photography, 3D renderings, paintings, illustrations, or movie poster styles. The focus is on "system completeness, clear classification, rich resources, and high development potential." [Layout Structure] The atlas uses a modular grid layout, using thin lines to divide different resource areas. Each area should contain a numbered title and a short category label, with the reading path from left to right and from top to bottom. The layout should have the sense of order of an instruction manual or game development document. Information density should be high but not chaotic; elements within each module should be evenly spaced. [Included Modules] 1. Player Character Module: Displays complete action frames, including standing, walking/running, jumping, etc., arranged horizontally like a sprite sheet. 2. Enemy Unit Module: Designs various enemies, including normal, ranged, heavy, and elite units. 3. Weapons and Items Module: Displays melee, ranged, projectiles, effects, and loot. 4. Basic Terrain Tile Module: Displays ground, walls, platforms, corners, and blocks of different materials. 5. Natural/External Scene Resources Module: Displays trees, grass, rocks, and obstacles. 6. Building/Base/Camp Resources Module: Displays doors, windows, walls, ladders, and camp facilities. 7. Special Terrain Module: Displays bridges, water bodies, cliffs, and cave entrances. 8. Indoor/Underground/Facility Resources Module: Displays pipes, control consoles, metal doors, and equipment. 9. Boss/Encounter Resources Module: Displays large bosses, special vehicles, and giant mechanisms. 10. General Decorations and Interactive Elements Module: Displays ladders, ropes, signs, switches, and mechanisms. [Visual Detail Requirements] All resources must maintain consistent pixel dimensions and world-building coherence. Proportional relationships must be clear. Action frames must demonstrate continuity; terrain tiles must support tiling; props and mechanisms must be functionally recognizable; boss elements should convey a sense of oppression.

promptLocalized.zh:
请基于 [游戏主题: {argument name="game theme" default="鬼灭之刃/炭治郎"}]，创建一个适合系列化发布、高完成度且高信息密度的“像素世界资产图集”。

这并非普通的像素插画或单一游戏场景，而是一份用于游戏开发、美术设定、关卡设计及视觉提案的“2D 像素游戏资产概览图”。视觉效果应呈现为一张完整的游戏素材项目，将 [游戏类型: {argument name="game type" default="横版动作"}] 所需的核心角色、敌人、道具、地形、场景、机关、Boss 及装饰元素，系统性地整理成一张清晰、专业且可复用的游戏资产图集。

[基本设置]
主题世界观：[游戏主题]
游戏类型：[游戏类型]
时代背景：[时代背景]
主角身份：[主角身份]
敌人类型：[敌人类型]
主要场景：[主要场景环境]
整体风格：[风格方向，例如：{argument name="style" default="16-bit 复古街机像素风格"}]
主色调：[主色调]
辅助色：[辅助色]
强调色：[强调色]
长宽比：[长宽比，横向 4:3]
若未填写，将根据游戏主题自动匹配最优方案。

[整体视觉要求]
视觉上采用大尺寸横向画布，背景简洁或干扰度低，呈现出游戏开发资产表或说明书式资源目录的观感。所有元素应为 2D 像素艺术精灵图，具备统一的像素密度、清晰的黑色/深色轮廓、有限的色阶以及复古游戏质感。请勿生成写实摄影、3D 渲染、绘画插图或电影海报风格。重点在于“系统完整、分类清晰、资源丰富且具备高开发性”。

[布局结构]
图集采用模块化网格布局，使用细线划分不同的资源区域。每个区域需包含带编号的标题和简短的类别标签，阅读路径从左至右、从上至下。布局应具备说明书或游戏开发文档的秩序感。信息密度需高但不混乱；各模块内的元素应等距排列。

[包含模块]
1. 玩家角色模块：展示完整的动作帧，包括站立、行走/奔跑、跳跃等，像精灵图表一样横向排列。
2. 敌方单位模块：设计多种敌人，包括普通、远程、重型及精英单位。
3. 武器与道具模块：展示近战、远程、投射物、特效及拾取物。
4. 基础地形瓦片模块：展示地面、墙壁、平台、转角及不同材质的方块。
5. 自然/外部场景资源模块：展示树木、草丛、岩石及障碍物。
6. 建筑/基地/营地资源模块：展示门、窗、墙壁、梯子及营地设施。
7. 特殊地形模块：展示桥梁、水体、悬崖及洞穴入口。
8. 室内/地下/设施资源模块：展示管道、控制台、金属门及设备。
9. Boss / 遭遇战资源模块：展示大型 Boss、特殊载具及巨型机关。
10. 通用装饰与交互元素模块：展示梯子、绳索、标志、开关及机关。

[视觉细节要求]
所有资源必须保持一致的像素尺寸逻辑和世界观连贯性。比例关系明确。动作帧需体现连续性；地形瓦片需支持平铺；道具和机关需具备功能识别度；Boss 元素应体现出压迫感。

templates.title: Isometric Microscopic World Profile Archive

titleLocalized.zh: 等轴测微观世界剖面档案

templates.prompt: Please create a high-quality, information-dense "Isometric Microscopic World Archive" visual map suitable for serial release, based on the [theme]. This is not just an ordinary room illustration or simple architectural drawing, but a thematic space overview combining "isometric perspective + architectural section structure + multi-layered functional spaces + high-density thematic props + miniature model feel + game scene concept art feel." The image should resemble an open miniature world, a business simulation game scene, a dollhouse model, or a world-building concept diagram, allowing viewers to immediately grasp the overall structure while repeatedly observing its details. [Basic Settings] Theme: [Theme, e.g., Insect Research Institute / Future Survival Base / Magic Potion Workshop / AI Automation Company / Plant Factory / Children's Learning Center / Space Supply Station] Space Name / Brand Name: [Brand Name or Space Name, can be left blank] Worldview Direction: [Realism / Science Fiction / Fairy Tale / Magic / Post-Apocalyptic / Museum / Laboratory / Business Simulation / Campus / Natural Ecology] Building Type: [Cabin / Base / Factory / Laboratory / Shop / Museum / Underground Space / Spaceship / Multi-level Studio] Core Function: [Main purpose of this space, e.g., research, production, display, living, training, trading, learning, maintenance, planting] Main Color Scheme: [Main color scheme, e.g., light blue, mint green, cream yellow, pink, orange-green, purple-blue, white-blue (tech feel)] Secondary Color: [Secondary color, can be left blank] Accent Color: [Accent color, can be left blank] Aspect Ratio: [1:1 / 3:4 / 4:5 / ...] [9:16] Information Density: [Medium-High/High/Very High] Overall Atmosphere: [Healing, Cute, Precise, Childlike, Scientific, Futuristic, Retro, Refreshing, Exploratory] If some fields are not filled in, please automatically deduce them based on the [Theme]; please do not leave them blank. All content must be generated uniformly around the theme, avoiding irrelevant elements. [Visual Structure] Use a clear isometric perspective/axonometric view, with the main subject being an open, multi-layered themed building or functional base. Viewers can simultaneously see the front, sides, top, and interior space of the building. The entire building is located in the center of the screen, occupying most of the area, with the background environment moderately faded to highlight the main subject. The interior of the building needs to be divided into multiple functional areas, each with a clear purpose, rather than randomly piling up decorations. This can include: 1. Main work area/core operation area 2. Display area/collection area/specimen area 3. Research area/laboratory area/control area 4. Storage area/shelf area/supply area 5. Living area/rest area/small living area 6. Energy area/machine area/pipeline area 7. Planting area/cultivation area/ecological area 8. Entrance area/traffic area/maintenance area 9. Spatial connection structures such as stairs, platforms, corridors, railings, ladders, etc. These structures create clear spatial relationships between different areas through stairs, corridors, platforms, pipes, bridges, or cables, making the image look like a realistically functioning miniature system. [Props and Details] Generate a large number of relevant props based on the [theme] and distribute them across different functional areas. Props need to be specific, identifiable, and theme-related, rather than vague decorations. Each small object should be as clear and legible as a game asset, with a clickable, interactive, and collectible feel. Props may include: - Themed equipment: machines, instruments, tools, consoles, containers, screens, workbenches - Household items: tables, chairs, bookshelves, beds, cups, boxes, cabinets, lamps - Display items: specimens, models, posters, signs, glass cabinets, display racks - Connecting structures: pipes, wires, ladders, stairs, conveyor belts, slides, platforms - Ecological elements: plants, water tanks, incubators, soil, branches, rocks, specimens - Character elements: a small number of characters, animals, robots, or themed creatures to provide a sense of proportion and storytelling. The number of props should be abundant but orderly. All props should serve the function of the space and the theme's worldview. [Style Requirements] The overall style should be clear, cute, and precise hand-drawn cartoon isometric illustrations. Lines should be clean, edges slightly rounded, and colors bright and soft, with an overall feeling of relaxation, healing, and exploration. Images should have the feel of commercial simulation games, children's science picture books, miniature models, or concept art pages. Avoid overly realistic, strong shadows, heavy oil painting effects, and complex noise. The focus is on clarity, refinement, depth, and high readability. [Color and Light] Use a soft color scheme with high brightness and low to medium saturation. Maintain a unified primary color, use secondary colors to differentiate different spaces, and accent colors to highlight key equipment and props. Avoid using pure black for line art; instead, use soft outlines such as dark gray, blue-gray, or brownish-gray. Keep the light and shadow light; avoid strong, realistic shadows. Build depth through color blocks, structures, lines, and localized highlights. The background should be light and low-contrast to make the main building stand out. [Composition and Reading Path] The main subject should be centered or slightly above, and the building should employ a multi-layered sectional structure. The visual reading path should begin with the overall building outline, proceed to the functional areas of each floor, and finally observe the details and props. The eye can be guided by elements such as stairs, platforms, corridors, pipes, and tracks. The overall image should be full but not crowded, rich but not cluttered. Every room, platform, and corner should have content while maintaining clear spatial boundaries. [Background Environment] The background can include a softened external environment, such as forests, cities, streets, underground rock formations, experimental parks, the seabed, space, campuses, factory exteriors, etc., depending on the theme. The background should not compete with the subject; it is recommended to use light colors, low opacity, and low contrast to achieve the effect of "clear subject, receding background." [Final Effect] The final image should look like a complete theme space concept sketch, with the structural feel of architectural cross-sections, the detail of game scene assets, and the cute, exploratory feel of a miniature dollhouse. It should be suitable for serialized visual creations, IP worldview displays, game scene settings, brand space concept sketches, science content covers, or visual posts in the style of Xiaohongshu/Pinterest. Ensure the image has: 1. A clear isometric perspective 2. A clear architectural cross-sectional structure 3. Complete multi-layered functional areas 4. Abundant props and thematic unity 5. Soft and bright colors 6. Clean and clear line art 7. A softened background and a prominent subject 8. High information density but not cluttered 9. A miniature world that is explorable, operable, and observable.

promptLocalized.zh:
请根据 [主题] 创建一张适合系列化发布、高完成度且高信息密度的“等轴测微观世界档案”视觉地图。

这不仅仅是一张普通的房间插画或简单的建筑图纸，而是一个结合了“等轴测视角 + 建筑剖面结构 + 多层功能空间 + 高密度主题道具 + 微缩模型感 + 游戏场景概念艺术感”的主题空间概览。图像应看起来像一个打开的微缩世界、商业模拟游戏场景、娃娃屋模型或世界观构建概念图，让观众一眼就能看清整体结构，同时又能反复观察其中的细微之处。

[基本设置]
主题：[主题，例如：昆虫研究所 / 未来生存基地 / 魔法药水工坊 / AI 自动化公司 / 植物工厂 / 儿童学习中心 / 太空补给站]
空间名称 / 品牌名称：[品牌名称或空间名称，可留空]
世界观方向：[现实 / 科幻 / 童话 / 魔法 / 后启示录 / 博物馆 / 实验室 / 商业模拟 / 校园 / 自然生态]
建筑类型：[小屋 / 基地 / 工厂 / 实验室 / 店铺 / 博物馆 / 地下空间 / 宇宙飞船 / 多层工作室]
核心功能：[该空间的主要用途，例如：研究、生产、展示、生活、培训、交易、学习、维护、种植]
主色调：[主色调，例如：浅蓝、薄荷绿、奶油黄、粉色、橙绿色、紫蓝色、白蓝色科技感]
辅助色：[辅助色，可留空]
强调色：[强调色，可留空]
长宽比：[1:1 / 3:4 / 4:5 / 9:16]
信息密度：[中高 / 高 / 超高]
整体氛围：[治愈、可爱、精准、童趣、科普、未来感、复古、清爽、探索感]

如果某些字段未填写，请根据 [主题] 自动合理推导；请勿留白。所有内容必须围绕主题统一生成，避免无关元素。

[视觉结构]
采用清晰的等轴测视角 / 轴测视图，主体为一个打开的多层主题建筑或功能基地。观众可以同时看到建筑的正面、侧面、顶部和内部空间。整个建筑位于屏幕中心，占据大部分区域，背景环境适度淡化以突出主体。

建筑内部需要划分为多个功能区，每个区域都有明确的用途，而不是随机堆砌装饰。可以包括：
1. 主工作区 / 核心操作区
2. 展示区 / 收藏区 / 标本区
3. 研究区 / 实验室区 / 控制区
4. 存储区 / 货架区 / 补给区
5. 生活区 / 休息区 / 小型居住区
6. 能源区 / 机器区 / 管道区
7. 种植区 / 培育区 / 生态区
8. 入口区 / 交通区 / 维护区
9. 楼梯、平台、走廊、栏杆、梯子等空间连接结构

通过楼梯、走廊、平台、管道、桥梁或电缆，在各个区域之间形成清晰的空间关系，使图像看起来像一个真实运作的微型系统。

[道具与细节]
根据 [主题] 生成大量相关道具，并将它们分布在不同的功能区。道具需要具体、可识别且与主题相关，而不是模糊的装饰。每个小物件都应像游戏资产一样清晰易读，具有可点击、可交互和可收集的感觉。

道具类型可包括：
- 主题设备：机器、仪器、工具、控制台、容器、屏幕、工作台
- 生活用品：桌椅、书架、床、杯子、盒子、柜子、灯具
- 展示物品：标本、模型、海报、招牌、玻璃柜、展示架
- 连接结构：管道、电线、梯子、楼梯、传送带、滑轨、平台
- 生态元素：植物、水箱、培养箱、土壤、树枝、岩石、标本
- 角色元素：少量角色、动物、机器人或主题生物，以提供比例感和故事感

道具数量应丰富但有序。所有道具都应服务于空间的功能和主题世界观。

[风格要求]
整体风格为清晰、可爱、精准的手绘卡通等轴测插画。线条干净，边缘略圆润，色彩明亮柔和，整体具有放松、治愈和探索的感觉。图像应具有商业模拟游戏、儿童科普绘本、微缩模型或概念艺术页面的感觉。

避免过度写实、强烈的暗部光影、厚重的油画感和复杂的噪点。重点在于清晰、精致、有层次且高度易读。

[色彩与光影]
使用高亮度、中低饱和度的柔和配色方案。主色调统一，辅助色用于区分不同空间，强调色用于突出关键设备和小道具。线稿颜色不使用纯黑色，应使用深灰、蓝灰或棕灰等柔和的轮廓线。

保持光影轻盈；不需要强烈的写实投影。通过色块、结构、线条和局部高光来构建层次。背景应使用浅色和低对比度处理，使主体建筑更加突出。

[构图与阅读路径]
主体居中或略微偏上，建筑采用多层剖面结构。视觉阅读路径应从整体建筑轮廓开始，进入各楼层的功能区，最后观察细节道具。视线可以通过楼梯、平台、走廊、管道和轨道等元素进行引导。

整体图像应饱满但不拥挤，丰富但不杂乱。每个房间、平台和角落都应有内容，同时保持清晰的空间边界。

[背景环境]
背景可以根据主题包含减弱的外部环境，例如森林、城市、街道、地下岩层、实验园区、海底、太空、校园、工厂外景等。背景不应与主体竞争；建议使用浅色、低透明度和低对比度，以达到“主体清晰，背景后退”的效果。

[最终效果]
最终图像应看起来像一张完整的主题空间概念图，既有建筑剖面的结构感，又有游戏场景资产图的细节，并结合了微型娃娃屋的可爱探索感。它应适用于系列化视觉创作、IP 世界观展示、游戏场景设定、品牌空间概念图、科普内容封面或小红书 / Pinterest 风格的视觉帖。

确保图像具有：
1. 清晰的等轴测视角
2. 清晰的建筑剖面结构
3. 完整的多层功能区
4. 丰富的道具和主题统一性
5. 柔和明亮的色彩
6. 干净清晰的线稿
7. 减弱的背景，突出的主体
8. 高信息密度但不杂乱
9. 可探索、可操作、可观察的微型世界感。
