templates.title: Shadow Ensemble movie poster template

titleLocalized.zh: Shadow Ensemble 电影海报模板

templates.prompt: Please base your opinion on [Subject:]{argument name="character name" default="Enter the character name"} Create a highly polished, narratively compelling "Shadow Ensemble Cover" suitable for a series release. This is more than just a simple character illustration or battle poster; it's a "group action cover" with the feel of a novel cover, comic book visuals, game promotional material, and dark fantasy illustration. The image needs to consist of a large, central figure, multiple mid-ground action characters, threatening background elements, localized energy effects, and a white space for the title, forming a complete cover showcasing the character factions and world-building. [Basic Settings] Theme:{argument name="scene theme" default="Spell Battle / Dark Journey to the West / Cyber ​​Hunter / Monster Hunting Team / Post-Apocalyptic Survivors / Magic Academy Battle Group"} Title: [Title of Work] Series Name/Brand Name: [Brand Name or Series Name] Subtitle: [Subtitle] Style Guidance:{argument name="style" default="Dark fantasy, retro comic book covers, hand-painted thick paint, fantasy novel covers, game visuals"} Main color scheme: Dark green-black-gray / Dark blue neon / Dark brown-gold-red / Sand yellow-rust / Dark purple-gold. Accent colors: Blood red energy, cyan spell light, golden divine light, blue lightning. Aspect ratio: 2:3 vertical / 3:4 vertical / 4:5 vertical / 9:16 vertical. [Structure] A vertical cover composition is used. A large visual figure must serve as the central figure and dominant element of the atmosphere. This figure can be in profile, half-body, back view, a frontal gaze, or a large silhouette, occupying the right side, top, or main background area. The expression should be calm, mysterious, and imposing. The figure may not necessarily participate in combat, but must command the overall atmosphere of the image. Arrange 3 to 6 action characters in the mid-ground, forming a group portrait of a combat formation. There should be clear division of labor and differences in posture between characters, such as charging, wielding a sword, casting spells, defending, summoning, jumping, being alert, and ranged attacking. Avoid static characters; strong rhythmic movement and visual dynamism must be created. Add enemy threats or world-building elements to the background, such as monsters, giants, villainous shadows, mechanical legions, demons, ruins, forests, alternate dimensions, battlefield smoke, or urban disasters. Background threats should not overshadow the characters but rather envelop them like shadows to enhance the sense of crisis and narrative depth. Set one or two high-saturation energy hotspots, such as red fire fists, blue lightning, green spells, purple magic, golden divine light, or white sword energy. Energy effects should be concentrated on key characters or weapons to create visual focal points, rather than illuminating the entire screen uniformly. [Composition] The overall structure is "large central character + mid-ground action group + background threat shadow + bottom or side blank title area." The image can utilize diagonal organization of characters, allowing the group to charge from the upper left to the lower right or from the bottom to the center, creating a strong sense of forward momentum. Maintain a clear blank title area, preferably located in the lower left, bottom, or side. Use off-white, light paper color, or low-saturation background colors for the blank areas to display [brand name/work title/subtitle]. The title layout should have the feel of a publication cover, using elegant serif fonts, retro title letters, comic book cover titles, or a high-end magazine style layout. The text area must be clear and not completely obscured by characters and backgrounds. Avoid perfectly rectangular edges; use irregular brushstroke edges, ink diffusion, torn paper styles, or natural dissipation to make characters and backgrounds appear to grow out of the paper, enhancing the hand-drawn cover feel and artistic quality. [Visual Style] The overall style should combine hand-drawn thick painting with comic book covers, possessing paper texture, brushstroke feel, shadow depth, and a retro publication feel. Lighting should primarily use low-key dark lighting, with a dark background, clear character outlines, and high-contrast focus provided by localized energetic light. The image should not be too clean; it should retain the hand-drawn texture, paper grain, edge brushstrokes, and dark haze. Primarily use low-saturation dark tones, supplemented with a small amount of high-saturation energetic colors. The overall atmosphere should have a sense of oppression, mystery, combat, and world-building depth. [Visual Objectives] The final image should look like a mature fantasy novel cover, a comic book special edition cover, a game character faction visual, or an IP promotional poster. It needs to possess the following: 1. A clear main visual character; 2. A dynamic and rhythmic group portrait; 3. A clear enemy threat or world-building background; 4. Strong yet restrained energy effects; 5. A legible title text area; 6. The overall texture of a retro hand-drawn cover. Ensure the visuals are rich in information yet not cluttered, with distinct character layers, a clear visual focus, and suitability for continuously generating works within the same series on different themes.

promptLocalized.zh:
请基于 [Subject: {argument name="character name" default="填写角色名称"}] 创建一个高完成度、高叙事张力的「Shadow Ensemble 封面」，适用于系列化发布。这不仅仅是一张普通的人物插画或简单的战斗海报，而是一张具有小说封面、漫画视觉、游戏宣传及暗黑奇幻插画质感的“群像动作封面”。画面需要由一个巨大的精神核心人物、多个中景动作角色、背景威胁元素、局部能量光效以及留白的标题区域组成，从而形成一个完整的角色阵营与世界观封面。

[基础设置]
主题：{argument name="scene theme" default="咒术对决 / 暗黑西游 / 赛博猎人 / 怪兽狩猎小队 / 末日幸存者 / 魔法学院战斗群"}
作品名称：[作品名称]
系列名称 / 品牌名称：[品牌名称或系列名称]
副标题：[副标题]
风格导向：{argument name="style" default="暗黑奇幻、复古漫画封面、手绘厚涂、奇幻小说封面、游戏视觉"}
主色调：深绿-黑-灰 / 深蓝霓虹 / 暗棕-金-红 / 沙黄-铁锈 / 深紫-金
强调色：血红能量、青色咒光、金色神光、蓝色闪电
画面比例：2:3 竖版 / 3:4 竖版 / 4:5 竖版 / 9:16 竖版

[画面结构]
采用竖版封面构图。必须有一个巨大的视觉人物作为精神核心和氛围主导元素。此人可以是侧影、半身、背影、正面凝视或巨大剪影，占据右侧、顶部或主要背景区域，表情冷静、神秘且具有压迫感，不一定参与战斗，但必须统领整张画面的气质。

在中景安排 3 到 6 个动作角色，形成战斗阵营群像。角色之间应有明确的分工和姿态差异，如冲锋、持刀、施法、防御、召唤、跳跃、警戒、远程攻击等。避免角色静止站立；必须形成强烈的节奏感动作和视觉动势。

在背景中加入敌方威胁或世界观元素，如怪物、巨人、反派阴影、机械军团、恶魔、废墟、森林、异空间、战场烟雾或城市灾难。背景威胁不应喧宾夺主，而应像阴影一样包裹角色，以增强危机感和叙事深度。

设置 1 到 2 个高饱和度能量热点，如红色的火焰拳、蓝色闪电、绿色咒力、紫色魔法、金色神光或白色剑气。能量效果应集中在关键角色或武器上，形成视觉焦点，而非全屏均匀发光。

[构图]
整体结构为“大型精神核心人物 + 中景动作群像 + 背景威胁阴影 + 底部或侧边留白标题区”。画面可利用对角线组织角色，让群像从左上向右下或从底部向中心冲锋，形成强烈的向前推进感。

保留清晰的留白标题区，建议位于左下、底部或侧边。留白区域使用灰白色、浅纸色或低饱和度背景色，以便放置 [品牌名称 / 作品名称 / 副标题]。标题排版应具有出版物封面感，使用优雅的衬线字体、复古标题字母、漫画封面标题或高端杂志风格布局。文字区域必须清晰，且不被角色和背景完全遮挡。

不要让边缘呈完全的矩形；使用不规则的笔触边缘、墨迹扩散、撕纸风格或自然消散，让角色和背景从纸张中生长出来，增强手绘封面感和艺术品质。

[视觉风格]
整体风格应结合手绘厚涂与漫画封面，具有纸张纹理、笔触感、暗部层次和复古出版物气质。光影以低调暗光为主，背景压暗，角色轮廓清晰，并由局部能量光提供高对比度焦点。画面不应过于洁净；应保留手绘质感、纸张颗粒、边缘笔触和暗色雾气。主要使用低饱和度暗色调，辅以少量高饱和度能量色。整体氛围应具备压迫感、神秘感、战斗感和世界观厚度。

[视觉目标]
最终图像应看起来像成熟的奇幻小说封面、漫画特刊封面、游戏角色阵营视觉或 IP 宣传海报。它需要具备：1. 清晰的主视觉人物；2. 具有节奏动势的群像；3. 明确的敌方威胁或世界观背景；4. 强烈但克制的能量效果；5. 可阅读的标题文字区；6. 复古手绘封面的整体质感。确保画面信息丰富但不杂乱，角色层次分明，视觉重心明确，适合持续生成不同主题的同一系列作品。

templates.title: ethereal Buddhist Pure Land scene

titleLocalized.zh: 空灵的佛教净土场景

templates.prompt: The Western Pure Land of Ultimate Bliss (also known as the Western Pure Land, Sukhavati) is the Buddha-land of Amitabha Buddha (Buddha of Infinite Life). Its core characteristic is the absence of all suffering, only pure happiness, a stark contrast to our Saha world (the world of suffering). It is located to the west of our world, a distance of ten trillion Buddha-lands (see the Amitabha Sutra for details). The principal Buddha is Amitabha Buddha (Infinite Light, Infinite Life), who constantly preaches the Dharma; flanked by Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva and Mahasthamaprapta Bodhisattva, collectively known as the "Three Saints of the West." The environment is adorned with the seven treasures, pure and flawless. The earth is made of gold, flat, soft, bright, and clean, without mountains, rivers, ravines, thorns, or rocks. Seven-jeweled ponds and water possessing eight virtues: The ponds are filled with seven jeweled materials (gold, silver, lapis lazuli, crystal, tridacna shell, red pearl, and agate). The water possesses eight virtues: sweetness, coolness, softness, lightness, clarity, fragrance, thirst-quenching, and nourishment of the mind. The pool's bottom is covered with golden sand, and its banks are adorned with seven-jeweled steps. Lotuses in the pool are as large as cartwheels, radiating light of blue, yellow, red, and white. Architecture: Seven-jeweled pavilions, palaces, and lecture halls float in the air, their size changing at will, translucent and crystalline, far surpassing the celestial realm. Jeweled Trees and Celestial Music: Seven rows of trees, seven layers of railings, and seven layers of nets, all made of the four precious materials. A gentle breeze rustles the trees and nets, producing subtle Dharma sounds, like hundreds of thousands of musical instruments playing simultaneously, naturally guiding listeners to contemplate the Three Jewels: Buddha, Dharma, and Sangha. Climate and Rain: There is no distinction between hot and cold, no calamities of wind and rain; the climate is always mild and comfortable. Mandala flowers fall from the sky six times a day and night, fragrant and colorful. Wondrous Birds: White cranes, peacocks, parrots, kalavinkas, etc., are all manifestations of Amitabha Buddha, emitting harmonious calls, proclaiming the Dharma. Sentient Beings: No suffering, only joy, and immeasurable lifespan. Rebirth: All beings are born from lotuses in the Seven Treasure Pond, not born of parents, and are free from the suffering of birth, old age, sickness, and death. Appearance: All have bodies of pure purple-gold, majestic and sublime, resembling Amitabha Buddha; possessing five supernatural powers: divine eye, divine ear, telepathy, knowledge of past lives, and supernatural speed, free and unhindered. Lifespan: Enduring countless eons, nearly eternal, without the worry of premature death or aging. Nature: All are supremely virtuous beings, free from greed, anger, ignorance, jealousy, or conflict; compassionate, egalitarian, wise, and pure, constantly hearing the Dharma. Life: Food and clothing arise naturally, requiring no labor; in the morning, they can travel to ten trillion Buddha-lands to make offerings to Buddhas and return at mealtime. Time and Space: Infinite and eternal. Time: Without day and night, without years and months, eternal happiness; this world does not experience the evolution of formation, existence, decay, and emptiness. Space: Vast and boundless, even accommodating all beings in the ten directions without ever being crowded; a single grain of dust can contain three thousand great chiliocosms.

promptLocalized.zh:
西方极乐世界（又称西方净土、Sukhavati）是阿弥陀佛（无量寿佛）的佛国。其核心特征是远离一切苦难，唯有纯粹的快乐，这与我们所处的“堪忍”（娑婆）世界形成鲜明对比。它位于我们世界西方，距离十万亿佛土之遥（详见《阿弥陀经》）。

主佛：阿弥陀佛（无量光、无量寿），常宣讲佛法；左右侍奉观世音菩萨和大势至菩萨，合称“西方三圣”。

国土环境：以七宝庄严，纯净无瑕。
大地：以黄金为地，平坦、柔软、明亮且洁净，没有高山、河流、沟壑、荆棘或岩石。
七宝池与八功德水：遍布七宝池（金、银、琉璃、水晶、砗磲、赤珠、玛瑙）。池水具备八种功德：甘甜、清凉、柔软、轻盈、清澈、芬芳、解渴、滋养心神。池底铺满金沙，池边有七宝阶道，池中莲花大如车轮，散发出青、黄、赤、白四色光芒。
建筑：七宝亭台、宫殿和讲堂，悬浮于空中，大小随心变化，通透晶莹，远胜于天界。
宝树与天乐：七重行树、七重栏楯、七重罗网，皆由四宝所成。微风吹拂树木与罗网，发出微妙的法音，如同百千种乐器同时演奏，自然引导听者生起对佛、法、僧三宝的念想。
气候与天雨：无寒暑之分，无风雨之灾，气候始终温和舒适；天空中昼夜六时飘落曼陀罗花，芬芳且色彩斑斓。
奇妙之鸟：白鹤、孔雀、鹦鹉、迦陵频伽等，皆为阿弥陀佛所化现，发出和谐的鸣叫声，宣扬佛法。

众生：无苦，唯有乐，寿命无量。
往生：众生皆从七宝池中的莲花化生，非父母所生，免受生、老、病、死之苦。
外貌：皆为紫磨真金色身，庄严殊胜，与阿弥陀佛相似；具备五种神通：天眼通、天耳通、他心通、宿命通、神足通，自在无碍。
寿命：历经无量劫，近乎永恒，无夭折或衰老之忧。
本性：皆为诸上善人，远离贪、嗔、痴、嫉妒或冲突；慈悲、平等、智慧且清净，常闻佛法。
生活：衣食自然化现，无需劳作；清晨可前往十万亿佛土供养诸佛，并在用餐时间返回。

时空：无限且永恒。
时间：无昼夜、无年月，永恒幸福；该世界不经历成、住、坏、空的演变。
空间：广袤无垠，即使容纳十方众生也永不拥挤；一粒微尘中即可容纳三千大千世界。

templates.title: Landscape Archive Model Template

titleLocalized.zh: 景观档案模型模板

templates.prompt: Please base on{argument name="subject" default="Great Wall / Mount Everest / The Bund / Pearl River"} Create a high-quality, professional "landscape archive model" visual suitable for a series of presentations. This is more than just a regular map or simple landscape illustration; it's a high-end archival visual presentation combining "2D cartography + 3D regional model + professional annotation system + museum exhibition feel." The image should resemble a realistic geographical research model, urban planning sand table, architectural scheme model, or world-building exhibit, possessing a professional, restrained, precise, and tactilely high-quality texture. [Basic Settings] Theme:{argument name="subject content" default="Crater Lake / Guangzhou / Chongqing"} Theme Type: [Natural Terrain / Urban Space / Mixed Landscape] Core Theme: [Core theme, e.g., crater, canyon, mountain range, lake, CBD, old town, landmark cluster, island city, historical site, main urban area] Content Focus: [Content focus, e.g., terrain elevation / city landmarks / road network / water system / relationship between nature and city / scene collection display] Style:{argument name="style" default="Geographical surveying style, paper art model style, architectural design style, museum archive style, urban planning style"} Primary Color: [Primary color, e.g., off-white, light gray, parchment white, sand, snow white] Secondary Color: [Secondary color, e.g., earth brown, rock gray, cool gray, light blue, moss green] Accent Color: [Accent color, e.g., thin black lines, red routes, blue water lines, yellow numbered markers] Aspect Ratio: [Aspect Ratio, e.g., 16:9 landscape / 3:4 portrait / 4:5 portrait / 1:1 square] [Composition] The main subject is a rectangular map project placed on a clean table or white cloth. The base has realistic thickness, with visible cross-sectional structures at the edges, like a delicate map slice or model base. The map surface is covered with a clear but restrained layer of information, including contour lines, road networks, water systems, regional boundaries, geographic textures, coordinates, subtle annotations, and drawing borders. In the center or off-center area, a 3D model "grows" from the 2D map, becoming the visual core of the entire image. If the [Theme Type] is Natural Terrain: The main body consists of mountains, canyons, craters, lakes, basins, islands, glaciers, faults, or coastlines, emphasizing elevation, layered contour lines, rock textures, and natural terrain undulations. If the [Theme Type] is Urban Space: The main body consists of core urban areas, CBDs, old town districts, landmark clusters, waterfront areas, road nodes, bridges, water systems, or parks, emphasizing building volume, urban characteristics, spatial hierarchy, and planning structure. If the [Theme Type] is Mixed Landscape: Blending natural terrain with man-made environments, such as mountain cities, island cities, ancient ruins, post-apocalyptic wastelands, fantasy capitals, or science fiction bases. [Detail Requirements] - The surface should retain the texture of a map paper and a professional information feel. - Terrain areas should have contour lines, slope layers, and a sense of depression. - Building areas should have a sense of volume, street relationships, and clear hierarchy. - Water bodies should use a low-saturation light blue. - Green spaces/forests should use moss green or low-saturation green. - Road networks should use thin lines to avoid being overwhelming. - Landmarks should be clearly identifiable. - Sci-fi/fantasy elements should maintain an archival model feel, rather than being pure scene illustrations. [Annotation System] Map items require complete and restrained annotation modules, including border lines, scale bars, legend areas, title areas, file numbers, index markers, annotation labels, and simple symbol explanations. The text does not need to be fully readable, but must present a realistic, clear, accurate, and orderly archival layout. [Camera and Lighting] Use an isometric or sandbox composition with a downward-sloping view, with a camera angle of approximately 30 to 45 degrees, to show the map plane, model height, edge thickness, and annotation areas. Lighting should be soft and natural, casting delicate and realistic shadows on a clean background, avoiding a cartoonish or cheap game UI feel.

promptLocalized.zh:
请基于 {argument name="subject" default="长城 / 珠穆朗玛峰 / 外滩 / 珠江"} 创建一个高质量、专业的“景观档案模型”视觉图，适用于系列展示。

这不仅仅是一张普通的地图或简单的景观插画，而是一种结合了“2D 地图制图 + 3D 区域模型 + 专业注释系统 + 博物馆展览感”的高端档案视觉呈现。图像应看起来像真实的地理研究模型、城市规划沙盘、建筑方案模型或世界构建展品，具有专业、克制、精确且富有触感的优质质感。

[基本设置]
主题：{argument name="subject content" default="火山口湖 / 广州 / 重庆"}
主题类型：[自然地形 / 城市空间 / 混合景观]
核心主体：[核心主体，例如：火山口、峡谷、山脉、湖泊、CBD、老城区、地标群、岛屿城市、遗迹、主城区]
内容重点：[内容重点，例如：地形高程 / 城市地标 / 路网 / 水系 / 自然与城市关系 / 场景集合展示]
风格：{argument name="style" default="地理测绘风格、纸艺模型风格、建筑方案风格、博物馆档案风格、城市规划风格"}
主色调：[主色调，例如：米白色、浅灰色、羊皮纸白、沙色、雪白色]
辅色调：[辅色调，例如：大地棕、岩石灰、冷灰色、浅蓝色、苔藓绿]
点缀色：[点缀色，例如：细黑线、红色路线、蓝色水系线、黄色编号标记]
长宽比：[长宽比，例如：16:9 横屏 / 3:4 竖屏 / 4:5 竖屏 / 1:1 正方形]

[构图]
主体是一个放置在干净桌面或白布上的长方形地图项目。底板具有真实的厚度，边缘可见剖面结构，如同精致的地图切片或模型底座。地图表面覆盖着清晰但克制的信息层，包括等高线、路网、水系、区域边界、地理纹理、坐标感、细微注释和绘图边框。

在中心或偏中心区域，一个 3D 模型从 2D 地图中“生长”出来，成为整个图像的视觉核心。

若 [主题类型] 为自然地形：主体由山脉、峡谷、火山口、湖泊、盆地、岛屿、冰川、断层或海岸线组成，强调高程、分层等高线结构、岩壁纹理及自然地形起伏。

若 [主题类型] 为城市空间：主体由核心城区、CBD、老城街区、地标群、滨水区、道路节点、桥梁、水系或公园组成，强调建筑体量、城市特征、空间层次及规划结构。

若 [主题类型] 为混合景观：融合自然地形与人造环境，例如山城、岛屿城市、古代遗迹、末日废土、奇幻都城或科幻基地。

[细节要求]
- 表面保留地图纸张质感和专业信息感。
- 地形区域应具备等高线、坡度分层和凹陷感。
- 建筑区域应具备体量感、街区关系和清晰的层级。
- 水体使用低饱和度的浅蓝色。
- 绿地/森林使用苔藓绿或低饱和度绿色。
- 路网使用细线条，避免喧宾夺主。
- 地标应清晰可辨。
- 科幻/奇幻元素应保持档案模型感，而非纯粹的场景插画。

[注释系统]
地图项目边缘需要完整且克制的注释模块，包括边框线、比例尺、图例区、标题区、档案编号、索引标记、注释标签和简单的符号说明。文字无需完全可读，但必须呈现出真实、清晰、精确且有序的档案排版。

[相机与光影]
使用斜向俯视的等轴测或沙盘构图，相机角度约为 30 到 45 度，展示地图平面、模型高度、边缘厚度及注释区域。光影应柔和自然，在干净的背景上投射出细腻的真实阴影，避免卡通化或廉价的游戏 UI 感。

templates.title: 1980s Japanese film style storyboard

titleLocalized.zh: 1980 年代日本电影风格分镜脚本

templates.prompt: Drawing inspiration from recent Indian film dance scenes that use dance to abstractly express characters' emotions, create a video depicting the "expulsion of foreigners" fervor displayed by the attackers, led by Shinsaku Takasugi, on the eve of the arson attack on the British Legation on January 31, 1863. The scene should be set in an Edo-era town with a Western cinematic atmosphere. Characters should be based on online research of real historical figures, emphasizing their distinctive features to resemble characters from a period drama. To avoid rejection by video generation services, avoid sexual innuendo, violence, or elements similar to existing works. Image quality should achieve a realistic, photographic feel reminiscent of 1980s Japanese live-action films. Develop a storyboard and generate 8 landscape images (16:9 aspect ratio) for each shot in Seedance 2.0, from start to finish. n=8. The style should be bold and comedic, effectively utilizing close-ups. A 1980s Japanese film look, shot on 35mm film. It possesses a photochemical texture, organic graininess, subtle halos, smooth highlight transitions, slightly enhanced shadows, and realistic contrast, without digital sharpening or HDR. It was shot using a 35mm cinema camera equipped with a retro spherical prime lens. Lens specifications: 28mm, 35mm, 50mm, 85mm; 35mm and 50mm lenses were primarily used for dialogue and observational compositions. Shot at 24 fps, 180-degree shutter speed, with restrained shoulder-mounted and tripod shooting, and slow, deliberate camera movement. The lighting is natural and functional: a mix of fluorescent and tungsten indoor lighting, slightly underexposed, with soft shadows and realistic skin tones. The color palette is soft and earthy: browns, beige, olive, cream, soft reds, and a slight yellow-green fluorescence. The film-like texture is inspired by the Kodak Eastman 5247/5294. The overall feel is intimate, understated, dryly humorous, realistic, and melancholic, reminiscent of 1980s Japanese dramas. This is a musical film without dialogue. Through the techniques of dance scenes in Indian films, it portrays the "expulsion of foreigners" spirit of the attackers, led by Shinji Takasugi, on the eve of the arson attack on the British legation on January 31, 1863. The soundtrack consists of flashy, fast-paced songs similar to those used in Indian film dance scenes.

promptLocalized.zh: 借鉴近期印度电影舞蹈场景中通过舞蹈抽象表达角色情感的技巧，创作一段视频，描绘 1863 年 1 月 31 日英国公使馆纵火案前夕，以高杉晋作（Shinsaku Takasugi）为首的袭击者们所展现出的“攘夷”热情。场景设定在具有西方电影氛围的江户城镇。角色应基于对真实历史人物的网络研究，并强调其特征，使其看起来像时代剧中的人物。为避免被视频生成服务拒绝，请勿包含性暗示、暴力或与现有作品相似的元素。图像质量应呈现 1980 年代日本真人电影的写实照片质感。构思分镜脚本，并为 Seedance 2.0 的每个镜头从起始帧到结束帧生成 8 张横向图像（16:9 宽高比）。n=8。风格要大胆且具有喜剧色彩，有效利用特写镜头。1980 年代日本电影外观，使用 35mm 电影胶片拍摄。具有光化学质感、有机颗粒感、细微的光晕、柔和的高光过渡、略微提升的暗部、写实的对比度，无数字锐化，无 HDR。使用配备复古球面定焦镜头的 35mm 电影摄影机。镜头规格：28mm、35mm、50mm、85mm；对话和观察性构图主要使用 35mm 和 50mm 镜头。24 fps，180 度快门，克制的肩扛和三脚架拍摄，缓慢而从容的运镜。灯光自然且实用：混合荧光灯和钨丝灯室内照明，略微欠曝，柔和的阴影，真实的肤色。色调柔和且偏大地色：棕色、米色、橄榄色、奶油色、柔和的红色，并带有轻微的黄绿色荧光感。胶片质感灵感源自 Kodak Eastman 5247 / 5294。整体感觉亲切、内敛、冷幽默、写实且忧郁，如同 1980 年代的日本剧情片。这是一部音乐电影，没有对话，通过印度电影舞蹈场景的技巧，展现 1863 年 1 月 31 日英国公使馆纵火案前夕，以高杉晋作为首的袭击者们的“攘夷”精神。配乐为类似印度电影舞蹈场景的华丽快节奏歌曲。

templates.title: Luxury skincare advertisement with soft tones

titleLocalized.zh: 柔和色调奢华护肤广告

templates.prompt: Create a vertical luxury skincare advertisement using soft, feminine pastel tones, similar in style to popular beauty ads on Instagram or TikTok, and without any app UI. The image should center on a glass dropper serum placed on a fluffy lavender-purple surface, photographed using hyper-realistic studio lighting, with warm golden sunlight streaming in from the upper left, accompanied by soft shadows, shimmering reflections, a dreamy mist effect, and a creamy blurred background. The bottle label should display {argument name="brand name" default="ELEGANT SKINCARE"} and{argument name="product name" default="SERUM"} The bottle is made of a translucent, pale pinkish-purple material, fitted with a shimmering rose gold dropper cap. An elegant, feminine vanity is arranged around the product: a round, gold-framed mirror on the left, a white lit candle in a glass jar on the right, a pearl necklace hanging in the lower left foreground, and four clusters of white baby's breath placed in the left foreground, the middle left foreground near the mirror, the right foreground, and the far right edge. Cute white and purple hand-drawn doodle decorations are added: curved arrows pointing to the serum, glitter, small hearts, short decorative strokes, and small circles scattered around the composition. Two paper notes are included: one on the left side of the bottle reads…{argument name="left note text" default="My daily glow secret!"} The bottom right corner has a sign that says{argument name="right note text" default="Feels amazing!"} Place a small, round, lavender-colored sticker that reads "MUST HAVE" on the right-hand sticky note. Use a striking, dark purple handwritten title text at the top.{argument name="headline text" default="Glowy Skin In A Bottle"} Below is a torn white tape-style strip with the following text:{argument name="tagline text" default="Nourish • Hydrate • Glow"} Add smaller, dark purple text "For Soft, Smooth & Glowing Skin" to the upper right of the bottle, and repeat "For Soft, Smooth & Glowing Skin" at the bottom center. Below that, write "Self care Everyday" in a lighter, softer white tone. Keep the design simple, sophisticated, comfortable, luminous, and aesthetically pleasing, ensuring the serum becomes the visual focus.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖版奢华护肤广告，采用柔和女性化的粉彩色调，风格类似于 Instagram 或 TikTok 上的热门美妆宣传，且不含任何应用 UI。画面中心展示一瓶玻璃滴管精华液，放置在蓬松的薰衣草紫色表面上，采用超写实摄影棚灯光拍摄，左上方有温暖的金色阳光射入，伴随柔和阴影、光泽反射、梦幻雾感以及背景中奶油般的虚化效果。瓶身标签应显示 {argument name="brand name" default="ELEGANT SKINCARE"} 和 {argument name="product name" default="SERUM"}，瓶身为淡粉紫色的半透明材质，配有闪亮的玫瑰金滴管盖。产品周围布置优雅的女性化梳妆台：左侧放置 1 面金色边框圆形桌面镜，右侧放置 1 个玻璃罐装的白色点燃蜡烛，左下方前景处垂挂 1 条珍珠项链，并在左前景、镜子附近的左中景、右前景以及最右侧边缘放置 4 簇白色满天星花束。添加可爱的白色和紫色手绘涂鸦装饰：指向精华液的弯曲箭头、闪光点、小爱心、短装饰笔触以及散布在构图周围的小圆圈。包含 2 张纸质便签：瓶子左侧的一张写着 {argument name="left note text" default="My daily glow secret!"}，右下方的一张写着 {argument name="right note text" default="Feels amazing!"}；在右侧便签上贴 1 个写有“MUST HAVE”的小圆形薰衣草色贴纸。顶部使用醒目的深紫色手写标题文本 {argument name="headline text" default="Glowy Skin In A Bottle"}，下方配有一条撕裂的白色胶带风格条，内容为 {argument name="tagline text" default="Nourish • Hydrate • Glow"}。在瓶子右上方添加较小的深紫色文案“For Soft, Smooth & Glowing Skin”，并在底部中心重复“For Soft, Smooth & Glowing Skin”，下方以更浅的柔白色调写上“Self care Everyday”。保持构图简洁、高端、舒适、有光泽且极具美感，确保精华液成为视觉焦点。

templates.title: Luxury lavender skincare product advertisement

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华薰衣草护肤品广告

templates.prompt: This luxury women's skincare advertisement features a 9:16 vertical aspect ratio and a hyper-realistic studio close-up of the makeup product, with a dreamy soft-focus effect and warm golden morning light. In the center foreground, an elegant pump-style serum sits atop a fluffy lavender-purple faux fur surface. The bottle, made of translucent pale purple glass, features a shimmering metallic gold pump and neck, showcasing a sophisticated sheen, soft shadows, and subtle shimmer within the liquid. The label on the front is printed in gold serif font {argument name="brand name" default="LUMIÈRE"} The smaller text below is{argument name="product name" default="RADIANCE ELIXIR"} Next comes "NOURISH • HYDRATE • GLOW" and "FOR SOFT, SMOOTH & GLOWING SKIN," with tiny lettering at the bottom. The bottle is surrounded by a luxurious vanity setting: a magnificent vintage mirror in the background, a lit ribbed glass candle jar in the lower left, a faceted glass perfume bottle with a gold neck on the right, its surface adorned with a string of creamy pearls, and delicate white baby's breath embellishments on the sides and lower right foreground. The background uses soft beige and blush pink, with a creamy blurring effect, creating a comfortable, high-end beauty brand atmosphere. Cute white and purple hand-drawn graffiti elements are added: exactly three heart-shaped graffiti, two glitter/star graffiti, one small jagged graffiti, one curved arrow pointing towards the bottle, and two sets of short decorative lines above the title. Add exactly four handwritten sticky notes with a torn edge effect and a washi tape scrapbook style: the left sticky note reads "Self care ♡ Everyday," the top right sticky note reads "For Soft, Smooth & Glowing Skin.♡," the bottom right sticky note reads "Radiant Confident You ♡," and next to the candle is a purple heart-shaped sticker that says "Glow is my favorite color ♡." Place a striking, large handwritten title in the upper half.{argument name="headline text" default="Glowy Skin In A Bottle"} The text uses a white brush font with a soft, pale purple outline or halo. Below it is a horizontal, pale purple banner with a subtitle.{argument name="tagline text" default="Nourish • Hydrate • Glow"} The logo features a white handwritten font, a simple composition, and a sophisticated, elegant brand feel, making it suitable for viral beauty ads on Instagram/TikTok. It boasts exquisite, editor-quality product photography, a light purple and gold color scheme, and a comfortable and captivating atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh:
奢华女性护肤品广告，9:16 竖屏构图，超写实摄影棚美妆产品特写，带有梦幻般的柔焦效果和温暖的金色晨光。画面中央前景处放置一瓶优雅的按压式精华液，置于蓬松的薰衣草紫人造毛皮表面上。瓶身为半透明淡紫色玻璃材质，配有闪亮的金属金泵头和瓶颈，具有高级的光泽反射、柔和的阴影以及液体中细微的闪光。正面标签上用金色衬线字体印有 {argument name="brand name" default="LUMIÈRE"}，下方较小的文字为 {argument name="product name" default="RADIANCE ELIXIR"}，接着是“NOURISH • HYDRATE • GLOW”和“FOR SOFT, SMOOTH & GLOWING SKIN”，底部还有极小的规格文字。瓶身周围环绕着奢华的梳妆台布置：背景是一个华丽的复古镜子，左下方有一个点燃的罗纹玻璃蜡烛罐，右侧有一个带金颈的切面玻璃香水瓶，表面铺着一串奶油色珍珠，两侧及右下角前景点缀着轻盈的白色满天星。背景采用柔和的米色和腮红粉色，带有奶油般的虚化效果，营造出舒适的高端美妆品牌氛围。

添加可爱的白色和紫色手绘涂鸦元素：正好 3 个心形涂鸦、2 个闪光/星星涂鸦、1 个小锯齿形涂鸦、1 个指向瓶身的弯曲箭头，以及标题上方 2 组短装饰线条。添加正好 4 个带有撕边效果和胶带剪贴簿风格的手写便签贴纸：左侧便签写着“Self care ♡ Everyday”，右上角便签写着“For Soft, Smooth & Glowing Skin.♡”，右下角便签写着“Radiant Confident You ♡”，蜡烛旁贴着一个紫色心形贴纸，写着“Glow is my favorite color ♡”。在上半部分放置醒目的大号手写标题文字 {argument name="headline text" default="Glowy Skin In A Bottle"}，采用白色笔刷字体，带有柔和的淡紫色轮廓或光晕。下方放置一个水平的淡紫色笔触横幅，上面写着副标题 {argument name="tagline text" default="Nourish • Hydrate • Glow"}，采用白色手写字体。构图简洁，具有高级柔美的品牌感，适合 Instagram/TikTok 的病毒式美妆广告风格，精致的编辑级产品摄影，淡紫色与金色配色方案，舒适而迷人的氛围。

templates.title: Street photography of motorized tricycles in India

titleLocalized.zh: 印度机动三轮车街头摄影

templates.prompt: A realistic street photograph from India, taken vertically, shows a black and yellow motorized rickshaw directly behind the vehicle in a narrow, busy market street, with the vehicle centered in the frame. The camera is positioned low, directly behind the vehicle, creating a strong sense of symmetry, with the rickshaw occupying most of the frame. A striking large red lettering on the yellow canopy at the top reads:{argument name="top text" default="AB TO PEECHHAA CHHOD DO MERA"} Below the car window, on the black rear panel, are three lines of stacked, large, bold white text in capital letters, which read:{argument name="bottom text" default="ITNI BHI SUNDAR NAHI HU MAIN"} Inside the rear window is a print of a captivating female portrait with long, dark brown hair, seated sideways, revealing one bare shoulder and a black bra strap, resembling a poster pasted behind the glass; her face is blurred. The display showcases two rectangular taillights (one on each side), worn metal bumpers, fenders, faded paint, grime, scratches, and the vehicle's authentic signs of age. The street background includes market shops, signs, pedestrians on both sides, and some figures in the distance, but is kept softly blurred through shallow depth of field, keeping the rickshaw sharp. Warm sunlight, authentic Indian urban atmosphere, natural colors, subtle cinematic bokeh, high-detail textures, the realism of documentary street photography, 4K hyperrealism.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实的印度街头摄影图像，采用竖构图，展示了一辆黑黄相间的机动三轮车在狭窄繁忙的市场街道上的正后方视图，车辆位于画面中心。相机位置较低，直接位于车辆后方，营造出强烈的对称构图，三轮车占据了画面的大部分空间。顶部的黄色顶棚上有醒目的大写红色文字，内容为 {argument name="top text" default="AB TO PEECHHAA CHHOD DO MERA"}。车窗下方的黑色后挡板上有三行堆叠的大号加粗白色大写文字，内容为 {argument name="bottom text" default="ITNI BHI SUNDAR NAHI HU MAIN"}。后窗内有一张长深棕色头发的迷人女性肖像印刷品，她侧身而坐，露出一侧裸露的肩膀和黑色肩带，看起来像贴在玻璃后的海报；她的面部显得模糊不清。展示 2 个矩形尾灯（两侧各一个）、磨损的金属保险杠、挡泥板、磨损的漆面、污垢、划痕以及车辆真实的岁月痕迹。街道背景包含市场店铺、招牌、两侧的行人以及远处的一些人物，但通过浅景深处理保持柔和模糊，使三轮车保持清晰。温暖的日光，真实的印度城市氛围，自然色彩，微妙的电影级虚化，高细节纹理，纪实街头摄影的真实感，4K 超写实。

templates.title: Neutral tones minimalist studio portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 中性色调简约影棚人像

templates.prompt: A highly realistic studio portrait, featuring a woman in her twenties with a well-proportioned figure.{argument name="subject gender" default="woman"} The shot is taken from eye level, focusing on the upper body, and is centered against a smooth, warm beige studio background, free of clutter. She has thick, long hair, the color of which is {argument name="hair color" default="black"} Her hairstyle is a loose, slightly messy, natural wave, full of volume, softly parted in the middle, falling over her shoulders. She poses relaxed and confidently, facing the camera with a calm, neutral, and composed expression. She wears two visible layers: a pure white crew-neck T-shirt underneath a light, open, gray-brown casual zip-up jacket, presenting a minimalist modern street style in neutral tones. A delicate, small earring adorns one ear. Professional studio lighting was used, employing soft main light and gentle fill light to create natural shadows, realistic skin tone, and a subtle sense of depth against the background. Shot with an 85mm portrait lens at f/2.8, the subject is sharply focused with a shallow depth of field, presenting an edited, fashionable portrait style. Color balance is natural, minimal retouching is used, resulting in ultra-high-definition detail, no filters, no noise, no motion blur, and no cartoonish characteristics.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度写实的影棚人像，主体为一名 20 多岁、身材匀称的 {argument name="subject gender" default="女性"}，采用平视视角，胸部以上构图，居中置于平滑的暖米色影棚背景前，背景无杂物。她留着一头浓密的长发，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"}，发型为蓬松、略显凌乱的自然波浪卷，发量充盈，中分发缝柔和，垂落在双肩。姿态放松且自信，正对镜头，表情冷静、中性且从容。身着两层可见的服装：内搭纯白色圆领 T 恤，外穿一件敞开的轻薄灰褐色休闲拉链夹克，呈现出中性色调的极简现代街头风格。一侧耳朵上佩戴一枚精致小巧的耳环。采用专业影棚布光，使用柔和的正面主光、轻柔的补光，营造出自然的阴影，肤色真实，与背景有轻微的层次感。使用 85mm 人像镜头拍摄，光圈 f/2.8，主体对焦清晰，景深较浅，呈现编辑时尚人像风格，色彩平衡自然，极简修图，超高清细节，无滤镜，无噪点，无运动模糊，无卡通特征。

templates.title: Poster featuring a woman in a film noir style and a red halo.

titleLocalized.zh: 黑色电影风格女性与红色光环海报

templates.prompt: A minimalist art poster portrait depicting a woman in clean profile, facing right, showcasing approximately her upper body. Her face is partially obscured by a softly blurred rectangular effect in front of her head. She has deep black hair styled in a low, loose bun with natural volume and wispy strands, and a single silver pendant earring is visible on her ear. She is dressed in a structured black blazer or tailored coat with a deep collar. The lower half of the figure dissolves into elongated drops of black ink, with numerous uneven vertical stripes extending downwards like wet paint pulled by gravity, creating a dramatic, melting silhouette. A large, perfectly placed, bright red disc is placed directly behind her head and upper shoulders, centered like a halo or a rising sun. A strictly limited palette of black, red, and warm off-white is used. The background is set on soft cream-colored paper or a subtly textured canvas. The lighting employs a high-end film noir approach to portraiture, emphasizing strong contrasts and highlighting the contours of the ears, jawline, neck, and cheeks, while casting deep shadows on the clothing. The composition remains vertically centered with ample negative space, creating an elegant, poster-like balance and an atmosphere of melancholy contemplation, seamlessly blending crisp, refined photographic detail with painterly graphic design.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极简主义艺术海报肖像，画面为一位女性的干净侧面，面向右侧，展示范围约为上半身。她的面部被头部前方柔和的矩形模糊效果部分遮挡。她留着深黑色头发，梳成低垂的松散发髻，带有自然的蓬松感和细碎发丝，可见的耳朵上戴着 1 只银色吊坠耳环。为她穿上一件结构感十足的黑色西装外套或剪裁考究的大衣，领口深邃。人物下半部分溶解为拉长的黑色滴墨痕迹，许多不均匀的垂直条纹向下延伸，如同受重力牵引的湿颜料，营造出戏剧性的融化剪影。在她的头部和上肩部正后方放置 1 个巨大的、完美的鲜红色圆盘，如同光环或初升的太阳般居中。使用严格限制的黑色、红色和暖米白色调色板。背景设置为柔和的奶油色纸张或带有细微纹理的画布。以高端黑色电影编辑肖像的方式为拍摄对象布光，强调强烈的对比度，在耳朵、下颌、颈部和脸颊轮廓处雕琢出高光，并在服装上投下深邃的阴影。构图保持竖向居中，留有充足的负空间，呈现优雅的海报式平衡感，营造出忧郁沉思的氛围，并将清晰精致的摄影细节与绘画般的平面设计融为一体。

templates.title: Red Sun Man Poster in Noir Film Style

titleLocalized.zh: 黑色电影风格红日男子海报

templates.prompt: Create a minimalist vertical art poster featuring the profile of a man in a sharp suit, facing left, with the perspective rising from mid-thigh. He wears a well-tailored dark suit jacket, a crisp white shirt, and a vintage 1940s black fedora adorned with a ribbon. His posture is upright, composed, and confident, exuding the aura of a classic film noir protagonist. Render the figure in a refined monochrome photographic style, with clear details and strong tonal contrasts, employing dramatic lighting inspired by Rembrandt to delineate deep shadows on the cheeks, ears, jawline, hat brim, and shoulders. Place a striking, perfectly round red disc directly behind the head and upper body, centered like a halo or rising sun, creating a strong visual focal point. The background should be a clean, off-white or beige paper texture with a subtle grain, and ample white space should be maintained around the subject. The lower half of the figure should dissolve into thin, elongated black ink droplets: twelve distinct drips of varying thicknesses hang from the hem of the suit and the lower part of the body, some long and straight, others gradually tapering, accompanied by a few tiny splatters, as if the body is merging into the canvas. The color scheme is strictly limited to black, red, and warm gray-white. The overall atmosphere should be somber, contemplative, elegant, slightly ominous, and modern, resembling a high-end gallery poster combining film noir portraiture with surreal ink abstract art.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张极简主义竖版艺术海报，主体为一名身着干练西装的男子侧影，面向左侧，画面呈现从大腿中部向上的视角。他穿着剪裁得体的深色西装外套、挺括的白衬衫，并戴着一顶带有丝带装饰的 1940 年代复古黑色软呢帽。他的姿态挺拔、沉稳且自信，散发出经典的黑色电影主角气质。以精致的单色摄影风格渲染人物，细节清晰，色调对比强烈，并运用受伦勃朗启发的戏剧性光影，勾勒出脸颊、耳朵、下颌线、帽檐和肩部的深邃阴影。在头部和上半身的正后方放置一个醒目的正圆形红色圆盘，如同光环或初升的太阳般居中，形成强烈的视觉焦点。背景应为干净的灰白色或米色纸质纹理，带有细腻的颗粒感，并在主体周围保留充足的留白。人物下半身应溶解为细长的黑色墨滴：从西装下摆和身体下部垂下 12 条粗细不一的明显滴痕，有的长而直，有的逐渐变细，并伴有少量细小溅点，仿佛身体正在融入画布。配色方案严格限制在黑色、红色和温暖的灰白色。整体氛围应沉郁、深思、优雅、略带不祥且具有现代感，宛如一张将黑色电影肖像与超现实水墨抽象艺术相结合的高端画廊海报。

templates.title: Olive green T-shirt editorial style studio portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 橄榄绿 T 恤编辑风格影棚肖像

templates.prompt: A highly realistic studio portrait of a woman in her early twenties with a well-proportioned figure. The composition uses a level perspective, cropping to the upper body. She stands relaxed and confidently, shoulders straight, her expression calm, neutral, and exuding self-assurance. She has thick, long hair, a deep brown to almost black color, naturally voluminous and textured with a slightly off-the-shoulder parting, falling naturally over her shoulders. She wears two visible garments: an olive green fitted crew-neck T-shirt, layered under a light beige casual jacket, which is open and slips off her shoulders, creating a relaxed, editorial style. The color palette uses soft, neutral tones, primarily earth tones. An 85mm portrait lens with an f/2.8 aperture was used, with precise focus on the subject, resulting in a shallow depth of field and a soft, natural background blur. The lighting employed a professional studio setup: soft main light, subtle fill light to preserve soft shadow details, and subtle rim light to enhance the depth between the subject and background. The background is a clean, smooth studio backdrop, featuring a soft, warm beige-gray neutral gradient, free of any distracting elements. Skin tones are realistic and natural, with balanced color grading and minimalist post-processing. The overall style resembles a modern, casual street-style portrait, boasting exceptional detail, clean lines, and lifelike realism.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度逼真的影棚肖像，主角是一位 20 多岁、身材匀称的女性。构图采用平视视角，截取至上半身，她站姿放松而自信，双肩平直，表情平静、中性且充满自信。她拥有一头浓密的长发，发色为深棕色至近乎黑色，卷发自然蓬松且纹理清晰，发缝略微偏分，自然垂落在双肩。她身着两件可见的服饰：一件橄榄绿修身圆领 T 恤，外搭一件浅米色休闲外套，外套敞开并从双肩滑落，营造出一种随性的编辑风格。色彩采用柔和的中性色调，以大地色系为主。使用 85mm 人像镜头，光圈 f/2.8，焦点精准对准主体，景深较浅，背景呈现柔和的自然虚化效果。布光采用专业影棚设置：柔和的正面主光，细腻的补光以保留柔和的阴影细节，以及微弱的轮廓光以增强主体与背景的层次感。背景为干净平滑的影棚幕布，呈现柔和的暖米灰色中性渐变，无任何杂物干扰。肤色真实自然，调色平衡，后期处理极简，整体风格如同现代编辑风格的休闲街头时尚肖像，超高细节，干净且逼真。

templates.title: Film Era Layout Grid

titleLocalized.zh: 电影时代排版网格

templates.prompt: Create a clean 2x2 grid against a pristine white studio backdrop, showcasing four large 3D typographic sculptures, each character entirely constructed from filmmaking equipment from different eras. The four letterforms are precisely four characters: the letter A in the top left, the number 5 in the top right, the letter X in the bottom left, and the number 9 in the bottom right. Each character should be facing forward, centered in its respective quadrant, clearly discernible, yet composed of densely packed, realistic film tools and set props, possessing believable occlusion, weight, and structural logic. Visualized using high-end Cinema 4D products, it employs subtle ambient occlusion, soft three-point studio lighting (with a softbox at the top), sharp shadows, realistic materials, and independent composition. Top Left: The letter A, composed of equipment from early films and silent films, is assembled from a vintage wooden tripod, a hand-cranked film camera, brass lenses, film reels, megaphones, horn-shaped horns, matte black metal parts, belts, and aged wood. Surface textures should include worn varnished wood, black crackled paint, brass rust, worn metal, and dusty antique patina. The outline should appear cluttered yet recognizable, with tripod legs and old camera bodies outlining the shape of an "A." Top right: The number 5, composed of mid-20th-century analog filmmaking equipment, is assembled from classic film cameras, film canisters, metal cans, brown leather cases, audio accessories, silver fabric bags, director's chairs, cylindrical lenses, production equipment, and vintage production bags. Materials should emphasize brushed aluminum, leather, canvas, rubber, and weathered industrial finishes. The number 5 should appear solid and balanced, with props stacked tightly to form the letter. Bottom left: The letter X, composed of late 20th-century video and broadcast equipment, is assembled from shoulder-mounted cameras, portable recorders, battery packs, coiled cables, box modules, control panels, worn blue-grey plastic casings, and rugged field electronics. Visible wiring and tape-secured components are included. The materials should have a utilitarian and slightly worn feel, featuring dark plastic, anodized metal, stickers, rubber handles, and yellow accent details. The intersecting diagonals of the X must be sharp and solid. Bottom right corner: The number 9, composed of contemporary digital cinema and virtual production equipment, is assembled from modern cinema cameras, compact monitors, LED light panels, drones, stabilizers, light shields, black modular accessories, and a vibrant green screen that forms part of the digital design. It includes smooth vents, carbon fiber textures, matte black metal, polished glass, and a bright green screen fabric as the dominant accent color. The number 9 should appear as modern and sophisticated as possible, with modular precision and a clean, industrial design aesthetic. Keep the background clean and simple, without extra text, floating objects, flat typography, or 2D rendering. The sculpture should look like a realistically proportioned object, rich in detail, photorealistic, and suitable for use as graphic design material.

promptLocalized.zh:
在纯白色的工作室背景上创建一个整洁的 2x2 网格，展示 4 个大型 3D 排版雕塑，每个字符均完全由不同时代的电影制作设备构建而成。这四个字形精确为 4 个字符：左上角字母 A，右上角数字 5，左下角字母 X，右下角数字 9。每个字符应正对前方，位于各自象限的中心，清晰可辨，但由密集的逼真电影工具和片场道具堆叠而成，具有可信的遮挡关系、重量感和结构逻辑。使用高端 Cinema 4D 产品可视化技术，采用微妙的环境光遮蔽、柔和的三点式工作室布光（顶部配有柔光箱）、清晰的阴影、逼真的材质以及独立的构图。

左上角：由早期电影和默片时代设备构成的字母 A，由复古木制三脚架、手摇电影摄影机、黄铜镜头、胶片盘、扩音器、喇叭形号角、哑光黑色金属部件、皮带和陈旧木材组装而成。表面质感应包括磨损的清漆木材、黑色裂纹漆、黄铜锈迹、磨损的金属和布满灰尘的古董包浆。轮廓应显得杂乱但可辨认，三脚架腿和旧摄影机机身勾勒出 A 的形状。

右上角：由 20 世纪中期模拟电影制作器材构成的数字 5，由经典电影摄影机、胶片盒、金属罐、棕色皮箱、音频配件、银色织物包、导演椅、圆柱形镜头、场务器材和复古制作包组装而成。材质应强调拉丝铝、皮革、帆布、橡胶和风化的工业饰面。数字 5 应显得厚实且平衡，道具堆叠紧密，构成字形。

左下角：由 20 世纪末视频和广播设备构成的字母 X，由肩扛式摄像机、便携式录音机、电池组、盘绕电缆、盒式模块、控制面板、磨损的蓝灰色塑料外壳和坚固的现场电子设备组装而成。包含可见的布线和胶带固定的组件。材质应具有实用感且略显破旧，带有深色塑料、阳极氧化金属、贴纸、橡胶手柄和黄色点缀细节。X 的交叉对角线必须清晰且厚实。

右下角：由当代数字电影和虚拟制作器材构成的数字 9，由现代电影摄影机、紧凑型监视器、LED 灯板、无人机、稳定器、遮光斗、黑色模块化配件以及构成数字一部分的鲜艳绿色绿幕布组装而成。包含光滑的通风口、碳纤维纹理、哑光黑色金属、抛光玻璃，并以明亮的绿幕织物作为主导点缀色。数字 9 应显得最为现代和精致，具有模块化的精确性和简洁的工业设计感。

保持背景简洁明了，无额外文字，无漂浮物体，无平面排版，无 2D 渲染。雕塑应看起来像具有真实比例的实体物体，细节丰富，具有照片级真实感，适合作为平面设计素材使用。

templates.title: Film Era Layout Grid

titleLocalized.zh: 电影时代排版网格

templates.prompt: Create a clean 2x2 grid showcasing four forward-facing 3D typographic sculptures against a seamless light gray studio background divided by thin white lines. Each quadrant contains a giant letter, entirely constructed from dense, realistic film equipment and set props from different cinematic eras; the letter's shape, though seemingly chaotic, is clearly discernible. High-end Cinema 4D rendering aesthetics, ambient occlusion, realistic proportions, intricate assembly details, subtle wear, metallic reflections, and three-point studio lighting with a soft top light source are employed. Top left: The letter S, representing early silent or primitive cinema, is constructed from antique brass and wooden cameras, exposed gears, film reels, projector parts, bellows, wooden tripod legs, and vintage optical housings; warm bronze and copper tones; the bottom contains three additional props: a black megaphone labeled "DIRECTOR," a clapperboard, and a stack of short film reels; the top right corner features a projector-like lens emitting a bright light. Top right corner: The letter C represents classic Hollywood filmmaking, consisting of a black metal film camera, studio lenses, film canisters, lens hoods, track carriage components, control boxes, and simulated studio hardware; primarily black, steel, and gunmetal gray with subtle brass accents; the bottom and right side integrate four additional props: a clapperboard, a square side module, a film canister marked "35," and a small cylindrical jar; a large positive light or lens illuminates the top right corner. Bottom left corner: The letter N represents modern analog or late 20th-century cinema, assembled from an Arriflex-style camera, long film zoom lenses, support frames, tracks, cables, a clapperboard, and a live sound recorder; primarily matte black with silver hardware and a few red decorative rings; the bottom contains three clearly visible basic elements: a clapperboard section, a labeled director's bar, and a rectangular audio recorder/control unit at the bottom. Bottom right corner: The letter D, representing digital and virtual production, consists of a RED-style digital cinema camera, monitors, battery packs, wireless transmitters, drones, LED panels, green screen fabric inserts, and modular support components; a black technical body with vibrant green accents and screen graphics; it includes four distinct integrated equipment types: a drone arm/propeller at the top, a rectangular LED light panel, multiple monitors, and a large camera lens in the bottom left corner. All objects are grounded and physically connected; there are no suspended parts, no flat typography, no handwritten style, no paper texture, and no cluttered backgrounds. Ultra-fine, sharp, 8K, exquisite graphic design material suitable for posters or cinematic visual contrasts.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个干净的 2x2 网格，展示四个面向前方的 3D 排版雕塑，背景为浅灰色无缝工作室背景，由细白线分隔。每个象限包含一个巨大的字母，完全由来自不同电影时代的密集、逼真的电影设备和片场道具构建而成，字母形状虽然混乱但清晰可辨。采用高端 Cinema 4D 产品渲染美学、环境光遮蔽、逼真的比例关系、复杂的拼装细节、细微的磨损、金属反射以及带有柔和顶光源的三点式工作室照明。左上角：字母 S，代表早期默片或原始电影时代，由古董黄铜和木制相机、外露齿轮、胶片卷轴、放映机零件、皮腔、木制三脚架腿和复古光学外壳构成；暖青铜和铜色调；底部包含 3 个额外道具：一个标有“DIRECTOR”的黑色扩音器、一个场记板和一叠短胶片盒；右上角有一个类似放映机的镜头发出明亮的光。右上角：字母 C，代表古典好莱坞电影制作，由黑色金属电影摄影机、工作室镜头、胶片盒、遮光斗、轨道车组件、控制箱和模拟片场硬件构成；主要是黑色、钢色和枪灰色，带有细微的黄铜装饰；底部和右侧内部集成了 4 个额外道具：一个场记板、一个方形侧模块、一个标有“35”的胶片盒和一个小型圆柱形罐；右上角有一个大型正向灯或镜头发出光芒。左下角：字母 N，代表现代模拟或 20 世纪末电影，由 Arriflex 风格摄影机、长电影变焦镜头、支撑架、轨道、电缆、场记板和现场录音机组装而成；以哑光黑色为主，配有银色硬件和少量红色装饰环；底部包含 3 个清晰可见的基础元素：一个场记板部分、一个带标签的导演条和一个底部的矩形音频录音机/控制单元。右下角：字母 D，代表数字和虚拟制作，由 RED 风格数字电影摄影机、监视器、电池组、无线发射器、无人机、LED 面板、绿幕织物插件和模块化支架组件构成；黑色技术机身，带有鲜艳的绿色装饰和屏幕图形；包含 4 种显著的集成设备类型：顶部的无人机臂/螺旋桨、一个矩形 LED 灯板、多个监视器和一个左下角的大型相机镜头。保持所有物体接地并物理连接，没有悬浮部件，没有平面排版，没有手写风格，没有纸张质感，没有杂乱的背景。超精细、锐利、8k，适用于海报或电影时代视觉对比的精致图形设计素材。

templates.title: Glass AI Sphere in the Garden

titleLocalized.zh: 花园中的玻璃 AI 球体

templates.prompt: A dreamlike, surreal outdoor still life scene unfolds under the bright afternoon sun: a transparent glass sphere sits at the center of a lush, moss-covered mound. Inside the sphere is a minimalist white, glowing computer face icon with two vertical eyes within a rounded rectangle and a short horizontal line below, resembling a friendly terminal or chatbot symbol. A compact white mechanical keyboard sits directly in front of the sphere, presented in a perfect frontal view. Five clusters of flowers surround the base of the sphere: two clusters of blue hydrangeas, two clusters of white hydrangeas, and one cluster of light golden-brown flowers, nestled among dense green moss and delicate fern leaves. The background is a clear, azure sky dotted with four soft white clouds. Warm sunlight streams in from the upper left corner, creating a cinematic lens flare, shimmering highlights on the glass, a shallow depth of field, and a softly blurred effect on distant trees. The highly detailed, realistic 3D rendering exudes a fantastical, eco-futuristic atmosphere. The composition is simple, symmetrical, and centered, with reflective light creating a gentle summer ambiance.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个梦幻般的超现实户外静物场景，呈现于明亮的午后阳光下：一个透明玻璃球体置于郁郁葱葱的苔藓土丘中央，球体内包含一个极简主义的白色发光计算机面部图标，圆角矩形内有两只垂直的眼睛，下方有一条短横线，看起来像一个友好的终端或聊天机器人符号。球体正前方放置着一个紧凑的白色机械键盘，呈完美的正面视角。球体底部周围环绕着 5 簇花朵：2 簇蓝色绣球花、2 簇白色绣球花和 1 簇浅金棕色花朵，它们掩映在茂密的绿苔和精致的蕨类植物叶片中。背景是清澈湛蓝的天空，点缀着 4 朵柔软的小白云，温暖的阳光从左上角射入，带有电影级的镜头光晕，玻璃上闪烁着高光，浅景深效果，远处的树木呈现柔和的虚化效果，高度精致的写实 3D 渲染，充满奇幻的生态未来主义氛围，构图简洁，对称居中，光泽反射，营造出温和的夏日气息。

templates.title: Siren Back to Back Under Cherry Blossoms at Dusk

titleLocalized.zh: 樱花暮色下的背靠背海妖

templates.prompt: Two powerful fantasy women stand back-to-back in the center of a vast cherry blossom forest at dusk, their full-body heroic compositions rendered from a slightly upward angle, showcasing an ultra-refined, cinematic anime-style realism. The woman on the left possesses {argument name="left character hair color" default="Vibrant deep red"} She has a short, layered hairstyle, a fit and athletic figure, and a powerful and domineering aura. She wears a black and dark red strappy combat suit, paired with a short leather top, high-cut bottoms, thigh-high straps resembling garter stockings, flowing semi-transparent red ribbons, and long, shiny black arm guards. The woman on the right possesses {argument name="right character hair color" default="blonde hair with soft pink ends"} She had shoulder-length, wavy hair and a curvaceous figure, her arms, shoulders, ribs, and thighs covered in large floral tattoos. She wore a black and purple lace-up fantasy outfit with transparent purple fabric panels, chain embellishments, and black gloves. Their bare backs were pressed tightly together, facing opposite directions, exuding a calm and awe-inspiring confidence. Behind and beside them, two enormous, glowing energy swords were embedded in the ground: the one on the left emitted lava-like red-orange flames and ember-like cracks, while the one on the right emitted electric purple and cyan energy, its blade crackling with lightning. The scene was set amidst a breathtaking cherry blossom landscape, with dense pink cherry trees, countless petals swirling wildly in the air, a dramatic sunset sky filled with magenta, purple, and orange clouds, distant lightning, and the faint outline of a Japanese city with pagodas on the horizon. It emphasizes primal power, sensual elegance, high-contrast contour lighting, flowing fabric and hair, glowing particle effects, rich red and purple color contrasts, an epic fantasy atmosphere, ultra-detailed rendering, sharp focus on the two women, and painterly cinematic depth.

promptLocalized.zh: 两位强大的奇幻女性在黄昏时分广阔的樱花林中央背靠背站立，全身英雄构图，采用略微仰视的视角，呈现超精细的电影级动漫写实风格。左侧女性拥有 {argument name="left character hair color" default="鲜艳的深红色"} 短层叠发型，身材曲线健美，气场强悍霸气；她身穿黑色与深红色绑带战斗服，搭配短款皮质上衣、高叉下装、类似吊带袜的大腿绑带、飘逸的半透明红色丝带以及长款亮面黑色护臂。右侧女性拥有 {argument name="right character hair color" default="金发配柔和粉色发梢"} 的波浪形齐肩发，身材曲线健美，手臂、肩膀、肋骨和大腿上布满了大面积的花卉纹身；她身穿黑色与紫色绑带奇幻服装，带有透明的紫色布料拼接、链条装饰和黑色手套。她们赤裸的后背紧紧相贴，面朝相反方向，展现出冷静而令人敬畏的自信。她们身后和身侧的地面上插着 2 把巨大的发光能量剑：左侧的一把散发着熔岩般的红橙色火焰和类似余烬的裂纹，右侧的一把散发着电光紫和青色的能量，剑身上闪烁着雷电。场景设定在令人惊叹的樱花景观中，茂密的粉色樱花树，无数花瓣在空中剧烈旋舞，戏剧性的日落天空布满了洋红色、紫色和橙色的云彩，远处有闪电，地平线上隐约可见带有宝塔的日式城市景观。强调原始力量、感性优雅、高对比度的轮廓光、随风飘动的布料和头发、发光的粒子特效、浓郁的红紫色彩对比、史诗般的奇幻氛围、超精细渲染、对两位女性的清晰对焦以及绘画般的电影深度。

templates.title: Surreal planetary sculpture still life

titleLocalized.zh: 超现实行星雕塑静物

templates.prompt: The surreal still life presented in the dark void resembles a melancholic yet luxurious sculpture exhibition arranged under a single, soft light. At the center of the image is a massive, suspended sphere, occupying about a third of the canvas's height. Its translucent surface possesses the texture of swirling planetary gas clouds, its hues a soft blend of cyan, cream, gray, and pale gold. Below and around the sphere, a dense cluster of moss-like leaves and coral-like plants in olive green and bronze hues surround it. To the left, a cluster of tiny, luminous white-purple flowers adorns the scene, while to the right, a cluster of brighter white flowers adds vibrancy. Behind the sphere, two horizontal rectangular stone slabs float: to the left, a partially obscured dark smoky slab, and to the right, a larger, warm brown-gold marble slab with lightning-like veins. In the lower right foreground, a polished rectangular stone block, displaying black, gray, and white hues, features striking marble patterns. The ground has a smooth, matte surface, with a pale green oval patch of light gradually fading into darkness. Cinematic art photography style, surreal contemporary installation art, minimalist composition, strong negative space, soft halo, delicate film grain, low-key lighting, gloss and mineral texture, slightly retro color tone, high contrast but soft focus, creating an elegant and mysterious atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 在暗黑虚空中呈现的超现实静物，如同在单一柔光下布置的忧郁奢华雕塑展。画面中央是一个巨大的悬浮球体，占据了约三分之一的画幅高度，其半透明的表面呈现出如云雾缭绕的行星气带质感，色调为柔和的青色、奶油色、灰色和淡金色。球体下方及周围环绕着一团浓密的苔藓状叶片和橄榄绿与青铜色的珊瑚状植物，左侧点缀着一簇微小的发光白紫色花朵，右侧则是一簇更明亮的白色花朵。球体后方悬浮着 2 块水平长方形石板：左侧是一块部分遮挡的暗烟色石板，右侧是一块更大的暖棕金大理石纹石板，带有闪电般的脉络。右下方前景处放置着 1 块抛光长方形石块，呈现黑、灰、白三色，带有极具张力的大理石纹路。地面为平滑的哑光表面，有一处淡绿色的椭圆形光斑逐渐隐入黑暗。电影级艺术产品摄影风格，超现实当代装置艺术，极简构图，强烈的留白，柔和的光晕，细腻的胶片颗粒感，低调照明，光泽与矿物纹理，略带复古的调色，高对比度但对焦柔和，营造出优雅而神秘的氛围。

templates.title: Retro Chinese Food Map Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 复古中国美食地图海报

templates.prompt: A hand-drawn retro-style poster depicting Chinese tourism and food, using watercolor and ink painting techniques, presents a bird's-eye view of a misty mountain town. The composition is stylized.{argument name="place name" default="Jinyun"} The illustrated map features delicate rice paper textures against a soft beige background, adorned with bluish-gray mountains, winding rivers, country roads, ancient towns, unique rocks, and bamboo leaves. Pink flowers adorn the four corners. A striking artistic calligraphy title is located in the upper left corner.{argument name="headline text" default="Jinyun Mountain Wild Food Adventure Map"} Below is a small subtitle ribbon that reads "Huangdi Jinyun: A Fairyland on Earth." On the left is a poetic Chinese text: "Jinyun, a land of mountains and rivers, a fairyland of wonders and flavors of rural life; the warmth of human life follows delicious food; encounter Jinyun's landscape, a taste of home." The central location is the main urban area of ​​Jinyun County, marked "Jinyun County Town," surrounded by illustrated routes connecting various attractions and local delicacies. It includes 12 numbered food stations, each with a realistic hand-drawn food illustration next to its corresponding location on the map, along with an orange circular number, a Chinese label, and a brief description. The 12 stations are: 1. "Heyang Tushuang Noodles", described as "authentic mountain flavor, a taste of home cooking"; 2. "Jianchuan Bamboo Shoots and Vegetables", described as "seasonal mountain delicacies, dried and fragrant"; 3. "Jinyun Baked Cakes", described as "charcoal oven aroma, a signature dish of Jinyun"; 4. "Knocked Meat Soup", described as "fresh, fragrant, soft and glutinous, authentic local flavor"; 5. "Yanxia Stewed Soup", described as "slow-cooked with stone, warming and nourishing"; 6. "Fresh Stream Fish", described as "mountain and river delicacies, so fresh it'll make your eyebrows fall off"; 7. "Huzhen Wontons/Loucai", described as "traditional method, with a rich, chewy flavor, the more you eat, the more fragrant it becomes"; 8. "Kudzu Root Tofu", described as "refreshing and cleansing from the mountains"; 9. "Mountain Flour Dumplings", described as "thin skin and generous filling, a mountain flavor"; 10. "Bitter Acorn Tofu", described as "mountain forest delicacies, naturally fresh"; 11. "Farmhouse Steamed Rice Cake", described as "rich glutinous rice aroma, a taste of childhood"; 12. "Old Street Rice Cake" is described as "sweet and fragrant, handmade using traditional methods." The map is labeled with eight place names: "Xinjian Town," "Huzhen Town," "Dayang Town," "Xiandu Scenic Area," "Heyang Ancient Residences," "Yandang Study," "Jiaolong Grand Canyon," and "Jinyun County." Distinctive scenic clusters are depicted, including traditional white-walled, black-tiled houses, steep karst peaks, bridges, and terraced fields. A small legend box is added to the lower right corner, containing five items: "Mountains," "Rivers," "Main Roads," "Townships," and "Scenic Landmarks," as well as a sixth food icon label, "Food Recommendations." A decorative compass rose is also included nearby. The overall atmosphere is elegant, ingenious, nostalgic, and sophisticated, resembling a cultural tourism poster combining a local food guide with scenic map illustrations—well-composed and exuding brand appeal.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张手绘复古中国旅游美食地图海报，采用水彩与水墨画风格，以俯瞰视角呈现云雾缭绕的山区县城景观。构图为一张风格化的 {argument name="place name" default="缙云"} 插画地图，带有淡雅的宣纸纹理，背景为柔和的米色，点缀着青灰色山脉、蜿蜒河流、乡村公路、古镇、奇石、竹叶，四角以粉色花卉装裱。左上角为醒目的艺术书法标题 {argument name="headline text" default="缙云 山野美食暴走地图"}，下方配有小型副标题丝带，写着“黄帝缙云·人间仙都”。左侧添加一段诗意中文文本：“山水缙云，仙都奇境 百味乡野，烟火人间 跟着美食，遇见缙云 一城山水，一口乡愁”。中心位置为标注“缙云县城”的县城主城区，周围环绕着连接各个景点与当地美食的插画路线。包含 12 个带编号的美食站点，每个站点在地图对应位置旁配有一份写实风格的食物手绘图，并带有橙色圆形数字、中文标签及一行简短描述。12 个站点分别为：1 “河阳土爽面”，描述为“山野本味，宾客烟火”；2 “笕川笋干菜”，描述为“时令山珍，晒干留香”；3 “缙云烧饼”，描述为“炭炉焦香，卷云招牌”；4 “敲肉羹”，描述为“鲜香软糯，地道乡味”；5 “岩下炖汤”，描述为“石材慢炖，暖身养胃”；6 “溪鱼鲜”，描述为“山水河鲜，鲜掉眉毛”；7 “壶镇扁食/落菜”，描述为“古法胶味，越吃越香”；8 “葛根豆腐”，描述为“山野清润，解腻爽口”；9 “山粉饺”，描述为“皮薄馅足，山野风味”；10 “苦槠豆腐”，描述为“山林珍味，自然本鲜”；11 “农家焐年糕”，描述为“糯香浓郁，儿时味道”；12 “老街米糕”，描述为“清甜米香，古法手工”。地图上标注 8 个地名标签：“新建镇”、“壶镇镇”、“大洋镇”、“仙都景区”、“河阳古民居”、“岩宕书房”、“蛟龙大峡谷”以及“缙云县城”。绘制具有辨识度的风景群落，包括白墙黑瓦的传统民居、陡峭的喀斯特峰林、桥梁及梯田地貌。右下角添加一个小型图例框，包含 5 个项目：“山脉”、“河流”、“主要道路”、“乡镇”和“景点地标”，以及第六个美食图标标签“美食推荐”。附近包含一个装饰性的罗盘玫瑰。整体氛围优雅、匠心独运、怀旧且高级，宛如一张结合了地方美食指南与风景地图插画的文化旅游海报，构图精良，品牌感十足。

templates.title: Macro photography of bursting soap bubbles

titleLocalized.zh: 肥皂泡破裂微距摄影

templates.prompt: A high-speed macro photograph of a bursting soap bubble, taken in a sunny garden, using a horizontal composition. On the far left of the image, a toddler's profile is shown, revealing their cheek, nose, lips, and partially closed or half-closed eyes, gently blowing on the soap bubble. A large soap bubble is placed on the left side of the frame. The left half of the bubble remains intact, appearing as a smooth, glossy, iridescent sphere with vibrant colors and strong reflective highlights, including bright sunlight spots above and reflections of trees and garden scenery on its surface. The right half of the bubble bursts outward, creating countless tiny droplets, mist, and delicate web-like liquid threads, clearly captured in mid-air and spreading to the right of the image. The dramatic transition between the intact sphere and the bursting spray is emphasized. The photograph was taken using bright direct sunlight, an extremely high shutter speed, sharp macro details, high contrast, saturated colors, and a blurred background of dark green leaves, exhibiting a Kodak Ektar 100 film-like quality. Hyper-realistic, ultra-detailed, freezes dynamic moments, shallow depth of field.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张在阳光明媚的花园中拍摄的肥皂泡破裂高速微距照片，采用横向构图。在画面最左侧，展示一名幼童的侧脸，可见其脸颊、鼻子、嘴唇以及部分闭合或半闭的眼睛，正对着肥皂泡轻轻吹气。在画面中左侧放置 1 个大肥皂泡。肥皂泡的左半部分保持完整，呈现为一个光滑、有光泽且带有虹彩的球体，色彩鲜艳，并有强烈的反光高光，包括上方的明亮太阳光斑以及表面反射出的树木和花园景色。肥皂泡的右半部分向外爆裂，形成无数细小的水滴、薄雾和纤细的网状液体丝，在半空中被清晰地定格，并向画面右侧扩散。强调完整球体与破碎喷溅之间的戏剧性过渡线。使用明亮的直射阳光、极高的快门速度、清晰的微距细节、高对比度、饱和的色彩，背景为虚化处理的深绿色叶片，并呈现出 Kodak Ektar 100 胶片质感。超写实、超细节、定格动态瞬间、浅景深。

templates.title: A cinematic "Last Supper" scene

titleLocalized.zh: 电影质感“最后的晚餐”场景

templates.prompt: A cinematic depiction based on a historical setting, the scene being{argument name="scene subject" default="Jesus and his disciples at the Last Supper"} The setting is a simple, ancient Middle Eastern restaurant at night. The perspective is an immersive close-up, level with the table, as if the viewer were sitting among them. The scene should include 13 men sitting closely around a long, narrow table. The central figure, through his composed demeanor, shoulder-length dark brown hair, beard, and the off-white robe with a light beige shawl, is clearly identified as Jesus. The 12 disciples should vary in age and appearance, with curly or wavy dark hair and beards, wearing robes in earth tones such as cream, brown, tan, soft blue, and dusty gray, leaning inwards, talking or listening intently. The room should have rough stucco walls, exposed dark wooden ceiling beams, a heavy wooden door at the back, simple wall niches, and small oil lamps or candlesticks casting a warm amber glow. The table should be set with simple food and tableware characteristic of the era: round flatbreads, grapes, olives, shallow bowls, earthenware plates, ceramic cups, and bronze or ceramic goblets, with a small candle near the center to create a visual focal point. The composition should be broad yet intimate, with a slightly crowded foreground edge, and some figures should be moderately cropped to enhance realism and immersion. The lighting should be low, golden, and dramatic, accompanied by soft shadows, a dignified atmosphere, realistic skin tones, natural fabric folds, and rich cinematic contrast. Rendered in a realistic style, it should present ultra-fine textures, subtle depth of field, and convey the emotional tone of a historical biblical film still.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张具有电影质感且基于历史背景的描绘，场景为 {argument name="scene subject" default="耶稣与门徒共进最后的晚餐"}，地点位于夜晚一间朴素的古代中东餐厅内。视角采用沉浸式的近景，高度与餐桌齐平，仿佛观众正坐在他们中间。画面中需包含 13 位男子紧凑地围坐在一张狭长的餐桌旁，中心人物通过其沉稳的气质、齐肩深棕色长发、胡须以及身穿的米白色长袍配浅米色披肩，清晰地呈现为耶稣形象。12 位门徒在年龄和外貌上应有所差异，留着卷曲或波浪状的深色头发和胡须，身穿奶油色、棕色、棕褐色、柔和蓝色和灰尘色等大地色系长袍，身体向内倾斜，正在交谈或专注聆听。房间应具有粗糙的灰泥墙壁、裸露的深色木质天花板横梁、后方的一扇厚重木门、简单的墙壁壁龛，以及投射出温暖琥珀色光芒的小油灯或烛台。餐桌上应摆放符合时代特征的质朴食物和器皿：圆形扁面包、葡萄、橄榄、浅碗、陶盘、陶瓷杯以及铜制或陶制高脚杯，中心附近的一支小蜡烛营造出视觉焦点。构图应宽广而亲密，前景边缘略显拥挤，部分人物被适度裁剪以增强真实感和沉浸感。灯光应低沉、金黄且富有戏剧性，伴有柔和的阴影、庄重的氛围、真实的肤色、自然的织物褶皱以及丰富的电影对比度。以写实风格渲染，呈现超精细的纹理、微妙的景深，并传达出历史圣经电影剧照的情感基调。

templates.title: The Last Supper selfie scene

titleLocalized.zh: 最后的晚餐自拍场景

templates.prompt: This is a cinematic, photorealistic reconstruction of "The Last Supper," presenting a self-portrait scene brimming with a sense of modern displacement, set within a dimly lit, ancient stone chamber. [Exhibition]{argument name="central figure" default="Jesus"} Seated at the center of a long, rustic wooden table, dressed in a dark earth-toned biblical robe, one arm outstretched to the camera, he holds a modern black smartphone for a group selfie. Around him, twelve disciples huddle closely around the table, making a total of thirteen, all dressed in simple first-century robes of beige, brown, taupe, soft blue, and cream. The composition should create an intimate, slightly humorous yet authentic atmosphere, with each person tilting towards the phone as if posing for a photo. Warm candlelight and soft firelight, with a few candles visible on the table and in wall niches, create amber highlights, deep shadows, and a sacred, old-world ambiance. The table is set with rustic pottery, clay cups, wooden bowls, torn flatbread, and simple food. The background should feature rough plastered stone walls, hanging curtains, wooden pegs, and sparse historical decorations. Using a mobile phone camera perspective to create a mid-range wide-angle group portrait composition, it features shallow depth of field, cinematic realism, delicate fabric textures, natural skin tones, and rich warm brown tones.

promptLocalized.zh: 这是一幅电影质感、照片级写实的“最后的晚餐”重构作品，呈现了一个充满现代时代错位感的自拍场景，地点位于昏暗的古老石室内。展示 {argument name="central figure" default="耶稣"} 坐在长条质朴木桌的正前方中央，身穿深色大地色系的圣经长袍，一只手臂伸向镜头，手持一部现代黑色智能手机进行集体自拍。在他周围，12 位门徒紧密地簇拥在桌子旁，总共 13 人，他们都穿着米色、棕色、灰褐色、柔和蓝色和奶油色的简约一世纪长袍。构图应营造出亲密且略带幽默但又不失真实感的氛围，每个人都向手机倾斜，仿佛正在摆姿势拍照。使用温暖的烛光和柔和的火光照明，桌上和墙壁壁龛中可见几支蜡烛，营造出琥珀色的高光、深邃的阴影和神圣的旧世界氛围。桌上摆放着质朴的陶器、粘土杯、木碗、撕开的扁面包和简单的食物。背景应呈现粗糙的抹灰石墙、悬挂的布帘、木钉和稀疏的历史装饰。以手机摄像头的视角进行中景广角群像构图，具有浅景深、电影级写实感、细腻的织物纹理、自然的肤色以及浓郁的暖棕色调。

templates.title: Nostalgic Youthful Memories Photo Wall

titleLocalized.zh: 怀旧青春记忆照片墙

templates.prompt: A nostalgic collage containing 16 snapshots of youth, arranged in a neat 4x4 grid with a square composition, reminiscent of fictional memories from Japanese coming-of-age films. It showcases the time spent together by a couple or a small group of college students, imbued with a dreamy, sensual atmosphere. The photos feature soft blue and pink tones, a slight film grain, low-light halos, motion blur, shallow depth of field, and the imperfect quality of casual mobile phone photography. The main, recurring subject is a young woman with {argument name="hair style" default="shortwave head"} Young women, wearing{argument name="top color" default="White or light gray knit top"} The image shows a young man with dark hair, wearing a casual dark jacket or a light-colored hoodie, who appears to be close friends or a shy couple. All visible faces are deliberately obscured by soft, rectangular blurs, but the body language remains warm, intimate, and natural. Contains 16 squares: 1) A solo woman's street portrait at night; 2) A man and woman side-by-side in an outdoor photo at night with city lights as the background; 3) Two friends taking a close-up selfie indoors, side-by-side; 4) An indoor photo near curtains; 5) A blurred street selfie of two people moving; 6) A cozy cafe table scene with drinks on the table, the woman touching her face, and the man sitting opposite her; 7) A spring park scene under blooming cherry blossoms; 8) A playful outdoor shot with hands partially obscuring the lens; 9) An indoor sofa or booth snapshot, one person holding a small camera; 10) A viewpoint or rooftop shot during the Blue Hour, with city lights as the background, two people standing together; 11) A portrait of two friends by the water at night or against a backdrop of city lights; 12) A close-up snapshot of two people side-by-side at night; 13) A heavily blurred close-up selfie, one person in motion; 14) An indoor snapshot in a mirrored area or restaurant, one person holding a camera; 15) A casual indoor pose with a peace sign next to a brick or tile wall; 16) A picnic scene in the park, with snacks on the table, and one of the friends holding a camera. Overall feeling: nostalgic, cinematic, intimate, youthful, spontaneous, and bittersweet, like a scrapbook of memories that never really happened.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张怀旧的拼贴画，包含 16 张青春抓拍照片，以整洁的 4x4 网格排列，方形构图，风格如同日本青春电影中虚构的记忆。展示一对或一小群大学生在日夜相处的时光，带有梦幻般的感性氛围，呈现柔和的蓝粉色调、轻微的胶片颗粒感、弱光下的光晕、动态模糊、浅景深，以及随意手机摄影的不完美质感。主要反复出现的主角是一位留着 {argument name="hair style" default="短波波头"} 的年轻女性，穿着 {argument name="top color" default="白色或浅灰色针织上衣"}，以及一位留着深色头发、穿着休闲深色外套或浅色连帽衫的年轻男性，他们看起来像是亲密的朋友或羞涩的情侣。所有可见的面部均被柔和的矩形模糊块刻意遮挡，但肢体语言依然温暖、亲密且自然。包含 16 个方格：1) 女性独自一人的夜间街头肖像，2) 夜间男女并肩的户外合影，背景是城市灯光，3) 两位朋友肩并肩的室内近距离自拍，4) 窗帘附近的室内合影，5) 两人移动中的模糊街头自拍，6) 舒适的咖啡馆餐桌场景，桌上有饮料，女性在摸脸，男性坐在对面，7) 樱花盛开下的春季公园场景，8) 手部部分遮挡镜头的俏皮户外拍摄，9) 室内沙发或卡座快照，其中一人拿着小型相机，10) 蓝色时刻的观景台或屋顶镜头，背景是城市灯光，两人站在一起，11) 夜间水边或城市灯光背景下的两位朋友肖像，12) 两人并肩的夜间近距离快照，13) 严重模糊的近距离自拍，其中一人处于动态中，14) 室内镜子区域或餐厅快照，其中一人举着相机，15) 砖墙或瓷砖墙旁的室内休闲比耶姿势，16) 公园野餐场景，有零食，其中一位朋友拿着相机对着镜头。整体感觉：怀旧、电影感、亲密、青春、自发且苦乐参半，就像一本从未真正发生过的记忆剪贴簿。

templates.title: Androgynous street style fashion magazine portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 中性街头风时尚杂志肖像

templates.prompt: A high-end fashion portrait, featuring a {argument name="subject gender" default="woman"} The subject, aged between mid-30 and early 40, has a naturally proportionate figure. The composition focuses on her upper body, from the waist down to her upper thighs. She stands with a relaxed and confident posture, hands in her pockets. She has long, wavy, dark chestnut brown hair, parted in the middle and falling naturally over her shoulders; she wears small gold hoop earrings, a delicate gold necklace, and a thin bracelet. Her clothing is a modern, minimalist, casual streetwear style with soft, neutral tones: an open light beige zip-up jacket over a fitted white cropped vest, paired with matching light beige drawstring jogging pants. The shot was taken at eye level using an 85mm portrait lens at f/2.8 to ensure a sharp subject and shallow depth of field. Professional studio lighting was used, with a softbox positioned to the left front as the main light, supplemented by subtle fill light to soften shadows, and a soft, warm rim light added to the hair and shoulder edges to enhance the sense of depth. The background should be a clean studio backdrop with a smooth gradient from grayish-brown to warm gray, free of clutter. The image should have a highly realistic and magazine-quality feel, with natural skin tones, balanced color gradation, extremely high detail, clear fabric textures, soft and natural shadows, no noise, no motion blur, no cartoonish style, and no anatomical distortion.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高端时尚摄影肖像，主体为一位 {argument name="subject gender" default="女性"}，年龄在 30 岁中期至 40 岁出头，体态自然匀称。构图为半身至大腿上部，她以放松且自信的姿态站立，双手插在裤兜里。她留着深栗棕色的长波浪卷发，中分发型自然垂落在肩头；佩戴一对小巧的金色圆环耳饰，颈间戴着精致的金色项链，手腕处有一条细手链。服装为现代极简休闲街头风，色调柔和中性：外搭一件敞开的浅米色拉链夹克，内穿修身白色短款背心，下身搭配同色系浅米色抽绳慢跑裤。采用平视角度拍摄，使用 85mm 人像镜头，光圈 f/2.8，确保主体清晰锐利，并呈现浅景深效果。使用专业影棚布光，左前方设置 1 个柔光箱作为主光，辅以微妙的补光以柔化阴影，并在发丝和肩部边缘增加 1 道柔和的暖色轮廓光以增强立体感。背景为干净的影棚幕布，呈现平滑的灰褐色至暖灰色渐变，无杂乱元素。画面应极具写实感与杂志质感，肤色自然，色彩分级平衡，细节超高，织物纹理清晰，阴影柔和自然，无噪点，无运动模糊，无卡通风格，且无任何解剖结构畸变。

templates.title: Women riding motorcycles on cliff roads

titleLocalized.zh: 骑摩托车行驶在悬崖公路上的女性

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_1 as the character base and REFERENCE_0 as the scene/atmosphere reference, the same woman is regenerated into a pixel art-style action shot: she is riding a motorcycle on a narrow cliffside coastal road at sunset. The composition is changed from a close-up portrait to a wider, cinematic full-body perspective, with the motorcycle traveling towards the observer along a winding road carved into the steep coastal cliffs. Her brown leather jacket and overall styling are maintained, but her hair is allowed to flow in the wind, and she is posed with both hands gripping the handlebars. The dramatic drop in ocean elevation on the left, the rocky cliffs on the right, and the warm orange-purple sunset sky are emphasized. The retro 16-bit pixel art aesthetic is preserved.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_1 作为角色基础，REFERENCE_0 作为场景/氛围参考，将同一位女性重新生成为像素艺术风格的动作镜头：她正骑着摩托车行驶在日落时分狭窄的悬崖沿海公路上。将构图从近景人像改为更宽广的电影级全身视角，摩托车正朝着观察者方向行驶在开凿于陡峭海边悬崖的蜿蜒道路上。保持她棕色皮夹克和整体造型的一致性，但让她的头发在风中飘动，并摆出双手握住车把的姿势。强调左侧壮观的海洋落差、右侧岩石峭壁以及温暖的橙紫色日落天空。保持复古的 16 位像素艺术美学。

templates.title: Luxury magazine covers and selected books showcase

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华杂志封面与精选书籍展示

templates.prompt: A photorealistic high-end magazine cover, employing international design and commercial publication styles, presents an exquisite editorial still-life photography effect. The cover background is a dimly lit, atmospheric interior space with shallow depth of field and warm ambient light. On the right center, a cream-colored paperback book stands upright on a glossy black marble table; the title is {argument name="book title" default="The Pathless Path"} The author is{argument name="author name" default="Paul Millerd"} The books are tilted slightly to the left to display both the cover and spine. The cover illustration is a minimalist dark blue line drawing depicting an office interior scene: an open door leading to a winding outdoor path, framed pictures on the wall, a water dispenser, a desk piled high with files, and a person slumped in an office chair. The author's name appears near the lower left corner of the cover, and the title is printed vertically on the spine. To the left of the books on the marble tabletop is a small stack of four blurred books, with a dark coffee cup with a tray in the lower left foreground. The background is a dimly lit, elegant room with blurred shelves and soft green plant silhouettes. The magazine masthead occupies the top:{argument name="magazine title" default="MONOCLE"} It features a large white serif font spanning the entire width, with a smaller white issue number in the upper left corner.{argument name="issue text" default="MAY 2024 • ISSUE 167"} The top right corner features a small white tagline reading "THE ENTREPRENEURS' MAGAZINE". Below the masthead is a thin line and a small gold serif font category bar containing six categories separated by dots: "AFFAIRS • BUSINESS • CULTURE • DESIGN • ENTERTAINING • FASHION". On the left, a prominent white serif headline reads "Rethinking Success". Below this is a white serif subheading about breaking free from default paths and building meaningful lives and work, followed by a small gold page number. The lower left sidebar contains four editorial preview blocks, each with a gold circular icon, a gold capital title, white descriptive text, and a gold page number. These four titles are "ESCAPE THE DEFAULT", "WORK WITH PURPOSE", "A NEW STORY", and a framed preview "DESIGN SPECIAL". The bottom right corner features a realistic barcode block with small price text above and a small issue number next to it. The overall layout should convey the feel of a real luxury magazine cover mockup: clear typography, elegant serif fonts, black and white cream gold color scheme, marble-like glossy reflections, cinematic shadows, delicate product reflections below the book, and a high-end editorial photography style.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张照片级逼真的高端杂志封面，采用国际设计与商业出版物风格，呈现出精致的编辑静物摄影效果。封面背景为光线昏暗、氛围感十足的室内空间，具有浅景深和温暖的环境光。在右侧中央，一张光亮的黑色大理石桌上竖立着一本奶油色的平装书，书名为 {argument name="book title" default="The Pathless Path"}，作者为 {argument name="author name" default="Paul Millerd"}。书籍略微向左倾斜，以便同时展示封面和书脊。封面插图为极简主义的深蓝色线条画，描绘了一个办公室内部场景：一扇通往蜿蜒户外小径的敞开大门、墙上的相框、饮水机、堆满文件的办公桌，以及一个瘫坐在办公椅上的人。作者姓名出现在封面左下角附近，书名也垂直印在书脊上。在大理石桌面的书籍左侧，有一小叠 4 本虚化处理的书籍，左下角前景处放着 1 个带托盘的深色咖啡杯。背景是一个昏暗而优雅的房间，带有模糊的货架和柔和的绿色植物轮廓。杂志刊头占据了顶部：{argument name="magazine title" default="MONOCLE"}，以巨大的白色衬线字体横跨整个宽度，左上角有小号白色期号文字 {argument name="issue text" default="MAY 2024 • ISSUE 167"}，右上角有小号白色标语文字“THE ENTREPRENEURS’ MAGAZINE”。刊头下方是一条细线和一行小号金色衬线字体的分类栏，包含 6 个以圆点分隔的类别：“AFFAIRS • BUSINESS • CULTURE • DESIGN • ENTERTAINING • FASHION”。在左侧，醒目的白色衬线大标题写着“Rethinking Success”。下方是关于告别默认路径、构建有意义的生活与工作的白色衬线副标题，随后是一个小的金色页码。左侧栏下方有 4 个编辑预告块，每个块都配有一个金色圆形图标、金色大写标题、白色描述性文字和一个金色页码。这 4 个标题分别是“ESCAPE THE DEFAULT”、“WORK WITH PURPOSE”、“A NEW STORY”以及一个带框的预告“DESIGN SPECIAL”。右下角是一个逼真的条形码块，上方有小号价格文字，旁边有小号期号。整体布局应呈现出真实奢华杂志封面样机的质感：清晰的排版、优雅的衬线字体、黑白奶油金配色、大理石上的光泽反射、电影般的阴影、书籍下方细腻的产品倒影，以及高端的编辑摄影风格。

templates.title: Minimalist SVG Pelican on a Bicycle

titleLocalized.zh: 极简 SVG 骑自行车的鹈鹕

templates.prompt: A minimalist flat vector illustration against a light gray background depicts a stylized pelican riding a bicycle. The image is composed of simple geometric SVG shapes with bold, dark charcoal outlines and clean details. The bicycle, presented in a side view, has two large wheels, each with a round rim and a simple four-spoke cross, along with a black frame, seat, cranks, and handlebars, with a thin horizontal line at the bottom. The pelican's form is abstract and slightly clumsy, constructed from clean outlines: a white, rounded oval body positioned above the bicycle; two narrow, orange-yellow leg shapes extending downwards to the pedals; a white neck and head stretching forward, featuring a small black eye, a long, triangular, orange-yellow upper beak, and a large, pale pink throat pouch. A single, upward-sloping white wing shape is added above the body. The composition is deliberately simple and slightly imperfect, like an SVG demo drawing generated from code in a code editor screenshot, but only rendering the artwork itself, without any interface, text, shadows, or additional backgrounds.

promptLocalized.zh: 在浅灰色背景上呈现一幅极简主义的扁平矢量插画，描绘了一只风格化的鹈鹕骑着自行车。图像由简单的几何 SVG 形状组成，带有深炭色的粗轮廓和简洁的细节。自行车以侧视图呈现，拥有 2 个大轮子，每个轮子配有圆形轮辋和简单的 4 辐条十字架，以及黑色的车架、车座、曲柄和车把，底部有一条细长的水平地面线。鹈鹕造型抽象且略显笨拙，由干净的轮廓形状构建而成：身体呈白色圆椭圆形，位于自行车上方；2 条窄窄的橙黄色腿部形状向下延伸至踏板；白色的颈部和头部向前伸展，配有 1 只黑色小眼睛、1 个长三角形的橙黄色上喙和 1 个巨大的淡粉色下喉囊。在身体上方添加一个向上倾斜的独立白色翅膀形状。保持构图刻意简洁且略带不完美感，如同代码编辑器截图中通过代码生成的 SVG 演示绘图，但仅渲染艺术作品本身，不包含任何界面、文字、阴影或额外背景。

templates.title: Neurons on the San Francisco Tram

titleLocalized.zh: 旧金山叮当车上的神经元

templates.prompt: A fantastical, cinematic portrait depicts an anthropomorphic neuron riding the outer footboard of a classic San Francisco cable car during prime time. The character possesses a massive, circular neuronal head with dozens of long dendrites radiating outwards like a crown, displaying a texture of pale purple, magenta, and flesh-gray with a subtle organic sheen. The face is blurred and featureless. The figure is dressed in Victorian or Edwardian gentleman's attire: a dark tweed jacket, patterned vest, shirt, tie, pinstripe trousers, polished brown shoes, and a pocket watch chain. One hand grips the brass pole of the cable car, while the other holds a vintage transit ticket inscribed "MUNICIPAL RAILWAY SAN FRANCISCO ADMIT ONE," accompanied by a small, round lapel badge bearing the word "MUNI." A slender, purple, axonal tail curls behind the body. The cable car is richly detailed, made of lacquered wood and brass, with a route sign on the side reading "POWELL AND MARKET / HYDE AND BEACH / FISHERMANS WHARF". The background shows a steep San Francisco street, with the cable car track extending into the distance. A second cable car is visible below a hillside in the distance, flanked by dense city buildings, and the Coit Tower is visible on the hazy mountaintop. The warm, nostalgic lighting, shallow depth of field, ultra-fine textures, surrealism, humorous yet elegant atmosphere, and centered full-body vertical composition all contribute to the overall effect.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满奇幻色彩的电影感肖像，描绘了一个拟人化的神经元在黄金时刻乘坐旧金山经典叮当车的外侧踏板。该角色拥有一个巨大的神经元头部，中心呈圆形，数十条长长的树突像皇冠一样向外辐射，呈现出淡紫色、紫红色和肉灰色的纹理，带有微妙的有机光泽。其面部区域模糊且没有五官。人物穿着维多利亚或爱德华时代的绅士通勤装：深色粗花呢夹克、花纹背心、衬衫、领带、细条纹长裤、抛光的棕色皮鞋以及怀表链。一只手抓着叮当车上的黄铜杆，另一只手举着一张复古交通票，上面写着 "MUNICIPAL RAILWAY SAN FRANCISCO ADMIT ONE"。加上一枚写有 "MUNI" 的小圆形翻领徽章。一条细长的紫色轴突状尾巴在身体后方卷曲。叮当车细节丰富，由清漆木材和黄铜制成，侧面的路线牌写着 "POWELL AND MARKET / HYDE AND BEACH / FISHERMANS WHARF"。背景展示了一条陡峭的旧金山街道，缆车轨道向远处延伸，远处山坡下有第二辆叮当车，两侧是密集的城市建筑，朦胧的山顶上可见科伊特塔。温暖的怀旧光影，浅景深，超精细纹理，超现实主义，幽默而优雅的氛围，居中全身构图，竖构图。

templates.title: Luxury fashion advertising portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华时尚广告人像

templates.prompt: A luxury fashion advertisement, featuring a cinematic editorial portrait: a tall, elegant woman wears a striking two-tone belted trench coat in burnt orange and deep black, over which she wears a cream-colored ribbed turtleneck sweater. One hand is in her pocket; the shot is a half-body composition, centered and facing the camera, with the wind blowing through her hair.{argument name="hair color" default="copper red"} The hair is loosely tied back, and the face is intentionally obscured by shadows or stylized cropping, creating a mysterious and high-fashion feel. The image is surrounded by fragments of torn orange and dark fabric, like layers of fabric being ripped apart to reveal the central subject. The background is a stormy sunset sky, with towering clouds emitting amber and bronze glows, creating a melancholic atmosphere, accompanied by subtle sparks and smoke at the bottom. It incorporates the aesthetics of a luxury brand advertisement: ultra-fine fabric textures, visible stitching, exquisite belt hardware, strong contrast, warm orange tones, photorealistic lighting, and high-end magazine advertising composition. A large, white, luxurious carriage emblem is placed above the chest area, below which is centered, bold serif text.{argument name="brand name" default="HERMES"} It features a clean, high-end typography and a vertical poster layout designed specifically for mobile-friendly, stylish advertising.

promptLocalized.zh: 奢华时尚广告，电影级编辑人像，一位高挑优雅的女性身着一件引人注目的双色系带风衣，配色为焦橙色与深黑色，内搭奶油色罗纹高领毛衣，单手插兜，半身构图，居中正对镜头，被风吹拂的 {argument name="hair color" default="铜红色"} 头发松散地束在脑后，面部有意通过阴影或风格化裁剪进行遮挡，营造出神秘的高级时尚感。画面四周由撕裂的橙色与深色布料碎片环绕，如同层层撕开的织物，露出中心的主体。背景是日落时分风暴密布的天空，耸立的云层散发着琥珀色与青铜色的光芒，氛围忧郁，底部伴有细微的飞溅火花与烟雾。融入奢华品牌宣传美学，超细腻的织物纹理，可见的缝线，精致的腰带五金，强烈的对比度，温暖的橙色调色，照片级写实光影，高端杂志广告构图。在胸部区域上方放置一个大型白色奢华风格马车徽标，其下方为居中的粗体衬线文字 {argument name="brand name" default="HERMES"}，采用简洁的高端排版，专为移动端生成的时尚广告设计的竖版海报布局。
