templates.title: Street photography of the Petronas Twin Towers on September 11th.

titleLocalized.zh: 9/11 双子塔街头摄影

templates.prompt: A striking, documentary-style street photograph taken in Lower Manhattan, showcasing the World Trade Center during the 9/11 attacks. The perspective is taken a few blocks away against a bright, clear blue sky. The composition centers on the Twin Towers; on the left, the upper floors of the towers are engulfed by a massive orange-black fireball, thick, dark gray smoke swirling horizontally in the sky, and debris falling. The tower on the right, adjacent to the Twin Towers, has its antenna clearly visible, partially obscured by smoke. In the foreground, six clearly visible bystanders stand with their backs to the camera on the street and sidewalk, staring in shock; closest to the camera is a man in a light blue shirt in the lower left corner. The avenue is lined with mid-rise urban buildings, including the beige building with black scaffolding on the left, the old brick facades of the street, the tall, curved streetlights near the center, traffic signs, and the dense urban canyon that draws the eye towards the towers. The photograph is realistically documentary style, with high detail, natural daylight, the compression effect of a telephoto lens, a sense of urgency, and sharp focus. There is no text or watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具冲击力的纪实风格街头照片，拍摄于曼哈顿下城，展示了 9/11 袭击期间的世界贸易中心，视角位于几个街区外，背景是明亮晴朗的蓝天。构图以双子塔为中心，左侧塔楼高层被巨大的橙黑色火球吞没，浓厚的深灰色烟雾在天空中水平翻滚，碎片向下坠落。右侧塔楼紧邻其旁，天线清晰可见，部分被烟雾遮挡。前景中，有 6 位清晰可见的旁观者背对镜头站在街道和人行道上，神情震惊地注视着前方；最靠近镜头的是左下方一名身穿浅蓝色衬衫的男子。大道两侧是中层城市建筑，包括左侧带有黑色建筑脚手架的米色大楼、街面古老的砖石外墙、中心附近高大的弧形路灯、交通标志，以及将视线引向塔楼的密集城市峡谷。写实纪录片摄影，高细节，自然日光，长焦镜头压缩感，紧迫的历史新闻氛围，焦点清晰，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Anime crowd shot perspective comparison

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫人群镜头视角对比

templates.prompt: A two-image comparison against a black background showcases dramatic camera angle changes within a crowded, anime-style street scene. A striking white text line is placed at the top center:{argument name="headline text" default="Shift the camera's perspective to ground level within the crowd."} Add two large white labels aligned with the panels on the left: label the top panel "Source Image" and the bottom panel "Output Result". Create two vertically stacked rectangular image panels in the center of the canvas. The top panel displays a top-down view of a crowded historical street in a hand-drawn anime film style, with dozens of people huddled together, surrounded by carriages and wheels; including bundled luggage, hats, soft earth-toned clothing, blue and tan attire, a busy composition, and figures overlapping in various directions. The bottom panel reproduces a similar scene, but shifts the camera to a low ground view inside the crowd, passing through the bodies of the people, with a large wheel visible at the right edge. The foreground should have a sense of immersion and crowding, with several figures bending or crouching near the camera, and a figure in a soft purple robe in the left foreground. At the bottom center, a kneeling or hunched figure in brown clothing stands, while to the right center, a woman in a light blue dress or coat carries a small child through a crowd. The environment is maintained as a chaotic old-world market or traffic street, with horses, carriages, people wearing wide-brimmed hats and simple period clothing, dusty ground, and warm, soft color tones. Soft, cinematic anime lighting and painterly shadows are used, creating a visual feel reminiscent of classic Studio Ghibli crowd sequences. The overall image should present a "before and after" shot experiment, with the top panel showing the original overhead composition and the bottom panel showing the transformed low-angle perspective.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张黑色背景的双图对比图，展示动漫风格拥挤街道场景中戏剧性的镜头角度变化。在顶部居中放置一行醒目的白色文字：“{argument name="headline text" default="将镜头视角移至人群中的地面水平。"}”。在左侧添加两个与面板对齐的大号白色标签：上方面板旁标注“源图像”，下方面板旁标注“输出结果”。在画布中央创建 2 个垂直堆叠的矩形图像面板。上方面板展示手绘动漫电影风格中，历史街道上人群密集的俯视视角，数十人挤在一起，周围有马车和车轮；包含捆绑的行李、帽子、柔和的大地色系服装、蓝色和棕褐色服饰，构图繁忙，人物在各个方向重叠。下方面板重现相同类型的场景，但将镜头切换至人群内部的低位地面视角，穿过人群身体之间，右侧边缘可见一个大车轮。前景应具有沉浸感和拥挤感，几个人物弯腰或蹲伏在镜头附近，左前景有一位身穿柔和紫色长袍的人物，底部中央有一位身穿棕褐色衣服的跪姿或佝偻人物，右中方有一位身穿浅蓝色连衣裙或外套的女性抱着一个小孩子穿过人群。保持环境为混乱的旧世界市场或交通街道，有马匹、马车、戴宽檐帽和穿着简单时代服装的人、尘土飞扬的地面以及温暖柔和的色调。使用柔和的电影级动漫光影、绘画质感的阴影，并呈现出经典吉卜力工作室人群序列的视觉感受。整体图像应呈现为一次“前后对比”的镜头实验，上方面板为原始的俯视构图，下方面板为转换后的低角度视角。

templates.title: Impressionist women by the lake in summer

titleLocalized.zh: 夏日湖畔的印象派女性

templates.prompt: A bright, impressionistic watercolor illustration depicts a young woman standing by a tree-lined lake in the bright summer sun. She is in profile, facing the water to her right, her face mostly obscured by the angle and light. Her dark brown hair is loosely tied into a messy low ponytail, a few strands fluttering gently in the breeze. She wears a flowing, ankle-length white dress, the fabric light and breathable, the sleeves loose and billowing in the warm wind. One hand rests behind her on a dark rock or tree root on the left edge, her body leaning slightly back, her posture relaxed and contemplative. The foreground is filled with lush wild cosmos flowers, mainly composed of vibrant orange and golden yellow, interspersed with slender green stems and a few small white flowers. To the left is a thick tree trunk, its dense green leaves filtering the shimmering sunlight, creating dappled light and shadow, bright highlights, and soft, blurred patches of light in the picture. To the right, a calm, turquoise lake stretches into the distance, rippling gently, with a hazy shoreline or low hills visible in the distance. The painting employs a high-key color scheme, primarily using refreshing greens, aquamarine, white, yellow, and orange; soft brushstrokes are used to create a light and airy atmosphere, a romantic seasonal feel, and an elegant composition; a vertical composition is employed; the foreground flowers are richly detailed; a bright, natural backlighting effect is presented; the overall atmosphere is tranquil and dreamlike.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅明亮的印象派水彩风格插画，描绘了一位年轻女性站在夏日明媚阳光下、绿树成荫的湖畔。她呈侧面轮廓，面向右侧的水面，面部大部分被角度和光线遮挡。她深棕色的头发松散地扎成一个凌乱的低马尾，几缕发丝在微风中轻轻飘动。她身着一件飘逸的及踝白色长裙，面料轻盈透气，袖口宽松，在暖风中轻轻起伏。她的一只手向后撑在左侧边缘的一块深色岩石或树根上，身体微微后倾，姿态放松而沉思。前景中布满了茂密的野生波斯菊，主要由鲜艳的橙色和金黄色两种颜色组成，点缀着纤细的绿色茎秆和少量白色小花。左侧是一棵粗壮的树干，头顶上方茂密的绿叶过滤着闪烁的阳光，在画面上营造出斑驳的光影、明亮的亮部以及柔和的虚化光斑。右侧，平静的绿松石色湖水向远方延伸，泛起淡淡的涟漪，远处可见朦胧的岸线或低矮的山峦。采用高调配色，以清新的绿色、水蓝色、白色、黄色和橙色为主；运用柔和的绘画笔触；营造轻盈的氛围、浪漫的季节感和优雅的构图；采用竖构图；前景花卉细节丰富；呈现明亮的自然逆光效果；整体氛围宁静且如梦似幻。

templates.title: Restaurant perspective conversion comparison

titleLocalized.zh: 餐厅视角转换对比

templates.prompt: A side-by-side comparison image of social media posts against a dark background showcases a test of camera angle changes inside a busy restaurant. At the top is large white sans-serif text that reads:{argument name="headline text" default="Show me the view of this crowded restaurant from behind the bar. Don't change anything in the scene except the perspective."} Two rounded rectangular photos are stacked vertically in the center of the page. The upper image has the large white text "Source" on its left; the lower image has the large white text "Output" on its left. The upper image shows the original restaurant scene from the customer side, looking towards the bar at the back: a warm, upscale, and crowded restaurant at night, with a huge illuminated wall of bottles in the background, wooden ceiling beams, and hanging spherical chandeliers. Bartenders and servers are at work, and the foreground and midground are filled with customers. The lower image shows the same restaurant, maintaining the same lighting, decor, crowd density, bottle wall, chandeliers, and overall atmosphere, but with a changed perspective: the camera is now positioned behind the bar, looking out over the crowded restaurant. The foreground of the lower image includes the bar countertop, glassware, bottles, metal bar tools, and the illuminated POS touchscreen in the left front, reinforcing the "behind the bar" perspective. Both photos were designed to maintain photorealistic quality, warm amber lighting, and a vibrant nighttime atmosphere, ensuring the lower image appears to be the same scene as the upper one, only with a different camera angle. It features a clean social media posting style with ample margins and a neat layout, making it suitable for use as a tweet screenshot or AI image comparison sticker.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张深黑色背景下的并排社交媒体对比图，展示了繁忙餐厅内部的摄像机角度转换测试。最上方是大号白色无衬线文字，内容为：{argument name="headline text" default="向我展示从吧台后方看向这间拥挤餐厅的视角。除视角外，场景中的任何内容都不要改变"}。页面中央垂直堆叠着两张圆角矩形照片。上方图片左侧有大号白色文字“原始视角 (Source)”；下方图片左侧有大号白色文字“输出结果 (Output)”。上方图片展示了从顾客侧看向后方吧台的原始餐厅场景：夜晚温馨、高档且拥挤的餐厅，背景是巨大的发光酒瓶陈列墙、木质天花板横梁、悬挂的球形吊灯，吧台调酒师和服务员正在工作，前景和中景坐满了客人。下方图片展示了同一间餐厅，保持了相同的灯光、装饰、人群密度、酒瓶墙、吊灯和整体氛围，但视角发生了变化：摄像机现在位于吧台后方，向外俯瞰拥挤的餐厅。在下方图片的前景中，包含吧台台面、玻璃器皿、酒瓶、金属吧台工具以及左前方发光的 POS 触摸屏，以强化“吧台后方”的视角。两张照片均需保持照片级真实感、温暖的琥珀色灯光和生动的夜晚氛围，并确保下方图片看起来与上方是同一场景，仅改变了摄像机角度。采用简洁的社交媒体发布风格，留有充足的边距和整洁的布局，适合作为推文截图或 AI 图像对比贴使用。

templates.title: Royal Blue Haute Couture Group Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 宝蓝色高定系列集体肖像

templates.prompt: A luxurious, fashion editorial-style portrait showcases four elegant young women posing together in a deep sapphire blue Baroque-style interior, exuding the quality of a haute couture group photograph. The scene employs a monochromatic palette of deep sapphire blue, midnight blue, and silver, with a backdrop adorned with heavy velvet curtains, floral arrangements, classical columns, and ornate metalware. All four women wear distinctive deep blue and cobalt blue evening gowns, exquisitely detailed: embellished with crystal beads, sequins, embroidered floral appliqués, multiple layers of tulle, satin, and sheer lace. The woman in the upper left has extremely long black hair and wears a dramatic long-sleeved sheer lace gown with floral embroidery and a corset-style bodice, her arm raised high above her head in a regal pose. The woman in the upper right has long, wavy light brown or blonde hair and wears a sleeveless, spaghetti-strap satin gown adorned with blue floral appliqués at the chest and waist, sitting upright with a composed expression. The woman in the lower left has long, straight black hair and wears a structured satin dress with thin straps. The bodice and skirt are adorned with jeweled floral embellishments, and the skirt is voluminous and pleated. The woman in the lower right has long, dark hair and wears an off-the-shoulder, sheer, shimmering gown with semi-transparent embroidery on the sleeves. She leans slightly forward, one hand gently touching her chin, her posture soft and contemplative. All four wear coordinated sapphire jewelry, including earrings, necklaces, and decorative hair accessories. The composition is a compact, vertical portrait with layered seated poses. Rich fabrics fill the foreground, and soft, diffused studio lighting, rich in detail, creating a captivating, luxurious advertising campaign style with deep shadows, delicate skin, and an atmosphere of elegant opulence.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张奢华的时尚编辑风格肖像，展示了 4 位优雅的年轻女性在深宝蓝色巴洛克风格室内共同摆拍，呈现出高级定制集体摄影的质感。场景采用深蓝宝石色、午夜蓝和银色的单色调，背景装饰有厚重的丝绒帷幔、花艺布置、古典立柱和华丽的金属器皿。4 位女性均身着独特的深蓝色和钴蓝色晚礼服，细节精致：饰有水晶珠饰、亮片、刺绣花卉贴花、多层薄纱、缎面和透明蕾丝。左上方的女性留着极长的黑发，身着一件戏剧性的长袖透明蕾丝礼服，带有花卉刺绣和紧身胸衣式上身，单臂高举过头，姿态高贵。右上方的女性留着长波浪浅棕色或金色头发，身着无袖细肩带缎面礼服，胸部和腰部饰有蓝色花朵贴花，坐姿端正，神情从容。左下方的女性留着长直黑发，身着结构感缎面连衣裙，配有细肩带，胸部和裙摆饰有珠宝花卉装饰，裙摆蓬松且带有褶皱。右下方的女性留着长深色头发，身着露肩透明闪光礼服，袖子带有半透明刺绣，身体微微前倾，一只手轻抚下巴，姿态柔和且沉思。4 人均佩戴协调的蓝宝石珠宝，包括耳环、项链和装饰性发饰。构图为紧凑的竖版肖像，采用层叠的坐姿，丰富的面料铺满前景，柔和的漫射影棚光，细节丰富，呈现出迷人的奢华广告大片风格，带有深邃的阴影、精致的肤质和高雅奢华的氛围。

templates.title: Nostalgic Watercolor Anime Adventure Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 怀旧水彩动漫冒险海报

templates.prompt: A nostalgic watercolor anime poster printed on textured off-white paper, employing a vertical double-exposure illustration composition inspired by late 1990s adventure anime. The main silhouette is the left profile of a young boy wearing upturned goggles, his face turned to the right, filled with a montage of dreamlike memories and fantastical scenes. Above the silhouette, in the center, eight children stand with their backs to the camera on a ridge, gazing at a distant, glowing crystal tower beneath a circular celestial portal in a misty, blue-purple sky; they are accompanied by seven small creature companions. In the upper right corner inside the silhouette, a giant dragon-like monster emerges from the clouds. Near the center, a glowing circular handheld digital device is added, its screen dimly lit and radiating light outwards. In the lower center area, two iconic small dinosaur-like creatures are depicted sitting atop an ancient shrine path, one a purple-horned creature, the other a small yellow reptile. At the bottom, a moss-covered torii gate, overgrown stone steps, a telephone pole, and a small country train on the right are displayed, all shrouded in mist and vegetation. At the very bottom, eight children are again depicted as tiny silhouettes walking side-by-side along a path, reinforcing the themes of friendship and memories. The artwork is rendered using soft ink and watercolor techniques, with tones of gentle blues, indigo, lavender, dark brown, and warm gold highlights, featuring splattered paint edges and painterly cloud textures. Maintaining a transparent and elegant composition, it possesses a sophisticated modern poster design feel, almost entirely free of the plasticky look often seen in AI (artificial intelligence) designs. Add the vertical Japanese text "あの日、也ちは选ばれた.あの日、デジモンと出会った." on the right, and The Japanese title Logo "デジモンアドベンチャー" is placed in the lower left corner, accompanied by a small English subtitle "DIGIMON ADVENTURE" and the date line "1999 - Eternal Adventure".

promptLocalized.zh: 一张印在纹理米白色纸张上的怀旧水彩动漫海报，采用受 20 世纪 90 年代末冒险动漫启发的竖版双重曝光插画构图。主体轮廓为一名年轻男孩的左侧侧脸，头上戴着一副向上推起的护目镜，面部朝向右侧，轮廓内填充着如梦似幻的记忆与奇幻场景蒙太奇。在轮廓上方的中心位置，展示 8 名儿童背对镜头站立在山脊上，望向云雾缭绕的蓝紫色天空中一个圆形天体传送门下方发光的远方水晶塔；他们身旁伴有 7 只小型生物伙伴。在轮廓内部的右上角，放置一只从云层中显现的巨型龙状怪物。在中心附近，添加一个发光的圆形手持数字设备，屏幕微亮，向外辐射光芒。在中下部区域，描绘 2 只标志性的小型恐龙状生物坐在古老的神社参道上方，其中一只是紫色长角生物，另一只是小型黄色爬行类生物。在底部区域，展示一座长满青苔的鸟居、杂草丛生的石阶、电线杆以及右侧的一列小型乡村火车，所有景物都笼罩在薄雾与植被之中。在最底部，再次呈现 8 名儿童作为微小剪影沿着小路并肩远去的画面，强化友谊与回忆的主题。使用柔和的水墨与水彩渲染，色调为柔和的蓝色、靛蓝、薰衣草紫、深褐色以及温暖的金色高光，并带有飞溅的颜料边缘和绘画感的云层纹理。保持构图的通透与优雅，具备精致的现代海报设计感，几乎没有常见的 AI 塑料感。在右侧添加竖排日文文字“あの日、僕たちは選ばれた。あの日、デジモンと出会った。”，并在左下角放置日文标题 Logo“デジモンアドベンチャー”，配以小型英文副标题“DIGIMON ADVENTURE”以及日期行“1999 - 永遠の冒険”。

templates.title: Ink painting poster of "Journey to the West"

titleLocalized.zh: 《西游记》水墨海报

templates.prompt: A magnificent Chinese ink-wash fantasy poster inspired by "Journey to the West," with the main subject being {argument name="character name" default="Sun Wukong"} The double-exposure silhouette on the left side occupies most of the page. The portrait is composed of soft tan, ash, parchment white, and smoky black watercolor textures against a grayish-white paper background with splattered brushstrokes and white space. The figure has a distinct ape-like facial contour, a short beard, and a golden headband on his forehead. Inside and around the silhouette, a layered mythological landscape in the style of traditional Chinese landscape painting is constructed, including luminous clouds, cliffs, clouds, and ancient temples. Above the head, in the center, is a bright moon, behind which sits a sacred Buddha statue atop a magnificent celestial palace complex with multi-tiered eaves. In the upper right, four pilgrims are shown walking along a cliffside path: a monkey king wielding a golden cudgel, a monk riding a white horse, a pig-faced companion, and a companion in black robes. In the center, a scene depicts the monkey king fiercely battling a coiled dragon or snake amidst swirling clouds. In the lower right corner, a luminous temple shrine hidden in the mountains is placed, inside which a golden statue can be seen. At the bottom, add three tiny pilgrims walking through a misty valley. Utilizing atmospheric depth, elegant calligraphic brushstrokes, ethereal clouds, and exquisite cinematic composition, it achieves a painterly quality rather than a digital feel. Add vertical Chinese calligraphy on the left, the content of which is {argument name="title text" default="Journey to the West"} The design incorporates smaller, vertical text on the sides and a few stamp-style markings to create an authentic poster look. Another subtle, vertical inscription is added to the cliff face on the right. The overall atmosphere is sacred, epic, ancient, mysterious, and poetic, possessing the quality of top-tier concept art with virtually no trace of typical AI generation.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张受《西游记》启发的宏伟中国水墨奇幻海报，主体为 {argument name="character name" default="孙悟空"} 的左侧面双重曝光剪影，占据页面大部分空间。肖像由柔和的棕褐色、灰烬色、羊皮纸白和烟黑色水彩纹理构成，背景为灰白色纸张，带有飞溅的笔触边缘和留白。人物具有明显的猿猴面部轮廓、短须，额头上戴着金箍。在剪影内部及周围，构建一个层次分明的传统山水风格神话景观，包含发光的云雾、悬崖、云朵和古老的寺庙。在头部上方的中心位置，绘制一轮明月，月亮后方有一尊神圣的佛像，坐落于宏伟的天宫建筑群之上，建筑拥有多层屋檐。在右上部，展示 4 位取经人走在悬崖小径上：一位手持金箍棒的猴王、一位骑着白马的僧人、一位猪脸同伴以及一位身着黑袍的同伴。在中间位置，描绘 1 场猴王在云雾缭绕中与盘旋的龙或蛇进行激烈战斗的场景。在右下角，放置 1 座隐匿于山间的发光寺庙神龛，内部可见一尊金色的神像。在底部区域，添加 3 位在雾气弥漫的山谷中行走的微小朝圣者。运用大气深度、优雅的书法笔触、飘渺的云雾，以及精致的电影级构图，使其呈现出绘画质感而非数字感。在左侧添加垂直的中文书法，内容为 {argument name="title text" default="西游记"}，并配以较小的侧边垂直文字和几枚印章风格的印记，以呈现地道的海报设计。在右侧悬崖面上加入另一处隐约的垂直位置铭文。整体氛围神圣、史诗、古老、神秘且富有诗意，具备顶级概念艺术的质感，几乎没有常见的 AI 生成痕迹。

templates.title: Hardcore style Neon Genesis Evangelion poster

titleLocalized.zh: 硬核风格《新世纪福音战士》海报

templates.prompt: A retro anime poster with dramatic tension, employing a hardcore sci-fi mecha visual style. In the foreground, three young pilots stand back-to-back, with a massive purple bio-mechanical robot standing behind them. The pilot in the center is a slender boy, wearing a dark navy blue and black pilot suit with white panels on his shoulders and a glowing red circular core on his chest, facing forward with a serious expression. To his left is a pale-faced girl with an ice-blue bob haircut, wearing a white futuristic bodysuit, slightly turned to the side. To his right is a girl with long, reddish-brown hair, her hair flowing to one side, wearing a bright red pilot suit, looking resolutely ahead. Behind the three, the massive mecha head occupies the center of the composition, symmetrically distributed, with a single horn, orange-glowing eyes, sharply defined armor, and massive shoulder structures extending upwards like black wings. The background is outer space, with two celestial bodies visible: a massive cratered moon directly behind the mecha head, and a smaller planet to the right. The poster's bottom depicts a dilapidated futuristic city, its buildings crumbling, littered with rubble, sparks, and debris. At the very center of the bottom are two tiny human silhouettes running forward through the ruins, surrounded by pink energy streams extending in arcs to the left and right. The color palette uses deep indigo, black, purple, rust red, and ashen gray, with a heavy film grain, aged ink texture, weathered paper wear, paint splatters, scratches, printing damage, and a rough silkscreen poster feel. The overall composition is a complete movie poster, with dense typography around the edges: a large vertical English title "NEON GENESIS EVANGELION" on the left, next to which is smaller red vertical text "HIRANO OF EVANGELION"; near the lower left corner is a red NERV logo and the word "NERV"; a boxed label in the lower left corner reads "TOKYO-3" and "JAPAN"; a red warning box in the upper right corner reads "ANGEL ATTACK" and Japanese characters below it; and multiple lines of vertical Japanese slogans along the left and right edges. Cinematic, emotional, apocalyptic, and highly detailed, it presents a perfect combination of iconic 1990s anime poster design and modern high-end illustration quality.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧张力的复古动漫海报，采用硬核科幻机甲主视觉风格。前景中，三名少年驾驶员背靠背站立，身后矗立着一台巨大的紫色生物机械机器人。中间的驾驶员是一位身材瘦削的少年，身穿深海军蓝配黑色的驾驶服，肩部带有白色镶板，胸口有一个发光的红色圆形核心，正面朝向前方，表情严肃。左侧是一位面色苍白的少女，留着冰蓝色短波波头，身穿白色未来感紧身衣，侧身微转。右侧是一位留着赤褐色长发的少女，发丝飘向一侧，身穿鲜艳的红色驾驶服，神情坚定地看向前方。在三人身后，巨大的机甲头部占据了构图中心，对称分布，长有一只角，双眼散发着橙色光芒，装甲棱角分明，巨大的肩部结构如同黑色羽翼般向上延伸。背景为外太空，可见 2 个天体：机甲头部正后方有一颗巨大的环形山月球，右侧有一颗较小的行星。海报底部展示了一座破败的未来城市，建筑残破，瓦砾、火花和碎片四散。在底部正中央，包含 2 个正在废墟中向前奔跑的微小人类剪影，周围环绕着向左右两侧弧形延伸的粉色能量流。色调采用深靛蓝、黑、紫、铁锈红和灰烬灰，带有浓重的胶片颗粒感、做旧墨迹纹理、风化的纸张磨损、油漆飞溅、划痕印刷损伤以及粗糙的丝网印刷海报质感。整体构图为完整的电影单张海报，边缘融合了密集的排版：左侧为巨大的垂直英文标题“NEON GENESIS EVANGELION”，旁边是较小的红色垂直文字“HIRANO OF EVANGELION”，左下角附近有红色的 NERV 标志和单词“NERV”，左下角有一个方框标签，写着“TOKYO-3”和“JAPAN”，右上角有一个红色的警告框，写着“ANGEL ATTACK”及其下方的日文字符，左右边缘还有多行垂直的日文标语。电影感、情绪化、末日氛围、高度细节，呈现出 1990 年代标志性动漫海报设计与现代高端插画品质的完美结合。

templates.title: Dark-style Chinese crime drama poster

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑风格中国犯罪剧海报

templates.prompt: A dark, rugged Chinese crime thriller poster, displayed vertically in a single-page layout, presents a melancholic neo-noir aesthetic and a strong cinematic contrast. The central image is a half-length portrait of a middle-aged East Asian man with a fierce expression, black curly hair, and wearing a dark, textured coat over a black shirt. Most of his face is hidden in shadow, and the image is framed from the chest up, slightly tilted to the right. His hands appear in the lower right corner, calmly holding a string of dark wooden prayer beads, suggesting power, danger, and ritual. The background is a dimly lit city alley or old street at night, overlaid with dirty textures, reflections from wet pavement, mottled walls, and blurred architectural silhouettes. At the bottom center, a figure sits in a chair with their back to the camera, placed under a strong spotlight, surrounded by nine figures standing in the darkness, creating a tense interrogation or underworld confrontation scene. The color palette is almost monochromatic, using black, charcoal gray, and dirty gray, accented with deep blood red and aged white lettering. On the left, a large, vertically arranged column of striking red Chinese calligraphy title text, with bold strokes and dry brush textures, almost fills the entire height of the poster. At the far left edge, two vertical lines of small white and red text are added: "My name is Gao Qiqiang," and "The bigger the storm, the more expensive the fish." On the right, a vertical line of white Chinese subtitles for the cast and crew is added, separated by a red dot: "Zhang Songwen as Gao Qiqiang." In the lower right corner, a striking white Chinese subtitle/title logo, "Raging Waves," is added, below which is the red serif English subtitle, "THE KNOCKOUT." Small, blurred Chinese release information or slogans are added to the bottom edge. The overall atmosphere is oppressive, violent, sophisticated, and highly designed, like the main visual poster for a crime drama on a high-end streaming platform, with rich layers, dramatic shadows, textured smoke and grime, and realistic photographic details.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张暗黑、粗粝的中国犯罪惊悚片电影海报，采用竖版单张布局，呈现出忧郁的新黑色电影美学和强烈的电影感对比。构图中心为一名中年东亚男性的半身肖像，他神情凶狠，留着黑色卷发，身穿深色质感大衣内搭黑色衬衫，面部大部分隐没在阴影中，画面取景自胸部以上，略微偏向右侧。他的双手出现在右下角，正冷静地盘着一串深色木质佛珠，暗示着权力、危险与仪式感。背景是昏暗的城市小巷或夜晚的老街道，叠加了脏旧纹理、湿润路面的反光、斑驳的墙壁以及模糊的建筑剪影。在画面下方中央，放置 1 个背对镜头坐在椅子上的人影，置于强烈的聚光灯下，周围环绕着 9 个站在黑暗中的人影，营造出紧张的审讯或地下世界对峙场景。色调采用近乎单色的黑、炭灰和脏灰色，辅以深血红色点缀和做旧的白色字体。在左侧，添加 1 列巨大的竖排表现力红色中国书法标题文字，笔触粗犷，带有飞白和干笔纹理，几乎占据了海报的全高。在最左侧边缘，添加 2 行竖排的白色和红色小字：“我叫高启强，”和“风浪越大，鱼越贵”。在右侧，添加 1 行竖排的白色中文字幕演职员表，中间以红色圆点分隔：“张颂文 饰 高启强”。在右下角区域，添加 1 个醒目的白色笔触中文字幕/标题标志“狂飙”，下方配有红色衬线体小字英文副标题“THE KNOCKOUT”。在底部边缘添加细小模糊的中文上映信息或标语。整体氛围压抑、暴力、高级且设计感极强，如同高端流媒体平台的犯罪剧主视觉海报，具有丰富的层次感、戏剧性的阴影、质感的烟雾与污垢，以及写实的摄影细节。

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度逼真的航空摄影照片，展示 {argument name="airline" default="中国南方航空"} 的 {argument name="aircraft model" default="A380"} 客机正在 {argument name="airport" default="上海浦东国际机场"} 抬轮起飞，采用侧面长焦航空摄影风格拍摄。飞机机头轻微上扬，刚离开跑道，起落架尚未收起，四台发动机清晰可见；机身呈白色，配有深蓝色腰线，机身前部印有醒目的中文航司名称，侧面印有英文航司名称，深蓝色垂尾上绘有红色木棉花标志。背景展示机场航站楼建筑，右侧可见一座高耸的空中交通管制塔台，天气晴朗，伴有轻微雾霾，呈现真实的机场氛围。包含跑道边缘细节、滑行道标志、前景干草，以及航站楼附近至少 2 架小型背景飞机，其中一架外观类似于旧版中国东方航空涂装。自然纪实摄影风格，细节锐利，比例准确，光影真实，3:2 构图，非插画风格，无夸张的日落色彩。

templates.title: Jing'an Temple Station, Line 2 entrance

titleLocalized.zh: 静安寺站 2 号线入口

templates.prompt: A realistic documentary-style photo showcasing the Shanghai Metro{argument name="station name" default="Jing'an Temple Station"}{argument name="subway line" default="Line 2"} The entrance area of ​​the station is shown from a passenger's eye level as they approach the turnstiles. The scene is a spacious indoor station hall with a modern-style dark brown curved wooden ceiling decorated with long, linear white lights. A large, dark-colored directional sign hangs in the center, featuring a green square icon for Line 2, the text "Line 2," the main station name "Jing'an Temple Station," and an icon with the bilingual text "Service Center." Below the sign are several stainless steel turnstiles; six turnstile lanes are visible in the foreground, some marked with green arrows, and at least one displaying a red "No Entry" symbol. The scene depicts a busy yet orderly flow of commuters, with approximately 10 to 15 adults dressed in casual autumn attire, mostly shown from behind, passing through the turnstiles to enter the station; their clothing includes jackets, jeans, backpacks, and shoulder bags, in neutral tones. On the left wall are automatic ticket machines or vending machines, as well as another smaller green Line 2 sign. The right-hand wall is a decorative white platform wall, prominently featuring the words "Jing'an Temple" in black calligraphy and subtle wavy lines. Nearby is a small green Line 2 marker. The materials used need to convey realism: polished gray speckled stone flooring, metal pillars, tiled walls, and realistic transportation facilities. The lighting is bright and even, creating a clean public transportation atmosphere. The composition uses a slightly wide-angle mobile phone photography perspective, centering on the overhead signage and turnstile area, achieving a highly realistic, natural, and detailed rendering of the authentic interior environment of a Shanghai subway station.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实纪录片风格的照片，展示了上海地铁 {argument name="station name" default="静安寺站"} {argument name="subway line" default="2 号线"} 站内的入口区域，视角为乘客走向闸机时的平视视角。场景为一个宽敞的室内站厅，天花板采用现代风格的深棕色弧形木条装饰，并配有长条形线性白光灯。中央悬挂着一块大型深色导向标识，上面印有绿色的 2 号线方形图标，文字显示“2号线 / Line 2”、主站名“静安寺站 / Jing'an Temple Station”以及带有双语文字“服务中心 / Service Center”的图标。标识下方是多台不锈钢闸机，前景可见 6 条闸机通道，部分显示绿色箭头指示，至少有一个显示红色禁止进入符号。画面展示了繁忙而有序的通勤人流，约 10 到 15 名身着秋季日常服装的成年人，大多以背影呈现，正穿过闸机进入车站；人物穿着包括夹克、牛仔裤、背包、单肩包，色调中性。左侧墙壁设有自动售票机或自动售货机，以及另一个较小的绿色 2 号线标识。右侧墙壁为装饰性的白色站台墙，上面印有醒目的黑色书法字体“静安寺”及微妙的波浪形线条，附近还有一个小的绿色 2 号线标记。材质需体现真实感：磨光灰色斑点石材地面、金属立柱、瓷砖墙面以及写实的交通设施。光线明亮均匀，呈现出整洁的公共交通氛围。构图采用略带广角效果的手机摄影视角，以头顶标识和闸机区域为中心，高度写实、自然、细节丰富，还原真实的上海地铁站内部环境。

templates.title: Pastel anime-style kimono girl by the lotus pond

titleLocalized.zh: 莲花池畔的粉彩动漫和服少女

templates.prompt: A dreamlike pastel anime illustration depicts a serene young girl by a pond in a spring garden under the moonlight. The artwork employs a delicate Japanese fantasy style, with flat anime colors, no shadows, and extremely clean, grain-free lines. She sits by the water, her back to the viewer, her face slightly turned towards the viewer, her expression calm yet melancholic. She has very long, straight hair, the color of which is {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} She sports soft bangs, her hair adorned with braided flowers forming a crown. She wears an elegant, flowing pale blue and cream kimono, stylized with waves and white fox patterns, the layered fabric cascading around her. A half-open traditional paper umbrella, adorned with crystal-like ornaments, leans against her right rear. Dense cherry blossom branches surround her head, petals scattered in the foreground. Ten luminous lotus flowers float in the pond, and four koi carp are clearly visible swimming nearby. In the background to the left, the silhouette of a small, multi-tiered pagoda is faintly visible on the water. From the upper left, a soft rainbow beam shines obliquely into the pond, creating an iridescent reflection. Several strings of faceted crystal ornaments hang from the branches, shimmering in the light. The color palette is dominated by lavender, pale pink, pale blue, ivory, and soft gold. The overall atmosphere is ethereal, romantic, tranquil, and magical, with intricate details, shimmering reflections on the water, and an exquisite composition arranged vertically.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅梦幻般的粉彩动漫插画，描绘了一位宁静的少女在月光下的春日花园池畔。画面采用精致的日式奇幻风格，平涂动漫色彩，无阴影，线条极其干净，无颗粒感。她以四分之三背影坐在水边，脸庞微微转向观众，表情平静而忧郁。她留着极长的直发，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色"}，配有柔和的刘海，发间编织着花朵装饰，形成花冠。她身穿优雅飘逸的淡蓝色与奶油色和服，上面饰有风格化的波浪和白狐图案，层叠的布料在周围铺开。右后方斜靠着一把半开的传统纸伞，伞上悬挂着水晶般的装饰物。头顶上方环绕着茂密的樱花枝，前景中散落着花瓣。池塘中漂浮着 10 朵发光的莲花，水面附近有 4 条清晰可见的锦鲤在游动。远处的左侧背景中，水面上隐约可见一座小型多层宝塔的剪影。从左上方，一道柔和的彩虹光束斜射入池塘，营造出虹彩般的倒影。树枝上悬挂着几串刻面水晶装饰，在光线下闪烁。色调以薰衣草紫、淡粉色、淡蓝色、象牙白和柔和的金色为主。整体氛围空灵、浪漫、宁静且充满魔力，细节装饰繁复，水面反光熠熠生辉，构图精致且呈竖向布局。

templates.title: Modern Queen's Iron Throne Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 现代女王铁王座海报

templates.prompt: An epic, medieval throne room-style cinematic fantasy poster depicts a modern woman confidently seated on a dark throne of iron swords. She is positioned at the center of the full-body portrait, legs crossed, arms casually resting on the throne's armrests, exuding an relaxed yet regal confidence. She has long, wavy hair.{argument name="hair color" default="gold"} Her hair fell over her shoulders, and she wore modern casual wear rather than traditional costume: a fitted long-sleeved top.{argument name="top color" default="Deep red"} A top, dark blue skinny jeans, and black ankle boots. The massive, jagged throne, forged from overlapping weathered sword blades, dominates the background. The scene is set in a dimly lit, melancholic royal hall, with warm candlelight, soft candle flames, and faint sparks or embers floating in the air. Two vertical banners bearing red three-headed dragon emblems hang in the distance. Dramatic high-contrast lighting, rich dark metallic textures, and warm orange highlights create a sophisticated, high-fantasy poster feel. Blurred, handwritten-style text is added near the curved area in the upper left of the throne, containing the following text:{argument name="name text" default="LAREENA STARKER"} At the bottom, add a striking and ornate metallic gold fantasy serif font title, displayed on the first line.{argument name="main title" default="BABE"} The smaller "OF" is displayed in the center at the bottom, and the larger "OF" is displayed at the very bottom.{argument name="subtitle" default="THRONES"} The letter "O" is designed as a circular badge with vertical stripes. The vertical poster composition, symmetrical frame, ultra-detailed, photorealistic feel, is a gorgeous and playful modern parody of the iconic fantasy throne poster.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张史诗级中世纪王座厅剧风格的电影感奇幻海报，展示了一位现代女性自信地坐在黑暗的铁剑王座上。她位于全身肖像的中心，双腿交叠，双臂随意地搭在王座扶手上，展现出一种轻松而女王范儿的自信。她留着长长的波浪卷发，{argument name="hair color" default="金色"} 发丝垂在肩头，身穿现代休闲装而非古装：一件修身长袖 {argument name="top color" default="深酒红色"} 上衣、深蓝色紧身牛仔裤和黑色短靴。王座巨大且参差不齐，由重叠的风化剑刃锻造而成，占据了大部分背景。场景设定在一个昏暗、忧郁的皇家大厅中，伴有温暖的烛光、柔和的烛火、空气中漂浮的微弱火星或余烬，背景远处悬挂着两面带有红色三头龙纹章的垂直旗帜。采用戏剧性的高对比度照明、丰富的深色金属质感、温暖的橙色高光，呈现出精致的高级奇幻海报质感。在王座左上方的弧形区域附近添加模糊的手写风格文字，内容为 {argument name="name text" default="LAREENA STARKER"}。在底部，添加醒目且华丽的金属金色奇幻衬线字体标题，第一行显示 {argument name="main title" default="BABE"}，下方居中显示较小的“OF”，最底部以超大字体显示 {argument name="subtitle" default="THRONES"}，其中“O”字母被设计为带有垂直条纹的圆形徽章。竖版海报构图，对称式框架，超精细，照片级真实感，是对标志性奇幻王座海报的华丽而俏皮的现代恶搞。

templates.title: Netflix-style "Atmosphere Coder" poster

titleLocalized.zh: Netflix 风格“氛围编码员”海报

templates.prompt: A cinematic parody of a streaming media poster, in a 2:3 vertical aspect ratio, employing a style similar to the teaser posters for Netflix's original dark comedy AI programming series. At the top, small white text displays {argument name="top banner text" default="A NETFLIX ORIGINAL"} Dominating the center of the image is a huge, glowing, sci-fi sans-serif title text, ice-white with a faint pale purple neon halo, displayed as {argument name="title text" default="VIBE CODER"} The text is arranged in two lines. Below that is the smaller white text "STARRING," and below that is the actor's name in bold pink all capital letters.{argument name="cast name" default="HUNKINS"} The scene depicts a dimly lit, emotionally charged programmer's bedroom or office, illuminated by monitors and violet-blue neon lights. In the center of the foreground, a plush teddy bear-like mascot sits lazily in a black office chair, wearing a black hoodie, its face mostly hidden in shadow, creating a mysterious comedic effect. The hoodie bears four lines of small, off-white text on the chest: "// SHIP IT", "// VIBE CHECK", "// NO BUGS", and "// JUST VIBES". In front of the character is an open laptop with four visible stickers: "vibe > spec", "DON'T THINK JUST PROMPT", a smiley face sticker, "Claude 3.5", and an abstract AI-style logo sticker. Behind the laptop are two widescreen monitors displaying dense code on a dark theme. The background includes two wall-mounted sticky notes/slogans on the left: one reads "IDEAS > PLANS"; on the right is a project with three lines of handwritten text above it: "BUILD FAST," "BREAK THINGS," and "ASK AI," followed by a fourth line below: "REPEAT," and a hand-drawn smiley face. Next to the project is a pinkish-purple neon light.</> A code icon is displayed. On the table in the lower right corner sits a matte black beverage can with "FOCUS (optional)" written in pink, and the edge of a pizza box reads "ITERATE LATER." The design utilizes rich shadows, soft, utilitarian lighting, purple and cyan rim lighting, subtle monitor glow, shallow depth of field, high contrast, a glossy, high-poster-like finish, and a slightly absurd, self-aware, comedic tone typical of startups. White slogan text is displayed in the center at the bottom.{argument name="tagline text" default="HE’S NOT A PROGRAMMER. HE’S A VIBE CODER."} The word "VIBE" is highlighted in pink. Below it are the release date lines in white and red.{argument name="release line" default="ONLY ON NETFLIX | COMING SOON"} The word "NETFLIX" is highlighted in bold red, making it look like a sophisticated official teaser poster for a fictional streaming series.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张 2:3 纵向比例的电影感戏仿流媒体海报，采用类似 Netflix 原创黑色幽默 AI 编程剧集的预告海报风格。最上方，小号白色文字显示 {argument name="top banner text" default="A NETFLIX ORIGINAL"}。画面中央占据主导地位的是巨大的发光科幻无衬线标题文字，呈冰白色，带有淡淡的淡紫色霓虹光晕，显示为 {argument name="title text" default="VIBE CODER"}，分两行排列。下方是较小的白色文字“STARRING”，再下方是粉色的加粗全大写演员姓名 {argument name="cast name" default="HUNKINS"}。场景展示了一个昏暗、情绪化的程序员卧室或办公室，夜晚由显示器和紫蓝色霓虹灯照亮。前景中央，一个毛绒泰迪熊般的吉祥物懒散地坐在黑色办公椅上，穿着黑色连帽衫，脸部大部分隐藏在阴影中，营造出一种神秘的喜剧感。连帽衫胸前有 4 行米白色小字，内容为：“// SHIP IT”、“// VIBE CHECK”、“// NO BUGS”、“// JUST VIBES”。角色前方是一台打开的笔记本电脑，上面贴着 4 张可见的贴纸：“vibe > spec”、“DON'T THINK JUST PROMPT”、一个笑脸贴纸、“Claude 3.5”，以及一个抽象的 AI 风格标志贴纸。笔记本电脑后方是 2 台宽屏显示器，显示着深色主题的密集代码。背景包括左侧的 2 张墙面便签/标语：一张写着“IDEAS > PLANS”的便签；右侧是一个项目，上面有 3 行手写文字“BUILD FAST”、“BREAK THINGS”、“ASK AI”，下方还有第四行“REPEAT”，以及一个手绘笑脸。项目旁边是一个粉紫色霓虹灯 </> 代码图标标志。右下角的桌子上放着一个哑光黑色饮料罐，上面用粉色文字写着“FOCUS (optional)”，还有一个写着“ITERATE LATER”的披萨盒边缘。运用丰富的阴影、柔和的实用光线、紫色和青色的轮廓光、微妙的显示器光晕、浅景深、高对比度、光面高级海报质感，以及一种略显荒诞、具有自我意识的初创公司喜剧基调。底部居中的白色标语文字显示 {argument name="tagline text" default="HE’S NOT A PROGRAMMER. HE’S A VIBE CODER."}，其中“VIBE”一词以粉色高亮显示。下方是白色和红色的发布日期行 {argument name="release line" default="ONLY ON NETFLIX | COMING SOON"}，其中“NETFLIX”为加粗红色。使其看起来像是一部虚构流媒体剧集的精致官方预告海报。

templates.title: 2x2 Makeup Portrait Collage

titleLocalized.zh: 2x2 美妆人像拼图

templates.prompt: A simple 2x2 portrait puzzle, with the main subject being {argument name="subject" default="A young East Asian woman"} The background is a minimalist, soft white studio setting, shot in a high-end beauty editing style. Each of the four frames is a tight close-up or half-body portrait, with soft, diffused lighting that reveals realistic skin texture, clear pores, delicate natural freckles, dewy eyes, and sharp details in the eyelashes, lips, and hair. The overall tone is elegant, clear, and neutral, with soft pink accents; the subject is kept in a straight line in most frames.{argument name="hair color" default="black"} Her hairstyle features light, wispy bangs. In the top left corner, she faces the camera, her hands resting on her cheeks, elbows outside the frame, creating a cute, symmetrical pose; most of her face is obscured by her hands, only her hair, ears, and the side of her face are visible. The top right corner shows the clearest portrait: she looks directly at the camera, her expression calm and slightly melancholic, her fingers interlaced in front of her lips, sporting long, semi-transparent light pink manicures, and four thick pink plastic flower rings on her fingers; her makeup is exquisite, and her lips are slightly parted. In the bottom left corner, she rests one hand on a white table, two pink hair clips adorning the left side of her hair; her style is casual and youthful, her posture relaxed. The bottom right corner shows a close-up of her upper body with her hair tied up, one hand supporting her chin, wearing a light pink inner layer and a fluffy off-white fleece zip-up jacket; her makeup is minimalist, and her expression is quiet and natural. The composition maintains the editorial style and is balanced, with thin white borders separating each frame, presenting a hyper-realistic beauty photography effect. The image quality is clear, the details are sharp, the skin texture is natural, and the shadows are soft, possessing the quality of a high-end cosmetics advertising film.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张简洁的 2x2 人像拼图，主体为 {argument name="subject" default="一位年轻的东亚女性"}，背景为极简影棚风格的柔和白色，采用高端美妆编辑风格拍摄。四格画面均为紧凑的特写或半身像，光线柔和漫射，呈现真实的皮肤纹理、清晰的毛孔、细腻的自然雀斑、水润的眼眸，以及睫毛、嘴唇和发丝的锐利细节。整体色调淡雅、通透且中性，带有柔和的粉色点缀；主体在多数画面中留着直的 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"} 发型，并带有轻薄的刘海。左上角画面中，她正对镜头，双手按在脸颊上，手肘位于画框外，形成可爱的对称姿势；面部大部分被双手遮挡，仅露出头发、耳朵和脸部侧面。右上角画面展示最清晰的美妆人像：直视镜头，表情平静略带忧郁，手指交叉置于唇前，留着长款半透明淡粉色美甲，手指上佩戴着 4 枚厚实的粉色塑料花朵戒指，妆容精致，双唇微启。左下角画面中，她单手叠放支撑在白色桌面上，左侧头发上别着 2 个粉色发夹，造型休闲年轻，姿态放松。右下角画面展示一张扎起头发的半身特写，单手托腮，身穿浅粉色内搭和毛茸茸的米白色羊羔绒拉链外套，妆容极简，表情安静自然。构图保持编辑风格且平衡，各画面间由细白边分隔，呈现超写实美妆摄影效果，画质清晰，细节锐利，皮肤质感自然，阴影柔和，具备高端化妆品广告大片的品质。

templates.title: Neumorphic Glass UI Kit Project

titleLocalized.zh: Neumorphic Glass UI Kit 项目

templates.prompt: The design showcases clean, skeuomorphic UI components against a soft, light gray background. The layout comprises 18 individual interface elements in a balanced design, featuring subtle shadows, a frosted, translucent white plastic surface, rounded corners, and a polished glass-like texture. Employing a sophisticated minimalist product design aesthetic, it combines a white-on-white layered effect, soft ambient light masking, refined internal shadows, and restrained accents of deep turquoise and vibrant orange. Includes 18 unique components: a large circular rotary knob in the upper left corner with a deep cyan center, fine radial scale, and a small orange position indicator; a small circular directional control with a cyan center button and four tiny arrow icons around it; a circular play button with a cyan triangle icon and a short orange progress arc around the edge; a horizontal pill-shaped toggle switch in the upper right corner with a cyan knob on the right; a rounded square heart-shaped button with a simple cyan outline heart; a small circular indicator button with an orange dot in the center; a pill-shaped plus/minus control with a cyan minus sign on the left and a cyan plus sign on the right, separated by a vertical dividing line; a long horizontal volume slider with a cyan speaker icon, fine slider scale, cyan track, a cyan knob near the right, and a faint waveform icon on the far right; a circular percentage dial displaying 60% with radial scale and several orange highlights near the upper right; a rounded square bell notification button with a cyan outline bell icon; 1 A compact music player card, with a small square album art of evergreen trees shrouded in mist on the left, titled "..."{argument name="track title" default="Forest Drive"} The subtitle is{argument name="track subtitle" default="Ambient Journey"} The interface features a thin progress bar and a circular play button on the right; a row of four small, circular utility icon buttons displaying slider/settings, search, share, and ellipsis respectively; a large circular compass with directional letters N, E, S, W and diagonal labels, featuring a cyan and orange pointer and a metal center; a tall, vertical slider on the right with a cyan track, a cyan knob in the center, small dots on the side, orange accents near the bottom, and a tiny speaker icon below; a bottom navigation bar, shaped like a pill with rounded corners, containing four icons separated by subtle lines: Home, bar chart, compass, and user profile, with the Home label in cyan activation; and a large, rounded pill-shaped call-to-action button in a glossy dark cyan color, labeled as {argument name="button text" default="Explore"} On the right side is a circular orange arrow button and a rounded square fingerprint button with a cyan fingerprint icon. With ample spacing and grid-based alignment, the overall rendering is highly refined, tactile, and futuristic, resembling a prototype of a luxury smart device UI suite.

templates.title: Biomimetic Smart Dashboard UI

titleLocalized.zh: 拟态风格智能仪表盘 UI

templates.prompt: A minimalist, skeuomorphic mobile dashboard UI mockup, viewed from the front, is centered on a soft light gray background and embedded within a white, rounded smartphone bezel with delicate embossed shadows and soft highlights. The interface features a minimalist white background with touches of turquoise and warm orange. A small circular menu button is located at the top left of the screen, with a speaker grille and front-facing camera dot in the center, and icons displaying Wi-Fi, signal strength, 100% battery level, and battery status on the right. The main layout comprises 12 unique UI modules: The top left corner features a large time card displaying "AM," "10:24," and "Friday, May 24th," with three miniature pagination dots below; the top right corner features a weather card displaying a soft 3D cloudy-to-sunny icon, "24°," "partly cloudy," and "New York"; below the time card are four small circular operation buttons arranged in a row: a grid icon, a heart, a bell, and a gear, with the grid button filled in dark cyan; to the right of the buttons is a slender horizontal slider card with a water droplet icon, "40%," and a cyan progress bar; the center left features a large circular volume controller with a thick, beveled silver knob, a surrounding scale ring (cyan on the left, orange on the right), a short orange indicator line near the top right, small speaker icons on either side, and a capsule-shaped label that reads "VOLUME"; the center right features a music player card with a square album cover featuring a dark cyan wave pattern, titled "Ocean Drive," with the subtitle "Miami." "Nights" features a thin orange progress bar displaying the times "1:45" and "3:48", along with three circular play control buttons for previous, play, and next tracks, with the play button filled in cyan. Below the music player are three small, rounded buttons: a cyan equalizer icon, a radio icon, and a slider icon. In the lower left corner is a compass card with a small circular button at the top corner, displaying the heading text "320° NW" above, and a fine analog compass with the letters N, E, S, and W and a cyan-orange pointer pointing northwest. In the lower right corner is an equalizer card with four vertical sliders, markings "+12", "0", and "-12", and frequency labels at the bottom "60", "250", "1K", "4K", and "16K", using orange sliders and white knobs. The bottom dock contains five control buttons: an orange circular power button, a small Bluetooth button, a central capsule-shaped waveform panel, a crescent button, and a sun brightness button. Utilizing soft ambient shadows, delicate internal embossing, rounded corners, and precise spacing, it creates a futuristic smart home or control center aesthetic inspired by the high-end Dribbble skeuomorphic style, featuring an ultra-refined, clear vector UI with a realistic sense of depth and exquisite product quality.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个简洁的拟态风格移动端仪表盘 UI 模型，采用正视视角，居中置于柔和的浅灰色背景之上，嵌入在一个带有细腻浮雕阴影和光泽柔和高光的白色圆角智能手机边框内。界面采用极简的白底白设计，辅以青绿色和暖橙色的点缀。手机顶部左侧设有一个小型圆形菜单按钮，中间为扬声器缝隙和前置摄像头圆点，右侧为显示 Wi-Fi、信号、100% 电量及电池状态的图标。主布局包含 12 个独特的 UI 模块：左上角为一个大型时间卡片，显示“AM”、“10:24”及“5 月 24 日，星期五”，下方带有三个微型分页圆点；右上角为一个天气卡片，显示柔和的 3D 多云转晴图标、“24°”、“局部多云”及“纽约”；时间卡片下方一行排列着 4 个小型圆形操作按钮，分别为网格图标、心形、铃铛和齿轮，其中网格按钮填充为深青色；按钮右侧为一个细长的水平滑块卡片，带有水滴图标、“40%”及青色进度条；左侧中部为一个大型圆形音量控制器，配有厚实的斜面银色旋钮、周围环绕的刻度环（左侧为青色，右侧为橙色）、右上角附近的短橙色指示线、两侧的小型扬声器图标，以及一个写有“VOLUME”的胶囊状标签；右侧中部为一个音乐播放器卡片，带有深青色波浪纹的方形专辑封面，标题为“Ocean Drive”，副标题为“Miami Nights”，一条橙色的细播放进度条显示时间“1:45”和“3:48”，以及三个用于上一曲、播放、下一曲的圆形传输控制按钮，其中播放按钮填充为青色；音乐播放器下方一行排列着 3 个小型圆角按钮，分别为填充青色的均衡器图标、广播图标和滑块图标；左下角为一个指南针卡片，顶部角落设有小型圆形按钮，上方显示航向文本“320° NW”，以及一个带有 N、E、S、W 字母和指向西北方向的青橙双色指针的精细模拟指南针；右下角为一个均衡器卡片，带有四个垂直滑块、刻度标记“+12”、“0”、“-12”以及底部的频率标签“60”、“250”、“1K”、“4K”、“16K”，使用橙色滑块杆和白色旋钮；底部停靠栏包含 5 个控制按钮：一个橙色圆形电源按钮、一个小型蓝牙按钮、一个中央胶囊状波形面板、一个新月按钮和一个太阳亮度按钮。运用柔和的环境阴影、细腻的内部浮雕、圆角设计、精确的间距，打造出受高端 Dribbble 拟态风格启发、超精细、清晰的矢量 UI、具有真实深度感和精致产品质感的未来主义智能家居或控制中心美学。

templates.title: Mimicry Smart UI Suite

titleLocalized.zh: 拟态智能 UI 套件

templates.prompt: Create a high-end, futuristic smart home and media control UI suite against a clean, light gray background. The layout is balanced with a dashboard-style design, featuring floating rounded cards and circular controls with soft, squeezed shadows, subtle internal highlights, a matte white surface, and elegant cyan and orange accents. The overall style is minimalist, futuristic, tactilely realistic, and highly refined, reminiscent of high-end mobile interface concepts. It includes 18 independent UI modules and icons: a large circular volume knob card in the top left corner with a dark cyan center, dotted edges, plus/minus symbols, and the text "VOLUME 67%"; a vertical volume slider card with a "VOLUME" label, a white knob, an orange level bar, a small speaker icon, and "67%"; a large circular balance dial in the top right center with 25, 50, 75, and 100 numerical scales, a central value of "72%", a label "BALANCE", and a small orange indicator; a circular compass widget in the top right corner with N, E, S, and W labels, a metallic cyan pointer, and a small orange accent dot on the edge; a smaller circular minimum-maximum knob in the center left center with a cyan center, textured white dial edges, an orange indicator, and "MIN" and "MAX" labels; three small circular function buttons in the bottom row, displaying a power symbol, a connection or wireless symbol, and a heart outline; below these buttons is a... A horizontal toggle switch with a cyan knob and the word "ON"; a large media player card in the center with a square album cover displaying abstract, layered cyan dunes or waves, the track title "Beyond The Horizon," the artist name "Aurora Nights," a heart icon in the upper right corner, a waveform progress display, timestamps "1:45" and "3:58," and four playback controls in the bottom row: shuffle, previous track, a central orange play button, next track, and loop; two columns of three rows of six rounded square application icons on the right, precisely displaying the following symbols: paper airplane arrow, stacked layers, a shield with a checkmark, clouds, a bell with a small orange notification dot, and a gear; a rectangular clock card in the lower left corner with a circular analog clock face, a large digital time "10:58 AM," a date line "Thursday, May 23," and sunrise/sunset times "06:15 AM" and "08:24 PM"; and a weather card at the bottom center displaying the location "San The screen displays "Francisco," current temperature "18°," weather condition "Partly Cloudy," high/low temperature "H: 21° L: 13°," a large inset of the sun behind clouds, and five columns of hourly forecasts labeled "11 AM," "12 PM," "1 PM," "2 PM," and "3 PM." In the lower right corner, a pill-shaped label selector contains three labels; the left label is active (cyan with an audio waveform icon), while the other two display a user icon and a folder icon. Directly below it is a search bar with a magnifying glass and the placeholder text "Search...". Below the search bar is a horizontal slider with a cyan progress bar and a white knob. In the lower right corner is a large, rounded CTA button with the text "...".{argument name="button text" default="EXPLORE"} The design features a centrally located icon with an orange arrow pointing to the right. Five circular navigation icons are centered at the bottom edge, displaying the homepage, a bar chart, a calendar with "23" on it, a chat bubble, and the user profile. Two floating action buttons are also present: a camera icon and an orange plus sign. The design uses a restrained color scheme primarily of white and very light gray surfaces, with a deep cyan-green gradient for active states and warm orange for highlights and notifications. Depth is emphasized through soft ambient shadows, subtle bevels, glossy reflections, and realistic material rendering. The layout remains spacious, symmetrical, yet not rigid, making it suitable for high-end mobile application concept demonstrations.

promptLocalized.zh: 在干净的浅灰色背景上创建一个高端的拟态智能家居与媒体控制 UI 套件，以平衡的仪表盘风格布局排列，包含悬浮圆角卡片和带有柔和挤压阴影、细腻内部高光、磨砂白色表面以及优雅青色与橙色点缀的圆形控件。整体风格极简、具有未来感、触感真实且高度精致，如同高端移动端界面概念。包含 18 个独立的 UI 模块和图标：左上角 1 个大型圆形音量旋钮卡片，中心为深青色光泽，带有圆点边缘、加减符号以及文字“VOLUME 67%”；1 个垂直音量滑块卡片，带有“VOLUME”标签、白色旋钮、橙色电平条、小型扬声器图标和“67%”；顶部中右侧 1 个大型圆形平衡拨盘，带有 25、50、75、100 的数字刻度，中心数值为“72%”，标签为“BALANCE”，以及一个小型橙色指示点；右上角 1 个圆形指南针小部件，带有 N、E、S、W 标签、金属青色指针以及边缘的一个小型橙色强调点；左侧中部 1 个较小的圆形最小-最大旋钮，带有青色中心、纹理白色拨盘边缘、橙色指示点以及“MIN”和“MAX”标签；下方一行 3 个小型圆形功能按钮，分别显示电源符号、连接或无线符号以及心形轮廓；这些按钮下方 1 个水平切换开关，带有青色旋钮和文字“ON”；中心 1 个大型媒体播放器卡片，带有显示抽象层叠青色沙丘或波浪的方形专辑封面，曲目名称“Beyond The Horizon”，艺术家名称“Aurora Nights”，右上角心形图标，波形进度显示，时间戳“1:45”和“3:58”，以及底部一行的 4 个播放控件：随机播放、上一首、中央橙色播放按钮、下一首和循环播放；右侧两列 3 行共 6 个圆角方形应用图标，精确显示以下符号：纸飞机箭头、堆叠图层、带勾选标记的盾牌、云朵、带有小型橙色通知点的铃铛以及齿轮；左下角 1 个矩形时钟卡片，带有圆形模拟时钟表盘、大型数字时间“10:58 AM”、日期行“Thursday, May 23”以及日出/日落时间“06:15 AM”和“08:24 PM”；底部中心 1 个天气卡片，显示位置“San Francisco”、当前温度“18°”、天气状况“Partly Cloudy”、最高/最低温“H: 21° L: 13°”、大型云后太阳插图，以及标注为“11 AM”、“12 PM”、“1 PM”、“2 PM”、“3 PM”的 5 列小时预报；右下角 1 个药丸状标签选择器，包含 3 个标签，左侧标签为激活状态（青色，带音频波形图标），另外 2 个标签显示用户图标和文件夹图标；其正下方 1 个搜索栏，带有放大镜和占位符文字“Search...”；搜索栏下方 1 个水平滑块，带有青色进度线和白色旋钮；右下角 1 个大型圆角 CTA 按钮，文字为“{argument name="button text" default="EXPLORE"}”，并带有一个向右的橙色箭头；底部边缘居中 5 个圆形底部导航图标，分别显示主页、柱状图、带有“23”的日历、聊天气泡和用户个人资料，旁边还有 2 个悬浮操作按钮：相机图标和橙色加号。使用以白色和极浅灰色表面为主的克制色调，激活状态使用深青绿色渐变，高亮和通知使用暖橙色。通过柔和的环境阴影、细腻的斜面、光泽反射和逼真的材质渲染来强调深度。保持布局宽敞、对称但不僵硬，适合高端移动应用概念演示。

templates.title: Screenshots from the martial arts MMORPG "Ancient Town" game

titleLocalized.zh: 武侠 MMORPG 古镇游戏截图

templates.prompt: A meticulously detailed, cinematic-quality screenshot of a third-person martial arts MMORPG is shown. The scene is set at dusk in a bustling ancient Chinese water town market street, with the perspective positioned behind the player character in the foreground center. The player character is a wandering swordsman, dressed in a dark gray and blue Hanfu-style robe with embroidered patterns, his long black hair tied in a low ponytail, carrying a sword sheath on his back, facing the crowded street ahead. The environment is a beautifully rendered Ming or Song Dynasty-style town, featuring traditional wooden shops, tiled roofs, hanging red lanterns, pink cherry blossom trees, damp, reflective cobblestone streets, a soft golden sunset, and townspeople dressed in ancient costumes. In the right foreground, three elegant female geishas in semi-transparent light-colored Hanfu stand outside an ornately decorated teahouse or brothel, draped with red silk curtains; one is playing the pipa, one sits in a light green and beige robe, and the other stands in a flowing rose-pink robe. The largest shop sign at the top features gold Chinese characters on a black plaque, and vertical shop banners with Chinese characters hang on both sides of the street. The overall composition should present the quality of a top-tier AAA Chinese fantasy RPG, with realistic character proportions, dense scene narrative, dramatic yet natural lighting, atmospheric depth, and complex clothing textures. It includes a complete Chinese game HUD overlay: a circular character portrait in the upper left corner displaying level 36 and two horizontal health and mana progress bars; a quest tracking panel on the left with four quest entries under each tag title; a semi-transparent chat box in the lower left corner displaying multiple lines of Chinese world chat content; a circular minimap in the upper right corner with location text; a vertical menu on the right with six icon buttons; a skill bar at the bottom center with ten slots, including eight square skill icons and two circular end slots with keyboard key labels; and a bottom menu row with six navigation icons. The game features ultra-detailed, photorealistic simulations of a fantasy game interface, exquisite UI, an immersive and crowded street scene, and a 16:9 aspect ratio.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张细节极其丰富的电影级第三人称武侠 MMORPG 游戏截图，场景设定在黄昏时分熙熙攘攘的中国古代水乡集市街道，视角位于前景中央玩家角色的后方。玩家角色是一位流浪剑客，身着深灰色与蓝色交叠的汉服风格长袍，衣物带有刺绣纹理，黑色长发扎成低马尾，背负一把剑鞘，正面向前方拥挤的街道。环境是渲染精美的明代或宋代风格城镇，拥有传统木质店面、瓦片屋顶、悬挂的红灯笼、粉色樱花树、潮湿且带有倒影的石板路、柔和的金色夕阳，以及身着古装的城镇居民。右侧前景处，恰好有 3 位优雅的女性艺伎身着半透明的淡色汉服，站在装饰华丽的茶馆或青楼外，此处挂有红色丝绸帘幕；其中一人正在弹奏琵琶，一人身着淡绿色与米色长袍坐着，另一人身着飘逸的玫瑰粉色长袍站立。上方最大的店招牌上写有黑色牌匾上的金色中文字体，街道两旁还悬挂着带有汉字的垂直店铺旗帜。整体构图应呈现出顶级 AAA 级中国奇幻 RPG 的质感，具备写实的角色比例、密集的场景叙事、戏剧性但自然的灯光、大气深度以及复杂的服装材质。包含完整的中文游戏 HUD 叠加层：左上角圆形角色头像，显示 36 级及 2 条水平的生命值与法力值进度条；左侧任务追踪面板，在标签标题下包含 4 条任务条目；左下角半透明聊天框，显示多行中文世界频道聊天内容；右上角圆形小地图，带有位置文本；右侧垂直菜单，包含 6 个图标按钮；底部中央的技能栏，包含 10 个槽位，其中 8 个方形技能图标及 2 个带有键盘按键标签的圆形末端槽位；底部菜单行包含 6 个导航图标。超细节、照片级真实的奇幻游戏界面模拟图，精致的 UI，沉浸式拥挤街道场景，16:9 纵横比。

templates.title: Japanese graduation photos under cherry blossom trees

titleLocalized.zh: 樱花树下的日本毕业照

templates.prompt: A soft, realistic photo of a Japanese graduation day, taken in a retro film style, shows six teenage girls standing outdoors against a backdrop of blooming cherry blossoms and the school gate. They are dressed in matching Japanese high school uniforms: navy blue blazers, white shirts, burgundy bow ties, grey-blue plaid pleated skirts, navy blue knee-high socks, and black loafers, each carrying a large navy blue backpack. The students stand close together on the road outside the school gate, their body language relaxed and cheerful, creating a casual class photo feel. At least five girls are making peace signs next to their faces, while the girl on the far right raises her hand in a playful salute. The photo emphasizes natural, long legs, neat dark straight hair with soft bangs, youthful styling, and realistic proportions. The composition is a full-body frontal shot, with the students slightly to the left and the school gate on the right. The image features a tall, black gatepost with the words "Sakura Girls' High School" inscribed vertically in gold Japanese. Next to it stands a white ceremonial signboard with the prominent Japanese words "Graduation Certificate Conferment Ceremony" and the school's name in smaller print below. The background is filled with blooming pale pink cherry blossoms, creating a shallow depth of field, soft pastel tones, a light spring mist, bright sunlight on a cloudy day, delicate film grain, and gentle contrast, all contributing to a low-key and nostalgic atmosphere reminiscent of an old-fashioned commemorative photograph.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张柔和、写实的日本毕业日照片，采用复古胶片摄影风格，展示了 6 名十几岁的女学生站在户外，背景是盛开的樱花和学校大门。她们穿着统一的日本高中校服：海军蓝西装外套、白衬衫、酒红色蝴蝶结、灰蓝色格子百褶裙、海军蓝及膝袜和黑色乐福鞋，每人背着一个大号海军蓝书包。这群学生紧挨着站在校门口的路上，肢体语言轻松欢快，呈现出随意的班级合影感。其中至少 5 名女生在脸旁比着剪刀手，最右侧的一名女生举起手做着俏皮的敬礼姿势。强调自然、修长的腿部线条，整齐的深色直发配上柔和的刘海，青春的造型以及真实的比例。构图为正面全身照，学生们略微偏左，学校大门位于右侧。画面中包含一根高大的黑色门柱，上面有垂直的金色日文“桜花女子高等学校”，旁边立着一块白色仪式告示牌，上面写着醒目的日文“卒業証書授与式”以及下方较小的校名。背景是盛开的淡粉色樱花树，浅景深，柔和的粉彩色调，淡淡的春日薄雾，阴天明亮的日光，细腻的胶片颗粒感，柔和的对比度，营造出一种老式纪念照片般低调而怀旧的氛围。

templates.title: Screenshots of ancient Chinese RPG market games

titleLocalized.zh: 中国古代 RPG 市场游戏截图

templates.prompt: A cinematic-quality screenshot from a third-person fantasy RPG game, set in a golden hour ancient Chinese market. The perspective is from behind the foreground party characters, overlooking a bustling cobblestone street, with a magnificent multi-tiered pagoda standing in the distance. The scene is rich in detail. At the center is a male hero in a magnificent deep red and black robe adorned with gold armor, holding a drawn sword pointing downwards. Beside him is a female companion in an elegant, flowing white Hanfu with red trim and gold ornaments. Four blurred foreground observers or guards frame the composition, two on each side. The street is crowded with townspeople in ancient costumes. On both sides of the street are traditional wooden buildings with arched tiled roofs, adorned with lanterns, red flags, and cloth awnings, with stalls and warm light shining from the windows. Petals or glowing particles drift in the air, creating a soft atmospheric haze, a strong depth effect, and rich, warm sunlight with long shadows. The visuals should present the exquisite quality of a AAA-level open-world martial arts action game, highly detailed, dramatic, immersive, and possessing a stylized fantasy aesthetic. It should include a complete in-game HUD interface: a square minimap with icons in the upper right corner; a quest list on the right side displaying 3 quests, the first of which is shown as {argument name="quest objective" default="Explore the West Gate Mansion"} The other two are repetitive combat-related missions; the circular player status area in the lower left corner includes health and stamina bars, as well as location text.{argument name="location name" default="Dinghe County"} The bottom center action bar contains 6 circular skill icons; the bottom right corner features a row of 8 small menus or system icons. It employs a 16:9 widescreen composition, ultra-refined environmental art, cinematic lighting and shadows, and shallow depth of field with foreground blur, creating a magnificent Chinese historical fantasy atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影级第三人称奇幻 RPG 游戏截图，背景设定在黄金时刻的中国古代市集，视角位于前景小队角色后方，俯瞰着繁忙的石板街道，远方矗立着一座宏伟的多层宝塔。场景细节丰富，画面中心为 1 名身着华丽深红黑配色长袍、点缀金色铠甲的男性英雄，手持向下指的拔出长剑；身旁有 1 名身着优雅飘逸白底红边汉服、佩戴金饰的女性同伴。周围有 4 名模糊的前景旁观者或守卫作为构图框架，左右各 2 名，街道上挤满了身着古装的城镇居民。街道两侧是带有弧形瓦顶的传统木质建筑，挂着灯笼、红旗、布质遮阳棚，设有摊位，窗户透出温暖的灯光。空中飘散着花瓣或发光粒子，带有柔和的大气雾感、强烈的景深效果，以及浓郁温暖的阳光和长长的阴影。画面应呈现出精致的 AAA 级开放世界武侠动作游戏质感，高度细腻、充满戏剧性、沉浸感强，并兼具风格化的奇幻美感。包含完整的游戏内 HUD 界面：右上角带有图标的方形小地图；右侧任务列表，其中可见 3 条任务，第 1 条显示为 {argument name="quest objective" default="探索西门府邸"}，其余 2 条为重复的战斗类任务；左下角圆形玩家状态区，包含生命值和体力条，以及位置文本 {argument name="location name" default="定河县"}；底部中央动作栏，包含 6 个圆形技能图标；右下角一排 8 个小型菜单或系统图标。采用 16:9 宽屏构图，超精细环境艺术，电影级光影，浅景深前景模糊，营造出宏伟的中国历史奇幻氛围。

templates.prompt: A luxurious studio fashion portrait, in which {argument name="group size" default="Four"} Elegant young women huddle together in a dramatic, dreamlike royal blue setting. They wear coordinated haute couture gowns in deep sapphire and midnight navy blue, adorned with shimmering beads, floral appliqués, sequins, lace sleeves, sheer mesh details, and voluminous, tiered skirts. The scene is monochromatic in blue, with a cool, melancholic, and sophisticated editorial gradation. The women are arranged in a tight triangular composition: two standing or positioned higher behind, two seated on a fabric-covered floor in front, each with a distinctly elegant posture: one with an arm raised above her head, one slightly tilted, one seated upright, and one with her chin resting on her hand. Their gowns, though individual, are unified in style, embellished with opulent crystals, embroidered flowers, and fitted bodices. Matching sapphire jewelry completes the look, including pendant earrings, gemstone necklaces, and floral hair accessories. Their long, flowing hair, a blend of deep black and soft light brown, is sleek and captivating. The scene is surrounded by a lavish backdrop: two classic urn-shaped vases filled with blue roses, a fluted stone pillar, heavy, shimmering velvet curtains, and piles of satin fabrics. Soft, diffused lighting creates subtle highlights on the satin and jewelry, evoking a noble, mysterious, and romantic atmosphere. The portrait, shot vertically from waist up to full body, showcases the highly detailed fabric textures, presenting a refined and luxurious beauty advertising aesthetic. No text is visible in the image.

titleLocalized.zh: 复古涩谷街头肖像

templates.prompt: A fashionable street portrait of a young woman standing at a busy Tokyo intersection during the day. The shot focuses on her upper body, with her back slightly to the camera, highlighting her bare shoulders. She has a messy short bob haircut, and her hair color is {argument name="hair color" default="Platinum"} The fabric was light and soft, and she was petite. She was wearing a {argument name="clothing color" default="White"} The off-shoulder top, made of a light and semi-transparent fabric with a beautiful drape, creates a romantic and airy atmosphere. She is placed in the foreground on the left side of the image, using a shallow depth of field effect, with a bustling background of pedestrians crossing the street. Behind her, a building with curved glass is added, and the viewer can see {argument name="background sign" default="TSUTAYA"} The logo is designed to evoke the spirit of Shibuya. It employs a warm, retro film aesthetic, with slightly faded tones, noticeable grain, a subtle blur, soft sunlight, gentle contrast, and a nostalgic, simulated snapshot atmosphere. The overall tone should be stylish, natural, and cinematic, like a fashion editorial shot captured in a bustling city.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张年轻女性站在繁忙的东京十字路口白天的街拍时尚肖像，取景范围为上半身，她微微背对镜头，突显出裸露的肩部。她留着一头凌乱的短波波头，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="铂金色"}，质感轻盈柔和，身形娇小。她穿着一件 {argument name="clothing color" default="白色"} 的露肩上衣，面料轻薄半透明，垂坠感十足，营造出浪漫轻盈的氛围。将她置于画面左侧前景，采用浅景深效果，背景是熙熙攘攘的过街行人。在她身后，加入一栋带有弧形玻璃的建筑，并可见 {argument name="background sign" default="TSUTAYA"} 的标志，以此呈现涩谷风情。采用温暖的复古胶片美学，色调略显褪色，带有明显的颗粒感、轻微模糊、柔和的阳光、柔和的对比度，以及怀旧的模拟快照氛围。整体基调应显得时尚、自然且具有电影感，如同在繁华都市中抓拍的时尚大片。

templates.title: Elegant Chinese Perpetual Calendar App UI

titleLocalized.zh: 优雅的中国万年历 App UI

templates.prompt: This is a clean and elegant iPhone app UI prototype showcasing a Chinese perpetual calendar and almanac application. The screenshot is a full-screen mobile screenshot with a soft, warm white background that has a delicate paper-like texture, presenting a refined East Asian editorial aesthetic. The interface uses a minimalist mix of serif and sans-serif fonts, with a color scheme including soft brown, gray, black, light blue, green, and gold accents. The layout is spacious with delicate dividing lines. The top displays the iOS status bar, showing the time as 8:45, along with cellular signal, Wi-Fi icons, and a 96% battery level indicator. Below is {argument name="month" default="April"} The title is accompanied by the subtitle "24th | Daily Perpetual Calendar," and on the right is a rounded rectangular date selection button labeled "Choose a Date," accompanied by a calendar icon and a plus sign. The main body is {argument name="year" default="2026"} The yearly calendar grid contains 7 columns of days of the week, labeled in Chinese as: Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, and Saturday. It renders a 6-row month view with 42 date cells, including dates for adjacent months. The visible dates should be: Row 1: 29, 30, 31, 1, 2, 3, 4; Row 2: 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11; Row 3: 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18; Row 4: 19, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25; Row 5: 26, 27, 28, 29, 30, 1, 2; Row 6: 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9. Each date cell contains a larger Gregorian calendar date, with a smaller lunar calendar date or note below. Add colored holiday and solar term labels to specific cells, displaying a total of 10 highlighted labels: "7-day holiday" on the 4th, "Qingming Festival" on the 5th, "19-day holiday" on the 6th, "Grain Rain" (green) on the 20th, "Labor Day" on the 1st of next month, "16-day holiday" on the 2nd of next month, "17-day holiday" on the 3rd in the last row, "Youth Day" on the 4th in the last row, "Start of Summer" on the 5th in the last row, and "Tianhou's Birthday" (orange) on the 9th in the last row. Add tiny moon phase markers to some dates, including a yellow crescent or dot icon around the 2nd, 10th, 17th, 24th, and the 2nd of next month. Add the Friday column {argument name="selected date" default="24"} The cells are highlighted with rounded blue gradient tiles and soft shadows, and the words "Eighth Day of the Lunar Calendar" are displayed in small print inside. Below the calendar, a detailed daily information panel is separated by white space. The left side features the prominent date title "April 24th"; the right side displays "Friday 2026" and "Eighth Day of the Third Lunar Month". Below are smaller gray metadata lines, such as "Day 114, Week 17, Golden Month" and traditional sexagenary cycle year/date strings, such as "Bingwu, Year of the Horse, Month of Renchen, Day of Wuchen". On the far right of this metadata area is a rounded capsule button labeled "Today". Below that is a large white rounded card with almanac guidance. The card contains two main sections with two headings: a green "Suitable" section and a red "Unsuitable" section, separated by a thin dotted line. The "Suitable" section includes the directional fortune lines "God of Happiness Southeast, God of Fortune North, God of Wealth North" and three activities: "Sacrifice", "Repair Walls", and "Avoid Other Activities". The "Taboos" section includes the conflicting line "Clashing with Dog, Facing South". At the bottom is a 5-item iOS-style tab bar, labeled "Today", "Month", "Year", "Effects", and "MORE"; the first tab is active and includes a small sub-tab for "April 24th". Overall style: High-end app design concept, a dignified traditional Chinese calendar aesthetic, high-fidelity mobile product screenshots, a realistic yet idealized interface, perfectly aligned typography, delicate shadows, soft contrast, possessing the sophistication of a startup product.

promptLocalized.zh: 一款简洁、优雅的 iPhone App UI 原型，展示了一款中国万年历及黄历应用。画面为全屏移动端截图，背景采用柔和的暖白色，带有细腻的纸张质感，呈现出精致的东亚编辑美学。界面采用极简的衬线体与无衬线体混排，配色包括柔和的棕色、灰色、黑色、淡蓝色、绿色及金色点缀，布局宽敞，分割线细腻。顶部显示 iOS 状态栏，时间为 8:45，包含蜂窝信号、Wi‑Fi 图标及 96% 的电量显示。下方为 {argument name="month" default="4月"} 的标题，辅以“24日 | 每日万年历”的副标题，右侧设有一个圆角矩形日期选择按钮，标注为“择日”，并配有日历图标及一个加号图标。主体部分为 {argument name="year" default="2026"} 年的月历网格，包含 7 列星期，中文标注为：周日、周一、周二、周三、周四、周五、周六。渲染 6 行月视图，共 42 个日期单元格，包含相邻月份的日期。可见日期应为：第一行 29、30、31、1、2、3、4；第二行 5、6、7、8、9、10、11；第三行 12、13、14、15、16、17、18；第四行 19、20、21、22、23、24、25；第五行 26、27、28、29、30、1、2；第六行 3、4、5、6、7、8、9。每个日期单元格包含一个较大的公历日期，下方附有较小的农历日期或备注。在特定单元格中加入彩色的节假日和节气标签，共显示 10 个高亮标签：4 日的“休十七”、5 日的“清明节”、6 日的“休十九”、20 日绿色的“谷雨”、下月 1 日的“劳动节”、下月 2 日的“休十六”、最后一行 3 日的“休十七”、最后一行 4 日的“青年节”、最后一行 5 日的“休立夏”，以及最后一行 9 日橙色的“天后诞”。在部分日期上添加微小的月相标记，包括 2 日、10 日、17 日、24 日及下月 2 日周围的黄色月牙或圆点图标。将周五列中 {argument name="selected date" default="24"} 的单元格突出显示，采用圆角蓝色渐变磁贴和柔和阴影，内部标注较小的“初八”字样。日历下方通过留白分隔出一个详细的每日信息面板。左侧为醒目的日期标题“4月24日”；右侧堆叠显示“星期五 2026”和“农历三月初八”。下方包含较小的灰色元数据行，如“第114天 · 第17周 金尊月”以及传统的干支纪年/日期字符串，如“丙午 · 马年 壬辰月 戊辰日”。在此元数据区域的最右侧，放置一个标注为“今日”的圆角轮廓胶囊按钮。下方展示一张带有黄历指引的白色圆角大卡片。卡片包含两个主要部分，共 2 个标题：绿色的“宜”部分和红色的“忌”部分，由细虚线分隔。在“宜”部分，包含方位运势行“喜神 东南 福神 正北 财神 正北”以及三项活动：“祭祀”、“修饰垣墙”、“余事勿取”。在“忌”部分，包含冲突行“冲煞 冲狗 煞南”。底部展示一个 5 项的 iOS 风格标签栏，标签依次为“今日”、“MONTH”、“YEAR”、“EVENTS”、“MORE”；第一个标签处于激活状态，并包含“4月24日”的小型子标签。整体风格：高端 App 设计概念，沉稳的中国传统日历美学，高保真移动产品截图，既写实又理想化的界面，排版完美对齐，阴影细腻，对比度柔和，具备初创公司级产品的精致感。

templates.title: Minimalist anime girl profile

titleLocalized.zh: 极简动漫少女侧颜

templates.prompt: A minimalist anime-style portrait of a young woman, showing her from the chest up, her face turned to the left, her head slightly turned, revealing only part of her eyes and ears. She has a neat short bob haircut, with slightly inward-curling ends and a few slightly messy strands; her hair color is {argument name="hair color" default="Platinum"} Her skin is fair and smooth, and she wears a loose-fitting white off-shoulder top or sweater that slips down to one shoulder, revealing her collarbone and upper back. The composition is simple yet graphic, using fine lines in a deep navy blue, with flat, soft colors and almost no shadows, presenting a cool, editorial illustration quality. Solid colors are used.{argument name="background color" default="Bright blue"} The background should contain no objects, scenes, or text. Position the half-body portrait slightly to the left of the frame, with negative space around the subject. The overall atmosphere should be quiet, stylish, modern, and elegant, similar to anime girl illustrations on Japanese social media. Do not add any accessories, jewelry, or additional background elements.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极简动漫风格的年轻女性肖像，展示胸部以上部位，侧脸朝左，头部略微转动，仅露出部分眼睛和耳朵。她留着利落的短波波头，发梢微微内扣，带有轻微凌乱的发丝，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="铂金色"}。皮肤白皙光滑，身穿一件露肩的宽松白色上衣或毛衣，滑落至一侧肩头，露出锁骨和上背部。构图简洁且具有图形感，采用深海军蓝色的细线条，平涂柔和色彩，几乎没有阴影，呈现出一种冷静的编辑插画质感。使用纯色 {argument name="background color" default="亮青蓝色"} 背景，不含任何物体、场景或文字。将半身肖像置于画面偏左位置，人物周围留有负空间。整体氛围安静、时尚、现代且优雅，类似于日本社交媒体上的动漫少女插画。请勿添加任何配饰、珠宝或额外的背景元素。

templates.title: A fantasy poster featuring a tiger and a rose under the moonlight.

titleLocalized.zh: 月光下的虎与玫瑰奇幻海报

templates.prompt: A dreamlike, cinematic fantasy illustration, presented in a vertical poster format. The image showcases {argument name="celebrity model" default="Liu Yifei"} Her profile was silhouetted against the backdrop of a silver, mirror-like lake at midnight. A bright full moon and a richly detailed starry sky hung overhead, the Milky Way stretching diagonally behind her. She was an elegant East Asian woman with shoulder-length black hair, wearing a flowing, high-slit silver sleeveless evening gown that shimmered like stardust. Her expression was serene and introspective, facing to her right, one foot touching the water, creating delicate, luminous ripples. On either side of the horizon, low islands accentuated the vast expanse of water and sky. A luminous, soft white rose vine, its graceful S-curve winding around her, began above her back, spiraled over her waist and legs, and extended downwards into her reflection in the water. Beneath the surface, the reflection was not an ordinary mirror, but a gigantic, luminous tiger composed of slender, neon-colored lines, inverted from the woman above. The tiger's body was dynamically coiled, its head near a large, luminous white rose in the lower right corner; the tiger appeared majestic, lean, and ethereal, rather than aggressive. The overall color scheme is cool blue, silver, and white, accompanied by soft moonlight, halo effects, mirror reflections, magical realism, minimalist composition, and high detail, creating a romantic and fantastical atmosphere. Elegant cursive text is added to the center of the bottom.{argument name="quote" default="A tiger in the heart, yet a rose in the hand."} A small four-pointed star icon was added to the bottom right corner. The overall style is exquisite and poetic, visually symbolizing inner strength and gentleness.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张梦幻般的电影级奇幻插画，采用竖版海报格式。画面展示了 {argument name="celebrity model" default="刘亦菲"} 的侧影，她赤脚走在平静如镜的午夜蓝色湖面上，头顶是明亮的满月和细节丰富的星空，银河在身后斜向延伸。她是一位优雅的东亚女性，留着齐肩黑发，身穿闪烁着星尘般光芒的银色无袖晚礼服，裙摆飘逸且带有高开叉。她神情平静而内省，面向右侧，一只脚触碰水面，激起细腻的发光涟漪。地平线两侧各有一座低矮的小岛，突显出广阔的水域与天空。一株发光的柔美白玫瑰藤蔓以优雅的 S 型曲线缠绕在她的身上，从她后背上方开始，盘旋过腰部和腿部，并向下延伸至水中的倒影里。在水面之下，倒影并非普通的镜像，而是一只由纤细白色霓虹轮廓构成的巨大发光线条虎，与上方女子呈倒置关系，虎身动态蜷曲，虎头靠近右下角一朵巨大的发光白玫瑰；这只虎应显得威严、精瘦且空灵，而非具有攻击性。整体色调为冷蓝色、银色与白色，伴有柔和月光、光晕效果、镜面反射、魔幻现实主义、极简构图、高细节，营造出浪漫的奇幻氛围。在底部中心添加优雅的草书文字 {argument name="quote" default="心有猛虎，细嗅蔷薇。"}，并在右下角添加一个小巧的四角星图标。整体风格精致、富有诗意，视觉上象征着内在的力量与温柔。

templates.title: AI Guangzhou Food Map Comparison

titleLocalized.zh: AI 广州美食地图对比

templates.prompt: This is a comparison image with a black background and a light gray grid, designed in a style similar to a social media quiz result poster. At the top are two large, bold sans-serif headlines side-by-side: "GPT image 2" above the left image and "Nano Banana" above the right. Below are two vertically arranged illustrated posters with a small gap between them. Both posters represent the same concept: a hand-drawn map of Guangzhou's food scene, but present two different visual styles. The left poster is richer in detail, texture, and content, with delicate illustrations; the right poster is simpler, flatter, and more intuitive. The left poster uses a warm-toned cream paper background, presenting a refined retro hand-drawn travel map style with delicate lines, a watercolor-like texture, decorated with flowers and lychees, and featuring miniature buildings, roads, river areas, and numerous food illustrations. The large Chinese headline at the top of the left poster reads "Guangzhou Foodie Map." The map covers approximately 12 food spots scattered throughout the city, each accompanied by a small food illustration, a Chinese label, and a brief handwritten annotation. The visible food items include grilled skewers, roasted meats, noodles, claypot rice, rice noodle rolls, dim sum, soups, and dessert bowls, with landmarks such as the Canton Tower and river views also incorporated. The poster on the right also features the Chinese title "Guangzhou Foodie Rambling Map," showcasing the same concept but employing a simpler infographic map style. It simplifies roads, icons, floral and lychee border decorations, food labels, and includes illustrations of rivers, the Canton Tower, and approximately 12 labeled food items. At the bottom of the entire comparison image is a circular black text box with a white outline. In its upper left corner is a bright yellow circular label with the bold black Chinese characters "Prompt Word." Inside the black panel is a multi-line paragraph of white Chinese text describing the image-generated prompt word. The overall composition is centered, with high contrast, presenting a refined AI image comparison post suitable for Chinese social media, featuring clear typography, poster-like symmetry, and a clean benchmark aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 这是一张黑色背景、带有淡灰色方格网的对比图，设计风格类似于社交媒体的测试结果海报。顶部是两个并排的粗体无衬线大标题：左侧图像上方为“GPT image 2”，右侧图像上方为“Nano Banana”。下方是两张垂直排列的插画海报，中间留有细小间隙。两张海报表现了同一个概念：一张手绘风格的广州美食暴走地图，但呈现出两种不同的视觉风格。左侧海报细节更丰富、纹理感强、内容密集且插画细腻；右侧海报则更简洁、扁平且直观。左侧海报采用暖色调的奶油纸背景，呈现出精致的复古手绘旅行地图风格，线条细腻，带有水彩质感，装饰有花卉和荔枝，并绘有微缩建筑、道路、河流区域以及大量美食插画。左侧海报顶部的大号中文标题为“广州 吃货暴走地图”。地图涵盖了约 12 个分布在城市各处的美食点，每个点都配有小型美食插画、中文标签和简短的手写风格注释。可见的美食包括烤串、烧腊、面食、煲仔饭、肠粉、点心、汤品和甜品碗，广州塔和江景等地标也融入其中。右侧海报同样带有“广州 吃货暴走地图”的中文标题，展示了相同的构思，但采用了更简洁的信息图式地图风格，简化了道路、图标、花卉和荔枝边框装饰、美食标注，并绘有河流、广州塔以及约 12 个带有标签的美食插画。在整个对比图的底部，有一个带有白色轮廓的圆形黑色文本框。其左上角附有一个亮黄色的圆形标签，上面印有加粗的黑色中文字符“提示词”。黑色面板内是一段描述图像生成提示词的白色中文文本，呈现为多行段落。整体构图居中，对比度高，呈现为一张精致的 AI 图像对比帖，适用于中国社交媒体，具有清晰的排版、海报般的对称感以及简洁的测试基准美学。

templates.title: AI Poster Comparison Thumbnails

titleLocalized.zh: AI 海报对比缩略图

templates.prompt: A vertical social media comparison poster with a black background featuring a subtle gray grid, designed in a minimalist tech review style. At the top are two large headlines side-by-side: the left one reads "GPT image 2" in bright yellow; the right one reads "Nano Banana" in white. Below the headlines are two tall poster mockups placed side-by-side with narrow spacing, both using a beige paper style. The left mockup showcases a traditional Chinese ink-wash fantasy poster inspired by *Journey to the West*, with a large vertical Chinese calligraphy of "Journey to the West" in the upper left corner. The image includes soft dark brown and gray ink-wash mountains, cliffs, clouds, temple architecture, and four tiny silhouettes: two heroes on a rocky ledge in the upper middle, and two travelers below; a swirling, glowing cloud vortex appears at the bottom of the image. The right-hand mockup showcases a more graphic, surreal poster. The image is constructed within a left-facing silhouette of a human head, filled with a Chinese fantasy landscape featuring pagodas, flowing water, paths, and figures. The silhouette bears the vertical title "Journey to the West." The silhouette is rendered in deep navy blue and black ink wash, surrounded by cream-colored paper. Both posters feature a centered, blurred, vertical rectangular overlay with soft, gray-beige edges. At the bottom is a rounded black instruction panel with a thin white border. A bright yellow capsule-shaped label in the upper left corner contains the bold black Chinese text "Prompt Word." The bottom panel contains multiple lines of bold white Chinese text. The text should read: "A Journey to the West-themed collector's edition epic poster, with a complete world view and classic scenes emerging from the silhouettes of the characters' profiles. The overall style leans towards movie posters and dreamy watercolor illustrations, quiet, grand, sacred, and nostalgic, with paper grain, a light misty feel, brushstrokes, and sophisticated white space." The overall style features exquisite Chinese technology comparison thumbnails, high contrast, edited layout, centered composition, and a 4:5 vertical screen ratio.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张垂直的社交媒体对比海报，背景为黑色并带有细微的灰色网格，设计风格如同简洁的科技测评图。顶部有两个并排的大标题：左侧为亮黄色文字“GPT image 2”；右侧为白色文字“Nano Banana”。标题下方是两个间距较窄、并排摆放的高大海报样机，均采用米白色纸张风格。左侧样机展示了一张受《西游记》启发的传统中国水墨奇幻海报，左上方有巨大的竖排中文书法“西游记”，画面包含柔和的深褐色和灰色水墨山峦、悬崖、云雾、寺庙建筑，以及 4 个微小的人物剪影：2 个英雄人物位于中上部的岩架上，另有 2 个旅人位于场景下方；画面下部出现了一个旋转的发光云雾漩涡。右侧样机展示了一张更具图形感的超现实海报，画面构建在一个向左侧的人头剪影内，内部填充了包含宝塔、水流、小径、人物的中国奇幻景观，剪影内有竖排标题“西游记”；剪影以深海军蓝和黑色水墨绘制，周围环绕着奶油色纸张。两张海报的中间区域均覆盖有一个居中的垂直长方形模糊遮挡块，边缘柔和，呈灰米色。底部是一个带有细白边框的圆角黑色说明面板。其左上角附有一个亮黄色胶囊状标签，内含加粗黑色中文文字“提示词”。底部面板内是一段多行的加粗白色中文文字。文字内容应为：“西游记主题收藏版史诗海报，人物侧脸剪影中生长出完整世界观与经典场景。整体偏电影海报和梦幻水彩插画风，安静、宏大、神圣、怀旧，带纸张颗粒、轻雾感、飞白刷痕与高级留白。” 整体风格为精致的中文科技对比缩略图，高对比度，编辑排版，居中构图，4:5 竖屏比例。
