templates.title: AI Hanfu Poster Comparison

titleLocalized.zh: AI 汉服海报对比

templates.prompt: A dark, tech-inspired contrast poster features a black background with subtle gray squares, displaying two vertically aligned infographics side-by-side for AI image generation comparison. Two striking yellow bold headings are placed at the top: "GPT image 2" above the left panel and "Nano Banana" above the right. The left panel is an elegant reference poster for traditional Hanfu (traditional Han clothing), with a warm, aged paper background. It features a prominent Chinese calligraphy title at the top, "Hanfu: Deconstruction Illustrated Guide," with a smaller subtitle below. The center image is a full-body woman in elegant traditional Hanfu, her face blurred. This is surrounded by numerous small, labeled infographics, fabric samples, embroidery close-ups, accessory descriptions, outline studies, and meticulously crafted Chinese annotations in an academic museum poster style. The use of beige, cream, light gray-blue, and faded ink tones gives the panel a refined archival aesthetic. The right panel is a simpler, more modern infographic poster with a light beige paper background and a prominent Chinese title at the top, "Traditional Chinese Hanfu: A Deconstruction Illustrated Guide to Ming Dynasty Clothing." The central image showcases a bright red Ming Dynasty robe, presented as a technical exploded view with multiple labeled arrows and component descriptions. Surrounding it are material samples, decorative pattern examples, a row of six circular color swatches, structural details, and a bottom strip displaying four small human anatomy diagrams illustrating the wearing order or silhouette comparison. The right-hand poster has a more flat design feel, stronger contrast, and more vibrant red accents. At the bottom of the overall image, a large, rounded black text box with a thin white border spans most of the width. A yellow, rounded label in the upper left corner contains the bold Chinese word "hint." Within the black box, a dense section of white Chinese text describes the test hints used to generate the Hanfu-themed deconstruction diagram, similar to a screenshot quote block. The overall composition should present a social media comparison image: centered, clean, high-resolution, with a dark background creating a strong contrast between the two poster panels.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张深色科技感对比海报，背景为黑色并带有细微的灰色方格，左右并排展示两张垂直方向的信息图，用于 AI 图像生成对比。在顶部放置两个醒目的黄色粗体标题：左侧面板上方为“GPT image 2”，右侧面板上方为“Nano Banana”。左侧面板是一张优雅的古风汉服参考海报，背景为温暖的旧纸质感，顶部有醒目的中式书法标题“汉服·解构图鉴”，下方配有较小的副标题，中心是一位身着淡雅传统汉服的全身女性，面部经过模糊处理。周围环绕着许多带有标签的小型图示块、布料样本、刺绣特写、配饰说明、轮廓研究以及学术博物馆海报风格的精细中文注释。使用米色、奶油色、浅灰蓝色和褪色的水墨色调，使面板呈现出精致的档案美学。右侧面板是一张更简洁的现代信息图海报，背景为浅米色纸张，顶部有醒目的中文标题“中国传统汉服：大明朝服解构图谱”。中心展示了一件鲜红色的明制长袍，以技术性爆炸图的形式呈现，配有多个标注箭头和部件说明。周围包含材质样本、装饰图案示例、一行 6 个圆形色卡、结构细节，底部条带展示了 4 个小型人体图示，说明穿着顺序或轮廓对比。右侧海报更具平面设计感，对比度更强，红色点缀更鲜艳。在整体图像底部，添加一个宽大的圆角黑色文本框，带有细白边，横跨大部分宽度。在左上角贴一个黄色圆角标签，内含加粗黑体中文“提示词”。在黑色框内，放置一段密集的白色中文文本，描述用于生成汉服主题解构图的测试提示词，类似于截图引用块。整体构图应呈现为社交媒体对比图，居中对齐，清晰整洁，高分辨率，深色背景与两个海报面板之间形成强烈对比。

templates.title: Luxury travel posters in Germany

titleLocalized.zh: 德国奢华旅行海报

templates.prompt: Create a retro style{argument name="country name" default="Germany"} This luxury travel poster boasts a design reminiscent of high-end travel advertisements. It employs a grand, symmetrical composition, paired with elegant typography and a gold border featuring delicate corner details. At the top center is a small gold coat of arms, below which is the word "DISCOVER," followed by a striking dark navy blue serif title.{argument name="headline country" default="GERMANY"} Below this, add the gold-letter slogan "LAND OF HISTORY. CULTURE. INSPIRATION.", followed by a smaller, classic serif subtitle "Timeless Traditions. Unforgettable Journeys.", accented with small horizontal decorative lines in black, red, and gold. Present a magnificent panoramic montage of iconic German scenery against a backdrop of a sparsely clouded, softly glowing blue sky at the golden hour. On the left, a fairytale-like white hilltop castle, reminiscent of Neuschwanstein, sits atop autumnal trees. The majestic Alps are placed in the center of the background. On the right, a historic European riverside city is showcased, with its dense red-roofed houses, arched stone bridges spanning the water, a domed cathedral, and a Gothic cathedral with twin spires. Add reflections on the calm river surface, and a white sightseeing boat in the lower right corner. The image should be imbued with a nostalgic, romantic, and alluring atmosphere, featuring warm sunlight, clear architectural details, and rich, cinematic color gradation. At the bottom center, five gold-lined cultural icons are arranged horizontally, each labeled: “ICONIC LANDMARKS,” “RICH HERITAGE,” “VIBRANT CULTURE,” “AUTHENTIC TRADITIONS,” and “BREATHTAKING LANDSCAPES.” Below this is a dark-colored horizontal food display bar, centered with the gold title “SAVOR THE TASTE OF GERMANY.” Within this bar are five bordered food panels, each with a white capital text below it: “BREZEL,” “BRATWURST,” “KARTOFFELSALAT,” “SCHWARZWÄLDER KIRSCHTORTE,” and “GERMAN BEER.” Each food item is presented in an enticing close-up: glistening pretzel bread on a plate, sausages with sauerkraut, creamy potato salad, slices of Black Forest cake garnished with cream and cherries, and a frothy beer mug. The overall design should maintain a sophisticated, upscale, poster-like feel, suitable for promotional campaigns in luxury destinations.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张复古风格的 {argument name="country name" default="德国"} 奢华旅行海报，设计感如同高端旅游宣传广告。采用宏大、对称的构图，搭配优雅的编辑排版，以及带有精致角落装饰细节的金色边框。在顶部中心，放置一枚小型金色国徽，下方为“DISCOVER”字样，随后是一个非常醒目的深海军蓝衬线标题 {argument name="headline country" default="GERMANY"}。在其下方，添加金色大写标语“LAND OF HISTORY. CULTURE. INSPIRATION.”，随后是一行较小的经典衬线副标题“Timeless Traditions. Unforgettable Journeys.”，并配以黑、红、金三色的小型水平装饰线。

展示一幅壮丽的德国标志性风景全景蒙太奇，背景是黄金时刻下云朵稀疏、柔和发光的蓝天。左侧呈现一座如同新天鹅堡般的童话白色山顶城堡，坐落在秋色树木之上。远景中心放置雄伟的阿尔卑斯山脉。右侧展示一座历史悠久的欧洲河畔城市，密集的红顶房屋、横跨水面的拱形石桥、圆顶大教堂以及带有双尖塔的哥特式大教堂。添加平静的河面反射，右下角有一艘白色观光船。画面应充满怀旧、浪漫和令人向往的氛围，具备温暖的阳光、清晰的建筑细节和丰富的电影级色彩分级。

在下方中部，均匀水平排列 5 个金色线条艺术风格的文化图标，下方附带标签：“ICONIC LANDMARKS”（标志性地标）、“RICH HERITAGE”（深厚底蕴）、“VIBRANT CULTURE”（活力文化）、“AUTHENTIC TRADITIONS”（地道传统）和“BREATHTAKING LANDSCAPES”（绝美风景）。

底部创建一个深色水平美食展示条，居中标题为金色的“SAVOR THE TASTE OF GERMANY”。在展示条内，包含 5 个带边框的美食面板，每张图片下方均标注白色大写文字：“BREZEL”（德国碱水面包）、“BRATWURST”（德国烤肠）、“KARTOFFELSALAT”（德国土豆沙拉）、“SCHWARZWÄLDER KIRSCHTORTE”（黑森林蛋糕）和“GERMAN BEER”（德国啤酒）。每种食物均以诱人的特写形式呈现：盘中光泽诱人的碱水面包、配有酸菜的烤肠、奶油土豆沙拉、点缀着奶油和樱桃的黑森林蛋糕切片，以及泡沫丰富的啤酒杯。整体设计需保持精致、高端、海报感，适合用于奢华目的地宣传活动。

templates.title: AI VR Poster Comparison

titleLocalized.zh: AI VR 海报对比

templates.prompt:
{
  "type": "comparison poster",

templates.title: Romantic Paris travel poster

titleLocalized.zh: 浪漫巴黎旅行海报

templates.prompt: A luxurious retro travel poster-style illustration, with{argument name="country name" default="France"} For the country,{argument name="city name" default="Paris"} Designed as an elegant travel advertisement for the destination, it showcases a magnificent and romantic Parisian cityscape against a backdrop of a golden sunset, with the sky displaying a dreamy gradient of peach, pink, pale purple, and soft gold. The Eiffel Tower, a towering and richly detailed landmark, stands majestically above the city, serving as the central landmark. Four additional iconic Parisian landmarks are included: the Louvre Pyramid on the left, the Arc de Triomphe near the center of the background, Notre Dame Cathedral to the right of the Eiffel Tower, and the Sacré-Cœur Basilica on a hillside in the upper right corner. The foreground is filled with lush, blooming flowers.{argument name="flower field" default="Lavender fields"} The vibrant purple hue creates a dreamlike, painterly foreground leading to the city. Below the Eiffel Tower, a river and elegant stone bridge are depicted, reflecting the warm glow of the setting sun. The composition should be idealized, cinematic, and slightly fantastical, blending multiple landmarks into a harmonious panorama. A sophisticated typography layered in the upper left to upper center area includes a very large serif title with the following content:{argument name="headline text" default="France"} Below this is a subtitle with small spacing and serifs, the content of which is:{argument name="subheadline text" default="Paris"} Above the subheading, place a gold iris decoration; below, add a small horizontal French tricolor flag accent. Below the main headline, include two lines of promotional copy that must be identical: “TIMELESS BEAUTY. ENDLESS INSPIRATION.” and “Where Every Moment Becomes a Memory,” in elegant lowercase capitals and italics. Add a thin gold decorative border around the entire poster, with delicate corner details. At the bottom, create a soft, creamy matte panel that blends with the image, centering the phrase “THE FRENCH ART OF LIVING” above, and below that, three dining elements: a butter croissant on a plate, a glass of red wine with a bottle of red wine, and a crème brûlée topped with berries. Label them “CROISSANT,” “FINE WINE,” and “CRÈME BRÛLÉE,” respectively. Add four small gold icons on the right, labeled below: “ICONIC LANDMARKS”, “RICH HERITAGE”, “AUTHENTIC CUISINE”, and “UNFORGETTABLE EXPERIENCES”. Overall style: ultra-refined and exquisite travel posters, romantic European travel advertisements, painterly realism, a warm and bright atmosphere, high-end print design, balanced composition, and high-end magazine aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张奢华的复古旅行海报风格插画，以 {argument name="country name" default="法国"} 为国家，{argument name="city name" default="巴黎"} 为目的地，设计如同一则优雅的旅游广告。展现宏伟、浪漫的巴黎城市景观，背景为黄金时刻的日落，天空呈现桃色、粉色、淡紫色和柔和金色的梦幻渐变。以埃菲尔铁塔为中心地标，高耸且细节丰富，矗立在城市上方。包含 4 个额外的巴黎标志性地标：左侧的卢浮宫金字塔、背景中央附近的凯旋门、埃菲尔铁塔右侧的巴黎圣母院，以及远方右上角山坡上的圣心大教堂。前景处填满繁茂盛开的 {argument name="flower field" default="薰衣草花田"}，呈现鲜艳的紫色，营造出通往城市的梦幻绘画感前景。埃菲尔铁塔下方绘有河流和优雅的石桥，倒映着温暖的夕阳余晖。构图应具有理想化、电影感和些许奇幻色彩，将多个地标融合成一幅和谐的全景图。

在左上至中上方区域叠加精致的编辑排版：一个非常大的衬线字体标题，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="法国"}，下方配以较小的间距衬线副标题，内容为 {argument name="subheadline text" default="巴黎"}。在副标题上方放置一个金色鸢尾花装饰；下方添加一个微小的水平法国三色旗点缀。在主标题下方，包含两行促销文案，内容必须完全一致：“TIMELESS BEAUTY. ENDLESS INSPIRATION.” 以及 “Where Every Moment Becomes a Memory”，采用优雅的小写大写字母和斜体字。在整张海报周围添加一圈纤细的金色装饰边框，并配以精致的边角装饰细节。

在底部，创建一个与图像融合的柔和奶油色雾面面板，面板上方居中显示短语 “THE FRENCH ART OF LIVING”，下方排列 3 种餐饮元素：1 个盘子里的黄油可颂、1 杯红酒配 1 瓶红酒，以及 1 个顶部点缀浆果的焦糖布丁。分别标注为 “CROISSANT”、“FINE WINE” 和 “CRÈME BRÛLÉE”。在右侧添加 4 个金色小图标，下方分别标注：“ICONIC LANDMARKS”、“RICH HERITAGE”、“AUTHENTIC CUISINE” 和 “UNFORGETTABLE EXPERIENCES”。整体风格：超精细、精致的旅行海报，浪漫的欧洲旅游广告，绘画写实主义，温暖明亮的氛围，高端印刷设计，构图平衡，高端杂志美学。

templates.prompt: Create an elegant Nordic luxury travel poster with the theme of{argument name="region name" default="NORTHERN EUROPE"} The design style is inspired by high-end travel brochure covers. It employs a wide, symmetrical layout with a delicate gold decorative border and sophisticated typography. A small compass star icon is placed at the top center, below which is the word "DISCOVER," followed by a prominent serif title with the following content:{argument name="headline text" default="NORTHERN EUROPE"} The color is dark navy blue. Below it, add a line of gold capital letters:{argument name="tagline" default="BREATHTAKING NATURE. RICH CULTURE. TIMELESS EXPERIENCES."} Below that is a smaller, elegant italic subheading:{argument name="subheading" default="Four Countries. Countless Memories."} The main image area is divided into four vertical landscape sections, showcasing iconic destinations during the golden hour, presented with soft sunset light and cinematic realism. Section 1: Copenhagen, Denmark, a colorful harbor with historical buildings, ships, calm reflections on the water, and domed landmarks in the background; add a small Danish flag above the labels DENMARK and COPENHAGEN. Section 2: Stockholm, Sweden, the skyline of the waterfront old town, with church spires reflected in the water under the warm sunset light; add a small Swedish flag above the labels SWEDEN and STOCKHOLM. Section 3: Helsinki, Finland, a small stone castle-like island fortress against a backdrop of blue sky and water; add a small Finnish flag above the labels FINLAND and HELSINKI. Section 4: Norway, magnificent fjords, steep and rugged mountains, waterfalls, and small red-roofed coastal villages by the water; add a small Norwegian flag above the labels NORWAY and FJORDS OF NORWAY. Below the four country sections, add a row of four evenly distributed gold line icons with descriptions: mountain icon with ICONIC LANDSCAPES, Viking ship icon with RICH HERITAGE, moose icon with WILD NATURE, and camera icon with UNFORGETTABLE JOURNEYS. Near the bottom center, place a gold separator and the title A TASTE OF THE NORTH. Below this, arrange five horizontally arranged food thumbnail sections, each displayed on a plate or bowl, with warm, inviting lighting and a deep blue border: 1) Smørrebrød — Denmark, an open sandwich topped with shrimp; 2) Köttbullar — Sweden, Swedish meatballs with cream sauce and blueberries; 3) Gravad lax — Finland, marinated salmon slices in a bowl; 4) Fish soup — Norway, creamy fish soup with herbs and seafood; 5) Kanelbulle — Sweden, glistening cinnamon rolls on a plate. The overall design employs sophisticated high-end tourism advertising aesthetics, featuring photorealistic landscapes, soft sunset color gradations, navy blue and gold graphic design, balanced composition, and clear typography, creating a nostalgic yet upscale European tourism atmosphere.

Countless Memories."}。主体图像区域被平均分为 4 个垂直风景板块，展示黄金时段的标志性目的地，呈现柔和的霞光和电影级的写实感。板块 1：丹麦哥本哈根，色彩斑斓的海港码头，背景为历史建筑、船只、平静的倒影水面及圆顶地标；在标签 DENMARK 和 COPENHAGEN 上方添加一面小丹麦国旗。板块 2：瑞典斯德哥尔摩，水滨老城天际线，教堂尖顶在温暖的日落光线下映照在水中；在标签 SWEDEN 和 STOCKHOLM 上方添加一面小瑞典国旗。板块 3：芬兰赫尔辛基，蓝天碧水下的一座小型石砌城堡式岛屿要塞；在标签 FINLAND 和 HELSINKI 上方添加一面小芬兰国旗。板块 4：挪威，壮丽的峡湾，陡峭崎岖的山脉，瀑布，以及水边的小型红顶沿海村庄；在标签 NORWAY 和 FJORDS OF NORWAY 上方添加一面小挪威国旗。在 4 个国家板块下方，添加一行 4 个均匀分布的金色线条图标及说明：山脉图标配 ICONIC LANDSCAPES，维京船图标配 RICH HERITAGE，驼鹿图标配 WILD NATURE，相机图标配 UNFORGETTABLE JOURNEYS。在底部中心附近，放置一个金色分隔符和标题 A TASTE OF THE NORTH。在其下方，横向排列 5 个美食缩略图板块，每个板块展示在盘子或碗中，配以温暖诱人的灯光和深蓝色边框：1) Smørrebrød — 丹麦，铺满虾仁的开放式三明治；2) Köttbullar — 瑞典，配奶油酱和越橘的瑞典肉丸；3) Gravad lax — 芬兰，碗中的腌制三文鱼片；4) Fish soup — 挪威，配香草和海鲜的奶油鱼汤；5) Kanelbulle — 瑞典，盘中光泽诱人的肉桂卷。整体采用精致的高端旅游广告美学，照片级写实风景，柔和的日落色彩分级，海军蓝与金色的平面设计，平衡的构图，清晰的文字排版，营造出怀旧而高端的欧洲旅游氛围。

promptLocalized.zh: 一张奢华的复古风格旅行海报，主题为 {argument name="country name" default="奥地利"}，设计感如同高端旅游广告。采用优雅、对称的海报布局，配有纤细的金色装饰边框和精致的角落装饰细节。顶部中央放置一个极简金色山峰标志，下方为“DISCOVER”字样；紧接着是一个非常醒目且精致的衬线体标题，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="AUSTRIA"}，颜色为深勃艮第红。在其下方，添加一行小号大写金色标语：“TIMELESS BEAUTY. RICH HERITAGE. UNFORGETTABLE EXPERIENCES.”，再下方是一行斜体手写字：“Where Tradition Meets Breathtaking Nature.”。在这些文字之间放置一个小的水平奥地利国旗图案。主体画面应为令人惊叹的黄金时刻高山湖泊合成场景：左侧是坐落在水面岩石悬崖上、酷似萨尔茨堡要塞的壮观山顶堡垒；远景中央是一个平静且具有倒影的湖泊，延伸至高耸的阿尔卑斯雪山山谷；右侧是一个风景如画的奥地利湖畔村庄，酷似哈尔施塔特，拥有陡峭屋顶的房屋、高耸的教堂尖塔、山坡上的教堂以及层叠而下延伸至水边的木质建筑。左侧射入温暖阳光，天空湛蓝清澈，山峰上闪烁着光芒，湖面映照出丰富的倒影，营造出浪漫的电影质感，细节极其丰富，宏伟且引人入胜。在画面中下部，均匀排列 5 个金色图标及标签的旅游亮点：1 个城堡图标配“ICONIC LANDMARKS”（标志性地标），1 个古典柱式图标配“RICH HERITAGE”（深厚底蕴），1 个音符图标配“VIBRANT CULTURE”（活力文化），1 个心形图标配“WARM HOSPITALITY”（热情好客），以及 1 个山峰图标配“BREATHTAKING LANDSCAPES”（壮丽景观）。在底部，创建一个水平美食条，在居中的标题“SAVOR THE TASTE OF AUSTRIA”（品味奥地利）下方，展示 5 张由细分隔线隔开的框式烹饪照片。这 5 道菜品分别为：维也纳炸牛排（Wiener Schnitzel）、苹果卷（Appelstrudel）、皇帝煎饼（Kaiserschmarrn）、萨赫蛋糕（Sachertorte）和米隆咖啡（Melange）。每张美食图片都应真实、光线温暖、摆盘精美，并在图片下方标注大写衬线体文字。整体风格：高端欧洲旅行宣传海报，精致的编辑设计，浪漫怀旧感，考究的排版，和谐的金色与勃艮第红点缀，将照片级写实风景与奢华宣传册美学完美融合。

templates.title: Q-version Iron Mountain Lean Impact Attack

titleLocalized.zh: Q 版铁山靠冲击攻击

templates.prompt: A comedic, cartoonish illustration depicts a petite yet fierce girl delivering a powerful Chinese martial arts shoulder strike—the "Iron Mountain Strike"—to a frightened boy's side. The girl is the focal point of the image.{argument name="character name" default="Red-haired martial arts girl"} Long and bright{argument name="hair color" default="Crimson"} Her hair billowed wildly backward, her eyes were sharp red, and her expression was one of resolute anger. She was charging from right to left at incredible speed, her body low and compact, one shoulder and upper back slamming into the boy's torso. One fist was pulled back, the other arm was tucked in for balance, one knee was bent forward, and the other leg was dragging backward. She wore a short red Chinese cheongsam with gold floral embroidery, gold trim, a side slit, and black flat shoes. The boy was a black-haired, chibi-style boy wearing a dark blue Chinese kung fu outfit with gold trim and black shoes. He was thrown backward by the impact, his mouth agape in shock, his eyes rolled back and glistening with sweat, his body flying backward to the left. The moment of impact was emphasized, with a bright, explosive impact effect, flying debris, sparks, and a strong line of speed distorting across the entire background. Dust clouds and ground scratches were added near the girl's dragging feet to show the explosive forward momentum. The composition used a comic book style, employing exaggerated movements, perspective shortening, and a diagonal charge from the lower right to the upper left. The image integrates three large Japanese onomatopoeic text elements: a vertical label on the right reading "鉄山靠!!", a smaller vertical annotation next to it reading "てつざんこう", and a large impact onomatopoeic word in the lower left reading "ドガッ!!". The overall atmosphere is fast-paced, comical, aggressive, and impactful, employing sophisticated modern anime rendering with glossy hair highlights, crisp line art, and dramatic red, white, and black contrasts.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅充满喜剧 Q 版风格的动态动漫动作插画，展示了一个娇小但凶猛的女孩对一个受惊男孩的侧面施展强力的中国武术肩部撞击——铁山靠。女孩是画面焦点：{argument name="character name" default="红发武术少女"}，长长的鲜艳 {argument name="hair color" default="绯红色"} 头发向后剧烈飘动，有着锐利的红眼和坚定愤怒的表情。她正以极快的速度从右向左冲刺，身体低伏紧凑，一侧肩膀和上背部撞向男孩的躯干，一只拳头后拉，另一只手臂收拢以保持平衡，一只膝盖向前弯曲，另一条腿向后拖曳。她穿着一件短款红色中式旗袍，带有金色花卉刺绣、金色滚边、侧开叉和黑色平底鞋。男孩是一个黑发 Q 版少年，穿着深蓝色中式功夫装，配有金色滚边和黑色鞋子，因冲击而向后退缩，张着嘴露出震惊的表情，双眼翻白，带有汗滴，身体向左后方飞出。强调碰撞的瞬间，在他身侧产生明亮的爆炸冲击效果、飞溅的碎片、火花以及横跨整个背景的强烈速度线扭曲。在女孩拖曳的脚部附近添加尘云和地面划痕，以展现爆炸性的前进动能。采用漫画风格的构图，运用夸张的动作、透视缩短以及从右下到左上的对角线冲刺。画面中集成了 3 个大型日语拟声词文字元素：右侧一个垂直的标注文字“鉄山靠!!”，旁边一个较小的垂直注释“てつざんこう”，以及左下方一个巨大的撞击拟声词“ドガッ!!”。整体氛围快速、滑稽、具有攻击性和强烈的冲击感，采用精致的现代动漫渲染，具有光泽的头发高光、清晰的线条艺术以及戏剧性的红、白、黑对比。

templates.title: Neon heart-shaped macaron-colored idol portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹心形装饰的马卡龙色系偶像肖像

templates.prompt: A cute, Japanese idol-style half-body portrait of a girl against a super kawaii macaron-colored bedroom background, centered in the image. Her face is partially obscured by a large, solid rectangular matte gray-brown mask. She has medium-length, dark brown wavy pigtails adorned with two oversized transparent pink bows, pearl strands, ribbons, and two dangling star ornaments. She wears a gorgeous, dreamy kawaii (yume-kawaii) idol dress, with a main color scheme of {argument name="main colors" default="Pink and lavender"} Featuring glossy satin, lace trim, ruffled off-the-shoulder sleeves, sheer ruffles, beading, and delicate gemstone details, the piece is adorned with a large jeweled heart-shaped brooch at the chest. Underneath, a lace halter neckline is worn, adorned with a sparkling choker featuring tiny macaron-colored embellishments, a ribbon bow tied beside a strand of hair which she gently holds in one hand, and a matching ruffled wristband. The background is a dreamy and elaborately decorated kawaii room, filled with soft fairy lights, macaron-colored curtains, ribbons, bows, plush textures, and luminous decorations. On the left, a pink neon heart logo with a bow outline is added, containing Japanese text.{argument name="neon sign text" default="Dreams are meant to be fulfilled."} The photos utilize soft-focus lenses, flash highlights, pearlescent textures, warm pinkish-purple ambient lighting, bokeh, and vertical social media photo compositions. The overall atmosphere is sweet, dreamy, idol-centric, feminine, and richly detailed, resembling a macaron-colored fashion editorial shot in a beautifully decorated kawaii studio.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张可爱的日系偶像风格女孩半身特写肖像，背景为超卡哇伊的马卡龙色卧室，构图居中。她的脸部被一个哑光灰褐色的大型实心矩形遮挡块遮住。她留着深棕色中长波浪双马尾，装饰着 2 个超大透明粉色蝴蝶结、珍珠串、丝带飘带和 2 个垂坠的星星挂饰。她身穿华丽的梦幻卡哇伊（yume-kawaii）偶像礼服，主色调为 {argument name="main colors" default="粉色和薰衣草色"}，采用光泽缎面、蕾丝花边、荷叶边露肩袖、透明褶边、串珠工艺、细小宝石细节，胸前饰有一个巨大的珠宝心形胸针。内搭蕾丝吊带领口，佩戴带有细小马卡龙色挂饰的闪亮项圈，其中一缕卷发旁系着丝带蝴蝶结，她用一只手轻轻托住，并配有相称的荷叶边腕带。背景是一个梦幻且装饰繁复的卡哇伊房间，充满柔和的仙女灯、马卡龙色窗帘、丝带、蝴蝶结、毛绒质感和发光装饰。在左侧，添加一个带有蝴蝶结轮廓的粉色霓虹心形标志，其中包含日文文本 {argument name="neon sign text" default="夢は叶えるもの"}。使用柔焦镜头、闪光高光、珠光质感、暖粉紫色环境光、焦外成像光斑，以及垂直社交媒体照片构图。整体氛围甜美、梦幻、偶像核心、女性化且细节丰富，宛如在装饰精美的卡哇伊摄影棚中拍摄的马卡龙色时尚大片。

templates.title: Gothic-style idol concert selfie

titleLocalized.zh: 哥特风偶像演唱会自拍

templates.prompt: A dramatic, self-portrait-style close-up of a stage scene shows a Japanese idol performer leaning towards the camera from a low angle, her upper body and outstretched arms dominating the frame. She has long, straight to slightly wavy hair, and her hair color is {argument name="hair color" default="dark reddish brown"} Her hair was glossy, and thick, side-swept bangs covered one eye. Her expression was cute and intimate; she placed one hand near her mouth, striking a shy idol pose, as if interacting directly with fans at a concert. She wore a black and dark {argument name="accent color" default="Purple"} The gothic idol stage costume features five clearly visible elements: a shiny, corset-style cropped top with metallic trim, a black belt with silver metal eyelets at the waist, black sheer mesh opera gloves, multiple straps on the upper arms, and a dangling silver chain across the chest and hem. The addition of glossy patent leather, studs, buckles, lace, and layered ruffles creates a highly detailed J-pop or anime concert look. The backdrop is a large indoor live stage with bright blue-white spotlights, smoke, truss installations, and LED screens flashing soft, abstract shapes, creating a strong backlighting and bokeh effect. The cinematic concert photography style employs high contrast, cool lighting with purple-blue highlights, shallow depth of field, slight lens distortion from a close-up arm perspective, dynamic foreground perspective, and vertical hand-held composition. This results in a vibrant, charismatic, and fan-service-oriented visual, much like…{argument name="idol group concept" default="A dark fantasy-style idol live performance"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的自拍视角舞台特写照片，一位日本偶像表演者从低角度向镜头倾身，上半身和伸出的手臂占据了画面的大部分。她留着长长的直发至微卷发，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="深红褐色"}，带有光泽感，厚重的斜刘海遮住了一只眼睛。她的表情可爱且亲密，一只手放在嘴边，摆出害羞的偶像姿势，仿佛正在演唱会现场与粉丝直接互动。她穿着一套黑色与深 {argument name="accent color" default="紫色"} 的哥特风偶像演出服，包含 5 个清晰可见的服装元素：带有金属饰边的亮面紧身胸衣式短上衣、腰间带有银色金属扣眼的黑色腰带、黑色透明网纱歌剧手套、上臂的多条绑带，以及横跨胸前和裙摆的垂坠银链。添加亮面漆皮质感、铆钉、搭扣、蕾丝和层叠的荷叶边面料，打造高细节的 J-pop 或动画歌曲演唱会造型。背景是大型室内现场舞台，配有明亮的蓝白色聚光灯、烟雾、桁架装置以及闪烁着柔和抽象形状的 LED 屏幕，营造出强烈的逆光和虚化效果。采用电影级演唱会摄影风格，高对比度，冷色调灯光配以紫蓝色高光，浅景深，近距离手臂视角带来的轻微镜头畸变，动态的前缩透视，以及竖屏手机构图。让画面充满活力、魅力十足且具有粉丝向服务感，如同 {argument name="idol group concept" default="一场暗黑奇幻风格的偶像现场演出"}。

templates.title: Close-up of the Red Idol Concert

titleLocalized.zh: 红色偶像演唱会特写

templates.prompt: A dynamic close-up photo of a concert, with the main subject being the performers on stage.{argument name="idol performer" default="Young J-pop female idol"} Shot from the audience's perspective, the scene features a shallow depth of field. She leans towards the camera, one hand reaching towards the foreground, creating a strong perspective compression effect; the other hand holds a black handheld microphone with a red decorative ring close to her mouth. She wears a richly detailed red and white ruffled idol costume: dark brown twin ponytails with bangs, two fluffy red pom-pom hair accessories tied with ribbon bows, red pendant earrings, a red choker with lace and heart-shaped gemstones, a lace-trimmed crop top with a large satin bow at the chest, off-the-shoulder ruffled sleeves, a cinched waist with red ribbon ties and small metal embellishments, a layered satin skirt decorated with sparkling beaded chains, and a heart-shaped gemstone ornament at the waist. Her nails are glossy red with cute white decorative nail art. The lighting is vibrant pink and deep red stage lighting, creating a glamorous live idol atmosphere. The background is filled with soft blurring effects, LED screens, stage setups, and countless glowing and floating heart-shaped confetti, creating a dreamy and romantic concert scene. Employing a photorealistic style, it showcases clear fabric textures, shimmering satin highlights, lace details, concert atmosphere, subtle dynamic energy, and the overall {argument name="color theme" default="Red and pink"} Color scheme. It blends a subtle sense of excitement with a fan-oriented stage presence, like {argument name="theme" default="Cute and romantic idol concert"} Photos of the promotional performance.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满动感的演唱会特写照片，主角为舞台上的 {argument name="idol performer" default="年轻的 J-pop 女偶像"}，以观众视角拍摄，具有浅景深效果。她向镜头倾斜，一只手伸向前景，形成强烈的透视缩短效果；另一只手拿着一支带有红色装饰环的黑色手持麦克风靠近嘴边。她身穿细节丰富的红白相间荷叶边偶像演出服：深棕色双马尾发型搭配齐刘海，两个蓬松的红色毛绒球发饰系着丝带蝴蝶结，佩戴红色吊坠耳环，颈部系着带有蕾丝和心形宝石的红色颈圈，身穿带有蕾丝边的露脐上衣，胸前有一个巨大的缎面蝴蝶结，露肩荷叶边袖子，束腰风格的中段设计带有红色丝带系带和小金属挂饰，层叠的缎面短裙上装饰着闪亮的珠链，腰间配有一枚心形宝石装饰。她的美甲是亮面红色，并配有可爱的白色装饰美甲艺术。灯光为生动的粉色和深红色舞台灯光，营造出华丽的现场偶像氛围。背景中充满了柔和的虚化效果、LED 屏幕、舞台装置以及无数发光的心形和漂浮的心形纸屑，营造出梦幻浪漫的演唱会场景。采用照片级逼真的风格，展现清晰的布料质感、闪亮的缎面高光、蕾丝细节、演唱会氛围、轻微的动态能量，以及整体的 {argument name="color theme" default="红色和粉色"} 色调。融入微妙的兴奋感和粉丝向的舞台魅力，如同 {argument name="theme" default="可爱浪漫偶像演唱会"} 的宣传现场表演照。

titleLocalized.zh: 病娇可爱风偶像自拍

templates.prompt: One{argument name="idol theme" default="Dark, yandere, cute idol"} A vertical close-up self-portrait of a girl, set in a narrow, neon-pink room. The camera angle shows her arm outstretched towards the camera, with a shimmering sleeve and a blurred hand visible in the foreground. She wears a richly detailed black and pink plaid stage costume, adorned with glossy vinyl straps, lace trim, ribbons, buckles, and layered accessories: a sleeveless corset, black mesh split sleeves, multiple black armbands on one upper arm, a pink bow, and a heart-shaped badge on her chest inscribed with "病みかわいい" (I feel sick). Her long, dark brown hair is styled in a high bun, with long, straight strands framing her face and decorated with large bows. Her visible hand is close to her lips, striking a shy idol pose, wearing pink lace fingerless gloves with ruffles, long manicures, and chunky rings. A pink armband with handwritten Japanese characters is added to her upper arm, along with delicate earrings. Her face is obscured by a large rectangular mosaic in the center, covering most of her forehead and chin. The background is cluttered and decadent, filled with black and pink graffiti, plastic curtains, plush toys, and distressed decorations. The scene must contain four clearly visible Japanese texts: graffiti on the left reading "闇ー?", below it "嫌いにならないで", and further below that "私だけ見ててね". A glowing heart-shaped neon sign in the upper right corner reads "病みしか勝たん". Two plush toys are placed in the background: a light pink plush animal on the left and a black plush toy with X-shaped eyes on the right. The lighting is a melancholic nightclub-style magenta and violet with glossy highlights, creating a chaotic underground idol dressing room atmosphere. High detail, luxurious texture, glitter, lace, vinyl materials, a messy yet cute gothic atmosphere, high contrast, smartphone selfie composition, and a vertical screen ratio.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张 {argument name="idol theme" default="暗黑病娇可爱风偶像"} 女孩的竖版特写自拍肖像，背景位于狭窄的霓虹粉色房间内。镜头视角为手臂向相机伸出，前景中可见一只闪亮的袖子和手部虚化效果。她身穿细节丰富的黑粉格纹舞台装，配有光面乙烯基绑带、蕾丝边、丝带、搭扣及层叠配饰：无袖紧身胸衣、黑色网眼分体袖、单侧上臂佩戴多个黑色臂环、粉色蝴蝶结，以及胸前一枚写有“病みかわいい”的心形徽章。深棕色长发扎成高丸子头，两侧留有长直发修饰脸型，并装饰着大蝴蝶结。她可见的手部靠近嘴唇，摆出羞涩的偶像姿势，戴着荷叶边粉色蕾丝露指手套，留着长长的美甲并佩戴粗款戒指。上臂增加一个带有手写日文的粉色臂环，并佩戴精致的耳环。面部被一个位于中心的大型矩形马赛克遮挡，遮住了从额头到下巴的大部分区域。背景杂乱且带有颓废感，布满了黑粉色涂鸦、塑料帘、毛绒玩具和做旧装饰。场景中需包含 4 处清晰可见的日文文本：左侧涂鸦写着“闇ー?”，下方涂鸦写着“嫌いにならないで”，更下方涂鸦写着“私だけ見ててね”，右上角有一个发光的心形霓虹灯牌，写着“病みしか勝たん”。背景中放置 2 个毛绒玩偶：左侧为一个浅粉色毛绒动物，右侧为一个眼睛呈 X 型的黑色毛绒玩偶。灯光为充满忧郁感的夜店风洋红色与紫罗兰色，带有光泽高光，营造出混乱的地下偶像更衣室氛围。超高细节，华丽质感，闪粉、蕾丝、乙烯基材质，凌乱的可爱哥特风氛围，高对比度，智能手机自拍构图，竖屏比例。

templates.prompt: The cover of a luxury fashion magazine features a vertical portrait of a composed and capable young professional woman, seated in a black leather office chair in a modern high-rise office. She has {argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown"} Her hair was styled into a neat high ponytail with soft side-swept bangs; she wore {argument name="top color" default="Deep red"} She wore a fitted ribbed short-sleeved knit top paired with a gray-brown high-waisted pleated midi skirt, and a delicate silver necklace with a small, key-shaped, layered pendant. She sat with her legs crossed, a slim tablet resting on her lap, her expression calm, composed, and exuding a restrained strength. The background was a sophisticated executive office, with wooden paneling on the right and floor-to-ceiling windows behind her. Behind the glass on the left, a blurred meeting scene and two indistinct business figures could be seen. In the lower left corner, an open laptop and stacks of documents sat on the edge of a desk. Soft natural light, a refined editorial style, realistic fashion photography, warm neutral tones, and subtle background blur—all hallmarks of high-end magazine aesthetics. The elegant magazine layout was further enhanced by a large serif masthead at the top, displaying…{argument name="magazine title" default="OFFICIELLE"} It is ivory white; there is a small subtitle in the lower left corner that reads "STYLE. CONFIDENCE. CAREER."; the date is in the upper right corner.{argument name="cover date" default="May 2024"} A total of five cover headlines were added: Top left: "DESK to DESTINY," with a smaller subtitle "Elevating everyday workwear with intent and ease."; Middle left: "POWER IN POISE," with a smaller subtitle "Refined staples and modern silhouettes for the woman who leads."; Middle right: "FOCUS & FLOW," with a smaller subtitle "Thoughtful style that keeps you confident from morning to night."; Bottom left: Large headline "MODERN ELEGANCE," with italicized subtitle "Polished looks. Purposeful days." and smaller text "Timeless style for the new generation of professionals."; Bottom right: A circular badge containing "WORKWEAR EDIT" and smaller text "Burgundy tones, warm neutrals, effortless confidence." templates.title: China's May Day Railway Travel Information Map

titleLocalized.zh: 中国五一铁路旅行信息图

templates.prompt: Create an exquisite Little Red Book-style infographic poster of a Chinese travel destination, employing soft watercolor map aesthetics and a square format to showcase a five-day high-speed rail travel route through China. The top left corner features a striking calligraphy title:{argument name="headline text" default="May Day travel plans"} Below it, add a green ribbon with white Chinese characters as a subtitle:{argument name="route text" default="Guangzhou → Hunan → Wuhan → Beijing"} Below the subtitle, add a line of smaller Chinese text: “Heading North: Discovering the Beauty of China.” The background is a light-colored illustrated map of central and northern China in beige and light sage green, with subtle mountain textures, gentle rivers, and delicate floral decorations in the corners. A vertically curving railway line extends from the bottom center to the top center, connecting four cities, accompanied by orange-red locating pins and striking red Chinese city names. From bottom to top, they are: Guangzhou, Hunan, Wuhan, and Beijing. Small white high-speed rail icons are placed along the tracks, with three green travel time labels: “Guangzhou → Hunan High-speed Rail approx. 2.5 hours,” “Hunan → Wuhan High-speed Rail approx. 1.5 hours,” and “Wuhan → Beijing High-speed Rail approx. 4.5 hours.” Near each city, there is a landscape collage or landmark illustration group: Guangzhou with a modern skyline and the Canton Tower; Hunan with green mountains and cultural landscapes; Wuhan with the Yellow Crane Tower and historical buildings; and Beijing with the Forbidden City/royal palace architecture. Add small scenic labels near the city illustrations, with the text "Guangzhou, the City of Flowers and a Culinary Capital," "Hunan, a Land of Mountains and Rivers and a Hub of Culture," "Wuhan, the City of Rivers and a City of Heroes," and "China's Capital, a Blend of History and Modernity." Below the main title, evenly arrange four minimalist icon badges with brief Chinese labels: a camera icon labeled "Featured Attractions," a train icon labeled "Direct High-Speed ​​Rail," a suitcase icon labeled "Easy Travel," and a star icon labeled "Recommended Restaurants." Around the map, place four rounded rectangular itinerary cards with green titles, cream backgrounds, and photo thumbnails. Each card must include a daily itinerary, a starred section for a recommended attraction, and a starred section for a recommended restaurant. The four cards are: 1) Top right card title "Beijing | 2 days," containing two lines of dates, four attraction thumbnails, and one food photo; 2) Middle right card title "Wuhan | 1.5 days," containing two lines of dates, four attraction thumbnails, and one food photo; 3) Middle left card title "Hunan | 2 days," containing two lines of dates, four attraction thumbnails, and one food photo; 4) Bottom left card title "Guangzhou | 1 day," containing one line of dates, four attraction thumbnails, and one food photo. The itinerary text uses practical Xiaohongshu-style Chinese travel plan text. A rounded-corner notes panel is added in the bottom right corner, containing two sections with green titles: "Itinerary Highlights" and "Travel Tips." Under "Itinerary Highlights," four key points are listed with small icons. Under "Travel Tips," four key points are listed with small icons. Decorate the notes area with a small luggage illustration and Chinese phrases in green handwritten italics, such as “Let’s go! Go and experience the spring scenery.” At the bottom center, place a small, rounded summary panel titled “Trip Overview,” containing four summary items with icons: Total Duration (approx. 6.5 days), Total Mileage (approx. 2100 km), Recommended Transportation (High-speed rail), and Best Travel Time (April 29 - May 5). In the lower left foreground, place a large, streamlined white high-speed train, diagonally upwards, overlapping the border as a visual focal point. Add a calligraphic closing phrase near the train: “The most beautiful scenery is on the road, the best time is during May Day.” Use elegant olive green, sage green, beige, and warm red tones to combine the charm of traditional Chinese travel posters with the clarity of modern infographics, ensuring clear typography, soft shadows, rounded cards, natural photo insertion, and a clean editorial layout.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张精致的小红书风格中国旅行信息图海报，采用柔和的水彩地图美学，方形格式，展示一条穿越中国的五天高铁旅行路线。左上角为醒目的毛笔书法标题：{argument name="headline text" default="五一出行计划"}。在其正下方，添加一条带有白色中文字符的绿色丝带副标题：{argument name="route text" default="广州→湖南→武汉→北京"}。在副标题下方添加一行较小的中文文字：“一路向北·发现中国之美”。背景为米色和浅鼠尾草绿色的中国中北部淡彩插画地图，带有淡淡的山脉纹理、柔和的河流以及角落处微妙的花卉装饰。一条垂直弯曲的铁路线从底部中心向上延伸至顶部中心，连接 4 个城市，并配有橙红色定位针和醒目的红色中文城市名称。从下到上依次为：广州、湖南、武汉、北京。沿途在轨道上放置白色小型高铁图标，并标注 3 个绿色旅行时间标签：“广州→湖南 高铁约 2.5 小时”、“湖南→武汉 高铁约 1.5 小时”以及“武汉→北京 高铁约 4.5 小时”。在每个城市附近，包含一个风景拼贴画或地标插画群：广州配以现代天际线和广州塔；湖南配以青山和人文景观；武汉配以黄鹤楼和历史建筑；北京配以紫禁城/皇家宫殿建筑。在城市插画附近添加小型风景标签，文字分别为“花城广州·美食之都”、“山水湖南·人文荟萃”、“江城武汉·英雄之城”和“中国首都·历史与现代交融”。在主标题下方，均匀排列 4 个极简图标徽章，并配有简短的中文标签：相机图标标注“精选景点”，火车图标标注“高铁直达”，行李箱图标标注“轻松出行”，星形图标标注“美食推荐”。在地图周围，放置 4 张圆角矩形行程卡片，配有绿色标题、奶油色背景和照片缩略图。每张卡片必须包含每日计划、一个推荐景点的星标部分，以及一个推荐美食的星标部分。4 张卡片分别为：1) 右上角卡片标题“北京｜2 天”，包含 2 行日期、4 个景点缩略图和 1 张美食照片；2) 右侧中间卡片标题“武汉｜1.5 天”，包含 2 行日期、4 个景点缩略图和 1 张美食照片；3) 左侧中间卡片标题“湖南｜2 天”，包含 2 行日期、4 个景点缩略图和 1 张美食照片；4) 左下角卡片标题“广州｜1 天”，包含 1 行日期、4 个景点缩略图和 1 张美食照片。行程文字填充采用实用的小红书风格中文旅行计划文案。在右下角，添加一个圆角备注面板，包含 2 个绿色标题的板块：“行程亮点”和“出行小贴士”。在“行程亮点”下，列出 4 个带有小图标标记的要点。在“出行小贴士”下，列出 4 个带有小图标标记的要点。在备注区域装饰一个小型行李插画，并以绿色手写风格斜体书写中文短语，例如“出发吧！去感受春天的风景”。在底部中心，放置一个小型圆角总结栏，标题为“行程总览”，包含 4 个带图标的总结项：总时长“总时长：约 6.5 天”、总里程“总里程：约 2100 公里”、推荐交通“推荐交通：高铁”以及最佳出行时间“最佳出行时间：4.29 - 5.5”。在左下角前景处，放置一列大型流线型白色高铁，呈对角线向上倾斜，作为视觉焦点部分重叠边框。在火车附近添加书法风格的结束语：“最美的风景在路上 最好的时光在五一”。使用优雅的橄榄绿、鼠尾草绿、米色和暖红色调，将中国传统旅行海报的魅力与现代信息图的清晰度相结合，确保排版清晰、阴影柔和、卡片圆润、照片插入自然，并保持整洁的编辑布局。

templates.title: Japanese fashion magazine cover: Carp streamer themed dress

titleLocalized.zh: 日式时尚杂志封面：鲤鱼旗主题礼服

templates.prompt: A luxurious Japanese women's fashion magazine cover, photographed in soft natural light against a pale blue sky with a blurred city skyline in the distance. The magazine's title, displayed in a large, elegant, oversized soft pink serif font, is prominently featured at the top.{argument name="magazine title" default="Lumiére"} The cover features small Japanese text above and around the front, with a small issue number marker in the upper right corner displaying "5," "May 2026," and "No. 218." At the center of the cover are two young Japanese women standing together, framed from the thighs up, posing confidently for the camera. Their faces are deliberately obscured by smooth, soft-focus rectangular blocks of color. The woman on the left wears a flowing pale blue dress inspired by carp streamers: a high-necked, Chinese-style design with a sleeveless inner lining, a long, transparent cape draped over the shoulders, and delicate layered metal and satin fish-scale appliqués on the chest, along with a large, stylized fish-eye pattern. The waist features more scale details and fin-like decorations, cinched and fastened with a decorative jeweled clasp. She has an elegant updo with a few wisps of hair and wears dangling earrings. The woman on the right wears a dress with the same design concept, in pale pink and white. It also features a high neck, semi-transparent cape-like side panels, a layered fish-scale bodice, and a prominent fish-eye pattern near the belt. It is paired with a soft pleated skirt, tassel embellishments on the belt, and matching dangling earrings. Her dark hair is styled in an elegant updo with a few strands framing her face. The overall look is light, elegant, feminine, and sophisticated, blending traditional Japanese elegance with modern haute couture. The soft color palette, primarily baby blue, blush pink, white, and delicate gold trim, is bright yet gentle, creating a high-end magazine feel. The cover features a realistically laid-out Japanese title: a text block on the left introducing the cover model, a large main title block at the bottom, a set of vertically arranged small teaser text on the right, and two light blue circular markers containing Japanese text. Above, it advertises a special gift set and includes product images of two small pouch-like accessories; below, it includes a shopping list with three rows of checkboxes. A pink ribbon-like label is added above the main title. The overall composition should be simple and appealing, with seasonal themes of Golden Week and carp streamer fashion.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张风格奢华的日式女性时尚杂志封面，在柔和的自然光下拍摄，背景为淡蓝色天空，远处有模糊的城市天际线。顶部印有巨大且优雅的刊名，以超大号柔粉色衬线字体显示 {argument name="magazine title" default="Lumiére"}，上方及周围环绕着小号日文封面文字，右上角标有小型期号标记，显示“5”、“2026 年 5 月”和“No.218”。封面中心为两名年轻的日本女性，两人站在一起，取景范围约为大腿以上，面向镜头摆出从容的编辑姿势，她们的面部被平滑的柔焦矩形色块刻意遮挡。左侧女性身着受鲤鱼旗启发的淡蓝色飘逸礼服：高立领中式设计，无袖内衬，肩部垂下长款透明斗篷，胸前饰有精致的层叠金属与缎面鱼鳞贴花，胸口有大型程式化鱼眼图案，腰部有更多鳞片细节和鳍状装饰，腰部收紧并配有装饰性珠宝扣。她留着优雅的盘发，带有几缕碎发，佩戴着垂坠耳环。右侧女性穿着同样设计理念的礼服，配色为淡粉色与白色，同样采用高领、半透明斗篷式侧片、层叠鱼鳞胸衣，腰带附近有明显的鱼眼图案，配有柔软的百褶裙、腰带上的流苏装饰以及配套的垂坠耳环；她的深色头发也盘成了精致的发髻，留有几缕发丝。整体造型轻盈、优雅、柔美且高级，融合了传统日式优雅与现代高定感。采用以婴儿蓝、腮红粉、白色和精致金边为主的柔和色调，光线明亮而柔和，呈现出高级杂志的质感。包含布局真实的日文封面标题：左侧一个介绍封面人物的文字块，下半部分有一个大型主标题块，右侧有一组垂直排列的小型预告文字，右侧还有 2 个淡蓝色圆形标注，内含日文文本；上方标注宣传特别附赠礼品套装，并包含 2 张小型袋状配饰的产品图，下方标注包含一个带有 3 行复选框的购物清单。在主标题上方添加一个粉色丝带状标签。整体构图应简洁、令人向往，并以黄金周和鲤鱼旗时尚为季节性主题。

templates.title: Japanese carp streamer fashion magazine cover

titleLocalized.zh: 日式鲤鱼旗时尚杂志封面

templates.prompt: A sophisticated Japanese fashion magazine cover, photographed in a bright and clear outdoor setting, with a pale blue sky and soft-focus modern railings in the background, in a vertical composition. The top masthead features a large, elegant, soft pink serif font, "L'Allure," with smaller Japanese text above and a Japanese subtitle in brackets in the upper right corner. The upper left corner displays the issue information as a large black "5," flanked and below by smaller text indicating May 2026, issue number 156, and the May 2026 issue itself. The cover showcases two adult East Asian women standing side-by-side from mid-thigh up, striking a pose befitting a luxurious editorial cover. Their faces are deliberately obscured by smooth, rectangular blurs. The soft, natural, and highly embellished lighting creates a sophisticated high-fashion magazine aesthetic. The woman on the left wears a navy blue blouse with sleeves featuring a dramatic fish-scale design in navy blue, white, and silver, tucked into a long, flowing, off-white skirt with a wide waist. She carries a fish-shaped handbag: a navy blue and cream-colored koi-inspired bag with round eye details, fish scale patterns, a fish tail silhouette, gold hardware, and a delicate dangling chain. Her hair, a deep brown to black, is loosely tied in a low bun, with a few strands softly framing her face. Her posture is elegant, her body slightly leaning forward, one hand near her chin. The woman on the right wears a crisp white blouse with a soft bow tie or vertical ruffles/placket details, paired with a striking koi-inspired skirt or dress in coral pink and deep blue, featuring layered fish scale patterns and a round eye-shaped embellishment at the waist. She carries a structured handbag: a rectangular white bag with coral pink koi face detailing, blue accents, gold hardware, a top handle, and a shoulder strap. Her dark hair is tied in a low ponytail. She stands slightly to the left, her hands relaxed, exuding a composed, editorial air. The fashion concept revolves around carp streamers and carp motifs, transforming the traditional Japanese imagery of carp streamers into sophisticated contemporary womenswear. The color palette features soft sky blue, blush pink, navy blue, white, cream, and coral red. Fabrics appear smooth, elegant, and light, adorned with printed or embroidered fish-scale patterns. The overall atmosphere is elegant, feminine, seasonal, and high-end, balancing tradition and modern fashion. A multi-line Japanese cover title is included, employing realistic editorial typography. The left side contains four text blocks: a red and black themed section on melancholic carp streamer fashion; a blue subheading on balancing traditional aesthetics with fresh elegance; a black text block on basic and updated styles for 20-year-old women; and a blue beauty section on transparent makeup looks for early summer. The right side contains three text blocks: a red "Cover Story" title below a larger black Japanese main title; a blue text block about a conservative style shining in fresh greenery; and a pink-framed reader giveaway notification below black Japanese text about new bags and accessories from luxury brands. Near the bottom left corner is a circular pink badge with white and cream Japanese text announcing a special walking guide supplement. At the bottom center, spanning most of the width, is a large, dramatic Japanese main title in pink and black serif and calligraphy style. This is designed as the cover of a realistic high-end women's fashion magazine, the magazine's name being {argument name="magazine name" default="L’Allure"} The theme is{argument name="fashion theme" default="Carp streamer-inspired spring fashion"} Publication period is{argument name="issue month" default="May 2026"} The text remains primarily in Japanese, with a large pink serif font used for the masthead. The design is simple, appealing, and luxurious.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张精致的日本时尚杂志封面，拍摄于明亮通透的户外环境，背景为淡蓝色天空和柔焦的现代栏杆，纵向构图。顶部刊头为巨大的优雅柔粉色衬线字体“L’Allure”，上方配有小型日文，右上角有带括号的日文副标题。左上角显示期刊信息，为一个巨大的黑色“5”，旁边和下方堆叠着较小的文字，标明 2026 年 5 月、第 156 期以及 2026 年 5 月刊的字样。封面展示了两位成年东亚女性，从大腿中部以上并肩站立，呈现出奢华编辑封面的姿态。她们的面部被平滑的矩形模糊块刻意遮挡。光线柔和、自然且修饰感强，具有精致的高级杂志美感。

左侧女性身着海军蓝衬衫，袖子采用海军蓝、白色和银色的戏剧性鱼鳞设计，搭配蝴蝶结或围巾式领口，束进一条长款飘逸的米白色半身裙中，裙腰宽大。她手提 1 只鱼形手袋：一款海军蓝与奶油色相间的鲤鱼灵感包，带有圆形眼睛细节、鱼鳞图案、鱼尾轮廓、金色五金件和垂下的细链条。她的头发呈深棕色至黑色，松散地扎成低发髻，几缕发丝柔和地修饰着脸庞。她的姿态优雅，身体略微倾斜，一只手靠近下巴。

右侧女性身着干练的白色衬衫，前襟带有柔和的领结或垂直荷叶边/门襟细节，搭配一条引人注目的鲤鱼灵感半身裙或裙装，主色调为珊瑚粉和深蓝色，带有层叠的鱼鳞纹样，腰间饰有圆形眼状装饰。她手提 1 只结构感手袋：一款长方形白色包袋，带有珊瑚粉色鲤鱼面部拼接、蓝色点缀、金色五金件、顶部手柄和肩带。她的深色头发扎成低马尾。她身体略微向左侧站立，双手放松，姿态流露出从容的编辑感。

时尚概念围绕鲤鱼旗和鲤鱼纹样展开，将传统的日本鲤鱼旗意象转化为精致的当代女装。色调为柔和的天空蓝、腮红粉、海军蓝、白色、奶油色和珊瑚红。面料显得平滑、优雅且轻盈飘逸，带有印花或刺绣的鱼鳞图案。整体氛围优雅、女性化、充满季节感且高端，平衡了传统与现代时尚。

添加多行日文封面标题，采用写实的编辑排版。左侧包含 4 组文本块：1 个关于忧郁鲤鱼旗时尚的红黑配色专题标题，1 个关于以清新优雅平衡传承传统美感的蓝色小副标题，1 个关于二十岁女性基础款与更新的黑色文本块，以及 1 个关于初夏透明感妆容的蓝色美妆专题行。右侧包含 3 组文本块：1 个红色的“封面故事”标题，下方配有较大的黑色日文主标题，1 个关于在清新绿意中闪耀的保守风格的蓝色文本块，以及 1 个粉色框选的读者赠品通知，下方配有关于奢侈品牌新款包袋和配饰的黑色日文文本。左下角附近放置 1 个圆形粉色徽章，带有白色和奶油色日文，内容为特别步行指南增刊。下部中心横跨大部分宽度，放置一个巨大的、由粉色和黑色衬线及毛笔字风格组成的戏剧性日文主标题。

将其设计为一本写实的女性高端时尚杂志封面，杂志名称为 {argument name="magazine name" default="L’Allure"}，主题为 {argument name="fashion theme" default="鲤鱼旗灵感春季时尚"}，刊期为 {argument name="issue month" default="2026 年 5 月"}。保持文本以日文为主，刊头采用大号粉色衬线字体，构图简洁、令人向往且奢华。

templates.title: Gyaru, the hottest girl in the classroom during her golden hour

titleLocalized.zh: 黄金时刻的辣妹（Gyaru）在教室

templates.prompt: This heartwarming golden-moment anime illustration depicts a stylish gyaru high school girl casually leaning against an empty desk in a Japanese classroom. Positioned at the center of a mid-shot full-body portrait, she faces the viewer, leaning slightly forward, one hand resting on the desk, the other in her cardigan pocket, exuding a friendly, approachable, and otaku-esque gyaru charm. She has long, wavy hair.{argument name="hair color" default="Bleached blonde hair"} Her hair was loose and naturally wavy at her shoulders, possessing a slightly messy yet charming quality. She wore multiple earrings, a delicate necklace, and long, manicured nails, her makeup fresh and youthful. Her attire was a stylishly tailored Japanese school uniform: a loose beige cardigan worn open over a white shirt, the shirt collar unbuttoned and tied with a large dark blue plaid bow, paired with a short, dark plaid pleated skirt. The classroom was illuminated by the low-angle afternoon sunlight streaming through the large window on the left, creating long shadows. The edges of her hair shimmered with soft contour light, creating a nostalgic amber atmosphere. In the background were several wooden desks and chairs, a green blackboard with Japanese thank-you notes and chalk doodles, and the gentle atmosphere of a quiet scene after school. High-detail anime rendering, exquisite light novel/visual novel key visual quality, soft cinematic lighting, elegant shadow treatment, romantic nostalgia, and vertical composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张温暖的黄金时刻动漫插画，描绘了一位时尚的辣妹（gyaru）高中女生，她随意地靠在空荡荡的日本教室课桌旁。她位于中景全身肖像的中心，面向观众，身体微微前倾，一只手放在桌子上，另一只手插在开衫口袋里，散发出一种友善、平易近人且符合御宅族审美的辣妹气质。她留着长长的波浪卷发，{argument name="hair color" default="漂染金发"}，发丝蓬松且在肩部呈现出自然的卷度，带着一种略显凌乱的迷人感，佩戴着多个耳环、精致的项链，留着长长的美甲，妆容清透年轻。她的装扮是时尚化的日本校服：一件宽松的米色开衫敞开穿在白色衬衫外，衬衫领口解开，领口系着一个大的深蓝色格子蝴蝶结，下身是短款深色格子百褶裙。教室被左侧大窗户射入的午后低角度阳光照亮，形成了长长的阴影，她的发丝边缘泛着柔和的轮廓光，营造出一种怀旧的琥珀色氛围。背景中有几张木制课桌椅、一块写有日语感谢语和粉笔涂鸦的绿色黑板，以及放学后安静场景的柔和氛围。高细节动漫渲染，精致的轻小说/视觉小说关键视觉图质量，柔和的电影级光影，优雅的阴影处理，浪漫的怀旧情绪，竖构图。

templates.title: Shining Anime Idol Concert Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 闪耀动漫偶像演唱会肖像

templates.prompt: A stunning illustration of an anime idol concert. At the center of the image is a female virtual singer performing, captured in a dynamic mid-range full-body shot from a slightly upward angle. One hand holds a microphone to her chest, while the other arm extends towards the audience. She has extremely long, voluminous twin ponytails that dramatically fill the entire image, her hair color a gradient from soft peach-gold to pink, with glossy highlights and curled ends. She wears a futuristic cyan headband and matching earmuffs. Her face is deliberately obscured by a simple, light pink square mask. She wears a vibrant cyan-blue idol dress with a lustrous, gemstone-like texture, a fitted bodice, white ruffled cap sleeves, a white sailor collar, and a large red bow adorned with blue gemstones at the chest. Gold chains and buttons adorn her waist, and the skirt is a tiered flared skirt with white ruffles and delicate pink stripes at the hem. Long red ribbons flutter at her waist and throughout her dress. She wears black knee-high stockings and holds a gold-cyan microphone. The stage is a spectacular, futuristic arena, with blue and purple glow sticks flashing in the audience, surrounded by intense shimmering effects, sequins, confetti, lens flares, and star-like rays. The background is filled with curved, glowing stage structures, neon arcs, and intersecting pink, purple, and blue spotlights overhead, creating a magical, high-energy live performance atmosphere. The art style features exquisite modern anime-inspired key visuals with ultra-high detail, glossy paint rendering, radiant lighting, shimmering highlights on fabrics and hair, and saturated cyan-magenta hues, creating a celebratory and emotionally charged idol performance atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张令人惊艳的动漫偶像演唱会插画，画面中央是一位正在表演的女性虚拟歌手，采用略微仰视的动态中景全身构图，一只手将麦克风握在胸前，另一只手臂向观众方向伸展。她拥有极长且蓬松的双马尾，戏剧性地铺满整个画面，发色呈现从柔和桃金色到粉色的渐变，带有光泽感高光和卷曲的发梢，佩戴青色未来感发带及配套耳罩饰品。她的面部被一个简单的米粉色方形遮挡块刻意遮盖。她身穿一件鲜艳的青蓝色偶像礼服，具有光泽的宝石质感，修身胸衣，白色荷叶边盖袖，白色水手领，胸前饰有镶嵌蓝色宝石的大红蝴蝶结，腰间配有金色链条装饰和金色纽扣，裙摆为分层喇叭裙，内衬白色褶边，下摆处有细粉色条纹点缀。腰间和服装上飘动着长长的红色丝带，穿着黑色过膝袜，手持金青色麦克风。舞台是一个壮观的未来感竞技场，观众席中闪烁着蓝色和紫色的荧光棒，周围环绕着强烈的闪光虚化效果、亮片、纸屑、镜头光晕和星状光芒。背景填充着弯曲的发光舞台结构、霓虹弧线，以及头顶交错的粉色、紫色和蓝色聚光灯，营造出充满魔力的高能量现场演出氛围。艺术风格为精致的现代动漫主视觉图，超高细节，光泽感绘画渲染，光芒四射的照明，织物和头发上的闪烁高光，饱和的青色-洋红色调，充满庆典感和情感张力的偶像表演氛围。

templates.title: Cute street style double portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱街头风双人肖像

templates.prompt: A candid street style portrait shows two adorable anime-style girls standing side-by-side in front of a colorful graffiti wall on a sidewalk in a Japanese city. The photo was taken at eye level, creating a shallow depth of field and soft, overcast natural light. Both girls have fair, smooth skin and short, straight bob haircuts, with bangs partially obscuring their foreheads. Their faces are deliberately simplified or blurred, giving them an anonymous, doll-like appearance. The girl on the left has {argument name="hair color" default="silver-gray"} The girl on the right has icy blue hair, wears a black knit hat with a rectangular "Nightfall" logo patch, a black leather jacket over a white printed T-shirt (with dark distressed illustrations and purple accents), layered silver chain necklaces (including heart-shaped pendants), a black choker, and carries a black backpack on one shoulder. The girl on the right has icy blue hair, wears a black knit hat with a white graffiti-style logo, an oversized black hoodie with striking bright pink Japanese graffiti lettering on the chest, a silver chain necklace, and carries a black backpack. They are relaxed and stylish, leaning slightly towards each other, one hand lightly touching the shoulder of the hoodie. The background is a brightly colored pink, blue, and purple graffiti wall, with a telephone pole covered in stickers on the right edge, including layers of street stickers such as "SMILE," "AQUARIUS," and a red sticker that reads "HELLO my name is," covered in graffiti. It emphasizes Japanese street style, alternative fashion, cute and cool atmosphere, realistic fabric texture, clear clothing details, subtle cinematic color grading, and trendy Harajuku snapshot aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张抓拍风格的街头时尚肖像，两位可爱的动漫风女孩并肩站立在日本城市人行道的彩色涂鸦墙前，采用平视视角拍摄，具有浅景深效果和柔和的阴天自然光。两人均拥有白皙细腻的皮肤和短直发波波头，刘海遮住部分额头，面部经过刻意简化或模糊处理，呈现出匿名的人偶感。左侧女孩留着 {argument name="hair color" default="银灰色"} 的头发，头戴饰有矩形 "Nightfall" 标志贴片的黑色针织帽，身穿黑色皮夹克，内搭白色印花 T 恤（带有深色磨损插画和紫色点缀图案），叠戴银色链条项链（含心形吊坠），佩戴黑色颈圈，单肩背着黑色双肩包。右侧女孩留着冰蓝色头发，头戴饰有白色涂鸦风格标志的黑色针织帽，身穿超大款黑色连帽衫，胸前印有醒目的亮粉色日文涂鸦字样，佩戴银色链条项链，双肩背着黑色双肩包。她们姿态放松且时尚，微微向对方倾斜，其中一只手轻触连帽衫肩部。背景是一面色彩鲜艳的粉、蓝、紫色调涂鸦墙，右侧边缘有一根贴满贴纸的电线杆，上面可见层叠的街头贴纸，包括 "SMILE"、"AQUARIUS" 以及一张写有 "HELLO my name is" 的红色贴纸，上面布满涂鸦。强调日系街头风格、另类时尚、可爱酷炫氛围、逼真的布料质感、清晰的服装细节、微妙的电影感调色以及潮流原宿快照美学。

templates.title: Q-version rabbit OpenPose illustration

titleLocalized.zh: Q 版兔子 OpenPose 图示

templates.prompt: A simple, centered full-body illustration showcasing an adorable chibi version.{argument name="animal type" default="rabbit"} Character, background is solid color{argument name="background color" default="Light gray"} The character is drawn in a flat cartoon style, featuring clear, bold black outlines and minimalist shadows. The character has a white body, a large, round head, two long, erect ears (with bright cyan inner ears), two large oval eyes with cyan irises, black pupils, and tiny highlights, thin, curved eyebrows, a small, pinkish-red nose, and a slightly upturned mouth. The character faces forward, with arms outstretched horizontally to the sides and legs apart in a simple standing pose. A short, semi-circular, fluffy tail, formed by short black dotted lines, is visible on the right side of the body. A clear OpenPose-style skeletal marker system is overlaid on the character: 2 purple eye keypoints, 1 red nose keypoint, 1 blue neck keypoint, 2 shoulder keypoints, 2 elbow keypoints, 2 wrist keypoints, 1 yellow spine or pelvic center point, 2 hip keypoints, 2 knee keypoints, and 2 ankle keypoints, totaling 17 colored points, connected to the face, shoulders, torso, arms, and legs by thin colored lines. Vibrant colors such as purple, magenta, red, blue, cyan, green, yellow, orange, and turquoise are used to make the overlays of poses clearly visible. The composition maintains vertical centering, symmetry, cleanliness, and a graphic feel, using the cute mascot character and poses of the overlays as the sole main subject.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张简单的全身居中插图，展示了一个可爱的 Q 版 {argument name="animal type" default="兔子"} 角色，背景为纯色 {argument name="background color" default="浅灰色"}，采用扁平卡通风格绘制，具有清晰的黑色粗轮廓和极简阴影。角色拥有白色的身体、一个硕大的圆头、两只竖起的长耳朵（内耳为亮青色）、两只带有青色虹膜、黑色瞳孔和微小高光的大椭圆形眼睛、细小的弯眉、小巧的红粉色鼻区以及微微上扬的嘴巴。角色正面朝向，双臂水平向两侧伸直，双腿分开呈简单的站立姿势，身体右侧可见一个由短黑虚线构成的半圆形短绒尾巴。在角色上方叠加一套清晰的 OpenPose 风格骨架标记系统：包含 2 个紫色眼部关键点、1 个红色鼻部关键点、1 个蓝色颈部关键点、2 个肩部关键点、2 个肘部关键点、2 个腕部关键点、1 个黄色脊椎或骨盆中心点、2 个髋部关键点、2 个膝盖关键点和 2 个踝部关键点，总计 17 个彩色点，并通过细彩色线条连接面部、肩部、躯干、手臂和腿部。使用紫色、洋红色、红色、蓝色、青色、绿色、黄色、橙色和蓝绿色等鲜艳的颜色，使姿态叠加层清晰可见。构图保持垂直居中、对称、整洁且具有图示感，以可爱的吉祥物角色和姿态估计叠加层作为唯一主体。

templates.title: Shiba Inu Space Dream Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 柴犬太空梦海报

templates.prompt: A dramatic illustration in the style of a Japanese inspirational movie poster, set at dusk, blends workplace burnout with a hopeful space fantasy. In the foreground, a humanized Shiba Inu with warm brown fur smiles confidently at the viewer, dressed in a tailored dark blue business suit, white shirt, and blue striped tie. The dog holds a black e-reader in its left paw, the screen displaying the word "Kindle," and a black and gold pen in its right. The background behind the characters is divided into two interwoven themes: on the left is a dense Tokyo-style cityscape at sunset, with the Tokyo Tower shimmering in orange light, and weary office workers hunched over their desks in dark office buildings under a heavy atmosphere of stress; on the right is a deep starry sky, dotted with blue nebulae, a rocket launching upwards, three airplanes, a winding, glowing golden trajectory line, an asteroid, two floating paw prints, two packs of compressed biscuits labeled "Kanpan," and a round rice cracker labeled "Nanbu Senbei." Near the lower right background, a family of four walks towards the bright horizon from behind, accompanied by a dog, symbolizing hope and future dreams. In the midground on the left, three floating black "projects" are added, each labeled with a Japanese word: "残业" (zanye, meaning "unfinished business"), "プヷャー" (preshock), and "会会满人電車" (meeting full train). On the wooden desk in the foreground, three eye-catching books stand upright: the first book on the left is white and blue, titled "The Method of Making English Ready for Busy Socialites," and includes a small illustration of the author's portrait; the second book in the middle is dark blue with gold accents, with a large title "The Strongest Survival Strategy is the Method of 'Survival'"; the third book on the right is white and blue, titled "The Fastest Job Skills are the Method of 'Survival'," and features a large "5" and a circular "5 MIN" icon. The table also includes a black coffee mug with the inscription "The future changes in 5 minutes," an open spiral notebook with a to-do list handwritten in Japanese: "Today's 1. Write a log (5 minutes) 2. Visit the family (5 minutes) 3. Trust the future (Wakuwaku)." Next to this is a paw print drawing, a flat black fountain pen, a globe on the far right, a plate of cookies, an extra pack of "canpan," and a small photo frame in the lower left corner. At the top is a luxurious gold title in large Japanese characters.{argument name="headline text" default="Go to space in 5 minutes!"} Below this is a smaller gold subtitle: "〜たかお柴犬のサイドFIRE物語〜". Below that, centered, is white text: "忙しい毎日に、たった5分。 犬だけど、梦は本気で掴んだ。" At the bottom center is a cinematic English tagline: "Based on a true story of たかお柴犬", followed by "A heartwarming comedy-drama about taking small steps to big dreams". The poster uses ultra-refined glossy rendering, with a striking contrast between the warm orange sunset and the cool tones of space. It's an inspirational commercial visual art piece with sharp typography, rich cinematic lighting, and a style that is both whimsical and sincere. The highly sophisticated social media poster composition is in a vertical format.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张戏剧性的日式励志电影海报风格插画，背景设定在黄昏，融合了职场倦怠与充满希望的太空梦想幻想。画面中心前景处，一只拟人化的柴犬拥有温暖的棕褐色皮毛，正自信地微笑着看向观众，它穿着剪裁利落的深蓝色商务西装、白色衬衫和蓝色条纹领带。这只狗左爪拿着一个黑色的电子阅读器，屏幕上显示着“kindle”字样，右爪握着一支黑金配色的钢笔。角色后方的背景分为两个相互融合的主题部分：左侧是日落时分密集的东京风格城市天际线，东京塔闪烁着橙色的光芒，深色的办公大楼里，疲惫的上班族在压力沉重的氛围下伏案工作；右侧是深邃的星空，点缀着蓝色星云、一枚向上发射的火箭、3 架飞机、一条蜿蜒发光的金色轨迹线、1 颗小行星、2 个漂浮的爪印、2 包标有“カンパン”的压缩饼干，以及 1 块标有“南部せんべい”的圆形仙贝。在右下方的背景附近，展示一家四口从背面走向明亮地平线的身影，身边跟着一只狗，象征着希望与未来梦想。在左侧中景处添加 3 块漂浮的黑色“项目”，上面分别写着日语词汇“残业”、“プレッシャー”和“会议 满员电车”。在前景的木质书桌上，放置 3 本醒目竖立的书籍：左侧第 1 本书为白蓝色，标题为“忙しい社会人のやり直し英语勉强法”，并配有小幅作者肖像插图；中间第 2 本书为深蓝色配金色，大标题为“『あたりまえ』を続けることは 最强の生存戦略である”；右侧第 3 本书为白蓝色，标题为“『すぐやる』は最速の仕事术”，并带有巨大的“5”和圆形的“5 MIN”图标。桌上还包括 1 个黑色咖啡杯，印有文字“未来は 5分で変わる”、1 本摊开的螺旋笔记本，上面用日语手写着待办事项清单：“今日やること ① ブログを書く（5分） ② 家族と過ごす（大切） ③ 未来を信じる（ワクワク）”，旁边还有一个爪印涂鸦、1 支平放的黑色钢笔、最右侧放置 1 个地球仪摆件、1 盘饼干、1 包额外的“カンパン”，以及左下角边缘处的小相框。顶部是奢华的金色大号日语标题文字“{argument name="headline text" default="5分で宇宙へ！"}”，下方配有较小的金色副标题：“〜たかお柴犬のサイドFIRE物语〜”。下方居中处是白色的文案：“忙しい毎日に、たった5分。 犬だけど、梦は本気で掴んだ。”底部中心处添加一句电影感十足的英文标语：“Based on a true story of たかお柴犬”，下方写着“A heartwarming comedy-drama about taking small steps to big dreams”。采用超精细光面海报渲染，温暖的橙色日落与冷色调太空形成鲜明对比，励志商业主视觉艺术，锐利的排版，丰富的电影级光影，风格既异想天开又真诚，高度精致的社交媒体海报构图，竖版格式。

templates.title: Tokyo Romantic Couple Photo Collage

titleLocalized.zh: 东京浪漫情侣照片拼贴

templates.prompt: A series of emotionally charged 4x3 photo collages, composed of 12 candid cell phone photos of a young couple on a Tokyo summer night, employs a nostalgic film-like texture, soft grain, low-saturation colors, slight blur, low contrast, dim streetlights, and intimate, casual compositions. The overall tone is romantic, youthful, intimate, and documentary-like, with warm gray-brown tones and a slightly desaturated teal-orange hue reflecting the city's nighttime atmosphere. The man has messy, short dark hair, a slender figure, and wears a dark outer layer or light jacket over a white T-shirt; the woman has long, dark brown hair, a slender figure, and wears a white sleeveless top with a black thin-strapped shoulder bag. In each frame, both individuals' faces are deliberately obscured by large areas of soft-edged blur to protect their privacy. Contains 12 tightly arranged, seamless grid images: First row, frame 1: An extreme close-up of a man's profile at night; Frame 2: A mirror or cell phone selfie of a woman standing side-by-side with a man outdoors at night; Frame 3: The two cuddling tightly beside a street with Japanese signs; Frame 4: The two kissing on a busy city crosswalk. Middle row, frame 5: The shadows of the two on the ground, one of them making a peace sign; Frame 6: The two standing intimately on a sidewalk in a city shopping street; Frame 7: A sunset over the waterfront skyline with Tokyo Tower, without people; Frame 8: A bird's-eye view of a man and woman standing close together on stairs or a passageway. Last row, frame 9: An intimate close-up of the two touching faces or kissing; Frame 10: A man fixing a woman's hair on a city street; Frame 11: The two riding scooters or motorcycles, both wearing helmets, with a motion blur effect; Frame 12: The two embracing under a pale blue sky, framed from the shoulders up. The background should include Japanese city streets, shops, pedestrian crossings, signs, buildings, nighttime traffic, and the city's nighttime atmosphere. Keep the composition casual and imperfect, like real memories, and present diverse cropping, soft focus, motion blur, and a realistic handheld mobile phone photography feel.

promptLocalized.zh: 一组充满情绪感的 4x3 照片拼贴，由 12 张年轻情侣在东京夏夜的手机抓拍照片组成，采用怀旧胶片质感、柔和颗粒、低饱和色彩、轻微模糊、低对比度、昏暗的环境街灯以及亲密的随意构图。整体基调浪漫、年轻、私密且具有纪录片风格，色调为暖灰棕色，并带有轻微去饱和的青橙色城市夜景氛围。男子留着凌乱的深色短发，身材苗条，身穿深色外搭或轻便夹克，内搭白色 T 恤；女子留着深棕色长发，身材苗条，身穿白色无袖上衣，肩上背着黑色细肩带包。在每一格画面中，两人的面部均被刻意添加了大面积的柔边模糊遮挡以保护隐私。包含 12 张紧凑排列的无缝网格图像：第一行第 1 格，夜间男子侧脸的极致特写；第 2 格，女子在夜间户外与男子并肩站立时拍摄的镜面或手机自拍；第 3 格，两人在带有日文标识的街道旁紧紧依偎；第 4 格，两人在繁忙的城市人行横道上接吻。中间一行第 5 格，地面上两人的影子，其中一人比着剪刀手；第 6 格，两人在城市商业街的人行道上亲密站立；第 7 格，带有东京塔的日落水岸天际线，无人物；第 8 格，从高处俯拍楼梯或通道上紧挨着的男女。最后一行第 9 格，两人脸部触碰或接吻的亲密特写；第 10 格，男子在城市街道上为女子整理头发；第 11 格，两人骑着踏板车或摩托车，均佩戴头盔，呈现动态模糊感；第 12 格，两人在淡蓝色天空下拥抱，取景为肩部以上。背景应包含日本城市街道、店面、人行横道、标识、建筑、夜间交通和城市夜晚氛围。保持构图随意且不完美，如同真实的记忆，呈现多样的裁剪、柔焦、动态模糊以及真实的手机手持摄影感。

templates.title: Gothic anime girl and the black rose

titleLocalized.zh: 哥特风动漫少女与黑玫瑰

templates.prompt: A dark anime-style gothic portrait, the main character is{argument name="character type" default="young women"} The composition is half-body, centered. She has long, multi-layered hair.{argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} Her hair was styled in messy twin ponytails, with strands falling naturally over her shoulders. She wore two large black ribbon lace hair ornaments, a black gothic dress with puffy sleeves and delicate lace trim, black lace fingerless gloves, and a black leather choker with a metal clasp. Two silver chain necklaces were layered around her neck, one of which had a striking cross pendant. She made a peace sign with her hands raised to her cheeks, her nails painted black, a pose that was both playful and cool. The background was a rich, blood-red gradient, creating a gloomy atmosphere. Five thorny black roses surrounded the figure, with black dripping patterns at the top edge, presenting a highly dramatic gothic horror aesthetic. The artwork uses a high-detail anime illustration style, with sharp lines, soft and dramatic shadows, emphasizing the sheen of the black fabric, pale skin, and a strong red-black contrast. The composition is symmetrical, with a close-up view, creating an overall elegant yet eerie atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张暗黑动漫风格的哥特肖像，主角为 {argument name="character type" default="年轻女性"}，半身构图，居中展示。她留着长长的多层次 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色"} 凌乱双马尾，发丝自然垂落在肩头。她佩戴着两个巨大的黑色丝带蕾丝发饰，身穿带有蓬松袖口和精致蕾丝花边的黑色哥特裙，戴着黑色蕾丝露指手套，以及带有金属扣的黑色皮质颈圈。颈部叠戴两条银色链条项链，其中一条挂着醒目的十字架吊坠。双手举在脸颊两侧比出剪刀手，指甲涂成黑色，姿态俏皮又不失酷感。背景为浓郁的血红色渐变，营造出阴郁的氛围，人物周围装饰着 5 朵带刺的黑玫瑰，顶部边缘有黑色滴落状图形，呈现出极具戏剧性的哥特恐怖美学。采用高细节动漫插画风格，线条锐利，阴影柔和且富有戏剧性，强调黑色织物的光泽感、苍白的肤色以及强烈的红黑对比，构图对称，近景取景，整体氛围优雅而诡谲。

templates.title: Movie-themed Lovers' Memory Collage

titleLocalized.zh: 电影感恋人记忆拼贴

templates.prompt: A 4x3 photo collage containing 12 cinematic snapshots of the daily lives of young Japanese couples, employing a film-like candid style with soft blur, low-saturation colors, graininess, halos, and shallow depth of field. The overall atmosphere is intimate, nostalgic, urban, and slightly melancholic, using a blend of warm and cool tones and natural, imperfect compositions. Includes 12 unique photographs: 1) A close-up portrait on a nighttime street, one person wearing a scarf, their face partially obscured, surrounded by luminous bokeh; 2) A couple huddled together on a train at night, quiet and sleepy; 3) A back-view perspective of a person walking alone through a city street at night, with bokeh of traffic lights and storefronts in the background; 4) A portrait taken at dusk or dawn on a rooftop or high outdoors, one person looking back at the camera, their hair blowing in the wind, wearing a jacket; 5) A bright daytime snapshot of a suburban street, one person standing by a hedge, casual and slightly overexposed; 6) A very close-up, dimly lit, self-portrait-like image of a couple posing indoors or at night, their faces soft and out of focus; 7) A couple sitting side-by-side on a beach watching the sunset from behind; 8) A couple talking at a small table in a cozy izakaya or vintage restaurant, with posters and warm tungsten lighting in the background; 9) 10) A candid shot inside a crowded indoor space or vehicle, showing a person slumped or resting, with strong motion blur and a deep green hue; 11) A couple standing face to face in a narrow alley at night, surrounded by lantern lights and rows of Japanese signs; 12) A quiet close-up of intertwined hands and draped clothing while sitting on an outdoor roadside; 13) A nighttime portrait of a person against a backdrop of towering city buildings and colorful, out-of-focus lights. All 12 images are borderless, presented in a seamless grid, with slight variations in composition and exposure, as if captured from multiple dates and ordinary moments.{argument name="film style" default="moody 35mm film"} (Film style){argument name="couple age" default="early 20s"} (Couple's age){argument name="city" default="Tokyo"} (City),{argument name="season" default="autumn"} (Seasons) and{argument name="overall mood" default="romantic nostalgia"} (Overall atmosphere).

promptLocalized.zh: 一张 4x3 的照片拼贴，包含 12 张年轻日本情侣日常生活的电影感怀旧快照，采用类似胶片摄影的抓拍风格，带有柔和模糊、低饱和色彩、颗粒感、光晕和浅景深效果。整体氛围亲密、怀旧、具有都市感且略带忧郁，采用冷暖交织的色调和自然且不完美的构图。包含 12 张独特的照片：1) 夜间街道上的近景人像，一人围着围巾，面部部分遮挡，周围环绕着发光的焦外成像光斑；2) 夜晚情侣在火车上紧靠在一起，互相依偎，安静而困倦；3) 夜晚一人在城市街道独自漫步的后侧方视角，背景是交通灯和店面的焦外光斑；4) 黄昏或清晨在屋顶或户外高处的肖像，一人回头看向镜头，发丝随风飘动，身穿夹克；5) 明亮的日间郊区街道快照，一人站在树篱旁，随性且略微过曝；6) 一张非常近距离、光线昏暗的类似自拍的画面，情侣在室内或夜晚合影，两人的面部柔和且失焦；7) 从背后看，情侣并排坐在海滩上观看海上日落；8) 情侣坐在舒适的居酒屋或复古餐厅的小桌旁交谈，背景有海报和温暖的钨丝灯光；9) 一张拥挤的室内或交通工具内的抓拍，一人瘫坐或休息，带有强烈的动态模糊和深绿色调；10) 情侣在夜晚狭窄的小巷中面对面站立，周围是灯笼光和竖排的日文招牌；11) 一张安静的局部特写，拍摄在户外路边坐着时交织的双手和垂下的衣物；12) 一张夜间人像，一人以高耸的城市建筑和色彩斑斓的失焦灯光为背景。保持所有 12 张图像无边框，以无缝网格呈现，构图和曝光略有差异，仿佛拍摄于多次约会和平凡瞬间。使用 {argument name="film style" default="moody 35mm film"}（胶片风格）、{argument name="couple age" default="early 20s"}（情侣年龄）、{argument name="city" default="Tokyo"}（城市）、{argument name="season" default="autumn"}（季节）以及 {argument name="overall mood" default="romantic nostalgia"}（整体氛围）。

templates.title: A librarian showcasing AI-generated books in a realistic style.

titleLocalized.zh: 展示 AI 书籍的写实风格图书管理员

templates.prompt: A realistic, vertical promotional portrait is set against a warm, modern library or bookstore interior. A young East Asian woman stands behind a wooden counter, displaying a large book to the camera. She has long, straight, dark brown hair parted in the middle, wears delicate earrings, and appears neat, friendly, and professional. She wears a white shirt, a soft green striped tie, and a beige apron with a name tag reading "Librarian Ai-chan" and a small open book icon sewn on it. Her left hand holds the book upright against her chest, slightly tilted towards the viewer, while her right hand is open beneath the book, a classic product presentation pose. The book is the visual focus: its dark, glossy cover features a striking orange title, "Pollo AI" (a large line of text at the top, with a glowing line in the center), followed by a smaller Japanese subtitle and functional description, and a circular "P" logo in the lower left corner. To the left of the counter is a transparent acrylic nameplate with Japanese text above and the prominent "Ai-chan" logo below. To the right of the counter, three hardcover books are stacked horizontally, each with a numbered label and a Japanese title on its spine. Against a softly blurred background, a tall wooden bookshelf stands on the left, displaying books, small potted plants, and a warm-toned lamp; a decorative painting with Japanese text hangs on the upper right wall; and a potted green plant sits on the far right. A small white "Pollo.ai" watermark is added to the upper right corner. The image uses warm ambient lighting, a shallow depth of field, and primarily beige and wood tones to depict realistic skin and fabric textures. The composition is simple, giving it the feel of a professional lifestyle advertisement. The composition is a portrait from mid-thigh to head, in a 3:4 ratio.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实风格的竖版宣传肖像，背景为温馨的现代图书馆或书店内部。画面中，一位年轻的东亚女性站在木质柜台后，正向镜头展示一本大书。她留着中分长直深棕色头发，佩戴精致的小耳环，外表整洁、亲切且专业。她身穿白色衬衫，系着柔和的绿色条纹领带，腰间系着米色围裙，围裙上缝有写着“Librarian Ai-chan”的姓名贴和一枚小巧的翻开书籍图标。她的左手将书竖直托在胸前，略微向观众倾斜，右手则在书下方摊开，呈现出经典的商品介绍姿势。书籍是画面的视觉焦点：深色光面封面上印有醒目的橙色标题“Pollo AI”（顶部一行大字，中心处有一行发光的字），下方配有较小的日语副标题和功能说明，左下角还有一个圆形的 P 字样 Logo。在柜台左侧放置一个透明亚克力桌牌，上方印有日语文字，下方印有醒目的“Ai-chan”字样。在柜台右侧，水平堆叠 3 本精装书，每本书的书脊上都有编号标签和日语标题。在柔和虚化的背景中，左侧设有一个高大的木质书架，摆放着书籍、小型盆栽和一盏暖色调台灯；右上角墙上挂着一张带有日语文字的装饰画；最右侧摆放着一盆绿叶植物。在右上角添加一个小的白色“Pollo.ai”水印。采用暖色调环境光，浅景深效果，以米色和木质色调为主，呈现真实的皮肤和织物纹理，构图简洁，具有专业生活方式广告的质感。画面构图为从大腿中部到头部的肖像，比例为 3:4。

templates.title: Anime Girl Under a Rainbow with an Umbrella

titleLocalized.zh: 撑伞彩虹下的动漫少女

templates.prompt: A stylish anime illustration depicts a young woman standing on a modern city street in the rain, shot from a high-contrast, low-angle perspective. She has {argument name="hair color" default="bright pink"} Her hair was tied in a messy low bun, with a few stray strands falling on either side of her face. She had fair skin and cool, slightly aloof light gray-green eyes. She wore a black baseball cap with elegant white handwriting on it {argument name="cap text" default="Butterflies"} She wore several small earrings and dangling gold star-shaped earrings. A thin stick, like a lollipop stick or candy stick, with a small star decoration at the end, was casually held in her mouth, her hand gently touching it. Her outfit was street-style chic, shimmering slightly in the rain: a black cropped vest, an oversized, semi-transparent white jacket slipping from her shoulders, one sleeve adorned with delicate gold patterns, layered silver necklaces, and a dark-colored wristwatch. In her right hand, she held a transparent umbrella, its surface reflecting the wet light and raindrops. To the right of the background was a massive, curved glass building, below which lay a blurred cityscape. After the rain, a bright blue sky revealed itself, and a vibrant rainbow arced across the upper right sky. The emphasis was on the shimmering, wet surfaces, the refracted light, the glistening raindrops, the reflective glass, and the slightly bright iridescent halo. Highly detailed comic-style lines, soft painterly shadows, bright highlights, cinematic composition, stylish urban atmosphere, and exquisite and luxurious texture.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张时尚的动漫插画，描绘了一位年轻女性站在雨中的现代城市街道上，采用极具张力的低角度视角。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="鲜艳粉色"} 的头发，扎着凌乱的低侧发髻，几缕碎发垂在脸颊两侧，皮肤白皙，有着清冷而略显疏离的浅灰绿色双眸。她戴着一顶黑色棒球帽，上面用优雅的白色手写体写着 {argument name="cap text" default="Butterflies"}，耳朵上有多个小耳环，并佩戴着垂坠的金色星形耳饰。她嘴里随意地衔着一根细棍，像棒棒糖棍或糖果棒，末端带有小星星装饰，一只手轻轻触碰着它。她的装扮是街头时尚风格，在雨中泛着微微的光泽：黑色短款背心，一件从肩头滑落的超大款半透明白色外套，其中一只袖子上带有精致的金色图案，叠戴的银色项链，以及一只深色腕表。她右手握着一把透明雨伞，伞面可见湿润的反光和雨滴。背景右侧是一座巨大的弧形玻璃建筑，下方是模糊的城市建筑，雨过天晴，明亮的蓝天显露出来，一道鲜艳的彩虹在右上方的天空中划出一道弧线。强调闪烁的湿润表面、折射的光线、晶莹的雨丝、反光的玻璃以及略显明亮的虹彩光晕。高细节的漫画风格线条，柔和的绘画式阴影，亮丽的高光，电影级的构图，时尚的都市氛围，精致而华丽的质感。

templates.title: Dark electronic music album cover

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑电子乐专辑封面

templates.prompt: The square-shaped, dark Japanese electronic pop album cover is cinematic and ethereal, set in a deserted city alley on a rainy night. The ground is wet and reflective, shrouded in deep blue-black shadows. At the center of the image is an elegant, ghostly woman facing a glowing vending machine. Drink cans are visible inside, and the machine emits a cold, blue-white light, with a tiny red indicator light on its right. She has extremely long, flowing silver-lavender hair, pale skin, and a mysteriously rendered face, sometimes hidden in shadow, sometimes appearing as a smooth, blurred void. She wears a semi-transparent, off-the-shoulder dress.{argument name="dress style" default="shimmering gray tulle dress"} The piece features delicate, shimmering textures, sheer, draped cuffs, and ornate crystal embellishments around the neck and chest. Her pose is solemn, almost prayerful, with one hand raised, a coin close to her lips, and the other gently clasped at her wrist. Two luminous red stigmata-like crosses are added to her wrist and the back of her hand, emitting a faint glow. The atmosphere is melancholic, mysterious, futuristic, sacred, and slightly gothic. It employs a high-contrast color palette accented with cool neon blue, silver, black, and deep red, complemented by elements of mist, drizzle, soft light, delicate film grain, and dramatic backlighting reminiscent of a vending machine. Ornate vintage borders are integrated into the four corners, and a thin border line is added around the cover. The artist's name is placed at the top center.{argument name="artist name" default="AYANO YUKIMURA"} It uses elegant serif capital letters, with a line of smaller Japanese text below:{argument name="artist name in Japanese" default="アヤノ ユキムラ"} Create a vertical black panel along the left side containing three text areas: the artist's name at the top, a long vertical white Japanese quote in the middle, and stacked genre text at the bottom.{argument name="genre text" default="JAPANESE DARK ELECTRO POP ALBUM"} Place the album title at the bottom center.{argument name="album title" default="VENDING MACHINE STIGMATA"} Featuring an oversized, glowing, crackled silver serif font spanning two lines, with subtle starlight shimmer and decorative patterns. Top-tier fantasy-realistic key visuals, ultra-refined, exquisite CD cover design.

promptLocalized.zh: 正方形日系暗黑电子流行乐专辑封面，电影感且空灵，背景设定在雨夜空旷的城市小巷，地面湿润且具有反射感，笼罩在深蓝黑色的阴影中。画面中心是一位优雅的幽灵般女性，她正对着一台发光的自动贩卖机，机内可见饮料罐，贩卖机散发出冰冷的蓝白色光芒，右侧亮着微小的红色指示灯。她拥有极长的飘逸银薰衣草色头发，皮肤苍白，面部处理神秘，或隐藏在阴影中，或呈现为平滑模糊的虚空。她身穿露肩半透明 {argument name="dress style" default="闪烁的灰色薄纱礼服"}，带有精致的闪光质感、透视垂坠袖口，颈部和胸前佩戴华丽的水晶饰品。她的姿势庄重如祈祷，一只手举起，硬币靠近嘴唇，另一只手轻轻握住手腕。在手腕和手背处各添加 2 个发光的红色圣痕状十字标记，散发出微弱的光芒。氛围忧郁、神秘、充满未来感、神圣且略带哥特风。采用冷霓虹蓝、银色、黑色和深红色点缀的高对比度调色板，辅以薄雾、细雨、柔光、细腻的胶片颗粒感以及来自自动贩卖机的戏剧性背光。在四个角落集成华丽的复古边框装饰，并在封面周围添加细边框线。在顶部中心，放置艺术家名称 {argument name="artist name" default="AYANO YUKIMURA"}，使用优雅的衬线大写字母，下方配有一行较小的日语：{argument name="artist name in Japanese" default="アヤノ ユキムラ"}。沿左侧创建一个垂直黑色面板，包含 3 个文本区域：顶部为艺术家名称，中间为长条垂直的白色日语引文，底部为堆叠的流派文本 {argument name="genre text" default="JAPANESE DARK ELECTRO POP ALBUM"}。在底部中心，放置专辑标题 {argument name="album title" default="VENDING MACHINE STIGMATA"}，采用超大发光的裂纹银色衬线字体，跨越 2 行，并带有细微的星光闪烁和装饰性花纹。顶级奇幻写实关键视觉图，超精细，精致的 CD 封套设计。

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高角度俯视的全身动漫风格 3D 虚拟偶像少女渲染图，背景为简洁的浅灰色摄影棚，右下方带有柔和的投影。她留着及腰的长直发，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="蓝绿色"}，配有齐刘海、头上饰有 2 个巨大的黑色蝴蝶结，一侧还别着一朵极具视觉冲击力的红色彼岸花风格发饰。她面容可爱年轻，呈现出时尚的另类偶像辣妹哥特风（alt-idol gyaru-goth），一只手抬起在脸旁比出剪刀手，另一只手自然垂在身侧。服装：一件超大款粉色上衣，每侧袖子上有 2 条黑色横纹，胸前印有做旧的黑色图案，外搭一件带有金属铆钉的黑色绑带吊带裙；下身穿着粉色格纹百褶短裙，裙边有磨损设计；腰间系着 2 条带有银色圆环和链条装饰的黑色腰带；胯部挂着 1 个毛绒钥匙扣小包；颈部佩戴 1 个黑色颈圈和多层叠戴的银色项链。腿部：穿着 2 只配套的粉黑条纹宽松腿套或过膝袜，大腿上可见 1 条黑色吊带。鞋履：2 只带有金属配件的黑色厚底鞋。整体风格为日系地雷系（jirai kei）、朋克和哥特街头风，采用粉黑配色，材质光泽感强，金属配饰丰富，服装纹理细节高度还原。角色渲染干净，光影清晰，细节丰富，比例风格化，具备精致的游戏头像品质，构图居中。

templates.title: Japanese-style premium curry advertisement layout

She wears a retro-futuristic bodysuit with a glossy finish: a silver and black bodysuit, heavy red shoulder armor, red forearm guards, a red belt with a large round pouch, red knee-high armor boots, and white gloves. Her hair color is {argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown"} The hair, medium-length and slightly messy, is loosely tied back, with a few strands falling beside the face. The character's face is deliberately obscured by a soft, rectangular blur effect. The background is an open, quiet station or parking lot-style corridor with smooth stone walls and floors, creating a shallow depth of field effect. A white number is visible in the background on the right.{argument name="background number" default="5"} The blue square logo. Natural, soft sunlight, realistic reflections on the glossy armor, cinematic cosplay photography, centered vertical composition, full-body shots, natural poses, and high detail.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张全身写实风格的女性特摄风太空女英雄肖像，她站在现代混凝土走廊中，轻轻倚靠在浅灰色立柱旁。她身穿复古未来主义盔甲紧身衣，材质具有光泽感：银黑相间的紧身连体衣、厚重的红色肩甲、红色前臂护甲、带有大号圆形腰包的红色腰带、红色及膝装甲靴以及白色手套。胸甲为金属银色，配有红色饰边，右胸处有一个圆形蓝色球体，带有小型通风口细节，颈部配有机械项圈，连接着两条垂在肩上的短灰色线缆。她左手在大腿高度拿着一个配色为红、白、蓝、黑的配套全罩式头盔。她的发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"}，中等长度，略显凌乱，松散地扎在脑后，几缕发丝垂在脸颊旁。角色的面部被柔和的矩形模糊效果刻意遮挡。背景是一个开阔、安静的车站或停车场式走廊，墙壁和地面为光滑的石材，具有浅景深效果，右侧背景中可见一个带有白色数字 {argument name="background number" default="5"} 的蓝色方形标志。自然柔和的日光，光泽盔甲上的逼真反射，电影级 Cosplay 摄影，居中垂直构图，全身入镜，姿态自然，高细节。

templates.title: Retro Sci-Fi Heroine and Police

titleLocalized.zh: 复古科幻女英雄与警察

templates.prompt: A realistic, live-action photograph features a young Japanese woman standing outdoors in worn, retro-futuristic, tokusatsu-style powered armor. Two female police officers in dark navy blue uniforms flank her. The armored woman is positioned in the center of the frame, shot in a mid-range composition from her thighs to her head, facing forward. The two officers are positioned on the left and right edges of the frame, in profile, turning towards her as if questioning or surrounding her. The woman wears bright red and silver metallic armor with noticeable scratches, paint chips, and slight dirt. It includes oversized round shoulder armor, a silver breastplate (with asymmetrical lines and a large blue sphere on the right), black flexible-lined sleeves, a white neck seal, and two short, ribbed tubes extending from her collar to her shoulders. She has a short, dark brown to black bob haircut peeking out from above the armor, holding a matching red helmet with a black visor and silver trim at her waist. The two female police officers wear plain dark navy blue jackets; the epaulettes of the officer on the left are clearly visible, and both have neat black low buns. The scene is set against a backdrop of gray urban concrete walls, with soft lighting and a shallow depth of field, creating a low-key, documentary-like quality. The composition should have a sense of candidness and tension, like behind-the-scenes footage of a sci-fi heroine being arrested or examined. The details are rich in texture, the skin is natural, the metallic reflections are realistic, the color tone is soft, and the composition is vertical.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张逼真的真人实拍风格照片，主角是一位年轻的日本女性，身穿磨损的复古未来主义特摄风格动力盔甲，站在户外，两侧各有一名身穿深海军蓝制服的女警察。身穿盔甲的女性位于画面中央，采用从大腿到头部的中景构图，面向前方；两名警察分别位于画面左右边缘，呈侧面姿态，正转向她，仿佛在进行盘问或包围。主角身穿带有明显划痕、掉漆和轻微污垢的亮红色与银色金属盔甲，包括超大号圆形肩甲、银色胸甲（胸甲上有不对称的线条和右侧 1 个巨大的蓝色圆形球体）、黑色柔性内衬袖子、白色颈封，以及 2 根从领口延伸至肩部的短肋状软管。她留着深棕色至黑色的短波波头，从盔甲上方露出，双手在腰间拿着 1 个配套的红色头盔，头盔配有黑色面罩和银色饰边。两名女警察身穿朴素的深海军蓝夹克；左侧警察的肩章清晰可见，两人均梳着整洁的黑色低发髻。场景设定在灰色城市混凝土墙前，光线柔和，景深较浅，呈现出一种低调的纪录片电影质感。构图应具有抓拍感和紧张感，如同科幻女英雄被捕或接受检查的幕后花絮。细节纹理丰富，皮肤自然，金属反射逼真，色调柔和，竖屏构图。
