templates.title: Retro tokusatsu armor snapshot portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 复古特摄装甲抓拍肖像

templates.prompt: A realistic portrait photograph of a young Japanese woman dressed in retro sci-fi special effects armor. The composition is a half-body shot (from mid-torso to above the head) against a blurred industrial concrete scene in the background. She keeps {argument name="hair color" default="black"} Her short, wet bob hair was messily tucked behind her ears, and most of her face was obscured by a large, rectangular, blurred visor in the center. She held a clear, crumpled plastic water bottle to her lips as if drinking. Her costume was a worn, retro superhero suit, comprising four distinct armor components: two shiny red shoulder armors, a scratched and grimy red and silver breastplate, and a round blue sphere embedded in the right side of her chest. Underneath the armor was a shiny black bodysuit with a white turtleneck and delicate gold rings at the collar. Two short, threaded metal tubes around the collar connected to two small, rectangular metal modules near the shoulders. The armor appeared practical, worn, slightly stained, and heavy, resembling an old-fashioned Japanese tokusatsu hero costume rather than modern, streamlined armor. Natural overcast lighting, shallow depth of field, soft gray concrete background, documentary cosplay photography style, capturing a fleeting moment, high-detail textures, realistic skin and fabric textures, vertical composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实真人风格的肖像照片，拍摄对象为一名身着复古科幻特摄装甲的年轻日本女性，构图为半身像（从躯干中部到头部上方），背景为虚化的工业混凝土场景。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="black"} 的湿发短波波头，凌乱地别在耳后，面部大部分被一个位于正中央的大型矩形模糊遮挡块遮住。她的一只手拿着一个透明的褶皱塑料水瓶，举至嘴边仿佛正在喝水。服装是一套磨损的复古英雄战衣，包含 4 个明显的装甲组件：2 个亮面红色肩甲、1 个带有划痕和污垢的红银配色胸甲，以及胸部右侧嵌入的 1 个圆形蓝色球体。装甲内搭为闪亮的黑色紧身衣，配有白色高领内衬，领口处有细金环装饰。领口周围有 2 根短小的罗纹金属软管，连接至肩部附近的 2 个小型矩形金属模块。装甲应呈现出实用、磨损、略带污渍且厚重的质感，看起来更像老式日本特摄英雄戏服，而非现代流线型装甲。自然阴天光线，浅景深，背景为柔和的灰色混凝土色调，纪实 Cosplay 摄影风格，抓拍瞬间，高细节纹理，写实的皮肤与织物质感，竖构图。

templates.title: Retro sci-fi armor back view

titleLocalized.zh: 复古科幻盔甲背面视角

templates.prompt: A cinematic sci-fi portrait, presented from behind, against the backdrop of a sterile futuristic laboratory corridor. The composition is a medium-close-up, focusing on the thighs to the head, with the subject slightly turned to the right, gazing towards an open vertical bay in the background. The subject has short, wet, and slightly disheveled black hair and wears a retro-futuristic suit of armor: glossy, worn red shoulder and upper body armor, a brushed silver metal backplate with rounded panel lines, two flexible metal ribs extending from the upper back to circular joints, black glossy lining on the arms and sides, a thick white neck seal, and delicate gold trim at the wrists on the red waist area. The armor should have a functional and used look, with minor scratches, abrasions, and realistic reflections. A rectangular privacy veil covers the visible side of the face, positioned at the center of the head's silhouette. In the background, slightly out of focus, a futuristic, upright capsule or medical static pod embedded in the wall is displayed. The interior is dimly lit, with cool blue vertical decorative lights and bright white ceiling lights. A small control panel is mounted on the right side of the pod. The environment is clean and industrial, with light gray walls, smooth floors, soft, diffused lighting with a shallow depth of field, realistic textures, and lifelike metallic materials. The cool interior tones contrast with the deep red armor, creating a rich and serious atmosphere, presenting an aesthetic style reminiscent of a live-action science fiction film.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影级的科幻肖像，展示了一个人从背面观察的视角，背景为无菌的未来实验室走廊。画面采用从中大腿到头部的中近景构图，主体略微向右转，望向背景中一个打开的垂直舱室。主体留着黑色短发，发丝湿润且层次凌乱，身穿一套复古未来主义盔甲：光泽感十足且带有磨损痕迹的红色肩甲和上身盔甲，带有圆润面板线条的拉丝银色金属背板，两条从上背部延伸至圆形接口的柔性金属肋管，手臂和侧面为黑色亮面内衬，配有白色加厚颈封，红色腰部区域在手腕处有精致的金色饰边。盔甲应呈现出实用且经过使用的质感，带有轻微的擦痕、划痕和逼真的反光。在侧脸可见区域覆盖一个矩形隐私模糊遮罩，位置居于头部侧影中心。背景中，在略微失焦处，展示 1 个嵌入墙壁的未来主义立式胶囊或医疗静止舱，内部昏暗，配有冷蓝色垂直装饰灯和明亮的白色顶灯，舱室右侧安装有一个小型控制面板。环境整洁且具有工业感，墙壁呈浅灰色，地面平滑，光线柔和漫射，具有浅景深效果，纹理写实，金属材质逼真，室内冷色调与深红色盔甲形成对比，细节丰富，氛围严肃，呈现出真人科幻电影的美学风格。

promptLocalized.zh: {"type":"编辑人像拼图","subject":{"gender_presentation":"年轻女性","hair":{"color":"深棕色","style":"短直波波头，下巴长度，侧分"},"wardrobe":{"main_garment":"浅色传统和服，带有大面积几何灰色块和细腻纹理","obi":"深李色或深棕色腰带，后背系成蝴蝶结"},"pose_and_mood":"平静、沉思、优雅、柔和的抓拍感"},"scene":{"location":"盛开的户外樱花林","season":"春季","lighting":"强烈的黄金时段逆光，带有梦幻雾气、发光高光、柔和过曝和太阳耀斑","color_palette":"淡粉色、奶油色、腮红粉、暖白色、柔灰色、柔和的李子色","depth_of_field":"极浅景深，前景和背景有浓郁的樱花虚化效果"},"layout":{"grid":{"rows":2,"columns":3,"count":6},"images":[{"position":"左上","description":"紧凑的侧面特写，面朝左侧，上半身构图，前景和背景充满樱花"},{"position":"中上","description":"侧面特写，面朝右侧，一只手轻触唇边，樱花间透出柔和逆光"},{"position":"右上","description":"四分之三全身侧面视角，站在樱花树下，和服与腰带清晰可见，阳光从右上角射入"},{"position":"左下","description":"近景人像，部分被前景失焦的樱花遮挡，主体转向左侧"},{"position":"中下","description":"中景背部四分之三姿势，头部微向左转，腰带蝴蝶结居中，背景为茂密樱花"},{"position":"右下","description":"背部四分之三视角人像，仰望明亮阳光，强烈的镜头耀斑和发光的轮廓光"}]},"style":{"photography":"浪漫日系春日人像摄影","finish":"高调、轻盈、粉彩色、电影感、柔和漫射","composition":"亲密的抓拍编辑风格，每一格画面均有花卉构图"},"prompt":"创作一张 6 格编辑人像拼图，主体为一名 {argument name=\"subject\" default=\"年轻女性\"}，身着 {argument name=\"kimono pattern\" default=\"带有大面积几何灰色块的浅色传统和服\"} 和 {argument name=\"obi color\" default=\"深李色\"} 腰带，在盛开的 {argument name=\"blossom type\" default=\"樱花\"} 下拍摄。使用 {argument name=\"lighting style\" default=\"带有梦幻雾气和镜头耀斑的黄金时段逆光\"}。发型为深棕色短波波头。生成一个 2x3 的网格，包含 6 张不同的人像：1 张面朝左侧的侧面特写，1 张面朝右侧且手指轻触唇边的侧面特写，1 张四分之三全身侧面视角，1 张被前景樱花遮挡的近景人像，1 张展示腰带蝴蝶结的中景背部四分之三姿势，以及 1 张仰望太阳的背部四分之三视角人像。强调浅景深、浓郁的花卉虚化、淡粉色和奶油色调、轻盈的高调曝光、柔和的电影感漫射，呈现浪漫的日系人像摄影风格。"}

templates.title: Elegant Ghost Warrior Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 优雅鬼族女战士肖像

templates.prompt: A beautifully crafted anime illustration depicts a tall, adult female demon, presenting a calm and elegant full-body portrait. She stands in three-quarter profile, her hands clasped on the hilt of an upright longsword. She possesses extremely long, straight hair.{argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} Her hair fell past her knees; her skin was pale, with elfin-like pointed ears, narrow, deep red eyes, and two smooth, curved red horns on her forehead. Her expression was cold, aloof, and slightly melancholic. She was dressed in {argument name="outfit style" default="White formal kimono with black and red accents"} The inner layer is a fitted white dress with a deep neckline, cinched with a black belt and layered waist embellishments. Over this is a semi-transparent patterned robe with subtle geometric designs; the wide sleeves are lined in red, and the hem is decorated with smoky, dark flame patterns. Her forearms are covered in polished silver armor, adding to her warrior aura. The massive, heavy sword is planted vertically before her, its blade and hilt black, fitted with a metal guard, and a vibrant, luminous red flame pattern flowing from the center of the blade. The composition is elegant and balanced, blending traditional Japanese aesthetics with a dark fantasy style. The background is a soft, pale lavender-grey decorative collage, featuring a circular window framing a landscape of Mount Fuji and a winding river, delicate floral silhouettes and blooming branches, abstract cloud patterns, hanging tassels, geometric fabric patterns, and a red sun halo on the right. The main color scheme uses soft white, lilac, grey-purple, black, and deep red. It incorporates subtle paper textures, clean lines, soft cel shadows, delicate highlights, and a gorgeous, highly detailed anime style. The overall atmosphere is tranquil, noble, mysterious, and slightly ominous, like {argument name="character name" default="Oni Alter"} The image is featured in a luxurious Japanese fantasy key visual.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的动漫插画，描绘了一位高挑的成年鬼族女性，呈现出冷静、优雅的全身肖像。她以四分之三侧面站立，双手交叠在竖立的长剑剑柄上。她拥有极长的直发，{argument name="hair color" default="银白色"} 的发丝垂过膝盖；皮肤苍白，有着精灵般的尖耳、狭长的深红色双眼，额头上长着两只光滑弯曲的红色犄角。她的表情冷峻、疏离且略带忧郁。她身着 {argument name="outfit style" default="带有黑红点缀的白色礼仪和服"}：内层为修身的白色连衣裙式设计，领口深邃；配有黑色腰带和层叠的腰部装饰；外罩一件半透明的图案长袍，带有微妙的几何纹样；宽大的袖口内衬为红色，裙摆边缘装饰着烟熏状的暗色火焰图案。她的前臂覆盖着抛光的银色护甲，增添了战士的气息。那柄巨剑沉重且巨大，垂直插在她的身前，剑身和剑柄呈黑色，配有金属护手，剑刃中央流淌着鲜艳发光的红色火焰纹路。构图优雅且平衡，融合了日本传统美学与暗黑奇幻风格。背景为柔和的淡薰衣草灰装饰拼贴画，包含一个框住富士山与蜿蜒河流景观的圆形窗户、精致的花卉剪影与盛开的枝条、抽象的云纹、悬挂的流苏装饰、几何织物图案，以及右侧一个红色的太阳圆环。主色调采用柔和的白色、丁香紫、灰紫色、黑色和深红色。加入微妙的纸张纹理、干净的线条、柔和的赛璐珞阴影、细腻的高光以及华丽的高细节动漫风格。整体氛围宁静、高贵、神秘且略带不祥之感，宛如 {argument name="character name" default="Oni Alter"} 在奢华的日式奇幻关键视觉图中的形象。

templates.title: Retro-style fictional anime movie poster

titleLocalized.zh: 复古风虚构动漫电影海报

templates.prompt: A retro-style Japanese fictional anime movie poster, inspired by the exaggerated theatrical posters of the 1980s and 1990s, possesses a deliberately charming, cheap pulp art texture. The scene is set in a dimly lit Japanese wooden house at night. A young female manga artist sits on the floor, next to a low table piled with manuscript paper, pens, ink, books, and drawing tools. Her messy, dark, shoulder-length hair is blown about by supernatural forces. She wears a cream-beige long-sleeved shirt with loose ruffles at the cuffs, paired with a dark plaid skirt. Her face is obscured by a soft, rectangular blur effect. One of her arms is outstretched, holding a glowing {argument name="device type" default="smartphones"} Pointing towards the shattered window, dazzling light and lightning erupt from the broken glass, illuminating the entire room with golden-white energy. Outside, the deep blue night sky is streaked with storm-like stripes and crackling lightning. The composition features a dynamic diagonal layout, with the raised arm and equipment pointing towards the central explosion point. Employing a hand-drawn anime style, the visual emphasizes dramatic rim lighting and movie poster-like shadows, using rich shades of cyan, navy, amber, and deep red to create a nostalgic, hand-drawn movie poster atmosphere. The left side of the poster is filled with prominent Japanese promotional text in multiple sections, including exaggerated red and yellow accent symbols and three classic cartoon boy expressions. A vertical Japanese slogan is added to the right. A large Japanese title spans the lower part of the image, using a red-blue metallic gradient font with sharp highlights and heavy shadows; the text content is {argument name="title text" default="The Girl Who Can Draw Time"} A cream-colored starburst badge is placed in the bottom right corner, containing more Japanese text and a small cartoon avatar. A large Japanese release date panel is added to the bottom left corner, using bright yellow numbers and white text, defaulting to {argument name="release date" default="July 18, 2025 (Kinshasa)"} Add six small rectangular film preview images from the film to the bottom edge. Add a small credits in Japanese and English to the bottom center, including {argument name="studio name" default="Building Fictions"} The overall layout presents the style of a fictional time-travel comedy anime poster set in 1935—noisy, nostalgic, cinematic, and with a touch of cheesiness in the best way possible.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张复古风格的日本虚构动漫电影海报，设计灵感源自 1980 年代至 1990 年代夸张的院线海报，带有刻意为之却又充满魅力的廉价纸浆艺术质感。场景设定在夜晚一间昏暗的日式木屋内，一位少女漫画家坐在地板上，身旁是摆满手稿纸、钢笔、墨水、书籍和绘画工具的矮桌。她凌乱的深色齐肩短发被超自然力量吹起，身穿奶油米色长袖衬衫，袖口有宽松的荷叶边，下搭深色格子裙。她的面部被一层柔和的矩形模糊效果遮盖。她的一只手臂向上伸展，将一个发光的 {argument name="device type" default="智能手机"} 举向破碎的窗户，耀眼的光芒和闪电从玻璃破裂处喷涌而出，以金白色的能量照亮了整个房间。窗外是深蓝色的夜空，伴随着风暴般的条纹和电光裂痕。构图呈动态的对角线布局，抬起的手臂和设备指向中央的爆炸点。采用手绘动漫主视觉风格，强调戏剧性的轮廓光、具有电影海报质感的阴影，运用丰富的青色、海军蓝、琥珀色和深红色，营造出怀旧的手绘电影海报氛围。海报左侧填充多个板块的醒目日文宣传文案，包括夸张的红黄色强调符号以及三个经典的漫画男孩卡通表情。右侧添加垂直的日文标语。在画面中下部横跨巨大的日文标题，采用红蓝金属渐变字体，带有锐利的高光和厚重的阴影，文字内容为 {argument name="title text" default="トキヲ描ける少女"}。右下角放置一个奶油色的星爆徽章，内含更多日文文本和一个小漫画头像。左下角添加一个巨大的日文上映日期板块，使用亮黄色数字和白色文本，默认为 {argument name="release date" default="2025年 7月18日(金)"}。底部边缘添加 6 个来自电影的小型矩形胶片预览图。底部中央添加日文和英文的小型制作人员名单，包括 {argument name="studio name" default="Building Fictions"}。整体布局呈现出一种设定在 1935 年的虚构时空穿越喜剧动漫海报风格，喧闹、怀旧、富有电影感，并以最棒的方式带有一丝俗气。

templates.title: Rainbow Rabbit DJ Anime Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 彩虹兔 DJ 动漫肖像

templates.prompt: A vibrant, anime-style DJ girl is positioned in a cute and dreamy rave aesthetic scene. The shot is a close-up of her upper body, behind a professional DJ console. She wears oversized rainbow bunny ear headbands and large rainbow headphones, one hand resting on the right earcup, the other touching the left turntable, as if preparing for the next track. The slightly upward angle creates a dynamic and emotional performance atmosphere. She is styled with a short, straight bob with bangs, and her hair color is {argument name="hair color" default="Light gold with rainbow-colored ends"} Her facial expression should convey a playful DJ vibe: one eye winks, a mischievous smile playing on her lips, as if she's about to ignite the crowd. She wears a white hoodie with rainbow stripes on the cuffs and a small red heart patch on the chest and sleeves. The DJ setup should include two turntables, one center mixer, four vertical channel faders, three rows of equalizer knobs, and two small displays with illuminated waveforms. The background is filled with a soft gradient from pale purple to pink, adorned with tiny glitters, floating soft hearts, and six colorful musical note icons surrounding the character. The rendering employs a refined, bright, and highly detailed anime illustration style, combined with glowing rainbow effects, soft shadows, clean lines, and saturated colors, to showcase the adorable energy of an idol colliding with a nightclub, and a highly infectious, magical "emo" atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一位充满活力的动漫风格 DJ 女孩，身处可爱梦幻的锐舞美学场景中，画面为半身特写，位于专业 DJ 控制台后方。她戴着超大号彩虹兔耳发箍和大型彩虹头戴式耳机，一只手按在右侧耳机罩上，另一只手触碰左侧唱盘，仿佛正在准备下一首曲目。采用略微仰视的视角，营造出充满活力和情感的表演氛围。为她设计一款短直波波头，配上齐刘海，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="带有彩虹发梢的浅金色"}。她的面部表情应展现出俏皮的 DJ 神态：一只眼睛眨眼，嘴角露出调皮的笑容，仿佛正准备引爆全场。她身穿一件白色连帽衫，袖口带有彩虹条纹，胸前和袖子上各有一个红色小爱心补丁。DJ 设备应包含 2 个唱盘、1 个中央混音台、4 个垂直通道推子、3 排均衡器旋钮以及 2 个带有发光波形图的小显示屏。背景填充柔和的淡紫色到粉色的渐变，点缀着微小的闪光、漂浮的柔和爱心，以及 6 个围绕在角色周围的彩色音符图标。采用精致、光亮、高细节的动漫插画风格渲染，配合发光的彩虹灯效、柔和的阴影、干净的线条、饱和的色彩，展现出偶像与夜店碰撞的可爱能量，以及一种极具感染力的魔法“emo”氛围。

templates.title: Rainbow Bunny Girl DJ Anime Avatar

titleLocalized.zh: 彩虹兔女郎 DJ 动漫头像

templates.prompt: A vibrant, anime-style close-up depicts a cute DJ girl in a dreamlike rave scene, taken from a slightly upward angle, as if the audience were standing in front of the DJ booth. She has a bob haircut and her hair color is {argument name="hair color" default="Gold with rainbow ends"} She has fluffy bangs and towering bunny ears, with a rainbow gradient on the inside of her left ear. Most of her face is obscured by a soft, beige-pink rectangular visor, but her pose suggests a playful wink and a mischievous smile. She wears oversized heart-shaped sunglasses with red and blue frames and glossy purple lenses. One hand is pressing a large rainbow-colored headphone cover to her ear, while the other arm extends across the DJ console towards the audience, creating a dynamic atmosphere as if the next track is about to start. She wears an oversized white hoodie with a large green butterfly logo on the chest and four heart-shaped patches sewn onto the sleeves and shoulders: one orange, one purple, one blue, and one red. The foreground shows a partially illuminated DJ mixer with brightly colored neon controls, knobs, and a glowing pink heart icon. The background is a dreamy and dazzling club fantasy world, filled with glowing stars, hearts, shimmering blur effects, soft beams of light, and gentle rainbow highlights, creating an atmosphere that is both "emo" and cute. Employing a highly refined anime illustration style, it utilizes glossy lighting, soft lighting effects, iridescent reflections, and saturated rainbow hues to present a cute and vibrant idol DJ aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满活力的动漫风格特写，描绘了一位可爱的 DJ 女孩置身于梦幻般的锐舞场景中，采用略微仰视的视角，仿佛观众正站在 DJ 台前。她留着波波头，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="金色配彩虹发尾"}，有着蓬松的刘海和高耸的兔耳朵，左耳内侧呈现彩虹渐变色。她的脸部大部分被中间一个柔和米粉色的矩形遮挡块遮住，但姿势应暗示出俏皮的眨眼和顽皮的笑容。她头顶戴着一副超大心形太阳镜，镜框一红一蓝，镜片带有光泽的紫色调。一只手正将一个巨大的彩虹色耳机罩按在耳边，另一只手臂越过 DJ 控制台向观众伸出，营造出一种仿佛即将播放下一首曲目的动感表演氛围。她穿着一件超大号白色连帽衫，胸前有一个巨大的绿色蝴蝶标志，袖子和肩部区域缝有 4 个心形补丁：1 个橙色、1 个紫色、1 个蓝色和 1 个红色。前景展示了部分发光的 DJ 混音台，配有色彩鲜艳的霓虹灯控制键、旋钮和一个发光的粉色心形图标。背景是一个梦幻且极具闪耀感的俱乐部幻想世界，充满了发光的星星、爱心、闪光虚化效果、柔和的光束和柔和的彩虹高光，营造出一种既“emo”又可爱的氛围。采用高度精致的动漫插画风格，运用光泽照明、柔光效果、虹彩反射、饱和的彩虹色调，呈现出可爱且充满活力的偶像 DJ 美学。

templates.title: The cover of the manga featuring a bass-playing girl and a designer boy

titleLocalized.zh: 贝斯少女与设计师少年的漫画封面

templates.prompt: A vibrant Japanese manga-style cover illustration features two anime characters standing side-by-side against a background of pink and blue pop art graphics, adorned with stars, dots, musical notes, hearts, shimmering lines, and playful doodles. At the top is a large, bold Japanese title in thick, dark brown kanji with white outlines and pink shading: "Yasaka-san to Chafuji-kun," arranged in a vibrant, layered composition within a fluffy, cloud-shaped title frame. The left half of the background is pink, while the right half is light blue, creating a rhythmic diagonal division and incorporating decorative manga cover elements. The image must showcase both characters, framed from mid-thigh up. On the left is a rebellious girl with straight black bob haircut and bangs, fair skin, dressed in punk rock style clothing, her posture slightly agitated and reserved, one hand near her mouth. She wore an oversized black zip-up hoodie over a red and black striped shirt, a red plaid pleated skirt, fishnet stockings, and a black heart-shaped choker. She held a black electric bass, the headstock, strings, pickups, and chrome hardware clearly visible. To her right was a cheerful young man with messy light brown short hair, fair skin, and a friendly, lively expression. He wore a white shirt with the sleeves rolled up to his elbows, a black fitted vest with a small badge on the chest, and black trousers. He held a stylus close to his face in one hand and a dark drawing tablet tucked under his other arm. Add two vertical Japanese speech bubbles: the left bubble has a pink outline and reads "うるさいのはキライ."; the right bubble has a blue outline and reads "そのセンスもっとみんなに届けたいです…". Small floating icons are added between and around the characters: two black musical notes, two pink hearts, two blue stars, and some curved arrows and glittering symbols to create a vibrant chemistry. The overall style is sophisticated modern comic book cover art with clean lines, glossy shadows, expressive character designs, bright and soft pop colors, and rich details, reminiscent of commercial light novel or comic book covers.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满活力的日式漫画风格封面插图，两位动漫角色并肩站立，背景为粉蓝双色拼接的波普图形，点缀着星星、圆点、音符、爱心、闪光线条和趣味涂鸦。顶部放置一个巨大的粗体日文标题，采用厚实的黑棕色汉字，配有白色描边和粉色阴影，文字为“夜坂さんと茶藤くん”，以充满活力的分层构图排列在蓬松的云朵状标题框内。背景左半部分为粉色，右半部分为浅蓝色，呈现对角线分割的节奏感，并带有装饰性的漫画封面元素。画面需展示 2 位角色，从大腿中部以上构图。左侧是一位叛逆的少女，留着黑色直发波波头和齐刘海，皮肤白皙，身着朋克摇滚风格服装，姿态略显烦躁内敛，一只手靠近嘴边。她穿着超大号黑色拉链连帽衫，内搭红黑横条纹衬衫，下穿红色格子百褶裙、渔网袜，颈戴黑色心形项圈。她怀抱一把黑色电贝斯，琴头、琴弦、拾音器和镀铬硬件清晰可见。右侧是一位开朗的少年，留着凌乱的浅棕色短发，皮肤白皙，表情友好生动。他穿着白色衬衫，袖子卷至肘部，外搭一件胸前带有小徽章的黑色修身马甲，下穿黑色长裤。他一手拿着触控笔靠近脸部，另一只手臂夹着一块深色绘图板。添加 2 个垂直的日文对话气泡：左侧气泡为粉色描边，写着“うるさいのはキライ。”；右侧气泡为蓝色描边，写着“そのセンスもっとみんなに届けたいです…”。在角色之间及周围添加小型浮动图标：2 个黑色音符、2 个粉色爱心、2 个蓝色星星，以及一些弯曲的箭头和闪光符号，以展现生动的化学反应。整体风格为精致的现代漫画封面艺术，线条干净，光泽感阴影，角色设计富有表现力，采用明亮的柔和波普色调，细节丰富，具有商业轻小说或漫画连载封面的美感。

templates.title: A shy anime girl sitting on a small stool

titleLocalized.zh: 坐在小凳子上害羞的动漫少女

templates.prompt: This is a soft, pastel-style anime illustration in a cute VTuber fan art style. The image depicts a shy, petite girl with short, light brown twin tails, fluffy bangs, a single ahoge (a cowlick), and small hair accessories including a heart-shaped hair clip. She has warm, large brown eyes, an extremely shy expression, flushed cheeks, and teardrop-shaped beads of sweat; her small mouth trembles slightly. She is sitting awkwardly on a small wooden stool, knees together, hands clenched tightly on her knees, clearly very uncomfortable with her posture. She wears an oversized cream-colored hoodie, a dark skirt, black socks, and black low-top sneakers with white laces. An arm with a dark blue sleeve extends from the left edge of the image, pointing at her with a teasing or accusatory tone. Comic-style stress symbols are added around the girl: a red, graffiti-like cloud of frustration above her head, two wavy, trembling marks near her body, and six blue sweat droplets floating around her. The bottom right corner features a white speech bubble containing the Japanese text "あうぅ…！姿态…悪い？" (Aww…! Is my…sitting posture really that bad?). The background is a softly lit pastel room. On the left is a cream-colored beanbag chair, and the bookshelves are filled with books, figurines, plush toys, and picture frames. On the right is a desk with a monitor, a PC, and a microphone stand. Behind the desk are wall art and character sketches. A pink blanket is draped over the furniture on the far right, and a light-colored rug covers the wooden floor. The room is warmly lit. The overall color scheme is soft pink and beige, with clean lines and delicate cel shadows. The characters are slightly chibi-style, creating a warm and slightly comical atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张柔和粉彩风格的动漫插画，采用可爱的 VTuber 同人画风。画面中是一位害羞的娇小少女，留着浅棕色短双马尾，有蓬松的刘海、一根呆毛以及包括心形发夹在内的小发饰。她有着温暖的大棕色眼睛，表情极度害羞，脸颊泛红，带着泪滴状的汗珠，小嘴微微颤抖。她正局促地蜷缩坐在一张小木凳上，膝盖并拢，双手紧张地攥在膝头，显然对自己的坐姿感到非常不自在。她穿着一件超大号的奶油色连帽衫、深色短裙、黑色袜子和系着白色鞋带的黑色低帮运动鞋。画面左侧边缘伸入一只穿着深蓝色袖子的手臂，正指着她进行调侃或指责。在少女周围添加漫画风格的压力符号：头顶上方有一个红色的涂鸦式沮丧云团，身体附近有 2 个波浪状的颤抖标记，周围漂浮着 6 个蓝色汗滴。右下角包含一个白色对话气泡，其中的日文文字写着“あうぅ…！姿勢…悪い？”（呜呜……！我的……坐姿很差吗？）。背景是一个光线柔和的粉彩房间，左侧放着一个奶油色懒人沙发，书架上摆满了书籍、小手办、毛绒玩具和相框；右侧是一张书桌，上面有 1 台显示器、1 台 PC 主机和 1 个麦克风支架。书桌后方装饰着墙面艺术和角色草图，最右侧的家具上披着粉色毯子，木地板上铺着浅色地毯，室内灯光温暖。整体采用柔和的粉米色调，线条干净，带有细腻的赛璐珞阴影，角色比例略带 Q 版感，营造出一种温馨而又充满喜剧感的害羞氛围。

templates.title: Japanese-style SaaS nighttime advertising banner

titleLocalized.zh: 日式 SaaS 夜间广告横幅

templates.prompt: A sophisticated square Japanese-style digital banner ad for an AI e-commerce optimization tool. The image is divided into two main visual areas by a striking blue diagonal line extending from the top center to the lower left. The left third showcases a realistic nighttime home office scene: a tired young woman sits at a desk, her face blurred, resting her chin on her hand as she gazes at an open laptop. A warm desk lamp illuminates her and the desktop, a mug sits in the foreground, and scattered documents, bookshelves, and a clock on the wall are softly blurred against the dark background, creating an atmosphere of working late into the night. The right two-thirds features a dark blue gradient promotional panel with subtle financial growth graphics in the background: near the upper right corner is an upward line chart with an arrow and four light blue transparent bar charts. The panel is filled with a striking, oversized white Japanese title with a strong shadow, arranged in four rows:{argument name="headline text" default="You can now automate changing thumbnails late at night."} Add a white subheading below.{argument name="subheadline text" default="Rakuten-specific A/B testing automation tool"} The chart is accompanied by a thin cyan underline. Below it is a horizontal flow bar containing three white, rounded-corner cards connected by two cyan arrows pointing to the right. Card 1 shows two side-by-side thumbnails of handbags, labeled "Samune A" and "Samune B," with blue and gray percentage badges in the middle ("64.3%" and "35.7%" respectively), and marked "VS." Card 2 shows a thumbnail of a selected black handbag, with a small gold crown icon above it, a gray checkmark on the right, a cyan checkmark badge, and a small Japanese title indicating automatic optimization above. Card 3 shows a simple analytical chart with axes, including several blue bars, a pink upward trend line, and Japanese labels about sales and CTR trends, with a pink result number "+47.2%" in the lower right corner. Add a bright pink, rounded-corner promotional badge to the bottom left corner, with two lines of eye-catching white Japanese text:{argument name="offer text" default="1-week free trial"} Add a dark navy blue rounded logo bar in the bottom right corner, containing a simple white geometric logo and a bold white sans-serif brand name.{argument name="brand name" default="Easy Creative"} It adopts a clean and modern SaaS advertising aesthetic, featuring high contrast, clear typography, glossy UI cards, subtle shadows, and a professional conversion-oriented layout, all in a 1:1 aspect ratio.

promptLocalized.zh:
一款精致的方形日式数字广告横幅，用于 AI 电商优化工具。画面由一条从上部中心延伸至左下方的醒目蓝色对角线分割为两个主要视觉区域。左侧三分之一处展示了一个写实的夜间家庭办公场景：1 位疲惫的年轻女性坐在桌前，面部经过模糊处理，单手托腮注视着打开的笔记本电脑。温暖的台灯照亮了她和桌面，前景放着一个马克杯，散乱的文件、书架和墙上的时钟在黑暗的背景中呈现出柔和的虚化效果，营造出深夜加班的氛围。右侧三分之二处为一个深蓝色渐变宣传面板，背景带有微妙的财务增长图形：右上角附近有 1 个带有箭头的上升折线图和 4 根浅蓝色透明柱状图。面板上填充醒目的超大号白色日文标题，带有强烈的投影，分为 4 行排列：{argument name="headline text" default="深夜の
サムネ入れ替え、
もう自動化
できます。"}。下方添加 1 行白色副标题 {argument name="subheadline text" default="楽天専用 A/Bテスト自動化ツール"}，并配有一条纤细的青色下划线。下方放置一个水平流程条，包含 3 个白色圆角卡片，由 2 个指向右侧的青色箭头连接。卡片 1 展示了 2 个并排的手提包缩略图，分别标注为“サムネA”和“サムネB”，中间带有蓝色和灰色的百分比徽章（分别为“64.3%”和“35.7%”），中间标有“VS”。卡片 2 展示了 1 个被选中的黑色手提包缩略图，上方有一个金色小皇冠图标，右侧有灰色清单线条，并配有一个青绿色确认勾选徽章，上方有指示自动优化的小型日文标题。卡片 3 展示了 1 个带有坐标轴的简单分析图表，包含几根蓝色柱状图、1 条粉色上升趋势线，以及关于销售额和 CTR 趋势的日文标签，右下角标有粉色的结果数字“+47.2%”。左下角添加 1 个亮粉色圆角促销徽章，上面有 2 行醒目的白色日文文本：{argument name="offer text" default="1週間
無料トライアル"}。右下角添加 1 个深海军蓝圆角 Logo 条，包含一个简单的白色几何徽标以及加粗的白色无衬线品牌名称 {argument name="brand name" default="Easy Creative"}。采用简洁现代的 SaaS 广告美学，高对比度、清晰的排版、光泽感的 UI 卡片、细腻的阴影，以及专业的转化导向布局，尺寸为 1:1。

templates.title: Magical Gothic study interior design

titleLocalized.zh: 充满魔力的哥特式书房室内设计

templates.prompt: The interior of a luxurious, fantastical Gothic study is photographed from a wide, symmetrical perspective, with no one in the frame. In the center of the room sits a magnificent dark wood desk, adorned with intricate carvings, an open book, scattered papers, an inkwell, a quill pen, and two small stacks of books. Behind the desk is a tall, throne-style upholstered chair, upholstered in deep blue-grey velvet and decorated with exquisite Baroque style. The ceiling features three chandeliers: a central crystal chandelier with glowing candles, a dark metal lantern to the upper left, and a warm amber chandelier to the upper right. To the left of the room, a tall, ornate bookshelf overflows with books and antiques, accompanied by a small side table with papers and miscellaneous items, and a tall, arched stained-glass window casting a cool blue light. To the right, a lavishly carved architectural niche or fireplace-like structure is added, along with a grey-blue vintage plush sofa (with two cushions) and a candlestick with a lit candle. The scene is set in a lavishly decorated old mansion or magical library, featuring stone walls, carved wood, antique furniture, and richly layered decorative objects. A large patterned rug covers the floor, leading to a desk. The lighting uses cool moonlight blue and luminous magenta ambient mist, complemented by warm candlelight highlights, creating a magical, mysterious, and cinematic atmosphere. The ultra-detailed, painterly 3D fantasy illustrations feature soft volumetric fog, shallow depth of field, glowing effects, high-detail textures, a central composition, and an elegant, fantastical, and magical feel, with a storybook-like realism.

promptLocalized.zh: 一间奢华的奇幻哥特式书房内部，采用宽阔的对称视角拍摄，画面中无人。房间中央放置一张华丽的深色木质书桌，桌上有雕刻细节、一本打开的书、散落的纸张、墨水瓶、羽毛笔以及整整 2 小叠书籍；书桌后方是一把高大的王座式软垫椅，采用深蓝灰色天鹅绒面料和精致的巴洛克风格装饰。顶部包含整整 3 盏吊灯：中央是一盏带有发光蜡烛的水晶吊灯，左上方是一盏深色金属灯笼，右上方是一盏温暖的琥珀色吊灯。房间左侧增加一个高大的雕花书架，上面摆满了书籍和古玩，配有一张放着纸张和杂物的小边桌，以及一扇投射出冷蓝色光芒的高大拱形彩色玻璃窗。右侧增加一个华丽的雕刻建筑壁龛或类似壁炉的结构，一张灰青色的复古毛绒沙发（配有 2 个靠垫），以及一个点着蜡烛的烛台。场景设定为装饰华丽的古老宅邸或魔法图书馆，具有石墙、雕花木材、古董家具和层次丰富的装饰性杂物。地板上铺着一块通向书桌的大型图案地毯。场景光影采用冷月光蓝与发光的紫红色环境雾气，辅以温暖的烛光高光，营造出一种充满魔力、神秘且具有电影感的氛围。超精细、绘画风格的 3D 奇幻插画，柔和的体积雾，浅景深，发光效果，高细节纹理，中心构图，优雅、奇幻、魔法感，故事书般的写实感。

templates.title: Crimson Dark Witch Ritual

titleLocalized.zh: 深红暗黑女巫仪式

templates.prompt: A dark fantasy illustration features a woman suspended in the center, presented as an almost entirely black silhouette against a brightly glowing crimson background. She floats barefoot above the reflective, dark red water, her arms relaxed and slightly outstretched, fingers gently spread, her posture both composed and powerful. Her extremely long {argument name="hair color" default="black"} Her hair billowed wildly to the left in the gale; she wore a tattered, smoky, and semi-transparent garment.{argument name="dress color" default="black"} The gown, with its layers of ribbons and torn fabric trailing downwards, blended into the shadowy mist. Behind her was a massive, ornate circular magical rune, perfectly outlining her body like a halo. The rune, composed of intricate gothic filigree, concentric circles, and arcane lace-like geometric patterns, radiated a bright, blood-red light, its core a fiery white-red. The entire scene was dominated by black and crimson tones, with swirling smoke, embers, and magical energy filling the air. Two clusters of sharp red crystals emerged from the darkness in the lower left and right corners. At the bottom of the scene was a luminous, reflective pool, mirroring the red ripples above. This created a hellish, mysterious, and solemn atmosphere, as if {argument name="character role" default="a dark sorceress"} Awakening in a forbidden ritual chamber. High contrast, cinematic backlighting, volumetric lighting, ultra-detailed digital painting, vertical composition, centered symmetrical composition, somber elegance, no text, no additional characters, no visible facial details.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张暗黑奇幻风格的插画，画面中央是一位悬浮的女性，以近乎全黑的剪影形式呈现，背景是强烈发光的深红色。她赤脚悬浮在反光的黑红色水面上方，双臂放松并微微向下伸展，手指轻柔张开，姿态沉稳而有力。她极长的 {argument name="hair color" default="black"} 头发在狂风中向左飘散，形成狂野的丝缕；她身穿一件破损、烟雾缭绕且半透明的 {argument name="dress color" default="black"} 礼服，层叠的丝带和撕裂的布料向下拖曳，融入阴影的薄雾中。她身后是一个巨大的华丽圆形魔法符文，如同光环般完美地勾勒出她的身体，符文由复杂的哥特式花丝、同心圆和奥术蕾丝般的几何图形构成，散发着明亮的血红色光芒，核心呈现出炽热的白红色。整个场景以黑色和深红色为主调，空气中弥漫着缭绕的烟雾、余烬和魔法能量。左下角和右下角各有 2 簇从黑暗中显现的尖锐红色水晶。画面底部是一个光亮的反光水池，倒映着上方红色的涟漪光影。营造出一种地狱般、神秘且庄严的氛围，仿佛 {argument name="character role" default="a dark sorceress"} 正在禁忌的仪式密室中觉醒。高对比度、电影级背光、体积光、超精细数字绘画、竖构图、居中对称构图、阴郁优雅，无文字，无额外角色，无可见面部细节。

templates.title: Emerald Dark Witch Ritual

titleLocalized.zh: 翡翠暗黑女巫仪式

templates.prompt: A dark fantasy full-body portrait depicts a mysterious witch standing barefoot in the center of an ancient ceremonial hall, turned sideways to the camera, her head slightly bowed, most of her body silhouetted against a powerful, emerald-green glowing magical halo. She has {argument name="hair style" default="Dark curly hair, loosely tied into a messy bun, with long strands falling on either side of her face."} Wearing a{argument name="dress color" default="black"} She wore a floor-length, backless dress with a thigh-high slit, the hem draped with long, shadowy ribbons or vine-like smoke. Behind her was a massive circular arcane symbol, composed of concentric circles, geometric lines, mystical symbols, and runes, with a prominent pentagram medallion at the top, left, and right. The environment was a Gothic stone hall with towering shadowy pillars, floating green smoke, a light magical mist, and a smooth, reflective floor engraved with another partial summoning circle.{argument name="glow color" default="Neon Emerald Green"} With its monochromatic black palette, high contrast, dramatic backlighting, volumetric fog, cinematic rim lighting, intricate magical lines, ethereal smoke, and unforgettable supernatural atmosphere, the game creates characters that appear elegant, dangerous, and otherworldly. Rendered with ultra-detailed fantasy illustrations, the game features symmetrical compositions centered around luminous markings, a vertical proportion, and an atmosphere of forbidden ritual magic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张暗黑奇幻全身肖像，描绘了一位神秘女巫赤脚站在古老仪式厅的中央，侧身对着镜头，头微微低垂，身体大部分处于强烈的翡翠色发光魔法圆环的剪影中。她留着 {argument name="hair style" default="深色卷发，扎成松散凌乱的发髻，长发丝垂在脸颊两侧"}，身穿一件 {argument name="dress color" default="黑色"} 拖地长裙，露背设计，开叉至大腿，裙摆处有长长的、如同阴影般的丝带或藤蔓状烟雾缠绕在身上。她身后是一个巨大的圆形奥术印记，由许多同心圆、几何线条、神秘符号、符文标记组成，顶部、左侧和右侧各有一个醒目的五角星奖章。环境是一个哥特式石厅，有高耸的阴影柱、漂浮的绿色烟雾、淡淡的魔法雾气，以及刻有另一个局部召唤阵的光滑反光地面。采用 {argument name="glow color" default="霓虹翡翠绿"} 和黑色的单色调，具有极高的对比度、戏剧性的背光、体积雾、电影般的轮廓光、错综复杂的魔法线条、空灵的烟雾以及令人难忘的超自然氛围。使人物显得优雅、危险且超凡脱俗，采用超精细的奇幻插画渲染，以发光印记为中心的对称构图，竖向比例，营造出禁忌仪式魔法的氛围。

templates.title: Okinawa Summer Tourism Banner

titleLocalized.zh: 冲绳夏季旅游横幅

templates.prompt: Create a sophisticated and eye-catching Okinawa summer banner advertisement for a Japanese travel agency. Use a wide, horizontal layout with a vibrant tropical beach scene as the entire background: crystal-clear turquoise ocean, white sand, green islands in the mid-to-far distance, deep blue sky, and large, fluffy white clouds, with palm leaves hanging in the upper right corner. In the right foreground, place a traditional Okinawan wind lion statue perched on a stone wall, surrounded by red hibiscus and lush tropical greenery. Near the water, add a small glass-bottomed sightseeing boat close to the shore. Add two simple fish graffiti icons to the sea surface. Use typography as the core element. Place the prominent Japanese calligraphy title text in the center left-to-center position.{argument name="headline text" default="Summer in Okinawa"} The design employs a blue gradient effect with white halos or soft outlines, resulting in a clean and elegant look. Above it, a handwritten Japanese slogan is added.{argument name="catchphrase" default="Blue sea, blue sky, and relaxing island time."} It is decorated with casual underlines. Below the main title, add a smaller Japanese subtitle.{argument name="subheading" default="Embark on a journey to encounter breathtaking scenery and warm hospitality."} In the top left corner, add a circular summer badge with a radiant, sunlit feel, against a soft cream background, adorned with delicate wavy lines, a small hibiscus decoration, and the Japanese text "この夏は沖縄で最高の思い出を！". Decorate the left side of the title area with a pink hibiscus and subtle wave-like graphic lines. In the lower center, place three rounded-corner white function cards side-by-side, partially overlapping the beach scene. Please clearly present all three cards: The first card features a circular photo of a sea turtle swimming underwater, accompanied by the Japanese title "Enjoying Beautiful Nature" and a brief text about the clear water and attractions; the second card features a circular photo of a bowl of Okinawa soba noodles, accompanied by the title "Able to Eat Okinawa Gourmet Noodles" and a brief text mentioning "Okinawa soba" and "Goat Chanpuru"; the third card features a circular photo of Shuri Castle, accompanied by the title "Enjoying the Viewpoint" and a brief text mentioning "Okinawa Churaumi Aquarium" and "Shuri Castle". Add small corals, seashells, hibiscus flowers, and starfish decorations around these cards. In the lower right corner, overlay a slanted light blue and cream-colored circular promotional sticker against a beach background, topped with a small yellow tag. The yellow label reads "Early Bird Booking!", and the main circle reads "Natsu no Okinawa Tour - Reviews Accepted!". Add a white frangipani flower near the sticker as an embellishment. Create a full-width dark blue footer at the bottom. On the left side of the footer, place the white travel agency logo icon and the company name text.{argument name="company name" default="XX Travel Co., Ltd."} Below this is a smaller Japanese caption. In the center of the footer are three circular line icons with brief Japanese descriptions: a calendar icon for travel planning, a customer service icon for travel assistance, and a suitcase icon for comfortable travel. On the right side of the footer is a framed CTA area containing the Japanese phrase "詳しくはこちらから" and a simulated search box containing {argument name="search text" default="XX trip to Okinawa"} And search icons. The overall design should present a high-end, cheerful, summery, and highly marketable style, like a professional Japanese website banner or tourism event visual.

promptLocalized.zh:
制作一张精致的日本旅行社冲绳夏季横幅广告，风格明亮且具有吸引力。采用宽幅横向布局，以生动的热带海滩场景作为全背景：清澈见底的绿松石色海洋、白色沙滩、中远处的绿色小岛、深蓝色天空及大朵蓬松的白云，右上角垂下棕榈叶。在右侧前景处，放置 1 座传统的冲绳风狮爷石像，坐落在石墙上，周围环绕着红色扶桑花和茂盛的热带绿植。在靠近水面的地方，加入 1 艘靠近岸边的小型玻璃底观光船。在海面上添加 2 个简单的小鱼涂鸦图标。

将排版作为核心元素。在左中至中心位置，放置非常醒目的日文书法标题文本 {argument name="headline text" default="夏の沖縄"}，采用蓝色渐变效果，带有白色光晕或柔和轮廓，清晰且优雅。在其上方，添加一句手写风格的日文宣传语 {argument name="catchphrase" default="青い海、青い空、心ほどける島時間。"}，并配有随意的下划线装饰。在主标题下方，添加一行较小的日文副标题 {argument name="subheading" default="感動の景色と、あたたかいおもてなしに出会う旅へ。"}。

在左上角，添加一个带有阳光放射感的圆形夏季徽章，背景为柔和的奶油色，配有细小的波浪线、一个小扶桑花装饰，以及日文文本“この夏は 沖縄で 最高の思い出を!”。在标题区域左侧装饰 1 朵粉色扶桑花和微妙的海浪图形线条。

在下方中间位置，并排放置 3 张圆角白色功能卡片，部分覆盖在海滩场景上。请清晰呈现全部 3 张卡片：第一张卡片以圆形照片展示海龟在水下游泳，配有日文标题“美しい自然を満喫”及关于透明海水和景点的简短正文；第二张卡片以圆形照片展示一碗冲绳荞麦面，配有标题“沖縄グルメを堪能”及提及“沖縄そば”和“ゴーヤチャンプルー”的简短正文；第三张卡片以圆形照片展示首里城，配有标题“観光スポットも充実”及提及“美ら海水族館”和“首里城”的简短正文。在这些卡片周围添加小珊瑚、贝壳、扶桑花和海星装饰。

在右下方，在海滩背景上叠加 1 个倾斜的淡蓝色与奶油色圆形促销贴纸，顶部带有一个黄色小标签。黄色标签写着“早めの予約がおトク!”，主圆圈内写着“夏の沖縄ツアー 好評受付中!”。在贴纸附近添加一朵白色鸡蛋花作为点缀。

在底部创建一个全宽的深蓝色页脚栏。在页脚左侧，放置白色旅行社 Logo 图标和公司名称文本 {argument name="company name" default="〇〇旅行株式会社"}，下方附带较小的日文标语。在页脚中心，放置 3 个圆形线条图标，并配有简短的日文说明：1 个用于旅游计划的日历图标、1 个用于旅行协助的客服图标，以及 1 个用于舒适旅行帮助的行李箱图标。在页脚右侧，添加一个带框的 CTA 区域，内含日文“詳しくはこちらから”以及一个模拟搜索框，其中包含 {argument name="search text" default="〇〇旅行　沖縄"} 和搜索图标。整体设计应呈现出高端、愉悦、充满夏日气息且极具市场吸引力的风格，如同专业的日本网页横幅或旅游活动视觉图。

templates.title: Realistic style sushi bar dinner portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 写实风格寿司吧台晚餐人像

templates.prompt: A realistic snapshot of a restaurant shows a young Japanese woman sitting at a traditional Japanese restaurant's wooden sushi counter in warm lighting, positioned in the center of the frame and facing the camera. She has long, straight hair.{argument name="hair color" default="black"} Her hair was styled with bangs, and she wore a soft beige knitted off-the-shoulder sweater with a wide, sailor-style neckline trimmed in brown, over which was a white button-down collar. The long sleeves had flared cuffs, showcasing a feminine and elegant style. She held chopsticks in her right hand, hovering above a small blue dish, while her left hand rested on the table. In front of her was a rectangular ceramic plate neatly arranged with eight pieces of sushi: pink tuna, dark red tuna, orange salmon, two pieces of shrimp nigiri sushi, and pale white fish. To her right was another rectangular plate containing assorted tempura, including two large shrimp and mixed vegetable tempura. To the left of the table were a ceramic teacup with striking black Japanese calligraphy, a wooden chopstick holder filled with disposable chopsticks, and some small packages. Behind her was an open sushi bar, where two chefs in white uniforms and chef hats could be seen, along with a glass display case, a handwritten Japanese menu, a wooden bar counter, and several customers dining in the background. Shot from eye level, it has the quality of smartphone photography, presenting a natural indoor perspective, a documentary style, rich wood texture, warm amber lighting, delicate food details, and shallow to medium depth of field, creating a real and busy dinner atmosphere. It is unstylized, not an illustration, and has a photorealistic feel.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实风格的餐厅抓拍照片，一位年轻的日本女性坐在光线温暖的传统日式餐厅木质寿司吧台前，位于画面中心并面向镜头。她留着长直的 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"} 头发，留着齐刘海，身穿一件柔软的米色针织露肩毛衣，领口为宽大的水手风格，带有棕色饰边，内搭白色纽扣领，长袖配喇叭袖口，展现出女性柔美端庄的时尚感。她右手拿着筷子悬在蓝色小碟上方，左手放在桌面上。她面前是一个长方形陶瓷盘，整齐地摆放着 8 块寿司，包括粉色金枪鱼、深红色金枪鱼、橙色三文鱼、两块虾仁握寿司和浅白色鱼肉；右侧是另一个长方形盘子，盛放着什锦天妇罗，包括 2 只大虾和混合蔬菜天妇罗。桌子左侧放着一个印有醒目黑色日文书法的陶瓷茶杯、一个装满一次性筷子的木制筷筒以及一些小包装物品。她身后是开放式寿司吧台，可以看到 2 名身穿白色制服和戴着厨师帽的厨师、玻璃展示柜、手写日文菜单牌、木质吧台以及背景中几位正在用餐的顾客。采用平视角度拍摄，具有智能手机摄影的质感，呈现自然的室内视角、纪实写实风格、丰富的木质纹理、温暖的琥珀色灯光、细腻的食物细节、浅至中等的景深，营造出真实忙碌的晚餐氛围，无风格化处理，非插画，照片级真实感。

templates.title: Cat Girl Idol Concert Stage

titleLocalized.zh: 猫娘偶像演唱会舞台

templates.prompt: A dynamic illustration of an anime idol concert depicts a female catgirl singer performing on a large stage. Using a dramatic low-angle perspective, she walks towards the camera, one gloved hand extending forward with a strong sense of perspective, while the other holds a black microphone. She has {argument name="hair color" default="Bright pink"} She has twin ponytails, fluffy cat ears on top of her head, and wears orange steampunk goggles adorned with red plaid bows on either side. Her outfit is an elaborate black and red punk idol ensemble, including a black lace-trimmed cropped top, a red plaid ruffled mini skirt, and a plethora of gold chains, heart and bell charms, belts, buckles, garter belts, and layered accessories. Costume details: 1 pair of cat ears, 1 pair of goggles, 2 hair accessory bows, a fingerless glove on her outstretched hand, a microphone, a cropped corset-style top, a plaid skirt, a belt, 2 sets of thigh-high garter belt systems, one leg wearing fishnet stockings, the other wearing red and black striped over-the-knee socks, and a pair of black lace-up boots. A fluffy pink cat tail can also be seen behind her. Her expression should be energetic, playful, and commanding, like a live pop-rock performance. The stage was filled with concert lighting trusses, purple and magenta spotlights, and glowing, blurred light spots. Behind it were steps, and in the foreground were two large black stage monitors and three visible venue screens displaying her live performance from different angles. There were also two visible neon signs with the text {argument name="sign text" default="Neko Otome"} One large screen in the upper left corner and another emitting pink light from a speaker in the front right corner, both adorned with cute cat face icons. Audience members in the lower right corner wave pink glow sticks. The presentation utilizes ultra-refined, exquisite anime rendering to showcase glossy fabrics, metallic highlights, vibrant pink and purple-red lighting, sharp lines, and high contrast.{argument name="idol name" default="Neko Otome"} It created a high-energy atmosphere as if the stadium concert tickets were sold out.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满动感的动漫偶像演唱会插画，描绘了一位女性猫娘歌手在大型舞台上表演的场景。采用极具戏剧性的低角度视角，她正向镜头迈步，一只戴着手套的手向前伸出，呈现出强烈的透视感，另一只手拿着黑色麦克风。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="亮粉色"} 的双马尾，头顶长着毛茸茸的猫耳，戴着一副橙色调的蒸汽朋克护目镜，两侧饰有红色的格子蝴蝶结。她的服装是一套精致的黑红朋克偶像装，包括黑色蕾丝边短款上衣、红色格子荷叶边迷你裙，以及大量的金链、心形和铃铛挂饰、腰带、搭扣、吊袜带和层叠配饰。服装细节清点：1 对猫耳，1 副护目镜，2 个发饰蝴蝶结，伸出的那只手上戴着 1 只露指手套，1 个麦克风，1 件短款胸衣式上衣，1 条格子裙，1 条腰带，2 套大腿吊袜带系统，一条腿穿着渔网袜，另一条腿穿着红黑条纹过膝袜，以及 1 双黑色系带靴。她的身后还可以看到一条毛茸茸的粉色猫尾。她的表情应充满活力、俏皮且具有统治力，如同现场流行摇滚演出一般。舞台上布满了演唱会灯光桁架、紫色和洋红色的聚光灯、发光的虚化光斑，身后有阶梯，前景中有 2 个大型黑色舞台监听音箱，以及 3 个可见的场馆屏幕，从不同角度播放着她的现场画面。包含 2 个可见的霓虹灯牌，文字为 {argument name="sign text" default="Neko Otome"}，一个位于左上角的大屏幕上，另一个在右前方的音箱上发出粉色光芒，两者均配有可爱的猫脸图标。右下角的观众挥舞着粉色的荧光棒。采用超精细的精致动漫渲染，展现光泽面料、金属高光、鲜艳的粉紫红色灯光、清晰的线条、高对比度，并为 {argument name="idol name" default="Neko Otome"} 营造出体育场演唱会门票售罄的高能氛围。

templates.title: Realistic style close-up of Japanese idols

titleLocalized.zh: 写实风格日本偶像特写

templates.prompt: A hyper-realistic close-up portrait of a young Japanese female idol, shot vertically from the shoulders up, with her head slightly tilted and looking directly at the camera. She has {argument name="hair color" default="jet black"} Her medium-length straight hair, with thick, straight bangs partially covering her forehead and gently framing her face, is striking. Her skin is incredibly smooth and fair, appearing evenly lit. Her large, deep brown eyes hold a soft glow, her nose is small and natural, and her slightly parted pink lips reveal slightly uneven front teeth, one of which is noticeably irregular and overlapping, creating a captivating yet imperfect smile. Her expression is calm, gentle, and innocent. She wears an exquisite light blue ruffled lace top with sheer pleats at the shoulders. The background is a soft, blurred palette of cool tones—lavender, blue, and pink—suggesting an indoor stage or event setting, with a bokeh effect reminiscent of light spots. The design emphasizes realistic skin texture, accurate asymmetrical teeth, an idol photography style, shallow depth of field, and a clean, refined Japanese portrait aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超写实的年轻日本女性偶像特写肖像，采用从肩膀以上的竖构图，头部微微倾斜，直视镜头。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="乌黑色"} 的中长直发，厚重的齐刘海遮住部分额头，并轻柔地修饰脸部两侧。她的皮肤非常光滑白皙，在柔和均匀的光线下呈现，深棕色的大眼睛带有柔和的亮光，鼻子小巧自然，微微张开的粉色嘴唇露出不整齐的前牙，其中一颗上牙明显不规则且重叠，营造出一种迷人且不完美的笑容。她的表情平静、柔和且纯真。她身穿一件精致的浅蓝色荷叶边蕾丝上衣，肩膀处可见透明的褶皱细节。背景是柔和模糊的薰衣草色、蓝色和粉色等冷色调，暗示着室内舞台或活动背景，并带有类似光斑的虚化效果。强调真实的皮肤纹理、准确的不对称牙齿、偶像摄影风格、浅景深以及干净精致的日式肖像美学。

templates.title: Japanese AI vs. YouTube thumbnails

titleLocalized.zh: 日文 AI 对决 YouTube 缩略图

templates.prompt: A striking Japanese YouTube thumbnail depicting the AI ​​race era, in a 16:9 widescreen, high-contrast, dramatic tech news style. It uses a dark, futuristic control room background filled with three glowing holographic dashboard screens, edged with blue web interface elements. A glowing circular hub, labeled "AI" in bright blue, is placed on the left and in the center, with three directional glowing energy arrows extending outwards to the competition platform: "Google" in a blue electric area on the left, "Claude" in a gold electric area in the upper right, and "OpenAI" in a magenta-purple electric area at the bottom center. Subtle world maps or territorial battle visualizations, such as glowing digital lands or zones of influence, are added below each brand area. On the right, a young Japanese woman, waist-high, is shown facing forward, wearing a long, straight, two-tone wig—one side soft pink, the other soft blue—and a plain white T-shirt and light pink skirt printed with "OKIHIRO AI Creative." She poses as a presenter, holding one index finger to her face. Her face is completely obscured by a large, softly-edged rectangular blur. Add a large, distressed white Japanese title text at the top:{argument name="headline text" default="AI Warring States Period"} Below it, add a second line of bold, gold Japanese text:{argument name="subheadline text" default="It's not just about performance."} At the bottom, place a large black banner with huge, bold, gold Japanese characters:{argument name="bottom text" default="The side that takes the air wins."} The layout should be oversized, bold, and eye-catching, with subtle glowing and shadow effects. Use a color scheme of black, electric blue, gold, magenta, and neon white for strong contrast and thumbnail readability.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张关于 AI 竞赛时代的醒目日文 YouTube 缩略图，16:9 宽屏，高对比度，戏剧性的科技新闻风格。使用深色未来主义控制室背景，充满 3 个发光的全息仪表盘屏幕，边缘环绕蓝色网络界面元素。在左侧和中心放置一个发光的圆形枢纽，标有亮蓝色的“AI”字样，并有 3 个定向发光的能量箭头向外延伸至竞争平台：左侧蓝色电光区域的“Google”，右上角金色电光区域的“Claude”，以及底部中心品红色-紫色电光区域的“OpenAI”。在每个品牌区域下方添加微妙的世界地图或领土争夺可视化效果，如发光的数字陆地或影响力区域。在右侧，展示一位腰部以上的年轻日本女性，面向前方，戴着一顶长直发分色假发，一侧为柔粉色，另一侧为柔蓝色，身穿印有“OKIHIRO AI Creative”字样的纯白 T 恤和浅粉色短裙。她以主持人姿势将一根食指举在脸旁。她的脸部被一个大的柔边矩形模糊块完全遮挡。在顶部添加巨大的做旧白色日文标题文字：{argument name="headline text" default="AI战国时代"}。在其下方，添加第二行加粗的金色日文文字：{argument name="subheadline text" default="性能だけの話じゃない"}。在底部放置一个宽大的黑色横幅，上面写着巨大的加粗金色日文文字：{argument name="bottom text" default="空気を取った側が勝つ"}。排版要超大、粗犷且引人注目，带有轻微的发光和投影效果。使用黑色、电光蓝、金色、品红和霓虹白作为配色方案，具有强烈的对比度和缩略图可读性。

templates.title: Cyberpunk-style AI tools comparison poster

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克风格 AI 工具对比海报

templates.prompt: A futuristic Japanese-style tech comparison poster, set against a dark cyberpunk control room background, uses a 16:9 widescreen composition. The upper left corner features a striking, distressed white Japanese title, "三つ巴" (San Tsu Tomoe), followed immediately by a prominent gold subtitle, "それぞれの武器" (Sorezore no Weapon). On the left side of the image, three glowing holographic contrast panels are arranged horizontally and connected by neon arrows: a blue panel labeled "Google," an amber-gold panel labeled "Claude," and a magenta panel labeled "OpenAI." The Google panel contains four internal cards: the two larger cards at the top are labeled "Gemini" and "Antigravity," while the two smaller cards at the bottom display analytical/dashboard-style visuals and a blue isometric cube. The Claude panel contains four internal cards: the large card at the top is labeled "Claude Code," and the three smaller cards at the bottom display network diagrams, text/code lists, and chart analysis. The OpenAI panel contains five internal cards: the two larger cards at the top are labeled "ChatGPT" and "Codex" respectively, while the three smaller cards at the bottom display the interface/code window and a geometric wireframe cube. Glowing bidirectional arrows are added between Google and Claude, and between Claude and OpenAI. A large neon-bordered banner with the words "Google / Claude / OpenAI" in gold lettering is placed at the bottom center. A young woman with long, straight, pink and blue highlights stands on the right, pointing to the panel on the left, and wears a shirt with black lettering {argument name="shirt text" default="OKIHIRO AI Creative"} She wore a pure white T-shirt and a light pink pleated skirt. Her face was obscured by a smooth, rectangular blur. The design employed cinematic sci-fi lighting, glossy holographic UI details, high contrast, and a vibrant blue-gold-purple color scheme, presenting a refined YouTube thumbnail aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张未来主义的日式科技对比海报，背景为暗色调的赛博朋克控制室，采用 16:9 宽屏构图。左上方有醒目的做旧白色日文标题“三つ巴”，下方紧跟醒目的金色副标题“それぞれの武器”。画面中左侧横向排列着 3 个发光的全息对比面板，并由霓虹箭头连接：蓝色面板标注为“Google”，琥珀金色面板标注为“Claude”，紫红色面板标注为“OpenAI”。Google 面板包含 4 个内部卡片：上方 2 个较大的卡片分别标注为“Gemini”和“Antigravity”，下方 2 个较小的卡片展示分析/仪表盘式视觉效果和一个蓝色等距立方体图形。Claude 面板包含 4 个内部卡片：上方 1 个大卡片标注为“Claude Code”，下方 3 个较小的卡片展示网络图、文本/代码列表和图表分析。OpenAI 面板包含 5 个内部卡片：上方 2 个较大的卡片分别标注为“ChatGPT”和“Codex”，下方 3 个较小的卡片展示界面/代码窗口和一个几何线框立方体。在 Google 与 Claude 之间，以及 Claude 与 OpenAI 之间添加发光的双向箭头。在底部中央放置一个巨大的霓虹边框横幅，上面印有金色文字“Google / Claude / OpenAI”。右侧站着一位年轻女性，正指向左侧的面板，她留着长直发，发色为粉色与青蓝色的挑染，身穿一件印有黑色文字“{argument name="shirt text" default="OKIHIRO AI Creative"}”的纯白 T 恤，下身穿着淡粉色百褶裙。她的面部被一个平滑的矩形模糊块遮挡。采用电影级科幻灯光，具有光泽的全息 UI 细节，高对比度，鲜艳的蓝-金-紫配色，呈现出精致的 YouTube 缩略图美学。

templates.title: Japanese AI Creative Promotion Slides

titleLocalized.zh: 日系 AI 创意推广 Slides

templates.prompt: Create a futuristic Japanese-style promotional main image for an AI creative service, with a design style similar to high-impact social media ads or presentation slides. The background uses a cyberpunk style with interwoven deep black and deep blue, embellished with glowing circuit patterns, stardust particles, and neon light trails surrounding the central editing screen. The composition is a single horizontal widescreen image containing six independent visual panels, with a human presenter on the right. A striking Japanese title is placed at the top center, using an aged metallic gold and white text, with the first line reading "Key is the image," and below it "Is it a moment?", featuring strong 3D depth, a rough texture, and dazzling lighting effects. The largest panel is placed in the center: a glowing blue desktop editing interface showcasing a sunrise view of a futuristic city from above, including rivers, greenery, streamlined skyscrapers, and warm orange sunlight, with a vertical toolbar containing sliders and a color wheel on the right. Five smaller glowing panels are arranged around this central panel, connected by outward-pointing gold curved arrows. Upper left panel: An example of a thumbnail showing an image of a future city and the Japanese word "Future を、いま出る.", with smaller subtitles "AI × Innovation" and "Era のソリューション" attached below, and a bright cyan label "サムネイル" attached below the panel. Upper right panel: Banner example showing an abstract blue digital globe or web image with the Japanese words "AIで、FUTUREをデザイ"ンする." and the subtitle "テクノロジーで, Society にインクトを", with the cyan tag "バナー" attached below. Bottom Left Panel: Slides/Document Examples, in a business infographic style, titled "Accelerating Videos with AI," containing three circular icon areas and an upward-pointing chart on the right, with a blue label "Data/Slides" below. Bottom Center Panel: SNS Post Examples, showing a person standing on a mountaintop watching the sunrise, accompanied by the eye-catching Japanese phrase "Take on the challenge, change the future." The bottom bar features social media interaction icons and a counter, with a blue label "SNS Portraits" below. Bottom Right Panel: Flyer Examples, using a dark blue event poster layout, titled "AI Utilization Seminar," with the subtitle "Expanding the Possibilities of Videos," the large date "June 15," the time "10:00–17:00," and a yellow circular badge that reads "Participation Fee Free," with a blue label "Flyers/Booklets" below. On the right side of the overall composition, a young female presenter is depicted in half-length, facing forward with a smile. Her right index finger lightly touches her cheek, as if emphasizing a key point. She has long, straight hair with light pink and light blue highlights on the sides, fair skin, and wears a dress printed with "..."{argument name="brand text" default="OKIHIRO AI Creative"} "A white T-shirt with black lettering, paired with a high-waisted pink skirt. promptLocalized.zh: 为 AI 创意服务创作一张充满未来感的日系宣传主图，设计风格类似于高冲击力的社交媒体广告或演示文稿 Slides。背景采用深黑与深蓝交织的赛博风格，点缀发光的电路图案、星尘粒子，以及环绕中央编辑屏幕的霓虹光轨。构图为单张横向宽屏，包含 6 个独立的视觉面板，右侧设有一名人类演示者。顶部中央放置醒目的日文大标题，采用做旧金属金与白色文字，第一行写着“鍵は画像”，下方为“一瞬で伝わる”，并带有强烈的 3D 深度、粗糙质感与耀眼光效。中心位置放置最大的面板：一个发光的蓝色桌面编辑界面，展示从高空俯瞰的未来城市日出景象，包含河流、绿植、流线型摩天大楼及温暖的橙色阳光，右侧为包含滑块和色轮的垂直工具栏。围绕该中心面板布置 5 个较小的发光面板，并用指向外部的金色曲线箭头连接。左上方面板：缩略图示例，展示未来城市图像及日文“未来を、いま创る。”，下方附有较小的子标题“AI × Innovation”和“時代のソリューション”，面板下方贴有亮青色标签“サムネイル”。右上方面板：横幅示例，展示抽象的蓝色数字地球或网络图像，配有日文“AIで、未来をデザインする。”及子标题“テクノロジーで、社会にインパクトを。”，下方贴有青色标签“バナー”。左下方面板：Slides / 文档示例，采用商业信息图风格，标题为“AIでビジネスを加速”，包含三个圆形图标区域及右侧向上的图表，下方贴有青色标签“资料・Slides”。底部中央面板：SNS 帖子示例，展示一人站在山顶看日出，配有醒目的日文“挑戦が、未来を変える。”，底部栏带有社交媒体互动图标及计数，下方贴有青色标签“SNS画像”。右下方面板：传单示例，采用深蓝色活动海报布局，标题为“AI活用セミナー”，副标题“ビジネスの可能性を広げる”，大字日期“6.15”、时间“10:00–17:00”，以及写有“参加费免费”的黄色圆形徽章，下方贴有青色标签“传单・小册子”。在整体构图的右侧，放置一名年轻女性演示者，半身像，面向前方，面带微笑，右手食指轻触脸庞，仿佛在强调核心观点。她留着长直发，两侧分别为浅粉色和浅蓝色挑染，皮肤白皙，身穿印有“{argument name="brand text" default="OKIHIRO AI Creative"}”黑色文字的白色 T 恤，搭配高腰粉色短裙。她的面部经过处理，呈现出简洁的广告风格。最底部添加一个巨大的金色日文口号，置于黑金边框的横幅内，写着“非エンジニアに刺さる”。整体采用强对比度、霓虹青色边缘光、金色装饰字体、光泽感 UI 边框、动感箭头，打造出专为向非技术背景的商业用户推广 AI 图像生成技术而优化的科技营销美学。

templates.title: Neon AI Thumbnail Comparison

titleLocalized.zh: Neon AI 缩略图对比

templates.prompt: Create a futuristic, neon cyberpunk-style Japanese YouTube thumbnail in a 16:9 aspect ratio. The background uses a dark, tech-city theme, incorporating blurred skyscrapers, digital grid lines, glowing particles, and high-contrast blue, pink, and gold lighting. A half-length female figure with long, straight, light blue hair, wearing a pure white short-sleeved T-shirt and a light pink skirt, is placed in the center of the image. She rests her chin on one hand and crosses the other arm, posing thoughtfully. Apply a soft rectangular blur to her face. Add a large, distressed, bold white Japanese title at the top: “The Dominant Power Has Weakened,” and directly below it, add striking bold yellow text: “…”{argument name="subheadline text" default="Nano Bananaから"} On the left, create a glowing blue hexagonal panel titled "Nano Banana" with the subtitle "Image Generation". The panel contains four 2x2 image tiles: 1) a fantastical floating island landscape at sunset, 2) a sunlit forest path, 3) a neon-lit futuristic city street at night, and 4) an outer space planet scene with stars and spacecraft. Below the left panel, add a glowing blue ribbon label with the text "かつては优位だった". On the right, create a glowing magenta hexagonal panel titled "{argument name="right panel title" default="GPT Image 2"} ", the subtitle below is "実物で使える出力へ". The panel contains 4 sample thumbnail cards arranged in a 2x2 manner, each card showing the same blue-haired woman (face blurred) and eye-catching Japanese text. 4 The labels above each card are: サムネイル's portrait, Memo's のアイキャッチ's portrait, LP's のセクション's portrait, and the large font content in the card are: 1). AI is the future of the company, 2) Conditions for the success of the company in the AI ​​era, 3) AI is accelerating the growth of the company, 4) The future is AI×Anata's idol. Between the left and right panels, place a bright, glowing gold arrow pointing from left to right with a sparkling particle trail, symbolizing transition or a shift in advantage. At the bottom, add a large black banner with a glowing gold border and bold gold text: "{argument name="bottom banner text" default="GPT Image 2へ"} The overall composition should present a sense of contrast, showcasing the shift from old-fashioned image generation to more commercially viable output, combined with impactful thumbnail typography, strong glowing effects, metallic textures for the main text, and a sophisticated social media marketing visual style.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张充满未来感、霓虹赛博朋克风格的日式 YouTube 缩略图，比例为 16:9。背景使用暗色调科技城市，包含模糊的摩天大楼、数字网格线、发光粒子，以及高对比度的蓝、粉、金三色灯光。画面正中央放置一位半身女性，留着长直的淡蓝色头发，身穿纯白色短袖 T 恤和浅粉色裙子，单手托腮，另一只手臂交叉，姿态沉思；将其面部进行柔和的矩形模糊处理。在顶部添加巨大的做旧粗体白色日文标题“主導権が揺れた”，并在其正下方添加醒目的黄色粗体文字“{argument name="subheadline text" default="Nano Bananaから"}”。在左侧，创建一个发光的蓝色六边形面板，标题为 Nano Banana，下方小标题为“画像生成”。面板内包含 4 个 2x2 排列的图像块：1) 日落时分的奇幻浮岛景观，2) 阳光明媚的森林小径，3) 夜晚霓虹闪烁的未来城市街道，4) 带有恒星和航天器的外太空行星场景。在左侧面板下方，添加一个发光的蓝色丝带标签，文字为“かつては優位だった”。在右侧，创建一个发光的洋红色六边形面板，标题为“{argument name="right panel title" default="GPT Image 2"}”，下方小标题为“実務で使える出力へ”。面板内包含 4 个 2x2 排列的示例缩略图卡片，每张卡片均展示同一位蓝发女性（面部模糊）及醒目的日文文字。4 个卡片上方的标签分别为：サムネイル画像、記事のアイキャッチ画像、LPのセクション画像、SNS投稿画像。卡片内的大字内容分别为：1) AIで変わるクリエイティブの未来，2) AI時代のクリエイティブ戦略 成功する企業の条件，3) AIで加速するビジネス成長，4) 未来をつくるのは AI×あなたのアイデア。在左右面板之间，放置一个明亮的金色发光箭头，从左向右指向，并带有火花般的粒子轨迹，象征过渡或优势的转移。在底部添加一个巨大的黑色横幅，带有金色发光边框，并写有醒目的金色粗体文字“{argument name="bottom banner text" default="GPT Image 2へ"}”。整体构图应呈现出一种对比感，展示从旧式图像生成向更具商业实用性输出的转变，并结合极具冲击力的缩略图排版、强烈的发光效果、主要文字的金属质感以及精致的社交媒体营销视觉风格。

templates.title: Workplace fashion magazine cover

titleLocalized.zh: 职场时尚杂志封面

templates.prompt: A sophisticated Japanese fashion magazine cover, set in a bright, modern office corridor, features a beautiful career woman confidently walking towards the camera in a full-body portrait. She wears a sharp, monochrome gray business suit: a fitted ribbed turtleneck short-sleeved knit top with four metal buttons adorning the off-shoulder strap, paired with a high-waisted gray pencil skirt and a matching gray belt with rectangular buckles. She carries a folder and documents in one hand, while her other arm swings naturally as she walks. She has long, dark brown hair, braided into a thick side plait that falls over her shoulder, with neatly styled bangs. The overall atmosphere is elegant, mature, and exudes feminine charm with understated strength. The scene is a sophisticated open-plan office; to the left is a glass conference room, and to the right are desks and colleagues working. Soft sunlight intertwines with clean office overhead lighting, accented by delicate indoor greenery. A shallow depth of field keeps the subject in sharp focus, while the background is softly blurred. The image employs a vertical composition reminiscent of a high-end magazine cover, with the model centered and occupying most of the frame from head to knee. Meticulously edited and retouched, it showcases realistic fabric textures, natural skin tones, and understated luxury. Overlaid with stylish Japanese and English magazine layouts: a large serif headline in the upper left corner.{argument name="headline text" default="Update"} The magazine features small Japanese text at the top, with the subtitle "The Office Muse" in handwritten font. To the right is a preview section titled "NEW BASIC, NEW ME." To the left is a special section titled "Focus on DETAIL." In the center left is an article box titled "My Work Style," and to the bottom right is a special section titled "Style Tip." A small box on the right reads "Scene PRESENTATION DAY," and to the bottom left is a circular "CHECK!" Page 25 is printed in small print at the bottom. Employing a luxurious fashion magazine aesthetic, the layout is clean and simple, with a restrained grayscale color scheme. The text and main content achieve an editorial balance, featuring realistic photography, rich detail, and soft contrast, creating an appealing, high-fashion look for workplace attire.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的日式时尚杂志编辑封面，背景设定在明亮的现代办公走廊中，画面主体为一位美丽的职场女性，正自信地向镜头走来，全身肖像。她身着利落的单色灰色职场套装：一件修身罗纹半高领短袖针织衫，斜肩带细节处饰有 4 枚金属纽扣，搭配高腰灰色铅笔裙，以及带有矩形扣的同色系灰色腰带。她一手拿着文件夹和文件，另一只手臂在行走间自然摆动。她留着深棕色长发，编成厚实的侧边麻花辫垂在肩头，配以柔顺整齐的刘海。整体氛围优雅、成熟、充满女性魅力且内敛有力。场景为精致的开放式办公室，左侧是玻璃会议室，右侧是办公桌和工作的同事，柔和的日光与干净的办公顶灯交织，点缀着精致的室内绿植，浅景深效果使人物保持清晰对焦，背景则呈现柔和的虚化。画面采用高级杂志封面的垂直构图，模特居中，占据从头部到膝盖的大部分画幅，经过精细的编辑修图，呈现真实的织物纹理、自然的肤色和低调的奢华感。叠加时尚的日文和英文杂志排版：左上方是一个大号衬线字体标题 {argument name="headline text" default="Update"}，上方配有较小的日文文案，副标题为手写体 "The Office Muse"，右侧为预告板块 "NEW BASIC, NEW ME."，左侧为标题为 "Focus on DETAIL" 的专题板块，左中部为标题为 "My Work Style" 的文章框，右下方为标题为 "Style Tip" 的专题，右侧有一个小方框标题为 "Scene PRESENTATION DAY"，左下方有一个圆形标注 "CHECK!"，底部有页码 25 的小字。采用奢华时尚杂志美学，布局简洁，色调为克制的灰阶，文字与主体之间达到编辑平衡，摄影写实，细节丰富，对比度柔和，营造出令人向往的职场穿搭大片感。

titleLocalized.zh: Office Muse 时尚封面

templates.prompt: A sophisticated high-fashion magazine cover portrait features a beautiful young professional woman standing by the floor-to-ceiling windows of a bright, modern corporate office, shot in a refined editorial style. She is slightly turned to the side, her expression calm, elegant, and confident, her face deliberately obscured by a soft, rectangular blurring effect. She has long, dark brown hair, braided into a thick side braid that falls over her shoulder. She is wearing a {argument name="top color" default="Deep Navy Blue"} She wears a fitted ribbed turtleneck sweater with short sleeves and three gold buttons on the left shoulder, paired with a high-waisted black pencil skirt and a thin black belt. Her right hand is raised, holding a light-colored cleaning cloth against the glass, presenting a symbolic lifestyle fashion scene rather than an actual cleaning action; her left arm hangs naturally at her side. Warm sunlight streams in from the window, creating soft highlights on her clothes and skin, with subtle reflections on the glass. Outside, a bright cityscape of towering office buildings stretches out. The interior background is soft-focused, revealing a minimalist office with a potted plant, a desk, and an office chair. The composition uses a vertical layout reminiscent of a high-end magazine cover, with the full-body shot cropped to mid-calf, and the model slightly to the right to allow for layout space on the left. Elegant Japanese fashion magazine-style cover text is added: a very large serif masthead in the upper left corner, with the text {argument name="main title" default="Office Muse"} The "Office" section is white, and the "Muse" section is dark blue. The top left corner features small, uppercase text: "CITY LIFE / BEAUTY / CAREER." The top right corner displays the issue number: "JUNE 2024" and "VOL. 28." It includes five additional text blocks: a Japanese subtitle below the main title; the "BEAUTY" section and Japanese text in the left sidebar; the "CAREER" section and Japanese text in the left sidebar; the prominent "Focus On You" title and a Japanese subtitle in the bottom left corner; and the "Interview" section and Japanese text within a semi-transparent light-colored circle in the bottom right corner. Three small blue rectangular labels are added near the bottom left corner, with content {argument name="tag line 1" default="SKINCARE ROUTINE"} ,{argument name="tag line 2" default="WORK SMARTER"} and{argument name="tag line 3" default="MINDFUL LIFE"} Overall atmosphere: exquisite, feminine, desirable, urban, elegant, professional, luxurious, clean natural light, realistic digital photography with a subtle fashion retouching feel, high-end Japanese magazine cover design.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的高级时尚杂志封面肖像，拍摄了一位美丽的年轻职场女性，她站在明亮的现代企业办公室落地窗旁，采用精致的编辑风格拍摄。她微微侧身面对镜头，表情冷静、优雅且自信，面部被柔和的矩形模糊效果刻意遮挡。她留着深棕色长发，编成粗侧辫垂在肩上。她身穿一件 {argument name="top color" default="深海军蓝"} 的修身罗纹半高领针织衫，短袖设计，左肩饰有三颗金色纽扣，下身搭配高腰黑色铅笔裙和细黑色腰带。她的右手抬起，拿着一块浅色清洁布抵在玻璃上，呈现出一种象征性的生活方式时尚场景，而非真实的清洁动作；左臂自然垂在身侧。温暖的日光从窗外射入，在她的衣物和皮肤上形成柔和的高光，玻璃上带有微妙的倒影，窗外是高耸办公楼组成的明亮城市景观。室内背景经过柔焦处理，可见一个极简主义办公室，内有 1 盆植物、1 张办公桌和 1 把办公椅。构图采用高级杂志封面的垂直布局，全身照裁剪至小腿中部，模特略微偏右，以便在左侧留出排版空间。添加优雅的日系时尚杂志风格封面文字：左上角放置一个非常大的衬线字体刊头，文字为 {argument name="main title" default="Office Muse"}，“Office”为白色，“Muse”为深蓝色；左上角有小型大写文字“CITY LIFE / BEAUTY / CAREER”；右上角有小型期号文字“JUNE 2024”和“VOL. 28”。包含 5 个额外的文本块：主标题下方的一行日文副标题；左侧栏的“BEAUTY”美容板块及日文正文；左侧栏的“CAREER”职场板块及日文正文；左下角醒目的大标题“Focus On You”及一行日文副标题；右下角一个半透明浅色圆圈内的“Interview”访谈板块及日文文字。在左下角附近添加 3 个蓝色小矩形标签，内容分别为 {argument name="tag line 1" default="SKINCARE ROUTINE"}、{argument name="tag line 2" default="WORK SMARTER"} 和 {argument name="tag line 3" default="MINDFUL LIFE"}。整体氛围：精致、女性化、令人向往、都市感、优雅、专业、奢华、干净的自然光，具有微妙时尚修图感的写实数字摄影，高级日系杂志封面设计。

templates.title: Elegant urban fashion magazine cover

titleLocalized.zh: 优雅都市时尚杂志封面

templates.prompt: Create a sophisticated, high-fashion magazine cover photo using a vertical portrait composition. The image depicts a beautiful young woman confidently walking towards the camera at sunset, against a backdrop of a modern financial district. She is centered, fully in the shot, taken from a street perspective with a cinematic depth of field, flanked by towering glass office buildings reflecting the warm golden sunset. The overall atmosphere is elegant, urban, powerful, and refined, like a high-end fashion magazine cover about after-get off work style. The woman has long, dark hair styled in a thick side braid, a slender and capable figure, and walks with the ease of a runway model. She wears a {argument name="top color" default="Burnt Orange"} A fitted ribbed turtleneck sweater with a decorative gold button on one shoulder, paired with a {argument name="skirt color" default="warm brown"} She wears a high-waisted pencil skirt, a black belt with gold buckles, and carries a structured black handbag. Her expression should be calm, confident, and elegant. Use soft, golden hour lighting to showcase realistic skin and fabric textures, with clear fashion photography quality in the clothing details. Slightly blurred business people strolling through the square in the background create a bustling city night atmosphere. The background should also include four office workers in the distance, softly focused, distributed along the walkway. Add realistic magazine cover typography to the image: a very striking and elegant serif masthead in the upper left corner, with text {argument name="magazine title" default="CITY POISE"} The lower left side features the cover titles: "AFTER-WORK STYLE THAT COMMANDS THE EVENING," "MODERN ELEGANCE," "Polished looks for the office and beyond," "WORK. WALK. WIND DOWN," "Versatile pieces that move with your day," "THE POWER OF NEUTRALS," and "Warm tones, clean lines, Quiet confidence." The upper right corner displays the smaller print "STYLE & CULTURE" and "MAY 2024." The lower right side includes the teaser: "Sunset meetings and city lights. Your best look starts here." The lower right corner also features the cover title "EVENING." "ELEVATED" (A Night of Advancement), accompanied by the small print "From desk to dinner plans—effortless style that transitions beautifully." A realistic barcode frame is placed in the lower right corner, containing "MAY 2024," the US/Canada price, the issue number, and the barcode lines. The overall composition should be simple, sophisticated, and balanced, presenting the feel of a genuine contemporary fashion magazine cover.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张精致编辑风格的高级时尚杂志封面照片，采用竖向肖像构图，展现一位美丽的年轻女性在日落时分自信地走向镜头，背景是现代金融区。她处于画面中心，全身出镜，以街头视角拍摄，具有电影般的景深效果，两侧高耸的玻璃办公大楼反射着温暖的金色夕阳。整体氛围优雅、都市、充满力量且精致，如同关于下班后风格的高端时尚杂志封面。这位女性留着深色长发，梳成厚实的侧边麻花辫，身形苗条干练，步伐从容如走秀。她身穿一件 {argument name="top color" default="焦橙色"} 的修身罗纹高领毛衣，一侧肩部带有装饰性金色纽扣，搭配一条 {argument name="skirt color" default="暖棕色"} 的高腰铅笔裙，系着黑色金扣腰带，手提一个结构感十足的黑色手袋。她的表情应显得冷静、自信且优雅。使用柔和的黄金时刻光线，呈现真实的皮肤和织物纹理，服装细节具备清晰的时尚摄影质感，背景中略微模糊的商务人士穿梭在广场上，营造出繁忙的城市夜晚氛围。背景应包含 4 位远处的办公人员，焦点柔和，分布在步道上。在图像上添加写实的杂志封面排版：左上角放置一个非常醒目且优雅的衬线字体刊头，文字为 {argument name="magazine title" default="CITY POISE"}；其下方左侧为封面标题：“AFTER-WORK STYLE THAT COMMANDS THE EVENING”（掌控夜晚的下班后风格）、“MODERN ELEGANCE”（现代优雅）、“Polished looks for the office and beyond.”（职场内外的精致造型）、“WORK. WALK. WIND DOWN.”（工作、漫步、放松）、“Versatile pieces that move with your day.”（随心而动的百搭单品）、“THE POWER OF NEUTRALS”（中性色的力量）以及“Warm tones, clean lines, Quiet confidence.”（暖色调，利落线条，静谧自信）；右上角为小字“STYLE & CULTURE”（风格与文化）和“MAY 2024”（2024 年 5 月）；其下方右侧为预告语：“Sunset meetings and city lights. Your best look starts here.”（夕阳会议与城市灯火，从这里开启你的最佳造型。）；右下角为封面标题“EVENING ELEVATED”（进阶之夜），配以小字“From desk to dinner plans— effortless style that transitions beautifully.”（从办公桌到晚餐约会，轻松转换的完美风格。）；右下角放置一个写实的条形码框，包含“MAY 2024”、美加价格、期号及条形码线条。整体构图应简洁、高级、平衡，并呈现出真实当代时尚杂志封面的质感。

templates.title: Dark Cyber ​​Elf wielding a crimson blade

titleLocalized.zh: 手持深红之刃的暗黑赛博精灵

templates.prompt: A dark, highly detailed anime cyberpunk gothic portrait, the main character is {argument name="character type" default="Female Elf Warrior"} The image, taken from a three-quarter profile, spans from above the thighs to the head, with a backdrop of an abandoned futuristic industrial city. She kept {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} She had a short, ear-length bob haircut, pale skin, long, pointed elf ears, a calm and aloof expression, and one glowing ear was visible.{argument name="eye color" default="Dark red"} Eyes. Strands of hair brushed against her face, a black star-shaped metal hair ornament adorning her temples. She wore a sleek black biomechanical armor skirt, its surface gleaming like obsidian, studded with spikes and layered plates, the shoulders and chest decorated with torn lace and intricate demonic exoskeleton details. One arm was encased in heavy armor, forming a massive organic mechanical gauntlet. She wielded, or fused with, a massive, serrated, living longsword, its blade slicing diagonally from the lower left foreground into her torso; the blade was crafted from black metal, covered in luminous veins and embedded with a red core, from which raging molten lava energy erupted like liquid flames. Red ribbons of energy, sparks, smoke, and ember-like particles swirled around her body and weapon. The background was a vertical, dystopian megastructure, filled with black steel towers, cables, hanging chains, fragments of red holographic code, mysterious technological emblems, and blurred industrial symbols, mostly swallowed by shadow. Employing a black and deep red color palette, the artwork boasts extremely high contrast, glossy highlights, sharp rim lighting, a strong backlighting effect behind the head, dense details, a chaotic painterly feel, and a chilling apocalyptic atmosphere. The composition presents the quality of top-tier dark fantasy key art, highly refined, cinematic, both majestic and elegant, yet brimming with explosive power.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅暗黑超细节动漫赛博哥特风格肖像，主角为 {argument name="character type" default="女性精灵战士"}，采用四分之三侧面视角，构图范围从大腿上方至头部，背景为废弃的未来工业城市。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色"} 的短款齐耳波波头，皮肤苍白，长而尖的精灵耳，表情冷静冷峻，露出一只发光的 {argument name="eye color" default="深红色"} 眼睛。发丝随风拂过脸庞，太阳穴附近佩戴着黑色的星形金属发饰。身着一套光滑的黑色生物机械装甲裙，表面呈现黑曜石般的光泽，带有尖刺和分层板甲，肩部和胸部饰有撕裂的蕾丝质感，并点缀着复杂的恶魔外骨骼细节。一只手臂被重型装甲包裹，形成巨大的有机机械护手。她手持或融合了一把巨大的锯齿状活体长剑，剑身从左下角前景斜向穿过至她的躯干；剑身由黑色金属打造，布满发光的脉络和嵌入的红色核心，狂暴的熔岩能量如液态火焰般喷涌而出。红色的能量丝带、火花、烟雾和余烬般的颗粒围绕着她的身体和武器盘旋。背景是一座垂直的敌托邦巨型建筑，充斥着黑色钢塔、电缆、悬挂的锁链、红色全息代码碎片、神秘科技徽章以及模糊的工业符号，大部分被阴影吞没。采用黑色与深红色的调色板，具有极高的对比度、光泽高光、锐利的轮廓光、头部后方强烈的背光效果、密集的细节、混乱的绘画感以及冷酷的末日氛围。构图呈现出顶级暗黑奇幻关键艺术的质感，高度精致、电影感十足，既威严优雅又充满爆发力。

templates.title: Cyberpunk 404: The Witch Summoning

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克 404 女巫召唤

templates.prompt: A highly dramatic, anime-style cyberpunk witch illustration. She stands on a dark rooftop high in a futuristic city at night, her perspective slightly downward. The protagonist is a young witch with fair skin, an ice-blue bob, elfin ears, and a cunning, confident gaze. She holds aloft a black wand, the tip of which dangles a faint purplish-red glow. She wears a huge black pointed witch's hat, lined with purple and covered in stitched patches, warning labels, ribbons, and white patterns, including the prominent "404" and a skull emblem. She is dressed in a black and purple futuristic outfit: an oversized hooded jacket with numerous ribbons and labels, a short black top with "404" printed on the chest, multiple belts, shorts, a single-leg fishnet stocking, black lace-up combat boots, a choker, and metallic accessories. The multiple hanging ribbons and labels clearly display "WITCH 404," "404," and glitch art-style markings. Beneath and beside her, a massive, glowing purple magic circle, blending hacker interface aesthetics with a rooftop, is projected onto the ground. The circle is filled with mysterious rings, runes, a central skull symbol, and scattered neon system text (like error code snippets), creating an atmosphere where witchcraft and digital corruption intertwine. Emerging from the magic circle is a massive armored summon: a black, futuristic demon knight or robotic familiar, clad in jagged, reflective armor, wearing a long, glowing purple mask, wielding a heavy weapon in one hand, its body dissipating into purple energy fragments and smoke. The background depicts a vast, rain-soaked metropolis, towering skyscrapers with industrial-looking rooftops filled with windows, balconies, cables, signs, and mist. A large, vertical graffiti-style sign on a nearby building displays three clearly visible elements: “404,” “Witch,” and “ERROR NOT FOUND,” along with a smaller “E404.” Additional purple neon glitch text and symbols are scattered across the rooftops and in the air. The overall design employs a dark color palette of black, indigo, and deep purple, accented with vibrant magenta and purple highlights, resulting in cinematic contrast, a reflective, wet-look surface, rich detail, and a sophisticated, high-end illustration style. The atmosphere is mysterious, avant-garde, stylish, and dangerous, perfectly blending urban fantasy, hacker aesthetics, and magical summoning elements.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的动漫风格赛博朋克女巫插画，她站在深夜未来都市高处的阴暗屋顶上，视角略微俯视。主角是一位皮肤白皙、留着冰蓝色短波波头、长着精灵尖耳、眼神狡黠自信的年轻女巫。她右手高举一根黑色魔杖，杖尖悬挂的球形饰物散发着淡淡的紫红色光芒。她戴着一顶巨大的黑色尖顶女巫帽，内衬为紫色，上面布满了缝补的补丁、警告标签、带子以及白色图案，包括醒目的“404”字样和骷髅徽章。她身穿黑紫色科技感服装：带有许多带子和标签的超大连帽夹克、胸前印有“404”的黑色短款上衣、多层腰带、短裤、单腿渔网袜、黑色系带战斗靴、颈圈以及金属配饰。多条悬挂的带子和标签上清晰可见“WITCH 404”、“404”以及故障艺术风格的标记。在她身下及身侧，屋顶地面投射出一个巨大的紫色发光魔法阵，融合了黑客界面美学，阵中充满了神秘圆环、符文、中央骷髅标志以及散落的霓虹系统文本（如错误代码片段），营造出巫术与数字腐蚀交织的氛围。从魔法阵中浮现出一个巨大的装甲召唤物：一个黑色的未来派恶魔骑士或机器人使魔，身披锯齿状反光盔甲，戴着狭长的紫色发光面罩，单手持重型武器，身体部分正在消散为紫色的能量碎片与烟雾。背景展现了一座广阔的雨中大都市，高楼林立，屋顶工业感十足，布满了窗户、阳台、电缆、招牌和雾气。附近建筑的墙上有一个巨大的垂直涂鸦风格招牌，上面有 3 个清晰可见的元素：“404”、“Witch”和“ERROR NOT FOUND”，以及一个较小的“E404”。屋顶和空中散布着额外的紫色霓虹故障文字和符号。整体采用黑色、靛蓝和深紫色的暗色调，搭配鲜明的洋红色与紫色高光，具有电影级的对比度、反光的湿润表面、丰富的细节以及高端精致的插画风格。氛围神秘、前卫、时尚且危险，完美融合了都市奇幻、黑客美学与魔法召唤元素。

templates.title: Four-panel comic strip: The Story of a Girl, a Robot, and a Goat

titleLocalized.zh: 四格漫画：女孩、机器人与山羊的故事

promptLocalized.zh: {"type":"四格电影感奇幻插画拼贴","subject":{"primary duo":"一名白发小女孩和一名高大饱经风霜的人形机器人","companion animal":"一只小白山羊","relationship":"在不同时间和季节里安静而充满保护欲的陪伴","girl":{"age_appearance":"幼童","hair":"短波波头，白色或银色头发，直刘海","clothing":"简约宽松的白裙，深色踝靴，其中一格中肩膀上裹着浅色斗篷或毯子","expression":"平静、温柔、沉思","features":"柔和的动漫风格面孔，娇小的体型"},"robot":{"scale":"与女孩相比非常高大","design":"老旧且饱经战火的人形机械，带有深色铁质装甲板，裸露的电缆和机械关节，宽阔的肩膀，长肢","head":"棱角分明的头盔状头部，带有成簇的红色发光传感器","surface":"锈迹、划痕、磨损的金属，局部略有植被覆盖或沾染泥土"},"animal":{"species":"山羊","appearance":"带有短角的小白山羊","behavior":"在每一格中都安静地待在女孩身边"}},"layout":{"grid":"2x2","panel_count":4,"gutters":"格间细白边框","sections":[{"title":"左上","position":"左上","count":3,"labels":["女孩站在浅雨水中，像撑伞一样拿着一片大叶子","机器人低头保护性地走在她身边","山羊走在她的另一侧"]},{"title":"右上","position":"右上","count":3,"labels":["女孩坐在草地高处背对镜头","机器人坐在她身边注视着日落","山羊坐在他们附近，俯瞰着发光的山谷和湖泊"]},{"title":"左下","position":"左下","count":3,"labels":["女孩蹲在森林溪流旁触摸水面","机器人蹲在身后温柔地观察","山羊在溪边喝水"]},{"title":"右下","position":"右下","count":4,"labels":["女孩坐在小篝火旁拿着马克杯","机器人蹲在火堆旁取暖","山羊蜷缩在火堆旁睡觉","黑色的水壶悬挂在火焰上方"]}]},"environments":{"top-left":"雨中废墟小径，有水洼，雾蒙蒙的灰色氛围，背景中有模糊的杂草丛生的建筑","top-right":"金色的日落景观，带有温暖的云彩、远山、反光的湖水和草坡","bottom-left":"阳光斑驳的绿色森林，旁边有一条清澈的浅溪，透过树叶的明亮光斑","bottom-right":"夜晚的蓝色雪林，飘着雪花，亲密的火光与寒冷的周围环境形成对比"},"style":{"genre":"忧郁的科幻奇幻","rendering":"高度精细的绘画风格动漫插画","lighting":"每一格都有戏剧性的电影级布光，在雨天、日落、森林白昼和火光雪夜之间有强烈的氛围转换","color_palette":"柔和的灰色和蓝绿色，与温暖的琥珀色日落和橙色火光相平衡","composition":"情感细腻的陪伴场景，机器人经常倾斜或蹲下以配合孩子的身高，富有感染力的叙事，柔和的景深"}}
