templates.title: Tokyo DisneySea Front Row Battle UI

titleLocalized.zh: 东京迪士尼海洋前排争夺战 UI

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed, comedic-style screenshot of a Japanese arcade fighting game, employing a battle scene style that overlays the aesthetics of a real photograph with the game's UI. The scene depicts a simulated battle between two groups of theme park fans vying for front-row seats in the outdoor plaza of Tokyo DisneySea. A 16:9 widescreen composition is used. The background clearly shows the Mediterranean harbor and Mount Prometheus, with a bright sky and clearly visible waterfront and DisneySea architecture. The foreground shows 10 young people dressed in winter casual wear, divided into two opposing teams of 5 against 5, leaning forward, grabbing, reaching out, and pushing like in a tug-of-war, their exaggerated movements resembling a still frame from a fighting game. Faces are anonymized using soft blurring. Floating character tags are added above each person, indicating their rank and Japanese name. The overall tone is absurd yet realistic, like a real snapshot transformed into a beautifully rendered arcade game battle scene. A complete Japanese fighting game HUD is added, featuring a bright blue-red contrast interface style. At the top is a central stage title bar that reads "Front Row Battle at Tokyo DisneySea Mickey Plaza Show," with a large timer displaying "TIME 89" in the center. A blue team title "PLAYER1" and team name "Front Row Hardcore Fan A" are added to the top left corner. A red team title "RIVAL" and team name "Rival Group B" are added to the top right corner. Five blue player status panels are stacked on the left, including avatars, levels, Japanese-style job nicknames, HP, SP, and BURST gauges. The five labels on the left are: "Lv.25 Hardcore Captain Yuuki," "Lv.24 Muscular Man," "Lv.23 Glasses Otaku Shinji," "Lv.23 Open-Heart Max Kento," and "Lv.22 Support Personnel Ryo." On the right, five red opponent status panels are stacked, labeled: "Lv.27 Opponent Captain Daiki", "Lv.26 Power Representative Victor", "Lv.24 Strategist Koji", "Lv.23 Hot-Blooded Han Riku", and "Lv.22 Support Girl Saki". Each panel should contain numerical HP and SP, as well as a segmented BURST gauge, similar in style to a Japanese arcade RPG fighting game interface. Above the fighters in the central scene, ten battle nameplates are placed, with the left team in blue and the right team in red. The ten labels are: "Lv.24 Takeru", "Lv.25 Yuuki", "Lv.23 Shinji", "Lv.23 Kento", "Lv.22 Ryo", "Lv.27 Daiki", "Lv.26 Victor", "Lv.23 Riku", "Lv.22 Saki", and "Lv.22 Misaki". Add a skill menu titled "Skills" in the bottom left corner, listing 5 skills with SP consumption: "Dash Assault SP 20", "Shoulder Push SP 25", "Use Luggage to Reserve Space SP 15", "Rope Drill SP 10", and "Instinct SP 50". Below this, add a dark description box explaining the highlighted skill "Instinct": "Use your aura to intimidate your opponent and push them away! For a certain period, the opponent is more likely to be stunned! (Greatly consumes BURST Gauge) Effect duration: 10 seconds". Add an item menu titled "Items" at the bottom center, containing 5 slots displaying icons and quantities: Water Bottle "x3", Folded Purple Towel "x2", Blue Drawstring Bag "x1", Gray Backpack "x1", and Lunch Box "x2". A mission panel titled "Mission" is added to the bottom right corner, with the mission text "Defend the front row until the show starts!" and the condition text "Condition: Push all members of the opposing team back to the back!". The countdown text reads "Show start time: 02:30". A small map titled "Mickey Square MAP" is added next to it, displaying the red and blue dots for the two teams in the square. At the very bottom edge, small Japanese controller prompts are included for actions such as skill usage, item usage, grab/push, and dash. Dramatic high-saturation lighting, sharp details, realistic clothing folds, and authentic square cobblestones are used to create a high-end Japanese game screenshot feel. The visuals should evoke an absurd yet believable crossover, as if combining a real photograph of Tokyo DisneySea crowds with a competitive arcade battle game interface.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张超精细的喜剧风格日本街机格斗游戏截图，采用对战场景样式，将真实照片的美学与游戏 UI 叠加在一起。场景展示了东京迪士尼海洋户外演出广场上，两组主题乐园粉丝为争夺前排位置而进行的激烈模拟对战。使用 16:9 宽屏构图。背景清晰可见地中海港湾和普罗米修斯山，天空明亮，水岸和迪士尼海洋的建筑清晰可见。前景展示 10 名身穿冬季休闲装的年轻人，分为 5 对 5 的两个对立阵营，像拔河一样身体前倾、抓扯、伸手、推搡，争夺位置，动作夸张，如同格斗游戏中的定格画面。面部使用柔和的模糊块进行匿名处理。在每个人上方添加悬浮角色标签，标注等级和日文名称。整体基调荒诞而写实，就像一张真实的抓拍照片被转化为精美的街机游戏对战画面。

添加一套完整的日式格斗游戏 HUD，采用亮面蓝红对比界面风格。最上方放置一个中央舞台标题栏，文字为“东京迪士尼海洋 米奇广场 演出最前排对战”，中间显示大计时器“TIME 89”。左上角添加蓝色队伍标题“PLAYER1”及队名“最前排硬核粉丝 A”。右上角添加红色队伍标题“RIVAL”及队名“竞争对手组 B”。左侧堆叠 5 个蓝色玩家状态面板，包含头像、等级、日式职业昵称、HP、SP 和 BURST 槽。左侧 5 个标签分别为：“Lv.25 硬核队长 勇树”、“Lv.24 肌肉男 武”、“Lv.23 眼镜宅 真司”、“Lv.23 开角心 MAX 健人”、“Lv.22 支援人员 亮”。右侧堆叠 5 个红色对手状态面板，标签为：“Lv.27 对手队长 大辉”、“Lv.26 力量代表 胜”、“Lv.24 战略家 浩二”、“Lv.23 热血汉 陆”、“Lv.22 支援女生 咲”。每个面板应包含数值化的 HP 和 SP 以及分段式 BURST 槽，风格类似于日式街机 RPG 格斗界面。

在中心场景的格斗者上方放置 10 个战斗名牌，左侧队伍为蓝色，右侧队伍为红色。10 个标签分别为：“Lv.24 武”、“Lv.25 勇树”、“Lv.23 真司”、“Lv.23 健人”、“Lv.22 亮”、“Lv.27 大辉”、“Lv.26 胜”、“Lv.23 陆”、“Lv.22 咲”、“Lv.22 美咲”。

左下角添加一个标题为“技能”的技能菜单，列出 5 个带有 SP 消耗的技能：“冲刺突击 SP 20”、“肩推强夺 SP 25”、“用行李占位 SP 15”、“钻绳索 SP 10”、“本气的毅力 SP 50”。下方添加一个深色说明框，解释高亮技能“本气的毅力”，文字为：“用气势威压对手，将其推开！一定时间内，对手更容易产生硬直！（大幅消耗 BURST 槽）效果时间：10 秒”。

底部中央添加一个标题为“道具”的道具菜单，包含 5 个显示图标和数量的槽位：水瓶“x3”、折叠紫色毛巾“x2”、蓝色抽绳包“x1”、灰色双肩包“x1”和盒饭“x2”。右下角添加一个标题为“任务”的任务面板，任务文字为“在演出开始前死守最前排！”，条件文字为“条件：将竞争对手组全员推回后方！”，倒计时文字为“距离演出开始：02:30”。旁边添加一个标题为“米奇广场 MAP”的小地图，显示广场上两队的红蓝点。在最底部边缘，包含用于技能使用、道具使用、抓取/推搡和冲刺等操作的小型日文控制器提示。

使用戏剧性的高饱和度光影、清晰的细节、写实的衣物褶皱、真实的广场石板路，呈现高端日本游戏截图的质感。画面应给人一种荒谬但可信的跨界感，仿佛是一张真实的东京迪士尼海洋人群照片与竞技街机对战游戏界面的结合。

templates.title: Japanese AI application promotion banner

titleLocalized.zh: 日文 AI 应用推广横幅

templates.prompt: Create a beautifully designed Japanese tech ad banner for a mobile app, in a 16:9 widescreen aspect ratio. The background features a futuristic blue-purple gradient, filled with glowing network lines, connecting nodes, soft lens flares, and delicate digital particles. At the top center is a modern app logo: a cyan hexagonal icon containing a large white “SC” and a small circuit symbol, followed by the brand text “SKILL Cert by AI” in a clean sans-serif font. “SKILL” is large and black, “Cert” is below it and also black, while “by AI” is smaller and cyan. At the center of the design is a striking Japanese headline in oversized white font with a dark blue outline and soft shadow.{argument name="headline text" default="AI-generated qualification certification application"} Next, add a second line of medium-sized white Japanese subtitle below, also with an outline and shadow:{argument name="subheadline text" default="Over 200 certifications for online battles"} Place a large, glossy, rounded rectangular call-to-action (CTA) button in the center of the foreground. It should be a bright cyan color with subtle gradients, bevels, and shadows, and contain striking white Japanese text.{argument name="button text" default="Instant free battles"} Three smartphone prototypes are showcased, arranged around the center: one at the bottom left, slightly tilted to the right, displays a leaderboard application interface with a line graph at the top, a small profile picture, a ranking list, and Japanese UI labels; a larger phone at the bottom right, slightly tilted to the left, displays a multiple-choice interface with Japanese question text, radio buttons, and a cyan button at the bottom; and a smaller phone at the far right edge, tilted inward, displays a dark dashboard-style interface with charts and Japanese text. Four floating UI graphic elements are added to the background: an analytical line graph panel at the top left, a holographic cube/dashboard cluster at the top right, a glowing wireframe brain or neural sphere behind a button at the bottom left, and a hexagonal chart/card element at the center right. A sleek AI, SaaS, and EdTech marketing aesthetic is employed, emphasizing high contrast, clean typography, hierarchy, neon effects, and advanced app promotion lighting.

promptLocalized.zh: 制作一张精美的日文科技广告横幅，用于移动应用，比例为 16:9 宽屏。背景采用充满未来感的蓝紫色渐变，布满发光的网络线条、连接节点、柔和的镜头光晕以及细腻的数字粒子。在顶部中心放置一个现代感应用 Logo：一个青色六边形图标，内部包含大号白色字母“SC”及一个小巧的电路符号，随后是品牌文字“SKILL Cert by AI”，采用简洁的无衬线字体，“SKILL”字号较大且为黑色，“Cert”位于其下方且为黑色，“by AI”字号较小且为青色。构图中心放置一行醒目的日文大标题，采用超大白色字体，带有深蓝色描边和柔和的投影：{argument name="headline text" default="AI 出题的资格认证对战应用"}。紧接着在下方添加第二行中等大小的白色日文副标题，同样带有描边和投影：{argument name="subheadline text" default="200 多种资格认证在线对战"}。在前景中间放置一个大型光泽圆角矩形行动号召（CTA）按钮，采用亮青色，带有细腻的渐变、斜面和阴影效果，内含醒目的白色日文文字：{argument name="button text" default="立即免费对战"}。展示 3 台智能手机样机，环绕中心排列：1 台位于左下方，略微向右倾斜，显示排行榜应用界面，顶部有折线图、小型个人资料头像、排名列表及日文 UI 标签；1 台较大的手机位于右下方，略微向左倾斜，显示多项选择题界面，包含日文题目文本、单选按钮以及底部的青色按钮；1 台较小的手机位于最右侧边缘，向内倾斜，显示深色仪表盘风格界面，包含图表和日文文本。在背景中添加 4 组悬浮的 UI 图形元素：左上方放置一个分析折线图面板，右上方放置一个全息立方体/仪表盘集群，左下方按钮后方放置一个发光的线框大脑或神经球体，右侧中心放置一个六边形图表/卡片元素。采用时尚的 AI、SaaS 和教育科技营销美学，强调高对比度、清晰的排版、层次感、霓虹光效以及高级的应用推广照明效果。

templates.title: Weathered Custom Cub Concept Motorcycle

titleLocalized.zh: 风化定制版 Cub 概念摩托车

templates.prompt: A highly detailed concept illustration showcases a heavily modified retro underbone motorcycle inspired by the Honda Super Cub, presented in a clean, studio-styled 4/3 left-hand perspective against a pure light gray background. The motorcycle boasts a rugged, post-apocalyptic street-custom aesthetic, employing a low-saturation black, white, and gray color scheme accented with touches of pink decals and paintwork. The strong weathering effect is emphasized: the body is covered in paint chips, scratches, oil stains, dirt, rust, ink splatters, worn edges, and layers of sticker residue. The front features a single square headlight with an X-shaped light pattern and two smaller, stacked auxiliary lights below. It utilizes spoked wheels, thick off-road tires, a visible front suspension, exposed mechanical details, chain drive, and a sturdy center stand that touches the ground. The leg guards and side panels are covered in graphic decals, Japanese warning labels, numbers, symbols, and distressed lettering, while a prominent large Chinese character is prominently displayed on the front fairing. Two hard-sided cargo boxes are added to the rear; the larger one is further away, while the smaller one is black with additional stickers. A vertical tag hangs near the rear boxes. It features a long black striped seat, rear rack frame, exposed wiring, metal brackets, bolts, and compact, practical accessories, giving it both a handcrafted look and functional design. The rendering style blends industrial design sketches with exquisite anime mecha concept art: precise lines, watercolor-style shadows, soft gray ground projections, highly detailed mechanical realism, slightly messy ink-lined edges, and the texture of a collector's item custom motorcycle illustration.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度精细的概念插图，展示了一辆受 Honda Super Cub 启发、经过深度改装的复古弯梁摩托车，采用干净的摄影棚风格，呈现左侧 4/3 视角，背景为纯浅灰色。这辆摩托车具有粗犷的后启示录街头改装美学，采用黑、白、灰的低饱和度配色，并点缀有少量粉色贴纸和涂装。重点强调强烈的风化效果：车身各处布满掉漆、划痕、油渍、污垢、锈斑、墨迹飞溅、边缘磨损以及层叠的贴纸残胶。车头配有 1 个方形大灯（带 X 型灯光图案）以及下方 2 个较小的堆叠式辅助灯。使用辐条轮毂、厚实的越野轮胎、可见的前悬挂、裸露的机械细节、链条传动，以及一个触地的坚固中心支架。腿部护板和侧板上覆盖着图形贴纸、日式警告标签、数字、符号和做旧的字体，前整流罩上有一个醒目的大号汉字标记。后部加装 2 个硬质侧边货箱，远侧为一个较大的货箱，近侧为一个贴有额外贴纸的黑色货箱，后箱附近还挂着 1 个垂直的吊牌挂饰。配备 1 个长条黑色条纹坐垫、后货架框架、裸露的线路、金属支架、螺栓以及紧凑的实用配件，使其看起来既有手工改装感又具备实用功能。渲染风格融合了工业设计草图与精致的动漫机甲概念艺术：精准的线条、水彩渲染的阴影、柔和的灰色地面投影、高细节的机械写实感、略显凌乱的墨线边缘，以及一种收藏级定制摩托车插画的质感。

templates.title: Medieval shot with reverse camera

titleLocalized.zh: 中世纪正反打镜头

templates.prompt: A series of cinematic medieval reverse shots, presented as grainy historical film stills, utilize a 21:9 ultrawide aspect ratio, overcast natural light, soft earth tones, a damp autumn atmosphere, realistic muddy textures, shallow depth of field, and strong over-the-shoulder composition. The scene is set on a muddy country road winding through a rural valley, flanked by rough wooden fences. In the distance are low, rolling hills covered with sparse trees, open fields, and a light-colored stone farmhouse or church on a hillside to the right. Two characters stand facing each other on the road. One is a weary medieval peasant, wearing a dirty brown tunic and hat, of medium build, carrying a wooden-handled axe on his shoulder and a leather belt across his chest. The other is a knight or armed traveler, wearing dark, weathered chainmail and a tattered hooded blouse, standing warily. Please create a reverse shot demonstration using cinematic grammar: First frame shown.{argument name="foreground character" default="Farmer carrying an axe"} From the perspective of his back in the right foreground, his shoulders and back occupy the right foreground of the image, while{argument name="background character" default="Knight in chainmail"} The first frame shows the knight in a full-body shot on the left, facing the camera and standing on a muddy road; the second frame reverses the angle, showing the knight's shoulders and hooded back blurred in the left foreground, while the farmer stands in the right mid-ground, carrying an axe. Maintaining consistency in location, weather, clothing, lens quality, and spacing between characters in both shots creates a restrained dramatic realism and a tense confrontational atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极其精致的动漫横幅插画，背景为温暖的金色文学部教室，采用宽幅电影感构图。左半部分是一个巨大的优雅发光手写标题，显示为 {argument name="headline text" default="Monika"}，采用超大书法字体，呈现白色和淡绿色，带有柔和的霓虹光晕、金属高光、装饰性花纹、爱心、闪光以及周围环绕的漩涡状装饰线条。右半部分是一位美丽的动漫女高中生，灵感源自 {argument name="character name" default="Monika"}，她坐在木质课桌前，身体略微朝左，留着长长的飘逸 {argument name="hair color" default="栗棕色"} 头发，系着一个巨大的白色蝴蝶结，有着温暖的棕色眼睛，表情沉思且自信。她身穿日本高中校服，包含 4 件清晰可见的服饰：棕色西装外套、白色衬衫、红色丝带领结和棕色菱格纹毛衣背心。她一只手拿着钢笔放在桌上的纸张上，另一只手靠近脸部，呈现出优雅的写作姿态。房间里充满了从高窗射入的夕阳余晖，空气中漂浮着尘埃微粒、飘带般的绿色丝带、花瓣，背景中挂着手写便签，黑板上写满了模糊的草书和几何涂鸦。画面中包含 9 个显眼的课桌和房间道具：左下角的一束白玫瑰、左侧的一叠书、中左侧的一个沙漏、一个带有绿色叶子徽章的密封信封、桌上散落的手稿页、书写手旁的一个笔帽、一把绿色软垫椅子、右后方的一架钢琴，以及右侧的一叠 4 本书。右侧 4 本书的书脊从上到下依次写着：“Save Me”、“My Feelings”、“Poems for the Literature Club” 和 “Just Monika”。添加丰富的体积光、闪烁的粒子、绿色与金色的色彩和谐、细腻的线条、超详细的绘画式阴影、浪漫视觉小说关键视觉图品质，以及高级精致的缩略图/横幅美学。

templates.title: Glass Reality Weaver in the Cosmic Hall

titleLocalized.zh: 宇宙大厅中的玻璃现实编织者

templates.prompt: A grand, cinematic-quality digital art scene depicting a cosmic fantasy: In the center of the left side of the image sits a colossal humanoid figure composed of transparent glass and liquid crystal, its body filled with luminous internal filaments, refracted highlights, and intricate swirling textures beneath its surface. The figure's posture resembles that of a divine craftsman or a real weaver, its hands raised, stretching and kneading a massive, luminous golden veil on the right side of the image. The face is smooth and blurred, almost like a mannequin, devoid of any discernible expression, thus highlighting the sculptural form and the effect of light penetrating the translucent skin. This fabric of light, like a living tapestry or membrane, presents a complete fantasy world: a viaduct, a dazzling futuristic city with slender towers and domes, multi-tiered terraces, luminous buildings, and three clusters of deep green trees growing in the air or on high ground. The environment surrounding the colossal life form is a grand celestial hall, with ornate arches and feather-like branching filaments of golden light, opening onto the deep blue midnight sky. The ground, polished black mirror stone, clearly reflects figures, gold lines, and architecture. Five reflective metal or glass spheres of varying sizes are placed in the foreground, capturing the surrounding gold and blue light. The emphasis is on the dramatic refraction of the glass structures, the shimmering caustics, the intricate light trails, and the rich reflections on the glossy ground. Color palette: deep navy blue, black, silver-blue, and shimmering gold. Atmosphere: awe-inspiring, mysterious, sacred, and visionary. Highly complex, Baroque sci-fi fantasy aesthetics, wide-angle composition, epic scale, extremely sharp details, volumetric lighting, and surreal realism.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅超精细电影级数字艺术的宏大宇宙奇幻场景：画面左中位置坐着一个由透明玻璃和液态水晶构成的巨大类人形象，其体内充盈着发光的内部丝状物、折射高光以及表面下精致的漩涡纹理。该形象姿态宛如一位神圣的工匠或现实编织者，双手高举，在画面右侧拉伸并捏合着一张巨大的发光金线面纱。面部平滑且模糊，近乎人体模型，没有可辨识的表情，从而突显了雕塑般的躯体以及光线穿透半透明皮肤的效果。这张光之织物如同活的挂毯或薄膜，其中呈现出一个完整的奇幻世界：1 座高架桥、1 座拥有细长塔楼和圆顶的璀璨未来城市、多层露台、发光建筑，以及 3 簇生长在浮空或高地上的深绿色树木。巨型生命体周围的环境是一个宏大的天体大厅，拥有华丽的拱门和由金光构成的羽毛状分支花丝结构，向深邃的午夜蓝星空敞开。地面为黑色抛光镜面石，清晰地反射出人物、金线和建筑。前景中放置了 5 个大小不一的反射金属或玻璃球，捕捉着周围的金光与蓝光。强调玻璃躯体带来的戏剧性折射、闪烁的焦散效果、错综复杂的光线轨迹，以及光亮地面上丰富的反射。调色板：深海军蓝、黑色、银蓝色和璀璨金。氛围：令人敬畏、神秘、神圣且富有远见。高度复杂、巴洛克式科幻奇幻美学、广角构图、史诗级规模、极其锐利的细节、体积光、超现实写实主义。

templates.title: Classic car magazine illustrated covers

titleLocalized.zh: 经典汽车杂志插画封面

templates.prompt: A minimalist editorial magazine cover set against a cream-colored studio background, its design reminiscent of high-end automotive illustration magazines. The main title at the top is in a large, compressed blue sans-serif font, and the content is {argument name="magazine title" default="AUTO ICON"} Below it is a small subtitle, "THE ILLUSTRATED AUTOMOBILE MAGAZINE". In the upper right corner, there is a small blue issue number text.{argument name="issue date" default="May 2026"} Below it is a line of large blue numbers with thin underlines: "No. 128". At the center of the image is a beautiful classic car.{argument name="car model" default="Red Blue Chea Stratos"} The illustration, taken from a 45-degree left-side front view, depicts a low-slung, wedge-shaped car with a bright red paint job, a black roof spoiler, pop-up headlights, finely detailed air vents on the hood, a black grille, gold wheels, realistic tires, and delicate reflections and shadows on the ground. A slender, anime-style figure stands on the right side of the car.{argument name="companion character" default="Blue-haired girl"} A full-body portrait, facing a car to the left, featuring a soft blue bob haircut with a small ponytail at the back of the head. Facial details are minimalist. She wears a white long-sleeved top, light blue skirt, white socks, and blue sneakers, carrying a blue shoulder bag. Her pose is casual, with one arm bent close to her chest. The design employs a refined style combining soft cel-shaded anime illustrations with realistic car rendering, retaining ample white space and maintaining an elegant balance in the print layout. Two large lines of red Japanese text are added to the left side of the cover.{argument name="main cover line" default="Red Lancia Stratos"} Below is a small blue Japanese subtitle: “伝説のラリーカーを、イラストで楽しむ.” Another line of small blue text reads “特集/ CLASSIC SPORTS,” along with a handwritten light red note: “with blue-haired girl.” In the lower left corner are two small pieces of Japanese cover text and a realistic barcode with tiny issue number numbers. The overall aesthetic remains minimalist, refined, transparent, and poster-like, featuring soft sunlight and shadows and a high-end Japanese magazine cover composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张在米白色摄影棚背景下的简洁编辑类杂志封面，设计风格如同高端汽车插画杂志。顶部的主标题为巨大的蓝色压缩无衬线字体，内容为 {argument name="magazine title" default="AUTO ICON"}，下方配有小型副标题“THE ILLUSTRATED AUTOMOBILE MAGAZINE”。在右上角，放置小型蓝色期号文本 {argument name="issue date" default="May 2026"}，其下方是一行带有细下划线的蓝色大号数字“No.128”。画面中心是一辆精美的经典 {argument name="car model" default="红色蓝旗亚 Stratos"} 插画，采用左侧前 45 度视角，车身低矮呈楔形，亮红色漆面，黑色车顶扰流板，弹出式大灯开启，引擎盖上有精细的通风口，黑色格栅，金色轮毂，逼真的轮胎，地面上有细腻的倒影和阴影。在汽车右侧站着一位身材苗条的动漫风格 {argument name="companion character" default="蓝发少女"}，全身像，面向左侧的汽车，留着柔和的蓝色短波波头，后脑勺扎着一小束头发，面部细节简约，身穿白色长袖上衣、浅蓝色短裙、白色短袜、蓝色运动鞋，背着蓝色单肩包，姿态随性，一只手臂弯曲靠近胸前。采用柔和的赛璐璐动漫插画与写实汽车渲染相结合的精致风格，保留大量留白，并保持优雅的印刷排版平衡。在左侧添加两行巨大的红色日文封面文字 {argument name="main cover line" default="赤いランチア・ストラトス"}，下方配有一行较小的蓝色日文副标题“伝説のラリーカーを、イラストで楽しむ。”。添加另一行蓝色小字“特集 / CLASSIC SPORTS”，以及一行手写风格的浅红色备注“with blue-haired girl”。在左下角，包含两块小型日文封面文案和一个带有微小期号数字的逼真条形码。整体美学保持极简、精致、通透且具有海报感，带有柔和的日光阴影和高端日系杂志封面的构图。

templates.title: Gangster cats playing poker

titleLocalized.zh: 黑帮猫咪打扑克

templates.prompt: A cinematic, ultra-detailed film noir scene unfolds: seven anthropomorphic house cats sit around a round, green felt poker table in a dimly lit, smoky underground bar. The central cat is the leader: a serious-looking tabby, dressed in a dark pinstripe suit, white shirt, tie, black fedora, and black sunglasses, calmly puffing on a thick cigar, the smoke dramatically rising to the overhead light fixture. Around him sit six other cats, all holding playing cards and dressed like gangster gamblers: on the far left is a gray tabby wearing a textured baseball cap and round sunglasses; next to it is a ginger cat wearing a dark fedora, thick gold chain, and sunglasses; to the right of center is a fluffy gray cat wearing a brown fedora; further to the right is a white tabby wearing a dark New York Yankees baseball cap and pendant necklace; and closer to the right is a striped cat in profile wearing a fedora and sunglasses; all the cats are dressed in gangster attire. The table is piled high with precise poker details: seven cats, each holding cards in its paws; stacks of red, blue, white, and black chips; scattered dollar bills; a whiskey glass to the right; and five community cards face up in the center. Warm amber lighting from a single overhead chandelier creates deep shadows, richly textured fur, realistic whiskers, reflective sunglasses, and a thick cigar smoke atmosphere. The background appears to be a dark wood-paneled gambling den, with vintage posters and signs on the walls, including a large poker poster on the left and a "ALL IN OR FOLD" sign on the right, along with bottles of liquor on shelves. The composition is a level, slightly wide-angle shot, centered on the cigar-smoking cats, creating a rugged yet luxurious gangster atmosphere with photorealistic realism, dramatic depth of field, high contrast, and cinematic color gradation.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个电影级、超细节的黑色电影风格场景，7 只拟人化的家猫围坐在圆形的绿色毛毡扑克桌旁，身处昏暗且烟雾缭绕的地下酒吧。中间的猫是老大：一只表情严肃的虎斑猫，身穿深色细条纹西装、白衬衫、系着领带，戴着黑色软呢帽和黑色墨镜，正从容地抽着一支粗雪茄，戏剧性的烟雾向上缭绕至头顶的灯具。周围坐着另外 6 只猫，它们都手持扑克牌，打扮得像黑社会赌徒：最左边是一只戴着质感鸭舌帽和圆形墨镜的灰虎斑猫；旁边是一只戴着深色软呢帽、粗金链和墨镜的姜黄色猫；中心右侧是一只戴着棕色软呢帽的毛茸茸灰猫；再往右是一只戴着深色纽约洋基队棒球帽和吊坠项链的白虎斑猫；右前方近处是一只戴着软呢帽和墨镜的侧身条纹猫；所有猫都呈现出黑帮造型。桌上堆满了精确的扑克细节：总共 7 只猫，每只猫爪中都拿着牌，桌上有成堆的红、蓝、白、黑筹码，散落的美元钞票，右前方放着一个威士忌酒杯，中间面朝上摆放着 5 张公共牌。使用来自上方单盏大吊灯的温暖琥珀色灯光，营造出深邃的阴影、质感丰富的毛发、逼真的胡须、反光的墨镜以及浓郁的雪茄烟雾氛围。背景应为一个深色木镶板的赌博窝点，墙上挂着复古海报和标志，包括左侧的一张大型扑克海报和右侧写有“ALL IN OR FOLD”的标牌，架子上还摆放着酒瓶。构图为平视视角且略带广角，以抽雪茄的猫为中心，营造出粗粝而奢华的黑帮氛围，具有照片级真实感、戏剧性的景深、高对比度以及电影级的色彩分级。

templates.title: Retro Super Famicom RPG Advertisement

titleLocalized.zh: 复古 Super Famicom RPG 广告

templates.prompt: Create a full-page retro Japanese Super Famicom game box advertisement, designed like a worn magazine page or game packaging front from the 1990s, presented on creased, stained, worn edges, fold marks, and slightly faded yellowed paper. The layout should have an authentic retro feel and be compact, including prominent Japanese promotional text, a fictional fantasy RPG logo, a roster of characters on the right, game screenshots on the left, and price and feature labels at the bottom. A large black "SUPER FAMICOM" title is placed in the upper left corner, with a smaller Japanese subtitle below and a line of red Japanese slogans nearby. The upper right corner contains a Super Famicom-style logo badge within a black rectangle, with the English text "SUPER FAMICOM LICENSED BY NINTENDO" below. The game title logo "Epic 7 Seven" is displayed at the top center in a gorgeous fantasy font, dark cyan and black, superimposed on a light blue circular magic emblem or mark. A small Japanese katakana subtitle is added below the logo. The right half showcases four anime/fantasy-style party members, rendered in a refined JRPG promotional illustration style: a young, white-haired male hero in a white cloak and blue-black attire, wielding a longsword; a pink-haired female knight or mage in dark armor with gold trim; a tall, black-haired swordsman in a dark, multi-layered robe; and a blonde, twin-tailed maid in a black and white ruffled skirt, extending one hand forward. Their faces should have generic, soft features, presented from a frontal or three-quarter profile, in a heroic pose. Four dark blue nameplates are added near each character, displaying their Japanese name and a brief job description. A vertical yellow Japanese slogan with a black outline is placed between the screenshot and the character group. The lower left side contains a screenshot of in-game combat within a dark blue rounded rectangle: a pixelated dungeon battle scene showing a purple dragon monster facing a four-person party against a stone corridor background. At the bottom of the battle screen, a classic RPG interface is displayed, featuring four Japanese command options and a team status list with character names, HP, and MP values. A red Japanese title is added to the lower left corner, followed by four black square bullet points for Japanese function text. A red circular promotional sticker with white Japanese text indicates high sales volume, next to a prominent price of "9,800 yen," surrounded by smaller Japanese retail text. The lower right corner contains a yellow information box labeled "RPG" with additional Japanese text, below which is a separate dark box indicating the number of players, "1." Retro print colors such as cream, dark blue, cyan, red, gold, black, and faded, soft character colors are used. The entire image should resemble a highly convincing fictional Super Famicom advertisement, promoting a {argument name="game title" default="Epic 7 Seven"} A classic fantasy RPG, featuring visible Japanese text, nostalgic typographical imperfections, and authentic 1990s console game marketing design.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张全页复古日本 Super Famicom 游戏盒广告，设计风格如同 1990 年代磨损的杂志内页或游戏包装正面，呈现于带有折痕、污渍、磨损边角、折叠痕迹及轻微印刷褪色的泛黄纸张上。排版应具有真实的复古感且布局紧凑，包含醒目的日文宣传文案、虚构的奇幻 RPG 标志、右侧的角色阵容、左侧的游戏截图，以及底部的价格和功能标注。左上角放置一个巨大的黑色“SUPER FAMICOM”标题，下方配有较小的日文副标题，附近有一行红色的日文标语。右上角包含一个黑色矩形内的 Super Famicom 风格标志徽章，下方附有英文文本“SUPER FAMICOM LICENSED BY NINTENDO”。顶部中央展示游戏标题标志“Epic 7 Seven”，采用华丽的奇幻字体，深青色与黑色，叠加在浅蓝色的圆形魔法纹章或印记之上。标志下方添加小号日文片假名副标题。右半部分展示 4 位动漫奇幻风格的队伍成员，采用精致的 JRPG 宣传插画风格：1 位身穿白色斗篷和蓝黑色服装、手持长剑的白发年轻男性英雄；1 位身穿带有金色饰边的深色盔甲的粉发女性骑士或法师；1 位身穿深色多层长袍的高个子黑长直剑士；以及 1 位身穿黑白荷叶边裙、单手向前伸出的金发双马尾女仆。他们的面部应为大众化且柔和的特征，正面或四分之三侧面视角，以英雄姿态构图。在每位角色附近添加 4 个深蓝色铭牌，标注日文角色名和简短的职业描述。在截图和角色组之间放置一条带有黑色轮廓的竖向黄色日文标语。左侧中下部包含 1 张深蓝色圆角矩形框内的游戏内战斗截图：一个像素风地下城战斗场景，展示 1 只紫色巨龙怪物面对 4 人小队，背景为石质走廊。在战斗画面底部，显示经典的 RPG 界面，包含 4 个日文指令选项以及带有角色名、HP 和 MP 值的队伍状态列表。左下角添加一个红色日文标题，后跟 4 个黑色方块项目符号的日文功能文本。底部中央放置一个带有白色日文文本的红色圆形促销贴纸，表示销量火爆，旁边印有醒目的“9,800円”价格，周围环绕较小的日文零售文本。右下角包含 1 个标有“RPG”的黄色信息框，内含额外的日文文本，下方是一个标有玩家人数“1人”的独立深色框。使用奶油色、深蓝色、青色、红色、金色、黑色以及褪色的柔和角色色彩等复古印刷色调。整张图像应看起来像是一张极具说服力的虚构 Super Famicom 广告，宣传名为 {argument name="game title" default="Epic 7 Seven"} 的经典奇幻 RPG，包含可见的日文文本、怀旧的印刷瑕疵以及地道的 1990 年代主机游戏营销设计。

templates.title: Retro Roaring Tiger Japanese Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 复古咆哮猛虎日式海报

templates.prompt: Create a bold, retro-Japanese-style poster on a square canvas, with a fierce, frontal tiger head as the sole central subject. The composition is perfectly symmetrical and occupies most of the frame. The tiger roars with its mouth wide open, revealing long, curved tusks, smaller lower teeth, a bright pink tongue, a dark throat, a pink nose, sharp yellow eyes, and dramatic black stripes covering its saturated orange fur, with white down on its cheeks and neck. Add decorative swirling stripes on its forehead to give the tiger's face a stylized, mythical feel. Use a rough, retro screen or stencil texture with noticeable grain, worn ink, and slightly broken edges, employing a limited palette of burnt orange, black, cream, white, soft pink, and touches of yellow. The background should be a flat, textured orange-red. In the upper right corner, include a small technical panel showing a side view of the tiger's skeleton, drawn with delicate cream lines, with compact, vertical Japanese annotation text below and to the sides, like pseudoscientific label blocks. In the bottom left corner, there are three vertically stacked icon boxes with thin cream borders: the first contains a heart icon and the label "Heart," the second contains a crossbones icon and the label "Strength," and the third contains three claw marks icons and the label "Instinct." At the bottom center, there are two very large cream-colored Japanese kanji characters with heavy black shadows and a rough, hand-carved woodblock print texture: "Beast." The overall composition maintains an aggressive, iconic, poster-like feel, is centered, and highly graphic, blending traditional Japanese poster aesthetics, the energy of tattoo GIFs, and a retro animal anatomy style.

promptLocalized.zh: 在方形画布上创作一张大胆的复古日式风格海报，以凶猛的正面虎头作为唯一的中心主体，构图完全对称并占据大部分画面。老虎张大嘴巴咆哮，露出长而弯曲的象牙獠牙、较小的下齿、鲜艳的粉色舌头、深色的喉咙、粉色的鼻子、锐利的黄色眼睛，以及饱和的橙色皮毛上覆盖着戏剧性的黑色条纹，脸颊和颈部带有白色绒毛。在额头上添加装饰性的漩涡条纹图案，使虎脸呈现出风格化的神话感。使用带有明显颗粒感、磨损墨迹、边缘轻微破损的粗糙复古丝网印刷或孔版印刷纹理，并采用由焦橙色、黑色、奶油色、白色、柔和粉色及少量黄色点缀组成的有限色调。背景应为平整的橙红色纹理底色。在右上角，包含 1 个小型技术图解面板，展示侧视图的老虎骨骼，采用纤细的奶油色线条绘制，下方和侧面配有紧凑的垂直日文注释文本，如同伪科学标签块。在左下角，包含 3 个垂直堆叠的图标框，带有纤细的奶油色边框：第一个包含心形图标及标签“心”，第二个包含交叉骨头图标及标签“力”，第三个包含三道爪痕图标及标签“本能”。在底部中心，放置 2 个非常大的奶油色日文汉字，带有厚重的黑色投影和粗犷的手工木刻版画质感：猛獣。保持整体构图具有侵略性、标志性、海报感、居中且高度图形化，融合了传统的日式海报美学、纹身闪图能量以及复古动物解剖图风格。

templates.title: The open notebook contains a handwritten plan in French.

titleLocalized.zh: 打开的笔记本，内含法文手写计划

templates.prompt: A realistic, overhead lifestyle photograph shows an open, lined notebook lying flat on a dark wood table, photographed in soft, natural indoor light with a warm, neutral tone. The notebook occupies most of the frame and is vertically centered. The two open pages contain neat, black French handwritten notes in rounded, casual handwriting, with slight imperfections, a few doodles, and a few lines of crossed-out text. A black ribbon bookmark hangs from the bottom center of the notebook. A partial view of a stack of books or papers is visible in the upper left corner, and a partial view of a white mug is visible in the upper right corner. The pages should be cream-colored, with faint horizontal lines and subtle creases along the seam. Near the top of the left page, write the underlined title "Plan articles blog", followed by six bullet points: "Écris intro + pourquoi j'ai lancé le blog", "10 idées reçues sur le minimalisme" (circle the number 10), "Ma routine du matin (version réaliste)", "Témoignages / retours lecteurs", "Outils que j'utilise au quotidien", and a crossed-out line of text "bons plans (liens affiliés)". At the bottom of the left page, add the underlined subtitle "Idées à creuser :", followed by three bullet points: "article sur les achats impulsifs", "parler d'argent sans tabou" (draw a small star next to it), and "digital declutter : par où commencer ?", and add an additional line of completely crossed-out handwritten text below. In the bottom left corner, draw a large cloud-shaped outline containing the text "Objectif : publier 2x/mois et rester authentique !", and draw a small heart doodle near the bottom right corner of the left page. At the top of the right page, write the underlined title "Routine matin idéale", followed by a six-line schedule: "6h30 : réveil (sans tel !!)", "6h40 : eau citron + respiration", "6h50 : 10 min de lecture", "7h05 : écriture / gratitude", "7h20 : sport / yoga / marche", "7h45 : douche + préparation", and below that, write "8h15 : focus boulot", accompanied by a hand-drawn star doodle on the right. Below this, add an underlined subtitle "Pensées du jour :", followed by three lines of quotes: "La discipline, c'est choisir entre", "ce que tu veux maintenant et", and "ce que tu veux vraiment.", with a small heart doodle below. In the bottom right corner, add an underlined subtitle "À ne pas oublier :", followed by three bullet points: "appeler la banque", "prendre rdv médecin", and a crossed-out line "annuler abo salle (too cher)". Keep the composition simple, minimalist, and authentic, like a casually taken snapshot of a real productivity diary or blog planning notebook.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实的俯视生活方式照片，展示了一本打开的横线笔记本平放在深色木质桌面上，在柔和的室内自然光下拍摄，色调温暖中性。笔记本占据了画面的大部分空间并垂直居中，翻开的两页上写着整齐的黑色法文手写笔记，字迹圆润随性，带有轻微的瑕疵、少量涂鸦和几行划掉的文字。笔记本底部中央垂下一条黑色丝带书签。左上角边缘可见一叠书或纸张的局部，右上角可见一个白色马克杯的局部。页面应呈现奶油色，带有淡淡的横线和微妙的中缝折痕。在左页顶部附近写下带下划线的标题“Plan articles blog”，随后列出 6 个项目符号： “Écris intro + pourquoi j’ai lancé le blog”、“10 idées reçues sur le minimalisme”（数字 10 需圈出）、“Ma routine du matin (version réaliste)”、“Témoignages / retours lecteurs”、“Outils que j’utilise au quotidien”以及一行划掉的文字“bons plans (liens affiliés)”。在左页下方，添加带下划线的副标题“Idées à creuser :”，随后列出 3 个项目符号：“article sur les achats impulsifs”、“parler d’argent sans tabou”（旁边画一个小星星涂鸦）以及“digital declutter : par où commencer ?”，并在下方额外添加一行完全划掉的手写文字。在左下角，画一个大的云朵状轮廓，内含文字“Objectif : publier 2x/mois et rester authentique !”，并在左页右下角附近画一个小爱心涂鸦。在右页顶部写下带下划线的标题“Routine matin idéale”，然后列出 6 行时间表：“6h30 : réveil (sans tel !!)”、“6h40 : eau citron + respiration”、“6h50 : 10 min de lecture”、“7h05 : écriture / gratitude”、“7h20 : sport / yoga / marche”、“7h45 : douche + préparation”，并在下方写上“8h15 : focus boulot”，右侧配有一个手绘星星涂鸦。在此下方，添加带下划线的副标题“Pensées du jour :”，并分 3 行写下引语：“La discipline, c’est choisir entre”、“ce que tu veux maintenant et”、“ce que tu veux vraiment.”，下方画一个小爱心涂鸦。在右下角，添加带下划线的副标题“À ne pas oublier :”，随后列出 3 个项目符号：“appeler la banque”、“prendre rdv médecin”以及一行划掉的“annuler abo salle (trop cher)”。保持构图简洁、极简且真实，如同从上方随意拍摄的真实生产力日记或博客规划笔记本。

templates.title: Tropical Citrus Soda Advertisement Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 热带柑橘汽水广告海报

templates.prompt: Create a vibrant tropical commercial poster showcasing a bottle of citrus soda, using a bright summer advertising style. Place a bottle {argument name="product name" default="Soda"} The plastic bottle is positioned slightly to the right of center in the image, tilted slightly to the left; the cap is yellow, and the transparent bottle is covered with cold condensation droplets, filled with a shimmering golden-orange soda. The label should feature orange slices and citrus images, along with the brand name.{argument name="product name" default="Soda"} The bottle features the phrase "aux agrumes d'été" and a small green "500 ml" logo. The background uses a sunny beach with a clear blue sky, turquoise ocean, soft clouds, and a blurred tropical palm leaf extending from the upper right corner. Dynamic splashes of water and scattered clear ice cubes are added around the bottom of the bottle, while five clearly visible citrus fruits are placed in the foreground: two orange segments, half a lime, half a grapefruit, and a slice of orange on the far right edge. The prominent French promotional text on the left reads: a large white title.{argument name="headline text" default="Soda"} The design features a small splash of water above and the handwritten yellow text "aux agrumes d'été" below. A yellow brushstroke badge with the text "LA FRAÎCHEUR QUI PÉTILLE!" is added to the center left. A vertical function list with three circular icons and French descriptions is added to the lower left: "SAVEURS NATURELLES", "SANS COLORANTS ARTIFICIELS", and "EXTRA RAFRAÎCHISSANT". A green brushstroke banner with the text "FORMAT PRATIQUE 500 ml" is added to the lower left. A circular beige eco-style stamp with a green outline and leaf pattern, containing the text "...", is added to the lower right.{argument name="seal text" default="PLAISIR FRUITÉ À CHAQUE GORGÉE"} The light effect presents a glossy and high-energy appearance, with a strong solar halo in the upper left corner. The colors are saturated, the packaging details are clear, the water droplets are realistic, and it has the texture of a sophisticated supermarket advertisement.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张充满活力的热带商业海报，展示一瓶柑橘汽水，采用明亮的夏季广告风格。将一瓶 {argument name="product name" default="Soda"} 塑料瓶置于画面中心偏右位置，略微向左倾斜；瓶盖为黄色，透明瓶身上覆盖着冰冷的凝结水珠，瓶内装满闪耀的金橙色汽水。标签上应印有橙子切片和柑橘图案，并带有品牌文字 "{argument name="product name" default="Soda"}"、短语 "aux agrumes d'été" 以及一个绿色的小型 "500 ml" 标志。背景使用阳光明媚的海滩，配以湛蓝的天空、绿松石色的海洋、柔和的云朵以及从右上角伸入的模糊热带棕榈叶。在瓶底周围添加富有动感的水花、散落的透明冰块，并在前景放置 5 个清晰可见的柑橘类水果：2 片橙子瓣、1 个青柠半块、1 个葡萄柚半块，以及最右侧边缘的 1 片橙子切片。在左侧放置醒目的法语促销文字：巨大的白色标题 "{argument name="headline text" default="Soda"}"，上方配有一个小水花装饰，下方为黄色的手写体文字 "aux agrumes d'été"。在左中部添加一个黄色笔触徽章，文字为 "LA FRAÎCHEUR QUI PÉTILLE !"。在左下方添加一个垂直的功能列表，包含 3 个圆形图标和法语说明："SAVEURS NATURELLES"、"SANS COLORANTS ARTIFICIELS" 和 "EXTRA RAFRAÎCHISSANT"。在左下角添加一个绿色笔触横幅，文字为 "FORMAT PRATIQUE 500 ml"。在右下角添加一个圆形的米色生态风格印章，带有绿色轮廓和叶子图案，内含文字 "{argument name="seal text" default="PLAISIR FRUITÉ À CHAQUE GORGÉE"}"。光效应呈现出光泽感和高能量，左上方有强烈的太阳光晕，色彩饱和，包装细节清晰，水珠真实，具有精致的超市广告质感。

templates.title: Moonlight Barn Fashion Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 月光谷仓时尚人像

templates.prompt: A cinematic, realistic portrait depicts a young woman sitting barefoot on a rectangular bundle of hay in a rural wooden barn at night. She wears a flowing mustard-yellow satin dress with thin straps, a deep neckline, and a small bow at the center of the chest. The fitted waist and long, cascading skirt spread across the straw-covered ground. Her long, wavy, auburn hair is loosely tied in a half-updo, with a few strands falling softly over her shoulders. Her pose is elegant and dignified: her legs are crossed at the ankles and extended forward, one hand resting near her knee, the other raised to gently veil her face. Warm golden light from the right illuminates her skin and dress, creating soft highlights and deep shadows, while cool blue moonlight streams through a small window on the left. Outside, a bright full moon hangs in the deep blue night sky, and the silhouettes of pine trees can be seen. The barn's interior is constructed of dark-stained vertical wooden planks, with built-in benches along the walls and scattered straw on the floor. Two bundles of hay are visible, including the one she's sitting on. The composition uses a full-body vertical angle, with the subject slightly tilted to the right of the frame. The shallow depth of field creates a private and melancholic atmosphere. The skin and fabric textures are richly detailed, exhibiting editorial-grade fashion photography quality and a soft, cinematic contrast.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影感写实人像，描绘了一位年轻女性在夜晚坐在乡村木制谷仓内长方形干草捆上的赤脚形象。她身穿一件飘逸的芥末黄缎面长裙，配有细吊带、深领口，胸前中央饰有小蝴蝶结，修身腰部设计，长长的垂坠裙摆铺散在铺满稻草的地面上。她留着一头波浪状的赤褐色长发，半扎成松散的发髻，几缕发丝柔和地垂在肩头。她的姿势优雅而端庄：双腿在脚踝处交叉并向前伸展，一只手放在膝盖附近，另一只手抬起轻轻遮住脸庞。右侧的温暖金光照亮了她的肌肤与裙装，营造出柔和的高光与深邃的阴影，而左侧一扇小窗透入清冷的蓝色月光。窗外可见深蓝色夜空中的明亮满月，以及松树的剪影。谷仓内部由深色染色垂直木板构成，墙边设有内置长凳，地面散落着零星稻草，可见 2 个干草捆，包括她所坐的那一个。采用全身垂直构图，人物略微偏向画面右侧，浅景深，营造出私密且忧郁的氛围，皮肤与织物纹理细节丰富，编辑级时尚摄影，柔和的电影感对比度。

templates.title: Health and Nutrition App Icon Matrix

titleLocalized.zh: 健康营养类 App 图标矩阵

templates.prompt: A clean matrix of 20 modern mobile app icon concepts, covering nutrition, calorie tracking, healthy eating, food recognition, and AI health tools. The background is a vibrant electric blue, complemented by soft studio lighting and subtle shadows. The icons are arranged in 4 rows and 5 columns with even spacing. Each icon is a rounded square with advanced iOS-style depth, smooth gradients, glass-like highlights, and clear 3D rendering details. The color scheme should primarily feature saturated blues, cyans, teals, whites, and lime greens, accented with small amounts of orange and yellow. It includes 20 distinct icon designs: 1) A bowl containing avocado, cereal, broccoli, and cherry tomatoes, surrounded by a camera scanning frame; 2) Four horizontally arranged nutrition bars in green, yellow, red, and blue, next to a white fork on a deep navy blue background; 3) A camera lens with a small bowl of vegetables in front; 4) A circular blue badge with text.{argument name="headline text" default="kcal"} And a green leaf overlapping at the bottom; 5) a cyan icon with text above a white bowl and two glittering symbols.{argument name="brand text" default="Ai"} 6) A glossy green apple with circuit traces and nodes, hinting at food technology AI; 7) Half an avocado in the center of a glowing scan frame; 8) A metal spoon with a blue lightning bolt symbol and curved tracing lines; 9) A segmented nutrition meter in green, orange, and red circles surrounding salmon and broccoli; 10) A divided plate containing roasted chicken, broccoli, rice, blueberries, and a small upward-rising histogram; 11) A camera lens on a white background with green leaves; 12) A glowing green apple in a scan frame with a flashing symbol; 13) A glowing circular ring in blue, green, yellow, and orange on a dark background; 14) A blue shield with a white fork in the center; 15) A yogurt or oatmeal bowl in a scan frame topped with strawberries, blueberries, and granola; 16) A dark navy blue calorie icon with text.{argument name="calorie text" default="kcal"} 17) A mint green square with a white circuit tree or branch chip pattern; 18) A healthy plate containing roasted chicken, avocado, tomato, and vegetables within a scanned frame; 19) A dark bowl filled with blueberries and white yogurt or cream, overlaid with a bright electric lightning symbol; 20) A light blue 3D cube icon with a fork and plate symbol on one side and green leaves on the other. The overall style should be highly refined, slightly futuristic, and commercially viable for App Store brand promotion. Ensure the visual language of the 20 icons is consistent, containing no additional text besides a visible short label, and presenting a sophisticated AI-generated product design aesthetic.

templates.title: Ancient Egyptian Queen and Black Panther

titleLocalized.zh: 古埃及女王与黑豹

templates.prompt: A cinematic portrait of ancient Egypt depicts a charismatic, queen-like woman kneeling on the warm desert sands, beside a massive black panther, against the backdrop of a sandstone temple courtyard. This woman possesses {argument name="hair color" default="jet black"} She has long, wavy hair, medium-brown skin, and wears a magnificent Egyptian gold headdress adorned with turquoise and sun disc details at its center. She also wears rectangular gold earrings, a large, layered Egyptian collar in gold and blue, multiple gold armbands and bracelets, and a revealing ivory-white and gold draped dress. Her torso is decorated with delicate gold chains, a gem-encrusted belt, and strappy sandals. Her posture is elegant and composed, one hand resting on the sand, her knees turned to the side, her body slightly turned towards the viewer. Beside her lies a black panther with glossy fur, subtle rose-colored markings, and amber eyes, reclining in the foreground like a sphinx, its expression serene, noble, and protective. The background includes three massive, carved temple columns adorned with hieroglyphs and animal reliefs, rendered with a soft, blurred effect. Golden hour sunlight, warm sandstone tones, realistic skin and fabric textures, dramatic yet natural shadows, shallow depth of field, ultra-high detail, realistic style, luxurious and mythical atmosphere, centered vertical composition, full-body seated figures with animal companions.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅电影质感的古埃及肖像，描绘了一位魅力十足、女王般的女性，跪在温暖的沙漠沙地上，身旁是一只巨大的黑豹，背景是砂岩神庙的庭院。这位女性拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="乌黑"} 的长波浪卷发，中棕色皮肤，佩戴着华丽的埃及金质头带，头带中央镶嵌着绿松石和太阳圆盘细节，戴着长方形金耳环、宽大的金蓝色叠层埃及领饰、多条金质臂环和手镯，身着露肤的象牙白与金色垂坠服饰，躯干上有精致的金链装饰、镶嵌宝石的腰带以及系带凉鞋。她的姿态优雅而沉稳，一只手撑在沙地上，双膝侧向一旁，身体略微朝向观众。她身旁是一只毛色油亮、带有隐约玫瑰花纹、双眼呈琥珀色的黑豹，它像狮身人面像一样卧在前景中，神态平静、高贵且具有保护性。背景中包括 3 根巨大的雕刻神庙石柱，上面饰有象形文字和动物浮雕，呈现出柔和的虚化效果。黄金时段的阳光，温暖的砂岩色调，逼真的皮肤和织物纹理，戏剧性而自然的阴影，浅景深，超高细节，写实风格，奢华且充满神话氛围，居中垂直构图，全身坐姿人物与动物伙伴。

templates.title: Giant Labyrinth Female Statue Monument

titleLocalized.zh: 巨型迷宫女性雕像纪念碑

templates.prompt: A surreal, dark fantasy-style realistic scene depicts a colossal female humanoid statue standing amidst a rugged mountain landscape. The high-angle, low-angle shot creates a sense of tension, making the statue appear to soar into the clouds. The statue's body features a massive, bell-shaped skirt, its surface completely covered with deeply carved labyrinthine patterns, like an ancient labyrinth sculpted from weathered stone and concrete, its surface covered in moss, grime, erosion, and the marks of time. At the center of the skirt's base, an arched entrance leads into the darkness, through which a narrow dirt path leads, making the statue appear as a habitable monument. The statue's arms hang naturally, its slender neck rising from above the structure, its head slightly turned to the side; it features short, wavy black hair, and facial details are partially obscured. The monument is surrounded by rocks, sparse alpine shrubs, and uneven ground. A steep, rocky peak is added to the right of the background. The sky is filled with heavy, somber storm clouds in a soft gray hue, creating a melancholic and ominous atmosphere. Color palette: cool grays, charcoal grays, stone beige, moss greens, and soft earth tones. Lighting should be natural, diffused overcast light with soft shadows. Style: hyper-realistic cinematography, grand scale, eerie surreal architecture, ancient labyrinthine temples integrated with female statues, highly detailed textures, and vertical composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个超现实暗黑奇幻风格的写实场景，展现了一座巨大的女性人形雕像，矗立在崎岖的山地景观中。采用极具张力的低角度仰拍，使雕像显得高耸入云。雕像的身体呈现出巨大的钟形裙摆，表面完全覆盖着深雕的迷宫图案，如同在风化的石材和混凝土上雕刻出的古老迷宫，表面布满青苔、污垢、侵蚀痕迹和岁月留下的斑点。在裙摆底部的中心位置，设置 1 个通向黑暗的拱形入口，一条狭窄的泥土小径直通其中，使这座雕像看起来像是一座可居住的纪念碑。雕像双臂自然下垂，细长的颈部从结构上方升起，头部微微侧转；采用短波浪黑发，面部细节部分遮挡。纪念碑周围散布着岩石、稀疏的高山灌木和不平坦的地面。背景右侧添加 1 座陡峭的岩石山峰。天空布满厚重的阴沉风暴云，色调为柔和的灰色，营造出一种忧郁、不祥的氛围。调色板：冷灰色、炭灰色、石米色、苔藓绿、柔和的大地色系。光照应为自然的漫射阴天光线，带有柔和的阴影。风格：超写实电影摄影、宏伟尺度、诡异的超现实建筑、与女性雕像融合的古老迷宫神庙、高度精细的纹理、垂直构图。

templates.title: Dancer couple on the cliff house

titleLocalized.zh: 悬崖屋上的舞者夫妇

templates.prompt: A dramatically vertical, cinematic photograph depicts a weathered wooden house jutting out from the edge of a steep cliff, its balcony suspended in mid-air. Ancient and dilapidated, the house is constructed of gray, sun-faded planks, warped and twisted, with dim or broken windows. A fragile, leaning wooden frame supports the balcony. Dense green vines and vegetation cling to the cliff face, partially framing the upper left corner of the image, while the rock face plunges sharply downwards across most of the composition. Two people stand on the balcony: a couple in formal attire, posing as if about to ballroom dance. The man, in a dark suit or tuxedo, faces the woman, one arm raised in a dance pose; the woman wears flowing robes {argument name="dress color" default="Dark red"} The woman in an evening gown, her hair styled in an updo, echoes the man's posture. The balcony railing, slender yet rugged, emphasizes the sense of danger and instability of the environment. The sky is a greyish-blue, overcast, with hazy mountains faintly visible in the lower right background. The realistic photographic style, with its melancholic natural light, showcases high detail in the aged wood and cliff textures, creating a dizzying yet surreal elegance. The composition places the house in the upper left corner, with the couple positioned near the upper right edge of the structure.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的竖构图电影感照片，展示了一座从陡峭悬崖边缘突出的风化木屋，阳台悬空于虚无之上。房屋古老而破败，由灰色、被阳光晒褪色的木板构成，木板弯曲变形，窗户昏暗或破损，阳台下方支撑着脆弱的倾斜木架。茂密的绿色藤蔓和植被攀附在悬崖上，部分框住了图像的左上角，而岩壁在构图的大部分区域急剧向下延伸。阳台上站着 2 个人：一对身着正装的夫妇，摆出交谊舞的姿势。男子身穿深色西装或燕尾服，面向女子，一只手臂抬起呈舞蹈姿势；女子身穿飘逸的 {argument name="dress color" default="深红色"} 晚礼服，发型盘起，与男子的姿势相呼应。阳台栏杆纤细而粗犷，突显了高度的危险感和不稳定的环境。天空呈灰蓝色，阴云密布，远处的右下方背景中隐约可见朦胧的山脉。采用写实的摄影风格，忧郁的自然光，展现出陈旧木材和悬崖纹理的高细节，营造出一种眩晕感与超现实的优雅，构图将房屋置于左上角，夫妇位于结构右上方边缘附近。

templates.title: Mysterious Cyber ​​Gothic Collage Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 神秘赛博哥特拼贴海报

templates.prompt: A dark, mysterious, cyberpunk-gothic vertical collage poster, densely packed and layered like a ritualistic film noir album cover, employs aged black, tan, bronze, and deep red tones. It blends simulated decay, glitch textures, scanned paper, technical schematics, surveillance graphics, sacred geometry, and fragmented photographic montage. On the right, a large, highly detailed, weathered profile of an aged human skull is displayed, partially obscured by circles, target markings, runes, fine grid lines, and red chart annotations. Near the top center, a mysterious woman with long, dark hair and pale skin, dressed in a low-cut black outfit, poses sensually, one hand raised near her face; a large, dark red halo is added behind her head. In the upper left quadrant, the back or shoulder of a pale, classically sculpted figure is depicted with a ghostly, fragmented quality. In the lower right center, a dark-skinned ritual figure or priestess is placed, adorned with layers of beads, necklaces, and ritual ornaments, partially obscured by textures and collage distractions. In the bottom right corner, a tattered rag doll or voodoo-style ragged puppet is displayed, suspended with visible seams and outstretched limbs. At the bottom center, a rainy night street scene is depicted, with a lone figure in a trench coat walking away in the dim light, and a car parked or stopped on the wet road, the surface reflecting a reddish glow. In the bottom left corner, a multifaceted black pyramid or crystalline geometric shape emerges from the darkness. Scattered throughout the design are seven distinct blocks of Latin text, styled in an aged serif font and mysterious inscriptions: “IN SOMNIIS VERITAS; IN DESIDERIIS, PERDITIO.”, “ANIMA SINE FINE VAGAT, IN UMBRIS SUI IPSIUS INVENTA.”, “PASSIO EST CLAVISTRA”, “EGO SUM QUI NUNQUAM FUI.”, “III FRAGMENTUM INFINITUM.”, “COR AMAT; MENS DUBITAT; ANIMA LACERATUR.”, and “IN VINO VERITAS IN SANGUINE REDEMPTIO.” Tiny UI-style microtext, barcode fragments, micro-charts, mysterious badges, crosshairs, and barely legible data panels are added throughout the image. The overall composition aims to create a somber, profound, cinematic, and surreal atmosphere, with heavy textures, layered transparency, subtle red accents, contrasting lighting, and the feel of a sophisticated dark art poster.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张深色神秘赛博哥特风格的竖版拼贴海报，如同仪式感十足的黑色电影专辑封面般密集且富有层次感，采用做旧的黑色、棕褐色、青铜色和深红色调。将模拟衰变、故障纹理、扫描纸张、技术示意图、监控图形、神圣几何和碎片化照片蒙太奇融为一体。在右侧，展示一个大型且高度精细的侧面陈旧人类头骨，经过风化处理，并部分覆盖着圆圈、目标标记、符文、细网格线和红色图表注释。在上方中央附近，放置一位留着深色长发、皮肤苍白的神秘女性，身穿低胸黑色服装，姿态性感，一只手抬起靠近脸部；在她脑后添加一个巨大的暗红色光环。在左上象限，包含一个苍白的古典雕像般人物的背部或肩部，呈现出幽灵般的碎片感。在右下中部，放置一个深色皮肤的仪式人物或女祭司，佩戴着层叠的珠子、项链和仪式装饰，部分被纹理和拼贴干扰所遮盖。在右下角，展示一个破旧的布娃娃或巫毒风格的破布人偶，呈现悬挂状态，可见明显的接缝和伸展的肢体。在底部中央，描绘一个雨夜街道场景，有 1 个孤独的穿风衣人物在昏暗的灯光下走远，另有 1 辆汽车停在或停滞在湿漉漉的道路上，路面反射着红色的光芒。在左下角，添加一个从黑暗中浮现的多面黑色金字塔或水晶状几何体。在整个设计中散布 7 个清晰的拉丁文文本块，样式为做旧的衬线字体和神秘铭文：“IN SOMNIIS VERITAS; IN DESIDERIIS, PERDITIO.”、“ANIMA SINE FINE VAGAT, IN UMBRIS SUI IPSIUS INVENTA.”、“PASSIO EST CLAVISTRA”、“EGO SUM QUI NUNQUAM FUI.”、“III FRAGMENTUM INFINITUM.”、“COR AMAT; MENS DUBITAT; ANIMA LACERATUR.” 以及 “IN VINO VERITAS IN SANGUINE REDEMPTIO”。在整张图像中添加微小的 UI 风格微型文字、条形码碎片、微型图表、神秘徽章、十字准线符号和难以辨认的数据面板。整体构图应营造出压抑、深奥、电影感和超现实的氛围，并具备厚重的纹理、层叠的透明度、微妙的红色点缀、明暗对比照明以及高级暗黑艺术海报的质感。

templates.title: Black and white war ink painting scene

titleLocalized.zh: 黑白战争水墨场景

templates.prompt: This dramatic black-and-white ink painting of war, using a vertical composition, combines realistic World War II imagery with abstract ink splashes against a large expanse of white background. On the left side of the image, four soldiers advance towards the center and into the distance: in the foreground, a large soldier stands on a rocky cliff, wearing a helmet, carrying heavy equipment, and holding a rifle with a bayonet; behind him, three smaller soldiers move to the right in a staggered formation. In the sky, five warplanes roar past through thick smoke. On the right side of the image is a steep rocky island or coastal cliff, topped with an abandoned fortress or castle, surrounded by smoke. Below, surging waves crash against reefs, and tiny landing figures are faintly visible on the narrow coastline. Using explosive black ink blots, smoke, scratches, splashes, and painterly fragmentation effects, the soldiers, cliffs, and waves are integrated into a highly expressive work. High-contrast monochrome, misty and hazy, using only desaturated grayscale to present a memorable cinematic texture, while leaving plenty of negative space, combining the styles of fine art and conceptual art.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅充满戏剧性的黑白水墨战争插画，采用竖构图，将写实的二战意象与大面积留白背景上的抽象泼墨笔触相结合。画面左侧共展示 4 名士兵向中心及远方推进：前景中 1 名巨大的士兵背影站在岩石峭壁上，头戴钢盔，背负重装，手持带刺刀的步枪；身后另有 3 名较小的士兵呈错落队形向右移动。天空中，5 架战机穿过浓烟呼啸而过。画面右侧是一座陡峭的岩岛或海岸悬崖，顶部矗立着一座废弃的堡垒或城堡，周围烟雾缭绕。下方描绘了汹涌的海浪拍打着暗礁，狭窄的海岸线上隐约可见靠近水面的微小登陆身影。运用爆发式的黑色墨迹、烟尘、划痕、滴溅和绘画般的碎片效果，将士兵、悬崖和浪花融为一体，构成一幅极具表现力的作品。高对比度单色调，雾气氤氲，仅使用去饱和的灰阶，呈现出电影般令人难忘的质感，并留有大量负空间，兼具纯艺术与概念艺术的风格。

templates.title: Victorian-style animal chess game

titleLocalized.zh: 维多利亚风格动物象棋对弈

templates.prompt: A highly detailed, cinematic portrait depicting an anthropomorphic animal.{argument name="dog breed" default="pug"} Imagine playing chess with a chimpanzee in a dimly lit, old-world Victorian study. The dog, a half-length figure, is on the left, dressed in a brown tweed blazer, white shirt, and bow tie. A round monocle with a chain hangs over one eye, and one paw rests beside the board as it thoughtfully observes the pieces. The chimpanzee, on the right, also wears a thick brown tweed blazer over a shirt, leaning forward with one hand supporting his chin in a classic contemplative pose, intently focused on the game. Between them is an intricately carved wooden chessboard, upon which lies a complete game of chess, 32 pieces clearly visible: 16 light-colored wooden pieces on the left and 16 dark-colored wooden pieces on the right, representing a realistic strategic layout rather than the initial arrangement. The room is filled with dark polished wood and leather armchairs. A warm amber lamp illuminates the far left, and bookshelves form the backdrop. Behind them, in the center, hangs a classical portrait, below which hangs a small mantel clock. The use of warm tungsten lighting, shallow depth of field, deep shadows, hyper-realistic hair and skin textures, subtle wrinkles, and reflections on a monocle creates a serious intellectual atmosphere with a touch of subtle humor. Symmetrical composition, eye-level perspective, photorealistic detail, sharp focus on faces and objects, luxurious period details, and deep brown and sepia tones all contribute to the overall effect.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅高度细腻的电影级肖像画，描绘了一只拟人化的 {argument name="dog breed" default="pug"} 和一只黑猩猩坐在昏暗的旧世界维多利亚式书房中对弈象棋。狗在左侧，半身像，身穿棕色粗花呢西装外套、白衬衫和领结，单眼戴着一副圆形的单片眼镜及链条，一只爪子放在棋盘旁，若有所思地注视着棋子。黑猩猩在右侧，同样穿着厚实的棕色粗花呢外套内搭衬衫，身体前倾，一只手托着下巴，呈现出经典的思考姿势，全神贯注地盯着项目。它们之间是一张雕刻精美的木制棋桌，上面摆放着一盘正在进行中的完整象棋，清晰可见 32 枚棋子：左侧 16 枚浅色木制棋子，右侧 16 枚深色木制棋子，呈现出真实的战略布局而非初始摆放。房间里充满了深色抛光木材、皮革扶手椅，最左侧有一盏温暖的琥珀色台灯，背景是书架，它们身后正中央挂着一幅古典肖像画，画下方有一个小型壁炉钟。采用温暖的钨丝灯光、浅景深、深沉的阴影、超逼真的毛发和皮肤纹理、细微的皱纹、单片眼镜上的反光，营造出一种严肃的知识分子氛围，并带有一丝微妙的幽默感。对称构图，平视视角，照片级逼真，面部和项目焦点清晰，奢华的时代细节，深棕色和棕褐色调。

templates.title: Pink fashion magazine cover

titleLocalized.zh: 粉色时尚杂志封面

templates.prompt: A glossy, high-fashion magazine cover portrait, shot vertically, evokes the style of a premium beauty and fashion publication. The image features a close-up of a young woman from the chest up, set in a softly glamorous studio environment. She is slightly turned to the side, one hand raised to her lips, her posture elegant and understated. Her face is deliberately obscured by a solid, matte, warm beige rectangle in the center. She has long, light brown, slightly wavy hair, with pink highlights shimmering in the strands. She wears large, delicate silver hoop earrings, and her nails are neatly manicured and painted with pale pink nail polish. She wears a pale pink, plush knit sweater with wide sleeves, exuding a luxurious and comfortable feel. The overall design uses a monochromatic pink palette, complemented by warm rose-colored lighting, soft lighting effects, shallow depth of field, meticulous retouching, and editorial fashion photography aesthetics. The background features a smooth pink gradient with subtle studio fog and halo effects. Designed as a magazine cover, it incorporates layered typography: a very large pale pink masthead at the top, with the text "..."{argument name="magazine title" default="GPT"} The upper right corner features an elegant serif font.{argument name="cover line" default="image 2.0"} Add small text "MAY 2024" and "FASHION & BEAUTY MAGAZINE" to the top left corner. Add three sidebars: "Special Interview" in the top left with Japanese text and "8P" below it; "Trend Report" in the bottom left with Japanese text below it; "Beauty Update" in the middle right with Japanese text below it; and "Style Guide" in the bottom right with Japanese text below it. Place a prominent large serif title at the bottom with the text "..."{argument name="main headline" default="The Power of Confidence."} The title, “The Power of,” is in black italic serif, while “Confidence.” is in oversized dark pink italic serif. Below it is the Japanese subtitle, “自分を信じて、もっと輝く私に.” The cover maintains a luxurious, elegant, trendy, and sophisticated feel, reminiscent of a contemporary Japanese fashion magazine.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张光泽感十足的高级时尚杂志封面肖像，采用竖构图，呈现出高端美妆与时尚刊物的风格。画面展示了一位年轻女性的胸部以上特写，置于柔和迷人的摄影棚环境中，她身体微微侧转，一只手举在唇边，姿态优雅含蓄。她的面部被一个位于中心位置、哑光暖米色的实心矩形色块刻意遮挡。她留着长长的浅棕色微卷发，发丝间闪烁着粉色的轮廓光，佩戴着大号细银圈耳环，指甲修剪整齐并涂有淡粉色甲油。她身穿一件淡粉色毛绒针织毛衣，袖口宽大，质感舒适奢华。整体采用单色粉色调，配以温暖的玫瑰色灯光、柔光效果、浅景深、精细的美容修图质感以及编辑类时尚摄影美学。背景为平滑的粉色渐变，带有细腻的摄影棚雾感和光晕。设计为杂志封面，包含分层排版：顶部横跨一个非常大的淡粉色刊头，文字为“{argument name="magazine title" default="GPT"}”，右上角配有优雅的衬线字体“{argument name="cover line" default="image 2.0"}”。左上角添加小字“MAY 2024”和“FASHION & BEAUTY MAGAZINE”。添加三个侧边专题栏：左上为“Special Interview”及其下方的日文文本和“8P”；左下为“Trend Report”及其下方的日文文本；右中为“Beauty Update”及其下方的日文文本；右下为“Style Guide”及其下方的日文文本。底部放置一个醒目的大号衬线标题，文字为“{argument name="main headline" default="The Power of Confidence."}”，其中“The Power of”采用黑色斜体衬线字，“Confidence.”采用超大号深粉色斜体衬线字。在其下方，添加日文副标题“自分を信じて、もっと輝く私に。”保持封面奢华、柔美、潮流且精致的质感，如同当代日本时尚杂志。

templates.title: Pink Office Transfer Announcement Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 粉色办公室调动公告海报

templates.prompt: A glossy, feminine, scrapbook-style office poster, inspired by sitcom-style workplace promotions, uses a 2:3 vertical composition. The image shows a key female figure standing in front of seven office colleagues against a warm beige office backdrop featuring blinds, desks, and a clearly visible Dunder Mifflin-style wall sign. The key female figure sports a messy blonde high bun, wears a light pink floral V-neck dress, and poses with her arms crossed, exuding confidence and a celebratory vibe. Behind her, seven colleagues are arranged in a loose semi-circle, dressed in soft blue, brown, black, and lilac office attire. The image is constructed as a mixed-media collage, incorporating torn paper, washi tape notes, brush-written headings, glitter textures, flowers, and pink and gold embellishments. A pink rectangular company card is placed in the upper left corner, featuring a white office logo and the text "DUNDER MIFFLIN, INC" and "PAPER COMPANY". At the top center is a large torn paper title, written in expressive calligraphy: "TRANSFER CONFIRMED," with "TRANSFER" in bright pink and "CONFIRMED" in black, underlined in pink and featuring a hand-drawn heart. In the upper right corner, a small off-white card is secured with pink tacks and pink tape, reading "NEW CHAPTER. NEW SCRANTON." Near the bottom center, a bold title consisting of four stacked lines of text is layered:{argument name="character name" default="PENNY"} Located on a pink paintbrush banner, "IS" is on a small white strip with two small hearts, "JOINING" is on a gold paintbrush banner, and "THE OFFICE" is on a light pink strip. A long pink transfer tag hangs in the lower left corner, held with a gold paperclip, reading "FROM DUNDER MIFFLIN, INC PAPER COMPANY / SCRANTON, PA / EST. 1949" above and "TO THE OFFICE / SCRANTON, PA" below, with a pink bathroom-style icon of a woman and a desk at the bottom. A pink card is placed in the lower right corner, divided into three sections: "NEW ROLE" with {argument name="job title" default="Sales Representative"} “NEW TEAM” paired with “{argument name="team text" default="Same Paper"} , and “NEW MEMORIES” paired with “{argument name="memories text" default="Let’s make some!"} Each section is decorated with small pink hearts. A pink ribbon is added to the center of the bottom, with the words "DUNDER MIFFLIN, INC. WELCOMES" written on it.{argument name="character name" default="PENNY"} ♡. The line below contains three small icons and text items: a glitter icon with "NEW JOB", a team icon with "NEW TEAM", and a heart icon with "NEW MEMORIES". A striking handwritten pink cursive "LET'S GO!" is added to the bottom right corner. Corners are decorated with pink peonies, tiny white-filled flowers, torn paper edges, soft glitter, and delicate gold foil dots. A warm rose hue, including blush pink, cream, gold, and black, creates a sophisticated poster composite effect, soft, charming lighting, and a joyful, celebratory atmosphere.

templates.title: The rooftop obscures the portrait.

titleLocalized.zh: 天台遮挡肖像

templates.prompt: A cinematic, realistic rooftop portrait, taken at the golden hour. An older man faces the camera, his face completely obscured by a large, vertical rectangular brown occluder. Visible features are clearly visible: thick, tightly curled grey hair with silver highlights; clearly defined ears; a long, slender neck showing the marks of time; a charcoal grey suit jacket over a tieless, off-white collared shirt. The composition employs a vertical cropping technique starting from the mid-chest. The scene is set on a real New York rooftop, with details including: a weathered HVAC unit in the foreground and left, a cylindrical rooftop water tower in the middle ground, two striking Art Deco skyscrapers in the background (the left resembling the Empire State Building, the right resembling the Chrysler Building), low brick buildings, rooftop pipes, vents, railings, and a soft, atmospheric haze. Using warm sunset lighting, the sky takes on an orange-pink hue, with subtle contour lighting around the ears and hair. The horizon has a shallow depth of field, and the textures of the suit fabric, rooftop concrete, metal machinery, and curly hair are richly detailed. The overall atmosphere is mysterious, editorial, and slightly surreal, like a magazine cover photo where the identity is obscured.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影质感的写实天台肖像，拍摄于黄金时刻。一位年长男性居中面向镜头，面部被一块巨大的垂直长方形棕色遮挡块完全遮住。清晰呈现可见部分：浓密且紧致的灰色卷发，带有银色高光；双耳清晰可见；颈部细长且显露岁月痕迹；上半身穿着炭灰色西装外套，内搭无领带的米白色翻领衬衫。构图采用从胸部中段向上的垂直肖像裁剪。场景设定在真实的纽约天台，细节包括：左前方 1 台风化的暖通空调机组，右中景 1 座圆柱形天台水塔，背景中 2 座醒目的装饰艺术风格摩天大楼（左侧类似帝国大厦，右侧类似克莱斯勒大厦），以及低矮的砖房、天台管道、通风口、护栏和柔和的大气薄雾。采用温暖的日落光影，天空呈现橙粉色调，耳朵和头发边缘带有微妙的轮廓光，天际线处景深较浅，西装面料、天台混凝土、金属机械和卷发的纹理细节丰富。整体氛围神秘、具有编辑感且略带超现实色彩，如同身份被遮挡的杂志封面照片。

templates.title: A satirical photo of a money jet in the tech world.

titleLocalized.zh: 讽刺科技圈金钱喷气机照片

templates.prompt: A satirical editorial photograph taken under a bright, cloudy sky on an airport tarmac. A white private jet is parked at an angle, its door open and stairs lowered. The fuselage prominently displays the neat corporate logo, "Google | ANTHROPIC." In the foreground, two adult male tech executives in dark business suits embrace tightly, facing the camera; one holds a thick wad of dollar bills. Their faces are deliberately obscured by smooth, rectangular blurs. In the midground and to the right, two other adult men in similarly blurred faces, also in dark suits, are pushing two airport luggage carts piled high with tightly bound bundles of dollars. The left cart has a black panel with the Google logo, while the right cart has a black panel that reads "Deep Pockets Division." The wet ground reflects the figures, carts, and the plane, adding a post-rain sheen. The composition is centered and slightly low-angled, with the embracing men dominating the frame, and the two cash carts clearly visible behind them. The overall tone is sharp, realistic, and rich in detail, with a corporate political satire. It presents a news photography style, with natural sunlight, clear focus, and subtle depth of field, showcasing high-end private aviation aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张在明亮多云天空下、机场停机坪上的写实讽刺社论照片。画面中，一架白色私人飞机斜向停放，舱门开启，舷梯放下。机身上印有醒目整洁的企业字样“Google | ANTHROPIC”。前景中，两名身着深色商务西装的成年男性科技高管紧紧拥抱，面向镜头，其中一人手中拿着一叠厚厚的美元钞票。他们的面部被刻意用平滑的矩形模糊块遮挡。中景和右侧，另外两名同样面部模糊、身着深色西装的成年男性，正推着两辆堆满紧密捆扎的美元砖块的机场行李推车。左侧推车上有一个带有 Google 标志的黑色面板，右侧推车上的黑色面板写着“Deep Pockets Division”。潮湿的地面反射出人物、推车和飞机的倒影，增添了雨后光泽感。构图居中且略带低角度，拥抱的两人占据画面主体，身后的两辆现金推车清晰可见。整体基调犀利、写实、细节丰富，具有企业政治讽刺意味，呈现新闻摄影风格，自然日光，焦点清晰，景深微妙，展现高端私人航空美学。

templates.title: Fun DIY Disaster Cat Comics

titleLocalized.zh: 趣味 DIY 灾难猫咪漫画

templates.prompt: Create a vibrant, humorous Spanish-language cartoon poster in a vertical format. It should feature a retro cartoon look, bold black outlines, warm orange and yellow tones, halftone textures, and exaggerated, lively characters. The layout is divided into four independent panels: a large title panel at the top, and three equally sized vertical panels at the bottom. In the top panel, a smug orange tabby cat repairman stands upright like a human in his comfortable living room studio, one paw holding a screwdriver, the other at his hip, wearing a tool belt with clearly visible tools. The cat squints confidently, a sly smile on its face. To the left of this panel is a large, jagged cartoon-style exploding frame containing the Spanish title in bold, distressed font: “3 PASOS PARA ARRUINAR ALGO FÁCIL,” with “ARRUINAR” in red and the rest in black. Below this is a strip of washi tape that reads “edición casera.” In the top panel background, a sign that reads "YO PUEDO SOLO" hangs on the wall, next to a small paw print, a small plant, a shelf, and dynamic radiating lines behind the cat. In the bottom row, create three labeled step panels, each with a yellow title box and bold black text. Panel 1, titled "PASO 1," shows the same orange cat sitting calmly by a floor lamp, eyes closed, looking overly confident, casually holding a screwdriver. Add a speech bubble that reads "Tranqui, esto lo arreglo en 2 minutos." Includes an open toolbox and several screws on the floor. Panel 2, titled "PASO 2," shows the cat currently repairing, now panicked, eyes wide, clumsily disassembling the wrong part of the lamp, debris and screws flying through the air. Add a speech bubble that reads "Ups..." and a note near the bottom that reads "tocar lo que no era." Includes visual movement lines, scattered debris, and overturned flowerpots. Panel 3, titled "PASO 3". Showing the consequences: broken and smoking light fixtures, exposed and sparking wires, a messy room with broken parts everywhere, and a cat sitting in shock, holding a screwdriver. A brown dog stands to the right, looking disappointed, asking in a speech bubble, "¿Qué hiciste?" The cat replies in another speech bubble, "No sé... se complicó solo." Add a washi tape label at the bottom that reads "resultado final". This makes the whole image fun, chaotic, and emoji-like, using beautiful digital illustrations, lively expressions, cartoon fonts, and a DIY disaster tone.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张色彩鲜艳、风格幽默的西班牙语漫画海报，采用竖版格式，具有复古卡通外观、粗黑轮廓、暖橙色和黄色调、半色调纹理以及夸张生动的角色。布局分为 4 个独立的画格：顶部是一个大标题画格，底部一行是 3 个等大的竖向画格。在顶部画格中，展示一只自鸣得意的橘色虎斑猫修理工，像人一样直立在舒适的客厅工作室里，一只爪子拿着螺丝刀，另一只爪子叉在腰间，戴着装有明显工具的工具带。猫咪眯着自信的眼睛，带着狡黠的笑容。在此画格左侧，放置一个巨大的锯齿状漫画爆炸框，内含粗体做旧字体的西班牙语标题：“3 PASOS PARA ARRUINAR ALGO FÁCIL”，其中“ARRUINAR”为红色，其余为黑色。下方添加一条写有“edición casera”的胶带纸条。在顶部画格背景中，墙上挂着一个写有“YO PUEDO SOLO”的牌子，旁边有一个小爪印，还有一盆小植物、架子以及猫咪身后动态的放射线。在底部一行，创建 3 个带标签的步骤画格，每个画格都有一个黄色标题框和粗体黑色文字。画格 1 标题：“PASO 1”。展示同一只橘猫平静地坐在落地灯旁，闭着眼睛，一脸过度自信，随意地拿着螺丝刀。添加一个对话气泡，写着“Tranqui, esto lo arreglo en 2 minutos.”。包含一个打开的小工具箱和地板上的几颗螺丝。画格 2 标题：“PASO 2”。展示猫咪正在修理中，现在惊慌失措，眼睛瞪大，笨拙地拆卸着灯具错误的部分，碎片和螺丝在空中飞舞。添加一个写着“Ups...”的对话气泡，并在底部附近贴一张写着“tocar lo que no era”的便签。包含视觉运动线、散落的碎片和倒下的花盆。画格 3 标题：“PASO 3”。展示后果：灯具损坏并冒着烟，电线裸露且伴有火花，房间一片狼藉，到处都是破碎的零件，猫咪惊呆地坐着，手里拿着螺丝刀。右侧站着一只棕色狗，看起来很失望，在对话气泡中问道：“¿Qué hiciste?”。猫咪在另一个对话气泡中回答：“No sé... se complicó solo.”。在底部添加一个写有“resultado final”的胶带标签。使整张图片充满趣味、混乱和表情包感，采用精美的数字插画、生动的表情、漫画字体和 DIY 灾难的基调。

templates.title: Anime Spring Travel Movie Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫春季旅行电影海报

templates.prompt: An exquisitely crafted international movie poster in an anime style, possessing a cinematic quality, a touch of oil painting, and soft, natural lighting. The composition centers on a young woman, framed to mid-thigh, in a relaxed pose, one hand tucked into the pocket of a navy blue zip-up hoodie. The hoodie features two yellow athletic stripes on each sleeve, a loose hood, and a half-open zipper, revealing a fitted white tank top underneath, with thin black straps subtly visible. She wears a black choker and a dark pendant earring. Her hairstyle is a platinum silver bob with long, sleek, side-swept bangs. Her face is deliberately obscured by a soft beige, flat rectangular embellishment. The overall style maintains an elegant restraint, rather than excessive detail, presenting a more natural and realistic effect than overly flamboyant hyper-realistic anime art. The background features a diagonally divided travel film collage: one panel showcases a Mediterranean-style coastal town perched on a cliff, with calm blue waters and distant birds in flight; another depicts a rural railway line with a train on the left and telephone poles standing beside the tracks; a third shows snow-capped mountains and winding roads through tranquil valleys; a fourth displays a city skyline at dusk with twinkling lights; and the final panel shows a coastal highway curving along the coast at sunset. Soft cream, blue, and slate tones create a nostalgic spring travel atmosphere. Elegant film festival award laurel leaves are added to the upper left, precisely stacked with three laurel leaves, accompanied by Spanish text indicating the major animation film festival awards. A large, centered title typography is added near the bottom, containing the following text:{argument name="headline text" default="VIAJES DE PRIMAVERA"} The text uses a refined, light ivory serif font. Below it, a smaller line of italic Spanish text is added.{argument name="tagline" default="Cada destino cambia su corazón."} Add the release information line below.{argument name="release text" default="PRÓXIMAMENTE EN CINES"} At the very bottom is a small credits and a small studio logo. The overall image should have the feel of an art-house film poster, promoting a drama film about spring travel, with balanced white space, sophisticated layout, and realistic print poster typography.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的动漫风格国际电影海报，具有电影质感、略带油画风格以及柔和的自然光效。构图中心为一位年轻女性，取景至大腿中部，姿态放松，一只手插在海军蓝拉链连帽衫的口袋里。连帽衫袖子上各有两条黄色运动条纹，兜帽宽松，拉链半开，内搭一件紧身白色吊带背心，隐约可见黑色细肩带。她佩戴着黑色颈圈和一只深色吊坠耳环。她的发型是铂银色短波波头，带有长长的斜刘海，质感顺滑轻盈。她的面部被一个柔和米色的扁平矩形遮挡块刻意遮盖。整体风格保持优雅克制，而非过度细节化，呈现出比华丽超写实动漫艺术更自然、更真实的效果。背景采用斜向分割的旅行电影拼贴画：一个板块展示了悬崖上地中海风格的沿海小镇，旁边是平静的蓝色水域和远处的飞鸟；一个板块展示了乡村铁路线，左侧有一列火车，轨道旁立着电线杆；一个板块展示了白雪皑皑的山脉和静谧山谷中蜿蜒的道路；一个板块展示了暮色下的城市天际线和点点灯光；最后一个板块展示了日落时分沿海岸弯曲的海滨公路。采用柔和的奶油色、蓝色和板岩色调，营造出怀旧的春季旅行氛围。在左上方添加优雅的电影节奖项月桂叶，精确堆叠 3 个月桂叶，并配以西班牙语文字，标明主要动画电影节奖项。在底部附近添加居中的大号标题排版，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="VIAJES DE PRIMAVERA"}，使用精致的淡象牙色衬线字体。在其下方，添加一行较小的西班牙语斜体标语 {argument name="tagline" default="Cada destino cambia su corazón."}。在下方添加发行信息行 {argument name="release text" default="PRÓXIMAMENTE EN CINES"}。在最底部包含微小的制作人员名单文字和一个小型工作室标志。整张图片应呈现出艺术电影海报的质感，宣传春季旅行题材的剧情片，具备平衡的留白、高级的布局设计以及逼真的印刷海报排版。

templates.title: Luxury Sunglasses Summer Promotion Advertisement

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华太阳镜夏季促销广告

templates.prompt: A stylish, high-end e-commerce ad showcases a pair of glossy black designer sunglasses, positioned at the center of a futuristic metal base with rounded corners and a luminous blue-white rim. Presented at a three-quarter front view, slightly tilted, the sunglasses feature thick, oversized square cat-eye frames with dark grey gradient lenses. The temples bear a delicate gold TOUS logo, and a small gold bear logo is located near the hinges. The background is a dark, sci-fi studio with reflective black and gunmetal grey surfaces, vertical architectural lighting strips, soft volumetric lighting, and cool-toned neon accents. A prominent promotional text layout in the upper right corner prominently displays the brand name.{argument name="brand name" default="Pollo.ai"} Placed in a huge stacked header{argument name="headline text" default="SUMMER SALE"} Above, SUMMER is white, SALE is a bright electric blue, followed by a huge white discount number.{argument name="discount" default="50%"} A thin, futuristic blue border is added around the title area. The design employs dramatic commercial lighting, sharp reflections, a luxurious product photography style, shallow depth of field, ultra-minimalist composition, advanced online store advertising aesthetics, photorealistic rendering, high contrast, and crisp detail.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张时尚的高端电商产品广告，展示了一副光泽感十足的黑色设计师太阳镜，置于一个带有圆角和蓝白色边缘发光效果的未来感金属底座中央。太阳镜以四分之三正面视角呈现，略微倾斜，采用厚实的超大方形猫眼镜框，配有深灰色渐变镜片，镜腿上有精致的金色 TOUS 品牌标识，铰链附近还有一个小巧的金色熊形标志。背景是一个深色科幻摄影棚，具有反光的黑色和枪灰色表面、垂直建筑灯带、柔和的体积光以及冷色调霓虹灯点缀。在右上角添加醒目的促销文本布局，将品牌名称 {argument name="brand name" default="Pollo.ai"} 置于巨大的堆叠标题 {argument name="headline text" default="SUMMER SALE"} 上方，其中 SUMMER 为白色，SALE 为明亮的电光蓝，随后是巨大的白色折扣数字 {argument name="discount" default="50%"}。在标题区域的部分周围加入细细的未来感蓝色边框线条。采用戏剧性的商业照明、锐利的反光、奢华的产品摄影风格、浅景深、超简洁的构图、高级在线商店广告美学、照片级渲染、高对比度以及清晰的细节。

templates.title: Luxury perfume advertisements on marble dressing tables

titleLocalized.zh: 大理石梳妆台上的奢华香水广告

templates.prompt: A luxurious e-commerce advertisement photo of a high-end perfume bottle on a polished gray-white marble vanity employs a warm, cinematic style, featuring soft golden lighting, shallow depth of field, and elegant reflections. The composition is square and highly textured, with the perfume bottle positioned slightly to the right of the frame, leaving space for promotional text on the left. The bottle is a tall, sculptural, hourglass-shaped glass bottle with a gradient smoky transparent gray base, a glossy gold spherical cap, a gold neck engraved with the exquisite brand logo, and a large, interwoven metallic gold monogram on the front. Maintain the brand identity without adding other products. The left foreground includes a cut crystal bowl with gold trim, partially cropped. The right background features a frosted gold cylindrical vase containing a soft white bouquet, blurred in the background. Behind the bottle is a black marble rectangular box with delicate white texture and gold trim. A champagne-colored satin fabric is softly blurred in the lower right foreground. The background should have a deep, luxurious, and softly blurred effect with a rich brown-black tone, and a vertical shadow panel on the left to complement the typography. Add an elegant serif font title in the upper left corner, with the content {argument name="headline text" default="Premium Perfume,"} It uses large, warm beige lettering; below it is a smaller serif subheading with the following content:{argument name="tagline" default="Subtlety and Elegance"} Add a thin, short, gold horizontal line below the subtitle. Place a small white logo in the upper right corner with the following text:{argument name="brand logo" default="Pollo.ai"} It emphasizes high-end materials, realistic glass refraction, golden metallic highlights, luxury product photography, exquisite composition, soft bokeh, and high-end beauty advertising aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高端香水瓶在抛光灰白大理石梳妆台上的奢华电商广告照片，采用温暖的电影级摄影风格，配以柔和的金色光影、浅景深和优雅的倒影。构图为方形且极具质感，香水瓶位于画面偏右侧，左侧留有促销文字空间。瓶身呈高挑的雕塑感沙漏状玻璃瓶，底部为渐变的烟熏透明灰色，配有光泽感金色球形瓶盖、刻有精致品牌标识的金色瓶颈，以及瓶身正面巨大的金属金色交织字母组合。保持品牌感，但不要添加其他产品。左侧前景包含 1 个带金边的切割水晶碗，部分画面被裁剪。右侧背景包含 1 个磨砂金色圆柱形花瓶，内插 1 束柔和的白色花束，呈虚化状态。瓶身背后放置 1 个带有细腻白色纹理和金色饰边的黑色大理石长方形盒。右下角前景处放置 1 块香槟色缎面布料，柔和虚化。背景应呈现深邃、奢华且柔和的虚化效果，带有浓郁的棕黑色调，左侧设有垂直阴影面板以衬托排版。在左上方添加优雅的衬线字体标题，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="Premium Perfume,"}，使用大号暖米色字母；下方配以较小的衬线副标题，内容为 {argument name="tagline" default="Subtlety and Elegance"}，副标题下方加一条纤细的短横金色线条。在右上角放置一个小型白色徽标，内容为 {argument name="brand logo" default="Pollo.ai"}。强调高级材质、逼真的玻璃折射、金色金属高光、奢华产品摄影、精致构图、柔和焦外成像以及高端美妆广告美学。

templates.title: Vintage Beagle Plant Guide

titleLocalized.zh: 复古比格犬植物图鉴

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, transform it into a vintage natural history encyclopedia illustration in the style of 19th-century scientific botanical illustrations. Retain the beagle and potted plant from the reference image as the main subjects, but redraw them as fine ink lines and pastel specimen illustrations drawn on aged off-white pages. Retain the dog's sitting posture, collar, and tag, as well as the plant's pot and overall structure. Add a formal infographic layout, containing a total of eight labeled areas: one central full-body study of a large beagle, one large plant study on the right, four left-side illustrations labeled "Fig. 1. Head (Front View)," "Fig. 2. Head (Side View)," "Fig. 3. Collar and Tag," and "Fig. 4. Forelegs (Front View)," three bottom-level comparative detail studies labeled "Eyes," "Nose," and "Leaf (Detail)," and one bottom-right annotation panel. Add delicate dotted line annotations around the main dog and plant, indicating features such as eyes, ears, nose, chest, legs, paws, fur, leaves, stems, and roots. The book features the page title "THE BEAGLE & THE HOUSEPLANT" at the top, the subtitle "Observations on a Domestic Companion and Its Environment," corner plate labels "PL. I." and "Tab. 1.", the central caption "Fig. 5. Adult Beagle (Canis lupus familiaris). Sitting posture.", the plant description "Fig. 6. Potted plant (Dracaena sp.)," the bottom section title "Fig. 7. Comparative Study: Details," and a five-line footnote box: "Location: Indoor," "Observations: Peaceful coexistence between companion animals and potted plants.", "Date: May 17, 2024," "Observer: Naturalist's Log," and "Plate I." It employs clean engraving lines, restrained light watercolor washes, delicate paper textures, decorative borders, and a symmetrical museum-style plate composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图片，将其转化为 19 世纪科学动植物插画风格的复古博物学百科全书图版。保留参考图中的比格犬和盆栽植物作为主体，但将其重绘为绘制在做旧米白色页面上的精细墨线与淡彩标本插图。保留狗的坐姿、项圈和吊牌，以及植物的花盆和整体结构。添加正式的信息图布局，总共包含 8 个标注区域：1 个中央大型比格犬全身研究图，1 个右侧大型植物研究图，4 个左侧栏插图，分别标注为“图 1. 头部（正面）”、“图 2. 头部（侧面）”、“图 3. 项圈与吊牌”和“图 4. 前爪（前视图）”，3 个底部对比细节研究图，分别标注为“眼睛”、“鼻子”和“叶片（细节）”，以及 1 个右下角的注释面板。在主要犬只和植物周围添加精致的虚线标注，标明眼睛、耳朵、鼻子、胸部、腿、爪、毛发、叶片、茎和根等特征。在顶部包含页面标题“THE BEAGLE & THE HOUSEPLANT”，副标题“Observations on a Domestic Companion and Its Environment”，角落图版标记“PL. I.”和“Tab. 1.”，中央说明文字“图 5. 比格犬（Canis lupus familiaris）成年。坐姿。”，植物说明文字“图 6. 盆栽植物（Dracaena sp.）”，底部章节标题“图 7. 对比研究：细节”，以及一个包含 5 行内容的注释框：“地点：室内”、“观察结果：伴侣动物与盆栽植物的和平共处。”、“日期：2024 年 5 月 17 日”、“观察者：博物学家日志”和“图版 I.”。采用干净的雕版线条、克制的淡水彩渲染、细腻的纸张纹理、装饰性边框角以及对称的博物馆图版构图。
