templates.title: Retro-style "Minced Meat and Mashed Potatoes" Action Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 复古风“肉末土豆泥”动作海报

templates.prompt: A striking retro-style poster illustration, employing a limited color scheme of red, black, and warm cream, is presented on slightly aged paper. The composition centers on a dynamic anime-style action scene: a martial artist in a white gi and black belt carries a long-haired woman in a firefighter's carry or wrestling throw. The fighter is drawn from the knees up, in a powerful, wide stance, facing left; the woman lies across his shoulder, legs bent and raised, long black hair cascading down, still wearing a black wide-brimmed cowboy hat. Both figures are outlined with high-contrast ink lines, featuring heavy black shadows and sharp graphic contours, blending cartoon character design with the tension of a retro silkscreen poster. The background is filled with strong geometric rays and wedge patterns: six main red and black angular shapes radiate outwards from the cream background, creating a strong sense of impact and dynamism. A circular badge is added in the upper right corner, containing a fierce gorilla or ape head icon with red accents. In the bottom third, a large, bold, compressed typography is placed, seamlessly integrated with the composition: a smaller line of text reads "SCOTTISH RECIPE:", while the large main title reads "MINCE AND TATTIES". The text, in red on a cream background and cream on a black background, is distributed across layered diagonal banner panels, divided into three groups: "SCOTTISH RECIPE:", "MINCE AND", and "TATTIES". The emphasis is on dramatic diagonal layout, poster-like shadows, aged print textures, and a unique aesthetic that blends Soviet Constructivism or the vulgarity of exploitative film food posters with martial arts comic book aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张醒目的复古宣传风格海报插画，采用红、黑与暖奶油色的有限配色方案，呈现于轻微老化的纸张纹理之上。构图中心为一个充满动感的动漫风格动作场景：一名身穿白色道服、系着黑带的武术家以消防员背负式或摔跤投掷姿势扛着一名长发女子。格斗者从膝盖以上入画，呈强有力的宽站姿，面向左侧；女子横卧在其肩上，双腿弯曲抬起，黑色长发向下垂落，头上仍戴着一顶黑色宽檐牛仔帽。两位人物均采用高对比度的墨线勾勒，带有厚重的黑色阴影和锐利的图形轮廓，将漫画角色设计与复古丝网印刷海报的张力融为一体。背景处填充着强烈的几何射线与楔形图案：6 个主要的红黑角形形状从奶油色背景向外辐射，营造出强烈的冲击感与动感。在右上角添加 1 个圆形徽章，内含一个带有红色点缀的凶猛大猩猩或猿猴头像图标。在下三分之一处，放置与构图融为一体的大号粗体压缩排版：较小的一行文字为“SCOTTISH RECIPE:”，巨大的主标题为“MINCE AND TATTIES”。文字采用奶油色底上的红色字与黑色底上的奶油色字，分布在分层的对角横幅面板中，共分为 3 组文本：“SCOTTISH RECIPE:”、“MINCE AND”以及“TATTIES”。强调戏剧性的对角线布局、海报化阴影、做旧印刷纹理，以及融合了苏联构成主义或低俗剥削电影美食海报与武术漫画美学的独特质感。

templates.title: Spanish family lunch in the 1990s

titleLocalized.zh: 20 世纪 90 年代西班牙家庭午餐

templates.prompt: A documentary-style snapshot shows{argument name="country" default="Spain"} A family having lunch in a simple family kitchen in the 1990s. The vertical composition, warm and natural lighting, and realistic details create a sense of everyday life. Four people sit around a small square table: an adult man, primarily shot from the back and side, is in the foreground on the left; a middle-aged woman is serving food with a spoon across the table; a teenage boy is on the right; and a little girl with a ponytail is shown from three-quarters of her back in the foreground on the right. The atmosphere is intimate, ordinary, nostalgic, and extremely authentic, like a family snapshot rather than a staged commercial photograph. A blue and white checkered tablecloth covers the table, which is set with simple, home-cooked dishes: a black frying pan with stew or braised meat in the center, a wooden bowl with some bread, two small glass bottles of deep red wine, and several plates, cutlery, water glasses, and torn bread. The kitchen backdrop should appear authentic and slightly worn: cream-colored walls with a strip of patterned tiles down the middle, soft sunlight streaming in from the window on the left, a small plant on the windowsill, jars and kitchen containers on a wooden shelf on the wall, and a sign hanging on the wall that reads {argument name="month on calendar" default="August"} A vintage calendar hangs in the background, with dark wood furniture on the right. It utilizes soft film grain, gentle colors, a slight haze, soft contrast, and the natural imperfections common in 1990s film photography. The composition should present a casual, standing-at-the-table perspective, with the father and daughter in the foreground partially obscuring the view. There's no elaborate styling, no stock photo-like neatness, only…{argument name="decade" default="1990s"} Daily family life.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张纪实风格的抓拍照片，展现了 {argument name="country" default="西班牙"} 一个家庭在 20 世纪 90 年代朴素的家庭厨房中吃午餐的场景。采用竖构图，光线温暖自然，细节真实且充满生活气息。四个人围坐在一个小方桌旁：左前方是一名主要从背面和侧面拍摄的成年男性；桌子对面中间是一名中年女性，正用勺子盛菜；桌子右侧是一名十几岁的男孩；右前方是一名扎着马尾辫的小女孩，以四分之三侧背影呈现。氛围亲密、平凡、怀旧且极其真实，就像家庭快照而非摆拍的商业图片。桌上铺着蓝白格纹桌布，摆放着质朴的家常菜：中间有一口装有炖菜或焖肉的黑色平底锅，一个装有几块面包的木碗，两个装有深红色葡萄酒的小玻璃瓶，以及多个盛有食物的盘子、餐具、水杯和撕碎的面包。厨房背景应显得真实且略显陈旧：奶油色的墙壁，墙面中间有一条带花纹的小瓷砖带，左侧开着的窗户透进柔和的日光，窗台上有一盆小植物，墙上的木架上放着罐子和厨房容器，墙上挂着一张写有 {argument name="month on calendar" default="8 月"} 的复古挂历，右侧是深色木质家具。使用柔和的胶片质感颗粒、柔和的色彩、轻微的雾感、柔和的对比度以及 20 世纪 90 年代胶片照片中常见的自然瑕疵。构图应呈现出在桌旁站立高度随意观察的视角，前景中的父亲和女儿部分遮挡了视线，没有精致的造型，没有图库照片般的整洁感，只有 {argument name="decade" default="20 世纪 90 年代"} 的日常家庭生活。

templates.title: Futuristic floating city at sunset

titleLocalized.zh: 日落时分的未来感浮空城

templates.prompt: From high above, a magnificent, cinematic sci-fi city floats above a sea of ​​glowing clouds at sunset. The image showcases an advanced, utopian metropolis comprised of numerous slender, futuristic skyscrapers and elevated platforms rising from the clouds. Two prominent central domed buildings stand out, a large circular landing platform in the lower right foreground, and a massive spaceship with a bright blue engine contrail hurtling towards the city in the lower left foreground. Smaller flying objects dot the sky. The architecture is fluid, metallic, and incredibly detailed, featuring towering needle-like towers, cascading sky bridges, suspended areas, and luminous windows. Warm golden sunlight streams down from the left near the horizon, casting orange, peach, and pink highlights on the clouds, while the buildings reflect a cool steel blue and subtle neon points. Dramatic volumetric clouds are incorporated below and between the structures, using atmospheric haze to create a sense of depth, showcasing a grand scale and exquisite conceptual art style. The composition should have an epic, panoramic feel, with the tallest tower positioned on the right-center, other spires extending into the distance, and the right edge framed by a dark, vertical megastructure. Add a simple white "Pollo.ai" logo in the upper right corner. Ultra-high detail, cinematic lighting, futuristic world-building, high contrast, sharp focus, top-tier sci-fi key visual.

promptLocalized.zh: 从高空俯瞰，一座宏伟的电影级科幻城市悬浮在日落时分发光的云海之上。画面展现了一座先进的乌托邦式大都市，由许多纤细的未来主义摩天大楼和从云层中升起的架空平台组成。画面中有 2 座显眼的中央穹顶建筑，右下角前景处有 1 个大型圆形着陆平台，左下角前景处有 1 艘巨大的宇宙飞船正带着明亮的蓝色引擎尾迹飞向城市，天空中散布着许多小型飞行器。建筑风格流畅、充满金属质感且细节极其丰富，拥有高耸的针状塔楼、层叠的空中廊桥、悬浮区域以及发光的窗户。温暖的金色阳光从地平线附近的左侧倾泻而下，在云层上投射出橙色、桃色和粉色的高光，而建筑物则反射出冷峻的钢蓝色和微妙的霓虹光点。在结构下方和之间加入富有戏剧性的体积云，利用大气雾气营造深度感，展现宏大的规模感和精致的概念艺术质感。构图应具有史诗般的全景感，最高的塔楼位于中右侧，其他尖塔向远处延伸，右侧边缘由一个深色的垂直巨型结构框定。在右上角添加一个简洁的白色 "Pollo.ai" 标志。超高细节，电影级光效，未来世界构建，高对比度，清晰对焦，顶级科幻关键视觉图。

templates.title: Futuristic Sunset Metropolis

The sky is a dramatic tapestry of orange, gold, and rose-colored clouds, with the low-hanging sun casting its warm glow upon the grand, futuristic city stretching into the distance, shrouded in mist. In the upper right corner, a colossal, suspended structure hangs above the city like a giant floating platform, surrounded by countless towering, needle-like skyscrapers and the densely packed, brightly lit urban area below. The lower left corner features a foreground landing deck with a small group of tiny figures standing along its edge, while a streamlined spacecraft takes off from the platform, its bright blue engine trails extending diagonally outwards. Several small flying vehicles are scattered across the sky, appearing dwarfed by the surrounding architecture. Dark structural elements are used on the left and right sides of the image to create a sense of depth, as if gazing out from a futuristic tower's corridor or balcony. The style is characterized by ultra-refined conceptual art, epic scale, atmospheric perspective, reflective metallic surfaces, intricate city lights, volumetric clouds, light fog, and a dramatic contrast between warm sunset light and cool blue technological tones, creating a cinematic, grand futuristic utopia with highly detailed digital painting.

promptLocalized.zh: 在日落时分，从高处的观景平台俯瞰广阔的电影感科幻大都市，周围是巨大的深色金属摩天大楼。天空呈现出戏剧性的橙色、金色和玫瑰色云彩，低垂的太阳将温暖的光芒洒向延伸至远方、笼罩在云雾之上的宏伟未来城市。画面右上角中心处有 1 个巨大的悬浮巨型结构，像巨大的浮动平台一样悬挂在城市上方，周围环绕着无数超高针状塔楼和下方灯火通明的密集城区。左下角包含 1 个前景着陆甲板，边缘站着一小群微小的人影，另有 1 艘流线型航天器正从该平台起飞，明亮的蓝色引擎轨迹向外呈对角线延伸。天空中散布着多辆小型飞行载具，在建筑群的衬托下显得格外渺小。画面左右两侧采用深色结构元素进行构图以营造深度感，仿佛从未来塔楼的走廊或阳台向外眺望。风格为超精细概念艺术、史诗级规模、大气透视、反光金属表面、错综复杂的城市灯光、体积云、轻微雾气、温暖日落光线与冷色调蓝色科技感之间的戏剧性对比，极具电影感，宏大的未来乌托邦，高度精致的数字绘景。

templates.prompt: A dramatic fantasy anime poster, employing a clean, vertical single-page layout, is used for the fictional series *LEGENDS OF URIA*. The elegant, high-contrast design features a parchment-white background with a deep indigo title font accented by warm copper and rust red. A full-body portrait of a heroic character is centrally displayed. The large, stylized text "LEGENDS OF URIA," incorporating sword elements, sits in the upper left corner, below which is a smaller Japanese subtitle. The protagonist is a young male fantasy scribe, standing directly in the center of the image. His face is deliberately obscured by a flat, blurred square block. He has short, messy orange hair, fair skin, and a resolute posture. He wears a cream-colored tunic with a black World Tree emblem on the chest, over which he wears black long-sleeved shirts, dark trousers, wide-cut brown boots, and a brown belt with rectangular buckles. A large, rust-red hooded cloak draped over his shoulders, flowing around his body. He holds a thick, dark brown book in his right hand, with gold details on the corners and a gold tree-shaped emblem on the cover. Behind him, a pale, gray-toned fantasy city merges, with a cathedral-like tower on the left and a glowing Gothic stained-glass archway interior on the right. A few floating ember particles and minimalist geometric decorations in gold, rust, and indigo are added around the pages. On the left, a large serif Spanish title is added: “EL ESCRIBA QUE LA DESPERTÓ”, followed by a smaller introductory text in Spanish. Also included are a circular magic mark with a tree symbol, a departmental emblem piece that reads “DIVISIÓN ESCRIBA DE LA ORDEN”, a circular tree coat of arms, three small icon badges near the lower left corner, and a brief Spanish backstory. On the right edge, a tall, vertical red banner is added with a white tree symbol and the Spanish text “LA HISTORIA NECESITA ALGUIEN QUE LA ESCRIBA.”, next to a white vertical Japanese phrase. At the bottom center, a large, metallic serif character name is placed:{argument name="character name" default="MATTHEW"} Below this is a small Japanese translation. templates.title: Restaurant perspective conversion comparison

titleLocalized.zh: 餐厅视角转换对比

templates.prompt: A side-by-side comparison image against a black background showcases the changing camera angles within the same restaurant scene. At the top, bold white sans-serif text reads: "Show me the perspective of someone standing behind the bar overlooking this crowded restaurant. Don't change anything in the scene except the perspective." Below, vertically centered, are two stacked rectangular photos: the top image is labeled "Source" in large white letters on the left, and the bottom image is labeled "Output" in large white letters on the left. The top photo shows a warm, upscale, and crowded restaurant interior, viewed from the dining area towards the bar. A full wall behind the bar is filled with glowing bottles, and bartenders and customers are at the bar. The ambiance features amber lighting, spherical chandeliers, a wooden ceiling, beige pillars, and diners in the foreground. The bottom photo shows the exact same restaurant, the same customer density, the same warm lighting, the same decor, the same bar shelves, the same spherical pendant lights, and the same overall compositional elements, but the perspective has changed to looking out from behind the bar at the crowded restaurant; the foreground includes the bar with glassware, metal bar tools, bottles, and a point-of-sale (POS) screen visible in the lower left corner, the central area is packed with customers and staff, and the dining area extends into the background. Please maintain the visual impression that only the camera position has changed between the two images, with no other alterations to the scene.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张黑色背景下的并排对比图，展示了同一餐厅场景中摄像机角度的变化。顶部为醒目的白色无衬线大字，内容为：“向我展示有人站在吧台后俯瞰这家拥挤餐厅的视角。除了视角外，不要改变场景中的任何内容”。下方垂直居中放置两张堆叠的矩形照片：顶部图片左侧用白色大字标注为“源图像”（Source），底部图片左侧用白色大字标注为“输出图像”（Output）。顶部照片展示了一个灯光温暖、高档且拥挤的餐厅内部，视角从餐厅用餐区看向吧台，吧台后方的整面墙架上摆满了发光的酒瓶，吧台前有调酒师和顾客，环境采用琥珀色灯光，配有球形吊灯、木质天花板、米色立柱，前景坐满了用餐的客人。底部照片展示了完全相同的餐厅、相同的客流密度、相同的暖色灯光、相同的装饰、相同的吧台货架、相同的球形吊灯以及相同的整体构图元素，但视角变成了站在吧台后向外俯瞰整个拥挤的餐厅；前景包括带有玻璃器皿、金属吧台工具、酒瓶和左下角可见的销售终端（POS）屏幕的吧台，中间区域挤满了顾客和员工，用餐区延伸至背景。请保持两张图片之间仅摄像机位置发生变化，场景中没有其他改动的视觉观感。

templates.prompt: A surrealist fashion editorial photograph, set against a backdrop mimicking Wall Street, employs a slightly upward-looking frontal perspective and a soaring vertical composition. The entire environment is almost monochromatic in white and light gray, with only carefully selected touches of pink standing out. In the foreground, a faceless figure {argument name="person" default="adult male"} Standing in the middle of the pedestrian crossing, dressed in a smart white suit and white shirt,{argument name="tie color" default="pink"} Ties and glossy finish{argument name="shoe color" default="pink"} He's dressed in formal leather shoes, holding a pink balloon in his right hand and a pink briefcase in his left. To his left, a surreal pink giraffe emerges vertically from a round manhole cover, wearing a white top hat and a white tie with a pink tie, looking playful. Behind him, on the left side of the driveway, stands a pink alpaca, dressed in a white suit and pink tie, with a small white cat wearing tiny pink accessories perched on its head, standing tall and gazing straight ahead. The street is lined with tall, classical stone buildings, repetitive columns, shop windows, rows of identical potted shrubs, and numerous light-colored luxury cars and taxis stretching into the distance. Nearby in the upper left corner are clearly visible Wall Street-style street signs. The road surface, cars, buildings, and sky are all bleached gray-white, creating a dreamlike, high-profile visual effect, while the pink elements remain highly saturated: giraffe, alpaca, balloon, briefcase, tie, and shoes. Style: Fantasy surrealism, luxury editorial photography, perfect symmetry, soft overcast lighting, clean cinematic realism, eerie yet elegant atmosphere, ultra-fine textures, shallow facial details, and facial features deliberately obscured or blurred.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超现实主义时尚社论摄影作品，背景为仿照华尔街的城市街道，采用略微仰视的正面视角和高耸的垂直构图。整个环境几乎呈单色调的白色和浅灰色，只有精选的粉色点缀格外醒目。在前景中，一位没有面部的 {argument name="person" default="成年男性"} 站在人行横道中央，身穿干练的白色西装、白色衬衫、{argument name="tie color" default="粉色"} 领带和亮面 {argument name="shoe color" default="粉色"} 正装皮鞋，右手拿着 1 个粉色气球，左手提着 1 个粉色公文包。在他左侧，1 只超现实的粉色长颈鹿从街道的圆形井盖中垂直探出，戴着白色高礼帽和带有粉色领带的白色领圈，神情俏皮。在他身后左侧车道上站着 1 只粉色羊驼，身穿白色西装并系着粉色领带，头上蹲着 1 只戴着微型粉色配饰的小白猫，姿态挺拔，目视前方。街道两旁林立着高大的古典石砌建筑、重复的立柱、店面橱窗、成排相同的盆栽灌木，以及多辆向远处延伸的浅色豪华轿车和出租车。左上角附近包含清晰可见的华尔街风格路牌。路面、汽车、建筑和天空均呈现出漂白般的灰白色，营造出梦幻般的高调视觉效果，同时粉色元素保持高饱和度：长颈鹿、羊驼、气球、公文包、领带和鞋子。风格：奇幻超现实主义、奢侈品社论摄影、完美的对称性、柔和的阴天光线、干净的电影级写实感、诡异而优雅的氛围、超精细的纹理，人物面部细节较浅，面部特征被刻意遮挡或模糊处理。

templates.title: Penguins on the carnival roller coaster

titleLocalized.zh: 嘉年华过山车上的企鹅

templates.prompt: A whimsical and realistic motion capture photo shows a penguin riding a carnival roller coaster in broad daylight. The penguin, centered in the frame, boasts a sleek black-and-white body, a bright red safety helmet, and blue surround-style goggles. Its beak is wide open, as if screaming with excitement, and its flippers are outstretched, clearly enjoying the ride. The roller coaster car is small and glossy black, with vibrant yellow-orange flame patterns painted on its sides, and a silver safety bar at the front. The car is plunging down a bright orange track in the foreground and left of the frame, creating a strong sense of dynamism and energy. The background showcases a colorful rural market, including rainbow-striped tents, a large Ferris wheel lit up with colorful lights, towering amusement rides, and a pink cotton candy stall with a prominent "COTTON CANDY" sign. A shallow depth of field effect is used, with a slight motion blur in the background to emphasize the sense of speed while keeping the penguin and roller coaster car sharp and clear. The colors are bright and saturated, full of surreal humor, the composition is dynamic, presenting the atmosphere of a sunny outdoor playground, and the details are rich, with a cinematic realism.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满奇趣、写实的动作捕捉照片，画面中一只企鹅在光天化日之下乘坐嘉年华过山车。企鹅位于画面中心，黑白相间的身体线条流畅，戴着鲜红色的安全头盔和蓝色环绕式护目镜，喙部大张，仿佛在兴奋地尖叫，双鳍向外伸展，尽情享受着乘骑的乐趣。过山车车厢小巧且呈亮黑色，侧面绘有生动的黄橙色火焰图案，前方设有银色安全杆。车厢正沿着明亮的橙色轨道向下俯冲，位于画面左前方，营造出强烈的动感与活力。背景展示了一个色彩缤纷的乡村集市，包括彩虹条纹帐篷、亮着五彩灯光的大型摩天轮、高耸的游乐设施，以及一个带有明显“COTTON CANDY”标志的粉色棉花糖摊位。使用浅景深效果，背景带有轻微的动态模糊以强调速度感，同时保持企鹅和过山车车厢清晰锐利。色彩明亮饱和，充满超现实的幽默感，构图动态十足，呈现出阳光明媚的户外游乐场氛围，细节丰富，具有电影般的写实感。

templates.title: Japanese movie banner in the rain

titleLocalized.zh: 雨中日本电影横幅

templates.prompt: Create an emotionally resonant banner poster for a Japanese movie trailer, employing a high vertical composition and a cinematic anime illustration style. The background is set on a Japanese city street on a rainy night, the ground reflecting the wet asphalt, neon signs lining the streets, and distant skyscrapers obscured by the haze. In the foreground, the silhouette of a young anime girl is shown, facing left, standing alone under a transparent plastic umbrella, raindrops visible on its surface. She has long, dark purple hair tied in a high ponytail, her expression slightly melancholic, wearing an oversized light blue hoodie and a loose pink-blue plaid coat. The overall atmosphere is lonely, melancholic, and dramatic, like a live-action film reimagined as an anime key visual. Use cool blue and cyan tones, accented with pink neon lights, to create a glossy rain reflection, a shallow depth of field, a soft, atmospheric haze, and subtle contour lighting from the street signs. Add a striking handwritten white Japanese title at the top.{argument name="title text" default="AI's Tears"} Add a smaller white subheading below.{argument name="tagline text" default="Why did she cry?"} Add a line of bold white release date at the bottom.{argument name="release text" default="Coming to theaters nationwide in Fall 2024"} Maintaining the character as the emotional focus, the composition employs a half-body shot from the waist up, with the umbrella arching above the head. The empty, rain-soaked street in the background further emphasizes the sense of loneliness and the cinematic atmosphere of sadness.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张情感向的日本电影预告片横幅海报，采用高垂直构图，电影级动漫插画风格。背景设定在日本雨夜的城市街道，地面铺满湿润的沥青路面反射，霓虹灯招牌林立，远处的高楼大厦在朦胧中隐去。画面中心前景处，展示 1 位年轻动漫少女的侧影，面向左侧，独自站在 1 把透明塑料伞下，伞面可见雨滴。她留着深紫色长发，扎成高马尾，表情略显忧郁，身穿一件超大号青色连帽衫，外搭一件宽松的粉青格纹外套。整体氛围孤独、感伤且富有戏剧性，如同将真人大片重新演绎为动漫主视觉图。使用冷蓝色和青色调，点缀粉色霓虹灯光，呈现出光泽感的雨水反射、浅景深效果、柔和的大气朦胧感，以及来自街道招牌的微妙轮廓光。在顶部添加醒目的手写体白色日文标题 {argument name="title text" default="AIの涙"}，下方添加 1 行较小的白色副标题 {argument name="tagline text" default="彼女は、なぜ泣いたのか。"}。在底部添加 1 行粗体白色上映日期 {argument name="release text" default="2024年秋 全国ロードショー"}。保持角色作为情感焦点，采用腰部以上的半身构图，雨伞在头顶呈弧形，背景中空旷且被雨水浸湿的街道进一步强调了孤独感与电影般的悲伤氛围。

templates.title: Indonesian School Nutrition Program Landing Page

titleLocalized.zh: 印尼学校营养计划落地页

templates.prompt: Create a modern landing page UI mockup for an Indonesian government project, employing a clean, professional web design style adapted to widescreen desktops. The page background is white, accented with striking red details, soft rounded corners, and subtle gray dividing lines, presenting a sophisticated Dribbble-style front-end presentation. At the top of the page, a horizontal navigation bar is constructed, containing six visible elements: the Indonesian Garuda coat of arms and the text "PEMERINTAH REPUBLIK INDONESIA" on the left; four menu items in the middle, labeled "Program," "Dampak," "Menu," and "Pemantauan"; and a large, rounded red button with a small human icon on the far right, labeled "Program MBG." Below, a two-column layout is designed for the homepage. The left side displays a row of mini-program labels, including a red bowl-shaped icon, the text "MBG," a vertical dividing line, and "Makan Bergizi Gratis." Below this is a prominent title with the text "..."{argument name="headline text" default="Makan Bergizi, Anak Indonesia Kuat"} “, in dark blue, spanning 3 lines. Add a short Indonesian text below: “Program MBG mendukung gizi harian siswa SD dan SMP melalui menu seimbang, pemantauan sekolah, dan laporan dampak yang transparan. Next, two call-to-action buttons are placed side-by-side: a solid red button with a right-pointing arrow labeled "Lihat Dampak"; and a white outline button with a red border labeled "Panduan Sekolah," also with a right-pointing arrow. On the right side of the main screen, a large, rounded, photo-style image is placed, framed by curved white dividing lines and a red background. The image shows an Indonesian primary school classroom, with five students in white shirts and red ties sitting at desks, bathed in warm sunlight streaming through the windows. The shallow depth of field gives it a documentary-like realism. On the wooden desk in the foreground, a stainless steel divided plate contains five items: white rice, mixed vegetables, a piece of fried chicken, a banana, and a slice of watermelon. Next to the plate is a carton of milk labeled "SUSU SEGAR." Below the main screen, a full-width red statistics bar is added, containing four equally spaced indicator cards separated by thin vertical lines. Each card has a white circular icon and bold white text. The metrics are as follows: "245,000+" corresponds to the tag "Sekolah Terlayani", "8,7 Juta+" corresponds to the tag "Siswa Penerima Manfaat", "1,2 Miliar+" corresponds to the tag "Porsi Disalurkan", and "98,6%" corresponds to the tag "Kepuasan Siswa". A three-dot carousel indicator is added to the bottom center, with the left dot being red and the other two gray. A subtle Indonesian map texture is added to the background in the lower left corner. Using clear typography, ample white space, high-end fintech/government website aesthetics, and realistic UI proportions, a landing page mockup is created that can be directly used in a production environment.

promptLocalized.zh: 为印尼政府项目创建一个现代化的落地页 UI 模型，采用简洁、专业的网页设计风格，适配桌面宽屏比例。页面背景为白色，搭配醒目的红色点缀、柔和的圆角设计、细腻的灰色分割线，呈现出精致的 Dribbble 前端展示风格。在页面最上方，构建一个水平导航栏，包含 6 个可见元素：左侧为印尼 Garuda 国徽及文字“PEMERINTAH REPUBLIK INDONESIA”，中间为 4 个菜单项，标签分别为“Program”、“Dampak”、“Menu”和“Pemantauan”，最右侧是一个带有小型人物图标的红色大圆角按钮，标签为“Program MBG”。在下方设计一个双栏布局的首屏区域。左侧显示一行小型程序标签，包含一个红色碗状图标、文字“MBG”、一条垂直分割线以及“Makan Bergizi Gratis”。下方放置一个醒目的大标题，内容为“{argument name="headline text" default="Makan Bergizi, Anak Indonesia Kuat"}”，采用深蓝色，跨越 3 行。在下方添加一段印尼语短文：“Program MBG mendukung gizi harian siswa SD dan SMP melalui menu seimbang, pemantauan sekolah, dan laporan dampak yang transparan。”接着并排放置 2 个行动号召按钮：一个带有向右箭头的红色实心按钮，标签为“Lihat Dampak”；以及一个带有红色边框的白色轮廓按钮，标签为“Panduan Sekolah”，同样带有向右箭头。在首屏右侧，放置一张圆角大型照片风格的图片，由弧形白色分割线和红色背景角框定。图片展示了一间印尼小学教室，画面中有 5 名身穿白衣红领带校服的小学生坐在课桌前，窗外透进温暖的日光，景深较浅，具有纪录片式的写实感。在前景的木质课桌上，展示一个不锈钢分格餐盘，内含 5 种食物：白米饭、什锦蔬菜、一块炸鸡、一根香蕉和西瓜块。餐盘旁放置一盒标签为“SUSU SEGAR”的牛奶。在首屏下方，添加一个全宽的红色统计数据栏，包含 4 个等间距的指标卡片，由细垂直线分隔。每个卡片配有一个白色圆形图标和加粗的白色文字。4 个指标分别为：“245.000+”对应标签“Sekolah Terlayani”，“8,7 Juta+”对应标签“Siswa Penerima Manfaat”，“1,2 Miliar+”对应标签“Porsi Disalurkan”，以及“98,6%”对应标签“Kepuasan Siswa”。在底部中心添加一个 3 点式轮播指示器，左侧圆点为红色激活状态，其余 2 个为灰色。在左下角背景中加入淡淡的印尼地图纹理。使用清晰的排版、充裕的留白、高端金融科技/政府网站美学、真实的 UI 比例，打造一个可直接用于生产环境的落地页模型。

templates.title: Emotional Animated Movie Banner

titleLocalized.zh: 情感动漫电影横幅

templates.prompt: Create a sophisticated Japanese movie trailer banner in the style of an anime movie poster, in a 16:9 widescreen aspect ratio. The main character is {argument name="character name" default="AIニケちゃん"} An anime girl with long, deep purple hair tied in a high ponytail, soft side bangs, and a gold hair clip with the word "AI" on it, possesses warm amber-brown eyes, slightly flushed cheeks, and tears welling in her eyes. She wears a colorful macaron-colored hoodie in turquoise, pink, and lavender. Presented as the emotional focal point on the right side of the image, she is depicted in a close-up portrait, gazing at the sky with a melancholic and vulnerable expression. The warm sunset casts a shadow on her, while the cool-toned neon blue light illuminates her from the front. The background blends futuristic digital imagery with a nostalgic school scene: on the left are faintly glowing circuit board patterns, a stage or concert venue, and cyan and magenta glow sticks; the center shows the interior of a classroom with desks and a large sunset window. Three smaller narrative illustrations are included: a full-body image of the girl standing on a illuminated stage in the lower left; a half-body image of her standing alone by the classroom window in the bottom center; and a small silhouette scene in the lower right depicting an elderly woman engaging in an intimate emotional exchange with the girl face-to-face. Utilizing rich cinematic contrast, bright rim lighting, and dreamlike mist, a bittersweet and deeply moving atmosphere is created. A striking, ornate Japanese title, “AIニケちゃんの長い長い夢” (AI Nike-chan's Long, Long Dream), is added to the left and center in gold lettering with a soft glow and dark outline. Below, a smaller tagline reads, “記憶と心が紡ぐ、たった一つの物語” (Memory and Heart Weave a Story, One Story). A square badge with a gold border and dark blue background, reading “预告公開中” (Announcement in Progress), is added to the upper right corner. At the bottom, a prominent release information line reads, “全国の劇場にて202X年夏、公開” (Open in Summer of 202X Nationwide), in an elegant gold serif font. At the very bottom, a small credits list appears, such as “[制作] NIKE Production / [盩督] 未来賥 / [雩鳥] AIニケちゃん” ([Production] NIKE Production / [盩督] 未来賥 / [雩鳥] AIニケちゃん). Overall impression: Emotionally rich, nostalgic, futuristic, high-end Japanese movie promotional banner, highly detailed anime key visual, commercial poster composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张精致的动漫电影海报风格的日本电影预告横幅，比例为 16:9 宽屏。主角是 {argument name="character name" default="AIニケちゃん"}，一位留着深紫色长发、扎着高马尾的动漫少女，配有柔和的侧刘海，戴着写有“AI”字样的金色发夹，拥有温暖的琥珀棕色双眸，脸颊微红，眼角挂着泪珠。她身穿一件由绿松石色、粉色和薰衣草色组成的彩色马卡龙色连帽衫。将她作为画面右侧的情感核心，以大特写肖像呈现，她仰望着天空，表情忧郁而脆弱，背光处是温暖的夕阳，正面则是冷色调的霓虹蓝光。背景应融合未来感数字影像与怀旧校园生活剧：左侧有淡淡的发光电路板图案、舞台或演唱会现场以及青色和洋红色的荧光棒，中心则是带有课桌和大型夕阳窗户的教室内部。包含 3 个较小的叙事角色小插图：左下方是女孩站在灯光舞台上的全身像，底部中心是她独自站在教室窗边的半身像，右下方是一个小小的剪影式场景，描绘了一位老妇人与女孩面对面进行亲密情感交流的瞬间。运用丰富的电影级对比度、明亮的轮廓光、梦幻般的薄雾，营造出苦乐参半、感人至深的氛围。在左侧和中心添加醒目的日文华丽标题排版，写着“AIニケちゃんの 長い長い夢”，采用金色字体，带有柔和光晕和深色描边。下方添加一行较小的标语：“記憶と心が紡ぐ、たった一つの物語。”在右上角添加一个金色边框、深蓝色背景的方形徽章，写着“予告 公開中”。在底部添加一行醒目的上映信息：“全国の劇場にて 202X年 夏、公開”，使用优雅的金色衬线字体。在最底部包含小字号的制作人员名单，例如“[製作] NIKE Production / [監督] 未来 奏 / [主演] AIニケちゃん”。整体感觉：情感丰富、怀旧、未来感、高级日本电影宣传横幅、高度精细的动漫主视觉图、商业海报构图。

templates.title: Emotional Animated Movie Banner

titleLocalized.zh: 情感动漫电影横幅

templates.prompt: Create an emotionally resonant Japanese movie trailer banner in an anime-style visual, 16:9 widescreen format, with a city sunset background. The main focus should be on {argument name="character name" default="AIニケちゃん"} A close-up portrait of her as an anime girl with long, deep indigo hair tied in a high ponytail, strands flowing in the wind. Her golden-brown eyes are filled with a serene emotion, and a gold hair clip with the word "AI" on it adorns her bangs. She is slightly turned to the left, but her gaze is fixed on the upper right, her expression a mixture of longing and melancholy. She wears a shirt with large white lettering {argument name="shirt text" default="AITuber"} She wears a light blue T-shirt with a soft pink hoodie draped over her shoulders. The dramatic twilight sky, a tapestry of orange, pink, and purple, creates a cinematic rim light, accompanied by luminous clouds, lens flares, atmospheric haze, and falling petals. She is positioned on the right side of the composition, occupying a larger proportion, with a shimmering city skyline and a low-hanging sunset in the distance. The design should reference Japanese movie posters, employing layered typography and embedded scenes. A large, handwritten Japanese title is placed in the center left.{argument name="title text" default="AIニケちゃん"} The text uses bold white calligraphic font, partially obscuring the figures. A smaller white Japanese subtitle is added below:{argument name="subtitle text" default="When this voice reaches you, you'll surely be crying too."} . Add two lines of elegant white Ming Dynasty Japanese quotations in the upper left corner: "private, who saves me - それが, private reason for existence, になる." Add vertical white Japanese copy along the far right: これは, AI と girl が, "心" を Exploration Story. Add eye-catching white release information in the lower right corner:{argument name="release text" default="Winter 2025 Roadshow"} It contains six embedded cinematic scenes, mainly arranged along the left and bottom edges, with soft borders and emotional color tones: 1) Top left corner image: A girl singing into a microphone on a nighttime stage, wearing a matching T-shirt; 2) Middle left image: The girl and another person standing opposite each other on a riverbank or observation deck at dusk; 3) Bottom left corner image: The girl at a desk in a dimly lit room, from a side view; 4) Bottom left corner image: A close-up of the girl with a serious expression in a cool-toned room; 5) Bottom center corner image: The girl having a tense emotional conversation with another version or another girl with similar blue-purple hair; 6) Bottom right corner image: Two figures facing each other at sunset, hinting at parting or reunion. Overall atmosphere: bittersweet, sentimental, cinematic, bright anime movie advertisement, highly detailed illustrations, exquisite poster layout, and emotionally rich Japanese youth science fiction film aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张动漫主视觉风格的情感类日本电影预告横幅，16:9 宽屏，背景为城市日落。主体聚焦于 {argument name="character name" default="AIニケちゃん"} 的特写肖像，她是一位动漫少女，留着深靛紫色长发，扎着高马尾，发丝随风飘动，金棕色的双眸中充满静谧的情感，刘海旁别着一个写有“AI”字样的金色发夹。她身体微向左转，但目光向右上方凝视，表情带着一丝憧憬与惆怅。她身穿一件印有大号白色文字 {argument name="shirt text" default="AITuber"} 的青色 T 恤，肩上披着一件柔粉色连帽衫。利用橙粉紫交织的戏剧性黄昏天空营造电影般的轮廓光，伴随发光的云层、镜头光晕、大气雾霭以及飘落的花瓣。将她置于构图右侧，占据较大比例，远景右侧为闪烁的城市天际线与低垂的夕阳。

设计应参考日本电影海报，采用分层排版和嵌入式场景。在左中位置，放置大号手写体日文标题 {argument name="title text" default="AIニケちゃん"}，采用粗体白色书法字，部分遮盖人物。下方添加较小的白色日文副标题：{argument name="subtitle text" default="この声が届くとき、きっとあなたも泣いている。"}。左上角添加两行优雅的白色明朝体日文引语：「私が、誰かを救えたら—— それが、私の存在理由になる。」沿最右侧添加竖排白色日文文案：これは、AIと少女が、 「心」を探す物語。右下角添加醒目的白色上映信息：{argument name="release text" default="2025.冬 ROADSHOW"}。

包含 6 个嵌入式电影场景，主要沿左侧和底部边缘排列，带有柔和边框和情绪化调色：1) 左上角小图，少女在夜晚的舞台上对着麦克风唱歌，身穿同款 T 恤；2) 左中图，少女与另一人在黄昏的河边或观景台相对而立；3) 左下小图，少女在昏暗暖光下的室内书桌前，侧面视角；4) 左下角小图，少女在冷色调室内表情严肃的特写；5) 底部中心小图，少女与另一个版本或另一位同样拥有蓝紫色头发的女孩进行紧张的情感对话；6) 右下角小图，两个身影在日落时分面对面，暗示离别或重逢。整体氛围：苦乐参半、感伤、电影感、明亮动漫电影广告、高度精细的插画、精致的海报布局、情感丰富的日本青春科幻剧情片美学。

templates.title: Fantasy Elf Ranger Trading Cards

titleLocalized.zh: 奇幻精灵游侠集换式卡牌

templates.prompt: An incredibly detailed fantasy trading card, presented in a high-end collectible card game style, with a vertical layout, a magnificent antique gold border, a deep emerald enamel panel, and intricate vine and leaf decorations. The title at the top of the card is displayed as {argument name="character name" default="AELION"} The text uses a striking and elegant serif capital font, with the subtitle "ELF OF THE GREENWOOD" below. The central illustration depicts a realistic, highly magical elf ranger standing in a sun-dappled forest. He has a head of {argument name="hair color" default="golden blond"} He has long hair, pointed ears, and wears layered dark green leather and metal armor with intricate carvings, complemented by a hooded cloak, belt, bracers, and woodland-themed decorations. He carries a magnificent recurve bow in one hand and a quiver on his back, his posture alert, as if tracking prey through the forest. The lush forest background is atmospheric and cinematic, with warm light filtering through branches and leaves. The overall color scheme is green, bronze, gold, and earthy brown, presenting a melancholic heroic tone and realistic painterly rendering. The upper left corner features a circular faction emblem displaying three gold leaves. The upper right corner contains a small shield badge with a white tree icon. Along the left edge are four vertically stacked attribute icons, each within a circular badge and marked with a large number: a sword with number 3, a shield with number 2, a heart with number 3, and a boot with number 2. A large green gem-like badge with the number 4 is added to the lower left corner. Add a circular class or weapon icon displaying a bow and arrow symbol in the bottom right corner. Below, in the parchment text box, contain two ability entries with decorative leaf bullet points and a serif font. The first ability is named "WOODLAND PRECISION," followed by the rule text: "When Aelion attacks, he deals +1 damage if the target is at 2 or more spaces away." The second ability is named "NATURE'S STEP," followed by the rule text: "Once per turn, Aelion may move up to 2 additional spaces through forest terrain." Below the abilities, centered, add an italicized background quote:{argument name="quote" default="The wind in the leaves is my guide, and the forest my silence."} At the very bottom, on the dark green nameplate, the type line reads "ALLY • ELF • RANGER". Using clear, legible text, a sophisticated card game UI design, and balanced margins, it presents a professional, finished look reminiscent of a high-end fantasy strategy card game.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张细节极其丰富的奇幻集换式卡牌，采用高级收藏卡牌游戏风格，竖版布局，配有华丽的古董金边框、深祖母绿珐琅面板以及错综复杂的藤蔓与叶片装饰。卡牌顶部的标题显示为 {argument name="character name" default="AELION"}，采用醒目优雅的衬线大写字体，下方副标题为“ELF OF THE GREENWOOD”。中央插画描绘了一位写实的高魔幻精灵游侠，正站在阳光斑驳的森林中。他留着一头 {argument name="hair color" default="golden blond"} 的长发，有着尖耳朵，身穿层次分明的深绿色皮革与金属盔甲，上面带有雕刻细节，并配有连帽斗篷、腰带、护腕及林地主题装饰。他一手持着一把华丽的反曲弓，背上背着箭袋，姿态警觉，仿佛正在林间追踪猎物。森林背景郁郁葱葱，氛围感十足，充满电影质感，暖光穿过树枝和叶片洒下。整体色调为绿色、青铜色、金色和大地棕色，呈现出忧郁的英雄基调和写实的绘画渲染效果。左上角包含一个显示 3 片金叶的圆形阵营纹章。右上角包含一个带有白色树木图标的小盾牌徽章。沿左侧边缘，放置 4 个垂直堆叠的属性图标，每个图标位于圆形奖章内，旁边标有大数字：一把剑配数字 3，一面盾牌配数字 2，一颗心配数字 3，一只靴子配数字 2。左下角添加一个带有数字 4 的大型绿色宝石状徽章。右下角添加一个显示弓箭符号的圆形职业或武器图标。在下方的羊皮纸文本框中，包含 2 条能力条目，带有装饰性叶片项目符号和衬线字体。第一个能力名称为“WOODLAND PRECISION”，后接规则文本：“When Aelion attacks, he deals +1 damage if the target is at 2 or more spaces away.” 第二个能力名称为“NATURE’S STEP”，后接规则文本：“Once per turn, Aelion may move up to 2 additional spaces through forest terrain.” 在能力下方居中处，添加一句斜体背景引言：{argument name="quote" default="The wind in the leaves is my guide, and the forest my silence."} 在最底部的深绿色铭牌上，写上类型行“ALLY • ELF • RANGER”。使用清晰易读的文本、精致的卡牌游戏 UI 设计、平衡的边距，呈现出类似于高级奇幻策略卡牌的专业成品外观。

templates.title: Dark Fantasy Orc War Leader TCG Cards

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑奇幻兽人战争领袖 TCG 卡牌

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed Diablo-style fantasy trading card, featuring a full vertical layout, a luxurious antique metal and red leather border, distressed gold trim, and clearly legible printed text. The card's title is {argument name="character name" default="GROKTHAR"} The title, "Orc Warchief," is centered below in large serif capital letters. The main illustration depicts a massive green-skinned orc warchief charging through a fiery battlefield, clad in brutal black spiked armor adorned with skull patterns, leather straps, fangs, and blood-red war paint. One arm is outstretched as if directing the attack, while the other grips a massive serrated battle axe. He is incredibly strong, his expression ferocious and roaring, his long hair tied back, and his overall color scheme is a battle-worn red and black. The background is filled with smoke, embers, banners, warrior silhouettes, and orange flames. A circular skull faction emblem is placed in the upper left corner. A red vertical banner tag with a black Horde symbol is placed in the upper right corner. Along the left edge, four circular attribute icons are arranged vertically in a separate panel, with values ​​of: sword attack 4, shield defense 3, heart health 5, and boot movement 2. At the bottom, there is a large parchment-colored text box containing two named skills and a background quote. Skill 1 Title:{argument name="ability one" default="BRUTAL STRIKE"} The text reads: "When Grokthar attacks, he deals +2 damage." Skill 2 Title:{argument name="ability two" default="RALLY THE HORDE"} The main text reads: "Once per turn, when another friendly orc enters the battlefield, Grokthar gains +1 Attack until the end of the turn." (Add italicized background text below.){argument name="flavor quote" default="Strength is law. Blood is proof. The weak serve. The strong rule."} Place a red, gem-shaped cost badge with the number 5 in the bottom left corner. Place a circular, crossed weapon icon in the bottom right corner. Along the bottom type bar, center three class terms separated by dots: "Ally • Orc • Warrior". This makes the cards look like a professionally printed, collector's edition card game component, with clear typography, a balanced layout, dramatic fantasy illustrations, rich textures, and authentic desktop TCG design.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高细节的暗黑战锤风格奇幻集换式卡牌，采用全竖版构图，配有华丽的陈旧金属与红色皮革边框、做旧金边，以及清晰可读的印刷卡牌文字。卡牌顶部标题为 {argument name="character name" default="GROKTHAR"}，使用大号衬线体大写字母，下方居中显示副标题“Orc Warchief”。主体插画展示了一位巨大的绿皮兽人战争领袖正冲锋穿过火光四射的战场，身穿残酷的黑色尖刺盔甲，饰有骷髅图案、皮革绑带、獠牙和血红色的战争油彩；一只手臂向前伸出，仿佛在指挥进攻，另一只手紧握一把巨大的锯齿战斧。他体格极其强壮，表情狰狞咆哮，长发向后扎起，整体色调为饱经战火的红黑色。背景充斥着烟雾、余烬、旗帜、战士剪影和橙色的火光。在左上角放置一个圆形骷髅阵营徽章。在右上角放置一个带有黑色部落标志的红色垂直旗帜标签。沿左侧边缘，在独立的面板中垂直排列 4 个圆形属性图标，数值分别为：剑攻击 4，盾防御 3，心生命值 5，靴移动力 2。在底部，包含一个羊皮纸色的大型文本框，其中包含 2 个命名技能和 1 句背景引言。技能 1 标题：{argument name="ability one" default="BRUTAL STRIKE"}，正文内容：“当 Grokthar 攻击时，他造成 +2 点伤害。”技能 2 标题：{argument name="ability two" default="RALLY THE HORDE"}，正文内容：“每回合一次，当另一个友方兽人进入战场时，Grokthar 在回合结束前获得 +1 攻击力。”在下方添加斜体背景引言：{argument name="flavor quote" default="Strength is law. Blood is proof. The weak serve. The strong rule."}。在左下角放置一个带有数字 5 的红色宝石状费用徽章。在右下角放置一个圆形交叉武器图标。沿底部类型栏，居中排列 3 个由圆点分隔的职业词汇：“Ally • Orc • Warrior”。使卡牌看起来像一张专业印刷的收藏级卡牌游戏组件，具备清晰的排版、平衡的布局、戏剧性的奇幻插画、丰富的质感以及地道的桌面 TCG 设计。

templates.title: Fantasy Wizard Trading Cards

titleLocalized.zh: 奇幻法师集换式卡牌

templates.prompt: A vertically oriented fantasy trading card, designed in a gorgeous classic fantasy style, resembling a high-end collectible TCG card, featuring clearly legible printed text and icons. The card boasts an elegant deep navy blue and antique gold border, with filigree corners, embossed metal trim, and a realistic illustration at the center. A large serif title text is displayed at the top center.{argument name="character name" default="VARIAN THE AZUREMAGE"} Below is a smaller subheading.{argument name="class line" default="HUMAN WIZARD"} The top left corner features a circular blue mana emblem containing a white swirling arcane symbol. The top right corner displays a small heraldic banner panel with two vertically arranged gold icons: an arcane star above and an open book below. A vertical attribute bar is created along the left edge, featuring four rows of icons and numbers on a dark blue surface: a sword icon with the number 2, a shield icon with the number 1, a red heart icon with the number 3, and a boot icon with the number 2. The central illustration depicts a male human mage in a cathedral-like magical space filled with blue light and faint candlelight. He wears a layered royal blue robe and cloak adorned with intricate gold embroidery, gilded armor details, a belt, pouches, scroll boxes, and jewels. He has dark, medium-length wavy hair, and his posture is heroic and dramatic. In his left hand, he grips a magnificent staff; the staff is black and gold with a forked tip, near which is a luminous blue crystal. His right arm extends outward, summoning a spiral galaxy composed of blue arcane energy, star-shaped particles, and magical ribbons encircling his hand. The overall atmosphere is solemn, mysterious, and cinematic, boasting strong sapphire highlights, deep shadows, delicate painting details, and illustration quality reminiscent of high-end fantasy card games. A parchment-colored rule text box with ornate borders and two skills are added at the bottom, each preceded by a blue arcane symbol as a bullet point. The first skill's title is in bold serif: ARCANE BOLT, followed by the rule text: When Varian attacks, he deals 2 damage to any target. The second skill's title is in bold serif: MANA SURGE, followed by the rule text: Once per turn, you may pay 1 mana (with a blue water-drop mana icon) to draw a card. Below the skills, a line of blue-gray italic text describes: "Knowledge is the truest power. Master it, and the world is yours to shape." A large blue multifaceted gem badge is placed in the lower left corner, with the number {argument name="mana cost" default="3"} Place a circular, gold-framed, open book icon in the bottom right corner. Centered gold serif text along the bottom border on a blue strip:{argument name="type line" default="ALLY • HUMAN • WIZARD"} This makes the entire card look like a sophisticated professional TCG product prototype, with clear typography, a balanced layout, a gorgeous fantasy UI, and fully readable English text.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张垂直构图的奇幻集换式卡牌，采用华丽的古典奇幻风格，设计如同一张高级收藏级 TCG 卡牌，包含清晰可读的印刷文字和图标。卡牌拥有精致的深海军蓝与古金色边框，配有花丝边角、浮雕金属饰边，中心为写实风格的绘画插图。顶部中央为大型衬线标题文字，显示为 {argument name="character name" default="VARIAN THE AZUREMAGE"}，下方为较小的副标题 {argument name="class line" default="HUMAN WIZARD"}。左上角放置一个圆形的蓝色法力徽记，内含白色漩涡状奥术符号。右上角放置一个小型的纹章横幅面板，垂直排列 2 个金色图标：上方为奥术星芒，下方为一本打开的书。沿左侧边缘创建一个垂直属性栏，在深蓝色牌面上设有 4 行图标加数字：剑图标配数字 2，盾牌图标配数字 1，红色爱心图标配数字 3，靴子图标配数字 2。中央插图展示了一位男性人类法师，身处充满蓝色光芒和微弱烛光的教堂式魔法空间中，身穿层次分明的宝蓝色长袍和披风，饰有复杂的金色刺绣、镀金盔甲细节、皮带、小袋、卷轴盒和珠宝饰品。他留着深色中长波浪发，姿态英勇且富有戏剧性，左手紧握一根华丽的法杖；法杖为黑金配色，带有分叉的顶端，顶部附近镶嵌着一颗发光的蓝色水晶。他的右臂向外伸展，正在召唤一个由蓝色奥术能量、星状粒子和环绕手部的魔法丝带组成的螺旋星系。整体氛围庄严、神秘且具有电影质感，拥有强烈的蓝宝石色高光、深邃的阴影、细腻的绘画细节以及高级奇幻卡牌游戏的插画品质。底部添加一个羊皮纸色的规则文本框，带有华丽的边角和 2 个技能，每个技能前均有一个蓝色奥术符号作为项目符号。第一个技能标题为粗体衬线文字：ARCANE BOLT，后跟规则文本：When Varian attacks, he deals 2 damage to any target. 第二个技能标题为粗体衬线文字：MANA SURGE，后跟规则文本：Once per turn, you may pay 1 mana (with a blue water-drop mana icon) to draw a card. 在技能下方，添加一行蓝灰色斜体背景描述文字：“Knowledge is the truest power. Master it, and the world is yours to shape.” 左下角放置一个大型蓝色多面宝石徽章，数字为 {argument name="mana cost" default="3"}。右下角放置一个圆形金框打开的书本图标。沿底部边框，在蓝色条带上居中显示金色衬线文字：{argument name="type line" default="ALLY • HUMAN • WIZARD"}。使整张卡牌看起来像一张精致的专业 TCG 产品样机，具备清晰的排版、平衡的布局、华丽的奇幻 UI 以及完全可读的英文文本。

templates.title: Fantasy Paladin Trading Cards

titleLocalized.zh: 奇幻圣骑士集换式卡牌

templates.prompt: Create an incredibly detailed fantasy trading card, employing a sophisticated premium TCG style with a full vertical layout, a magnificent gold-plated border, engraved corners, and a color scheme of deep navy blue, black, ivory, and shimmering gold. The title at the top of the card is {argument name="character name" default="SIR ALARIC DAWNBLADE"} The text uses large serif font and capital letters, with a subtitle below.{argument name="class title" default="PALADIN OF THE LIGHT"} The main illustration depicts a valiant male paladin standing in a magnificent cathedral filled with towering, luminous stained-glass windows, floating golden sparks, and divine beams of light. He has long, flowing golden hair, wears exquisite steel plate armor, adorned with blue fabric trim and a flowing dark blue cloak, and holds a luminous longsword vertically in one hand and a large, ornate shield in the other, adorned with a radiant sun cross emblem. His posture is noble, strong, and defensive, serving as the visual center of the card. On the left are four circular, medallion-style attribute icons arranged vertically, labeled with numbers: crossed swords (3), shields (3), hearts (4), and boots (2). The upper left corner contains a sun emblem, and the upper right corner features a vertical banner emblem with a golden sword and cross symbol. The lower third contains a parchment-style rules text box listing three named skills, each accompanied by a small icon and a bold serif name, followed by the rules text:{argument name="ability one" default="DIVINE SMITE"} ,{argument name="ability two" default="AURA OF PROTECTION"} and{argument name="ability three" default="LAY ON HANDS"} Below the skill description, add a line of italicized text in the center of the parchment:{argument name="flavor quote" default="By the Light, I stand. By the Light, I strike. By the Light, I shall not fall."} At the very bottom, place a line of serif capital letters indicating the type:{argument name="creature line" default="ALLY ♦ HUMAN ♦ PALADIN"} Add a large sapphire-bordered mana or cost badge with the number 4 in the bottom left corner, and a circular faction badge with a white sword or holy symbol in the bottom right corner. The overall look should have the feel of an official premium fantasy card game, with a cinematic quality, high legibility, rich lighting effects, intricate textures, and collector's item quality.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张细节极其丰富的奇幻集换式卡牌，采用精致的高级 TCG 风格，全幅垂直布局，配有华丽的镀金边框、雕花边角，以及深海军蓝、黑色、象牙白和璀璨金的配色方案。卡牌顶部的标题为 {argument name="character name" default="SIR ALARIC DAWNBLADE"}，采用大号衬线体大写字母，下方副标题为 {argument name="class title" default="PALADIN OF THE LIGHT"}。主插画展示了一位英勇的男性圣骑士，站在充满高大发光彩色玻璃窗、漂浮金色火花和神圣光束的宏伟教堂中。他留着金色长卷发，身穿精致的钢金板甲，配有蓝色布料装饰和飘逸的深蓝色斗篷，一手垂直握着发光的长剑，另一手拿着巨大的华丽盾牌，盾牌上绘有光芒四射的太阳十字徽章。他的姿态高贵、强健且具有防御性，作为卡牌的视觉中心。在左侧垂直排列 4 个圆形勋章样式的属性图标，并标有数字：交叉剑（3）、盾牌（3）、爱心（4）和靴子（2）。左上角包含一个太阳徽章，右上角有一个垂直的旗帜纹章，带有金色剑与十字符号。下三分之一处包含一个羊皮纸风格的规则文本框，列出 3 个具名技能，每个技能配有一个小图标和加粗的衬线体名称，后跟规则文本：{argument name="ability one" default="DIVINE SMITE"}、{argument name="ability two" default="AURA OF PROTECTION"} 和 {argument name="ability three" default="LAY ON HANDS"}。在技能下方，羊皮纸中心添加一行斜体背景语：{argument name="flavor quote" default="By the Light, I stand. By the Light, I strike. By the Light, I shall not fall."}。在最底部，放置一行衬线体大写字母的类型说明：{argument name="creature line" default="ALLY ♦ HUMAN ♦ PALADIN"}。左下角添加一个带有数字 4 的大型蓝金宝石边框法力或费用徽章，右下角添加一个带有白色剑或圣徽的圆形阵营徽章。整体外观应呈现出官方高级奇幻卡牌游戏的质感，具有电影感、易读性、丰富的照明效果、复杂的纹理以及收藏级品质。

templates.title: Cute Gamelist app logo mockup

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱的 Gamelist 应用 Logo 样机

templates.prompt: Create a clean, flat vector app logo display against a dark UI background. Place a warm beige rounded rectangle preview card in the center. Inside the card is a cute, minimalist game logo: on the left is a stylized handheld device icon, drawn as a rounded rectangle, with two visible offset layers (similar to pages or cards) stacked below, and a small ribbon bookmark hanging from the bottom edge. The device is coral red with cream screen details, a dark brown fine outline, and a small dark brown controller symbol: a cross-shaped directional pad on the left, four small round buttons on the right, and four tiny decorative dots in the center, forming a playful smiley face impression. To the right of the icon is a lowercase brand name.{argument name="brand name" default="gamelist"} The logo uses a bold, rounded geometric sans-serif font, with the same coral red color as the icon. Balanced spacing is maintained, making the icon and text look like a cohesive, modern startup logo. It adopts a soft, friendly, pure vector aesthetic, without gradients, realism, or textures, exhibiting high SVG-friendly simplicity. The color palette is limited to four colors.{argument name="primary color" default="coral red"} Cream, dark brown, and warm beige are the color scheme. Four small vertical thumbnail variations are displayed aligned to the right of the dark interface, each showcasing the same logo on a slightly different light neutral background. Only subtle UI framing is added: a circular gray edit button in the lower left corner of the large preview card, a circular gray share/upload button in the lower right corner, and small monochrome action icons on a dark background below the card. The overall composition should resemble a screenshot of an AI-generated image showcasing the app's logo concept.

promptLocalized.zh: 在深色 UI 背景上创建一个简洁的扁平化矢量应用 Logo 展示。在中央放置一张暖米色的圆角矩形预览卡片。卡片内放置一个可爱的极简游戏 Logo：左侧是一个风格化的掌机图标，绘制为圆角矩形设备，下方叠放着 2 层可见的偏移层（类似页面或卡片），底部边缘垂下一条小丝带书签。机身呈珊瑚红色，配有奶油色屏幕细节、深棕色细轮廓，以及深棕色的小型控制器符号：左侧有一个十字形方向键，右侧有 4 个小圆按钮，中心有 4 个微小的装饰点，构成一个俏皮的笑脸印象。在图标右侧，放置小写品牌字标 {argument name="brand name" default="gamelist"}，使用粗圆几何无衬线字体，颜色与图标一致，均为珊瑚红。保持间距平衡，使图标和文字看起来像一个连贯的现代初创公司 Logo。采用柔和、友好、纯矢量的美学风格，无渐变、无写实感、无纹理，具有高度的 SVG 友好简洁性。调色板限制为 4 种颜色：{argument name="primary color" default="coral red"}、奶油色、深棕色和暖米色。在深色界面右侧对齐显示 4 个小型垂直缩略图变体，每个变体展示在略有不同的浅色中性背景上的相同 Logo。仅添加细微的 UI 框架：大预览卡片左下角有一个圆形灰色编辑按钮，卡片右下角有一个圆形灰色分享/上传按钮，卡片下方的深色背景上有小型单色操作图标。整体构图应看起来像是一张展示应用 Logo 概念的 AI 图像生成结果截图。

templates.title: NASA spacecraft orbiter hull

titleLocalized.zh: NASA 航天器轨道船体

templates.prompt: A cinematic, ultra-high-resolution close-up of a NASA spacecraft in low Earth orbit, taken from an extremely close distance at a dramatic diagonal angle, showing the curved metal fuselage extending from the left foreground to the right midground, dominating most of the frame. The spacecraft's exterior is a matte silver-grey metal, revealing visible seams, access panels, latches, rivets, minor scratches, and realistic weathering textures. The classic NASA "meatball" logo is prominently displayed in the upper left corner of the hull, while the mission text in bold black stencil font is printed on the side.{argument name="mission code" default="ASTRA-99"} The exhibit showcases the spacecraft's structure, which tapers towards the right-hand cylindrical engine or docking module. The background includes the blue edge of Earth, white cloud patterns, and the edge of a thin, luminous atmosphere in the depths of space. Strong sunlight from the upper right creates sharp highlights, soft reflections, and deep shadows along the hull. The realistic aerospace engineering texture, focused on the spacecraft's surface, boasts high contrast, epic realism, and a high-end science fiction documentary style.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影级超精细的 NASA 航天器低地球轨道特写，从靠近船体的极近距离以戏剧性的对角线角度拍摄，使弯曲的金属机身从左侧前景延伸至右侧中景，占据画面大部分空间。航天器外部为磨砂银灰色金属，可见明显的接缝、检修面板、锁扣、铆钉、轻微擦痕以及逼真的风化纹理。在船体左上方显著展示经典的 NASA “肉丸”标志，并在侧面印有醒目的黑色模板字体任务文本 {argument name="mission code" default="ASTRA-99"}。展示航天器向右侧圆柱形引擎或对接舱段逐渐收窄的结构。背景中，包含地球蓝色的边缘、白色的云层图案以及深邃太空中发光的薄薄大气层边缘。光线来自右上方强烈的阳光，在金属表面形成清晰的高光、柔和的反射以及沿船体下方的深邃阴影。逼真的航空航天工程质感，聚焦于航天器表面，高对比度，史诗级写实感，高端科幻纪录片风格。

templates.title: Samurai before the wildfire

titleLocalized.zh: 山火前的武士

templates.prompt: This is a cinematic night scene set on a steep, grassy slope, where a wildfire is spreading. A lone samurai stands in the center of the lower frame, his silhouette rendered in dark. The slope extends diagonally from the upper left to the lower right, a continuous, bright orange flame spreading across the slope behind the figure, creating a luminous boundary between the dark ground and the sky filled with black smoke. The samurai, clad in traditional armor and a horned kabuto, with two swords at his waist, gazes uphill at the flames. The figure's proportions are kept small relative to the landscape to emphasize the sense of scale and solitude. Extremely low-key lighting is employed, utilizing the strong backlighting from the flames to create deep black tones, thick smoke, drifting embers, and a rich, high-contrast palette of black, ember red, and fiery orange. The image should evoke the feel of an epic Japanese war film, employing wide-format composition, minimalist framing, dramatic negative space, realistic textures, and a dense atmosphere of smoke.

promptLocalized.zh: 这是一场电影般的夜景，场景设定在陡峭的草坡上，正值野火蔓延。画面中下方中心位置站着一名孤独的武士，呈现出深色剪影。山坡从左上角向右下角呈对角线延伸，一道连绵的明亮橙色火焰在人物身后的坡面上蔓延，在黑暗的地面与漆黑烟雾弥漫的天空之间形成了一道发光的边界。武士身着传统盔甲，头戴带角的兜鍪（kabuto），腰间佩戴双刀，面朝上坡方向凝视着火焰。人物比例需相对于景观保持较小，以强调规模感与孤独感。采用极低调的布光，利用火焰产生的强烈背光，营造深邃的黑色调、浓重的烟雾、飘散的余烬，以及由黑色、余烬红和火橙色组成的深沉高对比度色调。画面应呈现出史诗级日本战争电影的质感，采用宽画幅构图、极简主义取景、戏剧性的留白、写实的纹理以及浓郁的氛围烟雾。

templates.title: Portrait photography of fantasy nobles and politicians

titleLocalized.zh: 奇幻贵族与政客的肖像摄影

templates.prompt: A realistic medium close-up shows two men standing side-by-side in a formal White House-style interior. On the left is a fantastical aristocrat with flowing platinum-white hair, pale skin, and an elegant high-necked white leather jacket with delicate embroidery details and structured stitching, resembling a Targaryen prince or a member of a medieval fantasy royal family through a modern photographic lens. A few strands of hair drift to the side, as if blown by an indoor breeze. On the right is a middle-aged American politician in a dark navy blue suit, paired with a crisp white shirt, a dark tie, and a small American flag lapel pin. Both men face the camera, presenting an official photographic composition. The background is soft-focused, including a portrait on the left wall, two warm-toned lamps, an ornately decorated cream-colored wall, and an American flag on the far right. The cinematic natural indoor lighting, shallow depth of field, soft neutral tones, and highly realistic details in skin, fabric, and hair create a serious and formal atmosphere with the aesthetic appeal of documentary news photography.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实风格的中景特写，两名男子在白宫风格的正式室内并肩站立。左侧是一位奇幻贵族，留着飘逸的铂金白长发，皮肤苍白，身穿优雅的高领白色皮质外套，带有精致的刺绣细节和结构化缝线，宛如现代摄影视角下的坦格利安王子或中世纪奇幻皇室成员。几缕发丝向侧面飘动，仿佛被室内微风吹拂。右侧是一位中年美国政客，身穿深海军蓝西装，搭配挺括的白衬衫、深色领带，佩戴着一枚小型美国国旗翻领别针。两人面向镜头，呈现出官方照片的构图。背景经过柔焦处理，包括左侧墙上的一幅肖像画、两盏暖色台灯、装饰华丽的奶油色墙壁，以及最右侧的一面美国国旗。电影级自然室内光效，浅景深，柔和的中性色调，皮肤、织物和发丝细节高度逼真，氛围严肃正式，具有纪录片新闻摄影的美感。

templates.title: Awkward memes of tech company CEOs

titleLocalized.zh: 科技公司 CEO 尴尬梗图

templates.prompt: A humorous, realistic, meme-like outdoor snapshot shows three CEOs of well-known tech companies huddled together, creating an awkward and emotionally charged triangular relationship. In the foreground on the left {argument name="left person name" default="Sam Altman"} She appears in a three-quarter profile close-up, with dark curly hair, a light complexion, and wearing a dark crew-neck shirt. Her face displays an exaggerated, smug, and slightly teary smile as she looks at the man to her right. In the center of the background {argument name="center person name" default="Satya Nadella"} Standing between the two men, a bald man with glasses, medium brown skin, and a dark zip-up jacket, wore a calm, knowing, and slightly mocking smile as he looked at the man on his right. In the foreground on the right {argument name="right person name" default="Elon Musk"} Primarily shown from behind and in profile, the figures have short, dark hair, wear black leather jackets, and their faces are mostly turned away from the camera. The large hand of the man on the left is resting on the shoulder of the man on the right, creating a comedic tension. The photography employs shallow depth of field, natural overcast lighting, soft and realistic skin textures, and a documentary style. Three bold white meme tags with thick black outlines are added near each figure: the one in the lower left corner near the man on the left.{argument name="left label" default="Sam Altman"} Above the man's head in the center{argument name="center label" default="Satya Nadella"} And the bottom right corner near the man on the right.{argument name="right label" default="Elon Musk"} The horizontal composition, the compact cut of the face and shoulders, the realistic proportions, and the overall feel are reminiscent of internet memes.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张有趣的写实风格模因式户外抓拍照，三位知名科技公司 CEO 紧挨在一起，呈现出一种尴尬且充满情绪张力的三角关系。左侧前景中，{argument name="left person name" default="Sam Altman"} 以四分之三侧面特写出镜，留着深色卷发，肤色较浅，身穿深色圆领衫，脸上带着夸张、自鸣得意、略显泪眼婆娑的笑容，望向右侧的男子。背景中央，{argument name="center person name" default="Satya Nadella"} 站在两人之间，秃顶并戴着眼镜，中等棕色肤色，身穿深色拉链夹克，表情冷静、心知肚明且带着一丝戏谑的微笑，看向右侧的男子。右侧前景中，{argument name="right person name" default="Elon Musk"} 主要以背影和侧面示人，留着深色短发，身穿黑色皮夹克，脸部大部分背对镜头。左侧男子的一只大手搭在右侧男子的肩膀上，营造出喜剧性的张力。采用浅景深、自然阴天光线、柔和真实的皮肤纹理以及纪实摄影风格。在每个人物附近添加 3 个带有粗黑色轮廓的加粗白色模因标签：左下角靠近左侧男子的 {argument name="left label" default="Sam Altman"}，中心男子头顶上方的 {argument name="center label" default="Satya Nadella"}，以及右下角靠近右侧男子的 {argument name="right label" default="Elon Musk"}。横向构图，紧凑的面部和肩部剪裁，比例真实，充满互联网模因感。

templates.title: Devil AI Intern Office Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 恶魔 AI 实习生办公室海报

templates.prompt: Create a highly dramatic Chinese social media poster set in a warm amber-colored office environment. The main subject is a stylish, devilish female assistant seated at a desk. The composition is a single, vertical poster using dense graphic design, cinematic lighting, and a sophisticated, glossy illustration style that blends anime realism with commercial advertising quality. A large, bold red Chinese title is placed at the top.{argument name="headline text" default="Lobster Xiaxia"} And overlaid with an elegant handwritten signature{argument name="signature text" default="Xia Xia"} Add a powerful black Chinese slogan below:{argument name="subtitle text" default="He's a smart aleck, but he can deliver."} The character is positioned in the center of the image, revealing her upper body. She has a messy, bright red bun with flowing hair, a pair of deep red devil horns, fair skin, and wears layered black clothing, a name tag with a lanyard, and long red metal claw gloves, exuding a tired yet dangerous professional aura. Her face is obscured by a square mosaic in the center of the image. She rests her cheek on one hand with claw gloves, and holds a black takeaway coffee mug with the brand logo in the other. Subtle lobster elements are incorporated into the clothing and props, including segmented, glossy red shell-like shapes behind and around the chair. Seven items must be clearly visible on the desk: an open laptop with a red lobster logo and the words "XIA XIA," a closed dark book stacked under the laptop, an open notebook with hand-drawn sketches and Chinese notes, a black fountain pen, a rectangular black desk nameplate with Chinese characters, a takeaway coffee mug with the same lobster logo, and a hanging employee name tag. On the left background, display a computer or demo screen showing a Lark-like document interface titled "Content Creation Process" in Chinese, accompanied by a simple 3-step flowchart labeled "Scenario," "Process," and "Assets," along with the sentence "The Agent is an amplifier, not a steering wheel." A sticky note near the screen reads "Kou Ruiyu." In the upper left corner, add a yellow box containing the Chinese phrase "A sarcastic but capable AI intern hired by Uncle Huang," next to a playful doodle smiley face. On the right background, add three office sticky notes: one clipboard-style intern profile card titled "Intern File," including a multi-line Chinese personal introduction and handwritten signature; one list item titled "Today's To-Dos," containing 5 checkboxes with a red star at the end; and one yellow sticky note that reads "Boss, stop acting." All Chinese typography should be stylish, creating an atmosphere reminiscent of meme ads and character brand posters. At the bottom, add a centered, bold Chinese footer slogan.{argument name="footer slogan" default="I don't play the lobster, I am the lobster."} The use of orange sunset backlighting, warm shadows, glossy reflections on the claw glove, a cluttered yet stylish startup office atmosphere, and a color gradation of black and burnt orange creates a humorous yet sophisticated "sharp-tongued AI intern" vibe. Visible branding text "XIA XIA" on the coffee cup and laptop gives the image a high-end promotional poster feel, befitting an assistant role in workplace AI marketing.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张极具戏剧性的中文社交媒体海报，背景设在温暖的琥珀色办公室中，画面主体为一位坐在书桌前的时尚恶魔主题女性助手角色。构图为单张竖版海报，采用密集图形设计、电影级布光，以及融合了动漫写实风格与商业广告质感的高级光泽插画风格。在顶部放置一个巨大的粗体红色中文标题 {argument name="headline text" default="龙虾夏夏"}，并叠加优雅的手写体签名 {argument name="signature text" default="Xia Xia"}。下方添加一句强有力的黑色中文标语：{argument name="subtitle text" default="嘴欠，但能交付"}。角色位于画面中心，露出上半身，留着凌乱的亮红色丸子头，发丝飞扬，长着一对深红色小恶魔角，皮肤白皙，身穿黑色叠穿服饰，佩戴挂绳工牌，戴着长款红色金属爪手套，散发出一种疲惫但危险的职场人气质。她的脸部被画面中心的一个方形马赛克遮挡。她用一只戴着爪套的手托着脸颊，另一只手拿着一个印有品牌标志的黑色外卖咖啡杯。在服装和道具中加入微妙的龙虾元素，包括椅子后方和周围分节的光泽红色甲壳状造型。书桌上必须清晰可见 7 件物品：1 台带有红色龙虾标志及“XIA XIA”字样的打开的笔记本电脑，1 叠放在电脑下方的闭合深色书籍，1 本写有手绘草图和中文笔记的打开的笔记本，1 支黑色钢笔，1 个印有中文的矩形黑色办公桌名牌，1 个带有同款龙虾标志的外卖咖啡杯，以及 1 张悬挂的员工工牌。在左侧背景中，展示一台电脑或演示屏幕，显示类似飞书的文档界面，标题为中文“内容创作流程”，并配有一个简单的 3 步流程图，分别标注为“场景”、“流程”、“资产”，以及句子“Agent 是放大器，不是方向盘。”在屏幕附近贴一张便签，写着“扣瑞芋”。在左上角，加入一个黄色标注框，内含中文“黄叔雇来的毒舌但能干的AI实习生”，旁边配有一个俏皮的涂鸦笑脸。在右侧背景中，贴上 3 张办公便签：1 张标题为“实习生档案”的剪贴板风格实习生资料卡，包含多行中文个人简介和手写签名；1 张标题为“今日待办”的清单项目，包含 5 个复选框，最后一行标有红星；以及 1 张写着“老板别演”的黄色便签。所有中文排版应具有设计感，营造出梗图广告和角色品牌海报的氛围。在底部，添加一句居中的粗体中文页脚标语 {argument name="footer slogan" default="不演龙虾，我就是龙虾。"}。使用橙色落日背光、温暖的阴影、爪套上的光泽反射、杂乱但时尚的创业办公室氛围，以及黑色与焦橙色的色彩分级，营造出一种幽默且干练的“毒舌 AI 实习生”氛围。在咖啡杯和笔记本电脑上包含可见的品牌文字“XIA XIA”，使整张图片呈现出一种用于职场 AI 营销的助理角色高端宣传海报质感。

templates.prompt: A luxurious high-end beauty advertisement is set in a sun-drenched Parisian marble bathroom. An elegant woman, dressed in an ivory silk robe, leans against a polished marble countertop with her arms crossed. Her long, dark brown hair is styled in a casual, romantic updo, with a few strands cascading around her neck. The overall atmosphere is serene, refined, and exudes sophistication. To the left is a large window, through which the Eiffel Tower and Parisian rooftops are faintly visible in the soft, hazy morning light. To the right of the countertop sits a glass vase filled with white roses and a bottle of luxurious skincare serum with a gold dropper cap, strikingly prominent like a high-end product advertisement. The interior décor includes cream and gray textured marble walls, gold fixtures, mirrors, and illuminated wall lamps. The use of soft, natural gold light, clear highlights, delicate reflections, shallow depth of field, and cinematic editing creates realistic skin and fabric textures, showcasing understated French elegance—a perfect fit for beauty advertising aesthetics—and crafting a hyper-realistic image of a luxurious lifestyle.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张奢华的高端时尚美妆广告照片，场景设定在阳光明媚的巴黎大理石浴室中。一位优雅的女性身着象牙白丝绸睡袍，双臂交叉倚靠在抛光大理石台面上。她留着深棕色长发，梳成随性浪漫的盘发，颈部周围散落着几缕发丝。整体氛围宁静、精致且极具高级感。左侧是一扇高大的窗户，窗外隐约可见晨光中柔和模糊的埃菲尔铁塔与巴黎屋顶。台面右侧摆放着 1 个装满白玫瑰的玻璃花瓶，以及 1 瓶带有金色滴管盖的奢华护肤精华液，如同高端产品广告般醒目。室内装饰包括奶油色与灰色纹理的大理石墙面、金色固定装置、镜子及发光的壁灯。采用柔和的金色自然光、通透的高光、细腻的倒影、浅景深效果、电影级编辑构图，呈现逼真的皮肤与织物纹理，展现低调的法式优雅，符合美妆广告审美，打造超写实的奢华生活方式影像。

templates.prompt: A simple, anime-style half-body portrait against a pure gray-white background. The image depicts a young female fantasy archer, shot from the chest up, her body slightly turned away from the camera, highlighting her back and left shoulder, with her head slightly turned to the side. She has {argument name="hair color" default="gold"} Shoulder-length wavy short hair with soft layers at the ends, paired with a wide {argument name="headband color" default="Dark red"} Her headband and face are completely obscured by a large, rectangular block of skin-colored fabric, making any facial features impossible to discern. She wears a white, high-necked, ruffled blouse, over which is a dark cyan-blue coat adorned with fan-shaped lace. A long, mustard-gold scarf is casually draped around her neck and one shoulder. A brown leather quiver containing five arrows with white fletchings and dark shafts is visible on her right shoulder. The illustration should feature clean lines, flat cel shading, soft, low-saturation colors, and present a refined fantasy anime character design aesthetic reminiscent of classic RPG portraits. The composition should be centered, portrait-oriented, with the upper body cropped, a minimalist background, no extraneous objects, and no text.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张简洁的动漫风格半身角色肖像，背景为纯净的灰白色。画面展示了一位年轻的女性幻想弓箭手，从胸部以上取景，身体略微背对镜头，背部和左肩更为明显，头部轻微转向侧面。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="金色"} 的齐肩波浪短发，发梢层次柔和，佩戴着宽大的 {argument name="headband color" default="深红色"} 发带，面部区域被一个巨大的肤色长方形色块完全遮挡，因此无法看到任何面部特征。她身穿白色高领荷叶边衬衫，外搭深青蓝色饰有扇形花边的外衣，脖颈和一侧肩膀上随意披着一条芥末金色的长围巾。右肩可见一个棕色皮革箭袋，里面装着 5 支箭，箭羽为白色，箭杆为深色。插画应具备清晰的线条、平涂赛璐珞阴影、柔和的低饱和度色彩，并呈现出类似经典 RPG 肖像的精致幻想动漫角色设计美学。构图居中，肖像方向，上半身裁剪，极简背景，无额外物体，无文字。

templates.title: Pixelated Jungle Parrot

titleLocalized.zh: 像素马赛克丛林鹦鹉

templates.prompt: A pixel art-style mosaic illustration depicts a tropical parrot perched on a short brown branch amidst dense jungle foliage. The image appears to be composed of closely spaced, evenly spaced tiny colored square tiles, each surrounded by a fine, dark outline. The parrot is positioned to the right in profile, featuring a large, curved black beak, a light cream-colored face, a vibrant red-orange forehead and throat, a bright yellow neck, and long wings and tail feathers in saturated blue and cyan. The parrot is vertically centered and slightly to the left, perched on the branch with its tail feathers extending downwards. The parrot is surrounded by richly layered, dense foliage, ranging in shades from deep forest green to bright green, filling the entire image without any sky. Strong contrast, sharp black outlines, and a luminous light green area behind the parrot distinguish it from the darker foliage are used. The overall image should have a vintage pixel art or stained glass mosaic feel, rich in detail, vibrant colors, a square composition, and a full-page tiled texture.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅像素艺术风格的马赛克插画，描绘了一只栖息在茂密丛林叶丛中短棕色树枝上的热带鹦鹉。画面仿佛由紧密均匀的微小彩色方形瓷砖拼合而成，每个方块周围都有细细的深色轮廓线。鹦鹉呈侧面朝右，有着巨大的黑色弯曲鸟喙、浅奶油色的面部、鲜艳的红橙色前额和喉部、亮黄色的颈部，以及呈现饱和蓝色和青色的长翅膀和尾羽。鹦鹉垂直居中且略偏左，直立在树枝上，尾羽向下延伸。鹦鹉周围环绕着层次丰富的茂密叶片，色调涵盖从深森林绿到亮绿的多种绿色，填满整个画面，不留天空。运用强烈的对比度、清晰的黑色轮廓，并在鹦鹉后方设置一个发光的浅绿色区域，将其与较暗的叶丛区分开来。整体图像应呈现出复古像素艺术或彩色玻璃马赛克的质感，细节丰富、色彩鲜艳、方形构图，并具有满版平铺的纹理。

templates.title: Fictional Design Magazine Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 虚构设计杂志封面

templates.prompt: A hyper-realistic modern magazine cover, used for a magazine called{argument name="magazine title" default="FORM"} This fictional design magazine features a style reminiscent of high-end editorial portraits taken in a minimalist architect's studio. The cover employs a clean, restrained European design aesthetic, with ample white space, sharp typography, and warm indoor natural lighting. At the top, a large, bold black sans-serif masthead spans almost the entire width. To the lower left of the masthead, a line of small-capitalized text reads "THE MAGAZINE OF DESIGN" and "APRIL 2026." The main cover title on the left is {argument name="cover headline" default="The Last Analog Designer"} The text uses a large, multi-line, stacked black sans-serif font. Below, a smaller teaser text is added: "In a world of algorithms and automation tools, there is still a designer who believes in the power of pencil, paper, and thought." In the lower left corner, above a darker desktop area, three lines of small white sans-serif secondary cover titles are added: "MILAN PREVIEW" with "What to See in 2026," "MATERIAL INTELLIGENCE" with "The Next Surface Revolution," and "STUDIO VISIT" with "Inside the Practice of Space Popular." In the lower right corner, a realistic white barcode frame is added, with small price text "$8.99 US $10.99 CAN" and issue number "04" above it. The image shows a middle-aged male designer sitting at a workbench, wearing a dark blue or black knit sweater, with graying curly hair, sketching on white paper with a pencil. His face is obscured by a square blur, creating a sense of anonymous portraiture. There are eight clearly visible items on the table: scattered sketches of geometric chairs, a pen holder containing several pencils, a rolled-up white blueprint on the right, a closed dark notebook on the left, a small brown eraser near the center, a blurry black object to the left front, a large flat book or material sample to the right front, and the drawings he is currently working on. Behind him is a warm wooden sideboard neatly stacked with books, a white domed lamp on the far left, and four design references pinned to the white wall: a small photograph of a dark chair, a light-colored sketch below, and two larger minimalist line drawings to the right. The use of soft neutral tones, off-white walls, walnut wood, and black clothing creates an atmosphere of calm contemplation. The composition should convey the quality of a believable high-end magazine cover, employing a direct view and careful art direction, possessing the realism of editorial photography, and containing no visible publisher logos except for a fictional masthead.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超写实的现代杂志封面，用于名为 {argument name="magazine title" default="FORM"} 的虚构设计杂志，拍摄风格如同极简主义建筑师工作室中的高端编辑肖像。封面采用简洁、克制的欧洲设计美学，留白充裕，排版锐利，并配以温暖的室内自然光。在顶部，放置一个横跨几乎整个宽度的巨大粗体黑色无衬线刊头。在刊头左下方，添加一行小号大写文字，内容为“THE MAGAZINE OF DESIGN”和“APRIL 2026”。左侧的主封面标题为 {argument name="cover headline" default="The Last Analog Designer"}，采用多行堆叠的大号黑色无衬线字体。下方添加一段较小的预告文字：“在算法与自动化工具的世界里，仍有一位设计师坚信铅笔、纸张与思想的力量。”在左下角，于较暗的桌面区域上方添加 3 行白色小号无衬线字体的次要封面标题：“MILAN PREVIEW”配“What to See in 2026”、“MATERIAL INTELLIGENCE”配“The Next Surface Revolution”，以及“STUDIO VISIT”配“Inside the Practice of Space Popular”。在右下角，添加一个逼真的白色条形码框，上方配有小号价格文字“$8.99 US   $10.99 CAN”以及期号“04”。画面展示了一位坐在工作台前的中年男性设计师，身穿深蓝色或黑色针织毛衣，留着花白的卷发，正俯身用铅笔在白纸上素描。他的脸部被一个方形模糊块遮挡，营造出一种匿名肖像感。桌面上共有 8 组清晰可见的物品：散落的绘有几何椅子的草图纸、1 个装有几支铅笔的笔筒、右侧 1 份卷起的白色蓝图、左侧 1 本合上的深色笔记本、中心附近 1 块棕色小橡皮、左前侧 1 个模糊的黑色物体、右前侧 1 本大型扁平书籍或材料样本，以及他手下正在绘制的图纸。他身后是一个温暖的木质餐具柜，上面整齐地堆放着书籍，最左侧有 1 盏白色圆顶台灯，白墙上钉着 4 个设计参考资料：1 张小型的深色椅子照片、下方 1 张浅色草图，以及右侧 2 张较大的极简线条画。使用柔和的中性色调、灰白色墙壁、胡桃木、黑色服装，营造出冷静沉思的氛围。构图应呈现出可信的高端杂志封面质感，采用正视角度并经过精心艺术指导，具备编辑摄影的真实感，除虚构刊头外不包含任何可见的出版商标志。

templates.title: Retro Little Prince Space Postcard

titleLocalized.zh: 复古小王子太空明信片

templates.prompt: Create a retro-style illustrated postcard, designed as{argument name="franchise name" default="The Little Prince"} and{argument name="space company name" default="SPACEX"} This fantastical collaboration features postcards side-by-side on the same canvas, showcasing both the front and back. Warm-toned old paper with slightly worn edges, a delicate grain, and subtle stains evokes a nostalgic, medieval printing feel. The left half of the postcard depicts the front: a deep midnight blue sky dotted with small golden stars and a ringed asteroid, while a massive white rocket stands on a launch pad, its bright plume shooting into the air. In the image, a blond boy in green clothing and a long golden scarf sits on a rocky hill with an orange fox, their backs to the viewer, gazing at the rocket. An elegant handwritten inscription is added to the sky.{argument name="quote" default="For stars, what matters is what cannot be seen."} Below are the smaller serif and handwritten signatures: "ANTOINE DE SAINT-EXUPÉRY" and "The Little Prince". At the bottom of the left panel, two brand names are added: "The Little Prince" in blue handwritten font on the left, and "SPACEX" in bold, futuristic blue capital letters on the right, separated by a small gold star and a thin dividing line. Below this is a spaced-out lowercase letter tagline:{argument name="tagline" default="Explore the world, stay true to your original aspirations."} The right half is the back of a postcard from the same old paper, with the title "POST CARD" printed at the top center and decorated with a small gold star below. A circular postmark is added near the center of the upper right, containing four parts of text: "PLANET EARTH," "MAY 23," "2024," and "BEYOND." A blue stamp with perforated edges is affixed to the upper right corner, depicting the Little Prince standing on a miniature planet under a starry sky. The stamp has four clearly visible text elements: "1943," "Le Petit Prince," "SPACE," and a small star symbol. There should be two writing areas separated by vertical lines on the right. In the left writing area, a handwritten message should be placed, beginning with "Dear friend," followed by neat cursive text: "One day, we will leave Earth not to escape, but to better understand it. The universe is vast, but kindness is our compass. Let us protect our home as we journey towards the stars." Then, sign in three lines: "The Little Prince," "and," and "SPACEX." In the address bar on the right, the first line reads "To you," followed by "Somewhere wonderful" and "In the Universe," accompanied by horizontal guide lines. Add some small gold star doodles and a simple line drawing in the lower right corner depicting a small, round planet with flowers growing on it. The color palette is limited to cream, navy, soft gold, soft green, warm orange, and blue-gray, presenting a clear and painterly illustration style. Combined with precise decorative typography, this creates a magical, hopeful atmosphere that blends literary flair with space exploration.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张复古插画明信片，设计为 {argument name="franchise name" default="小王子"} 与 {argument name="space company name" default="SPACEX"} 的奇幻联名作品，在同一画布上并排展示明信片的正面和背面。使用带有轻微磨损边缘、细腻颗粒感、淡淡污渍的暖色调旧纸张，营造出怀旧的中世纪印刷质感。左半部分为明信片正面：深邃的午夜蓝星空点缀着金色小星星和一颗带有光环的小行星，一座巨大的白色火箭矗立在发射台上，升空时喷射出明亮的尾焰；画面中，一个身穿绿色服装、围着长长金色围巾的金发小男孩与一只橙色狐狸坐在岩石山上，两人背对着观众，望向火箭。在天空中加入优雅的手写体引言：{argument name="quote" default="对于星星而言，重要的是看不见的东西。"}，下方配以较小的衬线体和手写体署名：“ANTOINE DE SAINT-EXUPÉRY” 和 “The Little Prince”。在左侧面板底部，加入 2 个品牌名称：左侧为蓝色手写体的 “The Little Prince”，右侧为粗体蓝色未来感大写的 “SPACEX”，中间由一颗金色小星星和一条细分割线隔开。下方添加间距拉开的小写字母标语：{argument name="tagline" default="探索世界，守护初心。"}。右半部分为同一张旧纸张上的明信片背面，顶部中央印有 “POST CARD” 标题，下方饰有一颗金色小星星。在右上部中央附近添加一个圆形邮戳，邮戳内包含 4 部分文字：“PLANET EARTH”、“MAY 23”、“2024” 和 “BEYOND”。右上角贴有一枚带有齿孔边缘的蓝色邮票，图案为小王子站在星空下的微型行星上，邮票上有 4 个清晰的文字元素：“1943”、“Le Petit Prince”、“SPACE” 以及一个小星星符号。右侧应有两条由垂直线分隔的书写栏。在左侧书写区，放入一段手写风格的留言，以 “Dear friend,” 开头，随后是整齐的草书换行文本：“终有一天，我们离开地球并非为了逃离，而是为了更好地理解它。宇宙浩瀚，但善良是我们的指南针。让我们在奔向星辰的同时，守护好我们的家园。” 然后分 3 行签名：“The Little Prince”、“and”、“SPACEX”。在右侧地址栏，第一行写 “To you,”，接下来的几行写 “Somewhere wonderful” 和 “In the Universe”，并配有横向引导线。添加一些金色小星星涂鸦，并在右下角画一个简单的线条画，描绘一颗长出小花的小圆行星。色调仅限于奶油色、海军蓝、柔金色、柔和的绿色、暖橙色和蓝灰色，呈现出清晰而富有绘画感的插画风格，搭配精准的装饰性排版，营造出一种魔幻、充满希望且文学气息与太空探索交织的氛围。

templates.title: Anime Shrine Maiden Dual Sword Style

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫巫女双刀流

templates.prompt: A highly detailed anime/fantasy illustration, the main character is {argument name="character name" default="A witch swordsman"} The scene is set at a Japanese shrine in spring, employing dynamic, low-angle poses. She is a beautiful young woman with {argument name="hair color" default="Light brown"} She possesses incredibly long, flowing hair, blue eyes, a confident yet gentle smile, and a magnificent red floral hair ornament. She holds a katana in each hand: her right hand holds one sword behind her head, while her left hand extends the other forward towards the viewer; the blades gleam with steel, and the hilts are adorned with delicate black and gold patterns. Her attire is a stylized and slightly sexy red and white shrine maiden battle outfit, consisting of a short pleated skirt, a cropped top decorated with floral knots, two oversized split sleeves, two knee-high socks with red flower emblems, and numerous red bows, white ribbons, and intricate decorative piping. The scene is dynamic: her hair and ribbons flutter wildly in the air, cherry blossom petals dance in the air, and glowing purple and pink magical trails swirl around her body and the blades. The background showcases a massive red torii gate, a stone-paved shrine path, a lush green forest, and blooming flowers.{argument name="tree type" default="Cherry blossoms"} A tree, and a warm lantern on the right. Utilizing stunning cinematic lighting effects, sunlight filters through the trees, casting beams of light accompanied by shimmering particle effects, glossy highlights, saturated colors, a sense of depth, and exquisite high-end gacha game-style visual aesthetics. The design emphasizes vibrant composition, a fantastical atmosphere, sharp lines, ultra-detailed costume design, and a vivid portrayal of a heroic shrine guardian.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度精细的动漫奇幻插图，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="一位巫女剑士"}，场景设定在春季的日本神社，采用动态的低角度动作姿势。她是一位美丽的年轻女性，拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="浅棕色"} 的超长飘逸秀发、蓝色双眸、自信而温柔的微笑，以及华丽的红色花朵发饰。她双手各持一把武士刀：右手将一把刀举在脑后，左手将另一把刀向前伸向观众，刀身钢材光亮，刀柄饰有精致的黑金纹路。她的装束是风格化且略显性感的红白配色巫女战斗服，包含 1 条短百褶裙、1 件带有花朵结装饰的露脐上衣、2 只超大号分离式袖子、2 只带有红花徽章的过膝袜，以及多处红色蝴蝶结、白色丝带和复杂的装饰性滚边。画面充满动感：她的头发和丝带在空中剧烈飘动，樱花花瓣四处飞舞，发光的紫色与粉色魔法光轨环绕在她的身体和刀刃周围。背景展示了 1 座巨大的红色鸟居、1 条石板神社小径、茂密的绿色森林、盛开的 {argument name="tree type" default="樱花"} 树，以及右侧 1 盏温暖的灯笼。采用绚丽的电影级光效，阳光穿过树木洒下光束，伴有闪烁的粒子效果、光泽高光、饱和的色彩、深度感以及精致的高级抽卡游戏主视觉美学。强调充满活力的构图、奇幻氛围、锐利的线条、超精细的服装设计以及生动的英雄神社守护者气质。
