templates.title: Anime Music Training Camp Promotional Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫音乐训练营宣传海报

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic, Japanese anime-style event promotional thumbnail poster. Use a 4:5 vertical composition, ultra-detailed, cinematic quality, neon lighting, and high contrast, with a design style reminiscent of social media announcements. The main subject is a beautifully crafted anime girl on the right side of the image, in a half-body portrait, with flowing hair.{argument name="hair color" default="Dark blue"} She has long hair adorned with tiny star hair clips, wears a dark hoodie, and large studio headphones around her neck. The background is a twilight-to-night city skyline shimmering with lights, musical energy particles, lens flares, and glowing petals. Her face is partially obscured by a soft, rectangular blur. The design utilizes vibrant colors of electric blue, purple, magenta, gold, and sunset orange. Layered Japanese typography is incorporated into the design, ensuring clear and legible text that blends seamlessly into the artistic visuals like a sophisticated promotional advertisement. Contains 8 The main text of the group: the copywriting in the upper left corner is "The story of the beginning and the sound of the music.", with a smaller subtitle below "The story of the beginning and the sound of the sound."; on the right In the upper corner is a glowing light box sign that reads "GW consecutive holidays!", and below it is a smaller neon light frame that reads "みんなで高の音楽をつくろう!"; above the main title in the center is the small English word "AI MUSIC BOOTCAMP 2", below it is a huge Japanese title "AI 音楽ブートキャンプ2"; across the middle is a huge golden metallic announcement that says "Opening decision!"; the date column reads "Opening period", followed by "5.2 SAT soil" and "5.4 MON month"; near the bottom is a label appeal that reads "Participate in はカンタン!! #AI音楽ブートキャンプ2 をつけて contributes するだけ!"; below is a line of encouragement "Welcome to those who are new to the world! みんなで高の音楽体験を!"; and there are 3 at the bottom. The icons represent the functions: "Learn with fellow students on the same path," "Create new music experiences with AI," and "Create your own song based on your thoughts." On the left edge, add a vertical film strip containing four embedded thumbnails showcasing the same girl in music-related scenes: 1) performing on stage for an audience, 2) working at a music production station with a screen and equipment, 3) singing into a microphone, and 4) playing an acoustic guitar. At the bottom, add two neon music-themed icon illustrations: a tilted smartphone with musical notes in the lower left corner and a glowing microphone with musical notes in the lower right corner. The text effect should be glossy and luminous with gold and white embossed highlights, and the title should be surrounded by vibrant beams of light and exploding sparks. The overall atmosphere should be inspiring, celebratory, futuristic, and emotionally resonant, as if targeting {argument name="event name" default="AI Music Bootcamp 2"} A high-impact advertisement for a music training camp during Japan's Golden Week.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张戏剧性的日系动漫风格活动宣传缩略图海报，采用 4:5 竖构图，超精细、电影质感、霓虹灯光、高对比度，设计风格如同社交媒体公告图。主体是一位位于画面中右侧的精美动漫少女，半身像，留着一头随风飘动的 {argument name="hair color" default="深蓝色"} 长发，发间装饰着小星星发夹，身穿深色连帽衫，脖子上挂着大号录音室耳机。背景是闪烁着灯光、音乐能量粒子、镜头光晕和发光花瓣的黄昏至夜晚城市天际线。她的面部区域被一个柔和的矩形模糊块遮挡。使用电光蓝、紫、洋红、金和落日橙的鲜艳配色。设计中填充层次分明的日文排版，文字清晰易读，并像精美的活动广告一样融入艺术画面中。包含 8 组主要文字：左上角文案为「始まるのは、キミと創る 音楽の物語。」，下方附带较小的副标题「AIを使って、みんなで音楽をつくる特別な3日間。」；右上角是一个发光的灯箱招牌，写着「GW連休!」，下方是一个较小的霓虹灯框，写着「みんなで最高の音楽をつくろう!」；中心主标题上方有小字英文「AI MUSIC BOOTCAMP 2」，下方是巨大的日文标题「AI音楽 ブートキャンプ 2」；中间横跨着巨大的金色金属质感公告，写着「開催決定!」；日期栏写着「開催期間」，随后是「5.2 SAT 土」和「5.4 MON 月」；底部附近是标签呼吁，写着「参加はカンタン!! #AI音楽ブートキャンプ2 をつけて投稿するだけ!」；下方是一行鼓励语「初心者も大歓迎! みんなで最高の音楽体験を!」；底部还有 3 个带有图标的功能说明，分别是「一緒に学ぶ 仲間とつながる」、「AIで創る 新しい音楽体験」和「想いをカタチに 自分だけの1曲を」。在左侧边缘，添加一个垂直的电影胶片条，包含 4 个嵌入式小图，展示同一位少女在音乐相关场景中的画面：1) 在舞台上对着人群表演，2) 在音乐制作台前工作，屏幕和设备齐全，3) 对着麦克风唱歌，4) 弹奏原声吉他。在底部区域添加 2 个霓虹音乐主题图标插画：左下角是一个带有音符的倾斜智能手机，右下角是一个带有音符的发光麦克风。文字效果应呈现光泽、发光感，并带有金色和白色的浮雕高光，标题周围环绕着充满活力的光束和火花爆炸。整体氛围应充满灵感、庆典感、未来感和情感共鸣，如同针对 {argument name="event name" default="AI音乐ブートキャンプ 2"} 的高影响力日本黄金周音乐训练营广告。

templates.title: Dreamy 16-shot continuous shooting couple stroll collage

titleLocalized.zh: 梦幻 16 连拍情侣漫步拼贴画

templates.prompt: A 4x4 collage, comprising 16 snapshots taken with a smartphone, arranged in a tight square grid with thin white dividing lines, presents the style of casual couple selfies taken during an evening stroll in a lush residential area. The images possess a soft, dreamlike quality, with slight motion blur, shallow depth of field, subtle fisheye or wide-angle lens distortion, and a nostalgic green-toned film aesthetic. The recurring protagonists are a lovely young woman and a tall young man, but in each image, their faces are deliberately obscured by a large, softly-edged rectangular blur at the center. The woman has long, wavy blonde hair tied in pigtails with oversized mint green ribbon bows; she has fair skin and wears a light sage-green sundress with pleats at the chest. The man has short, dark hair and wears a loose, dark charcoal gray T-shirt. The entire collage should evoke a playful, intimate, and casual feeling, as if captured in a moment of joking and laughter while walking outdoors. Showcasing 16 different photos: 1) A close-up selfie of two people side-by-side; 2) A slightly elevated selfie with greenery in the background; 3) A very close-up, blurred selfie of a man peering in from the left; 4) A high-angle solo photo of a woman beside a flowerbed and hedge; 5) A side profile selfie of a woman making a peace sign; 6) A woman standing on a narrow garden path, extending one hand towards the camera; 7) A selfie of two people making a peace sign together; 8) A tilted close-up with strong motion blur; 9) A solo portrait of a woman making a peace sign; 10) A selfie of a couple walking along the roadside; 11) A woman's back view, showing the back of her skirt and pigtails; 12) A selfie of a woman making a peace sign next to a man; 13) A very close-up cropped shot highlighting a woman's hair and bow; 14) A full-body back view of a couple walking away on a quiet street; 15) A close-up, blurred selfie with faces obscured by blurry blocks; 16) Another close-up selfie of the two side-by-side. Background details for the collage should include lush green hedges, garden flowers, narrow alleyways, roadside meadows, telephone poles, and quiet suburban streets. Use natural outdoor ambient light, soft highlights, and gentle contrast to create a casual, social media photo dump vibe.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个 4x4 的拼贴画，包含 16 张抓拍的智能手机快照，排列在紧凑的正方形网格中，带有细白色分隔线，呈现出在葱郁住宅区傍晚散步时随性拍摄的情侣自拍风格。图像具有柔和的梦幻感，带有轻微的运动模糊、浅景深、轻微的鱼眼或广角手机镜头畸变，以及怀旧的绿色调胶片美学。反复出现的主角是一位可爱的年轻女性和一位高个子年轻男性，但每张画面中他们的面部都被中心位置的大型柔边矩形模糊块刻意遮挡。女性留着长长的金色波浪卷发，扎着双马尾，系着超大的薄荷绿丝带蝴蝶结，皮肤白皙，身穿浅鼠尾草绿色的吊带连衣裙，胸前有褶皱设计。男性留着短黑发，穿着宽松的深炭灰色 T 恤。整个拼贴画应给人一种俏皮、亲密且随意的感觉，仿佛是在户外边走边开玩笑时捕捉到的瞬间。展示 16 张不同的照片：1) 两人肩并肩的近距离自拍，2) 带有背景绿植的略高角度自拍，3) 男性从左侧探入的极近距离模糊自拍，4) 女性在花坛和树篱旁的高角度单人照，5) 女性比出剪刀手的侧面自拍，6) 女性站在狭窄花园小径上向镜头伸出一只手，7) 两人一起比出剪刀手的自拍，8) 带有强烈运动模糊的倾斜特写，9) 女性比出剪刀手的单人特写肖像，10) 情侣在路边行走时的自拍，11) 女性的背影，展示裙子背面和双马尾，12) 女性在男性身旁比出剪刀手的双人自拍，13) 突出女性头发和蝴蝶结的极近距离裁剪，14) 情侣在安静街道上远去的全身背影，15) 以遮脸模糊块为主的近距离模糊自拍，16) 另一张两人并肩的近距离自拍。拼贴画的背景细节应包括茂密的绿色树篱、花园花卉、狭窄小巷、路边草地、电线杆和安静的郊区街道。使用自然的户外环境光、柔和的高光、柔和的对比度，营造出社交媒体照片墙（photo dump）的随性氛围。

templates.title: Texas-style pork poster

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the main photo and REFERENCE_1 to enhance the texture of the shredded pork, the homemade roast pork is transformed into a visually striking Texas BBQ poster. The original cuts of pork in the foil are preserved, but redesigned to look more appetizing and like a professional photograph: a deeper mahogany skin, more prominent black peppercorns, a richer glaze, visible juices, darker shadows, warm orange highlights, and a smoky atmosphere rising from above. It's placed against a dark, rustic background with cinematic food advertising lighting. A striking retro-Western-style headline is added to the upper left, in two lines: “TEXAS STYLE” and “PORK”. Below it, add three lines of Japanese text: “100℃で8時間、じっくり火入れ”, “Low & Slowで引き出す、”, and “やわらかさと旨み.” In the lower left corner, add two lines of handwritten-style Japanese slogans: “しっとり、” and “ほろり.” Using a sophisticated barbecue advertisement layout, emphasizing high contrast and a slight grainy texture, the final image achieves an effect reminiscent of a Texas-style shredded pork poster inspired by barbecue.

templates.title: Hot Burger King poster

titleLocalized.zh: 火辣 Burger King 皇堡海报

templates.prompt: A dramatic Burger King fast food advertisement poster, using a vertical composition, combines realistic food photography with bold Korean-style promotional graphic design. The official Burger King logo is placed at the top center. Below, a large, distressed Korean-style stacked headline reads "신제품와퍼출시!", with "와퍼" in a vibrant deep red and the rest in textured gray-white, against a smoky dark black background. The image centers on a massive burger, perfectly centered and dominating most of the frame from a slightly upward-looking frontal perspective. The burger contains eight clearly visible layers: a glossy sesame top bun, curly lettuce, thick slices of red tomato, thick white onion rings, pickle slices, ketchup strips, melted American cheese, a brightly charred grilled beef patty, and a soft bottom bun. A small gold crown icon floats above the top bun. The burger rests on a dark, rustic wooden peg base. Dramatic orange flames, glowing embers, hot sparks, and smoky atmosphere are added to the lower half and around the side edges to emphasize the grilling feature. Near the bottom, a second line of bold Korean text, “불맛의정점을경험하라”, is placed in the center, with “불맛” in red and the rest of the text in warm beige, separated above by a small flame icon. At the very bottom, a red badge label with a dark border is added, containing the bold black Korean text “한정판매”. The high-contrast black, red, orange, and burnt brown tones, strong cinematic lighting, glossy food highlights, and clear textures create a sophisticated, commercial advertising feel, resulting in a fiery and enticing atmosphere.

templates.prompt: A cinematic, high-end lifestyle visual depicts a young woman walking along a sun-drenched road on a hot summer day. She is drinking an ice-cold beverage.{argument name="beverage" default="Pepsi"} As the can moved, the clearly visible condensation droplets on its surface highlighted the contrast between the high temperature and the coolness. She wore wireless headphones, immersed in her own world. Her face had to perfectly match the provided reference image—accurate facial structure, skin tone, hairstyle, and expression—refined, natural, and visually appealing. She was dressed in coordinated {argument name="outfit color" default="red"} Outfit: A stylish cropped top (short sleeves, hem above the abdomen) paired with a short skirt that falls above the knee. The style is modern, simple, and avant-garde. She also wears a matching hat, adding a sporty streetwear aesthetic. Setting: An open road under strong light, with subtle heat waves in the background; warm colors suggest hot weather. The light is bright and slightly intense, creating realistic shadows and highlights on the skin and clothing.{argument name="beverage" default="Pepsi"} The aluminum can is richly detailed, with a clear logo, a metallic texture, and a condensation effect. Her interaction with the beverage appears natural and casual, like a moment captured while walking. The composition has a dynamic and lively feel, with a subtle sense of movement (the flowing hair, the walking posture). The background is softened to increase depth of field, ensuring the focus remains on the subject. Color grading: a warm summer atmosphere, with bold {argument name="outfit color" default="red"} Clothing and{argument name="beverage" default="Pepsi"} The brand's signature cool blue provides a striking contrast. Style: Cinematic lifestyle photography, commercial beverage advertising, street fashion aesthetics. Resolution: Ultra-high resolution, 4K, high detail, photorealistic.

promptLocalized.zh:

她的面部必须与提供的参考图高度一致——准确的面部结构、肤色、发型和表情——精致、自然且极具视觉吸引力。

她身着协调的 {argument name="outfit color" default="red"} 套装：一件时尚的短款上衣（半袖，下摆在腹部上方）搭配一条长度及膝上方的短裙。服装风格现代、简洁且前卫。她还戴着一顶配套的帽子，增添了运动街头风的审美。

RELENTLESS."} "and"{argument name="slogan two" default="WEAR WHAT YOU'VE BEEN THROUGH"} "—Some text is arranged vertically, while others are at a 30-degree angle, creating a chaotic yet deliberate graphic magazine style. At the top center, a thin horizontal navigation bar displays "AUTHENTIC FIT · LIVED-IN LUXURY · BUILT TO LAST" in a wide-spaced, all-caps serif font. REAL. RELENTLESS."}”和“{argument name="slogan two" default="WEAR WHAT YOU'VE BEEN THROUGH"}”——部分文字垂直排列，部分呈 30 度角，营造出一种混乱而刻意的图形杂志风格。右上角，醒目的品牌标识以纯白色呈现在深色背景上。顶部中央，一条纤细的水平导航式文字栏显示着“AUTHENTIC FIT · LIVED-IN LUXURY · BUILT TO LAST”，采用间距宽阔的全大写衬线字体。右侧中央放置了一个醒目的大标题——“{argument name="main headline" default="OWN"}”，采用超粗白色大号字体，下方紧跟较细字重的“THE MOMENT”，营造出强烈的视觉层级感。小巧的黄色加号（+）符号和对角箭头（↗）作为装饰细节散布在画面各处。左下角是醒目的口号组合：“DEFINE YOUR DENIM”，采用大号粗体无衬线白色文字，下方配有一行细小的副标题：“An unapologetic reminder that style is a statement. 该男子身穿 {argument name="clothing" default="红色连帽衫"}、黑色束脚慢跑裤、红白配色 Air Jordan 高帮运动鞋，佩戴深色墨镜和银色戒指。他以放松的后仰姿势靠在超大号字体上，一条腿弯曲，另一条腿微微向观众方向伸展。他的身体向右倾斜，脸部转向镜头，呈现自信的三分之二侧面视角。背景为哑光质感的黑色。

templates.title: 3D model of the magical seed pack

templates.prompt: A grand 3D scene: a weathered seed packet lies open on a potted planter, its promised contents bursting forth to transform into the garden it describes. The illustration on the front of the packaging comes to life. Fully scale, the seeds grow from the paper.{argument name="plant type" default="[Plants/Flowers]"} The roots are clearly visible through the bottom of the packaging, penetrating the soil below. Blooming in the corner {argument name="detail left" default="[Detail 1]"} On the other side, it is in the middle of its growth phase.{argument name="detail right" default="[Detail 2]"} It is not yet fully formed. Tiny insects belonging to this plant.{argument name="insect type" default="[Bee/Butterfly/Beetle]"} The seed packet floats in the air in perfect proportion. The written instructions on the back transform into a garden calendar, and "Spring Sowing" becomes a realistic spring morning light. "Abundant Sunlight" becomes a beam of light, precisely illuminating the highest blooming flower. Seeds are scattered between the seed packet and the soil, each showcasing a different stage of germination: seed coat cracking, primary root, primary bud, primary leaf. The torn top edge of the packaging becomes a tree line. Soil and water droplets are scattered on the surface of the potted planter. The tilt-shift depth of field and the greenhouse morning light allow the seed packet to become the garden it was meant to be.

角落处盛开的 {argument name="detail left" default="[细节 1]"}。另一侧处于生长中期的 {argument name="detail right" default="[细节 2]"}，尚未完全成形。

种子包与土壤之间散落着种子，每一颗都展示着发芽的不同阶段：种皮裂开、初生根、初生芽、初生叶。

templates.title: Urban alley mural artist

titleLocalized.zh: 城市巷弄壁画艺术家

templates.prompt: This is a cinematic, hyper-realistic night scene depicting a {argument name="artist" default="Young male street artist"} In progress{argument name="setting" default="Narrow city alleys"} Draw a large picture{argument name="mural subject" default="Female face mural"} The camera angle is slightly low, creating a dramatic and tense perspective. The artist, with medium-length, slightly messy dark hair and a light stubble or short beard, exudes a rugged yet creative aura. He wears a loose white T-shirt and casual jeans, the slightly oversized cut conveying a relaxed street style. He stands by the wall, intently engaged in spray painting, his posture focused. He is creating a huge, hyper-realistic mural of a female face on the rough brick wall. The mural is incredibly detailed—delicate skin tones, lifelike light and shadow, expressive eyes, and glossy lips—it looks almost like a photograph. The fine mist from the spray paint is visible in the air, capturing the light and adding dynamism and atmosphere. The scene is set in a narrow city alley at night, surrounded by towering buildings. The environment is rough and textured—old brick walls, splattered paint, fine dirt, and the marks of time in the city. Neon signs and distant streetlights cast vibrant reflections of cyan, magenta, and blue, creating a cinematic, slightly cyberpunk atmosphere. The lighting design is dramatic and layered: cool-toned ambient light fills the alleyway, while warm-toned neon highlights provide a striking contrast. Subtle rim lighting outlines the artist's silhouette, making him stand out from the dark background. The mural is partially illuminated, becoming a powerful visual focal point. A slight mist enhances the depth of field and softens the light. The entire scene is immersive, quiet, and full of artistic tension. The depth of field is moderate: the artist and mural are in sharp focus, while the background gradually fades into a soft blur with bokeh. Style: Hyperrealism, cinematography, street art aesthetics, ultra-fine texture, high dynamic range, delicate film grain. Camera parameters: 35mm or 50mm lens, f/1.8–f/2.8 aperture, low-light photography, slightly low angle shooting, natural perspective. Composition: Vertical composition (4:5 or 9:16), with the subject slightly off-center. The mural dominates the main image to achieve a powerful visual narrative. The uploaded image was used as a reference to generate the image.

promptLocalized.zh:
这是一个电影感、超写实的夜景，描绘了一位 {argument name="artist" default="年轻男性街头艺术家"} 正在 {argument name="setting" default="狭窄的城市巷弄"} 中绘制一幅大型 {argument name="mural subject" default="女性面孔壁画"}。摄像机角度略低，营造出一种富有戏剧性和张力的视角。艺术家留着中等长度、略显凌乱的深色头发，留着淡淡的胡茬或短须，展现出一种粗犷而富有创造力的气质。

他身穿宽松的白色 T 恤和休闲牛仔裤，略显宽大的剪裁透着随性的街头风格。他站在墙边专注地进行喷漆创作，姿态投入。

他正在粗糙的砖墙上创作一幅巨大的超写实女性面孔壁画。壁画细节极其丰富——细腻的肤色、逼真的光影、传神的双眼和光泽感十足的双唇，看起来几乎如同照片一般。喷漆产生的细微雾气在空气中可见，捕捉着光线，增添了动感与氛围。

场景设定在夜晚狭窄的城市巷弄中，四周是高耸的建筑。环境粗粝且富有质感——陈旧的砖墙、飞溅的油漆、细微的污垢以及城市岁月的痕迹。霓虹灯牌和远处的路灯投射出青色、洋红色和蓝色的鲜艳倒影，营造出一种电影般、略带赛博朋克风格的氛围。

灯光设计富有戏剧性和层次感：冷色调的环境光充盈着巷弄，而暖色的霓虹灯高光则形成了鲜明对比。微妙的轮廓光勾勒出艺术家的剪影，使其从黑暗的背景中凸显出来。壁画被部分照亮，成为强有力的视觉焦点。

氛围包含轻微的雾气，增强了景深并使光线柔和地发光。整个场景令人沉浸，安静且充满艺术张力。

景深适中：艺术家和壁画处于清晰的焦点，而背景则渐变为柔和的虚化效果，并带有散景光斑。

风格：超写实、电影摄影、街头艺术美学、超精细纹理、高动态范围、细腻的胶片颗粒感。

相机参数：35mm 或 50mm 镜头，f/1.8–f/2.8 光圈，弱光摄影，轻微低角度拍摄，自然视角。

构图：竖构图（4:5 或 9:16），主体略微偏离中心，壁画占据画面主体，以实现强有力的视觉叙事。
使用上传的图片作为参考生成图像

templates.title: Luxury fashion magazine cover prompts

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华时尚杂志封面提示词

templates.prompt: Create a high-fashion magazine cover inspired by luxury fashion publications. Use a reference image of a male subject. Black and white portrait photography against a clean, off-white studio background. The subject poses confidently from a low angle, head slightly tilted back, jawline defined, lips slightly parted, and tousled, naturally voluminous waves. Clothing consists of a dark turtleneck sweater layered under a textured, tailored plaid blazer. Soft, dramatic lighting creates sculpted facial shadows and elegant contrast. Magazine layout design, with an oversized serif masthead at the top.{argument name="masthead text" default="VOGUE"} The text is partially obscured by the main header. The page uses a minimalist advanced layout. The side text "FASHION" and the release date have been added.{argument name="issue date" default="2026 MAY"} The cover features the title "27 DIFFERENT STYLES" on the left and the bold slogan "LOOK FAMOUS" in the lower right corner. A small, semi-transparent red square overlay with the word "CATCHY" is added to one of the eye areas. The style should embody sophistication, modernity, cinematic quality, clean composition, sharp focus, hyper-realistic skin texture, editorial luxury aesthetics, balanced white space, and timeless fashion cover design. It should be a vertical magazine format with high resolution.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张受奢华时尚刊物启发的高级时尚编辑杂志封面。使用男性主体的参考图。黑白人像摄影，背景为干净的米白色影棚背景。主体以低角度自信地摆出姿势，微微仰头，下颌线清晰，双唇微张，凌乱的波浪发型自然蓬松。服装包括一件深色高领毛衣，外搭一件质感剪裁的格纹西装外套。光线柔和而富有戏剧性，营造出雕塑般的面部阴影和优雅的对比度。杂志排版设计，顶部为超大衬线体刊头文字 “{argument name="masthead text" default="VOGUE"}”，部分被主体头部遮挡。页面采用极简高级排版。添加侧边文字 “FASHION”，发行日期 “{argument name="issue date" default="2026 MAY"}”，左侧标题 “27 DIFFERENT STYLES”，以及右下角加粗的封面标语 “LOOK FAMOUS”。在其中一只眼睛区域添加一个小的红色半透明方形遮罩，上面写有 “CATCHY” 字样。风格应体现高级感、现代感、电影感、构图简洁、焦点清晰、超真实皮肤纹理、编辑奢华美学、平衡的留白，以及永恒的时尚封面设计。竖版杂志比例，高分辨率。

templates.title: 4K Nike sneaker advertisement prompt

titleLocalized.zh: 4K Nike 运动鞋广告提示词

templates.prompt: A hyper-realistic Nike sneaker ad, shot with a dark, emotional editorial style. In the image, a male leg wearing crisp white athletic socks (with subtle Nike logo details) floats against a near-black charcoal gray background, angled sharply at a 45-degree angle. The lower two-thirds of the image focuses on the main subject—a pair of Nike low-top sneakers in a clean two-tone color scheme.{argument name="color scheme" default="Glacier blue suede patchwork with off-white lychee-patterned leather"} The iridescent chrome Swoosh logo captures the ambient light. The composition employs a shallow depth of field, focusing clearly on the shoe while the area above the leg is softly blurred. The background is overlaid with a subtle urban texture—electric yellow and soft olive graffiti brushstrokes are faintly visible in the deep shadows. Multiple lines of extra-small, all-caps lettering surround the sneaker at different angles, with text such as "..."{argument name="slogan" default="THE ONLY LIMITS ARE THE ONES YOU SET FOR YOURSELF"} "—Conveying dynamism, speed, and energy. Some text is arranged vertically, while others are tilted at a 30-degree angle, giving the composition a chaotic yet deliberate sense of graphic design. In the upper right corner, the prominent Nike lettering and Swoosh logo are presented in pure white against a dark background. At the top center, a thin horizontal navigation text bar reads: "PURE COMFORT · ALWAYS AHEAD · THE FUTURE IS NOW," in a wide-spaced, all-caps serif font. A striking headline is placed in the center right, using contrasting typography—a huge, extra-bold white "MOVE," followed by a thinner "BEYOND," creating a dramatic typographic hierarchy. Small yellow plus signs (+) and diagonal arrows (↗) are scattered throughout the image as decorative details, adding a modern magazine aesthetic. In the lower left corner is a striking brand slogan combination: "DEFINE YOUR STRIDE," in large, bold, sans-serif white text, with a thin-lined subheading below: "An" An inspiring reminder that speed is a mindset. Every step forward is a statement. The overall lighting effects are dramatic and directional—a single cool-toned main light from the left makes the Swoosh shimmer, and the white leather shines in the darkness. Photorealistic. Commercial photography quality. High contrast. 4K resolution, 3:4 portrait format, optimized for social media.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张超写实的 Nike 运动鞋广告，采用深色、情绪化的编辑风格拍摄。画面中，一条穿着清爽白色运动袜（带有精致的 Nike 标志细节）的男性腿部悬浮在近乎黑色的炭灰色背景中，以大胆的 45 度视角斜向镜头。画面下三分之二处是主角——一双 Nike 低帮运动鞋，采用干净的双色配色方案：{argument name="color scheme" default="冰川青色麂皮拼接与米白色荔枝纹皮革"}，虹彩铬合金 Swoosh 标志捕捉着环境光。
构图采用浅景深，焦点清晰地落在鞋子上，腿部上方则呈现柔和的虚化效果。背景叠加了微妙的城市质感——在浓重的暗角中隐约可见电光黄和柔和橄榄色的涂鸦笔触。多行超小号全大写字母排版以不同角度环绕着运动鞋，文字内容如 "{argument name="slogan" default="THE ONLY LIMITS ARE THE ONES YOU SET FOR YOURSELF"}"——传达出动感、速度与能量。部分文字垂直排列，部分以 30 度角倾斜，赋予构图一种混乱却刻意的平面设计感。
右上角，醒目的 Nike 字标和 Swoosh 标志以纯白色呈现于深色背景之上。顶部中央，一条纤细的水平导航式文本栏写着："PURE COMFORT · ALWAYS AHEAD · THE FUTURE IS NOW"，采用间距宽阔的全大写衬线字体。右侧中央放置了一个引人注目的标题，采用对比鲜明的排版——巨大的超粗体白色字母 "MOVE"，后接较细字重的 "BEYOND"，营造出极具戏剧性的字体层级。
画面中散布着黄色的小加号 (+) 和对角箭头 (↗) 作为装饰细节，增添了现代感十足的杂志美学。左下角是醒目的品牌标语组合："DEFINE YOUR STRIDE"，采用大号粗体无衬线白色文字，下方配有细线副标题："An inspiring reminder that speed is a mindset. Every step forward is a statement." 整体光影效果极具戏剧性和方向感——来自左侧的单一冷色主光，使 Swoosh 闪烁生辉，白色皮革在黑暗中熠熠生辉。照片级真实感。商业摄影品质。高对比度。4K 分辨率，3:4 竖屏格式，针对社交媒体进行了优化。

templates.title: Anime movie poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫电影海报

templates.prompt: A stunning vertical poster for an animated film. A collision of visual language between Studio Ghibli and Makoto Shinkai. A girl in a tattered white shrine maiden's robe stands on the wings of a collapsing, colossal stone statue—an ancient giant covered in moss and shimmering with golden Chinese characters—slowly falling into a sea of ​​clouds. Her long, black hair flows upward against gravity. She stretches a hand towards the sky, where a massive rift tears the heavens open—beyond the rift, an inverted ocean floats above the clouds, an ancient wooden city hangs from its surface, lanterns drifting like stars. The sky transitions from a deep twilight blue at the bottom to a bright peach and rose gold at the top. Volumetric light pierces through the clouds. Cherry blossom petals and tattered paper talismans swirl in the air. Her expression is calm and resolute. Art style: Hand-drawn 2D animation, ultra-detailed background painting, expressive lines, rich cel shadows. Color palette: Deep indigo, peach, rose gold, warm amber, soft white. The bottom is strikingly elegant.{argument name="language" default="Japanese Kanji"} The title is followed by a subtitle in a clean, modern font. Above the title is a small, white, italicized slogan. Atmosphere: Mythical, spiritual, and bittersweet miracles. Theatrical release quality, Toho Films.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张令人惊叹的竖版动漫电影海报。吉卜力工作室与新海诚视觉语言的碰撞。一位身穿破旧白色巫女服的少女站在一尊崩塌的巨大石像神祇的翅膀上——这是一尊覆盖着青苔并闪烁着金色汉字符文的远古巨人，正缓缓坠入云海。她乌黑的长发逆着重力向上飘散。她向天空伸出一只手，那里一道巨大的天裂撕开了苍穹——在裂痕之外，一片倒置的海洋悬浮在云端之上，古老的木制城市从海面垂挂而下，灯笼如星辰般漂浮。天空从底部的深暮蓝色渐变为顶部的明亮桃色和玫瑰金。体积光穿透云层。樱花花瓣和破碎的纸符在空中盘旋。她神情冷静而坚定。艺术风格：手绘 2D 动画，超精细背景绘制，富有表现力的线条，丰富的赛璐珞阴影。色调：深靛蓝、桃色、玫瑰金、暖琥珀色、柔白色。底部为醒目优雅的 {argument name="language" default="日文汉字"} 标题，下方配有简洁现代字体的英文副标题。标题上方为小号白色斜体标语。氛围：神话感、灵性、苦乐参半的奇迹。院线发行级质量，东宝电影。

templates.prompt: In a full-body fashion shoot, a confident young model sits casually on concrete steps, legs slightly apart, one arm resting on her knee, the other relaxed, looking directly at the camera with a calm and commanding expression. She wears a light-colored denim jacket over a simple white T-shirt, unisex shorts, bright socks, and modern sneakers. The styling is simple, the posture natural, a gentle breeze ruffling her hair and clothing. A stylized cartoon character stands nearby.{argument name="animal" default="dog"} And interact with it to some extent, their positions natural, as if they were in the same space.{argument name="animal" default="dog"} Drawing in a bold cartoon style, it features heavy black outlines, vibrant neon hues (with blue, green, and yellow accents), exaggerated proportions, and lively expressions, creating a playful yet dynamic effect. Background: A bright outdoor urban environment with azure skies, soft clouds, and the texture of concrete under sunlight, strong natural light, and clear shadows. A fusion of hyper-realistic photography and graphic illustration, seamlessly integrating the subject with cartoon elements. Added graphic overlay elements: graffiti arrows, scribbles, abstract shapes, comic-style symbols, and dynamic lines. High contrast, HDR lighting effects, sharp focus, stylish cinematic composition, surreal mixed-media aesthetics, exquisite detail, and 8K resolution.

templates.prompt: 1. Design a modern, tech-style poster for the "AI Agent Tool Launch," in a 4:5 aspect ratio. Include an abstract network, a code window, and an Agent node. The overall visual should convey the quality of a high-end SaaS launch poster, and the text must be accurate and easy to read. 2. Generate a cover image suitable for a long post on X/Twitter, titled "AI Tool Trends in 2026," in a 16:9 aspect ratio with a clean and concise style. Include the title and three keywords: Agent / Workflow / Automation. The background should blend desktop workflow, browser, terminal, and data panel layouts, similar to a tech media header image. 3. Generate an advertisement image for a Web3 wallet security tool. The center of the image should display the wallet interface on a mobile phone, surrounded by on-chain addresses, risk warnings, a shield icon, and a visualization of the transaction path. The style should be professional and trustworthy, with the Chinese title: "Making Every On-Chain Operation Safer." 4. Create a Chinese infographic titled "5 Levels of AI Agent Capabilities," including: understanding tasks, calling tools, reading data, executing operations, and reviewing and optimizing. Present it with a clear hierarchical structure, each level accompanied by small icons, a white background, and tech-blue accents. 5. Generate a 4-panel comic strip illustrating the process of a creator going from manually searching for information, writing copy, and creating images, to automating the workflow using an AI Agent. The style should be lighthearted and humorous, with consistent characters and concise, clear Chinese dialogue. The last panel should highlight "doubling efficiency." 6. Generate a roadmap visual for an AI x Crypto project, including three phases: Q2, Q3, and Q4: MVP, Agent Marketplace, and On-Chain Automation. The style should reflect the product page quality of a fundraising presentation—simple, credible, futuristic, and with clear, easy-to-read text.

templates.title: Movie-style rainy night bus stop sign

templates.prompt: At a city bus stop on a rainy night, a{argument name="person" default="young women"} Standing alone under the dim yellow streetlights and bus stop sign, she looked down at her phone, not at the camera, adopting a natural waiting posture. She was wearing {argument name="clothing" default="A light jacket, a dark skirt, and white sneakers"} Long hair falls naturally, one hand holding a phone, the other a transparent umbrella. The subject is positioned in the right third of the frame, with a blurred foreground obscuring the left side, as if captured by chance from a street crowd or the edge of a car window. Bus stop signs, advertising light boxes, lampposts, and the edge of the umbrella form clear vertical and diagonal lines, guiding the viewer's focus. Raindrops reflect on the ground, while distant car lights and neon signs are blurred into soft spots of light. The overall lighting is a blend of cool-toned rainy night conditions and warm yellow streetlights, with soft top and side lighting, avoiding a posed feel. Shallow depth of field keeps the subject sharp while the background is slightly blurred; the image has realistic camera noise, slight motion blur, and imperfect composition, presenting a genuine, candid moment. The photo has a natural, authentic style, not a studio shot or a commercial production, and contains no text or watermarks.

templates.title: Social media personal homepage news broadcast conversion

titleLocalized.zh: 社交媒体个人主页新闻播报转换

templates.prompt: Analyze the uploaded screenshot of X (Twitter) profile. First, extract my profile picture, display name, and bio text. Then, based on my bio and overall style, generate a realistic Japanese TV breaking news broadcast featuring me. The image should closely resemble the person in the profile picture, appearing as if being interviewed live. The design style should mimic Japanese news programs (similar to NHK News or News Zero). All text must be in Japanese. Include the following elements: 1. A red "Breaking News" banner at the top of the screen. 2. A prominent Japanese headline summarizing who I am based on my bio (e.g., "Exclusive Interview with Mr. ○○, the Pioneer of the AI ​​Era"). 3. A profile information box on the side of the screen (similar to a Japanese news information panel), containing: - "Portrait" section: Three brief points about my personality or profession based on my bio. - "Focus" section: Three small items representing my interests or skills, inferred from my profile. 4. A scrolling news bar at the bottom of the screen containing 2-3 short, humorous updates generated based on my profile and interests, written in Japanese. 5. A fictional Japanese news channel logo in the corner (e.g., "Profile TV" or "X News Channel"). 6. A red "LIVE" indicator in the upper right corner. The overall look should resemble photorealistic Japanese television news broadcasts, with clear, modern Japanese typography. Ensure all Japanese text is legible and accurately reflects the information on my profile page.

右下角有一块铭牌风格的文字，写着 "{argument name="plaque text" default="MONA BANANA, 2026, Oil and Gold Leaf on Canvas"}"。
这是一件庄重典雅、与克里姆特真迹无异的作品。

templates.title: Traditional Japanese Buddhist statues

titleLocalized.zh: 传统日本佛像

templates.prompt: One statue{argument name="type of Buddhist statue" default="Standing statue of Thousand-Hand Guanyin Bodhisattva"} It evokes images of ancient Japanese Buddhist sculpture. It presents a serene and solemn atmosphere, similar to {argument name="collection" default="Tokyo National Museum"} A masterpiece in the collection. A full-body frontal view, the figure is slender and elegant, with a gentle and compassionate expression, half-closed eyes, and a warm smile. It includes an exquisite crown, flowing robes, and delicate ornaments. Numerous arms radiate outwards from the back, strongly emphasizing the symbolism of the Thousand-Armed Guanyin. The number of hands can be set to 42 according to actual sculpting tradition. The figure stands on a lotus pedestal, with a halo behind it. The primary material is [material name missing].{argument name="material" default="Wood carving"} The design evokes a sense of history, depicting textures such as lacquer, peeling gold leaf, weathered colors, traces of original hues, cracks, wear, and the weighty heritage of the temple. The overall design recalls the style of Japanese Buddhist statues from the Heian to Kamakura periods, showcasing nobility, elegance, and religious solemnity. Like professional museum photography, the deep, soft background highlights the three-dimensionality and texture of the statues. Museum-quality, cultural heritage-grade, ultra-high definition.

She wears a structured, oversized garment.{argument name="clothing" default="gray suit jacket"} She wore a soft white dress underneath a coat with a delicately textured pattern. A black sheer scarf was tied around her neck, hanging loosely to add contrast and fluidity. Her hands were half-tucked into her suit pockets, revealing black sheer gloves. Her hairstyle was a slightly messy, casual updo, with a few strands falling beside her cheeks. She wore bold, modern silver earrings. The background was minimalist, presenting a smooth, light gray tone with subtle curves that added depth without being distracting. The color palette was soft and sophisticated: gray, white, and black dominated the entire image. The overall atmosphere was elegant, modern, and slightly melancholic, like a high-fashion magazine photoshoot. Style keywords: fashion editor, minimalism, soft lighting, neutral tones, modern elegance, high detail, shallow depth of field, studio photography, cinematic composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超写实电影感街头美食广告海报，用于 {argument name="brand name" default="Licious"} 冷冻 {argument name="product name" default="Chicken Momos"}，在深色高端摄影棚中拍摄，采用戏剧性的情绪化灯光、深海军黑背景、光泽感黑色桌面，以及高对比度的商业食品摄影风格。构图为方形社交媒体广告布局，左侧为超大号加粗紧凑型白色无衬线标题文本，分两行显示 {argument name="headline text" default="PERFECTLY MADE."}，下方为较小的白色副标题 {argument name="tagline text" default="PRECISION IN EVERY BITE."}。在最左侧边缘，添加细小的垂直小型大写字母文本，内容为“FRESH • CLEAN • CONTROLLED”。在右上角背景处，以微妙的深灰色图案重复短语“CUT / STEAM / SERVE / REPEAT”，并在左下角地面区域附近以透视文本形式模糊重复“CUT / STEAM / SERVE / REPEAT”。总共展示 6 个饺子：5 个完整的蒸鸡肉饺子在中心和右侧动态悬浮排列，1 个切开的饺子位于中心，露出多汁的橙褐色鸡肉馅料和香草，一个亮红橙色的酱汁滴从开口的饺子中向下滴落。在饺子周围散布悬浮在空中的小辣椒片、香草碎和调味料颗粒，营造出爆发性的动感。在右侧放置 3 个零售产品盒，深度错落有致，黑色包装上印有 {argument name="brand name" default="Licious"} 标志和红色产品标题“CHICKEN MOMOS”，包装正面印有饺子的食品摄影图。在右下角前景处，放置 1 个装满鲜红色蘸酱的小黑碗。在底部添加一行细小的白色页脚文本，内容为“CHICKEN MOMOS • FRESHLY PREPARED • 2026 EDITION”，并在右下角放置“licious.com”。采用高端广告设计、超细腻的食物质感、饺子上的光泽高光、微妙的蒸汽光泽、清晰的排版、浅景深以及精致的高端商业活动美学。

templates.prompt: A minimalist luxury fashion advertising poster, used for{argument name="brand name" default="GUCCI"} Employing an editorial style, the background is a soft, warm beige, presenting a clean, high-end magazine layout. It showcases a stylish woman, positioned from mid-thigh up in a three-quarter profile on the right, sporting a sleek black bob and a visible gold hoop earring. Her face is deliberately obscured by a vertical, blurred rectangular block of color. She wears a camel wool coat over a black turtleneck sweater, and carries a classic designer shoulder bag under her arm. The bag, made of beige canvas, features a repeating monogram pattern, black leather trim and a shoulder strap, and a striking interlocking gold metal logo on the flap. Her posture is elegant and composed, one hand lightly resting on her coat, the other holding the bag, conveying an understated luxury. The soft, diffused lighting and neutral color palette create a sharp, fashion editorial style, showcasing the high-quality textures of the wool coat, leather, canvas, and metal accessories. The brand name is placed in large black serif font on the left side of the composition.{argument name="brand name" default="GUCCI"} Below that is a small, luxurious logo, followed by a thin vertical dividing line, and then stacked slogans.{argument name="tagline" default="TIMELESS ELEGANCE"} (Using a small uppercase sans-serif font), place the seasonal text near the bottom left corner.{argument name="season text" default="FALL WINTER 2024"} On the right edge, an oversized, cropped abstract digital graphic is added as a background design element in a light gray-brown color. The overall composition remains simple, balanced, and sophisticated, reminiscent of a luxury brand advertising poster or magazine cover.

templates.title: A determined boxer leaning against the ropes of the boxing ring

titleLocalized.zh: 倚靠在拳击台围绳上的坚毅拳手

templates.prompt: A portrait of a determined and realistic fitness lifestyle, featuring [the person/entity].{argument name="subject" default="A male athlete"} He is leaning back against the ropes of an old-fashioned boxing ring in a retro gym. The mid-shot, vertical composition frames the area from mid-thigh to above the head, with the subject centered and facing the camera. He wears an oversized briar grey hooded sweatshirt, the drawstring visible, the soft cotton texture, natural folds, and the kangaroo pocket at the front; black satin boxing shorts with white trim and curved white piping at the hem; his hands are wrapped in slightly worn and loose white wristbands. His posture is relaxed yet powerful: arms outstretched, resting on the ropes on either side of the boxing ring, shoulders relaxed, torso facing the camera, hands hanging naturally above the ropes. His dark brown, short to medium-length hair, slightly messy, reveals his forehead beneath the hood. His physique is natural and robust, with realistic proportions and subtly defined muscles. The boxing ring clearly shows the colors of its three ropes: red at the top of the background, light gray-white behind the waist, and dark blue in the foreground. The background has been soft-focused, showcasing the aged beige walls, scattered retro gym posters and banners, industrial-style wear and tear, and the dimly lit training space. The lighting is a blend of soft indoor natural light and gym ambient light, creating subtle shadows and a cinematic, melancholic tone. Photorealistic textures, low-saturation earth tones, shallow depth of field, and rich details in the fabrics, wristbands, skin, and ropes create an editorial sports portrait style.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张坚毅、写实的健身生活方式肖像，主角为 {argument name="subject" default="一名男性运动员"}，他正向后倚靠在复古健身房内老式拳击台的围绳上。中景竖构图，取景范围从大腿中部到头部上方，主体居中并面向镜头。他穿着一件超大号的石楠灰套头连帽衫，兜帽戴在头上，可见垂下的抽绳、柔软的棉质纹理、自然的褶皱以及前方的袋鼠兜；身着带有白色饰边和下摆处弧形白色滚边的黑色缎面运动拳击短裤；双手缠绕着白色手带，略显磨损且缠绕松散。他的姿态放松而有力：双臂向外展开，分别搭在左右两侧的拳击台围绳上，双肩舒展，躯干正对镜头，双手自然垂在围绳上方。深棕色短至中长发，在兜帽下露出额头，略显凌乱。体格自然且健硕，比例写实，肌肉线条低调。拳击台清晰可见 3 根围绳颜色：背景上方为红色围绳，腰部后方为浅灰白色围绳，前景下方为深蓝色围绳。背景经过柔焦处理，呈现出陈旧的米色墙面、零散的复古健身海报和横幅、工业风磨损痕迹以及昏暗的训练空间氛围。光线为柔和的室内自然光与健身房环境光混合，营造出细腻的阴影和电影般的忧郁基调。照片级真实纹理，低饱和度的大地色系，浅景深，织物、手带、皮肤和围绳细节丰富，呈现出编辑类体育肖像风格。

templates.title: Tough boxers in a retro boxing gym

templates.prompt: A rugged and realistic portrait of a fitness lifestyle, the protagonist is a{argument name="subject" default="male athletes"} He leans casually yet powerfully against the ropes of an old-fashioned boxing gym. The shot is a medium shot, vertically composed, with the subject centered, the frame extending from mid-thigh to head. His forearms rest on the top red ropes, while his hands hang naturally above the lower blue and white ropes. The protagonist is wearing an oversized {argument name="hoodie color" default="Hemp gray"} The hoodie, pulled up over the head, reveals a soft cotton texture, natural wrinkles, and a slightly worn, casual feel. Black boxing shorts are faintly visible at the bottom of the image. The hands are wrapped around slightly worn {argument name="hand wrap color" default="White"} The boxing bandages, with their layered wrappings around the wrists, palms, and knuckles, and the fabric tension, appear realistic and natural. The hair is dark, medium-length, and slightly damp, with a few strands falling from the hood to the forehead. The expression should be focused, calm, slightly tired yet determined, with natural lips conveying a contemplative atmosphere after training. The protagonist possesses a naturally athletic physique, with clearly defined and realistic muscle lines beneath the hoodie, broad shoulders, and no exaggerated muscle definition. The background is a retro boxing gym, with three ropes clearly visible: red at the top, white in the middle, and blue at the bottom. Behind the protagonist are old gray-white walls, vintage boxing posters, hanging training equipment, and blurred gym details, creating a sense of history and wear. templates.title: Anime tunnel cockpit scene

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫隧道驾驶舱场景

templates.prompt: A cinematic, anime-style car interior scene, with the perspective shifting from the back seat.{argument name="driver description" default="A young woman with shoulder-length black hair"} The camera focuses on her shoulders, capturing her driving through a dimly lit city tunnel late at night. She grips a classic retro three-spoke steering wheel, left hand at the 10 o'clock position and right hand at the 3 o'clock position. She wears a watch and a delicate bracelet, and a loose-fitting light-colored shirt with rolled-up sleeves. The dashboard resembles the cockpit of a retro sports car, featuring four round analog gauges emitting a warm orange-red glow, a retro radio console, metal trim, and a manual gearshift lever in the lower right foreground. Beyond the windshield, dense tunnel traffic is visible, with multiple cars ahead, red brake lights, and glaring overhead tunnel lights stretching into the distance, speedometer lines etched on the rough concrete walls. The composition is expansive and immersive, emphasizing the driver's hands, steering wheel, and dashboard, with the driver's face partially outlined in profile on the left edge. The image is rendered with bold, cartoonish lines, featuring heavy ink washes, dark shadows, soft blue-gray and black tones, and warm highlights from the dashboard and tunnel lights. The atmosphere is tense, focused, nighttime, and stylish, reminiscent of a dramatic street race or a thriller anime scene.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个电影级的动漫风格汽车内饰场景，视角从后座越过 {argument name="driver description" default="一位留着齐肩黑发的年轻女性"} 的肩膀，拍摄她深夜穿过昏暗城市隧道的画面。她双手紧握经典的复古三辐式方向盘，左手位于 10 点钟方向，右手位于 3 点钟方向，手腕上戴着手表和细手链，身穿宽松的浅色衬衫，袖口卷起。仪表盘是复古跑车的驾驶舱，可以看到 4 个发出暖橙红色光芒的圆形模拟仪表、复古收音机控制台、金属饰条，以及右下角前景中的手动换挡杆。挡风玻璃外展示着密集的隧道交通，前方有多辆汽车，红色的刹车灯，刺眼的头顶隧道灯向远处延伸，粗糙的混凝土墙壁上布满速度线。构图宽广且具有沉浸感，强调驾驶员的手部、方向盘和仪表盘，驾驶员的脸部在左侧边缘呈现部分侧面轮廓。采用粗犷的漫画风格线条渲染，带有厚重的墨水排线、深色阴影、柔和的蓝灰色和黑色调，以及来自仪表盘和隧道灯的暖色高光。氛围紧张、专注、充满夜色感且时尚，宛如戏剧性的街头赛车或惊悚动漫画面。

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 作为主体基础，将这张随意的沙漠快照转化为全身奢华时尚摄影棚肖像。将牛仔夹克、背心和短裤替换为一件合身的无肩带迷你鸡尾酒裙，颜色为 {argument name="dress color" default="粉蓝色"}，饰有华丽的银色花卉刺绣，胸部和上腰部各有 2 个几何镂空设计。将背景更改为干净、无缝的浅灰色摄影棚背景，并采用精致的高端编辑风格。在主体右手添加 1 个带有细链条的银色手拿包，并搭配 1 双尖头银色高跟鞋。将姿势调整为优雅的站立时尚姿势，一只手靠近面部，保持主体人物和发型特征不变，并应用柔和的电影级奢华灯光，呈现清晰的 8K 时尚摄影细节。

templates.title: Editorial Osaka Six Hoodie Advertisement

titleLocalized.zh: Editorial Osaka Six 卫衣广告

templates.prompt: A clean, editorial-style fashion advertising poster features a pale pinkish-blue studio background with a glossy, reflective floor. The composition is vertical and minimalist, with a large, bold white sans-serif font dominating the upper part of the background. The first line reads "OSAKA SIX:", and below, "006 REMAINS", filling the upper half of the background. Smaller white branding text in the upper right corner reads "Designed by ARTTEESHOW". At the bottom center of the image is a huge, forest-green crewneck sweatshirt, standing upright like a sculpture. Made of soft, thick cotton, it features dropped shoulders and extra-long sleeves that bunch up on the ground. A small black tag with "ARTTEESHOW" is located at the neckline. The sweatshirt has a large abstract collage print on the chest, composed of torn paper scraps in beige, tan, black, gray, white, and bright red, arranged vertically like stacked debris. Leaning to the right of the giant sweatshirt is a slender female fashion model with long, straight black hair, wearing the same sweatshirt.{argument name="sweatshirt color" default="Forest Green"} Wearing a hoodie and loose-fitting wide-leg sweatpants, paired with clean white low-top sneakers, she stands sideways, exuding a cool, detached editorial attitude. One hand is in her pocket, her body leaning against the oversized garment, her legs outstretched. Her face is softly blurred with rectangles, creating an anonymous, art-fashion feel. The smaller hoodie worn by the model also features the same abstract torn paper collage pattern on the chest. At the bottom center, two lines of small white text are added: “Made for comfort, worn for confidence.” and “Because life feels better when someone's carrying the weight of the world.” The image should evoke the high-end streetwear advertising style of the early 1990s, reinterpreted as contemporary luxury advertising, featuring crisp studio lighting, soft shadows, subtle ground reflections, precise product focus, a surreal contrast between the oversized hoodie and the model, and sophisticated magazine poster aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张干净的编辑风格时尚广告海报，背景为淡粉蓝色摄影棚，地面带有光泽的反射效果。构图呈垂直且极简风格，背景上方被巨大的白色加粗无衬线字体占据，第一行写着“OSAKA SIX:”，下方写着“006 REMAINS”，填满了主体后方的上半部分。右上角有小号白色品牌文字，写着“Designed by ARTTEESHOW”。画面中下部居中位置是一件巨大的森林绿色圆领卫衣，像雕塑一样竖立着，采用柔软厚实的棉质面料，落肩设计，超长袖子堆叠在地面上，领口处有一个写着 ARTTEESHOW 的黑色小标签。卫衣胸前有一个巨大的抽象拼贴印花，由米色、棕褐色、黑色、灰色、白色和鲜红色的撕纸碎片组成，像层叠的碎屑一样垂直排列。靠在巨大卫衣右侧的是一位身材苗条的女性时尚模特，留着黑色长直发，穿着同款 {argument name="sweatshirt color" default="森林绿"} 卫衣和宽松的阔腿运动裤，脚踩干净的白色低帮运动鞋。她侧身站立，展现出一种冷静、疏离的编辑风格态度，一只手插在口袋里，身体斜靠在巨大的服装上，双腿向前伸展；她的脸部被柔和的矩形模糊处理，营造出一种匿名艺术时尚感。模特身上穿着的较小号卫衣胸前也有同样的抽象撕纸拼贴图案。在底部中心，添加两行白色小字文案：“Made for comfort, worn for confidence.”以及“Because life feels better when someone’s carrying the weight of the world.” 画面应呈现出 20 世纪 90 年代初的高端概念街头服饰广告风格，并以当代奢华广告的形式重新演绎，具备清晰的摄影棚灯光、柔和的阴影、微妙的地面反射、精准的产品对焦、巨大卫衣与模特之间的超现实比例对比，以及精致的杂志海报美学。

templates.title: Hindi poetry poster: Parashurama

titleLocalized.zh: 印地语诗歌海报：帕拉舒拉马 (Parashurama)

templates.prompt: A vertically oriented literary poster, employing soft tan, ashe, and parchment tones, features a dramatic gold kintsugi-style crack running diagonally across the entire image. The background is made of finely textured paper with watercolor effects, swirling clouds, aged stains, and subtle marble textures. In the upper left corner is a large, faded monochrome half-length portrait of an elderly Indian man in traditional formal attire, emerging from the mist like a historical figure or poet, blending softly with the background. A small Hindi title line is placed in the upper right corner.{argument name="headline text" default="परशुराम की प्रतीक्षा"} Below this is a smaller author's signature, elegant and understated in style. Below that is a large, centered Hindi quote, written in refined serif Devanagari script and enclosed in oversized quotation marks, using the exact text.{argument name="main quote" default="जब नाश मनुज पर छाता है, पहले विवेक मर जाता है。"} In the lower half, create a valiant Hindu mythological warrior standing atop rugged black rocks, his body slightly turned to the left, his posture powerful and windswept. His bare, muscular torso is exposed, long, unruly black hair flowing upwards, and tattered crimson cloth is draped around his body, dramatically trailing to the right in a torn ribbon-like motion. In his left hand, he grips a large battle axe, its blade angled downwards, alluding to the Parashura horse. Dust, smoke, tiny fragments, and painterly splatter effects surround him. Add two smaller pieces of Hindi poetic text to the lower left and right of the warrior, maintaining balance like a printed poetry poster. The poetic text should remain dense and legible, but serve as a central introduction and supporting element to the figure. Employ a digital illustration style with the aesthetic appeal of a fine art poster, using soft, atmospheric lighting to create high contrast around the warrior, with subtle, luminous golden cracks running through the portrait, text areas, rocks, and fabric. The overall atmosphere is solemn, prophetic, patriotic, and powerful, like an inspirational poetry poster about India's moral decay and awakening of justice, suitable for social media sharing.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张竖构图的文学海报，采用柔和的棕褐色、灰烬色和羊皮纸色调，整个画面对角线贯穿着戏剧性的金色金缮风格裂纹。背景为质感细腻的纸张，带有水彩渲染效果、烟雾缭绕的云层、陈旧的污渍和淡淡的大理石纹理。左上角放置一位身着传统正式服装的印度老人的大型褪色单色半身肖像，如同历史人物或诗人般从迷雾中隐约浮现，与背景柔和融合。右上角设置一行小巧的印地语标题 {argument name="headline text" default="परशुराम की प्रतीक्षा"}，下方附带较小的作者署名，风格优雅且低调。在其下方，放置一句居中的大型印地语引言，使用精致的衬线体天城文，并由超大引号框起，使用确切文本 {argument name="main quote" default="जब नाश मनुज पर छाता है, पहले विवेक मर जाता है。"}。在下半部分，创作一位英勇的印度神话战士，他站在崎岖的黑色岩石上，身体略微朝左，姿态强劲，迎风而立。他赤裸着肌肉发达的躯干，长长的黑色乱发向上飘扬，身上缠绕着破烂的深红色布料，并以撕裂的丝带状向右侧戏剧性地拖曳。他左手握着一把大战斧，斧刃向下倾斜，暗示其为帕拉舒拉马。周围环绕着尘埃、烟雾、细小的碎片和绘画般的飞溅效果。在战士的左下方和右下方各添加两块较小的印地语诗歌文本，像印刷诗歌海报一样保持平衡。诗歌文本应保持密集且易读，但作为核心引言和人物的辅助内容。采用具有美术海报美感的数字插画风格，运用柔和的大气光影，战士周围形成高对比度，细微的金色发光裂纹穿过肖像、文本区域、岩石和织物。整体氛围庄重、具有预言感、爱国且强烈，如同关于印度道德崩溃与正义觉醒的励志诗歌海报，适合社交媒体分享。

templates.title: Dreamy Shibuya Bubble Girl

titleLocalized.zh: 梦幻涩谷泡泡少女

templates.prompt: A dreamlike, anime-style full-body illustration depicts a stylish young woman standing in the center of a Shibuya intersection in Tokyo on a bright, sunny day. The iconic cylindrical SHIBUYA 109 building forms the center of the background, surrounded by highly recognizable billboards, including a dense array of advertisements for Japanese cities such as H&M, DHC, DMM TV, and Big Echo. She is the sole central subject, her posture elegant, seemingly floating or weightless, standing on a giant, iridescent, translucent soap bubble. Her face is softly obscured and softened, her long, deep purple-black hair flowing in the wind, framing soft bangs, and adorned with a pink flower headdress with a ribbon on one side. She wears a sweet, feminine spring outfit: a pink sleeveless dress over a long-sleeved ruffled blouse, tied with a ribbon at the chest, a brown belt at the waist, and layered ruffles at the hem, with delicate cherry blossom embroidery at the bottom. Her expression and body language convey gentleness, elegance, fantasy, and a touch of magic. One of her hands is raised, her index finger pointing to a floating bubble containing a smartphone; her other hand holds a large, transparent, iridescent shopping bag-shaped bubble containing three items: a SHIBUYA 109 paper shopping bag, a pink shopping bag or packaging, and a pink bunny-face storage bag. Additionally, a separate floating smartphone/tablet is visible in the lower left bubble, and a small camera is contained within the lower right floating bubble. Surrounding her are numerous soap bubbles of varying sizes, all possessing a highly reflective iridescent sheen and delicate transparency, creating a soft, shimmering atmosphere. The cityscape should appear busy yet slightly soft-focused, with pedestrians in the distance and zebra crossings in the foreground, warm sunlight filtering through the urban canyons. The rendering employs exquisite, high-detail anime illustrations, using bright, soft tones, glossy reflections, soft lighting effects, romantic spring color schemes, and a magical Tokyo everyday aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张梦幻般的动漫风格全身插画，描绘了一位时尚的年轻女性在晴朗明媚的日子里站在东京涩谷十字路口中央。背景中心是标志性的圆柱形 SHIBUYA 109 大楼，周围环绕着极具辨识度的商业广告牌，包括类似 H&M、DHC、DMM TV、Big Echo 等密集的日本城市广告。她是画面中唯一的中心主体，姿态优雅，仿佛漂浮或处于失重状态，脚下踩着一个巨大的虹彩半透明肥皂泡。她的面部被柔和地遮挡并弱化处理，深紫黑色的长发在风中飘逸，留着柔和的刘海，一侧戴着带有丝带的粉色花朵头饰。她身着甜美的春季女性化服装：粉色无袖连衣裙内搭长袖荷叶边衬衫，胸前系有丝带，腰间系着棕色腰带，裙摆处有层叠的褶边，裙摆下部有精致的樱花刺绣。她的表情和肢体语言应显得温柔、优雅、奇幻且带有一丝魔法感。她的一只手向上抬起，食指指向一个漂浮的泡泡，泡泡内含 1 部智能手机；另一只手提着一个透明虹彩购物袋状的大泡泡，袋内可见 3 件物品：1 个 SHIBUYA 109 纸质购物袋、1 个粉色购物袋或包装，以及 1 个粉色小兔脸收纳袋。此外，在左下方泡泡外包含 1 个独立的漂浮智能手机/平板设备，右下方漂浮的泡泡内包含 1 台小型相机。周围环绕着许多大小不一的肥皂泡，所有泡泡都具有高反射性的彩虹光泽和细腻的透明感，营造出柔和闪烁的氛围。城市场景应显得繁忙但略带柔焦，远景中有行人，前景有斑马线，温暖的阳光穿过城市峡谷洒下。采用精致的高细节动漫插画渲染，使用明亮的柔和色调、光泽反射、柔光效果、浪漫的春季配色以及充满魔法感的东京日常美学。

templates.title: Sunshine Library Learning Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 阳光图书馆学习肖像

templates.prompt: A highly realistic indoor snapshot captures a young East Asian woman studying alone in a quiet, sunlit library or reading room. She sits at a wooden table, the shot taken from half-body, with several blurred wooden chair backs in the foreground. She has dark brown to black hair tied in a low ponytail parted in the middle, and wears a simple light gray knit sweater. An open book sits in front of her, and a white thermos is on the right side of the table. Strong, warm morning or afternoon sunlight streams in from the high window on the right, illuminating the right edge of her hair, her shoulders, the tabletop, and the pages of the book, while the rest of the room remains softly dark. The composition uses a telephoto perspective, featuring shallow depth of field, creamy foreground blur, natural shadows, and an atmosphere of quiet contemplation. The background includes a white standing air conditioner leaning against a dark wooden partition wall, and soft interior details of the study. Vertical portrait composition, documentary style, with a subtle film texture, presenting natural skin and fabric details, no stylized processing, no text, no other people, no posed smiles, only capturing the moment of focused study.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度逼真的室内抓拍照片，拍摄了一位年轻东亚女性在安静、阳光明媚的图书馆或阅览室独自学习的场景。她坐在木桌前，镜头从半身处取景，前景中有几把虚化的木椅靠背。她留着深棕色至黑色的头发，扎着中分低马尾，身穿一件简约的浅灰色针织毛衣。她面前放着一本打开的书，桌子右侧放着一个白色保温杯。强烈的暖色调晨光或午后阳光从右侧的高窗射入，照亮了她头发的右边缘、肩膀、桌面以及书页，而房间的其他部分则保持柔和的暗调。构图采用长焦观察视角，具有浅景深、奶油般的前景虚化、自然的阴影以及安静沉思的氛围。背景中包含靠在深色木隔断墙上的白色立式空调，以及书房柔和的室内细节。垂直肖像构图，纪实写实风格，带有微妙的胶片质感，呈现自然的皮肤和织物细节，无风格化处理，无文字，无其他人物，无摆拍笑容，仅捕捉专注学习的瞬间。

templates.title: Golden hour bus stop snapshots

titleLocalized.zh: 黄金时刻公交站抓拍

templates.prompt: A remarkably realistic street snapshot captures a young East Asian woman standing at a city bus stop. The perspective, slightly angled from behind other waiting passengers, creates a natural sense of obstruction and a documentary style. She stands on the right side of the frame, looking down at her smartphone, her long, straight, black hair shimmering warmly in the low-hanging sunset. She wears a white T-shirt under an open, light blue oversized shirt, paired with loose-fitting beige high-waisted trousers or a long skirt, and a canvas tote bag slung over her shoulder. She appears relaxed, engrossed in her phone. The scene includes two blurred foreground figures framing the main subject: a large, blurred silhouette with long hair on the left edge, and a shoulder and back view of someone wearing a dark shirt on the right edge. Behind her is a glass bus shelter panel reflecting trees and sunlight, with a vertical bus route chart clearly displaying four route numbers: 622, 648, 686, and 740, in the style of a Chinese bus timetable. The warm, soft light with a strong backlighting effect creates rim lighting around her hair, evoking a sunny evening atmosphere. Employing smartphone photography aesthetics, shallow depth of field, natural colors, and realistic skin and fabric textures, the film showcases everyday life in a Chinese city. The vertical composition, with subtle lens flare, presents a sense of unintentional slices of life.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超逼真的街头抓拍照片，拍摄了一位站在城市公交站的东亚年轻女性。视角略微从其他候车乘客的身后切入，使构图呈现出自然的遮挡感和纪实风格。她站在画面中右侧，低头看着手中的智能手机，一头乌黑的长直发在身后低垂的夕阳映照下闪烁着温暖的背光。她身穿白色 T 恤，外搭一件敞开的浅蓝色大码衬衫，下身穿着宽松的米白色高腰裤或长裙，肩上背着一个帆布托特包。她姿态放松，正沉浸在手机中。场景中包含 2 个模糊的前景人物以框住主体：左侧边缘是一个长发模糊的大型人影，右侧边缘是一个穿着深色衬衫的肩膀和背影。她身后是一个反射着树木和阳光的玻璃公交候车亭面板，最右侧是一个垂直的公交线路项目，上面清晰显示着 4 个线路编号：622、648、686 和 740，采用中国公交时刻表样式。光线温暖、柔和且具有强烈的背光效果，在她的发丝周围形成了轮廓光，营造出阳光明媚的傍晚氛围。采用智能手机摄影美学、浅景深、自然色彩、真实的皮肤和织物纹理，展现中国城市日常生活，竖屏构图，带有细微的镜头光晕，呈现出一种不经意间的生活切片感。

templates.title: Tang Dynasty court dancers

titleLocalized.zh: 唐朝宫廷舞者

templates.prompt: A cinematic, hyper-realistic scene depicts a Tang Dynasty court dancer performing in the grand hall of a magnificent ancient Chinese palace at night. A beautiful woman dressed in elegant {argument name="costume color" default="Black and gold color scheme"} A woman in a silk ballet dress stands in the center of the frame, striking a dramatic dance pose. Shot from an extremely low angle with a slightly wide-angle lens, the image creates an immersive and grand visual effect. Her costume is embroidered with dense, metallic gold patterns, layered with semi-transparent fabric, a high slit revealing an outstretched leg, long, sheer sleeves, and a wide, flowing silk veil sweeping outwards in two huge arcs, creating a strong sense of movement. She wears exquisite gold accessories, well-fitting gold ballet shoes, and her long black hair is styled in an updo adorned with dangling ornaments, topped with a magnificent gold headdress. Her makeup is refined and noble. The palace interior is spacious and luxurious, with tall red wooden pillars, dark carved beams, two large lanterns hanging overhead, a luminous ceremonial backdrop, and a huge calligraphic plaque hanging high behind her. In the softly blurred background, several attendants and musicians, including at least six visible figures, are arranged at the back and sides of the hall. The lighting is dramatic and cinematic, employing warm amber lantern light, golden highlights on clothing, soft shadow transitions, subtle mist, depth-of-field effects, and slight motion blur from rotating fabrics. Highly detailed textures, realistic skin rendering, rich contrast, a luxurious atmosphere, the grandeur of ancient Chinese palaces, and widescreen composition further enhance the experience.{argument name="aspect ratio" default="16:9"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 一个电影级、超写实的场景，描绘了一位唐朝宫廷舞者在夜晚宏伟的中国古代宫殿大厅内表演。一位美丽的女子身着优雅的 {argument name="costume color" default="黑金配色"} 丝绸舞裙，站在画面中央，摆出极具戏剧性的舞蹈姿势。采用极低角度拍摄，配合略微广角的镜头，营造出沉浸式且宏大的视觉效果。她的服装上绣有密集的金属质感金色图案，并配有层叠的半透明面料、高开叉设计露出一条伸展的腿、长长的透明袖子，以及向外扫出两道巨大弧线的宽大飘逸丝绸面纱，营造出强烈的动感。她佩戴着精致的金色配饰，穿着合脚的金色舞鞋，长长的黑发盘起并饰有垂坠的饰品，戴着华丽的金色头饰。她的妆容精致且高贵。宫殿内部宽敞奢华，高大的红色木柱、深色的雕花横梁、头顶悬挂着两盏大灯笼、发光的仪式背景，以及她身后高处悬挂着一块巨大的书法牌匾。在柔和模糊的背景中，有几位侍从和乐师，包括至少 6 个可见的人物，排列在大厅的后方和侧边。灯光具有戏剧性和电影感，采用温暖的琥珀色灯笼光、服装上的金色高光、柔和的阴影过渡、微妙的薄雾、景深效果，以及旋转面料带来的轻微运动模糊。高度精细的纹理、逼真的皮肤渲染、丰富的对比度、奢华的氛围、中国古代宫殿的宏伟感、宽银幕构图，{argument name="aspect ratio" default="16:9"}。

promptLocalized.zh: 一位电影感、超写实的 {argument name="dynasty period" default="唐代"} 宫廷舞者在夜晚的宏伟中国古代宫殿大厅内表演。一位美丽的女子站在画面中央，呈现出动态的舞蹈姿态，身体转动，一只手臂高高举起，另一只手臂横扫过躯干，两条长长的半透明丝绸水袖在空中划出戏剧性的弧线，长袍下摆在脚边散开。她身着优雅的 {argument name="costume colors" default="黑金配色"} 丝绸舞衣，饰有精致的刺绣，紧身胸衣上布满华丽的金色图案，裙摆层叠飘逸，深色外层织物带有细腻的金属光泽，内衬浅色袖口，并配有精致的金色饰品。她的发型是正式的盘发，佩戴着华丽的 {argument name="headpiece style" default="金凤冠"}，妆容精致，尽显高贵的历史气质。场景采用低角度、略带广角的镜头拍摄，营造出沉浸式的电影视角。宫殿内部前景和中景处有 4 根巨大的红棕色木柱，地面摆放着发光的灯笼、烛台，横梁雕刻精美，舞者身后垂挂着帷幔，两侧是格子窗，整个空间充满了温暖的琥珀色实用光。在柔和虚化的背景中，共展示 6 位次要人物：后方中央坐着 2 位乐师，两侧站着 4 位侍从。光影效果具有戏剧性和电影感，带有温暖的金色高光、柔和的阴影、微妙的薄雾以及从右侧射入的体积光，呈现出真实的皮肤和织物纹理、浅景深、袖口处轻微的动态模糊、丰富的对比度以及奢华的历史氛围。宽银幕 {argument name="aspect ratio" default="16:9"} 构图，主体居中，细节丰富，照片级真实感。

templates.title: Retro-style bedroom at night

titleLocalized.zh: 复古怀旧风格的夜晚卧室

templates.prompt: A cinematic, vintage-style bedroom nighttime photograph, taken at bedside level. In the left foreground is a worn wooden bed with a dark headboard, covered with a faded patchwork quilt, and two floral-patterned pillows neatly stacked at the head of the bed. The walls, stained, cracked, and weathered in warm ochre stucco, give the room a sense of age and slight decay. A framed vintage street scene hangs on the upper left wall, and a dark shoulder bag hangs on a hook in the center. Beside the bed is a small wooden bedside table with a round lampshade lamp casting a warm yellow glow, creating soft amber light and deep shadows. Five items are clearly visible on the table: a red cylindrical jar, a small square container, a shallow cup or ashtray, a small round alarm clock, and the lamp itself. Below the bedside table is a cluttered open shelf. To the right is a tall, old window with a dark wooden frame overlooking a deep blue night scene, with a few faint lights visible in the distance; the thin, worn curtains are half-drawn. Three items are clearly visible on the windowsill: a tall ceramic vase, a dark glass bottle, and a vintage black and silver radio/cassette player. To the lower right is a small stool or low table covered with newspapers, with more newspapers piled below. The overall lighting should contrast the understated warm tungsten light from inside with the cool blue night outside, creating a strong film grain, soft focus, rich shadows, a nostalgic realism style, and a subtle dustiness, evoking the atmosphere of a quiet, solitary apartment from the late 1970s or 1980s.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满电影感的复古卧室夜晚照片，视角处于床头高度。左侧前景是一张破旧的木床，配有深色床头板，覆盖着褪色的拼布被子，床头整齐地堆放着 2 个花卉图案枕头。墙壁是带有污渍、裂纹和岁月痕迹的暖赭色灰泥墙，赋予房间一种久居且略显荒废的质感。左上方的墙上挂着 1 幅复古街景画框，中间墙壁的挂钩上挂着 1 个深色单肩包。床边是一个小木制床头柜，上面摆放着 1 盏散发着暖黄色光芒的圆形灯罩台灯，在房间内投射出柔和的琥珀色光影和深邃的阴影。桌面上清晰可见 5 件物品：1 个红色圆柱形罐子、1 个小型方形容器、1 个浅口杯或烟灰缸、1 个小型圆形闹钟，以及台灯本身。床头柜下方是一个杂乱的开放式搁板。右侧是一扇高大的旧窗户，深色木质窗框外是深蓝色的夜景，远处隐约可见几点模糊的灯光；窗帘质地轻薄且磨损，半拉着。窗台上清晰可见 3 件物品：1 个高大的陶瓷瓶、1 个深色玻璃瓶和 1 台复古黑银色收音机卡带播放机。右下方有 1 张铺着报纸的小凳子或矮桌，下方还堆放着更多报纸。整体光影应为低调的室内钨丝暖光与室外冷蓝夜色形成对比，带有浓重的胶片颗粒感、柔焦效果、丰富的阴影、怀旧写实风格、细微的灰尘感，营造出 20 世纪 70 年代末或 80 年代安静、孤独公寓的氛围。

templates.title: Interior of a retro Chinese general store

titleLocalized.zh: 复古中国杂货铺内景

templates.prompt: A nostalgic photograph of the interior of an old-fashioned Chinese grocery store, taken from a customer's perspective with a slightly wide-angle composition. The image presents warm sepia and amber tones, with soft window light streaming in from the left, creating a delicate film grain, subtle vignetting, and a slightly hazy, vintage feel. Behind a long, dark wood glass counter stands the shop owner, a woman with a short black bob, wearing a plain white short-sleeved shirt, turned sideways to the camera, busy at the counter. The shop's atmosphere is authentic, simple, and full of life, as if transported to the late 1970s to the 1990s. On the upper right shelf sits a black vintage sewing machine, next to a handwritten Chinese price tag that reads "768 yuan." Behind it, the shelves are piled high with various small, colorful boxes and tin cans. On the wall hangs a large, vertical handwritten Chinese price list and two old paper calendars or posters. The foreground glass display case showcases a variety of vintage-packaged goods: piles of colorful tin cans and glass bottles, several rectangular illustrated tin cans, two patterned enamel washbasins, and several pairs of plain white canvas shoes arranged side-by-side on the bottom shelf. On the left side of the image, bright wooden-framed windows and more cluttered countertops create a striking contrast between the sunlight and the dim interior. The composition emphasizes a realistic documentary style, richly textured wood, aged surfaces, retro packaging design, a tranquil everyday atmosphere, and a layout that guides the eye from the shop owner in the center left to the sewing machine and shelves in the upper right corner.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满怀旧电影感的中国老式杂货铺内景照片，以顾客视角拍摄，采用略微广角的构图。画面呈现温暖的棕褐色和琥珀色调，左侧透入柔和的窗光，带有细腻的胶片颗粒感、淡淡的暗角以及轻微朦胧的复古质感。在长条形的深色木质玻璃柜台后，站着一位店主，她是一位留着黑色短波波头的女性，身穿素色白色短袖衬衫，侧身对着镜头，正在柜台上忙碌。店铺氛围真实、朴素且充满生活气息，仿佛置身于 20 世纪 70 年代末至 90 年代。右侧上方货架上摆放着一台黑色复古缝纫机，旁边立着一张手写的中文价格牌，上面写着“768元”。其后方的货架上堆满了各种小型彩色商品盒和铁罐。墙上挂着 1 张大型竖式手写中文价目表和 2 张旧纸质日历或海报。前景的玻璃柜中陈列着许多旧式包装商品：成堆的彩色铁罐和玻璃瓶、几个长方形插画铁罐、2 个印有花纹的搪瓷洗脸盆，以及底层货架上并排摆放的多双素色白色帆布鞋。画面左侧可见明亮的木框窗户和更多柜台杂物，形成了阳光与昏暗室内之间的强烈对比。强调写实的纪录片摄影风格、纹理丰富的木材、陈旧的表面、复古包装设计、宁静的日常氛围，以及引导视线从左中部的店主延伸至右上角缝纫机和货架的构图。

templates.title: The Incredible Infinite Golden Library

titleLocalized.zh: 不可思议的无限黄金图书馆

templates.prompt: A name{argument name="location name" default="Infinite Echoes Library"} The magnificent, palatial library boasts an incredible interior structure. The footage is shot using a cinematic ultra-wide-angle lens.{argument name="lens" default="8mm linear lens"} From an architectural photography perspective, the composition is perfectly centered and symmetrical. The scene showcases a vast central nave extending towards an unreachable vanishing point, flanked by towering black marble and gilded columns. Densely stacked bookshelves are piled high with ancient leather-bound books; the walls are made of marble with white veins, niches are inlaid with classical statues, adorned with ornate gold details, and hanging lanterns emit a warm glow. In the center of the foreground stands a solitary figure in a dark robe, his back to a huge reading table with a large, open book and small academic instruments, emphasizing the grandeur and awe of the space. The polished black stone floor reflects like a mirror, amplifying the columns and the golden light. A huge beam of amber sunlight pours down from above and from an invisible height on the upper walls, filling the hall with a bright haze of light, dust particles, and a sacred volumetric light. The architectural style should exhibit extremely high detail, Baroque, sacredness, and physically impossible qualities, with endless vertical repetition, intricate ornamentation, surreal depth, and a dreamlike sense of infinity. The color palette is dominated by molten gold, bronze, black marble, ivory, and warm candlelight highlights. The rendering effect is an epic, realistic fantasy architectural visualization, with extremely rich, clear, magnificent, immersive, and breathtaking details.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个名为 {argument name="location name" default="无限回响图书馆"} 的宏伟宫殿式图书馆，其内部结构不可思议。画面采用电影级超广角 {argument name="lens" default="8mm 直线镜头"} 建筑摄影视角，构图完美居中且对称。场景展示了一个向无法触及的消失点延伸的巨大中央中殿，两侧是高耸入云的黑色大理石与镀金圆柱，密集的层叠书架上堆满了古老的皮装书籍；墙面为带有白色纹理的大理石，壁龛中镶嵌着古典雕像，饰有华丽的金色细节，悬挂的灯笼散发着温暖的光芒。在前景正中央，站着 1 位身披深色长袍的孤独人物，背影对着一张巨大的阅览桌，桌上放着 1 本巨大的打开的书籍和小型学术仪器，突显出空间的宏大与震撼。抛光的黑色石质地面如镜面般反射，将圆柱与金色的光芒加倍呈现。巨大的琥珀色阳光束从上方及上层墙壁不可见的高处倾泻而下，使大厅充满了明亮的光雾、尘埃微粒和神圣的体积光。建筑风格应呈现出超高细节、巴洛克式、神圣感且物理上不可能的特质，具有无尽的垂直重复、复杂的装饰、超现实的深度以及梦幻般的无限感。色调以熔金、青铜、黑色大理石、象牙石及温暖的烛光高光为主。渲染效果为史诗级写实奇幻建筑可视化，细节极其丰富、清晰、宏伟、沉浸感强且令人叹为观止。

templates.title: Futuristic Animation Industry Magazine Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 未来感动画行业杂志封面

templates.prompt: Create a futuristic, professional magazine cover for the animation industry, featuring a vertical composition, high-end editorial design, and a cinematic, sophisticated feel. The magazine masthead is located in the upper left corner, using a large, bold white sans-serif font arranged in two lines.{argument name="magazine title" default="FRAME RATE"} Above is a line of yellow, all-caps slogan: THE INDUSTRY TRADE MAGAZINE FOR ANIMATION PROFESSIONALS. Below the masthead is a smaller, white subtitle: THE BUSINESS, TECHNOLOGY & ART OF ANIMATION. In the upper right corner, there is stacked, bold issue number information: yellow VOL. 23 and white SUMMER 2026. The cover features a stylized female humanoid robot or digital model in a dynamic running pose, facing right, full-body shot, one leg raised behind and one arm outstretched. Her body is a semi-transparent dark mesh, with internal joints, spine, and limb structures emitting orange light, complemented by blue and purple neon tracking lines, and circular halos of motion surrounding her wrists, ankles, hips, and feet. She has messy blue hair in a bun, and her face is smooth and simplified with minimal features, like a CG character prototype. Place her inside a dimly lit animation studio, with blurred monitors, desks, and concept art pinned to the walls in the background, using low-key, emotional ambient lighting to make the neon-effect character the visual focus. Add reflective flooring under her feet, with concentric holographic rings of green, yellow, and orange beneath her feet. To the left, an editorial cover title is arranged in a neat magazine layout. A small yellow label reads "COVER STORY." Below is a large, bold, white stacked title:{argument name="cover headline" default="PIPELINES THAT LEARN. STORIES THAT MOVE."} Below the title is a yellow subtitle: HOW AI IS TRANSFORMING EVERY STAGE OF ANIMATION PRODUCTION. In the lower left corner, three secondary articles are listed, each with a short yellow line above it: 1) INBETWEENING 2.0, with a small white lead: Inside the new generation of AI Inbetweening models changing the industry standard, and a yellow page number (p. 24). 2) CONSISTENCY AT SCALE, with a small white lead: Maintaining character performance with AI-assisted interpolation, and a yellow page number (p. 38). 3) ARTIST ORCHARD, NOT REPLACEMENT, with a small white lead: How top studios integrate AI tools while keeping artists in the loop, and a yellow page number (p. 52). Near the bottom right corner, add a black circular badge with a yellow outline containing yellow and white text: "WORKFLOW SPOTLIGHT" at the top, "DreamFrame Studios on building a proprietary AI animation stack" in the middle, and "p. 60" in yellow at the bottom. In the bottom right corner, place a white barcode frame with the price listed above: US $12.99 EUR €14.99, along with a few issue numbers. The color scheme uses black, charcoal gray, white, bright yellow, electric orange, blue, and purple. The overall feel should be high-end, forward-thinking, technically proficient, and credible, like the cover of a genuine AI-driven animation pipeline industry magazine.

STORIES THAT MOVE."}。标题下方是一个黄色副标题：HOW AI IS TRANSFORMING EVERY STAGE OF ANIMATION PRODUCTION。在左下角，列出 3 篇次要文章，每篇上方都有一条短黄色横线：1) INBETWEENING 2.0，配有白色小字导语：Inside the new generation of AI Inbetweening models changing the industry standard.，以及黄色的页码 p. 24。2) CONSISTENCY AT SCALE，配有白色小字导语：Maintaining character performance with AI-assisted interpolation.，以及黄色的页码 p. 38。3) ARTIST ORCHARD, NOT REPLACEMENT，配有白色小字导语：How top studios integrate AI tools while keeping artists in the loop.，以及黄色的页码 p. 52。在右下角附近，添加一个带有黄色轮廓的黑色圆形徽章，内含黄色和白色文字：顶部为 WORKFLOW SPOTLIGHT，中间为 DreamFrame Studios on building a proprietary AI animation stack，底部为黄色的 p. 60。在右下角，放置一个白色条形码框，上方标注价格：US $12.99 EUR €14.99，以及少量期数代码。配色方案采用黑色、炭灰色、白色、鲜黄色、电光橙、蓝色和紫色。整体感觉应高端、前瞻、精通技术且具有公信力，如同真实的 AI 驱动动画流水线行业杂志封面。

templates.title: Taoist Three Souls and Seven Spirits Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 道教三魂七魄海报

templates.prompt: A highly detailed vertical poster of Taoist metaphysics, printed in the style of an ancient Chinese religious scroll on aged beige Xuan paper, features exquisite decorative borders, ink calligraphy, faded stains, and classical chart annotations. At the top center, a striking title in black brush calligraphy reads:{argument name="headline text" default="Tao - Three Souls and Seven Spirits"} Below the title is a passage of classical Chinese text written in neat calligraphy. The composition is perfectly symmetrical, with a vertical spiritual axis at the center composed of platinum-gold energy, clouds, and lightning-like "qi" flows, extending from the bottom of the page to the celestial realm. At the very top, in the golden celestial realm above the axis, three Taoist immortals or deities are depicted seated on clouds, arranged to the left, center, and right, with halos and wearing soft green, cream, and blue robes. Below them is a towering, multi-layered cosmic body diagram composed of nine stacked circular domains or platforms, connected by swirling clouds and luminous energy. The five larger domains above represent the five internal organs, presented as miniature mythological landscapes: a forest-green domain representing the liver/wood, a fiery red-gold temple-city domain representing the heart/fire, a terraced yellow earth domain representing the spleen/earth, a silver-blue landscape domain representing the lungs/metal, and a deep blue underwater abyss domain representing the kidneys/water. At the central connection between the upper visceral realm and the lower spiritual realm, place a figure meditating within a bright sphere of light. Below these, add seven gradually darkening, underworld-like circular realms, each corresponding to one of the seven spirits. Each realm is densely filled with miniature scenes of humans, spirits, wild beasts, sacrificial rituals, suffering, temptation, conflict, and karmic symbols, surrounded by drifting smoke and energy bands. At the very bottom, display a human figure meditating in a root-like cave or physical pedestal, surrounded by chains, rocks, and worldly ties. Around the central pillar are nine labeled side panels and charts in traditional Chinese typography: the upper left corner features a circular diagram of the Bagua and Yin-Yang universe; the upper right corner displays a dotted chart of destiny or astrology; the upper left corner contains a list of the Three Souls; the upper right corner contains a list of the Seven Spirits; the middle left corner shows a diagram of the Five Elements with five colored nodes; the middle right corner shows a diagram of the circulation of essence, energy, and spirit with three nodes; the lower left corner contains a vertical list of seven categories or stages; the lower right corner contains a correspondence table; the lower left corner shows a diagram of the relationship between the Five Directions and the Five Elements in the human body; and the lower right corner shows a diagram of the meridians or human body for standing and meditation. Small Chinese labels are used extensively throughout, and each section is stamped with a red classical seal. The overall color scheme is a combination of rustic parchment, dark brown ink, soft jade, vermilion red, smoky gray, gold, cyan, and indigo. The style should present a museum-quality Taoist metaphysical chart texture, extremely complex, combining meticulous brushwork with ink wash, with a strong sense of sacredness, mystery, and academic atmosphere, full of symbolism, extremely delicate lines, and softly layered clouds, making it a high-resolution poster design.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张细节极其丰富的竖版道教玄学信息图海报，采用中国古代宗教卷轴风格，印在做旧的米色宣纸上，配有精美的装饰边框、水墨书法、褪色的污渍以及古典图表注释。顶部中央，醒目的黑色毛笔书法标题写着 {argument name="headline text" default="道·三魂七魄"}。标题正下方是一段用工整书法书写的古典中文说明文字。构图完美对称，中心是一条由白金色能量、云雾和闪电般的“气”流组成的垂直灵性轴线，从页面底部一直延伸至天界。最上方，轴线之上的金色天界中，描绘了 3 位坐在云端的道教仙人或神祇，呈左、中、右排列，带有光环，身着柔和的绿色、奶油色和蓝色长袍。在他们下方，创作一个高耸的多层宇宙身体图，由 9 个堆叠的圆形领域或平台组成，通过缭绕的云雾和发光的能量连接。上方的 5 个较大领域代表五脏，表现为微缩的神话景观：1 个代表肝/木的森林绿色领域，1 个代表心/火的火红金色寺庙城市领域，1 个代表脾/土的带有梯田的黄色大地领域，1 个代表肺/金的银蓝色山水领域，以及 1 个代表肾/水的深蓝色水底深渊领域。在上方脏腑领域与下方灵性层之间的中心连接处，放置一个处于明亮光球中打坐的人物形象。在这些下方，增加 7 个颜色渐深、类似冥界的圆形领域，分别对应七魄，每个领域都密布着人类、灵体、野兽、祭祀活动、苦难、诱惑、冲突和业力象征的微小场景，并被飘动的烟雾和能量带所环绕。最底部，展示一个在根状洞穴或肉体基座中打坐的人类形象，周围环绕着锁链、岩石和世俗的羁绊。在中心柱周围，包含 9 个采用传统中文排版的标注侧面板和图表：左上角为八卦与阴阳宇宙圆图；右上角为点状命理或星象图；左上方为三魂列表框；右上方为七魄列表框；左中部为带有 5 个彩色节点的五行关系图；右中部为带有 3 个节点的精气神循环图；左下部为 7 个类别或阶段的竖排列表框；右下部为对应关系表；左下角为五方与五行人体关系图；右下角为站立与打坐的经络或修炼人体图。在各个部分大量使用小型中文标签，并盖有红色的古典印章。整体色调为古朴羊皮纸色、深褐色水墨、柔和玉色、朱砂红、烟灰色、金色、青色和靛蓝色。风格应呈现出博物馆级的道教形而上学图表质感，极其复杂，采用工笔画与水墨渲染相结合，神圣、神秘、学术气息浓厚，充满象征意义，线条极其细腻，云层叠染柔和，是高分辨率的海报设计。

templates.title: Miniature City Weather Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 微缩城市天气海报

templates.prompt: A vertical weather poster for smartphones, with the theme of{argument name="city name" default="Chengdu"} The design style is a dreamlike, ultra-detailed miniature 3D city landscape against a bright blue sky. At the top center, a striking white, bold Chinese city name is placed, with a soft 3D depth and subtle shadow effect. Directly below the name, a rounded, fluffy white cloud icon is placed in the center. Below the icon, a smaller line of white text is added.{argument name="date text" default="Wednesday, April 22, 2026"} This is followed by a larger line of bold white text displaying the temperature.{argument name="temperature text" default="28° / 18°"} Finally, add a centered line of white weather text.{argument name="condition text" default="partly cloudy"} Maintain all text vertically stacked, evenly spaced, and neatly centered in the upper half of the image. In the lower half, create a captivating city blending traditional Chinese water town architecture with a modern skyline: tranquil turquoise canals encircle small islands, with two small arched stone bridges in the foreground, a pavilion on the island to the left, a tall, multi-tiered pagoda near the center to the right, traditional gray-tiled houses and shops scattered throughout, outdoor tea tables with parasols, lush willows, shrubs, flowers, and several small boats on the water. The distant view showcases a modern skyline, featuring numerous glass skyscrapers and a prominent needle-shaped observation tower. Scatter exactly five soft cumulus clouds across the sky (including the central weather icon area), and add a few birds for added life. Employ warm morning light, cinematic atmospheric perspective, shallow depth of field, tilt-shift miniature aesthetics, highly realistic textures, delicate water reflections, and a sophisticated yet whimsical travel poster atmosphere. Keep the composition simple, leave ample sky space at the top, and concentrate the miniature city at the bottom to present the effect of a high-end weather application's home screen image.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张适用于智能手机的竖版天气海报，主题为 {argument name="city name" default="成都"}，设计风格为梦幻般、超精细的微缩立体模型城市景观，背景为明亮的蓝天。在顶部中心位置，放置醒目的白色粗体中文城市名称，带有柔和的 3D 深度感和轻微的投影效果。在名称正下方，居中放置一个由圆润造型构成的蓬松白色云朵图标。图标下方，添加一行较小的白色文本显示 {argument name="date text" default="2026-04-22 星期三"}，接着是一行较大的白色粗体温度文本 {argument name="temperature text" default="28° / 18°"}，最后再添加一行居中的白色天气状况文本 {argument name="condition text" default="多云"}。保持所有文本垂直堆叠、间距均匀，并整齐地居中于图像上半部分。在下半部分，打造一个融合了中国传统水乡建筑与现代天际线的迷人城市：平静的绿松石色运河环绕着小岛，前景有 2 座小型拱形石桥，左侧岛屿上有一座凉亭，右侧中心附近有一座高大的多层宝塔，错落有致的灰瓦传统民居和店面，摆放着遮阳伞的户外茶桌，茂密的柳树、灌木、花卉以及水面上几艘小船。远景处展示现代化的天际线，包含许多玻璃摩天大楼和 1 座显眼的针状观光塔。在天空中散布恰好 5 朵柔和的积云（包含中央天气图标区域），并添加几只小鸟增添生机。采用温暖的晨光、电影级的空气透视感、浅景深、移轴微缩摄影美学、高度逼真的材质、水面细腻的倒影，以及精致且充满奇趣的旅游海报氛围。保持构图简洁，上方留出充足的天空空间，微缩城市集中在底部，呈现出高端天气应用首屏图像的效果。
