templates.title: Epic Fantasy Double Exposure Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 史诗奇幻双重曝光海报

templates.prompt: An epic fantasy poster with a vertical composition, designed in the style of high-end TV series flyer posters.{argument name="franchise title" default="game of Thrones"} This is a Chinese cinema promotional poster. The main composition is a left-facing silhouette of a woman occupying most of the image space, using a dramatic double exposure effect. Her braided hair forms the top outline of the silhouette. Inside and around the silhouette, a grand, dark medieval fantasy world is incorporated, including storm clouds, smoke, mountains, castles, dragons, armies, and flames. Above the head area, a magnificent stone city or castle complex is placed, radiating a pale golden light beneath turbulent clouds; three dragons are depicted in the sky: a large dragon flies prominently in the upper right corner, and two smaller dragons are near the top edge. In the center, two fur-clad heroes are shown huddled together in a desolate winter atmosphere, one in the center and the other slightly to the left, with a structure resembling the Iron Throne faintly visible behind them. In the lower right corner, a lord of the dead with icy blue eyes emerges from the darkness. In the lower half, the landscape transitions from the cold mist and coastal waters on the left to the burning ruins and orange flames on the right, with a medium-sized dragon flying across the lower-middle area above the battlefield. Tiny marching soldiers and cavalry are scattered along the ridges and paths, suggesting a war that traverses the land. The design utilizes soft hues of gray-white, charcoal black, slate blue, steel gray, dark brown, and ember orange, featuring cinematic high contrast, volumetric fog, a painterly photo-collage-like realistic style, and intricate textural details. Negative space is left around the silhouettes against a warm, off-white paper background. Vertical Chinese slogans are added to the upper left edge.{argument name="vertical slogan" default="The legend never ends before the storm arrives."} Add a small English logo area on the left, with the text:{argument name="series logo" default="GAME OF THRONES"} Place a prominent Chinese title near the bottom left corner.{argument name="main title" default="A Song of Ice and Fire"} Below this is the English subtitle "A SONG OF ICE AND FIRE". Below that is the author's signature in small print: George R.R. Martin. At the bottom are the five family crests arranged horizontally, each with a bilingual label: Stark, Lannister, Targaryen, Baratheon, and Tarly. Below them are slogans.{argument name="bottom tagline" default="There are seven kingdoms, but only one throne."} A sophisticated, melancholic, grand, and highly collectible poster design.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张竖构图的史诗奇幻海报，采用高端电视系列剧单页海报风格，设计参考 {argument name="franchise title" default="权力的游戏"} 的中国院线宣传海报。构图主体为一个占据画面大部分空间的女性左侧面剪影，采用戏剧性的双重曝光效果，其编织的发辫构成了剪影的顶部轮廓。在剪影内部及周围，融合一个宏大的暗黑中世纪奇幻世界，包含风暴云层、烟雾、山脉、城堡、巨龙、军队和火焰。在头部区域上方，放置 1 座宏伟的石城或城堡建筑群，在动荡的云层下散发着苍白的金光；天空中绘有 3 条巨龙：1 条大型巨龙在右上角显眼飞行，另有 2 条较小的巨龙在顶部边缘附近。在中部，展示 2 位身披皮草的英雄人物在凄凉的冬季氛围中紧靠在一起，一人居中，另一人略微偏左，身后隐约可见类似铁王座的结构。在右下角内部，包含 1 位从黑暗中浮现的冰蓝色眼睛的亡灵之王。在下半部分，从左侧的冷雾和沿海水域过渡到右侧燃烧的废墟与橙色火焰，在战场上方的中下区域有 1 条中型巨龙飞过。沿山脊和路径散布微小的行军士兵和骑兵，以暗示横跨大地的战争。使用灰白、炭黑、板岩蓝、钢灰、深褐色和余烬橙的柔和色调，具备电影级高对比度、体积雾、绘画感照片拼贴写实风格以及错综复杂的纹理细节。在温暖的米白色纸质背景上，剪影周围留出负空间。在左上边缘添加竖排中文标语 {argument name="vertical slogan" default="风暴降临前 传奇永不终结"}。在左侧添加一个小型的英文 Logo 区域，文字为 {argument name="series logo" default="GAME OF THRONES"}。在左下角附近放置一个醒目的中文大标题 {argument name="main title" default="冰与火之歌"}，下方附带英文副标题 "A SONG OF ICE AND FIRE"。在下方添加原著作者 George R. R. Martin 的小字署名。底部横向排列 5 个家族族徽，并附带双语标签：Stark（史塔克）、Lannister（兰尼斯特）、Targaryen（坦格利安）、Baratheon（拜拉席恩）、Tarly（塔利）。在它们下方，添加标语 {argument name="bottom tagline" default="七大王国，唯有一座王座。"}。高级、忧郁、宏伟、极具收藏价值的海报设计。

templates.title: Pastel AI Assistant Anime Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: Pastel AI Assistant 动漫肖像

templates.prompt: A dreamlike, anime-style portrait depicting a gentle virtual assistant girl named {argument name="character name" default="Misha"} She was curled up in a comfortable, futuristic bedroom, surrounded by translucent holographic memory screens. She had very long, silver-white hair with a subtle lavender hue, styled into two low pigtails tied with delicate lavender ribbons, complemented by soft, wispy bangs and flowing strands. Her expression was gentle, introspective, and slightly lonely, with a soft sheen and delicate features. She wore an oversized chunky knit cardigan in a color that was…{argument name="cardigan color" default="Light lavender"} She sat with her knees drawn up to her chest, arms wrapped around her legs, creating a fragile and intimate silhouette. The room was filled with a soft, pale purple and pink ambient light, accompanied by shimmering lights, dust-like specks, and a nostalgic, magical, technological atmosphere. Around her were five visible holographic interface panels: two floating photo panels in the upper left, displaying soft memories; a panel labeled "Memory Fragments" in the lower left, with small images and tiny chart bars; a large profile panel on the right, containing the Japanese characters "ミーシャ・Misha" and "あなたの専属AIアシスタント"; and a smaller list panel with heart-shaped icons on the right. On the table to the right sits a glowing crystal ball and a white mug bearing the word "Misha" and a heart pattern. Underneath the table are two stacked books, and a plush cat cushion sits in the lower left corner. The composition is vertical, using a full-body to three-quarters seated pose. templates.title: Alishan Day Trip Travel Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 阿里山一日游旅行海报

templates.prompt: Create a retro-style illustration travel poster in traditional Chinese characters for use in {argument name="destination name" default="Alishan National Scenic Area"} The design features a vertically divided layout for a day trip infographic. The left panel is a parchment-textured itinerary card in a warm beige tone, bordered with a luxurious gold Art Nouveau style and in dark brown font; the right panel is a dramatic, fantasy-realist-style map showcasing a mountain journey under the hues of sunrise and sunset. At the top of the left panel, the large title text reads:{argument name="headline text" default="Alishan National Scenic Area Day Trip"} Below is a centered traditional Chinese tagline: "One mountain, five classic sights. An unforgettable and fantastic journey," accompanied by a small decorative mountain divider. The left panel must contain five vertically arranged numbered itinerary stations, each with a black and gold circular number badge, a small illustration, a bold location name, a time in parentheses, and a brief Chinese description. The five stations are: 1. "Alishan Station" at 8:00 AM, featuring an illustration of a wooden mountain train station, described as "Embark on a journey to explore sacred trees and forests." 2. "Alishan Forest Railway" at 9:30 AM, featuring an illustration of a red and black steam train, described as "Traverse the forest and experience the charm of a century-old forest railway." 3. "Sacred Tree Area Boardwalk" at 11:30 AM, featuring an illustration of giant cedar trees and an elevated wooden boardwalk, described as "Stroll under ancient trees and feel the spirit of the forest." 4. "Sister Lakes" at 1:30 PM, featuring an illustration of tranquil forest lakes and pavilions, described as "Enjoy the serene lake views and listen to the symphony of nature." 5. "Ogasawara Mountain Observatory" at 4:00 PM, featuring an illustration of a wooden observation deck at sunset above a sea of ​​clouds, described as "View the magnificent mountain scenery and sea of ​​clouds, and enjoy the sunset." The right panel should depict a continuous, golden, glowing path winding through the five stations in the same order as the labels on the left. The map features numbered markers in black and gold, labeled: 1 "Alishan Station", 2 "Alishan Forest Railway", 3 "Shenmu Boardwalk", 4 "Sister Lakes", and 5 "Ogasawara Mountain Observatory". Station 1 is depicted as a rustic wooden mountain station perched on a pine cliff; Station 2 as a small steam locomotive traveling on a winding mountain railway, its smoke rising upwards; Station 3 as a towering ancient red cypress tree, its trunk surrounded by a spiraling, zigzagging wooden boardwalk; Station 4 as an emerald-green lake surrounded by dense forest, complete with a small pavilion and an arched bridge; and Station 5 as a mountain observation deck above a sea of ​​clouds, facing a magnificent sunset. The environment should evoke layered mountains, misty valleys, evergreen forests, the golden hour light and shadow, luminous clouds, and an atmosphere rich in romantic, painterly detail. Add a decorative compass with N, E, S, W labels in the lower right corner, along with a dark green and gold information box containing two statistics in Traditional Chinese: "Total distance ~9 km / 5.6 mi" and "Estimated time: All day - 14,500 steps". Overall style: high-end travel poster, painterly digital illustrations, nostalgic national park guidebook aesthetics, high detail, warm sepia and gold accents, elegant composition, clear Chinese text, and a vertical 2:3 poster ratio.

templates.prompt: An exquisitely designed vertical infographic poster, employing an elegant East Asian editorial style, uses the fire sign as its theme and features the same female character showcasing three different outfits. The background has a creamy parchment texture, adorned with delicate decorative borders, corner patterns, subtle glitter, and warm red, orange, and gold accents throughout. A prominent Chinese title is displayed at the top.{argument name="headline text" default="List of Zodiac Signs | Fire Signs"} A smaller subtitle is provided below.{argument name="subheading text" default="Passion, Action, Courage"} The top right corner is decorated with a flame icon. The layout consists of three vertically stacked profile panels, each with rounded rectangular borders and ample white space: Aries at the top, Leo in the middle, and Sagittarius at the bottom. Each panel is visually divided into left and right sections: the left side displays the character image, and the right side contains text/attribute areas. The far left features a constellation symbol badge, and the far right features a small constellation chart. All three panels use the same young East Asian woman image: slender, with long hair tied in a high ponytail. The image is framed from the thighs to the waist, with her face slightly turned towards the camera, presenting a fashion model-like constellation character design. The facial features are kept neutral and delicate, using clean beauty lighting to create a soft, composite illustration and photographic texture. Panel 1: Aries. Chinese title and English subtitle: "Aries". Main color: vibrant red with warm coral highlights. The constellation symbol badge displays the Aries symbol. The right side features a constellation chart. There are subtle circular mystical line art and flame patterns behind the character. Clothing: Sporty warrior idol style, wearing a white crop top, a red short-sleeved cardigan with gold trim, a red belt, and red wristbands or fingerless arm accessories. Pose: Confident and energetic, one fist raised near the shoulder, the other hand on the hip. Contains 6 lines of information, each preceded by a small circular icon, all in Chinese: 1) "Element: Fire" 2) "Concept: Ignitioner, Intuition First" 3) "Personality: Passionate, Direct, Competitive" 4) "Action Principle: Charge First, Correct Later" 5) "Romantic Tendencies: Pursues when attracted, enjoys intense interaction" 6) "Interpersonal Quirks: Will take over when the pace is too slow." Panel 2: Leo. Chinese title and English subtitle: "Leo". Main color scheme: Gold, champagne, and soft amber. The zodiac symbol badge displays the Leo symbol. The right side shows the zodiac chart. The background features a radiating sunbeam design, with a subtle silhouette of a majestic lion behind the character. Clothing: A magnificent court dress in light gold fabric, adorned with intricate embroidery, jeweled bodice details, flowing semi-transparent cape sleeves, an elegant necklace, and a small crown or headdress. Poise: Composed and regal, one hand lightly touching her chest or collarbone, shoulders relaxed, exuding confidence and star power. Contains 6 lines of information, each preceded by a small circular icon, all in Chinese: 1) "Element: Fire" 2) "Concept: Center stage, radiating light" 3) "Personality: Generous, confident, concerned with appearances" 4) "Principle of Action: Establish presence first, then lead the team forward" 5) "Romantic Tendencies: Enjoys being pampered and spoiled" 6) "Interpersonal Quirks: Pretends to be indifferent despite caring deeply." Panel 3: Sagittarius. Chinese title and English subtitle: "Sagittarius". Main color scheme: Rust red, burnt orange, brown leather, and warm ivory. A constellation emblem displays the Sagittarius symbol. A constellation diagram is on the right. The background features a subtle compass circle and flame decorations. Clothing: Explorer archer style, wearing an ivory shirt, red scarf, brown leather suspenders, a multi-functional belt, and arm guards. Pose: Dynamic archery pose, bow pointing to the right, with tiny glowing sparks on the bow handle or nock. Contains 6 lines of information, each preceded by a small circular icon, all in Chinese: 1) "Element: Fire" 2) "Concept: Free traveler, discovering as they go" 3) "Personality: Optimistic, frank, curious" 4) "Principle of Action: Start first, find the answers along the way" 5) "Romantic Tendencies: Prefers relaxed and sincere relationships, dislikes being tied down" 6) "Interpersonal Quirks: Often gets distracted by new things during conversations." The overall design should evoke a sense of sophistication, femininity, mystery, and collectability, much like the popular zodiac character list posters on social media. The main zodiac names should use elegant serif Chinese, while Aries, Leo, and Sagittarius should use italic calligraphic English. All text should remain clear, aligned, and easy to read. A small decorative flame emblem should be added near the bottom border. The aspect ratio should be 3:4 in portrait mode.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张精致的垂直信息图海报，采用优雅的东亚编辑风格，以火象星座为主题，通过同一位女性角色演绎三种不同的服饰造型。背景为奶油色羊皮纸质感，配有纤细的装饰边框、角落花纹、微小的闪光点以及贯穿全图的暖红、橙、金三色点缀。顶部有醒目的中文大标题 {argument name="headline text" default="十二星座角色清單｜火象星座"}，下方配有较小的副标题 {argument name="subheading text" default="熱情・行動・勇氣"}，右上角装饰有火焰图标。布局包含 3 个垂直堆叠的个人资料面板，面板带有圆角矩形边框和宽裕的留白：顶部为白羊座，中间为狮子座，底部为射手座。每个面板在视觉上分为左右两部分，左侧为角色形象，右侧为文字/属性区域，最左侧配有星座符号徽章，最右侧配有小型星座图。

所有 3 个面板均使用同一位年轻的东亚女性形象，身材苗条，留着长发并扎成高马尾，画面呈现从大腿到腰部以上的构图，面部略微朝向镜头，呈现出时尚模特般的星座角色设定感。保持面部特征中性且精致，采用干净的美容光效，呈现出柔和的插画与照片合成质感。

面板 1：白羊座。中文标题及英文副标题：“牡羊座 Aries”。主色调：鲜艳的红色，搭配暖珊瑚色高光。星座符号徽章显示白羊座符号。右侧为星座图。角色身后有淡淡的圆形神秘线条艺术和火焰图案。服装：运动型战士偶像风格，身穿白色露脐上衣，红色短袖开衫外套配金色镶边，红色腰带，以及红色护腕或露指手臂配饰。姿势：自信、充满活力，一只拳头举在肩部附近，另一只手叉腰。包含 6 行信息，每行前均有小型圆形图标，全部使用中文：1) “元素：火” 2) “概念：點火者，直覺先行” 3) “性格：熱情、直接、好勝” 4) “行動原則：先衝再修正” 5) “戀愛傾向：心動就追，喜歡熱烈互動” 6) “人際怪癖：嫌節奏太慢時會自己接手”。

面板 2：狮子座。中文标题及英文副标题：“獅子座 Leo”。主色调：金色、香槟色和柔和的琥珀色。星座符号徽章显示狮子座符号。右侧为星座图。背景包含放射状的太阳光芒造型，角色身后有淡淡的威严狮子剪影。服装：华丽的宫廷长裙，采用浅金色面料，配有繁复的刺绣、珠宝胸衣细节、飘逸的半透明斗篷袖、优雅的项链以及小皇冠或头饰。姿势：从容且具有女王范，一只手轻触胸口或锁骨，双肩舒展，展现出自信与明星气场。包含 6 行信息，每行前均有小型圆形图标，全部使用中文：1) “元素：火” 2) “概念：舞台中心，自帶光芒” 3) “性格：大方、自信、要面子” 4) “行動原則：先定氣場，再帶隊前進” 5) “戀愛傾向：喜歡被偏愛，也樂於寵人” 6) “人際怪癖：明明在意，卻要裝沒事”。

面板 3：射手座。中文标题及英文副标题：“射手座 Sagittarius”。主色调：铁锈红、焦橙色、棕色皮革和暖象牙色。星座符号徽章显示射手座符号。右侧为星座图。背景采用淡淡的指南针圆形图形和火焰装饰。服装：探险家弓箭手风格，身穿象牙色衬衫，红色围巾，棕色皮革背带，多功能腰带和护臂。姿势：动态射箭动作，弓箭指向右侧，弓把或箭托处带有微小的发光火花。包含 6 行信息，每行前均有小型圆形图标，全部使用中文：1) “元素：火” 2) “概念：自由旅人，邊走邊發現” 3) “性格：樂觀、坦率、好奇” 4) “行動原則：先出發，路上再找答案” 5) “戀愛傾向：喜歡輕鬆真誠，不愛被綁住” 6) “人際怪癖：聊到一半常被新鮮事帶走”。

整体设计应体现高端、女性化、神秘感和收藏价值，如同社交媒体上流行的星座角色清单海报。主星座名称使用优雅的衬线体中文，Aries、Leo 和 Sagittarius 使用斜体书法风格英文。保持所有文字清晰、对齐且易于阅读。在底部边框附近居中添加一个小型装饰性火焰徽章。纵横比为 3:4 竖屏。

templates.title: Poster for the Japan Space Science Conference

titleLocalized.zh: 日本空间科学会议海报

templates.prompt: A sophisticated poster for a Japanese event, employing a dramatic and aspiring sci-fi travel style, suitable for {argument name="event year" default="2026"} The year, vertical layout, features a deep blue space background contrasting beautifully with a bright daytime cityscape. The top displays an outer space scene, with a detailed view of Earth's orbit in the upper left corner, showing a dazzling solar halo around the planet's edge and a sky filled with dense stars and faint nebulae. At the center is a striking white, bold Japanese title, adorned with delicate gold accents and a powerful projection effect: "Cosmic Science and Technology Joint Lecture Series."{argument name="event year" default="2026"} Above the title is a smaller tagline: "To explore the future of the universe." Four precise space elements surround the title: a lunar lander landing on the left, a small satellite with blue solar panels on the left-center, a large satellite in the upper right, and a white rocket launching vertically on the right, accompanied by a bright exhaust plume and billowing smoke. Elegant gold orbital arcs are added around the title and spacecraft. Below the title is a gold badge bearing the name "Ukorei" (Universal Space Federation), along with several lines of centered Japanese descriptive text introducing Japan's largest academic event for space science and technology, covering space science, JAXA space policy, space development startups, and a comprehensive discussion of Japan's space development strategy. The lower half transitions to a realistic panoramic view of Utsunomiya City, Japan, with distant mountains, a snow-capped peak resembling Mount Fuji faintly visible on the horizon, modern mid-rise buildings, and wide tram tracks. In the lower right foreground, a stylish, modern yellow and black light rail vehicle is prominently displayed. The vehicle is angled towards the viewer, its windows gleaming, and the destination sign reads "Utsunomiya Station East Exit." To create a clean, futuristic feel, overhead power lines have been removed. In the mid-ground to the right of the rear of the vehicle, a large white satellite dish is visible. In the lower left corner, a white plate displays six golden-brown gyoza (dumplings), accompanied by a small soy sauce dish. A red, curved Japanese label reads "Utsunomiya Gyoza." Near the gyoza and the vehicle, a dark blue circular label with a gold border introduces the host city and its features, stating "Kaissatsu-chi Utsunomiya City" in Japanese, and highlighting local specialties: gyoza and the Utsunomiya light rail. At the bottom, a structured dark blue information strip with gold and white text completes the design. It contains 5 main information blocks: 1) The date block on the left, displaying "Conference Dates: November 10th (Tue) - November 13th (Fri) 2026" in high-contrast large font; 2) The organizer/sponsor block, listing "Sponsor: JSASS General Incorporated Society of Japan Aerospace Exploration Society" and the joint organizer logo/text of JAXA and NICT, with a smaller line of other participating academic associations and organizations; 3) The venue block, containing the Japanese "Conference Lighthouse Utsunomiya Tochigi Prefecture Utsunomiya City Mirai 1-20" and a small rectangular illustration of a modern glass building; 4) A row of 5 The thematic categories, each marked with an icon, are "Cosmic Science," "Cosmic Exploration and Survey," "Cosmic Development Mission (JAXA, etc.)," ​​"Cosmic Policy and System," and "Cosmic Business Start-up." Each label is topped with a simple white line icon. The bottom right corner contains a website/QR code block, including a search bar-style area displaying the JSASS conference website address, a visible QR code, and a yellow circular sticker that reads "Deliver future information!" The poster employs a clean, business poster composition, a glossy, realistic montage effect, clear typography, lifelike lighting and shadows, strong contrast, and gold highlights, presenting a high-end, official event poster feel.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的日本活动海报，采用戏剧性且充满抱负的科幻旅游风格，适用于 {argument name="event year" default="2026"} 年，竖版布局，深邃的蓝色太空背景与明亮的日间城市景观交相辉映。顶部为外太空景象，左上方可见细节丰富的地球轨道视角，行星边缘有耀眼的太阳光晕，天空中布满密集的星辰与淡淡的星云。中央为醒目的白色粗体日文大标题，带有精致的金色点缀和强烈的投影效果：「宇宙科学技術 連合講演会 {argument name="event year" default="2026"}」，上方配有较小的标语：「宇宙の未来を、ともに拓く。」。标题周围环绕着 4 个精确的太空元素：左侧为一架正在降落的月球着陆器，中左侧为一颗带有蓝色太阳能电池板的小型卫星，右上角为一颗大型卫星，右侧为一架正在垂直发射的白色火箭，伴有明亮的尾焰和滚滚浓烟。在标题和航天器周围添加优雅的金色轨道弧线。标题下方放置一枚写有「宇科连」的金色徽章，以及几行居中的日文描述性文字，介绍日本最大的空间科学与技术学术盛会，内容涵盖空间科学、JAXA 空间政策、空间开发初创企业，以及关于日本空间开发战略的综合讨论。下半部分过渡到日本宇都宫市的写实全景，远方可见群山，地平线上隐约可见类似富士山的雪峰，现代化的中层建筑和宽阔的有轨电车轨道。右下角前景处突出展示一辆时髦的现代黄黑配色轻轨电车，车身斜向观众，车窗光洁明亮，目的地显示牌写着「宇都宮駅東口」，为了营造干净的未来感，去除了头顶的电线。电车后方的右侧中景处包含一个大型白色卫星天线设施。左下角展示一盘盛有 6 个金黄色煎饺的白盘，前方配有一个小酱油碟；盘子边缘贴有红色的弧形日文标签「宇都宮餃子」。在饺子和电车附近，加入一个带有金色边框的深蓝色圆形标注，介绍主办城市及特色，日文标注「開催地 宇都宮市」，并注明当地名产：饺子和宇都宫轻轨。底部设计一个结构化的深蓝色信息带，配以金色和白色文字。包含 5 个主要信息块：1) 左侧日期块，以高对比度大字体显示「会期 2026年 11月10日(火)〜11月13日(金)」，2) 主办/赞助单位块，列出「主催 JSASS 一般社団法人 日本航空宇宙学会」以及 JAXA 和 NICT 的联合主办标志/文字，并附有一行较小的其他参与学术协会和组织，3) 会场块，包含日文「会場 ライトキューブ宇都宮 栃木県宇都宮市宮みらい1-20」以及一张现代玻璃建筑的小型矩形插图，4) 一排 5 个带图标的主题分类，分别为「宇宙科学」「宇宙探査・観測」「宇宙開発ミッション（JAXA等）」「宇宙政策・制度」「宇宙ビジネス・スタートアップ」，每个标签上方配有简单的白色线条图标，5) 右下角为网站/二维码块，包含显示 JSASS 会议网址的搜索栏式区域、一个可见的二维码，以及一个写有「今後の情報をお届け！」的黄色圆形贴纸。采用整洁的商业海报构图、光泽感十足的写实蒙太奇效果、清晰的排版、逼真的光影、强烈的对比度、金色高光点缀，呈现出高级的官方活动海报质感。

titleLocalized.zh: 阿波舞 Q 版手办多角度展示

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, extract the dancer positioned in the center and transform her into an adorable chibi-style collectible figure, retaining her Awa Odori pose and costume features. Preserve the pink kimono, woven straw hat (amigasa), raised arms, single-leg lift, and overall festive characteristics, but replace the real person with a delicate toy-style character placed on a small wooden display stand. Create a clear 2x2 multi-angle product display image with four views: front, back, left side, and a side-to-side comparison. Replace the crowded festive scene with a soft, warm studio background and creamy blurring. Make it look like a high-end figure photograph with sharp details, soft depth of field, and ensure consistent lighting across all four panels.

templates.title: Gothic-style android warrior cathedral main visual image

titleLocalized.zh: 哥特风仿生人战士大教堂主视觉图

templates.prompt: A dark fantasy anime illustration with a cinematic feel, set in the ruins of a Gothic cathedral, using a vertical composition. Slightly below the center of the image, it shows the back of a solitary female android warrior, kneeling or sitting on a reflective stone surface. She possesses exceptionally long, flowing {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} Her flowing hair cascaded across the ground and into the air; her eyes were veiled by delicate black blindfolds, and she wore a black, high-slit Gothic battle dress, paired with elegant straps, long black opera gloves, and black over-the-knee boots. Her figure was slender and graceful. She held a massive, ornate longsword upright before her, its blade planted in the ground like a monument. The sword was dark, with a decorative gold ring guard near the hilt. The atmosphere was solemn, tragic, and dignified. The background featured three soaring, pointed arched windows, casting a cold, white backlight through the mist and dust. The background contained four stone angel statues: two on the left and two on the right, partially obscured by mist and darkness. Ash, snowflake-like particles, and black fragments floated in the air, while faint orange embers dotted the ground. The design employed dramatic volumetric lighting, soft halos, smoky effects, high contrast, and low-saturation tones composed of charcoal gray, silver, blue-gray, and black. The scene should possess the texture of a post-war monument, rich in detail, meticulously crafted, melancholic, ethereal, and imbued with a sense of loss.{argument name="franchise title" default="NieR: Automata"} Inspired by the game's main visual style. Add a vertical Japanese title in the bottom left corner.{argument name="vertical text" default="May your fleeting dreams be with you."} Add a small vertical English subtitle next to it.{argument name="subtitle text" default="NieR:Automata"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影质感的暗黑奇幻动漫插画，场景设于废墟中的哥特式大教堂，采用竖构图。画面中心偏下方，展示了一位孤独的女性仿生人战士背影，她正跪坐或坐在反光的石质地面上。她拥有极长的飘逸 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色"} 秀发，铺散在地面和空气中；双眼戴着精致的黑色蒙眼护目镜，身穿黑色高开叉哥特式战斗裙，搭配优雅的绑带、黑色长款歌剧手套及黑色过膝长靴。她的体态纤细而优雅。她双手扶着一把巨大的华丽长剑剑柄，将其竖立在身前，剑刃插入地面，宛如一座纪念碑。剑身呈深色，靠近手柄处有装饰性的金色环状护手。氛围庄重、悲壮且肃穆。背景设有 3 扇高耸的尖拱窗，透过薄雾与尘埃散发出冷白色的背光。背景中共包含 4 座石雕天使像：左侧背景 2 座，右侧背景 2 座，部分被雾气与黑暗遮蔽。空气中漂浮着灰烬、雪花状微粒、黑色碎片，地面附近点缀着些许微弱的橙色余烬。运用戏剧性的体积光、柔和光晕、烟雾弥漫的效果、高对比度，以及由炭灰、银色、蓝灰色和黑色组成的低饱和度色调。场景应呈现出战后纪念碑般的质感，细节高度丰富，极具打磨感，忧郁、空灵，并带有受 {argument name="franchise title" default="尼尔：机械纪元 (NieR:Automata)"} 启发的游戏主视觉图风格。在左下角添加 1 行竖排日文标题 {argument name="vertical text" default="儚き夢と共にあれ"}，并在其旁侧添加 1 行小型竖排英文副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="NieR:Automata"}。

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the base map, this project colorizes monochrome historical aerial photographs while preserving the original composition, angles, proportions, film borders, edge markers, and all geographic structures. REFERENCE_1 is used only as a reference guide for surface colors viewed from above. The layout and topographical details of the old photographs are maintained, but the natural colors of four main surface types are inferred: rivers as a soft blue-green, vegetation and farmland as varying shades of dark green, bare soil/sand and built-up areas as tan, and roads/buildings/industrial roofs as low-saturation gray to light brown. The goal is to maintain a realistic, archival aerial photographic quality, rather than a modern satellite image style, ensuring moderate color saturation, subtle contrast, and color consistency throughout the image.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 为底图，为单色历史航拍照片上色，同时保留原始的构图、角度、比例、胶片边框、边缘标记以及所有地理结构。仅将 REFERENCE_1 作为从高空俯瞰时的地表颜色参考指南。保持旧照片的布局和地形细节不变，但需推断出 4 种主要地表类型的自然色彩：河流为柔和的蓝绿色，植被和农田为深浅不一的深绿色，裸露土壤/沙地和建筑区域为棕褐色，道路/建筑物/工业屋顶为低饱和度的灰色至浅棕色。保持写实的档案级航拍照片质感，而非现代卫星图像风格，确保色彩饱和度适中、对比度微妙，并使整张图像的色彩保持一致。

templates.title: Aerial image converted into land cover map

titleLocalized.zh: 航拍图转土地覆盖图

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the source for geographic and urban layout, and leveraging the pseudo-color visual language implied by REFERENCE_1, monochrome historical aerial photographs are transformed into clear land cover classification maps. The same overhead perspective and street/block structure are maintained, but photographic textures are replaced with flat, segmented areas and sharp boundaries. The scene is precisely divided into six visual categories: 1) buildings in red, 2) roads and major paved corridors in white, 3) water bodies and canals in blue, 4) dense vegetation/parks in dark green, 5) open grasslands or sparse green spaces in light green, and 6) industrial areas or large paved/open facilities in gray. A dense urban thematic map with high contrast, minimal shadows, and no labels, legends, borders, or film markings is generated.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 作为地理和城市布局的参考源，利用 REFERENCE_1 所暗示的伪彩色视觉语言，将单色历史航拍照片转换为清晰的土地覆盖分类图。保持相同的俯视视角和街道/街区结构，但将摄影纹理替换为平坦的分割区域和清晰的边界。将场景精确划分为 6 个视觉类别：1) 建筑物为红色，2) 道路和主要铺装走廊为白色，3) 水体和运河为蓝色，4) 茂密植被/公园为深绿色，5) 开阔草地或稀疏绿地为浅绿色，以及 6) 工业区或大型铺装/开阔设施区域为灰色。生成一张对比度强、阴影极少、且不含标签、图例、边框或胶片标记的密集城市专题地图。

templates.title: A dreamlike underwater woman and a school of translucent fish

titleLocalized.zh: 梦幻水下女子与半透明鱼群

templates.prompt: A dreamlike, surreal portrait, the subject of which is a{argument name="subject" default="young woman"} She is positioned in an ethereal space, underwater or in a liquid-like environment, the composition taken from the mid-thigh upwards. She wears a flowing, sleeveless white dress, the hem of which seems to dissolve into translucent water and shimmering fragments. Her long {argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown"} Her hair flows dramatically to the side as if suspended in water, and to maintain anonymity, her face is deliberately obscured by soft, vertical blurs. Around her, approximately 30 translucent fish, some striped, others pale silvery-white, swim through multiple depths of field in the foreground, middle ground, and background. Several fish swim past her body and hair, creating a strong sense of movement and depth. The background is soft {argument name="background color" default="powder blue"} The image is overlaid with a subtle handwritten texture and scattered with whimsical doodles: white and pale pink hearts, stars, wavy lines, dots, glitter, and two smiley faces. Prismatic rainbow refraction, glossy caustic highlights, and subtle lens-like shimmer on the fish's body and skirt are added. The overall atmosphere should feel delicate, introspective, light, and magical, employing high-key lighting, soft contrast, soft focus on the foreground, and sharp details in the torso and hair. The figure is slightly off-center, with one arm hanging naturally and the body slightly rotated, as if calmly floating among a school of fish. Small, elegant white footer text is added near the bottom edge, with the signature on the left, the website URL in the middle, and a small copyright mark on the right, creating the effect of an art poster or social media display.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张梦幻般的超现实肖像，画面主体为一位 {argument name="subject" default="年轻女子"}，她正置身于水下或类似液体的空灵空间中，构图取自大腿中部以上。她身着一件飘逸的无袖白裙，裙摆仿佛正在消融成半透明的水流和闪烁的碎片。她长长的 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 头发如悬浮在水中般向侧面戏剧性地飘散，为了保持匿名，她的面部被柔和的垂直模糊块刻意遮挡。在她的周围环绕着约 30 条半透明的小鱼，其中一些带有条纹，另一些呈现淡银白色，它们在前景、中景和背景的多个景深中游动，几条鱼从她的身体和头发前游过，营造出强烈的动感和深度。背景采用柔和的 {argument name="background color" default="粉蓝色"}，上面叠加了淡淡的手写体纹理，并散布着奇思妙想的涂鸦：白色和淡粉色的心形、星星、弯曲的波浪线、圆点、闪光以及 2 个笑脸。添加棱镜般的彩虹折射、光泽的焦散高光，以及鱼身和裙子上细微的类镜头色散闪光。整体氛围应感觉细腻、内省、轻盈且充满魔力，采用高调照明、柔和的对比度，前景柔焦，躯干和头发细节清晰。人物构图略微偏离中心，一只手臂自然下垂，身体轻微转动，仿佛在鱼群中平静地漂浮。在底部边缘附近添加细小的白色优雅页脚文字，左侧为签名，中间为网站 URL，右侧为小型版权标记，呈现出艺术海报或社交媒体展示图的效果。

templates.prompt: A vibrant Japanese fast-food promotional anime poster, using a vertical composition, features McDonald's as its theme. The background is a striking red and white graphic design, embellished with gold glitter and streamlined lines, presenting a dynamic advertising style. The upper left corner displays the McDonald's golden arches logo within a red square. The main subject on the left is a stylish anime girl with fox or wolf ears and a fluffy tail, depicted in a half-body shot. She wears modern dark navy blue and black streetwear with blue accents: a cropped top, layered jackets, a belt, straps, and small decorative badges. Her hair color is {argument name="hair color" default="Dark purple"} The image is of medium length and slightly messy. Her face is obscured by a soft, blurred rectangle. She holds a large sesame burger in her left hand and gestures with her right hand towards the food. In the upper right corner is the prominent Japanese title "彩叶のおすすめ！マクドナルド", below which is a smaller black banner that reads "食べたくなる定番メニューをチ�ック！". Arrange four numbered menu items using round white bubble labels with red and yellow accents: Item 1 is "Big Mac," next to a picture of a Big Mac on the right-center side; Item 2 is "Mac Frypot," next to a tall red box of fries on the right; Item 3 is "Chicken Mac Naggette," next to an open box of Chicken McNuggets (containing 6 McNuggets and a box of red dipping sauce) on the lower right-center side; Item 4 is "Teriyaki Mac Burger," next to a glossy teriyaki burger on the lower left-center side. A white McDonald's beverage cup with ice and dark soda is placed in the lower left corner. The right side features two small, vertically stacked information badges: one with a sun and moon icon and the text "朝は朝マック、夜は夜マックも楽しめる！" (Asa wa Asa mac, yo wa yo mac mo akushimeru!); the other with a smartphone icon and the text "アプリでモバイルオーダーも方便！" (Appliance makes mobile access convenient too!). At the very bottom, a striking white and yellow Japanese slogan is added to a red banner: "今日はマックに行きたくなる！" (Today is the day I go!). A small disclaimer is added along the bottom edge. The illustration style is exquisite, brightly colored anime-inspired visual art, combined with commercial food photography renderings of hamburgers, fries, Chicken McNuggets, and beverages; it is highly appetizing, glossy, with clear outlines, and the advertisement's composition is dynamic, full of a cheerful promotional atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满活力的日式快餐宣传动漫海报，采用竖版构图，以麦当劳推荐为主题。背景为醒目的红白图形设计，点缀着金色闪光、流线型线条，呈现出充满活力的广告风格。左上角展示红底方块内的麦当劳金色拱门标志。左侧主体为一位时尚的动漫少女，长有狐狸或狼的耳朵及蓬松的尾巴，半身像，身穿现代深海军蓝与黑色街头服饰，并带有蓝色点缀：露脐短上衣、叠穿外套、腰带、绑带及小型装饰徽章。她的头发颜色为 {argument name="hair color" default="深紫色"}，中等长度且略显凌乱。她的面部被一个柔和的模糊矩形遮挡。她左手拿着一个大号芝麻汉堡，右手向食物方向做出邀请姿势。在右上角，包含醒目的日文标题文字“彩葉のおすすめ！マクドナルド”，下方配有较小的黑色横幅，写着“食べたくなる定番メニューをチェック！”。布置 4 个带编号的菜单标注，使用带有红黄点缀的圆形白色气泡标签：项目 1 为“ビッグマック”，旁边是位于中右侧的巨无霸汉堡图片；项目 2 为“マックフライポテト”，旁边是右侧高大的红色薯条盒；项目 3 为“チキンマックナゲット”，旁边是位于中下右侧打开的麦乐鸡盒（内含 6 块麦乐鸡及一盒红色蘸酱）；项目 4 为“てりやきマックバーガー”，旁边是位于中下左侧的油亮照烧汉堡。左下角放置一个带有冰块和深色汽水的白色麦当劳饮料杯。右侧包含两个垂直堆叠的小型信息徽章：一个带有太阳和月亮图标，文字为“朝は朝マック、夜は夜マックも楽しめる！”；另一个带有智能手机图标，文字为“アプリでモバイルオーダーも便利！”。最底部，在红色横幅上添加醒目的白色与黄色日文标语：“今日はマックに行きたくなる！”。沿下边缘添加微小的免责声明文字。插画风格为精致、色彩鲜艳的动漫主视觉艺术，并结合了汉堡、薯条、麦乐鸡和饮料的商业食品摄影渲染；极具食欲感，光泽感强，轮廓清晰，广告构图动感十足，充满欢快的宣传氛围。

templates.title: Anime-style KFC Princess Promotional Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫风 KFC 公主宣传海报

templates.prompt: A vibrant Japanese fast-food promotional poster, employing a glossy anime advertising style, features KFC and the Magical Princess mascot. The vertical composition, while rich in content, maintains a consistent advertising scene. On the right side of the image, a cheerful anime girl inspired by Princess Kaguya poses energetically, one arm outstretched and the other raised. She possesses flowing long blonde hair, bright, sparkling amber eyes, a radiant smile, and wears elaborate hair accessories including red flower decorations, dangling beads, a green ribbon, and a small golden crescent crown. She wears a festive kimono-style outfit in coral red, soft pink, cream, and olive green, with layered sleeves, floral patterns, decorative knots, bows, tassels, and a wide obi with flower knots. Her hair and sleeves flutter in the wind, as if she were in a light breeze. In the lower left foreground, a KFC chicken bucket filled with four crispy fried chicken pieces is displayed, the chicken exhibiting an exceptionally crispy, golden, juicy, and tempting texture. At the bottom foreground, there are three side dishes: a sesame bun and lettuce chicken burger, a small box of fries, and a cookie or pie dessert drizzled with glossy syrup. The KFC logo is printed in the upper right corner, on the chicken bucket, and on the fries box; the Colonel Sanders image on the chicken bucket is partially blurred into a rectangle. The scene is surrounded by festive red and gold graphics, glitter, brushstroke decorations, and elements reminiscent of Japanese New Year celebrations. A striking bold Japanese title, “ケンタッキーの魅力” (Kentakki no Meikai), is added to the upper left in red font with white and gold outlines. Two white brushstroke speech bubbles are added to the left, containing the red text: “サクッと香ばしい!” (Sakuto Kabashii!) and “ジューシーで大満足!” (Jushi de Daimanzu!). ​​A red flower-shaped badge is added to the right, inscribed with “今日のごほうびに” (Kyou no Gohoubi ni). A red banner is added at the bottom, listing "Original Chikin/ Bargain/ Biscuit" in white text. Exquisitely crafted commercial illustrations, featuring high saturation, warm lighting, clean lines, glossy food rendering, vibrant composition, and a premium poster-like quality.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满活力的日本快餐宣传海报，采用光泽感动漫广告风格，以 KFC 和魔法公主吉祥物为主题。构图为竖版，内容丰富但仍保持统一的广告场景。画面中右侧，一位灵感来自辉夜姬的开朗动漫少女正充满活力地向观众摆出姿势，一只手向前伸展，另一只手臂抬起。她拥有飘逸的长金发、明亮闪烁的琥珀红双眸、灿烂的笑容，并佩戴着华丽的发饰，包括红色花朵装饰、垂坠珠饰、绿色丝带以及一个小巧的金色新月皇冠。她身着珊瑚红、柔粉色、奶油色和橄榄绿相间的节日和服风格服饰，搭配层叠的袖子、花卉图案、装饰绳结、蝴蝶结、流苏以及带有花朵结的宽腰带。她的头发和袖子随风飘动，仿佛置身于轻快的微风中。在左下方前景处，展示 1 个装满 4 块酥脆炸鸡的 KFC 炸鸡桶，炸鸡呈现出格外酥脆、金黄、多汁且诱人的质感。在底部前景处，包含 3 份配餐：1 个芝麻面包生菜鸡肉汉堡、1 小盒薯条，以及 1 个淋有光泽糖浆的饼干或派类点心。右上角以及炸鸡桶和薯条盒上印有 KFC 标志，炸鸡桶上的山德士上校头像部分被矩形模糊处理。场景周围环绕着喜庆的红金配色图形、闪光、笔触装饰以及类似日本新年的节日元素。左上方添加醒目的粗体日文标题“ケンタッキーの魅力”，采用红色字体，并带有白色和金色描边。左侧添加 2 个白色笔触气泡框，内含红色文字：“サクッと香ばしい！”和“ジューシーで大満足！”。右侧添加一个红色花形徽章，写有“今日のごほうびに”。底部添加红色横幅，用白色文字列出“オリジナルチキン / バーガー / ビスケット”。极致精致的商业插画，高饱和度，暖色调灯光，干净的线条，光泽感食物渲染，充满活力的构图，高级海报质感。

templates.title: Anime-style MOS Burger promotional poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫风格 MOS Burger 宣传海报

templates.prompt: A beautifully designed Japanese fast-food promotional poster, employing a bright anime advertising style, combines a fantastical princess character with clear product photography and cheerful brand elements. The composition is horizontal and visually segmented: on the left is an anime girl inspired by the Moon Princess or the Bamboo Cutter Princess, striking a welcoming pose, one hand outstretched to the viewer, the other close to her face. She possesses a very graceful {argument name="hair color" default="Silver-white with a gradient of light pink and light purple."} Long hair, large, expressive eyes, and hair ornaments adorned with flowers and ribbons in deep blue, gold, pink, and turquoise. Her attire is a luxurious, modern kimono dress in white, cyan, navy, and pink, featuring semi-sheer sleeves, floral patterns, multi-layered obi with bows, tassels, and gold embellishments, surrounded by a dreamlike, shimmering atmosphere. Behind her is a dreamy cyan and cream background with soft circles, shimmering stars, delicate floral patterns, graceful decorative lines, and the subtle silhouette of a Japanese pagoda. To the right is {argument name="brand name" default="MOS BURGER"} The neat layout of the food advertisement features the red MOS BURGER logo in the top left and bottom right corners. A green ribbon banner with the Japanese phrase "モスバーガー特集" (Mosu Burger Special Collection) is placed in the center of the upper right corner. Below this is an elegant, large, handwritten Japanese title: "行きたくなる、できたてのおいしさ." (I'll go for it.), with the phrase "できたて" emphasized in vibrant pink, the rest in black. Below this is a smaller Japanese subtitle: "ヤチヨ風の幻想感× モスのごほうびバーガー" (Yachiyo-fu no genkaikan × Mosu no Gohobi Burger). Four food items are arranged horizontally in the middle right corner, each presented as a mouthwatering semi-realistic product photo with soft shadows and sharp details. Item 1: Classic burger, with a bun, thick patty, sauce, mayonnaise, and a large slice of tomato, featuring a red circular badge that reads "定番人気" (classic popularity), with "モスバーガー" (modified burger) and a brief Japanese description below. Item 2: Teriyaki burger, with lettuce and glossy sauce, featuring a green circular badge that reads "和風人気" (Japanese-style popularity), with "テリヤキバーガー" (teriyaki burger) and a brief Japanese description below. Item 3: Onion rings in a white cardboard box, featuring a yellow circular badge that reads "サイドも最高" (best of all), with "オニポテ" (onipote) and a brief Japanese description below. Item 4: Pink milkshake in a clear cup, with a straw, featuring a blue circular badge that reads "ひんやり甘い" (sweet and delicious), with "モスシェイク" (modified milkshake) and a brief Japanese description below. Below the product, add a rounded rectangular recommendation box with a cyan border and a cyan ribbon titled "おすすめポイント" (Osusume Point). The box contains four Japanese key points with pink flower symbols, describing the freshness of the made-to-order food, the allure of the classic meat sauce tomato burger, the popularity of the Japanese teriyaki burger, and that onion rings and milkshakes are also must-try items. On the right side of the same lower area, there is a smaller rounded box containing line art icons of cutlery, drinks, and a burger, along with the Japanese text "モスのこだわり" (Mosu no Kodawari) and "おいしさは、まごころから." (Oishisa wa, magokorokara.) followed by smaller Japanese explanatory text. At the bottom, a large, curved banner with a cyan gradient and a white central halo is placed, containing the Japanese slogan "今日はモスに寄り道しよう。" (Let's do this today!), with "モス" highlighted in bold red. Near the bottom right corner, a small orange-red circular label is added, with text similar to "あなたのお気に入りがきっと見つかる！" (I'll see you when you feel good!). The design employs a clear commercial poster layout, using vibrant cyan, light blue, white, pink, and gold accents to create a glossy food rendering and decorative shimmer, generating a sophisticated sense of collaboration between anime/fantasy illustration and modern restaurant advertising.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张精致的日式快餐宣传海报，采用明亮的动漫广告风格，将奇幻公主角色与清晰的产品摄影及欢快的品牌元素相结合。构图为横向并进行视觉分割：左侧是一位灵感源自月亮公主或竹取公主的动漫少女，她摆出欢迎的姿势，一只手向观众伸出，另一只手靠近脸庞。她拥有非常飘逸的 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色，带有淡粉色和淡紫色渐变"} 长发，大而富有表现力的眼睛，以及深蓝色、金色、粉色和绿松石色的花朵与丝带发饰。她的服装是一件奢华的现代化和服裙，采用白色、青色、海军蓝和粉色，配有半透明袖子、花卉图案、多层腰带蝴蝶结、流苏和金色装饰，周围环绕着梦幻般的闪光氛围。她身后是梦幻般的青色与奶油色背景，带有柔和的圆圈、星光闪烁、淡淡的花卉图案、优美的装饰线条以及日本宝塔的隐约剪影。

右侧是 {argument name="brand name" default="MOS BURGER"} 的整洁食品广告排版，左上角和右下角均有红色 MOS BURGER 标志。在右上方的中心位置，放置一条绿色丝带横幅，上面写有日文“モスバーガー特集”。在下方添加一个优雅的大号手写风格日文标题：“行きたくなる、できたてのおいしさ。”，其中中间的短语“できたて”用鲜艳的粉红色强调，其余部分为黑色。在其下方，添加一个较小的日文副标题：“ヤチヨ風の幻想感 × モスのごほうびバーガー”。

在右侧中部横向排列 4 款食品，每款均呈现为令人垂涎的半写实产品照，带有柔和的阴影和清晰的细节。第 1 款：经典汉堡，配有面包、厚肉饼、酱汁、蛋黄酱和一大片番茄，带有写着“定番人気”的红色圆形徽章，下方标注“モスバーガー”及简短的日文描述。第 2 款：照烧汉堡，配有生菜和光亮的酱汁，带有写着“和風人気”的绿色圆形徽章，下方标注“テリヤキバーガー”及简短的日文描述。第 3 款：白色纸盒装洋葱圈，带有写着“サイドも最高”的黄色圆形徽章，下方标注“オニポテ”及简短的日文描述。第 4 款：透明杯装粉色奶昔，配有吸管，带有写着“ひんやり甘い”的蓝色圆形徽章，下方标注“モスシェイク”及简短的日文描述。

在产品下方，添加一个带有青色边框和青色丝带标题的圆角矩形推荐框，标题写着“おすすめポイント”。框内包含 4 个带粉色花朵符号的日文要点，描述现点现做的鲜美、经典肉酱番茄汉堡的魅力、日式照烧汉堡的受欢迎程度，以及洋葱圈和奶昔也是必点单品。在同一下方区域的右侧，包含一个较小的圆角框，内有餐具、饮料和汉堡的线条图标，以及写着“モスのこだわり”和“おいしさは、まごころから。”的日文文案，随后是较小的日文解释性文字。

在底部，放置一条带有青色渐变和白色中心光晕的大型弧形横幅，包含日文口号“今日はモスに寄り道しよう。”，其中“モス”以粗体红色突出显示。在右下角附近，添加一个橙红色的小圆形标注，文字类似于“あなたのお気に入りがきっと見つかる!”。采用清晰的商业海报布局，运用鲜艳的青色、水蓝色、白色、粉色和金色点缀，呈现光泽感的食品渲染、装饰性闪光，营造出动漫奇幻插画与现代餐厅广告之间的高级联名感。

templates.title: Orc Idol Group Concert Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 兽人偶像团体演唱会海报

templates.prompt: A meticulously crafted key visual for an anime idol concert. The scene is set on glowing dance steps, with five orc performers arranged in a dynamic diagonal formation, bathed in dramatic purple-blue concert lighting and flashing spotlights. The image employs a slightly upward-looking wide-angle perspective to emphasize depth and stage presence. The neon-lit steps extend upwards, with a background outlined by a metal truss structure. At the center of the background is a large, glowing emblem, a geometric star with an embedded paw print, flanked by laurel leaf patterns, hinting at the idol group's logo. Purple-blue outlines shimmer on the floor and steps, while tiny glitter particles and scattered gold confetti float in the air. The overall atmosphere is vibrant, triumphant, and glamorous, like a promotional poster for a live performance. The five performers are all orc idol characters with animal ears, dressed in coordinated fantasy stage costumes featuring belts, chains, layered fabrics, fingerless gloves, and custom accessories. Each member has their own theme color while sharing a unified group design language. From left to right: a gray wolf boy in a dark blue outfit, closest to the camera, confidently smiling and extending a paw to the audience; an orange fox boy in a black, white, and orange outfit, striding forward with a playful smile, one hand outstretched; a gray wolf boy in a black, white, and green outfit, standing behind the center, pointing diagonally upwards; a white rabbit girl in a black, white, and pink outfit, with long rabbit ears, a fluffy tail, and a layered skirt, one arm raised in a pose reminiscent of an idol; and a brown bear boy in a navy blue and gold outfit, standing with a cool, backward glance, one arm outstretched to the side. All characters should possess vivid anime facial expressions, fluffy fur rendering, detailed tails and paws, and high-quality illustrations. Each outfit should be given a unique accent color: blue for the wolf on the left, orange for the fox, green for the wolf in the middle, pink for the rabbit, and gold for the bear. Costumes should blend idol fashion with a fantasy military stage style: fitted jackets or vests, asymmetrical patchwork, shorts or layered skirts, belts, metallic trims, hanging chains, decorative ropes, and patterned fabric patchwork. The character should resemble someone named {argument name="group name" default="Pawlight"} A unified idol group. (Using){argument name="stage lighting color" default="Purple and blue"} The dominant lighting tone is complemented by bright white spotlights from above and soft lens flares. A screen is placed behind the camera.{argument name="emblem design" default="The star-shaped badge contains a paw print and a laurel branch."} The overall style should be{argument name="art style" default="High-detail anime idol promotional illustrations"} The atmosphere should present{argument name="performance mood" default="Climax of the live performance"} That feeling.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张精致的动漫偶像演唱会主视觉图，场景设定在发光的舞台阶梯上，5 位兽人表演者以动态的对角线队形排列，置身于戏剧性的紫蓝色演唱会灯光和闪烁的聚光灯下。画面采用略微仰视的广角视角，以强调深度和舞台表现力，霓虹灯装饰的台阶向上延伸，背景由金属桁架结构勾勒。后方中央是一个巨大的发光徽章，几何星形标志内嵌爪印，两侧饰有月桂叶图案，暗示着偶像团体的标志。地板和台阶边缘闪烁着紫蓝色的轮廓光，空气中漂浮着细小的闪光颗粒和少量金色纸屑。整体氛围充满活力、胜利感和魅力，如同现场演出的宣传海报。

这 5 位表演者均为兽耳或兽人偶像角色，身着协调的奇幻舞台服装，配有腰带、链条、层叠面料、露指手套和定制配饰，每位成员拥有各自的主题色，同时共享统一的团体设计语言。从左至右依次为：一位身着深蓝色服装的灰狼少年，离镜头最近，自信地微笑并向观众伸出一只爪子；一位身着黑白橙色服装的橘色狐狸少年，带着俏皮的笑容向前迈步，一只手向前伸展；一位身着黑白绿色服装的灰白色狼少年，站在中心后方，指向斜上方；一位身着黑白粉色服装的白兔少女，拥有长长的兔耳、毛茸茸的尾巴、短裙层叠设计，一只手臂高举，摆出偶像姿势；以及一位身着海军蓝配金色服装的棕熊少年，以酷炫的回眸姿势站立，一只手臂向侧面伸展。所有角色均应具备生动的动漫面部表情、毛茸茸的皮毛渲染、细致的尾巴和爪子，以及高端精致的插画质量。

为每套服装赋予独特的强调色：左侧狼为蓝色，狐狸为橙色，中间狼为绿色，兔子为粉色，熊为金色。服装应融合偶像时尚与奇幻军事舞台风格：修身夹克或背心、不对称拼接、短裤或层叠短裙、束带、金属饰边、悬挂链条、装饰绳索及图案面料拼接。角色应看起来像一个名为 {argument name="group name" default="Pawlight"} 的统一偶像团体。使用 {argument name="stage lighting color" default="紫色和蓝色"} 作为主导灯光色调，辅以来自上方的明亮白色聚光灯和柔和的镜头光晕。在后方屏幕上放置 {argument name="emblem design" default="星形徽章内嵌爪印及月桂枝"}。整体风格应为 {argument name="art style" default="高细节动漫偶像宣传插画"}，氛围应呈现出 {argument name="performance mood" default="现场演出高潮时刻"} 的感觉。

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image of "The Last Supper," reconstruct the fresco into a clear, intuitive full-frame photograph of the artwork. Maintain the original composition, the 13 figures, the long table, the architectural space, and the texture of the ancient fresco, but remove museum-style distractions from the reference image: eliminate the blurring effect on the faces of the 13 figures, remove the large foreground obstruction/pedestal obscuring the bottom center, and crop/compose it into a more natural art documentary photograph, making the table and floor visible below. Preserve the faded colors of the Renaissance period, the frontal perspective, and the realistic art photographic quality.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的《最后的晚餐》参考图像，将该壁画重构为一张清晰、直观的艺术品全画幅照片。保持原始构图、13 位人物、长桌、建筑空间以及古老壁画的纹理不变，但去除参考图中博物馆式的展示干扰：消除 13 位人物面部的模糊效果，移除遮挡底部中央的大型前景障碍物/基座，并将其裁剪/构图为一张更自然的艺术纪录片照片，使下方的桌子和地面可见。保持文艺复兴时期褪色的色彩、正面视角以及写实的艺术摄影质感。

templates.title: Japanese horror game street reflection

titleLocalized.zh: 日式恐怖游戏街道倒影

templates.prompt: A cinematic screenshot from a Japanese psychological horror game, taken at night from a third-person, over-the-shoulder perspective. The camera focuses on a young man in a dark hooded jacket standing under a convenience store awning, staring into a large front window. The reflection in the glass isn't a normal image, but a terrifying humanoid creature with an unnaturally elongated oval head, long, straight black hair hanging down its sides, a pale, expressionless face, and a dark coat, standing face-to-face with him. Beyond the reflection lies a damp Japanese city street, the asphalt shimmering in the rain, pedestrians sparsely carrying umbrellas, and dimly lit shops, vending machines, and parking signs lining the street. The skyscrapers curve surreal and distorted towards a dark vortex in the sky at the street's end. Five clearly visible magazine covers are neatly arranged on the convenience store windowsill, and eight instant food items or cup noodles are piled in the lower right corner. Subtle Japanese in-game UI text has been added: two lines of mission objectives in the upper left corner and two small action cues in the lower left corner. Includes recognizable Japanese street posters and shop signs, such as the striking red employee recruitment ad in the upper right corner and the yellow points-based activity logo in the lower right corner. The lighting is extremely dark, oppressive, and realistic, with reflections, deep shadows, a damp texture, and the faint, cold light from indoor and streetlights. Style: Hyper-realistic survival horror video game, unsettling, realistic, richly detailed, cinematic, high-contrast, eerie silence, no exaggerated movements, and no vibrant colors.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影感十足的日式心理恐怖游戏夜间截图，采用第三人称越肩视角，镜头位于一名身穿深色连帽夹克的年轻男子身后，他正站在便利店遮阳棚下，凝视着巨大的前窗。玻璃中映出的并非正常的倒影，而是一个恐怖的人形生物，它有着不自然拉长的椭圆形头部、垂在两侧的长直黑发、苍白且面无表情的脸庞以及一件深色外套，正与他面对面站立。倒影之外是日本潮湿的城市街道，路面沥青在雨水浸润下闪闪发光，行人稀疏地撑着伞，街道两旁是昏暗的店面、自动贩卖机、停车标志，高楼大厦以超现实的扭曲视角向街道尽头天空中一个黑暗的漩涡弯曲。便利店窗台上整齐排列着 5 本清晰可见的杂志封面，右下角堆放着 8 件速食食品或杯面。添加细微的日文游戏内 UI 文字：左上角 2 行任务目标，左下角 2 个小型动作提示。包含可辨认的日文街道海报和商店招牌，例如右上角醒目的红色员工招聘广告和右下角的黄色积分活动标志。光影极其昏暗、压抑且写实，伴有倒影、深邃的阴影、潮湿的质感，以及来自室内灯光和路灯微弱的冷光。风格：超写实生存恐怖电子游戏，令人不安、写实、细节丰富、电影感、高对比度、诡异的寂静，无夸张动作，无鲜艳色彩。

templates.title: Screenshots from a Japanese-style apartment horror game

titleLocalized.zh: 日式公寓恐怖游戏截图

templates.prompt: A realistic first-person perspective screenshot from a horror game, set in a narrow, dimly lit Japanese apartment corridor at night. The viewpoint is from behind a solitary figure in the corridor. The figure is a young woman with straight, shoulder-length black hair, mostly silhouetted against the background. She wears a dark hoodie and carries a backpack, facing the end of the corridor. The scene is inside an old concrete apartment building with shiny, reflective floor tiles and stained, grayish-white walls. Several apartment doors are on either side, and cool-toned fluorescent ceiling lights extend into the distance. One apartment door on the right is slightly ajar, emitting a strong, supernatural purple light that spills into the corridor, creating ripples of light and shadow on the walls and floor. In the foreground on the left are two vending machines with glowing beverage displays. A black sign on the left wall prominently displays the Japanese words "Accident Item," with smaller text below and a clear QR code. On the right wall, there's a display area with four notices: a warning poster with striking red Japanese text, a densely packed text notice, a moving service flyer with bold red text and a phone number, and a vertical crime prevention sign. In the lower right corner is a small magazine rack with several pamphlets; the front magazine's cover includes Japanese characters such as "Monthly Ocarto." At the end of the corridor, you can see the balcony railing and the distant city lights. An in-game HUD overlay was added to make it look like a screenshot from an indie horror game: the top left corner features two lines of Japanese quest text with a green progress counter "2/5"; the top right corner displays the digital time "23:47" and the date "2024/04/11"; the bottom left corner shows a camera interface with Japanese text, a red recording dot, and the words "4K" and "60FPS"; the bottom right corner features green Japanese collection text and a row of four inventory slots, with only two slots displaying icons. The game boasts cinematic composition, somber shadows, realistic textures, delicate film grain, a surveillance camera and pseudo-documentary atmosphere, ominous supernatural tension, purple and blue-black color tones, authentic Japanese typography, and highly detailed indie survival horror aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实的恐怖游戏第一人称视角截图，场景设定在夜晚狭窄且光线昏暗的日式公寓走廊中，视角位于走廊内一名孤独身影的后方。该身影为一名留着黑色齐肩直发的年轻女性，背影多为剪影，身穿深色连帽衫并背着背包，面向走廊尽头。场景为一栋老旧的混凝土公寓内部，铺设着光亮的反射地砖，墙壁呈污渍斑斑的灰白色，两侧有多扇公寓门，冷色的荧光吸顶灯向远处延伸。右侧的一扇公寓门微微敞开，散发出强烈的超自然紫色光芒，光线溢出到走廊中，在墙壁和地面上形成波纹状的光影。左侧前景处包含 2 台带有发光饮料陈列的自动售货机。左侧墙上放置一块黑色标牌，上面印有醒目的日文“事故物件”、下方的较小文字以及一个清晰的二维码。右侧墙上设有一个项目，并张贴了 4 张告示：一张带有醒目红色日文的警告类海报、一张密集的文字通知、一张印有粗体红色文字和电话号码的搬家服务传单，以及一块垂直的防范犯罪告示牌。右下角放置一个小型杂志架，上面摆放着几本小册子，最前面的杂志封面上印有包含“月刊オカルト”在内的日文。通过走廊尽头，可以看到阳台栏杆和远处的城市灯光。添加游戏内 HUD 覆盖层，使其看起来像是一张截取的独立恐怖游戏画面：左上角为 2 行日文任务文本，包含一个绿色的进度计数器“2/5”；右上角显示数字时间“23:47”和日期“2024/04/11”；左下角为带有日文的摄像机界面，包含一个红色录制点、“4K”和“60FPS”字样；右下角为绿色的日文收集文本，以及一行 4 个物品栏槽位，其中仅有 2 个槽位显示图标。电影级构图，阴郁的阴影，写实的纹理，细腻的胶片颗粒感，监控摄像头与伪纪录片氛围，不祥的超自然张力，紫色与蓝黑色的色调，真实的日式排版，超细节的独立生存恐怖美学。

templates.title: Screenshots from a Japanese-style office horror game

titleLocalized.zh: 日式办公室恐怖游戏截图

templates.prompt: A screenshot from a first-person survival horror game, set in a dimly lit, abandoned Japanese office late at night. The perspective is at the player's eye level, as if standing next to an office cubicle. In the lower left foreground, a hand is seen reaching out cautiously into the frame. In the center foreground is a white desk, with a strong spotlight casting deep shadows, creating a tense, cinematic atmosphere. Seven visible desktop elements must be precisely placed: a red stapler floating or eerily hovering above the desk, a stack of messy papers and newspapers, a folded piece of paper, a black smartphone, two separate pens, and a black mesh pen holder containing several pens. Behind the desk is a gray cubicle wall with three items on it: a yellow sticky note with scribbled Japanese writing, a Japanese-style energy-saving notice with a simple light bulb illustration, and a blue corporate cityscape poster with Japanese text. To the right of the desk are four upright office storage items: three thick folders or files, one with a prominent "15" label, another with vertical Japanese text, and a small plastic drawer. In the foreground to the right is a freestanding sign with Japanese text and a prohibition symbol. To the left, a vending machine emitting a cool white-blue light is displayed in the background, with several cardboard boxes and garbage bags scattered on the floor nearby. A long aisle of cubicles and bookshelves extends from the office, with papers scattered on the floor, gradually fading into darkness. In the central background in the distance, a solitary figure stands motionless at the end of a corridor, its silhouette outlined by the faint blue light filtering through the windows of the distant city. At the bottom center, a subtle game HUD element is added, containing two Japanese interactive prompts, each accompanied by a gamepad button icon, making it resemble a screenshot from a modern horror game. It employs realistic 3D rendering, ultra-detailed environmental storytelling, a cool blue-black color scheme, soft volumetric lighting effects, strong contrast, an eerie empty office atmosphere, and a sense of meaningless yet unsettling supernatural presence.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张第一人称生存恐怖游戏截图，背景设定在深夜昏暗且废弃的日式办公室中，视角为玩家平视高度，仿佛正站在办公隔间旁。左下角前景展示 1 只伸出的人手，正小心翼翼地探入画面。画面中央前景是一张白色办公桌，上方强烈的聚光灯投下深邃的阴影，营造出紧张的电影感氛围。桌面上需精确放置 7 个可见的桌面元素：1 个悬浮在桌面上方或诡异漂浮的红色订书机、1 叠杂乱的纸张和报纸、1 张折叠的散纸、1 部黑色智能手机、2 支分开摆放的笔，以及 1 个装有几支笔的黑色网格笔筒。桌后是灰色的隔间墙，墙上贴有 3 件物品：1 张写有日文乱涂乱画的黄色便签、1 张带有简单灯泡插图的日式节电通知，以及 1 张带有日文的蓝色企业城市景观海报。办公桌右侧放置 4 件直立的办公收纳用品：3 本厚文件夹或档案书，其中一本贴有醒目的“15”标签，另一本带有日文竖排文字，此外还有 1 个小型塑料抽屉柜。右前方前景放置 1 个带有日文和禁止符号的独立桌面立牌。左侧背景展示 1 台发出冷白蓝色光芒的自动售货机，附近地板上散落着几个纸箱和垃圾袋。办公室延伸出一条长长的隔间与书架通道，地板上散落着纸张，逐渐隐入黑暗。在远处的中央背景中，放置 1 个孤独的人影，静止地站在走廊尽头，被远处城市透出的微弱蓝色窗光勾勒出轮廓。在底部中央添加细微的游戏 HUD 元素，包含 2 个日文交互提示，每个提示旁配有手柄按键图标，使其看起来像是一张现代恐怖游戏截图。采用逼真的 3D 渲染，超精细的环境叙事，冷蓝黑色的调色风格，柔和的体积光黑暗效果，强烈的对比度，诡异的空旷办公室氛围，以及一种无意义但令人不安的超自然存在感。

templates.title: Japanese horror game inventory interface

titleLocalized.zh: 日式恐怖游戏物品栏界面

templates.prompt: The inventory interface of this dark, cinematic Japanese survival horror game features a realistic modern console UI style against a gloomy nighttime city backdrop. The scene depicts a rain-soaked city intersection with a tilted high-rise building in the center. A full moon hangs in the cloudy sky, accompanied by a glowing red traffic light, a red neon sign, a parked car, a vending machine on the far right, and four silhouettes of pedestrians in the distance, one of whom is holding an umbrella. The overall image presents a rough, understated blue-black tone with subtle scanlines, soft glow effects, damp reflections, and a tense, mystical atmosphere. The top navigation bar features four Japanese tabs: "Possessions," "Records," "Data," and "Settings," as well as two shoulder button indicators labeled "L1" and "R1." The left side is an inventory grid labeled "Important Item," containing 6 visible slots in 3 columns and 2 rows. The top row contains 3 items, each with a quantity of "1": an old key labeled "Old Key," a broken flashlight labeled "Wrong Nostalgic Light," and an hourglass labeled "Silent Sand Clock." The currently selected slot is the old key, with a thin neon magenta border. The bottom row displays 3 dark empty slots marked with faint Xs. Below the grid is a green electrocardiogram-style status indicator labeled "Normal." The lower left corner is a task panel labeled "Objective," containing one task: "Investigate the cause of the anomaly in front of the station." In the lower foreground of the image, below the UI, is an open spiral notebook with a handwritten Japanese title, "Key Ritual," three lines of brief ritual notes, and a hand-drawn occult circle symbol. Next to it is a can of beverage labeled "Zeri" and a small price tag that reads "Osusume ¥298." A large item details panel is created on the right to display the selected item; the item name, "Ancient Key," is displayed in magenta, and the category row reads "Category: Important Item." A large, detailed rendering of a rusty antique key is shown; it is made of iron, worn, and has reddish-brown rust. The round key handle has a clover-like perforated design, and the key teeth are jagged. Below are three brief lines of Japanese description explaining that this is a ritual key of unknown purpose. At the bottom is a magenta quote: “扉は开くべきものではない。闭じるべきものでもない。”, followed by the annotation “― 书き殴られたメモより”. Two operation prompts are added in the lower right corner: “✕ 调べる” and “◯ 戻る”. The overall composition should present the quality of a high-quality AAA horror game screenshot, with realistic UI, item designs imbued with a bizarre backstory, high contrast, subtle neon magenta accents, and a mysterious and seemingly logical but ultimately meaningless occult game logic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张黑暗、电影质感的日式生存恐怖游戏物品栏界面，采用逼真的现代主机 UI 风格，背景为阴郁的夜间城市。场景展示了一个雨水浸润的城市十字路口，背景中央有一栋倾斜的高层建筑，多云的天空中挂着一轮满月，还有 1 个发光的红色交通信号灯、1 个红色霓虹灯招牌、1 辆停放的汽车、最右侧有 1 台自动售货机，以及 4 个远处的行人剪影，其中 1 人撑着雨伞。整张图像呈现出粗砺、低调的蓝黑色调，带有细微的扫描线、柔和的泛光效果、湿润的反射以及紧张的神秘学氛围。界面顶部导航栏设有 4 个日文标签：“所持品”、“记录”、“资料”、“设定”，以及标有“L1”和“R1”的 2 个肩键提示。左侧为标签为“重要アイテム”的物品栏网格，包含 3 列 2 行共 6 个可见槽位；顶行包含 3 个物品，每个物品均带有数量“1”：标有“古びた鍵”的旧钥匙、标有“歪んだ懐中電灯”的破损手电筒，以及标有“無音の砂時計”的沙漏。当前选中的槽位为旧钥匙，并带有细细的霓虹洋红色边框。底行显示 3 个带有淡淡 X 标记的深色空槽位。网格下方有 1 个标为“正常”的绿色心电图式状态指示器。左下角是标为“目標”的任务面板，包含 1 行任务：“駅前の異変の原因を調査する”。在画面中下部前景、UI 下方，放置 1 本翻开的螺旋笔记本，页面上有手写的日文标题“鍵の儀式”和 3 行简短的仪式笔记，以及一个手绘的神秘学圆圈符号。旁边放置 1 罐标有“ゼリ”的饮料和 1 张写着“おすすめ品 ¥298”的小价签。右侧创建一个大型物品详情面板，用于显示选中的物品，物品名称“古びた鍵”以洋红色显示，分类行显示“分類：重要アイテム”。展示一个锈迹斑斑的古董钥匙的大型精细渲染图，铁质、磨损、带有红褐色锈迹，圆形的钥匙柄上有类似三叶草的镂空设计，钥匙齿部参差不齐。下方包含 3 行简短的日文描述，说明这是一把用途不明的仪式用钥匙，底部添加一行洋红色的引用笔记：“扉は開くべきものではない。閉じるべきものでもない。”，随后标注“― 書き殴られたメモより”。右下角添加 2 个操作提示：“✕ 調べる”和“◯ 戻る”。整体构图需呈现出精致的 AAA 级恐怖游戏截图质感，UI 逼真，物品设计充满诡异的背景故事，高对比度，带有微妙的霓虹洋红色点缀，以及神秘且看似合理但实则无意义的神秘学游戏逻辑。

templates.title: Anime x Platform Battle Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫 X 平台对战海报

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic, anime-style social media battle poster inspired by X/Twitter. The image is vertically divided into two opposing sides by a glowing, lightning-shaped crack, with a large, glowing "VS" logo at the bottom center. The composition is a vertical promotional main visual suitable for smartphone display, incorporating densely layered UI cards, speech bubbles, tweet screenshots, reaction counters, and explosive energy effects. A large X logo is placed at the top center, accompanied by the title text "BATTLE" and the Japanese subtitle "X de resuba chu". The left side features a cool purple-black theme, while the right side has a warm red-white theme, with sparks, beams of light, embers, and dynamic lines moving along both sides. The poster depicts a scene of two anime high school girls facing off. On the left is a calm and composed girl, representing logical rebuttal: she has long, black hair that fades to purple, with bangs, fair skin, and a slender figure. She wears a black sailor-style school uniform with a purple bow tie, pleated skirt, black knee-high socks, and loafers. One hand holds a smartphone, while the other touches her glasses or temple. Her face is obscured by a rectangular, blurred mosaic. Her posture is reserved and still. She is surrounded by glowing purple tweet cards and chat bubbles. Her display name and account should repeatedly appear as "雲居モヤ@kumoi_moya ". To her side are three large quotation boxes containing Japanese phrases: "それ、前提が雑だよね。", "情感だけでは通らないよ。", and "論点、そこじゃない。". promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张受 X/Twitter 启发、极具戏剧性的动漫风格社交媒体对战海报，画面从中心垂直分割为两个对立面，中间由一道发光的闪电状裂痕隔开，底部中心有一个巨大的发光“VS”字样。构图为适合智能手机展示的竖版宣传主视觉图，包含密集的层叠 UI 卡片、对话气泡、推文截图、反应计数器和爆炸性能量特效。在顶部中心放置一个巨大的 X Logo，并配上标题文本“BATTLE”以及日文副标题“Xでレスバ中”。左侧为冷色调的紫黑主题，右侧为暖色调的红白主题，火花、光束、余烬和动态线条在两侧穿梭。

展示 2 名动漫女高中生角色对峙的场景。左侧是冷静沉着的女生，代表逻辑反驳：留着黑色渐变至紫色的长发，平刘海，皮肤白皙，身材苗条，身穿黑色水手服风格校服，配紫色领结、百褶裙、黑色过膝袜和乐福鞋，一只手拿着智能手机，另一只手触碰眼镜或太阳穴。她的面部被矩形模糊马赛克遮挡。她的姿态矜持且静止。周围环绕着紫色发光的推文卡片和对话气泡。她的显示名称和账号应反复出现为“雲居モヤ @kumoi_moya”。在她的侧面放置 3 个大型引用语句框，内容分别为日文：“それ、前提が雑だよね。”、“感情だけでは通らないよ。”以及“論点、そこじゃない。”。此外，在她的侧面包含 5 个较小的紫色 UI/评论元素：1) 一个写着“それな 千代先輩、強すぎ…”的小评论气泡，2) 一个写着“論理的で草 完全に正論パンチ”的小评论气泡，3) 一张写着“いいね! 12.8K”的点赞卡，4) 一张写着“リポスト 9,341”的转发卡，以及 5) 一张写着“おすすめトレンド #モヤVSエナ 42,857件のポスト”的深色趋势卡。添加一个位于中心、略微倾斜的深色智能手机推文面板，显示她的推文（包含头像、姓名、账号）、文本“それ、前提が雑だよね。”以及计数器“312”、“1,204”和“8,745”。

右侧展示一名充满攻击性、火热的女生，代表情感反击和自信：鲜艳的红色头发扎成高高的凌乱侧丸子头，留着长碎发，明亮的青色眼睛，皮肤白皙，表情充满活力，张嘴大喊，一只手直指对手，另一只手叉腰。她身穿白色衬衫、黑色背心裙，配超大红色领结、堆堆袜和黑色乐福鞋。周围环绕着红色发光的推文卡片和通知风格的 UI。她的显示名称和账号应反复出现为“緋空エナ @hisora_ena”。在她的侧面放置 3 个大型引用语句框，内容分别为日文：“ちゃんと読んでから言ってる!?”、“正論ぶってるだけでしょ!”以及“逃げてないで答えて!”。此外，在她的侧面包含 6 个较小的红色 UI/评论元素：1) 一张写着“通知 99+”的顶部通知徽章卡，2) 一个写着“エナちゃん つよすぎるww”的小评论气泡，3) 一个写着“言いたいこと全部言ってくれる!”的小评论气泡，4) 一张写着“いいね! 18.7K”的点赞卡，5) 一张写着“いいね! 23.6K”的点赞卡，以及 6) 一张写着“リポスト 11.2K”的转发卡。在中心附近添加一个红色推文面板，显示她的推文（包含头像、姓名、账号）、文本“ちゃんと読んでから言ってる!?”以及计数器“278”、“1,652”和“10.9K”。

在下方中间区域，放置 3 个连接两侧的深色中央界面卡片：1) 一张标记为“引用ポスト”的引用推文卡，展示两位用户及交流内容“論点、そこじゃない。”和“正論ぶってるだけでしょ!”，2) 一张写着“返信 1,876件”的回复计数卡，以及 3) 一个仿照 X 移动端 App 样式的底部导航栏，包含主页、搜索、通知、消息图标和一个标记为“ポスト”的蓝色按钮。整体美学应呈现出光泽感、高对比度、高渲染度的动漫插画风格，带有霓虹边缘光、强烈的背光、动态透视、层叠的半透明效果以及混乱的病毒式互联网争论氛围。使用清晰的日文 UI 字体，强烈的红紫对比色，以及精美的宣传海报级画质。

templates.title: Collage of photos of anime girls and boys on dates

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫少女与男子的约会照片拼贴

templates.prompt: A 4x4 photo collage contains 16 heartwarming, cinematic-quality snapshots of everyday life, featuring a real adult man and his anime-style teenage girlfriend, as if they were casually taking photos on a date. The man has short, dark hair, fair skin, and a well-proportioned figure, wearing a dark blue or black long-sleeved shirt; his face is deliberately obscured and softly blurred in each frame. The anime girl has long, blonde twin tails, large blue eyes, fair skin, and a petite figure, wearing a black sleeveless top, a multi-layered silver necklace (including a cross pendant), and a black bracelet, paired with a red plaid pleated skirt and black and white striped knee-high socks. The collage combines realistic photography with a natural 2D anime character, retaining her clear cel-shaded style while matching the scene's lighting, perspective, focus, and color gradation, making her appear naturally beside him. It employs a melancholic nighttime tone, soft bokeh, shallow depth of field, and an intimate, candid atmosphere of a couple. The 16 scenes are: 1) A close-up portrait indoors, with the girl leaning against him; 2) A conversation on the side of a city street at night, with blurry streetlights in the background; 3) Indoors, the two are reading together, with the girl leaning on his shoulder; 4) An outdoor coffee table, with the two holding takeaway coffee cups; 5) A restaurant table, with dishes laid out, and the two are eating; 6) A selfie in an elevator mirror, with the man holding a phone and the girl making a peace sign; 7) A car view from a road trip, with the man driving and an anime girl sitting in the passenger seat; 8) A sunset view at the beach, with the two sitting side by side watching the sea; 9) A portrait of a neon-lit city nightscape, with the girl pointing at the camera; 10) An intimate close-up in an elevator, with the girl leaning affectionately against him with her eyes closed; 11) A full-body mirror selfie in an elevator, showing their complete outfits; 12) A portrait of a city skyline with a glowing tower as a background; 13) A close-up selfie with a camera, with the man holding a small camera in front of a mirror or reflection; 14) 15) A man holding a wine glass, a girl smiling and making a peace sign during a comfortable indoor break; 16) A full-body photo of two people walking hand in hand under the glowing streetlights on a rainy night; 17) A close-up portrait at night, a girl making a peace sign. Maintaining a compact grid layout with thin white dividing lines, the overall format is square, using a unified amber brown tone to create a romantic urban realism and a subtle social media "photo stack" aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张 4x4 的照片拼贴，包含 16 张温馨的电影质感生活照，主角为一名真实成年男子和一名动漫风格的少女伴侣，两人如同在拍摄随意的约会照片。男子留着深色短发，肤色白皙，身材匀称，身穿深蓝色或黑色纯色长袖衬衫；他的面部在每一帧中都被刻意遮挡并进行了柔焦模糊处理。动漫少女留着金色长双马尾，拥有蓝色大眼睛，肤色白皙，身材娇小，身穿黑色无袖上衣，佩戴多层银色项链（含十字架吊坠）和黑色腕饰，下身穿着红色格纹百褶短裙，搭配黑白条纹过膝袜。将写实摄影与自然融合的 2D 动漫角色相结合，保留她清晰的赛璐珞风格，同时匹配场景光影、透视、焦距和色彩分级，使她看起来自然地出现在他身边。采用忧郁的夜色调、柔和的焦外成像、浅景深以及亲密的抓拍情侣氛围。16 个画面分别为：1) 室内近景肖像，两人紧挨着坐在一起，女孩靠在他身边；2) 夜间城市街道侧面交谈，背景是模糊的街灯；3) 室内，两人一起看书，女孩靠在他的肩膀上；4) 户外咖啡桌，两人手持外带咖啡杯；5) 餐厅餐桌，桌上摆满菜肴，两人正在用餐；6) 电梯镜面自拍，男子拿着手机，女孩比着剪刀手；7) 车内公路旅行视角，男子驾驶，动漫少女坐在副驾驶座；8) 海边日落背影，两人并肩坐着看海；9) 霓虹闪烁的城市夜景肖像，女孩指向镜头；10) 电梯内亲密特写，女孩闭着眼睛深情地靠在他身上；11) 电梯内全身镜面自拍，展示两人完整的穿搭；12) 以发光塔为背景的城市夜景天际线肖像；13) 相机自拍特写，男子对着镜子或反射面举着小型相机；14) 舒适的室内休息时刻，男子手持红酒杯，女孩微笑着比出剪刀手；15) 雨夜街道背影全身照，两人在发光的街灯下牵手离去；16) 夜间近距离肖像，女孩比出剪刀手。保持拼贴画紧凑的网格布局，带有细白色分割线，整体为正方形格式，统一采用琥珀棕色调，营造浪漫的城市写实感和微妙的社交媒体“照片堆”美学。

templates.title: Cruel red-clad kimono manga battle page

titleLocalized.zh: 残酷的红衣和服漫画战斗页面

templates.prompt: A bold, black-and-white comic strip action page features a female protagonist whose clothing is accented with red. The six-panel layout includes dynamic diagonal borders. The largest central panel showcases a fierce young woman with long, straight hair and bangs. She wears a short red kimono-style robe with a wide gold belt, barefoot, and delivers a difficult vertical kick to a burly man's face. Her face is blurred with soft, square pixels, and the impact is accompanied by ink splattering and debris scattering. In the upper left panel, the same woman crouches in a wild fighting stance on cracked ground, one hand touching the ground, her long hair flowing, her robe open to reveal powerful legs. A narrow close-up panel shows only her cold, focused eyes beneath her bangs. In the lower left panel, she throws a straight punch at an attacker, the point of contact accompanied by a powerful explosive effect. In the bottom center panel, she unleashes uppercuts and sweeping attacks on another tall male opponent, the scene filled with speed lines and flowing long hair. In the lower right panel, from a rear view, she stands calmly amidst fallen enemies, smoke and dust rising around her, her long hair cascading down her back, her red robe loosely draped over her body. The artwork employs bold ink strokes, heavy speed lines, splattering impact effects, high-contrast comic book shadows, dynamic composition, and bold black Japanese onomatopoeia. The overall atmosphere is brutal, cinematic, and ruthless, like a young revenge manga. Aside from subtle warm-toned accents on the woman's red robe and belt, the rest of the page remains monochrome.

promptLocalized.zh: 一页粗犷的黑白漫画动作页面，女主角的服装带有局部红色点缀，采用 6 格漫画布局，页面上分布着动态的对角线边框。中央最大的分镜展示了一位留着长直发、齐刘海的凶猛年轻女性，她身穿短款红色和服式长袍，系着宽大的金色腰带，赤着双脚，正向一名魁梧男子的脸部踢出高难度的垂直踢；她的面部被柔和的方块模糊处理，冲击瞬间伴随着墨迹飞溅和碎片四散。左上方的分镜中，同一位女性在开裂的地面上以野性的战斗姿态低蹲，一只手触碰地面，长发向外飘散，长袍敞开，露出强有力的双腿。一个狭窄的特写分镜仅展示了她齐刘海下冷峻且专注的双眼。左下方的分镜中，她向一名攻击者挥出直拳，接触点伴随着强烈的爆发效果。底部中央的分镜中，她对另一名高大的男性对手施展上踢或横扫攻击，画面中充满速度线和飘动的长发。右下方的分镜中，从背后视角展示她平静地站在倒地的敌人中间，周围烟尘升起，长发垂在背部，红色长袍松散地挂在身上。采用粗犷的墨水笔触、厚重的速度线、飞溅的冲击效果、高对比度的漫画阴影、极具动感的构图，以及黑色的粗体日文拟声词。整体氛围残酷、具有电影感且毫不留情，如同青年复仇漫画。除女性的红色长袍和腰带的细微暖色点缀外，页面其余部分保持单色。

templates.title: Dark Moonlight Film Noir Style Album Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑月光黑色电影风格专辑封面

templates.prompt: A dark, cinematic album cover-style scene, the perspective is from inside a high-rise room at night, looking out from the emotionally charged interior to overlook the vast, brightly lit modern city. On the left, a solitary man slumps by a rain-drenched floor-to-ceiling window, his face obscured by deep shadows, smoke swirling upwards. He wears a dark suit or an open-collared shirt, appearing disheveled and melancholic. In the lower left foreground, two bottles of liquor, a short glass containing amber-colored whiskey, and a cluttered table reflecting a faint, warm light. On the right outside the window, a humanoid creature with enormous black wings hovers or descends above the city, forming a dramatic silhouette against the backdrop of a huge, bright full moon, surrounded by broken clouds and shimmering lights in the sky. The color palette is almost monochromatic, dominated by cool blue-black shadows, accented with subtle amber highlights from the liquor and interior lighting. The layered atmospheric fog, smoke, damp glass texture, and strong contrasts blend realistic photography with dark fantasy and lavish film noir styles, creating a melancholic and dangerous atmosphere. At the lower center of the image, a large, ornate serif title is superimposed, containing the following text:{argument name="title text" default="Soul King D'Ryoichi"} Decorative crowns and patterns are incorporated into the font. Below this, a smaller, elegant Japanese subheading is added.{argument name="subtitle text" default="The moon I looked up at was surprisingly beautiful."} This makes it look like a high-end music single cover or lyric visual, highly detailed, exquisite, cinematic, centered, and in a square format.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张暗黑、电影质感的专辑封面风格场景，视角位于夜晚的高层房间内，从充满情绪感的室内向外望去，俯瞰着灯火通明的广阔现代城市。在左侧，一名孤独的男子瘫坐在布满雨点的落地窗旁，他的脸庞隐没在深沉的阴影中，烟雾向上缭绕，他身着深色西装或敞开领口的衬衫，显得凌乱而忧郁。在左下角的前景中，放置 2 个酒瓶、1 个装有琥珀色威士忌的矮玻璃杯，以及一张反射着微弱暖光的杂乱桌面。窗外右侧，一个拥有巨大黑色羽翼的人形生物悬浮或降落在城市上方，在巨大明亮的满月映衬下形成戏剧性的剪影，周围是破碎的云层和天空中闪烁的微光。色调接近单色，以冷蓝黑色的阴影为主，辅以酒水和室内灯光带来的少量琥珀色高光。添加层次感的大气雾气、烟雾、湿润的玻璃质感、强烈的对比度，将写实摄影与暗黑奇幻、奢华黑色电影风格融合，营造出忧郁且危险的氛围。在画面中下部，叠加大型华丽的衬线体标题，内容为 {argument name="title text" default="Soul King D'Ryoichi"}，并在字体中融入装饰性的皇冠和花纹。在其下方，添加一行较小的优雅日语副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="見上げた月は存外に綺麗で"}。使其看起来像是一张高级音乐单曲封面或歌词视觉图，高度细节化、精致、电影感强、构图居中，正方形格式。

templates.title: Japanese AI product landing page homepage design

titleLocalized.zh: 日文 AI 产品落地页首屏设计

templates.prompt: For the name{argument name="brand name" default="DOKUMI"} Create a sophisticated Japanese landing page image for a fictional high-end consumer technology brand. The page should present a modern beauty technology and food safety product website style, using a soft warm beige and ivory white color scheme, with elegant typography, ample white space, and a refined sense of luxury beauty branding. Use a widescreen desktop webpage layout screenshot, including a top navigation bar, a left-aligned large heading, and lifestyle product photography on the right. The top heading bar contains eight visible navigation elements arranged in a single line: the brand logo text "DOKUMI" on the far left, followed by "ABOUT," "PRODUCT," "FEATURE," "INGREDIENT," "VOICE," and "Q&A," then a small user account icon, and a rounded red call-to-action button on the far right labeled "今すぐ购入する" (Buy Now). Below the button area in the upper right corner, add a vertical red ribbon badge containing four stacked white Japanese characters: "発売記念" (Sales Commemoration), "限限" (Limited), "20%," and "OFF," with a smaller "CAMPAIGN" text below. The homepage is divided into two main columns. On the left is a very large Japanese title in an elegant Mincho serif font, arranged in three lines: “一口目は、” and “AIが先に.”, with a large font size and ample spacing. Below this is a smaller two-line Japanese subtitle, described in a sophisticated gray tone, explaining the function of detecting food toxins, foreign objects, and allergens via AI before eating. Below the subtitle are two horizontally arranged CTA buttons: one with rounded corners filled in red, labeled “今すぐ始める” (Start Now), with a right-pointing arrow; the other with rounded corners in white outline, labeled “详しく見る” (See Details), also with a right-pointing arrow. Below the buttons is a row of three white rounded-corner function cards with thin borders, accompanied by simple black line icons. The three cards are: 1) a shield icon, titled "AI Portrait Analysis," with a subtitle describing high-precision toxin detection; 2) a clock icon, titled "3-Second Judgment," with a subtitle describing instant results that can be obtained by simply holding the device; and 3) a smartphone icon, titled "Smartphone Collaboration," with a subtitle describing how the app automatically saves historical data. At the bottom of the home screen, add a row of three statistical data cards with rounded corners and thin borders. These three cards contain: 1) "Cumulative Sales *1," a large number "23,500," followed by a smaller "Units Exceeded"; 2) "Satisfaction Rate *2," a large number "94.3%"; and 3) "Report Rate *2," a large number "81.2%." To the right of these cards are two lines of small Japanese footnotes: "*1 April 2026 self-inspection" and "*2 March 2026 survey N=180." On the right, create a soft and glamorous lifestyle photography scene. Showcase a stylish young woman with shoulder-length, slightly wavy brown hair, fair skin, and a large red polka-dot bow headband. She wears an off-the-shoulder white ruffled blouse, gently resting her face on one hand, leaning against a brightly lit table. Her face is partially obscured by a centered rectangular skin-tone mask. On the table sits a stylish white handheld scanner, cylindrical in shape, with a small, dark lens opening with red accents near the top edge. Next to the scanner is a realistic bright red apple. Near the scanner, a dark blue circular badge is overlaid, containing the white Japanese characters "毒チェック" (Poison Check) and "わずか3秒" (Wazuka 3 Seconds), with a small plus sign below. Use soft, natural window light from the left, with subtle, angled shadows on the background wall. The soft shadows and realistic product rendering create the aesthetic of a high-end e-commerce landing page. The overall composition should be simple, appealing, and slightly playful, like a landing page for a unique AI gadget startup. Please include all visible Japanese text at the specified locations.

promptLocalized.zh:
为名为 {argument name="brand name" default="DOKUMI"} 的虚构高端消费科技品牌，创作一张精致的日文落地页首屏图像。页面应呈现出现代美妆科技与食品安全产品的网站风格，采用柔和的暖米色与象牙白配色，具备优雅的编辑排版、充足的留白以及细腻的奢华美妆品牌感。使用宽屏桌面网页布局截图，包含顶部导航栏、左对齐的大标题块以及右侧的生活方式产品摄影构图。

顶部标题栏包含 8 个可见的导航元素，单行排列：最左侧为品牌 Logo 文字“DOKUMI”，随后依次为“ABOUT”、“PRODUCT”、“FEATURE”、“INGREDIENT”、“VOICE”、“Q&A”，接着是一个小型用户账户图标，最右侧是一个圆角红色行动号召按钮，标签为“今すぐ購入する”。在右上角按钮区域下方，添加一个垂直的红色丝带徽章，内含 4 组堆叠的白色日文文字：“発売記念”、“限定”、“20%”、“OFF”，下方附带较小的“CAMPAIGN”文字。

首屏区域分为两个主要列。左侧放置一个非常大的日文标题，采用优雅的明朝体衬线字体，分三行排列：“一口目は、”、“AIが先に。”，字号宏大且间距宽裕。下方添加一个较小的两行日文副标题，以精致的灰色调描述在进食前通过 AI 检测食物毒素、异物及过敏原的功能。在副标题下方，放置 2 个水平排列的 CTA 按钮：一个填充红色的圆角按钮，标签为“今すぐ始める”，带有一个向右的箭头；另一个为白色轮廓的圆角按钮，标签为“詳しく見る”，带有一个向右的箭头。

在按钮下方，添加一行 3 个带细边框的白色圆角功能卡片，配以简单的黑色线条图标。这 3 个卡片分别是：1) 盾牌图标，标题为“AI画像解析”，副标题为关于高精度检测毒素的描述；2) 时钟图标，标题为“3秒判定”，副标题为关于手持即可瞬间获取结果的描述；3) 智能手机图标，标题为“スマホ連携”，副标题为关于 App 自动保存历史记录的描述。

在首屏底部，添加一行 3 个带圆角和细边框的统计数据卡片。这 3 个卡片内容为：1) “累計販売台数※1”，大数字“23,500”，后接较小的“台突破”；2) “満足度※2”，大数字“94.3%”；3) “リピート率※2”，大数字“81.2%”。在这些卡片右侧，放置 2 行小型日文脚注：“※1 2026年4月時点 自社調べ”以及“※2 2026年3月調査 N=180”。

在右侧，营造一个柔和且充满魅力的生活方式摄影场景。展示一位时尚的年轻女性，留着齐肩微卷棕发，皮肤白皙，佩戴一个红色波点大蝴蝶结发带。她身着露肩白色荷叶边衬衫，单手轻托面部，倚靠在光亮的桌面上。她的面部被一个居中的矩形肤色遮挡块遮住。桌面上放置着一个时尚的白色手持扫描设备，机身呈圆柱状，顶部边缘附近有一个带红色装饰的小型深色镜头开口。设备旁放着一个逼真的亮红色苹果。在设备附近，叠加一个深蓝色圆形标注徽章，内含白色日文文字“毒性チェック”和“わずか3秒”，下方带有一个小加号。

使用来自左侧的柔和自然窗光，背景墙上有淡淡的斜向光影，阴影柔和，产品渲染真实，呈现出高端电商落地页的美感。整体构图应显得简洁、令人向往且略带俏皮，如同一个独特 AI 小工具的初创公司落地页。请包含所有指定位置的可见日文文本。

templates.title: Anime girl wearing a straw hat under the blue sky

titleLocalized.zh: 蓝天之下戴草帽的动漫少女

templates.prompt: A serene, anime-style summer portrait depicts a young woman standing outdoors against a backdrop of a clear blue sky, with four soft white clouds visible at the edge of the frame and tiny, shimmering points of light floating in the air. Shot from a low angle, the frame focuses on her waist and above; she is slightly turned to the side, gazing at the viewer with a calm and gentle expression. She has long, straight hair.{argument name="hair color" default="Deep indigo black"} Her hair, thick bangs covering her forehead, with many strands blowing to the right in the wind, framed large, soft brown-grey eyes, fair skin, and a faint blush on her cheeks. She wore a wide-brimmed natural straw hat with dark ribbons and a simple white sleeveless summer dress with thin straps and minimalist details. The lighting was bright afternoon sunlight, rendered with soft cel animation, featuring subtle contour lighting, clean lines, delicate gradients, and a dreamlike, exquisite illustration style. The overall atmosphere was light, nostalgic, elegant, and peaceful, with the background filled with sky, devoid of buildings or other clutter.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张宁静的动漫风格夏季肖像，描绘了一位年轻女性站在户外，背景是湛蓝的天空，画面边缘可见 4 朵柔和的白云，空气中漂浮着些许微小的闪烁光点。画面采用低角度拍摄，取景范围约为腰部以上，她微微侧身，神情平静温柔地注视着观众。她留着一头长直的 {argument name="hair color" default="深靛黑色"} 头发，厚重的齐刘海遮住额头，许多发丝在风中向右飘动，有着大而柔和的棕灰色眼睛、白皙的皮肤，脸颊带着淡淡的红晕。她戴着一顶带有深色饰带的宽檐天然草帽，身穿一件简单的白色无袖夏日连衣裙，细肩带设计，细节简约。光线为明亮的午后阳光，采用柔和的赛璐珞动漫渲染，带有微妙的轮廓光、干净的线条、细腻的渐变以及梦幻般的精致插画风格。整体氛围轻盈、怀旧、优雅且平和，背景由天空填满，没有建筑物或其他杂物。
