templates.title: Low-angle anime summer scene with hands reaching out

titleLocalized.zh: 低角度动漫夏季伸手画面

templates.prompt: A dramatic, anime-style summer scene, shot from an extremely low angle, creates a strong perspective and shortening effect: a young woman in a flowing white summer dress and a wide-brimmed straw hat stands on a sun-drenched country road, extending one hand directly towards the camera. Her outstretched palm dominates the foreground with its exaggerated perspective, as if inviting the viewer to take her hand. She has very long {argument name="hair color" default="Dark black"} Her hair billowed powerfully to the side in the wind, the white ribbon tied to her hat fluttering in the air. Her sleeveless dress, with soft pleats, was light and breathable, tied with a fabric bow at one side of her waist, her skin and fabric shimmering with bright sunlight highlights. The composition emphasizes dynamism, scale, and cinematic depth, making the character appear towering against a cobalt blue summer sky filled with wisps of clouds and fluffy white clouds near the horizon. She is placed on a paved country road, flanked by rustic wooden fences, with green fields and low mountains in the distance in the background. The crisp cel animation rendering, complemented by painterly details, saturated colors, bright midday light, high contrast, and ultra-clean lines, creates a sense of awe and freedom. No text, no other characters, a single-figure illustration.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的动漫风格夏季场景，采用极低角度拍摄，具有强烈的透视缩短效果：一位年轻女性身穿飘逸的白色夏日连衣裙，头戴宽檐草帽，站在阳光明媚的乡村小路上，将一只手直接伸向镜头。她张开的手掌以夸张的透视感占据了前景，仿佛在邀请观众牵住她的手。她有着非常长的 {argument name="hair color" default="深黑色"} 头发，在风中强劲地向侧面飘动，帽子上系着的白色丝带也在空中飞舞。她的连衣裙为无袖设计，带有柔和的褶皱，轻盈透气，腰间一侧系有布艺蝴蝶结，皮肤和布料上闪烁着明亮的阳光高光。构图强调了动态、尺度感和电影般的深度，角色在充满几缕纤细云丝和地平线附近蓬松白云的钴蓝色夏季天空映衬下显得高大。将她置于一条铺设好的乡村小路上，道路两侧是质朴的木栅栏，背景是绿色的田野和远处的低矮山脉。采用清晰的赛璐珞动漫渲染，辅以绘画般的细节、饱和的色彩、明亮的正午光线、高对比度、超干净的线条，营造出一种敬畏与自由的感觉。无文字，无其他角色，单人主题插画。

templates.title: Scene of female students at a rural train station

titleLocalized.zh: 乡村车站女学生场景

templates.prompt: A cinematic, anime-style illustration depicts a tranquil Japanese rural train station in early summer, imbued with a nostalgic travel atmosphere and bright midday sunlight. In the foreground on the left, a high school girl stands alone on the platform, her body slightly turned towards the viewer, her posture shy and gentle, her legs together, one foot slightly turned inward. She has {argument name="hair color" default="black"} She had a short bob haircut with smooth bangs, and wore a classic Japanese sailor school uniform: a white long-sleeved sailor shirt with navy blue trim, a bright red scarf, a dark navy blue pleated skirt, white socks, and dark brown loafers. One hand hung at her side, carrying a dark-colored schoolbag. Her expression should have been calm with a slight hint of melancholy, as if she was about to speak before the train pulled into the station. Place her next to an old wooden station building with large window panes and a simple wooden bench. Above her hangs a station sign that reads {argument name="station name" default="Yamanoshita Station"} Below is a smaller Romanized version of "YAMANOSHITA" along with brief local route information. A railway track extends from the right half of the image into the distance, flanked by lush meadows and wildflowers. A small local train is slowly approaching in the distance. A few telephone poles are added beside the tracks. In the background, magnificent mountains are visible, their peaks capped with snow, under a clear blue sky dotted with white clouds. The composition balances the perspective between the figures on the left and the railway tracks on the right. The background is rich in detail, the sunlight is clear, and a soft, anime-style rendering is used. The textures of the wood at the station and the railway tracks are realistic, creating an overall atmosphere of genuine, slice-of-life travel.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅电影质感的动漫风格插画，描绘了初夏时节宁静的日本乡村火车站，充满旅行的怀旧气息和明亮的正午阳光。画面前景左侧，一位高中女生独自站在站台上，身体微微朝向观众，姿态羞涩而温柔，双腿并拢，一只脚向内侧倾斜。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"} 的短波波头，刘海柔顺，身穿经典的日本水手服校服：白色长袖水手衫搭配海军蓝饰边、鲜红色的领巾、深海军蓝百褶裙、白袜和深棕色乐福鞋。她的一只手垂在身侧，提着一个深色的书包。她的表情应当显得平静而略带一丝惆怅，仿佛在火车进站前正欲开口说话。将她置于一座陈旧的木质车站建筑旁，建筑带有大块窗格和一张简单的木长椅。她上方悬挂着 1 块车站站牌，上面写着 {argument name="station name" default="山ノ下駅"}，下方配有较小的罗马拼音“YAMANOSHITA”以及简短的当地线路信息。画面右半部分延伸出 1 组铁轨，向远方延伸，铁轨旁是郁郁葱葱的草地和野花，远处有 1 列小型地方列车正缓缓驶来。在铁轨旁添加几根电线杆。远景处展现出壮丽的山脉，山顶覆盖着残雪，天空湛蓝，点缀着几朵白云。构图需平衡左侧的人物与右侧的铁轨透视，背景细节丰富，阳光清澈，采用柔和的动漫渲染风格，车站木材与铁轨的质感真实，整体营造出一种真挚的生活片段式旅行氛围。

templates.title: Japanese skincare product advertisement

titleLocalized.zh: 日系护肤水广告

templates.prompt: An advertisement for a high-end Japanese skincare lotion was shot in a bright, softly lit white studio, showcasing a clean and luminous beauty aesthetic. On the right side of the image is a close-up portrait of a young East Asian woman with flawless, hydrated skin, naturally glossy lips, delicate peach-toned makeup, deep brown eyes, and long, dark hair loosely tied back with a few strands framing her forehead. She smiles gently at the camera, resting her chin on her hand, wearing a simple white sleeveless top. On the left side of the image is a tall, transparent frosted lotion bottle, standing upright on a reflective surface of water, its surface adorned with tiny water droplets and a shimmering silver cap. The bottle is labeled "SUIREN" and "MOISTURIZING LOTION." Three pale pink cherry blossoms adorn the bottle: two clustered in the lower left corner, and one floating on the bottom right. Subtle shimmer and the soft reflection on the water's surface further enhance the effect. The campaign uses white, pearl, blush pink, and very light blue-gray tones, combined with diffused sunlight, silky skin contouring, and a shallow depth-of-field effect to create the feel of a high-end cosmetics advertisement. On the left, elegant black Mingchao-style Japanese text is added: large double-line headlines read “触れたくなる、” and “透明感.”; below are two smaller lines of text, “うるおい満ちて、” and “澄みわたる素肌へ.”; a thin-lined circle containing two phrases separated by an × is added, namely “高濡膜” and “透明感.” In the lower right corner, smaller Japanese text reads “うるおいが、私を輝かせる.”, below which is the brand name “SUIREN” and the subtitle “MOISTURIZING LOTION.” The overall composition is balanced and luxurious, presenting a magazine-quality visual effect for spring skincare posters.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高端日系护肤水广告，在明亮柔和的白色影棚中拍摄，呈现出干净、通透的美容美学。画面右侧为一位年轻东亚女性的特写肖像，她拥有无瑕水润的肌肤、自然的亮泽双唇、精致的桃色系妆容、深棕色眼眸，深色长发松散地扎在脑后，额前散落着几缕发丝。她对着镜头温柔微笑，单手托腮，身穿简约的白色无袖上衣。画面左侧放置 1 个高挑的透明磨砂化妆水瓶，直立在反光的水面上，瓶身带有细小的水珠，配有闪亮的银色瓶盖。瓶身标签印有“SUIREN”和“MOISTURIZING LOTION”。在瓶子周围点缀 3 朵淡粉色樱花：2 朵簇拥在左下角，1 朵漂浮在底部中右侧。添加淡淡的闪光和水面柔和的倒影。采用白色、珍珠色、腮红粉和极浅的蓝灰色调，配合漫射日光、丝滑的皮肤修饰、浅景深效果，营造出高级化妆品广告的质感。在左侧添加优雅的黑色明朝体日文文案：大号双行标题为“触れたくなる、”和“透明感。”；下方为两行较小的文字“うるおい満ちて、”和“澄みわたる素肌へ。”；添加一个细线条圆圈，内部包含两行短语，中间用 × 分隔，分别为“高保湿”和“透明感”。在右下角添加小号日文“うるおいが、私を輝かせる。”，下方标注品牌名“SUIREN”及副标题“MOISTURIZING LOTION”。整体构图平衡且奢华，呈现出杂志级春季护肤海报的视觉效果。

templates.title: Screenshot of a Japanese-style mobile game store

titleLocalized.zh: 柔和日系手游商店截图

templates.prompt: This is a beautifully designed Japanese-style mobile game promotional image, featuring a soft, pastel, and cute aesthetic. The format is a square advertisement divided into two columns. The left half has a light blush pink watercolor background, while the right half has a gradient background transitioning from warm cream to pink. A striking, deep rose pink round Japanese title is placed at the top of the left panel.{argument name="left headline text" default="Milk and a fluffy escape."} Below is a smaller gray subtitle{argument name="left subtitle text" default="Enter the world of gentle puzzle-solving."} Below, centered, is a modern smartphone model with a black border, showcasing the title screen of an adorable pastel escape game: a shimmering pink background, a fluffy cream-colored kitten with big, watery eyes, decorated with bubbles and hearts, and the Japanese logo "もふもふミルクにゃんこ". Below this is a smaller ribbon-like subtitle "脱出ゲーム" (Escape Game), and near the bottom is a circular "はじめる" (Hajimeru) start button. Scattered around the pink-background phone are translucent soap bubbles, small bows, hearts, and star-shaped sparkles. At the top of the right panel is a striking deep rose pink round Japanese title.{argument name="right headline text" default="Solve the mystery and escape the room."} Below is a smaller gray subtitle{argument name="right subtitle text" default="A 10-stage escape puzzle"} Below, centered, is a second smartphone model with a black border, showcasing the in-game scene: a dreamy pastel pink room with striped wallpaper, featuring a wooden shelf or dressing table, three small plush animals on the top shelf, three empty square boxes or slots on the middle shelf, and two small items on the bottom shelf, including a pink rectangle and a tilted card-like object. The phone's UI includes a tiny room title "Milk no Oheya" in the upper left corner, a small circular icon in the upper right corner, a vertical lock icon on the right edge, and a light-colored text bar at the bottom displaying "I don't know." The overall composition should evoke the feel of a gentle puzzle game's App Store screenshot, with soft lighting, pastel pink and cream tones, rounded fonts, clean spacing, and a cute and feminine aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的日系手游宣传图，采用柔和的粉彩可爱风格，格式为左右双栏分割的方形广告。左半部分为淡腮红粉色水彩背景，右半部分为暖奶油色至粉色的渐变背景。左侧面板顶部放置一个醒目的深玫瑰粉色圆体日文大标题 {argument name="left headline text" default="ミルクと、ふわふわ脱出。"}，下方配有较小的灰色副标题 {argument name="left subtitle text" default="やさしい謎解きの世界へ"}。下方居中放置一个黑色边框的现代智能手机模型，展示可爱粉彩逃脱游戏的标题画面：背景为闪烁的粉色，画面中有一只长着水汪汪大眼睛的毛茸茸奶油色小猫，装饰着气泡和爱心，日文 Logo 显示为“もふもふミルク にゃんこ”，下方带有较小的丝带状副标题“脱出ゲーム”，底部附近有一个圆形的“はじめる”开始按钮。在粉色背景的手机周围，散布着半透明的肥皂泡、小蝴蝶结、爱心和星形闪光。在右侧面板顶部放置一个醒目的深玫瑰粉色圆体日文大标题 {argument name="right headline text" default="謎を解いて、おへやを抜けだそう。"}，下方配有较小的灰色副标题 {argument name="right subtitle text" default="全10ステージの脱出パズル"}。下方居中放置第二个黑色边框的智能手机模型，展示游戏内画面：一个梦幻般的粉彩粉色房间，带有条纹壁纸，配有一个木制架子或梳妆台，顶层架子上排着 3 只小毛绒动物，中间架子上有 3 个空的方形框或槽位，底层架子上有 2 个小物件，包括一个粉色长方形物品和一个倾斜的卡片状物体。手机 UI 左上角添加一个微小的房间标题“ミルクのおへや”，右上角有一个小圆形图标，右侧边缘有一个垂直的锁图标，底部有一个淡色的文字栏，显示“アイテムがまだないよ”。整体构图应呈现出温和解谜游戏的 App Store 截图质感，光线柔和，采用粉彩粉色与奶油色调，搭配圆润的字体、整洁的间距以及可爱且女性化的美学风格。

templates.title: Gentle Japanese-style mobile game advertisement

titleLocalized.zh: 柔和日系手游广告

templates.prompt: Create an adorable Japanese-style mobile game promotional poster, vertically divided into two halves. The background uses a soft watercolor style, with shimmering, translucent bubbles scattered around the canvas. The left half features a gradient from mint green to light yellow, while the right half transitions from cream to pale pink. Place a bold, rounded Japanese title in a light blue-green font in the top left corner.{argument name="left headline text" default="Find it, get inspired, meow."} Below is a smaller, soft brownish-grey subtitle:{argument name="left subtitle text" default="Easy hints make it playable for everyone."} A bold, raspberry-pink, rounded Japanese title is placed in the upper right corner:{argument name="right headline text" default="ミニゲームも、たっぷり。"} Below is a smaller, soft purple-gray subtitle:{argument name="right subtitle text" default="Play endlessly with memory games, puzzles, and slide games."} Two prototype smartphones with black bezels, facing forward, are placed in the center of each half. The left screen displays a hidden object game scene set in a bright, sunroom filled with lush tropical plants. A cream-colored hammock hangs diagonally in the center of the scene, the floor is covered in pink tiles, and warm sunlight streams through the glass windows. Soft glass balls hang from the windows, and a lemon is in the lower left foreground. Cute little characters are hidden in the scene. The top of the phone's UI displays the room title in Japanese.{argument name="left game screen title" default="おひるねサンルーム"} The right side of the phone screen displays a memory game interface with a light pink background, a back arrow, and the Japanese title "マカロン記憶ゲーム" (Makara no Kiseki Game) centered at the top. A three-step progress indicator (step 1 is highlighted, steps 2 and 3 are grayed out) is displayed below, along with the small text "よく見てにゃ…" (You see…). Four macarons (in a 2x2 grid) are arranged on the screen: pink in the upper left, blue in the upper right, yellow in the lower left, and white in the lower right, each with a soft circular shadow below it. A small twinkling star icon and two decorative macarons are added to the lower right corner of the screen, along with small heart-shaped doodles nearby. The overall style is that of a sophisticated app promotional visual: cute, clear, elegant, and soft-focus, with rounded fonts, delicate gradients, and subtle floral details, presenting the advertising quality of a high-end casual game.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张可爱的日系手游宣传海报，垂直平分为左右两半，背景采用柔和的水彩画风，画布周围散布着光泽感十足的半透明气泡。左半部分为薄荷绿到浅黄色的渐变，右半部分为奶油色到淡粉色的渐变。左上角放置一个粗体青绿色的圆润日文大标题：{argument name="left headline text" default="見つけて、ひらめいて、にゃ。"}，下方配有较小的柔和棕灰色副标题：{argument name="left subtitle text" default="やさしいヒントで誰でも遊べる"}。右上角放置一个粗体树莓粉色的圆润日文大标题：{argument name="right headline text" default="ミニゲームも、たっぷり。"}，下方配有较小的柔和紫灰色副标题：{argument name="right subtitle text" default="記憶・パズル・スライドで遊びほうだい"}。左右两半的中心各放置一台正面朝向的黑色边框智能手机样机。左侧手机屏幕显示一个隐藏物品类游戏画面，场景位于明亮的温室阳光房中，布满茂盛的热带植物，奶油色吊床斜跨在画面中间，地面铺设粉色瓷砖，温暖的阳光透过玻璃窗洒下，挂着柔和的玻璃球，左下角前景处有柠檬，场景中隐藏着可爱的小角色；手机 UI 顶部显示日文房间标题：{argument name="left game screen title" default="おひるねサンルーム"}。右侧手机屏幕显示一个记忆类小游戏界面，背景为淡粉色，带有返回箭头，顶部居中显示日文标题“マカロン記憶ゲーム”，一个 3 步进度指示器（第 1 步高亮，第 2、3 步变灰），下方有小字说明“よく見てにゃ…”，界面中排列着 4 个马卡龙（2x2 网格）：左上粉色、右上蓝色、左下黄色、右下白色，每个马卡龙下方都有柔和的圆形阴影。在手机外右下角添加小星星闪烁图标和两个装饰性马卡龙，并在附近点缀细小的心形涂鸦。整体风格为精致的应用宣传主视觉图，可爱、通透、优雅、柔焦，搭配圆润的字体、细腻的渐变、微妙的花卉细节，呈现出高级休闲游戏的广告质感。

templates.title: Bedroom casual snapshots

titleLocalized.zh: 卧室休闲抓拍照片

templates.prompt: A candid, softly lit lifestyle photograph shows a young woman relaxing on a white bed in a minimalist bedroom. Shot vertically, from near her knees with a slightly wide angle, her legs and oversized top dominate the foreground. She reclines on the bed, wearing an oversized navy or black sweatshirt paired with very short light blue frayed denim shorts, her legs visible in the foreground. Her arms are raised overhead, her posture relaxed and languid, one wrist loosely bent. Her face is mostly obscured by her arms and the angle of the shot, creating a sense of unposed intimacy. The bed is set against a light gray wall, covered with wrinkled white sheets and large white pillows. To the left, near the window with sheer curtains, stands a freestanding clothes rack with eight hangers displaying neutral-toned clothing in black, white, beige, and gray, with a blue garment draped over the top bar. To the right and behind the bed, seven books are neatly arranged on a narrow shelf against the wall. Utilizing natural sunlight streaming in from the left-hand window, the design creates soft shadows, gentle cool tones, a subtle film grain, shallow depth of field, and a tranquil Japanese apartment aesthetic. It emphasizes a relaxed weekend atmosphere, understated realism, and a subtle presence that captures private moments rather than direct eye contact.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张抓拍的、光线柔和的生活方式照片，展示了一位年轻女性在极简卧室的白色床上休憩。采用竖构图拍摄，镜头从靠近她膝盖的位置以略微广角拍摄，使她的双腿和超大号上衣在前景中占据主导地位。她斜躺在床上，身穿一件超大号深海军蓝或黑色卫衣，搭配非常短的浅蓝色毛边牛仔短裤，前景中露出双腿。她的双臂举过头顶，姿态放松而慵懒，一只手腕松弛地弯曲，脸部大部分被手臂和拍摄角度遮挡，营造出一种未经摆拍的私密感。床靠在浅灰色墙壁前，铺着褶皱的白色床品和巨大的白色枕头。在左侧靠近带有透明窗帘的窗户旁，放置一个独立的衣架，上面挂着 8 个衣架，展示着黑色、白色、米色和灰色的中性色调服装，上方横杆还披着一件蓝色衣物。在床的右后方，墙边的窄架上整齐排列着 7 本竖放的书籍。利用从左侧窗户射入的自然日光，营造柔和的阴影、柔和的冷色调、轻微的胶片颗粒感、浅景深以及宁静的日式公寓美学。强调放松的周末氛围、低调的写实主义，以及捕捉私密瞬间的微妙存在感，而非直接的眼神交流。

templates.title: Gothic street style anime avatars

titleLocalized.zh: 哥特街头风动漫头像

templates.prompt: A centered, anime-style half-body portrait depicts a gender-neutral young man facing a clean, light gray-white background. The square composition is designed specifically for social media icons. The character has medium-length, layered, straight hair parted in the middle, predominantly black with glossy deep purple highlights, and vibrant purple at the ends and lower half. Strands of hair frame the face, falling to the shoulders. A large, softly edged, square, blurred area deliberately obscures the center of the face in a soft, pale purple-gray hue, obscuring the eyes, nose, and most of the facial features, revealing only part of the jawline and neck. Only a hint of pale skin is faintly visible at the edges of the blurred area. The right ear is adorned with multiple silver piercings, including small hoops, studs, and a cross-shaped pendant earring with chain details. The outfit is a dark, monochromatic streetwear style with a subtle gothic aesthetic: an inner black turtleneck top zipped up to the throat, layered under an oversized, semi-matte black jacket. One shoulder features a black strap with a rectangular metal buckle, while the other is adorned with a delicate chain. A long silver necklace with a cross pendant hangs from the chest. The lighting is soft and even, showcasing exquisite digital painting details and a semi-realistic anime rendering effect. The overall atmosphere is cool, stylish, slightly mysterious, and unconventional. Sparse, minimalist cyberpunk glitch art elements are added to the background: several thin vertical stripes and tiny rectangular pixels are scattered around the figure, in colors of pale cyan, lavender, magenta, and dark blue, with a faint four-pointed star near the upper right corner. The background remains clean and transparent, with the figure dominating the image.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张居中的动漫风格半身肖像，描绘了一位中性化的年轻人，正面对着干净的浅灰白色背景。构图为方形，专为社交媒体图标设计。角色留着中长款层次感直发，中分，发色以黑色为主，带有光泽的深紫色高光，发梢和下半部分染有鲜艳的紫色。零散的发丝修饰着脸庞，头发垂至肩部。面部中央被一个大面积的柔边方形模糊块刻意遮挡，色调为柔和的淡紫灰色，遮住了眼睛、鼻子和大部分五官，仅露出部分下颌线和颈部。模糊区域边缘仅隐约透出一点苍白的肤色。右侧可见的耳朵上装饰着多个银色穿孔，包括小圆环、耳钉以及带有链条细节的十字架吊坠耳环。服装为暗黑单色街头风格，带有微妙的哥特美学：内层为拉链拉至喉咙的高领黑色上衣，外搭一件黑色超大款半哑光夹克，一侧肩部配有带矩形金属扣的黑色绑带，另一侧肩部则配有细链条装饰。胸前垂挂着一条带有十字架吊坠的长款银色项链。光线柔和且均匀，呈现出精致的数字绘画细节和半写实动漫渲染效果。整体氛围酷炫、时尚、略带神秘感且风格另类。背景中添加稀疏的极简赛博故障艺术元素：人物周围散布着几条细长的垂直条纹和微小的矩形像素点，颜色为淡青色、薰衣草色、洋红色和深蓝色，右上角附近还有一个淡淡的四角星光点。保持背景简洁通透，人物占据画面主体。

templates.title: Anime BL promotional thumbnail

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫 BL 宣传缩略图

templates.prompt: A bright and refined anime-style promotional thumbnail with a romantic summer vibe. The composition employs visual segmentation, with large typographic text on the left and two handsome young men on the right. On the left, a semi-transparent white overlay panel with a soft, shimmering effect is placed against a sky-blue background, displaying the elegant blue gradient of the large, elegant serif font "GPT" at the top and the lavender-to-purple gradient "BL" below. Between and below this text are three lines of Japanese text: "最新の像生成で" (I'm creating the latest image), "作って" (I made it), and "游んでみた" (I played it), in a dark blue calligraphic font. Subtle decorative elements are added, such as twinkling stars, diagonal beams of light, dotted textures, and a cyan underline arc below the central text. On the right, two anime boys are shown in casual poses, leaning against a wire fence under green trees. The taller boy has messy, dark brown short hair, wears a white T-shirt under a navy blue cardigan, and layered silver necklaces, holding an iced coffee with a straw. The shorter boy has messy, silver-white short hair, wears a white T-shirt with a small badge on the chest, carries a black backpack, and wears layered silver necklaces and a small earring. Their posture is relaxed and intimate, with the dark-haired boy's arm draped over the other boy's. The bright blue and white color scheme, complemented by soft sunlight, lens flare, blurred effects, and a faint cityscape in the background, creates a clean and simple aesthetic reminiscent of a social media header or article thumbnail.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张明亮且精致的动漫风格宣传缩略图，带有夏日浪漫氛围。构图采用视觉分割，左侧为大号排版文字，右侧为两位帅气的年轻男子。在左侧，于天蓝色背景上放置带有柔光和闪烁效果的半透明白色层叠面板，顶部显示蓝色渐变的大号优雅衬线体文字“GPT”，下方为薰衣草色至紫色的渐变文字“BL”。在文字之间及下方排列三行日文：“最新の画像生成で”、“作って”和“遊んでみた”，采用深蓝色书法字体。添加微妙的装饰元素，如小星星闪光、对角线光束、点状纹理，以及中间文字下方的一道青色下划线弧线。在右侧，展示 2 位动漫少年半身像，他们靠在绿树下的铁丝网旁，姿态随意。个子较高的少年留着凌乱的深棕色短发，身穿白色 T 恤外搭海军蓝开衫，佩戴叠层银项链，手持一杯插着吸管的冰咖啡。个子较矮的少年留着凌乱的银白色短发，身穿胸前带有小徽章的白色 T 恤，双肩背着黑色双肩包，佩戴叠层银项链和一只小耳环。他们的姿势轻松亲密，深发少年将手臂搭在另一位少年身上。采用明亮的蓝白配色，辅以柔和的阳光、镜头光晕、虚化效果以及背景中淡淡的城市景观，营造出简洁的社交媒体页眉或文章缩略图美感。

templates.title: Anime Knight King on the Burning Battlefield

titleLocalized.zh: 燃烧战场上的动漫骑士王

templates.prompt: A highly dramatic anime-style fantasy battle illustration, featuring the protagonist as {argument name="character name" default="Artoria Pendragon"} A young female knight with emerald green eyes, her blonde hair styled in a braided bun, with loose bangs and a single tuft of hair, is depicted in a powerful, low-angle, mid-range full-body composition. She stands in the center of the frame, gripping a massive, luminous golden sword, its blade angled upwards along the left side of the image, adorned with ornate blue inlays and subtle runic engravings. She wears royal armor of blue and silver: a deep cobalt blue gown with gold trim, polished steel breastplate and skirt armor, heavy armored gauntlets, and multiple layers of plate armor covering her torso and hips; her white petticoat is partially torn and stained from battle. Her expression is serious, focused, and resolute, staring straight ahead as if facing an enemy. The background is a burning battlefield under a deep navy blue night sky, thick clouds, and faint starlight; the air is filled with embers, flames, ruined structures, broken spears, scattered swords, and debris. Two visible banners, blue with gold emblems, are also visible in the background, partially damaged and fluttering in the smoke. Subtle bloodstains and battle damage are added to the lower armor, sparks drift in the air, a strong cinematic silhouette light from the flames behind, reflective highlights on the metal, and a high-contrast hero composition. Ultra-fine polished anime illustrations, Fate-style knight king aesthetics, tense atmosphere, sharp lines, rich blue and gold color scheme, vertical composition, SFW.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅极具戏剧性的动漫风格奇幻战斗插画，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="阿尔托莉雅·潘德拉贡"}，一位拥有翠绿色双眸的年轻女骑士，金发梳成编织发髻，留着松散的刘海和一根呆毛，采用强有力的低角度中景全身构图。她站在画面中央，双手紧握一把巨大的发光金剑，剑身沿画面左侧向上倾斜，带有华丽的蓝色镶嵌和淡淡的符文雕刻。她身着蓝银相间的皇家铠甲：深钴蓝色礼服配金色饰边，抛光的钢制胸甲和裙甲，厚重的装甲护手，以及覆盖躯干和臀部的多层板甲，白色的衬裙部分因战斗而破损且沾满污垢。她表情严肃、专注且坚定，直视前方，仿佛正在面对敌人。背景是深海军蓝夜空下的燃烧战场，云层厚重，隐约可见星光，空气中弥漫着余烬、火焰、废墟结构、断裂的长矛、散落的剑和残骸。背景中包含 2 面可见的旗帜，旗面为蓝色，带有金色纹章，部分破损并在烟雾中飘扬。在下部铠甲上添加细微的血迹和战斗损伤，火花在空中飘散，身后火焰产生的强烈电影感轮廓光，金属上的反射高光，以及高对比度的英雄构图。超精细抛光动漫插画，Fate 风格骑士王美学，氛围紧张，线条锐利，蓝金配色丰富，垂直构图，SFW。

templates.title: Elegant anime girl on the flower street

titleLocalized.zh: 花街上的优雅动漫少女

templates.prompt: A highly detailed anime illustration depicts a stylish young woman strolling elegantly along a European-style flower street, using a standing pose that shows her full body to three-quarters of her body. She possesses {argument name="hair color" default="Deep indigo"} Her hair is styled in two extremely long pigtails, with a soft sheen and loose strands, adorned with white roses tied with black ribbons and ruffled hair accessories. She wears a romantic white mini-dress with a fitted, belted top, a sweetheart neckline, a black bow at the chest, layered ruffles, a dramatically asymmetrical outer skirt, and a white rose embellishment at the waist. Her accessories include a black choker with white floral embellishments, a black armlet, two white ruffled wristbands, two black stockings, two sheer black knee-high socks with lace trim, and she carries a small black handbag. Her expression should be delicate, elegant, and slightly shy, with one hand lightly brushing her hair aside and the other carrying the bag. The background is set in a sun-drenched cobblestone shopping alley, lined with boutique windows, flowerbeds, and soft pastel-colored buildings, with two signs reading "Rose Town" and "Rose Garden" respectively. It employs bright spring light and shadow, cool blue-purple shadows, shimmering highlights, rich floral details, and a dreamy, exquisite, and high-end anime painting style.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度精细的动漫插画，描绘了一位时尚年轻女性在欧式花街上优雅出游的场景，采用全身至四分之三身位的站姿。她拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="深靛蓝色"} 的秀发，发型为两根极长的双马尾，带有柔和的光泽和散落的发丝，并配有系着黑色丝带的白玫瑰与荷叶边发饰。她身穿一件浪漫的白色迷你裙，配有修身的束腰式上衣、心形领口、胸前的黑色蝴蝶结、层叠的荷叶边、极具戏剧性的不对称外裙，以及腰间的白玫瑰装饰。她的配饰包括 1 条带有白色花朵装饰的黑色颈圈、1 个上臂黑色臂环、2 个白色荷叶边腕带、2 条黑色吊带袜、2 只带有蕾丝边的透明黑色过膝袜，并手提 1 个黑色小手袋。她的表情应显得细腻、优雅且略带羞涩，一只手轻撩发丝，另一只手提着包。背景设定在阳光明媚的鹅卵石购物巷，街道两旁是精品店橱窗、花坛和柔和的粉彩色建筑，可见 2 块分别写着“Rose Town”和“Rose Garden”的招牌。采用明亮的春日光影、冷蓝紫色的阴影、闪烁的高光、丰富的花卉细节，以及梦幻、精致、高端的动漫绘画风格。

templates.title: The Fourth Crusade's chaotic and satirical posters

titleLocalized.zh: 第四次十字军东征混乱恶搞海报

templates.prompt: A chaotic, fictional Japanese movie poster themed around world history, designed with the style of a Hollywood blockbuster comedy-action epic, tells the story of the Fourth Crusade's complete misdirection, ultimately attacking Constantinople instead of heading to Jerusalem. The dense, boisterous, and ironic composition presents a dramatic collage of historical battlefields against a backdrop of bright blue skies, flames, smoke, medieval ships, domed buildings, city walls, and a large Crusader army. In the central foreground, a full-body portrait of a medieval Crusader in a dirty white tunic with a large red cross points directly at the viewer, surrounded by four other medieval figures in ornate robes, hoods, helmets, and merchant attire; their faces are blurred in soft rectangles, making the poster appear as a satirical cast reveal. At the top of the poster, large bright pink Japanese calligraphy reads {argument name="headline text" default="I'm completely lost when it comes to direction."} Above and below are smaller black Japanese slogans. A torn vertical headline on the left explains in striking yellow Japanese that they intended to go to Jerusalem but somehow destroyed the Byzantine Empire. Two huge parchment banners span the upper center: one states that the initial destination was Jerusalem, while the larger central banner declares Jerusalem as the destination in striking red Japanese, followed by smaller black text explaining that this was supposed to be the plan. In the upper right corner, a nailed parchment project board contains a list of five comedic routes, complete with icons and arrows: Departure, No Money, Bowing to Venice, Minor Attack on Zara, then Constantinople, and finally, indicated by a red line, that they somehow arrived there. There are eight speech bubbles and labels around the characters: one reads "Eh, huh?", one "No money...", one "Just doing orders, let's go.", one "A little detour.", one "I messed up, haha.", one "Zara? We've been there!", one labeled "Contract" with an expensive note, and one pointing to Venice as a sponsor. Additional wooden or parchment location signs indicate three locations: Zara, Venice, and Constantinople, with Japanese side notes identifying them as Christian or Byzantine cities. The lower half becomes darker and more catastrophic, showcasing a burning Byzantine-style city with a large domed church similar to the Hagia Sophia, naval battles, collapsed buildings, orange flames, and black smoke. At the bottom center, a huge, distressed yellow and white Japanese title announces the film as "The Fourth Crusade," stating that Constantinople burned due to getting lost, with a rough texture, heavy projection, and an explosive movie poster style. To the right of the title area, a red stamp-like blast label reads in Japanese that the story begins around 1204. At the very bottom is a narrow cast list containing six small actor thumbnails with Japanese labels, and a tiny, forged credits at the foot of the page. In the lower right corner is a bright pink star-shaped badge with yellow and white Japanese writing {argument name="badge text" default="It's a historical fact. It's unbelievable, though."} Overall style: absurd historical parody, cinematic key visuals, Japanese theatrical posters, high detail, a combination of photo-realistic composites and exaggerated graphic design, weathered paper texture, striking cartoon-style titles, comedic educational tone, and epic war film energy.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张以世界历史为主题的混乱虚构日式电影海报，设计风格如同好莱坞大片般的喜剧动作史诗，讲述了第四次十字军东征彻底迷路，最终攻击了君士坦丁堡而非前往耶路撒冷的故事。构图密集、喧闹且充满讽刺意味，在明亮的蓝天、火焰、浓烟、中世纪船只、圆顶建筑、城墙和十字军大军的背景下，呈现出一幅戏剧性的历史战场拼贴画。在画面中央前景，一名身穿脏兮兮白色束腰外衣、带有大红十字架的中世纪十字军战士全身像正指向观众，周围环绕着另外四名身着华丽长袍、兜帽、头盔和商人服饰的中世纪人物；他们的面部被柔和的矩形模糊处理，使海报看起来像是一场恶搞的演员阵容揭秘。海报顶部，巨大的亮粉色日文毛笔字写着 {argument name="headline text" default="方向性、完全に迷子。"}，上方和下方配有较小的黑色日文标语。左侧一条撕裂的垂直标题用醒目的黄色日文解释说，他们本打算前往耶路撒冷，却不知为何摧毁了拜占庭帝国。两条巨大的羊皮纸横幅横跨中上部区域：一条写着最初的目的地是耶路撒冷，中间较大的横幅用醒目的红色日文声明目的地是耶路撒冷，随后附有较小的黑色文字说明这本该是计划。右上角，一块钉着的羊皮纸项目板包含了一个 5 步喜剧路线列表，配有图标和箭头：出发、没钱、向威尼斯低头、轻微攻击扎拉，然后是君士坦丁堡，最后用红线暗示他们不知何故抵达了那里。角色周围共有 8 个对话气泡和标注标签：一个写着“诶，哈？”，一个写着“没钱……”，一个写着“奉命行事，走吧。”，一个写着“小绕路。”，一个写着“我搞砸了，哈哈。”，一个写着“扎拉？我们经过那里了！”，一个标注为“合同”并附注价格昂贵，还有一个指向威尼斯作为赞助商标签。额外的木制或羊皮纸地点标志标注了 3 个地点：扎拉、威尼斯和君士坦丁堡，并附有日文侧注，将其标识为基督教或拜占庭城市。下半部分变得更加黑暗和灾难化，展示了一座燃烧的拜占庭风格城市，有着类似圣索菲亚大教堂的大型圆顶教堂、海战、倒塌的建筑、橙色的火光和黑烟。底部中央，巨大的做旧黄色和白色日文标题字体宣布这部电影为《第四次十字军东征》，并称君士坦丁堡因迷路而燃烧，带有粗糙质感、厚重的投影和爆炸性的电影海报风格。标题区域右侧，一个红色印章式爆炸标签用日文写着故事始于 1204 年左右。最底部是一条狭窄的演员栏，包含 6 个带有日文标签的小型演员缩略图，页脚处还有微小的伪造演职员表。右下角放置了一个亮粉色的星形徽章，上面用黄色和白色日文写着 {argument name="badge text" default="史実です。信じられないけど。"}。整体风格：荒诞历史恶搞、电影级主视觉图、日式剧场海报、高细节、照片合成写实主义与夸张平面设计的结合、风化的纸张纹理、醒目的漫画式标题、喜剧教育基调、史诗战争片能量。

templates.title: A female student and her cat by the sunlit window

titleLocalized.zh: 阳光窗边的女学生与猫

templates.prompt: A warm, realistic indoor portrait with a large, sun-drenched window as the background. In the picture, a young woman in a Japanese school uniform sits on a wooden windowsill, cradling a tabby cat. The woman has a neat, chin-length bob haircut, and her hair is [color missing].{argument name="hair color" default="Medium brown"} She has side-swept bangs, her face partially obscured by a simple, centrally centered, blurred square. She wears a white shirt with a large blue-green plaid bow, paired with a matching blue-green plaid pleated skirt, and a soft, oversized beige knit cardigan. Her posture is relaxed and gentle, one hand lightly stroking a cat's head. The cat is a brown-black tabby with bright green eyes, facing the camera, wearing mini blue denim overalls over its white shirt. Utilizing the soft, golden hour natural light streaming in from the left window, the lush garden outside is rendered with a creamy, blurred effect. The vertical mid-range composition creates a warm and comforting atmosphere, showcasing realistic skin texture, fabric patterns, delicate cat fur details, shallow depth of field, and a serene, natural candid feel.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张温暖、写实的室内肖像，背景是一扇洒满阳光的大窗户。画面中，一位身穿日本校服的年轻女性坐在木质窗台上，怀里抱着一只虎斑猫。女性留着整洁的齐下巴波波头，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="中棕色"}，侧分刘海，脸部被一个居中的简单方形模糊块遮挡。她穿着白色衬衫，系着大号蓝绿格纹蝴蝶结，搭配同色系的蓝绿格纹百褶裙，外罩一件柔软的米色大廓形针织开衫。她姿态放松温柔，一只手轻轻抚摸着猫咪的头。这只猫是棕黑色条纹虎斑猫，有着明亮的绿色眼睛，正对着镜头，身上穿着一件套在白衬衫外面的迷你蓝色牛仔背带裤。利用从左侧窗户射入的柔和黄金时刻自然光，窗外郁郁葱葱的花园呈现出奶油般的虚化效果。采用竖构图的中景拍摄，营造出温馨治愈的氛围，展现逼真的皮肤质感、织物纹理、细腻的猫毛细节、浅景深以及宁静自然的抓拍感。

templates.title: Soft pastel anime girl full-body portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 柔和粉彩动漫少女全身像

templates.prompt: A full-body anime girl character design against a pure white background, with the character centered and slightly floating. The design employs a soft, minimalist pastel style, complemented by extremely fine gray lines and delicate flat color washes. She possesses a petite, youthful figure and a cute, gentle profile, with particular emphasis on a soft, rounded face, smooth cheeks, and a softened jawline and chin. Her face is obscured by a blank, skin-colored rectangle, devoid of any facial features. She has a short bob haircut, and her hair color is {argument name="hair color" default="Light gray-brown"} Her hair was slightly disheveled with light, airy ends, and long bangs partially covered her forehead. A pale blue-gray ribbon was tied on her right side. She wore three visible pieces of clothing: an oversized pale blue cardigan with loose cuffs and front buttons; a cream-white slip dress with a scalloped neckline and small buttons adorning the chest; and a ruffled hem with a small ribbon near her right thigh. She was barefoot, her legs slender and fair. She stood facing forward, her arms relaxed naturally outward with open palms. One leg was straight, while the other was slightly bent inward, presenting a shy and graceful posture. The entire illustration should convey a sense of lightness, cuteness, understated elegance, and neatness, like a simple Japanese anime fashion sketch, with ample white space, no props, no shadows, and no background elements.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个全身动漫少女角色设计，背景为纯白色，角色居中且略微悬浮。采用柔和的极简粉彩风格，配以极细的灰色线条和精致的平涂色彩。她拥有娇小年轻的身材和可爱温柔的轮廓，特别强调柔和圆润的脸型、平滑的脸颊以及柔化的下颌线和下巴。她的面部被一块空白的肤色长方形遮挡，没有任何五官细节。她留着短波波头，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="浅灰棕色"}，发丝微乱且发梢轻盈，长刘海遮住部分额头，右侧系着一个淡蓝灰色的丝带发饰。她穿着 3 件可见的服装：一件超大款淡蓝色开衫，袖口宽松且带有前扣；一件奶油白色吊带裙，领口呈扇贝形，胸前有小纽扣装饰；裙摆带有褶边，右大腿附近饰有一条小丝带。她赤脚，双腿纤细白皙，正面站立，双臂自然向外放松，手掌张开，一条腿伸直，另一条腿向内轻微弯曲，呈现出害羞且轻盈的姿态。整幅插画应给人一种轻盈、可爱、低调且整洁的感觉，如同简单的日式动漫时尚草图，留白充裕，无道具、无阴影，且无背景元素。

templates.title: silver-haired anime girl design

titleLocalized.zh: 全身银发动漫少女设计

templates.prompt: A full-body anime girl character design, standing in the center against a pure light gray background, facing forward, with a neutral and symmetrical posture, arms slightly hanging down, hands naturally relaxed outwards. She has a soft, youthful face, fair skin, large, warm brown eyes, and a gentle smile. Her hair is {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} Her hair was very long and straight, falling past her waist, with thick, side-swept bangs covering her right eye, and two metal hair clips visible on her left side. She wore a dangling earring in each ear. Her outfit was a cute, monochromatic idol-style dress with subtle pale blue accents: a white short-sleeved puff-sleeved blouse with a ruffled square neckline and a small black bow at the center of the chest; a black belt with a round silver buckle at the waist; and a light gray, multi-layered skirt with ruffled trim and a voluminous texture. A thin silver chain draped diagonally across the skirt. She wore a black choker with pale blue ruffles around her neck. She wore two black fingerless gloves with pale ruffled cuffs; two white over-the-knee stockings secured by two visible garters; and two black Mary Jane platform shoes with ankle straps. Using clean cel animation lines, soft pastel tones, minimalist shadows, clear design sketches, a frontal character reference style, no props, no background, and no text.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个全身动漫少女角色设计，居中站立在纯浅灰色背景上，正面朝向，姿态中性对称，双臂微垂，双手自然向外放松。她拥有柔和的青春面容、白皙的皮肤、大而温暖的棕色眼睛和温柔的浅笑。她的头发是 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色"}，非常长且直，垂过腰部，厚重的侧分刘海遮住了右眼，可见的左侧别着 2 个金属发夹。她每只耳朵戴着 1 个吊坠耳环。她的服装是一套可爱的单色系偶像风格连衣裙，带有微妙的淡蓝色点缀：白色短泡泡袖衬衫上衣，配有荷叶边方领，胸前中心有一个黑色小蝴蝶结；腰部系着黑色束腰带，配有圆形银色环扣；裙子为浅灰色多层短裙，带有荷叶边饰边，质感蓬松。在裙子上斜挂一条细银色腰链。脖子上戴着 1 个带有淡蓝色荷叶边的黑色颈圈。她戴着 2 只黑色露指手套，配有淡色荷叶边袖口；穿着 2 只白色过膝袜，由 2 条可见的吊袜带固定；脚穿 2 只黑色玛丽珍厚底鞋，配有脚踝绑带。使用干净的赛璐珞动漫线条，柔和的粉彩色调，极简阴影，清晰的设计图呈现，正面角色参考风格，无道具，无背景，无文字。

templates.title: Anime-style winter camping

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫风格冬日露营

templates.prompt: A cozy winter camping scene unfolds inside a large beige canvas tent, presented in a semi-realistic anime illustration style, featuring natural lighting and lifelike environmental details. The image accurately depicts two young women seated around a small kerosene heater used as a camping table, with a large black metal pot resting atop it. The wide-angle shot, taken slightly above their sitting height, creates a snapshot-like feel from inside the tent. The woman on the left has {argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown"} She had a high ponytail with messy bangs, wore a fluffy brown fleece jacket, dark trousers, and a red lanyard with her name tag. She sat leaning forward on a low camping chair, using chopsticks to hold a small bowl or food container. The woman on the right had {argument name="hair color" default="black"} She has shoulder-length short hair, wears a dark purple hoodie, a black down vest, light gray sweatpants, and dark shoes. She sits on another low camping chair, resting her chin on her hand, relaxed and slightly sleepy. Both of their faces are obscured by soft rectangular blurs, as if anonymized when the photo was posted. Around them, the image should include four clearly visible red beverage cans: two on a wooden table near the center, one in the lower right foreground (partially cropped), and one further to the right. Three wooden benches are arranged in a low U-shape around a heater. Add detailed camping elements: an olive-colored duffel bag on the ground to the left, a plastic storage box containing supplies behind the woman on the left with a white plastic shopping bag on top, a small bowl on the table, a bag of brightly colored snacks on a wooden board to the right, a soft brown cloth on the ground on the far left, and a black metal rack standing to the right rear. The tent interior should feature taut canvas walls, clearly defined seams and support poles, a gravel floor, and an overall warm, soft color scheme. Retain the texture of a real camping photograph, only transforming the figures into anime-style figures, while maintaining a high degree of realism in the environment.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个温馨的冬日露营场景，位于大型米色帆布帐篷内，呈现为半写实动漫插画风格，具备自然光影和逼真的环境细节。画面中准确展示 2 位年轻女性，她们围坐在一个用作露营桌的小型煤油取暖器旁，取暖器上方放着一个大型黑色金属锅。视角采用略高于坐姿高度的广角抓拍构图，使画面呈现出帐篷内随手拍摄的快照感。左侧女性留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 的高马尾，带有凌乱的刘海，身穿蓬松的棕色抓绒外套、深色长裤，并佩戴着挂有工牌的红色挂绳。她坐在低矮的露营椅上身体前倾，正用筷子夹着手中的小碗或食物容器。右侧女性留着 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"} 的齐肩短发，身穿暗紫色连帽衫，外搭黑色羽绒马甲，下身穿着浅灰色运动裤和深色鞋子。她坐在另一把低矮的露营椅上，单手托腮，姿态放松且略显困倦。两人的面部均用柔和的矩形模糊块遮挡，如同发布照片时进行了匿名处理。在她们周围，画面中需包含 4 个清晰可见的红色饮料罐：2 个位于中心附近的木质桌板上，1 个位于右下角前景处（部分裁切），另 1 个位于右侧较远位置。取暖器周围环绕着 3 块木质长凳板，呈低矮的 U 型排列。添加细致的露营元素：左侧地面放置 1 个橄榄色行李袋，左侧女性身后放置 1 个装有补给品的塑料收纳箱，箱子上放着 1 个白色塑料购物袋，桌上放着 1 个小碗，右侧木板上放着 1 包色彩鲜艳的零食，最左侧地面铺着 1 块柔软的棕色布料，右后方立着 1 个黑色金属架。帐篷内部应呈现紧绷的帆布墙面、清晰的接缝和支撑杆，地面为碎石，整体色调温暖柔和。保留真实露营照片的质感，仅将人物转化为动漫风格，同时保持环境的高度写实。

templates.title: Monochrome anime gothic style dress girl

titleLocalized.zh: 单色动漫哥特风连衣裙少女

templates.prompt: A full-body anime-style illustration depicts a slender young woman standing in a neutral pose against a clean, light gray-white background, the composition centered like a character design sketch. She has very long, straight hair.{argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} Her hair fell below her waist, soft, layered bangs obscuring one eye, and long sideburns framed her face. The style was exquisite, with soft shadows and highly refined colors, delicate lines, and subtle fabric folds, presenting a modern idol gothic aesthetic. She wore a short, ruffled white and light gray dress with eight prominent black buttons at the front, short puff sleeves with ruffled cuffs, ruffled shoulder straps, and a small black bow at the square neckline. The skirt featured a multi-layered, asymmetrical, light ruffled design. She wore a ruffled lace choker. A wide black belt was tied at her waist with a large silver circular buckle and a strap ending in a metal ring. She wore two black fingerless gloves with ruffled cuffs and silver bracelet details, and two white over-the-knee stockings. Two black garter straps extended from the skirt and were secured to the stockings. Her shoes were patent black Mary Jane heels with ankle straps and small bows at the toes. Add a small cross pendant earring to the visible ear. Maintain an overall monochromatic style with white, gray, black, and silver as the main colors to create a soft, elegant atmosphere and a clean studio look.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张全身动漫时尚插画，描绘了一位身材苗条的年轻女性，以中性姿态正面站立在干净的浅灰白色背景前，构图如同角色设计图纸般居中。她拥有非常长的直发，{argument name="hair color" default="银白色"} 发丝垂至腰部以下，柔软的层次感刘海遮住了一只眼睛，长长的侧发修饰着脸型。画风精致、柔和阴影且高度润色，线条细腻，布料褶皱微妙，呈现出现代偶像哥特美学。她穿着一件白色与浅灰色相间的短款褶边连衣裙，正面有 8 颗显眼的黑色纽扣，短泡泡袖，袖口有荷叶边，肩带带有褶边，方领口处饰有一个黑色小蝴蝶结，裙摆为多层不对称的轻盈褶边设计。颈部佩戴着褶边蕾丝颈圈。腰间系着一条宽大的黑色腰带，配有巨大的银色圆形环扣，并垂下一条末端带有金属环的带子。她戴着两只带有荷叶边袖口和银色手链细节的黑色露指手套，穿着两只白色过膝袜，裙摆上延伸出两条黑色吊袜带分别固定在双腿的丝袜上。鞋子为漆皮黑色玛丽珍高跟鞋，配有踝带和鞋头小蝴蝶结。在可见的耳朵上添加一个小巧的十字架吊坠耳环。整体色调保持以白色、灰色、黑色和银色为主的单色风格，营造出柔和优雅的氛围和干净的摄影棚展示效果。

templates.title: Convert RPG maps into anime event scenes

titleLocalized.zh: 将 RPG 地图转换为动漫事件场景

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference images, transform the top-down RPG town map into exquisite anime-style event illustrations viewed from human eye level. Retain the same village locations and layout clues: the central stone well, network of paths, hedges, wooden houses, and the narrow canal on the left. Transform the two small pixelated characters by the well into two full-size fantasy characters in the foreground: a silver-haired mage in a purple robe and staff, and a blonde elf in green-brown adventurer attire, both looking down into the well. Add a cinematic JRPG atmosphere with soft sunlight, detailed painterly rendering, crisp line art, and soft depth of field. Maintain the feeling that the scene is located in the same town square, but enhance it with natural perspective, richer environmental details, and add five background villagers: one male figure cropped at the left edge, two small figures standing on the central path in the distance, and two townspeople conversing beside a building on the right.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图像，将俯视视角的 RPG 城镇地图转换为从人眼高度观察的精致动漫风格事件插画。保留相同的村庄位置和布局线索：中央的石井、路径网络、树篱、木屋以及左侧狭窄的水渠。将井边的 2 个小型像素角色转换为前景中 2 个全尺寸的奇幻角色：一位身穿紫色长袍、手持法杖的银发法师，以及一位身穿绿棕色冒险者服装的金发精灵，两人正俯身看向井内。添加具有电影感的 JRPG 氛围，采用柔和的日光、细腻的绘画渲染、清晰的线条艺术以及柔和的景深效果。保持场景位于同一城镇广场的感觉，但通过自然的透视、更丰富的环境细节进行增强，并加入 5 位背景村民：左侧边缘处截取了 1 名男性，远处中央路径上站着 2 个小人影，右侧建筑旁有 2 位正在交谈的镇民。

templates.title: Anime character photos set in a real izakaya

titleLocalized.zh: 置身于真实居酒屋的动漫角色照片

templates.prompt: This candid photo, taken in a realistic anime style, shows two young women sitting at a worn wooden table in a Japanese izakaya (Japanese pub). The background is a striped wooden wall with a transparent plastic curtain on the right. The camera is positioned slightly above the table, shooting diagonally to create a casual snapshot feel. The woman in the foreground on the left has her back to the camera and leans forward; she has long, straight black hair and wears a thick, dark blue or black down jacket with a large hood. The second woman sits opposite her, facing the camera, relaxed, with one arm bent and resting on the table; she has shoulder-length dark brown to black hair parted in the middle, wearing a black down jacket over a light-colored top. The only difference is that the figures are replaced with clean, natural anime characters, while maintaining the realistic photographic quality of the restaurant environment. The mixed-media visual effect of combining anime characters with a real photograph is preserved. The table should include: two stainless steel cups, two pairs of chopsticks, a smartphone with a bright blue phone case on the left edge of the table, a pack of cigarettes next to the woman on the right, a large oval plate with thinly sliced ​​white onions and lemon wedges, a small dish of green vegetables, a small dish of brown food, a small dish of toast or bread, a small dark bowl, two small white empty bowls, and a handwritten Japanese menu in the lower right corner. The upper left corner of the background includes a wooden counter displaying white ceramic bottles and cutlery, and a handwritten Japanese menu poster on the wall. Warm indoor lighting, a casual nightlife atmosphere, a documentary-style realism, delicate wood grain, a slightly cluttered tabletop—an authentic Japanese casual dining scene.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张采用写实动漫风格的室内餐厅抓拍照，展示了两位年轻女性坐在日本居酒屋里一张陈旧的小木桌旁，背景是竖条纹木板墙，右侧有透明的塑料帘。相机位置略高于桌面，呈对角线拍摄，营造出随意的快照感。左侧前景中的女性背对镜头，身体前倾；她留着黑色长直发，身穿一件厚实的深蓝色或黑色羽绒服，戴着大兜帽。第二位女性坐在她对面，面向镜头，姿态放松，一只手臂弯曲放在桌上；她留着齐肩深棕色至黑色中分发型，身穿黑色羽绒服，内搭浅色上衣。仅将人物替换为干净、自然的动漫角色，同时保持餐厅环境的真实摄影质感不变。保留动漫角色与真实照片合成的混合媒介视觉效果。桌上需包含：2 个不锈钢杯子、2 双筷子、桌子中左侧边缘有一部带有亮蓝色手机壳的智能手机、右侧女性旁有一包香烟、1 个盛有薄切白洋葱和柠檬角的大椭圆形盘子、1 小碟绿色蔬菜、1 小碟褐色食物、1 小碟吐司或烤面包、1 个深色小碗、2 个白色空小碗，以及桌子右下角放着一张手写的日文菜单。左上角背景处包含一个摆放着白色陶瓷瓶和餐具的木制柜台，以及 1 张手写的日文墙面菜单海报。温暖的室内灯光，日常夜生活氛围，纪录片式的写实感，细腻的木纹，略显杂乱的桌面，地道的日本休闲餐饮场景。

templates.title: Tech company CEO meme photos

titleLocalized.zh: 科技公司 CEO 模因照片

templates.prompt: A photorealistic, meme-style outdoor close-up shows three tech company CEOs standing side-by-side, the composition subtly tense yet friendly. The foreground on the left is {argument name="left person" default="Sam Altman"} A half-length portrait of a man with short, dark, curly hair, pale skin, wearing a dark crew-neck shirt, his expression exaggerated and mocking, eyebrows raised, a crooked smile playing on his lips, looking at the man to his right. In the center of the background is {argument name="center person" default="Satya Nadella"} A bald man, wearing rectangular black glasses and a dark jacket, calmly smiled as he looked at the man to his right. The man in the foreground on the right was {argument name="right person" default="Elon Musk"} The image primarily shows the back and profile of the figure, wearing a black leather jacket. The person in the middle has their hand on the shoulder, a gesture that appears familiar and slightly possessive. The technique utilizes shallow depth of field, natural overcast daylight, blurred trees in the background, and a candid news photo feel. Three bold white labels with thick black outlines are added near each figure: the one next to the figure on the left is labeled "..."{argument name="left label" default="Sam Altman"} The figure in the middle is marked with "{argument name="center label" default="Satya Nadella"} The figure on the right is marked with "{argument name="right label" default="Elon Musk"} The overall atmosphere should evoke the feel of an industry insider meme, incorporating subtle social dynamics and sarcastic facial expressions.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张照片级逼真的模因风格户外特写，三位科技公司 CEO 并肩站立，构图微妙而紧张又不失友好。左侧前景是 {argument name="left person" default="Sam Altman"}，半身像，留着深色短卷发，肤色苍白，身穿深色圆领衫，表情夸张且带有戏谑感，挑着眉毛，嘴角带着一丝歪斜的微笑，正看向右侧的男子。背景中央是 {argument name="center person" default="Satya Nadella"}，秃顶，戴着黑色长方形眼镜，身穿深色夹克，平静地微笑着看向右侧的男子。右侧前景是 {argument name="right person" default="Elon Musk"}，主要呈现背影和侧脸，身穿黑色皮夹克，中间的人物将手搭在他的肩上，姿态显得熟悉且略带占有欲。使用浅景深、自然的阴天日光、背景模糊的树木，以及抓拍的新闻照片质感。在每个人物附近添加 3 个带有黑色粗描边的加粗白色标签：左侧人物旁标注“{argument name="left label" default="Sam Altman"}”，中间人物上方标注“{argument name="center label" default="Satya Nadella"}”，右侧人物旁标注“{argument name="right label" default="Elon Musk"}”。整体氛围应呈现出一种行业内部人士模因的感觉，包含微妙的社交动态和讽刺的面部表情。

templates.title: Nike surreal poster based on reference image

titleLocalized.zh: 基于参考图的 Nike 超现实海报

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, recreate the same surreal Nike fashion ad almost exactly as described, presenting it as a beautifully crafted poster: retaining the minimalist studio style with cool tones, a giant white Nike sneaker stands at a steep diagonal angle on its heel, a female model in all-white clothing leans against the shoe from the right three-quarters of the way down, against a backdrop of a large "NIKE" logo and a glossy, semi-reflective floor. To make the composition more compact and cinematic, the giant shoe occupies the left half, with the model standing on the right half, hands in her pockets. Render the "NIKE" text in the background as a large, bold white word, spanning behind the main subject and partially obscured by the sneaker and the model. Add two lines of elegant white sans-serif text at the bottom center: "Made for comfort, worn for confidence." and "Because life feels better when you move without limits." Leave the upper right corner blank, without adding any additional text, logos, watermarks, signatures, or explanatory text. Ultra-clean premium advertising texture, soft diffused cool light, delicate floor reflection, high detail, 3:4 aspect ratio.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图，几乎完全按照描述重新生成同样的 Nike 超现实时尚广告，并将其呈现为一张精美成品海报：保留冷色调的极简主义摄影棚风格，一只巨大的白色 Nike 运动鞋以陡峭的对角线角度立于鞋跟上，一位身着全白服装的女性模特以右侧四分之三侧面倚靠在鞋子旁，背景为一个巨大的“NIKE”字样，以及光泽感半反射地板。使构图更紧凑、更具电影感，巨大的鞋子占据左半部分，模特全身站立于右半部分，双手插在口袋里。将背景中的“NIKE”文字渲染为一个巨大的粗体白色单词，横跨在主体后方，并被运动鞋和模特部分遮挡。在底部中心添加两行优雅的白色无衬线字体标语：“Made for comfort, worn for confidence.” 以及 “Because life feels better when you move without limits.” 保持右上角留白，不要添加任何额外的文字、Logo、水印、署名、签名或说明文字。超洁净的高级广告质感，柔和的漫反射冷光，细腻的地板倒影，高细节，3:4 宽高比。

templates.title: Gothic Magical Girl and Magic Circle

titleLocalized.zh: 哥特风魔法少女与魔法阵

templates.prompt: A full-body anime fantasy illustration depicts a confident young magical girl standing at the center of a glowing magic circle inside a dark cathedral. She has {argument name="hair color" default="gold"} She has twin ponytails with large, spiraling curls at the ends, bangs, bright blue eyes, and a composed yet slightly playful smile. She wears a gothic black and dark navy blue ruffled dress with gold filigree trim, a tight-fitting bodice, multiple ruffles, puff sleeves, black gloves, and several dark blue ribbon bows. Black lace stockings adorn her thighs, and she wears shiny black ankle boots with bows. Her raised right hand holds a magnificent magic wand with a rounded head decorated with wings, star patterns, and a glowing pink crystal core. Behind her are two enormous, glowing, stained-glass wings, composed of intricate white and pink magical lines, creating the visual effect of angel wings. Pinkish-purple magical energy bands, floating sparks, and scattered glowing fragments surround her body and the foreground. On the ground is a large, complex magic circle with runes and layered concentric symbols, radiating intense pink and pale purple light. The visuals employ a dynamic, low-angle composition, with the character centered, one leg extended forward, skirt billowing outwards, and staff reaching towards the viewer. Dramatic, fantastical lighting, high contrast, and an ultra-refined anime-style rendering, along with rich shades of black, purple, and neon pink, sharp lines, and glossy highlights, create an epic magical transformation atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张全身动漫奇幻插画，描绘了一位自信的年轻魔法少女，她站在黑暗大教堂内部一个发光的魔法阵中心。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="金色"} 的双马尾，发梢带有大卷螺旋状卷发，留着齐刘海，拥有一双明亮的蓝色眼睛，嘴角带着从容且略显俏皮的微笑。她身穿一件哥特风黑色与深海军蓝相间的荷叶边连衣裙，饰有金色花丝镶边、紧身胸衣系带、多层褶边、泡泡袖、黑色手套和多个深蓝色丝带蝴蝶结，大腿上系着黑色蕾丝吊带袜，脚蹬饰有蝴蝶结的亮面黑色短靴。她举起的右手握着一根华丽的魔法杖，杖头呈圆形，带有翅膀状装饰、星星图案和一个发光的粉色水晶核心。她身后有 2 个巨大的发光彩色玻璃状翅膀，由错综复杂的白色和粉色魔法线条构成，营造出天使之翼的视觉效果。她的身体周围和前景中环绕着粉紫色的魔法能量带、漂浮的火花和散落的发光碎片。地面上是一个巨大的复杂魔法阵，带有符文和层叠的同心符号，放射出强烈的粉色和淡紫色光芒。画面采用动态的低角度构图，角色居中，一条腿向前迈出，裙摆向外飘扬，法杖向观众方向延伸。采用戏剧性的奇幻光影，高对比度，超精细的动漫渲染风格，丰富的黑色、紫色和霓虹粉色调，锐利的线条，光泽感高光，营造出史诗般的魔法变身氛围。

templates.title: Fantasy Tokyo Coexisting Urban Landscape

titleLocalized.zh: 奇幻东京共存城市景观

templates.prompt: A wide-format, cinematic anime-style key visual depicts a bustling modern Tokyo neighborhood transformed into a multicultural fantasy metropolis under a bright afternoon sky and fluffy clouds. The scene unfolds from a street perspective, along a wide pedestrian boulevard looking towards a large red torii gate in the distance, surrounded by stone steps, crowds, and dense commercial buildings. A Japanese castle stands atop a green mountain behind the city blocks. In the background, a towering radio tower resembling Tokyo Skytree is positioned slightly to the right of the center. The sky needs to be precisely filled with eight flying fantasy and science fiction elements: two large dragons, two winged humanoid angels, a giant flying saucer, and three smaller UFOs scattered further away. The city should evoke a social atmosphere where humans and fantasy races coexist naturally. Numerous brightly colored digital billboards and vertical signs are added to the buildings, including advertisements with Japanese text and fantasy characters; the largest curved screen on the left should display the text "Shinpi Sekai 神秘世界ようこそ" (Shinpi Sekai 神秘世界ようこそ), and a billboard below should mention a society where multiple races coexist. In the foreground, six prominent characters should be placed on the street: On the far left is a tall, elven female student with long brown hair, pointed ears, wearing a white shirt with a bow tie and a plaid skirt; in the center left is a humanoid crocodile or lizard-man in casual wear, wearing a jacket and pendant; nearby is a child with an animal ear, carrying a red backpack, wearing a scarf; to the left center is a white-haired boy with white wings wearing a light-colored jacket; to the right center is a silver-haired female student with cat ears wearing a light-colored jacket and a dark pleated skirt; to the center right is a black-haired boy wearing a black hoodie and carrying a backpack; and on the far right is a blonde, pointed-eared elven female student wearing a white short-sleeved shirt with a tie and a brown plaid skirt. In the midground and background, add a group of pedestrians, including more fantastical creatures. Additionally, add three more fantastical figures perched or high on the right-hand building: a black-clad, black-winged girl standing on a ledge, a small blonde, elven-like girl floating near the rooftop, and a small golden winged creature near the street. Style: Exquisite high-detail anime illustrations, light novel promotional art, sharp lines, vibrant colors, clear atmospheric perspective, bright sunlight, soft shadows, highly detailed city signage, full of fantasy, coexistence and world-building.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张宽幅电影感动漫主视觉图，描绘了一个繁华的现代东京式街区，在明亮的午后蓝天与蓬松云朵下，变身为一座多元文化的奇幻大都市。场景从街道视角展开，沿着宽阔的步行大道望向远方中心的一座大型红色鸟居，周围有石阶、人群、密集的商业建筑，城市街区后的绿山上矗立着一座日本城堡。背景中，一座酷似东京晴空塔的超高广播塔位于中心偏右侧。天空中需精确填充 8 个飞行中的奇幻与科幻元素：2 条大型飞龙、2 位长翅膀的人形天使、1 个巨大的飞碟以及 3 个散落在更远处的较小 UFO。城市应呈现出人类与奇幻种族自然共存的社会氛围。在建筑物上添加许多色彩鲜艳的数字广告牌和竖向招牌，包括日文文本和奇幻角色广告；左侧最大的曲面屏幕应显示文本“Shinpi Sekai 神秘世界 ようこそ”，下方的一个广告牌应提及多元种族共存的社会。在前景中，街道上需放置 6 位显眼的角色：最左侧是一位长棕发、尖耳朵、身穿白衬衫配蝴蝶结和格子裙的高挑精灵女学生；左中是一位身穿休闲装、戴着夹克和吊坠的人形鳄鱼或蜥蜴人；他附近是一个背着红色书包、戴着围巾、长着动物耳朵的小孩；中左是一位身穿浅色夹克、长着白色羽翼的白发少年；中右是一位身穿浅色夹克和深色百褶裙的银发猫耳女学生；右中是一位身穿黑色连帽衫、背着书包的黑发少年；最右侧是一位金发、尖耳朵、身穿白色短袖衬衫配领带和棕色格子裙的精灵女学生。在中景和背景中，添加一群行人，其中包括更多奇幻物种。此外，在右侧建筑上额外添加 3 位栖息或高处的奇幻人物：1 位站在壁架上的黑衣黑翼少女、1 位在屋顶附近漂浮的小型金发精灵状女孩，以及 1 位在街道附近的小型金色带翼生物。风格：精致的高细节动漫插画、轻小说宣传艺术、锐利的线条、鲜艳的色彩、清晰的空气透视、明亮的阳光、柔和的阴影、高度精细的城市标识，充满奇幻感、共存感与世界观构建。

templates.title: Urban fantasy coexistence time travel

titleLocalized.zh: 都市奇幻共存穿越

templates.prompt: This is a richly detailed anime-style urban fantasy illustration set in a bright and sunny busy Tokyo intersection, employing a street perspective and a wide-angle cinematic composition. The city blends modern realism with mythological fantasy: towering buildings with huge billboards covering their facades, a red radio tower visible in the distance, and pedestrians crowding the crosswalks under a blue sky and white clouds. The foreground showcases seven core characters: on the far left is a silver-haired elven woman in a flowing white dress, holding an iced drink and a canvas bag; in the center is a girl with long black hair, black animal ears, wearing a navy blue school uniform suit, plaid skirt, blue bow tie, and carrying a large navy blue shoulder bag, touching her head; next to her is a young man in a dark suit looking down at his phone; a gender-neutral white-haired angel in an elegant white and gold dress, with enormous white wings on her back; beside the angel is a blonde little girl in a gorgeous pink ruffled dress; in the foreground on the right is a black-haired woman in a black coat, shown in profile; on the far right, near the cave entrance, stands a blue-haired cat-eared toddler in a blue dress with a bow. In the midground crowd, humans and fantastical races are naturally mixed together. In the background, four clearly visible non-human or supernatural creatures are added: a giant dragon flying in the sky, a winged female angel descending above the street, a lizard-headed merchant in a suit near the angel, and a tall, horned demon with crossed arms and red skin beside a hillside path. On the right side of the image, the city transitions into a lush shrine hillside, dotted with towering trees, red torii gates, stone steps, and wooden signs with Japanese kanji. Below is the entrance to a rocky cave tunnel emitting a blue glow, with a wooden sign hanging above it; several figures are entering a shared underground area illuminated by crystals. The cityscape showcases six main billboard/logo elements: a massive billboard on the left proclaims "Shinpi Sekai: The Mysterious World" accompanied by images of planets; a large political poster in the center features Japanese text and a fist-shaped icon; two different buildings display signs reading "Future Research Institute" on their rooftops; a large billboard on the right displays Japanese text about coexistence along with silhouettes of different races; and a vertical banner with Japanese text hangs from a nearby building. The theme emphasizes the coexistence of modern urban daily life and a hidden fantasy society. The visuals require clear anime lines, exquisite light novel-style main visual rendering, rich textures, soft sunlight, delicate atmospheric perspective, vibrant and realistic colors, meticulous costume details, and the creation of a stunning sense of everyday bustle and a profound world-building foundation.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张细节丰富的动漫风格都市奇幻插画，场景设定在晴朗明亮的东京式繁忙十字路口，采用街头视角和宽幅电影感构图。城市将现代写实与神话奇幻融为一体：高楼林立，外墙挂满巨幅广告牌，远处可见一座红色广播塔，蓝天白云下，人行横道上挤满了行人。前景展示 7 位核心角色：最左侧是一位身穿飘逸白裙、手持冰饮和帆布袋的银发精灵女性；中心是一位留着长黑发、戴着黑色兽耳、身穿海军蓝校服西装、格子裙、蓝色领结并背着大号海军蓝肩包的女生，正抬手触碰头部；旁边是一位低头看手机的深色西装青年；一位中性化的白发天使，身着优雅的白金配色礼服，背负巨大的白色羽翼；天使身旁是一位穿着华丽粉色褶边连衣裙的金发小女孩；右侧前景是一位身穿黑色大衣的侧身黑发女性；最右侧靠近洞穴入口处，站着一位身穿蓝色蝴蝶结连衣裙的蓝发猫耳幼童。中景人群中，人类与奇幻种族自然地混杂在一起。背景中加入 4 个清晰可见的非人或超自然生物：天空中飞翔的 1 条巨龙、街道上方降落的 1 位带翼女性天使、天使角色附近 1 位穿着西装的蜥蜴头商人，以及山坡小径旁 1 位双臂交叉、皮肤通红的高大长角恶魔。画面右侧，城市过渡为郁郁葱葱的神社山坡，点缀着参天大树、红色鸟居、石阶以及写有日文汉字的木制招牌。下方是一个散发着蓝色光芒的岩石洞穴隧道入口，入口上方挂着木牌，几个人影正走入由水晶照亮的地下共享区域。城市景观中展示 6 个主要的广告牌/标志元素：左侧巨大的广告牌写着“Shinpi Sekai 神秘世界”并配有宇宙行星图像；中央是一张带有日文和握拳图标的大型政治海报；两栋不同建筑的屋顶分别设有写着“未来研究所”的标志；右侧是一张写有关于共存的日文内容并带有不同种族剪影的大型广告牌；附近建筑上还悬挂着 1 条写有日文的垂直横幅。强调现代城市日常生活与隐藏奇幻社会共存的主题。画面要求清晰的动漫线条、精致的轻小说主视觉渲染、丰富的质感、柔和的阳光、细腻的空气透视、鲜艳且真实感强的色彩、考究的服饰细节，并营造出令人惊叹的日常喧嚣感与深厚的世界观底蕴。

templates.title: Japanese classroom long hair snapshot

titleLocalized.zh: 日本教室长发快照

templates.prompt: This is a candid shot taken with a vertical mobile phone camera, capturing a photo-realistic scene of a Japanese high school classroom. The foreground features three female students in matching traditional dark blue sailor uniforms. The girl standing in the middle has extremely long, smooth, and glossy black hair that reaches below her knees, almost touching the ground; she is gently combing the ends of her hair with a small comb. The second girl stands behind her to the right, also with long, straight black hair, holding an open powder compact mirror in one hand and adjusting her sideburns or bangs with the other. The third girl kneels on the ground to the right, carefully cradling and tidying the middle girl's long hair. All three are wearing dark blue sailor-style uniforms with white stripes, pleated skirts, long sleeves, white socks, and indoor school shoes. Their faces are obscured or blurred. In the background, eight other students in dark uniforms sit at desks in small groups, their backs to the camera or turned to the side, creating the atmosphere of a typical classroom or class meeting. The classroom was furnished with wooden desks and chairs. Soft natural light streamed in through a large window on the left, and a green blackboard hung on the right wall. Notices were posted near the blackboard, and a sign above it read {argument name="wall sign text" default="Creativity and Integrity"} The plaque features Japanese calligraphy. The overall atmosphere is natural and unpretentious, like a snapshot from a documentary. It emphasizes realistic lighting, delicate details of hair strands, the unusually dramatic length of the middle girl's long hair, and a believable everyday school environment.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张采用竖屏手机摄影构图的抓拍风格、照片级真实的日本高中教室场景。画面前景的主体是三名身穿统一传统深蓝色水手服的女学生。中间站立的女生拥有一头极长、顺滑且富有光泽的黑发，长发垂至膝盖以下，几乎触及地面；她正低头用一把小梳子轻轻梳理发梢。第二名女生站在她身后右侧，同样留着长直黑发，一只手拿着打开的粉饼盒镜子，另一只手正在整理鬓角或刘海。第三名女生跪在右前方地面上，双手小心翼翼地捧着并整理中间女生的长发。三人都穿着深蓝色水手风校服，配有白色条纹装饰、百褶裙、长袖、白袜和室内校鞋。她们的面部被遮挡或模糊处理。背景中，另有 8 名身穿深色校服的学生坐在课桌旁，三五成群，背对或侧对着镜头，营造出普通课堂或班会课的氛围。教室里摆放着木制课桌椅，左侧的大窗户透进柔和的自然光，右侧墙上挂着一块绿色黑板，黑板附近贴着公告纸，黑板上方挂着一块写有 {argument name="wall sign text" default="创诚造实"} 的日本书法牌匾。整体氛围自然且不做作，如同纪录片式的快照。强调写实的灯光、细腻的发丝细节、中间女生长发不同寻常的戏剧性长度，以及真实可信的日常校园环境。

templates.title: Anime-style public relations representative at the industrial expo

titleLocalized.zh: 工业博览会上的动漫风公关代表

templates.prompt: An exquisitely designed anime-style illustration of a corporate booth, employing cel-shading and controlled highlights. The image depicts a young female public relations representative standing in three-quarter profile within a futuristic industrial exhibition space, illuminated by ambient lighting in cool purple and blue hues. Her face is partially obscured by a centrally located rectangular blur. She has extremely long, straight hair with a subtle purple undertone, cascading below her waist, adorned with geometric pendant earrings. She wears a sleek black business suit with white piping on the lapels, a dark shirt underneath, a fitted pencil skirt, a belt, and a prominent lanyard name tag. A white armband with the company logo and "OHNO HEAVY INDUSTRIES" is worn on her left arm. One arm holds a black display folder, also bearing the company logo and name; her other hand, palm up, gestures towards the booth display area, as if introducing the company. The booth's branding is prominent: a large, illuminated wall sign in the upper left corner displays the logo, the Japanese company name "大野重工株式会社" (Ohno Heavy Industries Co., Ltd.), the English name "OHNO HEAVY INDUSTRIES," and the slogan "BUILDING THE FUTURE. SUPPORTING THE WORLD." Below is a large poster display showcasing the skyline of an industrial refinery at dusk, accompanied by the Japanese text "技術で支え、未来を创る." (Support the future with technology) and smaller print below. In the lower left foreground, a standing nameplate displays the same logo and company name, along with the department name "広報部|PR DIVISION" and the representative's name "雲居モヤ" (KUMOI MOYA). Her hanging ID badge also displays the logo and smaller print indicating her public relations role. The exhibition features three visible industrial elements: a white architectural robot model on a base on the left, small mechanical devices in the mid-ground background, and a large white humanoid or armored industrial mech in the background on the right. It adopts a high-end exhibition or trade show setting, featuring glossy reflective surfaces, glass panels, sharp perspective lines, and brand panels throughout. The composition is vertical, framing the image from waist up to nearly full-body, with the character occupying the right-center position and the company logo clearly visible on the left. It emphasizes refined anime character design, a professional corporate ambassador aura, a futuristic heavy industrial brand feel, purple ambient lighting, and clean cel rendering effects, rather than overly dazzling special effects.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的动漫风格企业展位插画，采用赛璐珞着色和受控的高光处理。画面展示了一位年轻女性公关代表，她以四分之三侧面站立在充满未来感的工业展览空间中，空间内点缀着冷紫色和蓝色的氛围灯光。她的面部被一个居中的矩形模糊块遮挡。她留着极长的直发，发色带有微妙的紫色底色，长发垂至腰部以下，佩戴着几何形状的吊坠耳环。她身穿一套利落的黑色商务套装，翻领处有白色滚边，内搭深色衬衫，下着修身铅笔裙，系着腰带，并佩戴着显眼的挂绳工牌。她的左臂戴着一个白色臂章，上面印有公司 Logo 和“OHNO HEAVY INDUSTRIES”字样。她的一只手臂抱着一个黑色的展示文件夹，上面同样印有公司 Logo 和名称；另一只手掌心向上，向展位陈列区做出引导动作，仿佛正在介绍公司。展位品牌标识醒目：左上方有一块大型发光墙面招牌，上面印有 Logo、日文公司名“大野重工业株式会社”、英文名“OHNO HEAVY INDUSTRIES”以及标语“BUILDING THE FUTURE. SUPPORTING THE WORLD.”。下方是一块大型海报展板，展示了黄昏下的工业炼油厂天际线，并配有日文文案“技術で支え、未来を創る。”及下方的小字。在左下角前景处，放置一个立式铭牌，上面印有相同的 Logo 和公司名称，以及部门行“広報部 | PR DIVISION”和代表姓名“雲居 モヤ”（罗马音：KUMOI MOYA）。同时展示她悬挂的 ID 胸牌，上面印有 Logo 和暗示公关人员身份的小字。展览现场包括 3 个可见的工业展示元素：左侧底座上的一台白色建筑机器人模型，中景背景中的小型机械装置，以及右侧背景中一个大型白色人形或装甲工业机甲。采用高端展会或贸易展览场景，具有光泽的反射表面、玻璃面板、锐利的透视线条以及遍布各处的品牌展板。构图采用竖构图，取景范围从腰部以上到近全身，角色占据右中位置，左侧的公司标识清晰可辨。强调精致的动漫角色设计、专业的企业大使气质、未来重工业品牌感、紫色环境光，以及干净的赛璐珞渲染效果，而非过分闪耀的特效。

templates.title: Dark fantasy style PS5 RPG game cover art

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑奇幻风格 PS5 RPG 游戏封面艺术

templates.prompt: A striking key visual for a Japanese fantasy action RPG, designed in a style reminiscent of PlayStation 5 game cover posters. The vertical composition boasts exceptional detail, high contrast, and a cinematic dark fantasy aesthetic. The background features two colossal, dark purple dragons: the dominant one in the upper right corner, its mouth agape, orange flames flickering in its throat, and serrated obsidian scales with burning eyes; the silhouette of the other dragon in the upper left corner, its wings spanning the sky. A full moon hangs in the center of the sky, accompanied by purple nebulae, embers, ashes, and magical sparks. To the right, a dilapidated Gothic castle city lies in the background. In the foreground, three elven warriors stand in a triangular formation, clad in ornate metallic armor in shimmering magenta, silver, and violet hues. Center Character: A blonde elven princess warrior with medium-length hair, wearing a small crown or jeweled headdress, a white fur cloak draped over her shoulders, polished silver armor revealing her waist, and black gloves. She exudes confidence and wields a massive double-edged ceremonial axe, its blade adorned with intricate gold and silver filigree, a turquoise crystal core, and a beautifully carved silver-blue edge. Left Character: A tall elven archer warrior with long light brown hair, pointed ears, and exquisite rose-magenta armor. She wields a large, curved, fantastical longsword in her right hand and carries a quiver filled with pink arrows on her back. Right Character: An elven swordswoman with long, deep magenta hair, wearing floral headdresses, violet-magenta armor, and a black cloak. She wields a slender, downward-pointing sword. The image should present a designation {argument name="game title" default="ECLIPSE SAGA"} The original game boasts a sophisticated packaging aesthetic. It includes visible game packaging typography and branding elements: a white PS5 logo in the upper left corner; the studio label [O-prompt laboratory] in small brackets in the upper right corner; a large vertical Japanese slogan on the right; two lines of Japanese promotional text in the upper left; and a large, glowing gold serif main title at the bottom center, containing the following content:{argument name="game title" default="ECLIPSE SAGA"} Below is a smaller Japanese subtitle; the CERO C rating mark is in the lower left corner; there are three short Japanese descriptions of the game's features separated by diamond icons at the bottom center; and the OPL logo is in the lower right corner. The game employs a style that combines gorgeous anime-style illustrations with hyper-realism, rich details, delicate reflections, a fiery red outline, and contrasting purple and orange colors, giving it the feel of a mature, epic console fantasy adventure cover.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具张力的日式奇幻动作 RPG 主视觉图，设计风格仿照 PlayStation 5 游戏封面海报。竖构图，超高细节，高对比度，电影级暗黑奇幻风格。背景中可见 2 条巨大的黑紫色巨龙：右上方是一条占据主导地位的巨龙，嘴部大张，喉咙中闪烁着橙色的火焰，拥有锯齿状的黑曜石鳞片和燃烧的双眼；左上方是另一条巨龙的剪影，双翼横跨天际。天空中上方中央挂着一轮满月，伴有紫色星云、余烬、灰烬、魔法火花，右侧背景是一座破败的哥特式城堡城市。前景中，3 位精灵女战士呈英雄三角阵型站立，均身穿华丽的金属铠甲，呈现出亮面洋红色、银色和紫罗兰色调。中间角色：金发精灵公主战士，中短发，戴着小皇冠或珠宝头饰，肩披白色皮草斗篷，抛光银色铠甲露出腰部，佩戴黑色手套，姿态自信，手持一把巨大的双刃仪式斧，斧身有复杂的金银丝细工、绿松石水晶核心以及雕刻精美的银蓝色刀刃。左侧角色：身材较高的精灵弓箭手战士，留着浅棕色长发，尖耳朵，身穿精致的玫瑰洋红色铠甲，右手持一把巨大的弯曲奇幻长剑，背上背着装有粉色箭羽箭矢的箭袋。右侧角色：留着深洋红色长发的精灵女剑士，戴着花卉发饰，身穿紫罗兰洋红色铠甲，披着黑色斗篷，手持一把剑尖朝下的细长剑。图像应呈现出名为 {argument name="game title" default="ECLIPSE SAGA"} 的原创游戏的高级包装艺术感。包含可见的游戏包装排版和品牌元素：左上角白色 PS5 标志；右上角小型括号内工作室标签 [O-prompt laboratory]；右侧有大型竖排日文标语；左上方有 2 行日文宣传文案；底部中央有巨大的发光金色衬线字体主标题，内容为 {argument name="game title" default="ECLIPSE SAGA"}；下方有较小的日文副标题；左下角 CERO C 分级标志；底部中央有 3 段由菱形图标分隔的简短日文游戏特色介绍；右下角 OPL 标志。采用华丽的动漫绘画与超写实相结合的风格，细节丰富，反射效果细腻，带有火红色的轮廓光，紫色与橙色的色彩对比，整体呈现出成熟级史诗主机奇幻冒险封面的质感。

templates.title: Cover of a fantasy RPG featuring three female knights

titleLocalized.zh: 三位女骑士的奇幻 RPG 游戏封面

templates.prompt: A highly dramatic cover poster for a Japanese fantasy action RPG for PlayStation 5, employing a dark and opulent high fantasy style with a vertical composition reminiscent of high-end visual art. In the foreground, three armored female warriors stand valiantly against a backdrop of a glowing nighttime battlefield and a towering Gothic fantasy castle in the distance, punctuated by fireworks, embers, magical streaks, and a starlit, purplish-blue sky. The central figure is a blonde, elven-like knight with pointed ears, a fur collar, and silver-gold armor, wielding a massive double-headed ceremonial battle axe that spans the lower half of the image. The axe is richly detailed, featuring silver wirework, turquoise and blue crystal inlays, and an intricately carved circular blade. To the left stands a second female knight with long, deep red hair, wearing a steel and burgundy metallic breastplate, holding a downward-pointing sword; behind her, a large black raven with a single, glowing blue eye is faintly visible. A third female knight stands on the right, her long light brown hair obscuring her eyes. She has pointed ears and wears glossy magenta armor with a fantastical, revealing design; a quiver of arrows is visible behind her shoulder. Two red, bird-like creatures or phoenixes are added to the sky in the upper right corner. The overall atmosphere is epic, intense, and slightly gothic, filled with dense sparks, glowing particles, rimlight, and dazzling metallic reflections. A delicate, ornate gold border is added around the cover. A small circular logo and the text "O-prompt Laboratory" are placed in the upper left corner. The vertical Japanese slogan "絆と力に、运命を斬り拓け" is added to the right. A large, embossed gold serif font title for the game is placed at the bottom center:{argument name="game title" default="ELYSION"} Below this is a smaller serif capital letter subtitle:{argument name="subtitle" default="REBIRTH"} Below this is the Japanese subtitle "Ericion Ribers". The lower left corner features a realistic Japanese age rating badge with "CERO C" and the smaller text "Target audience: 15 years and older". At the bottom is the Japanese slogan "Beautiful knights, the battles that never end are now beginning." Below that is the English phrase "THE ETERNAL BATTLE OF THE KNIGHTS BEGINS NOW." This makes it look like exquisite AAA console box art for a fictional fantasy game—ultra-detailed, cinematic, richly textured, and with high contrast. The composition centers on three women and an oversized battle axe.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的日式奇幻动作 RPG PlayStation 5 游戏封面海报，采用深色华丽的高奇幻风格，构图呈垂直状，如同高级主视觉艺术。前景中，三位身披铠甲的女战士英勇站立，背景是发光的夜间战场和远处高耸的哥特式奇幻城堡，画面中点缀着烟花、余烬、魔法光迹以及星光璀璨的紫蓝色天空。中心人物是一位金发精灵般的骑士，有着尖耳朵、毛皮饰领、银金相间的铠甲，姿态威武，手中握着一把巨大的双头仪式战斧，横跨画面下半部分；战斧细节丰富，带有银色金属丝工艺、绿松石蓝水晶镶嵌以及复杂的圆形雕刻刀刃。左侧站着第二位女骑士，留着深红色长发，身穿钢色与酒红色调的金属胸甲，手持一把向下垂的剑；她身后隐约可见一只巨大的黑色乌鸦，有着一只发光的蓝色眼睛。右侧站着第三位女骑士，浅棕色长发遮住双眼，有着尖耳朵，身穿亮面洋红色铠甲，设计带有奇幻风格的露肤感；她肩后可见一筒箭矢。在右上方的天空中加入 2 只红色的飞鸟状生物或凤凰。整体氛围史诗、强烈且略带哥特感，充满密集的火花、发光粒子、轮廓光和华丽的金属反射。在封面四周添加一个华丽的细金边框。左上角放置一个小圆形徽标和文字“O-prompt Laboratory”。右侧添加竖排日文标语：“絆と力に、運命を斬り拓け”。底部中央放置巨大的浮雕金色衬线字体游戏标题：“{argument name="game title" default="ELYSION"}”，下方配以较小的衬线大写字母副标题：“{argument name="subtitle" default="REBIRTH"}”。在其下方添加日文副标题“エリシオン・リバース”。左下角包含一个写有“CERO C”的逼真日文年龄分级徽章，并附带小字“15才以上対象”。底部添加日文标语“美しき騎士たちの、終わりなき戦いが今、始まる。”，下方附带英文行“THE ETERNAL BATTLE OF THE KNIGHTS BEGINS NOW.”。使其看起来像是一款虚构奇幻游戏的精致 3A 主机盒装艺术，超精细、电影感、纹理丰富、高对比度，构图以三位女性和超大号战斧为核心。

templates.title: Miami Dock Action Movie Stills

titleLocalized.zh: 迈阿密码头动作电影剧照

templates.prompt: A photo{argument name="city" default="Miami"} A cinematic action still, shot on a sun-drenched pier, employs a vertical composition. In the foreground, a robust, muscular man in his thirties assumes a wide defensive stance, aiming a black semi-automatic pistol directly off-screen. He has short, dark hair, a muscular build, dark skin, a light stubble, wears a silver watch, a white T-shirt, an open blue short-sleeved printed shirt, and khaki cargo pants. Behind him to the left stands an athletic woman in her twenties or thirties, with dark skin and dark curly hair tied in a high ponytail. She wears a black tank top, denim shorts, a black belt, and layered gold necklaces, holding a black pistol at her right side, ready to act at any moment. The background is set on a weathered wooden pier beside bright blue water, with a tall palm tree on the left, three modern high-rise buildings in the background, and a police speedboat partially visible on the right edge. The bright midday sun, the azure sky, the glowing skin, the tense body language, the realistic proportions, the shallow depth of field, the high-detail photorealistic feel, the blockbuster-level combination with the atmosphere of a police thriller, the characters are clearly focused, and the horizon is slightly blurred.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张在 {argument name="city" default="迈阿密"} 阳光明媚的码头拍摄的电影级动作剧照，采用垂直构图。前景中，一名 30 多岁、体格健壮的硬汉正处于宽大的防御姿态，双手持一把黑色半自动手枪直接瞄准画外。他留着深色短发，身材魁梧，皮肤黝黑，留着浅浅的胡茬，戴着银色腕表，身穿白色 T 恤、敞开的蓝色短袖印花衬衫和卡其色工装裤。在他身后左侧，站着一位 20 多岁或 30 多岁的运动型女性，她皮肤黝黑，深色卷发扎成高马尾。她穿着黑色紧身背心、牛仔短裤、黑色腰带，佩戴叠戴的金项链，右手持一把黑色手枪垂在身侧，随时准备行动。背景设定在明亮蓝色水域旁风化的木质码头上，左侧有一棵高大的棕榈树，背景中有 3 座现代高层建筑，右侧边缘可见一艘局部警用快艇。正午明亮的阳光，湛蓝的天空，皮肤呈现光泽感，肢体语言紧张，比例写实，浅景深，高细节照片级真实感，大片级搭档警匪片氛围，人物焦点清晰，天际线略微模糊。

templates.title: Art Deco style Gotham City tram poster

titleLocalized.zh: 装饰艺术风格哥谭市电车海报

templates.prompt: A retro Art Deco style travel poster, using a simple 2D illustration style reminiscent of the 1950s, depicts an elevated tram entering at sunset.{argument name="city name" default="Gotham City"} The scene employs a towering vertical poster composition, emphasizing geometric symmetry and a sharp, stepped decorative border, devoid of 3D embossing or realistic textures. A large, angular Art Deco border is placed at the top, using luminous peach-gold lines, with three small dots precisely positioned at the top center. The title is placed within this border.{argument name="headline text" default="WELCOME TO GOTHAM CITY !"} Use an elegant, large Art Deco font, stacked in four lines, with the text precisely: "WELCOME," "TO," "GOTHAM," and "CITY!". Keep the layout clear, centered, and integrated with the poster design. Below, draw {argument name="city skyline style" default="futuristic Gotham skyscrapers"} The stylized skyline features soaring, narrow towers, stepped crowns, spires, and simplified window slits; twelve main buildings are visible on the skyline. Behind the buildings, a large, luminous semi-circular sun hangs low on the horizon. In the foreground, a long, streamlined elevated tram extends diagonally from the lower left to the lower right, with its front protruding on the right. The tram should have luminous cream-colored windows, rounded front corners, three precisely positioned circular headlights on the front, and an elegantly curved overhead cable spanning the composition. Two precisely positioned rails curve towards the viewer at the bottom. Color scheme: a gradient of deep indigo, violet, plum, black, peach, amber, and warm cream. Atmosphere: nostalgic, fluid, cinematic, light, and optimistic retro-futurism. The overall effect is to resemble a sophisticated mid-20th-century urban transportation and tourism poster.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张复古装饰艺术风格旅行海报，采用 1950 年代风格的简洁平面 2D 插画手法，展示了一辆高架电车在日落时分驶入 {argument name="city name" default="Gotham City"} 的场景。使用高耸的垂直海报构图，强调几何对称性、锐利的阶梯状装饰边框，且不含 3D 浮雕或写实纹理。在顶部放置一个巨大的棱角分明的装饰艺术边框，使用发光的桃金色线条，并在边框顶部中心位置精确放置 3 个小圆点。在此边框内，设置标题 {argument name="headline text" default="WELCOME TO GOTHAM CITY !"}，使用优雅的大号装饰艺术字体，分 4 行堆叠，文字内容精确为：“WELCOME”、“TO”、“GOTHAM”、“CITY !”。保持排版清晰、居中，并与海报设计融为一体。在下方，绘制 {argument name="city skyline style" default="futuristic Gotham skyscrapers"} 的风格化天际线，包含高耸狭窄的塔楼、阶梯状塔冠、尖顶以及简化的窗缝；天际线上可见 12 座建筑主体。在建筑后方，设置一轮低悬于地平线上的巨大发光半圆太阳。在前景中，展示 1 辆长条流线型高架电车，从左下角向右下角呈对角线延伸，车头在右侧突出。电车应具有发光的奶油色车窗、圆润的前角、车头正面精确的 3 个圆形车灯，以及横跨构图的优雅弧形架空电缆。底部使用精确的 2 条向观众弯曲的铁轨。配色方案：深靛蓝、紫罗兰、李子色、黑色、桃色、琥珀色和暖奶油色渐变。氛围：怀旧、流畅、电影感、轻盈、乐观的复古未来主义。使其看起来像一张精致的 20 世纪中叶城市交通旅游平面海报。

templates.title: The Crimson Throne's Judge

titleLocalized.zh: 深红王座上的审查者

templates.prompt: A somber expressionist oil painting depicts an elderly man in a business suit, seated upright on a richly decorated, gilded, and ornately adorned high-backed throne. He wears a black or deep burgundy suit over a white shirt and a highly saturated purple tie, his hands resting heavily on the throne's armrests. His hair, a light to greyish-gold, is casually combed back. His face is completely obscured by a centrally located, dark brown rectangular blur, creating an unsettling effect of censorship. The background is a claustrophobic space rendered with strong, vertical brushstrokes of deep red, scarlet, black, and maroon, as if the walls are dripping blood. The floor is a black and white checkerboard pattern, partially disrupted and smeared with rough brushstrokes. The painting employs impasto, an aggressive palette knife texture, blurred edges, high contrast, and a somber, sinister atmosphere. The composition is symmetrical and centered, presenting the fully seated figure, with the throne dominating the canvas, possessing the quality of a museum portrait and a psychologically unsettling tone.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅阴郁的表现主义油画，描绘了一位身着商务西装的老年男子，正面端坐在装饰华丽、带有镀金饰顶和雕花扶手的高背王座上。他身穿黑色或深酒红色的西装，内搭白色衬衫，系着饱和度极高的紫色领带，双手沉重地搭在王座扶手上。他的头发呈浅金至灰金色，向后随意梳理。面部被一个位于中央的暗棕色矩形模糊块完全遮挡，营造出一种令人不安的审查效果。背景是一个幽闭的空间，以深红、猩红、黑色和褐红色的强烈垂直笔触渲染，仿佛墙壁正在向下滴血。地面为黑白棋盘格图案，部分被粗犷的笔触破坏并涂抹。采用厚涂法、极具侵略性的调色刀质感、模糊的边缘、高对比度以及阴郁、邪恶的氛围。构图对称且居中，呈现完整的坐姿人物，王座占据画面主体，具有博物馆级肖像画的质感与心理恐怖的基调。
