templates.title: Cyber ​​DJ under the Red Boulder

titleLocalized.zh: 红色巨石下的赛博 DJ

templates.prompt: An emotionally charged vertical concert stage illustration, rendered in a dark, futuristic, anime-style painting, depicts a solitary electronic musician or DJ performing on a small platform. The performer stands in the center behind a folding table, wearing an oversized black hoodie, loose dark trousers, and heavy dark shoes, topped with a glossy black robotic helmet and a bright, round blue lens in the center of their face. One arm is dramatically raised, pointing towards a large, red, square panel suspended above the stage, while the other arm rests near the table. The background is filled with thick red and black smoke, creating a dramatic backlit atmosphere with a deep red halo and heavy shadows. Five visible equipment elements are on the table: an open, dark laptop in the center; a white square speaker or computer unit on the left; a pair of headphones on the right; a small audio device next to the white unit; and a glowing red can of beverage on the far right edge. Six additional visible elements surround the stage: a microphone stand to the performer's left, the edge of a keyboard or piano extending from the far left, two stacked equipment cases under and beside the table, an oriental-style patterned carpet covering the platform floor, and numerous black cables scattered across the stage. Above all these objects, a large, suspended red cube occupies the upper half of the frame, its perspective slightly tilted, its surface featuring dark vertical stripes and a rough, painterly texture. The cinematic low-angle composition, centered subject, dramatic negative space, strong red and black color scheme accented with blue, soft smoky lighting effects, and high contrast create a vibrant, experimental live music performance atmosphere, resulting in a mysterious cyberpunk ambiance.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满情绪感的竖构图演唱会舞台插画，采用深色未来主义绘画动漫风格，展示了一位孤独的电子音乐人或 DJ 在小型平台上表演。表演者站在折叠桌后方正中央，身穿超大号黑色连帽衫、宽松深色长裤和厚重的深色鞋子，戴着一个光亮的黑色机器人头盔，面部中央有一只明亮的圆形蓝色镜片。一只手臂戏剧性地向上举起，指向舞台上方悬浮的巨大红色方形面板，另一只手臂则靠近桌子。背景充斥着浓厚的红黑烟雾，营造出带有深红色光晕和浓重阴影的戏剧性背光氛围。桌上有 5 个可见的装备元素：中央是一台打开的深色笔记本电脑，左侧是一个白色方形音箱或电脑单元，右侧是一副耳机，白色单元旁有一个小型音频设备，最右侧边缘有一罐发光的红色饮料。舞台周围有 6 个额外的可见元素：表演者左侧的麦克风支架、从最左侧伸入的键盘或钢琴边缘、桌下及桌旁的 2 个堆叠设备箱、覆盖平台地面的东方风格花纹地毯，以及多条散落在舞台上的黑色线缆。在所有物体上方，一个巨大的悬浮红色方形体占据了画面上半部分，透视略微倾斜，表面带有较暗的垂直条纹和粗犷的绘画质感。电影级低角度构图，主体居中，极具戏剧性的留白，强烈的红黑配色辅以蓝色点缀，柔和的烟雾光效，高对比度，充满实验性现场音乐表演的活力，营造出神秘的赛博朋克氛围。

templates.title: Luxury Dubai city miniature model

templates.prompt: A highly detailed, cinematic-quality isometric miniature city model.{argument name="landmark tower" default="Burj Khalifa"} Rising from the center of a square architectural project, the design evokes the feel of a luxurious urban planning model against a black background. At the heart of the composition stands a towering silver skyscraper, surrounded by dense modern high-rises, illuminated roads, bridges, and warm city lights. Curving turquoise water features and artificial lakes encircle the central area in the form of interconnected ponds and canals, with a large circular fountain-like landscape near the tower's base, featuring several island-shaped features visible in the water. In the lower right quadrant, a large low-rise complex with circular geometric roofs and subtly green-lit areas connects to multi-lane roads and roundabouts. The entire city sits on a square beige map project, subtly etched with street grids and planning lines, its edges clearly visible and slightly convex. The perspective is a high, three-quarters isometric angle, centered and symmetrical, with the tower extending upwards into negative space. The interplay of light and shadow is dramatic and luxurious: warm golden edges illuminate the buildings and roads, cool-toned reflections appear on the water, the central tower has a sharp metallic highlight, and the model is surrounded by a deep black void. The image features three adult women with shoulder-length wavy light brown to dark blonde hair, all wearing loose white long-sleeved tops and flowing white wide-leg pants, styling themselves like minimalist fashion models, their expressions relaxed and natural. Their faces are deliberately obscured or blurred. One model leans against a large, upright white Croc on the left, another sits casually on a large white Croc in the upper right, and yet another leans against the ground in the lower right, supporting herself with one hand, half-sitting on a glossy blue sphere. The image uses two large white Crocs as central props: one stands vertically on the left, showcasing the sole and side profile; the other is tilted on a blue crystal block in the middle right, displaying the upper and toe. Both Crocs are classic foam slip-on styles, featuring perforations, a thick sole, a heel strap, and round logo studs. The upper of the clogs on the right center is decorated with eight clearly visible shoe flowers: a blue-green iridescent circular shoe flower, a white daisy with a yellow center, a black and white circular badge near the laces, a small "CROCS" lettering shoe flower, a dark flower, a peace sign, an orange smiley face, a white cloud, and an orange flower. Scattered around the scene are seven blue spheres of varying sizes, some floating and some on the ground: a large sphere behind the model on the left, a medium sphere floating near the center, a medium sphere in the lower left foreground, a medium sphere used as a seat below the model in the lower right, a small sphere in the upper left, and two more blue spheres integrated into the composition. Translucent, sculptural gel-like forms are added to the far left and right edges, and a sharply angled blue crystal-like rock is placed below the right shoe. At the bottom center, simple white sans-serif text is placed: First line {argument name="tagline line 1" default="Made for comfort, worn for confidence."} The second line{argument name="tagline line 2" default="Because life feels better when your feet stop complaining."} Below it are four minimalist function icons and white labels: “ICONIC COMFORT,” “LIGHTWEIGHT,” “EASY TO CLEAN,” and “UNIQUELY YOU.” These are placed at the bottom center.{argument name="logo text" default="crocs"} The logo should be in bold lowercase white with a small trademark symbol. The overall style should convey the feel of a high-end, surreal fashion editorial, featuring clean, editorial-grade lighting, soft shadows, a glossy texture, transparent composition, and a product advertising feel that embodies a modern lifestyle.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张为 {argument name="brand name" default="crocs"} 制作的高端摄影广告海报，采用单色淡蓝色与白色调，配有光泽感的反射地面和柔和的天蓝色背景。背景中醒目地展示着巨大的白色粗体无衬线压缩字体 {argument name="headline text" default="CROCS"}，几乎占据了整个画面的高度。在右上角添加一行白色小字：“Designed with ChatGPT”。画面中包含 3 位留着齐肩波浪形浅棕色至深金色头发的成年女性，她们均身穿宽松的白色长袖上衣和飘逸的白色阔腿裤，造型如同极简主义时尚模特，表情自然放松。她们的面部被刻意遮挡或模糊处理。一位模特斜靠在左侧巨大的直立白色洞洞鞋上，一位模特随意地坐在右上方的巨大白色洞洞鞋上，另一位模特则斜倚在右下方的地面上，单手撑地，半坐在一个光泽感的蓝色球体上。画面包含 2 只巨大的白色洞洞鞋作为核心道具：一只在左侧垂直站立，展示鞋底和侧面轮廓；另一只在右中部的蓝色水晶块上倾斜放置，展示鞋面和鞋头。两只洞洞鞋均为经典的泡沫套穿款式，带有透气孔、厚实鞋底、后跟带和圆形标志铆钉。右中部的洞洞鞋鞋面上装饰着 8 个清晰可见的鞋花：一个蓝绿色虹彩圆形鞋花、一朵黄色花心的白色雏菊、鞋带附近的一个黑白圆形徽章、一个小型的“CROCS”文字鞋花、一朵深色花朵、一个和平手势标志、一个橙色笑脸、一朵白云以及一朵橙色花朵。在场景周围散布 7 个大小不一、具有光泽感的悬浮或落地蓝色球体：左侧模特身后有一个大球，中心附近悬浮一个中球，左下角前景有一个中球，右下角模特下方用作座椅的一个中球，左上方有一个小球，以及另外 2 个融入构图的蓝色球体。在最左侧和最右侧边缘添加半透明的雕塑感凝胶状形态，并在右侧鞋子下方放置棱角分明的蓝色水晶状岩石。在底部中心，放置简洁的无衬线字体白色宣传文案：第一行为 {argument name="tagline line 1" default="Made for comfort, worn for confidence."}，第二行为 {argument name="tagline line 2" default="Because life feels better when your feet stop complaining."}。在其下方，展示 4 个极简主义功能图标及白色标签：“ICONIC COMFORT”（标志性舒适）、“LIGHTWEIGHT”（轻盈）、“EASY TO CLEAN”（易于清洁）和“UNIQUELY YOU”（独一无二的你）。在底部中心放置 {argument name="logo text" default="crocs"} 粗体小写白色标志，并带有小型商标符号。整体风格应呈现出高端超现实时尚大片的质感，具备干净的编辑级布光、柔和的阴影、光泽质感、通透的构图以及现代生活方式的产品广告感。

templates.prompt: An incredibly detailed anime fantasy action illustration depicts a valiant young woman wielding a glowing magic sword, lunging at the viewer. The image employs an extremely low-angle perspective, with the blade dominating the foreground and pointing directly at the camera. She possesses {argument name="hair color" default="Long pale pink"} Her beautiful hair flowed freely in the wind, and her eyes were bright and focused.{argument name="eye color" default="blue-green"} Her eyes shone with unwavering resolve. She wore an exquisite black Gothic Lolita battle dress, adorned with layered ruffles, lace trim, a cinched waist, split lace sleeves or gloves, thigh-high suspender details, and dark combat boots. Her attire was embellished with three vibrant blue roses: two adorning a black lace headdress, and one positioned on her chest. The sword was ornate and elegant, fitted with a silver filigree guard, its luminous blue blade covered in runic patterns. The background was {argument name="background palette" default="Violet, indigo and electric blue"} The starry sky, in shades of hues, is surrounded by multiple overlapping circular magic circles, arcane auras, stellar particles, shimmering fragments, and cosmic light trails. Crystal prism fragments and shimmering highlights have been added to the image, creating a strong glow effect, high contrast, delicate lace and fabric textures, and a sophisticated, high-end gacha game-like visual style. The overall composition is dynamic, cinematic, and imbued with a magical atmosphere, as if {argument name="character name" default="A gothic female magic swordswoman"} It is launching a fatal attack from within the astral dimension.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张细节极其丰富的动漫奇幻动作插画，描绘了一位英姿飒爽的年轻女性挥舞着发光的魔法剑向观众突刺。画面采用极端的低角度透视，剑刃占据前景并直指镜头。她拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="长长的淡粉色"} 秀发，在风中飘逸散开，眼神明亮且专注， {argument name="eye color" default="蓝绿色"} 的双眸透着坚毅。她身穿精致的黑色哥特洛丽塔战斗裙，配有层叠的荷叶边、蕾丝花边、束腰设计、分离式蕾丝袖或手套、大腿吊带细节以及深色战靴。她的装束点缀着 3 朵鲜艳的蓝色玫瑰：2 朵装饰在黑色蕾丝头饰上，1 朵位于胸前。剑身华丽优雅，配有银色花丝护手，发光的蓝色剑身上布满了符文图案。背景是 {argument name="background palette" default="紫、靛蓝和电光蓝"} 色调的星空，周围环绕着多个重叠的圆形魔法阵、奥术光环、星域粒子、闪烁的碎片以及宇宙光轨。画面中添加了水晶棱镜碎片和闪耀的高光，呈现出强烈的泛光效果、高对比度、精细的蕾丝与布料质感，以及精致的高级抽卡游戏主视觉风格。整体构图动感十足、充满电影质感与魔法氛围，仿佛 {argument name="character name" default="一位哥特魔法女剑士"} 正置身于星界维度中发动致命一击。

templates.title: The absurd tabloid Black Panther News front page

titleLocalized.zh: 荒诞小报黑豹新闻头版

templates.prompt: A realistic yet slightly humorous newspaper front page, shot from above onto a wooden table, boasts the texture of a large print newspaper, complete with delicate paper grain, creases, and slight lens distortion. The masthead in the upper left corner reads "The Daily Metro," the date column at the top center reads "Friday, April 22, 2005," and the section in the upper right corner is labeled "CITY NEWS | 05." A red banner in the upper left reads "EXCLUSIVE STORY." A striking, oversized black headline spans multiple lines: "Zoo Panther 'Marquise' Caught Leading a Double Life—A Charming Casanova in a Bar!" The large subheading below reads: "Panther 'Marquise' Escapes the Zoo at Night, Drifts to Bars, Becomes a Heartthrob for Lonely Women." The page layout should mimic a sensational tabloid style, featuring a large headline area, a large main image in the upper right corner, a small illustration below the body text on the left, three dense columns of newspaper text slightly to the left of the center, a quotation box in the middle, a secondary news item with a black panther image in the lower left corner, three small thumbnails at the bottom, and a sidebar on the right titled "What's Next For Mamquiss?". Most of the body text should remain small and partially meaningless or presented with AI-generated pseudo-text effects, but the main visible headline must be fully preserved. The main image in the upper right corner shows the back of a glamorous blonde woman in a champagne-colored silk dress standing beside a bar counter, with a large black panther standing upright on a stool or with its front paws resting on the counter. The bar background is filled with bottles and glassware, and the lighting is warm. The woman's face is deliberately obscured by rectangular blurred blocks. The panther is rounded, with glossy fur, rendered very realistically. The illustration below the left-hand headline shows a black panther near a zoo exit or path sign at night. The portrait in the lower left corner shows a close-up of the panther's face. Three thumbnails at the bottom depict nightlife scenes: the panther moving inside a bar, sitting with two women at a small round table, and resting in dim, warm lighting. Employing early 21st-century tabloid aesthetics, the print uses high-contrast black headline fonts, off-white newsprint, red accent lines, narrow columns, and a slightly cluttered, realistic newspaper composition. The overall tone is a gritty, absurd journalistic style, so realistic that it could easily be mistaken for a real newspaper at first glance. The pages are mostly filled, and the print was taken under natural indoor lighting.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张写实且略带幽默的报纸头版，从上方俯拍于木桌之上，设计呈现出印刷大报的质感，带有细腻的纸张纹理、折痕和轻微的镜头畸变。左上角的报头写着“The Daily Metro”，顶部中央的日期栏写着“2005 年 4 月 22 日，星期五”，右上角的版块标记为“CITY NEWS | 05”。左上方的红色横幅写着“EXCLUSIVE STORY”。醒目的超大黑色标题横跨多行：“动物园黑豹被抓包过双重生活——竟是酒吧里迷人的卡萨诺瓦！”下方的大副标题写着：“黑豹‘Marquise’夜间逃出动物园，流连酒吧，成为孤独女性心中的万人迷”。页面布局应模仿耸人听闻的小报风格，包含 1 个巨大的标题区、右上角 1 张大型主图、左侧正文下方 1 张小型插图、中央偏左 3 列密集的报纸正文、中间 1 个引语框、左下角 1 个带有黑豹肖像的次要新闻块、底部 3 张小型缩略图，以及右侧 1 个标题为“What’s Next For Mamquiss?”的侧边栏。大部分正文应保持微小且部分无意义或呈现 AI 生成的伪文字效果，但必须完整保留主要可见标题。

右上角的主图展示了一位身穿香槟色丝绸礼服的迷人金发女郎背影，她站在酒吧吧台旁，身边是一只直立在凳子上或前爪搭在吧台上的大型黑豹。酒吧背景中有许多酒瓶和玻璃器皿，灯光温暖。女子的面部被刻意用矩形模糊块遮挡。黑豹体态圆润、毛色光亮，渲染得十分逼真。左侧标题下方的插图展示了黑豹在夜间靠近动物园出口或路径指示牌的场景。左下角的肖像展示了黑豹面部的特写。底部的 3 张缩略图展示了夜生活场景：黑豹穿梭在酒吧内部、黑豹与两名女性坐在小圆桌旁、以及黑豹在昏暗暖光下休憩。

采用 21 世纪初的小报美学，使用高对比度的黑色标题字体、米白色新闻纸、红色强调线、窄栏排版以及略显杂乱的真实报纸构图。整体基调为冷面荒诞新闻风格，逼真到足以让人一眼误以为是真实报纸，页面填满大部分画面，并在自然室内光线下拍摄。

templates.title: Cyberpunk anime magazine cover

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克动漫杂志封面

templates.prompt: A visually striking futuristic cyberpunk-style anime magazine cover features a vertical full-page composition with dense Japanese typography and neon graphic design. The focus is on a close-up portrait of two figures in the foreground: on the left is a handsome anime boy with messy short black hair highlighted with bright blue, a striking white fringe, sharp golden eyes, fair skin, a confident smile, silver hoop earrings, a black street-style hooded jacket with zipper details, layered inner layers, and a black choker. Slightly lower and overlapping on the right is a stylish anime girl with long, wavy hair, a black baseball cap, oversized dark sunglasses, a purple and white futuristic jacket, and gloved fingers lightly touching her lips, exuding a cool demeanor. Around the top right corner, four embedded character portraits are arranged diagonally: a silver-haired anime boy in dark clothing, a purple-haired anime girl with violet eyes, a small silver-haired anime character with blue-pink highlights in her eyes, and a smaller brown-haired character at the bottom right edge. The background is deep black and deep navy blue, embellished with beams of electric magenta, hot pink, and cyan, glowing fragments, splatter textures, halftone patterns, angular borders, and diagonal UI-style decorations. The overall layout has the feel of a high-end Japanese magazine cover, with a large, distressed metallic white Chinese title printed at the top.{argument name="headline text" default="The bond that resonates"} The page is surrounded by small Japanese subtitles and editorial notes, with a special section in the upper right corner reading "FEATURE VOL. 04 2024 SPRING Inaugural Issue," a focus section on the left, and "4/5 PAGE" in the lower left corner, adorned with various brand logos and decorative symbols. The print boasts strong contrasts, a glossy finish, deep layering, dramatic edge lighting, and vivid neon reflections, creating a stylish urban sci-fi atmosphere, reminiscent of exquisite gacha game or light novel promotional images.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具视觉冲击力的未来主义赛博朋克风格动漫杂志封面，采用垂直全页构图，配有密集的日文排版和霓虹图形设计。画面焦点是前景中的双人近景肖像：左侧是一位帅气的动漫少年，留着凌乱的黑色短发，挑染着明亮的青色，前额有一撮醒目的白色刘海，拥有锐利的金色双眸、白皙的皮肤、自信的浅笑，佩戴银色圆环耳环，身穿黑色街头风格连帽夹克，带有拉链细节、叠穿内搭和黑色颈圈。右侧略低且部分重叠的是一位时尚的动漫少女，留着波浪长卷发，戴着黑色鸭舌帽和超大号深色墨镜，身穿紫色与白色相间的未来感夹克，戴着手套的手指轻触唇边，姿态冷酷。周围沿右上角对角线排列着 4 个嵌入式角色肖像：1 位身穿深色服装的银发动漫少年，1 位拥有紫罗兰色双眸的紫发动漫少女，1 位眼睛带有蓝粉色高光的银发动漫小角色，以及右下角边缘处 1 位较小的棕发角色。背景采用深黑色和深海军蓝，点缀着电光洋红色、热粉色和青色的光束、发光碎片、喷溅纹理、半调图案、棱角分明的边框以及对角线 UI 风格的装饰。整体布局呈现出高级日本专题杂志封面的质感，顶部印有巨大的做旧金属白汉字标题 {argument name="headline text" default="共鸣する绊"}，页面周围环绕着较小的日文副标题和编辑标注，右上角设有“FEATURE VOL. 04 2024 SPRING 创刊号”专题板块，左侧设有焦点板块，左下角标有“4/5 PAGE”页码，并点缀着各种品牌标识和装饰符号。对比强烈，光泽印刷质感，层次感深厚，边缘光影戏剧化，霓虹反射生动，充满时尚的都市科幻氛围，具备精致的抽卡游戏或轻小说宣传图品质。

templates.prompt: Create a visually striking Japanese anime magazine cover with a futuristic cyberpunk style, using a vertical portrait composition.{argument name="main character" default="A pink-haired anime girl"} She is the central subject, depicted in close-up shots. She sports a short bob with layered bangs, large, purplish-pink eyes, fair skin, and a calm, deep expression. She wears a black baseball cap with white lettering, a black X-shaped hair clip, a shiny black streetwear jacket with reflective graphic patches, and a magenta hood. She leans towards the viewer from the upper right, one hand reaching towards the camera with a dramatic perspective effect. Around her are four additional character panels: a partially obscured silver-haired character wearing a black hat in the lower foreground; a silver-haired male character in dark clothing and wearing earrings in the lower left triangular panel; a black-haired male character with striking white bangs and golden eyes in the bottom center panel; and a blonde female character wearing a dark choker and layered clothing in the lower right panel. The image is designed like a beautiful magazine cover with dense Japanese typography and editorial layout. A very prominent white bold Japanese headline is placed in the upper left corner, containing the following text:{argument name="main headline" default="Intersecting future lines"} A smaller Japanese subtitle is added nearby. A publication information block is added to the upper right corner, indicating "FEATURE," "VOL. 03," "2024 SPRING," and "Inaugural Issue." A vertical Japanese sidebar text is added to the right edge, with a multi-line Japanese text and a prominent magenta "5" in the left function box. A page number "3/5 PAGE" is added to the lower left corner, and small English labels such as "+ CONNECT," "+ IDENTITY," and "+ RESONANCE" are added near the bottom panel. A Japanese description bar is included at the bottom center, with a small logo in the lower right corner.{argument name="primary color palette" default="Electric magenta, purple, black, and cyan"} The design features a predominantly neon color scheme, complemented by luminous outline lighting, ink splatter decorations, sharp graphic diagonals, halftone textures, glossy highlights, and layered UI-style editing details. The overall atmosphere should be avant-garde, youthful, fashionable, and cinematic, resembling the cover of a high-end sci-fi visual culture magazine.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张具有未来赛博朋克风格、极具视觉冲击力的日式动漫杂志封面，采用竖版肖像构图，以 {argument name="main character" default="一位粉色头发的动漫少女"} 作为核心主体进行特写组合。她留着带层次刘海的短波波头，拥有硕大的紫粉色双眸、白皙的皮肤和冷静而深邃的表情，头戴印有白色文字的黑色棒球帽，佩戴黑色 X 型发夹，身穿带有反光图形贴片的亮面黑色街头风夹克，并戴着洋红色兜帽。她从右上侧向观众倾斜，一只手以戏剧性的透视效果伸向镜头。她周围共有 4 个额外的角色面板：下方前景处有一位部分被遮挡的银发角色，头戴黑色帽子；左下角三角形面板中有一位身着深色服装、佩戴耳环的银发男性角色；底部中央面板中有一位留着醒目白色前额发、拥有金色眼眸的黑发男性角色；右下角面板中有一位佩戴深色颈圈、穿着叠搭风格服装的金发女性角色。将图像设计为带有密集日文排版和编辑布局的精美杂志封面。在左上角放置一个非常醒目的白色粗体日文大标题，内容为 {argument name="main headline" default="交差する未来线"}，并在附近配以较小的日文副标题。在右上角添加发行信息块，注明“FEATURE”、“VOL. 03”、“2024 SPRING”和“创刊号”。在右侧边缘添加垂直的日文侧边栏文字，左侧功能框内包含多行日文文案和一个醒目的洋红色“5”，左下角添加页码标记“3/5 PAGE”，并在下方面板附近添加诸如“+ CONNECT”、“+ IDENTITY”和“+ RESONANCE”的小型英文标签。底部中央包含一条日文说明栏，右下角有一个小型徽标。使用以 {argument name="primary color palette" default="电光洋红、紫、黑和青色"} 为主的霓虹色调，辅以发光的轮廓光、墨迹飞溅装饰、锐利的图形对角线、半调纹理、亮面高光以及层叠的 UI 风格编辑细节。整体氛围应前卫、年轻、时尚且具有电影质感，呈现出高端科幻视觉文化杂志封面的效果。

templates.title: Dark Gatorade-style portrait

templates.prompt: A dramatic, high-contrast studio portrait featuring a {argument name="subject gender" default="male"} Athletes or models are featured in a visual style reminiscent of high-end sports drink advertisements. The subject is centered, facing the camera, and the composition utilizes a tight close-up of the head and shoulders. The subject has {argument name="hair style" default="Dark short hair combed back"} The ears are clearly visible, the jawline is strong, and there is a short beard or stubble. He wears a dark zip-up sports jacket, the zipper centrally located and clearly visible at the collar. The background is almost entirely black, using extremely low-key lighting. Subtle rim lighting and soft highlights outline the texture of the hair, ears, jawline, shoulders, and jacket, while most facial features are shrouded in shadow, creating a mysterious and intense atmosphere. The image should have a monochrome or near-monochrome quality, with deep blacks, soft gray highlights, cinematic contrast, rough textures, and reminiscent of…{argument name="brand style" default="Gatorade"} The advertising campaign embodies the aesthetics of a fashionable, commercial, and sporty brand. It features a vertical composition, a minimalist frame, and no text, logo, props, or visible environment.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张戏剧性、高对比度的影棚肖像，主角为一名 {argument name="subject gender" default="男性"} 运动员或模特，呈现高端运动饮料广告的视觉风格。主体居中，正对镜头，采用紧凑的头部和肩部特写构图。主体留有 {argument name="hair style" default="向后梳的深色短发"}，双耳清晰可见，下颌轮廓硬朗，带有短胡须或胡茬。身穿一件深色拉链运动夹克，拉链位于中心，在领口处清晰可见。背景几乎全黑，采用极端的低调照明，微妙的轮廓光和柔和的高光勾勒出头发、耳朵、下颌线、肩膀和夹克的纹理，而大部分面部特征则隐没在阴影中，营造出神秘而强烈的氛围。图像应呈现单色或近乎单色的质感，拥有深邃的黑色、柔和的灰色高光、电影级的对比度、粗犷的纹理，以及令人联想到 {argument name="brand style" default="佳得乐"} 广告活动的时尚商业运动品牌美学。竖构图，极简框架，无文字，无 Logo，无道具，无可见环境。

templates.title: Japanese anime magazine cover

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹动漫杂志封面

templates.prompt: Create a vibrant Japanese futuristic anime magazine cover, employing a vertical screen composition and a design style reminiscent of a glamorous feature article, filled with neon cyberpunk graphics. The overall composition is divided into five sharp, diagonally polygonal panels with black borders, each containing a different anime character portrait. A large, bold Japanese title is placed at the top.{argument name="masthead text" default="Dimensional intersection"} The design features a massive, distressed white font with pink paint splatters and dynamic stripes that span almost the entire width. Above this is a small white Japanese subtitle. In the upper right corner, design a magazine issue number block containing the word "FEATURE," a very large hollow "01," "VOL.", "MEMMODE," "2024 SPRING," and small Japanese "Inaugural Issue" stacked within a clean editorial layout. The background should be filled with abstract stripes, halftone dots, glitch textures, floating plus signs, diagonal lines, and halos in electric magenta, bright pink, cyan, blue, and black, creating a boisterous, next-generation visual culture feel. Five characters are displayed: 1) In the top left panel, a handsome, androgynous anime boy with messy, layered silver short hair, fair skin, and wearing black clothing with straps, zippers, and layered necklaces, presenting a cool, dark street style; 2) In the top right panel, a cute anime girl with light lavender pink twin tails, large magenta eyes, and wearing a mask printed with {argument name="cap text" default="MEMMODE"} 1) A black baseball cap with lettering, a black X-shaped hair clip, and black and purple clothing; 2) The central panel features a Q-version character with short white hair ending in cyan and pink, one bright blue eye and one pink eye, wearing a shiny black baseball cap and futuristic black clothing, looking directly at the audience; 3) The lower left panel features a serious-looking anime boy with black hair and bold white highlights on his forehead, amber eyes, earrings, a black hoodie and layered jacket, with blue neon outline lighting; 4) The lower right panel features a beautiful female character with wavy blonde hair under a dark baseball cap, wearing a choker, holding a silver microphone on her chest, rendered with pink and purple lighting. All characters must be highly detailed, clear, and vibrant in color, possessing large and expressive eyes, sharp cel rendering, a glossy texture, and richly layered urban futuristic fashion details. Add several editable text blocks around the cover: on the left is a special feature label with the Japanese word "特集" (Special Feature), a large stacked title "交差する5つの意志。" (The Will of the Five Crossings). Below are two lines of smaller Japanese text; a vertical side label reads "DIMENSION CROSS" and "MAIN"; in the lower left corner is a pick-up box with the word "PICK UP" and contains several lines of Japanese text and three lines of English tags, such as "#IDENTITY #CONNECT #FUTURE" and "#NEON #WILL #RESONANCE"; in the lower left corner is a bold page number "1/5 PAGE"; in the lower right corner is a focus box with "FOCUS" and small Japanese text; and at the bottom center is a Japanese slogan.{argument name="bottom tagline" default="A new story begins."} The overall style should present the texture of a high-end anime magazine cover, maintaining balance amidst chaos, featuring a strong diagonal composition, high contrast, glossy printing design, and a visual effect with a black background covered by neon pink and cyan energy.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张充满活力的日本未来主义动漫杂志封面，采用竖屏构图，设计风格如同光鲜亮丽的专题刊物，画面中充斥着霓虹赛博朋克图形。整体构图被分割为 5 个黑色边框的锐利对角线多边形面板，每个面板内包含不同的动漫角色肖像。在顶部放置一个超大的粗体日文刊名，文字为 {argument name="masthead text" default="次元交差"}，采用巨大的做旧白色字体，并带有粉色油漆飞溅和动态条纹装饰，几乎横跨整个宽度。在其上方添加一行白色的小号日文副标题。在右上角，设计一个杂志期号区块，包含 "FEATURE" 字样、一个非常大的空心 "01"、"VOL."、"MEMMODE"、"2024 SPRING" 以及堆叠在整洁编辑布局中的小号日文 "创刊号"。背景应充满电光洋红色、亮粉色、青色、蓝色和黑色的抽象条纹、半色调圆点、故障纹理、浮动加号、对角斜线和光晕，营造出一种喧闹的次世代视觉文化感。展示 5 个角色：1) 左上角面板，一位英俊的中性风动漫少年，留着凌乱的银色层次感短发，皮肤白皙，身穿带有绑带、拉链和叠戴项链的黑色服装，呈现酷炫的暗黑街头风；2) 右上角面板，一位可爱的动漫少女，留着淡薰衣草粉色双马尾，拥有巨大的洋红紫色眼睛，戴着印有 {argument name="cap text" default="MEMMODE"} 字样的黑色鸭舌帽，佩戴黑色 X 型发夹，身穿黑紫色服装；3) 中心面板，作为主打的 Q 版脸型角色，留着发梢带有青色和粉色的短白发，一只明亮的蓝色眼睛和一只粉色眼睛，戴着光亮的黑色鸭舌帽和未来感黑色服装，直视观众；4) 左下角面板，一位表情严肃的动漫少年，黑发配大胆的白色前额挑染，金琥珀色眼睛，佩戴耳环，身穿黑色连帽衫和叠穿外套，带有蓝色霓虹轮廓光；5) 右下角面板，一位柔美的女性角色，深色鸭舌帽下是波浪状金发，佩戴颈圈，胸前拿着一个银色麦克风，采用粉紫色灯光渲染。所有角色均需高度精致、清晰且色彩鲜艳，拥有大而传神的眼睛、锐利的赛璐珞渲染、光亮的质感以及层次丰富的都市科技时尚细节。在封面周围添加多个编辑文本块：左侧是一个带有日文 "特集" 的专题标注，一个巨大的堆叠标题 "交差する 5つの意志。"，下方有两行较小的日文；一个垂直的侧边标签，写着 "DIMENSION CROSS" 和 "MAIN"；左下角是一个带有 "PICK UP" 字样的拾取框，包含几行日文和 3 行英文标签，如 "#IDENTITY #CONNECT #FUTURE"、"#NEON #WILL #RESONANCE"；左下角有一个粗体的页码分数 "1/5 PAGE"；右下角有一个带有 "FOCUS" 和小号日文的焦点框；底部中心有一句日文标语 {argument name="bottom tagline" default="新たな物語の、はじまり。"}。整体风格应呈现出高端动漫专题杂志封面的质感，混乱中保持平衡，具有强烈的对角线构图、高对比度、光面印刷设计，以及以黑色为底色、被霓虹粉色和青色能量覆盖的视觉效果。

templates.title: A poster in the ink painting style paying tribute to Zheng Wen

titleLocalized.zh: 致敬郑问的水墨风格海报

templates.prompt: Create a vintage-style editorial poster printed on aged Xuan paper to commemorate {argument name="artist name" default="CHEN UEN"} The design blends museum infographics, Chinese ink painting illustrations, and calligraphy. The poster is a single, vertical image against a weathered parchment background with ink splatters, faded handwritten annotations, and red seals, creating an academic, archival atmosphere. At the top, the prominent black calligraphic characters "郑问" (Zheng Wen) are followed by a slash and large serif Romanized spelling.{argument name="romanized name" default="CHEN UEN"} A small red stamp is attached to the side. A subtitle is added below the title.{argument name="subtitle text" default="The Taiwanese Master Who Turned Comics into Ink-Born Epic"} The artwork uses an elegant reddish-brown serif font. At the center of the image is a dramatic, impressionistic scene: a male artist in a loose white shirt sits at a table, holding a brush suspended over the paper, his face softly blurred by rectangular strokes. Behind him, a halo-like ring of monochrome ink warriors and historical figures surrounds him: nine visible figures, including armored generals, swordsmen, and cavalrymen, emerging from bursts of black brushstrokes and smoky ink. On the left, a vertical section titled "Life & Milestones" is created, with a black-stroke title and a smaller Chinese subtitle. Six timelines are listed, marked with red years and bilingual descriptions: Born in Taiwan in 1958, *Warrior Black Panther* in 1983, *Abi Sword* in 1989, *Heroes of the Eastern Zhou Dynasty* in 1990, winner of the Japan Cartoonists Association Award in 1991, and *Legend Forever* in 2017. Below, add a section titled "Ink in Detail," containing four framed brushstroke studies with brief English descriptions: Dry brush texture, Ink wash gradient, Splatter energy, and Bold contour line. On the right, create a vertical area titled "Visual Method," with a black brushstroke title and a smaller Chinese subtitle. This contains five stacked framed studies in a graphic layout: Brush as blade, Ink as atmosphere, Anatomy as fate, History as theatre, and Speed ​​lines become calligraphy. Below in the center, create an area titled "Major Works Constellation," with a dark brushstroke title. Arrange five circular work nodes around the central ink ring, each containing calligraphic characters. Five nodes are marked: Abi Sword, Heroes of the Eastern Zhou, Assassin Biographies, Magical Super Asia, and Game character design legacy. Each circle contains a unique monochrome or low-saturation ink painting illustration, connected by thin lines resembling constellations. In the lower right corner, an area titled "Studio Notes" is added, containing six visible items: four hanging brushes, one ink bowl, and one palette with blue and red pigments; below this is a sketchbook with a pencil figure sketch. At the bottom, a wide area is added, titled "Why He Matters," with a black-stroke title and a smaller Chinese subtitle, followed by a serif English text describing his importance in comics, painting, calligraphy, film, and epic narratives. The color palette uses restrained tan, ink black, off-white, and soft gray, accented with deep red and a touch of blue. The overall image should present a sophisticated cultural tribute poster feel, with a compact and balanced layout, rich details, a painterly quality, and a faithful adherence to the aesthetics of Chinese ink painting.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张印在陈年宣纸上的复古编辑海报，以纪念 {argument name="artist name" default="CHEN UEN"}。设计风格融合了博物馆信息图表、中国水墨插画与书法。海报为单幅竖构图，背景为风化的羊皮纸，带有墨迹飞溅、褪色的手写批注、红色印章，营造出一种学术性的档案氛围。在最上方，放置醒目的黑色书法字体“郑问”，后接斜杠及大号衬线体罗马拼音 {argument name="romanized name" default="CHEN UEN"}，旁边配有一枚小红章。标题下方，添加副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="The Taiwanese Master Who Turned Comics into Ink-Born Epic"}，使用优雅的红褐色衬线字体。画面中心展示一幅充满戏剧性的写意场景：1 位男性艺术家身着宽松白衬衫坐在桌前，手持毛笔悬于纸上，面部被柔和的矩形模糊处理。在他身后，环绕着一圈如同光环般的单色水墨武士与历史人物：共 9 个可见人物，包括披甲将军、剑客和骑兵，从爆发式的黑色笔触和烟雾状墨迹中浮现。在左侧，创建一个标题为“Life & Milestones”的垂直区域，配有黑色笔触标题和较小的中文副标题。列出 6 条时间线，带有红色年份标记和双语说明：1958 年出生于台湾，1983 年《战士黑豹》，1989 年《阿鼻剑》，1990 年《东周英雄传》，1991 年获日本漫画家协会奖，2017 年传奇永存。下方添加一个名为“Ink in Detail”的小节，包含 4 个带框的笔触研究，并配以简短的英文说明：Dry brush texture（干笔纹理）、Ink wash gradient（水墨渐变）、Splatter energy（飞白气势）、Bold contour line（粗犷轮廓线）。在右侧，创建一个标题为“Visual Method”的垂直区域，配有黑色笔触标题和较小的中文副标题。包含 5 个堆叠的带框研究，采用图文布局：Brush as blade（笔如刀）、Ink as atmosphere（墨为境）、Anatomy as fate（骨骼即宿命）、History as theatre（历史即剧场）、Speed lines become calligraphy（速度线化为书法）。在下方中心，创建一个标题为“Major Works Constellation”的区域，配有深色笔触标题。在中央墨环周围排列 5 个圆形作品节点，环内带有书法字。标注 5 个节点：Abi Sword（阿鼻剑）、Heroes of the Eastern Zhou（东周英雄传）、Assassin Biographies（刺客列传）、Magical Super Asia（魔界人）、Game character design legacy（游戏角色设计遗产）。每个圆圈内包含独特的单色或低饱和度水墨插画，并以类似星座图的细线连接。在右下角，添加一个名为“Studio Notes”的区域，包含 6 个可见物品：4 支悬挂的毛笔、1 个墨碗和 1 个带有蓝红颜料的调色盘；下方放置一页带有铅笔人物素描的速写本。在底部，添加一个宽幅区域，标题为“Why He Matters”，配有黑色笔触标题和较小的中文副标题，随后是一段英文衬线体正文，描述他在漫画、绘画、书法、电影和史诗叙事方面的重要性。色调采用克制的棕褐色、水墨黑、米白色、柔和灰，并点缀深红色和少许蓝色。整幅图像应呈现出一种精致的文化致敬海报感，布局紧凑而平衡，细节丰富，具有绘画感，并忠实于中国水墨美学。

templates.title: New York Autumn Travel Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 纽约之秋旅行海报

templates.prompt: A vertical, edited Spanish travel poster with the theme of{argument name="trip type" default="III viaje fotográfico"} Titled "OTOÑO EN NUEVA YORK" (Autumn in New York), the design blends a sophisticated urban autumn atmosphere with the aesthetics of a high-end photography workshop. It employs a vertical poster layout optimized for mobile browsing, using a warm color scheme of off-white, beige, charcoal gray, and burnt orange. The left side of the composition is dominated by an oversized, compact black sans-serif font: at the top, smaller text reads "III VIAJE FOTOGRÁFICO," below which is a large, stacked title "OTOÑO," in the middle a smaller "EN" flanked by short horizontal lines, and below that, a large, stacked text "NUEVA YORK." On the right, a narrow information bar contains four lines of brief advantages, all in capital letters: "7 NOCHES" (7 nights), "GRUPO REDUCIDO" (small group tour), "GUÍAS EXPERTOS" (expert guides), and "MILES DE FOTOS" (abundant photos), with the last line in orange. Below, the date "17-24" is marked in large orange numbers, with "DE OCTUBRE" (October) and "DE 2026" (2026) in black capital letters below. A thin vertical line is added near the far right edge, topped with a small orange dot. An emotionally charged collage of New York street scenes is incorporated into the lower half of the poster and between the text, featuring the Manhattan Bridge in the center against a backdrop of dark brick buildings, wet streets, scattered vehicles, and steam rising from the road. In the foreground, a photographer with a backpack and a rusty orange knit hat is shown pointing a camera at the bridge. The large, cropped "NYC" lettering or similar bold graphics are integrated with the urban imagery in the lower half, creating a layered, double-exposure poster effect. Adding aged paper textures, rough torn edges, brush-painted white paint textures, and subtle stain effects creates a hand-edited feel. In the lower left center area, a circular orange stamp containing a small Statue of Liberty torch icon is placed, surrounding the text "III VIAJE FOTOGRÁFICO · OTOÑO EN NUEVA YORK". A dark horizontal bar is created at the bottom, containing information on two speakers, one on each side, separated by a thin orange vertical line: the left one is "CARLOS SÁNCHEZ", with " @CHOCUTUTS " in orange below; the right one is "JON TARAFA", with " @JONTCPHOTO " in orange below. At the very bottom center, the website address "VIAJENY.COM" is added in spaced orange capital letters. Two partially cropped grayscale portrait silhouettes are added to the bottom left and right corners, blending naturally with the dark footer area. Overall style: cinematic travel ad, contemporary magazine poster, bold typographic hierarchy, layered collage, raw New York autumn atmosphere, high contrast, elegant and dramatic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张竖版编辑风格的西班牙语旅行海报，主题为 {argument name="trip type" default="III viaje fotográfico"}，标题为“OTOÑO EN NUEVA YORK”（纽约之秋），设计风格融合了精致的都市秋日氛围与高端摄影研讨会美学。采用适合移动端浏览的竖长海报布局，配色方案选用温暖的米白色、米色、炭灰色和焦橙色。构图左侧以超大号紧凑型黑色无衬线字体为主：顶部小字写着“III VIAJE FOTOGRÁFICO”，下方是巨大的堆叠标题“OTOÑO”，中间是一个较小的“EN”，两侧配有短横线，再下方是巨大的堆叠文字“NUEVA YORK”。在右侧，放置一列狭窄的信息栏，包含 4 行简短的优势说明，全部大写：“7 NOCHES”（7 晚）、“GRUPO REDUCIDO”（小团出行）、“GUÍAS EXPERTOS”（专家向导）和“MILES DE FOTOS”（海量照片），最后一行使用橙色。下方用巨大的橙色数字标注日期“17-24”，并在其下用黑色大写字母标注“DE OCTUBRE”（10 月）和“DE 2026”（2026 年）。在最右侧边缘附近添加一条细竖线，顶部点缀一个小小的橙色圆点。在海报下半部分及字体间融入一张充满情绪感的纽约街头照片拼贴，画面中心为曼哈顿大桥，背景是深色砖墙建筑、湿润的街道、零星车辆和从路面升起的蒸汽；前景中，一名背着背包、戴着铁锈橙色针织帽的摄影师背影正举着相机对准大桥。让“NYC”的巨大裁剪字母或类似的粗体图形与下半部分的城市影像融合，营造出分层的双重曝光海报效果。添加做旧纸张纹理、粗糙的撕边叠加层、笔触感白色涂料纹理以及微妙的污渍效果，打造手工编辑的质感。在左下中部区域，放置一个圆形的橙色印章，内含一个小型的自由女神像火炬图标，并环绕文字“III VIAJE FOTOGRÁFICO · OTOÑO EN NUEVA YORK”。底部创建一个深色横条，包含 2 个主讲人信息，左右各一，中间用一条细橙色竖线隔开：左侧为“CARLOS SÁNCHEZ”，下方橙色字体标注“@CHOCUTUTS”；右侧为“JON TARAFA”，下方橙色字体标注“@JONTCPHOTO”。在最底部居中位置，以间距拉开的橙色大写字母添加网址“VIAJENY.COM”。在底部左右两角加入 2 个局部裁剪的灰度肖像剪影，与深色页脚区域自然融合。整体风格：电影感旅行广告、当代杂志海报、大胆的排版层级、分层拼贴、粗粝的纽约秋日氛围、高对比度、优雅且富有戏剧性。

templates.title: Studio photos of high-end gaming motherboards

titleLocalized.zh: 高端游戏主板摄影棚实拍图

templates.prompt: A product photo of a high-end, enthusiast-grade ATX gaming motherboard is shown against a dark studio background, using a three-quarter view tilted from the lower left to the upper right. The main body of the project features a matte black and gunmetal gray finish, with sharp geometric armor plates, brushed metal textures, and subtle RGB edge lighting effects in blue, purple, and magenta. A modern Intel-style CPU socket is visible at the top center, with four black DIMM memory slots on the right. Large VRM heatsinks are located at the top and upper left, and multiple reinforced PCIe slots are in the lower half. Three main branded heatsink areas are visible: a tall rear I/O shield at the upper left with an illuminated RGB eye logo and the word "MAXIMUS HERO"; a chipset/slot armor plate on the left with "SUPREMEFX" lettering; and a large, angular chipset cover at the lower right with a silver ROG-style logo and a stripe below that reads "FOR THOSE WHO DARE". The display showcases detailed capacitors, connectors, power interfaces, a debug display showing "88" in the upper right corner, and a small circular start button nearby. The ultra-high-resolution commercial product photography delivers sharp focus across the entire board, realistic metallic reflections, and a high-end, luxurious technological aesthetic. Dramatically understated lighting and a clean, seamless black background highlight the absence of cables, CPU, RAM, and other obstructions.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高端发烧级 ATX 游戏主板产品照片，背景为深色摄影棚环境，采用从左下向右上倾斜的四分之三俯视视角。该项目主体为哑光黑与枪灰色，配有锋利的几何装甲板、拉丝金属纹理，以及蓝色、紫色和洋红色的细微 RGB 边缘灯效。上方中央露出一个现代 Intel 风格 CPU 插槽，右侧设有 4 个黑色 DIMM 内存插槽，顶部和左上方配有大型 VRM 散热片，下半部分有多个加固的 PCIe 插槽。包含 3 个主要的品牌散热片区域：左上方的高大后置 I/O 护罩，带有发光的 RGB 眼睛标志和“MAXIMUS HERO”字样；左侧的芯片组/插槽装甲片，带有“SUPREMEFX”字样；以及右下角大型棱角分明的芯片组盖板，带有银色 ROG 风格徽标和下方写有“FOR THOSE WHO DARE”的条纹。展示详细的电容器、接头、电源接口、右上角显示“88”的调试显示屏，以及附近的一个小型圆形启动按钮。超精细商业产品摄影，全板焦点清晰，金属反射真实，呈现高端奢华科技美感，戏剧性的低调照明，干净的黑色无缝背景，无电缆，无 CPU，无 RAM，无其他杂物。

templates.title: Pixel-style Bolirana night scene

titleLocalized.zh: 像素风 Bolirana 夜景

templates.prompt: A retro pixel-art scene, evoking a sense of nostalgia, depicts the interior of a Columbia neighborhood bar at night, presented in a vertical, first-person perspective. In the foreground, at the bottom center, a hand holds a small, shiny metal Bolirana ball between its thumb and fingers, aiming at a full-fledged Bolirana game machine in the center of the room. The machine is themed around The Simpsons and Duff Beer: a red and yellow wooden lane, a large circular scoring hole at the front, several smaller scoring holes near the back panel, three upright metal pins or bumpers, the "Duff" logo on the back panel, and "THE SIMPSONS" printed below the front. A large sign on top of the machine reads "Tomate tu" and features a built-in digital scoreboard accurately displaying three player labels: "JUGADOR 1," "JUGADOR 0," and "JUGADOR 2," along with colorful pixelated score graphics. On the left brick wall, a large illuminated beer sign features an eagle emblem and the words "AGUILA CERVEZA." On the right, a young man in a dark hoodie and jeans stands sideways beside the machine, one hand in his pocket, the other pointing to the scoreboard, his face deliberately blurred. In the lower right foreground, a small wooden table holds two bottles of liquor: a tall "AGUARDIENTE AMARILLO MANZANARES" and a brown "AGUILA" beer. A narrow neon vertical window or illuminated panel is added to the right rear, emitting purple and blue light. The use of understated warm amber and red bar lighting creates deep shadows, brick walls, tiled floors, subtle reflections, and sophisticated 16-bit/32-bit pixel art shadows.{argument name="location" default="Duitama, Boyaka Province"} It creates a nostalgic, private, and slightly cinematic nightlife atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅充满怀旧气息的复古像素风场景，描绘了夜晚哥伦比亚社区酒吧的内部，采用竖屏第一人称视角。前景中，画面底部中央的一只人手正用拇指和手指捏着一颗闪亮的小金属 Bolirana 球，瞄准房间中央的一台完整 Bolirana 游戏机。游戏机采用《辛普森一家》和 Duff Beer 主题定制：红黄相间的木制球道，前端有一个大的圆形得分孔，后挡板附近排列着几个较小的得分孔，三个直立的金属销或保险杠，后挡板上有“Duff”标志，下方前端印有“THE SIMPSONS”字样。机器顶部的大招牌写着“Tomate tu”，并配有一个内置数字计分屏，准确显示 3 个玩家标签：“JUGADOR 1”、“JUGADOR 0”和“JUGADOR 2”，以及色彩丰富的像素化分数图形。左侧砖墙上，设有一个巨大的发光啤酒招牌，带有鹰标和“AGUILA CERVEZA”字样。右侧，一名身穿深色连帽衫和牛仔裤的年轻男子侧身站在机器旁，一只手插在口袋里，另一只手指向记分牌，面部刻意模糊处理。右下角前景处，放置一张小木桌，上面摆放着 2 瓶酒：一瓶高大的“AGUARDIENTE AMARILLO MANZANARES”和一瓶棕色“AGUILA”啤酒。在右后方增加一个狭窄的霓虹灯垂直窗户或发光面板，散发着紫色和蓝色的光芒。运用低调的暖琥珀色和红色酒吧灯光，营造出深邃的阴影、砖墙、瓷砖地面、细腻的反射效果，以及精致的 16 位 / 32 位时代像素艺术阴影，在 {argument name="location" default="博亚卡省杜伊塔马"} 营造出一种怀旧、私密且略带电影感的夜生活氛围。

templates.prompt: A cinematic, vertically composed photograph shows a hand holding up a giant, balloon-shaped wine glass filled with a shimmering golden citrus cocktail, against a backdrop of a lush indoor conservatory bar. The drink, backlit by the warm afternoon sun, takes on a translucent amber sheen. A slice of citrus is visible in the glass, and a sprig of fresh mint garnishes the rim. The hand reaches in from the lower left, elegantly holding the stem, and wears a thick, translucent amber bracelet on the wrist. The environment is filled with tropical greenery, hanging ferns, and vine-covered walls, with the bright conservatory roof structure visible above. Two warm, hanging light bulbs softly illuminate the background. Using shallow depth of field and a creamy blur, the strong sunlight filters through the leaves, creating a soft mist and a rich green-gold contrast. Add a blurred foreground leaf or plant along the right edge to compose the image. The lower background should suggest a busy café or cocktail bar with blurred figures, but these should remain highly blurred. Photorealistic and elegant lifestyle photography, full of atmosphere and sunshine, using a low angle to shoot a raised wine glass, showcasing high detail in condensation, glass reflections and glowing beverages.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影质感的竖构图照片，展示了一只手举起一个巨大的气球状葡萄酒杯，杯中盛着闪烁的金色柑橘鸡尾酒，背景是郁郁葱葱的室内温室酒吧。饮品被午后温暖的阳光逆光照射，呈现出半透明的琥珀色光泽。杯中可见 1 片柑橘，杯缘装饰着 1 簇新鲜薄荷。手从左下方伸入，优雅地握住杯柄，手腕上戴着 1 只厚实的半透明琥珀色手镯。环境布满了热带绿植、悬挂的蕨类植物和藤蔓覆盖的墙壁，上方可见明亮的温室屋顶结构，背景中有 2 个温暖的悬挂灯泡在柔和地发光。使用浅景深和奶油般的虚化效果，强烈的阳光透过叶片过滤，带有柔和的雾气，形成浓郁的绿金色彩对比。在右边缘添加一片模糊的前景叶子或植物来构图。背景下方应暗示一个繁忙的咖啡馆或鸡尾酒吧，有模糊的人影，但需保持高度虚化。照片级逼真，优雅的生活方式摄影，氛围感十足且阳光明媚，采用低角度仰拍举起的酒杯，展现冷凝水、玻璃反射和发光饮品的高细节。

templates.title: Cyberpunk-style designer debate poster

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克风格设计师辩论海报

templates.prompt: A cinematic cyberpunk poster in a 9:16 portrait format, using a low-angle, dynamic shot, shows a futuristic female designer running through a neon-lit metropolis at night, one hand reaching towards the camera, with a strong sense of perspective. She keeps {argument name="hair color" default="Black with magenta and violet highlights"} Her hair billowed in the wind, and she wore a shiny black techwear jacket, fingerless metallic gloves, and reflective futuristic streetwear. The scene was bathed in electric purple, magenta, blue, and white light, accompanied by damp streets, movement tracks, glowing skyscraper signs, holographic billboards, and deep urban spaces. A large title overlay was placed in the center of the image, with the text {argument name="headline text" default="O FIM DO DESIGNER?"} The design features a bold, glowing font, with a smaller, pink line at the top and a large, white, shimmering word below, surrounded by subtle angular HUD lines, and a small neon triangle at the bottom. The environment includes three visible vertical billboards with the following text: the left reads "Design of the Future," the middle right displays a portrait-style advertisement, and the far right reads "Is the Future Created by People or AI?" The composition is dynamic, glossy, and dramatic, reminiscent of a social media poster debating high-end AI and design, with strong rim lighting, reflections, speed lines, and a sophisticated sci-fi editorial style.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张 9:16 竖屏格式的电影级赛博朋克海报，采用低角度动态动作镜头，展示了一位未来主义女性设计师在夜晚的霓虹大都市中飞奔，一只手伸向镜头，具有强烈的透视感。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色带有洋红色和紫罗兰色挑染"} 的头发，在风中向后飘动，身穿亮面黑色机能风夹克，佩戴露指金属手套和反光未来主义街头服饰。场景浸润在电光紫、洋红、蓝和白色的光影中，伴有潮湿的街道、运动轨迹、发光的摩天大楼招牌、全息广告牌和深邃的城市空间。在画面中心放置一个巨大的标题叠加层，文字为 {argument name="headline text" default="O FIM DO DESIGNER?"}，采用粗体发光字体，上方一行较小且呈粉色，下方单词巨大、白色且闪烁光芒，周围环绕着微妙的角形 HUD 线条，下方有一个小的霓虹三角形。在环境中包含 3 个可见的垂直广告牌，文字内容如下：左侧写着“デザインの未来”，中右侧展示一个肖像风格广告，最右侧写着“未来を創るのは人か、AIか?”。构图极具活力、光泽感和戏剧性，呈现出如同社交媒体上高端 AI 与设计辩论海报的质感，具有强烈的轮廓光、反射效果、速度线以及精致的科幻编辑风格。

templates.prompt: A cozy, anime-style interior scene of a traditional Japanese soba noodle shop, the camera angle positioned at the height of the booth tables. Two young women sit near the corner of a rectangular wooden table, facing the camera, creating a candid, relaxed dining feel. The woman on the left has long, straight hair, and her hair color is {argument name="hair color" default="Lavender color with blue highlights"} The woman on the right has glossy, smooth hair with light bangs. She wears a white kimono-style blouse with bright blue trim, paired with a dark blue belted skirt. She is slightly plump and sits on a red vinyl bench on the left, turning slightly towards the camera, raising her left hand in a friendly wave. The woman on the right has a neat short bob, dark brown to black, with a hint of purple undercoat at the ends. She wears red rectangular glasses and small earrings, a fitted charcoal gray long-sleeved round-neck blouse, and light blue jeans. She sits on a red vinyl bench on the right, leaning slightly forward, holding chopsticks in her right hand, as if preparing to eat. On the table are two large black soba noodle bowls, one in front of each woman, filled with dark broth, noodles, slices of duck, and chopped green onions. Near the center of the back of the table is a clear water glass, next to two small condiment dishes. The restaurant should have a warm and nostalgic atmosphere, featuring wooden paneling, a shoji-style window on the left, a small potted plant on the windowsill, a counter displaying condiments and cutlery at the back, and a dark blue noren (traditional Japanese curtain) hanging on the right with the large white characters for "soba" and smaller vertical text for "te-ji-soba" (hand-pulled soba). Seven vertical wooden menu items are displayed on the back wall, listing Japanese dishes and prices, including labels such as "morisobaba," "zaruobaba," "kakeobaba," "tanukikiobaba," "minobuobaba," "tenpurababa," and "kamonanbanobaba." The restaurant utilizes clean and refined anime-style rendering, crisp line art, soft and warm lighting, delicate food illustrations, and rich wood textures to create a friendly, casual outing atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个温馨的动漫风格传统日式荞麦面馆室内场景，视角位于卡座餐桌高度。两名年轻女性坐在长方形木桌的近角处，面对镜头，呈现出休闲用餐的抓拍感。左侧女性留着长直发，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="带有青色挑染的薰衣草色"}，发丝光泽柔顺，留着轻盈的刘海；她身穿带有亮蓝色滚边的白色和服式上衣，搭配深蓝色腰带式半身裙；她身材微丰，坐在左侧红色乙烯基长凳上，身体微向镜头转动，左手举起，做出友好挥手的姿势。右侧女性留着利落的深棕色至黑色短波波头，发梢隐约可见紫色内层，戴着红色长方形眼镜和小型耳环，身穿修身的炭灰色长袖圆领上衣，下搭浅蓝色牛仔裤；她坐在右侧红色乙烯基长凳上，身体微向前倾，右手拿着筷子，仿佛正准备用餐。桌上摆放 2 只大型黑色荞麦面碗，每位女性面前各一只，碗中盛满深色汤底、面条、鸭肉片和葱花；在桌子后方中央附近放置 1 只透明水杯，旁边放 2 只小型调料碟。餐厅氛围应温馨且怀旧，配有木质镶板、左侧的障子式窗户、窗台上的一盆小绿植、后方摆放调料和餐具的柜台，以及右侧挂着的深蓝色暖帘，上面印有白色大字“蕎麦”和较小的竖排文字“手打ちそば”。后墙上展示 7 块竖排木质菜单项目，上面写着日式菜名和价格，包括“もりそば”、“ざるそば”、“かけそば”、“たぬきそば”、“肉そば”、“天ぷらそば”和“鴨南蛮そば”等标签。采用干净精致的动漫渲染、清晰的线条艺术、柔和温暖的灯光、细腻的食物插画、丰富的木质纹理，营造出友好的日常出游氛围。

templates.title: Retro-style sculpted hoodie portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 复古雕刻风格连帽衫肖像

templates.prompt: A centered black-and-white, vintage-style engraving portrait depicts a bearded man wearing a hoodie with a backwards baseball cap peeking out from beneath. Only the head and upper body are shown against a background of finely textured, off-white paper. Presented in a delicate pen-and-ink etching style, it employs dense cross-hatching, fine parallel lines, and shading reminiscent of ancient book illustrations. The figure faces forward, his posture calm and natural. An adjustable strap is visible at the forehead of the baseball cap, and combed-back hair peeks out from above the brim, while a thick beard covers the lower part of the face. Two drawstrings hang from the chest of the hoodie. The composition remains symmetrical and compact, like a classic engraved bust, devoid of color, modern graphic elements, and other objects in the background.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张居中的黑白复古雕刻风格肖像，描绘了一位蓄须男子，他穿着连帽衫并戴着兜帽，兜帽下露出反戴的棒球帽。仅展示头部和上半身，背景为带有细微纹理的素色米白色纸张。以细腻的钢笔画蚀刻风格呈现，运用密集的交叉排线、精细的平行线条以及古籍插画般的阴影效果。人物面朝前方，姿态沉稳自然。棒球帽前额处可见调节扣带，帽檐上方露出向后梳理的头发，面部下方留有浓密的络腮胡。连帽衫胸前垂下两条抽绳。构图保持对称且紧凑，如同经典的雕刻半身像，无色彩，无现代图形元素，背景中无其他物体。

templates.title: Luxury Fragrance Bottle in Gold Fur

templates.prompt: A luxurious editorial product photograph showcases a perfume bottle nestled within dense, soft faux fur, its rich hues of golden caramel and honey brown. At the center of the composition is a clear, oval glass bottle containing a warm amber liquid, topped with a glossy, rounded black cap and a simple white rectangular label. The label text should be displayed at the top.{argument name="brand name" default="BYREDO"} Large text displayed in the middle{argument name="product name" default="BAL D’AFRIQUE"} Small text displayed at the bottom{argument name="product type" default="EAU DE PARFUM"} Employing close-up still-life photography techniques and soft studio lighting, the images feature delicate highlights on the glass and bottle caps, and soft shadows in the fur folds, creating an overall warm, cinematic tone. The perfume bottle is slightly embedded in the fur, allowing the surrounding texture to envelop it from all sides, creating a high-end fashion editorial atmosphere. The composition is minimalist, with shallow depth of field and a clearly focused label, showcasing the aesthetics of a high-end beauty advertisement.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张奢华的编辑类产品摄影作品，展示了一个置于浓密、柔软的人造皮草中的香水瓶，皮草呈现出浓郁的金色焦糖色和蜂蜜棕色调。构图中心为一个透明的椭圆形玻璃瓶，瓶内装有温暖的琥珀色液体，配有光泽圆润的黑色瓶盖和简洁的白色长方形标签。标签文字应在顶部显示 {argument name="brand name" default="BYREDO"}，中间大字显示 {argument name="product name" default="BAL D’AFRIQUE"}，底部小字显示 {argument name="product type" default="EAU DE PARFUM"}。采用特写静物拍摄手法，配合柔和的影棚灯光，玻璃和瓶盖上有细腻的高光，皮草褶皱处有柔和的阴影，整体色调为温暖的电影感色调。香水瓶应略微嵌入皮草中，使周围的纹理从四面将其环绕，营造出高端时尚大片的氛围，构图极简，浅景深，标签焦点清晰，呈现出高端美妆广告的审美。

templates.title: Ink-wash etching style family portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 水墨蚀刻风格全家福

templates.prompt: A black-and-white hand-drawn family portrait, rendered with delicate pen-and-ink cross-hatching on textured white paper, depicts four people sitting closely together in a natural and relaxed composition. On the left is an adult male wearing a backwards baseball cap and a dark T-shirt, leaning towards the center of the image, with a shoulder bag featuring a prominent zipper slung across his chest. On the right is an adult female with curly hair tied in a loose high bun, wearing a light-colored T-shirt with large, striking preppy lettering.{argument name="shirt text" default="CITY"} Two young children sit close together in the center, both with short, curly hair and wearing matching light-colored T-shirts printed with strawberry patterns. The child on the left leans inward, one arm draped over the other, while the child on the right has their head slightly tilted back. Adults protectively surround the children from both sides, creating a warm family snapshot atmosphere. The entire image is rendered as a monochrome etching illustration, employing dense, fine hatching lines, sculptural shadows, and sharp outlines to maintain realism while also possessing an artistic feel; the image is colorless, with a background consisting only of pure, light-colored paper texture, and uses a vertical composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张黑白手绘全家福，采用细腻的钢笔交叉排线风格，呈现于带有纹理的白纸之上，画面中 4 人紧密坐在一起，构图自然随性。左侧是一位成年男性，头戴反向棒球帽，身穿深色 T 恤，身体向画面中心倾斜，胸前斜挎着一个带有明显拉链细节的单肩包。右侧是一位留着卷发并扎成松散高丸子头的成年女性，身穿浅色 T 恤，上面印有醒目的大号学院风字母 {argument name="shirt text" default="CITY"}。中间坐着两个紧挨在一起的幼童，两人都留着短卷发，穿着印满草莓图案的浅色配套 T 恤。左侧的孩子向内倾斜，一只手臂搭在另一个孩子身上，右侧的孩子头部微微上扬。大人们从两侧保护性地环绕着孩子，营造出温馨的家庭快照氛围。将整张图像渲染为单色蚀刻插画，运用密集的细线排线、雕刻般的阴影和清晰的轮廓线，在保持写实的同时兼具艺术感；画面无色彩，背景仅为纯净的浅色纸张纹理，采用竖构图。

templates.title: Perfume on Moss - Editing Style Photography

templates.prompt: This high-end, editorial-style product photography features a luxurious perfume bottle at its center, set against a warm, earth-toned still-life backdrop. The product is a clear, rectangular glass bottle filled with a golden-amber liquid, topped with a glossy, rounded black cap. A simple white label on the front bears the words "BYREDO," "BAL D'AFRIQUE," and "EAU DE PARFUM." The perfume bottle is placed vertically on a bent, light-colored, weathered driftwood, surrounded by a dense layer of dark green moss that blankets the foreground and lower part of the frame. The minimalist studio composition places the product against a smooth, warm brown-to-amber gradient background, bathed in soft, sunset-like light. Dramatic, directional warm lighting from the upper right creates a bright halo on the background, sharp highlights on the cap, and soft reflections on the glass, while casting delicate shadows on the wood and moss. Maintaining a vertical composition, with the bottle positioned at the bottom center of the image and ample negative space above, the overall atmosphere is natural, luxurious, earthy, and cinematic, presenting the exquisite effect of a high-end perfume advertisement.

templates.prompt: This realistic, nostalgic interior scene depicts a family of four in 1980s China, gathered together to watch an old-fashioned television. The room is simply furnished, warm, and slightly worn, and the composition employs a documentary-style snapshot. Four family members are depicted: a father in a dark blue Zhongshan suit sits on the far left; next to him is a mother in a dark purple printed shirt; in the foreground, a young boy in a blue jacket and olive-colored trousers sits on a small wooden stool; and on the right is a little girl with her hair tied up, wearing a pink printed jacket. All four are turned to the side or have three-quarters of their backs to the television, their expressions focused and quiet. A vintage wooden-framed CRT television sits on the right, below which is a dark cabinet covered with white lace fabric; a black-and-white program plays on the screen, showing a person speaking. Behind the family, the walls are cream-colored, with a large old poster of Chairman Mao on the upper left wall, and a red vertical calligraphy couplet hanging near the center, the content of which is…{argument name="wall banner text" default="The Four Modernizations: A Grand Vision for the Rejuvenation of China"} A wooden cabinet sits beneath frosted glass windows, covered with a lace tablecloth, displaying enamel mugs, a printed thermos, small jars, and a miniature bust. A square analog clock and a vase of pink flowers sit atop the television. In the foreground, a simple rectangular coffee table holds a covered enamel mug and a plate of peanuts. templates.title: Chinese families watching television in the 1980s

titleLocalized.zh: 20 世纪 80 年代中国家庭看电视

templates.prompt: This is a warm, realistic, cinematic interior scene depicting a Chinese family of four watching television at home in the 1980s. The room is simple yet filled with a nostalgic atmosphere, with soft afternoon sunlight streaming in through an old, large wooden window on the right. The four family members are depicted: the father sits in a wicker chair on the left, wearing a blue work jacket and dark trousers; the mother sits on the right-center, wearing a long-sleeved floral blouse and simple trousers; the young daughter sits on the sofa, wearing a red overalls dress over a light-colored blouse, white socks, and dark red shoes; the young son sits beside her, wearing blue overalls over a light-colored blouse. All four face the television, presenting a peaceful moment of everyday life. In the center of the room is an old-fashioned CRT television placed on a low double-door cabinet, its protruding rabbit-ear antenna clearly visible. The screen displays a performer dressed in a traditional red and yellow stage costume. Behind the television is a weathered yellow plaster wall, bearing the marks of time, with a portrait of a couple hanging above it. On the left stands a tall, distressed green metal wardrobe, its paint peeling, topped with a brown suitcase. On the right is a floral sofa, its back covered with a white lace cover. Two red circular paper cutouts, each bearing the character "福" (fortune), adorn the large window. The floor is made of old-fashioned stone or tile, uneven and full of historical charm. Using authentic details of a Chinese home from the 1980s, the slightly faded colors, rich surface textures, and lifelike furniture create a documentary-style nostalgic atmosphere. The eye-level composition, wide-angle lens, natural proportions, realistic details, warm earth tones, and delicate, cinematic realism all contribute to the effect.

promptLocalized.zh: 这是一幅温馨、写实的电影感室内场景，描绘了 20 世纪 80 年代一个中国四口之家在家中看电视的画面。房间简朴而充满怀旧气息，柔和的午后阳光从右侧一扇老旧的大木窗洒入。画面中共有 4 位家庭成员：父亲坐在左侧的藤椅上，身穿蓝色工装夹克和深色长裤；母亲坐在中右侧，身穿长袖碎花衬衫和简约长裤；年幼的女儿坐在沙发上，穿着红色背带裙，内搭浅色衬衫，脚穿白袜和深红色鞋子；年幼的儿子坐在她身旁，穿着蓝色背带裤，内搭浅色衬衫。4 人都面向电视，呈现出平静的日常生活瞬间。房间中央是一个放在低矮双门柜上的老式 CRT 电视，伸出的兔耳天线清晰可见，电视屏幕上正播放着一位身穿红黄相间传统舞台服装的表演者。电视后方是斑驳的黄色灰泥墙，墙上有岁月留下的痕迹，上方挂着一幅夫妻肖像。左侧立着一个高大的做旧绿色金属衣柜，漆面剥落，顶部放着 1 个棕色手提箱。右侧是一张碎花沙发，椅背上铺着白色蕾丝盖布。大窗户上贴着 2 个红色的圆形剪纸，上面印有“福”字。地面是老式的石砖或地砖，凹凸不平且充满年代感。运用 20 世纪 80 年代中国家庭的真实细节，色调略显褪色，表面质感丰富，家具充满生活气息，营造出纪录片风格的怀旧氛围。平视构图，广角镜头，自然比例，写实细节，温暖的大地色调，细腻的电影级写实感。

templates.prompt: A highly dramatic vertical sci-fi anime poster, set against a rugged hangar corridor reminiscent of *Neon Genesis Evangelion*. At the center of the image, a girl with a light blue bob haircut walks forward, her expression calm and expressionless, her arms hanging naturally at her sides. Behind her, a massive orange and black bio-mechanical mech crouches in a protective stance, exuding an oppressive aura and dominating most of the background. (The girl should be referenced...){argument name="character design" default="Ayanami Rei-style pilot"} She has short, ice-blue hair, extremely pale skin, and wears a tight-fitting white combat suit with black panels on the sides and fine gray stitching. The chest features four circular details in red, green, blue, and dark metallic colors. The mecha should be referenced {argument name="mecha design" default="Robots in the style of Unit-00"} It possesses heavy, angular armor, a single-eyed mask, long, clawed arms, and crouching legs. The armor is a battle-worn yellow-orange, while the internal structure is black and dark gray, marked with scratches, dirt, and damage. The scene is set in a desolate industrial bay, surrounded by collapsed metal beams, broken concrete, smoke, steam, dangling cables, and a damp, reflective ground. Bright orange sparks erupt from the broken machinery on either side. On the left wall is a large, worn NERV-style mural with a red leaf symbol and text.{argument name="wall slogan" default="GOD'S IN HIS HEAVEN. ALL'S RIGHT WITH THE WORLD."} Employing a cinematic low-angle composition to emphasize depth, the film utilizes realistic materials, hard-edged overhead lighting, cool steel blue shadows, warm sparkling highlights, volumetric fog, ultra-fine textures, high contrast, a somber atmosphere, and a movie poster-like quality. The overall atmosphere creates {argument name="franchise mood" default="Dark live-action version of "Neon Genesis Evangelion" poster"} The feeling is one of exquisite detail, realism, intensity, and iconic quality.

templates.title: Blurry Retro Pixel Parrot Jungle

titleLocalized.zh: 模糊复古像素鹦鹉丛林

templates.prompt: A retro pixel art illustration depicts a tropical parrot perched on a short brown branch in the heart of a lush jungle. The bird, in profile facing right, boasts a bright green body, vibrant blue wings and a long blue tail, a yellow chest, an orange-red head and neck, white patches around its eyes, and a large, curved black beak. The parrot is the sole central subject, magnified and outlined with dark pixelated edges. It is surrounded by dense rainforest vegetation filling the entire image: layers of green leaves, entwined vines, and tree trunks visible on either side, including two prominent trunks and numerous overlapping clusters of leaves. A soft, glowing halo is added behind the parrot, distinguishing it from the darker forest background. The illustration employs a square composition, highly saturated colors, classic 16-bit game sprite aesthetics, coarsely visible pixels, low-resolution mesh rendering, and deliberately soft, blurred pixel edges, rather than the sharp edges of modern pixel art. The overall atmosphere is lush, vibrant, and nostalgic, reminiscent of a tropical scene from an old video game.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅复古像素艺术风格的插画，描绘了一只热带鹦鹉栖息在茂密丛林中央的一根棕色短树枝上。鸟儿呈侧面轮廓，面向右侧，拥有明亮的绿色身体、鲜艳的蓝色翅膀和长长的蓝色尾羽、黄色胸部、橙红色头部和颈部、眼周有白色斑块，以及一个巨大的弯曲黑色喙。鹦鹉是画面中唯一的中心主体，经过放大处理，并带有深色的像素边缘轮廓。周围环绕着填满整个画面的浓密雨林植被：层叠的绿叶、缠绕的藤蔓，以及两侧可见的树干，包括 2 根可见的树干和许多重叠的叶簇。在鹦鹉身后添加一个柔和的发光光环，将其与较暗的森林背景区分开来。采用方形构图、高饱和度色彩、经典的 16 位游戏精灵美学、粗犷可见的像素、低分辨率网格渲染，以及刻意柔和、模糊的像素边缘，而非现代清晰的像素艺术。整体氛围郁郁葱葱、充满活力且富有怀旧感，宛如老式电子游戏中的热带场景。

templates.title: Macro shell jellyfish on moist basalt

templates.prompt: An ultra-refined naturalistic macro photograph showcases a bizarre marine organism. Resembling a fusion of a dome-shaped shell and a translucent jellyfish body, it clings to the edge of a dark, damp basalt staircase in a waterfall setting. The creature possesses a large, greyish-white hemispherical shell covered with tightly packed concentric ridges, exhibiting a weathered, matte texture and subtle radial divisions. Beneath the shell lies a glossy, milky-white gelatinous membrane with soft, translucent folds, hanging, moist tentacles, and a ring of small, oval spiracles visible at the base. Several short, translucent spines or fleshy protrusions cling to the rock along the left edge of the shell. The environment consists of layered vertical columns and ledges, their surfaces covered with flowing spring water, mineral residue, and water mist. Pearl-like, rounded nodules are scattered across the ledges in the foreground and midground. The overall composition is a cool, monochromatic palette of silver, charcoal, slate grey, and greyish-white. The soft, overcast lighting, high humidity, shallow depth of field, cinematic macro lens, ultra-realistic surface details, lifelike wet reflections, subtle water flow marks, and delicate water mist create a slightly eerie sense of realism in the biological organism (no visible light). The composition is centered, with the organism positioned in the left-middle foreground.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超精细的自然主义微距摄影作品，展示了一种奇异的海洋有机生物。该生物形似一个圆顶贝壳与半透明水母身体的融合体，附着在瀑布环境中深色湿润的玄武岩阶梯边缘。生物拥有一个巨大的灰白色半球形外壳，表面布满紧密排列的同心脊，呈现出风化的哑光质感和微妙的径向分割。外壳下方是光泽的乳白色胶状膜，带有柔软的半透明褶边、悬垂的湿润触须，以及底部可见的一圈小型椭圆形气孔。在外壳左侧边缘，有几根短小的半透明棘刺或肉质突起紧贴岩石。环境由层叠的垂直石柱和岩架组成，表面覆盖着流动的泉水、矿物质残留和水雾，前景和中景的岩架上散布着珍珠般圆润的结节。整体采用银色、炭色、板岩灰和灰白色的冷色调单色调。柔和的阴天光线，高湿度，浅景深，电影级微距镜头，超真实的表面细节，逼真的湿润反光，细微的水流痕迹，精致的水雾，呈现出一种略带诡异的生物有机体真实感（无可见光），构图居中，生物位于左中前景。

templates.title: Tibetan top hat ethnographic plate

Add a large title at the top center.{argument name="headline text" default="Tang Xu Mao"} The Romanized spelling is below.{argument name="romanization" default="(thang zhwa)"} Add a smaller subtitle describing it as a summer hat worn by Tibetan high monks. Add a bordered metadata panel in the top left corner containing several short Chinese fields; add a plate number in the top right corner.{argument name="plate number" default="Plate No. 27"} Add a bordered Chinese annotation at the bottom. Overall style: rigorous archival infographics, anthropological cataloging illustrations, historically based, precise weaving textures, ivory gold background with blue and red accents, elegant typography, fine lines and decorative separators, presenting highly detailed object rendering on a plain paper background.

Clothing should complement the racket's color scheme. The composition should be modern and minimalist, with a clean studio background or soft gradient colors. templates.title: Luxury Fragrance: The Art of Transformation

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华香水蜕变艺术

templates.prompt: A high-end, cinematic transformation artwork, presented through five vertical panels, showcases {argument name="subject" default="Luxury perfume"} The process of transforming a raw essence into a sculptural masterpiece is depicted, with each panel separated by fine black lines. Panel 1 (Origin): A fine glass perfume bottle rests on a dark, reflective surface, surrounded by {argument name="ingredients" default="Raw ingredients such as rose petals, agarwood, citrus peel, and mist"} Soft studio lighting, elegant shadows. Panel 2 (Release): The fragrance begins to diffuse into the air, visible scent mist swirling upwards in a fluid manner, forming soft, organic shapes, accompanied by luminous particles and vapor trails. Panel 3 (Transformation): The mist begins to shape into semi-formed silhouettes (abstract human figures or flowing fabrics), blending liquid, vapor, and light and shadow, dreamlike and luminous. Panel 4 (Abstract): The form becomes completely abstract—the flowing fragrance ribbons transform into smooth, glassy curves and fluid geometry, the dynamic moment frozen in mid-air. Panel 5 (Sublimation): The final form—a luxurious, sculptural perfume bottle or an abstract glass sculpture inspired by the fragrance essence, polished and reflective with luminous highlights, placed on a minimalist base. Style: Ultra-refined, an evolution from realism to abstraction, deep black background.{argument name="accents" default="Gold and silver embellishments"} Soft halo, high-contrast lighting, glossy reflection, cinematic luxury aesthetics, perfume ad style, 4K picture quality, sharp focus.

promptLocalized.zh:
一件高端电影感蜕变艺术作品，以五个垂直面板呈现，展示 {argument name="subject" default="奢华香水"} 从原始精华演变为雕塑杰作的过程，每个面板由细黑线分隔。
面板 1（起源）：一个高级玻璃香水瓶静置于深色反光表面上，周围环绕着 {argument name="ingredients" default="玫瑰花瓣、沉香木、柑橘皮和薄雾等原始成分"}，柔和的摄影棚灯光，优雅的阴影。
面板 2（释放）：香水开始向空气中扩散，可见的香氛雾气呈流体状向上盘旋，形成柔和的有机形状，伴有发光粒子和蒸汽轨迹。
面板 3（蜕变）：雾气开始塑造成半成形的轮廓（抽象的人形或飘逸的织物），融合了液体、蒸汽与光影，梦幻而明亮。
面板 4（抽象）：形态变得完全抽象——流动的香氛丝带转化为光滑的玻璃状曲线和流体几何结构，动态瞬间定格于空中。
面板 5（升华）：最终形态——一个奢华的雕塑感香水瓶或受香氛精华启发的抽象玻璃雕像，经过抛光，具有反光效果，带有发光高光，置于极简底座之上。
风格：超精细，从写实到抽象的演变，深黑色背景，{argument name="accents" default="金银色点缀"}，柔和光晕，高对比度照明，光泽反射，电影级奢华美学，香水广告风格，4K 画质，焦点清晰。

Only a very small amount of similar color accents are permitted elsewhere.

promptLocalized.zh:
ASPECT_RATIO: [{argument name="长宽比" default="3:4"}]

SOURCE_IMAGE: [{argument name="参考图" default="上传的照片"}]

ACCENT_COLOR: [{argument name="点缀色" default="单一鲜艳的高光色"}]

以上传的照片作为基础图像和唯一的身份来源。保持人物完全一致且清晰可辨。忽略原始构图，始终将其重新构图为紧凑的特写或上半身编辑裁剪，使面部占据画面主体。将图像转化为手势风格的编辑类墨水时尚插画。风格必须由粗犷的黑色笔触构成，而非细腻的素描线条。

使用：

极粗的黑色笔触

宽阔的干擦笔触

大面积不对称的黑色墨块

修长且随性的书法线条

破碎的轮廓

带有刮擦感的辅助线条

强烈的黑白对比（象牙白背景）

平滑的单色皮肤

粗笔触必须占据主导地位。不要主要用细轮廓线来绘制肖像。不要使其显得整洁、精致或柔和。图像应呈现出饱蘸墨水的绘画感，并以锋利且富有表现力的笔触收尾。

保持肖像的时尚感和高定感。

使用一件核心配饰，最好是超大号的半透明有色墨镜。

点缀色 [ACCENT_COLOR] 必须主要体现在该配饰中，尤其是镜片部分，呈现为大胆明亮的色调。仅允许在其他地方出现极少量的同色系辅助痕迹。

templates.title: Hyper-realistic iPhone 17 Pro Max Advertisement

titleLocalized.zh: 超写实 iPhone 17 Pro Max 广告

templates.prompt: A hyperrealistic image{argument name="phone model" default="Apple iPhone 17 Pro Max"} The advertisement was shot in a dark, emotional style. It features a stylish young woman with warm skin and a soft brown updo, wearing {argument name="clothing" default="Grayish purple velvet off-shoulder mini dress"} Wearing thigh-high grey-brown suede boots and a thin black choker, she poses confidently, extending her arm to take a selfie with her iPhone 17 Pro Max facing the camera. The phone features a titanium desert finish and a flush quad-camera system. The edge-to-edge ProMotion display shimmers with vibrant colors, dominating the center of the frame. The composition employs a shallow depth of field, with the focus clearly on the phone screen and her outstretched arm, while the background figure is rendered with a soft, cinematic bokeh effect.{argument name="background style" default="almost black charcoal gray"} The background features subtle urban textures—graffiti-like strokes in electric yellow and soft olive green are faintly visible within the deep, dark shadows. Multiple lines of tiny, all-caps text wrap around the phone at different angles, displaying phrases like "EVERY ANGLE. EVERY MOMENT. EVERY YOU." and "THE SHOT YOU NEVER MISS"—some vertically aligned, others tilted at a 30-degree angle, creating a chaotic yet deliberate graphic magazine style. A clean, brushed silver Apple logo contrasts against the dark background in the upper right corner. A thin, horizontal navigation bar at the top center displays "PRO CAMERA · TITANIUM BUILD · BEYOND INTELLIGENCE" in wide-spaced, all-caps serif font. A striking headline—"CAPTURE" in huge, bold white letters—is placed in the center of the right side, followed by the thinner "EVERYTHING," creating a dramatic typographic hierarchy. Yellow plus signs (+) and diagonal arrows (↗) are scattered throughout the image as decorative details. The bottom left corner features a striking slogan: "YOUR WORLD. YOUR FRAME." in large, bold, sans-serif white text, followed by a smaller subtitle: "The most powerful iPhone ever made. Every selfie is a cinematic moment." The overall lighting is dramatic and directional—a cool-toned main light from the upper left makes the titanium frame shimmer, the ProMotion display glows, and the velvet dress captures a soft, warm sheen in the darkness. Photorealistic. Commercial photography quality. High contrast. 4K resolution. 3:4 portrait format optimized for social media.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超写实的 {argument name="phone model" default="Apple iPhone 17 Pro Max"} 广告，采用暗调、情绪化的编辑风格拍摄。一位肤色温暖、留着柔和棕色盘发的时尚年轻女性，身穿 {argument name="clothing" default="灰紫色天鹅绒露肩迷你裙"}，脚蹬大腿高灰褐色麂皮高跟靴，颈戴细黑色颈圈，正处于摆拍姿势中，自信地伸出手臂，将 iPhone 17 Pro Max 朝向镜头进行自拍。手机采用钛金属沙漠色饰面，配备平齐的四镜头系统，边缘到边缘的 ProMotion 显示屏闪烁着鲜艳的色彩，占据了画面的中心。构图采用了浅景深，焦点清晰地落在手机屏幕和伸出的手臂上，背景人物则呈现出柔和的电影级虚化效果。{argument name="background style" default="近乎黑色的炭灰色"} 背景叠加了微妙的城市纹理——在浓重的暗色晕影中，隐约可见电光黄和柔和橄榄色的涂鸦笔触。多行超小的全大写排版文字以不同角度环绕手机，写着“EVERY ANGLE. EVERY MOMENT. EVERY YOU.”和“THE SHOT YOU NEVER MISS”等短语——有的垂直排列，有的以 30 度角倾斜，营造出一种混乱而刻意的图形杂志风格。右上角是简洁的拉丝银色 Apple Logo，与深色背景形成对比。顶部中央有一条细长的水平导航式文本栏，以间距宽阔的全大写衬线字体写着“PRO CAMERA · TITANIUM BUILD · BEYOND INTELLIGENCE”。右侧中心位置放置了一个醒目的大标题——“CAPTURE”采用巨大的超粗体白色字母，下方紧跟较细字重的“EVERYTHING”，形成了戏剧性的字体层级。画面中散布着黄色加号 (+) 和对角箭头 (↗) 作为装饰细节。左下角是醒目的标语组合：“YOUR WORLD. YOUR FRAME.”，采用大号粗体无衬线白色文字，下方配有一行细小的副标题：“The most powerful iPhone ever made. Every selfie is a cinematic moment.” 整体光影效果戏剧且具有方向感——来自左上方的冷色主光使钛金属边框闪烁，ProMotion 显示屏发出光芒，天鹅绒裙子在黑暗中捕捉到柔和温暖的光泽。照片级真实感。商业摄影质量。高对比度。4K 分辨率。专为社交媒体优化的 3:4 竖屏格式。

Facial split: Left side – Clean skin, with {argument name="markings" default="Delicate amber-colored technical markings (number "6.66", spiral symbol, hand-drawn style)"} Right side—{argument name="skin effect" default="Matte black skin covered with a thick layer of black resin (glossy, wet appearance, partially dry, with stretchy, shiny filaments between the skin and fingers)."} One eye is a natural dark brown, the other with a subtle amber glow (delicate, like light passing through honey, without a beam). templates.title: Dance choreography instructions

titleLocalized.zh: 舞蹈编排说明表提示词

templates.prompt: Dance Sequence Description [Visual Style] The composition features a highly detailed 3D rendered female dancer. The design style references professional choreography guidelines, employing a technical, chart-like layout. A clean white background, soft studio lighting, and strong contrast highlight body movements and postures. [Grid Layout] A structured 4x4 panel grid (16 frames total), evenly separated by thin black dividing lines. Each panel is the same size and clearly numbered 1 to 16 to show the continuous dance progression. [Character] Image1 is used as the base character. The same female dancer remains consistent across all panels, with accurate portrait features and proportions. [Costume] The dancer wears stylish and performance-appropriate clothing: a fitted top paired with a short, flowing skirt. The styling should be modern and visually appealing while also being practical for dance movements. Even in grayscale mode, the fabric should subtly respond to movement (presenting a slight sense of flow and wrinkles). [Panel Structure – Each Frame] Top Left: Step Number + Short Dance Move Name (e.g., “Step 5 – Rotation Transition”) Center: Full-body pose capturing a precise moment in the choreography Bottom Left: 3–4 lines of concise action description text Overlay: Movement arrows and directional guides to explain how the dancer transitions [Motion Instructions] Add curved arrows for smooth movements, straight arrows for directional steps, and circular indicators for rotations or turns. Emphasize rhythm, weight transfer, and localized body movements. [Rendering Quality] High-detail sculpted 3D style with smooth grayscale shadows, subtle projections, and clean lines. Maintain a beautiful concept art-level quality, ensuring every pose is clearly visible. [Constraints] No color, no background scene, no extra characters, no visual clutter; only dancers and illustrative elements are retained.

promptLocalized.zh: 舞蹈序列说明表 [视觉风格] 构图包含一位高度精细的 3D 渲染女性舞者。设计风格参考专业舞蹈编排指南，采用技术性、图表式的布局。干净的白色背景，柔和的摄影棚灯光，以及强烈的对比度以突出身体动作和姿态。 [网格布局] 结构化的 4×4 面板网格（共 16 帧），由细黑色分割线均匀隔开。每个面板尺寸相同，并清晰地编号为 1 至 16，以展示连续的舞蹈进程。 [角色] 使用 image1 作为基础角色。同一位女性舞者在所有面板中保持一致，具有准确的肖像特征和比例。 [服装] 舞者穿着时尚且适合表演的服装：修身上衣搭配短款飘逸裙装。造型应现代且具有视觉吸引力，同时兼顾舞蹈动作的实用性。即使在灰度模式下，面料也应微妙地响应动作（呈现轻微的流动感和褶皱）。 [面板结构 – 每一帧] 左上角：步骤编号 + 简短的舞蹈动作名称（例如：“步骤 5 – 旋转过渡”） 中心：捕捉编排中精确瞬间的全身姿态 左下角：3–4 行简洁的动作说明文字 叠加层：用于说明舞者如何过渡的运动箭头和方向引导 [运动指示] 加入用于流畅动作的曲线箭头、用于方向性步伐的直线箭头，以及用于旋转或转圈的圆形指示器。强调节奏、重心转移和身体局部动作。 [渲染质量] 高细节雕刻 3D 风格，具有平滑的灰度阴影、微妙的投影和干净的线条。保持精美的概念艺术级质感，确保每个姿态都清晰可见。 [限制条件] 无颜色，无背景场景，无额外角色，无视觉杂乱，仅保留舞者和说明性元素。

[Layout (Adaptive)] - Use a grid layout (automatically select 2 columns / 3 columns / irregular distribution) - Adjust the number of cards according to the content (usually 5–9) - High information density modules can be enlarged (increase visual weight) - Simple modules can be shrunk or merged [Card Design] - White cards (#FFFFFF) - Rounded corners + subtle shadows (soft sense of hierarchy) - Maintain consistent spacing and alignment [Each information module contains] - Simple illustrations (consistent style) - Clear headings (strong sense of hierarchy) - 1–3 core explanatory sentences (avoid verbosity) - Provide examples/comparisons/where necessary Summary [Content Organization Principles (Key)] Automatically select an appropriate structure based on the theme, for example: - Conceptual → Definition + Principle + Features + Examples - Comparison → A vs B (Comparison Structure) - Process → Steps/Flowchart - System → Components + Relationships - Skill → Methods + Techniques + Common Mistakes [Visual Hierarchy] - Title > Module Title > Body > Auxiliary Information - Important information can be highlighted with color or icons [Color Suggestions] - Primary Color: Choose according to the theme (Technology = Blue, Learning = Green, Warning = Orange) - Secondary Colors: 1–2 colors are sufficient - Avoid high saturation and flashy color schemes [Style Requirements] - Sufficient white space, with a strong sense of "breathing" - Unified icons (linear or flat) - Prioritize high readability - Clear educational orientation [Additional Optimization (Optional)] - May include: comparison modules/flow arrows/structure diagrams - A "core summary" module can be set as a visual ending.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张简洁的教育信息图海报，用于解释“{argument name="topic" default="主题"}”。

[整体风格]
现代极简 UI 风格，背景采用柔和的浅色调（例如：奶油色 #FAF7F2 / 浅灰蓝色），配色克制且舒适，适合长时间阅读。

[核心要求 (关键)]
根据“主题”的信息结构自然地组织内容模块。不要强行固定模块的数量或顺序；优先考虑清晰的逻辑信息，而非形式上的对称。

[布局 (自适应)]
- 使用网格布局（自动选择 2 列 / 3 列 / 不规则分布）
- 卡片数量根据内容调整（通常为 5–9 个）
- 高信息密度的模块可以放大（增加视觉权重）
- 简单的模块可以缩小或合并

[卡片设计]
- 白色卡片 (#FFFFFF)
- 圆角 + 微弱阴影（柔和的层次感）
- 保持统一的间距和对齐

[每个信息模块包含]
- 简单的插图（统一风格）
- 清晰的标题（强层级感）
- 1–3 句核心解释性文字（避免冗长）
- 必要时提供示例 / 对比 / 总结

[内容组织原则 (重点)]
根据主题自动选择合适的结构，例如：
- 概念类 → 定义 + 原理 + 特征 + 示例
- 对比类 → A vs B（对比结构）
- 流程类 → 步骤 / 流程图
- 系统类 → 组件 + 关系
- 技能类 → 方法 + 技巧 + 常见错误

[视觉层级]
- 标题 > 模块标题 > 正文 > 辅助信息
- 重要信息可通过颜色或图标进行高亮显示

[配色建议]
- 主色：根据主题选择（科技=蓝色，学习=绿色，警告=橙色）
- 辅色：1–2 种即可
- 避免高饱和度和花哨的配色

[风格要求]
- 留白充足，具有强烈的“呼吸感”
- 统一的图标（线性或扁平化）
- 优先考虑高可读性
- 清晰的教育导向

[额外优化 (可选)]
- 可包含：对比模块 / 流程箭头 / 结构图
- 可设置一个“核心总结”模块作为视觉结尾。
