Main colors: Dark brown, reddish-brown, light gold, off-white. Font style: The title uses Chinese calligraphy style, and the body text uses clear and easy-to-read Chinese Song/Kai fonts. Overall impression: Professional, classic, neat, and high-end, like a palmistry analysis card issued by a traditional fortune teller. Title design: The main title at the top reads: "Palm Analysis Chart." The subtitle reads: "Traditional Palmistry · I Ching Reference · Trend Analysis." A small red stamp is added next to the title, with the text: "Heavenly Secrets." Small print at the bottom reads: "For traditional culture and entertainment reference only." Palm line marking requirements: Please use thin reddish-brown lines, dotted lines, dots, and numbers to mark the following 12 key points on the palm. Each number must clearly correspond to the analysis content on the right. The 12 points to be marked are: 1. Life Line, 2. Head Line, 3. Heart Line, 4. Fate Line, 5. Sun Line, 6. Health Line/Mercury Line, 7. Marriage Line, 8. Venus Mount, 9. Jupiter Mount, 10. Moon Mount, 11. Thumb Angle/Willpower, 12. Finger Shape and Palm Shape. Marking requirements: The lines must conform to the actual palm lines in the first image; do not draw them arbitrarily. Numbers and text must not obscure the main body of the palm. Dotted guide lines must be clear, like professional charts. Reasonable labeling is required on the left, right, and inside of the palm. The overall layout should refer to the second image, with the palm analysis diagram on the left and the text description on the right. Right-side analysis text requirements: Please generate 12 Chinese analyses on the right, each corresponding to a number. The text style should combine traditional palmistry, the I Ching, and Traditional Chinese Medicine constitution analysis, using professional language with a certain sense of warning and metaphysics, but without excessive exaggeration. Each item should be limited to 2-4 lines, with clear and easy-to-read text. Please use the following analysis content: 1. Life Line: A large and continuous arc indicates good basic physical fitness and strong recovery under pressure; if there are breaks in the middle or later sections, it suggests periodic fatigue and an unbalanced lifestyle, requiring attention to energy depletion. 2. Wisdom Line: A long and slightly drooping line indicates meticulous thinking, strong perception, and good observation and imagination; however, it also suggests a tendency to overthink and experience repeated inner conflicts under emotional pressure. 3. Heart Line: Moderate length; a slight fork at the end indicates a serious but slow-burning approach to relationships, valuing both commitment and spiritual connection; sensitive and prone to disappointment due to high expectations. 4. Fate Line: Faint vertical lines in the palm suggest an early life path that wasn't straightforward, relying more on self-exploration and accumulation; later life tends towards stability, a pattern of trial and error before settling into a stable state. 5. Sun Line: A thin sun line indicates late-blooming fame and achievement, not achieved overnight, but gradually revealed through work, reputation, and professional abilities. 6. Health Line/Mercury Line: This line is relatively hidden; according to traditional Chinese medicine, it suggests prioritizing the spleen and stomach, sleep, and emotional management; fatigue and anemia are likely to occur after overwork or staying up late. 7. Marriage Line: If there are more than one thin line on the side, it indicates selective and deliberate approach to relationships, not easily committing; true stability often comes from a shared set of values ​​after maturity. 8. Venus Mount: A full base of the thumb indicates a person who values ​​relationships and loyalty, possesses strong vitality and affinity; it also shows a strong emphasis on security and practical comfort. 9. Jupiter Mount: A slight bulge below the index finger represents ambition, self-discipline, and a high sense of responsibility; suitable for roles of organizer, promoter, and coordinator in a team. 10. Moon Mount: A soft texture below the edge of the palm indicates strong intuition, empathy, and aesthetic sense; rich imagination, suitable for content creation, aesthetics, and communication-related work. 11. Thumb Angle/Willpower: A naturally open thumb angle represents independent thinking and a clear will to execute; not a follower, once a clear direction is formed, they can often persevere. 12. Finger and Palm Shape: An overall long palm shape and slender fingers indicate a type that combines sensibility and rationality, valuing both experience and logic; dislikes being careless in work, and is better suited for steady progress in finances. Bottom Conclusion: Please design a classic border information box at the bottom with the title: "Overall Conclusion". Content: • Overall, the chart is above average. Early years are marked by exploration and change, gradually becoming clearer in the later stages, moving towards steady accumulation. • The personality is rational, pragmatic, and empathetic, suitable for building value through professionalism, aesthetics, communication, or long-termism. • In relationships, sincerity and spiritual connection are valued. Slow to warm up but focused, stable relationships are more likely to be achieved after maturity. • The most important focus recently is adjusting sleep, emotions, and digestion; maintaining a stable state will lead to smoother fortune. Layout Requirements: Left Side: Enlarge the main palm, occupying 55%-60% of the screen. Right Side: Place 12 numbered analyses, occupying 35%-40% of the screen. Bottom: Place the comprehensive conclusion box. Text must be clear, without garbled characters, typos, or distortion. All numbers, lines, titles, and body text must have a consistent Chinese aesthetic style. The overall image should look like a professional metaphysical analysis chart, not a standard mobile phone screenshot. Do not include English. Do not include watermarks. Do not alter the basic shape of the original palm. Finally, output a high-definition 3:4 Chinese palmistry analysis poster.

promptLocalized.zh: 请根据我上传的第一张手掌照片，结合第二张参考图的排版风格，生成一张 3:4 比例的高清中文手相分析图。核心要求：请以第一张图中的真实手掌作为分析主体，尽量保留原手掌的形状、手指比例、掌型、肤色、掌纹走向及真实质感。第二张图仅供视觉风格参考：参考其中国玄学信息图风格、米白色背景、棕红色字体、传统书法标题、红色圆形编号、虚线引导线、掌纹标记、右侧文字分析栏以及底部综合结论框。请勿复制第二张图中的手掌，请勿复制水印，且不要包含任何平台 Logo。视觉风格：整体打造高端中国玄学风格的“手相分析图”。图片比例：3:4。画质：高清，细节清晰，适合发布在小红书上。背景：米白色宣纸纹理，带有淡淡的复古质感。主色调：深棕色、红棕色、浅金色、米白色。字体风格：标题使用中国书法风格，正文使用清晰易读的中文宋体/楷体。整体感觉：专业、古典、整洁且高端，如同由传统命理大师出具的手相分析卡。标题设计：顶部书写主标题：“手相分析图”。书写副标题：“传统手相 · 易理参考 · 趋势分析”。在标题旁添加一枚红色小印章，文字为：“天机”。底部书写小字：“仅供传统文化与娱乐参考”。掌纹标注要求：请使用细红棕色线条、虚线、圆点和数字在手掌上标记以下 12 个关键点。每个数字必须清晰对应右侧的分析内容。需标记的 12 个点：1. 生命线，2. 智慧线，3. 感情线，4. 命运线，5. 太阳线，6. 健康线 / 水星线，7. 婚姻线，8. 金星丘，9. 木星丘，10. 月丘，11. 大拇指张角 / 意志力，12. 指形与掌型。标注要求：线条必须符合第一张图中实际掌纹的走向，切勿随意绘制。数字和文字不得遮挡手掌主体。虚线引导线必须清晰，如同专业图表。左侧、右侧及手掌内部应有合理的标注。整体布局应参考第二张图，左侧为手掌分析图，右侧为文字说明。右侧分析文字要求：请在右侧生成 12 条中文分析，每一条对应一个数字。文字风格应结合传统手相、易经及中医体质，语言专业，带有一定的警示感和玄学感，但不过分夸大。每项内容控制在 2-4 行，文字清晰易读。请使用以下分析内容：1. 生命线：弧度较大且整体连贯，说明基础体能尚可，压力下的恢复力较强；若中后段出现断续，提示周期性疲劳及生活节奏失衡，需注意元气损耗。2. 智慧线：线条修长且略微下垂，显示思维细腻、感知力强，做事有观察力和想象力；但也容易思虑过多，在情绪压力下产生反复的内心冲突。3. 感情线：长度适中；若末端有轻微的分叉，代表对待感情认真且慢热，既看重投入也看重精神契合；内心敏感，易因期望过高而产生失落感。4. 命运线：掌中竖线较淡，说明早年路径并非一步到位，更多依赖自我探索与积累；后期趋于稳定，属于先试错后定型的格局。5. 太阳线：太阳线较细，名望与成就感属于晚发型，非一蹴而就，而是通过作品、口碑与专业能力逐渐显现。6. 健康线 / 水星线：此线较为隐蔽；按传统中医理念，多提示脾胃、睡眠与情绪管理需优先关注；一旦劳累或熬夜，易出现疲乏及气血亏虚感。7. 婚姻线：若侧边有不止一条细线，代表在情感经历中有选择与考量，不轻易定性；真正的稳定往往来自成熟后的价值观契合。8. 金星丘：拇指根部较为饱满，说明是一个重情重义之人，生命力与亲和力强；也显示出对安全感与现实温暖较为看重。9. 木星丘：食指下方有一定隆起，代表野心、自我要求以及不低的责任感；适合在团队中担任组织、推动与协调的角色。10. 月丘：掌缘下方质感柔软，说明直觉、共情力与审美感不弱；想象力丰富，适合从事内容、审美及沟通相关事务。11. 拇指张角 / 意志力：拇指张开角度自然，代表独立意识与执行意志明确；非随波逐流者，一旦想清楚方向，往往能持续前行。12. 指形与掌型：整体掌型修长，手指纤细，属于感性与理性并存的类型，既看重体验也讲究逻辑；做事不喜欢过于粗糙，财运更适合稳步推进。底部综合结论：请在底部设计一个古典边框信息框，标题为：“综合结论”。内容：• 整体格局中上，早年多探索与变动，中后期逐渐明朗，向稳步积累迈进。• 性格理性务实且具共情力，适合通过专业度、审美、沟通或长期主义建立价值。• 感情看重真诚与精神契合，慢热但专注，成熟后更易获得稳定关系。• 近期最重要的重点是调整作息、情绪与脾胃；稳住状态，运势会更顺遂。布局要求：左侧：放大手掌主体，占据屏幕 55%-60%。右侧：放置 12 条编号分析，占据屏幕 35%-40%。底部：放置综合结论框。文字必须清晰，无乱码，无错别字，无畸变。所有数字、线条、标题和正文必须具备统一的中国美学风格。整体图像应看起来像专业的玄学分析图，而非标准的手机截图。不要包含英文。不要包含水印。不要改变原手掌的基本形状。最后，输出一张高清 3:4 的中文手相分析海报。

templates.title: Q-version angels in the Jungle Book

titleLocalized.zh: 奇幻森林中的 Q 版天使

templates.prompt: {argument name="art style" default="High-quality Japanese anime style"} A fantasy world.{argument name="character" default="Miniature 'Q version angel' with white wings (Figure 1)"} In progress{argument name="setting" default="Mysterious Forest"} Elegantly soaring through the air. The chibi-style angel is adorable and stylized, its soft, glowing wings radiating a gentle light. The forest is filled with mystery, dotted with towering trees, twisted trunks, floating light particles, and bioluminescent plants and mushrooms. A light mist drifts through the space, creating a deep and mysterious atmosphere. Sunlight filtered through the trees intertwines with magical light, creating a dreamlike world. The camera uses dynamic composition, following the chibi angel and depicting its gliding posture in the air. Motion blur is used to convey a sense of speed, airflow, and the trajectory of flapping wings. The light is soft and dreamlike, with a dominant color palette of green, blue, and gold. Light particles and volumetric light fill the entire space. Ultra-high definition, cinematic quality, deep composition, overhead perspective—a masterpiece of art. No text, no logo, avoids overly realistic details (maintaining anime expressiveness).

promptLocalized.zh: {argument name="art style" default="高质量日本动漫风格"}，奇幻世界。一个 {argument name="character" default="带有白色翅膀的微型‘Q 版天使’（图 1）"} 正在 {argument name="setting" default="神秘森林"} 中优雅地飞行。Q 版天使可爱且风格化，柔软发光的翅膀散发着柔和的光芒。森林充满神秘感，点缀着参天大树、扭曲的树干、漂浮的光粒子以及生物发光的植物和蘑菇。轻雾在空间中飘荡，营造出深邃而神秘的氛围。透过树木过滤的阳光与魔法光芒交织，营造出一个梦幻般的世界。相机采用动态构图，追随 Q 版天使，描绘其在空中滑翔的姿态。表现出运动模糊以体现速度感、气流以及扇动翅膀的轨迹。光线柔和且梦幻，色调以绿色、蓝色和金色为主。光粒子和体积光充盈着整个空间。超高清，电影级，深邃构图，俯瞰视角，卓越的艺术作品。无文字，无 Logo，不要过于写实（保持动漫表现力）。

templates.title: French New Wave style torn paper collage poster

titleLocalized.zh: 法国新浪潮风格撕纸拼贴海报

templates.prompt: A collage of 1960s French New Wave film posters, set against a backdrop of worn beige paper. The design mimics the style of torn paper art film posters, featuring simulated graininess, aged printing texture, rough torn edges, ink wear, halftone imperfections, and slight misregistration. The central composition is a black-and-white half-length portrait of a woman with messy dark hair, her hand raised to cover her face and holding a cigarette. The composition focuses on her upper body, with her face obscured by a rectangular, blurred block. The design employs a layered collage layout, containing eight main paper elements: 1) A black text block in the upper left corner, with "LES FILMS DU CARREFOUR présentent" above and the stacked large characters "ANNA KARINA" and the smaller text "dans un film de JEAN-LUC GODARD" below; 2) A red torn quote panel on the left, reading "Il faut essayer d'être jeune comme on peut. - GODARD"; 3) A blue torn panel in the upper right corner with the black label "PRIX JEAN VIGO 1962"; 4) A narrow torn newspaper clipping in the upper right corner, reading "l'amour est plus fort que la mort"; 5) A yellow torn panel in the middle right, showing a black silhouette of a man wearing a hat facing a woman, next to a vertical black film border with white sprocket holes; 6) A black and white photograph of a Parisian street scene in the lower left corner, including wet ground, streetlights, pedestrians, and the clearly visible "HOTEL". 7) A small commentary text block in the lower left corner reads '"LE FILM QUI A CHANGÉ LE CINÉMA" - CAHIERS DU CINÉMA'; 8) A cropped black and white portrait of a man in a suit in the lower right corner, his face obscured by a rectangular blur block and partially covered by red torn paper shapes. At the bottom center, a large torn paper-style title is placed, using bold, compressed capital letters: black "À BOUT DE" and red "SOUFFLE," slightly slanted and spanning most of the width. Below the title, a blue torn paper strip is added with the white capital text "UNE HISTOIRE D'AMOUR ET DE LIBERTÉ". At the bottom center, black capital letters "COMING SOON" are added, below which is "LES FILMS DU CARREFOUR". The color palette is limited to faded cream, black, deep ultramarine, soft poster red, and mustard yellow. The overall atmosphere is rebellious, romantic, and cinematic, like a signature French New Wave poster composed of torn magazines, street photography, and striking typography.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张 20 世纪 60 年代法国新浪潮电影海报拼贴画，背景为陈旧的米色纸张，设计风格模仿撕纸艺术电影海报，具有模拟颗粒感、做旧印刷纹理、粗糙的撕裂边缘、油墨磨损、半色调瑕疵以及轻微的套印不准。构图中心为一名留着凌乱深色头发的女子的黑白半身肖像，她抬手遮脸并拿着一支香烟，胸部以上构图，面部被一个矩形模糊块遮挡。采用分层拼贴布局，包含 8 个主要纸张元素：1) 左上角黑色文本块，上方写有“LES FILMS DU CARREFOUR présentent”，下方为堆叠的大字“ANNA KARINA”及较小的文本“dans un film de JEAN-LUC GODARD”；2) 左侧红色撕裂引用面板，写有“Il faut essayer d’être jeune comme on peut. - GODARD”；3) 右上角蓝色撕裂面板，带有黑色标签“PRIX JEAN VIGO 1962”；4) 右上角狭长的撕裂报纸剪报，写有“l’amour est plus fort que la mort”；5) 中右侧黄色撕裂面板，展示一名戴帽男子面对一名女子的黑色剪影，旁边是带有白色链轮孔的垂直黑色胶片边框；6) 左下角黑白巴黎街景照片，包含潮湿的地面、路灯、行人和清晰可见的“HOTEL DU NORD”标志；7) 左下角小型评论文本块，写有 '"LE FILM QUI A CHANGÉ LE CINÉMA" - CAHIERS DU CINÉMA'；8) 右下角裁剪过的黑白男子西装肖像，面部被矩形模糊块遮挡，部分被红色撕裂纸张形状覆盖。在下部中间，放置巨大的撕纸风格标题，使用粗体压缩大写字母：黑色“À BOUT DE”和红色“SOUFFLE”，略微倾斜并横跨大部分宽度。在标题下方，添加一条蓝色撕裂纸条，上面印有白色大写文本“UNE HISTOIRE D’AMOUR ET DE LIBERTÉ”。在底部中心，添加黑色大写字母“COMING SOON”，下方为“LES FILMS DU CARREFOUR”。调色板限制在褪色的奶油色、黑色、深群青色、柔和的海报红和芥末黄。整体氛围叛逆、浪漫且具有电影感，如同由撕碎的杂志、街头摄影和醒目排版构成的标志性法国新浪潮海报。

templates.title: French New Wave protest film poster

titleLocalized.zh: 法国新浪潮抗议电影海报

templates.prompt: Create a retro French New Wave political film poster using a torn paper collage style and a vertical single-page composition, evoking the worn-out feel of a street poster from 1968. Use cream-colored paper, faded black, deep red, mustard yellow, and soft cobalt blue as the limited color palette, adding heavy simulated film grain, halftone printing textures, ink bleeds, creases, scratches, rough paper fibers, torn edges, glue stains, and slightly misaligned relief printing fonts. Place a black and white portrait in the center, depicting a melancholic young man in a dark coat, in a three-quarter profile, cropped from the chest up, with curly dark hair. His face is obscured by a rectangular piece of paper, like a censorship mark, giving the image a mysterious, art-film feel. Surrounding the portrait are torn collage fragments: at the top left is a red cardboard with a black silhouette of a running protester; below it is a narrow strip of grayish-white text that reads “PARIS, MAI 68” and the smaller French text “LES MURS ONT DES OREILLES, L'AVENIR AUSSI.”; the far left edge is a vertical black film border with the white “36 KODAK TRI-X PAN FILM” printed on it; at the bottom left is a mustard-yellow torn cardboard with a cropped dark silhouette portrait; at the top right is a blue torn cardboard with the quote “UN FILM COUP DE POING ET DE POÉSIE.”, below which is “— CAHIERS DU CINÉMA”; directly below it is a tall black-and-white photograph fragment depicting a solitary figure walking through a damp Parisian street under a streetlamp at night; near the center right is a small torn piece of newsprint with the French slogan “LA BEAUTÉ EST DANS LA”. The background is a scene of crowds; in the lower right corner is a red torn cardboard sign with black silhouettes of Parisian landmarks. At the top center, the slogan "NOT EVERY REVOLUTION IS TELEVISED" is added in narrow, black capital letters. Near the bottom center, "A FILM BY" is added in small, compressed black font.{argument name="director name" default="JEAN-PIERRE LEMAIRE"} The main title, in huge, compressed red capital letters, occupies the lower half, covering the torn cream-colored paper:{argument name="French title" default="L’HOMME QUI RÊVAIT"} The English subtitle "" is added below in smaller blue compressed uppercase letters.{argument name="English subtitle" default="THE MAN WHO DREAMED"} A long black strip is placed at the bottom center, with the large, compressed white capital letters "COMING SOON" printed on it, below which is the smaller text "ÉTÉ 1968". A Cannes-style laurel leaf logo is included in the lower left corner, reading "SÉLECTION OFFICIELLE FESTIVAL DE CANNES 1968". A small French credits is added in the lower right corner, including "UNE PRODUCTION LES FILMS DU SOLEIL DISTRIBUTION". Maintaining the overall asymmetry, rawness, rebelliousness, and elegance of the design evokes memories of Godard, Truffaut, the May 1968 protest graphics, and handcrafted collages of French art film posters.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张复古的法国新浪潮政治电影海报，采用撕纸拼贴风格，垂直单页构图，呈现出如同 1968 年贴在墙上饱经风霜的街头海报般的陈旧感。使用奶油色纸张、褪色的黑色、深红色、芥末黄和柔和的钴蓝色作为有限配色，并添加浓重的模拟胶片颗粒感、半色调印刷纹理、墨水渗漏、折痕、划痕、粗糙的纸张纤维、撕裂的边缘、胶水渍以及略有错位的凸版印刷字体。在中心位置放置一张黑白肖像，画面为一名穿着深色外套、神情忧郁的年轻男子，四分之三侧面，胸部以上剪裁，留着卷曲的深色头发，脸部被一块矩形纸片遮挡，如同审查标记，赋予画面神秘的艺术电影感。在肖像周围环绕撕裂的拼贴碎片：左上方是一个红色纸板，上面有奔跑抗议者的黑色剪影；下方是一条窄窄的灰白色文字条，写着“PARIS, MAI 68”以及较小的法文文案“LES MURS ONT DES OREILLES, L’AVENIR AUSSI.”；最左侧边缘是一条垂直的黑色胶片边框，印有白色的“36 KODAK TRI-X PAN FILM”；左下方是一个芥末黄色的撕裂纸板，上面有裁剪过的深色剪影肖像；右上方是一个蓝色撕裂纸板，包含引语“UN FILM COUP DE POING ET DE POÉSIE.”，下方注明“— CAHIERS DU CINÉMA”；其正下方是一张高大的黑白照片碎片，描绘了一个孤独的身影在夜晚的路灯下走过潮湿的巴黎街道；中右侧附近是一个小的撕裂新闻纸块，上面印有法文口号“LA BEAUTÉ EST DANS LA RUE”，背景是人群场景；右下方是一个红色撕裂纸板，上面有巴黎地标建筑的黑色剪影。在顶部正中，用窄体黑色大写字母添加标语“NOT EVERY REVOLUTION IS TELEVISED.”。在下方中部附近，用小号黑色压缩字体添加“A FILM BY {argument name="director name" default="JEAN-PIERRE LEMAIRE"}”。让主标题以巨大的红色压缩大写字母占据下半部分，覆盖在撕裂的奶油色纸张上：“{argument name="French title" default="L’HOMME QUI RÊVAIT"}”。正下方用较小的蓝色压缩大写字母添加英文副标题“{argument name="English subtitle" default="THE MAN WHO DREAMED"}”。在底部中心放置一条黑色长条，上面印有白色大号压缩大写字母“COMING SOON”，下方是较小的文字“ÉTÉ 1968”。在左下角包含一个戛纳风格的月桂叶标志，写着“SÉLECTION OFFICIELLE FESTIVAL DE CANNES 1968”。在右下角添加细小的法文制作人员名单，包括“UNE PRODUCTION LES FILMS DU SOLEIL DISTRIBUTION”。保持整体设计的不对称性、原始感、叛逆感与优雅感，唤起人们对戈达尔、特吕弗、1968 年 5 月抗议图形以及手工制作的法国艺术电影海报拼贴的记忆。

templates.title: A portrait of someone looking back on a neon-lit night.

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹之夜回眸肖像

templates.prompt: A cinematic close-up portrait: a young woman stands on a city street at night, framed vertically, the shot focusing on her midsection upwards. Her body is turned away from the camera, but she glances back at it, her expression both soft and powerful. She has long {argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown"} Wavy, voluminous hair with messy bangs, giving it a slightly wind-blown look. Natural, dewy makeup, minimalist style, and an oversized top.{argument name="jacket material and color" default="black leather jacket"} A melancholic urban backdrop, with blurred neon signs, streetlights, car headlights, and taillights creating a stunning bokeh effect, evokes the atmosphere of a bustling city center. The composition is off-center, with the subject positioned on the left-center side of the frame, the street extending to the right. Dramatic color separation in the lighting—one side of the hair and jacket has a cool cyan-blue hue, while the other side has a warm magenta hue—creates a cinematic, cyan-red color tone. High contrast, shallow depth of field, delicate film grain, and a slight halo effect in the highlights give it a realistic photographic style, as if shot with a Sony A7S III and an 85mm lens.

promptLocalized.zh: 电影感特写肖像，一位年轻女性站在夜晚的城市街道上，采用垂直构图，取景范围从躯干中部向上。身体背对镜头，回眸看向相机，表情柔和而强烈。留着长长的 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 波浪卷发，质感蓬松，带有凌乱的刘海，略显风吹感。自然水润妆容，极简风格，身穿一件超大号的 {argument name="jacket material and color" default="黑色皮夹克"}。忧郁的城市背景，模糊的霓虹灯招牌、路灯、车头灯和尾灯呈现出绚丽的散景效果，营造出繁华市中心的氛围。非中心构图，主体位于画面左侧中心，街道向右侧延伸。戏剧性的分色光影，一侧头发和夹克上带有冷青蓝色光，另一侧带有暖红洋红色光，呈现出青红色的电影级调色。高对比度，浅景深，细腻的胶片颗粒感，高光处带有轻微光晕，写实摄影风格，如同使用 Sony A7S III 搭配 85mm 镜头拍摄。

templates.title: Street-style collage poster featuring BRICS elements

titleLocalized.zh: 带有金砖元素的街头风拼贴海报

templates.prompt: Create a striking street fashion poster with a rough, edited collage aesthetic. The image shows a young man, half-length, seated slightly to the right behind a dark table. He has a thick, slicked-back hairstyle, wears a black leather motorcycle jacket over a plain white T-shirt, and his face is obscured by a rectangular mosaic. His right hand is raised near his face, his thumb and forefinger holding a tiny gold block, while his left hand rests on the table. A half-assembled gold block trophy with a green base is placed in the lower right corner of the table, and 18 small gold blocks are scattered on the table in front of him. The background uses a layered black and electric blue torn paper collage effect with rough, torn edges, distressed print textures, halftone dot patterns, white graffiti marks, fine grid overlays, and neon green, white, and black sticker-like graphic elements. The left half of the poster is dominated by an oversized title in a stacked layout, with huge distressed white block fonts that read "NO RULES." The "O" area is crossed out by a neon green "X". Below that is a huge neon green hand-drawn brush font "JUST", and below that is a white brush font "STYLE" with a neon green underline. Add 8 auxiliary stickers/text graphics to the composition: 1) A black washi tape sticker in the upper right corner with the white stacked text "BREAK THE NORM" and a small neon green smiley face next to it; 2) A narrow white vertical label in the middle of the right side with the text "STYLE IS FREEDOM"; 3) A black stacked sticker in the middle of the left side with the text "OWN YOUR LOOK. OWN YOUR WORLD."; 4) A blue torn paper label in the lower left corner with the text "STREET CODE" and a small globe icon; 5) A long black strip in the center of the bottom with the text "BUILT DIFFERENT." and below it, neon green handwritten "MADE TO STAND OUT."; 6) A neon green label in the lower right corner with the text "GLOBAL VIBES" and below it, smaller text "LOCAL ATTITUDE" and a globe icon; 7) A small black stamp in the lower right corner with the text "EST. 20XX" and a tiny subtitle; 8) A hand-drawn crown graffiti in the lower left corner. In addition, add several neon green "X" marks and white arrow/wavy line graffiti as decorative graphics. Use a high-contrast color scheme of electric blue, black, white, and neon green, and add gold building blocks as a warm metallic accent. The overall atmosphere should convey a youthful, confident, rebellious, and energetic feel, like an advertisement from a modern streetwear brand on Instagram.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张具有粗粝编辑风格拼贴美感的醒目街头时尚宣传海报。画面展示一位年轻男性，半身像，坐在深色桌子后方，位置略微偏右，留着厚实的背头，身穿黑色皮质机车夹克，内搭纯白色 T 恤。他的面部被一个矩形马赛克遮挡。他的右手举在脸部附近，拇指和食指捏着一块微小的金色积木，左手放在桌面上。在桌子右下角放置 1 个带有绿色底座的半组装金色积木奖杯，并在他面前的桌面上散落 18 块小型金色积木。背景采用分层的黑色与电光蓝撕纸拼贴效果，边缘粗糙撕裂，带有做旧印刷纹理、半调网点图案、白色涂鸦痕迹、细网格叠加层，以及霓虹绿、白、黑色的贴纸状图形元素。海报左半部分由超大标题占据，采用堆叠排版，巨大的做旧白色块状字体写着“NO RULES.”，其中“O”区域被一个霓虹绿色的“X”划过；下方是巨大的霓虹绿色手绘笔刷字体“JUST”，再下方是白色笔刷字体“STYLE”，并带有霓虹绿色下划线。在构图中添加 8 个辅助贴纸/文字图形：1) 右上角黑色胶带贴纸，写着白色堆叠文字“BREAK THE NORM”，旁边有一个小小的霓虹绿色笑脸；2) 右侧中部狭长的白色垂直标签，写着“STYLE IS FREEDOM”；3) 左侧中部黑色堆叠贴纸，写着“OWN YOUR LOOK. OWN YOUR WORLD.”；4) 左下角蓝色撕纸标签，写着“STREET CODE”，带有条形码和小地球图标；5) 底部中心黑色长条，写着“BUILT DIFFERENT.”，下方有霓虹绿色手写体“MADE TO STAND OUT.”；6) 右下角霓虹绿色标签，写着“GLOBAL VIBES”，下方有较小的文字“LOCAL ATTITUDE”和一个地球图标；7) 右下角小型黑色印章，写着“EST. 20XX”及微小的副标题；8) 左下角手绘皇冠涂鸦。此外，添加若干霓虹绿色“X”标记以及白色箭头/波浪线涂鸦作为装饰图形。使用电光蓝、黑、白和霓虹绿的高对比度配色方案，并将金色积木作为温暖的金属质感点缀。整体氛围应展现出年轻、自信、叛逆、充满活力的感觉，如同现代时尚街头品牌在 Instagram 上的广告。

templates.title: A fictional "skirt showdown" comic spread

templates.prompt: A realistic close-up photograph shows a pair of hands flipping through the center spread of a Japanese manga magazine. The slightly overhead view reveals the complete two-page black-and-white comic, including the spine's curve, the paper texture, and subtle page creases. The spread depicts an exaggerated, fictional fighting manga about girls battling using only skirt-based techniques. It employs a highly dynamic shonen manga style, featuring dense halftone dots, speed lines, ink splatter, exaggerated movements, and explosive typography. The central action spans two pages: two girls in school uniforms are fighting. The girl on the left stands powerfully, her long hair flowing, wearing a blazer and pleated skirt, her hands raised high above her head as if unleashing a finishing move; the girl on the right is spinning upside down, her pleated skirt billowing out like a tornado, her legs outstretched as if being thrown or spinning in the air. The composition should be chaotic and dynamic, with huge Japanese onomatopoeic words and attack text occupying the central position, especially the huge vertical title-style impact phrase "Inverted Revolving Strike" and another huge vertical move name "Lake of the White Bird," integrated into the action scenes. There are a total of 8 smaller side panels around the main screen: 4 stacked on the left page and 4 stacked on the right page. On the left page, panel 1 shows the girl undergoing rigorous training under a waterfall; panel 2 shows an inverted training scene in the water; panel 3 shows strength training or push-up-like exercises; panel 4 shows an emotional close-up of two girls facing each other. Next to these left-hand panels are bold Japanese motivational titles, including "The Heavenly Maiden's Journey!!", "The Inverted Training!!", "Wrist Muscle Training!!", and "My Thoughts of My Friends...!", with a huge emotional declaration at the bottom: "I can't resist trying!!! I'll win against all odds!!!". On the right-hand page, panel 1 is a close-up of an elegant opponent speaking calmly, accompanied by vertical Japanese dialogue; panel 2 is a roaring audience, crowded with spectators and shouting text; panel 3 is a small explanatory rule diagram labeled "Skirt Bout Rule", showing two simplified girl figures and a skirt icon, with brief Japanese rule text explaining that touching anything other than the skirt is prohibited; panel 4 is a close-up of a shocked face, accompanied by the reaction text "Naka!?" in a black exploding bubble. Overlay rectangular mosaics over two small face areas to mimic scans of online magazines. The comic should look like a real-life photograph of a weekly comic book compilation page, rather than a clean digital layout: visible halftone dots, binding shadows, page edges, slightly yellowed paper, soft ambient warm lighting, and realistic fingers gripping the lower corners on both sides.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实的特写照片，展示了一双人手正翻开一本日本漫画杂志的中心跨页。视角略微从上方俯瞰，可以看到完整的双页黑白漫画，包括书脊的弧度、纸张纹理以及轻微的页面褶皱。跨页描绘了一部夸张的虚构战斗运动漫画，讲述了女孩们仅使用基于裙装的技巧进行战斗的故事，采用了极具张力的少年漫画风格，包含密集的网点纸、速度线、墨点飞溅、夸张的动作以及爆炸性的字体设计。中心动作横跨两页：两名身穿校服的女孩正在交战，左侧的女孩站立，姿态强劲，长发飘逸，身着西装外套和百褶裙，双手高举过头顶，仿佛正在施展必杀技；右侧的女孩则呈倒立旋转状，百褶裙像龙卷风一样向外散开，双腿向上伸展，仿佛正被抛出或在空中旋转。构图应充满混乱与动感，巨大的日文拟声词和攻击文字占据中心位置，特别是巨大的垂直标题式冲击短语“倒立回転衝撃”和另一个巨大的垂直招式名称“白鸟の湖”，并融入动作画面中。主画面周围总共有 8 个较小的侧边分镜：左页堆叠 4 个，右页堆叠 4 个。左页中，分镜 1 展示了女孩在瀑布下进行严酷训练；分镜 2 展示了水中的倒立特训场景；分镜 3 展示了力量训练或类似俯卧撑的练习；分镜 4 展示了两个女孩面对面时的情感特写。在这些左侧分镜旁添加粗体的日文励志标题，包括“天女の滝行!!”、“倒立の特训!!”、“腕の筋トレ!!”、“亲友の想いを胸に…!!”，底部还有一句巨大的情感宣言“努力は里切らない!!! 绝対に胜つんだから!!!”。右页中，分镜 1 是优雅对手冷静说话的特写，配有垂直的日文对话；分镜 2 是咆哮的观众席，挤满了观众和呐喊文字；分镜 3 是一个微小的解释性规则图，标注为“スカートバウト・ルール”，展示了 2 个简化的女孩形象和一个裙子图标，并配有简短的日文规则文本，解释禁止触碰裙子以外的任何部位；分镜 4 是一个震惊的脸部特写，配有黑色爆炸气泡中的反应文字“なっ!?”。在 2 个小脸部区域覆盖一些矩形马赛克，以模仿网上发布的杂志扫描件。漫画应看起来像是在现实生活中拍摄的周刊漫画合集页面，而非干净的数字排版：可见网点、装订线阴影、书页边缘、轻微泛黄的纸张、柔和的环境暖光，以及抓握在两侧下角的真实手指。

Add subtle rainbow prism lens flare around the image (especially at the edges and bottom center) to create an iridescent, futuristic feel. The composition should be simple, bold, bright, and appealing, conveying the quality of a high-end consumer electronics social media ad.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高级方形广告海报，用于 {argument name="product name" default="AirPods Pro 3"}，采用现代科技广告风格。画面中央是一位年轻女性，置身于柔和的摄影棚环境中，背景为平滑的冷灰色。她戴着荧光青柠色针织帽，身穿带有青柠色滚边的黑白波浪条纹上衣。她留着及肩波浪形淡粉色头发，耳朵里戴着一只白色无线耳机。她的面部大部分被一个位于中央的暖米棕色大矩形模糊块遮挡。在极近的前景中，她的手伸向镜头，拿着一个打开的亮面白色充电盒，通过强烈的透视畸变呈现于镜头前；盒内可见两只白色高端无线耳机，充电盒正面有一个微小的绿色状态指示灯在发光。在右侧背景中添加两只额外的悬浮耳机，并进行柔和的模糊处理，以增加产品多样性和深度感。采用浅景深、清晰的产品高光、平滑的商业照明、细腻的反射效果，将精致的高端产品摄影与时尚编辑人像摄影相结合。在顶部叠加醒目的白色无衬线大号标题文字 {argument name="headline text" default="AIRPODS"}。在右上角放置较小的白色副标题文字 {argument name="subheading text" default="Apple Pods Pro 3"}。在左侧添加一段 3 行的白色促销文案 {argument name="left promo text" default="卓越音质与降噪体验"}。在右下角添加两个堆叠的大号白色数字功能标注：“30”及下方较小的文字“小时续航。”，以及“1”及下方较小的文字“年保修。”。在图像周围（尤其是边缘和下方中心）加入细微的彩虹棱镜镜头光晕，营造出一种虹彩般的未来感。构图应简洁、大胆、光亮、令人向往，呈现出高端消费电子产品社交媒体广告的质感。

templates.title: Parody of dark fantasy light novel covers

titleLocalized.zh: 恶搞异世界暗黑风轻小说封面

templates.prompt: This is a dramatically satirical anime/light novel cover, designed in a dark gothic romantic fantasy style, resembling an exaggeratedly exaggerated isekai (another world) web novel cover. At the center of the image is a handsome young anti-hero, in a half-length portrait, posed in a heroic three-quarter profile, arms crossed, his face mostly hidden in shadow, with messy hair {argument name="hair color" default="black"} With an emotional hairstyle and pale skin, he exudes a cold and melancholic aura. He wears gleaming black armor with massive shoulder armor, a black cloak and scarf wrapped high around his neck, dark gauntlets, and a diamond-patterned tunic beneath the armor, a small silver badge pinned to his chest. A massive black battle axe is slung diagonally over his shoulder, the hilt of a sword faintly visible in the lower left corner. The background is set inside an abandoned cathedral or castle archway, with towering stone pillars and huge round Gothic windows illuminated by cold, silvery moonlight. In the distance, sharp, fantastical castle spires are shrouded in mist. The design employs black, steel blue, silver, and antique gold tones, featuring high-contrast rim lighting, subtle magical glints, and painterly anime illustration details. The entire cover is surrounded by a magnificent gold filigree border, with elegant embellishments in every corner. Luxurious gold serif and handwritten typography are added, superimposed on the character like a real fantasy paperback cover. The main title should occupy the lower half, using a stacked line layout, and featuring decorative embellishments and mixed font sizes.{argument name="title text" default="That (who just wanted to take a nap) super invincible, excessively dark, emotionally insensitive, black-haired, red-eyed demon king who saved the world, slayed dragons, and accidentally built a harem."} Add the author's name in the upper right corner:{argument name="author name" default="TISAYAI"} Place a number in the top left corner.{argument name="volume number" default="1"} A small decorative badge. It includes three paragraphs of text in small gold font on the side: Top left: "I came into this world to flaunt my red eyes, melancholic hairstyle, and god-like protagonist aura. You're welcome."; Bottom left: "The villain trembles. The hero wails. He yawns."; Bottom right: "I didn't choose to live in another world; it's that life in another world insists on revolving around me." The overall tone is satirical, exaggerated, ornate, and deliberately absurd, like the cover of a high-end, bestselling isekai (another world) romance/action novel. Vertical composition, highly refined, ultra-detailed, cinematic, highly decorative, the layout and artwork are perfectly integrated.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满戏剧性的恶搞动漫轻小说封面，采用暗黑哥特浪漫奇幻风格，设计成夸张过头的异世界网文卷首封面。画面中心是一位英俊的年轻反英雄，半身像，采取英雄式的四分之三侧身姿势，双臂交叉，面部大部分隐藏在阴影中，留着凌乱的 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"} 情绪化发型，皮肤苍白，散发着冷峻忧郁的气息。他身穿光亮的黑色盔甲，带有巨大的肩甲，黑色斗篷和围巾高高裹住颈部，戴着深色护手，盔甲下是菱形图案的束腰外衣，胸前别着一枚小巧的银色徽章。巨大的黑色战斧斜背在肩上，左下角隐约可见剑柄。背景设定在废弃的大教堂或城堡拱门内，身后是高耸的石柱和巨大的圆形哥特式窗户，被冷冽的银色月光逆光照亮。远景中，尖锐的奇幻城堡尖塔隐没在迷雾中。采用黑色、钢蓝色、银色和古金色调，具有高对比度的轮廓光、细微的魔法闪光以及绘画般的动漫插画细节。整个封面四周环绕着华丽的金色花丝边框，每个角落都有优雅的装饰。添加奢华的金色衬线体和手写体排版，像真实的奇幻平装书封面一样叠加在角色上方。主标题应占据下半部分，采用堆叠行排列，配有装饰性花饰和混合字体大小：{argument name="title text" default="那个（只想睡个午觉的）超级无敌、过度暗黑、情感迟钝、黑发红眼、拯救世界、屠龙、意外收集后宫的魔王"}。在右上角，添加作者文字：{argument name="author name" default="TISAYAI"}。在左上角，放置一枚带有数字 {argument name="volume number" default="1"} 的小型装饰徽章。包含 3 段小号金色字体的侧边文案：左上角文案，“我来到这个世界就是为了炫耀我的红眼、忧郁发型和神级主角光环。不客气。”；左下角椭圆形文案，“反派颤抖。英雄哀鸣。他打了个哈欠。”；右下角文案，“我没有选择异世界生活，是异世界生活非要围着我转。” 整体基调讽刺、夸张、华丽且刻意荒谬，如同高端虚构的畅销异世界浪漫动作小说封面。竖构图，高度精炼，超细节，电影感，装饰性强，排版与艺术作品完美融合。

templates.title: Lin Daiyu ink painting poster

titleLocalized.zh: 林黛玉水墨海报

templates.prompt: Create an elegant, modern Chinese-style vertical poster, blending ink wash painting with exquisite digital illustrations on a warm, off-white rice paper background. The main subject is a young, ancient Chinese woman, seated sideways to the left, her expression serene and scholarly, dressed in a light gray-white Hanfu adorned with delicate floral embroidery and long sleeves. She holds an open, thread-bound book in her hands, placed before her knees. Her hairstyle is a classic low bun, with long hair cascading down her back, embellished with delicate gold ornaments and pearl floral hairpins. The face should remain clear in the final image, conveying a tranquil and elegant expression. The scene is constructed atop a dramatic, dark gray ink-wash rock, which surrounds her from behind and below like a chair, its edges featuring a soft, smoky watercolor effect. A slender, winding metallic gold line extends from the upper right corner to the lower left center. A blooming plum blossom branch extends diagonally from the right, adorned with small white flowers and dark branches. A pool of ripples is added near the lower left corner, with a single splashing droplet visible. A few delicate petals are scattered around the figure's hands and in the lower left midground. The color scheme remains restrained: ivory white, ink black, ashes gray, and soft gray-brown, accented with subtle gold details. The layout should have a sense of openness and asymmetry, with ample negative space on the left and top. Chinese characters are incorporated into the poster design: three large vertical characters in the upper left corner, containing the following text:{argument name="character name" default="Lin Daiyu"} Below is the Romanized "LIN DAIYU" in small-spaced serif font; next to the pinyin is a column of slender vertical Chinese poems; another column of short vertical Chinese text is added in the lower right middle section; and a short horizontal Chinese sentence is added at the bottom center. It includes four red seals as traditional decorations: one near the left-hand poem, one near the lower left corner where the water ripples are, and one next to the right-hand text; another small seal-like decoration is integrated into the layout area. Additionally, there are two minimalist gold line decorations in the lower right quadrant. The overall atmosphere is poetic, fragile, pure, melancholic, and full of literary flair, possessing the elegance of a museum poster and the high-end editorial quality.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张优雅中式新美学风格的竖版海报，在温暖的米白色宣纸背景上融合水墨画与精致的数字插画。构图主体为一位年轻的中国古代女性，侧身向左端坐，神态安静且富有书卷气，身着浅灰白色汉服，饰有精致的花卉刺绣和长袖。她双手捧着一本翻开的线装书置于膝前。发型为经典的低发髻，长发垂于身后，点缀着精致的金饰和珍珠花卉发簪。最终图像中面部区域应保持清晰，表情宁静优雅。场景构建于一块戏剧性的黑灰色水墨岩石之上，岩石如座椅般环绕在她的身后与下方，边缘呈现柔和的烟雾状水彩效果，一条纤细蜿蜒的金属金线从右上角延伸至左下中心。右侧斜向伸出一枝盛开的梅花，点缀着小白花和深色枝干。左下角附近加入一处水池涟漪，并可见一滴溅起的水珠。在人物双手周围及左下中景处散落几片淡雅的落花。色调保持克制：象牙白、水墨黑、灰烬灰、柔和灰褐色，并辅以细微的金色点缀。布局应具有通透感和不对称性，左侧和顶部留出大面积的负空间。将中文字体融入海报设计：左上方为 3 个巨大的竖排文字，内容为 {argument name="character name" default="林黛玉"}；下方为小号间距的衬线体罗马拼音 "LIN DAIYU"；拼音旁放置一列纤细的竖排中文诗句；右下中段增加另一列简短的竖排中文文本；底部中心添加一句简短的横排中文。包含 4 枚作为传统装饰的红色印章：1 枚靠近左侧诗句，1 枚靠近左下角水涟漪处，1 枚位于右侧文本旁，另有 1 枚小型印章式装饰融入排版区域。此外，在右下象限包含 2 个极简主义金线装饰。整体氛围诗意、脆弱、纯净、忧郁且充满文人气息，具有博物馆海报的优雅感与高端编辑质感。

templates.title: Guangzhou ink painting style city poster

titleLocalized.zh: 广州水墨风城市海报

templates.prompt: A refined vertical poster in a modern Chinese ink painting style, its design resembling the cover of a cultural city brand, with the theme of {argument name="headline text" default="Guangzhou"} Using soft, warm ivory paper as the background, leaving large areas of blank space, complemented by delicate gray watercolor mist and semi-abstract brushstrokes with matte metallic gold edges. The composition blends traditional Jiangnan ink painting with a modern skyline: in the center right, the Guangzhou skyline emerges from the mist on the calm water, with the Canton Tower, the most prominent and tallest building, depicted with slender lines and rich details, surrounded by several light gray-beige modern skyscrapers. In the lower left corner, a traditional small wooden boat is placed on the water, with a boatman wearing a straw hat, presented as a dark ink silhouette with subtle reflections. In the lower right foreground, a branch of plum blossoms extends inwards, its vigorous branches adorned with several bright red blossoms. Four birds are added to the blank space in the upper center. The water surface is kept smooth, reflective, and misty, allowing the cityscape to blend softly into the atmosphere. On the left, an elegant vertical text is designed using a minimalist poster layout: a large Chinese main title.{argument name="headline text" default="Guangzhou"} One with{argument name="region tag" default="Southern Guangdong"} The label features a small, red, stamp-like tag with two thin vertical lines of text: "Millennial Commercial Capital" and "Smoke and Fire Coexist with the Tide," a thin dividing line, and the English words "GUANGZHOU" and "CANTON" below. Two small red stamps and a minimalist mountain line icon are added near the text area in the lower left corner. At the bottom center, a short, understated Chinese phrase is placed.{argument name="bottom quote" default="The city is on the water, the dream is in the clouds, and the heart belongs to Lingnan."} Overall atmosphere: tranquil, elegant, poetic, and high-end editorial poster style, with balanced asymmetrical composition, light mist, and restrained color scheme, including ivory white, charcoal gray, warm beige, ink black, vermilion red, and brushed gold accents.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的竖版现代中式水墨风海报，设计风格如同文化城市品牌的封面，主题为 {argument name="headline text" default="广州"}。使用柔和的暖象牙色纸张作为背景，留出大面积空白，辅以细腻的灰色水彩云雾，以及边缘带有哑光金属金色的半抽象笔触弧线。构图融合了传统江南水墨画与现代天际线：在右中位置，描绘广州天际线在平静水面上的薄雾中显现，广州塔作为最显眼的最高建筑，线条纤细且细节丰富，周围环绕着几座浅灰米色的现代摩天大楼。在左下角的水面上，放置 1 艘传统小型木质篷船，船上有 1 位戴着斗笠的船夫，以深色水墨剪影呈现，并带有微妙的倒影。在右下角前景处，加入 1 枝向内斜伸的梅花，枝干苍劲，点缀着几朵鲜艳的红梅。在上方中间的留白处，添加 4 只飞鸟。保持水面平滑、具有反射感且充满雾气，城市景观柔和地融入大气之中。在左侧，采用极简海报布局设计优雅的竖排文字：大号中文主标题 {argument name="headline text" default="广州"}，一个写有 {argument name="region tag" default="南粤"} 的小型红色印章式标签，两列纤细的竖排文字“千年商都”和“烟火与潮涌共生”，一条细分割线，以及下方的英文小字“GUANGZHOU”和“CANTON”。在左下角文字区域附近添加 2 枚红色小印章和 1 个极简山脉线条图标。在底部正中央，放置一句淡淡的中文短句 {argument name="bottom quote" default="城在水上，梦在云间，心归岭南。"}。整体氛围：宁静、优雅、诗意、高端编辑海报风格，平衡的非对称构图，轻薄雾气，色调克制，包含象牙白、炭灰、暖米色、水墨黑、朱砂红及拉丝金点缀。

templates.title: New Chinese-style ice cream drink poster

titleLocalized.zh: 新中式冰淇淋饮品海报

templates.prompt: A high-end vertical poster employing elegant Neo-Chinese aesthetics features a single plastic cup of strawberry sundae ice cream as its core product. The cup is positioned at the bottom center of the image, photographed from a frontal, eye-level perspective with soft lighting. The top displays a glossy white spiral of soft-serve ice cream, while the interior showcases a textured interplay of creamy white and vibrant strawberry red. A simple gold-lined mascot is printed on the cup. Two strawberries are placed in front of the cup: one whole, the other halved, revealing its cut surface. The background is a warm ivory-colored, rice paper-like texture with ample white space. The product is surrounded by a traditional Chinese ink painting composition: hazy gray-black mountains, a winding river or road extending diagonally from the lower left to the upper right, its edges adorned with delicate gold foil. A pale round sun or moon sits at the top center, and a small traditional pagoda stands atop the mountain ridge, accompanied by soft, flowing cloud patterns. Blooming white plum blossoms adorn the right edge and lower left corner. The overall color scheme uses off-white, ink gray, soft beige, gold, and strawberry red, balancing minimalism with a sense of luxury. Vertical Chinese text is added to the upper left corner, with a large main title.{argument name="headline text" default="Mixue Ice Cream"} A thinner vertical subtitle is displayed next to it.{argument name="tagline text" default="Sweet as the first snow, warm as always"} Below is a small red Chinese character stamp, and below the stamp is a line of small capital serif Latin letters bearing the brand name.{argument name="brand text" default="MIXUE BINGCHENG"} Add a small Chinese slogan at the bottom center.{argument name="footer text" default="A cup of sweetness, a city, warming every ordinary day."} Exquisite commercial poster design, realistic product details, blending ink wash illustration style, simple yet luxurious layout, no unnecessary products or figures, and a clean background.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张采用优雅新中式美学的高端竖版海报，以单杯塑料杯装草莓圣代冰淇淋作为核心产品。杯子置于画面中下方，采用正面平视拍摄，光线柔和，顶部为光泽感十足的白色螺旋状软冰淇淋，杯内呈现奶油白与鲜艳草莓红交织的纹理，杯身印有简约的金色线条吉祥物。杯子前方摆放着 2 颗草莓：一颗完整草莓，另一颗对半切开并露出切面。背景为温暖的象牙色宣纸质感，留白充裕。产品周围环绕着水墨山水构图：朦胧的灰黑色山峦，一条如笔触般蜿蜒的河流或道路从左下角斜向右上角延伸，笔触边缘点缀着精致的金箔，上方中部有一轮淡雅的圆日或圆月，山脊上矗立着一座小型传统宝塔，伴有柔和的流云纹样，右侧边缘及左下角点缀着盛开的白梅花枝。整体色调为米白色、水墨灰、柔米色、金色与草莓红，平衡了极简主义与奢华感。左上方添加竖排中文字体，大号主标题为 {argument name="headline text" default="蜜雪冰城"}，旁边配以较细的竖排副标题 {argument name="tagline text" default="甜如初雪，温暖如常"}。下方放置一枚小型红色中文字印章，印章下方为一行小号大写衬线体拉丁字母品牌名 {argument name="brand text" default="MIXUE BINGCHENG"}。底部居中处添加一行小型中文标语 {argument name="footer text" default="一杯甜，一座城，温暖每一个平凡的日常"}。精致商业海报设计，产品细节写实，水墨插画风格融合，布局简洁奢华，无多余产品，无人物，背景整洁。

templates.title: New Chinese Style Ruyi Golden Cudgel Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 新中式如意金箍棒海报

templates.prompt: A refined poster with a modern Chinese aesthetic, featuring a warm ivory-colored Xuan paper background and a minimalist, vertically arranged composition. At the center is a luxurious Ruyi Jingu Bang (a magical staff), placed diagonally from the lower left foreground to the upper right, its base inserted into a dark, ink-splashed rock surface, its tip extending upwards, presenting a sense of stability and heroism. The metal surface is meticulously crafted, engraved with intricate traditional relief patterns and cloud and dragon motifs, with polished gold highlights and subtle shimmering reflections. Around the staff, two flowing, metallic gold ribbons spiral upwards in an S-shape, resembling calligraphic energy trajectories, semi-transparent and painterly. At the bottom, black and gray ink washes, smoke, clouds, and ink-splashed textures diffuse outwards, creating a strong visual impact and perfectly blending realism with Chinese ink painting. Maintaining an open composition with ample white space creates the feel of a high-end gallery poster. Following traditional poster layout, five sets of text are added: a large, vertically oriented black calligraphy title in the upper left corner, containing the following text {argument name="headline text" default="Ruyi Jingu Bang"} Next to the title is a line of smaller, vertical Chinese text: "With a heart at peace, all obstacles can be overcome." Below this is a slender Romanized subtitle in uppercase serif/sans-serif font: "RUYI JINGUBANG." At the bottom right is another line of vertical poetry: "A single thought stirs the winds and clouds / A single blow settles the heavens and earth." At the bottom center is a line of soft, small text: "Free and at ease, nothing is impossible." It includes two red seals: one in the lower left corner and a smaller seal near the lower right corner. Employing elegant black typography, subtle gray ink, soft diffused lighting, and highly detailed product rendering, it showcases a culturally luxurious brand image, creating a tranquil yet powerful atmosphere that perfectly blends the display of ancient mythological artifacts with contemporary high-end Chinese-style poster design.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的新中式美学海报，背景为温暖的象牙色宣纸质感，构图极简且呈纵向布局。画面中心为一根奢华的如意金箍棒，金箍棒呈对角线摆放，从左下角前景延伸至右上角，底端插入深色的泼墨岩石表面，顶端向上延伸，呈现出一种沉稳而英勇的角度。金属表面精雕细琢，刻有复杂的传统浮雕纹饰、云龙纹样，并带有抛光的金色高光和微妙的辉光反射。金箍棒周围，两条飘逸的金属质感金色笔触丝带呈 S 型螺旋向上，如同书法般的能量轨迹，半透明且具有绘画感。底部，黑色与灰色的水墨、烟雾、云雾和泼墨纹理向外扩散，形成强烈的视觉冲击，将写实风格与中国水墨画完美融合。保持构图开阔，留白充足，营造出高端画廊海报的质感。按照传统海报布局添加 5 组文字：左上方为巨大的黑色纵向书法标题，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="如意金箍棒"}；标题旁为一行较小的纵向中文文字“心有如意，万象皆可破”；下方为一行纤细的罗马拼音副标题，采用大写衬线/无衬线字体，内容为“RUYI JINGUBANG”；右下方为另一行纵向诗句“一念起，风云动 / 一棒定，乾坤静”；底部中心为一行淡淡的小字，内容为“自在如意，无所不成”。包含两枚红色印章，一枚位于左侧中下部，另一枚小印章位于右下角文字附近。采用优雅的黑色排版、微妙的灰色墨迹、柔和的漫射光效、超精细的产品渲染，展现文化奢华品牌感，营造出宁静而强大的氛围，完美融合了古代神话文物展示与当代高端中国风海报设计。

titleLocalized.zh: 秋日松鼠童装街拍

templates.prompt: A cinematic full-body portrait features an anthropomorphic squirrel child standing in the center of an autumn city pedestrian street, facing the camera with a serene and charming expression, hands in his coat pockets. The character boasts fluffy squirrel ears, soft tan and cream fur, clearly visible whiskers, and a large tail extending to the left of the frame. He wears a red beret, a blue plaid shirt, brown corduroy overalls, a beige trench coat, and brown lace-up boots. The portrait employs warm, golden-hour tones, accompanied by amber sunlight, shallow depth of field, and soft bokeh. The background is a blurred urban commercial street, with pedestrians, shops, and red awnings faintly visible, and autumn leaves scattered on the ground. Photorealistic fur and fabric details, reminiscent of a picture book, possess a fashion magazine style, with a centered composition, eye-level perspective, and a vertical portrait format.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影质感的全身肖像，主角是一位拟人化的松鼠儿童，正站在秋季城市步行街的中央，面对镜头，神态从容迷人，双手插在外套口袋里。角色拥有毛茸茸的松鼠耳朵、柔软的棕褐色与奶油色皮毛、清晰可见的胡须，以及一条向画面左侧延伸的大尾巴。角色身穿红色贝雷帽、蓝色格子衬衫、棕色灯芯绒背带裤、米色风衣和棕色系带皮靴。采用温暖的黄金时刻色调，伴随琥珀色阳光、浅景深和柔和的焦外成像效果。背景是模糊的城市商业街，隐约可见行人、店面和红色遮阳篷，地面散落着秋叶。照片级皮毛与织物细节，充满绘本魅力，时尚杂志风格，居中构图，平视视角，竖构图肖像。

templates.title: The little monkey dressed in denim and "under investigation"

titleLocalized.zh: 身穿牛仔服的“被审查”小猴子

templates.prompt: A full-body studio portrait featuring a stylized, anthropomorphic monkey standing facing the camera against a clean, seamless light blue background. The figure has a slender, petite body, arms and tail covered in brown fur, oversized, prominent ears, and a long, curved tail visible on the left. The face is deliberately obscured by a softly blurred square of color on the head, creating a sense of anonymous "censorship." The figure is dressed in five clearly visible fashion items: a blue denim beret, a medium-wash blue denim jacket with metal buttons and a chest pocket, a plain white crew-neck T-shirt, matching rolled-up blue jeans, and a pair of chunky white low-top sneakers. A silver pendant necklace is added over the shirt. The pose is relaxed and symmetrical, with arms hanging naturally at the sides, feet apart, and the figure centered from head to toe. The lighting is soft, diffused, and has a clean, commercial studio feel, with subtle shadows under the shoes. The collection is rendered with an ultra-detailed, whimsical fashion editorial style, blending realistic clothing textures with adorable, surreal character designs, crisp denim stitching, soft fur details, and high-end toy-like proportions.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张全身工作室肖像，主角为一位风格化的拟人化小猴子，正对镜头站立，背景为干净的浅蓝色无缝背景。角色拥有纤细的小巧身躯，手臂和尾巴上覆盖着棕色皮毛，有着超大的突出耳朵，左侧可见一条长而弯曲的猴尾。面部被一个位于头部的柔和模糊方形色块刻意遮挡，营造出一种匿名的“被审查”感。为角色穿上 5 件清晰可见的时尚单品：一顶蓝色牛仔贝雷帽、一件带有金属纽扣和胸前口袋的中度水洗蓝色牛仔夹克、一件纯白色圆领 T 恤、一条卷边的配套蓝色牛仔裤，以及一双厚底白色低帮运动鞋。在衬衫外添加 1 条银色吊坠项链。姿势放松且对称，双臂自然垂在身体两侧，双脚分开，人物从头到鞋居中于画面。灯光柔和、漫射且具有商业工作室的干净质感，鞋下带有细微阴影。以超细节的异想天开时尚编辑风格渲染，将逼真的服装质感与可爱的超现实角色设计、清晰的牛仔缝线、柔软的皮毛细节以及高级玩具般的比例融为一体。

templates.title: Enterprise meeting photo upgrade

titleLocalized.zh: 企业会议照片升级

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference images, recreate the same business meeting from a fresh perspective, transforming it into a sophisticated, high-end corporate photo. Move the view closer to the presentation screen and switch to a wide-angle view from the left front, positioning the display on the left and the conference table and attendees on the right near the floor-to-ceiling window. Replace the dimly lit surveillance camera style with bright natural light, clean modern office lighting, and a professional architectural interior feel. Remove all CCTV overlays, timestamps, recording indicators, floor/equipment text, and other surveillance camera artifacts. Upgrade the display content to a beautifully designed Keynote-style strategy slide, titled "2026 Annual Strategic Planning: Cloud Collaboration and New Ecosystem Building." On the left side of the slide, display a quarterly growth trend bar chart, marking the four quarters: Q1 +15%, Q2 +22%, Q3 +18%, Q4 +25%. On the right, display three text sections with bold titles: "Technology-Driven Innovation," "Global Market Expansion," and "User Experience Upgrade," each with brief Chinese text below. Maintaining a realistic feel to the scene, presenting the aesthetics of a high-end corporate brand, with neatly arranged seating, and subtle anonymization or soft-focus treatment of the figures.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图像，以全新的视角重新创作同一场商务会议，将其打造为精致的高端企业宣传照。将视角移近演示屏幕，并切换至左前方广角视角，使显示屏占据左侧，会议桌及参会人员位于右侧靠近落地窗的位置。将昏暗的监控摄像头风格替换为明亮的自然光、整洁的现代办公照明以及专业的建筑室内质感。移除所有 CCTV 叠加层、时间戳、录制指示器、地面/设备文字及其他监控摄像头的伪影。将显示内容升级为精美的 Keynote 风格战略 Slides，标题为“2026 年度战略规划：云端协同与新生态构建”。在 Slides 左侧展示 1 个季度增长趋势柱状图，标注 4 个季度：Q1 +15%、Q2 +22%、Q3 +18%、Q4 +25%。在右侧展示 3 个带有加粗标题的文本板块：“技术驱动创新”、“全球化市场拓展”和“用户体验升级”，下方各配有简短的中文正文。保持场景的写实感，呈现高端企业品牌美学，座位布置整齐，并对人物进行细微的匿名化处理或柔焦处理。

templates.title: Cyberpunk game collaboration poster

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克游戏联动海报

templates.prompt: A cinematic-quality promotional poster showcases the collaboration with a hardcore sci-fi military game, employing a high-end Chinese-style visual design for the event. The vertical composition features ultra-high detail, depicting a dark, futuristic battlefield city at night, accompanied by rain, smoke, sparks, neon fog, satellite antennas, towers, launch devices, and a war-torn industrial skyline. Two female combat characters stand back-to-back in the center of the image as the visual focal point. The character on the left is a tactical scout, clad in a black hooded armored camouflage suit with layered armor, straps, gauntlets, and glowing blue technological elements, wielding a high-tech, compact crossbow pointing downwards; her silhouette is sleek, deadly, and exudes a strong military feel. The character on the right is a cyberpunk female warrior, inspired by the punk gunslinger archetype, with long, flowing hair {argument name="hair color" default="blue"} Braided hair, shaved sides, tattoos on her arms, wearing a black leather jacket and tactical belt, wielding a massive, futuristic Gatling gun-like weapon that shimmers with a purple-blue light; she looks rebellious, dangerous, and highly distinctive. Their faces are obscured by black cubes resembling censorship blocks, maintaining a mysterious meme poster style. At the top, a small Chinese slogan reads "Two Battlefields, One Belief." Occupying the title position is a large, weathered metallic Chinese title, "Delta Force × League of Legends," the first half weathered silver, the second half worn gold. Below the title is a small Chinese slogan: "Tactical Coordination · Information Domination · Breaking Limits." In the left mid-ground, a large, glowing blue holographic logo with a geometric design and the word "HAAVK" is added. In the right mid-ground, a purple neon billboard is added, displaying the Chinese characters "Jinx · Information Position" and a smaller subtitle line below. Near the character on the left, in the lower left, a description box with a green label reads "Luna · Reconnaissance Position." Throughout the environment, red laser stripes in the sky, blue scan lines, a purple atmospheric halo, subtle explosion effects, and rich, cinematic volumetric lighting are added. At the bottom center, the co-branded logo and text "Delta Force × League of Legends" are placed, accompanied by the English subtitles "DELTA FORCE" and "LEAGUE OF LEGENDS," followed by the date line "Battlefield Gathering June 12th Battlefield Reconstruction." Below, four small feature badges with icons and bilingual labels are displayed side-by-side: "LIMITED SKIN," "LIMITED MISSIONS," "EXCLUSIVE REWARDS," and "TACTICAL SYNERGY." A final Chinese footer and tiny copyright text are added. Overall style: cinematic game marketing art, ultra-detailed realistic concept art, cyberpunk military style, Tencent-style collaborative posters, dramatic contrasts, blue-purple-orange lighting, clear typography, epic feel, and high-quality commercial execution.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影级的联动宣传海报，展现硬核科幻军事游戏合作，采用高端中式游戏活动主视觉设计。竖构图，超高细节，暗黑未来主义战场城市夜景，伴有雨水、烟雾、火花、霓虹雾气、卫星天线、塔楼、发射装置和饱经战火的工业天际线。两名女性战斗角色背靠背站在画面中心作为视觉焦点。左侧角色为战术侦察兵，身穿黑色连帽装甲隐身服，带有层叠护甲、绑带、护手和发光的蓝色科技元素，手持一把向下指的高科技紧凑型弩；其轮廓干练、致命且充满军事感。右侧角色为赛博朋克女性战士，灵感源自朋克神枪手原型，留着长长的电{argument name="hair color" default="蓝色"}编发，侧面剃发，手臂上有纹身，身穿黑色皮衣和战术腰带，手持一把巨大的、闪烁紫蓝色光芒的未来主义加特林式武器；她看起来叛逆、危险且极具标志性。她们的面部被类似审查方块的黑色方块遮挡，保留了神秘的模因海报风格。在最上方，小巧的中文标语写着“两大战场 一种信念”。占据标题位置的是巨大的做旧金属质感中文标题“三角洲行动 × 英雄联盟”，前半部分为风化的银色，后半部分为磨损的金色。标题下方是一行细小的中文口号：“战术协同 · 信息制胜 · 突破极限”。在左侧中景，加入一个巨大的发光蓝色全息标志，带有几何 Logo 和单词“HAAVK”。在右侧中景，添加一个紫色霓虹灯广告牌，上面写着中文“金克斯·信息位”以及下方的较小副标题行。在左侧角色附近的左下方，添加一个带有绿色标签的说明框，写着“露娜·侦察位”。在整个环境中，添加天空中的红色激光条纹、蓝色扫描线、紫色大气光晕、微弱的爆炸效果以及浓郁的电影级体积光。在底部中心，放置合作品牌 Logo 和文字：“三角洲行动 × 英雄联盟”，配有英文副标题“DELTA FORCE”和“LEAGUE OF LEGENDS”，随后是日期行“战场集结 6月12日 战场重构”。在下方，并排展示 4 个带有图标和双语标签的小型功能徽章：“限定皮肤 / LIMITED SKIN”、“限定任务 / LIMITED MISSIONS”、“专属奖励 / EXCLUSIVE REWARDS”和“战术协同 / TACTICAL SYNERGY”。添加最后的中文页脚标语和微小的版权文字。整体风格：大片级游戏营销美术、超高细节写实概念艺术、赛博朋克军事风、腾讯式合作海报、戏剧性对比、蓝-紫-橙色调灯光、清晰的排版、史诗感且商业化精良。

titleLocalized.zh: 沙漠风中蓝色礼服时尚大片

templates.prompt: A high-fashion full-body photograph depicting a barefoot woman walking across undulating desert dunes, wearing an eye-catching outfit.{argument name="dress color" default="Deep blue sapphire"} The chiffon gown featured a deep V-neck halter neckline, a fitted waist, an ultra-high slit, and a very long, sheer skirt that billowed powerfully to the right in the wind. Her{argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown"} Her long hair is naturally flowing, blown to one side by the wind. She wears delicate earrings, a bracelet, and a simple necklace. Presented in an elegant profile, her torso is upright, one leg extends from the slit in her dress, and one hand gently lifts the hem, creating a sense of dynamism and elegance. The scene is set in a bright, open desert or a dried-up lakebed, with a backdrop of pale sand, low, soft mountains on the horizon, and swirling dust at her feet and behind her. Warm afternoon backlighting, with a hazy sky, creates a soft golden-beige atmosphere, showcasing a strong sense of fabric transparency, cinematic dynamic effects, a luxurious fashion magazine style, hyper-realistic textures, and a simple background to highlight the quality of the dress and the wind.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高级时尚全身编辑摄影作品，画面中一位赤脚女性正站在起伏的沙漠沙丘上迈步前行，身着一件引人注目的 {argument name="dress color" default="深蓝宝石色"} 雪纺礼服，采用深 V 挂脖领口、裹身腰部设计、超高开叉，以及极长的透明裙摆在风中向右强力飘动。她的 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 长发自然披散，被风吹向画面一侧，佩戴着精致的耳环、手链和简约的项链。让她以优雅的侧面姿态呈现，躯干挺拔，一条腿通过开叉处伸出，一只手轻轻提着裙摆，营造出动感与优雅感。场景设定在明亮开阔的沙漠或干涸湖床上，背景是苍白的沙地、地平线上低矮柔和的远山，以及她脚下和身后盘旋的尘埃。采用温暖的午后逆光，天空阳光朦胧，营造出柔和的金色米色氛围，展现出强烈的面料通透感、电影般的动态效果、奢华时尚杂志风格、超写实纹理，以及简洁的背景，以突出礼服与风的质感。

templates.title: Cherry Blossom Garden Evening Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 樱花庭院晚宴肖像

templates.prompt: A photorealistic outdoor portrait captures an elegant young East Asian woman standing in a traditional Japanese garden during cherry blossom season. She is shown with three-quarters of her back turned, slightly turned to the camera, her face mostly obscured by the angle. She wears a deep burgundy satin evening gown with thin straps and a visually striking low-cut back, the fitted cut accentuating her waist and hips, the fabric possessing a soft, reflective texture. Her hair is styled in a casual, romantic updo, with a few strands cascading down, adorned with three small pink flower hair accessories, delicate pendant earrings, and a thin necklace. She is surrounded by cherry blossom branches laden with pale pink blossoms, petals drifting in the air. In the background is a traditional Japanese wooden building with dark beams, shoji windows, and a gray tiled roof, softly blurred by a shallow depth of field. The lower part of the image includes a tranquil garden pond with stone edging. Using warm spring sunlight, soft cinematic bokeh, highly detailed skin and fabric rendering, elegant poses, exquisite luxury fashion photography style, and natural colors, a tranquil atmosphere is created, employing a square composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张照片级逼真的户外肖像，展现了一位优雅的年轻东亚女性在樱花季伫立于日本传统庭院中的场景。她以四分之三背影示人，微微转向镜头，面部大部分被角度遮挡。她身穿一件深酒红色缎面晚礼服，配有细肩带和极具视觉冲击力的低露背设计，修身剪裁勾勒出腰部和臀部线条，面料呈现出柔和的反光质感。她的发型是随性浪漫的盘发，垂落几缕发丝，并点缀着 3 枚粉色小花发饰，佩戴着精致的吊坠耳环和细项链。周围环绕着挂满淡粉色花朵的樱花枝，空气中飘落着片片花瓣。背景处是一座带有深色横梁、障子窗和灰色瓦顶的传统日式木建筑，在浅景深效果下呈现出柔和的虚化感。画面下方背景包含一个宁静的庭院池塘和石砌边缘。采用温暖的春日阳光、柔和的电影级焦外成像、高细节的皮肤与面料渲染、优雅的姿态、精致的奢华时尚摄影风格、自然色彩，营造出宁静的氛围，采用方形构图。

templates.title: Clay Astronaut Lunar Market

titleLocalized.zh: 黏土宇航员月球市集

templates.prompt: A whimsical and fun handmade clay model, themed as{argument name="scene theme" default="Moon Night Market"} The scene is shot like a miniature movie set. The ground is unevenly textured, dusty lunar soil covered with small craters, against a deep black sky dotted with tiny, warm white stars. A cratered moon is visible in the upper left corner. Five small astronauts in thick, retro-style white spacesuits, wearing rounded helmets and dark, glossy masks, play the roles of market vendors and customers. Four rustic market stalls, constructed from rough wooden poles and stone counters, are set up, each covered with a soft blue-gray or rust-red fabric awning. Warm orange paper lanterns hang from the stalls, and six round light bulbs are strung together behind them, creating a comfortable contrast to the cold lunar environment. In the left foreground, a large stall is placed with two astronauts: one vendor serving food in bowls and plates behind the counter, and a customer with a backpack facing the stall. In the mid-ground background, place two smaller stalls, with an astronaut standing between or near them, seemingly browsing or purchasing goods. In the right foreground, place a stall under a red awning, overflowing with bread, pastries, jars, and baskets. Near the center foreground, add a rough, round stone table and four low stools; an astronaut sits beside it, holding a cup or bowl, with four small plates or food platters on the table. Scattered around the scene are several silver crates wrapped in aluminum foil, including one in the left foreground and a group on the right. The overall style should be tactile and handcrafted, like stop-motion puppets and sculpted clay miniatures, with delicate textures, warm, functional lighting from lanterns, shallow depth of field, and a captivating, surreal fusion of space exploration and a cozy street food market.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个充满奇趣的手工黏土立体模型，主题为 {argument name="scene theme" default="月球夜市"}，拍摄效果如同微缩电影布景。地面是布满小型陨石坑且质感不均的灰尘月壤，背景是深邃的黑色天空，点缀着许多微小的暖白色星星，左上方可见一颗布满陨石坑的月球。画面中有 5 个穿着厚实复古风格白色宇航服的小宇航员，他们戴着圆润的头盔和深色光泽面罩，分别扮演市集摊主和顾客。搭建 4 个由粗糙木杆和石质柜台组成的乡村风市集摊位，每个摊位上方都覆盖着柔和的蓝灰色或锈红色织物遮阳棚。摊位上悬挂着暖橙色的纸灯笼，摊位后方串联着 6 个圆形灯泡，与寒冷的月球环境形成舒适的对比。在左侧前景处，放置一个大型摊位，有 2 个宇航员：1 名摊主在柜台后用碗盘盛放食物，1 名背着背包的顾客面向摊位。在中景背景处，放置 2 个较小的摊位，有 1 个宇航员站在摊位之间或附近，仿佛在浏览或购买商品。在右侧前景处，放置一个红色遮阳棚的摊位，摆满了面包、糕点、罐子和篮子。在中心前方附近，添加一张粗糙的圆形石桌和 4 个低矮的圆凳；一个宇航员坐在旁边，手里拿着杯子或碗，桌面上摆放着 4 个小盘子或食物组合。在场景周围散落几个铝箔包裹的银色货箱，包括左侧前景的 1 个和右侧的一组。整体风格应具有触感和手工感，如同定格动画木偶和雕塑黏土微缩模型，具有细腻的纹理、来自灯笼的温暖实用照明、浅景深，以及太空探索与舒适街头美食市集之间迷人而超现实的融合。

templates.title: Zen Tea Ceremony Robot

titleLocalized.zh: 禅意茶道机器人

templates.prompt: A tranquil Japanese tea room is presented in an exquisite monochrome ink painting style on aged parchment, with soft shades of dark brown and gray, delicate brushstrokes, and precise lines. On the right, a {argument name="robot type" default="service robots"} A humanoid robot kneels on a tatami mat, its smooth white shell and exposed mechanical joints showcasing elegant industrial details. Head bowed, it slowly pours hot tea from a cast-iron teapot into a small ceramic cup. A simple cloth apron cinches its waist, perfectly blending traditional tea ceremony etiquette with a futuristic mechanical feel. In the foreground, five tea utensils are clearly visible on a low, black wooden tea table: a dark ceramic vase with a sparse leaf; an upright bamboo whisk; a tea bowl; a small teacup on a tray; and a cast-iron teapot held by the robot. The freshly brewed tea emits a faint steam. A scroll hanging behind the table displays a free-flowing enso (circular image). To the left, tall shoji doors diffuse soft sunlight into the room. The walls are simple stucco with subtle wear and ink stains. The overall composition is calm, balanced, minimalist, and thought-provoking, blending Japanese "wabi-sabi" aesthetics with a tranquil science fiction feel. The widescreen cinematic composition, eye-level perspective, and ample negative space create a meditative atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一间宁静的日式茶室，以精致的单色水墨画风格呈现于陈旧的羊皮纸上，色调为柔和的深褐色与灰色，笔触细腻，线条勾勒精准。在右侧，一个 {argument name="robot type" default="服务型机器人"} 人形机器人正跪坐在榻榻米上，其光滑的白色外壳和裸露的机械关节以优雅的工业细节呈现，它低头垂目，正将热茶从铸铁茶壶中缓缓倒入小巧的陶瓷杯里。机器人腰间系着简单的布围裙，将传统的茶道礼仪与未来主义机械感完美融合。画面中央前景处，一张低矮的黑色木制茶桌上清晰可见 5 件茶具：1 个深色陶瓷花瓶，插着一枝稀疏的叶片；1 个直立的竹制茶筅；1 个茶碗；1 个托盘上的小茶杯；以及机器人手中持有的 1 把铸铁茶壶。刚沏好的茶冒着淡淡的热气。桌后悬挂的卷轴上绘有一个笔触洒脱的圆相（Enso）。左侧，高大的障子门将柔和的日光漫射进室内。墙壁为素雅的灰泥墙，带有细微的磨损和墨渍，整体构图平静、平衡、极简且引人深思，将日式“侘寂”美学与静谧的科幻感融为一体。采用宽银幕电影构图，平视视角，留白充足，营造出一种冥想般的氛围。

templates.title: Fauvist still life of persimmons

titleLocalized.zh: 野兽派柿子静物画

templates.prompt: A bold Post-Impressionist still life, painted with impasto and viewed from a slightly overhead perspective. At the center is a round, turquoise plate containing three bright orange persimmons with green leaf tips arranged in a triangular cluster. The plate rests on a bright red tablecloth. A dark green glass bottle sits in the upper left, casting a soft shadow on a textured mustard-yellow wall. A folded napkin with broad, soft blue vertical stripes is located in the lower left. To the right of the table lies a kitchen knife, its silver blade gleaming, its dark blue handle angled diagonally upwards. The painting employs saturated complementary colors, expressive paint textures, visible palette knife brushstrokes, simplified forms, dark outlines for emphasis, and warm, vibrant Fauvist hues. The composition should have a handcrafted feel, full of energy and slightly naive, like a modern museum-style still life.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅大胆的后印象派静物油画，采用厚涂法笔触，视角略微俯视。画面中央是一个圆形的绿松石色盘子，盘中以三角形簇状摆放着 3 个带有绿色叶顶的亮橙色柿子。将盘子放在鲜红色的桌布上。左上方放置一个深绿色玻璃瓶，在纹理丰富的芥末黄色墙面上投下柔和的阴影。左下方包含一块折叠的餐巾，上面有宽大的奶油色和柔和的蓝色垂直条纹。在桌子的右侧，放置一把厨房刀，银色刀刃闪闪发光，深蓝色刀柄呈对角线向上倾斜。运用饱和的互补色、富有表现力的绘画质感、可见的调色刀笔触、简化的形式、深色的轮廓强调，以及温暖、活泼的野兽派色彩感。构图应呈现出手工制作的质感，充满活力且略显稚拙，如同现代博物馆风格的静物油画。

templates.title: Noir-style melting ink poster

titleLocalized.zh: 黑色电影风格融化墨迹海报

templates.prompt: A minimalist retro poster, using a 9:16 vertical composition with a cream-colored paper texture background. The centerpiece is a male silhouette facing right, the view extending from his hat to his upper thigh, reminiscent of a 1940s film noir intellectual, wearing a dark fedora (with a light-colored chin strap), a black suit jacket, a white shirt, and a dark tie. Dramatic high-contrast Rembrandt lighting and deep shadows obscure most of the face in the black silhouette, creating a sophisticated film noir atmosphere. A large, bright red circle, like a striking halo, is placed directly behind the head and upper shoulders, with clean, graphic lines. The lower half of the torso and jacket should dissolve into long, vertical black ink droplets and splatter effects, mixed with some gray wash marks, forming a melting ink effect extending downwards to the bottom of the poster. The color scheme is limited to {argument name="accent color" default="bright red"} Dark black, washed gray, and off-white. Add a prominent uppercase sans-serif heading near the bottom, centered, with the following content:{argument name="headline text" default="THE MID-CENTURY INTELLECTUAL"} Overall style: medieval modern poster design, cinematic noir style, minimalist editorial art, clean white space, elegant, memorable, graphic, museum poster quality.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极简主义复古海报，采用 9:16 竖构图，背景为米白色纸张纹理。画面中心为一名男性侧影，面向右侧，展示范围从帽子到大腿上部，造型如同 1940 年代的黑色电影知识分子，头戴深色软呢帽（配浅色帽带），身穿黑色西装外套、白色衬衫和深色领带。运用戏剧性的高对比度伦勃朗光影和深邃阴影，使面部大部分隐没在黑色剪影中，营造出精致的黑色电影氛围。在头部和上肩部正后方放置一个巨大的鲜红色圆圈，如同醒目的光环，线条简洁且具有图形感。躯干和外套的下半部分应溶解为长条状的垂直黑色墨滴和飞溅效果，并混合一些灰色水洗痕迹，形成向下延伸至海报底部的融化墨迹效果。配色方案限制为 {argument name="accent color" default="正红色"}、深黑色、灰色水洗色和米白色。在底部附近居中添加一行醒目的大写无衬线标题，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="THE MID-CENTURY INTELLECTUAL"}。整体风格：中世纪现代海报设计、电影黑色风格、极简主义编辑艺术、干净的留白、优雅、令人难忘、图形化、博物馆海报品质。

templates.title: Seamless gold roses on a deep blue background

titleLocalized.zh: 深蓝底色上的无缝金玫瑰

templates.prompt: A seamless repeating textile pattern designed as a four-way continuous wallpaper or fabric print, featuring vintage rose bouquets in metallic antique gold against a deep midnight blue background. The composition should be neatly tiled in all directions, with no visible seams, arranged in an elegant, full-coverage repeating pattern of rose clusters, half-open blossoms, buds, curled stems, and scattered leaves. Use delicate etched or jacquard-style lines to make the flowers appear as if woven, embroidered, or sculpted, rather than painted. Bouquet sizes should vary from medium to large, with dense clusters alternating with smaller, individual flowers to create a balanced repeating effect. The color palette is limited to rich, deep blues and bright, soft golds, offering strong contrast and a luxurious, deep, classic Baroque-inspired textile texture. Very subtle vertical shading and pleats are added to the surface to make it resemble draped fabric or curtains while maintaining the seamless repeating structure. Highly detailed, decorative, elegant, and opulent, this seamless pattern sample is suitable for upholstery, wallpaper, or luxury clothing fabrics.

promptLocalized.zh: 一种设计为四向连续壁纸或织物印花的无缝重复纺织图案，以深午夜蓝为背景，呈现金属古金色的复古玫瑰花束。构图应在所有方向上整齐平铺，无可见接缝，排列为玫瑰簇、半开花朵、小花蕾、卷曲茎秆和散落叶片的优雅全覆盖重复图案。使用精致的蚀刻或提花风格线条纹理，使花朵看起来像是编织、刺绣或雕刻而成，而非绘画。花束的比例应从中等到大型不等，密集的簇群与较小的独立花朵交替出现，以形成平衡的重复效果。调色板仅限于浓郁的深蓝色和明亮的柔和金色，具有强烈的对比感以及奢华、深沉、经典的巴洛克时尚纺织品质感。在表面添加非常细微的垂直阴影褶皱，使其看起来像垂下的织物或窗帘，同时保持无缝重复结构。高细节、装饰性、优雅、富丽堂皇，无缝图案样本，适用于室内装潢、壁纸或奢华服装面料。

templates.title: Blue Fantasy Hero Poster

templates.prompt: A dramatically rendered vertical fantasy game poster depicts a male warrior hero amidst an icy blue environment. Rendered with ultra-refined digital illustration, it boasts cinematic lighting and high contrast. The dynamic, slightly angled composition places the character across the frame, as if he's diving or thrusting through ice shards and streams of blue energy. He possesses {argument name="character name" default="Lan"} A young, handsome face, pale skin, sharply defined features, and disheveled hair.{argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} Short hair. His expression is calm, cold, and focused, his eyes looking down as if tracking prey. He wears streamlined fantasy armor in deep navy blue and black, with metallic silver edges and luminous cyan highlights, comprising four visible main armor pieces: a large right shoulder plate with a circular glowing core, close-fitting chest and torso armor, layered waist armor, and forearm armor. His body is turned to the side in a fluid assassin pose, one arm outstretched, revealing a long, glowing blue weapon or energy blade from the lower left. Sharp, translucent ice, swirling fabric-like frost flowers, and floating debris surround him, all illuminated by a bright blue light. The design uses cool tones primarily of sapphire, cobalt blue, and ice cyan, with glossy reflections and magical glowing effects. (Add 3 sets of visible Chinese typography, integrated like a mobile MOBA hero poster: a large white calligraphic title near the upper left center.){argument name="title text" default="Lan"} Next to it is a line of slender, vertically arranged poetic text.{argument name="tagline text" default="The annihilated blade, only for eternity."} There is a gold vertical game logo in the upper right corner.{argument name="logo text" default="Honor of Kings"} High-end e-sports promotional posters, rich in detail, exuding heroism, elegance, aloofness, mystery, and power.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的竖版幻想游戏海报，描绘了一位身处冰蓝色环境中的男性战士英雄，采用超精细的数字插画渲染，具有电影级光影和高对比度。构图动感且略带斜向，角色身体横跨画面，仿佛正在穿过冰片和蓝色能量流进行俯冲或突刺。他拥有 {argument name="character name" default="澜"}，一张年轻英俊的脸庞、苍白的皮肤、轮廓分明的五官以及凌乱的 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色"} 短发。他的表情冷静、冷峻且专注，双眼向下俯视，仿佛正在追踪猎物。他身着深海军蓝与黑色相间的流线型幻想盔甲，带有金属银色边缘和发光的青色高光，包括 4 个可见的主要盔甲部件：带有圆形发光核心的大型右肩甲、贴身的胸部与躯干护甲、分层腰甲以及前臂护甲。他的身体以流畅的刺客姿势侧转，一只手臂伸展，一把长长的发光蓝色武器或能量刃从左下方显现。周围环绕着锋利的半透明冰层、旋转的织物状霜花以及漂浮的碎片，所有元素都被明亮的蓝光照亮。使用以蓝宝石色、钴蓝色和冰青色为主的冷色调，并带有光泽反射和魔法发光效果。添加 3 组可见的中文排版，整合如移动端 MOBA 英雄海报：左上方中央附近有一个巨大的白色书法标题 {argument name="title text" default="澜"}，旁边有一行纤细的竖排诗意文字 {argument name="tagline text" default="被灭刃锋，只为永恒"}，右上角有一个金色的竖排游戏 Logo {argument name="logo text" default="王者荣耀"}。高端电竞宣传海报，细节丰富，英雄气概，优雅、冷峻、神秘且强大。

templates.title: Luxury Yae no Miko Collector's Edition Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华八重神子收藏级海报

templates.prompt: Create a luxurious vertical poster featuring anime character collectibles, employing the style of high-end magazine covers and merchandise catalogs. The center of the image should be {argument name="character name" default="Yaegami"} A beautiful adult witch with extremely long, flowing hair{argument name="hair color" default="pink"} With flowing hair and violet eyes, she sits gracefully atop a dark lacquered shrine treasure chest adorned with gold tassels and floral patterns, exuding confidence and allure. She wears an exquisite cherry blossom-themed ceremonial gown, crafted from layered, semi-transparent pink and white fabric, embellished with floral embroidery, ribbons, jewelry, gold details, split sleeves, a delicate veil, glamorous earrings, and strappy heels, showcasing a captivating, fashionable illustration silhouette. Her legs are crossed, and one hand lightly touches her lips. The overall composition revolves around cherry blossoms, petals, decorative borders, gold filigree, and soft pale pink lighting. The image should possess the quality of a special edition fan-collectible poster, incorporating various design elements and clear labeling. A large decorative serif font, "YAE MIKO," is placed at the top background, with "Generalpost • ETERNAL SAKURA" in the upper left corner and "Lady Guuji OF THE GRAND NARUKAMI SHRINE" in the upper right. A vertical line of Japanese text is added to the right of the character. The left side features a stamp page titled "CHIBI STAMP COLLECTION," containing six 2x3 arranged chibi character stamps, each displaying a different cute expression or pose. Below this is a "Mini Figure Collection" area, showcasing three chibi miniature figures side-by-side. Further down is the "Stickers" section, containing five die-cut stickers: four chibi character stickers and one fox mask sticker. A hanging "Character Profile" card is added to the bottom right corner, labeled "Birthday," "Affiliation," "Vision," and "Constellation," with a short quote at the bottom. The bottom edge includes four complimentary tickets or stamps: one fox crest round badge, one cherry blossom festival commemorative ticket, one Narukami Taisha special pass, and one stamp-style stamp marked with the date 27 APR 2024 and a fox image. A limited edition serial number label, "NO. 08888 / 10000," is added to the bottom left corner. templates.title: Bold tennis fashion poster

titleLocalized.zh: 大胆网球时尚海报

templates.prompt: A high-end sports fashion editorial poster, with a clean, off-white photography studio background and a huge, bold, black sans-serif compressed font.{argument name="headline text" default="FOCUS"} The image almost completely fills the background. In front of the text, a tall female tennis player is positioned, striking a confident and powerful pose. She is positioned slightly to the right of center, one leg straight on the ground, the other bent at the knee and raised, resting on the neck of an oversized, upright tennis racket. She turns her head to the side, her dark hair styled in a low ponytail, her skin radiant, and her legs long and shapely, presenting a luxurious advertising aesthetic. Her attire: a fitted white sleeveless V-neck tennis dress with a short pleated skirt, white wristbands, and white mid-calf athletic socks printed with black {argument name="brand letter" default="P"} The logo shows her wearing white tennis shoes. Her tennis racket is white with a dark string bed, resting vertically beneath her raised leg. Scattered on the reflective black court surface are five white tennis balls, each with a small black dot.{argument name="ball logo" default="P"} The logo features clear, mirror-like reflections of the athlete, racket, text, and ball. A sharp white court line is added diagonally across the bottom foreground. Soft yet directional studio lighting creates subtle highlights on skin and clothing, resulting in a high-end, luxurious sports advertising atmosphere. The color scheme is minimalist: black, white, warm skin tones, and subtle gray reflections. The composition should have the feel of a stylish advertising poster—simple, graphic, bold, and eye-catching.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高级运动时尚编辑海报，背景为干净的米白色摄影棚，巨大的超粗黑色无衬线压缩字体 {argument name="headline text" default="FOCUS"} 几乎填满了整个背景。在文字前方，放置一位身材高挑的女性网球运动员，她摆出自信的力量姿势，全身位于画面中心偏右位置，一条腿笔直着地，另一条腿屈膝抬起，膝盖搁在竖立的超大号网球拍拍颈上。她侧脸看向一旁，深色秀发梳成低马尾，皮肤光泽，双腿修长健美，呈现出奢华的广告美感。服装：一件修身白色无袖 V 领网球裙，配有短百褶裙摆，双腕佩戴白色护腕，白色中筒运动袜上印有黑色 {argument name="brand letter" default="P"} 标志，脚穿白色网球鞋。网球拍为白色，拍面为深色线床，垂直靠在她抬起的腿下。在反光的黑色球场地面上，散落着 5 个白色网球，每个球上都有一个小的黑色 {argument name="ball logo" default="P"} 标志，并呈现出运动员、球拍、文字和球的清晰镜面反射。在底部前景处添加对角线穿过的清晰白色球场线。灯光采用柔和但具有方向性的摄影棚布光，在皮肤和服装上营造出精致的高光，打造出高端奢华的运动广告氛围。极简配色：黑色、白色、温暖的肤色以及微妙的灰色反射。构图应呈现出时尚广告海报的质感，简洁、图形化、大胆且引人注目。

templates.prompt: A high-fashion style sports portrait, featuring a powerful female tennis player at the center against a simple light gray background. (Large words){argument name="headline text" default="FOCUS"} Presented in an ultra-bold black sans-serif compressed font, filling the entire background from edge to edge. She possesses{argument name="skin tone" default="Dark brown"} His skin had a glossy, editor-grade lighting effect; he was physically robust; and his hairstyle was {argument name="hair style" default="Long and neat high ponytail"} Her face is deliberately blurred, creating a smooth, rectangular mask effect, with no visible eyes, nose, or mouth. She wears a monochrome white tennis outfit consisting of five visible parts: a halter-neck sports bra, a pleated mini tennis skirt, a wristband, ribbed mid-calf socks with a small black "P" logo, and white tennis shoes. She strikes a confident and dominant pose: one leg straight, the other bent and raised, her foot resting on the neck of a vertically placed white tennis racket, her hand gripping the handle, the racket head touching the ground. The racket strings display subtle dark geometric patterns. The ground is a glossy reflective surface, reflecting the athlete and oversized lettering. Six white tennis balls are scattered on the ground: one partially cropped in the lower left corner, one above it to the left, one near the lower left center with a visible "P," one near the lower right center with a visible "P," and two clustered on the right, one with a visible "P" and the other with a visible lowercase "b." It adopts a minimalist high-end commercial advertising aesthetic, with high contrast, centered composition, full-body shots, symmetrical balance, and magazine-level retouching lighting effects.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高级时尚摄影风格的运动肖像，画面中心是一位强有力的女性网球运动员，背景为简洁的浅灰色。巨大的单词 {argument name="headline text" default="FOCUS"} 以超粗黑色无衬线压缩字体呈现，从边缘到边缘填满整个背景。她拥有 {argument name="skin tone" default="深棕色"} 的皮肤，呈现出光泽感的编辑级灯光效果，体格健壮，发型为 {argument name="hair style" default="长款利落的高马尾"}。她的面部特意模糊处理，呈现出平滑的矩形遮罩效果，没有可见的眼睛、鼻子或嘴巴。她身穿单色白色网球服，包含 5 个可见部分：挂脖式运动内衣、百褶迷你网球裙、一只护腕、带有黑色小字母“P”标志的罗纹中筒袜以及白色网球鞋。让她摆出自信且具有统治力的姿势：一条腿站直，另一条腿屈膝抬起，脚踩在垂直放置的白色网球拍拍颈上，单手握住拍柄，拍头触地。球拍线呈现出微妙的深色几何标志形状。地面为光泽感反射面，映照出运动员和超大号文字。在地面上散落 6 个白色网球：1 个位于左下角被部分裁剪，1 个位于其上方左侧，1 个位于左下中心附近且带有可见的“P”字样，1 个位于右下中心附近且带有可见的“P”字样，另外 2 个聚集在右侧，其中一个带有可见的“P”，另一个带有可见的小写“b”。采用极简高端商业广告美学，高对比度，居中构图，全身取景，对称平衡，以及杂志级的精修灯光效果。

templates.title: Dark Fantasy Scarlet Samurai Daimyo

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑奇幻绯红武士大名

templates.prompt: A highly dynamic dark fantasy anime illustration depicts a samurai daimyo in a powerful three-quarter full-body pose, centered and filling the frame. The character holds a drawn katana horizontally, the blade slightly tilted downwards and pointing to the right. The character possesses extremely long and wild, flowing swords {argument name="hair color" default="Crimson"} The hair flows towards the upper right corner of the composition, adorned with ornate gold hair ornaments and woven details. The character is dressed in luxurious and layered Japanese court and samurai attire: an inner white kimono with delicate subtle patterns, an outer robe of deep indigo and purple, two black lacquered arm guards, two exquisite gold shoulder armors, and the chest and waist decorated with multiple woven ropes, tassels, belts, chains, and gold filigree ornaments. The samurai sword features a magnificent dark hilt, red wrappings, and gilded fittings, its polished steel blade capturing bright highlights. A low-angle, heroic composition is employed, with sleeves and ribbons billowing outwards, emphasizing dynamism and dominance. The background is a near-black textured void, with a large circular emblem or moon-like symbol behind the character, painted in mottled gold and shadowy deep blue, its edges scattered with embers, ink stains, and fiery sparks. The color palette is rich yet restrained: black, deep navy, burgundy, crimson, antique gold, and ivory. Rendered in an ultra-refined oil painting/anime style, it presents intricate fabric patterns, metallic reflections, dramatic rim lighting, cinematic contrast, and a serious, dignified, and awe-inspiring atmosphere. Avoid cute shapes, bright, soft colors, glossy plastic textures, and oversaturated shimmer effects; maintain a mature, resolute, elegant, and highly refined texture.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具张力的暗黑奇幻动漫插画，描绘了一位武士大名，采用强有力的四分之三全身姿势，居中且填满画面。角色横向持有一把出鞘的武士刀，刀刃略微向下倾斜指向右侧。角色拥有极长且狂野、随风飘动的 {argument name="hair color" default="绯红色"} 头发，发丝流向构图的右上角，并配有华丽的金色发饰和编织细节。为角色穿上奢华且层次分明的日本宫廷与武士服饰：内层为带有精致暗纹的白色和服，外层为深靛蓝与紫色长袍，佩戴 2 个黑色漆面护臂，2 个精巧的金色肩甲，胸部和腰部装饰着多条编织绳、流苏、腰带、链条及金色花丝饰品。武士刀配有华丽的深色刀柄、红色缠带和镀金配件，抛光的钢制刀刃捕捉着明亮的高光。采用低角度的英雄式构图，袖子和丝带向外飘扬，强调动感与统治力。背景为近乎黑色的纹理虚空，角色身后有一个巨大的圆形纹章或类似月亮的标志，以斑驳的金色和阴影般的深蓝色绘制，边缘散落着余烬、墨迹和火红色的火星。色调浓郁且克制：黑色、深海军蓝、酒红色、绯红色、古金色和象牙白。以超精细的油画动漫风格渲染，呈现复杂的织物图案、金属反射、戏剧性的轮廓光、电影级的对比度，以及严肃、威严且令人敬畏的氛围。避免可爱的造型，避免明亮的柔和色彩，避免光泽的塑料质感，避免过度饱和的闪光效果；保持成熟、坚毅、优雅且高度精细的质感。
