templates.title: Japanese fashion tips poster editor

titleLocalized.zh: 日系时尚穿搭要点海报编辑

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0, transform the photo into a soft, Japanese-style fashion analysis poster while preserving the original subject, clothing, indoor window scene, and blurred face occlusion. Create a scrapbook/editing layout on a warm cream background, accented with blush pink and beige. Place the full-body photo on the left, presented as a slightly tilted print snapshot, with handwritten annotations. Add four circular detail close-ups on the right: 1) neckline/chest area, 2) knit shoulder and sleeve texture, 3) waist and jeans area, 4) cardigan hem and pocket area. Add a small portrait illustration near the bottom center, using the same person and clothing, in a casual leaning pose. Incorporate Japanese magazine-style typography and decorative doodles. Visible text should include the following parts and tags: top title "このコーデのFashion Point ♡", ribbon subtitle "ナチュラルに色っぽく见せる大人カジュアル", right title "POINT", point label "Point 01" "Point 02" "Point 03" "Point 04", the photo on the left is annotated "Soft and beautiful female image に♡" "ナチュラ"ルなのに视を集める抜け情コーデ✨", a title titled "COORDINATION TIPS" box (containing 4 lines of bullet points), a box titled "Instagrammable" (containing 4 lines of bullet points) (List of lines), and the bottom tagline "With a natural, vibrant color and a subtle, captivating charm, draw out your own charm." For the key descriptions, write concise Japanese text praising the deep V-neck, soft knit, subtle cropped design, and basic color scheme. Add small stars, hearts, glitter, flowers, seams, and a miniature camera icon. Make it look like a sophisticated social media fashion advice sheet, in portrait orientation.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用 REFERENCE_0，将照片转换为柔美风格的日系时尚穿搭解析海报，同时保留原人物、服装、室内窗边场景及模糊面部遮挡。在暖奶油色背景上创建剪贴簿/编辑排版，并点缀腮红粉色和米色。将主体全身照放置在左侧，呈现为略微倾斜的打印快照，并配有手写标注。在右侧添加 4 个圆形细节特写：1) 领口/胸部区域，2) 针织肩部和袖子纹理，3) 腰部和牛仔裤区域，4) 开衫下摆和口袋区域。在底部中心附近添加一个小的人像插图，使用同一人物和服装，呈现休闲倚靠姿势。加入日系杂志风格的排版和装饰性涂鸦。可见文字应包含以下部分和标签：顶部标题「このコーデの Fashion Point ♡」，丝带副标题「ナチュラルに色っぽく見せる大人カジュアル」，右侧标题「POINT」，要点标签「Point 01」「Point 02」「Point 03」「Point 04」，左侧照片注释「柔らかニットで女性らしい優しい印象に♡」「ナチュラルなのに視線を集める抜け感コーデ✨」，一个标题为「COORDINATION TIPS」的技巧框（含 4 行要点），一个标题为「Instagrammable」的方框（含 4 行清单），以及底部标语「ナチュラルな色気と抜け感で、あなたらしい魅力を引き出して。」。对于要点描述，请撰写简短的日文文案，赞美深 V 领、柔软针织、微妙的露腰设计和基础色系搭配。添加小星星、爱心、闪光、花朵、缝合线和一个微型相机图标。使其看起来像一张精致的社交媒体时尚建议单，纵向排版。

templates.title: Watercolor-style Minecraft world cross-section

titleLocalized.zh: 水彩风格 Minecraft 世界横截面

templates.prompt: A highly detailed watercolor illustration on textured off-white paper depicts a vertically suspended slice of a Minecraft-style world, framed by a massive, ruined rectangular stone archway. The composition is centered and vertical, with softly rendered clouds along the edges and sharp voxel details within. At the top, the weathered archway, composed of moss-covered stones, cracked bricks, and mineral-stained blocks, opens like a window, revealing a fantastical mountain range with hazy spires and two birds in the distance. The upper landscape includes two block trees, two small huts with sloping roofs, a church-like tower in the midground, a wooden fence, and the edge of a meadow. A small waterfall cascades down the left and right edges. In the left-middle foreground, a Steve-style adventurer, dressed in a cyan shirt and blue pants, stands with his back to the viewer, holding a pickaxe and gazing at the world beyond the archway. A pig is added to the meadow in the upper left. Beneath the surface, a cross-section showcasing the underground biome and structures is presented: on the left, an abandoned mineshaft with wooden supports and minecart tracks; in the central cave, blue water and a downward-pointing ladder; in the lower left corner, a glowing blue crystal ore; on the right, a bright orange lava well extending downwards; in the cave to the right center, a green creeper; in a small room on the right, a white skeleton archer; near the lower right corner, a purple Nether portal; and in a dimly lit lower room, a small spider. Warm torchlight is scattered throughout the caves for contrast. The color palette should blend earthy browns, mossy greens, cool blue mist, and fiery orange lava, with a dreamlike atmospheric perspective in the distance. The entire scene is rendered as a sophisticated fusion of Minecraft block geometry and traditional watercolor fantasy painting—complex, magical, nostalgic, and artistic.

templates.prompt: A dark, resolute, cinematic anime poster, adopting the style of a historical youth comic book cover, inspired by {argument name="series title" default="VINLAND SAGA"} The composition is vertical and dramatic, featuring a figure that closely resembles {argument name="character name" default="THORFINN"} A panoramic view of a young warrior's back, standing on jagged black rocks by a stormy seashore. He wears a weathered brownish-grey hooded robe or cloak with rough fur trim at the collar, a belt around his waist, dark trousers, and worn leather boots. His posture is tense and contemplative, his right hand gripping a short sword pointing downwards, facing the surging waves and spray under a cold, cloudy sky. Behind him, occupying the upper half of the image, is a large profile of his head and wet, disheveled blond hair, rendered with thick ink lines and painterly shadows to create a layered double exposure effect. On the left, there are four vertically stacked, embedded comic-style narrative panels: Panel 1 shows a close-up of the boy gripping the short sword; Panel 2 shows him with his back to a small group of armed men; Panel 3 shows a strong close-up of his eyes; Panel 4 shows him walking alone among tombstones or gravestones. Add a striking typography that blends seamlessly with the Chinese promotional poster: In the upper left corner, place small Japanese title text and the English text "VINLAND SAGA," with "YUKIMURA MAKOTO" below; near the lower left, place a large, distressed, blocky "THORFINN," accompanied by smaller katakana characters. Add multiple lines of white, vertical Chinese quotations on the left and right sides, one of which is emphasized with soft gold. Use desaturated charcoal black, slate gray, steel blue, dirty white, and faded brown tones with high contrast, fog, rain textures, rough brushstrokes, and an epic, melancholic atmosphere about abandoning violence and seeking peace. The overall look should convey the quality of a high-end character poster—emotional, windswept, somber, and richly detailed.

templates.prompt: This emotionally charged, cinematic noir illustration depicts a young woman walking directly towards the viewer on a rainy Tokyo street. Centered in the frame, her entire body is visible. She has shoulder-length, straight, grey-pink hair with bangs, the sides slightly curled inwards. Her face is deliberately obscured by a soft, rectangular blurring effect. She holds a cigarette to her lips in her right hand, a wisp of smoke curling upwards around her head. She wears a long, grey trench coat open to the left, over which she wears a white shirt, a black tie, and slim-fitting dark trousers, outlining the silhouette of a capable urban detective or career woman. The street is wet and highly reflective, with heavy rain pouring down, making the pavement gleam. Dark buildings line the sides, with a metal railing on the right. The overall color scheme is a rough, monochromatic palette, with only subtle touches of color in her hair and clothing. The background should include three clearly visible street signs: a tall, vertically illuminated sign on the left that reads "Jiji Press"; a circular speed limit sign displaying "30"; and a tall, weathered pillar on the right that reads "Chuo-ku Kyobashi 2-chome / 17". The overall atmosphere should be melancholic, mature, introspective, and stylish, like a fusion of comic book paneling and realistic urban photography, featuring delicate ink-textured lines, textured shadows, soft contrasts, and dramatic film noir lighting in the rain.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张情绪饱满的电影感动漫黑色电影插画，描绘了一位年轻女性在雨夜的东京街道上径直走向观众，画面居中，全身可见。她留着齐肩的灰粉色直发，带有齐刘海，两侧头发微微内扣，面部被柔和的矩形模糊效果刻意遮挡。她右手拿着一支烟靠近嘴边，一缕淡淡的烟雾在她头部旁向上缭绕。她身穿一件向左敞开的长款灰色风衣，内搭白色衬衫、黑色领带和修身深色长裤，勾勒出干练的都市侦探或职场女性轮廓。街道湿润且反光强烈，大雨倾盆而下，路面光泽感十足，两侧是深色建筑，右侧设有金属护栏，整体色调为粗粝的单色系，仅在头发和服装上保留细微的色彩点缀。背景中需包含 3 个清晰可见的街道标志：左侧是一个高大的垂直发光标志，写着“時事通信”；一个显示“30”的圆形限速标志；以及右侧一根写有“中央区 京橋 2丁目 / Chuo-ku Kyobashi 2-chome / 17”的高大风化立柱。整体氛围应显得凄凉、成熟、内省且时尚，如同漫画分镜与写实城市摄影的融合，具备细腻的墨水质感线条、纹理阴影、柔和的对比度以及戏剧性的雨中黑色电影灯光。

templates.prompt: A full-body street portrait in a hardcore comic style, the protagonist is a man with {argument name="hair color" default="Soft pink"} A tall, young woman with long hair tied in a side braid walks directly towards the camera through a narrow, rainy Japanese alleyway. Her face is obscured by a soft, mosaic-like blur, creating an air of anonymity and censorship. She wears a long black trench coat over a white shirt, a black tie, and high-waisted black trousers. One hand is in her coat pocket, the other hangs at her side, a lit cigarette between her fingers. Thin wisps of smoke rise, mingling with the rain. The alleyway is filled with rows of illuminated shop signs, warm lantern light casting shadows on the wet ground, and crisscrossing overhead wires and dark building facades framing the image. The scene includes three pedestrians in the background holding umbrellas: one with a blue umbrella in the mid-ground on the left, one with a reddish-brown umbrella in the rear right, and one with a green umbrella in the mid-ground on the right. On the far left, a vertical white sign with black Japanese characters is added; on the upper left, a large, stylized black onomatopoeic word is added; and on the right, a white speech bubble containing only ellipses is added. Using dramatic film noir lighting, heavy black ink, halftone paper shadows, delicate cross-hatching, and subtle paper textures, the composition evokes the symmetrical, centered feel of a serialized seinen manga panel, creating an overall somber, cinematic, and rainy atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张硬核漫画风格的全身街头肖像，主角是一位留着 {argument name="hair color" default="柔粉色"} 长发并扎着侧边长辫的高挑年轻女性，正沿着狭窄的雨夜日本巷弄径直走向镜头。她的面部被一层柔和的马赛克模糊效果遮盖，营造出一种匿名且被审查的神秘感。她身穿黑色长款风衣，内搭白色衬衫、黑色领带及高腰黑色长裤，一只手插在风衣口袋里，另一只手垂在身侧，指间夹着一支点燃的香烟。细长的烟雾袅袅升起，与雨水交织在一起。巷弄中布满了发光的竖排店招，温暖的灯笼光影映照在湿漉漉的地面上，头顶交错的电线与深色的建筑外墙构成了画面的框架。画面中包含 3 位撑伞的背景行人：左侧中景处 1 位撑蓝色雨伞的人，右后方 1 位撑红棕色雨伞的人，以及右侧中景处 1 位撑绿色雨伞的人。最左侧添加 1 个带有黑色日文的竖排白色招牌，左上方添加 1 个巨大的程式化黑色拟声词文字，右侧添加 1 个仅包含省略号的白色对话气泡。采用戏剧性的黑色电影光影、厚重的黑色墨水、网点纸阴影、细致的交叉排线、轻微的纸张纹理，构图呈现出连载青年漫画分镜的对称居中感，整体氛围阴郁、充满电影感且雨意浓郁。

templates.title: Fantasy animated movie poster against a sunset background

titleLocalized.zh: 日落背景下的奇幻动画电影海报

templates.prompt: A stunning vertical Japanese anime movie poster, showcasing a fantasy adventure film theme, employs a bright, cinematic art style, complemented by dramatic sunset lighting, oil painting-like clouds, and richly detailed background landscapes. The composition features four figures: the upper half is dominated by two striking upper-body portraits, with a full-body portrait of a little girl in the foreground, and a small urban crowd serving as a scale reference. The main characters are a girl and a boy, standing back-to-back in the upper center, facing opposite directions, their expressions calm, melancholic, and serious. The girl has short, wind-blown, deep navy blue hair with soft highlights, wearing a dark blue sailor-style outfit with a white collar and red bow tie, positioned on the left and larger in proportion. The boy is on the right, slightly smaller, with messy light brown hair, wearing a dark turtleneck coat or cloak, and a pensive expression. At the bottom center of the image, a young girl stands with her back to the camera on a stone observation deck, wearing a dark blue coat or dress, short socks, and dark shoes. A long red scarf flutters wildly in the wind. A black cat sits beside her, and the two gaze at the horizon and the city below. The background is a grand, fantastical city in the golden hour, with warm sunlight streaming into the valleys and onto the rooftops. To the right stands a magnificent spiral clock tower or fantastical cathedral spire. Scattered in the sky are six floating islands of varying sizes, covered in grass and with rocky bases, located in the upper left and upper right corners. Five white birds fly across the lower middle sky, and a giant silhouette of a gliding bird is visible in the midground on the left. The foreground is decorated with soft blue and white flowers and leaves on both sides. The color palette is dreamy, featuring violet, lavender, peach, gold, and soft blue, with luminous rim lighting, atmospheric haze, an epic scale, a sensual fantasy adventure atmosphere, and a high-quality hand-drawn animated poster feel. The image incorporates a Japanese movie poster layout: a large white vertical banner in the upper right corner and a large white Japanese title in the center.{argument name="title text" default="The Traveler Who Weaves the Stars"} Below is a smaller subtitle, with three white award laurel wreath logos in the upper left corner and a display in the lower left corner.{argument name="release date" default="7.18 FRI"} The poster displays the release date, with "ROADSHOW" at the top, a brief white promotional tagline in the lower right corner, and a credits list at the bottom center. At the very bottom is a small copyright notice. Overall, it presents the feel of an original blockbuster animated film poster produced by a renowned studio—emotionally moving, nostalgic, magical, and grand in scale.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张令人惊叹的竖版日式动画电影海报，展现奇幻冒险电影主题，采用明亮的电影级画风，配以戏剧性的日落光影、油画质感的云层和细节丰富的背景景观。构图总共包含 4 个人物：上半部分由 2 个醒目的上半身角色肖像占据，前景中有一名小女孩全身像，另有 1 个微小的城市人群作为环境比例参考。主要角色为一名少女和一名少年，两人在上方中心位置背靠背侧身而立，面朝相反方向，表情平静、忧郁且严肃。女孩留着被风吹拂的深海军蓝色短发，带有柔和的高光，身穿深蓝色水手服风格服装，配有白色领子和红色蝴蝶结，位于左侧且比例较大。男孩位于右侧，体型稍小，留着凌乱的浅棕色头发，身穿深色高领外套或斗篷，神情沉思。画面下方中心处，一名年幼的女孩背对镜头站在石制观景台上，身穿深蓝色外套或连衣裙，穿着短袜和深色鞋子，一条红色的长围巾在风中剧烈飘动；她身边坐着 1 只黑猫，两人一同凝视着地平线和下方的城市。背景是一座黄金时刻的宏大奇幻城市，温暖的阳光洒在河谷和屋顶上，右侧矗立着一座华丽的螺旋状钟楼或奇幻大教堂尖塔。天空中散布着 6 座大小不一、覆盖着草地且底部为岩石的浮空岛，分布在左上方和右上方。画面中还有 5 只白鸟飞过中下部天空，左侧中景处有 1 个巨大的滑翔鸟类剪影。前景底部两侧用柔和的蓝白色花卉和叶片装饰。色彩采用梦幻的紫罗兰色、薰衣草色、桃色、金色和柔和的蓝色，带有发光的轮廓光、大气雾气、史诗般的尺度感、感性的奇幻冒险氛围以及高级的手绘动画海报质感。画面中融入日文电影海报排版：右上角为白色大号竖排标语，中央为白色大号日文标题 {argument name="title text" default="星を紡ぐ旅人"}，下方配有较小的副标题，左上角有 3 个白色奖项月桂花环标识，左下角有显示 {argument name="release date" default="7.18 FRI"} 的上映日期块，上方标注 ROADSHOW，右下角有一句简短的白色宣传引语，底部中心有一行电影制作人员名单。最底部包含一行小字版权声明。整体呈现出由知名工作室制作的原创大片级动画电影海报质感，情感动人、怀旧、充满魔力且气势宏大。

templates.title: Cyberpunk Anime Movie Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克动漫电影海报

templates.prompt: A highly dramatic Japanese anime film poster, used for a fictional cyberpunk science fiction movie, employs a vertical single-page composition. At the center of the image is a young anime girl standing in an abandoned neon-lit alley at night, with a giant, glowing full moon above her head. She is pale, with a melancholic and serious expression, bright magenta glowing eyes, and short, cyan-to-blue hair tied in messy double braids, with wispy bangs and glowing highlights. She wears dark, futuristic school uniform-inspired clothing: a fitted black top, a pleated skirt, a tactical belt with a holster and suspension device, a loose cardigan with badge patches on the cuffs, and a high-tech glowing collar or headphones around her neck. One of her arms is clearly a cyborg prosthetic, revealing its mechanical structure, with pink energy emanating from its transparent panel. A circular neon core device, radiating pink light, is located on her chest. The environment is filled with holographic screens, broken signs, cables, debris, sparks, and floating pinkish-blue particles. Towering, dark buildings surround her, and moonlight casts a strong rim light from behind her head. Using melancholic hues of deep indigo, purple, black, cyan, and bright pink, the artwork achieves ultra-refined, painterly anime-like rendering, glossy reflections, cinematic contrast, volumetric lighting, floating debris, and an unforgettable futuristic atmosphere. Japanese poster typography is integrated into the artwork: on the right is a tall, vertical white banner with a key phrase highlighted in pink; in the upper left are three stacked Japanese award citations, each framed by a laurel wreath; below the center is a line of smaller Japanese text above the title; and in the center is a large white Chinese title.{argument name="main title" default="Future × Backline"} It features a glowing pink X in the center; directly below is the Romanized subtitle.{argument name="romanized title" default="MIRAI KAISEN"} Below that is a line of pink Japanese subtitles.{argument name="subtitle text" default="—The Code of the End—"} At the bottom center is a Japanese promotional slogan, with one word highlighted in pink; the bottom right corner prominently displays the theatrical release date.{argument name="release date" default="7.18"} Below, there is the small print "[FRI]" and "ROADSHOW"; the bottom edge features a small credits and copyright information. Overall, it has the feel of a high-end original animated feature film poster, with strong emotions, excellent production quality, and the style of an award-winning work.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的日本动漫电影海报，用于一部虚构的赛博朋克科幻电影，采用竖版单张构图。画面中心是一位年轻的动漫少女，站在夜晚废弃的霓虹小巷中，头顶是一轮巨大的发光满月。她面色苍白，表情忧郁而严肃，有着明亮的洋红色发光双眼，留着青色渐变至蓝色的短发，扎着凌乱的双麻花辫，配有细碎的刘海和发光的高光。她身穿深色、受未来主义校服启发的服装：修身黑色上衣、百褶裙、带有枪套和悬挂装置的战术腰带、一件袖口带有徽章补丁的宽松开衫，颈部戴着高科技发光项圈或耳机。她的一只手臂明显是赛博格义肢，露出机械结构，透明面板中透出粉色的能量光芒。她的胸前有一个圆形的霓虹核心装置，散发着粉色光芒。环境充斥着全息屏幕、破碎的招牌、电缆、碎片、火花以及漂浮的粉蓝色微粒，高耸的深色建筑环绕着她，月光从她脑后投射出强烈的轮廓光。使用深靛蓝、紫、黑、青和亮粉色的忧郁色调，呈现超精细的绘画感动漫渲染、光泽反射、电影级对比度、体积光、漂浮的残骸以及令人难忘的未来主义氛围。将日文海报排版融入艺术作品中：右侧是一行白色的高大竖排标语，其中一个关键短语以粉色高亮显示；左上方是 3 段堆叠的日文获奖评语，每段都由月桂花环框起；中下方标题上方有一行小字日文；中央是巨大的白色汉字标题 {argument name="main title" default="未来×回线"}，中间带有一个发光的粉色 X；正下方是罗马拼音副标题 {argument name="romanized title" default="MIRAI KAISEN"}；再下方是一行粉色的日文副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="—终焉之代码—"}；底部中央是一句日文宣传语，其中一个词以粉色高亮；右下角是醒目的影院上映日期 {argument name="release date" default="7.18"}，下方附有小字 [FRI] 和 ROADSHOW；底部边缘印有细小的制作人员名单和版权信息。整体呈现出高端原创动画长片海报的质感，情感强烈、制作精良且具有获奖作品的风格。

templates.title: Cyberpunk character status interface

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克角色状态界面

templates.prompt: A futuristic surveillance screen with a cinematic, anime-style aesthetic displays a full-body image of a young man standing in the center of a dark industrial corridor. The slightly elevated angle suggests he's being captured by a surveillance camera. Tall, lean, and muscular, with messy, short, silver-gray hair and pale skin, he exudes a cold and dangerous aura. He wears a black sleeveless turtleneck, black tactical trousers with straps and side pockets, a black belt with chain details, heavy black tactical boots, and a black jacket that has slipped off his shoulders. His expression is serious and inscrutable, surrounded by glowing scanning frames, as if locked onto a target in real time. The overall effect is a high-tech HUD overlay, using blue-gray and black tones, accented with subtle cyan interface lines, screen noise, and scan lines, creating a cyberpunk thriller atmosphere. The layout around the character includes 10 different UI panels: a top-left recording bar with a red REC indicator, timestamp, camera code, location, and video specifications; a top-left identification panel labeled "Observation Target," containing key data such as the codename Raven and ID; a center-left warning panel labeled "Important Person," displaying risk level A and other threat notes; a bottom-left basic information panel labeled "Basic Information," listing name, age, height, date of birth, occupation, personality, likes, and dislikes; a bottom-left vital signs monitoring panel labeled "Vessel Monitor," containing two waveform graphs and digital readings of heart rate, body temperature, and stress; a bottom-left action log panel labeled "Action Log," containing 6 timestamped records; and a large top-right facial recognition panel labeled "Facial Recognition Mode," displaying a magnified cropped image of the person and RAVEN. The system displays the matching results, a 99.7% accuracy progress bar, and a verified status; a right-center identification details panel labeled "Identification Information," including ID, code, unknown affiliation, and a short note; a bottom-right target analysis panel labeled "Target Analysis," containing a wireframe human model and various statistical data, including height, weight, body fat, muscle mass, combat strength, mobility, intelligence, danger level, and a large overall rating of A+; a bottom-right current location panel labeled "Current Location," including a small floor plan, a glowing location point, and the camera tag CAM-07. A tracking progress bar displaying "TRACKING..." with a progress of 97.6% is added to the bottom center; a monitoring memo box labeled "Monitoring Memo" is added to the bottom left corner, containing three brief key points; and a barcode with the code RX-0417-17 / TOP PRIORITY is added to the bottom. The upper right corner contains small system text such as SYSTEM ONLINE and SECURE LINK : OK. The entire interface uses Japanese text, clear thin-lined sci-fi borders, layered transparent screens, and realistic character lighting, presenting exquisite GPT-Image-2 anime illustration quality, as if it were a character codenamed {argument name="character name" default="Raven"} A classified character status display interface created by secret agents.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影级动漫风格的未来感监控状态屏幕，展示了一名站在黑暗工业走廊中央的年轻男子全身像，视角略高，仿佛被监控摄像头捕捉。他身材高挑、精瘦且健壮，留着凌乱的银灰色短发，皮肤苍白，散发着冷峻危险的气息。他身穿黑色无袖高领衫、带有绑带和侧袋的黑色战术长裤、系着挂链细节的黑色腰带，脚蹬厚重的黑色战术靴，肩上披着一件滑落的黑色夹克。他表情严肃且难以捉摸，面部周围环绕着发光的扫描框，如同实时目标锁定。整体画面呈现为高科技 HUD 档案叠加效果，采用蓝灰色与黑色调，配以微妙的青色界面线条、屏幕噪点、扫描线，营造出赛博朋克惊悚片的氛围。布局在角色周围包含 10 个不同的 UI 面板：1 个左上角录制条，带有红色 REC 指示灯、时间戳、摄像机代码、位置和视频规格；1 个左上方识别面板，标注为“観察対象”，包含代号 Raven 和 ID 等主体数据；1 个左侧中部警告面板，标注为“重要人物”，显示风险等级 A 及其他威胁备注；1 个左侧下部基本资料面板，标注为“基本情報”，列出姓名、年龄、身高、出生日期、职业、性格、喜好和厌恶；1 个左下角生命体征监测面板，标注为“バイタルモニタ”，包含 2 个波形图以及心率、体温和压力的数字读数；1 个左下侧行动日志面板，标注为“行動ログ”，包含 6 条带时间戳的记录；1 个右上角大型面部识别面板，标注为“顔認識ズーム”，显示 1 个放大的人像裁剪图、RAVEN 的匹配结果、99.7% 的准确率进度条以及已验证状态；1 个右侧中部识别详情面板，标注为“識別情報”，包含 ID、代号、所属不明及一段备注；1 个右下角目标分析面板，标注为“ターゲット分析”，包含 1 个线框人体模型及多项统计数据，包括身高、体重、体脂、肌肉量、战斗力、机动性、智力、危险等级及一个巨大的综合评价 A+；1 个右下角当前位置面板，标注为“現在位置”，包含 1 个平面图小地图、一个发光的位置点及摄像机标签 CAM-07。底部中央添加一个显示“TRACKING...”且进度为 97.6% 的追踪进度条，左下角添加一个标注为“監視メモ”的监控备忘录框，内含 3 条简短的要点式备注，底部添加一条带有代码 RX-0417-17 / TOP PRIORITY 的条形码。右上角包含诸如 SYSTEM ONLINE 和 SECURE LINK : OK 等小型系统文本。整个界面使用日文文本、清晰的细线科幻边框、分层透明屏幕，角色光影写实，呈现出精致的 gpt-image-2 动漫插画质量，如同为一名代号为 {argument name="character name" default="Raven"} 的秘密特工制作的机密角色状态显示界面。

He is centered, arms crossed, body slightly turned to one side, gazing out of the frame. His face is deliberately obscured by a soft, rectangular blur. He has neatly trimmed, thick, dark brown hair combed back. He wears a fitted top {argument name="jacket color" default="Navy Blue"} A zip-up knit jacket, layered over a dark turtleneck sweater in the same color family, paired with a silver watch with a light-colored dial, and a tailored bottom.{argument name="pants color" default="White"} Trousers. Two cars are parked on the roadside behind him: a silver hatchback on the left and a black SUV with a rear-mounted spare tire on the right. The composition is vertical, presenting a fashion magazine style, with a shallow depth of field, a sharp focus on the subject, and a softly blurred background of vehicles and buildings. The lighting is soft, natural sunlight under overcast skies, with a calm tone and realistic skin and fabric textures, showcasing a sophisticated and luxurious menswear style, a clean urban atmosphere, and a high-end lifestyle photographic aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张照片级写实的全景街头肖像，一位时尚的年轻男子站在城市人行道上，背景是一座宏伟的历史石建筑，带有高大的立柱、拱形窗户和古典建筑细节。他位于画面中心，双臂交叉站立，身体略微侧向一边，目光看向镜头外。他的面部经过柔和的矩形模糊处理，刻意遮挡。他留着修剪整齐的深棕色头发，发量浓密且向后梳理。他身穿一件修身的 {argument name="jacket color" default="海军蓝"} 拉链针织夹克，内搭同色系深色高领毛衣，佩戴一块浅色表盘的银色腕表，下身穿着干练的 {argument name="pants color" default="白色"} 长裤。他身后的路边停放着 2 辆车：左侧是一辆银色掀背车，右侧是一辆带有后挂式备胎的黑色越野 SUV。构图为竖构图，呈现时尚杂志风格，景深较浅，人物焦点清晰，车辆和建筑背景呈现柔和的虚化效果。光线为阴天下的柔和自然日光，色调沉稳，皮肤和织物纹理真实，展现出精致的奢华男装风格、干净的城市氛围以及高端生活方式摄影美学。

templates.title: Isometric Fantasy RPG Market Bug Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 等距视角奇幻 RPG 市场 Bug 场景

templates.prompt: A screenshot from a top-down, isometric perspective of a fantasy RPG game, set in a quaint medieval market street with a strong tilt-shift depth of field effect, making the scene look like a miniature model. In the foreground, a petite, chibi-style anime-inspired adventure girl faces a stall; she has {argument name="hair color" default="Medium brown"} She has twin ponytails adorned with blue ribbons, large round eyes, and a blue pacifier in her mouth. She wears a delicately detailed blue and white lace-trimmed dress with puff sleeves, white stockings, and dark shoes, with a small brown bag hanging from her waist. She is positioned slightly to the left of center in the image, looking up at a male shopkeeper leaning over a long wooden counter covered with a dark green tablecloth. The shopkeeper wears a white tie-front shirt with rolled-up cuffs and a brown vest, but his face is unnaturally blurred, smeared, or missing features, like a rendering bug. The stall is filled with props: two wicker baskets of produce, two cloth bags, a loaf of bread on the counter, a folded map or piece of paper, a framed blackboard sign, two reddish-brown ceramic bottles or jars, stacked wooden crates, wooden beams, and a hanging shop sign with a round cup design. In the background, a blurred woman in a long dress walks on a cobblestone street, with the outline of a carriage or wagon faintly visible to the left, in soft focus. The lighting is warm afternoon sunlight, casting dappled shadows on the cobblestone streets and stalls. It includes a complete game UI overlay: the top left corner displays the Japanese quest text "冒険し、情報を集めよう" (Break through various places, gather information); the bottom left corner features a circular minimap and two adjacent small icons; the bottom center is the status bar, displaying "Lv.12" and "1286/1286" as well as a green HP bar; the right center features an interaction tooltip, including a speech bubble icon, the Japanese text "話す" (Hahsu), and an "A" button icon; the bottom right corner has four circular action buttons, including a large blue sword attack button and three smaller skill buttons around it. The overall atmosphere should present a highly detailed JRPG town scene, warm and painterly, but one eerie, distorted face makes the image look like a game screenshot with a ghostly bug.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张俯视等距视角的奇幻 RPG 游戏截图，背景设定在古朴的中世纪市场街道，带有强烈的移轴景深效果，使场景看起来像微缩模型。前景中，一位娇小的 Q 版动漫风格冒险少女正面对着一个摊位；她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="中棕色"} 的双马尾，饰有蓝色丝带，有着圆圆的大眼睛，嘴里叼着蓝色奶嘴，身穿细节精致的蓝白相间蕾丝边连衣裙，配有泡泡袖、白丝袜、深色鞋子，腰间挂着一个小棕色小包。她位于画面中心偏左，抬头看着一位俯身在铺着暗绿色桌布的长木柜台后的男性店主。店主穿着白色系带衬衫，袖口卷起，外搭棕色背心，但他的脸部呈现出不自然的模糊、涂抹状或五官缺失，如同渲染 Bug 一般。摊位上摆满了道具：2 个柳条筐装的农产品、2 个布袋、柜台上放着 1 条面包、1 张折叠的地图或纸张、1 个带框的小黑板招牌、2 个红棕色调的陶瓷瓶或罐子、堆叠的木箱、木梁以及一个挂着的圆形杯子图案店铺招牌。背景中，1 位穿着长裙的模糊女性走在鹅卵石街道上，左侧隐约可见一辆马车或货车的轮廓，处于柔焦状态。光线为温暖的午后阳光，在石板路和摊位上投下斑驳的阴影。包含完整的游戏 UI 覆盖层：左上角显示日语任务文本“各地を冒険し、情報を集めよう”，左下角为圆形小地图及 2 个相邻的小图标，底部中心为状态栏，显示“Lv.12”和“1286/1286”以及绿色 HP 条，右侧中心为交互提示，包含一个对话气泡图标和日语文本“話す”以及一个“A”按钮图标，右下角为 4 个圆形动作按钮，包括 1 个大的蓝色剑术攻击按钮和周围 3 个较小的技能按钮。整体氛围应呈现出高细节的 JRPG 城镇场景，温馨且具有绘画感，但其中一个诡异的崩坏面部使图像看起来像是一张带有幽灵般 Bug 的游戏截图。

She faces the viewer, holding a handmade white sign with large, rounded pink lettering that reads:{argument name="sign text" default="3,500 フォロワー ありがとう♡"} It was decorated with small cherry blossoms, hearts, and tiny confetti-like markings. The girl kept it.{argument name="hair color" default="medium brown"} Her hair was tied in high pigtails with pink ribbons, and she had bangs with slightly curled ends. She was wearing a {argument name="sweater color" default="pastel pink"} She wore an oversized off-the-shoulder knit top, revealing a thin strap on one shoulder, paired with a white short pleated skirt with soft ruffles at the hem, and a delicate necklace. Her pose was gentle and symmetrical, her hands holding the left and right edges of the sign. The background was a sun-drenched cherry blossom avenue, with two benches visible on the right and a vintage streetlamp on the left, petals falling from the air and scattering on the ground. The use of warm backlighting, soft lighting effects, shallow depth of field, pastel and cream tones, a romantic seasonal atmosphere, highly detailed anime rendering, delicate lines, glossy hair highlights, and subtle fabric folds created an atmosphere celebrating social media gratitude.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张柔和梦幻的动漫插画，描绘了一位可爱的少女站在公园小径中央，四周是盛开的樱花树，尽显春意。她面向观众，胸前拿着一块手工制作的白色标语牌，上面用圆润的粉色大字写着 {argument name="sign text" default="3,500 フォロワー ありがとう♡"}，并装饰着小樱花、爱心和细小的纸屑状标记。女孩留着 {argument name="hair color" default="medium brown"} 的头发，扎成高双马尾，系着粉色丝带，留着齐刘海，发梢微卷。她的脸部刻意留白，呈现为一个平滑、有阴影的肤色椭圆形，没有眼睛、鼻子或嘴巴。她穿着一件 {argument name="sweater color" default="pastel pink"} 的超大号露肩针织衫，一侧肩膀露出细细的吊带，下身穿着白色短款百褶裙，裙摆有柔软的荷叶边，并佩戴着一条精致的小项链。她的姿势温柔对称，双手握住标语牌的左右边缘。背景是阳光明媚的樱花大道，右侧可见 2 张长椅，左侧有一盏复古路灯，花瓣在空中飘落并散落在地面上。使用温暖的逆光、柔和的柔光效果、浅景深、粉彩和奶油色调、浪漫的季节氛围、高度精细的动漫渲染、精致的线条、光泽的发丝高光、细腻的布料褶皱，营造出庆祝社交媒体感谢的氛围。

templates.title: Fantasy Guild Receptionist Novel Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 奇幻公会接待员小说封面

templates.prompt: An exquisitely designed anime-style fantasy light novel cover illustration, in a square composition, depicts a beautiful adult female guild receptionist in half-length portrait against the backdrop of an elegant adventurers' guild interior. She stands slightly to the right behind a wooden counter, facing forward, her posture calm and professional, one hand lightly holding a black and gold fountain pen near her shoulder. Her face is deliberately obscured by a centrally located beige rectangular octagonal hood. She is designed as {argument name="character name" default="リリアン・ヴェイル"} 27 years old, possess{argument name="hair color" default="Light gold"} Her hair was styled into an elegant updo, with soft bangs framing her face. She wore a custom-made dark brown turtleneck jacket adorned with ornate gold floral embroidery, layered over a green vest and a white ruffled blouse. A single, visible turquoise teardrop-shaped earring added to the look. The overall atmosphere was dignified, intellectual, and reliable. The background was a warmly lit, luxurious guild office, complete with dark carved wood trim, blurred heraldic plaques on the walls, framed documents, desk lamps, flowers, and soft gold dappled light, creating a high-end, fantastical workplace atmosphere. The top featured three lines of Japanese headings: the first line was a smaller heading, “《冒険者ギルドのお仕事ファンタジー》”, and the second line was a larger main heading, “鉄の受付嬢”.{argument name="highlighted name text" default="リリアン"} The name is highlighted in emerald green, the rest is black, and the third line is the subtitle "~冒険は、窓口から始まります~". At the bottom is a gorgeous dark brown and gold nameplate containing three lines of text:{argument name="nameplate text" default="リリアン・ヴェイル"} "Adventurer Guild Attendant (27 years old)", "Ding Ning, Zheng Qu, Jing Leng - That's my job." The book features exquisite Japanese book cover layout, decorative patterns, soft cinematic lighting, subtle depth of field, luxurious texture, and high-end fantasy novel cover composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的动漫风格奇幻轻小说封面插图，方形构图，展示了一位美丽的成年女性公会接待员，半身像，背景为优雅的冒险者公会内部。她站在木质柜台后方偏右的位置，面向前方，姿态冷静而专业，一只手轻握一支黑金配色的钢笔靠近肩部。她的面部被一个居中的米色长方形遮挡块刻意遮盖。她设定为 {argument name="character name" default="リリアン・ヴェイル"}，27 岁，拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="浅金色"} 的头发，梳成精致的盘发，柔和的刘海修饰脸型。她身穿深棕色定制高领夹克，饰有华丽的金色花卉刺绣，内搭绿色马甲和白色荷叶边衬衫。增加一只可见的青色宝石水滴状耳环。整体氛围庄重、知性且可靠。背景是光线温暖、奢华的公会办公室，配有深色雕花木饰、墙上模糊的纹章牌、装裱的文件、台灯、鲜花和柔和的金色光斑，营造出高端奇幻职场氛围。顶部包含 3 行日文标题排版：第一行是小型标题“《冒険者ギルドのお仕事ファンタジー》”，第二行是大型主标题“鉄の受付嬢 {argument name="highlighted name text" default="リリアン"} のプロの流儀”，其中高亮名称为翡翠绿色，其余为黑色，第三行是副标题“〜冒険は、窓口から始まります〜”。底部添加一个华丽的深棕色配金色名牌，包含 3 行文字：“{argument name="nameplate text" default="リリアン・ヴェイル"}”、“冒険者ギルド受付嬢 (27歳)”、“丁寧・正確・冷静 —— それが、私の仕事です。”。采用精致的日式书籍封面排版、装饰性花纹、柔和的电影级灯光、细腻的景深、奢华的质感以及高级的奇幻小说封面构图。

templates.title: Cute hand-drawn style personal profile poster

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱手绘风个人简介海报

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, transform the X/Twitter profile screenshot into a cute hand-drawn Japanese-style infographic poster summarizing the account's personal brand and services. Maintain the original character, feminine pink color scheme, AI/Udemy theme, cat elements, and the key achievement "140 students." Replace the original screenshot UI with an illustration-style flyer with a clean white background, featuring soft pink doodle borders, hearts, glitter, and sticky note style. Redraw the character in the top left corner as a friendly manga-style portrait, while retaining the small chibi-style companion from the reference image. Add a striking handwritten title (including the account name) and a subtitle about "Making Complex AI Simple, Helping Beginners Go from 0 to 1." The content is divided into seven clear sections: 1) a top heading area with short label stickers; 2) a self-introduction memo card; 3) a personal introduction in the form of a dialogue box; 4) "Target Audience" (containing 4 key points); 5) "Solvable Problems" (containing 4 key points); 6) "Core Values" (containing 4 key points); and 7) "Achievements and Strengths" (containing 4 key points). Additionally, a small notebook-style motivational quote card is added near the center of the bottom, and a cute cat illustration with a name tag is added in the lower right corner. A striking closing statement is added across the bottom, expressing "AI supports everyone who strives." The entire text is in Japanese, using a clear and legible handwritten font, warm and soft colors, and a beautiful layout suitable for social media sharing, making it both approachable and beginner-friendly.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图，将 X/Twitter 个人资料截图转化为一张可爱的手绘日式信息图海报，总结该账号的个人品牌及服务内容。保持原有的人物形象、粉色女性化色调、AI/Udemy 主题、猫咪元素以及“140 名学员”这一关键成就；将原本的截图 UI 替换为一张插画风格的单页传单，背景为简洁的白色，配以柔和的粉色涂鸦边框、爱心、闪光点及便利贴风格。在左上角将人物重绘为亲切的漫画风格肖像，并保留参考图中的小型 Q 版伙伴。添加一个醒目的手写标题（包含账号名称）以及一个副标题，内容关于“让复杂的 AI 变得简单，帮助初学者从 0 到 1”。将内容分为 7 个清晰的板块：1) 带有短标签贴纸的顶部标题区；2) 自我介绍备忘卡；3) 对话框形式的个人简介；4) “适合人群”（包含 4 个要点）；5) “可解决的问题”（包含 4 个要点）；6) “核心价值”（包含 4 个要点）；7) “成就与优势”（包含 4 个要点）。此外，在底部中心附近添加一张小型笔记本风格的励志语录卡，并在右下角添加一只带有姓名标签的可爱猫咪插画。在底部横跨添加一句醒目的结束语，表达“AI 支持每一位努力奋斗的人”。全文保留日语，使用清晰易读的手写字体、温暖的柔和色调，并采用适合社交媒体传播的精美排版，使其看起来既亲切实用，又对初学者友好。

templates.title: Fantasy Q-version wedding collage

titleLocalized.zh: 奇幻 Q 版婚礼拼贴画

templates.prompt: A dreamlike, fantastical wedding collage, crafted in soft pastel tones and a highly detailed anime/game art style. The image depicts a chibi-style newlywed couple, resembling Lalafells, nestled within a magnificent church, surrounded by warm bokeh, pale blue and pink hues, flowers, and falling pink petals. At the center of the image is a close-up of the bride and groom leaning towards each other, preparing for a kiss; the bride is on the left, the groom on the right. The bride is a chibi-style fantasy character with pointed ears, short dark brown hair, and a round face with a soft blush. She wears a large white floral headdress composed of two white roses, small white flowers, and green leaves, with a long white veil flowing behind her. She wears an elegant long-sleeved white lace wedding dress with delicate embroidery and a rhinestone-studded neckline. The groom is also depicted as a chibi-style fantasy character with pointed ears, short, choppy brown hair adorned with white lilies, and red tassel earrings. He wears a white formal wedding suit with delicately tailored layers, and a boutonniere with green leaves and white flowers. Around the main kissing scene are three tilted, inset photos with cream-colored borders: the upper left is a portrait of the groom extending his hand to the audience; the upper right is a portrait of the bride showing her hand and ring; and below is a photo of the couple sitting together outdoors in soft sunlight. The images are interspersed with ornate gold swirling decorative lines and shimmering lights, with a cluster of pale cream and pink roses in the lower right foreground. The background is the opulent interior of a church, complete with chandeliers, candles, soft floral arrangements, and a bright pastel mist. The overall style is romantic, ethereal, exquisite, and full of warmth, presenting a luxurious wedding album feel, and employing a vertical composition suitable for smartphone viewing.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张梦幻般的奇幻婚礼拼贴画，采用柔和的粉彩色调和高细节的动漫游戏艺术风格。画面中，两位类似拉拉肥（lalafell）的 Q 版新婚夫妇身处华丽的教堂内，周围环绕着温暖的焦外成像光斑、淡蓝色与淡粉色的色调、鲜花以及飘落的粉色花瓣。画面中心是新郎新娘侧身靠近准备亲吻的特写，新娘在左，新郎在右。新娘是一位拥有尖耳朵的 Q 版奇幻角色，留着深棕色短发，圆润的脸颊带着淡淡的红晕，头戴由 2 朵白玫瑰、小白花和绿叶组成的白色大花饰，身后飘着长长的白色头纱。她身穿优雅的长袖白色蕾丝婚纱，配有精致的刺绣和镶钻领口。新郎也是一位拥有尖耳朵的 Q 版奇幻角色，留着棕色短碎发，发间插着白色百合花，佩戴红色流苏耳环；他身穿白色正式婚服，剪裁层次细腻，胸前别着绿叶白花胸花。在亲吻主场景周围，有 3 张带有奶油色边框的倾斜嵌入式照片：左上方是新郎向观众伸手的肖像，右上方是新娘展示手部并露出戒指的肖像，下方是一张两人在柔和阳光下户外并坐的双人照。画面中穿插着华丽的金色漩涡装饰线条和闪烁的光点，右下角前景处有一束淡奶油色和粉色的玫瑰花簇。背景是富丽堂皇的教堂内部，配有吊灯、蜡烛、柔和的花艺布置和明亮的粉彩薄雾。整体风格浪漫、空灵、精致且充满温情，呈现出奢华的婚礼相册质感，并采用适合智能手机浏览的竖版构图。

templates.title: The female lead in a martial arts movie on a mountain terrace

titleLocalized.zh: 山间露台上的武侠电影感女主角

templates.prompt: A highly realistic, cinematic CG portrait depicts an elegant young Chinese martial arts heroine standing on a traditional wooden terrace, overlooking the blue-grey mountains shrouded in dawn mist. The mid-range composition places the figure slightly to the right of the frame, her posture dignified and upright, her hands gently clasped at her waist. She wears a magnificent black silk Hanfu-style robe with deep red piping and lining, wide, flowing sleeves, and a large golden dragon embroidered on the chest, adorned with cloud patterns. The skirt and cuffs feature exquisite embroidery details. Her hairstyle is an elegant ancient-style updo, adorned with a set of decorative floral hairpins and two long tassel pendants, and she wears delicate bracelets and pendant earrings. The scene includes a curved wooden bench beside the terrace railing, two sturdy wooden pillars, a carved wooden screen, and a lacquered wooden side table with a guqin (a traditional Chinese stringed instrument) placed on it. Soft, warm morning light streams in from the left, creating gentle highlights on the silk fabrics and wood, while distant mountains are shrouded in a light morning mist. The design emphasizes ultra-fine fabric textures, polished wood, elegant classical Chinese architecture, a tranquil and noble atmosphere, shallow depth of field, realistic skin and clothing rendering, and the aesthetic quality of a high-end historical drama.{argument name="camera framing" default="Medium full-body portrait"} ,{argument name="outfit color" default="Black and dark red"} ,{argument name="embroidery subject" default="Golden dragon and cloud patterns"} ,{argument name="time of day" default="sunrise"} as well as{argument name="background setting" default="Mountain terrace shrouded in mist"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度写实的电影感 CG 肖像，描绘了一位优雅的中国年轻武侠女主角，她站在传统的木制露台上，俯瞰着黎明时分云雾缭绕的蓝灰色山脉。画面采用中景构图，人物略微偏向画面右侧，姿态端庄挺拔，双手轻轻交叠于腰间。她身着华丽的黑色丝绸汉服风格长袍，配有深红色滚边和内衬，袖口宽大飘逸，胸前绣有 1 个巨大的金色龙纹图案，并饰有云纹，裙摆和袖口处均有精致的刺绣细节。她的发型是精致的古风盘发，配有 1 组装饰性花卉发簪和 2 个长流苏挂饰，佩戴着精致的手镯和吊坠耳环。场景包括露台栏杆旁 1 张弧形木凳、2 根粗壮的木柱、1 扇雕花木屏风，以及 1 张摆放着古琴的漆木边桌。柔和的暖色晨光从左侧射入，在丝绸面料和木材上形成柔和的高光，远处的山峦则笼罩在淡淡的晨雾中。强调超精细的面料纹理、抛光的木材、优雅的中国古典建筑、宁静高贵的氛围、浅景深、逼真的皮肤与服装渲染，以及高级历史剧的美学质感。使用 {argument name="camera framing" default="中景全身肖像"}、{argument name="outfit color" default="黑色与深红色"}、{argument name="embroidery subject" default="金色龙纹与云纹"}、{argument name="time of day" default="日出"} 以及 {argument name="background setting" default="云雾缭绕的山间露台"}。

templates.title: Pastel anime-style nail technician at the desk

titleLocalized.zh: 书桌前的粉彩动漫风美甲师

templates.prompt: A soft, pastel-style illustration depicts a young woman creating nail art at a comfortable desk in a sunny bedroom studio. She sits at a wooden table, leaning slightly to the left, with shoulder-length wavy hair of [color missing].{argument name="hair color" default="Light gray-brown"} She had bangs and a gentle, refined appearance. Her face was partially obscured by a centrally located, blurred square, but her posture was clearly visible: she held a small artificial nail tip in one hand and a fine liner brush in the other, meticulously drawing her nails. She wore a loose-fitting top.{argument name="cardigan color" default="light purple"} She wears a cardigan over a light cream-colored top. The scene is warm, airy, and feminine, with a watercolor-like texture and delicate lines, as soft, natural morning light streams in through the window. On the table are seven bottles of pinkish-purple nail polish, four nail art tools placed horizontally, eight nail art samples arranged on a white work mat, two miniature glitter or gel jars in the center, two cosmetic jars stacked beside her, a white UV/LED nail lamp emitting a pale blue glow on the left, and a stack of round cotton pads on the right. Behind her is a neatly arranged creative workspace: bookshelves hold books and storage boxes, two potted plants and a small picture frame sit on the left windowsill, two small potted plants are in the right window area, and pale purple-red curtains hang. In the background is a neatly made bed with blush-pink pillows. The scene includes a wooden chair, a shelf of books neatly arranged under the table, and a small display card showcasing five pink and purple nail art designs in the foreground. Adopting a dreamy, girly manga illustration aesthetic, the composition is simple, the color tone is soft pink-beige-lilac, and the hair has a soft highlight, creating a tranquil, handmade lifestyle atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张柔和的粉彩动漫风格插画，描绘了一位年轻女性在阳光明媚的卧室工作室里，于舒适的书桌前进行美甲创作。她坐在木桌旁，身体微向左侧，留着齐肩波浪卷发，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="浅灰棕色"}，留着齐刘海，外表温柔精致。她的面部被一个居中的方形模糊块遮挡，但其余姿势清晰可见：她一手拿着一个小巧的人造甲片，另一手拿着一支精细的勾线笔，正在仔细描绘。她身穿一件宽松的 {argument name="cardigan color" default="淡紫色"} 开衫，内搭浅奶油色上衣。场景温暖、通透且充满女性气息，带有水彩般的质感、细腻的线条，柔和的自然晨光透过窗户洒入。桌上整齐摆放着 7 瓶粉紫色调的指甲油、4 件横向放置的美甲工具、8 个排列在白色工作垫上的美甲样品、2 个位于中心前方的微型亮片或凝胶罐、2 个叠放在她手边的化妆品罐、1 台左侧发出淡蓝色微光的白色 UV/LED 美甲灯，以及右侧一叠圆形化妆棉。她身后是一个布置整洁的创意工作区：书架上放着书籍和收纳盒，左侧窗台上摆放着 2 盆盆栽和 1 个小型相框，右侧窗户区域有 2 盆小盆栽，挂着淡紫红色的窗帘，背景中是一张铺设整齐、放着腮红粉色枕头的床。画面包含一把木椅、桌下整齐摆放书籍的搁架，以及右前方一张展示着 5 款粉粉色和紫色美甲设计的小展示卡。采用梦幻的少女漫插画美学，构图简洁，色调为柔和的粉-米-丁香色，头发带有柔和的高光，营造出一种宁静的手工生活氛围。

templates.title: Cute Feng Shui Cloud Vegetable (mozuku) Making Guide Infographic

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱风水云菜（mozuku）制作指南信息图

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image of washed water spinach on its packaging, transform it into a cute Japanese recipe infographic poster teaching how to properly consume it. Ensure product recognition by displaying a photo of the packaging near the top and reuse the water spinach itself in small food/processing photos, but redesign all other elements with a bright, clean blue-pink editorial layout. Add a cheerful anime catgirl guide character with pink hair and cat ears who appears multiple times as an instructor. Create a striking Japanese title at the top: “洗いもずくを美味しく食べる手顺书” (Washing Water Spinach to Make It Delicious Handbook), and add a staff nameplate that reads “作业者：きらりあ・ネオン” (Worker: Kiraria Neon). Construct a 6-step vertical instruction flow on the left/center, connected using numbered circles from 1 to 6 and arrows. The 6 steps should be titled: 1 "Status Confirmation", 2 "Light Washing", 3 "Cutting Water", 4 "Cut with Kitchen Scissors", 5 "Adding Seasoning", 6 "Serving and Finishing". For each step, include a brief Japanese description and a supporting image/illustration showing the water spinach at that stage; specifically, include 1 image of packaging/close-up status confirmation, 1 image of rinsing in a strainer, 1 image of draining in a strainer, 1 image of cutting with kitchen scissors, 3 mini boxes for seasoning options below step 5, and 1 image of the finished dish served in a bowl below step 6. Add the title "おすすめtool" to the right panel to display 7 vignettes with labels: きゅうり, long taro, オクラ, みょうが, daye, しらす, and tofu. Add another recommendation panel on the right, titled "ネオンちゃんおすすめ", containing 2 cards marked A and B The menu cards: A "もずく酢きゅうり" and B "もずくスープ", each card comes with a picture of the bowl and a Japanese ingredient list. Add a "Note" box in the bottom right corner with three key points: "I don't want to wash it," "Cut the water vapor," and "Eat it as soon as you open it." Add a friendly Japanese footer banner at the bottom to encourage everyone to enjoy water spinach. The overall design is a highly readable supermarket flyer/cooking guide infographic, featuring rounded borders, glossy finishes, a clear hierarchical structure, and a vibrant, cute style.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的包装洗净水云菜参考图片，将其转换为一张可爱的日式食谱信息图海报，教授如何正确食用。通过在顶部附近展示包装照片来确保产品可辨识，并在小型食物/处理过程照片中重复使用水云菜本身，但将其他所有元素重新设计为明亮、整洁的蓝粉色编辑布局。添加一名开朗的动漫猫娘引导角色，她拥有粉色头发和猫耳，多次以指导员身份出现。在顶部创建一个醒目的日文标题：「洗いもずくを 美味しく食べる手順書」，并添加一个写有「作業者：きらりあ・ネオン」的工作人员名牌。在左侧/中间构建一个 6 步垂直指令流程，使用 1 到 6 的数字圆圈和箭头连接。6 个步骤标题应为：1「状態確認」、2「軽く水洗い」、3「水気を切る」、4「食べやすくカット」、5「味付け」、6「盛り付けて完成」。对于每个步骤，包含简短的日文说明和一张支持性的图片/插图，展示该阶段的水云菜；具体包括 1 张包装/特写状态确认图、1 张在滤网中冲洗的图片、1 张滤网沥水图、1 张用厨房剪刀剪切的图片、步骤 5 下方的 3 个调味选项迷你框，以及步骤 6 下方的 1 张成品碗装图。在右侧面板添加标题「おすすめ具材」，展示 7 种带有标签的小插图食材：きゅうり、長芋、オクラ、みょうが、大葉、しらす、豆腐。在右侧添加另一个推荐面板，标题为「ネオンちゃんおすすめ」，包含 2 张标记为 A 和 B 的菜品卡片：A「もずく酢きゅうり」和 B「もずくスープ」，每张卡片配有碗装图片和日文配料表。在右下角添加一个标题为「注意」的注意事项框，包含 3 个要点：「洗いすぎない」、「水気をしっかり切る」、「開封後は早めに食べる」。在底部添加一个友好的日文页脚横幅，鼓励大家享用水云菜。整体风格设计为易读性高的超市传单/烹饪指南信息图，采用圆角边框、光泽装饰、清晰的层级结构和充满活力的可爱风格。

templates.title: Partial illustration of the Petrified Knight card

titleLocalized.zh: 局部石化骑士卡牌插画

templates.prompt: A highly dramatic dark fantasy anime illustration depicting{argument name="character name" default="A blonde female knight king"} Kneeling in the center of the abandoned stone chamber, her body is undergoing partial petrification. She wears magnificent blue-silver royal armor, over which lies a deep cobalt blue long skirt and a white multi-layered petticoat, adorned with a silver breastplate and gold trim, resembling a legendary paladin. Her golden hair is tied back with a large, deep blue ribbon, featuring braided details and loose bangs. The composition employs a slightly overhead, full-body perspective, centered and symmetrical, with the character kneeling on the floor marked by circular cracked stone imprints. Her arms, legs, and the surrounding serpentine restraints are transforming into shattered gray rock, accompanied by clear cracks, fragments, dust, and flying debris. Huge, broken shackles and heavy chains bind her wrists and ankles; four sets of chains are visible, two attached to her arms and two to her legs. Around her, four serpentine stone forms meander from the ruined floor and pillars, encircling the scene like cursed shackles. The petrification is not yet complete: her torso, armor, long dress, and hair remain intact and in human form, while her limbs have been severely transformed into broken, marble-like rock with a rough texture and glowing cracks. The environment is a dark, abandoned temple, filled with broken pillars and scattered rubble, with subtle golden highlights on the floor patterns accentuated by cool, dim lighting. The overall atmosphere is tragic, awe-inspiring, and mythological, rendered with cinematic high detail, clear textures, dynamic debris, and dramatic shadows, presenting a refined quality reminiscent of anime and game card illustrations.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的黑暗奇幻动漫插画，描绘了 {argument name="character name" default="一位金发女骑士王"} 跪在废弃石室中央，身体正在经历局部石化。她身穿华丽的蓝银色皇家铠甲，内搭深钴蓝色长裙和白色多层衬裙，配有银色胸甲和金色饰边，造型如同传说中的圣骑士。她的金发用一条巨大的深蓝色丝带扎在脑后，带有编发细节和散落的刘海。构图采用略微俯视的全身视角，居中且对称，角色跪在圆形裂纹石质印记的地板上。她的双臂、双腿以及周围蛇形的束缚物正在转化为破碎的灰色岩石，伴随着清晰的裂纹、碎块、灰尘和向外飞溅的碎屑。巨大的断裂镣铐和沉重的锁链束缚着她的手腕和脚踝；可见 4 组锁链，其中 2 组连接在手臂上，2 组连接在腿上。在她周围，4 条蛇状的石质形态从废墟地面和柱子中蜿蜒而起，如同被诅咒的枷锁般环绕着场景。石化尚未完成：她的躯干铠甲、长裙和头发依然保持人类形态且完好无损，而四肢已严重转化为带有粗糙质感和发光裂纹线的破碎大理石状岩石。环境是一个黑暗的废弃圣殿，布满破碎的柱子、散落的瓦砾，冷色调的暗光中点缀着地板图案上微妙的金色高光。整体氛围悲壮、震撼且具有神话色彩，采用电影级高细节渲染，纹理清晰，碎屑动态感强，阴影处理戏剧化，呈现出精致的动漫游戏卡牌插画品质。

templates.title: Partial petrification dark fantasy card art

titleLocalized.zh: 局部石化暗黑奇幻卡牌艺术

templates.prompt: A dark fantasy collectible card illustration depicts a noble anime-style female knight amidst the ruins of a Gothic cathedral, presented in a dramatic three-quarter profile. She wears a royal blue gown with gold trim, adorned with a silver breastplate bearing blue heraldic insignia, armored gauntlets, and a dark corset. A deep purple petticoat peeks out from beneath the tattered, layered skirt. Her blonde hair is styled in a braided bun with loose bangs, and a large, deep blue bow is tied at the back of her head. Her body is undergoing…{argument name="status effect" default="Localized petrification"} Her hands, arms, and much of her dress and armor had turned into cracked rock, marble-like fissures spreading across her body. Her posture was tense yet elegant; one petrified hand was raised to her face, the other hunched over her torso, as if reacting to fear or shock. Her expression conveyed terror and helplessness. Floating around her were five broken stone slabs or card-like stones, inscribed with blurry figures and symbols, suspended at varying depths. Beside her floated a gigantic, grotesque eyeball, roughly the size of her head and shoulders, with a cracked, stone-like sclera, a staring iris, serrated crown-like spikes, and ornate organic textures; thick, pale, waxy liquid dripped from the eyeball, mixed with dark blood, forming long, heavy filaments and droplets. The setting was the interior of a dark, cavernous cathedral, its towering arches gradually fading into darkness. Multiple melted candles are placed in the scene, including those visible on the left edge, in the center of the lower background, and on the stone shelf in the right foreground; the candlelight is small and warm, casting amber highlights. Numerous luminous droplets or particles are added, falling through the air, echoing the liquid dripping from the eyeballs. The atmosphere is cursed, tragic, and oppressive, like a high-rarity status ailment card in a fantasy game. The scene is rendered with a richly detailed, anime-style art style, combining realistic textures, dramatic contrasts of light and shadow, cracked stone surfaces, weathered fabrics, polished but damaged armor, and a vertical card art composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张暗黑奇幻集换式卡牌插画，描绘了一位身处哥特式废墟大教堂中的高贵动漫骑士女性，采用戏剧性的四分之三侧身半身构图。她身穿带有金色饰边的宝蓝色礼服，佩戴着有蓝色纹章标记的银色胸甲、装甲护手和深色束腰，破损的层叠裙摆下露出深紫色的衬裙。她的金发扎成编织发髻，留着松散的刘海，脑后系着一个巨大的深蓝色蝴蝶结。她的身体正在经历 {argument name="status effect" default="局部石化"}：双手、双臂以及礼服和盔甲的大部分区域已化为开裂的岩石，大理石般的裂纹在身体上蔓延。她的姿态紧张而优雅，一只石化的手抬至脸旁，另一只手蜷缩在躯干前，仿佛在恐惧或震惊中做出反应。她的表情应流露出恐惧与无助。她周围漂浮着 5 块破碎的石板或卡牌状石块，上面刻有模糊的人物和符号，悬浮在不同深度的空中。她身旁悬浮着一颗巨大的怪异眼球，大小约等于她的头肩部，拥有开裂的石质巩膜、凝视的虹膜、锯齿状的冠状尖刺以及周围华丽的有机纹理；眼球滴落着浓稠的苍白蜡状液体，混合着深色的血液，形成长而沉重的丝状和滴状物。环境是一个阴暗的洞穴式大教堂内部，高耸的拱门逐渐隐入黑暗。场景中放置了多支融化的蜡烛，包括左侧边缘、背景下方中心以及右侧前景石架上可见的烛簇；烛火微小而温暖，投射出琥珀色的高光。添加许多发光的液滴或微粒在空中飘落，与眼球滴落的液体相呼应。氛围是被诅咒的、悲剧性的且压抑的，如同奇幻游戏中一张高稀有度的状态异常卡牌。采用细节丰富的绘画风动漫风格渲染，结合逼真的质感、戏剧性的明暗对比光影、开裂的石质表面、风化的织物、抛光但受损的盔甲，以及垂直的卡牌艺术构图。

promptLocalized.zh: {"type":"角色设计图","subject":"风格化比格犬吉祥物插画","style":"简洁的日式概念艺术项目，柔和的半写实绘画渲染，圆润友好的造型，精致的画室展示风格","character":{"species":"比格犬","personality":"温顺冷静，平易近人，可爱且结构统一的吉祥物设计","name":"{argument name=\"character name\" default=\"这个狗狗(我)\"}","appearance":{"body":"小型坐姿比格犬，大头，深邃明亮的眼睛，长长的垂耳，紧凑的口鼻部，柔软的胸毛，纤细的腿，圆润的爪子","coat pattern":"头部和侧面有棕褐色斑块，白色口鼻部，白色胸部，白色前腿和爪子，背部有黑色马鞍纹，尾巴尖为白色","primary colors":["棕褐色","白色","黑色","深棕色","薄荷绿点缀"]}},"layout":{"background":"浅暖灰色页面，带有精致的面板边框和圆角白色卡片","header":{"title":"角色设计系统","subtitle":"性格温顺、沉稳的比格犬角色。"},"sections":[{"title":"主视觉姿势","position":"左侧大面板","count":1,"labels":["坐姿主视觉"]},{"title":"多角度视图","position":"右上角","count":4,"labels":["正面","侧面","背面","3/4 侧视图"]},{"title":"表情","position":"中右侧","count":4,"labels":["中性（常态）","开心","好奇","困倦"]},{"title":"调色板","position":"左下角","count":6,"labels":["棕褐色（毛色） #C79B6E","白色（毛色） #F6F6F6","黑色（马鞍纹） #2E2E2E","眼/鼻（深色） #2B2620","眼睛（高光部） #5A4632","点缀绿 #A7CFB5"]},{"title":"设计说明","position":"右下角","count":3,"labels":["耳朵形状","尾部标记","身体比例"]}],"notes":"使用虚线引导线，小型日文注释文本，绿色圆角分区标签"},"composition":{"main_panel":"在浅薄荷绿矩形背景上，展示狗狗 3/4 左侧坐姿的大幅肖像","turnaround":"右上角卡片中均匀分布的四个全身视图，每个视图居中并垂直对齐","expressions":"四个侧面或 3/4 视角的头部特写，展示列出的情绪","palette":"六个圆形色块，下方附有日文标签和十六进制颜色代码","design_notes":"三个技术性小面板，带有虚线箭头和比例参考线，包括耳朵轮廓、尾部颜色过渡以及侧面身体测量图"},"rendering":{"lighting":"柔和的漫反射画室光效","texture":"平滑的毛发质感，带有细腻的笔触柔和度","shadows":"仅有轻微的落地阴影","linework":"极简或不可见的轮廓线，依靠色彩边缘呈现","quality":"高分辨率专业概念图"},"prompt":"创建一个精致的日式角色设计系统图，角色为 {argument name=\"character type\" default=\"温顺的比格犬吉祥物\"}。保持页面整洁、可爱，并在所有视图中保持高度一致。展示 1 个大型主视觉姿势、4 个多角度视图、4 种表情变体、6 个带标签的色块以及 3 个设计说明面板。使用指定的日文分区标题和标签。狗狗应具有 {argument name=\"coat colors\" default=\"棕褐色、白色和黑色，带有黑色马鞍纹和白色尾尖\"}，面部柔和友好，长垂耳，大而有神的眼睛。将主视觉姿势放在浅薄荷绿背景卡片上，使用薄荷绿圆角标题，并保持整体设计简洁、平衡且适合展示。添加日文正文和技术注释样式。整体氛围：{argument name=\"mood\" default=\"温顺、冷静且值得信赖\"}。横向比例，类似于专业的动画或游戏角色模型图。"}

templates.title: Realistic Valentine's Day Icon Portraits

titleLocalized.zh: 写实风格情人节偶像肖像

templates.prompt: A richly detailed, realistic portrait depicts an elegant, charismatic young Japanese woman on a Valentine's Day theme. Shot indoors in a luxurious, vintage room, warm afternoon sunlight streams in through tall windowpanes. She is seated or leaning forward, her hands outstretched towards the camera, offering a round, red chocolate box in the foreground, creating a slightly intimate first-person perspective. Her face is mostly obscured by her short bob and lowered head, conveying an atmosphere of shyness, gentleness, and mystery. She has {argument name="hair color" default="A soft gray-brown color with a hint of green at the ends."} Her hair was a messy, chin-length bob, glossy and textured, and she wore a deep burgundy beret adorned with a ribbon and a beige polka-dot bow on the right side. She was dressed in a gorgeous outfit.{argument name="outfit color" default="Deep red"} The Gothic Lolita-style dress features a sleeveless, high-neck halter design with sheer patterned fabric, black lace trim, delicate gold embellishments, and a small heart-shaped gemstone at the collar. It comes with matching separate sleeves, the cuffs adorned with semi-transparent ruffles, a pleated wristlet, heart-shaped pendant earrings, and a delicate chain embellishment at the waist. The round, red chocolate box is tied with a metallic gold ribbon. Inside, eight chocolates are clearly visible, arranged in a black compartment, including one red heart-shaped chocolate and seven square or round pralines. The background features soft floral arrangements, antique decorations, and a blurred effect from a crystal chandelier. Utilizing cinematic shallow depth of field, strong backlighting, realistic skin and fabric rendering, subtle lens flare, warm amber highlights, rich shadows, and a high-end fashion magazine photography style, it evokes the feel of {argument name="character concept" default="An elegant and mature idol with a romantic Valentine's Day theme."} A live-action adaptation. It emphasizes exquisite costume craftsmanship, a touch of cosplay yet a high-end studio-quality realism, and a refined yet melancholic atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张细节极其丰富的写实肖像，描绘了一位风格优雅、充满偶像感的年轻日本女性，呈现出情人节主题。拍摄于室内，背景是一间奢华的复古房间，温暖的午后阳光透过身后的高大窗格洒入。她正坐着或向前倾身，双手伸向镜头，在前景中递出一个圆形的红色巧克力礼盒，营造出一种略带亲密感的第一人称视角。她的脸部大部分被短波波头和低垂的头部遮挡，流露出羞涩、温柔且神秘的氛围。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="柔和的灰棕色，发梢带有淡淡的绿色调"} 头发，是齐颌长度的凌乱波波头，质感光泽，戴着一顶深酒红色贝雷帽，右侧装饰有丝带和米色波点蝴蝶结。她身着一件华丽的 {argument name="outfit color" default="深酒红色"} 哥特洛丽塔风格连衣裙，采用无袖高领挂脖设计，配有透明花纹面料、黑色蕾丝边、精致的金色装饰以及衣领处的一颗心形小宝石；搭配同款分离式袖套，袖口带有半透明荷叶边、褶皱腕饰、心形吊坠耳环以及腰间精致的链条装饰。巧克力礼盒为圆形红色，系着金属质感的金色丝带，盒内清晰可见 8 颗巧克力，放置在黑色隔层中，包括一颗红色心形巧克力和 7 颗各式方形或圆形果仁糖。背景包含柔和的花艺布置、古董装饰以及水晶吊灯的虚化效果。采用电影级的浅景深、强烈的逆光效果、逼真的皮肤与织物渲染、微妙的镜头光晕、温暖的琥珀色高光、丰富的阴影，以及高端时尚杂志的摄影风格，仿佛是 {argument name="character concept" default="一位优雅成熟、带有浪漫情人节主题的偶像"} 的真人版演绎。强调精美的服装工艺、略带 Cosplay 感但又具备高级摄影棚质感的写实度，以及一种精致而惆怅的氛围。

templates.title: Fantasy social media movie poster

titleLocalized.zh: 奇幻社交媒体电影海报

templates.prompt: A bright, vertically formatted fantasy animated film poster features a cute, chibi-style elf girl at its center, standing on a glowing circular platform in a futuristic neon-lit city at night. She has short, wavy, reddish-brown hair, pointed elf ears, large, sparkling brown eyes, translucent iridescent butterfly wings, and a transparent, shimmering beret-like halo. Her face is partially obscured by a square mosaic in the center. She poses like a performer or creator on stage, holding a glowing pen-shaped wand in one hand and extending the other outwards. She wears a shiny white cropped long-sleeved top, holographic iridescent shorts, and chunky white sneakers. The entire image is bathed in pale purple, pink, blue, and pearlescent highlights, accompanied by floating particles, lens flares, flashes, bokeh, butterflies, and magical light trails. Ten... A semi-transparent holographic social media-style panel and interface cards: The top left corner features a large post card displaying her portrait, accompanied by the Japanese text "今日の想いを、シェアします。" and reaction counts "12.6K", "532", and "1.2K"; the top left corner features a small quote card that reads "今日の気づき小さな一歩が未来を変える。"; and the top right corner features a small memo card that reads "アイデ".アメモいつか, Sound of the story. "; in the upper right corner is a large video post card showing her portrait, with a play button and the text "梦は、声に出すと动き出す. "; in the middle left is a square heart-shaped icon panel; in the center of the left is a quote card that reads "あなたの言葉にsaving われました. "; in the lower left corner is a story panel that says "みんなのストーリーあなたの体験が、Who かの勇気に. ” and comes with 3 A thumbnail image; on the right side of the center is a reply/comment card that says "sympathize! "ずっと応aidしています!" and is accompanied by a tiny profile icon; in the center of the right is a prompt word panel that reads "プロンプト光, HOPE, つながり, FUTURE, MAGIC , 优しさ" and a button labeled "Generate"; in the lower right corner is a label card that reads "#思いがつながる#日もありがとう#后をつくるのはprivateたち". Add 2 floating interaction counters near the bottom right of the character: a heart counter "25.8K" and a retweet/share counter "3.7K". A diagonal film strip is added to the lower left foreground, featuring four visible frames of the fairy girl, with a partially visible video editing timeline below. The background evokes a magical digital metropolis, with skyscrapers, screens, and silhouettes of the audience at the bottom, blending social media, filmmaking, and fairytale aesthetics. At the very top, the Japanese slogan "ひとつの投稿が、誰かの明日を光らせる。" is placed in elegant white text. At the bottom center, a large, glowing Japanese title is created in ornate serif calligraphy: "タイムラインの妖精" (Tiamline no Fairy), adorned with a small butterfly decoration, below which is the English subtitle "FAIRY AYA". templates.prompt: A cinematic anime-style action illustration, the protagonist is {argument name="character age/style" default="high school girl"} Wearing a dark navy blue school uniform, she knelt in a sunlit industrial corridor, holding a compact black pistol pointed directly at the audience. She had a messy short bob haircut, and her hair color was {argument name="hair color" default="black"} A few strands of hair fluttered to the side, her body leaning forward, her posture tense, as if she were preparing to retaliate from behind cover. Her attire consisted of five clearly visible garments: a black school uniform blazer with brass buttons, a white shirt, a blue plaid tie, a matching blue plaid pleated skirt, black knee-high socks, and shiny black loafers. She also carried two tactical accessories: a black thigh holster with a pistol strapped to her right leg, and a dark side pocket at her waist. Positioning her at the bottom of the frame with a dramatic foreground perspective, her bent knees dominate the foreground, and the pistol is centered in the image. The scene is set in a narrow, elevated corridor inside an industrial steel structure, complete with beams, railings, weathered wooden floors, crates, and a black metal barrel on the left. In the depth of the background, four fully armed tactical soldiers in dark gear and helmets are shown advancing towards her along the corridor. Strong diagonal shadows and bright afternoon sunlight filtering through the metal frame create alternating bands of light and shadow on the ground and the figures. The rendering effect needs to have delicate lines, semi-realistic anime proportions, glossy hair highlights, clear clothing folds, subtle graininess, and a blue-gray color scheme with realistic depth of field, tension, and dynamism.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影感动漫风格的动作插画，主角是一位 {argument name="character age/style" default="高中女生"}，身穿深海军蓝校服，跪在阳光照射的工业走廊上，双手持一把紧凑型黑色手枪直指观众。她留着一头凌乱的短波波头，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"}，几缕发丝向侧面飘动，身体前倾，姿态紧绷，仿佛在掩体后进行还击。她的装束包含 5 件清晰可见的衣物：带有黄铜纽扣的黑色校服西装外套、白色衬衫、蓝色格子领带、配套的蓝色格子百褶裙，以及黑色过膝袜和亮面黑色乐福鞋。她还携带了 2 件战术配件：右腿上绑着一个装有手枪的黑色大腿枪套，以及腰间的一个深色侧袋。将她置于画面下方，采用戏剧性的前缩透视，弯曲的膝盖占据前景，手枪位于画面中心。场景设定在工业钢结构内部的一条狭窄高架走廊上，配有横梁、栏杆、风化的木制地板、板条箱，左侧有一个黑色金属桶。在深景处，展示 4 名全副武装、身穿深色装备并佩戴头盔的战术士兵正沿着走廊向她推进。利用强烈的对角线阴影和穿过金属框架的明亮午后阳光，在地面和人物身上形成交替的光影带。渲染效果需具备细腻的线条、半写实的动漫比例、亮泽的发丝高光、清晰的衣物褶皱、细微的颗粒感，以及带有真实景深、张力和动感的蓝灰色调动作配色。

templates.title: Enkidu rests under a tree by the lake.

titleLocalized.zh: 恩奇都（Enkidu）在湖畔树下休憩

templates.prompt: A serene anime-style illustration depicting {argument name="character name" default="Enkidu"} Reimagined as a gender-neutral, feminine young woman with extremely long, straight hair, the hair color of which is {argument name="hair color" default="Light green"} The character sits on the grass, leaning against the trunk of a massive ancient tree in a sun-drenched lakeside park. Slender and elegant, the character wears a slightly loose white shirt with soft folds, paired with custom-made light beige or taupe trousers and simple white slip-on flats. The posture is relaxed, one knee bent, the other extended forward, hands casually resting on the knee, the body slightly leaning to the left of the viewer. Long hair falls over the shoulders, extending below the waist and spreading across the grass. The scene is set in bright morning or afternoon natural light, with dappled shadows cast by the trees on clothing, hair, the ground, and tree bark. The background showcases a tranquil blue lake, a lakeside path, a wooden park bench on the left, a black streetlamp beside the bench, and a small pavilion or gazebo on the opposite shore. Lush trees are reflected in the water, and the sky is azure, dotted with scattered white clouds. The foreground grass is dotted with small white and purple wildflowers, and the trees are richly detailed with moss patches on their bark, creating a tranquil and contemplative atmosphere. Highly detailed, painterly anime illustrations, with soft, cinematic composition, clear leaf textures, and hair gently swaying in the breeze. SFW (suitable for all ages), no text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张宁静的动漫风格插画，描绘了 {argument name="character name" default="恩奇都"} 被重新构想为一位中性化、呈现女性特征的年轻人，拥有极长的直发，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="浅绿色"}。角色坐在草地上，背靠着阳光明媚的湖畔公园里一棵巨大的古树树干。角色身形纤细优雅，穿着一件略显宽松的白色衬衫，衣褶柔和，搭配浅米色或灰褐色的定制长裤，以及简单的白色一脚蹬平底鞋。角色姿态放松，单膝弯曲，另一条腿向前伸展，双手随意地放在膝盖上，身体略微向观众的左侧倾斜，长发垂落在肩头，一直延伸至腰部以下，并铺散在草地上。场景设定在明亮的上午或午后自然光下，斑驳的树影投射在衣物、头发、地面和树皮上。背景展示了一片平静的蓝色湖泊、湖边铺设的步道、左侧有一张木质公园长椅、长椅旁有一盏黑色路灯，湖对岸有一座小型凉亭或亭阁，郁郁葱葱的树木倒映在湖水中，天空湛蓝，点缀着零星的白云。前景草地上点缀着白色和紫色的小野花，树木细节丰富，树皮上带有苔藓斑块，营造出宁静沉思的氛围。高度精细的绘画感动漫插画，柔和的电影级构图，清晰的叶片纹理，头发随微风轻拂，SFW（适宜全年龄），无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Anime mascots in supermarket shopping carts

titleLocalized.zh: 超市购物车里的动漫吉祥物

templates.prompt: A bright and detailed anime illustration, set in the snack aisle of a Japanese supermarket, presents the shelf arrangement from a wide-angle perspective. Five shopping carts are arranged diagonally from left to right, each piled high with packaged snacks and groceries, and each carrying a lively and adorable anthropomorphic or costumed character. In the first cart, a large, fluffy tabby cat mascot with brown and cream stripes, big golden eyes, a happy, toothy grin, and oversized pink paws is raising a paw to greet the viewer; he wears a white hoodie with a black rabbit logo and the word "NYA!", paired with black athletic shorts with yellow side stripes, and a small bell around his neck. In the second cart, a cheerful Shiba Inu boy grins, striking a "Dab" pose, wearing a red sleeveless hoodie or vest over a white shirt and black shorts. In the third vehicle, an orange fox boy with white muzzle and chest fur stood confidently with his arms crossed, eyes closed and a smug smile on his face, surrounded by shimmering light. He wore a black tracksuit with orange trim and chunky beaded jewelry. In the fourth vehicle, a humanoid character wearing a light blue hoodie and long white rabbit ears raised his hands in a peace sign; his face was deliberately blurred or obscured, and he wore dark shorts, striking a playful pose. In the fifth vehicle, a small brown bear mascot wearing a green T-shirt with a bear face pattern and the word "KUMA" excitedly raised his arms. The supermarket environment was filled with colorful snack boxes and bags on both sides, the floor was shiny tiled, and ceiling lights and Japanese promotional signs hung overhead. The image should include three large hanging signs: a poster in the upper left that reads "New Product! New Product!" and features a cute character illustration; a sign in the middle aisle with a large green "2" and the category text "Snak Confectionery Series" and "Cup Noodles & Drinks"; and a blue and red promotional poster in the upper right that reads "Great Deal! Big Thank You Sale." The left side should include a vertical shelf sign that reads "Sakusaku Food Sense." Add 5 clearly visible shopping cart price tags from front to back: "Today's のおすすめ! ポテトチップス198 yen (tax 込213 yen)", "Special sale!コーンフレーク158 yen (tax 込173 yen)", "おBUY! カップラーメン 128 yen (tax 込138 yen)", "ゆめちゃんセール! "おべんとう108 yen" and "バナナ88 yen". The campaign emphasizes a fun and engaging atmosphere, vivid expressions, clean lines, soft celluloid shadows, highly detailed product packaging, warm interior lighting, and whimsical, parade-style compositions.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张明亮且精致的动漫插画，背景设定在日本超市的零食货架区，采用广角视角呈现货架排列。五辆购物车从左前到右后呈对角线排列，每辆车都堆满了包装零食和杂货，每辆车里都坐着一个姿态活泼的可爱拟人化或穿戴戏服的角色。在第一辆车里，一个毛茸茸的大型虎斑猫男孩吉祥物，有着棕色和奶油色条纹的皮毛、金色大眼睛、开心的露齿笑容和超大的粉色肉垫，正举起一只爪子向观众打招呼；他穿着一件印有黑色兔子标志和“NYA!”字样的白色连帽衫，搭配带有黄色侧条纹的黑色运动短裤，脖子上戴着一个小铃铛。在第二辆车里，一只开朗的柴犬男孩咧嘴笑着，摆出类似“Dab”的姿势，身穿红色无袖连帽衫或背心，内搭白色衬衫和黑色短裤。在第三辆车里，一只橙色狐狸男孩有着白色的口鼻部和胸毛，双臂交叉自信地站着，闭着眼睛露出得意的微笑，周围闪烁着光芒，穿着带有橙色镶边的黑色运动服，佩戴着粗珠饰品。在第四辆车里，一个穿着浅蓝色连帽衫、戴着长长白兔耳朵的人形角色正举起双手比出剪刀手；面部刻意模糊或遮挡，穿着深色短裤，姿态俏皮。在第五辆车里，一只穿着印有熊脸图案和“KUMA”字样绿色 T 恤的小棕熊吉祥物正兴奋地高举双臂。超市环境两侧堆满了色彩缤纷的零食盒和包装袋，地面是光亮的瓷砖，头顶悬挂着天花板灯和日文促销标牌。画面中需包含 3 个大型悬挂标牌：左上方一张写有“新商品! 新商品!”并配有可爱角色插画的海报，中间过道标示牌上有一个巨大的绿色“2”以及分类文字“スナック菓子 シリアル”和“カップ麺 パン 飲料”，右上方一张写有“今がお得! 大感謝セール”的蓝红色促销海报。左侧包含 1 个垂直货架标牌，上面写着“サクサク食感”。从前到后添加 5 个清晰可见的购物车价格牌：“本日のおすすめ! ポテトチップス 198円 (税込213円)”、“特売品! コーンフレーク 158円 (税込173円)”、“お買得! カップラーメン 128円 (税込138円)”、“ゆめちゃんセール! おべんとう 108円”以及“バナナ 88円”。强调趣味性的宣传氛围、生动的表情、清晰的线条、柔和的赛璐珞阴影、高度细节化的包装商品、温暖的室内灯光以及异想天开的游行式构图。

templates.title: Cyberpunk Formula Neo racing HUD

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克 Formula Neo 赛车 HUD

templates.prompt: A hyper-realistic, futuristic racing game launch screen, set in a neon-lit cyberpunk city at night. The low-angle, third-person chase perspective showcases a Formula-style electric race on a wet, post-rain street track. The protagonist's vehicle is a sleek black open-wheel race car with glowing cyan lines on its body and shimmering cyan rims. Red lights on the rear display NEO.JP. The car drifts slightly on the wet asphalt, sparks flying from its chassis. Three opposing cars are ahead: a red open-wheel racer on the right, a dark-colored car in the distance, and another further away near a bend. The road curves left, passing through a canyon of tall buildings covered in massive LED billboards and vertical neon signs, casting stark reflections on the wet pavement. In the center of the background, a huge, glowing billboard reads FORMULA NEO, with NEO in large cyan letters. Yellow, illuminated herringbone-shaped guardrails are installed on both sides of the road bend, with a strong dynamic blur that emphasizes speed. The complete e-sports racing HUD features: The top left corner displays a 2/8 position indicator with a small POS label; the left-side leaderboard shows a total of 8 drivers: 1 KAZUKI, 2 NEO DRIVER, 3 REIJI, 4 YUINA, 5 SHO, 6 ALICE, 7 LUCAS, 8 TAIGA, with time differences next to most names; the top right corner displays lap information: LAP 2/3, BEST 00:58.123, LAP 00:21.456, split times: S1 00:21.456, S2 00:36.890, S3 --:--:---; the task box displays OBJECTIVE and "1位でフィニッシュする"; the bottom left corner shows a mini-map of the track and 98% of the DRS gauges; the bottom right corner features a futuristic circular speedometer displaying 278 KM/H. And 6 levels. At the bottom foreground, eight anime-style half-body portraits of team members are placed, evenly distributed at the bottom of the screen, forming an overlay of character lineups: 1 silver-haired character wearing a white racing suit, 2 red-haired characters wearing black shirts with flame symbols and red jackets, 3 long purple-haired characters wearing purple clothing, 4 black-haired characters wearing dark Team Neo racing suits, 5 short blue-black-haired characters wearing dark uniforms, 6 light brown-haired characters wearing gray uniforms, 7 green-haired characters wearing white and green clothing with their hands in front of their chests, 8 blonde-haired characters wearing yellow jackets, and an additional portrait of a pink-haired hooded character added on the far right, blending into the bottom lineup and creating a compact team banner feel; above the bottom portraits, the TEAM NEO text is displayed in a glowing cyan UI style in the center. It adopts an exquisite AAA-level game main visual art style, with ultra-detailed reflection effects, cinematic contrast, electric blue and magenta lighting, sharp UI graphics, dramatic perspective effects, and a highly realistic and stylized promotional poster texture.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超写实的未来感赛车游戏启动画面，背景设定在夜晚霓虹闪烁的赛博朋克城市。画面采用低角度第三人称追逐视角，展示了一场在雨后湿滑街道赛道上进行的 Formula 风格电动赛车比赛。主角车辆是一辆流线型黑色开轮式赛车，车身带有发光的青色线条，轮毂闪烁着青色光芒，车尾红色灯光文字显示为 NEO.JP，车辆在湿润的沥青路面上轻微漂移，底盘溅出火花。前方共有 3 辆对手赛车，包括右侧的一辆红色开轮式赛车、中心远处的深色赛车，以及更远处弯道附近的另一辆赛车。道路向左弯曲，穿过由高大建筑构成的峡谷，建筑外墙覆盖着巨大的 LED 广告牌和垂直霓虹灯招牌，在湿润的路面上形成强烈的倒影。背景中央，一块巨大的发光广告牌上写着 FORMULA NEO，其中 NEO 为巨大的青色字母。道路转弯处两侧设有黄色发光人字形护栏，并带有强调速度感的强烈动态模糊。叠加完整的电竞赛车 HUD：左上角显示 2/8 的位置指示器，带有小型 POS 标签；左侧排行榜显示总共 8 名车手，依次为 1 KAZUKI, 2 NEO DRIVER, 3 REIJI, 4 YUINA, 5 SHO, 6 ALICE, 7 LUCAS, 8 TAIGA，多数名字旁附有时间差；右上角显示圈数信息 LAP 2/3，BEST 00:58.123，LAP 00:21.456，分段计时 S1 00:21.456, S2 00:36.890, S3 --:--:---；任务框显示 OBJECTIVE 和 1 位でフィニッシュする；左下角为赛道小地图和 98% 的 DRS 仪表；右下角为圆形的未来感速度表，显示 278 KM/H 和 6 档。底部前景处，放置 8 个动漫风格的团队成员半身肖像，均匀分布在画面底部，形成角色阵容叠加层：1 位银发角色身穿白色赛车服，2 位红发角色身穿带有火焰标志的黑色衬衫及红色夹克，3 位长紫发角色身穿紫色服装，4 位黑发角色身穿深色 Team Neo 赛车服，5 位短蓝黑发角色身穿深色制服，6 位浅棕发角色身穿灰色制服，7 位绿发角色身穿白绿相间服装且手放在胸前，8 位金发角色身穿黄色夹克，最右侧额外增加一个粉色头发的连帽衫角色肖像，融入底部阵容，营造出紧凑的团队横幅感；底部肖像上方居中位置以发光的青色 UI 风格显示 TEAM NEO 文字。采用精致的 AAA 级游戏主视觉美术风格，超细节的反射效果，电影级的对比度，电光蓝与洋红色的灯光，锐利的 UI 图形，富有戏剧性的透视效果，以及高度写实且风格化的宣传海报质感。

templates.title: Girl on a polluted industrial beach

titleLocalized.zh: 污染工业海滩上的女孩

templates.prompt: A cinematic, realistic wide-angle shot showcases a lonely beach beside a decaying industrial coastal town under a vast summer sky. In the foreground, a young woman stands silently by the water, her back to the camera, gazing out at the sea. She wears a wide-brimmed straw hat, a loose white short-sleeved shirt, and faded blue denim overalls, her long, dark hair peeking out from under the hat. The beach is filthy, littered with clearly visible debris, including more than six rusty metal barrels, broken wood, plastic waste, scattered scrap metal, and floating industrial waste. To the left, a row of weathered concrete factories and apartment buildings stretches into the distance, their facades cracked, windows broken, and utility poles and wires crisscrossing. A towering chimney stands near the center of the background. To the right, the ocean displays a soft blue hue, dotted with tiny, foamy waves, with an abandoned dock or a row of old wooden piles extending into the water. In the distance, low, hazy mountains stretch along the horizon. The visual focus of the image is the sky: towering, massive white cumulonimbus clouds occupy most of the upper half of the image, rich in detail, appearing bright, dense, and majestic against the deep blue sky, creating a stark contrast with the desolate, polluted coastline. Natural sunlight, realistic shadows, high detail, understated documentary-style color gradation, a melancholic mood, an atmosphere of environmental collapse, sharp focus, 24mm lens composition, and a level perspective.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影感十足的写实广角镜头，展示了夏季广阔天空下，一座衰败的工业沿海城镇旁孤独的海滩。前景中，一名年轻女性背对镜头，静静地站在水边眺望大海，她戴着宽檐草帽，身穿宽松的白色短袖衬衫和褪色的蓝色牛仔背带裤，帽子下露出长长的深色头发。海滩肮脏不堪，散落着清晰可见的各类碎片，包括 6 个以上的生锈金属桶、破碎的木头、塑料垃圾、散落的废金属以及漂浮的工业废料。左侧，一排饱经风霜的混凝土工厂和公寓式建筑向远方延伸，外墙开裂，窗户破损，电线杆和电线纵横交错，背景中心附近有一座高耸的烟囱。右侧，海洋呈现出柔和的蓝色，泛着细小的泡沫浪花，一座废弃的码头或一排旧木桩延伸至水中。远景中，低矮朦胧的山脉沿着地平线延伸。画面的视觉重心是天空：高耸巨大的白色积雨云占据了图像上半部分的大部分空间，细节丰富，在深蓝色天空的映衬下显得阳光明媚、浓密而雄伟，与荒凉污染的海岸形成了强烈的对比。自然日光，写实阴影，高细节，低调的纪录片式色彩分级，忧郁的情绪，环境崩溃的氛围，清晰对焦，24mm 镜头构图，平视视角。

templates.title: Anime Maids at a Country Train Station

titleLocalized.zh: 乡村火车站的动漫女仆

templates.prompt: A highly detailed anime-style illustration depicts a tranquil Japanese rural train station platform on a bright summer afternoon. In the foreground is a full-body portrait of a young woman dressed in a classic black and white Victorian maid outfit. She stands slightly to the left of the center of the platform, facing forward, her hands lifting the sides of her skirt in a gesture resembling a curtsy. Her attire includes a black long-sleeved dress with white ruffles, a large white apron, a white ruffled maid's headdress, white cuffs, a white petticoat peeking out from under the skirt, white stockings, and black Mary Jane shoes.{argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown"} Her hair is straight with soft bangs. Her face should be obscured with soft mosaic tiles to create an anonymized effect. On the nearest track behind her, an old-fashioned cream-colored local train with striking blue horizontal stripes is placed, its destination marked "Regular" when viewed from a slightly angled front. On the right track, a second train is placed: a bright yellow local train further back, also marked "Regular" at the front. A total of two trains are displayed. The station is an open-air, slightly retro Japanese platform with overhead power lines, steel gantry frames, a weathered wooden roof, concrete platform edges, and yellow tactile paving. On the left, there is a large station sign displaying "のの," "Nono," and "福岡県福岡市," with directional arrows and destination labels for "Hakata" and "Tenjin." Simultaneously display two platform number signs: "1 noriba" above the foreground platform and "2 noriba" on the opposite platform. Add small flowers, warm sunlight, clear shadows, blue sky, and fluffy summer clouds at the bottom of the signs. The composition should present the quality of a refined slice-of-life anime background illustration, featuring realistic railway details, clean lines, soft painterly shadows, and a slightly nostalgic cinematic atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度精细的动漫风格插画，描绘了明亮夏日午后宁静的日本乡村火车站站台，前景是一位穿着经典黑白维多利亚式女仆装的年轻女性全身像。她站在站台中心偏左的位置，面向前方，双手提起裙摆两侧，做出类似屈膝礼的姿势。她的装束包括黑色长袖连衣裙配白色荷叶边装饰、大号白色围裙、白色荷叶边女仆头饰、白色袖口、裙摆下露出的白色衬裙层、白色短袜以及黑色玛丽珍鞋。使用 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 的头发，直发且留有柔和的刘海。她的面部应使用柔和的马赛克块遮挡，呈现出匿名化的效果。在她身后最近的轨道上，放置一列旧式奶油色当地火车，带有醒目的蓝色水平条纹，从前方以微斜的角度观察，目的地标志显示为“普通”。在右侧轨道上，放置第二列火车：一列更靠后的亮黄色当地火车，车头同样显示“普通”。总共展示 2 列火车。车站是一个露天的、略带怀旧气息的日本站台，配有架空电线、钢制龙门架、风化的木质屋顶、混凝土站台边缘和黄色盲道。在左侧，包含一个大型车站站牌，上面写着“のの”、“Nono”和“福岡県福岡市”，带有方向箭头以及“博多 Hakata”和“天神 Tenjin”两个目的地标签。同时展示 2 个站台编号牌：前景站台上方为“1 のりば”，对面站台为“2 のりば”。在站牌底部添加小花、温暖的阳光、清晰的阴影、蓝天和蓬松的夏季白云。构图应呈现出精致的日常番动漫背景插画质感，具备写实的铁路细节、干净的线条、柔和的绘画式阴影以及略带怀旧的电影感氛围。

templates.title: Japanese fan milestone thank you image

titleLocalized.zh: 日语粉丝里程碑感谢图

templates.prompt: A simple social media milestone celebration image with a soft white background. The left side features a screenshot of X's personal homepage, while the right side displays handwritten thank-you text. The left side showcases a realistic mobile Japanese creator account profile card: a dark banner at the top with striking white calligraphy, a circular avatar overlapping the banner, displaying the name "Takki | Samune Consultant" with a blue verification badge, and the account ID @gibkun1 . Below is a standard app UI font displaying the Japanese bio. Small metadata lines include birth date and joining date, as well as a statistics line focusing on follower count: "36,004 Followers" (circled in red). Below are the profile navigation tabs, containing seven tags: Post, Reply, Highlight, Animation, Portrait, Notes, and Okay. Below the tag is a visible tweet preview with a small avatar, the Japanese tweet content, and a 2x2 image grid containing four warm, glowing abstract thumbnails in black, gold, and orange tones. On the right, in large, casual black handwriting, is written "36,000 people achieved," highlighted in pale yellow below the number, with a red underline below the second line and three red celebratory decorative symbols above the number. A bold, hand-drawn red arrow points from the text on the right to the circle representing the number of followers in the screenshot. Below this is another handwritten message, "Ariga tou gozaimasu!", with a soft pink underline; in the lower right corner, smaller handwritten text reads "Korekaramo koku o oto keshite ikimasu!", followed by a simple smiley face and two pink glitter doodles. The overall composition should present the effect of a sophisticated thank-you note composed of screenshots and marker annotations, with subtle shadows around the screenshot cards, a balanced layout, clear Japanese typography in the UI, and expressive calligraphy for the celebratory text.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张简洁的社交媒体里程碑庆祝图，背景为柔和的白色，左侧为 X 个人主页截图样式，右侧为手写感谢文字。左侧展示了一张逼真的移动端日语创作者账号个人资料卡片：顶部深色横幅上带有醒目的白色书法字体，圆形头像与横幅重叠，显示名称为“タッキ | サムネ顧問”并带有蓝色认证徽章，账号 ID 为 @gibkun1，下方为标准的 App UI 字体显示的日语个人简介。包含出生日期和加入日期等小型元数据行，以及粉丝数作为焦点的统计行：“36,004 フォロワー”（已用红色圆圈标注）。下方显示个人资料导航标签，包含 7 个标签：ポスト、返信、ハイライト、動画、画像、記事、いいね。标签下方包含一条可见的推文预览，配有小头像、日语推文内容以及一个 2x2 的图片网格，内含 4 张黑、金、橙色调的温暖发光抽象缩略图。右侧用黑色大号随性手写体书写“36,000人 達成しました”，数字下方带有淡黄色高亮，第二行下方有红色下划线，数字上方有 3 个红色庆祝装饰符号。添加一个粗线条手绘红色箭头，从右侧文字指向截图中的粉丝数圆圈。下方放置另一条手写信息“ありがとう ございます！”，带有柔和的粉色下划线；右下角添加较小的手写文字“これからも 有益な情報を お届けしていきます！”，后跟一个简单的笑脸涂鸦和 2 个粉色闪光涂鸦。整体构图应呈现出由截图和马克笔标注组成的精致感谢帖效果，截图卡片周围带有微妙的投影，布局平衡，UI 中的日语排版清晰，庆祝文字采用富有表现力的毛笔手写体。
