templates.title: Japanese fan celebration post (36,000 followers)

titleLocalized.zh: 日语 36,000 粉丝庆祝帖

templates.prompt: A bold Japanese social media milestone celebration image, featuring a 1:1 square layout combining smartphone screenshots and hand-drawn calligraphy-style typography. The left half displays a realistic screenshot of the profile page (X-shaped, slightly tilted, with a white content area in dark mode). The profile name "タツキ｜サムネ咨询" and the account " @gibkun1 " are visible, along with a blue verification badge and the number of followers circled in bold red. The circled number should indicate…{argument name="follower count" default="36,004"} The screenshot should include the profile icon in the top left corner, the Japanese bio text line, the top navigation tab, and a tweet preview with four small glowing thumbnails near the bottom, creating a realistic mobile app screenshot effect. In the right half, partially covering the screenshot, place the large Japanese calligraphy "36,000 people reached!!" in vibrant red and black ink with a striking white outline and shadow; below this is an even larger, more expressive black calligraphy "本当にありがとう!!" with bold red underlines. Add vibrant manga-style accent lines, starbursts, black speed lines, yellow spark decorations, and rough paint textures around the text. Near the bottom right corner, add a small chibi-style celebration character with {argument name="character hair" default="Dark curly brown"} Hair, clothing{argument name="character outfit" default="black hoodie"} The character raises both fists to indicate excitement. Their face is intentionally blurred or obscured. A white speech bubble containing handwritten Japanese text is added next to the character.{argument name="speech bubble text" default="I look forward to your continued support!!"} It adopts the high-contrast celebratory thumbnail aesthetic typical of YouTube and X announcement posts in Japan, featuring layered sticker-like compositions, rough ink strokes, a red, black, white and gold color scheme, and a boisterous, grateful and viral social media design.

promptLocalized.zh: 一款大胆的日语社交媒体里程碑庆祝图，采用 1:1 正方形布局，结合了智能手机截图和手绘书法风格的排版。在左半部分，展示一张深色模式下白色内容区域的 X 个人资料页面逼真截图，略微倾斜，可见个人资料名称“タツキ｜サムネ顾问”和账号“@gibkun1”、蓝色认证徽章，以及用粗红色记号笔圈出的粉丝数。圈出的数字应显示 {argument name="follower count" default="36,004"}，并配有一个指向它的大红色箭头。截图应包含左上角的个人资料图标、日语简介文本行、顶部导航标签，以及底部附近带有 4 张小型发光缩略图的推文预览，营造出真实的移动端应用截图效果。在右半部分并部分覆盖截图的位置，放置巨大的日语毛笔字“36,000人达成!!”，采用鲜艳的红黑墨水，配有醒目的白色轮廓和投影；下方则是更大、更具表现力的黑色毛笔字“本当にありがとう!!”，并带有粗红色的下划线笔触。在文字周围添加充满活力的漫画风格强调线、星爆、黑色速度线、黄色火花装饰和粗糙的油漆纹理。在右下角附近，加入一个小型 Q 版庆祝角色，拥有 {argument name="character hair" default="深色卷曲棕色"} 头发，穿着 {argument name="character outfit" default="黑色连帽衫"}，双拳举起表示兴奋。面部特意模糊或遮挡。在角色旁边添加一个白色对话气泡，包含手写日语文本 {argument name="speech bubble text" default="これからもよろしくお願いします!!"}。采用日本 YouTube 和 X 宣布帖中典型的高对比度庆祝缩略图美学，具有层叠的贴纸式构图、粗糙的墨笔笔触、红黑白金配色方案，以及一种喧闹、充满感激之情且具有病毒式传播力的社交媒体设计。

templates.title: 36K Japanese-speaking fans celebration poster

titleLocalized.zh: 日语区 36K 粉丝庆祝海报

templates.prompt: Create a square Japanese social media milestone celebration poster. The left side should feature a realistic screenshot of a smartphone profile page, while the right side should include a striking hand-drawn manga-style font and colorful holiday doodles. The main title should occupy the top right corner, using large red calligraphy with a white outline and yellow highlights. The content should be {argument name="headline text" default="The number of people has exceeded 36,000!"} Below it, bold black handwritten calligraphy was added, containing the following text:{argument name="subheadline text" default="Thank you!"} The text is underlined with bold, bright pink marker lines. On the left is a slanted smartphone-style X/Twitter profile screenshot, featuring a dark banner, avatar, verified badge, username line, bio, tabs, and a visible follower count circled in red. The follower count should show approximately 36,004, with the circled number located in the lower center of the screenshot. A visible tweet preview is included, featuring a 2x2 grid of shimmering gold and colorful light-and-shadow textured images. Around the entire composition, a vibrant white background is filled with confetti, ribbons, stars, crown graffiti, confetti canisters, hearts, wavy lines, and radiating rays of pink, blue, yellow, orange, and cyan, creating a lively, celebratory announcement design. In the lower right corner, a cheerful, anime-style chibi male character is placed, possessing…{argument name="hair style" default="Dark brown curly hair"} Wearing a black hoodie, he raises a fist in a victory pose. His chibi-style face should be simple and cute, with a blush and an excited expression. Add a white speech bubble with a black outline near the character, containing two lines of handwritten Japanese text: the first line reads {argument name="speech text" default="It's all thanks to everyone who always supports me!"} The second line is written in pink.{argument name="thank you text" default="thanks so much!"} The page features 11 main decorative motifs: confetti, ribbons, stars, crown graffiti, confetti canisters, hearts, radiating rays, sparklers, wavy ribbons, colored paint smear effects, and exclamation mark decorations. The overall style should evoke a blend of handmade celebratory flyers and social media achievement images, employing bold brushstroke fonts, marker textures, bright and saturated colors, playful asymmetrical layouts, and high-energy Japanese pop aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张正方形的日语社交媒体里程碑庆祝海报，左侧混合写实的智能手机个人主页截图，右侧配以醒目的手绘漫画风格字体和色彩缤纷的节日涂鸦。主标题应占据右上角区域，使用巨大的红色毛笔字，带有白色描边和黄色光芒装饰，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="36,000人突破！"}。在其下方，添加醒目的黑色手写书法，内容为 {argument name="subheadline text" default="感謝です！"}，并用粗体亮粉色记号笔线条进行下划线标注。左侧展示一张倾斜的智能手机风格 X/Twitter 个人主页截图，包含深色横幅、头像、认证徽章、用户名行、个人简介、标签页，以及一个用红圈标出的可见粉丝数。粉丝数应显示约为 36,004 人，圈出的数字位于手机截图的中下部。包含一个可见的推文预览，其中有一个 2x2 的闪耀金色和彩色光影纹理图片网格。在整个构图周围，用充满活力的五彩纸屑、彩带、星星、皇冠涂鸦、礼花筒、爱心、波浪线以及粉色、蓝色、黄色、橙色和青色的彩色放射状光芒填满白色背景，营造出一种热闹的庆祝公告设计。在右下角，放置一个开朗的动漫风格 Q 版男性角色，拥有 {argument name="hair style" default="深棕色卷发"}，身穿黑色连帽衫，举起一只拳头做出胜利姿势。Q 版脸部应简洁可爱，带有红晕和兴奋的表情。在角色附近添加一个黑色描边的白色对话气泡，内含 2 行日语手写文字：第一行写着 {argument name="speech text" default="いつも応援してくれる皆さんのおかげです！"}，第二行用粉色写着 {argument name="thank you text" default="本当にありがとう！"}。在页面上统计并呈现 11 种主要的装饰图案：五彩纸屑、彩带、星星、皇冠涂鸦、礼花筒、爱心、放射状光芒线、火花标记、波浪丝带、彩色油漆涂抹效果以及感叹号装饰。整体风格应呈现出手工庆祝传单与社交媒体成就图的结合感，采用粗犷的毛笔字体、记号笔纹理、明亮饱和的色彩、俏皮的不对称布局以及高能量的日本流行美学。

templates.title: Cyberpunk-style Japanese manga cover

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克风格日本漫画封面

templates.prompt: Create a highly dramatic cover for a Japanese weekly manga magazine, employing a glossy printing design with a compact yet chaotic layout, much like a real shonen manga magazine. The large red and white masthead in the upper left corner reads "Weekly MAGAZINE NEO" with a thick black border; the upper right corner features a black issue number box that reads "Issue 18, 2027". A small price box on the left reads "Special Price 450 yen," with a barcode below. The overall theme is a near-future cyberpunk racing manga inaugural issue, utilizing highly saturated neon lights, a wet, reflective effect after rain, and a high-energy editorial layout filled with star-shaped exploding frames, labels, and teaser boxes. The central background showcases a futuristic city street at night, complete with magenta, cyan, and blue neon signs and wet pavement; in the upper right corner, a streamlined black Formula One race car with glowing cyan lines speeds through the city. In the foreground center of the image, a main protagonist is placed: a young anime male with messy black hair, wearing a black high-tech racing suit with glowing cyan circuit patterns, headphones around his neck, and a small patch on his chest that reads "NEO.JP"; he faces forward, striking a heroic pose. To the right, a large vertical series title is displayed in distressed white font: "FORMULA NEO," next to which is the smaller vertical Japanese text "フォーミュラネオ". Nearby is a staff information box that reads "Original Work・F1NEO.jp" and below it "/Manga・". In the upper right corner, a large yellow circular explosion box contains striking magenta and black text: "Chapter Color 64p!! Super Volume Opening!!!". Add a jagged yellow explosion frame in the center left, with the words "Bucchigiri's New Series!!" nearby, and a diagonal magenta ribbon that reads "The Fastest Story of 2089 Begins—". In the lower half, arrange seven supporting characters around the protagonist: on the left is a silver-haired man in a white futuristic jacket with glowing blue lines; in the lower left corner is a red-haired tough guy in a black and red jacket with flames burning on his right fist; slightly to the left of center is a hooded figure in a purple cloak holding a glowing purple book; in the center is a short-haired girl in dark tech attire holding a transparent holographic interface; in the right center is a brown-haired youth with crossed arms and a gray racing jacket; near the lower right center is a gentle-looking green-haired girl in a light-colored top; and on the far right is a blond boy in yellow clothing holding small cubes or dice. Near the bottom center, add a pink-haired chibi or child character wearing a light pink hoodie with hands clasped together. Add a black, jagged, exploding box in the bottom left corner with the text "Extreme Poster Included!!". In the middle of the bottom half, add a striking promotional slogan in white, cyan, and red: "New serialization in the current issue & popular work is gaining momentum!!" At the very bottom, there are rectangular preview panels for four other manga series. Each panel has a colored banner label and a Japanese title at the top: Panel 1 has a red label "New Series!", titled "The Sword Saint of the Overlord," and subtitle "~The Blade of Destiny~"; Panel 2 has a blue label "New Series!", titled "Astral Code," and subtitle "~Memory of the Galaxy~"; Panel 3 has a pink label "Highly Recommended!", titled "Elixir Heart," and subtitle "~Magical Girl Re-emerges!~"; Panel 4 has a green label "Highly Recommended!", titled "Kenkaou King," and subtitle "~The Summit Battle Edition~." Near the bottom right corner, there is a small illustration of the magazine volume with the text "Latest Single Volume 1, April 15th Release!!" At the very bottom, across a black strip, is a white disclaimer: "※これはファンメイドのフィクションです。実在の雑志・出版社とは关系ありません。" The design utilizes bold manga cover typography, exaggerated Japanese magazine compositions, densely overlapping text, thick borders, explosive visual elements, glossy highlights, a raw neon cyberpunk atmosphere, and exquisite anime illustrations.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张极具戏剧性的日本周刊漫画杂志封面，采用光面印刷设计，布局紧凑且充满混乱感，如同真实的少年漫画杂志。左上角的大型红白配色刊头标题为“週刊 MAGAZINE NEO”，带有粗黑边框；右上角有一个黑色期号框，写着“2027 年 18 号”。在左侧添加一个写有“特別定価 450 円”的小价格框，下方配有条形码。整体主题为近未来赛博朋克赛车漫画创刊号，采用高饱和度的霓虹灯光、雨后湿滑的反射效果，以及充满星形爆炸框、标注和预告框的高能量编辑布局。中央背景展示了夜晚的未来城市街道，配有洋红色、青色和蓝色的霓虹灯招牌及湿润的路面；背景右上角有一辆流线型黑色方程式赛车，带有发光的青色线条，正疾驰穿过城市。在画面中央前景处，放置 1 位主要主角：一位有着凌乱黑发的年轻动漫男性，身穿黑色高科技赛车服，上面勾勒着发光的青色电路纹路，脖子上挂着耳机，胸前有一个写着“NEO.JP”的小补丁；他正面向前方，摆出英雄姿态。在右侧，放置巨大的竖排系列标题，采用做旧的白色字体：“FORMULA NEO”，旁边附有较小的竖排日语文字“フォーミュラネオ”。在其附近，包含一个制作人员信息框，写着“原作・F1NEO.jp”以及下方的“/漫画・”。在右上角添加一个巨大的黄色圆形爆炸框，内含醒目的洋红色和黑色文字：“巻頭カラー 64p!! 超ボリュームで開幕!!!”。在左中位置添加一个锯齿状的黄色爆炸框，写着“ぶっちぎりの新連載!!”，附近有一条斜向的洋红色丝带，写着“2089 年 最速の物語が始まる―”。在下半部分，围绕主角安排 7 位配角：左侧是一位身穿白色未来感外套、带有蓝色发光线条的银发男子；左下角是一位身穿黑红夹克、右拳燃烧着火焰的红发硬汉青年；中心偏左是一位身穿紫色斗篷、手持发光紫色书籍的兜帽人物；中心是一位身穿深色科技装束、手持透明全息界面的蓝黑短发少女；右中心是一位双臂交叉、身穿灰色赛车夹克的棕发青年；右下中心附近是一位身穿浅色上衣、外表温和的绿发少女；最右侧是一位身穿黄色服装、手持小方块或骰子的金发少年。在底部中心附近，添加 1 位身穿浅粉色连帽衫、双手合十的粉发 Q 版或幼年角色。在左下角添加一个黑色锯齿状爆炸框，写着“描き下ろし特別ポスター付録!!”。在下半部分中间，添加一行醒目的宣传语，采用白色、青色和红色：“今号も激アツ新連載＆人気作が勢揃い!!”。在最底部，包含 4 个其他漫画系列的矩形预告面板，每个面板顶部都有彩色横幅标签和日语标题：面板 1 为红色标签“新連載!”，标题为“覇の剣聖”，副标题为“～宿命の刃～”；面板 2 为蓝色标签“新連載!”，标题为“アストラル・コード”，副标题为“～銀河の記憶～”；面板 3 为粉色标签“激推し!”，标题为“エリクシア・ハート”，副标题为“～魔法少女再起動!～”；面板 4 为绿色标签“激推し!”，标题为“喧嘩王キング”，副标题为“～頂上決戦編～”。在右下角附近，添加一张该杂志卷册的小插图，旁边文字写着“最新単行本 第 1 巻 4 月 15 日発売!!”。在最底部，横跨黑色条带放置一行白色免责声明：“※これはファンメイドのフィクションです。実在の雑誌・出版社とは関係ありません。”。使用粗体漫画封面排版、夸张的日本杂志构图、密集的重叠文字、粗边框、爆炸性视觉元素、光面高光、粗粝的霓虹赛博朋克氛围以及精致的动漫插画。

templates.title: Cyberpunk anime releases poster

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克动漫发布海报

templates.prompt: A highly dramatic poster for a Japanese anime release, set against a futuristic, neon-lit metropolis on a rainy night, employs a wide-format cinematic composition, showcasing bright cyberpunk lighting in electric blue, magenta, violet, and red hues. At the top center is a large, metallic silver sci-fi logo with the text {argument name="series title" default="FORMULA NEO"} The right side features a sharp badge, with a small Japanese subtitle below. A large, diagonally angled gold-bordered banner spans the center of the image, bearing a striking black Japanese title.{argument name="main headline" default="TV anime adaptation confirmed!"} Add a line of white Japanese posting information below.{argument name="release text" default="Scheduled to begin airing in April 2027"} Eight anime characters stand side-by-side in the foreground, full-body portraits, facing forward, as if revealing the character lineup: 1) A tall character wearing a white futuristic racing-style jacket and suit with cyan glowing trim, white hair, and a cool demeanor; 2) A red-haired youth wearing a black and orange jacket with flame patterns, dark trousers, sneakers, flame effects surrounding his arms, holding a thick book or tablet-like object; 3) A mysterious figure wearing a purple robe or coat with gold trim, elegant and with a mage-like aura; 4) A key protagonist wearing a dark navy blue or black racing suit with subtle cyan pipe decorations, with a serious posture. 5) A short, tech-savvy character, dressed in dark clothing, with a glowing cyan holographic interface panel surrounding one hand; 6) A silver-haired tough guy, dressed in gray-black tactical streetwear, arms crossed, wearing gloves and a multi-functional belt, with a resolute expression; 7) A green-haired girl, dressed in a casual green and white striped hoodie and trousers, shyly pressing an object against her chest; 8) A blond youth, wearing a mustard yellow vest, a shirt underneath with a black tie, and dark trousers decorated with stars or polka dots, standing next to a pink-haired girl wearing an oversized light-colored hoodie and shorts, looking down at a handheld device. The city background should include towering skyscrapers covered with neon signs, glowing Japanese and Roman letter billboards with a dynamic blur effect, a wet and reflective ground, and several futuristic race cars with red taillights and cyan highlights speeding past on the left and right sides. A small Japanese credits list, including a clearly visible Japanese fictional disclaimer, should be placed at the bottom edge. The visuals should present the quality of an official animated adaptation of a fictional racing and cyberpunk fantasy series, highly refined, with high contrast, poster-quality, and a slightly satirical yet highly persuasive style.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的日本动画发布海报，背景设定在雨夜中充满未来感的霓虹大都市，采用宽画幅电影构图，呈现出电光蓝、洋红、紫罗兰和红色的亮面赛博朋克光影。顶部中心位置是一个巨大的金属银色科幻 Logo，文字为 {argument name="series title" default="FORMULA NEO"}，右侧配有锋利的徽章，下方有小号日文副标题。画面中部横跨一条巨大的斜角金边横幅，上面印有醒目的黑色日文标题 {argument name="main headline" default="TVアニメ化決定！"}。下方添加一行白色的日文发布信息 {argument name="release text" default="2027年4月放送开始予定"}。前景中并排站立着 8 位动漫角色，全身像，面向前方，如同角色阵容揭晓：1）一位身材高大的角色，身穿白色未来感赛车风格外套和套装，带有青色发光饰边，白发，气质冷峻；2）一位红发青年，身穿黑橙色夹克，带有火焰图案，深色长裤，运动鞋，手臂周围环绕火焰特效，手持一本厚书或平板电脑状物体；3）一位神秘人，身穿带有金边的紫色长袍或外套，优雅且带有法师气质；4）一位核心主角，身穿深海军蓝或黑色赛车服，带有细微的青色管道装饰，姿态严肃；5）一位身材较矮的科技型角色，身穿深色服装，单手周围环绕着发光的青色全息界面面板；6）一位银发硬汉，身穿灰黑色战术街头服饰，交叉双臂，戴着手套，系着多功能带，表情坚毅；7）一位绿发少女，身穿休闲的绿白相间连帽衫和长裤，姿态羞涩，将物体紧贴胸前；8）一位金发青年，身穿芥末黄马甲，内搭衬衫系黑领带，穿着带有星形或圆点装饰的深色长裤，站在一位身穿超大号淡色连帽衫和短裤的粉发小女孩旁边，正低头看着手持设备。城市背景应包含高耸入云的摩天大楼，楼体布满霓虹招牌、发光的日文和罗马字母广告牌，带有动态模糊效果，地面湿润且具有反射感，左右两侧有几辆未来感赛车疾驰而过，带有红色尾灯和青色高光。底部边缘居中添加小号日文制作人员名单，包括一行清晰可见的日文虚构免责声明。画面应呈现出一部虚构的赛车与赛博幻想系列作品的官方动画改编视觉主图质感，高度精炼，对比度高，具备海报级水准，风格略带调侃但极具说服力。

templates.title: Hard-hitting film noir style comic book for women

titleLocalized.zh: 硬派黑色电影风格漫画女性页面

templates.prompt: A single-page, high-contrast, ink-wash style, hard-edged black-and-white comic strip, laid out as nine separate panels of varying sizes, each with a diagonal border. The protagonist is a mysterious adult woman who possesses {argument name="hair color" default="black"} With her disheveled long hair, curvaceous figure, and wearing a dark off-the-shoulder knit dress or sweater, adorned with a choker and dangling cross earrings, she is portrayed as a film noir anti-hero. Her face is deliberately obscured in multiple shots through shadows, blurring, or composition, lending her an anonymous and dangerous aura. The page employs dramatic brushstroke textures, rain-soaked city grime, ink splatter, heavy black tones, and cinematic lighting. The first shot in the upper left corner shows a nighttime city skyline with glowing windows in the rain, accompanied by vertical Japanese narration: "この街はいつも雨が降っている" (This street is still raining). The second shot in the upper center is a half-length portrait of the woman, her hair falling over her shoulders, her face obscured. The third shot in the upper right corner shows her back as she walks through narrow alleys or wet streets, accompanied by vertical text: "あたしの名前は谁も知らない" (Your name is unknown). The fourth shot in the middle on the left is an extreme close-up of the eyes, with vertical text: "知ってるのは里の面だけ". The 5th storyboard, left of center, shows an aerial view of the city of a building or block, with vertical text: "金とShと里奇りがこの街のルール". The sixth shot to the right of the center is a close-up of hands, money or violent underground transactions, with vertical text: "でもあたしはそのルールの外で生きてる". The 7th shot in the middle on the right is a partial close-up of a woman in the shadows, with vertical text: " initially the first time I watch." The eighth panel in the lower left corner is a medium shot of a woman standing with her arms crossed, accompanied by the vertical text: "あるのは譲れないたったひとつの相信だけ". Below this is a small illustrated panel showing two people sitting at a bar counter at night, with bottles and dim lighting in the background, accompanied by the vertical text: "夜が明けるまでに片をつける". The dominant ninth panel in the lower right corner shows a woman aiming a gun directly at the viewer using extreme foreshortening perspective, her hair flying and her body leaning forward. The panel is spanned by striking vertical Japanese text: "あたしの正义は" and "あたしが决める". All visible Japanese text remains completely unchanged. It emphasizes the aesthetics of youth crime comics, the tension of tough female vigilantes, the wet neon film noir atmosphere, the rough pen lines, ink splatter, and dramatic panel composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一页高对比度水墨风格的硬派黑白漫画，排版为包含 9 个大小不一、带有对角线边框的独立分镜页面。主角是一位神秘的成年女性，拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="black"} 的凌乱长发、曲线优美的身材，身穿露肩深色针织裙或毛衣，佩戴颈圈和垂坠十字架耳环，被刻画为一名黑色电影风格的反英雄。她的面部在多个分镜中通过阴影、模糊或构图刻意遮挡，赋予其匿名且危险的气质。页面运用了戏剧性的笔触纹理、雨水浸湿的城市污垢、墨点飞溅、厚重的黑色调以及电影般的布光。左上角第 1 分镜展示了雨中带有发光窗户的夜间城市天际线，并配有竖排日语旁白文字：「この街はいつも雨が降っている」。上方中间第 2 分镜是女性正面的半身像，头发散落在肩上，面部被遮挡。右上角第 3 分镜展示了她走在狭窄巷弄或湿润街道上的背影，配有竖排文字：「あたしの名前は誰も知らない」。左侧中间第 4 分镜是眼睛的极端特写，配有竖排文字：「知ってるのは裏の顔だけ」。中间偏左第 5 分镜展示了建筑物或街区的城市俯瞰图，配有竖排文字：「金と嘘と裏切りがこの街のルール」。中间偏右第 6 分镜是手部、金钱或暴力地下交易的特写，配有竖排文字：「でもあたしはそのルールの外側で生きてる」。右侧中间第 7 分镜是女性在阴影中的局部特写，配有竖排文字：「守るものなんか最初からなかった」。左下角第 8 分镜是女性双臂交叉站立的中景，配有竖排文字：「あるのは譲れないたったひとつの信念だけ」，下方配有一个小插图分镜，展示了两人坐在夜间酒吧柜台前，背景有酒瓶和昏暗的灯光，并配有竖排文字：「夜が明けるまでに片をつける」。右下角占据主导地位的第 9 分镜，展示了女性以极端的前缩透视法直接向观众瞄准手枪，头发飞扬，身体前倾，分镜中横跨着醒目的竖排日语大字：「あたしの正義は」和「あたしが決める」。保持所有可见的日语文字完全不变。强调青年犯罪漫画的美学、硬派女义警的张力、湿润的霓虹黑色电影氛围、粗犷的钢笔线条、墨水飞溅以及戏剧性的分镜构图。

templates.title: Farmers in a state of deep immersion in their work

titleLocalized.zh: 沉浸式深度工作状态的农夫

templates.prompt: This is a cinematic, ultra-detailed interior scene of a rural village, depicting a solitary figure.{argument name="subject" default="Elderly farmer"} Seated at a wooden table, he stares intently at a modern laptop, seemingly in deep work mode. He wears a weathered straw hat, a light sage-grey work shirt with the sleeves rolled up, and blue denim overalls. The composition is centered and symmetrical, a medium shot from the front, with his forearms resting on the desk behind the laptop. A dramatic golden energy erupts from behind and around him, forming dazzling sparks, luminous lines, electric wires, and halo-like outlines, making him appear powerful and unstoppable. The room is a warm, emotional farmhouse workspace. A large, multi-pane window on the left lets in soft natural light; on the table are a metal mug containing several pens and pencils, a ceramic mug, an open notebook (with a pen on it), a closed book in the lower left corner, and three books stacked on the right. Against the dim background, two blurry, ghostly or memory-like figures are positioned on the left and right sides, subtly obscured by the luminous energy. Using rich amber and dark brown tones, incorporating dust particles, dramatic backlighting, high contrast, shallow depth of field, and textured wood grain, a heroic surreal atmosphere is created, blending rural life with modern productivity. The style is realistic, highly detailed, with cinematic lighting and a square composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 这是一幅电影级、超细节的乡村室内场景，一位独处的 {argument name="subject" default="年长农夫"} 坐在木桌前，正全神贯注地盯着现代笔记本电脑，仿佛进入了深度工作模式。他戴着一顶饱经风霜的草帽，穿着浅鼠尾草灰色的工作衬衫，袖子卷起，搭配蓝色牛仔背带裤。构图居中且对称，采用正面中景拍摄，双前臂放在笔记本电脑后的桌面上。一股戏剧性的金色能量从他身后及周围爆发开来，形成耀眼的火花、发光的线条、电丝以及如光环般的轮廓，使他看起来充满力量且势不可挡。房间是一个温暖、情绪化的农舍工作空间，左侧有一扇大型多格窗户，投射出柔和的自然光；桌上放着一个装有几支钢笔和铅笔的金属杯、一个陶瓷马克杯、一本打开的笔记本（上面放着一支笔）、左下角有一本合上的书，右侧堆放着三本书。在昏暗的背景中，包含两个模糊的、如同幽灵或记忆般的人影，分别位于左右两侧，被发光的能量隐约遮蔽。使用浓郁的琥珀色和深褐色调，加入尘埃微粒、戏剧性的逆光、高对比度、浅景深、纹理木纹，营造出一种将乡村生活与现代生产力融合的英雄主义超现实氛围。写实风格，超细节，电影级布光，方形构图。

templates.title: Cover of a Japanese professional wrestling magazine

titleLocalized.zh: 日本职业摔角杂志封面

templates.prompt: Create a stunning cover illustration for a Japanese professional wrestling magazine in a dramatic, manga-style aesthetic. Using a vertical, full-frame composition, the compact and vibrant image showcases eight handsome male wrestlers in a wrestling ring under blue and white stadium lights. The background features a blurred, spectator effect, with red ring ropes crisscrossing behind them. All eight men are adults, possessing extremely well-developed, bodybuilder-level muscles, glossy skin, and clearly defined abs, chest, arms, and shoulders, striking poses reminiscent of a special feature lineup for a sports magazine. They are arranged in layers: four wrestlers in the upper half, four in the lower half, with two champions dominating the center foreground. The wrestler on the left, in the center foreground, has short black hair, a confident and serious expression, a clenched right fist, and wears black and gold metallic shorts. The wrestler on the right, in the center foreground, has short, spiky blond hair, a resolute expression, one hand on his hip, and wears bright blue metallic shorts. Surrounding them are six other wrestlers with varying hair colors and styles, including bleached blond, long black bangs, orange spiky hair, and dark brown spiky hair; all are shirtless, wearing professional wrestling shorts in red, blue, gold, or multicolored patterns, some wearing wristbands or glove straps. The design emphasizes glossy skin, magazine-retouched texture, heroic physiques, and slightly exaggerated masculinity. It features a bold commercial cover design, with a large red Japanese masthead at the top edged in gold and highlighted in white.{argument name="magazine title" default="Hot Pro Wrestling"} Below is a smaller English subtitle, "NETTOU PRO-WRESTLING". Above the title is a Japanese tagline: "Professional is the hottest!" In the upper right corner, a blue issue number box containing white text displays {argument name="issue date" default="May 2026 issue"} Large numbers{argument name="issue number" default="5"} The English month and year "MAY 2026" and the small price text "定価1,200円" are displayed. A prominent cover title is placed around the wrestlers, using authentic Japanese magazine layout: on the left is a large yellow and white text "最強代八人集結" (The Strongest Generation of 8 Gathered), accompanied by smaller text "新たな歴史がいま、始まる！ (New History Begins!); on the right is a large white text "美しき筋肉と闘志" (Beautiful Muscles and Fighting Spirit), accompanied by smaller yellow and white subheadings; there is also a red label containing the white text "若きエースたちの現在地" (Wakaki Ace's Present Place) and smaller white text below; in the lower left corner is a black box with "SPECIAL INTERVIEW" in English at the top, and the Japanese names of several interviewees stacked below; in the lower right corner is a cream-colored circular dot that reads "両面BIG ピンナップ付き！ (Two-sided BIG Pinkup Included!)". At the bottom center, add an explosively large Japanese main title: above it is a red ribbon tag "Save Version," and below it is huge gold and red text.{argument name="main headline" default="A special feature on handsome wrestlers"} At the bottom is a small white slogan: "So strong, so beautiful, so lovely, love me!" A barcode is added in the lower right corner, with small numbers below it. Overall appearance: A high-end Japanese sports and entertainment magazine cover—exquisite, gorgeous, vibrant, intense, captivating, rich in content yet easy to read, with accurate Japanese text rendering and authentic editorial hierarchy.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张采用戏剧性青年漫画风格的精美日本职业摔角杂志封面插画。采用垂直全幅构图，画面紧凑且充满活力，展示了 8 位英俊的男性摔角手在蓝白色体育场灯光下的摔角擂台中，背景为模糊的观众虚化效果，红色的擂台绳索在他们身后交错。所有 8 位男性均为成年人，拥有健美运动员级别的极度发达肌肉，皮肤油亮，腹肌、胸肌、手臂和肩膀线条分明，姿态如同体育杂志的特别专题阵容。将他们分层排列：上半部分 4 位摔角手，下半部分 4 位摔角手，中间由 2 位处于前景中心的冠军选手占据主导地位。左侧前景中央的摔角手留着黑色短发，表情自信严肃，右手握拳，身穿黑金配色金属质感短裤。右侧前景中央的摔角手留着金色短刺头，表情坚毅，一手叉腰，身穿亮蓝色金属质感短裤。在他们周围，放置另外 6 位发色和发型各异的摔角手，包括漂白金发、黑色长刘海、橙色刺头和深棕色刺头；他们均赤裸上身，穿着红色、蓝色、金色或多色图案的职业摔角短裤，部分佩戴护腕或手带。强调光泽感、杂志修图后的皮肤质感、英雄般的身体结构以及略带夸张的男性美。采用大胆的商业封面设计，顶部使用巨大的红色带金边和白色高光的日文刊头文字 {argument name="magazine title" default="熱闘プロレス"}，下方配有较小的英文副标题 "NETTOU PRO-WRESTLING"。在标题上方添加一句日文宣传语："プロレスが一番熱い！"。在右上角，加入一个蓝色期号框，内含白色文字，显示 {argument name="issue date" default="2026年5月号"}、大号数字 {argument name="issue number" default="5"}、英文月份年份 "MAY 2026" 以及小号价格文字 "定価1,200円"。在摔角手周围放置醒目的封面专题标题，采用地道的日文杂志排版：左侧为巨大的黄白色文字 "最強世代 8人集結"，辅以较小行文字 "新たな歴史が いま、始まる！"；右侧为巨大的白色文字 "美しき筋肉と闘志"，辅以较小的黄色和白色副标题；另有一个红色标签，内含白色文字 "若きエースたちの現在地" 及下方较小的白色文字；左下角为一个黑色方框，顶部以英文标注 "SPECIAL INTERVIEW"，下方堆叠多位受访者的日文姓名；右下角有一个奶油色圆形爆点，写着 "両面BIG ピンナップ付き！"。在底部中央，添加爆炸性的大号日文主专题标题：上方为红色丝带标签 "保存版"，下方为巨大的金红色文字 {argument name="main headline" default="イケメンレスラー大特集"}，底部配有较小的白色标语："その強さ、その美しさ、そのすべてに恋をする！"。在右下角添加一个条形码，下方配有小型数字。整体外观：高端日本体育娱乐杂志封面，精致、华丽、充满活力、强烈、迷人、内容丰富但易读，且具备准确的日文文字渲染和地道的编辑层级。

templates.title: Side-by-side PPT reconstruction presentation

titleLocalized.zh: 并排 PPT 重构演示

templates.prompt: Using the provided PowerPoint slide screenshot as a reference image, reconstruct it into a clear and beautifully rendered slide conversion, presented in a desktop side-by-side comparison. Maintain the original Japanese slide theme and overall layout, but remove dense selection boxes, editing boxes, and distorted vector artifacts from the reference image to make the slide look professionally reconstructed. Display two panels: the left side is a dark image viewer window displaying the exported slide image; the right side shows the same slide opened in PowerPoint Edit View. Retain the original monochrome infographic style and Japanese text structure, but ensure clear and legible typography, with icons, separators, and columns neatly aligned. Keep the slide as a single-page infographic with five main content areas: one row of top headings/titles, three columns of middle comparison bars, and one row of bottom use case rows containing five icon-embedded items. Include a footer and add the OpenAI logo in the lower right corner. Emphasize that this is a faithful PowerPoint reconstruction based on the uploaded image, presenting a realistic Windows desktop application screenshot look.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的 PowerPoint 幻灯片截图作为参考图像，将其重构为一张清晰、精美的幻灯片转换结果，并以桌面并排对比的形式呈现。保持原有的日文幻灯片主题和整体布局，但删除参考图中密集的选择框、编辑框以及变形的矢量伪影，使幻灯片看起来像经过专业重构一样。显示 2 个面板：左侧为显示导出幻灯片图像的深色图片查看器窗口；右侧为在 PowerPoint 编辑视图中打开的同一幻灯片。保留原始的单色信息图风格和日文文本结构，但要确保排版清晰易读，且图标、分隔线和列对齐整齐。将幻灯片保持为单页信息图，包含 5 个主要内容区域：1 行顶部标题/页眉、3 列页面中部对比栏、1 行底部包含 5 个带图标项目的用例行。包含页脚线条，并在右下角添加 OpenAI 徽标。强调这是基于上传图像的忠实 PPT 重构，并呈现出逼真的 Windows 桌面应用程序截图外观。

templates.title: Starry Blue Anime Girl Floating Illustration

titleLocalized.zh: 星空蓝动漫少女漂浮插画

templates.prompt: A full-body anime illustration depicts a dreamlike starry-sky girl floating diagonally against a pure white background, seemingly weightless in open air, presented from a bird's-eye view. She possesses extremely long, flowing {argument name="hair color" default="Deep Navy Blue"} Her hair, like an elegant ribbon, cascades around her body, shimmering with highlights, stray strands, and adorned with a star-shaped hair ornament on one side of her head. Her face is softly blurred, the composition emphasizing her delicate posture, attire, and the surrounding magical atmosphere. She wears a richly detailed white and blue sailor-style fantasy dress with semi-transparent layered sleeves, ruffled lace, shimmering lace, and lightweight fabric, adorned with a large star-shaped crystal brooch at the chest. The dress contains five clearly visible elements: a short, ruffled dress, a sailor collar and choker, semi-transparent split sleeves or draped chiffon layers, one leg clad in white knee-high stockings, and the other in dark blue star-patterned knee-high stockings with matching garters. She is barefoot, her feet clearly visible. Her posture is graceful and ethereal: one arm outstretched with an open palm, the other placed on her chest, one leg straight, the other slightly bent. Surrounded by luminous constellation patterns in cool blue tones, including six striking pentagrams scattered around her, countless tiny starlight, circular watercolor-style swirls, floating bubbles, and ornate crescent-shaped filigree encircling the canvas. The color scheme uses ice blue, cobalt blue, indigo, and white, complemented by shimmering sequins, soft translucent overlays, clean lines, and a light, ethereal halo. The overall atmosphere is magical, elegant, ethereal, and serene, like a star maiden suspended beneath a winter night sky, presented on a pure white canvas.

templates.title: Dark-themed anime boy with pins and prism light

titleLocalized.zh: 带有别针与棱镜光的暗黑系动漫少年

templates.prompt: A dark, melancholic anime-style illustration depicts a slender boy lying flat on a shadowy floor, shot from a vertical, top-down perspective. He has messy short hair.{argument name="hair color" default="White"} His pale skin, with most of his face obscured by shadow, and the blurred composition create an eerie yet poetic atmosphere. He was wearing {argument name="shirt color" default="White"} The shirt is soaked, wrinkled, and completely open, revealing the chest and abdomen. Thin streams of blood flow from the neck down the torso and lower body, creating a stylized rather than gory visual effect. Ten sewing pins must be precisely drawn in the image, attached to the clothing and around the body: two on the left shoulder and upper sleeve, two near the lower left waist and forearm, three on the right chest and shoulder area, one on the right side of the torso, and two near the lower right hem. An inverted wine glass is placed in the upper left corner, with spilled red wine beside it. A white butterfly rests gently on his lower abdomen. Add diagonal rainbow prism light bands that traverse the dark floor and his body, creating a cinematic high-contrast, soft painterly texture, delicate lines, and a melancholic, symbolic narrative. The overall atmosphere should be tragic, beautiful, ethereal, and unsettling, like the highly dramatic main visual in a psychological anime.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张暗黑、忧郁的动漫风格插画，描绘了一名身材纤细的少年平躺在阴暗的地板上，采用垂直构图的俯视视角。他留着凌乱的短发（{argument name="hair color" default="白色"}），肤色苍白，面部大部分被阴影遮蔽，构图留有模糊感，营造出一种诡异而诗意的氛围。他穿着的 {argument name="shirt color" default="白色"} 衬衫已被浸湿、褶皱且完全敞开，露出了胸部和腹部。细细的血流从颈部顺着躯干和下半身流下，呈现出风格化而非血腥的视觉效果。画面中需精确绘制 10 枚缝纫别针，别在衣物上及身体周围：左肩和上袖处 2 枚，左下侧腰部和前臂附近 2 枚，右胸和肩部区域 3 枚，右侧躯干中部 1 枚，右下摆附近 2 枚。在左上角放置 1 个倒扣的酒杯，旁边洒出红酒。在他的下腹部轻轻停着 1 只白蝴蝶。添加斜向的彩虹棱镜光带，横穿黑暗的地板和他的身体，呈现出电影般的高对比度、柔和的绘画质感、细腻的线条以及忧郁的象征性叙事。整体氛围应悲剧、唯美、空灵且令人不安，如同心理类动漫中极具戏剧性的视觉主图。

templates.title: Q-version Kendo anti-harassment poster

titleLocalized.zh: Q 版剑道反骚扰海报

templates.prompt: A striking Japanese anti-harassment poster, featuring an adorable yet powerful chibi anime style, is framed as a square social media image. At the center of the image, an incredibly cute chibi kendo character in full dark blue protective gear is charging forward, wielding a bamboo sword. The helmet is a dark indigo mask with white grilles and a red inner edge; the torso armor is dark blue with a red body; the waist skirt features the white hiragana character "けんどう" and a small pink cherry blossom badge. The character is striking a purple spiked monster ball representing misconduct. The image also includes four monsters with expressive faces, each bearing a large Japanese label: the top right monster is labeled "defamation," the bottom right "harassment," the bottom left "discrimination," and the left "malicious speech." Each monster is either knocked away or shattered, accompanied by orange-yellow blast shockwaves, flying black fragments, dynamic lines, dust, and beads of sweat on the monster's face. A comic-style speech bubble is added to the left, displaying the Japanese phrase "みんなが気持ちよく楽しめる場所を守るよ！" (We'll protect the place where everyone can enjoy themselves!). A large, vibrant Japanese title is placed at the top, in bold outline: dark blue text "Defamation is..." and bright red text "Absolutely unforgivable!". Two lines of Japanese text are added at the bottom: the first line in bold dark blue "Follow the rules, let's build the best community together!", and the second line in bold red "Violations will be severely punished." Two yellow warning triangle icons are placed in the lower left and lower right corners, for a total of two. The background features a light pink radiating light pattern, complemented by comic-style speed lines and subtle textures. The overall visual effect is clear, high-contrast, user-friendly, and inspiring, much like it would be for social media.{argument name="platform type" default="kendo"} The community created a beautifully illustrated community code of conduct, with the main text and characters surrounded by thick white sticker-like outlines.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张醒目的日本反骚扰宣传海报，采用可爱而有力的 Q 版动漫风格，构图为正方形社交媒体图片。画面中心，一名身穿深蓝色全套护具的超萌 Q 版剑道角色正挥动竹刀，充满动感地向前冲锋。头盔为深靛蓝色面具，配有白色格栅和红色内缘；躯干护具为深蓝色，配有红色胴；腰部垂裙上有白色平假名“けんどう”字样以及一个小小的粉色樱花徽章。角色正在击打代表不良行为的紫色尖刺怪物球。画面中共有 4 个面部表情丰富的怪物，身上分别贴有巨大的日语标签：右上角的怪物标签为“诽谤中伤”，右下角的怪物标签为“嫌がらせ”（骚扰），左下角的怪物标签为“差别”（歧视），左侧的怪物标签为“恶口”（恶语）。每个怪物都被击飞或击碎，伴随着橙黄色的爆炸冲击波、飞溅的黑色碎片、动态线条、灰尘以及怪物脸上的汗珠。在左侧添加一个漫画对话气泡，内容为日语“みんなが気持ちよく楽しめる場所を守るよ！”（我们要守护大家都能愉快享受的地方！）。顶部放置一个巨大的、充满活力的日语标题，采用粗体描边字样：深蓝色文字“诽谤中伤是”和亮红色文字“绝对不可原谅！”。底部添加两行日语文本：第一行为加粗深蓝色文字“遵守规则，让我们一起打造最棒的社区！”，第二行为加粗红色文字“违规行为将受到严厉处理。”。在左下角和右下角各放置一个黄色警告三角图标，总共 2 个。背景采用淡粉色放射状光芒，配以漫画风格的速度线和轻微纹理。整体视觉效果清晰、高对比度、友好且具有激励性，就像为社交媒体上的 {argument name="platform type" default="kendo"} 社区制作的精美社区准则插画，主要文字和角色周围带有厚实的白色贴纸状描边。

templates.title: Soft Gothic Girl with Playing Cards

titleLocalized.zh: 柔和哥特风少女与扑克牌

templates.prompt: A full-body anime illustration depicts an adorable Gothic Lolita girl sitting at a small round table in a softly Gothic-style tea room, facing the viewer with a confident yet mischievous smile. She has {argument name="hair color" default="grayish brown"} Her hair was styled in twin ponytails, tied with two black floral ribbons, complemented by soft bangs, pinkish-purple eyes, and a small black bat hair clip. Her pose was relaxed and playful: one elbow resting on the table, her cheek against her hand, the other hand raised towards the audience, holding a black playing card with a large pink heart and four small pink crosses. She wore a black long-sleeved sailor-style dress with a white collar, a large pink bow at the chest with a heart pendant at the center, a pleated skirt, a black choker with a silver cross pendant, layered silver necklaces, black knee-high socks, heart-shaped suspenders on her thighs, and platform black Mary Jane shoes with multiple straps, silver buckles, heart details, and cross decorations. She added delicate earrings and refined gothic accessories. The room utilized limited {argument name="accent color" default="Black and soft pink"} The color scheme features soft lavender-gray striped wallpaper. Two black curtains with pink fan-shaped trims are added to the upper left and upper right corners, along with a black cross wall hanging, a black bat wall hanging, and two pink heart wall hangings. On the left shelf, two tea sets are displayed: a white teapot with pink hearts and a white teacup with pink hearts. The girl sits in a black chair with a heart-shaped back. In front of her is a small black round table with a pink top. On the table, a cute project in progress is depicted: a rectangular project with alternating light and dark grids, a total of four player pieces (two pink and two dark navy blue), three visible single cards near the project, and three separate stacks of cards to the right of the table. A pink jelly dessert is added to a base plate behind the right side of the table. The floor is a large black and pink checkered pattern. The style should be refined modern animation, with clear lines, soft cel shadows, bright eyes, delicate fabric folds, clean composition, full of charming soft gothic atmosphere, rich accessory details, vertical portrait composition, full-body view, centered character, and a fantastical and fashionable style.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张全身动漫插画，描绘了一位可爱的哥特萝莉少女，她坐在柔和哥特风茶室的一张小圆桌旁，正对着观众，露出自信而调皮的微笑。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="灰褐色"} 的双马尾，发束由 2 条黑色花朵丝带系着，配有柔和的刘海、粉紫色的眼睛以及一个黑色小蝙蝠发夹。她的姿势放松而俏皮：一只手肘撑在桌面上，脸颊靠在手上，另一只手举向观众，手中拿着一张黑色扑克牌，牌面印有一个大粉色爱心和 4 个小粉色十字。她身穿黑色长袖水手风连衣裙，配有白色领子、胸前巨大的粉色蝴蝶结、蝴蝶结中心的爱心吊坠、百褶裙、带有银色十字架挂饰的黑色颈圈、叠戴的银色项链、黑色过膝袜、大腿上的心形环吊带，以及带有多个绑带、银色扣环、心形细节和十字装饰的厚底黑色玛丽珍鞋。添加小巧可爱的耳环和精致的哥特配饰。房间采用有限的 {argument name="accent color" default="黑色与柔和粉色"} 色调，墙纸为柔和的薰衣草灰条纹。在左上角和右上角各添加 2 个带有粉色扇形饰边的黑色窗帘，1 个黑色十字架墙饰，1 个黑色蝙蝠墙饰，以及 2 个粉色爱心墙饰。在左侧搁板上，展示 2 件茶具：1 个带有粉色爱心的白色茶壶和 1 个带有粉色爱心的白色茶杯。少女坐在一张黑色椅子上，椅背呈心形轮廓。她面前是一张黑色小圆桌，桌面为粉色。在桌面上，描绘一个正在进行中的可爱项目：1 个带有明暗交替格子的长方形项目，总共 4 个玩家棋子（2 个粉色和 2 个深海军蓝），项目附近有 3 张可见的单张卡牌，桌子右侧有 3 叠独立的卡牌。在桌子右后方的一个底座盘子上添加 1 个粉色果冻甜点。地板为大型黑粉格纹。风格应为精致的现代动漫，线条清晰，柔和的赛璐珞阴影，明亮的眼睛，细腻的布料褶皱，构图整洁，充满迷人的柔和哥特氛围，配饰细节丰富，竖向肖像构图，全身可见，角色居中，风格奇幻且时尚。

templates.prompt: A clean screenshot of a Windows 11 desktop, displaying an anime wallpaper. The wallpaper showcases {argument name="character name" default="Nezuko Kamado"} The portrait is a centered upper-body shot, facing the viewer directly. Her hands are raised in a playful cat-paw gesture, fingers spread. Her face is completely obscured by a large, vertical rectangular blurred/occluded block in the center. She has flowing hair {argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown to black"} Long hair with soft reddish-orange ends, a small pale pink bow pinned to the right side of her head. She wears a pink geometric-patterned kimono, over which is a dark haori with a pink lining, and a plaid obi with green and reddish-brown trim. Her visible hands are stylized with soft animal paw pads, one in each hand, creating a charmingly mixed effect. The background is a light ice-blue wallpaper with a glossy, abstract Windows 11 blue ribbon shape and subtle diagonal beams of light. Three desktop icons are vertically aligned in the top left corner: This PC, Recycle Bin, and Microsoft Edge. A dark, semi-transparent Windows 11 taskbar is added at the bottom, with centered icons and a system tray on the right, displaying a clock.{argument name="time" default="10:30 AM"} The date is displayed as{argument name="date" default="May 20, 2024"} The overall appearance is exquisite and bright, with an anime style, looking like a real desktop screenshot, with character wallpapers as the visual focus.

templates.title: Tokyo street cinematic color grading

titleLocalized.zh: 东京街头电影感色彩分级

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, while keeping the composition, architecture, towers, street elements, and framing completely unchanged, apply a cinematic gradation of cyan and orange tones. Deepen the blue sky into a darker, richer hue, increase the contrast of the clouds to make them more layered, and warm the sunlight on the buildings and streets to create a golden light and shadow effect at dusk. At the same time, increase the contrast and sharpness, and slightly deepen the shadows to give the entire photo a refined travel photography quality, while ensuring realism and that all signs and details are preserved.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图像，在保持构图、建筑、塔楼、街道元素和取景完全不变的前提下，应用电影感的青橙色色彩分级。将蓝天加深为更暗、更浓郁的色调，增加云层对比度使其更具层次感，将建筑和街道上的阳光调暖，营造出傍晚时分的金色光影效果。同时提高对比度和清晰度，略微加深阴影，使整张照片呈现出精致的旅行摄影质感，并确保真实感以及所有标识和细节得以保留。

templates.title: Key rescue suit monitoring HUD

titleLocalized.zh: 关键救援服监测 HUD

templates.prompt: Create a high-density, futuristic, Japanese sci-fi emergency HUD screen, namely {argument name="unit name" default="SOLJENNE"} The full-screen telemetry dashboard of the rescue suit features a black background with glowing red-orange interface graphics, a thin cyan-blue grid pattern, a worn industrial UI style, and a high-contrast cyberpunk control room aesthetic. The display is a unified monitoring panel divided into 12 clearly defined areas, each with Japanese titles and smaller English subtitles. Top title bar: The left title block displays “SOLJENNE SUIT EXTERNAL MONITORING SYSTEM”, with the English subtitle “SOLJENNE SUIT EXTERNAL MONITORING SYSTEM”, and a small red “LIVE” label; the central red warning banner displays “WARNING”, “危険レベル: MAXIMUM”, and “DANGER LEVEL : MAXIMUM”; the right identity block contains 4 elements, with the text “UNIT ID : SOLJENNE”, “STATUS : CRITICAL”, “MODE : RESCUE / EMERGENCY”, and a red triangle icon, with the text “SOLBRAIN” below and the subtitle “RESCUE & MEDICAL SUPPORT”. The left-middle section, titled "Overall Status," displays the system status "Critical," system integrity "18%," a waveform graph, and five vital sign readings: heart rate 136 bpm, body temperature 39.8°C, blood oxygen saturation 72%, and blood pressure 90/60 mmHg, along with a heart rate status label. The large central section, titled "Main Camera Feed," contains the main image: an injured astronaut in a bright red and silver rescue suit collapses backward in a dark biomechanical environment, with thick black cables or tendrils wrapped around his body. Sparks and debris flicker in the background, the helmet visor reflects light, and a circular blue device is mounted on the chest armor. The lighting is cinematic, and it features a red "REC" indicator and a timestamp "14:32:18:07." Below the camera feed is an emergency information bar divided into three sections: the left side features a warning icon and the text "Emergency Condition"; the center contains a Japanese explanation about an external attack causing the system to exceed its operational limits; and the right side contains red text including "Recommended Action" and "Immediate Rescue Request". The upper right section is titled "Suit System Analysis," accompanied by a red outline of a human body and seven lines of subsystem data: Chest Computer ERROR, Vital Signs Monitoring ERROR, Medical Scanner ERROR, Back Unit Connection ERROR, Mask DAMAGED, Data Link UNSTABLE, and another line showing upper body subsystem errors. The top right section, titled "DAMAGE STATUS," features a damage diagram of the human body outline and eight labeled damage data points: helmet 65%, chest armor 45%, left arm armor 32%, right arm armor 28%, back unit 18%, left leg armor 22%, right leg armor 20%, and boot unit 15%. The middle right section, titled "ENERGY MANAGEMENT," includes a circular gauge displaying "12%" and "MAIN SYSTEM," a countdown timer "00:02:47," and a small power consumption bar graph. The bottom right section, titled "VITAL MONITOR," contains four stacked waveform panels labeled with heart rate 136 bpm, respiration 26 rpm, blood oxygen saturation 72%, and body temperature 39.8°C. The lower left-center area, titled "ENERGY LEVEL," contains three readings: main battery 12%, backup battery 09%, and estimated operating time 00:02:47, all displayed using red segmented bars and bold numbers. The lower left-center area, titled "EXTERNAL ENVIRONMENT," contains five environmental readings: temperature 42.1°C, humidity 89%, air pressure 998 hPa, wind speed 3.8 m/s, and toxic gas 7.2 ppm. Below this is a warning bar with a hazard icon and the Japanese phrase "外外環境も危険レベルです" (This is a dangerous environment). The lower center-center area, titled "THEMAL MAP," displays a frontal thermal imaging scan of the human body, using red, orange, and yellow tones, and is accompanied by vertical color bars. The lower right section, titled "SYSTEM LOG," contains seven timestamped entries in both Japanese and English, including: external attack detected, chest computer overload, abnormal vital signs detected, back unit connection lost, energy below 20%, mask damaged, all systems in critical condition, and emergency rescue request sent. The lower right section, titled "Emergency Warning," features a large red "!!! SOS !!!," Japanese instructions indicating a rescue signal is being sent, and a circular radar beacon graphic. It employs highly detailed UI typography, a compact technical panel layout, glowing lines, scan lines, subtle screen noise, highlighted red warnings, and a somber atmosphere of a life support crisis.

templates.title: Pumas Mascot Stadium Victory

templates.prompt: A dramatic, hyper-realistic photograph of a sporting celebration against a backdrop of a packed football stadium. At the center of the image is a humanized Pumas mascot, leaping through the air in celebration, fists raised high, waving a navy blue flag emblazoned with a large gold Pumas emblem. The mascot has tan fur, a vividly expressive feline head, blue eyes, and black whiskers, wearing a white football jersey with a gold chest badge, white shorts, dark socks, and boots. Surrounding the mascot are enthusiastic fans in navy blue and gold attire, filling the stands to capacity. Four upward-spraying columns of fireworks are added around the stadium, and confetti, in gold and blue, drifts through the air. Three prominent banners and signs are also included: a giant black and gold banner reading "PUMAS," a recurring stadium circular sign reading "¡PUMAS 1º LUGAR!", and sideline advertisements with "LIGA BBVA" and "¡Gooooya!" Bright daylight, striking contrast, a clear shot of the leaping peak, a low-angle wide-angle sports photography composition, a vibrant champion atmosphere, cinematic realism, highly detailed textures, and the mascot clearly focused on while the details of the crowd and stadium in the background remain clearly visible.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的超写实体育庆祝照片，背景为座无虚席的足球场。画面中心是一位拟人化的 Pumas 吉祥物，它在球场半空中腾空跃起，双拳高举庆祝胜利，手中挥舞着一面印有大型金色 Pumas 徽章的深海军蓝旗帜。吉祥物拥有棕褐色的皮毛、表情生动的猫科动物头部、蓝色的眼睛和黑色的胡须纹理，身穿带有金色胸前徽章的白色足球服、白色短裤、深色球袜和球鞋。吉祥物周围是穿着海军蓝和金色服装的狂热球迷，看台座无虚席。在体育场周围添加 4 根向上喷发的烟火烟柱，画面中飘洒着金蓝相间的五彩纸屑。包含 3 处醒目的看台横幅和标牌区域：写有“PUMAS”的巨型黑金横幅、重复出现的写有“¡PUMAS 1º LUGAR!”的体育场环形标牌，以及带有“LIGA BBVA”和“¡Gooooya!”字样的场边广告。明亮的日间阳光，鲜明的对比度，定格在跳跃巅峰的清晰动作，低角度广角体育摄影构图，充满活力的冠军氛围，电影级写实感，高度细腻的纹理，焦点清晰地对准吉祥物，同时背景中的人群和体育场细节依然清晰可见。

templates.title: Helicopters above the city dust cloud

titleLocalized.zh: 城市尘埃云上方的直升机

templates.prompt: A cinematic, hyper-realistic aerial disaster scene, viewed from above and behind a single military transport helicopter flying over a dense urban cityscape at dusk. The helicopter, a dark, weathered matte gray utility helicopter, is tilted to the upper right corner of the frame when viewed from the right rear, clearly showing panel lines, antennas, landing gear, tail stabilizers, and an open side door. Below, a massive, swirling cloud of dust, likely from collapsed or exploding buildings, sweeps through the crowded city, forming a huge, beige-gray mushroom wall of fragments with a turbulent texture; smaller plumes of smoke and swirling particles spread between rooftops. The city below is vast and crowded, with low-rise buildings, narrow streets, scattered lights on rooftops, and distant mist clearly visible in the warm amber sunlight. The scene emphasizes the motion blur of the rotors, the volumetric dust, the dramatic scale, the intense backlighting of sunset, long shadows, atmospheric perspective, the stark contrast between the dark helicopter and the luminous dust, and the tense atmosphere of a war zone or rescue operation. Hyper-realistic, cinematic photography, high detail, lifelike textures, dynamic composition, wide-angle aerial photography, no text, no interface, no other aircraft.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个电影级的超写实空中灾难场景，视角位于一架单体军用运输直升机的后上方，直升机正飞越黄昏时分密集的城市街区。直升机为深色风化哑光灰色的通用直升机，从右后方观察，机身向画面右上角倾斜，清晰可见面板线条、天线、起落架、尾部稳定器以及打开的侧门。在其下方，一团由建筑物坍塌或爆炸引发的巨大翻滚尘埃云穿过拥挤的城市街区，形成一道巨大的米灰色碎片蘑菇墙，具有湍流质感，较小的烟柱和旋转的颗粒感在屋顶间蔓延。下方的城市广阔而拥挤，在温暖的琥珀色调阳光下，低矮的建筑、狭窄的街道、屋顶上零星的亮光以及远处的薄雾清晰可见。强调旋翼的运动模糊、体积感尘埃、戏剧性的规模感、强烈的背光日落照明、长长的阴影、大气透视、深色直升机与发光尘埃之间的强烈对比，以及紧张的战区或救援行动氛围。超写实，大片级摄影，高细节，逼真的材质，动态构图，广角航拍，无文字，无界面，无其他飞行器。

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0, the same kitten was restored to a clear, realistic high-resolution portrait while preserving the frontal composition, the white fur with tan markings on the head, the blue background, and the beige foreground table at the bottom. The face and eyes were sharpened, natural fur details and whiskers were added, the proportions were corrected to resemble a real kitten, lighting and contrast were improved, and severe blur/noise was removed, making it look like a clear DSLR-style pet photo with a shallow depth of field.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用 REFERENCE_0，将同一只小猫还原为清晰、逼真的高分辨率肖像，同时保留正面构图、头部带有灰褐色斑纹的白色皮毛、蓝色背景以及底部的米色前景台面。锐化面部和眼睛，增加自然的皮毛细节和胡须，将比例修正为真实幼猫的样子，改善光影和对比度，并去除严重的模糊/噪点，使其看起来像是一张具有浅景深效果的清晰 DSLR 风格宠物照片。

templates.title: Luxury melon posters from Food Reference

titleLocalized.zh: 来自美食参考的奢华蜜瓜海报

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image of melon slices in a glass bowl, transform it into a high-end luxury product advertising poster. Retain the same fruit and bowl as the main elements, but re-set the scene with dramatic warm gold lighting, a sophisticated black and gold interior background, and a polished marble tabletop. Optimize the fruit's shape to make it appear fresher, juicier, and more expensive, employing a refined commercial food photography retouching style. Compose it as a vertical poster with an elegant, centered metallic gold typography. Include six text elements: the top small print "LIMITED RESERVE," the brand name "POMEE," the main headline "Premium Melon Selection," the subheading "First Harvest Limited Edition - Rare and Exquisite Selection," the body text "Not just fruit, but collector's edition sweetness," and the bottom small print "POMEE LUXURY FRUIT COLLECTION." The overall atmosphere: high-end, unique, and exquisite, like a luxury perfume or jewelry advertisement, but presented as fruit.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的玻璃碗中蜜瓜切片的参考图，将其转化为一张高端奢华的产品广告海报。保留相同的水果和碗作为主体，但通过戏剧性的暖金色灯光、深色黑金风格的高端室内背景以及抛光大理石桌面进行重新布景。优化水果造型，使其看起来更新鲜、更多汁、更昂贵，并采用精致的商业食品摄影修图风格。将其构图为竖版海报，并配以优雅的金属金色居中排版。包含 6 个文本元素：顶部小字“LIMITED RESERVE”、品牌行“珀蜜”、大标题“臻选蜜瓜”、副标题“头茬限定・稀贵甄选”、正文“不是水果，是收藏级鲜甜。”以及底部小字“POMEE LUXURY FRUIT COLLECTION”。整体氛围：高端、独特、精致，如同奢侈香水或珠宝广告，但呈现的是水果。

templates.title: Anime/Fantasy Style Main Visual Project

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫奇幻风格主视觉项目

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic-quality animation key visual and concept art showcase project, with the theme of{argument name="project title" default="Codex & GPT-Image-2"} A fantastical adventure. The main image occupies the upper half: a wide, abandoned stone walkway above the clouds in the night sky leads to a circular observatory-style temple, complete with towers, antennas, and glowing mechanical devices at the top. Brilliant aurora borealis streaks across the distant mountains under a star-studded night sky. Three travelers stand on the bridge in a triangular composition. In the foreground center, a girl with long, pale hair, wearing a flowing white robe and cloak, walks towards the viewer, holding a staff adorned with red rings; her expression is serene and mysterious. To the left, a tall woman with extremely long, deep purple hair, wearing a dark cloak, is slightly turned to the side, gazing towards the building. To the right, a red-haired youth in a brown coat stands with his back to the viewer, carrying a large, dark weapon. The bridge surface is weathered and cracked, inlaid with glowing cyan rune stripes, and flanked by stone pillars and railings. A prominent title is added in the upper right corner, with a smaller Japanese subtitle below.{argument name="subtitle text" default="Aurora of Gray Silver"} Add a short Japanese slogan in the bottom left corner.{argument name="tagline text" default="The journey continues beyond memory."} Below the main image, a row of horizontally arranged detailed concept art in monochrome and soft tones is placed, comprising eight grouped design panels: 1. Full-body view of the white-haired female protagonist's outfit; 2. Expression of the white-haired female protagonist; 3. Accessories and equipment of the female protagonist; 4. Full-body view and details of the purple-haired female protagonist's outfit; 5. Full-body view and weapon of the red-haired male protagonist's outfit; 6. Exterior elevation of the observatory building; 7. Interior and structural reference images of the building; 8. Circular mechanical structure diagram. At the bottom are four environment thumbnails: 1. Abandoned mountain road landscape; 2. Ice-blue bridge or aqueduct environment; 3. Mountain path overlooking the temple; 4. Soaring cathedral-style interior hall. Overall style: A high-end anime/game art proposal project, rich in detail, highly painterly, with dramatic lighting and shadows, using cool blue and cyan tones, complemented by white stone and subtle orange title accents, exquisite layout, full of an epic fantasy sci-fi atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个电影级的动漫主视觉和概念艺术展示项目，主题为 {argument name="project title" default="Codex & GPT-Image-2"} 的奇幻冒险。主图占据上半部分：夜空中云层上方一条广阔的废弃石质栈道，通向一座圆形天文台式的圣殿，圣殿配有塔楼、天线以及顶端发光的机械装置。绚丽的极光在繁星点点的夜空下划过远处的山脉。三名旅人以三角形构图站在桥上。画面中心前景处，一位留着苍白长发、身穿飘逸白袍和斗篷的女孩正走向观众，手持带有红色圆环装饰的法杖；她神情平静而神秘。左侧，一位留着极长深紫色长发、身披深色斗篷的高挑女性微微侧身，望向建筑方向。右侧，一位身穿棕色外套的红发青年背对观众站立，背负着一件大型深色武器。桥面风化开裂，镶嵌着发光的青色符文条纹，两侧设有石柱和栏杆。在右上角添加醒目的大标题，下方配以较小的日文副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="灰銀のアウロラ"}。在左下角添加一行简短的日文标语 {argument name="tagline text" default="旅は、記憶の先へ続いている。"}。在主图下方，放置一排水平排列的单色及柔和色调的详细概念图，包含 8 个分组设计面板：1. 白发女主角全身服装转面图；2. 白发女主角表情图；3. 女主角配饰与装备图；4. 紫发女性服装转面与细节图；5. 红发男性服装转面与武器图；6. 天文台建筑外观立面图；7. 建筑内部与结构参考图；8. 圆形机械结构图。在底部放置 4 个环境缩略图：1. 废弃山路景观；2. 冰蓝色桥梁或引水渠环境；3. 远眺圣殿的山顶路径；4. 高耸的教堂式室内大厅。整体风格：高端动漫游戏艺术提案项目，细节丰富，绘画感强，光影戏剧化，采用冷蓝与青色调，搭配白石色和微妙的橙色标题点缀，布局精致，充满史诗般的奇幻科幻氛围。

templates.title: Retro open-world seaplane game screenshots

titleLocalized.zh: 复古开放世界水上飞机游戏截图

templates.prompt: A third-person game screenshot, styled entirely like an early 21st-century open-world crime game, shows a small white and burgundy seaplane flying low over a tropical coastal city. The camera is positioned directly behind the plane, centered on its tail, as it flies towards a cluster of mid-rise buildings near the seaside. The city below features flat-roofed buildings, palm-lined streets, canals, and bright turquoise waters, with a hazy blue sky and a light atmospheric haze softening the distant scenery. A tall, striped office building stands near the center of the background, with a glowing pink checkpoint ring floating in front of it. To the right are a winding coastline and canals lined with lush palm trees. A retro game HUD is added to the upper right corner, displaying the time as 13:27, a green money value of 500045605, two lines of white health and armor values ​​both at 100, a row of six wanted stars (2 lit, 4 unlit), a small weapon icon within a rounded square, and ammo text displayed as 2076-30. Below it, the quest text "SKIMMER FUEL!" is displayed, along with a horizontal blue progress bar. In the lower left corner, there's a small circular map with a pink border, showing black streets, light-colored land, blue water, a north marker marked with an "N," and a small player arrow. In the lower right corner, location names are displayed in an elegant green cursive font.{argument name="location name" default="Little Havana"} It uses low-poly vehicles and buildings, simple textures, soft shadows, saturated tropical colors, slight screen blur, and the iconic retro feel of action game screenshots from the PlayStation 2 era, with an aspect ratio of 16:9.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张第三人称游戏截图，风格完全模仿 21 世纪初的开放世界犯罪游戏，展示了一架白色和酒红色的小型水上飞机低空飞越热带沿海城市。镜头位于飞机正后方，居中对准机尾，飞机正朝向海滨附近的一组中层建筑飞行。下方的城市拥有平顶建筑、棕榈树林立的街道、运河和明亮的绿松石色海水，天空呈现朦胧的蓝色，轻微的大气雾气柔化了远景。背景中心附近矗立着一座高大的条纹办公大楼，建筑物前方漂浮着一个发光的粉色检查点圆环。右侧是弯曲的海岸线和排列着茂密棕榈树的运河。在右上角添加复古游戏 HUD，显示时间为 13:27，绿色金钱数值为 500045605，两行白色的生命值和护甲值均为 100，一行 6 颗通缉星（2 颗点亮，4 颗熄灭），一个圆角正方形内的小型武器图标，以及显示为 2076-30 的弹药文本。在其下方，显示任务文本“SKIMMER FUEL!”以及一条水平的蓝色进度条。在左下角，包含一个带有粉色边框的圆形小地图，显示黑色街道、浅色陆地、蓝色水域、标有 N 的北向标记以及一个小型的玩家箭头。在右下角，以优雅的绿色草书字体覆盖显示地点名称 {argument name="location name" default="Little Havana"}。使用低多边形车辆和建筑、简单的纹理、柔和的阴影、饱和的热带色彩、轻微的屏幕模糊，以及 PlayStation 2 时代动作游戏截图那种标志性的怀旧感，画面比例为 16:9。

templates.title: Isometric JRPG Town Plaza Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 等距视角 JRPG 城镇广场场景

templates.prompt: A richly detailed isometric town scene in the style of a classic JRPG, inspired by fantasy role-playing games from the late 1990s. The visuals employ a high-angle, three-quarter-view perspective reminiscent of pre-rendered game backgrounds, complemented by hand-drawn textures and small, pixelated characters. In the center of a sun-drenched stone plaza, two young adventurers converse face-to-face: one a boy with spiky red hair, wearing a blue tunic, an orange scarf, brown gloves, and sturdy boots; the other a girl with long, blonde hair tied in a high ponytail, wearing a light mint green dress over a white short-sleeved top and brown shoes. Weathered cobblestone streets surround them, the soft afternoon light casting long, dramatic shadows. Above, in the center, stands an ornate stone bell archway with two carved columns entwined with vines; beneath the arch is a neatly manicured rectangular lawn dotted with tiny yellow flowers. The upper left corner features an entrance to a stall or tent with a purple canopy and patterned carpet, inside which stands a chibi-style NPC merchant dressed in green with an orange vest. The lower section is surrounded by elegant white stone railings, featuring two recessed flowerbeds filled with red flowers and several staircases leading down to the plaza. Four red flags with gold badges are added, hanging from silver flagpoles, two on each side, fluttering diagonally. The architectural style should evoke a medieval fantasy feel while remaining clean and charming, featuring highly detailed masonry, vibrant vegetation, a nostalgic console-era adventure game atmosphere, and refined remastered pixel art effects. The visuals contain no user interface or text.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个细节丰富的经典 JRPG 风格等距城镇场景，灵感源自 20 世纪 90 年代末的奇幻角色扮演游戏。画面采用类似预渲染游戏背景的高位四分之三俯视视角，配以手绘纹理和小型像素风格角色。在阳光明媚的石砌广场中央，2 位年轻的冒险者角色正面对面交谈：一位是留着尖刺红发的少年，身穿蓝色束腰外衣，系着橙色围巾，戴着棕色手套，脚蹬结实的靴子；另一位是扎着高马尾的金色长发少女，身穿淡薄荷绿连衣裙，内搭白色短袖上衣，脚穿棕色鞋子。周围铺设着风化的鹅卵石路面，午后的柔和光线投射出长长的戏剧性阴影。在上方中央，放置一座装饰精美的石制钟拱门，带有 2 根雕花立柱，柱子上缠绕着藤蔓，钟拱下方是一个修剪整齐的长方形草坪，点缀着细小的黄色花朵。左上方包含一个紫色顶棚的摊位或帐篷入口，铺有花纹地毯，里面站着 1 位身穿绿衣、外罩橙色背心的 Q 版 NPC 商人。下半部分由优雅的白色石栏杆环绕，设有 2 个种满红色花朵的凹槽花坛，以及多条通往广场下方的阶梯。添加 4 面带有金色徽章的红色旗帜，分别挂在银色旗杆上，左右两侧各 2 面，旗帜呈对角线飘动。建筑风格应呈现出中世纪奇幻感，同时保持整洁迷人，具备高度精细的砌体结构、生机勃勃的植被、怀旧的家用机时代冒险游戏氛围，以及精致的重制版像素艺术效果，画面中不包含任何用户界面或文字。

templates.title: Desktop layout audit information diagram

titleLocalized.zh: 桌面布置审计信息图

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0, transform the accompanying desktop photo and its text description into a concise, edit-style infographic poster. Create a left-right comparison chart with two labeled photo panels: the left side, "Current Arrangement," uses the original scene; the right side, "Optimized Arrangement," showcases an ideal, improved version of the same room and desktop from a matching angle. Add a prominent, large serif font title at the top with the following text:{argument name="headline text" default="Desktop layout audit"} Around the left panel, add five issue label cards connected by guide lines: 1) Monitor Height — 👍 Acceptable — “Screen distance is acceptable, but eye focus is scattered” — Label “Neck fatigue”; 2) Seating Position — ❌ Severe Impact — “Low recliner, insufficient support” — Label “Back pain + hunchback”; 3) Lighting — ⚠️ Energy-draining — “Mixed light sources + side glare” — Label “Eye strain”; 4) Cable Management — ❌ Severe Impact — “Cluttered cables on the desktop and floor” — Label “Visual distraction/tripping risk”; 5) Clutter — ⚠️ Energy-draining — “Tools, boxes, and papers piled up” — Label “Distracting attention”. Add a red “Priority Fix” badge to the seating position issue. Around the right panel, add five improved tabs: 1) Monitor Height — ✅ Good — “Main screen centered, eye level”; 2) Seat Position — ✅ Good — “Seated with feet flat, elbows approximately 90°”; 3) Lighting — ✅ Good — “Soft front lighting, reduced glare”; 4) Cable Management — ✅ Good — “Cables stored under the desk”; 5) Clutter — ✅ Good — “Workspace tidy, equipment clearly zoned”. The optimized panel visually demonstrates the improvements: the main monitor is centered, the laptop is below, an ergonomic office chair is provided, the desktop is tidier, cables are hidden under the desk, the lighting is soft and balanced, and a small drawer cabinet has been added to the right while maintaining the original room layout. Add a legend at the bottom containing five items: “Legend,” “Priority Fix,” “Good,” “Acceptable,” “Energy-Consuming,” and “Severe Impact.” Four boxed areas have been added at the bottom: 1) "Free Fixes" includes 3 items: "Primary Fixes: Adjust Posture/Say Goodbye to Slouching", "Center Main Monitor", "Clean Up Desktop and Floor Clutter"; 2) "Under $50" includes 3 items: "Velcro Cable Ties + Under-Desk Cable Management", "Lumbar Support or Footrest", "Minimalist Desktop Organizer"; 3) "Worth the Investment" includes 3 items: "Ergonomic Office Chair", "Monitor Stand for Perfect Alignment", "Closed Locker/Drawer"; 4) "Focus Prediction" displays two dashboards labeled "Current: 2.5 hours/day" and "After Completing the First 3 Fixes: 5.5 hours/day", with a green capsule label showing "+3.0 hours". It adopts a sophisticated magazine infographic aesthetic, using soft green and cream tones, paired with rounded borders, minimalist text, clear icons, thin connecting lines, and beautiful typography suitable for social media sharing.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用 REFERENCE_0，将附带的桌面照片及其文字说明转化为一张简洁的编辑风格信息图海报。创建一个包含 2 个标注照片面板的左右对比图：左侧为“当前布置”，使用原始场景；右侧为“优化布置”，以匹配的角度展示同一房间和桌面的理想改进版本。在顶部添加一个醒目的大号衬线字体标题，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="桌面布置审计"}。在左侧面板周围，添加 5 个由引导线连接的问题标注卡：1) 显示器高度 — 👍 可接受 — “屏幕距离尚可，但视线焦点分散” — 标签“颈部疲劳”；2) 座椅位置 — ❌ 严重影响 — “低矮休闲椅，支撑不足” — 标签“背痛 + 驼背”；3) 照明 — ⚠️ 损耗精力 — “混合光源 + 侧面眩光” — 标签“视疲劳”；4) 线缆管理 — ❌ 严重影响 — “桌面及地面线缆杂乱” — 标签“视觉干扰 / 绊倒风险”；5) 杂物 — ⚠️ 损耗精力 — “工具、盒子、纸张堆积” — 标签“注意力分散”。在座椅位置问题处添加一个红色的“首要修复”徽章。在右侧面板周围，添加 5 个改进后的标注卡：1) 显示器高度 — ✅ 良好 — “主屏幕居中，与视线齐平”；2) 座椅位置 — ✅ 良好 — “座椅推入，双脚平放，肘部约 90°”；3) 照明 — ✅ 良好 — “柔和前置光，眩光减少”；4) 线缆管理 — ✅ 良好 — “线缆收纳于桌下”；5) 杂物 — ✅ 良好 — “工作区整洁，设备分区明确”。在优化后的面板中，直观展示改进效果：主显示器居中，笔记本电脑置于下方，配备人体工学办公椅，桌面更整洁，线缆隐藏于桌下，光线柔和平衡，右侧增加一个小抽屉柜，同时保持房间原貌。在底部添加包含 5 个项目的图例：“图例”、“首要修复”、“良好”、“可接受”、“损耗精力”、“严重影响”。在最下方添加 4 个方框区域：1) “免费修复”包含 3 项： “首要修复：调整坐姿 / 告别低矮瘫坐”、“居中摆放主显示器”、“清理桌面及地面杂物”；2) “50 美元以下”包含 3 项： “魔术贴扎带 + 桌下理线槽”、“腰靠或脚垫”、“简约桌面收纳盒”；3) “值得投资”包含 3 项： “人体工学办公椅”、“显示器支架以实现完美对齐”、“封闭式储物柜 / 抽屉”；4) “专注力预测”显示 2 个仪表盘，分别标注为“当前：2.5 小时/天”和“完成前 3 项修复后：5.5 小时/天”，并配有一个绿色胶囊标签显示“+3.0 小时”。采用精致的杂志信息图美学，使用柔和的绿色与奶油色调，搭配圆角边框、极简文字、清晰图标、细连接线，以及适合社交媒体分享的精美排版。

templates.title: Paris Eiffel Tower vacation selfie

titleLocalized.zh: 巴黎埃菲尔铁塔度假自拍

templates.prompt: A hyper-realistic vacation selfie shows a young woman standing directly beneath the Eiffel Tower in Paris, taken from a dramatic low angle with her phone positioned below her chest, making the tower appear to tower above her and fill the entire background. She is centered in the frame, the shot framing her mid-thigh upwards, her body slightly leaning forward, one arm outstretched – a classic selfie angle. She keeps {argument name="hair color" default="Medium brown"} Her shoulder-length straight hair, naturally parted to the side, was gently tousled by the breeze. Her skin was fair and warm, and she wore casual summer clothing. She was dressed in {argument name="top color" default="light pink"} A fitted ribbed strapless top, paired with{argument name="pants color" default="White"} High-waisted jeans, paired with a delicate silver chain necklace. Bright midday sunlight, a cloudless deep blue sky, crisp shadows, realistic skin texture, natural travel photo imperfections, authentic phone camera sharpness, casual tourist snapshot aesthetics, slight wide-angle lens distortion, a relaxed and confident pose, and a laid-back social media vacation vibe. The Eiffel Tower's symmetrical composition, its iron arches encircling her body, the structure extending to the very top of the image, makes it look like a photograph {argument name="location" default="Paris"} These are authentic, spontaneous summer travel photos, hyper-realistic with detailed metal mesh structures and vibrant, natural colors.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超写实的度假自拍，一位年轻女性站在巴黎埃菲尔铁塔正下方，采用戏剧性的低角度拍摄，手机置于胸部下方，使铁塔在头顶上方高耸并填满整个背景。她位于画面中央，取景范围从大腿中部向上，身体微微前倾，一只手臂向前伸展，呈现经典的自拍视角。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="中棕色"} 的齐肩直发，头发自然侧分，被微风轻轻吹乱，肤色白皙温暖，穿着休闲的夏季服装。她身穿 {argument name="top color" default="浅粉色"} 的修身罗纹抹胸，搭配 {argument name="pants color" default="白色"} 高腰牛仔裤，佩戴一条精致的细银链项链。明亮的正午阳光，万里无云的深蓝色天空，清晰的阴影，真实的皮肤纹理，自然的旅行照片瑕疵，真实的手机摄像头清晰度，休闲游客快照美学，轻微的广角镜头畸变，轻松自信的姿势，随性的社交媒体度假风。埃菲尔铁塔构图对称，其铁质拱门环绕着她的身体，结构延伸至图像的最顶端。使其看起来像是一张在 {argument name="location" default="巴黎"} 拍摄的真实自发夏季旅行照片，超写实，精细的金属网格结构，色彩鲜艳且自然。

templates.title: Retro AI Creative Brand Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 复古 AI 创意品牌海报

templates.prompt: Create a retro, cinematic personal brand poster, employing a distressed style that combines 1970s posters and movie advertisements. The horizontal composition features a heavy, worn black border, rough paper texture, ink smudging, halftone dots, edge wear, and aged printing flaws. Use a limited but bold color palette comprised of deep black, warm beige, saturated poster red, and mustard yellow. The composition is a unified poster, with the left side {argument name="character name" default="HOSSEIN"} A large-scale cropped portrait, a half-length portrait, shows the subject wearing dark sunglasses, a dark shirt, a chain necklace, and a mustard yellow jacket, with short, neat dark hair; the face is deliberately obscured by a soft gray-brown rectangular block of color in the center, creating an editorial sense of anonymity. On the far left is a vertical black panel containing two stacked "AI" squares and a subheading: the top square reads "AI," the subheading below is "CREATIVE AGENT," and below that is a large "AI" superimposed on a gold project graphic. Slightly to the right of center is a main diagonal beige title band with a large, compressed black font displaying the name.{argument name="main name text" default="HOSSEIN"} The title bar on the far right features a large red "AI". Below the large name, add a smaller, stretched subtitle: "AI CINEMATOGRAPHER · ADVERTIVE FOR BRAND". In the upper right corner, add a three-line stacked title with the following content:{argument name="top right headline" default="AI CINEMATOGRAPHER ADVERTIVE FOR BRAND"} Use bold beige text on a red background. In the red area below the title band, include four stacked black label boxes containing beige text: “CINEMATOGRAPHER,” “AI CREATOR,” “VISUAL ARTIST,” and “BRAND ADVISOR.” Near the right, add a three-line handwritten white cursive note: “Visual Storyteller,” “Brand Builder,” and “AI Explore.” Below, arrange six creative tech items: a circular orange graphic icon, a white audio waveform/equalizer graphic, a black clapperboard labeled “AI,” an open silver laptop, a pair of black headphones, and a professional film camera body with a prominent “RED” logo; the bottom right should also include the edge of a music keyboard/controller. In the lower right corner, place a small, dark terminal-style text block with tiny white monospaced font lines, hinting at AI-generated visuals and analytical data. Keep the overall design bold, raw, and highly graphic, like a high-end personal brand poster created for an AI creative director and visual storyteller.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张复古电影感个人品牌海报，采用 1970 年代宣传画与电影广告相结合的做旧风格，横向构图，带有厚重的磨损黑色边框、粗糙纸张纹理、油墨晕染、半调网点、边缘磨损及陈旧印刷瑕疵。使用深黑、暖米色、饱和海报红和芥末黄组成的有限大胆配色。构图为一张统一的海报，左侧为 {argument name="character name" default="HOSSEIN"} 的大尺寸裁剪肖像，半身像，佩戴深色墨镜，身穿深色衬衫、链条项链和芥末黄色夹克，留着干练的深色短发；面部被中间一个柔和灰褐色的矩形色块刻意遮挡，营造出一种编辑风格的匿名感。在最左侧放置一个垂直黑色面板，包含 2 个堆叠的“AI”方块和 1 行副标题：顶部方块写着“AI”，下方副标题为“CREATIVE AGENT”，下方还有一个巨大的“AI”叠加在金色项目图形上。在中心偏右位置，放置一条主要的对角线米色标题带，上面印有巨大的黑色压缩字体，显示名称 {argument name="main name text" default="HOSSEIN"}，标题带最右侧是一个超大的红色“AI”。在大名称下方，添加一行拉伸的小字副标题：“AI CINEMATOGRAPHER · ADVERTIVE FOR BRAND”。在右上角，添加一个 3 行堆叠的标题，内容为 {argument name="top right headline" default="AI CINEMATOGRAPHER ADVERTIVE FOR BRAND"}，使用红色背景上的粗体米色文字。在标题带下方的红色区域，包含 4 个堆叠的黑色标签框，内嵌米色文字：“CINEMATOGRAPHER”、“AI CREATOR”、“VISUAL ARTIST”和“BRAND ADVISOR”。在右侧附近，添加一段 3 行的手写白色草书笔记：“Visual Storyteller”、“Brand Builder”和“AI Explore”。在下方区域，排列 6 个创意科技物品：1 个圆形橙色图形图标、1 个白色音频波形/均衡器图形、1 个标有“AI”的黑色场记板、1 台打开的银色笔记本电脑、1 副黑色耳机和 1 台带有明显“RED”标识的专业电影摄像机机身；底部右侧还需包含音乐键盘/控制器的边缘。在右下角，放置一个小型的深色终端风格文本块，带有微小的白色等宽字体线条，暗示 AI 生成的视觉效果和分析数据。保持整体设计大胆、粗粝且极具图形感，如同为 AI 创意总监和视觉叙事者打造的高级个人品牌海报。

templates.title: Minimalist Abstract Tech Poster

templates.prompt: A minimalist abstract graphic poster, using a 16:9 widescreen composition, features a soft pale purple and light gray background composed of six wide horizontal color bands with a subtle left-to-right gradient effect. A striking black abstract symbol, resembling a stylized curved geometric mark or a cropped ribbon logo, is placed at the very center. It has a flat top, extends downwards into a graceful arc, and is compact at the bottom. The design remains extremely simple and empty, devoid of text, shadows, textures, and superfluous elements. Smooth vector-style edges present a soft, modern brand aesthetic and a cool, contemporary technological visual language.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极简抽象图形海报，采用 16:9 宽屏构图，背景为柔和的淡紫色与浅灰色，由 6 条宽阔的横向色带组成，并带有微妙的从左至右渐变效果。在正中心放置一个醒目的黑色抽象符号，形似风格化的曲线几何标记或裁剪后的丝带状 Logo，顶部平整，向下延伸出优美的弧线，底部紧凑。保持设计极其简洁、空旷，无文字、无阴影、无纹理，且无多余元素。采用平滑的矢量风格边缘，呈现出柔和的现代品牌美学以及冷静的当代科技视觉语言。

templates.title: Warm and cozy home peach-cutting portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 温馨居家切桃人像

templates.prompt: A realistic portrait taken with a smartphone, depicting a {argument name="person" default="young women"} The scene depicts her standing in the kitchen or near the dining table, slicing ripe peaches on a white plastic cutting board. The subject is centered in the frame, the subject positioned approximately from mid-thigh to above the waist, her body slightly tilted towards the camera, creating a casual, candid pose. She has very thick, long, dark brown to black natural curly hair, with distinct curls and subtle light brown highlights, falling over her shoulders and partially obscuring her cheeks. She is wearing an oversized top.{argument name="hoodie color" default="Dark brown"} The hooded sweatshirt with its loose cuffs lends the scene a relaxed, homey feel. One hand holds a kitchen knife vertically, slicing a peach slice in the center of the cutting board, while the other hand supports the fruit. Seven peach slices are clearly visible on the cutting board: three smaller slices on the left, one slice being sliced ​​in the middle, and three larger slices (including half a peach) on the right. The tabletop is made of light-colored wood. The room is warmly lit with beige walls and ceiling. A dark ceiling fan with three blades is visible in the upper left corner, two framed botanical paintings hang on the left wall, a potted green plant is in the lower left corner, a light sage-green chair is behind the table, a glowing white round paper lantern hangs on the right, and a rainbow-colored wall hanging or reflective fabric panel is in the background to the right rear. The use of soft indoor lighting, natural skin tones, delicate shadows, realistic fruit textures and knife details, documentary-style composition, and shallow to medium depth of field creates an authentic and genuine everyday home aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实的竖版智能手机照片，拍摄了一位 {argument name="person" default="年轻女性"} 站在厨房或餐桌旁，在白色塑料切菜板上切熟桃子的场景。主体位于画面中心，取景范围约为大腿中部或腰部以上，身体微微向镜头倾斜，呈现出随意的抓拍姿态。她留着非常浓密、长且深棕至黑色的天然卷发，发丝卷曲分明并带有少量浅棕色挑染，垂在肩头并部分遮住脸颊两侧。她穿着一件超大号的 {argument name="hoodie color" default="深棕色"} 连帽衫，袖口宽松，赋予画面一种轻松的居家生活感。一只手垂直握着厨房刀，正在切开位于切菜板中央的桃瓣，另一只手扶着水果。切菜板上清晰可见 7 块桃子：左侧有 3 块较小的桃瓣，中间有 1 块正在切开的桃瓣，右侧有 3 块较大的桃子（包括半个桃子）。桌面为浅色木纹。房间光线温暖舒适，背景为米色墙壁和天花板，左上方可见一台带有 3 片扇叶的深色吊扇，左侧墙上挂有 2 幅植物画框，左下角背景处有一盆绿叶植物，桌后有一把浅鼠尾草绿色的椅子，右侧悬挂着一个发光的白色圆纸灯笼，右后方背景处有一块彩虹色调的墙面挂饰或反光织物面板。采用柔和的室内光线、自然的肤色、细腻的阴影、写实的水果纹理和刀具细节、纪录片风格的构图、浅至中等的景深，营造出真实地道的日常居家美学。

templates.prompt: This is a minimalist 3D studio product rendering. An open laptop sits atop a modular, matte black industrial cube base. The image is slightly to the left, with a clean, pale purple background and a soft purple halo emanating from the lower left corner. The laptop is positioned three-quarters of the way to the right, featuring narrow black bezels and a slim, dark chassis. The screen is open approximately 100 degrees. The screen displays {argument name="brand name" default="Teoroa"} The minimalist web design portfolio homepage features a white interface with a wide, horizontal, light purple gradient strip across the main section. An abstract bird-shaped logo is located in the upper left corner, followed by the brand name; the top navigation bar contains four menu items: Home, Works, Studio, and News, with a separate Contact link on the far right. The title is placed in the upper right corner of the main section.{argument name="headline text" default="Designing intelligent visual systems with advanced artificial intelligence for modern digital experiences."} It uses a clean, modern black sans-serif font, with a small link below containing the text {argument name="cta text" default="Let's Connect →"} Large, cropped black text is displayed in the visible area at the bottom of the screen.{argument name="large title" default="Teoroo Studio™"} The laptop's base is a collection of modular, speaker-like metal cubes with perforations, circular ports, screws, recessed panels, and a grille texture. promptLocalized.zh: 一款极简主义 3D 工作室产品渲染图，一台打开的笔记本电脑放置在模块化哑光黑色工业立方体底座上，画面略微偏左，背景为干净的淡紫色，左下角散发出柔和的紫色光晕。笔记本电脑呈四分之三侧面朝右，配有窄黑色边框和纤薄的深色机身，屏幕打开约 100 度。屏幕上显示 {argument name="brand name" default="Teoroa"} 的极简网页设计作品集主页，采用白色界面，英雄区横跨宽大的水平淡紫色渐变带。左上角是一个抽象的小鸟状标志，后跟品牌名称；顶部导航栏包含 4 个菜单项：Home、Works、Studio、News，最右侧有一个独立的 Contact 链接。在英雄区右上方，放置标题 {argument name="headline text" default="Designing intelligent visual systems with advanced artificial intelligence for modern digital experiences."}，采用简洁现代的黑色无衬线字体，下方有一个小链接，文字为 {argument name="cta text" default="Let's Connect →"}。在屏幕下方的可见区域，显示超大裁剪的黑色排版文字 {argument name="large title" default="Teoroo Studio™"}。笔记本电脑下方的底座是一堆模块化扬声器式的金属立方体，带有穿孔、圆形端口、螺丝、凹槽面板和格栅纹理；正面中心部分为半透明亮黑色，露出内部机械细节，包括 2 个螺旋弹簧元件、3 个淡紫色圆形连接器装饰和 2 个悬挂的小型线缆状挂钩。添加微妙的反射、逼真的工作室灯光、柔和的阴影以及高端的未来工业设计美感。构图简洁优雅，留白充足，黑色物体与柔和背景之间形成高对比度，呈现出精致的艺术指导科技广告质感。

templates.title: A prototype holding a smartphone under neon lights

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹灯光下握持智能手机的样机

templates.prompt: A minimalist photograph shows a hand holding a modern smartphone vertically against a smooth, pale purple-to-pink gradient background. The composition is slightly to the left, with the forearm entering from the lower right corner, the hand naturally enveloping the phone, fingers visible on the left edge, and the thumb on the right. Dramatic neon film lighting effects are used, with a cool blue light on the left side of the hand and a deep magenta shadow on the right, creating a futuristic, tech-advertising atmosphere. The phone appears to be a high-end, full-screen device with black bezels, rounded corners, and a pill-shaped front-facing camera cutout at the top. The screen displays a clean, monochrome tech product landing page: a small, abstract black logo in the upper left corner, a small circular button labeled "Menu" in the upper right corner, two large, light-colored rectangular placeholders near the top, and centered text at the bottom. The main title is displayed as {argument name="headline text" default="Welcome to the future of design with Terot"} The smaller gray text below is displayed as {argument name="body text" default="Create intelligent design systems and AI-powered visual experiences."} Below, there are two clear call-to-action elements: one labeled with {argument name="primary button text" default="Create account"} The round outline button, and below it labeled{argument name="secondary button text" default="Login"} Simple text links. The overall style is fashionable, high-end, editorial, and cinematic, with soft shadows, realistic skin textures, delicate screen glow, and ample white space.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极简主义风格的摄影作品，展示了一只人手在平滑的淡紫色至粉色渐变背景前，垂直握持着一部现代智能手机。构图略微偏左，前臂从右下角切入，手部自然包裹住手机，手指可见于左侧边缘，拇指位于右侧。采用戏剧性的霓虹胶片灯光效果，手部左侧呈现冷蓝色光，右侧则是深洋红色阴影，营造出一种充满未来感的科技广告氛围。手机应呈现为高端的全面屏设备，带有黑色边框、圆角设计以及顶部的药丸状前置摄像头开孔。屏幕上显示一个简洁的单色设计科技产品落地页：左上角有一个小型抽象黑色 Logo，右上角有一个标有“Menu”的圆形小按钮，顶部附近堆叠着 2 个宽大的浅色矩形占位内容块，下半部分为居中的引导文案。主标题显示为 {argument name="headline text" default="Welcome to the future of design with Terot"}。下方较小的灰色正文显示为 {argument name="body text" default="Create intelligent design systems and AI-powered visual experiences."}。在下方，包含 2 个明确的行动号召元素：一个标有 {argument name="primary button text" default="Create account"} 的圆形轮廓按钮，以及下方一个标有 {argument name="secondary button text" default="Login"} 的简单文本链接。整体风格时尚、高端、具有编辑感和电影质感，带有柔和的阴影、逼真的皮肤纹理、细腻的屏幕光晕以及充裕的留白。
