templates.title: Japanese Children's Day Photo Card

titleLocalized.zh: 日本儿童节照片卡

templates.prompt: A soft, clear photograph, set against a warm off-white background, presents a minimalist Japanese greeting card aesthetic. In the image, a child of preschool age runs joyfully towards the camera from the left, holding aloft a long pole with two carp streamers attached: a large blue one above and a smaller red one below. The child wears a simple handmade paper samurai helmet, a loose ivory long-sleeved shirt, rolled-up light beige trousers, and white sneakers. The focus is on capturing dynamism, innocence, and a seasonal atmosphere, keeping facial features indistinct and generic. The illustrations are delicately hand-drawn, with lines as fine as gray pencil and soft, muted colors, adorning the children's space: two fluffy clouds, a bird, a small origami crane beside the text, four falling leaves, two wisps of wind, a small house, two tall trees, two purple irises in the lower left corner, and a patch of grass with sparse patches of grass scattered on the ground. On the right, elegant handwritten Japanese text is added.{argument name="headline text" default="Children's Day"} Below is smaller Japanese text.{argument name="subtext" default="Wishing you healthy growth."} At the bottom is an English subtitle in a light, handwritten style.{argument name="english subtitle" default="Children's Day"} The clean editing and layout, with ample negative space, and the use of natural and soft lighting, along with a color palette dominated by soft cream and beige tones, accented with delicate blue and red, present a calm and high-end lifestyle photography feel with soft shadows, making it perfect for seasonal holiday greeting cards or social media posts.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张柔和、通透的摄影作品，采用温暖的米白色背景，呈现出极简的日式贺卡美学。画面中，一名幼儿至学龄前阶段的孩童正从左中方欢快地向镜头跑来，一只手高高举着一根长杆，杆上系着 2 条鲤鱼旗：上方为 1 条大型蓝色鲤鱼旗，下方为 1 条较小的红色鲤鱼旗。孩童戴着简单的手工纸折武士头盔，身穿宽松的象牙白长袖衬衫、卷边浅米色长裤和白色运动鞋。保持面部特征不明显且通用，重点在于捕捉动感、纯真和季节氛围。在孩童周围点缀精致的手绘涂鸦插画，线条如灰色铅笔般细腻，并带有淡淡的柔和色彩：2 朵蓬松的云、1 只飞鸟、文字旁 1 只小折纸鹤、4 片飘落的叶子、2 簇弯曲的风线、1 座小屋、2 棵高大的树、左下角 2 朵紫色鸢尾花及草地，地面上散布着稀疏的草痕。在右侧，添加优雅的日文手写文字 {argument name="headline text" default="こどもの日"}，下方配以较小的日文文本 {argument name="subtext" default="すこやかな\n成長を願って。"}，最下方为轻盈手写体风格的英文副标题 {argument name="english subtitle" default="Children's Day"}。采用干净的编辑排版，留出充足的负空间，运用自然柔和的灯光，色调以柔和的奶油色和米色为主，辅以淡雅的蓝色和红色点缀，呈现出带有柔和阴影的平静、高端生活方式摄影质感，非常适合作为季节性节日贺卡或社交媒体贴文。

templates.title: Minimalist Japanese cooking course main image

titleLocalized.zh: 极简日式烹饪课程主图

templates.prompt: A soft, light{argument name="class theme" default="Japanese Home Cooking Course"} The main promotional image features a warm, off-white background, adopting a minimalist lifestyle flyer style. The left half showcases two figures: an adult woman and a little girl cooking together on a white kitchen countertop. Both are relaxed and natural, their body language gentle. The woman stands slightly behind and to the left of the girl, leaning in to support her and guiding her hand as she slices cucumbers on a wooden cutting board. Their faces are deliberately obscured by soft, rectangular blurring. The woman has a low, dark brown ponytail, wears a loose white shirt, and a natural linen apron. The girl has a dark high bun, wears a light-colored short-sleeved top, and a matching beige linen apron. On the countertop are a clear glass salad bowl, a folded striped kitchen cloth, a wooden bowl of vegetables on the far left, a small wooden tray or plate of colorful vegetables in front, and a small potted green herb near the center-right edge. Visible produce includes cucumber slices on a cutting board, and neatly arranged tomatoes, leafy greens, mushrooms, lemons or yellow citrus fruits, green peppers, or cucumbers, conveying a sense of freshness and health. The right half is left with ample white space, and elegant Japanese title text is placed there, using a refined serif font:{argument name="headline text" default="Cooking classes now open"} Add two lines of smaller Japanese text below:{argument name="subtext" default="Whether you're a beginner or want to have more fun, let's create something delicious together!"} The image is surrounded by seven delicate hand-drawn dark gray doodle elements: a small leaf branch on the far left, a hanging line in the upper left corner with five kitchen tools (frying pan, spatula, ladle, peeler or slender cutlery, oven mitts), a cluster of two floating leaves in the upper right corner, a small pot icon on the right, a mixing bowl icon with a small heart in the lower right center, and a long decorative line in the lower right corner. It employs soft natural sunlight, soft beige and cream tones, shallow depth of field, a clean editorial photography style, soft shadows, and a serene, family-oriented, sophisticated aesthetic suitable for cooking class landing pages or posters.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张柔和、轻盈的 {argument name="class theme" default="日式家庭烹饪课程"} 宣传主图，背景为温暖的米白色，采用极简生活方式传单风格。左半部分展示 2 个人物：一位成年女性和一名小女孩在白色厨房台面上共同烹饪，两人姿态自然从容，肢体语言温柔。女性站在女孩左后方，倾身给予支持，并引导女孩的手在木质切菜板上用菜刀切黄瓜。她们的面部特意用柔和的矩形模糊块遮盖。女性留着深棕色低马尾，身穿宽松的白色衬衫，系着天然亚麻围裙。女孩留着深色高丸子头，身穿浅色短袖上衣，系着配套的米色亚麻围裙。台面上放置一个透明玻璃沙拉搅拌碗、一条折叠的条纹厨房抹布、最左侧有一个木碗盛放蔬菜、前方有一个盛放彩色蔬菜的小木托盘或盘子，以及靠近中右边缘的一盆小型绿色草本植物。可见的农产品包括切菜板上的黄瓜片，以及整齐摆放的番茄、绿叶蔬菜、蘑菇、柠檬或黄色柑橘类水果、青椒或黄瓜，呈现出新鲜、健康的感觉。右半部分留出充足的留白，并放置优雅的日文标题文本，采用精致的衬线字体：{argument name="headline text" default="お料理教室開講"}。下方添加 2 行较小的日文正文：{argument name="subtext" default="はじめてさんも、もっと楽しみたい方も。 一緒に『おいしい』を作りましょう。"}。画面周围环绕 7 个精致的手绘深灰色涂鸦元素：最左侧 1 个小叶枝，左上角 1 条悬挂线，上面挂着 5 种厨房工具（平底锅、锅铲、汤勺、削皮器或细长餐具、隔热手套），右上角 1 簇 2 片漂浮的叶子，右侧 1 个小锅图标，中右下方 1 个带有小爱心的搅拌碗图标，以及右下角 1 条长长的单线装饰线条。采用柔和的自然日光、柔和的米色和奶油色调、浅景深、干净的编辑摄影风格、柔和的阴影，以及适合烹饪课程落地页或海报的宁静、亲子向的高级审美。

templates.title: Minimalist Programming Learning Group Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 极简编程学习小组海报

templates.prompt: A simple, warm, and minimalist poster promoting a coding workshop, employing a soft lifestyle photography and editorial design style. The image shows three young people sitting around a light-colored wooden table, collaborating using laptops and notebooks in a bright, neutral-toned room. The group consists of two men and one woman, all dressed in soft-toned casual wear; the person on the left wears a dark navy blue sweater, the woman slightly to the right wears a beige knit top, and the person on the far right wears a light gray hoodie, presented from a side view. Their faces are softened, with details not clearly visible. On the table are two open silver laptops, two ceramic mugs, two notebooks, and a smartphone; a pen is visible next to the person on the right. The figures are positioned in the right half of the image, with a large, pale sage-green organic speckled graphic as decoration in the background. The lighting is kept soft, natural, transparent, and slightly warm, with ample negative space on the left. A striking and elegant title typography is added on the left, with the first line displaying…{argument name="headline text" default="Claude Code"} Large Japanese characters are displayed below.{argument name="subheadline text" default="Barely"} Below the title, add a thin dashed line as a horizontal separator, followed by two lines of smaller Japanese text.{argument name="body text" default="Let's get together, learn, create, and update our skills together."} Add playful, dark, thin-lined hand-drawn doodles around the layout: a pendant light at the center of the top, and a handwritten note in the upper left corner.{argument name="note text" default="Let’s coding!"} The top right corner features a small laptop icon, next to a steaming coffee cup icon, the bottom left corner features a potted plant icon, and three long, curved decorative lines are distributed across the page. Using a beige-white background, the design blends a Japanese coffee shop aesthetic with a tech-inspired brand style, maintaining a balanced use of white space to present a sophisticated social media campaign flyer aesthetic, employing a 16:9 horizontal composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张简洁、温馨且极具极简主义风格的编程学习聚会宣传海报，采用柔和的生活方式摄影与编辑设计风格。画面展示了 3 名年轻人围坐在一张浅色木桌旁，在明亮的中性色调房间内使用笔记本电脑和笔记本进行协作。小组成员包括 2 男 1 女，均穿着色调柔和的休闲装；左侧的人身穿深海军蓝毛衣，中间偏右的女性身穿米白色针织上衣，最右侧的人身穿浅灰色连帽衫，呈侧面视角。他们的面部经过柔化处理，细节不明显。桌上放置 2 台打开的银色笔记本电脑、2 个陶瓷马克杯、2 本笔记本、1 部智能手机，右侧人手边可见 1 支笔。将人物构图在图像右半部分，背景处有一个巨大的淡鼠尾草绿色有机斑点图形作为装饰。保持光线柔和、自然、通透且略带暖意，左侧留出大量负空间。在左侧，添加醒目且优雅的标题排版，第一行显示 {argument name="headline text" default="Claude Code"}，下方显示大号日文字符 {argument name="subheadline text" default="勉強会"}。在标题下方，添加一条细虚线作为水平分隔线，随后是 2 行较小的日文正文 {argument name="body text" default="集まって、学んで、つくって、\n一緒にスキルをアップデートしよう。"}。在布局周围添加俏皮的深色细线条手绘涂鸦：顶部中心处 1 个吊灯，左上角 1 张手写便签写着 {argument name="note text" default="Let’s coding!"}，右上角 1 个小型笔记本电脑图标，旁边 1 个冒热气的咖啡杯图标，左下角 1 个盆栽图标，以及分布在页面上的 3 条长曲线装饰线。使用米白色背景，融合日式咖啡馆与科技感的品牌风格，保持平衡的留白，呈现出精致的社交媒体活动传单美学，采用 16:9 横向构图。

On the right side of the image is a Japanese woman in her twenties or thirties, seated at a light-colored wooden table, holding an open hardcover book, seemingly reading quietly. She has {argument name="hair color" default="Medium brown"} Her hair is styled in a half-updo with soft curls at the ends, adorned with delicate earrings, exuding a calm and elegant aura. She wears a navy blue suit jacket over a white top, presenting an elegant yet casual office style. On the table in front of her, three items are displayed: a white coffee cup and tray placed near the center in front, a small transparent glass vase filled with pale yellow and white flowers in the lower right corner, and she holds an open book. The composition is simple and minimalist, using bright natural light with soft shadows and a high-key cream background, resulting in a spacious and clean layout. On the left, there is a delicate hand-drawn Japanese-style text layout: a large title reads…{argument name="headline text" default="Reading at a cafe on a spring holiday."} , below is a smaller vertical text block that reads "やわらかな阳ざしと、ページをめくるSound. "いちばんのごほうび", and a handwritten English phrase.{argument name="accent text" default="Spring days"} The layout is adorned with subtle, sketch-style spring doodles, rendered in soft gray ink and pale pink accents. The image includes nine scattered cherry blossom petals, two simple line drawings of birds in the upper right corner, the outline of a window frame with cherry blossom branches in the upper right corner, a line drawing of a steaming coffee cup in the lower left corner, and line drawings of an open book, a small vase, and leaves in the lower left center, along with a few small leaf doodles. The overall style combines realistic photography with delicate hand-drawn editorial illustrations, evoking a calm, feminine Japanese magazine ad feel, showcasing the pleasant time spent reading in a café during springtime.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张柔和、轻盈的生活方式编辑图片，营造出温暖的春日咖啡馆氛围。在画面右侧放置一位 20 多岁到 30 多岁的日本女性，她坐在浅色木桌旁，手持一本打开的精装书，仿佛正在静静阅读。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="中棕色"} 的半扎发，发梢带有柔和的卷度，佩戴小巧耳环，气质沉静优雅。身穿海军蓝西装外套搭配白色上衣，呈现出优雅的休闲办公风格。在面前的桌子上，展示 3 件桌面物品：正前方靠近中心处放置 1 个白色咖啡杯及托盘，右下角放置 1 个装有淡黄色和白色花朵的小型透明玻璃花瓶，手中拿着 1 本打开的书。采用明亮的自然光，阴影柔和，背景为高调的奶油色，构图简洁极简，留白充裕。在左侧，添加精致的手绘风格日文编辑排版：一个大标题写着 {argument name="headline text" default="春の休日、カフェで読書。"}，下方是一个较小的竖排正文块，写着“やわらかな陽ざしと、ページをめくる音。ゆっくり流れる時間が、いちばんのごほうび。”，以及一句手写英文短语 {argument name="accent text" default="Spring days"}。在布局周围点缀细微的素描风格春日涂鸦，使用柔和的灰色墨水和淡粉色点缀。画面中包含 9 片散落的樱花花瓣，右上角有 2 只简单的线条画小鸟，右上角有 1 个带有樱花枝的窗框轮廓，左下角有 1 个冒着热气的咖啡杯线条画，左下中部有 1 个打开的书本、小花瓶和叶子的线条画，以及少量细小的叶子涂鸦。整体风格将真实摄影与细腻的手绘编辑插画相结合，唤起一种平静、女性化的日式杂志广告感，展现春日在咖啡馆阅读的美好时光。

The sky is a sunset ranging from light blue to pink, dotted with flat, square clouds. A small white crosshair is placed near the center of the image. The full survival mode HUD is displayed at the bottom: 10 red hearts, 10 hunger drumsticks, and a green experience level.{argument name="experience level" default="8"} And a 9-slot quick access bar. The quick access bar must contain 9 slots, from left to right: 1 selected custom compass icon, 1 hoe, 1 pickaxe, 1 axe, 1 bucket, 1 rope or cord item, 2 empty slots, and 1 set of markers {argument name="item stack count" default="10"} Cooked meat. In the lower right foreground, overlay a picture of a handheld {argument name="tool name" default="teleport compass"} The oversized custom item graphic is drawn as a minimalist pixel art-style compass with a tan dial, dark brown edges, a cream center, and a diagonally angled, thick red and blue pointer. The image is designed to look like an in-game screenshot taken on a tablet or PC, featuring a soft atmospheric fog, realistic voxel textures, and a child-friendly atmosphere for fast travel and location-saving navigation modules.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极简主义的高级食品广告海报，画面中心下方放置着一个浅米色陶瓷盘，盘中盛有一整颗切开的白菜泡菜，背景为干净的暖象牙色摄影棚背景。泡菜硕大、光泽感强且细节丰富，紧密层叠的白菜叶上裹满了鲜艳的深红色辣椒酱，调料纹理清晰可见，并点缀着几片深绿色的叶子。采用左上方柔和的漫射摄影棚灯光，营造出细腻逼真的阴影，呈现出清晰的食品摄影质感和精致的高端韩国商业美学。构图简洁，上方留有充足的负空间。在顶部中心位置，放置醒目优雅的韩文书法风格文字 {argument name="headline text" default="김치"}，并在其正下方用小巧精致的灰色韩文标注 {argument name="tagline text" default="매콤 아삭의 결정판."}。竖版海报布局，风格极其简洁，采用自然的陶瓷色调，色彩真实诱人，呈现出高端杂货店或餐厅的宣传视觉效果。

The model is a fashionable young person with {argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown to black"} Her curly hair was tied into a messy bun, and she wore rectangular black sunglasses, a short gold chain around her neck, and an oversized black printed T-shirt. Her face was deliberately obscured by a warm beige-brown, vertically blurred rectangular embellishment. The T-shirt featured a huge roaring tiger head print in orange, cream, black, and red, with prominent Japanese kanji characters printed below.{argument name="shirt text" default="Wild beast"} The model's upper thighs are displayed in a relaxed pose, one hand in her pocket, exuding a fashion editor's style. The background is an aged mixed-media mural in beige, black, and brick red tones, featuring a strong grunge texture, worn paper feel, paint drips, splatters, halftone dots, and graffiti layering effects. The composition includes two large circles: a black circle on the left and a large red circle behind the model on the right. It also includes three tall black vertical stripes, a light-colored rectangular block on the left, and a thin horizontal red stripe. promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张粗犷的街头风海报插画，画面中心为一名站在都市拼贴墙前的模特。模特是一位时尚的年轻人，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色至黑色"} 的卷发，扎成凌乱的丸子头，佩戴黑色长方形墨镜，颈部戴着短款金链，身穿超大号黑色印花 T 恤。面部被暖米棕色的垂直模糊矩形遮挡块刻意遮盖。T 恤上印有巨大的咆哮虎头图案，配色为橙色、奶油色、黑色和红色，下方印有醒目的日文汉字 {argument name="shirt text" default="猛獣"}。展示模特大腿中部以上的部分，姿态放松，一只手插在口袋里，展现时尚编辑风格的姿态。背景为做旧的混合媒介壁画，色调为米色、黑色和砖红色，具有强烈的 Grunge 质感、纸张磨损感、油漆滴落、喷溅、半调网点和涂鸦层叠效果。构图中包含 2 个大圆圈：左侧 1 个黑色圆圈，右侧模特身后 1 个大红色圆圈。包含 3 条高大的黑色垂直条纹，左侧还有 1 个浅色矩形块和 1 条细长的水平红色条纹。墙面艺术中包含 2 处可见的“猛獣”汉字，左下角有一处巨大的黑色喷绘版本，另一处在 T 恤上。在墙面右侧，包含 1 幅细节丰富的咆哮老虎插画，呈侧面/正面四分之三视角，张着嘴，带有橙黑条纹皮毛。在右上角，添加 2 个粉笔画风格的图示：1 个猫科动物骨架图和 1 个方框交叉骨符号。在右边缘附近添加 1 个黑色涂鸦标签，左下角添加 1 个白色小爱心。使用棕褐色、铁锈红、黑色、奶油色和深橙色的复古柔和色调。整体风格应呈现出日式街头时尚海报的质感，原始、叛逆、纹理丰富、高对比度，并带有磨损纸张上的丝网印刷效果。

{argument name="hair style" default="中长自然发型，略显凌乱，蓬松柔软"}

templates.prompt: This hyper-realistic close-up portrait in a beauty advertisement features a captivating young Western woman with thick, wavy, dark hair, defined cheekbones, bold, expressive eyebrows, and flawless, radiant skin. Her features are sharp yet feminine, and her expression is confident with a touch of rebelliousness. She wears a sophisticated black hat.{argument name="color scheme" default="Hot Pink"} Baseball cap with a striking light-emitting design printed on the front.{argument name="accent color" default="Hot Pink"} 3D lettering{argument name="name" default="SHARON"} The design style resembles a high-end streetwear brand logo. She wears stylish, semi-transparent pink round-framed glasses. A beige bandage on her nose and left cheek adds a stylized, avant-garde aesthetic. A lit cigarette dangles from her slightly parted lips, revealing her white teeth. Interspersed throughout the image are highly detailed anime-style miniature figures (a cute detective-style girl character: with a short brown bob, large, bright blue eyes, round-framed glasses, bright red overalls, a white shirt, and yellow gloves), playfully interacting within the composition: one sits on the brim of her hat, one climbs onto her ear, one pulls her lower lip, one hides in her collar, and another stands on her shoulder. A striking oversized cyan pencil is tucked under the hatband, serving as a strong graphic element. Clothing style: Luxurious streetwear—a black oversized jacket over a crisp white and pink striped shirt, tied with a delicate pink scarf. Color scheme: deep black, vibrant hot pink highlights, electric cyan accents, and bright yellow as a contrasting color. Lighting: High-end studio lighting with soft frontal fill light, complemented by dramatic rim lighting to enhance depth and dimension. Clean, seamless white background. Composition: Ultra-clear focus, magazine-style composition, luxurious fashion advertising style, cinematic depth of field, hyper-realistic textures (visible skin pores, fine fabric textures, and clear hair strands), 8K resolution, and extremely intricate detail. Atmosphere: Bold, playful, and high-fashion, a Gen Z luxury street advertising style that perfectly blends realism with surreal micro-narratives.

templates.title: Car poster conversion prompts

titleLocalized.zh: 汽车海报转换提示词

templates.prompt: A minimalist car poster showcasing an identical car to a subsequently uploaded photo. The AI ​​had to perfectly replicate the car in the uploaded image, ensuring the body shape, proportions, stance, color, trim, wheels, and all visible exterior details were identical. The car is presented from a right-hand front 4/4 perspective, conforming to the perspective of the original reference layout, but now with subtle {argument name="action" default="Drifting action"} Presented with realistic weight transfer, slight body lift, controlled smoke from the rear tires, and subtle creases behind the vehicle, without distorting the original car's geometry. The headlights follow the exact style from the reference photo, and a warm fog light effect is available as an option if the supplied car has fog lights. All stickers, logos, license plates, and window tints must match the car in the uploaded photo. The car drifts on a bright white, reflective, studio-style ground with soft reflections and realistic shadows, enhanced with subtle drift slick reflections and directional smudges. The background remains a clean white-to-light gray gradient, vertically dominated by large, semi-transparent, bold typographic text displaying the car model (automatically extracted from the uploaded photo). At the top: concise brand text "{argument name="brand name" default="Car brand name"} "(or the brand detected from the uploaded car photo). Below is spaced typographic text containing the same brand and model name. Below the car: Centered display of the accurate model name extracted from the uploaded photo. Below that is a brief description of the car's characteristics (efficiency, style, reliability). The bottom area displays a clean grid layout of specifications. If the actual specifications of the detected car model are known, generate accurate values; otherwise, generate placeholders in the same layout style (4 columns: horsepower, 0–100 km/h acceleration, top speed, engine displacement/fuel type). The entire poster employs minimalism, editorial style, high-key studio lighting, with ultra-clear reflections, sharp shadows, modern typography, and 4K realism, blending clean design with dynamic drift energy in a 9:16 aspect ratio."

promptLocalized.zh:
超简洁的汽车海报，展示与后续上传照片中完全相同的汽车。AI 必须复制上传照片中的汽车，确保车身形状、比例、姿态、颜色、装饰、轮毂及所有可见的外部细节完全一致。
汽车以右侧前 4/4 视角呈现，符合原始参考布局的透视角度，但现在以微妙的 {argument name="action" default="漂移动作"} 呈现。漂移通过逼真的重心转移、轻微的车身抬升、后轮胎产生的受控烟雾以及车辆后方淡淡的弯曲胎痕来表现，且不会扭曲原始汽车的几何结构。
前大灯遵循参考照片中的确切样式，如果提供的汽车有雾灯，则可选配温暖的雾灯光效。所有贴纸、车标、车牌和车窗贴膜必须与上传照片中的汽车匹配。
汽车在光亮的白色反射式摄影棚风格地面上漂移，地面保持柔和的反射和逼真的阴影，并增强了轻微的漂移滑痕反射和定向污迹。
背景保持为干净的白到浅灰渐变色，背景中垂直主导着巨大的半透明粗体排版文字，显示汽车型号（从上传的照片中自动提取）。
最上方：简洁的品牌文字 “{argument name="brand name" default="汽车品牌名称"}”（或从上传的汽车照片中检测到的品牌）。下方是包含相同品牌和型号名称的间距排版样式文字。
汽车下方：居中显示从上传照片中提取的准确型号名称。
下方是一段关于汽车特性的简短描述（效率、风格、可靠性）。
底部区域显示规格的简洁网格布局。如果已知检测到的汽车型号的真实规格，请生成准确数值；如果未知，则以相同的布局样式生成占位符（4 列：马力、0–100 km/h 加速、最高时速、发动机排量/燃料类型）。
整张海报采用极简主义、编辑风格、高调摄影棚照明，具有超清晰的反射、锐利的阴影、现代排版和 4K 真实感，将简洁设计与动态漂移能量融为一体，比例 9:16

templates.title: Dance Choreography Instructions

titleLocalized.zh: 舞蹈编排说明表

templates.prompt: Dance Sequence Description [Visual Style] The composition showcases a highly detailed 3D rendered female dancer. The design style resembles a professional dance choreography guide, employing a technical, chart-like layout. A clean white background, soft studio lighting, and strong contrast highlight body movements and postures. [Grid Layout] A structured 4x4 panel grid (16 frames total), evenly spaced by thin black dividing lines. Each panel is the same size and clearly numbered from 1 to 16 to show the continuous dance progression. [Character] Uses{argument name="reference" default="image1"} As the foundational character, the same female dancer remains consistent across all panels, with accurate similarity and proportions. [Costumes] The dancer wears stylish and performance-appropriate attire:{argument name="clothing" default="Fitted top paired with a short, flowy skirt"} The styling should look modern and visually appealing while facilitating dance movements. Even in grayscale, the fabric should subtly respond to movement (slight flow and folds). [Panel Structure – Each Frame] Top Left: Step number + brief dance move title (e.g., "Step 5 – Rotation Transition") Center: Full-body pose capturing a precise moment in the choreography Bottom Left: 3–4 lines of concise description of the movement Overlay: Movement arrows and directional guides indicating how the dancer transitions [Movement Indicators] Add curved arrows for fluid movements, straight arrows for directional steps, and circular indicators for rotations or turns. Emphasize rhythm, weight transfer, and localized body movements. [Rendering Quality] High-detail sculpted 3D style with smooth grayscale shadows, subtle projections, and clean lines. Maintain a beautifully crafted concept art-level finish, ensuring every pose is clearly visible. [Constraints] No color, no background scene, no extra characters, no visual clutter; only dancers and instructional elements are included.

promptLocalized.zh:
舞蹈序列说明表
[视觉风格]
构图展示了一位高度精细的 3D 渲染女性舞者。设计风格类似于专业的舞蹈编排指南，采用技术性、图表式的布局。干净的白色背景、柔和的摄影棚灯光以及强烈的对比度，以突出身体动作和姿态。
[网格布局]
结构化的 4×4 面板网格（共 16 帧），由细黑分割线均匀间隔。每个面板尺寸相同，并清晰地编号为 1 至 16，以展示连续的舞蹈进程。
[角色]
使用 {argument name="reference" default="image1"} 作为基础角色。同一位女性舞者在所有面板中保持一致，具有准确的相似度和比例。
[服装]
舞者穿着时尚且适合表演的服装：{argument name="clothing" default="修身上衣搭配短款飘逸裙子"}。造型应看起来现代且具有视觉吸引力，同时便于舞蹈动作。即使在灰度下，面料也应微妙地响应运动（轻微的流动感和褶皱）。
[面板结构 – 每一帧]
左上角：步骤编号 + 简短的舞蹈动作标题（例如：“步骤 5 – 旋转过渡”）
中心：捕捉编排中精确瞬间的全身姿势
左下角：3–4 行简洁的说明，描述该动作
叠加层：运动箭头和方向指南，说明舞者如何过渡
[运动指示器]
加入弯曲箭头表示流畅动作，直线箭头表示方向性步伐，圆形指示器表示旋转或转圈。强调节奏、重心转移和身体局部动作。
[渲染质量]
高细节雕刻 3D 风格，具有平滑的灰度阴影、微妙的投影和干净的线条。保持精美的概念艺术级成品，确保每个姿势都清晰可见。
[限制条件]
无颜色，无背景场景，无额外角色，无视觉杂乱，仅包含舞者和教学元素。

templates.prompt: A bold fashion editor's poster features a close-up portrait of a young female model wrapped in an oversized {argument name="clothing" default="Black down jacket"} The high, thick collar obscures the lower half of her face, presenting a minimalist, sleek, and modernly luxurious street fashion aesthetic. The model's upper body is slightly turned away from the camera, glancing back at the audience, creating a tense yet captivating posture. One hand gently rises near the zipper and collar, fingers lightly touching the fabric, as if adjusting something. This restrained, elegant, and deliberate movement contrasts softly with the heavy, oversized coat. Her shoulders are slightly tucked into the coat, creating a protective, stylish, and intimate silhouette. Her expression is calm and serious, with a subtle air of mystery. Her eyes are fixed on the camera, lips slightly parted, brows relaxed, and gaze steady and deep, conveying a quiet, understated, and sophisticated attitude, giving a soft, cool, elegant, and untouchable feeling. The overall atmosphere is melancholic, minimalist, sophisticated, and refined, with a quiet, luxurious winter editorial style. The outfit consists of an oversized matte black down jacket with exaggerated volume, a high collar, and clean zipper lines. Without additional accessories, it maintains a monochromatic, modern Korean magazine style. The poster design adopts a clean graphic magazine cover style, with a white background and an oversized background image.{argument name="accent color" default="red"} Vertical text layout, spelled as "{argument name="brand" default="GUVET"} The text, in bold or similar fonts, features a sharp layout, a red and black color scheme, a modern sans-serif typeface, micro-text blocks, embedded cropped detail frames showcasing close-ups of facial features, and subtle fashion magazine branding elements at the bottom. Soft studio lighting enhances skin texture, contrast, and shadows, while rich detail in the eyes and lips creates a refined, print magazine feel. Ultra-clear focus delivers a high-resolution, luxurious commercial fashion poster aesthetic with a sophisticated composition.

templates.prompt: A full-body fashion shoot, showcasing a confident woman.{argument name="subject" default="young women"} She sat casually on the concrete steps, relaxed, one leg slightly stretched out, arms hanging naturally, looking directly at the camera. Her long hair swayed gently in the breeze, her skin glowed naturally, and her makeup was sophisticated and modern. She wore a {argument name="jacket style" default="Light blue oversized denim jacket"} She wore a simple white T-shirt underneath, paired with neutral-colored slim-fit shorts, brightly colored socks, and trendy sneakers. Behind her,{argument name="characters" default="Tom and Jerry"} As playful cartoon characters integrated into the scene—slightly larger in size, interacting with each other and their surroundings (Tom peeks out from behind the steps, Jerry stands on the steps or runs mischievously)—they are naturally placed in the background, as if they were part of the world. Their style retains the characteristics of classic animation, with rugged outlines and expressive movements. Ultra-detail, HDR, sharp focus, cinematic composition, fashion magazine quality, 8K resolution.

templates.title: Design process from concept to form

titleLocalized.zh: 从概念到形态的设计流程

templates.prompt: Subject: [For example:]{argument name="subject" default="tennis serve"} Please present the evolution of this theme from concept to form, and the final design as the result, in an A4 portrait-format visual. Use a two-part structure. The top section should be a five-step visual flowchart outlining the essence of the theme: Inspiration → Trajectory and Energy → Abstract Lines and Structure → 3D Form → Final Design. Please build according to this process. Include detailed sketches, line drawings, design blueprints, small arrows, brief English labels, and elegantly arranged white space. The title should be "MOTION TO FORM". The bottom image displays the final "core visual" image formed by the above process. Categories are not limited; AI will select the most suitable design object based on the theme. It can be any form, such as products, objects, furniture, accessories, packaging, containers, lighting, gadgets, artwork, etc. Generate a fictional brand name, slogan, and short copy to create creative content suitable for advertising or design release visuals. The overall presentation should be highly complete, integrating project, brand advertising, and design development materials. It should showcase an aesthetic composed of minimalism, poetry, intelligence, and white space. The color scheme is based on neutral tones, complemented by 1-2 accent colors derived from the theme. It accurately depicts texture, light and shadow, structural beauty, and textural representation. High resolution, commercial-grade visual quality.

promptLocalized.zh:
主题：[例如：{argument name="subject" default="网球发球"}] 
请将该主题从概念到形态的演变过程，以及作为最终成果的成品设计，呈现在一张 A4 竖版视觉图中。采用上下两部分结构。
顶部为该主题精髓的五步可视化流程图：灵感来源 → 轨迹与能量 → 抽象线条与结构 → 三维形态 → 最终设计。请按照此流程构建。包含精细草图、线条图、设计蓝图、小箭头、简短的英文标签，以及布局优雅的留白。
标题为“MOTION TO FORM”。
底部图像展示由上述流程形成的最终“核心视觉”图。类别不限；AI 将根据主题选择最合适的设计对象。它可以是任何形式，如产品、物体、家具、配饰、包装、容器、灯具、小工具、艺术品等。
生成一个虚构的品牌名称、口号和简短文案，以创作出适合广告或设计发布视觉效果的创意内容。
整体呈现出极高的完成度，融合了项目、品牌广告和设计开发素材。展现出由极简主义、诗意、智能和留白构成的美感。配色方案以中性色调为基础，搭配 1-2 种源自主题的强调色。
准确描绘材质感、光影、结构美和纹理表现。高分辨率，商业级视觉质量。

templates.prompt: A stunning black and white studio portrait, featuring [the subject]{argument name="subject" default="Uploaded characters"} The shot is a medium shot at eye level, framing the subject from waist up. templates.title: Detailed biography infographic poster

titleLocalized.zh: 详细传记信息图海报

templates.prompt: Please provide{argument name="subject name" default="[Name]"} Create a visually rich and in-depth infographic. It shouldn't just be a list of information: I need you to delve into their life, major achievements, key career milestones, philosophical ideas, and their unique impact on technology and design. Avoid rigid, blocky layouts; use charts, annotations, and guide lines to organically integrate this information. Visual Style: Employ a bold, powerful, and highly graphic illustration style. Specifically, it should achieve the following effect: a highly realistic, photorealistic portrait of the person as the central focus. Surrounding this core are elements such as a timeline, analytical charts, classic products, quotes, and concise text. Composition: Keep the background simple. Utilize layered composition to seamlessly blend the realistic portrait with strong graphic elements (such as shapes, icons, and large blocks of color). The overall image should appear rich in content, textured, and highly professional.

promptLocalized.zh: 请为 {argument name="subject name" default="[姓名]"} 创建一张视觉效果极其丰富且深度的信息图。它不应只是信息的罗列：我需要你深入挖掘他们的生平、主要成就、关键职业里程碑、哲学思想，以及他们对技术和设计产生的独特影响。避免生硬的板块式布局；请使用图表、注释和引导线将这些信息有机地结合起来。视觉风格：采用大胆、有力且极具图形感的插画风格。具体来说，它应该呈现如下效果：中心焦点是该人物高度写实、如照片般的肖像。围绕这一核心的是时间轴、分析图表、经典产品、名言警句和简洁的文字等元素。构图：保持背景简洁。利用分层构图，将写实肖像与强烈的图形元素（如各种形状、图标、大色块）完美融合。整张图像应看起来内容充实、富有质感且非常专业。

templates.title: Luxury concept poster design

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华概念海报设计

templates.prompt: What you will generate is not an ordinary illustration, but a high-end concept poster that expresses through visual metaphor.{argument name="person name" default="ELON MUSK"} "The meaning and symbolism of this name and the person behind it. [The huge letters]"{argument name="person name" default="ELON MUSK"} "As the main element of the entire image, the font should be a bold, powerful, and highly impactful sans-serif typeface. The background should be..."{argument name="background color" default="Dark black"} The lettering is a slightly yellowish off-white with a paper texture, graininess, and subtle wear reminiscent of vintage screen printing or old posters. At the bottom center, place a monochrome portrait reminiscent of Elon Musk. It should share a similar atmosphere with the figure, conveying a look towards the future. The face should not be overly realistic, but rather rendered with strong shadows in a print/poster style. In the upper right corner, the composition should include a rocket launching diagonally upwards.{argument name="accent color" default="red"} As the accent color for the rocket's exhaust and smoke, let it pierce through the oversized letters, as if slicing them open. This symbolizes "breaking through the future," "breaking existing frameworks," and "massive challenges." The overall design should be simple yet powerful. Avoid adding too many elements; consist only of text, figures, the rocket, and red smoke. Be bold in composition, ensuring it leaves a lasting impression even from a distance. Add small auxiliary text such as "VISION / SCALE / MOTION" in the lower left corner and "BUILD THE FUTURE" in the lower right corner. If necessary, subtly place small symbols related to Tesla or X, but the focus should remain on the name "ELON MUSK" and the symbolic meaning of the figure. Unify the colors within the three main tones of black, gray, and red. Create a concept poster with a strong visual impact, conveying a sense of luxury, futurism, ambition, solitude, grand scale, and the energy of destruction and creation.

promptLocalized.zh:
你将生成的不是普通的插画，而是一张高端概念海报，通过视觉隐喻来表达 "{argument name="person name" default="ELON MUSK"}" 这个名字及其背后人物的意义与象征。

将巨大的字母 "{argument name="person name" default="ELON MUSK"}" 作为整个画面的主角。字体应为粗壮、有力且极具存在感的无衬线字体。背景应为 {argument name="background color" default="深黑色"}，字母则采用略带黄色的灰白色，并带有纸张纹理、颗粒感以及类似复古丝网印刷或旧海报的轻微磨损痕迹。

在底部中心位置，放置一张让人联想到 Elon Musk 的单色肖像。它应具有与人物本身相似的氛围，表现出一种仰望未来的神情。面部不宜过于写实，而是以印刷/海报风格通过强烈的阴影来表现。

在右上角，构图应包含一枚向斜上方发射的火箭。使用 {argument name="accent color" default="红色"} 作为火箭尾焰和烟雾的强调色，让它穿过巨大的字母，仿佛将其切开。这象征着“突破未来”、“打破现有框架”以及“大规模挑战”的含义。

整体设计应简洁而有力。不要添加过多元素；仅由文字、人物、火箭和红色烟雾构成。构图要大胆，确保即使在远处也能一眼留下深刻印象。

在左下角添加如 "VISION / SCALE / MOTION" 等小型辅助文字，右下角添加 "BUILD THE FUTURE"。如有必要，可以低调地放置与 Tesla 或 X 相关的小符号，但重点仍应放在 "ELON MUSK" 这个名字及其人物的象征意义上。

将色彩统一在黑、灰白、红三种主色调内。创作一张具有强烈视觉记忆点的概念海报，传达出奢华感、未来主义、雄心壮志、孤独感、宏大的格局感，以及破坏与创造的能量。

templates.title: Advanced Korean Palmistry Guide

titleLocalized.zh: 高级韩语手相分析指南

templates.prompt: Based on the uploaded photo of your hand, create an advanced Korean palmistry guide image. All visible text in the final image must be in Korean only. Please use a clean, sans-serif Korean font. The title must be exactly “손금분석가이드”. Create a sophisticated two-column layout: Left panel: Place the uploaded photo of your real hand within a clean, rounded card. Preserve the original hand shape, palm lines, skin texture, and natural details. Do not distort or redraw the hand. Right panel: Create a separate black-and-white palm line outline analysis based on the same hand. Highlight the main palm lines with fine lines and annotate them in Korean. Includes the following Korean tags and sections: “손금분석가이드”, “전체요약”, “생명선”, “두뇌선”, “감정선”, “운명선”, “재물선”, “태양선”, “결혼선”, “성격”, “직업운”, “재물운”, “연애운”, “조언”, “확인불가”. Analyzes hand shape, finger proportions, life line, wisdom line, heart line, fate line, wealth line, sun line, marriage line, and the depth, length, direction, breaks, forks, and overlaps of the lines. If anything is unclear, please label it “확인불가”. Korean interpretations should be concise, realistic, calm, and suggestive. Design style: 1:1 square format, white background, black and warm dark gray text, fine hairline dividing lines, rounded corner cards, soft shadows, large margins, ample white space, precise grid, minimalist line icons, luxurious editorial report style, high-end health analysis, elegant and expensive appearance. No English characters, Roman letters, incorrect Korean, random symbols, colorful decorations, cartoon style, mystical symbols, tarot card imagery, frightening atmosphere, cluttered backgrounds, or watermarks are allowed.

promptLocalized.zh:
根据上传的手掌照片，创建一份高级韩语手相分析指南图像。

最终图像中所有可见文本必须仅使用韩语。请使用简洁的韩语无衬线字体。标题必须完全为“손금 분석 가이드”。

创建精致的双栏布局：
左侧面板：将上传的真实手掌照片放置在一个简洁的圆角卡片内。保留原始手型、掌纹、皮肤纹理及自然细节。请勿扭曲或重绘手部。
右侧面板：基于同一手部创建独立的黑白掌纹轮廓解析图。用细致的线条高亮显示主要掌纹，并用韩语进行标注。

包含以下韩语标签和部分：
“손금 분석 가이드”、“전체 요약”、“생명선”、“두뇌선”、“감정선”、“운명선”、“재물선”、“태양선”、“결혼선”、“성격”、“직업운”、“재물운”、“연애운”、“조언”、“확인 불가”。

分析手型、手指比例、生命线、智慧线、感情线、命运线、财运线、太阳线、婚姻线，以及线条的深度、长度、走向、断裂、分叉和重叠情况。如果某处不清晰，请标注“확인 불가”。韩语解读内容需保持简短、写实、冷静且具有建议性。

设计风格：
1:1 正方形格式，白色背景，黑色及暖深灰色文字，细发丝分割线，圆角卡片，柔和阴影，大页边距，充裕的留白，精准的网格，极简线条图标，奢华编辑报告风格，高端健康分析，优雅且外观昂贵。

禁止出现任何英文字符、罗马字母、错误的韩语、随机符号、彩色装饰、卡通风格、神秘符号、塔罗牌意象、恐怖氛围、杂乱背景或水印。

templates.title: Cinematic Narrative Storyboard

titleLocalized.zh: 电影级叙事分镜

templates.prompt: - Person: Eastern woman @image_1 , black high ponytail, modified cheongsam{argument name="dress color" default="Dark purple"} Dress @image_2 , large gold vintage hoop earrings, red lips, exuding a cool and noble aura. - Vehicle: @image_3{argument name="car model" default="Huawei Smart World R7"} Nebula Purple paint, streamlined sedan silhouette, license plate displaying the Chinese characters "智界 R7". Scene: Outside a top-tier nighttime awards ceremony or international film festival venue. Marble plaza, flanked by media holding telephoto lenses and flashlights. In the distance, buildings feature giant light installations, and a red carpet stretches into the distance. Storyboard layout, deep black high-end editing layout, purple-gold title:{argument name="storyboard title" default="IGNITE · Zhijie R7 × Grand Ceremony Entrance Film Project"} Part 1 - People and Vehicle References (Professional Lookbook Layout Style): Extracted from reference images - front/side view of the person, full side view of the vehicle, close-up of the front face, macro shots of earrings and handbags. Part 2 - Divided into two parts: Left side: Real-world environmental scene reference (nighttime lobby atmosphere photo). Right side: Top-down spatial plan. Annotations: Spatial outline (stairs/plaza/passage), initial person position + dashed path arrow, 5 camera positions (number + abbreviation), camera direction arrows, product/prop anchor points, highlighted core composition area. 5-frame storyboard (2.39:1 widescreen): Frame 1: Long shot - moment of opening the door. The nighttime plaza is a sea of ​​flashing lights, the car door opens, the purple interior ambient lighting lights up first, backlit silhouette, hair and skirt fluttering in the wind. Frame 2: Entering and walking - low-angle shot. Shot from below, she gets out of the car wearing high heels, the marble floor reflects her skirt, Zhijie R7 The car body serves as a glowing backdrop in the background, with flashes of light in the distance. Frame 3: A glance back – an 85mm portrait close-up. She turns her head to look back, staring directly at the camera, her gold earrings shimmering under the flash, a slight upturn at the corners of her mouth, her expression commanding. Frame 4: A hero shot of the car and its driver. She stands in front of the car, a gentle breeze ruffling her skirt, the Zhijie R7 glowing from all sides behind her, its nebula purple paint harmonizing with her gown in a sophisticated color scheme, the background media and crowd blurred. Frame 5: Departure view. She enters the car, the door slowly closes, the taillights illuminate, and the vehicle slowly drives away from the red carpet amidst the flashes of light, leaving only a trail of light and shadow. Light and Shadow & Style: Strong nighttime side backlighting – instant flash exposure. Deep black background – the purple car body is one of the only light sources. 2.39:1 anamorphic widescreen – large aperture and shallow depth of field. Keywords: Absolute protagonist aura – grand ceremony-level narrative – film premiere quality.

promptLocalized.zh:
- 人物：东方女性 @image_1，黑色高马尾，改良旗袍 {argument name="dress color" default="深紫色"} 礼服 @image_2，金色复古大圆环耳环，红唇，气质清冷高贵。
- 车辆：@image_3 {argument name="car model" default="华为智界 R7"}，星云紫车漆，流线型轿车轮廓，车牌显示汉字“智界 R7”。

场景：顶级夜间颁奖典礼或国际电影节场馆外。大理石广场，两侧是手持长焦镜头和闪光灯的媒体。远处建筑配有巨型灯光装置，红毯延伸至远方。

分镜规划，深黑色高端编辑排版，紫金配色标题：“{argument name="storyboard title" default="IGNITE · 智界 R7 × 盛典入场大片项目"}”

第 1 部分 - 人物与车辆参考（专业 Lookbook 排版风格）：提取自参考图——人物正面/侧面、车辆全侧面、前脸特写、耳环与手提包微距。

第 2 部分 - 分为左右两部分：
左侧：环境真实场景参考（夜间大厅氛围照片）。
右侧：俯视空间平面图。标注内容：空间轮廓（楼梯/广场/通道）、初始人物位置 + 虚线路径箭头、5 个机位（数字 + 缩写）、摄像机方向箭头、产品/道具锚点、高亮核心构图区域。

5 帧分镜（2.39:1 宽银幕）：
第 1 帧：远景 · 开门瞬间。夜间广场闪光灯如海，车门开启，紫色内饰氛围灯率先亮起，背光剪影，发丝与裙摆在风中飘动。
第 2 帧：入场行走 · 低角度拍摄。从地面仰拍，她穿着细高跟鞋走下车，大理石地面映衬着裙摆，智界 R7 车身在后方作为发光的背景，远处闪光灯闪烁。
第 3 帧：回眸 · 85mm 人像特写。她侧身回眸，直视镜头，金色耳环在闪光灯下闪烁，嘴角微微上扬，表情掌控全场。
第 4 帧：人车英雄镜头。她站在车前，微风吹动裙摆，智界 R7 在身后全侧面发光，星云紫车漆与礼服形成高端色彩和谐，背景媒体人群虚化。
第 5 帧：离场尾镜。她进入车内，车门缓缓关闭，尾灯亮起，车辆在闪光灯中缓缓驶离红毯，只留下光影轨迹。

光影与风格：
强烈的夜间侧逆光 · 即时闪光灯曝光感。深黑色背景 · 紫色车身作为仅有的光源之一。2.39:1 变形宽银幕 · 大光圈浅景深。关键词：绝对主角光环 · 盛典级叙事 · 电影首映质感。

templates.title: Art film posters from the 1960s

titleLocalized.zh: 20 世纪 60 年代艺术电影海报

templates.prompt: Create a vertically composed poster on distressed cream-colored paper to achieve a handcrafted, simulated texture. Use rough, torn paper edges, layered magazine clippings, photocopy grain, halftone textures, ink bleeding, and slightly off-center silkscreen color printing effects. The subject should be a black-and-white photographic portrait, placed in the center or upper-middle of the frame. Embellish the subject with graphic blocks of deep red, cobalt blue, warm yellow, black, and ivory. Add supporting collage fragments such as rain-drenched European streets, film borders, newspaper clippings, city silhouettes, and film details, hand-typographically resembling a 1960s art film poster. Use a bold, compressed font with strong visual hierarchy. Add large headline text:{argument name="main title" default="[Main Title]"} Add a smaller subheading:{argument name="subtitle" default="[subtitle]"} Add the following text to the bottom:{argument name="event details" default="[Brand Name / Event Name / Upcoming Launch / Date]"} If necessary, a small line of text can be added at the top: "[Slogan]". The final product should evoke a cinematic, intellectual, rebellious, and editorial style, like a lost European film poster from the 1960s with a distinct perspective. Retain its raw, tactile, print-like, imperfect, and handcrafted qualities. Avoid modern glossy finishes.

promptLocalized.zh:
在做旧的奶油色纸张上创作一幅垂直构图的海报，营造出手工模拟的质感。使用粗糙的撕纸边缘、分层的杂志剪贴、复印颗粒感、半色调纹理、墨水渗色以及略有偏差的丝网印刷套色效果。主体应为黑白摄影肖像，置于画面中心或中上方位置。

在主体周围点缀深红、钴蓝、暖黄、黑色和象牙色的图形色块。添加辅助性的拼贴碎片，如雨中的欧洲街道、胶片边框、报纸剪报、城市剪影和电影细节，像 20 世纪 60 年代的艺术电影海报那样进行手工排版。

使用具有强烈视觉层级的粗体压缩字体。添加大号标题文字：“{argument name="main title" default="[主标题]"}”。添加较小的副标题文字：“{argument name="subtitle" default="[副标题]"}”。添加底部文字：“{argument name="event details" default="[品牌名称 / 活动名称 / 即将推出 / 日期]"}”。如有需要，可在顶部添加一行小字：“[标语]”。

最终成品应呈现出电影感、知识分子气息、叛逆感和编辑风格，如同 20 世纪 60 年代一张带有鲜明视角的遗失欧洲电影海报。保持其原始、触感、印刷感、不完美和手工制作的特质。避免使用现代的光泽感饰面。

templates.title: Golden hour outdoor organic selfie

titleLocalized.zh: 黄金时刻户外有机自拍

templates.prompt: A realistic, casual outdoor smartphone selfie; the subject is {argument name="subject age" default="middle-aged women"} The shot focuses on her chest and above, slightly off-center, and was taken with a mobile phone lens at arm's length. She has loose, shoulder-length curly hair in a warm color.{argument name="hair color" default="reddish-brown"} Her hair, gently ruffled by the breeze, shimmered with a golden backlight under the low-hanging sun behind her. She wore a dark {argument name="top color" default="Forest Green"} A V-neck knit top or cardigan, adorned with a delicate chain necklace, and a small hoop earring subtly visible through the hair. The background is an outdoor terrace or a path beside a stone wall, mostly covered by dense trees, with distant buildings faintly visible through the foliage. The sun is positioned in the upper left corner, creating a natural lens flare, warm rim lighting around the hair, soft highlights on the shoulders, and realistic golden hour contrast. The composition should convey an organic and unrefined quality, rather than a studio-perfect effect: a slightly handheld phone shooting perspective, natural skin texture, casual poses, realistic light and shadow, shallow depth of field from the phone's sensor, and authentic everyday social media selfie aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实、随意的户外智能手机自拍，拍摄对象为 {argument name="subject age" default="中年女性"}，取景范围为胸部以上，构图略微偏离中心，以手机镜头在手臂长度距离拍摄。她留着蓬松的齐肩卷发，发色为温暖的 {argument name="hair color" default="红褐色"}，被微风轻轻吹乱，在身后低垂的太阳照射下，散发出金色的逆光光泽。她身穿一件深 {argument name="top color" default="森林绿"} 的 V 领针织上衣或开衫，佩戴着一条精致的细链项链，透过发丝隐约可见一只小耳圈。背景为户外露台或石墙旁的步道，大部分背景被茂密的树木覆盖，透过枝叶可隐约看到远处的建筑。太阳位于左上角，营造出自然的镜头光晕、发丝周围温暖的轮廓光、肩部柔和的高光，以及写实的傍晚黄金时刻对比度。构图应呈现出有机且未经修饰的质感，而非影棚级的完美效果：带有轻微的手持手机拍摄视角、自然的皮肤纹理、随意的姿态、真实的光影、手机传感器带来的浅景深，以及地道的日常社交媒体自拍美学。

templates.title: Realistic style golden hour indoor selfie

templates.prompt: A realistic, casual indoor selfie, by{argument name="person" default="adult women"} The photo was taken with a handheld smartphone, framed in a square shape above the chest. She has shoulder-length, slightly messy wavy hair.{argument name="hair color" default="reddish-brown"} Her hair, naturally voluminous and slightly frizzy, is styled in the middle. Warm, golden sunlight streams in through a large window or sliding glass door on the left side of the image. She is wearing a simple {argument name="shirt color" default="White"} Wearing a short-sleeved V-neck T-shirt. The pose is relaxed and natural, with forearms subtly visible, presenting a realistic smartphone selfie perspective. The scene is an interior of a real apartment or residence: bright vertical window and door frames on the left, a beige wall in the background, and a dark brown sofa to the right rear. The lighting is soft, warm, and natural, with sunlight illuminating the hair, shoulders, and arms, creating subtle indoor shadows. Skin texture is realistic, unretouched. The overall look appears casual, believable, and unforced, like a real smartphone photo rather than a heavily edited AI portrait. It utilizes natural proportions, subtle image noise, ordinary interior background details, and an intuitive, realistic feel reminiscent of smartphone photography.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实的休闲室内自拍，由 {argument name="person" default="成年女性"} 手持智能手机拍摄，构图为胸部以上的方形画面。她留着齐肩、略显凌乱的波浪卷 {argument name="hair color" default="赤褐色"} 头发，发质自然蓬松且带有轻微毛躁，中分发型。画面左侧的大窗户或推拉玻璃门射入温暖的黄金时刻阳光。她穿着一件简单的 {argument name="shirt color" default="白色"} 短袖 V 领 T 恤。姿势放松自然，双前臂隐约可见，呈现出真实的手机自拍视角。场景为真实的公寓或住宅内部：左侧有明亮的垂直窗框和门框，背景为米色墙壁和右后方的深棕色沙发。光线柔和、温暖且自然，阳光照亮了头发、肩膀和手臂，带有轻微的室内阴影，皮肤纹理真实，没有经过美颜修饰。整体观感应显得随性、可信且未经刻意造型，就像一张真实的手机照片，而非精修的 AI 肖像。使用自然的比例、细微的图像噪点、普通的家居背景细节，以及直观的智能手机摄影写实感。

templates.title: Realistic golden hour porch selfie

titleLocalized.zh: 写实的黄金时刻门廊自拍

templates.prompt: A realistic, natural-style selfie, the protagonist is {argument name="subject age" default="middle aged"} A woman sits on her porch, photographed at the golden hour. The photo, taken handheld with the phone's front-facing camera, appears casual and natural. She keeps {argument name="hair color" default="Reddish-brown"} Her shoulder-length, slightly wavy hair was voluminous and a little messy. Her skin had a warm tone in the sunlight, and her overall image was natural and simple, like someone she would look like in everyday life. She was wearing a simple {argument name="top color" default="black"} Wearing a vest that exposes the shoulders, the composition is a close-up portrait from the chest up. Although centered, it is slightly tilted, creating a realistic handheld selfie effect, with part of the arm visible in the foreground. The lighting is warm, low-angle evening sunlight, casting soft highlights and shadows on the face, chest, and arms. The background is an outdoor residential porch, with white wainscoting on the left and a light-colored vertical porch column on the right. Pink and purple flowers and greenery are growing in hanging baskets or wall-mounted flowerpots. The image should have a candid, realistic feel with minimal processing, including realistic skin texture, natural stray hairs, slight asymmetry, and subtle phone lens distortion, avoiding the use of beauty filters or overly retouched AI aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实的自然风格自拍，主角是一位 {argument name="subject age" default="中年"} 女性，坐在自家门廊上，拍摄于黄金时刻。照片由手机前置摄像头以手持距离拍摄，显得随性自然。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="红棕色"} 的齐肩微卷发，发型蓬松且略带凌乱感，皮肤在阳光下呈现暖色调，整体形象自然、质朴，如同日常生活中的样子。她穿着一件简单的 {argument name="top color" default="黑色"} 背心，露出双肩。构图为胸部以上的近景肖像，虽然居中但略有倾斜，呈现出真实手持自拍的效果，前景中可见部分手臂。光线为低角度的温暖傍晚阳光，在面部、胸部和手臂上投下柔和的高光与阴影。背景为室外住宅门廊，左侧是白色护墙板，右侧是一根浅色的垂直门廊柱，挂篮或墙上花盆里种着粉色和紫色的小花以及绿植。图像应呈现出抓拍感、真实感，且处理痕迹极少，包含真实的皮肤纹理、自然的碎发、轻微的不对称感以及细微的手机镜头畸变，避免使用美颜滤镜或过度修饰的 AI 审美。

The composition is a relaxed, frontal view from the chest down, with a slightly imperfect feel. She has shoulder-length, soft, wavy, auburn hair, parted in the middle, with a natural texture and a few stray strands; her skin is fair with noticeable freckles, and her chest and neck show realistic skin texture. Her expression is casual and relaxed. She wears a light gray cardigan over a pale lace-trimmed camisole. The background is a white exterior door and wall, with a dark blue fabric chair or cushion visible on the left. The strong sunlight casts soft, warm highlights and natural shadows on her clothing and skin. The image should present an unretouched, candid, and highly realistic quality, rather than a heavily edited effect: including subtle asymmetry, normal mobile phone lens perspective, slightly compact cropping, a realistic home background, natural colors, soft contrast, and a documentary-level cinematic realism.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实的、原生智能手机自拍，拍摄对象为一位 {argument name="subject age" default="中年"} 女性，她坐在户外门廊或露台上，沐浴在午后温暖的黄金时刻阳光中。构图为胸部以上的休闲正面视角，略带不完美感。她留着齐肩的柔和波浪形赤褐色头发，中分，发质自然，有几缕碎发；皮肤白皙，带有明显的雀斑，胸部和颈部呈现真实的皮肤质感，神态日常且放松。她身穿浅灰色开衫，内搭淡色蕾丝边吊带背心。背景是一扇白色外门和墙壁，左侧可见一把深蓝色布艺椅子或坐垫，强烈的阳光在她的衣物和皮肤上投下柔和的暖色高光和自然阴影。画面应呈现出未经修饰、抓拍且极具真实感的质感，而非精修效果：包含微妙的不对称感、正常的手机镜头透视、略显紧凑的裁剪、真实的家居背景、自然的色彩、柔和的对比度以及纪录片级别的摄影真实感。

templates.title: Origami 3D Tyrannosaurus Rex Book Advertisement

titleLocalized.zh: 折纸立体霸王龙图书广告

templates.prompt: A cinematic studio photo shows an open book.{argument name="book type" default="Pop-up book"} Lay flat on a clean white surface, photographed from a low, frontal angle. At the center of the image is a piece entirely constructed from intricate white origami and laser-cut paper.{argument name="main subject" default="Tyrannosaurus Rex"} Leaping upwards from the crease of the pages, this enormous and visually striking dinosaur faces right, roaring with a gaping jaw revealing sharp, paper-like teeth. Its forelimbs are short, its hind legs powerful, and its long tail sweeps to the left. Its body is constructed from hundreds of delicate strips of paper and openwork cutouts, appearing backlit and translucent under the strong light from within and beneath the pages. Around the bottom, seven paper plant silhouettes rise from the pages: three darker shrubs in the foreground and four lighter-colored ferns in the background, all cut from paper. Blurred text is printed on the right side of the open page, and a bright white light emanates from the spine, penetrating the entire structure. The soft, cool blue ambient light contrasts with the warm white light inside the book, creating a dreamlike, children's advertising atmosphere. Strong spotlights from above and behind the dinosaur cast sharp shadows on the pages and the table. The background is minimalist yet rich in detail, possessing an elegant commercial advertising aesthetic. It features volumetric light and fog, a shallow depth of field, and uses a monochromatic white and blue color scheme. The composition is extremely clean, presenting a surreal, handcrafted realistic style.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影质感的摄影棚照片，展示了一本打开的 {argument name="book type" default="立体书"} 平放在干净的白色表面上，采用低角度正面视角拍摄。画面中心，一只完全由精细的白色折纸和激光切割纸张构成的 {argument name="main subject" default="霸王龙"} 从书页折痕处向上跃出。这只恐龙体型巨大且极具视觉冲击力，面向右侧，呈现出咆哮姿态，张开的下颚露出锋利的纸质牙齿，前肢短小，后腿强壮，长尾向左扫过。其身体由数百层精致的纸条和镂空剪裁构成，在内部和书页下方强光的照射下，呈现出背光和半透明的质感。在底部周围，书页中升起 7 株纸质植物剪影：前景中有 3 株颜色较深的灌木，后方有 4 株浅色的蕨类植物形状，均由纸张剪裁而成。打开的书页右侧印有模糊的文字，书脊中心散发出明亮的白光，向上穿透整个结构。柔和的冷蓝色环境光与书内温暖的白光形成对比，营造出梦幻般的儿童广告氛围。来自恐龙上方和后方的强聚光灯在书页和桌面上投下清晰的阴影。背景极简，细节丰富，具有优雅的商业广告美感，带有体积光雾，景深较浅，采用单色白与蓝的色调，构图极其干净，呈现出超现实的手工写实风格。

templates.prompt: An exquisite pop-up book advertisement for children, set against a dark, studio-style background. In the image, a hardcover book with thick white pages and a turquoise cover lies flat on a table. From the central crease, a richly detailed white origami Tyrannosaurus Rex leaps out in a dynamic, roaring pose, its mouth wide open revealing sharp triangular teeth, its tiny claws raised upwards, its thick, folded legs rooted in layers of paper jungle vegetation, and its segmented tail extending backwards. The dinosaur should have a handcrafted texture made of crisp cardboard, with clear geometric cardboard stitching and neat origami seams. Behind it, the right side of the page rises, casting a dramatic shadow of the Tyrannosaurus Rex's profile, forming a huge silhouette with its mouth wide open; this page also includes smaller paper-cut scenes: three flying pterosaurs and a simple mountain landscape. The dinosaur's base is surrounded by lush paper-cut plants and grasses growing from the pages. The scene is illuminated by cinematic warm-toned spotlights shining from the upper left, with a deep navy blue to black background, casting soft, realistic shadows on the books and their upright pages. At the top center, there is a stacked, bold white typography of advertisements with text {argument name="headline text" default="DINOSAURS POP UP ADVENTURE"} Below it is a white ribbon banner with the text:{argument name="tagline" default="A WORLD OF WONDER IN EVERY PAGE"} At the bottom center, four evenly spaced circular function icons are placed, each with a white title: an open book icon labeled "AMAZING POP UP DESIGNS," a hand icon labeled "HANDCRAFTED WITH CARE," a shield icon labeled "DURABLE & KID FRIENDLY," and a light bulb icon labeled "INSPIRES IMAGINATION." The design features a high-end toy catalog style, combining cinematic product photography with paper art illustrations, a central composition, high contrast, ultra-clean aesthetics, a fantastical feel, family-friendly design, and realistic paper textures.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的儿童立体书广告，背景为深色摄影棚风格。画面中，一本带有厚实白页和青绿色封面的精装书平放在桌面上。从书的中心折痕处，一只细节丰富的白色折纸霸王龙以动态咆哮的姿势跃出，它张大嘴巴露出锋利的三角形牙齿，细小的爪子向上抬起，粗壮的折叠腿扎根在层叠的纸质丛林植被中，分段式的尾巴向后延伸。恐龙应呈现出由挺括卡纸手工制作的质感，带有清晰的几何纸板拼接和整洁的折纸缝隙。在它身后，右侧书页部分立起，投射出霸王龙侧影的戏剧性阴影，形成一个张开大嘴的巨大剪影；该页面还包含小型剪纸场景：3 只飞行的翼龙和简单的山脉景观。恐龙底座周围环绕着从书页中生长出的茂密剪纸植物和草丛。场景采用从左上方照射的电影级暖色聚光灯，背景保持深海军蓝至黑色，书本和立起的书页上投射出柔和逼真的阴影。在顶部中心，包含堆叠的粗体白色广告排版，文字为 {argument name="headline text" default="DINOSAURS POP UP ADVENTURE"}，下方配有一条白色丝带横幅，文字为 {argument name="tagline" default="A WORLD OF WONDER IN EVERY PAGE"}。在底部中心，放置 4 个间距均匀的圆形功能图标，并配有白色标题：一个标有“AMAZING POP UP DESIGNS”的打开书本图标、一个标有“HANDCRAFTED WITH CARE”的手部图标、一个标有“DURABLE & KID FRIENDLY”的盾牌图标，以及一个标有“INSPIRES IMAGINATION”的灯泡图标。高端玩具目录风格，电影级产品摄影与纸艺插画结合，中心构图，高对比度，超洁净，奇幻，适合家庭，逼真的纸张纹理。

The overall layout should convey the feel of a high-end real estate investment advertisement, employing eye-catching typography, a glossy marketing design, and a color scheme of cyan, red, white, and gray. Place a small, capitalized headline in the upper left corner.{argument name="headline text" default="LIVE BETTER. INVEST SMARTER."} Below it, add a very large stacked main title:{argument name="main headline line 1" default="OWN YOUR"} (Dark cyan) and{argument name="main headline line 2" default="DREAM HOME"} (Bright red), using a bold, compressed sans-serif font. Add a cyan ribbon banner below with white capital letters.{argument name="tagline text" default="LUXURY LIVING. LASTING VALUE."} Below the slogan, three circular icons are arranged horizontally, separated by thin vertical lines: a shield icon with the text "SECURE YOUR FUTURE," a rising bar icon with the text "HIGH VALUE INVESTMENT," and a house icon with the text "MODERN & ELEGANT." On the left side and at the bottom center, a large, realistic contemporary luxury residence is displayed. The two-story building features white and gray facades, black trim, large windows, balconies, landscaped shrubs, and a paved driveway, presented from a three-quarter view. On the right, a Black adult male, above waist height, wearing a green knit sweater, faces forward, pointing directly at the viewer in a confident, sales poster pose; his body overlaps with the house and extends into the foreground. Near his lower torso, a glossy red circular badge with a slightly 3D effect contains large white capital letters.{argument name="callout text" default="BUY NOW!"} Attach a small, dark cyan, angled banner along its bottom edge that reads “LIMITED UNITS AVAILABLE!”. At the bottom, create a dark cyan panel containing three equally spaced, rounded rectangular property cards with white borders. Card 1 should showcase a row of modern townhouses, labeled “MODERN TERRACES,” with two footnotes below: “Spacious Rooms” and “24/7 Security.” Card 2 should showcase a luxury villa with a pool, labeled “LUXURY VILLAS,” with two footnotes below: “Premium Amenities” and “Prime Locations.” Card 3 should showcase a detached, upscale modern home, labeled “EXCLUSIVE HOMES,” with two footnotes below: “Registered Title” and “Trusted Developer.” At the very bottom, include a blank white rounded rectangle spanning most of the width as a placeholder for contact information or a footer. The goal is to create a clear, high-contrast, commercial, and desirable overall image, designed with the professionalism of a high-end real estate marketing poster.

INVEST SMARTER."}。在其正下方，添加一个非常大的堆叠式主标题：{argument name="main headline line 1" default="OWN YOUR"}（深青色）和 {argument name="main headline line 2" default="DREAM HOME"}（鲜红色），使用粗体压缩无衬线字体。下方添加一条青色丝带横幅，上面写着白色大写文字 {argument name="tagline text" default="LUXURY LIVING. LASTING VALUE."}。在标语下方，水平排列 3 个圆形功能图标，图标之间用细竖线分隔：盾牌图标配文“SECURE YOUR FUTURE”，上升的柱状图图标配文“HIGH VALUE INVESTMENT”，房屋图标配文“MODERN & ELEGANT”。在左侧中部和底部中心，展示一栋大型写实风格的当代豪华住宅，建筑为 2 层，拥有白色和灰色外墙、黑色饰边、大落地窗、阳台、景观灌木和铺设好的车道，以正面四分之三的角度呈现。在右侧，放置一位腰部以上的黑人成年男性，身穿绿色针织毛衣，面向前方，以自信的销售海报姿势直接指向观众；他的身体与房屋重叠并延伸至前景。在他下躯干附近，添加一个带有轻微 3D 效果的光泽红色圆形徽章，内含大号白色大写文字 {argument name="callout text" default="BUY NOW!"}，并在其底部边缘附加一个深青色的小型斜角横幅，上面写着“LIMITED UNITS AVAILABLE!”。在底部，创建一个深青色面板，其中包含 3 张带有白色边框且间距相等的圆角矩形房产卡片。卡片 1 应展示一排现代联排别墅，标签为“MODERN TERRACES”，下方放置 2 个小功能点：“Spacious Rooms”和“24/7 Security”。卡片 2 应展示一栋带泳池的豪华别墅，标签为“LUXURY VILLAS”，下方放置 2 个小功能点：“Premium Amenities”和“Prime Locations”。卡片 3 应展示一栋独立的高档现代住宅，标签为“EXCLUSIVE HOMES”，下方放置 2 个小功能点：“Registered Title”和“Trusted Developer”。在最底部，包含一个横跨大部分宽度的空白白色圆角矩形，作为联系方式或页脚信息的占位区域。使整体图像清晰、高对比度、商业化、令人向往，并像高端房地产营销海报一样专业设计。

templates.prompt: A charming, stylized 3D animated forest village scene, set during the golden hour, shows two adorable insect characters meeting on a cobblestone path, surrounded by cottages with mushroom-shaped roofs. In the left foreground, a cute {argument name="main insect type" default="ladybug"} Crouching low, it has an enormous, glossy black head, huge and expressive brown eyes, a small, smiling mouth, short, rounded tentacles, and a tiny [unclear - possibly a feature or feature] near one of its tentacles.{argument name="accessory color" default="red"} A bow. Its shell is brightly colored.{argument name="shell color" default="red"} It has distinct black spots, a deep charcoal black body, and rounded, supple limbs. In the middle ground on the right, a cheerful little {argument name="second insect type" default="bee"} Hovering slightly above the ground, facing the larger insect with an equally enormous head, shimmering eyes, delicate translucent wings, tiny antennae, and slightly raised forelimbs, it seems to be engaged in an excited conversation. The scene is set in a charming woodland village the size of an insect, with three small huts, round wooden doors, winding stone walls, and paths surrounded by moss, vines, flowers, and leafy plants. Warm, cinematic sunlight filters through the trees in the upper right, creating bright rim lighting, soft bokeh, and floating firefly-like particles. Shot from a low angle with a shallow depth of field, from the insect's perspective, the image is rich in autumnal greens and gold tones, with highly detailed textures, soft global illumination, a fantastical home movie atmosphere, Pixar-esque realism, and subtle dreamlike double exposures, with some areas of the image featuring subtle overlapping light and shadow or bokeh highlights.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个温馨的风格化 3D 动画森林村庄场景，时间设定在黄金时刻，展示了 2 只可爱的昆虫角色在鹅卵石小径上相遇，周围是带有蘑菇屋顶的小屋。左侧前景中，一只可爱的 {argument name="main insect type" default="瓢虫"} 低身蹲着，有着超大的亮黑色头部、巨大且富有表现力的棕色眼睛、小巧的微笑嘴巴、末端圆润的短触角，以及靠近其中一根触角处的一个微小的 {argument name="accessory color" default="红色"} 蝴蝶结。它的背壳是鲜艳的 {argument name="shell color" default="红色"}，带有明显的黑色斑点，身体呈深炭黑色，四肢圆润柔软。右侧中景中，一只欢快的小 {argument name="second insect type" default="蜜蜂"} 在离地稍高处盘旋，面对着那只较大的昆虫，有着同样超大的头部、闪烁的大眼睛、精致的半透明翅膀、细小的触角，以及微微抬起的前肢，仿佛正在兴奋地交谈。场景设定在一个迷人的昆虫大小的林地村落中，可见 3 座小屋、圆形的木门、弯曲的石墙、苔藓、藤蔓、花朵和叶片植物环绕着小径。温暖的电影级阳光从右上方的树木间穿过，营造出明亮的轮廓光、柔和的焦外成像以及漂浮的萤火虫般的微粒。使用浅景深，以昆虫视角的低机位拍摄，呈现丰富的秋绿色调和金色调，具有高度细腻的纹理、柔和的全局光照、奇幻的家庭电影氛围、皮克斯风格的写实感，以及微妙的梦幻双重曝光感，画面部分区域带有淡淡的重叠光影或虚影高光。

templates.prompt: A high-quality, handcrafted food photography image showcases a transparent acrylic display case placed on a rustic wooden table. The shot employs a clean 4:5 product style, with soft, natural lighting and a shallow depth of field. The case contains a dedicated display case.{argument name="dish name" default="Eggs Benedict"} The miniature kitchen model features a tiny chef figure in the center, dressed in a white chef's hat and uniform with a red scarf, preparing to drizzle glossy hollandaise sauce over Eggs Benedict stacked on top of half an English muffin. The central kitchen area includes a miniature stove, a frying pan, a small saucepan in the chef's hand, a wooden preparation table, two knives on the table, three hanging metal utensils, two stacked plates on a lower shelf, a small white bowl, and two seasoning grinders under the table. Surrounding the central scene, the acrylic box contains 12 transparent food compartments: the top four compartments hold two English muffins, three pieces of butter, three lemon slices, and three whole eggs; the left four compartments hold three slices of round Canadian bacon, two sprigs of parsley, one whole egg, and two bottles of condiments; the right four compartments contain a map card labeled "USA" (with a red map of the United States and a tiny marker of New York City), one compartment with chopped chives, two spice jars, and three beaten egg yolks. The top and bottom edges of the acrylic packaging feature striking red, white, and blue decorative stripes, echoing the colors of the American flag. A front label is added with the following text:{argument name="front label" default="EGGS BENEDICT"} Smaller text below{argument name="origin and date" default="USA - 1894"} Maintaining the high level of detail, realism, sophistication, and luxury of the miniature model, it resembles museum-quality culinary collectibles or high-end toy packaging, featuring clear, transparent reflections and a warm, edited desktop background.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高级手工美食摄影图片，展示了一个放置在质朴木桌上的透明亚克力收藏盒，采用干净的 4:5 产品风格拍摄，光线柔和自然，景深较浅。盒子内含一个专门展示 {argument name="dish name" default="Eggs Benedict"} 的微缩厨房模型，中心站着一位身穿白色厨师帽和白色制服、系着红色领巾的微型厨师人偶，正处于准备阶段，将光亮的荷兰酱淋在堆叠于英式松饼半块上的班尼迪克蛋上。在中心厨房区域内，包含 1 个微型炉灶、1 个平底锅、厨师手中 1 个小炖锅、1 张木制准备台、桌上 2 把刀、3 个悬挂的金属厨具、下层架子上的 2 个叠放盘子、1 个白色小碗以及桌下的 2 个调味研磨器。在中心场景周围，亚克力盒壁内置了 12 个透明食材格：顶排 4 个格子分别装有 2 个英式松饼、3 块黄油、3 片柠檬和 3 个全蛋；左侧 4 个格子分别装有 3 片圆形加拿大培根、2 枝欧芹、1 个全蛋和 2 瓶调味品；右侧 4 个格子分别装有 1 张标有 USA 的产地地图卡（带有红色美国地图和微小的纽约市标记）、1 格切碎的细香葱、2 个香料罐和 3 个打碎的蛋黄。亚克力包装的顶部和底部边缘带有醒目的红、白、蓝装饰条，呼应美国国旗配色。添加一个正面标签牌，文字为 {argument name="front label" default="EGGS BENEDICT"}，下方附有较小的文字 {argument name="origin and date" default="USA - 1894"}。保持微缩模型的高度细节、逼真、精致且奢华，如同博物馆级的烹饪收藏品或高端玩具包装，具有清晰的透明反射和温暖的编辑风格桌面背景。

templates.prompt: Create a high-end global sportswear promotional poster. The background is a simple light gray studio backdrop, and the foreground features a female athlete in a squatting position, using a fashionable advertising photography style. She is a young woman with {argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown"} She sports shoulder-length, slightly tousled short hair, a fitted white short-sleeved athletic T-shirt with a small black pumas logo on the chest, black leggings, a light gray sweatshirt tied around her waist, and gray running shoes with a sophisticated white brand logo. Her posture is low and powerful, one knee raised, one hand resting on the raised knee, the other hanging naturally, confidently facing the camera. Behind and around her, large black hand-drawn calligraphy fills most of the composition, showcasing a highly expressive activist style. templates.title: Ink-wash Tiger-riding Warrior

titleLocalized.zh: 水墨骑虎武士

templates.prompt: A dramatic, vertically composed Chinese ink-wash fantasy painting, executed on warm beige Xuan paper, seamlessly blends grand calligraphy with a heroic scene. On the right side of the painting, an ancient, solitary warrior, clad in a magnificent dark robe and layered black armor, rides atop a large tiger, standing on the edge of a rugged cliff. Both figures are presented from a three-quarters rear view, facing the expansive landscape to the left. The warrior, draped in a cloak with long, flowing ribbons that billow in the wind, raises a straight sword vertically, its blade transforming into a dazzling golden-white beam of light that shoots into the dense storm clouds. The tiger is robust, lifelike, and alert, richly detailed with striking stripes, white fur, and ceremonial drapery and harness adorned with exquisite gold accents. The sky is filled with soft, smoky gray ink-wash clouds, their diffused light mingling with golden speckles around the luminous sword. In the lower left, a hazy landscape extends towards distant mountains, rivers, and sparse foliage, rendered in pale gray ink to create layers of atmospheric mist. The left half of the composition features two large, vertically arranged, highly expressive black calligraphy lines, their bold and irregular strokes dominating the height. Beside them is a narrower vertical calligraphy line of smaller characters, along with a total of four red seals: two small seals near the smaller inscription, one near the upper right edge, and a double-layered red seal in the lower left corner. The composition emphasizes the strong contrast between negative space and bold ink, the aesthetics of literati painting, the flowing brushstrokes, the epic martial arts spirit, and a modern fantasy texture with restrained metallic highlights.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅极具戏剧性的竖构图中国水墨奇幻画作，绘制于暖米色宣纸上，将宏大的书法与英雄人物场景融为一体。画面右侧，一位身着华丽深色长袍与层叠黑色铠甲的古代孤勇武士骑在一只大老虎背上，立于嶙峋峭壁边缘，两者均以四分之三背面视角呈现，面向左侧的开阔景观。武士披着斗篷，长长的飘带在风中飞舞，他垂直举起一把直剑，剑身化作一道璀璨的金白色光柱，直冲入浓密的风暴云层中。老虎体格健硕、神态逼真且警觉，细节丰富，带有醒目的斑纹、白色毛发点缀，以及带有精致金色装饰的礼仪布饰与马具。天空中弥漫着烟灰色水墨云雾，晕染柔和，发光的剑束周围散布着金色斑点。左下方，朦胧的山水景观向远处的群山、河流、细小的树丛延伸，并以淡灰色水墨渲染出层叠的大气雾霭。在构图的左半部分，包含 2 列巨大的竖排表现力极强的黑色书法，笔触粗犷且不规则，占据了大部分高度；在旁边增加 1 列较窄的竖排小字书法，并总共添加 4 枚红色印章，其中 2 枚小印章靠近较小的题字，1 枚印章靠近右上边缘，1 枚双层红色印章位于左下角。强调留白与浓墨之间的强烈对比、文人画美学、挥洒的笔触气韵、史诗般的武侠气势，以及带有克制金属金高光的现代奇幻质感。

templates.title: Ink-wash equestrian warrior

titleLocalized.zh: 水墨骑马武士

templates.prompt: This dramatically dramatic vertical Chinese ink painting, rendered in monochrome black, charcoal gray, and soft gray tones on off-white Xuan paper, blends the brushstrokes of freehand landscape painting with the style of heroic epics and martial arts illustrations. On the right side of the painting, a general in armor stands on a rocky cliff, his back slightly turned, surveying the vast army below. A warrior, clad in layers of black lamellar armor, his cloak billowing in the wind, long ribbons adorning his hair, holds a straight sword, its blade pointing diagonally towards his horse. The muscular, jet-black warhorse stands firmly on the cliff edge, its tail and mane swaying gently in the breeze. In the lower half of the painting, a dense square of soldiers appears as hazy silhouettes, spears standing tall, battle flags fluttering, appearing and disappearing in the mist. In the distance, steep mountain peaks emerge from the clouds in the upper right corner, while seven small birds fly across the pale sky in the center of the painting. The left side of the image features two large columns of black cursive calligraphy: the main text reads "He fought across three thousand miles, his sword once faced a million soldiers," followed by a smaller vertical signature "Wang Wei" and a red seal. The design emphasizes strong negative space, the texture of ink wash, the flying white brushstrokes, a sense of grandeur and ambiguity, an epic sense of loneliness, the majestic spirit of martial arts, and a solemn and profound artistic conception.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅极具戏剧性的竖构图中国水墨画，采用单色黑、炭灰和柔和的灰色调，绘制于米白色宣纸之上，呈现出写意山水笔触与英雄史诗武侠插画的风格。画面右侧，一位身披盔甲的将军骑着战马伫立在岩石悬崖之上，背影略带侧面，正俯瞰着下方广阔的军队。武士身着层叠的黑色札甲，披风在风中飘动，发髻上系着长长的飘带；他手持一把直剑，剑身斜指马侧。战马肌肉发达，通体漆黑，稳稳地立于悬崖边缘，马尾和鬃毛在风中微微拂动。画面下半部分，密集的士兵方阵呈现为朦胧的剪影，长矛林立，战旗飘扬，在雾气中若隐若现。远方，陡峭的山峰在右上角的云雾中隐现，画面中央苍白的天空中飞过 7 只小鸟。画面左侧包含两列巨大的黑色狂草书法：主文为“一身转战三千里，一剑曾当百万师”，下方配有较小的竖排签名“王维”，以及一枚红色印章。强调强烈的留白、水墨晕染的纹理、飞白笔触、大气朦胧感、史诗般的孤独感、武侠的宏大气势以及庄重深沉的意境。

templates.title: Chinese ink swordsmen and calligraphy

titleLocalized.zh: 中国水墨剑客与书法

templates.prompt: A dramatically dramatic vertical Chinese ink painting, executed on aged Xuan paper, employs a minimalist monochrome style with soft, warm parchment tones. On the right side of the painting, an ancient swordsman stands alone on the edge of a steep, dark cliff, primarily shown from behind. He wears flowing ancient clothing, his long cloak billowing in the wind, his long hair, tied in a bun, cascading to the side, while his right hand holds a long sword. To the lower left extends a vast, misty landscape, revealing a distant frontier city, indistinct beacon towers and rooftops, winding rivers or plains, and layered mountain silhouettes shrouded in smoke. The painting utilizes expressive black brushstrokes, splashed ink textures, dry brush edges, ethereal white space, and a striking contrast between the deep black figure and cliff and the pale, expansive background. Two bold, large black calligraphy columns are added to the left half, reading "I wish to draw my sword" and "I will directly slay the Loulan." A smaller vertical inscription is added to the far left, reading "Six Songs of the Frontier by Li Bai," along with two red seals, one near the smaller inscription and the other near the upper right corner. The overall effect is heroic, solitary, contemplative, and full of pride, like a poster presenting the image of a Tang Dynasty poet and warrior in a traditional ink painting style.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的竖构图中国水墨画，绘制于陈旧的宣纸之上，采用极简的单色风格，带有柔和温暖的羊皮纸色调。画面右侧，一位古代剑客孤身伫立在陡峭的深色悬崖边缘，以四分之三背影为主。他身着飘逸的古装，长长的披风在风中飞舞，束着发髻的长发在风中向侧面飘散，右手垂持一把长剑。左下方延伸出广阔的迷雾景观，可见 1 座遥远的边塞城池、隐约的烽火台与屋顶、蜿蜒的河流或平原，以及层叠隐入烟霭的山峦剪影。运用富有表现力的黑色笔触、泼墨纹理、枯笔边缘、空灵的留白，以及浓重的深色人物与悬崖同苍白开阔背景之间的强烈对比。在左半部分添加 2 列醒目的大字黑色书法，内容为“愿将腰下剑”和“直为斩楼兰。”，并在最左侧添加 1 列较小的竖排题款，内容为“塞下曲六首 李白”，同时包含 2 枚红色印章，一枚靠近小字题款，另一枚靠近右上角。整体意境英雄气概十足，孤独、沉思且充满傲骨，如同将唐代诗人兼战士的形象以传统水墨画风格呈现的海报。

templates.title: Chinese ink painting and calligraphy

titleLocalized.zh: 中国水墨画与书法

templates.prompt: A traditional Chinese ink painting with a vertical composition, painted on aged gray-white Xuan paper, employs a minimalist monochromatic palette, combining soft gray washes with deep black brushstrokes. The composition integrates large, unrestrained Chinese calligraphy on the left and center with a misty landscape on the right. The inscription, "Reflecting a person as if reflecting water, cutting jade as if cutting mud," is written in bold strokes, arranged in two vertical columns. The left column contains four large characters, and the right column contains four large characters plus punctuation in the center. Each character is written with varying degrees of wetness, dryness, and ink density, revealing distinct brushstrokes, ink dots, and the texture of the ink marks. Two red seals are added: a small oval seal next to the calligraphy in the upper left corner, and a square seal in the lower left corner. The right half depicts towering, rugged cliffs, adorned with sparse pine trees, floating clouds, and two slender waterfalls flowing into a calm river. In the lower right foreground, two ancient Chinese literati dressed in flowing Hanfu (traditional Han clothing) with their hair styled in buns are depicted sitting at a flat stone table on a riverside rock, quietly discussing a "project" or manuscript. Their figures are relatively small compared to the landscape. The scene includes still water reflections, a low-lying island in the distance, and layers of atmospheric clouds. The overall mood is one of contemplation, literati painting, poetic solitude, and an elegant scholarly atmosphere. The illustration is inspired by Song Dynasty ink painting and complemented by exquisite calligraphy.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅竖构图的传统中国水墨画，绘制于陈旧的灰白色宣纸上，采用极简的单色调，结合柔和的灰色渲染与深邃的黑色笔触。构图将左侧和中央大幅奔放的中国书法与右侧烟雾缭绕的山水景观相结合。以粗犷的笔触书写引文：“照人如照水，切玉如切泥。” 排列为 2 列竖行，左列 4 个大字，右侧中央 4 个大字加标点，每个字均以干湿浓淡变化的笔触书写，可见明显的笔锋收尖、墨点与墨迹质感。添加 2 枚红色印章：一枚小椭圆形印章位于左上角书法旁，一枚方形印章位于左下角。右半部分绘制高耸嶙峋的悬崖，点缀稀疏的松树、漂浮的云雾，以及 2 条细长的瀑布汇入平静的河流。右下角前景处，描绘 2 位身着飘逸汉服、梳着发髻的中国古代文人，坐在河边岩石上的平坦石桌旁，俯身对着一个“项目”或手稿进行安静的探讨；他们的人物比例相对于山水景观应较小。包含静水倒影、远处的低矮小岛以及层叠的氛围感云雾。整体意境：沉思、文人画、诗意孤独、优雅的学者氛围，受宋代风格启发的水墨插画，配以精湛的书法。

templates.title: Old Shanghai style poster

titleLocalized.zh: 老上海融合风格海报

templates.prompt: A vertical cultural tourism poster printed on warm-toned off-white textured paper is inspired by handmade 3D silhouette collages, piecing together the outline of the Chinese character "Shanghai". Employing a sophisticated "fusion of old and new" Shanghai theme, it incorporates miniature architecture, street scenes, props, food, and typography, photographed from a frontal perspective with soft studio lighting and delicate projections. The overall composition is elegant, magazine-edition-esque, nostalgic, and sophisticated, using soft cream, brass gold, turquoise, brick red, jade, and weathered wood tones. In the upper left corner, the upper half of the Chinese character is constructed from a modern glass skyscraper, a tall historical building with a golden crown, a neoclassical waterfront building with a dome, a clock tower municipal building, two background towers, two red vintage Shanghai trams, and a rickshaw. Below this, a Jiangnan water town area is created, incorporating two tall, red Oriental Pearl Tower spheres and pillars, two vertically displayed cheongsams, four old-style Shikumen and lane houses, a winding waterfront canal, four wooden boats, and a gramophone on the far left and far right. At the center of the image, a large diagonal metallic relief title is placed, displayed in bold, retro 3D font.{argument name="headline text" default="SHANGHAI COLLECTION"} Add retro-style handwritten text to the right side of the upper composition.{argument name="subtitle text" default="OLD SHANGHAI FUSION"} Add serif font text in the lower left corner.{argument name="tagline text" default="DESIGN POSTER"} The lower half uses miniature models of traditional Chinese architecture and everyday objects to piece together the remaining parts of the Chinese characters: a large group of classical Chinese rooftop buildings, four vertical neon-style shop signs with Chinese characters, two square decorative plaques, a small green porcelain ewer, two shallow plates, a rectangular tray (containing six xiaolongbao), a long tray (containing three strings of white candied hawthorn-shaped desserts), two round mooncakes, a small sauce dish, a rectangular display shelf (containing four steamed buns), a bowl of noodles, two golden pastries, a plate of white flower-shaped desserts, a small doll, two Peking Opera masks, and two newspapers hanging in the lower right corner. The background remains spacious and simple, with the collage and text arranged diagonally, presenting an exquisite poster layout. The entire image looks like a meticulously assembled handmade paper and wood three-dimensional model, blending the charm of Art Deco Shanghai, the nostalgia of the Republic of China era, the elegance of the Jiangnan water towns, and traditional Chinese urban culture.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张印在暖色调米白色纹理纸上的竖版文化旅游海报，设计灵感源自手工 3D 剪影盒拼贴画，拼凑出“上海”的汉字轮廓。采用精致的“新旧交融”上海主题，融入微缩建筑、街景、道具、美食和字体，以正面视角拍摄，配以柔和的摄影棚灯光和细腻的投影。整体构图优雅、具有杂志编辑感、怀旧且高级，色调采用柔和的奶油色、黄铜金、青绿色、砖红色、玉色和风化木色。在左上方，用 1 座现代玻璃摩天大楼、1 座带有金色皇冠的高大历史建筑、1 座圆顶新古典主义滨水建筑、1 座钟楼市政建筑、2 座背景小塔、2 辆红色复古上海电车和 1 辆黄包车构建出汉字的上半部分。在其下方，打造一个江南水乡区域，包含 2 个高大的红色东方明珠塔球体与立柱元素、2 件垂直展示的旗袍、4 栋老式石库门和里弄住宅、1 条弯曲的滨水运河、4 艘水上木船，并在最左侧和最右侧各放置 1 台留声机。在画面中心，放置一个巨大的对角线金属质感浮雕标题，以粗体复古 3D 字体显示 {argument name="headline text" default="SHANGHAI COLLECTION"}。在上部构图右侧，添加手写风格的复古文字 {argument name="subtitle text" default="OLD SHANGHAI FUSION"}。在左下方，添加衬线字体文字 {argument name="tagline text" default="DESIGN POSTER"}。下半部分使用传统中式建筑微缩模型和市井物件拼凑出汉字的剩余部分：1 组大型古典中式屋顶建筑群、4 个带有中文字符的垂直霓虹灯风格店招、2 块方形装饰牌匾、1 个绿色小瓷执壶、2 个浅食盘、1 个长方形托盘（内含 6 个小笼包）、1 个长托盘（内含 3 串白色糖葫芦状甜点）、2 个圆形月饼、1 个小酱料碟、1 个长方形展示架（内含 4 个馒头）、1 碗面条、2 个金色糕点、1 盘白色花朵形状的甜点、1 个小人偶、2 个京剧脸谱，以及右下角悬挂的 2 份报纸。背景保持宽敞简洁，拼贴画和文字呈对角线排列，呈现出精致的海报布局。整张图像看起来像是一个精心组装的手工纸木立体模型，融合了装饰艺术风格的上海魅力、民国时期的怀旧感、江南水乡的韵味以及传统中国市井文化。

templates.title: Beijing Cultural Heritage Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 北京文化遗产海报

templates.prompt: An exquisite vertical cultural exhibition poster, featuring a warm ivory-textured paper background and an elegant museum catalog aesthetic with ample negative space. At the center of the image is a grand Chinese calligraphy work, presented in sculptural 3D architectural font, with the content {argument name="main Chinese character" default="Beijing"} Composed of two enormous, interconnected Chinese characters, the design is entirely constructed from miniature Beijing cultural heritage landmarks and traditional decorative elements. The strokes resemble carved lacquer and wooden architectural components, employing rich hues of vermilion red, aged gold, jade green, turquoise blue, stone gray, and ivory white, with exquisite relief details, soft shadows, and the texture of a handcrafted collectible. Iconic Beijing imagery is incorporated into the calligraphic strokes: glazed tile palace roofs, temple pavilions, staircases, carved railings, corner towers, winding sections of the Great Wall, auspicious clouds, stone lion sculptures, ancient trees, golden ginkgo branches, hanging red lanterns, Peking Opera masks, a string of translucent candied hawthorns, the Temple of Heaven, and a roast duck hidden within a lower stroke. The composition is like a miniature cultural world embedded in each stroke, possessing realistic depth, clear surface detail, and soft museum lighting from the upper left. Sparse text is added around the main artwork with exquisite typography: a tiny logo and the words "BEIJING CHINA" in the upper left, followed by "2024" and "CITY CULTURE SERIES" in small, thin serif capital letters below; a vertical Chinese title, "A Magnificent Epic of Beijing," in the upper right, accompanied by a few lines of smaller vertical Chinese text and a red seal; and elegant large serif text in the lower left.{argument name="city name in English" default="BEIJING"} Below is{argument name="subtitle" default="ETERNAL GLORY"} This is followed by smaller text "EXHIBITION POSTER," "NO.2024-001," and tiny heritage-themed footer text; the bottom right corner features tiny lowercase text.{argument name="tagline" default="TIMELESS HERITAGE"} And "CULTURAL LEGACY OF A THOUSAND YEARS". The overall style maintains luxury, poetry, high detail and high-end, blending traditional Chinese culture, architectural miniature art and contemporary poster design.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的竖版文化展览海报，背景为温暖的象牙色纹理纸，采用留白充裕的优雅博物馆图录美学设计。画面中心为一件宏大的中式书法作品，以雕塑感 3D 建筑字体呈现，内容为 {argument name="main Chinese character" default="北京"}，由两个巨大的相互连接的汉字构成，完全由微缩的北京文化遗产地标和传统装饰元素搭建而成。笔画如同雕漆与木质建筑构件，色彩采用浓郁的朱砂红、陈年金、玉石绿、绿松石蓝、石灰色和象牙白，具有精致的浮雕细节、柔和的阴影以及手工收藏品的质感。在书法笔画中融入标志性的北京意象：琉璃瓦宫殿屋顶、寺庙亭台、阶梯、雕花栏杆、角楼、蜿蜒的长城段落、祥云、石狮雕塑、古树、金色银杏枝叶、悬挂的红灯笼、京剧脸谱、一串晶莹剔透的冰糖葫芦、天坛，以及藏在下方笔画中的一只烤鸭。构图如同嵌入每个笔画中的文化微缩世界，具有逼真的深度、清晰的表面细节以及来自左上方的柔和博物馆灯光。在主艺术作品周围以精致的编辑排版添加稀疏的文字：左上方为一个微小的徽标和文字 "BEIJING CHINA"，下方为小号纤细衬线大写字母的 "2024" 和 "CITY CULTURE SERIES"；右上方为竖排中文标题 "北京 一座城的壮阔史诗"，配有几行较小的竖排中文文案和一枚红色印章；左下方为优雅的大号衬线文字 {argument name="city name in English" default="BEIJING"}，下方为 {argument name="subtitle" default="ETERNAL GLORY"}，随后是较小的文字 "EXHIBITION POSTER"、"NO.2024-001" 以及微小的遗产主题页脚文案；右下方为微小的小写字母文字 {argument name="tagline" default="TIMELESS HERITAGE"} 和 "CULTURAL LEGACY OF A THOUSAND YEARS"。整体风格保持奢华、诗意、高度细节化且高端，融合了中国传统文化、建筑微缩艺术与当代海报设计。
