templates.title: Blue Fantasy Knight character

titleLocalized.zh: 蓝色幻想骑士角色

templates.prompt: A full-body anime fantasy character design depicting a young male knight adventurer, standing frontally in a neutral pose against a transparent background with a visible gray checkerboard pattern. He has messy, medium-length hair.{argument name="hair color" default="warm brown"} His hair was layered and slightly spiky, and his physique was lean and heroic. His face was deliberately obscured by a soft, rectangular, blurred block at the center. He wore an exquisite royal blue and dark leather suit, with silver armor and gold filigree trim: a long, asymmetrical blue cloak draped over his shoulders and flowing to the sides; a high-necked blue tunic with close-fitting black and brown leather torso panels; two buckled, crossed breastplates; a wide, layered belt system at the waist; a leather side pocket on his left hip; silver shoulder armor and arm guards; two armored gauntlets; a slit blue robe with gold trim; dark trousers; two silver knee pads; and two high-top brown armored boots with metal toe caps and blue gemstone embellishments. The character is adorned with intricate fantasy decorations, including gold embroidery on his cloak and tunic, sculpted silver armor details, multiple buckles and straps, and a sunburst-like brooch on his right shoulder. A decorative longsword with a blue scabbard hangs from his right hip, revealing a magnificent gold and silver hilt. The illustration should maintain a clean, highly detailed style, presenting polished game character concept art in a refined JRPG aesthetic. The composition should be centered, with the entire body visible, clean lines, soft shadows, and an elegant fantasy aesthetic. It should be a standalone silhouette character without a background.

templates.title: Fantasy Warrior Character Concept Design

templates.prompt: A full-body concept art illustration of a fantasy character, the protagonist being {argument name="character gender" default="young men"} The soldier stands against a pure light gray background, relaxed yet poised to strike; the background is devoid of any environmental elements. He has messy hair {argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown"} With short hair, he presents a rugged, heroic JRPG style. Facial details are toned down, with the visual focus on his clothing and silhouette. He wears eight clearly visible clothing pieces: a dark, fitted bodysuit; a cream-colored layered breastplate with horned feather ruffles; a deep blue cloak draped over his shoulders and flowing backward; dark arm guards with wrapped forearms; a brown multi-functional belt with several tan leather bags and belts hanging from his waist; silver knee and greaves; and a pair of worn brown leather boots. He wields two weapons: a sheathed longsword at his left hip and a long, dark staff or club held diagonally downward in his right hand. The art style is highly detailed fantasy concept art with delicate ink outlines, soft earth tones, realistic fabric folds, soft shadows, and exquisite game character design. The composition is centered, and his entire body is clearly visible from head to toe.

templates.title: Astronauts on the Red Desert Planet

titleLocalized.zh: 红色沙漠星球上的宇航员

templates.prompt: A cinematic wide-angle shot shows a lone astronaut standing on the edge of a rock, his back to the camera, gazing at the vast red desert plains of a Mars-like planet. The astronaut is positioned in the lower center of the frame, wearing a realistic white EVA spacesuit with delicate gray panels, a life support backpack, heavy boots, and dark gloves; his helmet is not visible due to his back. The landscape is expansive and desolate, covered in rust-red dust, scattered rocks, and low-lying cliffs; the left foreground features a rugged cliff edge, the midground is dotted with rocky hills, and hazy mountains stretch across the distant horizon. The soft, warm peach and terracotta tones, with a thin atmospheric haze, and the gentle afternoon sunlight casting long shadows at the astronaut's feet, create an atmosphere of solitude, awe, and exploration, much like the opening scene of a science fiction film about first contact with an alien world. Realistic style, high detail, ultra-wide-angle composition, natural cinematic color gradation, epic feel, minimalism, no buildings, no vehicles, no text, no HUD, no other people.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个电影级的广角镜头，画面中一名孤独的宇航员站在岩石边缘背对镜头，眺望着火星般行星上广阔的红色沙漠平原。宇航员位于画面中下部，身穿写实的白色 EVA 宇航服，带有精致的灰色镶板、生命维持背包、厚重的靴子和深色手套；由于是背影，看不到头盔正面。景观广阔而荒凉，覆盖着铁锈红色的尘土、散落的石块和低矮的岩层；左侧前景为崎岖的悬崖边缘，中景散布着岩石丘陵，远处的地平线上延伸着朦胧的山脉。采用柔和的暖桃色和赤陶色调，带有稀薄的大气雾霾，午后柔和的阳光在宇航员脚后投下长长的影子。氛围孤独、充满敬畏感且富有探索性，如同科幻电影中关于首次接触外星世界的开场画面。写实风格，高细节，超广角构图，自然的电影级色彩分级，史诗感，极简主义，无建筑，无车辆，无文字，无 HUD，无其他人。

The image depicts a female athlete frozen in a leaping moment against a deep charcoal gray to purple gradient background. She is positioned slightly to the right of center, her body in a fluid, dynamic pose, as if soaring through the air. Her left arm is extended backward, her right arm bent forward, one leg kicking forward, and the other trailing backward. She has…{argument name="hair color" default="platinum blonde"} Her hair, styled in a messy bun with a few stray strands, is styled in an oversized off-white Nike crewneck sweatshirt, loose-fitting purple-grey marble-patterned sweatpants, and clean white Nike sneakers with a subtle purple sheen on the soles. Her face is obscured by a soft, rectangular blur, creating an anonymous, editorial feel. Behind and around her, dramatic electric purple smoke and energy clouds erupt and swirl, wrapping around her torso, legs, and feet, enhanced by luminous vapor trails and a storm-like atmosphere. A white Nike Swoosh logo is placed in the upper left corner. Three large, metallic silver 3D words are integrated into the lower part of the poster, containing the following text:{argument name="slogan text" default="JUST DO IT"} The image is broken down into visible word blocks: "JUST," "DO," and "IT," partially overlapping the athlete's body and spanning the entire composition like a striking advertising typography. The overall style is glossy, cinematic, high-end, and vibrant, utilizing dramatic rim lighting, strong contrast, a soft, atmospheric haze, and a fashionable, advertising-realistic style, as well as {argument name="brand name" default="Nike"} Create viral AI-generated sports advertising aesthetics.

templates.title: Winter Deer Paper-cut Forest

titleLocalized.zh: 冬日麋鹿剪纸森林

templates.prompt: This richly detailed, layered paper-cut perspective illustration depicts a family of four deer standing on a narrow forest path in the depths of winter. The image must precisely present four deer facing forward: a large, forked antlered male positioned slightly to the right of center; an adult female on the left; a smaller fawn in the foreground center; and another fawn on the right. The entire scene is constructed entirely in the style of exquisite paper-cutting, achieved through stacked layers of paper, clean cut edges, sculptural outlines, and soft, three-dimensional shadows between layers. The animals are made of warm brown, chestnut, tan, and cream-colored paper, with meticulous layering to represent chest fur, white muzzles, alert ears, and specks of snow on their heads, backs, and shoulders. A dense winter forest surrounds them, with tall, bare trees and fir trees rendered as layered paper silhouettes. Branches, bushes, rocks, and the ground are covered in a thick blanket of snow. Trees form a winding corridor, symmetrically framing the elk, with a snowy path extending from the foreground to the herd. The environment employs a restrained cool color palette: white, off-white, light gray, slate gray, and charcoal gray, contrasting with the warm brown of the elk. The distant trees possess a subtle, deep mistiness, and the light is clean, like that of a photography studio, creating a tranquil picture book atmosphere. The craftsmanship is exquisite, the winter scene elegant, the paper texture realistic, the 3D paper sculpture appearance refined, and the composition vertical.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅细节极其丰富的层叠剪纸立体透视插画，描绘了一家四口麋鹿站在深冬狭窄的林间小径上。画面中需精确呈现 4 只麋鹿正面向前：1 只体型高大、鹿角分叉的雄鹿位于画面中心偏右位置，1 只成年雌鹿位于左侧，1 只较小的幼鹿位于前景中央，另有 1 只幼鹿位于右侧。整个场景完全采用精致的剪纸工艺风格构建，通过堆叠的纸层、利落的切割边缘、雕塑般的轮廓以及层与层之间柔和的立体阴影呈现。动物由暖棕色、栗色、棕褐色和奶油色的纸张制成，细致地分层表现出胸部皮毛、白色的口鼻部、警觉的耳朵，以及落在它们头部、背部和肩部的点点积雪。周围环绕着茂密的冬日森林，高大的光秃树木和冷杉均以层叠的纸质剪影呈现。树枝、灌木、岩石和地面覆盖着厚厚的积雪。树木构成了环绕式的走廊，对称地框住麋鹿，雪路从前景延伸至鹿群。环境采用克制的冷色调：白色、灰白色、浅灰色、板岩灰和炭灰色，与暖棕色的麋鹿形成对比。远处的树木带有微妙的深度雾感，光线如同摄影棚般干净，营造出宁静的绘本氛围。超精细的工艺，优雅的冬日场景，逼真的纸张质感，精致的 3D 纸雕外观，竖向构图。

templates.title: The Vegetarian magazine cover features a minimalist literary style.

titleLocalized.zh: 《素食者》极简文学风封面

templates.prompt: A minimalist literary book cover, suitable for{argument name="book title" default="vegetarians"} Employing an elegant East Asian art book style, the book uses soft, deep forest green and warm off-white as its main color palette. The composition is vertically arranged and highly textured: the left two-thirds is textured beige paper, and the right third is a dark green area, separated by a rough, organically torn paper edge running from top to bottom. In the lower right center, a grayscale profile portrait of an East Asian woman is placed, facing right, her head slightly tilted back, eyes closed or half-closed, long black hair tied in a low bun. The figure should appear serene, fragile, and contemplative. The area above her head merges with the shape of torn white paper, creating a surreal collage effect. From the tear around her head and neck, slender wild plant stems with tiny leaves and buds grow diagonally, as if the plants are sprouting from within her. The addition of delicate paper textures, print quality, and soft tonal gradations presents a poetic, high-quality print feel. The main title, in oversized, dark green serif font, is vertically typewritten on the far left.{argument name="title text" default="vegetarians"} In the upper left corner, the author and translator information is displayed vertically in a small and elegant style: "[Korean] Han Kang, author" and "Pepper Tube | translator". In the upper right dark green area, Korean and English text are added in a refined serif font:{argument name="korean title" default="채식주의자"} "The Vegetarian" and{argument name="author name" default="Han Kang"} Add a vertically formatted Chinese quotation in small print on the lower right:{argument name="quote" default="There's a barren forest inside me; it has withered the things I don't want to eat."} In the bottom right corner, small Chinese publisher and year information are placed: "Sichuan Literature and Art Publishing House" and "2022". A small solid dark green dot is added below the title on the left as a graphic embellishment. The overall atmosphere is restrained, melancholic, intellectual, and literary, resembling the cover of an award-winning modern novel.

promptLocalized.zh: 一款极简文学书籍封面，适用于 {argument name="book title" default="素食者"}，采用优雅的东亚艺术画册风格，以柔和的深森林绿与暖米白色为主色调。构图呈垂直布局且极具质感：左侧三分之二为纹理米色纸张，右侧三分之一为深绿色区域，两者由一条从上至下贯穿的粗糙有机撕纸边缘分割。在右下方中心位置，放置一张东亚女性的灰度侧脸肖像，面朝右侧，头部微微上扬，双眼闭合或半闭，黑色长发扎成低发髻。人物形象应显得宁静、脆弱且富有沉思感。她头部的上方与撕裂的白色纸张形状融合，营造出超现实的拼贴效果。从她头部和颈部周围的裂口处，细长的野生植物茎秆带着微小的叶片和花蕾斜向生长，仿佛植物正从她体内萌发。添加细腻的纸张纹理、印刷质感及柔和的色调渐变，呈现出诗意的精品印刷感。在最左侧垂直排版超大号深绿色衬线体中文主标题：{argument name="title text" default="素食者"}。在左侧中上方，垂直排列小巧优雅的作者与译者信息：“[韩] 韩江 著”和“胡椒筒｜译”。在右上方深绿色区域，用精致的衬线字体添加韩文与英文文本：{argument name="korean title" default="채식주의자"}、“The Vegetarian”以及 {argument name="author name" default="Han Kang"}。在右侧中下方，添加一段垂直排版的小字中文引文：{argument name="quote" default="我的身体里 有一片荒芜的森林 它枯萎了 我不想吃的东西"}。在右下角，放置小号中文出版社及年份信息：“四川文艺出版社”和“2022”。在左侧标题下方添加一个小的实心深绿色圆点作为图形点缀。整体氛围克制、忧郁、知性且具有文学气息，宛如获奖现代小说的封面。

templates.title: The minimalist literary cover of *Educated*

titleLocalized.zh: 《Educated》极简文学风封面

templates.prompt: Design an exquisite, minimalist collage-style cover for a Chinese literary book. The background is a warm white textured paper with a subtle grainy and slightly aged feel. The composition is tall and elegant, with a striking vertical Chinese title in the center on the right, written in an aged black calligraphic font. The title reads "You should fly like a bird to your mountain," arranged in two columns: "You should fly like a bird" on the right and "Fly to your mountain" on the left. Near the top center is a delicate indigo bird, its flight path extending diagonally downwards, passing through the title and pointing to the lower right, creating a sense of ascension and freedom. In the lower left is a large triangular mountain shape, resembling a torn paper collage or wedge painting, with white snow-capped peaks that gradually transition to deep ultramarine and navy blue textures. A faint vertical line of English text is integrated into the right edge of the mountain, as if the mountain were pieced together from printed pages. Inside the blue mountain, the original English title is typed in white serif font: "Educated" on the first line, followed by "A Memoir." Add a small section of vertically arranged black Chinese quotations in the upper left corner, arranged in six lines, followed by a long dash, then two lines of the author's name "Tara Westover" in soft blue serif font, and then another dash. Add thin, vertically arranged copyright information in the lower right corner, including the author's Chinese name, followed by the blue English name "Tara Westover," and below that, black translator and publisher information. Maintain a spacious layout, utilizing strong white space and asymmetrical balance to present a poetic contemporary publishing aesthetic. Use only three primary colors: black, off-white, and indigo. The overall atmosphere should convey an intellectual, restrained, modern, and award-winning quality, suitable for works by [author's name - likely a writer or author].{argument name="author name" default="Tara Westover"} Creation{argument name="book title" default="Educated"} High-end version.

promptLocalized.zh: 设计一款精致的极简拼贴风格中文文学书籍封面，背景为带有细微颗粒感和淡淡陈旧感的暖白色纹理纸张。构图高挑优雅，右侧居中位置设有一个醒目的竖排中文标题，采用做旧的黑色书法字体，内容为“你当像鸟飞往你的山”，分为两列排版，右列为“你当像鸟”，左列为“飞往你的山”。顶部中央附近有一只精致的靛蓝色飞鸟，一条纤细的蓝色虚线飞行轨迹呈对角线向下延伸，穿过标题并指向右下方，营造出一种升腾与自由的意境。左下方放置一个巨大的三角形山峦形状，如同撕纸拼贴或楔形绘画，山峰呈白色积雪状，向下渐变为深群青色和海军蓝纹理。在山峦右侧边缘融入一条淡淡的竖排英文书籍正文，仿佛山峦是由印刷书页拼凑而成。在蓝色山峦内部，以白色衬线字体排版原始英文标题：第一行“Educated”，下方为“A Memoir”。左上方添加一小块竖排黑色中文引文，排成 6 行，下方加一条长破折号，接着是两行柔和蓝色衬线字体的作者名“Tara Westover”，随后再加一条破折号。右下边缘添加细长的竖排版权信息，包括作者的中文名，后跟蓝色的英文名“Tara Westover”，下方为黑色的译者和出版社信息。保持布局宽敞，利用强烈的留白、不对称平衡感，呈现出诗意的当代出版美学。仅使用 3 种主色：黑色、米白色和靛蓝色。整体氛围应体现出知识分子气息、克制、现代且具有获奖作品的质感，适用于由 {argument name="author name" default="Tara Westover"} 创作的 {argument name="book title" default="Educated"} 高端版本。

titleLocalized.zh: 极简主义文学小说封面

templates.prompt: A literary book cover employs a refined, minimalist editorial style, with a vertical composition and a soft palette of deep black, dark green, tan, and warm cream. The image is divided by large areas of flowing, curtain-like abstract shapes, creating dramatic negative space and diagonal beams of light. On the right, an elderly butler is shown with his back to the viewer, dressed in a formal black tailcoat or tuxedo jacket, revealing the cuffs of a white shirt, his hands clasped behind his back, facing a tall window with sheer curtains emitting soft light. His posture is reserved, dignified, and solitary. Below, within a triangular beam of light, a still-life composition is placed in dim light: three items on a table—a wine glass, a teapot, and a plate—all partially obscured in shadow. The left side should feature an elegant vertical Chinese title, the content of which is {argument name="title text" default="The long day is coming to an end"} The text uses a large, light gold serif font. Below this are smaller lines for the Chinese author and translator, along with a small Chinese quote. Small English text is added near the bottom left corner.{argument name="english title" default="The Remains of the Day"} and{argument name="author name" default="Kazuo Ishiguro"} And a small line of publisher information and year.{argument name="year" default="2024"} The image should evoke the feel of an award-winning contemporary literary novel cover: quiet, melancholic, restrained, cinematic, with paper texture, soft vignetting, delicate painterly shadows, and intentionally asymmetrical layout. Maintain a cohesive typography and design, with ample white space and avoiding the use of vibrant colors.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张采用精致极简编辑风格的文学书籍封面，纵向构图，采用深黑、深绿、棕褐色和暖奶油色的柔和色调。画面由大面积流动的窗帘状抽象形状分割，营造出富有戏剧性的留白和对角线光束。在右侧，展示一位背对观众的老管家形象，他身着正式的黑色燕尾服或礼服外套，露出白色衬衫袖口，双手交叠于背后，面向一扇带有薄纱窗帘、散发柔和光芒的高大窗户。他的姿态矜持、庄重且孤独。在下方的三角光束中，放置一组昏暗的静物：桌上摆放着 3 件物品，分别为酒杯、茶壶和盘子，均部分隐没在阴影中。左侧应呈现优雅的竖排中文标题，内容为 {argument name="title text" default="长日将尽"}，采用大型淡金色衬线字体。下方包含较小的中文作者和译者行，以及一段小字体的中文引语。在左下角附近，添加小型英文文本 {argument name="english title" default="The Remains of the Day"} 和 {argument name="author name" default="Kazuo Ishiguro"}，以及一行小型出版商信息和年份 {argument name="year" default="2024"}。图像应呈现出屡获殊荣的当代文学小说封面质感：安静、忧郁、克制、具有电影感，带有纸张纹理、柔和的暗角、细腻的绘画感阴影以及极具意图的非对称布局。保持排版与设计融为一体，留白充裕，且不使用鲜艳色彩。

templates.title: Minimalist cover of "No Longer Human"

titleLocalized.zh: 极简风《人间失格》封面

templates.prompt: This minimalist literary book cover features a refined East Asian editorial style, a vertical composition, and a warm off-white paper background with a delicate grainy printing texture. The image is vertically divided into two large abstract areas: the upper left half is a rough, gray, torn paper shape, and the lower left corner is a deep black block. Emerging from the black area is a striking white theatrical mask outline, with only a black slit for the eye; its large proportions and upward tilt suggest alienation and a hidden identity. At the bottom center where the gray and white areas meet, a small, solitary figure in a dark long coat stands on the edge of a narrow triangle, facing forward, emphasizing loneliness and vulnerability. From near the top center, a thin, slightly wavy red line hangs down, connecting in the middle to a soft red circular stamp-like disc, aligned with the figure below. A striking, bold, vertically typed Chinese calligraphy title is placed at the right center:{argument name="title text" default="No Longer Human"} Next to it, add a vertical line of Japanese pronunciation: "Ningenshikkaku". On the far right edge, add a vertical line of thin black quotations: "—My misfortune lies precisely in my lack of the ability to refuse—". In the upper left corner, add a small black vertical line of author and translator information: "[Japan] Osamu Dazai | Author Yang Wei | Translator". Below, add a short two-line Chinese sentence: "I am sorry for being born." In the lower right corner, add a small red vertical label: "Dazai Osamu's representative work". Below, add a small three-line black publication information block: "No Longer Human", "Dazai Osamu", "Dazai Osamu". In the lower left corner, add a small black publisher information block: "Shanghai Translation Publishing House 2024", with a short horizontal line below it. Using restrained white space, asymmetrical balance, original paper collage edges, and ink and gouache textures, with soft charcoal black, gray and faded vermilion red tones, it presents an elegant literary melancholy and creates a high-end modern Chinese novel cover design.

promptLocalized.zh:
一款极简主义文学书籍封面，采用精致的东亚编辑风格，竖构图，背景为温暖的米白色纸张，带有细腻的颗粒印刷质感。画面垂直分割为 2 个大型抽象区域：左上半部分为粗糙的灰色撕纸形状，左下角为深黑色的色块。从黑色区域中浮现出 1 个醒目的白色戏剧面具轮廓，仅留 1 条黑色眼缝，大比例裁剪并向上倾斜，暗示着疏离感与隐藏的身份。在灰色与白色区域交汇的底部中心，放置 1 个身着深色长外套的微小孤独人影，站在狭窄的三角形边缘上，面朝前方，强调孤独与脆弱感。从顶部中心附近，垂下 1 根带有轻微波浪感的细红线，在中间位置连接 1 个柔和的红色圆形印章状圆盘，与下方的人影对齐。在右侧中心设置 1 个醒目的黑色粗体竖排中文书法标题：{argument name="title text" default="人间失格"}。旁边添加 1 行竖排的日文读音：“にんげんしっかく”。在最右侧边缘，添加 1 行竖排的黑色细体引文：“—— 我的不幸，恰恰在于我缺乏拒绝的能力 ——”。在左上角，添加 1 行小号黑色字体的竖排作者与译者信息：“【日】太宰治｜著　杨伟｜译”。下方添加 1 句简短的两行中文：“生而为人
我很抱歉”。在右下角，添加 1 个红色小号竖排标签：“太宰治
代表作”。下方添加 1 个 3 行的小型黑色出版信息块：“人间失格”，“太宰治”，“だざい おさむ”。在左下角，添加 1 个小号黑色字体出版方信息块：“上海译文出版社
2024”，下方带有一条短横线。运用克制的留白、不对称平衡、原始纸张拼贴边缘、水墨与水粉质感，色调为柔和的炭黑、灰色与褪色的朱砂红，呈现优雅的文学忧郁感，打造高端现代中文小说封面设计。

templates.title: Anime girl and cherry blossoms in a snowy wonderland

titleLocalized.zh: 冰雪幻境中的动漫女子与樱花

templates.prompt: A highly detailed anime-style fantasy illustration depicts a tall, elegant woman, resembling an ice mage or a warrior inspired by a qilin. The image is a three-quarter view from behind, her head slightly turned, standing against a bright snow-covered mountain landscape filled with soft pink cherry blossoms. She possesses {argument name="hair color" default="Extremely light ice blue"} Her hair, extremely long and thick, flowed in the wind, layered and textured, with soft bangs, curled ends, and a playful tuft of hair on top. Two dark, curved horn-like ornaments with subtle red patterns stood on either side of her head. Her face was obscured by a flat, rectangular, blurred block of pale lavender gray. She wore a magnificent, fantastical bodysuit and gown in a color scheme of black, white, periwinkle, and sapphire, adorned with gold filigree armor details: a black, form-fitting breastplate, separate, semi-transparent bell sleeves with blue crystal feather cuffs, a backless white and blue top, an exquisite gold waist armor with a luminous blue gemstone core, sheer black pantyhose with gold geometric embellishments, layers of semi-transparent blue fabric, and three clearly visible red tassels hanging from her waist and side belts. Her right arm was outstretched, her gloved hand holding a luminous, semi-transparent blue water sphere suspended in her palm, containing a vortex resembling the flow of yin and yang. Curving arcs of water and ribbons of cold energy surrounded her. The background is a dreamlike, ethereal mountain scene, with a distant tower on the right, snow-capped peaks shrouded in mist, frosty trees, a shimmering atmosphere, falling petals, and pale pink flower clusters dotting the foreground and upper left corner. It employs soft backlighting, iridescent highlights, exquisite anime-style rendering, delicate gradients, clear decorative clothing details, a magical and fantastical atmosphere, cool blue and lavender hues accented with pink, a vertical composition, and no text or additional characters.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅高度精细的动漫奇幻插画，描绘了一位高挑优雅的女性，宛如冰雪法师或麒麟灵感的战士。画面采用全身四分之三背影视角，她头部微微偏转，伫立在充满柔和粉色樱花的明亮雪山景观中。她拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="极浅的冰蓝色"} 头发，发丝极长且浓密，随风飘逸，层次分明，带有柔和的刘海、卷曲的发梢以及头顶一撮俏皮的呆毛。头部两侧耸立着两个带有细微红色纹饰的深色弯曲角状装饰。她的面部被一块淡薰衣草灰色的扁平矩形模糊块遮挡。她身着华丽的奇幻紧身衣和礼服，配色包含黑色、白色、长春花色和蓝宝石色，并饰有金色花丝盔甲细节：黑色贴身胸甲、分离式半透明钟形袖、带有蓝色水晶羽毛袖口、露背的白蓝上衣、带有发光蓝色宝石核心的精致金色腰甲、带有金色几何装饰的透明黑色连裤袜、层叠的半透明蓝色布料，以及腰部和侧面腰带上悬挂的 3 个清晰可见的红色流苏装饰。她的右臂伸展，手戴手套，掌心悬浮着一个发光的半透明蓝色水球，内部有类似阴阳流动的漩涡。她周围环绕着卷曲的水流弧线和冰冷的能量丝带。背景是梦幻般的空灵高山场景，右侧有一座遥远的塔楼，云雾缭绕的雪峰、挂霜的树木、闪烁的氛围、飘落的花瓣，以及点缀在前景和左上角的淡粉色花簇。采用柔和的背光、虹彩高光、精致的动漫渲染、细腻的渐变、清晰的装饰性服装细节、魔法奇幻氛围、冷蓝色与薰衣草色调搭配粉色点缀，竖向构图，无文字，无额外角色。

templates.title: Ethereal Blue-Haired Fantasy Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 空灵蓝发奇幻肖像

templates.prompt: A highly detailed anime fantasy portrait, the main character is {argument name="character name" default="An elegant, blue-haired fantasy woman"} Presented with her back to the viewer in a three-quarters view, she glances back at the audience, her calm violet eyes conveying a gentle yet slightly aloof expression. She has extremely long, flowing hair.{argument name="hair color" default="Ice-like light blue"} Her hair, with its layered, light bangs, flowed in the wind, topped with a small ahoge (a single strand of hair sticking up) and a horn with dark, curved textures and subtle crimson stripes on the left side of her head. She wore an exquisite, backless, fantastical gown consisting of four main visible parts: a dark, fitted bodice; a white, backless outer layer with ornate gold trim and pale embroidery; two pointed arm sleeves that gradually faded to a semi-transparent blue-purple; and red and blue ribbons tied around her neck and waist. Delicate jewel-like tassels added to the upper back, the ends of which swayed in the air. The scene was illuminated from behind by soft spring sunlight, with a pale stone pavilion or arched balcony in the background, a large archway in the back, and clusters of flowers in the upper right corner.{argument name="flower type" default="Pink cherry blossoms"} The image features a few falling petals, luminous mist, subtle glimmers, and dreamy, soft hues. The composition is vertical, with the portrait above the thighs, the character slightly positioned to the right, and hair sweeping across a large area on the left side of the image. Rendered in a delicate, ethereal anime illustration style, it features soft lighting, translucent fabrics, bright eyes, delicate lines, cool lavender and blue tones, soft rim lighting, and a blurred, oil painting-like background. It emphasizes smooth, elegant surfaces, clean fabric folds, and minimal clothing wrinkles.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅高度精细的动漫奇幻肖像，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="一位优雅的蓝发奇幻女性"}，以四分之三背影姿态呈现，回眸看向观众，拥有平静的紫罗兰色双眸，表情柔和且略带疏离感。她留着极长的飘逸 {argument name="hair color" default="冰感淡蓝色"} 秀发，带有层次感的轻盈刘海，发丝随风飘动，头顶有一根小呆毛，左侧头部生有一只带有深色弯曲纹理及细微深红色条纹的角。她身着精致的露背奇幻礼服，包含 4 个主要可见部分：一件深色修身胸衣，一件带有华丽金边和淡色刺绣图案的白色露背外层，2 只渐变为半透明蓝紫色尖头袖套，以及系在颈部和腰部的红蓝丝带装饰。背部上方添加精致的珠宝状流苏细节，丝带末端在空中飘荡。场景由柔和的春日阳光从背后照亮，背景为淡色石质凉亭或拱形阳台，后方有一个大型拱门，右上角背景处点缀着成簇的 {argument name="flower type" default="粉色樱花"}。画面包含几片飘落的花瓣、发光的薄雾、细微的闪光以及梦幻的柔和色调。构图为竖版，大腿以上肖像，角色略微居右，秀发在画面左侧大面积扫过。以精致的空灵动漫插画风格渲染，具备柔和的光晕、半透明织物、明亮的双眸、细腻的线条、冷薰衣草色与蓝色调、柔和的轮廓光、油画质感的背景虚化，并强调平滑优雅的表面、干净的织物褶皱感以及极少的衣物褶皱。

templates.title: Isometric Perspective Scientific Concept 3D Model Grid

titleLocalized.zh: 等距视角科学概念立体模型网格

templates.prompt: A clean 2x2 concept model infographic is presented against a soft, light-colored background, showcasing four independent, suspended, isometric viewpoint 3D model panels, rendered in a beautiful 3D illustration style.{argument name="theme" default="science"} The branches feature soft gradient colors, glossy materials, gentle ambient lighting, delicate shadows, rounded futuristic shapes, and high detail. Top left: Biology, a lush biological laboratory island with a giant DNA double helix tower at its center, complete with an arched glass greenhouse, spiral staircase, cascading organic paths, greenery, flowerbeds, and fluid biomimetic structures; the word "BIOLOGY" is integrated into the platform's leading edge. This section is surrounded by four small biological-related icons: a microscope, a DNA symbol, a sprouting plant, and a circular cell or petri dish symbol. Top right: Physics, a cool-toned high-tech energy laboratory section with a central luminous platform, a circular accelerator ring, copper-like electromagnetic coils, a staircase leading to the core, a display screen with waveforms, and a futuristic industrial base labeled "PHYSICS"; four surrounding physics-themed icons are added: an atom, a horseshoe magnet, lightning, and a broken-line waveform. Bottom left: Chemistry (CHEMISTRY), a modular molecular research structure in purple and silver, consisting of a ball-and-stick lattice framework, laboratory pillars, beakers, flasks, and a luminescent crystal core; the platform is prominently labeled "CHEMISTRY" on both sides. This section is surrounded by four chemistry-related icons: two molecular structure diagrams, a pair of laboratory test tubes or flasks, and a small burner. Bottom right: Astronomy (ASTRONOMY), a rocky lunar observation island with crater terrain, a domed observatory, a telescope, stairs carved into the rocks, and a circular cosmic background; the leading edge is labeled "ASTRONOMY". This section is surrounded by four astronomy-themed icons: a ringed planet, twinkling stars, a small rocket, and a new moon. The four sections are evenly distributed in the quadrant layout, each with its own soft geometric background shape. A unified soft color scheme is adjusted according to the discipline, and an advanced gpt-image-2 style is used, making each concept feel like a collectible miniature world. No people are included in the image, and there is no additional text besides the four subject labels.

promptLocalized.zh: 在柔和的浅色背景上呈现一个整洁的 2x2 概念实体模型信息图，展示四个独立的悬浮等距视角立体模型板块，以精美的 3D 插画风格体现 {argument name="theme" default="科学"} 的分支，采用柔和的渐变色、光泽材质、柔和的环境光、细腻的阴影、圆润的未来感造型以及高细节表现。左上角：生物学（BIOLOGY），一个郁郁葱葱的生物实验室岛屿，中心矗立着巨大的 DNA 双螺旋塔，配有弧形玻璃温室建筑、螺旋楼梯、层叠的有机路径、绿植、花坛和流体仿生结构；平台前缘整合了“BIOLOGY”字样。该板块周围环绕 4 个小型生物相关图标：显微镜、DNA 符号、发芽的植物以及圆形细胞或培养皿符号。右上角：物理学（PHYSICS），一个冷色调的高科技能源实验室板块，中心设有发光平台、圆形加速器环、类铜电磁线圈、通往核心的楼梯、带有波形图的显示屏，以及标有“PHYSICS”的未来工业底座；添加 4 个周围的物理主题图标：原子、马蹄形磁铁、闪电和折线波形图。左下角：化学（CHEMISTRY），一个由球棍晶格框架、实验室立柱、烧杯、烧瓶和发光晶体核心构成的紫色与银色模块化分子研究结构；平台两侧显著标有“CHEMISTRY”。该板块周围环绕 4 个化学相关图标：两个分子结构图、一对实验室试管或烧瓶，以及一个小燃烧器。右下角：天文学（ASTRONOMY），一个岩石质感的月球观测岛，拥有陨石坑地形、圆顶天文台、望远镜、刻在岩石上的楼梯，以及背后圆形的宇宙星空背景；前缘标有“ASTRONOMY”。该板块周围环绕 4 个天文主题图标：带环行星、闪烁的星星、小火箭和新月。保持 4 个板块在象限布局中均匀分布，每个板块都有各自柔和的几何背景形状，根据学科调整统一的柔和色调，并采用高级的 gpt-image-2 风格，使每个概念都如同一个可收藏的微型世界。画面中不包含人物，除四个学科标签外无额外文字。

templates.title: Luxury Jade Fruit Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华翡翠水果海报

templates.prompt: A luxurious, editorial-style fruit advertisement poster features a deep, dark background. Close-ups showcase fresh, green cherry tomatoes and deep indigo blue blueberries, glistening with dewdrops, resting on glistening, moist green leaves. Dramatic, low-key lighting creates rich shadows, golden highlights, and a high-end cinematic macro-photography quality. The composition evokes an atmosphere of abundance, luxury, and sensory richness, with the fruit densely clustered in the lower two-thirds of the image, blending softly into the darkness at the edges. An elegant, high-fashion serif font in a warm champagne gold is added to the poster, along with a large central headline.{argument name="headline text" default="EMERALD BLOOM"} Occupying the upper half, it contains nine additional text blocks: "SEASONAL LIMITED" in the upper left corner, the brand text "NATURE'S" and "JEWELRY" split at the top center with a circular monogram logo in the middle, "THE TASTE OF SUNSHINE" in the upper right corner, "A RARE SUMMER HARMONY" in the upper left center with a smaller Chinese subtitle below, "Nature's Rarest, Moment's Finest" in italics in the upper right center, "HANDPICKED AT PEAK RIPENESS" in the lower left center with a smaller Chinese subtitle below, "From Nature, Curated for You" in handwritten font in the lower left corner with a smaller Chinese subtitle below, and "LIMITED EDITION" in the lower right corner, below which is "2024 · SUMMER COLLECTION". A vertical, rounded capsule element with a soft olive green gradient is added to the right, reminiscent of a minimalist product color scheme or bottle outline. The overall design maintains a sophisticated and high-end feel, inspired by fashion magazines and reminiscent of high-end seasonal jewelry or perfume advertisements, but with fruit as the central theme.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张奢华的编辑风格水果广告海报，背景为深沉的暗色调，画面特写展示了覆盖着晶莹水珠的新鲜青色圣女果和深靛蓝色蓝莓，静置在光亮湿润的绿叶之上。采用戏剧性的低调照明，呈现丰富的阴影、金色高光以及高端电影级的微距摄影质感。构图应营造出丰盈、昂贵且富有感官体验的氛围，水果密集簇拥在图像下三分之二处，并向边缘柔和地融入黑暗中。在海报上添加优雅的高级时尚衬线字体，颜色为暖香槟金，巨大的中心标题 {argument name="headline text" default="EMERALD BLOOM"} 占据上半部分。包含 9 个额外的文本块：左上角“SEASONAL LIMITED”，顶部中心分割品牌文字“NATURE'S”和“JEWELRY”，中间带有圆形字母组合徽标，右上角“THE TASTE OF SUNSHINE”，左中上部文字“A RARE SUMMER HARMONY”下方配有较小的中文副标题，右中上部斜体文字“Nature's Rarest, Moment's Finest.”，左中下部文字“HANDPICKED AT PEAK RIPENESS”下方配有较小的中文副标题，左下角手写体“From Nature, Curated for You.”下方配有较小的中文副标题，右下角“LIMITED EDITION”，其下方为“2024 · SUMMER COLLECTION”。在右侧添加 1 个垂直圆角胶囊元素，包含柔和的橄榄绿渐变，如同极简主义的产品色板或瓶身轮廓。整体设计保持精致、高端、受时尚杂志启发，让人联想到高端季节性珠宝或香水广告，但以水果为核心主体。

templates.title: Raiden General Beach Cosplay Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 雷电将军海滩 Cosplay 封面

templates.prompt: Create a stunning beach cosplay photo inspired by Raiden General from Genshin Impact, perfect for a high-fashion magazine cover. A mature woman sits on a large, dark seaside rock in a three-quarter frontal pose, one hand resting on the rock behind her, the other hanging naturally at her side, one leg raised high towards the camera. Her face is blurred by a soft rectangle in the center. She has thick, extremely long violet hair with magenta highlights, braided into a thick plait that falls over her shoulders, with strands flowing to the right, adorned with blue flower hair ornaments and gold accessories at the side of her head. She wears an elegant Raiden General-themed cosplay outfit in pale purple, lilac, and deep purple: a low-cut kimono-style top, semi-transparent flowing sleeves, layered belts and obi (waistband), a magnificent purple and gold circular badge at the waist, a jeweled choker, dangling blue and gold earrings, black armor-like arm guards, and sheer purple knee-high stockings with suspenders and decorative patterns. The lighting is natural, golden beach sunlight, with soft highlights on skin and fabrics, and a shallow depth of field, creating a luxurious editorial style. The background is a softly blurred coastline with light-colored sand, shimmering water, sea mist, and distant rocky islands or cliffs. This is framed as a full magazine cover, using an elegant and stylish font in a deep royal purple. The masthead is at the top, with large text, and the content is {argument name="magazine title" default="COSPLAY"} The top left corner features the small print "COSPLAY REALM MAGAZINE," and the top right corner features the small print "January 2024." The left side includes the cover titles: "RAIDEN SHOGUN," "COSPLAY BY SAKURA," "BEHIND THE SCENES AT THE BEACH," and "EXCLUSIVE INTERVIEW," with the small print below reading "Sakura talks about her love for Genshin Impact." The right side includes the cover title: "GENSHIN IMPACT" and the small print "SPECIAL EDITION," with the bottom right corner displaying "TOP COSER OF 2024" and the small print "Sakura's Road to Fame." A realistic barcode with a price tag is placed in the bottom left corner. Overall style: hyper-realistic cosplay photography, glossy magazine cover design, cinematic quality, sexy yet tasteful, high-fashion editorial style, highly detailed fabrics and accessories, clear subject against a softly blurred seascape background.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张以《原神》中雷电将军为灵感的迷人海滩 Cosplay 高级时尚杂志封面照片。一位成年女性坐在巨大的深色海边岩石上，呈四分之三正面姿势，一只手撑在身后的岩石上，另一只手自然垂在身侧，一条大腿向镜头方向高高抬起。她的面部被中心的一个柔和矩形模糊遮挡。她拥有一头浓密且极长的紫罗兰色秀发，带有洋红色挑染，编成粗辫垂在肩头，发丝随风飘向右侧，装饰着蓝色花朵发饰和头侧的金色配饰。她身着优雅的淡紫色、丁香色和深紫色雷电将军风格 Cosplay 服装：低胸和服式上衣、半透明飘逸袖子、层叠的腰带和腰封，腰间饰有华丽的紫色金色圆形徽章，佩戴镶有紫宝石的颈圈、垂坠的蓝金耳环、黑色盔甲质感的护臂，以及带有吊带和装饰图案的透明紫色过膝袜。光线为自然的金色海滩日光，皮肤和织物上带有柔和的高光，景深较浅，呈现出奢华的编辑风格。背景是柔和模糊的海岸线，有浅色沙滩、波光粼粼的海水、海雾以及远处的岩石岛屿或悬崖。将其构图为完整的杂志封面，并使用深皇家紫色的优雅时尚字体。刊头位于顶部，文字巨大，内容为 {argument name="magazine title" default="COSPLAY"}，左上角有小字“COSPLAY REALM MAGAZINE”，右上角有小字“2024 年 1 月”。左侧添加封面标题：“RAIDEN SHOGUN”、“COSPLAY BY SAKURA”、“BEHIND THE SCENES AT THE BEACH”，以及“EXCLUSIVE INTERVIEW”，下方附带小字“Sakura 畅谈她对《原神》的热爱”。右侧添加封面标题：“GENSHIN IMPACT”及小字“SPECIAL EDITION”，右下角添加“TOP COSER OF 2024”及小字“Sakura 的成名之路”。在左下角放置一个带有价格小字的写实条形码。整体风格：超写实 Cosplay 摄影、光面杂志封面设计、电影质感、性感而不失品味、高级时尚编辑风格、高细节织物与配饰、主体清晰且海景背景柔和模糊。

templates.title: Victory Parade of the Valiant Elf Knights

titleLocalized.zh: 英勇精灵骑士的胜利游行

templates.prompt: A dynamic fantasy anime illustration depicting a heroic {argument name="character role" default="Elf Knight"} The young girl strode through the massive, open stone castle gates. The extremely low, angular perspective emphasizes her victorious and imposing figure. She possesses an ethereal grace {argument name="hair color" default="Golden yellow"} Long hair, bright turquoise eyes, pointed elf ears, and a joyful smile. She raises her longsword high above her head in a victory pose, her left hand resting beside the scabbard at her waist. She wears exquisitely polished silver plate armor, with detailed engravings on her breastplate, shoulder armor, gauntlets, and knee-high greaves, paired with a bright green skirt or tunic, a brown belt, and a dark green cloak flowing behind her. She wears a delicate silver headdress. The background is the sunlit entrance to a medieval stone fortress, two tall wooden doors wide open, walls constructed of light-colored stone, and green flags bearing light-colored emblems hanging on either side. Behind her, seven townspeople in simple green attire raise their hands in celebration, one waving a small green flag. White petals or celebratory confetti drift throughout the scene, accompanied by shimmering lights and soft camera halos. The bright blue sky and warm sunlight create a hopeful, heroic atmosphere, showcasing the movement of her hair, cloak, and skirt. Employing a comic-style fantasy art with clean lines and rich details, featuring delicate lines, soft painterly shadows, bright highlights, and exquisite GPT-Image-2 anime illustration aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅充满动感的奇幻动漫插画，描绘了一位英勇的 {argument name="character role" default="精灵骑士"} 少女正大步穿过巨大的开放式石制城堡大门。采用极具张力的超低仰视视角，突显她胜利且高大的形象。她拥有飘逸的 {argument name="hair color" default="金黄色"} 长发、明亮的青绿色双眸、尖尖的精灵耳朵以及开怀的笑容。她右手将长剑高举过头顶，做出胜利的姿态，左手则放在腰间的剑鞘旁。她身穿精致的抛光银色板甲，胸甲、肩甲、护手和及膝护胫上刻有细节纹饰，搭配鲜绿色的短裙或束腰外衣、棕色腰带，以及身后随风飘扬的深绿色斗篷。头上戴着精致的银色头饰。背景是阳光明媚的中世纪石制堡垒入口，两扇高大的木门敞开，墙壁由浅色石材砌成，两侧各悬挂着一面印有浅色徽章的绿色旗帜。在她身后，7 位身穿简约绿色服装的城镇居民正举起双手欢呼庆祝，其中一人挥舞着一面小绿旗。白色花瓣或庆祝用的五彩纸屑飘散在整个场景中，伴随着闪烁的光点和柔和的镜头光晕。采用明亮的蓝天、温暖的阳光，营造出充满希望的英雄氛围，并展现头发、斗篷和裙摆的动感。采用线条清晰、细节丰富的漫画风格奇幻艺术，精细的线条、柔和的绘画式阴影、明亮的高光，以及精致的 gpt-image-2 动漫插画美学。

templates.title: Elf Knights Triumphant Parade

titleLocalized.zh: 精灵骑士凯旋游行

templates.prompt: A heroic, high-fantasy anime illustration depicts an elven female knight passing through a stone city gate during a public celebration. The image is shot from a low angle, centered. She possesses an ethereal quality {argument name="hair color" default="Golden yellow"} Long hair, pointed elf ears, and an elegant, athletic physique. Her face was mostly obscured by the angle of her arm and her raised arm. In her right hand, she pointed a long, ornate silver sword to the sky in a victory salute, while her left arm hung naturally at her side. She wore exquisitely polished silver plate armor, over which she wore a short jacket.{argument name="outfit color" default="Forest Green"} A dress adorned with an sculpted breastplate, armored gauntlets, layered skirt and leg armor, a belt and straps at the waist, and ornate knee-high armored boots. A deep green cloak billowed dramatically behind her. A sheathed secondary sword hung at her waist. She walked confidently forward, like a beloved champion responding to the cheers of the crowd. Around her, two rows of townspeople and elven citizens lined both sides of the street, raising their hands in celebration of her passing. Behind her stood a massive medieval stone archway, adorned with carvings, revealing three green banners bearing pale coats of arms, weathered walls, and the distant silhouette of towers. The sky was a vibrant deep blue, dotted with large, sunlit white clouds. White petals drifted through the air throughout the scene. Warm sunlight, cinematic rim lighting, delicate reflections from fabrics and armor, dynamic perspective, painterly anime-style rendering, a highly detailed fantasy background, and a festive, heroic atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅英雄主义高奇幻动漫插画，描绘了一位精灵女骑士在公共庆典期间穿过石砌城门，全身低角度视角，居中构图。她有着飘逸的 {argument name="hair color" default="金黄色"} 长发、尖尖的精灵耳朵和优雅健美的体格。她的面部大部分被角度和抬起的手臂遮挡。她右手将一把长而华丽的银剑直指天空，做出胜利的致敬姿势，左臂自然垂在身侧。她穿着精致的抛光银色板甲，内搭一件短款 {argument name="outfit color" default="森林绿"} 连衣裙，配有雕刻胸甲、装甲护手、层叠的裙甲和腿甲、腰间的皮带与绑带，以及装饰精美的及膝装甲靴。深绿色的斗篷在她身后戏剧性地飘扬。腰间挂着一把收鞘的副剑。她自信地向前走去，宛如一位回应民众欢呼的受爱戴冠军。在她周围，街道两侧各有 2 排城镇居民和精灵市民，他们举起双手，庆祝她的经过。她身后是一座巨大的中世纪石拱门，上面有雕刻装饰，可见 3 面印有浅色徽章图案的绿色旗帜，以及风化的墙壁和远处的塔楼轮廓。天空是鲜艳的深蓝色，漂浮着巨大的阳光白云。白色花瓣在整个场景的空气中飘落。温暖的日光，电影般的轮廓光，细腻的织物与盔甲反光，动态透视，绘画感动漫渲染，高度精细的奇幻背景，节日般的英雄氛围。

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0, only the clothing sections were extracted and transformed into a minimalist fashion magazine product display against a light warm beige background. The figures were completely removed, presenting the clothing as individual flat lay items: a short-sleeved top centered at the top, and a pair of shorts centered at the bottom. The vibrant colorful art prints from the reference image were retained, but the clothing was presented neatly, like an editorial catalog page, with soft studio shadows. A circular fabric detail illustration was added in the lower left corner, showcasing a close-up of the print. Elegant editorial typography and subtle annotation lines were added, comprising a total of four text blocks: a large title block in the upper left corner reading "COLORFUL ART SET UP," with brief Japanese text above and below; a text block labeled "TOPS" on the right with a Japanese description; a text block labeled "BOTTOMS" in the lower right corner with a Japanese description; and a text block labeled "FABRIC" in the lower left corner with a brief Japanese description. templates.title: Anime Museum Poster with Guanyin Image

titleLocalized.zh: 带有观音像的动漫博物馆海报

templates.prompt: A beautifully designed poster for a Japanese museum exhibition, employing a modern anime illustration style, vertical layout, warm ivory and gold tones, and adorned with soft colored confetti, reminiscent of a high-end spring holiday promotional advertisement. The foreground features four school-aged to young women, while the background is a magnificent Buddha statue. At the center of the background stands a towering gilded statue of the Thousand-Armed Kannon, radiating a luminous halo, with intricate carving details, its multiple arms symmetrically fanning outwards, hands clasped in prayer at the chest, emanating a sacred golden light. On the right side of the foreground is the largest character, a friendly young female guide or older student, who uses forced perspective to dramatically extend one hand towards the viewer; she has {argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown"} The first girl has shoulder-length hair, wears a blue striped shirt, a cream-colored sweater draped over her shoulders, and a light-colored skirt, with a warm and friendly expression. In the lower middle section are three young female students in matching school uniforms: light blue short-sleeved shirts tied with dark blue ribbons, and dark blue skirts. The girl on the left excitedly raises one arm forward, carrying a small shoulder bag; the girl in the middle holds an exhibition brochure upright; the girl on the right drinks water from a clear bottle while looking at the scene. The four girls are depicted with vivid anime-style faces, glossy hair, soft shadows, and energetic museum-going body language. The poster is filled with dense Japanese typography and decorative graphics. A prominent large title is placed on the left.{argument name="headline text" default="Let's go see the national treasures!"} The text uses an oversized gold and black calligraphy-style font, with one character highlighted in red. Smaller text, “千手観音、祈りの宇宙”, is added above. A red circular marker, “はじめての美術館にもおすすめ!”, is added in the upper left corner, and a white cloud-shaped speech bubble, “いっしょに新しい発見をしよう!”, is added in the upper right corner. A gold ribbon banner, “アスキー美術館 GW開催”, is added below the main title. Add a light blue circular information box on the left containing 5 Japanese copy describing the Buddha statue: "National Treasure Senju Kanyin Statue", "Thousand Hands, Thousand Years of Prayer", "伝える", "姧巻のスケールを,", "その目でSenseじてみて.". A dark rectangular exhibition nameplate with a gold frame is placed in the lower left corner, containing 5 lines of text: "Asia Art Museum GW Special Exhibition", the title "National Treasure Exhibition", "Senju Kanyin, Pray for the Universe", and the date line{argument name="event dates" default="2026.4.26 SAT - 6.15 SUN"} Add the museum's name in large font at the bottom center:{argument name="museum name" default="ASCII Art Museum"} This is followed by a smaller line of Japanese address and transportation information for the nearest station. A red and black banner is added to the bottom right corner: “心に残る体験が、きっとここに.” The bottom right corner contains three circular benefit icons and descriptions: a pink circle with a ticket icon, reading “学生はお得! 学生蔼提示で当日券200円OFF！”; a blue circle with a camera icon, reading “撮影OK! 一个の作品は写真撮影OK！”; and a gold circle with a gift icon, reading “来場者プレゼント! オリジナルしおりをプレゼント！”. The page is surrounded by subtle glitter, halftone dots, abstract speckles, and paper scrap shapes. Overall atmosphere: captivating, educational, elegant, and exciting, combining sacred cultural grandeur with joyful youthful exploration, like generating a fictional high-end museum advertisement poster with complete typography.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的日本博物馆展览海报，采用现代动漫插画风格，竖版布局，暖象牙色与金色调，点缀柔和的彩色纸屑，设计风格如同高端的春季假日活动宣传广告。构图前景为 4 位学龄至年轻女性角色，背景为一尊宏伟的佛像。背景中央是一尊高耸的镀金千手观音像，带有光芒四射的背光、精细的雕刻细节，多只手臂对称向外扇形展开，双手在胸前合十，散发着神圣的金色光芒。前景右侧是最大的角色，一位友好的年轻女性向导或高年级学生，利用强制透视法将一只手戏剧性地伸向观众；她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 的齐肩发，身穿蓝色条纹衬衫，肩上披着奶油色毛衣，搭配浅色裙子，表情温暖而亲切。中下部是 3 位穿着统一校服的年轻女学生：浅蓝色短袖衬衫，系着深蓝色丝带，搭配深蓝色短裙。左侧女孩兴奋地举起一只手臂指向前方，背着一个小挎包；中间女孩竖直拿着一本展览手册；右侧女孩一边喝着透明水瓶里的水，一边看向场景。为 4 位女孩绘制生动的动漫风格面部、有光泽的头发、柔和的阴影以及充满活力的博物馆出游肢体语言。海报中填充密集的日文排版和装饰性图形。在左侧放置一个醒目的大标题 {argument name="headline text" default="国宝を見に行こう!"}，使用超大的金黑双色书法风格字体，其中一个字符以红色高亮显示。上方添加较小的文字：“千手観音、祈りの宇宙”。在左上角添加一个红色的圆形标注，写着“はじめての美術館にもおすすめ!”，并在右上角添加一个白色的云朵状对话气泡，写着“いっしょに新しい発見をしよう!”。在主标题下方添加一条金色丝带横幅，写着“アスキー美術館 GW開催”。在左侧添加一个浅蓝色圆形信息框，内含 5 行描述佛像的日文文案：“国宝 千手観音立像”、“千の手が、千年の祈りを”、“伝える”、“圧巻のスケールを、”、“その目で感じてみて。”。左下角放置一块带有金色边框的深色矩形展览铭牌，包含 5 行文字：“アスキー美術館 GW特別展”、大标题“国宝展”、“千手観音、祈りの宇宙”，以及日期行 {argument name="event dates" default="2026.4.26 SAT - 6.15 SUN"}。底部中央添加大字号的博物馆名称：{argument name="museum name" default="アスキー美術館"}，后跟一行较小的日文地址和最近车站的交通信息。右下角添加一条红黑相间的标语：“心に残る体験が、きっとここに。”。右下角包含 3 个圆形福利图标及说明：一个带有票据图标的桃色圆圈，文字为“学生はお得! 学生証提示で当日券200円OFF!”；一个带有相机图标的蓝色圆圈，文字为“撮影OK! 一部の作品は写真撮影OK!”；以及一个带有礼物图标的金色圆圈，文字为“来場者プレゼント! オリジナルしおりをプレゼント!”。页面周围散布着微妙的闪光、半调网点、抽象斑点和纸屑形状。整体氛围：引人入胜、具有教育意义、优雅且令人兴奋，将神圣的文化宏伟与愉快的青春探索相结合，如同生成一张带有完整排版的虚构高端博物馆广告海报。

templates.title: Two-page campus band comic strip

titleLocalized.zh: 两页校园乐队漫画跨页

templates.prompt: This two-page black-and-white comic strip is set in a high school band rehearsal room at night. It employs a sophisticated modern shonen/seinen comic style, featuring delicate halftone effects, dramatic lighting, expressive speed lines, and glossy rendering of the instruments. The image shows four band members in school uniforms: a boy with messy short hair, looking surprised in front of a guitar and vocal microphone; a cool, beautiful girl with flowing long hair playing an electric guitar in the foreground; a petite, long-haired girl at the keyboard; and a drummer in the background with his face deliberately soft-focused. The rehearsal room has large windows offering views of the nighttime city skyline, and features chandeliers, amplifiers (including a visible Marshall stacked amplifier), a drum kit with the band logo, cables, and a sign on the wall that reads "Beat Box." The composition is a print comic strip spread, with seven panels across the two pages, including panel spacing, page borders, and page numbers 13 and 14 at the bottom. Left page: 3 panels – The top shows a shocked boy turning to the girls, accompanied by a giant Japanese speech bubble “E!?”; the middle shows a close-up of the long-haired guitarist girl, her expression calm, accompanied by a Japanese speech bubble “…別にいいよ”; the bottom is a panoramic shot of the four members in the rehearsal room. Right page: 4 panels – The top is a powerful performance shot, with the boy singing and playing, and the long-haired girl playing the guitar, accompanied by a giant onomatopoeic word “ジャッ”; the middle is a dynamic close-up of the long-haired guitarist playing intensely, her hair flowing, accompanied by musical notes and radiating speed lines, with the keyboardist girl visible in the background; the bottom is a close-up of the boy's shocked expression, with a soft blur effect, accompanied by a vertical Japanese speech bubble “…あれ”. Emphasis is placed on emotional contrast: as the girl's guitar playing changes the atmosphere, the boy's embarrassment and surprise transforms into admiration. The work uses only monochrome, no color, employs authentic manga fonts, cinematic composition, layered depth of field, and high-precision detail in the hair and instrument strings.

promptLocalized.zh: 两页黑白漫画跨页，背景设定在夜晚的高中乐队排练室，采用精致的现代少年/青年漫画风格，包含细腻的网点纸效果、戏剧性的光影、富有表现力的速度线以及乐器的光泽渲染。画面中可见 4 名身穿校服的乐队成员：一名留着凌乱短发、在吉他和主唱麦克风前感到惊讶的少年；一名在前景中弹奏电吉他、留着飘逸长发的冷静美少女；一名在键盘前的小巧长发少女；以及一名背景中面部被刻意柔焦处理的鼓手。排练室有巨大的窗户，可以看到夜晚的城市天际线，配有吊灯、音箱（包括可见的 Marshall 叠式音箱）、印有乐队标志的架子鼓、线缆，以及墙上写着“Beat Box”的标牌。构图为印刷版漫画跨页，两页共 7 个分镜，包含分镜间距、页面边框以及底部的页码 13 和 14。左页：3 个分镜——顶部是震惊的少年转向女孩们，配有巨大的日语对话气泡“え!?”；中间是长发吉他手女孩的特写，表情冷静，配有日语对话气泡“……別にいいよ”；底部是 4 名成员在排练室的全景镜头。右页：4 个分镜——顶部是充满爆发力的演奏镜头，少年在演唱和演奏，长发女孩在弹吉他，配有巨大的拟声词“ジャッ”；中间是长发吉他手激烈演奏的动态特写，头发飘动，伴有音符符号、放射状速度线，背景可见键盘手女孩；底部是少年震惊表情的特写，带有柔和的虚化效果，配有垂直的日语对话气泡“……あれ”。强调情感对比：随着女孩的吉他演奏改变了氛围，少年的尴尬惊讶转变为钦佩。仅使用单色，无色彩，采用正宗的漫画字体、电影级构图、分层景深，并对头发和乐器琴弦进行高精度细节刻画。

templates.title: Paladins in the Castle City

titleLocalized.zh: 城堡都市中的圣骑士

templates.prompt: A full-body anime fantasy illustration depicts a noble female knight walking through the streets of a medieval castle city during the day. The composition is centered and vertically elongated. She wears exquisitely polished silver plate armor adorned with elegant gold filigree, featuring layered shoulder armor, gauntlets, leg armor, greaves, and foot armor. Over this, she wears a flowing white battle robe with a slit cloak edged in gold and adorned with small crosses near the hem. In her left hand, she holds a large white kite-shaped shield with a raised gold border and a striking gold cross; in her right hand, she holds a scabbard or a longsword hanging down, the blade angled downwards towards her leg. Her hair is {argument name="hair color" default="Long, light gold"} Her hair, extremely long and flowing, was dramatically blown to the right by the wind, with fine strands shimmering in the light. She was described as {argument name="character type" default="A beautiful holy knight princess"} She exudes a calm, resolute, and courageous aura, her steps firm and upright. She is placed on a sunlit cobblestone street amidst ancient stone buildings, with a black wrought-iron street lamp on her right, greenery adorning the walls, and four visible blue and white heraldic banners emblazoned with gold emblems hanging along the street. In the background, a magnificent fairytale castle is displayed, with many towering spires and pointed roofs rising above the town. The sky is a bright blue, dotted with shimmering clouds, and birds fly by in the distance. Utilizing cinematic backlighting and armor edge lighting, the metallic reflections are highly detailed, the fabric folds are clear, and the stone textures are realistic, creating an epic fantasy atmosphere. The composition is elegant, presenting a refined, high-end anime illustration style reminiscent of a fantasy light novel cover.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张全身动漫奇幻插画，描绘了一位高贵的女性骑士在白天的中古世纪城堡都市街道上向前行走，构图居中且呈竖长比例。她身穿抛光精美的银色板甲，饰有优雅的金色花丝，配有层叠的肩甲、护手、腿甲、胫甲和足甲，外罩一件飘逸的白色战袍，分叉的斗篷边缘饰有金色镶边，下摆附近有小型十字图案。她左手持一面大型白色鸢形盾，盾牌饰有凸起的金色边框和醒目的金色十字架；右手持一把剑鞘或下垂的长剑，剑身向下倾斜于腿侧。她的头发为 {argument name="hair color" default="长长的浅金色"}，极长且披散，被风戏剧性地吹向右侧，细碎的发丝在光线下闪烁。将她描绘为 {argument name="character type" default="一位美丽的圣骑士公主"}，展现出冷静、坚定、英勇的气质，步伐挺拔。将她置于古老石建筑之间阳光明媚的鹅卵石街道上，右侧有一盏黑色铁艺路灯，墙边点缀着绿植，街道上悬挂着 4 面可见的蓝白相间纹章旗帜，旗帜上带有金色徽章。背景中，展现一座宏伟的童话般城堡，许多高耸的尖塔和尖顶屋顶在城镇上方升起。天空呈现明亮的蓝色，点缀着发光的碎云，远处有飞鸟掠过。运用电影级背光和盔甲边缘光，金属反射高度细腻，布料褶皱清晰，石材纹理逼真，营造出史诗般的奇幻氛围，构图优雅，呈现出类似于奇幻轻小说封面的精致高端动漫插画风格。

templates.title: Japanese-style summer sports drink poster

titleLocalized.zh: 日式夏季运动饮料海报

templates.prompt: A photorealistic Japanese summer beverage advertisement poster, using a vertical composition and a design style similar to official sports drink promotions. The image shows a full-body shot of a high school girl standing on a sunny mountain road, overlooking a coastal town and the sea, with a clear blue sky and large white clouds in the background. She is positioned slightly to the left of the frame, posing confidently, one leg relaxed, gazing into the distance, her right hand holding a clear plastic bottle at shoulder height.{argument name="drink brand" default="POCARI SWEAT"} She wore a classic Japanese sailor uniform: a white short-sleeved sailor shirt, a dark blue sailor collar with white stripes, a large dark blue bow tie, a knee-length dark blue pleated skirt, two white knee-high socks, and two dark blue or black loafers. Her hair was jet black and glossy. The bright midday light, sharp shadows, clean and fresh atmosphere, high realism, and commercial poster quality are striking. A strong brand-oriented composition is employed. In the upper left corner, a prominent large white logo is placed with "ION SUPPLY DRINK" above it, and below it is an oversized {argument name="main logo text" default="POCARI SWEAT"} The bottom features a white wavy shape. In the upper right corner, add a small white company logo and text.{argument name="company name" default="Otsuka"} On the right, set a vertical line of dark blue Japanese titles.{argument name="headline text" default="It's more welcome than water for a parched body."} In the bottom left corner, add a blue Japanese text block containing a large subheading and several lines of smaller descriptive text, styled similarly to real advertising copy. Near this text is a white circular information badge with blue Japanese text, and two smaller inner circles connected by plus signs, labeled "moisture" and "in". In the far left corner, add small blue recycling-related details and icons; in the bottom right corner, add the website URL.{argument name="website" default="www.pocarisweat.jp"} The overall design evokes the feel of a believable, high-end Japanese refreshing electrolyte drink poster, making it suitable for desktop wallpaper.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张照片级写实的日式夏季饮料广告海报，采用竖构图，设计风格类似于官方运动饮料宣传活动。画面展示了一位全身的少女高中生，她站在阳光明媚的山顶公路上，俯瞰着海岸小镇和大海，背景是湛蓝的天空和巨大的白云。她位于画面偏左侧，姿态自信，一条腿放松，望向远方，右手在肩部高度拿着一瓶透明塑料瓶装的 {argument name="drink brand" default="POCARI SWEAT"}。她身穿经典的日式水手校服：1 件白色短袖水手衫、1 个带有白色条纹的深蓝色水手领、1 个巨大的深蓝色领巾蝴蝶结、1 条及膝深蓝色百褶裙、2 只白色及膝袜以及 2 只深蓝色或黑色乐福鞋。她的头发乌黑顺滑，带有光泽。明亮的正午光线，清晰的阴影，清新干净的氛围，高写实度，商业海报质感。

采用强有力的品牌导向构图。在左上角，放置一个醒目的白色大号标志，上方写着“ION SUPPLY DRINK”，下方是超大的 {argument name="main logo text" default="POCARI SWEAT"}，底部带有白色波浪形状。在右上角，添加一个小型的白色企业标识和文字 {argument name="company name" default="Otsuka"}。在右侧，设置一行深蓝色的竖排日文标题 {argument name="headline text" default="渇いたからだに、水よりうれしい。"}。在左下角，添加一个蓝色的日文正文块，包含一个较大的副标题和几行较小的说明性文字，风格类似于真实的广告文案。在该文字附近，包含 1 个带有蓝色日文的白色圆形信息徽章，以及 2 个由加号连接的标有“水分”和“イオン”的小内圆。在最左下角，添加小号的蓝色回收相关细则和图标；在右下角，添加网站 URL {argument name="website" default="www.pocarisweat.jp"}。使整体设计呈现出一种可信的高端日式清爽电解质饮料海报感，适合用作桌面壁纸。

titleLocalized.zh: 漫画风格替身使者个人资料页

templates.prompt: A comic book-style character profile page with the dramatic visual language of a supernatural battle manga is printed on a slightly worn beige paper background, featuring black ink outlines, dense hatching, and high-contrast cel shadows. The composition is divided into three main parts: an information panel on the left, a full-body portrait of a female character in the center, and a humanoid stand with vertical Japanese dialogue text on the right. The central image depicts a tall, athletic young Japanese woman, approximately {argument name="character age" default="22"} She is 20 years old, with long, straight black hair, healthy bronze skin, and a muscular, athletic physique. Her face is blurred by a large rectangular mosaic. She wears three visible pieces of clothing: a tight-fitting, sweat-soaked white tank top, and a pair of dark blue, super-short athletic shorts with drawstrings, without any accessories. Sweat glistens on her skin and clothing, emphasizing a humid, sexy, and intense training atmosphere. She stands confidently in a frontal pose, one arm outstretched towards the viewer, creating a slight sense of perspective shortening. Behind her to the right, a streamlined humanoid avatar made of a glossy, pale purple liquid is displayed, with splashes of water around its head and shoulders, slender eyes, smooth, organic, armor-like anatomical structures, and three round purple spheres detailing its chest and abdomen. Two large, stylized purple Japanese onomatopoeic words in hand-drawn manga font are added to the image: "Gogogo…" near the top and "Gogogogo…" near the lower body. On the far right, there is a vertical black Japanese interjection: “オラオララッ！汗の一滴まで見逃されェ！”. The left panel is a character profile with a black border on a beige background, featuring multiple horizontal separators and Japanese text. Please accurately include the following data field: “スタンド使い名:” followed by “{argument name="character name" default="Mizusawa Sakura"} (ミズサワサクラ)", "gender:" followed by "female", "见た目:" followed by "黒髪ロング, a healthy body, a healthy body, a lot of clothing," "Year:" followed by "22 years old", "Length :" followed by "160cm", and "Occupation:" followed by "フリータージムトレーナー". Below, there is a radar chart titled "スタンドabilities パラメーター" with 6 around the chart Each labeled attribute is listed as: "Destructive Power B", "Speed ​​A", "Range C", "Growth Potential B", "Precision Motion A", and durability on the remaining axes, filled with a purple polygon. In the lower left corner, there is another text box containing the Stand's name and ability description. The Stand section should display: "Stand Name:" followed by "『..."{argument name="stand name" default="SWEAT BLOOM"} The text appears to be a series of seemingly unrelated phrases and sentences, making it difficult to translate coherently. It includes fragments about Stand abilities, a close-range Stand activated by sweat and bodily fluids, the ability to manipulate surrounding moisture, change liquid pressure and viscosity, slow opponents with sweat, make surfaces slippery to disrupt balance, and fire sweat at high speeds like bullets. The overall style is described as a hardcore serialized manga spread, featuring dynamic and sexy character designs, exaggerated JoJo-style effects, a clean page layout, detailed anatomical structures, purple accents for Stand effects and charts, a lack of modern UI elements, and full-page illustrations.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张具有超自然战斗漫画戏剧性视觉语言的漫画风格角色资料页，印在略显陈旧的米色纸张背景上，配有黑色墨水轮廓、密集的排线和高对比度的赛璐珞阴影。构图分为 3 个主要部分：左侧信息面板、中央全身女性角色肖像，以及右侧带有垂直日语对话文本的人形替身。画面中央描绘了一位高挑、健美的年轻日本女性，约 {argument name="character age" default="22"} 岁，留着黑色长直发，拥有健康的古铜色皮肤和肌肉发达的运动型身材。她的脸部被一个巨大的矩形马赛克模糊处理。她穿着 3 件可见的服装：一件紧身且被汗水浸透的白色背心、一条带有抽绳的深蓝色超短运动短裤，没有佩戴任何饰品。她的皮肤和衣服上闪烁着汗水，强调出一种潮湿、性感且激烈的训练氛围。她以自信的正面姿势站立，一只手臂向下伸向观众，营造出轻微的透视缩短感。在她身后右侧，展示一个由光泽感淡紫色液体构成的流线型人形替身，头部和肩部周围有飞溅的水滴，细长的眼睛，平滑的有机装甲状解剖结构，胸部和腹部有 3 个圆形的紫色球体细节。在画面中添加 2 个手绘漫画字体的大型风格化紫色日语拟声词：顶部附近写着“ゴゴゴ…”，下半身附近写着“ゴゴゴゴ……”。在最右侧，放置一段垂直的黑色日语感叹词：“オラオララッ！汗の一滴まで見逃されェ！”。左侧面板是一个米色背景上的黑色边框角色档案，带有多个水平分隔线和日语文本。请准确包含以下资料字段：“スタンド使い名:”后接“{argument name="character name" default="水沢 咲良"}（ミズサワ サクラ）”，“性別:”后接“女”，“見た目:”后接“黒髪ロング、健康的な体つき スポーティな服装が多い”，“年齢:”后接“22歳”，“身長:”后接“160cm”，以及“職業:”后接“フリーター ジムトレーナー”。在下方，包含一个标题为“スタンド能力パラメーター”的雷达图框，图表周围有 6 个标注的属性：“破壊力 B”、“スピード A”、“射程距離 C”、“成長性 B”、“精密動作性 A”，以及剩余轴上的耐久力，并填充紫色多边形。在左下角，包含另一个带有替身名称和能力描述的文本框。替身部分应显示：“スタンド名:”后接“『{argument name="stand name" default="SWEAT BLOOM"}』”及其下方“（スウェット・ブルーム）”。在“スタンドの能力:”下方，包含一段密集的日语段落，描述一种由汗水和体液激活的近距离替身，能够操纵周围的水分并改变液体的压力和粘度，通过汗水迟缓对手的动作，使表面变得湿滑以破坏平衡，并能以高速像子弹一样发射汗水。整体风格：硬核连载漫画跨页，动态性感动作角色设计，JoJo 风格的夸张表现，整洁的页面布局，精细的解剖结构，替身特效和图表填充使用紫色作为强调色，无现代 UI 元素，全页插图。

templates.title: Cyberpunk Rainy Night Robot Repair

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克雨夜机器人维修

templates.prompt: A cinematic cyberpunk street scene set in a rainy night, incredibly detailed and photorealistic. In the foreground, a young East Asian female technician with messy dark hair sits at a damp metal workbench, intently repairing a small, spherical, quadrupedal robot. Her face is obscured by a centrally located square mosaic. She wears a transparent plastic raincoat over dark clothing, the shiny folds of the raincoat reflecting neon lights. She holds a precision screwdriver in one hand, while the other adjusts exposed wiring and circuitry within the robot's shell. The robot is small and old, about the size of a small dog, with a rounded, white-gray body, a single blue camera lens serving as its eye, and clearly visible internal electronic components covered in scratches and grime. Four mechanical legs support it on the table. Scattered on the table are precisely prepared repair items: two screwdrivers, two batteries, a project, a small camera or lens module, scattered screws, wires, and a half-full glass of amber liquid. The surrounding area is a densely packed neon-lit East Asian alleyway market. The ground is wet from the rain, food stalls are steaming, and pedestrians are holding umbrellas. At least eight clearly visible illuminated signs are visible in the background, including one that reads {argument name="main neon sign" default="repair"} A large red sign, an orange sign that reads "OPEN," a bright sign that reads "24H," a sign that reads "Hotel" vertically, and other shop signs that blend Chinese, Japanese, and Korean styles. In the background, several figures wearing dark and transparent raincoats can be seen, some of their faces softened and blurred by the depth of field effect. The use of melancholic blue-orange lighting, glossy reflections, mist, volumetric rain, shallow depth of field, dramatic bokeh, anamorphic lens flare, high texture detail, and a rough realism creates the atmosphere of a lonely street mechanic repairing advanced hardware in a bustling futuristic city.

promptLocalized.zh: 电影级赛博朋克雨夜街头场景，超精细且具有照片级真实感。前景中，一位年轻的东亚女性技师留着凌乱的深色发髻，坐在潮湿的金属工作台前，正全神贯注地修理一个小型球形四足机器人。她的脸部被居中的方形马赛克遮挡。她身穿透明塑料雨衣，内搭深色服装，雨衣光亮的褶皱反射着霓虹灯光。她一手拿着精密螺丝刀，另一手正在调整机器人外壳内裸露的线路和电路。机器人小巧且陈旧，约小狗大小，拥有白灰色的圆润机身、一只蓝色的摄像头镜头作为眼睛，内部电子元件清晰可见，布满划痕和污垢，四条机械腿支撑在桌面上。桌面上散落着精确的维修杂物：2 把螺丝刀、2 块电池、1 个项目、1 个小型摄像头或镜头模组、散落的螺丝、电线以及半杯琥珀色液体。周围是密集的霓虹灯东亚巷弄市场，地面被雨水打湿，小吃摊冒着热气，行人撑着雨伞。背景中至少包含 8 个清晰的照明招牌，包括一个写有 {argument name="main neon sign" default="修理"} 的大型红色招牌、一个写有 "OPEN" 的橙色招牌、一个写有 "24H" 的明亮招牌、一个竖排写有 "ホテル" 的招牌，以及其他混合中、日、韩风格的店铺招牌。背景中可见几位身穿深色雨衣和透明雨衣的人物，部分面孔因景深效果而柔和模糊。采用忧郁的蓝橙色调灯光、光泽反射、薄雾、体积雨、浅景深、戏剧性焦外成像、变形镜头光晕、高纹理细节、粗粝的写实感，营造出一位孤独的街头技师在繁华的未来城市中修复先进硬件的氛围。

templates.title: Sunset Paper-cutting Art at Dawn Temple

titleLocalized.zh: 黎明寺日落剪纸艺术

templates.prompt: A layered paper-cutting artwork with extremely rich details, showcasing{argument name="scene" default="Wat Arun in Bangkok, Thailand at dusk"} Viewed from across the river, the composition is centered and symmetrical. The image should exhibit the effects of handcrafted 3D paper sculpture and paper-cutting art, with stacked layers of paper, sharp paper edges, soft relief depth, delicate shadows between layers, and exquisite decorative architectural details. In the center of the image, the temple's magnificent main tower rises from the ground, surrounded by four smaller towers, with lush dark green to black foliage at its base. Small pavilions dot the riverside promenade, and numerous Thai flags are arranged along the water's edge. In the foreground, the Chao Phraya River is presented as stylized, wavy paper waves in deep navy blue and charcoal gray, with a traditional long-tailed boat moving from left to right near the bottom center. The sky is filled with numerous horizontally extending, layered paper clouds, outlining the low-hanging sunset partially obscured behind the temple on the right side of the center of the image.{argument name="color palette" default="Golden yellow, amber, burnt orange, peach, terracotta, coral, and deep blue-black"} The warm-toned sunset color scheme maintains an elegant, complex, cinematic, and richly textured overall style, creating a feel reminiscent of a handcrafted paper model. The bright sky contrasts sharply with the dark foreground, presenting an overall exquisite Asian decorative art aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅细节极其丰富的层叠剪纸艺术作品，展示了 {argument name="scene" default="泰国曼谷黄昏时的黎明寺"}，从河对岸望去，构图居中且对称。图像应呈现出手工 3D 纸雕和剪纸艺术的效果，具有堆叠的纸张层次、清晰的纸张边缘、柔和的浮雕深度、层与层之间细腻的阴影以及精致的装饰性建筑细节。画面中央，寺庙宏伟的主塔拔地而起，周围环绕着 4 座较小的塔，底部是深绿色至黑色的茂密树丛，河滨步道上有小型凉亭，水边排列着多面泰国国旗。前景中，湄南河呈现为深海军蓝和炭灰色的风格化卷曲纸浪，底部中心附近有一艘传统的长尾船正从左向右穿行。天空中布满了许多水平延伸的层叠纸质云朵，勾勒出位于画面中心右侧、半掩在寺庙后的低垂落日。使用 {argument name="color palette" default="金黄、琥珀色、焦橙色、桃色、赤陶色、珊瑚色和深蓝黑色"} 的暖色调日落配色。整体风格保持优雅、复杂、具有电影感且纹理丰富，营造出一种手工纸质立体模型的感觉，明亮的天空与深色的前景形成鲜明对比，整体呈现出精致的亚洲装饰艺术美感。

templates.title: Dark Creative Overload in the Dead of Night

titleLocalized.zh: 深夜的暗黑创意超载

templates.prompt: A cinematic digital illustration, brimming with emotional tension, depicts a weary young creator sitting alone at a cluttered table late at night. The three-quarter view shows the creator leaning forward, one elbow resting on the table, the other hand partially obscuring their face, conveying a sense of exhaustion and overwhelming burden. The face is deliberately hidden in shadow. The figure wears dark casual clothing and a lanyard badge, suggesting an identity as a student, designer, or healthcare worker. The room is realistically and slightly messy, with a desk lamp, papers, a sketchbook, a mug, stationery, and stacks of books on the table. On the left wall hang two glowing X-ray films, a round clock, and shelves and sticky notes in deep shadow. In front of the figure is a glowing widescreen monitor displaying an AI image generation or creative editing interface. The main preview area features a sunset cityscape, below which is a row of thumbnail variations. The interface uses a modern, dark UI with a purple action button. The monitor is the primary light source, casting warm orange and cool blue highlights on the table. Surrounding the monitor and bursting into the air is a grand and surreal explosion of imagination and digital creativity: a galaxy-like vortex containing the colors of stars and nebulae, sparkling particles, light trails, and cosmic dust in purple, blue, pink, and gold. Embedded within the vortex are many dreamlike floating elements: a fantastical castle on a floating island with trees, planets and satellites, astronauts, a movie clapperboard, cameras, musical notes, glowing figures, a futuristic city skyline, hot air balloons, cars, birds, jellyfish-like glowing creatures, and multiple cats, including a giant sleeping orange cat in the upper right corner and a cat wearing a space helmet in the lower right corner. These magical images seem to be thoughts escaping from the computer, both beautiful and tinged with a sense of darkness and oppression, as if creativity, obsession, and intense emotions are filling the entire room. A skeletal anatomical hand model stands on the table to the right of the monitor, reinforcing the atmosphere of an art studio or study. The system employs dramatic low-key lighting, high contrast, intricate details, volumetric lighting effects, cinematic depth of field, and a balance between realism and fantastical surrealism. The overall atmosphere is melancholic, imaginative, and darkly inspiring, vividly visualizing what is {argument name="creative tool" default="AI Image Generation"} The feeling of being consumed by the thoughts that arise.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅充满情绪张力的电影感数字插画，描绘了一位疲惫的年轻创作者在深夜独自坐在杂乱的桌前。画面采用四分之三侧视图，创作者身体前倾，一只手肘撑在桌上，另一只手半遮面部，呈现出一种精疲力竭、不堪重负的姿态。面部故意隐藏在阴影中。人物穿着深色休闲服，佩戴着挂绳证件，暗示其学生、设计师或医护人员的身份。房间环境真实且略显凌乱，桌上有台灯、纸张、速写本、马克杯、文具和堆叠的书籍。左侧墙上挂着两张发光的 X 光片、一个圆形挂钟，以及深影中的搁板和便签。人物前方是一台发光的宽屏显示器，屏幕上显示着 AI 图像生成或创意编辑界面，主预览区是一幅日落城市艺术图，下方是一排缩略图变体，界面采用现代暗色 UI，配有一个紫色操作按钮。显示器是主要光源，在桌面上投射出温暖的橙色和冷蓝色的高光。在显示器周围并向空中喷涌而出的是一场宏大且超现实的想象力与数字创意大爆炸：一个类似星系的漩涡，包含恒星、星云色彩、火花粒子、光迹以及紫色、蓝色、粉色和金色的宇宙尘埃。漩涡中嵌入了许多梦幻般的漂浮元素：一座带有树木的浮空岛上的奇幻城堡、行星与卫星、宇航员、电影场记板、摄像机、音符、发光的人影、未来派城市天际线、热气球、汽车、鸟类、水母状的发光生物以及多只猫咪，包括右上角一只巨大的睡着的橘猫和右下角一只戴着太空头盔的猫。这些神奇的意象仿佛是电脑中逃逸出的思绪，既美丽又带着一丝暗黑与压迫感，仿佛创意、执念与强烈的情感正充斥着整个房间。显示器右侧的桌上立着一个骨骼解剖手模型，强化了艺术工作室或书房的氛围。采用戏剧性的低调照明、高对比度、复杂的细节、体积光效果、电影级景深，并平衡了写实感与奇幻超现实主义。整体氛围忧郁、充满想象力且带有暗黑的启发性，生动地视觉化了被 {argument name="creative tool" default="AI 图像生成"} 所产生的想法所吞噬的感觉。

templates.title: Xinjiang road trip journal page

titleLocalized.zh: 新疆公路旅行手帐页面

templates.prompt: A heartwarming handmade travel journal page, photographed from above on a wooden table, showcases an open double-page diary. The pages have thick, frayed edges, and layers of fabric tags peek out from the sides. The overall style is a realistic mixed-media travel journal, incorporating watercolor map art, handwritten Chinese titles, washi tape-stamped Polaroid photos, doodles, and soft natural light. On the top left page, the date "2024.09.20." is written in small handwriting, followed by a striking black brush-style Chinese title.{argument name="title text" default="Xinjiang Road Trip Journal"} Arrange five Polaroid-style photos on the page, each slightly tilted and secured with beige or patterned washi tape: The top left photo shows two travelers beside a blue alpine lake, labeled "Tianshan Tianchi"; the upper left vertical photo shows three people on a green meadow, labeled "Nalati Grassland"; the bottom left photo shows a couple beside a deep blue lake, labeled "Sayram Lake"; the upper right photo shows two travelers on an empty highway under a bright blue sky, labeled "Desert Highway"; and the lower center photo shows two figures standing on a sand dune at sunset, labeled "Sunset Dunes". Add small, handwritten bilingual location captions next to the photos on the left page: in a casual notebook style, write "Tianshan Tianchi", "Sayram Lake", "Desert Highway", and "Sunset Dunes". On the right page, a freehand watercolor map of Xinjiang is drawn in beige, light green, and blue, featuring a striking blue, winding highway that runs the length of the region, marked with 10 red location markers along the route. Map doodles are added: a group of small mountain icons near the top, a river and several blue lakes, a miniature compass in the upper right corner, two camel paintings, two yurt paintings, and thin gray roads branching off from the main blue route. At the bottom of the right page, three Polaroid photos are taped together: the bottom left shows people in traditional clothing, labeled "Grand Bazaar"; the bottom center shows people holding kebabs, labeled "Kimchi Skewers"; and the bottom right shows a couple taking a selfie inside a yurt, labeled "Yurt Selfie." Various small hand-drawn doodles are scattered across the two pages, including a sun, a car, two horse paintings, four fish icons, a crescent moon, several stars, small arrows, flame patterns next to food photos and below the map, and tiny decorative swirls. All text displayed is in Chinese, presenting a vivid aesthetic of a journal, realistic paper texture, subtle shadows under each photo, and a warm, memoir-like atmosphere throughout the Xinjiang road trip.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张温馨的手工旅行手帐页面，从正上方俯拍于木质桌面上，展示了一本打开的双页日记，纸张边缘厚实且带有毛边，侧面露出层叠的织物标签。整体风格为逼真的混合媒介旅行日记，包含水彩地图艺术、手写中文标题、胶带粘贴的拍立得照片、涂鸦以及柔和的自然光。在左上页，用小巧的笔迹写上日期“2024.09.20.”，并书写一个醒目的黑色毛笔风格中文标题 {argument name="title text" default="新疆公路旅行手帐"}。在页面上布置 5 张拍立得风格照片，每张略微倾斜，并用米色或花纹纸胶带固定：左上角 1 张照片展示了两位旅行者在蓝色高山湖泊旁，标注为“天山天池”；中上方偏左 1 张竖构图照片展示了三个人在绿色草地上，标注为“那拉提草原”；左下角 1 张照片展示了一对情侣在深蓝色湖泊旁，标注为“赛里木湖”；中上方偏右 1 张照片展示了两位旅行者在明亮蓝天下的空旷公路上，标注为“沙漠公路”；中下方 1 张照片展示了两个身影站在日落时的沙丘上，标注为“日落沙丘”。在左页照片旁添加小巧的手写双语地点注释：以随性的笔记本风格写上“天山天池 (Tianshan Tianchi)”、“赛里木湖 (Sayram Lake)”、“沙漠公路 (Desert Highway)”和“日落沙丘 (Sunset Dunes)”。在右页，用米色、淡绿色和蓝色绘制一张写意的新疆水彩地图，地图上有一条醒目的蓝色蜿蜒公路路线贯穿全境，并沿路线放置 10 个红色地点标记。添加地图涂鸦：顶部附近有一组小山图标、一条河流和几个蓝色湖泊、右上角有一个微型指南针、2 幅骆驼画、2 幅蒙古包画，以及围绕主蓝色路线分支的细灰色道路。在右页底部，放置 3 张用胶带粘贴的拍立得照片：左下 1 张展示了身着民族服饰的人们，标注为“大巴扎”；中下 1 张展示了手持烤肉串，标注为“烤肉串”；右下 1 张展示了一对情侣在蒙古包内自拍，标注为“蒙古包自拍”。在两页纸上散布各种小巧的手绘涂鸦，包括太阳、小汽车、2 幅马的画、4 个鱼图标、新月、几颗星星、小箭头、食物照片旁和地图下方的火焰图案，以及细小的装饰性漩涡纹。所有展示的文字均保持中文，呈现出生动的手帐美感、逼真的纸张质感、每张照片下方的轻微阴影，以及新疆公路旅行整体温馨的回忆录氛围。

templates.title: Fictional Couple Photo Collection Puzzle

titleLocalized.zh: 虚构情侣照片合集拼图

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image as a base, transform it into a realistic casual smartphone photo collage showcasing him as if he had a girlfriend. Maintain consistency in his identity, hairstyle, age, white hoodie, and natural, non-model-like appearance, but place him with a young woman within 16 square snapshots arranged in a 4x4 grid with thin white borders. Add a fixed female partner with long hair and a realistic (not a model-like) appearance, subtly changing her outfits within the collage, including a beige cardigan, a dark top, and a soft blue top. Let these photos evoke the feel of genuine couple memories captured on a smartphone: intimate mirror selfies, dimly lit, blurred selfies, indoor peace sign selfies, nighttime street selfies, motion-blurred close-ups, outdoor daytime photos under trees, indoor shoulder-to-shoulder photos, another blurred intimate photo, a restaurant photo with glasses on a table, warm nighttime dappled light photos, mirror selfies on rooftops or balconies with city lights, nighttime city walks, cozy cuddles, arm-in-arm poses, close-up portraits side-by-side, and another intimate cropped shot. The collection blends indoor home scenes, nighttime city scenes, an outdoor daytime scene, and a restaurant scene. Using imperfect composition, slight blur, flash, graininess, and spontaneous candid shots, it resembles a collection of real-life couple photos rather than a meticulously retouched advertisement.

promptLocalized.zh: 以提供的参考图像作为男性的基础，将其转化为一张逼真的休闲智能手机照片拼图，展示他仿佛拥有女朋友的样子。保持他的身份、发型、年龄、白色卫衣以及自然的非模特外貌一致，但让他与一名年轻女性出现在 16 张排列成 4x4 网格并带有细白边框的方形快照中。加入 1 位长发且外貌真实（而非精致模特）的固定女性伴侣，并让她在拼图中微妙地更换服装，包括米色针织开衫、深色上衣和柔和的蓝色上衣。让这些照片呈现出手机拍摄的真实情侣回忆感：亲密的镜前自拍、昏暗模糊的自拍、室内比耶自拍、夜间街头自拍、动态模糊特写、树下户外日间照、室内靠肩照、另一张模糊的亲昵照、桌上放着眼镜的餐厅就座照、温暖的夜间光斑照、带有城市灯光的屋顶或阳台镜前自拍、夜间城市漫步照、温馨依偎照、搂肩姿势、近距离并肩肖像以及另一张亲密的局部裁剪照。混合室内居家场景、夜间城市场景、一张户外日间场景和一张餐厅场景。运用不完美的构图、轻微模糊、闪光灯、颗粒感以及随性的抓拍构图，使其看起来像是一个真实的人保存的情侣照片合集，而非精修的广告大片。

templates.title: Ancient Chinese RPG Brothel Street UI

titleLocalized.zh: 古代中国 RPG 妓院街道 UI

templates.prompt: A cinematic third-person screenshot from a realistically styled open-world RPG set in ancient China, depicting a luxurious brothel district at night. The camera focuses on a tall male protagonist with long, half-tied black hair, dressed in a dark embroidered Hanfu robe, standing in the middle of a damp cobblestone street, facing an ornately decorated brothel. The central building is richly detailed, featuring carved wooden pillars, glowing red lanterns, and a golden calligraphy plaque, with warm amber lighting illuminating the street. A large horizontal sign above the entrance reads "Spring Courtyard." Vertical calligraphy couplets hang on the front pillars on either side. There are 16 visible NPCs around the entrance and street: a player character with their back to the camera in the foreground, 7 geishas in flowing, semi-transparent silk Hanfu posing or sitting on stools near the entrance, 6 pedestrians and guests scattered in the right-hand street and bridge area, and 2 figures sitting in the entrance area. The female character wears elegant Tang and Song dynasty-style long dresses in colors including pale peach, pink, ivory, mint green, and light gold, revealing her shoulders with layers of tulle and exquisite hairstyles and hair ornaments; the male character wears dark robes. The ground is glistening from recent rain, reflecting the lights. The background on the right depicts a canal town at night with stone bridges, multi-tiered traditional buildings, more lanterns, and a rich, atmospheric depth. The images should convey the quality of a high-budget game demo: ultra-detailed, photorealistic, dramatic, atmospheric, and sensual without being overtly explicit. The interface features a complete Chinese MMORPG HUD: a circular player portrait in the top left corner displaying level 35, red and blue health and mana bars, and small status icons; a quest tracker on the left with four Chinese quest lines; a chat box in the bottom left corner with multiple Chinese messages and channel tags; a circular minimap in the top right corner displaying the location text "Qinghe County · Yichun Courtyard (1123, 885)" and eight small menu icons around it; a thin experience bar at the bottom center; and an action bar in the bottom right corner with eight circular skill buttons, including a green martial arts skill, a gold highlighted ability, and a large movement/jump button.{argument name="game screenshot style" default="Hyper-realistic cinematic MMORPG UI"} ,{argument name="setting" default="Red-light districts in ancient China at night"} ,{argument name="main building sign" default="Spring Courtyard"} ,{argument name="player outfit color" default="Dark charcoal black"} , and{argument name="lighting mood" default="Warm lantern light and cool-toned night shadows"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 一张来自写实风格古代中国开放世界 RPG 的电影级第三人称游戏截图，场景设定在夜晚奢华的风月街区。镜头位于一名高大男性主角身后，他留着半扎的黑色长发，身穿深色刺绣汉服长袍，站在湿润的石板路中央，面对着一座装饰华丽的妓院楼阁。中心建筑细节丰富，配有雕花木柱、发光的红灯笼、金色书法牌匾，温暖的琥珀色灯光洒在街道上。入口上方的大型横向招牌写着“春院”。两侧前柱上挂着竖排书法对联。门口和街道周围共有 16 个可见的 NPC：前景中一名背对镜头的玩家角色，7 名身穿飘逸半透明丝绸汉服、在入口附近摆姿势或坐在凳子上的艺伎，6 名散布在右侧街道和桥梁区域的行人和客人，以及 2 名坐在入口区域的身影。女性角色穿着优雅的唐宋风格长裙，颜色包括淡桃红、粉色、象牙白、薄荷绿和浅金色，露出肩膀，层叠的薄纱，精致的发髻和发饰；男性角色穿着深色长袍。地面因刚下过雨而显得光亮，倒映着灯光。背景右侧是带有石桥、多层传统建筑、更多灯笼和浓厚大气深度的运河小镇夜景。图像应呈现出高预算游戏演示的质感，超精细、照片级写实、具有戏剧性、氛围感强且感性但不露骨。叠加完整的中文 MMORPG HUD 界面：左上角圆形玩家头像，显示 35 级，红色和蓝色生命值与法力值条，以及小型状态图标；左侧任务追踪器，包含 4 条中文任务线；左下角聊天框，带有多个中文消息和频道标签；右上角圆形小地图，显示位置文本“清河县·怡春院 (1123, 885)”以及周围 8 个小型菜单图标；底部中心有一条细长的经验条；右下角动作栏，包含 8 个圆形 skill 按钮，包括绿色武术 skill、金色高亮能力以及一个较大的移动/跳跃按钮。使用 {argument name="game screenshot style" default="超写实电影级 MMORPG UI"}, {argument name="setting" default="夜晚的古代中国红灯区"}, {argument name="main building sign" default="春院"}, {argument name="player outfit color" default="深炭黑色"}, 和 {argument name="lighting mood" default="温暖的灯笼光与冷色调夜影"}。
