templates.title: Anime-style folding bicycle event poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫风折叠自行车活动海报

templates.prompt: A bright and cheerful anime-style poster for a folding bicycle riding event, its design inspired by sophisticated Japanese advertisements, featuring dense typography, stickers, labels, and event information panels. The image showcases a sunny riverside promenade under blue skies and white clouds, with lush greenery in the upper right corner, complemented by flowerbeds, colorful flags, and falling petals. In the distance, a modern city skyline is visible on the water. In the foreground, a cute anime girl {argument name="hair color" default="Light chestnut brown"} With shoulder-length curly hair, a side-parted fringe, and two colorful hair clips, she smiles at the audience and winks playfully. She extends a hand towards the camera with a dynamic pose, as if inviting the audience to join in. She wears a yellow hooded windbreaker over a white T-shirt with colorful bicycle lettering, dark blue shorts, black knee-high socks, and carries a light blue backpack. Beside her is a mint green "FOLDY" compact folding bicycle, unfolded and parked on the path, clearly showing the wheels, frame fold, handlebars, seat, pedals, and rack, emphasizing its portability and urban leisure riding characteristics. The poster employs a glossy, high-saturation anime poster aesthetic, with clean lines, soft facial rendering, vibrant lighting, and playful graphic decorations. The poster should incorporate Japanese advertising-style layout elements. In the upper left corner is a large colorful headline that reads "Let's FOLDING" in oversized playful bubble font and block font RIDE!", with a line of smaller arc-shaped Japanese text "さあ、いっしょに出かけよう!" There is a blue ribbon-like subtitle "フォールディングバイクで, もっとfree に, もっと远くへ!". A yellow explosion sticker is placed in the upper right corner, containing a small flag icon with the text "フォールディングバイクサイクリングイベントOpen!" Add a white speech bubble with a pink outline near the girl's face, containing the handwritten Japanese text: "ねえ, キミ! fold りたたみはどこへでも行けるよ♪ 一行に行こっ!". Near the bike, add a small slanted sticker with the text "コンパクトにたためてhold ち云びラクラク♪". Add a title bar "イベントの楽しみポイント♪" on the lower left, followed by 4 pastel circle icon function points: 1) Pink bicycle icon with the text "folding りたたみでholding ちluck and freedom!" 2) Blue camera icon with text "フォトスポットで思い出を residualそう!" 3) Yellow drink icon with text "カフェタイムでほっとひと心♪" 4) Purple gift icon with the text "オリジナルグッズプレゼント!". Add a rounded white information card with green decorations to the lower right corner, titled "FOLDING BIKE サイクリングイベント", and mark the date "6.15 (Sun)" in large pink font. The card displays 4 rows of event details with colorful round icons: 1) Date row: "Opening date 2025. ※ Rainy weather will be postponed to 6.22 (Sunday)" 2) Location row: "Gathering place みなとみらい港パーク" and small print remarks "(Yokohama City, Kanagawa Prefecture)" 3) Route line: "コースみなとみらい～Wanyan いの気hold ちいいルートをwalking ります" and small-print remarks "(about 20km, beginners can rest assured!)" 4) Fee line: "Participation fee 3,000 yen" and small print remarks "(Guarantee・Souvenir paymentき) ※レンタルバイクあり (reservation required)". A pink banner is added to the bottom of the card, which reads "Welcome to those who are new to the game! Welcome to join us!" A large pink banner was made at the bottom of the poster, with the large Japanese text "さあ、二日は一丝に行ろう!", with small words on the left side "お神し込み・Detailed formula サイトへ!". Place a search bar style box at the bottom center with the content:{argument name="search text" default="フォールディングライド 2025"} A black and white QR code is added to the right side, accompanied by a pink label "Entry is here!". The bottom right corner features a small, illustrated photo of two cyclists riding side-by-side, with the handwritten note "It's me, too!" Maintaining a vibrant, magazine-quality event poster composition, it includes one main character, one folding bicycle, one large event information card, one speech bubble, one yellow pop-up sticker, one portable sticker, four function icons, one QR code, and one illustration.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张明亮欢快的动漫风格折叠自行车骑行活动宣传海报，设计参考了精致的日式广告，包含密集的排版、贴纸、标注和活动信息栏。画面展现了蓝天白云下阳光明媚的滨河步道，右上角有绿树枝叶掩映，配有花坛、彩旗、飘落的花瓣，远处水面可见现代城市天际线。前景中，一位可爱的动漫少女（{argument name="hair color" default="浅栗棕色"}齐肩卷发，侧分刘海，戴着两个彩色发夹）正对着观众微笑并俏皮地眨眼。她以动感的姿态伸出一只手伸向镜头，仿佛在邀请观众加入。她身穿黄色连帽防风外套，内搭印有彩色自行车字母的白色 T 恤，下穿深蓝色短裤、黑色过膝袜，背着一个浅蓝色背包。她身旁是一辆薄荷绿色的“FOLDY”紧凑型折叠自行车，处于展开状态停在步道上，清晰可见小轮、车架折叠处、车把、车座、脚踏和停车架，强调了便携性和城市休闲骑行的特点。采用光泽感强、高饱和度的动漫海报美学，线条干净，面部渲染柔和，光影充满活力，并配有俏皮的图形装饰。

海报需填充日式广告风格的布局元素。左上角是一个巨大的彩色标题，用超大号俏皮气泡字体和块状字体写着“Let’s FOLDING RIDE!”，上方有一行较小的弧形日文“さあ、いっしょに出かけよう！”，下方配有蓝色丝带状副标题“フォールディングバイクで、もっと自由に、もっと遠くへ！”。右上角放置一个黄色爆炸贴纸，内含一个小旗帜图标，文字为“フォールディングバイク サイクリングイベント 開催！”。在少女脸部附近添加一个带有粉色轮廓的白色对话气泡，内含手写体日文：“ねえ、キミ！ 折りたたみは どこへでも行けるよ♪ 一緒に 行こっ！”。在自行车附近，添加一个带有文字“コンパクトにたためて 持ち運びラクラク♪”的小型倾斜贴纸。在左下方添加一个标题栏“イベントの楽しみポイント♪”，随后是 4 个粉彩圆圈图标功能点：1) 粉色自行车图标，文字“折りたたみで 持ち運び自由！” 2) 蓝色相机图标，文字“フォトスポットで 思い出を残そう！” 3) 黄色饮料图标，文字“カフェタイムで ほっとひと息♪” 4) 紫色礼物图标，文字“オリジナルグッズ プレゼント！”。

右下方添加一张带有绿色装饰的圆角白色信息卡，标题为“FOLDING BIKE サイクリングイベント”，并用大号粉色字体标注日期“6.15(日)”。卡片内展示 4 行带有彩色圆形图标的活动详情：1) 日期行：“開催日 2025. ※雨天時は6.22(日)に順延” 2) 地点行：“集合所 みなとみらい 臨港パーク”及小字备注“(神奈川県横浜市)” 3) 路线行：“コース みなとみらい〜湾沿いの気持ちいいルートを走ります”及小字备注“(約20km、初心者安心！)” 4) 费用行：“参加費 3,000円”及小字备注“(保険・記念品付き) ※レンタルバイクあり（要予約）”。卡片底部添加一条粉色横幅，写着“初心者歓迎！ひとり参加も大歓迎！”。海报最底部制作一条宽大的粉色横幅，写有大号日文“さあ、次の休日は一緒に走ろう！”，左侧配有小字“お申し込み・詳細は公式サイトへ！”。底部中心放置一个搜索栏样式的框，内容为 {argument name="search text" default="フォールディングライド 2025"}。右侧添加一个黑白二维码，并配有粉色标签“エントリーはこちらから！”。右下角包含一张小巧的插图式照片，展示两名骑行者并肩骑行，配有手写备注“たのしいかも♡”。保持生动、杂志品质的活动海报构图，包含 1 个主角、1 辆折叠自行车、1 张大型活动信息卡、1 个对话气泡、1 个黄色爆炸贴纸、1 个便携性贴纸、4 个功能图标、1 个二维码和 1 张插图。

templates.title: Melancholy Night Street Comic Page

titleLocalized.zh: 忧郁夜街漫画跨页

templates.prompt: This is a two-page spread of black-and-white comic strip with a cinematic and melancholic tone. Drawn in a highly detailed seinen manga style, it features realistic lighting effects, reflections on a wet pavement, dense overhead power lines, and a star-studded night sky above a quiet Japanese residential street. The spread is divided into four panels. The upper left panel is a wide-angle shot of an empty suburban street at night, showing low houses, walls, utility poles, glowing streetlights, and a slightly reflective road stretching into the distance. The lower left panel shows the back of a boy walking alone on the same street, wearing a dark school uniform blazer, white shirt, loose striped tie, and slim-fit trousers, carrying a crossbody bag; his posture conveys weariness and inner conflict. A vertically shaped Japanese speech bubble is included in this panel, displaying the text "やっぱり俺には". The top panel on the right page features a close-up of the boy's hand, nervously clutching his suit jacket or shirt lapel, accompanied by a hand-drawn Japanese onomatopoeic word, "Gyut...". The bottom panel on the right page is a frontal portrait of the same boy outdoors at night, from the chest up. He has messy, light-colored short hair, a slightly disheveled school uniform, and an emotional expression. A crossbody bag strap is visible, and the background is filled with soft, glowing nighttime light spots and stars. Next to him is a vertically shaped Japanese speech bubble with the text "Demo... I regret it." A flat, square gray overlay obscures the center of his face. At the bottom of the right page, a rectangular sidebar contains the Japanese text "Talent ni Dehuitteshimatta." The layout of the printed manga pages is shown, with white margins. Page numbers 17 and 18 are centered at the bottom of the left and right pages, presenting a neat book-like double-page effect. Maintaining an overall grayscale tone, the style is dramatic, introspective, and as refined as a published comic book volume.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张具有电影感和忧郁基调的黑白漫画双页跨页，采用高细节的青年漫画风格绘制，包含写实的灯光效果、湿润路面的倒影、密集的架空电线，以及宁静的日本住宅街道上空繁星点点的夜空。整个跨页共分为 4 个分镜。左页上方分镜为深夜空旷郊区街道的广角建立镜头，街道两旁是低矮的房屋、围墙、电线杆、发光的街灯，以及向远处延伸的略带反光的道路。左页下方分镜展示了 1 名少年从背后看去的背影，他独自走在同一条街道上，身穿深色校服西装外套、白衬衫、松开的条纹领带、修身长裤，背着 1 个斜挎包；他的姿态显得疲惫且内心矛盾。在此分镜中加入 1 个竖向椭圆形的日语对话气泡，文字为「やっぱり俺には」。右页上方分镜为少年手部特写，他紧张地抓着西装外套或衬衫前襟，旁边配有 1 个手绘日语拟声词「ギュッ…」。右页下方分镜为同一少年在户外夜晚的胸部以上正面肖像，凌乱的浅色短发，校服略显凌乱，表情充满情感，可见斜挎包带，背景充满柔和发光的夜间光斑和星星。在他身旁放置 1 个竖向椭圆形的日语对话气泡，文字为「でも…悔しい」。用一个平面的方形灰色遮挡块遮住他脸部的中心位置。在右页底部，添加 1 个矩形旁白框，包含日语文字「才能に出会ってしまったー」。展示印刷漫画页面的排版，带有白色页边距，左页和右页底部居中位置标有页码 17 和 18，呈现整洁的书籍跨页效果。保持整体为灰度色调，风格戏剧化、内省且如同已出版漫画卷册般精致。

titleLocalized.zh: 灰度漫画少年进入音乐工作室

templates.title: Black and white comic style guitar studio page

titleLocalized.zh: 黑白漫画风格吉他工作室页面

templates.prompt: A black-and-white comic strip spread with a pure white background and thin black lines separating the columns. It employs a highly detailed, modern shonen/shoujo manga style with mixed line work, complemented by soft halftone effects and reflective highlights, creating a quiet and melancholic atmosphere. The scene is set in a music studio classroom at night, with large windows offering views of the brightly lit city skyline. The protagonist is a slender high school girl with long, straight, light-colored hair and bangs. She has delicate features, a serious and introspective expression, and wears a Japanese school uniform (white shirt, loose striped tie, and plaid skirt). She sits playing a solid-body electric guitar resembling a Stratocaster. In the large panel at the top left, a three-quarter profile of her full-body image is displayed. The guitar rests on her lap, her left hand on the fretboard, her right hand near the pickups, surrounded by studio equipment, including a drum kit to the left rear, two stacked guitar amps to the right, and a wall sign next to the door that reads "Beat Box." In the narrow panel at the top right, a close-up of the guitar neck and her fingertips is shown, accompanied by the vertically arranged Japanese onomatopoeic word "トン…". In the high panel at the center of the right, a close-up of the girl's profile is shown; she looks down at her instrument, her expression thoughtful, even slightly disappointed, with blurred city lights outside the window as a background. In the panel at the bottom left, a boy in a school uniform suit with a loose tie is shown sitting indoors, his body slightly turned to the side; his face is obscured by a large light gray rectangle, next to which is a vertical speech bubble containing the Japanese text "…やっぱり違う". In the panel at the bottom right, a close-up of the same boy from the chest up is shown, with a softly blurred halftone background; his face is also obscured by a large gray block. Printed page numbers are added in the center of the bottom margins: "5" at the bottom left and "6" at the bottom right. This emphasizes a subtle narrative theme: the realization that the sound is off, as if this were a sequel to a school band-themed manga. Maintain an overall black-and-white aesthetic, refinement, cinematic feel, and emotional restraint.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张黑白漫画跨页，背景为纯白，分栏间距为细黑线，采用高度精细的现代青年/少女漫画混合线条风格，配以柔和的网点纸效果、反光高光，营造出一种安静而忧郁的氛围。场景设定在夜间的音乐工作室教室，巨大的窗户可以看到窗外灯火通明的城市天际线。主角：一名身材苗条的高中女生，留着长直浅色头发和齐刘海，五官精致，表情严肃且内省，身穿日本校服（白色衬衫、松开的条纹领带和格子裙），坐着弹奏一把类似 Stratocaster 的实心电吉他。在左上角的大分格中，展示她四分之三侧面的全身像，吉他横放在膝盖上，左手按在指板上，右手靠近拾音器，周围环绕着工作室设备，包括左后方的一套架子鼓、右侧堆叠的两个吉他音箱，以及门旁写着“Beat Box”的墙面标志。在右上角的窄分格中，展示吉他琴颈和她按弦手的特写，配有竖排的日文拟声词“トン…”。在右侧中间的高分格中，展示女孩侧脸的近景特写，她低头看着乐器，表情沉思，甚至带着一丝失望，窗外模糊的城市灯光作为背景。在左下角的分格中，展示 1 名身穿校服西装、领带松开的少年，坐在室内，身体微微侧转；他的脸被一个巨大的浅灰色矩形遮挡，旁边有一个竖排对话气泡，内含日文文本“……やっぱり違う”。在右下角的分格中，展示同一名少年从胸部以上的近景，背景为柔和的虚化网点效果；他的脸同样被一个巨大的灰色遮挡块遮住。在底部页边距居中处添加印刷页码：左页下方为“5”，右页下方为“6”。强调一种微妙的叙事主题，即意识到声音不对劲，仿佛这是某部校园乐队题材漫画的后续页面。保持整体黑白、精致、电影感且情感克制。

templates.title: Special Feature in Japanese Magazine "Elephant Day"

titleLocalized.zh: 日本“象之日”杂志专题

templates.prompt: Create a soft, elegant Japanese lifestyle magazine editorial page using a warm, botanical watercolor style. The layout is an A4 portrait full-page design with a cream-colored paper background, a thin beige border, soft sage green accents, and a refined natural theme. The page features a cohesive magazine spread design with six distinct content sections: a large main illustration panel on the left, a long, rectangular title and article section in the upper right, three stacked information boxes from the center right to the bottom right, two small photo card-style image panels in the lower left, a circular quote badge near the bottom left of the main panel, and a summary box in the lower right. The theme is Japan's "Elephant Day." In the upper left, a small editorial header reads "LIFESTYLE / FEATURE / TOPIC," with a brief Japanese subtitle below. In the upper right, a striking large date title "4.28 EVENT" and an elegant serif main title "Elephant Day Special" are added, along with a short subtitle and a miniature elephant icon. Below this is a concise Japanese text section, presenting "Elephant Day" in a clean, magazine-style column format. The main illustration panel shows a gentle elephant standing on the left, rendered with delicate watercolors to depict realistic wrinkles, large ears, soft ivory-grey skin, and its trunk drooping towards a child beside it. The child is a gender-neutral anime boy with messy, dark purple-black wavy hair, fair skin, large eyes, wearing a black graphic T-shirt with a purple badge, paired with loose brown knee-length cargo shorts, barefoot, one hand casually in his pocket, the other gently touching the elephant's trunk. The background is a sunny zoo trail with wooden fences, soft green trees, dappled light and shadow, and branches hanging down from above. Near the elephant is a small wooden sign that reads "Elephant 4.28". A circular Japanese text badge is added near the lower left corner of the main image. In the lower left area, two framed snapshot-style panels are placed, using a washi tape scrapbook display style: the first, labeled "Feeding Time," shows a child feeding leaves to an elephant through a fence; the second, labeled "Peaceful Time," shows a child sitting on a wooden bench with an elephant in the background, a tranquil and contemplative scene. Each panel has a brief Japanese description below it. On the right, three information boxes are stacked, each marked "POINT 01," "POINT 02," and "POINT 03" within an olive green circle. Each box has a simple line icon and Japanese text: the first box contains an elephant icon, discussing memory; the second box contains an elephant trunk or face icon, discussing the elephant's large size yet delicate movements; the third box contains a zoo building icon, discussing what can be learned at the zoo. In the lower right corner, a framed summary box is added, with a ribbon-like header "まとめ" (matome), a small elephant silhouette, and two short Japanese summaries. At the bottom edge, there is page number "068", date "APRIL 2025", and a row of walking elephant silhouettes. Subtle botanical patterns, leaves, and light decorative brushstrokes are added throughout the page. The overall atmosphere is gentle, educational, heartwarming, light, natural, family-friendly, and sophisticated, like a high-end seasonal magazine feature.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张柔和、优雅的日式生活方式杂志编辑页面，采用温暖的植物水彩风格。版式为 A4 纵向全页布局，背景为奶油色纸张，配有米色细边框、柔和的鼠尾草绿点缀，以及精致的自然主题设计。页面为一个连贯的杂志跨页设计，包含 6 个不同的内容板块：左侧 1 个大型主插图面板，右上角 1 个长条状标题及文章栏，中右至右下角 3 个堆叠的信息要点框，左下角 2 个小型照片卡片式图像面板，主面板左下角附近 1 个圆形引语徽章，以及右下角 1 个总结框。主题为日本的“象之日”。在左上角，放置小型编辑页眉文字“LIFESTYLE / FEATURE / TOPIC”，下方配有简短的日文副标题。在右上角，添加醒目的大号日期标题“4.28 EVENT”和优雅衬线字体的主标题“象の日特集”，下方配有一行简短的副标题和一个微型大象图标。在其下方，设置 3 段简洁的日文正文，以干净的杂志专栏形式介绍“象之日”。主插图面板展示了一头温顺的大象站在左侧，以细腻的水彩渲染，表现出逼真的皱纹、大耳朵、柔软的象牙灰色皮肤，以及垂向身旁小孩的象鼻。小孩是一位中性风格的动漫男孩，留着凌乱的深紫黑色波浪卷发，皮肤白皙，大眼睛，身穿印有紫色徽章的黑色图案 T 恤，搭配宽松的棕色及膝工装短裤，赤着脚，一只手随意插在口袋里，另一只手轻轻触碰大象的鼻子。背景是阳光明媚的动物园步道，有木栅栏、柔和的绿树、斑驳的光影以及从上方垂下的枝叶。在大象附近，包含一个写有“Elephant 4.28”的小木牌。在主图左下角附近添加一个日文圆形文字徽章。在左下区域，放置 2 个带边框的快照式面板，采用胶带粘贴的剪贴簿展示风格：第一个标注为“Feeding Time”，展示小孩侧身隔着栅栏给大象喂食树叶；第二个标注为“Peaceful Time”，展示小孩侧身坐在木长椅上，背景是大象，场景宁静沉思。每个小面板下方都有简短的日文说明。在右侧，堆叠 3 个信息框，橄榄绿圆圈内分别标注“POINT 01”、“POINT 02”和“POINT 03”，每个框配有简单的线条图标和日文文字：第 1 个框包含大象图标，讨论记忆力；第 2 个框包含象鼻或象脸图标，讨论大象体型虽大却动作细腻；第 3 个框包含动物园建筑图标，讨论在动物园可以学到的知识。在右下角，添加 1 个带边框的总结框，配有丝带状页眉“まとめ”、一个小象剪影和 2 段简短的日文总结。在底部边缘，包含页码“068”、日期“APRIL 2025”以及一排行走的小象剪影。在整个页面中添加细微的植物花纹、叶片和轻盈的装饰笔触。整体氛围：温柔、教育性、暖心、轻盈、自然、亲子友好且精致，如同高端季节性杂志专题。

templates.title: Retro comic book style dating guide cover

titleLocalized.zh: 复古漫画风恋爱指南封面

templates.prompt: This is a retro 1980s Japanese manga magazine cover illustration, featuring faded paper texture, a slightly grainy print, and warm vintage ink tones. The composition is crowded yet playful, with a deep blue-purple background adorned with fluffy pink clouds and floating pink hearts. A large Japanese title in a striking hand-drawn font is located in the upper left corner, containing the following text:{argument name="headline text" default="A dangerous guide to romance"} Below is a smaller subtitle (Love Life). In the center of the image, a tall, delinquent-looking high school boy in a dark blue school uniform points one finger at the viewer, exuding confidence and charm. To his right, a sweet, manga-style high school girl with a short, dark brown bob, sparkling eyes, and a cream-colored sailor uniform with a pink collar and bow, looks up in surprise and admiration. In the lower left, a gothic Lolita-style girl with light purple twin tails, black ribbon accessories, and an elegant black and pink ruffled skirt covers her mouth with her hands, blushing shyly. At the bottom center is a fluffy black toy poodle wearing a mint blue polka-dot scarf, facing forward with a cute expression and its tongue slightly sticking out. In the upper right corner, a Cupid girl with black pigtails, white wings, a pink pleated skirt, white socks, and flower hair accessories is flying while reading a pink book with a heart-shaped cover. In the upper right background, a bespectacled male student is panicked, clutching his head with his hands, his eyes bulging exaggeratedly, creating a comedic effect. Near the middle right background stands a mature woman in warm orange clothing, partially obscured by the two main characters. On the far right is a dramatic villainous queen, wearing a glossy black armor-like corset, long black gloves, a high-necked cloak with a red lining, and a golden crown, posing with one hand raised. In the lower right corner, a huge open book extends diagonally into the frame, as if all the characters have stepped out of the book. The design employs dynamic comic book cover composition, exaggerated expressions, a romantic comedic atmosphere, hand-drawn cel animation shadows, and a retro weekly magazine poster design.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张 1980 年代复古日式漫画杂志封面插图，带有褪色的纸张质感、轻微的颗粒印刷感以及温暖的复古墨水色调。构图拥挤而俏皮，背景为深蓝紫色，点缀着蓬松的粉色云朵和漂浮的粉色爱心。左上角是一个巨大的日文标题，采用醒目的手绘字体，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="危険な恋愛手引書"}，下方配有较小的副标题（ラブ・バイブル）。画面中央，一名身材高挑、不良少年风格的男高中生身穿深色学兰校服，单手指向观众，神情自信且充满魅力。在他右侧中心，是一位甜美的少女漫画风格女高中生，留着深棕色短波波头，有着闪闪发光的大眼睛，身穿奶油色水手服，系着粉色领子和蝴蝶结，正惊讶而崇拜地抬头仰望。左下方坐着 1 位哥特萝莉风格少女，留着淡紫色双马尾，佩戴黑色丝带饰品，身穿精致的黑粉色荷叶边裙，双手捂嘴，害羞地脸红。底部中央是 1 只毛茸茸的黑色玩具贵宾犬，系着薄荷蓝波点围巾，正面向前方，表情可爱，舌头微微吐出。右上侧，1 位小丘比特女孩扎着黑色双马尾，背着白色翅膀，身穿粉色百褶裙，穿着白袜，戴着花朵发饰，正一边飞行一边阅读一本封面上印有爱心的粉色书。右上角背景中，1 位戴眼镜的男学生惊慌失措，双手抱头，眼睛夸张地凸起，充满喜剧效果。中右侧背景附近站着 1 位穿着暖橙色服装、风情万种的成熟女性，被主角二人组部分遮挡。最右侧是 1 位戏剧性的反派女王，身穿光泽感的黑色盔甲式束胸衣，戴着黑色长手套，披着红色内衬的高领斗篷，头戴金冠，单手抬起摆出姿势。右下角，一本巨大的打开的书斜向伸入画面，仿佛所有角色都是从书中走出来的。采用动态漫画封面构图、夸张的表情、浪漫喜剧氛围、手绘赛璐珞动画阴影以及怀旧周刊杂志海报设计。

templates.title: Cyber ​​AI Webinar Thumbnail

titleLocalized.zh: Cyber AI 网络研讨会缩略图

templates.prompt: Create a cool Japanese-style YouTube thumbnail with a dark, futuristic cyberpunk aesthetic. Use a 16:9 landscape orientation and a deep navy to black background filled with glowing blue circuit board patterns, interconnected network nodes, tiny digital cubes, and electrical lines. Place a small white Japanese title at the top center with the text:{argument name="headline text" default="New common sense in the AI ​​era that doesn't rely on intuition"} At the center, a large double-line Japanese title is added, using a metallic silver-white beveled font with a strong neon blue outer glow, and lightning effects interspersed behind and inside the letters. The content is {argument name="main title" default="Complete Guide to AI Tools"} Below the main title, a black banner with thin gold trim and white serif Japanese text is placed, containing the following:{argument name="subheadline text" default="Claude Code Commentary LIVE Tonight at 9:00 PM"} On the right, a cute chibi-style sheep mascot stands on a glowing blue circular platform. It has fluffy light blue and pale purple fur, small horns, simple dotted eyes, a neutral expression, and a purple-blue halo around its silhouette. It holds a short stick, and a red-orange flame halo surrounds its body. At the bottom, three glowing, futuristic rounded rectangular panels with blue neon borders and dark interiors are placed evenly from left to right. The left panel contains a white head with circuit icons and Japanese text.{argument name="bottom left label" default="From AI generation to the next stage of evolution"} The middle panel contains a white upward trend chart icon and the text "AI de branding". The right panel contains a white group icon with a gear icon and the text "Humans and AI also move" (人もAIも動かす戦略). High contrast, glossy metallic text effects, layered blue outline lighting, vibrant lightning, and subtle lens flare create a sophisticated and impactful webinar thumbnail aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个炫酷的日式 YouTube 缩略图，采用深色未来赛博科技风格，16:9 横向构图，深海军蓝至黑色的背景中布满了发光的蓝色电路板图案、连接的网络节点、微小的数字方块和电能线条。在顶部中心位置，放置一个白色的小型日语标题，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="センスに頼らないAI時代の新常識"}。在中心位置，添加一个巨大的双行日语标题，采用金属银白色斜面字体，带有强烈的霓虹蓝外发光，字母背后和内部穿插着闪电效果，内容为 {argument name="main title" default="AIツール 完全攻略"}。在主标题下方，放置一个带有细金边和白色衬线日语文本的黑色横幅，内容为 {argument name="subheadline text" default="Claude Code 解説LIVE 本日21:00〜"}。在右侧，加入 1 个可爱的 Q 版绵羊吉祥物，它站在一个发光的蓝色圆形平台上，拥有蓬松的浅蓝色和淡紫色毛发、小角、简单的圆点眼睛，表情中性，轮廓带有紫蓝色光晕，手持一根短棍，身体后方环绕着红橙色的火焰光环。在底部，放置 3 个发光的未来感圆角矩形面板，带有蓝色霓虹边框和深色内饰，从左到右均匀排列。左侧面板包含 1 个白色头部与电路图标，以及日语文本 {argument name="bottom left label" default="AI生成から次へ進化"}。中间面板包含 1 个白色上升趋势图图标和文本“AIでブランディング”。右侧面板包含 1 个白色群组与齿轮图标和文本“人もAIも動かす戦略”。使用极高的对比度、光泽金属文字效果、分层蓝色轮廓光、充满活力的闪电、微妙的镜头光晕，打造高级且极具冲击力的网络研讨会缩略图美学。

templates.title: Shining Gold AI Monetization Theme Thumbnail

titleLocalized.zh: 闪耀金色 AI 变现主题缩略图

templates.prompt: Create a luxurious black and gold-themed Japanese-style YouTube thumbnail, focusing on monetization with a strong visual impact, aiming to create a viral, celebratory, and high-value feel. Use a deep black background, complemented by intense gold light, glitter particles, starlight, lens flare, and firework lines radiating outwards from the center. Scatter shimmering gold confetti throughout the image. Place stacked, tilted Japanese yen banknotes in the lower left and right corners of the background, giving them a semi-transparent texture under gold light. Place a large, embossed, metallic gold Japanese title in the center of the image, featuring thick 3D beveled edges, strong highlights, black shadows, and a high-end foil texture. The top title should read "フォロワー100人未満でも" (Following in the example of "100人未満でも"), in bold white Japanese with a dark outline, centered at the top. The main text in the center should be "Image Generation" (upper line) and "Monthly 1,000,000" (lower line, largest font), both in large, gold 3D serif Japanese characters, with "100" particularly prominent and extra-large. Below, add a wide black banner with gold trim and elegant decorative corners, containing the subtitle "0 kara no jiku wo juen kōkai ・ reenactment possibility medsudd," in white text, with "juen kōkai" highlighted in gold. At the bottom, three black and gold rounded rectangular label panels are arranged horizontally, with ornate gold borders and subtle lighting effects. The left panel contains a gold upward trend chart icon and the text "jiku skō kōkai." The middle panel contains a gold map location icon and the text "0→100 rodo map." The right panel contains a gold rocket icon and the text "imo suguru fuji" (meaning "the method to begin now"). Add small laurel leaves or decorative gold patterns around these bottom panels. Place a cute, chibi-style sheep mascot on the right side of the composition, with fluffy light blue wool, cream horns and ears, a simple and neutral expression, a small body, and holding a red open book labeled "BOOK". The mascot should slightly obscure the right side of the main text area and have a clear outline to make it stand out from the shimmering background. The overall composition should have extremely high contrast, rich gold saturation, a glossy finish, and abundant detail, optimized into a striking social media thumbnail that instantly conveys the message of wealth, success, and AI-generated image monetization.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张奢华黑金风格的日系 YouTube 缩略图，主打变现主题，视觉冲击力强，旨在打造病毒式传播、庆典感及高价值感。使用深黑色背景，辅以强烈的金色光芒、闪光颗粒、星光、镜头光晕以及从中心向外辐射的烟花线条。在整个画面中散布闪亮的金色纸屑。在左下角和右下角背景处放置堆叠倾斜的日元钞票，使其在金色灯光下呈现半隐半现的质感。画面中心放置巨大的浮雕金属质感金色日文标题，采用厚实的 3D 斜面边缘、强高光、黑色阴影及高级箔面纹理。顶部标题应为“フォロワー100人未満でも”，使用粗体白色日文并带有深色描边，居中置于顶部。中间主要文字应为“画像生成で”（上行）和“月100万”（下行最大字体），均采用巨大的金色 3D 衬线体日文字符，其中“100”需特别突出且超大。下方添加一条带有金色饰边和优雅装饰角的宽幅黑色横幅，内含副标题“0からの実績を完全公開・再現可能メソッド”，文字为白色，其中“完全公開”需以金色高亮显示。底部水平排列 3 个黑金配色的圆角矩形标注面板，带有华丽的金色边框和微弱光效。左侧面板包含金色上升趋势图表图标及文字“実績スクショ公開”。中间面板包含金色地图定位图标及文字“0→100ロードマップ”。右侧面板包含金色火箭图标及文字“今すぐ始める方法”。在这些底部面板周围添加小型月桂叶或装饰性金色花纹。在构图右侧放置一只可爱的 Q 版绵羊吉祥物，拥有蓬松的浅蓝色羊毛、奶油色羊角和耳朵，表情简约中性，身体小巧，手中拿着一本标有“BOOK”字样的红色开卷。吉祥物应略微遮挡主文字区域的右侧，并带有清晰的轮廓，使其从闪烁的背景中脱颖而出。整体构图需具备极高的对比度、浓郁的金色饱和度、光泽感及丰富的细节，优化为一张能瞬间传达财富、成功与 AI 图像生成变现信息的醒目社交媒体缩略图。

templates.title: Romantic cottage window garden scene

titleLocalized.zh: 浪漫小屋窗台花园场景

templates.prompt: A dreamlike, romantic illustration depicts a young woman peering out of an open cottage window, perfectly highlighting the contrast between the sun-drenched garden outside and the cozy interior. She rests her elbows on the white windowsill, her hands supporting her chin, positioned at the center of the composition, her face partially obscured by her pose and hair. She has very long, light brown, wavy hair adorned with small white flowers, and wears a soft, vintage-style cream-beige floral dress with puff sleeves and delicate lace trim. The white wooden double windows open outwards, flanked by sheer lace curtains that sway gently in the breeze. The exterior walls, white brick or stucco, are covered in vines, and numerous small white flowers encircle the top and sides of the windows. In the foreground, a lush spring garden unfolds, featuring five floral arrangements: pale pink tulips, creamy white tulips, white daisies with yellow centers, delicate lavender spikes, and layers of pale pink garden roses or peonies, with a low white fence faintly visible at the bottom edge. Through the window, the interior space is clearly visible: a warm, softly lit, quaint, and charming room in a gentle beige tone. Botanical specimens adorn the walls, and vases and fresh flowers fill the wooden cabinets and shelves. A delicate pendant lamp hangs in the background. Soft morning light illuminates the room, with vines casting soft shadows on the walls and windowsills. The light pastel tones create a highly detailed, anime-realistic style, evoking an ethereal floral fantasy and a tranquil, nostalgic atmosphere. The composition is vertical.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅梦幻般的浪漫插画，描绘了一位年轻女性从敞开的小屋窗户向外探出，完美突显了室外阳光明媚的花园与室内舒适房间之间的对比。她双肘靠在白色窗台上，双手托腮，位于构图中心，面部被姿势和头发遮住。她留着一头非常长的浅棕色波浪卷发，发间点缀着几朵小白花，身穿一件柔和的复古奶油米色碎花裙，配有泡泡袖和精致的蕾丝花边。窗户为白色木质双开窗，向外敞开，两侧挂着轻薄的蕾丝窗帘，随风轻轻飘动。外墙为白色砖墙或灰泥墙，爬满了藤蔓，窗户顶部和两侧环绕着许多小白花。在室外前景中，展现一个郁郁葱葱的春日花园，包含 5 种花卉组合：淡粉色郁金香、奶油白色郁金香、带有黄色花心的白色小雏菊、柔和的薰衣草花穗，以及层叠的淡粉色花园玫瑰或牡丹，底部边缘隐约可见一道矮小的白色栅栏。透过窗户，清晰呈现室内空间：一个温暖、光线柔和的破旧别致风格房间，色调为柔和的米色，墙上挂着植物标本画，木质柜子或架子上摆放着花瓶和鲜花，背景中悬挂着一盏精致的小吊灯。采用柔和的晨光，藤蔓在墙壁和窗台上投下柔和的阴影，色调为轻盈的粉彩，呈现高度细腻的绘画感动漫写实风格，营造出空灵的花卉幻想意境、宁静而怀旧的氛围，采用竖构图。

templates.title: Tropical beach sandcastle statues

titleLocalized.zh: 热带海滩沙堡人像

templates.prompt: A realistic vertical portrait of a woman on a beach, kneeling on light-colored sand building a sandcastle, photographed in bright afternoon natural light with a shallow depth of field. She has long, dark brown hair tied in a high ponytail, a slender figure, and wears a short, dark blue sundress with thin straps, a deep V-neck, and a slightly flared hem. She leans forward playfully and naturally, her hands shaping the sand in front of her. She wears a delicate necklace (with a small pendant) and a simple bracelet. Five sandcastle elements are placed in the foreground: two tall, tower-like sandcastles on the right, two smaller, circular sand mounds in the center, and she holds an unformed block of sand. The background is a tropical beach covered in smooth, beige sand, with turquoise waters to the left, a tree-covered coastline in the distance, palm trees arching overhead, and a thick palm trunk along the right edge. The background features a soft, blurred effect, creating a clean, summer vacation-chic photography style. Skin tones appear natural and realistic, and the shadows of palm leaves cast on her arms and dress, creating a tranquil yet luxurious vacation atmosphere. The composition is a full-body to three-quarter-length portrait, using a vertical format with the subject centered, and the shooting angle is from eye level to slightly upward.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张逼真的海滩竖构图人像，一位年轻女性跪在浅色沙滩上堆沙堡，在明亮的午后自然光下拍摄，具有浅景深效果。她留着深棕色长发，扎成高马尾，身材苗条，身穿一件深蓝色短款太阳裙，带有细吊带、深 V 领和微微展开的裙摆。她以俏皮自然的姿态向前倾身，双手正在塑造面前的沙子。佩戴一条精致的细项链（带有一个小吊坠）和一只简约的手镯。前景中放置 5 个沙堡元素：右侧有 2 座较高的塔状沙堡，中心前方有 2 个较小的圆形沙堆，她手中拿着 1 个尚未成形的沙块。背景是热带海滩，铺满平滑的米色沙子，左侧是绿松石色的海水，远处是覆盖着绿树的海岸线，头顶有棕榈树拱起，右边缘包含 1 根粗壮的棕榈树干。背景采用柔和的虚化效果，呈现干净的夏季度假时尚摄影风格，肤色真实自然，棕榈叶的阴影投射在她的手臂和裙子上，营造出宁静的奢华度假氛围。构图为全身至四分之三的人像，采用竖构图，主体居中，拍摄角度为平视至略微仰视。

templates.title: Realistic female portraits at Japanese bus stops

titleLocalized.zh: 日本公交车站的写实女性肖像

templates.prompt: A realistic street snapshot depicts a young East Asian woman sitting at a sunny, glass-walled bus stop in Japan, shot from a vertical portrait perspective, focusing on her mid-thigh to above. She has dark brown hair tied in a low ponytail with soft side bangs, wears delicate pendant earrings, a white blazer over a fitted white tank top, and a high-waisted navy blue or black pencil skirt. Her relaxed pose, slightly leaning towards the camera with one shoulder close to the lens, conveys a professional and capable image. To her left and behind is a bus route timetable filled with Japanese text and route numbers, including 226, 609, 670, 632, and D32. In the background on the right, a blue city bus with a yellow roof is seen approaching or stopping along the roadside, softly out of focus. The bus shelter features reflective glass panels, a metal frame, and benches, against a backdrop of a sunny sidewalk, tree shadows, and distant city buildings. Utilizing natural midday light, the highlights are sharp, the shadows are soft, and the shallow depth of field reveals realistic skin and fabric textures. It achieves a commercial photography style with high detail and DSLR-like bokeh. The obscured facial areas are replaced with the natural and fully visible face of a charming adult woman, maintaining a calm and natural expression.{argument name="outfit color" default="White suit jacket paired with a white top and a dark skirt"} ,{argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown"} ,{argument name="location" default="Japanese city bus stops"} as well as{argument name="bus color" default="Blue body and yellow roof"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实的街头抓拍照片，画面中是一位年轻的东亚女性，坐在日本一个阳光明媚的玻璃墙公交车站，采用从大腿中部以上的竖构图肖像视角。她留着深棕色头发，扎成低马尾，配有柔和的侧刘海，戴着小巧的吊坠耳环，身穿白色西装外套，内搭合身的白色吊带背心，下身穿着高腰深海军蓝或黑色铅笔裙。她姿态放松，身体略微向镜头倾斜，一侧肩膀靠近镜头，呈现出干练的职场女性形象。她左后方是一个公交路线时刻表项目，上面写满了日文和路线编号，可见数字包括 226、609、670、632 和 合D32。右侧背景中，一辆蓝车身黄车顶的城市公交车正沿路边驶来或停靠，处于柔和的虚焦状态。公交候车亭配有反光玻璃板、金属框架和长椅，背景是阳光明媚的人行道、树影和远处的城市建筑。采用自然的午间光线，高光清晰，阴影柔和，浅景深，呈现真实的皮肤和织物纹理，商业摄影风格，高细节，具备 DSLR 般的虚化效果。将遮挡的面部区域替换为一位迷人成年女性自然且完全可见的面容，表情保持平静自然。使用 {argument name="outfit color" default="白色西装外套搭配白色上衣和深色裙子"}，{argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"}，{argument name="location" default="日本城市公交车站"} 以及 {argument name="bus color" default="蓝车身黄车顶"}。

titleLocalized.zh: 宝可梦风格动漫对战界面

templates.prompt: A dynamic anime-style battle interface, adopting the Pokémon battle opening style, with the screen divided diagonally into two opposing horizontal panels. A large, metallic gold "VS" logo is positioned in the center. The top panel features a bright pink speed line background with a black brushstroke border, while the left side displays {argument name="top character name" default="Rina Tennoji"} An anime girl wearing a blue school uniform jacket, white shirt, and red ribbon leans out from the left, her expression confident. She has short, layered pink hair with curled ends and bright yellow eyes. Floating beside her is a creature resembling Porygon II, its body glowing red and blue, rounded, with oval blue limbs and a round, yellow-and-black eye. The top panel on the right side displays "Rina Tennoji" in bold white lettering. The bottom panel background is a vibrant purple speed line with a black brushstroke border, and the right side displays {argument name="bottom character name" default="Hime Anyoji"} The image depicts an anime girl in a pink hoodie and school uniform, resting her chin on her hand. Her hair is styled in pink double braids tied with dark ribbons. Her face is obscured by a large, solid-colored cover. Floating beside her is a robotic creature resembling a Magneto, metallic silver and blue-gray in color, with a dome-shaped body, a large red eye in the center, a smaller eye on the side, a yellow antenna on top, and horseshoe-shaped magnetic arms on either side, ending in red and blue. The bottom left panel features the words "Hime Anyoji" in bold white lettering. The artwork employs clean anime lines, glossy cel shadows, dramatic dynamic lines, high contrast, and a composition reminiscent of a competitive game opening scene, against a black background. It includes two characters, two monster partners, two name tags, a central VS logo, and a small, stylized white artist signature in the lower left corner.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满动感的动漫对战界面，采用宝可梦对战开场风格，画面沿对角线分割为两个相对的水平面板，中心设有一个巨大的金属质感金色“VS”标志。顶部面板背景为亮粉色速度线，带有黑色笔触边框，左侧展示 {argument name="top character name" default="Rina Tennoji"}，一位身穿蓝色校服外套、白衬衫配红色丝带的动漫少女，从左侧探出身子，表情自信，留着层次感短粉发，发梢外翘，拥有一双明亮的黄色眼睛。她身旁漂浮着 1 只类似多边兽 II 的生物，通体红蓝光泽，身体圆润，带有椭圆形蓝色肢体，以及一只圆形的黄黑配色眼睛。顶部面板右侧以粗体白色描边大字写着“Rina Tennoji”。底部面板背景为鲜艳的紫色速度线，带有黑色笔触边框，右侧展示 {argument name="bottom character name" default="Hime Anyoji"}，一位身穿粉色连帽衫搭配校服的动漫少女，单手托腮，留着粉色双麻花辫发髻，并系有深色蝴蝶结。她的面部被一个大的纯色遮挡块遮住。她身旁漂浮着 1 只类似自爆磁怪的机器人生物，呈金属银色和蓝灰色，圆顶状身体，中心有一只红色大眼，侧面有一只较小的眼睛，顶部带有黄色天线，两侧为马蹄形磁铁手臂，末端为红蓝色。底部面板左侧以粗体白色描边大字写着“Hime Anyoji”。采用清晰的动漫线条、光泽感赛璐珞阴影、戏剧性的动态线条、高对比度，以及竞技游戏开场画面的构图，背景为黑色。包含 2 位角色、2 只怪兽搭档、2 个名称标签、1 个中心 VS 标志，以及左下角一个小的白色风格化艺术家签名。

templates.title: Shikishi's Signed Marker Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: Shikishi 签名马克笔肖像

templates.prompt: A vibrant, hand-drawn fashion portrait, employing a varied illustration style, presents the effect of a signature fan art sketch drawn with markers on a square white Shikishi project with thin gold trim. It depicts a stylish young woman, framed from the waist up, leaning slightly forward, one elbow close to her face, in a relaxed and friendly pose. Her face is covered by a simple rectangular masking block in soft beige. She has medium-length brown hair with warm highlights, a soft, voluminous style, side-swept bangs, and outward-curling ends. The image utilizes expressive black ink outlines, crisp marker strokes, watercolor-like washes, sketch-like shading, and a vibrant, lively hand-drawn texture. She wears a fitted dark gray ribbed long-sleeved knit top with subtle puff sleeves, layered with delicate gold necklaces, and dangling pearl earrings. A beige crossbody bag strap is slung across her chest, and a light beige skirt or dress is visible at the waist. A clean white background surrounds the figure. Two small glitter doodles are added on the left. Add a handwritten Japanese thank-you message and signature-style black ink lettering around the portrait: write in the upper right corner.{argument name="top message" default="ありがとう！"} Add an underline and a small heart; place a large, stylized signature below it.{argument name="signature name" default="Yui"} It includes a smiley face and a heart; and writes in the bottom left corner.{argument name="side message" default="Thank you for always supporting me ♡"} Write the date in the bottom right corner.{argument name="date" default="2024.5.20"} Add another heart. The overall image should convey a warm, personalized, and vibrant feel, like a celebratory signature illustration drawn on a square signature item.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅生动的手绘时尚肖像，采用多变的插画风格，呈现出在带有金色细边的方形白色 Shikishi 项目上用马克笔绘制的签名粉丝艺术草图效果。展示一位时尚的年轻女性，腰部以上构图，身体微微前倾，一只手肘靠近脸部，姿态休闲友好。她的面部区域被一个柔和米色的简单矩形遮挡块覆盖。她留着中长棕色头发，带有暖色挑染，发型蓬松柔软，侧分刘海，发梢外翻。画面采用富有表现力的黑色墨水轮廓、清晰的马克笔笔触、水彩般的晕染、素描阴影以及充满活力、生动的手绘质感。她身穿修身深灰色罗纹长袖针织衫，肩部有细微的泡泡袖设计，叠戴精致的金项链，佩戴吊坠珍珠耳环，一条米色斜挎包带斜跨过胸前，腰部可见浅米色裙子或连衣裙。人物周围留出充足的干净白色背景。在左侧添加 2 个小型闪光涂鸦。在肖像周围添加手写的日文感谢信息和签名风格的黑色墨水字迹：在右上角书写 {argument name="top message" default="ありがとう！"} 并加上下划线和一个小爱心；在其下方放置一个大的风格化签名 {argument name="signature name" default="Yui"}，并附带一个笑脸符号和一颗爱心；在左下角书写 {argument name="side message" default="いつも応援してくれてありがとう♡"}；在右下角书写日期 {argument name="date" default="2024.5.20"} 并加上另一颗爱心。整体图像应呈现出温暖、个性化、生动的感觉，如同在方形签名项目上绘制的庆祝性签名插画。

templates.title: Oil pastel style anime catgirl

titleLocalized.zh: 油画棒风格动漫猫娘

templates.prompt: A cute anime catgirl is crouching playfully in a handmade oil pastel illustration drawn on textured off-white paper. She has long, straight hair.{argument name="hair color" default="Deep purple, with light lavender tips."} She has a pair of large, pointed orange cat ears on her head, and a striped orange and black cat tail extending from her right side. She wears a tiger-themed bodysuit with a bright, vibrant color scheme.{argument name="outfit color" default="Bright orange"} She is adorned with striking black accents: long, fitted sleeves, a deep black chest and torso, orange legs and gloves, and soft, pale pink patches on her hips and upper thighs. She is crouching, one knee raised, one hand touching the ground in front of her, the other raised to her forehead in a salute, facing the viewer with a playful and energetic air. The entire image uses rough, pastel strokes, with a distinct graininess, uneven sketch-like black outlines, doodle-like color fills, and a childlike, simulated texture. A warm pastel palette is used, with orange as the main color, complemented by purple hair, a background with soft pink doodle shadows, and purple-blue doodle shadows at her feet. The composition maintains a centered full-body character on the paper, with a fantastical, captivating, and slightly chaotic style, like an expressive pastel doodle, irresistibly cute.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个可爱的动漫猫娘正以俏皮的姿势低蹲，画面呈现为在带有纹理的米白色纸张上绘制的手工油画棒插画。她留着长直发，{argument name="hair color" default="深紫色，发梢带有浅薰衣草色"}，头顶有一对尖尖的橙色大猫耳，右侧伸出一条橙黑相间的条纹猫尾。她身穿一套老虎主题的紧身衣，主色调为鲜艳的 {argument name="outfit color" default="亮橙色"}，并配有醒目的黑色装饰：长袖修身设计，胸部和躯干为深黑色，腿部和手套为橙色，臀部及大腿上部带有柔软的淡粉色补丁。她呈蹲姿，一膝抬起，一只手触碰身前地面，另一只手举至额头前敬礼，面向观众，展现出调皮且充满活力的感觉。整张图像采用粗糙的油画棒笔触，具有明显的颗粒感、不均匀的草图式黑色轮廓、涂鸦式的色彩填充以及充满童趣的模拟质感。使用温暖的粉彩调色板，以橙色为主色调，搭配紫色头发，背景带有柔和的粉色涂鸦阴影，脚下有紫蓝色的涂鸦阴影。构图保持为纸张上居中的全身角色，风格奇幻、迷人、略显凌乱，像是一幅充满表现力的油画棒涂鸦，可爱得令人难以抗拒。

templates.title: Cute oil pastel female portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱的油画棒女性肖像

templates.prompt: A soft and charming oil pastel portrait illustration of a woman seated indoors, drawn in a handmade crayon style with distinct waxy strokes, bold sketch lines, and subtle paper texture. The image shows her seated with her upper body slightly bent forward, one elbow resting on her knee, and the other hand supporting her cheek, creating a relaxed and natural atmosphere. Designed for her.{argument name="hair color" default="Medium chestnut brown"} Her shoulder-length hair was parted in the middle, with slightly curled ends and a few wispy strands framing her face. She was wearing a {argument name="sweater color" default="Soft gray"} A chunky knit sweater, paired with a{argument name="skirt color" default="warm beige"} A high-waisted midi skirt. Add two pieces of jewelry: a dangling earring visible on the right, and a delicate necklace with a small pendant. Add a small crossbody bag with a thin strap draped across the torso, the bag hanging near the waist. Use a warm, neutral color scheme of cream, beige, gray, brown, and soft charcoal, with subtle ochre highlights. Keep facial features simple, presented softly in the same pastel style, creating an overall sweet, warm, and very cute atmosphere. The background is a simple off-white interior space, with a wide horizontal gray band behind the main subject, hinting at a bench or wall decoration, with scattered beige and gray graffiti shadows on the floor and walls. Emphasize the charm of pastel drawing: imperfect edges, layered colors, dry-rubbed crayon texture, and a light sketchbook aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅柔和、可爱的油画棒女性室内坐姿肖像插画，采用手工蜡笔风格绘制，带有明显的蜡质笔触、粗犷的草图线条和轻微的纸张纹理。画面呈现她从大腿以上的部分，呈微微前倾的坐姿，一只手肘靠在膝盖上，另一只手托着脸颊，营造出一种随性自然的氛围。为她设计 {argument name="hair color" default="中栗棕色"} 的中分齐肩发，发尾微翘，有几缕碎发修饰脸型。让她穿着一件 {argument name="sweater color" default="柔和灰色"} 的粗棒针织毛衣，搭配一条 {argument name="skirt color" default="暖米色"} 的高腰半身裙。添加 2 件首饰：右侧可见一只垂坠耳环，以及一条带有小吊坠的精致项链。添加 1 个小型斜挎包，细肩带斜跨过躯干，包身垂在腰部附近。使用奶油色、米色、灰色、棕色和柔和炭色的暖色调中性配色，并带有淡淡的赭石色高光。面部特征保持简约，以同样的油画棒风格柔和呈现，整体氛围甜美、温馨且非常可爱。背景为简单的米白色室内空间，主体后方有一条宽阔的水平灰色带，暗示长椅或墙面装饰，地面和墙壁上有零星的米色和灰色涂鸦阴影。强调油画棒绘画的魅力：不完美的边缘、层叠的色彩、干擦蜡笔质感以及轻盈的速写本美学。

templates.title: Cute anime girl in oil pastel style

titleLocalized.zh: 油画棒风格可爱动漫少女

templates.prompt: A cute, hand-drawn anime girl illustration in the style of oil pastels, drawn on textured paper, featuring distinct crayon strokes, rough sketch outlines, and soft color blending. The main subject is a girl, with {argument name="hair color" default="black"} She had a chin-length bob with loose bangs, bright eyes, and rosy cheeks, and was gazing gently upwards to the left with a soft smile. She sat relaxed on the floor, one leg bent and raised, the other extended forward, her arms casually resting on her raised knee. She was wearing a bright {argument name="hoodie color" default="red"} hoodie,{argument name="shorts color" default="blue"} Shorts, black knee-high socks, and white sneakers with black stripes. The overall style is warm, charming, and playful, emphasizing the texture of oil pastels, the granular layers of paint, the discontinuous brushstrokes, and the slightly messy, childlike crayon drawing feel. The composition is a full-body portrait, located slightly to the left of the center of the image. The background is a simple abstract design, composed of wide diagonal crayon doodles in gray-blue, lavender gray, and beige. The paper background is off-white, with no complex scenes or superfluous objects.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张手绘油画棒风格的可爱动漫少女插画，绘于纹理纸张上，带有明显的蜡笔笔触、粗犷的草图轮廓和柔和的色彩融合。主体为一名少女，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"} 的齐下巴波波头，配有松散的刘海，拥有闪亮的大眼睛、红润的脸颊，正带着温柔的微笑向左上方凝视。她以放松的侧姿坐在地上，一条腿弯曲抬起，另一条腿向前伸展，双臂随意地搭在抬起的膝盖上。她穿着一件明亮的 {argument name="hoodie color" default="红色"} 连帽衫、{argument name="shorts color" default="蓝色"} 短裤、黑色过膝袜和带有黑色条纹的白色运动鞋。整体风格温暖、迷人且俏皮，强调油画棒的触感、颗粒状的颜料堆叠、断续的笔触以及略显凌乱的童趣蜡笔画感。构图为全身像，位于画面中心偏左位置，背景为简单的抽象设计，由灰蓝色、薰衣草灰和米色的宽大对角线蜡笔涂鸦组成，纸张底色为米白色，无复杂场景，无多余物体。

templates.title: Cute oil pastel style female student portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱油画棒风格女学生肖像

templates.prompt: A cute anime style{argument name="character type" default="Japanese female student"} Presented as a handmade oil pastel illustration on textured paper, it is a half-length portrait, centered in composition. She has{argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown"} Her hair was styled in two low, wavy pigtails, parted in the middle and adorned with small, dark hair ties, clearly showing her ears. Most of her face was covered by a large, vertical, skin-toned rectangular veil, positioned in the center of her face and extending from her forehead to her chin, revealing only her hair, ears, jawline, and a small portion of her neck. She wore a light beige school uniform jacket over a white ruffled blouse with lace trim at the collar and cuffs, and a deep red bow around her neck. Her right hand was clenched into a small fist and held near her chin, a shy, cute, and encouraging gesture. The background was entirely filled with rough, diagonal pink crayon doodles on warm, off-white paper. The emphasis on the heavy, waxy texture of the pastels, the visible paper grain, the soft color transitions, the broken strokes, the sketch-like outlines, the charming yet imperfect handmade crayon quality, and the soft, warm lighting created a nostalgic and incredibly cute atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张可爱的动漫风格 {argument name="character type" default="日本女学生"}，以纹理纸张上的手工油画棒插画形式呈现，半身肖像，居中构图。她有着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 的头发，扎成两个带有柔和波浪感的低双马尾，中分发型，配有小型深色发圈，耳朵清晰可见。她的脸部大部分被一个巨大的垂直肤色矩形遮挡块覆盖，该遮挡块位于脸部中央，从额头延伸至下巴，仅露出头发、耳朵、下颌边缘和少许颈部。她身穿浅米色校服外套，内搭白色荷叶边衬衫，领口和袖口饰有蕾丝般的褶边，颈部系着深红色蝴蝶结。她的右手握成小拳头举在下巴附近，呈现出害羞、可爱且加油的姿势。背景完全填满了温暖的米白色纸张上粗糙的对角线粉色蜡笔涂鸦。强调厚重的蜡质油画棒质感、可见的纸张纹理、柔和的色彩过渡、断续的色块笔触、素描般的轮廓线、迷人且不完美的手工蜡笔画质感、柔和的暖光，营造出怀旧且极具可爱感的氛围。

templates.title: Snowy sky with Japanese handwritten font

titleLocalized.zh: 带有日文手写字体的雪景天空

templates.prompt: This is an emotionally charged square winter photograph, gazing directly at a somber, gray-blue sky where snow is falling. It's surrounded by tall, leafless trees, their dark, bare branches extending inwards from the edges to form a circular canopy. Snowflakes of varying sizes are scattered throughout the frame; large, softly blurred snowflakes are closer in, while smaller, clearer snowflakes dot the distance, creating a dreamlike sense of depth. At the bottom edge, silhouettes of shorter winter trees can be seen, and a warm, amber-colored streetlamp faintly shines through in the lower right corner, while the rest of the image retains the cold, soft, and dim tones of dusk or twilight. In the center of the image, superimposed is a large, emotionally expressive white Japanese calligraphy font, the characters slightly irregular yet natural, containing the following text:{argument name="quote" default="This season is coming again."} It features a realistic handwritten feel, soft edges, moderate stroke variation, and is distributed in a casual line break pattern in the center of the sky. It emphasizes a melancholic nostalgia, a poetic Japanese winter atmosphere, cinematic minimalism, realistic photography, and a realistic handwritten font that blends perfectly with the falling snow.

promptLocalized.zh: 这是一张充满情绪感的方形冬季照片，视角直视阴沉的灰蓝色天空，此时正下着雪。四周被高大的无叶树木环绕，深色的光秃枝干从边缘向内延伸，形成了一个圆形的树冠。大小不一的雪花散落在整个画面中，镜头近处有一些大而柔和的模糊雪花，而远处则散布着许多细小清晰的雪花，营造出梦幻般的空间深度。在最底部的边缘，可以看到较矮的冬季树木剪影，右下角隐约透出温暖的琥珀色路灯光，而画面的其余部分则保持着黄昏或傍晚时分那种寒冷、柔和且昏暗的色调。在画面中央，叠加了巨大的、富有情感表现力的白色日文毛笔手写字体，字迹略显不规则且自然，内容为 {argument name="quote" default="また、この季節がやってくる。"}，具有真实的人工手写感、柔和的边缘、适度的笔触变化，并以随意的换行方式分布在天空中央。强调忧郁的怀旧感、诗意的日本冬季氛围、电影感极简主义、写实摄影，以及与降雪完美融合的真实手写字体。

templates.title: Autumn leaves with handwritten Japanese characters

titleLocalized.zh: 带有手写日语文字的秋叶

templates.prompt: A warm, shallow depth-of-field autumn photograph. Bright golden sunlight spills onto a dark asphalt road, scattering numerous maple leaves. The leaves are predominantly yellow, orange, and amber, with a striking bright orange leaf in the foreground and several yellow leaves extending diagonally into the distance. The camera is positioned at a low, close-up angle, with the focus clearly on the leaves in the central foreground, while the background and very close foreground exhibit a soft bokeh effect. In the center of the image, a delicate white handwritten Japanese text is superimposed, written in a fine brushstroke style, with slightly irregular and expressive strokes. The text reads:{argument name="overlay text" default="It's cold again today."} Natural outdoor light, a warm seasonal atmosphere, realistic textures, high contrast between sunlight-drenched leaves and rough pavement, square composition, and poetic social media aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张温暖、浅景深的秋季摄影作品，明亮的金色阳光洒在深色沥青路面上，散落着多片枫叶。叶片以黄色、橙色和琥珀色为主，左前方有一片醒目的亮橙色叶子，几片黄叶向远处呈对角线延伸。相机处于低角度近摄位置，焦点清晰地落在中央前景的叶片上，背景和极近前景呈现出柔和的焦外虚化效果。在图像中部，叠加了一段纤细的白色手写日语文字，采用细毛笔风格，笔触略显不规则且富有情感，内容为 {argument name="overlay text" default="今日も、寒いね。"}。自然户外光线，温馨的季节氛围，逼真的质感，阳光下的叶片与粗糙路面形成高对比度，方形构图，具有诗意的社交媒体美学。

templates.title: Dreamy bubbles with handwritten Japanese

titleLocalized.zh: 带有手写日文的梦幻泡泡

templates.prompt: A dreamlike, minimalist square image features a rainbow-colored soap bubble floating at its center. The background is a deep blue soft-focus effect, with bright natural light pouring down from the upper left, creating delicate lens flares, circular bokeh, and luminous highlights. The main bubble exhibits a clear rainbow reflection, with a star-like shimmer at the lower right edge. Six blurred bubbles are distributed around the image: a large, partial bubble in the lower left corner, a small bubble near the upper center, a faint bubble in the middle left, and three softly glowing bubbles clustered from the lower center to the lower right. The center of the image is covered with white, handwritten Japanese calligraphy, the content of which is…{argument name="headline text" default="Popping bubbles."} It possesses an emotionally rich, hand-painted ink feel, with slightly uneven brushstrokes and natural, organic spacing. The overall atmosphere is poetic, light, bright, and nostalgic, featuring shallow depth of field, sophisticated photographic aesthetics, simple composition, and a strong contrast between the sharp central bubble and the blurred, dreamlike background.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张梦幻般的极简主义正方形图片，中心漂浮着一个彩虹色的肥皂泡，背景为深蓝色柔焦效果，明亮的自然光从左上方倾泻而下，营造出精致的镜头光晕、圆形焦外成像和发光高光。主体泡泡呈现清晰的彩虹反射，右下边缘有一点星光般的闪烁；画面周围分布着 6 个虚化的泡泡：左下角有一个大的局部泡泡，上方中心附近有一个小泡泡，左侧中部有一个淡泡泡，下中部至右下区域聚集着 3 个柔和发光的泡泡。画面中央覆盖着白色的手写书法风格日文，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="はじける泡。"}，具有情感丰富的手绘墨迹感，笔触略显不均匀，间距自然有机。整体氛围诗意、轻盈、明亮且怀旧，具有浅景深、高级摄影美学、简洁的构图，以及清晰的中心泡泡与模糊梦幻背景之间的强烈对比。

templates.title: Cheers to the delightful combination of Japanese oden and beer!

titleLocalized.zh: 日式关东煮与啤酒的惬意干杯

templates.prompt: This is a warm and cozy Japanese-style home night scene, photographed in a natural lifestyle style. In the foreground, a right hand holds up a clear pint glass filled with golden beer, topped with thick, delicate white foam, positioned slightly to the right, as if toasting alone. In the softly blurred background, a small earthenware pot is simmering oden on a portable gas stove, the ingredients clearly visible, including a shiitake mushroom, two white round ingredients, several pieces of tofu, and other stewing side dishes. The scene is set in a tatami room, with warm indoor lighting and a shallow depth of field, creating a relaxed and intimate atmosphere. A striking white handwritten Japanese text is superimposed on the image.{argument name="message text" default="Good work today!"} Employing an emotionally resonant hand-drawn marker style, the uneven strokes and random spacing create a personal, notebook-like quality. It emphasizes soothing colors, soft bokeh, realistic skin tones, and the contrast between a crisp beer mug and a slightly out-of-focus, steaming hot pot in the background.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张温馨舒适的日式居家夜晚场景，采用自然的生活方式摄影风格。前景中，一只右手举起一杯装满金色啤酒的高透明品脱杯，杯顶有厚实细腻的白色泡沫，位置略偏右侧，仿佛在独自干杯。在柔和虚化的背景中，一个小型陶锅正放在便携式燃气灶上炖煮关东煮，清晰可见锅内的食材，包括 1 个香菇、2 个白色圆球状食材、几块豆腐以及其他炖煮配菜。场景设定在榻榻米房间，室内光线温暖，景深较浅，营造出轻松亲密的氛围。在图片上方叠加醒目的白色手写日文文本 {argument name="message text" default="今日も\nおつかれさま。"}，采用富有情感的手绘马克笔风格，笔触不均匀，间距随意，带有个人笔记般的质感。强调治愈系的色彩、柔和的焦外成像、真实的肤色，以及清爽的啤酒杯与背景中微微失焦的热气腾腾火锅之间的对比。

templates.title: Leverage Infinity Stand Poster

titleLocalized.zh: Leverage Infinity Stand 海报

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic, manga-style character poster with a faded off-white paper background. The design references a stand-up file page from *JoJo's Bizarre Adventure*, featuring heavy ink lines, halftone textures, painterly shadows, and exaggerated manga tension. The layout is vertical, with a dense data panel on the left and the main character occupying the center and right side. At the top left, below the large serif English title "LEVERAGE INFINITY" is the smaller Japanese text "スタンド名:". The data card on the lower left contains six lines of visible information, with Japanese labels and values: "スタンド使い名:" corresponds to the value "1-sphere", "Gender: Unknown", "見た目:" followed by a brief Japanese description, "Age: Unknown", "Height: 96cm", and "Occupation: Market Department/Nutrition". Below this, add a framed ability description bar titled "Stand Ability," containing multiple lines of Japanese text, with a bold English slogan at the bottom that must read: "Choose... TO THE MOOOOON!! Or face the MARGIN CAAAAALL!!" In the lower left corner, add a framed radar chart area titled "Stand Parameter," surrounded by five tagged attributes: "Destructive Power B," "Sustainability C," "Growth Potential A," "Spirit Power C," and "Human Telekinesis B"; fill the radar chart with semi-transparent pink polygons. The main illustration shows two stacked figures: the upper one is the humanoid Stand, and the lower one is the pig-shaped user. Stand is tall, metallic, and threatening, with a bright red mushroom cap with white dots on its head, round, gold-pink ear-like discs on either side, a segmented chrome alloy and brass body, muscular yet streamlined arms, and a pink pig nose symbol on its chest. Its face is blurred by a rectangular mosaic. It extends a sharply defined hand towards the viewer in a highly aggressive, perspective pose. Around Stand's upper body are three large, stylized purple and black onomatopoeic "gogogo". On the far right, a jagged speech bubble or impact shape contains four lines of bold Japanese text: "Reva," "Reva," "Reva," "Reva!!" Behind both figures, bursts of pinkish-purple flames and floating rock fragments create a strong sense of supernatural energy. The lower figure is a short, stout pig-like character, standing with legs spread apart, pink skin, small hoof-like feet, wearing a yellow-green scarf and a huge red-and-white-polka-dot mushroom hat with a thick yellow brim; its torso is blurred by a rectangular mosaic. The pig points outwards with one hand and carries a woven basket in the other, containing three items: a blue heart-shaped object and two round, agricultural product-like objects. Maintaining the dramatic and grotesque nature of the composition, it blends absurd humor, market-driven parody, and high-impact cartoon poster aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张戏剧性的漫画风格角色海报，背景为陈旧的米白色纸张，设计参考《JoJo》风格的 Stand 档案页，具有厚重的墨线、网点纹理、绘画感阴影和夸张的漫画张力。布局为垂直构图，左侧为密集的资料面板，主体人物占据中央和右侧。左上方，巨大的衬线体英文标题“LEVERAGE INFINITY”下方是较小的日文文本“スタンド名:”。下方左侧的资料卡包含 6 行可见信息，带有日文标签和数值：“スタンド使い名:”对应数值“1-sphere”，“性別: 不詳”，“見た目:”后接简短的日文描述，“年齢: 不詳”，“身長: 96cm”，以及“職業: 市場の条省・養分”。在其下方，添加一个标题为“スタンド能力”的带框能力说明栏，包含多行日文正文，底部是一句加粗的英文标语，内容必须为：“Choose... TO THE MOOOOON!! Or face the MARGIN CAAAAALL!!”。在左下方，添加一个标题为“スタンドパラメータ”的带框雷达图区域，图表周围有 5 个带标签的属性：“破壊力 B”、“持続力 C”、“成長性 A”、“スピード C”和“人念力 B”；用半透明的粉色多边形填充雷达图。主体插画展示了上下堆叠的两个形象：上方是人形 Stand，下方是猪型使用者。Stand 高大、金属感强且充满威胁，头部为亮红色带白点的蘑菇帽，两侧有圆形金粉色耳状圆盘，身体为分段式铬合金与黄铜材质，手臂肌肉发达但线条流畅，胸前有一个粉色猪鼻标志。其面部区域被一个长方形马赛克模糊处理。它以一种极具侵略性的透视姿势向观众伸出一只关节分明的手。在 Stand 上半身周围，放置 3 个巨大的紫色与黑色风格化“ゴゴゴ”拟声词。在最右侧，添加一个锯齿状的对话框或冲击形状，内含 4 行加粗的日文文本：“レヴァ”、“レヴァ”、“レヴァ”、“レヴァ!!”。在两个形象身后，爆发出的粉紫色光焰和漂浮的岩石碎片营造出强烈的超自然能量感。下方的形象是一个矮胖的猪身角色，双腿叉开站立，皮肤呈粉色，有着小小的蹄状脚，佩戴黄绿色领巾，头戴一顶巨大的红底白点蘑菇帽，帽檐内侧为厚实的黄色；躯干区域被一个长方形马赛克模糊处理。这只猪一只手向外指点，另一只手提着一个编织篮，篮中可见 3 件物品：1 个蓝色心形物体和 2 个圆形农产品状物体。保持构图的戏剧性和怪诞感，融合荒诞幽默、市场投机恶搞和高冲击力的漫画海报美学。

templates.title: Cyberpunk Fallen Angel Warrior

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克堕天使武士

templates.prompt: A highly detailed, symmetrical, anime-inspired cyberpunk illustration with a flat, saturated background.{argument name="background color" default="Dark red"} In the center of the image, a solitary, androgynous warrior sits languidly on a dark wooden chair, legs apart, hands resting naturally on his knees, exuding a calm threat and an aura of fallen divinity. His face is deliberately obscured, making him difficult to discern, but he wears an exquisitely crafted black samurai-style horned helmet adorned with two curved horns and dense mechanical decorations. Two enormous white wings spread out from his back. Behind and around his seated body, the composition is divided into two contrasting clusters of organic technological matter: on the left, a chaotic storm composed of cyan and dark blue cables, wires, plugs, circuit fragments, and technologically organic tendrils; on the right, an explosive cluster of flowers composed of pink cherry blossoms, petals, curling branches, and ribbon-like floral swirls. Behind the character to the right, a katana stands upright, slightly tilted inwards, with a black hilt and a clearly visible guard. The character is dressed in a mix of streetwear and armor: a two-tone jacket, the left half featuring dark cyan-black circuit patterns, the right half light pink floral patterns; black slim-fit trousers with asymmetrical details; cyan and pink striped socks; and chunky high-top sneakers with large soles, one predominantly cyan-black and the other pinkish-white, the uppers covered in graphic panels and straps. The hands have a semi-mechanical or armored appearance, with long, sharp fingers. The image is filled with tiny decorative fragments, petals, paint-like spots, and micro-details, giving the entire scene a finely hand-painted ink-line texture.{argument name="accent color 1" default="Cyan"} ,{argument name="accent color 2" default="pink"} A high-contrast color palette, primarily black and white, is set against a red background. Presented in an ultra-refined style that blends comics and graffiti, with clear lines and dense textures, the poster-style frontal composition perfectly integrates elements of angels, demons, flowers, and cybernetics.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超精细、构图对称、受动漫启发的赛博朋克插画，背景为平整且饱和的 {argument name="background color" default="深红色"}。画面中心，一位孤独的中性战士懒散地坐在深色木椅上，双腿分开，双手自然垂于膝间，散发出一种冷静的威胁感与堕落神性的气息。面部刻意遮挡，难以辨认，头戴精致的黑色武士风格带角头盔，配有 2 只弯曲的角和密集的机械装饰。角色背部向外展开 2 只巨大的白色羽翼。在坐姿身体的后方及周围，构图分裂为两团对比鲜明的有机科技物质：左侧是 1 团由青色和深蓝色电缆、电线、插头、电路碎片及科技有机卷须组成的混乱风暴；右侧是 1 簇由粉色樱花、花瓣、卷曲枝条和丝带状花卉漩涡组成的爆发性花丛。在角色右后方放置 1 把直立的武士刀，略微向内倾斜，配有黑色刀柄和清晰可见的护手。角色身着街头服饰与盔甲的混合装束：一件双色拼接夹克，左半部分为深青黑色电路图案，右半部分为淡粉色花卉图案；穿着黑色修身长裤，带有不对称细节；搭配青色与粉色相间的条纹袜；脚踩厚底高帮运动鞋，鞋底硕大，一只以青黑色为主，另一只以粉白色为主，鞋面布满图形面板和绑带。双手呈现半机械或盔甲化外观，手指修长锋利。画面中充斥着细小的装饰性碎片、花瓣、油漆状斑点和微观细节，使整幅场景呈现出精细的手绘墨线质感。使用以 {argument name="accent color 1" default="青蓝色"}、{argument name="accent color 2" default="粉色"}、黑色和白色为主的高对比度调色板，衬托在红色背景之上。以超精细的漫画与涂鸦融合风格呈现，线条清晰，纹理密集，采用海报式的正面构图，完美融合了天使、恶魔、花卉和控制论元素。

templates.title: Anime Park Date Illustration

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫公园约会插画

templates.prompt: A beautifully crafted anime-style illustration depicting {argument name="character duo" default="Gilgamesh and Enkidu"} A quiet date scene in the park. The composition uses a thigh-high angle, with the two walking side-by-side on a sunlit pebble path by the lake. The figure on the left is a tall, slender young man with short, straight hair.{argument name="left character hair color" default="Golden yellow"} The first character has long hair, wears a black cardigan, a loose white V-neck T-shirt, and beige khaki pants, and has his hands in his pockets. The character on the right is a slender, ethereal young man with extremely long hair.{argument name="right character hair color" default="Soft green"} Long, flowing hair sways to the right in the breeze. She wears an oversized white hoodie with a black drawstring, one arm swinging naturally as she walks. The atmosphere is gentle, intimate, and slightly romantic, like a casual, ambiguous date. They are placed in the center of the foreground, the blonde on the left, the green-haired on the right, both looking at each other or slightly ahead. The background is a beautiful public park, bathed in the bright light of a summer morning or afternoon: tall green trees arch overhead, casting dappled shadows on the path; a calm lake lies behind a black metal fence on the left; a small arched bridge is visible in the midground; white and purple flowerbeds adorn the path; two park benches are visible on the left; a streetlamp stands by the water; and a tiny pedestrian is seen in the distance on the right side of the path. The image features a clear blue sky with fluffy white clouds, lush vegetation with rich leaf details, soft and cinematic lighting, clean lines, and delicate shadows. This is a classic SFW (Small Frontier Works) anime key visual, elegant, tranquil, and visually rich, capturing a romantic slice of life in a vertical composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的动漫风格插画，描绘了 {argument name="character duo" default="吉尔伽美什和恩奇都"} 在公园安静约会的场景。画面采用大腿以上的构图，两人并肩走在湖边阳光明媚的石子路上。左侧角色是一位身材高挑纤细的年轻男性，留着短直的 {argument name="left character hair color" default="金黄色"} 头发，身穿黑色开衫外套、宽松的白色 V 领 T 恤和米色卡其裤，双手插在口袋里。右侧角色是一位身材苗条、气质空灵的年轻人，留着极长的 {argument name="right character hair color" default="柔绿色"} 飘逸长发，在微风中向右侧拂动，身穿带有黑色抽绳的超大款白色连帽衫，走路时单手自然摆动。氛围温柔、亲密且略带浪漫，仿佛一场暧昧的休闲约会。将他们置于前景中心，金发角色在左，绿发角色在右，两人看向彼此或略微前方。背景是美丽的公共公园，呈现明亮的夏日清晨或午后光影：高大的绿树在头顶拱起，在小径上投下斑驳的阴影；左侧黑色金属栅栏后是一片平静的湖泊；中景处可见一座小拱桥；步道旁点缀着白色和紫色的花坛；左侧可见 2 张公园长椅；水边立着 1 盏路灯；小径右侧远处有 1 个微小的行人。画面采用湛蓝天空配以朵朵白云，植被茂密，叶片细节丰富，光影柔和且具有电影感，线条干净，阴影处理细腻。SFW，优雅，宁静，视觉丰富的动漫主视觉图，具有浪漫的生活片段氛围，采用竖构图。

templates.title: Bubble Fox friends reunite in Niseko

titleLocalized.zh: 泡泡狐狸伙伴在二世谷重聚

templates.prompt: This is a bright, anime-style fantasy travel scene. The background is Niseko View Plaza in Niseko, Hokkaido, with a clear blue sky dotted with white clouds and towering snow-capped mountains in the distance. The scene is located in a roadside parking lot plaza. To the left is a modern, black-wood-style station building with Japanese signs reading "道の駅ニセコビュープラザ" (Michi no Eki Niseko View Plaza) and "Niseko View Plaza," as well as a vertical banner that reads "ようこそニセコへ" (Yoko to Niseko) and a tall food sign that reads "名物じゃがいも" (My Famous Foods). To the right is a dark-colored directional sign that reads "ニセコNiseko" and lists four icons and labels: "名产品Local Products," "农产品直売所Farmer's Market," "レストランRestaurant," and "情报コーナーInformation." In the center of the image, a charming anime girl with fox ears sits sideways on a giant, iridescent, translucent soap bubble, smiling and waving to the sky. She has {argument name="hair color" default="shimmering pale silver lilac color"} She has incredibly long, wavy hair, a pair of huge, fluffy fox ears, and a massive, bushy fox tail with iridescent highlights. She wears an exquisite, shimmering, semi-transparent white and pale blue dress with holographic sheen, layered cuffs, jewel embellishments, ribbons, and glossy lace-up ankle boots with bows, embodying the image of a magical bubble fox idol. Smaller soap bubbles float around her, refracting rainbow light. Three fox-girl friends reunite with her in the plaza: a dark-haired fox-eared girl wearing a navy blue jacket with the Niseko emblem, holding a vanilla ice cream and looking towards the center; a fox-eared girl in a khaki outdoor jacket and a dark baseball cap with "HOTEL" on it, holding a roasted corn cob; and a white-haired fox-eared girl in a shimmering pearl-colored hooded jacket and beret, holding a takeaway coffee cup and carrying a black backpack. Emphasizing a joyful reunion atmosphere, the collection combines travel photography composition with exquisite anime illustrations, showcasing richly detailed environmental signage, reflective soap bubble surfaces, soft sunlight, fresh mountain air, and high-precision painting textures.

promptLocalized.zh: 这是一幅明亮的动漫风格奇幻旅行场景，背景是北海道的二世谷道之站（Niseko View Plaza），天空湛蓝，白云点缀，远处耸立着巨大的雪山。场景位于路边的广场停车场，左侧是一座现代化的黑木风格车站建筑，可见写有“道の駅 ニセコビュープラザ”和“Niseko View Plaza”的日文标识，以及写着“ようこそ ニセコへ”的竖幅横幅，还有一个写着“名物 じゃがいも”的高大食物招牌。右侧是一个深色的导向牌，上面写着“ニセコ Niseko”，并列出了 4 个图标和标签：“名産品 Local Products”、“農産物直売所 Farmer's Market”、“レストラン Restaurant”和“情報コーナー Information”。画面中央，一位迷人的狐耳动漫少女侧坐在一个巨大的虹彩半透明肥皂泡上，微笑着向空中挥手。她有着 {argument name="hair color" default="闪烁的淡银丁香色"} 的超长波浪卷发，一对巨大的毛茸茸狐耳，以及一条带有彩虹反光高光的巨大蓬松狐狸尾巴。她身穿精致的闪亮半透明白色与淡蓝色礼服，带有全息光泽、层叠袖口、宝石装饰、丝带以及带有蝴蝶结的光泽系带短靴，呈现出魔法泡泡狐狸偶像的形象。她周围漂浮着多个较小的肥皂泡，折射着彩虹光芒。三位狐狸少女朋友在广场上与她重聚：一位留着深色头发的狐耳少女穿着带有二世谷徽章的海军蓝夹克，手里拿着香草冰淇淋，正看向中心；一位穿着卡其色户外夹克、戴着写有“HOTEL”字样深色鸭舌帽的狐耳少女，手里拿着烤玉米；还有一位白发狐耳少女穿着闪亮的珍珠色连帽夹克并戴着贝雷帽，手里拿着外带咖啡杯，背着黑色双肩包。强调欢快的重聚氛围，将旅行摄影构图与精致的动漫插画相结合，展现细节丰富的环境标识、反光的肥皂泡表面、柔和的阳光、清新的山间空气以及高精度的绘画质感。

templates.title: Anime-style Cthulhu tabletop role-playing club study group

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫风克苏鲁跑团学习会

templates.prompt: A richly detailed anime-style illustration depicts a late-night tabletop RPG session involving *Call of Cthulhu*. In a dimly lit antique study, warm oil lamps and candles cast their glow. Three young women sit around a wooden table piled high with game materials. On the left, a girl with long black braids, a military-style hat, and a camouflage jacket is nervously and somewhat frantically scribbling on a character card. In the center, a girl with long, pale purple twin ponytails, wearing an elegant dark green dress with gold trim and white lace cuffs, is playfully smiling, holding up a hardcover book titled *Talk of Cthulhu*, its cover featuring a dramatic, mysterious monster. Above her is the handwritten Japanese phrase "これで全員一時狂気ね" (It seems everyone's gone into a temporary frenzy) accompanied by a small heart. On the right, an orange-haired girl in a white coat, stethoscope, and name tag is nervously reading a piece of paper. Above her, handwritten Japanese text reads "SAN値がピンチ!" (SAN value is critical!), highlighted with vibrant lines. Scattered on the table are 10 multi-sided dice, various papers, 3 visible character cards or notes, 4 large maps, 2 mugs with dark badges, a glass of iced cola, a plate of cookies, a bag of potato chips with Japanese writing, a small sign that reads "Going Crazy," a bottle of black ink, and a white quill pen. In the lower right corner are two closed hardcover books on occultism, and to the right is an open giant monster encyclopedia. The background features tall bookshelves filled with old books, framed occult artwork (including a painting of a tentacle creature), an old, large wall map with markings and lines, candles, and wooden furniture, creating the atmosphere of a Victorian-era occult library. The composition is a cinematic wide-angle group portrait slightly above the desktop perspective, with extremely high rendering quality. It uses warm brown and amber lighting, with delicate textures, vivid character expressions and hairstyles, presenting a playful horror-comedy tone, and possessing top-notch quality as a key visual for light novels or visual novels.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张细节丰富的动漫风格插画，描绘了深夜进行《克苏鲁的呼唤》跑团游戏的场景。昏暗的古董书房内，温暖的油灯和蜡烛散发着光芒。三位年轻女性围坐在木桌旁，桌上堆满了游戏材料。左侧，一位留着黑色长辫、戴着军装风帽子并身穿迷彩夹克的女孩正神情紧张、略显手忙脚乱地用笔在角色卡上记录；中间，一位留着淡紫色超长双马尾的女孩身穿饰有金色镶边和白色蕾丝袖口的优雅深绿色连衣裙，正调皮地笑着，手中举起一本名为“Talk of Cthulhu”的精装书，封面上印有极具戏剧性的神秘怪物图案；她上方有手写的日语文字“これで全員 一时的狂気ね”（看来全员都陷入临时疯狂了呢）并配有一个小爱心。右侧，一位身穿白大褂、佩戴听诊器和工牌的橘发女孩正紧张地读着纸张，她上方的手写日语文字写着“SAN値が ピンチ！”（SAN 值告急！），并带有充满活力的强调线。桌面上散落着 10 枚多面骰子、各种纸张、3 张可见的角色卡或笔记、4 张大型地图、2 个印有深色徽章的马克杯、1 杯冰可乐、1 盘饼干、1 袋印有日文的薯片、1 个写着“发狂中”的小立牌、1 瓶黑墨水、1 支白色羽毛笔，右下角堆放着 2 本闭合的神秘学精装书，右侧还有 1 本打开的巨型怪物图鉴。背景是摆满旧书的高大书架、装裱好的神秘学艺术品（包括一张触手生物画作）、一张带有标记和连线的陈旧大型墙面地图、蜡烛、木质家具，营造出维多利亚时代神秘学图书馆的氛围。构图为略高于桌面视角的电影感广角群像，渲染度极高，采用温暖的棕色和琥珀色调灯光，纹理细腻，角色表情和发型生动，呈现出俏皮的恐怖喜剧基调，具备轻小说或视觉小说关键视觉图的顶级品质。

templates.title: Neon Cat Girl Soda Splash

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹猫娘苏打水喷溅

templates.prompt: A dynamic, anime-style cyberpunk illustration featuring a protagonist {argument name="character type" default="Cat-eared anime girl"} Using extreme close-up shots and low-angle perspectives, the glass soda bottle is pushed directly towards the viewer, making the bottle and hand dominate the foreground. The scene is immersed in explosive neon magenta, cyan, violet, and electric blue lighting, with a high-gloss, high-contrast texture and dense, shimmering particle effects. The character possesses long, flowing hair {argument name="hair color" default="Silver-white hair with cyan and pink highlights"} She had enormous, fluffy cat ears and layered hair that shimmered in the contour light. Most of her face was obscured, with a flat, rectangular review strip of soft purple covering her eyes. She wore a futuristic club outfit: a black lace-up top with small cat logo details, a semi-transparent iridescent jacket slipping from her shoulders, shimmering dark arm guards or gloves, metallic accessories, and dangling earrings. Her nails were painted a vibrant pink. In the foreground, she clutched a {argument name="drink label" default="NYAN EXTREME SODA"} A transparent bottle with a stylized cat face logo printed on a dark label. The bottle is filled with a bright blue and pink bubbly liquid; the cap is open, and a dramatic fountain of pink soda water sprays upwards and outwards, splashing across the entire image. The character is surrounded by floating translucent ice cubes, water droplets, glitter, and bokeh highlights. The background is not a realistic location, but an abstract burst of nightlife energy composed of swirling liquid, neon splashes, and luminous particles. It emphasizes exaggerated perspective, dynamism, a sensual pop art attitude, hyper-detailed reflections, glossy skin and fabrics, and a bold, sophisticated anime illustration aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅充满动感的动漫赛博流行风格插画，主角为一位 {argument name="character type" default="猫耳动漫女孩"}，采用极端的特写镜头和低角度透视姿势，将玻璃苏打水瓶直接推向观众，使瓶子和手部占据前景。场景沉浸在爆炸性的霓虹洋红色、青色、紫罗兰色和电光蓝灯光中，具有高光泽、高对比度的质感以及密集的闪烁粒子效果。角色拥有长而飘逸的 {argument name="hair color" default="带有青色和粉色挑染的银白色头发"}，巨大的毛茸茸猫耳，以及在轮廓光下闪烁的层叠发丝。她的面部大部分被遮挡，眼部区域覆盖着一个柔和紫色的扁平矩形审查条。她身穿未来主义俱乐部服装：带有小型猫咪标志细节的黑色系带上衣，从肩部滑落的半透明虹彩夹克，闪亮的深色护臂或手套，金属配饰以及垂坠耳环。她的指甲涂成了鲜艳的粉红色。在前景中，她紧握着一个贴有 {argument name="drink label" default="NYAN EXTREME SODA"} 标签的透明瓶子，深色标签上印有风格化的猫脸标志。瓶中装满了亮蓝色和粉色的气泡液体，瓶盖已开启，戏剧性的粉色苏打水喷泉向上和向外喷涌，溅满整个画面。角色周围环绕着漂浮的半透明冰块、水滴、闪粉和散景效果的亮点。背景并非写实的地点，而是由旋转的液体、霓虹溅射和发光粒子组成的抽象夜生活能量爆发。强调夸张的透视、动感、感性的波普艺术态度、超细节的反射、光泽的皮肤和织物，以及大胆的 gpt-image-2 精致动漫插画美学。

templates.prompt: This dynamic, anime-style cyberpunk illustration depicts a cat-eared girl pushing a soda bottle towards the camera. The extreme close-up angle creates a strong fisheye lens effect and exaggerated perspective. The soda bottle dominates the foreground, its label clearly reading "CAT NYAN SODA," with smaller, Japanese-style text below. The cap is open, and glowing carbonated liquid sprays upwards, creating a huge splash. The character is a stylish, futuristic girl with {argument name="hair color" default="Silver-white with blue-pink iridescence"} Her hair, thick and extremely long, dances in the air like neon ribbons. She has a pair of clearly visible cat ears, fluffy and large, adorned with three small accessories: a spiked ear clip, a miniature cat-face hair clip, and a small metal perforated detail. Most of her face is covered by a solid color in the center of the upper half.{argument name="censor block color" default="Purple"} Blocks obscure the view. She wears a short white tank top with small, barcode-like patterns, a dark, shiny jacket draped over her shoulders, layered necklaces, and a belt. Her nails are painted bright pink. The product is a plastic soda bottle filled with a deep purple liquid and featuring luminous highlights, adorned with a striking, playful white and pink logo. The scene is surrounded by floating ice cubes, shimmering water droplets, and exploding carbonated bubbles. A high-contrast color palette of electric magenta, purple, cyan, and deep blue is used, creating bright reflections on skin, hair, glass surfaces, and the liquid. The background is an abstract burst of nightlife energy, filled with lines, splashes, particles, and refracted light, lacking a defined environment but exuding intense dynamism and color. The image is glossy, highly saturated, chaotic yet stylish, like a high-end anime beverage advertisement poster with sharp lines, shimmering mirror highlights, and a rebellious pop cyberpunk aesthetic. Vertical composition, half-body portrait, single character, one bottle, one main soda splash, and six clearly visible floating ice blocks.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具动感的动漫赛博流行风格插画，一位猫耳少女将汽水瓶推向镜头，采用极端的特写视角，具有强烈的鱼眼透镜效果和夸张的透视感。汽水瓶占据了前景的中心位置，标签上清晰地写着“CAT NYAN SODA”，下方配有较小的日式风格文字；瓶盖已开启，发光的碳酸液体向上喷涌，形成巨大的水花。角色是一位时尚的未来感少女，拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="带有蓝粉虹彩的银白色"} 头发，发量丰盈且极长，如霓虹丝带般在画面中飞舞。她有一对清晰可见的猫耳，毛茸茸且硕大，装饰着 3 个小配饰：一个尖刺耳骨夹、一个微型猫脸发夹和一个小型金属穿孔细节。她的脸部大部分被一个位于上半脸区域中心的纯色 {argument name="censor block color" default="紫色"} 方块遮挡。她身穿一件短款白色背心，上面印有类似条形码的小图案，肩上披着一件深色亮面夹克，佩戴着叠层项链，腰间系着腰带。她的指甲涂成了亮粉色。产品是一个装满深紫色液体并带有发光高光的塑料汽水瓶，瓶身上印有白色和粉色的醒目俏皮标志。场景周围环绕着漂浮的冰块、闪烁的水滴和爆炸般的碳酸气泡效果。采用电光洋红色、紫色、青色和深蓝色的高对比度调色板，在皮肤、头发、玻璃表面和液体上呈现出明亮的反光。背景是抽象的夜生活能量爆发，充满了线条、飞溅物、粒子和折射光，没有明确的环境，只有强烈的动感和色彩。画面光泽感强、饱和度高、充满混乱与时尚感，如同高端动漫饮料广告海报，线条锐利，带有光芒晕染、闪烁的镜面高光和叛逆的流行赛博美学。竖构图，半身像，单人角色，1 个瓶子，1 个主要的汽水喷溅，6 个清晰可见的漂浮冰块。

templates.title: Rainbow Cat Girl Brackish Water Explosion

templates.prompt: A highly dynamic anime illustration depicts a neon cyberpunk idol catgirl extending a soda bottle towards the audience, employing extreme perspective to place the soda bottle in the foreground and the character filling the background. She possesses {argument name="hair color" default="Long gradient hair color from lavender to blue"} She has two black cat ears with soft pink fur on the inside, and a glowing halo floats above her head. Most of her face is obscured by a solid square block on the right side of the image, and her wild, flowing hair explodes outwards like ribbons and ponytails. She wears a glossy black and white futuristic streetwear outfit with a deep neckline, a short jacket, metal straps, and small accessories, with a round pink badge pinned to her chest. Her exposed hand tightly clutches a plastic soda bottle with a label that reads {argument name="brand name" default="Nyan SODA"} Her long fingernails were painted in cyan and pink. The bottle was transparent, filled with shimmering deep purple soda, glowing bubbles, and neon highlights, with a dramatic burst of vibrant magenta liquid gushing upwards from the spout. The scene was surrounded by a cluster of crystal-clear ice cubes, countless water droplets, paint-like splatters, shimmering particles, and arcs of energy. A strong palette of magenta, purple, indigo, and cyan was used, featuring high contrast, glossy reflections, halo effects, and bright rim lighting. The background was intended to be an abstract explosion of liquid, light, and movement, rather than a realistic scene. The overall effect was a fusion of a radical soda ad and an iconic key visual, chaotic, cute, and energetic, with ultra-refined anime rendering, crisp lines, shimmering highlights, and a vertical poster composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具动感的动漫插画，描绘了一位霓虹赛博偶像猫娘将汽水瓶伸向观众，采用极端的透视效果，汽水瓶占据前景，角色填充背景。她拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="从薰衣草色到青色的长渐变发色"}，两只黑色猫耳，内侧带有柔软的粉色绒毛，头顶漂浮着 1 个发光的光环。她的脸部大部分被画面中右侧的一个实心方形遮挡块遮住，狂野飘逸的头发像丝带和发束一样向外炸开。她身穿光泽感的黑白未来风街头服饰，领口深邃，搭配短款夹克、金属绑带、小巧配饰，胸前别着 1 枚圆形粉色徽章。她露出的手紧握着 1 个塑料汽水瓶，瓶身标签为 {argument name="brand name" default="Nyan SODA"}，长指甲涂成青色和粉色两种颜色。瓶子透明，装满了闪烁的深紫色汽水、发光的气泡和霓虹高光，瓶口向上喷涌出戏剧性的鲜艳洋红色液体。场景周围环绕着 1 阵晶莹剔透的冰块、无数水滴、油漆般的飞溅物、闪烁的颗粒和能量弧。使用强烈的洋红色、紫色、靛蓝色和青色调色板，具有高对比度、光泽反射、光晕效果和明亮的轮廓光。背景应是液体、光线和运动的抽象爆炸，而非写实场景。营造出一种激进的汽水广告与偶像主视觉图相结合的感觉，混乱、可爱且充满活力，具有超精细的动漫渲染、清晰的线条、闪烁的高光和竖版海报构图。

templates.title: Anime Shrine Maiden Amulet Counter

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫巫女御守柜台

templates.prompt: A simple, anime-style illustration depicts a young shrine maiden working at a traditional Japanese shrine amulet counter inside a warm wooden building. The main subject is a woman, shown from the waist up behind the counter; her face is softly blurred with rectangular lines, and she has long, straight hair.{argument name="hair color" default="black"} Her hair was tied up with a red rope and a white paper zigzag shrine ornament, and she wore a white kimono top and brightly colored {argument name="hakama color" default="red"} A woman in hakama (traditional Japanese clothing) is politely handing a talisman to a visitor across the counter; only the visitor's hands, torso, and beige jacket sleeves are visible in the foreground. The scene should create a tranquil and solemn atmosphere, with light streaming in through a wooden lattice window on the right, through which the red torii gate and shrine garden are faintly visible, creating a soft, blurred effect. The interior is richly detailed, featuring dark natural wood beams and shelves. A small shrine stall in the upper left corner is decorated with four hanging white paper tassels and two white vases containing sakaki trees. A vertical sign hanging on the right reads "御守・御札授与所" (Omamori/Otasagi no Soko). On the shelves to the left are shrine supplies and signs: three small shelf labels with "おみくじ" (Omikuji), stacks of paper tags and talismans, white drawstring bags, and standing signs with "御守," "御札," and "交通安全" (Traffic Safety). Three light-colored wooden display trays, each holding a colorful amulet, are neatly arranged on the counter. Five clearly visible paper labels or stacks of paper on the table are labeled "Evil Removal," "Amulet," "Imperial Talisman," "Imperial Seal," and "Imperial Gift," respectively. There is also an ink bottle, two calligraphy brushes, an empty wooden tray, a rectangular abacus, and bundles of paper items. The amulets being exchanged are delicate, light-colored, decorated with flowers and ribbons. The display employs a refined modern anime illustration style, with fine lines, soft shadows, realistic hand gestures, and fine dust particles in the air. The emphasis is on the interaction between the amulets and the counter, rather than exaggerated artistic treatment.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张简洁的动漫风格插画，描绘了一位年轻巫女在温暖的木质建筑内，于传统日本神社御守柜台前工作的场景。画面主体为一位女性，从腰部以上展示在柜台后，她的面部被柔和的矩形模糊处理，留着长直的 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"} 头发，用红绳和白色纸质锯齿状神社饰物束起，身穿白色和服上衣和鲜艳的 {argument name="hakama color" default="红色"} 袴。她正礼貌地将一枚护身符递给柜台对面的访客；前景中仅可见访客的手部、躯干和米色夹克袖子。场景应营造出宁静、庄重的氛围，光线由右侧木格窗射入，窗外隐约可见红色的鸟居和神社庭院，呈现柔和的虚化效果。室内细节丰富，配有深色天然木梁、货架，左上角设有一个小型神棚，装饰着 4 条悬挂的白色纸垂和 2 盆白色花瓶中的榊木。右侧悬挂着一块写有日文“御守・御札授与所”的竖牌。左侧货架上摆放着神社用品和标识：3 个写有“おみくじ”的小型货架标签，多叠纸签和护身符，白色抽绳袋，以及写有“御守”、“御札”和“交通安全”的立式标牌。柜台上整齐地排列着 3 个浅木色展示托盘，盛放着色彩缤纷的御守，5 个清晰可见的桌面纸质标签或纸堆，分别写着“厄除”、“御守”、“御札”、“御朱印”和“御礼”，此外还有墨汁瓶、2 支毛笔、一个空木托盘、一个长方形算盘以及成捆的纸质物品。正在交换的御守应为精致的淡色系，带有花卉装饰和系带。采用精致的现代动漫插画风格，线条细腻，阴影柔和，手部姿势写实，空气中带有细微的尘埃颗粒，重点强调主体与柜台的互动，而非夸张的艺术化处理。
