templates.title: The priestess presents the amulet.

titleLocalized.zh: 巫女呈献御守

templates.prompt: This is a beautifully crafted anime-style illustration, featuring a protagonist named {argument name="character name" default="Sound Comfort"} A young shrine maiden stands inside a traditional Japanese shrine amulet sales area; the image shows a half-length portrait from her thighs to her head. She has long, glossy hair.{argument name="hair color" default="black"} She has long, center-parted hair, fair skin, and a serene, gentle expression. Her face is centered in the frame and directly facing the camera, but is partially obscured by a rectangular blurred area. She wears classic shrine maiden attire, including a crisp white kimono-style blouse and a deep red hakama tied with a large bow. Her hands are presenting a white embroidered amulet to the viewer, carefully held against her chest; the amulet has a gold knot at the top and the Chinese characters "御守" (Omamori) printed vertically on the front. In the foreground of the counter, a wooden display tray neatly displays 10 amulets of various colors, including white, pink, red, purple, and gold-patterned designs, each with a decorative knot and gold and white embroidery. To the right of the counter, three stacks of paper talismans or amulets are neatly piled, each with a Japanese label; the rightmost stack is tied with a red and gold water rope. To the left of the counter stands a small wooden sign that reads "初穂料 800 ¥". The shrine's interior is warmly lit, with natural light streaming in through a large wooden-framed window on the left, creating a tranquil and elegant atmosphere. Through the window, one can see red railings and the hazy outline of the shrine courtyard and greenery. The background features wooden shelves and traditional decorations, with a vertical banner on the wall inscribed with "Omamori Omamori" (amulet and prayer token), below which are smaller words: "Various prayers accepted." The composition centers on the shrine maiden and the amulet in her hand, featuring a soft depth of field, delicate folds in her clothing, realistic hands, exquisite lines, and a high-quality modern anime rendering style that emphasizes the subject rather than the environment.

promptLocalized.zh: 这是一幅精致的动漫风格插画，主角是一位名为 {argument name="character name" default="音慰"} 的年轻巫女，她站在传统的日本神社御守售卖处内，画面呈现从大腿以上至头部的半身像。她留着一头柔顺有光泽的 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"} 中分长发，皮肤白皙，神态沉静温柔。她的面部处于画面中心并正对镜头，但面部区域被一个矩形模糊块遮盖。她身着经典的巫女服，包括挺括的白色和服式上衣和系着大蝴蝶结的深红色绯袴。她的双手正向观众呈献一枚白色的刺绣御守，小心翼翼地托在胸前；御守顶部系有金色绳结，正面印有竖排汉字“御守”。柜台前景的木制展示托盘中整齐摆放着 10 枚御守，颜色各异，包括白色、粉色、红色、紫色及金色花纹款式，每枚都配有装饰性绳结和金白刺绣。柜台右侧整齐堆放着 3 叠纸质神符或护身符包，每叠上均有日文标签；最右侧的一叠系着红金相间的水引绳。柜台左侧立着一块写有“初穂料 800円”的小木牌。神社内部光线温暖，自然光从左侧的大木框窗户射入，营造出宁静清雅的氛围。透过窗户可以看到红色的栏杆以及模糊的神社庭院和绿植。背景是木制货架和传统装饰，墙上挂着一块写有“御守 御札”的竖幅，下方有较小的文字“各种祈愿承办”。构图以巫女和手中的御守为中心，具有柔和的景深效果、细腻的衣褶、写实的双手、精致的线条，以及强调主体而非环境的高品质现代动漫渲染风格。

templates.prompt: A full-body anime illustration depicts three humanoid AI assistant idol girls standing side-by-side on a brightly lit, futuristic concert stage. Presented from a frontal perspective, they are shown completely from head to toe. Designed using the same Android base model, subtle individual differences are conveyed through clothing design, poses, and color balance rather than body shape. All three sport soft, wavy, silver-gray short bobs, large over-ear mechanical headphones, fair skin, and a youthful, idol-like appearance. They possess smooth, visible robotic limbs, accented with a striking red and black color scheme and heart-shaped decorative elements. The background is a large indoor venue with a steel truss structure overhead, bright white and pinkish-purple stage spotlights, a giant LED screen, and a reflective black stage floor with luminous grid lines and mirrored reflections. The overall atmosphere is sophisticated, cute, futuristic, and high-end, complemented by dramatic concert lighting and clear, detailed rendering. The girl on the left wears a predominantly black idol outfit with red accents: a short, semi-transparent black jacket over a black skirt or jumpsuit, paired with black armored over-the-knee mechanical legs, thick-soled black boots, red gloves, and heart-shaped details all over her body; her knees are slightly turned inward, her hands are pressed against her cheeks, her posture is shy and intimate, and her expression is sweet and rosy. The girl in the middle wears a red and white balanced idol outfit: a white sleeveless top with red heart decorations, a layered burgundy ruffled mini skirt, fully exposed red and black robotic arms and legs, and red platform shoes; she stands upright and dignified, one hand slightly raised near her face, clearly showcasing the structure of Android. The girl on the right wears a predominantly red idol dress with black lace-like details, a black belt, a flared skirt with a white ruffled petticoat, red and black knee armor, and red platform shoes; she stands elegantly, one arm bent close to her chest, the other outstretched, as if introducing herself to the audience. The three are evenly distributed in the frame. Emphasizing the contrast between soft idol fashion and hardcore mechanical construction, the three different costume variations employ color schemes based on black, red and white, and red, respectively. The highly detailed anime-style key visual features extremely clean lines, a strong sense of material sheen, soft facial shadows, and shimmering highlights, creating a cinematic stage atmosphere suitable for idol groups.{argument name="group name" default="Hallucinations"} High-quality propaganda art.

templates.prompt: A romantic, fantastical wedding illustration depicts two women standing hand-in-hand on a palace balcony under the moonlight. It employs a highly detailed anime style combined with a luminous, painterly texture, creating an elegant and dreamlike effect. The taller woman on the left has {argument name="left character hair color" default="Light brown"} The woman on the right has shoulder-length, smooth, layered short hair and wears a luxurious ivory-white custom-made wedding suit with gold embroidery, a high-necked ruffled blouse, a cream-colored vest, a scarf, chain accessories, and a long gown with a deep purple floral pattern lining; a purple flower brooch is pinned to her chest. The woman on the right has {argument name="right character hair color" default="black"} She has long, wavy hair and wears a gorgeous ivory wedding dress adorned with gold lace embroidery, featuring sheer lace sleeves, a fitted bodice, and an extra-long, semi-transparent veil, with a deep red lining and embellishments subtly visible at the hem. She wears ruby ​​jewelry and red and white floral ornaments in her hair. She holds a large bouquet of red, burgundy, and white flowers, accented with green leaves and cascading red ribbons, while holding her partner's hand intimately. The background features Gothic arched windows, hanging crystal decorations, glowing lanterns, purple flowers, a distant city skyline, a starry night sky, and a bright full moon. The composition incorporates decorative vertical Japanese title text: on the left {argument name="left title text" default="Shion's Protection"} Smaller vertically arranged phonetic symbols are attached next to it; the right side is {argument name="right title text" default="Crimson Snow's Devotion"} The title is accompanied by smaller, vertically arranged phonetic symbols. Crescent moon and snowflake-shaped decorative patterns are added around the title. The poster employs a vertical composition, a full-body perspective, showcasing luxurious fabrics, shimmering highlights, and soft bokeh. The overall color scheme is ivory, gold, purple, deep red, and midnight blue.

templates.title: Romantic Lily Wedding Church Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 浪漫百合婚礼教堂肖像

templates.prompt: A brightly lit, richly detailed anime-style wedding portrait depicts two brides in a romantic white chapel, surrounded by soft ivory light, sheer curtains, carved arches, delicate floral arrangements, and shimmering bokeh. The vertical and elegant composition showcases details from their thighs up to their full gowns; they are close together, exuding an intimate, lily-like atmosphere. The taller bride on the left has {argument name="hair color" default="Warm chestnut brown"} Her long, wavy hair cascaded over her shoulders and back. She wore an elegant white bridal suit with a fitted tuxedo, gold buttons, a cream-colored vest, and a silk scarf. The tuxedo featured delicate floral embroidery, and she wore a boutonniere adorned with pale blue and white roses. She was visibly moved, gently wiping away tears with a handkerchief, her other hand resting on her chest, revealing a moment of profound emotion evoked by the ceremony. The shorter bride on the right had {argument name="second bride hair color" default="Long black hair"} Her hair was jet black and glossy. She wore a gorgeous off-the-shoulder white wedding dress with icy blue undertones, featuring semi-sheer lace sleeves, intricate beading, floral embroidery, layered ruffles, and a long veil adorned with tiny flowers and crystal-like details. A silver floral hair accessory cascaded down her back. She gazed tenderly at her partner, holding a cascading bouquet of white roses, blue flowers, and drooping greenery. The design emphasized the contrast between the sharply tailored prince-style suit and the exquisite fairytale-like wedding dress, showcasing the luxurious texture of the fabrics, the sheer quality of the lace, the delicate embroidery, the soft shimmering highlights, the scattered starlight, and the dreamy, touching atmosphere. The image presented {argument name="relationship theme" default="An original lily wedding between a mature, career-woman style bride and a young, nurse-style bride."} The illustrations evoke a sense of refined elegance and sophistication, employing a delicate and high-end romantic illustration style that is ethereal, graceful, and captivating.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张光影明亮、细节极其丰富的动漫风格婚礼肖像，描绘了两位新娘在浪漫的白色教堂中，周围充盈着柔和的象牙色光芒、轻薄的窗帘、雕花拱门、淡雅的花艺布置以及闪烁的焦外成像。构图呈竖向且优雅，展示了两人从大腿以上到全身礼服的细节，她们紧紧依偎，呈现出亲密的百合氛围。左侧较高的新娘留着 {argument name="hair color" default="暖栗棕色"} 的长波浪卷发，垂落在肩头和背部，身着精致的白色新娘西装，搭配修身燕尾服、金色纽扣、奶油色马甲、丝绸领巾，燕尾处带有细腻的花卉刺绣，并佩戴着点缀淡蓝色的白玫瑰胸花。她神情动容，正用手帕轻轻擦拭泪水，另一只手放在胸前，展现出被仪式感动的瞬间。右侧较矮的新娘留着 {argument name="second bride hair color" default="黑色长发"}，发质乌黑亮丽，身着华丽的露肩白色婚纱，带有冰蓝色调，配有半透明蕾丝袖、复杂的珠饰、花卉刺绣、层叠的荷叶边，以及装饰着细小花朵和水晶般细节的长头纱。头侧装饰着银色花卉发饰，带有垂坠感。她温柔地抬头注视着伴侣，手中捧着由白玫瑰、蓝色花朵和垂坠绿植组成的瀑布式手捧花。强调剪裁利落的王子风西装与精致童话风婚纱之间的对比，展现奢华的面料质感、蕾丝的通透感、精细的刺绣、柔和的辉光高光、飘散的星光，以及梦幻感人的氛围。让画面呈现出 {argument name="relationship theme" default="一位成熟职场女性风格新娘与一位年轻护士风格新娘之间的原创百合婚礼"} 的感觉，采用精致、高端的浪漫插画风格绘制，空灵、优雅且动人。

templates.title: A Starry Night Lily Wedding at the Moonlight Cathedral

titleLocalized.zh: 月光大教堂中的星辰百合婚礼

templates.prompt: A highly detailed, anime-style, glamorous fantasy illustration of a yuri wedding, featuring full-body portraits of two brides walking hand-in-hand down the aisle in a starlit cathedral at night. The bride on the left is a tall, elegant, and androgynous woman with {argument name="left character hair color" default="warm brown"} The bride on the right has long, thick hair braided into a side plait. She wears a white, aristocratic wedding suit with fitted trousers, white high-heeled boots, a ruffled bow tie, multiple gold chains, embroidered gold thread patterns, a floral boutonniere, and a dramatic long white coat with a deep midnight blue starry sky pattern underneath. The bride on the right is an elegant woman with long hair {argument name="right character hair color" default="silver-white"} With her super long, wavy hair, adorned with a jeweled crown and a sheer veil, and dressed in a gorgeous outfit {argument name="wedding dress style" default="Fluffy white starry lace ball gown"} It features semi-transparent layered sleeves, delicate silver embroidery, star and moon patterns, shimmering beads, and tiny red gemstones adorning the skirt. She holds a bouquet of flowers.{argument name="bouquet flowers" default="Bouquet of white lilies and roses"} Their expressions were serene and romantic, huddled together as if in the midst of a ceremony. The scene was set in a Gothic cathedral shimmering with moonlight, featuring soaring, ornate arches, stained-glass-like windows, hanging banners, candles, white floral arrangements, and star decorations. Two enormous crescent moons were visible in the sky and on either side, with two vertical ceremonial banners and two dark-colored winged bird or griffin statues in the foreground. The background was rich and vibrant.{argument name="sky color" default="Deep blue sapphire"} A starry sky, accompanied by shimmering particles, softly falling petals, and polished reflective floors with gold patterns. Utilizing ultra-fine fabric textures, luminous highlights, delicate lace, sparkling jewelry, elegant compositions, a dreamy and romantic feel, a grand wedding atmosphere, soft and ethereal lighting, and a sophisticated and luxurious color palette of white, silver, gold, and midnight blue.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具细节的动漫风格华丽奇幻百合婚礼插画，全身肖像，描绘两位新娘在夜晚的星辰大教堂中挽手走过红毯。左侧新娘是一位高挑、优雅且中性化的女性，留着 {argument name="left character hair color" default="暖棕色"} 的长发，发丝厚实并编成侧边麻花辫，身着贵族风格白色婚礼西装，搭配修身长裤、白色高跟靴、荷叶边领结、多层金链、刺绣金丝花纹、花卉胸花，以及一件内衬为深午夜蓝星空图案的戏剧性长款白外套。右侧新娘是一位优雅的女性，留着 {argument name="right character hair color" default="银白色"} 的超长波浪卷发，佩戴珠宝皇冠和透明头纱，身着华丽的 {argument name="wedding dress style" default="蓬松的白色星辰蕾丝舞会礼服"}，配有半透明层叠袖子、精致的银色刺绣、星月图案、闪亮的珠饰，以及裙摆上点缀的细小红色宝石。她手持一束 {argument name="bouquet flowers" default="白百合与玫瑰花束"}。她们表情宁静而浪漫，紧紧依偎，仿佛正在仪式中行进。场景设定为一座闪烁着月光的哥特式教堂，拥有高耸华丽的拱门、类似彩色玻璃的窗棂、悬挂的旗帜、蜡烛、白色花艺和星辰装饰。建筑与天空中可见 2 轮巨大的新月，两侧前景处有 2 面垂直的仪式旗帜和 2 座深色的带翼鸟类或狮鹫雕像。背景是浓郁的 {argument name="sky color" default="深蓝宝石色"} 星空，伴有闪烁的微粒、空中飘落的柔和花瓣，以及带有金色图案的抛光反光地板。运用超精细的织物纹理、发光高光、精致蕾丝、闪耀珠宝、优雅构图、梦幻奇幻浪漫感、宏伟的婚礼氛围、柔和空灵的灯光，以及白色、银色、金色和午夜蓝组成的精致奢华色调。

templates.title: JoJo-style duck mascot Stand character profile

titleLocalized.zh: JoJo 风格鸭子吉祥物替身角色档案

templates.prompt: This is a full-page comic-style parody character profile illustration against a distressed off-white paper background. Inspired by the Stand user profile pages from JoJo's Bizarre Adventure, it features bold ink lines, hatching shadows, a dramatic pose, and stylized Japanese text. The central figure is an anthropomorphic duck mascot athlete, confidently striding forward, one gloved hand pointing directly at the audience, the other clenched into a fist. He has a round, light yellow duck head, a bright orange beak, large, shiny black eyes, and a fierce, determined expression fueled by a furrowed brow. His body is as strong as a human's, wearing a dark green sleeveless soccer jersey over a white shirt, white shorts, black shoes with blue laces, and yellow and black striped knee-high socks. A lanyard around his neck displays a small image of the duck mascot and the number "No. 001". The jersey features four clearly visible sponsor-style patches and labels: "Agricultural Cooperative Milk," "Konno Glass Industry," "Sagami Welfare Village," and a small badge marked "SC'S." Behind him stands his humanoid stand, a tall, muscular, armored figure with a metallic olive-gold body, a heart-shaped badge, narrow and intimidating eyes, and a raised fist surrounded by jagged purple aura flames. Four large purple manga-style onomatopoeic characters are added around the figure, each reading "Gogo…," one located to the upper left of the stand, and the other three stacked vertically to the left of the mascot. On the left side of the page, there is a profile text field consisting of 6 Japanese text separated by horizontal lines: "スタンド名: ガミティ", "Gender: Male", "见た目: ダチョウのマスコット", "年颢: Unknown", "Height: 175cm", "Occupation: Masato/ PR activity". On the right, place a large spiked speech bubble filled with bold vertical Japanese text: "オラオラオラオラオラ! 前に出るぞ! 极対にnegativeけねェーッ!" Sagamihara・Koyuki! Below, add a bottom right information block titled "Stand Name: 『Oosagami Ooo!』", with the subtitle "(SC Sagamihara Chapter 『Oosagami Ooo!』 yori)", followed by a paragraph titled "Stand Ability:", which describes an emotional amplification ability in dense Japanese text. In the bottom left corner, there is a purple-filled radar chart, 6 The axes are labeled as follows: "Destructive Power B", "Spirit B", "Range D", "Growth Potential C", "Precision Movement C", and "Sustainability C". The overall composition should present a dramatic comic magazine character introduction page feel, with the mascot in front and the Stand behind, using a strong perspective shortening effect, full of dynamic comic energy, and creating a humorous contrast between the cute sports mascot and the extremely serious supernatural battle performance.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张全页漫画风格的恶搞角色档案插图，背景为做旧的米白色纸张，设计灵感源自 JoJo 的替身使者资料页，具有粗犷的墨线、排线阴影、戏剧性的姿势以及风格化的日文文字。中心人物是一个拟人化的鸭子吉祥物运动员，正自信地大步向前，一只戴着手套的手直指观众，另一只手紧握成拳。他有着圆圆的浅黄色鸭头、亮橙色的喙、巨大的黑色亮眼，以及因皱眉而显得凶猛坚定的表情。他的身体像人类一样强壮，穿着深绿色无袖足球衫，内搭白色衬衫，下身穿白色短裤，脚蹬黑色鞋子配青色鞋带，以及黄黑横条纹过膝袜。脖子上挂着一条挂绳，上面系着一张 ID 证件，显示着鸭子吉祥物的小头像和“No.001”字样。球衣上有 4 个清晰可见的赞助商风格补丁和标签：“農協牛乳”、“今野硝子工業”、“相模福祉村”以及一个标有“SC'S”的小徽章。在他身后站着他的人形替身，一个高大肌肉发达的装甲形象，有着金属橄榄金色的身体、心形胸章、狭长且令人生畏的眼睛，并举起拳头，周围环绕着锯齿状的紫色灵气火焰。在人物周围添加 4 个巨大的紫色漫画拟声词文字，每个都写着“ゴゴ…”，其中一个位于替身左上方，另外 3 个垂直堆叠在吉祥物左侧。在页面左侧，包含一个个人资料文本栏，由 6 条水平线分隔的日文文本组成：“スタンド使い名: ガミティ”、“性別: 男”、“見た目: ダチョウのマスコット”、“年齢: 不明”、“身長: 175cm”、“職業: マスコット / PR活動”。在右侧，放置一个巨大的尖刺状对话气泡，里面填满粗体的垂直日文文字：“オラオラオラオラオラ！ 前に出るぞ！絶対に負けねェーッ！ 相模原・共に行こうぜェーッ！”。在下方，添加一个右下角信息块，标题为“スタンド名:『オオサガミ・オオオォ！』”，副标题为“(SC相模原チャント「オオサガミオオオォー！」より)”，随后是一段以“スタンド能力:”为标题的段落，用密集的日文正文描述一种情感放大能力。在左下角，包含一个紫色填充的雷达图，6 个轴分别标注为：“破壊力 B”、“スピード B”、“射程距離 D”、“成長性 C”、“精密動作性 C”和“持続力 C”。整体构图应呈现出戏剧性的漫画杂志角色介绍页感，吉祥物在前，替身在后，运用强烈的透视缩短效果，充满动态的漫画能量，并在可爱的运动吉祥物与极其严肃的超自然战斗表现之间形成幽默的对比。

templates.title: JoJo-style Stand character poster

titleLocalized.zh: JoJo 风格替身角色海报

templates.prompt: A manga-style, JoJo-inspired character card poster, set in a narrow city alley, featuring dramatic cel shadows, heavy ink lines, stylized speed lines and energy, and a vertical manga page layout. The main subject is a 19-year-old Japanese man.{argument name="character name" default="タカ・ハシ"} He is shown in the foreground on the left, from mid-thigh up, with his right hand raised in a victory gesture and his left hand holding a microphone close to his mouth. His face is deliberately blurred with rectangular mosaics. He has messy hair.{argument name="hair color" default="green"} He had short hair, wore a fitted green track jacket with gold stripes on the side and a large gold phoenix emblem on the chest, zipped up, paired with black trousers and black fingerless gloves. His humanoid stand was positioned slightly behind and to his right.{argument name="stand name" default="サガミ・サヴァイブ (SAGAMI SURVIVE)"} This is a compact armored mascot design, featuring a round, pale yellow bird head, angry, sharp eyes, an orange beak, and a sleek white and green mechanical body with metallic silver muscle lines. The Stand has green shoulder armor, green gauntlets, and gold trim, with a prominent "S" on each side of the chest plate. It strikes a pose with its fists outstretched, exuding aggression and energy. It includes four unique text panels and effects: a large white rectangular description box in the upper right corner, filled with dense Japanese text explaining the Stand; a jagged white speech bubble in the center right corner containing vertically arranged Japanese battle cries; a white character information box in the lower left corner containing a Japanese profile; and a white attribute box in the lower right corner containing a radar chart labeled "STAND PARAMETERS," with Japanese and English category tags and a five-line attribute list. Four stylized purple onomatopoeic words are added around the character: a large "Gogogogo…" near the top center, a "Do" near the bottom left, and "Dodo" effects near the bottom center and bottom right. The background is a gray-blue city alley with tall buildings extending backward in perspective. Overall tone: a parody of the character introductions from *JoJo's Bizarre Adventure*, combining the tension of the manga with the comical mascot Stand concept, exquisite manga poster composition, sharp print-quality details, and the aesthetics of a Japanese magazine page.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张漫画风格、受 JoJo 启发的角色卡海报，背景设在狭窄的城市小巷中，具有戏剧性的赛璐珞阴影、厚重的墨线、风格化的速度线能量以及垂直的漫画页面布局。主体是一名 19 岁的日本年轻男性，{argument name="character name" default="タカ・ハシ"}，从大腿中部以上展示在左侧前景，右手高举握拳呈胜利姿势，左手拿着手持麦克风靠近嘴边。他的脸部被刻意用矩形马赛克模糊处理。他留着凌乱的 {argument name="hair color" default="green"} 短发，身穿一件合身的绿色运动夹克，侧面带有金色条纹，胸前印有巨大的金色凤凰徽章，拉链拉上，搭配黑色长裤和黑色露指手套。在他右侧稍后方站着他的类人型替身 {argument name="stand name" default="サガミ・サヴァイブ (SAGAMI SURVIVE)"}，这是一个紧凑的装甲吉祥物形象，有着圆圆的淡黄色鸟头、愤怒的锐利双眼、橙色喙，以及光滑的白绿相间机械身体，带有金属银色的肌肉线条。该替身拥有绿色肩甲、绿色护手、金色饰边，胸甲两侧各有一个醒目的字母 S。它摆出双拳向前出击的姿势，充满攻击性和活力。包含 4 个独特的文字面板和特效：右上角 1 个大型白色矩形描述框，填满密集的日语文字以解释该替身；右中部 1 个锯齿状白色对话气泡，内含垂直排列的日语战斗呐喊；左下角 1 个白色角色信息框，内含日语个人资料；右下角 1 个白色属性框，包含一个标有 STAND PARAMETERS 的雷达图，带有日语和英语类别标签以及 5 行属性列表。在人物周围添加 4 个风格化的紫色拟声词文字：上中部附近 1 个巨大的“ゴゴゴゴ…”，左下角附近 1 个“ド”，以及下中部和右下角附近各 1 个“ドド”特效。背景是灰蓝色的城市小巷，高楼在透视中向后延伸。整体基调：对《JoJo 的奇妙冒险》角色介绍的恶搞致敬，结合了漫画的张力与滑稽的吉祥物替身概念，精致的漫画海报构图，锐利的印刷级细节，以及日本杂志页面的美学。

templates.title: Green Armored Dual-Sword Warrior

titleLocalized.zh: 绿色铠甲双剑战士

templates.prompt: A highly dramatic solo fantasy illustration featuring a protagonist who{argument name="character type" default="East Asian female swordswoman general"} The figure is depicted in a dynamic pose against a pure black background. The image shows her from the thighs up, centered and occupying most of the frame, with her arms outstretched to the sides, holding two straight swords, one thrusting towards the left and the other tilted towards the lower right foreground. Her face is deliberately obscured by a soft, rectangular blur effect, but the rest of the figure is rendered with exquisite detail. She has long {argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown"} Her hair, tied in a high ponytail, flowed freely in the air and was adorned with a magnificent green-gold accessory. She wore an exquisite dress.{argument name="armor color" default="Dark green and antique gold"} The lamellar armor, with intricate patterns engraved on metal plates, features multi-layered cuffs, heavy bracers, an exquisitely carved breastplate, dragon-shaped shoulder armor, a decorative belt, and flowing ribbons and a cloak that encircle the entire body. The attire blends Chinese historical warrior costumes with high-fantasy aristocratic styles, adorned with intricate gold and silver filigree, brocade patterns, metal trim, and embossed details. Cinematic lighting is employed, creating bright highlights on the polished blades and armor, resulting in strong contrasts, sharp edges, and a luxurious feel. The composition should evoke the quality of a high-end game character's key visual or collectible card illustration: elegant, fierce, and valiant, highly detailed, with a semi-realistic anime art style, black negative space, no background, no extraneous objects, no text, and a square composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的单人奇幻插画，主角为一名 {argument name="character type" default="东亚女性剑客将军"}，呈现动态的动作姿态，背景为纯黑色。画面展示了她从大腿以上的部分，居中且占据大部分画幅，双臂向两侧伸展，手持两把直剑，一把向画面左侧刺出，另一把向右下方前景倾斜。她的面部被柔和的矩形模糊效果刻意遮挡，但人物其余部分刻画得极其细腻。她留着长长的 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 头发，扎成高马尾，发丝在空中飘舞，并配有华丽的绿金发饰。她身穿精致的 {argument name="armor color" default="深绿色与古金色"} 札甲，金属板上刻有繁复的花纹，搭配多层袖口、厚重的护腕、雕刻精美的胸甲、龙形肩甲、装饰性腰带，以及环绕周身的飘逸丝带和斗篷。服装融合了中国风历史战士装束与高魔奇幻贵族风格，布满了复杂的金银丝细工、锦缎图案、金属镶边和浮雕细节。采用电影级布光，在抛光的剑刃和铠甲上呈现明亮的高光，对比强烈，边缘清晰，质感奢华。构图应呈现出高端游戏角色主视觉图或收藏卡牌插画的质感：优雅、凶猛、英勇，高度细节化，半写实动漫绘画风格，黑色负空间，无背景，无额外物体，无文字，方形构图。

templates.title: Baroque Fantasy Idol Show

titleLocalized.zh: 巴洛克幻想偶像表演

templates.prompt: A full-body fantasy anime-style illustration depicts a captivating young female idol performing on a magnificent gilded stage within the grand hall of a Baroque palace. She stands dramatically at a low angle on an intricately carved gilded balcony or platform, one leg slightly bent and crossed forward, her left arm extended towards the audience with a striking perspective, and her other hand resting lightly on her chest. She is slender and elegant, with long, flowing dark brown hair adorned with a decorative headdress of flowers and ribbons. Her expression is confident, dramatic, and captivating. She wears an exquisite, ruffled performance costume in a color {argument name="dress colors" default="Royal blue, deep red, white and gold"} The outfit features a corset trimmed with gold and a red front, white lace bodice and sleeves, a layered short pleated skirt, and a large, swirling outer skirt with gold embroidery around the edges, billowing wildly like a cape. Add ornate anklets with matching ribbon flowers, white high heels or ankle boots, and luxurious, delicate fabric textures. The scene is a richly decorated interior space with a large, illuminated Gothic arched window on the left, its ceiling and left side adorned with heavy, deep red velvet curtains. A large classical painting in a magnificent frame hangs on the right wall, behind which stands a tall, ornate column. A profusion of roses and pale flowers is arranged in the lower left, and a gilded railing spans the foreground. Warm golden backlighting filters through the stained-glass-like windows, creating a bright halo, soft mist, contour lighting on the hair and clothing, and deep, cinematic shadows. A few rose petals drift down from the ceiling. Highly detailed, meticulously crafted, romantic, grand, and dynamic compositions, rich textures, and a painting style that blends realistic lighting and luxurious fantasy idol aesthetics with anime illustrations.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅全身奇幻动漫风格插画，描绘了一位迷人的年轻偶像女性在宏伟的巴洛克宫殿大厅内，于华丽的镀金舞台上进行表演。她以戏剧性的低角度姿势站在雕刻精美的金色阳台或平台上，一条腿向前微屈交叉，左臂向观众方向伸出，呈现出强烈的透视感，另一只手轻放在胸前。她身材纤细优雅，深棕色的长发随风飘动，头戴装饰性的花朵与丝带头饰。她的表情自信、充满戏剧张力且引人入胜。她身着一套精致的荷叶边表演服，颜色为 {argument name="dress colors" default="宝蓝色、深红色、白色和金色"}：紧身胸衣饰有金边和红色前襟，白色蕾丝胸部和袖子，层叠的短款褶皱裙，以及边缘带有金色刺绣、如斗篷般在周围剧烈翻飞的大型旋涡状外裙。增加带有配套丝带花朵的华丽脚踝配饰、白色高跟鞋或短靴，以及奢华细腻的织物纹理。场景为装饰丰富的室内空间，左侧有一扇巨大的发光哥特式拱窗，顶部和左侧由厚重的深红色天鹅绒窗帘装点，右侧墙壁上挂着一幅装在华丽画框中的大型古典油画，身后有一根高大的雕花立柱，左下方摆放着一簇繁茂的玫瑰和浅色花卉，前景横跨着一道镀金栏杆。温暖的金色背光穿过类似彩色玻璃的窗户，营造出明亮的光晕、柔和的雾气、发丝与服装上的轮廓光，以及深邃的电影级阴影。几片玫瑰花瓣在空中飘落。高度细节化、极致打磨、浪漫、宏伟、动态构图，丰富的纹理，带有写实光影与奢华奇幻偶像美学的绘画风格动漫插画。

templates.title: Disposable film flash Tokyo night portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 一次性胶片闪光灯东京夜景人像

templates.prompt: A cinematic nighttime street photograph taken in Tokyo, shot from an extremely low ground angle, exhibiting the snapshot style of a direct flash film camera. It possesses a rough realism, noticeable film grain, slight soft focus, deep shadows, strong contrast, and a wet, reflective surface. In the center of the foreground, a {argument name="character gender presentation" default="androgynous young women"} Keep it{argument name="hair style" default="Black straight bob haircut that partially covers the face"} She crouches low, one hand resting on the wet street after the rain, tilting towards the camera in a tense, high-fashion pose. Her face is deliberately obscured by her hair and shadows. She wears four visible pieces of clothing: an oversized black blazer, a white shirt, a black tie, and black shorts or a skirt faintly visible beneath the blazer. She also wears three visible accessories/details: a ring, a bracelet, and a pair of shimmering, colorful lace-up ankle boots with a mosaic-like sequined appearance. To her right stands a black cat with bright, reflective eyes, fully visible and alert, staring at the camera. The scene is set in a narrow city alley or side street at night, with rain, smooth asphalt, cables and electrical boxes tangled on the left wall, and two vertically illuminated signs with Japanese writing in the background. Above and to the upper right, lush flowers bloom {argument name="tree blossoms" default="Cherry blossoms"} Filling the corners, it contrasts soft flowers with the rugged textures of the city. It includes blurred backgrounds from streetlights and storefronts, reflections of red, white, and yellow lights on the pavement, and a spontaneous, primal, and slightly surreal melancholic atmosphere of the night. It utilizes wide-angle lens perspectives, documentary street photography compositions, direct flash, and disposable camera aesthetics.{argument name="film mood" default="A snapshot of Japanese nightlife in the 1990s"} The realism.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张在东京拍摄的电影感夜间街头抓拍照片，采用极低的地面视角，呈现出一次性胶片相机直闪拍摄的快照风格，具有粗粝的写实感、明显的胶片颗粒、轻微的柔焦、深邃的阴影、强烈的对比度以及湿润反光的路面。在前景中央，一位 {argument name="character gender presentation" default="中性风年轻女性"}，留着 {argument name="hair style" default="遮住部分脸庞的黑色直发波波头"}，低身蹲伏，一只手按在雨后湿漉漉的街道上，以一种紧张的时尚大片姿势向镜头倾斜。面部被头发和阴影刻意遮挡。她穿着 4 件可见的服饰：一件超大号黑色西装外套、一件白色衬衫、一条黑色领带，以及外套下隐约可见的黑色短裤或短裙。她还佩戴了 3 件可见的配饰/细节：一枚戒指、一只手镯，以及一双带有马赛克亮片外观、闪闪发光的彩色系带短靴。她右侧站着 1 只黑猫，眼睛明亮且具有反光感，完全可见且警觉地注视着镜头。场景设定在夜晚狭窄的城市小巷或侧街，伴有雨水、光滑的沥青路面、左侧墙上缠绕的电缆和配电箱，背景中有 2 个带有日文的垂直发光招牌。右上角上方，茂密盛开的 {argument name="tree blossoms" default="樱花"} 填满了角落，在柔和的花朵与粗犷的城市纹理之间形成对比。包含来自路灯和店面的远景虚化效果，路面上红色、白色和黄色的灯光倒影，以及一种自发、原始且略带超现实感的深夜忧郁氛围。使用广角镜头视角、纪实街头摄影构图、直闪灯、一次性相机美学以及 {argument name="film mood" default="1990 年代日本夜生活快照"} 的写实感。

templates.title: Queen of the Black Gold Dragon

titleLocalized.zh: 黑金龙之女王

templates.prompt: A grand, high fantasy illustration depicts a dragon queen standing on the edge of a cliff, showing her full profile and facing left. She possesses {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} Her long hair, layered and cascading below her waist, framed a calm and stern expression. She wore an exquisite crown-like headdress adorned with numerous long, horn-like golden spikes extending backward. Her attire was a magnificent fusion of royal robes and bodysuits, its main color scheme being {argument name="primary palette" default="Black, ivory, and antique gold"} The costume is adorned with intricate gold trim, vine-like gilded patterns, and elegant crackled marble-style designs. It comprises four main visual elements: a fitted black and white color-blocked armor torso, a layered long skirt with flowing panels, a dark long cape trimmed with gold, and thigh-high tight-fitting leg armor or boots. She wields a ceremonial longsword standing vertically at her side, its blade slender and ornately decorated. Behind her encircles the silhouette of a colossal black dragon, its head menacing, its wings broad, its body encircling her like a protective shadow; delicate gold vein patterns adorn its wings. The background presents a pale, minimalist fantasy landscape, with a distant cluster of Gothic spires, open plains, faintly visible waters or swamps, and distant mountains under a soft creamy sky. The composition is vertical, elegant, and cinematic, with the character slightly right-centered, the dragon's head in the upper left, and long ribbons and fabric fluttering in the wind. The style is exquisite anime-inspired fantasy concept art, featuring ultra-delicate lines, restrained colors, bright ivory white negative space, luxurious black and gold decorations, ethereal atmosphere, sharp silhouette design, and a noble and sacred dragon-like aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张宏伟的高奇幻风格插画，描绘了一位站在悬崖边缘的龙族女王，展示全身侧面像，面向左侧。她拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色"} 的长发，发丝层叠垂落至腰部以下，表情冷静而严峻，头戴精致的皇冠状头饰，饰有多个向后延伸的长角状金色尖刺。她的服饰是皇家礼服与铠甲紧身衣的华丽融合，主色调为 {argument name="primary palette" default="黑色、象牙白和古金色"}，布满了复杂的金丝镶边、藤蔓般的镀金花纹以及优雅的裂纹大理石风格图案。服装包含 4 个主要的视觉元素：修身的黑白拼色铠甲躯干、带有飘逸裁片的层叠长裙、饰有金边的深色长披风，以及及大腿的紧身腿甲或长靴。她手持 1 把垂直伫立在身侧的仪式长剑，剑身纤细且装饰华丽。在她身后环绕着 1 条巨大的黑色巨龙剪影，巨龙头部狰狞，双翼宽大，其身躯如守护之影般环绕着她；双翼上绘有细腻的金色脉络图案。背景呈现出苍白、极简的奇幻景观，下方可见 1 座遥远的哥特式尖塔建筑群、开阔的平原、隐约的水域或沼泽，以及柔和奶油色天空下的远山。构图为竖向，优雅且具有电影感，角色略微偏右居中，龙首位于左上方，长丝带和布料在风中飘动。风格为精致的动漫风奇幻概念艺术，具有超细腻的线条、克制的色彩、明亮的象牙白负空间、奢华的黑金装饰、空灵的氛围、锐利的剪影设计，以及高贵神圣的龙族意境。

templates.title: Mecha Angel Girl in the Sky

titleLocalized.zh: 地球上空的机甲天使少女

templates.prompt: A dynamic, anime-style full-body illustration depicts a futuristic mecha angel girl floating in outer space above Earth, assuming a dramatic diagonal pose as if gliding or diving forward. She has short, messy hair {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} Her hair features soft, layered bangs, and she has a slender figure. Her face is partially obscured and turned to the right. Her body blends human and mechanical features: two metallic robotic arms and two robotic legs with black joints and polished silver armor plates are visible. She wears a white formal uniform with a fitted bodice, puffy short sleeves, gold trim, a flared skirt, and delicate white lace petticoat details. A luminous blue gem badge with ornate gold eye-shaped decorations adorns the chest and each sleeve, totaling three blue gem badges. The neckline is high, decorated with small gold stars, and a silver belt cinches her waist. Two enormous mechanical wings extend from her back, each composed of layered white feather-like panels attached to a segmented metal frame. Her left arm extends backward, mechanical fingers spread, and her legs are bent in flight, one knee raised and the other extended downward. The background is a deep black space, dotted with scattered starlight. Earth's curved horizon occupies the lower left and bottom edges, radiating a bright blue atmospheric halo, with white cloud patterns visible on the planet's surface. It employs cinematic contour lighting, glossy reflections on metallic components, crisp and clean anime-style lines, highly detailed fabric folds, elegant sci-fi fantasy design, and a sense of weightless movement.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满动感的动漫风格全身插画，描绘了一位漂浮在地球上方外太空的未来派机甲天使少女，她呈现出一种戏剧性的对角线动作姿态，仿佛正在滑翔或向前俯冲。她留着短而凌乱的 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色"} 头发，配有柔软的层次感刘海，身材纤细，面部部分被遮挡并转向右侧。她的身体融合了人类与机械特征：可见 2 只金属质感的机器人手臂和 2 条带有黑色关节及抛光银色装甲板的机器人腿。她身穿一件白色礼仪制服，配有修身胸衣、泡泡短袖、金色饰边、喇叭裙摆以及精致的白色蕾丝衬裙细节。胸部和双袖各镶嵌有一枚发光的蓝色宝石徽章，并带有华丽的金色眼状装饰，总计 3 枚蓝色宝石徽章。领口较高，饰有小巧的金色星星，腰间系有银色腰带。她的背部向外延伸出 2 只巨大的机械羽翼，每只翅膀由附着在金属分段框架上的层叠白色羽毛状面板组成。她的左臂向后伸展，机械手指张开，双腿在飞行中弯曲，一只膝盖抬起，另一条腿向下伸展。背景是深邃的黑色太空，布满细碎的星光，地球弯曲的地平线占据了左下方和底部边缘，散发着明亮的蓝色大气光环，行星表面可见白色的云层图案。采用电影级的轮廓光、金属部件上的光泽反射、清晰利落的动漫线条、高度细致的织物褶皱、优雅的科幻奇幻设计，以及失重运动的质感。

templates.title: Space Shuttle re-entering the atmosphere above Earth

titleLocalized.zh: 地球上空的重返大气层航天飞机

templates.prompt: A cinematic, hard science fiction illustration depicts a futuristic space shuttle performing an atmospheric reentry maneuver above Earth. The perspective is three-quarters of the way to the left, with the shuttle flying from right to left. The spacecraft is a streamlined white delta-wing orbiter with two vertical tail fins, two large rear-mounted engines, a sharp nose, dark cockpit windows, finely detailed panel lines, slight wear marks, and small black technical markings. The fuselage is printed with {argument name="ship name" default="STARSTREAK"} The text is incomplete and appears to be a fragment from a larger document. A long, dynamic orange-white fire trail, created by a blazing plasma sheath enveloping the nose, belly, wing edges, and upper rear of the space shuttle, dominates the upper background. The shuttle is clearly visible in the intense heat of the shockwave, its fuselage illuminated by bright outlines and scorching reflections. Below, a curved Earth occupies the lower half of the image, revealing the thin blue atmosphere, clouds, ocean, and a clearly defined spiral storm. Above lies the deep, dark blue of space, dotted with faint starlight. This highly detailed aerospace concept art is dynamic, featuring realistic lighting effects, high contrast, sharp focus, an epic orbital perspective, and a painterly/illustrated style. Aside from the fuselage markings, there is no text covering the shuttle.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅电影质感的硬科幻太空插画，描绘了一架未来感十足的航天飞机在地球上空进行大气层重返作业。视角为左前方四分之三处，航天飞机正从右向左飞行。该飞行器为流线型白色三角翼轨道器，配有 2 个垂直尾翼、2 个大型后置引擎、尖锐的机头、深色驾驶舱窗户、细腻的面板线条、轻微的磨损痕迹以及小型黑色技术标识。机身上印有 {argument name="ship name" default="STARSTREAK"} 字样。炽热的重返大气层等离子鞘包裹着机头、腹部、机翼边缘和后部上方，形成了一条长长的、充满动感的橙白色火尾，占据了背景上方的大部分区域。航天飞机在炽热的激波层中清晰可见，机身带有明亮的轮廓光和灼热的反射光。下方，弯曲的地球占据了画面的下半部分，可见稀薄的蓝色大气层边缘、云系、海洋以及一个清晰的螺旋风暴。上方是深邃的黑蓝色太空，点缀着微弱的星光。超精细的航空航天概念艺术，极具动感，写实的灯光效果，高对比度，焦点清晰，史诗般的轨道视角，绘画插画风格，除机身标识外无任何文字覆盖。

templates.title: Flame Angel in the Black Void

titleLocalized.zh: 黑色虚空中的烈焰天使

templates.prompt: A dramatic fantasy illustration depicts a female angel composed entirely of flames, suspended against a pure black background. Her body is translucent, sculpted from luminous orange, amber, and blazing white flames, with brighter highlights on her head, chest, knees, and the tips of her calves. She possesses two enormous wings formed by trails of flame, arching upwards at her back, and her long hair flows like a burning halo around her head. Her pose is dynamic and graceful, like a ballerina: her torso is bent, her left arm extends outwards, one leg is bent, and the other extends downwards into a pointed, fiery tip, as if she is descending or swooping through the air. She wears a short skirt or skirt-like garment also composed of flames. Turbulent, smoke-like bands of flame and trails of movement surround her body, especially behind her wings and around her lower body, creating a sense of speed and supernatural energy. High contrast, luminous edges, ethereal anatomy, no ground, no props, no text, centered vertical composition—a cinematic fantasy aesthetic of fire spirits.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅戏剧性的奇幻插画，描绘了一个完全由火焰构成的女性天使形象，悬浮在纯黑色的背景中。她的身体呈半透明状，由发光的橙色、琥珀色和炽热的白焰雕琢而成，头部、胸部、膝盖和小腿尖端有更明亮的高光。她拥有两只由火焰轨迹形成的巨大羽翼，在背后向上拱起，长发飘逸，如燃烧的光环般环绕在头部前方。她的姿态动感且优美，如同芭蕾舞者：躯干弯曲，左臂向外伸展，一条腿弯曲，另一条腿向下延伸成尖细的火焰末端，仿佛正在空中降落或俯冲。她穿着一件同样由火焰构成的短裙或短裙状服饰。身体周围环绕着湍流般的烟雾状火焰带和运动轨迹，特别是在翅膀后方和下半身周围，营造出速度感和超自然能量。高对比度，发光的边缘，空灵的解剖结构，无地面，无道具，无文字，居中垂直构图，电影级奇幻火灵美学。

templates.title: Candid portraits taken at a breakfast shop in Taiwan

titleLocalized.zh: 台湾早餐店抓拍人像

templates.prompt: A snapshot taken with a smartphone captures a young East Asian woman sitting at a small round table in a bustling, retro Taiwanese breakfast shop. She is the subject, framed from mid-thigh upwards, facing the camera in a casual pose. Her face is softly blurred in a rectangular pattern. She has shoulder-length straight hair parted in the middle, wears small gold hoop earrings, and a gold necklace with a delicate heart-shaped pendant. She wears a fitted white spaghetti-strap tank top and high-waisted blue denim shorts with slightly distressed hems. She holds a piece of fried dough stick (youtiao) to her mouth in one hand, and another broken piece on the table in the other. Four clearly visible food and drinks are on the table: a plate of fried dough sticks, a scallion pancake wrapped in black sesame seeds, a white styrofoam takeout box containing two pancakes (one coated with dark soy sauce and sprinkled with scallions), and a cup of takeout soy milk with a red straw and red Chinese characters printed on it. The restaurant's interior is compact and brightly lit by fluorescent lights. The floor is terrazzo, and the background is filled with diners. Behind her are large windows and signs on the wall, featuring striking red traditional Chinese characters listing breakfast items such as soy milk, fried dough sticks, rice balls, sesame seed cakes, and egg pancakes. Several customers are dining inside, while staff are busy behind the metal counter. A small TV on the wall plays a news anchor's message, and a menu hangs on the wall with red Chinese characters and prices. Realistic photography, natural indoor lighting, shallow depth of field, a vibrant local atmosphere, a slightly wide-angle mobile phone shooting perspective, documentary-style food and travel aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张用智能手机抓拍的照片，拍摄了一位年轻的东亚女性坐在一家繁忙的怀旧台湾早餐店里的小圆桌旁。她是主体，取景范围从大腿中部向上，她以随意的坐姿面向镜头。她的面部经过柔和的矩形模糊处理。她留着中分齐肩直发，戴着小巧的金色圆环耳环，以及一条带有精致心形吊坠的金色项链。她身穿修身的白色细肩带背心和高腰蓝色牛仔短裤，裤边有轻微的磨损设计。她一只手拿着一块油条靠近嘴边，另一只手在桌上拿着另一块掰开的油条。桌上摆放着 4 样清晰可见的食物和饮品：一盘油条块、一个包裹着的撒有黑芝麻的葱油饼、一个装有 2 个煎饼的白色泡沫外卖盒（其中一个涂有深色酱油膏并撒有葱花），以及一杯插着红色吸管、印有红色中文字样的外卖豆浆。餐厅内部空间紧凑，日光灯照明明亮，地面为水磨石风格，背景中坐满了用餐的食客。她身后是大窗户和墙上的标牌，上面印有醒目的红色繁体中文字，包括豆浆、油条、饭团、烧饼和蛋饼等早餐品项。店内有几位正在用餐的顾客，工作人员在金属柜台后忙碌，墙上挂着一台播放着女主播新闻的小电视，还有一个挂着的菜单项目，上面写着红色的中文字和价格。写实摄影，自然室内光，浅景深，生动的当地氛围，轻微的广角手机拍摄视角，纪实美食旅游美学。

templates.prompt: A candid street food photo taken in a narrow, old Taiwanese breakfast shop, using a realistic mobile phone photography style, with soft natural sunlight, presenting a slightly warm documentary-like quality. A person with {argument name="hair color" default="black"} A young East Asian woman with shoulder-length straight hair sits on a small red plastic stool, facing a red laminate table. She holds a steaming scallion pancake roll in both hands, her face deliberately obscured by a large, softly blurred rectangle. She wears a white tank top with thin straps and a bow, light blue high-waisted denim shorts, and a silver heart-shaped pendant necklace. Her posture is relaxed, her body slightly turned to the side, her legs peeking out from under the table. On the table are two white plates containing sliced ​​scallion pancakes, a steaming paper cup with red Chinese characters, and a white soup bowl containing dark vegetables and tofu or bean curd cubes, accompanied by a white soup spoon. Crumbs and paper wrappers are scattered on the table. Steam is clearly visible rising from the cup and bowl. The pancake roll in her hands appears generously filled, with egg, scallion pancake layers, and filling clearly visible. The background showcases the interior of a bustling local restaurant: behind a glass display case are two staff members, a Coca-Cola refrigerator, overhead fluorescent lights, an electric fan, tiled walls, and numerous Chinese menus and food posters with prices in New Taiwan Dollars. Clearly visible traditional Chinese signs are included, featuring items such as scallion pancakes, egg pancakes, and soy milk, with price tags ranging from NT$30 to NT$55. To the right is a glass display case piled high with fried dough sticks and pastries. To the left, a portion of the open-air storefront leading to the street is visible, with motorcycles and nearby buildings faintly discernible. The composition is vertical, cropped from head to knee in a seated pose, with the subject centered. The shallow depth of field retains sufficient detail to clearly present the shop environment, with realistic skin tones, creating a relaxed morning breakfast atmosphere and showcasing the everyday, busy beauty of Taipei's street food scene.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张在狭窄老旧的台湾早餐店拍摄的街头美食抓拍照片，采用写实的手机摄影风格，光线为柔和的自然日光，呈现出略带暖调的纪录片质感。一位留着 {argument name="hair color" default="black"} 肩部长度直发的东亚年轻女性，坐在红色的塑料小凳上，面前是红色的层压板桌，她正对着镜头，双手捧着一个热气腾腾的葱油饼卷。她的面部被一个大的柔和模糊矩形刻意遮挡。她身穿带有细肩带和蝴蝶结装饰的白色吊带背心、浅蓝色高腰牛仔短裤，佩戴着银色心形吊坠项链。姿态放松，身体微微侧向，桌下露出双腿。桌上摆放着 2 个装有切片葱油饼的白盘子、1 个印有红色中文字样的冒热气纸杯、1 个盛有深色蔬菜和豆腐或豆花块的白汤碗，配有一把白色汤勺，桌上散落着碎屑和纸包装。杯子和碗旁应有清晰可见的蒸汽升腾。她手中的饼卷看起来馅料十足，鸡蛋、葱油饼层和内馅清晰可见。背景展示了地道繁忙的本地餐馆内部：玻璃展示柜后有 2 名工作人员、一台可口可乐冰箱、头顶的日光灯管、电风扇、瓷砖墙壁，以及多张带有新台币价格的中文菜单和美食海报。包含清晰可见的繁体中文招牌，如葱油饼、蛋饼、豆浆，以及 30 到 55 元新台币左右的价格标签。右侧展示一个玻璃柜，里面堆放着炸油条或糕点。左侧露出部分通往街道的开放式店面，隐约可见摩托车和邻近建筑。构图为竖向，从头部到膝盖的全身坐姿裁剪，主体居中，景深较浅但保留了足够的细节以清晰呈现店铺环境，肤色真实，充满休闲的清晨早餐氛围，展现出台北街头美食的日常繁忙美感。

templates.prompt: A candid photo taken in the style of a street-side café, showing a young East Asian woman sitting at a small round table in a simple Taiwanese breakfast shop. She has a slender, curvaceous figure, wearing a fitted white ribbed crew-neck tank top and light gray drawstring sweatpants, adorned with a delicate necklace. She leans slightly forward towards the camera, holding a Taiwanese rice ball wrapped in a clear plastic bag near her mouth, as if about to take a bite. Her face is deliberately obscured by a large, centrally located rectangular blurred area. In the lower left foreground, on the table, is a large plastic takeout cup with a sealed lid and straw, containing light beige milk tea or soy milk, printed with cute cartoon characters and a few Chinese characters. Also on the table is a white paper food bag with an orange pattern. The scene depicts the interior of a realistic casual breakfast shop: on the far left is a window opening onto the street, letting in natural light and revealing the shadows of green leaves, parked motorcycles, and a white car outside; a retro-style vertical menu hangs on the left wall, displaying colorful Chinese characters listing breakfast and drinks; at the top background is a large horizontal menu item, densely covered with lines of blue and red Chinese text and prices; to the right rear is an open stainless steel kitchen counter, where a blurry image of a staff member can be seen standing, with other Chinese signs on the metal fixtures. The composition is a mid-range shot, centered on a seated woman, with soft, natural lighting, a slightly warm color palette, and realistic skin texture, conveying a sense of everyday documentary and authentic Taiwanese street food shop aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张街边咖啡馆风格的抓拍照片，一位年轻的东亚女性坐在一家朴素的台湾早餐店内的小圆桌旁，采用明亮的自然光拍摄，呈现出写实的智能手机摄影风格。她留着深棕色至黑色的长波浪卷发，披散在肩背上，身材苗条且有曲线，身穿一件修身的白色罗纹圆领短款背心和浅灰色抽绳运动裤，佩戴着一条精致的项链。她身体微微前倾朝向镜头，一只手拿着一份用透明塑料袋包裹的台湾饭团靠近嘴边，仿佛正要咬一口。她的脸部被一个居中的大矩形模糊块刻意遮挡。左下角前景的桌上放着 1 个带有密封盖和吸管的大号塑料外卖杯，里面装着浅米色的奶茶或豆浆，杯身上印有可爱的卡通人物和少量中文字样。桌上还有 1 个印有橙色图案的白色纸质食品袋。场景为真实的休闲早餐店内部：最左侧是一扇通往街道的窗户，透进自然光，可以看到窗外的绿叶阴影、停放的机车和一辆白色汽车；左侧墙上挂着 1 块垂直的复古菜单牌，上面写着五颜六色的中文字，列出了早餐和饮品；顶部背景处是 1 块宽大的横向菜单项目，上面密密麻麻地写着多行蓝色和红色的中文文字及价格；右后方是一个开放式的不锈钢厨房操作台，可以看到 1 名模糊的店员站在后面，金属装置上还有其他中文标识。构图为中景，以坐着的女性为中心，光影柔和自然，色调略暖，皮肤纹理真实，具有日常纪实感和地道的台湾本地小吃店美学。

templates.prompt: A candid mobile phone photo of a young East Asian woman sitting at a small table in a Taiwanese casual breakfast shop, taken at 9:16 AM with a vertical medium shot. She has shoulder-length straight hair, dark brown to black in color, styled in a side part; she is wearing {argument name="top color" default="Light gray"} She wears a fitted ribbed tank top, high-waisted light blue denim shorts, and a loose, sheer white cardigan that has slipped off her shoulders. She sits in a black chair, holding a foil-wrapped rice ball or sandwich near her mouth, as if about to take a bite. A large rectangular blurred mask is placed in the center of her face, covering the entire area. On the table in the lower left foreground, a large takeaway cup with a plastic lid and a red straw is placed. The background shows an open-air traditional breakfast stall, complete with a stainless steel counter, glass warmer, condiment bottles, a staff member behind the counter, a wall fan, and a menu with red and blue Chinese characters and prices printed above. The glass door on the left should also include Chinese signage and opening hours. The lighting should be natural sunlight, slightly soft, with realistic skin tones, creating a casual street-style feel. The shallow depth of field but clear background details create an authentic Taiwanese urban snack shop atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张年轻东亚女性坐在台式休闲早餐店小桌前的手机抓拍照片，9:16 竖构图的中景镜头。她留着齐肩直发，发色为深棕至黑色，侧分发型；身穿 {argument name="top color" default="浅灰色"} 的修身罗纹吊带背心、高腰浅蓝色牛仔短裤，以及一件从双肩滑落的宽松透视白色开衫。她坐在黑色椅子上，双手拿着一个锡纸包裹的饭团或三明治靠近嘴边，仿佛正要咬下去。身体略微向右侧倾，姿态自然放松，呈现出柔和的生活照美感。在她的面部中心位置放置一个大的长方形模糊遮挡块，覆盖整个面部区域。在左下方前景的桌子上，放置 1 个带塑料盖和 1 根红色吸管的大号外带杯。背景展示传统早餐摊位的开放式店面，配有不锈钢柜台、玻璃保温柜、调味瓶、柜台后 1 名工作人员、1 台壁扇，以及上方印有红蓝色中文字符和价格的菜单项目。左侧玻璃门上还应包含中文标识和营业时间。光线应为自然日光，略显柔和，肤色真实，具有休闲街拍的写实感，景深较浅但背景细节依然清晰，营造出地道的台湾城市小吃店氛围。

templates.title: Back-to-back dark-style pretty boy portraits

titleLocalized.zh: 背靠背暗黑系美少年肖像

templates.prompt: This highly dramatic and painterly anime-style illustration depicts two androgynous, handsome young men standing back-to-back in a dark and romantic historical fantasy setting. The figure on the left is taller, framed from mid-thigh up, with extremely long, messy black hair falling over his shoulders and chest. He wears a half-open white shirt, a fitted black vest, a brown belt, and a magnificent black military-style coat draped over his shoulders, adorned with gold embroidery, gold buttons, large gold epaulettes, fur trim on the collar, and a round, reddish-beige rose knot detail near his shoulder. His pose is relaxed yet dramatic, one hand brushing back his hair, his head slightly tilted back. The figure on the right is slightly shorter, framed from waist up, turned sideways with his back to the viewer. He has messy, short black hair, wears a white turtleneck shirt, a black vest, and dark gloves, his arms crossed, exuding a cool and reserved aura. Both characters possess pale skin and a melancholic, handsome youthful charm. At the center of the background is a huge, luminous red sun or moon, set against a backdrop with a gold-leaf texture and a black, decadent style. A deep red curtain or mist hangs in the lower left, while glowing red petals or embers drift in the air. Red flower branches adorn the right side. The design employs rich shades of deep red, black, antique gold, and ivory, combined with cinematic contour lighting, layered textures, meticulous costume rendering, and elegant brushstrokes, resulting in a final effect that is emotionally resonant, nostalgic, and highly detailed.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性与绘画感的动漫风格插画，描绘了两位中性风美少年在暗黑浪漫的历史奇幻构图中背靠背站立。左侧人物较高，取景自大腿中部以上，留着极长的凌乱黑发，垂落在肩头与胸前，身穿半敞的白衬衫、修身黑色马甲、棕色皮带，肩上披着一件华丽的黑色军装风格外套，饰有金色刺绣、金色纽扣、大型金色肩章、领口毛皮镶边，以及肩部附近的圆形红米色玫瑰花结细节。他的姿态放松而富有戏剧性，一只手撩向发间，头微微后仰。右侧人物略矮，取景自腰部以上，侧身背对，留着凌乱的短黑发，身穿白色高领衬衫、黑色马甲、深色手套，双臂交叉，散发出冷峻内敛的气质。两位角色均拥有苍白的皮肤和忧郁的美少年气质。背景中心是一轮巨大的发光红日或红月，衬托在带有金箔质感与黑色颓废风格的背景之上，左下方有深红色的帷幕或薄雾，空中飘散着发光的红色花瓣或余烬，右侧点缀着红色花枝。采用浓郁的深红、黑色、古金与象牙色调，结合电影级轮廓光、层叠质感、精细的服装渲染、优雅的笔触，呈现出一种充满情感、怀旧且高细节的最终效果。

templates.title: Dual-themed anime boy in a crystal box

titleLocalized.zh: 水晶盒中的双主题动漫少年

templates.prompt: A richly detailed fantasy anime illustration depicts two boys lying in transparent, crystal-like display cases, suspended in a dark theatrical space, with contrasting themes on either side. The left box, in warm olive green and gold tones, features a calm and elegant boy with short, light blond hair, fair skin, a black shirt, a loosely tied gold striped tie, beige trousers, and black leather shoes. He sits relaxed, holding a small flower close to his face. Ten clearly visible decorative elements surround him: a kraft paper bag filled with greenery, a metal mug, a lemon, a zebra figurine, an open book, a sunflower, drooping green vines, numerous floating soap bubbles, white floral patterns etched on the glass, and greenery covering the bottom of the box. The right box, in dramatic deep red and black tones, features a playful and confident boy with messy, medium-length brown hair, fair skin, and a black outfit with red accents and multiple layers of accessories. He kneels, holding a red rose in his mouth or hand. He is surrounded by 10 clearly visible decorative elements: a bone-white ornament, a multifaceted ruby, a multifaceted light-colored gemstone, a card or tag hanging on a chain, a red book, meat or food wrapped on a tray, a small lion statue, a red snack bag, paw prints on the bottom of the box, and shimmering red crystal fragments. The background is vertically split between the two boxes, presenting a star-studded cosmic gap, complete with hanging curtains, triangular pennants, a paw print pattern faintly visible on the red side, and a total of 4 balloons: 2 white and olive green on the left, and 2 red and black on the right. The composition is gorgeous, glossy, and cinematic, with dramatic reflections on the glass, rich highlights, floating particles, luxurious textures, and intricate props, creating a nostalgic storybook atmosphere. Rendered in a refined modern anime style, it is ultra-detailed, elegant, dreamlike, and full of emotional resonance.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张细节极其丰富的奇幻动漫插画，描绘了两位少年分别躺在透明水晶般的展示盒中，悬浮在黑暗的剧场空间里，两侧呈现出对比鲜明的主题。左侧盒子采用温暖的橄榄绿和金色调，盒中是一位冷静优雅的少年，留着浅金色短发，皮肤白皙，身穿黑色衬衫，系着松开的金色条纹领带，搭配米色长裤和黑色皮鞋，姿态放松，手持一朵小花靠近脸庞。他周围有 10 个清晰可见的装饰元素：1 个装满绿叶植物的牛皮纸袋、1 个金属马克杯、1 个柠檬、1 个斑马小雕像、1 本打开的书、1 朵向日葵、垂下的绿色藤蔓、许多漂浮的肥皂泡、玻璃上蚀刻的白色花卉图案，以及覆盖盒底的绿植。右侧盒子采用戏剧性的深红色和黑色调，盒中是一位顽皮自信的少年，留着凌乱的棕色中长发，皮肤白皙，身穿带有红色点缀和多层配饰的黑色服装，单膝抬起，嘴里咬着或手中拿着一朵红玫瑰。他周围有 10 个清晰可见的装饰元素：1 个骨白色的装饰物、1 颗多面红宝石、1 颗多面浅色宝石、1 个挂在链条上的卡片或标签、1 本红色的书、1 个托盘上包裹着的肉或食物、1 个狮子小雕像、1 个红色零食袋、盒底的爪痕，以及闪烁的红色水晶碎片。背景在两个盒子之间垂直分裂，呈现出星光熠熠的宇宙缝隙，配有垂下的窗帘、三角形彩旗串、红色一侧隐约可见的爪印图案，以及总共 4 个气球：左侧 2 个为白色和橄榄绿色，右侧 2 个为红色和黑色。构图华丽、光泽感强且具有电影质感，玻璃上有戏剧性的反射，高光丰富，漂浮的微粒，奢华的质感，复杂的道具，营造出怀旧的故事书氛围。以精致的现代动漫主视觉风格渲染，超细节，优雅，梦幻且充满情感共鸣。

templates.title: Portrait of a wounded monk in a dark fantasy style

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑奇幻风格受伤僧侣肖像

templates.prompt: An anime illustration with a dark fantasy atmosphere depicts an injured young man, with {argument name="hair color" default="Gray Gold"} His short, disheveled hair was slumped against a mottled white plaster wall. His face was mostly turned away from the camera and hidden in shadow, exuding a mysterious yet weary aura. He wore a loose black kimono robe, open at the chest to reveal lean, muscular muscles, and a deep red sash around his waist. A string of deep red prayer beads hung around his neck, while another string was wrapped in his hand and scattered on the floor. Beside him leaned an ornate black staff, its head adorned with rings and spear-like tips, resting against his shoulder. On the wall behind him, in the upper right corner, were obvious deep red bloodstains and drips, suggesting a recent battle. In the foreground, prayer beads, broken metal ornaments, several paper talismans inscribed with black calligraphy, and a red flower were scattered on the floor. The warm afternoon sunlight slanted into the frame from the left, creating a strong contrast of light and shadow on the folds of his robe, his hands, his chest, and the texture of the wall. The painting uses oil paint strokes, with delicate depictions of fabric and skin textures, a melancholic atmosphere, and an elegant composition. It employs a vertical portrait composition and presents a cinematic, anime-style visual aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满暗黑奇幻氛围的动漫插画，描绘了一位受伤的年轻男子，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="灰金色"} 的凌乱短发，瘫坐在斑驳的白色灰泥墙边。他的面部大多背对镜头并隐没在阴影中，透出一种神秘而疲惫的气质。他身穿一件宽松的黑色和服长袍，胸前敞开，露出精瘦的肌肉线条，腰间系着深红色的腰带。一串深红色的念珠挂在他的颈间，另一串念珠缠绕在他手中，散落在地板上。他身旁斜靠着一根装饰繁复的黑色法杖，杖头带有圆环和矛状尖端，斜倚在他的肩头。身后的墙壁上，右上角有明显的深红色血迹和滴痕，暗示着刚刚经历了一场战斗。前景的地板上散落着念珠、破碎的金属饰品、几张写有黑色书法文字的纸质符咒，以及一朵红花。午后温暖的阳光从左侧斜射入画面，在长袍褶皱、手部、胸膛和墙面纹理上形成了强烈的明暗对比。画作采用油画笔触，织物与皮肤质感刻画细腻，氛围忧郁，构图优雅，采用竖版肖像构图，呈现出电影级的动漫关键视觉风格。

templates.title: Portrait of a red-haired masked warrior

titleLocalized.zh: 红发蒙面武士肖像

templates.prompt: A dramatic, anime-style portrait depicts a solitary swordsman with an androgynous, elegant air. The image is presented from a three-quarter profile, showing the upper body from mid-thigh up, with the character gazing intently at the viewer with narrow, golden eyes. The character possesses {argument name="hair color" default="Deep crimson"} Their hair was long and layered with messy wisps, and a thick, long braid hung down in front, adorned with turquoise beads and tassels. They wore dark metal half-masks that covered the lower half of their faces, and had multiple red and silver ornaments on their ears. Their expressions were confident yet dangerous. One hand rested behind their neck, holding a katana resting on their shoulder; the hilt was black with red accents, and the blade had a reflective quality. Their clothing was a sophisticated blend of fantasy and feudal Japanese style: dark brown kimonos underneath, navy blue and magenta obi wrapped around their waists, tied with a loose gold belt adorned with beads, and a black robe with a red lining, the collar of which had a fluffy light-colored fur collar. The robe's cuffs were decorated with large red sun emblems, and a blue ornament was worn at the waist. The color scheme was predominantly red, black, gold, off-white, and dark blue. The background features a decorative Japanese painting, with a large, luminous red-orange sun disc behind the subject, adorned with red plum blossoms, smoky cloud patterns, parchment-textured beige and charcoal gray tones, and scattered gold leaf. The high-detail digital illustration boasts painterly anime-style rendering, gorgeous textures, delicate lines, emotional lighting, luxurious fabric folds, samurai aesthetics, and an elegant yet fierce atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅戏剧性的动漫风格肖像，描绘了一位拥有中性、优雅气质的独行剑客。画面采用四分之三侧身视角，展示从大腿中部以上的半身像，角色正用狭长的金色双眼凝视着观众。角色拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="深绯红色"} 的头发，长发层次分明且带有凌乱的碎发，另有一条垂在身前、装饰着绿松石珠子和流苏的粗长辫子。他们佩戴着遮住下半脸的深色金属半面具，耳朵上有多处红色和银色饰品，表情自信而危险。一只手搭在颈后，横握着一把架在肩上的武士刀；刀柄为黑色并带有红色点缀，刀刃具有反光质感。服装是奇幻与封建日本风格的精细结合：内穿暗棕色和服，腰间缠绕着海军蓝与洋红色的腰封，系着一条宽松的金色腰带，挂有珠饰，外罩一件内衬为红色的黑色长袍，领口带有蓬松的浅色毛领。长袍袖口饰有巨大的红色太阳徽章，腰间配有青色饰品。色调以红、黑、金、米白和深蓝为主。背景为一幅装饰性的日式画作，头后方有一个巨大的发光红橙色太阳圆盘，点缀着红梅花、烟雾状的云纹、羊皮纸质感的米色与炭灰色调，以及零星的金箔飞溅。高细节数字插画，绘画感动漫渲染，华丽的纹理，精致的线条，情绪化的光影，奢华的布料褶皱，武士美学，优雅而凶猛的氛围。

templates.title: Anime VR Bedroom Encounter

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫 VR 卧室邂逅

templates.prompt: A VR bedroom scene in an anime style, projected with 360-degree equidistant cylindrical projection, is viewed from a first-person perspective from the bed. A young woman is positioned extremely close to the viewer in the center of the image. She has {argument name="hair color" default="Medium brown"} Her smooth bob haircut with side-swept bangs, adorned with delicate earrings, and she wore a fitted top.{argument name="shirt color" default="Slate Blue"} She wears a shirt, the top button undone, paired with dark blue trousers. Her pose is intimate and immersive: kneeling on a messy white bed, straddling the viewer, one arm outstretched towards the camera, the other hand resting on the mattress, as if leaning towards the viewer in a VR experience. The room is a warm, softly lit modern bedroom with beige walls and recessed ceiling lights. To the left is a dark wood door; a television sits on a low dressing table, another dressing table displays framed pictures, and the central window is draped with white sheer curtains and dark gray blinds. Each of the two bedside tables has a lit lamp, a tall potted plant stands by the window, and a dark wood bookshelf is on the right. The scene must include two wall paintings, two bedside lamps, two potted plants, two dressing tables, one television, one bookshelf, one door, and one window. Employing a panoramic ultra-wide-angle 360-degree VR distortion effect, the walls are curved, the bed edges are slightly stretched, presenting an exquisite anime rendering style, soft and warm evening light and shadow, delicate bedding folds, a clean interior design, and a realistic virtual tour atmosphere.

templates.title: Dark fantasy four-armed female hero cover

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑奇幻四臂女英雄封面

templates.prompt: A highly dramatic cover illustration for a dark fantasy light novel, presented in a square composition. At the center of the image is a lithe female warrior in a dynamic thrusting pose, against a dimly lit, abandoned church-like or industrial Gothic interior scene, accompanied by a hazy, smoky background and floating warm-colored embers. She has long, silver-white hair, with a high ponytail that whips violently to the right; her skin is pale, and her face is deliberately blurred or featureless. Her body is enhanced by a total of four black mechanical arms, constructed from complex springs and segmented metal joints, extending around her like a spider. She wears a tattered black battle dress with armored waist details, belts, straps, a single thigh stocking, and biomechanical leg armor. Ensure that exactly four arms are visible: two upper arms and two lower arms; ensure that there are four glowing energy blades, one in each hand, the blades being a translucent neon blue with crystalline edges and magical circuit-like patterns of light. Emphasizing the contrast between matte black metal, tattered fabric, pale skin, and electric blue weapons, the composition should be cinematic, highly detailed, dynamic, and heroic, with a clear focus on the characters and a soft depth-of-field effect in the background. Add a gorgeous Japanese-style cover layout using a metallic gold with subtle bevels and sheen: a small, stylized text "Battle Access" at the top; and a large main title below.{argument name="headline text" default="The silence of the quad-arm"} ; Below it is a smaller subtitle ~ The four-armed female mercenary and the restraint of the world ~. Add a line of centered gold Japanese quotes near the bottom{argument name="quote" default=""I've come to buy your future at a high price.""} ; Directly below it is a smaller line of text - Timepiece Shitaka no Yunmei, Jindong no De no. Place the author's name at the bottom center{argument name="author name" default="ざっ"} Featuring a large gold font and elegant decorative dividing lines on both sides, this luxurious fantasy book cover adopts a melancholic dark brown and charcoal gray color scheme, accented with bright cyan highlights, presenting an ultra-refined anime-style realism and exquisite GPT-image-2 editorial illustration style.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的暗黑奇幻轻小说封面插画，采用正方形构图。画面中心是一位身姿矫健的女性战士，她正处于动态的突刺姿势中，背景是昏暗、废弃的教堂式或工业哥特式室内场景，伴有烟雾缭绕的模糊背景和漂浮的暖色余烬。她留着银白色长发，高马尾向右侧剧烈甩动，皮肤苍白，面部刻意模糊或无五官。她的身体由总共 4 条黑色机械手臂强化，这些手臂由复杂的发条和分段式金属关节构成，像蜘蛛一样在她周围延伸。她身穿破损的黑色战裙，带有盔甲束腰细节、皮带、绑带、单侧大腿袜圈以及生物机械腿甲。确保可见手臂正好 4 条：2 条上臂和 2 条下臂；确保有 4 把发光的能量利刃，每只手中持有一把，利刃呈半透明的霓虹蓝色，带有结晶边缘和类似魔法电路的光纹。强调哑光黑金属、破损布料、苍白皮肤与电光青色武器之间的对比。构图应具有电影感、高细节、张力十足且充满英雄气概，角色焦点清晰，背景具有柔和的景深效果。添加华丽的日式封面排版，采用带有细微斜面和光泽的金属金色：顶部为小型流派文字《バトルアクション》；下方为大型主标题 {argument name="headline text" default="クアッドアームの静寂"}；其下为较小的副标题 ～四本腕の女傭兵と錆びついた世界の約束～。底部附近添加一行居中的金色日文引言 {argument name="quote" default="「僕は君の未来を高値で買いに来た」"}；其正下方为较小的一行文字 ——時計仕掛けの運命が、今動き出す。最底部居中位置放置作者名 {argument name="author name" default="ざっ"}，使用大型金色字体，两侧配有优雅的装饰性分割线。采用奢华的奇幻书籍封面布局，色调为忧郁的深褐色与炭灰色，并点缀明亮的青色高光，呈现超精细的动漫风格写实感以及精致的 GPT-image-2 编辑插画风格。

titleLocalized.zh: 史诗奇幻机甲轻小说封面

templates.prompt: Create a highly dramatic Japanese light novel cover illustration themed around a fantasy mecha isekai story. The poster will be in a vertical format, with a massive, heroic humanoid robot dominating the foreground from a slightly upward angle to emphasize its grandeur. The robot's design is sleek and ornate, clad in silver armor with rich gold trim, flowing blue energy lines, a dazzling emerald core embedded in its chest, a crown-like ornament on its helmet, and a long, royal blue cape with gold trim draped down its back. Behind it unfolds multiple crystalline energy wings, approximately eight large, translucent green fragments arranged symmetrically in a fan shape like glowing blades. In its left hand, it holds a long, fantastical technological spear with a blue-glowing blade adorned with gold mechanical details. Two human characters stand at the robot's feet: on the left is a red-haired fantasy heroine with extremely long braids, dressed in an adventurer's outfit made of leather and fabric, her expression resolute as she gazes up at the robot; on the right is a short-haired, dark-haired young male protagonist, wearing a fantasy tunic and cloak, extending a hand towards the giant mech with awe and eagerness, primarily shown from behind. The background is set in an epic, ruined sci-fi fantasy world, with towering Gothic spires, scattered architectural ruins, swirling smoke, spectacular clouds, and the sky dotted with stars, planets, and lightning trails, with eight small flying warships scattered in the distance. It employs a high-precision anime-style visual style, with exquisite details, cinematic lighting and strong contrasts, using a blue, green, and gold color scheme, creating a heroic atmosphere, with delicate mechanical rendering, full of fantasy worldview, presenting the quality of a high-end game or novel cover. A striking Japanese title is added at the top: a large metallic logo.{argument name="series title" default="ASTRAIA"} Add above{argument name="tagline text" default="A full-fledged other-world sci-fi robot war chronicle"} Below this is a smaller Japanese subtitle. At the bottom, a striking and dramatic Japanese tagline is displayed in two lines in a glowing platinum font:{argument name="bottom catchphrase" default="Get on! Yuuki! That cry determined the fate of the world!"} The overall design remains compact, sophisticated, and easy to read, meeting business cover standards and ensuring the central robot becomes the absolute visual focus.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张极具戏剧性的日式轻小说封面插画，主题为奇幻机甲异世界故事。采用竖版海报构图，画面中心前景由一台巨大的英雄式人形机器人占据，采用略微仰视的视角，彰显其宏伟感。机器人造型流畅且华丽，身披白银色装甲，饰有丰富的金色镶边，流淌着青色能量线条，胸口镶嵌着璀璨的翡翠绿核心，头盔上带有皇冠状饰物，背部垂下一条镶金边的皇家蓝长披风。其身后展开多片晶体能量翼，约 8 片巨大的半透明绿色碎片如发光刀刃般对称扇形排开。左手持有一柄长款奇幻科技长枪，枪刃散发着蓝色光芒，并带有金色机械细节。机器人脚下站着 2 位人类角色：左侧是一位红发奇幻女主角，留着极长的辫子，身穿皮革与布料拼接的冒险者服装，神情坚定，正仰望着机器人；右侧是一位短发黑发的年轻男主角，身穿奇幻束腰外衣和斗篷，正满怀敬畏与急切地向巨型机甲伸出一只手，主要以背影示人。背景设定为一个史诗般的废墟科幻奇幻世界，耸立着哥特式尖塔，建筑残骸遍布，烟雾缭绕，云层壮观，天空中点缀着繁星、行星、闪电轨迹，远处散布着 8 艘小型飞行战舰。采用高精度的动漫主视觉风格，细节极致，电影级光影，对比强烈，采用蓝、绿、金配色，氛围英雄气概十足，机械渲染细腻，充满奇幻世界观，呈现出高级游戏或小说封面的质感。在顶部添加醒目的日文标题排版：在巨大的金属质感 Logo {argument name="series title" default="ASTRAIA"} 上方添加《{argument name="tagline text" default="本格異世界SFロボット戦記"}》，下方配有一行较小的日文副标题。在底部添加一行醒目且充满戏剧性的日文宣传语，以发光的白金字体分 2 行显示：{argument name="bottom catchphrase" default="乗って！ユウキ！ その叫びが、世界の運命を決めた！"}。整体设计保持紧凑、高级且易读，符合商业封面标准，并确保中央机器人成为绝对的视觉焦点。

templates.prompt: A highly dramatic Japanese light novel cover illustration, employing a highly detailed anime fantasy style and a square composition, depicts a group of heroes assuming battle stances at a deserted mountain pass at sunset, with cherry blossoms falling from the sky. The center of the scene is {argument name="hero title" default="Momotaro"} A young male warrior with black hair, clad in bright red samurai armor, crouches in the foreground, a katana held diagonally. To his right and slightly forward is a young female warrior with black hair, also wearing red armor and sporting a high ponytail, in a dynamic fighting stance, drawing her sword. Around them are five companions, making a total of seven characters: to the left and slightly forward is a girl with short brown hair, wielding a short blade; to the upper left is an angelic woman with long silver hair, enormous white wings, and drawing a bow; directly above is a tall, red-haired warrior carrying a massive weapon; to the upper right center is a girl with long, straight black hair, dressed in light red and white armor in a shrine maiden style; and to the right is a blonde girl wielding a magnificent warhammer. In the background, a distant Japanese castle, jagged rocks and broken ground, glowing embers, falling petals, and a brightly lit, backlit sky are added to the right side of the group. Utilizing cinematic fantasy lighting, an epic adventure atmosphere, exquisite painterly quality, sharp armor details, flowing hair, layered depth of field, and a bold, hero poster aesthetic, the top features striking metallic gold Japanese title text with black outlines.{argument name="top title text" default=""Fairy Tale Fantasy" Shin Momotaro Den"} Below it is a smaller white Japanese subtitle with a dark outline.{argument name="top subtitle text" default="The exiled and reincarnated former god saves the world with beautiful girls from a fairy tale world!!"} The bottom features prominent bright red Japanese promotional text with a white outline.{argument name="bottom catch text" default="Momotaro, the banished and reincarnated god, overcomes trials with the help of beautiful girls from fairy tales to defeat demons!"} The overall design presents the visual effect of a commercial fantasy web novel or comic book cover, full of vitality, rich composition, and highly visually impactful.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的日式轻小说封面插画，采用高细节动漫奇幻风格，方形构图，展示了一群英雄在日落时分的荒废山口摆出战斗姿态，樱花在空中飘落。场景中心为 {argument name="hero title" default="桃太郎"}，一位留着黑发的年轻男战士，身穿亮红色武士盔甲，蹲伏在前景中，斜握着一把武士刀。在他右前方的是一位留着高马尾、同样身穿红色盔甲的黑发年轻女性，也正处于拔刀的动态战斗姿态。在他们周围还有 5 位同伴，总计 7 名角色：左前方是一位留着棕色短发的女孩，手持短刃；左上方是一位留着银色长发、拥有巨大白翼并拉弓的天使般女性；正上方是一位扛着巨型武器的高大红发战士；中右上方是一位留着黑色直长发、身穿红白相间轻甲的巫女风格女孩；右侧是一位手持华丽大战锤的金发女孩。背景右侧添加一座遥远的日本城堡、嶙峋的岩石和破碎的地面、发光的余烬、飘落的花瓣，以及在群体后方带有强烈背光的光亮云层天空。运用电影级的奇幻光影、史诗般的冒险氛围、精致的绘画质感、锐利的盔甲细节、飘逸的头发、层叠的景深，以及大胆的英雄海报感。顶部包含醒目的金属金色带黑色描边的日文标题文字 {argument name="top title text" default="《御伽話ファンタジー》シン・桃太郎伝"}，下方配有较小的白色带深色描边的日文副标题 {argument name="top subtitle text" default="～追放・転生した元神は、おとぎ話の世界の美少女たちと世界を救う!!"}。底部包含醒目的亮红色带白色描边的日文宣传文字 {argument name="bottom catch text" default="追放、転生した神・桃太郎。御伽話の美少女たちと試練乗り越えて鬼退治！"}。整体呈现出商业奇幻网络小说或漫画封面的视觉效果，充满活力、构图饱满且极具视觉冲击力。

templates.title: Oil painting style steampunk girl portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 油画风格蒸汽朋克少女肖像

templates.prompt: An oil painting-style steampunk fantasy portrait depicts a young woman, turned to the left, about thigh-high, standing in a cramped studio filled with mechanical parts and clockwork mechanisms. She has thick, curly hair.{argument name="hair color" default="Golden yellow"} Long hair cascaded down her back, a few strands shimmering against the background. She wore enormous brass aviator goggles, the lenses displaying an iridescent blue-purple hue. She donned a romantic steampunk-style dress: deep {argument name="dress color" default="Cobalt blue"} She wears a tight-fitting corset and skirt, paired with a high-necked white blouse with ruffled trim and puff sleeves, the collar and hem featuring layered ruffles. Multiple brown leather belts with buckles are cinched at the waist and torso. She carries a medium-brown leather backpack with a round flap and visible buckles over one shoulder. The background is densely packed with industrial details: exposed pipes, valves, hanging instruments, circular gauges, and numerous clearly visible gears, including a large gear in the upper right corner and several ring-shaped metal components distributed along the walls. The painting employs an expressive oil painting style, using thick brushstrokes, soft edges, and a dreamlike, handcrafted texture. Tonally, the cool gray-blue and cyan in the background contrast sharply with the warm brass, copper, amber, and honey highlights on the machinery and hair. The atmosphere is fantastical, adventurous, and slightly nostalgic, reminiscent of a steampunk inventor's workshop from a storybook. The composition is vertical, with the character positioned slightly to the right of the frame. The background is softened but filled with mechanical forms, with no visible text or modern elements. The face is obscured by a rectangular, blurred block in the center with a soft brown hue.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张油画风格的蒸汽朋克奇幻肖像，描绘了一位侧身向左、约大腿以上部位的年轻女性，她正站在一个布满机械零件和发条装置的狭窄工作室中。她留着一头浓密卷曲的 {argument name="hair color" default="金黄色"} 长发，发丝垂落在背部，几缕散落的发丝在背景衬托下闪烁着微光。头顶戴着一副巨大的黄铜飞行员护目镜，镜片呈现出虹彩般的蓝紫色。她穿着一件浪漫的蒸汽朋克风格连衣裙：深 {argument name="dress color" default="钴蓝色"} 的紧身胸衣和裙摆，搭配带有褶边装饰和泡泡袖的高领白色衬衫，领口和下摆处有层叠的荷叶边，腰部和躯干处束有多条棕褐色皮带和扣环。她单肩背着一个带有圆形翻盖和可见扣环的中棕色皮质背包。背景两侧布满了密集的工业细节：裸露的管道、阀门、悬挂的仪器、圆形仪表以及多个清晰可见的齿轮，包括右上角的一个大齿轮和沿墙壁分布的多个环状金属组件。采用富有表现力的油画风格，运用厚涂笔触、柔和的边缘和梦幻般的手工质感。色调上，背景中冷峻的灰蓝色和青色与机械及发丝上温暖的黄铜色、铜色、琥珀色和蜂蜜色高光形成鲜明对比。氛围奇幻、充满冒险感且略带怀旧气息，宛如故事书中蒸汽朋克发明家的工作室。竖构图，角色位于画面中偏右位置，背景经过柔化处理但充满了机械形态，无可见文字，无现代元素，面部由一个位于中心、色调为柔和棕褐色的矩形模糊块遮挡。

templates.title: Steampunk cat airships skimmed across the sea.

titleLocalized.zh: 蒸汽朋克猫咪飞艇掠过海面

templates.prompt: A fantastical oil painting depicts a colossal cat-shaped steamship floating above a bright ocean under a clear blue sky and soft pink clouds. The airship dominates the composition from a low, three-quarter perspective on the left front, creating a grand sense of aerial grandeur. Its rounded, full hull, reminiscent of a Zeppelin, is rendered in pale pink and lavender hues with warm peach highlights. The prow is sculpted into a fluffy cat face with light pink fur, pointed ears, bright blue eyes, a small nose, and a huge opening revealing sharp, dark teeth, resembling the entrance of a grotesque figurehead. The hull is covered in ornate gilded brass trim, gold and silver filigree work, railings, pipes, rivets, balconies, portholes, hanging ornaments, and decorative mechanical fittings. Four tall funnels rise from the top deck, each striped with warm copper, red, and gold, spewing thick, cotton-candy-pink smoke that curls in the sky with an oil painting-like texture. The upper deck is adorned with intricate Victorian steampunk details, including domes, spires, lamp-like finials, miniature architecture, and a small golden cat statue near the bow. A pod or platform hangs below the hull, revealing tiny mechanical devices and a reddish-orange base. In the distance, three smaller vessels appear near the horizon on the turquoise, surging waves, further emphasizing the sense of scale. Below, the sea is depicted with vivid waves and white foam. Employing an imaginative storybook steampunk aesthetic, the work combines thick, impasto brushstrokes, visible paint textures, bright sunlight, romantic soft colors, and a dreamlike atmosphere reminiscent of a fantastical sea voyage. The vertical composition, highly detailed, and imbued with a magical, surreal, elegant, and playful style.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅充满奇幻色彩的油画，描绘了一艘巨大的猫形蒸汽飞艇，漂浮在晴朗蓝天和柔和粉云下的明亮海洋之上。飞艇以左前方低角度的四分之三视角占据了画面主体，营造出宏伟的空中感。其船体圆润饱满，结合了齐柏林飞艇的造型，呈现出淡粉色和薰衣草色，并带有温暖的桃色高光。船头雕刻成一只毛茸茸的猫脸，拥有浅粉色的皮毛、尖尖的耳朵、明亮的蓝色眼睛、小巧的鼻子，以及一张巨大的、露出锋利深色牙齿的开口，宛如怪诞的船首像入口。船身覆盖着华丽的镀金黄铜饰边、金银丝工艺、栏杆、管道、铆钉、阳台、舷窗、悬挂饰品和装饰性机械配件。顶层甲板耸立着 4 根高大的烟囱，每根烟囱都带有暖铜色、红色和金色的条纹，喷涌出浓厚的棉花糖粉色烟雾，在天空中卷曲出油画般的质感。上层甲板布满了复杂的维多利亚蒸汽朋克细节，包括圆顶、尖塔、灯状饰顶、微型建筑以及船头附近的一座小型金色猫雕像。船腹下方悬挂着一个吊舱或平台，可以看到微小的机械装置和红橙色的底座。远处，波涛汹涌的青色水面上，地平线附近出现了 3 艘较小的船只，进一步突显了比例感。下方的海面描绘着生动的波浪和白色泡沫。采用富有想象力的故事书蒸汽朋克美学，结合浓厚的厚涂笔触、可见的绘画纹理、明亮的阳光、浪漫的柔和色彩，以及令人联想到奇幻海上航行的梦幻氛围。竖构图，高度细节化，充满魔幻、超现实、优雅且俏皮的风格。

templates.title: Cinematic Layout Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 电影感排版海报

templates.prompt: A minimalist, cinematic poster, using a tall, vertical canvas with a cream-colored textured paper background and a dark, matte stage platform at the bottom. The main subject is a large, compact black sans-serif letter spelling out {argument name="main title" default="SAM ALTMAN"} The first word, almost dominating the entire height of the composition, is stacked on top of and overlaps with the second. One of the central vertical letters is replaced with a glowing, open doorway, its outline radiating a warm orange-red light, revealing a bright sunrise sky and a distant cityscape. On the stage, a three-quarter profile adult male, dressed in a dark crew-neck sweater, dark trousers, and light-colored sneakers, is placed walking towards the doorway, his proportions realistic and subtly dramatic with a rim light. In the upper right corner of the typography, three lines of large-spaced capital text are added, containing the following:{argument name="tagline line 1" default="AI."} ,{argument name="tagline line 2" default="POWER."} ,as well as{argument name="tagline line 3" default="POSSIBILITY."} In the bottom left corner, add a small line of orange acknowledgment text that reads:{argument name="credit text" default="OPENAI CEO"} Using strong proportional contrasts, ample white space, a magazine cover-style editing approach, a clean and modern layout, soft neutral tones, and a touch of warm orange accents, the design presents realistic light and shadow, delicate film grain, and a sophisticated futuristic atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极简主义的电影感海报，采用高垂直画布，背景为米白色纹理纸张，底部为深色哑光舞台平台。画面主体为巨大的黑色紧凑型无衬线字母，拼写出 {argument name="main title" default="SAM ALTMAN"}，几乎占据了整个构图的高度，第一个单词堆叠在第二个单词上方并与之重叠。将其中一个中央垂直字母替换为一个发光的开放式门廊，轮廓呈现温暖的橙红色光芒，显露出明亮的日出天空和远处的城市景观。在舞台上，放置 1 位从背后看去呈四分之三侧面的成年男性，正走向门廊，身穿深色圆领毛衣、深色长裤和浅色运动鞋，比例真实，并带有微妙的戏剧性轮廓光。在排版的右上角，添加 3 行间距较大的大写文本，内容为 {argument name="tagline line 1" default="AI."}，{argument name="tagline line 2" default="POWER."}，以及 {argument name="tagline line 3" default="POSSIBILITY."}。在左下角，添加 1 行小型的橙色致谢文字，内容为 {argument name="credit text" default="OPENAI CEO"}。运用强烈的比例对比、大量的留白、杂志封面式的编辑风格、简洁现代的布局、柔和的中性色调并辅以一抹温暖的橙色点缀，呈现出逼真的光影、细腻的胶片颗粒感以及精致的未来主义氛围。

templates.title: The Surreal Wind-Up Gentleman on Gear

titleLocalized.zh: 齿轮上的超现实发条绅士

templates.prompt: A surrealist impasto painting, reminiscent of late 19th-century Post-Impressionist masterpieces. The painting depicts a robust gentleman in a richly patterned gold-blue suit and top hat, awkwardly balancing on a giant bronze gear above a sun-drenched canal city. His face is obscured by a centrally located, vertically oriented rectangular brown occluder, creating a deliberate sense of anonymity and discontinuity. He wears a richly textured jacket with mosaic patches in ochre, cobalt blue, rust, and cream, paired with matching trousers and heavy leather boots; his waist is open, revealing a clockwork mechanism filled with gears and ornate brass details. His body leans forward, his arms outstretched as if struggling for balance, one boot resting on the gear, the other slightly raised. The background is a blue sky with swirling brushstrokes of clouds and scattered gold, with a historic clock tower and arched waterfront buildings visible in the lower left, and distant terracotta rooftops beside shimmering water in the right. The image employs heavy, visible brushstrokes, bright warm highlights, bold blue-gold contrasts, expressive textures, and an atmosphere that blends fantastical steampunk with Venetian flair. The figure is centrally located and large, slightly cropped by the frame, with a clearly visible giant gear at its feet, and a cityscape stretching into the distance below.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅超现实主义厚涂油画，带有 19 世纪末后印象派杰作的神韵。画面展示了一位穿着图案华丽的金蓝色西装、戴着高礼帽的健壮绅士，正笨拙地平衡在阳光明媚的运河城市上方的一个巨型青铜齿轮上。他的脸部被一个居中的垂直长方形棕色遮挡块掩盖，营造出一种刻意的匿名焦点中断感。他穿着一件质感丰富的夹克，上面有赭石色、钴蓝色、铁锈色和奶油色的马赛克式补丁，搭配同色系长裤和厚重的皮靴；他的腰部敞开，露出内部充满齿轮和华丽黄铜细节的发条装置。他的身体向前倾斜，双手伸展仿佛在努力保持平衡，一只靴子踩在齿轮上，另一只微微向外抬起。背景是带有漩涡状笔触云朵和散落金色笔触的蔚蓝天空，左下方可见一座历史悠久的钟楼和拱形水岸建筑，右侧则是水波粼粼旁遥远的赤陶色屋顶。画面采用厚重的可见笔触、明亮的暖色高光、大胆的蓝金对比、富有表现力的质感，以及奇幻的蒸汽朋克与威尼斯风情交织的氛围。人物构图居中且硕大，被画框略微裁剪，脚下是清晰可见的巨型齿轮，下方则是向远处延伸的城市景观。

templates.title: The tea alley street scene full of atmosphere

titleLocalized.zh: 充满氛围感的茶巷街景

templates.prompt: A photorealistic scene of a narrow teahouse alley in an old East Asian town, captured from a level perspective with a slightly telephoto lens. The alley is narrow and damp, brimming with life: weathered shopfronts, old concrete and brick walls, a tangled web of overhead wires, metal awnings, exposed pipes, hanging signs, and lush greenery and branches spreading from above and to the sides. In the left foreground, a rustic wooden table is set with teaware, including a metal kettle, a teapot, and a tray with several small blue-and-white porcelain teacups and other small vessels, along with a few extra cups; potted plants and stacked containers surround the table. Above and behind the table hang three illuminated, vertical lantern-style signs with black calligraphy on warm beige paper; the largest sign reads "Tea, One Flavor," while the others are similar in style. There are also several dark wooden signs with gold or light-colored lettering. In the center of the alley, thick white smoke rises from pots or food stalls, partially obscuring benches and the passageway. To the right, four bicycles are neatly arranged, close to crates, baskets, and a black trash can. Deeper into the alley, four people are casually seated or standing around small tables and stools, adding a sense of proportion without being overwhelming. The cobblestone pavement should appear wet and reflective, suggesting recent rain or damp weather. Soft, natural sunlight filters in from the bright exit at the alley's end, intertwining with warm-toned lantern light to create a cinematic contrast. Emphasis is placed on texture, realism, spatial depth, a slight mist, a documentary-style realism, and {argument name="city style" default="An old Chinese alley"} The cozy feeling of a hidden tea street.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个照片级写实的东亚老城区狭窄茶馆巷弄场景，采用平视视角，结合轻微长焦的街头摄影构图。巷道狭窄潮湿，充满丰富的生活气息：风化的店面、老旧的混凝土和砖墙、错综复杂的架空电线、金属遮阳棚、裸露的管道、悬挂的招牌，以及从上方和两侧蔓延而来的茂密绿植与树枝。在左侧前景处，放置一张质朴的木桌，上面摆放着茶具，包括 1 个金属水壶、1 个茶壶、1 个托盘，托盘上有几只青花瓷小茶杯和小型器皿，旁边还有几个额外的杯子；周围环绕着盆栽植物和堆叠的容器。在桌子上方和后方，悬挂 3 个发光的垂直灯笼式招牌，上面用黑色毛笔字书写在暖米色纸上，最大的招牌写着“茶一味”，其他招牌风格相似，此外还有几块带有金色或浅色字体的深色木质招牌。在巷子中央，展示从锅或小吃摊升腾而起的浓郁白烟，部分遮挡住凳子和通道。在右侧，整齐排列 4 辆自行车，紧靠着板条箱、篮子和一个黑色垃圾桶。在巷子深处，安排 4 个人在小桌凳旁随意坐着或站着，增加画面比例感且不喧宾夺主。石板路面应呈现湿润且带有反光的效果，暗示刚下过雨或天气潮湿。光线为柔和的自然日光，从巷子尽头的明亮出口透入，与暖色调的灯笼光交织，营造出富有电影感的对比氛围。强调纹理、真实感、空间深度、轻微的雾气、纪录片式的写实风格，以及 {argument name="city style" default="一条中国老巷"} 中那种隐秘茶街的温馨感。
