templates.title: Ibaraki Travel Guide Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 茨城旅游指南封面

templates.prompt: A beautifully illustrated cover illustration for a Japanese travel magazine, employing a soft watercolor and ink painting style, an A4 vertical layout, light pastel tones, and an elegant travel poster composition. The cover title is dominated by striking blue serif font, and the content is {argument name="main title" default="IBARAKI"} Below is a prominent Japanese title, "Ibaraki Prefecture Travel Guide," and a pink, cursive English subtitle, "Ibaraki Travel Guide." The upper left corner contains two lines of small Japanese text about Ibaraki's nature, history, scenery, and cuisine, adorned with a tiny pink cherry blossom icon. The upper right corner features a large, circular badge with a dotted border, containing Japanese text and the words "Complete Preservation Edition" in the center, decorated with a small ribbon below. The main subject is a young Japanese woman, a half-length portrait, positioned slightly to the right of the image, her face turned to the left in a three-quarter profile. She has short, wavy, dark brown to black hair that reaches her chin, with fine, natural strands, and a calm, neutral expression. She wears a light blue cardigan over a white, ruffled turtleneck shirt, and carries a beige crossbody bag with thin straps. Her face is deliberately obscured by a pure gray vertical rectangle in the center of her face area. The surrounding area is a collage of iconic Ibaraki landscapes: in the upper right corner, rolling hills are covered with a vast expanse of blue nemophila flowers, a Ferris wheel is visible in the distance, and tiny figures of tourists dot the ridge; in the middle right, there are traditional temples or pavilions amidst pink cherry blossoms; in the lower right, there is a bright waterfall and scenic stream; in the lower left, a torii gate stands in the shallow sea under the setting sun; and near the center of the lower left, there is a mountain landscape. Abundant blue flowers are added to the foreground at the bottom edge, surrounded by soft pink cherry blossoms on the right. The left side contains seven vertically arranged Japanese destination list entries, each with a colored title line and a smaller descriptive subtitle: "Kokuyo Hitachi Kaihama Park", "Kaigakuen", "Fukuroda no Taki", "Oarai Isomae Shrine", "Mt. Tsukuba", "Mizugo/Kasumigaura", and "Gurme/Café/Omiyage". A blue circular badge with the white Japanese characters "モデルコース4" is placed in the lower left corner, with a smaller itinerary below. The lower right corner contains three horizontal white labels with Japanese characters and icons: "絶景スポット" (Zetsukai Spote), "ご地方グルメ" (Gōchidōme), and "おみやげセレクション" (Omiyage Celebration). A pink ribbon banner with brief Japanese promotional text is added near the lower right corner. The upper left corner features a clean white background, elegant magazine layout, delicate lines, a dreamy spring atmosphere, exquisite travel cover design, high detail, and a premium printing quality.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的日式旅游杂志封面插图，采用柔和的水彩与水墨编辑风格，A4 竖版布局，轻盈的粉彩色调，优雅的旅游海报构图。封面标题由非常醒目的蓝色衬线大字主导，内容为 {argument name="main title" default="IBARAKI"}，下方配有醒目的日文标题“茨城県 旅行ガイド”，以及粉色的草书英文副标题“Ibaraki Travel Guide”。左上角包含两行关于茨城自然、历史、风景和美食旅游的小字日文文案，并点缀一个微小的粉色樱花图标。右上角放置一个带有细点边框的大型圆形徽章，中心包含日文文字及“完全保存版”字样，下方配有小丝带装饰。主体是一位日本年轻女性，半身像，位于画面右侧偏中位置，侧脸朝左，呈四分之三侧面视角。她留着深棕色至黑色的齐颌波浪短发，发丝细腻自然，表情平静中性。身穿浅蓝色开衫，内搭白色荷叶边高领衬衫，肩背细带米色挎包。她的面部被一个位于面部区域中央的纯灰色垂直矩形遮挡块刻意遮盖。周围融合了茨城的标志性风景拼贴画：右上角是连绵起伏的山丘上大片的蓝色粉蝶花海，远处可见摩天轮，山脊上有微小的游客身影；中右侧是粉色樱花丛中的传统寺庙或凉亭；右下侧是明亮的瀑布与景观溪流；左下侧是夕阳下矗立在浅海中的鸟居；左下侧中心附近是山地景观。底部边缘前景处添加丰富的蓝色花朵，右侧由柔和的粉色樱花环绕。左侧包含 7 个垂直排列的日文目的地列表条目，每个条目均配有彩色标题行和较小的描述性副标题：“国営ひたち海浜公園”、“偕楽園”、“袋田の滝”、“大洗磯前神社”、“筑波山”、“水郷・霞ヶ浦”以及“グルメ・カフェ・おみやげ”。左下角放置一个带有白色日文文字“モデルコース 4”的蓝色圆形徽章，下方附有较小的行程文案。右下角包含 3 个带有日文文字和图标的水平白色标签：“絶景スポット”、“ご当地グルメ”和“おみやげセレクション”。右下角附近添加一个粉色丝带横幅，配有简短的日文促销文案。左上角采用简洁的白色背景，优雅的杂志排版，细腻的线条，梦幻的春日氛围，精致的旅游封面设计，高细节，高级印刷质感。

templates.title: A bright and modern luxury lobby

titleLocalized.zh: 阳光明媚的现代奢华大堂

templates.prompt: A photorealistic, wide-angle interior architectural photograph showcases a modern luxury lobby bathed in the warm afternoon sun. The space features double-height ceilings, an open mezzanine, and transparent glass railings. It utilizes minimalist cream-colored stone walls, polished grey concrete or stone floors, and rich reddish-brown wood paneling throughout. To the left, a stylish reception desk blends seamlessly into the wood-paneled wall, adorned with two small table lamps and a recessed niche emitting a soft, warm glow. To the right, a floor-to-ceiling window wall reveals a hazy city skyline, with views of towering modern buildings and treetops. Near the window, a built-in sunken lounge area features soft salmon, terracotta, and grey-rose upholstery, including an L-shaped sofa and a matching ottoman, surrounded by a dark, low coffee table piled with books. A small mushroom-shaped table lamp with a cream-colored lampshade is added next to the seating. Several long, rectangular concrete planters filled with indoor plants are placed along the windows and deep within the lobby, bringing a tranquil, bio-friendly feel to the space. The composition, taken at eye level, uses strong natural light to cast long geometric shadows on the floor and walls, emphasizing clean lines, a sense of openness, quiet luxury, and a serene atmosphere befitting a high-end hotel or corporate reception. Color scheme: warm beige, cream, amber sunlight, rose-colored soft furnishings, deep bronze accents, and natural wood. The design boasts exceptional detail, a cinematic feel, realistic materials, a soft, atmospheric mist effect, and an architectural magazine-quality photographic style—no people, clean, and with a high-end design magazine aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张照片级逼真的广角室内建筑摄影作品，展现了一个被温暖的午后阳光洒满的现代奢华大堂。空间为双层挑高，设有开放式夹层和透明玻璃栏杆，采用极简主义奶油色石墙、抛光灰色混凝土或石材地面，以及通体丰富的红棕色木镶板。左侧设有一个融入木镶板墙面的时尚接待台，台面上摆放着 2 盏小台灯，并配有一个散发柔和暖光的嵌入式壁龛。右侧打造一面落地窗墙，展现出窗外朦胧的城市天际线，可见高耸的现代建筑和树梢。在靠近窗户的前景处，放置一个内置的下沉式休息区，配有柔和的鲑鱼色、赤陶色和灰玫瑰色软垫，包括一张 L 型沙发和 1 个配套的脚凳，中间围着一张深色矮咖啡桌，桌上堆放着几本书。在座位旁添加 1 盏带有奶油色发光灯罩的小型蘑菇台灯。沿窗户及大堂深处放置多个长条形混凝土花盆栽种的室内植物，为空间带来宁静的亲生物感。以平视角度构图，强烈的自然光在地面和墙壁上投射出长长的几何阴影，强调简洁的线条、开阔感、静谧的奢华感以及宁静的高端酒店或企业接待氛围。配色方案：暖米色、奶油色、琥珀色阳光、玫瑰色软装、深青铜色点缀以及天然木材。超高细节、电影感、逼真的材质、柔和的大气雾感、建筑杂志级摄影风格，无人物，整洁，高级设计杂志美学。

templates.title: Luxury office under the sunset skyline

titleLocalized.zh: 黄昏天际线景观下的豪华办公室

templates.prompt: This is a realistic interior rendering of a modern executive office at dusk, taken from a slightly wide-angle perspective, with a hazy cityscape visible through the floor-to-ceiling corner windows. The space is designed to be minimalist yet sophisticated, featuring warm ambient lighting and soft sunset hues to create a tranquil yet luxurious corporate atmosphere. In the center of the foreground is a large, rectangular modern desk in matte dark wood or charcoal gray, adorned with a slender desk lamp, a closed laptop or folder, and an ergonomic black office chair. To the left is a low, dark brown modern leather sofa and a minimalist metal coffee table, neatly arranged with three books or magazines and a decorative bowl. To the right foreground is a built-in rectangular planter filled with greenery; behind it is a glass-walled meeting room with red-toned walls and double glass doors. A corridor with built-in wooden bookshelves, displaying books and a few decorative items, extends into the depths of the office. The design incorporates recessed ceiling lights and concealed LED light strips along the ceiling edges. The floors are finished with polished concrete or smooth stone, and the overall color scheme is restrained, blending gray, taupe, dark wood, black, and the warm orange reflections from the sunset. Window views should dominate the composition, with the skyline exhibiting a soft, atmospheric feel and a slightly diffused effect, highlighting the elevated view, a sense of luxury, and a tranquil nighttime office atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张黄昏时分的写实风格现代行政办公室室内图，采用室内微广角视角，落地转角窗外呈现出远处朦胧的都市天际线。空间设计简约且高端，配有温暖的环境照明、柔和的日落色调，营造出宁静的企业奢华氛围。在前景中央，放置一张哑光深木色或炭灰色的现代大办公桌，造型简洁呈长方形，桌上配有一盏纤细的台灯、一台合上的笔记本电脑或文件夹，以及一把人体工学黑色办公椅。左侧放置一张深棕色低矮现代皮质沙发，以及一张简约的金属咖啡桌，桌上整齐摆放着 3 本书籍或杂志和 1 个装饰碗。右侧前景处展示一个内置的长方形花槽，内植绿色植物；其后方是一个玻璃墙会议室，内部墙面呈红色调，配有玻璃双开门。后方走廊设有内置木质书架，摆放着书籍和少量装饰品，延伸至办公室深处。采用嵌入式天花板灯、天花板边缘的隐形 LED 灯带，地面为抛光混凝土或平滑石材，整体色调克制，融合了灰色、灰褐色、深木色、黑色以及日落带来的温暖橙色反光。窗景应占据构图主体，天际线呈现出柔和的大气感并略带漫射效果，突显出高空视野、奢华感以及静谧的夜晚办公氛围。

templates.title: Luxury high-rise buildings in the hazy dawn

titleLocalized.zh: 朦胧晨曦中的豪华高层建筑

templates.prompt: A cinematic cityscape at sunrise, overlooking the modern downtown skyline shrouded in a light mist. Warm peach, crimson, and grey-gold morning light bathes the scene, the sun low behind the buildings, casting soft reflections on the glass facades. The composition employs an asymmetrical design: the right third of the frame features a close-up of the facade of a luxury high-rise residential building, with curved windows, soft rose-beige concrete strips, and clearly visible balconies on the third floor. Each balcony has transparent glass railings and several hanging green plants. Through the large windows, interior details are faintly visible, including modern furniture and a striking red chair in one of the rooms. The left and central background showcase a layered city skyline, comprising eight clearly identifiable high-rise buildings of varying heights and shapes, including a rectangular tower with a grid facade and crown-like top, a dark circular tower near the center, and several square residential and office buildings that gradually blend into the atmospheric perspective. The overall atmosphere is quiet, elegant, and slightly dreamlike, reminiscent of an editorial photograph of luxury real estate. Hyper-realistic, soft contrast, telephoto compression, exquisite architectural details, delicate window reflections, no people, no text.

promptLocalized.zh: 日出时分的电影级建筑城市景观，从高处俯瞰被淡淡薄雾笼罩的现代市中心天际线。温暖的桃色、绯红和灰金色晨光洒满场景，太阳低垂在建筑群后，玻璃幕墙上闪烁着柔和的倒影。构图采用非对称设计：画面右侧三分之一处，是一座豪华高层住宅楼的近景外立面，拥有弧形玻璃窗、柔和的玫瑰米色混凝土带以及 3 层清晰可见的阳台。每个阳台上都有透明玻璃栏杆和几盆垂下的绿植。透过大窗户，可以隐约看到室内细节，包括现代家具和其中一个房间里醒目的红色椅子。左侧和中心背景展示了层次分明的城市天际线，包含 8 座高度和形状各异、清晰可辨的高层建筑，其中包括一座带有网格立面和皇冠状顶部的长方形高塔、一座位于中心附近的深色圆形塔楼，以及几座逐渐融入大气透视中的方正住宅和办公楼。整体氛围安静、优雅且略带梦幻感，宛如豪华房地产的社论摄影作品。超写实，柔和对比度，长焦压缩感，精致的建筑细节，细腻的窗户倒影，无人物，无文字。

templates.title: Luxury Sunset Rooftop Terrace

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华日落屋顶露台

templates.prompt: A photorealistic sunset view from a luxurious high-rise terrace overlooking a dense modern city skyline, taken from a wide-angle perspective along a curved outdoor walkway. The scene is deserted, bathed in warm peach, pale pink, and golden hour light, with a soft, atmospheric haze. To the right is a modern building facade, its smooth beige concrete, deep eaves, floor-to-ceiling windows, and striking rust-red siding extending into the frame in an arc. To the left is a transparent glass safety railing extending diagonally into the distance, showcasing the city landscape below. Three large, circular, built-in flowerbeds, each in a soft terracotta hue, are situated along the terrace's edge, filled with ornamental grasses, low shrubs, and small landscape trees; the nearest flowerbed stands out prominently in the foreground. The background showcases a group of stylish skyscrapers with reflective glass and clean rectangular structures, including a particularly tall, slender central tower surrounded by several slightly shorter towers. The smooth, light-colored concrete floor casts long, soft shadows, creating a tranquil and minimalist atmosphere. Architectural photography style, extremely high detail, realistic materials, delicate reflections, elegant luxury residential design, tranquil high-end urban atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张照片级真实感的高层奢华露台日落图，俯瞰密集的现代城市天际线，采用沿弧形户外走道的广角视角。场景中无人，沐浴在温暖的桃色、淡粉色和黄金时刻的光线下，带有柔和的大气雾感。右侧是一座现代建筑立面，采用平滑的米色混凝土、深挑檐、落地玻璃以及醒目的铁锈红墙板，呈弧形延伸至画面中。左侧是一道透明玻璃安全护栏，沿对角线向远处延伸，展现下方的城市景观。在露台边缘设置 3 个大型圆形内置花坛，每个花坛呈柔和的赤陶色，种满观赏草、低矮灌木和小型景观树；最近的花坛在前景中尤为突出。背景展示了一组外观时尚、带有反射玻璃和简洁矩形结构的摩天大楼，其中包括 1 座特别高耸纤细的中央塔楼和周围几座略矮的塔楼。地面为平滑的浅色混凝土，带有长而柔和的阴影，营造出宁静简约的氛围。建筑摄影风格，超高细节，真实的材质，细腻的反射，优雅的奢华住宅设计，宁静的高端城市氛围。

templates.title: Dark fantasy "Inner Monster" poster

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑奇幻“内心怪物”海报

templates.prompt: A dark, fantasy gothic poster with a vertical composition, drawn in a richly detailed anime style, featuring dramatic light and shadow effects and a strong sense of texture. At the center of the image is a beautiful young woman with long, straight hair.{argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} Her hair was white, her skin pale, and her demeanor elegant, calm, yet fraught with danger. Most of her face was shrouded in shadow and mystery. She wore a magnificent black-and-blue crystal gown, adorned with lace, feathers, and serrated organic details; the sleeves were semi-transparent and flowing, and the bodice and neckline shimmered with blue light, as if infused with magic. Her right hand was slightly raised, outstretched, while her left hand hung at her waist. Around her, luminous blue butterflies and fragmented petals sprouted, creating a sense of metamorphosis and corruption. Behind her stood a colossal monstrous entity composed of darkness, ink, smoke, and cosmic textures, revealing seven glowing blue eyes and a massive maw filled with sharp, icy blue teeth. This creature possessed a Lovecraftian sense of predation and intimacy, haunting her like a guardian, a curse, or an inner demon. The color palette was dominated by black, midnight blue, indigo, and electric blue, accented with shimmering highlights like stars or splashes of wet paint. Add decorative antique silver filigree borders to the four corners and edges to make it look like an evil book cover or exhibition poster. Place striking Japanese title text at the top:{argument name="title text" default="The monster inside me"} . Add 8 vertical blocks of Japanese copy around the character, 4 on the left and 4 on the right, in elegant white Ming Dynasty. Copy block on the left (from top to bottom): "Creation source, すべてを壊し, すべてを生む.", "正しさよりも, 心が" "The moment of movement is the beginning of the letter.", "The beauty is the hunger of the world." Copy block on the right (from top to bottom): "Emotions are deep, people are hurting, hope is, hope is in the arms, and hugs are in the arms." "Scenery をdrawing きたい.", "窒い, danger ない, それでもstop められない.", and add a small piece of handwritten style atmospheric decorative text near the middle right edge. At the bottom center, add a line of eye-catching Japanese question:{argument name="bottom question" default="Is this a power? Or a curse?"} At the very bottom, add a smaller Japanese slogan:{argument name="tagline text" default="The monster inside me is waiting for its own story to unfold."} The overall image presents a persistent, beautiful, unsettling, and emotionally intense atmosphere, much like a high-end dark art poster about inner monsters and creativity.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张垂直构图的暗黑奇幻哥特海报，采用细节丰富的动漫风格绘制，光影戏剧性强，质感浓郁。画面中心是一位美丽的年轻女子，留着一头长直的 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色"} 头发，皮肤苍白，气质优雅、冷静却暗藏危险。她的面部大部分隐没在阴影与神秘感中。她身着一件华丽的黑深蓝色水晶礼服，带有蕾丝、羽毛及锯齿状的有机细节，袖子半透明且飘逸，胸衣和领口处闪烁着蓝色的光芒，仿佛注入了魔法。她的右手微微抬起，呈张开姿势，左手则垂在腰间。在她周围，部分从她身上生长出的是发光的蓝色蝴蝶和碎片状花瓣，营造出一种蜕变与腐蚀感。在她身后，矗立着一个由黑暗、墨水、烟雾和宇宙纹理构成的巨大怪物实体，可见 7 只发光的蓝色眼睛，以及一张布满锋利冰蓝色牙齿的巨大獠牙大嘴。这个生物带有洛夫克拉夫特式的掠夺感与亲密感，像守护者、诅咒或内心恶魔一样缠绕着她。色调以黑色、午夜蓝、靛青色和电光蓝为主，点缀着如星辰或湿润颜料飞溅般的闪亮高光。在四个角落和边缘添加装饰性的古董银色花丝边框，使其看起来像是一本邪恶的书籍封面或展览海报。在顶部放置醒目的日文标题文字：{argument name="title text" default="私の中のバケモノ"}。在人物周围添加 8 块垂直的日文文案，左侧 4 块，右侧 4 块，采用优雅的白色明朝体。左侧文案块（从上到下）：「创造の源、すべてを壊し、すべてを生む。」、「正しさよりも、心が动く瞬间を信じる。」、「美しいものに饥えている。」、「静けさの中で、世界をかき混ぜる。」。右侧文案块（从上到下）：「感情を深く、人の痛みも、希望も、まるごと抱きしめる。」、「枠を壊し、谁も见たことのない景色を描きたい。」、「怖い、危ない、それでも止められない。」，并在右中边缘附近添加一小段手写风格的氛围感装饰文字。在底部中央，添加一行醒目的日文提问：{argument name="bottom question" default="これは、力？それとも、呪い？"}。在最底部，添加一行较小的日文标语：{argument name="tagline text" default="私の中のバケモノは、私だけの物语を待っている。"}。整体画面呈现出一种执着、唯美、不安且情感强烈的氛围，如同关于内心怪物与创造力的高端暗黑艺术海报。

templates.title: Illusion Eye Mandala

titleLocalized.zh: 幻象之眼曼陀罗

templates.prompt: Against a pure white background, a perfectly centered sacred geometric mandala is rendered in an ultra-refined, illusory ink pointillist illustration style. The overall composition is a radially symmetrical circle, radiating warm gold, saffron, orange, coral, magenta, and violet hues, with a subtle cyan at the core. At the very center is a radiant circular core, with a bright cyan dot at its center, surrounded by concentric circles of pink, magenta, orange, and gold, like a luminous spiritual sun. Around this, numerous densely packed concentric bands are constructed, composed of tiny jewel-like eyes, bead-like forms, dots, and gold and silver filigree, all arranged with precise rotational symmetry. Around the center forms a four-point rhombus structure, with four large clusters of petal-shaped flames on each of the four sides, and four smaller clusters of curling spirals in the diagonal quadrants. On the outermost positive direction are four large almond-shaped eye patterns embedded in feather-like gold forms. The entire mandala contains dozens of tiny, colored eyes embedded in concentric rings, suggesting omniscient and omnipotent awareness. It employs extremely fine pointillism, micro-lines, ornate feather textures, and shimmering decorative details. The internal structure is predominantly luminous gold and ivory, transitioning towards a diffuse halo of violet and lavender dots at the outer edges. The image should possess a mystical, transcendent, complex, balanced, and meditative quality, like a celestial mandala or a divine emblem of illusion, showcasing a fusion of clear, highly detailed line art and soft, vibrant colors.

promptLocalized.zh: 在纯净的白色背景上，呈现一个完美居中的神圣几何曼陀罗，采用超精细的幻象墨水点彩插画风格渲染。整体构图呈放射状对称的圆形，散发着温暖的金色、藏红花色、橙色、珊瑚色、洋红色、紫罗兰色，核心处带有淡淡的青色。在正中心，放置一个光芒四射的圆形核心，中心是一个明亮的青蓝色圆点，周围环绕着粉色、洋红色、橙色和金色的同心圆，宛如一颗发光的灵性太阳。在其周围，构建许多密集排列的同心圆带，由细小的宝石状眼睛、珠状形态、圆点和金银丝细工组成，所有元素均以精确的旋转对称方式排列。在中心周围形成一个四点菱形结构，上下左右各有 4 簇巨大的花瓣状火焰，对角象限则有 4 簇较小的卷曲螺旋。在最外层的正方向上，包含 4 个嵌入羽毛状金色形态中的大型杏仁状眼睛图案。整个曼陀罗中，包含数十个镶嵌在圆环中的微型彩色眼睛，暗示着全知全能的觉知。采用极细的点画法、微线条、华丽的羽毛纹理和闪烁的装饰细节，内部结构以发光的金色和象牙色为主，向外边缘过渡为紫罗兰色和薰衣草色点状颗粒组成的弥散光晕。图像应具有神秘、超然、复杂、平衡和冥想的质感，如同一个天体曼陀罗或幻象神圣徽章，呈现出清晰的高细节线条艺术与柔和绚丽的色彩融合。

templates.title: Children's crayon-style portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 儿童蜡笔画风格肖像

templates.prompt: A realistic overhead photograph shows a child's crayon drawing on a slightly wrinkled piece of white paper placed on a wooden table. The drawing depicts a scene in a naive, elementary school style.{argument name="character" default="Donald Trump"} A simple portrait, with messy yellow crayon hair, peach-colored skin, large ears, a blue suit jacket, a white shirt collar, and a red tie. The face faces forward and occupies most of the page. On the left side of the page, a raised hand is making a rude gesture with the middle finger extended. The lines are uneven black pencil or crayon outlines, the coloring rough, sloppy, and deliberately clumsy, with obvious childlike strokes, even extending beyond the lines. On the right side of the page are vertical lines of handwritten black Japanese characters.{argument name="side text" default="とらんぷさん"} The composition is a casual smartphone snapshot rather than a sharp scan, showcasing the entire sheet of paper, slight perspective distortion, soft indoor lighting, and the texture of the wood surface surrounding the paper. It emphasizes the realistic texture of handmade crayons, clumsy proportions, and a convincingly "badly drawn but charming" aesthetic of children's art.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张逼真的俯拍照片，展示了放置在木质桌面上一张略有褶皱的白纸上的儿童蜡笔画。画作以稚拙的小学风格描绘了 {argument name="character" default="Donald Trump"} 的简单肖像，有着凌乱的黄色蜡笔头发、桃色皮肤、大耳朵、蓝色西装外套、白色衬衫领子和红色领带。面部正对前方并占据了纸张的大部分空间，纸张左侧有一只抬起的手，正竖着中指做出粗鲁的手势。线条是不均匀的黑色铅笔或蜡笔轮廓，上色粗糙、潦草且刻意笨拙，带有明显的儿童笔触，甚至超出了线条范围。纸张右侧有竖排的黑色手写日语文字 {argument name="side text" default="とらんぷさん"}。构图为随意的智能手机快照，而非清晰的扫描件，展现了整张纸、轻微的透视畸变、柔和的室内光线以及纸张周围木质表面的纹理。强调真实的手工蜡笔质感、笨拙的比例以及令人信服的“画得不好但很有魅力”的儿童艺术美感。

templates.title: Anime-style Rapunzel Tower Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫风格长发公主高塔场景

templates.prompt: A fantastical animated fairy tale illustration depicting {argument name="character name" default="Rapunzel"} She leaned out of the window of the towering stone tower, her gaze slightly upward from the outside. She wore a soft lavender-colored medieval-style princess dress with puff sleeves, white lace trim, and a fitted bodice, and a pink and white rabbit ear headband. Her extremely long {argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown"} Her hair was braided into a huge, thick braid, hanging down from the windowsill and extending to the bottom of the picture. A fluffy white rabbit sat on her right shoulder, adding a touch of adorable fantasy. The stone tower was light beige, with round windowsills, arched window openings, and deep purple interior curtains. Green ivy climbed the walls and window frames. The background presented a sunny, fairytale landscape: a clear blue sky, fluffy white clouds, rolling green hills, a winding river, a three-arched stone bridge, and a European-style town with a castle or cathedral in the distance. The overall atmosphere was triumphant, charming, and magical, like a sophisticated high-end fantasy anime key visual. The painting features rich detail, soft natural light, clean lines, delicate atmospheric perspective, lush vegetation, elegant composition, and a vertical format.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅充满奇幻色彩的动漫童话插画，描绘了 {argument name="character name" default="Rapunzel"} 从高耸的石塔窗户探出身子，视角从外部略微仰视。她身穿一件柔和的薰衣草色中世纪风格公主裙，配有泡泡袖、白色蕾丝花边和修身胸衣，头上戴着粉白相间的兔耳朵发箍。她极长的 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 头发编成了一条巨大的粗辫子，从窗台上垂下，一直延伸到画面底部。一只毛茸茸的小白兔坐在她的右肩上，增添了一抹可爱的奇幻气息。石塔呈浅米色，带有圆形的窗台、拱形窗洞、深紫色的室内窗帘，墙壁和窗框上爬满了绿色的常春藤。背景展现了一幅阳光明媚的童话景观，天空湛蓝，白云朵朵，连绵的青山、蜿蜒的河流、一座三拱石桥，以及远处带有城堡或大教堂的欧式小镇。整体氛围充满胜利感、迷人且富有魔力，如同精致的高端奇幻动漫主视觉图。细节丰富的绘画质感，柔和的自然光，干净的线条，细腻的空气透视，茂密的植被，优雅的构图，竖构图。

templates.title: Anime-style summer soft drink advertisement poster

templates.prompt: A bright, vibrant anime-style summer soda advertisement poster is set against a beach backdrop. The sky is a vivid cobalt blue, dotted with towering white clouds, and the sun is positioned near the top center, creating lens flare and radiating beams. The image features three Japanese high school girls dressed in matching summer sailor uniforms: short-sleeved white blouses with navy blue ribbon bows and dark navy blue pleated skirts. All three have dark hair, varying in length from shoulder-length to long, flowing in the wind, and their poses are youthful and lively. In the left foreground, a girl dramatically pushes a large plastic soda bottle towards the viewer from a low angle, making it dominate the composition; through perspective, her hand and the bottle appear exceptionally large. In the center, a second girl sits low by the water, one knee raised, drinking from a smaller bottle of soda. On the right, a third girl stands in profile or three-quarter view, also drinking soda, her hair and skirt billowing in the sea breeze. The seawater is a rich turquoise color, bathed in bright sunlight. Vibrant waves outline the lower left and right edges, with water droplets and shimmering points of light scattered throughout the image. A few white seabirds dot the distant sky. The overall atmosphere is fresh, nostalgic, youthful, and cinematic, much like the main visual for a high-end Japanese beverage. The bottle label should be a simple, minimalist white design, printed with a modern sans-serif font.{argument name="brand name" default="ASCII SPARK"} Below is smaller text describing the flavor.{argument name="flavor text" default="Yuzu White Peach Brackish Water"} And a small 500 mL label. The brand logo is placed in the upper left corner, using thin capital letters, with a white handwritten Japanese slogan added in the lower left corner.{argument name="tagline text" default="Summer gives us a moment of pure exhilaration."} The bottle combines refreshing cel animation rendering with painterly light effects, presenting ultra-fine water droplets, condensation droplets, transparent plastic texture, sparkling carbonated bubbles, and a highly dynamic perspective shortening effect.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张明亮、充满活力的动漫风格夏季汽水广告海报，背景设定在海边，天空是鲜艳的钴蓝色，点缀着高耸的白色积云，烈日位于顶部中心附近，产生镜头光晕和放射状光束。画面中包含 3 名身穿同款夏季水手服的日本女高中生：短袖白衬衫配海军蓝丝带蝴蝶结和深海军蓝百褶裙。三人的头发均为深色，随风飘动，长度从齐肩到长发不等，姿态青春活泼。左侧前景处，一名女孩以戏剧性的低角度将一个大塑料汽水瓶推向观众，使其在构图中占据主导地位；通过透视效果，她的手和瓶子显得格外巨大。中间位置，第二名女孩低坐于水边，单膝抬起，正喝着一瓶较小的汽水。右侧，第三名女孩以侧面或四分之三侧面站立，同样在喝汽水，她的头发和裙摆在海风中飘动。海水呈现出浓郁的绿松石色，阳光明媚，充满活力的浪花勾勒出左下和右下边缘，画面中散布着水滴和闪烁的光点。远方的天空中点缀着几只白色海鸟。整体氛围清新、怀旧、青春且具有电影感，如同高端日本饮料的商业主视觉。瓶身标签应为简洁的白色极简风格，印有现代无衬线字体 {argument name="brand name" default="ASCII SPARK"}，下方配有较小的风味文字 {argument name="flavor text" default="柚子白桃汽水"} 以及细小的 500 mL 标识。品牌 Logo 置于左上角，采用纤细的大写字母，左下角添加白色手写风格的日文标语 {argument name="tagline text" default="夏がくれる、はじけるひととき。"}。采用清爽的赛璐珞动漫渲染与绘画感光效相结合，瓶身呈现超精细的水滴、冷凝水珠、透明塑料质感、闪烁的碳酸气泡以及极具张力的透视缩短效果。

The image includes souvenir kiosks displaying postcards and signs, flower stalls overflowing with blooms, a café terrace covered with red and white checkered tablecloths, a carnival mask shop window, stacks of vintage suitcases along the canal, striped mooring posts, clothes drying between buildings, wrought iron lamps, and old buildings in peach, ochre, and cream colors with green shutters and terracotta tile roofs. Clearly visible shop signs read "MASCHERE," "CAFFÈ," "SOUVENIRS," "FIORI," and "VENEZIA." Hidden within the scene {argument name="duck count" default="4"} A few small yellow rubber ducks serve as a fun search challenge, with one prominently displayed next to a stack of suitcases, while the others are cleverly integrated into the bustling market details. A fluffy white dog is added next to a flower stall. The overall style resembles a high-end collectible toy city illustration, rich in layers, full of joy and warmth, with a travel theme, soft depth of field, clear miniature texture, and a lively fairytale atmosphere.{argument name="city" default="Venice"} As a location inspiration, and to present the crowd{argument name="character style" default="Cute chibi tourists"} The style showcases various poses such as walking, chatting, taking photos, shopping, sitting in a cafe, standing on a bridge, and riding a gondola.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度精细的等轴测微缩立体模型插画，展现了温暖金色日光下热闹的威尼斯运河广场。画面呈现出超可爱的纯手工旅行场景质感，包含 Q 版玩偶般的游客、微型店面、纹理丰富的石板路、花箱、条纹遮阳篷以及波光粼粼的绿松石色水面。整体构图紧凑且充满奇趣，设计为隐藏物品游戏场景，右上角的装饰牌上写着 {argument name="headline text" default="找到小鸭子！🐤"}。展现迷人的威尼斯风情，中心有一座横跨狭窄运河的拱形石桥，水中有数艘贡多拉，还有数十位身着彩色服装、戴着帽子、墨镜，手持相机和购物袋的游客与当地人。画面中设有摆放明信片和标牌的纪念品亭、鲜花簇拥的花摊、铺着红白格子桌布的咖啡馆露台、狂欢节面具店橱窗、运河边堆叠的复古行李箱、条纹系船柱、建筑间晾晒的衣物、锻铁路灯，以及漆着绿色百叶窗、盖着赤陶瓦屋顶的桃色、赭色和奶油色老建筑。包含清晰可见的店招，写着“MASCHERE”、“CAFFÈ”、“SOUVENIRS”、“FIORI”和“VENEZIA”。在场景中隐藏 {argument name="duck count" default="4"} 只黄色小橡皮鸭作为趣味搜寻挑战，其中一只特别显眼地停在堆叠的行李箱旁，其余则巧妙地融入在繁忙的市场细节中。在花摊旁加入一只毛茸茸的小白狗。整体风格如同高端收藏级玩具城市插画，层次丰富、充满欢乐与温馨的旅行主题，具有柔和的景深、清晰的微缩质感和热闹的童话氛围。以 {argument name="city" default="Venice"} 作为地点灵感，并让人群呈现 {argument name="character style" default="可爱的 Q 版游客"} 风格，展现行走、聊天、拍照、购物、在咖啡馆小坐、站在桥上以及乘坐贡多拉等多种姿态。

templates.prompt: This is a highly detailed isometric toy-model style illustration depicting the bustling canal district of Venice in an adorable, chibi-style, hidden object scene reminiscent of a "find the ducklings" game. The image showcases the vibrant streets and canals of ancient Venice, crammed with hundreds of miniature characters—each with exaggerated proportions, bright eyes, and diverse attire—almost filling every sidewalk, bridge, balcony, gondola, and café seat. The composition employs a vertical, three-quarter-length perspective, overlooking a narrow canal running through the center, with a stone arch bridge at the top center and densely packed historical buildings in warm tones on either side. Architectural features include terracotta roofs, faded orange, ochre, cream, and brick-red stucco walls, green shutters, flower boxes, striped awnings, hanging signs, lanterns, and richly detailed shopfronts. To the upper left is a tall clock tower with a sign that reads "PONTE DEI SOSPIRI"; to the right of the bridge is a red awning that reads "Cafe Venezia"; to the upper right is a building with a huge "TRATTORIA" sign; there is also a green sign that reads "AL VAPORETTO San Marco - Rialto"; to the left is a striped awning that reads "GELATO"; a small "FOTO" sign; in the lower left corner of the square is a kiosk that reads "CARNEVALE DI VENEZIA"; to the lower right is a glowing shop that reads "MURANO GLASS"; and near the edge of the canal on the right is a small "SUPRI" sign. Seven gondolas are moored in the canal, each with passengers and gondoliers wearing striped shirts and straw hats, and red and white mooring posts are visible in the water. The square and canal edges are filled with market stalls, coffee tables under two large parasols, carnival masks, balloons, framed artwork, pastries, glassware, souvenirs, flowers, and streetlights. More chibi-style characters watching the scene are placed in windows, balconies, and doorways. A small yellow rubber duck is hidden in a window next to the "TRATTORIA" building in the upper right corner, making it clearly visible yet easily overlooked. A decorative sign in the upper right corner reads "Find the duck!" with a small duck icon. The overall rendering employs an ultra-high-density, handcrafted miniature aesthetic, with clear details, warm, saturated colors, soft lighting, and a cinematic quality, exuding the charm of a playful travel poster and the atmosphere of a whimsical vacation puzzle book.

promptLocalized.zh: 这是一幅高度精细的等轴测玩具模型风格插画，描绘了拥挤的威尼斯运河区，采用可爱的 Q 版风格，设计为“寻找小鸭子”的隐藏物品场景。画面展示了繁华的古老威尼斯街道和运河，挤满了数百个头部比例夸张、眼神明亮、穿着各异的微型角色，几乎填满了每一条人行道、桥梁、阳台、贡多拉和咖啡馆座位。构图采用垂直俯视的四分之三视角，俯瞰穿过中心的一条狭窄运河，上方中部有一座石拱桥，两侧是色调温暖的密集历史建筑。建筑特色包括赤陶屋顶、褪色的橙色、赭石色、奶油色和砖红色的灰泥墙、绿色百叶窗、花箱、条纹遮阳篷、悬挂的招牌、灯笼以及细节丰富的店面。左上方有一座高大的钟楼，挂着写有“PONTE DEI SOSPIRI”的招牌；桥右侧有一个写着“Cafe Venezia”的红色遮阳篷；右上方的建筑上有一个巨大的“TRATTORIA”招牌；还有一个写着“AL VAPORETTO San Marco - Rialto”的绿色招牌；左侧有一个写着“GELATO”的条纹遮阳篷；一个小型的“FOTO”招牌；左下角广场上有一个标有“CARNEVALE DI VENEZIA”的售货亭；右下方有一家发光的商店，标有“MURANO GLASS”；右侧运河边缘附近还有一个小的“SUPRI”招牌。运河里停着 7 艘贡多拉，每艘船上都有乘客和穿着条纹衫、戴着草帽的船夫，水中还有红白相间的系船柱。广场和运河边缘摆满了市场摊位、两把大遮阳伞下的咖啡桌、狂欢节面具、气球、装裱艺术品、糕点、玻璃器皿、纪念品、鲜花和路灯。在窗户、阳台和门口，放置了更多正在观看场景的 Q 版人物。在右上角“TRATTORIA”建筑旁的一个窗户里隐藏着 1 只黄色小橡皮鸭，使其清晰可见但又容易被忽略。在右上角添加一个装饰性招牌，上面写着“Find the duck!”并配有一个小鸭图标。整体渲染采用超高密度的手工微缩模型美学，细节清晰，色彩饱和温暖，光影柔和且具有电影质感，散发着俏皮的旅游海报魅力和奇趣的度假解谜书氛围。

templates.prompt: A casual smartphone photo taken in a home office or gaming setup, shot vertically from a first-person perspective. In the foreground, a left hand holds a black ceramic mug with partially white lettering, absurdly filled with a rich chicken masala instead of a beverage. The curry is a deep orange-red, creamy smooth, with three pieces of chicken visible, topped with a swirl of white yogurt and garnished with a few fresh cilantro leaves. The mug sits on a dark brown wooden table on the left side of the frame. The background presents a realistic tabletop scene: a black adjustable desk lamp on the left, a black wall switch on the off-white wall revealing white heating pipes and radiators, a red audio jack with knobs and cables behind the table, a white game controller behind the mug, a computer monitor displaying an instant messaging application on the right edge, several cables scattered on the table, and a large dark tablecloth with subtle red decorative patterns in the lower right corner. Using warm afternoon indoor light with soft shadows, it presents a slight wide-angle mobile phone lens distortion, and the hand and mug in the foreground have a shallow depth of field effect, presenting an overall humorous yet highly realistic everyday snapshot aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张在家庭办公室或游戏桌面环境下拍摄的随性智能手机照片，采用第一人称视角垂直拍摄。前景中，一只左手拿着一个印有部分白色标志文字的黑色陶瓷马克杯，杯子里荒谬地装满了浓郁的鸡肉玛萨拉，而不是饮料。咖喱呈浓郁的橘红色，质地奶油般顺滑，可以看到 3 块鸡肉，顶部有白色酸奶漩涡，中心点缀着少量新鲜香菜叶。马克杯位于画面中左侧，放置在深棕色木质桌面上。背景展示了写实的桌面场景：左侧有一盏黑色可调节台灯，米白色墙壁上有一个黑色墙壁开关，可见白色的暖气管道和暖气片，桌面后方有一个带有旋钮和线缆的红色音频接口，马克杯后方有一个白色游戏手柄，右侧边缘有一台显示着即时通讯应用界面的电脑显示器，桌面上散落着几根线缆，右下角有一张带有细微红色装饰图案的大型深色桌垫。采用温暖的午后室内光线，带有柔和的阴影，呈现出轻微的广角手机镜头畸变，前景的手和马克杯具有浅景深效果，整体呈现出一种幽默但高度写实的日常快照美学。

templates.title: A stylish bride wearing a hat

titleLocalized.zh: 佩戴礼帽的时尚新娘肖像

templates.prompt: A high-fashion studio portrait, featuring a young woman reclining on the ground against a seamless light gray background. The composition cuts downwards from her hat to her hands, with her face deliberately blurred in a soft rectangular shape. She wears an elegant white dress made of sheer, pleated fabric, adorned with three-dimensional floral appliqués on the straps and bodice; the fitted cut creates an ethereal silhouette. Her hair color is {argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown to black"} Her hair was styled into two long, puffy braids, one on each side, each braid secured with multiple white hair ties into rounded sections. She wore an exaggerated, tilted white hat adorned with layers of tulle, mesh, ribbon loops, lace trim, and a few tufts of light feathers. The pose was designed with one elbow supporting her weight, the other hand reaching towards the lower edge of the frame, her torso tilted diagonally for a sophisticated fashion magazine composition. The lighting employed soft, diffused studio light, smooth skin tones, minimalist shadows, a luxurious bridal styling, monochromatic white clothing accents, and a clean, crisp magazine aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高级时尚影棚肖像，拍摄一位年轻女性侧卧在无缝浅灰色背景前的地面上，构图从帽子向下截取至手部，面部特意用柔和的矩形模糊处理。她身着一件优雅的白色礼服，采用透明褶皱面料，肩带和胸前饰有立体花卉贴花，剪裁修身，呈现出空灵的轮廓。她的发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色至黑色"}，梳成两条长长的泡泡辫，两侧各一条，每条辫子用多个白色发圈扎成圆润的节段。她佩戴着一顶倾斜的夸张白色礼帽，由层叠的网纱、网格、丝带环、蕾丝花边和几簇轻盈的羽毛装饰而成。姿势设定为单手肘支撑，另一只手伸向画面下边缘，躯干呈对角线倾斜，以呈现精致的时尚杂志构图。采用柔和的漫射影棚光，平滑的肤色，极简的阴影，奢华的新娘时尚造型，单色白色服装点缀，以及干净利落的杂志美学。

templates.title: Avant-garde Bride Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 先锋派新娘肖像

templates.prompt: A high-fashion studio portrait, featuring a woman seated against a seamless light gray background, presenting an ethereal bridal look with a vertical composition from headpiece to the ends of her hair. She wears a flowing, sleeveless white gown with a high-necked, ruffled design, a sheer, ruffled chiffon covering the bodice, and delicate white floral appliqués adorning the neck, bust, waist, and upper hem, the soft, draped skirt cascading to the floor. Her hair color is {argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown"} Her hairstyle featured two extremely long, oversized bubble braids, one on each side, each tied with a white ribbon. The left braid had four bubble sections, and the right braid had three, both extending to the ground in thick, glossy loops. She also wore an exquisite white hat tilted to one side, made of lace, mesh, and sculptural floral details. This diagonal tilt, with one hand on the ground and her torso leaning, created an elegant editorial pose. Maintaining a sophisticated, bridal, and avant-garde style, the design employed soft, diffused lighting to showcase realistic skin texture, clear fabric details, minimalist shadows, and a clean, luxurious magazine aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高级时装摄影棚肖像，拍摄一位坐在无缝浅灰色背景前的女性，呈现空灵的新娘造型，采用从头饰到发尾的垂直构图。她身着飘逸的无袖白色礼服，高领褶皱设计，胸前覆盖透明褶皱雪纺，颈部、胸部、腰部及裙摆上部点缀着精致的白色花朵贴花，柔软的垂坠裙摆铺散在地面上。她的头发颜色为 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"}，造型为 2 条极长的超大泡泡辫，两侧各一条，每段均用白色发带扎起；左侧辫子可见 4 个泡泡节，右侧辫子可见 3 个泡泡节，两条辫子以厚实光泽的环状延伸至地面。她还佩戴了一顶向一侧倾斜的精致白色礼帽，由蕾丝、网纱和雕塑感花卉细节制成。让她呈对角线倾斜姿势，一只手撑在地面，躯干倾斜，营造出优雅的编辑时尚姿态。保持精致、新娘风与先锋派的格调，采用柔和的漫射光，展现真实的皮肤质感、清晰的织物细节、极简的阴影，以及干净的奢华杂志美学。

templates.title: Main image showing protein powder splatter effect

titleLocalized.zh: 蛋白粉飞溅效果主图

templates.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic commercial product splash effect, featuring a large white plastic whey protein bucket with a label printed on it.{argument name="brand name" default="PUREZZA"} and{argument name="product name" default="WHEYPRO"} The protein shaker is suspended above a glass filled with a thick chocolate protein shake. The protein shaker is centered, slightly tilted to the right, with a glossy, smooth surface and a striking blue, white, and black label. The label should prominently state "100% WPC PROTEIN MILK" and include small nutritional information such as "82G PROTEIN," "2G SUGAR/SERVING," "119% RDI OF VC," "100% CHOLINE," a circular "GMP" badge, a black stripe printed with "WHEY MILK PROTEIN CONCENTRATE," another stripe printed with "LOW SUGAR / LOW FAT / RICH NATURAL," and a flavor label.{argument name="flavor text" default="BLACK COOKIES FLAVOUR"} The protein shaker is surrounded by upward and outward sprays of glossy chocolate liquid, creating dramatic arcs, droplets, and a dynamic effect of seemingly frozen in mid-air. The scene includes five whole chocolate sandwich cookies, along with scattered cookie fragments and crumbs, with a cookie partially visible in the lower right and upper left corners. Only a portion of the glass at the bottom is visible, appearing transparent and overflowing due to the splashing impact. A high-contrast studio background is used, with a deep blue gradient on the left transitioning to bright white on the right, employing cinematic contour lighting for sharp reflections. The protein shaker is sharply focused, and the textures of the liquid and cookie crumbs are richly detailed. The overall style should convey the feel of a high-end sports nutrition advertisement, full of dynamism and energy, making it ideal as the header image for a modern fitness e-commerce website.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超写实的商业产品飞溅效果图，主体为一个大型白色塑料乳清蛋白桶，标签上印有 {argument name="brand name" default="PUREZZA"} 和 {argument name="product name" default="WHEYPRO"}，悬浮在装满浓稠巧克力蛋白奶昔的玻璃杯上方。蛋白桶居中，略微向右倾斜，表面光洁亮丽，标签采用醒目的蓝、白、黑配色设计。标签应显著标明“100% WPC PROTEIN MILK”，并包含小型营养说明，如“82G PROTEIN”、“2G SUGAR/SERVING”、“119% RDI OF VC”、“100% CHOLINE”、一个圆形的“GMP”徽章、一条印有“WHEY MILK PROTEIN CONCENTRATE”的黑色条纹、另一条印有“LOW SUGAR / LOW FAT / RICH NATURAL”的条纹，以及一个口味标签 {argument name="flavor text" default="BLACK COOKIES FLAVOUR"}。蛋白桶周围环绕着向上和向外喷溅的亮面巧克力液体，呈现出富有戏剧性的弧线、液滴，以及定格在空中的动态效果。场景中包含 5 块完整的巧克力夹心饼干，以及散落在各处的饼干碎块和碎屑，右下方和左上方各有一块饼干局部可见。底部的玻璃杯仅露出部分，呈透明状，因飞溅冲击而溢出。使用高对比度的摄影棚背景，左侧为深蓝色渐变，向右过渡至明亮的白色，采用电影级的轮廓光，反射清晰，蛋白桶焦点极其锐利，液体和饼干碎屑的纹理细节丰富。整体风格应呈现高端运动营养广告的质感，充满动感与活力，非常适合作为现代健身电商网站的头图。

templates.title: Nighttime balcony flash selfie

titleLocalized.zh: 夜晚阳台闪光灯自拍

templates.prompt: A candid selfie of a young woman on her balcony at night, taken from a slightly high angle with her handheld phone. Her face is mostly obscured by shadows and the composition, emphasizing her outfit and the atmosphere rather than facial details. She kept {argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown"} Her long, wavy hair fell naturally over her shoulders. She had a medium wheatish complexion and wore two delicate gold necklaces, one a thin chain and the other with a small cross pendant. A subtle bracelet was visible on her wrist. She wore a fitted white sleeveless cropped top and {argument name="bottoms" default="Light blue low-rise jeans"} The waist is exposed. The pose is relaxed and slightly forward, with one arm outstretched holding a phone, presenting a casual outing style. The scene is set on a modern apartment balcony at night, with glass railings and a blurred distant city skyline in the background, dotted with tiny spots of light. Dim ambient light combined with the phone's direct flash illuminates the torso and hair, creating a strong contrast, soft noise, slight motion blur, and a realistic late-night social media selfie effect. The vertical composition, close-up cropping from the upper chest to the hips, realistic photography, emotional, intimate, unretouched, and naturally proportioned.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张年轻女性在夜晚阳台上的抓拍自拍，由手持手机以略高的角度拍摄，面部大部分被阴影和构图遮挡，重点突出穿搭和氛围而非面部细节。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 的长波浪卷发，自然垂落在双肩，肤色为中等小麦色，佩戴 2 条精致的金项链，一条为细链，另一条带有十字架小吊坠，手腕处可见一条低调的手链。她身穿一件修身的白色无袖短款背心和 {argument name="bottoms" default="浅蓝色低腰牛仔裤"}，露出腰部。姿势放松且略微前倾，一只手臂伸出持机，呈现出休闲的出门穿搭风格。场景设定在夜晚的现代公寓阳台，配有玻璃栏杆，背景是模糊的远方城市天际线，点缀着细小的光斑。使用昏暗的环境光配合手机直闪，照亮躯干和头发，营造出强烈的对比感、柔和的噪点、轻微的动态模糊，以及真实感十足的深夜社交媒体自拍效果。竖屏构图，从上胸部到臀部的近景裁剪，写实摄影，情绪化，私密感，未经修饰，自然比例。

templates.title: Spanish UPS socket wiring diagram

titleLocalized.zh: 西班牙语 UPS 插座接线信息图

templates.prompt: Using the provided APC Back-UPS reference image, convert it into a clear Spanish-labeled setup guide and overlay it directly onto the photo. Keep the UPS photo true and unchanged as the base image, but add color-coded labels to show which outlets are for battery backup and which only provide surge protection. Add two title boxes at the top: a dark gray box on the left with the text "SOLO PROTECCIÓN (sin batería)" and a green box on the right with the text "CON BATERÍA (recomendado para equipos críticos)". Highlight the four outlets on the right with a green outline group and individual green outlines, and place four numbered green labels on the right: "1 Servidor 1", "2 Servidor 2", "3 Servidor 3", "4 Switch (mover aquí)". On the left, highlight the currently used top-left outlet with an orange outline and add an orange label box with the text "Switch: mover de aquí", along with a curved arrow from that outlet to the bottom outlet in the green group on the right. In addition, the three sockets in the lower left corner are outlined in light gray, and three gray labels are added to the left: “Solo protection (sin batería)”, “No crítico”, and “Libre / periféricos”. At the bottom, a large yellow warning box with a warning icon is added, with the text: “Ojo: 3 servidores + 1 switch pueden sobrecargar un Back-UPS ES 700. Si pita o se apaga al probarlo, necesitas un SAI más potente.” The design adopts a clean infographic style, using clear and easy-to-read bold typography, neat rounded rectangles, high contrast, and practical IT chart presentation.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的 APC Back-UPS 参考图片，将其转换为一张清晰的西班牙语标注设置指南，并直接覆盖在照片上。保持 UPS 照片真实且不变作为底图，但添加颜色编码的标注，以显示哪些插座是电池备份的，哪些仅提供浪涌保护。在顶部添加 2 个标题框：左侧为深灰色框，文字为“SOLO PROTECCIÓN (sin batería)”，右侧为绿色框，文字为“CON BATERÍA (recomendado para equipos críticos)”。用绿色轮廓组和单独的绿色轮廓突出显示右侧的 4 个插座，并在右侧放置 4 个带编号的绿色标签：“1 Servidor 1”、“2 Servidor 2”、“3 Servidor 3”、“4 Switch (mover aquí)”。在左侧，用橙色轮廓突出显示当前使用的左上角插座，并添加一个橙色标注框，文字为“Switch: mover de aquí”，同时添加一条从该插座指向右侧绿色组底部插座的弯曲箭头。此外，用浅灰色勾勒出左下方的 3 个插座，并在左侧对齐添加 3 个灰色标签：“Solo protección (sin batería)”、“No crítico”和“Libre / periféricos”。在底部，添加一个带有警告图标的大型黄色警告框，文字如下：“Ojo: 3 servidores + 1 switch pueden sobrecargar un Back-UPS ES 700. Si pita o se apaga al probarlo, necesitas un SAI más potente.” 采用简洁的信息图风格，使用清晰易读的粗体排版、整洁的圆角矩形、高对比度以及实用的 IT 图表呈现方式。

The bottle is covered in realistic condensation droplets and features a white rubber dropper tip and a gleaming metallic gold neck. The front label is elegantly minimalist, printed with {argument name="brand name" default="HydraGlow"} The smaller text below is{argument name="product name" default="Vitamin C Serum - 30ml"} and{argument name="benefit line" default="Brightening & Anti-Aging Formula"} Above the brand name is a minimalist gold lotus-themed logo. Soft, natural morning light streams in from the side, creating delicate highlights, subtle shadows, and a clean, luxurious spa atmosphere. The shallow depth of field effect clearly focuses on the bottles, and the overall color scheme of neutral cream and white presents a high-end e-commerce advertising aesthetic, realistic texture, and a refined health brand style.

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华时尚大片风格 4:20 产品海报

templates.prompt: A minimalist, studio-style poster for a high-end fashion product. On the right side of the image stands an oversized, semi-transparent pink glass hookah, almost as tall as the composition itself. Its circular reservoir is half-full of pale pink liquid, and soft white smoke emanates from the top of its long, vertical neck. A downward-sloping conduit is visible inside the glass. A slender, athletic woman with dark skin and high-bun dreadlocks casually leans against the hookah on the left side of the image. Her face is softly blurred with a rectangular overlay. She wears a dark olive-colored sports bra, loose beige jogging pants, white mid-calf socks with green stripes, and thick-soled off-white sneakers. One leg is crossed in front of the other, and one arm rests on the hookah's slanted, bowl-shaped spout. Behind them, large, bold, dark green compressed numbers are printed on a warm beige wall.{argument name="headline text" default="4:20"} It almost covers the entire height of the background. In the bottom left corner, add a short, simple piece of Spanish text in sans-serif capital letters.{argument name="quote" default="DEJÓ DE SER EXCEPCIÓN. — YA FORMA PARTE DEL PAISAJE."} The overall visual effect should convey the quality of a luxury lifestyle advertising campaign: simple composition, soft earth tones, soft studio lighting, delicate shadows, clear product details, fashion magazine styling, realistic glass reflections, and sophisticated contemporary cannabis culture aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极简摄影棚风格的高端时尚产品海报。画面右侧矗立着一个超大尺寸的半透明粉色玻璃水烟壶，几乎与构图等高，圆形的储水室中盛着半满的淡粉色液体，长长的垂直壶颈顶部散发出柔和的白烟，玻璃内部可见斜向下的导管。一位深色皮肤、留着高发髻脏辫的苗条运动型女性，随性地倚靠在画面中左侧的水烟壶旁，她的面部被柔和的矩形模糊处理，身穿深橄榄色运动内衣、宽松的米色慢跑裤、带有绿色条纹的白色中筒袜以及厚底米白色运动鞋。她的一条腿交叉在另一条腿前，一只手臂搭在水烟壶倾斜的碗状接口上。在他们身后，暖米色的墙面上印有巨大的深绿色粗体压缩数字 {argument name="headline text" default="4:20"}，几乎覆盖了背景的整个高度。在左下角，添加一小段简洁的无衬线字体大写西班牙语文案 {argument name="quote" default="DEJÓ DE SER EXCEPCIÓN. — YA FORMA PARTE DEL PAISAJE."}。整体视觉效果应呈现出奢华生活方式广告大片的质感：构图简洁、大地色系柔和、柔光摄影棚照明、细腻的阴影、清晰的产品细节、时尚杂志造型、逼真的玻璃反射，以及精致的当代大麻文化审美。

templates.title: Retro handheld console themed fashion portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 复古掌机主题时尚肖像

templates.prompt: A high-quality studio fashion portrait, featuring a half-body shot of a young woman against a seamless, vibrant red background, with the subject centered. Her face is completely obscured by a solid, vertical rectangle of warm brown skin tone. She has {argument name="hair color" default="copper red"} Her hair was styled in several messy little buns on top of her head, with long, defined spiral curls hanging down on both sides, creating a playful Y2K fashion editor style. She wore rectangular black glasses, faintly visible on the left side of the visor; her right ear featured layered silver stud earrings and a long dangling earring. She wore a distressed grey layered outfit: a fitted inner layer, an outer sheer mesh short-sleeved top, and extra-long, fingerless sleeves with noticeable overlock stitching and wear marks. She also wore layered silver chain necklaces. Her nails were long, pointed, metallic lavender-colored manicures. Her right hand was placed at her chest, displaying a camera {argument name="handheld console" default="Blue Game Boy Advance SP"} The screen is dark and inactive, but the buttons are clearly visible. The left hand lightly touches the chin, striking a soft, fashionable pose, fingers slightly bent. The image should have a clean, commercial photographic quality, with clear details, soft and even lighting, realistic skin and fabric textures, and a striking color contrast between the gray clothing and the red background, exuding a cool and edgy retro gaming aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高规格的摄影棚时尚肖像，拍摄对象为一位年轻女性的半身照，背景为无缝的鲜红色，人物居中。她的面部被一个暖棕色肤色的实心垂直遮挡矩形完全覆盖。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="铜红色"} 的头发，头顶扎着多个凌乱的小发髻，两侧垂下长而清晰的螺旋卷发，营造出俏皮的 Y2K 时尚编辑风格。她戴着黑色长方形眼镜，在遮挡条左侧隐约可见；右耳戴着叠戴的银色耳钉和一只长款吊坠耳环。她身着做旧的灰色叠穿服装：内层修身，外层为透明网眼短袖上衣，并搭配超长分离式露指袖套，边缘带有明显的包缝线和磨损痕迹。她还佩戴了叠戴的银色链条项链。指甲为长款尖头金属薰衣草色美甲。她的右手置于胸侧，展示着一台朝向镜头的 {argument name="handheld console" default="蓝色 Game Boy Advance SP"}，屏幕呈暗色未激活状态，按键清晰可见。左手轻触下巴，摆出柔和的时尚姿势，手指微弯。图像应呈现出干净的商业摄影质感，细节清晰，光线柔和均匀，皮肤和织物纹理真实，灰色服装与红色背景形成鲜明的色彩对比，整体散发出酷飒的另类复古游戏美学。

templates.title: Sunrise over the Valley of the Enchanted House

titleLocalized.zh: 奇幻小屋山谷日出

templates.prompt: A heartwarming, fairytale-style rural illustration depicting a sunrise at the golden hour, rendered in a soft, whimsical digital gouache and watercolor style. The painting shows a cottage nestled in a lush green valley, complete with a warm red-orange tiled roof, cream-colored stucco walls, a stone chimney emitting wisps of smoke, a small porch, and a tiny upper-level balcony. The cottage is positioned in the lower right corner of the composition, surrounded by a vibrant garden filled with wildflowers and tall grass. In front of the cottage, a figure dressed in…{argument name="dress color" default="light blue"} A young girl in a dress and apron is gently sweeping the path with a broom. Near the porch, draw a black cat sitting upright. Beside the path, draw a small stone well with a wooden roof. To the right of the house, draw a clothesline with two white sheets hanging to dry. The foreground should be richly delineated with lush foliage and flowering plants, especially the two clumps of drooping leaves in the upper left and upper right corners, creating a natural vignetting effect. A winding dirt path begins in the foreground, passes the cottage, and extends into the distance through rolling meadows and forested hills. The middle ground and background are filled with layered green hills, pines, and deciduous trees, with soft morning mist permeating the valleys, and distant mountains appearing and disappearing in the hazy atmosphere. Use warm sunlight coming in from the left to illuminate the grass and rooftops with soft golden highlights, and soft peach-colored clouds float in the pale blue sky. The atmosphere should be tranquil, pastoral, nostalgic, and magical, like a landscape from a children's picture book. No text, no borders, richly detailed vegetation, painterly lines, balanced composition, and a square format.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅温馨的童话风格乡村插画，呈现黄金时刻的日出景象，采用柔和奇幻的数字水粉与水彩画风。画面展示了一座坐落在郁郁葱葱的绿色山谷中的小屋，配有温暖的红橙色瓦片屋顶、奶油色灰泥墙、冒着轻烟的石砌烟囱、一个小门廊和一个小型上层阳台。将小屋置于构图的右下角，周围环绕着开满野花和高草的繁茂花园。在屋前，画 1 位穿着 {argument name="dress color" default="浅蓝色"} 连衣裙和围裙的年轻女孩，正用扫帚轻轻清扫小径。在门廊附近，画 1 只坐姿端正的黑猫。在小径旁，画 1 口带木质屋顶的小石井。在屋子右侧，画 1 条晾衣绳，上面挂着 2 条正在晾晒的白色床单。前景应由茂密的枝叶和花卉植物丰富地勾勒，特别是左上角和右上角各 2 簇悬垂的叶子，营造出自然的暗角效果。一条蜿蜒的泥土小径从前景开始，经过小屋，穿过起伏的草甸和森林覆盖的山丘延伸至远方。中景和背景填充着层叠的绿色山丘、松树和落叶树，柔和的晨雾在山谷中弥漫，远处的山脉在大气朦胧中若隐若现。使用从左侧射入的温暖阳光，以柔和的金色高光照亮草地和屋顶，淡蓝色的天空中飘浮着柔和的桃色云朵。氛围应宁静、田园、怀旧且充满魔力，如同儿童绘本中的景观。无文字，无边框，细节丰富的植被，绘画感的线条，平衡的构图，正方形格式。

templates.title: Fairytale cottages in the Alps

titleLocalized.zh: 阿尔卑斯山谷中的童话小屋

templates.prompt: This dreamlike, picture book-style landscape painting depicts a cozy fairytale cottage nestled in a lush Alpine valley. The soft brushstrokes evoke warm sunlight and a delicate, atmospheric mist. The cottage, positioned slightly to the left of center, is next to a winding pebble path. It features cream-colored stucco walls, a steep, moss-covered thatched roof, a small chimney, arched dormer windows, and a bluish-green door. Flowers climb the walls and fence. In the left foreground, a large, leafy tree casts cool shadows over wildflowers, meadows, and rough wooden stakes. To the right, a clear stream meanders through the scene, flowing over an old stone bridge. In the middle ground, a small village with a church-like tower is hidden among the trees. In the background, towering, rugged mountains rise majestically, their slopes softened by the mist, their peaks surrounded by white clouds. The artwork uses rich greens, sun-kissed gold, and soft blue-gray mountains to create a tranquil pastoral atmosphere, featuring highly detailed vegetation, textured brushstrokes, and the unique charm of classic fantasy illustrations.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅梦幻般的绘本风格风景画，描绘了坐落在郁郁葱葱的阿尔卑斯山谷中的温馨童话小屋，采用柔和的绘画风格，呈现出温暖的阳光和细腻的大气雾感。小屋位于画面中心偏左侧，紧邻蜿蜒的石子小路，拥有奶油色的灰泥墙、陡峭且覆盖着苔藓的茅草屋顶、一个小烟囱、弧形老虎窗、青蓝色的大门，墙壁和栅栏周围爬满了鲜花。左侧前景是一棵枝繁叶茂的大树，为野花、草地和粗糙的木桩投下清凉的阴影。右侧，一条清澈的溪流穿过场景，流经一座古老的小石桥。中景处，一个带有教堂式塔楼的小山村掩映在树丛中。背景中，高耸崎岖的山脉巍峨耸立，山坡在薄雾中显得柔和，山顶环绕着洁白的云朵。画面采用浓郁的绿色、阳光般的金色、柔和的蓝灰色山脉，营造出宁静的田园氛围，并具备极高细节的植被、富有质感的笔触以及奇幻经典插画的独特韵味。

templates.title: "Blue Pen" campaign poster

titleLocalized.zh: “蓝笔”竞选海报

templates.prompt: A square, social media-format Brazilian political campaign poster, employing a hyper-stylized, cinematic texture with a deep blue and black color scheme, strong contrast, and a rough texture, presents the composition of a heroic propaganda poster. On the right side of the image, a middle-aged man wearing a bright royal blue polo shirt appears half-body facing the camera, one hand outstretched to the viewer, holding a blue ballpoint pen vertically as the central symbol. His posture is confident and determined, highly campaign-oriented, with the pen tip close to the lens creating a forced perspective effect. Behind him, two large flags hang above the background: the Puerto Rican flag in the upper left and the Brazilian flag in the upper right. Below, dark silhouettes of the crowd and the distant city skyline at sunset, with orange light shimmering on the horizon, create a rally atmosphere. On the left, four striking campaign slogans are arranged vertically, each preceded by a large blue "X" mark. The four text paragraphs must be completely identical: “ELE NÃO TEM A MIDIA”, “ELE NÃO TEM PROJETOS”, “ELE TAMBÉM NÃO TEM O POVO”, and “O RESTO ELE VAI DESCOBRIR NA HORA”. Use compressed capital letters, alternating between white and electric blue text for emphasis, with each slogan separated by a thin blue horizontal line. At the bottom is an oversized, distressed capital headline “CANETA AZUL”, with “CANETA” in weathered white and “AZUL” in vibrant blue, spanning almost the entire width. Below this is a blue italic compressed capital subheading “PARA DEPUTADO”, flanked by thin blue horizontal lines. The overall design should evoke the style of a viral meme campaign ad: bold, satirical, aggressive, and easily shareable, featuring dramatic contour lighting, sharp details, realistic skin and fabric textures, and sophisticated poster-quality composite effects.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张正方形社交媒体格式的巴西政治竞选海报，采用超风格化电影质感，色调为深蓝色与黑色，对比度强烈，纹理粗犷，呈现出英雄主义宣传海报的构图。画面右侧，一名中年男子身穿亮宝蓝色 Polo 衫，半身出镜面向镜头，一只手伸向观众，手中竖直握着一支蓝色圆珠笔作为核心象征物。他的姿态自信、坚定，极具竞选感，笔尖靠近镜头形成强迫透视效果。他身后背景上方悬挂着两面巨大的旗帜：左上方为波多黎各旗帜，右上方为巴西旗帜。背景下方是暗色的群众剪影和日落时分远处的城市天际线，地平线上闪烁着橙色光芒，营造出集会氛围。在左侧，垂直排列 4 条醒目的竞选标语，每条标语前均有一个巨大的蓝色“X”标记。4 段文字内容必须完全一致：“ELE NÃO TEM A MIDIA”、“ELE NÃO TEM PROJETOS”、“ELE TAMBÉM NÃO TEM O POVO”以及“O RESTO ELE VAI DESCOBRIR NA HORA”。使用压缩大写字体，白色与电光蓝文字交替强调，每条标语之间用细蓝色水平线分隔。底部放置一个超大号的做旧大写标题“CANETA AZUL”，其中“CANETA”为风化白色，“AZUL”为鲜艳蓝色，几乎横跨整个宽度。下方添加一行蓝色斜体压缩大写副标题“PARA DEPUTADO”，两侧配有细蓝色水平线。整体设计应呈现出病毒式传播的模因竞选广告风格，大胆、讽刺、具有侵略性且易于分享，具备戏剧性的轮廓光、锐利的细节、逼真的皮肤与织物纹理，以及精致的海报级合成效果。

templates.title: A surreal orange down jacket fashion shoot at a bus stop.

titleLocalized.zh: 超现实橙色羽绒服公交车站时尚大片

templates.prompt: A surreal haute couture photograph, set against a desolate Icelandic roadside backdrop under a somber, gray sky. At the center of the composition is a small, Brutalist-style concrete bus stop, its walls weathered and peeling, containing only a simple bench. A tall, slender adult man stands inside, dressed in a tailored black suit, shirt, and shoes, his gaze casually directed to one side. The entire bus stop is covered by a massive, bright orange down jacket, shaped like an inflatable tent, its canopy resembling a monumental sculpture. The collar hangs open above the roof, sleeves draped over the damp ground, the glossy nylon fabric displaying realistic folds, down filling, seams, and snap buttons—details of a high-fashion product. The foreground road, deep and rain-soaked, reflects delicate shadows, creating a cold, damp atmosphere. The background showcases barren hills with sparse snow and the windswept coastline of a remote region. Employing the shooting techniques of luxury magazine advertisements, the film emphasizes cinematic realism, centered composition, and soft natural light. The monochromatic environment contrasts sharply with the orange coat, the colors are minimalist, and there is a slight monumental distortion in proportion, presenting clear details in the fashion photography.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超现实的高级时装摄影作品，背景设定在冰岛风格的荒凉路边，天空阴沉灰暗。构图中心是一个小型粗野主义风格的混凝土公交车站，墙面斑驳风化，内部设有一张简单的长椅。一名身材修长的成年男子站在候车亭内，身穿剪裁考究的黑色西装、黑色衬衫和黑色皮鞋，神态自然地看向一侧。整个公交车站被一件巨大的亮橙色羽绒服覆盖，羽绒服呈充气帐篷状，如同纪念碑式的雕塑顶棚笼罩着候车亭；衣领在屋顶上方敞开，袖子垂落在潮湿的地面上，光泽感的尼龙面料呈现出逼真的褶皱、充绒隔层、接缝、按扣等时尚产品细节。前景中的道路深邃且被雨水打湿，带有细腻的倒影，营造出寒冷潮湿的氛围。背景展现了带有少量积雪的贫瘠丘陵，以及偏远地区被风吹拂的海岸线感。采用奢侈品杂志广告的拍摄手法，强调电影般的写实感、居中构图、柔和的自然光，单色环境与橙色外套形成强烈对比，色彩简约，带有轻微的纪念碑式比例失真，呈现出清晰的时尚摄影细节。

templates.title: Retro Pop Art Comics

titleLocalized.zh: 复古波普艺术漫画

templates.prompt: A four-panel comic strip in a bold, retro Sunday comic strip/1980s pop art style, featuring thick black outlines, halftone textures, vibrant, saturated colors (bright pink, cyan, yellow, and teal), and dynamic comic font. Main character: a stylish young woman with {argument name="hair color" default="Wavy mint green"} Hair, wearing oversized black sunglasses, dressed{argument name="clothing" default="Pink polka dot strapless top"} A confident expression, glossy lips, dramatic lighting. Secondary character: An adorable chibi penguin character (dark blue body, white belly, yellow beak hat), with bright, sparkling eyes, petite in stature, exuding a playful and mischievous aura. Panel 1 (Close-up, Bold Opening): A magnified portrait of the woman, her hair slightly swaying. A bright, cartoonish explosion background. Text: "The wind can't blow my sunglasses off!" Dialogue bubble: "Come on, breeze." Panel 2 (Beach Chaos Begins): A beach scene in strong winds—palm trees bend, hats, towels, and drinks are blown away. The woman stands confidently. The penguin character appears beside her. Text box: "Beach Day!" Dialogue bubble: "Ha! Dream on, wind." Little penguin text: "Quack!" Panel 3 (Wind Intensifies): Stronger gusts—trash cans tip over, seagulls soar in the air, debris flies everywhere. The woman remains calm, her hair dramatically swaying. The penguin laughs mischievously. Text box: “Stronger!” Dialogue bubble: “That’s it?” / Penguin: “Hehe!” 4th panel (final joke): Reveals a large electric fan wearing sunglasses dramatically blowing air. The woman is surprised. The penguin stands proudly next to the fan. Text box: “Ultimate BOSS.” Dialogue bubble: “Wait… no!” Large cartoon text: “You’ve been blown away!” Bottom caption: “Respect the fan.”

promptLocalized.zh: 一个采用大胆复古周日连环画 / 1980 年代波普艺术风格的 4 格漫画，具有粗黑轮廓线、半色调纹理、鲜艳饱和的色彩（亮粉色、青色、黄色、蓝绿色）以及动态漫画字体。主角：一位时尚的年轻女性，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="波浪状薄荷绿"} 头发，戴着超大号黑色太阳镜，穿着 {argument name="clothing" default="粉色波点抹胸上衣"}。自信的表情，光泽感双唇，戏剧性的光影。次要角色：一个可爱的 Q 版企鹅装扮角色（深蓝色身体、白色肚皮、黄色喙帽），有着闪亮的大眼睛，身形娇小，充满顽皮淘气的氛围。第 1 格（特写，大胆开场）：女性的放大肖像，头发微微飘动。明亮的漫画爆炸背景。文字：“风根本吹不掉我的墨镜！”对话气泡：“来吧，微风。”第 2 格（海滩混乱开始）：强风中的海滩场景——棕榈树弯曲，帽子、毛巾和饮料被吹飞。女性自信地站着。企鹅角色出现在一旁。文本框：“海滩日！”对话气泡：“哈！想得美，风。”小企鹅文字：“嘎！”第 3 格（风力增强）：更强的阵风——垃圾桶倾倒，海鸥在空中，碎片飞舞。女性依然镇定，头发戏剧性地飘动。企鹅顽皮地大笑。文本框：“更强了！”对话气泡：“就这？” / 企鹅：“嘿嘿！”第 4 格（最终笑点）：揭示一个戴着太阳镜的大型电风扇正在戏剧性地吹风。女性感到惊讶。企鹅自豪地站在风扇旁边。文本框：“终极 BOSS。”对话气泡：“等等……不！”大型漫画文字：“你被吹跑了！”底部标题：“尊重风扇。”

templates.title: Terrain Font Satellite View

titleLocalized.zh: 地形字体卫星视图

templates.prompt: A hyper-realistic satellite view from space, featuring a clean, modern editorial layout with nine vertical panels arranged on a white background, collectively forming the word "..."{argument name="word" default="MADPENCIL"} Each panel contains a letter composed entirely of natural Earth terrain, without any artificial text overlays: Panel 1 (M): Rugged mountains and deep valleys form a sharp, angular "M," with rock textures and high-altitude shadows; Panel 2 (A): A meandering river flows through a dense forest, forming an organic "A," with a strong contrast between water and vegetation; Panel 3 (D): Desert dunes and wind-eroded sand patterns sculpt a smooth "D," with warm tones and soft gradations; Panel 4 (P): Agricultural grids and patchwork fields form a structured "P," with clearly visible geometric patterns; Panel 5 (E): Glaciers and ice floes carve a crisp "E," with bright white and ice blue, and fractured textures; Panel 6 (N): Braided river systems on floodplains form an "N," with branching channels featuring natural flow lines; Panel 7 (C): Coastlines and ocean edges sculpt a curved "C," with visible waves and sediment gradations; Panel 8 (I): A narrow canyon or straight river traversing the terrain forms a minimalist "I" shape with a strong sense of verticality; Panel 9 (L): Volcanic terrain with lava flows forms an "L" shape, with dark rocks accented by glowing red/orange lava. A bird's-eye view, NASA Earth observation style, ultra-fine textures, realistic geographical environment, consistent panel proportions and lighting, sparse clouds, high contrast, sharp focus, subtle atmospheric haze, natural color gradation, ultra-high resolution 8K, clean panel spacing, modern gallery-style composition, visually coherent yet each panel presents a distinct biome, clearly legible lettering that blends organically with the terrain.

promptLocalized.zh: 来自太空的超写实卫星视图，白色背景上排列着 9 个垂直面板的简洁现代编辑布局，共同组成单词 "{argument name="word" default="MADPENCIL"}"，每个面板包含一个完全由自然地球地形构成的字母，无人工文字叠加：面板 1 (M)：崎岖的山脉和深谷形成锐利的角状 "M"，岩石纹理，高海拔阴影；面板 2 (A)：蜿蜒的河流穿过茂密的森林形成有机的 "A"，水体与植被对比强烈；面板 3 (D)：沙漠沙丘和风蚀沙纹塑造出平滑的 "D"，暖色调，柔和的渐变；面板 4 (P)：农业耕地网格和拼贴田野形成结构化的 "P"，几何图案清晰可见；面板 5 (E)：冰川和冰层雕刻出清脆的 "E"，明亮的白色和冰蓝色，断裂纹理；面板 6 (N)：洪泛区上的辫状河流系统形成 "N"，带有自然流线的分支河道；面板 7 (C)：海岸线和海洋边缘塑造出弯曲的 "C"，可见波浪和沉积物渐变；面板 8 (I)：穿过地形的狭窄峡谷或笔直河流形成极简的 "I"，强烈的垂直感；面板 9 (L)：带有熔岩流的火山地形形成 "L"，深色岩石点缀着发光的红/橙色熔岩。俯视卫星视角，NASA 地球观测风格，超精细纹理，逼真的地理环境，所有面板比例和光照一致，云层稀少，高对比度，焦点清晰，微妙的大气雾霾，自然色彩分级，超高分辨率 8K，面板间距整洁，现代画廊风格构图，视觉上连贯但每个面板呈现截然不同的生物群落，字母清晰可辨且与地形有机融合。

The perspective should convey a sense of aerial view with a slight angle, as if shot from a floating, airborne perspective, enhancing the sense of depth and spatial distortion. A striking, modern 3D typography is incorporated to spell out "{argument name="text" default="CITY NAME"} And seamlessly integrate it into the urban landscape; for example, incorporate it into streets, rooftops, or topography, making it appear as part of the environmental structure. Illuminate the scene in the soft sunlight of a slightly overcast day, using diffused light to create subtle shadows and realistic highlights on buildings, vegetation, and roads. Surround this miniature planet with a vast atmospheric sky, smoothly transitioning to abstract swirling clouds, adding a dreamlike quality without being overwhelming. Use a device specifically designed for {argument name="location" default="CITY NAME"} A custom-designed, balanced, and realistic color scheme, primarily featuring natural greens, sky blues, and subdued architectural hues, while maintaining color vibrancy and clarity. The final image is rendered in an ultra-detailed, realistic style, emphasizing the accuracy, depth, and environmental realism of textures, resulting in a refined, cinematic quality.

templates.title: Travel snapshot collage prompts

titleLocalized.zh: 旅行快照拼贴提示词

templates.prompt: A collage composed of 12 snapshots documents a young man{argument name="ethnicity" default="Chinese nationality"} Women in{argument name="location" default="Phuket"} Sentimental moments during solo travel are all from{argument name="device" default="smartphones"} Casual shots. Each frame is like a fleeting personal memory—imperfect, sunny, intimate, and natural, without any trace of posing. The woman in the images possesses a naturally full figure and soft contours, subtly highlighting her bust without exaggeration. Her state is authentic and unretouched, like a record from a private album. Scenes include: walking barefoot on the beach, a seaside under strong sunlight, swaying palm trees, overexposed reflections on the sea, a small local cafe, a simple motel room, a coastal sunset, a night market, and a view from inside a moving car. Smartphone shooting aesthetics are employed: slight motion blur, soft focus, overexposed highlights from tropical sunlight, lens flare, lens flare, high ISO noise at night, uneven composition, and casual cropping. The compositions exhibit randomness and spontaneity—the subject is sometimes off-center, partially obscured, in motion, or covered by light leaks. The interplay of light and shadow is diverse: the dazzling afternoon sun, the warm glow of the golden hour, the deep hues of sunset, and the damp streetlights at night. Color Grading: A faded cinematic feel, slightly reduced saturation with warm highlights, a nostalgic film look, fine graininess, and enhanced shadow detail. Emotional Tone: Loneliness, fleeting youth, bittersweet nostalgia, quiet introspection, like memories of a solo trip. Layout: 12 images arranged in a loose, irregular collage grid, slightly tilted and misaligned, like a scrapbook. No text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张由 12 帧抓拍组成的拼贴画，记录了一位年轻的 {argument name="ethnicity" default="中国籍"} 女性在 {argument name="location" default="普吉岛"} 独自旅行时的感性瞬间，均由 {argument name="device" default="智能手机"} 随手拍摄。
每一帧都如同转瞬即逝的个人记忆——不完美、阳光明媚、亲密且自然，毫无摆拍痕迹。

画面中的女性拥有自然丰满的身材和柔美的轮廓，在不夸张的前提下微妙地突显了胸部线条。她的状态真实且未经修饰，仿佛私人相册中的记录。

场景包括：赤脚走在沙滩上、强光下的海边、摇曳的棕榈树、过曝的海面反光、小型当地咖啡馆、简朴的汽车旅馆房间、海岸日落、夜市、从行驶中的车内向外看的视角。

采用智能手机拍摄美学：轻微的运动模糊、柔焦、热带阳光造成的过曝高光、镜头光晕、眩光、夜间高 ISO 噪点、不均匀的构图、随意的裁剪。

构图呈现出随机与自发感——主体有时偏离中心、部分被遮挡、处于运动中，或被漏光效果遮盖。

光影变化多样：刺眼的午后阳光、温暖的黄金时刻光芒、深沉的日落色调、潮湿的夜间街灯。

色彩分级：褪色的电影质感、略微降低饱和度并带有暖色高光、怀旧的胶片感、细腻的颗粒感、提升的暗部细节。

情感基调：孤独、转瞬即逝的青春、苦乐参半的怀旧感、安静的内省，如同独自旅行时的回忆。

布局：12 张图片以松散、不规则的拼贴网格排列，略微倾斜且不对齐，如同剪贴簿一般。

无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Detailed animal encyclopedia generation

titleLocalized.zh: 详细动物百科全书生成

templates.prompt: [Animal Name]{argument name="animal name" default="Enter animal name here"} [Objective] To create a large-format, publication-quality encyclopedia illustration, presented as a single image. Generate a publication-grade illustration that combines scientific accuracy with visual appeal. [Output Format] - Contain all information in a single image - Aspect Ratio: 16:9 - Quality: High (crucial for ensuring the accuracy of small text, thin lines, and labels) [Screen Design Principles] Layout, partitioning, information prioritization, margin design, typography, decorative elements, and color scheme should be determined autonomously by GPT based on the animal's characteristics, habitat, and classification. Design the most suitable layout for the specific animal, without being limited by templates. [Essential Elements] Integrate the following elements naturally into a single image: 1. Master Specimen Illustration - Full adult depiction with the highest precision - Scientifically accurate colors, patterns, and proportions - Scientific name (italic), common name, and classification information (order, family, genus) - Scale bar or size comparison 2. Growth/Development Record - Step-by-step illustrations of changes from juvenile to adult - Concise labels for each stage 3. Ecological/Behavioral Description - Scenes of action in the natural environment (foraging, predation, reproduction, territorial behavior, etc.) - Habitat vegetation and topography included in the background 4. Morphological Details - Close-ups of characteristic features (claws, teeth, feathers, scales, eyes, etc.) - Enlarged depiction of surface textures 5. Distribution/Habitat Range - World or regional distribution map - Habitat type description 6. Data Labeling - Body length, weight, lifespan, diet, conservation status (IUCN, etc.) - Easy-to-read tables or charts [Style Guidelines] - Publication-quality natural history encyclopedia style - Realistic botanical/naturalist painting style (19 (Precision of a 20th-century naturalist + Modern color expression) - Paper texture: Cream-colored hot-pressed watercolor paper or parchment-style - Typography: Uniform serif font. Scientific names use italics; data can use mixed small sans-serif fonts - Borders: Thin ink borders + classic graphic decorations - Overall color scheme, layout tone, and page design optimized by GPT based on habitat, classification, and ecology [most important directive]: Develop a deep understanding of the animal's unique ecological, cultural, and taxonomic characteristics to design a page that feels "made specifically for this animal." Visualize the essence of the animal, rather than using generic templates. Ensure all text is actually rendered within the image, without leaving blank labels.

promptLocalized.zh:
[动物名称]
{argument name="animal name" default="在此处输入动物名称"}

[目标]
完成一张可达到出版质量的大幅动物百科全书图版，作为单幅插图呈现。生成一张兼具科学准确性与视觉美感的出版级图版。

[输出格式]
- 将所有信息包含在一张图像中
- 长宽比：16:9
- 质量：高（对于确保小字、细线和标签的精确度至关重要）

[屏幕设计原则]
布局、分区、信息优先级、页边距设计、排版、装饰元素和配色方案应由 GPT 根据动物的特征、栖息地和分类自主决定。为该特定动物设计最合适的布局，不受模板限制。

[必须包含的基本要素]
将以下要素自然地整合到一个画面中：

1. 主标本绘图
- 以最高精度描绘成体全身
- 科学准确的颜色、图案和比例
- 学名（斜体）、俗名和分类信息（目、科、属）
- 比例尺或尺寸对比

2. 生长/发育记录
- 从幼体到成体变化的逐步插图
- 每个阶段的简洁标签

3. 生态/行为描绘
- 自然环境中的动作场景（觅食、捕食、繁殖、领地行为等）
- 背景中包含栖息地植被和地形

4. 形态细节
- 特征部位的特写（爪、牙、羽毛、鳞片、眼睛等）
- 表面纹理的放大描绘

5. 分布/栖息地范围
- 世界或区域分布图
- 栖息地类型描述

6. 数据标注
- 体长、体重、寿命、饮食、保护状况（IUCN 等）
- 易于阅读的表格或图标格式

[风格规范]
- 出版级自然历史百科全书风格
- 写实的植物/博物学家绘画笔触（19 世纪博物学家的精确度 + 现代色彩表现）
- 纸张质感：奶油色热压水彩纸或羊皮纸风格
- 字体：统一的衬线体。学名使用斜体；数据可使用混合的小号无衬线字体
- 边框：细墨线边框 + 古典图版装饰
- 整体配色、布局基调和页面设计由 GPT 根据栖息地、分类和生态进行优化

[最重要的指令]
深入理解该动物独特的生态、文化意义和分类特征，设计出一个仿佛“专为该动物而作”的页面。可视化该动物的精髓，而不是使用通用的模板。确保所有文本都实际渲染在画面内，不要留下空白标签。

templates.title: Anime school spy movie poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫校园间谍电影海报

templates.prompt: A dramatic, anime-style Japanese movie poster is set against the backdrop of a modern downtown street bathed in bright afternoon sunlight. Towering office buildings line both sides, their overhead wires crisscrossing the street. Vertical Japanese-style shop and company signs hang along the sides, and the street ends at a cinematic vanishing point. In the foreground, two high school girls stand confidently in heroic poses, framed by a low-angle composition reminiscent of a blockbuster poster. The girl on the left is slightly taller, with long, flowing black hair styled in a half-up bun adorned with a white flower hair accessory. Her arms are crossed, her expression serious and composed. She wears a navy blue school uniform blazer with gold buttons, a white shirt, a red tie, and a red plaid pleated skirt. She is bare-legged, wearing shiny black loafers. The girl on the right has a light brown bob haircut, her expression gentle yet determined, making a peace sign with her right hand. She wears the same navy blue blazer, white shirt, red tie, and red plaid pleated skirt, paired with navy blue over-the-knee socks and brown loafers. The two characters are elegantly and stylishly designed, presenting a refined modern anime illustration style with clear lines, rich cel shadows, and glossy highlights. Their hair and clothing have a subtle, windswept quality. The image uses strong contrasts: blue skies and white clouds, warm sunlight rim lighting, and long street shadows, creating the atmosphere of a high-budget action-drama film poster. A large, layered title layout is added at the bottom center, mixing Japanese and English in a bold, blockbuster style. Above the main title is a line of Japanese text, “一命と絆とスパイー” (Ichimei to Kizuna to Spy). The main title includes a striking line of large Japanese text, “私立あかつき学園” (Shiritsu Akatsuki Gakuen), emphasized in white, red, and cyan. Below this is an overlaid English subtitle, “THE SPY WHO FORGOT THE BONDS,” in a bold, white, compressed font with a grainy texture, where the word “SPY” is particularly large and prominent. The overall composition presents the feel of a fictional action-campus spy movie poster, in a vertical format, highly refined, and full of dynamism and dramatic tension.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张戏剧性的动漫风格日本电影海报，背景设定在明媚午后阳光下的现代市中心街道，两侧是高耸的办公大楼，上方布满了密集的电线，街道两旁挂着垂直的日式商店和公司招牌，道路尽头呈现出电影般的消失点。前景中，两名高中女生以自信的英雄姿态全身站立，采用类似大片海报主视觉的低角度构图。左侧女生身材稍高，一头乌黑长发随风飘动，半扎丸子头并配有白色花朵发饰，双臂交叉，表情严肃沉稳，身穿海军蓝校服西装外套，配金色纽扣、白衬衫、红领带和红格子百褶裙。她光着腿，穿着亮面黑色乐福鞋。右侧女生留着浅棕色短波波头，表情柔和但坚定，右手比出剪刀手。她穿着同款海军蓝西装外套、白衬衫、红领带和红格子百褶裙，搭配海军蓝过膝袜和棕色乐福鞋。两位角色设计优雅、时尚，呈现出精致的现代动漫插画风格，线条清晰，赛璐珞阴影丰富，高光亮泽，头发和衣物带有细微的随风飘动感。画面运用强烈的对比，蓝天白云，温暖的阳光轮廓光，长长的街道阴影，营造出高预算动作剧情片的海报氛围。在下方中心处添加大型分层标题排版，以粗犷的电影大片风格混合日文和英文。主标题上方包含一行日文标语“一命と絆とスパイー”。主标题包含一行醒目的大号日文“私立あかつき学園”，并以白色、红色和青蓝色进行强调。下方叠加一行英文副标题“THE SPY WHO FORGOT THE BONDS”，采用粗体白色压缩字体，带有颗粒质感，其中“SPY”一词尤为巨大且突出。整体构图呈现出虚构动作校园间谍电影海报的质感，竖版格式，高度精致，充满动态与戏剧张力。

templates.title: Cinematic Sakura Ronin Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 电影感樱花浪人海报

templates.prompt: A cinematic, vertical movie poster composition, themed around a film titled {argument name="title text" default="SAKURA RONIN"} A samurai-themed drama. In the foreground, a lone female ronin is positioned, shown from about three-quarters of her back, her head slightly turned towards the camera. Her dark, disheveled hair is loosely tied in a bun, with a few stray strands falling. She wears a floral kimono ranging from deep black to deep burgundy, adorned with delicate cherry blossom patterns and a neatly fastened sash. The fabric texture is realistic, conveying a sense of weariness and drama. In her right hand, she holds a samurai sword tilted downwards towards the lower left corner; a second sheathed sword hangs at her waist. Her posture is calm, resolute, and bears the marks of battle. The scene is filled with falling cherry blossom petals, some sharp and some blurred in the foreground and background. The setting is at dusk, with a raging fire behind a Japanese torii gate, smoke billowing into the stormy sky, the ground wet and reflecting shadows. Tiny silhouettes of figures are near the gate, mountains rise in the distance, embers float, and a strong warm backlight shines from the left. Utilizing high-contrast, cinematic lighting, the orange flames contrast with deep shadows, creating a sense of volume in the smoke, dramatic rim lighting on the ronin, shallow depth of field, and a distorted lens flare across the center of the frame. The ultra-realistic rendering, melancholic epic atmosphere, and sophisticated movie poster style are all achieved. Precise typography is added and integrated into the poster: at the very top, a large, tall, thin serif font in a deep crimson color displays the text {argument name="title text" default="SAKURA RONIN"} Directly below, the slogan uses a smaller, elegant italic serif font in a light ivory color, and the text content is as follows:{argument name="tagline text" default="One blade. One promise."} At the bottom center, use widely spaced small capital letters for the cast and crew list, in light beige, with the text content as follows:{argument name="bottom credits" default="A YOUART CINEMATIC PRESENTATION · STORY CHAIN · 2026"} Ensure the text is clear, centered, and highly legible. A total of two swords are visible in the image: one unsheathed katana in the hand, and one sheathed sword at the waist.

templates.title: Anime Suspense Movie Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫悬疑电影海报

templates.prompt: A dramatic Japanese movie poster, employing a refined anime film style and a vertical single-page composition. Set at night, the background presents a shimmering, futuristic cityscape of Tokyo and Gunma, filled with blue holographic HUD graphics, starlight-like particles, and overlays of surveillance interfaces. The poster features five visible characters: a close-up of a mysterious woman occupying the entire upper right background, her profile shown, with long black hair, wearing an elegant white wide-brimmed hat with a dark ribbon, her expression serious and enigmatic; three teenage students in the left foreground, wearing Japanese school uniforms (dark blazers, white shirts, and red striped ties), with a tall, disheveled boy in the center, a girl with a black ponytail on the left, and a short-haired girl facing forward on the right; and a minor supporting character in the lower right corner, a light-haired violinist in a heavy fur-trimmed winter coat, playing the violin. A glowing holographic map of Japan is added to the lower part of the image, with a red target star pointing towards Gunma Prefecture, accompanied by coordinates and data labels. Include visible small red and blue English interface text such as "OPERATION AKATSUKI", "THE BONDS NEVER DIES", "IN PROGRESS", "TARGET: AKATSUKI CITY", "AKATSUKI CITY", "GUNMA PREFECTURE", "JAPAN", and coordinate strings. The left-hand skyline should feature a Tokyo Tower-style landmark shimmering with orange-red light. Use strong blue, black, silver, and deep red lighting, wet, glossy highlights, falling snowflakes or ash particles, layered depth of field, and high-contrast painterly details. At the bottom, create a large, bold, metallic Japanese title in red, white, and blue:{argument name="headline text" default="Akatsuki Academy (private school)"} Below it is a large, metallic silver English subtitle:{argument name="tagline" default="THE BONDS NEVER DIES"} Add a small Japanese credits list above the release date, including a fictional director, screenwriter, character designer, and cast list, and center the release date at the very bottom.{argument name="release date" default="12.20 ROADSHOW"} The overall atmosphere should evoke the feel of a high-budget suspense drama, a youth ensemble mystery, or a sci-fi thriller anime movie poster.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满戏剧性的日本电影海报，采用精致的动漫电影风格，垂直单页构图。背景设定在夜晚，呈现出闪烁着未来感的东京与群马主题城市景观，画面中布满了蓝色全息 HUD 图形、星光般的粒子以及监控界面叠加效果。海报包含 5 个可见的角色元素：1 位占据右上角整个背景的神秘女性特写，侧脸出镜，留着长长的黑发，戴着一顶优雅的白色宽檐帽，配有深色丝带，表情严肃且难以捉摸；3 名位于左中前景的青少年学生，身穿日本校服（深色西装外套、白衬衫和红条纹领带），中间是一位高个子乱发男孩，左侧是一位扎着黑色马尾辫的女孩，右侧是一位短发女孩正面向前；以及 1 位位于右下角的小型配角，一位穿着厚重毛领冬装、正在拉小提琴的浅发色小提琴手。在画面中下部添加一张发光的日本全息地图，红色目标准星对准群马县，并配有坐标和数据标注。包含可见的红色和蓝色小字英文界面文本，如“OPERATION AKATSUKI”、“THE BONDS NEVER DIES”、“IN PROGRESS”、“TARGET: AKATSUKI CITY”、“AKATSUKI CITY”、“GUNMA PREFECTURE”、“JAPAN”以及坐标字符串。左侧的天际线应包含一个闪烁着橙红色光芒的东京塔式地标。使用强烈的蓝色、黑色、银色和深红色灯光，湿润的亮面高光，飘落的雪花或灰烬粒子，层叠的景深以及高对比度的绘画细节。在底部，创建一个巨大的粗体金属红、白、蓝三色日文标题：{argument name="headline text" default="私立 あかつき学園"}，下方配有巨大的金属银色英文副标题：{argument name="tagline" default="THE BONDS NEVER DIES"}。在上映日期上方添加小字日文演职员表，包括虚构的导演、编剧、角色设计和演员名单，并在最底部居中放置上映日期行：{argument name="release date" default="12.20 ROADSHOW"}。整体氛围应呈现出高预算悬疑剧、青春群像推理和科技惊悚动漫电影海报的质感。
