titleLocalized.zh: 燃烧的动漫校园惊悚片海报

templates.prompt: A highly dramatic Japanese anime movie poster, employing a dark action-thriller style, is a vertical single-page poster. The background depicts a school and city streets engulfed in flames at night, accompanied by blazing orange flames, thick black smoke, flying sparks, shattered buildings, slippery roads after rain, and a cinematic apocalyptic atmosphere. The upper half showcases close-ups of the profiles of two large, opposing characters, facing inwards: on the left is a boy with messy, medium-length brown hair, fair skin, and a serious expression, wearing a dark school uniform jacket and white shirt; on the right is a girl with long ponytail, fair skin, and a strong expression, also wearing a school uniform with a red ribbon tied at the collar. Between the two is a reflective blade tilted upwards, reflecting the firelight. A vertical Japanese slogan, in white serif font, is added at the top center, stating:{argument name="tagline text" default="This summer, hidden bonds will change destiny."} In the center, a large, layered Japanese title is placed, employing a worn metallic texture, heavy cinematic typography, dynamic scratches, sparks, and a contrasting red and blue color scheme. The content is {argument name="main title" default="Akatsuki Academy (private school)"} Above it is a smaller Japanese subtitle, "Kizuna to Spai to Natsu". Below it is a bold, silver, blockbuster-style English subtitle:{argument name="english subtitle" default="THE SUMMER WITH SHADOW BONDS"} The lower half showcases a full-body action scene: a determined-looking high school girl riding a blue sports motorcycle at high speed through a burning school street. She has short, brown hair that billows in the wind, her eyes sharp and focused. She wears a short-sleeved white shirt, a loose red tie, a plaid skirt, black fingerless gloves, and black shoes. Her posture is low and aggressive, as if she's chasing or fleeing. The motorcycle has sleek, angular lines, bright headlights, and clearly visible stickers, including "Shinobi" on the fairing and "250R" on the exhaust pipe. A police car with flashing red and blue lights is included in the background on the right. At the very bottom, a small Japanese movie credits-style text line is added, along with a gold-white release date line containing the following text:{argument name="release line" default="Summer 2025 Roadshow"} Employing ultra-refined anime illustrations, high-contrast lighting and shadows, glossy reflections, dramatic rim lighting, strong orange and blue color tones, dynamic perspectives, and sophisticated modern anime poster design, it presents the exquisite texture of a high-budget film's main visual.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的日本动漫电影海报，采用黑暗动作惊悚风格，构图为垂直的电影单张海报。背景是夜晚被火焰吞噬的校园和城市街道，伴有炽热的橙色火焰、黑色浓烟、飞溅的火星、破碎的建筑、雨后湿滑的路面以及电影般的末日氛围。上半部分展示 2 个大型对立角色的侧脸特写，面朝内侧：左侧是一位留着凌乱棕色中长发、皮肤白皙、表情严肃的少年，身穿深色校服外套和白衬衫；右侧是一位留着长马尾、皮肤白皙、表情强烈的少女，同样身穿校服，领口系着红色丝带。在两人之间，放置一把向上倾斜的反射刀刃，映照着火光。在上方中心添加垂直的日文标语，使用白色衬线字体，内容为 {argument name="tagline text" default="この夏、隠された絆が運命を変える―"}。在中间位置，放置一个巨大的分层日文标题，采用磨损的金属质感、厚重的电影排版、动态划痕、火花以及红蓝对比色，内容为 {argument name="main title" default="私立 あかつき学園"}，上方配有较小的日文副标题“絆とスパイと夏”。正下方添加粗体银色大片风格的英文副标题：{argument name="english subtitle" default="THE SUMMER WITH SHADOW BONDS"}。下半部分展示 1 个全身动作场景，一位神情坚定的女高中生正骑着一辆蓝色运动摩托车，在燃烧的校园街道上高速行驶。她留着短棕发，在风中飘动，眼神犀利专注，身穿短袖白衬衫、松开的红领带、格子裙、黑色露指手套和黑色鞋子。她的姿势压得很低，充满侵略性，仿佛正在追逐或逃离。摩托车线条流畅且棱角分明，带有明亮的前灯和清晰可见的贴纸，包括整流罩上的“Shinobi”和排气管上的“250R”。在右侧背景中包含 1 辆闪烁着红蓝警灯的追逐警车。在最底部，添加小号的日文电影演职员表风格文字行，以及金白色的上映日期行，内容为 {argument name="release line" default="2025.夏 ROADSHOW"}。采用超精细的动漫插画、高对比度光影、光泽反射、戏剧性的轮廓光、强烈的橙蓝调色、动态视角、高级现代动漫海报设计，呈现出高预算电影主视觉图的精致质感。

templates.title: Fantasy GPT Image Skill Banner

titleLocalized.zh: Fantasy GPT Image 技能横幅

templates.prompt: A richly detailed illustration of a fantasy studio, presented in a wide-format cinematic banner, depicts a group of mischievous young apprentices gathered around an elderly master craftsman in the center. The scene evokes the magical atmosphere of an artisan's workshop, complete with warm amber lighting, glowing runes, floating icons, scrolls, framed artwork, and a shrine overflowing with tools and antiques. At the top center, a striking black-brush banner displays large, hand-painted gold lettering.{argument name="headline text" default="GPTImage2Skill"} In the center sits an elderly saint with a topknot and a white beard, dressed in a multi-layered robe of brown and gray, calmly seated on a low stool, seemingly instructing his apprentices. Around him are eight chibi-style apprentices, their expressions exaggerated and lively, their black hair tied in small topknots, dressed in traditional clothing of purple, green, red, orange, yellow, blue, and cyan, each proudly displaying a different piece of art. Please accurately draw and display the eight apprentices plus the master in the center. On the far left, a child in purple kneels, holding an anime-style action portrait with an electric blue effect. In the upper left, a child in green holds up a beverage poster featuring matcha and East Asian lettering. Near the lower left, an apprentice in green displays a simple diagram with small UI boxes and charts. Near the center right, a child in orange-red holds a realistic photo of a luxury perfume bottle. To its right, a child in yellow-orange displays a realistic photo of a bird with a soft bokeh effect. In the upper right corner, a cheerful child holds up a tablet or framed mobile app screen displaying a clean interface. In the lower right corner, a child in blue showcases a dark-themed analytics dashboard filled with charts and graphs. In the upper right corner, a tall, imposing figure stands in a magnificent white-gold robe and crown-like headdress, holding two fantastical artworks: one a darker landscape, the other a moonlit city or temple scene. This upper right area should contain exactly two artworks. Scatter glowing, floating UI-style icons around the room; include exactly six floating icon/logo elements: a puzzle icon, a network node icon, a code window, a cube icon, a glowing sign next to the puzzle icon that says "PLUGIN," and a glowing star sign that says "SKILL." Additionally, add two glowing magic scroll banners, one near the upper right corner and the other in the bottom foreground, both overlaid with stylized colored code lines. The environment should feel like a combination of an ancient studio, a fantasy library, and a creative AI studio, complete with stone archways, wooden beams, distant mountain views visible through openings, and golden magical particles swirling in the air. The highly detailed digital illustrations are tightly composed, imbued with a fantastical epic feel, featuring saturated colors, strong edge lighting effects, and clear details, achieving a painterly quality comparable to a fantasy promotional poster.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张细节丰富的奇幻工作室插画，采用宽幅电影横幅格式，画面中一群顽皮的年轻学徒聚集在中央的一位老大师周围。场景营造出一种充满魔力的工匠工作室氛围，配有温暖的琥珀色灯光、发光的符文、漂浮的图标、卷轴、带框艺术品以及摆满工具和古玩的神龛。在顶部中央，一个引人注目的黑色笔触横幅上写着巨大的手绘金色文字 {argument name="headline text" default="GPTImage2Skill"}。中间坐着一位留着发髻、长着白胡子的老圣人，身穿棕褐色和灰色的多层长袍，平静地坐在矮凳上，仿佛正在指导这群学徒。在他周围有 8 位 Q 版学徒，他们表情夸张生动，黑发扎着小发髻，身穿紫色、绿色、红色、橙色、黄色、蓝色和青色的传统服饰，每个人都自豪地展示着不同的作品。请准确绘制并显示 8 位学徒加上中央的大师。最左侧，一名身穿紫衣的孩子跪着，手持一幅带有电光蓝色特效的动漫风格动作肖像。左上方，一名身穿绿衣的孩子举起一张印有抹茶饮品和东亚字体的饮品海报。左下侧附近，一名身穿绿衣的学徒展示了一张带有小型 UI 框和图表的简洁示意图。中右侧附近，一名身穿橙红色衣服的孩子拿着一张逼真的奢华香水瓶产品照。在它右侧，一名身穿黄橙色衣服的孩子展示了一张带有柔和焦外成像效果的逼真鸟类照片。中右上方，一名开朗的孩子举起一个平板电脑或带框的移动应用屏幕，显示着简洁的界面。右下侧，一名身穿蓝衣的孩子展示了一个充满图表和图形的深色主题分析仪表板。右上角，一位身穿华丽白金长袍、头戴皇冠状头饰的高大尊贵人物站着，手持 2 幅奇幻艺术品：一幅是较暗的风景画，另一幅是月光下的城市或寺庙场景。此右上角区域请包含正好 2 幅艺术品。在房间周围散布发光的漂浮 UI 风格图标；请包含正好 6 个漂浮图标/标志元素：一个拼图图标、一个网络节点图标、一个代码窗口、一个立方体图标、一个在拼图图标旁写着 "PLUGIN" 的发光标志，以及一个写着 "SKILL" 的发光星形标志。此外，添加 2 个边缘发光的魔法卷轴横幅，一个在右上角附近，另一个在底部前景，两者都覆盖着程式化的彩色代码线条。环境应感觉像是古代工作室、奇幻图书馆和创意 AI 工作室的结合体，配有石拱门、木梁、透过开口可见的遥远山景，以及在空气中旋转的金色魔法粒子。高度精美的数字插画，构图紧凑，充满奇幻史诗感，色彩饱和，边缘光影效果强烈，细节清晰，具有绘画质感，达到奇幻宣传海报的品质。

templates.title: Transforming anime girls into cinematic photos

titleLocalized.zh: 将动漫少女转化为电影感照片

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, recreate the same girl and black cat, maintaining the same sitting pose, but transform the flat anime drawing into a realistic, cinematic photograph. Keep the orange and black gothic dress, white ruffles, lightning bolt armband, headdress, black cat reclining on her lap, white socks, and black Mary Jane shoes consistent with the reference image. Place her in an atmospheric retro interior environment, with a background including worn wooden floors, old stucco walls, and a floor-to-ceiling window on the left letting in soft, warm light; the curtains are light and airy, casting warm afternoon shadows. Use a nostalgic dark brown tone, adding subtle film grain, soft shadows, and a shallow depth of field to create a realistic editorial photographic style.

templates.title: Cinematic Sunset Couple Close-up

titleLocalized.zh: 电影感日落情侣特写

templates.prompt: This is a cinematic close-up of a golden moment, capturing a young couple's intimate interaction outdoors, framed from the chest up. The focus is on a handsome young man with {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} His tousled, wavy hair framed a softly defined jawline, his skin a delicate light brown. His expression was calm and profound, his gaze slightly upward and directed to the left. He wore a loosely tailored, elegant black open-collar shirt. A young woman with long, dark brown hair nestled in his arms, her large face half-buried in his shoulder and chest, creating a tender and protective atmosphere; only parts of her hair, shoulders, and a black spaghetti-strap dress were visible in the image. The shot used warm sunset backlighting, with the sun low in the sky to their left and behind, creating bright rimlight on their hair and shoulders, accompanied by soft lens flare, amber highlights, and a shallow depth of field. The background consisted of a blurred natural landscape and low hills. The composition should be romantic, magazine-worthy, and cinematic, like a high-end perfume or fashion advertisement, showcasing delicate skin texture, realistic patterns, hair flowing in the breeze, soft earth tones, and high-end cinematic color grading. Photorealistic, emotionally resonant, intimate, 50mm lens vision, exceptional detail, natural light, and soft contrast.

promptLocalized.zh: 这是一张电影质感的黄金时刻特写，拍摄了一对年轻情侣在户外亲密互动的瞬间，取景范围为胸部以上。画面焦点是一位英俊的年轻男子，他留着 {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} 的凌乱波浪卷发，下颌线条柔和分明，肤色呈现细腻的浅棕色，神情平静而深邃，目光微微向上并投向左侧。他身穿一件剪裁宽松优雅的黑色开领衬衫。一名留着深棕色长发的年轻女子依偎在他怀中，她的脸庞大半埋在他的肩头和胸前，营造出一种温柔且充满保护感的氛围；画面中仅可见她的部分秀发、肩膀以及黑色细肩带连衣裙。采用温暖的日落逆光，太阳位于他们左后方的低空，在他们的发丝和肩头勾勒出明亮的轮廓光，伴有柔和的镜头光晕、琥珀色高光、浅景深效果，背景是模糊的自然景观和低矮的山丘。构图应充满浪漫、杂志大片和电影感，如同高端香水或时尚广告，呈现细腻的皮肤质感、逼真的纹理、微风拂过的发丝、柔和的大地色调以及高端的电影级调色。照片级真实感，情感充沛，亲密无间，50mm 镜头视觉，超高细节，自然光，柔和对比度。

templates.title: Paris Saint-Germain (PSG) official transfer announcement poster

titleLocalized.zh: 巴黎圣日耳曼 (PSG) 转会官宣海报

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic official football transfer announcement poster in a vertical social media format. The centerpiece is a realistic adult male football player, wearing a modern Paris Saint-Germain home jersey, arms crossed, positioned above the chest to showcase his powerful physique. To maintain anonymity, most of his face is covered by softly blurred rectangular blocks, with sleek short hair visible at the edges. The overall color scheme is a deep navy blue PSG theme, accented with striking red and white. The jersey should feature a red vertical stripe with white borders on the sides. From the viewer's perspective, the left side displays the red sports brand logo, the right side the PSG crest, and the torso subtly features sponsor text. Place the player against a layered graphic background. The upper right corner of the background is filled with a large, faded version of the PSG crest, while the right side features a dark silhouette of the Eiffel Tower, incorporating painterly brushstroke textures, fine graininess, and a white vertical stripe with bold red brushstrokes on the left. The PSG club crest is placed in the upper left corner. Add stacked, bold, all-caps sans-serif text to the left: “NEW CLUB. NEW CHAPTER. PARIS.”, with the last word in red. Add a large, distressed white block title to the bottom of the image that reads, “…”{argument name="player surname" default="MBAPPE"} Above this is a smaller-spaced capitalized name.{argument name="player first name" default="KYLIAN"} Above the large surname is superimposed red handwritten text: "{argument name="welcome text" default="Welcome To Paris"} Add the text "PARIS SAINT-GERMAIN" in small capital letters at the bottom center, with the year in red below.{argument name="year" default="2026"} The logo is flanked by thin dividing lines. The lower left corner features stacked, small-sized text reading "ICI C'EST PARIS," with "PARIS" in red. A circular, stamp-style badge is added to the lower right corner, bearing the text "PARIS IS MAGIQUE." Employing cinematic lighting, high contrast, and a premium sportswear poster design style, it presents clear fabric textures, deep shadows, a rough editorial feel, and refined transfer window announcement aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh: 制作一张极具戏剧性的足球转会官宣海报，采用竖版社交媒体格式。画面中心为一名写实的成年男性足球运动员，身穿现代风格的巴黎圣日耳曼主场球衣，双臂交叉，采用胸部以上构图，展现强健的运动体魄。为了保持匿名，面部大部分区域覆盖有柔和的矩形模糊块，边缘可见利落的短发。整体采用深海军蓝色的 PSG 主题配色，辅以醒目的红色和白色点缀。球衣正面应包含一条两侧镶有白边的红色垂直条纹，从观众视角看，左侧饰有红色运动品牌 Logo，右侧胸前饰有 PSG 队徽，躯干处有若隐若现的赞助商文字。将球员置于分层图形背景前，背景右上角填充有巨大的淡化版 PSG 队徽，右侧为深色的埃菲尔铁塔剪影，并融合绘画般的笔触纹理、细腻的颗粒感，以及左侧一条带有粗犷红色笔触的白色垂直涂漆条。左上方放置 PSG 俱乐部徽章。在左侧添加堆叠的粗体大写无衬线标语文字：“NEW CLUB. NEW CHAPTER. PARIS.”，其中最后一个单词为红色。在画面中下部添加一个巨大的做旧白色块标题，内容为“{argument name="player surname" default="MBAPPE"}”，上方配以较小的间距大写名“{argument name="player first name" default="KYLIAN"}”。在大号姓氏上方叠加红色的手写体文字“{argument name="welcome text" default="Welcome To Paris"}”。在底部中心添加小号大写文字“PARIS SAINT-GERMAIN”，下方为红色的年份“{argument name="year" default="2026"}”，两侧配有细分隔线。左下角包含堆叠的小号文字“ICI C'EST PARIS”，其中“PARIS”为红色。右下角添加一个圆形印章风格徽章，文字为“PARIS IS MAGIQUE”。采用电影级布光、高对比度、高级运动品牌海报设计风格，呈现清晰的织物纹理、深邃的阴影、粗粝的编辑质感以及精致的转会窗口官宣美学。

templates.title: Fox-eared street-style boy in a steampunk city

titleLocalized.zh: 蒸汽朋克城市中的狐耳街头风少年

templates.prompt: An incredibly detailed anime-style illustration depicts a stylish fox-eared boy casually sitting on the edge of a suspended industrial platform in a vast, vertical steampunk city. He has messy yet layered hair {argument name="hair color" default="Light gold"} His hair, with a deep magenta highlight on one side, adorned with a pair of enormous fox ears, the inner fur of which was lighter in color, and a fluffy cream-colored fox tail curled behind him. His face was deliberately obscured by a flat, square visor positioned in the center. He wore a glossy black bomber jacket embroidered with scattered floral patterns in pink and purple-blue, with deep red and black stripes on the ribbed cuffs and collar. Underneath the jacket was a black printed T-shirt with ornate gold lettering and badge details, partially concealed by layered straps and a necklace. His attire included loose-fitting black cargo pants (with zipper details), black socks with small gold lettering, and thick-soled black shoes with bright magenta laces. Multiple silver rings, black suspenders or belts with metal buckles were added, along with a long olive-gold belt draped from the platform. He maintained a relaxed seated posture, one knee raised, the other extended diagonally downwards, left arm resting on the raised knee, and right hand supporting him at his side. The overall vibe was cool, urban, and slightly rebellious. The background is a complex labyrinth of towering light blue and gray-white mechanical structures, stacked platforms, scaffolding, suspended chains, exposed cables, floating boxes, and several round clocks embedded in the building, creating a dense, vertical, futuristic steampunk environment blending into the atmospheric haze. It employs soft sunlight, muted industrial colors, fine lines, delicate ink and watercolor rendering, crisp fabric highlights, and refined contemporary anime illustration aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张细节极其丰富的动漫风格插画，描绘了一位时尚的狐耳少年，他正随意地坐在广阔的垂直蒸汽朋克城市中一座悬浮工业平台的边缘。他留着凌乱且富有层次感的 {argument name="hair color" default="浅金色"} 头发，一侧有一缕深洋红色挑染，长着一对巨大的狐耳，内侧毛发呈浅色，身后蜷缩着一条蓬松的奶油色狐狸尾巴。他的面部被一个位于正中央的扁平方形遮挡块刻意遮盖。他身穿一件亮面黑色飞行员夹克，上面绣有红粉色和紫蓝色两种颜色的零星花卉图案，罗纹袖口和领口带有深红色与黑色的条纹。夹克内搭一件黑色印花 T 恤，上面有华丽的金色字母和徽章细节，被层叠的带子和项链部分遮挡。他的装束包括宽松的黑色工装裤（带有拉链细节）、带有小号金色字母的黑色短袜，以及配有亮洋红色鞋带的厚底黑色鞋。添加多个银色戒指、黑色背带或带有金属扣的束带，以及一条从平台垂下的橄榄金色长腰带。让他保持放松的坐姿，一只膝盖抬起，另一条腿斜向下伸展，左臂搭在抬起的膝盖上，右手撑在身侧。整体氛围酷炫、都市且略带叛逆。背景是一个由高耸的浅青色和灰白色机械结构、堆叠的平台、脚手架、悬挂的链条、裸露的电缆、悬浮的箱子以及嵌入建筑中的几座圆形时钟组成的复杂迷宫，营造出一种融入大气雾霾中的密集垂直未来蒸汽朋克环境。采用柔和的日光、柔和的工业色彩、精细的线条、细腻的墨水与水彩渲染、清晰的织物高光，以及精致的当代动漫插画美学。

templates.title: Surreal Crocs Summer Advertising Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 超现实 Crocs 夏季广告海报

templates.prompt: Create a surreal lifestyle fashion advertising poster for the brand.{argument name="brand name" default="crocs"} Vertical composition, photorealistic feel, and golden hour outdoor lighting. A young woman sits comfortably on a lakeside meadow filled with white daisies, leaning against a giant pale sage-green foam clog. The enormous shoe, like a whimsical sculpture, dominates the frame, positioned behind her at a slight angle, with a raised heel strap and a rounded brand logo stud visible on the side. It showcases authentic Crocs style details: ventilation holes at the top, textured molded foam surface, thick sole, front perforations, and side perforations. The model wears matching light green clogs, white slouch socks, a soft sage-green cropped vest, high-waisted cream-colored printed shorts, a loose white shirt draped over her shoulders, and a simple necklace. She has a dark, messy bun, leans casually to one knee, and gazes up at the sky. Background: a tranquil lake, distant green hills or low mountains, and a bright blue sky dotted with soft, cumulus clouds. Employing a clean, editorial aesthetic, the ad creates a cheerful, light summer vibe with a shallow depth of field that, while still ensuring the model and the oversized shoes are clearly visible. White branding text—a large, rounded lowercase logo—is placed at the top center.{argument name="logo text" default="crocs"} It also features a small trademark symbol; a white slogan is added below it.{argument name="tagline" default="Come as you are. Comfort follows."} The emphasis is on the harmony between the color schemes of the models' clothing and shoes, the desirable comfort, the fantastical proportions, and the exquisite quality of commercial photography.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超现实生活方式时尚广告海报，品牌为 {argument name="brand name" default="crocs"}。竖版构图，照片级真实感，黄金时刻户外光效。一位年轻女性在开满小白雏菊的湖畔草地上惬意地坐着，倚靠在一只巨大的淡鼠尾草绿色泡沫洞洞鞋旁。这只巨大的鞋子像一件趣味雕塑般占据画面主体，放置在她身后，呈微倾斜角度，后跟带竖起，侧面可见圆形的品牌标志铆钉。展示真实的 Crocs 风格细节：顶部的透气孔、纹理模压泡沫表面、厚鞋底、前部孔洞及侧面穿孔。模特穿着同色系的浅绿色洞洞鞋、白色堆堆袜、柔和的鼠尾草绿短款背心、高腰奶油色印花短裤，肩上披着一件宽松的白色衬衫，佩戴简约项链。她留着深色凌乱丸子头，单膝弯曲斜倚，姿态随性，仰望天空。背景：平静的湖泊、远处的绿色丘陵或低矮山脉，以及点缀着大片柔软积云的明亮蓝天。采用干净的编辑广告美学，营造欢快、轻盈的夏季氛围，景深较浅，但足以确保模特和巨大的鞋子清晰可见。在顶部居中添加白色品牌文字：大号圆润小写标志 {argument name="logo text" default="crocs"}，并带有小型商标符号；下方添加一行白色标语 {argument name="tagline" default="Come as you are. Comfort follows."}。强调模特服装与鞋子配色方案之间的和谐感、令人向往的舒适感、奇幻的比例对比以及精致的商业摄影质感。

templates.title: Editor-level palmistry interpretation infographic

titleLocalized.zh: 编辑级手相解读信息图

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0, the photograph of the hand was converted into a clean, editor-grade hand infographic with a light beige background. The same palm, direction, skin tone, and black perforated strap were preserved, cleanly cut out, and placed on the left as the main image. A modern magazine-style single-page layout was built around it, using thin dividing lines, rounded light gray information panels, elegant serif headings, and small, minimalist line icons. The following seven heading sections were added: "PALM READING GUIDE" in the top left corner, with the subtitle "Insights. Strengths. Path."; a summary card "AT A GLANCE" in the top right corner; "YOUR PALM LINES" containing one simple hand line drawing and five annotation lines; "THE MAJOR LINES" containing five individual cards; "PALM FEATURES" containing four feature lines; "WHAT THIS MEANS FOR YOU" containing five interpretation lines; and a summary bar at the bottom titled "YOUR PATH". The "YOUR PALM LINES" section contains five labels with brief descriptions: HEART LINE, HEAD LINE, LIFE LINE, FATE LINE, and SUN LINE. The "THE MAJOR LINES" section contains five cards titled HEART LINE, HEAD LINE, LIFE LINE, FATE LINE, and SUN LINE, each with a small icon and a brief summary. The "PALM FEATURES" section contains four rows: PALM SHAPE, FINGERS, THUMB, and MOUNTS. The "WHAT THIS MEANS FOR YOU" section contains five rows: STRENGTHS, CHALLENGES, LOVE & RELATIONSHIPS, CAREER & LIFE PATH, and GUIDANCE. Fill all the text with an elegant lifestyle magazine tone tailored to this hand feature. Make it look like a high-quality palmistry report generated from an uploaded photo of the hand.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用 REFERENCE_0，将拍摄的手部照片转换为背景为浅米白色的简洁编辑级手相信息图。保留相同的手掌、方向、肤色和黑色穿孔表带，将其干净地抠出并放置在左侧作为主图。围绕它构建现代杂志风格的单页布局，使用细分割线、圆角浅灰色信息面板、优雅的衬线标题和小型极简线条图标。添加以下 7 个标题板块：左上角为“PALM READING GUIDE”，副标题为“Insights. Strengths. Path.”；右上角为“AT A GLANCE”摘要卡片；“YOUR PALM LINES”包含 1 个简单的手部线条示意图和 5 条标注线；“THE MAJOR LINES”包含 5 张独立卡片；“PALM FEATURES”包含 4 个特征行；“WHAT THIS MEANS FOR YOU”包含 5 个解读行；底部摘要条为“YOUR PATH”。在“YOUR PALM LINES”中，包含 5 个带有简短描述的标签：HEART LINE（感情线）、HEAD LINE（智慧线）、LIFE LINE（生命线）、FATE LINE（命运线）、SUN LINE（太阳线）。在“THE MAJOR LINES”中，包含 5 张标题分别为 HEART LINE、HEAD LINE、LIFE LINE、FATE LINE、SUN LINE 的卡片，每张卡片配有小图标和简短的要点解读。在“PALM FEATURES”中，包含 4 个行：PALM SHAPE（手掌形状）、FINGERS（手指）、THUMB（拇指）、MOUNTS（掌丘）。在“WHAT THIS MEANS FOR YOU”中，包含 5 个行：STRENGTHS（优势）、CHALLENGES（挑战）、LOVE & RELATIONSHIPS（爱情与人际关系）、CAREER & LIFE PATH（事业与人生路径）、GUIDANCE（指引）。使用针对该手部特征、风格优雅的生活方式杂志语调，填充所有正文内容。使其看起来像是一份由上传的手部照片生成的优质手相解读报告。

templates.title: Cinematic Nordic Football Legend Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 电影质感北欧足球传奇海报

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic, legendary football poster, designed as a double-exposure portrait superimposed on a textured off-white paper background. The overall composition is a giant {argument name="athlete name" default="Erling Haaland"} A side silhouette, facing right, filled with a dramatic montage of a Nordic football journey. The outer head outline remains realistic, with long, wind-blown blond hair at the top and back, and an ear visible along the far right edge. Inside the silhouette, a somber, rainy narrative scene is constructed, rendered in deep navy, charcoal black, steel blue, cool gray, and soft gold. At the top of the silhouette, a rugged mountain landscape under cloudy skies, a small coastal village with warm lighting, and a football player standing on the sidelines as seen from behind are placed; a clearly visible sign is also included.{argument name="location text" default="BRYNE"} In the upper center area, add two figures from a memory scene: an elderly man embracing a child, both with their backs to the camera in the misty rain. Nearby, add a smaller action figure in a red jersey, running and celebrating. On the right center, place a larger action figure in a yellow jersey, sprinting through rain and sparks. In the central area, add a tactical analysis strip containing drawn arrows, circles, dotted passing routes, and small player markers, overlaid with subtle technical text (such as sprint speed and top speed values) to create a data-driven, elite athlete feel. In the left center foreground, highlight the main character, wearing a dark, almost black jersey, with long blond hair tied back, explosively charging diagonally towards the audience; his clothes are wet and reflective. Behind him, show a brightly lit, crowded stadium with a strong atmosphere. In the lower right corner, depict a goalkeeper making a save, and a football with a bright trajectory shooting into the goal. Add subtle rain, mist, embers, water droplets, and ink-like smudged edges around the silhouette to allow the image to blend naturally into the paper. Place an elegant gold-lined capital title at the bottom center.{argument name="title text" default="THE MACHINE FROM THE NORTH"} And below it, place a neat little subtitle.{argument name="tagline text" default="Built In Rain, Finished In Silence"} The overall style should present an epic sports biography poster feel, with ultra-high detail, rich emotion, strong atmosphere, dramatic lighting and shadow, high contrast, painterly realism, advanced fan editing aesthetics, cinematic depth of field, clear subject, and a mythical Scandinavian tone.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影质感的足球传奇海报，设计为叠加在纹理米白色纸张背景上的双重曝光肖像。整体构图为一个巨大的 {argument name="athlete name" default="Erling Haaland"} 侧面剪影，面向右侧，剪影内部填充着充满戏剧性的北欧足球之旅蒙太奇画面。保持外侧头部轮廓真实，顶部和后部有被风吹拂的长金发，最右侧边缘可见耳朵。在剪影内部，构建一个深海军蓝、炭黑、钢蓝、冷灰和柔和金色的阴郁暴雨叙事场景。在剪影顶部，放置一个多云天气下的崎岖山地景观、一个带有温暖灯光的小型沿海村庄，以及 1 名从背后看去站在球场边区域的足球运动员；包含一个清晰可见的标志，上面写着 {argument name="location text" default="BRYNE"}。在中上区域，添加 2 个来自记忆场景的人物，一名老人搂着一个孩子，两人都在雾雨中背对镜头。附近添加 1 个较小的身穿红色球衣、正在奔跑庆祝的动作人物。在中右侧，放置 1 个较大的身穿黄色球衣、在雨水和火花中奋力冲刺的动作人物。在中央地带，加入 1 条战术分析带，包含绘制的箭头、圆圈、虚线传球路线和小球员标记，并叠加微小的技术文本（如冲刺速度和最高速度值），营造出数据驱动的精英运动员感。在左中前景处，突出主角人物，身穿深近乎黑色的球衣，长金发扎在脑后，以爆发性的动作斜向冲向观众，衣服湿润且具有反光感。在他身后，展示一个灯火通明、氛围浓厚的拥挤体育场。在右下角，描绘 1 名守门员正在扑救，以及 1 个带着明亮运动轨迹射入球门的足球。在剪影周围添加微妙的雨水、薄雾、余烬、水雾和类似墨水的晕染边缘，使图像自然地融入纸张。在底部中心，放置一个优雅的金色衬线大写标题 {argument name="title text" default="THE MACHINE FROM THE NORTH"}，并在其下方放置一行精致的小副标题 {argument name="tagline text" default="Built In Rain, Finished In Silence"}。整体风格应呈现史诗级体育传记海报感，超高细节、情感丰富、氛围感强、光影戏剧化、高对比度、绘画级写实感、高级粉丝剪辑美学、电影级景深、主体清晰，并带有神话般的斯堪的纳维亚基调。

templates.title: Cinematic Style Football Legend Silhouette Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 电影质感足球传奇剪影海报

templates.prompt: A digital collage in the style of a movie poster, featuring the silhouette of a male football legend looking to the left against a creamy white background with rough, oil paint brushstrokes. The image employs luxurious deep navy, sepia, bronze, and gold tones, combined with dramatic high-contrast lighting and luminous highlights, creating a sophisticated editorial aesthetic. Within the silhouette, a layered visual journey of ambition and grandeur is constructed, comprising eight unique scene elements: 1) In the upper left of the head, a young boy in shorts stands on a rocky cliff by the sea, a soccer ball beside him, gazing at the coastal mountains glowing at sunset; 2) In the upper right of the head, a small boat floats on the water near the cliff; 3) In the center, an adult soccer player in a light-colored jersey floats in mid-air, seemingly striking or controlling the ball, dynamic and heroic; 4) In the lower left of the center, a lone man stands with his back to the brightly lit stadium; 5) In the middle of the image, a row of five golden "Golden Ball" style trophy spheres gleam; 6) In the lower left, a soccer field is presented as a bright golden halo, with a small player silhouette nearby, and surging waves in front; 7) Near the center of the lower part, a pensive figure sits on a jagged mountain peak; 8) In the lower right, a long, glowing road stretches across the desert-like terrain towards the horizon. Add a row of warm-lit architectural colonnades to the right side of the silhouette, blending it seamlessly with the layered scene. The silhouette's hair should be dark and textured, with the right side of the face left blank for layout. Place striking, elegant metallic gold text in the lower right corner.{argument name="headline text" default="MADE BY OBSESSION"} Below is a smaller italicized serif subtitle.{argument name="tagline" default="A Life Scored In Gold"} To make the subject appear{argument name="athlete name" default="Cristiano Ronaldo"} The essence of the work doesn't require photorealism; instead, it emphasizes the mythical legacy, perseverance, the great achievements of football, and the aesthetic style of a high-end sports documentary poster. Vertical composition, highly detailed, cinematic atmosphere, art-house sports poster style, fine graininess, oil painting composite, embellished with gold light and shadow.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影海报风格的数字拼贴画，主体为一位向左看的男性足球传奇人物的侧面剪影，背景为带有粗糙油画笔触纹理的米白色。画面采用奢华的深海军蓝、棕褐色、青铜色和金色调，配合戏剧性的高对比度光影、发光高光，营造出一种高端的编辑艺术感。在剪影内部，构建一段充满雄心与伟大的分层视觉旅程，包含 8 个独特的场景元素：1) 在头部左上方，一个穿着短裤的小男孩站在岩石海边悬崖旁，身边放着一颗足球，望向日落时分发光的海岸山脉；2) 在头部右上方区域，悬崖附近水面上有一艘小船；3) 在中心位置，一名身着浅色球衣的成年足球运动员悬浮在半空中，仿佛正在击球或控球，动态且英勇；4) 在中左下方区域，一名孤独的男子背对着站在灯火通明的球场上；5) 在画面中部，一排 5 个金色的“金球奖”风格奖杯球体熠熠生辉；6) 在左下方，一座足球场呈现为明亮的金色光环，附近有一个小小的球员剪影，前方是汹涌的海浪；7) 在下部中心附近，一个沉思的身影坐在锯齿状的山峰上；8) 在右下方，一条发光的长路穿过沙漠般的地形延伸向地平线。在剪影中右侧内部添加一排带有暖光的建筑柱廊，与分层场景融为一体。剪影的头发应呈现深色且富有质感，面部剪影右侧部分留白，以便排版。在右下方放置醒目优雅的金属金色文字 {argument name="headline text" default="MADE BY OBSESSION"}，下方配以较小的斜体衬线副标题 {argument name="tagline" default="A Life Scored In Gold"}。使主体呈现出 {argument name="athlete name" default="Cristiano Ronaldo"} 的神韵，无需追求照片级写实，重点强调神话般的传承、毅力、足球伟大成就以及高端体育纪录片海报的美学风格。竖构图，高度精细，电影氛围，美术体育海报，细腻颗粒感，油画合成，金色光影点缀。

templates.title: Kessoku Band's Rough-Looking Anime Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 结束乐队 (Kessoku Band) 粗粝感动漫海报

templates.prompt: A highly dramatic anime-style rock band poster, employing a rough, splatter-paint promotional style, features a wide-angle composition of the four girls from the Kessoku Band on stage, showcasing a dynamic concert atmosphere. The background is a chaotic black concert curtain, covered in paint splatters, sparks, smoke, and neon-like colored lines, with a huge, bold white calligraphy strip across the top displaying the band's name.{argument name="band name" default="KESSOKU BAND"} Add a large comic-style dialogue box in the upper left corner, containing bold, hand-drawn English text.{argument name="speech bubble text" default="KESSOKU BAND WERE CRUSHING IT"} The image precisely captures the four band members standing side-by-side, each dressed in dark band T-shirts and casual stage attire, surrounded by stylized colored lights. On the far left is Ryo Yamada, with short, dark blue hair, holding a cream-colored bass, his expression calm, with blue paint splattered behind him, displaying his Japanese and English names: "山田リョウ" and "YAMADA RYO". Second from the left is Nijika Ijichi, with blonde twin tails, her posture energetic, one hand making a victory sign, warm yellow paint splattered behind her, a large red ribbon tied around her collar displaying her name: "伊地知虹夏" and "IJICHI NIJIKA". A red drum kit is placed behind the center area, the bass drum bearing the band's logo. Second from the right is Kita Ikuyo, with bright red long hair, playing a blue electric guitar, with red splashes behind her, displaying her name "Kita Ikuyo" and "KITA IKUYO". Far right is Gotoh Hitori, with flowing pink long hair, playing a black electric guitar, with pink splashes behind her, displaying her name "Gotoh Hitori". A large, bright pink Japanese title, "Kyoudai Bando" (End Band), is placed in the lower left corner, written in a dynamic calligraphy style, with a smaller white Japanese slogan below. A diagonal bright pink paintbrush banner is added in the lower right corner, containing a bold black handwritten English slogan.{argument name="bottom slogan" default="LIVE IS OUR LIFE, LOUDER THAN YESTERDAY. STRONGER TOGETHER."} Employing a high-contrast comic book poster aesthetic, each girl corresponds to saturated shades of blue, yellow, red, and pink, featuring a rough halftone texture, distressed brushstroke fonts, an explosive stage lighting atmosphere, and exquisite anime character rendering. The composition remains compact, avant-garde, and poster-quality, reminiscent of official movie or concert key visuals.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的动漫摇滚乐队海报，采用粗粝的泼墨宣传风格，画面呈现结束乐队 (Kessoku Band) 的四位女孩在舞台上的宽幅构图，展现动态的演唱会氛围。背景为混乱的黑色演唱会幕布，布满油漆飞溅、火花、烟雾、霓虹般的色彩线条，顶部横跨巨大的粗犷白色毛笔字样，显示乐队名称 {argument name="band name" default="KESSOKU BAND"}。在左上方添加一个巨大的漫画对话框，内含粗体手绘英文文本 {argument name="speech bubble text" default="KESSOKU BAND WERE CRUSHING IT"}。画面中精准呈现 4 名乐队成员肩并肩站立的表演姿态，每人都穿着深色乐队 T 恤和休闲舞台装，周围环绕着风格化的彩色灯光。最左侧是山田凉 (Yamada Ryo)，留着深蓝色短发，手持奶油色贝斯，表情冷静，身后有蓝色油漆飞溅，并显示其日文和英文名："山田リョウ" 和 "YAMADA RYO"。左二为伊地知虹夏 (Ijichi Nijika)，留着金色双马尾，姿态充满活力，一只手比出胜利手势，身后有温暖的黄色飞溅，领口系着大红丝带，并显示其名称为 "伊地知虹夏" 和 "IJICHI NIJIKA"。中心区域后方放置一套红色鼓组，大鼓上印有乐队标志。右二为喜多郁代 (Kita Ikuyo)，留着鲜艳的红色长发，弹奏蓝色电吉他，身后有红色飞溅，并显示其名称为 "喜多郁代" 和 "KITA IKUYO"。最右侧是后藤一里 (Gotoh Hitori)，留着飘逸的粉色长发，弹奏黑色电吉他，身后有粉色飞溅，并显示其名称为 "後藤ひとり" 和 "Gotoh Hitori"。左下角放置巨大的亮粉色日文标题，采用充满张力的毛笔字书写 "结束バンド"，下方配有较小的白色日文标语。右下角添加一条对角线亮粉色油漆笔触横幅，内含粗体黑色手写英文标语 {argument name="bottom slogan" default="LIVE IS OUR LIFE, LOUDER THAN YESTERDAY. STRONGER TOGETHER."}。采用高对比度的漫画海报美学，每位女孩对应饱和的蓝、黄、红、粉色调，带有粗糙的网点纹理、做旧的画笔字体、爆炸性的舞台灯光氛围以及精致的动漫角色渲染。保持构图紧凑、前卫且具有海报质感，如同官方电影或演唱会的主视觉图。

templates.title: Comic style: Speaker electrocution scene

titleLocalized.zh: 漫画风格：音箱触电场景

templates.prompt: A black-and-white comic panel, employing a dramatic, shonen manga-style parody, depicts a rock band from a certain high school.{argument name="band name on shirts" default="Cable ties"} The scene depicts girls being electrocuted by an overloaded guitar amplifier during practice. The composition is a single, wide-format image, with four girls surrounding a large amplifier in the center of the foreground. Arcs, smoke, sparks, luminous energy, and jagged lightning bolts swirling around the amplifier surround it. The composition utilizes halftone shading, halftone textures, bold outlines, speed lines, exaggerated expressions of shock, and a chaotic comedic rhythm. On the far left, a partially obscured girl sits, her face mostly hidden by a tall rectangular frame; she wears a dark band T-shirt and dark trousers, one arm bent upwards in surprise. In the center left, a girl with light-colored long hair and bangs wears a dark band T-shirt with a large bow at the collar, her eyes spiraling, mouth agape in panic, one finger pointing to her lips, seemingly frozen in confusion. In the center right, a short girl with messy, medium-length dark hair, her eyes spiraling, covers her mouth with her hands and recoils, also wearing a dark band T-shirt. On the far right, a girl with long hair, wearing a light-colored zip-up sports jacket and a short skirt, sits stiffly with her knees together, her eyes wide open in a spiral shape, her mouth agape, beads of sweat on her face, leaning back in terror. The speaker is located in the lower center of the screen, with a neat row of eight control knobs visible on its front. A cable is plugged into the left side, and another into the right. A small power switch is located on the right side; bright arcs of electricity erupt from the top panel. There are four dialogue or narration text areas: a large narration box in the upper left corner, containing the following text {argument name="left narration" default="Until the day of practice, the speakers were overloaded."} A jagged speech bubble appears in the lower left corner, containing the following content:{argument name="lower left exclamation" default="I got an electric shock!"} Above the girl in the middle left is a large speech bubble containing the following content:{argument name="center scream" default="Ahhh!"} And a large chat bubble in the upper right corner, the content of which is{argument name="right reaction" default="What the hell?!"} Additionally, add a stylized onomatopoeic word "ZAP!" to the top right, accompanied by a bold Japanese-style impact font. The background should primarily feature an abstract comic book effect: dense halftone gradients, electric auras, smoke, and impact bursts, rather than detailed room details. The tone: a comedic soul-swap incident setting, tense yet playful, with classic comic book parody paneling.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅黑白漫画分镜，采用戏剧性的少年漫恶搞风格，描绘了来自某高中摇滚乐队的 {argument name="band name on shirts" default="結束バンド"} 少女们在练习时因吉他音箱过载而触电的场景。构图为单幅宽画幅，4 位少女围绕着前景中央的大型音箱，音箱周围闪烁着电弧、烟雾、火花、发光能量以及缠绕场景的锯齿状闪电。使用网点纸阴影、半调纹理、粗犷的勾线、速度线效果、夸张的震惊表情以及混乱的喜剧节奏。最左侧，1 位部分被遮挡的少女坐着，脸部大部分被一个高大的长方形旁白框遮住；她穿着深色乐队 T 恤和深色长裤，一只手臂因惊讶而向上弯曲。左中位置，1 位留着浅色长发、平刘海的少女穿着深色乐队 T 恤，领口系着大蝴蝶结，双眼呈螺旋状，张着嘴陷入恐慌，一只手指着嘴唇，仿佛因困惑而僵住。右中位置，1 位留着凌乱中长深色头发的矮个子少女双眼呈螺旋状，双手捂嘴向后退缩，同样穿着深色乐队 T 恤。最右侧，1 位留着长发、身穿浅色拉链运动外套和短裙的少女双膝并拢僵硬地坐着，双眼圆睁呈螺旋状，张着嘴，脸上带着汗珠，惊恐地向后倾斜。音箱位于画面下方中央，正面可见一排整齐的 8 个控制旋钮，左侧插着一根线缆，右侧插着一根线缆，右侧有一个小型电源开关区域；明亮的电弧从顶部面板喷涌而出。包含 4 个对话或旁白文本区域：左上角一个高大的旁白框，内容为 {argument name="left narration" default="直到练习那天，音箱过载了"}，左下方一个锯齿状对话气泡，内容为 {argument name="lower left exclamation" default="触电了！"}，左中少女上方一个大对话气泡，内容为 {argument name="center scream" default="啊啊啊！"}，以及右上角一个大对话气泡，内容为 {argument name="right reaction" default="什么鬼——？！"}。此外，在顶部中右侧添加一个风格化的拟声词，内容为“ZAP！”，旁边配有粗体的日式冲击字体。背景应以抽象的漫画效果为主：密集的网点渐变、电光气场、烟雾和冲击爆发，而非详细的房间细节。基调：喜剧向灵魂互换事故设定，紧张而俏皮，经典的漫画恶搞分镜。

templates.title: Comic: Body Swap Riot

titleLocalized.zh: 漫画：身体互换大骚乱

templates.prompt: A simple, black-and-white comic panel in a youth/anime style depicts four girls from a rock band crammed into a cramped music studio after an electrical accident, caught in a chaotic body-swap scenario. A large, handwritten title at the top reads:{argument name="headline text" default="Body swapping chaos!"} The image is a single, wide-format piece with dramatic speed lines and comic-book tension. From left to right: Girl 1 is a short-haired, shy girl wearing a black band T-shirt and dark trousers, staring at her hands in shock as she speaks. The dialogue box contains the following text:{argument name="left speech" default="Huh?! My voice?!"} Girl 2 is a calm, expressionless blonde with long, straight hair, wearing a black band T-shirt, scarf, and plaid pants. She stands with one hand on her hip and says in a smaller chat box, "Hmm. This... is too noisy." Girl 3 is a flustered, cheerful girl with medium-length hair, wearing a black band T-shirt and long skirt. She is blushing and sweating, with her hands pressed to her mouth. The large chat box contains {argument name="center speech" default="Huh?! I've turned into Kita-chan?!"} Girl 4 is a long-haired girl wearing a zip-up hoodie and a short skirt. She sits stiffly with her arms crossed and eyes closed, complaining in a tall speech bubble.{argument name="right speech" default="Pochi-chan's body... is too crowded!"} Above or near the four girls are small circular head icons, indicating whose soul resides in whose body, serving as an illustrative device for body swapping. The band's T-shirts feature a simple Japanese logo on the chest. The background showcases three clearly visible studio elements: a drum kit at the back, a megaphone or speaker, and the floor and the edges of cables or equipment around the perimeter. Monochrome halftone paper shading, halftone textures, blush marks, sweat droplets, bold ink lines, and expressive cartoon fonts are used. The atmosphere is one of comedic panic, awkward confusion, and post-rehearsal chaos in a rehearsal room. The composition should appear crowded, legible, and have a sense of {argument name="series" default="Lonely Rock!"} It evokes the feel of fan-made comics.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张采用简洁青年/动漫风格的黑白漫画分镜，描绘了摇滚乐队的 4 位少女在一次电力事故后，挤在狭窄的音乐工作室里，陷入混乱的身体互换主题。顶部有手写的大字标题，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="身体互换大骚乱！"}。画面为单幅宽画幅，带有戏剧性的速度线和漫画张力。从左到右：女孩 1 是短发羞涩女孩，身穿黑色乐队 T 恤和深色长裤，正盯着自己的手震惊地说话，对话框内容为 {argument name="left speech" default="诶？！我的声音？！"}；女孩 2 是冷静、面无表情的金发长直发女孩，身穿黑色乐队 T 恤、围巾和格子裤，单手叉腰，在较小的对话框中说道：“嗯。这……太吵了。”；女孩 3 是慌乱的开朗女孩，中等长度头发，身穿黑色乐队 T 恤和长裙，脸红、流汗，双手紧贴嘴边，大对话框内容为 {argument name="center speech" default="诶——？！我变成喜多酱了？！"}；女孩 4 是长发女孩，身穿拉链连帽衫和短裙，僵硬地坐着，双臂交叉，双眼紧闭，在一个高大的对话框中抱怨道 {argument name="right speech" default="波奇酱的身体……太挤了！"}。4 位女孩上方或附近都有小圆形的头像图标，用以展示谁的灵魂在谁的身体里，作为身体互换的说明装置。乐队 T 恤胸前印有简单的日文标志。背景展示了 3 个清晰可见的工作室元素：后方的架子鼓、一个扩音器或音箱，以及地板和四周的线缆或设备边缘。使用单色网点纸阴影、半色调纹理、脸红标记、汗滴、粗犷的墨线和富有表现力的漫画字体。氛围为喜剧式的恐慌、尴尬的困惑以及排练室里事故后的混乱。构图应显得拥挤、易读，并具有受 {argument name="series" default="孤独摇滚！"} 启发的同人漫画感。

templates.title: Cyberpunk mythology movie poster

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克神话电影海报

templates.prompt: A cinematic, ultra-high-resolution sci-fi movie poster, used for{argument name="title text" default="KALKI PROTOCOL"} The vertical single-page design blends mythological and cyberpunk-inspired Indian aesthetics. At the center of the image is a figure with his back to the viewer—a mysterious warrior, standing upright in a high-necked, dark, futuristic trench coat, gazing at the vast, neon-lit metropolis. The figure has dark, curly hair tied in a messy bun, a glowing circular earring on one ear, and a strong, muscular profile, with most of his face hidden in shadow. Behind his head is a large, radiating golden-orange halo composed of concentric circles inscribed with sacred Sanskrit script and mystical symbols, lending the character a divine, prophetic quality. Futuristic versions of {argument name="city name" default="Mumbai"} Dense skyscrapers, holographic billboards, elevated structures, reflective water features, and a cool blue-purple nighttime atmosphere contrasting with the warm halo. Includes 3 flying vehicles: 2 high-speed hoverbikes speeding along the lower right, leaving bright magenta engine trails; 1 small hovercraft in the distant right sky. Add a striking illuminated billboard with the words:{argument name="billboard text" default="MUMBAI"} Below this is a line of smaller Amagi-style text. More vertical neon signs with Amagi-style text are scattered along the building's perimeter. The color scheme should be electric cyan, deep indigo, magenta, orange, and gold, presenting a wet, reflective surface, volumetric fog, dramatic rim lighting, and a sophisticated, poster-like texture. A large, futuristic, glowing title font is placed at the bottom of the image, containing the following text:{argument name="main title" default="KALKI PROTOCOL"} Add a slogan below it.{argument name="tagline" default="THE FINAL ERA BEGINS"} Following this is the release date line "COMING 3125.11", followed by a multilingual cast and crew list that includes "HINDI - TELUGU - TAMIL - KANNADA - MALAYALAM - ENGLISH", with a small tagline at the bottom. High contrast, epic scale, sophisticated concept art, seamless double exposure composition, a clash between cyberpunk Mumbai and Indian mythology, full of action and sacred atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影级超精细科幻电影海报，用于 {argument name="title text" default="KALKI PROTOCOL"}，采用竖版单页设计，融合了神话与赛博朋克风格的印度美学。画面中心展示一个背对观众的人物，这是一位神秘的战士，身穿高领深色未来主义长风衣，笔直站立，凝视着广阔的霓虹大都市。人物留着深色卷发，扎成凌乱的发髻，一侧耳朵戴着发光的圆形耳环，轮廓强健，面部大部分隐藏在侧影阴影中。在头部后方，放置一个巨大的放射状金橙色光环，光环由刻有梵文风格神圣文字和神秘符号的同心圆组成，赋予角色神圣、预言般的特质。在人物轮廓内部及周围，融合未来主义版本的 {argument name="city name" default="Mumbai"}：密集的摩天大楼、全息广告牌、高架结构、反射水域，以及与温暖光环形成对比的冷蓝紫色夜色氛围。包含 3 辆飞行载具：2 辆高速悬浮摩托在右侧中下部飞驰，拖着明亮的洋红色引擎尾迹；1 辆小型悬浮飞行器在右侧远方天空中。添加一个醒目的发光广告牌，上面写着 {argument name="billboard text" default="MUMBAI"}，下方附有一行较小的天城体文字。在建筑物沿线散布更多带有天城体文字的垂直霓虹灯招牌。配色方案应为电光青、深靛蓝、洋红、橙色和金色，呈现湿润的反射表面、体积雾、戏剧性的轮廓光以及精致的大片海报质感。在画面中下部放置巨大的未来主义发光标题字体，内容为 {argument name="main title" default="KALKI PROTOCOL"}。在其下方添加标语 {argument name="tagline" default="THE FINAL ERA BEGINS"}，随后是上映日期行“COMING 3125.11”，接着是一行多语言演职员表，列出“HINDI - TELUGU - TAMIL - KANNADA - MALAYALAM - ENGLISH”，底部附有一行小标签。高对比度、史诗级规模、高级概念艺术、无缝双重曝光构图、赛博朋克孟买与印度神话的碰撞，充满动作感与神圣气息。

templates.title: Monochrome Magic Heart-Shaped Wand

titleLocalized.zh: 单色魔法心形魔杖

templates.prompt: A centered studio render of a magical girl wand or scepter, designed like a toy collectible, against a pure light gray background, showcasing a frontal view. The wand employs a monochrome matte white to light gray clay rendering style, with soft, even lighting and delicate shadows, emphasizing sculpted form rather than color. At the top is a large circular medallion, with a multifaceted heart-shaped gem at its center, surrounded by a magnificent ring. At the very top of the ring is a large five-pointed star, surrounded by eight smaller five-pointed stars and four decorative swirling patterns. Symmetrical small angel wings extend from the lower left and right sides of the circular head. Below the medallion is a large bow, with a small heart-shaped gem at its center and two ribbons hanging down. The handle is slender and cylindrical with a spiral twisting texture, and an additional heart-shaped badge is attached to the upper part of the grip. The end is a spherical head with vertical grooves. The overall silhouette is cute, symmetrical, elegant, and fantastical, making it ideal for simple product concept renderings or 3D model displays.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张居中的魔法少女魔杖或权杖摄影棚渲染图，设计如玩具收藏品般，以纯浅灰色背景为衬托，展示正面视角。魔杖采用单色哑光白至浅灰色的黏土渲染风格，光线柔和均匀，阴影细腻，强调雕刻形态而非色彩。顶部有一个巨大的圆形奖章，中心镶嵌一颗多面心形宝石，周围环绕着华丽的圆环，圆环顶部中心恰好有 1 颗大型五角星，周围分布着 8 颗小型五角星，以及 4 个卷曲的装饰性漩涡纹样。圆形头部下侧左右两侧延伸出对称的小型天使翅膀。奖章下方是一个巨大的蝴蝶结，中心镶嵌一颗心形小宝石，并垂下两条丝带。手柄细长呈圆柱形，带有螺旋扭转纹理，握柄上部额外安装了 1 个心形徽章，末端为带有垂直凹槽的球状柄头。整体轮廓可爱、对称、优雅且充满奇幻感，非常适合用于简洁的产品概念渲染或 3D 模型展示。

templates.title: Premier League title celebration in the rain

titleLocalized.zh: 雨中英超冠军奖杯庆祝时刻

templates.prompt: A highly dynamic sports photograph, with a player wearing a {argument name="team jersey color" default="Sky blue"} jersey{argument name="football player" default="Manchester City players"} He stands in the center of the rain-soaked stadium, the Premier League trophy held high above his head. The massive silver trophy is topped with a gold crown, and two light blue ribbons hang from the handles. The words "Premier League" are clearly engraved on the front. The player wears a modern football jersey with the dark sponsor's name "ETIHAD AIRWAYS" and a small team crest printed on the chest, his arms fully outstretched in a victorious pose. The composition employs a tight vertical cropping from the mid-torso upwards, with the trophy positioned at the top center of the image, partially obscuring the player's head. Effects such as torrential rain, wet metallic reflections, somber overcast lighting, shallow depth of field, and blurred stadium spectators in the background are added. On the right side of the background, a glowing blue electronic screen displays prominent text.{argument name="scoreboard text" default="GOAL"} Photorealistic sports news photography with high detail, natural stadium colors, celebratory moments, a slightly telephoto lens feel, and clear focus on trophies and upper bodies.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具张力的体育摄影作品，画面中心为一名身穿 {argument name="team jersey color" default="天蓝色"} 球衣的 {argument name="football player" default="曼城球员"}，他站在雨中的球场中央，双手将英超联赛奖杯高高举过头顶。巨大的银色奖杯顶部带有金色皇冠，手柄处悬挂着两条浅蓝色丝带，正面清晰可见刻有“Premier League”字样。球员身穿现代足球球衣，胸前印有深色赞助商文字“ETIHAD AIRWAYS”及小型队徽，双臂完全向上伸展，呈现出胜利的姿态。构图采用从躯干中部向上的紧凑竖向剪裁，奖杯位于画面上方中心，部分遮挡住球员头部。添加大雨倾盆的效果、湿润的金属反光、阴郁的阴天光影、浅景深效果，以及背景中模糊的球场观众。在背景右侧，加入一块发光的蓝色电子屏幕，上面显示着醒目的文字 {argument name="scoreboard text" default="GOAL"}。照片级逼真的体育新闻摄影，高细节，自然的球场色彩，庆祝瞬间，略带长焦镜头感，奖杯和上半身焦点清晰。

templates.title: Epic Milestone X Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 史诗级里程碑 X 海报

templates.prompt: A dramatic vertical poster, employing a dark cinematic graphic novel style. In the upper left corner is a giant red hand-drawn "X," topped with a massive, distressed Chinese font proclaiming "Over 20,000 Followers," where the number "2" is red and the rest are in bold, grayish-white blocky lettering. Below the title is a smaller, thin white Chinese slogan: "Every follow is an accumulation of power." The lower half presents an apocalyptic, monumental landscape: a massive metallic X-shaped structure explodes upwards from its center, its core radiating a powerful platinum glow, surrounded by flying debris, broken rocks, dust streaks, sparks, and taut, radiating energy beams. At the base of the glowing X, a tiny, solitary human silhouette stands on a jagged black rock platform to emphasize proportion. The color scheme uses black, charcoal gray, grayish-white, metallic gold, and blood red, emphasizing high contrast, rough textures, scratched ink strokes, weathered print wear, and a strong sense of impact and victory. At the bottom, add another short Chinese sentence in white: "True influence comes from consistently seen value." Below this, add a short red line as embellishment. The overall composition should present an epic, poster-like feel, used to celebrate achieving {argument name="follower milestone" default="20,000"} A milestone, it blends bold, poster-style typography, explosive dynamism, soaring symmetry, and a powerful social growth metaphor built around the X symbol.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满戏剧性的竖版海报，采用暗黑电影感图像小说风格。左上方是一个巨大的红色手绘“X”，顶部横跨着巨大的做旧风格中文字体“关注破 2 万”，其中数字“2”为红色，其余字符为粗犷的灰白色块状字体。在标题下方，添加一行较小的白色细体中文标语：“每一次关注，都是力量的累积。”下半部分展示一个末日般的纪念碑式景观，一座巨大的金属 X 型结构从中心向上爆炸，核心散发出强烈的白金色光芒，周围环绕着飞溅的碎片、破碎的岩石、尘埃条纹、火花和极具张力的放射状能量束。在发光的 X 底部，放置一个微小的孤独人类剪影，站在锯齿状的黑色岩石平台上以体现比例感。配色方案采用黑色、炭灰色、灰白色、金属金和血红色，强调极高对比度、粗粝质感、刮擦般的墨迹笔触、风化的印刷磨损感，以及强烈的冲击力和胜利感。在底部，加入另一句白色中文短句：“真正的影响力，来自持续被看见的价值。”并在下方配以一条短红线作为点缀。整体构图应呈现出一种史诗级的公告海报感，用于庆祝达到 {argument name="follower milestone" default="2 万"} 的里程碑，融合了大胆的宣传画风格字体、爆炸性的动态感、高耸的对称性，以及围绕 X 符号构建的强大社交增长隐喻。

templates.title: Poster of scientific anatomy of bayberry

titleLocalized.zh: 杨梅科学解剖海报

templates.prompt: An ultra-detailed scientific botany poster, set against a pure black background, features a large cross-section of a bayberry fruit at its center. Utilizing dramatic studio lighting, it achieves the realism of ultra-macro food photography, revealing a moist, glossy surface in a rich, deep red to wine-red hue. The fruit is presented as a halved anatomical specimen, occupying most of the image; the left half showcases the intact outer skin covered with countless tightly packed, bead-like protrusions, while the right half reveals translucent red flesh, its fibrous, juicy texture radiating towards the large, brown pit within the central cavity. Elegant ivory-white Chinese lettering in the upper left corner reads the title:{argument name="headline text" default="Yangmei Anatomy"} The subtitle below is{argument name="subtitle text" default="The wild balance of sour and sweet"} The fruit is surrounded by six Chinese labeling areas, each accompanied by a delicate ivory-white guide line and small dots, pointing to the precise fruit structure. Area 1, located in the upper left, is labeled "Structure 01 Pericarp Protrusions" with four lines of descriptive text. Area 2, located in the upper right, is labeled "Structure 02 Juicy Pulp" with four lines of descriptive text. Area 3, located in the middle right, is labeled "Structure 03 Seed" with four lines of descriptive text. Area 4, located in the lower left, is labeled "Structure 04 Pulp Cells" with four lines of descriptive text. Area 5, located in the lower center, is labeled "Structure 05 Nut (Endocarp)" with three lines of descriptive text. Area 6, located in the lower right, is labeled "Structure 06 Vascular Bundles" with three lines of descriptive text. The text style is a refined, slightly calligraphic serif Chinese font, with white text on a black background, similar to museum exhibit labels or high-end infographics. The composition is symmetrical and natural, with minimal negative space, a luxurious feel, educational value, realistic texture, rich details, high contrast, no superfluous objects, no borders, and no watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超精细的科学植物学海报，采用纯黑背景，画面中央为一个巨大的杨梅果实横截面，运用戏剧性的摄影棚灯光，呈现超微距食品摄影的真实感，表面湿润有光泽，色调为浓郁的深红至酒红色。果实呈现为半切的解剖标本，占据画面大部分空间；左半部分展示了覆盖着无数紧密排列的珠状突起的完整外皮，右半部分揭示了半透明的红色果肉，呈纤维状多汁纹理向中心腔体内的褐色大果核放射。左上方有优雅的象牙白色中文字体，标题为 {argument name="headline text" default="杨梅·解剖"}，下方副标题为 {argument name="subtitle text" default="酸与甜的野性平衡"}。果实周围有 6 个中文标注区域，每个区域均配有纤细的象牙白色引导线和小圆点，指向精确的果实结构。区域 1 位于左上方，标注为“结构 01 果皮突起”，配有 4 行说明文字。区域 2 位于右上方，标注为“结构 02 多汁果肉”，配有 4 行说明文字。区域 3 位于中右侧，标注为“结构 03 种子”，配有 4 行说明文字。区域 4 位于左下方，标注为“结构 04 果肉细胞”，配有 4 行说明文字。区域 5 位于下中央，标注为“结构 05 果核（内果皮）”，配有 3 行说明文字。区域 6 位于右下方，标注为“结构 06 维管束”，配有 3 行说明文字。文字风格为精致、略带书法感的衬线中文字体，黑底白字，类似于博物馆展品说明牌或高端编辑信息图。构图对称且自然，负空间极少，质感奢华、具有教育意义、触感真实、细节丰富、对比度高，无多余物体，无边框，无水印。

templates.title: Style Spectrum Fashion Posters

titleLocalized.zh: Style Spectrum 时尚海报

templates.prompt: A 9:16 vertical poster, reminiscent of a high-end fashion magazine, is set in a tranquil yet futuristic circular gallery. The walls are smooth beige stone, and a large circular skylight in the ceiling provides soft, warm light. A sculptural circular platform sits at the center. The image features seven figures of the same young East Asian woman, each with long, dark, curly hair, representing different archetypes, arranged in an elegant, symmetrical composition around the platform. The most prominent figure, seated at the edge of the platform facing forward, wears a loose ivory-white shirt and matching casual trousers, her expression calm and composed, becoming the visual focal point. The other six stylistic incarnations surrounding her are: a woman on the left wearing a soft cream-colored dress and a high bun, gentle and approachable; a woman in the center behind wearing a sleeveless black fitted suit, calm and rational; a woman in the upper right wearing a light beige cardigan with a light-colored skirt or trousers, casual and relaxed; a woman in the lower left wearing a sharp black suit and dark clothing, urban minimalism; a woman in the lower right wearing a gray-brown oversized suit, mature and confident; and a woman at the bottom front wearing a comfortable cream-colored knit top with loose light-colored trousers, everyday comfort. The seven figures share the same face, but their styles, emotions, and postures differ. The use of soft, neutral tones—ivory, cream, gray-brown, beige, stone gray, and black—creates a soft, atmospheric haze, cinematic depth of field, high-end magazine aesthetics, minimalism, and delicate skin texture. Elegant Chinese fonts are incorporated into the composition: top title.{argument name="headline text" default="You are not just one type."} Below is a smaller English subtitle.{argument name="subtitle text" default="Explore your style spectrum"} Place six Chinese style tags with brief descriptive phrases next to the surrounding figures: Gentle Atmosphere, Cool and Intellectual, Relaxed Korean Style, Urban Minimalism, Mature Aura, and Everyday Casual. Add a Chinese call to action at the bottom.{argument name="bottom question" default="Which one would you most like to be?"} and smaller supporting text{argument name="bottom caption" default="Tell me in the comments section"} High-end poster design, stylish and cinematic quality, elegant composition, soft-focus effect, exquisite and desirable.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张 9:16 竖版的高端时尚杂志风格海报，背景设定在一个宁静且充满未来感的圆形画廊中，墙面为平滑的米色石材，天花板设有大型圆形天窗，光线柔和且温暖，中心设有一个雕塑感十足的圆形平台。画面中展示了 7 个同一位年轻东亚女性的形象，她们留着深色长卷发，分别化身为不同的个性原型，以优雅对称的构图环绕在圆形平台周围。位于中心且最显眼的人物坐在平台边缘面向前方，身穿宽松的象牙白衬衫和配套的休闲长裤，神情平静且内敛，成为视觉焦点。围绕着她的另外 6 种风格化身分别为：左侧身穿柔和奶油色连衣裙、发髻高盘的女性，温柔且平易近人；后方中央身穿无袖黑色修身套装的女性，冷静且理性；右上角身穿浅米色开衫搭配浅色裙装或长裤的女性，休闲且松弛；左下角身穿干练黑色西装和深色服饰的女性，都市极简风；右下角身穿灰褐色廓形西装的女性，成熟且自信；底部前方身穿舒适奶油色针织衫搭配宽松浅色长裤的女性，日常舒适风。七个人物拥有相同的面容，但造型、情绪和姿态各异。采用象牙白、奶油色、灰褐色、米色、石灰色和黑色的柔和中性色调，营造出柔和的大气朦胧感、电影级的景深、高端杂志美学、极简主义以及细腻的皮肤质感。在构图中融入优雅的中文字体：顶部标题 {argument name="headline text" default="你不只有一种样子"}，下方配有较小的英文副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="Explore your style spectrum"}。在周围的人物旁放置 6 个带有简短描述性标语的中文风格标签：温柔氛围、清冷知性、松弛韩系、都市极简、轻熟气场、日常休闲。在底部添加中文行动号召 {argument name="bottom question" default="你最想成为哪一个？"} 以及较小的辅助文案 {argument name="bottom caption" default="评论区告诉我"}。高级海报设计，时尚大片质感，构图优雅，柔焦效果，精致且令人向往。

templates.title: Luxury skincare editorial style grid

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华护肤品编辑风格网格

templates.prompt: Create a 4 x 3 luxury skincare marketing collage grid containing 12 squares, using shades of warm ivory, cream, champagne gold, and soft beige. The overall atmosphere is exquisitely refined, minimalist, sensual, and high-end, showcasing milky diffused light, soft cinematic shadows, dewy, radiant skin, and the aesthetics of high-end beauty magazines. Square 1: A frosted glass skincare pump bottle stands on a transparent shelf, with a matte cream-colored body, a metallic gold pump head and neck, and the brand name displayed in an elegant serif font.{argument name="brand name" default="BLOOMGLOW"} The product name is displayed as{argument name="product name" default="RADIANCE MOISTURIZING EMULSION"} The first frame features a creamy beige wall against a backdrop of slanted sunlight. The second frame is a macro close-up of a thick layer of white lotion applied to a smooth creamy surface, showcasing its sculpted texture and soft highlights. The third frame is a close-up of the back of a woman's head and neck; her dark hair is styled in a neat low bun, her skin is radiant, and her ears are exposed—a minimalist composition. The fourth frame shows a sheer creamy curtain illuminated by sunlight, with shadows of leaves or flowers cast upon it. The fifth frame is a close-up of a woman's bare shoulders and upper back; her skin is dewy and glowing, a hand touches her shoulder, and a smear of lotion slides down her back—an intimate skincare editor's perspective. The sixth frame shows a crystal-clear droplet of lotion falling onto a matte creamy surface—a macro study of the product's texture. The seventh frame is a close-up of the same woman's jawline, neck, and collarbone; fingers lightly touch her neck, revealing a fresh, dewy sheen and soft shadows. Panel 8: A close-up of another application of white lotion, smoother and wider than panel 2, with a reflective, moist highlight. Panel 9: A pale champagne-toned, sun-drenched, shimmering water surface, with an abstract liquid texture and shimmering reflections. Panel 10: The same skincare bottle is placed diagonally on pleated satin or silk fabric, with soft sunlight, subtle shadows, and a clearly visible brand logo. Panel 11: A close-up of a hand, showing an oval-shaped application of white lotion to the back of the hand with the fingers of another hand, complemented by neatly trimmed, natural nails. Panel 12: A woman's radiant neck and shoulders, with a prominent collarbone highlight, dewy and luminous skin, and a hint of dark hair visible at the top edge. Maintain a clean and balanced composition, using thin white dividing lines between the 12 panels. Style keywords: minimalist luxury, creamy soft light, high-end cosmetics advertising, tactile texture, hydration, skin glow, cinematic beauty editing, understated luxury, breathable, hydrated radiance. There are no cluttered elements or bright colors; no props are added except for bottles, fabrics, water, curtains, and skincare textures.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个 4 x 3 的奢华护肤品营销拼贴网格，包含 12 个方格，使用暖象牙白、奶油色、香槟金和柔和米色的色调。整体氛围极致精致、简约、感性且高端，呈现乳白色漫射光、柔和的电影感阴影、水润光泽的肌肤，以及高端美容杂志的审美。第 1 格：一个磨砂玻璃护肤泵瓶立在透明架子上，哑光奶油色瓶身，金属金泵头和瓶颈，优雅的衬线字体品牌名显示为 {argument name="brand name" default="BLOOMGLOW"}，产品名称显示为 {argument name="product name" default="RADIANCE MOISTURIZING EMULSION"}，以奶油米色墙面为背景，伴有斜射阳光。第 2 格：在光滑奶油色表面上厚涂白色乳液的微距特写，具有雕塑感的质地，柔和的高光。第 3 格：女性头部和颈部的背面特写，深色头发梳成利落的低发髻，肌肤透亮，露出耳朵，构图极简。第 4 格：被阳光照亮的透明奶油色窗帘，叶片或花朵的阴影投射其上。第 5 格：女性裸露肩膀和上背部的特写，肌肤水润发光，一只手触碰肩膀，一抹乳液顺着背部滑落，亲密的护肤编辑视角。第 6 格：一颗晶莹剔透的乳液水滴落在奶油色哑光表面上，微距产品质地研究。第 7 格：同一位女性下颌线、颈部和锁骨的局部特写，手指轻轻触碰颈部，呈现清新水润的光泽，柔和的阴影。第 8 格：另一处白色乳液的微距涂抹，比第 2 格更平滑宽阔，带有反光的湿润高光。第 9 格：淡香槟色调的阳光波光水面，抽象的液体质感，带有闪烁的倒影。第 10 格：同一款护肤瓶斜放在褶皱的缎面或丝绸织物上，柔和的阳光，微妙的阴影，品牌标识清晰可见。第 11 格：手部特写，用另一只手的手指将椭圆形的白色乳液涂抹在手背上，修剪整齐的自然美甲。第 12 格：女性富有光泽的颈部和肩部，锁骨高光突出，肌肤水润透亮，顶部边缘隐约可见深色头发。保持构图简洁平衡，在 12 个面板之间使用细白色分割线。风格关键词：极简奢华、奶油柔光、高端化妆品广告、触感纹理、补水、肌肤光泽、电影感美妆编辑、低调奢华、透气水润光感。无杂乱元素，无明亮色彩，除瓶子、织物、水、窗帘和护肤质地外，不添加其他道具。

templates.title: Poetic female portraits in the garden

titleLocalized.zh: 花园中充满诗意的女性肖像

templates.prompt: A realistic outdoor portrait depicts a contemplative and naturally beautiful young woman standing on a garden path, bathed in the soft, golden hour light. The camera pans upwards from mid-thigh, centering her in the frame, facing the lens, her posture relaxed yet upright. She has {argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown"} Her long, thick hair, with a fluffy, slightly wavy texture, falls naturally over her shoulders. Dress her in a loose-fitting, off-white knit sweater with long sleeves, paired with high-waisted, loose-fitting navy blue or black trousers or a flowing skirt. A pair of thin-rimmed round glasses hangs from the sweater collar. In one hand she holds a sharpened yellow pencil, and in the other a slightly worn sketchbook or notebook, suggesting she is writing, sketching, or observing nature. The overall atmosphere should lean towards literary, artistic, intellectual, and understated, rather than glamorous. Place her in a lush garden, with a stone path visible, surrounded by abundant soft greenery, and blurred flowers in the foreground and background. Use a shallow depth of field effect to create a creamy, blurred background, with warm sunlight filtering through the trees behind her, creating soft, natural highlights on her hair and sweater. The image should have the quality of a candid, edited photograph, highly realistic, with a soft and tasteful style, natural and gentle colors, delicate textures, and exuding a tranquil and refined aesthetic. Vertical composition, 4:5 portrait ratio.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实风格的户外肖像，画面中是一位沉思且自然美丽的年轻女性，她站在花园小径上，沐浴在柔和的黄金时刻光线下。镜头从大腿中部向上取景，她位于画面中心，面向镜头，姿态放松且挺拔。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 的长发，发量丰盈，呈现出蓬松的微卷质感，自然垂落在肩头。为她穿上一件米白色的宽松针织毛衣，搭配长袖，下身穿着深海军蓝或黑色的高腰宽松长裤或飘逸的裙装。毛衣领口挂着一副细圆框眼镜。她的一只手拿着一支削好的黄色铅笔，另一只手拿着一本页面略显陈旧的素描本或笔记本，暗示她正在写作、素描或观察自然。整体氛围应偏向文学、艺术、知性且低调，而非华丽。将她置于一个郁郁葱葱的花园中，画面可见 1 条石板小径，周围有丰富的柔和绿植，前景和背景中有模糊的花朵。使用浅景深效果，营造出奶油般的虚化背景，温暖的阳光透过她身后的树木洒下，在她的头发和毛衣上形成柔和的自然高光。图像应呈现出抓拍编辑照片的质感，高度写实，风格柔和且有品位，色彩自然柔和，纹理细腻，散发出一种宁静、有修养的美感。竖构图，4:5 肖像比例。

templates.title: A glamorous portrait of a woman in a black dress

titleLocalized.zh: 身着黑色礼服的魅力女性肖像

templates.prompt: A realistic half-length portrait of an elegant and charming woman indoors, shot vertically, framing the image from above her chest to above her head. She is slightly turned to the side, facing the camera with a composed and confident posture. She has {argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown"} She has long, voluminous, wavy hair with a soft, slightly tousled texture, and a warm, light bronze complexion. Her neck and shoulders are slender. She wears a fitted black long-sleeved dress or top made of finely pleated fabric. The deep V-neck design creates a stylish and sexy evening look. A delicate gold chain with a small, round pendant adorns her neck. The lighting is soft and warm, with subtle shadows and a shallow depth of field. The background is a luxurious modern interior space with creamy beige walls, soft warm lighting on the left, and bright windows or door frames on the right. The overall atmosphere is refined, elegant, and high-end, like…{argument name="subject" default="A beautiful woman"} The fashion magazine spreads showcase realistic skin texture, natural light makeup, cinematic bokeh, and a high-end lifestyle photography style.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张室内优雅魅力女性的写实半身肖像，采用竖构图，取景范围从胸部上方至头部上方，她微微侧身面对镜头，姿态从容自信。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 的长款蓬松波浪卷发，发丝质感柔和凌乱，肤色呈现温暖的浅古铜色，颈部与肩部线条纤细。她身着一件修身的黑色长袖连衣裙或上衣，采用精细褶皱面料，深 V 领口设计营造出时尚且性感的晚装风格，颈部佩戴一条精致的金色细链，坠有一枚小巧的圆形吊坠。采用柔和温暖的环境光，阴影处理细腻，景深较浅；背景为奢华的现代室内空间，墙面呈奶油米色，左侧有模糊的暖色灯光，右侧有明亮的窗户或门框边缘。整体氛围精致、柔美且高端，宛如 {argument name="subject" default="一位美女"} 的时尚杂志大片，呈现真实的皮肤纹理、自然的淡妆效果、电影级的焦外成像以及高端生活方式摄影风格。

templates.title: Retro Hong Kong actress tribute poster

titleLocalized.zh: 复古香港女星致敬海报

templates.prompt: A retro Hong Kong film tribute poster in the elegant magazine style of the 1980s and 1990s, with the main image being {argument name="celebrity name" default="Rosamund Kwan"} A captivating close-up portrait of her half-length figure, seated indoors against a soft, neutral beige background. She sports voluminous, medium-length, dark brown, wavy hair parted to the side, her skin glowing, her expression serene and gentle. One hand is lightly raised near her cheek. She wears a cream-white blazer and large round pearl earrings. The lighting employs warm, diffused studio lighting, a soft-focus effect, a refined film-like texture, delicate grain, and luxurious, vintage tones of beige, ivory, dark brown, and deep plum. The composition is inspired by commemorative or celebrity archive posters, with the typography seamlessly integrated with the portrait: on the far left is a very large, deep plum-colored, vertically written Chinese calligraphy-style name text, containing the following {argument name="main Chinese name" default="Rosamund Kwan"} To its right is a line of smaller, thin, vertical Chinese characters, the content of which is:{argument name="vertical tagline" default="A peerless beauty, eternal grace"} Below the main heading on the left, place the elegant italic serif English name.{argument name="English name" default="Rosamund Kwan"} Below it, add two lines of smaller serif Chinese introductory text. In the lower left corner, there are three stacked rectangular movie still thumbnails with thin borders, each showcasing a different role played by the actress; each thumbnail has a narrow vertical Chinese title bar along its left edge. To the lower right of the portrait, place a text block containing the large Chinese surname and given name in two lines, followed by the English name, then the date of birth, and two more lines of Chinese descriptive text. Add a deep plum-colored, handwritten signature near the lower right corner. At the bottom center, add two lines of classic serif Chinese slogans, with ample negative space between them and the main layout. Overall look: a sophisticated, sensual, high-end editorial poster, a genuine retro Hong Kong actress tribute style, balanced typography, high-quality print design, and a portrait-led layout.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张 1980 年代至 1990 年代优雅杂志风格的复古香港电影致敬海报，画面主体为 {argument name="celebrity name" default="关之琳"} 的迷人半身特写肖像，她坐在室内，背景为柔和的中性米色。她留着蓬松的深棕色中长波浪卷发，侧分发型，皮肤光泽，神情从容温婉，一只手轻抬靠近脸颊，身穿奶油白色西装外套，佩戴大颗圆形珍珠耳环。采用温暖的漫射影棚光，柔焦效果，精致的胶片质感，细腻的颗粒感，以及米色、象牙白、深褐色和深李子色的奢华怀旧色调。构图设计参考纪念或明星档案海报，排版与肖像融为一体：最左侧为非常大的深李子色垂直中式书法风格姓名文字，内容为 {argument name="main Chinese name" default="关之琳"}；其右侧为一行较小的纤细垂直中文文字，内容为 {argument name="vertical tagline" default="绝代佳人・风华永恒"}。在左侧大标题下方，放置优雅的斜体衬线英文名 {argument name="English name" default="Rosamund Kwan"}。在其下方，添加两行较小的衬线字体中文引言。在左下角，包含 3 张堆叠的矩形电影剧照缩略图，带有细边框，每张缩略图展示该女星的不同角色；每张缩略图左侧边缘均有一条狭窄的垂直中文标题条。在肖像右下侧，放置一个文本块，包含分两行排列的大号中文姓氏和名字，下方为英文名，接着是出生日期行以及另外 2 行中文描述文字。在右下角附近添加一个深李子色的手写签名风格签名。在底部中心，添加 2 行经典衬线风格的中文标语，与主体布局之间留有充足的负空间。整体外观：高级、感性、高端编辑海报，地道的复古香港女星致敬风格，排版平衡，优质印刷设计，以肖像为主导的布局。

templates.title: Bohemian style fashion advertising remake reference

titleLocalized.zh: 波西米亚风时尚广告重制参考

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the layout, scene, and advertising style template, and REFERENCE_1 as the product source, a new double-panel fashion marketing collage was created, but the dress in the original image was replaced with the shirt from REFERENCE_1. The lifestyle composition of the beach and poolside scenes from REFERENCE_0 was retained: a large close-up in the upper left corner, a full-body standing shot in the beach scene in the upper right corner, a seated shot by the pool in the lower left corner, and three circular fabric/detail labels arranged vertically on the right. The overall high-end bohemian summer advertising feel, soft natural light, sand, parasols, lounge chairs, basket accessories, and vacation atmosphere were maintained. The product was redesigned as a realistic lifestyle outfit: in the full-body and seated shots, the red embroidered V-neck shirt from REFERENCE_1 was paired with denim shorts, while ensuring visual consistency in the model and styling across all frames. All headlines and functional copy in the reference images were replaced with entirely new English fashion advertising text; do not directly copy the original words: use a large headline.{argument name="headline text" default="Holiday"} Above this is a smaller, handwritten brand name, a brief three-line descriptive subheading, and three functional descriptions corresponding to three circular headings. The three functional headings should highlight the neckline, sleeve length, and embroidery details. Maintain a sophisticated e-commerce poster design, rounded white card edges, elegant typographic hierarchy, and add a pink handwritten tagline in the lower right corner.{argument name="tagline" default="Boho Chic Style"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 作为布局、场景和广告风格模板，以 REFERENCE_1 作为产品来源，重新创作出同样的双联幅时尚营销拼贴画，但将原图中的连衣裙替换为 REFERENCE_1 中的衬衫。保留 REFERENCE_0 中海滩与池畔的生活方式构图：左上角 1 张大尺寸特写，右上角海滩场景中的 1 张全身站立照，左下角 1 张池畔坐姿照，以及右侧垂直排列的 3 个圆形面料/细节标注。保持整体高端波西米亚夏季广告的质感、柔和的自然光、沙滩、遮阳伞、躺椅、篮子配饰以及度假氛围。将产品重新设计为真实的生活方式穿搭：在全身照和坐姿照中，将 REFERENCE_1 中那件红色刺绣 V 领衬衫与牛仔短裤搭配，同时确保模特和造型在所有画面中保持视觉一致。将参考图中的所有标题和功能文案替换为全新的英文时尚广告文本，切勿直接复制原词：使用一个大标题 {argument name="headline text" default="Holiday"}，上方配以较小的手写体品牌词，一个简短的 3 行描述性副标题，以及与 3 个圆形标注相对应的 3 段功能简介。3 个功能标题应重点突出领口、袖长和刺绣细节。保持精致的电商海报设计、圆角白色卡片边缘、优雅的排版层级，并在右下角添加一行粉色手写标语 {argument name="tagline" default="Boho Chic Style"}。

templates.title: Luxury religious concept poster grid

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华宗教概念海报网格

templates.prompt: Create a picture about{argument name="theme" default="religion"} The luxurious concept infographic poster is arranged in a clean 2x2 grid against a cinematic background ranging from deep navy blue to black. Each quadrant contains a floating stone island, rendered as a highly detailed miniature monumental scene, with warm golden contour lighting and soft volumetric shadows, presenting an elegant dark fantasy editorial style with realistic textures, symmetrical composition, and exquisite gold typography. Top left: Islam, featuring a magnificent and ornate mosque with a large central dome, smaller domes, two minarets, arched entrances, palm trees, stone steps, and glowing windows, situated on a circular floating island; to the left are three vertical icon labels that read “TAWHID,” “SALAH,” and “QURAN”; to the right is a decorative plaque with Arabic calligraphy; at the bottom is a crescent symbol above the large gold title “ISLAM.” Top right: Christianity, featuring a Gothic stone church with a soaring central spire and cross, pointed arches, stained-glass windows, small trees, and a stone path with railings on a floating island; on the left are three vertical icon labels that read “FAITH,” “LOVE,” and “BIBLE”; on the right is a framed plaque with quotes “FOR GOD SO LOVED THE WORLD THAT HE GAVE HIS ONLY BEGOTTEN SON” and “JOHN 3:16”; at the bottom is a cross symbol integrated into the large gold title “CHRISTIANITY.” Bottom left: Hinduism, featuring an exquisite South Indian temple tower atop a stepped stone complex with smaller shrines, flags, rocky landscapes, and warm interior lighting, situated on a floating island; three vertical icon labels on the left read “DHARMA,” “KARMA,” and “MOKSHA”; a decorative mandala emblem with the “Om” symbol on the right; and an “Om” symbol at the bottom above the large gold title “HINDUISM.” Bottom right: Buddhism, featuring a colossal seated Buddha meditating on a tiered stone pedestal, surrounded by rocks, bonsai-like trees, and temple steps, situated on a floating island; to the left are three vertical icon labels reading “MINDFULNESS,” “DHARMA,” and “COMPASSION”; to the right is a framed plaque with the inscription “THE MIND IS EVERYTHING. WHAT YOU THINK YOU BECOME. - BUDDHA -”; at the bottom is a Dharma wheel symbol above the large gold title “BUDDHISM.” Maintaining visual consistency across all four sections, the design utilizes premium gold UI borders, sculpted icon badges, polished serif fonts, dramatic studio lighting, high contrast, subtle halos, and perfect centering.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张关于 {argument name="theme" default="religion"} 的奢华概念实体信息图海报，以整洁的 2x2 网格排列在深海军蓝至黑色的电影级背景上。每个象限包含一座漂浮的石岛，渲染为高度精细的微型纪念碑场景，配以温暖的金色轮廓光和柔和的体积阴影，呈现出优雅的暗黑奇幻编辑风格，具有逼真的材质、对称的构图和精致的金色排版。左上角：伊斯兰教，以一座宏伟华丽的清真寺为特色，拥有一个大型中央圆顶、较小的圆顶、两座宣礼塔、拱形入口、棕榈树、石阶和发光的窗户，位于一个圆形的漂浮岛屿上；左侧有 3 个垂直图标标签，分别写着“TAWHID”、“SALAH”和“QURAN”；右侧有一块装饰性牌匾，上面有阿拉伯书法；底部是一个新月符号，位于金色大标题“ISLAM”上方。右上角：基督教，以一座哥特式石教堂为特色，拥有高耸的中央尖塔和十字架、尖拱门、彩色玻璃风格的窗户、小树和漂浮岛上的围栏石径；左侧有 3 个垂直图标标签，分别写着“FAITH”、“LOVE”和“BIBLE”；右侧有一块带框的引文牌匾，写着“FOR GOD SO LOVED THE WORLD THAT HE GAVE HIS ONLY BEGOTTEN SON”和“JOHN 3:16”；底部是一个十字架符号，融入了金色大标题“CHRISTIANITY”中。左下角：印度教，以一座精致的南印度寺庙塔楼为特色，耸立在带有较小神龛、旗帜、岩石景观和温暖室内光线的阶梯式石制建筑群之上，位于漂浮岛屿上；左侧有 3 个垂直图标标签，分别写着“DHARMA”、“KARMA”和“MOKSHA”；右侧有一个带有“Om”符号的装饰性曼陀罗徽章；底部是一个“Om”符号，位于金色大标题“HINDUISM”上方。右下角：佛教，以一座巨大的坐姿佛像为特色，佛像在分层的石基座上冥想，周围环绕着岩石、盆景般的树木和寺庙台阶，位于漂浮岛屿上；左侧有 3 个垂直图标标签，分别写着“MINDFULNESS”、“DHARMA”和“COMPASSION”；右侧有一块带框的引文牌匾，写着“THE MIND IS EVERYTHING. WHAT YOU THINK YOU BECOME. - BUDDHA -”；底部是一个法轮符号，位于金色大标题“BUDDHISM”上方。保持所有 4 个部分在视觉上的一致性，采用优质的金色 UI 边框、雕刻图标徽章、抛光的衬线字体、戏剧性的摄影棚灯光、高对比度、微妙的光晕和完美的居中呈现。

templates.title: Old photos restored to DSLR-quality portrait mode

titleLocalized.zh: 老照片修复为单反级人像

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference images, restore damaged old family photographs to natural, modern, high-resolution portraits while preserving the original four-person composition, poses, framing, clothing, and outdoor rural background. Remove all visible signs of aging, including tears, cracks, creases, stains, worn paper edges, scratches, and fading. Convert the black and white/sepia image to realistic, soft colors, preserving accurate skin tones and neutral earth-tone clothing. Enhance details, sharpen fabric and hair textures, improve contrast and dynamic range, and elevate it to professional-grade DSLR quality, achieving sharp focus and subtle shallow depth of field, as if using a professional DSLR.{argument name="camera model" default="Canon EOS R6 II"} The photography was average. The goal was to ensure the final result was highly realistic, natural, and faithful to the original subject's facial features and proportions.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图像，将受损的家庭老照片修复为自然、现代的高分辨率人像，同时保持原有的 4 人构图、姿势、取景、服装及户外乡村背景不变。去除所有可见的岁月痕迹，包括撕裂、裂纹、折痕、污渍、磨损的纸张边缘、划痕及褪色。将黑白/棕褐色图像转换为逼真的柔和色彩，保留准确的肤色和中性大地色系的服装。增强细节，锐化织物与头发纹理，改善对比度与动态范围，并将其提升至专业级的 DSLR 画质，实现清晰对焦与微妙的浅景深效果，如同使用 {argument name="camera model" default="Canon EOS R6 II"} 拍摄一般。确保最终结果高度写实、自然，并忠实于原始人物的面部特征与比例。

templates.title: Futuristic posters of Shenzhen cultural heritage

titleLocalized.zh: 深圳文化遗产未来感海报

templates.prompt: A dramatic, vertical poster-style cityscape image, showcasing{argument name="city name" default="Shenzhen"} The scene, captured at the golden hour, perfectly blends traditional Chinese cultural heritage with a futuristic coastal metropolis. The image, viewed from a high hillside, is a panoramic collage of towering, layered structures. The right and central areas showcase a dense, modern skyline adjacent to a tranquil bay, with a streamlined, bullet-shaped skyscraper prominently displayed, surrounded by glass towers, a long bridge spanning the water, distant mountains, and softly lit clouds illuminated by sunrise or sunset. In the midground, a large modern municipal building with a flowing white roof and a central red accent is visible. The lower right shows a bustling container port with blue gantry cranes, cargo ships, and winding roads outlined by warm-toned long-exposure light trails. In the foreground, a white high-speed train winds its way into the city from an elevated bridge. The left side incorporates lush forested hillsides, dotted with traditional red-walled multi-tiered pagodas, ancient Chinese courtyards with gray-tiled roofs and red lanterns, and a towering natural stone monument inscribed with red Chinese characters. In the lower right corner, six small figures stand on a viewing platform, some standing, some sitting, gazing at the entire city. The composition is unified by the atmospheric mist drifting between the historic hillside and the modern city center. A striking black Chinese calligraphy is added to the upper left corner, containing the following text:{argument name="main calligraphy" default="Shenzhen"} Below it is a small red stamp, and nearby is a row of vertical Chinese slogans.{argument name="slogan text" default="Daring to be the first, open-minded and inclusive, innovative and boundless, growing together with the future."} Add red text to the stone tablet.{argument name="stone inscription" default="Dapeng Fortress"} The upper left and lower left edges are decorated with expressive gold ink splashes and brushstroke textures, while the background has an elegant parchment texture, gradually transitioning into a realistic cityscape. The overall style is an ultra-refined, cinematic-quality tourism poster concept art, featuring realistic architecture, a warm amber and cyan color gradation, clear lighting, volumetric fog effects, intricate environmental details, excellent composition with a subtle fantasy montage feel, high contrast, and an aesthetic that presents a high-end tourism promotion aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的竖版海报风格城市景观图，展示了 {argument name="city name" default="深圳"} 在黄金时刻的景象，将中国传统文化遗产与未来感滨海大都市完美融合。画面采用从高处山坡俯瞰的视角，构图为高耸且层次丰富的全景拼贴。右侧及中心区域展示了紧邻宁静海湾的密集现代天际线，一座流线型子弹头状的超高层摩天大楼尤为醒目，周围环绕着玻璃塔楼、横跨水面的长桥、远山以及被日出或日落照亮的柔和云层。中景处包含一座拥有流动白色屋顶且中心带有红色点缀的现代大型市政建筑。右下方展示了一个繁忙的集装箱港口，配有蓝色龙门吊、货轮以及由暖色长曝光光轨勾勒出的蜿蜒道路。前景下方，一列白色高铁行驶在高架桥上，蜿蜒驶入城市。左侧融入了郁郁葱葱的森林山坡，点缀着传统的红墙多层宝塔、带有灰色瓦片屋顶和红灯笼的中国古建筑庭院，以及一块刻有红色汉字的天然高耸石碑。右下角边缘处，放置 6 个站在观景台的小人，有的站立，有的坐着，正眺望整座城市。利用在历史山坡与现代城市核心之间飘动的大气薄雾来统一构图。左上方添加醒目的黑色中国书法，内容为 {argument name="main calligraphy" default="深圳"}，下方配有一枚小红印章，并在附近放置一列竖排中文标语 {argument name="slogan text" default="敢为人先 开放包容 创新无限 与未来 共生长"}。在石碑上添加红色文字 {argument name="stone inscription" default="大鹏所城"}。左上角和左下角边缘装饰有富有表现力的金色水墨飞溅和笔触纹理，背景为淡雅的羊皮纸质感，并逐渐过渡到写实的城市景观中。整体风格为超精细的电影级旅游海报概念艺术，建筑写实，采用暖琥珀色与青色的色调分级，光线清晰，具有体积雾效果，环境细节错综复杂，构图精良但带有轻微的奇幻蒙太奇色彩，对比度高，呈现出高端旅游宣传的审美。
