templates.title: Japanese Rain Gear Product Catalog Layout

titleLocalized.zh: 日式雨具产品目录排版

templates.prompt: Against a soft, warm light gray background, create a clean and sophisticated Japanese fashion catalog page, showcasing a coordinated rain gear set in a flat lay, reflecting a product editing style. At the center of the image is a women's hooded raincoat, a dark gray-blue, front facing up with slightly inward-curving sleeves, neatly arranged. The raincoat is mid-length, featuring a full front zipper, snap-button windproof placket details near the collar, a structured large hood, adjustable drawstrings at the hood and waist, two vertical zippered pockets, refined seams, and a slightly elongated, curved back hem, with a dark lining visible at the bottom opening. In the upper right corner, a matching dark gray-blue wide-brimmed rain hat is placed, slightly tilted, with a darker inner brim and a small black label on the crown. Soft, diffused studio lighting, combined with delicate and realistic shadows, creates a high-end product photography feel. Editorial-style typography and labeling are added around the product, employing a minimalist Japanese layout. The top left corner features a small Japanese tagline, “雨の日も、わたしらしく.”, above which is the prominent serif English title, “OUTDOOR SET UP.” Below this is a short, vertically arranged section of Japanese text describing this stylish and practical raincoat and hood set. The bottom left corner features a serif subtitle, “DETAILS,” with two vertically stacked circular inset detail images: the upper circle shows a close-up of the hood and drawstring hardware; the lower circle shows the effect of water droplets condensing on the blue waterproof fabric. Each circle is accompanied by brief Japanese descriptions to the right. Two serif English product labels are added to the right side of the page, each with a thin leader line: “HAT” is labeled next to the hood in the upper right corner, with a brief Japanese description below; “COAT” is labeled next to the raincoat in the lower right corner, with a brief Japanese description below. The layout maintains a clean balance, with elegant white space, showcasing a sophisticated magazine-style layout, realistic clothing textures, and modern outdoor luxury aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh:
在柔和的暖浅灰色背景上，创作一张简洁、高端的日式时尚目录页面，以平铺方式展示一套协调的雨具套装，呈现出产品编辑风格。画面中心为 1 件女性连帽雨衣，呈暗灰蓝色，正面朝上，袖子微微向内弯曲，摆放整齐。雨衣为中长款，配有全前拉链、领口附近的按扣防风门襟细节、结构感十足的大兜帽、兜帽和腰部的可调节抽绳、两个垂直拉链口袋、精致的接缝结构，以及略长的弧形后下摆，底部开口处可见深色内衬。在右上方，放置 1 顶同色系的暗灰蓝色宽檐雨帽，略微倾斜，帽檐内侧颜色较深，帽冠处有一个小黑标。使用柔和的漫射摄影棚灯光，配合细腻逼真的阴影，营造出高级的产品摄影质感。

在产品周围添加编辑风格的排版和标注，采用极简的日式布局。左上角放置一行小字日文标语“雨の日も、わたしらしく。”，其上方为醒目的衬线体英文标题“OUTDOOR SET UP”。下方添加一小段垂直排列的日文正文，描述这款时尚且实用的雨衣雨帽套装。左下角添加衬线体副标题“DETAILS”，并垂直堆叠 2 张圆形内嵌细节图：上方圆圈展示兜帽和前襟抽绳五金件的特写；下方圆圈展示水珠在蓝色防水面料上凝结的效果。每个圆圈右侧配有简短的日文说明文字。页面右侧添加 2 个衬线体英文产品标注，并配有细引线：“HAT”标注在右上方的雨帽旁，下方附带简短日文描述；“COAT”标注在右下方的雨衣旁，下方附带简短日文描述。保持布局通透平衡，留白优雅，展现精致的杂志排版风格、逼真的服装质感以及现代户外奢华美学。

templates.title: Blue Fashion Portrait in the Rain

titleLocalized.zh: 雨中蓝色时尚人像

templates.prompt: A dreamlike portrait of a fashion editor, depicting a young woman standing outdoors on a rainy day, beside a shallow reflecting pool and a pebble path. The vertical composition frames the image from mid-thigh upwards. She wears a monochrome light pinkish-blue raincoat, consisting of a wide-brimmed waterproof sun hat and a high-necked functional raincoat with a hood, featuring a shiny silver front zipper, multiple drawstrings, adjustable buckles, and rope details at the chest and waist. The jacket's zipper is high, the collar partially obscuring her chin, creating a sense of coverage and utilitarian style. She sports a dark short bob, peeking out from under the hat. Her pose is slightly turned to the right, her head facing the camera, conveying a calm and restrained emotion. Soft, diffused light and cool tones create a misty atmosphere, while a very shallow depth of field gives the modern architectural structures in the background a blurred, minimalist feel. The scene should possess a futuristic and tranquil quality, with wet surfaces, fine raindrops, a greyish-white sky, soft reflections in the water, and {argument name="outfit color" default="pale powder blue"} The dominant color palette is clean and minimalist, giving the image a high-end contemporary street photography feel, with a slightly cinematic, light, soft-focus, subtle contrast, and delicate film texture. A small, handwritten-style watermark is added near the right edge, containing the following text:{argument name="watermark text" default="aichof"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 一张梦幻般的时尚编辑人像，画面中一位年轻女性站在阴雨天的户外，身旁是一个浅浅的倒影池和鹅卵石步道，采用竖构图，取景范围约为大腿中部以上。她身穿一套单色淡粉蓝色雨衣，包括一顶宽檐防水遮阳帽和一件带有兜帽的高领机能雨衣，配有闪亮的银色前拉链、多条抽绳、调节扣以及胸部和腰部的绳索细节。外套拉链拉高，领口遮住部分下颚，营造出一种包裹感和实用主义风格。她留着深色短波波头，从帽子下露出。姿势略微侧身，身体朝向右侧，头部面向镜头，展现出平静、内敛的情绪。使用柔和的漫射光，冷色调，营造雾蒙蒙的氛围，并使用极浅的景深，使背景中的现代建筑结构呈现出模糊的极简感。场景应具有未来感和宁静感，伴有湿润的表面、细微的雨滴、灰白色的天空、水中柔和的倒影，以及以 {argument name="outfit color" default="pale powder blue"} 为主的干净极简色调。使图像看起来像高端当代街头摄影，略带电影感、轻盈、柔焦、细腻的对比度以及微妙的胶片质感。在右侧边缘附近添加一个手写风格的小水印，内容为 {argument name="watermark text" default="aichof"}。

titleLocalized.zh: 未来感深圳城市海报

templates.prompt: A highly dramatic, vertical poster-style digital painting, showcasing{argument name="city name" default="Shenzhen"} It perfectly blends future urban development with traditional culture at a golden moment. promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的竖版海报风格数字绘画，展示了 {argument name="city name" default="深圳"}，将未来城市发展与传统文化在黄金时刻完美融合。顶部中央，醒目的中式书法大字写着 {argument name="main title" default="深圳"}，采用质感十足的金色笔触，旁边配有一枚小巧的红色印章。正下方，醒目的中文标语 {argument name="subtitle text" default="敢闯敢试，开放包容"} 以同样的暖金白色调呈现。天际线以一座高耸、流畅的中央摩天大楼（类似平安金融中心）为主体，周围环绕着密集的现代高层建筑，背景是深邃的暴风雨蓝云，在地平线附近向温暖的夕阳余晖敞开。中景和右侧，一个拥有 4 台红色集装箱起重机和堆叠集装箱的现代港口，彰显了贸易与工业实力。一列高铁从底部中央蜿蜒驶向天际线，轨道走廊闪烁着生动的霓虹蓝白光迹，以优美的 S 型曲线穿过城市，象征着速度、创新与互联。天空中，11 架四轴无人机组成松散编队飞行，象征着科技与物流。左侧前景融入了一座历史悠久的岭南风格骑楼，精致的屋檐与温暖的室内灯光，与现代建筑形成鲜明对比。底部前景增加了茂密的绿植和盛开的鲜花，右下角的粉红色花朵尤为鲜艳。采用电影感、励志且精致的概念艺术风格，具备丰富的空气透视感、超精细的建筑细节、明亮的强光、微妙的薄雾以及蓝金配色。构图宏大、乐观且富有远见，如同庆祝创新、开放、交通、商业与文化遗产的旅游或城市品牌宣传海报。右下角包含一个白色小字中文水印，内容为 {argument name="watermark text" default="豆包AI生成"}。

templates.title: Retro Japanese-style photo booth journal pages

titleLocalized.zh: 复古日式大头贴风格手账页面

templates.prompt: This is a nostalgic Japanese sticker photo style collage, with a warm-toned off-white textured paper background. The design is inspired by the doodle pages of Heisei-era gyaru (gyaru) photo booths. The top left corner features large, reddish-brown crayon-style handwritten Japanese characters “Showa no Hi.” (Showa Day). Below on the left are five lines of handwritten notes with playful doodles: 1) “Sen bu~~~” (First I'll give up~~~) in dark gray font, decorated with light blue waves; 2) “July 11.6” with a yellow moon doodle; 3) “Sunny 20°C” with a small orange sun, a red thermometer, and white clouds; 4) “Showa no Hi” with a miniature red flag and an open book icon; 5) “Tatami no Hi” with a green tatami icon, followed by “Naporitan no Hi” and a fork icon. At the bottom is a large, reddish-brown handwritten phrase “Heisei gyaru prique no sho” (Heisei Gyaru prique no sho), underlined. The right half features a square snapshot of a young Japanese woman sitting at the counter of a wooden café by a sunny window, her face softly blurred in a rectangular pattern. She has a messy, dark brown updo with a few strands falling loose, and wears an oversized beige knit sweater. She's holding a creamy or lemon soda with ice cream and red cherries, sipping it through a straw, gazing out the window. The café's interior is cozy and retro, filled with warm brown wood elements, soft afternoon light, and decorative paintings, creating a tranquil Showa-era tea-drinking atmosphere. The photo is surrounded by cute, pastel-painted doodles: an orange sunbeam in the upper left corner, three yellow stars, two pink hearts, a blue swirling line in the upper right corner, a small green sprout at the bottom, a simple yellow puppy sketch in the lower right corner, and green leaf decorations around the edges of the page. The overall composition should present a light, handmade, feminine, nostalgic and casual atmosphere, with imperfect strokes reminiscent of markers and crayons, soft colors with an earthy feel, perfectly recreating the authentic texture of a retro Japanese photo booth journal.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满怀旧感的日式贴纸照片风格手账拼贴，背景为暖色调的米白色纹理纸，设计灵感源自平成时代的辣妹（gyaru）大头贴涂鸦页面。左上角有红棕色蜡笔风格的手写日文大字“昭和の日。”。下方左侧排列着 5 行带有俏皮涂鸦的手写笔记：1) 深灰色字体的“先负~~~”，配有淡蓝色波浪装饰；2) “月齢11.6”，配有黄色月亮涂鸦；3) “晴れ20°C”，配有小橙色太阳、红色温度计和白色云朵；4) “昭和の日”，配有微型红旗和打开的书本图标；5) “畳の日”，配有绿色榻榻米图标，下方紧接着“ナポリタンの日”及叉子图标。底部有红棕色手写大字“平成ギャルプリクラの落書”，并带有下划线。右半部分放置一张方形抓拍照片，画面中一位年轻日本女性坐在阳光明媚的窗边木质咖啡馆吧台前，面部经过柔和的矩形模糊处理。她留着深棕色凌乱盘发，几缕发丝垂落，身穿超大款米色针织毛衣。她正手持一杯加了冰淇淋和红樱桃的奶油苏打或柠檬苏打，透过吸管啜饮，目光望向窗外。咖啡馆内部温馨复古，充满暖棕色木质元素、柔和的午后自然光，背景挂有装饰画，营造出宁静的昭和时代纯喫茶氛围。照片周围环绕着粉彩蜡笔风格的可爱手绘涂鸦：照片左上角的橙色太阳光芒、3 颗黄色星星、2 颗粉色爱心、右上角的蓝色旋风线条、底部的小绿芽、右下角简单的黄色小狗简笔画，以及页面周围的绿叶装饰。整体构图应呈现出轻盈、手工感、女性化、怀旧且随性的氛围，笔触带有马克笔和蜡笔的不完美感，色调柔和且富有大地气息，完美还原地道的复古日式大头贴手账质感。

templates.title: Showa era notebook-style portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 昭和之日手账风肖像

templates.prompt: A soft, light Japanese lifestyle poster against a light beige textured paper background creates a warm, nostalgic atmosphere. The right side depicts a young woman seated in a relaxed side posture, one knee raised, wearing an oversized white long-sleeved shirt and blue jeans. Her dark brown hair is tied in a messy bun, with a few strands falling around her cheek, and one hand gently touching her forehead. Her face is minimized or obscured, making the overall atmosphere and styling more important than her personal identity. The poster employs soft natural light, high-key exposure, and a sophisticated editorial style combined with hand-drawn doodles. The left half features handwritten Japanese text in a crayon or colored pencil style. Large orange text at the top {argument name="date text" default="April 29"} Below is{argument name="headline text" default="Showa Day"} Below this, add a short, gray handwritten Japanese phrase: “なつかしい風が心をふわっとほどいてくれる日.” (A nostalgic wind, a day that makes the heart feel light and relaxed.) Below that, add three lines of small information with icons: a smiley face icon with “先负” (first in a row), a crescent moon icon with “月齢11.6” (monthly age 11.6), and a sun icon with “晴れ20℃” (sunny 20℃). Then add a dotted line separator and a handwritten list titled “今日は何の日?” (What day is it today?) containing four bullet points: “昭和の日” (Showa Day), “畳の日” (Tatami Day), “ナポリタンの日” (Napolitan Day), and “国际盲导狗の日” (International Guide Dog Day), each accompanied by small doodles such as flags, tatami mats, pasta plates, and dogs. Draw a pink cloud-shaped dialog box in the bottom left corner, containing a handwritten quote.{argument name="quote" default="きみのえがおが いちばんだいすきだよ by ○○より"} The artwork includes: two white cloud doodles near the upper right corner, a yellow sun doodle in the upper right corner, several small green leaves floating in the air, faint wind-blown lines near the woman's head, and four small pink, yellow, and orange flower doodles around her legs at the bottom edge. The color scheme remains soft pastel, using orange, pink, olive green, gray, cream, and denim blue. The overall effect should resemble an emotionally resonant Japanese holiday planner calendar page, perfectly blending minimalist portrait photography with charming, childlike illustrations.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张柔和、轻盈的日式生活方式海报，背景为浅米色纹理纸，营造出温暖的怀旧氛围。右侧展示一位年轻女性，她以放松的侧姿坐着，单膝抬起，身穿超大款白色长袖衬衫和蓝色牛仔裤。她深棕色的头发扎成凌乱的丸子头，脸颊旁散落着几缕发丝，一只手轻轻触碰额头。面部应弱化或遮挡，使整体氛围和造型比个人身份更重要。采用柔和的自然光、高调曝光，以及精致的编辑摄影风格与手绘涂鸦相结合。左半部分放置蜡笔或彩色铅笔风格的日文手写文字。顶部的大号橙色文字为 {argument name="date text" default="4月29日"}，下方为 {argument name="headline text" default="昭和の日"}。在其下方，添加一段灰色的日文手写短句：“なつかしい風が 心をふわっと ほどいてくれる日。”（怀旧的风，让心轻盈舒展的日子。）下方添加 3 行带有图标的小信息：1 个笑脸图标配“先负”，1 个新月图标配“月齢 11.6”，以及 1 个太阳图标配“晴れ 20℃”。接着添加一条虚线分隔符，以及一个标题为“今日は何の日？”（今天是什么日子？）的手写列表，包含 4 个项目符号： “昭和の日”、“畳の日”、“ナポリタンの日”和“国際盲導犬の日”，每一项都配有小涂鸦，如旗帜、榻榻米、意大利面盘和狗。左下角绘制 1 个粉色云朵形状的对话框，包含手写引语 {argument name="quote" default="きみのえがおが いちばんだいすきだよ by ○○より"}。画面装饰包括：右上角附近正好 2 个白色云朵涂鸦，右上角 1 个黄色太阳涂鸦，空中飘浮着几片绿色小叶子，女性头部附近有几条淡淡的风痕线条，底部边缘她腿部周围正好 4 个粉色、黄色和橙色的小花涂鸦。色调保持柔和的粉彩色，使用橙色、粉色、橄榄绿、灰色、奶油色和牛仔蓝。整体效果应呈现为一张充满情感的日式节假日手账日历页，将极简主义肖像摄影与可爱的童趣插画完美融合。

templates.title: AI Supercar Poster Comparison

titleLocalized.zh: AI 超跑海报对比

templates.prompt: Create a side-by-side comparison image on a black background with a light gray grid, similar in style to benchmark posts on Chinese social media, to compare two AI-generated supercar posters. Place two large headings at the top: "GPT image 2" in bold yellow on the left, and "Nano Banana" in bold white on the right. Below them, center-align two different vertical racing poster designs side-by-side, with a narrow gap in between. The poster on the left should present a high-end racing advertisement style, using a black, red, and white color scheme, depicting a bright red supercar speeding along a wet track at dusk, with cinematic reflections, motion blur, and intense lighting effects. Add a small brand logo in the upper left corner, a large headline "VORTEX X7" with "X7" in bright red, and a subheading such as "BORN FOR SPEED. BUILT TO WIN." Add two laurel leaf-like badges to the right of the heading area. The lower half contains three content blocks: the left side is the "SPECIFICATIONS" column, containing a 7-row list with icons and labels covering engine, horsepower, top speed, acceleration, transmission, drive system, curb weight, and a compact list of fuel capacity (if needed) in the last row; the middle section is the "FEATURES" column, containing 5 key points; and a bold price block displaying "STARTING AT" and {argument name="price" default="$189,900"} The price is displayed in a striking red. Add a limited-edition badge, a slogan block that reads "FEEL THE SPEED. OWN THE TRACK.", and a red call to action strip that reads "ORDER NOW." Use subtle footer details and contact-style microtext at the bottom edge. The right-hand poster should look more editorial and technical, accented with navy blue, charcoal gray, beige, and orange, featuring a dark blue supercar drifting on a racetrack against a backdrop of smoke and landscape. At the top, use a premium magazine-style header with three stacked headings: "FORMULA APEX | AETHELRED APEX," "CHAMPIONSHIP HERITAGE," and a performance subheading. In the lower half, create a dense specifications sheet layout with eight main sections: "SPECIFICATION SHEET," "COMPETITION PACK OPTIONS," "ENGINE," "SUSPENSION," "CHASSIS," "DRIVETRAIN," "LAUNCH EDITION | RESERVE NOW," and "SERVICE & SUPPORT." Includes a small performance chart, a boxed options panel with 3 icon cards, and a single-line display.{argument name="launch price" default="$2,850,000 USD"} The release price, a production quota area displaying 50 units worldwide, an allocation or progress tracker with segmented bars, and a line indicating when production began.{argument name="production year" default="2025"} The text includes dense, detailed technical explanations. Below both posters, add a rounded black text box with a white border, spanning most of the width. Overlay a yellow rounded label in the upper left corner containing the Chinese word "Tips". Inside the box, place a line of bold white Chinese text:{argument name="prompt text" default="Generate a racing car poster image, including specifications and pricing information."} The overall composition should present a sophisticated AI-generated social media image comparison screenshot, featuring sharp typography, high contrast, neat alignment, and realistic poster mockup proportions.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个在带有浅灰色网格的黑色背景上的并排对比图，风格类似于中国社交媒体上的基准测试帖，用于比较两张 AI 生成的超跑海报。在最上方放置 2 个大标题：左侧为加粗黄色文字“GPT image 2”，右侧为加粗白色文字“Nano Banana”。在它们下方居中位置，并排展示 2 张不同的垂直赛车海报设计，中间留有窄缝。左侧海报应呈现为高端赛车广告风格，采用黑、红、白配色，画面为一辆亮红色超跑在黄昏时湿滑的赛道上疾驰，带有电影质感的反射、动态模糊和强烈的灯光效果。在左上角加入一个小品牌标志，巨大的标题“VORTEX X7”中“X7”为亮红色，并配有副标题如“BORN FOR SPEED. BUILT TO WIN.”。在标题区域右侧添加 2 个类似月桂叶的徽章。在下半部分，包含 3 个内容区块：左侧为“SPECIFICATIONS”列，包含 7 行带有图标符号和标签的列表，涵盖引擎、马力、最高时速、加速、变速箱、驱动系统、整备质量，并在最后一行紧凑地列出燃油容量（如有需要）；中间为“FEATURES”列，包含 5 个要点；以及一个加粗的价格区块，显示“STARTING AT”和以 {argument name="price" default="$189,900"} 显示的醒目红色价格。添加 1 个限量生产徽章、1 个写有“FEEL THE SPEED. OWN THE TRACK.”的口号区块，以及 1 条写有“ORDER NOW”的红色行动呼吁条。在底部边缘使用微小的页脚细节和联系方式风格的微型文字。右侧海报应看起来更具编辑感和技术感，采用海军蓝、炭灰色、米色和橙色点缀，画面为一辆深蓝色超跑在赛道上漂移，背景带有烟雾和景观。在顶部，使用高级杂志风格的页眉，包含 3 行堆叠标题：“FORMULA APEX | AETHELRED APEX”、“CHAMPIONSHIP HERITAGE”以及一个性能副标题。在下半部分，创建一个密集的规格表布局，包含 8 个主要部分：“SPECIFICATION SHEET”、“COMPETITION PACK OPTIONS”、“ENGINE”、“SUSPENSION”、“CHASSIS”、“DRIVETRAIN”、“LAUNCH EDITION | RESERVE NOW”和“SERVICE & SUPPORT”。包含一张小型性能图表、一个带有 3 个图标卡片的盒装选项面板、一行显示 {argument name="launch price" default="$2,850,000 USD"} 的发布价格、一个显示全球限量 50 台的生产配额区域、一个带有分段条的分配或进度跟踪器、一行说明生产开始于 {argument name="production year" default="2025"} 的文字，以及密集的精细技术说明文字。在两张海报下方，添加一个白色边框的圆角黑色提示词框，横跨大部分宽度。在左上角覆盖一个黄色的圆角标签，内含中文“提示词”。在框内，放置一行加粗的白色中文文字：{argument name="prompt text" default="生成一张赛车海报图片，包含规格参数和价格信息。"}。整体构图应呈现为一张精致的社交媒体 AI 图像对比截图，具备锐利的排版、高对比度、整齐的对齐以及逼真的海报样机比例。

templates.title: Tired girl in a quiet room

titleLocalized.zh: 安静房间里疲惫的女孩

templates.prompt: A soft, low-saturation monochrome anime-style illustration depicts a weary young woman languidly resting in a quiet room. The artwork uses delicate sketch lines and flat, warm gray-beige shades. She has long, almost black, dark brown hair, slightly disheveled, with soft bangs. Her skin is fair, and her half-open eyes reveal fatigue. Her expression is one of exhaustion and absent-mindedness, with a slight pout conveying emotional weariness. She slumps sideways in a chair or sofa, one hand supporting her chin, her elbow propped up, her posture relaxed and natural, giving a realistic sense of being completely drained. She wears an oversized, dark charcoal gray off-the-shoulder long-sleeved sweatshirt, one side slipping down to reveal one shoulder and collarbone, the overall silhouette loose. In the foreground is a round table with a plain mug, two small paper wrappers or sticky notes, and a small rectangular chocolate. On a small table to the left of the room sits a simple vase with a few green leaves. A small note hangs on the wall, reading "Otsukarewatashi" (Thank you for your hard work, myself). A speech bubble near her head reads "Nanmoshitakuna~i" (I don't want to do anything). The composition is vertical and intimate, resembling a casual illustration of daily life or an emotional sketch. Ample white space, a minimalist background, and understated home details create an atmosphere of calm, drowsy, and emotionally exhausted.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张柔和、低饱和度的单色动漫风格插画，描绘了一位在安静房间内慵懒休憩的疲惫年轻女性。画作采用细腻的草图线条和暖灰米色调的平涂阴影。她留着深棕色近乎黑色的长发，发丝凌乱，留着柔软的刘海，皮肤白皙，半睁的眼睛流露出疲惫感。她的表情显得心力交瘁、心不在焉，微微嘟着嘴，透出一种情感上的疲惫。她侧身瘫坐在椅子或沙发上，单手托腮，肘部支撑，姿态松弛自然，给人一种“全身力气都被抽干”的真实感。她穿着一件超大款深炭灰色露肩长袖卫衣，卫衣一侧滑落，露出单侧肩膀和锁骨，整体轮廓宽松。前景是一张圆桌，上面放着一个素色马克杯、2 个小纸包装或便签，以及 1 小块长方形巧克力。房间左侧的小桌面上摆放着一个简单的花瓶，插着几枝绿叶。墙上挂着一张小纸条，写着“おつかれわたし”（辛苦了，我自己）。她头顶附近的对话框写着“なんもしたくな〜い”（什么都不想做）。构图垂直且亲密，宛如随性的生活插画或情绪素描，留白充裕，背景极简，居家细节低调，营造出一种平静、困倦且情感耗竭的氛围。

templates.title: Playful Pastel Portrait Collage

titleLocalized.zh: 童趣粉彩肖像拼贴

templates.prompt: A dreamlike mixed-media pastel illustration, drawn on white textured paper with a distinct central vertical crease, exhibits a naive and playful crayon and oil pastel style. The portrait of a girl, partially obscured, is positioned slightly to the left of center. A large, softly-edged rectangular blur obscures the center of the image from her forehead to her chest, revealing only partial facial features. Visible details include dark blue-black hair, a warm brown eye, parts of her cheek and neck, and a cream or pale yellow garment. Loose, doodle-like plant lines and abstract brushstrokes in teal, olive green, black, white, ochre, and peach are arranged around the image. The image is scattered with hand-drawn Japanese hiragana and numbers, like a child's doodles on paper: in the upper left corner are orange "新" (shin) and "し" (shi); in the upper right corner are vertically stacked mustard-colored and dark olive-colored "お" (o), "ば" (ba), and "ら" (ra); in the center right is a small turquoise flag shape; in the center right lower is an orange sun symbol; in the lower right corner is brown text resembling numbers, "11.6"; and in the lower left corner is an orange open book icon. Several diagonal crayon strokes in gold and white are added behind and around the figures. Maintaining an ethereal, imperfect, expressive, and slightly melancholic composition, the image showcases the rough, grainy paint, visible paper texture, and soft earth tones, creating an atmosphere that blends a child's memory drawing with contemporary art illustration.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅梦幻般的混合媒介粉彩插画，绘制在带有明显中心垂直折痕的白色纹理纸上，呈现出天真烂漫的蜡笔与油画棒风格。画面中，一位女孩的半遮面肖像位于中心偏左位置，由于一个巨大的柔边矩形模糊区域遮挡了从额头到胸部的画面中心，仅露出部分面部特征。可见的细节包括深青黑色头发、一只温暖的棕色眼睛、部分脸颊和颈部，以及一件奶油色或浅黄色的服装。周围环绕着松散的涂鸦植物线条和青绿色、橄榄绿、黑色、白色、赭色及桃色的抽象笔触。画面中散布着手绘的日语平假名和数字，如同儿童在纸上的涂鸦：左上角有橙色的「新」和「し」，右上角垂直堆叠着芥末色和深橄榄色的「お」「ば」「ら」，中右侧有一个小小的青绿色旗帜形状，中右下方有一个橙色太阳符号，右下角有棕色的类似数字的文本「11.6」，左下角有一个橙色的翻开书本图标。在人物背后和周围添加几道金黄色与白色的斜向蜡笔扫痕。保持构图空灵、不完美、富有表现力且略带忧郁感，展现出粗糙的颗粒感颜料、可见的纸张纹理、柔和的大地色调，营造出一种儿童记忆画作与当代艺术插画相结合的氛围。

templates.title: Sketch of a woman relaxing on a sofa

titleLocalized.zh: 沙发上放松的女性素描

templates.prompt: A soft, low-saturation anime-style interior illustration depicts a young woman reclining casually on a sofa. She has {argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown"} Her long hair was slightly disheveled, with a few strands falling over her shoulders. She wore an oversized, charcoal-gray off-the-shoulder knit sweater, which slipped down to reveal one shoulder, paired with loose-fitting light beige sweatpants and soft socks. Her posture was casual and languid, her body curled up on the sofa, one elbow resting on a cushion, her hand supporting her cheek, and her legs bent to one side. Her expression appeared tired, quiet, and introspective, carrying a sense of emotional exhaustion, yet also a feeling of comfort. The scene was shot from sofa height in a medium-shot, full-body composition. The room is tranquil and minimalist, furnished with a sofa, three large cushions, and a round wooden coffee table in the foreground. On the table sits a ceramic mug with a simple cat drawing and the handwritten word "neko," a smartphone lying flat, and a notebook or paperback with tiny Japanese characters on the cover. A small note with the words "nantokanaruru yo" (I love you) is pasted on the wall, and a leaf extends into the upper right corner of the frame. The room employs desaturated warm gray and beige tones, using delicate pencil lines, light watercolor washes, and subtle textures reminiscent of sketch paper to create a melancholic, everyday atmosphere. The composition remains ethereal, intimate, and understated, like a quiet illustration in a book of everyday art.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张柔和、低饱和度的动漫风格室内插画，描绘了一位年轻女性以放松、随意的姿态侧卧在沙发上。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 的长发，发丝略显凌乱，几缕发丝垂落在肩头。她穿着一件炭灰色的超大号露肩针织毛衣，毛衣滑落露出单侧肩膀，下身搭配宽松的浅米色运动裤和柔软的袜子。她的姿势随意而慵懒，身体蜷缩在沙发上，一只手肘撑在靠垫上，手掌托着脸颊，双腿向一侧折叠。她露出的表情应显得疲惫、安静、内省，带着一种情感上的疲惫感，却又感到舒适。场景采用沙发高度的正面中景全身构图。房间宁静简约，配有 1 张沙发、3 个大靠垫、前景中 1 张圆形木制咖啡桌；桌上放着 1 个陶瓷马克杯，杯上有简单的猫咪涂鸦和手写文字“ねこ”，1 部平放的智能手机，以及 1 本封面上写有细小日语字迹的笔记本或平装书；墙上贴着 1 张写有“なんとかなるよ”的小纸条，右上角有一枝叶片伸入画面。采用去饱和的暖灰与米色调，运用细腻的铅笔线条、轻盈的水彩晕染、类似素描纸的微妙纹理，营造出一种伤感的日常氛围。构图保持空灵、亲密且低调，如同生活艺术画册中安静的插画。

templates.title: Illustration of a woman relaxing on a sofa

titleLocalized.zh: 沙发上放松的女性插画

templates.prompt: A soft, low-saturation anime-style illustration depicts a young woman lounging on a light-colored sofa in a quiet living room. She has long, slightly disheveled, dark brown, wet hair that falls loosely over her shoulders and chest, and wears a small earring in one ear. Her posture is relaxed yet slightly weary, her head tilted back, her hand supporting her cheek. Her face is partially obscured by a centrally located, grayish-brown square panel. She wears a loose, off-the-shoulder white blouse that has slipped down to reveal a thin black camisole, and her legs are casually curled up on the sofa. Her posture should appear soft and natural, with a sense of relaxation. Two tabletop items are placed in the foreground: a black mug and a thick book or binder stacked on the edge of a small table. A potted plant is visible on the left side of the background, and a semi-transparent light-colored curtain hangs behind the sofa. The overall design uses soft tones of warm gray, cream, off-white, charcoal gray, and light brown, combined with sketch-like lines, delicate watercolor washes, and transparent white space to create a tranquil and intimate atmosphere, much like a fashion lifestyle editorial illustration.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅柔和、低饱和度的动漫风格插画，描绘了一位年轻女性在安静的室内客厅里，慵懒地躺在浅色沙发上的竖构图画面。她留着长长的深棕色湿发，略显凌乱，发丝松散地垂在肩头和胸前，一只耳朵上戴着小耳环。她姿态放松且略显疲惫，头部倾斜，手托着脸颊。她的面部被一个位于中心位置、呈灰褐色的方形遮挡块遮住。她穿着一件宽松的露肩白衬衫，衬衫滑落至身体下方，露出一条细细的黑色吊带，双腿随意地蜷缩在沙发上。她的姿态应显得柔软自然，带有一种松弛感。前景放置 2 件桌面物品：1 个黑色马克杯和 1 本叠放在小桌边缘的厚书或活页夹。背景左侧包含 1 盆绿植，沙发后方挂着半透明的浅色窗帘。整体采用暖灰、奶油色、米白色、灰炭色和浅褐色的柔和色调，结合素描般的线条、细腻的水彩晕染、通透的留白，营造出如同时尚生活方式编辑插画般宁静而亲密的氛围。

templates.title: Japanese Halloween horror-themed logo

titleLocalized.zh: 日式万圣节惊悚主题 Logo

templates.prompt: A whimsical Japanese-style horror title logo, placed against a clean white background and centered. The main body consists of bold, rounded, handwritten-style hiragana characters.{argument name="main text" default="はるか"} The white lettering features a cool, pale blue shadow, a delicate worn texture, and a deep navy blue outline with a luminous blue halo. The text is surrounded by a Halloween-themed atmosphere: a cute white ghost floats in the upper left corner, a red-orange paper lantern with black Chinese characters hangs to the left, a large magnifying glass overlaps in the lower right corner, and a silhouette of a haunted castle with three towers and warm, glowing windows is set in the background. A traditional Japanese stone lantern with glowing windows is added to the right, and two blue will-o'-the-wisp torches are placed on the far right. Several black bat silhouettes flutter around the castle, accompanied by a deep indigo mist, electric blue flames, and an ink-drop-like shadow base below the logo. The logo uses a vibrant neon color scheme of midnight blue, cyan halo, white, and orange accents, presenting a refined sticker-style game logo illustration style with sharp edges, soft lighting, and a combination of fantastical horror and high contrast.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个充满趣味的日式惊悚标题 Logo，置于干净的白色背景上，采用居中构图。主体为粗体圆润手写风格的平假名文字 {argument name="main text" default="はるか"}，白色字体带有冰冷的淡蓝色阴影、细腻的磨损纹理，以及深海军蓝色的粗轮廓和发光的蓝色光晕。文字周围环绕着万圣节妖怪氛围：文字左上方漂浮着 1 个可爱的白色幽灵，左侧悬挂着 1 个印有黑色汉字的红橙色纸灯笼，文字右下方重叠着 1 个大型放大镜，背景中设有 1 座带有 3 座高塔和温暖发光窗户的闹鬼城堡剪影。右侧添加 1 个带有发光窗户的传统日式石灯笼，最右侧放置 2 个蓝色鬼火火把，城堡周围飞舞着几只黑色蝙蝠剪影，伴有深靛色薄雾、电蓝色火焰，以及 Logo 下方墨水滴落般的阴影基底。采用午夜蓝、青色光晕、白色和橙色点缀的鲜艳霓虹配色，呈现出精致的贴纸式游戏 Logo 插画风格，边缘清晰，光影柔和，兼具奇幻恐怖氛围与高对比度。

templates.title: Japanese-style facial beauty report layout

titleLocalized.zh: 日式面部美容报告排版

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0, the uploaded portrait is transformed into a clean, sophisticated Japanese aesthetic analysis panel, titled "..."{argument name="headline text" default="Facial Beauty Report"} Retain the same photo as the source image, including facial blurring/masking effects, and place it in a rounded-corner card in the upper right corner. Format the output as a white edited report page with a thin gray border, black typography, and a luxurious beauty consultation layout. Add the following 8 report sections: 1) Top header, including small English text "FACIAL BEAUTY REPORT ✦", large Japanese title, and subtitle "あなたらしさを生かし, よりCharming になるためのANALYSIS レポート"; 2) An OVERVIEW box, listing 5 lines of content: Age (estimated) 20–24 years old, gender female, face shape ややovate, パーソナル impression clean feeling・close しみやすい・soft らかい, analysis date 2024.05.24; 3) A total score box labeled "Couple Attractiveness", containing a display{argument name="total score" default="82"} A circular dashboard with a 100/100 rating, and a brief rating guide: 50 = average / 70 = good / 85 = very good / 90+ = excellent; 4) A rating box containing 7 items: left-right symmetry 84/100, facial proportions 83/100, bone structure/rim 80/100, skin texture 85/100, eye attractiveness 85/100, nose shape 78/100, mouth attractiveness 81/100, overall harmony 83/100; 5) A FACIAL CONTOUR panel displaying a simplified line drawing of the face, with blurred facial areas obscured and measurement guidelines marked, with vertical markings of 1/3, 1/3, 1/3, marked 5 times at the bottom 1/5; 6) a detailed analysis section, containing 8 lines of content corresponding to the above indicators and a brief Japanese explanation; 7) a strengths box titled Strong み (あなたのCharm ポイント), containing 3 items with icons: クリアでIMpression of な目元,なめらかなsarcoplasm, バランスの取れた锟斤拷; 8) An improvement suggestion box titled Improvement of できるPoints (よりCharmを高めるために), containing 3 Items with icons: 目の下のクマ, noseのthree-dimensional feeling, lipのbloody feeling; 9) A line of final suggestions, titled body だしなみ・スタイル improvement proposal, including 4 The columns are labeled as Hearstair, Make, Skincaya, and Lifestair, each accompanied by a simple black line icon and a brief Japanese suggestion. Add a footer text line in the bottom right corner:{argument name="footer text" default="BEAUTY IS BALANCE."} Overall style: minimalist clinic report, balanced grid layout, soft shadows, rounded corner panels, black and gray tones only, highly readable Japanese magazine design.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用 REFERENCE_0，将上传的肖像转换为简洁、高级的日式美学分析面板，标题为 {argument name="headline text" default="顔立ち美容レポート"}。保留与源图像相同的照片，包括面部模糊/遮挡效果，并将其放置在右上角的圆角卡片中。将输出格式化为带有细灰色边框、黑色排版和奢华美容咨询布局的白色编辑报告页面。添加以下 8 个报告部分：1) 顶部页眉，包含小号英文文本“FACIAL BEAUTY REPORT ✦”、大号日文标题以及副标题“あなたらしさを活かし、より魅力的になるための分析レポート”；2) 一个 OVERVIEW 框，列出 5 行内容：年齢（推定） 20–24歳, 性別 女性, 顔の形 やや卵型, パーソナル印象 清潔感・親しみやすい・柔らかい, 分析日 2024.05.24；3) 一个标注为 総合魅力度スコア 的总分框，包含一个显示 {argument name="total score" default="82"}/100 的圆形仪表盘，以及一个简短的评分指南：50=平均的 / 70=良い / 85=非常に良い / 90+=優秀；4) 一个包含 7 个项目评分的指标框：左右対称性 84/100, 顔の比率（プロポーション） 83/100, 骨格・輪郭 80/100, 肌質 85/100, 目の魅力 85/100, 鼻のバランス 78/100, 口元の魅力 81/100, 全体の調和 83/100；5) 一个 FACIAL CONTOUR（シンプルライン図）面板，展示简化的线稿面部图，模糊的面部区域被遮盖，并标注测量指南，垂直方向标记为 1/3, 1/3, 1/3，底部重复标记 5 次 1/5；6) 一个 詳細分析 部分，包含与上述指标对应的 8 行内容及简短的日文解释说明；7) 一个标题为 強み（あなたの魅力ポイント） 的优势框，包含 3 个带图标的项目：クリアで印象的な目元, なめらかな肌質, バランスの取れた輪郭；8) 一个标题为 改善できる点（より魅力を高めるために） 的改进建议框，包含 3 个带图标的项目：目の下のクマ, 鼻の立体感, 唇の血色感；9) 一行最终建议，标题为 身だしなみ・スタイル改善提案，包含 4 列，分别标注为 ヘアスタイル, メイク, スキンケア, ライフスタイル，每列配有一个简单的黑色线条图标和简短的日文建议。在右下角添加一行页脚文本：{argument name="footer text" default="BEAUTY IS BALANCE."}。整体风格：极简诊所报告、平衡的网格布局、柔和阴影、圆角面板、仅限黑灰色调、高可读性的日式杂志设计。

templates.title: Transform comic book panels into apocalyptic mecha posters

titleLocalized.zh: 将漫画分镜转化为末日机甲海报

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference images, recreate the original manga storyboard into a highly dramatic anime movie poster. Retain the original two characters, their relative positions, and the original Japanese text in the dialogue boxes, but remove the manga borders and speech bubbles. Rearrange the text into two large, vertically aligned text blocks floating in the sky: the right side reads "戦争ならだいじょうぶ。 もうすぐ终わります。"; the left side reads "地は焼かれ涙と悲鸣は新たなる争いの狼烟となるの。". Transform the simple black and white line drawings into a richly detailed illustration, presenting realistic light and shadow, weathered textures, and the atmosphere of a post-apocalyptic battlefield at dusk. Replace the original simple background with a massive Gundam-style mecha standing behind the character. The mecha is covered in sharp, wing-like protrusions, shimmering with magenta energy cracks, surrounded by smoke, embers, ruins, and gloomy clouds. Upgrade the boy to a full-color anime version, wearing a dark military uniform with red trim, smiling and raising one hand. Upgrade the cat-mask character to a sinister yet expressive full-color image, with a shattered white armor-like mask, pale blue eyes, a wide grin, a dark hooded cloak, and a small bell around his neck. Add a red battle flag to the lower left background. The overall style should evoke an epic war poster feel, using a low-angle composition, ultra-high detail, high contrast, and a rugged, somber, and cinematic quality.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图，将原始漫画分镜重制为极具戏剧张力的动漫电影海报。保留原有的 2 个角色、他们的相对位置以及对话框中的日语原文，但需移除漫画边框和对话气泡，并将文字重新排版为悬浮在天空中的 2 个大型竖排文本块：右侧为「戦争なら だいじょうぶ。 もうすぐ 終わります。」；左侧为「地は焼かれ 涙と悲鳴は 新たなる争いの 狼煙となるの。」。将简单的黑白线条画转化为细节丰富的绘图场景，呈现逼真的光影、风化质感以及黄昏时分的末日战场氛围。将原本简洁的背景替换为矗立在角色身后、体型巨大的高达风格机甲，机甲覆盖着锋利的翼状突起，闪烁着洋红色的能量裂纹，周围环绕着烟雾、余烬、废墟残骸以及阴沉的云层。将男孩升级为全彩动漫版本，身着带有红色饰边的深色军装，保持微笑并举起一只手。将猫型面具角色升级为既阴森又富有表现力的全彩形象，面部带有碎裂的白色盔甲状面具，双眼泛着淡蓝色的光，咧嘴大笑，身披深色连帽斗篷，颈部挂着一个小铃铛。在左下角背景处添加一面红色战旗。整体风格需呈现史诗级战争海报感，采用低角度构图，超高细节，高对比度，粗犷、阴郁且具有电影质感。

templates.title: Dark fantasy fusion mech lineup

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑奇幻合体机甲阵容

templates.prompt: Against a backdrop of a smoke-filled studio, a dramatic lineup of dark fantasy mechs is presented, rendered with ultra-refined concept art and featuring wide-angle, cinematic compositions. The image precisely showcases six malevolent biomechanical entities, standing side-by-side on a mirror-like surface. All are designed as components or forms of combined robot suits. The overall design language evokes Gothic, hellish, and Baroque styles: black steel materials, dark silver armor, jagged edges, thorny protrusions, skeletal filigree, and a red-glowing core and eyes, accented with delicate white metallic highlights and traces of deep red energy. The overall atmosphere is eerie, grand, and apocalyptic. From left to right: First, a towering humanoid mech, the largest character in the lineup, with a crown-like halo behind its head, massive, layered black wings or blade-like wings drooping downwards, a bright core embedded in the center of its ornate chest armor, asymmetrically inlaid with multiple red glowing spheres, and a long staff or spear held diagonally in its hand. Second, a tall, slender angel-demon type humanoid mech with a long body, a spiked antler crown, a narrow waist, blade-like suspension armor plates, and glowing red shoulder nodes, standing tall and imposing. Third, a quadrupedal beast-type unit, crouching low and extremely aggressive, resembling a demonic wolf or a dragon-like hound, covered in curved blade-like armor and long horns extending backward, its eyes glowing red, and its back arched. Fourth, a heavy quadrupedal siege unit, even more robust and heavily armored, with a forward-protruding head assembly and two large, circular, shield-like wheel-like structures on either side, covered with radiating spikes, one of which has a glowing red core embedded in its center. Fifth, a centaur or upright beast-type warrior mech with long legs, layered armor, a horned head, and sharp bird-dragon features, more slender than the heavy unit but still imposing, with red lights on its chest and head. Sixth, a symmetrical winged emblem unit, resembling more of a mechanical phoenix emblem than a humanoid body, with two broad metal wings spreading outwards from a central halo. A conical component hangs from its tail, inlaid with three clearly visible red gem-like cores. The color scheme remains almost monochromatic, retaining only the luminous red. Emphasis is placed on sharp contours, intricate carvings, layered armor plates, and detailed cable and skeletal mechanical mechanisms. Smoke drifts behind the figure, and faint reflections are cast beneath its feet. The image should present…{argument name="theme" default="Dark Combination Robot"} The artwork boasts a high-quality concept art style, featuring ultra-detailed dark fantasy sci-fi illustrations. It employs a panoramic aspect ratio, a frontal view of the entire scene, and high-contrast lighting to highlight the metallic edges against a deep black background.

promptLocalized.zh:
在黑色烟雾缭绕的摄影棚背景下，呈现出一组极具戏剧性的暗黑奇幻机甲阵容，采用超精细概念艺术渲染，并具备宽幅电影级构图。画面中精确展示了 6 个邪恶的生物机械体，它们并排站立在光亮如镜的地面上，所有设计均为合体机器人套装的部件或形态。整体设计语言呈现出哥特式、地狱风和巴洛克风格：黑钢材质、暗银色装甲、锯齿边缘、荆棘状突起、骨架花丝，以及散发红色光芒的核心与双眼，并点缀着细腻的白金属高光和丝丝深红能量痕迹。整体氛围阴森、宏伟且充满末日感。

从左至右依次为：第一，一座高耸的人形霸主机甲，是阵容中体型最大的角色，头后带有皇冠状光环，巨大的层叠黑色羽翼或刃状翅膀向下垂落，华丽的胸甲中央镶嵌着明亮的核心，不对称地嵌入了多个红色发光球体，手中斜持一根长杖或长矛。第二，一台高挑纤细的天使恶魔型人形机甲，拥有修长的躯体、尖刺状鹿角头冠、窄腰、刃状悬挂装甲板以及发红光的肩部节点，姿态挺拔且威严。第三，一台四足兽型单位，低伏且极具侵略性，宛如恶魔狼或龙形猎犬，覆盖着弯曲的刃状装甲和向后延伸的长角，双眼散发红光，背部轮廓呈拱形。第四，一台重型四足攻城单位，体型更魁梧且装甲厚重，头部组件前伸，两侧安装有两个巨大的圆形盾状轮式结构，布满放射状尖刺，其中一个轮子中心嵌有发红光的核心。第五，一台半人马或直立兽型战士机甲，拥有长腿、层叠装甲、带角头部以及锐利的鸟龙特征，比重型单位更纤细但依然气势逼人，胸部和头部带有红色灯光。第六，一台对称的翼状徽章单位，看起来更像机械凤凰纹章而非人形躯体，两片宽大的金属翅膀围绕中央光环向外展开，尾部悬挂着锥形部件，上面镶嵌着 3 颗清晰可见的红色宝石状核心。

色调保持近乎单色，仅保留发光的红色。强调锋利的轮廓、复杂的雕刻、层叠的装甲板、线缆和骨架机械细节，人物身后飘散着烟雾，脚下映出淡淡的倒影。画面应呈现出 {argument name="theme" default="暗黑合体机器人"} 的高级概念图质感，风格为超精细暗黑奇幻科幻插画。采用全景长宽比、正面阵容展示，并运用高对比度照明，在深邃的黑色背景下凸显金属边缘。

templates.prompt: Create a minimalist e-commerce mockup with a light gray background, using a simple two-image contrast layout. Place a small, rounded-corner reference image in the upper right corner, showing the back of a white, fluffy dog ​​standing on soft light blue fabric, wearing a beige knitted pet sweater with light blue trim. The sweater features a large cartoon dog face patch in brown, black, and white, along with the word "Smile" in red cursive, a small red cherry, a blue star, and a yellow crescent moon. Below the reference image, place a rounded light gray text bubble containing the following Japanese text in black sans-serif font: “像内のペットを猫に差し替え、元の像と同じ衣装を着せた状态にする。猫は面对または侧が見える向きで、完全がはっきり見えるようにする。” (Replace the pet in the image with a cat and dress it in the same clothing as in the original image. The cat should be facing forward or to the side, with its entire body clearly visible.) In the lower left corner, place a large, rounded image with a subtle dark border, showing a gray tabby white cat standing against the same soft light blue fabric background. The cat's body is slightly turned to the left, but it looks directly at the camera. Its ears are erect, and its large, round eyes are bright and alert. Its chest and limbs are white, while its back and tail have gray stripes. Its expression is calm yet alert. The cat wears a matching beige knitted pet sweater with light blue ribbed trim at the collar, cuffs, and hem, fitting its body perfectly. The sweater's pattern matches the reference image: red cursive "Smile," cherry blossoms, blue stars, a yellow crescent moon, and a large textured cartoon dog face patch on the side. The lighting is soft and even, giving the product photo a studio-quality feel, with realistic fabric texture, minimalist shadows, and an overall style that aligns with the professional aesthetics of a pet clothing catalog.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个背景为浅灰色的简洁电商效果图，采用简单的双图对比布局。在右上角放置 1 张圆角小尺寸参考图，展示一只白色毛茸茸的狗背影，它站在柔软的浅蓝色布料上，穿着一件带有浅蓝色滚边的米色针织宠物毛衣。毛衣上有一个棕、黑、白三色的大型卡通狗脸贴布，以及红色的草书单词“Smile”、一颗红色小樱桃、一颗蓝色星星和一轮黄色新月。在该参考图下方，放置 1 个圆角浅灰色文本气泡，内含黑色无衬线字体日语说明：“画像内のペットを猫に差し替え、元の画像と同じ衣装を着せた状態にする。猫は正面または側面が見える向きで、全身がはっきり見えるようにする。”（将图片中的宠物替换为猫，并让其穿上与原图相同的服装。猫应面向正面或侧面，全身清晰可见。）在左下角放置 1 张带有细微深色边框的圆角大图，展示一只全身灰虎斑白猫站在同样的柔软浅蓝色布料背景上。猫咪身体略向左侧，但直视镜头，耳朵竖立，圆眼睛大而有神，胸部和四肢为白色，背部和尾巴有灰色条纹，神态平静且机警。猫咪穿着同样的米色针织宠物毛衣，领口、袖口和下摆处有浅蓝色罗纹滚边，贴合身形。毛衣图案与参考图一致：红色的草书“Smile”文字、樱桃图案、蓝色星星、黄色新月，以及侧面带有纹理的大型卡通狗脸贴布。光线柔和且均匀，呈现出网店摄影棚产品照的质感，具有逼真的布料纹理、极简的阴影，整体风格符合宠物服装目录的专业审美。

templates.title: The bewildered elf girl at her desk

titleLocalized.zh: 书桌前困惑的精灵少女

templates.prompt: A cute pastel anime illustration depicts a young, fairy-like female news anchor or office worker, sitting at her desk typing on a mechanical keyboard in a cozy bedroom workspace. The image is presented from a front-side perspective, with a large black computer monitor partially obscuring her figure in the foreground to the left. She has long, wavy hair, and her hair color is {argument name="hair color" default="orange color"} She has glossy, pointed elf ears and a small red flower hair clip on her right side. She wears a light blue pajama-style shirt with red heart patterns, delicate white lace trim at the collar, and a sparkling red bow around her neck. Her hands are on the keyboard, her nails painted a soft pink, and she sits in a round pink office chair. Above her head is a speech bubble with a large question mark inside, suggesting she's feeling confused while working at the computer. The room has a soft, bright, and girlish atmosphere, using light pink and cream tones with a shallow depth of field and delicate lines. The background includes: a framed picture on the wall with pink animals and heart patterns; a small potted plant near the left; a plush toy on the shelf behind her; and two sticky notes on the upper right wall, one with a plus sign and the other with {argument name="note text" default="がんばろう!"} A blue cat figurine or plush toy on the right shelf; a small potted plant on the right; four pastel binders or books on the bottom right shelf; and a white mug with a pink heart on the bottom right table. The computer monitor should have a subtle blue glowing heart icon on the back, and the keyboard should have RGB backlighting. Clean and refined cel-shaded anime style, high detail, soft ambient lighting, a warm gaming table atmosphere, cute pastel decorations, and 4K illustrations.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张可爱的粉彩动漫插画，描绘了一位年轻的精灵少女主播或上班族，坐在书桌前使用机械键盘打字，背景是温馨的卧室工作区。画面采用前侧方视角，左前方有一个巨大的黑色电脑显示器，部分遮挡了她的身体。她留着长长的波浪卷发，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="橙色"}，带有光泽感，长着尖尖的精灵耳朵，右侧别着一个小红花发夹。她穿着一件浅蓝色睡衣风格的衬衫，上面印有红色心形图案，领口带有非常精致的白色蕾丝花边，颈部系着一个闪亮的红色蝴蝶结。她的双手放在键盘上，指甲涂成柔和的粉色，坐在圆形的粉色办公椅上。她头顶上方有一个对话气泡，里面有一个大大的问号，暗示她在电脑前工作时感到困惑。房间氛围柔和、明亮且充满少女感，采用浅粉色和奶油色的色调，具有浅景深效果和细腻的线条。背景包括：1 幅挂在墙上的相框，画着粉色动物和心形图案；1 盆靠近左侧的小盆栽；1 个摆在她身后架子上的毛绒玩具；2 张贴在右上角墙上的便签，一张画着加号，另一张写着 {argument name="note text" default="がんばろう!"}；1 个放在右侧架子上的蓝色猫咪手办或毛绒玩具；1 盆放在右侧的小盆栽；4 个放在右下角架子上的粉彩活页夹或书籍；以及 1 个放在右下角桌面上、印有粉色心形的白色马克杯。电脑显示器背面应有一个微妙的蓝色发光心形图标，键盘应带有 RGB 灯光。干净精致的赛璐珞动漫风格，高细节，柔和的环境光，温馨的游戏桌氛围，粉彩可爱风装饰，4k 插画。

promptLocalized.zh: 一张明亮的动漫奇幻插画，描绘了一位 {argument name="animal mascot" default="虾夷飞鼠少女"} 在阳光明媚的夏日翱翔于 {argument name="city" default="札幌"} 上空。视角采用震撼的航拍角度，俯瞰着长长的林荫大道和公园，公园内有喷泉、人群、花坛，远方矗立着红色的札幌电视塔。角色是一位充满灵气的年轻兽耳少女，长着 2 只毛茸茸的松鼠耳朵、1 条巨大的蓬松尾巴，以及随风飘动的长长的 {argument name="hair color" default="银金色"} 秀发。她以对角线姿态横跨画面，仿佛在天空中滑翔或漂浮，双臂向两侧伸展。她身着一套精致且闪烁着半透明光泽的 {argument name="outfit color" default="虹彩浅白色"} 服装：一件镶嵌宝石的奇幻连衣裙，配有薄纱般的斗篷、精致的肩带、荷叶边短裤、亮面过膝袜、华丽的手镯、宝石装饰和轻便的系带鞋。强调整体高度反光的肥皂泡美学：她周围漂浮着 18 个大小不一的泡泡，每一个都带有彩虹般的虹彩、闪烁的高光和玻璃般的反射，场景中还散布着细小的星光闪烁。织物应呈现出珠光感，仿佛由泡泡制成，带有强烈的棱镜光泽、闪粉以及精致的 gpt-image-2 动漫质感。明亮饱和的蓝天、蓬松的白云、清澈的阳光、细致的城市天际线、郁郁葱葱的绿树，以及一种充满魔力的轻盈动感与自由感。整体画面令人眼花缭乱、华丽、奇幻且充满庆典氛围，构图以飞行的角色为中心，在泡泡与光影的迸发中穿过城市景观。

She is a beautiful young knight princess with extremely long, flowing twin tails and hair of {argument name="hair color" default="Soft pink"} Her hair flowed outwards as if blown by a magical wind, creating bright bands of light. She wore magnificent white and deep sapphire blue ceremonial armor, adorned with luxurious gold filigree, a fitted breastplate, layered shoulder armor, long armor sleeves, a blue skirt with gold trim, white knee-high stockings with lace trim, and exquisite gold knee and shin guards. The fabric moves naturally, creating a solemn, sacred, and fantastical atmosphere. It emphasizes cinematic composition, a heroic aura, and stunning details in light and shadow.

titleLocalized.zh: 跪姿蓝甲骑士

templates.prompt: A highly dramatic vertical fantasy anime illustration depicts a female knight kneeling sideways, slightly to the right, her hands gripping a massive, upright greatsword, as if in prayer or displaying solemn resolve. She possesses long, flowing hair that reaches the ground, the color of which is {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} The fabric was smooth and glossy. Her face was mostly obscured by the side profile and her bowed head, creating a quiet, introspective atmosphere. She wore {argument name="armor color" default="Deep cobalt blue"} Her streamlined, reflective metallic armor, polished to a gleaming shine, features intricately sculpted shoulder armor, long metal gauntlets, a form-fitting breastplate with side cutouts, segmented waist armor, and over-the-knee metallic boots. She wears a matching blue metallic pleated skirt. Her slender and elegant figure embodies anime aesthetics. A massive greatsword, crafted from dark steel, boasts a broad blade and ornate hilt, extending vertically from the left side of the frame beyond the frame. She kneels on one knee, her torso upright, her head slightly bowed towards the sword, conveying a sense of awe, mourning, or resolute determination. The background is set in an abandoned stone corridor or ancient city passageway, flanked by towering, blurred walls, accompanied by soft mist, floating dust, and cool blue-white backlighting cascading from above and behind, outlining the contours of her hair and armor. The visual details include tiny fragments on the ground, cinematic depth of field, high-contrast reflections, an ethereal atmosphere, ultra-fine surface textures, and polished metallic shadows.{argument name="illustration style" default="High-detail cinematic-quality key visual images for animation"} A sophisticated, dark fantasy style.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的竖构图奇幻动漫插画，描绘了一位侧身跪姿的女骑士，人物略微偏右，双手握着一把巨大的直立巨剑，仿佛在祈祷或展现庄严的决心。她拥有一头长及地面的飘逸长发，颜色为 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色"}，质感顺滑且富有光泽。她的面部因侧面角度和低头姿态而大部分被遮挡，营造出一种安静、内省的氛围。她身穿 {argument name="armor color" default="深钴蓝色"} 的流线型反光金属铠甲，打磨得光亮如新，带有高光质感，包括雕刻精美的肩甲、长款金属护手、带有侧身镂空设计的贴身胸甲、分段式腰甲以及过膝金属长靴。下装为同色系的蓝色金属百褶短裙。她的体态纤细优雅，符合动漫美学风格。巨剑高大，由深色钢铁打造，拥有宽阔的剑身和华丽的护手，从画面左侧地面垂直延伸至画框之外。她呈单膝跪地姿态，躯干挺直，头部微微向剑身低垂，传达出敬畏、哀悼或坚定的情绪。背景设定在废弃的石质走廊或古城通道中，两侧是高耸模糊的墙壁，伴有柔和的雾气、漂浮的尘埃，以及从上方和后方倾泻而下的冷蓝白色背光，在她的发丝和铠甲边缘勾勒出轮廓光。画面细节包括地面细微的碎片、电影级的景深效果、高对比度的反光、空灵的氛围、超精细的表面纹理、抛光金属阴影，以及 {argument name="illustration style" default="高细节电影级动漫关键视觉图"} 风格的高级英雄暗黑奇幻氛围。

templates.title: Anime-style girl and zebra on the grassland

titleLocalized.zh: 身处草原的动漫风少女与花斑马

templates.prompt: A beautifully crafted full-body illustration in anime style, depicting a {argument name="character type" default="Young Native American women"} Standing on the sun-drenched grassland, her demeanor is calm and dignified, presenting a visually appealing image suitable for all ages (SFW). She kept {argument name="hair color" default="black"} She has shoulder-length, softly layered hair with side-swept bangs, adorned with two feather ornaments and several beaded hair ties in red, blue, and white. She wears a traditional-style tan deerskin dress with three long tassels at the chest, waist, and hem. The dress features four prominent geometric beaded embellishments: a patterned trim at the neckline, a wide beaded belt, beaded thigh straps at the hem, and matching beaded wristbands. She also wears layered beaded necklaces, including a large round pendant and two dangling feather beaded necklaces. Behind her to the right stands a tan and white zebra, clearly visible from head to legs, looking directly at the viewer. The scene is set in an open meadow and wildflower field, with rolling hills in the distance, under a clear blue sky dotted with white clouds. Bathed in warm afternoon sunlight, her hair and tassels sway gently in the breeze, showcasing the delicate texture of the fabric, natural skin shadows, and cinematic composition. The image should be elegant, dignified, and picturesque, with vibrant colors, rich details, clean lines, a soft rendering style, and a vertical composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的动漫风格全身插画，描绘了一位 {argument name="character type" default="年轻的美国原住民女性"} 站在阳光明媚的草原上，气质沉稳庄重，呈现全年龄段（SFW）视觉效果。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"} 的齐肩发，发丝层次柔和，带有侧刘海，装饰着 2 枚羽毛饰品和几根红、蓝、白三色的串珠发绳。她身穿传统风格的棕褐色鹿皮裙，在胸前、腰间和裙摆处有 3 处长流苏装饰。裙装包含 4 处明显的几何串珠点缀：领口花纹镶边、宽串珠腰带、裙摆下方的串珠大腿带以及配套的串珠腕带。她还佩戴着叠戴的串珠项链，包括 1 枚大型圆形吊坠和 2 条垂下的羽毛串珠项链。在她右后方站着 1 匹棕白相间的花斑马，从头部到腿部清晰可见，正看向观者。场景设定在开阔的草地和野花丛中，远处有连绵的丘陵，天空湛蓝，点缀着朵朵白云。采用温暖的午后阳光，发丝和流苏在微风中轻拂，展现细腻的织物纹理、自然的皮肤阴影和电影级的构图。画面应优雅、庄重且如画般美丽，色彩鲜艳，细节丰富，线条干净，渲染风格柔和，采用竖构图。

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫天空幻想主视觉图

templates.prompt: A beautifully crafted anime fantasy key visual, employing a wide-format cinematic composition. The right side of the image showcases a serene young female protagonist against a backdrop of a vast sky kingdom. She is a beautiful girl, possessing {argument name="hair color" default="Long silver-white"} Hair, very big{argument name="eye color" default="clear blue"} Her eyes are bright, her skin fair, and she wears a calm, slightly melancholic smile as she turns her head. Her hair is very long, flowing in the wind, with soft, layered bangs and side embellishments: a blue crystal hair ornament adorned with silver filigree and flowing blue ribbons. She wears an elegant white and blue fantasy outfit, comprising four main visible elements: a white hooded cloak draped over her shoulders, a dark blue inner skirt or cinched outer garment, a magnificent silver armor with sculpted details on the shoulders and upper sleeves, and a blue gemstone brooch pinned to her chest. The background is a bright, high-altitude fantasy world filled with bright clouds, blue skies, and floating islands; it includes three prominent floating architectural elements: a large central floating landmass with a castle-like structure, a slender spire rising from the clouds in the lower left corner, and a distant, tower-like island near the center. In the upper left sky, a majestic white dragon is depicted, wings outstretched, flying diagonally above the title area. Add a large, stylized Japanese title on the left, using metallic silver and glowing blue font, with the content being:{argument name="main title" default="The White Dragon's Wings and Blue Memories"} The lettering incorporates decorative wing patterns. Below it, two lines of smaller Japanese subtitles are added on the left:{argument name="episode label" default="Episode 1"} and{argument name="episode subtitle" default="Silver gap"} A few glowing white feathers or petals are scattered in the air. The design uses cool tones of white, silver, and bright sky blue, featuring highly detailed lines, soft cel-shaded shadows, sharp highlights, ethereal lighting, and the texture of a premium light novel cover or fantasy anime poster.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的动漫幻想主视觉图，采用宽幅电影构图，画面右侧展示了一位宁静的年轻女主角，背景是广阔的天空王国。她是一位美丽的少女，拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="长长的银白色"} 头发，大大的 {argument name="eye color" default="清澈蓝色"} 眼睛，皮肤白皙，转头回眸时带着平静而略显忧郁的微笑。她的头发非常长，随风飘动，带有柔软的层次感刘海和侧面装饰：1 个带有银色花丝和飘逸蓝色丝带的蓝色水晶发饰。她穿着优雅的白蓝配色幻想服装，包含 4 个可见的主要服饰元素：1 件披在肩上的白色连帽斗篷，1 件深蓝色内裙或束腰外衣，1 个带有雕刻细节的华丽银色盔甲肩部及上袖部分，以及 1 枚别在胸前的蓝色宝石胸针。背景是一个明亮的高海拔幻想世界，充满了明亮的云朵、蓝天和漂浮的岛屿；包含 3 个显眼的漂浮建筑元素：1 个带有城堡结构的大型中央漂浮陆地，1 个从左下角云层中升起的细长尖塔，以及 1 个靠近中心位置的遥远塔状岛屿。在左上方的天空中，描绘 1 条雄伟的白龙，双翼展开，在标题区域上方斜向飞行。在左侧添加一个大型风格化日文标题，采用金属银色和发光的蓝色字体，内容为 {argument name="main title" default="白竜の翼と青き記憶"}，字母中融入了装饰性的翅膀图案。在其下方，居左添加 2 行较小的日文副标题：{argument name="episode label" default="第１話"} 和 {argument name="episode subtitle" default="白銀の空隙"}。空中散落着几片发光的白色羽毛或花瓣。使用白色、银色和明亮天蓝色的冷色调，具有高度详细的线条、柔和的赛璐珞阴影、清晰的高光、空灵的灯光，以及高级轻小说封面或幻想动漫宣传海报的质感。

templates.title: 8-grid luxury apartment couple collage

titleLocalized.zh: 8 宫格豪华公寓情侣拼贴画

templates.prompt: Based on the couple in REFERENCE_0, this project places the same pair of people in a warm, luxurious modern high-rise apartment, creating an eight-panel collage storyboard focusing on the characters and interior design. Maintaining consistency in their relationship, approximate age, body type, hairstyle, and all-white casual wear, the collages naturally transition from prime time to nighttime scenes in different areas of the apartment. Employing a cinematic lifestyle/architectural photography style, the project uses soft amber lighting, large floor-to-ceiling windows, expansive city skyline views, and beige and wood-toned furniture to create a tranquil and sophisticated atmosphere. The collages are arranged into eight equally sized squares, separated by thin white borders. Includes the following eight precise scenes: 1) A couple cooking together on the kitchen island; 2) A couple watching TV on the sofa from behind at night; 3) A couple sitting side by side on the sofa in daylight; 4) A couple standing by the window gazing at the sunset from behind; 5) A wide-angle shot of the living room and dining area, showcasing the skyline; 6) A woman sitting alone on the sofa near the kitchen; 7) A couple talking by the kitchen island; 8) A wide-angle shot of the living room at sunset, including the sofa, dining table, TV wall, and skyline. Prioritizing interior design style and spatial continuity, the shots achieve a magazine-like composition and realistic photographic quality.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 中的情侣为基础，将同一对男女置于温暖、奢华的现代高层公寓室内，生成一个聚焦于人物与室内设计的 8 宫格拼贴故事板。保持他们的关系、大致年龄、体型、发型以及全白休闲装的风格一致，但在公寓的不同区域自然地呈现从黄金时刻到夜晚的场景。采用电影感生活方式/建筑摄影风格，运用柔和的琥珀色灯光、大型落地窗、广阔的城市天际线景观、米色和木色调家具，营造宁静高端的氛围。将拼贴画排列为 8 个等大的方格，并带有细白边分隔。包含以下 8 个精确场景：1) 情侣在厨房岛台一起做饭，2) 夜晚从背后拍摄情侣坐在沙发上看电视，3) 日光下情侣并肩坐在沙发上，4) 日落时分从背后拍摄情侣站在窗前眺望，5) 客厅和用餐区的空镜广角，展现天际线景观，6) 女士独自坐在靠近厨房的沙发上，7) 情侣在厨房岛台旁交谈，8) 日落时分客厅的空镜广角，包含沙发、餐台、电视墙和天际线。优先考虑室内设计风格和空间连续性，呈现杂志般的构图和写实的照片质感。

templates.title: Snow Rabbit Elf Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 雪兔精灵肖像

templates.prompt: A portrait in a soft, painterly style depicts a mysterious young woman who possesses {argument name="hair color" default="Long white hair"} With a pair of high-perched rabbit ears atop her head, the composition employs a vertical, centered perspective above the chest. Her face is completely obscured by a flat, beige rectangular veil, creating an anonymous and surreal effect. She wears a traditional ivory kimono-style robe with striking black trim: three distinct black areas, including a wide, overlapping collar, two cuff sashes, and a black obi tied in front. A white rabbit patch with brown trim is embroidered on her left breast. A red braided rope ornament, tied in a bow, adorned with two tassels and a small rabbit pendant, hangs from her right side of her hair. Her long, flowing hair, slightly windswept, is silky smooth and falls over her shoulders. The background is set in a tranquil snow scene, with falling snowflakes creating a greyish-white winter atmosphere, dotted with bare trees, and a faint silhouette of a traditional pagoda visible in the distance on the right. Employing exquisite East Asian fantasy aesthetics, the colors are soft, the lighting is warm, and the texture is delicate, like a watercolor or gouache painting. The clothing details are highly refined, the atmosphere is tranquil, and the composition is symmetrical and centered.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅柔和的绘画风格肖像，描绘了一位神秘的年轻女子，她有着 {argument name="hair color" default="长长的白发"} 和一对高耸于头顶的兔耳，构图采用胸部以上的竖向居中视角。她的面部被一块平整的米色矩形遮挡块完全掩盖，营造出一种匿名且超现实的效果。她身着一件传统的象牙色和服式长袍，配有醒目的黑色镶边：共有 3 处明显的黑色区域，包括宽大的交领、2 条袖口饰带以及系在身前的黑色腰带。左胸处绣有 1 个棕色勾边的白色兔子补丁。她右侧的头发上悬挂着 1 个红色编织绳饰品，系成蝴蝶结状，并装饰有 2 个流苏和 1 个小型兔形挂件。长发飘逸，略带风吹感，如丝般顺滑，垂落在双肩。背景设定在宁静的雪景中，飘落着雪花，呈现出灰白色的冬日氛围，点缀着枯树，右侧远处隐约可见模糊的传统宝塔剪影。采用精致的东亚幻想美学，色调柔和，光线温润，带有水彩或水粉画般的细腻质感，服装细节高度精炼，氛围宁静，构图对称居中。

templates.prompt: A two-panel comic-style page, employing a dramatic, semi-realistic black-and-white ink wash style with warm, deep brown sunset hues, depicts a public park at dusk. On the far left is a wooden bench with four illuminated streetlights, lush trees, a dirt path, distant city buildings, and a small playground with slides in the background. In the upper panel, a Jack Russell Terrier stands on the left, leashed, having just finished defecating; a small pile of feces near its hind legs is highlighted with a cartoonish embellishment. The dog, with white fur and dark spots, wears a collar and leash, its eyes closed, its expression playful and content, one hind leg raised, tail wagging, hinting at an upcoming kick. On the right, a young woman with shoulder-length curly hair squats, holding an open plastic poop bag in one hand and a leash loop in the other. She wears a cable-knit cardigan over a long floral dress with a ribbon at the neckline and low-heeled shoes. Her face is blurred by a soft rectangle. In the upper right corner is a large speech bubble containing vertical Japanese text: "よしよし。…さて、ササっと片付けて帰ろっか。". Below, a sudden close-up action is created: the dog is now on the left, in a low, aggressive stance, brow furrowed, eyes sharp, a bead of sweat on its forehead, and air escaping from its nostrils, as if it's straining to support itself and kicking dirt backward. An explosive line of speed radiates across the entire frame, a cloud of sand and dust rushing towards the woman crouching on the right. The woman leans back slightly, still holding the poop bag, and near her head is a shocked inner monologue speech bubble containing vertical Japanese text: "あ、まずい……。". Next to the dog, a jagged, jarring sound bubble containing the giant Japanese character "フンッ!" is placed. The design emphasizes absurd humor and dynamism, with details including finely detailed fur, textured ground, dynamic fragments, expressive comic book screen tones, rough panel borders, and a cinematic action-comedy rhythm.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅两格日本漫画风格的页面，采用戏剧性的半写实黑白水墨画风，并带有温暖的深褐色日落色调。背景是黄昏时的公共公园，最左侧有一张木长椅，配有 4 盏发光的街灯、茂密的树木、一条泥土小径、远处的城市建筑，以及背景中一个带有 Slides 的小型游乐场。在上方分格中，一只杰克罗素梗犬站在画面中左侧，系着牵引绳，刚在地上排完便；它后腿附近有一小堆粪便，并带有漫画式的强调符号。这只狗有着白底深色斑点的毛发，戴着项圈和牵引绳，双眼紧闭，表情顽皮且满足，一条后腿抬起，尾巴摇动，暗示着即将开始向后踢土。在右侧，一位留着齐肩卷发的年轻女性蹲着，一只手拿着打开的塑料拾便袋，另一只手拿着牵引绳环。她穿着麻花针织开衫，搭配饰有领口丝带的长款碎花连衣裙，脚踩低跟鞋。她的脸部被一个柔和的矩形模糊处理。右上角有一个巨大的对话气泡，内含竖排日语文字：「よしよし。…さて、ササっと片付けて帰ろっか。」。在下方分格中，营造一个突如其来的特写动作瞬间：这只狗现在位于左侧，呈现出低姿态的攻击性站位，眉头紧锁，眼神犀利，带有一滴汗珠，鼻孔喷出气流，仿佛正在用力支撑并向后踢土。爆炸性的速度线辐射整个画面，一团沙砾尘土向右侧蹲着的女性喷涌而去。女性微微后仰，手中仍拿着拾便袋，头顶附近有一个震惊的内心独白气泡，内含竖排日语文字：「あ、まずい……」。在狗的旁边，放置一个锯齿状的冲击音效气泡，内含巨大的日语文字：「フンッ！」。强调荒诞的幽默感与动感，细节刻画包括细腻的毛发、有质感的地面、动态的碎片、富有表现力的漫画网点纸、粗犷的分格边框，以及电影般的动作喜剧节奏。

templates.prompt: A serene, fantastical winter portrait depicts a woman standing outdoors, surrounded by falling snow. The composition begins at mid-thigh and rises upwards. She wears an elegant black and white traditional Hanfu-style robe. Her face is completely obscured by a smooth white rabbit mask with upright pink-lined rabbit ears, small black eyes, and a minimalist, adorable expression. She has extremely long, straight hair that reaches her waist, adorned with delicate white flowers and branch-like hair ornaments. The robe is entirely white, with delicate silver embroidery on the chest and shoulders. The sleeves are wide and draped, with black piping at the collar and cuffs. A black sash is tied at the waist, with a ribbon adorned with tassels, knots, and snowflake-shaped decorations hanging down the front. The clothing features prominent rabbit motifs: four illustrator-style white rabbits—two large rabbits below the outer cuffs, one small hopping rabbit on the black skirt hem, and one sitting rabbit on the front lower skirt panel. The image possesses a tranquil, ethereal, and cinematic atmosphere, employing cool blue-gray tones and shallow depth of field to present soft, natural winter light and shadow. The background features blurred snow-covered traditional East Asian architecture and distant, steep mountains, creating the ambiance of a misty mountain temple. The overall image is covered in light snowfall, with extremely fine fabric textures and a soft, volumetric mist effect, presenting a refined and dreamlike GPT-Image-2 aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张宁静的冬季奇幻人像，画面中一位女子站在户外，周围飘落着细雪，构图从大腿中部向上。她身着优雅的黑白配色传统汉服风格长袍。她的脸部被一个光滑的白色兔面具完全遮住，面具上有竖起的粉色内衬兔耳、小巧的黑色眼孔以及极简可爱的表情。她留着垂至腰下的超长直发，银白色发丝间点缀着精致的白色花朵和树枝状发饰。长袍通体雪白，胸口和肩部有细腻的银色刺绣，袖口宽大垂坠，领口和袖缘饰有黑色滚边，腰间系着黑色束腰，前方垂着带有流苏绳结和雪花状饰物的系带。服装上带有明显的兔子元素：共 4 只插画风格的白兔，其中 2 只大兔子位于外侧袖口下方，1 只小跳兔位于下摆黑色裙片上，1 只坐姿兔位于前下裙片上。画面氛围宁静、空灵且具有电影感，采用冷蓝灰色调，浅景深，呈现柔和的自然冬日光影。背景为模糊的雪中东亚传统建筑和远处的陡峭山峦，营造出雾气缭绕的高山寺庙意境。画面整体覆盖轻柔的降雪，布料纹理极其细腻，带有柔和的体积雾感，呈现出精致梦幻的 gpt-image-2 美学风格。

Her long, straight, silver-white hair cascades over her shoulders, adorned with a magnificent silver headdress inlaid with gold and silver filigree, pearls, dangling tassels, light turquoise, and a pair of striking, upright white rabbit ears. Her face is deliberately obscured by a smooth, rectangular blur. Snowflakes fall in the scene. The background presents a dramatic, cold blue-gray sky, snow-covered pine trees, distant jagged mountains, stone lanterns, and a traditional Chinese temple building with an arched tiled roof on the right. The overall atmosphere is ethereal, noble, and full of winter vibes. It uses soft diffused light, shallow depth of field, highly detailed fabric textures, realistic fantasy style, and exquisite GPT-Image-2 aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度精细的奇幻肖像，描绘了一位侧身站立的年轻女子，她戴着优雅的白色兔耳，身着传统的东亚汉服，置身于雪后的冬日庭院中。她拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色"} 的长发，发丝极长且如丝般顺滑，在微风中轻轻飘动，并装饰着华丽的花卉和珠宝发饰。她的面部大部分被一个位于中央的灰色矩形模糊遮罩所遮挡，覆盖了眼睛、鼻子和上脸颊，仿佛为了隐私而进行了马赛克处理。兔耳高耸、毛茸茸且呈白色，质感逼真，内侧为淡粉色，通过一个精致的头饰固定，头饰上点缀着黑色蕾丝、银丝工艺、小花、水晶、珠子和流苏。头饰上可见 2 个带有黑色兔子图案的圆形刺绣装饰，以及多个黑白相间的垂坠流苏、精致的链条和花卉金属枝叶。她佩戴着不对称的长款珠饰流苏耳环。她身着层叠的 {argument name="outfit style" default="带有兔子刺绣的黑白汉服"}，配有光泽感的深色滚边、半透明的浅色面料，并在 3 处可见刺绣兔子图案：领口附近的一只小兔子、胸前的一个大型圆形兔子纹章，以及袖口上一个隐约可见的兔子图案。整体色调为单色的银、白、炭黑和柔和的灰色，营造出一种清冷空灵的氛围。前景和背景中雪花正轻轻飘落。她身后是柔和虚化的 {argument name="background setting" default="覆盖着积雪的中国古典园林及亭台楼阁"}，具有浅景深、大气雾感、电影级光斑效果、超精细的织物纹理、柔和的冬日光影、优雅的构图以及宁静神秘的美学风格。竖构图肖像，上半身特写，奢华奇幻服装摄影，超写实，高细节，精致的编辑级美学图像。

templates.prompt: This is an anime-style scene with a melancholic, cinematic feel, depicting a person who {argument name="hair color" default="silver"} A young woman with a bob haircut that reached her chin sat in a dimly lit room filled with flowers in the pouring rain late at night. She leaned languidly against a wooden table and a stack of old wooden crates, one arm hanging limply at her side, her posture conveying a sense of weariness, melancholy, or dreamlike tranquility. She wore a light-colored {argument name="dress color" default="Light sage green"} She wears a Victorian-style off-the-shoulder dress with ruffled sleeves, a fitted bodice, an ankle-length skirt, white trim, and a short white apron-style crinoline at the back, along with two large dark blue bows (one near the waist and the other near the back). She wears black Mary Jane shoes. The scene is set in an indoor greenhouse or flower shop, with a large window behind her; raindrops cover the glass, and the hazy city lights outside shimmer in the night. Two strong starburst halos are added to the right window, along with scattered reflections on the wet floor. The room is filled with rich floral arrangements and scattered flowers, with clusters of deep red, pink, and cream flowers distributed in the shadows on the left, right, and foreground edges. The floor is shiny and wet, covered with scattered rose petals and puddle-like reflections. The table and wooden crates are wet and shimmering, enhancing the rain-soaked atmosphere. The composition is a full-body shot, slightly tilted from the left front, with the character positioned on the right side of the frame. The lighting is understated yet dramatic, with bright backlight streaming through the windows, soft contour lighting on the dress and hair, deep shadows, and shimmering highlights on raindrops, petals, and wet surfaces. Highly detailed, with realistic fabric folds, reflective water, a romantic gothic atmosphere, and an elegant yet slightly chaotic scene, this is an ultra-refined digital illustration.

promptLocalized.zh: 这是一幅充满忧郁电影感的动漫风格场景，描绘了一位留着 {argument name="hair color" default="银色"} 下巴长度波波头的年轻女性，在深夜大雨中坐在昏暗且铺满花朵的房间里。她慵懒地斜倚在一张木桌和一叠旧木箱上，一只手臂无力地垂下，姿态流露出疲惫、忧郁或梦幻般的静谧感。她穿着一件浅 {argument name="dress color" default="浅鼠尾草绿"} 色的维多利亚风格露肩连衣裙，配有荷叶边袖子、修身紧身胸衣、及踝长裙、白色饰边，背部饰有短小的白色围裙式裙撑，以及 2 个深青色大蝴蝶结（分别位于腰部和背部附近）。她穿着黑色玛丽珍鞋。场景设定在一个室内温室或花店，她身后是一整面高大的窗户；玻璃上布满雨滴，窗外模糊的城市灯光在夜色中闪烁。在右侧窗户处增加 2 处强烈的星芒光晕，并在湿润的地面上增加零星的倒影。房间里摆满了丰富的花艺布置和散落的花朵，深红色、粉色和奶油色的花簇分布在左侧、右侧和前景边缘的阴影中。地面光亮潮湿，铺满了散落的玫瑰花瓣和水洼般的倒影。桌子和木箱湿润且闪烁着光泽，增强了雨水浸润的氛围。构图为全身像，从左前方略微倾斜，角色位于画面中右侧。光线低调且富有戏剧性，窗户透出明亮的逆光，裙子和头发上有柔和的轮廓光，阴影深邃，雨滴、花瓣和湿润表面上有闪烁的高光。高度细节化，真实的织物褶皱，反光的水面，浪漫的哥特氛围，优雅但略显凌乱的场景，超精细数字插画。

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度精细的动漫幻想肖像，描绘了一位美丽的年轻女法师，身处城堡中光影斑驳的花园里。构图为纵向，展示了她腰部以上的形象，右手握着一根华丽的法杖，顶端镶嵌着一颗巨大的多面紫色水晶。她的面部被遮挡，但整体设计优雅精致。她拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="铂金色"} 的秀发，长发丝滑，光泽感强，发丝柔顺飘逸，带有细腻的高光，没有毛躁或干枯感；头发一侧编有发辫，并装饰着 3 朵紫色花朵和精致的金色镂空发饰。她身穿一件 {argument name="dress color" default="薰衣草色与白色"} 的幻想礼服，带有露肩荷叶袖、半透明面料、层叠雪纺、复杂的金色镶边、刺绣细节，以及领口、胸前和腰部镶嵌的 3 颗紫色宝石。增加一个珠宝项圈式领口和带有金链的优雅手臂装饰。背景是梦幻般的宫殿庭院，开满紫色花朵，藤蔓缠绕，有石拱门和远处的城堡尖塔，空气中弥漫着发光的粒子和飘落的花瓣。使用强烈的暖色背光与柔和的粉彩环境光相结合，营造出闪烁的高光、发丝边缘光、空灵的柔光效果和浪漫的魔法氛围。色调以薰衣草紫、紫罗兰色、柔粉色、珍珠白和金色为主。超精细、精致的动漫插画，细腻的线条，光泽面料的反射，电影级的景深，高级幻想卡牌艺术美学。

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度精细的动漫奇幻肖像，描绘了一位美丽的年轻女子坐在魔法花园石桌旁，时间设定在黄金时刻，采用半身垂直构图。她拥有一头 {argument name="hair color" default="铂金色"} 的长发，发丝柔顺、富有光泽且经过精心打理，线条流畅、质感柔软，无毛躁或杂乱感，并梳着优雅的半扎发，侧边带有编发和金色发饰。发型设计应强调健康、奢华的质感，展现清晰的发丝纹理和明亮的挑染效果。她身着一套 {argument name="outfit colors" default="黑色、白色和紫罗兰色"} 的华丽奇幻礼服，领口为高领黑色设计并饰有金色花丝，胸前覆盖白色花卉蕾丝，袖子为半透明泡泡袖配蕾丝袖口，装饰有紫色水晶宝石和优雅的手部配饰。胸前佩戴着一颗巨大的多面紫罗兰色宝石吊坠，并搭配同款紫色耳环和装饰点缀。她的姿态优雅端庄，一只手轻抬至下巴附近，另一只手拿着一束紫色小花。周围环绕着前景和背景中盛开的紫罗兰花、发光的蝴蝶、飘落的花瓣，以及远处模糊的、带有哥特式拱门和尖塔的梦幻大教堂式花园。在前景下方的桌上放置一本打开的书。运用温暖的逆光、穿过发丝的轮廓光、柔和的魔法光晕、淡薰衣草色和粉色的氛围、闪烁的微粒、浅景深、超精细纹理、精致的动漫插画风格、浪漫的奇幻氛围、空灵的优雅感以及奢华的绘画质感。

templates.title: Retro 1998 Japanese Geocities style personal homepage

titleLocalized.zh: 复古 1998 年日本 Geocities 风格个人主页

templates.prompt: A retro Japanese homepage from the late 1990s is displayed in a Microsoft Internet Explorer window from the Windows era, presented as a full browser screenshot. The page title bar reads "Lumeng no Tanshiba - Microsoft Internet Explorer," and the browser interface perfectly recreates the classic Internet Explorer look, including the menu bar, navigation icons, address bar, and status bar. The website background is a black starry sky, adorned with tiny colored stars, and surrounded by a gold dotted border and glowing pixel-style decorative frames. The page header displays the purple Japanese text "Secret Garden Heroes…," below which is a large, ornate title "Lumeng no Tanshiba," with the subtitle "Since 1998" in a bright blue italic serif font. In the center of the page is a low-poly 3D anime girl with pink hair, wearing a blue crop top, dark shorts, white shoulder armor, and brown boots, standing facing forward with a neutral expression. Arrange four game-style characters or special effects elements around the central area: one flame each in the upper left and upper right corners of the central area, one blue pixelated robot character in the lower left corner, and one small red and white pixelated character in the lower right corner. Add one silver metal hanging capsule decoration each slightly to the upper left and upper right of the central area. The page uses a dense, old-fashioned webpage layout, divided into three columns. The left sidebar contains five boxed areas: a navigation bar titled "What are you looking for?" containing ten blue links marked with an asterisk, tagged "Latest Information," "Monster Bulletin Board," "Game Room," "Professor's Room," "Tour Room," "Music Room," "Ebook Room," "BBS (Billboard)," "Chat," and "Link Collection"; a visitor counter box displaying "You are a visitor with a green number style, '003666'"; a large blue "BBS" banner button with the smaller text "Billboard" below; and a black and yellow "Under Construction" button. A "CONSTRUCTION" warning banner with tiny green construction worker icons; and a black banner with the word "Link" in red handwriting and the blue text "Mutual Link Welcome!!" templates.title: Improve whiteboard photo clarity

titleLocalized.zh: 提升白板照片清晰度

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference photo, recreate the whiteboard scene from the same camera angle and composition, and enhance it into a clearer, higher-quality image. Remove glare/reflections, increase contrast and sharpness, brighten the whiteboard surface, and make all handwritten text deeper and more legible while neatly retaining its original position. Keep the black border, walls, hooks, and parts of the heads on the bottom/right edge consistent with the original composition. Preserves handwriting, including visible Japanese words and romanization/notes, such as とうきょう/ TOU KYOU, きょうと/ KYOUTO, せんせい/ SEN SE I, ええ/ EE, おおさか/ SA KA,ありがとう/ A RI GA TO U, こうこう/ KO U KO U, とおい/ TO OI, 大きい, おおきい, 美/BI, EG, 木, 久み, でなく/びゃく, ぶっか/ BUKKA, ざっし, かぎ, しゅぎょう, today, KONBANWA, フィー, and Spanish notes fluidido, fragmentado and Frag.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考照片，在相同的摄像机角度和构图下重现白板场景，并将其增强为更清晰、高画质的照片。去除眩光/反光，增加对比度和锐度，提亮白板表面，并使所有手写文字更深、更易读，同时整齐地保留在原位置。保持黑色边框、墙壁、挂钩以及底部/右侧边缘的部分人头与原始构图一致。保留手写内容，包括可见的日语单词和罗马拼音/笔记，例如 とうきょう / TOU KYOU, きょうと / KYOUTO, せんせい / SEN SE I, ええ / E E, おおさか / SA KA, ありがとう / A RI GA TO U, こうこう / KO U KO U, とおい / TO O I, 大きい, おおきい, 美 / BI, 卵, 木, 休み, でなく / びゃく, ぶっか / BUKKA, ざっし, かぎ, しゅぎょう, 今日, KONBANWA, フィー，以及西班牙语笔记 fluido, fragmentado 和 Frag。

templates.title: Anime Girl in Sunny Cafe

titleLocalized.zh: 阳光咖啡馆里的动漫少女

templates.prompt: A delicate anime-style illustration depicts a lovely young woman sitting alone by a sunny cafe window, the composition showing her in a frontal seated position, roughly above her thighs. She has {argument name="hair color" default="Light brown"} Her hair was styled into two short pigtails, each tied with a dark blue bow, and she had soft bangs, giving her a sweet and youthful appearance. She wore a white summer dress with ruffles and black polka dots, featuring short puff sleeves, a fitted bodice, a large bow at the chest, and layered ruffles at the hem. Her hands were lightly folded under her chin, her posture both shy and cheerful, her body slightly leaning forward, as if she were on a pleasant café date. On the table in the foreground was a small dessert plate with a mini tart topped with strawberries, blueberries, whipped cream, and mint leaves, next to a tall iced latte with a straw. The background was a cozy, modern café interior with wooden tables and chairs, pendant lights, potted plants, wall decorations, and a long window sill. Through the large window, one could see bright green trees and a soft daytime cityscape. The light was warm afternoon natural light, streaming in from the right, creating soft highlights, delicate shadows, and a comfortable and pleasant atmosphere. Rich in detail, with clean lines, soft and lustrous shadows, delicate fabric texture, and romantic charm, this high-quality anime illustration features a square composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的动漫风格插画，描绘了一位可爱的年轻女性独自坐在阳光明媚的咖啡馆窗边，画面采用约大腿以上的正面坐姿构图。她有着 {argument name="hair color" default="浅棕色"} 的头发，扎成两个短双马尾，并系着两个深蓝色蝴蝶结，留着柔和的刘海，外表甜美青春。她身穿一件带有黑色小圆点的白色荷叶边夏装，短泡泡袖，紧身胸衣设计，胸前饰有大蝴蝶结，裙摆处有层叠的荷叶边。她双手轻叠在下巴下方，姿态羞涩而开朗，身体微微前倾，仿佛正在进行一场愉快的咖啡馆约会。前景的桌面上放着一个小甜点盘，盘中有一块配有草莓、蓝莓、鲜奶油和薄荷叶的迷你塔，旁边是一杯插着吸管的高杯冰拿铁。背景是温馨的现代咖啡馆内部，配有木质桌椅、吊灯、盆栽、墙面装饰和一个长条窗台。透过大窗户，可以看到明亮的绿树和柔和的日间城市街景。光线为温暖的午后自然光，从右侧射入，营造出柔和的高光、细腻的阴影和舒适宜人的氛围。细节丰富，线条干净，阴影柔和且富有光泽，布料质感细腻，充满浪漫魅力，高质量动漫插画，方形构图。

templates.title: 4K Realistic Style Rolo Cover Remastered

titleLocalized.zh: 4K 写实风格 Rolo 封面重制

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference images, recreate the original retro game cover image into a refined 4K cinematic remaster. Retain the prominent "ROLO TO THE RESCUE" title at the top, the horizontally framed main visual layout, the jungle background, and the five characters arranged from left to right: a beaver in the water, a squirrel on the shore, an elephant in the center, a blue rabbit, and a mole wearing a miner's hat emerging from a mound of dirt. Transform these five characters into adorable semi-realistic 3D animated creatures, giving them natural fur, skin, and a soft stylized finish, while preserving their iconic proportions and the nostalgic feel of the original cover. Optimize the composition to achieve a high-end, modern game promotional image quality, using warm, golden hour jungle lighting to enhance depth of field, improve the realism of vegetation and water reflections, and refine the wooden border. Fix any blurred or obscured facial areas to ensure each character is clearly visible. The image should be widescreen, rich in detail, and suitable for all ages, creating a modern, realistic remastered visual experience while remaining faithful to the original cover.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图，将原始复古游戏封面构图重制为精致的 4K 电影级重制版。保留顶部醒目的“ROLO TO THE RESCUE”标题、横向框架式主视觉布局、丛林背景，以及从左至右依次排列的 5 个角色：水中的海狸、岸上的松鼠、中央的大象、蓝色兔子，以及戴着矿工帽从土堆中钻出的鼹鼠。将这 5 个角色转化为可爱的半写实 3D 动画生物，赋予其自然的毛发、皮肤和柔和的风格化处理，同时保留其标志性的比例和原封面的怀旧感。优化构图，使其呈现出高端现代游戏宣传图的质感，采用温暖的黄金时刻丛林光影，增强景深，提升植被和水面反射的真实感，并精修木质边框。修复所有模糊或遮挡的面部区域，确保每个角色都清晰呈现。画面需采用宽屏比例，细节丰富，老少皆宜，在忠实于原封面的基础上，营造出现代写实重制版的视觉效果。

templates.prompt: For a product named{argument name="app name" default="Shine"} Create a sophisticated App Store promotional poster for the AI ​​professional photo app, employing a warm and minimalist brand style. Use a vertical mobile screenshot ad layout with a soft beige background and an upward-extending golden arc at the bottom edge. Place an elegant, large black serif title in the upper left corner, divided into three lines, with the content {argument name="headline text" default="Create professional business photos with Shine"} Add a white, jagged star-shaped badge with black serif text in the center left side.{argument name="badge text" default="Before + After"} On the right, a large, tilted modern smartphone model is displayed, slightly angled to the left, with a slim metal frame and a realistic screen. The screen should display the application interface for AI-generated professional portraits. At the top of the screen is a small "SHINE" logo, a large serif subtitle "Show Your Most Professional Self.", and the accompanying text "Upload a few photos, and we'll generate studio-quality professional portraits for you." In the upper right corner is a small, rounded capsule button displaying "⚡ 8 Points," and an iPhone-style status bar showing 9:41. In the center of the screen is a before-and-after comparison card, with two portrait panels side-by-side, each labeled once: the left panel is labeled "Before," and the right panel is labeled "After." The left portrait is of a casual man wearing a dark T-shirt in a typical indoor setting; the right portrait is of the same man transformed into a professional portrait wearing a dark suit jacket with a light-colored shirt in a warm, blurred studio setting. A circular toggle arrow button is placed centered between the two panels. Below, there's a "HOW IT WORKS" section with three vertically arranged steps: 1) "1. Upload," with the text "Upload 8–12 clear personal photos."; 2) "2. We create," with the text "Our AI will generate a variety of professional-looking photos."; 3) "3. Download," with the text "Choose your favorite photo and download the high-resolution image." Each step is accompanied by a rounded square icon in peach or pink tones. Near the bottom of the screen, there's a large, rounded yellow CTA button with the text {argument name="button text" default="Start Shine ✦"} The smaller text below reads "8 points per session." In the lower left foreground, a cute, stylized white mascot is placed. It has a rounded body, short arms, rosy cheeks, dotted eyes, a smiling mouth, and wears a golden cowboy hat and matching scarf. The oversized hat extends towards the center and covers the bottom area in front of the phone. The mascot uses a soft 3D illustration style, while the phone screen features a sophisticated UI design, maintaining brand consistency in beige and gold, complemented by subtle shadows, clean spacing, and a refined startup marketing aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 为一款名为 {argument name="app name" default="Shine"} 的 AI 职业照应用制作一张精致的 App Store 宣传海报，采用温暖简约的品牌风格。使用垂直手机截图广告布局，背景为柔和的米色，底部边缘有向上延伸的弧形金黄色形状。在左上方放置一个优雅的大号黑色衬线体标题，分为 3 行，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="用 Shine 打造专业职业照"}。在左侧中心添加一个白色锯齿状星形徽章，内含黑色衬线体文字 {argument name="badge text" default="Before + After"}。在右侧，展示一个大型倾斜的现代智能手机模型，向左微倾，带有纤细的金属边框和逼真的屏幕。手机屏幕应显示 AI 生成专业职业照的应用界面。屏幕顶部包含一个小型的 SHINE 字标，一行大号衬线体副标题“展现最专业的你。”，以及辅助正文“上传几张照片，我们将为您生成影棚级职业照。”，右上角有一个小型的圆角胶囊按钮，显示“⚡ 8 积分”，以及显示 9:41 的 iPhone 风格状态栏。在手机屏幕中间，展示一张前后对比卡片，并排两个肖像面板，每个面板各标注一次：左侧标签为“Before”，右侧标签为“After”。左侧肖像是一位穿着深色 T 恤、背景为普通室内的休闲男士；右侧肖像则是同一位男士变身为穿着深色西装外套搭配浅色衬衫、背景为温暖影棚虚化效果的专业职业照。在两个面板之间居中放置一个圆形切换箭头按钮。在下方，包含一个“HOW IT WORKS”部分，垂直排列 3 个步骤：1) “1. Upload”，文字为“上传 8–12 张清晰的个人照片。”，2) “2. We create”，文字为“我们的 AI 将生成多种专业职业照。”，3) “3. Download”，文字为“选择您最喜欢的照片并下载高清图像。”为每个步骤配上桃色或粉色调的圆角方形图标。在手机屏幕底部附近，添加一个大型圆角黄色 CTA 按钮，文字为 {argument name="button text" default="开始 Shine ✦"}，下方小字显示“每场次 8 积分”。在左下角前景处，放置一个可爱的风格化白色吉祥物，身体圆润，手臂短小，脸颊红润，眼睛呈点状，嘴巴微笑着，戴着一顶金黄色牛仔帽和配套的领巾；超大的帽子应向中心延伸，并覆盖在手机前方的底部区域。吉祥物采用柔和的 3D 插画风格，手机屏幕采用高级 UI 设计，保持米色与金色的品牌一致性，辅以细腻的阴影、整洁的间距以及精致的初创公司营销美学。
