titleLocalized.zh: AI 模型路由应用商店截图

templates.prompt: Create a sophisticated App Store promotional screenshot using a warm beige and golden orange brand color scheme, with a vertical composition that presents a high-end yet friendly startup aesthetic. The layout is a single vertical marketing graphic with a soft cream background and an orange gradient at the bottom. In the upper left corner, place a very striking and elegant black serif title displayed in three lines:{argument name="headline text" default="Driven by leading AI models"} To the right of the title, add a white, jagged star-shaped badge with subtle shadows, containing two lines of serif text:{argument name="badge text" default="Optimal Model"} Below the left-hand heading is a vertical list of four AI service providers, with icons and names evenly spaced: Claude (orange sunburst icon), Gemini (multicolored four-pointed star icon), OpenAI (black knot icon), and Seedance (purple-blue gradient S icon). Below this is a left-aligned serif text block divided into two parts: first, a four-line black text list reading "Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, Seedance."; then, a final line of brand-colored orange text.{argument name="tagline text" default="Powered by Merl."} On the right half, a realistic modern smartphone, slightly tilted to the left, is placed with a reflective silver frame, black screen bezel, a dynamic island-style top cutout, visible side buttons, and soft shadows. The phone screen should display a clean, cream-colored AI-modeled routing app UI. At the very top of the screen is a 9:41 time display along with standard signal, Wi-Fi, and battery icons. Inside the app, a short greeting, "HEY BESTIE," is displayed, followed by a question title in bold serif font.{argument name="screen title" default="What should we project?"} This is followed by a short sans-serif subheading about routing requests to the AI ​​model best suited for the task. A small rounded badge with "+8 points" is added to the top right corner of the app content. Below, there's a section labeled "Model Stack," along with a stack of four rounded cards, each with a soft, muted background. Card 1: Claude, with an orange sunburst icon, described as "Writing, Reasoning, Speech Matching Output," and labeled "Best for Writing" (small pill-shaped tag). Card 2: Gemini, with a colorful star icon, described as "Image Generation, Research, Visual Tasks," and labeled "Best for Images." Card 3: OpenAI, with a black knot-like icon, described as "Avatars, Image Generation, Intelligent Creation," and labeled "Best for Creation." Card 4: Seedance, with a purple-blue gradient "S" icon, described as "Video Generation, Animation, AI UGC Short Films," and labeled "Best for Video." Below the card, place a large, rounded, yellow-orange CTA button with the text "Start Projecting ✦", and below that, a line of smaller text reads "8 points per session". At the bottom of the phone's UI, create a black tab bar containing four navigation items: a home icon, a selected center pill-shaped icon (with a small mascot face and label), and a home icon.{argument name="app name" default="Merl"} The app includes a clock/history icon and a profile icon. At the bottom left of the screen, place a cute 3D mascot character: a round, cream-colored ball with small feet, dark brown dotted eyes, rosy cheeks, and a smiling mouth, wearing a golden wizard's hat and a matching cloak secured by a circular buckle. The mascot should slightly obscure the phone and sit on an orange ground, casting a soft shadow. Overall style: a high-end, friendly tech brand feel; clear typography; detailed realism; soft shadows; a clean app mockup; App Store screenshot quality; consistent visual brand identity; high readability; and high resolution.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个精致的 App Store 宣传截图，采用暖米色和金橙色的品牌色调，纵向构图，呈现高端且友好的初创公司美学。布局为单张垂直构图的营销图形，背景为柔和的奶油色，底部带有橙色渐变地面。在左上方，放置一个非常醒目且优雅的黑色衬线字体标题，分 3 行显示：{argument name="headline text" default="由领先的 AI 模型驱动"}。在标题右侧，添加一个带有细微投影的白色锯齿状星形徽章，内含 2 行衬线文字：{argument name="badge text" default="最佳模型"}。在左侧标题下方，展示一个包含 4 个 AI 服务商的垂直列表，图标加名称，间距均匀：Claude（橙色太阳光芒图标）、Gemini（多色四角星光图标）、OpenAI（黑色结状图标）以及 Seedance（紫蓝色渐变 S 图标）。在其下方，添加一个左对齐的衬线字体正文块，分为两部分：首先是 4 行黑色文本列表，内容为“Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, Seedance.”，然后是最后一行品牌色橙色文本：{argument name="tagline text" default="由 Merl 提供支持。"}。在右半部分，放置一部稍微向左倾斜的逼真现代智能手机，带有反光银色边框、黑色屏幕边框、灵动岛风格顶部切口、可见的侧边按钮以及柔和的阴影。手机屏幕应显示一个简洁的奶油色 AI 模型路由应用 UI。在手机屏幕最顶部，包含 9:41 的时间显示以及标准的信号、Wi-Fi 和电池图标。在应用内部，显示一行简短的问候语“HEY BESTIE.”，接着是一个粗体衬线字体的问题标题 {argument name="screen title" default="我们要投射什么？"}，随后是一个关于将请求路由至最适合任务的 AI 模型的短小无衬线副标题。在应用内容右上角添加一个小的圆角徽章，显示“+ 8 积分”。在下方，包含一个名为“模型堆栈”的区域标签，以及一叠 4 张圆角卡片，每张卡片都有淡淡的柔和背景色。卡片 1：Claude，带有橙色太阳光芒图标，描述为“写作、推理、语音匹配输出”，并带有小药丸形状标签“最适合写作”。卡片 2：Gemini，带有彩色星光图标，描述为“图像生成、研究、视觉任务”，并带有标签“最适合图像”。卡片 3：OpenAI，带有黑色结状图标，描述为“头像、图像生成、智能创作”，并带有标签“最适合创作”。卡片 4：Seedance，带有紫蓝色渐变 S 图标，描述为“视频生成、动态、AI UGC 短片”，并带有标签“最适合视频”。在卡片下方，放置一个大的圆角黄橙色 CTA 按钮，文字为“开始投射 ✦”，下方有一行小字写着“每场会话 8 积分”。在手机 UI 底部，创建一个黑色标签栏，包含 4 个导航项：主页图标、一个选中的中心药丸形状图标（带有一个小吉祥物脸部和标签 {argument name="app name" default="Merl"}）、时钟/历史记录图标以及个人资料图标。在手机左下方的前方，放置一个可爱的 3D 吉祥物角色：一个圆润的奶油色小球，有小脚、深棕色圆点眼睛、红润的脸颊和微笑的嘴巴，戴着金色的巫师帽，披着同色系的斗篷，斗篷由一个圆形扣环系住。吉祥物应稍微遮挡手机，并坐在橙色地面上，投下柔和的阴影。整体风格：高端友好的科技品牌感、清晰的排版、细腻的写实感、柔和的阴影、简洁的应用模型、App Store 截图质量、一致的视觉品牌形象、高度可读、高分辨率。

templates.title: Minimalist AI-powered Contrast Slides

titleLocalized.zh: 极简 AI 锁定对比 Slides

templates.prompt: This 16:9 aspect ratio minimalist presentation slide features a warm light gray paper background with ample white space and a layout following a sophisticated Swiss-style grid, exhibiting the aesthetic appeal of high-end PPT/Keynote design. This slide is a comparison page about "lock-in," using elegant Chinese typography mixed with subtle English navigation text. The top left corner features two lines of small, uppercase English breadcrumb navigation: "COMPARISON · LOCK-IN" and below that, "CLOSED VS OPEN," using a thin sans-serif font with wide letter spacing. The top right corner displays page numbers "04 / 08." In the upper left-center section, a large, bold black Chinese title is added: "True locking is not the model, it's memory." Below the title, on the left, a three-line comparison list is created, separated by thin horizontal lines. The first line has the bold Chinese label "Minor Risk" on the left, and an explanation on the right: "The state exists on the server; the thread cannot be recovered after changing the model." The far right is aligned with a tiny uppercase English keyword: "STATE." The second row features a bold label on the left: "Medium Risk." The right side explains, "Closed-source harnesses have invisible memory patterns and are difficult to transfer." The keyword on the far right is "SHAPE." The third row features a bold label on the left: "Highest Risk." The right side explains, "The entire harness and long-term memory are behind the API." The keyword on the far right is "LOCK-IN." A small, embedded comparison chart card with a white background and a thin border is placed to the right of the slides. It contains two side-by-side system architecture panels. The left panel represents the closed system, using dark gray and soft red accents; the right panel represents the open system, using dark blue accents. Each panel should have five small icon labels at the top, a highlighted harness module in the center, multiple rounded rectangular modules stacked below, and four small capability icons with brief Chinese labels at the bottom. Keep the embedded chart detailed but small in size, making it a secondary visual element rather than the visual focus. Add small, light gray Chinese footer text in the lower left corner: "Layout Test - Top Title + Two-Part Content Below." Place a small page number "04" in the lower right corner. A carousel indicator with seven small dots is added to the center of the bottom edge. The fourth dot is a short, dark, rounded capsule-shaped dot indicating the current page, while the remaining six are light gray dots. A subtle navigation tooltip is added to the bottom right edge: "← → Page navigation, ESC close." The overall design utilizes crisp vector text rendering, understated contrast, elegant spacing, and a cool, high-end infographic style suitable for AI platform contrast and API memory locking in business presentations.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张 16:9 比例的极简主义编辑风格演示 Slides，采用暖浅灰色纸张背景，留白充裕，布局遵循精致的瑞士风格网格，具备高端 PPT/Keynote 设计美感。该 Slides 为关于“锁定”的对比页面，使用优雅的中文排版并混合微小的英文导航文本。左上角放置两行小型大写英文面包屑导航：“COMPARISON · LOCK-IN”及下方的“CLOSED VS OPEN”，使用字间距较宽的细体无衬线字体。右上角放置页码指示器“04 / 08”。在上半部分居中偏左处，添加一行超大号加粗黑色中文字体标题：“真正的锁定，不是模型，是记忆。”在标题下方的左侧区域，创建三行对比列表，行间以细横线分隔。第一行左侧为加粗中文标签“轻度风险”，右侧为解释说明“状态存在服务端，换模型后无法恢复线程。”，最右侧对齐一个微小的大写英文关键词：“STATE”。第二行左侧为加粗标签“中度风险”，右侧为说明“闭源 harness 的记忆形态不可见，难以迁移。”，最右侧关键词为“SHAPE”。第三行左侧为加粗标签“最高风险”，右侧为说明“整个 harness 和长期记忆都在 API 后面。”，最右侧关键词为“LOCK-IN”。在 Slides 右侧放置一张小型嵌入式对比图表卡片，背景为白色，带有细微边框，包含两个并排的系统架构面板。左侧面板代表封闭系统，采用深灰色和柔和的红色点缀；右侧面板代表开放系统，采用深蓝色点缀。每个面板顶部应有 5 个小型图标标签，中央有一个高亮的 harness 模块，下方堆叠多个圆角矩形模块，底部一行有 4 个带有简短中文标签的小型能力图标。保持嵌入图细节丰富但尺寸较小，使其作为辅助视觉元素而非视觉重心。左下角添加微小的浅灰色中文页脚文本：“布局测试 · 顶部标题 + 下方两段式内容”。右下角放置小型页码“04”。底部边缘居中处添加一个轮播指示器，包含 7 个小圆点，其中第 4 个圆点为短深色圆角胶囊状，表示当前页面，其余 6 个为浅灰色圆点。在右下角边缘添加微弱的导航提示：“← → 翻页   ESC 关闭”。使用清晰的矢量文本渲染、低调的对比度、优雅的间距，以及适合 AI 平台对比与 API 记忆锁定商业演示的冷静高端信息图表风格。

templates.title: Cinematic "Amnesia" Theme Slides

titleLocalized.zh: 电影感“记忆缺失”主题 Slides

templates.prompt: Create a minimalist, cinematic presentation slides with a deep black background and a high-end editorial style PowerPoint layout in a 16:9 widescreen aspect ratio. The layout employs an asymmetrical design, with a large block of text on the left and a documentary-style photograph in the upper right corner, leaving ample negative space. Use elegant, high-contrast Chinese fonts to create a high-end magazine feel. Place a line of small uppercase text in the upper left corner: “PHOTO • HUMAN STORY”. Below this, add another line of small uppercase text: “MEMORY HAS WEIGHT”. The main title on the left is in striking white bold Chinese font, divided into two lines:{argument name="headline text" default="What was deleted wasn't the assistant, but the sense of familiarity."} Below the title, place a small, two-line paragraph of Chinese text in white or light gray:{argument name="body text" default="The story of the email assistant in the article is very powerful: the same template can be rebuilt, but the tone, preferences, and implicit rules all need to be taught again."} Add a dark, semi-transparent quoting box below, with a thin white vertical line along the left edge; the box contains two layers of text: the Chinese quoting content.{argument name="quote" default="Without memory, an agent can be easily copied; with memory, the experience begins to become unique."} The image includes a smaller caption: "Image Type: Documentary Photograph." On the right, a warm-toned documentary photograph is inserted: an adult sits at a dimly lit office desk with their back to the camera, looking at a computer monitor; a desk lamp stands to the left of the monitor, documents are pasted on the wall, and soft sunlight streams in through the window. The monitor screen displays a simple white interface with the text centered in the center.{argument name="screen text" default="Your conversational Assistant has been deleted."} The photos should have a film-like quality, with soft brown and gray tones, creating an atmosphere that is private, deep, and slightly melancholic. Add similar interface details for pagination: "05 / 08" in the upper right corner, "PHOTOGRAPHIC ANCHOR · MEMORY LOSS STORY" in microtext in the lower left corner, "05" in small text in the lower right corner, and eight tiny pagination dots at the bottom center, with the fifth dot highlighted as a slender white capsule, and the rest as dark gray dots. Add a small navigation tooltip in the bottom right corner: "← → Page Turn · ESC Close". Overall atmosphere: editorial style, restraint, cinematic feel, memory and loss, high-end Keynote slide design, clean spacing, precise alignment, and sophisticated narrative presentation aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个极简主义电影感演示 Slides，采用深黑色背景和高端编辑风格 PPT 排版，比例为 16:9 宽屏。布局采用非对称设计，左侧为大面积文本块，右上角放置一张纪实风格照片，留出充裕的负空间。使用优雅且高对比度的中文字体，营造出高端杂志的质感。在左上角放置一行小型大写微型文字：“PHOTO • HUMAN STORY”。在其下方，添加另一行小型大写文字：“MEMORY HAS WEIGHT”。左侧的主标题为非常醒目的白色粗体中文字体，分为两行：{argument name="headline text" default="被删除的不是助手，\n是熟悉感。"}。在标题下方，放置一段较小的白色或浅灰色中文段落，共两行：{argument name="body text" default="文章里的邮件助手故事很有力量：同一个模板可以重建，但语气、\n偏好、隐性规则，都要重新教一遍。"}。下方添加一个深色半透明引用框，左侧边缘带有一条细长的白色垂直线；框内包含两层文本：中文引用内容 {argument name="quote" default="没有记忆, Agent 很容易被复制; 有了记忆, 体验才开始变得专属。"}，以及一行较小的署名文字“配图类型 · 人文纪实照片”。在右侧，插入一张暖色调的人文纪实照片：一名成年人背对镜头，坐在昏暗的办公室书桌前看着电脑显示器；显示器左侧立着一盏台灯，墙上贴着文件，柔和的日光透过窗户洒入。显示器屏幕上显示着简洁的白色界面，居中文字为 {argument name="screen text" default="Your conversational Assistant has been deleted."}。照片应呈现胶片摄影质感，色调为柔和的棕色和灰色，氛围私密、深沉且略带忧郁。添加类似界面的分页细节：右上角显示“05 / 08”，左下角微型文字“PHOTOGRAPHIC ANCHOR · MEMORY LOSS STORY”，右下角小字“05”，底部中心放置 8 个微小的分页圆点，其中第 5 个圆点高亮显示为细长的白色胶囊状，其余为暗灰色圆点。在最右下角，添加微小的导航提示“← → 翻页 · ESC 关闭”。整体氛围：编辑风格、克制、电影感、记忆与缺失、高端 Keynote 幻灯片设计、简洁的间距、精准的对齐、高端叙事演示美学。

templates.title: Dark-themed AI product presentation slides

titleLocalized.zh: 深色系 AI 产品演示文稿 Slides

templates.prompt: This is a sophisticated, dark-toned presentation slide with a minimalist, tech-inspired design. It features a 16:9 widescreen layout, a matte black background, and elegant gray-white typography with subtle gray dividing lines. The overall atmosphere is stylish, cinematic, and high-end, reminiscent of a product launch or a well-designed AI startup presentation. Two lines of small navigation text, "UI SCENE · OPEN HARNESS," are placed in the upper left corner, below which is "DEEP AGENTS," in a thin, uppercase sans-serif font with ample letter spacing. A small page indicator in the upper right corner displays "07 / 08." The main title occupies the upper left corner, using an elegant, large serif font with a mix of English and Chinese text.{argument name="headline text" default="Open up harness, open up memories."} Below that, add two lines of Chinese text using a smaller serif font:{argument name="body text" default="The solution is not to let the model vendor manage the state for you, but to put the harness, standards, and memory backend back into the hands of the developers."} In the left-center area, create three horizontal functional rows separated by thin gray lines. Each row uses a bold Chinese label on the left, a brief Chinese description in the middle, and a tiny uppercase English keyword aligned on the right. The first row is labeled "Standard," with the description "agents.md/skills make contextual entries visible," and the keyword "OPEN." The second row is labeled "Model," with the description "Models are replaceable; memories should not be tied to a single platform," and the keyword "AGNOSTIC." The third row is labeled "Storage," with the description "Mongo/Postgres/Redis can be used as self-owned memory backends," and the keyword "OWNED." On the right, place a large embedded UI mockup within a light gray rounded rectangle with subtle shadows, similar to a screenshot of a product project dashboard. The mockup should be a solid light beige and gray, with a structured layout divided into three main columns. The left column features a narrow vertical icon sidebar, a panel listing items/files such as "agents.md," "skills," "workflows," "memories," and "tools," and a code editor block at the bottom. The middle column, titled "Model Independent," contains four rows of selectable models and small controls, with three function cards at the bottom. The right column, titled "Memory Backend," contains three database cards: MongoDB, Postgres, and Redis, and a bottom panel titled "Portable," displaying a code snippet. Within the models is another top card titled "Open Standards," with tab-like controls. In the lower left corner outside the models, a small line of text in both Chinese and English reads: "UI Scenario Diagram - Three Same-Height Panel Test." At the bottom center, there's a carousel indicator consisting of eight small dots; the seventh dot is highlighted as a short white capsule, while the others are dark gray circles. A small page number "07" is placed in the lower right corner. Additionally, a subtle footer (in both Chinese and English) is added near the lower right edge, very discreetly, such as a demo metadata line. The presentation utilizes precise grid alignment, ample white space, understated luxury, Swiss-style composition, and refined aesthetics reminiscent of YouMind AI product presentations.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张采用极简主义编辑科技风格的高级深色演示幻灯片，16:9 宽屏布局，哑光黑色背景，配以精致的灰白色排版和微妙的灰色分割线。整体氛围时尚、具有电影感且高端，类似于产品发布会或设计感十足的 AI 初创公司演示文稿。在左上角放置两行小型导航文字：“UI SCENE · OPEN HARNESS”，下方为“DEEP AGENTS”，采用纤细的大写无衬线字体，并带有宽阔的字间距。在右上角添加一个小型页面指示器，显示“07 / 08”。主标题占据左上方，采用优雅的大号衬线中英文混合排版：{argument name="headline text" default="开放 harness,开放记忆。"}。在其下方，添加一段 2 行的中文正文，使用较小的衬线字体：{argument name="body text" default="解决方案不是让模型供应商替你保管状态,而是把 harness、标准和记忆后端都放回开发者手里。"}。在左中部区域，创建 3 行由细灰线分隔的水平功能行，每行左侧使用加粗的中文标签，中间为简短的中文描述，右侧对齐一个微小的大写英文关键词。第 1 行标签：“标准”，描述：“agents.md / skills 让上下文入口可见。”，关键词：“OPEN”。第 2 行标签：“模型”，描述：“模型可替换,记忆不应被单一平台绑定。”，关键词：“AGNOSTIC”。第 3 行标签：“存储”，描述：“Mongo / Postgres / Redis 可作为自有记忆后端。”，关键词：“OWNED”。在右侧，将一个大型嵌入式 UI 模型放置在带有微妙阴影的浅灰色圆角矩形框内，类似于产品项目仪表板的截图。模型应为单色浅米色和灰色，结构严谨，分为 3 个主要列。左列：一个狭窄的垂直图标侧边栏，加上一个列出“agents.md”、“skills”、“workflows”、“memories”、“tools”等项目/文件的面板，底部为一个代码编辑器块。中列：一个标题为“模型无关”的部分，包含 4 行可选模型和小型控件，底部有 3 张功能卡片。右列：一个标题为“记忆后端”的部分，包含 MongoDB、Postgres 和 Redis 的 3 张数据库卡片，以及底部一个标题为“可迁移”的面板，显示一段代码片段。在模型中包含另一张顶部卡片，标题为“开放标准”，带有类似标签页的控件。在模型外部的左下角，添加一行微小的中英文说明文字：“UI 情景图 · 三张同高画面板测试”。在底部中心，包含一个由 8 个小圆点组成的轮播指示器，第 7 个点高亮显示为短白色胶囊状，其余为暗灰色圆圈。在右下角放置一个小页码“07”。此外，在右下边缘附近添加一行微弱的微小页脚注释（中英文），非常隐蔽，例如演示元数据行。使用精确的网格对齐、大量的留白、低调的奢华感、瑞士风格的构图以及精致的 YouMind AI 产品主题演讲美学。

templates.title: AI-powered partnership announcement poster scenario

titleLocalized.zh: AI 合作伙伴关系发布海报场景

templates.prompt: A warm, editorially styled announcement poster, set in a sunny creative studio, creates a comfortable startup work environment. At the center of the composition are two adorable mascots seated side-by-side on a beige sofa, surrounded by photographers, journalists, and content creators capturing the moment. Above them, a huge hand-drawn poster hangs on a light-colored brick wall, displaying the words "Big news. Better together" in oversized brushstrokes.{argument name="brand name" default="Skywork"} ×{argument name="product name" default="GPT Image 2"} The text is surrounded by playful, colorful decorative brushstrokes. The mascot on the left is a glossy blue chibi character with a rounded body, large black oval eyes, a smiling face, a white facial panel, a paintbrush-like crown, palette patterns on its cheeks, and a white "S" mark on its abdomen, gesturing happily with one hand. The mascot on the right is a small white and cyan robot with a rounded helmet-like head, a black facial screen, glowing cyan eyes and a smile, cyan circuitry details all over its body, and a cyan spiral badge on its chest, also smiling and gesturing as if in conversation. In front of them is a wooden coffee table with exactly eight visible items: a small potted plant, a white mug with "PIXELS IDEAS IMPACT" printed on it, three stacked design books, an open sketchbook (containing concept sketches), a pen, a flat smartphone, and a smartphone taking a picture of the mascot in the foreground. Surrounding the scene are exactly seven... Several real people enter the frame; some hold DSLR cameras, one holds a video camera with a flip screen, and there are three microphones with square microphone tags labeled "TECH NEWS," "AI ZONE," and another media name. A translucent cyan holographic interface panel is added next to the robot, hinting at AI-generated visuals and design tools. The walls and shelves are decorated with details of a creative studio: art prints and posters pinned to the walls, bearing phrases like "Create Inspire Elevate," "CREATIVITY MEETS INTELLIGENCE," "IMAGINE GENERATE ELEVATE," and "FUTURE IS CREATIVE," along with brush illustrations, printed circuit diagrams, books, plants, and a studio light in the upper right corner. The lighting is golden sunlight streaming in from large industrial windows on both sides, creating a cinematic, optimistic launch event atmosphere. Style: A combination of exquisite 3D illustration and commercial lifestyle photography, highly detailed, friendly, branded, with vibrant yet tasteful colors, soft depth of field, sophisticated poster composition, and a square format.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张温暖的编辑风格公告海报，背景设定在阳光明媚的创意工作室中，营造出舒适的初创公司办公氛围。构图中心为两个可爱的吉祥物并排坐在米色沙发上，周围环绕着记录这一时刻的摄影师、记者和内容创作者。在他们上方，浅色砖墙上悬挂着一张巨大的手绘海报，上面用超大号笔刷字体写着“Big news. Better together. {argument name="brand name" default="Skywork"} × {argument name="product name" default="GPT Image 2"}”，文字周围带有俏皮的彩色装饰笔触。左侧吉祥物是一个光泽感十足的蓝色 Q 版角色，拥有圆润的身体、大大的黑色椭圆形眼睛、微笑的脸庞、白色面部面板、头顶画笔状的冠饰、脸颊上的调色板图案以及腹部的白色“S”标志，正用一只手快乐地打着手势。右侧吉祥物是一个白色与青色相间的小型机器人，拥有圆润的头盔状头部、黑色面部屏幕、发光的青色眼睛和微笑、遍布全身的青色电路细节以及胸前的青色螺旋徽章，同样微笑着并像在交谈一样打着手势。在他们面前放置一张木制咖啡桌，桌上正好有 8 件可见物品：1 盆小盆栽、1 个印有“PIXELS IDEAS IMPACT”字样的白色马克杯、3 本堆叠的设计书籍、1 本打开的素描本（上面有概念草图）、1 支笔、1 部平放的智能手机，以及 1 部在前景中拍摄吉祥物的智能手机。场景周围环绕着正好 7 个部分进入画面的真人，有些人拿着单反相机，一人拿着带有翻转屏幕的摄像机，还有 3 个带有方形麦克风牌的麦克风，分别标有“TECH NEWS”、“AI ZONE”和另一个媒体名称。在机器人旁边添加半透明的青色全息界面面板，暗示 AI 生成的视觉效果和设计工具。墙壁和架子上装饰着创意工作室的细节：钉在墙上的艺术印刷品和海报，上面写着“Create Inspire Elevate”、“CREATIVITY MEETS INTELLIGENCE”、“IMAGINE GENERATE ELEVATE”和“FUTURE IS CREATIVE”，此外还有画笔插图、电路图印刷品、书籍、植物以及右上角的摄影棚灯。灯光为黄金时段的阳光，从两侧的大型工业窗户射入，营造出电影般、乐观的发布会氛围。风格：精致的 3D 插画与商业生活摄影相结合，高度细节化，友好，品牌感强，色彩鲜艳但有品位，柔和的景深，高级海报构图，方形格式。

templates.title: Holographic AI Visionary Collector's Card

titleLocalized.zh: 全息 AI 远见者收藏卡

templates.prompt: This is an extremely detailed, collector-grade card illustration, presented in a high-end holographic monster card style, with a 2.5:3 vertical layout and a thick metallic gold border and glossy foil texture. Her face is deliberately obscured by a large, softly-edged rectangular blur effect in the center. A silver badge reading "BASIC" is located in the upper left corner. The large title text at the top center reads {argument name="headline text" default="Sam Altman"} Below is a smaller silver ribbon subtitle{argument name="subtitle" default="AI Visionary"} The upper right corner displays HP 130 and a small, circular tech energy icon. The background is filled with glowing blue, purple, and gold circuits, stars, and data-like streaks. To the left and behind the character, there is a bright neon badge that looks like an AI knot-like symbol floating above a vertical beam of light. The upper right corner contains a white network diagram with connecting nodes, labeled MODELS, and slightly below it is a circular interface ring labeled ALIGNMENT. Near the lower right of the portrait area, the curved horizon of Earth is displayed, with glowing interconnected lines covering the planet. To the lower left of the portrait area, there is a dark cyan billboard-style panel with the text BUILDING SAFE & BENEFICIAL AGI, below which is a tiny silhouette of a character. Also to the lower left, overlapping with the portrait frame, is a black and gold badge with a brain chip symbol and the word LEGEND. Below the portrait, add a silver information bar that reads "NO. 1985 Tech Entrepreneur HT: 5'9" WT: 165 lbs". The lower half of the card contains three game text areas. The first section features a red metallic capsule title labeled "Ability," with the purple title "Scale Intelligence" and a small tech energy icon to the right; below that is a black rule text describing a strategic deck-finding ability. The second section is the attack line, with three small circular energy icons on the left, the bold attack name "Model Leap," and right-aligned damage 70+; below that is a short black explanatory sentence. The third section is another attack line, with four small circular energy icons on the left, the bold attack name "AGI Catalyst," and right-aligned damage 120; below that is another explanatory sentence. Below these, add an italicized quote box with a slanted silver border, containing the text "{argument name="quote" default="The cost of intelligence will eventually converge to near the cost of electricity." — Sam Altman}". At the very bottom, there is a section with 3... The attribute bars for each labeled component include: Weakness x2 with a blue lightning bolt icon, Resistance -30 with a gray shield icon, and Retreat with two black arrow energy symbols. templates.title: Cute Google Fonts tutorial infographic

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱的 Google Fonts 教程信息图

templates.prompt:
Create a lovely, soft, Japanese-style infographic slide with a clean white background and soft, rounded abstract color blocks in light blue, cream, and light green. The design is friendly, educational, and modern, featuring bold, rounded Japanese typography, subtle shadows, thin gray outlines, dotted line separators, and small decorative doodles. At the top center, place a striking, deep navy blue title that reads "How to Use Google Fonts." Directly below it, add a blue subtitle that reads "Importing with 3 Steps," flanked by a row of small blue dots. In the upper right corner, add a circular blue page badge that reads "2/2." Arrange three rounded rectangular step cards evenly from left to right in the middle row at the top. Each card has a light background, soft borders, and a colorful circular badge with a number in the upper left corner. Card 1 has a light blue background and a blue badge with "1" written inside. The first card features a simple magnifying glass icon overlaid on the letter "Aa," decorated with a small yellow star. The bold title reads "Select Fonts," and the smaller text below reads "Explore Fonts You Like." Card 2 has a light green background with a green badge containing the number "2." It displays a browser window icon with parentheses "...".</> The clipboard is displayed with a small green animated marker. The bold title reads "Copy the code," and the smaller text below reads "Get the link @import ." Card 3 has a light cream background with an orange badge containing the number "3." Inside, a document icon labeled "CSS" is displayed with a small orange decorative marker. The bold title reads "Specify in CSS," and the smaller text below reads "Set up font-family." Two medium-sized blue triangular arrows are placed between the three cards to illustrate the process. In the lower center, three horizontally aligned presentation boxes are created. The left box is a rounded white code panel with a small blue label that reads "HTML." Inside, the following code is displayed in blue text, strictly divided into three lines: <link href=\"https://fonts.googleapis.com/"
"css2?family=Kiwi+Maru&display=swap"
"rel=\"stylesheet\"> The middle frame is a rounded white code panel with a small green label that says "CSS". Inside, it displays "body {" " font-family: 'Kiwi Maru', serif;" "}" in dark text. The right frame is a rounded white simulated browser window with a light blue title bar and three tiny red, yellow, and green circular window buttons in the upper left corner. Inside, it displays the black Japanese sample text "こんにちは、 Kiwi Maru" in a cute, rounded handwritten font. Two small glitter decorations are added to the right side of this browser window. At the bottom, four pill-shaped badges are placed from left to right. Badge 1 is white with a small blue star icon and the text "Google Fonts を使うメリット". Badge 2 is light blue with the bold text "無料" and a pink heart. Badge 3 is light green with the bold text "すぐ使える" and a small alarm clock icon. Badge 4... The canvas is pale yellow, featuring the bold text "日本語フォントも豊富" (Japanese vocabulary is abundant) and a small flower icon. Four additional decorative elements are added around the canvas: a yellow three-stroke glitter above the title, a light blue dotted grid in the upper left background, a thin light green ring on the left, and a miniature smiling bonsai illustration in the lower left. Maintaining the overall flat vector style, the design is clear, cute, and highly legible, reminiscent of a social media educational carousel.

promptLocalized.zh:
创建一个可爱的柔和日系信息图 Slides，背景为干净的白色，配有淡蓝色、奶油色和浅绿色的柔和圆角抽象色块。设计风格友好、具有教育意义且现代，采用粗圆体日文排版、微妙的投影、细灰色轮廓、虚线分隔符以及小巧的装饰性涂鸦。在顶部中心，放置一个深海军蓝色的醒目大标题，内容为“Google Fontsの使い方”。在其正下方，添加一个蓝色的副标题，内容为“3ステップでかんたん導入”，两侧配有一排蓝色小圆点。在右上角，添加一个圆形的蓝色页面徽章，写着“2/2”。

在上部中间一行排列 3 张圆角矩形步骤卡片，从左到右均匀分布，每张卡片都有淡色背景、柔和边框，并在左上角有一个带数字的彩色圆形徽章。卡片 1 背景为淡蓝色，蓝色徽章内写有“1”。内部展示一个简单的放大镜图标覆盖在“Aa”字母上，并配有一个黄色小星星装饰。粗体标题为“フォントを選ぶ”，下方较小的文字为“Google Fontsで
好きなフォントを探す”。卡片 2 背景为淡绿色，绿色徽章内写有“2”。内部展示一个浏览器窗口图标，包含代码括号“</>”和剪贴板，并配有绿色小动效标记。粗体标题为“コードをコピー”，下方较小的文字为“linkタグや@importを
取得する”。卡片 3 背景为淡奶油色，橙色徽章内写有“3”。内部展示一个标有“CSS”的文档图标，并配有橙色小装饰标记。粗体标题为“CSSで指定”，下方较小的文字为“font-family に設定して
使う”。在 3 张卡片之间放置 2 个中等大小的蓝色三角形箭头以展示流程。

在下部中间，创建 3 个水平对齐的演示框。左侧框是一个圆角白色代码面板，带有一个写着“HTML”的蓝色小标签。内部以蓝色文字显示以下代码，严格分为 3 行：“<link href=\"https://fonts.googleapis.com/"
"css2?family=Kiwi+Maru&display=swap"
"rel=\"stylesheet\">”。中间框是一个圆角白色代码面板，带有一个写着“CSS”的绿色小标签。内部以深色文字显示：“body {"
"    font-family: 'Kiwi Maru', serif;"
"}”。右侧框是一个圆角白色模拟浏览器窗口，带有淡蓝色标题栏，左上角有 3 个红、黄、绿色的微型圆形窗口按钮。内部显示黑色的日文示例文本“こんにちは、
Kiwi Maru”，使用可爱的圆角手写体。在该浏览器窗口右侧添加 2 个小闪光装饰。

在底部，从左到右放置 4 个药丸形状的徽章。徽章 1 为白色，带有一个蓝色小星星图标和文字“Google Fontsを使うメリット”。徽章 2 为淡蓝色，带有粗体文字“無料”及一颗粉色爱心。徽章 3 为淡绿色，带有粗体文字“すぐ使える”及一个小闹钟图标。徽章 4 为淡黄色，带有粗体文字“日本語フォントも豊富”及一朵小花图标。

在画布周围添加 4 个额外的装饰元素：标题左上方的一个黄色三笔闪光，左上角背景的一个淡蓝色虚线方格网，左侧的一个细浅绿色圆环，以及左下角的一个微型微笑盆栽插图。保持整体构图为扁平矢量风格，清晰、可爱且高度易读，呈现出社交媒体教育轮播图的风格。

templates.title: Pokémon anime shop clothing preview poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫 Pokémon 商店服装预告海报

templates.prompt: A dreamy, pastel anime-style fashion poster is set inside a bright Pokémon merchandise store. The vertical composition visually divides the space into two areas: a large, semi-transparent information panel on the left and a full-body Pokémon display on the right. The atmosphere is soft, elegant, and light, with diffused indoor lighting, creamy highlights, soft reflections on the polished floor, and a delicate shoujo manga illustration style. The background clearly shows the interior of the Pokémon store, including shelves, the Pokémon logo, large Poké Ball badges on the wall, potted plants, plush toys, and figurines. Visible Pokémon merchandise includes three prominent plush toys or mascots: Pikachu in the lower right corner, and two smaller plush toys on the shelf resembling Piplup and others in pastel blue tones. A girl stands slightly to the right of center, striking an elegant, fashionable pose, one leg crossed in front of the other, one hand gently raised near her chest, the other relaxed outwards. Her face is deliberately obscured by a soft, rectangular blur. She has long, wavy hair, the color of which is {argument name="hair color" default="Platinum"} Her hair was curly, and her appearance was delicate and graceful. She wore an exquisite pastel outfit: a white turtleneck blouse with layered ruffles, a light blue sleeveless suspender dress (cinched at the waist with a flowing midi skirt), a small white crossbody bag with a flap, white socks, and shiny black Mary Jane shoes. She wore delicate pink earrings. The overall feel of the outfit was elegant, fresh, and lovely, with a lightweight fabric. To the left was a frosted semi-transparent poster panel with elegant typography and decorative patterns. The panel contained five clearly defined text blocks or label areas: 1) A top banner with the Japanese text "次回衣装プロンプト公開" above and large conjoined English text below.{argument name="headline text" default="Next Outfit"} 2) A name block containing the Japanese name "セラス・柳田・リリエンフェルト" and the smaller Romanized spelling "Ceras Yanagida Lilienfeld"; 3) A teaser text "次回の衣装もお楽しみに！" followed by a small Poké Ball icon; 4) A bordered description box titled "Next Coordinate," followed by several lines of small Japanese text; 5) A ribbon at the bottom with the text "..."{argument name="footer text" default="Coming Soon..."} The logo reads "STAY TUNED!" and features a small Pikachu silhouette. The overall color scheme is light blue, white, silver-gray, and blush pink. Subtle decorative edges are added, creating a sophisticated promotional layout reminiscent of a boutique fashion teaser poster, used for revealing the costumes of the themed anime character.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张梦幻般的粉彩动漫时尚发布海报，场景设定在明亮的 Pokémon 商品店内。构图呈垂直状，视觉上分为两个区域：左侧是一个大型半透明信息面板，右侧是全身角色展示。场景氛围柔和、优雅且轻盈，带有漫射的室内光线、奶油色高光、抛光地板上的柔和倒影，以及精致的少女漫画插画风格。背景中展示清晰可辨的 Pokémon 商店内部，包括陈列架、Pokémon 标志、墙上的大型精灵球徽章、盆栽、毛绒玩具和手办；可见的 Pokémon 商品包括 3 个醒目的毛绒玩具或吉祥物：右下角的皮卡丘，以及架子上 2 个类似波加曼和其他粉蓝色调的小型毛绒玩具。女孩站在画面中心偏右的位置，摆出优雅的时尚姿势，一条腿交叉在另一条腿前，一只手轻轻抬起靠近胸前，另一只手自然向外放松。她的面部被一个柔和的矩形模糊块刻意遮挡。她留着长长的波浪卷发，颜色为 {argument name="hair color" default="铂金色"}，发丝卷曲，外形精致柔美。她穿着一套精致的粉彩服装：带有层叠荷叶边的白色高领衬衫、浅蓝色无袖背带连衣裙（收腰设计，配有飘逸的中长款裙摆）、一个带有翻盖的小型白色斜挎包、白色短袜和亮面黑色玛丽珍鞋。佩戴精致的粉色耳环。服装整体感觉优雅、清新且可爱，面料质感轻盈。在左侧放置一个磨砂半透明海报面板，配以优雅的排版和装饰性花纹。面板上包含 5 个明确的文本块或标签区域：1) 顶部横幅，上方是日文“次回衣装プロンプト公開”，下方是大号连体英文文本 {argument name="headline text" default="Next Outfit"}；2) 姓名块，包含日文“セラス・柳田・リリエンフェルト”及较小的罗马拼音“Ceras Yanagida Lilienfeld”；3) 一行预告文字“次回の衣装も お楽しみに！”，并配有一个小型精灵球图标；4) 一个带边框的描述框，标题为“Next Coordinate”，后跟几行小型日文正文；5) 底部丝带，文字为 {argument name="footer text" default="Coming Soon..."} 和“STAY TUNED!”，并配有一个小型皮卡丘剪影。整体采用淡蓝色、白色、银灰色和腮红粉色调。添加淡淡的装饰性边角，呈现出如同精品时尚预告海报般的精致宣传布局，用于主题动漫角色服装揭秘。

templates.title: Civilization-style Japanese island cities

titleLocalized.zh: 文明系列风格的日本岛屿城市

templates.prompt: A highly detailed isometric screenshot of a grand strategy game, employing a modern historical 4X game interface style, showcasing {argument name="civilization name" default="Japanese Empire"} exist{argument name="era" default="1260 AD"} A densely packed island port city from a specific period. The city almost covers the entire island, surrounded by vibrant turquoise waters and deep blue sea. The city's layout is extremely dense and organic, featuring hundreds of closely packed low-rise wooden buildings, narrow, winding streets, numerous docks and piers, and bustling port infrastructure surrounding the coastline. At the island's center stand four prominent landmarks: three large traditional East Asian temples or palaces with tiered blue-green tiled roofs, arranged around a wide plaza; and a towering red pagoda located slightly to the right of the center. Numerous smaller shrines, courtyards, stone paths, groves, and pale pink cherry blossoms scattered among the rooftops are interspersed throughout. The island's topography should feature slight elevation changes, rocky edges, and several port entrances, connected by bridges and wooden waterfront platforms. Sixteen vessels of various types should be accurately visible in the surrounding waters: large sailing ships, medium-sized merchant ships, and small boats, some moored at the docks, others anchored offshore. Wisps of smoke rising from various parts of the city and port suggest industrial and daily activities. The overall lighting is bright afternoon sunlight, with sharp shadows and highly saturated colors that highlight the clear water, weathered wood, ceramic roof tiles, and coastal rocks. The camera angle is high, with a wide field of view and a slight tilt, like a city overview in a top-tier strategy game. templates.title: The whimsical cast of residents of the animated town

titleLocalized.zh: 异想天开的动画小镇居民阵容

templates.prompt: A clear cast list against a pure white background showcases 13 stylized 3D characters in a whimsical stop-motion animation style, featuring exaggerated proportions, textured fabrics, worn surfaces, soft earth tones, and a slightly eerie yet captivating personality. Arranged in two rows: seven characters at the top and six at the bottom, each character is accompanied by soft, grounded shadows and ample white space, much like a studio casting board for an animated film. The top row, from left to right: 1) A very tall and thin middle-aged man, wearing a worn brown suit, white shirt, narrow red tie, and plaid trousers, with long, slender fingers and a languid posture; 2) A short, plump elderly woman with red curly hair, wearing a pink cardigan over a floral dress, comfortable shoes, and carrying a brown handbag; 3) A very burly man with tattoos on his forearms, wearing a red plaid flannel shirt, suspenders, dark worn trousers, and heavy boots, presenting a rugged worker's image; 4) A thin, gothic-style girl with pale skin. 5) A thin teenager wearing a messy black ponytail, a black jacket, a dark shirt, and skinny jeans, arms crossed, looking bored; 6) A very tall old woman with an elegant beehive hairstyle, a long face, wearing a brown shirt, scarf, long brown skirt, high heels, and a handbag, holding a cigarette in one hand; 7) A slender teenager or young man with dark curly hair, wearing a striped sweater, skinny jeans, and brown shoes. Bottom row, from left to right: 8) A haggard, frail old man, wearing tattered wads of clothes and a stained apron, leaning forward, looking exhausted; 9) A thin middle-aged woman, her hair piled high in a bun, wearing a mustard yellow cardigan, a blue long skirt, flat shoes, and a shoulder bag, carefully carrying something in front of her chest; 10) A stocky police officer, wearing a heavy navy blue winter uniform with a fur collar, badges, a multi-functional belt, dark trousers, and black shoes; 11) A chubby, curly-haired boy, wearing a hoodie under a sleeveless baseball jacket, knee-length shorts, socks, and sneakers, gripping a backpack strap tightly; 12) A emaciated old man, wearing a hat, with a large nose and a hunched back, wearing a long coat and tight pants, leaning on a cane; 13) A tall, thin mechanic or gas station worker, wearing a dark blue overall and hat with writing visible on it.{argument name="cap text" default="GAS"} Holding a wrench. Maintain a high level of detail in the rendering, showcasing the realism of felt, wool, denim, knitwear, leather, and dusty textures, while preserving cartoonish anatomy and expressive silhouettes. Use soft tones of brown, rust red, dusty pink, charcoal gray, navy blue, beige, and faded denim. The overall atmosphere should evoke the eccentric residents of a run-down town from a darkly comedic animated feature film, presenting a sophisticated ensemble casting project.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张纯白背景下的清晰角色阵容表，展示了 13 个全身风格化 3D 角色，采用异想天开的定格动画风格设计，具有夸张的比例、纹理织物、磨损表面、柔和的大地色调，以及略带诡异却又迷人的个性。将它们排列成 2 行：顶部一行 7 个角色，底部一行 6 个角色，每个角色都带有柔和的接地阴影并留有充足的留白，就像动画电影的工作室选角项目（casting board）一样。顶部一行，从左到右：1）一个极高且瘦削的中年男子，身穿破旧的棕色西装、白衬衫、窄红领带和格子裤，手指修长，姿态慵懒；2）一个矮胖的老年妇女，留着红色的卷发，穿着粉色开衫搭配碎花连衣裙，穿着舒适的鞋子，拎着棕色手提包；3）一个非常魁梧的壮汉，前臂有纹身，穿着红色格子法兰绒衬衫、背带、深色磨损长裤和厚重的靴子，呈现出粗犷的工人形象；4）一个瘦削的哥特风少女，皮肤苍白，扎着凌乱的黑色马尾，穿着黑色夹克、深色衬衫和紧身牛仔裤，双臂交叉，表情无聊；5）一个瘦长的少年，戴着针织帽，穿着叠穿的连帽衫和夹克，搭配紧身牛仔裤和运动鞋，双手插兜；6）一个非常高大的老妇人，留着优雅的蜂窝头，脸型狭长，穿着棕褐色衬衫、围巾、长棕色裙子，搭配高跟鞋和手提包，一只手拿着香烟；7）一个苗条的青少年或年轻男性，留着深色卷发，穿着条纹毛衣、窄腿裤和棕色鞋子。底部一行，从左到右：8）一个憔悴虚弱的老人，穿着破烂的叠穿衣服和沾有污渍的围裙，身体前倾，姿态疲惫；9）一个瘦削的中年妇女，头发盘成高发髻，穿着芥末黄开衫、蓝色长裙，搭配平底鞋和单肩包，双手在胸前小心翼翼地拿着东西；10）一个敦实的警官，穿着厚重的海军蓝冬季制服，带有毛领、徽章、多功能腰带、深色长裤和黑色鞋子；11）一个胖乎乎的卷发男孩，穿着连帽衫外搭无袖棒球夹克，搭配及膝短裤、袜子和运动鞋，紧紧抓着背包带；12）一个骨瘦如柴的老人，戴着帽子，大鼻子，脊椎佝偻，穿着长外套、紧身裤，拄着拐杖；13）一个瘦长的机械师或加油站工人，穿着深蓝色连体工作服和帽子，帽子上可见文字 {argument name="cap text" default="GAS"}，手里拿着一把扳手。保持渲染的高度细节，展现毛毡、羊毛、牛仔布、针织、皮革和灰尘般的材质真实感，同时保持漫画式的解剖结构和富有表现力的剪影。使用棕色、铁锈红、灰粉色、炭灰色、海军蓝、米色和褪色牛仔布的柔和色调。整体氛围应如同来自一部黑色幽默动画长片中破旧小镇的古怪居民，呈现为一张精致的群像选角项目。

templates.prompt: A fashionable young woman wearing{argument name="headwear" default="beige headscarf"} Wearing round-framed glasses, she stood on a quiet city street lined with modern brick buildings and boutiques. She was dressed in a {argument name="top color" default="maroon"} of{argument name="top style" default="Long-sleeved sweatshirt"} She wore white stripes on the cuffs and a striking graphic logo on the front, paired with loose-fitting black trousers. She carried a small black shoulder bag, casually posing with one hand in her pocket, confidently looking at the camera. Behind her were retro-style signs hanging vertically from buildings and large glass storefronts displaying clothing. The streets were clean, and the sky was a soft overcast, creating even, natural lighting. The overall aesthetic was minimalist, stylish, and slightly cinematic, with soft colors exuding a comfortable urban atmosphere.

The posture is strong, his gaze focused beyond the frame. Bottom Right Panel — Mental Focus: The athlete sits on the floor or low cubes, elbows on knees, hand supporting chin, in a contemplative posture. A medicine ball is beside him. The graffiti should imitate, follow, or exaggerate the shapes, poses, or movements presented in the image, such as outlining poses, extending limbs, adding lines of motion, or creating creative elements that "interact" with the subject. Ensure the graffiti blends naturally into the scene, as if intentionally drawn on a photograph. Use a sketch-like, imperfect hand-drawn style, with organic lines, slightly uneven strokes, and a casual, illustrative feel. Add lively handwritten text elements around the image. The text should match the atmosphere or implied context of the scene, with a tone that is appropriate for the scene.{argument name="text tone" default="playful and spontaneous"} Avoid using fixed phrases; instead, generate contextual, creative, and humorous text based on each unique image. Maintain compositional balance so that the graffiti enhances the image's expressiveness without overshadowing it. The overall aesthetic should be playful, expressive, and suitable for social media sharing. High resolution, clear overlay effects, and vibrant, natural color harmony are required.

promptLocalized.zh:
分析上传的图像，并保留原始主体、构图和光影。请勿改变主体身份或结构。添加 {argument name="doodle style" default="playful, hand-drawn doodles"}，使其与图像中的主体产生直接互动。涂鸦应模仿、跟随或夸大图像中呈现的形状、姿势或动作，例如勾勒姿势、延伸肢体、添加运动线条，或创作出与主体“互动”的创意元素。

确保涂鸦自然地融入场景，仿佛是有意在照片上绘制的一样。

采用草图式、不完美的手绘风格，线条要有机、笔触略显不均匀，并带有随性的插画感。

在图像周围加入灵动的手写文字元素。文字应与场景的氛围或隐含语境相符，语气设定为 {argument name="text tone" default="playful and spontaneous"}。

避免使用固定短语，应根据每张独特的图像生成具有情境感、创意且幽默的文字。保持构图平衡，使涂鸦在增强图像表现力的同时，不会喧宾夺主。整体美学风格应保持趣味性、表现力，并适合社交媒体分享。要求高分辨率、清晰的叠加效果，以及鲜活且自然的色彩协调。

templates.title: E-commerce technology infographic

titleLocalized.zh: 电子商务科技信息图

templates.prompt: against"{argument name="product name" default="Apple MacBook Air M3"} A high-impact e-commerce infographic featuring a laptop. Aspect ratio: 1:1 square composition. Foreground: An extreme close-up of a hand holding an open, ultra-thin silver MacBook, facing the camera. The Apple logo is visible on the back of the display. The screen is slightly tilted, showcasing a vibrant gradient wallpaper. The hand and the edges of the laptop have a subtle macro lens blur effect to create depth and realism. Center subject (medium shot): A {argument name="model description" default="A young woman with a smiling face, freckles, and wavy light pink hair."} She was wearing a vibrant outfit.{argument name="outfit" default="lime-colored knitted beanie and black and white striped psychedelic long-sleeved shirt"} She stands confidently behind the MacBook, looking at the camera as if showcasing a product. Background and lighting: A clean studio background with a soft, light gray gradient. Diagonal rainbow prism lens flare and soft light leaks are added to create a sophisticated Apple aesthetic. Multiple blurred MacBooks float in the background at varying angles, creating depth and dynamism. The soft, diffused, and professional lighting highlights the laptops' metallic finish. Typography and Layout (Simple sans-serif font, white): Top center (background): Huge bold text: "MACBOOK" (placed behind the model, partially obscured) Top right corner: "Apple MacBook Air M3" Left side: "M3 chip, powerful performance" Right side: Eye-catching bold "18", with the text "Hours of battery life." Bottom right corner: Eye-catching bold "1", with the text "Yearly warranty." Bottom left corner (optional badge): "M3 chip. Fast response. Energy efficient." Style: 8K resolution, ultra-clean commercial product photography, vibrant and minimalist color tones, shallow depth of field, sharp focus on the MacBook, high-end Apple-style advertising aesthetics, glossy metallic reflections, modern technological brand feel.

promptLocalized.zh:
针对 "{argument name="product name" default="Apple MacBook Air M3"}" 笔记本电脑的高影响力电子商务信息图。
宽高比：1:1 正方形构图。
前景：
手持一台打开的超薄银色 MacBook 朝向镜头的极致特写。显示屏背面可见 Apple 标志。屏幕略微倾斜，展示着充满活力的渐变壁纸。手部和笔记本电脑边缘带有微妙的微距镜头模糊效果，以营造深度和真实感。
中心主体（中景）：
一位 {argument name="model description" default="面带微笑、长着雀斑、留着波浪形淡粉色头发的年轻女性"}。她穿着一件充满活力的 {argument name="outfit" default="青柠色针织冷帽和黑白条纹迷幻长袖衬衫"}。她自信地站在 MacBook 后方，看向镜头，仿佛在展示产品。
背景与灯光：
干净的摄影棚背景，带有柔和的浅灰色渐变。添加对角线彩虹棱镜镜头光晕和柔和的漏光效果，以呈现高级的 Apple 风格美学。背景中漂浮着多台模糊的 MacBook，角度各异，营造出深度和动感。灯光柔和、漫射且专业，突显笔记本电脑的金属质感。
排版与布局（简洁无衬线字体，白色）：
顶部中央（背景）：巨大的粗体文字：“MACBOOK”（置于模特身后，部分被遮挡）
右上角：“Apple MacBook Air M3”
中左侧：“M3 芯片，性能强劲”
中右侧：醒目粗体“18”，下方配文“小时电池续航。”
右下角：醒目粗体“1”，下方配文“年保修。”
左下角（可选徽章）：“M3 芯片。疾速响应。高效节能。”

风格：
8K 分辨率，超洁净商业产品摄影，充满活力且极简的色调，浅景深，焦点清晰对准 MacBook，高级 Apple 风格广告美学，光泽金属反射，现代科技品牌感。

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅风格化的数字插画，描绘了一位留着 {argument name="hair style" default="凌乱亮黄色短波波头"} 的年轻女性，她有着柔和的雀斑、自然的妆容和圆环耳环，身穿黄色长袖上衣。肖像采用了 {argument name="theme" default="超现实拼图构图"} 设计，她的面部和上半身被分割成拼图块。部分拼图块中融入了写实的绿色眼睛、鸟类插画、抽象纹理和几何色块等艺术元素。皮肤细腻光滑，五官轮廓分明，嘴唇光泽感强，构图对称，光线柔和，背景为 {argument name="background" default="柔和的粉色"}。超高细节，高分辨率，现代编辑艺术风格，阴影极少，轮廓清晰，构图美观且平衡。

templates.title: Fashion Magazine Collage Guide

titleLocalized.zh: 时尚杂志拼贴画指南

templates.prompt: A collage layout of an American fashion magazine, with{argument name="model name" default="Karina"} The main subject is against a clean, textured white background with subtle grid lines. The prominent title in the upper left corner reads, "{argument name="brand name" default="ZARA"} The "S 7-DAY OUTFIT GUIDE" is presented in black and pink font, adorned with playful star doodles. Below is a short English subtitle: "Zara's weekly style picks ❤️". To the right is a high-resolution image of Zara wearing a black sequined slip dress, looking directly at the camera with her hand on her chin. The upper right corner includes handwritten notes and hashtags such as #ZaraStyle #DailyLooks, surrounded by small hearts and star doodles. The central area displays seven "Polaroid-style" photos, arranged in two rows, labeled from MONDAY to SUNDAY. Each image is accompanied by a short, attractive English description, featuring casual handwritten notes and small arrows or heart doodles: MONDAY: A relaxed "casual vibe," wearing a navy blue baseball cap, a beige sweatshirt, and holding a coffee. ("Keep Mondays comfy and easy.") TUESDAY: A bold "street style," wearing a black nylon jacket. ("Turn up the street vibe.") WEDNESDAY: A sharp "office look," wearing a grey suit jacket and glasses, holding a mug. ("Smart and confident midweek energy.") THURSDAY: A gentle, feminine outfit, wearing a light blue cardigan. ("Light, soft, and effortlessly pretty.") FRIDAY: A sleek, "cool and chic" look, wearing a black leather jacket. ("All-black, all confidence.") SATURDAY: A romantic "date night" look, with wavy hair and an off-the-shoulder white top. ("Cute, flirty weekend mood.") SUNDAY: A comfortable "relaxation moment" outfit, wearing a beige knit sweater. ("Slow down and stay comfy.") (Bottom left corner features a...){argument name="brand name" default="ZARA"} A black label bearing the words "Zara" is accompanied by a brief English introduction about her fashion influence. Below is a "STYLE TIPS" section listing three simple English tips. The bottom edge includes a barcode graphic and the text: "Zara inspo for your everyday style."

promptLocalized.zh:
一份美式时尚杂志拼贴布局，以 {argument name="model name" default="Karina"} 为主角，背景为带有细微网格线的干净纹理白底。左上角醒目的标题为“{argument name="brand name" default="ZARA"}’S 7-DAY OUTFIT GUIDE”，采用黑色和粉色字体，并点缀着俏皮的星星涂鸦。下方有一行简短的英文副标题：“Zara’s weekly style picks ❤️”。

右侧是一张高清大图，展示了身穿黑色亮片吊带裙的 Zara，她直视镜头，手托下巴。右上角包含手写风格的笔记和 #ZaraStyle #DailyLooks 等标签，周围环绕着小爱心和星星涂鸦。

中心区域展示了七张“拍立得风格”的照片，分两行排列，分别标注从 MONDAY 到 SUNDAY。每张图片都配有简短、美观的英文说明，带有随性的手写笔记以及小箭头或爱心涂鸦：

MONDAY：轻松的“休闲氛围”，戴着海军蓝鸭舌帽，身穿米色卫衣，手拿咖啡。（“Keep Mondays comfy and easy.”）

TUESDAY：大胆的“街头风格”，身穿黑色尼龙夹克。（“Turn up the street vibe.”）

WEDNESDAY：干练的“办公室造型”，身穿灰色西装外套并佩戴眼镜，手拿马克杯。（“Smart and confident midweek energy.”）

THURSDAY：温柔的女性化穿搭，身穿浅蓝色开衫。（“Light, soft, and effortlessly pretty.”）

FRIDAY：利落的“时髦酷感”造型，身穿黑色皮夹克。（“All-black, all confidence.”）

SATURDAY：浪漫的“约会之夜”造型，留着波浪卷发，身穿露肩白色上衣。（“Cute, flirty weekend mood.”）

SUNDAY：舒适的“放松时刻”穿搭，身穿米色针织衫。（“Slow down and stay comfy.”）

左下角是一个带有“{argument name="brand name" default="ZARA"}”字样的黑色标签，配有一段关于她时尚影响力的简短英文介绍。下方是“STYLE TIPS”板块，列出了三条简单的英文小贴士。底部边缘包含一个条形码图形和一行文字：“Zara inspo for your everyday style.”

templates.title: K-Pop Dance Teaching Guide

titleLocalized.zh: K-Pop 舞蹈教学指南

templates.prompt: K-Pop Dance 16-Step Tutorial Guide (4x4 Grid) [Visual Style] High-end K-pop dance tutorial guide, featuring clear studio lighting composition in a monochrome grayscale style, strong contrast, modern editing style + performance aesthetics, clean white background, and no distracting elements [grid layout, strict requirements].{argument name="layout" default="4×4 grid (16 equally divided panels)"} Thin black dividing lines clearly label each panel from 1 to 16. Top left: Step number + brief title. Bottom left: 3-4 lines of brief description. Overlay: Arrow + action guide (curve, straight line, circle). [Character]{argument name="dancer description" default="South Korean female dancer (K-pop idol style)"} Slim, fit figure with long, flowing hair (soft waves or straight hair, dynamic). Confident, expressive K-pop performance energy. All 16 panels maintain the same character (consistent face and proportions). [Clothing K-POP style]{argument name="outfit" default="Fitted crop top, high-waisted loose jeans and sneakers"} The costumes should be trendy, inspired by idol stage performances. Fabrics should react naturally to movement (subtle wrinkles, dynamic feel). 🔢 [16 dance moves, sequence flow] Starting position: Right side step, left side step, hip swing combination, body downward rhythm, back step, leg sweep, quarter turn, hair flip and freeze, side step, drag, cross, back step and turn, body upward wave, hip circle, lock step, arm sweep, freeze, chest bounce and heavy beat, final freeze. [Panel structure, each frame] Center: Full body posture (clear dance move positions) Bottom left corner: Brief key points (clean layout) Movement arrows show direction, rotation, and fluidity, emphasizing rhythm, weight transfer, and the signature crispness of K-pop. [Movement style] Crisp heavy beats + smooth transitions (K-pop characteristic) Clear body control (hips, chest, arms) Expressive poses and attitude. [Rendering quality] Ultra-detailed, high resolution, clear anatomical structure and pose definition, smooth grayscale shadows, no blur, no distortion, no clutter. [Constraints] No background elements, no extra characters, no color (strict grayscale) – maintaining a minimalist teaching aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh:
K-Pop 舞蹈 16 步教学指南（4×4 网格）

[视觉风格]
高端 K-pop 舞蹈教学指南，单色灰度风格
清晰的影棚灯光构图，对比强烈
现代、编辑风 + 表演美学
干净的白色背景，无干扰元素

[网格布局，严格要求]
{argument name="layout" default="4×4 网格（16 个等分面板）"}
细黑色分割线
每个面板清晰标注 1–16 号
左上角：步骤编号 + 简短标题
左下角：3–4 行简短说明
叠加层：箭头 + 动作引导（曲线、直线、圆形）

[人物]
{argument name="dancer description" default="韩国女舞者（K-pop 偶像造型）"}
身材苗条、健美
长发造型（柔和波浪或直发，动态感）
自信、富有表现力的 K-pop 表演活力
所有 16 个面板保持同一人物（面部和比例一致）

[服装 K-POP 风格]
{argument name="outfit" default="修身短上衣、高腰宽松牛仔裤和运动鞋"}
服装应具有潮流感，灵感源自偶像舞台
面料随动作自然反应（细微褶皱、动态感）

🔢 [16 个舞蹈动作，序列流程]
起始姿势
右侧并步点地
左侧并步点地
胯部摆动组合
身体下压律动
后撤步扫腿
四分之一转轴转
甩发与定格
侧步拖拽
交叉后撤与转身
身体向上波浪
胯部绕环
锁步
手臂扫动定格
胸部弹动与重拍
最终定格

[面板结构，每个画面]
中心：全身姿势（清晰的舞蹈动作位置）
左下角：简短要点说明（排版整洁）
动作箭头显示方向、旋转和流动感
强调节奏、重心转移和 K-pop 标志性的利落感

[动作风格]
利落的重拍 + 流畅的过渡（K-pop 特色）
清晰的身体局部控制（胯部、胸部、手臂）
富有表现力的姿势与态度

[渲染质量]
超精细，高分辨率
清晰的解剖结构与姿势明确度
平滑的灰度阴影
无模糊、无畸变、无杂乱

[限制条件]
无背景元素
无额外人物
无颜色（严格灰度）
保持简洁的教学美学

templates.title: Low-angle urban street photography

titleLocalized.zh: 低角度城市街头摄影

templates.prompt: Hyperrealism{argument name="angle" default="Low angle"} Street photography, the subject is a{argument name="subject" default="A young man standing confidently"} Located in the heart of a modern city, surrounded by towering, symmetrical high-rise apartment buildings, it forms a geometric framework framing the sky. Shot from a low angle (a wormhole perspective), it creates a powerful and dominant visual effect. The subject is a stylish young man with short, curly hair and a light stubble, dressed in {argument name="outfit" default="Yellow rectangular sunglasses, a plain black oversized T-shirt, and beige cargo pants with camouflage patches."} He holds a clear water bottle in one hand. Black headphones hang around his neck, and a backpack strap is visible on his shoulder. His expression is calm and slightly serious, looking directly at the camera. Background: A bright blue sky dotted with soft clouds; buildings converge inward, creating strong leading lines and a sense of symmetry. Urban residential buildings feature repetitive windows and light-colored concrete tones. Lighting: Natural sunlight, sharp shadows, high contrast, sharp details, HDR quality. Composition: Centered subject, vertical composition, strong perspective distortion from a wide-angle lens (24mm or wider), cinematic depth of field. Style: A blend of fashion magazine and urban realism, ultra-detailed, 8K resolution, sharp focus, realistic skin texture, high dynamic range.

promptLocalized.zh:
超写实 {argument name="angle" default="低角度"} 街头摄影，拍摄对象为一位 {argument name="subject" default="自信站立的年轻男子"}，身处现代城市中心，四周被高耸对称的高层公寓楼环绕，形成了一个框住天空的几何框架。从地面向上仰拍（虫眼视角），营造出一种强大且极具主导力的视觉效果。

拍摄对象是一位留着短卷发、蓄着淡胡茬的时尚年轻男子，身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="黄色矩形墨镜、纯黑色廓形 T 恤、带有迷彩补丁的米色工装裤"}，单手拿着一个透明水瓶。脖子上挂着黑色耳机，肩上可见背包带。

表情冷静且略显严肃，直视镜头。

背景：明亮的蓝天，点缀着柔软的云朵，建筑向内汇聚，形成了强烈的引导线和对称感。城市住宅楼带有重复的窗户和浅色混凝土色调。

光影：自然日光，清晰的阴影，高对比度，锐利细节，HDR 质感。

构图：主体居中，垂直构图，广角镜头（24mm 或更广）带来的强烈透视畸变，电影级景深。

风格：时尚杂志与城市写实风格的结合，超精细，8k 分辨率，焦点锐利，真实的皮肤纹理，高动态范围。

templates.title: Skincare product advertising projects

titleLocalized.zh: 护肤品广告项目

templates.prompt: Create a clean and bright{argument name="product type" default="Skincare product advertisements"} The project uses a 16:9 aspect ratio and consists of 9 shots. Soft natural light is used to present a minimalist aesthetic, creating a fresh and light atmosphere, with white and soft colors as the main color scheme.{argument name="subject" default="The protagonist is a young woman with light makeup and an elegant hairstyle."} She is dressed in light and elegant clothing. The scene is set in a modern, sun-drenched interior with large windows, creating a tranquil atmosphere. There is no text or subtitles in the footage. A clear narrative unfolds: she begins at her desk, appearing somewhat tired or troubled, followed by a close-up of her face showing dry or dull skin. She discovers a clear bottle of skincare products and gently displays it. A close-up shows the liquid dripping onto her hand, followed by her applying the product to her face. After use, her skin looks hydrated, radiant, and smooth. The transition shifts to her feeling confident and refreshed, walking in a bright and clean space, accompanied by a gentle breeze and flowing elements. The scene concludes with a still-life shot of the product on a minimalist canvas, the final frame showing her holding the product and smiling gently at the camera. The focus is on natural expressions, radiant skin, and the transformation from dullness to freshness. Cinematic close-ups, soft focus, light and shadow reflections, and subtle glitter are incorporated to enhance the pure aesthetic. The overall style remains elegant, minimalist, and visually comfortable, without any branding text.

promptLocalized.zh:
创建一个简洁明亮的 {argument name="product type" default="护肤品广告"} 项目，采用 16:9 布局，共 9 个分镜。使用柔和的自然光，呈现极简美学，营造清新、轻盈的氛围，色调以白色和柔和色系为主。{argument name="subject" default="主角是一位妆容清透、发型精致的年轻女性"}，身着轻盈优雅的服装。场景设定在现代且阳光充足的室内，配有大窗户，氛围宁静。画面中不包含任何文字或字幕。

templates.title: Martial arts choreography poster

templates.prompt: A simple instructional poster, using a 4x4 grid (16 panels), showcases a male martial artist demonstrating Pencak Silat choreography. The protagonist is a muscular man with medium-length dark hair and a beard, wearing a red shirt, beige trousers, and white sneakers. The style is semi-realistic illustration, blending hand-drawn sketch lines, soft shadows, and a light-textured paper background. Each panel contains subtle movement arrows and subheadings. The layout is minimalist and balanced. Top title: “Pencak Silat Choreography – 16 Counts – 10 Seconds – Smooth Flowy Chill”. Panel 1: Wide ready stance, knees bent, one hand forward for defense, focused expression. Panel 2: Step forward and perform an outside block, arm extended for defense. Panel 3: Inside block with an upward diagonal sweep, torso rotation. Panel 4: Powerful straight punch forward, hip alignment. Panel 5: Side step into a low stance, hands pushing outward. Panel 6: Knees raised to a ready position, balanced posture. Panel 7: Front kick extended forward, other arm in defense. Panel 8: Step back into defensive cover, arms crossed. Panel 9: Low block, sweeping the arm downward from a squatting position. Panel 10: Lateral hook with hip rotation. Panel 11: Body rotation, feet rotation in a circular motion. Panel 12: Forward palm strike, stable posture. Panel 13: Low sweep close to the ground from a squatting position. Panel 14: Smoothly rise from a low position, moving upward. Panel 15: Controlled lockout, one arm raised in defense. Panel 16: Finishing pose, feet together, hands placed on chest, composed posture. Includes hand-drawn arrows (with blue and purple accents), a clean infographic layout, evenly spaced panels, and consistent character design throughout. A focused male martial artist performs a fluid Pencak Silat sequence in a minimalist studio. He was in his early twenties, well-built, of medium height, with a warm tan complexion, thick, wavy dark hair, and a neatly trimmed short beard. He wore a well-fitting dark red shirt with the sleeves rolled up to his forearms, slightly distressed beige slim-fit trousers at the knees, and clean white sneakers. His expression was calm, controlled, and focused. The scene was a softly lit, neutral studio with off-white textured walls and a slightly worn wooden floor. The diffused, cinematic lighting created soft shadows and accentuated fluid movement. The choreography is continuous and rhythmic, without abrupt cuts: 0–2 seconds: Begins in a solid ready stance, knees bent, one palm forward for defense, eyes focused forward. 2–4 seconds: Step forward into an outside block, transitioning to an upward sweeping inside block. 4–6 seconds: Hip rotation delivers a straight punch, followed by a side step and a push-back motion. 6–8 seconds: Smoothly raise and extend the knee for a controlled front kick, maintaining balance. 8–10 seconds: Step back into a defensive cover, crouch for a low block, then rise to deliver a hook punch. 10–12 seconds: Cleanly rotate the body, transitioning to a forward palm strike. 12–14 seconds: Lower the center of gravity for a sweeping motion, then smoothly rise into a locked-down control stance. 14–15 seconds: Finishes with a respectful closing gesture, hands clasped together at the chest. The style is soft, fluid, and controlled, with precise martial arts intent rather than aggression. Emphasis is placed on balance, breathing, and continuity. The camera uses a stable medium-to-long-range shot with subtle, slow tracking, and no editing.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张简洁的教学海报，采用 4x4 网格（16 个面板），展示了一位男性武术家演示 Pencak Silat 动作编排。主角是一位身材健硕、留着中长深色头发和胡须的男性，身穿红色衬衫、米色长裤和白色运动鞋。风格为半写实插画，融合了手绘草图线条、柔和阴影以及浅色纹理纸张背景。每个面板都包含细微的动作箭头和小标题。布局极简且平衡。顶部标题：“Pencak Silat Choreography – 16 Counts – 10 Seconds – Smooth Flowy Chill”。

面板 1：宽大的准备姿势，膝盖弯曲，一只手向前防御，神情专注。
面板 2：向前迈步并进行外格挡，手臂伸展以进行防御。
面板 3：内格挡向上斜向扫动，躯干旋转。
面板 4：强有力的直拳向前，髋部对齐。
面板 5：侧步进入低姿势，双手向外推。
面板 6：膝盖高抬至蓄力位置，姿势平衡。
面板 7：前踢向前伸展，另一只手臂进行防御。
面板 8：向后迈步进入防御掩护，双臂交叉。
面板 9：低位格挡，在深蹲姿势中向下扫动手臂。
面板 10：伴随髋部旋转的横向勾拳。
面板 11：身体转动，双脚旋转，呈现圆周运动。
面板 12：向前掌击，姿势稳定。
面板 13：深蹲姿势下靠近地面的低位扫动。
面板 14：从低姿势平稳起身，向上运动。
面板 15：受控的锁定姿势，一只手臂向上防御。
面板 16：结束礼，双脚并拢，双手按在胸前，姿态从容。

包含手绘箭头（蓝色和紫色点缀）、简洁的信息图布局、间距均匀的面板，以及所有帧中一致的角色设计。

一位专注的男性武术家在极简主义工作室中表演流畅的 Pencak Silat 动作序列。他 20 多岁，体格健壮，中等身高，肤色呈温暖的棕褐色，留着浓密的波浪状深色头发和修剪整齐的短胡须。他穿着一件合身的深红色衬衫，袖子卷至前臂，穿着膝盖处略有磨损的米色修身长裤，以及干净的白色运动鞋。他的表情冷静、受控且专注。
场景是一个光线柔和的中性工作室，背景为米白色纹理墙面，地板为略显陈旧的木质地板。灯光漫射且具有电影感，营造出柔和的阴影，并突显了流畅的动作。
动作编排连续且富有节奏感，没有突兀的剪辑：
0–2 秒：以扎实的准备姿势开始，膝盖弯曲，一只手掌向前防御，双眼注视前方
2–4 秒：向前迈步进入外格挡，过渡到向上扫动的内格挡
4–6 秒：髋部旋转打出直拳，随后重心转移进行侧步并伴随推掌动作
6–8 秒：平稳抬膝并伸展进行受控的前踢，保持平衡
8–10 秒：向后迈步进入防御掩护，下蹲进行低位格挡，随后起身打出勾拳
10–12 秒：身体干净利落地转动，过渡到向前掌击
12–14 秒：降低重心进行扫动，随后流畅起身进入锁定控制姿势
14–15 秒：以恭敬的结束礼收尾，双手在胸前合十
运动风格柔和、流畅、受控，具有精确的武术意图而非攻击性。强调平衡、呼吸和连贯性。摄像机采用稳定的中远景镜头，伴随细微的缓慢追踪，无剪辑。

templates.title: Chinese traditional ink painting style

titleLocalized.zh: 中国传统水墨插画风格

templates.prompt: [Character/Theme] ={argument name="character" default="Master Xuan in Zone Zero"} This is a richly colored illustration of an East Asian calligraphic figure, based on a line drawing framework. It primarily uses lines to outline the character, supplemented by light, freehand coloring. Calligraphic brushstrokes are employed, utilizing mixed-hair brushes and central brushwork. Some strokes use the side of the brush to create a "flying white" effect, achieving a dry brush texture. Hair is depicted with delicate, thread-like lines. The outlines are open with intermittent double lines, creating a sense of interplay between solid and void. A large area of ​​negative space is left on the white paper background. Transparent watercolor glazing, light ink rendering, and partial boneless coloring are used. The color layers are transparent, the color blocks are pure, and the edges are soft. Shadows are minimal, light is diffused, contrast is low, and the colors are flat. The character's clothing, hairstyle, and accessories are drawn strictly according to the original design, avoiding the use of generic Hanfu templates to maintain the character's unique logic. The hand structure is accurate, with complete and clear fingers, natural joints, and an elegant posture. The overall coloring is unified and clear in tone for the skin, hair, clothing, and accessories.

[Character/Theme] = {argument name="character" default="《绝区零》中的玄大师"}。
一幅色彩丰富的东亚书法线条人物插画，基于白描骨架，以线条勾勒为主，辅以写意风格的轻盈着色。使用书法毛笔的墨线，运用兼毫笔触和中锋运笔，部分笔触通过侧锋产生“飞白”效果，以实现干笔纹理。发丝由纤细如游丝的线条勾勒。轮廓线开放且带有间断的双线，营造出虚实相生的效果。白色纸张背景上留有大面积的负空间。采用透明水彩罩染、淡墨渲染，并进行局部没骨法着色。色层透明，色块纯净且边缘柔和。阴影极少，光线散射，对比度弱，色彩扁平。角色严格按照原始设计绘制服装、发型和配饰，避免使用通用的汉服模板，以保持角色独特的逻辑。手部结构准确，五指完整清晰，关节自然，姿态优雅。整体上色，皮肤、头发、服装和配饰的色调统一且清晰。

templates.prompt: Generate a book summary infographic poster with a medium information density and the theme "{argument name="book title" default="Book Title"} "--- Step 0 (Key Pre-Assessment) Before starting generation, determine the category of the book (multiple selections possible): * Cognitive Growth (Mindset/Self-Improvement) * Business/Wealth (Making Money/Career/Investment) * Psychology/Emotion (Interpersonal Relationships/Inner Self/Human Nature) * Fiction/Story (Narrative/Character/Metaphor) Adjust the content logic according to the category. [Overall Style] Modern minimalist UI + light retro illustration style. Soft light-colored background (cream/beige/light gray). Low-saturation tones (dark green/dark blue/brown). Keywords: quiet, substantial, easy to read. [Core Principles] Do not use fixed module titles. Do not force structural completeness. Organize information naturally according to the book type. [Content Modules] 1. Opening: Book title, author, one-sentence insight. 2. Core Understanding: "What this book really wants to express is..." 3. Highlights: Key points adjusted according to the category. 4. Visual Structure: Decision path, leverage system or character relationship diagram. 5. Example/ Excerpt: A memorable scene or case study. 6. Introduction: A meaningful sentence. 7. Action: Practical steps to take after reading. [Design Details] Adaptive grid layout, card-style information presentation, 6:4 text-to-image ratio, consistent illustration style, clear hierarchical structure. [Tone and Tone] It should sound like a human sharing insights and reflections on the book, rather than a dry summary.

promptLocalized.zh:
生成一张 [中等信息密度] 的书籍摘要信息图海报，主题为 "{argument name="book title" default="书籍标题"}"。

---

第 0 步（关键预评估）

在开始生成之前，确定该书所属的类别（可多选）：
* 认知成长（思维 / 自我提升）
* 商业 / 财富（赚钱 / 职业 / 投资）
* 心理 / 情感（人际关系 / 内在自我 / 人性）
* 小说 / 故事（叙事 / 角色 / 隐喻）

根据类别调整内容逻辑。

[整体风格]
现代极简 UI + 轻复古插画风格。柔和的浅色背景（奶油色 / 米色 / 浅灰色）。低饱和度色调（深绿色 / 深蓝色 / 棕色）。
关键词：安静、充实、易读。

[核心原则]
不要使用固定的模块标题。不要强求结构的完整性。根据书籍类型自然地组织信息。

[内容模块]
1. 开篇：书籍标题、作者、一句话见解。
2. 核心理解：“这本书真正想表达的是……”
3. 亮点：根据类别调整的关键要点。
4. 视觉结构：决策路径、杠杆系统或角色关系图。
5. 示例 / 片段：令人难忘的场景或案例。
6. 引言：富有深意的句子。
7. 行动：阅读后可采取的实用步骤。

[设计细节]
自适应网格布局，卡片式信息呈现，6:4 的图文比例，统一的插画风格，清晰的层级结构。

[语气语调]
听起来应该像是一个人类在分享对书籍的洞察和感悟，而不是枯燥的总结。

titleLocalized.zh: 天津城市宣传海报提示词

templates.prompt: A 2026 Tianjin city promotional poster, brimming with the festive atmosphere of the Spring Festival, blends elegance with the city's cultural heritage. The overall design employs a "Guochao" (national trend) illustration style combined with double exposure art techniques. The composition follows an S-shaped flow, guiding the viewer naturally and smoothly, combining modern design with Eastern aesthetics. Against a pure white, high-quality background, the image retains a large area of ​​white space, creating a fresh, elegant, and transparent feel. In the lower right corner stands a miniature figure in traditional Chinese clothing, gracefully waving a long red silk ribbon. This red ribbon, soft, elegant, and full of tension, spirals upwards and naturally extends to the upper left, forming a visually striking flowing trajectory. As the red ribbon extends, it gradually transforms into the magnificent Haihe River, incorporating Tianjin's cultural context and geographical imagery, resembling a long scroll connecting the past and present of the city. Overlaid within this visual subject of "river" and ribbon is a hand-drawn panoramic map of Tianjin in a Guochao style, rich in layers, majestic in scale, and exquisitely detailed. The image highlights key landmarks and urban elements of Tianjin: the Tianjin Eye (a prominent and highly recognizable landmark), the Haihe River (the core waterway running through the image), the Jiefang Bridge (embodying the beauty of the city's history and industry), the Jinwan Square complex (showcasing modern urban prosperity), the Century Clock (an iconic landmark), the Ancient Culture Street (reflecting traditional culture), the Five Avenues villa complex (reflecting the historical blend of Chinese and Western styles), the Drum Tower (reflecting Tianjin's ancient charm), the Italian Style Area (adding romance and exoticism to the city), and elements of Tianjin Port and ocean-going freighters (reflecting the city's openness, port's global connectivity). Cultural symbols such as Yangliuqing New Year paintings, Zhang's clay figurines, crosstalk cultural symbols, and twisted dough sticks are appropriately incorporated as decorative details to enhance regional recognition. The entire image presents a visual conception of "river, city, bridge, port, ancient and modern blending," accompanied by light clouds and mist, carrying an ethereal quality of Eastern aesthetics. The colors are mainly Chinese red, gold, elegant white, green, and light blue, with warm gold accents; the overall feeling is festive yet not gaudy, rich yet not chaotic. Image Requirements: Rich in detail, complex in structure, and clear in layering. The cityscape should be clearly visible, creating a sense of awe and artistry. Maintain the festive atmosphere of the Spring Festival, modern aesthetics, and the quality of a promotional poster. It should have a distinct hand-drawn feel, be exquisitely beautiful, and possess collectible visual quality. It should have the grandeur of a city promotional video poster and the high-end feel of a tourism poster. Text Layout Requirements: The English title "SPRING 2026" should be elegantly presented in the lower left corner. This should be paired with a vertically arranged Chinese slogan, such as: "River and Sea, Tianjin, Charming Tianjin" or "Hometown of Tianjin, Open Tianjin" or "Ancient and Modern Blend, Tianjin of All Things." Text Requirements: Aesthetically pleasing and elegant layout. Clear and complete handwriting. High-end poster design. Harmonious combination of Chinese and English. No garbled characters or typos. Overall Meaning: Showcase the unique charm of Tianjin as a historical and cultural city, an important northern port city, and a modern international metropolis, reflecting the Haihe River scenery, the ancient charm of Tianjin, and the open and inclusive urban spirit. Poster Size: 9:16, Vertical.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张充满节日春节氛围的 2026 年天津城市宣传海报，融合了优雅风格与城市文化底蕴。
整体画面采用“国潮”插画 + 双重曝光艺术手法。构图延续 S 型流线，视觉引导自然流畅，兼具现代设计感与东方美学韵味。

在纯白高质感背景上，画面保留大面积留白，整体感觉清新、优雅且通透。
右下角站立着一位身着传统中式服装的微缩人物，姿态灵动，挥舞着长长的红色绸缎舞带。
这抹红绸质感柔软、优雅且富有张力，在空中盘旋上升并自然延伸至左上方，形成极具视觉冲击力的流动轨迹。

随着红绸的延伸，它逐渐幻化为壮丽的海河水脉，同时融入天津的文化脉络与地理意象，宛如一幅连接古今的城市长卷。
在这一“河流”与绸缎交织而成的视觉主体中，叠加了一幅国潮风格的天津城市手绘全景地图，层次丰富，气势磅礴，细节精致震撼。

画面中重点突出了天津的关键地标与城市元素：
天津之眼（显著地标，极具辨识度）
海河（贯穿画面的核心水系）
解放桥（体现城市历史与工业之美）
津湾广场建筑群（展现现代城市繁荣）
世纪钟（标志性景观）
古文化街（体现传统文化）
五大道别墅群（体现中西合璧的历史风貌）
鼓楼（体现天津古韵）
意式风情区（增添城市浪漫与异域风情）
天津港与远洋货轮元素（体现城市开放、港口与全球互联的性格）
适当融入杨柳青年画、泥人张彩塑、相声文化符号及麻花等文化符号作为装饰细节，增强地域辨识度。

整幅画面呈现出“河、城、桥、港，古今交融”的视觉意境，伴有轻云与水雾，带有东方美学的空灵感。
色彩以中国红、金色、优雅白、绿色和浅蓝色为主，局部点缀暖金色；整体感觉喜庆而不俗气，丰富而不杂乱。

图像要求：
细节丰富，结构复杂，层次清晰。
城市景观清晰可见，带来震撼感与艺术感。
保持春节氛围、现代美学与宣传海报质感。
具有明显的手绘感，精致美观，具备收藏级的视觉质量。
既有城市宣传片海报的气势，又有旅游海报的高端感。

文字排版要求：
左下角采用优雅的排版呈现英文标题：“SPRING 2026”。
搭配竖排中文宣传标语，例如：
“河海津门，魅力天津”
或
“津门故里，开放天津”
或
“古今交融，万象天津”。

文字要求：
布局美观大方。
笔迹清晰完整。
高端海报设计感。
中英文和谐搭配。
无乱码，无错别字。

整体寓意：
展现天津作为历史文化名城、北方重要港口城市及现代国际大都市的独特魅力，反映海河风情、津门古韵以及开放包容的城市精神。

海报尺寸：9:16 竖版。

templates.prompt: One{argument name="style" default="High-end anime film style"} Character posters, using{argument name="composition" default="9:16 Vertical version"} The composition is inspired by Japanese key visuals and double-exposure storytelling techniques. Top area: Large, opposing profiles of the two main characters (one on each side), rich in detail and with soft expressions, form the dominant silhouette composition. Their hair and outlines blend into ink blots, dust, and particles. Center area: A full-body character stands confidently (in a heroic pose), positioned slightly below the center of the image, serving as a visual anchor. The clothing is exquisitely detailed, with dramatic lighting and subtle glow. Inside the large silhouette: a sophisticated double-exposure collage showcases multiple scenes—urban landscapes, battlefields, architecture, symbolic environments, supporting characters, and moments of emotional storytelling. Fog, ink wash, smoke, and layered transparency seamlessly blend everything. Lower middle area: Supporting characters are arranged in cinematic groups, their dynamic poses adding depth and gradually fading into the atmosphere. Bottom: Symbolic landscapes (trees, ruins, or cities) emerging from the mist add depth and provide a narrative conclusion. Style:{argument name="texture" default="Japanese ink painting + watercolor texture"} + Soft graininess + Cinematic anime-style rendering. Soft color palette (beige, dark brown, gray, soft blue tones). High detail with soft edges. Paper-textured background with ample negative space. Edges dissolve into ink dots and dust. Composition: Strong vertical flow, guiding the eye from top → center → bottom. Horizontal symmetry and balance. Simple, minimalist, and high-end poster design. Lighting: Soft diffused light, subtle highlights and glows, atmospheric haze. Typography (optional): Minimalist Japanese vertical text on the sides. Small movie title at the bottom center. Quality: Ultra-fine, 4K, sharp focus, cinematic depth, masterpiece.

templates.title: Double Exposure Character Poster Prompt

titleLocalized.zh: 双重曝光角色海报提示词

templates.prompt: A card titled "{argument name="poster title" default="INPUT NAME"} The character promotional posters all employ a unified vertical main visual composition (9:16). Each poster follows a hierarchical structure of "large at the top, small at the bottom": the upper half uses the character's most recognizable element (head, facial contours, mask, or upper body silhouette) as the dominant oversized visual focus, forming a highly distinctive silhouette; the lower middle part presents the character's full body as a secondary subject, using a stable standing pose or slight movement to establish the visual core of the composition. Double exposure and collage-style narrative composition are used within the large silhouette and around the character. Multiple scenes, symbolic imagery, small character interactions, and auxiliary elements are incorporated. The environmental details are layered and integrated with smoke, ink wash, and negative space. Complementary secondary elements are added to the left and right sides to create narrative tension and spatial variation. A continuous, flowing visual line runs through the entire composition, connecting the main character, the internal collage, and the large silhouette above, enhancing coherence and guiding the viewer's eye. The overall composition retains a large area of ​​negative space. The edges are treated with ink wash, soft blurring, and fragmented transitions, achieving a balance between "having" and "not having" inspired by Eastern aesthetics. The overall style is unified, refined, and restrained, emphasizing depth, narrative, strong visual impact, and a coherent series of poster language.

templates.title: A modern version of Esther writing at her workbench

titleLocalized.zh: 在工作台前写作的现代版以斯帖

templates.prompt: A cinematic, photorealistic modern portrait depicting a person reimagined as modern.{argument name="character name" default="Esther"} She sits at a large workbench, leaning forward, sketching or annotating on paper with a black pen. She has thick, long, wavy hair, medium olive-brown skin, and wears a soft beige cardigan over a neutral-colored vest, adorned with delicate layered necklaces and a simple ring. Her posture is natural and focused; one hand is writing, while the other rests casually on the maps, drawings, and printed papers spread out on the table. The image uses a mid-range close-up composition slightly above the table, focusing on her upper body and hands. Warm indoor natural light, a shallow depth of field, and a softly blurred background of a creative studio or workshop, with earthy browns and amber tones, create an intimate, contemplative, and contemporary narrative atmosphere. The emphasis is on realism, the texture of skin and fabric, natural curls, documentary-style photography, delicate color grading, and her serious yet serene expression.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影感十足、照片级真实的现代肖像，描绘了被重新构想为现代人的 {argument name="character name" default="以斯帖"}。她坐在宽大的工作台前，身体前倾，正用黑色钢笔在纸上素描或批注。她留着浓密的长卷发，皮肤呈中等橄榄棕色，身穿米色柔软开衫，内搭中性色背心，佩戴着精致的叠戴项链和一枚简约戒指。她的姿态自然且专注，一只手在书写，另一只手随意地搭在桌上铺开的地图、画作和打印纸张上。画面采用略高于桌面的中景特写构图，焦点集中在她的上半身和双手。运用温暖的室内自然光，浅景深效果，背景是柔和虚化的创意工作室或工作坊，色调为大地棕色和琥珀色，营造出一种亲密、深思且具有当代叙事感的氛围。强调真实感、皮肤与织物的质感、自然的卷发、纪录片风格的摄影手法、细腻的调色，以及她严肃而平静的神情。

templates.title: The back of the gorgeous celestial card

titleLocalized.zh: 华丽天体卡牌背面

templates.prompt: The back design of this mysterious card features a vertical composition, set against a pure light gray background. It is a magnificent rectangular card with rounded corners and a thick, deep charcoal-black beveled border. The card surface exhibits an aged, smoky gradient effect, with dark gray edges and a soft, pale silver sheen at the center, possessing a dusty, vintage texture, subtle scratches, slight spots, and scattered tiny points of light resembling a starfield. An elegant, symmetrical Art Nouveau style and celestial framework are added to the inner border, outlined with soft gold lines. A circular compass-shaped medallion is placed at each of the four corners, engraved with delicate star patterns. Two large, partially circular star-disc-shaped decorations are added to the lower left and right corners. Exquisite decorative curls and filigree are added to the four corners. Nine clearly visible bright stars are scattered across the card surface, each with a warm, golden, four-pointed glint of varying sizes. Subtle radiating guide lines are added, converging towards the center and lower center, and vertically aligning two small diamond-shaped star symbols near the top and lower centers. Maintaining perfect symmetry in the composition, with a blank space in the center for the title, the overall style is luxurious, mysterious, retro, and minimalist. High detail, soft lighting, exquisite metallic texture, fantastical tarot or oracle card back aesthetics, and a clean studio display effect.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张垂直构图的神秘卡牌背面设计，置于纯浅灰色背景中心，呈现为一张带有圆角和厚实深炭黑色斜面边框的华丽矩形卡牌。卡面呈现出一种陈旧的烟熏渐变效果，边缘为深灰色，中心散发着柔和的浅银色光芒，并带有灰尘般的复古质感、细微划痕、轻微斑点以及类似星场的细小光点散布。在内边框处添加优雅对称的新艺术风格与天体框架，采用柔和的金色线条勾勒。在四个角各放置一个圆形罗盘状奖章，内部刻有精致的星形图案。在左下角和右下角添加两个大型的部分圆形星盘状装饰。在四个角加入精美的装饰性卷曲和花丝。在卡面上散布 9 个清晰可见的明亮星光，带有大小不一、温暖的金色四角闪光。添加细微的放射状引导线，向中心和下中心汇聚，并在顶部中心和下中心附近垂直对齐两个小型菱形星形符号。保持构图完全对称，中间留白以便放置标题，整体风格奢华、神秘、复古且极简。高细节，柔和光晕，精致的金属质感，奇幻塔罗牌或神谕卡背美学，干净的摄影棚展示效果。

templates.title: Stylish Terrace Outfit Photos

titleLocalized.zh: 时尚露台穿搭照片

templates.prompt: A full-body fashion photograph shows a stylish, mature woman standing in bright natural daylight on a covered outdoor terrace. She has short, voluminous platinum blonde hair, poses confidently with her hands on her hips and one leg casually crossed in front of the other. Her face is softened, lacking detail. She wears a fitted long-sleeved cropped top in a color that is {argument name="top color" default="warm rust brown"} She paired it with high-waisted light blue distressed wide-leg jeans (with several rips) and brown platform sandals. She wore a plethora of accessories, including multi-layered necklaces (one with a large, unique pendant), stacked bracelets, rings, drop earrings, and a smartwatch. She carried a {argument name="bag color" default="Cognac Brown"} A beaded drawstring bucket bag. The background is an upscale backyard lounge area with woven dark rattan patio furniture, beige cushions, a striped beige outdoor rug, a blue cabinet with a TV mounted above, sliding glass doors, and greenery visible from the windows. A few pink flowers are added to the left, and fern leaves enter the frame in the lower right corner. The overall style should convey the sophistication of a lifestyle blogger's outfit photo, with realistic smartphone photography effects, slightly overexposed, clear details, natural lighting that flatters skin tones, and a vertical composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张全身时尚照片，展现了一位时尚的成熟女性站在明亮的自然日间光线下，位于带顶棚的户外露台上。她留着蓬松的短款铂金金色头发，姿态自信，双手叉腰，一条腿随意地交叉在另一条腿前。她的面部经过柔化处理，没有细节。她穿着一件修身长袖短款上衣，颜色为 {argument name="top color" default="暖锈棕色"}，搭配高腰浅蓝色做旧阔腿牛仔裤（带有几处破洞），以及棕色厚底凉拖。她佩戴了丰富的配饰，包括多层项链（其中一条带有大型个性吊坠）、多层叠戴手镯、戒指、垂坠耳环和智能手表。她手中提着一个 {argument name="bag color" default="干邑棕色"} 的串珠抽绳水桶包。背景是一个高档的后院休息区，配有编织深色藤制露台家具、米色靠垫、条纹米色户外地毯、一个上方挂有电视的蓝色柜子、滑动玻璃门，以及窗外可见的绿植。在左侧添加几朵粉色花朵，右下角有蕨类植物叶片进入画面。整体风格应呈现出精致的生活方式博主穿搭照质感，写实的智能手机摄影效果，曝光略微提升，细节清晰，光线自然且修饰肤色，采用竖构图。
