templates.title: Stylish and mature women's terrace outfit portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 时尚成熟女性露台穿搭人像

templates.prompt: A full-body portrait of a stylish, mature woman. She stands confidently on a covered outdoor terrace, centered in the frame, hands on her hips, looking directly at the camera. She has a voluminous pixie cut and her hair is [color missing].{argument name="hair color" default="White"} She exuded a mature and elegant temperament. She was wearing a {argument name="top color" default="Rust brown"} The outfit features a fitted, long-sleeved, turtleneck cropped top paired with light blue high-waisted wide-leg ripped jeans (with five noticeable distressed or ripped spots), brown wooden platform mules, and a brown leather bucket bag with long tassels slung over the arm. Accessories include a large gold medallion pendant necklace, layered bracelets, and rings. The backdrop is a sophisticated, neutral-toned terrace with stone-paved flooring. A wicker outdoor chair is placed in the foreground, and a dark blue project cabinet is in the background. A flat-screen TV hangs on the left wall, adorned with two lantern decorations and potted plants. Cream-colored stucco pillars and lush green hedges surround the scene. Natural sunlight, soft editorial lighting, a realistic photographic style, vertical composition, and a focus on the details of the outfit create a luxurious lifestyle fashion editorial that is both relaxed and sophisticated.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张时尚成熟女性的全身人像照，她自信地站在带顶棚的户外露台上，位于画面中心，双手叉腰，直视镜头。她留着蓬松的精灵短发，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="白色"}，尽显成熟优雅的气质。她身穿一件 {argument name="top color" default="铁锈棕色"} 的修身长袖高领短款上衣，搭配浅蓝色高腰阔腿破洞牛仔裤（裤身上有 5 处明显的磨损或破洞），脚踩棕褐色木质厚底穆勒鞋，手臂上挎着一个带有长流苏的棕褐色皮革水桶包。配饰包括 1 条大型金质奖章吊坠项链、多层叠戴手镯和戒指。背景是一个色调高级的中性风露台，铺设着石砖地面，前景摆放着藤编户外座椅，后方有一个深蓝色项目柜，左侧墙上挂着平板电视，柜子上摆放着 2 个灯笼装饰品和盆栽绿植，周围是奶油色灰泥柱和郁郁葱葱的绿色树篱。自然日光，柔和的社论摄影光效，写实摄影风格，竖构图，聚焦于穿搭细节，奢华生活方式时尚大片，风格既轻松又不失精致感。

templates.title: Poster for Guan Yu in "Black Myth"

titleLocalized.zh: 《黑神话》关羽海报

templates.prompt: Epic dark fantasy poster, featuring the main character as {argument name="character name" default="Guan Yu"} Reimagined in the style of a mythological action game hero, the character is presented from a low-angle, centered position, tall and imposing. He wears exquisite ancient Chinese armor in distressed gold and dark green, adorned with dragon and beast motifs. His massive shoulder armor is sculpted into the shape of a roaring monster, with layers of scales, an ornate belt buckle, and long, black hair that billows wildly in the wind. He wears a faded green turban. In one hand, he holds a long-handled weapon with a dark shaft and a red tassel at the blade; in the other hand, he displays a massive, ornate guandao (a type of halberd), its hilt intricately carved, its broad, curved steel blade angled towards the viewer. A huge, luminous full moon forms a halo behind his head, surrounded by faint traces of ancient Chinese calligraphy. A flowing crimson cloak and tattered red ribbons flutter in the air, creating a strong diagonal sense of movement. The environment is a smoke-filled hellish battlefield, with dark clouds, scattered ashes, and shimmering, lava-like red light near the ground. In the background, jagged rocks and massive, shadowy statues or demonic forms are faintly visible. The color palette features polished gold, ember orange, blood red, charcoal black, and deep jade green. It boasts ultra-refined cinematic lighting, dramatic contour lighting from moonlight, high contrast, volumetric smoke, richly textured metals, fabrics, and hair, ultra-detailed fantasy concept art, top-tier video game key visuals, and a vertical poster design. It includes four sets of integrated text reminiscent of movie/game posters: an arc-shaped Chinese text at the top around the moon, the title line "Black Myth" in the lower center, the oversized gold calligraphy main title "Guan Yu," and a smaller Chinese slogan at the bottom with a central circular logo.

promptLocalized.zh: 史诗级暗黑奇幻海报，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="关羽"}，以神话动作游戏英雄的风格重新构思。全身低角度构图，居中呈现，高大威猛。身着做旧金与深绿色相间的精美中国古代战甲，饰有龙兽纹样，巨大的肩甲雕刻成咆哮的怪兽造型，层叠的鳞甲，华丽的腰带扣，长长的黑发在风中狂乱飘动，佩戴着褪色的绿色头巾。他一手竖持长柄武器，杆身深色，刀刃处系有红色流苏；另一只手展示着一把巨大的华丽关刀，刀柄雕刻精美，宽阔的弧形钢刃斜向观众。一轮巨大的发光满月在他脑后形成光环，周围环绕着一圈淡淡的中国古代书法。飘动的深红色披风和破碎的红色布带在画面中飞舞，营造出强烈的对角线动感。环境为烟雾缭绕的地狱战场，乌云密布，灰烬飘散，地面附近闪烁着熔岩般的红光，背景中隐现参差不齐的岩石和巨大的阴影雕像或恶魔形态。色调采用磨光金、余烬橙、血红、炭黑和深玉绿。超精细电影级光影，月光带来的戏剧性轮廓光，高对比度，体积烟雾，质感丰富的金属、布料和毛发，超精细奇幻概念艺术，顶级电子游戏主视觉图，竖版海报设计。包含 4 组类似电影/游戏海报的集成文字：月亮周围顶部的弧形中文，中下部的标题行“黑神话”，超大的金色毛笔书法主标题“关公”，以及底部带有中心圆形徽标的小字中文标语。

templates.title: Hyper-realistic gym mirror selfie

titleLocalized.zh: 超写实健身房镜面自拍

templates.prompt: A hyper-realistic mirror selfie taken in a modern, upscale gym. A fit young woman stands in the foreground of the setting, in a vertical composition, creating a candid, dating app-style effect. She's taking a selfie with her phone, which obscures most of her face, resulting in a genuine mirror selfie effect. templates.title: Chinese portrait photography book pages

templates.prompt: Create a clean and sophisticated Chinese photography tutorial book page layout, using vertical typography, off-white paper background, generous margins, and elegant typography to present a minimalist magazine style. The page uses a single-page spread design, containing five clearly separated content blocks: a top title bar, a left text bar, a large main image on the right, a lighting diagram in the lower left corner, and two thumbnail examples and a tooltip in the lower right corner. In the top title bar, place small-sized Chinese text: “Portrait Photography Practical Guide | Chapter 04 The Use of Light and Influence.” In the upper left corner, place a large, eye-catching olive-green chapter number “04-2,” followed by a multi-line, bold black Chinese title: “Soft Portraits in Natural Light.” Below this, add a smaller olive-green subtitle: “Creating a Gentle Atmosphere Using Flower Shadows and Diffuse Light.” Below the subtitle, add a black body text describing how natural environments, flowers, or tree shadows soften sunlight, creating clean, soft, and atmospheric portraits. Below, create an olive-green heading “● Shooting Tips”, followed by three Chinese text tips: 1. “Light Direction”: Choose natural light from above or to the side, and use flower shadows to soften facial contours; 2. “Foreground and Atmosphere”: Use large areas of soft foreground flowers to compose the shot and add depth; 3. “Expression and Emotion”: Guide the model to maintain a natural, calm expression and relaxed gaze. On the right side of the page, place a large vertical portrait photograph occupying the upper right half: a soft, ethereal close-up portrait of a young East Asian woman with long, straight black hair, wearing a light pink top and a delicate necklace, surrounded by numerous white hydrangeas. The lighting is diffused natural light, accompanied by flower shadows and a romantic atmosphere, with shallow depth of field, creating an elegant magazine photography style. Below the main image, add a line of small Chinese technical parameters: “● Focal Length: 85mm Aperture: f/2.8 Shutter Speed: 1/640s ISO: 100 White Balance: Auto.” In the lower left section, a rounded frame contains a simple black-and-white hand-drawn lighting diagram titled "● Lighting Diagram". The diagram shows three elements: a sun icon in the upper left corner, a camera icon in the lower left corner, and a sketch of a woman's back in the center, accompanied by a dotted line indicating the direction from the sun and Chinese annotations explaining how to use flowers to soften the natural light from above and in front into dappled diffused light, while using the flowers as a foreground and compressing the space with a medium-telephoto lens to create a blurred effect. In the lower right section, an olive-green title "● More Attempts" is added, below which are two small vertical thumbnails of the woman in a field of white flowers. Each thumbnail has a brief Chinese description: the left one says "Shooting with sidelight creates stronger light and shadow layers," and the right one says "Shooting with backlight increases transparency." On the far right of the thumbnails, a rounded rectangular tip box is placed, titled "✦ Tips," briefly suggesting avoiding direct sunlight at midday and prioritizing the soft light of early morning or evening for a gentler image. Add page number "086" in the bottom left corner. The book employs elegant Chinese book layout, featuring olive green accents, black text, and subtle gray dividing lines, showcasing high-end publishing design, balanced white space, realistic printing layout, and exquisite professional book typesetting.

创建一个简洁、高级的中文摄影教程书页，采用纵向排版，米白色纸张背景，配以宽裕的页边距和精致的排版，呈现极简杂志风格。页面采用单页跨页式设计，包含 5 个清晰分隔的内容区块：顶部标题栏、左侧文本栏、右侧大幅主图、左下角布光示意图，以及右下角的 2 个缩略图示例和 1 个提示框。在顶部标题栏，放置小号中文文本：“人像摄影实战指南 | Chapter 04 光线与影响的运用”。在左上方，放置一个橄榄绿色的醒目大号章节编号“04-2”，下方紧跟多行排版的黑色粗体中文标题：“自然光下的
柔美人像”。在其下方，添加较小的橄榄绿色副标题：“利用花影与漫射光
营造温柔氛围”。在副标题下方，加入一段黑色正文，描述自然环境、花卉或树影如何柔化阳光，营造出干净、柔和且富有氛围感的人像。下方创建一个橄榄绿色的“● 拍摄要点”标题，随后列出 3 条中文正文提示：1 “光线方向”，说明选择顶部或侧上方自然光，并利用花影柔化面部轮廓；2 “前景与氛围”，说明利用大面积柔和的前景花卉来构图并增加深度；3 “表情与情绪”，说明引导模特保持自然、平静的表情和放松的眼神。在页面右侧，放置一张占据右上半部分的大幅竖构图人像照片：一位年轻东亚女性的柔和、空灵近景人像，留着黑色直长发，身着淡粉色上衣，佩戴精致项链，周围环绕着大量白色绣球花，光线为漫射自然光，伴有花影和浪漫氛围，浅景深，优雅的杂志摄影风格。在主图下方，添加一行小号中文技术参数：“● 焦距：85mm   光圈：f/2.8   快门：1/640s   ISO：100   白平衡：自动”。在左下区块，放置一个圆角框，内含一张简单的黑白手绘布光示意图，标题为“● 布光示意图”。图中展示 3 个元素：左上角的太阳图标、左下角的相机图标，以及居中的女性背影草图，并配有来自太阳的虚线方向指示，以及中文标注，解释如何利用花卉将上方前侧的自然光柔化为斑驳的漫射光，同时利用花卉作为前景，通过中长焦镜头压缩空间，营造虚化效果。在右下区域，添加橄榄绿色的“● 更多尝试”标题，下方放置 2 张该女性在白花丛中的小幅竖向缩略图。每张缩略图配有简短中文说明：左侧为“侧光拍摄，光影层次更强”，右侧为“逆光拍摄，增加通透感”。在缩略图最右侧，放置一个圆角矩形提示框，标题为“✦ 小贴士”，简短建议避免正午强光直射，优先选择清晨或傍晚的柔和光线以获得更温和的画面。在左下角添加页码“086”。采用优雅的中文书籍排版，搭配橄榄绿色点缀、黑色正文、细微的灰色分割线，呈现高端出版设计、平衡的留白、逼真的印刷布局以及精致专业的书籍排版。

promptLocalized.zh: {"type":"书籍内页排版","language":"中文","genre":"摄影教程排版","page":{"size":"竖版书页","background":"米白色哑光纸","page_number":"24","header_left":"人像摄影入门与进阶","header_right":"第 1 章  光线与曝光","footer_right":"用光影讲述故事"},"title_block":{"section_number":"03","headline":"自然光人像拍摄技巧","subtext":"利用自然光拍摄人像，能够营造柔和、真实且富有氛围的画面。本页以侧逆光环境下的人像为例，解析用光、构图与情绪表达这三大要点。","position":"左上角"},"main_image":{"position":"左侧栏","subject":"一位留着黑色双麻花辫年轻女性的特写人像，身穿带有荷叶边领口和精致饰边的白色蕾丝裙，在午后温暖的自然光下拍摄","framing":"从胸部到头顶的竖向裁剪","lighting":"强烈的侧逆光，发丝和肩部带有金色轮廓光，柔和的暖色高光，浅景深，圆形背景虚化","background":"深绿色户外植被，带有阳光斑驳的虚化效果","face":"面部区域覆盖有刻意模糊的矩形"},"right_column":{"sections":[{"title":"拍摄参数参考","position":"右上角","count":9,"items":[{"label":"相机","value":"Sony α7R IV"},{"label":"镜头","value":"85mm F1.4"},{"label":"光圈","value":"F1.8"},{"label":"快门","value":"1/640s"},{"label":"感光度","value":"ISO 100"},{"label":"焦距","value":"85mm"},{"label":"白平衡","value":"日光"},{"label":"测光模式","value":"点测光"},{"label":"拍摄时间","value":"下午 4:00"}]},{"title":"拍摄要点","position":"中右侧","count":4,"items":["侧逆光勾勒发丝与轮廓，增强立体感与氛围。","使用大光圈虚化背景，突出人物主体。","让模特自然低头或侧望，传递柔和、安静的情绪。","点测光对焦在面部，确保主体曝光准确。"]},{"title":"构图与姿态参考","position":"右下角","count":3,"items":[{"label":"三分法构图","description":"人物位于画面三分线交叉点，构图更平衡。"},{"label":"引导线构图","description":"发辫与肩线形成引导线，增强画面流动感。"},{"label":"特写构图","description":"突出眼神与表情，强化情绪表达。"}]},{"title":"进阶提示","position":"右底部","count":1,"items":["尝试在不同时间段拍摄（如清晨或傍晚），光线色温与角度会带来不同的氛围感。也可以使用反光板补光，提高面部明暗影部分。"]}]},"bottom_left_box":{"title":"拍摄思路","position":"主图下方左侧","body":"选择下午的自然光，利用树影与阳光形成的斑驳光斑作为背景，让画面更具层次。模特穿着白色蕾丝服装，在光线的照射下更显柔美。通过低头、侧望的姿态，营造安静、温柔的氛围。"},"style":{"overall":"简洁高级的书籍排版，极简中文排版，现代摄影教育布局","grid":"左侧大图，右侧结构化信息面板，各板块间有细微分割线","typography":"粗体无衬线章节号与标题，较小的常规正文，整齐对齐的标签与数值，单色黑色文本","color_palette":"暖奶油色、黑色、柔灰色、金色阳光、深绿色、白色织物"}}

templates.prompt: A realistic flash photograph taken directly above shows a young woman lying on a crumpled white bed, surrounded by scattered dollar bills. Her long, dark hair cascades dramatically across the sheets like a halo. She wears a black cropped tank top or sports bra with low-waisted black trousers that reveal her white waist, showcasing her slender figure. Her left arm is outstretched towards the camera, her palm open, creating a strong perspective effect and a striking, high-fashion visual. A blurry banknote flies past in the foreground, adding dynamism and depth. She wears layered silver jewelry: two pearl silver necklaces, several heavy silver bracelets on her wrists, and rings on her fingers. Approximately 40 dollar bills are scattered throughout the scene, primarily $100 bills, mixed with a few smaller denominations. The photograph features a strong, direct on-camera flash, high contrast, slight wide-angle distortion, a casual yet luxurious street style, early 21st-century paparazzi aesthetics, a centered composition, a full-body shot cropped from mid-thigh upwards, white bedding filling the background, and a realistic photographic style.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张从正上方俯拍的写实闪光灯照片，一名年轻女子躺在褶皱的白色床铺上，周围散落着美元钞票。她乌黑的长发像光环一样戏剧性地向四周散开，铺在床单上。她身穿黑色短款背心或运动内衣，搭配低腰黑色长裤，露出白色的腰边，展现出紧致的腰部线条。她的左臂直伸向镜头，手掌张开，呈现出强烈的透视缩短效果，营造出极具冲击力的时尚大片视觉感。一张模糊的钞票在镜头前方的近景处飞过，增加了动感与深度。她佩戴着叠搭的银饰：两条珍珠银项链、手腕上多枚厚重的银手镯以及手指上的戒指。场景中大约散落着 40 张美元钞票，主要是 100 美元面额，混杂着少量小面额钞票。采用强烈的机顶闪光灯直射，高对比度，轻微的广角畸变，充满随性的奢华街头风格，21 世纪初的狗仔队美学，居中构图，从大腿中部向上截取的全身照，白色寝具填满背景，写实摄影风格。

titleLocalized.zh: 雨夜咖啡馆 360 度全景

templates.prompt: A warm, cinematic 360-degree panoramic view of a café interior, rendered as an immersive, isometric cylindrical projection widescreen scene, with slight fisheye distortion due to the panoramic format. The scene is set in a stylish, softly lit café with polished wooden floors, arched ceiling details, hanging chandeliers, bookshelves, greenery, small round tables, and large windows dripping with raindrops, through which city lights stream in. The atmosphere is amber, private, and authentic, like a panoramic photograph of everyday life taken indoors on a rainy night. Eight identical young female figures are incorporated into the scene, creating a multi-narrative composition within the café. In the central foreground, one woman is closest to the camera, her hands outstretched, one holding a coffee and the other a plate of cut fruit, making direct eye contact with the viewer. On the far left, a second woman, casually dressed, operates an espresso machine behind the counter, like a barista. In the center left, a third woman stands beside a bookshelf, reading or flipping through documents. In the rear right, the fourth female figure stands beside a camera tripod, looking at a mobile phone or small device, as if preparing content or checking notes. In the middle right, the fifth female figure sits at a table holding printed paper. To her right, the sixth female figure leans over and speaks with the seventh woman, who is sitting at a table using a laptop and has documents spread out. At the far right window, the eighth female figure, wearing a long, light-colored coat, gazes into the room. Maintaining visual consistency across all eight female figures {argument name="character appearance" default="A young East Asian woman with long, dark, curly hair and a slender figure"} However, the clothing choices differ slightly, featuring soft, neutral loungewear and casual café attire in cream, beige, gray, and lavender. Visible props include: an espresso machine, a laptop, a camera tripod, several sheets of paper, two cups on the table and one being handed to someone, and a small vase on the right-hand table. The style emphasizes natural candid poses, environmental storytelling, realistic indoor reflections, understated tungsten lighting, rain-drenched highlights, and a warm café/office atmosphere. The style is hyper-realistic photography, high detail, soft shadows, warm color grading, and documentary-style realism. The aspect ratio is ultra-wide panorama, suitable for panoramic backgrounds or immersive scenes.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅温暖且具有电影质感的 360 度咖啡馆室内全景图，渲染为具有沉浸感的等距柱状投影宽幅场景，因全景格式带有轻微的鱼眼畸变。场景设定为一家时尚且灯光柔和的咖啡店，铺设着抛光的木地板，拥有弧形天花板细节、悬挂的吊灯、书架、绿植、小圆桌，以及布满雨滴的大窗户，窗外透出城市灯光。氛围呈现琥珀色，私密且真实，如同在雨夜室内拍摄的生活全景照片。在场景中加入 8 个完全相同的年轻女性形象，在咖啡馆内构成多重叙事的构图。在中心前景处，其中一个女性形象离镜头最近，双手向前伸出，一手端着咖啡，另一手托着一盘切好的水果，与观者进行直接的视线交流。在最左侧，第二个女性形象在柜台后操作浓缩咖啡机，穿着休闲，如同咖啡师。左中位置，第三个女性形象站在书架旁阅读或翻阅文件。在后方中右侧，第四个女性形象站在相机三脚架旁，看着手机或小型设备，仿佛正在准备内容或查看笔记。中右侧，第五个女性形象坐在桌旁拿着打印纸。在她的右侧，第六个女性形象俯身与第七个坐在桌前、正在使用笔记本电脑并摊开文件的女性交谈。在最右侧窗边，第八个女性形象穿着长款浅色外套，向室内凝视。保持所有 8 个女性形象在视觉上的一致性，即 {argument name="character appearance" default="一位留着深色长卷发、身材苗条的年轻东亚女性"}，但服装搭配略有不同，采用奶油色、米色、灰色和薰衣草色的柔软中性居家服及休闲咖啡馆着装。包含可见道具：1 台浓缩咖啡机、1 台笔记本电脑、1 个相机三脚架、多张纸张、桌上的 2 个杯子以及正在被递出的 1 个杯子，右侧桌上还有 1 个小花瓶。强调自然的抓拍姿势、环境叙事、逼真的室内倒影、低调的钨丝灯光、雨窗高光以及温馨的咖啡馆办公氛围。风格：超写实摄影、高细节、柔和阴影、暖色调调色、纪录片式生活写实。长宽比为超宽全景，适用于全景背景或沉浸式场景。

templates.title: Plant-based skincare gift box advertisement

titleLocalized.zh: 植物护肤礼盒广告

templates.prompt: Create a high-end e-commerce product advertisement with a fresh, botanical skincare style. The centerpiece of the image is an open gift box placed on a light-colored stone tabletop. The packaging uses a pale sage green and off-white color scheme, presenting a minimalist luxury aesthetic with a matte finish. Delicate watercolor leaf illustrations are printed on the inside of the lid and on the small packaging pouch. The lid opens upright, revealing an elegant layout: a large brand logo.{argument name="product name" default="MONSTER Skin Essence"} Subtitle line{argument name="headline text" default="Soothe skin in 7 days"} Below is smaller Chinese text, with three small circular function icons arranged horizontally in the center. Inside the box, four flat-laid sheet masks are neatly stacked on the left, while five slender glass ampoules stand vertically side-by-side on the right, each with a silver cap and vertical label text. The same delicate small brand logo is printed on the front edge of the gift box. On the right side of the design, three vertically stacked linear efficacy icons and bilingual labels are placed: the leaf icon is accompanied by…{argument name="benefit one" default="Soothing and Repairing"} The English subtitle "SOOTHING REPAIR" is accompanied by a wave-like water ripple icon.{argument name="benefit two" default="Hydrating and moisturizing"} The advertisement includes the English subtitle "HYDRATING," and the scale icon is accompanied by the Chinese label "衡肤皮" (Balance Skin) and the English subtitle "BALANCE." The surrounding environment evokes a tranquil natural spa setting: blurred green branches extend from the upper left and right corners, moss-covered stones adorn the sides, delicate leaves are arranged in the foreground, and soft diffused light shines against a warm ivory background. Employing a balanced frontal composition, soft shadows, high-end commercial lighting, clear packaging details, and a gentle green hue, the advertisement creates a calm, credible, and sophisticated visual for skincare products.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个高端电商产品广告，采用清新的植物护肤风格，画面中心为一个打开的礼盒，放置在浅色石质桌面上。包装采用淡鼠尾草绿与米白色调，呈现极简奢华美学，哑光质感，盒盖内侧及小包装袋上印有精致的水彩叶片插画。盒盖直立打开，展示优雅的排版：大号品牌行 {argument name="product name" default="MONSTER 皮肤精华"}，副标题行 {argument name="headline text" default="7天舒缓肌肤"}，下方配有较小的中文文案，中心区域水平排列 3 个小型圆形功能图标。盒内左侧整齐堆叠 4 袋平铺的面膜，右侧并排竖立 5 支纤细的玻璃精华安瓶，每支均配有银色瓶盖及垂直标签文字。在礼盒前缘，印有同样精致的小号品牌标识。在构图右侧，放置 3 个垂直堆叠的线性功效图标及双语标签：叶片图标配有 {argument name="benefit one" default="舒缓修护"} 及英文副标题 "SOOTHING REPAIR"，波浪水纹图标配有 {argument name="benefit two" default="水润保湿"} 及英文副标题 "HYDRATING"，平衡秤图标配有中文标签 "平衡肌肤" 及英文副标题 "BALANCE"。场景周围营造宁静的自然水疗环境：左上角和右上角伸入虚化的绿色枝叶，两侧点缀苔藓覆盖的石块，前景布置细微叶片，暖象牙色背景下呈现柔和的漫射光。采用平衡的正视构图、柔和阴影、高端商业布光、清晰的包装细节、柔和的绿色调，打造冷静、可信且高端的护肤品广告视觉。

templates.title: Panoramic Technology Activity Atrium Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 全景科技活动中庭场景

templates.prompt: A cinematic, ultra-wide-angle panoramic scene, set within a modern, multi-level event atrium at night, is shot with the effect of a 360-degree conference presentation, employing dramatic warm-toned, low-key lighting and gleaming dark architectural surfaces. In the center of the foreground, a professional woman in a brown suit jacket and dark trousers stands confidently, pointing to a large flat-panel display on a tripod; the screen shows the city skyline at dusk reflected on the water. Behind the display is a tall, luminous backdrop with abstract, flowing white light bands and subtle, constellation-like golden glitter. Rows of audience members sit in the background, watching the presentation. In the left foreground, a woman in a gray business suit stands around a round table with documents, a clipboard, a pen, and a small service bell, as if handling registration or event administration. In the foreground on the right, four women are gathered around two small round tables, showcasing products and hospitality items: one sporty woman in a fitted top holds a VR headset, one woman in a casual light-colored hoodie holds a controller, one woman in a beige cardigan is arranging cups and cutlery, and another woman in a light-colored dress stands nearby, holding a phone or small gadget. On the right table are 11 prominent items: a glowing glass ball lamp, two VR headsets, a rectangular product box, a metal thermos or coffee pot, and six white teacups lined up. The entire scene should evoke the atmosphere of a high-end tech lifestyle launch event, seamlessly integrating business presentations, immersive gadgets, and coffee service. It utilizes realistic human proportions, documentary-style set design, sophisticated corporate event photography, subtle reflections on the ground, deep depth of field, and a seamless ultra-wide-angle panoramic composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个电影级的超广角全景场景，位于夜晚现代化的多层活动中庭内，拍摄效果如同 360 度会议展示，采用戏剧性的暖色调低调照明和光亮的深色建筑表面。在前景中央，一位身穿棕色西装外套和深色长裤的职业女性自信地站立，指向三脚架上的大型平板显示器；屏幕上显示着水面上的暮色城市天际线。显示器后方是一个高大的发光背景板，上面有抽象的流动白色光带和淡淡的星座般金色闪光。场地背景中坐满了成排的观众，正在观看演示。左侧前景中，1 位身穿灰色商务套装的女性站在一张圆桌旁，桌上放着文件、剪贴板、一支笔和一个小型服务铃，仿佛正在处理注册或活动行政事务。右侧前景中，4 位女性聚集在两张小圆桌旁展示产品和接待用品：1 位穿着修身上衣的运动型女性拿着 VR 头显，1 位穿着休闲浅色连帽衫的女性拿着控制器，1 位穿着米色开衫的女性正在摆弄杯子和餐具，另有 1 位身穿浅色连衣裙的女性站在附近，拿着手机或小物件。右侧桌子上共有 11 件显眼的物品：1 个发光的玻璃球灯、2 个 VR 头显、1 个长方形产品盒、1 个金属保温瓶或咖啡壶，以及 6 个排成一行的白色茶杯。整个场景应呈现出高端科技生活方式发布会的氛围，将商务演示、沉浸式小工具和咖啡服务融为一体。使用逼真的人体比例、纪录片风格的布景、精致的企业活动摄影效果、地面上的微妙倒影、深邃的景深以及无缝的超广角全景构图。

templates.title: Cyberpunk AI Font Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克 AI 字体海报

templates.prompt: A vertical cyberpunk-style promotional poster showcases a custom sci-fi display font against a backdrop of a neon-lit futuristic city at sunset. The top of the image is dominated by a massive, metallic 3D title, "AI Next Generation," with the English word "AI" above the Chinese characters. The overall design features a heavy, steel-mecha-style black font with beveled edges, chrome reflections, a deep gunmetal gray surface, electric blue internal glow, cyan outline lighting, and sharp industrial geometry. In the foreground below the title, a cute, chibi-style robot mascot stands bravely, sporting a white armored body and black joints, a sleek black digital front screen, bright cyan glowing eyes (one of which is blinking), a wide-open smiling face, golden earphone-like earpieces, and a glowing triangular badge. It raises a fist in celebration and strides forward. Surrounding the scene are six auxiliary robot characters and drones: a chibi-style robot with pink paw pads and a cheerful, glowing expression (cat ears) in the lower left corner; a chibi-style robot with rabbit ears running in the lower right corner; a square multi-functional robot vehicle with a small digital face in the far lower right corner; two spherical drones in the upper left and upper right corners; and a larger flying robot in the center left. The background is a dense futuristic urban canyon, flanked by towering skyscrapers, elevated roads, holographic billboards, and glowing signs, with atmospheric perspective fading towards the bright center. Three billboards are clearly visible: a pink neon cat-themed billboard on the left, a blue holographic robot diagram billboard in the upper right corner, and a purple neon billboard in the lower right corner. The streets are smooth and reflective, with glowing, circuit-like lane markings and beams of cyan and magenta. Employing a dramatic low-angle perspective, a centrally symmetrical poster layout, high contrast, vibrant cyan, magenta, purple, orange, and gold lighting, exquisite anime and 3D illustration style, and cinematic sunset clouds, the design showcases a dynamic, playful, futuristic, cute, and grand technological brand aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张竖版赛博朋克宣传海报，用于展示定制的科幻显示字体，背景设定在日落时分霓虹闪烁的未来城市。构图顶部由巨大的金属质感 3D 标题文字“AI 超世代”占据，英文“AI”位于汉字上方，整体呈现出厚重的钢制机甲风格黑色字体，带有斜角边缘、铬合金反射、深枪灰色表面、电光蓝内发光、青色轮廓光以及锐利的工业几何造型。标题下方的前景中心，一个可爱的 Q 版机器人吉祥物正英勇地站立着，它拥有白色装甲机身和黑色关节、光滑的黑色数字面屏、明亮的青色发光双眼（其中一只眼睛在眨眼）、张开的笑脸、金色的耳机状耳盘以及发光的三角形胸章，正举起一只拳头欢呼并向前迈步。周围环绕着 6 个辅助机器人角色和无人机：左下角有一个带有粉色肉垫和欢快发光表情的猫耳 Q 版机器人，右下角有一个正在奔跑的兔耳 Q 版机器人，右下角远端有一个带有小数字脸的方形多功能机器人车辆，左上角和右上角各有一个球形无人机，左中位置有一个较大的飞行机器人。背景是密集的未来城市峡谷，两侧耸立着高楼大厦、高架道路、全息广告牌、发光标牌，大气透视感向明亮的中心逐渐淡出。画面中包含 3 个清晰可见的广告牌：左侧是一个粉色霓虹猫主题广告牌，右上角是一个蓝色全息机器人结构图广告牌，右下角是一个紫色霓虹广告牌。街道光滑且具有反射感，带有发光的电路状车道标记以及青色与洋红色的光束。采用戏剧性的低角度透视，居中对称的海报布局，高对比度，充满活力的青色、洋红色、紫色、橙色和金色灯光，精致的动漫与 3D 插画风格，电影般的日落云层，展现出充满活力、俏皮、未来感且可爱又宏大的科技品牌美学。

templates.prompt: A fashion photograph with a cinematic quality, featuring a {argument name="subject" default="young women"} She stands on a damp, dark rock platform before a towering waterfall in a rocky canyon. A full-body shot, wide horizontal composition, the subject slightly tilted to the right of the frame. The waterfall, a massive white torrent and curtain of mist, occupies most of the left and center of the background. The scene has a melancholic, elegant, and realistic atmosphere, rendered in natural, overcast light, with a cool gray tone that subtly contrasts with her warm skin tone. She is slender and athletic, with long, shapely legs {argument name="hair style" default="Dark long hair tied in a high ponytail"} Her face was slightly turned to the side, presenting a composed and fashionable pose. She was wearing a {argument name="top color" default="Dark brown"} Asymmetrical one-shoulder pleated cropped top, paired with a {argument name="bottom style" default="Beige high-waisted wrap mini skirt with a thin belt and built-in shorts"} She wore strappy high-heeled sandals. Her skin and clothing were slightly damp from the mist. One leg was extended forward, her hips slightly turned, one arm hung naturally at her side, and the other was casually placed, outlining a confident, luxurious fashion statement. Background details included a large waterfall, a smooth black rock wall on the right, and a wet, reflective stone platform at her feet. Hyperrealistic photography, high detail, shallow depth of field yet the waterfall remains clearly discernible, soft mist, water droplets, highly textured natural textures, high-end magazine aesthetics, soft earth tones, no text, no irrelevant people, no props.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影质感的时尚摄影作品，画面中一位 {argument name="subject" default="年轻女性"} 站在岩石峡谷内一座高耸瀑布前的湿润深色岩石平台上。全身照，宽幅横向构图，主体略微偏向画面右侧，瀑布作为巨大的白色湍流和水雾幕墙占据了背景的左侧和中心大部分区域。场景氛围忧郁、优雅且写实，采用自然阴天光线，环境呈现冷灰色调，与温暖的肤色形成微妙对比。她身材苗条健美，双腿修长，留着 {argument name="hair style" default="扎成高马尾的深色长发"}。她的脸部略微侧转，呈现出从容的时尚大片姿态。她身穿一件 {argument name="top color" default="深棕色"} 不对称单肩褶皱短款上衣，搭配一条 {argument name="bottom style" default="米色高腰裹身迷你裙，配有细腰带和内置短裤"}，以及系带高跟凉鞋。她的皮肤和服装因水雾而略显湿润。她的一条腿向前伸展，臀部微侧，一只手臂自然垂在身侧，另一只手臂自然放置，勾勒出自信的奢华时尚大片轮廓。背景细节包括 1 座大型瀑布、右侧 1 面光滑的黑色岩壁以及脚下 1 个湿润且具有反光效果的石台。超写实摄影，高细节，浅景深但瀑布依然清晰可辨，柔和的水雾，水滴，极具质感的自然纹理，高级杂志拍摄美学，柔和的大地色调，无文字，无无关人员，无道具。

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹梳妆镜前的赛博朋克少女

templates.prompt: A highly detailed anime-style cyberpunk dressing room at night, with a young woman in the center of the image sporting a short bob haircut and hair coloring {argument name="hair color" default="Soft pink"} The scene is mostly shot from behind, showing her sitting at a vanity, facing a tri-fold mirror. Her face is largely obscured by the angle and composition, with the scene focusing on atmosphere, style, and reflections rather than character portrayal. She wears a futuristic black and white hooded streetwear jacket with neon embellishments, layered straps, glossy materials, and functional details, and a pair of large RGB-lit headphones hang around her neck. A black X-shaped hair clip is visible on the side of her hair, and a pink and cyan glowing holographic circuit tattoo is visible on her bare upper arm. The tri-fold mirror creates an infinitely extending tunnel of reflections in the central mirror, repeating her seated posture and the blue-lit room in the distance; the left mirror shows the back of her head and the back of her jacket, while the right mirror presents a three-quarter profile of her, as she thoughtfully touches her lips. Twenty clearly visible grooming and desktop items are arranged on the table: a compact keyboard, a small beverage can, a smartphone with a bright anime-style lock screen, a round, glowing cat-ear desktop clock or speaker, two round powder compacts, three tall cosmetic bottles, four upright lipsticks or lip glosses, three makeup brushes in a pen holder, two pen-shaped makeup tools, and two additional small makeup containers. Eight clearly visible anime character figurines or dolls are displayed on surrounding shelves, enhancing the atmosphere of an otaku collector's bedroom studio. Dramatic neon lighting in magenta, violet, and electric blue creates shimmering reflections, cinematic halos, rich environmental details, and a sophisticated, futuristic anime illustration style inspired by high-end game concept art. The overall atmosphere should be private, stylish, slightly melancholic, and deeply immersive.{argument name="room theme" default="Collector's Cyberpunk Bedroom Dressing Table"} In self-expression.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度精细的动漫风格赛博朋克梳妆室夜景，画面中心是一位留着短波波头的年轻女性，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="柔和粉色"}，大部分视角从背后拍摄，她正坐在化妆台前，面对着一面三折镜。她的面部因角度和构图而大部分被遮挡，场景侧重于氛围、造型和倒影，而非身份刻画。她穿着一件充满未来感的黑白配色连帽街头风夹克，带有霓虹装饰、层叠绑带、光泽材质和机能风细节，脖子上挂着一副巨大的 RGB 灯效耳机。她的发侧可见一个黑色 X 形发夹，裸露的一侧上臂显示出粉色和青色的发光全息电路纹身图案。三折镜在中间镜面创造出无限延伸的倒影隧道，重复着她坐着的姿态以及远处蓝光笼罩的房间；左侧镜面显示她的后脑勺和夹克背面，右侧镜面则呈现出她四分之三侧面的倒影，她正若有所思地轻触嘴唇。桌面上摆放着 20 件清晰可见的梳妆及桌面物品：1 个紧凑型键盘、1 个小饮料罐、1 部带有明亮动漫风格锁屏界面的智能手机、1 个圆形发光猫耳桌面时钟或音箱、2 个圆形化妆粉饼盒、3 个高瓶身化妆品、4 支竖立的口红或唇彩、3 支插在笔筒里的化妆刷、2 支笔状化妆工具，以及 2 个额外的小型化妆容器。周围的架子上展示着 8 个清晰可见的动漫角色手办或玩偶，强化了御宅族收藏家卧室工作室的氛围。运用洋红色、紫罗兰色和电光蓝的戏剧性霓虹灯光，呈现光泽倒影、电影级光晕、丰富的环境细节，以及受高端游戏原画启发、精致且充满未来感的动漫插画风格。整体氛围应显得私密、时尚、略带忧郁，并深度沉浸在 {argument name="room theme" default="收藏家赛博朋克卧室梳妆台"} 的自我表达之中。

templates.title: Cute mermaid puppy underwater game launch screen

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱的美人鱼小狗海底游戏启动界面

templates.prompt: A bright, fantastical 3D underwater game launcher is placed within a rounded rectangular app window, designed like a sophisticated login page for a children's casual game. The scene is a colorful underwater world, with warm sunlight streaming through clear turquoise water, soft bubbles floating around, and the sandy seabed covered with corals and shells in soft hues. On the left, the prominent large Chinese title dominates the center of the image: "Bubble Bay Mermaid Dog Rescue Team," with a smaller line above it reading "Underwater Rescue Begins!" and a subtitle below: "Collect Shells, Help Turtles, and Light the Lighthouse with Little Puppy." All text uses a clean, modern UI font, with the title in very large, deep navy blue characters. On the right, an adorable mermaid puppy character inspired by preschool adventure animation is placed: a smiling puppy with cream and light brown fur, large violet eyes, cyan accessories on its drooping ears, a purple seashell necklace, and a mint green mermaid tail, floating vertically in the water. The character is surrounded by a magical coral reef environment, featuring 10 prominent foreground and midground marine elements: a purple rock arch on the far left, a pink starfish attached to the coral on the left, a pale purple clam shell in the lower left corner, a large pink branching coral in the center foreground, a pink seashell in the lower right corner, an orange starfish on the beach in the middle right, a blue porous rock in the foreground on the right, a cluster of blue tubular coral on the far right, a tall pinkish-purple coral tower behind the character, and an orange flower-shaped coral next to the tower. Soft hues of aquamarine, cyan, pink, pale purple, peach, and coral orange are used to create a glossy, toy-like texture and a soft depth-of-field effect. Three rounded UI buttons are arranged horizontally in the lower left corner: a yellow main button with a play icon labeled "Start"; a white secondary button with a circular target icon labeled "Level Selection"; and a white secondary button with a star icon labeled "Sticker". Additionally, a small circular settings button with a gear icon is added in the upper right corner. Overall style: The startup screen of a high-end children's mobile game is playful, healing, with cinematic lighting and high-end 3D illustrations, making it both friendly and captivating.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张明亮、奇幻的 3D 海底游戏启动界面，置于圆角矩形 App 窗口中，设计风格如同精致的儿童休闲游戏登录页面。场景为色彩斑斓的海底，温暖的阳光透过清澈的绿松石色海水倾泻而下，周围漂浮着柔和的气泡，沙质海床上覆盖着柔和色调的珊瑚和贝壳。在左侧，醒目的大号中文标题文字占据了构图中心：“泡泡湾人鱼狗救援队”，上方有一行较小的文字“海底救援开始啦”，下方副标题为“和小汪一起收集贝壳、帮助海龟、点亮灯塔。”所有文字均采用简洁现代的 UI 字体，标题使用非常大的深海军蓝色字符。在右侧，放置一个灵感源自学龄前冒险动画风格的可爱美人鱼小狗角色：一只面带微笑的小狗，拥有奶油色和浅棕色皮毛，大大的紫罗兰色眼睛，垂耳上装饰着青色配饰，戴着一枚紫色小贝壳项链，长着薄荷绿色的美人鱼尾巴，在水中垂直漂浮。角色周围环绕着神奇的珊瑚礁环境，包含 10 个显眼的前景和中景海洋元素：最左侧 1 个紫色岩石拱门，左侧珊瑚上附着 1 个粉色海星，左下角 1 个淡紫色蛤蜊壳，前景中央 1 个大型粉色分枝珊瑚，右下角 1 个粉色贝壳，中右侧沙滩上 1 个橙色海星，右侧前景 1 个蓝色多孔岩石，最右侧 1 簇蓝色管状珊瑚，角色后方 1 座高大的粉紫色珊瑚塔，以及塔旁 1 个橙色花朵状珊瑚。使用水绿色、青色、粉色、淡紫色、桃色和珊瑚橙色的柔和色调，呈现出光泽的玩具质感和柔和的景深效果。在左下方水平排列三个圆角 UI 按钮：一个带有播放图标的黄色主按钮，标注为“开始”；一个带有圆形目标图标的白色次要按钮，标注为“选关”；以及一个带有星星图标的白色次要按钮，标注为“贴纸”。此外，在右上角添加一个带有齿轮图标的小型圆形设置按钮。整体风格：高端儿童手游启动画面，俏皮、治愈、电影级光影、高端 3D 插画，友好且引人入胜。

templates.title: Soft underwater mermaid puppy game UI

titleLocalized.zh: 柔和水下美人鱼小狗游戏 UI

templates.prompt: The game's start screen is an adorable side-view underwater casual game, featuring a soft 3D cartoon style, designed like a delicate children's web game interface. The scene showcases a bright underwater world, with sunlight streaming through clear blue water, accompanied by floating bubbles, silhouettes of small fish in the distance, and a dreamlike coral reef environment filled with rounded pink, purple, blue, and mint green corals, seaweed, shells, rocks, and sand. Slightly to the left of the center, a mermaid puppy character inspired by a rescue dog cartoon floats happily underwater. It has a puppy face, sparkling eyes, drooping ears, a small crown-like ornament on its head, and a fish tail instead of hind legs, facing forward with a joyful expression. To the right stands a whimsical candy-colored coral lighthouse, shaped like a pink and white seashell tower, with a glowing lighthouse at the top, a pearl embedded in the roof, round seashell windows, a small balcony, a purple door, and coral details at the base. The game's UI elements are directly overlaid on the scene: In the upper left corner are two rounded white capsule buttons, the first labeled "Go to the Lighthouse," and the second displaying "0/3"; in the upper right corner is a round white pause button with a pause icon. Near the lighthouse, four semi-transparent colored target rings float on the interaction points: a pink ring near the upper-middle window, a yellow ring near the upper right lighthouse area, a light blue ring covering the lower right shell window, and a ring with a large white outline surrounding a purple jellyfish in the lower left. Three collectible shell/pearl items are visible in the scene: a glowing gold pearl in the open shell at the center, a small dark blue pearl shell at the bottom of the lighthouse, and a red pearl shell on the UI panel at the bottom center. At the bottom center are three rounded white operation prompt buttons with the text: "Arrow keys/WASD," "Space/Enter: Place bead," and "Esc: Return to map." A large, semi-transparent, rounded white panel is added behind the bottom operation buttons. The overall visuals should evoke feelings of joy, safety, color, and wonder, featuring a high degree of sophistication, soft depth of field, gentle lighting and shadows, a glossy toy-like texture, and aesthetics suitable for children's mobile or web game use.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个可爱的侧视角水下休闲游戏开始界面，采用柔和的 3D 卡通风格，设计如同精致的儿童网页游戏界面。场景展示了明亮的海底，阳光透过清澈的蓝色海水倾泻而下，伴有漂浮的气泡、远处细小的鱼群剪影，以及梦幻般的珊瑚礁环境，布满了圆润的粉色、紫色、蓝色和薄荷绿珊瑚、海草、贝壳、岩石和沙地。画面中心偏左处，一只灵感源自救援犬卡通的美人鱼小狗角色在水下快乐地漂浮，它有着小狗的脸庞、闪烁的大眼睛、耷拉的耳朵、头顶小巧的皇冠状饰品，以及代替后腿的鱼尾，正面向前方，表情欢快。右侧矗立着一座奇趣的糖果色珊瑚灯塔，形状像一座粉白相间的贝壳塔，顶部有发光的灯室、屋顶上镶嵌着一颗珍珠、圆形的贝壳窗、小阳台、紫色大门，底部装饰着珊瑚细节。游戏 UI 元素直接叠加在场景上：左上角有 2 个圆润的白色胶囊按钮，第一个写着“去灯塔”，第二个显示“0/3”；右上角有 1 个带有暂停图标的圆形白色暂停按钮。在灯塔附近，展示 4 个漂浮在交互点上的半透明彩色目标环：1 个粉色环靠近中上部窗户，1 个黄色环靠近右上角灯室区域，1 个淡蓝色环覆盖在右下角贝壳窗上，以及 1 个带有白色大轮廓的环围绕着中下部偏左的一只紫色水母。场景中可见 3 个可收集的贝壳珍珠物品：1 颗发光的金色珍珠位于中心处打开的贝壳中，1 个深蓝色小珍珠贝壳位于灯塔底部，以及 1 个红色珍珠贝壳放置在底部中央的 UI 面板上。在底部中央，放置 3 个圆润的白色操作提示按钮，文字分别为：“方向键 / WASD”、“空格 / 回车：放珠”和“Esc 回地图”。在底部操作按钮后方添加一个大型半透明圆润白色面板。整体画面应给人以快乐、安全、多彩且神奇的感觉，具有高度的精致感、柔和的景深、柔和的光影、光泽的玩具质感，以及适合儿童的移动端或网页游戏美学。

templates.title: Cute underwater mermaid puppy game UI

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱的水下美人鱼小狗游戏 UI

templates.prompt: A charming screenshot from a children's 3D game showcases a bright underwater world from a slightly overhead, third-person perspective, set within a colorful seaweed maze. The visuals are soft, luminous, and toy-like, with rounded shapes and smooth, clay-like textures. The colors are highly saturated and soft, with cinematic Tyndall effect beams shining through clear blue seawater. In the maze, a little mermaid puppy inspired by Coral from Paw Patrol stands in the lower left corner, sporting a friendly yet courageous smile. She has a light brown puppy face, large, expressive eyes, pinkish-purple mermaid-themed accessories, and a small mermaid tail, all designed in a charming, family-friendly animated style. Beside her on the sandy seabed, a pair of scissors—the hidden object—can be seen. The maze walls are constructed of lush green and blue-green seaweed, edged with rounded pebbles, forming a winding path at the center of the scene. The seabed is light golden sand, dotted with scorched light, scattered small shells and stones, and numerous floating bubbles. Surrounding the maze are fantastical blue, purple, and cyan coral rock structures, including a shell-shaped treasure niche with a starfish on the left and a large, open pink clam containing a pearl on the right. Two turtles are located on the right side of the game area: a larger, light green turtle and a smaller, brownish-green turtle. Additionally, three separate clumps of upright marine plants are scattered across the open sand. Add a translucent white cross-shaped path marker or target indicator above the center of the maze. Present it as a refined mobile game interface framed by a rounded rectangular screen. It contains a total of 6 UI elements: In the top left corner is a white pill-shaped label with the Chinese characters "Find Scissors," next to which is a white rounded counter displaying "0/3"; in the top right corner is a circular white pause button with a pause icon; and at the bottom center are three white rounded command buttons labeled "Arrow Keys/WASD," "Space/Enter: Scissors," and "Esc: Return to Map." The overall atmosphere is comfortable, playful, magical, and reassuring, like an educational hide-and-seek game for a sick child, boasting high-end casual game art style and a clean, app store-quality presentation.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张可爱的儿童 3D 游戏截图，展现了一个明亮的水下世界，视角为略微俯视的第三人称视角，场景位于色彩斑斓的海草迷宫内。画面具有柔和、光亮、类似玩具的质感，形状圆润，材质呈现平滑的粘土风格，色彩采用高饱和度的柔和色调，电影级的丁达尔效应光束透过清澈的蓝色海水照射下来。在迷宫中，一只灵感来自《汪汪队立大功》中 Coral 的小美人鱼小狗站在左下角附近，脸上带着友好且英勇的微笑。她有着浅棕色的小狗脸庞、大而富有表现力的眼睛、粉紫色的美人鱼主题配饰以及一条小美人鱼尾巴，设计风格为讨人喜欢的合家欢动画风。在她身旁的沙质海床上，可以看到一把剪刀，即隐藏物品的目标。迷宫墙壁由茂密的绿色和蓝绿色海草构成，边缘带有圆润的鹅卵石，在场景中心形成了蜿蜒的路径。海床是浅金色的沙地，上面有焦散光斑、散落的小贝壳和石块，以及许多漂浮的气泡。迷宫周围是奇幻的蓝、紫、青色珊瑚岩结构，包括左侧一个带海星的贝壳状宝藏壁龛，以及右侧一个内含珍珠的大型张开粉色蛤蜊。游戏区域右侧有 2 只海龟：1 只较大的浅绿色海龟和 1 只较小的棕绿色海龟，此外在开阔的沙地上还有 3 丛独立的直立海生植物。在迷宫中心上方添加一个半透明的白色十字形路径标记或目标指示器。将其呈现为由圆角矩形屏幕框住的精致手机游戏界面。总共包含 6 个 UI 元素：左上角是一个药丸形状的白色标签，上面写有中文“找剪刀”，旁边是一个白色的圆角计数器，显示“0/3”；右上角是一个带有暂停图标的圆形白色暂停按钮；底部中心排列着 3 个白色的圆角指令按钮，分别标注为“方向键 / WASD”、“空格 / 回车：剪刀”和“Esc 回地图”。整体氛围舒适、俏皮、充满魔力且令人安心，就像为生病的孩子准备的教育类捉迷藏小游戏，具有高端休闲游戏美术水准和简洁的应用商店级展示效果。

templates.title: Cute mermaid puppy underwater game screen

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱的美人鱼小狗水下游戏画面

templates.prompt: A bright, fantastical 2D underwater game scene, presented in a delicate children's animation style, is shown as a full-screen level screenshot within a rounded rectangular game viewport. The background features a colorful coral reef, with a light-colored pebble path winding from the foreground to the center of the sandy seabed, creating a sense of depth. Sunlight streams down from the clear blue water, and numerous tiny bubbles float in the scene. Soft, toy-like coral reefs and pink, peach, lilac, turquoise, and mint-colored marine plants surround the path, flanked by rock formations. Two starfish are placed in the foreground: a purple starfish on the lower left rock and a pinkish-orange starfish in the lower right. Two translucent pink jellyfish are added, positioned on the left and right sides of the screen respectively, emitting a soft glow. Six glowing pink clam shells are scattered along the path and around it, each radiating a soft magical halo. Four collectible golden-orange shells with pearl centers are placed near the central game area. Add a large purple balloon-shaped jellyfish obstacle with a white outline and short tentacles to the lower left center and middle right positions respectively. In the left-middle foreground, place an adorable mermaid puppy character inspired by the preschool animation Rescue Dog: a small, smiling dog face, large, expressive eyes, light brown and cream fur, a pink headdress, and a cyan mermaid tail, its posture playful and cheerful, as if moving forward. On the right, add a faintly dotted circular target marker above the environment. Overlay a simple Chinese mobile game UI: two white rounded capsule buttons in the upper left corner, displaying "Collect Shells" and "1/5" respectively; a white circular pause button with "II" in the upper right corner. Place three white rounded command buttons at the bottom center, with blue-gray text: "Arrow Keys/WASD", "Space/Enter: Bubble", and "Esc Return to Map". The overall visuals have a strong sheen, soft lighting suitable for children, high and balanced color saturation, creating a dreamy coral reef atmosphere, and a simple composition consistent with the art style of casual games.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张明亮、奇幻的 2D 水下游戏场景，采用精致的儿童动画风格，呈现为圆角矩形游戏视口内的全屏关卡截图。背景为色彩斑斓的珊瑚礁，沙质海床上一条浅色石子路从前景蜿蜒延伸至画面中心，营造出空间深度感。阳光从清澈的蓝色水面上方倾泻而下，许多小气泡在场景中漂浮。道路两侧环绕着柔软、玩具般的珊瑚群和粉色、桃色、淡紫色、绿松石色及薄荷色的海生植物，两侧还有岩石架。在前景放置 2 只海星，左下角岩石上是一只紫色海星，右下角是一只粉橙色海星。添加 2 只半透明的粉色水母，分别位于画面中左和中右位置，散发着柔和的光芒。在道路沿线及周边散落 6 个发光的粉色蛤蜊壳，每个都散发着柔和的魔法光晕。在中间游戏区域附近放置 4 个带有珍珠中心、金橙色的可收集贝壳。在左下中心和中右位置各添加一个大型紫色气球状水母障碍物，带有白色轮廓和短小的触须。在左中前景处，放置一个受学龄前动画救援犬启发的可爱的美人鱼小狗角色：小巧的微笑狗脸、大而有神的眼睛、浅棕色和奶油色皮毛、粉色头饰、青色美人鱼尾巴，姿态俏皮欢快，仿佛正在向前移动。在右侧，在环境上方添加一个淡淡的虚线圆形目标标记。叠加简单的中文手机游戏 UI：左上角有两个白色圆角胶囊按钮，分别显示“收贝壳”和“1/5”；右上角有一个带有“II”的白色圆形暂停按钮。底部中心放置 3 个白色圆角指令按钮，文字为蓝灰色：“方向键 / WASD”、“空格 / 回车：泡泡”和“Esc 回地图”。整体画面光泽感强、光线柔和、适合儿童，色彩饱和度高且平衡，营造出梦幻般的珊瑚礁氛围，构图简洁，符合休闲游戏艺术风格。

templates.title: Place the reference character into the Shibuya scene

titleLocalized.zh: 将参考人物置入涩谷场景

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_1 as the base scene, the woman from REFERENCE_0 is naturally inserted into the bustling crowd at the Shibuya intersection, making her a photorealistic passerby. The lighting, perspective, camera angles, proportions, and street-style realism of REFERENCE_1 are matched, while maintaining consistency in her clothing, bag, and overall appearance with REFERENCE_0. She is placed slightly to the left of the foreground, among pedestrians, her body slightly turned to the left, her posture natural and relaxed, as if she were already there when the photo was taken. Through realistic shadows, color matching, edge blending, and partial crowd occlusion, she is perfectly integrated into the environment, avoiding a "cut-out" effect. The existing urban background, signs, and crowd composition from REFERENCE_1 are preserved.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_1 作为基础场景，将 REFERENCE_0 中的女性自然地插入到涩谷十字路口繁忙的人群中，使其成为一名照片级逼真的路人。匹配 REFERENCE_1 的光影、透视、镜头感、比例及街拍真实感，并保持其服装、包袋和整体外观与 REFERENCE_0 一致。将她放置在前景偏左的位置，置身于行人之中，身体微向左侧，姿态自然放松，仿佛她原本就在那里拍摄的一样。通过逼真的阴影、色彩匹配、边缘融合以及部分人群遮挡处理，使她与环境完美融合，避免产生“抠图感”。保留 REFERENCE_1 中现有的城市背景、标志牌及人群构图。

templates.title: Watercolor-style family riverside selfies

titleLocalized.zh: 水彩风格家庭河畔自拍

templates.prompt: A warm and cheerful watercolor-style family selfie, set against a sunny, shallow riverbank, rendered with soft washes, delicate paper textures, and naturally blended, gentle tones. Three people are visible in the image. In the left foreground, a smiling mother is very close to the camera, her friendly face dominating the frame. She wears a dark baseball cap, her cheeks glowing with a soft pink, her makeup natural, and short, reddish-brown hair peeking out from under the cap. Above her, in the center, the father stands in the water behind her, smiling directly at the camera. He has short, dark hair, a light stubble, and wears a dark long-sleeved sun-protective shirt, making a peace sign with one hand. On the right, a child wearing a light-colored woven sun hat and a coral pink dress approaches the camera, making peace signs with both hands; the child's face is partially obscured by a flat, brown square mask. The background showcases a blue sky with fluffy white clouds, a row of green trees, and a sunlit shallow water area with soft reflections. The composition resembles an intimate vacation snapshot taken with a reach out, featuring a slightly wide-angle perspective, bright natural light, and a warm family travel atmosphere. The portrait has been retouched and beautified, with soft, glowing skin and a touch of blush. The details are clear, presenting the texture of a hand-drawn illustration.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张温馨、欢快的水彩风格家庭自拍，背景为阳光明媚日子的浅水河畔，采用柔和的渲染、细腻的纸张纹理以及自然融合的柔和色调绘制。画面中可见三人。左侧前景中，一位面带微笑的母亲非常靠近镜头，友好的面容占据了大部分画面，她戴着深色棒球帽，脸颊泛着柔和的粉色，妆容自然，短红棕色头发从帽檐下露出。上方中央，父亲站在她身后的水中，直视镜头微笑，留着深色短发，有淡淡的胡茬，身穿深色长袖防晒衣，一只手比出剪刀手。右侧，一个戴着浅色编织遮阳帽、身穿珊瑚粉色连衣裙的小孩向镜头靠拢，双手比出剪刀手；小孩的脸部被一个平坦的棕褐色方形遮挡块遮住。背景展示了 1 片蓝天和蓬松的白云、1 排绿树，以及带有柔和倒影的阳光浅水区。构图如同伸手拍摄的亲密度假快照，略带广角视角，明亮的自然光，充满温馨的家庭出游氛围，经过润色和美化的肖像处理，皮肤柔和发光，带有淡淡的腮红，细节清晰，呈现出手绘插画的质感。

templates.title: Japanese dark style alternative rock poster

titleLocalized.zh: 日系暗黑风格另类摇滚海报

templates.prompt: Create a dark, realistic, cinematic-style Japanese alternative rock album poster using a 2:3 vertical composition. The foreground features three young rock band members in heroic poses. The central figure, positioned slightly lower and closest to the camera, wears a black leather jacket, open at the chest, layered necklaces, and a black choker. He has pale skin, messy long black hair, and a rebellious, melancholic expression. The figure on the left is tall and thin, with messy grey-blonde hair, large tattoos on his neck and chest, a black leather jacket over a distressed black shirt, and layered chains and a belt. The figure on the right is tall and thin, with tousled light brown hair, wearing a grey distressed military-style jacket over a black skull-patterned shirt, layered necklaces and rings, visible hand tattoos, and a belt. The background is a ruined battlefield at dusk or night, with smoke, sparks, tattered flags, flocks of birds or crows in the sky, and collapsed buildings. The two standing figures are backlit, creating a harsh, apocalyptic atmosphere. Add scratched film texture, shattered glass effect, dust, embers, and high-contrast melancholic lighting, with desaturated black, charcoal gray, tan, and soft steel gray tones. The poster needs to integrate 13 visible text blocks to present a high-end music poster quality: At the very top is the small English text "ALTERNATIVE ROCK NEW ERA BEGINS"; in the middle are three song labels: on the left, "地" (Romanized "CHIJOU") and two lines of small Japanese text below; in the middle, "解放" (Romanized "KAIHOU") and two lines of small Japanese text below; on the right, "掲げろ" (Romanized "KAKAGERO") and two lines of small Japanese text below; in the middle is a large Japanese title "この声が、時代を変える."; below that is the English "ALTERNATIVE ROCK"; below that is the Japanese slogan "三つの歌が、ひとつの未来を創る—"; followed by the English slogan "3 SONGS. 3 SOULS. 1 The bottom section features three release information blocks labeled "Revolution," "Ground," and "Release," each including the Romanized version and the date "2025.06.01 RELEASE." At the very bottom is a box-shaped banner that reads "NEW ALBUM - 2025.06.01 ON SALE." The font design should convey a metallic, weathered, and luminous effect, with the large Japanese title occupying the lower-middle visual center. The overall atmosphere should be epic, rebellious, and emotionally charged, like a high-budget visual poster.{argument name="music project" default="Japanese alternative rock album"} The song title revolves around{argument name="song title 1" default="ground"} ,{argument name="song title 2" default="liberation"} and{argument name="song title 3" default="Raise it up"} Expand.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影感十足的暗黑写实风格日系另类摇滚专辑宣传海报，采用 2:3 纵向构图，前景为三位年轻摇滚乐队成员的英雄式姿态。中间的人物位置略低且最靠近镜头，身穿黑色皮夹克，敞开胸口，佩戴叠层项链和黑色颈圈，皮肤苍白，留着凌乱的黑色长发，表情叛逆忧郁。左侧人物身材高瘦，留着凌乱的灰金色头发，颈部和胸部有大面积纹身，黑色皮夹克内搭做旧黑色衬衫，佩戴叠层链条和腰带。右侧人物身材高瘦，留着蓬松的浅棕色头发，身穿灰色做旧军装风格夹克，内搭黑色骷髅图案衬衫，佩戴叠层项链和戒指，手部纹身可见，并系有腰带。背景是黄昏或夜晚的废墟战场，伴有烟雾、火星、破烂的旗帜、空中的鸟群或乌鸦、坍塌的建筑物，两位站立的人物身后有逆光光晕，呈现出粗粝的末日氛围。添加划痕胶片质感、碎玻璃叠加效果、灰尘、余烬，以及高对比度的忧郁灯光，色调为去饱和的黑色、炭灰色、棕褐色和柔和的钢灰色。海报中需集成 13 处可见的文字块，呈现高级音乐海报质感：最顶部为小号英文文本“ALTERNATIVE ROCK NEW ERA BEGINS”；海报中部有 3 处歌曲标注，左侧为“地上”（罗马音“CHIJOU”）及下方两行小号日文文案，中间为“解放”（罗马音“KAIHOU”）及下方两行小号日文文案，右侧为“掲げろ”（罗马音“KAKAGERO”）及下方两行小号日文文案；中部有一行巨大的日文标题“この声が、時代を変える。”；下方为一行英文“ALTERNATIVE ROCK”；再下方为一行日文标语“三つの歌が、ひとつの未来を創る—”；接着是一行英文标语“3 SONGS. 3 SOULS. 1 REVOLUTION”；底部为 3 个发行信息块，分别标注“解放”、“地上”和“掲げろ”，每个均包含罗马音及日期“2025.06.01 RELEASE”；最底部为一个盒状横幅，写有“NEW ALBUM - 2025.06.01 ON SALE”。字体设计需呈现金属感、风化感和发光效果，巨大的日文标题应占据中下部视觉中心。整体氛围应史诗、叛逆、充满情感，如同高预算的视觉主打海报，用于 {argument name="music project" default="日系另类摇滚专辑"}，歌曲标题围绕 {argument name="song title 1" default="地上"}、{argument name="song title 2" default="解放"} 和 {argument name="song title 3" default="掲げろ"} 展开。

templates.title: Japanese Claude Future Infographic

templates.title: Dark Fantasy Bureau Character Setting Table

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑奇幻局角色设定表

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the base character design, this project reimagines the same male student within a fictional, dark Japanese bureaucratic fantasy world. While maintaining his core physique, hairstyle, and facial structure, the school uniform concept is replaced with three official character variations, presented in the form of a professional concept art document. The background is an aged white paper with fine grid lines, rendered in black ink, soft grayscale tones, and deep red accent marks. A three-column layout, labeled 01, 02, and 03, is used, each column showcasing a full-body front, side, and back view of the same character reimagined for different positions. Character 01 is a tax collector, wearing a long black coat with hanging documents, armbands, shoulder straps, a belt, and a compact case. Character 02 is an arcane audit clerk, wearing glasses and a robe-like coat over a formal suit, with hanging stamps and inspection documents, ledgers or writing pads, writing instruments, and a briefcase. Character 03 is the courier for sealing artifacts, wearing a military-style hat, mask, heavy protective jacket, straps, tags, and carrying a large shipping box and a backpack-like cargo unit. Each character is accompanied by vertical Japanese side notes, dense bureaucratic labels, official badges, stamps, serial numbers, and a small English subtitle for the character's name. At the bottom, there are three equipment sections, one at the bottom of each column: Character 01 displays 3 items—a hard case, an official stamp, and 2 paper forms; Character 02 displays 4 items—a black equipment/ledger panel, a set of 4 pens, a tray containing 6 stamp sticks or ink cartridges, and a blue manual; Character 03 displays 4 items—a shipping box, 2 paper tags/forms, 3 hanging sealing tools, 2 round sealing tools, and 1 document card. An additional footer includes 4 color samples, 3 badges, a notification block, and a publication/record information box. Overall style: The design combines high-end anime concept with mysterious government archives, with meticulous clothing details, restrained composition, and realistic fabric rendering, creating a serious institutional atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 作为基础角色设定，将同一名男学生重新设计为虚构的日本暗黑官僚奇幻世界观档案。保持其核心体型、发型和面部结构一致，但将校服概念替换为 3 种官方角色变体，并以专业概念艺术文档的形式呈现，背景为带有细网格线的陈旧白纸，采用黑色墨水、柔和的灰度色调以及深红色强调标记。采用 3 列布局，分别标记为 01、02 和 03，每列展示同一角色为不同职位重新构思后的全身正视图、侧视图和背视图。角色 01 为税务征收官，身穿长款黑色大衣，带有悬挂的文件、臂章、肩带、皮带和一个紧凑型箱子。角色 02 为奥术审计书记员，佩戴眼镜，在正装外叠穿长袍式外套，带有悬挂的印章和检查文件、账本或写字板、书写工具以及公文包。角色 03 为封印文物快递员，佩戴军用风格帽子、面罩、厚重的防护外套、绑带、标签，并配有一个大型运输箱以及类似背包的货物单元。在每个角色旁边添加垂直的日语侧注、密集的官僚标签、官方徽章、印章、序列号以及角色名称的英文小副标题。在底部，包含 3 个装备部分，每列下方各一个：角色 01 展示 3 件物品——一个硬质箱子、一枚官方印章和 2 份纸质表格；角色 02 展示 4 件物品——一个黑色设备/账本面板、一套 4 支笔、一个装有 6 根印章棒或墨盒的托盘以及 1 本蓝色手册；角色 03 展示 4 件物品——一个运输箱、2 个纸质标签/表格、3 个悬挂式封印工具以及 2 个圆形封印工具加 1 张文档卡。包含一个额外的页脚条，其中包含 4 个色样、3 个徽章标志、一个通知块以及出版/记录信息框。整体风格：高端动漫概念表与神秘政府档案设计相结合，服装细节考究，构图克制，织物渲染写实，具有严肃的机构氛围。

templates.title: Japanese creator interview magazine interior page design

titleLocalized.zh: 日本创作者访谈杂志内页设计

templates.prompt: Design an exquisite double-page spread for a Japanese magazine, inspired by contemporary creator features in high-end design and culture magazines. The layout employs a clean, editorial interview style, complemented by a white background, navy blue accents, thin line divisions, elegant typography, and a balanced grid system. The overall atmosphere is sophisticated, modern, and slightly masculine, like a feature article on a handsome AI visual creator. In the upper left corner of the left page, a striking stacked English title, "CREATOR INTERVIEW," is placed using a bold, compressed sans-serif font, with small vertical issue number text, such as "VOL.23 / MAY 2024," added to the outer margins. At the bottom left and throughout most of the page, a large, cinematic image showcases a…{argument name="creator identity" default="Male AI visual creators"} Seated at a desk, wearing a dark hoodie, in a sophisticated studio. The subject's face is deliberately soft-focused or anonymized. The room is warmly lit, with multiple monitors displaying image editing or visual generation interfaces. A desk lamp sits on the table, and the walls are covered with concept art, posters, sketches, and fantasy artwork. A large white Meijō-style Japanese title is overlaid in the lower left corner of the photo: “X で世界観を育てる、AI表示現の実験室.” (Cultivating worldviews on X, a laboratory for AI expression.) Below this is smaller Japanese text introducing the account @multusdim_AI , describing an experimental AI art practice that emphasizes atmosphere, cue word design, and visual world construction. At the bottom of the left page is a smaller, horizontally arranged block of Japanese edited text summarizing the creator's focus and interview background. On the right page, five clearly separated edit sections are created. Section 1 is the main interview section, with the title “INTERVIEW” in blue uppercase sans-serif font at the top. Below are four formatted Japanese Q&As, each beginning with a blue "Q." and "A." The Q&As should discuss the creator's reasons for publishing their work on X, their creative focus, recurring themes, and observations of audience reactions. In the center of the interview section, add a large blue Japanese quote in oversized quotation marks: "AI でつくるのは畫ではなく、空気ごと伝わる体験." (AI creates not just images, but experiences that convey the entire atmosphere.) Section 2 is an image card in the upper right corner, showcasing a warm café portrait of a graceful maid-themed woman holding a drink, accompanied by a visible "MAID" label and a brief Japanese description. Section 3 is the second image card below, depicting a retro-futuristic street in the rain, with reflections of cars and neon lights, labeled "RETRO FUTURE" and a brief Japanese description. Section 4, the third image card at the bottom, showcases a richly detailed steampunk city or a massive clockwork structure, accompanied by smoke and brass machinery, labeled "STEAMPUNK" with a brief Japanese description. Section 5, the fourth image card at the bottom, displays a snapshot of a young woman outdoors in the warm sunset, labeled "EVERYDAY SNAP" with a brief Japanese description. At the bottom of the right page, three bordered information panels are added. The first is a "PROFILE" box containing the account name " @multusdim_AI " and a few lines of Japanese description, describing an AI visual creator focused on blending realism, retro-futurism, maid aesthetics, and steampunk atmosphere. The second is the "KEYWORDS" box, listing six Japanese keywords separated by slashes: "フォトリアル/ プロンプト设计/ メイド/ レトロフューチャー/ スチームパンク/ X运用/ AIアート" (realistic/ cue word design/ maid/ retro-futuristic/ steampunk/ X运用/ AI art), maintaining the same editorial feel. The third is a dark blue horizontal follow banner that reads "Follow: @multusdim_AI ". Page numbers 26 and 27 are added in the bottom corner, along with small footer text such as "CREATOR INTERVIEW" and "MAY 2024 / VOL.32". Using realistic magazine printing spacing and a clear editorial hierarchy, a highly convincing Japanese magazine layout is created.

promptLocalized.zh:
设计一款精致的日本双页杂志内页，风格参考高端设计与文化杂志中当代的创作者专题。排版采用简洁的编辑访谈风格，配以白色背景、海军蓝点缀、细线条分割、优雅的排版以及平衡的网格系统。整体氛围精致、现代且略带阳刚之气，如同对一位帅气的 AI 视觉创作者的专题报道。

在左页左上角，放置一个非常醒目的堆叠式英文标题“CREATOR INTERVIEW”，使用粗体压缩无衬线字体，外侧页边距处添加小的垂直期号文本，如“VOL.23 / MAY 2024”。在左页下方及大部分区域，放置一张电影感十足的大图，展示一位 {argument name="creator identity" default="男性 AI 视觉创作者"} 坐在书桌前，身穿深色连帽衫，身处氛围感十足的工作室中。人物面部刻意进行柔焦或匿名化处理。房间光线温暖昏暗，多台显示器上显示着图像编辑或视觉生成的工作界面，桌上摆放着台灯，墙上贴满了概念艺术、海报、草图和奇幻艺术作品。在照片左下角叠加一个巨大的白色明朝体日文专题标题：“X で世界観を育てる、AI 表現の実験室。”（在 X 上培养世界观，AI 表达的实验室。）并在下方添加较小的日文正文，介绍账号 @multusdim_AI，描述一种重视氛围、提示词设计和视觉世界构建的实验性 AI 艺术实践。在左页底部，包含一个水平排列的较小日文编辑文本块，总结创作者的关注点和访谈背景。

在右页，创建 5 个清晰分隔的编辑板块。板块 1 是主访谈栏，顶部标题为蓝色的英文大写无衬线字体“INTERVIEW”。下方格式化 4 条日文问答，每条以蓝色的“Q.”和“A.”开头。问答内容应讨论创作者在 X 上发布作品的原因、创作时的关注点、反复出现的主题以及对观众反应的观察。在访谈栏中部，添加一个巨大的蓝色日文引语，配以超大引号：“AI でつくるのは画像ではなく、空気ごと伝わる体験。”（用 AI 创作的不仅是图像，而是能传达整个氛围的体验。）板块 2 是右上角的图片卡片，展示一张温暖的咖啡馆肖像，画面中是一位柔美优雅的女仆主题女性正拿着饮料，配有可见标签“MAID”和一段简短的日文介绍。板块 3 是下方的第二张图片卡片，展示一条雨中复古未来主义街道，有汽车和霓虹灯倒影，标注“RETRO FUTURE”及简短日文介绍。板块 4 是下方的第三张图片卡片，展示一座细节丰富的蒸汽朋克城市或巨大的发条结构，伴有烟雾和黄铜机械，标注“STEAMPUNK”及简短日文介绍。板块 5 是底部的第四张图片卡片，展示一张年轻女性在温暖夕阳下户外的日常随拍，标注“EVERYDAY SNAP”及简短日文介绍。

在右页底部，添加 3 个带边框的信息面板。第一个是“PROFILE”框，包含账号名“@multusdim_AI”和几行日文简介，描述一位专注于融合写实主义、复古未来、女仆美学和蒸汽朋克的氛围感 AI 视觉创作者。第二个是“KEYWORDS”框，列出 6 个用斜杠分隔的日文关键词：“フォトリアル / プロンプト設計 / メイド / レトロフューチャー / スチームパンク / X運用 / AIアート”（写实 / 提示词设计 / 女仆 / 复古未来 / 蒸汽朋克 / X 运营 / AI 艺术），保持同样的编辑感。第三个是深蓝色水平关注横幅，写着“Follow: @multusdim_AI”。在底部角落添加页码 26 和 27，以及小的页脚文本，如“CREATOR INTERVIEW”和“MAY 2024 / VOL.32”。使用真实的杂志印刷间距、清晰的编辑层级，打造极具信服力的日本杂志排版。

templates.title: Clay toy landing page UI design

titleLocalized.zh: 粘土玩具落地页 UI 设计

templates.prompt: Create a warm and fun Japanese landing page for a children's clay toy brand, with an overall design in the style of handcrafted soft clay 3D models. The entire interface should have the appearance of a pastel-sculpted clay model, with rounded edges, slight finger marks, a matte texture, soft shadows, and a comfortable cream background. At the top, display a pill-shaped navigation bar containing a small clay house logo and the brand name "ねんどあそび" (Nendoasobi), followed by five navigation items: "Product Overview," "Set Contents," "Play Area," "Customer Feedback," and "Questions and Answers." On the far right is a circular shopping cart icon. In the first screen area, place a large dark brown clay title on the left side with the text "こねて, つくって, あそぼう." , with a smaller auxiliary text below "Hand ざわりが楽しい, やさしい Clay のおもちゃセット.". Add 2 rounded clay CTA buttons below: "Product を见る" and "ギフトにする" (with a small gift icon attached). On the right side of the main screen area, 12 clay toy illustrations are arranged: a rainbow and clouds, a lion, an elephant, a block tower with a red roof, a green circular badge that says "Target age 3+", a beige oval badge that says "Safe Material", a white rabbit holding a carrot, trees, a yellow ball, a blue toy car, a pink donut and strawberry, and a small red star in the lower right corner. Below, a row of three advantage display cards is created, each made of gray-white clay, containing an icon, a title, and a short Japanese description. Card 1 title: "Yawaraka Material" (with a clay hand icon). Card 2 title: "Kuri Kaishi Yuberu" (with a circular arrow icon). Card 3 title: "Imagination wo Yuteru" (with a light bulb icon). Below this, add a centered partial title “人気のセットラインナップ” (Popular Set Line Nuggets), surrounded by four small colored dots. Then, three product cards are displayed. Card 1, with a blue badge “人気No.1”, displays four animal models: a lion, an elephant, a rabbit, and a giraffe, titled “どうぶつセット” (Doubts Set), priced at “¥2,980”, and includes a blue button “详しく見る” (See details). Card 2, with an orange badge “おすすめ” (Osusume), displays seven snack models: a donut, a cake slice, a strawberry cream cake, a pink ice cream cone, a cookie, candy fragments, and a leaf, titled “おやつセット” (Oyatsu Set), priced at “¥2,680”, and includes an orange button “详しく見る” (See details). Card 3 features a blue "NEW" badge and showcases four toy vehicles: a red car, an airplane, a police car, and an excavator. It's titled "Norimono Set" and priced at "¥3,200," accompanied by a dark blue "See Details" button. A horizontal safety bar is added, containing three items: a heart icon with text about parent-child fun, a gift icon with text about gift popularity, and a shield icon with text about peace of mind and safety. A large coral-colored clay banner is created at the bottom, titled "See Your Favorite Set," and accompanied by a cream-colored button that reads "Now Check." Finally, a slim footer is added, containing four compact items and icons: "Free shipping on orders over 5,000 yen", "Same-day shipping available", "30-day return guarantee", and "Support available". The balanced grid layout, frontal view, soft natural light, and subtle shadows present a high-quality product design, combining captivating handcrafted stop-motion animation aesthetics with a sophisticated yet child-friendly atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 为儿童粘土玩具品牌创建一个温馨、有趣的日本落地页，整体采用手工软粘土立体模型风格设计。整个界面应呈现出由粉彩造型粘土雕刻而成的外观，具有圆润的边缘、轻微的指压痕迹、哑光质感、柔和的阴影以及舒适的奶油色背景。在顶部，展示一个药丸形状的导航栏，包含一个小粘土房屋 Logo 和品牌名称“ねんどあそび”，随后是 5 个导航项：“商品一覧”、“セット内容”、“遊び方”、“お客様の声”、“よくある質問”，最右侧是一个圆形的购物车图标。在首屏区域，左侧放置一个深棕色粘土大标题，文字为“こねて、つくって、あそぼう。”，下方配有一句较小的辅助文案“手ざわりが楽しい、やさしい粘土のおもちゃセット。”。在下方添加 2 个圆润的粘土 CTA 按钮：“商品を見る”和“ギフトにする”（附带一个小礼物图标）。在首屏区域右侧，排列 12 个粘土玩具插图：彩虹与云朵、狮子、大象、带红屋顶的积木塔、写有“対象年齢 3+”的绿色圆形徽章、写有“安全素材”的米色椭圆形徽章、拿着胡萝卜的白兔、树木、黄球、蓝色玩具车、粉色甜甜圈和草莓，右下角还有一个小红星。在下方，创建一个包含 3 张卡片的优势展示行，每张卡片均由灰白色粘土制成，包含图标、标题和简短的日语描述。卡片 1 标题：“やわらか素材”（配手持粘土图标）。卡片 2 标题：“くり返し遊べる”（配循环箭头图标）。卡片 3 标题：“想像力を育てる”（配灯泡图标）。在此下方，添加一个居中的部分标题“人気のセットラインナップ”，周围环绕 4 个彩色小圆点。随后展示 3 张产品卡片。卡片 1 带有蓝色徽章“人気No.1”，展示 4 个动物模型：狮子、大象、兔子、长颈鹿，标题为“どうぶつセット”，价格为“¥2,980”，配有青色按钮“詳しく見る”。卡片 2 带有橙色徽章“おすすめ”，展示 7 个零食模型：甜甜圈、蛋糕片、草莓奶油蛋糕、粉色冰淇淋蛋筒、饼干、糖果碎片和叶子，标题为“おやつセット”，价格为“¥2,680”，配有橙色按钮“詳しく見る”。卡片 3 带有蓝色徽章“NEW”，展示 4 个交通工具玩具：红色小汽车、飞机、警车、挖掘机，标题为“のりものセット”，价格为“¥3,200”，配有深蓝色按钮“詳しく見る”。添加一个水平保障栏，包含 3 个项目：心形图标配亲子乐趣文案、礼物图标配礼品人气文案、盾牌图标配安心・安全文案。底部创建一个珊瑚色粘土大横幅，标题为“お気に入りのセットを見つけよう”，并配有一个写着“今すぐチェック”的奶油色按钮。最后添加一个纤细的页脚栏，包含 4 个紧凑的项目及图标：“5,000円以上で送料無料”、“最短当日発送”、“30日間返品保証”和“サポート対応”。采用平衡的网格化网页布局、正面视角、柔和的自然光、细腻的阴影，呈现出高水准的产品设计模型质感，兼具迷人的手工定格动画美学与高端且亲近儿童的氛围。

templates.title: Android engineers inside the maintenance bay

titleLocalized.zh: 维护舱内的 Android 工程师

templates.prompt: A richly detailed, futuristic anime-style illustration depicts a female Android engineer in a cramped industrial repair room. She stands behind a waist-high machine workbench, facing the viewer. She sports a neat short bob with straight bangs, and her hair is [color missing].{argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown"} She wore a pair of elegant rectangular glasses. Her expression was calm and focused. Her body was clad in a sleek black and white biomechanical suit, featuring realistic panel seams, exposed abdominal mechanical components, flexible gray robotic arms, and a small marking on her chest that read "RC19". The overall appearance was elegant and graceful, presenting a mechanical quality rather than a bulky one. Her hands rested on a large rectangular control platform in front of her, a heavy metal device with rounded black corners, a white top plate, four visible bolt posts, a central circular interface, technical printed labels, and a sign that read {argument name="front machine label" default="MANIC"} The orange front bar is prominently displayed. The scene is illuminated by an industrial chandelier overhead, creating dramatic warm highlights on the polished armor and metal surfaces. The room is filled with black pipes and bundles of cables running along the ceiling and walls, which are made of metal. Small warning signs are affixed to the left wall, maintenance notices to the right, and a compact control box is located nearby. A cable is coiled on the floor near the machine. On the right, there is a tilted diagnostic monitor displaying a cyan holographic interface with a humanoid body image, status graphs, and a circular reading of "98%". Next to it is a small auxiliary control box with buttons and a glowing label that reads {argument name="console text" default="LINK ONLINE"} The overall atmosphere evokes a cyberpunk futuristic feel, blending precision engineering with a tranquil industrial sci-fi realism. The centered, half-body to knee-length composition, slightly low viewing angle, clean lines, glossy reflections, intricate hard-surface details, realistic metallic textures, cinematic contrast, and the interplay of warm overhead lighting and cool screen light create a refined, high-end conceptual art aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张细节极其丰富的未来感动漫风格插图，描绘了一位身处狭窄工业维修室的女性 Android 工程师，她站在齐腰高的机器工作台后，面向观众。她留着利落的短波波头，配有直刘海，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"}，戴着一副精致的矩形眼镜。她的神情冷静而专注。她的身体穿着一套光滑的黑白双色生物机械套装，带有逼真的面板接缝、外露的腹部机械组件、灵活的灰色机械手，胸前有一个写着“RC19”的小型标记。整体外观优雅、柔美，且呈现出机械质感而非臃肿感。她双手撑在面前的大型矩形控制平台上，该平台是一个沉重的金属装置，带有圆润的黑色边角外壳、白色顶板、四个可见的螺栓柱、一个中央圆形接口、技术印刷标签，以及一条写有 {argument name="front machine label" default="MANIC"} 的橙色前条。场景由头顶上方的一盏工业吊灯照明，在抛光的装甲和金属表面上营造出极具戏剧性的暖色高光。房间内布满了沿天花板和墙壁延伸的黑色管道与成捆的电缆，墙面为金属材质，左侧墙上贴有小型警告牌，右侧墙上贴有维修通知单，另有一个紧凑的控制箱，地面上有一根电缆在机器附近盘绕。在右侧，包含 1 台倾斜的诊断显示器，显示着青色的全息风格界面，上面有类人身体图、状态图表和一个显示“98%”的圆形读数。旁边放置 1 个带有按钮的小型辅助控制盒，上面有一个发光的小标签，写着 {argument name="console text" default="LINK ONLINE"}。整体氛围为赛博机械维护、精密工程和静谧的工业科幻写实感。采用居中的半身至膝盖构图，略微低平的视线角度，清晰的线条，光泽的反射，复杂的硬表面细节，逼真的金属纹理，电影级的对比度，暖色顶光与冷色屏幕光交相辉映，呈现出精致的高端概念艺术质感。

templates.title: Japanese urban horror novel cover

titleLocalized.zh: 日式都市恐怖小说封面

templates.prompt: A dark psychological horror novel cover illustration with a cinematic, rough digital painting style. It creates a wide, ominous composite scene set in a decaying modern Japanese environment. The left side blends a commuter train car with a late-night office on the right. In the foreground, a female ghost stands with her back to the viewer. She has long, disheveled, seemingly wet, black hair, and her face is completely obscured by a solid black rectangular void. The color palette uses cool blue-gray, charcoal gray, dirty white, and low-saturation browns, complemented by glaring fluorescent overhead lights and deep shadows. On the left, the crowded train car interior is shown, revealing four commuters: two men in business suits gripping or standing under handrails, a woman in plain office attire with her face blurred or obscured, and a passenger in the distance near the door. The illustration includes a row of handrails overhead, dirty metal bars, scratched windows, and a suffocating sense of perspective. In the lower left foreground, a large white cracked flowerpot holds a withered plant with curled, brown leaves and dried soil. At the center, a female ghost serves as a dividing line between the two spaces; her body and hair blend into black stains and shadows. To the right, a desolate office is depicted, with three employees working under fluorescent lights in the background, surrounded by computer monitors, files, and glass partitions. In the right foreground, a burly office worker, chest to thigh, wearing a wrinkled white shirt and a loose tie, holds files; his head is cut off by a top border, adding to the unease. Black cracks, grime, ink-like tendrils, and water stain textures scattered on the walls, floor, and edges of the images give the scene an infected or haunted feel. A subtle, still sense of dread is added, like a curse lurking in everyday life. A large, distressed white Japanese title text is superimposed in the center of the image:{argument name="title text" default="The gap itself"} Below it, add smaller white subtitle text:{argument name="subtitle text" default="Day 1: Monday"} Use a rough, cracked, horror-style font, centered above the figure. The overall effect should evoke the unsettling image of a literary cover or a promotional visual for a horror-themed Japanese urban story.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张具有电影质感、粗粝数字绘画风格的暗黑心理恐怖小说封面插画。创作一个宽幅、不祥的复合场景，背景设定在衰败的现代日本环境，左侧融合了通勤列车车厢，右侧则是深夜的办公室，画面正中央前景处站着一位背对观众的女性幽灵。她留着凌乱且看起来湿漉漉的长黑发，脸部被一个实心的黑色矩形虚空完全遮挡。色调采用冷蓝灰色、炭灰色、脏白色和低饱和度的棕色，配以刺眼的荧光顶灯和深邃的阴影。在左侧，展示拥挤的列车车厢内部，可见 4 名通勤者：2 名身穿商务西装的男性正抓着或站在吊环下方，1 名身着素色办公装的女性面部模糊或被遮挡，还有 1 名靠近车门的远景乘客。包含上方的一排吊环、肮脏的金属杆、有划痕的窗户以及令人窒息的透视感。在左下角前景处，放置 1 个巨大的白色裂纹花盆，里面种着 1 株枯萎的植物，叶片卷曲呈棕色，土壤干涸。在中心位置，利用女性幽灵作为两个空间的分隔点；她的身体和头发融入黑色的污渍与阴影中。在右侧，描绘一个凄凉的办公室，背景中有 3 名员工在荧光灯下办公，配有电脑显示器、文件和玻璃隔断。在右侧前景处，展示 1 名从胸部到大腿的上班族，身穿褶皱的白衬衫，领带松垮，手里拿着文件；他的头部被顶部边框切断，增添了不安感。在墙壁、地板和图像边缘散布黑色裂纹、污垢、墨汁般的卷须和水渍纹理，使整个场景感觉像是被感染或闹鬼。加入微妙的静止恐惧感，如同隐藏在日常生活中的诅咒存在。在画面中间叠加巨大的做旧白色日文标题文字：{argument name="title text" default="隙間、そのもの"}。在其下方，添加较小的白色副标题文字：{argument name="subtitle text" default="第１日：月曜日"}。使用边缘粗糙、带有裂纹的恐怖风格字体，居中置于人物上方。整体效果应呈现出一种令人不安的文学封面或恐怖日式都市故事的宣传主视觉图。

templates.title: Leafa (Anime Style Sky Portrait)

titleLocalized.zh: 莉法 (Leafa) 动漫风格天空肖像

templates.prompt: A beautifully crafted anime/fantasy illustration featuring a protagonist from "Sword Art Online".{argument name="character name" default="Leafa"} She is a young elven girl with long, golden hair tied in a high ponytail with a large light green bow. Loose bangs frame her face, and a thin braid adorns each cheek. She has pointed elven ears and emerald green eyes, and smiles confidently and gently at the camera. She floats in mid-air or rests on a cloud, one knee raised close to her chest, arms wrapped around her leg, creating a dynamic perspective from a slightly upward angle. She is adorned with a pair of translucent, light mint-green elven wings that shimmer and radiate behind her. Her attire is a classic green elven warrior outfit: a dark green belted dress with white trim and a tiered skirt, white long sleeves, white knee-high socks with jagged edges, a dark brown belt and ties at the waist and legs, and brown knee-high leather boots. The scene is set above a sun-drenched fantasy city, with towering stone towers, magnificent buildings, bridges, floating clouds, and a warm golden sunset in the background. It employs soft background blur, cinematic contour lighting, subtle glitter effects, and high-detail anime rendering with vibrant colors, smooth shadows, and an ethereal, heroic feel.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的动漫奇幻插画，主角是来自《刀剑神域》的 {argument name="character name" default="Leafa"}。她是一位年轻的精灵少女，留着一头金色长发，扎成极高的马尾，并系着一个巨大的浅绿色蝴蝶结，两侧留有松散的刘海，脸颊两侧各有一条细细的编发。她有着尖尖的精灵耳朵、翠绿的眼睛，正对着镜头露出自信温柔的微笑。她悬浮在半空中或栖息在云端，单膝抬起靠近胸前，双臂环抱着腿部，从略微仰视的角度呈现出极具动感的透视构图。为她配上一对半透明的浅薄荷色精灵翅膀，在身后闪耀，舒展且明亮。她的服装是经典的绿色精灵战士装：深绿色束腰连衣裙，配有白色饰边和分层裙摆，白色长袖，边缘呈锯齿状的白色过膝袜，腰部和腿部配有深棕色腰带和绑带，以及棕色过膝皮靴。场景设定在阳光明媚的奇幻城市上空，背景可见高耸的石塔、华丽的建筑、桥梁、漂浮的云朵以及温暖的金色夕阳。采用柔和的背景虚化、电影级轮廓光、细微的闪光效果，以及色彩鲜艳、阴影平滑、充满空灵英雄气息的高细节动漫渲染。

titleLocalized.zh: 手持沙锤的肌肉派对男

templates.prompt: A highly detailed anime-style illustration featuring a protagonist who{argument name="character type" default="Rugged middle-aged man"} He is at a wild tropical dance party. The shot is taken from a dramatic low angle, the camera close to his torso. He possesses an extremely strong and muscular physique, with clearly defined abs, a broad chest, and glistening beads of sweat on his skin. He has a slight stubble on his jaw and neck, and short, messy light brown hair. His face is mostly out of frame or obscured, thus focusing attention on his physique and movements. He is wearing an open {argument name="shirt style" default="Bright Hawaiian floral shirt"} He is dressed in a shirtless outfit, adorned with large, colorful hibiscus flowers, and wears a gold necklace with a circular pendant. He is wielding two large maracas, one extended towards the audience from the left foreground and the other to the side. The maracas are decorated with red, yellow, green, and black stripes and feature a strong motion blur effect to convey energetic movement. The background depicts a crowded nightclub or music festival crowd with raised hands, neon laser beams, firework-like lights, dazzling blur effects, and confetti flying everywhere. The use of explosive hues of magenta, purple, blue, gold, green, and bright pink, combined with glossy highlights, strong rim lighting, exaggerated perspective, and dynamic foreground perspective, creates a celebratory and extreme party atmosphere. This makes it resemble a high-end, sophisticated anime key visual, with clean lines, dramatic shadows, shimmering effects, and an extreme sense of energy.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超精细的动漫风格插图，主角是一位 {argument name="character type" default="粗犷的中年男子"}，身处狂野的热带舞会中。画面采用戏剧性的低角度拍摄，镜头紧贴其躯干。他拥有极其强壮的健美体格，腹肌线条分明，胸部宽阔，皮肤上闪烁着明显的汗珠，下颚和颈部略带胡茬，留着凌乱的浅棕色短发。他的面部大部分处于画面之外或被遮挡，从而将焦点集中在他的体格和动作上。他穿着一件敞开的 {argument name="shirt style" default="明亮的夏威夷花衬衫"}，上面印有大型彩色木槿花，内里未穿衬衫，脖子上戴着一条带有圆形吊坠的金项链。他双手各摇晃着一个大沙锤，左侧前景的一个沙锤向观众方向伸出，右侧的另一个沙锤则向侧面伸展，沙锤上带有红、黄、绿、黑条纹，并带有强烈的动态模糊效果，以展现充满活力的动作。背景是拥挤的夜店或音乐节人群，人们高举双手，霓虹激光束、烟花般的亮光、绚丽的虚化效果以及漫天飞舞的五彩纸屑随处可见。使用洋红色、紫色、蓝色、金色、绿色和亮粉色的爆炸性色调，搭配光泽高光、强烈的轮廓光、夸张的透视、动态的前缩透视，营造出一种欢庆且极致的派对氛围。使其看起来像高端精致的动漫关键视觉图，具备清晰的线条、戏剧性的阴影、闪烁的特效以及极致的能量感。

The scene employs a dramatic overhead perspective, with the character positioned in the center right of the frame, glancing back as she flies over the city. She has long {argument name="hair color" default="Golden yellow"} Her hair was tied in a very high ponytail with a large, light-colored bow. She had pointed elf ears, a slender figure, and translucent, yellowish-green fairy wings made of luminous crystals. She wore a fantastical green and white outfit with gold trim: a short green dress or tunic, white armor details on the chest, a brown belt, white split sleeves or fitted arm guards, white knee-high stockings with lace trim and dark straps, and brown knee-high boots. Her skirt, ribbons, ponytail, and wings billowed in the wind to emphasize speed and height. The background was a vast, sun-drenched aerial kingdom, with countless intricately detailed towers, domes, bridges, and castle-like buildings piercing through the clouds, showcasing complex architectural structures and atmospheric depth. Warm golden sunlight poured down from the upper left, creating lens flares, rim lights, shimmering dust particles, and luminous highlights on the wings and the city. Featuring highly detailed anime-style artwork, cinematic composition, dynamic perspective, soft volumetric clouds, stunning fantasy lighting, vibrant green and gold color schemes, an epic adventure atmosphere, and exquisite GPT-Image-2 image quality.

templates.prompt: A simple, high-end Japanese-style advertising poster used to showcase the concept of luxury beds or mattresses, with the title:{argument name="product title" default="Sleep above the clouds"} The English subtitle is{argument name="english subtitle" default="Sleep Cloud"} The poster is designed around the concept of zero-gravity sleep. It uses a minimalist soft white background with light pinkish-blue tones to create a light, airy feel and a tranquil, sophisticated aesthetic. The poster layout is elegant: on the left is a large, refined serif Japanese title in a grayish-pinkish-blue color, above which is a line of smaller text: "重力ゼロの、やさしい眠り." (Gravity Zero, Yasashii Sleep). The main title, "云の上の眠り" (Sleep Above the Clouds), is centered, and below is an English subtitle, flanked by thin horizontal lines. Below this are two short paragraphs of blue text describing a suspended, free, and comfortable sleep experience. On the right is a soft-light 3D rendered bedroom scene on a suspended rectangular platform: a modern white bed with a low backrest, two white pillows, and white bedding are placed there, with a light blue blanket draped diagonally over the lower half of the bed. This makes the bed appear to float slightly above the platform, with a faint blue halo below to evoke the feeling of zero gravity. A tall, arched window is set in the background, displaying a blue sky and soft white clouds. A small, round bedside table sits beside the bed, displaying a vase with delicate flowers and a small ornament. A round, cream-colored rug and a light blue floor cushion are placed under the bed. Two fluffy cloud props are placed beside the platform bed. Faint clouds float along the edge of the poster. In the lower left to center area, three circular function icons are placed with their descriptions: a cloud icon representing the comfort of weightless suspension, a wavy line icon representing a soft, enveloping feeling, and a leaf icon representing a safe and comfortable material. A large, rounded blue call-to-action button with white Japanese text is added in the lower left corner.{argument name="button text" default="Try it now"} And a right-pointing arrow, next to a circular badge that reads "Limited Time Offer". A compact three-line information bar is added to the bottom right corner, with small icons: a truck icon with "Free Shipping", a shield icon with "30-Day Return Guarantee", and a calendar icon with the date.{argument name="deadline date" default="Until June 30, 2025 (Monday)"} Add a light white color to the upper right corner.{argument name="brand watermark" default="Pollo.ai"} Watermark. Overall style: soft 3D product visualization, Scandinavian-inspired minimalism, dreamy cloud theme, luxury bedding advertising, diffused light, light blue shadows, clean composition, and sophisticated commercial poster design.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张简洁、高端的日式广告海报，用于展示奢华床具或床垫概念，标题为 {argument name="product title" default="雲の上の眠り"}，英文副标题为 {argument name="english subtitle" default="Sleep Cloud"}，围绕零重力睡眠概念设计。采用极简柔白色背景，搭配淡粉蓝色调，营造出轻盈的留白感和宁静的高级健康美学。海报布局优雅：左侧为精致的衬线体日文大标题，颜色为灰粉蓝色，上方配有一行小字「重力ゼロの、やさしい眠り。」，主标题「雲の上の眠り」居中，下方为英文副标题，两侧饰以细横线。其下方添加两段简短的蓝色小字正文，描述悬浮、自由、舒适的睡眠体验。右侧展示一个柔光 3D 渲染的卧室场景，位于一个悬浮的长方形平台上：放置 1 张带有低靠背的现代白色床，配 2 个白色枕头、白色床品，床的下半部分斜搭着 1 条浅蓝色盖毯。让床看起来微微悬浮于平台之上，下方带有淡淡的蓝色光晕，以体现零重力感。背景处设置 1 个高大的拱形窗户，窗内显示蓝天与柔和的白云。床边放置 1 个小型圆形床头柜，上面摆放 1 个插着精致花枝的小花瓶和 1 个小物件，床下铺有 1 张圆形奶油色地毯，配 1 个浅蓝色地板坐垫，平台床边摆放 2 个蓬松的云朵道具。海报边缘漂浮着淡淡的云朵。在左下至中部区域，放置 3 个圆形功能图标及其下方说明：1 个云朵图标代表无重力悬浮舒适感，1 个波浪线图标代表柔软包裹感，1 个叶子图标代表安全舒适的材质。左下角添加 1 个大型圆角蓝色行动呼吁按钮，内含白色日文 {argument name="button text" default="今すぐ体験する"} 及向右的箭头，旁边配有 1 个圆形轮廓徽章，写着「期間限定」。右下角添加 3 行紧凑的信息栏，配有小图标：1 个货车图标配「送料無料」，1 个盾牌图标配「安心の30日間返品保証」，以及 1 个日历图标配日期 {argument name="deadline date" default="2025.6.30(月)まで"}。在右上角添加一个淡淡的白色 {argument name="brand watermark" default="Pollo.ai"} 水印。整体风格：柔和的 3D 产品可视化、受斯堪的纳维亚风格启发的极简主义、梦幻云朵主题、奢华寝具广告、漫射光、淡蓝色阴影、纯净构图、精致的商业海报设计。
