templates.title: Pancake Angel Idol Cafe Selfie

titleLocalized.zh: 松饼天使偶像咖啡馆自拍

templates.prompt: A casual watercolor line drawing depicts a young male idol, styled like a waffle angel, taking a selfie in a trendy café. The composition uses a close-up, slightly wide-angle selfie perspective, with one arm extending from the left foreground towards the viewer, creating a relaxed, fan-service snapshot feel. He has messy, short blond hair, delicate features, and enormous white angel wings spread behind him. A quirky stack of {argument name="head accessory" default="Golden muffins drizzled with syrup and topped with butter"} He was like a halo. He was wearing an oversized white T-shirt with a printed logo.{argument name="shirt text" default="PANCAKE TENSHI"} The outfit features lettering and a pancake design, and includes a delicate necklace with small star pendants. The overall atmosphere is cheerful, dreamy, and has a touch of idol appeal. Japanese text appears in the speech bubbles near his head.{argument name="speech bubble text" default="So fluffy today too! ♪ Pancake power!"} The café behind me was bright and had a sketch-like interior, with a blackboard sign that read {argument name="cafe sign" default="CAFE Pancake Heaven"} On the left are shelves and windows, while in the background on the right, two idol performers hold microphones on a small stage under hanging lights. The foreground displays three pancake-themed dishes: a small pancake dessert decorated with whipped cream and berries in the lower left corner, a plate of truncated pancakes at the bottom center, and a cup labeled {argument name="cup text" default="TENSHI CAFE"} Iced drinks in plastic cups with labels and little wing icons. Hand-drawn doodles, little hearts, glitter, and handwritten Japanese menu notes are added around the food, and a small "playlist" card is included in the lower right corner. Using expressive pencil lines, soft beige and honey tones, and white highlights, it presents a slightly messy café sketchbook style and a charming editorial illustration quality.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张随性的水彩墨线动漫插画，描绘了一位造型如松饼天使般的年轻男偶像在时尚咖啡馆内的自拍。构图采用近距离、略带广角效果的自拍视角，他的一只手臂从左侧前景伸向观众，营造出一种随性的粉丝福利快照感。他留着凌乱的短金发，长相清秀，身后展开着巨大的白色天使翅膀。头顶上方戴着一叠奇趣的 {argument name="head accessory" default="淋着糖浆、放着黄油块的金黄松饼"}，宛如光环。他穿着一件超大号白色 T 恤，上面印有 {argument name="shirt text" default="PANCAKE TENSHI"} 字样和松饼图案，并佩戴着一条带有小星星吊坠的细项链。整体氛围欢快、梦幻，且带有一丝偶像气息。他头部附近的对话气泡中写着日文 {argument name="speech bubble text" default="今日もふわふわ〜♪ パンケーキパワー！"}。身后的咖啡馆内部明亮且带有速写感，黑板招牌上写着 {argument name="cafe sign" default="CAFE Pancake Heaven"}，左侧有货架和窗户，右侧背景中有 2 位偶像表演者在悬挂灯饰下的小舞台上拿着麦克风。前景展示了 3 份摆盘或供应的松饼主题餐点：左下角是一份装饰有鲜奶油和浆果的小型松饼甜点，底部中央是一盘被截断的松饼，右下角是一杯贴有 {argument name="cup text" default="TENSHI CAFE"} 标签及小翅膀图标的塑料杯冰饮。在食物周围添加手绘涂鸦、小爱心、闪光点和手写日文菜单备注，右下角还包含一张小小的“歌单”卡片。运用富有表现力的铅笔线条、柔和的米色和蜂蜜色调、白色高光，呈现出略显凌乱的咖啡馆速写本风格以及迷人的编辑插画质感。

templates.title: Fictional Triple Crown commemorative poster

titleLocalized.zh: 虚构三冠赛马纪念海报

templates.prompt: A highly dramatic Japanese horse racing champion poster, employing a cinematic, high-contrast, high-end sports advertising style. The main subject is a powerful, deep bay to almost black thoroughbred racehorse, its coat glossy, mane gently flowing in the breeze, a small white star on its forehead, facing the right side of the camera in a commanding three-quarters pose. The horse wears racing gear, with a large white number "7" and its Japanese name printed on the dark blue saddle pad.{argument name="horse name" default="コントロール"} The design employs a deep navy blue, black, and metallic gold color scheme, complemented by luminous highlights, mist, sparks, and a night sky atmosphere to create a legendary and triumphant ambiance. The layout should convey the feel of an elite champion poster: an oversized gold Japanese title in the upper left corner.{argument name="main headline" default="Triple crown winner."} Below is a smaller gold subtitle: "That name is the master of the pinnacle." On the left, three gold laurel wreath achievement markers are arranged vertically: 1) "Satsuki Sho" with the smaller text below "Nakayama Racecourse Shiba 2000m", 2) "Nippon Darby" with the smaller text below "Tokyo Racecourse Shiba 2400m", and 3) "Kikusho" with the smaller text below "Kyoto Racecourse Shiba 3000m". In the lower left corner, towards the center, is a large, metallic gold Japanese horse name.{argument name="horse name large" default="コントロール"} Below this is the widely spaced serif Roman letter name CONTROL. Below that is a line of gold Japanese pedigree description: "Male/Aoshikage Father:{argument name="sire name" default="チープコンパクト"} On the right, a semi-transparent portrait of an older male horse trainer wearing a hat and glasses emerges from the dark background, his expression serious and authoritative; a vertical white sign on the far right edge reads "Control the heart, dominate the race." Near the trainer's portrait, a handwritten white calligraphy signature is added: "Trainer" followed by a large signature.{argument name="trainer name" default="Yuzo"} Below is a smaller white phrase: "Belief is to dominate victory." In the lower right corner, three smaller action panels or silhouette scenes depict the same horse galloping under the jockey's guidance. Each panel has a cool blue tone and is labeled in gold below: "Satsuki Prize," "Nippon Darby," and "Chrysanthemum Prize." The overall composition is compact and elegant, incorporating layered smoke, stadium lights, gold dust, and strong contrasts to create a visual effect reminiscent of a high-end commemorative poster for a fictional Triple Crown race.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的日式赛马冠军海报，采用电影级、高对比度的高端体育广告风格。主体是一匹强壮的深骝色至近乎黑色的纯血赛马，毛色光亮，鬃毛微风拂动，额头有一颗小白星，以霸气的四分之三全身姿态面向镜头右侧。马匹佩戴着赛马装备，深蓝色马鞍垫上印有巨大的白色数字“7”以及日文马名 {argument name="horse name" default="コントロール"}。采用深海军蓝、黑色和金属金配色，辅以发光高光、薄雾、火花和夜空氛围，营造出传奇且凯旋的意境。排版应呈现精英冠军海报的质感：左上方为超大号金色日文标题 {argument name="main headline" default="三冠制覇。"}，下方配有较小的金色副标题「その名は、頂点の制御者。」。在左侧，垂直排列 3 个金色月桂花环成就标注：1) 「皐月賞」及下方小字「中山競馬場 芝2000m」，2) 「日本ダービー」及下方小字「東京競馬場 芝2400m」，3) 「菊花賞」及下方小字「京都競馬場 芝3000m」。在左下至中心位置，放置巨大的金属质感金色日文马名 {argument name="horse name large" default="コントロール"}，下方为间距拉开的衬线体罗马字母名称 CONTROL。其下方添加一行金色日文血统说明：「牡・青鹿毛　父：{argument name="sire name" default="チープコンパクト"}」。在右侧，添加一张戴着帽子和眼镜的年长男性练马师的半透明肖像，从深色背景中浮现，神情严肃且充满权威感；最右侧边缘配有垂直的白色标语「心を制し、レースを支配する。」。在练马师肖像附近，加入手写风格的白色书法练马师署名：「調教師」后接巨大的签名式名称 {argument name="trainer name" default="夕造"}，下方配有一句较小的白色短语：「信念は、勝利を支配する。」。在右下角，展示 3 个较小的动作面板或剪影场景，描绘同一匹马在骑师驾驭下奔跑的画面，每个面板均带有冷蓝色调，下方以金色标注：「皐月賞」、「日本ダービー」、「菊花賞」。整体构图紧凑而优雅，融合了层叠的烟雾、体育场灯光、金粉和强烈的对比，呈现出如同虚构三冠赛马高端纪念海报般的视觉效果。

templates.title: Japanese-style inventory management app promotional poster

titleLocalized.zh: 日式库存管理 App 宣传海报

templates.prompt: A simple promotional poster for a mobile app, featuring a soft mint green background, centered composition, and vertically distributed elements, used to promote the app's name.{argument name="app name" default="Zaiko"} The app is an inventory management app. At the top is a rounded white capsule-shaped logo containing the green app name; below is a smaller outline capsule containing a green dot, the number 01, and the Japanese text "見える化" (mieru ka). Below that is a bold, dark navy blue Japanese title:{argument name="headline text" default="Eliminate forgetting things when shopping."} This is followed by a smaller gray Japanese subtitle: "Confirm Replenishment Timekeeping by Checking the Number of Days Remaining." Below the subtitle, three rounded category labels are arranged horizontally: a white label with a red dot labeled "Remaining Days"; a white label with a yellow dot labeled "Notifications"; and a white label with a green dot labeled "Replenishment Management." In the center, a front-facing, black-bezel smartphone model is displayed, showing the interface of the Grocery and Household Inventory Tracking App. At the top of the phone screen should be a solid green status bar displaying the app name; below that is a light-colored information bar; followed by a summary card containing three status counters: red dot "2 Need Replenishment", yellow dot "1 Need Replenishment", and green dot "2 Need Replenishment". Below is a vertically scrolling list containing four inventory item cards with rounded corners, subtle shading, and colored emergency status bars: 1) Shower, with a red status bar and a red badge that says "Over 1 day"; 2) Toilet Page, with a red status bar and a red badge that says "Ato 2 days"; 3) Dishware Washer, with a yellow status bar and a yellow badge that says "Ato 5 days"; 4) Body Soap, with a green status bar and a green badge that says "Ato 10 days". Each card has a small circular product icon, the Japanese item name, and category/date text on the left. The bottom control bar contains three small controls labeled "Supplement", "Also", and "Refresh". A floating green circular plus button has been added near the bottom right corner of the phone screen. At the bottom of the app's UI, there's a green tab bar containing three navigation items and icons: Home, Shopping List, and Settings. The phone is placed on a glossy, rounded green base with soft white side supports and subtle shadows. A large, rounded white Call for Action (CTA) capsule containing Japanese text is also added to the base.{argument name="button text" default="You'll know exactly what you need to buy soon."} Overall style: A sophisticated startup landing page template, iOS app screenshot aesthetics, soft gradients, minimalist Japanese UI design, clear typography, centered composition, soft ambient shadows, and high-quality app store marketing visuals.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张简洁的移动端 App 宣传海报，采用柔和的薄荷绿背景，构图居中且呈垂直分布，用于宣传名为 {argument name="app name" default="Zaiko"} 的库存管理 App。顶部放置一个圆角白色胶囊状 Logo，内含绿色的 App 名称；下方是一个较小的轮廓胶囊，包含一个绿点、数字 01 以及日文文本“見える化”。在下方添加一行深海军蓝色的加粗日文大标题：{argument name="headline text" default="買い忘れを、なくす。"}，随后是较小的灰色日文副标题：残り日数で補充タイミングをひと目で確認。在副标题下方，横向排列 3 个圆角分类标签：一个带有红点的白色标签，标注为“残り日数”；一个带有黄点的白色标签，标注为“通知”；以及一个带有绿点的白色标签，标注为“補充管理”。在中心位置，展示一个正面的黑色边框智能手机模型，屏幕显示杂货与家庭库存追踪 App 的界面。手机屏幕顶部应有一个纯绿色状态栏，显示 App 名称；下方是一个浅色信息条；接着是一行包含 3 个状态计数器的摘要卡片：红点“2 要補充”、黄点“1 もうすぐ”以及绿点“2 余裕あり”。下方显示一个垂直滚动的列表，包含 4 张带有圆角、细微阴影和彩色紧急状态条的库存物品卡片：1) シャンプー，配有红色状态条和写着“1日超過”的红色徽章；2) トイレットペーパー，配有红色状态条和写着“あと2日”的红色徽章；3) 食器用洗剤，配有黄色状态条和写着“あと5日”的黄色徽章；4) ボディーソープ，配有绿色状态条和写着“あと10日”的绿色徽章。每张卡片左侧包含一个小圆形产品图标、日文物品名称及分类/日期文本，底部操作栏包含 3 个小控件，分别标注为“補充した”、“まだある”和“リスト”。在手机屏幕右下角附近添加一个悬浮的绿色圆形加号按钮。在 App UI 底部，包含一个绿色标签栏，内含 3 个导航项及图标：ホーム、買い物リスト 和 設定。将手机放置在一个带有柔和白色侧支撑和明显柔和阴影的亮面圆角绿色底座上，并在底座上添加一个大型圆角白色行动呼吁（CTA）胶囊，内含日文文本 {argument name="button text" default="そろそろ買うものが、すぐわかる"}。整体风格：精致的初创公司落地页模型、iOS App 截图美学、柔和渐变、极简日式 UI 设计、清晰的排版、居中构图、柔和的环境阴影、优质的应用商店营销视觉图。

templates.prompt: A clean and modern app promotional poster with a very light mint blue background, featuring a centered vertical composition similar to a landing page screenshot of a Japanese inventory management app. At the top is a small, rounded white capsule-shaped logo with a soft shadow, containing green text.{argument name="app name" default="Zaiko"} Below, add a smaller, rounded-out badge with a blue dot and the text "02 First Edition". Further down, add a large, bold, dark navy blue Japanese title:{argument name="headline text" default="The initial guide makes it ready to use right away."} This is followed by a smaller gray subtitle: “Let’s learn about management flow from the start.” Below the subtitle, three small, rounded white category labels with soft shadows are evenly arranged: “Summarize” with a green dot, “Usage” with a blue dot, and “Start” with a dark dot. A realistic front view of a modern smartphone mockup is displayed in the center, with a black border, rounded corners, subtle reflections, and a dramatic soft blue glow at the bottom. The phone screen displays the app UI, with a green status bar at the top, a white “Zaiko” title, iPhone-style status icons at the top, a darkened app interface background, and a centered new user guide mod card overlaid on top. The white mod card has rounded corners and soft shadows, with a light green circular icon area at the top containing a green cube symbol. This is followed by the bold Japanese welcome title "Zaiko へようこそ!", the smaller subtitle "Consumables Management アプリ", and the main text "このアプリは, おうちのConsumables をManagement するよ!". Adds a light gray rounded corner list box containing 3 sample inventory items displayed in rows, complete with miniature icons: "Tower", "Tower", and "Waste". Add a sentence with green highlighting below: "『そろそろBUYわなきゃ!』を教えてくれるから、BUYいforgetれなし✨". At the bottom of the modal card is a large, rounded green main button labeled "..."{argument name="button text" default="See how to use it"} It features a small book icon and a soft text link below it that reads "Skipp." Behind the modal card, the app UI is subtly visible: a green header, a side category bar, and a bottom tab bar containing three labels: "Home," "Buying Things List," and "Settings," each with a simple white icon. Below the phone, a large, rounded blue label card with a soft shadow and a centered white capsule-shaped label with the text "..."{argument name="footer text" default="Even first-time setup is easy."} It adopts a sophisticated Apple-style SaaS marketing aesthetic, combining soft gradients, subtle shadows, rounded UI elements, and clear typography to create a friendly and trustworthy atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张简洁现代的应用宣传海报，背景为极淡的薄荷蓝色，采用类似日本库存管理应用落地页截图的居中垂直构图。顶部放置一个带有柔和阴影的小型圆角白色胶囊状 Logo，内含绿色文字 {argument name="app name" default="Zaiko"}。下方添加一个较小的圆角轮廓徽章，带有一个蓝点和文字“02 初回ガイド”。再下方设置一个深海军蓝色的粗体日文大标题：{argument name="headline text" default="初回ガイドで、すぐ使える。"}，随后是一个较小的灰色副标题：“起動したら管理の流れをやさしく案内”。在副标题下方，均匀排列 3 个带有柔和阴影的小型圆角白色分类标签：带绿点的“サンプル”、带蓝点的“使い方”以及带深色点的“すぐ開始”。中心位置展示一个写实的现代智能手机样机正面视图，黑色边框，圆角设计，带有微妙的反光，手机下方有戏剧性的柔和蓝光。手机屏幕显示应用 UI，顶部为绿色状态栏，标题为白色的“Zaiko”，顶部有 iPhone 风格的状态图标，背景为变暗的应用界面，上方覆盖一个居中的新手引导模态卡片。白色模态卡片具有圆角和柔和的投影，顶部有一个淡绿色圆形图标区域，内含一个绿色立方体符号。接着是粗体的日文欢迎标题“Zaikoへようこそ！”，较小的副标题“消耗品管理アプリ”，以及正文“このアプリは、おうちの消耗品を管理するよ！”。添加一个浅灰色圆角列表框，包含 3 个分行显示的库存示例项目，并配有微型图标：“トイレットペーパー”、“シャンプー”和“洗剤”。下方添加一句带有绿色高亮的句子：“『そろそろ買わなきゃ！』を教えてくれるから、買い忘れなし ✨”。在模态卡片底部，包含一个大型圆角绿色主按钮，标签为 {argument name="button text" default="使い方を見る"}，并配有一个小书本图标，下方是一个柔和的文字链接“スキップ”。在模态卡片后方，应用 UI 隐约可见：绿色页眉、侧边分类条以及底部标签栏，包含 3 个标签，分别标注为“ホーム”、“買い物リスト”和“設定”，每个标签均配有简单的白色图标。在手机下方，放置一张大型圆角蓝色标注卡片，带有柔和阴影和居中的白色胶囊状标签，文字为 {argument name="footer text" default="はじめての設定も迷わない"}。采用精致的 Apple 风格 SaaS 营销美学，结合柔和的渐变、微妙的阴影、圆润的 UI 元素、清晰的排版，营造出友好且值得信赖的氛围。

templates.prompt: Create a clean and modern promotional main image for the landing page of a Japanese inventory management app. Use a soft, warm off-white background with a subtle mint green gradient at the bottom. The image is vertically centered. At the top is a rounded white capsule-shaped logo containing the green text "Zaiko". Below this is a small rounded badge with a tiny yellow dot and the text "05 Pro Extension". Next, add a bold, dark navy blue Japanese headline "管理をもっと、快适に." (Management wo motto, Kuaisu ni.) and a smaller gray subheading "无制限登录・分析・広告なしのProプラン" (Unlimited Login, Analysis, and Advertisements). Below this, display three small, rounded function labels side-by-side: a white label with a green dot for "无制限" (Unlimited), a white label with a yellow dot for "分析" (Analysis), and a white label with a red dot for "広告なし" (Advertisements). The center features a realistic front view of an iPhone with narrow black bezels, rounded corners, subtle reflections, and soft shadows. The phone screen displays a Japanese app subscription page. The top status bar shows the time as 1:44 with a back arrow, and the left tab bar displays "(tabs)" with the centered title "Proプラン". The page content should include a light gold circular icon containing a gold star, titled "Zaiko Pro" with the subtitle "もっと方便に、もっと快适に". Below is a rounded white contrast card with 3 function rows and 3 column titles: "機能", "Free", and "Pro". The 3 rows are: "アイテム無制限", under Free it is "3个まで", and under Pro it is the green "無制限"; "消费ベース分析", under Free it is "-", and under Pro it is the green "OK"; "広告非表示", under Free it is "広告あり", and under Pro it is the green "広告なし". Below the card, add the section title "Plan selection" and stack two plan options: a selected annual plan with a green outline and a green radio button, labeled "Annual Plan," with a small red badge "Ode," and the price line showing "¥2,000/year (approx. ¥167 per month)"; and an unselected monthly plan with a gray radio button, labeled "Monthly Plan," and priced at "¥300/month." Below the plan, place a large, rounded green call-to-action button with the text "Pro ni App Great." Below that, add a centered text link "Restore previous purchases," and a few lines of small gray subscription disclaimer text. At the very bottom of the back of the phone, a large, rounded orange base card is added, containing a white capsule label with the green text "Proなら広告なしでスムーズ". It adopts a sophisticated startup app marketing style, utilizing soft shadows, clear spacing, rounded UI, clear Japanese typography, and a minimalist, high-end aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 为日语库存管理 App 落地页创建一个简洁现代的推广主图。背景采用柔和温暖的米白色，底部带有淡淡的浅薄荷绿渐变。构图垂直居中。顶部放置一个圆角白色胶囊状 Logo，内含绿色文字“Zaiko”。正下方添加一个小型圆角徽章，带有一个微小的黄色圆点和文字“05 Pro 扩展”。随后添加一个深海军蓝色的加粗日语大标题“管理をもっと、快適に。”，以及一个较小的灰色副标题“無制限登録・分析・広告なしのProプラン”。在下方，并排展示 3 个小型圆角功能标签：一个带有绿点的白色标签“無制限”，一个带有黄点的白色标签“分析”，以及一个带有红点的白色标签“広告なし”。中心位置展示一台写实的 iPhone 正面视图，具有窄黑色边框、圆角、微妙的反光和柔和的阴影。手机屏幕上显示一个日语 App 订阅页面，顶部状态栏时间为 1:44，带有返回箭头，左侧标签栏显示“(tabs)”，居中标题为“Proプラン”。页面内容应包含一个浅金色圆形图标，内含金星，标题为“Zaiko Pro”，副标题为“もっと便利に、もっと快適に”。下方包含一个圆角白色对比卡片，设有 3 行功能行和 3 列标题“機能”、“Free”、“Pro”。这 3 行分别为：“アイテム無制限”，Free 下为“3個まで”，Pro 下为绿色的“無制限”；“消費ベース分析”，Free 下为“-”，Pro 下为绿色的“OK”；“広告非表示”，Free 下为“広告あり”，Pro 下为绿色的“広告なし”。在卡片下方，添加分区标题“プランを選択”，并堆叠 2 个计划选项：一个带有绿色轮廓和绿色单选按钮的已选中年度计划，标签为“年額プラン”，带有红色小徽章“お得”，价格行显示“¥2,000/年 (月あたり約¥167)”；另一个为未选中的月度计划，带有灰色单选按钮，标签为“月額プラン”，价格为“¥300/月”。在计划下方，放置一个大型圆角绿色行动号召按钮，文字为“Proにアップグレード”。下方添加一个居中的文本链接“以前の購入を復元”，以及几行微小的灰色订阅免责声明文本。在手机背后的最底部，添加一个大型圆角橙色底座卡片，内含一个白色胶囊标签，文字为绿色的“Proなら広告なしでスムーズ”。采用精致的初创公司 App 营销风格，运用柔和阴影、通透的间距、圆角 UI、清晰的日语排版以及极简的高级美学。

templates.title: Shonen manga magazine cover

titleLocalized.zh: 少年漫画杂志封面

templates.prompt: Create a glossy, Japanese weekly shonen manga magazine cover, adopting the style of a high-energy commercial manga anthology. The layout is compact and crowded, with explosive typography and a dramatic cover title design. The cover is vertically oriented, with a large red title at the top, bordered in thick black and accented with yellow, accompanied by the English subtitle "WEEKLY JUMP". Surround the main character with numerous Japanese teaser phrases, issue number frames, star-shaped pop-up frames, side notes, and circular preview illustrations, mimicking the dense text and gimmicky effect of a real manga magazine cover. Place the issue details in the upper right corner, including the date and a large issue number, and add several eye-catching promotional banners in yellow, red, white, and black. The main subject: A handsome, anime-style young martial artist is positioned in the center, a half-body portrait, striking a powerful fighting pose, his fists thrown towards the viewer. He has messy, layered hair.{argument name="hair color" default="gold"} His hairstyle features long bangs obscuring one eye, revealing sharp amber eyes, a confident smirk, and multiple earrings. He wears a soft white panda hat with black ears and a panda eye patch, and a bright red Chinese kung fu shirt with black frog buttons and black piping, adorned with a large black dragon pattern on the chest. His pose should be dynamic and confrontational, as if ready to strike at any moment, with a perspective-effect fist dominating the foreground. Background: A warm and slightly blurred traditional East Asian street or indoor market scene with wooden beams, lantern-like red decorations, and golden ambient lighting. The background should remain soft to highlight the figure and typography. The lower half of the cover uses bursts of fiery yellow energy, black ink splatters, speed lines, and paint-like brushstrokes to enhance visual impact. Layout and Cover Title Design: The left side features a large vertical calligraphic slogan, with a very large main title spanning the center of the lower part in an aggressive black and red kanji style font. Below this is a smaller white and yellow horizontal slogan. The lower left corner has a yellow pop-up box promoting circulation or sales figures. Near the lower right corner is a red banner promoting a special feature. The upper right corner has a large yellow and green feature box. The right side features two stacked circular character preview portraits, accompanied by brief Japanese preview text. Additionally, a small skull badge graphic is integrated near the title area on the top right. The overall look must convey the feel of a bestselling action manga magazine, highlighting a title {argument name="series title" default="Dragon Fist Roar"} A new serialized martial arts comic, and the protagonist{argument name="character name" default="Yume"} Shaped into a new generation of teen comic book heroes. The colors are highly saturated, the animation rendering is clear, and it boasts a refined printed cover texture, strong contrast, and authentic magazine cover composition.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张光泽感十足的日式周刊少年漫画杂志封面，采用高能量商业漫画选集的风格，布局紧凑拥挤，排版充满爆发力，并配有戏剧性的封面标题设计。封面为纵向构图，顶部由巨大的红色刊名占据，带有粗黑边框和黄色点缀，并附有英文副标题“WEEKLY JUMP”。在主角周围添加大量日文预告短语、期号框、星形爆炸框、侧边标注和圆形插图预览，模仿真实漫画杂志封面那种文字密集、充满噱头的效果。将期号详情置于右上角，包括日期和一个大号期号，并添加多个黄色、红色、白色和黑色的醒目宣传横幅。

主体：一位帅气的动漫风格少年武术家位于中心，半身像，摆出强有力的战斗姿态，双拳向观众方向挥出。他留着凌乱的层次感 {argument name="hair color" default="金色"} 发型，长刘海遮住了一只眼睛，有着锐利的琥珀色双眼、自信的坏笑和多处耳钉。他戴着一顶柔软的白色熊猫帽，帽子上有黑色耳朵和熊猫眼罩，身穿鲜红色的中式功夫衫，配有黑色盘扣和黑色滚边，胸前饰有巨大的黑色龙纹。他的姿势应充满动感和对抗性，仿佛随时准备出击，透视效果的拳头占据了前景。

背景：温暖且略微模糊的传统东亚街道或室内市场场景，带有木梁、灯笼般的红色装饰和金色环境光，背景保持柔和，以突出人物和排版。在封面下半部分使用火热的黄色能量爆发、黑色墨迹飞溅、速度线装饰和类似油漆的笔触效果，以增强视觉冲击力。

排版与封面标题设计：左侧包含 1 个巨大的垂直书法口号，下部中心横跨 1 个非常大的主标题，采用具有侵略性的黑红汉字风格字体，下方配有 1 个较小的白色和黄色水平标语，左下角有 1 个宣传发行量或销量的黄色爆炸框，右下角附近有 1 个宣传特别专题的红色横幅，右上角有 1 个大型黄绿相间的专题框，右侧堆叠 2 个圆形人物预览肖像，旁边配有简短的日文预告文字。此外，在顶部中右侧刊名区域附近集成 1 个小型骷髅徽章图形。整体外观必须呈现出畅销动作漫画期刊的感觉，重点推介一部名为 {argument name="series title" default="龍拳の咆哮"} 的新连载武术漫画，并将主角 {argument name="character name" default="Yume"} 塑造成新一代少年漫画英雄。色彩超饱和，动漫渲染清晰，具有精致的印刷封面质感、强烈的对比度和地道的杂志封面构图。

templates.title: High-end Japanese gym poster

titleLocalized.zh: 高级日式健身房海报

templates.prompt: A high-end vertical poster designed for a fictional fitness brand, shot in a realistic, upscale fitness magazine style. The image showcases a fit, curvaceous adult woman in a modern gym, the camera panning from her upper thighs to her head, revealing a dynamic three-quarter profile as she uses a cable machine. She has {argument name="hair color" default="Golden yellow"} Her hair was tied in a high ponytail with a few stray strands falling down. Her skin glistened slightly with sweat. She wore a deep navy blue, high-slit bodysuit with slender shoulder straps. Her right hand gripped a black rope handle near her waist, the rope extending downwards to the right; her left arm was bent and supported beside the exercise machine's upright. The use of strong, warm side sunlight mixed with cool-toned gym ambient lighting creates bright highlights on her shoulders, chest, arms, and thighs. A shallow depth-of-field effect blurs the gym equipment in the background, creating a luxurious yet dynamic commercial gym atmosphere. The layout references Japanese gym posters, with a striking white Mingchao-style vertical title in the upper left corner.{argument name="headline text" default="The strength to bring things into balance."} Below it is a thin blue horizontal line, and below that is a smaller white subtitle.{argument name="subheadline text" default="Don't push yourself too hard. Keep going."} A minimalist geometric logo is placed in the lower left corner, below which is the brand name in white capital sans-serif font.{argument name="brand name" default="NOVAFIT"} and a small slogan{argument name="tagline" default="STRENGTH & BALANCE"} The layout is simple and sophisticated, with strong contrasts, giving it a brand-oriented and practical advertising poster design feel, in a 4:5 vertical aspect ratio.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张为虚构运动健身品牌设计的高级竖版海报，采用写实的高端健身杂志风格拍摄。画面展示了一位身材健美、曲线优美的成年女性，置身于现代健身房中，镜头从大腿上部到头部拍摄，呈现出她在使用绳索训练器时充满动感的四分之三侧身姿态。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="金黄色"} 的头发，扎成高马尾，有几缕碎发垂下，皮肤因汗水而微微闪烁，身穿深海军蓝色的高开叉连体训练服，肩带纤细。她的右手在腰部附近紧握黑色绳索手柄，绳索向右下方延伸；左臂弯曲并支撑在训练器立柱旁。运用侧面强烈的暖色阳光与冷色调健身房环境光混合，在肩膀、胸部、手臂和大腿处形成强光，采用浅景深效果，背景中的健身器械虚化，营造出奢华且充满动力的商业健身氛围。排版参考日式健身房海报，左上角使用醒目的白色明朝体竖排标题 {argument name="headline text" default="整える強さ。"}，下方配有一条细蓝色横线，再下方是较小的白色副标题 {argument name="subheadline text" default="無理をしない。続ける。"}。左下角放置一个极简几何 Logo，下方是白色大写无衬线字体的品牌名称 {argument name="brand name" default="NOVAFIT"}，以及一行小标语 {argument name="tagline" default="STRENGTH & BALANCE"}。排版简洁高级，对比强烈，具有品牌感和实用的广告海报设计感，4:5 竖版比例。

templates.title: Red jet armor studio rendering

titleLocalized.zh: 红色喷气式机甲摄影棚渲染

templates.prompt: A full-body studio render showcases a highly detailed, transformable anime-style mecha, inspired by a red jet fighter robot, standing confidently in a three-quarter view against a clean, seamless light gray background. The robot possesses a heroic, angular silhouette, with two tall vertical tail fins behind its head, two swept-back aircraft wings on its back and shoulders, and two downward-pointing blast cannons mounted on its forearms. The main body of the armor is {argument name="primary armor color" default="Bright red"} Featuring white wingplates and lower legs, a dark navy charcoal gray endoskeleton and thighs, small yellow vent details on the chest and shoulders, and a glossy, translucent blue cockpit canopy inlaid in the center of the chest. The head is compact and mechanical, with a dark visor and helmet-like structure partially embedded between the shoulder components. A small purple Decepticon-style badge is printed on the robot's right wing. Emphasis is placed on hard-surface panel lines, layered mechanical armor, realistic joints, pistons, vents, air intakes, and the texture of a premium plastic and metal model kit. The wings should have sharp aerodynamic edges with red stripes, the shoulders should resemble jet engine casings, and the legs should be thick with asymmetrical aircraft component armor, including two small side fins near the lower legs and a missile-like detail visible on the right outer tibia. The product photography utilizes clear product lighting, ultra-sharp focus, subtle shadows under the feet, and presents a refined collectible toy/concept art effect in the style of modern Japanese mecha design drawings.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张全身摄影棚渲染图，展示了一个高细节、可变形的动漫机甲，灵感源自红色喷气式战斗机机器人，以自信的四分之三正面姿态站立在干净的浅灰色无缝背景前。该机器人拥有英雄般的棱角轮廓，头部后方竖立着 2 片高大的垂直尾翼，背部和肩部安装有 2 片后掠式飞机机翼，前臂安装有 2 门向下指向的爆能炮。装甲主体为 {argument name="primary armor color" default="亮红色"}，配有白色翼板和小腿，深海军炭灰色内骨架和大腿，胸部和肩部带有小型黄色通风口细节，胸部中央镶嵌着光泽的半透明蓝色驾驶舱盖。头部紧凑且充满机械感，配有深色面罩和头盔状结构，部分嵌入肩部组件之间。在机器人的右翼上印有一个紫色的小型霸天虎风格徽章。强调硬表面刻线、分层机械装甲、逼真的关节、活塞、通风口、进气口以及高级塑料与金属模型套件的质感。机翼应具有带有红色条纹的锋利空气动力学边缘，肩部看起来像喷气发动机外壳，腿部应厚实且带有不对称的飞机部件装甲，包括小腿附近 2 片小型侧鳍和右外胫骨上可见的 1 个导弹状细节。采用清晰的产品摄影布光、超锐利对焦、脚下微妙的阴影，并以现代日本机甲设计图纸的风格呈现出精致的收藏级玩具/概念艺术效果。

templates.title: Portrait of the Deer Pavilion Ballroom

titleLocalized.zh: 鹿鸣馆舞厅肖像

templates.prompt: A cinematic, photorealistic portrait, the subject of which is{argument name="ethnicity" default="Japan"} A woman is dancing at a reception in the luxurious Rokumeikan ballroom in late 19th-century Japan. The image shows her in a two-thirds profile view from the waist up, her body slightly turned to the left. She is wearing an elegant dress.{argument name="dress color" default="Champagne Beige"} The Victorian-style evening gown, with its fitted bodice and soft-sheen satin fabric, features layered lace trim at the neckline and shoulders, decorative buttons and floral embellishments on the front, and long matching opera gloves. Her dark hair is styled in an elegant formal updo with curls and delicate jeweled hair accessories, adorned with teardrop earrings and a layered necklace with small pendants. One of her gloved hands holds a folding fan or a small handbag at her waist. The background is a grand historic ballroom, warmly lit by amber gaslights or chandeliers, with a shallow depth of field, where four guests in formal attire are faintly visible: two women and two men. Behind her are gentlemen in dark suits, ladies in period dresses, and large floral arrangements, all rendered with an elegant bokeh effect. The overall atmosphere is romantic, nostalgic, and luxurious, with rich dark brown tones, soft cinematic contrast, and realistic skin and fabric textures, creating a truly immersive experience.{argument name="venue style" default="Rokumeikan"} The image evokes the feeling of graceful dance. The composition draws inspiration from high-end historical film stills, employing a vertical portrait style with the subject centered, posing naturally, elegantly, and noblely.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影级、照片写实风格的肖像，主角是一位 {argument name="ethnicity" default="日本"} 女性，正在 19 世纪末日本奢华的鹿鸣馆时代舞厅招待会上跳舞。画面呈现腰部以上的三分之二侧身姿态，身体微微向左转。她身穿一件优雅的 {argument name="dress color" default="香槟米色"} 维多利亚风格晚礼服，紧身胸衣剪裁合体，采用柔和光泽的缎面材质，领口和肩部饰有层叠的蕾丝花边，前襟带有装饰性纽扣和花卉饰边，并佩戴长款配套歌剧手套。她的深色头发梳成精致的正式盘发，带有卷曲的发丝和精致的珠宝发饰，佩戴水滴状耳环以及带有小吊坠的叠戴项链。她的一只戴着手套的手在腰间拿着一把折扇或一个小手包。背景是一个宏伟的历史舞厅，有着温暖的琥珀色煤气灯或吊灯照明，景深较浅，背景中隐约可见 4 位穿着正式礼服的宾客：2 位女性和 2 位男性。她身后是身着深色西装的绅士、穿着年代礼服的女士以及大型花艺装饰，均呈现为优雅的焦外成像效果。整体氛围浪漫、怀旧且奢华，带有浓郁的深褐色调，柔和的电影级对比度，逼真的皮肤和织物纹理，营造出在 {argument name="venue style" default="鹿鸣馆"} 优雅起舞的意境。构图参考高端历史电影剧照，采用竖向肖像构图，主角居中，姿态自然，优雅且高贵。

templates.title: Anime Girl in the Golden Clockwork World

titleLocalized.zh: 金色发条世界中的动漫少女

templates.prompt: A stunning vertical anime illustration depicts an exquisitely crafted steampunk world, with walls adorned with massive interlocking clocks, exposed gears, rotating rings, pendulums, and ornate mechanical structures crafted from polished gold, brass, bronze, and dark steel. The composition is incredibly dense and complex, clearly showing three dominant oversized clock faces: one in the upper left, a large partial clock in the lower right, and a circular clock structure in the upper center, surrounded by dozens of smaller springs and gears visible in the deep background. A dazzling beam of platinum light cascades down from the top center, creating shimmering highlights, rim lights, reflections, lens flares, and a strong sense of depth on the metallic mechanisms. Floating in the lower left is a young anime girl, approximately three-quarter length, with {argument name="hair color" default="Soft pastel colors"} Her long, wavy hair seemed to float in the air, and she had a pair of {argument name="eye color" default="Emerald Green"} She had large, bright eyes and a gentle, slightly melancholic expression. She was wearing an exquisite dress.{argument name="dress color" default="Dried rose powder"} A Lolita-style dress with heavy ruffles, lace, ribbons, layered frills, floral details, puff sleeves, a fitted bodice, and matching high heels, topped with a floral soft hat or mini hat. Her posture is light and floating, one arm slightly outstretched, her skirt and hair swaying in an invisible motion, as if drifting within a giant celestial clock tower. The overall atmosphere is magical, luminous, complex, and romantic, featuring ultra-fine lines, high-contrast lighting, rich metallic reflections, a fantastical steampunk aesthetic, and a high-end visual style reminiscent of anime-style illustrations. There is no text, no borders, and no extra characters. The design emphasizes an overwhelming sense of scale, dense mechanical complexity, and the contrast between the delicate female figure and the magnificent golden machinery.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张令人惊叹的竖版动漫插画，描绘了一个精致的蒸汽朋克时间世界，墙壁上布满了巨大的连锁时钟、裸露的齿轮、旋转的圆环、摆钟以及由抛光金、黄铜、青铜和深色钢材构成的华丽机械结构。构图极其密集且复杂，画面中清晰可见 3 个占据主导地位的超大时钟表盘：一个位于左上方，一个巨大的局部时钟位于右下方，还有一个环状时钟结构位于中上方，周围环绕着数十个深层背景中可见的小型发条和齿轮组件。一道耀眼的白金色光束从顶部中心倾泻而下，在金属机械上营造出闪烁的高光、轮廓光、反射、镜头光晕和强烈的深度感。左下方漂浮着一位年轻的动漫少女，约四分之三全身像，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="柔和的粉彩色"} 长波浪卷发，仿佛悬浮在空中，有着一双 {argument name="eye color" default="翡翠绿"} 的大眼睛，表情温柔且略带忧郁。她穿着一件精致的 {argument name="dress color" default="干枯玫瑰粉"} 洛丽塔风格连衣裙，带有厚重的褶边、蕾丝、丝带、层叠的荷叶边、花卉细节、泡泡袖、紧身胸衣系带和配套的高跟鞋，头上还戴着一顶花卉软帽或迷你帽。她的姿态轻盈漂浮，一只手臂微微伸展，裙摆和头发在无形的动作中飘动，仿佛在巨大的天体钟楼内漂流。整体氛围充满魔幻、光影感、复杂且浪漫，具有超精细的线条、高对比度的光影、丰富的金属反射、奇幻蒸汽朋克美学，以及高级主视觉图风格的绘画感动漫渲染。无文字，无边框，无额外字符。强调压倒性的规模感、密集的机械复杂性，以及柔美的女性角色与宏伟的金色机械之间的对比。

templates.title: Gorgeous Emerald Magical Girl Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 华丽翡翠魔法少女肖像

templates.prompt: A highly detailed portrait of a magical girl from an anime, employing a luxurious shoujo manga illustration style, showcasing a confident young heroine inspired by planetary-themed sailor guardians. She stands in a three-quarter profile pose, the frame angled from mid-thigh upwards, the composition centered, left hand on hip, right thumbs-up. She possesses {argument name="hair color" default="Warm chestnut brown"} Her beautiful hair is tied into a high, voluminous ponytail, secured with two glossy green beads, with long curls cascading dramatically to the right. Her attire is a classic school-style magical uniform, incorporating five clearly visible main elements: a fitted white blouse, a deep emerald green sailor collar, a large pink bow with a round emerald brooch at the chest, a short, pleated emerald green skirt, and a large pink back bow visible at the waist. She also wears four visible accessories: two long white elbow gloves, two tiered emerald green wristbands, small pink gemstone earrings, and a green choker. The costume rendering should convey a satin-like sheen and an elegant reflective texture. The character should exude courage, composure, and a radiant heroic charm. The background is a magnificent starry fantasy scene, diagonally divided into two contrasting areas: a deep midnight blue galaxy filled with stars, and a bright, iridescent crystal field with a prismatic sheen. The scene is surrounded by delicate gold filigree lace, suspended crystal chains, star pendants, jeweled ornaments, and large multifaceted gemstones. Floral crystal embellishments are added to the corners, particularly layered, translucent flowers and roses in lavender, violet, and ice blue. The entire image is filled with strong glitter effects, lens flares, glitter, and jewel reflections. A rich palette of emerald green, blush pink, gold, sapphire, lavender, and pearl white is used. The overall composition should convey a sophisticated, dazzling, luxurious, and nostalgic quality, like…{argument name="character theme" default="Emerald Planet Guardian"} Luxury collectible art prints. Ultra-detailed anime illustrations, crisp lines, glossy highlights, bright shadows, intricate decorative backgrounds, master-level quality, square composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅高度精致的动漫魔法少女肖像，采用奢华的少女漫插画风格，展现了一位灵感源自行星主题水手守护者的自信少女英雄。她以四分之三侧身姿势站立，取景范围从大腿中部向上，构图居中，左手叉腰，右手竖起大拇指。她拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="暖栗棕色"} 的秀发，扎成高耸且蓬松的马尾，并用 2 个亮面绿色珠饰固定，长长的卷发向右侧戏剧性地垂落。她的服装是经典的学院风魔法制服，包含 5 个清晰可见的主要元素：修身的白色上衣、深翡翠绿水手领、胸前带有圆形绿宝石胸针的大型粉色蝴蝶结、短款百褶翡翠绿裙，以及腰间可见的大型粉色后蝴蝶结。她还佩戴了 4 种可见配饰：2 只长款白色肘部手套、2 层叠式翡翠绿腕带、小型粉色宝石耳钉和一条绿色项圈。服装渲染需呈现出缎面般的光泽感和优雅的反射质感。角色应展现出勇敢、从容和闪耀的英雄魅力。背景为华丽的星空奇幻场景，对角线划分为 2 个对比鲜明的区域：充满繁星的深午夜蓝银河，以及带有棱镜光泽的明亮虹彩水晶场。场景周围环绕着精致的金色花丝蕾丝、悬挂的水晶链、星形吊坠、珠宝装饰和大型多面宝石。角落处加入花卉水晶装饰，特别是薰衣草色、紫罗兰色和冰蓝色的层叠半透明花朵与玫瑰。整幅画面充满强烈的闪光特效、镜头星芒、闪粉和珠宝反射。使用翡翠绿、腮红粉、金色、蓝宝石色、薰衣草色和珍珠白的丰富色调。整体构图应呈现出高级、璀璨、华丽且怀旧的质感，如同 {argument name="character theme" default="翡翠行星守护者"} 的豪华收藏级艺术印刷品。超精细动漫插画，清晰的线条，光泽高光，明亮的阴影，复杂的装饰背景，大师级品质，方形构图。

templates.title: Awkwardly blurry candid shot of rainbow hair color in a nightclub

titleLocalized.zh: 尴尬模糊的夜店彩虹发色抓拍

templates.prompt: A poorly timed snapshot, taken too close and framed slightly from behind, as if someone accidentally snapped a picture of someone in the worst possible moment of a dimly lit nightclub. The image is vertically composed with strong motion blur, and the subject almost fills the entire frame. Only one person is shown, with their back to the camera, so their face is not visible; they have long, wavy hair.{argument name="hair color" default="Rainbow-colored hair colors"} The light pink and orange hues transition from the top of the head to yellow, green, cyan, blue, and purple at the ends of the hair. The person wears a light blush pink top or hoodie, the lighting soft and also blurred by movement. The composition should feel awkward and intrusive; the camera is too close, the hair dominates the left and center of the frame, and only part of the shoulder and back is visible in the lower right corner. Against a dark background, there is a dimly lit nightclub bar area, scattered with colored lights, glittering bottles, and a blurry, reflective highlight on the right, all out of focus. The use of harsh mixed nightclub lighting, low-light digital camera noise, flash-like exposures on the hair and clothing, strong blur, shallow detail, and an unpleasant, accidental cell phone shot atmosphere makes it feel like a captured snapshot, messy, spontaneous, and with a genuine sense of imperfection.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张抓拍的、时机不佳的快照，拍摄距离过近且略微从后方取景，仿佛有人在昏暗的夜店里最糟糕的时刻意外拍下了一个人。图像采用竖构图，带有强烈的动态模糊，主体几乎填满了整个画面。仅展示 1 个人，背对镜头，因此看不到脸部，留着长波浪卷发，{argument name="hair color" default="彩虹色系发色"} 从头顶的亮粉色和橙色过渡到发梢的黄色、绿色、青色、蓝色和紫色。此人穿着淡腮红粉色的上衣或连帽衫，光线柔和，同样因移动而模糊。构图应显得尴尬且具有侵入感，镜头靠得太近，头发占据了画面的左侧和中心，右下角仅露出部分肩膀和背部。在黑暗的背景中，包含 1 个昏暗的夜店吧台区域，散布着彩色灯光、闪亮的酒瓶和右侧模糊的反光高光，全部处于失焦状态。使用刺眼的混合夜店灯光、低光数字相机噪点、头发和衣服上的闪光灯式曝光、强烈的模糊、浅显的细节以及一种不讨喜的手机意外拍摄氛围。使其感觉像是一张被禁存的快照，凌乱、自发且具有真实的瑕疵感。

templates.title: Q-version cat-eared maid crayon drawing scene

titleLocalized.zh: Q 版猫耳女仆蜡笔画场景

templates.prompt: A warm and nostalgic anime illustration in a playful crayon style, with a textured beige paper background. At the center of the image is an adorable chibi-style cat-eared maid, lying on the floor, drawing in a giant spiral sketchbook. She has oversized cat ears, a lace maid headband, and twin tails, her hair a bright pastel color scheme of pink, blue, yellow, and orange. She has large, cyan-blue eyes, her expression focused and calm. She wears a black and white maid outfit, decorated with bows, lace, puff sleeves, fluffy cuffs, and delicate hair clips. She holds a blue crayon, drawing a simple crayon figure in the sketchbook. Scattered around her are crayon scribbles and loose pieces of paper on the table or floor. The illustration must include six clearly visible crayons of different colors; avoid showing conspicuous crayon boxes. To the left is a small cardboard box containing a sleepy black cat curled up among the crayons, next to a simple cat face drawing. In the lower left foreground, a white toy robot cat with blue accents sits and watches. In the upper right background, two children's drawings are hung, clipped to a rope: one depicts a pink heart, the other flowers and a rainbow. A large line of handwritten Japanese crayon text is added to the upper left corner: "完璧じゃなくていーんだよ！ だって、今日のわたしはがんばったもん！", written in colored crayon strokes. The overall lighting is soft, creating a comfortable craft room atmosphere, with a delicate grain and deliberately rough crayon texture. The artwork should be cute, heartfelt, and have a handmade feel, with uneven lines and rich doodle layers, but avoid showing realistic crayon packaging boxes.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅温暖且充满怀旧感的动漫插画，采用童趣十足的蜡笔画风格，背景为带有纹理的米色纸张。画面中心是一位超萌的 Q 版猫耳女仆，她趴在地上，正在一本巨大的螺旋素描本上作画。她有着超大的猫耳、蕾丝女仆发带和双马尾，发色为粉、蓝、黄、橙组成的明亮马卡龙色系，拥有一双硕大的青蓝色眼睛，神情专注而平静。她身穿黑白配色的女仆装，装饰着蝴蝶结、蕾丝、泡泡袖、毛绒袖口和精致的小发夹。她手持一支蓝色蜡笔，正在素描本上画着一个简单的蜡笔小人。她周围的桌面或地板上散落着凌乱的蜡笔涂鸦和零散的纸张。画面中需包含 6 支清晰可见、颜色各异的蜡笔，不要出现显眼的蜡笔包装盒。左侧放置一个小型纸板箱，里面有一只睡眼惺忪的黑猫蜷缩在蜡笔中，旁边画有一个简单的猫脸涂鸦。左下角前景处，放置一个带有蓝色点缀的白色玩具机器人猫，正坐着观看。右上角背景处，悬挂着 2 幅用夹子固定在绳子上的儿童画：一幅画着粉色爱心，另一幅画着花朵和彩虹。左上角添加一行巨大的手写日语蜡笔文字：「完璧じゃなくて いーんだよ！ だって、今日の わたしは がんばったもん！」，文字采用彩色蜡笔笔触。整体采用柔和的灯光，营造出舒适的手工室氛围，带有细腻的颗粒感和刻意呈现的粗糙蜡质蜡笔纹理。画面需可爱、走心且具有手工感，线条不均匀且涂鸦层次丰富，但不要展示写实的蜡笔包装盒。

templates.title: Gothic wedding dress with deep red accents

titleLocalized.zh: 深红点缀哥特式婚纱

templates.prompt: A highly dramatic full-body fantasy portrait of a bride, the protagonist{argument name="character name" default="A young woman"} Standing amidst the ruins of a Gothic cathedral, she adopts a slightly upward-looking perspective to accentuate the grandeur of her gown. She wears an exquisite wedding dress with a fitted white corset, delicate lace embroidery, off-the-shoulder lace details, and long, semi-transparent lace gloves. The skirt is extremely voluminous, layered with ruffles, sheer fabric, and lace trim, with the inner lining and front center revealing a voluminous silhouette.{argument name="accent color" default="Deep crimson"} A stunning gradient from white reveals a rich red fabric peeking through the white outer skirt. Clusters of red roses and ribbons adorn the waist and front of the skirt, complemented by a large floral headdress composed of white and red flowers. Her{argument name="hair color" default="Deep red"} Her hair is styled in a soft updo, with a few strands framing her face. She wears a long cathedral veil, edged with intricate lace, that cascades down her back. A bouquet of red and white roses is held in her hand or placed beside her. Floating rose petals surround her, predominantly red with touches of white, creating a cinematic dynamism. The backdrop is the vast interior of an abandoned cathedral, with soaring pointed arches, broken window frames, weathered stone, and climbing vines, soft sunlight streaming in through the openings. The overall atmosphere is elegant, ethereal, romantic, and subtly Gothic, showcasing highly detailed fabric rendering, realistic lace textures, soft lighting, high contrast, and a refined, painterly, fantastical illustration style. The red accents are kept clean, luxurious, and floral, avoiding any smudging or blood-like visual effects.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的全身奇幻新娘肖像，主角 {argument name="character name" default="一位年轻女性"} 站在废墟哥特式大教堂中，采用略微仰视的视角以突显礼服的宏伟。她身着精致的婚纱，配有修身的白色束胸衣、细腻的蕾丝刺绣、露肩蕾丝细节以及长款半透明蕾丝手套。裙摆极其蓬松，层叠着层叠褶边、透明面料和蕾丝饰边，裙摆内层和前中位置呈现出从 {argument name="accent color" default="深绯红色"} 到白色的惊艳渐变，白色外裙下隐约可见浓郁的红色面料。腰部和裙前点缀着红玫瑰花簇与丝带，并配有由白花和红玫瑰组成的大型花卉头饰。她的 {argument name="hair color" default="深酒红色"} 头发梳成柔和的盘发，留有几缕发丝，身披长款大教堂头纱，边缘饰有复杂的蕾丝，在身后铺展开来。她手中拿着或身旁放着一束红白玫瑰花束。周围环绕着漂浮的玫瑰花瓣，以红色为主，间杂少量白色，营造出电影般的动感。背景是广阔的废弃大教堂内部，拥有高耸的尖拱、破碎的窗棂、风化的石材、攀爬的藤蔓，柔和的日光透过开口处倾泻而下。整体氛围优雅、空灵、浪漫且带有轻微的哥特感，呈现出超细节的面料渲染、逼真的蕾丝质感、柔和的光晕、高对比度以及精致的绘画级写实奇幻插画风格。保持红色点缀的干净、奢华与花卉感，避免晕染，杜绝任何类似血迹的视觉效果。

templates.title: Japanese-style summer accessories advertising poster

titleLocalized.zh: 日系夏季配饰广告海报

templates.prompt: Create a sophisticated Japanese summer fashion advertising poster, using a 1:1 square layout to present a bright and transparent coastal lifestyle photography style with the quality of a high-end product catalog. The image shows a half-length portrait of a young woman against a tropical beach background with turquoise ocean, light sand, and a soft sky, with slightly blurred palm leaves in the upper right corner. She wears a wide-brimmed natural straw sun hat decorated with blue ribbons, has long, straight black hair, and wears a loose blue and white tie-dye top. Her face is partially obscured by a soft rectangular blur in the center. One hand gently touches the brim of the hat. Add beach-style hair accessories to the hat and sides of her hair: lanyards with shells, beads, tassels, and circular decorations, and a long white and blue braided braid on the right. She wears four eye-catching pieces of jewelry: a silver heart-shaped pendant necklace, stacked beaded and metal bracelets on her wrists, a shell drop earring on the left, and a shell drop earring on the right. Using soft, natural light and a clean, high-end product advertising style, the skin tone is warm and the color palette is a refreshing summer blue. The image is designed like a commercial poster, with Japanese text and product labeling integrated around the model. A handwritten English phrase is placed in the upper left corner.{argument name="tagline" default="Summer Breeze"} Use a slender, elegant white font. Add a large, dark blue Ming Dynasty-style title below:{argument name="headline text" default="Embrace summer with my own unique radiance."} Below this, add two lines of dark gray Japanese text: “海風に揺れるアクセサリーで、” and “いつものコーデを特別に.”. In the center left, create a semi-transparent white rounded-corner panel titled “— おすすめアイテム—”, with three product cards arranged horizontally. Card 1 shows a silver heart-shaped necklace, tagged “Ocean Heart Necklace”, priced at “¥2,980”. Card 2 shows shell drop earrings, tagged “Shell Drop Pierce”, priced at “¥2,480”. Card 3 shows a natural beaded bracelet, tagged “Natural Beads Bracelet”, priced at “¥1,980”. In the bottom left corner, add a blue circular discount badge containing the white Japanese words "Limited Time Offer" and the large text "10% OFF". Above this, overlay a white coupon capsule tag with a small blue ribbon icon, containing "Coupon Code" and a large code.{argument name="coupon code" default="SUMMER10"} The text includes the small print "Effective period: August 31, 2024". In the upper right corner, a semi-transparent light blue circular badge is placed with the elegant light-colored text "New Collection 2024". In the lower left corner, the brand logo is added.{argument name="brand name" default="LUMIERE"} The text uses large serif capital letters, with the widely spaced word "ACCESSORY" below. In the lower right corner, there is a white, rounded call-to-action button with a cyan-outlined shopping cart icon, and the text reads:{argument name="button text" default="Check it out now"} The text is followed by a right-pointing arrow. The layout is kept elegant and balanced, presenting a promotional design reminiscent of high-end Japanese fashion e-commerce.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张精致的日系夏季时尚广告海报，采用 1:1 正方形布局，呈现明亮通透的海岸生活方式摄影风格，具备高端产品目录的质感。画面展示一位年轻女性的半身像，背景为热带海滩，拥有绿松石色的海洋、浅色沙滩、柔和的天空，右上角背景处有轻微虚化的棕榈叶。她戴着一顶带有蓝色丝带装饰的宽檐天然草编遮阳帽，留着长直黑发，身穿宽松的蓝白扎染上衣。她的面部被居中的柔和矩形模糊块遮挡。一只手轻轻触碰帽檐。在帽子和头发两侧添加海滩风发饰：带有贝壳、珠子、流苏和圆形装饰的挂绳，右侧包含一条长长的白蓝编织发辫。她佩戴 4 件显眼的珠宝：一条银色心形吊坠项链、手腕上叠戴的珠饰与金属手链、左侧一只贝壳垂坠耳环、右侧一只贝壳垂坠耳环。使用柔和的自然光，采用干净的高端产品广告风格，肤色温润，色调为清爽的夏季蓝色。

将图像设计为商业海报，日文文字和产品标注围绕模特进行整合。在左上角，放置手写体英文短语 {argument name="tagline" default="Summer Breeze"}，使用纤细优雅的白色字体。下方添加一行深蓝色明朝体大标题：{argument name="headline text" default="夏をまとう、私らしい輝き。"}。在其下方，添加两行深灰色的日文正文：“海風に揺れるアクセサリーで、” 以及 “いつものコーデを特別に。”。

在左侧中部，创建一个半透明的白色圆角面板，标题为 “— おすすめアイテム —”，其中横向排列 3 张产品卡片。卡片 1 展示银色心形项链，标签为 “Ocean Heart Necklace”，价格为 “¥2,980”。卡片 2 展示贝壳垂坠耳环，标签为 “Shell Drop Pierce”，价格为 “¥2,480”。卡片 3 展示天然珠饰手链，标签为 “Natural Beads Bracelet”，价格为 “¥1,980”。

在左下角，添加一个蓝色圆形折扣徽章，内含白色日文 “期間限定” 和大号文字 “10% OFF”。在其上方叠加一个白色优惠券胶囊标签，带有蓝色小丝带图标，包含 “クーポンコード” 和大号代码 {argument name="coupon code" default="SUMMER10"}，以及小字 “有効期限：2024.8.31まで”。

在右上角，放置一个半透明的水蓝色圆形徽章，带有优雅的浅色文字 “New Collection 2024”。在左下角，添加品牌 Logo 文字 {argument name="brand name" default="LUMIERE"}，使用大号衬线体大写字母，下方配有间距较宽的 “ACCESSORY” 字样。在右下角，放置一个带有青色轮廓购物车图标的白色圆角行动呼吁按钮，文字为 {argument name="button text" default="今すぐチェック"}，后跟一个向右的箭头。保持所有排版精致且平衡，呈现出高端日系时尚电商的促销布局。

templates.title: Animation Creative Team Studio Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫创意团队工作室海报

templates.prompt: A refined anime-style illustration of a corporate team. The background is a bright, modern creative studio, featuring three women (half-length figures) seated behind workbenches, arranged from left to right, forming a team introduction poster. The overall atmosphere is elegant, professional, soft, and slightly dreamlike, with delicate lines, painterly shadows, translucent window lighting, soft pastel tones, and a sophisticated visual novel/keyword rendering style. On the left is a fashion digital artist named {argument name="character name" default="Runa"} She has long, wavy, lavender-colored hair tied in a high ponytail with braids, a few strands falling loose. She wears a black lace-trimmed tank top, layered necklaces, and an oversized, semi-transparent lavender-colored jacket that slips off her shoulders. She holds a stylus in one hand, and beside her is a digital screen displaying purple-toned anime illustrations. In the center is a virtual singer character named {argument name="character name" default="Shino Tanemori"} She has extremely long, straight, silver-lilac hair, pale skin, and a calm expression. She wears a black top under a semi-transparent, shiny jacket with a belt and ties, and a delicate star-shaped hair accessory. She lightly touches her collar with one hand. To her right is an editor/director named {argument name="character name" default="Hashimoto Susumu"} She had short, neatly parted gray-brown hair, wore a white shirt with a dark cardigan, and a lanyard. She rested her chin on one hand, while the other held a pen on a document, her expression focused. The office backdrop included tall bookshelves, binders, a large, softly lit window, a "projects" board with charts and notes on the wall, piles of documents, notebooks, mugs, and an office desk that, while seemingly cluttered, was neatly organized. The image incorporates printed branding and editorial typography text, making it resemble a recruitment or mission poster: the top left title reads "KAMINOOPS STUDIO," followed by "クリエイターチーム" and a brief Japanese mission statement; the top right title reads "Our Mission" with supplementary Japanese text; three business card panels, one for each person, are aligned below the characters, each containing a job title, a brief Japanese bio, and age and height information; the bottom horizontal information bar is divided into four square areas, including a title section on team connections on the left, three icon-based explanatory boxes in the middle, and a box on the right containing three key points about team values. The clean editorial composition, with subtle borders and semi-transparent white text panels, realistic desk perspective, and rich details in fabric sheen and hair strands, presents the aesthetic effect of a high-end Japanese studio brochure.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的动漫风格企业团队插画，背景为明亮的现代创意工作室，画面中包含 3 位坐在工作台后的女性（半身像），从左至右排列，呈现为团队介绍海报。整体氛围优雅、专业、柔和且略带梦幻感，线条细腻，采用绘画式阴影、通透的窗光、柔和的粉彩色调以及精致的视觉小说/关键视觉图渲染风格。左侧是一位时尚数字艺术家，名为 {argument name="character name" default="Runa"}，留着蓬松的薰衣草色波浪长发，扎着高马尾并带有编发点缀，几缕发丝垂落，身穿黑色蕾丝边吊带背心，佩戴叠层项链，外搭一件滑落肩头的超大款半透明薰衣草色外套，一手拿着触控笔，身旁是显示着紫色调动漫插画的数位屏。中间是一位虚拟歌手角色，名为 {argument name="character name" default="種守 詩乃"}，留着极长的直顺银丁香色头发，肤色冷白，表情平静，内穿黑色上衣，外搭带有皮带和束带的亮面半透明外套，佩戴精致的星形发饰，单手轻触领口。右侧是一位编辑/导演，名为 {argument name="character name" default="橋本 推"}，留着灰棕色短发，侧分整齐，身穿白色衬衫，外搭深色开衫，佩戴挂绳，单手托腮，另一只手拿着笔放在文件上，神情专注。办公室背景包括高大的书架、活页夹、一扇柔和发光的大窗户、墙上挂着图表和笔记的“项目”板、成堆的文件、笔记本、马克杯以及办公桌上虽显杂乱但井然有序的物件。在图像中融入印刷品牌和编辑排版文本，使其看起来像招聘或使命海报：左上角标题为“KAMINOOPS STUDIO”，下方为“クリエイターチーム”及一段简短的日语使命说明；右上角标题为“Our Mission”并配有日语辅助文本；角色下方对齐排列 3 个名片面板，每人一个，包含职位行、简短的日语个人简介以及年龄和身高信息；底部横向信息栏分为 4 个方框区域，包括左侧关于团队连接的标题区、中间 3 个基于图标的说明框，以及右侧关于团队价值的方框，内含 3 个要点。采用整洁的编辑构图，配有细微的边框和半透明白色文本面板，办公桌透视真实，织物光泽和发丝细节丰富，呈现出高端日本工作室宣传册的美学效果。

templates.title: 360-degree panoramic view of Tokyo's back alleys in ink painting style

titleLocalized.zh: 东京后巷水墨 360 度全景

templates.prompt: A monochrome black ink line drawing, designed specifically for 360-degree panoramas using isometric cylindrical projection, presents a strong panoramic distortion and curved architectural lines within an ultra-wide format. The scene is a narrow outdoor platform or walkway in a densely populated residential area of ​​Japan, viewed at eye level, with the left and right edges curving upwards, as if encased in VR or polar coordinate panorama conversion. In the left foreground, a young woman with her face deliberately blurred crouches on the concrete pavement near a metal railing, wearing a loose short-sleeved T-shirt (with a dark chest pocket), shorts, and sneakers, her medium-length dark hair hanging down in front. Next to her, exactly one black cat sits on the ground, facing the city view. Also in the left foreground are: exactly one closed umbrella placed against the wall, exactly two flower pots, exactly one outdoor air conditioner, exactly one mailbox, exactly one doorbell/intercom, and an apartment sign that reads "201 Kopo Haruka". The mid-ground showcases descending staircases and dense housing and apartment buildings, complete with balconies, awnings, windows, electrical boxes, and narrow alleyways. In the background, a complex network of utility poles, transformers, and overhead power lines traces dramatically across the sky. Rendered with fine pen-and-ink hatching, sketch-like cross-shading, architectural details, and a quiet, observational, comic-book-style travel sketch aesthetic, the background is a clean white, achromatic, with no gray tones except for deliberately blurred faces. The emphasis is on everyday realism, dense urban textures, subtle fisheye distortion, and the feeling of being immersed in a hand-drawn panoramic slice of Tokyo.{argument name="aspect ratio" default="2:1"} A panoramic composition is used, preserving the image as a seamless 360-degree environmental illustration suitable for conversion to polar coordinate panoramas. Optionally, the crouching subject is set as {argument name="character description" default="Young women in casual summer clothes"} Set the block as{argument name="location style" default="Dense Japanese residential back alleys"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅单色黑墨线稿，专为等距柱状投影的 360 度全景设计，在超宽画幅中呈现强烈的全景畸变和弯曲的建筑线条。场景为日本密集住宅区内的一处狭窄户外平台或走道，平视视角，左右边缘向上弯曲，仿佛为 VR 或极坐标全景转换而包裹。左侧前景中，一名面部刻意模糊的年轻女性蹲在金属栏杆附近的混凝土路面上，身穿宽松短袖 T 恤（带深色胸袋）、短裤和运动鞋，中长深色头发垂在身前。她旁边，恰好有 1 只黑猫坐在地上，面向城市景观。左侧前景中还有：恰好 1 把靠墙放置的闭合雨伞、恰好 2 个花盆、恰好 1 台室外空调机、恰好 1 个邮箱、恰好 1 个门铃/对讲机，以及 1 个写有“201 コーポ ハルカ”的垂直公寓招牌。中景展现了向下的楼梯以及密集的房屋和公寓楼，配有阳台、遮阳篷、窗户、配电箱和狭窄的小巷。背景中，复杂的电线杆、变压器和架空电线交织成网，在天空中划出戏剧性的弧线。以精细的钢笔水墨排线、速写交叉阴影、建筑细节和安静的观察式漫画旅行素描美学进行渲染，背景为干净的白色，无色彩，除刻意模糊的面部外无灰色渲染。强调日常现实感、密集的城市纹理、轻微的鱼眼畸变，以及置身于手绘东京全景切片中的感觉。使用 {argument name="aspect ratio" default="2:1"} 全景构图，并将图像保留为适合转换为极坐标全景的无缝 360 度环境插图。可选地，将蹲着的主体设为 {argument name="character description" default="身着休闲夏装的年轻女性"}，将街区设为 {argument name="location style" default="密集的日本住宅后巷"}。

templates.title: Cyberpunk Izanagi: Warrior of Gods

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克伊邪那岐：神之战士

templates.prompt: A cyberpunk portrait with a cinematic feel, the protagonist is {argument name="character name" default="Izanagi"} He has been reconstructed as a futuristic god warrior. The image shows his back and a slightly turned posture against a backdrop of a neon-lit metropolis after the rain. The figure stands centered in the foreground, his expression calm and dignified, glancing back to his left.{argument name="hair style" default="Messy, layered black short hair with a braided section."} The silhouette reveals that of a young man. His body is a complex fusion of human and machine: glossy black biomechanical arms, shoulders, and torso revealing cables, metal joints, and elegant, luminous golden circuitry. He wears a flowing white robe inspired by Shinto and Japanese imperial attire, layers of semi-transparent fabric billowing in the wind, adorned with delicate gold embroidery, tassels, knots, and decorative buckles, draped over his mechanical body like a sacred garment. In his right hand, he wields a downward-sloping, luminous katana, its blade shimmering with platinum energy, the ornate hilt casting dazzling light and shadow on the wet ground. A massive circular halo floats behind his head, composed of holographic golden concentric circles, mysterious circuitry, and celestial interface lines, creating a sacred technological mandala effect. In the midground stands a colossal red torii gate, against a backdrop of towering futuristic skyscrapers filled with windows and vertical city lights. The street surface, glistening with rain, reflects the glint of the sword and the city lights. The scene is filled with drifting sparks, floating embers, and fine mist, using cinematic backlighting against a backdrop of dark metallic tones.{argument name="accent color" default="White and gold"} A strong contrast is created between them. Ultra-detailed, epic, mythological, photorealistic concept art, high contrast, sharp focus, volumetric lighting, reflective surfaces, intricate costume design, a fusion of Japanese mythology and futuristic science fiction, and vertical composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅电影质感的赛博朋克肖像，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="伊邪那岐"}，被重构为一位未来神之战士。画面展示其背影及略微侧身的姿态，背景是雨后霓虹闪烁的夜间大都市。人物居中伫立于前景，神态从容且威严，回头望向左侧，留着 {argument name="hair style" default="凌乱的黑色层次感短发，带有一缕编发"}，展现出年轻男性的轮廓。他的身体是人类与机械的复杂融合：光泽的黑色生物机械手臂、肩部和躯干，露出电缆、金属关节以及优雅的金色发光电路。他身着受神道教和日本皇室服饰启发的飘逸白色礼袍，层叠的半透明布料在风中飘动，饰有精致的金色刺绣、流苏、绳结和装饰性扣环，如同圣衣般披在机械躯体之上。右手持一把向下倾斜的发光武士刀，刀刃闪烁着白金色的能量，华丽的刀镡在湿润的地面上投射出耀眼的光影。他脑后悬浮着一个巨大的圆形光环，由全息金色同心圆、神秘电路和天体界面线条构成，营造出一种神圣的科技曼陀罗效果。中景处矗立着一座巨大的红色鸟居，背景是布满窗户和垂直城市灯光的高耸未来摩天大楼。街道地面因雨水而光亮，映射着刀光与城市灯火。画面中充斥着飘散的火花、浮动的余烬、细密的薄雾，采用电影级背光，在深色金属色调与 {argument name="accent color" default="白色和金色"} 之间形成强烈的对比。超细节、史诗感、神话风、照片级真实感概念艺术、高对比度、焦点清晰、体积光、反射表面、复杂的服装设计，日本神话与科幻未来的融合，垂直构图。

templates.title: Gothic anime characters in front of the cathedral

titleLocalized.zh: 大教堂前的哥特风动漫人物

templates.prompt: A full-body dark gothic anime illustration depicts a tall, slender young man standing confidently before a towering, ruined cathedral. The image is vertically oriented, with the figure centered. He has messy, slightly curly short hair, the color of which is {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} His skin was pale, exuding a neutral and elegant aura. His expression was hidden in shadow, appearing understated and reserved, his face partially obscured by dramatic light and shadow. He wore a layered all-black outfit: a worn long coat with sharp, asymmetrical panels, a high-necked inner jacket, a textured dark shirt, loose capri trousers tapering to the calves, and polished black lace-up boots. One hand was in his coat pocket, the other hanging naturally, presenting a calm, aloof, and aristocratic posture. Behind him stood the massive Gothic cathedral facade, with five spires visible, including a central spire with a cross, exhibiting an ink-painting-like texture. The ambient color scheme was a monochromatic mix of charcoal gray, ashes, and black, with subtle, soft brown undertones, accompanied by heavy paint drips, ink-like textures, a hazy mist, and reflections from the damp ground beneath his feet. A strong backlight from the upper left created a halo effect around the figure, outlining the silhouette of the cathedral. The overall atmosphere is desolate, solemn, mysterious, and cinematic, blending elements of gothic fashion magazines, dark fantasy, and ink-wash concept art. It features highly detailed clothing folds, freehand brushstrokes, strong contrasts, a textured, decadent background, and elegant composition. There is no text or additional characters.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张全身暗黑哥特风动漫插画，描绘了一位身材修长的年轻男子自信地站在高耸的废墟大教堂前，采用垂直构图，人物居中。他留着凌乱且微卷的短发，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色"}，皮肤苍白，散发着中性而优雅的气质。他的表情隐没在阴影中，显得低调内敛，面部被戏剧性的光影部分遮挡。他身穿全黑的叠穿服饰：一件带有锋利不对称裁片的破旧长款大衣、高领内搭夹克、质感深色衬衫、在小腿处收紧的宽松七分裤，以及抛光的黑色系带靴。他一只手插在大衣口袋里，另一只手臂自然下垂，呈现出冷静、疏离且贵族般的姿态。在他身后矗立着巨大的哥特式教堂外墙，可见 5 座尖塔，包括中央带有十字架的塔尖，呈现出水墨画般的质感。环境色调为单色木炭灰、灰烬色和黑色，带有微妙的柔和棕色底色，伴有厚重的颜料滴落、墨点纹理、朦胧雾气以及脚下湿润的地面反射。利用左上方的强烈背光在人物周围营造出光环效果，并勾勒出大教堂的剪影。整体氛围凄凉、庄重、神秘且具有电影感，融合了哥特时尚杂志、暗黑奇幻和水墨概念艺术风格。高度细腻的衣褶、写意的笔触、强烈的对比、充满质感的颓废背景、优雅的构图，无文字，无额外角色。

templates.title: Neon anime poster with a dual protagonist atmosphere

titleLocalized.zh: 具有双主角氛围的霓虹动漫海报

templates.prompt: This is a poster for an original TV animation series, featuring a dramatic vertical composition, and is titled {argument name="title text" default="ナイトコード：リベラシオン"} The English subtitle, "Nightcode: Liberation," is located directly below the large Japanese logo at the top center. The composition shows two protagonists standing back-to-back in a neon-lit cyberpunk city at night. On the left is a slender boy turned to the left, with messy black hair, pale skin, sharp violet eyes, and a serious expression. He wears a dark, high-necked, uniform-style jacket. In the foreground on the right is a half-length portrait of a girl, her face slightly turned to the right, but her back is to the boy; her face is obscured by a large, softly edged rectangular blur, but her body and hair are clearly visible. She has extremely long, two-tone hair, half soft pink and half dark charcoal gray, which falls naturally, with the darker side tied in a side ponytail. She wears a white sailor-style top with navy blue trim, wide sleeves tied with a large, bright pink bow, and a dark pleated skirt. The background is a dense, futuristic nightscape, dotted with glowing windows, magenta and cyan city lights, a thin mist, lens flares, bokeh, and subtle star-like grain, creating a melancholic urban fantasy atmosphere. A high-contrast color scheme of black, indigo, violet, cyan, and neon pink is used, with halftone dot textures added to the upper right and lower left corners. Stylized Japanese promotional text is incorporated throughout the poster: a short, small slogan at the top, a vertical slogan on the right, and a circular badge on the left.{argument name="release month text" default="Broadcasting begins this summer, July!"} The left column displays the staff list in small Japanese print, the bottom left corner shows the voice actor lineup, and the bottom row features a prominent banner in large print.{argument name="bottom tagline" default="Dual personality x Magic x Youth = The false savior begins."} Near the bottom right corner are text indicating the official website and social media accounts. The logo should have a luminous, elegant, and slightly fragmented effect, with a supernatural cyberpunk feel. It is rendered in a sophisticated modern animated poster style, with strong cinematic lighting and shadows, clear lines, and delicate shading, demonstrating a high level of promotional visual design. The hair and clothing details are rich, and the overall tone showcases a dual identity, magic, youth, and the emergence of a pseudo-savior under the neon lights.

promptLocalized.zh: 这是一张原创电视动画系列的海报，采用戏剧性的垂直构图，标题为 {argument name="title text" default="ナイトコード：リベラシオン"}，英文副标题 “Nightcode: Liberation” 位于顶部中央大型日文 Logo 的正下方。画面构图展示了 2 位主角背靠背站在夜晚的霓虹赛博城市中。左侧是一位侧身向左的瘦削少年，留着凌乱的黑发，皮肤苍白，有着锐利的紫罗兰色双眼，表情严肃，身穿深色高领制服风格外套。右侧前景是一位半身像少女，面部略向右侧，但背对着少年；她的脸部被一个大型边缘柔和的矩形模糊块遮挡，但身体和头发清晰可见。她留着极长的双色头发，一半是柔和的粉色，另一半是深炭灰色，发型自然垂落，深色一侧扎着侧马尾，身穿带有海军蓝饰边的白色水手服上衣，袖子宽大，系着巨大的亮粉色蝴蝶结，下身穿着深色百褶裙。背景是密集的未来主义夜景，点缀着发光的窗户、洋红色和青色的城市灯光、薄雾、镜头光晕、焦外成像以及细微的星状颗粒，营造出一种忧郁的都市奇幻氛围。使用黑色、靛青、紫罗兰、青色和霓虹粉的高对比度配色，并在右上角和左下角加入半调网点纹理。海报各处添加风格化的日文宣传文案：顶部有一行小字短标语，右侧有一条垂直口号，左侧有一个圆形徽章，写着 {argument name="release month text" default="今夏 7月 放送開始!"}，左侧一列为日文小字职员表，左下角为声优阵容，底部横跨一行醒目的大字标语 {argument name="bottom tagline" default="二重人格×魔法×青春＝偽りの救世主、開幕。"}，右下角附近有小型官方网站和社交媒体账号文字。Logo 应呈现出发光、优雅且略带破碎的效果，具有超自然赛博魔法的质感。采用精致的现代动画海报风格渲染，光影电影感强，线条清晰，阴影光泽细腻，具备高级宣传视觉设计水准，头发和衣褶细节丰富，整体基调展现了霓虹之夜下双重身份、魔法、青春以及伪救世主的登场。

templates.title: Minimalist sunscreen product cover

titleLocalized.zh: 极简防晒产品封面

templates.prompt: A clean, minimalist still-life product photo used as a cover for a beauty short video, employing a 9:16 vertical composition. On a light gray-white shelf in front of a warm ivory-textured stucco wall, five sunscreen and UV protection skincare products are arranged vertically in a straight line. From left to right: 1) a glossy blue-gold gradient bottle with a round cap; 2) a matte white squeeze tube; 3) a slightly curved white squeeze tube with soft beige tones and elegant black lettering; 4) a slender pink tube with a metallic gold cap; 5) a white tube with a blue label. Soft natural light from the left casts delicate plant leaf shadows on the upper left of the wall, leaving subtle projections behind the products. The overall style remains transparent, sophisticated, and understated, with ample negative space above the products for cover text. The use of neutral cream, white, beige, and blue tones creates a realistic commercial photography feel, with fine textures and sharp packaging focus, creating a soft, high-end skincare advertising atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张用于美妆短视频封面的干净、极简风格产品静物照，采用 9:16 竖构图。在暖象牙色纹理灰泥墙前的浅灰白色搁板上，将 5 款防晒及紫外线防护护肤品垂直并排摆放成一条直线。从左至右依次为：1) 一个带有圆盖的亮面蓝金渐变瓶；2) 一支哑光白色挤压管；3) 一支带有柔和米色调和优雅黑色字体的微弧形白色挤压管；4) 一支带有金属金盖的纤细米粉色管；5) 一支带有蓝色标签的白色管。使用来自左侧的柔和自然光，在墙壁左上方投射出精致的植物叶片阴影，并在产品后方留下淡淡的投影。整体风格保持通透、高级且低调，产品上方留出大量负空间以便添加封面文字。采用中性奶油色、白色、米色和蓝色调，呈现真实的商业摄影质感，纹理细腻，包装对焦清晰，营造出柔和的高端护肤广告氛围。

templates.title: Japanese collage fashion portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 日式拼贴时尚肖像

templates.prompt: A stylized half-length to three-quarter-length portrait of a Japanese woman, inspired by {argument name="character name" default="Non, Nōnen Rena"} The subject is centered, facing the camera with a calm and composed expression, her hands gently clasped at her waist. She has medium-length, jet-black hair, softly layered and combed back, slightly voluminous at the top, and fair skin. She wears a luxurious deep red velvet gown with an exaggerated, large ruffled neckline, delicate vertical lace trim on the chest, and lace embellishments on the cuffs, exuding romantic, vintage elegance. The artwork should be presented in a refined, oil painting-like illustration style, requiring realistic anatomical structures, soft shadows, rich fabric textures, and delicate highlights on the velvet texture. The background is a Japanese-themed handmade torn paper collage, composed of layered textured paper in indigo, cyan, sage green, cream, and gold foil tones. The background must include five clearly visible torii gate silhouettes, three pagoda silhouettes on the right and lower right, and hand-painted bamboo leaves integrated into multiple layers of paper. The collage should exhibit exquisite craftsmanship, with irregularly torn edges, overlapping papers, and decorative gold elements. The vertical composition places the figure at the center of the image, while the background serves as an elegant backdrop rich in cultural heritage. With no text, no borders, and no superfluous objects, it presents a refined museum poster aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅风格化的半身至七分身日本女性肖像，灵感源自 {argument name="character name" default="Non, Nōnen Rena"}，人物居中，正对镜头，表情沉稳从容，双手在腰间轻轻交叠。她留着中等长度的乌黑秀发，发丝层次柔和，向后梳理，头顶略显蓬松，肤色白皙。她身着奢华的深红色丝绒礼服，配有夸张的大荷叶边领口，胸前饰有精致的垂直蕾丝边，袖口亦有蕾丝装饰，尽显浪漫的复古优雅。以油画质感的精致编辑插画风格呈现，要求解剖结构真实，阴影柔和，织物纹理丰富，丝绒质感带有细腻的高光。背景采用以日本为主题的手工撕纸拼贴画，由靛蓝、青色、鼠尾草绿、奶油色和金箔色调的层叠纹理纸构成。背景中需包含 5 个清晰可见的鸟居剪影，右侧及右下方分布 3 个宝塔剪影，并将手绘竹叶融入多层纸张中。拼贴画应呈现出精湛的工艺感，边缘不规则撕裂，纸张相互叠加，并点缀装饰性金色元素。垂直构图，人物占据画面主体，背景作为文化底蕴深厚的优雅衬托。无文字，无边框，无多余物体，呈现精致的博物馆海报美学。

templates.title: Deep red Japanese collage portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 深红色的日式拼贴肖像

templates.prompt: An exquisite vertical portrait, with the subject being {argument name="subject" default="A Japanese actress and singer"} A half-length portrait, centered and facing forward. She has deep black wavy hair, reaching the length of a mullet, combed back to softly frame her ears and neck. She wears a dramatic deep red chiffon blouse or dress, adorned with exaggerated semi-transparent ruffles at the collar, chest, and cuffs. Her hands are gently clasped at the bottom center of the image, her posture serene and formal. Her face is deliberately obscured by a flat, rectangular block of skin color, revealing no facial features, creating an effect of anonymous edited art. The background is an exquisite Japanese collage composed of torn washi paper textures and gilded surfaces. On the right are two red torii gates of varying proportions, on the left a dark five-story pagoda, red maple leaves adorn the upper right corner, bamboo shadows in the upper left, and delicate gold plant patterns in the lower corner. The work employs a rich palette of burgundy, vermilion, burnt ochre, black, cyan, parchment, and gold leaf, combined with painterly brushstrokes, soft shadow transitions, antique screen painting aesthetics, and luxurious museum-quality lighting. The overall composition is elegant, profound, and ceremonial, blending contemporary portrait photography with traditional Japanese screen painting and Japanese painting styles.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张精致的竖构图艺术肖像，主体为 {argument name="subject" default="一位日本女演员兼歌手"}，半身像，居中且面向前方。她留着深黑色波浪卷发，长度及鲻鱼头，头发向后梳起，柔和地修饰着耳部和颈部线条。身着一件极具戏剧感的深红色雪纺衬衫或连衣裙，领口、胸前和袖口处饰有夸张的半透明荷叶边。双手在画面下方中心处轻轻交叠，姿态沉静而正式。面部区域被一个平面的肤色矩形色块刻意遮挡，没有任何五官可见，营造出一种匿名编辑艺术的效果。背景是由撕裂的和纸纹理和镀金表面组成的精致日式拼贴画，右侧有 2 座比例不同的红色鸟居，左侧有 1 座深色的五重塔，右上角点缀着红枫叶，左上角有竹影，下角饰有精致的金色植物图案。使用勃艮第红、朱砂红、焦赭色、黑色、青色、羊皮纸色和金箔构成的丰富色调，结合绘画般的笔触、柔和的阴影过渡、古董屏风画美学以及奢华的博物馆级布光。整体构图优雅、深沉且具有仪式感，融合了当代肖像摄影与传统的日式屏风画及日本画风格。

templates.title: Anime fox-eared girl on a tropical beach

titleLocalized.zh: 热带海滩上的动漫狐耳少女

templates.prompt: A vibrant, anime-style tropical beach illustration depicts a cheerful fox-eared schoolgirl posing for a selfie in the foreground under the bright midday sun. She stands on a mosaic-tiled beach terrace at the edge of a bright turquoise lagoon, her body slightly turned to one side. One arm extends towards the viewer with a strong sense of perspective, palm open, while the other is held beside her face in a peace sign. She has long, flowing hair that dances in the sea breeze.{argument name="hair color" default="Bright reddish orange"} She has two fluffy fox ears with white inner edges, and wears a white and yellow frangipani hair accessory with pearl-like dangling ornaments on one side. Her face is obscured by a soft, rectangular blur effect. She wears a semi-transparent white Japanese sailor uniform top with navy blue trim and a red scarf, a navy blue pleated skirt, white socks, brown loafers, and a beaded bracelet. The background showcases a luxurious tropical resort bay with four thatched parasols, six lounge chairs, lush palm trees, flowering bushes, white sand beaches, clear shallow waters where corals and fish are visible, three white yachts moored offshore, four large seagulls overhead, three birds flying in the distance, and two tiny paragliders in the sky. The sky is a deep blue, dotted with towering white cumulus clouds, with a blazing sun in the upper left corner accompanied by an iridescent lens flare, and the sea shimmering with light. In the foreground at the bottom of the terrace, two black cats with their backs to the viewer are looking at the girl. Colorful seashells and pebbles are embedded around the tiles, and four sets of tropical fruits are arranged: a bowl on the left holds mangoes and passion fruit, while a plate on the right contains sliced ​​mangoes, coconuts, and purple passion fruit. There are also two decorative tropical plants. The overall effect is a highly detailed, glossy, and saturated summer fantasy aesthetic, with dynamic composition, clean anime lines, bright water reflections, flowing hair, and a playful vacation atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅生动的动漫风格热带海滩插画，在强烈的正午阳光下，前景中一位开朗的狐耳女学生正摆出仿佛在自拍的姿势。她站在明亮的绿松石色泻湖边缘的马赛克瓷砖海滨露台上，身体微微侧向一边，一只手臂以强烈的透视感向观众伸出，手掌张开，另一只手举在脸旁比出剪刀手。她有着随海风飘动的长发，颜色为 {argument name="hair color" default="明亮的赤橙色"}，两只毛茸茸的狐耳内侧为白色，一侧戴着带有珍珠般垂饰的白黄色鸡蛋花发饰。她的面部被柔和的矩形模糊效果遮挡。她穿着半透明的白色日本水手服上衣，配有海军蓝饰边和红色领巾，下身是海军蓝百褶短裙，穿着白袜、棕色乐福鞋，并戴着串珠手链。背景展示了一个豪华的热带度假海湾，有 4 把茅草遮阳伞、6 张躺椅、茂密的棕榈树、开花的灌木丛、白沙滩、可见珊瑚和鱼类的清澈浅水区，离岸停泊着 3 艘白色游艇，头顶有 4 只大鸥鸟和 3 只远处的飞鸟，天空中还有 2 个微小的滑翔伞运动员。天空呈现出浓郁的蓝色，点缀着高耸的白色积云，左上方是炽热的太阳，伴有彩虹色的镜头光晕，海面上闪烁着粼粼波光。露台底部的前景中有 2 只背对观众的黑猫正看向女孩，瓷砖周围嵌入了彩色的贝壳和鹅卵石，并摆放了 4 组热带水果：左侧碗中盛放着芒果和百香果，右侧盘子里有切好的芒果、椰子和紫色百香果，此外还有 2 盆装饰性的热带植物。超精细、光泽感、高饱和度的夏季幻想美学，动态构图，干净的动漫线条，明亮的水面反射，飘逸的头发动态，俏皮的度假氛围。

templates.title: Dark Mode AI Viewer and Course Website Preview

titleLocalized.zh: 深色模式 AI 查看器及课程网站预览

templates.prompt: A screenshot of a desktop AI image viewer interface in dark mode showcases a preview of the generated website design. The overall canvas is charcoal gray, employing a minimalist, modern application UI. The top left corner features a small white sans-serif text title, "Thought for 2m 6s," accompanied by a subtly angled icon. The middle left displays a large rounded rectangle preview, showcasing a black-themed, luxurious landing page for a Japanese online course. Inside the preview, the website's main screen area has a black background, using elegant serif and sans-serif fonts. Above is a small English title, "ONLINE COURSES," and below is a large Japanese main title, "デザインとキャリアを、次のステージへ," with a smaller Japanese subtitle below that. The main content area of ​​the website contains six course cards arranged in a 3-column, 2-row grid. Each card boasts a sophisticated, cinematic, and high-end style, featuring atmospheric images, category tags, Japanese titles, brief descriptions, small circular lecturer avatars, and links in the "See details →" style. Card 1 showcases a UI design image with the main title "Thoughts and Programs on the Essence of UI Design." Card 2 displays a Figma-related screen image with the title "Figma Master Lecture Practice Edition." Card 3 showcases paper writing tools with the title "Technology for Information Design that Creates Distributed Structures." promptLocalized.zh: {"type":"华丽的日语人格信息图海报","theme":"融合动漫插画与优雅编辑排版的柔和知识型自我档案卡","canvas":{"orientation":"纵向","aspect_ratio":"2:3","background":"暖象牙色纹理纸，带有细致的米色装饰边框、微妙的角落花纹、微小闪光，以及在右上角、左下角和右下角的淡雅花卉装饰"},"title_block":{"headline":"对话智能档案","subheadline":"参考示意图 / 非正式 IQ 测试","position":"顶部居中","style":"深棕色精致日文明朝体大标题，下方配有较小的副标题"},"main_layout":{"left_panel":{"position":"左上","type":"插画板块","description":"一幅温馨的阳光动漫风格学习场景，一位年轻女性坐在窗边的木书桌前，穿着宽松的浅米色针织毛衣，留着深棕色凌乱发髻，发丝轻柔，一手托腮，另一手在打开的笔记本上书写。桌子左侧放着一台银色笔记本电脑，桌缘附近放着一部智能手机，温暖的背光从窗户射入，背景中有书架和一小瓶花。面部被一个居中的矩形马赛克模糊块遮挡，呈柔和的米棕色。","style":"高细节水彩动漫插画，光影柔和金黄，层次感细腻，线条精致，氛围宁静沉思"},"right_panel":{"position":"右上","type":"评分卡","count":5,"cards":[{"label":"语言理解","score":"88/100","icon":"打开的书","description":"对词义和语境的理解精准，逻辑表达能力强。擅长从对话和文章中解读意图。"},{"label":"抽象思维","score":"90/100","icon":"灯泡","description":"擅长洞察事物的本质与结构，能灵活发现模式与规律。具备多维视角。"},{"label":"构建力","score":"85/100","icon":"四块拼图","description":"具备整理信息并清晰总结的能力。在策划、设计及文章架构方面表现突出，擅长把控整体流程。"},{"label":"元认知","score":"82/100","icon":"头部侧影与大脑","description":"客观审视并调节自身思维与情绪的能力较强。能够冷静地进行自我分析并持续学习。"},{"label":"创造整合","score":"92/100","icon":"星星与拼图","description":"将不同元素连接并创造新价值与想法的能力极高。能够塑造出独特的世界观。"}],"card_style":"圆角矩形奶油色面板，配有细米色边框，左侧为图标，蓝灰色板块标题，右侧为优雅衬线字体的大号分数，标题下方附有日语解释文字"},"middle_section":{"position":"中下","title":"综合印象","body":"兼具知性好奇心与创造力，思维深度与温柔并存的平衡型人格。在珍视自身价值观的同时，也能为周围带来积极影响。","quote_intro":"用一句话概括此人的智力特征……","highlight_quote":"“以感性与理性描绘并塑造未来的创作者类型”","style":"优雅的框选区域，居中对齐的日语文字，并以柔和的玫瑰棕色高亮引用语"},"bottom_section":{"position":"底部","title":"未测要素（本测试无法评估的领域）","count":6,"items":["处理速度","记忆容量","身体能力","人际关系深度","环境适应力","运气因素"],"note":"这些要素同样构成了你的魅力与潜能。","footer_message":"你的思维与感性将为世界带来新的价值与温暖。请按照自己的节奏，创造独一无二的未来。","signature_text":"Believe in yourself.","decor":"每项前配有匹配的小图标，左侧为花卉装饰，右侧为茶杯插画"}},"style":{"palette":["暖象牙色","米色","深褐色","灰玫瑰色","柔金色","柔和蓝灰色"],"typography":"经典日文衬线体混合优雅衬线数字及小型草书英文装饰文字","rendering":"高级编辑海报，极其清晰的日语文字渲染，平衡的间距，精致的信息图设计，女性化田园学术美学"}}

{"type":"日系灵感人格特质信息图海报","style":{"overall":"柔和水彩动漫插画，温暖米色与柔和色调，精致复古文具美学，优雅手绘花卉装饰，轻微纹理纸张背景，对称装饰布局","mood":"温柔、深思、创意、女性化、舒适、治愈"},"canvas":{"orientation":"纵向","border":"带有花卉边角的细致复古边框"},"title":{"main":"你的本质地图","subtitle":"构成你的重要元素"},"center":{"subject":"一位腰部以上的动漫风格年轻女性，坐在阳光明媚窗边的木质书桌前","face":"刻意模糊的面部区域","hair":"凌乱卷曲的棕色盘发，带有松散的发丝和柔和的蓬松感","outfit":"宽松米色针织衫和长款浅色裙子","pose":"一手拿着打开的笔记本，另一手拿着笔靠近嘴唇，呈思考姿态","surroundings":["书桌左侧放着打开的笔记本电脑","堆叠的书籍和笔记本","带有爱心图案的陶瓷马克杯","插着白花的小玻璃花瓶","桌上的相机","窗外透进的温暖背光"]},"layout":{"sections":[{"title":"价值观","position":"左上","count":4,"labels":["诚实・温柔・自由","成长・感恩・美好","乐于助人","珍惜与人的连接和感恩之心，在保持自我的同时不断成长，心中常怀美好事物。"],"icon":"爱心与打开的书","frameColor":"柔粉色"},{"title":"优势","position":"右上","count":4,"labels":["想象力・创造力","思考力・语言表达能力","持续力・细致度","擅长产生创意，并将其转化为语言或形式。能够脚踏实地，创作出高质量的作品。"],"icon":"星星与调色板","frameColor":"柔蓝色"},{"title":"爱好","position":"中左","count":4,"labels":["阅读书籍","构思创意","创作・设计","在咖啡馆度过的时光"],"icon":"嫩芽","frameColor":"柔绿色"},{"title":"重视的事物","position":"中右","count":4,"labels":["活出自我","心灵的连接","发现生活中的小确幸","不勉强自己，保持自己的节奏。察觉身边的幸福，细细品味每一天。"],"icon":"旗帜与茶杯","frameColor":"柔黄色"},{"title":"行动特征","position":"左下中","count":4,"labels":["三思而后行","按计划推进","重视独处时间","深思熟虑，确认后再行动。在安静的时间里整理思绪，深化自己的内心世界。"],"icon":"笔与笔记本","frameColor":"柔薰衣草色"},{"title":"能量来源","position":"下中","count":3,"labels":["安心的人际关系","沉浸在爱好中的时间","接触自然与美好事物"],"icon":"爱心","frameColor":"柔粉色"},{"title":"未来愿景","position":"右下中","count":4,"labels":["用自己的想法与创意","为他人提供帮助","创造内心充实的生活","以自己的方式创造价值，成为能点亮他人内心的人。"],"icon":"叶子与地球仪","frameColor":"柔蓝色"},{"title":"心灵关键词","position":"左下框","count":1,"labels":["『将思绪化为形，闪耀独特的自我』"],"icon":"茶杯、打开的笔记本、笔","frameColor":"淡蓝色"},{"title":"你的本质","position":"下中框","count":3,"labels":["兼具感性与知性，","重视内心想法，","创意的光芒"],"icon":"小型花卉装饰","frameColor":"淡金色"},{"title":"重视的平衡","position":"右下框","count":2,"labels":["个人时间","人际连接"],"icon":"天平","frameColor":"淡粉色"},{"title":"让魅力更闪耀的秘诀","position":"底部横条","count":3,"labels":["不必追求完美，享受过程","相信直觉，迈出小小一步","在安心的环境中，守护自己的节奏"],"frameColor":"奶油色"},{"title":"页脚寄语","position":"最底部","count":2,"labels":["你正以属于你的光芒，温柔地照亮这个世界。","请保持真实的自己，继续创造美好的未来。"],"frameColor":"无"}],"centerpieceCaption":{"top":"思考与创作，都是我想要珍视的事物。"}},"decorativeElements":{"count":10,"labels":["打开的书插画","带笔的调色板","小花与叶子","笔记本电脑","相机","爱心马克杯","堆叠的书籍","玻璃花瓶","茶杯","书上的地球仪"]},"textRendering":"高精度日文排版，优雅明朝体标题搭配易读正文，清晰的海报级层级结构","quality":"高细节，精致的编辑级信息图构图，平衡的间距，柔和的发光高光"}

promptLocalized.zh: {"type":"动画项目表","style":"动态水墨画与霓虹元素融合，电影感概念项目，以黑白单色为基调，点缀深红色及电光洋红色/青色高光，粗犷的笔触飞溅纹理，高对比度，戏剧性的速度线，漫画动作构图","subject":{"main 个由细白线分隔的项目面板","sections":[{"title":"CUT1：墨世界・开战","position":"左上","count":1,"labels":["墨水世界中的开场战斗"]},{"title":"CUT2：墨之敌，出现","position":"中上","count":1,"labels":["墨水敌人从飞溅中现身"]},{"title":"CUT3：高速斩击","position":"右上","count":1,"labels":["高速斩击攻击"]},{"title":"CUT4：敌，增殖","position":"左中","count":1,"labels":["敌人增殖并包围英雄"]},{"title":"CUT5：子弹时间发动","position":"正中","count":1,"labels":["发动子弹时间"]},{"title":"CUT6：开始假动作斩击","position":"右中","count":1,"labels":["时间静止时开始假动作斩击"]},{"title":"CUT7：超高速移动（追踪镜头）","position":"左下","count":1,"labels":["带追踪镜头的超高速移动"]},{"title":"CUT8：完成所有假动作斩击","position":"中下","count":1,"labels":["完成所有假动作斩击"]},{"title":"CUT9：子弹时间解除","position":"右下","count":1,"labels":["子弹时间结束"]},{"title":"CUT10：全敌，爆散","position":"底部左侧宽屏","count":1,"labels":["所有敌人爆裂成墨水和霓虹色彩"]},{"title":"CUT11：余韵","position":"底部右侧宽屏","count":1,"labels":["宁静的余波与胜利姿态"]}],"count":11},"panels":[{"title":"CUT1：墨世界・开战","scene":"雾气缭绕的水墨战场，远景是传统的日本寺庙建筑和山峦。猫武士站在前景，摆出低位预备姿势，围巾飘动，举起一把黑色画笔状的剑。世界以灰度为主，围巾带有微妙的红色。","camera":"中远景低角度"},{"title":"CUT2：墨之敌，出现","scene":"数十个不定形的影子敌人，双眼闪烁着白光，从猫咪周围剧烈的黑色墨水飞溅中涌出。混乱的飞溅填满了画面。","camera":"远景镜头"},{"title":"CUT3：高速斩击","scene":"英雄发起冲锋，对成群的墨水怪物进行快速对角斩击。强烈的运动轨迹和弯曲的黑色斩击弧线主导了构图。","camera":"动态动作视角"},{"title":"CUT4：敌，增殖","scene":"敌人数量增加，从四面八方包围猫咪。密集的抽象剪影和飞溅物逼近，极具威胁感。","camera":"远景包围镜头"},{"title":"CUT5：子弹时间发动","scene":"英雄特写镜头。猫咪自信地垂直举起剑，附近的墨水敌人静止在原地。飞溅的纹理悬浮在半空中。","camera":"紧凑特写"},{"title":"CUT6：开始假动作斩击","scene":"在静止的时间里，只有猫咪在移动，在静止的影子敌人之间做出从容的斩击姿态。围巾在灰色的场景中划出优雅的红色曲线。","camera":"中景动作镜头"},{"title":"CUT7：超高速移动（追踪镜头）","scene":"速度隧道构图，猫咪以极高速度奔跑或冲刺，身体前倾，围巾在身后飘扬，背景拉伸成黑白放射状模糊。","camera":"追踪跟拍镜头"},{"title":"CUT8：完成所有假动作斩击","scene":"在完成所有围绕敌人的预设斩击动作后，英雄回到中心。墨水团在冷静的猫咪周围形成一个圆形漩涡。","camera":"中心远景镜头"},{"title":"CUT9：子弹时间解除","scene":"猫咪面部和肩部的极致特写，眼神锐利地看向前方，红围巾格外显眼，标志着子弹时间的结束。","camera":"极致特写"},{"title":"CUT10：全敌，爆散","scene":"巨大的全景爆炸，所有静止的敌人同时爆裂成黑色墨水、明亮的 {argument name=\"neon accent colors\" default=\"洋红色、青色和紫色\"} 颜料，以及从中心小小的英雄身上向外辐射的爆炸飞溅。","camera":"超广角全景镜头"},{"title":"CUT11：余韵","scene":"爆炸过后，战场重归宁静。猫咪在广阔的水墨山水画中胜利伫立，残留的霓虹色条纹在雾气中逐渐消散。","camera":"远景英雄式结局镜头"}],"text":{"header language":"日语","captions":"每个面板在黑色条上都有白色日语标题文字，图像区域下方有一句简短的解释性句子"},"rendering":{"aspect ratio":"整体 16:9","finish":"精细的项目插画，概念艺术质量，富有表现力的墨水飞溅，面板之间视觉连贯性流畅"}}
