CBD 摩天大楼","王府井牌楼"],"foods":["白盘上的北京烤鸭","一碗炸酱面","盘中的驴打滚","配有小菜的豆汁儿茶具","老北京铜锅涮羊肉及配料"],"city_areas":["带有小船和远处白塔的什刹海湖景","胡同街区小景"],"decorative_elements":["大型黑色书法标题","红色竖式印章","边框周围的水彩树叶","带有红色小爱心的撕边纸条"]},"color_palette":{"paper":"暖象牙色","greens":"鼠尾草绿和橄榄绿","architecture":"宫廷红和金赭色","water":"柔和的蓝色","accents":"墨黑色和朱砂红"},"prompt":"创作一张详细的 {argument name=\"city name\" default=\"北京\"} 水彩插画海报，采用手工中国旅行写生风格，绘制在有纹理的奶油色纸张上。左上方使用大型黑色书法书写主标题 {argument name=\"main title\" default=\"北京\"}，并配有一个刻有 {argument name=\"seal text\" default=\"京味儿\"} 的小红印章。以简化的鸟瞰城市地图为背景，绘有淡色的道路、运河、公园和街区。在地图内外安排 17 个带标签的插图：10 个地标或区域场景、5 个美食插图和 2 个现代或生活方式街区。将故宫置于中心作为视觉焦点，天安门位于其下方。包含以下中文标签场景和菜肴：八达岭长城、北京烤鸭、颐和园、奥林匹克公园、老北京胡同、故宫、炸酱面、天坛、驴打滚、北京大学、豆汁儿、天安门广场、老北京涮羊肉、什刹海、国贸 CBD、王府井大街。在每个标签旁添加简短的手写中文描述。展示青山上的长城、水边的颐和园、带鸟巢的奥林匹克公园、带自行车和黄包车的胡同四合院、天坛、北京大学校门、国贸天际线、王府井牌楼以及带小船的什刹海。美食插图展示烤鸭、炸酱面、驴打滚、豆汁儿套装和铜锅涮羊肉。画面保持轻盈迷人，运用柔和的水彩晕染、随性的墨线、柔和的绿蓝色调、宫廷红与赭石色，营造出怀旧的文化旅游海报感。左侧添加一段手写中文介绍，右下角添加一张撕边纸条，写有结束语 titleLocalized.zh: 奢华黑金运动鞋广告

templates.prompt: Create a highly dramatic high-end sneaker advertisement in a dark-toned studio, employing cinematic black and gold lighting effects. The image captures a male athlete in explosive motion from an extremely low-angle wide-angle shot, with a massive sneaker extending forward to dominate the visual center. He is in the moment of jumping or sprinting forward, one knee bent, one arm outstretched, wearing a black fitted T-shirt under a metallic bronze bomber jacket, paired with black athletic shorts, black mid-calf socks with a small gold triangle logo, and stylish black and gold running shoes. The shoe design needs to embody futurism and luxury, featuring black mesh, glossy black leather overlays, metallic gold accents, gold eyelets, branded tongue details, and a sculpted open heel support structure. Add luminous gold energy bars, sparks, fragments, and shockwaves to the ground beneath the dominant shoe design, using a glossy reflective material to capture highlight details. A large, luminous gold lettering is placed in the background, displaying {argument name="brand text" default="VOLTEX"} and smaller text{argument name="product line" default="ELITE"} Incorporate these elements as part of the composition behind the athlete. Employ a high-contrast, sharp-detail, commercial fashion photography style, adding dynamic motion blur only to particles and light trails to create a luxurious, high-end sportswear brand feel, and using a striking hero composition suitable for footwear marketing campaigns. The image must include two clearly visible shoes, two socks, one jacket, one T-shirt, and one pair of shorts. Add a small watermark area in the upper right corner with the text:{argument name="watermark brand" default="insMind"} and{argument name="watermark model" default="GPT Image 2"} The overall color scheme is dominated by black, bronze, and luminous gold.

promptLocalized.zh: 在暗调摄影棚中创作一张极具戏剧性的高端运动鞋广告，采用电影质感的黑金灯光效果。画面捕捉了一位男性运动员在极端低角度广角镜头下的爆发性动作，一只巨大的运动鞋前伸至前景，占据视觉中心。他正处于跳跃或向前冲刺的瞬间，单膝弯曲，单臂伸展，身穿黑色修身 T 恤外搭金属古铜色飞行员夹克，搭配黑色运动短裤、带有小型金色三角形标志的黑色中筒袜，以及时髦的黑金配色跑鞋。鞋履设计需体现未来感与奢华感，包含黑色网面、亮面黑色皮革覆层、金属金色点缀、金色鞋眼、品牌鞋舌细节以及雕塑感的开放式后跟支撑结构。在主导鞋款下方的地面添加发光的金色能量条、火花、碎片以及冲击波，地面采用亮面反射材质，捕捉高光细节。背景处放置巨大的发光金色字体，显示 {argument name="brand text" default="VOLTEX"}，以及较小的文字 {argument name="product line" default="ELITE"}，将其作为构图的一部分融入运动员身后。采用高对比度、锐利细节、商业时尚摄影风格，仅在粒子和光轨处添加动态运动模糊，呈现奢华高端的运动品牌质感，并采用适合鞋履营销活动的醒目英雄构图。画面需包含 2 只清晰可见的鞋子、2 只袜子、1 件夹克、1 件 T 恤和 1 条短裤。在右上角添加一个小型的水印区域，文字为 {argument name="watermark brand" default="insMind"} 和 {argument name="watermark model" default="GPT Image 2"}。整体色调以黑色、古铜色和发光的金色为主。

templates.title: Anime Shrine Maiden Movie Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫巫女电影海报

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, transform it into a highly dramatic Japanese movie poster while retaining the original shrine maiden archer/swordsman character, fire portal, bow, quiver, thunder sword, and shrine background. Adjust the image style to a darker, higher-contrast, and more detailed movie poster texture, employing strong red and black tones, denser ember effects, stronger rim lighting, and a more oppressive supernatural atmosphere. Add two demonic guardian cats to the foreground at the character's feet: a white cat on the left with glowing blue eyes and a roaring mouth, and a black cat on the right with glowing red eyes and a roaring mouth, both surrounded by crackling red energy. Add vaguely visible monsters and demon masks to the edges of the dark forest on both sides. Add flying arrows, talismans, sparks, and glowing red energy trails around the character. Maintain the central hero composition, but format the entire image as a complete Japanese movie poster with layered typography. Add the Japanese tagline at the top: “禁断の力が、暗を裂く—” (Forbidden power ga, darkness wo riku—). Add two vertical sidebars: the left one reads "その巫女神より授かりし退魔の刃。" and the right one reads "暗を祓い、すべてを护るために—". Add a small genre description above the title: "Exorcism × Witch × Divine Realm Battle Action". Add a large, distressed kanji main title near the bottom center: "Exorcism Witch", with a subtitle below: "—Red Lotus Divine Sword—". Add a small Japanese credits below the title, followed by the website "taimamiko-movie.jp", and at the very bottom, add release information: "2025. Summer nationwide Roadshow". Add a small, dark rectangular logo block in the upper right corner. Make it look like a beautifully designed fantasy horror action movie poster.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图像，将其转化为一张极具戏剧性的日式电影海报，同时保留原有的巫女弓箭手兼剑士角色、火之传送门、弓、箭袋、雷霆之剑以及神社背景。将图像风格调整为更暗黑、高对比度且细节更丰富的电影海报质感，采用强烈的红黑调色、更密集的余烬效果、更强的轮廓光以及更具压迫感的超自然氛围。在角色脚下的前景处增加 2 只恶魔守护猫：左侧为一只双眼泛着蓝光、张嘴咆哮的白猫，右侧为一只双眼泛着红光、张嘴咆哮的黑猫，两只猫均被噼啪作响的红色能量环绕。在两侧黑暗森林的边缘，增加隐约浮现的怪物和鬼面。增加角色周围飞舞的箭矢、符咒、火花以及发光的红色能量轨迹。保持中心英雄构图，但将整张图像格式化为带有分层排版的完整日式电影海报。在顶部添加日文标语：“禁断の力が、闇を裂く—”。添加 2 条垂直侧边标语：左侧为“その巫女神より授かりし退魔の刃。”，右侧为“闇を祓い、すべてを護るために—”。在标题上方添加一行小型类型说明：“退魔×巫女×神域バトルアクション”。在底部中心附近添加大型做旧汉字主标题：“退魔巫女”，下方附带副标题：“—紅蓮の神剣—”。在标题下方添加小号日文制作人员名单，随后添加网址“taimamiko-movie.jp”，并在最底部添加上映信息：“2025.夏　全国ロードショー”。在右上角添加一个小型深色矩形标志块。使其看起来像是一张精美的虚构奇幻恐怖动作电影海报。

templates.title: Steel gears rolling on the ridge

titleLocalized.zh: 山脊上滚动的钢铁齿轮

templates.prompt: A cinematic, realistic action shot shows a massive steel gear rapidly rolling along a narrow, rocky ridge. Shot from a ground-level perspective, the gear occupies the right side of the frame. The gear has an industrial feel, a metallic texture, weathered and heavy, with large teeth, a round hub, and clearly defined internal spokes, exhibiting a realistic brushed steel reflection and slight wear. The rotating gear has a strong motion blur, while the terrain remains relatively sharp; as the gear bounces across the dirt path, dust, gravel, and debris fly outwards from the point of contact. The background is a dramatic, undulating mountain landscape, with the foreground dotted with dry grass, loose rocks, and uneven ground. The shot uses warm afternoon sunlight, natural earth tones, a light, airy mist in the mountains, and a widescreen cinematic aspect ratio. It emphasizes speed, weight, impact, and absurd realism, as if a giant mechanical part is speeding through a remote wilderness. There are no people, vehicles, buildings, or text in the shot.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影级写实动作镜头，展现一个巨大的钢铁齿轮在狭窄的岩石山脊上快速滚动。镜头从地面视角拍摄，齿轮占据了画面的右侧。齿轮呈工业风格，金属质感，饱经风霜且厚重，带有粗大的齿、圆形轮毂和清晰的内部辐条，呈现出逼真的拉丝钢反射效果和轻微磨损。旋转的齿轮带有强烈的动态模糊，而地形保持相对清晰，随着齿轮在泥土小径上弹跳，尘土、碎石和杂物从接触点向外飞溅。背景是连绵起伏、山峰嶙峋的戏剧性高山景观，前景点缀着干草、松散的石块和不平整的土地。采用温暖的午后阳光，自然的大地色调，山间带有浅浅的空气感薄雾，并使用宽屏电影比例。强调速度、重量、冲击力和荒诞的真实感，仿佛一个巨大的机械零件正在偏远的荒野中飞驰。画面中无人、无车辆、无建筑物、无文字。

templates.prompt: A highly dramatic anime-style sci-fi action illustration depicts a girl floating in deep space, positioned at the center of a dynamic pose, as if charging towards the viewer. She has {argument name="hair color" default="black"} Her short, slightly messy bob haircut was paired with a stylish pair of black futuristic goggles-style headphones. The goggles featured two glowing cyan horizontal bars, a small red HUD displaying a heart-shaped icon and "356 bpm," and a small yellow "42" indicator in the lower left corner. The headphones had two upright rabbit-ear antennas and rounded earcup side modules. Her expression was calm and confident, revealing only the lower half of her face. She wore a fitted, high-necked, dark long coat with delicate armor folds and a thin, vertical, glowing blue seam down the front, complemented by black gloves and black boots. Her left arm was extended forward towards the camera, gripping an oversized futuristic energy pistol with a massive barrel, sharply angled mechanical structure, and a core and muzzle gleaming with a strong electric blue light, employing a striking perspective shortening effect. Her right hand held a dark samurai sword diagonally behind her. The coat billowed outwards during movement, creating a sense of weightlessness and speed. The background is a star-studded cosmic space, with a bright orange-blue nebula halo behind her head and torso, surrounded by several small rocky asteroids. The overall tone is deep, with neon blue highlights, high-contrast rim lighting, cinematic composition, ultra-detailed anime-style drawing, sharp lines, a glossy technological surface, and the tension of an action poster, all within a vertical portrait composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅极具戏剧性的动漫科幻动作插画，描绘了一位漂浮在深空中的少女，她处于全身动态姿势的中心，仿佛正向观众冲刺。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"} 的短波波头，略显凌乱，佩戴着一副时髦的黑色未来主义护目镜式耳机，护目镜上有 2 条发光的青色水平显示条，一个小型的红色 HUD 读数显示着一颗心形图标和“356 bpm”，护目镜左下角还有一个黄色的小型“42”指示灯。耳机配有 2 个竖起的兔耳天线和圆形的耳罩侧模块。她的表情冷静而自信，仅露出下半张脸。她穿着一件修身的高领深色长外套，带有精致的装甲褶皱，正面有一条垂直的纤细发光蓝色缝线，并配有黑色手套和黑色靴子。她的左臂向前伸向镜头，握着 1 把超大号的未来主义能量手枪，枪管巨大，机械结构棱角分明，核心和枪口闪烁着强烈的电蓝色光芒，采用了强烈的透视缩短效果。她的右手向后斜持着 1 把深色的武士刀。外套在运动中向外飘散，营造出失重感和速度感。背景是布满星辰的宇宙空间，她的头部和躯干后方有一个明亮的橙蓝色星云光环，周围散布着几颗小型岩石小行星。整体色调深沉，带有霓虹蓝高光，高对比度的轮廓光，电影级构图，超精细的动漫绘画，锐利的线条，光泽感的科技表面，充满动作海报的张力，垂直肖像构图。

templates.title: Cubist style Chinese membership promotion poster

titleLocalized.zh: 立体主义风格中文会员促销海报

templates.prompt: Create a bold Chinese promotional poster, employing a chaotic graphic style that blends Mondrian, Fauvism, and Cubism, featuring thick black outlines, irregular geometric color blocks, and a high-contrast color scheme of red, blue, yellow, white, and black. The layout is a compact, single-page, vertical membership event poster, incorporating multiple slanted panels and sharp angular divisions, presenting a design aesthetic reminiscent of paper-cut collage and retro commercial posters. A large white trapezoidal panel is placed at the top center, containing an oversized black Chinese title: "VIP Membership" on the first line, "Initial Recruitment" on the second line, along with the year.{argument name="year" default="2026"} The title is integrated with a striking bright blue number. Four decorative icons/mascot elements are added to the left: a circular bear face logo within a yellow circle in the upper left corner, a blue and white clock icon below, a half-body black and white bear mascot wearing a blue scarf and raising one arm in the center left, and a cropped bear mascot face in the lower left corner. In the center of the left side, a tall red countdown panel is added, with the Chinese characters "Countdown Only" in white at the top, a large yellow number "1" in the middle, and a large white "天" (sky) character at the bottom. In the upper right corner, a large white price panel is placed, displaying the original price line "Original Price ¥2999/Year" (2999 with strikethrough), below which is the text "Final Price," and a large red price "¥1299/Year." Below this, a blue title bar labeled "Savings Guide" is created, dividing this area into three vertical discount columns labeled 1, 2, and 3. The first column displays "Instant Discount with Coupon" and a large blue "200," with a percentage-style coupon icon below. The second column displays "Further Discount for Group Buying" and a large red "1500," with three simplified character icons in blue, yellow, and red below. The third column displays "Get it when Group Formation" and a large red "¥730," with smaller black text "Exclusive Gift" and a gift box icon below. In the lower left corner, a white benefits panel with a blue label titled "Core Benefits" is added. Inside, two small rectangular avatar thumbnails are placed in the upper left corner, and three lines of text are listed on the right: "AI × Family Education × Meta-Learning," with the blue highlighted name "howie" followed by black Chinese description text, and the red highlighted name "savage" followed by black Chinese description text. Below this text is a list of four lines of benefits marked with small blue icons: "Year-round live streaming support, unlimited replays for members," "Member-exclusive transcript + Level 3 notes," "All-in-One AI Knowledge Base 24/7 Q&A," and "Free family account for learning with teammates." A black horizontal bar is created at the bottom center, containing white text: "AI Insider 1 Year (¥365) + Physical Gift Package (¥365)." Below this bar, three product images are displayed side-by-side: a magazine-style booklet cover, an orange notebook/book cover, and a blue book cover, with two small circular mascot badges next to the products. At the bottom center, a large blue call to action panel features the prominent white Chinese text "Scan to join the group purchase now" and a yellow subtitle "— Lock in the launch price—," followed by a smaller line of white and yellow text: "Average daily cost of ¥3.55, unlock the whole family's AI learning power!" A black and white QR code within a white box is added in the lower right corner. At the very bottom, create two footer bars: a blue bar on the left with a shield icon and the white text "Price Guarantee: 180-day price drop refund"; and a red bar on the right with a card/payment icon and the white text "Easy Payment: Alipay 12-month interest-free installments." Use extremely bold sans-serif Chinese fonts, exaggerated proportional contrast, dynamic asymmetrical composition, and overlapping panels to create a vibrant social media marketing poster feel.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张风格大胆的中文促销海报，采用蒙德里安、野兽派与立体主义相结合的混乱图形风格，配以粗黑轮廓线、不规则几何色块，以及红、蓝、黄、白、黑的高对比度配色。布局为紧凑的单页纵向会员活动海报，包含多个倾斜面板和锐利的角形分割，呈现出剪纸拼贴和复古商业海报的设计感。在顶部中心放置一个巨大的白色梯形面板，内含超大黑色中文标题：第一行“大会员”，第二行“首次招募”，并将年份 {argument name="year" default="2026"} 以醒目的亮蓝色大数字融入标题中。在左侧加入 4 个装饰性图标/吉祥物元素：左上角一个黄色圆圈内的圆形熊脸 Logo，下方一个蓝白相间的时钟图标，左中位置一个戴着蓝色围巾、举起一只手臂的半身黑白熊吉祥物，以及左下角一个裁剪过的熊吉祥物脸部。在左侧中心，添加一个高大的红色倒计时面板，顶部写有白色中文“倒计时仅剩”，中间是一个巨大的黄色数字“1”，底部是一个大号白色“天”字。在右上角，放置一个大型白色价格面板，显示原价行“原价 ¥2999/年”（2999 带有删除线），下方显示“到手价”字样，以及巨大的红色价格“¥1299/年”。在其下方，创建一个标有“省钱攻略”的蓝色标题条，并将该区域分为 3 个垂直优惠栏，分别标注为 1、2 和 3。第 1 栏显示“领券立减”及一个巨大的蓝色“200”数字，下方配有百分号样式的优惠券图标。第 2 栏显示“拼团再减”及一个巨大的红色“1500”数字，下方配有三个蓝、黄、红色的简化人物图标。第 3 栏显示“成团即得”及一个巨大的红色“¥730”数字，下方配有较小的黑色文字“专属赠礼”及一个礼盒图标。在左下角，添加一个带有蓝色标签标题“核心权益”的白色权益面板。内部左上方放置 2 个小型矩形头像缩略图，右侧列出 3 行文字：“AI × 家庭教育 × 元学习”，蓝色高亮名称“howie”后跟黑色中文描述文字，以及红色高亮名称“savage”后跟黑色中文描述文字。在这些文字下方，包含 4 行带有蓝色小图标的权益列表：“全年直播陪伴，会员无限期回看”、“会员专享逐字稿 + 三级笔记”、“All in One AI 知识库 24*7 答疑”以及“免费送一个家庭账号，和队友一起学”。在底部中间横跨处，创建一个黑色水平条，内含白色文字：“AI 内参 1 年（¥365） + 实物大礼包（¥365）”。在该条下方，并排展示 3 个产品图：1 本杂志风格的小册子封面、1 本橙色笔记本/书本封面和 1 本蓝色书本封面，产品旁还有 2 个小型圆形吉祥物徽章。在底部中心，放置一个大型蓝色行动呼吁面板，配有醒目的白色中文“扫码立刻拼团”和黄色副标题“— 锁定首发价 —”，随后是一行较小的白黄相间文字：“平均每天 3.55，撬动全家 AI 学习力！”。在右下角，添加一个白色方框内的黑白二维码。在最底部，创建 2 个页脚栏：左侧为蓝色条，配有盾牌图标和白色文字“价保承诺：180 天降价立即退差价”；右侧为红色条，配有卡片/支付图标和白色文字“轻松支付：花呗 12 期分期免息”。使用极粗的无衬线中文字体、夸张的比例对比、动态非对称构图、重叠面板，营造出充满活力的社交媒体营销商业海报感。

templates.title: Mondrian-style Chinese promotional poster

titleLocalized.zh: 蒙德里安风格中文促销海报

templates.prompt: Create a bold Chinese promotional poster using Mondrian-style, Fauvist, and slightly Cubist graphic design, featuring thick black grid lines, flat primary color blocks, and a clean white background. This vertical mobile poster boasts a highly structured layout, retail advertising aesthetics, high contrast, and sharp, vector-like edges. The design is playful yet strongly sales-oriented. The top center title area is a large white panel with the striking black Chinese characters "VIP Membership 2026 First Recruitment," and a yellow circular badge in the upper right corner containing a simple black cartoon bear face icon. The upper left corner contains three abstract rectangular blocks in a Mondrian composition: a red square, a white rectangle, and a blue vertical rectangle. A tall countdown bar is created on the left, with the red title "Countdown" at the top, a large, thick-edged red number "1" in the center, a red "天" (sky) character near the bottom, and yellow text "Expiration Price Restored to Original Price" within a black stripe at the bottom. The main pricing panel on the right displays the small black text "Original Price ¥2999/Year" with a strikethrough, followed by larger black text "Final Price," and a huge red price "¥1299," then black "/Year." Below this is a smaller black formula: "= ¥200 off with coupon + ¥1500 off with group purchase + Gift worth ¥730." Below this is a full-width blue section labeled "Money-Saving Guide." Below this, a three-column money-saving guide is constructed, containing three numbered panels: Panel 1 has a blue corner mark "1" with the text "Get a coupon for an instant discount of ¥200", a blue button-like strip "Scan to get a coupon", smaller text below "Get the coupon first, then join the group purchase", and a black and white QR code; Panel 2 has a yellow corner mark "2" with the text "Join the group purchase and get an additional ¥1500 off", and a small book or magazine cover thumbnail at the bottom; Panel 3 has a red corner mark "3" with the text "Get a ¥730 exclusive gift upon forming a group", smaller text below "AI Insider 1 Year (¥365)" and "Physical Gift Pack (¥365)", and two small gift thumbnails at the bottom. A white strip is added below the three columns with bold black text: "An average of ¥3.55 per day, unlocking the whole family's AI learning power!" In the lower middle section, on the left, there are two host/personal profile blocks: the first displays a square avatar, the blue name "howie", and the black text "Navigator" plus "Equipping AI with New Skills" and "Demanding Value from AI Systems"; the second displays a square avatar, the orange-red name "savage", and the black text "Take You" plus "Cultivating Intrinsic Motivation" and "Building a Learning Family Together". To the right of these data blocks, create a list of benefits arranged horizontally in four rows. Each row has a colored icon on the left and black text on a white background on the right: The first row uses a blue TV or screen icon, with text about year-round live streaming support, replay access, transcripts, notes, and 24/7 AI knowledge support; the second row uses a yellow book icon, with text about 10 years of in-depth experience, learning OS, becoming OS, reading OS, variable OS, and parenting OS, all within the AI ​​knowledge base, and providing long-term Q&A guidance; the third row uses a blue person icon, with text about member communities, practical exchanges, group communities, and 1-on-1 consultations; the fourth row uses a red person icon, with text about free family accounts for teammates to learn together. Near the bottom, a yellow panel is added on the left, containing a waving, all-black cartoon bear mascot. A striking blue call to action, "Scan the code to join a group purchase now," is placed in the center of the bottom, with a black decorative line and the subtitle "Lock in the initial price" below. A large black and white QR code is placed in the lower right corner. Finally, the bottom bar is divided into two colored areas: the blue area on the left features a white shield icon and the white text "Price Guarantee: 180-day price drop refund"; the red area on the right features a white card/payment icon and the white text "Easy Payment: Alipay 12-month interest-free installments". Each section is surrounded by a thick black border, asymmetrical geometric composition, minimalist shadows, poster-level typography hierarchy, and Chinese e-commerce campaign design, making it vibrant and colorful.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张大胆的中文促销海报，采用蒙德里安风格、野兽派及轻微立体主义的图形设计，配以粗黑网格线、平涂原色块和简洁的白色背景。竖版手机海报，布局高度结构化，具备零售广告美感，高对比度，边缘清晰如矢量图，设计风格俏皮且具有强烈的销售导向。顶部中央的标题区为一个白色大面板，内有醒目的黑色中文大字“大会员 2026 首次招募”，右上角设有一个黄色圆形徽章，内含简单的黑色卡通熊脸图标。左上角包含 3 个抽象矩形块，采用蒙德里安式构图：一个红色正方形、一个白色矩形和一个蓝色竖矩形。左侧创建一个高大的倒计时栏，顶部为红色标题“倒计时”，中央是一个巨大的粗边红色数字“1”，底部附近有一个红色“天”字，底部黑色条纹内有黄色文字“过期恢复原价”。右侧主定价面板中，显示黑色小字“原价 ¥2999/年”并带有删除线，随后是较大的黑色文字“到手价”，以及超大的红色价格“¥1299”，后跟黑色“/年”，下方有一行较小的黑色公式：“= 领券立减 200 + 拼团立省 1500 + 赠礼价值 730”。在此下方，放置一个全宽蓝色分区栏，标注为“省钱攻略”。在其下方，构建一个 3 列省钱指南，包含 3 个编号面板：面板 1 有蓝色角标“1”，文字“领券立减 200”，一个蓝色按钮状条带“扫码领券”，下方小字“先领券，再拼团”，以及一个黑白二维码；面板 2 有黄色角标“2”，文字“拼团再减 1500”，底部有一个小型书籍或杂志封面缩略图；面板 3 有红色角标“3”，文字“成团即得 ¥730 专属赠礼”，下方小字“AI 内参 1 年（¥365）”和“实物大礼包（¥365）”，底部有 2 个小型礼品缩略图。在 3 列下方添加一个白色条带，配以粗体黑字：“平均每天 3.55，撬动全家 AI 学习力！”。在中下部，左侧放置 2 个主持人/个人资料块：第一个显示方形头像，蓝色名字“howie”，以及黑色小字“领航”加“武装 AI 新技能”和“向 AI 系统要价值”；第二个显示方形头像，橙红色名字“savage”，以及黑色小字“带你”加“培养内驱力”和“共建学习型家庭”。在这些资料块右侧，创建一个包含 4 行水平排列的权益列表，每行左侧配有彩色图标，右侧为白底黑字：第 1 行使用蓝色电视或屏幕图标，文字内容关于全年直播陪伴、回放权限、逐字稿、笔记及 24×7 AI 知识支持；第 2 行使用黄色书籍图标，文字内容关于 10 年深度经验、学习 OS、成为 OS、阅读 OS、变量 OS、育儿 OS，全在 AI 知识库中，并提供长期问答指导；第 3 行使用蓝色人物图标，文字内容关于会员社群、实战交流、小组社区及 1 对 1 咨询；第 4 行使用红色人物图标，文字内容关于免费家庭账号，可供队友共同学习。底部附近，左侧添加一个黄色面板，内有挥手的全身黑色卡通熊吉祥物。底部中央放置一行醒目的蓝色行动号召文字“扫码立刻拼团”，下方配有黑色装饰短线及副标题“锁定首发价”。右下角放置一个大型黑白二维码。最后，底部栏分为 2 个彩色区域：左侧蓝色区域配有白色盾牌图标及白色文字“价保承诺：180 天降价立即退差价”；右侧红色区域配有白色卡片/支付图标及白色文字“轻松支付：花呗 12 期分期免息”。每个区块周围使用粗黑边框，不对称几何构图，极简阴影，海报级排版层级，中文电商活动设计，充满活力且色彩丰富。

templates.title: Q-version dinosaur museum 3D model

titleLocalized.zh: Q 版恐龙博物馆立体模型

templates.prompt: This is a highly detailed, warm, and fantastical isometric view of the interior of a two-story dinosaur museum, teeming with cute, cartoon-style children and fossil exhibits. The scene presents a handcrafted, miniature model-like quality, featuring toy-like figures with bright, sparkling eyes, round faces, and exquisite wooden and brass museum furniture. The scene is presented from a high, cornered, bird's-eye view, revealing the bustling central hall where exhibits and visitors are arranged in a pleasingly staggered manner. The scene includes approximately 52 cute, cartoon-style children scattered throughout the museum; both the upper balcony and the lower hall are very crowded. Each child is dressed as a little explorer, wearing brightly colored casual wear, backpacks, hats, jackets, shorts, and sneakers, many carrying guidebooks or brochures. The overall atmosphere is cheerful and adventurous, with golden ambient lighting from hanging lamps, polished wooden railings, a staircase on the left, tiled stone floors, framed dinosaur posters on the walls, educational signs, specimen cabinets, bookshelves, plants, and gift shop-style display tables. The exhibits prominently feature six large, clearly visible dinosaur skeletons: a dominant Tyrannosaurus Rex skeleton with its mouth wide open on the upper right; a medium-sized theropod skeleton in the lower right pit; a Triceratops skull and partial skeleton on the lower right; a partial skeleton of a long-necked dinosaur arranged vertically along the lower left edge; a large fossil skull in the lower central foreground; and a small fossil or turtle-like specimen on a wooden cabinet at the lower right corner. In addition, there are five glass display cases or tabletop specimen exhibits: a central rectangular butterfly or insect specimen table in the lower center; a glass-topped fossil case to the left of the center; a smaller blue tabletop specimen case near the left center; a slanted educational control panel or fossil information display stand next to the dinosaur pits; and an additional display table integrated into the lower right work area. Numerous smaller fossil trays, bones, rocks, and excavation samples are added to the counters and floor exhibits. The building structure should include two visible floors: an upper mezzanine balcony surrounding the rear and right sides, and an open lower exhibition space. A staircase leads to the balcony on the left. On the upper wall, several framed dinosaur posters and museum exhibits were displayed, including a prominent poster that read:{argument name="poster title" default="DINOSAURS"} Add an emergency exit sign above the back door. Use a rich color palette, including honey-brown wood, beige fossils, cyan and blue exhibit graphics, and touches of red, yellow, and green on the children's clothing. The overall atmosphere is one of playful exploration, a blend of a children's science museum and a collector's model world, with high scene density, sharp focus, rich detail, cinematic depth of field, and the realistic feel of high-quality picture book miniatures. There are no adults, no blank spaces, no modern minimalism; every part of the image should be filled with captivating museum activities.

promptLocalized.zh:
这是一个高度精细、温暖且充满奇幻色彩的等轴测视角双层恐龙博物馆内景，挤满了 Q 版动漫儿童和化石展品。画面呈现出手工制作的微缩模型质感，带有玩具般的人偶、闪亮的大眼睛、圆润的脸庞以及精致的木质与黄铜材质博物馆家具。场景采用高处转角俯视视角，可以看到繁忙的中央大厅，展示品和游客摆放得错落有致。场景中包含约 52 名散布在博物馆各处的 Q 版儿童，上层阳台和底层大厅都非常拥挤，每个孩子都打扮成小小探险家的模样，穿着色彩鲜艳的休闲装，背着背包，戴着帽子，穿着夹克、短裤和运动鞋，许多人手里还拿着导览手册或宣传册。整体氛围欢快且充满冒险气息，金色的环境光来自悬挂的小灯，配有抛光的木质栏杆、左侧的楼梯、瓷砖石地板、墙上装裱的恐龙海报、教育标识、标本柜、书架、植物以及礼品店风格的展示桌。

重点展示 6 个清晰可见的大型恐龙骨架展品：右侧上层是一具张开大嘴、占据主导地位的大型霸王龙骨架；中央右侧底层展坑内是一具中型兽脚类恐龙骨架；右下方是一个三角龙颅骨及部分骨架展示；左下边缘垂直排列着一具长颈恐龙的部分骨架；下方中央前景处是一个大型化石颅骨展示；右下角尽头的木柜上是一个小型化石或类似海龟的标本。此外，还包括 5 个玻璃展示柜或桌面标本展品：下方中间是一个中央长方形蝴蝶或昆虫标本桌，中心左侧是一个玻璃顶化石柜，中左侧附近是一个较小的蓝色台面标本柜，恐龙展坑旁是一个倾斜的教育控制面板或化石信息展台，右下方工作区还集成了一个额外的展示桌。在柜台和地面展品上，添加许多较小的化石托盘、骨头、岩石和挖掘样本。

建筑结构应包含 2 个可见楼层：一个环绕后侧和右侧的上层夹层阳台，以及下方开放式的底层展览空间。左侧设有一道通往阳台的楼梯。在上层墙壁上，放置几张装裱好的恐龙海报和博物馆项目，其中包括一张醒目的海报，上面写着 {argument name="poster title" default="DINOSAURS"}。在后门上方添加一个紧急出口标志。使用丰富的色调，包括蜂蜜棕色的木材、米色的化石、青色和蓝色的展览图形，以及孩子们服装上点缀的红色、黄色和绿色。整体氛围是充满童趣的探索感，仿佛儿童科学博物馆与收藏家模型世界的结合，具有极高的场景密度、清晰的焦点、丰富的细节、电影般的景深以及高级的绘本微缩模型写实感。画面中没有成人，没有留白，没有现代极简主义；画面的每一处都应充满迷人的博物馆活动。

templates.title: Richard Feynman Psionic Trading Card

titleLocalized.zh: 理查德·费曼 (Richard Feynman) 灵能交易卡

templates.prompt: A well-crafted parody trading card, featuring classic Pokémon card art.{argument name="character name" default="Richard Feynman"} The theme is [theme missing]. The cards feature a vertical layout with a thick, metallic gold border, rounded corners, a glossy collectible finish, and a densely printed card UI. A silver capsule label in the upper left corner reads "BASIC." The top features the prominent, bold black name "[name missing]".{argument name="character name" default="Richard Feynman"} (with a white outline), below which is a silver banner with the subtitle "{argument name="subtitle" default="theoretical physicist"} The upper right corner displays "HP 120," next to a purple psychic eye icon. The main illustration is a dramatic, realistic portrait of Richard Feynman, a half-length portrait, wearing a slightly wrinkled white short-sleeved shirt, a pen in his breast pocket, with curly dark hair, and lively gestures, as if explaining physics; his face is obscured by a simple rectangular blur. The background is visually divided into two parts: on the left is a dark blackboard filled with handwritten physical equations and symbols, including Lagrange quantities, psi symbols, summation symbols, and small Feynman diagram sketches; a line of white chalk quotes on the blackboard reads: "The Universe is made of atoms, but atoms are made of stories. – R. Feynman." The lower left corner of the frame shows a stack of books with an atomic badge and a black and gold medallion that reads "LEGEND." The right side of the frame depicts a vibrant cosmic scene with glowing particles, orbital paths, spirals, coiled charges, and swirling blue, purple, gold, and orange glowing galaxies. The lower right corner of the illustration features a white mug with the text "There's..." printed on it. "Plenty of Room at the Bottom." Below the portrait is a narrow silver data bar that reads "NO. 1918 Theoretical Physicist HT: 5'6" WT: 135 lbs." The lower half of the card features a holographic purple-blue nebula background with a card text panel. First, there's a red gradient pill-shaped label that reads "Ability," followed by a large purple title:{argument name="ability name" default="Path integral intuition"} The right side features a purple Psionic Eye icon. Below is the rule text in small black text: "During your turn, you may look at the top 4 cards of your deck and put them back in any order. Then you may draw a card. This ability represents Feynman's masterful ability to see multiple possibilities and choose an elegant path." Below are two attack abilities. Attack 1 has 3 cost icons: 2 purple Psionic Eye icons and 1 colorless star icon; the title is "Feynman Diagram," and the damage on the right is "60+"; the text reads: "For each different retreat cost type of your opponent's active Pokémon, this attack gains 60 damage." Attack 2 also has 3 cost icons: 2 purple Psionic Eye icons and 1 colorless star icon; the title is "There's Plenty of Room," and the damage on the right is "100"; the text reads: "Search for a Basic Energy card from your deck and attach it to 1 of your Standby Pokémon. Then, shuffle." Near the bottom is an italicized quote: "I would rather have questions that can't be answered than answers that can't be questioned." – Richard Feynman. The bottom status bar contains three clearly marked sections: Weakness (blue teardrop icon, "×2"), Resistance (dark shield icon, "-30"), and Retreat (two colorless star icons). The lower left corner features tiny printed text "Illus. Ben Wootten" and the card number "002/150," next to a small star rarity symbol. The lower right corner contains a small black silhouette of a standing man. Overall style: high-end fan-made scientist trading cards, retro TCG typography, portrait realism, holographic galaxy foil texture, clear printed text, and playful crossover design.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张制作精良的恶搞交易卡，采用经典 Pokémon 卡牌风格，以 {argument name="character name" default="理查德·费曼"} 为主题。卡牌采用垂直布局，配有厚实的金属金色边框、圆角设计、光面收藏质感以及密集的印刷卡牌 UI。左上角有一个银色胶囊标签，写着“BASIC”。顶部是醒目的黑色粗体名称“{argument name="character name" default="理查德·费曼"}”（带白色描边），下方是一个银色横幅副标题，写着“{argument name="subtitle" default="理论物理学家"}”。右上角显示“HP 120”，旁边是一个紫色的灵能之眼图标。主插画是理查德·费曼的戏剧性写实肖像，半身像，身穿略显褶皱的白色短袖衬衫，胸前口袋插着钢笔，留着卷曲的深色头发，手势生动，仿佛正在讲解物理学；他的面部被一个简单的矩形模糊块遮挡。背景在视觉上分为两部分：左侧是一块深色黑板，写满了手写的物理方程和符号，包括拉格朗日量、psi 符号、求和符号以及小的费曼图草图；黑板上还有一行白色粉笔字引语：“The Universe is made of atoms, but atoms are made of stories. – R. Feynman”。艺术框左下角是一叠书，上面有一个原子徽章和一个写着“LEGEND”的黑金勋章。艺术框右侧是一个充满活力的宇宙场景，有发光的粒子、轨道路径、螺旋、电荷卷曲以及蓝色、紫色、金色和橙色的发光星系漩涡。插画右下角放着一个白色马克杯，上面印有文字“There's Plenty of Room at the Bottom”。肖像下方是一条窄窄的银色数据条，写着“NO. 1918 Theoretical Physicist HT: 5’6” WT: 135 lbs.”。卡牌下半部分是全息紫蓝色星云背景，配有卡牌文本面板。首先是一个红色渐变药丸状标签，写着“Ability”，随后是紫色大字标题：“{argument name="ability name" default="路径积分直觉"}”，右侧配有一个紫色灵能之眼图标。下方是黑色小字规则文本：“在你的回合中，你可以查看卡组顶部的 4 张卡牌，并以任意顺序放回。然后，你可以抽一张牌。此技能代表了费曼洞察多种可能性并选择优雅路径的精湛能力。”下方是 2 个攻击技能。攻击 1 有 3 个消耗图标：2 个紫色灵能之眼图标和 1 个无色星形图标；标题为“费曼图”，右侧伤害为“60+”；正文：“对手的活跃 Pokémon 每有一种不同的撤退消耗类型，此攻击增加 60 点伤害。”攻击 2 有 3 个消耗图标：2 个紫色灵能之眼图标和 1 个无色星形图标；标题为“There’s Plenty of Room”，右侧伤害为“100”；正文：“从你的卡组中搜索一张基础能量卡，并将其附着在你的 1 只备战 Pokémon 上。然后，洗牌。”底部附近有一句斜体风味引语：“I would rather have questions that can’t be answered than answers that can’t be questioned.” – 理查德·费曼。底部状态栏包含 3 个明确标注的部分：弱点（蓝色水滴图标，“×2”）、抗性（深色盾牌图标，“-30”）和撤退（2 个无色星形图标）。左下角有微小的印刷字“Illus. Ben Wootten”和卡牌编号“002/150”，旁边有一个小星星稀有度符号。右下角包含一个站立男子的黑色小剪影。整体风格：高端粉丝自制科学家交易卡、怀旧 TCG 排版、肖像画写实主义、全息星系箔质感、清晰的印刷文本以及趣味十足的跨界设计。

templates.title: Place the character in a classical portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 将角色置入古典肖像

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, replace the male figure in the original image with the designated character, while maintaining the same pose, composition, and realistic photographic style. Transform the scene into an outdoor historical backdrop with a shallow depth of field forest or garden background. Dress the character in exquisite 18th-century dark aristocratic attire: a tricorn hat, an embroidered long coat, a fitted waistcoat with buttons, a high-necked scarf, and two white ruffled cuffs. Keep the character centered and imposing, use cinematic lighting, a softly blurred background, and include a distant, blurred figure on the right side.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图像，将原图中的男性替换为指定角色，同时保持相同的站姿、构图和写实的摄影风格。将场景转换为户外历史背景，并配以浅景深的森林或花园背景。为角色穿上精致的 18 世纪深色贵族服饰：1 顶三角帽、1 件刺绣长外套、1 件带有排扣的合身马甲、1 条高领领巾以及 2 只白色荷叶边袖口。保持角色居中且充满气场，运用电影级布光，背景需柔和虚化，并在右侧包含 1 个远处的模糊身影。

templates.title: Mixed Reality Cafe Illustration

titleLocalized.zh: 混合现实咖啡馆插画

templates.prompt: {argument name="subject" default="A fashionable young woman"} She sat at a table in an outdoor cafe, holding a hot coffee cup to her lips. She had short, curly black hair and wore {argument name="accessory" default="Oversized tinted sunglasses"} She wore a beige cropped sweater, loose brown high-waisted trousers, and chunky white sneakers. A tote bag with a minimalist coffee-themed illustration slung over her shoulder. The scene combined realistic photography with {argument name="overlay style" default="Fun 2D Cartoon Overlay"} Combined. Animated coffee elements float around her: a smiling cappuccino cup with heart-shaped latte art, cute coffee beans with tiny faces, and caramel splatters forming cartoon-style shapes. Soft graffiti-like steam rises, transforming into hearts and stars. On the table are: a croissant, a notebook with sketches, and a second coffee cup. Background: A realistic, cozy café street with brick walls, plants, warm golden hour light, and soft shadows. Slight depth-of-field effect, with the subject clearly in focus. Style: A fusion of realism and vibrant cartoon illustration, pop art aesthetics, high saturation but warm tones, simple composition, suitable for Instagram posts, soft halo, and 4K detail.

promptLocalized.zh:
{argument name="subject" default="一位时髦的年轻女性"} 坐在户外咖啡馆的桌旁，手持热咖啡杯靠近唇边。她留着黑色短卷发，戴着 {argument name="accessory" default="超大号有色墨镜"}，身穿米色短款毛衣、宽松棕色高腰裤和厚底白色运动鞋。肩上挎着一个印有极简咖啡主题插画的托特包。

场景将写实摄影与 {argument name="overlay style" default="趣味 2D 卡通叠加"} 相结合。她周围漂浮着动画咖啡元素：带有心形拉花的微笑卡布奇诺杯、长着小脸的可爱咖啡豆，以及形成漫画风格形状的焦糖飞溅。柔和的涂鸦蒸汽升腾，化作心形和星星。

桌上摆放着：一个羊角面包、一本带有素描画的笔记本，以及第二个咖啡杯。

背景：写实舒适的咖啡馆街道，有砖墙、植物、温暖的黄金时刻光线和柔和的阴影。轻微的景深效果，主体清晰对焦。

风格：写实主义与活力卡通插画的融合，波普艺术美学，高饱和度但色调温暖，构图简洁，适合 Instagram 发布，柔和光晕，4k 细节。

Accessory Layout: Carefully arrange [ACCESSORY 1], [ACCESSORY 2], [ALT VERSION], [PACKAGING FEATURE], and [LIMITED EDITION DETAIL] around the figure. templates.title: Luxury skincare advertising projects

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华护肤品广告项目

templates.prompt: An infographic for a cinematic luxury skincare campaign featuring a glycolic acid exfoliating serum. Layout: 16 panels arranged in a clean 4x4 grid, each panel showcasing a progressive skincare routine and transformation sequence. Subject: A modern young woman with clear, radiant skin, natural makeup, and a soft, minimalist aesthetic, holding and using a high-end glass dropper-sized bottle of glycolic acid serum. Style: High-end skincare advertising campaign, minimalist dermatological aesthetics, soft cinematic lighting, white marble background with soft tones, high-end editorial beauty photography style, realistic illustrations with a delicate, luminous, and smooth skin texture. Sequence (Visual Evolution Between Panels): 1. Close-up of the luxurious serum bottle on a marble countertop. 2. Close-up of the glass bottle and label. 3. Using a dropper to dispense the serum. 4. Serum on fingertips. 5. Gently applied to the face. 6. Close-up of the serum absorption process. 7. Smooth skin texture. 8. Subtle contrast and transition hints. 9. Initial signs of radiant skin. 10. A mirror scene in the skincare routine. 11. A minimalist aesthetic reminiscent of a dermatology clinic. 12. Focus on hydration and enhanced radiance. 13. Close-up of a portrait of a person with healthy, radiant skin. 14. Sunlight reflecting on smooth skin. 15. High-end product makeup photography with a luminous finish. 16. Final main visual: Serum bottle + model with radiant skin. Design: Clean grid division, simple and elegant numbering 1–16, thin lines between panels, soft arrows indicating the flow of the process, exquisite editing and layout, balanced composition. Top heading: "GLYCOLIC ACID – 16 STEP SKIN TRANSFORMATION"

promptLocalized.zh:
一份用于乙醇酸去角质精华液的电影级奢华护肤广告项目信息图。布局：16 个面板以整洁的 4x4 网格排列，每个面板展示渐进式的护肤流程和蜕变序列。

主体：一位皮肤清透、散发光泽的现代年轻女性，妆容自然，呈现柔和简约的美学风格，手持并使用一瓶高端玻璃滴管装乙醇酸精华液。

风格：高端护肤广告项目，极致简洁的皮肤科美学，柔和的电影级光效，白色大理石与柔和色调背景，高端编辑类美妆摄影风格，带有细腻光泽与平滑肤质效果的写实插画。

序列（面板间的视觉演变）：

1. 大理石台面上的奢华精华液瓶身特写
2. 玻璃瓶与标签的近景
3. 滴管吸取精华液
4. 精华液滴在指尖
5. 温和涂抹于面部
6. 精华液吸收过程特写
7. 肤质平滑效果
8. 微妙的对比前后过渡暗示
9. 焕发光泽的初步显现

templates.title: Luxury skincare commercial photography

templates.prompt: A high-resolution commercial marketing photograph, featuring {argument name="model description" default="A young woman with long, smooth, dark hair, now styled in natural, slightly wavy curls."} She was wearing{argument name="outfit" default="Minimalist beige satin camisole"} Set against a clean, matte ivory-colored studio backdrop, the composition presents a luxurious "{argument name="product name" default="LumiSkin Vitamin C Serum"} The dropper bottle is prominently positioned in the foreground, held delicately to her chest with her fingers and tilted towards the camera to emphasize the product. Visual vibrancy is enhanced by bright orange graphic elements, including flowing liquid lines and circular halos, suggesting radiance and hydration. A suspended, semi-transparent label in a striking modern sans-serif font highlights key selling points such as "brightening and enhancing" and "24-hour hydration and radiance." Soft, directional lighting creates a gentle glow on the model's skin while crisp reflections on the glass serum bottle, emphasizing its premium feel. The serum inside is a rich amber color that shimmers in the light. A prominent headline in bright orange, "Why your skin loves it," is displayed in the upper left corner, adding contrast and visual depth. The overall aesthetic is clean, bright, and sophisticated. A shallow depth of field keeps the product and the model's confident, natural expression clearly in focus, while the smooth, blurred background creates a sophisticated, magazine-worthy look.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张高分辨率的商业营销摄影作品，主角为 {argument name="model description" default="一位留着柔顺深色长发、现呈现自然微卷造型的年轻女性"}。她身着 {argument name="outfit" default="极简米色缎面吊带"}，置身于干净的哑光象牙色摄影棚背景中。构图将一款奢华的“{argument name="product name" default="LumiSkin 维生素 C 精华液"}”滴管瓶置于前景显眼位置，她用手指轻巧地将其托在胸前，并向镜头倾斜以突出产品。

视觉活力通过鲜艳的橘色图形元素得到增强，包括流动的液体线条和圆形光晕元素，暗示着光泽与水润感。悬浮的半透明标注框以醒目的现代无衬线字体突出了“提亮增效”和“24 小时水润光泽”等核心卖点。

灯光柔和且具有方向性，在模特肌肤上营造出柔和的光泽，同时在玻璃精华瓶上形成清脆的反射光，强调其高端质感。瓶内的精华液呈浓郁的琥珀色，在光线下熠熠生辉。左上角有一行醒目的大标题：“Why your skin loves it”，采用亮橘色，增加了对比度和视觉层级。

整体美学风格干净、明亮且高端，浅景深效果使产品与模特自信自然的表情保持清晰对焦，而背景平滑虚化，呈现出精致的杂志大片质感。

templates.prompt: A hyper-realistic 8K cinematic portrait, taken and uploaded using a dramatic chiaroscuro style. The subject is seated in a three-quarter profile, leaning slightly forward, his posture relaxed yet dignified. His face is turned away from the camera, one side clearly illuminated while the other is completely shrouded in deep, velvety shadow. He appears thoughtful, not looking at the camera. The pose is precise: hands clasped in front of the chest; one hand extended, fingers slightly angled, the other hand resting on the first hand with only the fingers visible. He is wearing {argument name="accessories" default="A luxurious black chronograph watch, complete with an elegant metal bracelet, a silver ring, and a beaded bracelet."} He was wearing{argument name="clothing" default="A sharply tailored black suit jacket, worn over a white shirt with the collar slightly open."} The image showcases the exquisite texture of the fabric. stage opening— A wide-angle shot shows her alone on a huge, dark stage, with a rotating spotlight above— During the rotation, her skirt or clothing fabric wraps and freezes with her body's movement— A sudden, sharp freeze-frame, one arm outstretched, the other bent at a 90-degree angle as she glides— A side view showing her smoothly sliding/gliding on the ground, her body close to the ground in slow motion— Extremely close-up of a jump with hands moving slowly and gracefully in the air—full body leaping into the air, legs split, arms outstretched, landing at the highest point of the jump—powerful landing, kneeling on one knee, dust particles flying around—attitude—low-angle shot of her standing posture, chin slightly tucked, looking directly at the camera, an explosive burst of energy—the crowd in the background reacts, raising their hands in silhouette—final sequence—multiple exposures with a ghosting effect, showing three overlapping movement positions in the final eight beats—teammates/other dancers blur into the frame behind her, energy building to a climax—the final pose, fully extended, arms reaching towards the ceiling, head tilted back—unforgettable moment—wide-angle cinematic lens, spotlight beam, smoke/haze, text overlay displaying DANCE. Style references: cinematic sports feature, Adidas/Nike advertising aesthetics, dramatic contrast lighting, 85mm lens quality, 4K ultra-high definition. Characters remain consistent throughout all frames.

终章 — 完全伸展的最终姿势，双臂伸向天花板，头部后仰

Each print is accompanied by a styling description. ⑩ Style Archetypes — Single typographic panel. Style tagline font size enlarged (e.g., "Modern Romantic / Warm Classic"). Rendering specifications: Hyper-realistic, 8K, magazine-edited print quality, warm neutral tones, consistent soft diffused studio lighting across all panels, a serif title font + a fine sans-serif body font, no gradients, only a flat matte surface.

promptLocalized.zh:

以主体摄影棚肖像为核心 — 皮肤修饰至如玻璃般透亮，保留自然结构与真实的毛孔纹理，采用柔和的定向主光，不对面部进行任何改动。背景：带有细腻亚麻纹理的暖色羊皮纸。排版风格如同印在厚重哑光纸张上的《Vogue Italia》美容增刊。结构化编辑网格，3 列非对称布局，宽阔的留白，衬线体压缩标题，所有标签采用宽字间距大写，所有面板采用统一的暖象牙白/沙色/羊皮纸背景系统，超写实 8K 画质，柔和漫射摄影棚光线，平整优雅的表面，无投影。
面板：
① 色调诊断 — 从冷灰到暖琥珀的色调光谱条，主体读数的精密指针标记。标签：冷色 / 中性偏冷 / 中性 / 中性偏暖 / 暖色。精细标注文字。
② 季节性色彩调色板 — 10–12 个主体最佳季节的织物纹理色卡。每个色卡标注诗意的色彩名称和 HEX 值。分组：能量色 / 最柔和选项 / 协调中性色。
③ 避雷色彩 — 一排去饱和的冲突色调，带有精细的编辑删除线。呈现方式简洁且不刺眼。
④ 美妆图谱 — 眼影渐变粉末色卡 / 皮肤上的腮红试色条 / 从若有似无到大胆的唇色光谱 / 高光质感标注：香槟金、玫瑰金、珠光象牙白。
⑤ 发色光谱 — 弧形渐变条：基色、维度色、高光色、对比色。最佳选项处有金色括号标记。
⑥ 珠宝与金属指南 — 平铺编辑渲染图：黄金、玫瑰金、氧化银、铂金饰面，以及互补的宝石色调。极简造型。
⑦ 你的色彩穿搭 — 3–4 个编辑风格的 Lookbook 框架，主体穿着符合调色板的服装。风格标签：静奢风 / 休闲编辑风 / 晚宴气场。
⑧ 胶囊衣橱网格 — 服装平铺图：上装、下装、外套、鞋履、包袋 — 全部符合调色板。展示互搭性的协调线条。Net-a-Porter 编辑审美。
⑨ 印花与图案 — 4 个织物印花缩略图：微几何、色调抽象、经典条纹、花卉比例。每种印花配有一行造型说明。
⑩ 风格原型 — 单一排版面板。风格标识标题字号放大（例如：“现代浪漫 / 温暖古典”）。三个定义美学的词汇。四行编辑风格的衣橱哲学笔记。
渲染规格：超写实，8K，杂志编辑印刷质量，暖中性色调，所有面板保持一致的柔和漫射摄影棚光线，一种衬线标题字体 + 一种精细无衬线正文字体，无渐变，仅平整哑光表面。

templates.title: Mixed Reality Comic Style Conversion

titleLocalized.zh: 混合现实漫画风格转换

templates.prompt: Transform the subject of this image into a 4:5 mixed reality effect, with a completely realistic background, lifelike facial rendering, and bold {argument name="style" default="Cartoon costumes"} Hand-drawn comic book flame effects and playful cartoon companions. A live-action hybrid composition is used, maintaining the main subject as a clear identity anchor while presenting stylized elements as carefully designed overlays within a unified scene. Characters: Retain the subject's identifiable facial features, hairstyle, and beard texture (if present), then re-render the face with realistic AAA-grade structure, natural skin texture, and a clean blending approach. Ensure high brightness, low contrast, medium saturation, and low-sharpness detail. Dress the character in exaggerated cartoon costumes with simplified seams and graphic embellishments to make them appear deliberate rather than photographic. Add fun cartoon characters as visual aids, giving them lively contours, rounded shapes, and energetic poses, while maintaining the main subject as the primary visual focus. The body should maintain human realism, but clothing and accessories should have a comic book-style exaggeration and strong graphic personality. Face and Anatomy: Maintain the core facial proportions, expression logic, and similarity of the main subject, rendering with realistic but controllable blended facial details. Use natural eye depth and realistic skin texture, avoiding a plastic toy look or complete cartoonish distortion. The body should be in life-size proportions, with stylization focused on clothing, props, and surrounding cartoon elements. Environment: Redesign the exact same environment as a realistic scene with clear depth and natural perspective. Construct the scene as a mixed reality stage, clearly placing cartoonish flame illustrations, playful animated elements, and graphic energy bursts within a realistic space without disrupting spatial coherence. Maintain the credibility, structure, and physical presence of the background, integrating stylized elements as deliberately designed interventions. Rendering Workflow: Use a mixed reality rendering workflow, combining realistic environmental treatment with stylized 2D graphic overlays and mixed character compositing. Preserve realistic lighting and shadows on the face and background, then overlay cartoon clothing, cartoonish shapes, and illustrated flame forms through clear outline control and edge separation. The final product must present a polished, real-world composite feel with deliberate animation design language, neither purely cartoon rendering nor ordinary photographic. Color and Lighting: A realistic environmental tone is achieved using clean, low contrast and bright, cartoonish highlights. Shadows on the background and faces remain natural, while stylized clothing and effects possess a strong neon-like energy and high color separation.

promptLocalized.zh:
将此图像中的主体转换为 4:5 的混合现实转换效果，背景完全写实，面部渲染逼真，并结合大胆的 {argument name="style" default="卡通服饰"}、手绘漫画火焰特效以及俏皮的卡通同伴。采用真人混合构图，在保持主体作为清晰身份锚点的同时，使风格化元素在统一的场景中呈现为精心设计的叠加层。

角色：
保留主体可识别的面部特征、发型状态以及胡须纹理（若存在），然后以逼真的真人 AAA 级结构、自然的皮肤质感和干净的混合集成方式重新渲染面部。确保高亮度、低对比度、中等饱和度以及低锐度细节。为人物穿上夸张的卡通服装，采用简化的接缝和图形装饰，使其看起来是刻意设计的，而非拍摄出来的。添加有趣的卡通角色作为视觉辅助，赋予其生动的轮廓、圆润的形态和活泼的姿态，同时保持主体作为主要的视觉焦点。身体应保持人类的真实感，但服装和配饰应带有漫画式的夸张感和强烈的图形个性。

面部与解剖结构：
保持主体核心的面部比例、表情逻辑和相似度，以逼真但可控的混合面部细节进行渲染。使用自然的眼部深度和真实的皮肤质感，避免塑料玩具感或完全的漫画式扭曲。身体应呈现真人比例，风格化重点集中在服装、道具和周围的漫画元素上。

环境：
将完全相同的环境重新设计为具有清晰深度和自然透视的写实场景。将场景构建为一个混合现实舞台，漫画火焰绘图、俏皮的动画元素和图形能量爆发在不破坏空间连贯性的前提下，清晰地置于真实空间内。保持背景的可信度、结构感和物理存在感，并将风格化元素作为刻意设计的介入内容进行整合。

渲染流程：
使用混合现实渲染流程，将写实的环境处理与风格化的 2D 图形叠加及混合角色合成相结合。保留面部和背景的真人光影，然后通过清晰的轮廓控制和边缘分离，叠加卡通服装、漫画效果形状和插画火焰形态。最终成品必须呈现出一种经过打磨的真实世界合成感，带有刻意的动画设计语言，既非纯粹的卡通渲染，也非普通的照片。

色彩与光影：
在写实的环境基调下，使用干净的低对比度和明亮的漫画式高光表现。背景和面部的阴影保持自然，而风格化的服装和特效则带有强烈的霓虹般能量和高色度分离。

templates.title: Magnetic iron powder logo scene

titleLocalized.zh: 磁性铁粉 Logo 场景

templates.prompt: Will{argument name="logo source" default="Uploaded logo"} Transformed into a hyper-realistic scene, where the logo outline is {argument name="material" default="Iron powder"} Formed under the influence of a magnetic field. The logo must maintain its precise shape and proportions, appearing as if a magnet of the same shape as the logo (or hidden beneath the surface) is influencing the iron powder, causing it to naturally align into a recognizable shape. Material Details: Fine iron powder with a sharp, spiky, needle-like structure. Densely clustered along magnetic lines of force, forming the logo's outline. Density variation—thicker near the magnetic poles, gradually thinning outwards. Matte, deep metallic texture with subtle reflections. Physical Representation: The iron powder must follow a realistic magnetic field pattern—forming radiating and curved lines with spikes and ridges. Stronger attraction areas form thicker, raised clusters. Outer areas show a softer, more dispersed arrangement. Natural randomness and slight irregularity—no perfect edges. Some loose iron powder is scattered outside the main shape. Surface Interaction: Flat surfaces, such as {argument name="surface type" default="Lab bench, glass plate or matte black tray"} The iron powder rests on the surface, but bulges noticeably in areas affected by magnetism (creating a spiked texture). Fine dust and tiny particles surround it. Environment and People: A realistic classroom, science lab, or creative studio environment. Partially visible figures – hands moving magnets below or near the surface. A child or adult may be observing or interacting (adding emotional curiosity). Other subtle elements: out-of-focus notebooks, tools, or lab supplies. Lighting: Directional top lighting, creating shadows on the bulging iron powder. Subtle highlights on the metallic edges. Balanced natural or indoor lighting. Atmosphere: Curiosity. A sense of exploration. Both educational and visually satisfying. A quiet yet captivating moment. Camera and Composition: A close-up shot from above or slightly tilted. The logo is clearly visible through the arrangement of the iron powder. Hands or interactive elements are slightly off-center to enhance the narrative. Format: Aspect Ratio: Strict 4:5 portrait. No text overlay. Style: Hyperrealistic macro + environmental photography. Physically precise magnetic behavior. Cinematic yet grounded in solid realism.

promptLocalized.zh:
将 {argument name="logo source" default="上传的 logo"} 转换为一个超写实的场景，其中 Logo 轮廓由 {argument name="material" default="铁粉"} 在磁场反应下形成。Logo 必须保持其精确的形状和比例，看起来就像是一个形状与 Logo 相同的磁铁（或隐藏在表面下方）正在影响铁粉，使其自然地排列成可识别的形状。材质细节：
细小的铁粉，具有尖锐、刺状、针状的结构。
沿磁力线密集聚集，形成 Logo 轮廓。
密度变化 —— 磁极附近较厚，向外逐渐变薄。
哑光深金属质感，带有微妙的反光。

物理表现：
铁粉必须遵循真实的磁场模式 —— 形成尖刺和脊状的放射状及曲线线条。
较强的吸引区域形成更厚、隆起的簇状物。
外部区域显示出更柔和、更分散的排列。
自然的随机性和轻微的不规则性 —— 没有完美的边缘。
一些松散的铁粉散落在主体形状之外。

表面交互：
平坦表面，例如 {argument name="surface type" default="实验台、玻璃板或哑光黑色托盘"}。
铁粉静置于表面，但在受磁力影响的区域明显隆起（呈现尖刺质感）。
周围有细微的灰尘和微小颗粒。

环境与人物：
真实的教室、科学实验室或创意工作室环境。
部分可见的人物 —— 手部在表面下方或附近移动磁铁。
可能有一名儿童或成人正在观察或互动（增加情感上的好奇心）。
其他微妙元素：失焦的笔记本、工具或实验室用品。

光影：
定向顶光，使隆起的铁粉产生阴影。
金属边缘有微妙的高光。
平衡的自然光或室内光。

氛围：
好奇心。
探索感。
既具教育意义又在视觉上令人满足。
安静但引人入胜的时刻。

相机与构图：
俯视或略微倾斜的特写镜头。
通过铁粉排列清晰可见 Logo。
人手或互动部分略微偏离中心，以增强叙事感。

格式：
宽高比：严格 4:5 竖屏。
无文字覆盖。

风格：
超写实微距 + 环境摄影。
物理精确的磁性行为。
电影感且扎实的现实主义。

templates.title: High-end sportswear creator portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 高端运动风创作者肖像

templates.prompt: Based on the uploaded personal photo, generate a high-quality, realistic studio-style athletic portrait of the subject. The primary task is to preserve the subject's authentic identity. The face must be highly recognizable, including face shape, proportions, eyes, nose, lips, skin tone, and overall similarity. The generated result must clearly identify the same person, not someone else or a composite AI face. If the original photo's expression looks like a passport photo, a stiff, neutral expression, an awkward smile, or insufficient eye contact, do not retain it. Replace it with a refined athletic portrait expression: calm, confident, gentle yet serious, composed, restrained yet resolute. The eyes should look directly at the camera, with a firm and focused gaze, carrying subtle tension. The mouth should remain relaxed and closed, without showing teeth when smiling. The overall facial expression should convey confidence through restraint, self-discipline, and composure. Create a clean, healthy, feminine, athletic, and sophisticated creator portrait. templates.title: Thick application: Boulevard des Boulevards in Springtime, Paris

titleLocalized.zh: 厚涂法：巴黎春日林荫大道

templates.prompt: A Parisian street scene brimming with springtime charm, rendered in a richly textured impasto oil painting style. The perspective is at street level, extending along a sun-drenched boulevard. To the left are blooming cherry blossoms, and to the right, elegant cream-colored Haussmannian architecture. The sky is a vibrant, highly saturated blue, dotted with large, soft white clouds, and pink petals drift through the air, scattering across the sidewalk. The left side of the scene includes a black wrought-iron riverside railing and a tall, vintage streetlamp, while the right side reveals a bustling outdoor café terrace with awnings and seated customers. In the distance, at the end of the street, stands a magnificent, domed historical building. The scene depicts a vibrant mix of pedestrians in the warm weather, including two cyclists with their backs to the viewer in the foreground, and a woman in a flowing pink dress and sun hat strolling under the cherry blossoms. The overall atmosphere is bright, romantic, cheerful, and warm. Using heavy, clear palette knife strokes, high color saturation, sunlight and dappled shadows, highly expressive painting details, and expansive, cinematic compositions, the artist creates a picturesque Parisian spring scene.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅洋溢着春日气息的巴黎街景，采用质感丰富的厚涂油画风格。视角位于街道平面，沿着阳光明媚的林荫大道延伸，左侧是盛开的樱花树，右侧是优雅的奶油色奥斯曼风格建筑。天空呈现出饱和度极高的亮蓝色，点缀着大朵柔软的白云，粉色的花瓣在空气中飘落，散落在人行道上。画面左侧包含黑色铁艺河岸围栏和 1 盏高大的复古路灯，右侧是热闹的户外咖啡馆露台，配有遮阳篷和落座的顾客，远处的街道尽头矗立着一座宏伟的圆顶历史建筑。画面展现了温暖天气下熙熙攘攘的行人，包括前景中 2 位背向观众骑行的骑行者，以及 1 位身穿飘逸粉色长裙、戴着遮阳帽漫步在樱花树下的女士。整体氛围明亮、浪漫、欢快且充满暖意。运用厚重且清晰的调色刀笔触、高色彩饱和度、阳光与斑驳的阴影、极具表现力的绘画细节，以及宽广的电影级构图，营造出如诗如画的巴黎春日景象。

Warm amber light filters through many windows and into the shops, contrasting sharply with the cool twilight atmosphere. A canal extends along the bottom of the image, its deep, reflective surface reflecting the surrounding landscape. Stone steps descend to the waterline, and a narrow, railinged walkway meanders along the riverbank's curve. Near the lower right, two vending machines are located, with a bicycle on each of the left and right edges, and a small canal bridge on the far right. The shopfront is crammed with vertical Japanese-style signs and faded blue, red, cream, and turquoise exterior walls, displaying signs for "Yamashiro Shoten," "Tabako," "Panbecare," "Kubota," "Snack," "Trinoto," "Kyudo," "Wakami," and "Shokudo." Rooftop gardens, clotheslines, vines, flowerpots, small lanterns, curtains, posters, and worn handrails are added, filling every corner with a sense of life. templates.title: Eye-catching double cheeseburger advertisement poster

titleLocalized.zh: 醒目双层芝士汉堡广告海报

templates.prompt: A striking and visually impactful fast food advertisement poster is suitable for{argument name="brand name" default="McDonald's"} The design employs a dramatic, commercial food photography style. The layout is a single, vertical poster with a warm beige textured background, using the brand's red and yellow color scheme, complemented by vibrant paint splatters, flying debris, and glistening sauce droplets. The iconic red-and-yellow archway logo is placed in the upper left corner. The upper half of the poster features a large, bold, all-caps headline:{argument name="headline text" default="BITE INTO PERFECTION."} The first line uses black, and the second line uses vibrant red, slightly slanted and overlapping for maximum visual impact. Directly below, add a slanted yellow banner containing a black capital subtitle:{argument name="tagline text" default="DOUBLE THE CHEESE. DOUBLE THE CRAVING."} The main focus of the poster is a close-up of a double cheeseburger, positioned in the lower right corner and center: a glossy bun topped with sesame seeds, followed by orange cream sauce, chopped white onions, crisp lettuce, two thick, charcoal-grilled beef patties, and two layers of melted cheddar cheese, dramatically dripping from the patties to the sides, revealing the toasted bun at the bottom. Explosive splashes of red sauce and golden, cheese-like droplets are added to the back and surrounding area, creating a dynamic and enticing atmosphere. On the left is a black circular price tag with a rough yellow outline, displaying oversized yellow numbers.{argument name="price" default="₹179"} It is accompanied by a white rupee symbol. A bold, blocky, stacked product label is placed to the lower left of the hamburger, containing the following information:{argument name="product name" default="DOUBLE CHEESE STACK"} The design uses rectangular text blocks in a mix of red, black, and yellow, accompanied by a small curved arrow pointing towards a hamburger. A rounded yellow call-to-action button with the text "ORDER NOW →" is added to the bottom left corner. The bottom edge contains a red footer with small white text detailing the app and website, including "Available on app" and "mcdonalds.in". It employs ultra-refined food modeling, glossy highlights, crisp textures of patties and bread, dramatic studio lighting, shallow depth of field, commercial poster framing, and a sophisticated, enticing fast-food advertising aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张醒目且极具视觉冲击力的快餐广告海报，适用于 {argument name="brand name" default="McDonald's"}，采用戏剧性的商业食品摄影风格设计。布局为单张垂直海报，背景为暖米色纹理，采用红黄品牌配色，辅以充满活力的油漆飞溅、飞舞的碎屑和光泽感十足的酱汁水滴。左上角放置标志性的红底黄拱门方形 Logo。海报上半部分采用巨大的全大写粗体标题，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="BITE INTO PERFECTION."}，第一行使用黑色，第二行使用鲜艳的红色，略微倾斜并重叠以实现最大视觉冲击力。在其正下方，添加一个倾斜的黄色笔触横幅，内含黑色大写副标题：{argument name="tagline text" default="DOUBLE THE CHEESE. DOUBLE THE CRAVING."}。主体是位于海报右下角及中心位置的双层芝士汉堡特写镜头：顶部是带有芝麻的光泽面包，面包下层是橙色奶油酱、切碎的白洋葱、清脆的绿叶生菜、2 片厚实的炭烤牛肉饼，以及 2 层融化的切达芝士，芝士戏剧性地从两片肉饼上滴落至侧面，底部可见烘烤过的面包底。在汉堡后方及周围添加爆炸式的红色酱汁飞溅和金色的芝士状水滴，营造出动感与诱人的氛围。左侧包含一个带有粗糙黄色轮廓的黑色圆形价格标签，以超大号黄色数字显示 {argument name="price" default="₹179"}，并配有白色卢比符号。在汉堡左下方，放置一个粗体块状堆叠产品标签，内容为 {argument name="product name" default="DOUBLE CHEESE STACK"}，采用红、黑、黄混合的矩形文本块，并配有一个指向汉堡的小弯箭头。左下角添加一个圆角黄色行动呼吁按钮，文字为“ORDER NOW →”。底部边缘包含一个红色页脚栏，附有白色的小字应用和网站详情，包括“Available on app”和“mcdonalds.in”。使用超精细的食品造型、光泽高光、肉饼和面包的清晰纹理、戏剧性的影棚灯光、浅景深、商业海报构图以及高级诱人的快餐广告美学。

templates.title: Cute cartoon-style children playing on a fitness ball

titleLocalized.zh: Q 版儿童在健身球上玩耍

templates.prompt: This adorable chibi-style illustration depicts three children playing on a large exercise ball in a cozy living room on a rainy day. The central child in the foreground is holding a blue yoga ball, with messy medium-length black hair, large purple eyes, a slightly sleepy and pouting expression, wearing a black T-shirt and olive-colored overalls, barefoot, leaning forward with his arms resting on the ball. To the left, another child sits on a pink exercise ball, with short black hair tied in small low pigtails, wearing a white T-shirt with small black and red graphic logos, olive-colored overalls, barefoot, and with his hands on the ball. The face is rendered as a soft, square blur mask covering the entire face area. To the right, a child sits on a yellow exercise ball, with fluffy short blonde hair, bright orange eyes, a bright smile, and excitedly outstretched arms, wearing a white T-shirt with text printed on it.{argument name="shirt logo" default="AIFEK"} Wearing olive-green overalls and barefoot, the room features a warm, sunlit interior with a large window in the background, numerous lush green indoor plants, wooden shelves, framed plant wall art, plush toys including teddy bears and green frogs, colorful stacking toys, and interlocking, soft-toned foam mats. The room feels soft, safe, fun, and cozy, employing diffused sunlight, soft shadows, clean anime lines, soft painterly shading, glossy highlights on exercise balls, and an appealing chibi-style proportion with oversized heads and lively expressions. Bright, healthy colors and a refined modern anime illustration style are used.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张可爱的 Q 版动漫插画，描绘了 3 个小孩在雨天的温馨客厅里，在大型健身球上玩耍的室内场景。构图中心位于前景处的一个孩子，他正抱着一个蓝色瑜伽球，留着凌乱的中长黑发，有着大大的紫色眼睛，表情略带困倦和嘟嘴，身穿黑色 T 恤和橄榄色工装裤，赤着脚，身体前倾，双臂搭在球上。左侧放置 1 个孩子，坐在粉色健身球上，留着扎成小巧低双马尾的短黑发，身穿带有黑色和红色小图形标志的白色 T 恤，橄榄色工装裤，赤着脚，双手放在球上。将面部渲染为覆盖整个面部区域的柔和方形模糊遮罩。右侧放置 1 个孩子，坐在黄色健身球上，留着蓬松的金色短发，有着明亮的橙色眼睛，笑容灿烂，双臂兴奋地向外伸展，身穿白色 T 恤，上面印有文字 {argument name="shirt logo" default="AIFEK"}，橄榄色工装裤，赤着脚。使用温暖的阳光室内环境，背景有一扇大窗户，多盆郁郁葱葱的绿色室内植物，木质搁架，带框的植物墙面艺术，包括泰迪熊和绿色青蛙在内的毛绒玩具，色彩缤纷的堆叠玩具，以及互锁的柔和色调泡沫地垫。让房间感觉柔和、安全、充满乐趣且温馨，采用漫射日光、柔和阴影、干净利落的动漫线条、柔和的绘画式阴影、健身球上的光泽高光，以及具有超大头部和生动表情的极具吸引力的 Q 版比例。使用明亮、健康的色调和精致的现代动漫插画风格。

templates.title: Cyberpunk pixel art: close-up kissing

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克点阵艺术：近距离亲吻

templates.prompt: A close-up digital illustration in a vertical format depicts two women leaning close together in an intimate moment, about to kiss, in a futuristic neon-lit city at night. The entire image is composed of thousands of glowing, colorful dots, presenting a rich pointillist style. The woman on the left has {argument name="hair color" default="Dark black"} Her hair was casually styled into a messy bun, with a few strands falling beside her cheeks; her shoulders were bare, adorned with delicate, semi-transparent fin-shaped earrings, resembling small bat wings or fantastical fish gills, their edges outlined with pale pink and blue light. The woman on the right had {argument name="second hair color" default="black"} Her hair is styled in a short, mohawk cut with the sides shaved, and her long hair is pulled back. Multiple earrings adorn her exposed ears, and she wears a dark, futuristic sleeveless jacket with straps and metallic details. The two figures are close together, their lips almost touching, creating a sensual cyberpunk atmosphere. Electric blue, cyan, indigo, violet, magenta, and soft peach skin tones are used, with variations in pixel size and brightness to outline contours, shadows, and highlights. The background showcases a blurred neon cityscape, including three vertically glowing signs and skyscraper lights, all composed of tiny, luminous dots. The painting emphasizes a melancholic nightlife atmosphere, soft rim lighting, shallow depth of field, intricate dotted textures, and a mosaic-like effect, as if the entire scene were constructed from bioluminescent pixels. Style: High-detail cyberpunk pointillist portrait, dreamlike, romantic, immersive, and cinematic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张竖构图的近景数字插画，描绘了两位女性在夜晚的未来派霓虹城市中侧身靠近、即将亲吻的亲密瞬间。整幅画面完全由成千上万个发光的彩色点阵构成，呈现出浓郁的点彩画风格。左侧女性留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深黑色"} 的头发，随意地盘成凌乱的发髻，几缕发丝散落在脸颊旁；她裸露着双肩，佩戴着精致且半透明的鳍状耳饰，形状如同小蝙蝠翅膀或奇幻鱼鳃，边缘勾勒着淡粉色与蓝色的光芒。右侧女性留着 {argument name="second hair color" default="黑色"} 的头发，侧边剃短的莫霍克发型，长发向后梳起；她露出的耳朵上有多个耳环，身穿带有绑带和金属细节的深色未来派无袖夹克。两人面部贴近，双唇几乎触碰，营造出一种感性的赛博朋克氛围。使用电光蓝、青色、靛蓝、紫罗兰、洋红色以及柔和的桃色肤色调，通过点阵的大小和亮度变化来勾勒轮廓、阴影和高光。背景展示了模糊的霓虹城市景观，包含 3 个垂直发光的标志和高楼灯光，所有元素均由微小的发光点阵组成。强调忧郁的夜生活氛围、柔和的轮廓光、浅景深、错综复杂的点刻纹理以及马赛克般的绘画效果，仿佛整个场景由生物发光像素构建而成。风格：高细节赛博朋克点彩肖像，梦幻、浪漫、沉浸式、电影感。

templates.title: A cinematic portrait of a tech leader smoking.

titleLocalized.zh: 科技领袖电影感吸烟肖像

templates.prompt: A high-quality, cinematic portrait, displayed in a 9:16 portrait aspect ratio. The image {argument name="foreground person" default="Sam Altman"} Standing in the foreground on the left, against a backdrop of a traditional, ornate dark wood Chinese building with delicate green lattice windows and carved architectural details, he faces the camera, wearing a black zip-up jacket with the white OpenAI logo clearly visible on the chest. His arm is outstretched towards the viewer, holding a cigarette in the lower left foreground, positioned extremely close to the lens, making the cigarette and hand appear large, soft, and out of focus, creating a strong depth-of-field blur effect. Standing slightly behind and to the right is {argument name="background person" default="Elon Musk"} He is looking at the camera, a cigarette in his hand near his mouth, wearing a black T-shirt with a white xAI logo on the front, his other hand in his pocket. Utilizing the warm, golden hour sunlight from the side, sharp shadows, realistic skin texture, and high contrast are created, resulting in an emotionally resonant amber hue on the face, clothing, and wooden exterior. The composition should have a candid feel yet be refined, with a tight crop from mid-thigh upwards, the foreground figure dominating the frame, and a second figure partially overlapping behind it. Emphasis is placed on realistic photography, cinematic color grading, shallow depth of field, natural facial proportions, subtle smoky atmosphere, and {argument name="left chest logo" default="OpenAI"} Jacket and{argument name="right chest logo" default="xAI"} The brand details are clearly visible on the shirt.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高质量的电影感肖像，采用 9:16 竖屏比例。画面中 {argument name="foreground person" default="Sam Altman"} 站在左侧前景，背景为一座传统的华丽深色木质中式建筑，配有精致的绿色格栅窗和雕刻建筑细节。他面向镜头，身穿黑色拉链夹克，胸前清晰可见白色的 OpenAI 标志。他的手臂向观众方向伸出，在左下角前景处握着 1 支香烟，使其极其靠近镜头，令香烟和手部显得巨大、柔和且失焦，呈现出强烈的景深模糊效果。在他右后方稍远处站着 {argument name="background person" default="Elon Musk"}，他正看向镜头，手中拿着 1 支香烟靠近嘴边，身穿黑色 T 恤，胸前印有白色 xAI 标志，另一只手插在口袋里。利用侧向的温暖黄金时刻阳光，营造出锐利的阴影、逼真的皮肤纹理、高对比度，并在面部、服装和木质外墙上呈现出富有情绪感的琥珀色调。构图应具有抓拍感但又不失精致，从大腿中部向上紧凑裁剪，前景人物占据画面主体，第二个人物在其后方部分重叠。强调写实摄影、电影级调色、浅景深、自然的脸部比例、微妙的烟雾氛围，以及 {argument name="left chest logo" default="OpenAI"} 夹克和 {argument name="right chest logo" default="xAI"} 衬衫上清晰的品牌细节。

templates.title: Enhanced roof EO image

titleLocalized.zh: 增强屋顶 EO 图像

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, enhance it into a high-resolution nadir satellite/aerial cropped image of the same rooftop scene. Maintain the same architectural geometry, the stairs at the top edge, the roof railing, the blue awning in the lower left corner, and the brown slatted roof in the lower right corner, but sharpen the edges, increase contrast, slightly correct perspective, and remove compression noise. Make the roof details clearer and more legible, especially defining the single solar water heater on the white roof as a rectangular panel with a small tank/cylindrical attachment and clear shadows. Preserve the compact cropped composition and realistic Earth-observational image look.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图像，将其增强为同一屋顶场景的高分辨率天底卫星/航空裁剪图。保持相同的建筑几何结构、顶部边缘的楼梯、屋顶围栏、左下角的蓝色遮阳篷以及右下角的棕色板条屋顶，但要锐化边缘、增加对比度、稍微校正透视并清除压缩噪点。使屋顶细节更清晰易读，特别是将白色屋顶上的单个太阳能热水器明确为带有小型水箱/圆柱体附件及清晰阴影的矩形面板。保留紧凑的裁剪构图和逼真的地球观测图像外观。

templates.title: Classic Chinese style pet portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 古典中国风宠物肖像

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the pet's base, the cat is transformed into an exquisite traditional Chinese ink painting, presenting the style of ancient literati portraits. The cat's features—silver gradient markings, round face, large eyes, and frontal sitting posture—are preserved, while all modern interior objects are removed, placing the cat within an elegant classical rockery composition. A soft, aged Xuan paper background is added, a pale moon is added near the center in the upper left, a clump of bamboo in the upper right, an ornamental Taihu stone on the right, and a magnolia branch with three large white flowers in the lower left. Vertical Chinese calligraphy containing four large characters is added in the upper left, followed by a narrower vertical inscription below, with two red seals affixed near the inscription. Delicate brushstrokes, soft beige-gray tones, subtle rendering, and fine fur details create a tranquil and poetic atmosphere reminiscent of an ancient Eastern scroll painting.

templates.prompt: A realistic, documentary-style historical photograph shows{argument name="number of people" default="4"} A group of Chinese people sit around a rough wooden table. The background is an old, whitewashed rural courtyard with dark wooden doors and broken lattice windows. The scene is set in mid-20th-century China, with soft, natural colors and gentle lighting, and the composition presents a casual, observational perspective. To the right foreground, a man in an olive-green military-style uniform and cap leans forward, seemingly speaking or handing something. Two seated men wear blue-grey Mao-era work jackets and hats, and a fourth is faintly visible on the far left edge. Seven items are clearly visible on the table: a white enamel teapot, two white enamel cups, and one printed with…{argument name="tin text" default="COFFEE"} A rectangular metal coffee can with a label, a folded brown leather shoulder bag, a white cloth bag or folded paper bag, and a small dish or ashtray. The wooden table, weathered and uneven, exudes a strong sense of texture and is full of the marks of time. The courtyard floor is rammed earth, the walls are rough stucco, and climbing plants grow in the upper left, with a clothesline hanging diagonally above. Shot from a seated eye level, the composition is slightly off-center, with shallow depth of field, possessing a delicate film grain and authentic details of the era. It emphasizes realism, understated tension, a lifelike quality, and a cinematic documentary atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实的纪录片风格历史照片，展示了 {argument name="number of people" default="4"} 名中国人围坐在一张粗糙的木桌旁。背景是一座带有深色木门和破损格栅窗的古老粉墙乡村庭院。场景设定在 20 世纪中叶的中国，色调柔和自然，光线柔和，构图呈现出一种不经意的观察视角。右前方一人身穿橄榄绿军装风格制服和配套军帽，身体前倾，仿佛正在发言或递送物品。两名坐着的人身穿蓝灰色毛泽东时代工作夹克和帽子，第四个人在最左侧边缘隐约可见。桌上清晰可见 7 件物品：一个白色搪瓷茶壶、2 个白色搪瓷杯、1 个印有 {argument name="tin text" default="COFFEE"} 标签的矩形金属咖啡罐、1 个折叠的棕色皮质挎包、1 个白色布包或折叠纸包，以及 1 个小碟子或烟灰缸。木桌饱经风霜，凹凸不平，质感强烈，充满岁月痕迹。庭院地面为夯土，墙壁为粗糙的灰泥墙，左上方有爬藤植物，上方斜拉着一根晾衣绳。采用坐姿视平线角度拍摄，构图略微偏离中心，浅景深，带有细腻的胶片颗粒感和真实的时代细节。强调写实感、低调的张力、生活化的质感以及电影般的纪实摄影氛围。

templates.title: Guangzhou Ink Painting Travel Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 广州水墨笔触旅行海报

templates.prompt: A sophisticated digital painting in poster style, with a simple, pure white background. In the upper left corner, a giant traditional calligraphy brush extends, wielding a bold, flowing S-shaped black ink stroke. Within the ink stroke lies {argument name="city" default="Guangzhou"} A highly detailed panoramic cityscape seamlessly blends the modern skyline with historic waterfront architecture. The upper section showcases the modern skyline at sunrise or sunset, bathed in warm golden light, including the slender Canton Tower, dense glass skyscrapers, rivers, bridges, and soft clouds. The brushstrokes extend downwards to a scenic waterway, its banks lined with lush trees and vibrant flowers, complemented by traditional Chinese pavilions, pagoda-like structures, and elegant waterfront features. The lower section continues the river view, showcasing cruise ships and red wooden sightseeing boats, before transitioning to more city landmarks, including a large modern arched bridge and distant buildings. The style blends ink painting, watercolor, and ultra-detailed travel poster illustration, with vivid black ink dots and dry brush textures along the edges of the shapes, creating the effect of the city being painted with a single, fluid brushstroke. The composition remains vertically centered, with ample negative space around it. A prominent black calligraphy of "Guangzhou" is placed in the lower right corner, accompanied by a small red seal; smaller Chinese characters "Millennial Commercial Capital, Vibrant Guangzhou" are added at the bottom center. The overall atmosphere is elegant, full of cultural atmosphere, has a cinematic quality and is desirable, perfectly combining historical heritage with the beauty of a future city.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅精致的海报风格数字绘画，背景为简洁的纯白色。画面左上角伸出一支巨大的传统书法毛笔，挥洒出一道粗犷、流畅的 S 型黑色墨迹。墨迹之中展现出 {argument name="city" default="广州"} 高度细腻的全景城市风貌，将现代天际线与历史悠久的水岸建筑融为一体。上部展现日出或日落时分的现代天际线，沐浴在温暖的金色光辉中，包括纤细的广州塔、密集的玻璃摩天大楼、河流、桥梁以及柔和的云彩。笔触向下延伸至风景秀丽的河道，两岸绿树成荫，点缀着绚丽的花卉，并配有中国传统凉亭、塔式建筑和优雅的水滨结构。下部延续河景，展现游船和红色的木质观光船，随后过渡到更多城市地标，包括一座大型现代拱桥和远处的建筑群。融合水墨画、水彩画和超细腻旅行海报插画风格，在绘制形状的边缘处带有生动的黑色墨点和干笔纹理，营造出城市仿佛由毛笔一气呵成绘就的效果。构图保持垂直居中，周围留有充足的负空间。右下角放置醒目的黑色书法“广州”，旁边配有一枚红色小印章；底部中心添加较小的中文文字“千年商都·活力广州”。整体氛围优雅、充满文化气息、具有电影质感且令人向往，完美结合了历史底蕴与未来城市之美。

templates.title: Han Li character poster in ink painting style

titleLocalized.zh: 水墨风韩立角色海报

templates.prompt: A vertical, modern Chinese-style fantasy character poster features a textured Xuan paper background rendered in elegant monochrome ink wash style, accented with low-saturation cyan and delicate gold lines. The central figure is a full-body male cultivator.{argument name="character name" default="Han Li"} He stood amidst the misty mountains and waters, his feet resting on a dark lakeside rock. Tall and slender, with a composed demeanor and refined air, his long hair was half-tied, the rest flowing in the wind. He wore…{argument name="robe color" default="Dark blue-green and light gray"} Layered Hanfu: A wide-sleeved, dark-colored robe is worn over a light-colored long gown, adorned with embroidered trim, ornate waist ornaments, tassels, and flowing, semi-transparent ribbons. His expression should be composed, serene, and ethereal. One hand hangs naturally, while the other is slightly raised, the palm shrouded in a faint, pale blue-white aura. The composition utilizes strong negative space and an exquisite poster layout: the figure is slightly to the right, with majestic, ink-wash mountains shrouded in mist behind him, bamboo branches in the upper right corner, a tranquil lake below, a small pavilion on a rock in the lower right corner, sparse trees on the left bank, and scattered petals near the ground. Delicate, winding gold decorative lines are added to the background and foreground. The overall color scheme is restrained, soft, and atmospheric, combining the artistic conception of a literati painting with the quality of a cinematic character poster. The design needs to integrate four text elements: The top left corner should feature the prominent vertical black calligraphy "Han Li," next to a small red seal; below that is a vertical line of poetry, "A green robe stands against the wind, a heart as deep as the abyss," with the Romanized spelling "Han Li" in smaller characters below that; and at the bottom center, a line of smaller characters.{argument name="bottom quote" default="Walking beyond the mundane world, with one's heart set on the pinnacle of the Great Dao."} To make the image appear{argument name="series title" default="A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality"} The high-end series of posters requires accurate calligraphy fonts, distinct layers of clouds and mist, natural flowing clothing, and an extraordinary and refined aura of immortal heroes.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张竖版新中式仙侠角色海报，背景为纹理质感的宣纸，采用优雅的单色水墨渲染，辅以低饱和度的青色点缀和极细微的金色线条勾勒。画面中心为全身男性修仙者 {argument name="character name" default="韩立"}，他伫立在烟雾缭绕的山水间，脚下一块深色湖畔岩石。他身形高挑，神态沉稳，气质儒雅，长发半束，其余发丝随风飘动，身着 {argument name="robe color" default="深蓝绿色与浅灰色"} 叠穿汉服：外罩宽袖深色长袍，内搭浅色长衫，饰有刺绣边饰、华丽腰饰、流苏以及飘逸的半透明丝带。他的表情应显得从容、清冷且具有仙气。一只手自然下垂，另一只手微微抬起，掌心萦绕着淡淡的淡蓝白色灵气。构图运用了强烈的留白与精致的海报布局：人物略微偏右，身后是隐入云雾的巍峨水墨山峦，右上角点缀竹枝，下方为静谧湖泊，右下角岩石上建有一座小亭，左岸有疏落树木，地面附近有零星花瓣飘落。在背景和前景中加入纤细蜿蜒的金色装饰线条。整体色调克制、柔和且富有氛围感，兼具文人画意境与电影级角色海报的质感。设计中需集成 4 个文字元素：左上角书写醒目的竖排黑色书法“韩立”，旁侧配有一枚小红印，下方配有一行竖排诗句“青衫临风，道心如渊”，下方标注小字罗马拼音“Han Li”，底部居中书写一行小字 {argument name="bottom quote" default="行于凡尘之外，心向大道之巅"}。使画面呈现出 {argument name="series title" default="凡人修仙传"} 高端系列海报的质感，要求书法字体准确、云雾景深层次分明、衣物飘动感自然，并展现出超凡脱俗的仙侠英雄气韵。

templates.title: Roughly hand-drawn tabby cat using a mouse.

titleLocalized.zh: 粗糙的鼠标手绘虎斑猫

templates.prompt: A deliberately rough hand-drawn digital sketch, the main subject being {argument name="animal" default="tabby cat"} Centered on a pure white background, it appears to have been drawn with a computer mouse in a basic drawing program. The figure is seated facing forward, with a symmetrical composition, a large head, a simplified body, and smiling eyes. It has a small pink triangular nose, a small black mouth, long gray whiskers, pink inner ears, and orange tabby stripes on its forehead, cheeks, chest, legs, and sides. The outline is drawn with thin, uneven golden-orange lines that tremble and sway, the fur texture is messy and scribbled, the proportions are imperfect, giving it a casual, amateurish feel. The image should look both cute and clumsy, like casual mouse-written art, containing one cat, two ears, two closed eyes, one nose, one mouth, and six visible whiskers. The minimalist composition, lack of props, shadows, and background, the clean white canvas, and simple flat colors create a playful and clumsy charm.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张刻意粗糙的手绘数字草图，主体为 {argument name="animal" default="虎斑猫"}，居中放置在纯白色背景上，看起来像是用电脑鼠标在基础绘图程序中绘制的。正面坐姿，构图对称，头部较大，身体简化，闭着眼睛微笑，有着小小的粉色三角形鼻子、小巧的黑色嘴巴、长长的灰色胡须、粉色的内耳，额头、脸颊、胸部、腿部和侧面带有橙色虎斑条纹。使用金橙色的细而不匀的轮廓线，线条抖动且摇晃，毛发纹理凌乱涂鸦，比例不完美，充满业余涂鸦的随意感。图像应看起来既可爱又笨拙，如同随意的鼠标手写艺术，画面中包含 1 只猫、2 只耳朵、2 只闭着的眼睛、1 个鼻子、1 张嘴和 6 根可见的胡须。极简构图，无道具，无阴影，无背景，干净的白色画布，简单的平涂色彩，充满俏皮而笨拙的魅力。

templates.title: Minimalist Fox Demon Character Sketch

titleLocalized.zh: 极简狐妖角色草图

templates.prompt: Draw a simple full-body anime character concept sketch against a pure white background. The character should be centered with ample white space around her. Depict a slender young female fox spirit with two upright fox ears and extremely long, flowing hair of [color missing].{argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} Her facial features are blurred, giving the impression of an unfinished design. She wears a short, wrap-around dress inspired by a kimono, with short sleeves, a wide sash at the waist, a layered, asymmetrical skirt, and a long ribbon or fabric tail flowing to the right. She wears knee-high fitted boots with simple angular embellishments near the knees. Her pose is elegant and relaxed, with her legs slightly crossed, her left arm hanging naturally, and her right arm raised with an open palm. Above her raised hand floats a small, magical fire sprite, glowing with a pale green and light gold light, shaped like a curled teardrop surrounded by tiny wisps of light. The main body of the figure is rendered primarily with delicate monochrome pencil or ink line art, with very light gray shadows, while the floating flame is the only colored element. The design is minimalist, featuring refined comic book proportions, soft yet clear outlines, ample white space, no background objects, and no text.

promptLocalized.zh: 在纯白色背景上绘制一张简洁的全身动漫角色概念草图，角色居中，周围留有大量空白。描绘一位身材苗条的年轻狐妖女性，头顶长有 2 只竖立的狐耳，留着一头极长的飘逸秀发，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色"}，面部特征模糊，呈现出未完成的设计稿质感。她身穿受和服启发的短款裹身裙，配有短袖、腰间宽腰带、层叠的不对称裙摆，以及 1 条向右飘动的长丝带或布料尾巴。脚穿及膝修身靴，膝盖附近有简单的棱角装饰。她的姿势优雅放松，双腿微交叉站立，左臂自然下垂，右臂抬起，手掌张开。在她抬起的手上方悬浮着 1 团小巧的魔法火焰精灵，呈现青绿色和淡金色光芒，呈卷曲的泪滴状，周围环绕着细小的光丝。人物主体主要采用精致的单色铅笔或墨水线稿渲染，带有极浅的灰色阴影，而悬浮的火焰是唯一的彩色元素。极简主义角色设计风格，精致的漫画比例，柔和清晰的轮廓，通透的留白，无背景物体，无文字。

templates.title: Illustration of a sleepy girl in front of a laptop

titleLocalized.zh: 笔记本电脑前的困倦女孩插画

templates.prompt: A minimalist illustration against a light gray background, employing simple hand-drawn lines with deep navy blue outlines and soft pink accents. The image depicts a tired young woman with a short, straight, soft pink bob, sitting at a table using an open laptop. She is turned three-quarters to the left, her eyes half-closed, her expression weary and resigned. She wears a loose, soft pink cardigan over a simple top, seated in a casual chair. The table contains three objects: an open laptop in front of her, a covered coffee mug behind the laptop, and a smartphone near the lower right corner. The lines are loose, casual, and slightly imperfect, like a stylish editor's doodle. Large text is placed to the left of the figure.{argument name="headline text" default="NEMUTAI"} Use a dark navy blue bold uppercase serif font and make the words {argument name="subtitle text" default="girl"} Overlay it with a smaller, soft pink cursive font. Add a small handwritten artist's signature near the bottom right edge of the desktop. Ample white space, flat colors, no shadows, a modern feminine atmosphere, a drowsy home office feel, and a balanced composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅浅灰色背景上的简洁极简主义插画，采用简单的手绘线条风格，带有深海军蓝色的轮廓和局部的柔和粉色填充。画面展示了一位留着柔和粉色短直波波头的困倦年轻女性，坐在桌前使用打开的笔记本电脑。她以 3/4 侧面朝左，双眼半闭，神情疲惫且无奈。她身穿一件套在简约上衣外的柔和粉色宽松开衫，坐在轻描淡写的椅子上。桌面上包含 3 个物体：她面前的 1 台打开的笔记本电脑，笔记本电脑后方的 1 个带盖外带咖啡杯，以及桌面右下角附近的 1 部智能手机。线条保持宽松、随意且略显不完美，如同充满时尚感的编辑涂鸦。在人物左侧放置大号文字 {argument name="headline text" default="NEMUTAI"}，使用深海军蓝色的粗体大写衬线字体，并让单词 {argument name="subtitle text" default="girl"} 以较小的柔和粉色草书字体与其重叠。在桌面右下边缘附近添加一个小的手写艺术家签名。留白充足，平涂色彩，无阴影，现代女性化氛围，困倦的居家办公感，构图平衡。
