templates.title: Rendering of Chinese royal palace architectural model

titleLocalized.zh: 中式皇家宫殿建筑模型渲染

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed single-building model image showcasing a traditional Chinese imperial palace, similar to the throne room of the Forbidden City, using an isometric, slightly overhead perspective. The composition is perfectly centered and symmetrical, with the building occupying over 70% of the image. Only the main building and its surrounding stone platform are shown, against a clean, light gray-white studio background, excluding cityscapes, surrounding buildings, people, vehicles, text, or other irrelevant objects. The palace boasts a magnificent double-eaved hip roof with slightly upturned eaves covered in ornate golden glazed tiles. The roof ridge is exquisitely decorated, with curled ornaments at the eaves. Below the eaves, vibrant blue-green and gold bracket details are displayed, running horizontally beneath the two layers of eaves. The facade is a long, narrow front with 10 red columns supporting 9 red wooden doors above, adorned with delicate latticework and gold emblems. The building sits atop a tall, light-colored stone platform, with three terraces visible in front, maintaining an overall symmetrical height. Add a grand central staircase along the central axis, featuring a wide, ornate marble walkway flanked by two narrower staircases on either side, as well as symmetrical side staircases extending from the upper terrace to the lower side platforms. White marble balustrades with balusters and railings should adorn the terrace edges and the sides of the staircases. The central walkway should include intricate bas-relief dragon carvings. The stone plaza base should be light gray with fine brickwork and clean edges. Lighting should be soft, even, and neutral, reminiscent of a high-end museum model rendering, emphasizing realistic materials and clean geometry. The image should present a refined, standalone architectural reference rendering suitable for AI construction animation.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个高度精细的单体建筑模型图像，展示一座传统中式皇家大殿，类似于紫禁城宫殿的宝座大厅，采用等轴测略微俯视的视角。构图完美居中且对称，建筑占据画面 70% 以上的区域。仅展示主体建筑及其周围的石质台基环境，背景为干净的浅灰白色摄影棚背景，不包含城市景观、周边建筑、人物、车辆、文字或其他无关物体。大殿拥有宏伟的重檐庑殿顶，屋檐四角微微翘起，覆盖着华丽的金黄色琉璃瓦，屋脊装饰精美，檐角处有卷曲的装饰。屋檐下方展示生动的蓝绿色与金色相间的斗拱细节，横向贯穿于两层屋檐之下。立面为长条形正面，前方有 10 根红色圆柱，支撑着上方 9 间红色木门，门上带有精致的格栅板和金色徽章装饰。建筑坐落于高大的浅色石质台基群上，前方可见 3 层露台，整体高度对称。在中心轴线上添加一座宏伟的中央阶梯，中间设有一条宽阔的雕花大理石御路，两侧紧邻两条较窄的台阶，此外还有从上层露台延伸至下层侧边平台的对称侧阶梯。露台边缘和阶梯两侧设有带有望柱和栏板的白色大理石栏杆。中央御路应包含精细的浅浮雕龙纹石刻。石质广场底座应为浅灰色，带有细微的砖缝和清晰的边缘。光照柔和、均匀且中性，如同高级博物馆模型渲染，强调逼真的材质和整洁的几何结构。图像应呈现出一种精致的独立建筑参考渲染效果，适用于 AI 施工动画。

templates.title: Explosion image of the Imperial Palace

titleLocalized.zh: 皇宫大殿爆炸图

templates.prompt: A highly detailed image{argument name="building name" default="Magnificent Chinese Imperial Palace Hall"} Exploded views of the building assembly are presented in a clean studio environment with a pure white background. The composition is centered and perfectly symmetrical, using a slightly elevated isometric front view. The building is vertically divided into six clearly identifiable construction layers, evenly spaced and precisely aligned along a central axis, suspended in mid-air. From bottom to top, the following are shown: 1) A large, light-colored stone base platform with wide front steps, carved royal walkways, paved tiles, and surrounding edges; 2) An elevated white marble terrace with multiple steps, carved railings, and tiered ceremonial platforms; 3) The main hall facade with rows of red-lacquered columns, red doors and wall panels, and ornate painted bands; 4) A dense and ornate blue-green-gold bracket system spanning the width of the structure; 5) A brown wooden roof frame and upper wooden skeleton with visible beams, latticework, and eaves; 6) A finished royal gold-tiled roof suspended at the very top, with a graceful double-eaved profile, ridge ornaments, upturned corners, and finely textured tiles. Emphasis should be placed on realistic materials: light-colored carved stone, red lacquered wood, painted brackets, log frames, and glazed gold tiles. Images should have the quality of museum-quality architectural construction drawings or high-end reference boards, extremely clear, elegant, and professional, but should not contain any labels, text, people, vehicles, tools, scaffolding, or surrounding buildings.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度精细的 {argument name="building name" default="宏伟的中国皇宫大殿"} 建筑装配爆炸图，展示在纯白色背景的干净摄影棚环境中。采用居中、完全对称的构图，以及略微抬高的等轴测正视图。建筑在垂直方向上被分为 6 个清晰可辨的施工层，各层之间均匀间隔并沿中心轴精确对齐，悬浮排列。从下至上依次展示：1) 带有宽阔前台阶、雕刻御路、铺地砖和周边边缘的大型浅色石基座平台；2) 带有多个台阶、雕刻栏杆和分层礼仪平台的高架汉白玉露台层；3) 带有成排红漆柱、红门和墙板以及装饰华丽的彩绘带的主殿立面；4) 横跨结构宽度、密集且华丽的蓝绿金配色斗拱组；5) 带有可见梁架、格栅结构和飞檐的棕色木质屋顶框架及上部木质骨架；6) 悬浮在最顶部的成品皇室金瓦屋顶，具有优美的双檐轮廓、脊饰、翘角和纹理细腻的瓦片。强调逼真的材质：浅色雕刻石材、红漆木、彩绘斗拱、原木框架和琉璃金瓦。图像应呈现出博物馆级的建筑施工说明图或高级参考图板的质感，极其清晰、优雅且专业，但图中不包含任何标签、文字、人物、车辆、工具、脚手架或周边建筑。

templates.title: Chinese Palace Components Project

titleLocalized.zh: 中国宫殿构件项目

templates.prompt: This is a neat display of the building materials and components of a traditional Chinese imperial palace, presented in a front view against a light, warm, neutral background. All components are neatly grouped like a high-end architectural inventory, featuring realistic miniature renderings, sharp edges, natural shadows, and museum-quality detail. The composition comprises seven clearly defined areas: a complete architectural model in the upper left corner; two large roof components in the upper right corner, below which are 23 gilded roof elements; four small roof corner ornaments in the far right corner; two wooden roof truss frame components in the middle right, below which are six layers of long wooden beams and two slender columns; and the bottom area includes the building's base and facade components. The complete architectural model is a symmetrical Chinese palace with a gilded double-eaved hip roof, red columns, blue-green painted bracket details, and a carved white stone base with central and side steps. In the lower left section, a separate white stone pedestal platform, four upright carved balustrade columns, a carved stone ramp slab, and a narrow stone staircase are displayed. In the lower left section of painted wood components, two long blue-green-gold beams and ten sets of blue-green-gold brackets arranged in two rows are shown. In the lower right center, nine red columns with light-colored stone bases are displayed. At the bottom row, six sets of red lacquered door and window units are shown: a pair of palace double doors, a narrow lattice window, a wide three-lattice window, and three additional pairs of lattice window panels, all with ornate gold insignia at the bottom. High-detail carvings of stone textures, lacquered wood, glazed tiles, and aged timber structures are used. The overall image should present a precise palace architectural suite style, elegant, symmetrical, and independent, without any figures, labels, text, urban backgrounds, scaffolding, machinery, or other irrelevant objects.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张整洁的传统中国皇宫大殿建筑材料与构件展示项目，采用正视图呈现，背景为浅暖中性色。将所有部件像高端建筑清单一样整齐地分为不同组别，具有逼真的微缩模型渲染效果、清晰的边缘、自然的阴影以及博物馆级的细节。构图包含 7 个明确的分组区域：左上角为 1 个完整的建筑模型，右上角为 2 个大型屋顶组件，其下方为 23 个金色屋顶构件，最右上角为 4 个小型屋顶角饰，中右侧为 2 个木质屋顶桁架框架组件，桁架下方为 6 层长木梁及 2 根细柱，底部区域包含建筑基座和立面部件。完整的建筑模型是一座对称的中国宫殿大殿，配有金色重檐庑殿顶、红色柱子、蓝绿色彩画斗拱细节，以及带有中央台阶和侧台阶的雕花白石台基。在左下方的构件区，展示 1 个分离的白石基座平台、4 根竖立的雕花栏杆柱、1 块雕花石坡道板和 1 段窄石阶。在左下方的彩画木构件区，展示 2 根长蓝绿金色横梁和 10 组排列成两行的蓝绿金色斗拱。在右下方的中间位置，展示 9 根带有浅色石基的红色圆柱。在最底行，展示 6 组红色漆面门窗单元：1 对宫殿双扇门、1 扇窄格栅窗、1 扇宽三扇格栅窗以及 3 组额外的成对格栅窗扇，所有门窗底部均带有华丽的金色圆章装饰。使用高细节的雕刻石材纹理、漆木、琉璃瓦和陈年木结构。整体图像应呈现出精确的宫殿建筑套件图风格，优雅、对称、独立，且画面中没有人像、标签、文字、城市背景、脚手架、机械或其他无关物体。

templates.title: Retro Pop Art Style Family Travel Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 复古波普风家庭旅行海报

templates.prompt: A bold and vibrant retro pop collage-style travel poster, presented vertically. The background is a bright, saturated orange with layered paper textures, halftone dots, paint splatters, rough brushstrokes, diagonal stripes, checkerboard patterns, abstract color blocks, and hand-drawn white graffiti, including four star patterns, three jagged marks, and several short decorative brushstrokes. The upper half prominently displays a large {argument name="headline text" default="Go!"} The text, in an oversized, cartoon-style handwritten font, features white fill with rough sketch-like outlines, a slight 3D depth, and yellow paint accents, ending with an exaggerated exclamation mark. In the lower right and center foreground, a joyful scene of a family of four on vacation is depicted. The figures, rendered in a paper-cut style with thick white sticker outlines, include an adult male, an adult female, a boy, and a girl. All four are looking up to the upper left or right, pointing excitedly ahead, conveying enthusiasm and dynamism. The man, standing on the right, is tall, wearing a light-colored hat, a white T-shirt, a yellow cardigan, and blue jeans with visible suspenders, one arm pointing straight up. The woman stands slightly to his left and slightly behind, wearing a straw hat and a loose white shirt, smiling and pointing upwards. In the foreground, the boy, wearing dark sunglasses, a yellow shirt under a light-colored jacket, and carrying a backpack, points diagonally upwards. Beside him, a girl wearing a straw hat and a yellow and white striped top points upwards, while leaning against or standing next to a bright yellow hard-shell suitcase, its retractable handle clearly visible in the lower right corner. The overall design uses warm tones of orange, yellow, and white with high contrast, creating a playful summer travel atmosphere. It has a dynamic diagonal flow, presenting a poster-like advertising tension and a mixed-media visual effect that combines photographic figures with illustrative graphic design.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张大胆且充满活力的复古波普拼贴风格旅行海报，采用竖构图。背景为鲜艳的饱和橙色，带有层叠的纸张纹理、半调网点、油漆飞溅、粗犷的笔触、斜条纹图案、棋盘格装饰、抽象色块以及手绘白色涂鸦，包括 4 个星形图案、3 个锯齿标记和若干短促的装饰笔触。上半部分醒目地展示了巨大的 {argument name="headline text" default="Go!"} 字样，采用超大号漫画风格手写字体，白色填充配以粗糙的素描笔触轮廓，带有轻微的 3D 深度感和黄色油漆点缀，末尾是一个夸张的感叹号。在右下方和中心前景处，展示一家四口度假时欢快的情景，人物采用剪纸照片风格，带有厚实的白色贴纸轮廓：包括 1 名成年男性、1 名成年女性、1 名男孩和 1 名女孩。四人都抬头看向左上方或右上方，兴奋地指着前方，传达出热情与动感。男子站在右侧，身材高大，戴着浅色帽子，身穿白色 T 恤、黄色开衫外套、蓝色牛仔裤，背带可见，一只手臂笔直向上指着。女子站在他左侧稍后方，戴着草帽，身穿宽松的白色衬衫，微笑着向上指。前方，男孩戴着深色太阳镜，黄色衬衫外搭浅色夹克，背着背包，斜向上指着。在他身旁，女孩戴着草帽，穿着黄白条纹上衣，向上指着，同时扶着或站在一个亮黄色的硬壳行李箱旁，行李箱的伸缩拉杆在右下角清晰可见。整体采用橙色、黄色和白色的暖色调，对比度高，营造出俏皮的夏季旅行氛围，具有动态的对角线流动感，呈现出海报般的广告张力，以及摄影人物与插画图形设计相结合的混合媒介视觉效果。

templates.title: Surreal Japanese meme thumbnail in front of the pyramids

titleLocalized.zh: 金字塔前的超现实日本梗图缩略图

templates.prompt: A dramatic, absurd Japanese clickbait-style poster features a desert sunset as a backdrop, with a massive pyramid serving as a stone tabletop in the foreground. A disheveled Japanese man in a dark blue kimono-style robe kneels behind a black plate of translucent squid sashimi, meticulously arranging it with chopsticks. His face is obscured by a rectangular blur, his wild hair forming a striking silhouette against the orange glow of the low-hanging sun and scattered clouds. The plate is neatly stacked with pale pink squid slices, a large blue-purple shiso leaf, and a yellow decorative flower. To the right is a wooden tray with condiments and small dishes. On the left edge of the pyramid's surface, a giant human thumbnail stands like a monument, before which a miniature orchestra of about ten dressed string players and a conductor appears to be performing on the stone. The visual humor lies in the fact that the man, who should be conducting an orchestra inside the thumbnail, is instead decorating the pyramid's summit with salted squid. It employs ultra-refined realistic compositing, exaggerated proportions and contrasts, cinematic sunset rim lighting, rough textures, high contrast, and a surreal sense of humor. The striking Japanese title text is integrated into the composition, using bold, cartoonish YouTube thumbnail style, with thick black outlines, yellow and white font, red brush accents, black ink splatter after the top title, and a huge red shout at the bottom. Contains 6 Text block: The large yellow text in the upper left corner "Asuka's fingertips in the claws in the middle of the でオーケストラ command しなきゃ!", the red strokes below it "と思ったら", the large white and yellow text "ピラミ" in the lower middle "ッドの上でイカの塩心をデコレーションしてました~", super large red text at the bottom. The words "チクショー!!", and the yellow tag text "#まいにちチクショー" in the lower right corner. The overall composition is like an exaggerated Japanese viral meme thumbnail, using a vertical composition that is dense and eye-catching.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张戏剧性、荒诞的日本点击诱饵风格海报，背景是沙漠中的日落，巨大的金字塔作为前景中的石制桌面。一名头发凌乱的日本男子身穿深蓝色和服式长袍，跪在盛有半透明鱿鱼刺身的黑色盘子后，正用筷子精细地摆盘。他的面部区域被一个矩形模糊块遮挡，狂乱的头发在低垂的太阳和零散云朵构成的橙色发光天空下形成鲜明的剪影。盘子里整齐地堆放着淡粉色的鱿鱼片、一片巨大的青紫苏叶和一朵黄色装饰花。右侧放着一个带有调味品和小碟子的木制分格托盘。在金字塔表面的左侧边缘，展示 1 个像纪念碑一样竖立的巨大人类大拇指指甲，指甲前有 1 个由约 10 名身着正装的弦乐手和指挥组成的微型管弦乐队，仿佛正在石头上表演。视觉笑点在于：该男子本应在指甲里指挥管弦乐队，结果却在金字塔顶端装饰盐渍鱿鱼。采用超精细的写实合成、夸张的比例对比、电影般的日落轮廓光、粗粝质感、高对比度和超现实幽默感。将醒目的日文标题文字融入构图中，采用粗体、漫画式的 YouTube 缩略图风格，配以粗黑色轮廓、黄白相间的字体、红色画笔点缀、顶部标题后的黑色墨迹飞溅，以及底部巨大的红色呐喊文字。包含 6 个文本块：左上角的大号黄色文字“明日も親指の爪の中でオーケストラ指揮しなきゃ!”，其下方红色笔触上的“と思ったら”，中下部大号白黄色文字“ピラミッドの頂上でイカの塩辛をデコレーションしてました〜。”，底部超大号红色文字“チクショー!!”，以及右下角的黄色标签文字“#まいにちチクショー”。整体构图如同夸张的日本病毒式梗图缩略图，采用竖构图，内容密集且引人注目。

templates.title: Two anime girls with brightly colored hair

titleLocalized.zh: 两位发色亮眼的动漫少女

templates.prompt: A clean-background anime illustration depicts two girls standing side-by-side from a slightly overhead two-thirds profile perspective. The image presents a stylish monochrome with accent colors, featuring clean, crisp lines, manga-style halftone shading and delicate textures, and subtle cyan and magenta printing misalignment effects, creating a modern graphic quality. The girl on the left has extremely long, silver-white hair that fades to a vibrant electric blue at the ends, styled in two small buns with the rest falling naturally. She has bright, large eyes, her expression calm yet slightly curious. She wears a school uniform consisting of a white shirt, a black sleeveless knit vest, a dark pleated skirt, a bright blue bow at the neckline, white socks, and black loafers, her hands behind her back, her body slightly leaning forward. The girl on the right has thick, dark hair {argument name="hair color" default="Dark purple"} She wore a high ponytail with distinct layers of hair, possessed golden amber eyes, and had a cool and reserved expression; she wore a metal hair clip with the words "..." written on it.{argument name="hair clip text" default="AI"} Her outfit is a sporty streetwear-style school uniform: an oversized white jacket with striking purple trim and a hooded lining, layered over a grey top, with shorts mostly covered by the jacket, paired with white socks and purple high-top sneakers, her hands in the jacket pockets. To maintain compositional balance, the girl on the left is slightly to the left, and the girl on the right is slightly to the right, both looking up at the viewer. Abstract black shadow bars and dotted halftone graphics are added below and around them, rather than a detailed environmental background. The emphasis is on the sophisticated fusion of comic book illustration and key visual design elements of contemporary anime, high contrast, a minimalist background, a trendy "bright hair day" vibe, and a cool, creative combination.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张背景干净的动漫插画，描绘了两位并肩站立的少女，采用略微俯视的三分之二侧面视角。画面呈现出时尚的单色加点缀色风格，线条清晰利落，带有漫画网点阴影和细腻的半调纹理，并加入轻微的青色与洋红色印刷错位效果，营造出摩登的图形质感。左侧少女留着极长的银白色长发，发梢渐变为鲜艳的电光蓝，扎着两个小圆发髻，其余头发自然垂下；她拥有明亮的大眼睛，表情平静且略带好奇。她身穿校服，包括白色衬衫、黑色无袖针织背心、深色百褶裙，领口系着亮蓝色蝴蝶结，搭配白袜和黑色乐福鞋，双手背在身后，身体微微前倾。右侧少女留着浓郁的 {argument name="hair color" default="深紫色"} 高马尾，发丝层次分明，拥有金琥珀色的双眼，表情冷峻内敛；她佩戴着一个金属发夹，上面写着 {argument name="hair clip text" default="AI"}。她的穿搭是运动街头风校服：一件超大款白色夹克，配有醒目的紫色饰边和连帽内衬，内搭灰色上衣，短裤被夹克遮住大半，搭配白袜和紫色高帮运动鞋，双手插在夹克口袋里。保持构图平衡，左侧少女略微偏左，右侧少女略微偏右，两人都抬头看向观众。在她们下方和周围添加抽象的黑色阴影条和点状网点图形，而非详细的环境背景。强调漫画插画与当代动漫关键视觉设计的精致融合，高对比度，极简背景，时尚的“亮眼发色日”氛围，以及酷炫的创意组合感。

templates.title: Sky blue princess-style anime design

titleLocalized.zh: 天蓝色公主风动漫设计

templates.prompt: A full-body anime character design, styled as a celestial ice princess, standing upright against a clean white studio background, centered in the frame, exuding elegance and ethereal beauty. She possesses {argument name="hair color" default="Ice-like gradient blue"} Her hair is extremely long and voluminous, cascading in soft, ribbon-like waves to below her knees, with braids near the crown, side bangs, and delicate star-shaped hair accessories. Subtle crescent-shaped horn decorations are added above the head as part of the magical styling. Most of her face is obscured by a soft, rectangular blur, but the rest of the illustration is sharp, delicate, and richly detailed. She wears a shimmering {argument name="dress color" default="light sky blue"} The fantasy gown features a fitted corset, sweetheart neckline, semi-sheer puff sleeves, and a short front with a long back, the skirt extending into two long, cascading side panels. The corset and skirt are adorned with silver filigree, small stars, snowflake glitter, crescent moon patterns, and gemstone pendants. A large starburst decoration adorns the chest, with crystal chains hanging from it. She wears a moon choker and matching earrings. She wears sheer white knee-high stockings, one adorned with small blue stars and garter-like patterns, and shiny blue high heels with ankle straps, bows, and star-shaped embellishments at the toes. The gown utilizes a bright color palette of white, pale blue, cyan, and silver, with shimmering magical particles interspersed throughout the fabric. Seven suspended celestial elements surround her: four luminous four-pointed stars and three snowflake-shaped symbols, with soft cyan light trailing around her body and skirt. The overall atmosphere is dreamy, magical, exquisite, and full of princess vibes. It is presented in a high-detail anime illustration style, with smooth gradients, delicate lines, soft lighting effects, glossy highlights, and high-quality character concept art.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张全身动漫角色设计图，风格为天界冰雪公主，正面站立于干净的白色摄影棚背景中，居中构图，优雅且空灵。她拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="冰感渐变蓝"} 的头发，极长且蓬松，呈柔软的丝带状波浪垂至膝盖以下，头顶附近有编发设计，配有侧刘海和精致的星形发饰。在头部上方添加微妙的月牙形角状装饰，作为魔法造型的一部分。她的面部大部分被柔和的矩形模糊遮盖，但插画其余部分清晰、精致且细节丰富。她身穿一件闪烁的 {argument name="dress color" default="淡天蓝色"} 幻想礼服，配有合身的紧身胸衣、心形领口、半透明泡泡袖，以及短款前短后长裙摆，裙摆向后延伸出两片长长的垂坠侧裙片。胸衣和裙摆装饰有银色花丝、小星星、雪花闪光、月牙图案、宝石坠饰，胸前饰有巨大的星爆装饰，并垂挂着水晶链。佩戴月亮颈圈和配套耳环。她穿着透明的白色过膝袜，其中一只袜子上装饰着蓝色小星星和类似吊袜带的小图案，脚穿带有脚踝绑带、蝴蝶结和脚尖星形装饰的亮面蓝色高跟鞋。使用由白色、淡蓝色、青色和银色组成的明亮色调，织物间点缀着闪烁的魔法粒子。在她周围环绕 7 个悬浮的天体元素：4 个四角发光星芒和 3 个雪花状符号，身体和裙摆周围环绕着柔和的青色光迹。整体氛围梦幻、神奇、精致且充满公主气息，以高细节动漫插画风格呈现，具有平滑的渐变、细腻的线条、柔和的光效、亮面高光以及优质的角色概念艺术质感。

templates.title: Anime Girl Schoolgirl Carrying Chair Illustration

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫女学生抱椅插画

templates.prompt: A full-body anime illustration depicting a shy female student, with {argument name="hair color" default="Soft pink"} Her long hair was tied into two low pigtails, each adorned with a fluffy white hair accessory and a light blue ribbon. She had warm, large brown eyes, a slight blush on her cheeks, and a gentle, slightly pouting expression. She sat sideways on a simple classroom chair, her arms wrapped around the back, her chin and forearms resting on the back, gazing at the audience. She wore a Japanese high school uniform: a white shirt under an oversized beige cardigan, tied with {argument name="neckwear color" default="red"} She wears a tie, a grey plaid pleated mini skirt, black sheer tights, and dark brown loafers. Her legs are together, leaning forward, presenting a dignified sitting posture. The background is a softly lit classroom with warm wooden floors; the neutral and blurred background color focuses attention on the girl and the chair. The style is clean and refined, reminiscent of modern anime, with soft shadows, flowing lines, delicate fabric folds, subtly glossy hair, natural proportions, and warm ambient light. The vertical composition, with the entire body centered and the chair fully visible, creates a warm and lovely atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张全身动漫插画，描绘了一位害羞的女学生，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="柔粉色"} 的长发，扎成两个低双马尾，每个马尾上都系着蓬松的白色毛绒发饰和淡蓝色丝带。她有着温暖的大棕色眼睛，面带轻微红晕，表情温柔且略带嘟嘴，侧身坐在简单的教室椅子上，双臂环抱着椅背，下巴和前臂搁在椅背上方，注视着观众。她身穿日本高中制服：白色衬衫外搭一件超大号米色开衫，系着 {argument name="neckwear color" default="红色"} 领带，穿着灰色格子短百褶裙、黑色透明连裤袜和深棕色乐福鞋。双腿并拢向前倾斜，呈现出端庄的坐姿。背景是光线柔和的教室，铺着温暖的木地板，背景色调中性且模糊，将焦点集中在女孩和椅子上。采用干净精致的现代动漫风格，柔和的阴影、流畅的线条、细腻的布料褶皱、微光泽的头发、自然的比例以及温暖的环境光。竖构图，全身居中，椅子完整可见，营造出温馨可爱的氛围。

templates.title: Gourmet Inspiration Haute Couture Fashion Project

titleLocalized.zh: 美食灵感高级定制时尚项目

templates.prompt: Using provided food reference images, the cuisine is transformed into a luxury fashion concept project, making the dishes a direct design inspiration for haute couture evening gowns. The visual essence of the ingredients and plating is preserved: light green vegetable chunks are transformed into layered, flowing silk and chiffon fabrics; dark green portions into sheer dark green linings; red sausage slices into delicate rust-red piping and small decorative details; sesame seeds into delicate beadwork; and the pattern of the blue and white porcelain bowls into printed scarf collars, wide belts, and matching handbags. A full-body female fashion model wearing the gown is displayed at the center; four close-up detail panels on the right showcase the back view, waist/belt structure, embroidery textures, and handbags. Editorial layout is added to the left, including a prominent Chinese title, an English subtitle "Fashion Inspired by Flavor," a brief Chinese description, and five vertical fabric/material color swatches derived from the colors of the dishes and the bowl patterns. The overall presentation is a clean, high-fashion catalog style, using an elegant studio backdrop to create a high-end fashion design showcase.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的菜肴参考图，将美食转化为奢华时尚概念项目，使菜肴成为高级定制晚礼服的直接设计灵感。保留食材和摆盘的视觉基因：将浅绿色蔬菜块转化为层叠飘逸的丝绸和雪纺面料，深绿色部分转化为深绿色的透视内层，红色的香肠切片转化为精致的铁锈红滚边和小型装饰细节，芝麻转化为细腻的珠绣，而蓝白瓷碗的图案则转化为印花围巾领、宽腰带及配套手袋。在中心展示 1 位全身女性时尚模特，身着该礼服；右侧设置 4 个细节特写面板，分别展示背面视图、腰部/腰带结构、刺绣纹理以及手袋。左侧添加编辑排版，包含 1 个醒目的中文大标题，1 个英文副标题“Fashion Inspired by Flavor”，1 段简短的中文描述，以及 5 个源自菜肴色彩和碗具图案的垂直布料/材质色卡。整体呈现干净的高级时装画册风格，采用优雅的摄影棚背景，打造高端时尚设计展示效果。

templates.title: Pink twin-tailed anime girl sitting on a chair

titleLocalized.zh: 坐在椅子上的粉色双马尾动漫少女

templates.prompt: A full-body anime illustration depicts a cute young woman sitting backwards on a wooden dining chair against a simple, studio-style background in a soft off-white color scheme. She has very flowing long hair.{argument name="hair color" default="Soft pink"} Her hair was styled into two low pigtails, each adorned with a fluffy pom-pom hair accessory and a blue ribbon, totaling two pom-poms and two bows. Her posture was shy yet slightly playful: she straddled a chair, facing the back, her arms crossed and resting on the back, her face close to the audience. Her long, elegant legs stretched diagonally forward, ankles crossed, revealing her bare feet. She wore a loose-fitting top {argument name="cardigan color" default="Beige"} A cardigan, slipping off one shoulder, paired with a short top.{argument name="skirt pattern" default="Purple plaid"} A pleated mini skirt, worn over a spaghetti-strap camisole or bra, and sheer black pantyhose. The design emphasizes glossy, silky hair, delicate skin shadows, subtle fabric folds, and a semi-realistic anime-style rendering effect with refined, soft lighting. The chair is a medium-brown wooden chair with a beige upholstered back and seat. The composition is vertically centered, presenting a fashionable illustration style, showcasing the complete chair, legs, and feet against a minimalist background free of clutter.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张全身动漫插画，描绘了一位可爱的年轻女性反坐在木制餐椅上，背景为简洁的影棚风格，色调为柔和的米白色。她留着非常飘逸的长发，{argument name="hair color" default="柔粉色"} 头发梳成两个低双马尾，每个马尾上各系着 1 个蓬松的毛绒球发饰和 1 条蓝色丝带，总共 2 个毛绒球和 2 个蝴蝶结。她的姿势羞涩且略带俏皮：她跨坐在椅子上，面向椅背，双臂交叉叠放在椅背上方，脸部靠在手臂上看向观众。她的双腿修长优雅，向斜前方伸展，脚踝交叉，露出赤足。她穿着一件宽松的 {argument name="cardigan color" default="米色"} 开衫，开衫从一侧肩膀滑落，搭配一条短款 {argument name="skirt pattern" default="紫色格纹"} 百褶迷你裙，内搭可见细肩带吊带衫或文胸，并穿着透明黑色连裤袜。强调光泽丝滑的发丝、细腻的皮肤阴影、微妙的布料褶皱，以及具有精致柔和光影的半写实动漫渲染效果。椅子为中棕色木椅，配有米色软垫靠背和座垫。构图为垂直居中，呈现时尚插画风格，展示了完整的椅子以及双腿和双脚，背景极简，无多余杂物。

templates.title: Gothic Lolita Twin-Tail Full-Body Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 哥特萝莉双马尾全身肖像

templates.prompt: A full-body illustration in an anime style depicts a young woman standing in the center of a bright white interior space, against a backdrop of simple wall decorations. She faces the camera directly, her pose symmetrical, her hands gently lifting the sides of her skirt. She has {argument name="hair color" default="Warm chestnut brown"} Her long hair, styled in extremely long twin ponytails with a soft sheen, featured straight bangs and slightly curled ends, cascading below her waist. She wore an elegant black and white Gothic Lolita outfit: a white high-necked blouse with a ruffled collar, lace trim, ruffled cape-like cuffs, long puff sleeves, and a row of small vertical buttons; a large black ribbon bow around her neck, adorned with a magnificent oval embossed brooch at its center; a tight black corset tied at the front and adorned with eight gold buttons arranged in two rows of four; a voluminous black bell-shaped skirt with multiple layers of pleats at the hem, including three striking black ruffles near the bottom and two layers of white lace petticoats visible between the black layers; two strings of pearl chains dangling from her hips, with a small decorative embossed pendant on her right hip. She wore black knee-high stockings with lace trim and ribbon embellishments, and shiny black Mary Jane shoes with a medium-thick sole. The overall atmosphere is exquisite, sweet, and classic, showcasing delicate fabric textures, soft studio lighting, clean shadows, highly refined lace and satin textures, and the aesthetic style of high-end character fashion showcase images.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张动漫时尚全身插画，描绘了一位年轻女性站在明亮的白色室内空间中央，背景为简洁的墙面装饰线条。她正面对镜头，姿态对称，双手轻轻提起裙摆两侧。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="暖栗棕色"} 的长发，发型为极长的双马尾，带有柔和光泽，配有平直的刘海，发梢微卷，垂落至腰部以下。她身着优雅的黑白哥特萝莉装：白色高领衬衫，配有荷叶边领口、蕾丝饰边、褶皱披肩式袖口、长泡泡袖以及一排垂直的小纽扣；颈部系着巨大的黑色丝带蝴蝶结，中心饰有华丽的椭圆形浮雕胸针；穿着紧身黑色束腰，前部系带，并饰有 8 枚金扣，呈两列各 4 枚排列；下身穿着蓬松的黑色钟形裙，裙摆处有多个层次的褶皱，包括靠近裙摆底部的 3 层醒目黑色褶边，以及黑色层之间可见的 2 层白色蕾丝衬裙；臀部垂挂着两串珍珠链，右侧臀部配有一个小型装饰性浮雕吊坠。她穿着带有蕾丝边和丝带装饰的黑色过膝袜，以及带有中等厚底的亮面黑色玛丽珍鞋。整体氛围精致、甜美且经典，呈现出细腻的布料质感、柔和的摄影棚灯光、干净的阴影、高度精细的蕾丝与缎面纹理，以及高端角色时尚展示图的美学风格。

templates.title: Gothic Gunfire Girl Under the Moonlight

titleLocalized.zh: 月光下的哥特式炮火少女

templates.prompt: A highly dramatic dark fantasy anime illustration, employing a towering vertical composition and presented from a low, upward angle. In the foreground, a solitary, ethereal female warrior stands atop a colossal statue of a roaring beast or the severed head of a slain monster. Her posture is powerful and unwavering, her shoulder bearing a massive Gothic cannon or church column-shaped weapon. The weapon is incredibly tall, crafted from black iron and stone, adorned with ornate spires and filigree, and bound with glowing red chains. Its tip spews forth fierce crimson flames, sparks, and fragments. Behind her rises a massive full moon, its surface etched with a glowing circular crosshair, its cool silver light piercing through the swirling clouds. The female warrior possesses exceptionally long, flowing {argument name="hair color" default="Platinum White"} Her hair, whipping violently to the right in the wind, clad in layers of tattered black and white ceremonial armor robes, with a feathered and ragged texture, blending the aesthetics of Gothic knights, fallen angels, and priestesses. Her face was mostly obscured, adding to her mystery and solemnity. Surrounding her were crumbling Gothic cathedral towers, broken flying buttresses, scattered shards of stained glass, floating debris, and distant spires gradually disappearing into the stormy moonlit sky. The color palette was dominated by low-saturation blue-gray, charcoal black, silver, and purple, accented with chains and the intense red glow of cannon fire. The rendering was a highly detailed, high-contrast, painterly concept art style, full of dynamism, cinematic lighting, sharp atmospheric perspective, intricate details of architectural destruction, and a slightly rough, textured visual effect, creating a deliberately awe-inspiring and dramatic effect. It emphasizes an epic scale, an apocalyptic grandeur, fabrics fluttering in the wind, scorching embers, and a tragic atmosphere of holy war.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的黑暗奇幻动漫插画，采用高耸的垂直构图，以低角度仰视呈现。前景中，一位孤傲空灵的女战士站在一尊巨大的咆哮野兽雕像或被击杀的怪物首级之上，她姿态强劲而稳健，肩扛着一把巨大的哥特式炮枪或教堂柱状武器。武器高得不可思议，由黑铁和石材打造，饰有华丽的尖塔和花丝，缠绕着发光的红色锁链，顶端喷涌出猛烈的深红色火焰、火花和碎片。她身后是一轮巨大的满月，月面上刻着发光的圆形十字准星状纹章，清冷的银光穿透翻滚的云层。女战士拥有极长的飘逸 {argument name="hair color" default="铂金白"} 发丝，在风中向右剧烈飘动，身着层叠破损的黑白礼仪铠甲长袍，带有羽毛和褴褛的质感，融合了哥特骑士、堕天使和女祭司的美学风格。她的面容大部分被遮挡，增添了神秘与庄严感。周围是残破的哥特式教堂塔楼、破碎的飞扶壁、散落的彩色玻璃碎片、漂浮的残骸，以及在暴风雨般的月夜天空中逐渐隐没的远方尖塔。色调以低饱和度的蓝灰色、炭黑色、银色和紫色为主，并点缀着锁链和炮口喷射出的强烈红光。渲染效果呈现为超精细、高对比度、具有绘画感的概念艺术，充满动态感、电影级光影、锐利的大气透视、复杂的建筑破坏细节，以及略带粗粝、质感强烈的视觉效果，营造出一种刻意为之的震撼与戏剧性。强调史诗般的尺度、末日般的宏大感、随风飘动的织物、炽热的余烬以及悲剧性的圣战氛围。

templates.title: Kyoto travel photo editing

titleLocalized.zh: 京都旅游照片编辑

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, transform the same person into a realistic outdoor travel snapshot taken in Kyoto. Replace the indoor amusement park/claw machine background with Kinkaku-ji (Rokuon-ji), featuring a reflecting pond, green trees, blue sky, distant trees and hills, and a wooden fence in the foreground. Keep the face covered by the same rectangular blur/masking block. Change the clothing to a white short-sleeved ribbed knit top (with a tie collar), light blue high-waisted jeans, a thin necklace, and a gray-blue shoulder bag. Adjust the pose so that the person is standing next to the fence, making a peace sign with their right hand to the side of their face. The image features bright, natural midday sunlight, a casual smartphone travel style, realistic proportions, and a soft depth of field.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图像，将同一人物转换为一张在京都拍摄的写实户外旅游快照。将室内游乐场/抓娃娃机的背景替换为金阁寺（鹿苑寺），背景包含倒影池、绿树、蓝天、远处的树木山丘以及前景中的木栅栏。保持面部被同样的矩形模糊/遮挡块遮盖。将服装更换为白色短袖罗纹针织上衣（带系带领口）、浅蓝色高腰牛仔裤、细项链以及灰蓝色单肩包。调整其姿势，使其站在栅栏旁，右手在脸侧比出 1 个剪刀手。明亮的自然正午阳光，休闲智能手机旅游照风格，写实比例，柔和的景深。

templates.title: Transform arcade portraits into Kyoto travel photos

titleLocalized.zh: 将街机厅人像转换为京都旅行照

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, while maintaining the subject's image and realistic photographic style, transform it into a travel snapshot taken outdoors at Kinkaku-ji Temple in Kyoto. Replace the arcade background with Kinkaku-ji Temple by a tranquil pond, featuring green trees, a cloudy daytime sky, and a bamboo fence in the foreground. Recompose the image as a portrait mobile photo, showing the subject's body from mid-thigh up, standing in front of Kinkaku-ji Temple, with their left hand making a peace sign near their face. Change the clothing to a white short-sleeved T-shirt paired with a sleeveless white printed dress, adding a thin crossbody strap and bracelet. Remove all captions, watermarks, claw machine images, and plush toys. Keep the face area occluded/blurred as shown in the reference image.

templates.title: Dark West Gunslinger in the Rain

titleLocalized.zh: 雨中暗黑西部枪手

templates.prompt: A cinematic black-and-white New Western scene unfolds in a downpour: a lone cowboy gunslinger walks directly towards the camera along a muddy road, fully visible in the center of the frame. He wears a dark, wide-brimmed cowboy hat, a soaked long leather overcoat, a dark shirt, dark trousers, gloves, and boots, rain glistening on every surface. His face is shrouded in deep shadow, creating an atmosphere of anonymity and intimidation. One hand holds a revolver pointing downwards. Behind him, on the right side of the road, a similarly rain-soaked dark horse stands or slowly follows, slightly out of focus but clearly visible. On the left side of the road, a solitary wooden cross stands on a gravestone. The terrain is flat and desolate, with open fields stretching into the distance under low-hanging storm clouds. The road is strewn with puddles and reflective, wet mud, with splashes of water visible around the cowboy's boots. The film employs dramatic storm lighting, high contrast, deep blacks, silver highlights, and a somber, contemplative atmosphere. The composition should evoke the feel of a dark Western movie poster, symmetrical yet confrontational, with the central figure dominating the image, raindrops piercing vertically across the entire frame, clear textures of the coat and soil, and a shallow background depth, presenting an overall tone of fortitude, melancholy, and menacing.

promptLocalized.zh: 一场大雨中电影质感的黑白新西部场景：一位孤独的牛仔枪手正沿着泥泞的道路径直朝镜头走来，位于画面中央，全身可见。他戴着深色宽檐牛仔帽，穿着一件湿透的长款皮质风衣、深色衬衫、深色长裤、手套和靴子，雨水在每一处表面闪烁。他的脸隐藏在深邃的阴影中，营造出一种匿名且威慑的氛围。他的一只手拿着一把向下指的左轮手枪。在他身后道路的右侧，站着或缓慢跟随一匹同样被雨水淋湿的深色马匹，略微失焦但清晰可见。道路左侧插着一个孤零零的木制墓碑十字架。地势平坦、荒凉，低垂的暴风云下，开阔的田野向远方延伸。道路上布满了水坑和反光的湿泥，牛仔靴子周围可见飞溅的水花。使用戏剧性的风暴光影、高对比度、深邃的黑色、银色的高光以及阴郁、沉思的氛围。构图应呈现出暗黑西部电影海报的感觉，对称且具有对抗性，中心人物占据画面主导地位，雨丝垂直穿过整个画面，外套和泥土质感清晰，背景景深较浅，整体呈现出一种坚毅、忧郁且充满威胁的基调。

templates.title: Anonymous Cowboy in the Rain

titleLocalized.zh: 雨中匿名的牛仔

templates.prompt: A cinematic black-and-white portrait depicts a lonely figure.{argument name="character type" default="cowboy"} He walks directly towards the camera on a flooded dirt road in a wide-open countryside. Centered in the frame, fully visible, he wears a dark, wide-brimmed cowboy hat, a long, rain-soaked leather overcoat over dark clothing, and heavy boots splashing shallow water. His face is completely obscured by a smooth, rectangular blur or occlusion, creating an anonymous and unsettling presence. A simple wooden cross is stuck to the left of the road. The background is a desolate, flat landscape with low-lying grass, a winding, muddy path stretching into the distance, and dramatic storm clouds hanging low in the sky. The composition emphasizes the damp texture, reflective puddles, cascading raindrops, melancholic contrast, rugged realism, and a somber, almost bleak atmosphere reminiscent of a still from a New Western thriller. Shot from eye level, with a symmetrical composition, a centered subject, and a slightly hazy depth of field in the background, it boasts high detail, monochrome, and photorealistic quality.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影质感的黑白肖像，描绘了一位孤独的 {argument name="character type" default="牛仔"} 正走在开阔乡村被水淹没的土路上，径直走向镜头。他位于画面中心，全身可见，戴着深色宽檐牛仔帽，身穿浸透雨水的长款皮风衣，内搭深色衣物，沉重的靴子溅起浅水。他的面部被一个平滑的矩形模糊或遮挡块完全遮盖，营造出一种匿名且令人不安的存在感。路左侧插着 1 个简单的木制十字架。背景是荒凉平坦的景观，长着低矮的草丛，一条蜿蜒的泥泞小路延伸至远方，戏剧性的风暴云低垂在天空中。强调潮湿的质感、反光的水洼、向下倾泻的雨滴、忧郁的对比度、粗犷的写实感，以及如同新西部惊悚片剧照般严峻而阴郁的氛围。采用平视视角正面拍摄，构图对称，主体居中，远景带有轻微的景深雾气，高细节，单色，照片级写实。

The materials are realistic, the shadows are soft, and the overall visualization quality is top-tier. The lower half features a clean presentation layout on a white background, complete with Chinese labels and thin dividing lines, reminiscent of an architectural concept project. The left side contains a text block with one title and three lines of specifications: the title is {argument name="headline text" default="Modern minimalist style villa"} Following this are Chinese descriptions of the area, dimensions, and structural/feature descriptions. In the middle are two labeled floor plans, both drawn in a grayscale architectural style, including furniture and room outlines: one labeled "First Floor Plan" and the other "Second Floor Plan," both marked with dimensions of 13000 x 10000. To the right is a column of four interior perspective thumbnails, each labeled with Chinese room tags: "Living Room," "Dining Room," "Master Bedroom," and "Master Bedroom." At the bottom is a horizontal row of four additional perspective thumbnails, labeled "Kitchen," "Staircase," "Bathroom," and "Balcony." Total number of thumbnail renderings: 8; total number of floor plans: 2; total number of main layout areas: 4. The interior thumbnails should be consistent with the overall design language of the house: warm neutral tones, beige and wood tones, minimalist luxury furniture, integrated lighting, clean cabinetry, modern staircase, hotel-style bathroom, and scenic balcony seating. The overall style resembles a high-end developer's sales project or an architect's concept page, with a clear grid layout, balanced margins, an editorial-grade presentation effect, ultra-detailed, realistic, and high-resolution.

一张柔和的水彩少女漫画风格插画，描绘了一位美丽的成年幻想女性冒险者在温馨质朴的意大利餐厅独自用餐。画面采用半身构图，她位于木桌中央，拥有飘逸的 {argument name="hair color" default="金色"} 长发、精致的五官和梦幻般的浪漫表情，一只戴着手套的手托着脸颊，另一只手拿着叉子。她身穿蓝色幻想风格服装，肩部和胸部配有棕色皮革盔甲，袖子修长合身，内搭低领白色上衣，造型如同 RPG 游戏女主角，但以优雅、柔美的少女漫画感呈现。她面前是一盘白色的番茄酱意大利面，撒有磨碎的奶酪，顶部正好有 2 片罗勒叶，叉子上挑起了一小口面条。桌上正好有 1 个白色意面盘，左下角前景有 1 个水杯，右下角有一个柳条篮装着的 1 瓶绿色葡萄酒。背景是温暖的阳光洒进的餐厅内部，以疏朗透明的水彩渲染，左侧有 1 块写着 {argument name="menu board text" default="菜单
意大利面
卡邦尼
肉酱面
蛤蜊面
提拉米苏
葡萄酒"} 的项目，下方架子上有 5 个彩色瓶子，墙上挂着 2 幅画，右上角有 1 盏吊灯，窗边有鲜花装饰。采用纹理纸张质感、柔和的棕褐色轮廓线、温暖的米色和蜂蜜色灯光、轻柔的绘画晕染效果、浪漫的氛围、竖构图，呈现出高端少女漫画水彩插画的精致感。

templates.title: Chengdu Food Stroll Map

titleLocalized.zh: 成都美食漫步地图

templates.prompt: A heartwarming hand-drawn travel and food poster, using a Japanese watercolor sketch style, showcases {argument name="city name" default="Chengdu"} A food walking map. Using textured beige paper as a background, it features ink outlines, impressionistic watercolor washes, handwritten Japanese annotations, decorative miniature steam vortexes, and orange dotted walking routes connecting food stalls and tourist areas. The composition is a compact, single-page illustrated map, with numerous labeled miniature scenes and dishes arranged around the page. The top left corner features a striking calligraphy title, “Chengdu City Gourmet Walking Map,” below which is a ribbon-like subtitle, “Eat, Walk, Enjoy Chengdu!”, and a small speech bubble next to the panda reads, “Welcome to the Gourmet Town!” The page features 11 tagged elements: 1) "Jinli Ancient Street," depicted as a traditional Chinese archway street adorned with red lanterns and bustling with pedestrians; 2) "People's Park," depicted as an outdoor teahouse filled with tea drinkers under the trees; 3) "Dandan Noodles," depicted as spicy noodles picked up with chopsticks; 4) "Xiaolongbao," depicted as bamboo steamers containing soup dumplings and small dipping saucers; 5) "Tea Culture," depicted as a large plastic cup filled with bubble tea printed with "Chengdu"; 6) "Chunxi Road," depicted as a modern commercial street bustling with pedestrians and lined with shops; 7) "Kuanzhai Alley," depicted as the entrance to a historical alleyway frequented by tourists; 8) "Mapo Tofu," depicted as a plate of Mapo Tofu sprinkled with green garnish; 9) "Sichuan Hot Pot," depicted as a yin-yang pot with one side spicy red broth and the other clear broth, surrounded by small portions of ingredients; 10) "Skewered Food," depicted as a lively street stall with customers; 11) A cute panda illustration sits at the bottom center of the page, serving as a mascot resting along the route. Scattered around the food are short, handwritten notes containing Japanese reactions to spiciness, recommendations, and tasting notes, such as "Uma spiciness!", "Hot!", "Jiwa~ru!", "Piri spiciness!", and "Koko gokubeki!". Small red chili pepper illustrations adorn various parts of the page. A torn-paper style sticky note box titled "Osusume Route" is added to the bottom left corner, with recommended routes written below and a small note: "※This is the map." A handwritten slogan, "Chengdu, the City of Gastronomy," is added to the bottom right corner, along with a friendly invitation. Overall atmosphere: charming, alluring, comfortable, editorial, like a travel journal, rich in detail and with a clear layout and balanced white space, it is a captivating travel illustration map.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张温馨的手绘旅行美食海报，采用日式水彩速写风格，展示了 {argument name="city name" default="成都"} 的美食漫步地图。使用带有纹理的米色纸张作为背景，搭配墨水轮廓、写意水彩晕染、手写日文注释、装饰性的小蒸汽漩涡，以及连接美食点和观光区的橙色虚线步行路线。构图为紧凑的单页插画地图，页面周围排列着许多带有标签的微型场景和菜肴。左上角有醒目的毛笔字标题“成都 成都市 グルメ散歩マップ”，下方配有丝带状副标题“食べて、歩いて、楽しむ成都！”，熊猫旁的小对话气泡写着“美食の街へようこそ！”。页面上包含 11 个带标签的特色元素：1) “锦里古街”，表现为挂着红灯笼、行人穿梭的传统中式牌坊街道；2) “人民公园”，表现为树下坐满茶客的户外茶馆；3) “担担面”，表现为被筷子挑起的辛辣面条；4) “小笼包”，表现为装有汤包的竹蒸笼及小蘸碟；5) “茶文化”，表现为印有“成都 CHENGDU”字样、装满珍珠奶茶的大塑料杯；6) “春熙路”，表现为行人往来、店面林立的现代商业街；7) “宽窄巷子”，表现为有游客进出的历史巷弄入口；8) “麻婆豆腐”，表现为撒有绿色点缀的麻婆豆腐盘；9) “四川火锅”，表现为一边红油辣汤、一边清汤的鸳鸯锅，周围摆放着小份食材；10) “串串香”，表现为有顾客光顾的热闹街头摊位；11) 页面中下部有一只可爱的小熊猫插画，作为在路线旁休息的吉祥物。在食物周围散布一些简短的手写标注，包含日文的辛辣反应、推荐和品尝笔记，如“うま辛!”、“熱々!”、“じわぁ〜る!”、“ピリ辛!”和“ここ行くべき!”。页面各处点缀着小红辣椒插画。左下角添加一个标题为“おすすめルート”的撕纸风格便签框，下方写有推荐路线，并附有一行小字“※マップはイメージです”。右下角添加一句手写标语“美食之都・成都”，下方配有一行友好的邀请语。整体氛围：迷人、诱人、舒适、具有编辑感、像旅行日志一样，细节丰富且布局通透，留白平衡，是一张引人入胜的旅游插画地图。

templates.title: Cyberpunk mechanical angels descend upon the megacity

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克机械天使降临超级都市

templates.prompt: A huge{argument name="subject type" default="Mechanical Angel Girl"} Hovering above the densely packed futuristic metropolis at night, the film employs a striking low-angle perspective, making her appear like a divine figure overlooking the entire skyline. She possesses a streamlined female humanoid body composed of white, silver, and graphite biomechanical armor, revealing exposed segmented joints, intricate and sophisticated mechanical structures, and luminous cyan energy lines running through her torso, hips, thighs, knees, and chest. Her face is smooth, almost featureless, like a blank mask, partially obscured by shadows. She wears luminous cyan goggles over her eyes and an exquisite metallic halo-like headdress or antenna device. She possesses two enormous, outstretched wings, each composed of layered metallic feathers in black, gray, and silver. Near the center of each wing is embedded a luminous circular cyan technological badge, totaling two wing badges. Her posture is serene, solemn, and sacred, her arms hanging naturally at her sides, her legs extending downwards, as if descending in silence. Surrounded by heavy rain, mist, drifting particles, and dramatic storm clouds torn apart by the bright sky behind, the scene creates a sacred cyberpunk atmosphere. Below lies a vast vertical city, densely packed with dark skyscrapers dotted with thousands of tiny window lights, shrouded in mist and steam, the ground reflecting a damp sheen. The image includes four flying vehicles or drones scattered across the city's skies. Added are neon billboards with an East Asian futuristic urban style, including a large red vertical sign on the left reading "Warning" and the smaller English word "ALERT"; a smaller red sign reading "Emergency Alert"; a large billboard on the right reading "Angels, Descend."; and two billboards depicting the same mechanical angel image. The color scheme is cool steel gray, midnight blue, black, white, and electric cyan, accented with scattered red neon lights. Style: Ultra-refined, cinematic sci-fi illustrations, a fusion of dystopian cyberpunk and biblical angelic imagery, combining painterly qualities with clarity, a rich atmosphere, an epic scale, high contrast, rain-soaked details, awe-inspiring, unforgettable, and magnificent.

promptLocalized.zh: 一位巨大的 {argument name="subject type" default="机械天使少女"} 悬浮在夜晚密集的未来超级都市上空，采用极具张力的低角度仰拍视角，使她如同神迹般俯瞰整个天际线。她拥有流线型的女性人形躯体，由白色、银色和石墨色生物机械装甲构成，裸露的分段式关节、错综复杂的精密机械结构，以及贯穿躯干、髋部、大腿、膝盖和胸部的发光青色能量线。她的面部平滑，几乎没有五官，宛如一张空白面具，部分隐没在阴影中，双眼处佩戴着发光的青色护目镜，头戴精致的金属光环状头饰或天线装置。她拥有 2 只巨大的伸展羽翼，每只翅膀由黑色、灰色和银色的层叠金属羽毛组成，每只翅膀中心附近各嵌入 1 个发光的圆形青色科技徽章，总计 2 个翅膀徽章。她的姿态沉静、庄严且神圣，双臂自然垂于身侧，双腿向下延伸，仿佛在寂静中降临。周围环绕着大雨、薄雾、漂浮的微粒，以及被身后明亮天光撕裂的戏剧性风暴云，营造出神圣的赛博朋克氛围。下方是广袤的垂直城市，暗色的摩天大楼密布，点缀着成千上万的微小窗灯，弥漫着雾气与蒸汽，地面反射着湿润的光泽。画面中包含 4 架散布在城市半空中的飞行载具或无人机。添加带有东亚未来都市风格的霓虹灯广告牌，包括左侧一个巨大的红色竖排标识，写有“警戒”及小字英文“ALERT”；一个较小的红色标识写有“緊急警報”；右侧一个巨大的广告牌写有“天使, 降臨。”；以及 2 个描绘相同机械天使形象的广告牌。配色方案：冷钢灰色、午夜蓝、黑色、白色和电光青色，辅以零星的红色霓虹灯点缀。风格：超精细电影级科幻插画，反乌托邦赛博朋克与圣经天使意象的结合，兼具绘画感与清晰度，浓郁的大气效果，史诗般的尺度，高对比度，雨水浸润，令人敬畏、难以忘怀且宏伟壮丽。

promptLocalized.zh:
一张细节极其丰富的奇幻收藏卡插画，采用优质日式手游 RPG 风格，垂直集换式卡牌布局，配有华丽的金色花丝边框、冰蓝色宝石装饰以及精致的深海军蓝 UI。主画面展示了 {argument name="character name" default="SERA"}，一位神圣的北方祭司战士，以英雄般的全身姿态屹立在画面中央前景，正视前方。她身穿精美的银白色礼仪铠甲，配有雕刻金属工艺、毛皮镶边肩甲、多层白色布料饰板、半透明冰晶装饰以及发光的蓝色宝石镶嵌。她留着一头极长且浓密的金色长辫垂在身前，皮肤白皙，表情高贵而冷峻。右手握着一把优雅的长柄冰铸剑，剑尖向下倾斜。在她身后和身侧是一只巨大的守护虎，拥有白色皮毛、深色条纹、发光的青色双眼，头部、肩部和前肢长有巨大的锯齿状蓝色水晶，姿态既具保护性又充满攻击性。背景是冰封的星辰宫殿景观，矗立着冰尖塔、水晶建筑，伴有雪花粒子、冷蓝色光芒，以及横跨暴风雨夜空的闪电。色调以白色、银色、蓝宝石色、青色光芒和金色镶边为主，细节极致，线条清晰，具有发光的魔法效果、强烈的对比度以及扭蛋游戏稀有卡牌的渲染效果。

画面中需集成精确的卡牌 UI 元素：顶部中央为黑金配色的标题牌，文字为 "{argument name="card title" default="神異 - Divine Anomaly -"}"；左上角为一个巨大的虹彩金色稀有度徽章，显示 "UR"，下方直接排列 8 颗金星。底部中央为一个大型黑金名牌，文字为 "セラ / {argument name="display name" default="SERA"}"，下方副标题为 "北の都の巫女 / Priestess of the Northern Capital"。在底部属性栏上方，包含 4 个矩形信息面板，呈 2x2 排列，每个面板左侧带有圆形图标：面板 1 标签 "属性 / Attribute"，值为 "金・氷・雷"，英文行 "METAL + ICE + THUNDER"；面板 2 标签 "守護神 / Guardian Deity"，值为 "雷晶虎 / Thunder Crystal Tiger"；面板 3 标签 "役割 / Role"，值为 "殲滅・制圧 / Attack Control"；面板 4 标签 "スキル / Skill"，值为 "零界断罪 / Absolute Zero Verdict"。最底部为 5 部分组成的属性栏，从左至右依次为图标、标签和数值，具体属性如下："ATK 980"、"DEF 870"、"SPD 760"、"MAG 930"、"SUP 620"。保持所有排版优雅、浮雕感强且具有高奇幻质感，采用日英双语文字，呈现出光泽感卡牌游戏质感、对称构图以及奢华的优质卡牌展示效果。

templates.prompt: A gorgeous, high-fantasy collectible character card with a sophisticated mobile RPG style. It features a full-width vertical composition, a magnificent black and gold mesh border, and luminous emerald accents. She wears a long, semi-transparent veil, floral embroidery, vine trim, delicate beading, and numerous small white flowers woven into her clothing and hair. Her face is mostly hidden in the shadows of her hood and veil, creating an ethereal and mysterious visual effect. She holds a slender wooden bow entwined with vines and flowers. Behind her stands a majestic spirit deer made of living wood and roots, its antlers covered in flowers, its eyes gleaming with a pale light, and a turquoise magical vortex on its chest. The background is a dense, sacred forest with towering trees, dappled beams of light, floating dust, glowing sprites, circular magical rings, reflections on the water, and a soft, turquoise atmospheric mist. The game features ultra-detailed fantasy illustrations, an elegant, realistic painting style, rich textures, glowing magical effects, intricate costume design, and a premium collectible card feel. At the top center, there is a dark green plaque with gold trim that reads "Divine Anomaly -". In the upper left corner, there is a very large iridescent rarity marker "UR" with a purple-to-blue glow, below which are 7 gold stars. In the upper right corner, a circular green elemental badge with white leaves and wind patterns is added, below which is a small plaque that reads "Attribute: Wood/Wind". Near the bottom center, a large circular dark green plaque with gold trim is added, displaying the character name "RINEA" and the subtitle "Priestess of the Western Forest". Create three middle information panels above the attribute row. Each panel is dark green with a gold border and a circular icon: Panel 1 is labeled "Guardian Deity," with the value "Forest Spirit Deer," and the English subtitle "Forest Spirit Deer"; Panel 2 is labeled "Servitude," with the value "Purify Regenerate," and the English subtitle "Purify Regenerate"; Panel 3 is labeled "Skill," with the value "Requiem of Verdant Souls," and the English subtitle "Requiem of Verdant Souls." Create five attribute panels at the bottom with icons and large serif numbers, from left to right: "ATK 720," "DEF 810," "SPD 840," "MAG 910," and "SUP 880." Overall style: High-end gacha card UI, sacred natural fantasy, ornate decorative borders, glowing emerald green and gold color scheme, clear typography, symmetrical and exquisite layout, highly refined and solemn.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张采用高级手游 RPG 风格的华丽高奇幻收藏级角色卡，全幅垂直构图，配有华丽的黑金丝网边框和发光的祖母绿装饰。卡牌描绘了 {argument name="character name" default="リネア / RINEA"}，一位站在魔法林间溪流中的神秘森林祭司，身着象牙白、鼠尾草绿、苔藓绿和柔和金色层叠的飘逸长袍，配有长长的半透明面纱、花卉刺绣、藤蔓饰边、精致的珠饰，以及编织在服饰和头发中的许多小白花。她的脸大部分隐藏在兜帽和面纱的阴影下，呈现出一种空灵且神秘的视觉效果。她手持一把缠绕着藤蔓和花朵的纤细木弓。在她身后站着一只由活木和树根构成的雄伟灵鹿，鹿角上覆盖着花朵，双眼闪烁着苍白的光芒，胸前有一个青绿色的魔法漩涡。背景是茂密的神圣森林，有高大的树木、斑驳的光束、漂浮的尘埃、发光的精灵、圆形的魔法环、水面反射和柔和的青绿色大气雾气。采用超精细的奇幻插画渲染、优雅的绘画写实风格、丰富的质感、发光的魔法效果、复杂的服装设计以及高级集换式卡牌的质感。

在顶部中央，有一个带有金色饰边的深绿色铭牌，上面写着“神異 - Divine Anomaly -”。在左上角，放置一个非常大的虹彩稀有度标记“UR”，带有紫到青的辉光，下方有 7 颗金星。在右上角，添加一个带有白色叶子和风图案的圆形绿色元素徽章，下方是一个写着“属性 木・風 WOOD + WIND”的小牌匾。在下部中央附近，添加一个大的圆形深绿色牌匾，带有金色边缘，显示角色名称“リネア / RINEA”和副标题“西の森の巫女 / Priestess of the Western Forest”。

在属性行上方创建 3 个中间信息面板，每个面板均为深绿色，带有金色边框和圆形图标：面板 1 标记为“守護神”，数值为“森の精霊鹿”，英文副标题为“Forest Spirit Deer”；面板 2 标记为“役割”，数值为“浄化・再生”，英文副标题为“Purify Regenerate”；面板 3 标记为“スキル”，数值为“鎮魂の森風”，英文副标题为“Requiem of Verdant Souls”。

在底部创建 5 个带有图标和大型衬线数字的属性面板，从左到右依次为：“ATK 720”、“DEF 810”、“SPD 840”、“MAG 910”、“SUP 880”。整体风格：高级扭蛋卡 UI、神圣自然奇幻、华丽装饰边框、发光的祖母绿与金色配色、清晰的排版、对称且精致的布局，高度精细且庄严。

templates.title: UR Fox Fairy Priest Fantasy Cards

titleLocalized.zh: UR 狐仙祭司奇幻卡牌

templates.prompt: A luxurious fantasy trading card illustration, featuring a high-quality anime gacha style, a vertical layout, and a gorgeous gold-plated border with gem inlays, designed like an ultra-rare character card. The card depicts a character named {argument name="character name" default="カヤ / KAYA"} The image depicts a full-body shrine priestess, standing slightly to the right of center, against a backdrop of a dreamy, pinkish-purple sacred forest filled with cherry blossoms, glowing lanterns, mist, a small waterfall, and shrine architecture. She is a beautiful and elegant young woman with a remarkably graceful presence.{argument name="hair color" default="Soft pink"} She has long hair, fox ears, and wears a white fox mask on one side of her head, ceremonially partially obscuring her upper face. She wears an exquisitely layered kimono and priest's robe in pink, rose, plum, and gold, adorned with intricate embroidery, shoulder armor, woven ropes, paper talismans, decorative tassels, and luminous gemstone ornaments. She holds a magnificent ceremonial staff topped with rings, talismans, ribbons, and several large purple crystal balls. To her left sits a sacred white fox spirit beast with nine enormous, glowing tails and delicate golden vine-like patterns. The entire image is filled with magical flashes, soft diffused lighting, shimmering particles, and ethereal pink light effects. The card layout must include precisely visible areas and labels. At the top center is a dark plaque with a gold border, inscribed "Divine Anomaly -". In the upper left corner is a large gradient rarity marker "UR", below which are seven gold stars arranged directly. The left side contains four stacked black metallic attribute panels with icons and bilingual labels: 1) Water drop icon, "Attribute", "Water Prayer", "WATER + PRAYER"; 2) Fox head icon, "Guardian Deity", "Golden Vine White Fox"; 3) Hand gesture icon, "Yakuza", "Heal Support"; 4) Circular mark icon, "Skill", "Prayer Light Barrier". At the bottom center is a large plaque that reads "KAYA", with the subtitle "Priestess of the Eastern Village". Along the bottom edge are five attribute panels, with icons and values ​​arranged in this exact order: ATK 760, DEF 690, SPD 820, MAG 960, SUP 990. Employing highly refined collector's card aesthetics, the design features dense decorative filigree, engraved gold edges, gemstone corners, dramatic fantasy lighting, ultra-detailed costume design, soft anime-style rendering, a luminous magical atmosphere, and a rich harmony of pink, gold, ivory, and violet colors. The final image should evoke the feel of a high-rarity Sacred Fox Oracle card—grand, mysterious, elegant, and sophisticated.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张奢华的奇幻集换式卡牌插画，采用优质动漫抽卡风格，竖版构图，带有华丽的镀金边框和宝石镶嵌，设计如同超稀有角色卡。卡牌展示了一位名为 {argument name="character name" default="カヤ / KAYA"} 的全身神社祭司，她站在画面中心偏右的位置，背景是充满樱花、发光灯笼、薄雾、小瀑布和神社建筑的梦幻粉紫色圣林。她是一位美丽优雅的年轻女性，拥有非常飘逸的 {argument name="hair color" default="柔粉色"} 长发、狐狸耳朵，头上侧戴着一个白色狐狸面具，以仪式感造型半遮住上半脸。她身着精致的层叠和服与祭司袍，配色为粉色、玫瑰色、梅红色和金色，配有复杂的刺绣、肩甲、编织绳、纸符、装饰性流苏和发光的宝石饰品。她手持一根华丽的仪式法杖，顶端饰有圆环、符咒、丝带和多颗巨大的紫色水晶球。她左侧坐着一只神圣的白狐灵兽，拥有九条巨大的发光尾巴和精致的金色藤蔓状花纹。整幅画面充满了魔法闪光、柔和的泛光照明、闪烁的微粒和空灵的粉色光效。

卡牌布局必须包含精确可见的区域和标签。顶部中央是一块带有金边的深色牌匾，写着“神異 - Divine Anomaly -”。左上角有一个巨大的渐变稀有度标记“UR”，下方直接排列着 7 颗金星。左侧包含 4 个堆叠的黑金属性面板，带有图标和双语标签：1) 水滴图标，“属性”，“水・祈”，“WATER + PRAYER”；2) 狐头图标，“守護神”，“黄金の蔓の白狐”，“Golden Vine White Fox”；3) 合十礼图标，“役割”，“祈癒・支援”，“Heal Support”；4) 圆形印记图标，“技能”，“祈灯结界”，“Prayer Light Barrier”。底部中央是一块大型铭牌，写着“カヤ / KAYA”，下方副标题为“東の里の巫女 / Priestess of the Eastern Village”。沿底部边缘包含 5 个属性面板，按此精确顺序排列图标和数值：ATK 760、DEF 690、SPD 820、MAG 960、SUP 990。

采用高度精炼的收藏级卡牌美学，密集的装饰性花丝、雕刻金边、宝石边角、戏剧性的奇幻光影、超精细的服装设计、柔和的动漫绘画渲染、发光的魔法氛围，以及粉色、金色、象牙白和紫罗兰色的丰富色彩和谐。最终图像应呈现出高稀有度神圣狐仙神谕卡的感觉，宏伟、神秘、优雅且高端。

templates.title: Neon Japanese AI Prompt Promo Banner

titleLocalized.zh: Neon Japanese AI Prompt Promo Banner

templates.prompt: Create a high-impact Japanese-style homepage banner to promote digital products featuring business infographics and slide prompts, employing a futuristic neon tech aesthetic. Use a 16:9 widescreen composition, a deep black background with a subtle dark blue grid texture, glowing blue beams, and a soft green energy wave sweeping across the lower right corner. The overall visual should convey a high-end, cyberpunk glow, and modern SaaS marketing feel, with sharp contrast and sophisticated UI lighting effects. Place the ChatGPT logo and "ChatGPT" lettering in the upper left corner, featuring a green and white glowing effect. Near the center of the upper part, add a rounded, glowing blue capsule badge with a small label that reads "NEW" and the main text "GPT Images 2.0". In the upper right corner, place a green rounded rectangle app-style badge with a note logo and the word "note". On the left half, build a stack of Japanese main titles. Above the titles, add a small label with a green outline that reads "ChatGPT Images 2.0 Specialized". Next, a very eye-catching two-line bold white title is placed: “Video Mapping Slide” and “Prompt”. Next to the second line, a large, glowing electric blue number “50” is placed with a bright neon edge, and a smaller “Select” character in the lower right corner. Below the title, a thin, blue neon horizontal dividing line is added. Below that, the Japanese subtitle is placed: “Property Quality Mapping ga, swipe de suru.”, where the “swipe de” character group is highlighted in bright blue, while the rest remains white. In the right half, three stacked, floating dark UI cards are displayed with blue neon outlines, each slightly tilted and glowing, like preview thumbnails of a business slides template. The number of cards is strictly three. The top card should display an organizational chart template titled "01 Organizational Structure Chart Template," with a subtitle, a CEO box at the top, four department boxes below, and a total of eight member boxes at the bottom. The middle card should display a data analysis dashboard template titled "01 Data Analysis/Graphic Chart Template," including a green percentage "+32.5%," a monthly vertical bar chart with six bars (labeled from January to June), and a donut chart legend containing four items. The bottom card should display a business process diagram template titled "01 Business Process Chart Template," containing a five-step horizontal icon process connected by arrows, with a brief Japanese label below each step. At the bottom, create a row of four function items separated by thin vertical dividing lines. Each function item should have a glowing circular icon and two lines of white Japanese text. These four functions are: “50 Selectable Programs for Easy Use”, “High-Precision Tentation for Specialized Businesses”, “Maximize Short Time & High-Quality Operation Efficiency”, and “Make Business Utilization Safe”. The icon styles should be inspired by lightning bolts, targets/crosshairs, clocks, and shields, respectively. The typography should use bold, geometric sans-serif fonts, with large, neatly aligned Japanese title text and clear hierarchy. Emphasize blue and green neon effects, glossy reflections, glowing edges, and a clean, conversion-oriented landing page aesthetic. Avoid using people or photographs; use only graphic design, UI cards, icons, and Japanese marketing text.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张具有高影响力的日式宣传首屏横幅，用于推广关于商业信息图表和 Slides 提示词的数字产品，采用未来感霓虹科技风格。使用 16:9 的宽屏构图，深黑色背景，带有微妙的深蓝色网格纹理，发光的蓝色光束，以及在右下角扫过的柔和绿色能量波。整体视觉应呈现出高端、赛博发光、现代 SaaS 营销的质感，具备清晰的对比度和精致的 UI 灯光效果。

在左上角放置 ChatGPT Logo 和“ChatGPT”字样，呈现绿色和白色发光效果。在上部中心附近，添加一个圆角发光蓝色胶囊徽章，带有一个写着“NEW”的小标签，主文字为“GPT Images 2.0”。在右上角，放置一个绿色圆角矩形 App 风格徽章，带有 note Logo 和“note”字样。

在左半部分，构建日文主标题堆栈。在标题上方添加一个绿色轮廓的小标签，文字为“ChatGPT Images 2.0 特化”。接着放置一个非常醒目的两行白色粗体大标题：“ビジネス図解・スライド”和“プロンプト”。在第二行旁边，放置一个超大的发光电蓝色数字“50”，带有明亮的霓虹边缘光，右下角附带较小的“選”字。在标题下方，添加一条细长的蓝色霓虹水平分割线。在其下方，放置日文副标题：“プロ品質の図解が、秒で完成する。”，其中“秒で”字符组以亮蓝色高亮显示，其余部分保持白色。

在右半部分，展示 3 张堆叠的悬浮深色 UI 卡片，带有蓝色霓虹轮廓，每张卡片略微倾斜并带有发光效果，如同商业 Slides 模板的预览缩略图。卡片数量严格为 3 张。最上方的卡片应显示组织架构图模板，标题为“01 組織体制図のテンプレート”，包含一行小副标题，顶部有一个 CEO 框，下方有 4 个部门框，最底层总共有 8 个成员框。中间的卡片应显示数据分析仪表板模板，标题为“01 データ分析・グラフ図解のテンプレート”，包含一个绿色百分比“+32.5%”、一个带有 6 根柱状图的月度垂直柱状图（标注 1 月至 6 月），以及一个包含 4 个项目的圆环图图例。最下方的卡片应显示商业流程图模板，标题为“01 ビジネスプロセス図解のテンプレート”，包含一个由箭头连接的 5 步水平图标流程，每个步骤下方有简短的日文标签。

在底部，创建一行由细垂直分割线隔开的 4 个功能项。每个功能项应有一个发光的圆形图标和两行白色日文文本。这 4 个功能分别是：“すぐに使える プロンプト50選”、“ビジネス特化の 高精度テンプレート”、“時短＆高品質 作業効率を最大化”以及“商用利用も安心 そのまま使える”。图标风格分别参考闪电、目标/十字准星、时钟和盾牌。

排版应采用粗体、几何无衬线字体，日文标题文字要极大，对齐整齐，层级分明。强调蓝色和绿色霓虹光效、光泽反射、发光边缘，以及简洁的转化导向型落地页美学。不要出现人物或摄影照片，仅使用图形设计、UI 卡片、图标和日文营销文本。

templates.title: Modern-day Sukeban street portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 现代版太妹（Sukeban）街头肖像

templates.prompt: A full-body street portrait in a fashionable editorial style depicts a modern-day Japanese delinquent vigilante, standing with her legs apart at the center of a crossroads in Tokyo's bustling entertainment district. The slightly upward-angled shot conveys a bold sense of heroism. She is a young Japanese woman with {argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown"} Her hair was styled in a high ponytail, with a few stray strands falling down. She wore a white sailor-style school uniform with a navy blue collar, tied with a large, deep red bow, paired with a dark navy blue pleated mini-skirt, an oversized black leather motorcycle jacket, white mid-calf socks, and thick-soled white sneakers with bright red laces. One hand casually held a metal yo-yo, the string dangling as her signature weapon, while her other hand was in her jacket pocket. Her posture was confident, rebellious, and confrontational, as if in response to…{argument name="character concept" default="Sukeban Deka (Detective Sister)"} A contemporary reinterpretation. The scene is set on a real Tokyo city street, with a zebra crossing underfoot, cars parked behind, pedestrians on the sidewalk, and vertical Japanese shop signs and billboards hanging from the skyscrapers, the background gradually blurring. Using shallow depth of field, the urban background is clearly discernible yet softly blurred, while the subject remains sharp and centered in the frame. The lighting is bright natural daylight, with soft contrast, realistic skin tones, and the sharpness of high-fashion photography, creating a cinematic urban cool-girl atmosphere. Emphasizing realism, the high detail of the leather texture and pleated skirt is showcased, with the ponytail swaying gently in the wind, presenting a refined contemporary Japanese street style aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张全身时尚编辑风格的街头肖像，描绘了一位现代日本不良少女义警，双腿分开站在东京繁华娱乐区十字路口中央，采用略微仰视的拍摄角度，展现出大胆的英雄气概。她是一位年轻的日本女性，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 的高马尾，有几缕碎发垂下，身穿带有海军蓝领子的白色水手服校服，系着大大的深红色蝴蝶结，搭配深海军蓝百褶短裙、超大号黑色皮质机车夹克、白色中筒袜以及带有亮红色鞋带的厚底白色运动鞋。她的一只手随意地拿着一个金属溜溜球，绳子垂下作为标志性武器，另一只手插在夹克口袋里。姿势自信、叛逆且具有对抗性，仿佛是对 {argument name="character concept" default="太妹刑事（Sukeban Deka）"} 的当代重新诠释。场景设定在真实的东京城市街道上，脚下是斑马线，身后停着汽车，人行道上有行人，高楼大厦上挂满了垂直的日式商店招牌和广告牌，背景逐渐虚化。使用浅景深，使城市背景清晰可辨但柔和模糊，同时主体清晰且位于画面中心。光线为明亮的自然日间光，对比柔和，肤色真实，具有高级时尚摄影的锐度以及电影般的城市酷女孩氛围。强调写实感，展现皮革纹理和百褶裙的高细节，马尾随风微动，呈现出精致的当代日本街头风格美学。

templates.title: Manga Pillar Anime Character Poster

titleLocalized.zh: Manga Pillar 动漫角色海报

templates.prompt: A vertical, full-body poster of an anime character, inspired by the dynamic entrance of a comic book hero. The upper left corner features the striking, bold Japanese title "マンガ柱" (Manga Pillar), with the smaller kana "ばしら" (Bashira) above it. Below is a black nameplate with a pink border that reads "漫画咲" (Manga Saki), also with kana above the kanji. In the center stands a vibrant young female anime swordswoman, confidently striding forward, facing the camera with a radiant smile and sparkling eyes. She has extremely long, voluminous twin tails, and her hair is [color missing].{argument name="hair color" default="Soft pink"} Her hair is studded with blue, yellow, and pale purple highlights and adorned with numerous hair clips and ribbons, including small tags with manga themes. Her eyes are large and bright, a vibrant pinkish-purple with a glossy sheen. She wears a Demon Slayer-style uniform in deep navy blue or black, complete with gold buttons, a white belt, loose-fitting joggers, white leggings printed with manga onomatopoeia and graffiti, and black platform sandals with pink straps. Over the uniform is a flowing haori, the outer layer covered with black and white manga panels and ink drawings, while the inner lining is bright pink. She holds a katana in each hand: one sword is held horizontally across her shoulder in her right hand, and the other hangs down in her left. The scabbards and hilts of both swords are decorated with manga elements and accented with pink, with one scabbard bearing prominent Japanese characters. Small star-shaped sparkles are added around the character. Scattered manga pages and cropped manga panels are arranged diagonally in the scene, as if blown by the wind. The image features three large, pink and black cartoon onomatopoeic words: "Don!" in the lower left corner, "Don!" near the lower right leg, and "Don!" to the right of the haori. It also includes two speech bubbles: a spiked bubble in the upper right corner containing "!!", and a vertical spiked bubble on the left containing Japanese dialogue. The background features soft pink and white halftone dots and ink splatter patterns with inward-converging dynamic speed lines, creating a comic book cover-like visual effect. The highly detailed and exquisite anime illustrations boast clear lines, vivid expressions, strong hair shine, a stylish and fantastical design, a playful hero pose, a vibrant pink color scheme, and poster-quality composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张竖构图的全身动漫角色海报，设计灵感源自极具张力的漫画英雄登场画面。左上方印有醒目的粗体日文标题“マンガ柱”，上方带有小字假名“ばしら”；下方配有一个带有粉色边框的黑色名牌，上面写着“漫画咲”，汉字上方同样带有假名。画面中央站着一位充满活力的少女动漫剑士，她自信地迈开双腿，正面对着镜头，笑容灿烂，双眼闪烁着光芒。她留着一头极长且蓬松的双马尾，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="柔粉色"}，发间穿插着青色、黄色和淡紫色的挑染，并装饰着许多发夹和丝带，其中包括带有漫画主题的小标签。她的双眼又大又亮，呈现出鲜艳的粉紫色，带有光泽感。她身穿深海军蓝或黑色的鬼灭风格制服，配有金色纽扣、白色腰带、宽松的束脚裤、印有漫画拟声词和涂鸦的白色绑腿，以及带有粉色绑带的黑色厚底凉鞋。制服外罩着一件飘逸的羽织，外层布满了黑白漫画分镜和墨绘图形，内衬则为亮粉色。她双手各持一把武士刀：右手将一把刀横扛在肩上，左手垂下一把刀。两把刀的刀鞘和刀柄均装饰有漫画元素，并带有粉色点缀，其中一个刀鞘上还印有醒目的日文字样。在角色周围添加一些小星星状的闪光。画面中散落着飞舞的漫画书页和剪裁过的漫画分镜，呈对角线分布，仿佛被风吹起。画面中包含 3 处粉色与黑色的大号漫画拟声词：左下方一处“ドン!”，右下腿部附近一处“ドン!”，以及羽织右侧一处“ドン”。此外还包含 2 个对话气泡：右上角一个尖刺状气泡内写着“!!”，左侧一个垂直的尖刺状气泡内写着日文对话。背景为柔和的粉白双色网点与墨迹飞溅图案，并带有向内汇聚的动态速度线，营造出漫画封面跨页的视觉效果。高细节精致动漫插画，线条清晰，表情生动，发丝光泽感强，时尚奇幻造型，俏皮英雄姿态，以粉色为主调的鲜艳配色，海报级构图。

templates.prompt: A dramatic fantasy wildlife illustration featuring a {argument name="creature name" default="Nue"} The beast, centered in the center, crept towards the viewer against a backdrop of towering Alpine cliffs above the clouds. This chimera seamlessly blends three main animal features: the face and black-and-white fur of a raccoon or leopard, the muscular orange-and-black striped body of a tiger, and a long, scaly tail curving upwards. Its thick, realistic fur, dark mane-like folds around its neck, round ears, amber eyes, and an alert yet eerie expression are all striking. Its raised forelimbs reveal massive, curved black claws, emphasizing its stealthy and predatory gait. The scene is set in…{argument name="mountain setting" default="A cliff at an altitude of 3,000 meters in the rugged snow-capped mountains."} The background features steep forest valleys, jagged snow-capped peaks, scattered conifers, exposed rocks, and bright sunlight under blue skies and white clouds. The film employs a cinematic low-angle perspective, with creatures dominating the foreground, ultra-detailed hyper-realistic textures, natural lighting, and a clear focus on the monster. The background possesses atmospheric depth, creating an epic monster encyclopedia aesthetic, believable anatomical structures, high contrast, and an atmosphere that is both solemn and sinister.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张戏剧性的奇幻野生动物插画，主角为一只 {argument name="creature name" default="鵺"}，全身居中展示，正向观众潜行，背景是云层上方高耸的阿尔卑斯岩架。这只野兽是一只奇美拉，其身体无缝融合了 3 种主要的动物特征：貉或狸猫的面部及黑白相间的毛绒面具、老虎肌肉发达的橙黑条纹身体，以及身后向上弯曲的 1 条带状鳞片长蛇尾。其毛发浓密且逼真，颈部周围有深色的鬃毛状褶边，圆耳朵，琥珀色的眼睛，表情警觉且诡异。前肢抬起，露出巨大的黑色弯曲利爪，强调出潜行和捕食的步态。场景设定在 {argument name="mountain setting" default="崎岖雪山脉中海拔 3,000 米的云端悬崖"}，背景包括陡峭的森林山谷、锯齿状的雪峰、零星的针叶树、裸露的岩石，以及蓝天白云下的明亮日光。电影级低角度视角，生物占据前景，超精细的超写实纹理，自然的自然光，焦点清晰地对准怪物，背景具有大气深度，史诗般的妖怪图鉴美学，可信的解剖结构，高对比度，氛围庄严而险恶。

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑动漫风能量饮料海报

templates.prompt: A highly dramatic, fictional anime-style commercial poster for an energy drink brand uses a limited-edition color scheme of black, deep red, and white, creating a striking and dynamic contrast. The vertical composition is richly layered, reminiscent of Japanese street posters. In the foreground, a gothic, chibi-style anime girl faces forward. She has short, straight hair, pale skin, and wears oversized round goggles with glowing red lenses. She wears a dark, oversized hoodie and holds a can of black energy drink close to the viewer. Her hoodie features cat-themed details and accessories, surrounded by hand-drawn white graffiti lines: exactly six cat faces or cat characters, four bats, four stars, two hearts, and several lightning bolt graffiti and sparkle marks. The can is black with red accents and a cat logo, and features the bold English text "NEKON ENERGY" and "BLACK SHOCK." In the midground and background, an abandoned futuristic city canyon extends towards a bright red energy burst at the center. A human silhouette stands with its back to the viewer in the middle of the street before the explosion, surrounded by jagged skyscrapers and red shockwave streaks. At the top center, a large, distressed white Japanese title dominates the poster:{argument name="headline text" default="Instinct awakens."} The smaller white Japanese subtitle below reads:{argument name="tagline text" default="Cut through the darkness and surpass your limits."} In the top left corner, create a vertical list containing three benefits, each with a small white icon and Japanese text. The first section has a lightning bolt icon, titled "The Strongest Benefit," with the subtitle "Caffeine 160mg Alginin Combined." The second section has a cat face icon, titled "Concentration Booster," with the subtitle "Awaken Your Brain with Garana and Vitamins." The third section has a heart icon, titled "Fatigue Recovery Support," with the subtitle "Cure with Amino Acids and Essential Amino Acids." In the top right corner, place a white logo text.{argument name="brand logo" default="Pollo.ai"} At the bottom, add a large white Japanese slogan:{argument name="bottom slogan" default="The black shock, full power."} Directly below it, the product name is displayed in bold, italic, and red capital letters:{argument name="product name" default="NEKON ENERGY BLACK SHOCK"} Add a small white Japanese footer at the bottom center: “闇を味方に、未来を掴め.” In the lower right corner, place a red paint splatter badge with the black and white Japanese text: “エナジー売上No.1 ※自社調べ.” The overall style blends rugged cyberpunk post-apocalyptic illustrations, comic book key visuals, and rough white marker graffiti superimposed on a highly rendered red and black cityscape. The large font has a cracked texture, strong cinematic light and shadow, and a sense of depth, presenting a sophisticated commercial poster design.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的虚构能量饮料品牌动漫商业海报，采用黑、深红和白色的限定配色，对比强烈且充满张力。构图为竖版，层次丰富，如同日本街头海报。前景中，一位哥特风 Q 版动漫少女正对着前方，她留着短直发，皮肤苍白，戴着红色镜片发光的超大圆形护目镜，身穿深色超大号连帽衫，右手拿着一罐黑色能量饮料靠近观众。她的连帽衫带有猫咪主题细节和小配饰，周围环绕着手绘白色涂鸦线条：正好 6 个猫脸或猫咪角色、4 只蝙蝠、4 颗星星、2 颗爱心，以及若干闪电涂鸦和火花标记。饮料罐为黑色，带有红色点缀和猫咪标志，罐身上印有粗体英文文本：“NEKON ENERGY” 和 “BLACK SHOCK”。在中景和背景中，一座废弃的未来主义城市峡谷向中心明亮的红色能量爆发点延伸。爆炸前的街道中央站着一个背对观众的人类剪影，周围是锯齿状的摩天大楼和红色的冲击波条纹。在顶部中央，巨大的做旧白色日文标题占据了海报主体：{argument name="headline text" default="本能、覚醒。"}。下方较小的白色日文副标题写着：{argument name="tagline text" default="闇を切り裂き、限界を超えろ。"}。在左上角，创建一个包含 3 个利益点的竖向列表，每个点配有一个白色小图标和日文文案。第一个区块带有闪电图标，标题为“最強のエナジー”，副标题为“カフェイン160mg アルギニン配合”。第二个区块带有猫脸图标，标题为“集中力ブースト”，副标题为“ガラナとビタミン群で 脳を覚醒”。第三个区块带有爱心图标，标题为“疲労回復サポート”，副标题为“クエン酸＆必須アミノ酸で リカバリー”。在右上角，放置白色 Logo 文本 {argument name="brand logo" default="Pollo.ai"}。在底部，添加一条巨大的白色日文标语：{argument name="bottom slogan" default="黒の衝撃、全開。"}。在其正下方，以粗体斜体红色大写字母设置产品名称：{argument name="product name" default="NEKON ENERGY BLACK SHOCK"}。在底部中央添加一行小号白色日文页脚：“闇を味方に、未来を掴め。”。在右下角，放置一个红色油漆飞溅徽章，上面写着黑白相间的日文：“エナジー売上 No.1 ※自社調べ”。整体风格融合了粗犷的赛博朋克末日插画、漫画主视觉图以及在高度渲染的红黑色城市景观上叠加的粗糙白色记号笔涂鸦，大号字体带有裂纹质感，光影电影感强，深度感十足，呈现出高级的商业海报设计感。

templates.prompt: A beautifully crafted screenshot from a dark fantasy visual novel, reminiscent of anime and game art, shows four girls standing side-by-side in a dimly lit, retro-styled crimson prison mansion lounge. The background features deep red walls and dark wood paneling, with a burning fireplace in the center and two warm-glowing wall lamps on either side. The composition shows the characters from the knees up, surrounded by ornate black filigree shadows and UI decorations. A silver badge is in the upper left corner, an interlocking gear pattern in the upper right, and a small circular "Auto" button in the lower left. Below, in the center, is a Japanese dialogue subtitle: "——Ema to Shirley, Hanna ga tōsei datta.", written in a white Mingchao font with a subtle glow. The overall atmosphere is gothic, mysterious, and elegant, resembling a steampunk-inspired otome or dark school visual novel. Four female characters are featured. Leftmost Character 1: A young blonde woman wearing a simple white dress with a brown belt, long yellow gloves, and a royal blue hooded cloak. templates.prompt: A chilling monochrome Japanese animated film poster, employing a bold ink-and-charcoal style, uses only high-contrast black, white, and gray, with a towering vertical composition. The scene depicts a view from a dark room looking out at an open door. On the right stands the silhouette of a young boy, his back to the viewer in three-quarter profile, with messy short hair, wearing a black and white striped T-shirt, loose dark trousers, and sneakers, silently gazing out the door. On the left is an open wooden door, rough and weathered, with a prominent round handle and the Japanese phrase "开けたのは、ぼくじゃない" written vertically. Outside the door is a surreal, towering mountain or jagged boulder, positioned in the distance, like a hand-drawn ink illustration. A luminous white zigzag path or fissure winds from the foot of the mountain to a bright opening near the summit. Small rock fragments float around the mountain. At the foot of the mountain, four tiny human silhouettes stand on a dark ridge, facing the towering peaks. Bright light streams into the room, casting a long, dark shadow on the floor that stretches towards the viewer; at the end of the shadow is a demonic face, with two white, almond-shaped eyes embedded in the darkness. The floor and walls are covered in crisscrossing lines and heavy textures, creating an eerie, psychologically unsettling atmosphere. In the upper right corner, three stacked award sections, adorned with elegant serif fonts, display laurel wreaths and release notes in a Japanese film festival style, along with the prominent release date text "8.28 ROADSHOW". At the bottom of the image, a large, distressed white hand-painted font spans across the film title:{argument name="film title" default="RAISE"} Below this is the smaller katakana "レイズ". Above the bottom credits, in Japanese, is the tagline: "君の『影』が、世界を救う." The very bottom contains a dense, tiny Japanese credits and website address, giving it the feel of a real movie poster. Overall atmosphere: ominous, poetic, surreal coming-of-age horror fantasy, an independent animated film poster, dramatic negative space, film poster design, unsettling yet beautiful.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张令人毛骨悚然的单色日本动画电影海报，采用粗犷的水墨和炭笔风格，仅使用高对比度的黑、白、灰三色，构图呈高耸的垂直状。场景是从黑暗房间内向外望向敞开的门。右侧站着一名小男孩的剪影，背影呈四分之三侧面，留着凌乱的短发，身穿黑白横条纹 T 恤、宽松深色长裤和运动鞋，正静静地凝视着门外。左侧是敞开的木门，质感粗糙且饱经风霜，门上有明显的圆形把手，并竖排写着日文“開けたのは、ぼくじゃない”。门外是一座超现实的巍峨高山或锯齿状巨石，位于远方中心，如同手绘水墨插画，一条发光的白色之字形路径或裂缝从山脚蜿蜒至山顶附近的明亮开口处。山体周围漂浮着细小的岩石碎片。在山脚下，恰好有 4 个微小的人类剪影站在黑暗的山脊上，面对着高山。明亮的门光洒进房间，在地板上拉出一道延伸向观者的长长黑色阴影；阴影尽头是一个恶魔脸庞，黑暗中嵌入了 2 只白色的杏仁状眼睛。地板和墙壁布满交叉排线和厚重的纹理，营造出一种诡异的心理恐怖氛围。在右上角添加 3 块堆叠的奖项区域，配以优雅的衬线字体，展示日本电影节风格的桂冠和发行文案，并加上醒目的发行日期文本“8.28 ROADSHOW”。在画面中下部以巨大的做旧白色手绘字体横跨电影标题：“{argument name="film title" default="RAISE"}”，下方配以较小的片假名“レイズ”。在底部演职员表上方居中添加日文标语：“君の『影』が、世界を救う。”最底部包含密集的微小日文演职员表和网址，呈现出真实电影海报的质感。整体氛围：不祥、诗意、超现实的成长恐怖奇幻，独立动画电影海报，戏剧性的负空间，电影海报设计，不安而唯美。

templates.title: Anime Mecha Game Release Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫机甲游戏发布海报

templates.prompt: A highly detailed vertical poster for an anime/game release features a dreamlike post-apocalyptic sci-fi style, employing cinematic lighting and cool color palettes of lavender, indigo, silver, and pale pink. In the foreground, two girls kneel facing each other amidst shallow puddles and rubble, creating a focal point of intimate emotion. The girl on the left has extremely long, flowing deep purple hair, wears a nautical-style sailor uniform, pleated skirt, and black knee-high socks, her expression serious yet gentle as she lightly touches the other's face. The girl on the right has long, silver-lilac hair, wears a tattered white-gray school uniform and dark skirt, and a faintly glowing halo behind her head, hinting at her robotic or supernatural identity. Their foreheads touch, their hair flowing in the wind, and pink petals float around them. Behind them stands a massive, damaged humanoid mech, white-gray in color, with scratches on its armor plates revealing its internal frame, its head bowed, half-buried in the ruins. The background showcases the facades of two severely damaged, overgrown buildings with broken windows, beams of light filtering through a bright, cloudy sky, creating a melancholic yet hopeful atmosphere. Scattered debris, including two faintly visible, bent classroom chairs, is added in the lower corner. The poster employs a sophisticated mobile game-style visual composition, featuring dramatic depth of field, glossy reflections, soft lighting effects, volumetric lighting, and detailed artwork. Korean promotional typography is integrated into the poster: a large vertical headline in the upper left corner.{argument name="headline text" default="세계는 그날의 노래로 무너졌다"} The small English slogan in the top left corner reads "The world collapsed in that song," the small English text in the top right corner reads "HOPE WILL FIND US," and the large title is located at the bottom center.{argument name="game title" default="스텔라 소라"} Its Romanized subtitle "STELLA SORA", below which is a smaller type description line "학원× 메카닉× 백합서사RPG", and a large release date at the bottom center.{argument name="release date" default="2025.06.25"} The bottom edge displays four platform and brand elements: one with an anime girl avatar and the logo {argument name="search label" default="스텔라 소라"} The app icon in the small search bar, one App Store logo, one Google Play logo, one Windows logo, and the bottom right corner.{argument name="publisher name" default="YOSTAR VERSE"} Small publisher logos and copyright information.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度精细的竖版动漫游戏发布海报，采用梦幻般的末日科幻风格，运用电影级光影及薰衣草紫、靛蓝、银色和淡粉色的冷色调。前景中，2 名少女在浅浅的积水与瓦砾中面对面跪着，营造出亲密的情感中心。左侧少女留着极长的飘逸深紫色长发，身穿海军风水手服、百褶裙和黑色过膝袜，表情严肃而温柔，正轻轻触碰对方的脸庞。右侧少女留着银丁香色长发，身穿破损的白灰色校服和深色短裙，脑后有一个微弱发光的环状光晕，暗示其机器人或超自然身份。两人额头相抵，发丝随风飘动，周围漂浮着粉色的花瓣。身后矗立着 1 台巨大的破损人形机甲，机甲呈白灰色，装甲板上有划痕，露出内部框架，头部低垂，半埋在废墟中。背景展示了 2 栋严重受损、爬满植被的建筑立面，窗户破碎，明亮多云的天空中透出光束，营造出忧郁而充满希望的氛围。在下角加入散落的残骸，包括 2 把隐约可见的弯曲教室椅子。采用精致的手机游戏主视觉构图，具有戏剧性的景深、光泽反射、柔光效果、体积光和绘图细节。海报中集成了韩语宣传排版：左上角的大型竖排标题 {argument name="headline text" default="세계는 그날의 노래로 무너졌다"}，左上角的小型英语标语 "The world collapsed in that song"，右上角的小型英语文本 "HOPE WILL FIND US"，底部中心的大型标题 {argument name="game title" default="스텔라 소라"} 及其罗马拼音副标题 "STELLA SORA"，下方较小的类型说明行 "학원 × 메카닉 × 백합 서사 RPG"，底部中心的大型发布日期 {argument name="release date" default="2025.06.25"}，以及下方的 "GRAND LAUNCH"。底边展示 4 个平台和品牌元素：1 个带有动漫少女头像和标有 {argument name="search label" default="스텔라 소라"} 的小型搜索栏的应用图标、1 个 App Store 徽标、1 个 Google Play 徽标、1 个 Windows 徽标，以及右下角 {argument name="publisher name" default="YOSTAR VERSE"} 的小型发行商标志和版权信息。

templates.title: Cyberpunk tandem motorcycle chase

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克双人摩托追逐

templates.prompt: A dynamic, anime-style cyberpunk action illustration depicts two riders speeding along a futuristic sports motorcycle on a modern city highway after a rain shower. The camera is low, close to the left front wheel, using a dramatic wide-angle perspective, with the massive front wheel dominating the foreground as the motorcycle leans sharply into a corner. The rider is a young man with messy, deep burgundy hair, wearing a black high-tech riding jacket and trousers with armor plates, accented with magenta and cyan glowing light strips, and black gloves. Subtle printed markings, including the number 07, adorn his jacket and the motorcycle. He is focused on driving: his hands grip the handlebars tightly, his body leaning forward, and his feet firmly planted on the footpegs. Behind him is a two-person passenger, a cheerful young woman with short, wavy blonde hair, a tuft of hair on her head, and colorful triangular hair clips. She wears an oversized white futuristic jacket with purple and cyan graphic embellishments, over a black top, and sneakers with glowing details. She clings to the rider, one arm around him, leaning with the motorcycle, her expression excited and carefree. Neither rider is wearing a helmet. The motorcycle is a streamlined black cyberpunk superbike with sharp lines, an enclosed mechanical structure, neon pink and blue light strips, a dark windshield, clearly visible front disc brakes, and stylish decals including "07" and sharp geometric patterns. The road surface is wet, and the tires splash water violently, leaving long trails of mist behind the motorcycle. Strong motion blur is added to the background and curbs to emphasize the sense of speed. The environment is a futuristic urban highway with guardrails, blurred high-rise buildings, elevated road structures, and a bright blue sky with soft clouds. It features crisp, refined anime-style rendering with rich detail, glossy reflections, cinematic lighting effects, a sense of speed lines, and a vibrant color scheme of black, magenta, cyan, white, and steel gray.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张充满动感的动漫风格赛博朋克动作插画，描绘了 2 名骑手驾驶 1 辆未来感运动摩托车，在雨后白天的现代城市高速公路上疾驰。镜头位置较低，靠近左前轮，采用戏剧性的广角透视，巨大的前轮占据前景，摩托车正大幅度倾斜过弯。驾驶者是一名年轻男子，留着凌乱的深酒红色头发，身穿黑色高科技骑行夹克和带有装甲板的裤子，点缀着洋红色和青色的发光灯带，佩戴黑色手套，夹克和车身上有微妙的印花标记，包括数字 07。他正在专注驾驶：双手紧握车把，身体前倾，双脚稳稳踩在脚踏上。他身后是一名双人乘客，一位开朗的年轻女性，留着短波浪金发，头顶有一撮呆毛，戴着彩色三角形发夹，身穿超大号白色未来感夹克，配有紫色和青色图形装饰，内搭黑色短装，脚蹬带有发光细节的运动鞋。她紧贴在驾驶者身后，一只手搂着对方，随车身倾斜，表情兴奋且无忧无虑。两名骑手均未佩戴头盔。摩托车是一辆流线型黑色赛博朋克超级摩托车，车身线条硬朗，机械结构封闭，配有霓虹粉色和蓝色灯带、深色挡风玻璃、清晰可见的前盘式制动器，以及包括 07 和锋利几何图形在内的时尚贴纸。路面湿滑，轮胎溅起剧烈的水花，在车后拉出长长的水雾。背景和路缘添加强烈的动态模糊，以强调极速感。环境是未来派城市高速公路，配有护栏、模糊的高层建筑、高架道路结构，以及带有柔和云朵的明亮蓝天。采用清晰、精致的动漫渲染，细节丰富，具有光泽反射、电影级光效、速度线能量感，以及黑色、洋红色、青色、白色和钢灰色的生动配色。
