templates.title: Convenience store candid portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 便利店抓拍人像

templates.prompt: A beautiful{argument name="subject" default="young women"} In their early twenties, they possess facial features, skin tone, and overall appearance consistent with the provided reference image; their occupation is {argument name="occupation" default="Convenience store cashier"} She was dressed in typical {argument name="store brand" default="7-Eleven"} Uniform (a white shirt with green, red, and orange accents, a name tag with "MEEM" on it, and hair neatly tied back, consistent with the style in the reference image). She stands behind the checkout counter, serving customers with a friendly and natural expression, matching the personality and facial structure in the reference image. A POS machine, barcode scanner, and small items such as candy and drinks are on the counter. Capture the moment: The photo was taken discreetly from the customer's perspective using a smartphone, with a slightly blurred foreground and an unforced composition, presenting a natural, unstaged feel. The composition should accurately reproduce the appearance of the person in the reference image without distortion. Lighting: Bright and evenly distributed convenience store neon lights, maintaining realistic skin tones and color accuracy consistent with the reference image. Environment: The interior of a modern convenience store, with neatly arranged goods on the shelves behind the checkout counter, creating a clean, orderly, and bright atmosphere. Photography style: Hyper-realistic candid photography, shallow depth of field, natural textures, high detail, with slight motion blur to enhance realism, minor smartphone noise, 4K resolution. Optional variations: * Slightly tilted angle * Reflections on the glass display case * Subtle movements as she hands over a receipt or gives change * A gentle, natural smile consistent with the reference image

promptLocalized.zh:
一位美丽的 {argument name="subject" default="年轻女性"}，20 出头，拥有与所提供参考图像一致的面部特征、肤色和整体外貌，职业是 {argument name="occupation" default="便利店收银员"}。她穿着典型的 {argument name="store brand" default="7-Eleven"} 制服（带有绿色、红色和橙色装饰的白衬衫，佩戴写有“MEEM”的工牌，头发整齐地向后扎起，与参考图像中的造型一致）。

她站在收银台后，正为顾客提供服务，表情友好自然，与其参考图像中的个性和面部结构相符。柜台上放着 POS 机、条形码扫描仪以及糖果和饮料等小商品。

抓拍瞬间：照片以顾客视角通过智能手机隐蔽拍摄，前景略带模糊，构图不刻意，呈现出一种未经摆拍的自然感。构图应在不失真的前提下，精准还原参考图像中的人物样貌。

光影：明亮且分布均匀的便利店霓虹灯光，保持真实的肤色和与参考图像一致的色彩准确度。

环境：现代化的便利店内部，收银台后货架上的商品摆放整齐，营造出干净、有序且明亮的氛围。

摄影风格：超写实抓拍摄影，浅景深，自然纹理，高细节，带有轻微的运动模糊以增加真实感，细微的智能手机拍摄噪点，4K 画质。

可选变体：

* 略微倾斜的角度
* 玻璃展示柜上的反光
* 她递送收据或找零时轻微的动作
* 与参考图像一致的温柔、自然的微笑

templates.title: Cinematic Duo Concert Performance

titleLocalized.zh: 电影感双人演唱会表演

templates.prompt: A hyper-realistic, cinematic concert performance, high-energy, boldly charismatic, and a dominant duo, resembling a top-tier global pop idol stage. Powerful, crisp, synchronized yet stylistically distinct (male = strength/composure, female = sharp/playful). 👥 Main Characters (Duo): Male Dancer: Western male, short, dark brown hair, defined jawline, light stubble, fitted sleeveless black performance top or asymmetrical streetwear hoodie, black cargo pants with neon accents, muscular arms, powerful and composed energy, and a cool, commanding presence. Female Dancer: Western female, blonde curly hair (voluminous and bouncy curls), high ponytail or half-up hairstyle, black and metallic pink techwear jacket, fitted cargo pants, confident, fiery, expressive, with the aura of a pop diva (like a high-fashion stage performer), a sharp and captivating presence. Chemistry: A powerful duo with a slightly competitive atmosphere, provocative interactions, stage presence, and an electrifying chemistry rather than tender romance. 🎤 Stage Design: Dark concert stage with bright reflective floor and LED walls: Red/pink glitch visual effects + pulsed cyberpunk graphics. Lighting: Red spotlight (focuses on women), White/blue spotlight (focuses on men), Strobe lights falling with the beat. Atmosphere: Smoke + light fog. Dancers: 2–4 silhouettes (optional, low attention). ⏱️ Timeline (10 seconds – powerful): 0–1 second: Complete darkness → Beat falls, double silhouettes back-to-back flashing, low-angle cinematic push-in. 1–2 seconds: Right side step (synchronized) → Male weighted rhythm, female crisp and light impact, direct eye contact (dominance). 2–3 seconds: Left side step → Chest rhythm (powerful synchronized impact), lights flashing with impact. Women add a slight confident head tilt + curled hair bounce. 3–4 seconds: Arm waves (mirror style): Male right → left, female left → right. Camera semi-circular track movement. 4–5 seconds: [Further details needed for the sequence]. Pointing and sliding towards each other → Almost colliding → A moment of tension frozen in time 🔥 5–6 seconds hip rotation contrast: Female fluid and expressive, male controlled and composed → Arms crossed and then opened (large synchronized strike) 6–7 seconds attitude exchange: Head turn + gesture → Male cold and focused gaze → Female mischievous smile, confident queen 7–8 seconds side slide in opposite directions → Rapid alternation of shoulder rhythm, fast editing + miniature zoom impact 8–9 seconds synchronized body rhythm (different styles) → Large, commanding arm circles overhead, backlight sweeping across the stage 9–10 seconds final chest strike → Frozen in time, both pointing at the camera Final pose: Male slightly back, composed stance, Female in front, chin raised, confident mischievous smile Spotlight locked, dark background 🎥 Photography style: Low-angle dominant shot, rapid push-in zoom falling with the beat, track shot for the dynamics of the two, fast cinematic MV editing, slight handheld shaking to increase impact and realism ⚡ Energy-Driven, Not Cute – Powerful Stage Presence: Female: Playful, Sharp, Confident Diva; Male: Calm, Powerful, Controlled Presence; Interaction: Provocative + Competitive Tension ✨ Additional Details: Bouncy Golden Curls, Realistic Sweat Shine Under Stage Lights, Fabric Movement (Functional Style + Flowing Work Pants), Reflective Flooring

templates.title: Portrait of a Girl in a Daisy Meadow

titleLocalized.zh: 雏菊草地中的少女肖像

templates.prompt: A soft, natural portrait, the subject is{argument name="subject" default="A young woman"} She was sitting{argument name="environment" default="A lush meadow filled with white daisies"} She looked up at the camera, with {argument name="eye details" default="Bright big eyes"} Her expression was gentle and serene. Her long brown hair cascaded naturally over her shoulders. She rested her chin on her hands, elbows slightly tucked in, her posture relaxed and intimate. She wore a loose-fitting beige off-the-shoulder sweater, which had slipped slightly, revealing light blue bra straps underneath. The lighting was natural sunlight, soft and even, without harsh shadows. The slightly downward angle created a dreamy, whimsical feel. Daisies and green grass filled the background, creating a vibrant and fresh spring atmosphere. High detail, shallow depth of field, soft focus, photorealistic realism, cinematic color grading.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张柔和、自然的肖像，主角是 {argument name="subject" default="一位年轻女性"}，她正坐在 {argument name="environment" default="一片开满小白雏菊的郁郁葱葱的草地"} 上。她抬头看向镜头，有着 {argument name="eye details" default="明亮的大眼睛"} 和温柔平静的表情。她棕色的长发自然地垂落在肩头。她双手托腮，手肘内收，姿态放松而亲密。她穿着一件宽松的米色露肩毛衣，毛衣微微滑落，露出里面浅蓝色的肩带。光线为自然日光，柔和均匀，没有强烈的阴影。视角略微俯拍，营造出一种梦幻、奇妙的感觉。背景中密布着雏菊和绿草，营造出充满活力的清新春日氛围。高细节，浅景深，柔焦，照片级真实感，电影级调色。

templates.title: Anime Double Exposure Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫双重曝光海报

templates.prompt: A character promotional poster with the title "{argument name="title" default="INPUT NAME"} The design employs a cinematic vertical main visual composition (9:16). The upper part presents an image composed of flowing wind and cherry blossom particles.{argument name="subject" default="Anime Girl"} The facial contours are large and radiate a soft glow, creating a dreamlike, delicate, and slightly translucent texture. The lower half showcases the character's full body, her posture composed and elegant, dressed in {argument name="clothing" default="Elegant modern Japanese-style clothing"} Lightweight fabric sways in the wind. A double-exposure narrative is employed within the silhouette: floating cherry blossoms, fragments of memory, a soft sky gradient, emotionally charged close-up moments, and natural elements blending into a watercolor mist. The left side uses warm pink tones and floral energy, while the right side maintains balance with a cool sky blue. A delicate, luminous breeze connects the top silhouette to the character below. The edges are soft and painterly, gradually fading into the white blank space, presenting an ethereal anime aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张角色宣传海报，标题为“{argument name="title" default="INPUT NAME"}”，采用电影级竖版主视觉构图（9:16）。上半部分呈现出一个由流动的风和樱花粒子构成的 {argument name="subject" default="动漫少女"} 面部轮廓，轮廓巨大且散发着柔和的光芒，营造出梦幻、细腻且略带透明的质感。
下半部分展示了角色全身，姿态从容优雅，身着 {argument name="clothing" default="优雅的现代和风服饰"}，轻盈的布料随风飘动。
在轮廓内部运用双重曝光叙事：漂浮的樱花、记忆碎片、柔和的天空渐变、充满情感的特写瞬间，以及融入水彩薄雾中的自然元素。
左侧采用温暖的粉色调与花卉能量，右侧则以清冷的天蓝色保持平衡。一条纤细的发光微风线条将顶部的轮廓与下方的角色连接起来。
边缘柔和且具有绘画感，逐渐淡入白色的留白空间，呈现出空灵的动漫美学。

templates.title: Artistic Identity Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 艺术感身份肖像

templates.prompt: A modern digital portrait depicting a{argument name="subject" default="young man"} The facial recognition process strictly used the submitted reference images, preserving the person's accurate facial features, precise facial structure, and natural realism. The subject displays a confident and cheerful smile and is wearing {argument name="accessory" default="Fashion Eyeglasses"} The figures are presented in various poses. The central portrait is large, clear, and richly detailed, highlighting facial contours and skin tone under warm, soft lighting. In the background, the translucent silhouette of the same figure and its expressive form {argument name="background style" default="Red brushstrokes"} The abstract composition blends seamlessly. The foreground includes two smaller versions of the man: one dressed casually, exuding confidence; the other seated, legs crossed, lost in thought. The clothing is youthful and casual, primarily consisting of a light-colored shirt and jeans. The background combines clean white space with textured elements and bold red brushstrokes, creating a striking artistic contrast. The overall composition follows a modern poster style, featuring subtle glowing effects, smooth transitions, and a sophisticated, high-end digital art feel.

promptLocalized.zh:
一幅现代数字肖像，描绘了一位 {argument name="subject" default="年轻男子"}。严格使用提交的参考图像进行面部识别，保留了人物确切的面部特征、精确的面部结构以及自然的真实感。主体面带自信愉悦的微笑，佩戴着 {argument name="accessory" default="时尚眼镜"}，并以多种姿态呈现。
中央肖像画面大、清晰且细节丰富，在温暖柔和的灯光照射下，突显了面部轮廓和肤色。背景中，同一人物的半透明侧影与富有表现力的 {argument name="background style" default="红色笔触"} 抽象构图完美融合。
前景中包含了该男子的两个较小版本：一个身着休闲装，姿态自信；另一个坐着，双腿交叉，神情沉思。服装年轻休闲，以浅色衬衫和牛仔裤为主。
背景将简洁的留白与纹理元素及大胆的红色笔触相结合，营造出引人注目的艺术对比。整体构图遵循现代海报风格，带有微妙的发光效果、平滑的过渡以及精致的高端数字艺术质感。

templates.title: Crumpled paper furniture concept design

titleLocalized.zh: 揉皱纸张家具概念设计

templates.prompt: Design concept:{argument name="furniture type" default="creased chair"} Core concept: to{argument name="inspiration" default="crumpled paper ball"} The “controlled chaos” is transformed into a sculptural and highly comfortable seating experience. Phase 1: Observation and Morphological Analysis. The goal is to deconstruct the imagery of crumpled paper into usable geometric data. Crease Mapping: Identify the main “valve lines” and “ridge lines.” These lines represent the chair’s potential structural ribs or seams. Multifaceted Planes: Decompose the sphere into a series of irregular polygons. Each plane of the paper becomes a potential panel for the chair’s upholstery or shell. Shadow Study: Analyze how the “crumpled” shape forms deep grooves. These natural pockets guide the placement of the user’s weight. Phase 2: Iterative Morphological Exploration. Transition from the sphere to the seat through “digital crumpling.” Subtractive Sculpting: Imagine the paper sphere as a solid entity. Use Boolean operations to “sculpt” a seat groove that is both ergonomic and retains the external jagged texture. Tension Simulation: Use 3D software (such as Rhino or Blender) to simulate the compression process of a flat material. This ensures that the creases look realistic, not “modeled.” "Throwing" Logic: Attempting to simulate gravity by dropping a digital grid and observing its natural settling, mimicking the primal feeling of "throwing." Phase Three: Ergonomic Transformation and Blueprinting elevate the primal aesthetic to a functional object. Comfort Core: Covering a standard ergonomic template (seat angle: 105°–110°) with a crumpled form. Adjusting internal "creases" to provide lumbar support and pressure relief. Blueprint Generation: Creating technical orthographic views (front, side, top). Planned Dimensions: Seat height: 450 mm, overall width: 850 mm. Surface Smoothing: Maintaining sharp "paper edges" on the outer shell while softening internal contact points to ensure a comfortable feel against the skin. Phase Four: Structural Integration and Scaling Make the Concept Physically Feasible. Skeleton: Designing a hidden internal frame (CNC bent steel rods or 3D printed lattices recommended) distributed along the most prominent ridges of the paper creases to provide rigidity. Material Selection: * Option A (High-end):{argument name="material" default="Multi-faceted cast aluminum"} Option B (Soft): Vacuum-formed recycled plastic shell covered with "memory crease" technical fabric to maintain the wrinkled appearance. Phase 5: Final Prototype and Material Finish Texture Replication: Apply a matte, microporous finish to the material to mimic the feel of heavy paper. Light and Shadow Contrast: Use directional studio lighting in the final rendering to emphasize the "crumpled" shadows, making the chair look like a huge, discarded piece of inspiration. Design Advice: To maintain the realism of the "crumpled" appearance, avoid symmetry.

promptLocalized.zh:
设计概念：{argument name="furniture type" default="揉皱椅"} 核心理念：将 {argument name="inspiration" default="揉成团的纸球"} 的“受控混乱”转化为一种具有雕塑感且高度舒适的座椅体验。

第一阶段：观察与形态分析 目标是将揉皱纸张的意象解构为可用的几何数据。折痕映射：识别主要的“谷线”和“脊线”。这些线条代表了椅子潜在的结构肋条或接缝。多面平面：将球体分解为一系列不规则的多边形。纸张的每一个平面都成为椅子软包或外壳的潜在面板。阴影研究：分析“揉皱”形态如何形成深邃的凹槽。这些天然的口袋引导着用户重量的承托位置。

第二阶段：迭代形态探索 通过“数字揉皱”从球体过渡到座椅。减法雕刻：将纸球想象为一个实体。使用布尔运算“雕刻出”一个既符合人体工学又保持外部锯齿状纹理的座椅凹槽。张力模拟：使用 3D 软件（如 Rhino 或 Blender）模拟一张平面材料被压缩的过程。这能确保折痕看起来真实，而非“建模”出来的。 “抛掷”逻辑：尝试基于重力的模拟，将数字网格落下，观察其自然沉降的状态，以模仿“抛掷”的原始感。

第三阶段：人体工学转换与蓝图绘制 将原始美学升华为功能性物体。舒适核心：在揉皱形态上覆盖标准的工学模板（座椅角度：105°–110°）。调整内部“折痕”以提供腰部支撑和压力缓解。蓝图生成：创建技术正投影视图（前视图、侧视图、顶视图）。规划尺寸：座高：450 mm，总宽：850 mm。表面平滑处理：在外壳上保持锐利的“纸张边缘”，同时软化内部接触点以确保皮肤触感舒适。

第四阶段：结构集成与缩放 使概念具备物理可行性。骨架：设计一个隐藏的内部框架（建议使用 CNC 弯曲钢杆或 3D 打印晶格），使其沿着纸张折痕最明显的脊线分布，以提供刚性。材料选择：* 选项 A（高端）：{argument name="material" default="多面铸铝"}，配以白色粉末涂层。选项 B（柔软）：真空成型的再生塑料外壳，覆盖“记忆折痕”科技面料，以保持褶皱外观。

第五阶段：最终原型与材料饰面 纹理复制：在材料上应用哑光、微孔饰面，以模仿厚重纸张的触感。光影对比：在最终渲染中使用定向摄影棚灯光来强调“揉皱”阴影，使椅子看起来像一件巨大的、被丢弃的灵感作品。设计建议：为了保持“揉皱”外观的真实感，请避免对称。

templates.title: Korean comic-style fighting storyboard

titleLocalized.zh: 韩漫风格格斗分镜

templates.prompt: Generate a high-quality, cinematic storyboard collage in a 16:9 aspect ratio, composed of 8–10 consecutive frames. The entire image should use {argument name="art style" default="Stylized Korean comic/webcomic style"} Create artwork with clean lines, soft cel-shading, dynamic action composition, and expressive visual storytelling. Avoid photorealism. Do not use realistic face rendering. Keep faces slightly simplified, stylized, and illustrative, while maintaining an appealing character design and strong facial expressions. No text, subtitles, titles, or watermarks. Scene concept: A free-for-all between a man and a young Chinese woman, with the woman ultimately emerging victorious. The tone should be tense, stylish, energetic, and dramatic, with a strong visual rhythm and clear action storytelling. The scene should be simple and clear, for example {argument name="setting" default="City rooftops at dusk"} The setting is either a modern training ground or a spacious industrial platform. The female protagonist is a young Chinese woman in her early twenties, an adult, drawn in a Korean comic style. She is wearing {argument name="outfit" default="Pink Barbie-style sportswear"} The female character is stylish and feminine. Her design should embody youth, agility, and confidence. She possesses a light and nimble figure, clear body lines, a slender yet strong silhouette, and elegant yet powerful movements. Her expression and posture should convey calm, focus, and composed confidence. The male opponent is an adult male, stronger and more aggressive. He should initially appear tough and intimidating, visually contrasting with the woman's agility, skill, and composure. The sequence is structured as follows: Frame 1: Wide-angle opening shot. The man and woman stand apart in a tense standoff, creating a dramatic atmosphere with a strong composition. Frame 2: Close-up or medium shot detail—stylized eyes, clenched hands, ready stance, subtle body tension before the fight begins. Frame 3: The man launches the first attack, fast and powerful. Frame 4: The woman dodges smoothly and precisely, using agile footwork and flexible body movements. Frame 5: Fluid exchange of movements—blocking, sliding, pivoting, and dodging—presented from a dynamic comic book perspective. Panel 6: The fight escalates. The woman remains calm, beginning to gauge her opponent's rhythm. Panel 7: The turning point. She finds an opening and counters with clean, decisive techniques. Panel 8: A visually impactful moment of action—a spin, redirection, sweeping kick, or knockdown—demonstrating her control. Panel 9: The man falls or is clearly defeated, panting or collapsing to the ground. Panel 10: The final hero shot. The woman stands in dramatic lighting, composed, calm, and victorious. Visual Style: Korean comic/webcomic style illustrations, cinematic comic paneling, delicate lines, soft cel shadows, dramatic lighting, dynamic movements, expressive poses, elegant choreography, stylish panel composition, simple background design, high detail, vibrant yet controlled colors.

promptLocalized.zh:
生成一个 16:9 画幅的高质量电影感分镜拼贴图，由 8–10 个连贯的画格组成。整张图像应采用 {argument name="art style" default="风格化的韩漫 / 网络漫画风格"} 进行绘制，具备清晰的线条、柔和的赛璐珞阴影、动态的动作构图以及富有表现力的视觉叙事。避免照片写实感。不要使用写实的人脸渲染。保持面部略微简化、风格化且具有插画感，同时保持吸引人的角色设计和强烈的表情表达。无文字、无字幕、无标题、无水印。

场景概念：
一名男子与一名年轻中国女性之间的自由格斗，最终由女性获胜。基调紧张、时尚、充满活力且富有戏剧性，具有强烈的视觉节奏和清晰的动作叙事。场景应简洁明了，例如 {argument name="setting" default="黄昏时的城市屋顶"}、现代训练场或空旷的工业平台。

女主角：
一名 20 出头的年轻中国女性，成年人，采用韩漫风格绘制。她穿着 {argument name="outfit" default="粉色芭比风运动装"}，外观时尚且具有女性魅力。她的设计应体现出年轻、敏捷和自信。她拥有轻盈灵巧的身材、清晰的身体线条、纤细而结实的轮廓，动作优雅且充满力量。她的表情和姿态应传达出冷静、专注和从容的自信。

男性对手：
一名成年男性，体格更强壮，更具攻击性。他起初应显得强硬且具有威慑力，与女性的敏捷、技巧和镇定形成视觉对比。

分镜推进：
第 1 格：广角建立镜头。男子与女子在紧张的对峙中分开站立，氛围戏剧化，构图强烈。
第 2 格：特写或中景细节——风格化的眼睛、紧握的双手、准备姿态、格斗开始前微妙的身体张力。
第 3 格：男子率先发起攻击，速度快且力量大。
第 4 格：女子平稳而精准地闪避，运用敏捷的步法和灵活的身体动作。
第 5 格：流畅的动作交换——格挡、滑步、轴心转动和闪避动作，以动态的漫画视角呈现。
第 6 格：格斗升级。女子保持冷静，开始洞察对方的节奏。
第 7 格：转折点。她找到破绽，并以干净利落的技巧进行反击。
第 8 格：视觉冲击力强的动作瞬间——旋转、重定向、扫腿或击倒——展示她掌控局面。
第 9 格：男子倒地或明显战败，气喘吁吁或瘫倒在地。
第 10 格：最终英雄镜头。女子在戏剧性的光线下站立，姿态从容，冷静且获胜。

视觉风格：
韩漫 / 网络漫画风格插画，电影感漫画分镜，精致的线条，柔和的赛璐珞阴影，戏剧性光影，动态动作，富有表现力的姿势，优雅的动作编排，时尚的分镜构图，简洁的背景设计，高细节，色彩鲜艳但受控

templates.title: Anime Worldview Construction and Character Setting Table

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫世界观构建与角色设定表

templates.prompt: [Expected Output] Worldview setting data + Original anime character design data *Please not only conceive of characters, but also the environment, culture, systems, technology, and daily life of the world in which they live. [Worldview Seed] Enter here [Number of Schemes] Enter here *For example: Only 1 scheme needed / Want to compare multiple schemes, etc. [Number of Characters] Enter here [Character/Occupation] Enter here [Setting/Environment] Enter here *If there are few details, please design new parameters for climate, terrain, resources, hazard factors, transportation, and living style based on the entered keywords. [Society/Systems] Enter here *Design community rules, division of labor, identity markers, affiliation marks, communication methods, and rituals that conform to the input content. [Technology/Belief/Taboos] Enter here *Based on the input content, naturally deduce material processing, recording methods, communication, prayer, taboos, festivals, and body decorations, etc. [Lifestyle/Culture] Enter here *Housing, food, transportation, work tools, clothing style, decorative meaning, seasonal activities, currency, writing system, heraldry, etc. [Overall Atmosphere] Enter [World Features] Enter [Key Priorities] Enter [Completion Direction] Enter *For example: emphasize realism/lifelike atmosphere, emphasize mystery, emphasize the practicality of clothing, focus more on architecture, a bright style for children, etc. [Differentiation Description] Enter [Painting Tone] Smooth lines, flat anime style, minimalist cel shadows, single-layer shadows, no gradients, no thick paint, no realistic textures, no strong contrasts, using a flat visual effect suitable for animation production. [Anime Conversion Description] While maintaining the structure, theme, color scheme, characters, and cultural meaning of the original design, simplify the painting to adapt to animation production. Use a flat anime style and keep shadows in a single layer. Treat translucent materials or thin fabrics as simplified cel-style planes, rather than realistic textures. Based on the above input, create an image in the style of "world setting data + character setting data" for the original anime. Purpose: Not only to showcase the characters, but also to intuitively convey the world in which the characters live. Create a set of setting materials that presents the world's environment, culture, living tools, architecture, transportation, and clothing origins as a unified whole. The most important point: First, extract the world's unique "visual rules" from the input content. Reflect these visual rules in all elements: background, architecture, tools, clothing, color scheme, materials, heraldry, and overall page layout. Desired effects: - Clothing, tools, and living environments should look like items actually used by people living in this world. - Characters, backgrounds, tools, text, and material samples should appear to belong to the same cultural sphere. - Convey the unique environment, resources, and lifestyle derived from the worldview seed. - Shapes should originate from necessities in daily life, rather than existing typified patterns. - Possess a unique shape language, color palette, and texture that are instantly recognizable. Thought process: 1. Determine the world's "environment" (climate, terrain, lighting, seasons, dangers, resource distribution) based on the input. 2. Determine the "lifestyle" (housing, diet, work, transportation, storage, exchange, recording, celebrations) based on the environment. 3. Determine the "clothing and tools" (fixed style, layering, carrying, protection, displaying identity/role) based on the lifestyle. 4. Determine the "Character Appearance" based on clothing/tools (focusing on clothing, equipment, materials, colors, and silhouettes, not just the face/hairstyle). 5. Determine the "Page Design" based on visual rules (reflecting the recording medium, patterns, white space, and chart style of the world). Enhanced Diversity: Invent a new cultural sphere for each input. If multiple options are required, ensure each has unique living principles, material logic, and aesthetics. Significantly change for each option: - Topographical and climatic appearance - Architectural and urban landscape shapes - Primary materials - Meaning of colors - Clothing silhouettes - How tools are held, stored, and carried - Creation of symbols, text, patterns, and heraldry - Page layout format ideas (not fixed themes, for inspiration only): Environments: Arid zones, cold regions, highlands, wetlands, volcanic ash areas, mirror lakes, fog valleys, windy areas, polar nights, low gravity, floating strata, luminous caves, etc. Materials: Paper, bone, ceramics, leather, resin, glass, shells, bamboo, straw, crystals, recycled fabrics, lacquer, ash, feathers, amber, etc. Culture: Oral traditions, mask culture, scent recognition, knotted rope record-keeping, shadow puppetry, seasonal migration, silent rituals, dance contracts, etc. Structure: Folding, wrapping, weaving, hanging, inserting, binding, layering, sealing, carving, bundling, inflating, etc. Mandatory Elements: 1. Worldview Projects (symbolic landscapes, cityscapes, tools, heraldry, color rules, shape language). 2. Character Design Data (full-body standing poses, details of clothing, equipment/back/personal items conveying the character). 3. World-Character Connection (ensuring clothing/equipment logic originates from the world's technology/beliefs/environment). 4. Page Design (layout varies with the worldview, using appropriate charting methods and minimalist labels/symbols). Quality Standards: - Non-generic fantasy style; the world's origins must be evident. - A unified cultural feel between characters and backgrounds. - Decorations must have practical, religious, or functional significance. - Clear visual differences between multiple world schemes. Visual Presentation: - High resolution, anime style, delicate lines, clean cel coloring. - A mixed layout of world-building elements, full-body character portraits, and tool details. - Minimalist text, prioritizing the display of visual concept design sketches. Ultimate goal: To ensure the design allows viewers to intuitively grasp the world's creation, the residents' lives, material limitations, cultural meanings, and community rules. To create a sense of unity, making the background and characters instantly recognizable as belonging to the same unique world.

基于上述输入，为原创动漫创作一张“世界观设定资料 + 角色设定资料”风格的图像。

目的：
不仅是展示角色，还要直观地传达角色所处的世界本身。创建一套设定资料，使世界的环境、文化、生活工具、建筑、交通和服装起源呈现为一个统一的整体。

最重要的一点：
首先，从输入内容中提取该世界独有的“视觉规则”。将该视觉规则反映在所有元素中：背景、建筑、工具、服装、配色方案、材料、纹章以及整体页面布局。

期望效果：
- 服装、工具和居住环境应看起来像是生活在这个世界的人们实际使用的物品。
- 角色、背景、工具、文字和材料样本应看起来属于同一个文化圈。
- 传达由世界观种子衍生出的独特环境、资源和生活习惯。
- 形状应源于日常生活中的必要性，而非现有的类型化套路。
- 具备一眼即可识别的独特形状语言、调色板和材质感。

思考过程：
1. 根据输入确定世界的“环境”（气候、地形、光照、季节、危险、资源分布）。
2. 根据环境确定“生活方式”（居住、饮食、工作、交通、存储、交换、记录、庆典）。
3. 根据生活方式确定“服装和工具”（固定方式、层叠、携带、防护、展示身份/角色）。
4. 根据服装/工具确定“角色外观”（重点在于服装、装备、材料、颜色和轮廓，而非仅仅是面部/发型）。
5. 根据视觉规则确定“页面设计”（反映该世界的记录媒介、图案、留白和图表风格）。

多样性增强：
为每个输入发明一个新的文化圈。如果要求多个方案，确保每个方案都有独特的生活原则、材料逻辑和审美。

针对每个方案，显著改变：
- 地形和气候外观
- 建筑和城市景观形状
- 主要材料
- 颜色的含义
- 服装轮廓
- 工具的握持、存储和携带方式
- 符号、文字、图案和纹章的创作
- 页面布局格式

构思候选（非固定主题，仅供灵感参考）：
环境：干旱地带、寒冷地区、高地、湿地、火山灰区、镜面湖、雾谷、强风区、极夜、低重力、浮动地层、发光矿洞等。
材料：纸、骨、陶瓷、皮革、树脂、玻璃、贝壳、竹子、稻草、晶体、再生织物、漆、灰、羽毛、琥珀等。
文化：口头传统、面具文化、气味识别、结绳记事、皮影记录、季节性迁徙、静默仪式、舞蹈契约等。
结构：折叠、包裹、编织、悬挂、插入、捆绑、层叠、密封、雕刻、成捆、充气等。

强制要素：
1. 世界观项目（象征性景观、城市景观、生活工具、纹章、颜色规则、形状语言）。
2. 角色设定资料（全身站姿、传达角色的服装、装备/背面/随身物品的细节图）。
3. 世界-角色连接（确保服装/装备的逻辑源于该世界的科技/信仰/环境）。
4. 页面设计（布局随世界观而变，使用适当的图表方法和极简的标签/符号）。

质量标准：
- 非通用的奇幻风格；必须能看出世界的起源。
- 角色与背景之间具有统一的文化感。
- 装饰必须具有生活、信仰或功能意义。
- 多个世界方案之间应有明显的视觉差异。

视觉呈现：
- 高分辨率、动漫风格、精致的线条、干净的赛璐珞上色。
- 世界项目 + 全身角色 + 工具细节的混合布局。
- 文字极简，优先展示视觉概念设计图。

最终目标：
确保设计能让人直观感受到世界的建立、居民的生活、材料的限制、文化含义和社区规则。创造一种统一感，使背景和角色能被一眼识别为属于同一个独特的世界。

templates.title: Character promotional poster frame

titleLocalized.zh: 角色宣传海报框架

templates.prompt: [Basic Specifications] - Character Promotional Poster - Vertical (9:16) - Unified main visual - Composition suitable for series extension [Character Design] - Faithfully reproduces reference design (hairstyle/face/clothing/elements) - Accurately replicates iconic features to ensure high recognizability [Composition Structure] - Hierarchical structure of "large at the top and small at the bottom" - Upper half: Enlarged iconic elements (head/face outline/mask/upper body silhouette) - Lower half: Full-body placement of the character - Stable standing posture or slight dynamic [Main Visual Design] - Strong iconic giant silhouette at the top - Focuses visual impact - Conveys the character's symbolism at a glance [Collage/Double Exposure] - Giant silhouette contains multiple elements - Layering of scenes, symbolic patterns, and environment - Builds a narrative - Integrates into smoke, ink painting, or white space [Worldview Expression] - Multiple scenes based on the character's worldview - Layout of symbolic patterns - Dynamics or arrangement of secondary characters - Environmental details (nature/architecture/atmosphere) [Layout (Left and Right Composition)] - Places complementary elements on the left and right sides - Providing rhythm to the composition - Creating narrative tension [Visual guidance design] - A single visual flow from top to bottom - Giant silhouette at the top -> Internal collage -> Full-body character at the bottom - Continuous visual guidance design [White space and edge treatment] - Extensive use of negative space (white space) - Edge effects: ink wash, soft blur, fragmented treatment [Aesthetics and concept] - Reflecting Eastern aesthetics: white space, artistic conception, beauty of incompleteness - Coexistence of tranquility and tension [Style and tone] - Unified visual appearance - Refined expression - Restrained tone, avoiding information overload [Finished product quality] - High depth of field - Strong visual impact - Emphasizing narrative - Achieving a level of completion suitable for a series of posters

promptLocalized.zh:
[基本规格]
- 角色宣传海报
- 竖版 (9:16) 统一主视觉
- 构图适用于系列化延展

[角色设计]
- 忠实还原参考图设计（发型/面部/服装/元素）
- 精准复刻标志性特征，确保高辨识度

[构图结构]
- “上大下小”的层级结构
- 上半部分：标志性元素放大（头部/脸部轮廓/面具/上半身剪影）
- 下半部分：角色全身放置
- 稳定的站姿或轻微动态

[主视觉设计]
- 顶部采用强有力的标志性巨型剪影
- 聚焦视觉冲击力
- 一眼传达角色象征

[拼贴/双重曝光]
- 巨型剪影内包含多种元素
- 场景、象征性图案与环境的层叠
- 构建叙事感
- 融入烟雾、水墨或留白中

[世界观表达]
- 基于角色世界观的多重场景
- 象征性图案的布局
- 次要角色的动态或排布
- 环境细节（自然/建筑/氛围）

[布局（左右构图）]
- 左右两侧放置互补元素
- 为构图提供节奏感
- 营造叙事张力

[视线引导设计]
- 从上到下的单一视觉流线
- 顶部巨型剪影 -> 内部拼贴 -> 下部全身角色
- 连续的视觉引导设计

[留白与边缘处理]
- 大量使用负空间（留白）
- 边缘效果：水墨晕染、柔和模糊、碎片化处理

[美学与理念]
- 体现东方美学：留白、意境、残缺美
- 静谧与张力的共存

[风格与基调]
- 统一的视觉外观
- 精致的表达
- 克制的基调，避免信息过载

[成品质量]
- 高景深表现
- 强烈的视觉冲击力
- 强调叙事性
- 达到适合系列海报的完成度

templates.title: Cinematic Seed Lifecycle Project

templates.prompt: A 2x5 project grid containing 10 frames, suitable for a 15-second realistic CGI animated short film.{argument name="aesthetic" default="BBC Planet Earth documentary aesthetics"} Macro photography, rich green tones and golden hour light and shadow, natural soft shadows, the ultimate scale transformation from micro to macro. Theme:{argument name="theme" default="The journey of a seed drifting in the wind, weathering storms, and finally growing into a vibrant, towering tree."} Frame by frame: (1) Extreme wide-angle autumn forest, a seed falls from a tall tree, with golden light spots in the background; (2) Macro tracking shot - the seed floats in the air, passing by insects and leaves, delicate and tiny; (3) Slow motion impact - the seed falls on the soft soil, dust flies, and a raindrop falls next to it; (4) Surreal underground macro - the roots begin to grow in the dark, microscopic and beautiful; (5) Wide-angle dramatic shot - a storm rages, everything is uprooted, but the seed remains unmoved; (6) Macro close-up - the first green shoot breaks through the soil, the tip is covered with morning dew, and the sunlight shines on it; (7) Accelerated growth sequence - the seedling rises, the seasons change, the light and shadow change, full of vitality; (8) Wide-angle shot - the sapling has already stood, birds fly in, and the leaves sway gently in the wind; (9) Mid-range warm color shot - Children play in the shade of the tree, and a bird builds its nest on a branch; (10) Mirror wide-angle lens - the view is taken from the perspective of the original tall tree, and the newly grown towering tree stands here, symbolizing the cycle of life.

templates.title: May Inspirational Welcome Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 五月励志欢迎海报

templates.prompt: Design a high-end inspirational social media poster with a dark, cinematic editing style, in a 4:5 vertical aspect ratio. The image is divided into two main areas: the left side for typography and the right side for the vision visuals. The background uses black to deep charcoal gray with subtle textures, featuring subtle vertical striped wall details on the right, a glossy reflective floor, and elegant neon lime accents with warm gold highlights. On the right, depict a figure: a man in a fitted dark jacket and trousers, walking towards a large circular portal. The portal should be large enough to radiate a warm gold halo and soft internal light, positioned slightly to the right. Behind the portal is a tranquil and bright natural scene, with a narrow stepping stone path extending forward through the grass, accompanied by soft sunlight, distant mist, and an upper edge surrounded by green foliage. The figure should appear resolute and contemplative, stepping towards a new beginning. On the left, create a clean and inspirational typography. The top features a subheading "NEW MONTH" in a widely spaced, uppercase sans-serif font, with a short, thin lime-colored line on the left. Below this are two main headings: "WELCOME TO" in a large, warm beige uppercase font, and "..."{argument name="headline text" default="MAY"} "Use extra-large, bold white capital font to dominate the left half. Add a glowing lime-colored short underline below the large month word. Below the title, add an inspirational paragraph in white sans-serif font, highlighting some words in lime: 'May is a fresh start. A new chapter. A greater opportunity to become more, do more and have more.' Highlight 'fresh start,' 'new,' 'opportunity,' and 'more' in lime. Below this, place a rounded rectangular label card with a subtle glowing border. The card contains a circular icon badge with a simple lime-colored leaf symbol. Add three lines of stacked text to the right of the icon: 'New month.', 'Fresh energy.', and 'Bigger moves.' The last line is in lime. In the lower center of the image, create four equally spaced value pillars separated by thin vertical lines. Each pillar contains a minimalist lime-colored icon, a capital title, and a short description. Use the following four items from left to right: 1)" 1) Target icon, titled "CLARITY," meaning "Know your direction." 2) Calendar icon, titled "DISCIPLINE," meaning "Stay consistent." 3) Rising bar chart icon, titled "GROWTH," meaning "Keep evolving." 4) Fast-forward arrow icon, titled "MOMENTUM," meaning "Build forward daily." Add a thin horizontal dividing line at the bottom. Below that, place a capitalized closing statement: "THIS IS YOUR..."{argument name="month name" default="MAY"} ".", the next line should contain "".{argument name="closing line" default="STEP INTO IT."} The majority of the text is white or warm beige, with "MAY" and some emphasized content in lime green. The overall atmosphere is inspirational, modern, luxurious, focused, and proactive, suitable for social media posting, featuring clear sans-serif typography, high contrast, cinematic lighting effects, and a sophisticated personal growth brand aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh:
设计一张高端励志社交媒体海报，采用深色电影质感编辑风格，比例为 4:5 竖版。画面分为 2 个主要区域：左侧为文字排版区，右侧为愿景视觉区。背景使用黑色至深炭灰色，带有细腻纹理，右侧有淡淡的竖条纹墙面细节，地面有光泽反射，并融合优雅的霓虹青柠色强调光与暖金色高光。

在右侧，展示 1 位人物：一名身穿修身深色夹克和长裤的男性背影，正走向一个巨大的圆形传送门。传送门应足够大，散发着暖金色的光环和柔和的内部光晕，位置略偏右侧。传送门后方是一个宁静明亮的自然场景，有一条狭窄的踏脚石小径向前延伸，穿过草地，伴有柔和的阳光、远处的薄雾，上方边缘由绿叶树枝环绕。人物应呈现出坚定且深思的状态，迈向新的开始。

在左侧，创建简洁的励志排版。顶部包含一个小标题“NEW MONTH”，使用间距较大的大写无衬线字体，左侧配有一条细短的青柠色线条。下方放置 2 行主标题：“WELCOME TO”使用大号暖米色大写字体，以及“{argument name="headline text" default="MAY"}”使用超大加粗白色大写字体，占据左侧半部分的主导地位。在大号月份单词下方添加一条发光的青柠色短下划线。

在标题下方，添加一段白色无衬线字体的励志段落，并将部分词汇高亮为青柠色：“May is a fresh start. A new chapter. A greater opportunity to become more, do more and have more.” 将“fresh start”、“new”、“opportunity”和“more”高亮为青柠色。

在此下方，放置 1 张带有微弱边框光晕的圆角矩形标注卡片。卡片内包含 1 个圆形图标徽章，内含一个简单的青柠色叶子符号。图标右侧添加 3 行堆叠文字：“New month.”、“Fresh energy.” 和 “Bigger moves.”，最后一行使用青柠色。

在画面中下部，创建 4 个等间距的价值支柱，由细竖线分隔。每个支柱包含 1 个极简青柠色图标、1 个大写标题和 1 段简短说明。从左至右依次使用以下 4 项：1) 目标图标，标题“CLARITY”，说明“Know your direction”。2) 日历图标，标题“DISCIPLINE”，说明“Stay consistent”。3) 上升柱状图图标，标题“GROWTH”，说明“Keep evolving”。4) 快进箭头图标，标题“MOMENTUM”，说明“Build forward daily”。

在底部，添加一条细水平分割线。下方放置一行大写结束语：“THIS IS YOUR {argument name="month name" default="MAY"}.”，下一行放置“{argument name="closing line" default="STEP INTO IT."}”。大部分文字使用白色或暖米色，其中“MAY”及部分强调内容使用青柠色。

整体氛围：励志、现代、奢华、专注、积极进取，适合社交媒体发布，具有清晰的无衬线排版、高对比度、电影级光效以及精致的个人成长品牌美学。

templates.prompt: A 3D low-poly cartoon-style scene: A scrawny, poorly dressed young man slumps in a blue plush armchair in a wood-paneled room, viewed from a mid-to-long distance, slightly below table height. He has messy dark brown dreadlocks, pale skin, droopy eyelids, and a wide-open mouth revealing uneven white teeth, his expression exaggerated and comical. His posture is relaxed and languid: one leg is stretched out on the coffee table, the other is curled up in the chair; one hand holds a small smoking paraphernalia near his face, topped with a tiny red star, while the other holds a gray remote control. He is wearing a {argument name="shirt color" default="Royal Blue"} T-shirt, a pair{argument name="shorts color" default="Mustard Yellow"} Shorts, white knee-high socks, and oversized red sandals. In front of him was a rectangular wooden coffee table, on which three items were clearly visible: a cluster of bright green flower buds directly in front, a folded piece of white paper beside them, and a round gray ashtray filled with dark soot to the right. The room was warm and minimalist in color, with striped wooden wainscoting, dark wood floors, soft interior lighting, and a small section of trimmed wall decoration visible in the upper right corner. The overall visual effect was humorous, rugged, and handcrafted, like an independent animated sitcom made of paper collage or low-poly clay textures, with soft shadows, slightly worn surfaces, and a casually "decadent" relaxed atmosphere.

A centered title was added to the top center of the image.{argument name="headline text" default="MNEMOS"} The text should be a tall, clean, wide-spaced, all-caps sans-serif font in a bright, warm white, large enough to span most of the screen width. Keep the background unchanged, making only minor adjustments to the tonal balance to enhance readability and refine the overall image.

templates.title: Futuristic Living System Holographic Portrait

templates.prompt: A cinematic vertical nightscape photograph showcases a {argument name="subject" default="young women"} She sat in the kitchen/living space of a modern apartment, head down, staring at the flashing smartphone in her hands. Her face was mostly obscured by shadows and composition; her dark hair was parted in the middle and tied in a low bun. She wore a silky slate-blue spaghetti-strap dress and layered gold necklaces, including one engraved with…{argument name="necklace text" default="Angel"} A name tag necklace. The scene is illuminated by melancholic blue, purple, and cyan ambient light emanating from the room and the phone screen, creating a futuristic cyberpunk luxury atmosphere. A floating holographic augmented reality interface panel emerges from the phone, hovering over her chest and upper body, appearing as a translucent neon blue-purple with delicate glowing outlines, tiny particles, and digital spark effects. Five clearly visible UI panels and tabs are displayed: the system tab in the upper left corner {argument name="system label" default="LIFE SYSTEM"} The large panel on the left displays "Identity Status: VERIFIED (concept)" with a circular profile icon and a digital globe visualization; the middle right panel displays "Health Sync: STABLE" with a waveform pattern; the lower left panel displays "Finance Flow: ACTIVE" with small bar and line charts; the lower right panel displays "Access Level: GLOBAL"; and a narrow panel in between displays "Habits Initialization". The background features modern dark wood kitchen cabinets and a softly blurred countertop, with subtle, functional lighting and window dappled light on the left. The game boasts shallow depth of field, realistic skin and fabric textures, a premium smartphone photography feel, soft lighting effects, realistic low-light performance, high contrast, a futuristic yet believable near-future interface design, and a 9:16 vertical aspect ratio.

templates.title: Realistic Canadian citizen card

titleLocalized.zh: 逼真的加拿大公民卡

templates.prompt: A clean studio product photo showcases a realistic Canadian citizenship card laid flat on a light gray matte surface. The card is centered with ample white space around it. Landscaped with rounded corners and a slight thickness, it features soft shadows and is photographed from a near-overhead angle, giving it a subtle perspective. Designed as a bilingual Canadian identity card, it features a delicate guilloche security pattern in light pink, blue, and gray with subtle abstract wave patterns. Two small Canadian flags adorn the upper left corner, flanking a bold black sans-serif title text: the first line reads "CANADA – CANADIAN CITIZENSHIP CARD," and the second "CARTE DE CITOYENNETÉ CANADIENNE." To the left is a passport-style half-length portrait of a woman with straight, dark brown hair parted in the middle, wearing a navy blue crewneck sweater, but her face is obscured by a solid rectangular blur for privacy. To the right of the portrait is the main identity information text in black, a mix of capital letters and numbers, arranged in neat left-aligned lines. Please strictly use the following visible bilingual fields and numbers: “Surname / Nom” followed by “MARTIN”; “Given names / Prénoms” followed by “ÉMILIE SOPHIE”; “CANADIAN / CANADIENNE” for nationality; “Citizenship Number / Numéro de citoyenneté” followed by “1234-5678”; “Date of birth / Date de naissance” followed by “14 APR 1996”; “Sex / Sexe” followed by “F”; “Place of birth / Lieu de naissance” followed by “MONTRÉAL, QC, CANADA”; “Issue date / Date d'émission” followed by “20 MAY 2024”; “Expiry date / Date d'expiration” followed by “20 MAY 2034”. The upper right corner features two official security elements: a dark Canadian coat of arms and a small metal square with a maple leaf below. The lower right corner includes a large iridescent holographic maple leaf security feature with a rainbow sheen. A cursive signature "Émilie S. Martin" is added to the lower right corner, below which is the inscription "Holder's Signature / Signature du titulaire". The overall style is a highly realistic photograph of a government-issued document, with clear text, authentic typography, a card-like texture, neutral lighting, a simple background, no hands, and no other extraneous items.

templates.title: Poorly made MS Paint-style emoji portraits

titleLocalized.zh: 拙劣的 MS Paint 风格表情包肖像

templates.prompt: A childlike, crudely drawn digital portrait against a pure light gray background, centered close-up of the upper body. The figure is a comical adult man with messy light blonde stubble, most of his dark hair hidden by a gray ribbed knit hat. A small orange circular badge with the white number "10" is pinned to the right side of the hat. He wears oversized, thick-rimmed black sunglasses that completely obscure his eyes. His face displays an exaggerated, toothy grin, with oversized, square white teeth dominating the lower half of his face, drawn clumsily and unevenly, with a few tiny red marks on his gums. His nose is simple and cartoonish, and his left ear protrudes. He wears a thick black jacket over a cream or off-white sweater. The style deliberately strives for a messy, amateurish, childlike doodle feel: jagged black outlines, rough lines, disproportionate proportions, childish anatomy, minimal shading, and random fill colors, giving the impression of a hand-drawn MS Paint or cheap tablet sketch. Keep the composition simple and humorous, with a charming "ugly-cute" feel, like a poorly drawn viral meme avatar.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅稚气未脱、笔触粗糙的数字涂鸦肖像，背景为纯浅灰色，构图为胸部以上的居中特写。画中是一位滑稽的成年男子，留着凌乱的浅金色胡茬，深色头发大部分被一顶灰色罗纹针织帽遮住。针织帽右侧别着一枚小小的橙色圆形徽章，里面写着白色数字“10”。他戴着一副超大号黑色粗框墨镜，完全遮住了眼睛。他的脸上露着夸张的露齿大笑，超大的方形白牙占据了下半张脸的大部分，线条画得笨拙且不均匀，牙龈处还有几处细小的红色标记。鼻子画得简单且卡通，左侧耳朵突出。他穿着一件厚实的黑色夹克，内搭米白色或奶油色毛衣。画风刻意追求凌乱、业余、像小孩子涂鸦般的质感：锯齿状的黑色轮廓、粗糙的线条、不协调的比例、幼稚的解剖结构、极少的阴影、随意的填充颜色，呈现出一种手绘 MS Paint 或廉价平板电脑草图的感觉。保持构图简洁、幽默，并带有一种迷人的“丑萌”感，就像一个画得很烂的病毒式表情包头像。

templates.title: The office "everything is fine" collapse scene

titleLocalized.zh: 办公室“一切都好”崩溃现场

templates.prompt: A stylized and humorous editorial illustration depicts a chaotic and ablaze office, rendered in warm orange, amber, and smoky brown tones, with cinematic lighting and a painterly quality. At the center of the scene is a distraught office worker, seated at his desk, wearing a rumpled olive green shirt and a loose black tie, holding a black coffee cup close to his face. His face is replaced with a warm-toned rectangular mask. He has messy dark brown hair, and black rectangular glasses are visible from the side. Above him, on a stained beige wall, is a centered, bold, black sans-serif quote, divided into two lines, which reads:{argument name="headline text" default="this is fine. everything is fine."} Below is a hand-drawn red underline. The room is filled with visible black smoke billowing from the corner of the ceiling. A glowing red emergency alarm light is located in the upper left, and a ceiling smoke detector is in the upper right. A crooked, cute dog poster hangs on the left wall, reading "HANG IN THERE!". In the lower left foreground, a black metal wastebasket engulfed in flames contains a piece of paper labeled "PLAN" with three checkboxes, all indicating "do thing." A dark-colored nameplate near the front edge of the desk reads "chaos coordinator." Scattered on the desk are numerous documents, sticky notes, a pen, binder clips, and miscellaneous office supplies. A piece of paper with "DEADLINES (yikes)" written in red handwriting is placed in the center. A green sticky note on the lower left reads "call back someday maybe." An open gray laptop on the right has a yellow sticky note that reads "good job me :)." In the lower right foreground, an overturned beige coffee cup is displayed, dark coffee spilled on documents and a simple red line graph. A whiteboard titled "TODAY:" is added to the right wall, featuring four checklist items: "survive," "coffee," "pretend," and "check email (ugh)." Below, a withered, dead office plant sits, and a small note on the wall reads "IT'S FINE." The overall atmosphere, absurd yet calm in the face of apparent disaster, is imbued with an ironic sense of corporate burnout, detailed by elements such as smoke, embers, cracked walls, and a refined digital illustration aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张风格化且幽默的社论插画，描绘了一个陷入混乱并起火的办公室，采用温暖的橙色、琥珀色和烟熏棕色调，呈现电影般的灯光和绘画质感。场景中心是一位焦头烂额的上班族，坐在办公桌前，穿着皱巴巴的橄榄绿衬衫，系着松垮的黑色领带，手里拿着一个黑色咖啡杯靠近脸部。将其面部替换为一个暖肤色的矩形遮挡块。他留着凌乱的深棕色头发，侧面可见黑色矩形眼镜。在他上方污渍斑斑的米色墙面上，放置一行居中的粗体黑色无衬线引语，分为两行，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="this is fine. everything is fine."}，下方有一条手绘的红色下划线。房间里充斥着从天花板角落卷出的可见黑烟，左上方有一个发光的红色紧急警报灯，右上方有一个天花板烟雾探测器。左侧墙上挂着一张歪斜的可爱小狗悬挂海报，上面写着“HANG IN THERE!”。左下角前景处，展示一个被明火吞没的黑色金属废纸篓，里面有一张标有“PLAN”的纸，上面有 3 个复选框，内容均为“do thing”。在桌子前缘附近放置一个深色的办公桌名牌，上面写着“chaos coordinator”。桌上散落着许多零散的文件、便签、一支笔、长尾夹和杂乱的办公用品。在中心位置放置一张用红色手写体标有“DEADLINES (yikes)”的纸。左下方贴一张绿色便签，写着“call back someday maybe”。右侧放置一台打开的灰色笔记本电脑，上面贴着一张黄色便签，写着“good job me :)”。右下角前景处，展示一个翻倒的米色咖啡杯，深色咖啡洒在文件和一张简单的红色折线图上。右侧墙上添加一个标题为“TODAY:”的白板，上面有 4 个检查清单项目：“survive”、“coffee”、“pretend”和“check email (ugh)”。下方放置一盆枯萎的死掉的办公绿植，墙上贴着一张写有“IT'S FINE”的小便签。整体氛围在明显的灾难面前显得荒诞而平静，充满讽刺性的企业职业倦怠感，细节包括烟雾、余烬、裂纹墙壁以及精致的数字插画质感。

templates.title: MS Paint Doodle Redrawing

titleLocalized.zh: MS Paint 涂鸦重绘

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, redraw its composition and iconic silhouette as a very rough, childlike MS Paint doodle. Retain the side pose, blue headscarf, pale yellow scarf, pearl earrings, and brown clothing, but simplify all elements to rough black outlines, messy doodle fills, uneven proportions, and deliberately low-level hand-drawn marks against a pure white background. Make it look like a quickly completed amateur digital sketch with tiled colors and no painterly shading.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图像，将其构图和标志性轮廓重绘为非常粗糙、充满童趣的 MS Paint 涂鸦。保留侧面姿势、蓝色头巾、淡黄色长围巾、珍珠耳环和棕色服装，但将所有元素简化为粗糙的黑色轮廓、杂乱的涂鸦填色、不均匀的比例，以及在纯白背景上刻意表现出的低水平手绘痕迹。使其看起来像是一幅快速完成的业余数字草图，具有平铺的色彩，且没有任何绘画般的阴影效果。

templates.title: Graffiti Pencil Mountain View

titleLocalized.zh: 涂鸦铅笔山景

templates.prompt: A monochrome pencil sketch of a landscape drawn on white paper with freehand doodle-like strokes, exhibiting a distinct graphite texture, bold hatching, and expressive intersecting shadows. The scene depicts a tranquil rural valley. In the right foreground stands a large, broad-leaved tree with a deep, textured trunk and a canopy composed of scattered sketch strokes. A narrow dirt road begins near the bottom center, curving gently towards the middle ground, leading to a small, pointed-roof farmhouse on the left side of the picture. A row of wire fence posts is added beside the road in the left foreground, surrounded by low grass and shrubs, with bushes and trees scattered around the house. A series of layered mountains are depicted in the background, with the highest peak located in the middle left, rendered with soft shadows using slanted pencil strokes. The sky contains light sketch lines, dotted with two large clouds and three flying birds. The overall composition is ethereal, pastoral, and hand-drawn, with natural perspective, retaining the vitality of an unfinished sketch, and devoid of color, as if drawn from a casual landscape sketchbook.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅在白纸上用随性涂鸦笔触绘制的单色铅笔素描风景画，具有明显的石墨质感、粗犷的排线和富有表现力的交叉阴影。画面展现了一个宁静的乡村山谷场景，右侧前景中有一棵巨大的阔叶树，树干深邃且富有质感，树冠由零散的素描笔触构成。一条狭窄的土路从底部中央附近开始，向中景轻轻弯曲，通向位于画面中左侧的一座小型尖顶农舍。在左侧前景的道路旁添加一排带有铁丝的栅栏柱，路边环绕着低矮的草丛和灌木，房子附近散布着灌木和树木。背景处绘制了一系列层叠的山峦，最高峰位于中左侧，用斜向的铅笔笔触进行柔和的阴影处理。天空中包含轻盈的素描线条，点缀着 2 朵大云和 3 只飞翔的小鸟。整体构图空灵、具有田园气息且充满手绘感，透视自然，保留了未完成的素描活力，且不含色彩，仿佛出自随意的风景速写本。

templates.title: 3D male avatar against a red background

titleLocalized.zh: 红色背景下的 3D 男性头像

templates.prompt: A centered 3D stylized close-up portrait of a man against a smooth, vibrant deep red studio backdrop. The rendering is reminiscent of a finely crafted animated character, with realistic lighting and soft subsurface skin tones. He has thick, glossy black hair styled in a neat side-parted pompadour with sculpted waves, revealing his ears, and subtly visible thin-rimmed gold-rimmed glasses. Only the head and a small portion of the upper shoulders are shown, with a tight cropping that fills the top of the image. The character wears a dark top, barely visible at the bottom edge. The symmetrical frontal composition, extremely clean background with high contrast and soft rim lighting, creates a sophisticated 3D illustration quality reminiscent of modern animated portraits. The face is sharp and detailed, with a neutral expression, and the overall design remains minimalist yet iconic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张居中的 3D 风格化男性特写肖像，背景为平滑且鲜艳的深红色摄影棚背景。渲染效果如同精致的动画角色，具有逼真的光影和柔和的次表面皮肤着色。他留着浓密且富有光泽的黑色头发，梳理成整齐的侧分蓬巴杜发型，带有雕塑感的波浪纹理，露出耳朵，两侧隐约可见细圆框金丝眼镜。仅展示头部和少量上肩部，紧凑裁剪，使发型填满画面顶部。角色穿着深色上衣，仅在底部边缘隐约可见。采用对称的正面构图，背景极其简洁，对比度高，带有柔和的轮廓光，呈现出类似于现代动画头像的高级 3D 插画质感。面部应清晰且细节丰富，表情中性，整体设计保持简约且具有标志性。

templates.title: Cinematic Shared Apartment Breakfast UI

titleLocalized.zh: 电影感合租公寓早餐 UI

templates.prompt: The game interface, presented in a cinematic first-person visual novel style, showcases a cozy morning breakfast scene in the dining room of a shared apartment. Shot with a slightly wide-angle lens and shallow depth of field, it depicts two young women seated opposite each other at a wooden table, bathed in soft golden sunlight streaming through a large window on their left. The woman on the left, her hair casually tied back, wears a grey vest and a loose cardigan that has slipped off one shoulder, leaning back casually with one hand behind her head. The woman on the right, with long black hair, wears a beige oversized knit sweater, her hands supporting her chin, leaning forward against the table. Their faces are obscured by soft, rectangular blurs. Two breakfast plates are clearly visible on the table: the plate in front of the woman on the left contains pasta or salad, while the larger plate in front of the woman on the right holds several slices of toast; a second plate nearby on the right contains two fried eggs. The scene also includes two mugs, a small glass, a folder with papers and a pen in the lower left foreground, a small black camera in the bottom right center, and a vase with white flowers in the lower right foreground. The room feels comfortable and inviting, furnished with wooden furniture, a central doorway at the back, kitchen shelves and chairs in the background, and sunlight casting reflections on the floor and tabletops. A sophisticated Chinese interactive story game HUD overlay has been added. Top left: A dark, rounded title capsule containing a homepage icon and the text "Surround View Heartbeat Project," followed by a smaller capsule reading "Chapter One," then the scene title "Morning in a Shared Apartment" and a smaller location label "Restaurant." The left-side vertical status panel contains five stacked buttons, displaying: "Route Unlocked," "Career 32," "Sincerity 38," "Stress 38," and "Trust Average 30." Top right: Four compact, rounded buttons labeled "Relationships," "Memories," "Save," and "Settings." Near the bottom center of the desktop, a small, floating location label reads "Planetarium Vision." At the bottom is a dark, semi-transparent dialogue box with the speaker's label "Narration" and the text, "The next morning, you wake up and sit down in the center of the dining table. Fruit, coffee, contracts, dancing shoes, a controller, and scenery are arranged in a circle." A small "Next Page" arrow button is on the right. Overall style: realistic, cinematic game screenshots, an intimate, homey atmosphere, soft glow effects, gentle beige and brown tones, advanced narrative application UI, immersive and emotionally suggestive.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个电影感的第一人称视觉小说游戏界面，展示了合租公寓餐厅中温馨的清晨早餐场景，采用略微广角镜头拍摄，具有浅景深效果。两位年轻女性坐在木桌对面，左侧大窗户透进的柔和金色阳光洒在她们身上。左侧的女性头发凌乱地扎起，身穿灰色背心和一件从一侧肩膀滑落的宽松开衫，随意地向后靠着，一只手放在脑后。右侧的女性留着长长的黑发，身穿米色大码针织毛衣，双手托腮，身体前倾靠向桌面。她们的面部被柔和的矩形模糊块遮挡。桌上有 2 个清晰可见的早餐盘：左侧女性面前的盘子里装着意面或沙拉类食物，右侧女性面前的大盘子里放着几片吐司；右侧附近还有第二个早餐盘，里面有 2 个煎蛋。画面中包含 2 个马克杯、1 个小玻璃杯、左下角前景处有一个带有纸张和笔的文件夹、底部中右侧有一个小型黑色相机，以及右下角前景处有一个插着白色花朵的花瓶。房间感觉舒适且充满生活气息，配有木质家具、后方中央的门口、背景中的厨房搁架和椅子，阳光在地面和桌面上投下倒影。添加一个精致的中文互动故事游戏 HUD 叠加层。左上角：一个深色圆角标题胶囊，内含一个主页图标和文字“环景心动计划”，以及一个写着“第一章”的小胶囊，随后是场景标题“合租公寓的早晨”和一个较小的地点标签“餐厅”。左侧垂直状态面板包含 5 个堆叠按钮，依次显示：“路线 未锁定”、“事业 32”、“真诚 38”、“压力 38”、“信任均值 30”。右上角：4 个紧凑的圆角按钮，分别标注为“关系”、“回忆”、“存档”、“设置”。在底部中央桌面附近，添加一个悬浮的小型地点标签，写着“天文馆景想”。底部放置一个深色半透明对话框，带有发言人标签“旁白”和文字“第二天早晨，你在餐桌中央醒来般坐下。水果、咖啡、合同、舞鞋、手柄和景程围成一圈。”，右侧配有一个小型的下一页箭头按钮。整体风格：写实的电影感游戏截图，亲密的居家氛围，柔和的辉光效果，柔和的米色和棕色调，高级叙事应用 UI，沉浸式且具有情感暗示。

templates.prompt: A heartwarming late-night street stall photo with a soothing, Xiaohongshu-esque aesthetic. The image features a young woman sitting down; her face is blurred, she has medium-length straight black hair, and is wearing {argument name="top color" default="warm beige"} She wears a deep V-neck ribbed knit top and high-waisted blue jeans. She sits sideways on a red plastic stool, a small glass of pale beer close to her lips, relaxed and slightly tipsy, conveying a casual, candid nightlife vibe. The scene is a casual roadside stall, dimly lit and warm: on the yellow table in the lower left corner are two bottles of beer with green labels, a plastic cup with beer foam, a pack of colorful cigarettes, and a few scraps of napkins; behind her is an old-fashioned electric fan placed on a white appliance box, with a semi-transparent plastic curtain hanging behind her, and two red plastic stools visible in the background. To the right is a small stall counter with shelves, cups, and red cans, and a partially illuminated sign. Hand-drawn white graffiti outlines are added around the figures and objects, accompanied by arrows, flashes, hearts, swirls, and handwritten Chinese annotations throughout the frame, like an emotional caption. Includes 10 Chinese captions: "The old-fashioned fan is whirring~ It evokes a sense of nostalgia♡", "The small space separated by the plastic curtain feels safer~", "The warmth and humanity of roadside stalls are the most comforting~", "Icy beer is bittersweet~ The more you drink, the more relaxed you feel!", "Sip slowly~ Let yourself clear your mind a bit♡", "The bubbles in the glass are like tiny moments of happiness slowly disappearing~", "A little tipsy tonight... My mood is just right, let's put all our worries aside♡", "Comfortable outfits are liberating and relaxing~ Being yourself is the most important♡", "High-waisted jeans flatter your proportions and give you a sense of security!", and a large cloud-shaped caption near the bottom left that reads, "Life occasionally needs a little bit of tipsy happiness~ Love yourself well today♡". The photos employ a realistic mobile photography style with cinematic contrast, giving skin and hair a glossy sheen. The slightly compact composition creates an intimate street nighttime atmosphere, presenting a soft yet clear, editor-grade image quality. The handwritten notes remain bright white and legible, naturally blending into the photos.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张具有小红书风格治愈系项目美学的温馨深夜路边摊照片。画面中是一位坐着的年轻女性，面部经过模糊处理，留着中长直黑发，身穿 {argument name="top color" default="暖米色"} 的深 V 领罗纹针织上衣和高腰蓝色牛仔裤。她侧身坐在红色塑料凳上，一只手拿着一小杯淡色啤酒靠近嘴边，神态放松且略带微醺，呈现出一种随性的夜生活抓拍感。场景是一个休闲的路边摊，灯光昏暗温暖：左下角的黄色桌面上摆放着 2 瓶绿色标签的啤酒、1 个带有啤酒泡沫的塑料杯、1 包彩色香烟和几张零碎的餐巾纸；她身后放置着 1 台旧式电风扇，放在 1 个白色家电包装箱上，身后挂着半透明的塑料帘，背景中可见 2 把红色塑料凳。右侧是一个小型摊位柜台，上面有货架、杯子和红色易拉罐，还有一个部分可见的照明招牌。在人物和物体周围添加手绘的白色涂鸦轮廓，并配以箭头、闪光、爱心、漩涡以及遍布画面的手写中文标注，如同情绪化的配文。包含 10 条中文标注：“老式风扇呼呼转着～有种怀旧感♡”、“塑胶布帘隔开的小空间 反而更有安全感～”、“路边小摊 人间烟火气 最抚慰人心～”、“冰凉的啤酒 苦中带甘～ 越喝越放松！”、“小口慢慢喝～ 让自己 稍微放空一下♡”、“杯子里的泡泡 像小小的快乐 慢慢消失～”、“今晚有点微醺… 心情刚刚好 什么烦恼都 先放一边吧♡”、“舒服的穿搭 自在又放松～ 做自己最重要♡”、“高腰牛仔裤 修饰比例 也很有安全感！”，以及左下角附近一个云朵形状的大号文案，写着“生活偶尔需要 一点微醺的小确幸～ 今天也要好好爱自己♡”。采用写实的手机摄影质感，具有电影般的对比度，皮肤和头发上有光泽感，构图略显紧凑，营造出亲密的街头夜晚氛围，并呈现出柔和而清晰的编辑级画质。保持手写笔记为明亮的白色且清晰易读，自然地融入照片中。

templates.prompt: A richly detailed poster for the fantasy studio, employing a wide-format cinematic composition, features a large hand-drawn black brushstroke banner at the center with glowing gold calligraphy that reads:{argument name="headline text" default="GPTImage2Skill"} The scene is a cozy magical workshop, located in a wooden cave or an old scholar's hut, filled with warm amber light, glowing UI icons, scrolls, tools, potion bottles, and framed artwork. An opening behind a banner reveals a distant, mysterious mountain landscape. A total of nine characters are featured: six lively and adorable chibi-style mythological apprentices inspired by *Journey to the West*; one elderly master with double buns and a long white beard, seated in the center; and two elegant, tall, fantastical women standing on the right. Several faces are deliberately obscured by softly blurred rectangles. The apprentices have round, vivid faces, petite and sturdy figures, and topknots. They wear traditional clothing in purple, green, red, orange, yellow, and blue, their postures full of energy and a sense of accomplishment, as if showcasing their work. The elderly master sits calmly in the center, leaning on a cane, surrounded by children. The two women on the right wear magnificent robes and gold ornaments; one wears a crown, her posture resembling a mysterious patron or a spirit queen. Includes eight display items or screens held by the characters: a herbal tea packaging design with a Chinese layout and an image of a green beverage; an illustration of an anime warrior character with an electric blue effect; a monochrome product sketch or UI wireframe page; a mobile app interface mockup on a tablet; a product photo of a luxury perfume bottle; a wildlife photograph of a small bird; a dark fantasy landscape painting; and a blue analytics dashboard screen. Surrounding the group are seven glowing interface/logo elements: a code monitor in the top left corner, a neon puzzle icon, a neon network node icon, a neon cube icon, a neon image frame icon, a glowing sign that says "PLUGIN," and a glowing sign that says "SKILL." Add two glowing floating scrolls with stylized code lines, one near the top right corner and the other in the center foreground at the bottom. The environment should be busy, festive, and handcrafted, blending Chinese mythology, generative AI creativity, game art, application design, product photography, dashboards, and illustrations. It should feature ultra-refined digital painting, storybook fantasy aesthetics, dramatic rim lighting, warm gold and orange highlights, cyan-blue magical accents, layered depth, dense props, fantastical sparkles, and an exquisite promotional banner look.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张细节丰富的奇幻工作室海报，采用宽幅电影构图，中央是一个巨大的手绘黑色笔触横幅，上面有发光的金色书法，写着 {argument name="headline text" default="GPTImage2Skill"}。场景是一个温馨的魔法工作室，位于木质洞穴或古老的学者小屋内，充满了温暖的琥珀色灯光、发光的 UI 图标、卷轴、工具、药水瓶和装裱好的艺术品，横幅后的开口处可以看到远方神秘的山峦景观。总共安排 9 个人物：6 位受《西游记》启发、活泼可爱的 Q 版神话学徒，1 位坐在中央、留着双发髻和长白胡须的老大师，以及 2 位站在右侧、优雅高挑的奇幻女性。几张面孔被柔和的模糊矩形刻意遮挡。学徒们有着圆润生动的脸庞、娇小敦实的身材、发髻，穿着紫色、绿色、红色、橙色、黄色和蓝色的传统服饰，姿态充满活力和成就感，仿佛在展示他们的作品。老大师平静地坐在中间，双手拄着拐杖，被孩子们环绕。右侧的 2 位女性身着华丽的长袍，佩戴金色饰品，其中一位戴着皇冠，姿态如同神秘的赞助人或灵界女王。包含由角色持有的 8 个展示项目或屏幕：1 个带有中式布局和绿色饮品图像的草本茶包装设计，1 个带有电光蓝色特效的动漫战士角色插画，1 张单色产品草图或 UI 线框图页面，1 个平板电脑上的移动应用界面模型，1 张奢华香水瓶产品照片，1 张小型鸟类野生动物摄影作品，1 幅暗黑奇幻风景画，以及 1 个蓝色分析仪表盘屏幕。在群体周围环绕 7 个发光的界面/标志元素：左上角 1 个代码监视器，1 个霓虹拼图图标，1 个霓虹网络节点图标，1 个霓虹立方体图标，1 个霓虹图像框图标，1 个写着“PLUGIN”的发光标志，以及 1 个写着“SKILL”的发光标志。添加 2 个发光的悬浮卷轴，上面带有程式化的代码线条，一个在右上角附近，另一个在底部中心前景。环境应显得忙碌、喜庆且具有手工质感，融合了中国神话、生成式 AI 创意、游戏艺术、应用设计、产品摄影、仪表盘和插画。采用超精细数字绘画、故事书奇幻美学、戏剧性的轮廓光、温暖的金色和橙色高光、青蓝色魔法点缀、分层深度、密集的道具、奇幻的火花以及精致的宣传横幅外观。

titleLocalized.zh: 极简黑白男性剪影

templates.prompt: A minimalist, high-contrast black and white vector portrait depicting the upper body of a young man in a three-quarter profile facing left, with the face deliberately left blank to create a clean negative space silhouette effect. He has thick, messy, medium-length hair with rich layers and a side-parted fringe, with sharp white highlights interspersed among the black hair; the right ear is clearly visible, and the jawline, neck, and collar are outlined by smooth graphic curves. He wears a simple dark crew neck shirt or jacket, represented by a rugged black shape, complemented by a few clean white decorative lines. The composition is centered and compact, with a pure light gray to off-white background, devoid of text, props, extraneous objects, and any facial features. promptLocalized.zh: 一款极简主义高对比度黑白矢量肖像，展示了一位年轻男性的上半身，呈四分之三侧面朝左，面部刻意留白，呈现出干净的负空间剪影效果。他留着浓密且凌乱的中长发，层次感丰富，带有侧分刘海，黑色头发间点缀着锐利的白色高光线条；右侧耳朵清晰可见，下颌线、颈部和衣领通过流畅的图形曲线勾勒。他穿着一件简单的深色圆领上衣或夹克，表现为粗犷的黑色形状，辅以几条利落的白色装饰线。构图居中且紧凑，背景为纯净的浅灰色至灰白色，无文字、无道具、无额外物体，且不包含任何面部特征。采用时尚现代的 Logo 式动漫与编辑风格剪影，具备干净的矢量边缘、极简阴影、强烈的负空间感、海报设计美学以及正方形构图。

templates.prompt: A hyper-realistic Forbes-style editorial magazine cover, photographed as a formal indoor business portrait. A confident young woman.{argument name="cover subject name" default="MIRA"} Seated in the center of a beige upholstered armchair, in a luxurious modern interior space against a backdrop of dark stone or wood walls and softly blurred greenery, she sports long, voluminous, slightly wavy, dark brown hair parted in the middle. Her complexion is warm and radiant, and her expression is calm and composed. She wears a fitted black dress with a black blazer and a delicate small oval gold pendant necklace. Her posture is elegant and poised, leaning slightly back in the chair, one arm resting naturally on the armrest. Warm, cinematic lighting creates soft highlights on her hair and face, employing shallow depth of field, sophisticated color grading, and sharp fashion editorial details. The image is designed like a full magazine cover, topped with a striking white serif masthead.{argument name="magazine title" default="Forbes"} The top right corner features the date text "MAY 2025" in small uppercase letters. DEFINING THE FUTURE.” On the right, add a stacked headline: “YOUNG ENOUGH TO CHANGE THE WORLD,” and below that, another text block: “BOLD IDEAS. REAL IMPACT. promptLocalized.zh: 一张超写实的福布斯风格编辑类杂志封面，拍摄为正式的室内商业肖像。一位自信的年轻女性 {argument name="cover subject name" default="MIRA"} 坐在米色软垫扶手椅中央，身处奢华的现代室内空间，背景为深色石材或木墙，并配有柔和虚化的植物。她留着长而蓬松、微卷的深棕色中分发型，肤色温暖明亮，表情从容镇定。她身穿修身黑色连衣裙，外搭黑色西装外套，佩戴一条精致的金色小椭圆形吊坠项链。她姿态优雅从容，微微后靠在椅背上，一只手臂自然地放在扶手上。采用温暖的电影级灯光，在头发和面部形成柔和的高光，使用浅景深、高级调色以及锐利的时装编辑细节。将图像设计为完整的杂志封面，顶部印有醒目的白色衬线字体刊头 {argument name="magazine title" default="Forbes"}，右上角为小号大写日期文本“MAY 2025”，左侧为“30 UNDER 30”专题行，采用精致的衬线排版，并重复放大数字“30”。在左侧栏添加小号封面文字：“MEET THE NEXT GENERATION OF GAME CHANGERS RESHAPING THE FUTURE.”（遇见重塑未来的下一代变革者）。在左下角添加醒目的淡黄色衬线字体大标题：{argument name="main headline" default="MIRA"}。在其下方添加副标题：“FOUNDER. templates.title: Liuhu Hanfu Sunset

titleLocalized.zh: 柳湖汉服夕照

templates.prompt: A serene golden moment: a portrait of a person on a riverbank in ancient China.{argument name="character name" default="An elegant young woman"} She stands beneath a towering ancient willow with long, drooping branches. She wears an elegant, flowing Hanfu, layers of coral red, peach, and pale pink silk embroidered with delicate flowers; the semi-transparent outer sleeves and long ribbons flutter in the breeze. A traditional oil-paper umbrella, pale rose pink, with its bamboo ribs faintly visible, rests behind her, forming a halo-like outline above her head. Her hairstyle is an elaborate updo, adorned with flower hairpins and small blossoms. The composition is a vertical full-body portrait, with the woman positioned slightly to the right of center. The thick, clearly defined trunk of the willow tree occupies the left side, and the warm sunset hangs low on the horizon, illuminating the calm lake surface, which shimmers. Distant mountains are faintly visible, and a small pavilion stands on the far shore. The foreground is adorned with wildflowers and tender green grass, with clothing and willow leaves swaying gently in the breeze, creating a dreamy atmosphere of mist and volumetric light. It presents a romantic and realistic painting style with extremely delicate textures and a soft, cinematic halo. The color tone is warm amber and soft pastel, full of ethereal historical fantasy atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张宁静的黄金时刻中国古代河畔人像，{argument name="character name" default="一位优雅的年轻女子"} 站在一棵垂着长长枝条的参天古柳之下。她身着优雅飘逸的汉服，层叠的珊瑚红、蜜桃色和淡粉色丝绸上绣着精致的花卉，半透明的外袖和长长的丝带在微风中飘动。她肩后撑着 1 把传统的油纸伞，淡玫瑰粉色，隐约可见竹制伞骨，在头顶形成光环般的轮廓。她的发型是华丽的盘发，点缀着花朵发簪和小花。构图采用竖版全身像，女子位于画面中心偏右，粗壮且纹理分明的柳树树干占据左侧，温暖的夕阳低悬在地平线上，照耀着平静的湖面，水面波光粼粼，远山隐约可见，远岸有 1 座小型亭台。前景点缀着野花和柔嫩的青草，衣物和柳叶在微风中轻轻摆动，营造出梦幻的大气薄雾和体积光，呈现出浪漫的写实绘画风格，纹理极其细腻，带有柔和的电影感光晕，色调为温暖的琥珀色与柔和的粉彩色，充满空灵的历史奇幻氛围。

templates.title: Sunset skateboarding boy wearing loose jeans

titleLocalized.zh: 身穿宽松牛仔裤的日落滑板少年

templates.prompt: A full-body street fashion photograph captures a young skateboarder standing on a concrete seaside promenade at sunset. Tall palm trees silhouette against the backdrop, and the warm, soft sky transitions from peach to pale gold. The subject faces the camera in a relaxed, editorial pose, one hand in his pocket, the other gripping a worn skateboard frame vertically. He is wearing a {argument name="beanie color" default="lavender"} A knitted beanie conceals messy, medium-length, dark hair; an oversized, distressed light brown workwear jacket with two flap pockets on the chest and a small square logo patch, layered over a plain white T-shirt; a black and white checkered belt; extremely loose, deep indigo jeans with contrasting stitching and large workwear-style patch pockets; and checkered slip-on skate shoes. The jeans are the key highlight: the extra-wide legs create heavy folds on the shoes, presenting an exaggerated sense of volume without losing the authentic denim texture. The shot is a natural, candid style with a slightly soft film-like quality, soft tones, delicate grain, and realistic lighting. It blends fashion editorial style with skateboard culture, shot at eye level with a 35mm lens and shallow depth of field, creating the atmosphere of Venice Beach. Several pedestrians and a cyclist in the background are kept in small proportion and out of focus.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张全身街头时尚摄影作品，拍摄了一位年轻滑板少年站在日落时分海滨混凝土步道上的场景，背景中高大的棕榈树呈现出剪影，温暖的柔和天空色调从桃色渐变为淡金色。主体以放松的编辑风格姿势面对镜头，一只手插在口袋里，另一只手垂直握住一块磨损的滑板支架。他戴着一顶 {argument name="beanie color" default="薰衣草色"} 针织冷帽，遮住凌乱的中长深色头发；身穿一件超大廓形、做旧浅棕色工装短外套，带有两个胸前翻盖口袋和一个小方形 Logo 贴标，内搭纯白色 T 恤；系着黑白棋盘格腰带；穿着极度宽松的深靛蓝色牛仔裤，带有撞色缝线和大型工装风格贴袋；脚踩棋盘格一脚蹬滑板鞋。牛仔裤应作为核心亮点：超宽裤腿，在鞋面上堆叠出厚重的褶皱，呈现出夸张的体积感但又不失真实的牛仔质感。自然抓拍风格，略带柔和的胶片质感，色调柔和，带有细腻颗粒感，光影真实，融合了时尚编辑风格与滑板文化，采用 35mm 镜头平视拍摄，浅景深，营造出 Venice Beach 的氛围，背景中的几位行人和一名骑行者保持较小比例并处于失焦状态。

templates.title: Ancient Chinese Bronze Calligraphy Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 中国古代青铜书法海报

templates.prompt: This exquisite poster design, in the style of ancient Chinese art, uses warm ivory-textured paper, featuring minimalist layout and ample white space, giving it the feel of a museum catalog. The central element of the composition is {argument name="main calligraphy" default="This is what a man should be like"} Presented in bold, expressive black ink calligraphy, the five large characters are arranged vertically in the center left position. To the right is a line of elegant, metallic gold vertical Chinese characters, the content of which is {argument name="side quote" default="He can be replaced"} At the right center is a magnificent, dark bronze ritual vessel frame, shaped like a square jade disc or a hook-shaped rectangular ring, with weathered verdigris, a heavy texture, and rounded inner corners. The upper left corner is adorned with a stylized animal head carving. Through the hollow opening of the bronze vessel, a faint gray-toned ink-wash historical landscape painting is displayed: distant mountains, open plains, and a tattered flag fluttering in the wind. At the bottom center rests a separate bronze ritual vessel with two upright handles, its body rounded and stout, decorated with a taotie relief, displaying an aged, bluish-brown verdigris. Around the composition are several columns of small, vertical Chinese annotation text, like an academic exhibition poster: a long, thin column of seasonal descriptions on the far left, a compact vertical philosophical quote in the upper right corner, a small vertical commentary next to the main calligraphy, a source/interpretation text in the lower left corner, and a period/culture text in the lower right corner. It contains a total of four red seals, distributed in different areas, with a tiny gold dragon emblem added near the lower center. A small printed signature text is added in the lower right corner.{argument name="designer credit" default="DESIGNER : A CHIH"} The color scheme features off-white paper, matte black ink, dark oxidized bronze, soft gray landscape, antique gold typography, and vermilion seals. The lighting is soft and diffused, the posters are displayed flat, and the overall design is clean and sophisticated, blending Song Dynasty aesthetics, calligraphy exhibition posters, bronze archaeology, and luxurious editorial layout.

promptLocalized.zh: 一款精致的中国古代风格海报设计，采用暖象牙色纹理纸张，极简的编辑排版，留白充裕，呈现出博物馆图录的质感。构图中心为 {argument name="main calligraphy" default="大丈夫當如是"}，以粗犷、富有表现力的黑色墨迹书法呈现，垂直排列于左中位置，共 5 个大字。右侧放置一行优雅的金属金色竖排中文字符，内容为 {argument name="side quote" default="彼可取而代之"}。右中位置设有一个宏伟的深色青铜古礼器框架，形状类似方形玉璧或钩状矩形环，带有风化的铜绿、厚重的质感、圆润的内角，左上角饰有风格化的兽首雕刻。在青铜器中空的开口处，展示一幅淡淡的灰度水墨历史山水画：远山、开阔平原，以及一杆随风飘扬的破旧旗帜。底部中心放置 1 个独立的青铜礼器，带有两个直立耳，器身圆润矮胖，饰有饕餮纹浮雕，呈现出陈旧的青绿褐色铜锈。在构图周围添加多列细小的垂直中文注释文本，如同学术展览海报：最左侧为 1 列细长的季节性说明，右上角为 1 个紧凑的垂直哲学引语块，主书法旁为 1 个小型垂直评论块，左下角为 1 个来源/解释文本块，右下角为 1 个时代/文化文本块。总共包含 4 枚红色印章，分布在不同区域，并在中下部附近添加 1 个微小的金色龙纹标志。右下角添加细微的印刷署名文本 {argument name="designer credit" default="DESIGNER : A CHIH"}。配色方案为米白色纸张、哑光黑墨、深色氧化青铜、柔和的灰度山水、古金色排版和朱砂红印章。光线柔和漫射，平铺海报展示，正视视角，超洁净的高端文化平面设计，融合了宋代美学、书法展览海报、青铜器考古和奢华编辑排版风格。

templates.title: The Shining poster: Children's crayon drawing style

titleLocalized.zh: 《闪灵》海报：儿童蜡笔画风格

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, recreate the same poster composition and character placement, but transform it into a quirky yet adorable childlike crayon drawing. Retain the woman with the knife peeking from the right and the broken door frame, but simplify all elements to hand-drawn colored pencil/crayon textures on a clean white background. Replace the dark, spooky atmosphere with playful kindergarten art elements while retaining the unsettling scene at the bottom. Accurately add two smiling clouds, a rainbow arch above the characters, a teddy bear in the lower left corner, a rabbit in the lower right corner, a lollipop on the left, a wrapped candy near the title, six scattered stars, and three small hearts. Redraw the movie title at the bottom into a giant rainbow crayon font, writing "THE SHINING," with each letter brightly colored and childlike. Make it look innocent, cheerful, scribbled, and imperfect, yet still subtly eerie.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图像，重现相同的海报构图和人物位置，但将其转化为诡异又可爱的儿童蜡笔画。保留从右侧窥视的持刀女性和破门框架，但将所有元素简化为干净白纸背景上的手绘彩色铅笔/蜡笔纹理。用俏皮的幼儿园艺术元素取代阴暗的恐怖氛围，同时保留底层令人不安的场景。准确添加 2 朵微笑的云、角色上方 1 个彩虹拱门、左下角 1 只泰迪熊、右下角 1 只兔子、左侧 1 根棒棒糖、标题附近 1 颗包装糖果、散落的 6 颗星星和 3 个小爱心。将底部的电影标题重绘为巨大的彩虹蜡笔字体，写上“THE SHINING”，每个字母都要色彩鲜艳且充满童趣。使其看起来天真、欢快、潦草且不完美，但仍带有一丝微妙的诡异感。

templates.title: Parody image of the cartoon penguin admiral

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫企鹅海军上将恶搞图

templates.prompt: This is a simple yet visually striking anime-style parody illustration featuring a chubby emperor penguin portrayed as a powerful naval commander. The penguin is depicted in a half-body composition, positioned at the center of the image. He wears a bright red fast-food baseball cap with a yellow McDonald's golden arches logo, shiny black round sunglasses, and a huge, crescent-shaped white mustache that curves dramatically across his face. A white admiral's coat, complete with crimson epaulettes, ornate gold tassels, a black lining, and gold trim, is draped over his shoulders. Three clearly visible scars adorn his chest: one long diagonal scar and two shorter, intersecting scars. His small, orange beak and calm, intimidating expression exude a dry, comedic humor. Background: A massive white stone fortress wall, inspired by the Naval Headquarters in anime, with huge black calligraphic Chinese characters on the outer wall. Two white flags bearing the word "MARINE" can be seen, along with damaged battlements, smoke plumes, sparks, rubble, and surging blue waves in the foreground. Blue skies and white clouds stretch behind the fortress. The composition is symmetrical and poster-like, with penguins dominating the foreground. Style: A clear cel animation style, with bold black outlines, saturated colors, exquisite memetic-level character design, a dramatic yet humorous crossover atmosphere, clearly recognizable outlines, and a square composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅简洁且极具视觉冲击力的动漫恶搞插画，主角是一只胖乎乎的帝企鹅，被塑造成一位战力爆表的海军指挥官，采用半身构图，位于画面中心。企鹅戴着 1 顶亮红色的快餐店棒球帽，帽上有黄色的麦当劳风格金拱门标志，戴着 1 副光亮的黑色圆形墨镜，留着 1 撇巨大的月牙形白胡子，胡子在脸上呈现出夸张的弧度；肩上披着 1 件白色海军上将大衣，配有深红色肩章、华丽的金色流苏、黑色内衬和金色镶边。企鹅胸前有 3 道清晰可见的伤疤：1 道长斜线伤疤和 2 道较短的交叉伤疤。它的喙小而呈橙色，表情冷静且具有威慑力，带有一种喜剧式的冷幽默感。背景：一座巨大的白色石制要塞墙，灵感源自动漫中的海军总部，外墙上写着巨大的黑色书法汉字，可以看到两面标有“MARINE”的白旗，以及受损的城垛、烟柱、火花、瓦砾和前景中汹涌的蓝色海浪。要塞后方是蓝天白云。构图对称且具有海报感，企鹅占据前景主导地位。风格：清晰的赛璐珞动漫风格，粗黑轮廓线，色彩饱和，精致的模因级角色设计，充满戏剧性又幽默的跨界氛围，轮廓清晰易辨，方形构图。

templates.title: Blue starry sky anime girl design

titleLocalized.zh: 蓝色星空动漫少女设计

templates.prompt: The design is in the style of a full-body anime character illustration, featuring a single, centered girl standing in a neutral, frontal pose against a pure white paper background. The ink lines are delicate and clean, complemented by soft watercolor and colored pencil rendering, creating a soft, magical girl aesthetic. She is a petite girl with flowing hair reaching her knees.{argument name="hair color" default="Ice Blue"} Her hair features straight bangs, pointed elf ears, and a dreamlike, fantastical aesthetic; her face is mostly obscured by soft, blurred patches. She wears two crescent-shaped hair ornaments and two dangling star-chain ornaments, with small stars adorning her hair. Her attire consists of a short, puff-sleeved dress in sky blue and white, a fitted bodice, white ruffled shirt sleeves, a Peter Pan collar, button-down front, and a large oval gemstone brooch at the chest. The skirt is flared with a white ruffled hem, decorated with two large crescents on the lower left and right sides, and a large white star in the center, scattered with numerous small yellow stars. Two star pendants hang from her waist, and her wrists are fitted with ruffled cuffs. She wears white knee-high socks with four visible blue star patterns on her legs, paired with blue high heels adorned with ankle bows and star decorations. templates.title: 9 men's fashion collages

titleLocalized.zh: 9 张男士时尚拼图

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference images, create a clean 3x3 Instagram-style fashion lookbook collage. The people in the collage should maintain a consistent hairstyle, body type, and overall image, but their faces should be anonymized/blurred. Create nine different lifestyle outfit photos showcasing natural candid poses and employing a soft, realistic photographic style. Keep the subject a stylish young man, varying the clothing, setting, composition, and pose across the nine photos. Please include the following 9 scenarios: 1) A selfie on a sunny beach wearing a white T-shirt; 2) A photo of yourself leaning against a railing on a city rooftop, wearing a black T-shirt and light-colored trousers, looking out into the distance; 3) A photo of yourself standing in front of a light-colored solid-color wall, wearing a light blue striped shirt, dark jeans, carrying a black shoulder bag, and with your arms crossed; 4) A photo of yourself sitting on an outdoor terrace, holding a smartphone, wearing a white T-shirt, a light beige outer shirt, and light blue jeans; 5) A half-body photo of yourself at a comfortable cafe table, wearing a white T-shirt under a dark cardigan, holding a glass; 6) A minimalist full-body photo of yourself in front of a solid-color wall, wearing a fitted white long-sleeved top and dark trousers, with your hands in your pockets; 7) A photo of yourself walking on a narrow outdoor staircase/alley, wearing a black knit top, white trousers, and carrying a black bag; 8) A photo of yourself standing on the grass, wearing a light blue cardigan shirt over a white T-shirt, paired with dark jeans, with your hands in your pockets; 9) A photo of yourself relaxing on a park bench under a tree, wearing a dark cardigan and a white T-shirt. A T-shirt and light blue jeans. Using natural light, the soft, elegant tones create a realistic, editorial-quality fashion photography feel while maintaining a consistent style that aligns with social media aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图，生成一张干净的 3x3 Instagram 风格时尚 Lookbook 拼图。拼图中的人物需保持一致的发型、体型和整体形象，但面部需保持匿名/模糊处理。创作 9 张不同的生活方式穿搭照片，展现自然的抓拍姿态，并采用柔和、写实的摄影风格。保持主体为一名时尚的年轻男性，并在 9 张图中变换服装、场景、构图和姿势。请严格包含以下 9 个场景：1) 在阳光明媚的海滩上穿着白色 T 恤的自拍；2) 在城市天台倚靠栏杆，穿着黑色 T 恤和浅色长裤的远眺照；3) 在浅色纯色墙前，穿着浅蓝色条纹衬衫、深色牛仔裤，背着黑色单肩包，双臂交叉的站姿照；4) 在户外露台坐着，手持智能手机，穿着白色 T 恤、浅米色外搭衬衫和浅蓝色牛仔裤；5) 在舒适的咖啡馆桌前，穿着白色 T 恤外搭深色开衫，手持玻璃杯的半身照；6) 在纯色墙前，穿着修身白色长袖上衣和深色长裤，双手插兜的极简全身照；7) 在狭窄的户外楼梯/小巷中行走，穿着黑色针织上衣、白色长裤并背着黑色包袋；8) 在草地上站立，穿着浅蓝色开衫衬衫内搭白色 T 恤，配深色牛仔裤，双手插兜；9) 在树下的公园长椅上放松，穿着深色开衫、白色 T 恤和浅蓝色牛仔裤。使用自然光，色调柔和优雅，呈现写实的编辑级时尚摄影质感，并保持符合社交媒体审美的统一风格。
