templates.title: Comparison of Japanese skincare product advertisements

titleLocalized.zh: 日本护肤品广告对比

templates.prompt: Create a side-by-side comparison image showcasing two vertical Japanese skincare product banner ads against a dark charcoal gray background. Each banner uses a minimalist smartphone-style ad mockup, presenting a white and ice-blue beauty aesthetic. The banner on the left should appear elegant and visually sophisticated, but with a weaker sales focus: a softly backlit close-up showing a half-body portrait of a woman with wet hair and radiant skin, her face obscured by a centrally positioned rectangular blur, accompanied by pale blue water patterns and floating water droplets. A bottle labeled "..." is placed in the lower right corner.{argument name="product name" default="VITA LUMIÈRE"} The white and silver sunscreen tube features sophisticated Japanese serif and sans-serif fonts, with a large blue rounded CTA button at the bottom. Contains the Japanese title: "Transparent ツヤ Muscle を つ く る ビ タ ミン C×日焼けstop めクリーム", with brief auxiliary text above and below, and 3 in the middle and bottom A round function icon, a handwritten subtitle of "まるでスキンケア! つけるたび, Su Muscle がうるおう.", and a CTA button with "Now すぐTransparent ツヤ Muscle Sense of Motion" at the bottom. The banner on the right should be a powerful, direct response version of the same product and model, with a clearer hierarchy, more eye-catching copy, and more persuasive conversion elements: a larger Japanese headline at the top, “UV rays, not so scary.”, the same model’s face with a centered rectangular blur, the product tube displayed on the right is larger, accompanied by a blue bubble badge that reads “Transparent skin”, the same handwritten-style subheading is placed diagonally on the chest area, and three large, glossy circular statement badges are arranged in the lower center, reading “Skin toning effect,” “Uruoi beauty serum 80%,” and “Vitamin C inducer.” A pink event banner is added above the CTA button, reading “Limited-time offer, free shipping during the first batch.” The CTA button on the right should be larger and more prominent, with the text "Immediately feel transparent skin." Use bright, cool tones of white, ice blue, silver, and subtle holographic highlights, combined with realistic cosmetic rendering, soft water splashes, translucent bubbles, and a sophisticated Japanese beauty advertising style. Ensure high contrast between the headline and CTA, clearly conveying the visual impression that the right-side ad is more persuasive and has better conversion optimization than the left-side ad.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一张并排对比图，在深炭灰色背景上展示 2 个竖版日本护肤品广告横幅，每个横幅均采用简洁的智能手机风格广告模型，并呈现白色与冰蓝色的美容美学。左侧横幅应看起来优雅且视觉精致，但销售导向较弱：采用柔和背光特写，展示一位湿发、皮肤透亮女性的半身像，其面部被居中的矩形模糊块遮挡，配以淡蓝色水纹理、漂浮的水滴，右下角放置一支标有 {argument name="product name" default="VITA LUMIÈRE"} 的白银色防晒霜管，采用精致的日文衬线体和无衬线字体，底部设有一个大的蓝色圆角 CTA 按钮。包含日文标题：「透明ツヤ肌をつくる ビタミンC×日焼け止めクリーム」，上方和下方附有简短的辅助文案，中下方有 3 个圆形功效图标，手写风格的副标题「まるでスキンケア！つけるたび、素肌がうるおう。」，以及底部显示「今すぐ透明ツヤ肌を体感する」的 CTA 按钮。右侧横幅应为同一产品和模特的强力直接响应版本，具有更清晰的层级、更醒目的文案和更具说服力的转化元素：顶部横跨更大的日文标题「紫外線も、くすみも、もう怖くない。」，同样的模特面部带有居中矩形模糊，产品管在右侧显示得更大，配有一个写着「透明ツヤ肌をつくる」的蓝色气泡徽章，胸部区域倾斜放置同样的手写风格副标题，中下方排列 3 个大型光泽圆形声明徽章，分别写着「肌トーンアップ効果」、「うるおい美容液成分80%」和「ビタミンC誘導体」，CTA 按钮上方增加一条粉色活动横幅，写着「初回限定・送料無料キャンペーン中」。右侧的 CTA 按钮应更大且更突出，文案为「今すぐ透明ツヤ肌を体感する」。使用白色、冰蓝色、银色和淡淡全息高光的明亮冷色调，结合逼真的化妆品渲染、柔和的水花装饰、半透明气泡、高级日本美容广告风格，确保标题与 CTA 之间具有高对比度，并清晰传达出右侧广告比左侧广告更具说服力和转化优化效果的视觉印象。

templates.title: Japanese drama collage style movie poster

titleLocalized.zh: 日剧拼贴风格电影海报

templates.prompt: A highly dramatic Japanese movie poster collage, employing a glossy, sensual coming-of-age style, designed like an official theatrical release's key visual. The central element of the composition is {argument name="main character" default="A young Japanese woman"} A close-up portrait of her, with shoulder-length, slightly wavy brown hair, natural makeup, wearing a white shirt, bathed in the warm golden sunset and the light outlining her hair. The central portrait is surrounded by a dense montage of nine auxiliary visual elements: 1) Top left: The female protagonist, wearing a dark school uniform and bow tie, is silhouetted against a brilliant sunset; 2) Center left: A smaller portrait of the female protagonist in her school uniform; 3) Bottom left: A fluffy, long-haired brown dog looks at the camera; 4) Top right: The female protagonist, as an office worker, works on her laptop under warm indoor lighting; 5) Center right: A romantic silhouette of a couple standing by a riverbank railing at sunset; 6) Bottom right: A ferret curled up in a soft blanket, looking out; 7) Bottom right: A graduate in a graduation gown and cap, holding their diploma; 8) Bottom left center: The female protagonist sits on the bank with the dog and ferret, her back to the camera; 9) On the right are two small, tilted snapshots: one of a concert or livehouse scene with her back to the camera, and the other of the female protagonist riding a bicycle by the water. The lower left background features a large red torii gate standing in the sea near the city skyline, reminiscent of Miyajima, against a backdrop of vibrant orange-pink twilight and shimmering water. A soft cherry blossom border is added to the lower right edge. The overall atmosphere should be emotional, inspiring, bittersweet, and affirming of life, with rich amber, rose, and violet hues, cinematic depth of field, poster-quality composite effects, soft-focus halos, and sophisticated movie poster typography. A large Japanese title is prominently placed at the bottom center.{argument name="title text" default="The Miracle That Is Me"} The text uses a bold white calligraphy font, paired with an elegant serif English subtitle below.{argument name="english subtitle" default="The Miracle of Me"} Incorporate multiple lines of small white Japanese promotional text around the collage, including inspirational quotes in the upper left, upper right, center left, and bottom areas. Add a Japanese slogan centered below the title, a small credits of the production team at the bottom center, and the year in the lower right corner.{argument name="release label" default="ROADSHOW"} It makes it look like a poster for a high-end Japanese drama movie from 2024, telling the story of a woman's life journey through school, work, love, pets, music, and graduation.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的日式电影海报拼贴画，采用光泽感十足的感性成长风格，设计如同官方院线主视觉图。构图中心为 {argument name="main character" default="一位年轻日本女性"} 的大特写肖像，她留着齐肩微卷棕发，妆容自然，身穿白色衬衫，沐浴在温暖的金色夕阳和勾勒发丝的轮廓光中。中心肖像周围环绕着 9 个辅助视觉元素组成的密集蒙太奇：1) 左上角，女主角身穿深色校服系着领结，侧影映衬在灿烂的夕阳天空下；2) 左中，女主角较小的校服肖像；3) 左下方，一只毛茸茸的长毛棕色小狗看向镜头；4) 右上角，女主角作为上班族在温暖的室内灯光下用笔记本电脑工作；5) 右中，一对男女在夕阳下的河岸栏杆旁站立的浪漫剪影；6) 右下方，一只蜷缩在柔软毯子里向外看的雪貂；7) 右下角，穿着学士服、戴着学士帽的毕业生手持毕业证书；8) 左下中心，女主角与小狗和雪貂一起坐在岸边，背对镜头；9) 右侧叠放着 2 张倾斜的小快照，一张是背对镜头的演唱会或 Livehouse 场景，另一张是女主角在水边骑自行车。在左下角背景中，包含一座矗立在城市天际线附近海中的大型红色鸟居，让人联想到宫岛，天空为鲜艳的橙粉色暮色，水面波光粼粼。在右下边缘添加柔和的樱花作为边框。整体氛围应充满情感、励志、苦乐参半且肯定生命，色调为浓郁的琥珀色、玫瑰色和紫罗兰色，具有电影般的景深、海报级的合成效果、柔焦光晕以及精致的电影海报排版。在底部中央醒目地放置大型日文标题 {argument name="title text" default="私という奇跡"}，采用粗体白色毛笔书法字体，下方配以优雅的衬线体英文副标题 {argument name="english subtitle" default="The Miracle of Me"}。在拼贴画周围融入多行小型白色日文宣传语，包括左上、右上、左中和底部区域的感悟引言。在标题下方居中添加日文标语，底部中央添加小型制作人员名单，右下角添加年份及 {argument name="release label" default="ROADSHOW"}。使其看起来像是一部 2024 年的高端日剧电影海报，讲述一位女性通过学校、工作、爱情、宠物、音乐和毕业所经历的人生旅程。

templates.title: An adorable ferret snuggling in its pet bed

titleLocalized.zh: 在宠物窝里依偎的可爱雪貂

templates.prompt: A charming hand-drawn animal illustration in a soft watercolor and colored pencil picture book style, presented from a top-down perspective. Two ferrets are curled up tightly together in a square pet bed with high, padded edges. The ferret on the left is light cream-colored with fluffy fur, a pink nose, round, shiny black eyes, and a gentle, sweet expression; its long body protectively encircles the other ferret. The ferret on the right is sable-colored with a dark brown body, warm tan underfur, a cream-colored mask, a pink nose, and bright black eyes. It smiles slightly, revealing tiny teeth, with one small paw raised to its chest. Their bodies form a comfortable spiral composition, face to face. The pet bed's inner lining is a soft light gray, while the outer lining is dark charcoal black, featuring a distinct fabric texture and soft shadow folds in each corner. Surrounding the bed are four pink doodle hearts and four glitter or accent symbols, creating a playful sticker style and adding a kawaii vibe. Using a warm off-white paper background with a subtle beige wash effect, delicate textured edges, fine hair details, soft lighting, and charming soft tones, the overall effect creates a lovely and warm atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张可爱的动物手绘插画，采用柔和的水彩和彩色铅笔绘本风格，视角为正上方俯视。两只雪貂在方形宠物窝内紧紧蜷缩在一起，窝有高高的软垫边缘。左侧的雪貂呈浅奶油色，毛发蓬松，有着粉色的鼻子、圆润光亮的黑色眼睛和温柔甜美的表情；它长长的身体保护性地环绕着另一只雪貂。右侧的雪貂为紫貂色，有着深棕色的身体、温暖的棕褐色底毛、奶油色的面罩、粉色鼻子和明亮的黑眼睛，微微笑着，露出细小的牙齿，一只小爪子举在胸前。它们的身体形成了一个舒适的螺旋构图，脸贴着脸。宠物窝内垫为柔和的浅灰色，外侧为深炭黑色，具有明显的织物纹理，每个角落都有柔和的阴影褶皱。周围环绕着 4 个粉色的涂鸦爱心和 4 个闪光或强调符号，呈现出俏皮的贴纸风格，增添了 kawaii 的氛围。使用温暖的米白色纸张背景，带有淡淡的米色水洗效果、精致的纹理边缘、细腻的毛发细节、柔和的灯光、迷人的柔和色调，整体营造出一种可爱且充满温情的氛围。

templates.title: Photo of Japanese miso ramen

titleLocalized.zh: 日式味噌拉面标注照片

templates.prompt: A casually taken smartphone photo shows a bowl of food displayed on a bright red ramen counter.{argument name="dish name" default="Miso Ramen"} The photo is taken from a close-up, overhead perspective of the restaurant. The bowl is light blue-gray, served on a matching tray, and filled with a rich, golden-brown miso broth. Thick, wavy noodles are hidden beneath the toppings, topped with bean sprouts, scallions, and a few thin slices of char siu pork, with a tall pile of brown bamboo shoots at the center. A small bowl of half a serving of rice sits on the right side of the frame. The background is soft-focused, subtly revealing restaurant utensils on the counter, such as a metal kettle, condiment boxes, chopsticks, and cups, creating an authentic ramen shop atmosphere. White and dark brown hand-drawn, brush-style Japanese annotations are overlaid on the photo, accompanied by playful arrows and cloud-shaped speech bubbles, making it appear as if the writing was directly on the image. A striking, large, handwritten Japanese title is added to the upper left corner:{argument name="headline text" default="Negiton Miso Ramen in front of Hirai Station"} Add 6 labels around the ramen bowl: 1) A label pointing to the char siu pork in the upper left corner, with the text:{argument name="pork note" default="Thick slices of char siu"} ;2) The label pointing to the dried bamboo shoots at the top center reads: "Ingredients: Dried bamboo shoots";3) The label near the rice bowl at the top right reads: "Half a serving of rice is included for free, so happy♡";4) The label pointing to the soup base at the bottom right reads: "Pork bone broth with rich miso, full of back fat flavor◎";5) The label pointing to the vegetables at the bottom left reads: "Bean sprouts and green onions, crisp and refreshing";6) The dotted cloud label pointing to the ingredients at the bottom left reads:{argument name="special note" default="Hidden beneath are 'sweet scallions,' the key to enhancing sweetness and umami."} In addition, a cloud-shaped praise tag was added to the upper right corner with the text: "A creation inspired by the 'Chan' style"; and a cloud-shaped tag was added to the lower right corner with the text: "Add extra water for flat curly noodles, resulting in a chewy texture." The overall style remains enticing, welcoming, informative, and scrapbook-like, perfectly combining authentic food photography with neat handwritten reviews.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张随手拍摄的智能手机美食照，展示了一碗放在鲜红色拉面店吧台上的 {argument name="dish name" default="味噌拉面"}，拍摄角度为餐厅实景近距离俯拍。碗呈浅蓝灰色，配有同色托盘，碗中盛满了浓郁的金棕色味噌汤底，厚实的波浪面条隐藏在配料之下，表面铺着豆芽、葱花和几片薄切叉烧肉，中心堆叠着高高的一簇棕色笋干。画面右侧放着一小碗半份米饭。背景经过柔焦处理，隐约可见吧台上的餐厅用品，如金属水壶、调料盒、筷子和杯子，营造出地道的拉面店氛围。照片上叠加白色和深棕色的手绘毛笔风格日文标注，配以俏皮的箭头和云朵状气泡，仿佛直接写在图片上一样。在左上角添加一个醒目的大号手写日文标题：{argument name="headline text" default="平井站前『Negiton』味噌拉面"}。在拉面碗周围添加 6 个标注说明：1) 左上方指向叉烧肉的标注，文字：{argument name="pork note" default="满满的薄切叉烧"}；2) 顶部中央指向笋干的标注，文字："配料：笋干"；3) 右上方靠近米饭碗的标注，文字："半份米饭免费赠送，超开心♡"；4) 右下方指向汤底的标注，文字："猪骨汤底配浓郁味噌，背脂风味十足◎"；5) 左下方指向蔬菜的标注，文字："豆芽和青葱，口感爽脆"；6) 左下角指向配料下方的虚线云朵标注，文字：{argument name="special note" default="下面藏着『甜葱』，是提升甜味和鲜味的关键"}。此外，在右上角添加一个云朵形状的赞美标注，文字为："『Chan 系』风味灵感之作"；并在右下角添加一个云朵形状的标注，文字为："多加水扁平卷面，口感劲道"。整体风格保持诱人、亲切、信息丰富且具有剪贴簿感，将真实的食物摄影与整洁的手写评论完美结合。

templates.title: Street scene transformed into anime background

titleLocalized.zh: 街景转动漫背景

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference images, transform Google Maps Street View photos into clean, hand-drawn anime-style cityscape illustrations, while preserving the same camera angles, sidewalk compositions, tree arrangements, left-side buildings, right-side roads, and pedestrian positions. Remove all Google Maps UI overlays, labels, arrows, buttons, and screenshot elements. Replace the overcast atmosphere with bright, clear daytime lighting, adding soft blue skies, gentle sunlight, warm highlights, and slightly idealized colors. While maintaining a realistic scene layout, create a refined, tranquil, and picturesque effect, like background illustrations in slice-of-life anime.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图像，将谷歌地图街景照片转换为干净的手绘动漫风格城市景观插画，同时保留相同的摄像机角度、人行道构图、树木排列、左侧建筑、右侧道路以及行人位置。移除所有谷歌地图的 UI 覆盖层、标签、箭头、按钮及截图元素。将阴天氛围替换为明亮清澈的日间光照，加入柔和的蓝天、轻柔的阳光、温暖的高光以及略显理想化的色彩。在保持场景布局真实的同时，使其呈现出精致、宁静且如画的效果，如同日常系动漫中的背景插画。

templates.title: Transform Google Maps Street View into Autumn Illustrations

titleLocalized.zh: 将 Google Maps 街景转换为秋季插画

templates.prompt: Using the provided city sidewalk reference map, transform the scene into a refined autumn cityscape illustration. Maintain the original perspective, street layout, tree placement, sidewalk perspective, right-hand road, and left-hand building structure, but replace the summer green vegetation with vibrant red, orange, and golden autumn leaves. Change the overcast effect to a bright, clear daytime sky, adding warm sunlight and soft directional shadows. Remove artifacts from the Google Maps screenshot and redraw the entire scene as a refined and realistic anime-style background illustration. Preserve the atmosphere of a bustling commercial street, but redraw pedestrians as stylish modern city dwellers, and make the shops and vehicles appear more elegant and harmonious.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的城市人行道参考图，将场景转换为精致的秋季城市街景插画。保持原有的视角、街道布局、树木位置、人行道透视、右侧道路以及左侧建筑群的结构，但将夏季的绿色植被替换为红、橙、金黄色的绚丽秋叶。将阴天效果改为明亮清澈的日间天空，并加入温暖的阳光和柔和的定向阴影。去除 Google Maps 截图中的伪影，将整个场景重绘为精致且写实的动漫风格背景插画。保留繁华商业街的氛围，但将行人重绘为时尚的现代都市人，并使店面和车辆看起来更加优雅且协调。

templates.title: Screenshots of the ChatGPT app, featuring cute four-panel comics.

titleLocalized.zh: ChatGPT 应用截图，包含可爱的四格漫画

templates.prompt: A screenshot of the ChatGPT mobile app in dark mode showcases the generated images embedded in the conversation. The top title bar is black, with a menu icon on the left and the words "ChatGPT" displayed in the center. A small pink heart decoration adorns the title, and two rounded buttons on the right are for editing/sharing and more options, respectively. The overall design has a subtle purple glow. The main generated image is a rounded 2x2 comic grid with four panels, labeled 1, 2, 3, and 4 with pink circles. The comic adopts a dreamy bedtime aesthetic, with warm pastel pinks, lavender purples, cream, and soft gold lighting. In each panel, a fluffy white dog with long, droopy ears, pink bows, and a gentle expression is comforting a gray kitten plush toy on a pink bed. The room is cozy and whimsical, filled with twinkling fairy lights, star-shaped light spots, plush toys, pillows, a crescent moon visible through the window, and soft blankets. The first panel shows a white dog sitting beside a gray cat, an open picture book or storybook, both wrapped in blankets, with several lines of Chinese dialogue and speech bubbles above. The second panel shows the white dog hugging the kitten tighter under the blankets and talking softly, with a teddy bear or rabbit doll visible on the right, and Chinese text above. The third panel shows the kitten looking more melancholy and curled up, with the white dog protectively embracing it. A cup sits on the bedside table in the foreground, with more Chinese dialogue above. The fourth panel shows the two characters lying sleepily under the blankets, snuggling together, the white dog with half-closed eyes, the kitten resting, surrounded by warm starlight and a sleepy glow; Chinese dialogue is displayed above. The bottom edge of the comic features a light-colored explanatory bar with additional Chinese text and a small rabbit icon; a large Chinese button-style label in the lower left corner of the image area reads "Edit". Below the comic strip, a large section of white text appears on a black background. The writing style resembles emotional social media posts, incorporating crying faces, moon emojis, flashing lights, and hearts, divided into several short paragraphs. At the bottom is the ChatGPT message input bar, with a plus button on the left (placeholder text reads "Ask ChatGPT"), a microphone icon in the middle, and a purple circular voice button on the right. The overall image appears to be a screenshot of a real mobile app, using a portrait orientation. The cute four-panel bedtime illustration is surrounded by a high-contrast black UI, including Chinese interface text, creating a sophisticated mobile product presentation.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张处于深色模式的 ChatGPT 移动端应用截图，展示了对话中嵌入的生成式图像。顶部标题栏为黑色界面，左侧带有菜单图标，中间显示“ChatGPT”字样，标题旁有一个粉色小爱心装饰，右侧有两个圆角按钮分别用于编辑/分享和更多选项，整体带有淡淡的紫色光晕。主体生成的图像是一个圆角 2x2 漫画网格，共 4 个分格，分别用粉色圆圈标有 1、2、3 和 4。漫画采用梦幻的睡前美学，色调为温暖的粉彩粉色、薰衣草紫、奶油色和柔和的金色光影。在每一格中，一只长着长垂耳、耳边系着粉色小蝴蝶结、表情温柔的毛茸茸白狗，正在粉色床上安慰一只灰色的小猫玩偶。房间温馨且充满童趣，布满了闪烁的仙女灯、星形光斑、毛绒玩具、枕头、窗外可见的弯月以及柔软的毯子。第 1 格显示白狗坐在灰猫身旁，摊开一本图画书或故事书，两者都裹在被子里，上方有几行中文对话文本和小气泡。第 2 格显示白狗在被子里更紧地拥抱着小猫并轻声交谈，右侧可见一只泰迪熊或兔子玩偶，上方有中文文本。第 3 格显示小猫看起来更忧伤并蜷缩着，白狗保护性地环抱着它，前景的床头表面放着一个杯子，上方有更多中文对话文本。第 4 格显示两个角色在被子里困倦地躺着，依偎在一起，白狗半闭着眼睛，小猫正在休息，周围环绕着温暖的星光和睡前光晕；上方显示中文对话文本。漫画底部边缘是一条浅色的说明栏，带有额外的中文文本和一个小兔子图标；图像区域左下角有一个大的中文按钮式标签，写着“编辑”。漫画下方的聊天内容中，有一大段白色文字显示在黑色背景上，文风类似于情感化的社交媒体文案，包含哭脸、月亮、闪光和爱心表情符号，分为多个短段落。最底部是 ChatGPT 消息输入栏，左侧有一个加号按钮，占位符文本为“问问 ChatGPT”，中间是麦克风图标，右侧是一个紫色圆形语音按钮。整体图像应呈现为真实的手机应用截图，采用竖屏构图，可爱的睡前四格插图被高对比度的黑色 UI 包围，包含中文界面文本，具有精致的移动产品展示效果。

templates.title: Lively and adorable American Shorthair kittens

titleLocalized.zh: 活泼可爱的美国短毛猫幼崽

templates.prompt: A richly detailed and playful studio-style digital illustration featuring two animals with silver-black striped fur and bright {argument name="eye color" default="Bright blue"} American Shorthair tabby kittens are tightly entwined, their movements full of energy. The kitten in front, positioned at the bottom of the frame, leans slightly to the left, its mouth slightly open as if meowing or laughing joyfully, revealing tiny teeth and a pink tongue. Its front legs are spread wide, displaying a lively posture. The second kitten, positioned above and behind, leans forward and rests its head on the shoulder of the first kitten, playfully nibbling or rubbing against its head. A soft paw rests on the first kitten's body as if embracing it. Both kittens have large paws, fluffy fur, clearly defined whiskers, and vivid expressions, exuding a charming playfulness. The composition is a compact full-body portrait, with the two kittens centered and occupying most of the frame. The background is in an abstract painting style, with {argument name="accent colors" default="Sky blue, warm orange, and cream"} The dynamic splash effects create a lively art studio atmosphere while maintaining a soft and simple aesthetic. The floor has a subtle texture, dotted with echoing paint strokes. Bright, soft, and frontal lighting highlights the bright eyes, fluffy fur, and high-contrast tiger stripes. Rendered in a delicate, semi-realistic, adorable animal illustration style, the image is ultra-clear, highly detailed, richly colored, warm, whimsical, and vibrant.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张细节丰富、充满趣味的影棚风格数字插画，主角是 2 只拥有银黑色条纹皮毛和明亮 {argument name="eye color" default="亮蓝色"} 眼睛的美国短毛虎斑猫幼崽，它们正紧紧地纠缠在一起，动作充满活力。前方的幼崽位于画面下方，身体微向左侧，嘴巴微张，仿佛在欢快地喵喵叫或大笑，露出细小的牙齿和粉色的舌头，前腿向两侧张开，姿态活泼。第二只幼崽位于后上方，探身搭在前一只幼崽的肩头，轻轻地玩闹式啃咬或蹭着对方的头顶，一只柔软的爪子像拥抱一样搭在前一只幼崽身上。两只幼崽都有着大大的爪子、毛茸茸的质感、清晰的胡须、生动的表情，透着一股迷人的顽皮劲。采用紧凑的全身肖像构图，两只幼崽居中并占据画面大部分空间。背景为抽象的绘画风格，带有 {argument name="accent colors" default="天蓝色、暖橙色和奶油色"} 的动态泼溅效果，营造出活泼的艺术工作室氛围，同时保持画面柔和简洁。地面带有轻微的纹理，点缀着相呼应的颜料涂抹痕迹。光线明亮、柔和且从正面照射，突显出水灵的眼睛、蓬松的毛发以及高对比度的虎斑纹路。以精致的半写实可爱动物插画风格渲染，画面超清晰、高细节、色彩丰富、温馨、奇趣且充满活力。

templates.prompt: A large isometric, disassembled environment atlas showcases densely packed modular retro city buildings and room sections against a pure white background, presenting the texture of a high-resolution game asset disassembly or building assembly catalog. The image contains 20 main assembly structures or room modules, each disassembled into floating components: a small gable house with a blue roof, a dark blue square building, a rust-red house, a cylindrical weathered tower, a white two-story house with a blue roof, a warm-toned wood-paneled corner house, a compact study or office, a bedroom, a dining room with a balcony, a café or kitchen, a narrow storefront, a small illuminated alcove room, a large concrete stairwell module, a small tiled bathroom, a medium-sized concrete staircase and platform module, a large concrete staircase platform module, a narrow concrete corridor or service module, a large empty concrete room, and a blue vending machine area. Hundreds of disassembled, individual components are neatly arranged around each module: roof panels, corrugated awnings, wall fragments, doors, louvers, windows, stair sections, railings, balconies, signs, pipes, antennas, utility poles, light fixtures, vents, instruments, water tanks, flower pots, planters, benches, crates, air conditioners, cabinets, fences, street railings, buckets, jars, utility boxes, and small street props. The style combines painterly qualities with precision, contrasting warm amber interior lighting with worn concrete, oxidized metal, peeling paint, rust-red and dark blue roofs, turquoise decorative lines, and aged urban textures. It emphasizes miniature-like realism, isometric perspective, disassembled assembly displays, evenly distributed suspended components around each structure, clearly discernible outlines, soft studio shadows, extremely intricate details, conceptual art-level refinement, and as a…{argument name="city style" default="Nostalgic Japanese retro town"} The atlas presents a comprehensive environmental asset of the neighborhood. It contains 20 main modules, with numerous small props and potted plants arranged along the bottom edge, maintaining overall balance across the canvas. It uses a clean, pure white background, has no borders, no figures, no vehicles except for one bicycle, and contains no text labels.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张大型等轴测拆解式环境图集，展示了在纯白背景下密集的模块化复古城市建筑及房间剖面，呈现出高精细度游戏资产拆解图或建筑拼装目录的质感。图像包含 20 个主要的组装结构或房间模块，每个模块均拆解为悬浮部件：1 栋带蓝色屋顶的小型人字顶房屋、1 栋深蓝色方形建筑、1 栋锈红色小房、1 栋圆柱形风化塔楼、1 栋带蓝色屋顶的白色双层住宅、1 间暖色木镶板转角房、1 间紧凑型书房或办公室、1 间卧室、1 间带阳台的餐厅、1 间咖啡馆或厨房、1 间狭窄店面房、1 间小型照明壁龛房、1 个大型混凝土楼梯间模块、1 间小型瓷砖洗手间、1 个中型混凝土楼梯及平台模块、1 个大型混凝土楼梯平台模块、1 个狭窄混凝土走廊或服务模块、1 间大型空置混凝土房，以及 1 个蓝色自动售货机区域。所有模块周围整齐地排列着数百个以拆解方式呈现的独立组件：屋顶板、波纹遮阳棚、墙体片段、门、百叶窗、窗户、楼梯段、栏杆、阳台、招牌、管道、天线、电线杆、灯具、通风口、仪表、水箱、花盆、花箱、长椅、板条箱、空调、橱柜、围栏、街道护栏、水桶、罐子、公用设施箱及小型街道道具。风格兼具绘画感与精确性，温馨的琥珀色室内灯光与磨损的混凝土、氧化金属、剥落的油漆、锈红色及深蓝色屋顶、青绿色装饰线条以及老旧的城市纹理形成对比。强调微缩模型般的真实感、等轴测视角、拆解式组装展示、每个结构周围均匀分布的悬浮部件、清晰可辨的轮廓分离、柔和的摄影棚阴影、极其复杂的细节、概念艺术级的精致度，以及作为 {argument name="city style" default="怀旧日本复古城区"} 街区综合环境资产图集的质感。包含 20 个主要模块，底部边缘排列着许多小型道具和盆栽，整体构图在整个画布上保持平衡。使用清爽的纯白背景，无边框，无人物，除 1 辆自行车外无其他车辆，且不包含任何文字标签。

templates.title: Japanese-style hair salon diagnosis poster

titleLocalized.zh: 日式美发诊断沙龙海报

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, transform it into a sophisticated Japanese-style hair salon hairstyle diagnosis poster. Maintain the quality of the person, clothing, hair color, and realistic studio photograph, placing her portrait as the main image within an elegant cream-gold color scheme editing layout. Add the Japanese title "ヘアスタイル诊レポート" (Hair Salon Diagnosis Report) at the top, along with a small English subtitle "Premium Hair & Makeup Analysis" and supporting Japanese text above. Below the title, create four tiered hairstyle recommendation sections: 1) "くびれミディ×シースルーバング" (Kubire Hair × Hair Salon Banging), 2) "ナチュラルミディレイヤー" (Natural Hair Salon Hairdressing), 3) "重めボブ" (Heavy Hair Salon Poster), and retain a large original/main portrait section with Japanese explanatory text on the left. In each recommendation section, a realistic edited version of the same woman wearing the recommended hairstyle is generated, using a circular rank badge and multiple small feature tags. Added a color recommendation section called "similar わせヘアカラープラン" containing 4 A color card showing the effect of the same woman wearing these hair colors: "ショコラブラウン", "グレージュ", "ローズベージュ", "モーヴブラウン". Additionally, add a narrow sidebar named "おすすめしないカラー" containing 3 Stacked color blocks and labels: "黄みの强いオレンジ", "真っ黑", "青みの强いピンク・ビビッド". Three additional sections have been added to the bottom: “Similar Hairstyle Examples” (containing four hairstyle design examples of the same woman), “Facial Type/Impression Analysis” (containing radar charts and Japanese annotations), and “Makeup Points” (containing five rows of cosmetic items labeled “base,” “eyebrow,” “eyebrow,” “chick,” and “lip”). The design adopts a soft, luxurious salon brand style, using thin gold trim, rounded white panels, delicate floral corner decorations, and a clean, high-end magazine-like layout.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图像，将其转换为精致的日式美发沙龙发型诊断海报。保持人物、服装、发色及写实摄影棚照片的质感不变，将她的肖像作为主图放置在优雅的奶油金配色编辑布局中。在顶部添加日文标题“ヘアスタイル診断レポート”，并配以小型英文副标题“Premium Hair & Makeup Analysis”及上方的日文辅助文案。在标题下方创建 4 个分级的发型推荐板块：1) “くびれミディ×シースルーバング”，2) “ナチュラルミディレイヤー”，3) “重めボブ”，并在左侧保留带有日文说明文字的大幅原始/主肖像板块。在每个推荐板块中，生成同一女性换上建议发型的写实编辑版本，并使用圆形等级徽章和多个小型特征标签。添加一个名为“似合わせヘアカラープラン”的颜色推荐部分，包含 4 张色卡，展示同一女性换上这些发色的效果：“ショコラブラウン”、“グレージュ”、“ローズベージュ”、“モーヴブラウン”。此外，添加一个名为“おすすめしないカラー”的窄侧边栏，包含 3 个堆叠的色块及标签：“黄みの強いオレンジ”、“真っ黒”、“青みの強いピンク・ビビッド”。在底部添加 3 个额外部分：“似合うヘアアレンジ”（包含 4 个同一女性的发型设计示例）、“顔タイプ・印象分析”（包含雷达图和日文注释）以及“メイクポイント”（包含 5 行标注为“ベース”、“眉”、“アイメイク”、“チーク”、“リップ”的化妆品项）。采用柔和的奢华沙龙品牌风格，使用细金边、圆角白色面板、精致的花卉边角装饰，以及简洁的高级杂志感排版。

templates.title: A striking thumbnail on the theme of the threat of AI in Japan

titleLocalized.zh: 极具冲击力的日本 AI 威胁主题缩略图

templates.prompt: Create a visually striking Japanese YouTube thumbnail with an ultra-aggressive clickbait style and a 16:9 landscape aspect ratio. The background features a deep black and red color scheme, filled with red lightning, smoke clouds, glowing sparks, ink splatter, and explosive energy. The composition includes four main text areas and two graphic icon elements. At the top, a large, distressed white Japanese title text is placed.{argument name="top headline text" default="Video Editing Director"} The font is an ultra-bold, blocky typeface with a rough, worn texture, black outlines, and heavy shadows. A large, central title in Chinese characters occupies most of the image.{argument name="main title text" default="Annihilation"} The text uses a broken font with a color gradient from red at the top to yellow at the bottom, featuring a cracked stone texture, black borders, fragmented debris, and impactful lighting effects. Below, in the center, a black diagonal banner with a white border contains bright yellow and red emergency Japanese text.{argument name="warning text" default="If things continue like this, I'll lose my job...!?"} On the left, a vertical black panel is added, listing four warnings, each marked with a red X: "Case Reduction," "Loss on Orders," "AI Leader," and "Owaconization." On the right, a realistically styled Japanese male, chest to upper body, is shown, leaning slightly to the left, wearing a black T-shirt, with short dark hair and a strong red outline; his face is obscured by a skin-toned rectangular mosaic. In the lower right corner, two Adobe-style application icons, "Pr" and "Ae," are partially overlapping, dark blue-purple rounded rectangles, both with a broken glass texture and covered by a large red diagonal paint scratch X. A faint dark city skyline outline is added to the background in the lower left corner. Overall visual effect: sensational, destructive, high-contrast, rough, richly textured, with strong red and black tones, heavy shadows, dramatic lighting effects, and sophisticated viral thumbnail composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个极具视觉冲击力的日本 YouTube 缩略图，采用超激进的点击诱饵风格，16:9 横屏比例。背景为深邃的黑红配色，充满红色闪电、烟雾云团、发光火花、墨迹飞溅和爆炸能量。构图包含 4 个主要文本区域和 2 个图形图标元素。在顶部，放置巨大的做旧白色日文标题文本 {argument name="top headline text" default="動画編集ディレクター"}，使用超粗体块状字体，带有粗糙的磨损质感、黑色描边和厚重的阴影。在中心位置，放置占据画面大部分区域的超大主标题汉字 {argument name="main title text" default="全滅"}，采用破碎字体，颜色从顶部的红色渐变至底部的黄色，带有裂纹石材质感、黑色边框、碎片残骸和冲击光效。在下方中心，添加一个带有白色边框的黑色斜向横幅，内含亮黄色和红色的紧急日文文本 {argument name="warning text" default="このままだと仕事がなくなる…!?"}。在左侧，添加一个垂直的黑色面板，列出 4 个警告事项，每项前均带有红色 X 标记： 「案件減少」, 「単価下落」, 「AIの台頭」, 「オワコン化」。在右侧，展示一名胸部以上的写实风格日本男性，略微向左侧身，身穿黑色 T 恤，留着深色短发，轮廓边缘带有强烈的红色轮廓光；他的脸部被一个肤色调的矩形马赛克遮挡。在右下角，包含 2 个 Adobe 风格的应用程序图标「Pr」和「Ae」，采用深蓝紫色圆角矩形，部分重叠，两者均呈现出破碎的玻璃质感，并被一道巨大的红色斜向油漆划痕 X 覆盖。在左下角背景中添加一个隐约的暗色城市天际线轮廓。整体视觉效果：耸人听闻、破坏性强、高对比度、粗粝感、纹理丰富，并配以强烈的红黑调色、厚重阴影、戏剧性光效和精致的病毒式缩略图构图。

templates.title: Shiretoko Bubble Sea Angel Selfie

titleLocalized.zh: 知床泡泡海天使自拍

templates.prompt: A highly detailed anime-style winter harbor selfie scene, set against the backdrop of the Shiretoko Peninsula in bright daylight, features three female characters posing for a close-up half-body shot. At the center of the image is a dreamlike "soap bubble sea angel" girl, her body design inspired by sea angels, exhibiting a translucent iridescent texture. She possesses pale, ice-blue long hair, a lustrous opal skin tone, and intricate clothing details. Two large, crystal-clear, fin-like earrings adorn either side of her head, embellished with small seashells and flower hair ornaments. Four flowing, jelly-like tentacles, like transparent ribbons, encircle her body. She wears an exquisite, shimmering white-ice-blue outfit, paired with a fur-trimmed winter coat, layers of translucent fabric, pearl chains, and gemstone accessories, radiating a bright, fantastical ocean beauty. To her left is a human friend, wearing a deep navy blue winter coat and a thick white scarf, her shoulder-length dark hair flowing in the wind, making a peace sign with one hand. To her right is another human friend, wearing a white knitted hat with pom-poms, a beige winter coat, and a dark scarf, extending her arm towards the camera for a selfie. The phone case is a glossy light lavender silver, adorned with small, adorable marine life charms or stickers that echo the sea angel theme. The nails are neatly trimmed, displaying a subtle sheen. The background showcases a snow-covered fishing port, with four boats, ice floes, cold blue water, harbor buildings, and distant snow-capped mountains against a backdrop of azure sky and thin clouds. The image includes seven soap bubbles floating at varying depths, capturing rainbow-like light and shadow. The composition evokes the intimacy and vibrancy of a wide-angle selfie, with a slight perspective distortion due to the outstretched arm. The lighting has a shimmering wintery quality, with clear atmospheric details and an overall style reminiscent of sophisticated high-end anime illustrations.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度精细的动漫风格冬季港口自拍场景，背景位于知床半岛，明亮的白昼，3 位女性角色以半身特写构图进行合影。画面中心是一位梦幻般的“肥皂泡海天使”少女，其身体设计灵感源自海天使，呈现半透明的虹彩质感，拥有苍白的冰蓝色长发、光泽的蛋白石肤色及服饰细节，头部两侧有 2 个巨大的晶莹剔透鳍状耳饰，点缀着小型贝壳与花朵发饰，4 条流动的果冻状触须像透明的丝带鳍一样围绕在身体周围。她身着精致闪耀的白冰蓝色服装，搭配毛领冬装外套、层叠的半透明面料、珍珠链条、宝石配饰，散发出明亮的海洋奇幻美感。左侧是一位人类好友，身穿深海军蓝冬装外套，围着厚实的白色围巾，齐肩深色长发在风中飘动，单手比出剪刀手。右侧是另一位人类好友，戴着带毛球的白色针织帽，身穿米色冬装外套和深色围巾，手臂伸向镜头进行自拍。手机壳为光泽的淡薰衣草银色，上面贴有与海天使主题相呼应的小巧可爱海洋生物挂件或贴纸，指甲修剪整齐，呈现出淡雅的光泽感。背景展示了一个白雪皑皑的渔港，可见 4 艘船只、浮冰、冰冷的蓝色海水、港口建筑，以及在湛蓝天空和薄云映衬下远处覆盖着积雪的山脉。画面中包含 7 个漂浮在不同深度的肥皂泡，捕捉着彩虹般的光影。构图呈现出广角手机自拍的亲密感与活力，因手臂伸展而带有轻微的透视畸变，光线呈现出闪烁的冬日质感，大气细节清晰，整体风格为精致的高端动漫插画。

templates.title: A Japanese feudal-era garden in the rain

titleLocalized.zh: 雨中的日本封建时代庭院

templates.prompt: A cinematic, ultra-detailed scene of a rainy night in a Japanese feudal era courtyard, viewed from a high, slightly tilted angle, as if overlooking from an upper balcony or rooftop. The scene is deserted, focusing on the atmosphere, architecture, and damp surfaces. A wide, slate-paved courtyard dominates the frame, its dark, smooth stones creating ripples in a puddle, reflecting the intense light of lanterns. To the left is a traditional wooden building with a tiled roof and deep eaves; warm interior light spills from the open entrance, near which are several barrels and containers. In the center are two fenced wooden areas or workspaces, featuring lattice partitions, stacks of timber or bundled materials, low benches, and small lanterns on shelves. To the right foreground is another fenced partition, hanging two fabric banners bearing circular clan crests. In the background, a wide gate and walls outline the courtyard; a total of four vertical banners, each bearing the same crest, are visible throughout the scene. Six tripod torch stands were added around the courtyard; though the flames were small, they appeared exceptionally bright in the rain. Several warm wall lamps adorned the area around the gate and buildings. A melancholic blue-gray nighttime color scheme was employed, paired with warm amber-colored practical lighting to realistically depict raindrops, damp wood, soaked fabrics, stone textures, a light mist, and soft volumetric light. The composition should evoke the feel of a realistic samurai historical drama set, striving for realism and photorealism rather than stylization; the image should not include figures, modern objects, text, or fantasy elements.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅电影级、超精细的日本封建时代雨夜庭院场景，视角呈高位且略带倾斜，仿佛从上层阳台或屋顶俯瞰。场景中空无一人，重点在于氛围、建筑和潮湿的表面。宽阔的石板庭院占据了画面的大部分，地面铺设着深色光滑的石板，积水潭中泛起雨滴激起的涟漪，并映照出灯笼的强烈光影。左侧是一座传统的木制建筑，配有瓦片屋顶和深檐，温暖的室内光线从敞开的入口溢出，门口附近摆放着几个木桶和容器。中央有两个带围栏的木制区域或工作区，设有格子隔断、堆叠的木材或捆绑的材料、低矮的长凳，以及放置在木架上的小型灯笼。右侧前景是另一个带围栏的隔断，挂着两面印有圆形氏族纹章的织物旗帜。背景中，一座宽敞的大门和围墙构成了院落的轮廓，整个场景中总共可见 4 面悬挂的垂直旗帜，每面都印有相同的纹章。在庭院周围增加 6 个三脚架火炬台，火焰虽小但在雨中显得格外明亮，大门和建筑附近还点缀着几盏温暖的壁灯。采用忧郁的蓝灰色夜色调，搭配温暖的琥珀色实用灯光，呈现逼真的雨丝、湿润的木材、浸透的织物、石材纹理、淡淡的薄雾和柔和的体积光。构图应呈现出写实的武士历史剧布景感，追求真实与照片级写实，而非风格化，画面中不包含人物、现代物品、文字或奇幻元素。

templates.title: Ancient forest temple above Blue Spring

titleLocalized.zh: 蓝泉之上的古老森林神殿

templates.prompt: A cinematic, highly fantastical setting, presented from a slightly elevated, wide-angle perspective, showcases an ancient forest sanctuary. At its center is a circular stone platform rising from a bright, turquoise spring, upon which stands a tall, weathered golden statue or temple monument. Four narrow stone bridges extend in a cross shape from the platform, the front bridge pointing towards the viewer, the left and right bridges curving gently above the water; a path behind winds through the forest, leading to steep steps. Enormous redwoods surround the pool, their thick trunks covered in moss, intertwined with roots, ferns, vines, rocks, and deep green shrubs. The water is crystal clear, displaying a gradient from deep turquoise to sapphire blue, with two clusters of floating water lilies visible in the lower left and right corners. At the top center of the distant background, two symmetrical small temple buildings, flanking the stone steps, are partially obscured by foliage. In the lower left and right corners of the foreground, two ancient wooden temple roofs are added, partially hidden in shadow and vegetation. Strong sunlight slants down from the upper right corner, filtering through the mist and gaps in the tree canopy, casting Tyndall effect beams of light onto the trees, bridge, and water. The overall atmosphere is mysterious, ancient, tranquil, and slightly desolate, boasting rich cinematic contrast, ultra-fine textures, moss-covered rocks, subtle sense of ruin, and realistic natural lighting, presenting epic fantasy concept art and photorealistic masking painting quality. No one is depicted in the scene.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个电影级的高奇幻环境场景，以略微抬高的广角视角展现一座古老的森林圣所。中心是一个从明亮的蓝绿色泉水中升起的圆形石台，台座上矗立着一座高大且饱经风霜的金色石像或神殿纪念碑。四座狭窄的石桥从圆台向四周呈十字形延伸，前方的桥梁指向观者，左右两侧的桥梁在水面上方轻柔弯曲；后方的路径穿过森林，直通向陡峭的台阶。水池周围环绕着巨大的红杉树，树干粗壮，覆盖着厚厚的苔藓，交织的根系、蕨类植物、藤蔓、岩石和深绿色的灌木丛错落有致。水质清澈见底，呈现出从深青色到蓝宝石色的渐变，左下角和右下角可见两簇浮动的睡莲。在远景背景的顶部中心，放置两座对称的小型神殿建筑，分列于石阶两侧，部分被枝叶遮掩。在近景的左右下角，加入两座古老的木制寺庙屋顶，均部分隐没在阴影和植被中。强烈的阳光从右上角斜射而下，穿过薄雾和树冠缝隙，在树木、桥梁和水面上投射出丁达尔效应的光束。整体氛围神秘、古老、宁静且略显荒废，具有丰富的电影级对比度、超精细的纹理、长满苔藓的岩石、微妙的废墟感、逼真的自然光影，呈现史诗级奇幻概念艺术和照片级遮罩绘画品质，画面中无人。

templates.title: Original long-horned character redrawn in anime style

titleLocalized.zh: 原创长角角色动漫风格重绘

templates.prompt: Based on REFERENCE_0, this original character has been redrawn as a refined modern anime illustration, rather than a rough sketch. The core design remains unchanged: white hair, black curved horns, a wisp of red hair by the ear, a white shirt, a red tie with a small gold label at the tip, black suspenders, a brown belt, black trousers, a gold waist chain, a dark, cape-like outer fabric, a choker, dangling cross earrings, and a confident pose with one hand behind the head. This gives it the quality of a high-end character redraw, breathing new life into the original artwork.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 为角色基础，将该原创角色重绘为精致的现代动漫插画，而非粗糙的草图。保持核心设计不变：白发、黑色弯角、耳边的一缕红色发丝、白衬衫、尖端带有小金标的红领带、黑色背带、棕色腰带、黑裤子、金色腰链、披风般的深色外层布料、颈圈、垂坠的十字架耳环，以及单手置于脑后的自信姿势。将整体升级为高细节、光泽感的渲染效果，配以干净的线条、戏剧性的光影、丰富的布料褶皱、闪亮的黑色皮革质感，并采用更成熟、时尚的比例。将角色置于夜间深色的石柱背景中，辅以冷色调轮廓光，采用略微仰视的半身近景构图。使其呈现出高端角色重绘作品的质感，赋予旧版原创画作全新的生命力。

templates.title: Cinematic Japanese temple main hall

titleLocalized.zh: 电影感日式寺庙大殿

templates.prompt: The interior of a grand and cinematic traditional Japanese temple or palace, constructed almost entirely of dark, aged wood, presents a near-perfect sense of symmetry through a slightly elevated central perspective. In the foreground is a wide, polished wooden corridor leading to a raised central platform and a shrine-like inner chamber at the rear. To the left and right of the corridor are shallow indoor reflecting pools filled with deep blue-green water, dotted with natural rocks and moss patches, their delicate ripples capturing warm light. The architectural details are meticulous and solemn: robust wooden pillars, intricately carved beams, railings, tatami-floored side chambers, sliding shoji doors, fusuma panels adorned with delicate natural patterns, and hanging lanterns. At the rear center, above the shrine, a large wooden plaque displays striking Japanese calligraphy, the content of which is…{argument name="calligraphy text" default="Abbot"} The rear wall features a central screen or mural in soft tan tones, while additional painted panels are found in the side rooms. The lighting is low, warm, and dramatic, with soft amber lantern light intertwining with natural beams, creating reflections on the water and casting long shadows on the wooden floors. The overall atmosphere is serene, sacred, contemplative, and slightly mysterious, characterized by incredibly detailed textures, realistic materials, cinematic depth of field, and a sophisticated realism.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个宏伟且具有电影感的传统日式寺庙或宫殿大殿内部，几乎完全由深色陈年木材建造，采用略微抬高的中心视角，呈现出近乎完美的对称感。场景前景是一条宽阔的抛光木质走廊，直通后方抬高的中央平台和神龛般的内室。走廊左右两侧是浅浅的室内倒影池，池中盛满深蓝绿色的水，散布着天然岩石、苔藓斑块，细微的涟漪捕捉着温暖的光线。建筑细节考究且庄重：粗壮的木柱、雕刻精美的横梁、栏杆、铺设榻榻米的侧室、推拉式障子门、绘有精致自然图案的袄绘（fusuma）面板以及悬挂的灯笼。在后方中央、神龛上方，一块巨大的木制牌匾上展示着醒目的日文书法，内容为 {argument name="calligraphy text" default="方丈"}。后墙包含一幅色调柔和的棕褐色中央屏风或壁画，侧室亦有额外的绘画面板。光线低沉、温暖且富有戏剧性，柔和的琥珀色灯笼光与自然光束交织，在水面上形成倒影，并在木地板上投下长长的阴影。整体氛围宁静、神圣、引人深思且略带神秘感，具有超高细节的纹理、逼真的材质、电影级的景深以及高端的写实风格。

templates.title: Elegant and stylish female portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 优雅时尚姿态女性肖像

templates.prompt: A refined, semi-realistic digital fashion portrait depicts a slender adult woman against a clean white studio backdrop. The portrait is vertically composed, showcasing the figure from above the thighs to above the head. She wears a deep charcoal-grey to black satin camisole with delicate, subtly sheen straps, paired with fitted high-waisted black trousers. Her body presents an elegant S-curve: hips tilted to one side, torso slightly twisted, shoulders relaxed, neck long, head turned to the side, face mostly obscured. Her arms hang naturally in a graceful, dance-like pose, one hand at her side, the other bent outwards with relaxed fingers. She has dark brown hair styled in a loose low bun, with a few strands falling around her head and neck. The soft, high-key lighting, delicate skin shadows, smooth brushstrokes, anatomically accurate fashion illustration style, minimalist background, serene editing style, subtle fabric sheen, clean contours, and understated luxurious beauty all contribute to the overall effect. The focus is on posture and body lines, without any accessories or props, and the background has no visible environmental details except for a solid color.

templates.title: Minimalist stick figure pose sketch

templates.prompt: Against a light gray background, a minimalist black sketch depicts a crude stick figure in a pose, outlined with uneven, hand-drawn strokes. The head, located near the top center, is oval-shaped with a small dot for an eye and a short arc suggesting a simple nose or smile. A vertical line extends downwards from the head, forming the neck and torso. The figure has two arms: the left arm extends significantly to the left in a large arc; the right arm is bent to the right, with the forearm hanging down. The lower body is only partially shown, with a central line extending downwards and a short arc on the lower left suggesting a bent leg. The entire pose appears loose, abstract, and gestural, like a quick graffiti sketch, with ample blank space, lacking shadows, colors, clothing, or detailed anatomical details.

promptLocalized.zh: 在浅灰色背景上的一幅极简黑色粗线条草图，展示了一个用不均匀的手绘笔触勾勒出的简陋火柴人姿势。人物头部位于上方中心附近，呈椭圆形，有 1 个小圆点作为眼睛，以及 1 条短弧线暗示简单的鼻子或微笑。一条垂直线从头部向下延伸作为颈部和躯干。人物有 2 条手臂：左臂向左侧大幅度伸展，呈大弧线状；右臂向右侧弯曲，前臂下垂。下半身仅部分呈现，1 条中心线向下延伸，左下方有 1 条短弧线暗示弯曲的腿部。整个姿势显得松散、抽象且具有手势感，就像一个快速的姿势说明涂鸦，留有大量空白，没有阴影、色彩、服装或详细的解剖结构。

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, redesign it into a sophisticated retro Japanese music release poster, while retaining the same segmented layout, band illustration on the right, and overall composition. Upgrade the font from simple placeholder text to an authentic retro poster style: add an aged typographic texture, uneven ink, and a slightly worn silkscreen appearance. Retain the three columns of vertical text on the left, but refactor them with stronger hierarchy and color differentiation: use a warm gold for the Japanese service announcement column, a soft cyan for the platform list, and a grayish pink for the date/release column. Change the original release start information at the bottom of the left Japanese column to "In Release♪" and highlight it in a larger pink font, adding musical notes. Add a thin gold decorative border and corner decorations around the left text block. In the right panel, retain the title text in the moon area, but refactor it into a striking retro aged font with the content "MY MIDNIGHT KIDS' COMPLEX". Apply a consistent retro poster effect to the entire image: delicate paper texture, faded edges, slight scratches, slightly darkened borders, and richer retro cyan/gold/pink tones.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图，将其重新设计为精致的复古日式音乐发行海报，同时保留相同的分割布局、右侧的乐队插画以及整体构图。将字体从简单的占位文本升级为地道的复古海报风格：添加做旧印刷纹理、不均匀的墨迹以及轻微磨损的丝网印刷外观。保留左侧的 3 列垂直文本，但通过更强的层级和色彩区分进行重构：日文服务公告列使用暖金色，平台列表使用柔和的青色，日期/发行列使用灰粉色。将左侧日文列底部原有的发行开始信息更改为「配信中♪」，并以较大的粉色字体突出显示，同时加上音符。在左侧文本块周围添加细金色的装饰边框线和边角装饰。在右侧面板中，保留月亮区域的标题文本，但将其重构为醒目的复古做旧字体，内容为“MY MIDNIGHT KIDS’ COMPLEX”。为整张图像应用统一的怀旧海报效果：细腻的纸张纹理、褪色的边缘、轻微的划痕、略微变暗的边框，以及更浓郁的复古青/金/粉色调。

templates.prompt: A clean, centered, chibi-style full-body anime illustration against a simple gray-green background. The image depicts a young girl standing barefoot, facing forward, with a large head and small body. Her face is obscured by a sign in her hand, so her features are not visible. She has glossy black hair with subtle cool green highlights in her bangs, parted in the middle to the side, with a slightly outward-curling wisp of hair on the upper left. Her hair is tied into two low pigtails, secured by dark red hair ties behind her ears, the ends slightly curled and messy. She wears a simple white short-sleeved T-shirt paired with loose beige cargo pants with two prominent side flap pockets, slightly wrinkled, and the cuffs rolled up to above her ankles. She stands barefoot on the ground, casting a soft oval shadow beneath her feet. She holds a rectangular handheld sign in both hands, one in each hand, for a total of two hands holding the item. The sign is white with a thin, light-colored wooden border, and a wooden pole extends from the center of the lower part of the sign. The notice board features three lines of handwritten Japanese text in bold black font, centered on the front: 1) "今日の" 2) "四コマと动漫は" 3) "お休みです". Maintaining a symmetrical and minimalist composition, the character occupies most of the frame from head to toe. It employs sophisticated modern anime-style shadow rendering, with clear lines, soft color gradients, and adorable proportions, creating a quiet and inviting atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张干净、居中的 Q 版全身动漫插画，背景为素雅的灰绿色。画面展示了一个赤脚站立、面向前方的幼态小女孩，拥有大头小身的比例。她的脸被手中的告示牌挡住，因此看不到五官。她留着亮黑色的头发，刘海处有微妙的冷绿色高光，中分偏侧，左上方有一缕微微向外弯曲的碎发。头发扎成两个低双马尾，用深红色发圈系在耳边，发梢微卷且略显凌乱。她穿着一件简单的白色短袖 T 恤，搭配宽松的米卡其色工装裤，裤子上有两个明显的侧边翻盖口袋，略带褶皱，裤脚卷起至脚踝上方。她赤脚平站在地面上，脚下有一个柔和的椭圆形阴影。她双手握着一块长方形手持告示牌，左右手各露出一只，共两只手抓着项目。告示牌为白色，带有细细的浅色木质边框，中心下方延伸出一根木杆。告示牌上居中书写着三行黑色的粗体手写风格日文：1) "今日の" 2) "四コマと動画は" 3) "お休みです"。保持构图对称且极简，角色从头到脚占据画面的大部分空间。采用精致的现代动漫阴影渲染，线条清晰，色彩渐变柔和，比例可爱，营造出一种安静的公告牌氛围。

templates.title: Celestial Planet Champagne Fan Art

titleLocalized.zh: Celestial Planet Champagne 同人艺术

templates.prompt: A luxurious fantasy anime illustration, set in the depths of outer space. A close-up shows a slender hand wearing a glossy black glove, emerging from a white astronaut's sleeve, elegantly holding a magnificent crystal champagne glass. The glass is exquisitely decorated, made of transparent iridescent crystal, adorned with intricate gold filigree and gemstone inlays. A large, translucent bow adorns the rim, with long, flowing ribbons and dangling gemstone chains, stars, beads, and crystal pendants gracefully curving outwards. Floating within the glass are seven adorable chibi-style planets, each with simple round eyes and small mouths, bobbing like sparkling soda bubbles: near the top is a small gray moon planet, a red planet, an orange planet with sleepy eyelashes, a bright blue Earth-like planet with green continents, a dark blue planet, a pale beige striped ring planet, and near the bottom a mint turquoise planet. The glass and stem are filled with shimmering gems, tiny bubbles, and refracted rainbow light. The background features a rich starry sky, with a bright, purplish-blue Milky Way band diagonally across the image, dotted with dense, twinkling starlight. In the upper right corner is a glowing, circular planet or logo, displaying a gradient of blue, purple, and cyan, with a white symbol at its center. Employing a magical celestial idol aesthetic and ultra-refined anime-style drawing, the design emphasizes radiant highlights, jewel-like transparency, dreamlike cosmic light and shadow, saturated blue-purple tones, delicate gold lines, crisp flashes, elegant composition, a fantastical fan art atmosphere, and a sophisticated, high-end fantasy poster quality. The lower right corner contains a small, stylized Japanese title logo with the text {argument name="title text" default="Planet Nine"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅奢华的奇幻动漫插画，背景设定在深邃的外太空中。画面特写了一只戴着亮面黑色手套的纤细手，从白色的宇航员袖口中伸出，优雅地握着一只华丽的水晶香槟杯。酒杯装饰精美，由透明的虹彩水晶制成，饰有复杂的金色花丝、宝石镶嵌，杯口处系着一个巨大的半透明蝴蝶结，长长的轻纱丝带与悬垂的宝石链条、星星、珠子和水晶挂饰向外优雅地弧形延展。杯中漂浮着 7 颗可爱的 Q 版行星，它们有着简单的圆眼睛和小嘴，像闪烁的苏打气泡一样浮动：顶部附近有一颗灰色的小月球行星、一颗红色行星、一颗带有困倦睫毛的橙色行星、一颗拥有绿色大陆的明亮蓝色地球状行星、一颗深蓝色行星、一颗淡米色条纹环状行星，以及底部附近的一颗薄荷绿松石色行星。杯身和杯脚中充满了闪闪发光的宝石、细小的气泡和折射的彩虹光芒。背景是丰富的星空，一条明亮的紫蓝色银河带斜向横跨画面，点缀着密集的闪烁星光；右上角有一个发光的圆形行星或 Logo，呈现蓝、紫、青渐变色，中心包含一个白色符号。采用魔法天体偶像美学、超精细动漫绘画风格，强调光芒四射的高光、宝石般的透明感、梦幻的宇宙光影、饱和的蓝紫色调、精致的金色线条、清脆的闪光、优雅的构图、奇幻的同人艺术氛围以及精致的高端奇幻海报质感。右下角包含一个小型风格化的日语标题 Logo，文字为 {argument name="title text" default="第九惑星"}。

templates.title: Leopard print embellished Q version fashionable girl

titleLocalized.zh: 豹纹点缀 Q 版时尚女孩

templates.prompt: This adorable chibi-style fashion illustration depicts a stylish young woman posing playfully over her shoulder against a clean, warm beige background. She has a large head and small body, huge, bright eyes, long eyelashes, slightly flushed cheeks, and a shy smile, turning to look at the viewer with a confident yet playful expression. Her hair is {argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown"} Her hair was styled in a very large, messy high bun, with a few wisps of hair falling around her cheeks and tied with a leopard-print hair tie or ribbon. Two small gold hair clips, one star-shaped and one round, were pinned to the side. She wore three visible earrings on one ear: two small hoops and one star-shaped drop earring. Her clothing consisted of an oversized black off-the-shoulder long-sleeved top that slipped off one shoulder; high-waisted beige loose-fitting jogging pants with tapered cuffs; a thin belt or drawstring detail; a decorative waist chain; and a leopard-print belt with long, flowing ribbons tied at the back of her waist. She wore black platform sneakers with white soles and small gold star embellishments. Her hands were casually in her pockets, one leg straight, the other slightly raised forward, as if she were taking a step. A hand-drawn black heart was added next to her head. The style is an exquisite anime-inspired fashion sketch with extremely clean lines, soft cel shadows, delicate warm highlights, elegant and stylish proportions, presenting the beauty of a premium sticker illustration. The background is minimalist, the composition is centered, and the details of the hair and accessories are rich.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张全身可爱的 Q 版时尚插画，描绘了一位时尚年轻女性在干净的暖米色背景下，摆出俏皮的回眸姿势。她拥有大头小身的比例、巨大的亮面眼睛、长睫毛、微微泛红的脸颊和腼腆的笑容，正回过头看向观众，表情自信且俏皮。她的头发是 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"}，扎成 1 个非常大的凌乱高丸子头，脸颊旁散落着几缕细碎的发丝，并系着 1 个豹纹发圈或丝带。侧面别着 2 个金色小发夹，一个是星形，一个是圆形。她的一侧耳朵上戴着 3 个可见的耳环：2 个小圆环和 1 个星形吊坠耳环。服装：一件超大号黑色露肩长袖上衣，从一侧肩膀滑落；1 条高腰米色宽松慢跑裤，裤脚收口；1 条细腰带或抽绳细节；1 条挂在腰间的装饰性腰链；以及 1 条系在腰部后侧、带有长长飘带的豹纹腰带。鞋子是 1 双黑色厚底运动鞋，配有白色鞋底和金色小星星装饰。她的双手随意插在口袋里，一条腿伸直，另一条腿微微向前抬起，仿佛正迈步走动。在她的头部旁边加入 1 个手绘的黑色小爱心涂鸦。风格为精致的动漫风时尚草图，线条极其干净，采用柔和的赛璐珞阴影，带有细腻的暖色高光，比例优雅时尚，呈现精品贴纸插画的美感，背景极简，构图居中，头发丝和配饰细节丰富。

titleLocalized.zh: 柔和风 Q 版女孩坐姿肖像

templates.prompt: A soft, anime-style illustration depicts a cute little girl sitting on the floor, knees curled up, one hand supporting her cheek, gently smiling at the viewer. She keeps {argument name="hair color" default="Light gray-beige"} Her hair was tied in a high side ponytail with a lavender-purple hair tie, and wispy bangs and loose curls framed her face. She had very large and lustrous eyes.{argument name="eye color" default="blue-purple"} Eyes, a small nose, rosy cheeks, and a sweet, cartoonish face. She wore two hair clips on the side of her bangs, one a yellow wavy clip and the other a pink double-bar clip. She wore a comfortable, oversized white sweatshirt with lavender trim on the collar and cuffs, and a small purple graffiti pattern on one sleeve, paired with loose-fitting {argument name="bottom color" default="lavender purple"} Shorts, white slouch socks, and chunky white sneakers with cyan, lavender, and pink accents. She also carries a small, round cyan crossbody bag with a gold zipper and a cherry charm. The clean white background is punctuated with sparse, playful doodle elements: a pink heart outline, two small yellow triangles, a cyan triangle, several tiny, soft-toned confetti dots, and a half-tone lavender dot in the lower right corner. The painting is rendered in a delicate, light watercolor cartoon style, with fine, freehand lines, soft shadows, and muted candy colors. Ample white space creates an overall gentle and innocent atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张柔和的动漫风格插画，描绘了一个可爱的小女孩坐在地板上，双膝蜷缩，一只手托着脸颊，正温柔地对着观众微笑。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="浅灰米棕色"} 的头发，扎着高侧马尾，系着薰衣草紫色的发圈，细碎的刘海和松散的卷发修饰着脸庞。她有着一双非常大且富有光泽的 {argument name="eye color" default="蓝紫色"} 眼睛，小巧的鼻子，红润的脸颊，以及甜美的 Q 版脸型。她在刘海侧面戴着 2 个发夹，一个是黄色波浪形发夹，另一个是粉色双杠发夹。她穿着一件舒适的超大款白色卫衣，领口和袖口有薰衣草紫色镶边，一只袖子上有一个紫色的小涂鸦图案，搭配宽松的 {argument name="bottom color" default="薰衣草紫色"} 短裤、白色堆堆袜，以及带有青色、薰衣草紫色和粉色点缀的厚底白色运动鞋。她还背着一个小巧的圆形青色斜挎包，包上有金色拉链和一个樱桃挂饰。使用干净的白色背景，并点缀稀疏俏皮的涂鸦元素：1 个粉色心形轮廓、2 个黄色小三角形、1 个青色三角形、若干微小的柔和色调五彩纸屑点，以及右下角的一块薰衣草紫色半色调圆点。采用精致轻盈的水彩漫画风格渲染，线条纤细写意，阴影柔和，色彩为柔和的糖果色，留白充足，整体氛围温柔纯真。

templates.title: Soft and cute style girl fashion portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 柔和可爱风少女时尚肖像

templates.prompt: A soft, pastel-colored full-body anime illustration depicts a cute girl standing playfully with one leg raised against a clean, greyish-white background. Her face is deliberately obscured by a smooth, rectangular blur effect similar to her skin tone, creating a sense of anonymous portraiture. She has {argument name="hair color" default="Warm chestnut brown"} Her hair was styled in a messy high bun with loose curls and a side-parted, voluminous look, adorned with two pale purple hair clips and a pale purple hair tie. She wore a soft, oversized pale purple cardigan with two flower patches on the chest, over a beige shirt with a small pink bow at the neckline, and a pink plaid pleated skirt. Her accessories included a single dangling flower earring visible in her right ear. She wore loose beige leggings with pale purple stripes and chunky pink lace-up sneakers. Leaning slightly forward with her hands in her cardigan pockets, one leg straight and the other bent and raised behind her, she exuded a sweet, stylish, and adorable vibe. Surrounding her were four large pale purple circles, two pink four-pointed stars, two gold glitters, two pale purple crescents, one pale purple flower icon, three tiny pink dots, and three tiny pale purple dots, serving as floating decorative elements. It employs soft cel shadow effects, delicate lines, pastel shades of pink and purple, exquisite character designs, simple white space, and modern Japanese cute and fashionable illustration aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅柔和的粉彩色动漫全身插画，描绘了一位可爱的少女，她以俏皮的单腿抬起姿势站在干净的灰白色背景前。她的面部被一块与肤色相近的平滑矩形模糊效果刻意遮挡，营造出一种匿名肖像感。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="暖栗棕色"} 的头发，梳成凌乱的高丸子头，带有松散的卷发丝和侧分蓬松感，并装饰有 2 个淡紫色发夹和一个淡紫色发圈。她穿着一件柔软的淡紫色超大号开衫，胸前有 2 个花朵补丁，内搭一件带有领口小粉色蝴蝶结的米色衬衫，以及一条粉色格纹百褶短裙。她的配饰包括右耳可见的 1 只垂坠花朵耳环。她穿着宽松的米色腿套，带有淡紫色条纹装饰，并搭配厚底粉色系带运动鞋。她身体微倾，双手插在开衫口袋里，一条腿伸直，另一条腿在身后弯曲抬起，传达出甜美、时尚的可爱风氛围。周围环绕着 4 个大型淡紫色圆形、2 个粉色四角星、2 个金色闪光、2 个淡紫色新月形、1 个淡紫色花朵图标、3 个微小的粉色圆点和 3 个微小的淡紫色圆点，作为漂浮的装饰元素。采用柔和的赛璐珞阴影光效、细腻的线条、粉色与紫色的粉彩色调、精致的角色设计、简洁的留白以及现代日系可爱时尚插画美学。

templates.title: Japanese Pork Cutlet Rice Diet Video Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 日式猪排饭减肥法视频封面

templates.prompt: Create a bright and visually striking Japanese-style YouTube video cover for a diet video on the theme of weight loss, using a simple left-right split composition. The left side features a white background filled with an oversized, bold Japanese title, stacked vertically and diagonally for optimal readability: the top line is a large, bright orange "カツ丼" (katsudon) with a thick white outline and soft shadow; below is a dark brown "食べても" (eat it); followed by a bright pink "太らない方法" (too unpleasant method) with a white outline and yellow underline; at the bottom is a large red-orange "5," next to a dark brown "选!" (choose!) with a white outline. Add small yellow sparkles and manga-style emphasis symbols around the title. In the lower left corner, place a simple flat illustration depicting a woman above waist height, wearing a yellow vest and with brown hair tied in a ponytail, making an "OK" gesture against a light yellow circle background. On the right is a close-up of an enticing pork cutlet rice bowl photographed under warm light: a ceramic bowl with blue vertical stripes holds a golden-brown fried pork cutlet topped with egg, onion, and rice, glistening with sauce and visible rising steam, garnished with a single green herb leaf. In the upper right corner, a white circular badge with a yellow dotted border contains the endearing handwritten Japanese phrase "おいしく楽しく♪ 贤くコントロール!", surrounded by a yellow emphasis mark. At the bottom edge, a light cream-colored horizontal information bar is added, with five circular icons and five labels evenly distributed from left to right: a salad bowl icon with the text "Good food in salads", a scale icon with "Be aware of your own health", a walker icon with "Exercise in moderation", a water cup icon with "Enjoy water", and a clock icon with "Make time for eating". The design employs a glossy commercial cover aesthetic, warm-toned food photography, thick-outlined fonts, a cheerful health-themed color scheme, and a high-contrast design optimized for social media click-through rates.

promptLocalized.zh: 制作一张明亮且具有视觉冲击力的日式 YouTube 视频封面，主题为减肥饮食，采用简洁的左右分割构图。左侧为白色背景，填充超大号的加粗日文标题，采用垂直和对角线堆叠排列以实现最佳可读性：顶部一行是巨大的鲜橙色“カツ丼”，带有厚实的白色描边和柔和的投影；下方是深棕色的“食べても”；接着是亮粉色的“太らない方法”，带有白色描边和黄色的下划线装饰；底部是一个巨大的红橙色“5”，旁边是带有白色描边的深棕色“選!”。在标题周围添加黄色小火花装饰和漫画风格的强调符号。在左下角，放置一个简单的扁平化插图，描绘 1 位腰部以上、身穿黄色背心、棕色头发扎成马尾的女性，做出“OK”的手势，背景为一个浅黄色圆圈。右侧展示一碗在暖光下拍摄的诱人猪排饭特写：1 个带有蓝色竖条纹的陶瓷碗，盛着铺在鸡蛋洋葱米饭上的金黄色炸猪排，酱汁油亮，可见上升的热气，顶部装饰 1 片绿色香草叶。在右上角，添加 1 个带有黄色虚线边框的白色圆形徽章，内含亲切手写风格的日文“おいしく楽しく♪ 賢くコントロール!”，徽章周围带有黄色强调符号。在底部边缘，加入一条浅奶油色的横向信息栏，从左到右均匀分布 5 个圆形图标和 5 个标签：1 个沙拉碗图标配文字“バランスの良い食事”，1 个秤图标配“カロリーを意識”，1 个步行者图标配“適度な運動”，1 个水杯图标配“水分をしっかり”，以及 1 个时钟图标配“食べる時間を工夫”。采用光泽感商业封面美学、暖色调美食摄影、厚实描边字体、欢快的健康主题配色，以及针对社交媒体点击率优化的强对比度设计。

templates.title: ChatGPT app cat story screenshot

titleLocalized.zh: ChatGPT 应用猫咪故事截图

templates.prompt: A realistic screenshot of the ChatGPT mobile app in dark mode on a smartphone, with a black background and an iOS-style UI. The top displays a title bar, a hamburger menu icon on the left, a rounded label with "ChatGPT" in the middle, and two icons on the right: a compose icon and a three-dot menu. Below are three rounded cat thumbnails: the first shows an orange and white cat sleeping on a plush cushion under a black metal chair frame on a wooden floor; the second shows a calico cat curled up on a light green round cushion in bed; and the third shows a cream-colored cat curled up sleeping in a brown plush pet bed. Below the thumbnails is a dark gray chat bubble containing the Japanese text: “これを良い感じにfacebookのストーリーに流せる感じにして。ばえるかんじで。” Below the message, the generated image is displayed: a tall, vertical Facebook Story-style collage that blends the three cat photos into a warm, comforting composition. The top area features an orange and white cat under a chair, the middle area a curled-up calico cat, and the bottom area a cream-colored cat in a fluffy bed. Soft beige and brown tones, dreamy lighting, subtle bokeh, delicate glitter, and a gentle lifestyle aesthetic are applied. Cute Japanese handwritten-style overlay text and stickers are added to the collage: a speech bubble near the top reads "Today is here♡", a vertical sticky note on the left reads "Minna sorezore otori no bazo de", two small heart doodles near the center, and a large diagonal title "Shiawasesuyasuya time." In the bottom left corner of the generated image, a rounded, dark button labeled "编集する" (Edit), and a circular download icon with a downward arrow is placed near the bottom center. At the very bottom of the screen, there is a ChatGPT input bar with a plus icon, placeholder text "ChatGPT に质问…" (ChatGPT に质问…), a microphone icon, and a circular voice button. This makes the overall image look like a realistic application screenshot, vertically oriented, with a thin white scroll bar visible on the right edge.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张逼真的 ChatGPT 移动端应用深色模式智能手机截图，背景为黑色，呈现 iOS 风格的 UI。顶部显示标题栏，左侧为汉堡菜单图标，中间为标有“ChatGPT”的圆角标签，右侧为两个图标：撰写图标和三点菜单。下方展示一行 3 张圆角猫咪缩略图：第一张是橘白猫在木地板上的黑色金属椅架下睡在毛绒垫子上；第二张是三花猫在床上蜷缩在浅绿色圆垫上；第三张是奶油色猫在棕色毛绒宠物窝里蜷缩睡觉。在缩略图下方，放置一个深灰色聊天气泡，其中包含日语文本：“これを良い感じにfacebookのストーリーに流せる感じにして。ばえるかんじで”。在消息下方，展示生成的图像，这是一个高垂直的 Facebook 故事风格拼贴画，将这 3 张猫咪照片融合为一张温暖、舒适的构图。顶部区域是椅子下的橘白猫，中间区域是蜷缩的三花猫，底部区域是毛绒窝里的奶油色猫。应用柔和的米色和棕色调、梦幻般的灯光、轻微的散景光圈、细微的闪光以及柔和的生活方式美学。在拼贴画上添加可爱的日式手写风格覆盖文字和贴纸：顶部附近的一个气泡写着“今日も おつかれさま♡”，左侧的垂直便签写着“みんなそれぞれ お気に入りの場所で”，中心附近有两个小爱心涂鸦，以及一条大的对角线标题“しあわせ すやすや時間。”。在生成图像的左下角，覆盖一个标有“編集する”的圆角深色按钮，底部中心附近放置一个带有向下箭头的圆形下载图标。在屏幕最底部，包含 ChatGPT 输入栏，带有加号图标、占位符文本“ChatGPT に質問…”、麦克风图标和一个圆形语音按钮。使整体图像看起来像一张真实的应用程序截屏，垂直方向，右侧边缘可见细长的白色滚动条。

templates.title: Retro Japanese Lovart event poster

titleLocalized.zh: 复古日式 Lovart 活动海报

templates.prompt: A bold Japanese event thumbnail poster with a light gray background and a retro arcade pop art style. At the center of the composition is a large diagonal lettering "LOVART" in oversized white block font with a thick black border, a substantial 3D feel, subtle pixelated stepped inner edges, and yellow halftone shadows. Above the lettering is a large, bright yellow Japanese title with a black border: "AI Design Application Training Association". Below the main lettering are two lines of slightly slanted, bold white Japanese subtitles with black borders: the first line reads "Latest Tool Gun ×", and the second line reads "Pro's Dark Continuation Power". At the bottom center is a pixelated black text label with a yellow shadow that reads "speaker kats". On the right side, overlapping with the main logo, a bright yellow, jagged star-shaped badge with a thick black border is added, containing three lines of stacked black text: "5.10 (sat)", "19:00", and "START". Around the logo are 12 playful, game-style decorative icons and shapes: two yellow pentagrams, two pairs of red cherries with green stems, two small yellow game controllers, a black circle with a yellow controller symbol inside, two solid yellow triangles, a yellow dashed triangle, a white-outlined polygon, and a small black-and-white spiral square. A high-contrast color scheme of yellow, black, white, and light gray is used, combined with thick outlines, sticker-like layering, cartoonish halftone dots, and clear, legible Japanese typography.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张以浅灰色为背景、采用复古街机波普艺术风格的大胆日式活动缩略图海报。构图中心为一个巨大的对角线字标，写着“LOVART”，采用超大白色块状字体，带有粗黑边框、厚实的 3D 感、微妙的像素阶梯状内边缘以及黄色半调阴影装饰。在字标上方，放置一行带有黑色边框的亮黄色大号日文标题：“AIデザイン運用時培会”。在主字标下方，添加两行带有黑色边框且略微倾斜的粗体白色日文副标题：第一行为“最新ツール実銃 ×”，第二行为“プロの暗続力”。在下方中心处，放置一个带有黄色投影的像素风黑色文本标签，写着“speaker kats”。在右侧与主 Logo 重叠处，添加一个带有粗黑边框的亮黄色锯齿状星形徽章，内含 3 行堆叠的黑色文字：“5.10(sat)”、“19:00”、“START”。在 Logo 周围点缀 12 个俏皮的游戏风格装饰图标和形状：2 个黄色五角星、2 对带绿色果梗的红樱桃、2 个小型黄色游戏手柄、1 个内部带有黄色手柄符号的黑色圆圈、2 个实心黄色三角形、1 个黄色虚线三角形、1 个白色轮廓多边形以及 1 个小型黑白螺旋正方形。采用黄色、黑色、白色和浅灰色的高对比度配色方案，结合粗轮廓、贴纸式分层、漫画半调圆点以及清晰易读的日文字体排版。

titleLocalized.zh: 复古游戏风格日本活动横幅

templates.prompt: Create a bold thumbnail of a Japanese event with a retro 8-bit video game style against a clean white background, using a black, white, and bright yellow color scheme. The composition is a highly graphic poster, filled with pixel art decorations, thick black outlines, comic book halftone dots, shadows, and arcade-style stickers. A large title is placed in the center: "{argument name="main title" default="LOVART"} The text uses an oversized, blocky font, bright yellow with a bold black outline, white border, and heavy shadow, slightly tilted and occupying most of the screen space. Above the title, a jagged white banner with a black outline is added, containing the Japanese title "{argument name="top banner text" default="AI Design and Operation Seminar"} Below the main title, a black ribbon is placed with the Japanese characters "..." written on it in yellow and white stripes.{argument name="subheading text" default="Latest tools practice × Professional foundation skills"} In the lower left center, add a large rounded rectangular date panel, filled in yellow with a black outline and white trim, containing a pixelated calendar icon on the left, displaying "..." in a large black retro font.{argument name="event date" default="Starting at 19:00 on May 10th (Saturday)."} In the lower right corner, there is a black spiked label that reads "speaker," above large text with a yellow outline.{argument name="speaker name" default="kats"} Above. Add 11 decorative game elements around the layout: a pixelated speech bubble with "LEVEL UP!" in the upper left, a yellow lightning bolt near the top, a yellow question mark cube with a black question mark in the upper right, a pixelated sword on the right, a starburst graphic with "GAME ON!" on the right, a pixelated character from Red Cliff wearing a yellow jacket and jumping with a punch on the left, a small black "1UP" life icon with three yellow hearts in the lower left, a retro game controller below it, and three sets of twinkling stars scattered throughout the composition. Add comic-style decorations such as dotted halftone patches, slanted yellow speed lines, small checkerboard stripes, and a pixelated cursor pointer near the subtitle. Include a stylized anime avatar in the lower right, wearing a black hat and a black hoodie with yellow accents, with the face partially obscured or simplified, blending in like a streamer or event host badge. Ensure all Japanese and English text is clear, legible, and accurately typified, giving the overall vibe a high-energy YouTube thumbnail or design/AI workshop social media banner feel.

promptLocalized.zh: 在干净的白色背景上，以黑、白、亮黄为配色方案，创作一张复古 8-bit 电子游戏风格的大胆日本活动缩略图。构图为一张极具图形感的海报，充满了像素艺术装饰、粗黑轮廓线、漫画半调圆点、投影和街机风格贴纸。在中心位置，放置一个巨大的标题“{argument name="main title" default="LOVART"}”，采用超大块状字体，亮黄色配以粗黑轮廓、白色边框和厚重阴影，略微倾斜并占据画面大部分空间。在标题上方，添加一个带有黑色轮廓的锯齿状白色横幅，包含日语标题“{argument name="top banner text" default="AI设计运营研讨会"}”。在主标题下方，放置一条黑色丝带，上面写有黄白相间的日语文字“{argument name="subheading text" default="最新工具实践 × 专业基础能力"}”。在左下方中心处，添加一个大的圆角矩形日期面板，黄色填充配以黑色轮廓和白色饰边，左侧包含一个像素日历图标，并以巨大的黑色复古字体显示“{argument name="event date" default="5.10 (周六) 19:00 开始"}”。在右下方，放置一个黑色的尖刺标签，上面写着“speaker”，位于带有黄色轮廓的大字“{argument name="speaker name" default="kats"}”上方。在布局周围添加 11 个装饰性游戏元素：左上方 1 个写着“LEVEL UP!”的像素对话气泡，顶部附近 1 个黄色闪电，右上角 1 个带有黑色问号的黄色问号方块，右侧 1 把像素剑，右侧 1 个写着“GAME ON!”的星爆图形，左侧 1 个穿着黄色夹克、挥拳跳跃的赤壁像素角色，左下方 1 个带有三个黄色心形的小型黑色“1UP”生命图标，其下方 1 个复古游戏手柄，以及散布在构图中的 3 组闪烁星星。添加漫画风格的装饰，如点状半调补丁、倾斜的黄色速度线、小棋盘格条纹以及副标题附近的像素光标指针。在右下角包含一个风格化的动漫头像，戴着黑色帽子和带有黄色装饰的黑色连帽衫，面部部分遮挡或简化，像主播或活动主持人徽章一样融入其中。确保所有日语和英语文本清晰、易读且排版准确，整体呈现出高能量的 YouTube 缩略图或设计/AI 研讨会社交媒体横幅的氛围。

templates.title: Anime AI Team Studio Meeting

titleLocalized.zh: Anime AI 团队工作室会议

templates.prompt: This heartwarming, cinematic-style anime-inspired group illustration is set in a cozy creative studio at night, depicting five young characters seated around a wooden table during an AI brainstorming session. The scene is presented from table-height perspective, creating a natural and realistic composition, with not everyone looking directly at the camera. In the foreground center, a person with short black hair and a black hoodie sits with their back to the viewer, using an open laptop. The screen displays a futuristic, blue, glowing AI interface with a circular "AI" logo. To the left foreground, a young man with short silver hair, wearing a white turtleneck jacket with light blue trim, sits sideways, facing the team. To the center left, another young man with short silver hair, wearing a light-colored jacket and white shirt, is thoughtfully resting his chin on his hand. In the background to the center right, a tall, elegant silver-haired character in a flowing white multi-layered robe leans over the table, guiding the discussion. To the right, a young woman with a silver-blue side ponytail, wearing a blue and white hoodie, rests her chin on her hand, using a tablet. The image should include two laptops displaying blue glowing AI-themed dashboards, one tablet in use, a white ceramic mug near the center, a black takeout cup with a blue heart icon on the right front, and a small bowl of snack cubes on the far right edge of the table. The left side of the background should show a glass panel or wall with hand-drawn Japanese brainstorming notes and diagrams, including the words "AI," "Idea," "future," and the repeated phrase "image generation." Add a potted plant behind the team and arrange warm pendant lights or soft, blurred lighting. Use golden hour indoor lighting, presenting rich amber highlights and soft shadows, and employ high-precision anime illustration rendering to depict delicate hair and reflective screens, creating a collaborative, intelligent, and relaxed atmosphere. Add an elegant cursive text overlay at the bottom, stating "{argument name="character names" default="Mai, Luca, Koyo, Grace & Shun"} ".

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅温馨的电影感动漫风格群像插画，背景设定在夜晚舒适的创意工作室中，展示了 5 位年轻角色在 AI 头脑风暴会议期间围坐在木桌旁。场景采用桌子高度的视角，构图自然且真实，并非所有人都看向镜头。画面前景中央，一位留着黑色短发、身穿黑色连帽衫的人背对观众坐着，正在使用一台打开的笔记本电脑，屏幕上显示着带有圆形“AI”标志的蓝色发光未来感 AI 界面。左侧前景中，一位留着银色短发、身穿白色高领夹克配浅蓝色饰边的年轻男子侧身而坐，面向团队。中左侧，另一位留着银色短发的年轻男子身穿浅色夹克和白衬衫，正托着下巴沉思。后方中右侧，一位身材高挑、气质优雅的银发角色身穿飘逸的白色多层长袍，俯身在桌前引导讨论。右侧，一位留着银蓝色侧马尾的年轻女子身穿蓝白相间的连帽衫，单手托腮，正在使用平板电脑。画面中需包含 2 台显示着蓝色发光 AI 主题仪表盘的笔记本电脑，1 台正在使用中的平板电脑，1 个位于中心附近的白色陶瓷马克杯，1 个位于右前方带有蓝色爱心图标的黑色外卖杯，以及 1 个位于桌子最右侧边缘的小碗零食方块。背景左侧展示一块玻璃板或墙面，上面有手绘的日语头脑风暴笔记和图表，包括“AI”、“アイデア”、“未来”以及重复的“画像生成”字样。在团队后方添加一盆绿植，并布置温暖的吊灯或柔和的虚化灯光。采用黄金时段的室内光线，呈现丰富的琥珀色高光和柔和阴影，采用高精度的动漫插画渲染，刻画细腻的发丝和反光的屏幕，营造出协作、智慧且轻松的氛围。在底部添加一行优雅的草书文字覆盖，内容为“{argument name="character names" default="Mai, Luca, Koyo, Grace & Shun"}”。

templates.title: Censored version of comic-style female student portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 审查版漫画风女学生肖像

templates.prompt: A black-and-white comic-style illustration depicts a Japanese high school girl in a sailor uniform, in half-length profile, standing by a window in a classroom or school corridor. She has long, straight hair.{argument name="hair color" default="black"} Her hair had a glossy, dark sheen, with a few strands swaying gently to the right in the breeze. Her face was deliberately obscured by a centrally located gray rectangular swatch, covering her eyes, nose, and most of her face. She was dressed in traditional {argument name="school uniform" default="Dark blue sailor suit"} She wears a dark sailor collar, three-stripe trim, long sleeves, and a neatly tied scarf. The composition is vertically compact, with the girl occupying most of the frame. She lowers her head slightly, her posture calm, introspective, and melancholic. The background shows a window frame, an outdoor railing, and a simplified school building structure drawn with fine architectural lines. The work employs clean pen-and-ink line art, high-contrast shadows, halftone paper textures, delicate cross-hatching, sparse minimalist background details, and an elegant comic book aesthetic. Monochrome only, white paper background, subtle cinematic lighting, an emotionally charged atmosphere of everyday life, and highly detailed hair and clothing folds.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张黑白漫画风格的插画，描绘了一位身穿水手服的日本女高中生，半身侧面像，站在教室或学校走廊的窗边。她留着长直发，{argument name="hair color" default="黑色"} 的发丝带有光泽的墨色高光，几缕发丝随风轻轻向右飘动。她的面部被一个位于中央的灰色矩形审查块刻意遮挡，覆盖了眼睛、鼻子和大部分脸部。她穿着传统的 {argument name="school uniform" default="深蓝色水手服"}，配有深色水手领、三条纹装饰、长袖和系得整齐的领巾。构图为竖向紧凑裁剪，女孩占据了画面的大部分，她微微低头，姿态平静、内省且忧郁。背景展示了 1 个窗框、1 个室外栏杆和 1 个用细建筑线条绘制的简化教学楼结构。采用干净的钢笔线条艺术、高对比度阴影、网点纸纹理、精致的交叉排线、稀疏的极简背景细节以及优雅的漫画分镜美学。仅限单色，白色纸张背景，微妙的电影感光影，情感化的生活片段氛围，高度细致的头发和衣物褶皱。

templates.title: Cute and adorable twin music camera designs with a soft, milky feel

titleLocalized.zh: 奶系柔和风 Q 版音乐相机双子

templates.prompt: A cute, soft-toned anime illustration depicts two chibi-style twin girls sitting side-by-side behind a large retro camera, the composition balanced. The girl on the left has {argument name="hair color" default="Cream Gold"} She had a short, light pink bob, wore a huge pink bow and oversized, round, soft-colored headphones, her cheeks were slightly flushed, and she had simple, oval, dark eyes. The girl on the right had {argument name="second hair color" default="Soft peach"} Both characters have short hair, with a single strand tied at the side and a ribbon-like decoration. They wear matching oversized, soft-colored headphones, their cheeks slightly flushed, and share the same minimalist, chibi-style facial features. Their hands rest above a camera, as if peeking in, their expressions calm yet slightly curious. The camera itself is enormous, intricate, and whimsical, featuring a powder blue base accented with pink and cream. It has a large central lens and two smaller, circular side lenses, giving it a toy-like mechanical feel. Behind them is a deep navy blue semi-circular background, adorned with floating white and soft-colored musical notes. The entire scene is surrounded by numerous interwoven gears, dials, rings, dots, and small decorative shapes, arranged symmetrically like a music box or a wind-up halo. A soft cream background is used, with the color scheme limited to soft cyan, baby blue, blush pink, peach, ivory, and navy blue. The lines are clean and rounded, employing a flat, anime-style aesthetic, complemented by soft shadows, delicate textures, and a dreamy, retro-futuristic, and adorable atmosphere. It emphasizes the exquisite sticker texture, high visual clarity, and sweet "milky soft" aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅可爱的奶系柔和风动漫插画，两名 Q 版双子少女紧挨着坐在一台大型复古相机后方，构图平衡。左侧少女留着 {argument name="hair color" default="奶油金"} 色短波波头，戴着巨大的粉色蝴蝶结和超大号圆形柔和色系耳机，脸颊微红，有着简约的椭圆形深色双眼。右侧少女留着 {argument name="second hair color" default="柔桃色"} 短发，侧边有一缕发束和丝带状装饰，佩戴同款超大号柔和色系耳机，脸颊微红，拥有同样的极简 Q 版面部特征。两个角色双手撑在相机上方，仿佛正探头窥视，表情平静且略带好奇。相机造型巨大、精致且充满奇趣，采用粉蓝色搭配粉色与奶油色点缀，设有一个大型中央镜头和两个较小的圆形侧镜头，呈现出玩具般的机械质感。她们身后是深海军蓝色的半圆形背景，点缀着漂浮的白色与柔和色系音符。整个场景被许多相互交织的齿轮、表盘、圆环、圆点和小装饰形状环绕，如同音乐盒或发条光环般对称排列。使用柔和的奶油色背景，配色方案限定为柔和青色、婴儿蓝、腮红粉、桃色、象牙白和海军蓝。线条干净圆润，采用扁平化动漫风格，辅以柔和阴影、细腻纹理和梦幻般的复古未来主义可爱氛围。强调精致的贴纸质感、高视觉清晰度以及甜美的“奶系柔和”美学。

templates.title: advertisement for high-end clinics in Ginza

titleLocalized.zh: 银座高端诊所广告

templates.prompt: This is a luxurious vertical advertisement poster designed for a high-end cosmetic clinic in Ginza, employing the sophisticated style of a high-end Japanese magazine. The composition utilizes a portrait aspect ratio optimized for smartphone viewing, with a deep black and midnight blue background framed by a delicate double-lined metallic Art Deco border and elegant details in the corners. The center right corner features a captivating half-length portrait of an East Asian woman in a sleeveless black evening gown, her skin delicate and fair, her hair styled in an elegant low bun, and a sparkling diamond teardrop earring adorning one earlobe. Her posture is graceful and composed, showing three-quarters of her back, her head slightly turned, conveying a sense of uniqueness and luxury. The scene is set on a Ginza street at night, with cinematic blurred lighting and high-end architecture; on the left is a highly recognizable classic Ginza clock tower, radiating a warm glow, while modern buildings and bright streetlights extend into the background. To protect privacy, the face is partially blurred, covered with a soft rectangular blur mask to conform to the original layout. Add a large, elegant serif gold title at the top center:{argument name="headline text" default="GINZA LUXE CLINIC"} On the right, add one line of vertical Japanese text, using large white Mingchao serif font: "{argument name="vertical tagline" default="Ginza, a sanctuary for skin."} At the bottom of the image, a large metallic gold ribbon banner with realistic wrinkles and highlights is placed, containing two lines of centered white serif text: the first line reads "OPEN Commemoration," and the second line reads "All Mentions 50% OFF." Below the ribbon, a centered Japanese sentence is added, using white serif font: "{argument name="subheading text" default="Invest in your beauty at a special price."} At the bottom, add two lines of smaller, centered white Japanese text: the first line reads "Limited to 30 people," and the second line reads "ご予約はプロフィールより." The overall lighting should convey a sense of luster, cinematic quality, and luxury, possessing the aesthetic characteristics of high-end skincare advertisements. It should feature strong contrasts, subtle gold reflections, and a clean layout to create the feel of an exclusive, high-end brand. Aside from the clinic's name, it should contain no logos, add no additional products, and maintain a clean aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张为银座高端医美诊所设计的奢华垂直版美容诊所广告海报，采用精致的日本高端杂志广告风格。构图采用适合智能手机浏览的竖屏比例，背景为深邃的黑色与午夜蓝，外框饰有纤细的双线金属金装饰艺术风格边框，并在角落处加入优雅的细节设计。画面右前方中心位置呈现一位魅力十足的东亚女性半身像，身着无袖黑色晚礼服，皮肤细腻白皙，发型为精致的低盘发，单侧耳垂佩戴着一颗闪耀的钻石水滴耳环。她姿态优雅从容，以四分之三背影示人，头部微微转动，传达出独特性与奢华感。场景设定在夜晚的银座街头，配以电影质感的虚化灯光与高端建筑；左侧包含一座辨识度极高的银座经典钟楼，散发着温暖的光芒，现代建筑与明亮的路灯在背景中延伸。为了保护隐私，面部应保持部分模糊，覆盖一层柔和的矩形模糊遮罩，以符合原始布局。在顶部中心，添加大号优雅的衬线体金色标题：{argument name="headline text" default="GINZA LUXE CLINIC"}。在右侧，添加 1 行竖排的日文标语，使用大号白色明朝体衬线字： 「{argument name="vertical tagline" default="銀座、肌の聖域へ。"}」。在画面中下部，放置 1 条宽大的金属金丝带横幅，带有逼真的褶皱与高光，内含 2 行居中的白色衬线体文字：第一行「OPEN記念」，第二行「全メニュー50%OFF」。在丝带下方，添加 1 句居中的日文句子，使用白色衬线体： 「{argument name="subheading text" default="美への投資を、特別な価格で。"}」。在底部，添加 2 行居中的较小白色日文文字：第一行「先着30名様限定」，第二行「ご予約はプロフィールより」。整体光影应呈现出光泽感、电影感与奢华感，具备高端护肤广告的美学特征，对比强烈，带有细腻的金色反光，排版简洁，营造出独家高端品牌的质感。除诊所名称外，不包含任何标志，不添加额外产品，画面整洁。
