templates.title: Blue ballpoint pen "Dark History" comic battle page

titleLocalized.zh: 蓝色圆珠笔“黑历史”漫画对战页

templates.prompt: A single hand-drawn comic strip, set against a cream-colored notebook paper, is entirely composed of rough blue ballpoint pen lines, exuding a messy, teenage doodle feel. The panel layouts are uneven, the shadows are sloppy, and the action is exaggerated, presenting a deliberately amateurish "dark history notebook" style. The page contains a total of six vertically arranged panels: one top wide panel, one second wide panel, one third wide panel, one narrow horizontal impact panel, and two smaller panels side-by-side at the bottom. In the first panel at the top, a round, pink, spherical, cute hero is dramatically crouching on the left, a long sword stuck behind him, his eyes fierce; on the right stands a curly-haired man in a shirt, tie, and trousers, looking like a thug or office worker, hands in his pockets, against a desolate rocky plain with sloppy clouds and speed lines. In the second panel, a chubby swordsman leaps diagonally into the air, surrounded by vertical lines of motion; the panel is filled with huge handwritten Japanese onomatopoeia, in two sets: "断タネ" on the left and "超時空" on the right. In the third panel, the hero flies low from left to right, unleashing a sharp energy slash or screaming attack at the man on the right; the panel is spanned by a huge handwritten Japanese shout: "ズギャアアアン!!!". In the fourth narrow panel, the entire scene is filled with the chaos of smoke, impact graffiti, and explosions, accompanied by a huge handwritten Japanese sound effect: "ドォォォン!!!". In the fifth panel in the lower left corner, the smoke dissipates, revealing the man unharmed, casually using two fingers to catch or block the small sword near his face; next to his fingers is a tiny handwritten note: "ピタ…". In the sixth panel at the bottom right, a close-up of the chubby hero appears, screaming in terror, eyes wide open, sweating profusely, with dark striped shadows on his face; to the right is a line of vertical handwritten Japanese reaction: “Naka!?”. Please obscure the faces of human characters with soft rectangular blur blocks. Overall tone: a comical and over-the-top parody of a battle manga, middle school notebook doodles, chaotic composition, monochrome blue ink pen sketches, no sophisticated digital rendering, retaining visible doodle marks and imperfect anatomical structures.

promptLocalized.zh: 一页手绘漫画，背景为米白色笔记本纸，完全由粗糙的蓝色圆珠笔线条构成，充满凌乱的青少年涂鸦感，分镜框不均匀，阴影潦草，动作效果夸张，呈现出刻意为之的业余“黑历史笔记本”风格。页面总共包含 6 个垂直排列的分镜：1 个顶部宽幅分镜，1 个第二宽幅分镜，1 个第三宽幅分镜，1 个狭窄的横向冲击分镜，以及底部的 2 个小分镜并排排列。在顶部第一个分镜中，一位圆滚滚、类似粉色球状剑客的可爱英雄在左侧做出戏剧性的蹲姿，身后插着一把长剑，眼神凶狠；右侧站着一名卷发、身穿衬衫领带西裤的混混或上班族男子，双手插兜，背景是荒凉的岩石平原，配有潦草的云朵和速度线。在第二个分镜中，圆滚滚的剑客举剑斜向跃入空中，周围环绕着垂直的运动线条；分镜中填满了巨大的手写日文拟声词，共有 2 组文字：左侧为“断タネ”，右侧为“超時空”。在第三个分镜中，英雄从左向右低空飞过，向右侧的男子释放出一道尖锐的能量斩击或尖叫般的攻击；分镜横跨着一个巨大的手写日文呐喊：“ズギャアアアン!!!”。在第四个狭窄的分镜中，整个画面充满了烟雾、冲击涂鸦和爆炸的混乱感，配有 1 个巨大的手写日文效果音：“ドォォォン!!!”。在左下方的第五个分镜中，烟雾散去，男子毫发无损，随意地用两根手指在脸部附近夹住或挡下了那把小剑；手指旁有一行极小的手写标注：“ピタ…”。在右下方的第六个分镜中，圆滚滚的英雄出现特写，他惊恐地尖叫着，双眼圆睁，满头大汗，脸上带有深色的条纹阴影；右侧有一行垂直的手写日文反应：“なっ!?”。请将人类角色的面部用柔和的矩形模糊块遮挡。整体基调：滑稽且过度夸张的战斗漫画戏仿，初中生笔记本涂鸦，构图混乱，单色蓝墨水笔素描，无精致的数字渲染，保留可见的涂鸦痕迹和不完美的解剖结构。

templates.title: Retro anime style: kotatsu (heated table) family scene

titleLocalized.zh: 复古动漫风格：暖桌家庭场景

templates.prompt: A nostalgic anime illustration set in a traditional Japanese tatami room during winter, using a slightly downward-sloping, three-quarters perspective. In the center of the image is a low wooden kotatsu table covered with a thick brown patchwork quilt, and two cushions are visible on the tatami mats. Three people sit around the table: one with long, straight hair {argument name="hair color" default="blue-green"} A young woman wearing a pink sleeveless dress with a white collar sits across the table peeling an orange; another young woman with a purple bob haircut, wearing a pale yellow top, blue skirt, and a white apron tied in a knot at the back, sits in the foreground on the right; a little boy wearing a white top with blue sleeves and blue shorts kneels on the left, half-craning under the kotatsu (heated table) to warm himself. On the table are three yellow-green plastic bottles labeled "mello Yello," a round woven tray containing five whole oranges, and a peeled orange with its peel scattered on the table. In the background on the left stands a bulky 1980s CRT television set with wood grain trim on the sides, placed on a low TV stand, below which is a silver VCR or game console. The television screen displays a blue title screen with white Japanese subtitles and glowing pale circular patterns. Behind the characters are a shoji sliding door on the left and two beige okata doors on the right wall. Warm interior lighting, a cozy family atmosphere, a retro Japanese house from the Showa era, delicate hand-drawn cel animation style, soft shadows, clean lines, and slightly faded retro colors.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅充满怀旧感的动漫插画，场景设定在冬季的传统日式榻榻米房间内，采用略微俯视的三分之四视角。画面中央是一张低矮的木制暖桌，上面覆盖着厚实的棕色拼布被，榻榻米上可见 2 个坐垫。桌旁坐着 3 个人：一位留着长直发（{argument name="hair color" default="蓝绿色"}）并穿着白色领口粉色无袖连衣裙的年轻女性，坐在桌子对面剥着橘子；另一位留着紫色波波头的年轻女性，穿着淡黄色上衣、蓝色裙子，系着在背后打结的白色围裙，坐在右侧前景；还有一个穿着白底蓝袖上衣和蓝色短裤的小男孩，跪在左侧，正半钻进暖桌下取暖。桌上放着 3 瓶贴有“mello Yello”标签的黄绿色塑料瓶、一个盛有 5 个完整橘子的圆形编织托盘，以及 1 个剥开的橘子，橘子皮散落在桌面上。左侧背景中立着一台 1980 年代的厚重 CRT 电视机，侧面带有木纹装饰，放置在低矮的电视柜上，下方还有一台银色的录像机或游戏机。电视屏幕上显示着带有白色日文字幕和发光淡圆形图案的蓝色标题画面。角色身后是左侧的 1 扇障子拉门和右侧墙上的 2 扇米色袄门。温暖的室内灯光，温馨的家庭氛围，昭和时代的复古日式住宅，细腻的手绘赛璐珞动漫风格，柔和的阴影，干净的线条，以及略显褪色的复古色调。

templates.title: Anime Party Spot the Difference Game

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫派对找茬游戏

templates.prompt: A brightly colored, anime-style spot-the-difference puzzle, presented in a split-screen design with side-by-side lines separated by a vertical white dividing line. The scene depicts a cozy indoor birthday or party celebration, with a slightly overhead view. In the foreground, four young people are huddled together taking a candid photo. Three faces are deliberately blurred by soft rectangular obscuring blocks, leaving only one face clearly visible: a cheerful young man with messy, medium-length red hair, his eyes crinkling into crescent moons as he grins broadly, stands at the upper right of the group. To the left is a slender, dark-haired girl with very long, straight hair, fair skin, and large, purplish-gray anime eyes. She wears a fitted white long-sleeved top and black trousers, leaning inward and playfully pointing to the girl on her right. Behind her stands another dark-haired girl with a high ponytail tied with a mint green hair tie, wearing a light-colored top and skirt; a sneaker is visible in the lower left corner. In the center is a shorter, dark-haired character wearing a beige cable-knit sweater and a gray skirt. On the right is a black-haired girl with double braids, wearing a beige blouse with ruffled cuffs and a navy blue pleated skirt. A red-haired character's hand is on her shoulder. The background is decorated with rich party elements: many soft-colored balloons hanging overhead, twisted ribbons, colorful confetti floating and scattered everywhere, string lights twinkling with warm light, and a table covered with a white tablecloth, on which are placed snack plates, bottles, and glasses. Wrapped gift boxes are also on the floor to the right. The right panel clearly marks 6 differences marked with red circles as the answers to the puzzle: 1 is a missing or changed purple balloon at the top edge, 1 is a changed bottle or glass on the table behind, 1 is a round-framed pair of glasses added to the ponytail girl's face, 1 is a small red dot or hair accessory to the right of the middle character, 1 is a missing or changed earring/ear detail on the braided girl in the lower right corner, and 1 is a green sneaker with a changed color in the lower left corner. The visuals feature soft, delicate anime-style rendering, warm festive colors, clear lines, rich details in clothing folds, and a vibrant celebratory atmosphere, designed specifically for spot-the-difference comparison images on social media.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张色彩鲜艳的动漫风格找茬拼图，采用左右并排的分屏设计，中间由一条垂直的白色分割线隔开。场景展示了一个温馨的室内生日或派对庆典，视角略微俯瞰，前景中 4 位年轻人紧密地聚在一起拍摄抓拍照片。其中 3 张脸被柔和的矩形遮挡块刻意模糊处理，只有 1 张脸清晰可见：一位有着凌乱中长红发的开朗青年，他双眼笑成弯月，咧嘴大笑，站在人群右上方。左前方是一位身材苗条的黑发女孩，留着超长直发，皮肤白皙，拥有一双紫灰色的动漫大眼，身穿修身白色长袖上衣和黑色长裤，正向内倾斜并俏皮地指向右侧的女孩。她身后站着另一位黑发女孩，扎着高马尾，系着薄荷绿色的发圈，穿着浅色上衣和裙子；左下角露出一只运动鞋。中间是一位个子较矮的深发角色，身穿米色麻花针织衫和灰色裙子。右侧是一位扎着双麻花辫的黑发女孩，穿着带有荷叶边袖口的米色衬衫和海军蓝百褶裙，红发角色的手搭在她的肩膀上。背景装饰着丰富的派对元素：头顶悬挂着许多柔和色调的气球、扭曲的彩带、漂浮并散落在各处的彩色纸屑、闪烁着暖光的串灯，以及铺着白色桌布的餐桌，上面摆放着零食盘、瓶子、玻璃杯，右侧地板上还放着包装好的礼盒。右侧面板中明确标注了 6 处红圈标记的差异，作为谜题答案：1 处位于顶部边缘缺失或改变的紫色气球，1 处位于后方餐桌上改变的瓶子或玻璃杯，1 处位于马尾女孩脸上新增的圆框眼镜，1 处位于中间角色右侧的小红点或发饰，1 处位于右下角麻花辫女孩身上缺失或改变的耳环/耳朵细节，以及 1 处位于左下角改变颜色的绿色运动鞋。画面采用柔和精致的动漫渲染，暖色调的节日配色，线条清晰，衣物褶皱细节丰富，充满活力的庆典氛围，专为社交媒体的找茬对比图而设计。

templates.title: Cute Japanese-style daycare menu calendar

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱日式托儿所菜单日历

templates.prompt: A cute, soft-toned Japanese-style daycare monthly meal calendar poster, featuring a gentle watercolor children's art style and a clean white background. The horizontal design has a highly organized layout, resembling a printable daycare menu. A large title at the top center uses a playful, rounded Japanese font, and the content is {argument name="headline text" default="May Menu"} Below it is a smaller pink ribbon-shaped subtitle that reads:{argument name="subtitle text" default="0-year-old class - later stage of feeding (around 9-11 months)"} The header is decorated with two adorable baby illustrations holding bowls, two carp streamers, and a small blue origami boat; the upper right corner features a pink speech bubble containing Japanese text.{argument name="note text" default="This baby food is soft and easy to eat."} Adorned with two small purple flowers. Create a 6-column monthly calendar grid, using rounded pastel label headers for weekdays, with the Japanese characters for: Moon, Fire, Water, Wood, Metal, and Earth. Fill 25 date cells to show the layout for the month, covering the dates 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22, 23, 25, 26, 27, 28, 29, and 30, leaving some blank cells at the beginning of the month. Use thin pink gridlines and soft pastel tones. Label the three holiday cells in red Japanese: 4th with "Midori no Hi" and "Kyuen"; 5th with "Kodomo no Hi" and "Kyuen"; and 6th with "Shinetsu Kyubi" and "Kyuen". Add small seasonal illustrations to the blank cells at the beginning of the month and the holiday cells: a chick with a clover, a sandwich, a cluster of flowers, a tender leaf, a clover and a tree, a samurai helmet with a flag, and a flowering tree. In each meal day cell, display tiny Japanese menu text with miniature food illustrations such as a bowl of porridge, soup, vegetables, fruit, yogurt, bread, cookies, and snacks. Include a snack line starting with "Oyatsu:" on meal days. Add a row of horizontal legends at the bottom, containing 10 labeled food icons: おかゆ, パン, fish, 鶏肉, pork meat, tofu, にんじん, ほうれん草, とうもろこし, fruit,ヨーグルト. Place a rounded note box in the lower left corner containing a Japanese disclaimer{argument name="footer note" default="*The content has been partially modified for posting on social media."} Add a pink encouraging bubble in the bottom right corner with the following content:{argument name="encouragement text" default="We support your daily growth!"} It features a tiny, smiling baby illustration. Overall style: warm, easy to read, child-friendly, kawaii nursery flyer, soft watercolor texture, rounded shapes, accents of pink, cream, yellow, blue and green, with exquisite editorial poster quality.

promptLocalized.zh: 一款可爱的柔和色调日式托儿所月度膳食日历海报，采用柔和的水彩儿童画风格，背景为干净的白色。设计为横版，布局高度条理化，如同可打印的托儿所菜单表。顶部中央是一个巨大的标题，采用俏皮的圆体日文字体，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="5月の献立表"}，下方配有一个较小的粉色丝带状副标题，内容为 {argument name="subtitle text" default="0歳児クラス・後期食（9〜11ヶ月頃）"}。页眉处装饰有 2 个拿着碗的可爱婴儿插画、2 面鲤鱼旗、1 只蓝色小折纸船；右上角有一个粉色对话气泡，内含日文文本 {argument name="note text" default="やわらかくて 食べやすい 離乳食です"}，旁边点缀着 2 朵紫色小花。创建一个 6 列的月度日历网格，工作日采用圆润的粉彩标签页眉，日文分别为：月, 火, 水, 木, 金, 土。填充 25 个日期单元格以展示当月布局，日期涵盖 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22, 23, 25, 26, 27, 28, 29, 30，月初留有部分空白单元格。使用细粉色网格线和柔和的粉彩色调。用红色日文标注 3 个节假日单元格：4 日标注“みどりの日”和“休園”，5 日标注“こどもの日”和“休園”，6 日标注“振替休日”和“休園”。在月初的空白单元格和节假日单元格中添加小型季节性插画：1 只带三叶草的小鸡、1 个三明治、1 簇花朵、1 枝嫩叶、1 株三叶草和树木、1 个带旗帜的武士头盔、1 棵开花的树。在每个膳食日单元格中，显示微小的日文菜单文本，并配有微型食物插画，如粥碗、汤、蔬菜、水果、酸奶、面包、饼干和零食。在膳食日包含以“おやつ：”开头的零食行。底部添加一行水平图例，包含 10 个带标签的食物图标：おかゆ, パン, 魚, 鶏肉, 豚肉, 豆腐, にんじん, ほうれん草, とうもろこし, 果物, ヨーグルト。左下角放置一个圆角备注框，内含日文免责声明 {argument name="footer note" default="※SNS掲載用に、内容を一部改変しております。"}。右下角添加一个粉色鼓励气泡，内容为 {argument name="encouragement text" default="毎日の成長を応援しています♪"}，并配有一个微小的微笑婴儿插画。整体风格：温馨、易读、亲和儿童、卡哇伊托儿所传单、柔和水彩质感、圆润形状、粉红、奶油、黄色、蓝色和绿色点缀，具备精致的编辑海报品质。

templates.title: Selfie in helicopter cabin at sunset

titleLocalized.zh: 日落时分的直升机机舱自拍

templates.prompt: A casual close-up selfie taken inside a small helicopter cabin, using a front-facing phone camera, shows an adult passenger seated on the left. The face is obscured by a large, centrally located rectangular privacy blur, but reflective rainbow-colored wraparound sunglasses are visible above. The subject has short, dark hair, wears a dark jacket, and has one hand near their chest, as if grasping a strap or collar. The helicopter's interior is dimly lit and enclosed, featuring a black ceiling, circular overhead vents, a curved cabin frame, and visible wiring near the center ceiling line. An empty black leather passenger seat is on the right. A bright, round window on the far right showcases the sun-drenched blue waters and distant coastline or low-lying city skyline. Warm, golden hour light streams through the window, creating a striking contrast, with orange highlights on the cabin surfaces, resulting in an emotionally charged, cinematic travel photo quality. The realistic smartphone photography, slightly grainy low-light exposure, tight composition, and natural perspective create an authentic and relaxed atmosphere for a vacation helicopter trip.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张在小型直升机机舱内拍摄的随性特写自拍，由前置手机摄像头拍摄，画面左侧坐着一名成年乘客。人物面部被一个位于中心的大型矩形隐私模糊块遮挡，但上方可见反光的彩虹色环绕式太阳镜。主体留着深色短发，身穿深色夹克，一只手靠近胸前，仿佛正抓着带子或衣领。直升机内部昏暗封闭，配有黑色天花板、头顶的圆形通风口、弧形机舱框架、中心顶线附近可见的电线，右侧是一个空的黑色真皮乘客座椅。最右侧明亮的圆形窗户展示了窗外阳光明媚的蓝色水域以及远处的海岸线或低矮的城市天际线。温暖的黄金时刻光线透过窗户射入，形成了强烈的对比，机舱表面带有橙色高光，呈现出一种充满情绪感的电影级旅行照片质感。逼真的智能手机摄影，略带颗粒感的低光曝光，紧凑的构图，自然的视角，营造出真实随性的度假直升机之旅氛围。

templates.title: Playful Rainbow Goggles Graffiti

titleLocalized.zh: 童趣彩虹护目镜涂鸦

templates.prompt: A rough, whimsical digital doodle created in simple drawing software. Against a white background, it presents a close-up scene from a selfie perspective, with a main character positioned in the lower left and center. The figure has messy medium-brown hair, wears a dark blue jacket, revealing a light-skinned neck and chest, and oversized ski goggles or sunglasses with a bright rainbow band across the lenses, the colors being red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple in sequence. The face is mostly obscured by a large, square, beige, blurred block or occlusion located at the center of the head and upper body. A pale hand is raised near the bottom center, as if giving a thumbs-up or holding something close to the camera. The figure is surrounded by simple black outline background doodles: two small cloud shapes near the top, a large, tilted airplane or rocket-like object in the upper right corner, a gray, round, standing object to the right of the figure that looks like a stone, a backpack, or a wrapped human figure, and a tall, white rectangular object on the far right with a yellow sun drawn on top and blue jagged doodles below. Using rough, uneven hand-drawn lines, messy coloring that goes outside the lines, and minimalist shadows, the artwork presents a naive, childlike aesthetic and a playful composition with low-detail details.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅在简单绘图软件中创作的粗糙童趣数字涂鸦，白色背景，呈现出一种自拍视角的特写场景，画面左下方和中心位置有一位主角。人物留着凌乱的中棕色头发，身穿深蓝色夹克，露出浅肤色的颈部和胸部，佩戴着超大号滑雪护目镜或遮阳镜，镜片上有一条横跨双眼的明亮彩虹色带，颜色依次为红、橙、黄、绿、蓝、紫。人物面部大部分被一个位于头部和上半身中心的大型方形米色模糊块或遮挡块遮住。一只苍白的手举在底部中心附近，仿佛在比大拇指或拿着靠近镜头的东西。人物周围环绕着简单的黑色轮廓背景涂鸦：顶部附近有 2 个小云朵形状，右上角有 1 个大型倾斜的飞机或火箭状物体，人物右侧有 1 个灰色的圆形站立物体，看起来像石头、背包或包裹着的人形，最右侧有 1 个高大的白色长方形物体，顶部画着一个黄色太阳，下方有蓝色锯齿状涂鸦。使用粗糙不均匀的手绘线条、涂出界外的凌乱填色、极简的阴影，呈现出稚拙的儿童画美学和低细节的趣味构图。

templates.title: Painting of the Twenty-Four Bridges Under the Moon

titleLocalized.zh: 月下二十四桥画作

templates.prompt: A panoramic classical East Asian ink painting of a night scene, presented in the style of an antique handscroll, depicting {argument name="bridge name" default="Twenty-Four Bridges"} A scene under a bright full moon. At the center of the composition is a large stone arch bridge spanning a calm, reflective river. Fourteen slender women in flowing traditional Hanfu robes walk in a line on the bridge, each shown in profile or three-quarter view. Their clothing is in soft shades of gray-pink, pale jade, beige, cream, and faded lavender. The bridge features three arches, weathered stone textures, carved railings, and small, warm-colored lanterns near the central pier. Faint Chinese characters are engraved at the central span. The bridge is surrounded by the poetic landscape of Jiangnan: distant, misty mountains, floating clouds, a bright moon in the upper right sky, drooping willows on the right, blooming trees on the left, pavilions and towers on both banks, and small traditional boats on the water, including a covered boat with lanterns moored in the lower right foreground. Soft moonlight reflects on the river, a light mist shrouds the mountains and bridges, and the overall design employs a restrained monochromatic palette, accented with delicate low-saturation colors. The upper left corner features a vertical column of Chinese calligraphy, titled {argument name="calligraphy title" default="Moonlit Night on the Twenty-Four Bridges"} Below the painting are two lines of poetry, and the painting also bears a red seal. The overall atmosphere is tranquil, melancholic, literary, and dreamlike, showcasing highly detailed brushstrokes, aged paper texture, soft atmospheric perspective, and exquisite composition befitting a museum-quality historical Chinese painting.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅全景式古典东亚水墨夜景画，呈现古董手卷风格，描绘了 {argument name="bridge name" default="二十四桥"} 在明亮满月下的景象。构图中心为一座横跨平静反光河流的大型石拱桥，桥面上正有 14 位身着飘逸传统汉服长袍的苗条女子排成一列行走，每位人物均以侧面或四分之三侧面呈现，服饰色调为柔和的灰粉色、淡玉色、米色、奶油色及褪色的薰衣草紫。桥梁可见三座拱门，具有风化的石材纹理、雕花栏杆，中央桥墩附近装有小型暖色灯笼，中心跨度处刻有隐约的汉字。桥梁四周环绕着诗意的江南山水：远处层峦叠嶂的迷雾山脉、漂浮的云朵、右上角天空中明亮的月亮、右侧垂下的柳树、左侧盛开的树木、两岸的亭台楼阁，以及水面上小型传统船只，包括右下角前景中一艘带篷和灯笼的停泊船只。河面上洒下柔和的月光倒影，山脉与桥梁周围笼罩着淡淡的薄雾，整体采用克制的单色调，并点缀精致的低饱和度色彩。左上角包含一列竖排的中国书法，标题为 {argument name="calligraphy title" default="二十四桥明月夜"}，下方附有两行诗句，画作上还带有红色印章。整体氛围宁静、忧郁、富有文学气息且如梦似幻，展现出极具细节的笔触、陈旧的纸张纹理、柔和的空气透视感，以及博物馆级历史中国画的精致构图。

templates.title: Ghibli style: A man in front of the Paris Opera

titleLocalized.zh: 吉卜力风格：巴黎歌剧院前的男子

templates.prompt: A warm and painterly anime illustration, in the style of Studio Ghibli, depicting a {argument name="subject type" default="young man"} He sat shirtless on a dark green wooden bench in front of the Paris Opera (Palais Garnier). He was only wearing {argument name="shorts color" default="Navy blue"} Wearing drawstring shorts, with a slender, athletic build, and slightly tousled dark brown hair, he exuded a relaxed and casual air. One arm was stretched out on the back of a bench, while the other gently held a lit cigarette to his lips. He sat with his legs naturally apart, wisps of smoke rising in the bright sunlight. The background was {argument name="landmark" default="Paris Opera"} A detailed front view reveals the opulent Beaux-Arts architectural style, including towering columns, sculpted figures, gilded roof sculptures, green oxidized copper domes, and two flags visible on the roof: the French flag and the EU flag. The left foreground includes a large, ornate black streetlamp and a sign that reads {argument name="street sign text" default="RUE SCRIBE 9e ARR."} Blue Parisian street signs. Stone railings added between benches and the street, a few pedestrians near the opera house entrance, and a dark-colored car on the road. Bright afternoon sunlight, soft blue skies, fluffy white clouds, cinematic composition, hand-drawn textures, and nostalgic cel animation color grading create a tranquil and romantic European summer atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅温暖且富有绘画感的动漫插画，采用吉卜力工作室风格，展示了一位 {argument name="subject type" default="年轻男子"} 赤裸上身坐在巴黎歌剧院（Palais Garnier）前一张深绿色木质长椅上。他仅穿着 {argument name="shorts color" default="藏青色"} 系带短裤，拥有苗条的运动型身材，深棕色短发略显凌乱，姿态轻松随意，一只手臂伸展在长椅靠背上，另一只手轻轻地将点燃的香烟凑近嘴边。他双腿自然分开坐着，缕缕轻烟在阳光明媚的空气中升起。背景是 {argument name="landmark" default="巴黎歌剧院"} 的详细正面视图，呈现出华丽的布杂艺术（Beaux-Arts）建筑风格，包括高耸的圆柱、雕塑人物、镀金的屋顶雕像、绿色的氧化铜圆顶，以及屋顶上可见的两面旗帜：法国国旗和欧盟旗帜。左侧前景包含 1 盏大型黑色华丽路灯和 1 个写有 {argument name="street sign text" default="RUE SCRIBE 9e ARR."} 的蓝色巴黎路牌。在长椅和街道之间增加石质栏杆，歌剧院入口附近有少量行人，道路上有一辆深色汽车。采用明亮的午后阳光、柔和的蓝天、蓬松的白云、电影级构图、手绘质感、怀旧的赛璐珞动画调色，营造出宁静、浪漫的欧洲夏季氛围。

templates.title: Icy Coke Splash Ad

titleLocalized.zh: 冰爽可乐飞溅广告

templates.prompt: A high-end studio commercial photo features an aluminum soda can standing upright in the center of the frame, placed on a damp, reflective black surface, shot at eye level. The can has a deep navy to black metallic finish, covered with a thick layer of condensation. The label design is modern and minimalist. The label contains four text elements: a white water droplet icon near the top, and bold, compressed uppercase letters in the center.{argument name="brand name" default="REFRESH"} The lettering features a subtle red outline, with smaller text below.{argument name="product subtitle" default="CHILLED COLA"} The text at the very bottom is{argument name="tagline text" default="ICE COLD"} The image features a crown-shaped water splash effect on both sides and the back of the can, with dozens of frozen water droplets suspended in mid-air. The result is a sharp, high-speed photographic style, with dynamic arcs interwoven with the scattered droplets, and small splashes at the bottom. The lighting employs cinematic commercial techniques: strong cool white contour lighting on both sides, glossy highlights on the aluminum can surface, deep shadows, bright reflections in the water splashes, and a deep, emotionally charged gradient black background. The image emphasizes ultra-sharp details of the can and water splashes, conveying the quality of a high-end beverage advertisement, a refreshing and icy atmosphere, and photorealistic macro product photography. The vertical composition and shallow depth of field, while maintaining sharp, frozen detail in the main water splash areas, achieve a quality comparable to a luxury e-commerce main image.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高端摄影棚商业广告照片，画面正中央竖立着一个铝制汽水罐，置于潮湿且具反射效果的黑色表面上，采用产品高度平视拍摄。罐体呈深海军蓝至黑色金属质感，表面布满厚重的冷凝水珠，标签设计现代简约。可见标签包含 4 个文本元素：顶部附近的一个白色水滴图标，中间是加粗压缩大写字母的 {argument name="brand name" default="REFRESH"} 字样并带有微妙的红色轮廓，下方是较小的 {argument name="product subtitle" default="CHILLED COLA"} 字样，最底部是 {argument name="tagline text" default="ICE COLD"} 字样。罐体两侧及后方爆发出皇冠状的水花飞溅效果，数十颗冰冻水珠悬浮在半空中，呈现出清晰的高速摄影风格，动态弧线与散落的水珠交织，底部伴有小型溅射。灯光采用电影级商业布光：两侧强烈的冷白色轮廓光，铝罐表面呈现出光泽感的高光，阴影深邃，水花中带有明亮的反光，背景为深邃且富有情绪感的渐变黑。强调罐体与水花的超锐利细节，高端饮料广告质感，清爽冰凉的氛围，照片级真实感的微距产品摄影，竖构图，浅景深但主要水花部分保持锐利冻结，具备奢侈品电商主图级的品质。

templates.title: Emotional Hijab female mobile phone call portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 情绪感希贾布（Hijab）女性手机通话人像

templates.prompt: A highly evocative, realistic indoor portrait featuring a young Muslim woman wearing {argument name="hijab color" default="black"} Hijab, dressed in a loose white puff-sleeved shirt, blue jeans, and white sneakers, sits casually in a dark brown leather armchair. She is presented in a relaxed, editorial pose, one knee raised, one hand near her ankle, and the other holding a smartphone to her face as if on a call. The image is vertically composed, framing upwards from mid-shin, centered, with her body slightly turned towards the camera. Her face is processed, blurred or softly anonymized, with no visible facial details. Soft, natural window light from the upper right casts gentle shadows on the understated beige textured wall, creating a warm, tranquil afternoon atmosphere. The image emphasizes Hijab's realistic draping folds, the crisp cotton texture of her shirt, the denim feel, and her minimalist lifestyle aesthetic. The use of soft neutral tones, shallow depth of field, and a documentary-style fashion photography approach, with subtle grain and soft contrast, results in an elegant, modern editorial visual.

The background includes two circular celestial bodies or abstract spheres: a pale, moon-shaped circle in the upper left and a deep red sphere in the right, along with two sets of vertical architectural stripes, one along the left edge and the other near the upper right edge, all integrated into the same multifaceted abstract structure. The color palette employs the soft hues of aged paper, including beige, off-white, charcoal black, faded navy blue, and gray, accented with touches of deep red. The background is a dense wall composed of torn printed pages and paper scraps, the paper exhibiting a weathered texture. The image contains precise text elements: the large "DADA" in the upper left corner, "anti-kunst" near the upper right corner, "Die Kunst ist tot / Es lebe / die Kunst" in the middle left, "ZUFALL / ist / notwendig" in the lower left corner, an oversized "6" and "No." on the left, fragmented "X", "UT" and "frag / ment" in the lower right corner, and a partial year number "192" in the upper right corner. The collage should include three realistic eye silhouettes located on the outer or partial outer sides of the face, two small bee illustrations in the body area, three bullseye-like circular graphics on the clothing, a small astronaut or a photograph of a person in a spacesuit in the upper right corner, a mechanical rocket or engine collage element in the upper left corner, a wave photograph strip in the lower right corner, and multiple overlapping circular charts. The character's clothing should be a futuristic high-necked jacket pieced together from confetti and diagram fragments, with small red tag details near the collar and a prominent "06" mark on the chest. The composition should be a vertical poster style, with a compact, asymmetrical, and editorial layout, featuring rough paper edges, glue seams, photocopying noise, and ink stains, creating a strong contrast between organic portrait features and abstract graphic structures. Style: Avant-garde Dadaism, Bauhaus-influenced collage, cartoon portraits incorporating archival prints, extremely high detail, rich texture, a flat frontal perspective, no clean digital gradations, and no modern sheen.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实的法文报纸头版特写编辑照片，略微斜放在深色桌面上，设计风格如同精致的全国性日报。报头是一个带有白色报纸字体的蓝色大矩形，写着 {argument name="newspaper name" default="Le Parisien"}，下方有一条细红线。中央主标题采用超大号粗体黑色衬线字体，写着 {argument name="main headline" default="ChatGPT Vs Gemini : Le match des images"}。正下方是一个较小的法文斜体衬线副标题，写着 {argument name="subheadline" default="Deux intelligences artificielles s’affrontent dans une bataille visuelle sans précédent"}。在页面中心，放置一张宽矩形专题图片，展示 2 只未来感十足的拳击手套从左右两侧碰撞：左侧手套为深石墨色和黑色，带有微妙的发光电路图案，手腕附近有 OpenAI 结形标志，并带有亮白色的 {argument name="left glove label" default="ChatGPT"} 字样；右侧手套为金属蓝银色，带有发光的蓝色电路，并带有蓝白色发光的 {argument name="right glove label" default="Gemini"} 字样。两只手套在中间戏剧性地碰撞，光效如同高端科技广告。主报道周围有 4 个较小的报纸预告块：顶部角落各 2 个，右侧边栏堆叠 2 个，每个块都有密集的法文占位符式文章文本、细分隔线、诸如“Pag. 2”或“Page 4”的小页码引用，以及一些蓝色全大写栏目标签，如“LE AMIT”、“LE PARISIEN”和“CONFIANTS”。在图片下方增加一行斜体衬线文本，重复视觉对决的主题。采用地道的报纸排版比例、清晰的印刷纹理、米白色新闻纸上的黑色油墨、微妙的纸张折痕以及柔和的自然光，呈现出一张逼真的报纸头版照片。

templates.title: Poster for the movie "King Kong: Rebirth"

titleLocalized.zh: 《金刚：重生》电影海报

templates.prompt: A high-definition movie poster depicts the reboot of the giant monster against a Manhattan backdrop at sunset. A massive, angry-looking giant ape (similar to King Kong) stands atop a badly damaged skyscraper in the foreground, its jaws agape, baring its fangs. The monster is muscular, covered in dark brown fur, and its chest, arms, shoulders, and legs are covered in clearly visible battle scars and fresh wounds. One hand grips a broken steel spire and a shattered roof, while its other enormous foot crushes the roof. The city below is New York, with the Empire State Building clearly visible in the background on the right-center, its dense skyline gradually merging into a dramatic golden haze. The sky is filled with dark clouds, torn apart by the warm orange glow of the sunset. The image must include three military helicopters: one in the upper right corner, shining a bright searchlight on the giant ape; a smaller helicopter near the right-center skyline; and one in the lower left corner, sweeping its searchlight across a smoke-shrouded building. Add firelight, smoke columns, glowing embers, a sense of destruction on the street level, and an atmosphere of massive urban chaos. The composition adopts a sophisticated, modern Hollywood movie poster style, with the monster centered and towering above the city. Add tagline text in the bottom third:{argument name="tagline text" default="The legend rises again."} Above the credits, two large lines of embossed metal titles are placed:{argument name="movie title" default="KING KONG"} And below{argument name="subtitle" default="REBORN"} Below this, add a dense and realistic movie credits block containing multiple lines of information for producers, directors, actors, and screenwriters, using a small, compressed font. At the very bottom, add the release date.{argument name="release text" default="Summer 2026"} It employs hyper-realistic lighting and shadows, dramatic contrasts, blockbuster poster compositions, volumetric smoke, sharp details, photorealistic fur textures, and high-end action-adventure disaster film aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超高清电影海报，描绘了日落时分曼哈顿背景下的巨型怪兽重启之作。一只体型庞大、神情愤怒的巨猿（类似金刚）站在前景中一座损毁严重的摩天大楼顶端，张开大嘴咆哮，露出獠牙。怪兽肌肉发达，覆盖着深棕色皮毛，胸部、手臂、肩膀和腿部布满了清晰可见的战斗伤痕和新鲜伤口。一只手紧紧抓着断裂的钢制尖塔和破碎的楼顶，另一只巨大的脚踩碎了屋顶。下方的城市是纽约，中右侧背景中可以清晰看到帝国大厦，密集的城市天际线逐渐融入戏剧性的金色雾霭中。天空中布满了乌云，被温暖的橙色夕阳余晖撕裂。画面中需包含 3 架军用直升机：1 架位于右上角，正用明亮的探照灯照射巨猿；1 架较小的直升机位于中右侧天际线附近；1 架位于左下角，正用探照灯扫过烟雾缭绕的建筑。添加火光、烟柱、发光的余烬、街道层面的破坏感以及大规模城市混乱的氛围。构图采用精致的现代好莱坞影院单张海报风格，怪兽居中并耸立在城市之上。在底部三分之一处添加标语文本：{argument name="tagline text" default="传奇再度崛起。"} 在演职员表上方，放置两行巨大的金属浮雕标题：{argument name="movie title" default="KING KONG"} 以及下方的 {argument name="subtitle" default="REBORN"}。在其下方，添加一个密集且逼真的电影演职员表块，包含多行制片人、导演、演员和编剧信息，采用小型压缩字体。最底部添加上映日期：{argument name="release text" default="2026 年夏季"}。采用超写实光影、戏剧性对比、大片海报构图、体积烟雾、锐利细节、照片级皮毛质感以及高端动作冒险灾难片美学。

templates.title: Dark-style street fashion photography

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑风街头穿搭时尚摄影

templates.prompt: A candid street style photo shows a slender young woman crossing a city crosswalk at dusk, shot with a slightly tilted, handheld camera, creating a paparazzi-like effect. She keeps {argument name="hair color" default="jet black"} Her medium-length straight hair dramatically swayed to one side in the wind, and she wore a dark, oversized double-breasted suit jacket over a {argument name="dress style" default="Black sequined mini skirt"} She paired it with{argument name="boots style" default="Black over-the-knee boots"} She carries a silver chain shoulder bag and two stacked silver necklaces, including a chunky chain necklace and a heart-shaped pendant necklace. Her hands are in her suit pockets, and her gait is natural and confident. The background is a blurred downtown street with traffic, headlights, skyscrapers, and pedestrians, with three blurred figures visible in the background. A red circular no-crossing traffic sign is visible in the upper left background, and a white zebra crossing is visible at her feet. The film employs melancholic blue-toned lighting, shallow depth of field, soft motion blur, realistic skin and fabric textures, luxurious fashion editorial styling, cinematic cool tones, and a slightly grainy, high-end editorial photography feel.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张抓拍风格的街头时尚照片，一位身材苗条的年轻女性在黄昏时分穿过城市人行横道，采用略微倾斜的手持相机拍摄，营造出编辑部狗仔队的视觉感。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="乌黑色"} 的中长直发，在风中戏剧性地向一侧飘动，身穿一件深色超大款双排扣西装外套，内搭 {argument name="dress style" default="黑色亮片迷你裙"}。她搭配了 {argument name="boots style" default="黑色过膝长靴"}、一个银色链条肩包以及 2 条叠戴的银色项链，包括 1 条粗链条项链和 1 条心形吊坠项链。她的双手插在西装口袋里，步伐自然且自信。背景是模糊的城市市中心街道，有车流、车灯、高楼大厦和行人，背景中可见 3 个虚化的人物。左上方背景包含 1 个红色的圆形禁止通行交通标志，脚下是白色的斑马线。采用忧郁的蓝调时刻光影、浅景深、柔和的动态模糊、逼真的皮肤和织物纹理、奢华时尚大片造型、电影般的冷色调，以及略带颗粒感的高端编辑摄影质感。

templates.prompt: A highly dramatic, hyper-realistic studio image shows two black leather boxing gloves colliding in mid-air in the center of the frame, captured in a tight close-up against a background of deep navy blue to black gradient. The left glove is cut in from the left and bears markings.{argument name="left glove text" default="GPT-Image 2"} The gloves feature large, luminous, ice-blue sans-serif fonts, and futuristic blue circuitry patterns are wrapped around the gloves and wrists. The right glove is cut in from the right and is marked with {argument name="right glove text" default="Nano Banana 2"} Featuring a large, bold, warm gold sans-serif font, the cuffs are adorned with sharply angled gold decorative stripes and stylized gold badges. promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧性的超写实摄影棚图像，两只黑色皮质拳击手套在画面中央空中碰撞，采用紧凑的特写镜头，背景为深海军蓝至黑色的渐变色。左侧手套从左方切入，上面标有 {argument name="left glove text" default="GPT-Image 2"}，采用大型发光冰蓝色无衬线字体，手套和手腕上缠绕着未来感的蓝色电路轨迹图形。右侧手套从右方切入，上面标有 {argument name="right glove text" default="Nano Banana 2"}，采用大型粗体暖金色无衬线字体，袖口带有棱角分明的金色装饰条纹和程式化的金色徽章。捕捉碰撞瞬间，明亮的金属火花和微小颗粒在两只手套之间迸发。强调光泽皮革质感、可见的缝线、戏剧性的轮廓光、高对比度、微妙的反射以及高端科技与运动对决的审美。电影级构图、居中碰撞、对称平衡、超高细节、清晰对焦、商业广告风格。

templates.title: Cherry Blossoms at Dawn Lakeside

titleLocalized.zh: 樱花晨曦湖畔

templates.prompt: A tranquil and realistic spring lakeside landscape is presented from the shore using a wide-format, cinematic composition. Pale pink cherry blossom branches form two main clusters: one dense canopy spans the entire top edge, while the other extends into the frame from the lower right corner. The lake's surface is like a mirror, reflecting the dark shadows of the trees, the blossoms, and the distant, layered blue mountains. Rows of cherry trees and tall, dark evergreen trees stand along the water's edge on either side of the shore, and a small, quiet village is faintly visible in the center of the lake in the distance. The sky is a clear, soft blue, and the light is the gentle glow of a morning sun, creating an overall atmosphere of tranquility, elegance, and a touch of dreaminess. A sophisticated, centered typography is added to the lower part of the image: a large, warm cream-colored serif font containing the following text:{argument name="headline text" default="Good morning."} Below the icon is a small decorative flower icon, with a thin horizontal dividing line on each side; below the icon is a line of smaller, more widely spaced sans-serif capital text that reads:{argument name="quote" default="Let the day unfold."} The text should blend naturally with the scenery, with a balanced, luxurious, and magazine-like feel, like a high-end social media greeting card.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅宁静且具有写实感的春日湖畔景观，以宽画幅的电影感构图从岸边视角呈现。淡粉色的樱花枝条在画面中形成两个主要簇群：一簇茂密的树冠横跨整个顶部边缘，另一簇花枝从右下角延伸入画。湖面如镜，倒映着深色的树影、花朵以及远处层叠的蓝色山峦。湖岸左右两侧，成排的樱花树与高大的深色常青树沿水而立，远处的湖中心隐约可见一个小巧宁静的村庄。天空呈现清澈柔和的蓝色，光线是温和的清晨晨光，整体氛围宁静、优雅且略带梦幻感。在画面中下部添加精致的居中排版：大号暖奶油色衬线字体，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="Good morning."}，下方配有一个小型装饰花朵图标，图标两侧各有一条细长的水平分割线；在图标下方，是一行较小的、字母间距较大的无衬线大写文字，内容为 {argument name="quote" default="Let the day unfold."}。文字应与景致自然融合，布局平衡、奢华且具有杂志质感，如同高端的社交媒体问候卡。

templates.title: Convert childlike hand-drawn style photos

titleLocalized.zh: 童趣手绘风格照片转换

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0, the composition, figures, poses, clothing, drinks, and background layout were reproduced exactly as in the original image, but the entire image was transformed into a playful, childlike crayon and colored pencil drawing style on clean white paper. The subject remains centered, and the face is still obscured by a simple beige blur. The Thai text on the black T-shirt and the Café Amazon logo on the cup are retained. All environmental details were simplified into childlike doodles with uneven lines and random coloring: a gray car on the left, a blue accessible parking sign, two streetlights, three visible trees, an Amazon store with a black roof, a small figure at a distant entrance, a curb ramp with handrails, and a tiled floor drawn with loose perspective grid lines. This makes it look cute, rugged, and humorous, like a child's sketch version of the original photograph.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用 REFERENCE_0，重现与原图完全一致的构图、人物、姿势、服装、饮品及背景布局，但将整张图片转换为在干净白纸上绘制的俏皮儿童手绘蜡笔及彩色铅笔画风格。保持主体居中，面部依然用简单的米色模糊块遮挡。保留黑色 T 恤上的泰文以及 Café Amazon 杯子的品牌标识。将所有环境细节简化为稚拙的涂鸦，线条不均匀且填色随意：左侧 1 辆灰色汽车、1 个蓝色无障碍停车标志、2 盏路灯、3 棵可见的树木、1 间黑色屋顶的 Amazon 店铺、远处门口的 1 个小人、1 个带扶手的路缘坡道，以及画成松散透视网格线的瓷砖地面。使其看起来既可爱又粗犷且充满幽默感，就像是原照片的儿童速写版本。

templates.title: City Posters for the Future AI Era

titleLocalized.zh: 未来 AI 时代城市海报

templates.prompt: A cinematic, vertical sci-fi poster is set at sunset, offering a panoramic view of a vast futuristic megacity rooftop observation deck from behind. In the foreground, two protagonists stand side-by-side: a tall, adult male in a tailored dark business suit, black shoes, and a white shirt, his back to the camera; beside him is a luminous, translucent blue female humanoid AI hologram, its body composed of light particles, wireframe lines, and constellation-like nodes. The human confidently faces the skyline, while the holographic AI raises a hand, projecting a bright holographic city blueprint composed of neon blue building outlines and transparent UI panels. The man's left hand holds a glowing golden octagonal device, designed like a compass or navigation badge, with bright radiating lines. The city is densely packed with skyscrapers, aerial traffic, digital billboards, and dotted with cyberpunk lights in blue, cyan, and magenta; a flying car is visible to the right. The sky transitions from warm orange sunlight near the horizon to a deep blue night sky above, accompanied by dramatic clouds and a high-tech, optimistic atmosphere. Four main holographic interface clusters have been added: a large projected city model above the AI's hand, an analysis panel with charts and circular diagrams in the center of the screen, a transparent data screen in the upper right corner, and a billboard-like screen in the lower right corner displaying a huge "AI" logo. At the top center, a large, futuristic border title is placed, using bold, glowing Chinese characters in a metallic white-gold font.{argument name="headline text" default="The era of intelligent agents: imagination sets the boundaries, action determines victory or defeat."} The overall composition should be forward-thinking, business-like, inspiring, and high-end, featuring ultra-refined lighting effects, a reflective, damp roof surface, volumetric lighting, sharp focus, an epic scale, and exquisite GPT-Image-2 poster aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张电影质感的竖版科幻海报，背景设定在日落时分，从后方视角俯瞰广阔的未来超级城市屋顶观景台。前景中，2 位主角并肩站立：一位身材高大的成年男性，身穿修身深色商务西装、黑色皮鞋和白色衬衫，背对镜头；旁边是一位发光的半透明蓝色女性人形 AI 全息影像，其身体由光粒子、线框线条和星座般的节点构成。人类自信地面对天际线，而全息 AI 抬起一只手，投射出一幅由霓虹蓝建筑轮廓和透明 UI 面板组成的明亮全息城市蓝图。男子的左手拿着 1 个发光的金色八角形装置，设计如同指南针或导航徽章，带有明亮的放射状线条。城市中密布着摩天大楼、空中交通、数字广告牌，并点缀着蓝色、青色和洋红色的赛博朋克灯光；右侧可见 1 辆飞行汽车。天空从地平线附近的温暖橙色阳光过渡到上方的深蓝色夜空，伴有戏剧性的云层和高科技的乐观氛围。添加 4 个主要的全息界面集群：AI 手上方 1 个大型投射城市模型，画面中心 1 个带有图表和圆形示意图的分析面板，右上角 1 个透明数据屏幕，以及右下角 1 个类似广告牌的屏幕，显示巨大的“AI”字样。在顶部中心，放置一个巨大的未来感边框标题，使用粗体发光的中文字符，配以金属白金色字体：{argument name="headline text" default="智能体时代：想象定边界，行动决胜负。"}。整体构图应具有前瞻性、商务感、启发性和高端质感，具备超精细的灯光效果、反射湿润的屋顶表面、体积光、清晰对焦、史诗般的规模以及精致的 gpt-image-2 海报美学。

templates.title: Hybrid caching execution flowchart

titleLocalized.zh: 混合缓存执行流程图

templates.prompt: Create a clean, vertical technical workflow infographic with a light gray background, employing a minimalist modern product chart style. Use rounded white cards, thin colored outlines, simple vector line icons, dark blue text, and dark blue connecting arrows. The overall composition is a centered, top-to-bottom flowchart containing 7 numbered main steps, and 2 parallel cache group panels branching from step 4 to step 5. A dark, thick return arrow loops from the bottom to the top on the far left. Use a clean sans-serif font, maintain ample spacing, and use soft, light colors without gradients or shadows to ensure clarity for the presentation slides. Place the step 1 card at the top center with a blue outline and a code/chat icon on the left. Title text: "1."{argument name="step 1 title" default="Chat completion request"} The subtitle is: "conversation_id + cache_salt + new suffix message". Below this is the Step 2 card, with a blue outline and document/list icon. Title: "2. Front-end Conversation Ledger". Subtitle: "Renting Same ID + Tracking Committed Messages". Below this is the Step 3 card, with a cyan outline and a database icon with a magnifying glass. Title: "3. Precise Conversation Cache Lookup". Subtitle: "conversation_id Committed Round Status". Below this is the Step 4 card, with a purple outline and branch scheduler icon. Title: "4. Scheduler Cache Attachment". Subtitle: "Setting num_computed_tokens + Attaching Committed Status". From Step 4, it branches down into two side-by-side group panels. Left group panel: a light green rounded container, titled "Full-attention KV Cache Group". Inside, two inner cards are stacked. The first inner card has a green block grid icon, titled "Committed Block Reference", and subtitled "Shared Aligned Full KV". The first internal card, the second one below, has a green layered paper icon, titled "Tail COW Copy," with the subtitle "Copying Unaligned KV Tail." A small footer is added to the bottom of the green panel: "Paging K/V Tensors for Transformer Layers." The right-hand group panel is a light purple rounded container titled "Mamba Terminal State Cache Group." It contains two stacked internal cards. The first card has a purple database/network icon, titled "Committed Terminal State," with the subtitle "Exact State at Committed Length." The second card below has a purple wavy line icon, titled "Requesting Ownership of Terminal Copy," with the subtitle "Copying SSM + Dialogue State." A small footer is added to the bottom of the purple panel: "Aligned Mode Terminal State Placement." The outputs of the two group panels are merged into the centered Step 5 card, with a blue outline and microchip icon. The title is: "5. Hybrid Model Execution." The subtitle is: "Run Only Uncached Suffixes." At the bottom of this card, two capsule-shaped labels are placed side-by-side: "Transformer Layer" and "Mamba Layer." Step 6 is placed below. Step 1: A card with a blue outline and a glittering icon. Title: "6. Decoding Assistant Token". Subtitle: "Streaming Response Token by Token". Below this is Step 7: A card with a warm yellow-orange outline and a checked database icon. Title: "7. Round of Commit Completion". Subtitle: "Publish Suspended State or Discard on Failure". Add a thick, dark blue looping arrow on the far left, leading from the upper left to Step 1 and back up from Step 7 at the bottom. Loop along this left side, placing stacked comment text near the lower half: "Reuse the committed dialog header on the next request". Add two upward dashed publish arrows from Step 7 toward the cache group panels: a green dashed arrow on the left pointing to the green cache panel, labeled "Publish New State"; and a purple dashed arrow on the right pointing to the purple cache panel, also labeled "Publish New State". Maintain the total number of 7 numbered main cards, 2 cache group panels, 4 internal cache cards, and 2 capsule labels. Maintain a vertical scale similar to the conference slides architecture diagram.

promptLocalized.zh:
创建一个背景为浅灰色的简洁垂直技术工作流信息图，采用极简现代产品图表风格，使用圆角白色卡片、细彩色轮廓、简单的矢量线条图标、深蓝色文本和深蓝色连接箭头。整体构图为居中的自上而下流程图，包含 7 个带编号的主要步骤，以及从第 4 步分支到第 5 步的 2 个并行缓存组面板，最左侧有一个从底部循环回顶部的深色粗返回箭头。使用清晰的无衬线字体，保持充裕的间距，使用柔和的淡色调，无渐变，无阴影，确保演示 Slides 的清晰度。

在顶部中心放置第 1 步卡片，带有蓝色轮廓和左侧的代码/聊天图标。标题文本：“1. {argument name="step 1 title" default="聊天补全请求"}”。副标题：“conversation_id + cache_salt + 新后缀消息”。

下方放置第 2 步卡片，带有蓝色轮廓和文档/列表图标。标题：“2. 前端对话账本”。副标题：“租用相同 ID + 追踪已提交消息”。

下方放置第 3 步卡片，带有青色轮廓和带放大镜的数据库图标。标题：“3. 精确对话缓存查找”。副标题：“conversation_id  已提交轮次状态”。

下方放置第 4 步卡片，带有紫色轮廓和分支调度器图标。标题：“4. 调度器缓存附加”。副标题：“设置 num_computed_tokens + 附加已提交状态”。

从第 4 步向下分支为 2 个并排的组面板。

左侧组面板：一个淡绿色圆角容器，标题为“Full-attention KV 缓存组”。内部堆叠 2 张内部卡片。第一张内部卡片带有绿色块网格图标，标题“已提交块引用”，副标题“共享对齐的完整 KV 块”。下方第二张内部卡片带有绿色分层纸张图标，标题“尾部 COW 拷贝”，副标题“拷贝未对齐的 KV 尾部”。在绿色面板底部添加小字页脚：“用于 Transformer 层的分页 K/V 张量”。

右侧组面板：一个淡紫色圆角容器，标题为“Mamba 终端状态缓存组”。内部堆叠 2 张内部卡片。第一张内部卡片带有紫色数据库/网络图标，标题“已提交终端状态”，副标题“已提交长度下的精确状态”。下方第二张内部卡片带有紫色波浪线图标，标题“请求拥有的终端拷贝”，副标题“拷贝 SSM + 对话状态”。在紫色面板底部添加小字页脚：“对齐模式终端状态放置”。

将两个组面板的输出合并到居中的第 5 步卡片中，带有蓝色轮廓和微芯片图标。标题：“5. 混合模型执行”。副标题：“仅运行未缓存的后缀”。在此卡片底部区域内，并排包含 2 个胶囊状标签：“Transformer 层”和“Mamba 层”。

下方放置第 6 步卡片，带有蓝色轮廓和闪光图标。标题：“6. 解码助手 Token”。副标题：“逐个 Token 流式传输响应”。

下方放置第 7 步卡片，带有暖黄橙色轮廓和带勾选的数据库图标。标题：“7. 提交完成的轮次”。副标题：“发布挂起状态或在失败时丢弃”。

在最左侧添加一个深蓝色粗循环箭头，从左侧上方进入第 1 步，并从底部的第 7 步返回上方。沿此左侧循环，在下半部分附近放置堆叠的注释文本：“下一次请求复用已提交的对话头部”。

从第 7 步向缓存组面板方向添加 2 个向上的虚线发布箭头：左侧一个绿色虚线箭头指向绿色缓存面板，标注“发布新状态”；右侧一个紫色虚线箭头指向紫色缓存面板，同样标注“发布新状态”。

保持 7 张带编号的主卡片、2 个缓存组面板、4 张内部缓存卡片和 2 个胶囊标签的总数不变。保持类似于会议 Slides 架构图的纵向比例。

templates.title: Retro sci-fi "casualty record board" front page

titleLocalized.zh: 复古科幻“伤亡记录台”头版

templates.prompt: A black-and-white sci-fi newspaper front page with a retro-futuristic style, designed like a casualty report announcement, featuring aged paper texture, halftone grain, thin technical border lines, and a slightly worn photocopy feel. The layout is a horizontal single-page print, with a prominent header label at the top displaying {argument name="section label" default="CASUALTY DESK"} On the left third of the page, there is a large, compressed, all-caps, bold, sans-serif heading with the following content:{argument name="headline text" default="TWENTY-FIVE HULLS LOST AS THREE GARRISONS HOLD THEIR LINES"} The text is arranged in five lines. Below are two dense, newspaper-style blocks of text, using narrow columns and small, monospaced or typewriter-style fonts, with a few bolded ship and faction names embedded within. The content should have the feel of a military logistics report from interstellar warfare, mentioning specific times, sectors, casualties, garrisons, probes, tollbooth locations, and damaged ships. The right two-thirds of the page features a detailed monochrome ink illustration: in the upper right sky, a massive wedge-shaped capital ship or dreadnought hovers diagonally from the lower left to the upper right, its hull covered in layers of armor plates, antennas, gantry cranes, and dense structural details. Below, occupying the lower right half, is an industrial checkpoint or garrison gate, spanning a wide road or landing lane, constructed from a brutalist sci-fi framework, vertical towers, gantry cranes, and utility structures, with perspective lines drawing the eye towards the distant center. A small, medium-range aircraft is added near the horizon below the gate. In the background on the far right, there is a group of towering oil refinery-style towers and industrial buildings. A subtle hexagonal grid pattern is overlaid on the upper right and lower right backgrounds, delicately blending into the paper texture. Only grayscale tones, black ink lines, etched conceptual art shadows, and newspaper print contrasts are used. The overall atmosphere is somber, militaristic, archival, and editorial, like a war correspondent's column from a newspaper of a distant future space empire.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张复古未来主义风格的黑白科幻报纸头版，设计为伤亡报告公告样式，具有做旧纸张纹理、半色调颗粒感、纤细的技术边框线条以及略显磨损的复印件质感。布局为横向单页印刷，顶部设有醒目的报头标签，显示为 {argument name="section label" default="CASUALTY DESK"}。页面左侧三分之一处，是一个巨大的压缩全大写粗体无衬线标题，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="TWENTY-FIVE HULLS LOST AS THREE GARRISONS HOLD THEIR LINES"}，分 5 行排列。下方是 2 个密集的报纸风格正文块，采用窄栏排版，使用小型等宽或打字机风格字体，文中嵌入了少量加粗的舰船和派系名称。文章内容应呈现出星际战争中军事后勤报告的质感，提及具体时间、扇区、伤亡人数、驻军、探测器、收费站位置及受损舰船。页面右侧三分之二处为详尽的单色墨水插图：在右上方的天空中，1 艘巨大的楔形主力舰或无畏舰从左下方斜向右上方悬浮，舰身覆盖着层叠的装甲板、天线、龙门架和密集的结构细节。下方占据右下半部分的是 1 个工业检查站或驻军大门，横跨宽阔的道路或着陆车道，由粗野主义科幻框架、垂直塔架、龙门塔和公用设施结构构成，透视线条将视线引向中心远方。在大门下方的地平线附近添加 1 架小型中距离飞行器。在远右侧背景中，包含 1 组高耸的炼油厂式塔楼和工业建筑。在右上和右下背景上叠加淡淡的六边形网格图案，微妙且部分融入纸张纹理中。仅使用灰度色调、黑色墨水线条、蚀刻概念艺术阴影和报纸印刷对比度。整体氛围阴郁、军事化、具有档案感和社论感，如同来自遥远未来太空帝国报纸的战地记者专栏。

templates.title: Epic Yasuo Fantasy Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 史诗级亚索奇幻海报

templates.prompt: A highly dramatic vertical fantasy poster, featuring the main character as {argument name="character name" default="Yasuo"} (From *League of Legends*), depicting him as a solitary wandering swordsman amidst the dark aesthetics of a warring empire. The composition is a unified poster, blending two proportions of the figure: the upper half is a large, panoramic close-up (head and upper body), while the lower half features a full-body image of the hero standing on a stone pedestal. He has long black hair tied in a high samurai bun, strands fluttering wildly in the wind; his face is resolute, and he wears layered samurai armor in deep navy blue, charcoal gray, and black, adorned with ornate gold trim. His tattered cloak and waistband billow to the right, and he holds a downward-sloping, gleaming samurai sword in his right hand. A bright golden wind-powered ribbon spirals upward from the figure below, passing through the center of the image and connecting with the large portrait above, accompanied by countless ember-like sparks and luminous brushstrokes. The background is a grand military scene, showing two battle banners, rows of soldiers, and a multi-tiered pagoda-like fortress city shrouded in smoke in the distance. The color palette features melancholic midnight blue, ashen gray, black, and warm metallic gold, employing cinematic high-contrast lighting and detail reminiscent of concept art, with ink-splash textures at the edges, creating a mythical, solemn, and epic atmosphere. Stylized vertical Chinese calligraphy flanks the design: the right side features three stacked text elements—"疾风剑豪" (The Wind Swordsman), a large "Yasuo," and a smaller vertical "YASUO"; the left side displays a vertical quote, "Death is like the wind, always by my side." At the bottom are three lines of large serif gold titles: "YASUO," "THE UNFORGIVEN," and "LEAGUE OF LEGENDS." Overall, the design presents a high-end character poster effect, with ultra-high detail, dynamic wind effects, glowing particles, heroic poses, and a fusion of dark fantasy and martial arts styles.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧张力的竖版奇幻海报，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="Yasuo"}（来自《英雄联盟》），将其描绘为一名身处暗黑帝国战争美学背景下的孤独流浪剑客。构图为一张统一的海报，融合了两种比例的人物形象：上半部分为占据画面的巨幅半侧面特写（头部及上半身），下半部分中央为站在石座上的全身英雄形象。他留着黑色长发，扎成高高的武士发髻，发丝在风中凌乱飘动；面容坚毅，身着深海军蓝、炭灰与黑色叠层武士盔甲，饰有华丽的金边。他那破旧的长斗篷和腰布向右飘动，右手持一把向下倾斜的闪光武士刀。一道明亮的金色风能丝带从下方人物处向上盘旋，穿过画面中心，与上方的大幅肖像相连，伴随着无数余烬般的火星和发光的笔触轨迹。背景是宏大的军队场景，可见 2 面战旗、成排的士兵，以及远方隐没在烟雾中的多层宝塔式要塞城市。色调为忧郁的午夜蓝、灰烬灰、黑色与温暖的金属金，采用电影级高对比度光影，具备概念艺术的绘画细节，边缘带有水墨飞溅质感，营造出神话般、庄重且史诗的氛围。两侧包含风格化的竖排中文书法：右侧为 3 个堆叠的文本元素，分别为“疾风剑豪”、大号“亚索”以及小号竖排“YASUO”；左侧为 1 句竖排引言“死亡如风，常伴吾身。”底部添加 3 行大号衬线字体金色标题：“YASUO”、“THE UNFORGIVEN”以及“LEAGUE OF LEGENDS”。整体呈现高端角色主视觉海报效果，超高细节，动态风感，发光粒子，英雄姿态，暗黑奇幻与武侠武士风格的融合。

templates.title: clumsy doodle cat line drawing

titleLocalized.zh: 笨拙涂鸦猫咪简笔画

templates.prompt: A deliberately clumsy and childlike digital doodle depicting a creature named{argument name="character name" default="Shiro"} The image features a cheerful cat in a chaotic graffiti meme style against a pure white background. The cat is positioned in the center, playfully leaping and stretching, facing right. It has a rounded white body, short legs, oversized paws, a curved, upright tail, triangular ears with pale pink inner ears, closed, smiling eyes, a small pink nose, black whiskers, and a simple cartoon mouth. A bright red collar adorns the cat, with a round yellow name tag bearing handwritten black letters that read {argument name="tag text" default="SHIRO"} The deliberately imperfect black outlines and uneven proportions create a naive, hand-drawn feel, as if quickly sketched in drawing software. Behind the cat, a huge circular tornado is added.{argument name="main swirl color" default="Bright green"} and{argument name="secondary swirl color" default="Lime Green"} Composed of numerous overlapping brushstrokes with scattered white oval gaps, and embedded around the swirls are six short, curved red accent brushstrokes. The overall feel is cute, quirky, chaotic, and fun, like a viral, clumsy repaint trend, using flat color schemes, no shadows, and rough, freehand brushstrokes.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅刻意笨拙、充满童趣的数字涂鸦，画的是一只名叫 {argument name="character name" default="Shiro"} 的快乐猫咪，采用混乱的涂鸦模因风格，背景为纯白色。猫咪位于画面中心，呈现出俏皮的跳跃伸展姿态，面向右侧，拥有圆润的白色身体、短腿、超大的爪子、弯曲竖起的尾巴、带有淡粉色内耳的三角形耳朵、闭着微笑的眼睛、小巧的粉色鼻子、黑色胡须以及简单的卡通嘴巴。给猫咪戴上一条鲜红色的项圈，上面挂着一个圆形的黄色名牌，用手写体黑色字母写着 {argument name="tag text" default="SHIRO"}。使用刻意不完美的黑色轮廓、不均匀的比例，呈现出如同在绘图软件中快速绘制的稚拙手绘感。在猫咪身后，添加一个巨大的圆形龙卷风，由 {argument name="main swirl color" default="亮绿色"} 和 {argument name="secondary swirl color" default="酸橙绿"} 的许多重叠笔触组成，带有零星的白色椭圆形空隙，并在漩涡周围嵌入了 6 条短而弯曲的红色强调笔触。整体感觉可爱、搞怪、混乱且充满趣味，如同病毒式传播的笨拙重绘潮流，采用平涂配色，无阴影，线条为粗糙的徒手笔触。

templates.title: Low-angle selfie at the Eiffel Tower

titleLocalized.zh: 埃菲尔铁塔低角度自拍

templates.prompt: A hyper-realistic travel selfie taken from a low angle directly beneath the Eiffel Tower in Paris. The background is a bright, cloudless sunny day, with the towering tower overhead, creating a perfect vertical symmetry with the azure sky. In the foreground, a person with {argument name="hair color" default="Medium brown"} A young woman with medium-length straight hair is very close to the camera, her phone positioned below her chest, taking a selfie from a low angle. Her expression is natural and relaxed, giving off a casual, vacation vibe. She is wearing {argument name="top color" default="light pink"} A fitted ribbed strapless top, paired with{argument name="bottom color" default="White"} High-waisted jeans and two delicate silver necklaces. Her skin appears warm in the strong midday sun, the Eiffel Tower structure casting clear, natural shadows, and subtle highlights on her shoulders and collarbone. The composition extends from mid-thigh to head, with one arm naturally outstretched towards the camera, presenting a natural selfie pose. templates.title: Chaotic MS Paint Sticker Emoji Set

titleLocalized.zh: Chaotic MS Paint Sticker Emoji Set

templates.prompt:
Task Objective:
Generate a set of 16 chat-style sticker emojis based on the reference images. The result should feel expressive, highly shareable, and stylistically unified — but intentionally chaotic, low-quality, and humorous.

The final output should look like:
Someone who cannot draw, using a mouse in MS Paint, randomly doodling and writing text at the same time — messy, awkward, low-effort, but unexpectedly funny.

————————
Input Structure:

Image 1: Character reference (may include one or multiple subjects such as people, pets, or combinations)
Image 2: Layout reference (only for understanding the 4x4 grid structure, not style)

User Inputs:
- Text content (multiple lines, any language, may be fewer or more than 16)

————————
Character Usage Rules:

- Identify all possible subjects in Image 1 (people, animals, etc.)
- Each subject can act as a main character
- Different stickers can feature different characters
- Some stickers may include multiple characters interacting
- Distribution should feel natural and context-driven

————————
Consistency Definition (Critical Redefinition):

This task prioritizes “consistent imperfection”, NOT realistic consistency.

The same character across stickers:
Does NOT need to look identical,
but must feel like it was drawn by the same unskilled person.

Must be consistent in:
- Drawing behavior (same clumsy hand)
- Simplification logic
- Error patterns (crooked proportions, shaky lines)
- Overall messiness level

Allowed:
- Facial distortion
- Proportion inconsistency
- Structural errors
- Missing details

Must retain:
- Minimal recognizable traits (e.g. silhouette, color, signature features)

Summary:
Consistency = “wrong in the same way”, not “accurate likeness”

————————
Layout & Structure:

- 16 stickers total, arranged in a 4x4 grid
- Each sticker is an independent frame
- Can feature single or multiple characters
- Individual frames can be messy
- Overall grid must remain clear and readable

————————
Text System (Core Expression Layer):

User provides multiple lines of text:

Quantity Handling:
- If fewer than 16 → automatically complete to 16
- If more than 16 → select the most expressive 16

Language Rule:
- Use the same language as the user input
- Do NOT enforce any specific language

Completion Rules:
- Maintain tone consistency (sarcastic, lazy, emotional, clingy, absurd, etc.)
- Prefer internet-style expressions
- Short phrases preferred, but longer lines allowed
- Avoid repetition

Expression Goals:
- Instantly understandable
- Emotionally strong
- Feels like real meme text

Tone Priority:
- Complaints
- Self-talk
- Emotional bursts
- Indifference / annoyance / absurd humor

Avoid:
- Polite responses
- Formal or structured phrasing

————————
Text-Image Integration (Critical):

Text must be DRAWN, not typeset.

Must:
- Look like mouse handwriting (crooked, shaky, uneven size)
- Be messy (tilted, overlapping, misaligned)
- Have inconsistent spacing
- Be placed freely (on face, beside, edges, etc.)

Allowed:
- Repeated letters (aaaaa)
- Stretched words (soooo tired)
- Random punctuation (????!!!)
- Messy or ugly writing

Must:
- Remain readable
- Not block understanding

————————
Expression Generation Mechanism (Most Important):

Simulate this process:

“A person who cannot draw, using a mouse, doodling randomly while writing text at the same time.”

Key Rules:
- Image and text must come from the SAME moment
- Not: draw first, then add text
- But: draw and write simultaneously

Each sticker should feel like:
- Random doodle
- Then spontaneous writing
- Or both happening together

Should feel:
- Unplanned
- Careless
- Immediate

————————
Text-Image Relationship:

Text and visuals should form:
- Commentary
- Emotional amplification
- Self-talk
- Or slightly mismatched humor

Allowed:
- Loose or imperfect alignment
- Absurd or off-topic humor

Goal:
Not accuracy, but humor

————————
Aesthetic DNA (Core Style Driver):

Style origin:
Terrible MS Paint doodles + failed imitation + extremely low drawing skill

Visual Traits:

Lines:
- Shaky, unstable, jagged
- Mouse-drawn look

Forms:
- Bad proportions
- Stick figures or crude shapes
- Distorted structures

Details:
- Minimal or none
- “Cannot draw” feeling

Texture:
- Pixelated
- Rough edges

Composition:
- Frames can be messy
- Grid must stay readable

Emotion:
- Awkward, direct, absurd, funny

Resemblance:
- Only vaguely resembles the original
- Like a failed copy

————————
Style Enforcement (Critical):

When conflict occurs:

Realism vs Style → ALWAYS choose Style

Allowed to break:
- Detail
- Proportion
- Accuracy
- Cleanliness

Strictly forbid:
- Clean lines
- Correct anatomy
- Polished visuals
- Designed aesthetics

Rule:
If it looks “good”, it is WRONG.

Force it back to messy, ugly, low-effort.

————————
Anti-Template & Randomization System (Critical):

Strictly forbid:
- Numbering (1, 2, 3…)
- List-style output
- Sequential planning

Must treat all 16 stickers as:
“16 independent, random expressions”

Randomness Requirements:

- Vary text length
- Vary tone and emotion
- Some complete, some fragmented
- Some minimal or almost empty

Avoid:
- Repetition
- Predictable phrasing
- Common default responses

Allow:
- Abrupt or weird expressions
- Uneven density
- Inconsistent structure

Generation Method:

Do NOT plan all 16.

Instead simulate:
“16 separate spontaneous moments”

Must include:
- Emotional fluctuation
- Instability
- Randomness

Anti-reuse rule:

Each generation must:
- Avoid repeating previous outputs
- Avoid fixed patterns
- Feel freshly created

————————
Sticker Requirements:

- Each sticker visually distinct
- Clear emotional signal
- Usable in chat
- Strong expressive power

————————
Final Goal:

Generate 16 stickers.

The result must feel like:

“A person who cannot draw used a mouse to doodle 16 times,
randomly writing emotional thoughts each time —
messy, inconsistent, but unexpectedly funny.”

NOT:

“A clean, well-designed AI sticker set”

templates.prompt: Recreate the given image as a crayon-style illustration, giving the impression of a 10-year-old's hand-drawn artwork. templates.prompt: Q-version (cute) avatar photo prompt (based on uploaded female portrait): Use an uploaded photo of a young woman as a base. Do not add any new characters. Transform the existing subject into a Q-version journal-style composition while fully preserving their real identity, facial features, hairstyle, etc.{argument name="hair color" default="Long, smooth brown hair"} Natural makeup{argument name="outfit tone" default="Black clothing"} Posture, lighting, and a comfortable interior atmosphere. [Scene Inspection] The scene should reflect {argument name="mood" default="Comfortable lifestyle / Selfies / Workspace atmosphere"} The space is complemented by soft lighting, aesthetically pleasing interior elements, inspirational neon signs, and laptop desktop setups. The overall atmosphere maintains a calm, stylish, and slightly efficient lifestyle feel. [Q Version Characters] Add 5–8 identical Q version mini-characters of girls: - Same long, smooth brown hair (slightly wavy) - Same clothing color scheme (black top) - Same gentle, confident expression style: - Kawaii Q version sticker style - Big head, small body proportion - Lively and cute expression - Soft pastel shadows - Clear, high-quality sticker texture [Q Version Actions – No Repetition] - Holding a coffee - Using a laptop - Taking a selfie - Relaxed leaning pose - Making a peace sign - Thinking pose - Stretching/relaxing pose - Smiling and waving [Sticker Placement] - Place the Q version characters only on the edges and blank areas - Do not obscure the main face or body - Add white outline + soft shadow - Create a slightly floating sticker effect [Doodles] Add exquisite journal-style doodles: - Hearts, glitter, stars, arrows - Aesthetic lines and circles - Soft glowing accents Palette: White + warm yellow + soft pink (echoing the neon atmosphere) [Handwritten Text] Add 5–8 short, aesthetically pleasing phrases: - "just me" - "soft life" - "stay cozy" - "little moments" - "focus mode" - "good vibes only" - "create & grow" - "be you" Style: - Handwritten font - White text with a soft halo - Pink/yellow highlights [Composition] - Center focus: Real girl (keep it as is) - Surrounded by Q-version stickers + doodles + text - Keep the layout balanced, neat, and uncluttered [Style Keywords] Realistic photo + Q-version stickers, kawaii aesthetics, comfortable lifestyle, warm light, journaling, soft light, high detail, Instagram aesthetic [Final Output] A refined, high-quality, social media-ready journal-style image combining: Realistic subject + cute Q-version extensions + aesthetic doodles [Avoid] - Altering facial features - Over-beautifying or AI-distorted faces - Cluttered composition - Irrelevant/random elements - Obscuring the subject

promptLocalized.zh:
Q 版头像手账风格照片提示词（基于上传的女性人像）

以上传的年轻女性照片为基础。请勿添加任何新人物。将现有主体转化为 Q 版手账风格构图，同时完整保留其真实身份、面部特征、发型、{argument name="hair color" default="长而柔顺的棕色头发"}、自然妆容、{argument name="outfit tone" default="黑色服装"}、姿势、光影以及舒适的室内氛围。

[场景检测]
场景应体现 {argument name="mood" default="舒适生活方式 / 自拍 / 工作空间氛围"}，配以柔和的灯光、美学室内元素、励志霓虹灯牌和笔记本电脑桌面布置。全程保持冷静、时尚且略带高效的生活方式氛围。

[Q 版形象]
添加 5–8 个相同女孩的 Q 版迷你形象：
- 相同的长而柔顺的棕色头发（微卷）
- 相同的服装色调（黑色上衣）
- 相同的温柔、自信表情

风格：
- 卡哇伊 Q 版贴纸风格
- 大头小身的比例
- 表情生动可爱
- 柔和的粉彩阴影
- 清晰、高质量的贴纸质感

[Q 版动作 – 不重复]
- 手持咖啡
- 使用笔记本电脑
- 自拍
- 放松的倚靠姿势
- 比耶手势
- 思考姿势
- 拉伸 / 放松姿势
- 微笑并挥手

[贴纸放置]
- 仅将 Q 版形象放置在边缘和空白区域
- 请勿遮挡主体面部或身体
- 添加白色描边 + 柔和投影
- 呈现轻微的浮动贴纸效果

[涂鸦]
添加精致的手账风格涂鸦：
- 爱心、闪光、星星、箭头
- 美学线条和圆圈
- 柔和的发光点缀

调色板：
白色 + 暖黄色 + 柔粉色（与霓虹灯氛围相呼应）

[手写文字]
添加 5–8 个简短的美学短语：
- "just me "
- "soft life"
- "stay cozy"
- "little moments"
- "focus mode"
- "good vibes only"
- "create & grow"
- "be you "

风格：
- 手写字体
- 带柔和光晕的白色文字
- 粉色/黄色局部高光

[构图]
- 中心焦点：真实女孩（保持不变）
- 周围环绕 Q 版贴纸 + 涂鸦 + 文字
- 保持布局平衡、整洁，不杂乱

[风格关键词]
写实照片 + Q 版贴纸，卡哇伊美学，舒适生活方式，暖光，手账日记，柔光，高细节，Instagram 美学

[最终输出]
一张精致、高质量、适合社交媒体发布的手账风格图片，结合了：
写实主体 + 可爱 Q 版延伸 + 美学涂鸦

[避免]
- 改变面部特征
- 过度美化或 AI 面部扭曲
- 构图杂乱
- 无关/随机元素
- 遮挡主体

The image uses a dynamic, low-angle, cinematic composition; her body is slightly twisted, presenting a {argument name="smartphone model" default="Xiaomi 17 Pro"} The smartphone extends towards the camera lens, creating a strong visual impact, with the phone dominating the foreground. The phone features a matte metallic lavender purple body with a minimalist design and rounded corners, housing a large rectangular camera module. The left side of the module contains two large lenses, while the right side features a circular secondary screen displaying a minimalist purple gradient clock UI. The Leica logo is printed next to the camera, accompanied by a simple flash strip, and a refined brand logo at the bottom. Clothing: A fitted long-sleeved cropped top in a soft lavender purple hue, paired with high-waisted grey-olive cargo pants, showcasing modern technological fashion aesthetics. Controlled highlights around the phone's edges, clear reflections on the lens and screen, and minimal shadows, presenting a high-end product photography style. Futuristic UI Overlay: Slender white/purple lines and nodes point to product features, accompanied by floating labels: "Leica Camera System," "Secondary Display Integration," and "Ultra-Slim Premium Design." A frosted glass panel in the lower left corner lists: "Flagship Performance," "Advanced AI Imaging," "Fast Charging," and "Next-Gen AI." promptLocalized.zh: 超写实高端智能手机广告，主角是一位 20 出头、肤色白皙、五官立体且自信的年轻女性，佩戴着时髦的黑色猫眼太阳镜。她留着浓密的长辫子，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="柔和的薰衣草紫"}，与产品主题相呼应。画面采用动态的低角度电影感构图，她身体微微扭转，将一部 {argument name="smartphone model" default="Xiaomi 17 Pro"} 智能手机伸向镜头，形成强烈的视觉冲击，手机占据前景主体。手机采用哑光金属薰衣草紫色机身，外观极简，边角圆润，配有大型矩形摄像头模组。模组左侧包含两个大尺寸镜头，右侧为圆形副屏，显示极简的紫色渐变时钟 UI，摄像头旁印有 Leica 标识，配有简洁的闪光灯条，底部有精致的品牌 Logo。服装：修身长袖短款上衣，色调为柔和的薰衣草紫，搭配高腰灰橄榄色工装裤，展现现代科技时尚美学。背景：从浅灰到柔和薰衣草紫的极简渐变，背景中带有模糊处理的大型字体以增加深度。灯光：柔和的影棚灯光，色调中性偏冷，皮肤光泽细腻，手机边缘有受控的高光，镜头和屏幕上有通透的反射，阴影极少，呈现高端产品摄影风格。构图：低角度拍摄以营造力量感，主体位于画面左侧，手机占据右侧前景，留出充足的负空间用于品牌展示。未来感 UI 覆盖层：纤细的白色/紫色线条和节点指向产品特性，配有悬浮标签：“Leica Camera System”（徕卡影像系统）、“Secondary Display Integration”（副屏集成）、“Ultra-Slim Premium Design”（超薄高端设计）。左下角设有毛玻璃效果面板，列出：“Flagship Performance”（旗舰性能）、“Advanced AI Imaging”（先进 AI 影像）、“Fast Charging”（快速充电）、“Next-Gen AI”（下一代 AI）。顶部角落文字：“Xiaomi 17 Pro”，采用简洁现代的无衬线字体。风格：高端旗舰智能手机广告，未来感，极简，优雅。画质：8K，超精细，焦点清晰，HDR，电影级商业摄影，纹理真实。

templates.prompt: Japanese negative film aesthetics, city at night.{argument name="location" default="Tokyo streets near Shibuya Crossing"} The soft neon glow intertwines with the cool-toned streetlights, with slight highlight overflow, low contrast, softly faded colors, delicate graininess, imperfect exposure, and a realistic, candid feel. A stunningly beautiful young woman, exuding a subtle sensuality, natural body lines, effortless charm, and a slightly mysterious urban atmosphere. Clothing:{argument name="clothing" default="A fitted tank top or cropped camisole, layered with an oversized blazer that slips off one shoulder."} High-waisted denim shorts or a short skirt, a thin belt, a small shoulder bag, the look slightly messy, as if she had just spent a long night. Hair and makeup: slightly messy natural black or dark brown hair, a few strands falling across her cheeks, dewy skin with a slight glow, smudged eyeliner, soft reddish-brown eyeshadow, natural shimmering lip makeup, the makeup slightly worn. Scene: an alley next to the Shibuya intersection, the damp ground reflecting neon signs and the headlights of passing vehicles, the lights of a convenience store flashing in the background, blurry pedestrians and taxis stretched into light trails. Moment: she was walking very fast, but suddenly slowed down—as if she had just seen something unexpected. The person who hadn't arrived, or perhaps heard a sound behind them; their movements hadn't completely stopped, capturing that moment of hesitation: the body slightly turned but not fully facing the light source, the shoulders uneven as the suit jacket slipped further down, one foot still raised, creating tension between movement and stillness; the hands: one hand loosely holding the phone, the screen still lit; the other hand near the collarbone, fingers gently pressing, as if searching for support; the expression: unfocused but not empty eyes—a subtle blend of searching and wariness, a flicker of emotion (surprise or recognition of someone); lips slightly parted, as if wanting to speak but then stopping themselves; light and shadow:{argument name="lighting style" default="Mixed Light and Shadow – Cool-toned Streetlights and Warm-toned Convenience Store Lights"} Occasionally, strong direct flashes of light hit the face, flattening the depth of field, while the background is enveloped in a silky motion blur. Composition: A slightly off-center composition, the subject is not entirely sharp, with slight motion blur at the edges, and the contrast of movement in the background is exaggerated. Atmosphere: A fleeting, interrupted moment, something is about to happen but hasn't yet—a quiet urban loneliness intertwined with tension, "the moment before the story begins," cinematic, nostalgic, a subtle sensibility revealed from fragility rather than deliberate intent. -- 2:3

templates.title: Inflatable surrealistic product poster

titleLocalized.zh: 充气感超现实主义产品海报

templates.prompt: Design a product poster with a 4:5 aspect ratio to showcase a product.{argument name="fruit" default="orange"} "A 3D juice bottle. Using a whimsical, surrealist style reminiscent of inflatable plastic packaging, the bottle is given a dynamic, squeezed-toy-like appearance. The poster should convey the juice's freshness, tension, and tangible freshness through the obvious expansion, stretching, and compression of the bottle, as if the bottle is being squeezed from the inside. Subject: A bottle is positioned in the center of the left side of the image, rendered in a semi-3D stylized (non-realistic) manner. The bottle exhibits obvious deformation—expanding outwards in the middle and slightly compressing the neck, as if the pressure of the juice inside is squeezing the container walls. The internal liquid intensifies this effect, forming rounded convex surfaces that cling tightly to the plastic walls. The cap is slightly tilted due to pressure. The bottle appears elastic and vibrant, rather than rigid and inflexible. Composition:" The core mechanism of the composition is "internal pressure deformation." The eye enters from the most bulging part of the bottle (the central bulge), then moves along the curved tension line to the right, stretching the layout. The camera uses a slightly upward close-up perspective with a slight fisheye distortion, enhancing the sense of pressure and expansion. The bottle extends diagonally into the frame, as if resisting some invisible resistance. The blank area on the right is deliberately stretched and distorted, echoing the deformation of the bottle. Layout: Title:{argument name="headline" default="SQUEEZE BACK"} The title uses a thick, rounded, inflatable font to mimic the effect of inflated plastic. The font itself undergoes physical deformation—letters near the bottle are stretched horizontally and compressed towards the edges, as if subjected to the same pressure. The title is located on the right side of the bottle and partially covers the bulging edge. The subtitle, "Juice that pushes back," uses a narrow sans-serif font, straight and hard, contrasting with the soft title. Small, round micro-text labels (such as "100% Organic," "No Added Sugar") are like printed stickers, slightly deformed due to surface tension. Lighting/Graphics: Soft studio lighting suitable for stylized rendering is used—creating broad diffused highlights on curved surfaces and subtle mirror-like stripes that conform to deformation. Realistic reflections are not pursued; only controlled, simplified light bands are retained to emphasize volume and elasticity. Color: The "orange" juice bottle color and 3D title text. Sticker elements are used to accent "bright lime green." The glowing orange contrasts sharply with the dark background. Background: A smooth, dark gradient background with subtle, radiating tension lines spreading outwards from the bottle, like invisible pressure waves. There are no cluttered textures; the space is simple yet full of dynamic distortion. Style: Neo-Pop Surrealist product illustration, blending the logic of inflatable materials, playful deformation, and a striking commercial clarity. Texture: Soft, plastic-like rendering with sharp edges, smooth gradient transitions, no noise or graininess, and a polished finish.

promptLocalized.zh:
设计一张比例为“4:5”的产品海报，展示一款“{argument name="fruit" default="橙子"}”果汁的 3D 瓶身。采用趣味十足的充气塑料包装超现实主义风格，让瓶子呈现出被挤压玩具般的动态感。海报应通过瓶身明显的膨胀、拉伸和压缩效果，传达出果汁的鲜活感、张力以及触手可及的新鲜感，仿佛瓶子正从内部被挤压。

主体：
画面左侧中心位置为一个瓶子，采用半 3D 风格化表现（非写实）。瓶身呈现明显的变形——中段向外膨胀，瓶颈略微压缩，仿佛内部果汁的压力正在挤压容器壁。内部液体加剧了这种效果，形成圆润的凸面，紧贴着塑料壁。瓶盖因压力而略微倾斜。瓶子看起来富有弹性、充满活力，而非坚硬死板。

构图：
构图的核心机制是“内部压力变形”。视线从瓶身最膨胀的部分（中心凸起）进入，随后沿着弯曲的张力线向右侧拉伸的排版移动。镜头采用略微仰视的特写视角，并带有轻微的鱼眼畸变，增强了压力感和扩张感。瓶子斜向伸入画面，仿佛正在对抗某种无形的阻力。右侧的留白区域经过刻意的拉伸和扭曲，与瓶身的变形相呼应。

排版：
标题：“{argument name="headline" default="SQUEEZE BACK"}”，采用厚实、圆润、充气感的字体，模仿充气塑料的效果。字体本身发生了物理变形——靠近瓶身处的字母水平拉伸，向边缘处则被压缩，仿佛受到了同样的压力作用。标题位于瓶身右侧，并部分覆盖了瓶身的膨胀边缘。副标题：“Juice that pushes back.”（果汁，反向回弹），采用窄体无衬线字体，笔直且坚硬，与柔软的标题形成对比。小圆形的微文案标签（例如“100% 有机”、“无添加糖”）如同印刷贴纸，因表面张力而略微变形。

光影 / 图形处理：
采用适用于风格化渲染的柔和摄影棚灯光——在曲面上呈现宽广的漫反射高光，以及顺应变形的细微镜面条纹。不追求写实反射，仅保留受控的、简化的光带，以强调体积感和弹性。

色彩：
“橙色”果汁瓶身颜色及 3D 标题文字。贴纸元素点缀“亮青柠绿”。发光的橙色与深色背景形成强烈对比。

背景：
平滑的深色渐变背景，带有从瓶身向外扩散的细微放射状张力线，如同无形的压力波。没有杂乱的纹理，空间简洁但充满动态扭曲感。

风格：
新波普超现实主义产品插画，融合充气材质逻辑、趣味变形以及极具冲击力的商业清晰度。

质感：
柔和的类塑料渲染，边缘清晰，渐变过渡平滑，无噪点或颗粒感，抛光处理。

templates.title: Hand-drawn storyboard preview sketches

titleLocalized.zh: 手绘故事板预演草图

templates.prompt: Create a rough, hand-drawn PREVIS + rescue chase storyboard page in a 16:9 landscape format. Use an extremely simple 2D pre-draft sketch style: - Stick figure/human silhouette only - No facial details, no clothing details, no anatomical details - No textures, no shadows, no detailed rendering - Loose black sketch lines - Red boxes are only for camera framing - Blue arrows are only for indicating movement/strength/breathing/direction - Rough director's thumbnails, not concept art - Keep it as simple as possible if you're unsure; don't add details. Display 8 numbered panels on one page, arranged slightly irregularly but clearly and legibly. Main body:{argument name="subject" default="Two best friends race on skateboards in the sky above the clouds."} environment:{argument name="environment" default="A bright, open sky, fluffy cloud paths, drifting clouds, distant sunlight, followed by a dark storm cloud region with wind, rain, and lightning."} Atmosphere: Playful, adventurous, fast-paced, fun, with moments of suspense, then exhilarating and triumphant. Sequence: In a fun cloud skateboarding race, one friend accidentally drifts into a dangerous storm cloud and loses control, followed by a last-minute rescue by another. Rhythm Points: 1. Wide-angle setup shot. Two friends skateboard side-by-side above the clouds, playfully racing in the sky. 2. Side tracking shot. The race accelerates. One friend leans forward and takes a slight lead, the other close behind. 3. 3/4 front side view. The leading friend, focused on the race, accidentally veers into a dark storm cloud area ahead. 4. Overhead shot. The storm cloud engulfs the leading friend. Strong wind arrows, rain, and lightning. The skateboard shakes violently. 5. Close-up/medium shot action shot. The second friend senses the danger, slams on the brakes, then veers and rushes into the storm. 6. Dynamic low-angle shot. A rescuer on a skateboard rushes into the storm cloud, reaching out through wind, rain, and lightning to grab a trapped friend. 7. Hero Side Shot. A last-minute rescue. The rescuer grabs another friend's arm or hoodie, pulling them out of the storm cloud just as lightning strikes behind them. 8. Wide-Angle Ending Shot. The two friends rush back into the sunny clouds, regain their balance, and continue skating side-by-side, laughing as they continue their race. Use a variety of camera angles: close-up, wide-angle, low angle, overhead, side profile, rear, 3/4 perspective. Add brief handwritten notes near the panels. Maintain clear coherence between subjects, props, environment, and direction of movement. Focus on staging, camera, movement, timing, and coherence. Prioritize readability over drawing quality. Avoid elaborate illustrations, sleek UIs, and infographic designs. Target Tone: Fun, family-friendly animation energy, clear visual storytelling, and a simple, easy-to-read action rhythm.

promptLocalized.zh:
创建一个 16:9 横向格式的粗略手绘 PREVIS + 救援追逐故事板页面。

使用极其简单的 2D 预演草图风格：
- 仅限火柴人 / 人体模型剪影
- 无面部细节，无服装细节，无解剖细节
- 无纹理，无阴影，无精细渲染
- 黑色松散的草图线条
- 红色方框仅用于摄像机取景
- 蓝色箭头仅用于表示运动 / 力量 / 呼吸 / 方向
- 粗略的导演缩略图，而非概念艺术
- 如果不确定，画得越简单越好，不要增加细节

在一页纸上展示 8 个编号面板，排列略显不规则但清晰易读。

主体：{argument name="subject" default="两个好朋友在云端之上的天空中踩着滑板竞速"}
环境：{argument name="environment" default="明亮开阔的天空，蓬松的云朵路径，漂浮的云层，远处的阳光，随后进入带有风、雨和闪电的黑暗风暴云区"}
氛围：俏皮、冒险、快速、有趣、片刻悬疑，随后变得振奋人心且充满胜利感
序列：在一次有趣的云端滑板比赛中，一位朋友意外漂移进入危险的风暴云中并失去控制，随后另一位朋友进行了千钧一发的救援

节奏点：
1. 广角建立镜头。两个朋友踩着滑板在云端之上并排滑行，在天空中俏皮地竞速。
2. 侧向跟踪镜头。比赛加速。一位朋友向前倾身并取得微弱领先，另一位紧随其后。
3. 3/4 前侧视角。领先的朋友在专注于比赛时，意外转向前方黑暗的风暴云区域。
4. 俯拍镜头。风暴云吞没了领先的朋友。强风箭头、雨水和闪电。滑板剧烈晃动。
5. 特写 / 中景动作镜头。第二位朋友察觉到危险，刹那间猛踩刹车，随后转向并冲向风暴。
6. 动态低角度镜头。救援者踩着滑板冲入风暴云中，在风雨和闪电中向前伸出手，试图抓住被困的朋友。
7. 英雄侧拍镜头。千钧一发的救援。救援者抓住另一位朋友的手臂或连帽衫，在闪电击中身后的瞬间将他们从风暴云中拉出。
8. 广角结局镜头。两个朋友重新冲回阳光明媚的云层，恢复平衡，继续并排滑行并大笑着继续比赛。

使用多样的摄像机角度：特写、广角、低角度、俯拍、侧面轮廓、后方、3/4 视角。
在面板附近添加简短的手写注释。
保持主体、道具、环境和运动方向的清晰连贯性。

专注于调度、摄像机、运动、时机和连贯性。
优先考虑可读性而非绘画质量。
避免精细的插图、整洁的 UI 和信息图表设计。

目标基调：有趣的家庭动画活力，清晰的视觉叙事，简单易读的动作节奏
