templates.title: Spherical character meme template

titleLocalized.zh: 球形角色模因模板

templates.prompt: Stylized 3D characters based on a fixed meme template. Priority order: 1. Accurate spherical body (most important) 2. Identity feature similarity 3. Visual refinement Base model (absolutely locked): - A perfect spherical body (completely undistorted) - No torso, no waist, no flattening - The outline must always appear as: "a sphere with slender limbs" - Slender, simple limbs directly attached to the sphere - Neutral standing pose, arms hanging naturally - The body must look completely consistent in all outputs - Use the same repeating 3D model every time. If the character looks humanoid instead of spherical, it's an error. --- Identity Mapping: Map the provided character onto this spherical body: - Place facial features directly on the sphere - Preserve: - Eye shape, size, spacing, and expression - Eyebrows and demeanor - Add a simple mouth if necessary - Add key identity elements: - Hair (wrapped around the sphere) - Hat (must be worn naturally on top of the sphere) - Accessories (glasses, etc.) - Colors and patterns - The character must be instantly recognizable - This is not a redesign: → It should look like the same character crammed into this body --- Clothing Mapping (Key): - The body must maintain a perfect spherical shape - Clothing must never alter the body shape - Clothing is applied as a surface layer on the sphere - Concept: Like drawing, printing, or slight embossing on the sphere --- Style: - Smooth, matte plastic material - Simple, minimalist geometry - Pixar/vinyl toy-like style - Soft reflections --- Scene:{argument name="background" default="A cozy children's bedroom"} : - Wooden floors - Bed with striped blankets - Children's drawings on the wall - Warm ambient lighting - Soft depth of field --- Rendering: - High-quality 3D rendering (Blender/Octane style) - Cinematic lighting - Global illumination - 50mm lens - Sharp character focus - Soft shadows - 4K resolution --- Final Intent: The result should look like a meme: The exact same spherical Mike Wazowski-esque body, with different characters awkwardly and humorously projected onto it. Everything must conform to the spherical body. Nothing can cover this sphere.

promptLocalized.zh:
基于固定模因模板的风格化 3D 角色。

优先级顺序：
1. 精确的球形身体（最重要）
2. 身份特征相似度
3. 视觉精致度

基础模型（绝对锁定）：

- 一个完美的球体身体（完全没有变形）
- 无躯干、无腰部、无扁平化处理
- 轮廓必须始终呈现为：“一个带有细长四肢的球体”
- 细长、简单的四肢直接连接在球体上
- 中性站立姿势，手臂自然下垂

- 身体在所有输出中必须看起来完全一致
- 每次都使用相同的重复 3D 模型

如果角色看起来像人形而不是球形，则为错误。

---

身份映射：

将提供的角色映射到这个球形身体上：

- 将面部特征直接放置在球体上
- 保留：
- 眼睛的形状、大小、间距、表情
- 眉毛和神态
- 必要时添加简单的嘴巴

- 添加关键的身份元素：
- 头发（包裹在球体周围）
- 帽子（必须自然地戴在球体顶部）
- 配饰（眼镜等）
- 颜色和图案

- 角色必须一眼就能被认出来

- 这不是重新设计：
→ 它看起来应该是同一个角色被强行塞进了这个身体里

---

服装映射（关键）：

- 身体必须保持完美的球形
- 服装绝不能改变身体形状

- 服装作为表面层应用在球体上
- 构思：像绘制、印刷或轻微浮雕在球体上一样

---

风格：

- 光滑的哑光塑料材质
- 简洁、极简的几何形状
- 类似 Pixar / 搪胶玩具的风格
- 柔和的反射

---

场景：

{argument name="background" default="温馨的儿童卧室"}：
- 木地板
- 带有条纹毯子的床
- 墙上的儿童画
- 温暖的环境光
- 柔和的景深

---

渲染：

- 高质量 3D 渲染（Blender / Octane 风格）
- 电影级灯光
- 全局光照
- 50mm 镜头
- 角色焦点清晰
- 柔和阴影
- 4K 分辨率

---

最终意图：

结果应该看起来像一个模因：
每次都是完全相同的球形 Mike Wazowski 式身体，
不同的角色被尴尬而幽默地映射在上面。

一切都必须符合球形身体的要求。
没有任何东西可以覆盖这个球体。

templates.prompt: Lighting (Hollywood Food Ad Grade): Dramatic high-contrast lighting, intense warm orange contour lighting from flames, cool-toned shadow fill light to add depth, face +{argument name="food item" default="Hamburger"} Sharp main light on the bread, sauce, and cheese; HDR highlights; deep shadows (not flat); cinematic halo effect; dynamic elements with light overflow effect (viral impact): floating sparks, oil droplets, sauce splatter hovering in mid-air, subtle motion blur on the flames, and energetic composition and typography (bold text + rugged street style): "{argument name="main text" default="FLAME GRILLED ATTITUDE"} "—— Large, bold, distressed font; orange/yellow brushstroke background with graffiti elements: arrows, a crown sketch, a circular "WHOPPER" marker, and side notes: "YOUR WAY".{argument name="side note" default="SINCE 1954"} "SAUCE BOSS" (handwritten style) Composition: Subject centered, hamburger slightly in front (depth effect), rule of thirds composition, layered poster composition, foreground + middle ground + background separation Camera: 50–85mm lens, shallow depth of field f/1.8, hamburger + face super sharp focus, cinematic framing, slight perspective push-pull Color Grading: Super high-end orange-black-red cinematic color grading, fiery light, high contrast, rugged luxury, subtle film grain Style: A fusion of Burger King advertising campaigns + street posters + high-end fashion editing style, hyper-realistic, 8K ultra-high definition, clear texture, bold advertising aesthetics --ar 4:5 --style raw --v 6 --q 2

promptLocalized.zh:
灯光（好莱坞食品广告级）：
戏剧性高对比度灯光，来自火焰的强烈暖橙色轮廓光，用于增加深度的冷色调阴影补光，面部 + {argument name="food item" default="汉堡"} 上的锐利主光，面包 + 酱汁 + 芝士上的 HDR 高光，深邃阴影（非平淡），电影级光晕 + 光溢出效果

动态元素（病毒式冲击力）：
漂浮的火星，油脂滴，悬停在空中的酱汁飞溅，火焰上的细微动态模糊，充满能量的构图

排版（粗体 + 粗犷街头风格）：
“{argument name="main text" default="FLAME GRILLED ATTITUDE"}” —— 大型粗体做旧字体，橙色/黄色笔触背景
涂鸦元素：箭头，皇冠草图， “WHOPPER” 圆形标记
侧边注释：“YOUR WAY”，“{argument name="side note" default="SINCE 1954"}”，“SAUCE BOSS”（手写风格）

构图：
主体居中，汉堡略微靠前（深度效果），三分法构图，分层海报构图，前景 + 中景 + 背景分离

相机：
50–85mm 镜头，浅景深 f/1.8，汉堡 + 面部超锐利对焦，电影级取景，轻微透视推拉

调色：
超高级橙-黑-红电影级调色，炽热光感，高对比度，粗犷奢华感，细微胶片颗粒

风格：
Burger King 广告活动 + 街头海报 + 高端时尚编辑风格融合，超写实，8K 超高清，清晰纹理，大胆的广告美学

templates.prompt: Subject: 35mm color film photography, powerful direct flash, highlights on skin and clothing, strong catchlights in the eyes, high-contrast flash lighting, realistic film grain and color shift, stylish and pure basketball court style editing, first-person low-angle shooting. Subject description: Facial features are completely based on the uploaded image, 100% match.{argument name="character description" default="A Chinese female idol in her early twenties"} She possesses a hyper-realistic, exquisitely beautiful Chinese face: almond-shaped fox eyes, natural double eyelids, a high nose bridge, a delicate V-shaped jawline, perfectly realistic porcelain-white skin with fine texture, micro-pore details, and a natural, dewy glow under flash photography. Her makeup is fresh and natural, with a soft, dewy sheen, subtle natural blush on her cheeks, slightly parted, naturally pink lips, and fine, natural freckles on her nose and cheeks. She has long, dark brown hair consistent with the reference image. Her hands rest gently on the basketball hoop.{argument name="outfit" default="Clothing details description"} As dusk fell, the figure turned to the side, back naturally arched, one leg extended towards the camera, the other slightly bent, hands resting on a basketball hoop shoulder-high, looking directly at the audience with a soft, vulnerable, and yearning gaze, accompanied by a gentle smile. The glaring flash created sharp, mirror-like highlights and intense lighting effects. The background was a blurred basketball court and hoop under a twilight sky, with high-contrast film color grading, natural flash effects, and extremely clear yet soft skin, employing true 35mm direct flash aesthetics and natural hair detail.

templates.title: Film-quality storyboard production project

titleLocalized.zh: 电影级故事板制作项目

templates.prompt: story ={argument name="story subject" default="A beautiful woman in a white dress enjoys a stunning sunset in a luxurious villa perched on a cliff."} Scenes: 1) Wide-angle drone shot 2) Wide-angle walking shot by the pool 3) Over-the-shoulder medium-wide-angle shot by the pool 4) Medium-wide-angle shot leaning against a railing 5) Close-up of a hand (in water) 6) Overlooking the bay 7) Close-up of a smile 8) Wide-angle shot of someone smiling while holding champagne, accompanied by the elegant font "LuxLife Retreats". Create a cinematic production project/visual plan to present a complete concept for a short film or commercial. The layout should be simple, grid-based, and divided into clearly labeled areas. Include: Shared creative direction (top bar): Overall constraints, such as the number of shots, a unified color palette, and a common environmental background. Character + Styling Reference Section: Showcase models from multiple angles (front, back, side, close-up, relaxed pose), along with clothing and accessory references. Emphasize consistency in character identity while allowing for subtle variations for specific scenes. Environment and Scene Design Section: An outdoor landscape location with dramatic natural features, and a top-down view illustrating the spatial movement path. Include camera positions and label the shot types along the route. Storyboard Section: A series of numbered frames (approximately 8 shots) showcasing the progression of the scene. Each frame includes: camera type/lens feel, lens size (wide-angle, medium shot, close-up, macro), movement method (static, tracking, handheld, etc.), and a brief description of the action and emotional progression. Lighting/Atmosphere/Style Notes: Visual examples accompanied by brief descriptions of lighting conditions, atmosphere, and texture. Includes transitions throughout the day and changes in light quality. Mood and Keywords Module: A concise list of mood tones and thematic descriptions to guide the creation of the work. Audio/Tone Section: Indications for ambient sounds, musical style, and overall sound atmosphere. Cinematography Notes: Overall visual concept, including shot characteristics, movement style, and post-production feel. The entire project should look cohesive, cinematic, and professionally designed—like a director's pre-production guide, conveying the tone, rhythm, and visual narrative at a glance.

promptLocalized.zh:
story = {argument name="story subject" default="一位身穿白裙的美丽女子在悬崖上的豪华别墅中享受绝美的日落黄昏"}, 

场景：
1) 广角无人机镜头
2) 泳池边广角行走镜头
3) 泳池边过肩中广角镜头
4) 靠在栏杆上的中广角镜头
5) 手部特写（在水中）
6) 俯瞰海湾
7) 微笑特写
8) 手持香槟微笑的广角镜头，配以优雅字体文字“LuxLife Retreats”

创建一个电影级制作项目 / 视觉规划表，为短片或商业广告呈现完整的概念。布局应简洁、基于网格，并划分为清晰的标注区域。

包含：共享创意方向（顶部栏）：整体限制条件，如镜头数量、统一的调色板以及通用的环境背景。

角色 + 造型参考部分：展示多角度（正面、背面、侧面、特写、放松姿势）的模型，并附带服装和配饰参考。强调角色身份的一致性，同时允许针对特定场景进行细微变化。

环境与场景设计部分：一个具有戏剧性自然特征的户外风景地点，以及一张说明空间移动路径的俯视图。包含摄像机位置，并沿路线标注镜头类型。

故事板部分：一系列编号的画面（约 8 个镜头），展示场景的推进。每个画面包括：摄像机类型 / 镜头感、镜头尺寸（广角、中景、特写、微距）、运动方式（静态、追踪、手持等）、动作和情感推进的简要描述。

灯光 / 氛围 / 风格说明：视觉示例搭配关于灯光条件、氛围和质感的简短描述。包含一天中不同时间的过渡以及光线质量的变化。

情绪与关键词模块：一份简洁的情感基调和主题描述列表，用于指导作品创作。

音频 / 音调部分：环境音、音乐风格以及整体声音氛围的指示。

摄影说明：整体视觉理念，包括镜头特性、运动风格和后期处理感。

整个项目应看起来具有凝聚力、电影感且设计专业——就像一份导演的预制作指南，能够一眼传达出基调、节奏和视觉叙事。

templates.title: New York travel Instagram nine-grid

titleLocalized.zh: 纽约旅游 Instagram 九宫格

templates.prompt: Based on the clear, front-facing photos I uploaded, generate a "New York travel blogger's casual nine-grid collage." Please strictly maintain the true identity of the people in the photos, including face shape, facial proportions, eyes, nose, lips, jawline, skin tone, age, hairline, and overall demeanor. Do not turn the people into white faces, do not over-beautify them, and do not transform them into other people. The people in the nine photos must look like the same person, as if they were taken by a friend or taken with a mobile phone during a trip to New York. Visual format: Generate a 3x3 nine-grid collage, with a total of 9 travel photos. The overall style should look like a travel album from WeChat Moments, Xiaohongshu, or Instagram, rather than a professionally edited photographic work. Each grid is a photo taken with a mobile phone, with a different scene, expression, and pose. Character setting: A young travel blogger from a first-tier city in China, with a natural, beautiful, relaxed, and cheerful demeanor, reflecting the lifestyle and atmosphere of a travel blogger. The outfit should be a stylish and casual look for traveling in New York, including elements such as a white tank top, jeans, a knit sweater, a light jacket, sunglasses, a crossbody bag, and sneakers. The overall aesthetic leans towards East Asian trends—avoid overly sexy looks, studio-style shots, or stereotypical "Instagram face" expressions. The overall photography style: low-resolution iPhone snapshots, slightly blurry, occasionally overexposed, with inconsistent lighting, casual composition, and slightly tilted angles, like candid shots taken by friends while walking, selfies, candid shots, or casual travel snapshots. Avoid being too perfect or like commercial advertisements. Photos should be authentic, conveying a sense of everyday life and travel memories. Nine-grid composition: 1. Top left: A selfie near the Statue of Liberty. Holding the phone, with the Statue of Liberty and the sea in the background. Smiling happily, hair blowing in the breeze, slightly overexposed, presenting a genuine tourist selfie feel. 2. Top center: Times Square at night. The background includes neon lights, billboards, crowds, and streets. The person is walking and turning back to smile at the camera; there is a slight motion blur, as if taken by a friend. 3. Top right: Central Park. Sitting on a bench or on the grass, relaxed, hand on chin or touching hair, natural expression. Background includes trees and sunlight, with slight cell phone compression. 4. Center left: New York street pizzeria or hot dog stand. Holding a slice of pizza or street food, smiling and ready to eat, expressive and infectious. Background includes shop signs, street crowds, and warm-toned lighting. 5. Center: Museum of Art Gallery. Standing next to a large modern artwork, naturally looking back. No specific copyrighted artwork; just the museum atmosphere. Looks like a casual tourist photo. 6. Center right: Museum of Natural History. Standing next to a dinosaur skeleton, looking up curiously or excitedly, or looking at a friend. Background includes tourists and gallery lights. 7. Bottom left: Brooklyn Bridge. Walking and smiling while looking back, hair blowing in the wind, slightly blurry, composition slightly off-center, but the subject is clearly visible. 8. Bottom center: Empire State Building or high-rise observation deck. Selfie or photo taken by a friend with the New York skyline in the background. Make a peace sign, pout, or gaze naturally. A genuine tourist photo vibe. 9. Bottom right: Street style in SoHo or Dumbau. Walk down the street in stylish casual wear, sunglasses or a bag, turning back and smiling. The background should be red brick buildings, cafes, or street signs. Expression and pose requirements: Avoid staring at the camera or smiling in every photo. Use variety: selfie smile, turning back, side profile, laughing while eating, looking at scenery/exhibits, candid shots while walking, relaxed sitting poses, making gestures. It should feel like a real person traveling, not a posed model. Image restrictions: No distorted fingers, extraneous limbs, or facial feature drift. Ensure the face remains consistent across all frames. No strange text, gibberish signs, incorrect logos, excessive smoothing, plastic-looking skin, or obvious AI faces. Maintain the quality of a real mobile travel photo. Final output: A 1:1 scale 3x3 nine-grid travel jigsaw puzzle, with a realistic mobile phone photo style, a New York travel diary atmosphere, consistent character identity, and a variety of expressions and poses, suitable for posting on Xiaohongshu, WeChat Moments, and X.

promptLocalized.zh: 基于我上传的清晰正面照片，生成一张“纽约旅行博主随手拍九宫格拼图”。请严格保持照片中人物的真实身份特征，包括脸型、面部比例、眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇、下颌线、肤色、年龄、发际线和整体气质。不要将人物变成白人面孔，不要过度美颜，也不要将其变成其他人。九张图中的人物必须看起来是同一个人，就像是在纽约旅行时由朋友拍摄或用手机自拍的一样。视觉格式：生成一个 3x3 的九宫格拼图，总共 9 张旅行照片。整体风格应看起来像微信朋友圈、小红书或 Instagram 上的旅行相册，而不是专业修图的摄影作品。每一格都是一张手机拍摄的照片，具有不同的场景、表情和姿势。角色设定：一位来自中国一线城市的年轻旅行博主，气质自然、漂亮、放松且爱笑，体现出生活方式和旅行博主的氛围。穿搭应为纽约旅行的时尚休闲风，包括白色背心、牛仔裤、针织衫、轻便外套、墨镜、斜挎包和运动鞋等元素。整体审美倾向于东亚流行趋势——不要过度性感，避免影棚感或刻板的“网红脸”。整体摄影风格：低分辨率的 iPhone 随手拍感，略微模糊，偶尔过曝，光线不统一，构图随意，角度略微倾斜，就像走路时朋友抓拍、自拍、偷拍和随意的旅行记录。不要太完美，不要像商业广告大片。照片应真实，具有生活气息和旅行回忆感。九宫格内容：1. 左上：自由女神像附近的自拍。拿着手机，背景是自由女神像和大海。开心地笑着，头发微风吹拂，略微过曝，呈现真实的游客自拍感。2. 中上：夜晚的时代广场。背景是霓虹灯、广告牌、人群和街道。人物正在走路并回头对镜头微笑；有轻微的动态模糊，仿佛是朋友抓拍的。3. 右上：中央公园。坐在长椅或草地上，姿势放松，手托下巴或摸头发，表情自然。背景有树木和阳光，带有轻微的手机压缩画质。4. 左中：纽约街头披萨店或热狗摊。拿着一片披萨或街头小吃，笑着准备吃，表情生动且具有感染力。背景包括商店招牌、街头人群和暖色调灯光。5. 正中：纽约艺术博物馆画廊。站在一幅大型现代艺术品旁，自然地回头。没有特定的受版权保护的艺术品；仅呈现博物馆氛围。看起来像一张随意的游客照。6. 右中：自然历史博物馆。站在恐龙骨架旁，好奇且兴奋地抬头看或看向朋友。背景有游客和画廊灯光。7. 左下：布鲁克林大桥。边走边回头微笑，头发被风吹起，有轻微的抓拍模糊感，构图略微偏离中心，但主体清晰可见。8. 中下：帝国大厦或高层观景台。与纽约天际线的自拍或朋友拍摄。摆出剪刀手、嘟嘴或自然的凝视。真实的游客照氛围。9. 右下：苏豪区 (SoHo) 或 DUMBO 的街拍。穿着时尚休闲装走在街上，戴着墨镜或背着包，回头微笑。背景是红砖建筑、咖啡馆或街道标志。表情和姿势要求：避免在每张照片中都盯着镜头或微笑。使用多样的变化：自拍微笑、回头、侧面、吃东西时大笑、看风景/展品、走路抓拍、坐姿放松、做手势。应该感觉像是一个真实的人在旅行，而不是摆拍的模特。图像限制：没有变形的手指、多余的肢体或面部特征漂移。确保面部在所有格子中保持一致。没有奇怪的文字、乱码标志、错误的 Logo、过度磨皮、塑料感皮肤或明显的 AI 脸。保持真实的手机旅行照片质感。最终输出：1:1 比例的 3x3 九宫格旅行拼图，真实的手机照片风格，纽约旅行日记氛围，一致的人物身份，多样的表情和姿势，适合发布在小红书、朋友圈和 X 上。

templates.title: Executive professional studio portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 高管专业摄影棚肖像

templates.prompt: [Men's Version Prompt] Based on the front-facing photo I uploaded, generate a professional business portrait for men in a studio setting. Please strictly preserve the true identity features of the person in the photo, including face shape, facial proportions, eyebrow and eye structure, nose, lips, jawline, skin tone, perceived age, facial texture, hairline, and hairstyle. Do not replace the person with someone else, do not excessively age them, do not excessively smooth their skin, and do not generate a fake AI face. The final result must be a high-quality professional portrait that looks like the same person. The visual style should reference high-end corporate executive portraits, LinkedIn business portraits, and management photos on company websites. The person should face the camera, using a classic upper-chest portrait composition. The posture should be natural and upright, with relaxed yet powerful shoulders. The eyes should look directly at the camera, with a confident, calm, and approachable expression, accompanied by a subtle smile, showcasing a professional, reliable, and authoritative demeanor. Please replace the clothing with a well-tailored dark gray textured suit, paired with a crisp white shirt and a high-quality navy blue tie. The suit should be well-fitting, crisp, and have a business-like feel; the collar, shoulder line, and tie knot should be clear and natural. Avoid excessive luxury and avoid looking like a wedding photo or artistic portrait. Use soft, highly refining professional studio lighting. The main light should come from the front side, creating natural light and shadow layers on the face, with subtle catchlights in the eyes and realistic skin texture. The overall look should be clean and high-end. Avoid glaring bright light, overexposure, greasy reflections, and heavy shadows. The background should be a smooth, blurred gradient from dark gray to warm gray-brown, simple and clean, without clutter, text, or logos. The background should only be used to complement the subject and should not overshadow it. Photo requirements: realistic photographic feel, commercial portrait photography, high resolution, clear details, natural skin tone, high-end texture, stable composition, centered subject, and harmonious head-to-shoulder proportions. Please strictly preserve the true identity features of the person in the photo, including face shape, facial proportions, eyebrow and eye structure, nose, lips, jawline, skin tone, perceived age, facial texture, hairline, and hairstyle. Do not replace the person with another, do not excessively age them, do not overly beautify them, and do not generate fake AI faces. The final result must be a high-quality professional portrait that looks like the same person. The visual style should reference high-end female professional portraits, LinkedIn business portraits, company website team introduction photos, and professional portraits of entrepreneurs. The person should face the camera, using a classic upper-chest portrait composition. The posture should be natural and upright, with relaxed shoulders, a clear neck line, and eyes looking directly at the camera. The expression should be confident, gentle, and composed, with a subtle smile, showcasing the professional, reliable, approachable, and insightful qualities of a female professional. Please replace the clothing with a well-tailored dark professional suit jacket (black, dark gray, or navy blue is acceptable), worn over a simple white shirt, light-colored silk shirt, or a clean solid-color inner layer. The overall look should be high-end, sophisticated, and sharp; avoid overly sexy or exaggerated fashion sense, and don't resemble a celebrity photo or an artistic portrait. The shoulder line, collar, fabric texture, and layering of the suit jacket should be clear and natural. Keep makeup and hair natural and authentic, suitable for formal business occasions. Makeup should be clean, elegant, and flattering, preserving natural facial features; avoid heavy makeup and do not significantly alter the shape of eyebrows, eyes, or lips. Hairstyles can be slightly styled to make hair look voluminous, clean, and shiny, suitable for business portraits. Use soft, highly refining professional studio lighting. The main light should come from the front side, creating natural light and shadow layers on the face, with subtle catchlights in the eyes and realistic skin texture. The overall look should be clean and high-end. Avoid glaring bright light, overexposure, oily reflections, and heavy shadows. The background should be a smooth, blurred gradient from dark gray to warm gray-brown, simple and clean, free of clutter, text, or logos. The background should only serve to complement the subject and should not overshadow it. Photo requirements: realistic photographic feel, commercial portrait photography, high resolution, clear details, natural skin tones, high-end texture, stable composition, centered subject, and harmonious head-to-shoulder proportions. Aspect ratio 3:4.

promptLocalized.zh: [男士版提示词] 基于我上传的正面照片，生成一张专业的男士摄影棚商务肖像。请严格保留照片中人物真实的身份特征，包括脸型、五官比例、眉眼结构、鼻子、嘴唇、下颌线、肤色、感知年龄、面部纹理、发际线和发型。请勿将人物替换为他人，请勿过度减龄，请勿过度磨皮，也不要生成虚假的 AI 面孔。最终结果必须看起来像是同一位人物的高质量专业肖像。视觉风格应参考高端企业高管头像、LinkedIn 商务肖像以及公司官网上的管理层照片。人物面向镜头，采用经典的胸部以上半身肖像构图。姿态自然挺拔，双肩放松但传达出力量感。双眼直视镜头，表情自信、沉稳且平易近人，带有内敛的微笑，展现出专业、可靠且权威的气质。请将服装替换为剪裁合身的深灰色质感西装，内搭挺括的白衬衫，并配以高品质的海军蓝领带。西装应合身、平整，具有商务质感；领口、肩线和领带结应清晰自然。避免过度奢华，避免看起来像婚纱照或艺术写真。使用柔和、修饰性强的专业摄影棚灯光。主光从前侧方照射，在脸上营造出自然的光影层次，眼睛带有轻微的眼神光，皮肤纹理真实。整体观感干净、高端。避免刺眼的强光、过曝、油腻的反光和沉重的阴影。背景为从深灰色到暖灰褐色的平滑模糊渐变，简洁干净，无杂物、文字或 Logo。背景仅用于衬托主体，不应喧宾夺主。照片要求：真实的摄影感、商业肖像摄影、高分辨率、清晰的细节、自然的肤色、高端的质感、稳定的构图、主体居中、头肩比例协调。长宽比 3:4。[女士版提示词] 基于我上传的正面照片，生成一张专业的女士摄影棚商务肖像。请严格保留照片中人物真实的身份特征，包括脸型、五官比例、眉眼结构、鼻子、嘴唇、下颌线、肤色、感知年龄、面部纹理、发际线和发型。请勿将人物替换为他人，请勿过度减龄，请勿过度美颜，也不要生成虚假的 AI 面孔。最终结果必须看起来像是同一位人物的高质量专业肖像。视觉风格应参考高端女性专业头像、LinkedIn 商务肖像、公司官网团队介绍照片以及创业者的专业肖像。人物面向镜头，采用经典的胸部以上半身肖像构图。姿态自然挺拔，双肩放松，颈部线条清晰，双眼直视镜头。表情自信、温和且沉稳，带有内敛的微笑，展现出专业、可靠、平易近人且富有洞察力的女性专业人士气质。请将服装替换为剪裁合身的深色专业西装外套（可以是黑色、深灰色或海军蓝），内搭简单的白衬衫、浅色丝绸衬衫或干净的纯色内搭。整体造型应高端、干练、利落；避免过于性感，避免夸张的时尚感，不要看起来像网红照片或艺术写真。西装外套的肩线、领口、面料质感和层次感应清晰自然。请保持妆发自然真实，适合正式的商务场合。妆容应干净、优雅、显气色，保留原始的面部特征；避免浓妆，不要显著改变眉毛、眼睛或嘴唇的形状。发型可以在原有基础上稍作整理，使头发看起来蓬松、干净、有光泽，适合商务肖像。使用柔和、修饰性强的专业摄影棚灯光。主光从前侧方照射，在脸上营造出自然的光影层次，眼睛带有轻微的眼神光，皮肤纹理真实。整体观感干净、高端。避免刺眼的强光、过曝、油腻的反光和沉重的阴影。背景为从深灰色到暖灰褐色的平滑模糊渐变，简洁干净，无杂物、文字或 Logo。背景仅用于衬托主体，不应喧宾夺主。照片要求：真实的摄影感、商业肖像摄影、高分辨率、清晰的细节、自然的肤色、高端的质感、稳定的构图、主体居中、头肩比例协调。长宽比 3:4。

templates.title: Fun Watercolor and Crayon Drawings

titleLocalized.zh: 童趣水彩与蜡笔画

templates.prompt: Use the uploaded image as a reference. Retain its structure, composition, and main visual information. Reconstruct the provided image into a realistic handcrafted artwork created by a bright 10-year-old. Preserve the original image's main layout, composition, and recognizable content, but transform the entire scene into a 10-year-old's watercolor drawing, blending crayon strokes and paper collage elements. The image should be placed on a clean white paper background. Give it a realistic handcrafted feel, including quirky outlines, simple shapes, uneven coloring, visible watercolor textures, crayon strokes, cut-out edges, slight glue marks, layered paper pieces, imperfect proportions, and charmingly childlike details. Do not use the original color scheme. Replace it with {argument name="color theme" default="Bright rainbow colors, soft pastel colors, playful candy colors, and cheerful craft colors."} Add whimsical, childlike decorations naturally around the scene:{argument name="decorations" default="Castles, fairytale towers, candy, lollipops, stars, smiling clouds, rainbows, hearts, flowers, glitter, planets, stickers, and random doodles."} At the same time, add fantasy and science fiction style paper collage characters, just like a child would add them for fun:{argument name="extra characters" default="Brave armored heroes, silly villains, colorful mecha robots, adorable monsters, floating UFOs, friendly little aliens, cute princesses, and fun spaceships flying in the sky."} All visible text should be redrawn in a childlike handwriting, like a 10-year-old writing with crayons and watercolors. The handwriting should be uneven, slightly messy, cute and innocent, with letters of varying sizes, irregular spacing, a playful wobbly feel, and imperfect alignment. The final image should convey a sense of authenticity, dynamism, imagination, innocence, rich color, and childlike creativity—like a charming school art project made with watercolors, crayons, scissors, glue, and colored paper.

promptLocalized.zh:
以上传的图片作为参考图。保留其结构、构图及主要视觉信息。

将提供的图片重构为一件由聪明的 10 岁儿童创作的写实手工艺术品。

保留原图的主要布局、构图和可识别的内容，但将整个场景转化为 10 岁儿童的水彩笔画，并混合蜡笔笔触和纸艺拼贴元素。

图像应置于干净的白纸背景上。使其看起来具有真实的手工感，包括歪歪扭扭的轮廓、简单的形状、不均匀的涂色、可见的水彩笔纹理、蜡质蜡笔笔触、剪纸边缘、轻微的胶水痕迹、分层的纸片、不完美的比例以及迷人的童趣细节。

不要使用原始配色方案。将其替换为 {argument name="color theme" default="明亮的彩虹色、柔和的粉彩色、俏皮的糖果色以及欢快的手工工艺色彩"}。

在场景周围自然地添加异想天开的童趣装饰：{argument name="decorations" default="城堡、童话塔、糖果、棒棒糖、星星、微笑的云朵、彩虹、爱心、花朵、闪光、行星、贴纸和随意的涂鸦"}。

同时添加奇幻和科幻风格的纸艺拼贴角色，就像孩子为了好玩而添加的一样：{argument name="extra characters" default="勇敢的盔甲英雄、愚蠢的大反派、色彩斑斓的机甲机器人、可爱的怪物、漂浮的 UFO、友好的小外星人、可爱的公主以及在天空中飞行的趣味宇宙飞船"}。

所有可见文字应重绘为童稚的笔迹，就像 10 岁孩子用蜡笔和水彩笔书写的一样。笔迹应参差不齐、略显凌乱、可爱且天真，字母大小不一、间距不规则、带有俏皮的晃动感和不完美的对齐方式。

最终图像应呈现出真实、灵动、富有想象力、纯真、色彩丰富且充满童趣创造力的感觉——就像一件用水彩笔、蜡笔、剪刀、胶水和彩色纸制作的迷人学校艺术项目。

templates.prompt: A mature fantasy female character, depicted in a close-up half-body shot, possesses exceptionally long, voluminous, silver-white hair. The hair is light and flowing, richly layered, with a soft sheen and silky texture, naturally cascading in the air to form elegant, flowing curves. Her face is delicate and ethereal, with refined, three-dimensional features, fair and translucent skin, a high nose bridge, and soft, natural lips. Her expression is serene and mysterious, radiating an aura of goddess and elf. Her collarbone is clearly defined, and her shoulders and neck appear gracefully extended. The upper chest is moderately visible, and the optimized openings and cuts of her clothing enhance the natural and aesthetically pleasing appearance of her chest and collarbone, achieving a look that is both sexy and dignified. The character's eyes are clear and captivating, with a color of {argument name="eye color" default="brown"} With delicate highlights and dreamy lashes, the eyes are adorned with subtle shimmering particles and exquisite makeup. A magnificent, fantastical bird, resembling a phoenix, surrounds the character, its wings long and flowing, its feathers light and translucent. The overall color scheme is {argument name="color theme" default="Blue, ice blue, light blue, and silver white"} The main element, accented with a few delicate metallic edges, makes the divine bird appear sacred, dreamlike, and elegant. The background is a deep night sky and starlight space, adorned with tiny stars, luminous particles, and a hazy cosmic feel, creating a dreamlike and mysterious atmosphere. promptLocalized.zh:

她的面容精致空灵，五官细腻立体，皮肤白皙通透，鼻梁挺拔，唇形柔和自然，表情宁静而神秘，散发着女神与精灵般的气质。

角色双眸清澈迷人，颜色为 {argument name="eye color" default="棕色"}，带有精致的高光和梦幻般的睫毛，眼周点缀着淡淡的闪烁微粒与精致妆容。

背景为深邃的夜空与星光空间，点缀着细小的星辰、发光微粒和朦胧的宇宙感，营造出梦幻而神秘的氛围。画面整体色调统一为蓝银色系，强调冰蓝、湖蓝、浅蓝与银白之间的层次变化，打造出纯净、清冷、华丽且空灵的视觉体验。

templates.title: Romantic Couple Travel Photo Album Grid

titleLocalized.zh: 浪漫情侣旅行相册网格

templates.prompt: Please create a "Couple's Beach Trip Film-Style Snapshot Album Collage" based on the two real photos of adults I uploaded. Strictly preserve the real physical features of both individuals. Regardless of gender, they must match the person in the uploaded photo, including face shape, facial proportions, eye structure, nose, lips, jawline, skin tone, age, hairline, hairstyle, and overall demeanor. Women should have a B-cup bust. Do not transform them into white faces, avoid influencer aesthetics, do not over-beautify, and do not replace them with strangers. Ultimately, all the small photos must be of the same couple, depicting various travel scenes as if taken with a mobile phone, a point-and-shoot camera, or by a friend. Format: 4x4 collage, 16 small photos in total. Narrow black dividing lines between photos, black background, and wide black borders at the top and bottom, similar to a mobile phone photo album, Instagram, or Xiaohongshu (Little Red Book) memory fragments. Avoid elaborate professional typography or commercial poster styles. Core visual style: nostalgic film + old iPhone snapshots + couple's travel album. Includes slight film grain, shadow noise, slight out-of-focus, motion blur, compression, occasional overexposure/backlighting, unstable lighting, and imperfect composition. Warm tones, natural skin tones, faded greens/blues, and gray-blacks, similar to mobile vacation photos from 2016 to 2021. Avoid high definition, cleanliness, or over-sharpening. Film filter: Slight Kodak/Fujifilm disposable camera style. Slight grain, warm yellow highlights, soft lighting, and slight nighttime noise. It should look like a genuine old photograph, not a heavy modern template. Relationships: An intimate, natural couple with lifelike interactions: holding hands, taking selfies, gazing into each other's eyes, hugging, leaning on each other's shoulders, kissing cheeks, eating, and walking side-by-side. Intimate but not erotic or vulgar. Travel scenes: A summer seaside city vacation with a Mediterranean, Greek island, or Italian coastal feel. Scenes include beaches, hotel mirrors, sunsets, restaurants, balconies, docks, and nighttime city views. These should feel like snapshots of life, not touristy check-in photos. 16 Frames: 1. Beach selfie, close-up, strong light, slightly overexposed. 2. Woman sitting alone in a café, hair tousled by the wind, a snapshot from a friend's perspective. 3. Man walking away on a white town street, a stroll at dusk. 4. Hotel bathroom mirror selfie, dim lighting, with noise. 5. Woman turning back and smiling on the beach, dressed in summer attire, with waves in the background. 6. Very close-up selfie, blurry, woman with eyes closed, man close to her cheek. 7. Woman's profile looking at the sea at sunset, grainy, low contrast. 8. Man sitting on a pier or in a café, looking relaxed at the camera. 9. Holding hands and walking at night, motion blur, warm light. 10. Man sitting by the pool/sea, half-body shot, relaxed expression. 11. Group selfie, messy hair, slightly out of focus but full of emotion. 12. Man photographing a woman, travel documentary style. 13. Close-up selfie of loud laughter, candid. 14. A man eating street food, his movements natural and simple. 15. A woman looking back from a balcony at night, with city lights in the background, showing nighttime noise. 16. A beach selfie, kissing on the cheek, a commemorative photo for the last day. Consistency Requirements: Maintain perfect consistency in the couple's appearance across all clothing and lighting changes in every grid. Facial distortion or asymmetry is not allowed when shooting from the side or at night. Hand Stability: Avoid placing hands close to the face. Do not use complex gestures or grabbing hair to prevent AI distortion. Hands should be placed naturally. Expressions and Poses: Variety is key: selfies, side profiles, back views, eating, and walking. Avoid constantly smiling at the camera. Quality: A realistic old iPhone photo album feel, low resolution, graininess, compression, and imperfect composition. Restrictions: No distorted fingers, extra limbs, strange text or watermarks. No nude or underage subjects. Avoid "AI plastic" faces. Final output: A 4x4 couple's travel photo album collage, 1:1 scale, black background, retro film/old iPhone style, showcasing intimate, relaxing and authentic summer vacation memories.

promptLocalized.zh: 请根据我上传的两位成年人的真实照片，生成一张“情侣海边旅行胶片风快照相册拼贴”。严格保留两人的真实外貌特征。无论男女，都必须与上传照片中的本人一致，包括脸型、五官比例、眼睛结构、鼻子、嘴唇、下颌线、肤色、年龄、发际线、发型特征以及整体气质。女性为 B 罩杯。不要将他们变成白人面孔，避免网红审美，不要过度美化，也不要替换成陌生人。最终，所有小照片必须是同一对情侣，呈现出如同手机、傻瓜相机或朋友拍摄的各种旅行场景。格式：4x4 拼贴，共 16 张小照片。照片之间有窄黑色分割线，黑色背景，顶部和底部有宽大的黑色边框，类似于手机相册、Instagram 或小红书的记忆碎片。避免精致的专业排版或商业海报风格。核心视觉风格：怀旧胶片 + 旧 iPhone 快照 + 情侣旅行相册。包含轻微胶片颗粒、阴影噪点、轻微失焦、动态模糊、压缩感、偶尔的过曝/逆光、不稳定的光线以及不完美的构图。暖色调、自然肤色、褪色的绿/蓝色和灰黑色，类似于 2016 年至 2021 年的手机度假照片。不要高清、干净或过度锐化。胶片滤镜：轻微的柯达/富士一次性相机风格。轻微颗粒感、暖黄色高光、柔光和轻微的夜间噪点。看起来应该是真实的旧照片，而不是厚重的现代模板。人物关系：一对亲密、自然的情侣，有生活化的互动：牵手、自拍、对视、拥抱、靠肩、亲吻脸颊、进食和并肩行走。亲密但不色情或低俗。旅行场景：夏季海滨城市度假，具有地中海、希腊岛屿或意大利海岸风情。场景包括海滩、酒店镜子、日落、餐厅、阳台、码头和夜间城市景观。这些应该感觉像是生活片段，而不是游客打卡照。16 格内容：1. 海滩自拍，特写，强光，轻微过曝。2. 女性独自坐在咖啡馆，头发被风吹乱，朋友视角快照。3. 男性在白色小镇街道上走远，傍晚散步感。4. 酒店浴室镜子自拍，光线昏暗，有噪点。5. 女性在海滩回头微笑，夏日装扮，背景有海浪。6. 极近距离自拍，模糊，女性闭眼，男性靠近她的脸颊。7. 女性在日落时分看向大海的侧脸，颗粒感，低对比度。8. 男性坐在码头或咖啡馆，神态放松地看向镜头。9. 夜间牵手散步，动态模糊，暖光。10. 男性坐在泳池/海边，半身照，表情放松。11. 合影自拍，头发凌乱，略微失焦但情感充沛。12. 男性拍摄女性，旅行纪录片风格。13. 大声欢笑的特写自拍，抓拍感。14. 男性吃街头小吃，动作自然简单。15. 女性夜晚在阳台上回眸，背景是城市灯光，有夜间噪点。16. 海滩自拍，亲吻脸颊，最后一天纪念照。一致性要求：在所有服装和光线变化中，保持情侣在每个网格中的外貌完全一致。侧面或夜景拍摄时，面部不得变形或走样。手部稳定性：避免手部靠近脸部。不要使用复杂的手势或抓头发，以防 AI 变形。手部应自然放置。表情与姿势：多样性是关键：自拍、侧脸照、背影、进食和行走。避免一直对着镜头微笑。质量：真实的旧 iPhone 相册感，低分辨率、颗粒感、压缩感和不完美的构图。限制：没有变形的手指、多余的肢体、奇怪的文字或水印。没有裸露或看起来未成年的主体。避免“AI 塑料感”面孔。最终输出：一张 4x4 情侣旅行相册拼贴，1:1 比例，黑色背景，怀旧胶片/旧 iPhone 风格，展示亲密、放松且真实的夏日度假记忆。

templates.title: IT Architecture Knowledge Infographic

titleLocalized.zh: IT 架构知识信息图

templates.prompt: 01 Frontend (User-visible part) Definition: The interface that users can see, click, and interact with. Application scenarios: Website, mini-program, and app interfaces. Tools: HTML (structure), CSS (style), JavaScript (interaction). 02 Backend (Behind-the-scenes processing part) Definition: The brain behind the scenes, responsible for logic and calculation. Application scenarios: On the server side, invisible to the user. Functions: Handling login and registration, calculating prices and recommending products, receiving frontend requests and returning data. Common languages: Java, Python, Go, JavaScript (Node.js) 03 Database (Memory part) Definition: Used to store and manage data. Stored content: Accounts, passwords, orders, inventory, etc. Common databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL (relational, similar to tables), MongoDB (document-based, similar to folders) 04 SaaS (Software as a Service) Definition: SaaS = Software as a Service. Core characteristics: Can be used through web pages, mini-programs, or apps. Monthly or yearly subscriptions. Common forms: Websites, mobile apps, and mini-programs can all be SaaS. 05 Summary Frontend: The user-visible interface Backend: The underlying logic and computation Database: Data storage and management SaaS: A service model for delivering software over the network Frontend presentation → Backend processing → Database storage → SaaS delivery method Please draw an easy-to-understand diagram based on the above content.

promptLocalized.zh:
01 前端 (用户可见部分)

定义：用户可以看到、点击并进行交互的界面。
应用场景：网站、小程序和 App 的界面。
工具：HTML (结构)、CSS (样式)、JavaScript (交互)。

02 后端 (幕后的处理部分)

定义：幕后的大脑，负责逻辑和计算。
应用场景：在服务器端，用户不可见。
功能：
处理登录和注册
计算价格并推荐产品
接收前端请求并返回数据
常用语言：Java、Python、Go、JavaScript (Node.js)

03 数据库 (记忆部分)

定义：用于存储和管理数据。
存储内容：账号、密码、订单、库存等。
常用数据库：
MySQL、PostgreSQL (关系型，类似于表格)
MongoDB (文档型，类似于文件夹)

04 SaaS (软件即服务)

定义：SaaS = Software as a Service。
核心特征：
可通过网页、小程序或 App 使用
按月或按年订阅
常见形式：网站、移动端 App 和小程序都可以是 SaaS。

05 总结

前端：用户可见的界面
后端：幕后的逻辑与计算
数据库：数据的存储与管理
SaaS：通过网络交付软件的服务模式
前端展示 → 后端处理 → 数据库存储 → SaaS 交付方式

templates.title: Cinematic Nighttime Portrait Photography

titleLocalized.zh: 电影感夜间人像摄影

templates.prompt: A cinematic portrait taken by a top film photographer using 35mm Kodak Portra 800 film, showcasing a striking contrast between convenience store fluorescent lights and outdoor colorful neon lights. It features realistic film grain, high contrast, slight color shift, and a street-film style post-processing. Subject Description: Use the uploaded reference photo as the main subject. Facial features, bone structure, and natural skin texture (visible pores) must be 100% identical; race or gender must not be altered. Fine skin texture and tiny pores, naturally dewy makeup, slightly flushed cheeks, naturally rosy and slightly parted lips, and long, dark brown hair cascading around her face and neck. Clothing and Pose: She is wearing {argument name="clothing type" default="Fitted white short-sleeved shirt"} , pairing{argument name="bottoms" default="black pleated skirt"} Wearing black, patent leather, pointed-toe stilettos. Late at night, she leaned against {argument name="location" default="The glass door of a 24-hour convenience store"} She holds a cold drink in one hand and places the other behind her back. Her eyes are playful yet slightly vulnerable as she looks directly at the camera, her gentle eyes carrying a calm and soft smile. Scene setting: The bright, cool-toned fluorescent lights inside the store intertwine with the pink and blue neon lights of the storefront sign, complemented by strong lighting and neon accents. A realistic reflection appears on the glass door, with a blurred background showing the convenience store interior and shelves overflowing with snacks. Lens aesthetics: Kodak Portra 800's signature warm skin tones contrast with cool light, natural highlights and smooth transitions; the unique subtle halos, grain, and cinematic quality of 35mm film; cinematic composition, ultra-high detail, and 8K ultra-realistic textures. Positive keywords: Soft skin rendering, natural hair strands, realistic fabric folds and drape, no plastic-looking skin, no excessive digital sharpening, no oily skin, a truly authentic late-night convenience store atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh:

templates.title: Travel Photo Calendar Card

titleLocalized.zh: 旅行照片月历卡

templates.prompt: Based on my uploaded real travel photos, generate a 9:16 aspect ratio "calendar card". [1. Execution Method (Most Important)] This is a photo editing task, not a regeneration. You must use the original photo as the base image: - Keep the facial features, expressions, hairstyles, and poses of the people completely unchanged. - Preserve the original lighting, color temperature, and shadow relationships. - Do not perform skin smoothing, brightening, repainting, or stylization. - Do not change the environment, composition, or color atmosphere. - The original photo must look unmodified. [2. Allowed Operations (Overlay Only)] Only design layers can be added on top of the original photo: - A 30% gradient expansion at the bottom (for placing the calendar). - A soft, semi-transparent mask (to ensure text readability). - Calendar layout + month titles + text. Prohibited: Repainting the subject/background, changing the overall tone, or applying design filters. [3. Color Rules] Colors must be extracted from the current image (primary/secondary/accent color). Only slight desaturation and brightness uniformity are allowed. Maintain a realistic sense of color. [4. Layout Structure] Top 70%: Original photo (unmodified). Bottom 30%: Gradient + Calendar area (natural transition). It must look like a magazine page, not a template calendar. [5. Calendar Content] Automatically generate corresponding years and months: - Title:{argument name="date title" default="July 2026 / 2026.07"} - Day of the week: Mon Tue Wed Thu Fri Sat Sun - Dates: Arranged according to a real calendar, strictly aligned. [6. Copywriting Rules] Length: 8-16 characters. Maximum two lines. Do not use exclamation marks. Do not use clichés or philosophical statements. Use emotional snippets or atmospheric sentences. [7. Recommendations] Prioritize photos of profiles, head tilts, or dynamic poses over close-up portraits to reduce the risk of AI facial distortion. Ultimate core rule: Don't try to create a "better" photo; simply lightly overlay a design layer on top of an existing photo.

promptLocalized.zh:
基于我上传的真实旅行照片，生成一张 9:16 比例的“月历卡”。

[1. 执行方法（最重要）]
这是一项照片编辑任务，而非重新生成。你必须以原始照片作为底图：
- 保持人物的五官、表情、发型和姿态完全不变。
- 保留原始光影、色温和阴影关系。
- 不得进行磨皮、提亮、重绘或风格化处理。
- 不得改变环境、构图或色彩氛围。
- 原始照片必须看起来未经改动。

[2. 允许的操作（仅限叠加）]
仅可在原始照片上方添加设计图层：
- 底部 30% 的渐变扩展（用于放置日历）。
- 柔和的半透明遮罩（确保文字可读性）。
- 日历布局 + 月份标题 + 文案。
禁止：重绘主体/背景、改变整体色调或应用设计滤镜。

[3. 色彩规则]
色彩必须从当前图像中提取（主色/辅色/强调色）。仅允许轻微的去饱和度和亮度统一。保持真实的色彩感。

[4. 布局结构]
顶部 70%：原始照片（未经改动）。
底部 30%：渐变 + 日历区域（自然过渡）。必须看起来像杂志页面，而非模板日历。

[5. 日历内容]
自动生成对应的年份和月份：
- 标题：{argument name="date title" default="2026 年 7 月 / 2026.07"}
- 星期：一 二 三 四 五 六 日
- 日期：根据真实日历排列，严格对齐。

[6. 文案规则]
长度：8-16 个字符。最多两行。不要使用感叹号。不要使用陈词滥调或人生哲理。使用情感碎片或氛围感句子。

[7. 建议]
优先选择侧脸、侧头或动态动作的照片，而非近景正脸肖像，以降低 AI 面部畸变的风险。

最终核心规则：不要试图制作一张“更好”的照片，只需在现有照片上轻盈地覆盖一层设计图层。

templates.title: Travel journal Q-version collage generator

titleLocalized.zh: 旅行手账 Q 版拼贴生成器

templates.prompt: Transform your uploaded travel photos into fun, Q-version travel journal-style collages, while retaining the original photos as the background. Maintain the recognizability and structural integrity of the original photos. Preserve the facial features, expressions, body shapes, poses, clothing, lighting, and realistic backgrounds of the people in the photos. Do not replace the people, change their identities, redraw faces, or alter the actual travel scenes. The edited effect should present the texture of illustrations and journal elements superimposed on the real photos. Add 4 to 7 cute Q-version mini-characters of the people in the uploaded photos. Each mini-character should be based on the same person, maintaining consistent facial features, hairstyles, clothing details, and overall personality. Use a large-head Q-version proportion, vivid expressions, exquisite details, and a light cartoon rendering effect. Have each mini-character perform different natural travel actions. Choose a variety of snapshot moments, such as taking photos, walking and looking around, looking at a map, checking navigation, pulling a suitcase, drinking coffee, admiring the scenery, posing next to attractions, crouching down to observe flowers or street details, taking photos with a mobile phone, hair blowing in the wind, looking around because you are lost, or jumping happily. The poses should appear natural and lifelike, as if captured from a real journey, rather than a staged photo. Overlay hand-drawn doodles, handwritten notes, and sticker-like details to create a relaxed travel journal style. Use white and soft pink as accents, with slightly irregular hand-drawn lines. Include arrows, stars, hearts, sparkles, airplanes, location icons, dotted lines, hand-drawn circles, washi tape, stickers, and small decorative symbols. Add 3 to 6 short handwritten English phrases related to your travel mood and memories. Change the phrases each time; don't use a fixed combination. Examples of tone include: "go somewhere new," "chase the horizon," "little moments matter," "memory unlocked," "lost but happy," "soft days," "just wandering," "no plans, just go," "take it slow," "follow the sun," "breathe and see," "quiet joy," and "this feels right." Place the handwritten phrases near people, minifigures, or travel actions to blend the text and images naturally. Avoid using neat or formal fonts. The handwriting should appear casual and personalized, as if casually added to a travel journal. The final image should evoke a light, healing, transparent, cute, and relaxing atmosphere, with a sense of freedom and nostalgic travel sensibility. Maintain a balance between the realistic photograph and the subtle enhancements of the illustrations. Viewers should first recognize it as a genuine travel photo, then notice the charming chibi characters and journal details.

promptLocalized.zh:
将上传的旅行照片转换为趣味十足的旅行手账风格 Q 版拼贴画，同时保留原始照片作为底图。

保持原始照片的可辨识度和结构完整性。保留照片中人物的面部特征、表情、体型、姿势、服装、光影以及真实的背景。请勿替换人物、更改其身份、重绘面部或改变真实的旅行场景。编辑效果应呈现出插画和手账元素叠加在真实照片之上的质感。

添加 4 到 7 个上传照片中人物的可爱 Q 版迷你形象。每个迷你角色都应基于同一个人，保持一致的面部特征、发型、服装细节和整体个性。使用大头 Q 版比例、生动的表情、精致的细节以及轻盈的卡通渲染效果。

让每个迷你角色做出不同的自然旅行动作。选择多样化的抓拍瞬间，例如拍照、边走边看、看地图、查看导航、拉行李箱、喝咖啡、欣赏风景、在景点旁摆姿势、蹲下观察花朵或街道细节、用手机拍摄、头发被风吹起、因迷路而四处张望或开心地跳跃。姿势应显得自然且富有生活气息，仿佛是在真实的旅途中被捕捉到的，而非刻意摆拍。

叠加手绘涂鸦、手写笔记和贴纸般的细节，营造出轻松的旅行手账风格。主要使用白色和柔和的粉色作为点缀，线条采用略显不规则的手绘风格。包含箭头、星星、爱心、闪光、小飞机、定位图标、虚线路线、手绘圆圈、胶带纸、贴纸以及细小的装饰符号。

添加 3 到 6 个与旅行心情和回忆相关的简短英文手写短语。每次更换不同的短语，不要使用固定的组合。语气示例包括：“go somewhere new”、“chase the horizon”、“little moments matter”、“memory unlocked”、“lost but happy”、“soft days”、“just wandering”、“no plans, just go”、“take it slow”、“follow the sun”、“breathe and see”、“quiet joy” 以及 “this feels right”。

将手写短语放置在人物、迷你角色或旅行动作附近，使文字与图像自然融合。避免使用整齐或正式的字体。书写应显得随意、个性化，就像是随手添加在旅行日记中一样。

最终图像应呈现出轻盈、治愈、通透、可爱且放松的氛围，并带有一种自由感和旅行怀旧感。保持真实照片与微妙插画增强效果之间的平衡。观众应首先将其识别为一张真实的旅行照片，随后注意到迷人的 Q 版角色和手账细节。

templates.title: Movie-quality action film storyboard

templates.prompt: Create a high-quality 4K cinematic action film storyboard that must contain only [the following].{argument name="panel count" default="8"} One screen (no more, no less) shows a person{argument name="protagonist" default="female protagonist"} The process of winning in realistic fight scenes. promptLocalized.zh:
创建一个高质量的 4K 电影级动作片分镜脚本，必须且仅包含 {argument name="panel count" default="8"} 个画面（不多不少），展示一名 {argument name="protagonist" default="女性主角"} 在写实的打斗场景中获胜的过程。使用戏剧性的光影、高对比度阴影、写实的环境（{argument name="location" default="废弃仓库、屋顶或地下格斗场"}）以及粗粝的电影色调。画面中不要出现任何文字。
该分镜脚本必须严格包含以下 8 个场景：
暗色调、高强度的环境全景建立镜头（雨、灰尘或低光氛围），两名格斗者面对面站立
女性主角专注表情的特写，呼吸平稳，紧张感积聚

最终画面——她站姿稳健且冷静，虽有轻伤但占据主导地位，在戏剧性光影下看向前方，明确获胜

templates.prompt: Convert the provided image into a professional single-page, high-resolution PNG digital oil painting template. Please use {argument name="canvas size" default="A4 portrait canvas"} The resolution is 300 DPI, and the background is pure white. The main artwork must be a clear black and white line drawing, containing only black outlines, black numbers, and white unfilled colorable areas. Do not create PDFs, documents, mockups, multi-page layouts, or color versions. Colors, grayscale, shadows, textures, gradients, transparency, or pre-filled areas are not allowed in the main artwork. Analyze the original image and adaptively select the number of colors based on image complexity, ranging from one to a maximum.{argument name="color count" default="14 colors"} If an image has only 1-2 important colors, use only 1-2; simple images use 3-6; medium-complexity images use 7-10; complex, photographic, or highly detailed images use 11-14. Don't force unnecessary colors. Assign a unique number to each selected color, and merge similar hues unless differentiation is necessary for identification. Transform the image into simplified, fully enclosed, and easily colorable areas while preserving recognizable composition, main objects, characters, text, logos, foreground, background, and key details. Each colorable white area must contain the correct black number, clearly centered within the matching area, and be easily readable, upright, and not touching the outline. Large areas of black or dark color in the original image must be preserved as white colorable areas with the correct numbers, not filled with black. Only small, permanent black line details (such as mouth lines, nostrils, pupils, eyelashes, seams, or small decorative brushstrokes) can remain unnumbered. At the bottom of the same PNG image, add a neat legend section titled "Instructions" with the text "Paint the areas with the matching colors." List each number used, its corresponding small color block, and the English color name. Color blocks can only appear in the legend. Ensure the numbering matches the legend perfectly, each paintable area is numbered, all areas are closed, and the final result should be neat, professional, printable, and clearly recognizable from the original image.

分析原始图像，并根据图像复杂度自适应选择颜色数量，范围从 1 种到最多 {argument name="color count" default="14 种颜色"}。如果图像仅有 1-2 种重要颜色，则仅使用 1-2 种；简单图像使用 3-6 种；中等复杂度使用 7-10 种；复杂、摄影类或高度详细的图像使用 11-14 种。不要强行使用不必要的颜色。为每种选定的颜色分配一个唯一的数字，除非为了识别必须区分，否则请合并相似的色调。

templates.title: Seedance 2.0 Waiting Queue Poster

titleLocalized.zh: Seedance 2.0 等候队列海报

templates.prompt: Create a simple square promotional poster with a warm beige-white background, featuring an isometric miniature 3D model. Place a large, bold, rounded sans-serif title text at the top.{argument name="headline text" default="Seedance 2.0 - No Waiting"} The image is divided into two rows with a vibrant left-to-right gradient from blue and purple to magenta and then to orange. Below the title, a long, winding queue of tiny, stylized figures waits before rows of minimalist white cube-shaped buildings; this includes 12 visible white building units extending into the distance, each with simple rectangular doors and windows, and a prominent open doorway on the right. The crowd should consist of dozens of diverse, casually dressed figures arranged in a winding line to create a sense of depth, with a staff member in a purple uniform guiding people through the open doorway. The design utilizes soft studio lighting, shallow depth of field, subtle shadows, glossy surfaces, and a high-tech advertising visual style. At the bottom center, a colorful, circular gradient app-style icon is placed, followed by black text.{argument name="brand name" default="HailuoAI"} Maintain a clean and simple composition, with the title occupying the upper half and the queue scene occupying the middle and lower areas.

promptLocalized.zh: 制作一张简洁的正方形宣传海报，采用暖米白色背景，呈现等轴测微缩 3D 立体模型。在顶部放置巨大的粗体圆角无衬线标题文本 {argument name="headline text" default="Seedance 2.0 无需等待"}，分为两行，并带有从蓝色和紫色过渡到洋红色再到橙色的鲜艳从左至右渐变效果。在标题下方，展示一条蜿蜒的长队，由微小的风格化人物组成，在成排的极简白色立方体建筑前等候；包含 12 个向远处延伸的可见白色建筑单元，每个单元都有简单的矩形门窗，右侧有一个显眼的开放式门口。人群应包含数十个穿着休闲装的多元化小人物，排列成蜿蜒的线条以营造深度感，一名身穿紫色制服的工作人员在开放式门口附近引导人们进入。使用柔和的摄影棚灯光、浅景深、微妙的阴影、光洁的表面以及高端科技广告的视觉风格。在底部中心，放置一个彩色圆形渐变应用风格图标，后跟黑色字标 {argument name="brand name" default="HailuoAI"}。保持构图空灵简约，标题占据上半部分，队列场景占据中部和下部区域。

templates.title: Ice Codex robot avatar

titleLocalized.zh: Ice Codex 机器人头像

templates.prompt: Create a full-body chibi-style Codex mascot with a clean white background featuring subtle icy blue splatter effects and soft tundra shadows. The character is a small, futuristic robot wearing an oversized deep navy black hooded parka and platform boots, presented as a highly detailed 3D digital illustration with a painterly texture, glossy sci-fi material, cyan outline lighting, and a cool Arctic color scheme. The hood is round, like a helmet, framing a black, rounded rectangular visor with two half-open, glowing cyan eyes. There is no mouth, and the expression is calm and unmoved. Add seven translucent, jagged ice crystals to the top and sides of the hood, with the longest crystal located at the top center, its edges emitting an electric blue glow with frost refraction and snowflake-like spots. Place two glowing atomic symbols on the outfit: a large cyan atomic symbol on the left side of the hood and a smaller one on the chest/left shoulder area. The torso armor is fluffy and segmented, adorned with cyan circuitry-like decorations, small luminous panels, wear marks, scratches, and glowing text on the chest.{argument name="chest text" default="DL"} In the character's left hand, five stacked, translucent, glowing cyan crystal data sheets or code pages are displayed; in the right hand, an open miniature laptop is shown, angled towards the viewer, with a black screen displaying cyan text filled with tiny, garbled characters. The design features a centered composition, an adorable proportion with a large head and short limbs, dramatic icy blue highlights, delicate snow/ice textures on the ground, and a high-quality mascot avatar appearance suitable for developer profile pictures. Custom avatars are available.{argument name="avatar theme" default="ice codex robot"} , pairing{argument name="primary color" default="deep navy blue"} armor and{argument name="glow color" default="cyan blue"} light.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个全身 Q 版 Codex 头像吉祥物，背景为干净的白色，带有淡淡的冰蓝色喷溅效果和柔和的冻土阴影。角色是一个小巧的未来感机器人，身穿超大号深海军黑连帽派克大衣和厚底靴，呈现为高细节的 3D 数字插画，具有绘画质感、光泽感科幻材质、青色轮廓光和冷色调的北极配色。兜帽呈圆形，像头盔一样，框住黑色的圆角矩形面罩，面罩上有两只半睁半闭的青色发光眼睛，没有嘴巴，表情平静且不为所动。在兜帽顶部和两侧添加 7 个半透明的锯齿状冰晶，最长的冰晶位于顶部中心，边缘发出电光蓝色的光芒，带有冰霜折射和雪花般的斑点。在套装上放置 2 个发光的原子标志：兜帽左侧有一个大的青色原子符号，胸部/左肩区域有一个较小的原子符号。躯干盔甲蓬松且分段，带有青色电路般的装饰、小型发光面板、磨损痕迹、划痕以及胸部发光的文字 {argument name="chest text" default="DL"}。在角色的左手中，展示 5 张叠在一起的半透明发光青色晶体数据表或代码页；在右手中，展示 1 台打开的微型笔记本电脑，角度朝向观众，屏幕为黑底青字，上面布满了细小的乱码。采用居中构图，大头短肢的可爱比例，戏剧性的冰蓝色高光，地面上有细腻的雪/冰纹理，以及适合开发者个人资料图片的优质吉祥物头像外观。自定义头像为 {argument name="avatar theme" default="ice codex robot"}，搭配 {argument name="primary color" default="deep navy blue"} 盔甲和 {argument name="glow color" default="cyan blue"} 灯光。

templates.title: Luxury Fragrance Fashion Sample

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华香水时尚样机

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image as a product base, transform a simple perfume bottle photograph into a studio-quality fashion advertising mockup. Maintain the accuracy and clarity of the perfume bottle design, label text, black cap, amber liquid, and glass shape, placing it in the foreground with a model's hand holding it close to the camera. Add a fashion model to the background, posing dynamically using a low-angle, wide-angle composition, wearing {argument name="suit color" default="Bright orange"} A suit, black shirt, black belt, and patent black dress shoes. The model should project a confident, editorial pose, with one leg extended forward, using perspective to exaggerate the product's proportions. A clean, warm beige studio background, professional softbox lighting, clear commercial product reflections, and shallow depth of field will create the feel of a high-end luxury perfume advertisement. The face should be kept inconspicuous or slightly blurred to ensure the product remains the visual focus. Overall atmosphere: bold, modern, high-fashion, and sophisticated studio mockup.

promptLocalized.zh: 以提供的参考图作为产品基础，将简单的香水瓶拍摄画面转换为摄影棚级别的时尚广告样机。保持香水瓶设计、标签文字、黑色瓶盖、琥珀色液体及玻璃形状的准确与清晰，将其置于前景，由一只模特的手靠近镜头握持。在背景中添加 1 位时尚模特，采用低角度广角构图进行动态摆拍，身着 {argument name="suit color" default="亮橙色"} 西装，内搭黑色衬衫，系黑色腰带，穿着亮面黑色正装皮鞋。模特需呈现自信的编辑风格姿态，一条腿向前伸展，并通过透视效果夸大产品比例。使用干净的暖米色摄影棚背景、专业的柔光箱照明、清晰的商业产品反射、浅景深效果，营造高端奢华香水广告的质感。保持面部不显眼或轻微模糊，以确保产品始终是视觉焦点。整体氛围：大胆、现代、高级时尚、精致的摄影棚样机。

templates.title: Luxury GPT Images 2.0 Release Poster

titleLocalized.zh: Luxury GPT Images 2.0 发布海报

templates.prompt: Create a picture for{argument name="product name" default="GPT Images"}{argument name="version number" default="2.0"} The luxurious vertical promotional poster employs a high-end cinematic 3D style. The main subject is an iridescent mosaic chameleon perched on a large pearl shell, both covered in tiny reflective mirror tiles and mother-of-pearl surfaces, shimmering with rose gold and cool cyan sheen. A gradient background from deep cyan to navy blue is used, embellished with shimmering particle dust, delicate and elegant orbital light trails, starburst lens flares, and a subtly reflective ground with scattered shimmering spots. The typography is prominently placed in the upper half: a total of four visible text elements, including an oversized metallic serif title…{argument name="headline text" default="GPT Images"} The separate small version number on the right.{argument name="version text" default="2.0"} The slogans stacked on the left side{argument name="tagline" default="Words are your vision."} ", and the brand logo with a colorful circular swirl icon in the lower right corner"{argument name="brand name" default="HailuoAI"} The main title uses an elegant, high-contrast Didot/Bodoni style serif font in a light silver chrome alloy material, with a delicate bevel effect and refined letter spacing. The overall composition should present the texture of a high-end technology launch advertisement: a glossy, magical feel, fashion magazine-like lighting, ultra-detailed 3D rendering, reflective caustics, soft volumetric lighting, with the focus clearly on the chameleon and seashell, using a 2:3 vertical aspect ratio.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张用于 {argument name="product name" default="GPT Images"} {argument name="version number" default="2.0"} 的奢华垂直宣传海报，采用高级电影级 3D 风格。画面主体为一只栖息在大型珍珠贝壳上的虹彩马赛克变色龙，两者均覆盖着微小的反光镜面瓷砖和珍珠母贝表面，闪烁着玫瑰金与冷青色的光泽。使用深青色至海军蓝的渐变背景，点缀着闪烁的粒子尘埃、纤细优雅的轨道光迹、星芒镜头光晕，以及带有零星闪烁光斑的微光反射地面。将排版醒目地置于上半部分：总共 4 个可见文本元素，包括超大金属衬线标题“{argument name="headline text" default="GPT Images"}”、右侧独立的小字版本号“{argument name="version text" default="2.0"}”、左侧堆叠的标语“{argument name="tagline" default="Words are your vision."}”，以及右下角带有彩色圆形漩涡图标的品牌标识“{argument name="brand name" default="HailuoAI"}”。主标题使用优雅、高对比度的 Didot/Bodoni 风格衬线字体，采用淡银色铬合金材质，带有细腻的斜角效果和精致的字间距。整体构图应呈现高端科技发布广告的质感：光泽感、魔幻感、时尚杂志般的布光、超精细 3D 渲染、反射焦散、柔和的体积光，焦点清晰地聚焦于变色龙和贝壳上，采用 2:3 垂直比例。

templates.title: Sunset over a mountain lake (oil painting)

titleLocalized.zh: 日落高山湖泊油画

templates.prompt: To create a magnificent romantic realist oil painting, depicting{argument name="time of day" default="Golden Sunset"} A desolate mountain wilderness at midday. In the foreground is a vast, tranquil mountain lake, reflecting the sky, pine forests, rocky shores, and towering snow-capped peaks. The majestic main peak, bathed in warm orange sunlight, is sharply defined, surrounded by rugged cliffs and distant glaciers gradually disappearing into the atmospheric mist. The sun, near the right horizon, casts a luminous amber light onto the water and illuminates scattered clouds in the blue-gold sky. Dense evergreen trees form both sides of the image: a dark forest barrier on the right and steep rocky cliffs on the left. Add subtle details: the rising mist from the lake, scattered rocks and driftwood in the foreground, the warm reflections on the water, and two deer standing on the right bank.{argument name="painting style" default="19th-century Hudson River School Romantic landscapes"} The style emphasizes highly detailed brushstrokes, a bright and grand feel, an epic scale, a tranquil atmosphere, rich and warm colors, naturalistic light and shadow, and is devoid of text and borders.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅宏伟的浪漫主义写实油画，描绘 {argument name="time of day" default="金色日落"} 时分的高山荒野。前景是一个广阔平静的山间湖泊，倒映着天空、松林、岩石海岸和高耸的雪峰。主峰雄伟壮丽，在温暖的橙色阳光照射下轮廓分明，周围环绕着崎岖的悬崖和逐渐隐入大气薄雾中的远方冰川。太阳位于右侧地平线附近，将发光的琥珀色光芒投射在水面上，并照亮了蓝金交织的天空中零散的云朵。茂密的常绿树木构成了画面的两侧，右侧是深色的森林屏障，左侧是陡峭的岩石悬崖。添加细腻的细节：湖面升起的薄雾、前景零星的岩石和浮木、水面上荡漾的温暖倒影，以及 2 只站在右侧岸边的鹿。使用 {argument name="painting style" default="19 世纪哈德逊河画派浪漫主义风景"} 风格，强调高细节笔触、明亮的大气感、史诗般的尺度、宁静的氛围、浓郁温暖的色调、自然主义光影，无文字，无边框。

templates.title: Qiu Liu Hanfu Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 秋柳汉服海报

templates.prompt: Create a vertical, cinematic, fantastical fashion poster that showcases elegant historical East Asian aesthetics: a young woman {argument name="character description" default="An elegant noblewoman, her chestnut-brown hair styled in a low bun and adorned with delicate little flower hairpins."} She stood sideways beneath the ancient willow tree, her reflection shimmering in the stream. Her face was deliberately rendered with a soft, square, warm-toned blur, while the rest of her features remained sharp. She was dressed in {argument name="outfit description" default="The layered beige and cream-colored embroidered Hanfu, adorned with red floral patterns, features wide long sleeves, a pleated skirt, and flowing rust-red ribbons."} Supporting on shoulders{argument name="umbrella description" default="A large, cream-colored oil-paper umbrella adorned with delicate red flowers, revealing its wooden ribs."} The image features only a woman, an open umbrella, a huge, dark, twisted willow trunk, many golden weeping branches, pale white flowers clustered at her feet, scattered rocks, and a calm stream reflecting warm light at the bottom. It employs warm, golden-moon autumnal tones, a dreamlike shallow depth of field, volumetric backlighting, soft bokeh, and highly detailed fabric embroidery, blending realistic painting style with luxurious fashion photography. The 9:16 poster composition places the full-body figure slightly to the left of center. A vertical calligraphic title is added to the right of the woman.{argument name="vertical title text" default="Yin Dao Lin Xuan Mi Pang"} It is accompanied by two tiny butterfly patterns, and below it is an elegant serif subtitle.{argument name="subtitle text" default="INICE SOND MIOSE SURTAL AUTMON"} At the very bottom, there are several lines of small, decorative serif text centered in the center, deliberately rendered mostly unreadable, creating the effect of an art book or poster footer. Maintaining a tranquil, poetic, late autumn atmosphere, it emphasizes delicate natural textures and avoids any modern elements.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖版电影感奇幻时尚海报，呈现优雅的历史东亚美学：一位年轻女子，{argument name="character description" default="一位优雅的贵族女性，栗棕色头发梳成低发髻，饰有精致的小花发簪"}，侧身站在古柳树下浅浅的倒影溪流旁。她的面部被刻意处理为柔和的方形暖色模糊效果，而其余人物细节清晰。她身着 {argument name="outfit description" default="层叠的米色与奶油色刺绣汉服，饰有红色花卉图案，宽大的长袖，百褶裙，以及飘逸的铁锈红丝带"}，肩上撑着 {argument name="umbrella description" default="一把绘有精致红花、露出木质伞骨的大型奶油色油纸伞"}。画面中仅包含一名女子、一把撑开的伞、一棵巨大的深色扭曲柳树树干、许多金色的垂柳枝、脚边簇拥的浅白色花朵、散落的岩石，以及底部反射着暖光的平静溪流。采用温暖的深秋黄金时刻色调，梦幻般的浅景深，体积光背光，柔和的焦外成像，高度精细的织物刺绣，融合写实绘画风格与奢华时尚摄影，9:16 海报构图，全身人物居中偏左。在女子右侧添加竖排书法标题 {argument name="vertical title text" default="茵悼晽萱弥旁"}，旁边配有两个微小的蝴蝶图案，下方添加一行优雅的小字衬线副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="INICE SOND MIOSE SURTAL AUTMON"}。在最底部，包含几行居中的细小装饰性衬线信用文字，刻意处理为大部分不可读，呈现艺术画册海报页脚的效果。保持宁静、诗意、深秋的氛围，强调细腻的自然纹理，且不包含任何现代物品。

templates.title: Convert Sims screenshots to CCD style photos

titleLocalized.zh: 将 Sims 截图转换为 CCD 风格照片

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the base image, convert screenshots from The Sims 4 into realistic images.{argument name="photo style" default="CCD digital camera photos from the early 21st century"} Retain the original figures, clothing, poses, framing, store entrance, metal grille, bicycles, street, and overall composition, but make it look like a realistic candid photograph, not a game render. Add a cool-toned twilight effect, a strong built-in flash effect on the subject, a wet, rain-soaked pavement with subtle reflections, a softened background depth of field, slight underexposure, visible digital noise, slight chromatic aberration, lens bokeh, vignetting, and a low-resolution CCD texture. Anonymize the face with a soft, square blur effect. Maintain a natural 16:9 snapshot aspect ratio and an imperfect, casual composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 作为底图，将《模拟人生 4》(Sims 4) 截图转换为写实的 {argument name="photo style" default="21 世纪初 CCD 数码相机照片"}。保持原有的人物、服装、姿势、取景、店面入口、金属格栅、自行车、街道以及整体构图，但要使其看起来像是一张真实的抓拍照片，而非游戏渲染图。添加冷色调的暮光效果、主体上强烈的内置闪光灯效果、带有细微反射的潮湿雨后路面、柔化的背景景深、轻微的曝光不足、可见的数字噪点、轻微的色差、镜头柔光、暗角以及低分辨率的 CCD 质感。将面部匿名化处理为柔和的方形模糊效果。保持自然的 16:9 快照比例和不完美的随意构图。

variables.defaultValue: CCD digital camera photos from the early 21st century

templates.title: Convert Sims 4 screenshots to CCD carnival selfies

titleLocalized.zh: 将 Sims 4 截图转换为 CCD 嘉年华自拍

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference images as the basis for Sims 4 characters, they are transformed into realistic ones.{argument name="photo style" default="CCD digital camera flash photos"} This is not a game screenshot. The character is positioned in a close-up, handheld selfie pose, wearing {argument name="outfit" default="pure white sweatshirt"} One arm is extended towards the camera, and the other hand is giving a thumbs-up. Change the scene to {argument name="new setting" default="Nighttime amusement parks or carnivals"} The image exhibits a strong on-camera flash effect, slightly harsh highlights, low-light noise, minor blur, and a retro point-and-shoot camera color palette. A festive background is added, including a red carpet walkway, striped carnival stalls, glowing lightbox bulbs, string lights, trees, and exactly six visible balloons: four on the left in purple, green, green, and yellow, and two on the right in blue and red. The square mosaic obscuring the face from the reference image is retained, but the overall image is made to look like a realistic snapshot rather than a rendered scene.

promptLocalized.zh: 以提供的参考图像作为 Sims 4 角色基础，将其转换为逼真的 {argument name="photo style" default="CCD 数码相机闪光灯照片"}，而非游戏截图。将角色调整为近距离手持自拍姿势，身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="纯白色卫衣"}，一只手臂伸向镜头，另一只手比出大拇指。将场景更改为 {argument name="new setting" default="夜间游乐园或嘉年华"}，呈现强烈的机顶闪光灯效果、略显生硬的高光、低光噪点、轻微模糊以及怀旧的卡片机色彩。添加充满节日氛围的背景，包括红地毯步道、条纹嘉年华摊位、发光的灯箱灯泡、串灯、树木，以及正好 6 个可见的气球：左侧 4 个分别为紫色、绿色、绿色和黄色，右侧 2 个分别为蓝色和红色。保留参考图中遮挡面部的方形马赛克，但使整体图像看起来像是一张真实的随手拍照片，而非渲染场景。

templates.title: Da Vinci Awards trophy presentation scene

titleLocalized.zh: Da Vinci Awards 奖杯领奖场景

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic, photorealistic still from an awards ceremony, featuring the main character as {argument name="character name" default="John C. Swaggert"} A silver-haired actor, dressed in a black tuxedo with a white shirt, a light silver tie, and a white pocket square, stood behind an elegant black and gold podium on the grand theater stage. His face was covered by a flat, skin-colored rectangular privacy mask, similarly obscuring the faces of the audience with small skin-colored squares. In his left hand, he held up a magnificent, large gold trophy: a ring containing a small Vitruvian-style sculpture, with small holes in the ring, a black base engraved with a gold plaque that read "THE VITRUVIAN CINEMATIC ACHIEVEMENT AWARD." The podium also bore the inscription "THE VITRUVIAN CINEMATIC ACHIEVEMENT AWARD" in gold serif font, below which was a gold eagle emblem. Behind him, a large American flag hung in the background on the left, and on the right was a large black stage screen with the inscription "THE VITRUVIAN CINEMATIC ACHIEVEMENT AWARD" in gold serif font.{argument name="event title" default="The 97th Da Vinci Awards"} The image features a small gold eagle emblem. A black microphone is placed in the center of the frame, complemented by warm chandelier lighting, golden architectural details, spotlights piercing through the mist, and blurred applause from audience members in formal evening attire, creating a luxurious patriotic banquet atmosphere. The composition employs a wide 4:3 aspect ratio, shallow depth of field, realistic lens perspective, rich, warm lighting, clear details of the trophy, and a high-end broadcast-quality event photography style.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影级照片写实的颁奖典礼剧照，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="John C. Swaggert"}，一位银发男演员，身穿黑色燕尾服，内搭白色衬衫，系浅银色领带，佩戴白色口袋巾，站在大剧院舞台上优雅的黑金讲台后。他的面部被一个平坦的肤色矩形隐私遮罩覆盖，观众的面部也同样用小的肤色方块遮挡。他左手举起一座精美的大型金色奖杯：一个圆环内嵌维特鲁威人风格的小雕像，圆环上有小圆孔，底座为黑色，上面刻有金色铭牌，写着“THE VITRUVIAN CINEMATIC ACHIEVEMENT AWARD”。讲台正面也用金色衬线字体写着“THE VITRUVIAN CINEMATIC ACHIEVEMENT AWARD”，下方配有金色鹰徽。在他身后，左侧背景悬挂着巨大的美国国旗，右侧是一个大型黑色舞台屏幕，上面用金色衬线字体写着“{argument name="event title" default="The 97th Da Vinci Awards"}”，并配有一个小型金色鹰标。画面中央放置一个黑色麦克风，配以温暖的吊灯灯光、金色的建筑细节、穿透薄雾的聚光灯、身着正式晚礼服的观众虚化鼓掌效果，营造出奢华的爱国晚宴氛围。采用宽幅 4:3 构图，浅景深，真实的镜头透视，浓郁温暖的灯光，清晰的奖杯细节，以及高端广播级活动摄影风格。

promptLocalized.zh: {"type":"四格 AI 风格转换对比拼图","purpose":"创建一张社交媒体对比图，展示同一位赛博朋克少女姿势在四种风格下的渲染效果，从动漫到写实","canvas":{"orientation":"纵向","aspect_ratio":"3:4","resolution":"768x1024","background":"单张拼图，采用对角线和矩形面板分割，无外边框"},"main_subject":{"description":"一位时尚年轻女性，采取蹲姿游戏玩家姿势，一只膝盖抬起靠近镜头，一只手靠近嘴部，另一只手臂放在腿上，留着长长的淡粉金色头发，带有青色挑染，戴着黑色渔夫帽，穿着超大号黑色印花 T 恤，黑色磨边牛仔短裤，佩戴黑色手镯、耳环和朋克饰品","face_treatment":"每个面板中脸部均被一个柔和的矩形遮挡块刻意遮盖","customizable_identity":"{argument name=\"角色名称\" default=\"匿名赛博朋克游戏少女\"}","hair_color":"{argument name=\"头发颜色\" default=\"淡粉金色，带有青色挑染\"}","outfit":"{argument name=\"服装风格\" default=\"黑色渔夫帽，超大号黑色印花 T 恤，黑色磨边牛仔短裤，朋克手镯\"}"},"setting":{"description":"霓虹灯游戏卧室或网吧，配有显示器、海报、发光兔子标志、粉色和紫色 LED 灯光、动漫墙绘，充满赛博朋克氛围","signage_count":3,"visible_signage":["粉色霓虹兔子图标","GAME OVER 海报或霓虹灯","黑色和粉色骷髅笑脸海报"]},"layout":{"panel_count":4,"panels":[{"position":"左上","style":"Niji 风格动漫插画，色调更暗更忧郁，具有绘画感的动漫阴影，精细的线条","label":"{argument name=\"左上标签\" default=\"Niji\"}","notes":"相同的坐姿，黑色渔夫帽，长发飘逸，模糊的脸部遮挡块，柔和的冷色背景"},{"position":"右上","style":"Gpt image 2.0 动漫，更明亮精致的动漫渲染，清晰的轮廓，生动的粉色和青色高光，光泽感角色艺术","label":"Gpt image2.0 动漫","notes":"相同的姿势，大腿和上半身的近景裁剪，背景为色彩鲜艳的波普艺术墙"},{"position":"左下","style":"Gpt image 2.0 半写实动漫，略带写实的动漫外观，皮肤和光影更柔和，但仍保留插画感","label":"Gpt image2.0 ちょいリアル","notes":"相同的姿势，背景有霓虹兔子标志和显示器，强烈的洋红色灯光"},{"position":"右下","style":"Gpt image 2.0 照片级写实版本，真实的相机摄影外观，较暗的曝光，真实的皮肤纹理，真实的织物和头发质感","label":"Gpt image2.0 実写","notes":"相同的姿势，电竞椅和霓虹背景，脸部被矩形模糊遮盖"}]},"annotations":{"arrow_count":3,"arrows":"粗线条手绘白色弯曲箭头，展示从左上到右上、右上到左下、左下到右下的演变过程","text_style":"白色手写笔刷字体，略微倾斜，休闲社交媒体标记风格","comparison_flow":"Niji 动漫源风格逐渐转换为 GPT image 2.0 动漫、半写实动漫和照片级写实输出"},"composition":{"camera":"低角度近景，强调抬起的膝盖和坐姿，时尚摄影构图","lighting":"高对比度霓虹粉、紫、青和蓝色反射光","mood":"前卫、时尚、赛博朋克、游戏少女美学","quality":"高细节、清晰、有光泽、社交媒体对比拼图"},"negative_prompt":"避免额外的面板，避免无法辨认的标签，避免在面板之间改变坐姿，避免未遮盖的脸部，避免肢体扭曲，避免多余的手指，避免杂乱的拼图对齐"}

1500 多座活火山，它们在不断改变着地球的面貌！"},{"title":"岩浆 vs 熔岩","position":"左侧下部绿色卡片","content":"岩浆：在地下还没喷出来的炽热岩石，温度可达 700~1200°C。熔岩：喷出地表的岩浆，流动时会逐渐冷却。","includes":"两幅小型对比插图"},{"title":"火山喷发会带来什么？","position":"左下角浅黄色卡片","content":"列举 3 种影响并配图标：带来适合植物生长的肥沃土壤，形成新的陆地和岛屿，但也可能造成火山灰和熔岩流灾害。"},{"title":"小小观察家","position":"右下角浅黄色卡片","content":"火山周围常有丰富的矿物、温泉和独特的生态系统，是地球送给我们的礼物！","includes":"放大镜插图"}]},"detail_insets":{"count":2,"items":[{"position":"右侧中部","shape":"圆形放大剖面","content":"四个可见层标注：火山灰、火山弹、浮石层、火山灰"},{"position":"右侧下部","shape":"圆形放大剖面","content":"棕色与灰色地下岩层的特写"}]},"small_figures":{"count":6,"items":["左上方的一名儿童探险家吉祥物","火山左侧基部三名背着背包、拿着望远镜的小探险家","左下方草丛中的一只狐狸","左侧山谷上方的一只飞鹰"]}},"rendering_instructions":"创建一张连贯的剖面图，确保每个带编号的箭头都指向正确的火山结构。使岩浆呈现白炽色，带有黄白色高光和橙红色边缘，添加烟雾、火山灰颗粒、熔岩裂缝、逼真的分层岩层，以及带有黄色数字徽章的整洁圆角标注框。保持所有中文字符清晰易读，并像精美的教育书籍页面一样进行排版。","customizable_subject":"{argument   "type": "Children's Science Popularization Medical Infographic Poster",

  "main_visual": {
    "subject": "Large central anatomical section of the human heart",

    "main_labels": [
      "superior vena cava",
      "Pulmonary artery",
      "right atrium",
      "Tricuspid valve",
      "Right ventricle",
      "Inferior vena cava",
      "aorta",
      "pulmonary veins",
      "left atrium",
      "Mitral valve",
      "Left ventricle",
      "Ventricular septum"
    ]
  },
  "layout": {
    "format": "Vertical infographic, 4:5 aspect ratio",
    "top_header": "The word \"heart\" is written in large red handwriting, and the title reads \"The Human Body's Super Pump\" in blue. Next to the title is a small mascot representing the heart/red blood cell.",
    "right_column": {
      "sections_count": 4,
      "sections": [
        {
          "title": "Blood circulation route map",
          "position": "Top right",
          "content": "Miniature illustrations featuring icons of the heart, lungs, and body, along with red and blue arrows.",
          "legend_count": 2,
          "legend_labels": [
            "hypoxic blood",
            "Oxygenated blood"
          ],
          "step_count": 4,
          "step_labels": [
            "1. Deoxygenated blood returns from the whole body to the heart.",
            "2. Sent to the lungs for gas exchange",
            "3. Oxygenated blood travels from the lungs to the heart.",
            "4. Pumped to all parts of the body"
          ]
        },
        {
          "title": "1. Valve opening and closing",
          "position": "Center upper right",
          "content": "Two small cross-sectional views of the heart, showing the opening and closing of the valves.",
          "diagram_count": 2,
          "labels": [
            "The valves open and blood flows into the ventricles.",
            "The valves close to prevent blood from flowing backward."
          ]
        },
        {
          "title": "2. Myocardial layer structure",
          "position": "center right",
          "content": "Close-up of the layers of the heart wall, accompanied by a pediatrician mascot.",
          "labels_count": 3,
          "labels": [
            "Endocardium",
            "Myocardial layer (thick and strong)",
            "Epicardium"
          ],
          "caption": "The heart muscle is like a strong muscle; it pumps blood when it contracts!"
        },
        {
          "title": "3. Heart rhythm",
          "position": "Bottom right",
          "content": "Electrocardiogram (ECG) line graph and brief popular science knowledge",
          "facts_count": 2,
          "facts": [
            "Normal adult heart rate: 60-100 beats/min",
            "During exercise, your heart rate increases, giving your body more energy!"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    "bottom_area": {
      "sections_count": 3,
      "sections": [
        {
          "title": "Color Tips",
          "position": "Bottom left",
          "item_count": 2,
          "items": [
            "Blue = hypoxic blood (low oxygen content)",
            "Red = Oxygenated blood (high oxygen content)"
          ],
          "decor": "The red blood cell mascot is observing through a telescope."
        },
        {
          "title": "Knowledge Tips",
          "position": "Shimonaka",
          "bullet_count": 5,
          "bullets": [
            "The heart is like a pump that never stops working.",
            "The left ventricle has the thickest muscle, allowing it to pump blood further.",
            "The valves act like small doors, allowing blood to flow in only one direction.",
            "A single heartbeat (heart contraction + relaxation) propels blood forward.",
            "Good habits for a healthier heart: exercise, sleep, and avoiding staying up late!"
          ]
        },
        {
          "title": "speech bubbles",
          "position": "Bottom right",
          "text": "{argument name=\"doctor speech bubble\" default=\"Thank you for your hard work!\"}",
          "decor": "The female doctor character stands next to an adorable mechanical heart pump and smiling red blood cells."
        }
      ]
    },
    "left_annotations": "A dashed guide line leads from the label to the heart structure, with a brief Chinese explanation below each label.",
    "character_elements_count": 5,
    "character_elements": [
      "Small red blood cell mascot near the top title",
      "Three smiling red blood cell mascots in the heart chambers and blood vessels",
      "The male doctor holding a magnifying glass in the bottom left corner",
      "The female doctor displaying knowledge tips in the lower middle position",
      "The mechanical heart pump character in the bottom right corner"
    ]
  },
  "text_rendering": "All visible labels are in Simplified Chinese, clear and easy to read, and are accompanied by rounded colored label borders and dashed annotation lines.",
  "lighting": "Soft, glossy highlights, clean shadows, high-resolution, print-quality composition.",
  "avoid": "The realistic, gory, and gloomy style of the medical textbook, the messy and barely legible tiny text, and the English labels."
}

templates.prompt: Generate a realistic vertical mobile phone street snapshot, in which {argument name="subject" default="An adult woman with shoulder-length dark brown wavy hair"} On a sun-drenched sidewalk in a Japanese city, she crouches in front of a wide-angle lens. She's in a low crouch, leaning forward, one elbow resting on her knee, the other outstretched towards the camera, making her hand and long, pale pink glossy nails stand out prominently in the foreground. Her face is completely obscured by a centered, opaque, brownish-pink blurry square, creating an anonymity effect. She wears a tight-fitting, low-cut top.{argument name="top color" default="White"} A short-sleeved top, light-wash blue jeans, and beige transparent square-toed sandals. The photo utilizes strong midday sunlight, deep shadows on the asphalt pavement, realistic skin highlights, hair flowing in the wind, a paparazzi-like composition, a slightly tilted angle, ultra-realistic mobile phone camera quality, shallow depth of field, perspective distortion, and high detail. The background is a street corner in a Japanese city, including tiled building facades, green awnings, vertical utility poles with stickers and handwritten Japanese markings, blue pedestrian signs, and other items {argument name="restaurant sign text" default="かめや"} The restaurant signboard; more small Japanese signs and street clutter were added to enhance realism. Shot from an extremely low angle close to the ground, with tight cropping, a 9:16 vertical screen ratio, and a realistic documentary style, rejecting illustration or anime feel.

promptLocalized.zh: 生成一张写实风格的竖版手机街头抓拍，画面中 {argument name="subject" default="一位留着齐肩深棕色波浪卷发的成年女性"} 在阳光明媚的日本城市人行道上，蹲伏在广角镜头前。她呈低蹲姿势，身体前倾，一只手肘抵在膝盖上，另一只手向镜头伸出，使手部和修长的淡粉色光泽美甲在前景中显得格外突出。她的脸部被一个居中的不透明棕粉色模糊方块完全遮盖，呈现出匿名效果。她身穿一件紧身低胸 {argument name="top color" default="白色"} 短袖上衣、浅色水洗蓝牛仔裤和米色透明带方头凉鞋。采用正午强烈的阳光，沥青路面上的浓重阴影，逼真的皮肤高光，随风飘动的发丝，类似狗仔队的抓拍构图，略微倾斜的视角，超真实的手机拍摄质感，浅景深透视畸变，以及高细节表现。背景是日本城市街角，包含贴有瓷砖的建筑立面、绿色遮阳棚、带有贴纸和手写日文标记的垂直电线杆、蓝色行人路标，以及写有 {argument name="restaurant sign text" default="かめや"} 的餐厅招牌；加入更多细小的日文标志和街头杂物以增强真实感。采用近地面的极低角度拍摄，紧凑裁剪，9:16 竖屏比例，写实纪录片风格，拒绝插画或动漫感。
