templates.title: Anime-style ChatGPT partners in learning scenarios

titleLocalized.zh: 学习场景中的动漫版 ChatGPT 伙伴

templates.prompt: Create a refined anthropomorphic character in an anime style,{argument name="AI character name" default="ChatGPT"} She is depicted as a gentle, young female AI companion in a warm, sunlit study. She has a short, silver-white bob with soft waves, braided into small braids, the ends of which fade to a light blue hue. She wears a light blue OpenAI knot hair accessory and ribbon; her face is obscured by a centrally located beige square mosaic. She wears an elegant white academic robe with wide, light blue linings on the cuffs, over which she wears a black dress or vest, and a light blue tie with gold trim, small tech-inspired badges, and a light blue ribbon emblem on her sleeve. She sits at a wooden desk, holding a dark book with the words "Knowledge Understanding Inspiration" and a small OpenAI-style knot symbol on the cover, her other hand raised as if displaying a holographic projection. To her left floats a semi-transparent cyan chat bubble labeled "ChatGPT" with the text "Your AI companion. Here to help, inspire, and understand." Next to it is a small heart. Surrounding the bubble are three smaller, glowing square icons: a light bulb icon, a magnifying glass icon, and a chat message icon. The desk must contain eight clearly visible learning items: a dark mug with the OpenAI-style logo and "ChatGPT," a stack of four books labeled "Science," "History," "Art," and "Philosophy," a cyan fountain pen, an open notebook, a black book held by the character, and a small white robot mascot with glowing cyan eyes and the OpenAI-style logo. The open notebook has two pages: the left page is titled "Ideas," with notes on "Conversations," "Possibilities," and "Infinite"; the right page is titled "Today's Plan," with a list of items including "Help someone," "Spark ideas," and "Make a difference," accompanied by doodles and hearts. The background depicts a cozy library with bookshelves, potted plants, sunlight streaming through windows, and a dark blackboard. The blackboard displays an OpenAI-style knot and the phrase "Together, we can:," followed by five bullet points: "Learn," "Create," "Solve," "Explore," and "and more!", decorated with small star and cat face doodles. The artwork employs a soft, anime-style style with bright rim lighting, using cyan and cream tones, delicate highlights, rich detail, and a shallow depth of field to create a warm and optimistic atmosphere, using a vertical composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个精致的动漫风格拟人化形象，将 {argument name="AI character name" default="ChatGPT"} 描绘成一位在温暖阳光书房中的温柔年轻女性 AI 伙伴。她留着带柔和波浪的银白色短波波头，编有小辫子，发梢呈青色渐变，并佩戴着青色的 OpenAI 结发饰和丝带；她的脸部被一个居中的米色方形马赛克遮挡。她身穿优雅的白色学术长袍，宽大的袖口内衬为青色，内搭黑色连衣裙或马甲，系着青色领带，配有金色镶边、小型科技感徽章，袖子上有一个青色丝带纹章。她坐在木质书桌前，怀中抱着一本深色书籍，封面上印有“Knowledge Understanding Inspiration”字样和一个小型的 OpenAI 风格结符号，另一只手抬起，仿佛正在展示全息投影。在她的左侧漂浮着一个半透明的青色聊天气泡，上面标有“ChatGPT”字样，文字内容为“Your AI companion. Here to help, inspire, and understand.”，旁边还有一个小爱心；气泡周围环绕着三个较小的发光方形图标：一个灯泡图标、一个放大镜图标和一个聊天信息图标。书桌上需包含 8 个清晰可见的学习用品：一个印有 OpenAI 风格结标志和“ChatGPT”字样的深色马克杯、一叠标有“Science”、“History”、“Art”和“Philosophy”的四本书、一支青色钢笔、一本打开的笔记本、角色手中持有的黑色书籍，以及一个带有青色发光眼睛和 OpenAI 风格标志的小型白色机器人吉祥物。打开的笔记本有两页：左页标题为“Ideas”，笔记内容为“Conversations”、“Possibilities”和“Infinite”；右页标题为“Today’s Plan”，清单项目包括“Help someone”、“Spark ideas”和“Make a difference”，并配有小涂鸦和爱心。背景展示一个温馨的图书馆，配有书架、盆栽、透过窗户射入的阳光以及一块深色黑板。黑板上显示着一个 OpenAI 风格的结符号和短语“Together, we can:”，后接 5 个项目符号点：“Learn”、“Create”、“Solve”、“Explore”和“and more!”，并装饰有小星星涂鸦和猫脸涂鸦。采用柔和的动漫绘画风格，带有明亮的轮廓光，使用青色和奶油色调，高光细腻，细节丰富，景深较浅，营造出温馨乐观的氛围，采用竖构图。

templates.title: Chaotic Comic Uniform Transformation

titleLocalized.zh: 混乱漫画制服变身

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as a composition reference and REFERENCE_1 as a character/pose reference, the sketches were transformed into exquisite, high-energy comic/anime illustrations. The arrangement of the four characters was maintained: a large, muscular student in the center rear showing off his arms; a small, white-haired student in a crouching/action pose in the lower left corner; a slender, standing student raising his fist on the right; and a cropped close-up of a pink-haired student's shocked face in the lower left corner. The rough, colored sketches were converted into clean, ink-line art, complemented by vibrant cel shading, strong comic paneling, and exaggerated perspective. A chaotic explosion background was added behind the three full-body characters, including orange-yellow sparks, smoke, speed lines, impact spikes, and comic-style explosion shapes. Two visible Japanese text elements were added: a large sound effect in the upper left corner.{argument name="sound effect text" default="カオス!"} And the jagged speech bubble in the bottom right corner, the content of which is{argument name="speech bubble text" default="What!? My school uniform!?"} The school uniform theme from REFERENCE_1 is retained, but rendered as finished outfits: the characters in the middle and on the left wear mint green sweaters and teal skirts, while the character on the right wears a dark, fitted uniform, and the foreground in the lower left corner features a shocked close-up of their faces. A dynamic shonen comedy comic book style is adopted, using bold outlines, dramatic motion lines, saturated colors, and layered comic book effects.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 作为构图参考，REFERENCE_1 作为角色/姿势参考，将草图转化为精美、高能量的漫画/动画插图。保持 4 个角色的排列：中间后方是一个巨大的肌肉发达的学生正在展示手臂，左下角是一个白发小个子学生处于蹲伏/动作姿势，右侧是一个苗条的站立学生正在举起拳头，左下角是一个被裁切的粉发震惊特写脸部。将粗糙的彩色草图转换为干净的墨线稿，并配以鲜艳的赛璐珞阴影、强烈的漫画分镜感和夸张的透视效果。在三个全身角色身后添加混乱的爆炸背景，包括橙黄色火花、烟雾、速度线、冲击尖刺和漫画爆炸形状。添加 2 个可见的日语文本元素：左上角的大型音效 {argument name="sound effect text" default="カオス!"} 和右下角的锯齿状对话气泡，内容为 {argument name="speech bubble text" default="えぇっ!?\n私の制服!?"}。保留 REFERENCE_1 中的校服主题，但将其渲染为成品服装：中间和左侧角色采用薄荷绿毛衣和蓝绿色裙子，右侧角色采用深色修身制服，左下角前景为震惊的特写脸部。采用动态少年喜剧漫画页面风格，使用粗轮廓线、戏剧性的运动线条、饱和的色彩和分层漫画效果。

templates.title: Cinematic trampoline photography

titleLocalized.zh: 电影感跳床摄影

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic ultra-wide-angle, low-angle action photo in a dimly lit setting.{argument name="room type" default="Hotel Bedroom"} Inside, a photo taken from below, looking up at the messy white bed.{argument name="number of people" default="Two"} vibrant{argument name="subjects" default="young women"} Leaping high above the mattress. The larger subject on the right freezes in mid-air, knees bent, arms outstretched, barefoot, long black hair flying wildly upwards, wearing a white sleeveless crop top and light yellow shorts. The smaller subject on the left also leaps on the bed, arms raised high, wild black hair swaying with the movement, wearing a yellow tank top with white lace trim and blue denim shorts. Keep both faces blurred or softly obscured by movement and shadows, while emphasizing body movements, flying hair, and playful energy. Use dramatic warm-toned hotel lighting: bright backlighting behind the jumpers creates dazzling rim lighting, lens flare, dust particles in the air, and strong silhouettes; warm glow from bedside lamps on either side, curtains on the right, framed artwork on the left wall, a dark headboard, disheveled white sheets, and a large pillow in the foreground. The camera angle needs to be extremely close to the bed surface, employing a 24mm wide-angle perspective, dynamic diagonal composition, slight fisheye distortion, shallow depth of field, high ISO film grain, realistic skin tones, clear fabric textures, motion blur of hair and limbs, and a spontaneous, candid atmosphere. Style:{argument name="visual style" default="Photorealistic, cinematic editing and photography"} Warm-toned shadows, high contrast, a chaotic yet joyful atmosphere, no text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影感超广角低角度动作照片，场景位于光线昏暗的 {argument name="room type" default="酒店卧室"} 内，从凌乱的白色床面向上仰拍，{argument name="number of people" default="两名"} 充满活力的 {argument name="subjects" default="年轻女性"} 在床垫上方高高跃起。右侧较大的主体在空中定格，双膝弯曲，双臂张开，露出赤脚，长长的黑发凌乱地向上飞扬，身穿白色无袖短款上衣和浅黄色短裤。左侧较小的主体也在床上跳跃，双臂高举，凌乱的黑发随动作摆动，身穿带有白色蕾丝花边的黄色吊带衫和蓝色牛仔短裤。保持两人的面部模糊或被动作与阴影柔和遮挡，同时强调肢体动作、飞扬的头发和俏皮的活力。使用戏剧性的暖色调酒店灯光：跳跃者身后的明亮背光营造出耀眼的轮廓光、镜头光晕、空气中的尘埃颗粒以及强烈的剪影；两侧床头灯发出温暖的光芒，右侧有窗帘，左侧墙上有装裱的画作，深色床头板，凌乱的白色床单，前景中有大枕头。相机视角需极度贴近床面，采用 24mm 广角透视、动态对角线构图、轻微鱼眼畸变、浅景深、高 ISO 胶片颗粒感、真实的肤色、清晰的织物纹理、头发和四肢的动态模糊，以及自发性的抓拍氛围。风格：{argument name="visual style" default="照片级逼真的电影感编辑摄影"}，暖色调阴影，高对比度，混乱而欢乐的氛围，无文字，无水印。

titleLocalized.zh: 佩戴听诊器的护士肖像

templates.prompt: Create a realistic, frontal half-body portrait photograph, with the subject being a{argument name="profession" default="Female nurses or clinicians"} The background is a solid gray-white textured wall. The main character is wearing {argument name="scrub color" default="Claret"} The observer wears a V-neck medical scrub suit with short sleeves and a small chest pocket on the right side, with metal snap details near the collar. A delicate stethoscope hangs naturally around the neck, with black tubing, silver metal ear loops, and gray earplugs near the pocket; the round stethoscope head is positioned on the left side. The subject has medium-length brown hair tied back with a few stray strands near the ears. The posture is upright and neutral, with level shoulders. The face is intentionally obscured by a large square mosaic of skin-toned privacy, concealing all facial features while retaining the hair, ears, neck, clothing, and stethoscope. promptLocalized.zh: 创建一张逼真的、正面半身肖像照片，主角为一名 {argument name="profession" default="女性护士或临床医生"}，背景为一面纯色灰白色纹理墙。主体穿着 {argument name="scrub color" default="酒红色"} V 领医疗刷手服，短袖，观察者右侧有一个小胸袋，领口附近有金属按扣细节。一条精致的听诊器自然地挂在脖子上，黑色管路，银色金属耳挂，灰色耳塞靠近口袋，圆形的听诊头位于观察者左侧。人物留着中等长度的棕色头发，向后扎起，耳边有几缕碎发，姿态中立挺拔，双肩平齐，构图居中，裁剪范围从头顶上方到躯干中部。面部被一个大的方形肤色隐私马赛克块有意遮挡，隐藏了所有面部特征，同时保留了头发、耳朵、颈部、服装和听诊器。使用柔和均匀的室内光线，呈现清晰的摄影细节、自然的色彩、极简的背景，以及干净的临床证件照风格。

templates.title: Full-page storyboard for color comics

titleLocalized.zh: 彩色动漫漫画跨页分镜

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as a composition reference and REFERENCE_1 as a detailed pose/layout reference, the sketch was transformed into a beautiful full-color anime/manga storyboard. The same four-person arrangement and pose were maintained: a strong student in the middle rear showing off his muscles, a blond student on the right showing off his muscles, a short, white-haired student on the left crouching and gathering strength, and a red-haired character in the lower left foreground who was heavily cropped out and showed a shocked expression. The rough structural lines were replaced with clean ink lines, cel shading, and a complete school uniform color scheme. A high-energy manga background not present in the reference image was added: dense blue radial speed lines, halftone textures, blue and yellow star patterns, and a yellow manga explosion effect. A jagged dialogue box containing vertically arranged Japanese text was retained in the lower right corner.{argument name="speech bubble text" default="なにしてんの?"} This results in a final image with a dramatic, comedic, comic-book-style spread effect, featuring clear outlines, saturated colors, and dynamic visual impact.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 作为构图参考，REFERENCE_1 作为精细姿势/布局参考，将草图转化为精美的全彩动漫漫画分镜。保持相同的 4 人排列和姿势：中间后方 1 名强壮的学生正在展示肌肉，右侧 1 名金发学生正在展示肌肉，左侧 1 名白发小个子学生呈蹲姿蓄力，左下角前景 1 名红发角色被大面积截取并表现出震惊的表情。将粗糙的结构线替换为干净的墨线、赛璐珞阴影以及完整的校服配色。添加参考图中没有的高能漫画背景：密集的蓝色放射状速度线、网点纹理、蓝黄色星形图案以及黄色漫画爆炸特效。在右下角保留 1 个锯齿状对话框，其中包含垂直排列的日语文本 {argument name="speech bubble text" default="なにしてんの?"}。使最终图像呈现出戏剧性的喜剧少年漫画跨页分镜效果，具备清晰的轮廓、饱和的色彩和动态的视觉冲击力。

templates.title: Anime-style hikers and stunning mountain scenery

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫风格徒步者与绝美山景

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the base landscape, all YAMAP branding, dates, routes, and data overlay text were removed, transforming the scene into a refined anime-style travel illustration while retaining the mountaintop perspective overlooking the city, lake, distant mountains, hazy sky, and green forest foreground. A foreground character was added: a young anime hiker, shown from behind/three-quarter profile, standing atop an ancient stone castle wall gazing at the scenery. Character settings were then configured.{argument name="hair color" default="Long light blue hair"} The character wears a high ponytail adorned with a blue ribbon and star hair accessories, a light blue hiking shirt, beige cargo hiking pants, brown hiking boots, fingerless gloves, and carries a large dark hiking backpack. Add four clearly visible equipment/accessory elements to or near the character: a rolled-up sleeping mat strapped to the backpack, a hanging blue star pendant, a small blue bird perched near the shoulder, and a small hiking pouch/shoulder strap detail. Add weathered rocks at the character's feet and softly blurred green leaves in the lower foreground to enhance depth. Maintain a serene and aesthetically pleasing composition, showcasing bright morning light, a soft, atmospheric haze, clear anime-style lines for the character, and a soft, delicate semi-realistic style in the background. Do not include any text, logos, UI elements, or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 作为基础景观，移除所有 YAMAP 品牌标识、日期、路线及数据叠加文本，将场景转换为精致的动漫风格旅行插画，同时保留俯瞰城市、湖泊、远山、朦胧天空和绿色森林前景的山顶视角。添加一名前景角色：一位年轻的动漫徒步者，背影/四分之三侧背影，站在古老的石制城堡墙头眺望风景。为角色设置 {argument name="hair color" default="长长的水蓝色头发"}，扎成高马尾，配有蓝色丝带和星星发饰，身穿浅蓝色徒步衬衫、米色工装徒步裤、棕色徒步靴，佩戴露指手套，背着一个大型深色徒步背包。在角色身上或附近添加 4 个清晰可见的装备/配饰元素：1 个绑在背包上的卷起睡垫、1 个悬挂的蓝色星星挂件、1 只停在肩膀附近的小型蓝色鸟类伙伴，以及 1 个小型徒步小包/肩带细节。在角色脚下添加风化的石块，并在下方前景处加入柔和模糊的绿叶以增加景深。保持构图优美宁静，呈现明亮的晨光、柔和的大气朦胧感、角色清晰的动漫线条，以及背景中柔和细腻的半写实风格。不要包含任何文本、Logo、UI 或水印。

templates.title: Victorian-style tea room waiting wallpaper

titleLocalized.zh: 维多利亚风格茶室等候壁纸

templates.prompt: Create an elegant, dark Victorian-style dressing room vertical mobile wallpaper to evoke the atmosphere of preparing for a sophisticated tea party. Write in delicate white Japanese-style calligraphy in the upper left corner.{argument name="quote" default="I will wait for you with a calm heart."} A small decorative dividing line is added below the text. The image shows an ornate chair draped with a black and white maid-style outfit: a black midi, a white apron-style front, wide white ruffles, and a large black bow adorned with a gold brooch and dangling chain tassels. In the foreground is a polished silver tray with four tea utensils precisely arranged: a white porcelain teapot with gold embellishments, a matching sugar bowl, a teacup and saucer containing amber tea, and a small gold cup or covered bowl with a dome, next to which sits a delicate spoon. To the right is a folded white lace-trimmed maid's accessory or apron with black shoulder straps and a gold medallion. On the dressing table are five grooming items precisely arranged: a warm-light lamp with a cream-colored lampshade, a large oval mirror with a gold frame, a vase containing lavender, a lace headband with two purple ribbon bows, and three small round gold boxes. Add two floral arrangements: lavender in a glass vase, and fresh flowers resembling purple saffron in a small black vase in the lower right corner, with a few purple petals scattered on the table.{argument name="room style" default="Dark antique mahogany Victorian interior style"} Warm lighting is used, with soft sunlight streaming in through a high window on the left, complemented by dark curtains. This showcases richly carved wooden panels, reflective metal surfaces, and deep shadows, creating a romantic waiting room atmosphere. The color scheme employs a soft palette of black, ivory, gold, brown, and purple. The composition uses a 9:16 vertical aspect ratio, with the chair on the left, the dressing table and mirror on the right, and the tea tray in the foreground below, leaving ample dark negative space around the short phrase.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张优雅的深色维多利亚风格更衣室竖版手机壁纸，营造出为精致茶会做准备的氛围。在左上方用纤细的白色日文明朝体书写 {argument name="quote" default="整えた心で、君を待つ。"}，并在文字下方添加一个小巧的装饰性分割线。画面中有一把雕花椅子，上面搭着一件黑白配色的女仆风格服饰：黑色中片、白色围裙式前襟、宽大的白色荷叶边，以及胸前饰有金质胸针和垂坠链条流苏的巨大黑色蝴蝶结。前景放置一个抛光的银色托盘，上面精确摆放四件茶具：一个带有金色装饰的白瓷茶壶、一个配套的糖罐、一个盛有琥珀色茶水的茶杯及杯托，以及一个带有圆顶的小金钟或盖碗，旁边放着一把精致的勺子。右侧放置一件折叠好的白色蕾丝边女仆配饰或围裙，带有黑色肩带和金质奖章。梳妆台上精确摆放五件梳妆物品：一盏带有奶油色灯罩的暖光台灯、一面金框大椭圆镜、一个插有薰衣草的花瓶、一个带有两个紫色丝带蝴蝶结的蕾丝发带，以及三个圆形小金盒。添加两处花艺布置：玻璃花瓶中的薰衣草，以及右下角黑色小花瓶中类似紫色藏红花的鲜花，桌面上散落着几片紫色花瓣。使用 {argument name="room style" default="深色古董红木维多利亚室内风格"}，运用温暖的灯光，左侧高窗透入柔和的日光并配有深色窗帘，展现丰富的雕花木板、反光的金属表面、深邃的阴影，营造浪漫的等候室氛围，色调采用黑、象牙白、金、棕和紫色的柔和配色。构图采用竖屏 9:16 比例，椅子位于左侧，梳妆台和镜子位于右侧，茶盘位于前景下方，并在短句周围留出充足的深色负空间。

templates.title: Masked Palace Wallpaper

titleLocalized.zh: 假面宫殿壁纸

templates.prompt: Create a fantasy background illustration in the style of a vertical mobile wallpaper, set in a magnificent palace room during the Golden Hour. Through a tall arched window with ornate black and gold grilles, the distant, hazy domed palace and spires can be seen. A deep red patterned curtain is drawn back on the left, with a tassel hanging from its center. In the foreground, a dark, carved wooden table is laden with luxurious props: a white envelope with a red wax seal, a stack of scattered letters and papers, a black ink bottle, a black quill pen held upright, a roll of parchment, a magnificent black and gold masquerade mask, a half-finished glass of red wine, an openwork metal lantern with a lit candle, and two embroidered fabrics, one red and one black and gold. Use warm amber sunlight, dramatic shadows, and floating dust to create a romantic and mysterious atmosphere, with rich burgundy, bronze, black, and gold as the main colors. Add elegant Japanese messages to the curtain area on the left.{argument name="message text" default="Hiding the truth behind the mask."} The design uses an elegant serif font in a pale gold color, with a thin horizontal gold line and tiny glitter dots at the bottom. The composition should be cinematic, serene, and slightly melancholic, as if hinting at court intrigue and the truth hidden behind masks.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖屏手机壁纸风格的奇幻背景插画，场景设定在黄金时刻一座富丽堂皇的宫殿房间内。透过带有华丽黑金格栅的高大拱窗，可以看到远处模糊的圆顶宫殿和尖塔。左侧拉开一扇深红色的花纹窗帘，顶部中央悬挂着一个流苏。前景中，放置一张深色雕花木桌，桌上摆满了奢华的道具：一个带有红色火漆印的白色信封、一叠散落的信件和纸张、一个黑色墨水瓶、一支竖立的黑色羽毛笔、一卷羊皮纸、一个华丽的黑金假面舞会面具、半杯红酒、一个装有燃烛的镂空金属灯笼，以及两块分别呈红色和黑金色的刺绣布料。运用温暖的琥珀色阳光、戏剧性的阴影、浮动的尘埃，营造出浪漫而神秘的氛围，色调以浓郁的酒红色、青铜色、黑色和金色为主。在左侧窗帘区域添加优雅的日语寄语文字 {argument name="message text" default="仮面の奥に、\n真実を隠して。"}，采用精致的衬线字体，颜色为淡金色，下方配有一条纤细的水平金线和微小的闪光点。构图需具有电影感、宁静且略带忧郁，仿佛在暗示宫廷阴谋以及面具背后隐藏的真相。

templates.title: Moonlight Guardian Balcony

titleLocalized.zh: 月光守护者阳台

templates.prompt: Create a vertical fantasy background illustration in a dark, romantic gothic style, set from a high stone balcony at night. The scene overlooks a vast, brightly lit castle city, with spires rising against a deep blue sky filled with clouds, warm light shining from windows, and a full moon hanging high. In the left foreground, two massive weathered stone pillars entwined with ivy and vines are placed, a black cloak or cape draped over a chair or railing, and a glowing brass lamp on a wooden chest. In the lower foreground, an old parchment map is laid on a dark wooden table, with an ornate emerald-adorned dagger lying diagonally on it, next to a black leather glove, two scrolls tied with rope, and a small metal cup or ink bottle near the edge of the balcony. On the right is a decorative locked treasure chest and a potted plant with white flowers. The warm candlelight in the foreground contrasts with the cool moonlight of the distant city, creating a tranquil, protective atmosphere. Add an elegant white-serif calligraphic vertical Japanese phrase to the left-hand pillar, formatted as two vertical columns of text, containing the following:{argument name="message text" default="The silent blade will protect you."} The scene is set as follows:{argument name="setting mood" default="A silent guardian overlooks the royal capital."} ,by{argument name="main foreground item" default="A dagger inlaid with emeralds"} As the visual focus, the background is{argument name="sky condition" default="Clouds under the moonlight"} and{argument name="city style" default="Gothic fantasy castle city"} No people appear in the scene.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张深色浪漫哥特风格的垂直奇幻背景插画，视角设在夜晚的高处石质阳台上。场景俯瞰着一座广阔且灯火通明的城堡城市，云层密布的深蓝色天空下，尖塔林立，窗户透出温暖的灯光，一轮满月高悬。左侧前景放置两根缠绕着常春藤和藤蔓的巨大风化石柱，一把椅子或栏杆上披着一件黑色斗篷或披风，木箱上放着一盏发光的黄铜灯。在下方前景处，摆放一张铺在深色木桌上的陈旧羊皮地图，一把饰有祖母绿的华丽匕首斜放在地图上，旁边是一只黑色皮手套、两卷用绳子系着的卷轴、阳台边缘附近的一个小金属杯或墨水瓶，右侧是一个装饰性的锁闭宝箱，以及一盆开着白色花朵的盆栽。前景使用温暖的烛光与远方城市清冷的月光形成对比，营造出一种静谧的守护氛围。在左侧石柱上添加一段优雅的白色衬线书法垂直日文短句，排版为两列垂直文本，内容为 {argument name="message text" default="静かな刃は、君を守る。"}。场景设定为 {argument name="setting mood" default="一位沉默的守护者俯瞰王都"}，以 {argument name="main foreground item" default="一把镶嵌祖母绿的匕首"} 作为视觉焦点，背景为 {argument name="sky condition" default="月光下的云层"} 和 {argument name="city style" default="哥特奇幻城堡城市"}。画面中不出现任何人物。

templates.title: Censored portrait of an elf cyborg

titleLocalized.zh: 受审查的精灵赛博格肖像

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic, square-shaped anime illustration showcasing an extreme close-up of a pale, elven cyborg girl, viewed from the shoulders up against a deep black abstract ink background. She possesses {argument name="hair color" default="Very light ice blue-white"} Her shoulder-length hair was messy, with loose strands and lines rendered in heavy black ink. A long, sharp elven ear protruded horizontally from the left side, adorned with subtle mechanical details. Her face was deliberately obscured by a large, flat, vertically rounded rectangular censorship block.{argument name="censor block color" default="cool light gray"} A centrally located obscuring block covers her entire face from forehead to chin, concealing all facial features. Her neck, collarbone, and upper chest are exposed, revealing intricate black biomechanical circuits, cables, armor fragments, and organic mechanical textures on her pale skin. Employing a high-contrast monochrome comic book style accented with icy blue highlights, the work utilizes rough brushstrokes, splattered ink, hand-drawn outlines, and heavy black shadows to create a rugged cyberpunk dark fantasy atmosphere. The composition is tightly packed around the head and shoulders, with elven ears and hair filling the frame; there is no text, no borders, and no other characters.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张戏剧性的方形动漫插画，展示一位苍白的精灵赛博格少女的极致特写，画面呈现从肩部以上，背景为深邃的黑色抽象水墨。她拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="极浅的冰蓝色-白色"} 凌乱的齐肩发，发丝散乱，线条采用厚重的黑色墨迹，左侧有一只长而尖锐的精灵耳朵水平伸出，耳部附近带有细小的机械细节。她的面部被一个巨大的垂直圆角矩形审查遮挡块刻意遮住，颜色为平面的 {argument name="censor block color" default="冷浅灰色"}，遮挡块居中覆盖从额头到下巴的整个面部，隐藏了所有五官。她的颈部、锁骨和上胸部裸露在外，呈现出复杂的黑色生物机械电路、线缆、盔甲碎片以及苍白皮肤上的有机机械纹理。采用高对比度的单色漫画风格，点缀冰蓝色高光，运用粗糙的笔触、飞溅的墨迹、手绘轮廓、浓重的黑色阴影，营造出粗犷的赛博朋克暗黑奇幻氛围。构图应紧凑地围绕头部和肩部，精灵耳朵和头发填满画面，无文字，无边框，无其他角色。

templates.title: Shih Tzu Park Photo Restoration

titleLocalized.zh: 西施犬公园照片修复

templates.prompt: Based on the provided reference image, recreate this Shih Tzu and create a natural, clear photograph. Remove the card border, printed numbers, text, scratches, discoloration, and any obstructions or mosaics. Replace the original card/photo background with a sunny outdoor park scene: the dog lies on lush green grass, with softly blurred trees and warm sunlight in the distance. Keep the dog centered and facing the camera, in a pose similar to the original, while retaining its black and white coat pattern and two black hair knots. Enhance the image quality to achieve a clear, modern pet portrait style with realistic fur details, natural lighting, and a shallow depth of field.

promptLocalized.zh: 以提供的参考图为基础，重现这只西施犬，并将其制作成一张色彩自然、清晰的照片。去除电话卡边框、印刷数字、文字、划痕、变色以及任何遮挡物或马赛克。将原有的卡片/照片背景替换为阳光明媚的户外公园场景：狗狗躺在翠绿的草地上，远处是柔和模糊的树木和温暖的阳光。保持狗狗居中并面向镜头，姿势与原图相似，同时保留其黑白毛色图案和两个黑色发结。提升图像质量，使其呈现出清晰的现代宠物肖像风格，具备逼真的毛发细节、自然光影和浅景深效果。

templates.title: Soft Neon Angel Girl

titleLocalized.zh: 柔和霓虹天使少女

templates.prompt: Create a vivid anime-style illustration against a pure black background, featuring a floating angel girl as the main character.{argument name="hair color" default="Soft pink"} She had a bob haircut with bangs, soft pink eyes, and a shy, slightly pouting expression. She was wearing a {argument name="jacket color" default="Bubble Gum Pink"} She wears a zip-up track jacket with white stripes on the sleeves, paired with a white short pleated skirt, white knee-high socks (with two pink stripes at the top), and chunky, soft pink lace-up sneakers. She's positioned in a mid-air seated position, one knee raised, the other bent downwards, one hand near her mouth, the other outstretched. Two white wings are added behind her, and a melting, creamy pink halo with a glossy dripping effect is added above her head. She's surrounded by a dreamy neon candy space atmosphere: a ringed asteroid in the lower left, three striking dripping yellow-pink star ornaments, two fluffy pink-purple clouds, and soft ribbon trails of pink, mint green, cyan, and lavender purple around her body. High-saturation, cute cyberpunk pop colors are used, along with bold, clean anime-style outlines, iridescent contours with green and magenta, shimmering highlights, scattered sparkles, and a high-contrast sticker-like composition against a black background. The overall atmosphere should be cute, ethereal, magical, and slightly surreal, like a gentle angel floating in a candy-colored galaxy.

promptLocalized.zh: 在纯黑色背景上创作一张生动的动漫风格插画，主角是一位漂浮的天使少女，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="柔和粉色"} 的波波头，配有齐刘海，拥有柔和的粉色双眸，表情羞涩且略带嘟嘴。她穿着一件 {argument name="jacket color" default="泡泡糖粉色"} 的拉链运动夹克，袖子上有白色条纹，搭配白色短百褶裙、膝上白色长袜（袜口处有两条粉色条纹），以及厚底的柔和粉色系带运动鞋。让她呈现出半空中坐姿，一膝抬起，另一条腿向下弯曲，一只手靠近嘴边，另一只手向外伸展。在她身后添加两只白色羽翼，头顶上方添加一个正在融化的奶油粉色光环，并带有光泽滴落效果。用梦幻般的霓虹糖果空间氛围环绕她：左下方放置一颗带环的小行星，三个醒目的滴落状黄粉色星星挂饰，两团蓬松的粉紫色云朵，以及粉色、薄荷绿、青色和薰衣草紫色的柔和丝带轨迹围绕在她的身体周围。使用高饱和度的可爱赛博流行色彩，粗线条且干净的动漫勾线，带有绿色和洋红色的虹彩像差轮廓，闪亮的高光，零星散布的小火花，以及在黑色背景下具有高对比度的贴纸式构图。整体氛围应可爱、空灵、充满魔力且略带超现实感，宛如一位柔和系天使漂浮在糖果色的银河之中。

templates.title: Sleepy chibi angel girl

titleLocalized.zh: 困倦的 Q 版天使女孩

templates.prompt: Create a cute chibi-style anime sticker illustration, the main character is {argument name="character name" default="A sleepy angel girl"} Floating in a flat and bright{argument name="background color" default="Sky blue"} In front of the background. The character has fair skin, half-open blue eyes, a small, androgynous mouth, and long {argument name="hair color" default="Light gold"} She has pigtails with bangs and face-framing strands, tied with two large black bows. A thick, golden, drop-shaped halo sits atop her head, surrounded by three small, shimmering golden stars. Two pairs of white feathered angel wings adorn her back. She is dressed in an oversized {argument name="jacket color" default="Blue-green"} She wore a zip-up tracksuit jacket with a high neck, silver zipper, and two white stripes on the sleeves, paired with a black short pleated skirt. The outfit positioned her in a seated, suspended position, one knee raised, the other hanging naturally, her posture slightly languid, her expression sleepy. She wore white over-the-knee socks with black horizontal stripes, and {argument name="shoelace color" default="yellow"} White sneakers with laces. Featuring a clean, kawaii digital art style with bold black lines, rounded and simple shapes, soft, flat colors, minimal shadows, no text, a centered composition, visible throughout, and a playful mascot proportion.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张可爱的 Q 版动漫贴纸插画，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="一位困倦的天使女孩"}，悬浮在平整明亮的 {argument name="background color" default="天蓝色"} 背景前。角色拥有白皙的皮肤、半睁的青色眼眸、小巧的中性嘴巴，以及长长的 {argument name="hair color" default="浅金色"} 双马尾，配有齐刘海和修饰脸型的发丝，并用 2 个黑色大蝴蝶结扎起。她的头顶上方有一个厚实的金色滴落状光环，周围环绕着 3 颗金色小闪星。她的背后有 2 对白色羽毛小天使翅膀。为她穿上一件超大号的 {argument name="jacket color" default="青绿色"} 拉链运动外套，配有高领、银色拉链和袖子上的两条白色条纹，下身搭配一条黑色短款百褶裙。让她呈现坐姿悬浮在半空中，一只膝盖抬起，另一条腿自然下垂，姿态略显慵懒，表情困倦。她穿着带有黑色横条纹的白色过膝袜，以及配有 {argument name="shoelace color" default="黄色"} 鞋带的白色运动鞋。采用干净的卡哇伊数字艺术风格，线条粗黑，形状圆润简洁，色彩平涂柔和，阴影极少，无文字，构图居中，全身可见，具有俏皮的吉祥物比例。

templates.title: Q-version angel girl at sunset

titleLocalized.zh: 日落时分的 Q 版天使女孩

templates.prompt: Create a heartwarming square anime illustration with a background of a grassy riverside slope at sunset. Three chibi-style angel girls sit side-by-side on the slope, knees drawn up to their chests, facing forward, with small, beady eyes and gentle smiles. Each girl has a glowing headband and a pair of small white wings on her back, totaling three headbands and three pairs of wings. The girl on the left has {argument name="left character hair color" default="Long light blue hair"} She wore a light blue zip-up track jacket with white stripes, a dark pleated skirt, striped knee-high socks, and light blue sneakers. The middle girl possessed {argument name="middle character hair color" default="Long blonde twin tails tied with black ribbons"} She wore a dark green zip-up track jacket with white stripes, a black pleated skirt, striped knee-high socks, and yellow-accented sneakers. The girl on the right has {argument name="right character hair color" default="Long pink hair"} She wears a coral pink zip-up track jacket with white stripes, a white pleated skirt, striped knee-high socks, and pink-accented sneakers. The background employs a cute and softly lined 2D anime style, featuring warm, nostalgic lighting, rounded proportions, clean silhouettes, and delicate grass textures dotted with white daisies. The left side of the background includes a staircase leading up a slope, while the right side shows a calm river reflecting the orange sun. In the distance, there is a bridge and a city skyline under a peach-orange sky and scattered fluffy clouds. The overall atmosphere should be tranquil, fantastical, and slightly magical, with the sun low near the horizon, and the grass and water shimmering with warm golden light.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅温馨的正方形动漫插画，背景是日落时分的河畔草坡。画面中共有 3 位 Q 版天使女孩并排坐在坡上，双膝抱胸，面向前方，有着小小的豆豆眼和温柔的微笑。每位女孩头顶上方都有一个发光的头环，背部有一对小巧的白色翅膀，总计 3 个头环和 3 对翅膀。左侧女孩拥有 {argument name="left character hair color" default="长长的水蓝色头发"}，身穿带有白色条纹的青色拉链运动夹克、深色百褶裙、条纹过膝袜和青色点缀的运动鞋。中间女孩拥有 {argument name="middle character hair color" default="系着黑色丝带的长金发双马尾"}，身穿带有白色条纹的深绿色拉链运动夹克、黑色百褶裙、条纹过膝袜和黄色点缀的运动鞋。右侧女孩拥有 {argument name="right character hair color" default="长长的粉色头发"}，身穿带有白色条纹的珊瑚粉拉链运动夹克、白色百褶裙、条纹过膝袜和粉色点缀的运动鞋。采用可爱且线条柔和的 2D 动漫风格，呈现温暖怀旧的灯光、圆润的比例、干净的轮廓，以及点缀着小白雏菊的细腻草地纹理。背景左侧包含一段通往坡上的阶梯，右侧是倒映着橙色太阳的平静河流，远处有一座桥梁，以及在桃橙色天空和零星蓬松云朵下的城市天际线。整体氛围应宁静、奇幻且略带魔力，太阳低垂在地平线附近，草地和水面上闪烁着温暖的金色光芒。

templates.title: Unexpected iPhone selfie extraction

titleLocalized.zh: 意外的 iPhone 自拍提取

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_1 as the source, extract the accidentally taken selfie below and transform it into a final standalone image: completely remove the ChatGPT interface, text bubbles, download icon, and input field. Then, uncrop/expand the snapshot to fill the entire frame, presenting a portrait iPhone-style photo. Follow the intent described in REFERENCE_0: make it look like a slightly unsuccessful, casual selfie taken unintentionally while pulling your phone out of your pocket, with a casual low angle, cluttered composition, slight motion blur, uneven lighting, slight overexposure due to indoor lighting, and a very realistic phone camera texture. Retain the indoor environment, ceiling light, wall lamp, and subject from the photo below, but show more of the face, neck, dark shirt, and thin chain necklace, and add a blurred finger-occlusion effect in the lower left foreground. Avoid making it look like a staged, heavily edited, cinematic, or deliberately composed work.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_1 为素材源，提取下方意外拍摄的自拍照片并将其转化为最终的独立图像：彻底移除 ChatGPT 界面、文本气泡、下载图标和输入栏，然后对快照进行反裁剪/扩展，使其填满整个画面，呈现为竖屏 iPhone 风格的照片。遵循 REFERENCE_0 中描述的意图：使其看起来像是一张从口袋里掏出手机时无意间拍下的、略显失败的随意自拍，带有随意的低角度、杂乱的构图、轻微的运动模糊、不均匀的灯光、室内灯光造成的轻微过曝，以及非常真实的手机摄像头质感。保留下方照片中的室内环境、吸顶灯、壁灯和主体，但要展示出更多的面部、颈部、深色衬衫和细链项链，并在左下角前景处加入模糊的手指遮挡效果。避免使其看起来像是有意摆拍、经过精修、具有电影感或刻意构图的作品。

templates.title: ChatGPT Accidentally Touching Selfie Interface

titleLocalized.zh: ChatGPT 误触自拍界面

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the source prompt text and REFERENCE_1 as the application interface composition reference, the final ChatGPT mobile chat interface was generated. The Japanese prompt was kept near the top right corner as a small, rounded gray message bubble. Below it, a typical selfie was generated that looked like it was taken accidentally while pulling a phone out of a pocket: the image should have a messy, tilted composition, slight motion blur, uneven sunlight glare or overexposure, and no deliberate sense of composition. The selfie background was set in a brightly lit residential street, with part of a young woman's figure cropped out on the right side of the image. She has long, dark hair, and a sleeve of a beige coat is visible in the foreground, with buildings and a blue sky in the background. The ChatGPT application UI was included: a top bar with a hamburger menu button, a "ChatGPT" title capsule, a compose icon, and a three-dot menu; below the image was an edit button and a centered downward arrow button. The aim was to maintain a casual, imperfect snapshot feel, rather than a polished or cinematic image.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用 REFERENCE_0 作为源提示文本，REFERENCE_1 作为应用界面构图参考，生成最终的 ChatGPT 移动端对话界面。将日语提示词保留在右上角附近，作为一个小巧的灰色圆角消息气泡；在下方生成一张看起来像是从口袋里掏出手机时误触快门拍摄的普通自拍：画面应呈现凌乱的倾斜构图、轻微的运动模糊、不均匀的阳光眩光或过曝，且没有任何刻意的构图感。自拍背景设定在明亮日光的住宅区街道，画面右侧裁切掉了一名年轻女性的部分身影，她留着深色长发，前景中有一只穿着米色外套的袖子伸向镜头，背景是建筑物和蓝天。包含 ChatGPT 应用 UI：顶部栏带有汉堡菜单按钮、“ChatGPT”标题胶囊、撰写图标和三点菜单；在图片下方包含一个“編集する”编辑按钮和一个居中的向下箭头按钮。保持随意的非完美快照感，而非精致或电影级的画面。

titleLocalized.zh: 兔子角色精灵图集

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the base for character design, the character image was converted into a background.{argument name="background color" default="pure white"} A clean 2D game sprite collection. Retain the rabbit character's proportions, black outline style, blue inner ears, blue eyes, small red nose, and fluffy tail, but remove all Japanese tags and reference image titles. Generate {argument name="sprite count" default="57"} Each sprite is a separate full-body image, arranged in a loose grid with transparent gaps between poses. It includes the following visible rows: 6 small front-facing idle/expression sprites; 8 sprites running to the right; 8 sprites running/stepping to the right; 4 front-facing neutral idle sprites; 5 front-facing cute/paw-holding sprites; 8 sleepy, sad, crouching, and low-energy sprites; 6 front-facing happy/neutral expression sprites; 6 dynamic running or jumping sprites; and 6 cute reaction sprites at the bottom, including shy, surprised, bashful, smiling with eyes closed, tilting head, and covering mouth poses. The line art remains simple and consistent, as is used in {argument name="game type" default="2D platform games or casual mobile games"} A collection of hand-drawn cartoon sprites, each sprite must be unique and must not contain shadows, props, text, borders or background scenes.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 作为角色设计基础，将该角色图转换为背景为 {argument name="background color" default="纯白色"} 的整洁 2D 游戏精灵图集。保留兔子角色的比例、黑色轮廓风格、蓝色耳内侧、蓝色眼睛、红色小鼻子和毛茸茸的尾巴，但需移除所有日语标签和参考图标题。生成 {argument name="sprite count" default="57"} 个独立的全身精灵图，以松散的网格排列，并在姿态之间留出透明间隔。包含以下可见行：6 个小型正面待机/表情精灵；8 个向右奔跑精灵；8 个向右奔跑/跨步精灵；4 个正面中性待机精灵；5 个正面可爱/握爪精灵；8 个困倦、悲伤、蹲伏和低能量精灵；6 个正面愉快/中性表情精灵；6 个动态奔跑或跳跃精灵；以及底部的 6 个可爱反应精灵，包括害羞、惊讶、羞涩、闭眼微笑、歪头和手捂嘴姿势。保持线条艺术简洁且一致，如同用于 {argument name="game type" default="2D 平台游戏或休闲手游"} 的手绘卡通精灵图集，每个精灵均需独立，且不包含阴影、道具、文字、边框或背景场景。

templates.title: Balenciaga street style sketch

titleLocalized.zh: Balenciaga 街头时尚素描

templates.prompt: Create a casual, hand-drawn street sketch using a simple black ink marker style. The background is white, and the image accurately depicts two tall, slender young women standing on a neon-lit city sidewalk in the rain.{argument name="store name" default="BALENCIAGA"} The storefront. Write the handwritten word prominently in the upper left corner.{argument name="store name" default="BALENCIAGA"} The woman's face on the left is clearly visible, and she has {argument name="hair color" default="Bright golden yellow"} She has chin-length short hair with bangs, a relaxed and slightly tilted posture, long legs, and wears high-heeled open-toe sandals. She also wears an oversized black hoodie or sweatshirt with small white lettering printed on the chest.{argument name="chest logo text" default="BB BALENCIAGA"} The woman on the right is taller, with long black braids or dreadlocks, her face deliberately blurred into a rectangular shape. She wears an oversized black zip-up jacket and a black mini-skirt, her legs are long, and she wears high-heeled open-toe sandals. She has her hands in her pockets, her posture casual. The clothing is primarily filled with dense black graffiti, with rough white highlights and irregular outlines. The background should include five clearly visible vertical city signs on the left: a tall white sign with yellow symbols and red squares, a narrow black sign with yellow characters, and a sign with red Japanese katakana.{argument name="red sign text" default="カラオケ"} A white sign, a small traffic light-like sign (with red/yellow/green markings), and a small blue sign on the street; add another small blue and white sign along the far right edge. Depict a wet sidewalk with reflective ripples of red, yellow, blue, and gray, tiny pedestrians in the distance, simple architectural perspective lines, and a minimalist shop facade on the right. Maintain a sketch-like, high-fashion, candid, and imperfect composition, using thin black lines, a few splashes of color, and plenty of white space.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张随性、手绘风格的时尚街头素描，采用朴素的黑色墨水马克笔风格，背景为白色，画面中准确呈现 2 位高挑纤瘦的年轻女性，站在雨中霓虹闪烁的城市人行道上，背景为 {argument name="store name" default="BALENCIAGA"} 店面。在左上方写上醒目的手写单词 {argument name="store name" default="BALENCIAGA"}。左侧女性面部清晰可见，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="亮金黄色"} 的齐下巴短发并带有刘海，姿态放松且微倾，双腿修长，穿着高跟露趾凉鞋，身穿超大号黑色连帽衫或卫衣，胸前印有白色小字 {argument name="chest logo text" default="BB BALENCIAGA"}，下搭黑色短裙。右侧女性更高，留着黑色长辫或脏辫，面部呈刻意模糊的矩形，身穿超大号黑色拉链夹克和黑色短裙，双腿修长，穿着高跟露趾凉鞋，双手插兜，姿态随意。衣物主要以密集的黑色涂鸦填充，带有粗犷的白色高光和不规则的轮廓线。背景应包含左侧 5 个清晰可见的垂直城市招牌：一个带有黄色符号和红色方块的高大白色招牌，一个带有黄色字符的窄长黑色招牌，一个带有红色日文片假名 {argument name="red sign text" default="カラオケ"} 的白色招牌，一个类似交通灯的小型招牌（带有红/黄/绿标记），以及街边一个蓝色小招牌；在最右侧边缘再添加一个蓝白相间的小招牌。描绘湿漉漉的人行道，上面有红色、黄色、蓝色和灰色的反射波纹，远处有微小的行人，简单的建筑透视线，以及右侧极简的店面墙壁。保持构图的素描感、高级时尚感、抓拍感和不完美感，使用细黑线条，点缀少量色彩，并留出大量空白。

templates.title: Soft and cute style study room illustrations

titleLocalized.zh: 柔和可爱风学习室插画

templates.prompt: Create a warm, hand-drawn illustration in colored pencil and crayon style, depicting a lovely, softly colored corner of a study room with warm beige paper textures and sketch-like brown outlines. The illustration features a young woman with {argument name="hair color" default="Long wavy light brown hair"} She sat at a wooden table, writing with a black pen in an open diary; her face was deliberately obscured by a simple beige square veil. She wore a pink plaid ruffled dress with lace trim and a bow, sitting on a wooden chair with a pink fan-shaped rug at her feet. The room contained a large wooden table with two visible drawers, an open notebook, a stack of closed pink books, a teacup with a tray, a pen, a wooden chair, a window with floral curtains, a hanging vine, four potted plants, a bookshelf filled with colorful books, a small picture frame, a floral lamp, and a framed floral painting on the wall. There were two visible text labels: one read…{argument name="wall sign text" default="luffynodoo"} A pink hanging wall sign, and one that reads{argument name="cloud text" default="ももいろ\nメモリーズ♡"} The scene features cloud-shaped speech bubbles. Adorable doodles surround the design: four large pink flowers, eight yellow stars, one blue smiley cloud, one pink lollipop, one wrapped candy, as well as small hearts and glitter dots. Using soft pink, cream, honey brown, pale yellow, mint green, and baby blue, it presents a fantastical Japanese stationery aesthetic, delicate cross-hatching, and warm sunlight, without striving for realism.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅温馨的手绘彩色铅笔和蜡笔风格插画，描绘一个可爱的柔和色调学习室角落，具有温暖的米色纸张质感和素描感的棕色轮廓。画面中展示一位年轻女性，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="长波浪浅棕色头发"}，坐在木桌前用黑色钢笔在打开的日记本上书写；她的脸部被一个简单的米色方形遮挡块刻意遮住。她穿着带有蕾丝花边和蝴蝶结的粉色格子荷叶边连衣裙，坐在木椅上，脚下铺着粉色扇形地毯。房间内包含 1 张带 2 个可见抽屉的大木桌、1 本打开的笔记本、1 叠闭合的粉色书籍、1 个带托盘的茶杯、1 支钢笔、1 把木椅、1 个窗外有花的窗帘窗户、1 条悬挂的藤蔓、4 盆盆栽、1 个放着彩色书籍的书架、1 个小相框、1 个花卉台灯以及墙上 1 幅装裱的花卉画。包含 2 个可见的文字标签：一个写着 {argument name="wall sign text" default="luffynodoo"} 的粉色悬挂墙牌，以及一个写着 {argument name="cloud text" default="ももいろ\nメモリーズ♡"} 的云朵对话气泡牌。场景周围环绕着可爱的涂鸦：4 朵大粉花、8 颗黄星星、1 朵蓝色笑脸云、1 根粉色棒棒糖、1 颗包装糖果，以及小爱心和闪光点。采用柔和的粉色、奶油色、蜜棕色、淡黄色、薄荷绿和婴儿蓝，呈现出奇幻的日式文具美学、精致的交叉排线、温暖的阳光，且不追求写实感。

templates.title: The Bubble Dream of a Fox-Eared Girl

titleLocalized.zh: 狐耳少女的泡泡梦

templates.prompt: Create a bright and highly detailed anime-style summer scene. The background is a mountain parking lot next to a cable-stayed bridge, with a clear blue sky dotted with fluffy white clouds. The central figure in the picture is {argument name="character name" default="Alma"} A cheerful young fox-eared girl with sandy-gold hair and upright Arctic fox ears, her posture playful and carefree, wearing an oversized {argument name="hoodie color and pattern" default="Red and black plaid hoodie"} She is wearing black shorts and thick-soled black lace-up boots; she is walking lightly, as if dancing, holding a bubble wand, her expression joyful. Around her are three other girls of similar age playing with bubbles: one on the left, with long black hair, wearing a navy blue jacket, skirt, black stockings, and sneakers, is holding a bubble wand; another on the middle left, with short silver hair, wearing a gray hoodie, dark skirt, tights, and white sneakers, is holding a small bubble bottle; and the third on the right, wearing a beige hoodie and dark skirt, is reaching for a bubble. The image should include four prominent large soap bubbles: a huge rainbow-colored bubble floating to the lower right of the fox-eared girl, a large bubble above her head, a large bubble near the upper right corner, and a medium-sized bubble near the sky on the left; in addition, it should include approximately 14 smaller bubbles scattered among them, all of which are transparent with rainbow highlights and bright reflections of the landscape. The background includes tree-lined mountains with distant peaks lightly covered in snow. To the left is a tall cable-stayed bridge tower and cables, while to the right are parked cars and trucks. White parking lines mark the asphalt road, greenery lines the roadside, and a blue road sign reads {argument name="bridge sign text" default="Niseko Bridge"} Below is a small English text. The composition employs a cinematic wide-angle, low-angle, slightly upward perspective, with bright sunlight, soft shadows, and a clear sense of depth. Bubbles reflect shimmering light, presenting a refined, modern anime illustration quality that combines painterly qualities with clear, delicate lines.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅明亮且高度精细的动漫风格夏日场景，背景位于斜拉桥旁的山间停车场，天空湛蓝，点缀着蓬松的白云。画面中心人物是 {argument name="character name" default="Alma"}，一位开朗的年轻狐耳少女，有着沙金色头发、竖起的北极狐耳朵，姿态俏皮无忧，身穿一件超大号的 {argument name="hoodie color and pattern" default="红黑格纹连帽衫"}、黑色短裤和厚底黑色系带靴；她正轻盈地迈步，仿佛在跳舞，手中拿着泡泡棒，神情愉悦。她周围有 3 位同样学龄的女孩正在玩泡泡：左侧一位留着长黑发，身穿海军蓝夹克、短裙、黑色长袜和运动鞋，正举起泡泡棒；中左侧一位留着银色短发，身穿灰色连帽衫、深色短裙、连裤袜和白色运动鞋，手里拿着一个小泡泡瓶；右侧一位身穿米色连帽衫和深色短裙，正伸手去够泡泡。画面中需包含 4 个醒目的大肥皂泡：一个巨大的彩虹色泡泡漂浮在狐耳少女右下方，一个大泡泡在她头顶上方，一个大泡泡在右上角附近，还有一个中大型泡泡在左侧天空附近；此外还需包含约 14 个散布在它们之间的小泡泡，所有泡泡均呈透明状，带有彩虹高光和景观的亮面反射。背景包括绿树成荫的山脉，远处的山峰覆盖着少量积雪，左侧有一座高大的斜拉桥塔和缆索，右侧停放着轿车和货车，沥青路面上有白色的停车位线，路边有绿植，以及一块蓝色的道路指示牌，上面写着 {argument name="bridge sign text" default="ニセコ大橋"}，下方附有小型英文文本。采用电影级广角构图，低角度略微仰视视角，阳光明媚，阴影柔和，具有通透的景深感，泡泡反射出闪烁的光芒，呈现出精致的现代动漫插画品质，兼具绘画感与清晰细腻的线条。

templates.title: A miniature study with warm and soft colors

titleLocalized.zh: 温馨柔和色调的微缩书房

templates.prompt: Create an incredibly detailed and inviting miniature 3D model room, using soft pastel tones and a hand-drawn storybook/cartoon style, presented from a three-quarter isometric perspective, like a tiny open box with beige stitched fabric walls and floor edges. At the center of the scene is a young woman sitting at a wooden desk, wearing a pink plaid skirt with ruffled off-the-shoulder sleeves, lace trim, a bow at her chest, and a delicate necklace; her long {argument name="hair color" default="Wavy light brown"} Her hair fell over her shoulders, and her face was covered by a flat, brown square veil. She was writing in an open notebook on the table. The desk contained ten clearly visible items: an open notebook, a pen in her hand, a teacup with a saucer, a closed pink notebook, two round buttons, a blue-wrapped candy, a pink striped candy, a tiny yellow candy, and a small flower. To the left, a warm wooden window with lace curtains let in garden light; outside were pink roses and greenery. Near the window, three fluffy white clouds were added, and the room was decorated with small stars and floral doodles. On the right wall, a pink stitched nameplate read…{argument name="wall sign text" default="luffynodoo"} It is surrounded by tiny heart-shaped graffiti, as well as two blue cloud graffiti and two yellow star graffiti. To the right is a small wooden shelf and cabinet containing four upright books, a succulent plant, a lampshade, and a [item name missing].{argument name="jar label" default="CANDY"} Labeled jars. A woven plant basket, a wooden chair, and a small red rug are placed on the floor, scattered with embroidered flowers, encircling yellow threads, and delicate candy, flower, star, and cloud patterns. Warm sunlight, soft shadows, realistic miniature textures, embroidered fabric seams, delicate lace, wood grain, and soft pink and beige tones create a charmingly whimsical atmosphere. High detail, square composition, and no additional text besides wall signs and candy jar labels.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个细节极其丰富的温馨微缩立体模型房间，采用柔和的粉彩色调、手绘故事书动漫风格，以四分之三等轴测视角呈现，如同一个带有米色缝合织物墙壁和地板边缘的微型开口盒子。场景中心是一位坐在木制书桌前的年轻女性，她穿着粉色格子裙，带有荷叶边露肩袖、蕾丝饰边、胸前蝴蝶结和精致的项链；她长长的 {argument name="hair color" default="波浪状浅棕色"} 头发垂在肩上，脸部被一个平坦的棕褐色方形遮挡块覆盖。她正拿着笔在桌上的打开的笔记本上书写。书桌上包含 10 个清晰可见的桌面物品：一本打开的笔记本、她手中的一支笔、一个装有茶的茶托茶杯、一本闭合的粉色笔记本、两颗圆形纽扣、一颗蓝色包装的糖果、一颗粉色条纹糖果、一颗微小的黄色糖果和一朵小花。左侧添加一扇带有蕾丝窗帘的温暖木窗，花园的光线从中透入；窗外是粉色的玫瑰和绿植。在窗户附近添加三朵蓬松的白云，房间周围点缀着小星星和花朵涂鸦。在右侧墙上放置一个粉色缝合的名牌，上面写着 {argument name="wall sign text" default="luffynodoo"}，周围环绕着微小的心形涂鸦，以及两个蓝色云朵涂鸦和两个黄色星星涂鸦。右侧摆放一个小木架和柜子，里面放着四本直立的书、一盆多肉植物、一个灯罩和一个贴有 {argument name="jar label" default="CANDY"} 标签的罐子。地板上放置一个编织植物篮、一把木椅、一块红色小地毯，并散布着刺绣般的小花、环绕的黄色丝线，以及随处可见的精致糖果、花朵、星星和云朵图案。使用温暖的阳光、柔和的阴影、逼真的微缩质感、刺绣织物接缝、精致的蕾丝、木纹、柔和的粉色和米色调，营造可爱奇幻的氛围，高细节，方形构图，除墙面标志和糖果罐标签外，不包含任何额外文字。

promptLocalized.zh: {"type":"高度精细的等距视角隐藏物品旅行插画","concept":"一个温馨的京都纪念品街场景，观众需要在其中寻找名为 {argument name=\"mascot name\" default=\"ルヒア\"} 的小吉祥物，呈现出一种奇思妙想的“寻找角色”解谜感。","setting":{"location":"寺庙附近的京都古老参道","season":"{argument name=\"season\" default=\"春季樱花季\"}","time":"温暖的金色傍晚，伴有发光的商店灯笼","architecture":"传统的木质町屋商店、深色弧形瓦屋顶、格子窗、狭窄的石板巷，远处是景深虚化处理的多层宝塔和寺庙建筑","atmosphere":"热闹的黄金周旅游氛围，拥挤而可爱，怀旧，微缩模型感"},"style":{"visual_style":"超精细可爱 3D 微缩模型，Q 版人偶人群，移轴摄影效果，温暖的电影感光效，密集的隐藏物品构图，玩具般的质感，浅景深","camera":"高处四分之三等距视角，俯瞰狭窄的商业街，竖屏构图","color_palette":"暖棕色、灯笼红、柔和的樱花粉、奶油色纸质招牌、色彩丰富的纪念品包装"},"main_scene":{"crowd":"数十名身着花纹和服与浴衣的 Q 版儿童和游客挤满街道；大头、亮晶晶的眼睛，小手拿着甜点、雨伞、护身符、烤串和纪念品","shops":"左右两侧各有两家主要的纪念品店，摆满了招财猫、达摩玩偶、盒装甜点、扇子、护身符、糖果、抹茶点心和小玩具","hidden_object":"将吉祥物 {argument name=\"mascot name\" default=\"ルヒア\"} 自然地隐藏在纪念品或人群中，它是一个有着可爱脸庞的圆滚滚黄色小鸟状角色，不显眼但可以找到。","top_right_banner":"带有棕色边框的装饰性奶油色招牌，上面写着 {argument name=\"headline text\" default=\"ルヒア?を探せ!\"}，文字旁边还有该圆滚滚吉祥物的小插图。"},"visible_text_and_signs":{"count":9,"labels":[{"text":"ルヒア?を探せ!","position":"右上角装饰性横幅"},{"text":"八ツ橋","position":"左侧前景的大红灯笼"},{"text":"京都名物 八ツ橋","position":"红灯笼旁边的竖式木牌"},{"text":"清水寺参道","position":"背景中间的竖式白色路牌"},{"text":"京のおみやげ","position":"右侧上方商店的大型横向招牌"},{"text":"桜うどん","position":"右侧商店边缘的竖式招牌"},{"text":"抹茶ソフト","position":"左侧街道下方附近的黑色立牌"},{"text":"お漬物","position":"左侧商店附近的小型竖式招牌"},{"text":"お物","position":"中左侧附近的小型红色挂灯笼"}]},"notable_discrete_objects":{"count":12,"items":["大型红色纸灯笼","小型红色挂灯笼","阳台上的奶油色纸灯笼","人群中的红色遮阳伞","绿色抹茶冰淇淋展示模型","招财猫摆件","达摩玩偶","盒装纪念品甜点","折扇","圆形糖果串","木质阳台茶桌","远处的宝塔"]},"composition_notes":"使画面密集地填满许多微小的面孔和物体，但要保持沿巷道清晰的视觉路径。利用樱花枝条勾勒屋顶和背景。包含充满微型纪念品的温暖商店内部。增加一些由人头和灯笼造成的自然遮挡，以增强寻物解谜的趣味性，但避免任何遮挡面部或出现黑块的情况。","quality":"前景细节锐利，屋顶瓦片和木材纹理复杂，日文招牌清晰可辨，高分辨率，迷人且适合全家欣赏"}

She was dressed {argument name="outfit" default="A beige cable-knit midi dress, with a light blue oversized denim jacket draped over her shoulders."} Wearing an exquisite necklace and bracelet, she sits on a dark wooden chair, legs crossed, one hand resting on the table, the other gently touching her cheek. Her dark hair is casually tied up, with natural wisps, but her face is deliberately obscured by a solid brown square in the center, achieving anonymity. Two visible tabletop props are positioned near the right edge: a small cup of frothy latte and a clear glass vase containing dried flowers and eucalyptus leaves. The background includes two striking café decorative elements: a dark blackboard menu with "DAILY SPECIALS" written on it, along with blurred handwritten prices, and warm, vertical wooden wall panels. The film employs a natural documentary style, featuring shallow depth of field, warm wood tones, creamy highlights, realistic fabric textures, soft window lighting, delicate film grain, a 50mm lens perspective, an f/2.8 aperture, a vertical portrait composition, an intimate café atmosphere, and high realism, devoid of any illustrative or CGI feel.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实的编辑类生活方式摄影作品，主体为 {argument name="subject" default="一位年轻女性"}，她坐在舒适的复古咖啡馆内一张质朴的木桌旁，身旁是高大的老式窗格，柔和的日光从左侧倾泻而入。她身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="一件米色麻花针织中长裙，肩上披着一件浅蓝色超大款牛仔外套"}，佩戴着精致的项链和手链，坐在深色木椅上，双腿交叠，一只手放在桌上，另一只手轻轻触碰脸颊。她深色的头发随意挽起，留有自然的碎发，但她的面部被一个位于正中央的纯棕色方块刻意遮挡，以实现匿名化。桌上恰好有 2 个可见的桌面道具：右侧边缘附近有一小杯奶泡拿铁，以及一个装有干花和尤加利叶的透明玻璃花瓶。背景中包含 2 个醒目的咖啡馆装饰元素：一块写有“DAILY SPECIALS”字样的深色黑板菜单，上面有模糊的手写价格，以及温暖的垂直木质墙板。采用自然的纪录片摄影风格，具有浅景深、暖木色调、奶油色高光、写实的织物纹理、柔和的窗光、细腻的胶片颗粒感、50mm 镜头视觉、f/2.8 光圈、竖构图人像、私密的咖啡馆氛围、高度写实，无插画或 CGI 感。

templates.prompt: A realistic vertical portrait, showcasing a{argument name="subject" default="Young East Asian male professionals"} Sitting at a modern desk, calm and looking directly at the camera, his expression gentle and neutral. He kept {argument name="hair style" default="Medium-length, dark brown layered hairstyle with a slightly damp look, parted to the side and featuring loose bangs."} He had fair and delicate skin, refined features, and a stylish and capable appearance. He wore {argument name="outfit" default="A black oversized blazer, worn over a plain white T-shirt."} He wore a blue lanyard and a clearly visible employee badge. His hands rested on the keyboard of a space gray laptop, with a black Apple logo on the desktop to his left. Besides the laptop, three other items were clearly visible: a black smartphone facing upwards in the center, a white spiral notebook to his right with a black pen resting diagonally on it. The background was a bright glass-walled corporate office with blurred desks, windows, partitions, and cool-toned sunlight. The shallow depth of field and realistic reflections, combined with a soft gray-blue hue, diffused light, and a high-end editorial photography style, showcased the quality of an 85mm lens, natural skin texture, sharp facial focus, and a 2:3 vertical composition, creating a professional yet stylish atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张写实风格的竖版肖像，展示一位 {argument name="subject" default="年轻东亚男性职场人士"} 坐在现代办公桌前，神情平静，直视镜头，表情柔和中性。他留着 {argument name="hair style" default="中长款深棕色层次感发型，略带湿发质感，侧分并留有松散刘海"}，皮肤白皙细腻，五官精致，外表时尚干练。他身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="黑色廓形西装外套，内搭纯白色 T 恤"}，胸前挂着蓝色挂绳和清晰可见的员工工牌。他的双手放在一台深空灰色笔记本电脑的键盘上，电脑左侧的桌面上放着黑色 Apple 标志。桌面上除了笔记本电脑外，还有 3 件清晰可见的物品：正前方中央放着一部正面朝上的黑色智能手机，右侧放着一本白色螺旋笔记本，笔记本上斜放着一支黑色钢笔。背景为明亮的玻璃墙企业办公室，带有模糊的办公桌、窗户、隔断和冷色调日光，浅景深，逼真的反射效果，采用柔和的灰蓝色调，光线柔和漫射，高端编辑摄影风格，85mm 镜头质感，自然的皮肤纹理，面部焦点清晰，2:3 竖构图，营造出专业又不失时尚的氛围。

templates.title: Cyberpunk fashion magazine cover

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克时尚杂志封面

templates.prompt: Create a high-fashion cyberpunk magazine cover featuring a close-up portrait of a young woman in a neon-lit capital city night. She sports long, thick cyber-braided hair made of glossy black fiber optic cables with blue, purple, and magenta highlights, complete with metal hoops, and a circular tech accessory by her ear. Her face is intentionally obscured by a soft, brownish-purple square pixelated privacy mask. She wears a black ribbed belted top, a loose-fitting off-the-shoulder black leather jacket, and a wide, futuristic chrome choker with panel details. One hand holds a small, transparent cyber-terminal or smartphone-like device with glowing blue interface graphics, its connecting cable extending into her clothing. The background is a rainy city street at night, with wet, reflective pavement, blurred pedestrians, towering buildings, and colorful, out-of-focus billboards and signs, shot with shallow depth of field, cinematic bokeh, glossy reflections, and realistic editorial lighting. Design it as a fashion magazine cover, incorporating three precise text elements: a large, thin white masthead in the upper left corner, with text {argument name="magazine title" default="NEURO"} The two short titles in the upper right corner contain the following text:{argument name="cover caption" default="FASHION SNAP\nCAPITAL CITY NIGHT"} The small issue number/date marker in the lower left corner contains the text "{argument name="issue text" default="2126 / SPRING"} The cover features a vertical layout, sophisticated cyberpunk aesthetics, photorealistic details, a cool blue-purple neon color scheme, and clear typography.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高级时尚赛博朋克杂志封面，展示一张年轻女性在霓虹闪烁的首都城市夜晚的街头风格特写肖像。她留着长而浓密的赛博编发，由光泽感黑色光纤电缆制成，带有蓝色、紫色和洋红色的高光，配有金属连接环，耳边有一个圆形科技装饰。她的脸部被一个柔和棕紫色的方形像素化隐私遮挡块有意遮盖。她身穿黑色罗纹系带上衣、宽松的露肩黑色皮夹克，以及带有面板细节的宽大未来感铬合金颈圈。她的一只手拿着一个小巧的透明赛博终端或类似智能手机的设备，上面有发光的蓝色界面图形，连接的电缆延伸到她的服装中。背景是下雨的城市夜街，有潮湿的反射路面、模糊的行人、高耸的建筑以及色彩斑斓的失焦广告牌和标志，采用浅景深、电影级散景、光泽反射和逼真的编辑级灯光进行拍摄。将其设计为时尚杂志封面，包含 3 个精确的文本元素：左上角巨大的细体白色刊头，文字为 {argument name="magazine title" default="NEURO"}；右上角两行简短的标题，文字为 {argument name="cover caption" default="FASHION SNAP\nCAPITAL CITY NIGHT"}；左下角微小的期号/日期标记，文字为 {argument name="issue text" default="2126 / SPRING"}。采用竖版封面构图，高级赛博时尚美学，照片级逼真细节，冷色调蓝紫色霓虹配色，以及清晰的排版。

templates.title: Cozy Cat-themed Holiday Bedroom

titleLocalized.zh: 温馨猫咪假日卧室

templates.prompt: Create a warm and comforting anime-style illustration, depicting {argument name="character description" default="A happy anthropomorphic calico cat"} A scene depicting a lazy holiday afternoon enjoyed in a sun-drenched bedroom. The character reclines on a soft, cream-colored bed, dressed in {argument name="outfit" default="A plain white T-shirt and loose gray drawstring sweatpants"} Wearing round, metal-framed glasses, she smiled with her eyes closed, one hand behind her head, the other holding a cup of frothy {argument name="drink" default="Golden Beer"} Add a calico cat's tail curled on the bed, clearly visible paw pads, a faint blush, and relaxed body language. The room should create a tranquil and homey atmosphere, with golden sunlight streaming in through a large window on the left, overlooking a blue sky and fluffy clouds, and green plants placed on the windowsill and in the foreground. Place two pillows behind the character, one mustard yellow and the other a green checkered pattern, paired with cream-colored bedding and a rounded wooden headboard. The wall behind the bed includes three wall decorations: a sign that reads {argument name="poster text" default="GOOD DAY"} A cat poster, a small "Relax" tag with a cat paw print, and a framed landscape photo are displayed. On the upper right wall shelf are five visible items: a hanging plant, a cat-face plush toy or ornament, two upright books, and a framed landscape photo. To the right is a bedside table with a lamp, a small alarm clock, and a cup; an open beverage can sits on the bed near the character. In the foreground, a low table holds a cup of tea and a book titled {argument name="magazine title" default="NEKO LIFE"} The magazine features a cat illustration on the cover, alongside a small potted plant. It uses soft, painterly shadows, delicate lines, and warm beige and honey tones to depict cozy, charming everyday objects, dappled sunlight, and relaxed moments of life.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅温暖、舒适的动漫风格插画，描绘 {argument name="character description" default="一只快乐的拟人化三花猫"} 在阳光充足的卧室里享受慵懒假日午后的场景。角色斜倚在柔软的奶油色床上，身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="一件纯白 T 恤和宽松的灰色抽绳运动裤"}，戴着圆形金属框眼镜，闭着双眼微笑着，一只手枕在脑后，另一只手拿着一杯泡沫丰富的 {argument name="drink" default="金色啤酒"}。添加一条卷曲在床上的三花猫尾巴、清晰可见的脚掌肉垫、淡淡的红晕以及放松的肢体语言。房间应营造出宁静且充满生活气息的氛围，左侧大开的窗户透进金色的阳光，窗外是蓝天和蓬松的云朵，窗台和前景处摆放着绿植。在角色身后放置两个枕头，一个为芥末黄，另一个为绿色格子图案，搭配奶油色床品和圆润的木质床头板。在床头墙面上，包含三个墙面装饰：一张写有 {argument name="poster text" default="GOOD DAY"} 的猫咪海报、一个带有猫爪印的“Relax”小挂牌，以及一幅风景画框。在右上方的墙面搁板上，包含五个可见物品：一盆垂吊植物、一个猫脸毛绒玩具或装饰品、两本立着的书，以及一个风景照片框。在右侧放置一个床头柜，上面有台灯、小闹钟和一个杯子；在角色附近的床上放置一个打开的饮料罐。在前景处，放置一张矮桌，上面有一杯茶和一本名为 {argument name="magazine title" default="NEKO LIFE"} 的杂志，封面上印有猫咪插画，旁边还有一盆小绿植。采用柔和的绘画式阴影、细腻的线条、温暖的米色和蜂蜜色调，展现精致的温馨杂物、斑驳的阳光以及轻松的生活片段氛围。

templates.title: Girl faces giant robot

titleLocalized.zh: 女孩面对巨型机器人

templates.prompt: Create a dark, cinematic, realistic rural sci-fi scene using a 4:5 vertical composition. In the foreground, a {argument name="girl age" default="little girl"} Standing with her back to the audience on the muddy dirt road, in the center, gazing at the horizon; she had loose, dark brown braids, wore a gray knitted sweater, and a {argument name="skirt color" default="Dark red patterned skirt"} Black pantyhose and worn dark boots. The road winds gently upwards through dry brown grass and bushes. In the mid-ground to the left sits an old stone hut with rough gray brick walls, a red terracotta roof, a chimney, a dark wooden door, a small window, and a low stone wall, next to a withered tree. In the background to the right stands a massive ancient robot, about ten times the height of the hut, humanoid and weathered, constructed of dark, corroded metal plates, with exposed cables dangling from its joints. It has broad shoulders, heavy arms, thick legs, a skull-like head with round eyes, and a thin, spiked antenna at the top; it stands motionless in the mist, facing the girl. The atmosphere is gloomy and apocalyptic, with heavy, charcoal-gray storm clouds covering most of the sky, dramatic diffused light filtering through gaps in the clouds, a soft earthy hue, high contrast, grainy textures, realistic depth of field, a low horizon, a wide-angle cinematic perspective, emotional cinematic color grading, no text, and no borders.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个暗黑电影级写实风格的乡村科幻场景，采用 4:5 竖构图。前景中，一个 {argument name="girl age" default="小女孩"} 背对观众站在泥泞的土路上，居中站立，望向地平线；她留着深棕色的松散辫子，身穿灰色针织毛衣、一条 {argument name="skirt color" default="深红色花纹裙子"}、黑色连裤袜和磨损的深色靴子。道路在干枯的棕色草丛和灌木丛中微微向上蜿蜒。左侧中景处坐落着一座古老的小石屋，有着粗糙的灰色砖墙、红陶瓦屋顶、烟囱、深色木门、一扇小窗和一道低矮的石墙，旁边有一棵枯树。右侧背景中耸立着一个巨大的古代机器人，高度约为小屋的十倍，人形且饱经风霜，由深色腐蚀的金属板构成，关节处悬挂着裸露的电缆，肩膀宽大，手臂沉重，双腿粗壮，头部呈骷髅状并带有圆形眼睛，顶部有一根细长的天线尖刺；它在迷雾中一动不动，面向女孩。氛围阴郁且具有末日感，厚重的炭灰色风暴云覆盖了大部分天空，戏剧性的漫射光穿过云层缝隙，色调为柔和的大地色，高对比度，颗粒感纹理，真实的景深，低地平线，广角电影视角，情绪化的电影调色，无文字，无边框。

titleLocalized.zh: 重音特（Kasane Teto）流行偶像肖像

templates.prompt: Create a vibrant anime close-up portrait, the main character is {argument name="character name" default="Kasane Teto"} A mischievous young virtual singer. She possesses vibrant {argument name="hair color" default="Bright pink"} Her hair is styled into two large, glossy, drill-like pigtails on either side, with short, choppy bangs and loose sideburns. She has large pink eyes with golden highlights, long black eyelashes, light blush, and a playful, toothy smile. She is depicted leaning towards the viewer with a strong sense of perspective, one arm outstretched, index finger pointing directly at the camera, the other hand lightly touching her cheek, her nails trimmed pink. She wears a deep navy blue sleeveless collared shirt with bright magenta piping, magenta buttons, a small pocket on the front and chest, and a separate deep navy blue sleeve. The style is cute and pop idol anime illustration-like, with clean lines, cel-shaded lighting, soft skin tones, and thick white sticker-like outlines around the character. The background is set to a flat, light color scheme.{argument name="background color" default="pink"} It is adorned with white graffiti: precisely containing 3 outlined stars, 7 four-corner glitter points, and 3 short radiating emphasis lines near the upper right corner. The composition should be vibrant, centered, cropped from above the torso, with the enlarged pointing gesture in the foreground echoing the face surrounded by double-drill ponytails.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张充满活力的动漫特写肖像，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="重音特（Kasane Teto）"}，一位调皮的年轻虚拟歌手。她拥有鲜艳的 {argument name="hair color" default="亮粉色"} 头发，两侧扎成两个硕大且富有光泽的钻头双马尾，配有短碎刘海和松散的侧发。她有着粉红色的大眼睛，带有金色高光、长长的黑色睫毛、淡淡的腮红以及俏皮的露齿笑容。让她以强烈的透视感向观众倾斜，一只手臂向前伸出，食指直指镜头，另一只手轻触脸颊，指甲修剪成粉色。让她身穿深海军蓝无袖翻领衬衫，配有亮洋红色滚边、洋红色纽扣、前襟和胸前小口袋，手臂上可见一只分离式的深海军蓝袖套。采用可爱的流行偶像动漫插画风格，线条清晰，赛璐珞风格光影，肤色柔和，角色周围带有厚实的白色贴纸状轮廓。背景设置为平铺的淡 {argument name="background color" default="粉色"}，并点缀白色涂鸦：精确包含 3 个轮廓星形、7 个四角闪光点以及右上角附近的 3 条短放射状强调线。构图需充满活力，居中对齐，从躯干上方裁剪，前景中放大的指点手势与双钻头马尾环绕的面部形成呼应。

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic vertical anime movie poster in a polished modern Japanese fantasy style, with a deep navy, violet, and sunset-orange color palette, cinematic rim lighting, falling red petals, icy crystal shards, and glowing magical particles. The poster features exactly 6 characters arranged in a dense ensemble composition: 1 central black-haired teenage boy in a dark cloak holding a radiant blue crystalline star-shaped weapon at the lower center, his face obscured by a soft square blur; 1 white-haired young man in a white military-style coat on the left, turned in profile, face obscured by a soft square blur; 1 pink-haired young girl in a white academy uniform at the lower left clasping her hands, face obscured by a soft square blur; 1 long dark-blue-haired young woman on the right wearing a black sleeveless outfit and carrying a sword, face visible and looking determined; 1 blond young man in a pale coat at the lower right, face obscured by a soft square blur; and 1 ethereal pale-haired female figure looming behind them at the top, partially hidden, with her face covered by a large muted rectangular block. In the background, show a towering gothic castle or cathedral spire rising into a glowing dusk sky on the right, with dark flowing hair-like shapes and starry night textures sweeping across the upper left. Add exactly 8 text elements: large vertical Japanese slogan on the left reading {argument name="left slogan" default="Reclaim the truth of the world."}, a smaller vertical phrase beside it reading {argument name="small left phrase" default="Defy this fate"}, vertical Japanese copy on the right reading {argument name="right slogan" default="In a world dominated by despair, the boy—"}, small production copy above the title reading {argument name="production line" default="A brand new, original TV animation series."}, a large luminous Japanese title at the bottom center reading {argument name="main title" default="Star Ash Resonance"}, a spaced Roman subtitle below it reading "SEIKAI NO RESONANCE", a release line reading "2025年 TVアニメ放送開始", and tiny staff/cast credits plus a final tagline along the bottom reading "信じる意志が、未来を変える". Use elegant Japanese poster typography, high contrast, layered depth, painterly detail, sharp highlights on fabric and hair, and a premium theatrical key visual composition.

The ground is a dark featureless plane with subtle reflections and faint grid-like seams, stretching to a straight distant horizon. On the right side, place two simple modern industrial cuboid buildings: one large dark gray corrugated metal box building tilted in perspective with small narrow black rectangular windows, a dark doorway, and a few roof vents; farther right, a white rectangular building partially cropped by the frame with sparse vertical black windows. Add a thin glowing pink-red line or laser strip running from the bottom center foreground toward the horizon beside the buildings, creating a strong perspective guide. titleLocalized.zh: Clay Baba Yaga With Chicken-Leg Hut

templates.prompt: Create a cute stylized 3D clay-rendered character on a clean white background: {argument name="character name" default="Baba Yaga"} as a squat elderly folklore witch wearing a large soft {argument name="hat color" default="burnt orange-red"} hood or cap, long gray hair hanging down on both sides, and a simple brown robe with rounded toy-like folds. Her face is deliberately hidden by one flat opaque square censor block in a warm brown skin tone, centered over the head and covering all facial features. She holds exactly one crooked wooden walking staff in her left hand. Beside and partly attached to her right side is exactly one miniature log cabin hut, made from rounded golden-brown logs, with exactly one arched wooden door, exactly one small square upper window, exactly one dark blue-gray shingled roof, and exactly one squat chimney. The hut stands on exactly two birdlike chicken legs with three front claws visible on each foot, sculpted in the same warm wood-clay style. templates.title: Chibi Witch Owl Figurine

titleLocalized.zh: Chibi Witch Owl Figurine

templates.prompt: Create a polished 3D stylized fantasy mascot on a pure white background: a cute chibi witch-owl creature sitting inside a carved wooden bucket or half-barrel, rendered like a collectible game figurine with soft studio lighting, rounded shapes, warm colors, high detail, ambient occlusion, and a clean isolated product-shot composition. The character has a squat round body covered in dark brown feathers, orange bird feet with 6 visible talons total, shaggy pale cream hair, a muted purple headscarf tied in a bow on the right side, pointed orange ears, and a strange square faceless area over the front of the head in a smooth brown gradient. The creature holds 1 straw broom upright in its right hand and has 1 small glowing lantern hanging from the front of the barrel. On the ground to the right are 3 props: 1 cream skull, 1 red mushroom cap with white spots and green stem, and 1 small wooden base/stone patch. templates.title: AI Cost Reduction Taoist Talisman

titleLocalized.zh: AI Cost Reduction Taoist Talisman

templates.prompt: Create a single front-facing Chinese Taoist talisman on an off-white background, centered as a tall vertical rectangle of aged golden-yellow rice paper with subtle fibrous texture, slight mottling, and a thin red outer border plus inner red frame. Use deep cinnabar-red ink for the sacred graphics and mostly black ink for side calligraphy, with a hand-brushed, slightly imperfect printed look. The talisman contains 4 vertical text columns: left black column reading {argument name="left invocation text" default="This will reduce the cost of all state-of-the-art (SOTA) large-scale models to one-tenth of the original cost."}, right black column reading {argument name="right invocation text" default="The imperial edict ordered the Heavenly Court and the Underworld to reduce computing power consumption and lower costs."}, a small red boxed column at lower left reading "立降十成", and a small red boxed column at lower right reading "成本大降". In the center, draw a large ornate red Taoist spell glyph with stacked Chinese characters, including a top title {argument name="central title text" default="Imperial Edict and Spirit Painting"} and the phrase {argument name="central reduction text" default="one-tenth"}, shaped like a flowing ritual sigil with angular strokes. Above it place 1 yin-yang symbol inside a red circle, surrounded by 8 red bagua trigrams arranged symmetrically. Add 2 mirrored vertical red circuit-like ritual lines flanking the central glyph, each with circular nodes, giving a mystical-computing hybrid feeling. At the bottom center add 1 red square seal stamp containing four stylized characters, default text {argument name="seal text" default="The Mandate of Heavenly Mandate and the Mandate of Heavenly Mandate"}, and beneath it 1 small trigram mark. Decorate the four corners with 4 red flame-cloud ornaments and add fine red ornamental curls near the bottom corners. The composition should resemble an authentic Daoist paper charm redesigned as a humorous magical cost-reduction talisman for SOTA AI models, cleanly photographed or scanned, flat 2D, high resolution, no perspective distortion.

templates.prompt: Place the primary chassis or structural platform perfectly centered as the core spine, and position the main body shell separately (left or top), aligned parallel as a reference form while preserving accurate proportions, stance, and geometry of the real vehicle.￼ Design a multi-layered exploded system with components separated across depth (Z-axis) as well as planar spacing, using clear hierarchy: micro hardware (bolts, screws, washers) tightly grouped, functional assemblies moderately spaced, and major systems widely separated.￼ Organize parts into realistic subsystems depending on the {argument name="vehicle type" default="vehicle"} type, including front assembly (suspension, steering, brakes), rear assembly (suspension, drivetrain, differential), chassis/structure (frame, monocoque, subframes), powertrain (engine or motor with slight internal exposure, transmission, intake, exhaust, cooling), electronics (battery, ECU, wiring harness with clean routing), and wheel systems (4 wheels symmetrically placed with tire, rim, and hub separation).￼ Ensure engineering realism by preserving mechanical relationships, aligning shafts and rotational axes, maintaining symmetry across left/right systems, and grouping micro components logically near their assembly points in precise micro-grid arrangements. templates.title: Candid Mall Shopping Snapshot

titleLocalized.zh: Candid Mall Shopping Snapshot

templates.prompt: Create a realistic low-resolution candid phone photo of {argument name="people" default="two young adults"} descending an indoor {argument name="location" default="shopping mall escalator"}, captured from a lower diagonal angle across the escalator. The composition should feel accidental and slightly imperfect, with the escalator handrail and glass side panel cutting across the foreground as a strong diagonal obstruction. On the left, show a cheerful young man with short black slightly tousled hair, wearing a dark casual short-sleeve shirt. He is smiling genuinely while carrying several {argument name="products" default="oversized PC hardware boxes"} pressed against his torso, including visible GeForce RTX 4080 graphics card boxes, ASUS or GALAX-style GPU packaging, and a large black AORUS monitor box. His face, neck, forearms, and hands are visible, with natural warm skin tone and practical tension in the hands from holding heavy boxes. On the right, show a slim young woman standing slightly higher on the escalator, calm and composed, looking downward rather than at the camera. She has a neat short dark bob haircut with straight bangs, soft indoor shine, pale warm ivory skin, and an East Asian fashion-editorial inspired makeup style: smooth matte base, subtle eyes, and defined red lips. She wears a fitted sleeveless cream or beige knit top covered with small repeated dark text-like pattern, matching long patterned arm sleeves, and a short black pleated skirt with vivid blue and turquoise plaid paneling, blue trim, and a dark belt. Visible skin includes her face, neck, exposed shoulders, upper arms, a small neckline area, and partially visible thighs above the escalator rail. The skin should look natural and softly matte, as if smooth and cool to the touch, lit by ordinary overhead mall lights rather than beauty lighting. The background is a warm brown wood or laminate wall panel area inside a mall or electronics shopping center, with vertical seams, reflective metal rails, glass panels, and a partial passerby shape near the edge of the frame. Use practical indoor mall lighting: soft overhead illumination, warm reflected light from the brown wall, weak uneven shadows, and broken reflections on the escalator glass and metal. Keep a deep phone-camera-like depth of field where the subjects, boxes, escalator, and background remain mostly readable. The image should preserve compressed social-media photo texture: mild noise, softened details, slightly muddy colors, imperfect framing, and a believable candid snapshot feeling. The emotional tone is a funny, slightly surreal tech purchase moment: the man looks proud and happy after buying expensive gaming hardware, while the woman appears cool, stylish, and detached. It should feel like they had just bought the hardware and were caught by someone passing by before either noticed the camera.

templates.title: Childhood and Present Self Encounter

titleLocalized.zh: Childhood and Present Self Encounter

templates.prompt: Please generate an emotional photography work titled 'My Childhood Self and My Current Self Looking at Each Other' based on the clear personal photo I uploaded. Please strictly preserve the real identity characteristics from my current photo, including: face shape, facial proportions, eye and eyebrow structure, nose, lips, jawline, skin tone, sense of age, hairline, hairstyle features, and overall temperament. Do not turn me into someone else, do not Westernize, do not use influencer-style filters, do not over-beautify, and do not generate a fake AI face. The entire image must allow someone to see at a glance that the left and right sides are different life stages of the same person. Composition: Generate a 4:5 vertical, realistic photography-style portrait. There are two figures in the frame, sitting in the same simple studio space, looking at each other, forming a gentle emotional exchange. Left side: Childhood version of me. Right side: Current me (adult version, face must match my uploaded photo). Both adopt natural sitting positions; the image is simple, the composition is stable, and the focus is on the eye contact and emotional connection between the two people. Left character: Childhood version of me. Please reasonably generate a childhood version of me based on my current looks, aged approximately 7 years old. Retain identity features that correspond to the present to ensure it looks like 'me as a child,' including the continuation of facial contours, eye temperament, and face shape. Requirements: With an innocent, natural, and warm smile; head turned slightly to the right, looking at the adult version of me; wearing a light gray T-shirt and blue jeans; the year '1999' clearly written above the head. Right character: My current self. The right side is the current me, which must strictly reference the real appearance in my uploaded photo. Requirements: The adult image must be natural and realistic; sitting, body slightly facing left; hands naturally resting on the chin; with a calm, gentle, and restrained smile; eyes looking at the childhood self on the left, presenting a gentle gaze as if conversing with the past self; wearing a white T-shirt and blue jeans; the year '2026' clearly written above the head. Scene and Background: The scene is a pure, soft professional studio background. Suggested background colors: light gray, warm gray, beige gray, or cream gray. The background should be simple and clean, with no clutter, no furniture, and no complex decorations. Make the image look like a real studio photograph rather than a poster design. Lighting and Atmosphere: Use soft, warm, cinematic lighting; light is even and natural, with slight three-dimensionality and soft shadows on the face. The overall atmosphere is gentle, quiet, healing, and has a sense of time flowing. The emotional focus is the gentle eye contact between the childhood self and the current self. Style Requirements: Overall style: professional portrait photography, minimalist emotional photography, realistic, natural, restrained, high-quality realistic style, focusing on character emotions and the visual communication between the two versions. Important Restrictions: Do not change my core looks; do not make the childhood version a stranger; no cartoon style, no illustration style, no AI plastic skin; no exaggerated makeup, no excessive smoothing; no complex backgrounds, no extra people; no incorrect hands, no extra fingers; no garbled text; no other text except for the years '1999' and '2026' at the top. Final Output: Output a 4:5 vertical, highly realistic, warm, minimalist, cinematic photography piece. On the left is the childhood me, and on the right is the current me, both sitting and looking at each other, like a real photograph about time, growth, and self-reconciliation.
