templates.title: Minimalist Studio Editorial Grid

titleLocalized.zh: Minimalist Studio Editorial Grid

templates.prompt:
Please generate a 'Warm Minimalist Studio Fashion Photo Shoot 3x3 Grid Collage' based on the clear photo of the person I uploaded.

Strictly preserve the real identity characteristics of the person in the photo, including face shape, facial feature proportions, eyebrow and eye structure, nose, lips, jawline, skin tone, perceived age, hairline, hairstyle features, and overall temperament. Do not turn the person into someone else; avoid excessive beautification, influencer-style aesthetics, or AI-generated fake faces. The final nine images must feature the same adult person, just presenting different compositions, poses, and local details within the same studio shoot.

Image Format:
Generate a 3x3 fashion photo collage with a 4:5 aspect ratio. The nine photos should look like an editorial moodboard from a magazine page or a contact sheet curated by a photographer. Each cell features the same person in the same studio setting but with different views, including facial close-ups, half-body shots, profile shots, shoulder and neck details, waist details, back views, upper body movement, and two-thirds body compositions.

Character Setting:
An adult East Asian female with a natural, clean, soft, and fashionable temperament, reflecting the aesthetic sense of women from first-tier cities. The overall feeling should be elegant, relaxed, and feminine, but must be high-end, restrained, and natural—not vulgar, not overly sexy, not studio-style kitsch, and without influencer filters.

Hairstyle and Makeup:
Retain the real hairstyle base from the original photo, but it can be slightly styled to be more voluminous, airy, and naturally lustrous. Hair can be naturally loose, slightly messy, with a light wind-blown effect. Makeup should be clean and elegant, skin with a natural glow, preserving real skin texture; no heavy makeup, no exaggerated eye makeup, no plastic skin.

Outfit:
The person wears a white slim-fit cropped tank top, a white knit vest, a white off-the-shoulder top, or a white ribbed sleeveless top, paired with light blue loose jeans. Accessories include minimalist thin necklaces, thin bracelets, or small earrings. The overall outfit is clean, light, and fashionable, like the minimalist female photo style popular in major cities in Korea/Japan/China. Clothing should fit the body naturally but not be overly revealing or sexualized.

Scene:
A clean indoor studio with a background of warm beige, cream, or light camel walls. No clutter, no furniture, no text, no logos. The overall environment is minimalist, warm, and soft, like a high-end fashion magazine shoot set.

Lighting:
Soft warm studio lighting, with light coming softly from the front-side or above, giving the skin a slight creamy texture and natural highlights. Shadows should be soft; no hard flash, no strong contrast. The overall atmosphere is warm, dreamy, and cinematic.

3x3 Grid Content:

Grid 1:
Facial close-up, head slightly turned, hair naturally falling along the side of the face with a slight wind-blown feel. Eyes looking at the camera or slightly away, expression quiet, confident, and soft.

Grid 2:
Profile half-body shot, the person standing, body sideways to the camera, one hand naturally raised to tidy the hair, eyes closed or head slightly lowered, pose elegant and relaxed. Highlight the profile, neck, and upper body lines.

Grid 3:
Shoulder, neck, and collarbone detail, showing only the chin, neck, shoulder line, white top, and thin necklace, without showing the full face. High-end, restrained, with a magazine detail close-up feel.

Grid 4:
Soft emotional facial close-up, eyes closed or half-closed, hair naturally sweeping across the face, relaxed expression, slight soft focus and warm light.

Grid 5:
Half-body fashion shot, one hand naturally placed near the collarbone or lightly resting on the upper chest, the other hand hanging naturally. Movement should be elegant; no exaggerated gestures, expression quiet and atmospheric.

Grid 6:
Two-thirds body or near full-body shot, person in a white cropped top and light blue jeans, hands naturally raised or stretching, posing like a natural stretch in a studio. The image should be fashionable, clean, and light.

Grid 7:
Shoulder, neck, and hand detail, capturing the white top, thin necklace, and fingers lightly touching the collar or shoulder. Hands must be natural and structurally correct, no deformation, not overly sexy.

Grid 8:
Back view or side-back shot, person facing away from the camera, one hand naturally raised to tidy hair, revealing the upper back silhouette and long hair lines. Elegant and restrained, not over-exposed.

Grid 9:
Waist and upper body detail, capturing the white cropped top, light blue jeans, waistline, and fabric details. Composed like a fashion magazine detail outfit shot, no full face needed.

Overall Photography Style:
High-end fashion magazine editorial, warm minimalist studio shoot, slight film feel, soft focus but clear features, natural skin tone, clean visuals, lifestyle moodboard atmosphere. Lens feel like 35mm to 85mm portrait photography, shallow to medium depth of field, sharp subject, simple soft background.

Expression and Pose Requirements:
The nine images should not all have the same expression or angle. There should be variety: looking at the camera, closing eyes, profile, head down, tidying hair, body stretching, back view, and detail shots. Overall natural, relaxed, and elegant; not like an ID photo, not like a Taobao model stiffly posing.

Consistency Requirements:
All nine images must maintain consistency in the same person's face and temperament. Composition, pose, angle, and cropping can change, but do not change face shape, facial feature proportions, nose, lips, eyes, skin tone, or perceived age. Do not make people in different cells look like different individuals.

Hand and Body Stability Requirements:
Hand movements must be simple and natural. Do not generate extra fingers, deformed fingers, broken wrists, misplaced arms, or strange body structures. If hands are prone to error, automatically simplify the movement. Priority is given to the realism and naturalness of the person, followed by pose complexity.

Restrictions:
No other people, no cluttered backgrounds, no text, no watermarks, no logos. No exaggerated heavy makeup, no excessive skin smoothing, no plastic skin, no cartoon style, no vulgarity or pornography, no excessive exposure, no incorrect human anatomy, no blurred low-quality faces.

Final Output:
A single 4:5 vertical 3x3 fashion photography grid collage. The overall effect should be close to a high-end female editorial moodboard in a warm minimalist studio: clean, soft, fashionable, natural, restrained, and atmospheric.

templates.title: Time-Travel Birthday Reunion Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: Time-Travel Birthday Reunion Portrait

templates.prompt:
Please generate an emotional photography piece titled "My Childhood Self and My Current Self Celebrating a Birthday Together" based on the clear current personal photo I uploaded.

Please strictly preserve the authentic identity characteristics from my current photo, including: face shape, facial proportions, eyebrow and eye structure, nose, lips, jawline, skin tone, sense of age, hairline, hairstyle characteristics, and overall temperament.

Do not change me into a different person, do not westernize, do not follow "internet celebrity" aesthetics, do not over-beautify, and do not generate AI fake faces. The entire image must make it immediately obvious that the child and the adult in the frame are the same person at different stages of life.

---

## Core Image Settings

Generate a highly realistic 4:5 vertical photography piece.

There are two characters in the scene:
- One is my childhood version
- One is my current version

The two characters should appear in the same real scene, the same photo, under the same lighting, and within the same color palette, as if they are truly sitting together for a birthday and taking a commemorative photo.

Do not use dividing lines, do not use split screens, do not stitch dual scenes together, and do not make one half black-and-white and the other half color. The whole must look like a naturally and authentically captured birthday group photo, not a poster collage.

---

## Character Relationship and Emotion

This is a photo about "my current self meeting my childhood self and celebrating a birthday together." There should be a clear emotional connection and a sense of interaction between the two, as if they are meeting gently in the same space-time.

Emotional keywords: Warm, healing, quiet, soft, moving, growth, self-reconciliation, sense of time flow.

The interaction could be:
- The two looking at each other
- Both looking down at the cake together
- The adult looking gently at their younger self while the child responds naturally and happily

The overall feeling should be: On this birthday, the grown-up version of me finally sits down to accompany my younger self in blowing out the candles.

---

## Left Character: My Childhood Version

Please reasonably generate a childhood version of me based on my current appearance, aged approximately [Childhood Age, e.g., 5/6/7 years old].

This child must retain identity characteristics that correspond to my current self, making it clear that this is "me as a child," including:
- Continuity of facial contours
- Continuity of gaze and temperament
- Continuity of face shape features
- An overall "look like the same person" temperament

Childhood version requirements:
- Natural sense of age, like a real child
- Expression is innocent, warm, and natural
- Clothing is simple and daily, such as a light gray T-shirt, knit top, or minimalist children's wear
- Natural sitting posture, not stiff
- Can smile, look at my current self, or look at the cake
- Must not be a stranger child; there must be a strong "this is me when I was little" déjà vu

---

## Right Character: My Current Self

The right side is my current self, which must strictly refer to the facial appearance in the photo I uploaded.

Adult version requirements:
- Face must match the reference photo
- Looks like the current me, realistic and natural
- Sense of age consistent with current state
- Wearing clean and nice daily clothing, such as a white/beige/light-colored top paired with blue jeans
- Natural and relaxed posture
- Can rest chin on hands or place them naturally on the table
- Gaze directed at the childhood self with a gentle, calm, and restrained smile

Emotional focus for the adult version: As if gently watching one's past self, accompanying her/him as they grow up.

---

## Cake and Age Elements

Place a realistic and natural birthday cake in the middle or foreground. The cake should be one of the emotional centers of the frame but should not overpower the subjects.

Requirements:
- Cake placed in the center of the table
- Simple, realistic, and natural design suitable for a birthday atmosphere
- The cake has lit number candles
- The number on the candles is: [Current Age]
- The candle flame is soft and warm, slightly illuminating the faces of the two characters and the surface of the cake
- The cake is an important symbol of "my current self and my childhood self celebrating a birthday together"

---

## Year Information

Please present the following years in a low-key, simple, and elegant small font within the frame:
- Near or above the childhood character: ([Childhood Year])
- Near or above the current character: ([Current Year])

The font should be simple and natural, like lightweight typography in a photographic work, and should not distract from the main subject. Aside from these years and the age numbers on the cake, no other text should appear.

---

## Scene and Background

The scene is a pure, soft, and minimalist indoor photography space.

Suggested background colors: Light gray, warm gray, beige gray, cream gray.

Requirements:
- Clean and simple background
- No complex decorations, no clutter, no extra people
- Just a table is enough
- The overall look should be like a real photo studio or a minimalist lifestyle photography space

---

## Lighting and Tone

Use soft, warm, cinematic lighting.

Requirements:
- Even and natural light
- Faces have a slight three-dimensional feel
- Soft shadows
- Unified overall color tone
- No different color temperatures on left and right sides
- Do not create a visual effect of two different eras stitched together

The overall tone should be warm, healing, and realistic, like a high-end but natural birthday commemorative photo.

---

## Style Requirements

The overall style is: High-quality realistic photography · Minimalist emotional photography · Birthday commemorative portrait. Realistic, natural, and restrained, suitable for posting on social media.

The focus of the image is: Two life stages of the same person celebrating a birthday together in the same space-time, creating a gentle emotional exchange.

---

## ⚠️ Important Restrictions

- Do not change my core appearance
- Do not make the childhood version a stranger child
- No split screens, no dividing lines, no collage feel
- Do not make one side black-and-white and the other colored
- No westernization, no internet celebrity look, no AI fake faces
- No cartoon style, no illustration style, no plastic skin
- No exaggerated makeup, no excessive skin smoothing
- No complex backgrounds, no extra people
- No hand errors, no extra fingers
- No garbled text
- Aside from ([Childhood Year]), ([Current Year]), and the [Current Age] on the cake candles, no other text should appear.

---

## Final Output

Output a 4:5 vertical, highly realistic, warm, minimalist, and cinematic birthday emotional photography piece. In the frame, my childhood self and my current self sit in the same scene, celebrating a birthday together with a birthday cake and age candles in between. The two look as if they have truly met in the same space-time, forming a real commemorative photo about time, growth, and self-embrace.

The two characters should appear in the same real scene, the same photo, under the same lighting, and within the same color palette, as if they are truly sitting together for a birthday and taking a commemorative photo.

Do not use dividing lines, do not use split screens, do not stitch dual scenes together, and do not make one half black-and-white and the other half color. The whole must look like a naturally and authentically captured birthday group photo, not a poster collage.

---

## Character Relationship and Emotion

This is a photo about "my current self meeting my childhood self and celebrating a birthday together." There should be a clear emotional connection and a sense of interaction between the two, as if they are meeting gently in the same space-time.

Emotional keywords: Warm, healing, quiet, soft, moving, growth, self-reconciliation, sense of time flow.

The interaction could be:
- The two looking at each other
- Both looking down at the cake together
- The adult looking gently at their younger self while the child responds naturally and happily

The overall feeling should be: On this birthday, the grown-up version of me finally sits down to accompany my younger self in blowing out the candles.

---

## Left Character: My Childhood Version

Please reasonably generate a childhood version of me based on my current appearance, aged approximately [Childhood Age, e.g., 5/6/7 years old].

This child must retain identity characteristics that correspond to my current self, making it clear that this is "me as a child," including:
- Continuity of facial contours
- Continuity of gaze and temperament
- Continuity of face shape features
- An overall "look like the same person" temperament

Childhood version requirements:
- Natural sense of age, like a real child
- Expression is innocent, warm, and natural
- Clothing is simple and daily, such as a light gray T-shirt, knit top, or minimalist children's wear
- Natural sitting posture, not stiff
- Can smile, look at my current self, or look at the cake
- Must not be a stranger child; there must be a strong "this is me when I was little" déjà vu

---

## Right Character: My Current Self

The right side is my current self, which must strictly refer to the facial appearance in the photo I uploaded.

Adult version requirements:
- Face must match the reference photo
- Looks like the current me, realistic and natural
- Sense of age consistent with current state
- Wearing clean and nice daily clothing, such as a white/beige/light-colored top paired with blue jeans
- Natural and relaxed posture
- Can rest chin on hands or place them naturally on the table
- Gaze directed at the childhood self with a gentle, calm, and restrained smile

Emotional focus for the adult version: As if gently watching one's past self, accompanying her/him as they grow up.

---

## Cake and Age Elements

Place a realistic and natural birthday cake in the middle or foreground. The cake should be one of the emotional centers of the frame but should not overpower the subjects.

Requirements:
- Cake placed in the center of the table
- Simple, realistic, and natural design suitable for a birthday atmosphere
- The cake has lit number candles
- The number on the candles is: [Current Age]
- The candle flame is soft and warm, slightly illuminating the faces of the two characters and the surface of the cake
- The cake is an important symbol of "my current self and my childhood self celebrating a birthday together"

---

## Year Information

Please present the following years in a low-key, simple, and elegant small font within the frame:
- Near or above the childhood character: ([Childhood Year])
- Near or above the current character: ([Current Year])

The font should be simple and natural, like lightweight typography in a photographic work, and should not distract from the main subject. Aside from these years and the age numbers on the cake, no other text should appear.

---

## Scene and Background

The scene is a pure, soft, and minimalist indoor photography space.

Suggested background colors: Light gray, warm gray, beige gray, cream gray.

Requirements:
- Clean and simple background
- No complex decorations, no clutter, no extra people
- Just a table is enough
- The overall look should be like a real photo studio or a minimalist lifestyle photography space

---

## Lighting and Tone

Use soft, warm, cinematic lighting.

Requirements:
- Even and natural light
- Faces have a slight three-dimensional feel
- Soft shadows
- Unified overall color tone
- No different color temperatures on left and right sides
- Do not create a visual effect of two different eras stitched together

The overall tone should be warm, healing, and realistic, like a high-end but natural birthday commemorative photo.

---

## Style Requirements

The overall style is: High-quality realistic photography · Minimalist emotional photography · Birthday commemorative portrait. Realistic, natural, and restrained, suitable for posting on social media.

The focus of the image is: Two life stages of the same person celebrating a birthday together in the same space-time, creating a gentle emotional exchange.

---

## ⚠️ Important Restrictions

- Do not change my core appearance
- Do not make the childhood version a stranger child
- No split screens, no dividing lines, no collage feel
- Do not make one side black-and-white and the other colored
- No westernization, no internet celebrity look, no AI fake faces
- No cartoon style, no illustration style, no plastic skin
- No exaggerated makeup, no excessive skin smoothing
- No complex backgrounds, no extra people
- No hand errors, no extra fingers
- No garbled text
- Aside from ([Childhood Year]), ([Current Year]), and the [Current Age] on the cake candles, no other text should appear.

---

## Final Output

Output a 4:5 vertical, highly realistic, warm, minimalist, and cinematic birthday emotional photography piece. In the frame, my childhood self and my current self sit in the same scene, celebrating a birthday together with a birthday cake and age candles in between. The two look as if they have truly met in the same space-time, forming a real commemorative photo about time, growth, and self-embrace.

templates.prompt:
Use the uploaded photo to generate a 9:16 vertical calendar card.

[1. Execution Mode — Critical]

This is an image editing task, NOT image generation.

Use the original photo as the base layer
Do NOT recreate, redraw, or reinterpret the image

Strictly preserve:

face, identity, expression, hair, body, clothing
original lighting, shadows, color temperature
environment and composition

❗ No beautification, no smoothing, no retouching
❗ The photo must look unchanged

[2. Allowed Operations — Overlay Only]

Only add design elements on top:

bottom 30% soft gradient extension (for calendar area)
subtle translucent mask for readability
calendar layout, month title, and short caption

Forbidden:

repainting or altering existing pixels
changing global color style
applying “design filters”
[3. Color Strategy]

Colors must come from the current image:

extract primary / secondary / accent colors
apply slight desaturation and brightness normalization only
keep original photo color feeling

👉 Respect the image, do not redesign the color system

[4. Layout Structure]
Top 70%: original image (untouched)
Bottom 30%: gradient + calendar
smooth transition, no hard edges
clean spacing, minimal design
magazine-like, not template-style
[5. Calendar Content — Must Be Accurate]

Generate correct calendar for the given month:

Title: {argument name="month title" default="July 2026 / 2026.07"}
Weekdays: Mon Tue Wed Thu Fri Sat Sun
Dates: accurate alignment based on real calendar
[6. Caption Rules — Important]

Length: 8–16 words (or equivalent short phrase)

Requirements:

max 2 lines
no exclamation marks
no clichés, no motivational tone
do NOT explain emotions

Preferred style:

subtle, atmospheric
fragment-like, not fully explanatory
leave emotional space

👉 Make people pause, not finish reading

[7. Image Selection Guidance — Key to Success]

Prefer:

side face / partially hidden face
natural遮挡 (hat, hand, shadow)
motion (walking, turning)
mood > facial detail

Avoid:
front-facing portraits
strong identity-focused close-ups

👉 Reduce face-modification risk

[Final Principle]

👉 Do NOT generate a better photo.
Gently place design on the original photo.

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic vertical portrait of a confident male tech entrepreneur seated at a dark desk in a modern studio office, centered in the frame from mid-torso up. He wears a textured {argument name="blazer color" default="charcoal gray"} blazer over a black button-up shirt, with neatly slicked-back black hair, hands clasped around a smartphone at the bottom center. The face area should be covered by a plain rectangular skin-tone placeholder block, as if reserved for a face-swap or uploaded portrait. The background is a moody black shelving wall with teal cyan LED strip lights: one long horizontal light behind the head, another on a left shelf, and two on the right shelves. Include visible studio props on the shelves: one large podcast microphone on the upper left, one camera on the middle left, one camera lens on the lower left, a camera and small plant on the upper right, two awards/trophies on the middle right, and a small metallic desk object on the lower right. Use dramatic low-key lighting, teal rim light, realistic shadows, glossy highlights, shallow depth of field, premium corporate branding aesthetic, ultra-realistic photography, sharp focus on the suit and hands. Add a bold glowing name title in the lower-right corner reading {argument name="name text" default="DILSHAD\nHUSSAIN"}, in large condensed white uppercase sans-serif letters with a cyan neon glow, thin cyan horizontal line above and below the text, and a small triangular accent under the lower line. Aspect ratio 9:16, high resolution, social-media poster style.

  "type": "Stardew Valley style character wiki poster",
  "format": "square pixel-art game UI poster",
  "overall_style": "cozy retro 16-bit pixel art mixed with an anime-style in-game portrait, warm parchment panels, wooden frames, golden-brown UI borders, tiny decorative leaves and hearts, faithful to the look of a Stardew Valley villager profile page",

  "header": {

        "count": 1,
        "labels": [

        ],
        "contents": "short biography text: Tomie is enigmatic, beautiful, and terrifying. She doesn’t age, and no one truly understands her. Befriend her carefully—she remembers everything."
      },

        "position": "bottom left",

templates.prompt: Create a candid front-facing smartphone selfie of {argument name="subject" default="a young Asian woman"} sitting on an unmade bed in a dim bedroom at night, framed from the upper thighs to just above the head with one arm extended toward the camera. templates.prompt: Create a square anime-style CD jacket illustration with a dramatic Japanese ink-wash and watercolor aesthetic on aged cream paper. The central subject is a young woman named {argument name="character name" default="Shinako"}, an elegant saxophone player with very long wind-swept {argument name="hair color" default="violet-purple"} hair, purple eyes, and a large dark purple flower hair ornament. She wears a gothic black dress with layered ruffles, lace sleeves, violet ribbons, a purple waist sash, thigh-high dark stockings, and a slightly melancholic but confident expression while playing a large polished brass saxophone angled downward across her body. The composition should feel like a fusion of traditional Japanese art and modern rock album cover design: splattered sumi ink, watercolor blooms, red maple leaves, purple hydrangea-like flowers, bare tree branches, distant shrine torii gates, a hazy pagoda silhouette, a large muted red sun near the top, and dynamic blue-black waves swirling at the lower left. Use textured paper grain, ink splashes, rough brush edges, and layered transparent washes; keep the palette dominated by purple, black, indigo, antique gold, muted crimson, and ivory. Include exactly 7 visible text elements integrated like album cover typography: a dark vertical brush-stroke name strip on the upper left containing large Japanese text {argument name="artist name Japanese" default="Shinako"}, small vertical roman text "SHINAKO" beside it, a huge black calligraphic Japanese album title on the right reading {argument name="album title Japanese" default="The spirit of making excuses"}, small centered roman text beneath it reading "IWAKE DAMASHII", bottom-left Japanese genre text {argument name="genre tagline Japanese" default="Japanese rock x saxophone"}, tiny English subtitle below it reading "WAGASHI ROCK × SAXOPHONE", and a red rectangular seal stamp on the lower right reading {argument name="seal text" default="A cry from the soul"}. Make the lettering look hand-brushed, asymmetrical, and slightly weathered, with no modern clean vector look. The final image should be a polished square album-cover illustration, highly detailed, atmospheric, and print-ready.

基于上传的真实照片，创作一张高质量的“{argument name="style" default="Q 版克隆贴纸日记照片"}”。请保留原人物的身份、面部特征、发型、发色、服装、身体比例、姿势、光影和背景。请勿改变面部特征或将主体完全转化为插画——需保持写实照片的质感。

包含 5–8 个符合健身氛围（可爱、充满活力、鼓励性）的简短手写风格短语。主要使用白色文字，带有轻微的粉色高光和小装饰符号。

templates.title: Pixar-style project layout

titleLocalized.zh: 皮克斯风格项目布局

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic project page with a 2x3 grid (6 scenes), using a single image.{argument name="style" default="3D Pixar style"} Soft, warm-toned lighting, based on{argument name="theme" default="Gugu Gaga Costume Universe"} This page, "Share Your Light – Part 1," should convey the completeness required for a 15-second short film. All characters in all storyboards must be consistent: - Gugu Gaga Penguin: A petite, adorable child in a black penguin mascot costume, with a white belly, yellow feet, a yellow beak-shaped hood, short, messy dark hair, blue hair clips, a collar, and a crossbody strap. - Sunny Chick: A petite, adorable child in a round, yellow chick costume, with a small orange beak, short, curly orange hair, and a sunflower hair clip. Include simple speech bubbles with precise dialogue in quotes. No other text should appear on the page. Storyboard 1 (Top Left) – The Opening Solitude: Evening, a small, cozy playground, the sun setting, soft orange light. Long shot. Gugu Penguin sits alone on the edge of a sandpit, shoulders drooping, feet dangling, a faintly glowing lantern toy beside him. The background is a slightly blurred empty swing. Gugu's speech bubble: "My light is so faint... no one even notices me." Shot 2 (top center) – Close-up of sadness: Medium shot, zoom in on Gugu. The lantern's light appears faint on the costume. Gugu looks at her reflection in the lantern, her eyes welling up with tears. The background is mostly empty. Gugu's speech bubble: "Maybe I should hide it." Shot 3 (top right) – First encounter: The same playground, medium shot of two people. Sunny the chick waddles into the frame from the side with a string of paper stars, looking friendly and curious. Gugu looks up, surprised. Warm colors, sunset behind them. Sunny's speech bubble: "Hey... I noticed. Your light guided me here." Shot 4 (bottom left) – Sitting together: Two-person shot, Gugu and Sunny are now sitting side by side on the edge of the sandpit, the lantern between them casting a soft glow on the costume. The background park lights begin to appear, creating dappled light spots. Sunny's body language is open and friendly. Gugu's speech bubble: "Really? I don't think it's that bright." Shot 5 (bottom center) – Gentle reassurance: A slight zoom in on Sunny and Gugu. Sunny leans closer, smiling gently, an arm that looks like a wing pointing towards the lantern. The lantern's light brightens slightly. Sunny's speech bubble: "It's bright enough for me to find you." Shot 6 (bottom right) – Part 1 suspense: A medium close-up of two people, the lantern positioned between their faces. Gugu looks uncertain but hopeful. Sunny's eyes sparkle in the warm light. Background blurred. Gugu's speech bubble: "But what if it's not enough to help anyone?" No further text; leaving this emotional suspense at the end of Part 1.

promptLocalized.zh:
创建一个 2x3 网格（6 个分镜）的电影感项目页面，单张图像，{argument name="style" default="3D 皮克斯风格"}，柔和的暖色调灯光，基于 {argument name="theme" default="Gugu Gaga 玩偶服宇宙"}。此页面为“分享你的光芒 – 第一部分”，应呈现出 15 秒短片所需的完整感。所有分镜中的角色需保持一致：

- Gugu Gaga 企鹅：身穿黑色企鹅吉祥物玩偶服的娇小可爱儿童，白色肚皮，黄色脚掌，黄色喙状兜帽，短而凌乱的深色头发，蓝色发夹，带有项圈和斜挎带。

- Sunny 小鸡：身穿圆形黄色小鸡玩偶服的娇小可爱儿童，带有小巧的橙色喙，短卷橙色头发，向日葵发夹。

包含简单的对话气泡，并附上引号内的准确对话。页面上不要出现其他文字。

分镜 1（左上）– 开篇的孤独：
傍晚，一个小而温馨的游乐场，夕阳西下，柔和的橙色光线。远景。Gugu 企鹅独自坐在沙坑边缘，肩膀下垂，企鹅脚悬空，身边放着一个微弱发光的小灯笼玩具。背景是略显模糊的空秋千。Gugu 的对话气泡：“我的光芒太微弱了……根本没人注意到我。”

分镜 2（中上）– 近景的悲伤：
中景，拉近 Gugu。灯笼的光在玩偶服上显得很微弱。Gugu 看着灯笼里的倒影，眼眶湿润。背景大部分仍是空的。Gugu 的对话气泡：“也许我应该把它藏起来。”

分镜 3（右上）– 初次接触：
同样的游乐场，中景双人镜头。Sunny 小鸡拿着一串小纸星星从侧面摇摇晃晃地走进画面，神情友善且好奇。Gugu 抬头，感到惊讶。暖色调，夕阳在他们身后。Sunny 的对话气泡：“嘿……我注意到了。你的光芒指引我来到这里。”

分镜 4（左下）– 坐在一起：
双人镜头，Gugu 和 Sunny 现在并排坐在沙坑边缘，灯笼在他们中间，在玩偶服上投下柔和的光芒。背景公园灯光开始出现，形成点点虚化光斑。Sunny 的肢体语言开放且友好。Gugu 的对话气泡：“真的吗？我觉得它没那么亮。”

分镜 5（中下）– 温柔的安慰：
稍微拉近 Sunny 和 Gugu。Sunny 凑近，温柔地微笑着，一只像翅膀一样的手臂指向灯笼。灯笼的光亮了一些。Sunny 的对话气泡：“它足够亮，让我找到了你。”

分镜 6（右下）– 第一部分悬念：
中近景双人镜头，灯笼位于他们脸部中间。Gugu 看起来有些不确定，但充满希望。Sunny 的眼睛在暖光下闪闪发光。背景虚化。Gugu 的对话气泡：“但如果它不足以帮助任何人怎么办？”没有其他文字；将这个情感悬念留在第一部分的结尾。

templates.title: Cinematic Character Posters with Layers and Depth

titleLocalized.zh: 具有层次深度的电影感角色海报

templates.prompt: Design a high-end cinematic character poster with a layered and deep composition (9:16 vertical screen), employing a strong "foreground-midground-background" separation design rather than a silhouette composition.{argument name="character" default="Role"} Slightly off-center, presenting a dynamic and perspective-like pose, and{argument name="environment" default="Environment (wind, light, particle, fabric movement)"} Natural interaction. Camera angles should be intentional—low angles convey power, or slight tilts create tension—thus creating dynamism and presence. Backgrounds should not be confined to specific shapes but should build a vibrant world around the character: create an atmospheric environment (fog, city lights, ruins, natural landscapes, etc.); use beams of light, volumetric light, and floating particles to naturally place subtle narrative elements in space (rather than collage); introduce floating fragments or layered planes (shards of glass, light panels, fragments of memory, holographic slices, or torn edges of paper) to surround or interweave in the scene, each element containing a subtle symbolic visual effect related to the character's story—maintaining minimalism and elegance, avoiding clutter. Lighting should be cinematic and directional: strong key light outlines the subject; edge light separates the subject from the background; soft gradients and shadow decay enhance depth; color schemes should follow {argument name="color palette" default="Controlled duotone systems (e.g., cyan-orange, magenta-gold, deep red-black)."} Color transitions are smooth, avoiding oversaturation. Layout: Place the title in a clean, modern, cinematic layout, subtly integrating the text into the environment (ground, light and shadow projections, or floating UI style). Avoid heavy or overly large typographic layouts. Overall style: Hyperrealistic + cinematic editing style, sharp subject details, a background with soft atmospheric depth, minimalist yet meaningful narrative elements, achieving top-tier movie poster quality. Avoid: Silhouette-filled compositions, heavy collage density, watercolor textures, or ink-wash edges. Focus on spatial depth, realism, and cinematic immersion.

promptLocalized.zh:
设计一张具有层次深度构图（9:16 竖屏）的高端电影感角色海报，采用强烈的“前景-中景-背景”分离设计，而非剪影式构图。
{argument name="character" default="角色"} 略微偏离中心，呈现动态且具透视感的姿势，与 {argument name="environment" default="环境（风、光、粒子、织物运动）"} 自然互动。摄像机角度应具有意图感——低角度展现力量感，或轻微倾斜营造张力——从而创造出动感与存在感。
背景不应被限制在特定形状内，而应围绕角色构建一个鲜活的世界：
营造氛围感环境（雾气、城市灯光、废墟、自然景观等）
光束、体积光、漂浮粒子
将微妙的叙事元素自然地置于空间中（而非拼贴式）
引入漂浮碎片或分层平面（玻璃碎片、光板、记忆片段、全息切片或撕裂的纸张边缘），使其环绕或穿插于场景中，每个元素都包含与角色故事相关的微弱象征性视觉效果——保持极简与优雅，避免杂乱。
光影应具备电影感且具有方向性：
强主光勾勒主体轮廓
边缘光将主体与背景分离
柔和的渐变与阴影衰减以增强深度
配色方案应遵循 {argument name="color palette" default="受控的双色调系统（例如：青橙色、紫金色、深红黑）"}，色彩过渡平滑，避免过度饱和。
排版：
将标题置于简洁、现代的电影化布局中
将文字微妙地融入环境（地面、光影投影或浮动 UI 风格）
避免厚重或过大的排版
整体风格：超写实 + 电影级编辑风格，主体细节锐利，背景具有柔和的氛围深度，叙事元素极简且富有深意，达到顶级电影海报品质。
避免：剪影填充构图、沉重的拼贴密度、水彩质感或水墨边缘。专注于空间深度、写实感与电影级沉浸感。

The overall composition should not be a simple collage, but rather a sophisticated narrative synthesis of silhouettes. It should possess the associative effect of double exposure, but leans more towards a fusion of movie poster and dreamy watercolor illustration. Utilize soft aerial perspective, gentle misty transitions, paper texture, white edges with brushstrokes, and large areas of white space. The layout should appear restrained, sophisticated, tranquil, grand, sacred, nostalgic, poetic, and legendary. Palette:{argument name="colors" default="A blend of deep red and gray, soft pink, and deep obsidian."} All elements—style, color, scene, material—must automatically adapt to the theme, with every detail closely linked to it. They should be instantly recognizable. Avoid cluttered, jarring collages, templated backgrounds, or cheap fantasy elements.

promptLocalized.zh:
基于 {argument name="theme" default="进击的巨人"}，自动生成一张具有收藏价值的史诗级叙事海报：使用 {argument name="character" default="戴着红色围巾的米卡莎·阿卡曼"} 的侧面剪影作为外轮廓。在剪影内部，有机地生长出一个最契合主题的完整世界。希干希纳区燃烧的街道倒映在她的眼中；少年艾伦·耶格尔的笑容在烟雾中逐渐消散；阿卡曼家族的纹章如水印般隐约浮现；最终战场的阵阵海风带走了所有记忆；倒计时沙漏的碎片化作飘落的樱花，随后消散为灰烬。

整体构图不应是简单的拼贴，而应是精致的剪影叙事合成。它应具备双重曝光的联想效果，但更倾向于电影海报与梦幻水彩插画的融合。运用柔和的空气透视、轻柔的雾气过渡、纸张纹理、带有笔触感的白边以及大面积的留白。布局应显得克制、高级、宁静、宏大、神圣、怀旧、诗意且具有传奇色彩。

调色板：{argument name="colors" default="深红色与灰色的融合、柔和的粉色、深邃的黑曜石色"}。

所有元素——风格、色彩、场景、材质——必须自动适配主题，每一个细节都与主题紧密相连。一眼即可精准识别。避免杂乱、生硬的拼贴、模板化的背景或廉价的奇幻素材。

templates.prompt: Please generate a high-quality, high-resolution poster-style storyboard with the theme "{argument name="subject" default="Street freestyle football"} ·{argument name="action" default="16-step action breakdown"} The layout should be a 4x4 square grid, with each cell displaying a series of consecutive movements by the same street soccer performer in the same setting. The overall image should resemble both a high-end sports poster and a technical breakdown tutorial, combining visual impact with clear movement analysis. [Overall Setting] Theme: Street freestyle soccer performance (non-match or training), featuring a single performer completing a series of consecutive skill moves. Atmosphere: Street style, urban, cinematic, sporty, cool, and rhythmic. Background: Set in {argument name="background" default="Nighttime City Small Streetball Court"} Or a city square football space, complete with graffiti walls, barbed wire, distant building lights, streetlights, and a slightly reflective ground. The environment must be consistent and have a trendy street aesthetic. [Character Requirements] Protagonist: A young, handsome freestyle football expert, light, coordinated, and strong, with short black hair, confident demeanor, and fluid, controlled movements. The same person must appear in all 16 cells; do not change the character in different cells. Clothing: Cool football gear, but do not include words such as "Champion" or specific country names. The clothing should have the texture of a professional team jersey. [Layout Requirements] The entire image is a 4x4 grid of 16 cells. Each cell must contain: 1. Large step number (1-16) 2. Chinese action title 3. 2-4 short Chinese action highlights 4. Clear full-body shot of the character 5. Football trajectory arrow/footwork path 6. The ball must be clearly visible and logically positioned. Overall font style: Sports poster aesthetics, clear and powerful. Images should be sharp and clean; figures and balls must be complete and not truncated at the feet. [Action Sequence] Design 16 consecutive, distinct movements in sequence to form a complete freestyle performance: [Detailed steps 1-16, including starting position, footwork, step-around, flick, knee control, circling, shoulder stop, rainbow flick, and closing move]. [Visual Style] - High-end sports poster style - Cinematic nighttime lighting and shadows - Strong sense of movement and trendy street aesthetics - Clear arrows and trajectory lines to aid in understanding the ball's path - A color scheme primarily based on red, black, and gold to create a sophisticated feel - Eye-catching typography suitable for social media sharing.

promptLocalized.zh:
请生成一张高质量、高清晰度的海报风格故事板，主题为“{argument name="subject" default="街头花式足球"} · {argument name="action" default="16 步动作分解"}”。布局应为 4x4 的方形网格，每个单元格展示同一位街头足球表演者在相同场景下的连续动作步骤。整张图片应看起来既像高端体育海报，又像技术分解教学项目，兼具视觉冲击力和清晰的动作解析感。

[整体设定]
主题：街头花式足球表演（非比赛或训练），由一名表演者完成一套连续的技巧动作。
氛围：街头感、都市风、电影感、运动、酷炫且富有节奏感。
背景：设定在 {argument name="background" default="夜间城市小型街头球场"} 或城市广场足球空间，配有涂鸦墙、铁丝网、远处的建筑灯光、路灯以及略带反光的地面。环境必须保持一致，并具有潮流街头美学。

[人物要求]
主角：一位年轻帅气的花式足球专家，身材轻盈、协调且健壮，留着黑色短发，气质自信，动作流畅且受控。
同一个人必须出现在所有 16 个单元格中；请勿在不同单元格中更换人物。
服装：酷炫的足球装备，但不要出现“Champion”或特定国家名称等文字。服装应具有专业球队球衣的质感。

[布局要求]
整张图片为 16 个单元格的 4x4 网格。每个单元格必须包含：
1. 大号步骤编号（1-16）
2. 中文动作标题
3. 2-4 个简短的中文动作要点
4. 清晰的人物全身动作镜头
5. 足球轨迹箭头 / 脚法路径
6. 球必须清晰可见且位置符合逻辑。

整体字体风格：运动海报美学，清晰且有力。图像应锐利、整洁，人物和球必须完整，不得在脚部处被截断。

[动作序列]
请按顺序设计 16 个连续动作，每个动作都截然不同，形成一套完整的花式表演：[详细步骤 1-16，包括起始姿势、脚底拉球、跨步绕球、挑球、膝部控制、环绕世界、肩部停球、彩虹过人以及谢幕动作]。

[视觉风格]
- 高端体育海报风格
- 电影级夜间灯光与阴影
- 强烈的运动感与潮流街头美学
- 清晰的箭头和轨迹线，有助于理解球的运动路径
- 以红、黑、金为主的配色方案，营造高级质感
- 适合社交媒体传播的醒目排版

This generates a high-quality 16-grid movement deconstruction poster with the theme "..."{argument name="theme" default="Dunhuang dance "Flying Apsaras""} Core Requirements: - Layout: A 4x4 square grid with 16 cells, each cell corresponding to a continuous dance movement, numbered 1-16, following the original choreography logic of Dunhuang dance. - Aesthetics: Not ordinary teaching charts, but a cinematic storyboard poster with the atmosphere of Dunhuang murals, elegant in style and visually impactful. - Characters: The main character is {argument name="character_image" default="A classically elegant beauty"} (Gentle face, slender figure, and graceful demeanor), maintaining consistency across all cells without character switching. - Style: Dunhuang dance style, capturing the essence of "flying apsaras," showcasing flowing ribbons, elegant postures, and core movements such as lifting, sinking, rushing, leaning, twisting, and tilting. - Costume:{argument name="costume_style" default="Classic Dunhuang Flying Apsara Costumes"} The costumes feature nude and camel tones, accented with gold and sapphire patterns (clouds, intertwined flowers), and are made from lightweight, breathable fabrics (gauze/chiffon), paired with traditional headdresses and long silk ribbons. - Background: A mural-style background, primarily in earthy yellow and ochre, incorporating textures, auspicious clouds, and silhouette elements, complemented by soft warm lighting to highlight the dancers. - Cell Content: Prominent step numbers, Chinese names of movements (dance terminology), concise Chinese key points of the movements, and ribbons and arrows indicating body movement trajectories. - Overall Effect: Refined, unified, and sophisticated, perfectly combining practical teaching with the aesthetics of classical poster art and historical murals.

promptLocalized.zh:
古典之美：敦煌舞“飞天”动作拆解海报
生成一张高质量的 16 宫格动作拆解海报，主题为“{argument name="theme" default="敦煌舞《飞天》"}”。核心要求：
- 布局：4x4 正方形网格，共 16 个单元格，每个单元格对应一个连续的舞蹈动作，按 1-16 编号，遵循敦煌舞原始编舞逻辑。

- 人物：主角为 {argument name="character_image" default="古典优雅的美人"}（面容柔和、身姿纤细、气质灵动），在所有单元格中保持一致，不出现人物切换。

- 服装：{argument name="costume_style" default="经典敦煌飞天服饰"}，采用裸色和驼色调，配以金色和石青色的纹样（云纹、缠枝花卉），使用轻盈透气的面料（纱/雪纺），搭配传统头饰和长绸。

- 单元格内容：醒目的步骤编号、中文动作名称（舞蹈术语）、简洁的中文动作要点，以及丝带和身体运动轨迹箭头。
- 整体效果：精致、统一且高级，将教学实用性与古典海报艺术及历史壁画美学完美结合。

The background is a gradient of very light warm white and pale blue-gray, with clean white space. Soft snowflakes, ice crystals, shimmering particles, and faint golden light fall in the air, creating a tranquil, dreamlike, and beautiful winter wonderland atmosphere. The overall color scheme is dominated by snow white, deep green, jade, pale gold, and ice blue-gray. The image is bright and clear, with soft light and shadow, blending ink painting aesthetics, the texture of oriental illustration, and a high-end fantasy art style. Style: Beautiful oriental fantasy illustration, ancient style fairy heroine, exquisite digital painting, soft focus light and shadow, snow scene atmosphere, gorgeous hair accessories, exquisite clothing texture, realistic fur texture, cool and ethereal, poetic white space, high-end feel, ultra-high detail, exquisite character portraits, dreamlike atmosphere, clean and elegant, wallpaper-quality image.

背景为极浅的暖白与淡蓝灰色渐变，留白干净。柔和的雪花、冰晶、闪烁的微粒和淡淡的金光在空气中飘落，营造出宁静、梦幻且唯美的冬日仙境氛围。整体色调以雪白、深绿、碧玉、淡金和冰蓝灰为主。画面明亮通透，光影柔和，融合了水墨美学、东方插画质感与高端奇幻艺术风格。

templates.title: Underwater forest stream photography

titleLocalized.zh: 水下森林溪流摄影

templates.prompt: Shot using a high-definition underwater camera, this prompt aims to capture authentic natural underwater landscapes in an environment that is {argument name="environment description" default="Clear, shallow stream beside a tropical rainforest"} Vertical composition, 3:4 aspect ratio, mid-to-long distance. The camera is slightly below the water's surface, showcasing the shimmering water above, realistically depicting water refraction and natural reflection. Sunlight streams obliquely into the water from the upper right corner, creating soft beams and underwater light spots. The dark reflections and shadows of large tree branches occupy part of the upper right corner of the composition. At the center of the image is clear, tranquil stream water with slightly suspended particles, and {argument name="number of fish" default="5-8"} Small, native freshwater fish swim naturally, primarily gray-silver and light brown, varying in size and spacing, not forming orderly schools. Dark green, yellowish-green, and brownish-green aquatic plants grow on the stream bed, swaying gently with the current, naturally distributed, unlike in an artificial aquarium. The bottom consists of grayish-brown fine sand, gravel, pebbles, and a few naturally shaped stones, with slight traces of algae and water erosion. Multiple springs at the bottom show fine sand slowly seeping from the holes, forming slight sand clouds and localized water disturbances, rather than white smoke, steam, or large bubbles. This is a real shot of a natural landscape, with a high-end nature documentary feel, approaching the style of National Geographic ecological photography. It features clear water, natural lighting, restrained colors, realistic underwater optical effects, slight graininess, natural depth of field, and high-definition detail. There are no people, no buildings, no artificial elements, no text, no borders, and no logos. Avoid CG-like effects, aquarium appearance, underwater corals, exaggerated schools of fish, oversaturated greens, dreamy lighting effects, or plastic aquatic plants.

promptLocalized.zh:
使用高清水下相机拍摄，此提示词旨在捕捉真实的自然水下景观，环境为 {argument name="environment description" default="热带原始森林旁的清澈浅溪"}。

竖构图，3:4 比例，中远景。镜头略低于水面，展示上方波光粼粼的水面，呈现逼真的水波折射和自然反射。

阳光从右上角斜射入水中，形成柔和的光束和水下光斑。大树枝的深色倒影和阴影占据了右上角的部分构图。

画面中央是清澈宁静的溪水，带有轻微的悬浮颗粒，以及 {argument name="number of fish" default="5-8"} 条原生淡水小鱼在自然游动，主要为灰银色和浅褐色，大小和距离各异，未形成整齐的鱼群。溪床上生长着深绿色、黄绿色和褐绿色的水草，随水流轻轻摇曳，分布自然，不像人工水族箱。

底部由灰褐色细沙、砾石、鹅卵石以及几块形状自然的石头组成，带有轻微的藻类痕迹和水蚀迹象。底部的多个泉眼显示细沙从孔洞中缓慢涌出，形成轻微的沙云和局部水体扰动，而非白烟、蒸汽或大气泡。

自然景观实拍，高端自然纪录片质感，接近《国家地理》生态摄影风格。具备清澈的水质、自然光照、克制的色彩、逼真的水下光学效果、轻微的颗粒感、自然的景深以及高清细节。

无人物，无建筑，无人造痕迹，无文字，无边框，无 LOGO。避免 CG 感、水族箱外观、海底珊瑚、夸张的鱼群、过饱和的绿色、梦幻光效或塑料水草。

templates.prompt: #Summer Grape Girl Photo Series | 3x3 Nine-Grid Hints: Based on **1-3 clear personal photos** uploaded by users, a theme is generated for each photo.{argument name="photo theme" default="Summer Grape Girl Photo Series"} **3x3 Nine-Grid Photo Collage**. --- ## 1. Subject Requirements: Strictly retain the user's authentic identity characteristics, including but not limited to: - Face shape - Facial proportions - Eyebrow and eye structure - Nose shape - Lip shape - Skin tone - Age - Hairstyle - Overall temperament. The person in each of the nine small photos must clearly look like **the same real girl**; she cannot become a stranger, cannot look overly Westernized, cannot resemble an internet celebrity, cannot be excessively beautified, and cannot have an AI-generated feel. The subject's identity must remain consistent across all photos. --- ## 2. Theme Setting: The theme of the entire photo set is **"Grape Girl Photo Series"**, with the following atmosphere requirements: - Fresh - Natural - Sweet and light - Everyday youthful feeling - Summer outdoor feeling - With a Japanese film portrait style - Looks like high-quality lifestyle photos taken by an ordinary girl, rather than exaggerated studio photography. --- ## 3. Styling Setting: Subject's clothing: - **{argument name="clothing style" default="Off-white/grey-white dress or slip dress"} **The material is soft, natural, and exudes youthful energy. - Worn on the head**{argument name="headwear accessory" default="Purple retro floral headscarf"} **The color scheme should be a soft purple, such as light purple, grape purple, or hazy purple.** - Simple small earrings can be paired with it; the overall accessories should not be complicated or overly fashionable. The overall look should be natural and clean, like a portrait of an ordinary girl, without excessive retouching or resembling a commercial advertisement. --- ## 4. Scene Setting: The scene should be a **summer outdoor picnic on a grassy field/beside a vineyard/under the shade of trees**. The image should contain the following elements: - Purple grapes - Grape bunches - Wicker basket - Picnic mat - Glass bottle - White plate or light-colored tableware - Grass, tree shadows, natural sunlight - The minimalist tabletop or picnic setup background should be softly blurred to present a natural and realistic atmosphere, with dappled sunlight filtering through the leaves. --- ## 5. 3x3 Grid: The output should be a **3x3 grid mosaic**, divided by a white border. The nine photos must showcase **the same person, the same outfit, and the same theme/scene**, but each photo must be significantly different in the following aspects: - Facial angle - Pose - Shooting distance - Camera position - Expression - Hand gestures - Composition ### Key Requirements - Don't let the face in all nine photos face the same direction. - Don't let the expressions in all nine photos be almost identical. - Don't have only subtle differences. It should look like a series of behind-the-scenes photos taken consecutively during the actual shoot. --- ## 6. Pose Suggestions for the Nine Photos The nine photos can include the following different poses: 1. Sitting next to a picnic mat, holding a bunch of grapes in both hands, smiling with eyes closed. 2. Lying on the grass, head slightly tilted, looking at the camera, with grapes scattered around. 3. Holding a grape close to the mouth, looking at the camera with a playful expression. 4. A half-body side shot, naturally bending down to arrange grapes in a basket. 5. Sitting facing forward, with grapes, a glass bottle, and a basket in front of you; a calm expression. 6. Close-up shot: Holding grapes to the cheek, relaxed and smiling. 7. Slightly turning the head, holding a bunch of grapes, a natural candid shot. 8. Eyes closed, smelling or leaning close to grapes, looking relaxed and happy. 9. Lying on the side in the grass or under a tree, holding a wicker basket, gazing gently at the camera. --- ## 7. Overall Photography Style: - Fujifilm camera feel - Japanese film photography style - Soft natural light - Slight film grain - Shallow depth of field - Realistic shooting feel - Fresh summer tones - Purple grapes as the visual focus - Clean image, full of life and youthful energy. --- ## 8. Visual Requirements: - High-fidelity portrait photography - Natural skin texture - No plastic-looking skin - No excessive smoothing - No exaggerated beautification - No excessive sharpening - No cartoonish feel - No illustration feel - No CG feel - No cheap studio photography feel

promptLocalized.zh:
# 夏日葡萄女孩照片系列 | 3x3 九宫格提示词

基于用户上传的 **1-3 张清晰的个人照片**，生成一个主题为 **"{argument name="photo theme" default="夏日葡萄女孩照片系列"}"** 的 **3x3 九宫格照片拼图**。

---

## 1. 人物要求

严格保留用户的真实身份特征，包括但不限于：

- 脸型
- 面部比例
- 眉眼结构
- 鼻型
- 唇形
- 肤色
- 年龄感
- 发型特征
- 整体气质

九张小图中的人物必须清晰地看起来是**同一个真实女孩**；她不能变成陌生人、不能看起来过于西化、不能像网红脸、不能过度美颜，也不能有 AI 生成感。必须在所有照片中保持人物身份的一致性。

---

## 2. 主题设定

整组照片的主题为 **“葡萄女孩照片系列”**，氛围要求：

- 清新
- 自然
- 甜美轻盈
- 日常青春感
- 夏日户外感
- 带有日系胶片人像风格
- 看起来像普通女孩拍摄的高质量生活照，而非夸张的影楼摄影。

---

## 3. 造型设定

人物服装：

- **{argument name="clothing style" default="米白色/灰白色连衣裙或吊带裙"}**，材质柔软，自然，具有青春气息。
- 头上佩戴 **{argument name="headwear accessory" default="紫色复古碎花头巾"}**，色调为柔和的紫色，如浅紫、葡萄紫或雾霾紫。
- 可搭配简单的小耳环；整体配饰不宜复杂或过于时尚。

整体造型应自然、干净，像普通女孩的人像照，不要过度修饰或像商业广告。

---

## 4. 场景设定

场景为 **夏日户外草地野餐 / 葡萄园旁 / 树荫下**。

图像中包含以下元素：

- 紫葡萄
- 葡萄串
- 藤编篮
- 野餐垫
- 玻璃瓶
- 白色盘子或浅色餐具
- 草地、树影、自然阳光
- 极简的桌面或野餐布置

背景应柔和虚化，呈现出自然真实的氛围，并带有阳光透过树叶洒下的斑驳光影。

---

## 5. 3x3 九宫格要求

输出为 **3x3 九宫格拼图**，中间由白色边框分隔。

九张照片必须展示**同一个人、同一套服装、同一个主题/场景**，但每张照片必须有明显不同的：

- 面部角度
- 姿势
- 拍摄距离
- 拍摄机位
- 表情
- 手部动作
- 构图方式

### 关键要求

- 不要让九张照片中的脸部朝向同一方向。
- 不要让九张照片的表情几乎相同。
- 不要只有细微的差别。

它看起来应该像是一组在真实拍摄过程中连续抓拍的幕后花絮照。

---

## 6. 九张照片的姿势建议

九张照片可以包含以下不同的状态：

1. 坐在野餐垫旁，双手捧着一串紫葡萄，闭眼微笑。
2. 躺在草地上，头微微倾斜，看着镜头，旁边散落着葡萄。
3. 手拿一颗葡萄靠近嘴边，看着镜头，表情俏皮。
4. 半身侧拍，自然地低头整理藤篮里的葡萄。
5. 正面坐姿，面前摆放着葡萄、玻璃瓶和篮子；表情平静。
6. 特写镜头，手拿葡萄贴在脸颊旁，表情放松微笑。
7. 微微回头，拿着一串葡萄，表情自然抓拍。
8. 闭眼，闻着或凑近葡萄，看起来放松且快乐。
9. 侧卧在草地或树下，抱着藤篮，温柔地注视镜头。

---

## 7. 摄影风格

整体风格为：

- 富士相机质感
- 日系胶片摄影风格
- 柔和自然光
- 轻微胶片颗粒感
- 浅景深
- 真实的拍摄感
- 清新的夏日色调
- 以紫葡萄为视觉焦点
- 干净的画面，富有生活气息和青春感。

---

## 8. 视觉要求

- 高保真人像摄影
- 自然的皮肤纹理
- 无塑料感皮肤
- 无过度磨皮
- 无夸张美颜
- 无过度锐化
- 无卡通感
- 无插画感
- 无 CG 感
- 无廉价影楼摄影感

All nine photos must clearly show the same real girl; she cannot be a stranger, cannot look Western, cannot have a generic "internet celebrity" face, cannot be excessively beautified, and cannot show any signs of AI generation. The overall theme is a fresh and natural everyday girl portrait. (The text also mentions clothing...){argument name="clothing description" default="Cream white or off-white soft dress/slip dress"} and{argument name="accessory" default="Purple retro floral headscarf"} The overall style should be clean, natural, and casual, evoking a summery, girlish vibe. Accessories should be simple, such as small earrings, and not overly ornate. The scene should be an outdoor picnic scene in the shade of a tree or vineyard, depicting people having a summer picnic. Elements such as purple grapes, bunches of grapes, woven baskets, glass bottles, picnic mats, and light-colored tableware should be included to create a natural, lived-in feel. Sunlight should filter through the leaves, creating soft, dappled light and shadow, with a naturally blurred background. The final image should be designed as a 3x3 grid with a white border. All nine small images must feature the same person, the same clothing, and the same scene, but each must be significantly different: different expressions, different facial angles, different poses, different shooting positions, and different compositions (wide shots and close-ups). These nine photos could showcase: smiling while holding grapes, lying on the grass looking at the camera, holding grapes to lips, tidying a basket, sitting facing forward, a close-up of grapes against the cheek, a casual glance back, smelling grapes with eyes closed, and lying on the grass holding a basket. The style should evoke the feel of a Fujifilm camera, Japanese film photography, a realistic shooting style, soft natural light, shallow depth of field, slight film grain, and fresh, natural color tones. Purple grapes should be the visual focal point. The image should be clean, pleasing to the eye, and convey a sense of life and youth. Avoid: Western-looking faces, "internet celebrity" faces, excessive beautification, artificial-looking skin, fake faces, repetitive expressions, repetitive angles, deformed hands, distorted props, cluttered backgrounds, studio-style images, illustration-style images, or CG-like effects.

基于用户上传的 1-3 张清晰个人照片，生成一个主题为“{argument name="photo theme" default="夏日葡萄少女写真系列"}”的 3x3 网格照片拼图。

严格保留主体真实的身份特征，包括脸型、面部比例、眼眉结构、鼻子、嘴唇、肤色、年龄、发型特征以及整体气质。所有九张图中的人物必须清晰地看起来是同一个真实女孩；她不能变成陌生人、不能看起来像西方人、不能像网红脸、不能过度美颜，也不能有 AI 生成的痕迹。

整体主题为清新自然的日常少女写真。人物穿着 {argument name="clothing description" default="奶油白或米白色柔软连衣裙 / 吊带裙"} 和 {argument name="accessory" default="紫色复古碎花头巾"}。整体造型干净、自然、日常，具有夏日少女氛围。配饰简洁，如小耳环，不宜过于华丽。

场景设定为户外草地、树荫下或葡萄园旁的夏日野餐人像。包含紫色葡萄、葡萄串、编织篮、玻璃瓶、野餐垫和浅色餐具等元素，营造自然的生活感。阳光透过叶片洒下，形成柔和的斑驳光影，背景自然虚化。

将最终图像设计为带有白色边框的 3x3 网格。所有九张小图必须是同一个人、同样的服装和同样的场景，但每一张都必须有显著差异：不同的表情、不同的面部角度、不同的姿势、不同的拍摄位置和不同的构图（远景与特写）。不要仅仅是同一个角度的九种细微变化。

避免：西方脸、网红脸、过度美颜、塑料感皮肤、假脸、重复的表情、重复的角度、手部畸形、道具扭曲、杂乱的背景、影棚风格、插画风格或 CG 感。

Strictly preserve the true identity of both individuals. The girl and boy must clearly represent themselves in the uploaded photos, including face shape, facial proportions, eyebrow structure, nose, lips, jawline, skin tone, age, hairline, hairstyle features, and overall demeanor. Do not transform them into Western faces, Korean studio-style photos, "internet celebrity" faces, or overly beautified strangers. All 9 final small photos must be of the same real Chinese couple, captured from different angles, distances, and everyday moments at home. ## Visual Format: Generate a 3x3 collage containing 9 small photos, with an overall ratio of 1:1. Use narrow spacing between photos.{argument name="border color" default="black"} Separator line, and placed{argument name="background color" default="black"} The background should resemble a carefully curated home photo album. Avoid commercial posters or studio layouts; avoid repetitive templates. ## Core Visual Style Overall Style: Japanese lifestyle photography, Fujifilm texture, authentic home couple portraits, candid shots, gentle, relaxed, quiet, and narrative. Focus on the colors and atmosphere of Fujifilm, such as the Superia, Pro 400H, or C200. Images should have low saturation but not too dark, soft natural highlights, translucent and restrained skin tones, slight film grain, slight shadow noise, and soft contrast. It should look like an airy, layered Fujifilm lifestyle photo. Avoid: old iPhone texture, phone compression, digital sharpening, heavy retro filters, commercial or e-commerce style. ## Relationship Between the Two People{argument name="relationship" default="A real, intimate, and natural young Chinese couple"} Every frame should clearly showcase their familiarity and companionship as a couple. Interactions should be genuine and relaxed: leaning, eye contact, smiling with their heads down, resting their heads on each other's shoulders, reading together, passing things, preparing food, tidying clothes, seeing each other in the mirror, or gazing at each other from a doorway. Intimate but restrained—no cloying, no eroticism, and no contrived wedding photo-like performance. ## Expressions and Angles Nine photos should not all show the subject looking directly at the camera or merely a slight smile. Expressions must be varied: giggling, being amused, smiling with their heads down, quiet, daydreaming, gazing tenderly, chatting relaxedly, focusing on a task, turning back in response, laughing with eyes closed, looking out the window, or looking at each other. Facial angles must vary significantly. Do not repeat the same template. Use a combination of angles: front, half-front, side, looking down, looking back, slightly tilted back, close-up of back, mirror angle, distant observation, and close-ups of everyday details. Each frame should have a new head orientation and visual rhythm. ## Clothing Requirements Do not use the original clothing from the uploaded photos. Replace them with natural Japanese lifestyle clothing: low-saturation, neutral colors, and soft materials. Colors such as cream white, oatmeal, light gray, pale coffee, hazy blue, or charcoal gray. Items include knitted cardigans, soft T-shirts, linen shirts, loungewear, long skirts, or socks. It should look like comfortable clothing that a real couple would wear at home. ## Home Environment A clean and tidy apartment with authentic living details (not a show flat). Includes elements such as curtains, wooden floors, sofa, pillows, blankets, books, photo albums, cups, plates, plants, bedside lamps, mirrors, or tables—all supporting details to complement the couple. ## 9 Frames Content 1. Quiet Moment by the Window: The boy looks out the window; the girl leans back naturally. The atmosphere is quiet. 2. Reading on the Sofa: Reading together; one person leans on the other's shoulder. 3. Passing Plates: Passing fruit at the dining table; there are dynamic movements and eye contact. 4. Kitchen Preparation: Preparing food; one person cuts fruit while the other watches and laughs. 5. Doorway View: A view of the living room through the door frame. 6. Bedroom Touch: Sitting on the bed; a girl gently straightening a boy's collar. 7. Floor Photo: Sitting on the carpet together reading a magazine; natural sitting posture. 8. Mirror Image: Captured through a full-length mirror; adjusting hair or briefly looking at each other in the mirror. 9. Balcony Pause: Standing by a sliding door; one person looking outside while the other smiles and approaches. ## Consistency and Stability: Maintain facial consistency across 9 frames. Avoid complex hand gestures (do not touch the face or cross fingers). Quality should include slight film grain and scan texture to feel like a set of realistic photographs, not a perfect AI mesh. Avoid digital artifacts, superfluous limbs, or strange text.

promptLocalized.zh:
基于用户上传的两名成年情侣的真实照片，生成一张“{argument name="photo style" default="富士胶片风格日本居家情侣肖像"} 3x3 网格相册拼贴”。

严格保留两人的真实身份特征。女孩和男孩必须清晰地呈现出上传照片中的本人，包括脸型、面部比例、眼眉结构、鼻子、嘴唇、下颌线、肤色、年龄、发际线、发型特征以及整体气质。不要将他们变成西式面孔、韩式影楼风格、网红脸或过度美化的陌生人。所有 9 张最终的小照片必须是同一对真实的中国情侣，从不同的角度、距离和居家生活瞬间捕捉。

## 视觉格式
生成一张 3x3 的拼贴图，包含 9 张小照片，整体比例为 1:1。照片之间使用窄的 {argument name="border color" default="黑色"} 分隔线，并放置在 {argument name="background color" default="黑色"} 背景上，如同精心整理的居家相册。不要使用商业海报或影楼布局；避免重复的模板。

## 核心视觉风格
整体风格：日本生活方式摄影、富士胶片质感、真实的居家情侣肖像、抓拍、温柔、放松、安静且具有叙事感。
聚焦于 Superia、Pro 400H 或 C200 等富士胶片的色彩和氛围。图像应具有低饱和度但不过于灰暗、柔和的自然高光、通透而内敛的肤色、轻微的胶片颗粒感、轻微的阴影噪点以及柔和的对比度。它应该看起来像一张充满空气感、层次丰富的富士胶片生活照。
避免：老旧的 iPhone 质感、手机压缩感、数码锐化、厚重的复古滤镜、商业广告或电商风格。

## 人物关系
两人是 {argument name="relationship" default="一对真实、亲密且自然年轻的中国情侣"}。每一帧都应清晰地展示他们作为情侣的熟悉感和陪伴感。互动应真实且放松：倚靠、眼神交流、低头笑、靠在肩膀上、一起阅读、递东西、准备食物、整理衣物、在镜子中看到对方或在门口注视。亲密但克制——没有油腻感、没有色情意味，也没有刻意的婚纱照式表演。

## 表情与角度
9 张照片不应全部看向镜头或仅仅是微微一笑。表情必须丰富多样：咯咯笑、被逗乐、低头笑、安静、发呆、温柔注视、放松聊天、专注于某项任务、回头回应、闭眼大笑、看向窗外或看向对方。
面部角度必须有显著变化。不要重复相同的模板。使用多种角度组合：正面、半正面、侧面、低头、回头、微仰、近背影、镜面角度、远距离观察和生活细节特写。每一帧都应有新的头部朝向和视觉节奏。

## 服装要求
不要使用上传照片中的原装衣服。将它们更换为自然的日本生活方式服装：低饱和度、中性色、柔软材质。颜色如奶油白、燕麦色、浅灰色、淡咖啡色、雾霾蓝或炭灰色。单品包括针织开衫、柔软 T 恤、亚麻衬衫、家居服、长裙或袜子。看起来应该是真实情侣在家中穿着的舒适服装。

## 居家环境
一个干净整洁、带有真实生活痕迹的公寓（不是样板间）。包含窗帘、木地板、沙发、枕头、毯子、书籍、相册、杯子、盘子、植物、床头灯、镜子或桌子等元素——所有这些都是为了衬托情侣的辅助细节。

## 9 帧内容
1. 窗边安静时刻：男孩看向窗外；女孩自然地倚靠。氛围安静。
2. 沙发阅读：一起看书；一人靠在另一人的肩膀上。
3. 递盘子：在餐桌旁递水果；有动态的动作和眼神交流。
4. 厨房准备：准备食物；一人切水果，另一人看着并大笑。
5. 门口视角：通过门框观察客厅的视角。
6. 卧室触碰：坐在床上；女孩温柔地整理男孩的衣领。
7. 地板照片：坐在地毯上一起看杂志；自然的坐姿。
8. 镜中碎片：通过穿衣镜捕捉；整理头发或在镜中短暂对视。
9. 阳台停顿：站在推拉门旁；一人看向外面，另一人微笑着走近。

## 一致性与稳定性
保持 9 帧中面部的一致性。避免复杂的手部动作（不要触碰脸部或手指交叉）。质量应包含轻微的胶片颗粒和扫描质感，以感觉像是一套真实的照片，而不是完美的 AI 网格。避免数码伪影、多余的肢体或奇怪的文字。

templates.prompt: nation:{argument name="country" default="[Please enter the country name]"} A miniature felt landscape made from fluffy yarn, wool, and knitting techniques, designed as a unified and harmonious little world (not a collage) that reflects the country’s authentic landscape, culture, and daily life. Structure: - Select 4–7 naturally integrated elements (landscape, architecture, transportation, street life, culture) - All elements must flow naturally as a whole. Foreground: Everyday life—small shops, cafes, markets, interacting crowds, local clothing, street details, subtle dynamics, full of warm human touch. Midground: Connecting flow lines—streets, bridges, rivers, paths, transportation, cultural spaces, guiding the eye naturally from front to back. Background: A strong identity anchor—landmarks, skylines, mountains, or symbolic landscapes that clearly represent the country (keep it simple, avoid crowding). Style: Hand-felt wool, yarn, needle felt textures, visible fibers, soft edges, miniature craftsmanship, high-end miniatures. Realistic lighting: Warm golden hour or bright afternoon, soft shadows, clear visibility, soft sheen enhancing depth. Color: Soft but saturated hues reflecting the country's natural colors (green, sky blue, architectural colors, cultural accents), warm and balanced composition. Vertical composition, balanced or centered perspective, slight overhead or immersive angles, clear foreground, midground, and background depth atmosphere: Warm, sensual, tranquil, and exquisite—like a handcrafted fairytale version of real life (not childish). Rules: - No logos or text overlays - No collage-style composition - No cluttered random symbols - Maintain realism, but present the style and quality of a handcrafted miniature world: 16K, ultra-fine, hyper-realistic miniature textures, cinematic depth, clear focus output target: A single, harmonious felt miniature world that instantly conveys the identity and atmosphere of the selected country by integrating landscape, culture, and daily life.

promptLocalized.zh:
国家：{argument name="country" default="[请输入国家名称]"}

一个由蓬松纱线、羊毛和针织工艺制成的微缩毛毡景观，设计为一个统一且和谐的小世界（非拼贴画），反映该国真实的景观、文化和日常生活。

结构：
- 选择 4–7 个自然融合的元素（景观、建筑、交通、街头生活、文化）
- 所有元素必须作为一个整体环境自然流动

前景：
日常生活——小店、咖啡馆、集市、互动的人群、当地服饰、街道细节、细微的动态，充满温暖的人文气息

中景：
连接流线——街道、桥梁、河流、路径、交通工具、文化空间，引导视线从前到后自然过渡

背景：
一个强有力的身份锚点——地标、天际线、山脉或象征性景观，清晰地代表该国（保持简洁，避免拥挤）

风格：
手工羊毛毡、纱线、针毡纹理、可见的纤维感、柔和的边缘、微缩工艺、高级微缩模型写实感

光影：
温暖的黄金时刻或明亮的午后，柔和的阴影，清晰的可见度，柔和的光泽增强深度感

色彩：
柔和但饱和的色调，反映该国的自然色调（绿色、天蓝色、建筑色、文化点缀），温暖且平衡

构图：
竖构图，平衡或居中的视角，轻微的俯视或沉浸式角度，清晰的前景、中景、背景深度

氛围：
温暖、感性、宁静、精致——如同现实生活的纯手工童话版本（非低幼感）

规则：
- 无徽标或文字叠加
- 禁止拼贴式构图
- 禁止杂乱的随机符号
- 保持写实感，但呈现为手工微缩世界的风格

质量：
16K，超精细，超写实微缩纹理，电影级深度，清晰对焦

输出目标：
一个单一、和谐的毛毡微缩世界，通过整合景观、文化和日常生活，瞬间传达出所选国家的身份与氛围

The large window on the right dominates, acting as both glass and a portal: it reflects the subject and the bus interior while simultaneously showcasing the surreal city streets outside. Through the glass, a damp, reflective tree-lined avenue is displayed, flanked by elegant old buildings, with pedestrians moving slowly, one holding a red umbrella, and a car with its headlights on. The ordinary street gradually transforms into a dreamlike scene, with nine colorful kites floating in the sky against a pinkish-blue sunset backdrop, soft luminous particles suspended in the air, creating an exaggeratedly warm, cinematic feel. The window displays a layered effect of the bus interior's realistic reflection and the surreal world outside.{argument name="time of day" default="Golden hour sunset"} The lighting effects blend natural sunlight on the face with dreamy warm highlights, complemented by delicate film grain, realistic lens reflections, and subtle motion blur, creating an atmosphere full of imagination, a sense of escape, and tranquil happiness.

templates.title: Alice-style leaf boat fantasy scene

titleLocalized.zh: 爱丽丝风格的叶舟奇幻场景

templates.prompt: Create a whimsical, high-quality fantasy portrait, featuring a subject with a style similar to {argument name="character theme" default="Alice in Wonderland"} A young girl, she was leaning against a huge green leaf boat, drifting on a narrow, winding blue stream. She kept {argument name="hair color" default="Golden hair"} A girl with wavy hair, wearing a blue bow headband, a blue puff-sleeved dress, a white apron over a white ruffled skirt, and pink shoes with asymmetrical knee-high striped socks: one blue and white striped, the other pink and white striped. The leaf boat is shaped like a curled natural leaf, with a raised stem at the back, clearly defined veins, and a sharp bow. The interior is lined with soft cushions in pale blue, pink, and yellow. The girl is relaxed, her arms resting on either side of the boat, her legs outstretched, drifting diagonally from the lower left to the upper right of the scene. The stream is surrounded by lush, bright green moss-covered banks, rounded hedges, enormous fairytale trees, and oversized, colorful flowers in pink, purple, blue, yellow, and orange. The water should be a deep turquoise, with tiny ripples, bubbles, and shimmering light around the leaf boat. Adopting a dreamy fairytale garden atmosphere, the colors are vibrant and saturated, with shallow depth of field, soft background blur, cinematic composition, and realistic 3D fairytale illustration style. The texture details of leaves, fabrics, water surfaces and flowers are rich, and the vertical portrait composition creates a magical and tranquil artistic conception.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张异想天开的高品质奇幻肖像，画面主角是一位风格类似于 {argument name="character theme" default="爱丽丝梦游仙境"} 的年轻女孩，她正斜倚在一艘巨大的绿色叶舟中，在一条狭窄且蜿蜒的蓝色溪流上漂流。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="金色长发"} 波浪卷，戴着蓝色蝴蝶结发带，身穿蓝色泡泡袖连衣裙，外搭白色围裙，内衬白色荷叶边裙摆，脚穿粉色鞋子，并穿着不对称的过膝条纹袜：一只为蓝白条纹，另一只为粉白条纹。叶舟呈卷曲的天然叶片状，后部有隆起的叶柄，叶脉清晰，船头尖锐，内部铺有淡蓝色、粉色和黄色的柔和色调靠垫。女孩姿态放松，双臂搭在叶舟两侧，双腿向尖端伸展，沿画面从左下角向右上角对角线漂流。溪流周围环绕着郁郁葱葱的亮绿色苔藓河岸、圆润的树篱、巨大的童话树木，以及粉色、紫色、蓝色、黄色和橙色的超大号彩色花朵。水面应呈现浓郁的青蓝色，叶舟周围伴有细小的涟漪、泡沫和闪烁的波光。采用梦幻般的童话花园氛围，色彩鲜艳饱和，浅景深，柔和的背景虚化，电影级构图，逼真的 3D 童话插画风格，叶片、织物、水面和花朵的纹理细节丰富，采用竖屏肖像构图，营造出神奇而宁静的意境。

templates.title: Elven adventurers with veils in a medieval village

titleLocalized.zh: 中世纪村庄中被遮挡面部的精灵冒险者

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic, dark fantasy medieval street scene, employing a hyper-realistic 3D game concept art style, in a 16:9 widescreen aspect ratio. The foreground shows two adult elven adventurers walking side-by-side along a muddy cobblestone village path, approaching the viewer. The character on the left is a pale-skinned elven woman with long, disheveled hair.{argument name="left character hair color" default="Gray Gold"} The first character has braided hair, pointed ears, and wears layered olive-green druidic robes, adorned with belts, pouches, hanging metal ornaments, necklaces, tattered strips of cloth, and details of leaves and feathers. Her arms are covered in glowing white vine-like magical tattoos. The character on the right is a darker-skinned elven woman with thick, bushy hair.{argument name="right character hair color" default="dark brown"} With dreadlocks, pointed ears, and dressed in a green-brown leather ranger outfit, draped in fur shoulder armor, and adorned with feather decorations, armbands, a belt, chains, and amulets, their posture exuded the confidence of warriors. Both their faces were deliberately painted with a solid, opaque background.{argument name="face covering color" default="dark brown"} A square obscuring block covers the face, positioned in the center. The background is set in a richly detailed fantasy medieval market village, featuring wooden thatched huts, bundles of hay hanging in the shop on the right, barrels, baskets, wooden stalls, villagers in the distance, and a towering stone castle with towers and battlements in the background.{argument name="lighting mood" default="warm afternoon golden sunlight"} It creates dramatic shadows, volumetric fog, shallow depth of field, realistic fabric and leather textures, high detail, a fantastical atmosphere, cinematic composition, Unreal Engine rendering quality, and no text or logo.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅电影级暗黑奇幻风格的中世纪街道场景，采用超写实 3D 游戏概念艺术风格，宽屏 16:9。前景展示两名成年精灵冒险者并肩走在泥泞的鹅卵石村道上，正朝观众走来。左侧角色是一位皮肤苍白的精灵女性，留着长而凌乱的 {argument name="left character hair color" default="灰金色"} 编发，长着尖耳朵，身穿层叠的橄榄绿德鲁伊长袍，佩戴皮带、小袋、悬挂的金属饰物、项链、破损的布条、叶片与羽毛细节，双臂上有发光的白色藤蔓状魔法纹身。右侧角色是一位肤色较深的精灵女性，留着浓密厚实的 {argument name="right character hair color" default="深褐色"} 脏辫，长着尖耳朵，身穿绿棕色皮革游侠装，披着毛皮肩甲，佩戴羽毛装饰、臂带、腰带、链条、护身符，姿态自信如战士。两人的面部均被故意用纯色不透明的 {argument name="face covering color" default="深褐色"} 方形遮挡块覆盖，位于脸部中心。背景设定在一个细节丰富的奇幻中世纪集市村庄，有木质茅草屋、右侧店面挂着的干草束、木桶、篮子、木质摊位、远处的村民，以及背景中耸立的高大石砌城堡，带有塔楼和城垛。使用 {argument name="lighting mood" default="温暖的午后金色阳光"}，营造戏剧性的阴影、体积雾、浅景深、逼真的布料与皮革质感，高细节，充满奇幻氛围，电影级构图，Unreal Engine 渲染品质，无文字，无 Logo。

templates.title: Knight and Mage vs. Gargoyle

titleLocalized.zh: 骑士法师大战石像鬼

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic dark fantasy action scene in the ruined cathedral hall: a{argument name="hero type" default="Female knight mage clad in armor"} Crouching and in a defensive charging stance in the left foreground, she wears ornate dark steel and leather plate armor, overlaid with a long, two-tone beige and black battle robe; one arm is outstretched behind her, gripping a spiked mace or flail that flashes with golden magical sparks, while the other arm supports a circular, glowing shield with warm light emanating from its edges. In the right midground, facing her is a massive {argument name="enemy type" default="Headless Gargoyle"} Composed of cracked gray stone slabs, bound by broken chains, it charges forward with its massive fist raised, scattering rubble from its body. The battle scene is set inside a magnificent yet damaged palatial cathedral, featuring soaring arches, carved columns, tall, broken windows, and gilded marble floors with circular geometric patterns, littered with stones, dust, and rubble. Utilizing dramatic backlighting from bright arched windows behind the gargoyle, shields and weapons are highlighted with warm, golden magic, deep shadows, volumetric light dust beams, realistic textures, highly detailed armor and stone, dynamic low-angle wide-angle compositions, shallow depth of field, and a cinematic feel, this epic game boasts a cinematic style, presented in a 16:9 widescreen aspect ratio, with no text or UI.

promptLocalized.zh: 在废墟大教堂大厅中创作一个电影级的黑暗奇幻动作场景：一位 {argument name="hero type" default="身披铠甲的女骑士法师"} 在左侧前景中蹲伏并做出防御性冲刺姿态，身穿华丽的深色钢制与皮革板甲，外罩一件长款米黑双色战袍；一只手臂向后伸展，紧握着一把闪烁着金色魔法火花的带刺钉头锤或流星锤，另一只手臂向前支撑着一面边缘散发着暖光的圆形发光盾牌。在右侧中景处，与她对峙的是一个巨大的 {argument name="enemy type" default="无头石像鬼"}，由开裂的灰色砖石板构成，身上缠绕着断裂的锁链，正举起巨大的拳头冲锋，身上不断掉落碎石。战斗场景设定在一个宏伟且受损的宫殿式大教堂内部，拥有高耸的拱门、雕刻的石柱、高大的破损窗户，以及带有圆形几何图案的镶金大理石地面，地面散落着石块、灰尘和瓦砾。使用来自石像鬼身后明亮拱窗的戏剧性逆光，盾牌和武器上带有温暖的金色魔法高光，深邃的阴影，体积光尘束，逼真的纹理，高细节的盔甲和石材，动态的低角度广角构图，浅景深电影感，史诗级游戏电影写实风格，16:9 宽屏，无文字，无 UI。

templates.title: Cinematic-quality spinning latte splash effect

titleLocalized.zh: 电影级旋转拿铁飞溅效果

templates.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic, cinematic coffee advertisement image. At the center of the image is a slightly tilted, transparent stemmed glass suspended in mid-air, containing…{argument name="drink type" default="Cream Latte"} It seemed to be slowly rotating. The glass displayed distinct layers of caramel coffee color, topped with a thick layer of white milk foam, and sprinkled with {argument name="topping" default="cocoa powder"} Warm steam rises from the milk foam, forming soft, curling smoke. Two large, sculptural bands of milk splatter surround the glass, one sweeping upwards along the left and the other curling downwards to the right, accompanied by numerous suspended coffee drips, milk drips, and coffee beans frozen in slow motion. A vertical clump of fine cocoa dust is added to the right side of the image, giving it a luminous effect. The background features a warm, dark café setting, with gold-blurred lighting, blurred shelves and bottles, creating warm amber highlights. The use of shallow depth of field, dramatic rim lighting, and glossy reflections on the glass evokes a high-speed macro photography feel, reminiscent of a high-end beverage advertisement. The focus is clearly on the latte and the splatter, with rich contrast and a vertical composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超写实电影级咖啡广告图像，画面中心为一杯悬浮在半空中、略微倾斜的透明高脚杯，杯中盛放着 {argument name="drink type" default="奶油拿铁"}，仿佛正在缓慢旋转。玻璃杯呈现出层次分明的焦糖咖啡色泽，顶部覆盖着厚实的白色奶泡，并撒有 {argument name="topping" default="可可粉"}。温暖的蒸汽从奶泡中升起，形成柔和的卷曲烟雾。在玻璃杯周围环绕 2 条大型雕塑感牛奶飞溅带，一条沿左侧向上扫过，另一条在右下方卷曲，同时配以大量悬浮的咖啡滴、牛奶滴和在慢动作中定格的咖啡豆。在画面右侧添加一团垂直的细微可可粉尘，并使其呈现发光效果。背景采用温馨的深色咖啡馆环境，配以金色虚化灯光、模糊的货架和瓶子，营造温暖的琥珀色高光，使用浅景深、戏剧性的轮廓光、玻璃杯上的光泽反射，呈现高速微距摄影质感，具备高端饮料广告风格，焦点清晰地聚焦在拿铁和飞溅物上，对比度丰富，采用竖构图。

A direct translation wouldn't be meaningful without further context or clarification. It includes phrases like "a large black crescent moon surrounding a blue and cream crescent moon, with a small orange-red dot emitting three black radio wave arcs, and a pink dotted semicircle," "media banner icon, a cream-colored play triangle on the left, a slanted checkerboard rectangle of alternating orange-red and black squares on the right, surrounded by a black track with small black dots," and "palette_strip: {"position":"bottom", "swatch_count":7,"swatches":[{"index":1,"color":"deep navy blue"},{"index":2,"color":"neutral soft blue"},{"index":3,"color":"near black"},{"index":4,"color":"warm cream"},{"index":5,"color":""{argument name="accent orange" default="Bright orange-red"} {"index":6,"color":"}{argument name="accent blue" default="Electric Blue"} {"index":7,"color":"}{argument name="accent pink" default="grayish pale purple"} "}]},"visual_details":"Use clean vector edges with a slight paper-like texture and soft imperfections; keep shapes simple and symbolic, with black guide lines interspersed around objects; pink dashed paths should be evenly spaced small dots; maintain a sophisticated design system atmosphere suitable for deliverable Web UI illustrations,"rendering":"High-resolution flat vector stock sheet, centered layout, consistent icon proportions, no labels, no typography"}

templates.title: Retro Anime Space Adventure Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 复古动漫太空冒险海报

templates.prompt: Create a deep-space sci-fi adventure poster in the style of 1990s retro anime. The background features a shimmering blue nebula, with a massive Earth-like planet in the upper left corner. Silhouettes of large, bluish-green alien creatures or spaceships are faintly visible in the background, and a futuristic city with antenna towers and domes is visible on the bottom horizon. In the foreground, two adventurous children stand on a red rocky cliff: the girl is dressed in…{argument name="girl outfit" default="A red cropped T-shirt, black trousers, and pink sneakers, with dark wavy pigtails."} He was holding a yellow banana-shaped ray gun; the boy was wearing {argument name="boy outfit" default="White shirt, brown shorts, white socks, paired with oversized white sneakers"} A hand is raised towards a glowing orange light source. Two adorable mascot companions are added to the right; there must be two: one is a brown bear-like mascot wearing a red shirt and blue scarf, and the other is a smaller, grayish-brown animal mascot. The sky is filled with 24 small, triangular, cheese-shaped rocket ships, including three larger cheese rockets on the left with blue winglets and orange thruster flames, and the remaining 21 smaller cheese rockets extending into the distance. The use of dramatic hand-drawn cel animation colors, high contrast, crisp ink lines, and cosmic blue and orange highlights creates a retro VHS-era adventure composition and movie poster feel. A large, centered vertical rectangular mask is placed in front of the background, partially obscuring the huge blue outline and the boy; the mask reveals {argument name="overlay left color" default="Cyan"} arrive{argument name="overlay right color" default="dark gray-purple"} The smooth, soft gradient, with no text on the rectangle.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 1990 年代怀旧动漫风格的深空科幻冒险海报。背景为星光璀璨的蓝色星云，左上方设有一颗巨大的类地行星，背景中隐现着巨大的青蓝色外星生物或飞船剪影，底部地平线处为带有天线塔和圆顶的未来城市。前景中，两名充满冒险精神的孩童站在红色的岩石悬崖上：女孩穿着 {argument name="girl outfit" default="红色短款 T 恤、黑色长裤、粉色运动鞋，留着深色波浪双马尾"}，手持一把黄色香蕉形状的射线枪；男孩穿着 {argument name="boy outfit" default="白色衬衫、棕色短裤、白色袜子，搭配超大号白色运动鞋"}，一只手向着发光的橙色光源举起。在右侧添加两个可爱的吉祥物伙伴，数量必须为 2 个：一个是穿着红衬衫、系着蓝围巾的棕褐色熊状吉祥物，另一个是较小的灰褐色动物吉祥物。天空中布满 24 艘小型三角形奶酪形状的火箭飞船，其中左侧有 3 艘较大的奶酪火箭，带有蓝色侧翼和橙色推进器火焰，其余 21 艘较小的奶酪火箭向远处延伸。采用戏剧性的手绘赛璐珞动画色彩、高对比度、清晰的墨线勾勒、宇宙蓝与橙色高光，呈现复古 VHS 时代的冒险构图和电影海报质感。在背景前方放置一个居中的大型垂直矩形遮罩，部分遮盖住巨大的蓝色轮廓和男孩，遮罩呈现从 {argument name="overlay left color" default="青蓝色"} 到 {argument name="overlay right color" default="深灰紫色"} 的平滑柔和渐变，矩形上不含任何文字。
