promptLocalized.zh: {"type":"2D Q 版角色动画精灵图集","subject":{"character name":"{argument name=\"character name\" default=\"Sammy\"}","style":"可爱的游戏吉祥物，小巧的 Q 版比例，粗而柔和的轮廓，轻微的赛璐珞阴影，干净的贴纸式渲染","face":"大部分为无特征的平滑米色方形脸，带有细微的渐变，在右中位置附近的一个小精灵上显示一个微小的表情","hair":"{argument name=\"hair style\" default=\"深棕色短卷发\"}","skin":"浅暖米色","outfit":{"top":"{argument name=\"hoodie color\" default=\"青色连帽衫，配深蓝色袖子和小型前袋\"}","bottom":"深海军蓝长裤或短裤（取决于姿势）","shoes":"奶油色运动鞋，配深色鞋底"}},"canvas":{"background":"纯白色","composition":"大型精灵图集，包含许多排列在松散行中的独立姿势，无网格线，无标签，留有大量空白","view":"主要是正面和四分之三侧面视图，小巧的全身精灵","total sprites":57},"layout":{"row count":9,"rows":[{"row":1,"count":6,"descriptions":["正面待机站立","正面待机站立重复","正面待机站立重复","正面待机站立重复","正面待机站立重复","正面待机站立重复"]},{"row":2,"count":8,"descriptions":["从左到右奔跑跨步 1","从左到右奔跑跨步 2","从左到右奔跑跨步 3","从左到右奔跑跨步 4","从左到右奔跑跨步 5","从左到右奔跑跨步 6","从左到右奔跑跨步 7","从左到右奔跑跨步 8"]},{"row":3,"count":8,"descriptions":["奔跑循环交替跨步 1","奔跑循环交替跨步 2","奔跑循环交替跨步 3","奔跑循环交替跨步 4","奔跑循环交替跨步 5","奔跑循环交替跨步 6","奔跑循环交替跨步 7","奔跑循环交替跨步 8"]},{"row":4,"count":4,"descriptions":["右手握拳站立","双臂举起站立","单手挥手站立","小型庆祝姿势站立"]},{"row":5,"count":5,"descriptions":["低姿蹲伏","单臂向上跳跃","向后翻滚或跌倒","空中蜷缩或滚动","小型正面待机站立"]},{"row":6,"count":8,"descriptions":["行走或慢跑姿势","正面直立","盘腿坐姿","手膝着地爬行","带有可见眉毛和闭嘴微笑的微小正面角色","跪姿或侧坐姿","高挑中性正面姿势","双臂放松正面站立"]},{"row":7,"count":6,"descriptions":["宽幅自信站姿","双手垂下的正面待机","正面放松待机","正面待机微调","正面待机微调","正面待机微调"]},{"row":8,"count":6,"descriptions":["单膝抬起的行走跨步","行走跨步交替","双臂向前的奔跑姿势","行走跨步交替","行走跨步交替","行走跨步交替"]},{"row":9,"count":6,"descriptions":["正面待机站立","侧步或蹲伏动作","正面待机站立","胸前持有或拥抱小物体站立","持有小物体站立交替","正面待机站立"]}]},"rendering instructions":"为名为 {argument name=\"character name\" default=\"Sammy\"} 的游戏角色创建一个精致的精灵图集概念图。使用白色背景，将 57 个小型 Q 版精灵按 9 行松散排列，数量分别为 6、8、8、4、5、8、6、6 和 6。保持所有精灵设计一致：深色卷发、青色连帽衫配蓝色袖子、海军蓝下装、奶油色鞋子、超大米色无特征脸部、圆润身体、柔和阴影和干净的卡通线条。包含奔跑、行走、待机、挥手、欢呼、跳跃、蹲伏、翻滚、坐姿、爬行、跪姿和持有物体的姿势，其中一个微小的中心精灵显示一个简单可爱的微笑表情。无文字、无标签、无网格、无背景场景。"}

templates.title: Squeeze and stretch jump action table

titleLocalized.zh: 挤压与拉伸跳跃动作表

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the character base, create a clear animation motion sheet, transforming the character into a full-body jump sequence study while retaining the same clothing, badges, bald head, shoes, stylized ink-painting look, and facial occlusion/blurring. Expand the view from a cropped portrait to a wide layout with a beige paper texture featuring ground lines, subtle motion lines, small impact markers, and instructional typography. Add title text in the top left corner.{argument name="title text" default="SQUASH AND STRETCH"} and subtitle{argument name="subtitle text" default="JUMP SEQUENCE — 7 STAGES"} The seven numbered poses, arranged from left to right, are as follows: 1. "ANTICIPATION (CROUCHING)" (Preparatory Action: Crouch), the character crouches with arms swinging back; 2. "EXTREME SQUASH (COMPRESSED)" (Extreme Squeeze: Compression), the character crouches even more tightly; 3. "EXTREME STRETCH (TAKEOFF)" (Extreme Stretch: Takeoff), the character stretches upward, arms raised, feet off the ground; 4. "APEX (MID-AIR ARC)" (Ascendance: Air Arc), the character contracts in mid-air; 5. "STRETCH (DOWNWARD ACCELERATION)" (Stretch: Downward Acceleration), the character stretches vertically as they descend; 6. "SQUASH (IMPACT LANDING)" (Squeeze: Landing Impact), the character compresses upon landing, touching the ground with one hand; 7. "RECOVERY (RETURN TO STANCE)" (Recovery: Return to Standing), the character stands relaxed with hands in pockets. Use bold black capital letters to label each numbered stage, maintaining consistent character proportions across poses except for deliberate compression and stretching, and giving the table the appearance of a professional 2D animation reference chart.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 为角色基础，制作一张清晰的动画动作表，将角色转化为全身跳跃序列研究，同时保留相同的服装、徽章、光头、鞋子、风格化水墨插画外观以及面部遮挡/模糊处理。将视图从裁剪后的肖像扩展为带有地面线、细微运动线、小型冲击标记和教学排版的米色纸张纹理宽幅布局。在左上角添加标题文本 {argument name="title text" default="SQUASH AND STRETCH"} 和副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="JUMP SEQUENCE — 7 STAGES"}。展示从左至右排列的 7 个编号姿势：1 “ANTICIPATION (CROUCHING)”（预备动作：蹲伏），角色蹲伏且双臂后摆；2 “EXTREME SQUASH (COMPRESSED)”（极限挤压：压缩），角色更深地紧凑蹲伏；3 “EXTREME STRETCH (TAKEOFF)”（极限拉伸：起跳），角色向上拉伸，双臂抬起，双脚离地；4 “APEX (MID-AIR ARC)”（顶点：空中弧线），角色在半空中收缩；5 “STRETCH (DOWNWARD ACCELERATION)”（拉伸：向下加速），角色在下降时垂直拉伸；6 “SQUASH (IMPACT LANDING)”（挤压：着陆冲击），角色着陆时压缩，单手触地；7 “RECOVERY (RETURN TO STANCE)”（恢复：回到站姿），角色双手插兜，放松站立。在每个编号阶段下方使用粗体黑色大写标签，除刻意的挤压与拉伸变形外，保持各姿势中角色比例的一致性，并使该表呈现出专业 2D 动画参考图表的效果。

In the upper right corner, a massive cream-colored archway soars above the city, shimmering in the morning light; an orange sun lies within the archway, leading to it via a long white staircase. Add a tiny, solitary figure on a terrace in the middle tier for scale reference. Add delicate details: a small waterfall cascading down a deep blue interior wall, glowing windows, a small golden spire, a bare pink flowering tree on a balcony, a crescent moon in the hazy sky, and two tiny white birds. Leave negative space on the left side for layout when composing the image. Add 6 visible text blocks: the small serif "VOL. 02" in the upper left corner above "2026"; and a large, vertically formatted dark blue-gray Chinese title.{argument name="headline text" default="The darkness before dawn"} Below it is a brief Chinese quote.{argument name="Chinese quote" default="It's not punishment; it's the universe preparing for an even more magnificent sunrise."} A short, handwritten English introduction{argument name="English quote" default="Before dawn, a greater sunrise is being prepared."} The small text "2026 DAWN" in the lower left corner, paired with a vertically formatted Chinese phrase.{argument name="vertical phrase" default="Walk towards the light"} The text also includes the small text "VOL.02" in the lower right corner. The design employs a sophisticated editing and layout style, elegant letter spacing, delicate paper texture, atmospheric mist, soft halo, and cinematic morning light to create a tranquil and meditative atmosphere. It is ultra-detailed yet minimalist, borderless, and features a non-realistic photographic style.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖构图的治愈系励志艺术壁纸，风格灵感源自《纪念碑谷》，呈现柔和的奇幻建筑，比例 9:16。画面是一座由堆叠的几何塔楼、拱门、桥梁、阶梯、露台、运河及小型圆顶凉亭组成的“不可能”城市，悬浮在薄雾中，以精致的等轴测视角呈现，线条简洁极简。使用温暖的晨曦色调，包含桃色、奶油色、浅沙色、薄荷绿、绿松石色、薰衣草紫以及深靛蓝色的阴影。在右上角，一座巨大的奶油色拱门高耸于城市之上，在晨光中熠熠生辉；橙色的太阳位于拱门内，一条长长的白色阶梯通向它。在中间层级的露台上加入一个微小的孤独人物作为比例参照。添加细腻的细节：沿深蓝色内墙流下的细小瀑布、发光的窗户、小巧的金色尖顶、阳台上的一棵光秃粉色花树、朦胧天空中的一弯新月以及两只微小的白鸟。构图时在左侧留出负空间以便排版。添加 6 处可见文本块：左上角小号衬线体“VOL. 02”位于“2026”上方；深蓝灰色的竖排大号中文标题 {argument name="headline text" default="黎明前的黑暗"}；其下方是一句简短的中文引言 {argument name="Chinese quote" default="不是惩罚，是宇宙在准备更壮丽的日出。"}；一句小型手写体英文引言 {argument name="English quote" default="Before dawn, a greater sunrise is being prepared."}；左下角小号文本“2026 DAWN”搭配竖排中文短语 {argument name="vertical phrase" default="向光而行"}；以及右下角小号文本“VOL.02”。使用精致的编辑排版风格，优雅的字间距，带有细腻的纸张纹理、大气雾气、柔和光晕、电影感晨光，营造宁静冥想的氛围，超细节且极简，无边框，非写实摄影风格。

templates.title: Gentle Abyss Quotes Wallpaper

titleLocalized.zh: 柔和深渊语录壁纸

templates.prompt: Create a vertical, inspirational art wallpaper with a tranquil, Monument Valley-style isometric composition, using soft, soothing macaron colors and ample negative space. The scene is an illusory architectural city composed of pale peach, lavender, cream, and powder blue stone: towering, narrow towers, arches, bridges, staircases, walls, and floating platforms arranged around a central, deep vertical abyss. The image includes only a tiny, solitary figure standing on the upper bridge, wearing a purple cloak or long dress and a white headdress, gazing into the abyss. Add a prominent building facade in the center right, featuring a glowing circular entrance, like a warm, orange-pink solar eclipse, casting light into the deep shaft. Add a small, bare decorative tree in a square flowerpot on each of the lower left and right platforms. The architecture should include multiple surreal staircases, including a long diagonal staircase in the lower left center and stairs leading to the upper right tower; the tallest tower has a turquoise dome and a small spire. A pale sun disk in the upper left creates an atmospheric haze, soft glow, delicate shadows, and minimalist lines. A large, vertically arranged Chinese quote is placed in the upper left corner, rendered with delicate, elegant gray brushstrokes.{argument name="quote text" default="When you gaze into the abyss, the abyss also gazes into you."} Below it, add a line of light gray English translation:{argument name="English translation" default="When you gaze into the abyss, the abyss gazes into you."} Add small edits to the poster details: text in the top left corner.{argument name="volume label" default="VOL.01"} Below is a tiny horizontal line, and the text in the upper right corner {argument name="year" default="2026"} Below are four vertically arranged small dots, on the left is a block containing the keywords "depth" and "gaze", a minimalist circular logo is placed in the lower left corner with "LOOK DEEP" and "BE SEEN" above it, and three horizontally arranged small dots are placed in the lower right corner. The overall composition maintains an ethereal, refined, profound, and sophisticated feel, with the quote occupying one-third of the left side, and a surreal city rising in the center and on the right.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖版励志艺术壁纸，风格为宁静的《纪念碑谷》式等轴测构图，采用柔和治愈的马卡龙色调，并留出大量朦胧的负空间。场景是一座由淡桃色、薰衣草紫、奶油色和粉蓝色石材构成的错觉建筑城市：高耸狭窄的塔楼、拱门、桥梁、阶梯、护墙和浮动平台围绕着中心深邃的垂直深渊排列。画面中仅包含一个站在上方桥梁上的微小孤独人影，身穿紫色斗篷或长裙，头戴白饰，正凝视着深渊。在右中位置添加一个显眼的建筑立面，设有一个发光的圆形入口，宛如温暖的橙粉色日食，将光线投射进深邃的竖井中。在左下平台和右侧平台上各添加一棵方形花盆中的小型光秃装饰树。建筑应包含多个超现实阶梯，包括左下中心的一条长对角线楼梯和攀爬右上塔楼的阶梯；最高的塔楼拥有绿松石色的圆顶和一座小尖塔。左上方使用一个苍白的太阳圆盘，营造出大气雾气、柔和光晕、细腻阴影和极简线条感。在左上方放置大型竖排中文语录，采用纤细优雅的灰色笔触：{argument name="quote text" default="当你凝视深渊时，深渊也在凝视你。"}。在其下方，添加一行浅灰色的英文翻译：{argument name="English translation" default="When you gaze into the abyss, the abyss gazes into you."}。添加小型编辑海报细节：左上角文字 {argument name="volume label" default="VOL.01"} 下方配有一条微小的水平线，右上角文字 {argument name="year" default="2026"} 下方配有四个垂直排列的小圆点，左侧添加一个包含“depth”和“gaze”的关键词块，左下角放置一个极简圆形 Logo，上方标注“LOOK DEEP”和“BE SEEN”，右下角放置三个水平排列的小圆点。保持整体构图空灵、精致、深邃且具有高级感，语录占据左侧三分之一，超现实城市在中心和右侧升起。

templates.title: Electric Blue Lightning Effect VFX

titleLocalized.zh: 电光蓝闪电特效 VFX

templates.prompt: Create a high-resolution{argument name="effect type" default="Lightning and thunder"} VFX footage with a pure black background (giving it a transparent feel), intended for use in games or compositing effects. It showcases five independent vertical lightning bolts extending from the top edge to the bottom: one near the far left, one in the left center, one in the center (largest and brightest), one in the right center, and one near the far right. Each lightning bolt has a jagged branch main lightning bolt, with a bright color.{argument name="lightning color" default="Electric Blue"} The core is incandescent in color, with small, outward-spreading branches and a soft blue halo. At the base of each lightning bolt, a bright starburst impact point is added, positioned on a subtle horizontal luminous line, with faint sparks, fine particle scattering, and a slight mirror reflection below the impact point. This makes the central lightning bolt the tallest, thickest, and brightest visual focal point, while the other four lightning bolts are slightly narrower and evenly distributed. It features a dramatic, dark storm energy look, high contrast, clear branch details, luminous halos, volumetric lighting, no text, characters, scenes, or borders, and a 16:9 widescreen composition, making it suitable for overlaying visual effects.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个高分辨率的 {argument name="effect type" default="电闪雷鸣"} VFX 素材，背景为纯黑色（呈现透明感），旨在用作游戏或合成特效图。展示 5 条从顶部边缘延伸到底部的独立垂直闪电柱：一条靠近最左侧，一条位于左中，一条位于中心（最大且最亮），一条位于右中，一条靠近最右侧。每条闪电都有锯齿状的分支主闪电，颜色为强烈的 {argument name="lightning color" default="电光蓝"}，核心呈白热色，并带有向外扩散的细小分支以及柔和的蓝色光晕。在每条闪电的底部，添加一个明亮的星爆冲击点，置于一条微妙的水平发光线上，并带有微弱的火花、细小的粒子散射以及冲击点下方轻微的镜像反射。使中心闪电成为最高、最粗、最亮的视觉焦点，其余四条闪电略窄且均匀分布。采用戏剧性的暗黑风暴能量外观，高对比度，清晰的分支细节，发光光环，体积光，无文字，无角色，无场景，无边框，16:9 宽屏构图，适合作为视觉特效素材进行叠加使用。

templates.title: Mini-Me 3D Selfie Transformation

titleLocalized.zh: Mini-Me 3D 自拍变身

templates.prompt: Based on the provided reference selfie, the composition, clothing, lanyard, name tag, gestures, indoor ceiling background, perspective, and realistic lighting of the original photo are kept largely unchanged. Solid blocks obscuring the face are removed, and a natural and realistic face is reconstructed, matching the hairstyle, head angle, skin tone, and selfie lighting. Seven 3D animated "mini-me" figures identical to the original self are added to the scene, using a cute Pixar style and incorporating realistic touch shadows, depth of field, reflections, and matching warm lighting effects: one standing on the left shoulder with arms crossed, one waving from above the name tag, one hugging the right edge of the name tag with eyes closed, one peeking out from the collar, one sitting on the lanyard near the name tag in a thoughtful pose, one sitting on the yellow lanyard in front looking up, and one with hands hanging from the lanyard below. These mini-characters wear simple, matching dark clothing and tiny lanyards, interacting naturally with real objects. A subtle magical shimmering atmosphere is added without altering the original selfie base image. Overall atmosphere: playful and cute, creating a sense of being in a miniature world within the original photograph.

promptLocalized.zh: 基于提供的参考自拍，保持原照片的构图、服装、挂绳、工牌、手势、室内天花板背景、透视关系以及真实光影基本不变。去除遮挡面部的实心方块，并重构一张自然且真实的面部，使其发型、头部角度、肤色和自拍光线相匹配。在场景中添加 7 个与本人形象一致的 3D 动画“迷你我”，采用可爱的皮克斯风格，并融入真实接触阴影、景深、反射以及相匹配的暖光效果：1 个站在左肩上交叉双臂，1 个站在工牌上方挥手，1 个闭眼拥抱工牌右侧边缘，1 个从衣领处探出头，1 个坐在靠近工牌的挂绳上呈思考姿势，1 个坐在前侧黄色挂绳带上向上看，1 个双手悬挂在下方的挂绳带上。让这些迷你角色穿着简约的同款深色服装并佩戴微型挂绳，与真实物体自然互动。在不改变真实自拍底图的前提下，添加微妙的魔法闪光氛围。整体氛围：俏皮、可爱，营造出一种置身于原照片中的真实微缩世界感。

templates.title: Electric Blue Lens Flare VFX

titleLocalized.zh: 电光蓝镜头光晕 VFX

templates.prompt: Create a high-resolution, cinematic-quality VFX clip to showcase a stunning visual experience.{argument name="light color" default="Electric blue-white"} Lens flare against a pure black background. The composition is slightly tilted to the left of the image, with a highly exposed white core at the center, surrounded by a dazzling blue glow. A straight horizontal beam of light crosses the edge of the image, intersecting with the central vertical beam to form a bright cross. Numerous slender, radiating starburst rays are added around the core, accompanied by soft volumetric halos, delicate blue halo, and faint circular lens artifacts around the center. Four small secondary halo spheres are precisely added to the horizontal beam: one faint sphere to the left of the core and three brighter blue-white spheres to the right. The background remains completely black, without text, objects, borders, or visible textures, aiming to create an anime/game effect asset that appears transparent even when rendered against a black background. It utilizes a 16:9 widescreen aspect ratio, boasts sharp highlights, realistic optical halo physics, high contrast, a glossy sci-fi energy, and clean edges suitable for post-production compositing.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个高分辨率的电影级 VFX 素材，展示一个绚丽的 {argument name="light color" default="电光蓝白色"} 镜头光晕，背景为纯黑色。构图略微偏向画面左侧，中心为高曝光的白色核心，周围环绕着耀眼的蓝色光芒。一条笔直的水平光束横跨画面边缘，与中心垂直光束交汇形成明亮的十字。在核心周围添加许多向外放射的细长星芒射线，并带有柔和的体积光晕、细腻的蓝色雾气以及中心周围淡淡的圆形镜头伪影。在水平光束上精确添加 4 个小型次级光晕球：核心左侧 1 个微弱的小球，右侧 3 个更明亮的蓝白色球体。保持背景完全黑色，无文字、无物体、无边框且无可见纹理，旨在打造一种即便渲染在黑色背景上也能呈现透明感的动漫/游戏特效素材。采用 16:9 宽屏比例，高光锐利，具备逼真的光学光晕物理效果、高对比度、光泽感的科幻能量，以及适合后期合成的干净边缘。

templates.title: Movie-quality fire effects materials

titleLocalized.zh: 电影级火焰特效素材

templates.prompt: Create a high-resolution VFX fire effect: Against a pure black background, generate a wide, horizontal wall of flames rising from the bottom edge and spanning the entire screen. The flames should have a bright yellowish-white core, saturated orange-red outer flames, and a translucent wave of smoke and heat fading upwards into the darkness.{argument name="flame height" default="Flame peaks of varying heights"} It presents an uneven, curled shape, including several huge, twisted pillars of fire on the left, center, and right sides, as well as a dense band of small flames at the bottom. Numerous upward-drifting particles of scorching embers and sparks are added, with tiny red-orange spots scattered above the flames. This makes it look like realistic, cinematic game effects or composite elements, with high contrast, sharp details, and a natural sense of turbulent motion. It contains no objects, no text, no figures, no borders, and is centered.{argument name="background color" default="pure black"} ,{argument name="fire color palette" default="Yellow, white, orange, red"} ,{argument name="aspect ratio" default="16:9 widescreen landscape"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创建高分辨率 VFX 火焰特效素材：在纯黑背景下，生成一道从底部边缘升起、横跨整个画面的宽幅水平火焰墙。火焰应具备明亮的黄白色核心、饱和的橙红色外焰，以及向上渐隐至黑暗中的半透明烟雾热浪。使用 {argument name="flame height" default="高低错落的火焰峰值"}，呈现不均匀的卷曲形态，包括左、中、右侧几根巨大的扭曲火柱，以及底部一层密集的小火焰带。添加大量向上飘散的炽热余烬颗粒和火星，火焰上方散布着细小的红橙色斑点。使其看起来像逼真的电影级游戏特效或合成元素，高对比度，细节锐利，蕴含自然的湍流运动感，无物体，无文字，无人物，无边框，居中构图，{argument name="background color" default="纯黑色"}，{argument name="fire color palette" default="黄、白、橙、红"}，{argument name="aspect ratio" default="16:9 宽屏横向"}。

templates.title: Anime-style rural dog-walking T-shirt scene

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫乡村遛狗 T 恤场景

templates.prompt: Create a delicate full-body illustration in anime style, in which {argument name="character description" default="A stylish young woman with long, silver-gray pigtails"} On a bright summer noon, she walked towards the audience along a narrow country lane, her face deliberately blurred with a soft, square effect. She wore high, voluminous, wavy pigtails adorned with purple rose hair accessories, her skin was fair, and she wore a black choker and black hair ties. Her legs were smooth and glossy, with a black floral vine tattoo on one calf. She wore an oversized, slightly sheer, damp-looking white T-shirt with a striking print on the chest.{argument name="shirt text" default="HIMAINU"} The text below the image is a simple emoji. She wears a black pleated skirt with pale purple ruffles and black Mary Jane platform shoes. Her left hand holds a black leash, the other end of which is {argument name="dog description" default="A cream-colored curly-haired toy poodle"} The puppy, tongue lolling out, walked happily beside her. (Background setting:){argument name="setting" default="The picturesque Japanese countryside features rice paddies, traditional wooden houses, roadside wildflowers, telephone poles, and forested mountains."} The image must include a dirt and gravel road, irrigation ditches, lush fields, a deep blue sky, bright white clouds, strong midday sunlight, clear shadows, vibrant and saturated colors, and richly detailed anime background art. It should employ a vertical composition, a level perspective, and a centered character with the puppy in the lower left foreground, creating a cinematic summer atmosphere. The lines should be clean and crisp, the fabric highlights delicate, the hair details rich, and the environment layered effectively.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张精致的动漫风格全身插画，画面中 {argument name="character description" default="一位留着银灰色长双马尾的时尚年轻女性"} 在明媚的夏日正午，沿着狭窄的乡村小道向观众走来，她的面部被刻意处理为柔和的方形模糊效果。她扎着高高的蓬松波浪双马尾，戴着紫色玫瑰发饰，皮肤白皙，颈部佩戴黑色项圈，手腕戴着黑色发圈，双腿光洁亮泽，其中一侧小腿上有黑色花藤纹身。她身穿一件超大号、略带半透明湿感效果的白色 T 恤，胸前印有醒目的 {argument name="shirt text" default="HIMAINU"} 字样，下方配有一个简单的表情符号，下身搭配一条带有淡紫色荷叶边装饰的黑色短褶裙，脚穿黑色玛丽珍厚底鞋。她的左手牵着一根黑色牵引绳，绳子另一端是 {argument name="dog description" default="一只奶油色卷毛玩具贵宾犬"}，小狗正吐着舌头，神情愉悦地走在她身旁。背景设定为 {argument name="setting" default="风景优美的日本乡村，有稻田、传统木屋、路边野花、电线杆和森林覆盖的山脉"}；画面需包含泥土碎石路、灌溉渠、郁郁葱葱的田野、深蓝色的天空、明亮的白色积云、强烈的正午阳光、清晰的阴影、鲜艳饱和的色彩以及细节丰富的动漫背景艺术。采用竖构图、平视视角、角色居中，小狗位于左下角前景，营造出电影般的夏日氛围，线条干净利落，织物高光细腻，发丝细节丰富，环境层次感强。

templates.title: Japanese SNS Automated Thumbnails

titleLocalized.zh: 日本 SNS 自动化缩略图

templates.prompt: Create a high-energy Japanese YouTube thumbnail/social media banner in a 16:9 widescreen format, using a dramatic black, white, and electric yellow color scheme, paired with explosive comic-style speed lines, brush textures, glowing arrows, sparks, and a futuristic AI-automated atmosphere. The left half is dominated by a huge, bold Japanese title, with text {argument name="main headline text" default="Effortless SNS Strategy"} The first line uses bold white text on a black background, while "SNS" and subsequent characters use a large, bright yellow block font with a black shadow. Below this, a slanted white stroke band containing black text is added.{argument name="subheadline text" default="Everything changed with GPT Image 2."} A large black-painted banner with striking white and yellow Japanese characters is placed at the bottom.{argument name="bottom banner text" default="Automate both images and articles with skills"} The yellow phrase at the end is emphasized. On the right half, a young woman with an anime style is shown, sporting very long, flowing two-tone hair (pink on the left, blue on the right), and wearing a dress printed with…{argument name="shirt text" default="OKIHIRO AI Creative"} She wears a white T-shirt and a pink skirt; her face is obscured by a centered, soft pink and gray square mosaic block, and her right hand extends towards the viewer in a dynamic, perspective pose. It includes three floating social media icons: a black square X icon near the top center, a round white square Instagram icon in the upper right corner, and a round white square YouTube play icon in the lower right corner. Glowing AI/content automation elements are added around the center, including a bright, open cube with a cloud symbol, floating image cards, yellow directional arrows, and outward-radiating gold rays. The design combines crisp anime illustrations with bold ad graphic design, featuring high contrast, sharp outlines, saturated colors, motion blur accents, and sophisticated viral thumbnail compositions optimized for click-through rates.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个高能量的日本 YouTube 缩略图 / 社交媒体横幅，采用 16:9 宽屏格式，使用戏剧性的黑、白、电光黄配色方案，搭配爆炸性的漫画风格速度线、画笔纹理、发光箭头、火花以及未来感十足的 AI 自动化氛围。左半部分由巨大的粗体日语标题主导，文字为 {argument name="main headline text" default="頑張らない SNS 展開"}，第一行采用黑色笔触背景上的白色粗体字，“SNS”及后续字符采用超大亮黄色块状字体并带有黑色阴影。在其下方，添加一条倾斜的白色笔触带，包含黑色文字 {argument name="subheadline text" default="GPT Image 2 で全部変わった"}。沿底部放置一个宽大的黑色笔触横幅，上面写着醒目的白色和黄色日语文字 {argument name="bottom banner text" default="画像も記事もスキルで自動化"}，强调最后的黄色短语。在右半部分，展示一位动漫风格的年轻女性，留着非常长的飘逸双色头发（左侧粉色，右侧蓝色），身穿印有 {argument name="shirt text" default="OKIHIRO AI Creative"} 的白色 T 恤和粉色短裙；她的脸部被一个居中的、呈柔和粉色和灰色调的方形马赛克块遮住，她的右手以动态的透视姿势伸向观众。包含三个悬浮的社交媒体图标：顶部中心附近的一个黑色方形 X 图标，右上角的一个圆形白色方形 Instagram 图标，以及右下角的一个圆形白色方形 YouTube 播放图标。在中心周围添加发光的 AI / 内容自动化元素，包括带有云符号的明亮开口立方体、悬浮图像卡片、黄色方向箭头和向外辐射的金色光芒。采用清晰的动漫插画与大胆的广告图形设计相结合，高对比度、锐利的轮廓、饱和的色彩、运动模糊点缀，以及针对点击率优化的精致病毒式缩略图构图。

promptLocalized.zh: {"type":"戏剧性动漫棒球对抗海报","composition":"一张高能量的左右分割对抗主视觉图，画面包含 2 名动漫风格的女性棒球选手对峙，左侧为中日龙队（Chunichi Dragons）的蓝色调，右侧为阪神虎队（Hanshin Tigers）的黑金调。画面中心放置一个巨大的手绘笔触“VS”，左侧笔触为蓝色，右侧为黄色，背景为球场泛光灯、火花以及座无虚席的夜间棒球场。采用光泽感现代运动动漫渲染，线条清晰，边缘光影效果强烈，具有深邃感、动态粒子效果及海报般的对比度。","subjects":{"count":2,"left_player":{"description":"红发动漫少女，身着中日龙队队服，四分之三侧身面向内侧，头戴印有白色 CD 标志的深蓝色棒球帽，白色球衣配蓝色滚边，胸前印有“Dragons”字样，球衣号码 7 号，深蓝色内搭，腰间拿着棕色棒球手套，一只拳头举至肩部附近，展现出自信的比赛日姿态","face":"用暖肤色的纯色柔和矩形遮挡块覆盖面部，完全遮盖五官","team":"{argument name=\"left team name\" default=\"中日龙队\"}"},"right_player":{"description":"深绿色波波头动漫少女，身着阪神虎队队服，四分之三侧身面向内侧，头戴印有黄色 HT 标志的黑色球帽，白色条纹球衣配黑黄滚边，胸前印有“Tigers”字样，球衣号码 1 号，黑色内搭，黑色棒球手套举在脸旁，佩戴黄色小发带，展现出沉稳的竞技姿态","face":"用柔和的灰米色纯色矩形遮挡块覆盖面部，完全遮盖五官","team":"{argument name=\"right team name\" default=\"阪神虎队\"}"}},"background":{"left_half":"蓝色球场氛围，配有泛光灯，远处有蓝色的龙形吉祥物剪影和模糊的 Dragons 字样/标志","right_half":"金色与黑色球场氛围，配有泛光灯，远处有巨大的风格化虎头徽章","center":"明亮的垂直光束将两队分开，VS 后方有黑色墨迹飞溅"},"visible_text":{"count":8,"items":["中日ドラゴンズ","DRAGONS","— セ・リーグ 公式戦 —","阪神タイガース","TIGERS","今、勝利の扉が開かれる！","ナゴヤドーム / 甲子園球場","@tiiai11"],"main_headline":"{argument name=\"main headline text\" default=\"今、勝利の扉が開かれる！\"}","match_label":"{argument name=\"match label text\" default=\"— セ・リーグ 公式戦 —\"}","venue_text":"{argument name=\"venue text\" default=\"ナゴヤドーム / 甲子園球場\"}"},"typography":"粗体运动标志字体：左下角为巨大的蓝色衬线体 DRAGONS，右下角为带有黑色描边的巨大黄色 TIGERS，底部黑色笔触上方为超大号白色日文书法标题，下方配有较小的蓝/黄色场地文字。为所有文字添加细微的白色描边和阴影以提高可读性。","style":"16:9 横向海报，动漫运动插画，电影级球场灯光，饱和的蓝金配色，细节锐利，宣传比赛卡片设计，非写实风格。"}

templates.title: Crimson Wings Giant Mech

titleLocalized.zh: 深红之翼巨型机甲

templates.prompt: Create a highly dramatic vertical anime mecha illustration, featuring a mecha named {argument name="mecha title" default="Crimson Sky"} A giant humanoid robot stands powerfully in a symmetrical, frontal stance on a futuristic circular launch platform. The robot's main body is {argument name="armor color" default="Glossy deep red"} Adorned with white, black, dark gunmetal gray, and subtle gold decorative panels, its entire body is covered in intricate hard-surface armor, panel lines, vents, exposed mechanical joints, stickers, scratches, and small warning markings. It possesses a sharp, heroic silhouette reminiscent of Gundam, featuring an angular helmet, glowing cyan eyes, a narrow visor, broad armored shoulders, layered chest armor, long, segmented legs, and two large arm weapons or shield-blades; one forearm is equipped with a long-barreled rifle with a cyan energy bar, while the other wields a large, angular red and white shield blade. A massive backpack consisting of six main blade-like wing components is added: two large upward-pointing red wings, two broad horizontal red and white wings, and two long downward-pointing tail fins, all edges decorated with white and gold components, presenting a phoenix-like aerial form. The low-angle, upward-looking perspective emphasizes the robot's immense size, with a centered composition, dynamic perspective, and a clear cel-shaded anime rendering style, combining realistic mechanical details, high-contrast sunlight, glossy reflections, and deep shadows. The scene background is set to bright.{argument name="sky setting" default="Clear blue sky and scattered white clouds"} Below, a futuristic base and horizon are visible in the distance, emphasizing scale and grandeur. The overall style is reminiscent of a high-end Japanese giant robot poster, featuring ultra-high detail, sharp lines, vibrant colors, and cinematic lighting. Apart from optional small technical markings on the armor, there is no visible text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张极具戏剧性的竖版动漫机甲插画，主角是一台名为 {argument name="mecha title" default="破天深红"} 的巨型人形机器人，它以充满力量感的对称正面姿态伫立在未来感十足的圆形发射平台上。机器人主体为 {argument name="armor color" default="光泽深红色"}，辅以白色、黑色、深枪灰色及少量的金色装饰面板，全身覆盖着复杂的硬表面装甲、刻线、通风口、外露机械关节、贴纸、划痕以及细小的警示标记。赋予它类似高达的锐利英雄轮廓，配有带角的棱角分明头盔、发光的青色双眼、窄面罩、宽阔的装甲肩部、层叠的胸甲、修长的分段式腿部，以及两件大型手臂武器或盾刃装置；一只前臂装备着带有青色能量条的长管步枪，另一只则配有大型棱角分明的红白盾刃。添加一个由六个主要刃状翼组件构成的巨大背部飞行背包：两片巨大的向上红翼、两片宽阔的水平红白翼以及两片长长的向下尾鳍，所有边缘均饰有白色和金色部件，呈现出凤凰般的空中形态。采用低角度仰拍视角以突显机器人的巨大感，构图居中，透视动态，采用清晰的赛璐珞动漫渲染风格，兼具写实的机械细节、高对比度阳光、光泽反射及深邃阴影。场景背景设定为明亮的 {argument name="sky setting" default="晴朗蓝天与零星白云"}，下方可见远处的未来基地与地平线，强调规模与宏大感。整体风格为高端日本巨型机器人海报，超高细节，线条清晰，色彩鲜艳，电影级光影，除装甲上可选的细小技术标记外，不包含任何可见文字。

templates.title: Deep Red Melancholy Double Exposure Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 深红忧郁双重曝光肖像

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic, cinematic studio portrait, with the subject being {argument name="subject" default="A young man"} The side profile, wearing{argument name="clothing" default="black hooded sweatshirt"} His head was slightly lowered, one hand resting on his forehead, as if under immense pressure or deep in thought. (Using strong...){argument name="lighting color" default="Deep crimson"} The lighting, with its heavy rim lighting, outlines the messy, dark curls, ears, neck, hands, and folds of the sweatshirt, while the subject is mostly immersed in near-pure black shadows. A diffused smoke or mist is added to the background, illuminated by red light; a large, soft, ghostly outline of the same head and shoulders is added to the right side of the background, creating a psychological double exposure effect. The composition is vertical, a close-up from chest to head, with the subject facing left, featuring high contrast, a melancholic film noir style, shallow depth of field, deep red and black tones, delicate film grain, realistic photographic texture, and an introspective emotional atmosphere. Keeping most of the face hidden in shadow and pose, rather than clearly visible, emphasizes anonymity and tension.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张戏剧性的电影感摄影棚肖像，主体为 {argument name="subject" default="一名年轻男子"} 的侧面轮廓，身穿 {argument name="clothing" default="黑色连帽卫衣"}，头部微垂，一只手按在额头上，仿佛压力巨大或陷入沉思。使用强烈的 {argument name="lighting color" default="深绯红色"} 灯光，以浓重的轮廓光勾勒出凌乱的深色卷发、耳朵、颈部、手部和卫衣褶皱，而人物主体大部分沉浸在近乎纯黑的阴影中。在背景中加入弥漫的烟雾或薄雾，并被红光照亮；在右侧背景中加入一个巨大的、柔和且幽灵般的同款头部和肩部轮廓，营造出心理层面的双重曝光效果。构图为竖构图，从胸部到头部的特写，主体面向左侧，具有高对比度、忧郁的黑色电影风格、浅景深、深红与黑色调、细腻的胶片颗粒感、逼真的摄影质感以及内省的情绪氛围。保持面部大部分隐藏在阴影和姿势中，而非清晰可见，以强调匿名感和紧张感。

templates.title: Dark Goblin Shaman in the Haunted Swamp

titleLocalized.zh: 闹鬼沼泽中的黑暗哥布林萨满

templates.prompt: Create a dark fantasy film-quality illustration depicting an evil {argument name="creature type" default="Goblin Shaman Warrior"} Crouching low in the haunted swamp at night. The scene is a three-quarter view, with the creature centered, staring directly at the viewer with a menacing grin. The creature possesses mottled blue-green leather skin, a long, curved nose, eyes that glow with an icy blue light, large, pointed ears adorned with small rings and decorations, sharp, jagged teeth, claw-like feet, lean limbs, and a tuft of tangled, dreadlock-like tentacles atop its head. It is dressed in tattered tribal leather, ragged strips of cloth, bone and metal ornaments, and worn, dark shoulder armor. Its forearms are encased in oversized ancient gauntlets made of corroded bronze-black metal, each gauntlet ending in long, claw-like spikes and containing a large, circular, glowing cyan magical core—two glowing gauntlet cores in total. Turquoise will-o'-the-wisps swirl around the gauntlets, drifting through the air. The background is set in a desolate, misty swamp, the ground black and muddy, with reflections in the shallow water, where reeds, twisted leafless trees, hanging moss, and jagged thorn outlines grow. In the distance, a sinister Gothic castle stands, its many spires gleaming, a bright, circular blue arcane symbol glowing on its exterior wall. The composition employs a deep midnight blue tone, paired with cyan rim lighting and magical effects, presenting a wet, reflective surface, dense fog, high contrast, ultra-detailed biological anatomy, ornate armor textures, a somber fairytale horror atmosphere, and a dramatic low-angle composition. The focus is clearly on the goblins, achieving cinematic concept art quality in a square frame.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张黑暗奇幻电影级插画，描绘一个邪恶的 {argument name="creature type" default="哥布林萨满战士"} 在夜晚的闹鬼沼泽中低身蹲伏。画面采用四分之三侧视图，生物居中，正带着凶狠的笑容直视观众。该生物拥有斑驳的蓝绿色皮革皮肤、长而弯曲的鼻子、发着冰蓝色光芒的眼睛、带有小环和装饰的大尖耳、锋利参差的牙齿、爪状足部、精瘦的四肢，头顶长着一簇纠结如脏辫般的触须。为它穿上破烂的部落皮革、褴褛的布条、骨头和金属饰品，以及磨损的深色肩甲。双前臂包裹在由腐蚀的青铜黑色金属制成的超大古代护手内，每个护手末端有长长的爪状尖刺，并各含一个巨大的圆形发光青色魔法核心，总计两个发光的护手核心。在护手周围添加缭绕的绿松石色鬼火，并使其在空气中飘散。背景设定为充满迷雾的死寂沼泽，地面是黑色泥泞，浅水区有倒影，生长着芦苇、扭曲的无叶树木、悬挂的苔藓和锯齿状的荆棘轮廓。在远景处放置一座阴森的哥特式黑暗城堡，城堡有许多针状尖塔，外墙上有一个明亮的圆形蓝色奥术符号在发光。采用深午夜蓝调，搭配青色轮廓光和魔法光效，呈现湿润的反射表面、浓重的雾气、高对比度、超精细的生物解剖结构、华丽的盔甲质感、阴郁的童话恐怖氛围、戏剧性的低角度构图，焦点清晰地对准哥布林，具备电影级概念艺术品质，方形画幅。

The goblin possesses mottled {argument name="skin color" default="Bluish-gray leather-textured skin"} A gigantic, roaring face, jagged, sharp yellow teeth, a wrinkled pig-like snout, exaggerated cheekbones, huge pointed ears adorned with earrings and metal hoops, and eyes that gleamed {argument name="eye glow color" default="Blue-green"} The radiance. A wild, upright mohawk hairstyle was designed for him, with a hair color of {argument name="hair color" default="Electric Blue"} Sparse strands of hair flew upwards, as if electrified. Clad in tattered dark leather and fragmented spiked armor: a heavy spiked shoulder guard on one side, mismatched heavy bracers, clawed metal gauntlets, and belts, straps, amulets, bone ornaments, and worn decorations. It features dramatic rim lighting, eyes and smoke emitting a bluish bioluminescence, high-contrast shadows, shallow depth of field, ultra-fine textures, a dirty, utilitarian fantasy-realistic style, cinematic 3D creature design, wide-angle perspective, centered composition, a strong menacing expression, no text, and no borders.

A deep blue starry sky is used, with bright, galactic-like nebulae overhead, cool-toned moonlight, blue bioluminescent accents, orange claw-like light reflecting in the water, volumetric fog, high detail, dramatic low-angle composition, realistic fantasy concept art, crisp textures, cinematic lighting, and a square format.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影级暗黑奇幻肖像，描绘一个在夜晚雾气缭绕的月光沼泽中蹲伏的地精战士。地精拥有绿色斑驳的皮肤，超大的尖耳朵上戴着多个银色圆环耳环，凌乱狂野的 {argument name="hair color" default="绿松石蓝"} 头发，长而发光的橙色爪状指甲，以及双手撑在水面附近的佝偻掠食姿态。在面部中心放置一个平坦的不透明深橄榄色方形遮挡块，遮住面部特征。为地精穿上粗犷的部落拾荒者盔甲：带有发光青色眼睛的青铜雕刻骷髅肩甲、红色皮带、破烂的棕色布裙、厚重的护腕、金属环、符文装饰以及磨损的奇幻装备。场景设定在一个浅沼泽中，充满反射的黑水、芦苇、雾气、发光的青色蘑菇，前景和背景中散落着骨头和可见的头骨。使用深蓝色星空，头顶有明亮的银河系般的星云，冷色调月光，青色生物发光点缀，水中反射着橙色的爪光，体积雾，高细节，戏剧性的低角度构图，写实奇幻概念艺术，清晰的纹理，电影级光效，方形格式。

templates.title: Glowing Goblin Shaman in the Swamp

templates.prompt: Create a 3D character portrait in a cinematic dark fantasy style, depicting a wild {argument name="creature type" default="Goblin Shaman"} Crouching low in the swamp at night, it lunges at the audience with a sinister grin. The creature possesses mottled green skin, a narrow, wrinkled face, sharp fangs, long, pointed ears with multiple silver rings, eyes that glow with an icy blue light, and wild, spiky hair combed upwards.{argument name="hair color" default="Cyan and magenta"} Hair. Add glowing cyan tribal markings to the forehead, chest, and arms, with the brightest rune positioned directly above the brow. Dress the goblin in rugged fantasy armor: a large, weathered brass shoulder guard with studs, dark leather belts, a circular metal chest piece, a tattered red loincloth, and red leather forearm bracers adorned with black mystical symbols. Claws should extend forward, wreathed in smoky orange magical flames, with glowing runes on the wrists and fingertips. The scene is set in a dimly lit swamp, with shallow, reflecting water, mist, reeds, scattered bones, ribs, and skulls, dotted with clusters of bioluminescent cyan mushrooms and tiny green firefly-like specks. Shot from a low angle, emphasizing dramatic depth of field to showcase the highly detailed creature carvings, the texture of the wet skin and armor, the voluminous blue mist, the starlight-like bokeh in the background, and the striking contrast between the cool-toned cyan magical glow and the warm-toned orange flames on the hands. It was transformed into a square, ultra-detailed, cinematic fantasy rendering, creating a highly aggressive and threatening atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影级暗黑奇幻风格的 3D 角色肖像，描绘一只野性的 {argument name="creature type" default="哥布林萨满"} 在夜晚的沼泽中低身蹲伏，带着邪恶的笑容向观众扑来。该生物拥有斑驳的绿色皮肤、狭窄且布满皱纹的脸庞、锋利的獠牙、带有多个银色圆环穿孔的长尖耳、发着冰蓝色光芒的双眼，以及向上梳起的狂野尖刺状 {argument name="hair color" default="青色和洋红色"} 头发。在前额、胸部和手臂上添加发光的青色部落纹饰，最明亮的符文位于眉心正上方。为哥布林穿上粗犷的奇幻盔甲：一个带有铆钉的大型风化黄铜肩甲、深色皮带、圆形金属胸部装置、破旧的红色缠腰布，以及绘有黑色神秘符号的红色皮革前臂护腕。双爪应向前伸展，缠绕着烟雾缭绕的橙色魔法火焰，手腕和指尖带有发光的符文。场景设定在昏暗的沼泽中，地面有浅浅的反射水面、薄雾、芦苇、散落的骨头、肋骨和头骨，并点缀着成簇的生物发光青色蘑菇和微小的绿色萤火虫状光点。采用低机位拍摄，强调戏剧性的景深，展现高细节的生物雕刻、湿润的皮肤和盔甲质感、体积感十足的蓝色雾气、背景中星光璀璨的虚化效果，以及冷色调青色魔法光芒与暖色调橙色手部火焰之间的强烈对比。将其制作成一张方形、超精细、电影级的奇幻渲染图，营造出一种极具侵略性的威胁氛围。

templates.title: Anime-style artist portrait (face obscured)

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫风格艺术家头像（已遮挡面部）

templates.prompt: Create a dynamic single-panel anime illustration depicting a stylish young man with messy, tousled hair.{argument name="hair color" default="Black hair with light purple highlights"} A half-length portrait against a clean white background. His face is deliberately obscured by a large, centrally located square occlusion, rendered in a soft gradient from dark to warm gray, concealing all facial features. One of his hands extends towards the viewer with a strong sense of perspective, his fingers holding a stylish black paintbrush or stylus, as if painting in mid-air. He is draped in an oversized, glossy garment.{argument name="jacket color" default="White"} A tech-inspired jacket, layered over a black shirt and hoodie, features prominent straps, buckles, zippers, a black lining, and several silver necklaces with small pendants. A delicate silver ring adorns his outstretched finger. Employing vibrant sketch lines and semi-realistic anime rendering, the hair and hands are richly detailed, accented with soft lavender and pale pink brushstrokes to create a stylish urban sci-fi atmosphere. Surrounding the design are hand-drawn graffiti and abstract design symbols: a ringed planet at the top left, a pink lightning bolt at the top right, two wireframe geometric polyhedra at the bottom left and right edges, multiple small starbursts, scattered black dots, diagonal ink splatters, and constellation-like connecting lines. The overall composition should evoke the feel of a modern digital artist's portrait or profile illustration, with the pen tip and hand closest to the camera, featuring clear black-and-white contrast, a casual cartoon sketch texture, and devoid of any text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张动感的单格动漫插画，描绘一位时尚的年轻人，留着凌乱蓬松的 {argument name="hair color" default="带有淡紫色挑染的黑发"}，半身像，背景为干净的白色。他的面部被一个居中的大方形隐私遮挡块刻意遮盖，采用柔和的深灰到暖灰渐变，遮住所有五官。他的一只手以强烈的透视感伸向观众，指间握着一支时尚的黑色画笔或触控笔，仿佛在半空中作画。为他穿上一件超大号的亮面 {argument name="jacket color" default="白色"} 科技风夹克，内搭黑色衬衫和连帽衫，配有明显的绑带、搭扣、拉链、黑色内衬以及几条带有小吊坠的银色项链。在他伸出的手指上添加细银戒指。采用充满活力的草图线条、半写实动漫渲染，头发和手部细节丰富，点缀柔和的薰衣草色和淡粉色笔触，营造出时尚的都市科幻氛围。周围环绕手绘涂鸦和抽象设计符号：左上方正好有 1 个带环行星，右上方有 1 个粉色闪电，左下和右下边缘各有 2 个线框几何多面体，以及多个小星星闪光、散落的黑点、对角线墨水溅射和类似星座的连接线。整体构图应呈现出现代数字艺术家头像或个人资料插画的质感，笔尖和手部最靠近镜头，具有清晰的黑白对比、随性的漫画草图纹理，且不包含任何文字。

promptLocalized.zh: {"type":"宽屏赛博奇幻游戏开发插图，带有空白 UI 文本面板","aspect_ratio":"16:9","style":"高细节动漫像素艺术混合风格，等距视角地下城游戏美术，光泽感数字绘画，霓虹蓝赛博界面叠加层，深海军蓝配色搭配温暖火光，形状清晰易读，无可见文字","main_concept":"一位开发者正在使用 AI 工具生成奇幻 RPG 地下城场景，其中包含一个大型空白项目面板和一个留空的标题面板，以便后续插入文本。","layout":{"canvas":"1280x720 宽屏构图","left_panel":{"position":"左上半部分","shape":"大型圆角矩形","count":1,"appearance":"深色半透明海军蓝面板，带有细薄的蓝色发光边框，完全空白，无文字，占据画面左侧约 45% 的区域"},"bottom_panel":{"position":"左下至中心","shape":"宽圆角矩形","count":1,"appearance":"深色半透明海军蓝面板，带有细薄的蓝色发光边框，完全空白，无文字，横跨底部大部分宽度"},"right_scene":{"position":"右上及中右侧","description":"等距视角石质地下城房间，呈现如战术 RPG 地图般的效果，连接着未来感蓝色电路线条和全息 UI 元素"},"foreground_viewer":{"position":"右下角","description":"一名戴兜帽的人在电脑显示器前的背影，头部被发光的蓝色耳机状弧线和明亮的电路大脑符号环绕，正在屏幕上观察地下城地图"}},"dungeon":{"environment":"方形灰色石砖地面，带有破损的墙壁、柱子、凸起方块、蓝色网格路径线，散布着光源","lighting":"四团温暖的橙色火炬火焰置于石柱和墙壁上，与电光蓝全息投影交相辉映","hero":{"count":1,"description":"一名身穿紫色兜帽和深色盔甲的小型 Q 版冒险者，手持短剑，站在地下城中心附近"},"enemies":{"count":5,"items":["左侧一只亮绿色史莱姆","左上方一只大耳紫色蝙蝠","中右侧一只小型橙色蘑菇生物","右上方一名红眼发光、手持紫色法杖的兜帽暗黑法师","右侧一名持剑圆盾的骷髅战士"]},"treasure_and_items":{"count":7,"items":["上方中心一个关闭的金色宝箱","右上方一瓶绿色药水","右中心一瓶蓝色药水","英雄右下方一枚圆形戒指或魔法护身符","英雄左下方一堆三枚金币","底部中心一块面包","左下方一个灰色尖刺陷阱"]},"monitors_and_hud":{"count":3,"items":["主显示器显示地下城地图的微缩版本","左下角分析屏幕显示图表和界面小部件","右侧屏幕显示垂直蓝色条形图"]}},"background":{"description":"深海军蓝数字工作空间，带有淡淡的电路板痕迹、发光的数据库圆柱图标、小型浮动方块和细腻的渐变效果"},"customizable_elements":{"project_theme":"{argument name=\"project theme\" default=\"AI 辅助奇幻 RPG 地下城生成\"}","main character":"{argument name=\"main character\" default=\"紫色兜帽 Q 版冒险者\"}","interface panels":"{argument name=\"interface panels\" default=\"两个用于后续文本的空白半透明圆角矩形\"}","color palette":"{argument name=\"color palette\" default=\"深海军蓝、霓虹蓝、紫色和温暖的橙色火光\"}","overall mood":"{argument name=\"overall mood\" default=\"神秘、技术感、趣味性及游戏化\"}"},"rendering_instructions":"生成一张干净且精致的插图，适合作为社交媒体标题图或演示文稿 Slides。保持两个大型 UI 面板为空白，不要添加任何文字。保持左侧/底部空白文本区域与右侧细节丰富的等距视角奇幻地下城之间的强烈对比。不要添加任何 Logo、水印、说明文字或随机文本。"}

templates.title: Three brightly colored cheerleaders posing in a photo studio.

titleLocalized.zh: 三位色彩鲜明的啦啦队员摄影棚姿势

templates.prompt: Create a bright and stylish studio photo to showcase{argument name="number of cheerleaders" default="Three"} Young female cheerleaders in a seamless and vibrant performance{argument name="background color" default="orange color"} A group photo in front of the backdrop. The scene features three performers: the cheerleader on the left, wearing a shimmering blue two-piece cheerleading outfit with silver trim and a large blue bow, leans forward, holding a silver pom-pom in one hand; the cheerleader in the middle, wearing a shimmering red two-piece cheerleading outfit with gold trim and a red bow, stands in the center, one hand on her hip, holding a metallic gold pom-pom; the cheerleader on the right, wearing a shimmering green two-piece cheerleading outfit with white and silver trim and a green bow, performs a dramatic high kick, raising one leg straight up, holding a white pom-pom. All three wear short pleated skirts, white mid-calf socks with stripes matching their outfits, and clean white sneakers. The photographer used glossy sequined fabrics, sharp studio lighting, vibrant saturated colors, full-body vertical compositions, energetic dance team poses, dynamic hair effects, sophisticated commercial photography style, sharp details on uniforms and cheerleading balls, a smooth orange floor that blends into the background, and for anonymity, a simple square pixelated blur mask to cover the face.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张明亮的摄影棚时尚照片，展示 {argument name="number of cheerleaders" default="三位"} 年轻女性啦啦队员在无缝的生动 {argument name="background color" default="橙色"} 背景前合影。场景中共有三名表演者：左侧的啦啦队员身穿闪亮的蓝色两件套啦啦队服，配有银白色饰边和巨大的蓝色蝴蝶结，身体斜倾，单手举起并手持银色啦啦球；中间的啦啦队员身穿闪亮的红色两件套啦啦队服，配有金白色饰边和红色蝴蝶结，站在正中央，单手叉腰并手持金属质感的金色啦啦球；右侧的啦啦队员身穿闪亮的绿色两件套啦啦队服，配有白色和银色饰边以及绿色蝴蝶结，正在进行戏剧性的垂直高踢腿动作，单腿笔直向上抬起，手持白色啦啦球。三人都穿着短百褶裙、带有与服装颜色相配条纹的白色中筒袜，以及干净的白色运动鞋。使用亮面亮片面料、清晰的摄影棚灯光、鲜艳的饱和色彩、全身垂直构图、充满活力的舞蹈队姿势、动态的头发效果、精致的商业摄影风格、制服和啦啦球上的锐利细节、与背景融为一体的平滑橙色地板，并为了匿名起见，使用简单的方形像素化模糊遮罩遮盖面部。

templates.title: Gold leaf portrait in gold leaf cutting technique

titleLocalized.zh: 切金工艺金箔和服肖像

templates.prompt: Create a vertical, ultra-detailed Japanese decorative portrait, employing the luxurious screen and gilding techniques. It depicts a young Japanese woman turned to the left, dressed in opulent clothing.{argument name="kimono color" default="Deep vermilion"} The bride's kimono was covered in gold leaf, delicate cherry blossom patterns, and intricate brocade textures. Her long, lustrous {argument name="hair color" default="black"} Her hair cascaded down her back, adorned with a delicate cluster of red and white cherry blossom hair ornaments and numerous dangling gold hairpin chains. A flat, opaque vase was placed in the center of her face.{argument name="face covering" default="warm brown square"} Facial features are obscured. The background is a radiant landscape of antique gold leaf, featuring visible cracked foil textures, finely cut gold engraving lines, flowing rivers of gold and cream, and in the distance {argument name="background mountain" default="Mount Fuji"} A dark silhouette of pine trees, and a profusion of red and white cherry blossoms blooming in the upper right and lower left foreground. The composition employs a dense gilded effect, combined with layered metallic sheets, raised lacquer-like contours, mosaic gold crackles, delicate floral filigree, and shimmering highlights; creating a texture that blends traditional Japanese painting with high-fashion portraiture. Warm golden tones, extremely luxurious surface details, elegant asymmetrical composition, absence of modern objects and text, and a 2:3 aspect ratio.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅垂直、超精细的日本装饰性肖像，采用奢华的屏风和切金工艺风格。展示一位侧身向左的年轻日本女性，身穿华丽的 {argument name="kimono color" default="深朱红色"} 新娘和服，覆盖着金箔、淡雅的樱花图案和复杂的锦缎纹理。她长而有光泽的 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"} 秀发垂在脑后，装饰着一簇精致的红白樱花发饰和许多悬垂的金色簪子链。在她的脸部中央放置一个平坦不透明的 {argument name="face covering" default="暖棕色方块"}，遮住面部特征。背景是光芒四射的古董金箔景观，具有可见的裂纹箔片纹理、精细的切金雕刻线条、流动的金色与奶油色河流、远处的 {argument name="background mountain" default="富士山"}、深色的松树剪影，以及在右上角和左下角前景中盛开的大量红白樱花。采用密集的镀金构图，结合层叠的金属薄片、凸起的漆器质感轮廓、马赛克金裂纹、精致的花卉金银丝细工和闪烁的高光；营造出传统日本画与高级时尚肖像相结合的质感。暖色调的金色光影，极其华丽的表面细节，优雅的非对称构图，无现代物品，无文字，垂直 2:3 纵横比。

templates.title: Cozy living room mirror selfie

titleLocalized.zh: 温馨客厅镜面自拍

templates.prompt: Create a realistic, high-end lifestyle mirror selfie showcasing an adult woman reclining sideways on a modern beige sofa in a cozy, minimalist living room. She keeps {argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown short hair"} She had a chin-length bob haircut and a slender figure. She leaned against the left armrest of the sofa, one hand resting on a cushion, the other holding a dark-colored smartphone in front of her face; her face was deliberately obscured by a simple rectangular privacy/obscuring block. She was wearing a fitted top.{argument name="top style" default="White ribbed long-sleeved turtleneck crop top"} And a{argument name="skirt style" default="Brown and gray plaid mini skirt"} The figure's legs are bare, stretching diagonally to the right of the frame. The composition uses a 16:9 wide aspect ratio, showing the entire body from head to toe at a slightly low, flat angle. The pose is relaxed and elegant, the human anatomy natural, the skin texture delicate, and the fabric folds realistic. The room's walls are beige stucco, furnished with a cream-colored sofa with square armrests and matching cushions. A black hemispherical table lamp emitting a warm glow sits on a dark side table on the far left. The room has wooden flooring, and on the far right is a tall, sculptural gray ceramic vase filled with delicate branches and leaves. Warm ambient lighting and soft shadows create a comfortable nighttime atmosphere. The shallow depth of field, soft neutral tones, and editorial-grade interior photography style result in ultra-realistic details. There is no visible text, no superfluous figures, and no distorted hands or feet.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张逼真、高端的生活方式镜面自拍照片，展示一位成年女性侧身斜倚在温馨简约客厅的现代米色沙发上。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色短发"} 的齐下巴波波头，身材苗条，上半身靠在沙发左侧扶手上，一只手放在靠垫上，另一只手拿着深色智能手机挡在脸前；她的面部被一个简洁的矩形隐私模糊/遮挡块刻意遮住。她穿着一件修身的 {argument name="top style" default="白色罗纹长袖高领露脐上衣"} 和一条 {argument name="skirt style" default="棕灰色格纹迷你裙"}，双腿裸露，向画面右侧斜向伸展。构图采用 16:9 宽画幅，全身从头到脚，略微低平的视线角度，姿态休闲优雅，人体结构自然，皮肤纹理细腻，布料褶皱真实。房间墙面为米色灰泥，配有方形扶手的奶油色沙发及同色系抱枕，最左侧深色边几上放着一盏散发温暖光芒的黑色半球形台灯，铺设木地板，最右侧摆放着一个高大的雕塑感灰色陶瓷花瓶，插有精致的枝叶。采用温暖的环境光，阴影柔和，营造舒适的夜晚氛围，浅景深，柔和的中性色调，编辑级室内摄影风格，超逼真细节，无可见文字，无多余人物，无扭曲的手部或脚部。

templates.title: Greenhouse Cyber ​​Street Style Anime Girl

titleLocalized.zh: 温室赛博街头风动漫少女

templates.prompt: Create a vibrant full-body anime illustration for "Green Day," depicting a stylish young woman in a sun-drenched greenhouse, surrounded by lush tropical plants, hanging baskets, potted flowers, and shimmering green lights like fireflies. She stands playfully leaning against a tiled garden path, one hand reaching towards a wall of leaves. The image employs a dynamic wide-angle perspective, with the abundant foliage in the foreground outlining the scene. Her face is framed by a softly edged, opaque background.{argument name="face censor color" default="green"} A square blurry obscuring her features. She has a short bob haircut, and her hair color is {argument name="hair color" default="Yellow-green gradient with orange hair ends"} She wore iridescent crystal cat ears and delicate hair clips. Dressed her in cyberpunk streetwear: an oversized, shiny black jacket adorned with pixelated fluorescent green, magenta, white, and purple checkered patterns, layered over a black cropped top, paired with a black mini skirt, pink belt details, and a dangling zipper charm, finished with white slouch socks and chunky black sneakers with pink laces and fluorescent accents.{argument name="jacket pattern colors" default="Fluorescent green, magenta, white, and purple pixel checkerboard pattern"} The dominant pattern for the jacket is a greenhouse filled with strong, slanting sunlight streaming through the glass roof, warm backlighting, shimmering bokeh, saturated green tones, pink floral accents, and richly detailed foliage, presenting a refined, modern anime style with clean lines, bright colors, and a cheerful spring vibe.

promptLocalized.zh: 为“绿色日”创作一张充满活力的全身动漫插画，描绘一位时尚少女置身于阳光明媚的温室中，四周环绕着茂密的热带植物、吊篮、盆栽花卉以及如萤火虫般闪烁的绿色光点。她站在铺设瓷砖的园林小径上，姿态俏皮地微微倚靠，一只手伸向叶墙，画面采用极具张力的广角透视，前景中繁茂的叶片勾勒出场景轮廓。她的面部被一个柔边不透明的 {argument name="face censor color" default="绿色"} 方形模糊遮挡。她留着短波波头，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="黄绿色渐变配橙色发梢"}，佩戴着虹彩水晶猫耳配饰和精致发夹。为她穿上赛博街头风格服饰：一件超大款亮面黑色夹克，饰有像素化的荧光绿、洋红、白、紫棋盘格图案，内搭黑色短款上衣，配黑色迷你裙、粉色腰带细节、垂坠的拉链挂饰，穿着白色堆堆袜和带有粉色鞋带及荧光点缀的厚底黑色运动鞋。将 {argument name="jacket pattern colors" default="荧光绿、洋红、白、紫像素棋盘格"} 作为夹克的主导图案。温室应充满穿过玻璃屋顶的强烈斜向阳光、温暖的背光、闪烁的焦外成像效果、饱和的绿色调、粉色花卉点缀以及细节丰富的叶片，呈现出线条清晰、色彩明亮且充满春日欢快气息的精致现代动漫风格。

templates.title: Cozy nighttime snapshots in the living room

titleLocalized.zh: 温馨夜晚客厅抓拍

templates.prompt: Create a warm, realistic, candid 35mm film-style indoor snapshot, depicting a cozy yet slightly cluttered apartment living room at night. The main subject is {argument name="subject description" default="A young East Asian woman with messy short black hair and round-framed glasses"} She lay sprawled on the dark gray fabric sofa, her head turned forward at the right edge. One arm was bent behind her head, while the other stretched out naturally. Her eyes were closed or half-closed, her expression weary yet serene. She was wearing {argument name="top color" default="A soft blue sleeveless vest"} and{argument name="shorts color" default="Light gray drawstring lounge shorts"} Bare legs stretched out on the sofa, a wrinkled beige blanket wrapped around the waist, cushions beside her. The room should feel lived-in and private: magazines and papers piled on the chair and side table, bookshelves filled with books and records in the background, three black remote controls and a ceramic mug neatly arranged on the low wooden coffee table to the right, and a stack of blankets piled on the footstool or mat behind her. The scene should include three warm light sources: a floor lamp in the foreground to the left, a small table lamp on the central cabinet in the background, and another lamp illuminating the area next to the curtains in the background to the right.{argument name="lighting mood" default="Warm tungsten filament lamp night light"} The image features shallow depth of field, soft film grain, natural skin tones, slight motion blur, a realistic sense of clutter, and a non-posed, documentary-style composition that views the room from above the sofa. It avoids over-beautification, creating an ordinary and tranquil home evening atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张温暖、真实、抓拍风格的 35mm 胶片感室内快照，呈现夜晚温馨且略显杂乱的公寓客厅。主体为 {argument name="subject description" default="一位留着黑色凌乱短发、戴着圆框眼镜的年轻东亚女性"}，她头朝前右侧边缘，倒卧在深灰色布艺沙发上，一只手臂弯曲在脑后，另一只手臂自然向外舒展，双眼闭合或半闭，表情疲惫而宁静。她身穿 {argument name="top color" default="一件柔和的蓝色无袖背心"} 和 {argument name="shorts color" default="浅灰色抽绳居家短裤"}，赤裸的双腿沿沙发伸展，腰间围着一条褶皱的米色盖毯，身旁放着靠垫。房间应充满生活气息且私密：椅子和侧面桌面上堆放着杂志和纸张，背景书架上摆满了书籍和唱片，右侧的低矮木质咖啡桌上整齐地放着 3 个黑色遥控器和 1 个陶瓷马克杯，后方的脚凳或地垫上堆着一叠毯子。画面需包含 3 个温暖的光源：左前方的落地灯、后方中央柜子上的小台灯，以及右后方窗帘旁发光的另一盏灯。使用 {argument name="lighting mood" default="温暖的钨丝灯夜光"}，浅景深，柔和的胶片颗粒感，自然的肤色，轻微的动态模糊，真实的杂乱感，以及从沙发上方斜向俯瞰整个房间的非摆拍式纪实构图。避免过度美化，营造出普通而宁静的居家夜晚氛围。

She is a petite virtual idol with long, glowing hair.{argument name="hair color" default="Blue-green"} She has twin ponytails, her hair flowing out like semi-transparent ribbons, bright blue eyes, fair skin, and a confident, playful smile. She wears a shimmering black and gray cyberpunk idol outfit, including a sleeveless metallic corset, a short pleated skirt with glowing blue-green triangular panels, black over-the-knee boots, separate semi-transparent sleeves, futuristic arm armor, a headset microphone, and small, angular hair accessories. Her right hand extends towards the audience, a microphone cable dynamically swirling in the foreground. Surrounding her are intense blue and electric blue light trails, shimmering particles, lens flares, laser beams, and transparent holographic fabric shapes rotating around her body. The background is a packed stadium concert at night, with glowing light sticks, LED screens, stage trusses, spotlights, and bursts of stage lighting, predominantly blue with touches of magenta. It employs high-contrast, cinematic lighting, glossy stage floor reflections, deep black shadows, vibrant neon effects, sharp anime lines, highly detailed rendering, dynamic composition, and spectacular visuals.{argument name="mood" default="Near-future virtual idol live performances"} Atmosphere. promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张极具戏剧性的竖版动漫演唱会插画，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="初音未来"}，她站在巨大的未来感舞台上，采用极低视角拍摄，使她看起来高大且充满英雄气概。她是一位娇小的虚拟偶像，留着长长的发光 {argument name="hair color" default="青绿色"} 双马尾，发丝如半透明丝带般向外飘散，拥有明亮的青色双眸、白皙的皮肤以及自信俏皮的微笑。她身穿光泽感十足的黑灰色赛博偶像服装，包括无袖金属质感紧身胸衣、带有发光青绿色三角形镶板的短百褶裙、黑色过膝长靴、分离式半透明袖套、未来感手臂护甲、头戴式麦克风以及小型棱角分明的发饰。她的右手向观众伸出，一根麦克风线在前景中动态环绕。周围环绕着强烈的青色和电蓝色光轨、闪烁的粒子、镜头光晕、激光束以及围绕她身体旋转的透明全息织物形状。背景是挤满观众的夜间体育场演唱会，有发光的应援棒、LED 屏幕、舞台桁架、聚光灯以及青色为主、带有少量洋红色点缀的舞台灯光爆发。采用高对比度的电影级布光、舞台地面的光泽反射、深邃的黑色阴影、鲜艳的霓虹光效、锐利的动漫线条、高度精细的渲染、充满活力的构图，以及壮观的 {argument name="mood" default="近未来虚拟偶像现场演出"} 氛围。无文字，无水印。

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic, anime-style sci-fi action scene set in a dimly lit industrial facility corridor. Use a wide-angle composition, with the image divided by a concrete pillar: in the left foreground, a tense young woman {argument name="character name" default="Blonde Secret Agent"} Hiding behind the wall, she cautiously peeked out, her hands gripping a black semi-automatic pistol tightly and pointing it upwards; she kept {argument name="hair color" default="gold"} She wore a low ponytail with loose bangs, a black sleeveless cropped vest, and black tactical shorts, with sweat visible on her arms and shoulders. Her face was deliberately obscured by a flat, opaque beige square hood. In the mid-ground to the right of the corridor stood two uniformed security personnel: a brown-haired male officer pointed to a tablet in his hand, while a blond officer held a tablet; both wore dark blue futuristic combat uniforms with light blue piping, armored shoulders, and high black boots, their faces also obscured by matching opaque beige square hoods. The environment was a long underground military or research base corridor, with polished reflective concrete floors, raw concrete walls, exposed pipes on the ceiling, bright white fluorescent light strips, and blue luminous access panels. A heavy metal door stood to the right, the overall lighting a cool blue-gray. The atmosphere was secretive, suspenseful, and tactical, as if the woman were ambushing or monitoring the two guards. It adopts a highly detailed Japanese anime illustration style with sharp lines, realistic perspective, strong sense of depth, rich shadow atmosphere, and strong reflective gloss on the ground, giving it a cyberpunk military atmosphere. It uses a 16:9 widescreen composition and has no readable text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个电影级动漫风格的科幻动作场景，背景位于昏暗的工业设施走廊中。构图采用广角，画面被一根混凝土柱分隔：左侧前景中，一名紧张的年轻女性 {argument name="character name" default="金发秘密特工"} 躲在墙后，小心翼翼地探出身子，双手紧握一把黑色半自动手枪并向上指；她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="金色"} 的低马尾，留有松散的刘海，身穿黑色无袖短款背心和黑色战术短裤，手臂和肩膀上可见汗水。她的脸部被一个平面的不透明米色方形遮挡块刻意遮盖。走廊右侧的中景处站着两名身穿制服的安保人员：一名棕发男性警官正指向手中的平板电脑，另一名金发警官则拿着平板电脑；两人均身穿深蓝色未来感作战服，配有浅蓝色滚边、装甲肩部和高筒黑靴，他们的脸部同样被配套的不透明米色方形遮挡块遮盖。环境是一个长长的地下军事或研究基地走廊，地面为抛光反光混凝土，墙壁为原始混凝土，天花板上有裸露的管道，配有明亮的白色荧光灯带、蓝色发光的接入面板，右侧有一扇厚重的金属门，整体光效为冷蓝灰色。氛围隐秘、悬疑且充满战术感，仿佛该女子正在伏击或监视这两名守卫。采用高细节的日本动漫插画风格，线条锐利，透视真实，景深感强烈，阴影氛围浓厚，地面反光光泽感强，具有赛博朋克军事氛围，采用 16:9 宽屏构图，无任何可读文字。

templates.title: Holographic Hatsune Miku Cyber ​​Concert

templates.prompt: Create a 9:16 vertical cyberpunk anime concert poster, showing the image.{argument name="character name" default="Hatsune Miku"} Performing as a giant, semi-transparent hologram above a crowded, futuristic arena. She has extremely long, glowing turquoise twin tails that flow like wide ribbons in the composition; she is slender, wearing a sleeveless, greyish-blue futuristic vest, a turquoise tie, a black pleated miniskirt with turquoise trim, dark knee-high stockings, arm warmers, headphones, and glowing high heels. Shot from a dramatic low angle, she stands with her legs apart on a circular holographic stage, one hand holding a microphone close to her mouth, the other arm outstretched towards the audience; a softly pixelated square occlusion/blur block is placed in the center of her face, as in the generated preview. Intense turquoise, aquamarine, and electric blue lighting is used, along with volumetric beams of light shooting upwards from the stage, transparent polygonal ribbons, scan lines, holographic grid patterns, floating triangle icons, particle sparks, and glowing hair. Below, the arena is filled with the silhouettes of the audience's hands and numerous blue glow sticks, against a backdrop of dark, skyscraper-like trusses and LED rings. Includes four clearly visible text/UI blocks: a vertical row of glowing Japanese slogans on the left.{argument name="left vertical slogan" default="Connecting feelings, let them resonate into the future."} Vertical illuminated Japanese slogans on the right{argument name="right vertical slogan" default="I hope this song reaches your heart..."} The bottom left corner features a cyan holographic song information panel (containing 4 lines of content): "♪{argument name="song title" default="Universe Beat"} "// Temp: 128BPM", "// Key: G#m", and "// Mode: Lydian"), as well as the cyan holographic activity panel in the lower right corner (titled as{argument name="event title" default="ECHO×LINK"} Below, it is labeled "VIRTUAL LIVE" and "2045," and features a small equalizer bar and tiny technical symbols. promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张柔和且高细节的动漫插画，描绘一位可爱的年轻女性在阳光明媚的日子坐在户外咖啡馆，采用略微俯视的角度进行上半身特写。她的面部被一个居中的纯色方形马赛克有意遮挡，马赛克颜色为温暖的桃肤色，遮住了眼睛、鼻子和嘴巴，但保留了头发、耳朵、脖子、服装和冰淇淋的可见度。她拥有非常飘逸的 {argument name="hair color" default="浅蜜金色"} 长发，发丝细腻，带有凌乱的刘海、光泽感高光和温暖的背光。她穿着女性化的春季服装：米白色开衫内搭白色荷叶边衬衫，衬衫上有细小的淡色花卉刺绣，并有一条细棕色肩带斜跨。她的一只手拿着一个香草软冰淇淋蛋筒靠近嘴边；蛋筒带有粉色纸套，上面印有英文“ice cream”。在柔和模糊的背景中，包含一家人行道咖啡馆或甜点店橱窗、右侧一盆绿叶盆栽、木质长椅或栏杆元素，以及左侧 1 个立式菜单牌，上面显示日文“ミルク バニラ”和价格“¥350”，并配有小巧的香草冰淇淋插图。使用柔和的色调、细腻的线条、明亮的金色阳光、柔和的焦外成像、柔和的阴影、浅景深以及温馨浪漫的日常番氛围。竖构图，精致的现代动漫风格，高度细腻的头发和服装纹理，画面中没有其他人、没有额外的招牌、没有水印。

He has messy hair {argument name="hair color" default="Grayish brown"} Long hair, combed back, topped with two dark, forked, antler-like dragon horns, revealing a pointed ear adorned with a small earring. A long, golden, scaled dragon tail coiled around his left side. Four large, serrated, purple, fin-like scales with a net-like pattern were added to the back of his head and neck, while golden scale patches graced his shoulders, collarbone, chest, and forearms. His torso was muscular, with defined abs, and a bare chest with warm, cel-shaded highlights. He was dressed in a vibrant robe wrapped around his waist and arms.{argument name="robe colors" default="Orange and magenta"} The fabric features gold floral embroidery in the lower left corner, with loose sleeves flowing around the instrument. The instrument, positioned vertically on the right side of the composition, boasts a black body and neck, gold fittings, clear frets and strings, a decorative headstock, and dark, tassel-like horizontal ropes near the top. The piece employs an elegant Japanese fantasy character art style, with clean, crisp lines, soft, painterly cel shadows, warm gold accents, highly detailed scales and hair, a light gray-white background, and a close-up composition from the thighs to the head. The atmosphere is dramatic yet serene, with no text or watermark.

templates.title: Portrait of the melancholy Lin Daiyu

titleLocalized.zh: 忧郁林黛玉肖像

templates.prompt: Create a melancholic portrait with a cinematic quality, featuring [the subject].{argument name="character name" default="Lin Daiyu"} (One of the female protagonists in *Dream of the Red Chamber*), she sits regally in an antique-style Chinese study. She is a delicate noblewoman, dressed in a pale blue, semi-transparent Hanfu, with layers of sheer fabric at the cuffs and delicate embroidery on the collar, over which lies a soft white robe. Her long, black hair is styled into an elegant, loose bun, with a few strands adorned with small flower hairpins, silver tassels, and a turquoise bead. Her posture is serene and profound; one hand gently supports her chin, the other rests on a dark wooden table, and a handwritten book lies open beside her. A large, medium-gray square obscures the center of her face, concealing her features. The room is dimly lit and atmospheric, with cool blue light streaming in from the left window, accompanied by soft mist and a shallow depth of field; the background features dark wooden furniture and blurred hanging calligraphy scrolls, while the foreground displays antique objects, including a stack of old books, a small, bluish-green ceramic jar, and a corner of a wooden birdcage or shelf. Add a large, vertical, off-white Chinese calligraphy piece in the upper left corner, with the following content:{argument name="calligraphy text" default="Lin Daiyu"} Below it is a red stamp, the contents of which are also {argument name="seal text" default="Lin Daiyu"} The style should be realistic, like that of Chinese period drama photography, melancholic, elegant, and poetic, with high detail, a soft film grain texture, and a cool, desaturated bluish-gray tone, in a 2:3 vertical composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影质感的忧郁肖像，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="林黛玉"}（《红楼梦》女主角之一），她正端坐在古色古香的中国书房内。她是一位娇弱的贵族少女，身着淡蓝色半透明汉服，袖口层叠轻纱，领口绣有精致花纹，内搭柔软的白色长袍。她乌黑的长发梳成优雅的松散发髻，几缕发丝垂落，点缀着小巧的花朵发簪、银质流苏饰品和一颗绿松石珠。她姿态静谧且深沉，一只手轻托下颌，另一只手放在深色木桌上，身旁摊开着一本手写书。一张巨大的中灰色方形色块遮住了她的面部中心，掩盖了五官。室内光线昏暗且充满氛围感，左侧透入冷调的蓝色窗光，伴有柔和的雾气和浅景深效果；背景是深色木质家具和模糊的悬挂书法卷轴，前景摆放着古董物件，包括一叠旧书、一个小巧的青绿色陶瓷罐，以及木制鸟笼或架子的一角。在左上方添加大型竖排米白色中国毛笔书法，内容为 {argument name="calligraphy text" default="林黛玉"}，下方盖有一枚红色印章，内容同样为 {argument name="seal text" default="林黛玉"}。风格应为写实的中国古装剧摄影，忧郁、优雅、诗意，高细节，带有柔和的胶片颗粒感，采用冷调去饱和的青灰色调，竖构图 2:3。

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic, documentary-style street photography piece, the content of which is {argument name="location and era" default="Akihabara, Tokyo in the 1990s"} The shot, taken at eye level, is taken at dusk or twilight in a narrow electronics shopping street. There are approximately 30 pedestrians in the scene, mostly adult men dressed in 1990s casual wear such as denim jackets, plaid sweaters, light-wash jeans, bomber jackets, business suits, shoulder bags, and shopping bags; their faces are soft, blurred, or have a motion blur reminiscent of old television snapshots. The street is crowded but not chaotic; some people are standing, some are browsing, some are walking with their backs to the camera, and some are gathered near the shops. Tall commercial buildings line both sides of the street, covered with dense Japanese electronics store signs, including large vertical and horizontal signs with recognizable fragments, such as {argument name="main sign text" default="オノデン"} ,{argument name="store brand text" default="Panasonic"} The store features signs with "FAN," "BEST," and other katakana characters. To the left is a prominent blue-yellow electronics store awning, while to the right are orange-blue awnings, shelves, posters, and boxed goods displayed at the entrance. Overhead, power lines crisscross between the mid-rise buildings, reflecting a bright, whitish sky. The aesthetic is reminiscent of 1990s Japanese consumer-grade cameras or VHS broadcast aesthetics: 4:3 aspect ratio, slightly lower resolution, the softness of interlaced scanning, soft colors, slight film grain, overexposed highlights in the sky, subtle barrel distortion, and a natural sense of crowding, devoid of modern smartphones, LED billboards, contemporary fashion elements, or futuristic elements.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张照片级写实的纪录片风格街拍，内容为 {argument name="location and era" default="20 世纪 90 年代的东京秋叶原"}，视角为平视，拍摄于黄昏或傍晚时分狭窄的电子产品购物街。场景中约有 30 名行人，多为穿着 20 世纪 90 年代休闲服饰的成年男性，如牛仔夹克、格纹毛衣、浅色水洗牛仔裤、飞行员夹克、商务西装、单肩包和购物袋；面部柔和、模糊或带有类似旧电视抓拍的动态模糊感。街道拥挤但不混乱，人们有的站立、有的浏览、有的背对镜头行走、有的聚集在店面附近。街道两侧林立着高大的商业建筑，覆盖着密集的日本电子商店招牌，包括大型竖排和横排标志，上面有可辨认的片段，如 {argument name="main sign text" default="オノデン"}、{argument name="store brand text" default="Panasonic"}、“FAN”、“BEST” 以及其他片假名商店招牌。左侧有一个显眼的蓝黄色电子商店雨棚，右侧则有橙蓝色遮阳篷、货架、海报以及陈列在入口处的盒装商品。头顶上方的电线在中层建筑之间交错，映衬着明亮而泛白的天空。采用 20 世纪 90 年代日本消费级摄像机或 VHS 广播美学：4:3 画幅、略低的解析度、交错扫描的柔和感、柔和的色彩、轻微的胶片颗粒感、天空处过曝的高光、细微的桶形畸变、自然的拥挤感，且不包含现代智能手机、LED 广告牌、当代时尚元素或未来主义元素。

templates.title: Friends with umbrellas after school in the rain

titleLocalized.zh: 雨后放学撑伞的友人

templates.prompt: Create a delicate anime-style illustration depicting two Japanese high school girls walking home through a wet suburban street after school on a rainy day. They stand side by side under a large, transparent plastic umbrella covered in raindrops, the umbrella dominating the upper half of the composition, with the metal ribs and black central axis clearly visible. The image is vertically composed, using a waist-to-thigh framing, soft cinematic backlighting, puddles reflected on the road, a light drizzle, telephone poles stretching into the distance, metal railings along the sidewalk, houses and greenery on either side, and purple hydrangeas blooming on the right. The girl on the left is shorter and has {argument name="left girl hair color" default="Chestnut brown short bob haircut"} The girl on the right wore a large red bow in her hair, a navy blue school uniform with gold buttons, a white shirt, a red plaid bow tie, and a dark pleated plaid skirt. She carried a large navy blue backpack with a cute little plush toy hanging from it. One hand gripped the backpack strap, while the other gently touched or held the umbrella handle; she looked shy and stayed close to her friend. The girl on the right was taller and had {argument name="right girl hair color" default="Long lavender purple hair"} She wore a blue flower hair clip behind her ear, a navy blue school uniform with gold buttons, a white shirt, a blue plaid bow tie, and a dark pleated plaid skirt, with a large navy blue backpack slung over her shoulder. She held the umbrella handle firmly in the center, standing protectively beside the shorter girl. The faces of both girls were deliberately obscured by softly edged, skin-toned rectangular blurs, concealing all facial features. The emphasis is on the details of wet clothing, the shimmering raindrops, the delicate strands of hair dampened by the rain, the realistic transparency of the umbrella, the sparkling water droplets, and the gentle, tranquil atmosphere of friendship after school. High-detail anime rendering, natural proportions, soft depth of field, a cool blue-gray rainy-day tone paired with warm skin tones, and no visible text in the image.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张精致的动漫风格插画，描绘两名日本女高中生在放学后的雨天，走在湿漉漉的郊区街道上回家的场景。她们紧挨着站在一把覆盖着雨滴的大号透明塑料雨伞下，伞面占据了构图的上半部分，清晰可见金属伞骨和黑色的中轴。画面为竖构图，采用腰部到大腿的取景，柔和的电影级背光，路面上映出水洼，细雨蒙蒙，电线杆向远处延伸，人行道旁设有金属护栏，两侧是住宅和绿植，右侧盛开着紫色绣球花。左侧的女孩个子较矮，留着 {argument name="left girl hair color" default="栗棕色短波波头"}，侧面戴着一个红色大蝴蝶结发饰，身穿带有金色纽扣的海军蓝西装校服、白色衬衫、红色格子领结、深色百褶格子裙，肩上背着一个海军蓝大书包，上面挂着一个可爱的小毛绒挂件。她一只手抓着书包带，另一只手轻轻触碰或扶着伞柄处，神情羞涩，紧贴着她的朋友。右侧的女孩个子较高，留着 {argument name="right girl hair color" default="长款薰衣草紫发"}，耳边别着一个蓝色花朵发夹，身穿带有金色纽扣的海军蓝西装校服、白色衬衫、蓝色格子领结、深色百褶格子裙，肩上背着一个海军蓝大书包。她稳稳地握住伞柄中心，保护性地站在较矮女孩的身旁。两名女孩的面部特意用柔和边缘的肤色矩形模糊块遮盖，隐藏了所有面部特征。强调湿润衣物的细节、雨水的亮光、被雨水打湿的细腻发丝、写实的雨伞透明度、闪烁的水滴，以及雨后放学友谊中那种温柔宁静的氛围。采用高细节动漫渲染，自然比例，柔和的景深，冷蓝灰色雨天色调搭配暖色肤色，画面中无任何可见文字。

templates.title: Japanese reading instruction infographic

titleLocalized.zh: 日语阅读教学信息图

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 and REFERENCE_1 as the source of messy handwritten study notes, their content was transformed into concise vertical Japanese teaching infographics for quick sharing with teachers. The core themes of narrative text reading curriculum design were retained, but the content was organized visually rather than simply copying the note pages. A sophisticated white background layout was created, featuring navy blue chapter titles, rounded cards, simple flat icons, arrows, checkmarks, and color-coded boxes. A main heading was added.{argument name="headline text" default="Designing lessons to foster reading skills"} and subtitle{argument name="subtitle text" default="~A class that deepens interpretation by using descriptions as a basis and starting from discrepancies~"} The infographic is divided into seven numbered sections and a final summary column: 1) Basic course structure, divided into four steps: facts (description) → explanation → meaning → personal expression; 2) Three stages of learning depth, labeled as: low: superficial understanding, medium: interpretation formation, high: meaning reconstruction; 3) Question design, including the conditions for good questions, question process, and specific example prompts; 4) Key points for improving dialogue quality, including two comparison cards: NG (inadequate) and target dialogue, and keyword tags: comparison, association, reinterpretation; 5) The most important role of the teacher, focusing on making "zre" (cognitive bias/difference) visible, including cards for specific actions and NG actions; 6) Assessment and observation, including two cards: observation points and methods; 7) The meta-perspective of curriculum improvement is presented as five interconnected cards: connection to the previous material, enhancing language sensitivity, utilizing the initial "zure," creating "shared consensus," and reviewing learning. This concludes with a striking summary statement.{argument name="summary statement" default="A lesson that deepens interpretation by using descriptions as a basis and starting from discrepancies."} This concludes with a three-point checklist: reading based on evidence, expanding thinking through dialogue, and giving meaning in your own words. The goal is to make the final result resemble professionally designed Japanese teaching materials, rather than just a photograph of notes.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 和 REFERENCE_1 作为杂乱的手写学习笔记来源，将其内容转换为简洁的垂直日语教学信息图，方便与教师快速分享。保留关于叙事文本阅读课程设计的核心主题，但以视觉化方式组织内容，而非简单复制笔记页面。创建一个精致的白色背景布局，搭配海军蓝章节标题、圆角卡片、简洁的扁平化图标、箭头、复选标记和颜色编码框。添加主标题 {argument name="headline text" default="読む力を育てる授業デザイン"} 和副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="〜描写を根拠に、ズレを起点として、解釈を深める授業〜"}。将信息图分为 7 个编号部分以及一个最终总结栏：1) 课程基本结构，分为四个步骤：事实（描写）→ 解釈 → 意味づけ → 自分の言葉；2) 学习深度的三个阶段，标注为：低：表面的理解，中：解释的形成，高：意义的重构；3) 问题设计，包含好问题的条件、问题流程及具体示例提示；4) 提升对话质量的要点，包含两张对比卡片：NG（不佳）和 目指す対話（目标对话），以及关键词标签：比较、关联、再解释；5) 教师最重要的角色，重点在于让“ズレ”（认知偏差/差异）可视化，包含具体行动和 NG 行动的卡片；6) 评估与观察，包含两张卡片：見るポイント（观察要点）和 方法；7) 课程改进的元视角，展示为五个相连的卡片：与前一教材的连接、提高对语言的敏感度、利用最初的“ズレ”、创造“共识的共享”、回顾学习。最后以醒目的总结陈述 {argument name="summary statement" default="描写を根拠に、ズレを起点として、解釈を深める授業"} 和三项检查清单结束：基于根据进行阅读、通过对话扩展思维、用自己的语言赋予意义。使最终结果看起来像专业设计的日语教学讲义，而非笔记照片。

templates.prompt: Create a bright, flat-colored, anime-style social media celebration poster. It should have no visible lines, use soft pastel tones, and achieve a clean graphic texture similar to a Kindle cover. The main subject is a cheerful young anime girl wearing a flowing pink kimono, positioned on the left side of the image and dynamically cropped, with long, wavy hair flowing in the wind.{argument name="hair color" default="pink"} Her face was obscured by a solid light pink square. She extended one hand from the upper left to greet the audience, while her other hand was happily clasped to her chest. She wore a light cherry blossom pink kimono with wide sleeves, small white cherry blossom patterns, a bright blue obi with gold cross-stitching, a yellow bow, and a thin red cord tied at the waist. To the right was a large, soft white circular text area displaying a celebratory message: elegant green handwriting.{argument name="headline text" default="Thank you!"} Huge coral pink numbers{argument name="milestone number" default="1400"} And striking coral-colored Japanese text{argument name="Japanese message" default="Thank you to all my followers!"} The characters and text are adorned with abundant spring greenery: crisp lime-green leaves, white cherry blossoms, scattered pink petals, yellow-green confetti, and soft bokeh lighting. A vibrant color palette of pink, coral, lime green, white, turquoise, and sky blue creates a joyful holiday atmosphere, while the composition employs dynamic diagonal lines, soft floodlighting, and a 4:3 aspect ratio.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张明亮、扁平色彩的动漫风格社交媒体庆祝海报，要求无可见线条，采用柔和的粉彩色调，呈现类似 Kindle 封面般干净的图形质感。主体是一位开朗的年轻动漫少女，身着飘逸的粉色和服，位于画面中左侧并进行动态裁剪，留着一头随风飘动的长卷发 {argument name="hair color" default="粉色"}；她的脸部被一个实心浅粉色方块遮挡。她从左上方伸出一只手向观众致意，另一只手开心地握在胸前。她身穿浅樱粉色和服，配有宽袖、白色小樱花图案、带有金色交叉纹路的亮蓝色腰带、黄色蝴蝶结，腰间系着一根细红绳。在右侧放置一个巨大的柔和白色圆形文本区域，用于展示庆祝信息：优雅的绿色手写体 {argument name="headline text" default="Thank you!"}、巨大的珊瑚粉色数字 {argument name="milestone number" default="1400"} 以及醒目的珊瑚色日语文本 {argument name="Japanese message" default="フォロワー 人感謝！"}。在角色和文字周围点缀丰富的春季植物：清新的青柠色叶片、白色樱花、散落的粉色花瓣、黄绿色纸屑以及柔和的散景光效。采用粉色、珊瑚色、青柠绿、白色、绿松石色和天蓝色的鲜艳配色，营造出欢乐的节日氛围，构图采用对角线动态、柔和的泛光照明以及 4:3 横向比例。

templates.prompt: Create a vibrant full-body anime character illustration, the main character is {argument name="character name" default="Neo Alice"} A video world girl inspired by Alice in Wonderland, using bright cyan, white, and gold tones. She is a blonde girl with extremely long, flowing hair, sparkling blue eyes with star-shaped highlights, a radiant smile, a huge dark blue bow in her hair, tall white rabbit ears, and a small blue X-shaped hair clip. She extends one hand to the audience in an inviting gesture and takes a step forward, wearing a white dress with light blue trim and black spade symbols on the hem, a light blue flared cape-like coat with a dark blue ribbon bow at the collar and dark blue cuffs, white lace-up sneakers, and a gold pocket watch pendant with a blue play button icon on the dial. The background is a fantastical digital wonderland: three playing cards are visible, including the Ace of Spades on the left, the Ace of Hearts near the top right, and a card with a blue pixel/tree symbol near the bottom left; a giant circular clock is in the upper left; three curled blue films surround the scene; an arched portal on the right reveals a silhouette of a white castle and a checkerboard path; many blue, white, and yellow square pixels and glittering shapes float around. The ground uses a dynamic blue and white checkerboard perspective, embellished with abstract video frame patterns, pixel blocks, and geometric shapes. Clean, glossy anime lines, soft cel-shaded shadows, vibrant composition, high-key lighting, and clear details create a playful magical atmosphere; the vertical poster format centers the characters and slightly tilts them to emphasize dynamism. The main color scheme uses {argument name="main color palette" default="Sky blue, white, navy blue, and gold"} The atmosphere is set as{argument name="mood" default="Bright, fantastical and vibrant"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张充满活力的全身动漫角色插画，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="Neo Alice"}，一位灵感源自《爱丽丝梦游仙境》的视频世界少女，采用明亮的青色、白色和金色调。她是一位金发少女，留着极长的飘逸秀发，闪烁的蓝色双眸中带有星形高光，笑容灿烂，头上戴着巨大的深蓝色蝴蝶结，长着高耸的白色兔耳，并别着一个蓝色的小 X 型发夹。她一只手伸向观众，做出邀请的姿势并向前迈步，身穿带有淡蓝色饰边的白色连衣裙，裙摆上有黑色的黑桃标志，外搭淡蓝色喇叭形斗篷式外套，领口系着深蓝色丝带蝴蝶结，袖口为深蓝色，脚穿白色系带运动鞋，佩戴着一枚金色的怀表吊坠，表盘内是一个蓝色的播放按钮图标。背景是奇幻的数字仙境：画面中可见 3 张扑克牌，包括左侧的黑桃 A、右上角附近的红桃 A，以及左下角附近带有蓝色像素/树木符号的卡牌；左上方有 1 个巨大的圆形时钟；3 条卷曲的蓝色胶片环绕在场景周围；右侧有 1 个拱形传送门，展示着白色城堡剪影和棋盘格小径；周围漂浮着许多蓝色、白色和黄色的方形像素与闪光形状。地面采用动态的蓝白棋盘格透视，点缀着抽象的视频帧图案、像素块和几何形状。采用干净、光泽的动漫线条，柔和的赛璐珞阴影，充满活力的构图，高调照明，细节清晰，营造出俏皮的魔法氛围；采用竖版海报格式，角色居中并略微倾斜以体现动感。主色调使用 {argument name="main color palette" default="天蓝色、白色、海军蓝和金色"}，氛围设定为 {argument name="mood" default="明亮、奇幻且充满活力"}。

templates.prompt: Create a simple, square, anime-style profile picture of a stylish young man, cropped from above his chest to above his hairline, centered on a pure white background. He has messy, layered hair.{argument name="hair color" default="warm gold"} The hair features a dark, outlined shape, with volume at the crown and messy strands on the sides, exhibiting a slight undercut around the ears. The face is deliberately obscured by an opaque square block of color in the center.{argument name="face block color" default="warm beige"} The eyes, nose, mouth, and most of the cheeks are covered, revealing only the hair, ears, neck, collarbone, and collar. Multiple gold earrings adorn both ears, including a combination of small hoops and studs, with a single gold pendant earring featuring a green rhombus gemstone on the observer's right side. templates.title: Magical Girl AI Music Thumbnail

titleLocalized.zh: 魔法少女 AI 音乐缩略图

templates.prompt: for{argument name="brand name" default="Sousaku AI"} Create a bright, highly saturated anime YouTube-style promotional thumbnail with a magical girl music theme. Two adorable brown-haired magical girls sit side-by-side in the center of the image, both smiling with their eyes closed, sharing a pair of wired headphones and listening to music playing from a smartphone placed between them; the phone screen displays a color equalizer with playback controls. The girl on the left wears a yellow and white ruffled magical girl dress, adorned with small wings, star decorations, a yellow bow, and a miniature banana-shaped crown, hinting at a banana-themed variant; the girl on the right wears a pink and white ruffled magical girl dress, adorned with a blue ribbon twin-tail bow, a star brooch, white gloves, and soft angel wings. Use a glossy, idol-anime rendering style, ensuring large, sparkling eyes even with closed eyes, complemented by soft blush, delicate ruffles, ribbons, and subtle highlights. The background features an explosive rainbow concert fantasy design, filled with neon gradients, flashes, starbursts, glowing musical staves, and three main sets of music-themed icons: oversized musical notes scattered throughout the image, a grand treble clef on the left, and speaker/headphone graphics on either side. Colorful waveforms and equalizer bars extend horizontally behind the character, with a row of piano keys along the lower left edge. Four clearly visible text elements are included: a large Japanese title at the top.{argument name="headline text" default="♪AI-generated music♪"} It features a thick white border, a dark shadow, and a gradient fill from pink to yellow to blue; a small handwritten Japanese slogan is located near the bottom left corner.{argument name="tagline text" default="Enter the world of music♪"} The large curved ribbon at the bottom is the title.{argument name="bottom title" default="Sousaku AI"} ; and the circular white logo badge in the upper right corner.{argument name="logo text" default="Sousaku.AI"} It features a small red origami bird icon. The composition is adapted to a 16:9 thumbnail, creating a strong visual impact with high contrast, dense kawaii visual effects, and an ad atmosphere generated by celebratory music. The layout is clear and easy to read, with no white space.

promptLocalized.zh: 为 {argument name="brand name" default="Sousaku AI"} 创建一张明亮、超高饱和度的动漫 YouTube 风格宣传缩略图，采用魔法少女音乐主题。画面中心并排坐着 2 名可爱的棕发魔法少女，两人都闭着眼睛微笑，共享一副有线耳机，聆听放在她们中间的 1 部智能手机播放的音乐；手机屏幕显示着带有播放控制的彩色均衡器。左侧少女身穿黄白相间的荷叶边魔法少女裙，配有小翅膀装饰、星星装饰、黄色蝴蝶结以及一个微型香蕉形状的皇冠配饰，暗示其为香蕉主题变体；右侧少女身穿粉白相间的荷叶边魔法少女裙，配有蓝色丝带双马尾蝴蝶结、星星胸针、白色手套和柔软的天使翅膀装饰。采用光泽感偶像动漫渲染风格，即使闭眼也要呈现大而闪亮的眼睛风格，配以柔和的腮红、精致的荷叶边、丝带和细腻的高光。背景为爆炸性的彩虹音乐会幻想设计，充满霓虹渐变、闪光、星芒、发光的五线谱，以及 3 组主要的音乐主题图标：散布在画面中的超大音符、左侧的一个大高音谱号，以及两侧的扬声器/耳机图形。在角色身后水平延伸出彩色的波形和均衡器条，左下边缘配有一排钢琴键盘。包含 4 个清晰可见的文字元素：顶部巨大的日语标题 {argument name="headline text" default="♪AI楽曲生成♪"}，带有粗白边、深色投影以及粉色到黄色再到蓝色的渐变填充；左下角附近的一句小型手写风格日语标语 {argument name="tagline text" default="音楽の世界へ♪"}；底部巨大的弧形丝带标题 {argument name="bottom title" default="Sousaku AI"}；以及右上角圆形的白色 Logo 徽章 {argument name="logo text" default="Sousaku.AI"}，配有一个红色的小型折纸鸟图标。构图适配 16:9 缩略图，极具视觉冲击力，高对比度，密集的卡哇伊视觉特效，营造庆祝音乐生成的广告氛围，排版清晰易读，无留白区域。
