templates.prompt: Create a richly detailed anime-style fantasy illustration depicting a tea party in Alice in Wonderland held in a sunny Victorian glasshouse. At the center of the scene sits {argument name="main character" default="Alice"} She sat in a luxurious turquoise tufted armchair, wearing a classic light blue puff-sleeved dress, paired with a white apron and a black headband, her hair flowing freely.{argument name="hair color" default="gold"} Long hair; her face was covered by a flat, beige square veil. She held two teacups, one to her lips, the other on a tray in her other hand. Surrounding her were three fairy companions: to her left, a white rabbit dressed in a dark blue tailcoat, gold waistcoat, red bow tie, white gloves, and carrying a pocket watch; above her floating in mid-air a grinning grey striped Cheshire Cat with bright blue eyes and a curled tail; to her right, the Mad Hatter, wearing a dark green coat, bow tie, gloves, and a tall black top hat, on which was written…{argument name="hat card text" default="10/6"} The playing cards, his face similarly covered by a flat, beige square obscuring block. The table in the foreground is laden with exquisite afternoon tea: three large floral porcelain teapots or covered pots, five visible teacups and trays, two tiered dessert stands, and various cakes, tarts, cookies, macarons, and berries arranged on ornate plates. The background utilizes lush roses, ivy, antique clocks, gold accents, porcelain patterns, and soft bokeh details. Through the tall windows behind them, a bright fairytale garden and distant, fantastical castle towers against a blue sky can be seen. The warm, shimmering, and painterly light showcases the incredibly fine textures of fabrics, furs, porcelain, pastries, and flowers, employing a refined Japanese anime illustration style to create a cinematic composition and a highly fantastical atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅细节丰富的动漫风格奇幻插画，描绘在阳光明媚的维多利亚式玻璃温室中举行的爱丽丝梦游仙境茶会。场景中心坐着 {argument name="main character" default="爱丽丝"}，她坐在华丽的绿松石色簇绒扶手椅上，身穿经典的浅蓝色泡泡袖连衣裙，搭配白色围裙和黑色发带，留着一头飘逸的 {argument name="hair color" default="金色"} 长发；她的脸部被一个平面的米色方形遮挡块覆盖。她手里拿着 2 个茶杯，一个举在嘴边，另一个放在另一只手的托盘上。在她周围环绕着 3 位仙境伙伴：左侧是一只穿着深蓝色燕尾服、金色马甲、红色领结、戴着白手套并拿着怀表的白兔；上方半空中漂浮着一只咧嘴笑的灰色条纹柴郡猫，有着明亮的青色眼睛和卷曲的尾巴；右侧是疯帽子，身穿深绿色外套，系着领结，戴着手套和高高的黑色礼帽，帽上可见一张写着 {argument name="hat card text" default="10/6"} 的纸牌，他的脸部同样被一个平面的米色方形遮挡块覆盖。前景的桌子上摆满了精致的下午茶：3 个大型花卉瓷茶壶或带盖壶，5 个可见的茶杯和托盘，2 个多层甜点架，以及摆放在华丽盘子里的各种蛋糕、蛋挞、饼干、马卡龙和浆果。背景中运用了茂盛的玫瑰、常春藤、古董钟、金色装饰、瓷器花纹和柔和的焦外成像细节。透过他们身后的高大窗户，可以看到明亮的童话花园和蓝天下遥远而奇幻的城堡塔楼。光线温暖、闪烁且富有绘画感，展现出超细腻的织物、皮毛、瓷器、糕点和花卉质感，采用精致的日本动漫插画风格，呈现电影般的构图和高奇幻氛围。

templates.title: Anime Couple Under the Meteor

titleLocalized.zh: 流星下的动漫情侣

templates.prompt: Create a vertical anime-style romantic night scene illustration, in which {argument name="couple description" default="A young couple"} They sat side-by-side on the hood of a black, shiny sedan in a seaside parking lot. The tall man sat slightly to the left in the back, wearing a light gray denim jacket over a white hoodie, blue jeans, and casual sneakers; he had chin-length light blue-silver hair with faint red tips. The woman sat in front of him, wearing a white cropped denim jacket over a black top, slim-fit light blue jeans, white sneakers, and small earrings; she had long, wavy, burgundy hair with orange-red tips, styled in a crown braid. Their bodies were close together; he gently embraced her, their hands clasped tightly, their posture intimate, both looking up at the sky. Please use a soft square privacy blur/mosaic to obscure their faces. The background is a deep blue starry sky and sea, with streaks of light streaking across the sky.{argument name="sky feature" default="A bright meteor with a long, luminous tail."} The horizon shimmers with light, dotted with wispy clouds, and road markings are visible on the parking lot floor. Employing a refined, high-detail Japanese anime rendering style, cinematic lighting, and cool blue tones, the car body features soft highlights, creating a delicate and romantic atmosphere. The clean lines and composition make it suitable as a smartphone wallpaper.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖屏动漫风格的浪漫夜景插画，画面中 {argument name="couple description" default="一对年轻情侣"} 并肩坐在海边观景停车场的黑色亮面轿车引擎盖上。高个子的男性坐在后方略偏左侧，身穿浅灰色牛仔夹克，内搭白色连帽衫，下身穿蓝色牛仔裤和休闲运动鞋；他留着齐下巴长度的淡蓝银色头发，发梢带有淡淡的红色。女性坐在他前方，身穿白色短款牛仔夹克，内搭黑色上衣，下身穿修身浅蓝色牛仔裤，脚踩白色运动鞋，佩戴小巧耳环；她留着波浪长卷发，发色为酒红紫色，发梢呈橙红色，并编有冠状发辫。两人身体紧贴，他温柔地环抱着她，双手紧握，姿态亲昵，两人一同抬头仰望。请用柔和的方形隐私模糊/马赛克遮挡住两人的面部。背景是深蓝色的星空与大海，天空中划过 {argument name="sky feature" default="一颗带有长长发光尾迹的明亮流星"}，地平线上波光粼粼，点缀着淡淡的云彩，停车场地面可见道路标线。采用精致的高细节日本动漫渲染风格，电影级光影，冷蓝色调，车身带有柔和的高光，营造细腻的浪漫氛围，线条清晰，构图适合作为智能手机壁纸。

templates.title: Anime-style rooftop stargazing couple

templates.prompt: Create a vertical anime-style night scene illustration, in which {argument name="number of characters" default="Two"} Young people sat barefoot, side by side, on the deep blue tiled roof of a traditional Japanese house, their faces veiled by soft, square, blurred masks. The taller character on the left possessed {argument name="left character hair color" default="Light ice-blue hair with a red highlight on the inside."} Wearing loose, light blue pajamas with white piping and a small anchor badge on the chest pocket, she kneels on one knee, one arm casually placed, protectively embracing another character. The shorter character on the right possesses {argument name="right character hair color" default="Her hair was reddish-purple, gradually turning orange at the ends, and she wore it in a side ponytail, accessorized with a blue hair tie and a small yellow hair clip."} The character, dressed in cream-colored plaid pajamas with brownish-red hues, clasps her hands together in front of her chest as if making a wish, and leans gently towards the character on her left. The image should depict two bright shooting stars streaking diagonally from the upper left towards the center, leaving blue and purple trails in the star-studded night sky. The background depicts a calm moonlit ocean with its shimmering reflections, distant hills, and a tranquil coastal town, where rooftops and windows emitting warm light are visible. The composition uses a slightly overhead rooftop perspective, with the eaves and wooden walls of houses in the upper right corner. It employs delicate cel animation lines, glowing highlights, a romantic and tranquil atmosphere, and a deep navy blue night, with clear details, presented as a vertical wallpaper composition suitable for smartphones.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖屏动漫风格的夜景插画，画面中 {argument name="number of characters" default="两名"} 年轻人赤脚并肩坐在传统日式房屋深蓝色的瓦片屋顶上，他们的面部被柔和的方形模糊遮罩覆盖。左侧较高的角色拥有 {argument name="left character hair color" default="淡冰蓝色头发，内侧有一缕红色挑染"}，身穿带有白色滚边和胸前口袋小锚徽章的宽松浅蓝色睡衣，单膝支起，一只手臂随意放置，并保护性地搂着另一名角色。右侧较矮的角色拥有 {argument name="right character hair color" default="红紫色头发，发梢渐变为橙色，扎着侧马尾，配有蓝色发圈和黄色小发夹"}，身穿带有棕红色调的奶油色格纹睡衣，双手合十放在胸前仿佛正在许愿，并轻轻靠向左侧角色。画面中需呈现 2 颗明亮的流星从左上方斜向中心划过，在繁星密布的夜空中留下蓝色和紫色的轨迹。背景描绘平静的月光海洋及其波光粼粼的倒影、远处的山丘以及一座静谧的沿海小镇，镇上可见屋顶和几扇透出暖光的窗户。采用略微俯视的屋顶视角构图，右上角包含房屋的屋檐和木墙，运用精致的赛璐珞动漫线条、发光高光、浪漫宁静的氛围、深海军蓝夜色，细节清晰，并呈现为适合智能手机的竖屏壁纸构图。

templates.title: Anime-style mirrored lake and sky background

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫风格镜面湖泊天空背景

templates.prompt: Create a widescreen, cinematic anime-style background illustration depicting a vast, mirror-like lake with a bright {argument name="sky color" default="clear blue"} A daytime sky. The horizon, flat and low in the middle ground, is framed by a series of pale purple and warm beige mountains stretching from left to right. The lake, as calm as glass, perfectly reflects the sky, clouds, and mountains, creating a serene sense of boundless space. Large, fluffy cumulus clouds are added to the upper left and upper right edges, with a few wispy white clouds dotting the horizon; their reflections should softly appear in the water below. The composition utilizes bright summer sunlight, soft pastel tones, atmospheric perspective, delicate brushstrokes, and a dreamlike Japanese anime aesthetic. The composition remains open and simple, excluding figures, buildings, boats, or text, emphasizing tranquility, spatial scale, and a serene, fantastical travel atmosphere.{argument name="aspect ratio" default="16:9 widescreen"} Proportional rendering delivers clear details and a soft glow effect.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张宽屏电影级动漫风格背景插画，展现一片广阔如镜的湖泊，上方是明亮的 {argument name="sky color" default="清澈湛蓝"} 白昼天空。地平线位于中景处，平直且低垂，一连串淡紫色与暖米色的山脉从左至右延伸。湖面如玻璃般平静，完美倒映出天空、云朵和山脉，营造出一种宁静的无限空间感。在左上边缘和右上侧添加大片蓬松的积云，地平线处点缀少量细碎白云；这些云朵的倒影应柔和地显现在下方水中。运用明亮的夏季阳光、柔和的粉彩色调、空气感透视、细腻的绘画笔触以及梦幻的日本动画背景美学。构图保持开阔简洁，不包含人物、建筑、船只或文字，强调宁静感、空间尺度以及静谧的奇幻旅行氛围。以 {argument name="aspect ratio" default="16:9 宽屏"} 比例渲染，呈现清晰的细节与柔和的辉光效果。

templates.title: Cyberpunk Cupcake Rooftop Girl

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克纸杯蛋糕天台少女

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed vertical-screen anime-style cyberpunk illustration, with the main character being {argument name="character name" default="Kapupu"} A stylish young woman sits on the edge of a high-rise rooftop in a densely packed, futuristic Tokyo-style city at dusk. She has a messy short bob haircut, and her hair is {argument name="hair color" default="Dark purple-black"} She was surrounded by a glowing purple outline, exuding confidence and coolness. Her face was deliberately obscured by a soft purple square veil, adding a touch of mystery. A small cupcake, topped with purple frosting, chocolate drizzle, and a red cherry, rested evenly on her head. She wore an oversized {argument name="hoodie color" default="Purple"} She wore a hoodie covered in punk patches, skull and crossbones designs, and anime sticker art, with a large patch on the back that read "SKELETON." She paired it with black shorts, purple socks, and chunky black sneakers adorned with skull patterns and neon accents. She sat sideways, one hand resting on the edge of the rooftop, one leg bent, the other dangling above the city, illuminated by magenta and blue neon lights. The rooftop surface was black and worn, covered in graffiti, stickers, skull graffiti, stars, and a giant pink spray-painted word "DREAM." Behind her was a stunning neon cityscape, crammed with skyscrapers, holographic billboards, and clearly visible Japanese signs, including large vertical signs proclaiming "Future," "Chasing Dreams," and "Star Party," as well as smaller signs like "Hotel," "LIVE," "OPEN DRIVE," and "2024," all glowing with saturated pink, purple, cyan, and electric blue light. The sky is a spectacular panoramic view of the starry universe, with a bright Milky Way nebula in the upper right corner, countless stars, and seven clearly visible meteors or meteorites streaking across the sky in blue, purple, and gold diagonals. Bright sunset halos are added between the buildings on the horizon, creating dramatic rim lighting, glossy highlights, intricate lines, ultra-fine textures, high contrast, vibrant synthetic wave tones, cinematic perspective, and a refined GPT-Image-2 anime illustration quality.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅高度精细的竖屏动漫风格赛博朋克插画，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="Kapupu"}，一位时尚的少女，坐在黄昏时分一座密集的未来感东京风格城市的高层天台边缘。她留着凌乱的短波波头，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="深紫黑色"}，带有发光的紫色轮廓光，姿态自信酷炫，脸部被一个柔和的紫色方形遮挡块刻意遮住，增添了一丝神秘感。她的头顶平衡地放着一个小纸杯蛋糕，上面有紫色糖霜、巧克力淋酱和一颗红樱桃。她穿着一件超大号的 {argument name="hoodie color" default="紫色"} 连帽衫，上面布满了朋克补丁、骷髅交叉骨图案、动漫贴纸艺术，背部有一个写着“SKELETON”的大补丁，搭配黑色短裤、紫色袜子和装饰有骷髅图案及霓虹点缀的厚底黑色运动鞋。她侧身坐着，一只手撑在天台边缘，一条腿弯曲，另一条腿悬在城市上方，被品红色和蓝色的霓虹灯照亮。天台表面呈黑色且磨损，布满了涂鸦、贴纸、骷髅涂鸦、星星和一个巨大的粉色喷漆单词“DREAM”。在她身后是令人震撼的霓虹城市景观，挤满了摩天大楼、全息广告牌和清晰可见的日式招牌，包括写有“未来”、“夢を追え”、“星団”的大型竖向招牌，以及较小的招牌如“ホテル”、“LIVE”、“OPEN DRIVE”和“2024”，所有招牌都散发着饱和的粉色、紫色、青色和电蓝色光芒。天空是壮观的星空宇宙全景，右上角有一片明亮的银河星云，无数繁星，以及 7 颗清晰可见的流星或陨石以蓝色、紫色和金色对角线划过天空。在地平线的建筑之间添加明亮的日落光晕，营造戏剧性的轮廓光、光泽高光、复杂的线条、超精细的纹理、高对比度、充满活力的合成波色调、电影般的透视效果，以及精致的 gpt-image-2 动漫插画质感。

templates.prompt: Create a bright and fantastical widescreen anime-style illustration featuring three adorable chibi characters running and leaping across a mirror-like shallow pool under a clear blue sky: a chibi boy on the left, a small mascot robot in the middle, and a chibi girl on the right. The child on the left is wearing {argument name="left child outfit" default="Green hoodie, dark blue rolled-up jeans, and green sneakers"} She has messy short black hair, arms outstretched as if leaping, one leg raised, and her face deliberately blurred with a soft, square effect. The character in the middle is {argument name="mascot design" default="A round robot mascot in white and lime green, with big blue eyes, a green heart logo on its chest, leaf-shaped green ear plates, rounded segmented limbs, and a sprout antenna with a small white flower blooming at the top."} They were happily smiling and waving as they walked on. The child on the right was wearing {argument name="right child outfit" default="Pink hoodie, blue pleated skirt, white socks and pink sneakers"} The character, sporting a short brown bob, runs briskly and raises a fist, his face deliberately blurred with a soft, square effect. The scene is set on a vast, reflective body of water, like a dreamlike salt flat, where the three characters are clearly reflected.{argument name="background setting" default="Distant low mountains on the horizon, fluffy sun-drenched clouds, and a brilliant afternoon blue sky."} As a background, the air and water are filled with shimmering star-shaped rays and warm golden halos, creating a magical and joyful atmosphere. It employs a refined Japanese children's book anime rendering style, using soft watercolor-like shadows, clean lines, gentle tones, and bright highlights, resulting in rich detail. The image is displayed in a 16:9 widescreen composition and contains no text or logo.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张明亮且充满奇幻色彩的宽屏动漫风格插画，画面中恰好有 3 个可爱的 Q 版角色在湛蓝天空下，如镜面般的浅水滩上奔跑跳跃：左侧为 1 名 Q 版男孩，中间为 1 个小型吉祥物机器人，右侧为 1 名 Q 版女孩。左侧儿童穿着 {argument name="left child outfit" default="绿色连帽衫、深蓝色翻边牛仔裤和绿色运动鞋"}，留着凌乱的黑色短发，双臂张开如同在跳跃，一条腿抬起，面部刻意用柔和的方形模糊处理。中间角色为 {argument name="mascot design" default="一个白色和青柠绿相间的圆形机器人吉祥物，拥有蓝色大眼睛、胸前有绿色爱心标志、叶片状的绿色耳板、圆润的分段式肢体，以及一个顶端开着小白花的嫩芽天线"}，正开心地微笑着挥手前行。右侧儿童穿着 {argument name="right child outfit" default="粉色连帽衫、蓝色百褶裙、白色短袜和粉色运动鞋"}，留着棕色波波头短发，轻快地奔跑并举起一只拳头，面部刻意用柔和的方形模糊处理。场景设定在广阔且具有反射效果的水面上，如同梦幻般的盐滩，水面清晰地倒映着 3 个角色。使用 {argument name="background setting" default="地平线上遥远的低矮山脉、蓬松的阳光云朵以及灿烂的午后蓝天"} 作为背景。空气和水面中充盈着许多闪烁的星形光芒和温暖的金色光晕，营造出神奇而欢快的氛围。采用精致的日本童书动漫渲染风格，运用柔和的水彩质感阴影、干净的线条、柔和的色调、明亮的高光，画面细节丰富，采用 16:9 宽屏构图，无文字，无 Logo。

templates.prompt: Create a clean, modern app icon on a pure white background: a circular, cloud-like logo composed of overlapping, soft petals, filling the space from the top left corner.{argument name="top color" default="violet"} To the middle{argument name="middle color" default="bright sky blue"} Then go to the bottom right corner{argument name="bottom color" default="Blue-green"} The logo features a smooth gradient. Inside, a minimalist landscape icon depicts two snow-capped mountains: a smaller one on the left and a larger one in the center on the right, both with a soft blue gradient at their descent. A small, pure white sun or moon circle is added to the upper left. At the base of the mountains, a flowing white, wavy line separates the snow-capped peaks from the blue area below, adding a subtle sense of depth and a glossy highlight effect. The clean, vector-style design, rounded edges, soft gradients, absence of text and borders, and centered composition create a high-resolution app icon aesthetic.

templates.prompt: Create an original Y2K fashion magazine-style flash photograph, with the subject being {argument name="subject" default="adult women"} Leaning against a pure blue studio backdrop, the composition extends from above her head to her hips, her body spanning the frame. Her face is deliberately obscured by a flat, opaque, beige-gray rectangle; her messy dark hair is tied up, with a few strands falling loose. She wears a pink and white checkered tank top with a loose hem and side ties, layered with silver necklaces, oversized dark brown patent leather gloves, and low-waisted light blue jeans, the waistband undone to reveal a white belt underneath. templates.prompt: for{argument name="character name" default="Naruto Uzumaki"} Create a vertical anime movie poster with a hardcore ink-painting collage style. The composition centers on a large close-up of the left side, with the protagonist being a character with spiky hair.{argument name="hair color" default="Bright golden"} The young ninja has blue eyes, three whisker marks on his cheeks, and a black headband engraved with a spiral leaf symbol. Within and around his head's outline, a montage of dark brown and orange tones is incorporated, containing eight precise narrative elements: a roaring red nine-tailed fox head in the upper right corner; an orange-clad ninja charging with a kunai in the center right; a silver-haired masked ninja holding a blue glowing energy ball in the lower right corner; a small squad of ANBU ninjas in the upper center; two blurred portraits of minor characters in the middle; a miniature battle scene in the lower center; and layered black village gates and ruins in the background. In the bottom foreground, the same blond ninja is shown from behind, standing on a dark rocky cliff, wearing an orange and black jumpsuit, a ninja tool pouch at his waist, and a headband ribbon swaying in the wind, overlooking the rugged mountains and intricately detailed hidden villages carved with Hokage portraits below. The scene is surrounded by expressive black ink blots, bold brushstrokes, smoky, dirty textures, fluttering orange leaves, and embers, all set against a creamy white paper background, creating a warm burnt orange hue and deep black shadows. A striking vertical Japanese calligraphy title is added to the left.{argument name="main title text" default="うずまき ナルト"} Below it is an orange leaf spiral badge, and in the lower left corner is a red square stamp.{argument name="seal text" default="Ninja Way"} A thin, vertical Japanese slogan was added to the right side.{argument name="right tagline" default="To become Hokage"} Add smaller vertical Japanese text near the title.{argument name="side tagline" default="A ninja of the Leaf Village, with pride in their hearts."} At the bottom center, the Roman numeral text "NARUTO UZUMAKI" is added in a serif font, with a small subtitle below. Employing movie poster lighting, high detail, a dynamic asymmetrical layout, and a traditional Japanese ink painting texture, it maintains anime accuracy while rejecting photorealistic styles.

promptLocalized.zh: 为 {argument name="character name" default="漩涡鸣人"} 创建一张硬核水墨拼贴风格的竖版动漫电影海报。构图中心为一个巨大的左侧面特写，主角是一位有着刺猬头 {argument name="hair color" default="亮金色"} 的少年忍者，拥有蓝色眼睛，脸颊上有三道胡须印，额头上戴着刻有螺旋叶片标志的黑色护额。在他的头部轮廓内外，融合一张深褐色与橙色调的蒙太奇画面，包含 8 个精确的故事元素：右上角咆哮的红色九尾狐头，中右侧手持苦无冲锋的橙衣忍者，右下角手持蓝色发光能量球的银发蒙面忍者，上方中心的一小队暗部忍者，中间两个模糊的小角色肖像，下方中心的一处微型战斗场景，以及背景中层叠的黑色村门与废墟。在底部前景中，展示同一个金发忍者从背后的视角，站在深色岩石峭壁上，身穿橙黑相间的连体服，腰间系着忍具包，头带飘带随风摆动，俯瞰着下方雕刻着火影头像的崎岖山脉与精细的隐村。场景周围环绕着极具表现力的黑色墨迹、粗犷的笔触、烟雾状的脏污纹理、飞舞的橙色落叶与余烬，在米白色纸张背景上呈现出温暖的焦橙色与深邃的黑色阴影。在左侧添加醒目的竖排日式毛笔书法标题 {argument name="main title text" default="うずまき ナルト"}，下方配有一个橙色叶片螺旋徽章，左下角盖有一个红色方形印章 {argument name="seal text" default="忍道"}，右侧添加纤细的竖排日文标语 {argument name="right tagline" default="火影になるために"}，标题附近添加较小的竖排日文文本 {argument name="side tagline" default="木ノ葉の忍、誇りを胸に。"}。在底部中心，添加衬线字体的罗马字母文本“NARUTO UZUMAKI”，下方配有一行微小的副标题。采用电影海报灯光，高细节，动态非对称布局，传统日式水墨画质感，保持动漫准确性，拒绝照片写实风格。

Her neck and shoulders are rendered in dark, polygonal cuts in shades of plum, navy, maroon, and black, creating an elegant high-necked look. A large, opaque matte rectangle in a certain color is placed at the center of her face.{argument name="face block color" default="Soft grayish brown"} Facial features are obscured like a deliberate privacy mask or placeholder. Dramatic angular lighting, sharp polygonal edges, high-contrast shadows, and jewel-like facets are employed. The background features a soft pastel gradient and is embellished with {argument name="background colors" default="Light cream, pink, lavender and light cyan"} An abstract, semi-transparent polygonal shape. templates.prompt: Create a simple anime-style single-panel portrait, with the main character being {argument name="character name" default="Miina"} A cute cat-eared girl. The photo is taken from a high-angle, selfie-like perspective, against a pure white background. She has glossy hair {argument name="hair color" default="black"} She had a short bob haircut with messy bangs and a few stray strands; a pair of huge black cat ears on her head, the inner ears were pale pink with white down; she had soft, sleepy gray-blue eyes, a faint blush on her cheeks, and slightly pouting lips, giving the impression of just waking up. She was wearing an oversized top.{argument name="hoodie color" default="white"} A hoodie with drawstring, loose cuffs, and front pockets, paired with a subtly visible black skirt or shorts. The pose is designed with one arm outstretched towards the viewer, as if holding a camera, while the other hand rubs the eyes, conveying a cat-like drowsiness; a small floating bubble and two dots are added to the left side of the head to further suggest sleepiness. Using crisp black lines and smooth celluloid coloring, the hoodie features subtle blue-gray shadows, the hair has glossy highlights, and the skin tones are soft and pale. The composition is bright and simple, with the face centered and cropped for a close-up. A small, light-colored, stylized signature text is added to the lower right corner.{argument name="signature text" default="ミーナ"} .

templates.title: Overlapping Anime Knight Dynamic Trajectory

titleLocalized.zh: 重叠动漫骑士动态轨迹

templates.prompt: Create a wide-format anime-style action illustration on a pure white or transparent background, showcasing four overlapping copies of the same female fantasy knight, arranged horizontally and staggered from left to right like a dynamic trajectory. The character is {argument name="character archetype" default="A blonde female paladin"} Charging or lunging to the right, leaning forward, long {argument name="hair color" default="Golden yellow"} Her hair flowed back in the wind like ribbons, and a deep robe with ornate gold trim was draped behind her.{argument name="cape color" default="Royal Blue"} A large cloak, full of dynamism. She wears polished silver plate armor covering a navy blue dress and corset, paired with white armored boots and gauntlets, and decorative gold filigree details; a white belt or cloak strip with gold embroidery flows in the center of the composition. In the rightmost foreground replica, she holds a long silver sword, the blade angled forward, with a gold cross hilt and a fantasy knight-inspired design. The four replicas should be almost identical, partially obscured to create a layered cut-out/sticker effect, emphasizing a sense of rapid movement. The artwork features clean, crisp lines, high-detail anime/fantasy game character rendering, bright highlights on the metallic armor, an elegant blue and gold color scheme, dynamically flowing fabric and hair, minimalist shadows, no background, no text, no borders, and a centered 3:2 horizontal canvas composition. An opaque element is added above the visible facial area of ​​the rightmost foreground character.{argument name="face cover color" default="Light beige"} Use blocks to cover the face while keeping the rest of the character intact.

promptLocalized.zh: 在纯白或透明背景上创作一张宽幅动漫风格动作插画，展示同一个女性奇幻骑士的 4 个重叠复制体，像动态轨迹一样从左到右水平错位排列。角色为 {argument name="character archetype" default="一位金发女性圣骑士"}，正向右冲刺或突进，身体前倾，长长的 {argument name="hair color" default="金黄色"} 头发如丝带般在风中向后飘扬，身后披着一件带有华丽金色饰边的深 {argument name="cape color" default="宝蓝色"} 大斗篷，动态十足。她身穿覆盖在海军蓝裙装和紧身胸衣上的抛光白银色板甲，配有白色装甲靴和护手，以及装饰性的金色花丝细节；一条带有金色刺绣的白色腰带或斗篷条在构图中间飘动。在最右侧的前方复制体中，她手持一把长银剑，剑身斜向前方，配有金色十字护手和奇幻骑士风格设计。4 个复制的人物应几乎完全相同，部分遮挡，营造出分层剪纸/贴纸效果，强调快速移动感。采用清晰利落的线条艺术，高细节动漫奇幻游戏角色渲染，金属盔甲上的明亮高光，优雅的蓝金配色方案，动态流动的布料和头发，极简阴影，无背景，无文字，无边框，3:2 横向画布居中构图。在最右侧前方角色的可见面部区域上方添加一个不透明的 {argument name="face cover color" default="浅米色"} 方块，遮住面部，同时保持人物其余部分完整。

templates.prompt: Transform this image (already uploaded) into a soft, atmospheric cloud composition while preserving {argument name="subject" default="Recognizable facial features of the subject"} Expression and identity. The face should present a form subtly composed of clouds, blending naturally into the overall composition.{argument name="background" default="bright blue sky"} In the background, use soft, diffused lighting, combined with gentle highlights and ethereal shadows, to create a sense of depth and realism. Ensure the transition is symbolic rather than literal, avoiding hard edges, skin textures, or sharp details. The subject should appear to emerge from or dissolve into the clouds. Keep facial proportions, eyes, smile, and key features clearly visible within the cloud structure. Style: Dreamy, Ethereal, Surreal, Cinematic Lighting: Natural Daylight, Soft Halo, Volumetric Lighting Tone: Sky Blue, Pure White, Soft Gradient Atmosphere:{argument name="mood" default="Tranquil, invigorating, and inspiring"} Add subtle cloud layers around and within the face for a seamless blend. The background should be a clean blue sky with soft cloud gradients. High resolution, hyper-realistic cloud texture, smooth blending, no text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh:
将此图像（已上传）转换为柔和、富有氛围感的云朵构图，同时保留 {argument name="subject" default="主体可辨认的面部特征"}、表情和身份。

I was surrounded by several anime-style characters, their design resembling {argument name="anime name" default="[Anime Title]"} The characters in (e.g.){argument name="character name" default="[Role]"} [Characters], [Characters], [Characters], and [Characters]). 将整张图片转换为 {argument name="illustration style" default="可爱卡通风格插画"}，并融入讨人喜欢的涂鸦美学。在保持原场景和角色细节的同时，呈现出生动、柔和且充满趣味的卡通效果。

templates.title: Korean magazine-style couple portraits

titleLocalized.zh: 韩系杂志风情侣肖像

templates.prompt: Take a picture{argument name="subject" default="Half-body close-up couple photos"} The man is in front, and the woman naturally approaches from the side and rear, gently resting her head near the man's neck and shoulder. They are close but not stiff; the image should convey a sense of intimacy, with the woman leaning naturally and the man accepting her. Atmosphere: A quiet, soft photograph that establishes a trusting relationship. The man looks at the camera with a calm, gentle, and composed expression, as if naturally accepting the relationship; the woman looks softly at the camera or slightly tilts her head to look at the man's profile, her eyes gentle, revealing a hint of dependence, with a faint smile. Avoid exaggerated smiles; the image should convey the natural relaxation of a long-term relationship. Expressions and Angle: Don't have both of them facing the camera directly. The man can lean slightly forward, while the woman peeks out from behind, maintaining a balanced relationship. Restrained expressions with slightly upturned corners of the mouth convey a tranquil warmth. Composition: A medium close-up, focusing on the distance between the two, their facial relationship, and the intimacy of their neck and shoulder. Background:{argument name="background color" default="warm gray"} The clean studio backdrop and soft, even lighting create an atmosphere reminiscent of the opening image in a Korean magazine photoshoot, used to capture the relationship between the characters.

promptLocalized.zh:
拍摄一张 {argument name="subject" default="半身特写情侣写真"}。男士在前，女士从侧后方自然靠近，将头轻轻靠在男士的颈肩附近。两人非常亲密但并不僵硬地贴在一起；画面应呈现出女士自然倚靠、男士自然接纳的亲密感。

氛围设定：
一张安静、柔和的照片，建立起一种充满信任的人物关系。男士看向镜头，表情冷静、温柔且沉稳，仿佛自然地接纳了这段关系；女士柔和地看向镜头或微微侧头看向男士的侧脸，眼神温柔，流露出些许依赖感，嘴角带着浅浅的微笑。避免夸张的笑容；应呈现出长期相处关系中那种自然的放松感。

表情与角度：
不要让两人都完全正对镜头。男士可以略微朝前，女士从后方探出脸庞，保持一种错落有致的人物关系。表情克制，嘴角微微上扬，传达出一种静谧的温暖感。

构图：
中景特写，聚焦于两人之间的距离、面部关系以及肩颈的亲密感。背景为 {argument name="background color" default="暖灰色"} 的干净摄影棚背景，采用柔和均匀的布光。整体氛围如同韩系杂志写真的首图，用于定格人物关系。

templates.title: Q-version clone sticker diary

titleLocalized.zh: Q 版分身贴纸日记

templates.prompt: Based on the uploaded photo, generate a high-quality "Q-version clone sticker diary photo". [Main Subject Positioning] Model Shooting Scene: Centered on a real model, presenting a high-definition social media lifestyle diary style. The image should be exquisite and fun, with a balanced layout and rich visual effects without being cluttered. [Q-version Clone Design] Add [Q-version clone design] around the main subject.{argument name="number of clones" default="5-8"} Each chibi-style mini-avatar features an adorable sticker style, characterized by a "large head, small body + large, expressive eyes + simple digital art style." Each avatar must maintain a high degree of resemblance to the real person—hairstyle, clothing, and color must be identical—but must be designed with different poses and expressions relevant to the photograph (e.g., hands on hips, wearing a hat, jumping, back view, lying down, etc.), ensuring all poses are unique and appropriate for the shooting context. [Visual Effects] Each chibi character should be rendered as a sticker with a white outline, soft shadows, and a slight floating effect, arranged around the main subject and at the edges of the image, avoiding obscuring the face or key body parts. [Doodle Elements] Add light, hand-drawn doodles (hearts, sparkles, arrows, dynamic lines, circles) using a white background with light pink accents, maintaining a simple scrapbook diary style that blends naturally with the overall image. [Typography] Includes {argument name="phrases" default="5-8 short, handwritten English phrases that match the shooting atmosphere"} The text should be predominantly white with subtle pink highlights and small decorative symbols (such as stars or wavy lines). Its placement should harmonize with the graffiti and not obscure the main subject. [Composition Requirements] The main subject should be centered, surrounded by Q-version stickers and graffiti elements, creating a balanced "center subject, surrounding elements" layout. The overall style should be a sophisticated, playful, high-definition social media lifestyle diary, visually rich yet well-organized.

promptLocalized.zh:
基于上传的照片，生成一张高质量的“Q 版分身贴纸日记照片”。

[主体定位] 模特拍摄场景，以真人模特为中心主体，呈现高清社交媒体生活方式日记风格。画面应精致且充满趣味，布局平衡，视觉效果丰富而不杂乱。

[Q 版分身设计] 在主体周围添加 {argument name="number of clones" default="5-8"} 个 Q 版迷你分身，采用可爱的贴纸风格，特征为“大头小身 + 大而生动的眼睛 + 简洁的数字艺术风格”。每个分身必须保持与真人高度相似——发型、服装和颜色必须完全一致——但需设计成不同的摄影相关姿势和表情（如叉腰、戴帽子、跳跃、背影、躺卧等），确保所有姿势各不相同且符合拍摄语境。

[视觉效果] 每个 Q 版角色应渲染为带有白色描边、柔和阴影和轻微浮动效果的贴纸，排列在主体周围及画面边缘，避免遮挡面部或关键身体部位。

[涂鸦元素] 添加轻盈的手绘涂鸦（爱心、闪光、箭头、动态线条、圆圈），使用白色底色搭配浅粉色点缀，保持简洁的剪贴簿日记风格，与整体画面自然融合。

[文字设计] 包含 {argument name="phrases" default="5-8 个符合拍摄氛围的简短手写风格英文短语"}。文字应以白色为主，带有轻微的粉色高光和小装饰符号（如星星或波浪线），位置需与涂鸦协调，且不遮挡主体。

[构图要求] 真人主体居中，Q 版贴纸和涂鸦元素围绕其四周，形成平衡的“主体居中，元素环绕”布局。整体风格为精致、俏皮的高清社交媒体生活方式日记风，视觉丰富且井然有序。

templates.title: Korean graffiti illustration portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 韩式涂鸦插画肖像

templates.prompt: Create a photo based on the user's uploaded photo.{argument name="illustration style" default="Korean-style hand-drawn graffiti illustrations"} Character posters in this style. Retain the character's authentic identity and overall temperament, but the overall presentation should lean towards an illustration style rather than a realistic redraw. Style reference: Korean semi-realistic illustration, with a distinct sense of character, natural and expressive facial emotions, half-body composition, and slightly dynamic poses. Emphasize loose, casual hand-drawn lines, black ink outlines, ink splatters, sketch-like brushstrokes, visible brush textures, and the fusion of soft pastel tones and ink shadows, presenting a cartoon sketch-like texture. Avoid creating a highly realistic illustration; don't make it look too much like a photograph. It should have more of a "hand-drawn" feel, with free lines, loose edges, and slightly unfinished artistic elements in certain areas. Hair and clothing details should be rich, with an overall look that is both refined and has a casual doodle atmosphere. Keep the background simple, for example {argument name="background" default="Pure white or light-colored paper texture"} And freely add some symbolic decorative elements around the figure, such as{argument name="decorative elements" default="Handwritten phrases, stars, hearts, arrows, ink dots, small stickers"} Please freely develop the copy and background atmosphere according to the character's temperament. The final effect should be high-end, light, and dynamic, like the Korean-style hand-drawn character posters that will become popular on X.

promptLocalized.zh:
基于用户上传的照片，创作一张 {argument name="illustration style" default="韩式手绘涂鸦插画"} 风格的人物海报。保留人物真实的身份特征和整体气质，但整体呈现效果应明显偏向插画风格，而非写实重绘。

风格参考：韩式半写实插画，鲜明的人物感，自然且富有表现力的面部情绪，半身构图，轻微的动态姿势。强调松散、随性的手绘线条、黑色墨水轮廓、墨迹飞溅、素描般的笔触、可见的画笔纹理，以及柔和粉彩色调与墨影的融合，呈现出漫画素描般的质感。

不要制作成高度写实的插画；不要让它看起来太像照片。它应该具有更多的“手绘”感，线条自由、边缘松散，局部区域带有略显未完成的艺术感。头发和服装细节应丰富，整体外观既精致又带有随性的涂鸦氛围。

背景保持简洁，例如 {argument name="background" default="纯白或浅色纸张纹理"}，并围绕人物自由添加一些象征性的装饰元素，如 {argument name="decorative elements" default="手写短语、星星、爱心、箭头、墨点、小贴纸"}。请根据人物的气质自由发挥文案和背景氛围。最终效果应高端、轻盈且灵动，如同在 X 上会走红的韩式手绘人物海报。

templates.title: GPT Image 2 Identity Preservation Portrait Cue

titleLocalized.zh: GPT Image 2 身份保持肖像提示词

templates.prompt: Please use the photos I upload only as a reference for identifying the person, to preserve their true appearance. Do not retain the original image's background, clothing, props, posture, or environment. Generate a completely new image.{argument name="portrait type" default="Quirky Girl Studio Portrait"} Strictly maintain the real characteristics of the person in the uploaded photo, including face shape, facial proportions, eyes, nose, lips, skin tone, age, hairline, hairstyle, and overall temperament. Do not turn them into strangers, do not Westernize them, do not over-beautify them, and avoid an "AI fake face" look. Hairstyles should naturally extend from the uploaded photo: - Keep hair length consistent - Refer to the original image for bangs - If the original image shows black hair, please process it to a dark brown-black, dark tea-brown, or natural dark coffee color; avoid pure black - Only optimize for a studio style; do not drastically change the hairstyle and makeup.{argument name="makeup style" default="Korean-style quirky and cute girl makeup"} The look should feature a clear, creamy complexion, naturally straight brows, light pinkish-brown or peach-pink eyeshadow, prominent under-eye bags, long eyelashes, thin eyeliner, and a generous amount of pink or peach blush extending to the under-eye area. A touch of red on the tip of the nose is added, and the lips should be a glossy strawberry pink or peach. The overall makeup should be sweet, lively, and playful; avoid heavy makeup or Western-style makeup. The overall style should be {argument name="visual style" default="Korean-style teen magazine aesthetic, quirky and playful, a blend of sweet and cool, exquisite studio portraits."} The background is a seamless light gray or cream white studio backdrop with soft, bright lighting, creating a clean and transparent visual effect with a slight film grain and magazine-like quality.

promptLocalized.zh:
请仅将我上传的照片作为人物身份的参考，以保持其真实外貌。请勿保留原图中的背景、服装、道具、坐姿或环境。生成一张全新的 {argument name="portrait type" default="古灵精怪少女摄影棚肖像"}。

严格保持人物的真实身份特征，包括脸型、面部比例、眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇、肤色、年龄、发际线、发型基础以及整体气质。不要将其变成陌生人，不要进行西化处理，不要过度美化，并避免出现“AI 假脸”感。

templates.title: Professional Hairstyle and Makeup Analysis Guide

titleLocalized.zh: 专业发型与妆容分析指南

templates.prompt: Hairstyle Analysis: Based on the uploaded facial photo, I hope you can create a hairstyle that {argument name="style" default="luxurious"} A striking hairstyle diagnostic chart! Maintain the original facial features, face shape, and overall feel, presenting a side-by-side or sequential comparison of different hairstyles. Allow users to immediately identify which hairstyles are "best matches," "average," and "not recommended," conveying how each hairstyle makes the face appear smaller, enhances the overall look, or makes the person appear more refined. I want to compare long hair, short hair, with/without bangs, curly hair, straight hair, layered hairstyles, updos, etc. The design style should be fashionable, like a professional stylist's document. Keep the text concise and high-quality, suitable for social media posting! Makeup Analysis Guide: Based on the uploaded facial photo, create a luxurious makeup analysis guide image! Based on the original facial features, present a natural effect, ensuring it still looks like the same person, avoiding excessive application or retouching. Furthermore, diagnose and summarize face shapes (fresh, soft and elegant, elegant, feminine, cute, energetic and cute, cool and edgy, cool and casual, mature, youthful, curvy, straight). Use a sophisticated design similar to a magazine beauty feature, and use it throughout.{argument name="language" default="Japanese"} Label your posts. Keep text to a minimum, and clearly showcase key information through images. Achieve professional-level quality that encourages people to share on social media!

promptLocalized.zh:
发型分析：
基于上传的面部照片，我希望你创作一张具有 {argument name="style" default="奢华"} 感的发型诊断图！请保持原有的面部特征、脸型和氛围，并呈现出仿佛尝试了不同发型的并排或顺序对比效果。让用户一眼就能看出哪些发型是“最佳匹配”、“一般”和“不推荐”，并传达出每种发型如何让脸型显得更小、提升气质或使人看起来更精致。我希望对比长发、短发、有/无刘海、卷发、直发、层次感发型、盘发等。设计风格应时尚，如同专业造型师的文档。文字保持精简且高质量，适合社交媒体发布！
妆容分析指南：
基于上传的面部照片，创作一张奢华的妆容分析指南图片！以原始面部特征为基础，呈现自然的效果，确保看起来依然是同一个人，避免过度涂抹或过度修图。此外，诊断并总结脸型（清新风、柔和优雅风、优雅风、女性化、可爱风、活力可爱风、酷飒风、酷飒休闲风、成熟脸、幼态脸、曲线型、直线型）。采用类似杂志美妆专题的精致设计，全程使用 {argument name="language" default="日语"} 标注。文字保持最少，重点通过图片进行清晰展示。请达到专业水准，让人们有分享到社交媒体的欲望！

templates.title: Sunflower Field Fashion Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 向日葵花田时尚人像

templates.prompt: Create a realistic, sunny, and stylish portrait, depicting a young woman standing in a lush, green area.{argument name="flower field" default="Sunflower field"} The image, taken on a bright summer day, uses a vertical composition from mid-thigh to above the head. She is wearing a {argument name="outfit" default="White deep V-neck one-piece swimsuit with thin straps and a wrap-around waist design."} Her shoulders were bare, her posture elegant and graceful, one arm hanging naturally, her body slightly turned towards the camera.{argument name="hair color" default="Medium brown"} Her long hair flowed in the wind, spreading to the right, displaying a natural highlighting effect in the sunlight. Her face was framed by a centrally located {argument name="face cover color" default="warm brown"} A square masking block deliberately obscures the entire face area, but leaves the hair and neck visible. It is surrounded by numerous blooming yellow sunflowers and green leaves, including a large sunflower in the lower left foreground and several softly blurred sunflowers in the background. The composition utilizes shallow depth of field, a creamy blurred background, warm natural sunlight, soft skin tones, a light summer atmosphere, a high-resolution DSLR photography style, realistic textures, and a bright, clear color palette.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实的阳光时尚人像，描绘一位年轻女性站在茂密的 {argument name="flower field" default="向日葵花田"} 中，时间为明亮的夏日，采用从大腿中部到头顶上方的竖构图。她身穿一件 {argument name="outfit" default="白色深 V 领连体泳衣，配有细肩带和腰部包裹设计"}，双肩裸露，姿态优雅柔和，一只手臂自然下垂，身体略微朝向镜头。她那 {argument name="hair color" default="中棕色"} 的长发随风飘动，向右侧散开，在阳光下呈现出自然的挑染效果。她的面部被一个位于中心位置的 {argument name="face cover color" default="暖棕色"} 正方形遮挡块刻意遮盖，遮住了整个面部区域，但保留了头发和颈部可见。周围环绕着许多盛开的黄色向日葵和绿叶，包括左下角前景中的一朵大向日葵，以及背景中多朵虚化柔和的向日葵。使用浅景深、奶油般虚化的背景、温暖的自然日光、柔和的肤色、轻盈的夏日氛围、高分辨率 DSLR 摄影风格、写实的纹理以及明亮通透的色彩基调。

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑蕾丝时尚肖像

templates.prompt: Generate a realistic full-body studio fashion portrait, featuring a {argument name="subject" default="young women"} Standing in a minimalist, dark gray concrete room, with a backdrop of rough-textured walls and a polished concrete base, she kept {argument name="hair color and style" default="Dark brown long curly hair"} Her face was deliberately obscured by a soft, rectangular blur effect, leaving no visible facial features. She was wearing a {argument name="outfit" default="Black sheer lace long-sleeved high-neck wide-leg jumpsuit with delicate geometric mesh pattern, fitted at the waist, and layered over a dark-colored lining."} , pairing{argument name="shoes" default="Black pointed-toe high heels"} She was positioned slightly to the side of the camera, one hand near her waist, the other hanging naturally at her side, exuding an elegant, magazine-worthy feel. The lighting, low-key and subtly dark from the upper left, created subtle shadows and a soft charcoal gray tone, achieving a high-fashion catalog feel. Fabric details were clearly defined, proportions were realistic, and the vertical composition, full-body shot, and clean industrial background were used, with no text or unnecessary props in the image.

promptLocalized.zh: 生成一张写实的全身影棚时尚肖像，画面中一位 {argument name="subject" default="年轻女性"} 站在极简风格的深灰色混凝土房间内，背景是粗糙纹理的墙面和抛光混凝土底面。她留着 {argument name="hair color and style" default="深棕色长卷发"}，面部被柔和的矩形模糊效果刻意遮挡，没有可见的五官特征。她身穿一件 {argument name="outfit" default="黑色透视蕾丝长袖高领阔腿连体裤，带有精致的几何网眼图案，腰部修身，内搭深色底衬"}，搭配 {argument name="shoes" default="黑色尖头高跟鞋"}。让她身体略微侧向镜头，一只手放在腰间附近，另一只手自然垂在身侧，展现出优雅的时尚杂志大片感。采用来自左上方的暗调低调照明，呈现微妙的阴影和柔和的炭灰色调，具备高级时装目录的质感，面料细节清晰，比例写实，采用竖构图，全身取景，背景为干净的工业风，画面中不含任何文字或多余道具。

templates.title: Aztec street style panda poster

titleLocalized.zh: 阿兹特克街头风熊猫海报

templates.prompt: Create a dynamic, single-panel street-style character poster, featuring an anthropomorphic character.{argument name="animal character" default="Giant panda"} The character stands confidently on a white background in a three-quarter full-body pose. She wears an exquisite Mesoamerican/Aztec-style feather headdress in shades of deep cyan, emerald, dark blue, black, and gold, adorned with ornate gold mask details, jade-like circular ornaments, dangling feathers, multi-layered necklaces, and ceremonial jewelry. She is dressed in a modern urban techwear outfit: a black oversized bomber jacket with cyan and gold geometric trim, a white printed T-shirt with a stylized ancient mask pattern, loose black cargo pants with gold side trim, black fingerless gloves, green, white, and black platform sneakers with gold details, and a small cyan crossbody bag decorated with a gold mask emblem. The character has a fluffy black, white, and cyan tail and holds a vertical ceremonial scepter or staff covered with repeating gold lettering and cyan decorations. The artwork employs a bold comic/anime illustration style with sharp lines, strong shadow contrasts, rich fabric folds, metallic gold highlights, and vibrant brushstroke splatter textures. Add three large, graffiti-style words on the left, with the following content:{argument name="headline text" default="BUILDING ON XAHAU"} The arrangement is as follows: "BUILDING" at the top left, "ON" in smaller gold lettering below, and "XAHAU" in large cyan lettering at the bottom, all drawn with bold, dry brushstrokes and ink splatter effects. Behind the character, on the right side, horizontal cyan brushstrokes and white lines depicting an ancient mask are added, partially obscured by the character. The color scheme should emphasize cyan, jade green, black, white, and metallic gold, with a simple composition, a strong street art feel, and no realistic photographic elements.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张充满动感的单格街头风角色海报，主角是一位拟人化的 {argument name="animal character" default="大熊猫"}，以四分之三全身姿势自信地站立在白色背景上。角色佩戴着精致的中美洲/阿兹特克风格羽毛头饰，色调为深青色、祖母绿、深蓝色、黑色和金色，并配有华丽的金色面具细节、玉石般的圆形装饰、垂坠的羽毛、多层项链和仪式珠宝。为角色穿上现代都市机能风服装：一件带有青色和金色几何饰边的黑色大廓形飞行员夹克、一件印有程式化古老面具图案的白色印花 T 恤、带有金色侧边装饰的宽松黑色工装裤、黑色露指手套、带有金色细节的绿白黑配色厚底运动鞋，以及一个装饰着金色面具徽章的小型青色斜挎包。角色拥有一条毛茸茸的黑白青三色尾巴，一只手拿着一根垂直的仪式权杖或手杖，杖身覆盖着重复的金色字形图案和青色装饰。采用大胆的漫画/动画插画风格，线条锐利，阴影对比强烈，布料褶皱细节丰富，带有金属质感的金色高光以及充满活力的笔触飞溅纹理。在左侧添加 3 个巨大的涂鸦风格单词，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="BUILDING ON XAHAU"}，排列方式为：左上方为“BUILDING”，下方较小的金色字体为“ON”，底部巨大的青色字体为“XAHAU”，采用粗犷的干笔触和墨水飞溅效果绘制。在角色身后，右侧加入横向扫过的青色笔触和白色的古老面具线条画图案，部分被角色遮挡。配色方案应强调青色、玉绿色、黑色、白色和金属金色，构图简洁，具有强烈的街头艺术感，且不包含写实摄影元素。

templates.title: Low-poly port game screenshots

titleLocalized.zh: 低多边形港口游戏截图

templates.prompt: Create a screenshot in the style of an early 21st-century low-resolution 3D video game, employing a hardcore open-world action game aesthetic. The perspective is positioned behind a shirtless, muscular male character who has {argument name="hair color" default="gold"} The character has short hair and stands on a rooftop or observation platform high above an industrial port. The character dominates the foreground from shoulders to waist, possessing broad, low-poly shoulders and pixelated skin texture. The right hand is raised near the face, as if holding a phone or shielding the eyes from the sun. A large, opaque square occlusion block of color is placed in the center of the foreground above the character's head and face.{argument name="censor block color" default="Soft grayish brown"} The background depicts a blue bay with concrete docks, piers, warehouses, containers, small boats, and two large cargo ships moored near the shore. Dark green hills rise on the horizon against a pale blue sky. The design utilizes blocky polygonal geometry, blurred, compressed textures, soft daylight tones, visible jagged edges, and a 4:3 aspect ratio reminiscent of console game cutscenes or gameplay footage.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一张 21 世纪初低分辨率 3D 电子游戏风格的截图，采用硬核开放世界动作游戏画风。视角位于一名赤裸上身的肌肉男性角色身后，他留着 {argument name="hair color" default="金色"} 短发，站在工业港口上方的高处屋顶或瞭望台上。角色从肩部到腰部占据前景，拥有宽阔的低多边形肩膀和像素化的皮肤纹理，右手举在脸部附近，仿佛正在拿手机或遮挡阳光。在角色头部和脸部上方的前景中心处放置一个大的不透明方形遮挡块，颜色为 {argument name="censor block color" default="柔和灰褐色"}。背景展示一片蓝色海湾，配有混凝土码头、栈桥、仓库、集装箱、小型船只以及停泊在近海的两艘大型货轮，地平线上有深绿色的山丘和淡蓝色的天空。使用块状多边形几何体、模糊的压缩纹理、柔和的日光色调、可见的锯齿边缘，以及类似主机游戏过场动画或游戏实录的 4:3 构图。

The camera is positioned on the front left side of the vehicle, looking at the driver through the open window. The driver is wearing {argument name="clothing" default="A black jacket"} One hand is clearly visible, gripping or resting on the steering wheel in the foreground. His head and ears are visible, but his entire face is obscured by a large opaque area.{argument name="censor block color" default="Medium brown"} A rectangular privacy hood is deliberately placed over the face, positioned in the center and extending from the forehead to the chin. The interior is dark gray and black, featuring a rough, low-poly steering wheel, seats, headrests, door frames, and dashboard shape. Outside the windows, dimly lit city streets or parking lots are displayed, with blurred trees, pavement, and vertical utility poles, rendered with blocky textures and a strong pixelated effect. The composition employs a hard polygonal geometry, jagged edges, flat shadow effects, soft nighttime colors, visible compression artifacts, and cinematic screenshot-like framing with blacked-out top and bottom panels.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张低分辨率、21 世纪初 3D 电子游戏风格的截图，呈现出粗粝的 PlayStation 2 / GTA 游戏美学。画面展示了 {argument name="character type" default="一名光头男司机"} 夜间坐在车内的特写视角。摄像机位于车辆左前方外侧，透过敞开的车窗看向司机。司机身穿 {argument name="clothing" default="一件黑色夹克"}，一只手清晰可见，正握住或搭在前景的方向盘上。可以看到他的头部和耳朵，但整个面部被一个巨大的不透明 {argument name="censor block color" default="中棕色"} 长方形隐私遮挡块刻意覆盖，该遮挡块位于面部中央，从额头延伸至下巴。车内饰为深灰色和黑色，配有粗糙的低多边形方向盘、座椅、头枕、车门框架和仪表盘形状。窗外展示昏暗的城市街道或停车场，带有模糊的树木、路面和垂直电线杆，并以块状纹理和强烈的像素化效果呈现。采用硬朗的多边形几何结构、锯齿状边缘、平坦的阴影光效、柔和的夜间色彩、可见的压缩伪影，以及带有顶部和底部黑色遮幅的电影级截图构图。

templates.title: 3D cartoon crossover suburban scene

titleLocalized.zh: 3D 卡通跨界郊区场景

templates.prompt: Create a bright and nostalgic 3D cartoon video game scene, featuring three iconic characters standing side-by-side on a suburban sidewalk:{argument name="left character" default="Garfield"} On the left is an orange striped cat with droopy, half-closed eyes and a bored expression;{argument name="middle character" default="Snoopy"} In the center is a small white beagle with black ears, a black nose, and a red collar; and{argument name="right character" default="Charlie Brown"} On the right is a bald, round-faced little boy wearing a yellow shirt with black jagged stripes, black shorts, yellow socks, and brown shoes. The background is a yellow wooden house with purple accents, an open porch, and a small window with a purple frame; the foreground is a light-colored concrete path with green lawns, purple picket fences, a cyan garage-style building, undulating grassy slopes, pine trees, an autumn tree, blue sky, and soft white clouds. Employing the low-poly aesthetics of early 21st-century console games, with rounded, toy-like proportions, smooth, simple textures, saturated colors, slightly exaggerated heads and feet, soft sunlight, and a fixed third-person camera perspective that slightly looks down on the three characters, the three characters appearing somewhat confused or indifferent.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个明亮且充满怀旧感的 3D 卡通电子游戏场景，画面中恰好有 3 个标志性角色并排站在郊区的人行道上：{argument name="left character" default="Garfield"}，左侧是一只橙色条纹猫，有着下垂的半闭眼睛和无聊的表情；{argument name="middle character" default="Snoopy"}，中间是一只白色小猎犬，有着黑色的耳朵、黑色的鼻子和红色的项圈；以及 {argument name="right character" default="Charlie Brown"}，右侧是一个秃头圆脸的小男孩，穿着带有黑色锯齿条纹的黄色衬衫、黑色短裤、黄色袜子和棕色鞋子。场景背景是一栋带有紫色装饰的黄色木板房，门廊敞开，有一个紫色边框的小窗户；前景是浅色的混凝土小路，配有绿色草坪、紫色尖桩篱笆、青色车库式建筑、起伏的草坡、松树、一棵秋色树、蓝天和柔和的白云。采用 21 世纪初主机游戏的低多边形美学，圆润的玩具般比例，简洁平滑的材质，饱和的色彩，略显夸张的头部和脚部，柔和的日光，以及从上方略微俯视三人的固定第三人称摄像机视角，三个角色看起来都显得有些困惑或不以为然。

templates.title: Neon Instagram AI Creator Poster

titleLocalized.zh: Neon Instagram AI Creator 海报

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic, vertical cyberpunk-style social media poster. The background is a neon pink and magenta nighttime city with a wet, reflective surface. Skyscrapers are covered in glowing billboards, creating a futuristic social media atmosphere. At the center of the image is a confident male AI Creator emerging from a giant, upright smartphone shaped like an Instagram screen, dressed in…{argument name="blazer color" default="Rose Pink"} A tailored suit jacket, white turtleneck sweater, layered silver necklaces, black slim-fit trousers, and clean white sneakers; his face should be softly blurred in a square shape while maintaining sharp hair and body contours. The top of the phone screen displays the Instagram tag, the time 11:11, and five story circles spanning the top, labeled Your Story, mtariq.ai, a blurred central profile, viral.king, and luxury.vibe. The figure is placed on a circular rectangular luminous platform with bright pink rim lighting; the text on the front of the platform reads {argument name="platform name text" default="Mr. Tariq –"} Then came{argument name="platform role text" default="AI CREATOR"} The scene is surrounded by four large, floating social interaction badges: a heart-shaped notification with the number 1 in the center left, a heart-shaped notification with the number 7 in the bottom left, a heart-shaped notification with the number 1 in the top right, and a plain heart-shaped notification in the center right. Three floating neon tech cubes are added above the sky, and Instagram logo panels and holographic billboards are added throughout the buildings. The billboards include readable slogans.{argument name="left billboard slogan" default="FOLLOW YOUR DREAMS"} CREATE. INSPIRE. INFLUENCE, AI POWERED FUTURE, YOU ARE THE BRAND. and 10M+ FOLLOWERS. On the right, add a giant billboard displaying a full-body replica of the man and another portrait billboard. On the street in the lower left, place a large retro camera prop with a neon outline. Utilize dramatic low-angle perspective, glossy reflections, volumetric pink lighting effects, high contrast, ultra-detailed 3D realism, sharp fashion editorial lighting, futuristic Instagram brand energy, and a 4:5 poster composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影级竖版赛博朋克风格网红海报，背景为霓虹粉色与洋红色的夜间城市，地面湿润且具有反光效果，摩天大楼上覆盖着发光的广告牌，营造出充满未来感的社交媒体氛围。画面中心是一位自信的男性 AI Creator，正从一个巨大的 Instagram 屏幕形状的直立智能手机中走出，身穿 {argument name="blazer color" default="玫瑰粉色"} 定制西装外套、白色高领毛衣、叠戴银色项链、黑色修身长裤和干净的白色运动鞋；他的面部应进行柔和的方形模糊处理，同时保持头发和身体轮廓清晰。手机界面顶部显示 Instagram 字标、时间 11:11，以及横跨顶部的 5 个故事圆圈，分别标注为 Your Story、mtariq.ai、一个模糊的中心个人资料、viral.king 和 luxury.vibe。将人物置于一个带有亮粉色边缘照明的圆形矩形发光平台上，平台正面文字为 {argument name="platform name text" default="Mr. Tariq –"}，随后是 {argument name="platform role text" default="AI CREATOR"}。场景周围环绕 4 个巨大的悬浮社交互动徽章：左中位置是一个数字为 1 的心形通知，左下角是一个数字为 7 的心形通知，右上角是一个数字为 1 的心形通知，右中位置是一个纯心形通知。在天空上方添加 3 个悬浮的霓虹科技立方体，并在建筑物各处加入 Instagram 标志面板和全息广告牌。包含可读的广告牌标语：{argument name="left billboard slogan" default="FOLLOW YOUR DREAMS"}、CREATE. templates.title: Final version of classroom snapshot group photo

titleLocalized.zh: 最终版课堂抓拍合影

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_2 as a reference for the characters, clothing, and classroom props, a cleaner, final version of the classroom snapshot was regenerated. The image still features the four women and their coordinated outfits, but their pose has been changed to standing behind desks instead of sitting. The casual "V-sign" gesture and the Japanese school classroom setting are retained, while the background is adjusted to include a large, dark blackboard on the right and a doorway/cabinet area on the left. The camera angle needs to be slightly tilted, close-up, and wide-angle, creating a flash effect with slight motion blur and a realistic smartphone/disposable camera texture. Facial anonymization/blurring is maintained, consistent with the reference image. The image must include four women: the woman on the left wears a white cardigan over a beige top and a light-colored denim mini-skirt; the second woman wears a pink top with a beige pleated skirt and a sweater tied around her waist; the third woman wears a dark blazer over a yellow top and a black mini-skirt; and the woman on the right wears a blue shirt with a red tie and a beige pleated skirt. The foreground desk should be cluttered with study and personal items, including a laptop covered in stickers, a silver laptop, magazines/books, a small digital camera, a beige tote bag, small cosmetics/stationery, and a blue water bottle. The final result should be a professionally retouched image with optimized body proportions and clothing, while retaining the playful atmosphere of the reference photo.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_2 作为人物、服装和课堂道具的参考，重新生成一张更整洁、最终版的课堂抓拍合影。画面中仍为那四位女性和经过调整的协调服装，但将她们的姿势改为站在课桌后方，而非坐着。保留随意的“剪刀手”活力和日本学校教室的场景，同时将背景调整为右侧有一块大型深色黑板，左侧为门口/柜子区域。摄像机角度需略微倾斜、近景、广角，呈现出闪光灯拍摄的效果，带有轻微的运动模糊和真实的智能手机/一次性相机质感。保持面部匿名/模糊处理，与参考图一致。画面中必须包含 4 位女性：左侧女性身穿白色开衫内搭米色上衣，下着浅色牛仔短裙；第二位女性身穿粉色上衣，搭配米色百褶裙，腰间系着毛衣；第三位女性身穿深色西装外套，内搭黄色上衣，下着黑色短裙；右侧女性身穿蓝色衬衫，系红色领带，搭配米色百褶裙。前景课桌需摆放杂乱的学习和个人用品，包括贴满贴纸的笔记本电脑、银色笔记本电脑、杂志/书籍、小型数码相机、米色托特包、小型化妆品/文具以及蓝色水杯。最终效果应呈现为经过体型和服装优化后的精修图，同时保留参考图中俏皮的合影氛围。

templates.title: Giant Artists on Spotify Mobile

titleLocalized.zh: Spotify 手机上的巨型艺术家

templates.prompt: Create a high-end 3D photorealistic rendering showcasing a giant smartphone tilted at an angle on a dark, matte textured surface, using a high-angle, three-quarter view. The phone's display features a Spotify-style music player interface with a black UI, rounded album art, white controls, and green accent icons. The track currently playing is {argument name="song title" default="Last Last"} The singer is{argument name="artist name" default="Burna Boy"} Playlist/title text is displayed near the top.{argument name="playlist title" default="African Giant"} The album cover features a portrait against a bright blue sky and white clouds, accompanied by red handwritten lettering. Above the phone screen stands a full-body, photorealistic male music artist, his proportions miniature giant relative to the device. He wears a black short-sleeved shirt, black trousers, and black sneakers, adorned with a multi-layered diamond necklace, bracelet, and watch; his arm tattoos are clearly visible. His hands are in his pockets, and his face is deliberately obscured by a soft, square blur effect. Dramatic studio lighting is used, the phone's glass surface reflects light, and clear shadows are cast beneath his shoes, creating a realistic depth-of-field effect and a high-end commercial photography feel. The background is a deep charcoal gray with extremely rich textural detail, and the composition is a 1:1 square.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高端 3D 照片级写实编辑渲染图，展示一部斜放于深色哑光纹理表面的巨型智能手机，采用高角度四分之三视角。手机显示屏呈现 Spotify 风格的音乐播放器界面，采用黑色 UI、圆角专辑封面、白色控件及绿色强调图标。正在播放的曲目为 {argument name="song title" default="Last Last"}，演唱者为 {argument name="artist name" default="Burna Boy"}，顶部附近显示播放列表/标题文本 {argument name="playlist title" default="African Giant"}。专辑封面展示了一幅以明亮蓝天白云为背景的人像，并配有红色手写风格字体。手机屏幕上方站立着一位全身照片级写实的男性音乐艺术家，其比例相对于设备而言如同微缩巨人，身穿全黑短袖衬衫、黑色长裤、黑色运动鞋，佩戴多层钻石项链、手链、手表，手臂纹身清晰可见；他双手插兜，面部被柔和的方形模糊效果刻意遮挡。采用戏剧性的影棚灯光，手机玻璃表面呈现光泽反射，鞋底下方投射出清晰阴影，具备真实的景深效果，呈现高级商业摄影质感，背景为深炭灰色，材质细节极其丰富，采用 1:1 正方形构图。

templates.title: Anonymous Winter Noir Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 匿名冬季黑色电影风格肖像

templates.prompt: Create a{argument name="subject" default="A mysterious adult male"} A cinematic close-up portrait against a somber winter backdrop, employing a compact composition from the shoulders up. He has wet, dark hair, his right ear is visible, and a corner of his glasses is faintly visible on the left, but his face is completely obscured by a large, centrally located, vertical, dark charcoal-colored rectangle, like a deliberately anonymized occlusion. He wears a heavy, dark coat with a thick fur collar or hood covered in frost and snow crystals. The atmosphere is cold, with a bluish and melancholic hue, accompanied by falling snowflakes, softly blurred bokeh in the background, and dramatic, understated lighting that accentuates the icy texture of his hair and fur. The realistic cinematic style, shallow depth of field, high detail, cool blue-green tones, and subtle film grain create a suspenseful film noir atmosphere. The image should be horizontally composed, with the subject occupying most of the frame and the face-obscuring rectangle centered.

templates.title: Luxury street style shark tunnel statue

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华街头风鲨鱼隧道人像

templates.prompt: Hyper-realistic wide-angle fashion photography, capturing a {argument name="subject" default="young women"} She was walking through the transparent shark tunnel in the underwater aquarium, looking at the camera. She kept {argument name="hair style" default="Long brown curly hair, wearing a silk headband"} The makeup is fresh and simple. Clothing: an oversized black Gucci-style printed streetwear T-shirt with a striking red and green luxury logo pattern; light blue high-end distressed jeans with noticeable rips at the thighs and knees; limited-edition black, white, and red high-top sneakers; a wristwatch; and a beige designer canvas backpack with a dark monogram pattern slung over one shoulder. The tunnel is a long, arched acrylic passageway with a damp, reflective dark panel floor, illuminated by low-lying rectangular wall lamps that emit the aquarium's characteristic blue light, with strong guiding lines extending into the distance. The surrounding water is a vibrant deep blue, with shimmering, causticized light above. Six sharks are clearly visible in the background: one large shark in the upper left, one medium-sized shark in the middle left, one small shark in the middle left, one large shark in the upper right, one shark in the far right center, and one small shark in the far right center. The tunnel is flanked by corals and reefs, with small tropical fish scattered around. All the sharks, corals, and distant tunnel details in the background are clear and perfectly focused. A full-body portrait was shot from a low to eye-level angle, simulating the effect of a Canon R5, using a 24mm lens, f/8 depth of field, ISO 800, and a blend of neutral studio-grade daylight simulation and aquarium blue lighting. The results are clear and realistic textures, strong reflections, high dynamic range, natural skin tones, no blurring, and no text obscuring.

promptLocalized.zh: 超写实广角时尚大片，拍摄一位 {argument name="subject" default="年轻女性"} 正迈步走在透明的水下水族馆鲨鱼隧道中，并望向镜头。她留着 {argument name="hair style" default="棕色长卷发，佩戴丝绸发带"}，妆容清新简约。服装：黑色超大款 Gucci 风格印花街头 T 恤，带有醒目的红绿奢华 Logo 图案；浅蓝色高档做旧牛仔裤，大腿和膝盖处有明显的破洞设计；黑白红配色限量版高帮运动鞋；佩戴腕表；单肩背着一个带有深色老花图案的米色设计师帆布双肩包。隧道为长拱形亚克力通道，地面为湿润且具有反光效果的深色面板，配有低位长方形壁灯，呈现水族馆特有的蓝色灯光，强烈的引导线向远处延伸。周围水域为生动的深蓝色，上方有波光粼粼的焦散光影。背景中清晰可见 6 条鲨鱼：左上方 1 条大型鲨鱼，左中位置 1 条中型鲨鱼，左侧中部 1 条小型鲨鱼，右上方 1 条大型鲨鱼，右中远处 1 条鲨鱼，以及右侧中心远处 1 条小型鲨鱼。隧道两侧布满珊瑚和岩礁，周围散布着小型热带鱼，所有背景中的鲨鱼、珊瑚及远处的隧道细节均清晰且对焦完美。采用低至平视角度拍摄全身人像，模拟 Canon R5 拍摄效果，24mm 镜头，f/8 大景深，ISO 800，中性摄影棚级日光模拟与水族馆蓝色灯光混合，纹理清晰逼真，反光质感强烈，高动态范围，肤色自然，无模糊，无文字遮盖。

templates.title: Children's crayon-style Mr. Bean Holiday poster

titleLocalized.zh: 儿童蜡笔画风格 Mr Bean Holiday 海报

templates.prompt: Create a flat-scan style children's crayon and colored pencil drawing on white lined notebook paper. The paper has distinct blue horizontal lines, a red vertical margin on the left, slight paper texture, and three perforations on the left edge. Reconstruct a fun movie poster composition with the theme of {argument name="movie title" default="MR. BEAN'S HOLIDAY"} On the right side of the image, an awkward adult man in a grey suit jacket, white shirt, bright red tie, brown trousers, grey socks, and shiny black shoes is stepping out of a yellow train door, his right hand hanging down, carrying a brown checkered briefcase. His left leg is exaggeratedly kicked upwards and to the left, his anatomy simplified and lines wobbly. A simple brown rectangular occlusion is placed in the center of his face, but parts of his dark hair and ears are still visible. The background is filled with heavy, uneven blue crayon doodles as the sky, and in the lower left corner is a simplified small beach scene containing three horizontal bands of color: dark blue ocean, green coastline, and light yellow sand. The train is a tall, yellow, vertical shape on the right, with a black door frame outline and blue handrails, drawn with a childlike perspective. A large handwritten poster font is added in the center of the left side, stacked in two lines: the first line shows {argument name="top title text" default="MR. BEAN'S"} The first line uses blue block letters, with a large "BEAN'S" preceded by a smaller "MR."; the second line displays {argument name="bottom title text" default="HOLIDAY"} The lettering uses red block letters, both outlined in black, and the layout resembles a movie poster title. A small luggage tag is attached to the suitcase handle, which reads {argument name="luggage tag text" default="MR BEAN"} Using shaky crayon lines, uneven coloring that extends beyond the outline, simple facial and body details, and dense doodle strokes, it presents an innocent elementary school student drawing style while retaining the layout of a movie poster.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张在白色横线笔记本纸上的平面扫描风格儿童蜡笔及彩色铅笔画，纸张带有明显的蓝色横线、左侧红色竖向页边线、轻微的纸张纹理，以及左边缘 3 个打孔。重构一张趣味十足的电影海报构图，主题为 {argument name="movie title" default="MR. BEAN'S HOLIDAY"}：画面右侧，一名穿着灰色西装外套、白色衬衫、亮红色领带、棕色长裤、灰色袜子和闪亮黑皮鞋的笨拙成年男子正从黄色火车车门走出，右手下垂提着一个棕色格子手提箱。他的左腿向左上方夸张地踢出，解剖结构简化且线条摇晃。在他的脸部中心放置一个简单的棕褐色长方形遮挡块，但保留部分深色头发和耳朵可见。背景填充着厚重且不均匀的蓝色蜡笔涂鸦作为天空，左下角是一个简化的小型海滩场景，包含 3 条水平色带：深蓝色海洋、绿色海岸线和浅黄色沙滩。火车是右侧一个高大的黄色垂直形状，带有黑色门框轮廓和蓝色扶手，以稚嫩的透视感绘制。在左侧中心添加大型手写海报字体，分为 2 行堆叠：第一行显示 {argument name="top title text" default="MR. BEAN'S"}，采用蓝色块状字母，巨大的“BEAN'S”前带有较小的“MR.”；第二行显示 {argument name="bottom title text" default="HOLIDAY"}，采用红色块状字母，两者均有黑色描边，布局如同电影海报标题。在手提箱把手上系一个小行李牌，上面写着 {argument name="luggage tag text" default="MR BEAN"}。使用摇晃不稳的蜡笔线条、超出轮廓的不均匀填色、简单的面部和身体细节、密集的涂鸦笔触，呈现出一种天真的小学生绘画风格，同时保留电影海报的布局。

templates.title: Elegant camel coat portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 静奢风驼色大衣人像

templates.prompt: Create a realistic portrait of a fashion editor, with the subject being {argument name="subject" default="A woman with a short black bob haircut"} She stood by a tall window in the room, half-hidden behind semi-transparent linen curtains that let in warm sunlight. She was wearing a minimalist dress.{argument name="coat color" default="Camel"} A wool coat, loosely draped over the shoulders, features a soft silhouette with a wide lapel, a single dark button, and flap pockets. It's worn over a simple top.{argument name="inner garment" default="Ivory white silk camisole"} Her face is blurred with smooth rectangles to maintain anonymity, one hand gently clutching the collar of her dress. The style emphasizes understated luxury, showcasing a restrained feel inspired by The Row—no logos, no accessories, no bags, no jewelry, only the elegant drape of fabrics and refined proportions. A warm beige interior background, soft shadows, shallow depth of field, natural window light, delicate film grain, soft neutral tones, and a high-end magazine photography feel are used. The vertical composition and half-body framing create a tranquil and contemplative atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实风格的时尚编辑人像，主体为 {argument name="subject" default="一位留着黑色短波波头的女性"}，她站在室内一扇高大的窗户旁，半掩在透着暖色日光、半透明的亚麻窗帘后。她身穿一件极简主义 {argument name="coat color" default="驼色"} 羊毛大衣，大衣松散地披在肩上，采用柔和的廓形剪裁，配有宽翻领、单颗深色纽扣和翻盖口袋，内搭一件简约的 {argument name="inner garment" default="象牙白丝绸吊带衫"}。她的面部被平滑的矩形模糊处理以保持匿名，一只手轻轻抓着胸前的衣领。强调静奢风格，展现受 The Row 启发的克制感，无 Logo，无配饰，无包袋，无珠宝，仅呈现优雅的织物垂坠感与精致的比例。采用暖米色室内背景，柔和阴影，浅景深，自然窗光，细腻胶片颗粒，柔和中性色调，高端杂志摄影质感，竖构图，半身取景，营造宁静沉思的氛围。

templates.title: Xahau Panda Street Style Poster

titleLocalized.zh: Xahau Panda 街头风海报

templates.prompt: Create a vibrant, street-style character poster with a white background and cyan and gold splatter brushstrokes. The main subject is an anthropomorphic figure.{argument name="animal character" default="panda"} The character assumes a confident two-thirds profile, looking to the side, one hand in their pocket, the other holding a magnificent vertical cane/staff adorned with gold and blue geometric symbols. They wear a striking Aztec/Mesoamerican-style feather headdress (blue, emerald, navy, black, and gold), a gold ceremonial forehead mask, layered turquoise and gold jewelry, an oversized black bomber jacket with gold patches and blue trim, a white printed T-shirt with stylized ancient mask patterns, loose black cargo pants with blue straps and gold side details, chunky green, black, and white sneakers, gloves, and a small blue crossbody bag with a gold mask emblem. A clearly visible, fluffy black, white, and blue tail is added to the back of their legs. The composition includes three striking handwritten characters on the left, reading "{argument name="headline text" default="BUILDING ON XAHAU"} The text, with "BUILDING" and "XAHAU" in deep cyan and "ON" in metallic gold, is placed diagonally and given a hand-drawn texture with a splatter effect. In the background on the right, a large, fine-lined white mask illustration is added to a deep cyan brushstroke panel. The overall style is a high-contrast comic/anime concept art style, featuring sharp ink lines, vibrant splatter effects, detailed fabric folds, gold highlights, and a sophisticated, encrypted street culture aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张充满活力的街头风角色海报，背景为白色，带有青色和金色的喷溅笔触。主体是一个拟人化的 {argument name="animal character" default="熊猫"}，全身呈自信的三分之二侧身姿势，看向侧面，一只手插在口袋里，另一只手拿着一根装饰有金青色几何符号的华丽垂直手杖/手杖。角色佩戴着引人注目的阿兹特克/中美洲风格羽毛头饰（青色、祖母绿、海军蓝、黑色和金色）、金色仪式前额面具装饰、层叠的绿松石与金色首饰，身穿带有金色补丁和青色饰边的黑色超大号飞行员夹克、印有程式化古老面具图案的白色印花 T 恤、带有青色绑带和金色侧边细节的宽松黑色工装裤、厚实的绿黑白配色运动鞋、手套，以及一个带有金色面具徽章的小型青色斜挎包。在腿部后方添加一条清晰可见的蓬松黑白青三色尾巴。构图包括左侧 3 个醒目的手写体大字，内容为“{argument name="headline text" default="BUILDING ON XAHAU"}”，其中“BUILDING”和“XAHAU”为深青色，“ON”为金属金色；将文字斜向放置，并呈现出带有喷溅效果的手绘质感。在右侧背景中，在深青色笔触面板上添加一个大型细线条白色面具插图。采用高对比度的漫画/动漫概念艺术风格，具有锐利的墨线、充满活力的喷溅效果、细致的布料褶皱、金色高光以及高端加密街头文化美学。

templates.title: Maximalist Sky Temple City

titleLocalized.zh: 极繁主义天空寺庙之城

templates.prompt: Create a maximalist fantasy cityscape showcasing magnificent East Asian architecture. Employ a low, wide-angle perspective, looking upwards into a deep canyon comprised of cascading temples and cliffside structures. At the center of the scene is a massive, ornate palace gate and a multi-tiered temple complex, complete with dark, arched roofs, gilded carvings, red pillars, hanging crimson flags, lanterns, prayer flags, rope bridges, suspended balconies, and countless intricate architectural details. In the background stands an incredible vertical megastructure, composed of densely packed pagodas, towers, terraces, skywalks, circular observatory-style platforms, and scaffolded shrines, soaring into the clouds, as if an ancient sacred city has grown into a colossal mountain metropolis.{argument name="architectural culture" default="Tibetan, Chinese and Himalayan temple styles"} ,{argument name="primary accent color" default="Deep crimson"} Rich gold accents, weathered dark wood, stone walls, metal carvings, and lush vegetation clinging to the rock ledges. Includes multiple slender waterfalls cascading from the cliffs on either side, floating mist, beams of sunlight piercing through dramatic blue skies and cumulus clouds, atmospheric haze conveying a grand scale, tiny figures and walkways adding depth, and a dense foreground framed by shadowy eaves on either side.{argument name="visual style" default="Cinematic Hyperrealistic Fantasy Concept Art"} Extremely high detail, epic scale, sharp and gorgeous textures, volumetric lighting, rich contrast, stunning vertical composition, 16:9 widescreen, no text, no modern vehicles, no sci-fi neon lights.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅极繁主义奇幻城市景观，呈现宏伟的东亚建筑风格。采用低位广角视角，向上仰望由层叠寺庙和悬崖建筑构成的深邃峡谷。场景中心为一座巨大的华丽宫殿大门和多层寺庙建筑群，配有深色弧形屋顶、镀金雕花饰边、红色立柱、悬挂的深红色旗帜、灯笼、经幡、绳桥、悬空阳台以及无数细微的建筑细节。背景中矗立着一座不可思议的垂直巨型结构，由密集堆叠的宝塔、塔楼、露台、空中走廊、圆形天文台式平台和脚手架神龛组成，直入云雾之中，仿佛一座古老的神圣城市生长成了一座巨大的山中大都市。添加 {argument name="architectural culture" default="藏式、中式及喜马拉雅寺庙风格"}，{argument name="primary accent color" default="深绯红色"}，丰富的金色装饰、风化的深色木材、石墙、金属雕花，以及附着在岩架上的茂密植被。包含多条从左右两侧悬崖倾泻而下的细长瀑布、漂浮的薄雾、穿透戏剧性蓝天与积云的阳光束、展现宏大尺度的空气感雾霾、用于增加深度的微小人物与步道，以及两侧阴影屋檐形成的浓密前景框架。使用 {argument name="visual style" default="电影级超写实奇幻概念艺术"}，极高细节，史诗尺度，锐利的华丽纹理，体积光，丰富的对比度，令人惊叹的垂直构图，16:9 宽屏，无文字，无现代交通工具，无科幻霓虹灯。

templates.title: Sunset Beach Samurai Pose

titleLocalized.zh: 日落海滩武士姿势

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as a posing and movement guide, the model was replaced with a realistic adult female warrior, maintaining the same kneeling lunge pose: one knee on the ground, the other leg forward, the left hand clawing near the knee, and the right hand holding a katana overhead. Using REFERENCE_1 as a lighting, color, and environment guide: a dramatic golden-orange sunset beach scene was presented, with the sun behind the subject, shimmering sea, wet sand, visible rocks in the distance, strong backlighting, lens flare, and a high-contrast, cinematic warm color palette. Using REFERENCE_2 as a hairstyle guide: long, messy, wet black hair, with loose strands falling around the face and neck, creating a damp texture. A practical beach combat outfit was added:{argument name="top" default="Black asymmetrical crop top"} ,{argument name="bottom" default="Brown wrap-around shorts"} ,as well as{argument name="footwear" default="Black strappy sandals"} Similar to the reference image, use a square privacy occlusion block to cover the face. To achieve photorealistic results, use a full-body, vertical composition and emphasize the sunset's afterglow through highlights on the water and skin. The number of weapons is strictly limited to one samurai sword.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 作为姿势和动作指南，将模特替换为一名逼真的成年女性战士，保持相同的跪姿弓步：一只膝盖着地，另一条腿向前，左手呈爪状靠近前膝，右手将一把武士刀举过头顶。以 REFERENCE_1 作为光影、色彩和环境指南：呈现戏剧性的金橙色日落海滩场景，太阳位于主体后方，海面波光粼粼，沙滩湿润，远处可见岩石，强烈的逆光效果，镜头光晕，以及高对比度的电影感暖色调。以 REFERENCE_2 作为发型指南：长款凌乱的湿润黑发，松散的发丝垂落在脸部和颈部周围，呈现潮湿质感。添加一套实用的海滩战斗装束：{argument name="top" default="黑色不对称露脐上衣"}，{argument name="bottom" default="棕褐色裹身短裙裤"}，以及 {argument name="footwear" default="黑色绑带凉鞋"}。像参考图一样，用方形隐私遮挡块遮住面部。使图像达到照片级逼真效果，采用全身、竖构图，并通过水面和皮肤的高光来强调日落的余晖。武器数量严格限制为 1 把武士刀。

templates.title: A magical girl in a cozy kitchen

titleLocalized.zh: 温馨厨房里的魔法少女

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed, cinematic-quality anime illustration, in which {argument name="character name" default="A pink magical girl protagonist"} She sat sideways on the warm wooden kitchen counter, a gray mug in one hand and a small spoon near her lips in the other, as if savoring tea or a dessert. She kept {argument name="hair color" default="Bright pink"} She had messy twin ponytails adorned with ribbons and flowers, and possessed large, sparkling eyes and a gentle, curious smile. She wore a gorgeous dress {argument name="outfit color" default="pink and white"} A ruffled magical girl dress, adorned with bows, gold trim, lace ruffles, split sleeves, white over-the-knee boots, long ribbons, and hanging star ornaments. The backdrop is a warm, realistic kitchen, bathed in golden light. Sunlight streams in from the left window, a potted basil plant and small bottles sit beside the sink, complemented by white cabinets, cream-colored tile backsplashes, and warm under-cabinet lighting. Six hanging kitchen utensils are precisely displayed on a metal shelf behind her: a small frying pan, a narrow ladle, a large slotted spoon, a shiny round ladle, a strainer, and a black spatula. On the countertop in front of her are neatly arranged chopped vegetables: carrot slices, leafy greens, cherry tomatoes, mushrooms, garlic cloves, and small chili peppers. On the gas stove to the right sits a reflective chrome kettle, spouting water in wing-like or patterned shapes.{argument name="magic color" default="pink"} Stylized glowing steam, surrounded by tiny flashes, sits beside a large cauldron simmering. The style combines a realistic kitchen environment with exquisitely rendered anime characters, featuring rich reflections, shallow depth of field, warm orange highlights, cool sunlight and shadows, intricate fabric details, and a fantastical magical atmosphere, all in a 4:3 ratio.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高度精细的电影级动漫插画，画面中 {argument name="character name" default="一位粉色魔法少女主角"} 侧坐在温暖的木质厨房台面上，一只手拿着灰色马克杯，另一只手拿着小勺靠近嘴边，仿佛正在品尝茶或甜点。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="亮粉色"} 的双马尾，发丝凌乱，装饰着丝带和花朵，拥有闪烁的大眼睛和温柔好奇的微笑。她身穿华丽的 {argument name="outfit color" default="粉白相间"} 荷叶边魔法少女裙，配有蝴蝶结、金色饰边、蕾丝褶皱、分离式袖子、白色过膝靴、长长的飘带和悬挂的星星挂件。背景是一个温馨写实的厨房，正值黄金时刻，左侧窗户透入阳光，水槽旁摆放着盆栽罗勒和小瓶子，配有白色橱柜、奶油色瓷砖防溅板和温暖的橱柜下照明。在身后的金属架上准确展示六件悬挂的厨具：一个小平底锅、一个窄长汤勺、一个大漏勺、一个闪亮的圆汤勺、一个滤网和一个黑色锅铲。她面前的台面上整齐摆放着切好的蔬菜：胡萝卜片、绿叶菜、圣女果、蘑菇、大蒜瓣和小辣椒。右侧的燃气灶上放着一个反光的铬合金水壶，冒出形状如翅膀或花纹的 {argument name="magic color" default="粉色"} 风格化发光蒸汽，周围环绕着细小的闪光，旁边还有一个正在炖煮的大汤锅。采用写实厨房环境与精致动漫角色渲染相结合的风格，具有丰富的反射效果、浅景深、温暖的橙色高光、清冷的日光阴影、复杂的布料细节和奇幻的魔法氛围，比例为 4:3。

templates.title: Anime female swordsman in the wet market

titleLocalized.zh: 湿货市场里的动漫女剑士

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic, realistic wet market scene, and naturally composite a 2D anime-style female swordsman into the realistic environment. The character is {argument name="character name" default="A blue-haired anime female swordsman"} She sat sideways on a beige plastic vegetable basket in the middle of a crowded indoor Chinese farmers' market, holding a long bunch of green onions in both hands, as if selecting or buying them. She had very long {argument name="hair color" default="Dark blue"} She wears a high ponytail with a few stray strands, dressed in a gorgeous blue and white fantasy-style kimono with layered cuffs, a white pleated skirt, dark arm guards, navy blue leggings, sandals, gold trim, and small tassel embellishments. A sheathed katana is slung across her left shoulder. Her face is softly blurred in a rectangular shape to conceal her identity, while the rest of her body is depicted clearly. Small yellow cartoon exclamation marks are added near the onion to emphasize surprise or attention. The background is a realistic, bustling farmers' market with wet, reflective concrete floors, fluorescent lights overhead, and blurred faces of customers and vendors. Baskets piled high with leafy greens, tomatoes, and peppers, along with handwritten price tags in Chinese, displaying {argument name="price sign text" default="Scallions are 2.2 yuan per jin (500g)"} and{argument name="second price sign text" default="Celery is 2.2 yuan per jin (500g)"} The scene needs to include two clearly visible price tags, many stacked vegetable baskets, and create a damp market atmosphere. A hybrid style should be used: the environment should have a realistic documentary style, while the characters should be rendered with delicate cel animation, combined with realistic lighting effects, a slight depth of field, a 16:9 aspect ratio, high detail, natural shadows, and the glossy reflection of the wet ground, presenting an urban lifestyle, as if a fantasy game character has accidentally visited the local market.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影级写实风格的湿货市场场景，将一位 2D 动漫风格的女剑士自然地合成到真实环境中。角色为 {argument name="character name" default="一位蓝发动漫女剑士"}，侧身坐在拥挤的中国室内农贸市场中间的一个米色塑料蔬菜筐上，双手拿着一捆长长的青葱，仿佛正在挑选或购买。她留着非常长的 {argument name="hair color" default="深蓝色"} 高马尾，有几缕碎发，身穿华丽的蓝白配色幻想风和服，配有层叠袖口、白色百褶短裙、深色护臂、海军蓝绑腿、凉鞋、金色镶边和小流苏装饰，左侧斜挎着一把带鞘的武士刀。她的面部经过柔和的矩形模糊处理以隐藏身份，而身体其他部分则刻画得十分清晰。在葱的附近添加黄色的小型漫画感叹号，以强调惊讶或关注。背景是一个真实的繁忙农贸市场，地面是潮湿且带有反光的混凝土，头顶是日光灯管，周围是面部模糊的顾客和摊贩，堆满了绿叶蔬菜、番茄和辣椒篮子，以及手写的中文价格牌，上面写着 {argument name="price sign text" default="小葱 2.2元一斤"} 和 {argument name="second price sign text" default="芹菜 2.2元一斤"}。画面中需包含两个清晰可见的价格牌、许多堆叠的蔬菜筐，并营造出潮湿的市场氛围。采用混合风格：环境采用写实纪录片摄影风格，角色采用细腻的赛璐珞动漫渲染，结合逼真的光影效果，带有轻微的景深，16:9 构图，高细节，自然阴影，湿润地面的光泽反射，呈现出都市生活气息，仿佛一位幻想游戏角色偶然造访了当地的菜市场。

templates.title: Anime warriors eating ramen

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫战士吃拉面

templates.prompt: Create a scene with a cinematic, anime-style feel:{argument name="character description" default="A young, red-haired fantasy female warrior with a long ponytail"} She sat on a round stool in front of the narrow counter of a Japanese ramen shop late at night. She was wearing {argument name="outfit" default="A red and black leather armor with gold trim, complete with a belt, straps, arm guards, thigh straps, and high boots."} She leans forward casually, using chopsticks to scoop noodles from a steaming bowl of ramen. Her other hand rests on the brushed metal counter. The ramen bowl glows warmly, steam rising and forming a clear white mist. The scene is a secluded alleyway ramen bar, complete with a stainless steel counter, chopstick holder, condiment bottles, chili oil jar, cooking pot, tiled walls, a Japanese menu hanging on the wall, and the blurry figure of a chef behind the counter. Outside the open entrance is a damp, late-night city alley, with reflections on the ground, softly out-of-focus lighting, a sign, and a red lantern. The design contrasts warm amber interior lighting with cool, dark blue street tones, shallow depth of field, realistic environmental details, glossy reflections, cinematic composition, a 3/4 side view, a medium-wide angle, and highly detailed anime illustrations combined with realistic background textures. A square soft-focus occlusion block is added to the character's face, centered on the face to obscure facial features. Atmosphere: Comfortable, atmospheric, urban, slightly rough, late-night meal after a battle.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅电影感动漫风格的场景：{argument name="character description" default="一位留着长高马尾的红发年轻奇幻女战士"} 坐在深夜狭窄日式拉面店柜台前的圆凳上。她穿着 {argument name="outfit" default="带有金色饰边的红黑配色皮甲，配有腰带、绑带、护臂、大腿绑带和高筒靴"}，随意地向前倾身，手持筷子从热气腾腾的拉面碗中挑起面条。她的另一只手放在拉丝金属柜台上。拉面碗散发着温暖的光芒，蒸汽向上缭绕，形成清晰的白色烟雾。场景是一家私密的巷边拉面吧，配有不锈钢柜台、筷筒、调味瓶、辣椒油罐、烹饪锅、瓷砖墙壁、挂着的日文菜单项目，以及柜台后模糊的厨师身影。开放式入口外是潮湿的深夜城市小巷，地面上有倒影、柔和的焦外成像灯光、招牌和一个红灯笼。使用温暖的琥珀色室内灯光与冷暗的蓝色街道色调形成对比，浅景深，逼真的环境细节，光泽反射，电影级构图，3/4 侧视图，中广角取景，高度详细的动漫插画与写实背景纹理相结合。在角色面部添加一个方形柔焦遮挡块，以面部为中心，遮住面部特征。氛围：舒适、有氛围感、都市、略带粗粝感、战斗后的深夜餐点。
