templates.prompt: Create a realistic vertical outdoor fashion portrait, with the subject being {argument name="subject" default="Young female model"} Keep it{argument name="hair color" default="Long silver-white platinum blonde hair"} Her hair was softly parted to the side and slightly ruffled by the wind, falling over her shoulder. She wore a simple dress.{argument name="outfit" default="Loose white long-sleeved top"} She wears a black rope necklace with a small silver crescent pendant. The shot is taken from above the chest, in a relaxed two-thirds profile, with one hand raised near her cheek and hair, revealing delicate fingers. An opaque square privacy mask in a soft beige color is placed in the center of her face, obscuring her eyes, nose, and mouth, while revealing her hair, ears, chin, hands, and clothing. Warm backlighting with bright rim lighting around the hair creates a dreamy, shallow depth of field effect, with soft, circular bokeh of peach and pale purple scattered in the background. The scene should appear as a blurred, bluish-gray cityscape or building facade. The shot is taken with a soft editing style, maintaining natural skin tone in visible areas, high-key exposure, a 9:16 vertical composition, simulating real camera optics, and a soft, cinematic tone.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实风格的竖版户外时尚肖像，主体为 {argument name="subject" default="年轻女性模特"}，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="长款银白色铂金发"}，头发柔和地侧分并被风微微吹乱，垂落在肩头。她穿着一件简约的 {argument name="outfit" default="宽松白色长袖上衣"}，佩戴一条黑色绳状项链，挂坠为一个银色小月牙。采用胸部以上的构图，呈现放松的三分之二侧身姿态，一只手抬起靠近脸颊和头发，露出精致的手指。在面部中心放置一个不透明的方形隐私遮挡块，颜色为柔和的米粉色，遮住眼睛、鼻子和嘴巴，同时露出头发、耳朵、下巴边缘、手部和衣物。使用温暖的背光阳光，头发边缘带有明亮的轮廓光，营造梦幻的浅景深效果，背景中分布着桃色和淡紫色的柔和圆形焦外光斑。场景应呈现为模糊成蓝灰调的城市街道或建筑外墙。采用柔和的编辑风格拍摄，可见皮肤区域保持自然肤色，高调曝光，9:16 竖构图，模拟真实相机光学效果，色调处理具有柔和的电影质感。

titleLocalized.zh: 咖啡馆英语词汇学习日志

promptLocalized.zh: {"type":"基于照片的英语词汇学习日志页面","format":"9:16 竖版社交媒体图片","base_scene":"一张写实的咖啡馆抓拍照片，一位年轻女性坐在大窗户旁的木桌前，一手拿着黑色智能手机，低头温婉地看着。她穿着米色罗纹毛衣，留着深棕色长发和柔和的刘海。她面前放着一本打开的书，左侧有一个带有拉花图案的白色咖啡杯，前景中有一个放在白色盘子里的羊角面包，右侧有一个米色单肩包。自然光从窗户射入，窗外隐约可见树木和街道。温暖舒适的色调，生活化摄影，浅景深，构图简洁。","overlay_style":{"description":"添加可爱的白色手绘涂鸦注释，营造语言学习笔记本的风格，使用粉笔/马克笔风格的字体、下划线、箭头、物体轮廓、小爱心、星星、圆点和闪光标记。注释应与真实照片融为一体，既俏皮又具有教育意义，且不会显得过于杂乱。","language":"带有简单例句的英语词汇"},"vocabulary_items":{"count":6,"items":[{"word":"phone","position":"女性左侧，靠近智能手机处","target":"她手中的黑色智能手机","example":"My phone is in my hand.","decoration":"手机周围有白色轮廓，单词下方有下划线，虚线箭头指向手机"},{"word":"cup","position":"左下方，靠近咖啡处","target":"白色咖啡杯","example":"This cup has coffee.","decoration":"杯子周围有白色轮廓，旁边有小爱心，箭头指向杯子"},{"word":"book","position":"中心，在打开的书上方","target":"桌上打开的书","example":"I read a book.","decoration":"单词旁边有小爱心，箭头向下指向书本"},{"word":"bag","position":"右侧，在米色包上方","target":"桌上的米色单肩包","example":"My bag is on the table.","decoration":"下划线，强调光线，箭头指向包，包周围有部分白色轮廓"},{"word":"croissant","position":"左下方，靠近糕点处","target":"盘子里的羊角面包","example":"I eat a croissant.","decoration":"下划线，小星星，虚线箭头指向羊角面包"},{"word":"plate","position":"右下方，靠近餐具处","target":"羊角面包下方的白色盘子","example":"The plate is on the table.","decoration":"下划线，小爱心，箭头指向盘子，盘子周围有白色轮廓"}]},"decorative_elements":{"count":7,"items":["右上角附近的小涂鸦星星","右上角附近的微小虚线闪光簇","右上角附近的小涂鸦星星","右上角附近带有放射线的爱心","左下角附近的两颗微小星星","左下角拿着标语牌的 Q 版女孩贴纸","贴纸上的对话/标语文字：Let's learn!"]},"customization":{"main subject":"{argument name=\"main subject\" default=\"在咖啡馆学习的年轻女性\"}","setting":"{argument name=\"setting\" default=\"大窗户旁的温馨咖啡馆\"}","vocabulary theme":"{argument name=\"vocabulary theme\" default=\"日常咖啡馆物品\"}","annotation color":"{argument name=\"annotation color\" default=\"白色\"}","sticker text":"{argument name=\"sticker text\" default=\"Let's learn!\"}"},"quality":"照片级真实感底图，搭配整洁的手绘教育注释，温暖的自然光，高分辨率，手机壁纸比例，迷人的学习日志美学"}

promptLocalized.zh: {"type":"垂直照片风格的英语词汇笔记页面","source_scene":"一张从平视角度拍摄的写实便利店或小型超市过道照片，高大的金属货架上摆满了零食、饮料、牛奶、面包、纸巾和日用品；前景地板上放着一个装有水果和杂货的红色购物篮；右侧有一个放着一把黑色雨伞的雨伞架","style":"保持底图的写实感，然后在照片上方添加可爱的白色手绘学习笔记标注，如同随意的马克笔书写；使用圆润的手写英文字体、白色涂鸦轮廓、箭头、闪光符号和柔和的投影以确保易读性","aspect_ratio":"9:16 垂直智能手机图像","layout":{"annotated_vocabulary_count":5,"vocabulary_items":[{"word":"{argument name=\"first vocabulary word\" default=\"milk\"}","example_sentence":"{argument name=\"first example sentence\" default=\"Milk is on the shelf.\"}","target":"右上角货架上的牛奶瓶","annotation":"在牛奶瓶组周围添加白色圆润轮廓，箭头从单词指向瓶子，放置在右上侧附近"},{"word":"bottle","example_sentence":"The bottle has water.","target":"中间货架上的一瓶深色水","annotation":"在瓶子周围添加小白色轮廓，弯曲箭头和标签放置在左侧中部"},{"word":"bread","example_sentence":"This bread is soft.","target":"右侧中间货架上塑料包装的面包","annotation":"在几袋面包周围添加大白色轮廓，箭头和标签放置在右侧中心"},{"word":"umbrella","example_sentence":"The umbrella is by the shelf.","target":"右下角灰色金属雨伞架中的黑色雨伞","annotation":"沿雨伞和架子添加白色轮廓，箭头和标签放置在右下角"},{"word":"basket","example_sentence":"The basket is red.","target":"前景地板上的红色购物篮","annotation":"在购物篮周围添加白色轮廓，虚线弯曲箭头和标签放置在左下角"}]},"visual_details":{"doodles":"在左上角和左下角等空白区域添加白色小闪光涂鸦；在右上角和雨伞附近添加短促的强调笔触","text_treatment":"大号小写词汇单词，单词下方为较小的例句，全部采用白色手写字体并带有微妙阴影","composition":"繁忙的超市货架作为背景，标注保持清晰易读，并放置在对应物体附近，且不会遮挡过多商品","lighting":"明亮的室内荧光灯照明，具有自然的抓拍感","language_learning_goal":"将日常生活照片转化为有趣的视觉英语词汇学习日记页面"}}

templates.title: Laundry Balcony Vocabulary Log

titleLocalized.zh: 洗衣阳台词汇日志

templates.prompt:
{
  "type": "A photo-based visual English vocabulary log page",
  "source_scene": "A realistic vertical smartphone photo taken from the doorway shows a laundry balcony in a small apartment, bathed in soft light. On the left is a tall, latticed window offering views of neighboring buildings; in the middle is a metal clothes rack with clothes hanging on it; on the right is a washing machine with a potted plant on top; in the lower left corner is a perforated laundry basket full of clothes; near the bottom are pink slippers on the floor; the floor is gray tiled, and there are beige cabinets on the walls.",
  "style": "Maintaining the realism and naturalness of the original photo, a cute white handwritten study notebook is then overlaid, featuring hand-drawn arrows, outlines, highlights, brackets, and underlined doodles; a casual scrapbook/language learning diary style; clear and legible font with subtle shadows to enhance contrast.",
  "format": {
    "orientation": "Vertical 9:16 Smartphone Poster",
    "composition": "Place the labels directly next to the corresponding objects without obstructing the scene; use white marker-style text and doodles."
  },
  "vocabulary_overlay": {
    "headline": "No main title, only numbered word tags placed around the image.",
    "count": 6,
    "items": [
      {
        "number": 1,
        "word": "{argument name=\"word 1\" default=\"window\"}",
        "example_sentence": "{argument name=\"sentence 1\" default=\"I open the window.\"}",
        "target_object": "The large window panes and metal railings in the upper left and center",
        "placement": "Near the upper right of the window",
        "doodles": "The curved arrow pointing to the window, the small emphasis line, and the short underline below the sentence."
      },
      {
        "number": 2,
        "word": "{argument name=\"word 2\" default=\"shirt\"}",
        "example_sentence": "{argument name=\"sentence 2\" default=\"This shirt is clean.\"}",
        "target_object": "A light blue shirt hanging on the clothes rack",
        "placement": "Next to the hanging shirt, lower left",
        "doodles": "The white outline that marks the edge of the shirt, the arrow pointing towards the shirt, and the small glitter dots."
      },
      {
        "number": 3,
        "word": "towel",
        "example_sentence": "The towel is dry.",
        "target_object": "gray towels hanging on a metal clothes rack",
        "placement": "Below the towel, slightly to the right of center",
        "doodles": "An upward arrow pointing to the towel and a simple underline."
      },
      {
        "number": 4,
        "word": "basket",
        "example_sentence": "The basket is full.",
        "target_object": "The round plastic laundry basket filled with clothes in the lower left corner",
        "placement": "Next to the laundry basket, lower left",
        "doodles": "White outlines along the edges and sides of the laundry basket, arrows pointing towards the basket, subtle emphasis strokes, and underlines."
      },
      {
        "number": 5,
        "word": "slippers",
        "example_sentence": "My slippers are here.",
        "target_object": "A pair of light pink slippers on the floor near the bottom",
        "placement": "The top of the slippers, slightly to the right of the center of the bottom.",
        "doodles": "The white outline around the two slippers, the curved arrows pointing to them, the small glitter, the underline"
      },
      {
        "number": 6,
        "word": "plant",
        "example_sentence": "The plant is green.",
        "target_object": "Green potted plants above the washing machine",
        "placement": "Next to the plant, upper right",
        "doodles": "The white outline around the leaves and pot, the arrows encircling the plant, the glitter."
      }
    ]
  },
  "text_rendering": "Use a clear, white, handwritten font, bolding vocabulary and slightly smaller example sentences. Number each item from 1 to 6. Add playful notebook-style markers, but ensure all text is legible.",
  "lighting_and_mood": "Bright, overcast lighting; a cozy, everyday home atmosphere; a combination of realistic photography and captivating study notes."
}

promptLocalized.zh:
{
  "type": "基于照片的视觉化英语词汇日志页面",
  "source_scene": "一张从门口拍摄的写实竖版智能手机照片，展示了一个小型公寓的洗衣阳台，光线柔和。左侧有高大的栅栏窗，窗外可见邻近建筑；中间是一个挂着衣服的金属晾衣架；右侧是一台洗衣机，上面放着一盆绿植；左下角有一个装满衣物的穿孔洗衣篮；底部附近地板上有粉色家居拖鞋；地面为灰色瓷砖，墙上有米色橱柜",
  "style": "保持原照片的写实与自然感，随后叠加可爱的白色手写学习笔记，包含手绘箭头、轮廓、闪光点、圆括号和下划线涂鸦；休闲剪贴簿 / 语言学习日记风格；清晰易读的字体，并带有细微阴影以增强对比度",
  "format": {
    "orientation": "竖版 9:16 智能手机海报",
    "composition": "将标签直接放置在对应物体旁边，且不遮挡场景；使用白色马克笔风格的文字和涂鸦"
  },
  "vocabulary_overlay": {
    "headline": "无主标题，仅在图像周围放置编号词汇标签",
    "count": 6,
    "items": [
      {
        "number": 1,
        "word": "{argument name=\"word 1\" default=\"window\"}",
        "example_sentence": "{argument name=\"sentence 1\" default=\"I open the window.\"}",
        "target_object": "左上方和中间的大窗格及金属窗栏",
        "placement": "窗户右上方附近",
        "doodles": "指向窗户的弯曲箭头、小强调线、句子下方的短下划线"
      },
      {
        "number": 2,
        "word": "{argument name=\"word 2\" default=\"shirt\"}",
        "example_sentence": "{argument name=\"sentence 2\" default=\"This shirt is clean.\"}",
        "target_object": "晾衣架上挂着的浅蓝色衬衫",
        "placement": "挂着的衬衫旁，左下方",
        "doodles": "勾勒衬衫边缘的白色轮廓、指向衬衫的箭头、小闪光点"
      },
      {
        "number": 3,
        "word": "towel",
        "example_sentence": "The towel is dry.",
        "target_object": "挂在金属晾衣架上的灰色毛巾",
        "placement": "毛巾下方，中间偏右",
        "doodles": "指向毛巾的向上箭头和简单的下划线"
      },
      {
        "number": 4,
        "word": "basket",
        "example_sentence": "The basket is full.",
        "target_object": "左下方装满衣物的圆形塑料洗衣篮",
        "placement": "洗衣篮旁，左下方",
        "doodles": "洗衣篮边缘和侧面的白色轮廓、指向洗衣篮的箭头、小强调笔触、下划线"
      },
      {
        "number": 5,
        "word": "slippers",
        "example_sentence": "My slippers are here.",
        "target_object": "底部附近地板上的一双浅粉色拖鞋",
        "placement": "拖鞋上方，底部中心偏右",
        "doodles": "两只拖鞋周围的白色轮廓、指向它们的弯曲箭头、小闪光点、下划线"
      },
      {
        "number": 6,
        "word": "plant",
        "example_sentence": "The plant is green.",
        "target_object": "洗衣机上方的绿色盆栽植物",
        "placement": "植物旁，右上方",
        "doodles": "叶片和花盆周围的白色轮廓、环绕植物的箭头、闪光点"
      }
    ]
  },
  "text_rendering": "使用清晰的白色手写字体，词汇加粗，例句字号稍小。按 1 到 6 的顺序为每个项目编号。添加俏皮的笔记本风格标记，但确保所有文字清晰可辨。",
  "lighting_and_mood": "明亮的阴天光线，温馨的日常家居氛围，写实摄影与迷人学习笔记标注的结合"
}

  "type": "Photorealistic before-and-after makeup comparison magazine pages",
  "format": "The unfolded two-page booklet layout features a distinct center crease, a glossy printing finish, and vertically segmented contrast.",

    "description": "A portrait of a young Japanese woman from the shoulders up, with her face deliberately obscured by opaque, skin-colored rectangles on both pages.",
    "hair": "Medium-length hair ranging from dark brown to black; the left side features a messy updo or bare hair, while the right side has glossy, loose, wavy curls.",
    "clothing": "The left side features a casual white crew neck T-shirt, while the right side features an off-the-shoulder or one-shoulder style.",
    "pose": "The left side shows a frontal half-body portrait; the right side shows an elegant, beautiful pose with one hand lightly touching her cheek, her hair framing her face."
  },
  "layout": {
    "sections": [
      {
        "title": "Before",
        "position": "Left page",
        "count": 1,
        "visual_style": "Soft, beige-gray indoor lighting, a natural, unadorned appearance, and a soft, realistic mobile photography feel.",
        "headline": "{argument name=\"before headline text\" default=\"Before\"}",
        "tag_label": "{argument name=\"before tag label\" default=\"すっぴん\"}",
        "checklist_count": 4,
        "checklist_labels": [
          "rough skin",
          "クマ・くすみ",
          "Flat face",
          "Looks tired"
        ]
      },
      {
        "title": "After",
        "position": "Right page",
        "count": 1,
        "visual_style": "Brighter, more radiant makeup lighting; a refined, transformative makeup look; dark, glossy hair; and a clean, professional style.",
        "headline": "{argument name=\"after headline text\" default=\"After\"}",
        "tag_label": "{argument name=\"after tag label\" default=\"After makeup\"}",
        "checklist_count": 4,
        "checklist_labels": [
          "Increased transparency",
          "The eyes appear larger",
          "A facial structure with depth and dimension",
          "A bright and cheerful impression"
        ]
      }
    ],
    "comparison_elements": {
      "arrow_count": 1,
      "arrow_description": "A white, curved arrow points from the Before portrait on the left to the After portrait on the right, crossing the middle crease.",
      "decorations": "The \"After\" label has a small glittery decoration near it; \"Before\" uses handwritten white font, while \"After\" uses pinkish-white handwritten font.",
      "label_boxes": "Below \"Before\" is a black rectangular label box, and below \"After\" is a bright pink rectangular label box.",

  "rendering_instructions": "Create a single, landscape-oriented image showcasing the complete unfolded booklet, visible on both pages. Ensure all Japanese list text is clearly legible. Do not add any extra panels or list items. Keep the privacy occlusion blocks on both faces flat and opaque."
}

templates.title: Anime Hackers in a Futuristic Server Room

titleLocalized.zh: 未来感服务器机房中的动漫黑客

templates.prompt: Create a sci-fi illustration with a cinematic, anime-style aesthetic, depicting a young woman in a high-tech server room, viewed from a slightly sideways angle from behind as she operates a large, transparent holographic touchscreen. She keeps {argument name="hair color" default="gold"} Her hair was tied in a low ponytail with messy bangs; her skin was fair; her expression was focused; one arm was outstretched, her index finger touching a glowing circular interface. She was wearing {argument name="outfit" default="Black sleeveless crop top and black distressed denim shorts"} This gives the scene a sleek and casual hacker/agent vibe. The environment is a dark, futuristic data center corridor, flanked by towering server racks, complete with cyan LED strips, cables, illuminated panels, a reflective metal floor, rectangular light strips overhead, and a sealed sci-fi door in the distance. A holographic display dominates the left side of the composition, featuring densely packed tech UI graphics, circuit diagrams, data panels, and a striking pinkish-white bold warning title that reads:{argument name="headline text" default="VALORIAN INVASION PLAN"} It utilizes dramatic blue cyberpunk lighting, clean lines, exquisite anime rendering, delicate background perspective, glowing transparent glass effects, and a tense secret mission atmosphere. The 16:9 widescreen composition features mid-to-long-range background cinematography, high detail, sharp focus, and no extra characters.

Two pieces of luggage must be precisely depicted in the shot: a small brown leather backpack near her hips by the bed, and a silver hard-shell suitcase with its handle extended, standing on the dark carpet beside the bed. The bed is covered with neat white sheets and pillows, and the walls are a warm beige, creating a comfortable yet weary atmosphere. On the right side of the frame, a wooden desk is placed, with three hotel amenities clearly visible: a white electric kettle, a white mug, and a small tray; a black flat-screen TV should also be on the desk, next to a wooden chair. The shot uses cinematic warm lighting, with delicate shadows, realistic proportions, and rich details in fabric folds, presenting a quiet, late-night atmosphere. There is no text, no watermark, and no other figures in the scene.

templates.title: Anime Punk Rock Music Festival Stage

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫朋克摇滚音乐节舞台

templates.prompt: Create a vibrant, anime-style outdoor rock festival scene with a backdrop of a clear blue sky and scattered white clouds, shot from a dramatic low angle from the front of the stage. The main subject is {argument name="lead singer" default="A young female punk rock singer"} Her posture was powerful; she raised one knee, one black combat boot resting on the large front desk speaker stand, one hand holding a microphone close to her chest, her right hand pointing high into the crowd. This gave her {argument name="hair color" default="Messy, dark brown short hair with bright orange ends."} The character is dressed in a black leather crop top with straps, layered chokers, studded bracelets, fingerless gloves, and an asymmetrical black skirt with belts, buckles, chains, straps, silver rings, and an orange lining that billows in the wind. The image must include exactly three visible band members: the lead singer in the center foreground, the guitarist playing electric guitar next to a microphone stand in the rear left, and the drummer sitting behind the drum kit in the rear right. All faces are rendered as deliberately blurred, smooth rectangles, devoid of any facial features. The scene is surrounded by a large metal truss festival stage, overhead scaffolding, suspended speakers, amplifiers, cables, and stage lighting; four bright, round stage lights are mounted on the right-hand support. Two prominent stacked speaker stands with delicate knobs, screens, gauges, and colored LEDs are added to the lower left foreground. The overall atmosphere should be vibrant, summery, and festival-like, featuring crisp sunlight, high contrast, flowing clothing and hair, cinematic depth of field, delicate lines, vivid colors, and a refined, modern Japanese anime illustration quality. use{argument name="festival theme" default="Spring Golden Week Music Festival"} The atmosphere is such that the image does not contain any readable text or logo.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个充满活力的动漫风格户外摇滚音乐节场景，背景是湛蓝的天空和零星的白云，采用从舞台前方拍摄的戏剧性低角度视角。主体是 {argument name="lead singer" default="一位年轻的朋克摇滚女歌手"}，她姿态强有力，单膝抬起，一只黑色战靴踩在大型前台音响架上，一手将手持麦克风靠近胸前，右手高高指向人群。赋予她 {argument name="hair color" default="凌乱的深棕色短发，发梢带有亮橙色"}，身穿黑色皮革绑带露脐上衣、叠戴项圈、铆钉手环、露指手套，以及带有皮带、搭扣、链条、绑带、银色戒指和随风飘动的橙色内衬的黑色不规则短裙。画面中需包含正好三名可见的乐队成员：前景中央的主唱、左后方正在麦克风架旁弹奏电吉他的吉他手，以及右后方坐在鼓组后的鼓手。所有面部均渲染为刻意模糊的平滑矩形，不带任何五官特征。周围环绕着大型金属桁架音乐节舞台、头顶脚手架、悬挂式音箱、放大器、线缆和舞台灯光；在右侧支架上包含四盏发光的明亮圆形舞台灯。在左下前景处添加两个显眼的堆叠式音响架，带有精细的旋钮、屏幕、仪表和彩色 LED 灯。整体氛围应充满活力、夏日感和音乐节气息，呈现清脆的阳光、高对比度、随风飘动的衣物和头发、电影般的景深、细腻的线条、鲜艳的色彩以及精致的现代日本动漫插画品质。使用 {argument name="festival theme" default="春季黄金周音乐节"} 氛围，且画面中不包含任何可读文字或 Logo。

templates.title: Cute doodle-style Japanese cafe dessert photos

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱涂鸦风格日式咖啡馆甜点照片

templates.prompt: Create a warm, photorealistic lifestyle food photograph showcasing a cozy Japanese café table bathed in golden afternoon light, overlaid with adorable hand-drawn doodles in white, yellow, and pink markers. The scene features five edible/drink items arranged precisely on a wooden tray: a large strawberry shaved ice in a clear glass bowl, topped with whipped cream and fresh strawberries, with red syrup crystals cascading down one side; a striped ceramic teacup to the left; a small bowl containing a pink peach-shaped dessert to the left front; an iced lemonade with a straw and mint leaves to the right; and a crème brûlée on a patterned plate to the right front, topped with whipped cream and strawberries. Add exactly four cute, blush-covered smiley faces: one on the shaved ice, one on the teacup, one on the lemon slice in the drink, and one on the pudding. A vertical café banner with the text "[Text missing]" is included against a softly blurred background.{argument name="banner text" default="Shaved ice"} There are exactly 7 handwritten Japanese text annotations superimposed: a large white title near the shaved ice.{argument name="headline text" default="Summer shaved ice"} The small round label above the dessert{argument name="ice tag text" default="ice"} The yellow cloud text on the left{argument name="summer note" default="Cool off this summer"} The white cloud text in the upper right corner{argument name="mood note" default="A good meal puts me in a good mood."} The yellow star-shaped text on the right side of the middle{argument name="check in note" default="Weekend check-in"} The pink cloud text in the lower right corner reads "一口の価値があります" (This is the price of one bite), along with a few decorative handwritten embellishments. Cute doodle hearts, glitter, arrows, stars, and playful animated markers surround the food, as if drawn directly onto the photograph. Using shallow depth of field, natural window lighting, amber tones, realistic textures, glossy ice cubes, condensation droplets on the drink glass, a wooden tabletop, and a blurred background of a casual café interior, a pleasant summer atmosphere is created, presenting a fusion of high-resolution food photography and adorable doodle illustrations.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张温暖、照片级真实的生活方式美食摄影图，展现午后金光下的温馨日式咖啡馆餐桌，并叠加白色、黄色和粉色的马克笔手绘可爱涂鸦。场景中木托盘上恰好摆放 5 样可食用/饮品：中心为 1 份盛在透明玻璃碗中的大型草莓刨冰，顶部饰有鲜奶油和新鲜草莓，红色糖浆结晶沿一侧流下；左侧为 1 只条纹陶瓷茶杯；左前方为 1 只盛有粉色桃子形状甜点的小碗；右侧为 1 杯带吸管和薄荷叶的冰柠檬饮品；右前方为 1 份放在花纹碟子上的焦糖布丁，顶部饰有鲜奶油和草莓。添加恰好 4 个带腮红的卡哇伊笑脸：分别位于刨冰、茶杯、饮品中的柠檬片和布丁上。在柔和虚化的背景中，包含一个垂直的咖啡馆横幅，文字为 {argument name="banner text" default="かき氷"}。叠加恰好 7 处手写日语文本注释：刨冰附近的大号白色标题 {argument name="headline text" default="夏のかき氷"}，甜点上方的小圆标签 {argument name="ice tag text" default="氷"}，左侧的黄色云朵文字 {argument name="summer note" default="清凉一夏"}，右上方的白色云朵文字 {argument name="mood note" default="美食で良い気分"}，中右侧的黄色星形文字 {argument name="check in note" default="週末チェックイン"}，右下方的粉色云朵文字 "一口の価値があります"，以及少量装饰性手写点缀。在食物周围环绕可爱的涂鸦心形、闪光、箭头、星星和俏皮的动态标记，仿佛直接在照片上绘制而成。采用浅景深、自然窗光、琥珀色调、写实纹理、光泽冰块、饮品杯上的冷凝水珠、木质桌面、休闲咖啡馆室内虚化背景，营造愉悦的夏季氛围，呈现高分辨率美食摄影与可爱涂鸦插画的结合。

templates.title: Kawaii Crepe Cafe Photos

titleLocalized.zh: Kawaii 可丽饼咖啡馆照片

templates.prompt: Create a realistic and charming lifestyle food photograph set in a warm, sunny dessert café. In the center of the image is a light-colored wooden table with a cream-colored metal stand decorated with small hearts. Two large cone-shaped crepes wrapped in pink checkered paper are placed vertically on the stand. The crepe on the left is filled with whipped cream, chocolate sauce, and crunchy toppings; the crepe on the right is filled with whipped cream, strawberry slices, cranberries, and a tiny yellow smiley face heart-shaped cookie. Next to it are two clear plastic takeaway drinks with domed lids and light pink straws: one is a pastel strawberry drink topped with whipped cream and strawberry pieces, and the other is a bright yellow mango/lemon drink topped with whipped cream and yellow fruit pieces; both cups feature simple, cute smiley faces and a small, round café logo that reads "ANGEL CREPES". A pair of round-framed pink sunglasses is placed in front of the drinks. The background is soft-focused, with green leaves peeking through a large window on the left, framed by peach-pink curtains; on the right, comfortable wooden café shelves, stools, plants, and a crepe illustration with a pink border are visible. Overlaid on the photo are hand-drawn pastel doodles and white, pink, and yellow Japanese-style handwritten notes, as if drawn with markers: including five main text doodles, the content of which is {argument name="upper left handwritten text" default="Gourmet food and a good mood"} ,{argument name="upper right bubble text" default="Super cute crepes ♡"} ,{argument name="lower left bubble text" default="Holiday vacation"} ,{argument name="middle right highlight text" default="A perfect trip"} as well as{argument name="lower right bubble text" default="Every bite is worth it ♡"} Add extra decorative graffiti: hearts, flashing lights, sun icons, arrows pointing to crepes and drinks, dynamic lines, and dashed looping lines. Use golden hour lighting, shallow depth of field, and soft bokeh with a pastel pink and cream color scheme to create a cheerful vacation atmosphere, presenting realistic food textures and a playful Kawaii handwritten annotation style.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实且可爱的生活方式美食照片，场景设在温暖阳光明媚的甜点咖啡馆内。画面中央是一张浅色木桌，桌上放着一个带有小爱心装饰的奶油色金属架，架子上竖直插着两个用粉色格纹纸包裹的大号圆锥可丽饼。左侧的可丽饼内填满了鲜奶油、巧克力淋酱和脆脆的配料；右侧的可丽饼内填满了鲜奶油、草莓片、小红莓以及一块微小的黄色笑脸心形饼干。旁边放着两个带有圆顶盖和淡粉色吸管的透明塑料外带饮料：一杯是顶部铺满鲜奶油和草莓碎的粉彩草莓色饮料，另一杯是顶部铺满鲜奶油和黄色水果碎的亮黄色芒果/柠檬饮料；两个杯子上都画有简约可爱的笑脸，并印有一个写着“ANGEL CREPES”的小型圆形咖啡馆标志。在饮料前方放置一副圆框粉色太阳镜。背景经过柔焦处理，左侧的大窗户透出绿叶，配有桃粉色窗帘；右侧可见舒适的木质咖啡馆货架、凳子、植物以及一幅粉色边框的可丽饼插画。在照片上叠加手绘的粉彩涂鸦和白色、粉色及黄色的日式手写笔记，如同用马克笔绘制一般：包含五个主要文字涂鸦，内容分别为 {argument name="upper left handwritten text" default="美食と いい気分"}、{argument name="upper right bubble text" default="超かわいい クレープ♡"}、{argument name="lower left bubble text" default="休日の バケーション"}、{argument name="middle right highlight text" default="完璧な旅"} 以及 {argument name="lower right bubble text" default="一口ごとに 価値がある♡"}。添加额外的装饰性涂鸦：爱心、闪光、太阳图标、指向可丽饼和饮料的箭头、动感线条以及虚线循环线。使用黄金时段的灯光，采用浅景深、柔和的焦外成像效果，配色方案为粉彩粉色和奶油色，营造愉悦的度假氛围，呈现逼真的食物质感和俏皮的 Kawaii 手写注释风格。

templates.title: Cute doodle train bento photos

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱涂鸦火车便当照片

templates.prompt: Create a warm and realistic snapshot of food on a train journey, showcasing a folding dining table by the window with a soft-focus background of blue-patterned seats and sunlight streaming in through the window. The main subject is an oval wooden bento box containing white rice, koji (fried pork belly), fried chicken, tamagoyaki (Japanese rolled omelet), salmon, stew, sausage, pickles, and potato salad. Some of the food items are decorated with cute, simple smiley faces. Surround it with five other travel snacks: on the left is a bottle of tea with a Japanese label.{argument name="tea label text" default="Afternoon Tea Delicious Unsweetened Darjeeling"} In the lower left corner is a light pink square pouch or napkin packet, and at the bottom is a packaged wet chopstick sleeve labeled with {argument name="chopstick packet text" default="おてもと"} The top right corner features a brown butter sandwich cookie package with the English/Japanese brand name "BUTTER SAND ITOKO" and handwritten Japanese text above it. The bottom right corner shows a small pink snack box with a cute bear face and Japanese text. Overlaying the photo are playful white, pink, and yellow pastel hand-drawn doodles: a total of 9 handwritten annotations, including one near the bottle.{argument name="left headline text" default="Good food, good mood"} The top center is eye-catching{argument name="main headline text" default="Travel Bento"} Near the top right corner{argument name="right note text" default="A perfect short trip"} The text includes phrases like "Delicious~" in the clouds near the bento box, "Perfect combination" in the clouds in the lower left corner, "Battery no Ittoko" above the biscuits, "I'll treat you to a trip!" in the speech bubble on the right, "Absolutely delicious!" near the chopsticks, and a short Japanese text on the pink bear snack box. Fourteen decorative doodle elements are added: four hearts, three stars, three smiley faces, two arrows, one miniature camera icon, and one bunny face. The overall composition should convey a casual, everyday feel, enhanced by cute doodles. Golden hour lighting, shallow depth of field, realistic textures, and soft shadows create a pleasant and comfortable travel atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张温馨且写实的火车旅行美食快照，展示靠窗的折叠餐桌，背景是柔焦处理的青色花纹座椅，阳光透过窗户洒入。画面主体是一个椭圆形木制便当盒，内含白米饭、香松、炸鸡、玉子烧、三文鱼、炖菜、香肠、腌菜和土豆沙拉，部分食物上绘有可爱简单的笑脸。在周围放置 5 样旅行餐点：左侧是一瓶带有日文标签的瓶装茶 {argument name="tea label text" default="午後の紅茶 おいしい無糖 Darjeeling ダージリン"}，左下角是一个淡粉色方形小袋或餐巾纸包，底部是一个包装好的湿筷子套，上面标有 {argument name="chopstick packet text" default="おてもと"}，右上角是一个棕色的黄油夹心饼干包装，上面可见英文/日文品牌文字 "BUTTER SAND ITOKO" 以及上方的日文手写字，右下角是一个带有可爱小熊脸和日文的小粉色零食盒。在照片上叠加白色、粉色和黄色的趣味粉彩手绘涂鸦：共 9 处手写文字标注，包括瓶子附近的 {argument name="left headline text" default="美食好心情"}，顶部中央醒目的 {argument name="main headline text" default="旅行便当"}，右上角附近的 {argument name="right note text" default="完璧の小旅行"}，便当附近云朵里的 "美味しい〜"，左下角云朵里的 "完璧な組み合わせ"，饼干上方的 "バターのいとこ"，右侧对话框里的 "旅行のお供にぴったり!"，筷子附近的 "絶対に一口の価値あり!"，以及粉色小熊零食盒上的小段日文。添加 14 个装饰性涂鸦元素：4 个爱心、3 个星星、3 个笑脸、2 个箭头、1 个微型相机图标和 1 个小兔子脸。整体构图应呈现出一种随性的生活照质感，通过可爱的涂鸦增添魅力，采用黄金时刻的灯光、浅景深、写实的质感、柔和的阴影，营造出愉悦舒适的旅行氛围。

templates.title: Futuristic mecha kimono warrior

titleLocalized.zh: 未来感机甲和服战士

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic, realistic vertical portrait of the character, the main character being {argument name="character name" default="SUZUNE"} A futuristic female warrior stands sideways inside a magnificent, industrial-style sci-fi megastructure. She wears a weathered helmet {argument name="helmet color" default="yellow"} The helmet features a construction-style design with cat-ear-like protrusions, mechanical ear modules, small stickers including white flowers, and worn black lettering. Her messy, long blonde hair is tied in a high ponytail, cascading down the back of the helmet. Her face is obscured by a solid-color, opaque brown square positioned in the center. Her attire is a black and gold mechanized Japanese combat kimono: glossy black lacquered armor, metallic gold patterns, a short armor jacket, a layered asymmetrical skirt, a waist-revealing design, thigh straps, black gloves, and heavy cybernetic shoulder armor with circular mechanical joints. The material surfaces should have a realistic tactile feel, with scratches, dirt, paint chips, rain spots, and a hard, reflective surface. She maintains a confident side profile, head slightly lowered, body leaning to the left, one arm hanging naturally. The background is the interior of a vast futuristic city factory, filled with suspended machinery, vertical steel beams, cranes, cables, gantry cranes, orange and black industrial modules, dust, fog, and cool-toned sunlight streaming in from high windows. Employing dramatic low-angle compositions, high contrast, emotionally charged cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, ultra-fine textures, a realistic live-action film style, and a powerful aura that is highly recognizable in a futuristic city. Color scheme: black, worn gold, yellow helmet accents, smoky gray industrial shadows, and subtle warm orange lighting. 2:3 aspect ratio, full-body to three-quarter-length compositions, high-end game cinematic concept art realism.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影级、写实的竖构图角色设计肖像，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="SUZUNE"}，一位未来感女性战士，侧身站立在宏伟的工业科幻巨型建筑内。她佩戴着一顶饱经风霜的 {argument name="helmet color" default="yellow"} 施工风格战斗头盔，头盔上有类似猫耳的凸起、机械耳部模块、包括小白花在内的小型贴纸以及磨损的黑色字样。她凌乱的金色长发扎成高马尾，从头盔后部垂下。面部被一个位于脸部正中央的纯色不透明棕色方块遮挡。她的服装是一套黑金配色的机械化日式战斗和服：亮面黑色漆器盔甲、金属质感金色花纹、短款盔甲上衣、层叠的不对称裙摆、露腰设计、大腿绑带、黑色手套以及带有圆形机械关节的厚重赛博肩甲。材质表面应具有真实的触感，带有划痕、污垢、掉漆、雨水斑点以及坚硬的反光表面。让她保持自信的侧身姿态，头部微垂，身体向左倾斜，一只手臂自然下垂。背景是一个巨大的未来城市工厂内部，充满了悬挂的机械、垂直钢梁、起重机、电缆、龙门架、橙黑色工业模块、灰尘、雾气以及从高处窗户射入的冷色调日光。采用戏剧性的低角度构图、高对比度、情绪化的电影级布光、浅景深、超精细纹理、写实的真人电影风格，以及在未来城市中极具辨识度的强大气场。配色方案：黑色、磨损的金色、黄色头盔点缀、烟灰色工业阴影、微妙的暖橙色灯光。比例 2:3，全身至四分之三身位构图，高级游戏电影概念艺术写实风格。

templates.prompt: Create a full-body haute couture fashion editorial, with the main subject being {argument name="character name" default="An elegant adult woman"} She was standing in the aisle of a luxurious boutique. The aisle had glossy dark wood floors, cream-paneled walls, mirrors, and warm chandeliers. A navy blue blazer was displayed on a mannequin to the left. She had shoulder-length, loose curls.{argument name="hair color" default="warm brown"} Her hair was styled with a white headband, teardrop earrings, and a delicate necklace. She struck a confident pose, one hand lightly touching the wall, her gaze fixed on the camera. Her attire was sophisticated business luxury: a short grey tweed blazer over a white shirt, paired with high-waisted, glossy bottoms.{argument name="skirt color" default="Rich chocolate brown"} A pencil skirt embroidered with white flowers, paired with black pointed-toe ankle-strap stilettos. The design utilizes realistic fabric textures, clean cuts, delicate reflections, warm, cinematic boutique lighting, shallow depth of field, vertical composition, and a high-fashion magazine photography style. The face should be obscured or anonymized through soft, neutral blurring, while retaining the hairstyle and overall pose.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张全身高定时尚大片，画面主角为 {argument name="character name" default="一位优雅的成年女性"}，她正站在一间奢华的精品店走廊中。走廊铺设着光亮的深色木地板，墙面为奶油色镶板，配有镜子和温暖的吊灯，左侧的人体模型上展示着一件海军蓝西装外套。她留着齐肩蓬松卷曲的 {argument name="hair color" default="暖棕色"} 头发，戴着白色发带，佩戴着水滴状耳环和精致的项链，自信地摆出姿势，一只手轻轻触碰墙壁，目光看向镜头。她的装扮是精致的商务奢华风格：一件短款灰色粗花呢西装外套内搭白色衬衫，下身穿着高腰光泽感 {argument name="skirt color" default="浓郁巧克力棕色"} 铅笔裙，裙身带有白色花卉刺绣，脚踩黑色尖头踝带细高跟鞋。运用写实的布料质感、利落的剪裁、精致的倒影、温暖的电影感精品店灯光、浅景深、竖构图，以及高端时尚杂志的摄影风格。面部应通过柔和的中性模糊处理进行遮挡或匿名化，同时保留发型和整体姿态。

templates.title: Anime-themed escalator fashion portraits

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫商场扶梯时尚人像

templates.prompt: Create a sophisticated, vertical, anime-style fashion illustration depicting a young woman standing on an indoor escalator in a bright, modern shopping mall or traffic atrium. She is wearing a {argument name="hat style" default="Black newsboy cap with glossy trim"} Shoulder-length light brown hair peeked out from under the brim of her hat, and she wore long dangling earrings and a smart outfit.{argument name="blouse color" default="White"} A short-sleeved shirt with puff sleeves and a large bow at the collar, paired with high-waisted {argument name="skirt color" default="black"} She wears a pleated midi skirt and carries a small black quilted shoulder bag with a gold chain. Her face is deliberately blurred with a soft, square-shaped effect, while the rest of the image remains sharp. Her full body is shown from a slightly lower angle, one hand hanging naturally at her side, the other resting lightly on the escalator handrail, her posture elegant and composed. The background is a spacious glass-roofed interior space with sloping steel beams, marble or dark stone cladding, warm wood ceiling decorations, glass railings, and a pair of parallel escalators extending behind her; the image includes a faint silhouette of an upper-level figure in the distance. Employing a realistic anime-style rendering, the image features sharp lines, soft skin shadows, rich details in fabric folds, and a glossy reflective escalator handrail. Bright early summer sunlight streams through the skylight, creating a bright and transparent light effect with a shallow depth of field, resulting in a stylish urban travel atmosphere. The vertical composition and high detail further enhance the effect.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张精致的竖版动漫风格时尚插画，描绘一位年轻女性站在明亮的现代购物中心或交通中庭的室内自动扶梯上。她戴着一顶 {argument name="hat style" default="带有光泽饰带的黑色报童帽"}，齐肩浅棕色头发从帽檐下露出，佩戴着长款吊坠耳环，身穿一件干练的 {argument name="blouse color" default="白色"} 短袖衬衫，衬衫带有泡泡袖，领口处系着一个大蝴蝶结，搭配一条高腰 {argument name="skirt color" default="黑色"} 百褶中长裙，并背着一个带有金链条的小型黑色绗缝单肩包。她的面部特意采用了柔和的方形隐私模糊处理，而图像其余部分保持清晰。以略低于视角的角度展现她的全身，一只手自然垂在身侧，另一只手轻轻搭在扶梯扶手上，姿态优雅从容。背景是一个宽敞的玻璃屋顶室内空间，配有斜向钢梁、大理石或深色石材墙板、温暖的木质天花板装饰、玻璃栏杆，以及她身后延伸的一对平行自动扶梯；画面中包含上层人物隐约的远景剪影。采用写实动漫渲染风格，线条清晰，皮肤阴影柔和，织物褶皱细节丰富，自动扶梯金属扶手具有光泽反射，明亮的初夏日光透过天窗倾泻而下，光线明快通透，具有浅景深效果，营造出时尚的都市出行氛围，竖构图，高细节。

templates.title: Sunset on the rooftop at the end of Golden Week

titleLocalized.zh: 黄金周结束时的天台日落

templates.prompt: Create a melancholic anime-style illustration to showcase {argument name="time of day" default="18:00 Sunset"} Capture{argument name="holiday name" default="Golden Week"} The atmosphere is one of impending end and the return to work tomorrow. The scene is a quiet city rooftop, the perspective focused on a solitary young man standing behind a waist-high concrete wall and black metal railings, his hands in his coat pockets, gazing at the city. He has messy, dark brown short hair and wears a long coat.{argument name="coat color" default="gray-brown trench coat"} Wearing dark trousers and black shoes, his posture was still, heavy, and thoughtful, revealing a sense of helplessness and post-holiday melancholy. In the foreground of the rooftop were cracked concrete slabs, weeds growing from the cracks, stains, and weathered walls. Beyond the railing were the soft silhouettes of the distant city skyline, apartment buildings and office buildings dotted with warm lights. The sun, low on the horizon, was a pale golden disc partially obscured by buildings, projecting an orange gradient sky that faded upwards to a soft beige. The sky must contain seven clearly visible birds: a large bird silhouette in the upper left, five small birds loosely gathered in the upper right center, and a tiny bird near the far right edge. Using a cinematic composition, the figure is positioned slightly below the horizon, with a large expanse of blank sky above, complemented by warm sunset backlighting, soft atmospheric haze, thin clouds, low-saturation colors, delicate line art, and picturesque anime-like background details, creating a quiet, lonely, and slightly fearful bittersweet atmosphere before returning to ordinary life.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅忧郁的动漫风格插画，展示 {argument name="time of day" default="18:00 日落时分"}，捕捉 {argument name="holiday name" default="黄金周"} 即将结束、明日即将复工的氛围。场景为一个安静的城市天台，视角位于一名孤独的年轻男子身后，他站在齐腰高的混凝土矮墙和黑色金属栏杆旁，双手插在外套口袋里，眺望着城市。他留着凌乱的深棕色短发，穿着一件长款 {argument name="coat color" default="灰褐色风衣"}、深色长裤和黑色鞋子；他的姿态静止、沉重且若有所思，流露出一种无奈和节后忧郁。天台前景有开裂的混凝土板、缝隙中生长的杂草、污渍和风化的墙壁。栏杆外是远处城市天际线的柔和剪影，公寓楼和办公楼点缀着温暖的灯光。太阳低垂在地平线上，是一个被建筑物遮挡住部分的淡金色圆盘，投射出橙色的渐变天空，并向上方褪色为柔和的米色。天空中必须包含 7 只清晰可见的鸟：左上方 1 只大型鸟类剪影，右上中方松散地聚集着 5 只小鸟，最右侧边缘附近还有 1 只极小的鸟。采用电影级构图，人物位于地平线略下方，上方是大面积的留白天空，配合温暖的日落逆光、柔和的大气雾霾、稀薄的云层、低饱和度的色彩、细腻的线条艺术、如画般的动漫背景细节，营造出一种回归平凡生活前，那种安静孤独与些许畏惧的苦涩氛围。

templates.title: The melancholy of the end of Golden Week

titleLocalized.zh: 黄金周结束的忧郁

templates.prompt: Create a melancholic anime-style illustration that describes {argument name="character description" default="A young man with disheveled hair and a tired expression"} exist{argument name="time" default="18:00"} Curled up on a sofa in a dimly lit apartment, facing a large window overlooking a dense city skyline bathed in the glow of the setting sun, the scene conveys the painful reality of the Golden Week holiday ending and the return to work tomorrow: quiet, heavy, and resigned. The character rests their face in their hand, gazing at the orange-purple twilight. The image showcases the warm sunset streaming through the window, dramatic clouds, silhouettes of distant buildings, and the deep blue shadows inside. The apartment should evoke the messy yet vibrant atmosphere of post-holiday life: an open suitcase and clothes on the left, an open planner, scattered papers, a smartphone, a calculator, chopsticks, a bowl, snack wrappers, and a mug on a low table in the foreground, and a coat or bag draped over the sofa. The composition employs cinematic lighting, delicate background art, a soft anime-style aesthetic, and emotionally charged slices of life, using contrasting compositions to sharply contrast the beautiful sunset with the character's inner fear. The image contains no readable text or titles, maintaining the scene's realism and restraint. The character's face should be turned away from or partially obscured to emphasize this pervasive sense of melancholy. Overall theme:{argument name="theme" default="The end of Golden Week and the fear of returning to work tomorrow"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张忧郁的动漫风格插画，描述 {argument name="character description" default="一位头发凌乱、神情疲惫的年轻男子"} 在 {argument name="time" default="18:00"} 蜷缩在昏暗公寓的沙发上，面对着巨大的窗户，窗外是落日余晖笼罩下的密集城市天际线。画面氛围传达出黄金周即将结束、明天就要恢复工作的痛苦现实：安静、沉重、无奈，角色用一只手托着脸，凝视着橙紫色的黄昏。展现温暖的夕阳洒进窗户，戏剧性的云层，远处建筑的剪影，以及室内深蓝色的阴影。公寓应呈现出假期后凌乱且充满生活气息的样子：左侧放着打开的行李箱和衣物，前景的矮桌上放着打开的日程本、散落的纸张、智能手机、计算器、筷子、碗、零食包装袋和一个马克杯，沙发上还搭着一件外套或包。运用电影级光影、细腻的背景美术、柔和的动漫绘画风格、情感化的生活片段氛围，并采用对比构图，将美丽的日落与角色内心的恐惧形成鲜明对比。画面中不包含任何可读文字或标题，保持场景的真实与克制，角色的脸部应背对或部分遮挡，以强调这种普遍的忧郁感。整体主题：{argument name="theme" default="黄金周结束与明天重返工作的恐惧"}。

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed 2.5D fashion-generated portrait, featuring a person named{argument name="character name" default="AI Lady"} A stylish, young AI woman is showcased on a high-rise glass observation deck overlooking a bright, futuristic eco-city. The background features circular towers, sky bridges, rooftop gardens, waterways, and shimmering sunlight. She is dressed in…{argument name="outfit color palette" default="Warm chocolate brown, cream lace, smoky gray plaid and leopard print"} A bohemian gothic-chic layered look: a soft brown knit cardigan with lace trim at the neckline and cuffs, paired with a short plaid ruffled mini skirt with a cream-colored lining, cinched at the waist with a wide belt and embellishments, an asymmetrical leopard-print scarf, sheer striped knee-high socks, and oversized brown chunky platform boots adorned with cream-colored lace cuffs, tassels, knots, and pom-poms. A matching brown felt beret, decorated with lace ribbons and floral embellishments, completes the look.{argument name="hair color" default="Light brown with gold highlights"} The subject sports long, wavy hair, layered necklaces, and delicate accessories. The shot uses a vertical full-body composition, taken from a slightly high angle, with a 2.5D semi-realistic rendering for a glossy effect, clear fabric textures, delicate lace and metallic accessories, voluminous sunlight, sharp urban background depth, and a captivating futuristic fashion magazine photography atmosphere. It is ultra-detailed, with vibrant and natural colors, and contains no text or logos.

templates.prompt: Create a detailed anime action illustration, the main character is {argument name="character name" default="A female mecha student warrior"} Presented in a dynamic, crouching pose against a clean white background, surrounded by a thin, futuristic red HUD-style border with sharp angles. The character is a young anime girl with {argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown"} She has long, straight hair with bangs, wearing a white hair clip, and possesses large brown eyes and a focused expression. She wears a short, white-blue Japanese sailor uniform with a red scarf, paired with a pleated light blue mini-skirt and white sneakers, revealing her waist. The design features heavy, well-defined mechanical armor: glossy white-blue mechanical forearms, shoulders, thighs, calves, knee pads, and hands, adorned with brass/gold joints, circular pistons, screws, segmented fingers, and small red technical markings; the hands must conform to anatomical structure, with clearly defined finger joints and a realistic grip. She holds a long samurai sword vertically on the left side of the image, one mechanical hand gripping the hilt above her head, the other hand supporting her on the ground, the blade extending to her side, with a subtle sweeping arc behind her, hinting at the moment of a rapid strike and landing. A clean cel animation rendering style is used to showcase the detailed mecha design, the soft highlights on the glossy armor, warm skin tones, clean lines, subtle ground shadows, and the texture of a futuristic concept art poster. Contains 3 visible text/logo elements: small red text in the top left corner.{argument name="top left logo text" default="MECHA GIRLS"} The bottom center border{argument name="bottom center caption" default="MECHA GIRL"} And the one with the round red logo in the lower right corner.{argument name="bottom right logo text" default="IONEN"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张精致的动漫动作插画，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="一位机甲女学生战士"}，以动态的低蹲姿势呈现于干净的白色背景之上，外围环绕着带有尖角切割的细红色未来感 HUD 风格边框。角色是一位年轻的动漫少女，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 的长直发，齐刘海，戴着白色发夹，拥有棕色大眼睛和专注的神情；身穿短款白青色日本水手校服，系红色领巾，搭配百褶青色迷你裙、白色运动鞋，露出腰部。为她设计厚重且关节分明的机械装甲：光泽感的白青色机械前臂、肩部、大腿、小腿、护膝和手部，配以黄铜/金色关节、圆形活塞、螺丝、分段式手指以及细小的红色技术标记；手部必须符合解剖学结构，手指关节清晰且抓握感真实。她垂直握着一把长武士刀于画面左侧，一只机械手握住头顶上方的刀柄，另一只手支撑在地面上，刀刃延伸至身侧，身后带有淡淡的扫掠运动弧线，暗示快速斩击落地的瞬间。采用干净的赛璐珞动漫渲染风格，展现精细的机甲设计、光泽装甲上的柔和高光、温暖的肤色、利落的线条、微妙的地面阴影，以及未来感概念艺术海报的质感。包含 3 个可见的文字/Logo 元素：左上角的小型红色文字 {argument name="top left logo text" default="MECHA GIRLS"}，底部中央边框处的 {argument name="bottom center caption" default="MECHA GIRL"}，以及右下角带有圆形红色徽标的 {argument name="bottom right logo text" default="IONEN"}。

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫创作者被拒场景

templates.prompt: Create a 16:9 widescreen anime-style illustration depicting a young woman feeling immense pressure at her desk in a cramped bedroom. She sits at a wooden desk, staring in horror at her open laptop. The character is {argument name="character name" default="An unknown young Japanese creator"} She had messy, shoulder-length hair.{argument name="hair color" default="black"} She had bangs and a fringe, fair skin, huge, round, terrified eyes, beads of sweat on her cheeks, her mouth trembling as she opened it, and a bluish-purple shadow of despair hanging over her forehead; she wore an oversized black hoodie and slumped in a black office chair. A laptop sat to the right of the desk, its screen facing the audience, displaying bold Japanese text on its white display.{argument name="laptop rejection text" default="My application was rejected."} Add a speech bubble next to her head with the following content:{argument name="speech bubble text" default="マジか…"} Add a black doodle representing frustration above the laptop, with a vertical comic-style pressure line in the upper left corner of the background. The room should evoke the atmosphere of a creator's bedroom: a gray mug with a black cat pattern on the left side of the desk, a spiral notebook and a black fountain pen with short handwritten notes on the right, and a minimalist bed with blue-gray sheets in the back right corner. Bookshelves hold books, folders, a potted plant, and a black cat plush toy. The image should include four clearly visible areas of Japanese text: rejection messages on the laptop, speech bubbles, and text written on the left wall.{argument name="wall note text" default="If you don't give up on your dreams, they will come true...!"} It also features inspirational notes with kitten doodles and brief notes on job categories in a notebook. Using clean, modern anime-style lines, the interior color scheme is a soft gray-beige, complemented by soft shadows, a comedic expression of despair, a richly detailed notebook keyboard, and subtle perspective, presenting a refined web article illustration style.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 16:9 的宽屏动漫风格插图，描绘一位在狭小卧室工作台前感到压力巨大的年轻女性，她坐在木质书桌前，惊恐地盯着打开的笔记本电脑。角色为 {argument name="character name" default="一位不知名的日本年轻创作者"}，留着凌乱的齐肩 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"} 发和刘海，皮肤白皙，有着巨大的圆形惊恐双眼，脸颊两侧挂着汗珠，嘴巴颤抖着张开，额头上笼罩着蓝紫色的绝望阴影；她穿着一件超大号黑色连帽衫，瘫坐在黑色办公椅上。笔记本电脑位于书桌右侧，屏幕朝向观众，白色屏幕上显示着醒目的粗体日文 {argument name="laptop rejection text" default="審査ダメでした"}。在她的头部旁边添加一个对话气泡，内容为 {argument name="speech bubble text" default="マジか…"}，在笔记本电脑上方添加一团代表沮丧的黑色涂鸦，背景左上方有垂直向下的漫画压力线。房间应营造出创作者卧室的氛围：书桌左侧放着一个带有黑猫图案的灰色马克杯，右侧放着一本螺旋笔记本和一支黑色钢笔，上面有手写的简短笔记，右后方是一张铺着蓝灰色床品的简约床铺，书架上摆放着书籍、文件夹、一盆盆栽和一只黑猫毛绒玩具。画面中需包含 4 处清晰可见的日文文本区域：笔记本电脑上的拒稿信息、对话气泡、左侧墙上写着 {argument name="wall note text" default="夢は あきらめなければ 叶う…!"} 并带有小猫涂鸦的励志便条，以及笔记本上关于工作类别的简短笔记。采用干净现代的动漫线条，室内色调为柔和的灰米色，配合柔和的阴影、喜剧化的绝望表情、细节丰富的笔记本键盘、轻微的深度透视，呈现出精致的网页文章插图风格。

templates.title: Nico Robin Library Cosplay Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 妮可·罗宾图书馆 Cosplay 肖像

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic full-body fashion cosplay portrait, with the main character being {argument name="character name" default="Nico Robin"} The image depicts an elegant adult woman standing in a dimly lit antique library. She has very long hair.{argument name="hair color" default="black"} With wavy hair and sunglasses perched atop her head, she exudes confidence and relaxation, holding an open antique book as if reading. Her attire consists of a deep navy blue short-sleeved crop top with a wide collar, white piping, a small compass-shaped badge on the chest, a deep V-neck, and a rose-pink tulle skirt with tassels and a high slit revealing one leg. She completes the look with shiny pink pointed-toe heels. The scene is set in an ornate old-world study, complete with wooden bookshelves, antique picture frames, a magnificent chandelier, a carved round wooden table, an upholstered chair, and warm candlelight; the table must contain exactly three visible burning candles, and a warm lamp or candlelight is positioned in the background on the right. The lighting employs emotional, cinematic techniques: warm amber highlights, deep shadows, shallow depth of field, a luxurious vintage atmosphere, realistic skin texture, magazine-style composition, a 9:16 vertical aspect ratio, and full-body detail visible from head to toe. The overall effect is elegant, sexy, and sophisticated.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张照片写实风格的全身时尚 Cosplay 肖像，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="妮可·罗宾"}，展现一位优雅的成年女性站在昏暗的古董图书馆中。她留着非常长的 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"} 波浪卷发，头顶架着一副太阳镜，姿态自信而放松，双手捧着一本打开的古董书，仿佛正在阅读。她的装束为一件深海军蓝短袖露脐上衣，配有宽大的翻领、白色滚边、胸前饰有小型指南针状徽章、深 V 领口，以及一条系带玫瑰粉色纱笼裙，裙摆带有流苏和高开叉，露出一条腿，脚踩亮面粉色尖头高跟鞋。场景设定在一个装饰华丽的旧世界书房，配有木质书架、古典画框、头顶的华丽吊灯、雕花圆木桌、一把软垫椅以及温暖的烛光；桌上需包含恰好三支可见的燃烧蜡烛，右侧背景处有一盏温暖的灯或烛光。采用情绪化的电影级布光、温暖的琥珀色高光、深邃的阴影、浅景深、奢华的复古氛围、真实的皮肤纹理、杂志大片摄影构图、9:16 竖构图，全身从头到鞋可见，高细节，优雅且性感，格调高雅。

templates.title: Punk Anime Collection Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 朋克动漫画集封面

templates.prompt: Create a vibrant modern anime book cover/poster in a rebellious punk gothic street art style, with a horizontal 16:9 composition and a primary color palette of bright pink, magenta, black, white, and orange. The centerpiece of the image is a captivating original anime girl with exceptionally long, two-tone twin tails.{argument name="hair color" default="Platinum blonde hair with neon pink and orange highlights."} She wears a black leather corset, a studded choker, a padlock necklace, chains, straps, and a bright pink silk bow tie; her arms are raised and crossed in front of her face in a defiant X-shape, and she wears black lace fingerless gloves adorned with rings, studs, miniature hearts, and stars, and has long manicured nails. Her exposed skin is covered with colorful tattoo-style stickers, including skulls, hearts, flowers, stars, crowns, the words "RIOT" and "REBEL," and graffiti graphics. A flat, opaque, gray-pink square obscures her face, concealing facial details. The background is a dense punk collage wall with torn paper, graffiti, black ink splatters, skull stickers, crowns, a giant X mark, barcodes, shredded tape, and Japanese street magazine layouts. It contains six striking text elements: a large white serif headline with black shadows in the upper left corner, containing the following text:{argument name="headline text" default="ILLUSTRATION COLLECTION"} Below is a smaller subheading{argument name="subtitle text" default="Original Character Art"} The text on the left is in Japanese.{argument name="Japanese theme text" default="The aesthetics of rebellion"} In the upper right corner is a black label with the following content:{argument name="series label" default="ARTBOOK // VOL. 01 // REBELLION // BEAUTY // CHAOS"} On the right is the Japanese graffiti "Chaos," and near the lower right edge is the vertical Japanese text "The Beauty of Chaos." Two barcode stickers are added to the lower left corner, along with three large black crown graffiti. The collage on the right features two prominent skull graphics and several pink and black X-shaped graffiti marks. It employs clean, crisp anime lines, glossy highlights, high contrast, delicate accessories, layered silkscreen printing texture, the vibrancy of a fashion magazine cover, a chaotic yet balanced layout, a clear focal point, and professional illustration quality.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张生动的现代动漫画集封面/海报，采用叛逆的朋克哥特街头艺术风格，横向 16:9 构图，以亮粉色、洋红色、黑色、白色和橙色为主色调。画面中心是一位迷人的原创动漫少女，留着超长的双色双马尾，{argument name="hair color" default="白金发色，带有霓虹粉和橙色挑染"}，身穿黑色皮质束胸上衣，佩戴铆钉项圈、挂锁项链、链条、绑带以及亮粉色丝带领结；她双臂抬起交叉于脸前，摆出反抗的 X 型姿势，戴着黑色蕾丝露指手套，上面饰有戒指、铆钉、微型心形和星星饰品，留着长长的美甲。她露出的皮肤上布满了彩色纹身风格的贴纸，包括骷髅、心形、花朵、星星、皇冠、单词“RIOT”和“REBEL”以及涂鸦图形。在她的脸部中心放置一个平整不透明的灰粉色方块遮挡物，遮住面部细节。背景是一面密集的朋克拼贴墙，上面有撕裂的纸张、涂鸦、黑色墨迹飞溅、骷髅贴纸、皇冠、巨大的 X 标记、条形码、胶带碎片以及日式街头杂志排版。包含 6 个醒目的文字元素：左上角是一个巨大的带有黑色阴影的白色衬线标题，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="ILLUSTRATION COLLECTION"}，下方是一个较小的副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="Original Character Art"}，左侧是日文 {argument name="Japanese theme text" default="反逆の美学"}，右上角是一个黑色标签，内容为 {argument name="series label" default="ARTBOOK // VOL. 01 // REBELLION // BEAUTY // CHAOS"}，右侧是日文涂鸦“混沌”，右下边缘附近是竖排日文“混沌の美”。左下角添加 2 个条形码贴纸，包含 3 个大型黑色皇冠涂鸦，右侧拼贴画中有 2 个显眼的骷髅图形，以及多个粉黑相间的 X 型涂鸦标记。采用清晰利落的动漫线条、光泽高光、高对比度、精细的配饰、分层的丝网印刷质感、时尚杂志封面的活力、混乱但平衡的布局、清晰的焦点以及专业的插画品质。

templates.title: Luxury Idol Cosplay Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华偶像 Cosplay 肖像

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed vertical fashion portrait of a captivating anime idol-style woman on a dimly lit concert stage, shot as a half-length portrait. She has {argument name="hair color" default="Platinum"} Her hair was styled in huge, high pigtails with slightly curled ends, featuring straight bangs and side braids. A large, fluffy white bow adorned the top of her head, decorated with black ribbons and gold trim. Her face was deliberately obscured by an opaque, beige-grey square in the center, covering her forehead and chin. She wore a luxurious white, short, military-style jacket with black and gold stripes, gold rope braids, gold chains, and ornate epaulettes on the cuffs, collar, and shoulders. Underneath the jacket was a glossy black lace-up corset with white fringed neckline, adorned with a black choker with gold rings, multi-layered gold necklaces, dangling geometric gold earrings, and white gloves; one gloved hand was raised near the choker, while the other was on her hip. Employing dramatic backstage spotlight effects, with bright circular lights in the upper corners creating a cool blue-gray misty feel, strong rim lighting on the hair edges, shallow depth of field, and an ultra-refined cosplay photography style, the film features clear fabric and hair textures, high contrast, an elegant black, white, and gold color scheme, rounded corners, and no visible text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高度精细的竖版时尚肖像，展现一位在昏暗演唱会舞台上的迷人动漫偶像风格女性，取景为半身像。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="铂金色"} 的巨型高双马尾，发梢微卷，配有直刘海和侧边编发细节，头顶饰有一个超大的蓬松白色蝴蝶结，蝴蝶结上带有黑色缎带和金色镶边。她的面部被一个位于中央的不透明灰米色方块刻意遮挡，覆盖范围从额头到下巴。她身穿一件奢华的白色短款军装风夹克，袖口、领口和肩部饰有黑金条纹、金色绳编、金链以及华丽的肩章细节。夹克内搭一件光泽感的黑色系带紧身胸衣，领口饰有白色毛边，并佩戴带有金环的黑色颈圈、多层金项链、垂坠的几何形状金耳环以及白色手套；一只戴手套的手抬起靠近颈圈，另一只手叉腰。采用戏剧性的后台聚光灯效果，上方角落有明亮的圆形灯光，营造冷蓝灰色的雾气感，头发边缘有强烈的轮廓光，浅景深，超精致的 Cosplay 摄影风格，清晰的布料和发丝质感，高对比度，优雅的黑白金配色，圆角图像，无可见文字。

templates.title: Masked Idol Concert Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 蒙面偶像演唱会肖像

templates.prompt: Create a realistic close-up portrait of a concert performer, featuring a charismatic male idol. The composition should focus on the upper body, with a deep navy blue stage background and falling gold and white confetti. The performer should have {argument name="hair color" default="Platinum with subtle gold streaks"} With layered, tousled hair, he wears a white military-style prince stage uniform, adorned with black and metallic gold trim, ornate epaulettes, star-shaped brooches, chains, pins, and shimmering embellishments, layered over a black shirt and white tie. He wears a white beret with a black and gold trim at a tilted angle, dangling gold earrings, and rings. A strong close-up perspective is used, dramatically extending one arm towards the camera; the fingers are slightly blurred due to the shallow depth of field, while the torso and clothing details remain sharp and luxurious. A large, opaque beige square is placed at the center of his face, completely obscuring his features. The photography employs a high-fashion K-pop concert style, with realistic lighting, glossy fabric highlights, cinematic shallow depth of field, a celebratory atmosphere, and a vertical 4:5 composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实风格的演唱会特写肖像，主角为一位魅力十足的男性偶像表演者。画面采用胸部以上构图，背景为深海军蓝色的舞台，伴有飘落的金色与白色纸屑。表演者留着 {argument name="hair color" default="带有细微金条纹的铂金色"} 层次感碎发，身穿白色军装风格王子舞台制服，配有黑色与金属金镶边、华丽的肩章、星形胸针、链条、别针及闪亮的装饰，内搭黑色衬衫和白色领带。头上斜戴一顶带有黑金装饰带的白色贝雷帽，佩戴垂坠感金耳环，手上戴着戒指。采用强烈的近景透视，让他的一只手臂戏剧性地伸向镜头，手指因浅景深效果略显模糊，而躯干和服装细节保持清晰且质感奢华。在面部中心放置一个大型不透明米色方块，完全遮挡五官。采用高级时尚 K-pop 演唱会摄影风格，真实光影，光泽面料高光，电影级浅景深，庆祝氛围，垂直 4:5 构图。

templates.title: Golden Hour Daisy Field Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 黄金时刻雏菊田人像

templates.prompt: A hyper-realistic, touching portrait from a movie, featuring [the subject].{argument name="subject" default="A young South Korean woman"} She lay on her side amidst the lush white daisies and towering green grass. She was dressed {argument name="dress color and style" default="A soft light gray dress with delicate ruffles and sheer long sleeves."} The fabric wrinkled naturally, draping down her curled-up body. The composition employs a relaxed and intimate pose, with one arm folded near her face, her body slightly curled up, and her long, straight {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown hair"} Scattered on the grass, gently ruffled by the breeze. Shot from above at a slight angle, daisies dot the foreground and background, some blossoms subtly piercing the frame to add depth.{argument name="lighting" default="Natural sunlight at the golden hour"} The color palette is warm and soft, with realistic highlights on the hair and fabric, soft shadows, creating a dreamy and ethereal atmosphere. It features shallow depth of field, a creamy blurred background, cinematic color grading, soft contrast, high detail, an 85mm lens, f/1.8, 4K resolution, and hyper-realism. Faces should appear natural and richly detailed, with realistic skin texture and a serene, peaceful expression, looking softly into the camera. Avoid artificial skin smoothing, plastic-looking skin, over-sharpening, hand deformities, superfluous limbs, strong flash, cartoonish style, and unrealistic colors.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超写实的电影感人像照片，主角为 {argument name="subject" default="一位年轻的韩国女性"}，她侧卧在茂密的白色雏菊和高耸的绿草丛中。她身穿 {argument name="dress color and style" default="一件带有精致荷叶边和透明长袖的浅灰色柔和连衣裙"}，布料自然起皱，顺着她蜷缩的身体自然垂落。构图采用放松且亲密的姿势，一只手臂折叠在脸部附近，身体微微蜷缩，长直的 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色头发"} 散落在草地上，被微风轻轻吹乱。从上方以微小角度近距离拍摄，前景和背景中点缀着雏菊，部分花朵轻轻穿过画面以增加深度。使用 {argument name="lighting" default="黄金时刻的自然阳光"}，色调温暖柔和，头发和布料上有逼真的高光，阴影柔和，营造出梦幻空灵的氛围，浅景深，奶油般虚化的背景，电影摄影色彩分级，柔和对比度，高细节，85mm 镜头，f/1.8，4k，超写实。面部应看起来自然且细节丰富，具有逼真的皮肤纹理和宁静平和的表情，柔和地看向镜头。避免人工磨皮、塑料感皮肤、过度锐化、手部畸形、多余肢体、强闪光、卡通风格以及不真实的色彩。

templates.title: Touching movie scene among daisies

titleLocalized.zh: 雏菊丛中的电影感人像

templates.prompt: A hyper-realistic, cinematic vertical composition photograph, the subject is{argument name="character description" default="A young South Korean woman"} She lay on her side amidst the lush white daisies and towering green grass, at the perfect moment. She was dressed {argument name="dress description" default="A light gray sleeveless dress with a delicate ruffled neckline and a light, flowing skirt."} Her long, straight, brown hair fell naturally across the grass, gently ruffled by the breeze. Her body was curled up in a relaxed pose, one arm bent near her head, the other placed in front of her, her bare legs peeking out from among the flowers. Her face was deliberately obscured by a centered, soft-edged square blur effect, presenting a warm brown tone that concealed all facial details while preserving the visibility of her hair, neck, shoulders, and body. Shot from a slightly tilted, overhead angle, the composition is intimate, with countless golden-centered white daisies and tall grasses surrounding the foreground and background. Using warm, natural sunlight, the skin and fabrics have soft highlights, the grass and flowers cast soft shadows, creating a dreamy shallow depth of field, a creamy, soft bokeh effect, a realistic film photography style, natural color gradation, soft contrast, 85mm lens quality, f/1.8 aperture, high detail, 4K, hyperrealism.

templates.prompt: Create a warm, rustic food photography poster showcasing a Spanish tortilla. At the center of the image is a perfectly round, golden-brown Tortilla de patatas, served on a large, cream-colored ceramic plate decorated with cobalt blue patterns. A triangular piece is cut from the plate and moved slightly to the lower right, revealing the thick layers of potato and egg inside; the tortilla's surface is glossy, golden, and clearly textured, topped with a sprig of fresh thyme. Use a three-quarter-length, low-angle perspective with shallow depth of field, natural window lighting, and rich, inviting colors to create a comfortable Mediterranean kitchen atmosphere. Arrange six supporting props around the plate: three whole potatoes on linen in the upper left, a small bowl of fresh green herbs in the upper right, a bottle of olive oil in the upper right, a small bowl of coarse salt in the lower left, and parsley leaves scattered on the linen. Add three elegant white and beige handwritten fonts: a large title in the upper left.{argument name="headline text" default="Tortilla de Patatas"} It also includes a heart-shaped doodle and a small explanatory text in the lower left corner.{argument name="left caption" default="Simple. Honesta. Deliciosa."} And the small explanatory text with a heart and underline in the lower right corner.{argument name="right caption" default="Hecha con amor"} Maintain a sophisticated, realistic, and appealing composition with an editorial quality and restaurant-standard feel. The focus is clearly on the potato pancakes, while the background details are presented with a soft, blurred effect.

Honesta. Deliciosa."}，以及右下方带有爱心和下划线的小说明文字 {argument name="right caption" default="Hecha con amor"}。保持构图高级、写实、诱人且具备编辑级质感和餐厅水准，焦点清晰地聚焦于土豆饼，背景细节则呈现柔和的虚化效果。

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic widescreen sci-fi game key visual with a black overlay, showcasing a squadron of three futuristic Arwing-style starfighters flying above a deep blue ocean, through bright white clouds, and under a clear blue sky. The largest fighter occupies the center left front position in a dynamic profile, its nose pointing to the left. It features angular white fuselage panels, purple-blue swept wings and tail, and a pilot silhouette visible through a dark glass canopy. A small red fox emblem adorns the cockpit exterior, featuring {argument name="ship side text" default="STAR FOX"} The game features exquisite decals, including text, and clear lines on the mechanical panels. The second fighter, smaller in size, is located in the lower right foreground and flies at a slight angle, sharing the same white and blue color scheme. The third fighter, partially obscured by the main ship, is in the middle right background, flying in formation and gradually disappearing into the atmospheric haze. It employs refined Nintendo-style 3D rendering of space combat aesthetics, a heroic adventure theme, clean hard-surface modeling, glossy materials, realistic sunlight, soft cloud shadows, and an ocean horizon with tiny distant islands. The formation spacing conveys a sense of movement, with high detail, vibrant colors, and a clear focus on the lead aircraft, all presented in a 16:9 cinematic composition.

templates.title: Desktop organization layout infographic

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the source photo, create a clean and realistic infographic of a "post-organized" desktop layout. Maintain the original desk, shelves, monitor/laptop settings, CPU location, and overall room view, but tidy up the workspace: organize cables, clean the desktop, place items in designated storage areas, and add matching storage boxes/baskets, pegboards/accessory areas, pen holders, book storage boxes, transparent display cases, and dedicated areas for water cups/tissues/small tools. Adopt a green and white color scheme, similar to an educational poster, with a large title at the top:{argument name="headline text" default="Workbench layout plan (can be directly copied)"} Overlay 12 green circular numbered markers onto the edited photo and add a title to the right panel.{argument name="right panel title" default="Item location list"} The layout is divided into 12 distinct areas: ① Monitor/Secondary Screen, ② Main Unit, ③ Cable Management, ④ Laptop Workspace, ⑤ Mouse Pad/Mouse Area, ⑥ Water Cup/Bottle Area, ⑦ Tissue/Tool Area, ⑧ Left Side Under-Table Storage Box, ⑨ Right Side Under-Table Storage Box, ⑩ Book Storage Box, ⑪ Figurine Display Area, ⑫ Frequently Used Small Items Area/Pegboard. A title is added at the bottom:{argument name="steps title" default="Organization steps (from top to bottom)"} The section contains 6 step-by-step cards, each with a small before-and-after thumbnail and a brief Chinese label: ① Clean the desktop, ② Install accessories, ③ Place large items, ④ Organize by section, ⑤ Cable management, ⑥ Final check. A title is added to the bottom left corner.{argument name="tips title" default="Storage Tips"} The prompt box contains four checkbox suggestions: Keep frequently used items within easy reach, group similar items together, check cables weekly, and only keep currently used items on your desktop. A title is added to the bottom center/right side:{argument name="tools title" default="Recommended storage tools"} The recommended section includes five product icons: desktop storage tray, pegboard with hooks, cable ties/cable clips, storage box with handle, and transparent display box. The overall design needs to be neat, practical, bright, and directly operable, like a home office organization guide generated based on the original photo.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 作为源照片，制作一张整洁、写实的“整理后”桌面布局方案信息图。保持原有的书桌、搁板、显示器/笔记本电脑设置、主机位置及整体房间视角，但需整理工作区：理顺线缆，清理桌面，将物品放入明确的收纳区，添加配套的收纳盒/篮、洞洞板/配件区、笔筒、书本收纳盒、透明展示盒以及专用的水杯/纸巾/小工具区域。采用绿白配色的教学海报风格，顶部设置大标题：{argument name="headline text" default="工作台整理布局方案图（可直接照做）"}。在整理后的照片上叠加 12 个绿色圆形编号标记，并在右侧面板添加标题 {argument name="right panel title" default="物品定位清单"}，列出 12 个明确的区域：① 显示器 / 副屏，② 主机，③ 线缆管理，④ 笔记本电脑工作区，⑤ 鼠标垫 / 鼠标区，⑥ 水杯 / 水瓶区，⑦ 纸巾 / 工具区，⑧ 左侧桌下收纳盒，⑨ 右侧桌下收纳盒，⑩ 书本收纳盒，⑪ 手办展示区，⑫ 常用小物件区 / 洞洞板。底部添加标题为 {argument name="steps title" default="整理步骤（从上到下）"} 的板块，包含 6 张步骤卡片，每张卡片配有小型的整理前后对比缩略图及简短的中文标签：① 清理桌面，② 安装配件，③ 放置大件物品，④ 分区收纳，⑤ 线缆管理，⑥ 最终检查。左下角添加标题为 {argument name="tips title" default="收纳小贴士"} 的提示框，包含 4 条复选框建议：将常用物品放在单手可及处、同类物品归类放置、每周检查线缆、桌面上仅保留当前使用的物品。底部中/右侧添加标题为 {argument name="tools title" default="推荐收纳工具"} 的推荐栏，包含 5 个产品图标：桌面收纳托盘、洞洞板 + 挂钩、理线带 / 理线夹、带手柄收纳盒、透明展示盒。整体设计需整洁、实用、明亮且具备直接的可操作性，如同基于原照片生成的家庭办公整理指南。

The sculpture depicts an anime-style cat-eared maid character entirely made of colored sand.{argument name="hair color" default="pink"} A bob haircut, two pointed cat ears, a white maid headband with ruffles, a navy blue and white maid outfit with puff sleeves, and a huge {argument name="bow color" default="Bright blue"} Bows, jewel-like accessories, and clearly visible neon triangle patterns on the sleeves. The character's face is framed by a centered, flat {argument name="face cover color" default="Grayish pink"} Square obscuring blocks are deliberately used to match the surreal generative style. The character holds two wooden chopsticks in one hand, eating from a round bowl containing three distinctly textured, sandy foods: white rice around the rim, brown beans or pearls in the center, and a layer of pink minced meat on top. A string of beads or sauce is dripping from the chopsticks into the bowl. The design emphasizes the fine sandy texture of every surface, the tiny scattered grains of sand, realistic shadows, shimmering dust particles, and clear reflections from transparent glass. Background: A warm, modern interior environment, including a sofa, blurred windows, cabinets, books, a vase, and a small plant, using shallow depth of field, soft afternoon golden light, and a high-detail product photography style with a 4:3 composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个逼真的沙雕艺术品，展示在木质底座的透明长方形玻璃罩内，放置于暖阳照耀的客厅中一张抛光的木质咖啡桌上。该雕塑描绘了一个完全由彩色沙子构成的动漫风格猫耳女仆角色，拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="粉色"} 的波波头、2 只尖尖的猫耳、一个荷叶边白色女仆发带、一件带有泡泡袖的藏青色与白色相间的女仆装、胸前系着一个巨大的 {argument name="bow color" default="亮蓝色"} 蝴蝶结、珠宝般的配饰，以及袖子上清晰可见的霓虹三角形图案。角色的面部被一个居中的平坦 {argument name="face cover color" default="灰粉色"} 方形遮挡块刻意遮盖，以契合超现实的生成风格。角色一只手拿着 2 根木筷，正从 1 个圆形碗中进食，碗里盛着 3 种纹理分明的沙质食物：碗边是白米饭，中间是棕色的圆豆或珍珠，顶部堆叠着粉色的肉末配料，一串珠子或酱汁正从筷子上落入碗中。强调每一处表面的细颗粒沙质纹理、细小的散落沙粒、逼真的阴影、闪烁的尘埃颗粒以及清晰的透明玻璃反射。背景：温馨的现代室内环境，包括沙发、窗户虚化效果、柜子、书籍、花瓶和一株小植物，采用浅景深、柔和的午后金色光线，呈现高细节的产品摄影风格，4:3 构图。

templates.title: Cat wife cooking meme

titleLocalized.zh: 猫咪妻子做饭梗图

templates.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic vertical smartphone meme, presenting the deliberate flaws of a low-end Android phone shot: glaring mixed kitchen lighting, slight motion blur, noticeably noisy shadows, compression artifacts, awkwardly tilted composition, and a close-up selfie perspective. The subject is a black and white house cat standing upright beside the stove, one paw outstretched towards the camera, making the paw appear large and blurred in the foreground, while the cat's face remains sharp, with a serious and indifferent expression, and a small black spot around its nose and mouth. Dress the cat in two clearly visible outfits: a lavender floral dress with lace and bow details, and a matching ruffled nightcap decorated with a colorful ribbon bow. The cat's other paw holds a wooden spoon, stirring a black frying pan on the right side of the frame, containing browned food, green herbs, and red pepper flakes, with blue gas flames visible below. The scene is set in a cramped, cluttered family kitchen. The walls are stained, and behind the cat is a metal shelf crammed with condiment and sauce bottles. A blender sits on the countertop, various kitchen utensils hang on it, and the floor is worn-out tile. Add a meme title at the top center, using bold white font with a thick black outline, containing the following text:{argument name="caption text" default="POV : “Aku jadi Istrimu, Mas”"} The goal is to make this picture look like a real, candid selfie of someone cooking—both comical and surreal, with photorealistic realism and no fancy studio lighting.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超逼真的竖屏智能手机梗图，呈现出一种刻意为之的低端 Android 手机拍摄的瑕疵感：刺眼的厨房混合光线、轻微的运动模糊、噪点明显的阴影、压缩伪影、尴尬的倾斜构图以及近距离自拍视角。主体是一只黑白相间的家猫，直立在灶台旁，一只前爪伸向镜头，使爪子在前景中显得巨大且模糊，而猫脸保持清晰，表情严肃且冷漠，鼻子和嘴巴周围有一小块黑色斑点。为猫穿上两件清晰可见的服装：一件带有蕾丝花边和蝴蝶结细节的薰衣草色碎花居家裙，以及一顶装饰着彩色缎带蝴蝶结的同色系荷叶边睡帽。猫的另一只爪子拿着一把木勺，正在搅拌画面右侧的一个黑色平底锅，锅里有炒至褐色的食物、绿色香草和红辣椒碎，下方可见蓝色的燃气火焰。场景设定在一个狭窄、凌乱的家庭厨房中，墙壁有污渍，猫身后是一个挤满了调味瓶和酱料瓶的金属架，台面上放着搅拌机，挂着各种厨具，地面是磨损的瓷砖。在顶部中心添加 1 个梗图标题，使用带有粗黑描边的加粗白色字体，内容为 {argument name="caption text" default="POV : “Aku jadi Istrimu, Mas”"}。让这张图片看起来像是一张真实的、偶然抓拍的做饭自拍，既滑稽又超现实，同时具备照片级的真实感，且没有任何精致的摄影棚灯光。

templates.title: A candid, realistic kitchen scene

titleLocalized.zh: 意外抓拍的厨房写实风格

templates.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic snapshot, simulating the effect of taking a photo with a low-end Android phone in a narrow, old, and cluttered kitchen at night. The image should convey a sense of a poorly timed snapshot: tilted composition, glaring warm indoor light, high ISO noise, compression artifacts, imperfect autofocus, motion blur, and a large, out-of-focus finger partially obscuring the lower half of the lens. On the right side of the image, show {argument name="subject" default="An elderly woman"} She was wearing{argument name="dress pattern" default="A burgundy floral short-sleeved lounge dress"} He was in the middle of an action, violently waving his arms at the camera.{argument name="object being swung" default="A slipper or sandal"} The waving object is positioned very close to the left of the frame, with a strong motion blur. Her face is obscured by a simple rectangular blur/mosaic, but her body is visible. The background is a dilapidated home kitchen with beige, stained, and peeling paint walls, a dark wooden cabinet, an old window or door frame on the left, a rice cooker, stacked pots and pans, plastic containers, a red bucket, cluttered shelves, and scattered household items. The composition is meant to appear awkward and imperfect, as if the photographer captured this moment in a moment of panic. The image is slightly rotated, unevenly exposed, softly focused, and has a rough texture, creating a raw, documentary-like realism. Please use a vertical smartphone aspect ratio.{argument name="aspect ratio" default="9:16"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超写实的意外抓拍照片，模拟在夜晚狭窄、陈旧且杂乱的厨房中，使用低端 Android 手机拍摄的效果。画面应呈现出一种时机不佳的快照感：倾斜的构图、刺眼的室内暖光、高 ISO 噪点、压缩伪影、不完美的自动对焦、运动模糊，以及一只大而失焦的手指部分遮挡镜头下半部分。在画面中右侧，展示 {argument name="subject" default="一位年长的女性"}，她穿着 {argument name="dress pattern" default="一件酒红色碎花短袖家居裙"}，正处于动作中，猛烈地向镜头挥动 {argument name="object being swung" default="一只拖鞋或凉鞋"}；挥动的物体位于左侧镜头极近处，带有强烈的运动模糊。她的脸部被一个简单的矩形模糊/马赛克遮挡，但身体可见。背景是一个破旧的居家厨房，墙壁呈米色且有污渍，油漆剥落，有一个深色木制壁柜，左侧有一个旧窗户或门框，还有电饭煲、堆叠的锅具、塑料容器、红桶、杂乱的架子以及散落的家居用品。构图要显得尴尬且不完美，仿佛摄影师惊慌失措下意外捕捉到了这一瞬间，画面略微旋转，曝光不均匀，焦点柔和，质感粗糙，充满原始的纪实写实感。请使用垂直智能手机比例 {argument name="aspect ratio" default="9:16"}。

templates.title: Candid Bird Contest Meme Photo

titleLocalized.zh: Candid Bird Contest Meme Photo

templates.prompt: Create a raw, portrait-oriented smartphone photo meme, presenting a deliberately imperfect, low-end Android phone-shot quality, as if captured by chance under an open-air roof during a crowded bird-singing competition in Indonesia. The image shows a throng of people standing shoulder to shoulder, with many round birdcages hanging from the ceiling, and green trees and glaring sunlight in the background. In the foreground, a person with {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} A pale, tattooed youth with disheveled hair and a faded, dusty-colored sleeveless shirt is celebrating. He clenches his fist and leans close to the camera, his face blurred with excitement; his face, and the faces of several others nearby, are obscured by flat, brown rectangular blocks. To the right, a man in a bright yellow T-shirt and a black baseball cap points to a birdcage in the air, and the surrounding crowd reacts. A partially visible banner in the background reads "LATBER" along with smaller Indonesian text, obscured by the crowd and motion blur. A striking, bold white sans-serif meme title with a thick black border is added at the top center, containing the text:{argument name="caption text" default="POV kicau mania: burungmu mulai gacor pas dinilai juri"} It makes the image look realistic, cluttered, compressed, noisy, slightly wide-angle, awkwardly composed, with inaccurate autofocus, uneven lighting, and blurred edges, and has realistic mobile phone camera artifacts, rather than a sophisticated staged photo.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张原始的竖屏智能手机照片模因，呈现出一种刻意不完美的低端 Android 手机拍摄质感，仿佛是在印尼一场拥挤的鸟类歌唱比赛中，于露天顶棚下偶然抓拍到的场景。画面中人头攒动，肩并肩站在一起，天花板上悬挂着许多圆形的鸟笼，背景中透出绿树和刺眼的日光。前景中，一名留着 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色"} 凌乱头发、身穿褪色粉尘色无袖衫的苍白纹身青年正处于庆祝时刻，他握紧拳头靠近镜头，因兴奋而产生运动模糊；他的脸部以及附近几人的脸部被平面的棕色矩形遮挡块覆盖。右侧，一名身穿亮黄色 T 恤、头戴黑色鸭舌帽的男子正指向空中的鸟笼，周围人群做出反应。背景中包含一个部分可见的活动横幅，上面写着“LATBER”以及较小的印尼语活动文字，被人群和运动模糊部分遮挡。在顶部中心添加醒目的粗体白色无衬线模因字幕，并带有粗黑边框，文字内容为 {argument name="caption text" default="POV kicau mania: burungmu mulai gacor pas dinilai juri"}。让图片感觉真实、混乱、压缩、噪点多、略带广角、构图尴尬、自动对焦不准、光线不均、边缘模糊，并具有真实的手机摄像头伪影，而非精致的摆拍照片。

templates.title: Chaotic cat snapshots with flash

titleLocalized.zh: 混乱猫咪闪光灯抓拍

templates.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic snapshot taken with a smartphone flash. The background is a messy, dimly lit apartment at night. Using a 9:16 vertical composition, the image exhibits the quality of a low-end Android phone camera, featuring strong direct flash, motion blur, imperfect autofocus, noise, compression artifacts, awkward tilted composition, and a raw, chaotic party atmosphere. The image conveniently includes two young people and a black and white cat: on the left is a young man with {argument name="hair color" default="Silver-gray messy shoulder-length hair"} One person, wearing an oversized off-white T-shirt and light gray sweatpants, is backing away and twisting their body, one arm outstretched forward; to their right is a young woman with long black hair, wearing a light-colored T-shirt and denim shorts, barefoot, leaning forward and holding a cat. The cat, with black and white tuxedo markings, is suspended between the two, its mouth wide open, hissing or howling, its claws gripping the forearm of the person on the left, creating a sense of a chaotic, unexpected moment. Large rectangular privacy blocks are added to obscure the faces of both people, like hiding one's identity online. The background is cluttered and realistic: a low table with cans, cups, bottles, snacks, and trash, various items scattered on the floor, slippers at the bottom, warm, dim indoor lighting, and doorways and furniture hidden in shadow. It makes it look like a poorly timed, real mobile phone snapshot rather than a retouched photo, with overexposed flash highlights, blurred action, off-center cropping, and a sense of the photographer's slow reaction.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超写实的智能手机闪光灯抓拍照片，背景是夜晚凌乱昏暗的公寓，采用 9:16 竖构图，呈现出低端安卓手机摄像头的质感，带有强烈的直射闪光、运动模糊、不完美的自动对焦、噪点、压缩伪影、尴尬的倾斜构图，以及原始混乱的派对氛围。画面中恰好有两名年轻人和一只黑白猫：左侧是一名年轻人，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="银灰色凌乱齐肩发"}，身穿超大号米白色 T 恤和浅灰色运动裤，正向后退缩并扭动身体，一只手臂向前伸展；右侧是一名留着长黑发的年轻女性，身穿浅色 T 恤和牛仔短裤，赤着脚，身体前倾抱着猫。猫被悬在两人之间，有着黑白燕尾服斑纹，嘴巴大张着嘶嘶叫或嚎叫，爪子抓着左侧人的前臂，营造出一种慌乱的意外瞬间。添加大的矩形隐私遮挡块遮住两人的脸部，就像发布在网上隐藏身份一样。背景杂乱且写实：一张放着罐头、杯子、瓶子、零食和垃圾的矮桌，地板上散落着各种物品，底部有拖鞋，温暖的暗色室内灯光，门口和家具隐没在阴影中。让它看起来像是一张时机把握极差的真实手机快照，而不是精修照片，带有过曝的闪光高光、模糊的动作、偏离中心的裁剪，以及一种摄影师反应太慢的真实感。

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个包含 16 个画面的宽幅电影级故事板信息图，展示 {argument name="subject" default="年轻日本女性"} 经营她自己的 {argument name="business" default="温馨咖啡馆"} 的日常流程。采用写实摄影风格，运用温暖的电影色调、柔和的咖啡馆灯光、浅景深、精致的室内设计以及高端咖啡馆氛围。每个画面都应呈现同一位写实的 {argument name="person" default="扎着马尾辫、身穿白衬衫和深色围裙、表情自然的日本女性"}。将故事板排列成整洁的 4x4 网格布局，包含编号面板、醒目的标题、简短的项目符号说明，以及类似于专业电影制作故事板的流畅视觉叙事。场景包括：开店准备、研磨咖啡豆、萃取浓缩咖啡、打发奶泡、制作拉花、服务顾客、记录订单、烘焙甜点、清洁咖啡吧台、清洗杯具、补充原料、管理收银台、装饰咖啡馆、晚间清理、打烊以及在一天结束时享用咖啡放松身心。在所有场景中加入逼真的蒸汽、倒影、温暖的阳光、咖啡馆装饰、电影级摄像机角度和温馨的氛围。超精细、写实的人物外观、奢华咖啡馆商业美学、视觉化的故事板构图，4K 画质。
