templates.title: Double Exposure Ocean Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 双重曝光海洋肖像

templates.prompt: A medium format film double-exposure portrait, meticulously crafted with in-camera simulation, featuring two balanced exposures: the first exposure captures the golden hour of crashing waves against a rugged rocky coastline, the bright sunset light casting warm amber and soft rose highlights through the spray of the waves; the second exposure presents a clear profile of an elegant woman with flowing long hair against a deep black, seamless studio background, subtle rim lighting outlining her figure. The seascape organically fills and outlines her hair, shoulders, and upper body, naturally blending into her form, transforming the waves into threads of movement and emotion, with foam, spray, and coastal textures intertwining with her profile. The work emphasizes elegant composition, emotional depth, and visual poetry—romantic, painterly, melancholic, and cinematic. It features soft and delicate tonal transitions, rich film grain, soft halos, subtle shadow depths, bright highlights, dreamlike simulated imperfections, the shallow depth of field of medium format, and exquisite layered transparency. Shot using a Pentax 67, paired with Portra 800 film and pushed up by 1 stop, with metering at −1 EV per exposure to achieve balanced density and preserve highlight detail. Artistic editing aesthetics: timeless, ethereal, emotional, and refined, with museum-quality photographic prints.

promptLocalized.zh: 中画幅胶片双重曝光肖像，精心制作的机内模拟合成，两次曝光平衡：第一次曝光捕捉黄金时刻汹涌的海浪拍打崎岖岩石海岸线的画面，明亮的日落光线在海浪喷雾中投射出温暖的琥珀色和柔和的玫瑰色高光；第二次曝光呈现一位优雅女性的清晰侧影，她留着飘逸的长发，背景为深黑色无缝影棚，微妙的轮廓光勾勒出她的身形。海景有机地填充并勾勒出她的头发、肩膀和上半身，自然地融入她的形态中，使海浪化作动感与情感的丝缕，泡沫、喷雾和海岸纹理与她的侧影交织在一起。强调优雅的构图、情感深度和视觉诗意——浪漫、油画感、忧郁、电影感。柔和而细腻的色调过渡、丰富的胶片颗粒、柔和的光晕、微妙的阴影深度、明亮的高光、梦幻的模拟瑕疵、中画幅的浅景深以及精致的层叠透明感。使用 Pentax 67 拍摄，搭配 Portra 800 胶片并推 1 档，每次曝光测光为 −1 EV，以获得平衡的密度并保留高光细节。艺术编辑美学，永恒、空灵、情绪化、精致，博物馆级摄影印刷品质。

templates.title: Cinematic Cycling Project

titleLocalized.zh: 电影感骑行项目

templates.prompt: A hyper-realistic cinematic close-up: A female cyclist tightens a baby pink professional glove on her wrist. The focus is on the stretch of her fingers, tendons, and fabric. The glove material exhibits realistic tension and wrinkles. The cool, foggy environment, soft diffused light, cinematic shallow depth of field, and subtle breathing movements blend into the frame, creating a hyper-realistic texture. Frame 5—A hyper-realistic cinematic close-up of a helmet and focused gaze: A female cyclist wearing a helmet and professional cycling glasses adjusts a baby pink hood below her face. The tight, symmetrical composition focuses on her eyes and hands. Slow, controlled movements, the fabric gently stretching around her face. Slight fog on her glasses, her calm and determined gaze turning slightly to the side. A blurred, foggy background, cool, cinematic lighting, and photorealistic detail. Frame 6—A hyper-realistic cinematic wide-angle shot of a foggy mountain range: A foggy valley and dense forest under a cloudy sky. Thick fog drifts among the trees and along the road. A cold and melancholic atmosphere, soft volumetric fog, and the subtle rustling of wind through branches and grass. The cool, cinematic color grading, high dynamic range, and profound atmosphere, combined with almost static shots and extremely subtle cinematic push-in shots. Frame 7—A drone tracking shot: A hyper-realistic, cinematic drone wide-angle shot shows three female road cyclists riding side-by-side uphill on a foggy, slippery mountain road. The cyclists wear baby pink professional cycling gear, contrasting sharply with the cool gray environment. A smooth, side-view drone tracking shot, parallel to the cyclists. The wet asphalt reflects soft light, tiny tire splashes, floating fog across the road, synchronized pedaling rhythm, natural movements, and a documentary-like realism. Frame 8—A frontal speed shot: A hyper-realistic, cinematic drone frontal shot shows three female cyclists riding quickly in a single file on a slippery mountain road. The camera flies backward at the same speed, maintaining a constant composition and centered perspective. The baby pink cycling jackets are visible through the rain and fog. The reflections of wet asphalt, the spray from tires, the dynamic raindrops, the cinematic image stabilization with a subtle, natural drone-like floating effect, and the cool mountain background. Frame 9—a hyper-realistic cinematic close-up of the bicycle drivetrain, the camera mounted near the rear wheel and drivetrain of the road bike. As the bike struggles uphill in the rain, baby pink cycling shoes and a cycling jersey are visible. The detailed movements of the chain, freewheel, chainring, and wheels convey a realistic sense of mechanical motion. Water droplets splash on the drivetrain, and the texture of the wet asphalt is clearly defined and reflective. The natural vibrations of the bicycle, shallow depth of field, cinematic motion blur, the misty mountain atmosphere, and the high-end commercial realism all contribute to the effect.

promptLocalized.zh:
超写实电影感特写，一位女性骑行者正在系紧手腕上的婴儿粉色专业手套。聚焦于手指、肌腱和织物的拉伸感。手套材质呈现出逼真的张力和褶皱。清冷的雾气环境，柔和的漫射光，电影级浅景深，细微的呼吸起伏感融入画面，超写实纹理。

第 5 帧 — 头套与专注的眼神

超写实电影感特写，一位佩戴头盔和专业骑行镜的女性骑行者正在调整脸部下方的婴儿粉色头套。紧凑的对称构图，聚焦于眼睛和双手。缓慢而受控的动作，织物在脸部周围轻柔拉伸。眼镜上有轻微的雾气，冷静而坚定的眼神微微向侧面转动。雾气弥漫的模糊背景，清冷的电影级灯光，照片级细节。

第 6 帧 — 雾中山脉定场镜头

超写实电影感广角镜头，阴天下的雾气山谷和茂密森林。浓雾在树木间和道路上飘荡。寒冷而忧郁的氛围，柔和的体积雾，树枝和草丛中细微的风吹动感。清冷的电影级调色，高动态范围，深邃的氛围感，几乎静止的镜头配合极其细微的电影级推镜头。

第 7 帧 — 无人机追踪骑行者

超写实电影感无人机广角镜头，三位女性公路骑行者在雾天湿滑的山路上并排上坡。骑行者身穿婴儿粉色专业骑行服，与清冷的灰色环境形成鲜明对比。平滑的侧向无人机追踪镜头，与骑行者保持平行。湿润的柏油路面反射着柔和的光线，细微的轮胎溅水，横穿道路的漂浮雾气，同步的踩踏节奏，自然的动作，纪录片式的写实感。

第 8 帧 — 正面速度镜头

超写实电影感无人机正面镜头，三位女性骑行者在湿滑的山路上单列纵队快速骑行。摄像机以相同的速度向后飞行，保持恒定的构图和居中视角。在雨雾中可见婴儿粉色的骑行夹克。湿润的柏油路面反射，车轮溅起的水雾，动态的雨滴颗粒，带有细微自然无人机浮动感的电影级防抖，清冷的山地背景。

第 9 帧 — 自行车传动系统终章

超写实电影感特写，摄像机安装在公路车后轮和传动系统附近。雨中奋力上坡时，可见婴儿粉色的骑行鞋和下半身骑行服。链条、飞轮、牙盘和车轮的细节动作呈现出逼真的机械运动感。水滴溅落在传动系统上，湿润的柏油路面纹理清晰且具有反射感。自行车自然的震动，浅景深，电影级动态模糊，雾气缭绕的山地氛围，高端商业级的写实感。

templates.title: Anime Functional Style Character Posters

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫机能风角色海报

templates.prompt: Create a visually striking anime-style poster featuring a protagonist from {argument name="franchise" default="Original series"} of{argument name="character name" default="The character"} This project reconstructs the characters through modern street fashion, techwear, and high-end Japanese graphic design. The art style should blend high-fashion cinematography, anime movie posters, and futuristic editorial art. Before generating scenes, carefully study the characters' original personalities and emotional energy. Their body language, expressions, poses, special effects, and compositions should all reflect their authentic traits from the original work. While retaining the iconic features of the original work, redesign the original costumes into fashionable streetwear/techwear outfits. Utilize layered jackets, tactical straps, oversized silhouettes, futuristic sneakers, functional accessories, and cyberpunk details, subtly incorporating elements of their abilities or worldview. Pose design should conform to the character archetype. Expressions must possess emotional realism and cinematic quality—sharp anime eyes, subtle emotions, a believable attitude, and a high-end character aura. Visual Style: Anime × Streetwear × Cyberpunk Graphic Design, clean lines, semi-flat shadows combined with high-detail rendering, strong contrast, minimalist yet impactful composition, modern Japanese poster aesthetics, fashion editorial style, and highly refined anime illustrations. Composition: 3:4 vertical composition, off-center character placement, strong diagonal compositional dynamism, layered and dynamic framing, large areas of white space, stylish typographic integration, asymmetrical modern layout. Color: Clean white or soft neutral background, using the character's signature original colors as the main color scheme, adding a complementary secondary color, a minimalist color scheme, creating bold contrasts within controlled saturation, with accent colors integrated into lighting, effects, and graphic elements. Background Design: Abstract geometric layout, Japanese typography, minimalist UI/cybertech graphics, ink splatters, paint splashes, energy traces, subtle worldview references, a high-end poster balance, avoiding clutter. Effects: Energy trails, dynamic brushstrokes, glowing effects, atmospheric particles, oil painting texture; effects visually match the character's abilities and emotional tone. Lighting: Sharp, cinematic lighting, clean hard shadows, controlled rim lighting, soft colored halos from signature accent colors, high-end editorial contrast. Rendering: Ultra-detailed anime illustrations, clean vector texture, 4K poster quality, highly refined key visuals, and a stylish feel.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张视觉冲击力极强的动漫风格海报，主角是来自 {argument name="franchise" default="原系列"} 的 {argument name="character name" default="该角色"}，通过现代街头时尚、机能风（techwear）和高端日本平面设计进行重构。艺术风格应融合高端时尚大片、动漫电影海报及未来主义编辑艺术。在生成场景前，请仔细研究角色的原始性格和情感能量。其肢体语言、表情、造型、特效及构图都应体现其原著中的真实特质。在保留原著标志性特征的同时，将原始服装重新设计为时尚的街头风 / 机能风装束。运用叠穿夹克、战术绑带、超大廓形、未来感运动鞋、机能配件、赛博时尚细节，并巧妙融入其能力或世界观的元素。姿势设计应符合角色原型。表情必须具备情感真实感和电影感——锐利的动漫双眸、细腻的情绪、可信的态度及高端的角色气场。视觉风格：动漫 × 街头风 × 赛博平面设计，干净的线条，半扁平化阴影配合局部高细节渲染，强对比度，极简但富有冲击力的构图，现代日式海报美学，时尚编辑风格，高度精致的动漫插画。构图：3:4 竖构图，角色偏心放置，强烈的对角线构图动势，层次感与动态框架，大面积留白，时尚的排版整合，非对称现代布局。色彩：干净的白色或柔和中性背景，以角色的标志性原著色作为主色调，添加一种互补的辅助色，极简配色方案，在受控饱和度下形成大胆对比，强调色融入光影、特效及图形元素中。背景设计：抽象几何布局，日文排版，极简 UI / 赛博科技图形，墨迹，泼漆，能量痕迹，微妙的世界观参考，高端海报的平衡感，避免杂乱。特效：能量轨迹，动态笔触，发光特效，大气粒子，油画质感，特效应在视觉上与角色的能力体系及情感基调相匹配。光影：锐利的电影级布光，干净的硬阴影，受控的轮廓光，由标志性强调色带来的柔和彩色光晕，高端编辑风格的对比度。渲染：超细节动漫插画，干净的矢量感质感，4K 海报画质，高度精致的关键视觉图，时尚感。

titleLocalized.zh: 立体主义厚涂春日肖像

templates.prompt: A tranquil{argument name="subject" default="Women in their 30s"} With flowing, long, dark hair, she stood elegantly in the enchanting spring forest, dressed in a {argument name="outfit" default="Elegant white flowing long dress"} Bathed in the warm, golden hour sunlight. A medium-shot portrait, shot at eye level with a 50mm standard lens, presenting natural proportions and an intimate realism. Her calm, serene expression exudes a tranquil power and ethereal beauty. Surrounding her are lush spring vegetation, moss-covered trees, delicate wildflowers, and sunlight softly filtering through the verdant green and earthy brown hues of the woodland. The golden hour light creates a bright halo effect, warm highlights, and rich atmospheric depth. Presented with exquisite Cubism, blending expressive impasto textures—bold geometric fragmentation, layered planes, abstract natural forms, thick, visible brushstrokes, rich palette knife texture, and three-dimensional pigment depth. Combining Picasso-esque Cubist structures with dreamlike, captivating realism, balancing abstraction with recognizable beauty. Forest green, earthy brown, ivory, and warm amber dominate the overall color palette. Ultra-detailed, cinematic masterpieces of art, museum-quality digital paintings, high-quality textures, dynamic compositions, 8K resolution, 4:5 vertical portrait ratio, premium digital wallpapers.

promptLocalized.zh: 一位宁静的 {argument name="subject" default="30 多岁的女性"}，留着飘逸的深色长发，优雅地站在迷人的春日森林中，身着一件 {argument name="outfit" default="优雅的白色飘逸长裙"}，沐浴在温暖的黄金时段阳光下。中景肖像构图，以 50mm 标准镜头平视拍摄，呈现自然的比例与亲密的真实感。她平静、安详的表情散发着静谧的力量与空灵的美感。周围是茂密的春日植被、长满苔藓的树木、娇嫩的野花，以及透过翠绿色和大地棕色林地色调柔和投射的阳光。黄金时段的光线营造出明亮的光晕效果、温暖的高光以及丰富的氛围深度。以精湛的立体主义风格融合表现力十足的厚涂油画质感呈现——大胆的几何碎片化、分层的平面、抽象的自然形态、厚重可见的笔触、丰富的调色刀质感以及立体的颜料深度。将毕加索风格的立体主义结构与梦幻般的迷人现实主义相结合，平衡抽象感与可辨识的美感。森林绿、大地棕、象牙白和暖琥珀色主导了整个色调。超精细、电影级艺术杰作、博物馆级数字绘画、高质感、动态构图、8K 分辨率、4:5 竖向肖像比例、高级数字壁纸。

templates.title: Night Rain Storyboard

titleLocalized.zh: 夜雨分镜信息图

templates.prompt: Create a wide 9-grid cinematic storyboard infographic. Use a realistic photographic style with warm cinematic tones. Arrange the scenes in a clean 3x3 grid layout, including numbered panels, bold titles, short bullet points, and a smooth visual narrative reminiscent of professional filmmaking storyboards. Panel 1 — Eyes in the Storm: A hyper-realistic extreme close-up of a female cyclist's face in a nighttime downpour. Focus on her eyes, wet eyelashes, the texture of her damp skin, and the rain streaming down her face. She wears a pale pink cycling helmet and a pale pink mask. The faint red reflection from the bicycle taillight dynamically flickers on her eyes and skin, interwoven with the cool blue of the night. High-contrast cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, hyper-realistic skin texture, 85mm macro lens, and a resolute expression. Panel 2 — Aggressive Night Ride: A hyper-realistic cinematic medium close-up of a female cyclist aggressively riding in a nighttime downpour. She pedals hard, leaning forward. Her pale pink waterproof cycling jacket gleams slightly in the wet reflection. Bicycle headlights pierce through the rain and mist, their slight flickering creating dynamic illumination. The wet asphalt reflects red and white light. Smooth, cinematic tracking shots, stable with natural slight shaking. Panel 3 — Rain Impact Macro: Hyper-realistic macro cinematic lens showcasing the moment large raindrops hit wet asphalt at night. Huge crowns of water and ripples spread in puddles, slow motion revealing delicate hydrophysical effects. Cool blue cinematic hues, with subtle reflections from bicycle lights. Extremely shallow depth of field, rough wet asphalt texture, dramatic nighttime atmosphere. Fixed, stabilized macro shooting. Panel 4 — Three Cyclists in a Storm: Hyper-realistic cinematic lens showing three female road cyclists riding side-by-side rapidly in a nighttime downpour. All cyclists wear light pink cycling gear, contrasting with the deep blue environment. Powerful pedaling, wheels splashing water, bicycle lights illuminating the rain. One light flickers irregularly, creating unstable light and shadow variations on the cyclists and the wet pavement. Smooth, stable tracking shots from behind and to the side. Cinematic motion blur enhances the sense of speed. Panel 5 — Drivetrain under pressure: Hyper-realistic macro cinematic close-up showcasing a bicycle drivetrain during a high-intensity ride in a nighttime downpour. The rear sprocket, chain, derailleur, and chainring move violently under load. Pale pink cycling shoes are partially visible during pedaling. Water droplets, oil, and mud splatter on the metal surfaces. Flashing light intermittently sweeps across the rotating components, revealing sharp mechanical details before disappearing into darkness. Hyper-realistic wet textures and reflections. Panel 6 — Overhead drone formation: Hyper-realistic drone overhead shot showing three female cyclists riding in a perfect single file on a wet mountain road at night. Pale pink jackets are clearly visible against the dark, reflective asphalt. Perfect 90-degree vertical angle, locked composition, smooth and stable drone movement, no rotation or perspective shift. Reflections from the wet road surface, drizzle visible under bicycle lights, and atmospheric mist surrounding the road edge. Panel 7 — Side-tracking Speed ​​Shot: A hyper-realistic cinematic side-tracking shot showing female cyclists riding at high speed in nighttime rain and fog. The camera moves parallel to them, with a stable FPV-style cinematic motion. Occasionally, bright spots of flashing headlights are captured on their pale pink gear. Tires splash water, rain streaks across the screen, and a strong motion blur in the background emphasizes speed and endurance. Panel 8 — Headlight Piercing the Darkness: A hyper-realistic cinematic front shot showing the lead female cyclist riding straight towards the camera in heavy rain and dense fog. Her bicycle headlight flashes softly as it pierces the darkness. Her pale pink jacket is soaked through, with droplets splashing from the wheels. A focused expression, rapid breathing, and an aggressive forward lean. The wet asphalt shimmers with white and red reflections. Smooth, stable camera movement with a subtle cinematic floatiness. Panel 9 — Final Hero Close-up: A hyper-realistic cinematic hero close-up showing the female cyclist slowing down slightly after a vigorous ride. A tight composition of her face and upper body. A pale pink helmet, a soaked jacket, damp skin, raindrops dripping from her chin and glasses. Red taillights flicker softly behind her, creating subtle red highlights on the water droplets and facial contours. A calm but weary expression, visible breathing, cinematic low-key lighting, a cool blue ambiance, hyper-realistic details—the closing shot of a high-end sports advertisement.

Composition and shooting angle: Use an extremely low, upward-looking angle to create a sense of dominance and grand scale. The center of the composition is {argument name="subject" default="boy"} It occupies the lower and middle parts of the image. Directly above it, along the central axis, at the top of the image is a huge {argument name="airplane type" default="airliner"} Flying at extremely low altitude. Viewed from below, the aircraft's belly, landing gear, and two engines on each side are visible. The perspective enhances the drama, making the plane appear enormous, almost looming over the subject. The composition places the figure and the aircraft in a vertical line, amplifying the visual impact. Scene and Atmosphere: An open outdoor space with the sky dominating the background. The sky is cloudy with soft, fluffy clouds, and the light is natural sunlight. The atmosphere is tense and dynamic, with action elements. Around the subject, the powerful airflow from the aircraft's engines whips up dust, pebbles, and debris. Turbulence is palpable in the air, and everything in the scene seems to be in motion. The flying particles have a slight motion blur, creating a sense of speed. Character: A young man with striking features, exuding composure and confidence. His face is partially obscured by large-framed dark sunglasses, adding a touch of mystery. His skin looks natural, with a realistic texture. His lips are slightly closed, his expression calm and confident, appearing somewhat rebellious amidst the chaotic scene. Hairstyle: Stylish, thick, dark hair blown to the sides by strong airflow. His hair flows upwards, creating a chaotic sense of movement and energy. Posture and Body Language: The boy sits on a raised surface, such as a retaining wall, concrete curb, or platform edge. One leg is bent at the knee, the foot resting on the surface; the other leg hangs naturally, creating a relaxed, asymmetrical posture. One hand rests on the raised knee, the other hangs naturally. The torso leans slightly forward, shoulders are relaxed, and the posture is confident and composed, demonstrating control. The head is slightly raised, and the chin is slightly tilted upwards. Clothing: Casual style with a slightly rugged aesthetic. He is wearing {argument name="shirt style" default="Red, blue and white checkered shirt"} Wearing light blue jeans with ripped knees and a slightly loose fit. Converse sneakers with a distinctive design and rubber soles. The clothing sways in the wind, the fabric stretching and shifting slightly. Lighting: Natural sunlight, softened by clouds, with no harsh shadows. The contrast of light and shadow emphasizes the texture of the skin, fabric, and the metallic surface of the aircraft. The light shines softly from above and in front, gently sculpting the face and body.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张高质量的写实照片，竖构图，电影质感，高细节，动态场景，具有强烈的临场感和剧烈的气流感。

构图与拍摄角度：
镜头采用极低的角度向上仰拍，营造出一种主导感和宏大的规模感。构图中心是 {argument name="subject" default="男孩"}，占据画面的下部和中部。在他的正上方，沿中心轴线，画面上部是一架巨大的 {argument name="airplane type" default="客机"} 在极低高度飞行。从下方观察飞机，可以看到其机腹、起落架以及两侧的两台发动机。透视效果增强了戏剧性，飞机显得极其庞大，仿佛直接笼罩在主体上方。画面布局使人物与飞机形成一条垂直线，强化了视觉冲击力。

场景与氛围：
开阔的户外空间，天空占据了大部分背景。天空多云，云层柔软蓬松，光线为自然日光。氛围紧张且充满动感，带有动作元素。在主体周围，飞机引擎产生的强大气流将灰尘、小石子和碎片卷入空中。空气中能感受到湍流，场景中的所有元素似乎都在运动。飞扬的颗粒带有轻微的运动模糊，营造出速度感。

人物：
一位面部特征鲜明、沉稳自信的年轻男性。脸部被一副大框深色墨镜部分遮挡，增添了一丝神秘感。皮肤看起来自然，具有真实的质感。嘴唇微闭，表情冷静、自信，在混乱的场景中显得有些不羁。

发型：
时尚的浓密深色头发，被强劲的气流吹向两侧。发丝向上飘动，营造出混乱的动感与能量。

姿势与肢体语言：
男孩坐在一处高起的表面上，例如护墙、混凝土路缘或平台边缘。一条腿膝盖弯曲，脚踩在表面上；另一条腿自然垂下，形成一种放松的非对称姿势。一只手放在抬起的膝盖上，另一只手自然下垂。躯干略微前倾，肩膀放松，姿势自信且从容，展现出掌控力。头部微抬，下巴微微上扬。

服装：
休闲风格，带有略显粗犷的美感。他穿着 {argument name="shirt style" default="红蓝白格纹衬衫"}，浅蓝色牛仔裤，膝盖处有破洞设计，版型略微宽松。脚穿 Converse 风格的运动鞋，鞋型辨识度高，带有橡胶底。服装随风摆动，面料略微拉伸并产生位移。

光线：
自然日光，被云层柔化，没有强烈的阴影。光影对比强调了皮肤、面料和飞机金属表面的质感。光线从上方及前方略微照射，对脸部和身体进行了柔和的塑形。

Warm golden hour lighting, casual handheld composition, crispy and spicy texture, comfortable evening atmosphere, shallow depth of field, cinematic orange-brown tones. templates.title: Apple-style coach personal brand poster

titleLocalized.zh: Apple 风格教练个人品牌海报

templates.prompt: Using the uploaded portrait as a reference, design a high-end, minimalist, Apple-style Chinese coach promotional poster. Overall visual style: modern, simple, restrained, sophisticated, and minimalist, similar to the visual language of Apple product launch posters. The layout should have ample negative space, using soft lighting, a light gray-white background, and refined typography. No Apple logo, no redundant decorations, and no complex backgrounds. Portrait presentation: Preserve the portrait's natural facial features and temperament, making them appear professional, approachable, and confident. Attire should be a light gray suit jacket paired with a white crew neck/white shirt, maintaining a clean, studio-like feel. Place the portrait on the right or center-right of the frame, using a half-body composition, natural soft lighting, a clear face, and a white-to-light gray gradient background. Layout: Text on the left, portrait on the right. Use a modern sans-serif Chinese font, in black or dark gray, with clear hierarchy and a sense of breathing room. The main title should be the largest, the subtitle medium, and the skill descriptions smaller, all aligned to create a sophisticated brand feel. Poster text: Main title:{argument name="name" default="Bear Awakening"} ,subtitle:{argument name="title" default="Textual Creation Artist"} ,Skill:{argument name="abilities" default="Skilled in short article writing, action empowerment, and traffic acquisition"} Design specifications: Vertical poster, 4:5 aspect ratio. Color scheme: white, light gray, dark gray, black. Avoid using bright colors, cartoon style, exaggerated poses, or cluttered elements.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用上传的肖像作为参考，设计一张高端、极简、Apple 风格的中文教练宣传海报。整体视觉风格：现代、简洁、克制、高级且极简，类似于 Apple 产品发布海报的视觉语言。布局应留有充足的负空间，采用柔和光影、浅灰白色背景以及精致的排版。无需 Apple Logo，无需冗余装饰，无需复杂背景。人物呈现：保留人物真实的五官特征与气质，使其看起来专业、亲和且自信。着装应为浅灰色西装外套搭配白色圆领衫/白衬衫，保持干净的摄影棚质感。将人物置于画面右侧或中右侧，采用半身构图，自然柔光，面部清晰，背景为白至浅灰的渐变色。布局：文字在左，肖像在右。使用现代无衬线中文字体，颜色为黑色或深灰色，层级分明且留有呼吸感。主标题最大，副标题中等，技能描述较小，整体对齐以营造高级品牌感。海报文字：主标题：{argument name="name" default="Bear Awakening"}，副标题：{argument name="title" default="文字创作艺术家"}，技能：{argument name="abilities" default="擅长短文创作、行动赋能、流量获取"}。设计规格：竖版海报，4:5 比例。配色方案：白色、浅灰色、深灰色、黑色。避免使用艳丽色彩、卡通风格、夸张姿势或杂乱元素。

templates.title: Chinese concept poster generator

titleLocalized.zh: 中文概念海报生成器

templates.prompt: Based on the provided [Title], an advanced Chinese concept poster will be automatically generated. Users only need to provide the title:{argument name="title content" default="Enter title here"} Your task: Understand the theme, emotions, social issues, and metaphors behind the headline, and then complete the visual design. Don't mechanically depict the headline; instead, transform it into a visual poster in the style of a film magazine. 1. Style: High-end horizontal concept poster. Emotions can encompass social issues, psychological insights, humanistic concerns, intimate relationships, or workplace stress. The visual effect should resemble an in-depth report cover or an art exhibition poster. 2. Layout: Place the main headline on the left/top and the visual metaphor on the right/bottom. A strong connection must be established between the text and images. Emphasize visual impact, memorability, and white space. The default horizontal aspect ratio is 16:9, 4:3, or 3:1. 3. Typography: The main headline must be large and centered. Automatically generate subheadings (maximum 24 characters) to elaborate on deeper issues. Separate the bottom labels (4-6) with vertical lines. The font must match the theme (serif for social critiques, bold sans-serif for psychological insights). 4. Visual Metaphor: Utilize elements such as broken statues, empty chairs, mirrors, nighttime cityscapes, or medical images. Focus on one core metaphor + 2-4 details. 5. Atmosphere: Low saturation, sophisticated lighting, cinematic graininess, and deep emotional depth. Reject cute or bright internet template styles. 6. Output: A complete 4K high-resolution Chinese poster. No explanation required, only the image is output.

promptLocalized.zh: 基于提供的 [Title]，自动生成一张高端中文概念海报。用户仅需提供标题：{argument name="title content" default="在此输入标题"}。你的任务：理解标题背后的主题、情绪、社会议题及隐喻，随后完成视觉设计。不要机械地描绘标题，而是将其转化为电影杂志风格的视觉海报。1. 风格：高端横版概念海报。情绪可涵盖社会议题、心理洞察、人文关怀、亲密关系或职场压力等。视觉效果应类似于深度报道封面或艺术展览海报。2. 排版：左侧/上方放置大标题，右侧/下方放置视觉隐喻。文字与图像之间需建立强关联。强调视觉冲击力、记忆点及留白。默认为 16:9、4:3 或 3:1 的横向比例。3. 字体排版：主标题必须巨大且居中。自动生成副标题（最多 24 个字符）以阐述深层议题。底部标签（4-6 个）用竖线分隔。字体需与主题匹配（社会批判类使用衬线体，心理洞察类使用粗体无衬线体）。4. 视觉隐喻：使用破碎雕像、空椅子、镜子、夜间城市景观或医疗影像等元素。聚焦于 1 个核心隐喻 + 2-4 个细节。5. 氛围：低饱和度、高级光影、电影质感颗粒、深厚的情感深度。拒绝可爱或明亮的互联网模板风格。6. 输出：一张 4K 高分辨率的完整中文海报。无需解释过程，仅输出图像。

templates.title: GTA VI style 8K cinematic poster

titleLocalized.zh: GTA VI 风格 8K 电影感海报

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed 8K vertical poster, inspired by modern {argument name="game name" default="Grand Theft Auto VI"} The design should project the iconic visual style of GTA VI posters. It should evoke a cinematic urban atmosphere with bold compositions, vibrant lighting, layered graphic elements, and avant-garde modern street luxury. The overall design must strongly capture the signature feel of GTA VI posters, including dynamic neon hues, a tropical modern city vibe, dramatic shadows, glossy highlights, stylized textures, decorative elements, graphic overlays, urban symbols, luxurious lifestyle accents, and an immersive environmental narrative. Add sophisticated poster embellishments such as abstract shapes, graffiti-style accents, subtle retro-modern textures, luxury vehicle silhouettes, nightlife elements, palm tree shadows, road sign details, luminous reflections, and layered visual effects to enrich the composition while avoiding clutter. Place a large, cinematic headline text prominently on the poster.{argument name="main title" default="Grand Theft Auto VI"} The font design should be inspired by official promotional posters for AAA video games, where "GTA" should be explicitly written as "Grand Theft Auto." The font should appear bold, luxurious, and modern, and blend naturally into the poster design, complemented by additional smaller decorative text, symbols, labels, and graphic UI elements. Stylistic elements to enhance the realistic atmosphere of the game poster. The subject must not replicate the exact pose in the reference photograph. Create a completely new, visually more appealing pose that showcases stronger body language, natural movements, and expressive emotions. Expressions should be lively, charming, confident, and cinematic, rather than stiff, awkward, or flat. The pose must exude the elegance and attitude of an international fashion model, combining fashionable confidence with relaxed realism. Avoid static standing poses. Instead, use dynamic stances, subtle movements, stylish gestures, asymmetrical body positioning, realistic interaction with the environment, and strong eye contact to create a high-end editorial visual effect. Clothing should adopt a trendy modern casual style that incorporates influences from luxury streetwear. Clothing must appear fashionable, youthful, and visually rich, avoiding blandness or monotony. Combine diverse colors, layered clothing items, modern fabric textures, unique patterns, fashionable accessories, and elements relevant to GTA VI. Contemporary fashion details that complement each other. The styling should appear sophisticated, photogenic, and believable, resembling a fusion of high-end fashion magazine aesthetics and modern open-world game aesthetics. Utilize cinematic lighting with realistic skin textures, detailed fabric rendering, atmospheric reflections, richly detailed environmental compositions, balanced contrast, and ultra-clear visual details. The poster should convey the quality of official next-generation AAA game promotional art, possessing highly refined rendering quality, immersive visual storytelling, and professional graphic design execution. promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高度精细的 8K 竖版海报，灵感源自现代 {argument name="game name" default="Grand Theft Auto VI"} 宣传艺术的标志性视觉风格。设计应呈现电影般的都市氛围，具备大胆的构图、鲜艳的灯光、分层的图形元素以及前卫的现代街头奢华时尚感。整体设计必须强烈捕捉 GTA VI 海报的标志性氛围，包括动态霓虹色调、热带现代城市氛围、戏剧性阴影、光泽高光、风格化纹理、装饰性元素、图形叠加、城市符号、奢华生活方式点缀以及沉浸式的环境叙事。添加高级海报装饰元素，如抽象形状、涂鸦风格点缀、细腻的复古现代纹理、豪华车辆剪影、夜生活元素、棕榈树阴影、路牌细节、发光反射以及分层视觉效果，在丰富构图的同时避免拥挤感。在海报上显著位置放置大型电影感标题文本“{argument name="main title" default="Grand Theft Auto VI"}”，字体设计灵感应参考 AAA 级电子游戏官方宣传海报，其中“GTA”的全称应明确写为“Grand Theft Auto”。字体应显得大胆、奢华、现代，并自然地融入海报设计中，辅以额外的较小装饰性文本、符号、标签和图形 UI 风格元素，以增强真实的游戏海报氛围。主体不得复制参考照片中的确切姿态。创作一个全新的、视觉上更具吸引力的姿态，展现更强的肢体语言、自然动作和富有表现力的情绪。表情应生动、充满魅力、自信且具有电影感，而非僵硬、尴尬或平淡。姿态必须展现出国际时装模特般的优雅与态度，将时尚自信与轻松的写实感相结合。避免静态站立姿势。相反，应使用动态站姿、细微动作、时尚手势、不对称身体定位、与环境的真实互动以及强有力的眼神表达，以营造高端的编辑视觉效果。服装应采用融合了奢华街头服饰影响的潮流现代休闲时尚。服饰必须显得时尚、年轻且视觉丰富，避免平淡或单调。结合多样的色彩、叠穿的服装单品、现代面料纹理、独特的图案、时尚配饰以及与 GTA VI 风格相辅相成的当代时尚细节。造型应显得高级、上镜且可信，类似于高端时尚杂志与现代开放世界游戏美学的结合。使用具有真实皮肤纹理、精细面料渲染、大气反射、深度丰富的环境构图、平衡对比度和超清晰视觉细节的电影级灯光。海报应呈现出官方次世代 AAA 级游戏宣传艺术的质感，具备高度精炼的渲染质量、沉浸式视觉叙事和专业的平面设计执行力。超精细、高美感、电影级构图、真实比例、高级海报排版、鲜艳的现代调色板、视觉冲击力强，并以超高清 8K 质量渲染。宽高比 {argument name="ratio" default="4:5"}

promptLocalized.zh: {"type":"电影感 8 格故事板拼贴","format":"宽屏 16:9 联系表，面板间带有细白边","style":"温暖的黄金时刻写实 3D 动画风格，柔和的景深，富有表现力的家庭电影氛围，高细节，电影级灯光","branding":"整体图像右上角带有小巧的 HIX AI 标志","numbering":{"count":8,"style":"每个面板左上角带有黑色数字的白色圆角方形标签","labels":["1","2","3","4","5","6","7","8"]},"main characters":{"girl":"{argument name=\"main character\" default=\"一位年轻的女学生，留着高马尾长棕发，身穿芥末黄连帽衫，深色裤子，运动鞋，背着蓝色书包\"}","kitten":"{argument name=\"kitten description\" default=\"一只受伤的小橘猫，有着巨大的光泽眼睛、蓬松的毛发和包扎好的前爪\"}"},"setting":"{argument name=\"setting\" default=\"安静的郊区上学路、狭窄的砖墙巷子以及阳光明媚的教室\"}","overall story":"{argument name=\"story theme\" default=\"一位富有同情心的女孩在上学路上救助了一只受伤的小猫，并让全班同学都喜欢上了它\"}","panel layout":{"count":8,"panels":[{"number":1,"position":"左上","scene":"日出时分，林荫郊区街道的开场场景。女孩背着蓝色书包走向学校，背景是白色栅栏、房屋、停放的汽车、秋叶和温暖的阳光。"},{"number":2,"position":"中上","scene":"在狭窄的砖墙巷子里，女孩蹲在一只破旧的纸箱旁。橘猫虚弱地躺在箱子附近，一只爪子受伤，抬头看着她；周围散落着碎片，低角度的黄金光线营造出戏剧性效果。"},{"number":3,"position":"右上","scene":"特写镜头，女孩正用白色手帕温柔地包裹小猫受伤的爪子。小猫的脸占据了右侧，有着巨大的情感丰富的眼睛；浅景深，温柔的手部处于焦点位置。"},{"number":4,"position":"左中","scene":"女孩继续沿着人行道走，小猫藏在她的书包里，只有毛茸茸的橘色脑袋从半开的拉链中探出。背景是城市学校街道，有行人和柔和的晨光。"},{"number":5,"position":"正中","scene":"教室内，老师在项目上写着方程式和简单的图表，学生们坐在课桌前。女孩紧张地坐在阳光明媚的窗边，低头看着桌上拉上的书包。"},{"number":6,"position":"右中","scene":"当书包拉链打开，橘猫探出头时，同学们惊讶地围在女孩的课桌旁。女孩保护性地摸着书包；大家兴奋地凑近观看。"},{"number":7,"position":"左下","scene":"从猫咪背后拍摄的特写，它现在已经从书包里出来，面对着一群惊讶的学生。孩子们在暖光下围着小猫，表现出喜悦和好奇；小猫的耳朵和蓬松的背部是前景中的突出形状。"},{"number":8,"position":"右下","scene":"阳光明媚的教室窗边最终镜头。女孩抱着橘猫坐在怀里，同学们围在周围开心地抚摸它。明亮的窗户、植物、温暖的午后光辉，充满喜悦的情感结局。"}]},"visual notes":"在每个面板中保持女孩形象一致：芥末黄连帽衫、马尾辫、蓝色书包。保持小猫形象一致：体型小、橘色、蓬松、受伤且前爪有白色绷带。使用电影级构图、温暖的琥珀色阳光、逼真的纹理和温馨的动画电影外观。人物面部可以柔和处理或不突出，但肢体语言应清晰表达同情、紧张、惊讶和喜悦。","negative prompt":"无恐怖、无血腥、无残忍、除了八个数字标签和小标志外无文字说明、无额外面板、无扭曲的小猫解剖结构、无重复的女孩形象"}

templates.title: A strange VHS file shows a figure at the bedroom door.

titleLocalized.zh: 诡异 VHS 卧室门口人影

templates.prompt: Create a still image of an eerie "found video" from a degraded 1990s VHS home video, presented from a low-angle, handheld camera perspective in a dimly lit, cluttered bedroom at night. The walls are a dark reddish-brown, with deep shadows. To the left is a white metal bed frame and a messy bed, with several blurry posters on the wall. To the right is an open wooden door, with fabric or clothing hanging on it. A figure stands in the central doorway.{argument name="subject" default="A still human figure"} Wearing{argument name="costume" default="Outlined with light-colored rabbit ear hoods or a rabbit mask"} A light-colored patterned jacket, dark high-waisted trousers, and light-colored shoes; the face is deliberately blurred into a flat rectangle, making the image appear anonymous and unnatural.{argument name="lighting" default="Extremely low light conditions, accompanied by a weakening camera flash."} The composition should feature muddy colors, darkened blacks, soft focus, film grain, analog scan lines, chromatic aberration, slight lens distortion, vignetting, and a black VHS border around the image. The composition should evoke a sense of chance, the bizarre, and documentary, rather than cinematic, like a disturbing single frame from a lost videotape, with a figure in the doorway centered but partially swallowed by darkness.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张来自 20 世纪 90 年代退化 VHS 家庭录像的诡异“拾得录像”静帧，以低角度手持摄像机视角呈现夜晚昏暗凌乱的卧室。房间墙壁呈暗红褐色，阴影深重，左侧有一张白色金属床架和凌乱的床铺，墙上贴着几张模糊的海报，右侧是一扇敞开的木门，挂着布料或衣物。在中央门口站着 {argument name="subject" default="一个静止的人形身影"}，身穿 {argument name="costume" default="带有淡色兔耳兜帽或兔面具的轮廓"}、花纹浅色夹克、深色高腰裤和浅色小鞋；面部被刻意模糊成扁平的矩形遮挡，使该形象显得匿名且不自然。使用 {argument name="lighting" default="极低光照，伴随微弱的相机闪光灯衰减"}、浑浊的色彩、压暗的黑色、柔焦、胶片颗粒、模拟扫描线、色差噪点、轻微镜头畸变、暗角，并在画面周围添加黑色 VHS 边框。构图应呈现出偶然、怪异且纪实的感觉，而非电影感，就像是一盘失落录像带中令人不安的单帧画面，门口的人影居中但部分被黑暗吞没。

templates.title: Wooden "Impossible" Urban Knot

titleLocalized.zh: 木质“不可能”城市结

templates.prompt: Create a macro studio photograph of a desktop sculpture: a closed, continuous, self-intersecting "impossible" urban manifold, shaped like a robust wooden knot or a coiled torus, made entirely of light-colored, smooth architectural model wood.{argument name="urban center" default="Chicago"} The city center is uniformly mapped onto every curved surface of the manifold, with the iconic skyline, dense downtown blocks, grid-like streets, elevated tracks, and bridge-like infrastructure all physically squeezed out of the wood. The design emphasizes a spatial paradox: there is no true "upward" direction. Skyscrapers, rectangular buildings, street grids, and track strips simultaneously bulge inward into the cavity and outward to the outer edges, extending laterally along the twisted ribbon-like structure, while roads loop and close around the knots. The sculpture rests on a simple white gallery base, exhibiting a distinct miniaturization and handcrafted quality, with visible wood grain, precise laser-cut grooves, clean beveled edges, and miniature architectural details. Using pure, warm-toned gallery lighting, sharp and complex intersecting shadows are projected through the gaps against a neutral gray-brown background with shallow depth of field, presented from a three-quarter perspective, showcasing the central void, overlapping ribbon-like structures, and impossible geometry. The overall atmosphere is elegant, rigorous, architectural, and surreal, resulting in a highly realistic, product-grade museum photograph.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张桌面雕塑的微距摄影棚照片：一个闭合、连续、自相交的“不可能”城市流形，形状如同一个粗壮的木结或缠绕的环面，完全由浅色、光滑的建筑模型木材制成。将 {argument name="urban center" default="芝加哥"} 的城市中心均匀映射到流形的每一个曲面上，标志性的天际线、密集的市中心街区、网格状街道、高架轨道以及桥梁般的基建结构均从木材中物理挤出。强调空间悖论，即没有真正的“向上”方向：摩天大楼、矩形建筑、街道网格和轨道条同时向内突出到空腔中、向外突出到外缘，并沿着扭曲的带状结构向侧面延伸，而道路则在结的周围循环闭合。雕塑放置在一个简单的白色画廊底座上，具有明显的微缩感和手工制作痕迹，可见木纹、精确的激光切割槽、干净的斜切边缘以及微型建筑细节。使用纯净的暖色调画廊照明，通过空隙投射出锐利且复杂的交叉阴影，背景为中性灰褐色，采用浅景深，并以四分之三视角呈现，展现出中心空洞、重叠的带状结构和不可能的几何形状。整体氛围优雅、严谨、具有建筑感且充满超现实色彩，呈现为一张高度写实的产品级博物馆摄影作品。

templates.title: Impossible wooden Chicago knot city

titleLocalized.zh: 不可能的木质芝加哥结城市

templates.prompt: Create a macro photograph depicting an impossible tabletop sculpture: a closed, continuous, and self-intersecting topological manifold handcrafted from light-colored, smooth architectural model wood.{argument name="urban center" default="Chicago"} The city center is uniformly mapped across the entire surface of the knot, squeezing a clearly visible urban skyline—towers, dense blocks, grid-like streets, bridges, railroads, highways, and infrastructure—directly from the wooden surface. This creates a paradoxical geometry with no true upward direction: buildings grow outward, extend inward into the hollow rings, stretch laterally along the ribbon-like structure, and invert beneath the arches; roads and rail corridors encircle the manifold and endlessly loop back to themselves. Emphasis is placed on Chicago-like landmarks, including clusters of dark-wood skyscrapers with antenna towers reminiscent of Willis Tower and John Hancock Center, dense downtown high-rises, river bridge trusses, and elevated rail lines integrated into the knot. The sculpture should form several interlocking toroidal rings with open hollow slits, intricate internal shadows, and dense micro-architectural details on every visible surface. Use original gallery lighting, creating sharp, intersecting shadows, paired with a neutral gray gallery background and a clean white square base to ensure it reflects the proportions of a handcrafted tabletop architectural model. The material should be a single-color light-colored linden or birch, with fine laser-cut textures, tiny windowpane grids, delicate etched roads, and layered wood strips. It should be shot from a three-quarter frontal perspective, with shallow macro depth of field, high realism, clear details, and no people in the frame.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张微距摄影作品，拍摄一个不可能存在的桌面雕塑：一个由浅色、光滑的建筑模型木材手工打造的闭合、连续且自相交的拓扑结流形。将 {argument name="urban center" default="芝加哥"} 的城市中心均匀地映射在结的整个表面上，从木质表面直接挤压出清晰可见的城市天际线塔楼、密集的街区、网格状街道、桥梁、铁路线、高速公路和基础设施。使几何结构呈现出悖论感，没有真正的向上方向：建筑物向外生长，向内延伸至空心环中，沿着带状结构横向延伸，并在拱门下方倒置；道路和铁路走廊环绕着流形，并无限地循环回自身。强调类似芝加哥的地标，包括类似于威利斯大厦 (Willis Tower) 和约翰汉考克中心 (John Hancock Center) 带有天线塔的深色木质摩天大楼群、密集的市中心高层建筑、河桥桁架以及集成在结中的高架轨道。雕塑应形成几个相互交织的环面状圆环，带有开放的空心缝隙、复杂的内部阴影，以及在每个可见表面上密集的微型建筑细节。使用原始的画廊照明，呈现锐利的交叉阴影，搭配中性灰色的画廊背景和干净的白色方形底座，以确保其呈现出纯手工桌面建筑模型的比例。材质应为单色浅色椴木或桦木，具有精细的激光切割纹理、微小的窗格网格、精致的蚀刻道路和分层木条，以四分之三正面视角拍摄，具有浅微距景深、高真实感、清晰的细节，且画面中无人。

templates.title: Classroom friends candid photos

titleLocalized.zh: 课堂好友抓拍

templates.prompt: Create a snapshot in the style of a 35mm disposable film camera to showcase {argument name="group description" default="Four young female friends"} A casual daytime photoshoot in a traditional Japanese classroom. The scene features four people: one sitting to the left front, wearing a white off-the-shoulder ruffled crop top and denim mini-skirt, making a peace sign; another standing behind her, wearing a pink fitted V-neck crop top and white pleated mini-skirt, making double peace signs; one sitting to the right center, wearing a pale yellow off-the-shoulder top and black shorts, resting her chin on her hand while leaning against a desk; and one standing on the far right, wearing a light blue striped shirt and white mini-skirt, leaning forward against a desk. Their faces are all softly blurred into rectangular shapes to anonymize them. The nostalgic classroom background, including rows of wooden desks and chairs, beige metal lockers on the back wall, a large window on the right, and lush green trees outside, evokes the warm afternoon sunlight, the dust in the air, and the relaxed atmosphere after school. The image includes clearly visible items on the desks: two plastic beverage bottles, a magazine with an ornate cover on the front desk, a pink handbag, a black hair styling tool or storage box, a book with a blue cover and a few stationery items on the right desk. The composition uses a wide, horizontal shot slightly above desk height, featuring slight wide-angle distortion, a tilted framing, a natural sense of clutter, film grain, a soft-focus effect, and the strong light effect created by the interplay of flash and outside light. The colors are soft, presenting realistic simulated photographic imperfections. The overall atmosphere creates a candid, vacation-like snapshot of friends in a classroom, both stylish and playful yet possessing photorealistic quality.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 35mm 一次性胶片相机风格的抓拍照片，展示 {argument name="group description" default="四位年轻女性好友"} 在日式旧教室中白天的随意摆拍。场景中共有 4 人：一人坐在左前方，身穿白色露肩荷叶边短上衣和牛仔短裙，比着剪刀手；一人站在她身后，身穿粉色修身 V 领短上衣和白色百褶短裙，比着双剪刀手；一人坐在中右侧，身穿淡黄色露肩上衣和黑色短裤，单手托腮靠在课桌上；一人站在最右侧，身穿浅蓝色条纹衬衫搭配白色短裙，身体前倾靠在课桌上。她们的面部均经过柔和的矩形模糊处理，以实现匿名化。使用怀旧的教室背景，包含成排的木制课桌椅、后墙上的米色金属储物柜、右侧宽大的开窗以及窗外翠绿的树木，呈现温暖的午后阳光、空气中的微尘以及随性的放学后氛围。画面中包含清晰可见的课桌物品：2 个塑料饮料瓶、前排课桌上 1 本封面华丽的杂志、1 个粉色手提包、1 个黑色美发工具或收纳盒、右侧课桌上 1 本蓝色封面的书以及少量文具。构图采用略高于课桌高度的宽幅横向抓拍，带有轻微的广角畸变、倾斜的取景、自然的杂乱感、胶片颗粒、柔焦效果，以及闪光灯与窗外光线交织的强光效果，色彩柔和，呈现真实的模拟摄影瑕疵。整体氛围营造出一种好友在教室中不经意间的度假感抓拍，既时尚俏皮又具备照片级的真实感。

templates.title: Classroom photos taken by friends

titleLocalized.zh: 课堂好友抓拍照片

templates.prompt: Create a realistic 35mm film snapshot to showcase {argument name="number of friends" default="Four"} Adult women are gathered in an old classroom, sitting behind wooden desks against a backdrop of tall, sunlit windows and gray metal lockers. The atmosphere is casual, like a candid shot during a break, with soft natural sunlight, a slight wide-angle perspective, visible film grain, soft tones, and a slightly cluttered environment. Chairs, bags, notebooks, magazines, plastic water bottles, and stationery are scattered on the desks in the foreground. From left to right, the four people are: 1) a woman with long, dark hair, wearing a white short-sleeved ruffled crop top and light blue denim mini skirt, with one hand raised above her head; 2) a woman with medium-length brown hair, wearing a fitted {argument name="center outfit color" default="pink"} 1) A woman in a crop top and white pleated skirt is making a peace sign; 2) A woman with a dark short bob, wearing a light yellow strapless crop top and black skirt, is making a peace sign at the back of the crowd; 3) A woman with her hair tied up, wearing an open light blue shirt (knotted at the waist, with a low-cut top underneath) and a white skirt, is making a peace sign. Have them stand side-by-side in a friendly group photo, facing the camera, with their faces deliberately obscured by square pixelated blur blocks to protect their privacy. Create an atmosphere reminiscent of a Japanese classroom or clubroom, using worn wooden tables, metal lockers, and large windows with bright, overexposed outdoor light to present realistic skin texture, natural body proportions, casual poses, and an authentic film camera feel. Avoid using studio lighting to make it look like an unretouched, candid snapshot of real life.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实的 35mm 胶片抓拍照片，展示 {argument name="number of friends" default="四位"} 成年女性在旧教室中聚在一起，坐在木质课桌后，背景是高大的阳光窗户和灰色金属储物柜。氛围随意，如同课间休息时的抓拍，带有柔和的自然日光、轻微的广角透视、可见的胶片颗粒、柔和的色调，以及略显杂乱的环境，前景的课桌上散落着椅子、包袋、笔记本、杂志、塑料水瓶和文具。从左到右数这四个人：1) 一位留着深色长发、身穿白色短袖荷叶边露脐上衣和浅蓝色牛仔短裙的女性，一只手举在头边；2) 一位留着中长棕色头发、身穿修身 {argument name="center outfit color" default="粉色"} 露脐上衣和白色百褶短裙的女性，正在比剪刀手；3) 一位留着深色短波波头、身穿浅黄色抹胸露脐上衣和黑色短裙的女性，在人群后方比剪刀手；4) 一位扎着头发、身穿敞开式浅蓝色衬衫（腰间打结，内搭低领上衣）和白色短裙的女性，正在比剪刀手。让她们肩并肩组成友好的合影构图，面向镜头，面部刻意用方形像素马赛克模糊块遮挡以保护隐私。营造日本教室或社团活动室的氛围，使用磨损的木桌、金属储物柜、带有明亮过曝室外光的大窗户，呈现真实的皮肤纹理、自然的身体比例、随意的造型以及地道的胶片相机质感。避免使用影棚灯光，使其看起来像是一张未经修饰的真实生活抓拍。

The classroom backdrop features beige lockers, a bright, large window on the right, and worn wooden desks scattered with personal belongings, including a laptop covered in stickers, a small digital camera, headphones, a water bottle, sunglasses, a tote bag, a backpack, and a black thermos. promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实风格的 35mm 胶片感抓拍照片，内容为 {argument name="group description" default="四位大学生年轻女性"} 在阳光明媚的教室里亲密合影，她们坐在旧木课桌旁或倚靠在金属椅边。场景中共有 4 人：左侧女性身穿白色开衫衬衫内搭白色罗纹背心，下着浅蓝色牛仔短裙，系皮带，穿白袜和深色鞋，侧身倚靠并举起一只手靠近脸部；第二位女性身穿粉色短袖短款上衣和白色百褶裙，比出剪刀手；第三位女性身穿浅黄色吊带衫、白色开衫衬衫、深色短款西装外套、黑色短裙和条纹过膝袜，做出俏皮的手势；右侧女性身穿腰间打结的超大款浅蓝色衬衫，内搭白色背心，系宽松深色领带，穿白色百褶裙配链条腰带，白袜配黑色乐福鞋，跪在椅子上比出剪刀手。将所有 4 个人的面部刻意用柔和的方形模糊块遮挡，以实现匿名化处理。教室背景设有米色储物柜，右侧有明亮的大窗户，摆放着磨损的木制课桌，散落着个人物品，包括贴满贴纸的笔记本电脑、小型数码相机、耳机、笔记本、水杯、太阳镜、托特包、背包和一个黑色保温杯。采用自然窗光、轻微广角视角、真实的肤色、休闲的日本青年时尚风格、浅景深、细腻的胶片颗粒感、不完美的抓拍构图，呈现高分辨率的编辑摄影效果。整体氛围：{argument name="mood" default="课间休息后友好的早晨抓拍"}。

templates.title: Heart-shaped Sunset Cave Figure

titleLocalized.zh: 心形日落洞穴人像

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic vertical portrait, with the main subject being {argument name="subject" default="A young woman with long black braids"} She stood in the very center of a natural heart-shaped cave opening. The rough, black volcanic rock of the cave formed a dark heart-shaped frame around the entire scene, its inner edges shimmering with warm, reddish-orange contour lighting. The protagonist faced the camera, arms outstretched horizontally, wearing {argument name="outfit" default="An oversized beige windbreaker paired with navy blue sleeves, distressed denim shorts, thick white slouch socks, white sneakers, and a small backpack."} Behind her was a spectacular sunset over the sea: the sun hung low on the horizon, just between her legs, casting a golden path of light on the water, and the sky was filled with vibrant orange, pink, purple, and blue clouds. The image should include eight seagulls flying at different distances: a large, blurry seagull in the upper left, a large seagull in the upper right center, a small seagull near the center of the sky, a large seagull in the right center, a small seagull in the upper right distance, a small seagull in the center of the right side, a seagull in the lower left corner above the horizon, and a tiny distant seagull near the sunset line. The composition should be realistic, with high dynamic range, strong backlighting, warm sunset glow, delicate rock textures, birds with slight motion blur, shallow depth of field, symmetrical romantic composition, full-body portrait, and a 2:3 vertical aspect ratio.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影感的竖构图人像，主角为 {argument name="subject" default="一位留着黑色长辫的年轻女性"}，她正站在一个天然心形洞穴开口的正中央。粗糙的黑色火山岩洞穴在整个场景周围形成了一个深色的心形框架，内边缘闪烁着温暖的红橙色轮廓光。主角面向镜头，双臂水平伸展，身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="一件超大款米色防风衣，搭配海军蓝袖子、磨边牛仔短裤、厚实的白色堆堆袜、白色运动鞋和一个小背包"}。她身后是壮观的海上日落：太阳低悬在地平线上，正好位于她的双腿之间，在水面上投射出一条金色的光路，天空中布满了鲜艳的橙色、粉色、紫色和蓝色云彩。画面中需包含 8 只处于不同距离的飞行海鸥：左上方有一只模糊的大海鸥，中右上方有一只大海鸥，天空中央附近有一只小海鸥，中右侧有一只大海鸥，右上方远处有一只小海鸥，右侧中央有一只小海鸥，地平线上方左下角有一只海鸥，以及日落线附近有一只极小的远景海鸥。采用写实摄影风格，高动态范围，强烈的逆光效果，温暖的日落余晖，细腻的岩石纹理，鸟类带有轻微的动态模糊，浅景深氛围，对称的浪漫构图，全身人像，竖构图 2:3 比例。

templates.title: Sierra-style castle pixel art under the moonlight

titleLocalized.zh: 月光下的 Sierra 风格城堡像素艺术

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed pixel art scene in the style of the 1990s Sierra adventure game, depicting a {argument name="castle type" default="Medieval Bavarian Castles"} The scene at night, viewed from the tranquil opposite shore of the lake, depicts a magnificent and fairytale-like castle with white stone walls, steep red roofs, half-timbered upper floors, numerous cylindrical towers and corner towers, crenellated walls, glowing arches, and warm yellow light filtering through many small windows. A narrow stone bridge spans the water, leading to the castle's entrance on the left. The scene is set against a deep cobalt blue moonlit landscape, with a bright full moon hanging in the upper left sky, dotted with stars, soft wispy clouds, dark pine silhouettes, distant mountains, and a rocky lakeshore, framed by several tall evergreen trees on either side. The lake should dominate the foreground, reflecting the entire castle, moonlight, bridge, windows, and towers in shimmering horizontal pixel ripples. Add a few glowing fireflies along the lakeshore and on the water's surface. It adopts a retro VGA pixel art aesthetic inspired by the classic Sierra point-and-click adventure game, featuring a crisp jitter effect, limited but vibrant blue-purple tones, bright highlights, high contrast, painterly pixel clusters, a romantic fantasy atmosphere, and contains no modern UI or text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅细节丰富的 20 世纪 90 年代 Sierra 冒险游戏风格像素艺术场景，描绘一座 {argument name="castle type" default="中世纪巴伐利亚城堡"} 在夜晚的景象，从宁静的湖对岸望去。城堡宏伟且充满童话色彩，拥有白色石墙、红色陡峭屋顶、半木结构的上层楼面、多个圆柱形塔楼和角楼、雉堞状城墙、发光的拱门，以及从许多小窗户中透出的温暖黄光。一座狭窄的石桥横跨水面，通往城堡左侧的入口。场景设定在深钴蓝色的月光景观中，左上方天空悬挂着一轮明亮的满月，点缀着繁星、柔和的层云、深色的松林剪影、远处的山峰、岩石湖岸，左右两侧由几棵高大的常青树框景。湖泊应占据前景，将整个城堡、月光、桥梁、窗户和塔楼倒映在闪烁的水平像素涟漪中。在湖岸边和水面上添加少量发光的萤火虫。采用受经典 Sierra 点击式冒险游戏启发的怀旧 VGA 像素艺术美学，具有清晰的抖动效果、有限但充满活力的蓝紫色调、明亮的高光、高对比度、绘画般的像素簇、浪漫的奇幻氛围，且不包含任何现代 UI 或文字。

templates.title: Cherry Blossom Rose Clock Tower Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 樱花玫瑰钟楼肖像

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic vertical portrait, with the subject being {argument name="subject" default="A young woman with long chestnut brown hair and two loose braids"} She stood under a huge, dark cherry blossom tree, dressed in {argument name="outfit" default="A soft beige knit sweater"} Gently holding a pink rose to her lips. The scene is set in a magical old European stone clock tower garden at golden hour, with the tall, ornate clock tower in the background slightly out of focus, covered in roses and greenery. The subject is placed in the foreground below a tree trunk on the left, pink roses growing on the bark, and dense cherry blossom branches forming an arch at the top. The image must include one striking clock tower, one huge cherry tree trunk, one rose held by the subject, and many pink petals falling in the warm sunset. A romantic fairytale atmosphere is employed, using shallow depth of field, soft bokeh, warm backlighting, halos on the hair, delicate fabric textures, natural skin tones, cinematic color grading, a realistic photographic style, a 35mm portrait lens feel, and a vertical 2:3 composition to present a dreamlike realistic effect. Visible facial features should conform to {argument name="face appearance" default="A natural and soft portrait appearance"} Maintain a tranquil, nostalgic, and elegant atmosphere. No text, no watermarks, no modern objects.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影感的竖构图肖像，主体为 {argument name="subject" default="一位留着栗棕色长发、扎着两个松散麻花辫的年轻女性"}，她站在一棵巨大的深色樱花树下，身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="一件柔软的米色针织毛衣"}，轻轻地将一朵粉色玫瑰拿在唇边。场景设定在黄金时刻一座充满魔力的欧洲古老石砌钟楼花园中，背景中高大华丽的钟楼略微失焦，上面爬满了玫瑰和绿植。将主体置于左侧树干旁的近景下方，树皮上长着粉色玫瑰，茂密的樱花枝叶在顶部形成拱形。画面中必须包含 1 座醒目的钟楼、1 棵巨大的樱花树干、1 朵由主体持有的玫瑰，以及许多在温暖夕阳下随风飘落的粉色花瓣。采用浪漫的童话氛围，使用浅景深、柔和的焦外成像、温暖的逆光、发丝上的光晕、细腻的织物纹理、自然的肤色、电影级调色、写实摄影风格、35mm 肖像镜头感、竖向 2:3 构图，呈现梦幻般的写实效果。可见的面部特征应符合 {argument name="face appearance" default="自然柔和的肖像外观"}；保持宁静、怀旧且优雅的氛围。无文字，无水印，无现代物品。

templates.title: Iridescent glass Gothic aesthetic portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 虹彩玻璃哥特美学肖像

templates.prompt: Create a visually striking editorial close-up portrait of a woman with porcelain-white skin, featuring {argument name="hair color" default="Gray and gold highlights"} Her hair was disheveled, strands falling across her forehead and cheeks, framed by a tight vertical composition from her forehead to her chin. Her face was slightly tilted, one large eye positioned in the upper right corner and the other in the lower left, both gazing intently at the viewer. She possessed large, lustrous blue-grey irises, filled with a kaleidoscopic effect of crystal reflections, complemented by dramatic black smoky eye makeup, thick, long, spider-leg-like eyelashes, sharp eyeliner, and a small beauty mark below the outer corner of her right eye. Her lips were full, slightly parted, and painted with…{argument name="lip color" default="Deep black cherry glossy lipstick"} A transparent, iridescent glass dagger or shard slits diagonally across the face from the upper left to the lower right, grazing between the bridge of the nose and the eyes, refracting rainbow colors like an oil film and prism light. The overall color scheme is dominated by low-saturation graphite gray skin and hair color, while the glass shard and eyes display vibrant holographic blues, purples, oranges, greens, and pinks. The style blends hyper-realistic fashion photography with surreal gothic doll aesthetics, showcasing extremely delicate skin texture, moist, glossy highlights, and clearly defined individual hair strands. High contrast, soft studio lighting, shallow depth of field, no text, no background distractions, and a vertical portrait composition are employed.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张极具视觉冲击力的编辑类美妆特写肖像，主角是一位拥有瓷白肌肤的女性，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="灰金与棕色挑染"} 的凌乱发型，发丝垂落在额头和脸颊上，画面采用从额头到下巴的紧凑垂直构图。她的脸部微微倾斜，一只大眼睛位于右上角，另一只位于左下角，双眼都凝视着观众。赋予她超大且富有光泽的蓝灰色虹膜，虹膜中充满水晶般万花筒式的反射效果，搭配戏剧性的黑色烟熏眼妆、浓密纤长的蜘蛛腿睫毛、锋利的眼线，以及右眼外眼角下方的一颗小美人痣。她的双唇丰满，微微张开，涂抹着 {argument name="lip color" default="深黑樱桃色亮面唇膏"}。一片透明的虹彩玻璃匕首或碎片从左上角斜向穿过面部至右下角，掠过鼻梁和双眼之间，折射出如同油膜和棱镜光般的彩虹色泽。整体色调以低饱和度的石墨灰肤色和发色为主，玻璃碎片和双眼则呈现出鲜艳的全息蓝、紫、橙、绿和粉色。风格融合超写实时尚摄影与超现实哥特玩偶美学，展现极度细腻的皮肤纹理、湿润的光泽高光、清晰的单根发丝，高对比度，柔和的摄影棚灯光，浅景深，无文字，无背景干扰，垂直肖像构图。

templates.prompt: Create a touching movie poster, with the foreground center position as {argument name="subject" default="young women"} A bust, dressed in a fitted outfit{argument name="outfit color" default="black"} The subject wears a long-sleeved top and delicate layered silver necklaces. Her long, dark brown hair is parted in the middle and braided into two loose braids. Soft studio lighting is used, with subtle warm rim lighting on her hair and shoulders. The entire background behind her is filled with a large black-and-white close-up of a face, focusing on a large eye, eyebrow, eyelashes, and part of the nose, dramatically cropped to position the eye on the right side of the image, with dark hair framing the edges. Using an emotional monochrome background, the foreground subject is rendered in soft, natural colors, with high contrast, shallow depth of field, and an edited fashion poster composition. The 16:9 aspect ratio is used, employing realistic photography, a clean and modern aesthetic, and no text or logo. A soft rectangular overlay is added on the left as a dark gray-brown block, and a smaller warm skin-toned rectangle is overlaid on the subject's face, creating an anonymous poster mockup effect.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影感人像海报，前景中心位置为 {argument name="subject" default="年轻女性"} 的半身像，身穿修身的 {argument name="outfit color" default="黑色"} 长袖上衣，佩戴精致的叠层银色项链。主体留着深棕色长发，中分并编成两条松散的辫子，采用柔和的摄影棚灯光，头发和肩部带有微妙的暖色轮廓光。主体后方的整个背景填充一张巨大的黑白人脸特写照片，聚焦于一只大眼睛、眉毛、睫毛和部分鼻梁，进行戏剧性的裁剪，使眼睛位于画面右侧，深色头发环绕边缘。使用情绪化的单色背景，前景主体采用柔和的自然色彩，高对比度，浅景深，编辑时尚海报构图，16:9 横向比例，写实摄影，简洁现代美学，无文字，无 Logo。在左侧添加一个柔和的矩形覆盖区域作为暗灰棕色块，并在主体面部覆盖一个较小的暖肤色矩形，营造出匿名海报样机效果。

templates.title: Gritty Claude Prompts Carousel Cover

titleLocalized.zh: Gritty Claude Prompts 轮播图封面

templates.prompt: Create a square, grunge-inspired social media carousel cover poster with a backdrop of worn beige paper, presenting a rough, photocopy/magazine aesthetic. At the center of the composition is a black-and-white photograph taped together, scratched and worn, with a face obscured by a large area of ​​gray paint; the photograph is held in place by two pieces of yellowed masking tape, a horizontal strip above and a torn vertical strip along the right edge. Add a large, hand-drawn red star graffiti in the upper left corner, using a rough stamp font layered on the torn paper. The main title is "{argument name="headline text" default="CLAUDE PROMPTS"} The text uses huge, black, decadent-style capital letters across the center, partially overlapping the photo. Above the bottom title is the smaller word "EVERY," followed by a large red stamped word in the center below.{argument name="emphasis word" default="BEGINNER"} Add a black "NEEDS" sign in the bottom right corner. Add a subtitle near the bottom, centered.{argument name="subtitle text" default="A STARTER PACK FOR REAL LIFE"} Use uppercase letters in a small typewriter style. Add tiny handwritten footer text in the lower left corner.{argument name="footer label" default="CLAUDE • BEGINNER PROMPTS"} Add "SWIPE →" to the bottom right corner and a small page indicator to the top right corner.{argument name="page indicator" default="01 / 12"} Using a limited palette of dirty beige, black ink, gray paint, and deep red, and adding torn edges, ink blots, rough halftone textures, scratches, tape shadows, and imperfect alignment, it looks like an underground punk flyer repurposed as a bold AI cue carousel thumbnail.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个方形的颓废风社交媒体轮播图封面海报，背景为陈旧的米色纸张，呈现出一种复印件/杂志的粗糙美学。构图中心是一张黑白胶带粘贴的照片，照片有刮痕和磨损，并用大面积的灰色油漆涂抹遮挡了面部；照片由两块泛黄的遮蔽胶带固定，上方是一条水平胶带，右侧边缘是一条撕裂的垂直胶带。在左上角添加一个巨大的手绘红色星形涂鸦，并使用层叠在撕裂纸片上的粗糙印章字体。主标题为“{argument name="headline text" default="CLAUDE PROMPTS"}”，采用巨大的黑色颓废风大写字母横跨中心，部分覆盖在照片上。在底部标题上方添加小字“EVERY”，接着在下方中间位置添加一个巨大的红色印章词“{argument name="emphasis word" default="BEGINNER"}”，右下角添加黑色的“NEEDS”。在底部附近居中添加副标题“{argument name="subtitle text" default="A STARTER PACK FOR REAL LIFE"}”，使用小型打字机风格的大写字母。在左下角添加微小的手写页脚文字“{argument name="footer label" default="CLAUDE • BEGINNER PROMPTS"}”，右下角添加“SWIPE →”，并在右上角添加一个小型的页面指示器“{argument name="page indicator" default="01 / 12"}”。使用脏米色、黑色墨水、灰色油漆和深红色的有限调色板，并加入撕裂边缘、墨迹、粗糙的半色调纹理、划痕、胶带阴影和不完美的对齐效果；使其看起来像是一张被重新利用为大胆的 AI 提示词轮播图缩略图的地下朋克传单。

templates.prompt: Create a 1:1 square social media carousel cover with a near-black background for a sophisticated dark tech aesthetic. Use a huge, bold, alligator-compressed sans-serif font, left-aligned and split across lines, with the text "{argument name="headline text" default="60 CLAUDE PROMPTS EVERY BEGINNER NEEDS"} The title uses a bright orange glow effect for "60" and "BEGINNER," while the rest of the text is bright white. Below the title, add a smaller, more widely spaced subtitle in uppercase letters that reads: "..."{argument name="subtitle text" default="A STARTER PACK FOR REAL LIFE"} The color is light peach. Add a tiny footer tag in the bottom left corner with the content "".{argument name="footer text" default="CLAUDE · BEGINNER PROMPTS"} Add an orange call to action in the bottom right corner.{argument name="call to action" default="SWIPE →"} It contains three large, softly blurred orange-red gradient spheres: a partially crescent-shaped sphere cuts in from the upper right corner, a partially warm pink/orange halo cuts in from the lower right edge, and a small pink halo peeking out from the left edge. An orange-outlined octagonal star icon is included in the upper left corner of the title. A thin white corner marker is added to each of the four corners, and a small page indicator is added to the upper right corner with the text "".{argument name="page indicator" default="01 / 12"} Overall style: high-contrast black, neon orange halo, clean editing grid, sharp modern startup brand feel, minimalist futuristic UI details, clear typography, and professional carousel thumbnail design.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个 1:1 的方形社交媒体轮播图封面，采用近乎黑色的背景，呈现高级的深色科技美学。使用巨大的粗体大写压缩无衬线字体，左对齐并分行排列，文字内容为“{argument name="headline text" default="60 CLAUDE PROMPTS EVERY BEGINNER NEEDS"}”，其中“60”和“BEGINNER”使用鲜艳的橙色发光效果，其余文字使用亮白色。在标题下方，添加一行字间距较宽的小号大写副标题，内容为“{argument name="subtitle text" default="A STARTER PACK FOR REAL LIFE"}”，颜色为淡桃色。在左下角添加一个微小的页脚标签，内容为“{argument name="footer text" default="CLAUDE · BEGINNER PROMPTS"}”，右下角添加橙色的行动号召语“{argument name="call to action" default="SWIPE →"}”。包含 3 个巨大的柔和模糊橙红色渐变球体：一个部分新月形球体从右上角切入，一个部分热粉色/橙色光晕从右下边缘切入，以及一个小粉色光晕从左侧边缘露出。在标题左上方包含 1 个橙色轮廓的八角星图标。在四个角各添加 1 个细白色角标裁剪标记，并在右上角添加一个小的页面指示器，内容为“{argument name="page indicator" default="01 / 12"}”。整体风格：高对比度黑色、霓虹橙色光晕、简洁的编辑网格、锐利的现代初创公司品牌感、极简的未来主义 UI 细节、清晰的排版、专业的轮播图缩略图设计。

titleLocalized.zh: 景泰蓝工艺 PPT 封面

templates.prompt: Create a 16:9 widescreen PowerPoint cover slide with an elegant traditional Chinese craft presentation style. The background is an ivory-colored Xuan paper texture, decorated with a dark cyan and gold border and Chinese-style corner flowers. The main title on the left is in a striking dark blue Chinese calligraphy font, and the content is {argument name="headline text" default="Cloisonné enamel"} Below is a smaller gold subtitle{argument name="subtitle text" default="Oriental Splendor in Fire and Gold"} Below it, place a centered, rounded label with cyan text that reads:{argument name="section label" default="Traditional Crafts Theme Sharing"} Add a short explanatory text line in the lower left corner.{argument name="footer note" default="Discover a magnificent craft composed of a metal base, fine wires, and enamel glazes."} Add a delicate dark cyan page number indicator to the upper right corner, with the following content:{argument name="page indicator" default="01 / 10"} The right half showcases an exquisitely detailed blue-gold cloisonné vase resting on a dark wood base. The vase is adorned with lotus flowers, green lotus leaves, curling gold wire patterns, turquoise accents, and a magnificent gold handle. The foreground of the table features seven delicate craft items: a roll of gold wire, a flat cloisonné floral medallion, a key-shaped gold ornament, a fine metal craft pen or stylus, and four small bowls containing blue, green, turquoise, and white/gold enamel powder respectively. The background incorporates elegant ink-wash landscapes, a distant pavilion, soft lotus lines, and floating auspicious cloud patterns. Employing refined museum-style aesthetics, the presentation combines realistic product rendering with delicate Chinese illustrations. The color scheme uses harmonious cream, deep navy, turquoise, and metallic gold, with clear typography and balanced negative space, presenting the composition of a high-end educational PowerPoint presentation title slide.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个 16:9 宽屏 PowerPoint 封面幻灯片，采用优雅的中国传统工艺演示风格，背景为象牙色宣纸质感，配有深青色与金色的装饰边框及中式角花。左侧主标题为醒目的深蓝色中式书法字体，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="掐丝珐琅"}，下方配有较小的金色副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="火与金线中的东方华彩"}。在其下方放置一个居中的圆角标签牌，文字为青色，内容为 {argument name="section label" default="传统工艺主题分享"}；左下角添加一行简短的说明文字 {argument name="footer note" default="认识一种以金属胎、细丝与珐琅釉色共同构成的华美工艺"}。右上角添加一个精致的深青色页码指示器，内容为 {argument name="page indicator" default="01 / 10"}。右半部分展示一个细节极其丰富的蓝金景泰蓝花瓶，置于深色木质底座上，瓶身装饰有莲花、绿色荷叶、卷曲的金丝纹样、绿松石色点缀及华丽的金色把手。桌面前景包含 7 件精细的工艺物件：1 卷金丝、1 个扁平的景泰蓝花卉奖章、1 个钥匙形状的金色饰品、1 支精细的金属工艺笔或触针，以及 4 个分别盛有蓝色、绿色、绿松石色和白/金色珐琅粉末的小碗。背景融入淡雅的水墨山水、远处的凉亭、柔和的莲花线条画以及漂浮的祥云纹样。采用精致的博物馆课程美学，将写实的产品渲染与细腻的中国插画相结合，配色采用和谐的奶油色、深海军蓝、绿松石色与金属金，排版清晰，负空间平衡，呈现出高端教育类 PPT 标题幻灯片的构图。

The camera angle is extremely low, close to the polished marble floor, shooting upwards with a dramatic perspective: one booted leg kicks sharply towards the audience with strong motion blur, while the other leg extends backward, and one hand rests on the reflective floor. The performer looks at the audience with a confident and sharp expression. She possesses a graceful, flowing {argument name="hair color" default="Rose Pink"} Long twin ponytails, green eyes, a white maid headband with ruffles, and dressed in gorgeous attire.{argument name="outfit color" default="Deep emerald green"} A Gothic Lolita maid dress featuring puff sleeves, white lace trim, a corset-style top, a bow, a multi-tiered skirt, stockings, and lace-up high-heeled boots. Bright white circular speed lines and curved wind bands are added around the spinning body to emphasize high-speed movement. The setting is a luxurious and sunlit ballroom with tall arched windows on both sides, walls with gilded details, a soaring ceiling with hanging chandeliers, dust floating in the air, beams of light shining through, and the floor reflecting gleaming marble patterns. Utilizing cinematic lighting, extreme perspective, strong motion blur, sharp focus on the face and supporting hands, delicate fabric folds and lace details, an elegant fantasy anime rendering style, high detail, vertical composition, and dramatic dynamism, it is text-free and watermark-free.

templates.title: Graphical school trip itinerary poster

titleLocalized.zh: 图形化修学旅行日程海报

templates.prompt: Transform the provided reference timetable into a bold and modern graphic travel poster or magazine layout while retaining the overall schedule structure and key itinerary information of the school trip. Replace the original bland document layout with a dynamic diagonal composition and use oversized, calligraphic-style Japanese titles.{argument name="headline text" default="Travel itinerary"} and targeting{argument name="trip duration" default="2 nights, 3 days"} Go to{argument name="destination area" default="Kansai area"} The trip is divided into three large vertical date sections: Day 01 Kyoto, Day 02 Nara/Osaka, and Day 03 Osaka. The dates and main activities from the references are retained, but presented in a clean, poster-style text format with a thin-lined timeline. High-contrast neon-toned decorative graphics, including bright pink, cyan, yellow, blue, green, and purple, are added, incorporating sharp triangles, ink splatter effects, speed lines, halftone textures, arrows, graffiti, and collage-style overlays. Photographic or illustrative travel images not included in the references are added: images of Kyoto's temples and shrines, Nara's deer, Osaka Castle, bustling Osaka street scenes, and Tsutenkaku/Tower images, presented in tilted monochrome or duotone cropped panels. Include short English slogans such as "SCHOOL TRIP 2024," "MOVE. SEE. FEEL. JOURNEY," and "NO PLAN NO LIFE JUST GO," as well as date-themed tags like HISTORY, PAST & PRESENT, and FREEDOM. The background primarily uses a cream-colored paper texture paired with black font, presenting a vibrant, editorial street design style, making the final product look like a sophisticated youth travel guide cover or schedule poster, rather than informal handouts.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考时间表，将其转化为大胆且现代的图形化旅行海报或杂志排版设计，同时保留修学旅行的整体日程结构和关键行程信息。将原本平淡的文档布局替换为动态的对角线构图，使用超大号毛笔书法风格的日语标题 {argument name="headline text" default="旅のしおり"}，以及针对 {argument name="trip duration" default="2泊3日"} 前往 {argument name="destination area" default="関西方面"} 旅行的小标题。将日程精确划分为 3 个大型垂直日期板块：Day 01 京都、Day 02 奈良 / 大阪、Day 03 大阪，保留参考资料中的时间和主要活动，但以简洁的海报文本形式排版，并配以细线条的时间轴。添加高对比度的霓虹色调装饰图形，包括亮粉色、青色、黄色、蓝色、绿色和紫色，并融入尖角三角形、泼墨效果、速度线、半调纹理、箭头、涂鸦以及拼贴风格的覆盖层。添加参考资料中未包含的摄影或插画类旅行图像：京都的寺庙与神社建筑、奈良的鹿、大阪城、繁华的大阪街景以及通天阁/塔楼图像，以倾斜的单色或双色调剪裁面板形式呈现。加入简短的英文标语，如 "SCHOOL TRIP 2024"、"MOVE. SEE. FEEL. JOURNEY."、"NO PLAN NO LIFE JUST GO."，以及如 HISTORY、PAST & PRESENT 和 FREEDOM 等日期主题标签。背景主要采用米白色纸张质感，搭配黑色字体，呈现出充满活力的编辑类街头设计风格，使最终成品看起来像是一份精致的青年旅行手册封面或日程海报，而非正式的讲义。

Add a hardcore manga-style close-up of the main character in the upper right corner's Day 1 area, and convert the schedule into 20 illustrated event panels and 3 date title cards: Day 1 contains 9 event panels, labeled as follows: 06:30 School assembly/departure, 08:00 Shinkansen ride, 10:30 Arrive at Kyoto Station, 11:30 Visit Kiyomizu-dera Temple, 14:30 Visit Kinkaku-ji Temple, 15:45 Visit Fushimi Inari Shrine, 17:15 Hotel pick-up/drop-off, 19:00 Dinner, 20:00 Group meeting; Day 2 contains 6 event panels, labeled as follows: 09:30 Visit Todai-ji Temple, 12:30 Walk in Nara Park, 13:30 Visit Osaka Castle, 15:00 Visit Aquarium, 17:30 Free time/dinner in Dotonbori, 20:00 Return to hotel/shower; Day 3 contains 5 event panels, labeled as follows: 09:30... templates.title: Darwin Tree of Life podcast cover

titleLocalized.zh: Darwin Tree of Life 播客封面

templates.prompt: Create a 16:9 cinematic podcast cover illustration in a dark Renaissance natural history style, blending vintage oil painting with fantastical scientific print textures. On the left, an elderly Victorian naturalist, strikingly resembling Charles Darwin, sits in the shadows, surrounded by leather books, an open sketchbook filled with botanical and animal notes, scattered papers, brass instruments, and dimly lit study walls; his face is obscured by a simple, vertical brown rectangle, creating a smeared effect. The center and right of the image depict a glowing seascape at sunset, with a sailboat perched on a distant cliff, birds circling overhead, and a massive, symbolic tree of life with its trunk winding across the sky. Place 13 clearly visible elements of natural history among the branches: a jaguar or leopard, a monkey, a bear mammal, a perching bird, two birds together, a pangolin, a fox or small canine, a sea turtle, a large tortoise, a fish, a lizard or reptile, a spiral seashell, and a star-shaped plant specimen. The background on the right should transition to a deep cosmic blue night sky, dotted with stars, spiral galaxies, circular scientific charts, fossils, leaves, insects, roots, and marine life, suggesting evolution, biodiversity, and cosmic time. Utilize dramatic contrasts of light and shadow, warm golden highlights, turquoise shadows, fine sculpted details, an oil painting-like texture, and a mysterious academic atmosphere. Place a striking and elegant gold Chinese title at the bottom center of the image.{argument name="headline text" default="Nature has no designer"} Below is a smaller gold subtitle{argument name="subtitle text" default="Darwin and the Tree of Life"} The cover is flanked by delicate decorative dividing lines and small floral embellishments. Maintaining a clear, centered, luxurious, and easy-to-read layout, it exudes the quality of a high-end science history podcast cover. The overall color scheme features vintage amber, deep forest green, dark cyan, black, and luminous gold; high detail, cinematic composition, and no modern elements.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 16:9 的电影感播客封面插图，采用深色文艺复兴自然历史风格，融合复古油画与奇幻科学版画质感。左侧展示一位维多利亚时代的年长博物学家，外貌酷似查尔斯·达尔文，他坐在阴影中，身旁堆放着皮质书籍、一本画满植物与动物笔记的敞开素描本、散乱的纸张、黄铜仪器以及昏暗的书房墙壁；他的脸部被一个朴素的垂直棕色长方形色块遮挡，呈现出被涂抹的效果。画面中央及右侧展现出一片夕阳下的发光海景，远处的悬崖边有一艘帆船，空中飞鸟盘旋，一棵巨大的象征性生命之树枝干蜿蜒，铺满天空。在枝干间放置 13 个清晰可见的自然历史元素：一只美洲豹或豹子、一只猴子、一只熊类哺乳动物、一只栖息的鸟、两只在一起的小鸟、一只穿山甲类动物、一只狐狸或小型犬科动物、一只海龟、一只大型陆龟、一条鱼、一只蜥蜴或爬行动物、一个螺旋贝壳以及一个星状植物标本。右侧背景应过渡到深邃的宇宙蓝夜空，点缀着繁星、螺旋星系、圆形科学图表、化石、叶片、昆虫、根系和海洋生物，暗示进化、生物多样性与宇宙时间。运用戏剧性的明暗对比光影、温暖的金色高光、青绿色阴影、精细的雕刻细节、油画质感以及神秘的学术氛围。在画面下方中央放置醒目优雅的金色中文标题 {argument name="headline text" default="大自然没有设计师"}，下方配以较小的金色副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="达尔文与生命之树"}，两侧辅以纤细的装饰性分割线和小型花饰。保持排版清晰、居中、奢华且易读，呈现出高端科学历史播客封面的质感。整体色调：复古琥珀色、深森林绿、深青色、黑色与发光的金色；高细节，电影感构图，不包含任何现代物品。

templates.title: Dark History Podcast Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑历史播客封面

templates.prompt: Create a 16:9 landscape-oriented, dark cinematic podcast cover with a dramatic Baroque oil painting texture. Use contrasting gold-brown lighting and aged parchment texture to create a historically suspenseful atmosphere. In the right-center foreground, a weary medieval scholar or miller sits at a rough wooden table, his face deliberately obscured by a dark square shadow. One hand rests on his temple, while the other writes on a manuscript with a quill. The table contains five main foreground items: a mysterious notebook filled with diagrams, scattered manuscript paper, a burning candle, a piece of cheese with holes, and scattered larvae; nine clearly visible larvae are precisely included around the cheese and paper. Behind him, a surreal cosmic sky and stars, astrological rings, a cratered moon, golden nebula dust, and blurred mathematical manuscript symbols are integrated, transitioning to a late medieval village in the lower left and a church official or inquisitor in the shadows in the upper right. Add four clearly visible text blocks: a large cream-colored Chinese main title on the left.{argument name="main title" default="The Miller in the Cheese Universe"} Below is a smaller subheading{argument name="subtitle" default=""Cheese and Maggots" and the Intellectual History of Ordinary People"} In the lower left corner is a very small slogan.{argument name="tagline" default="— When an ordinary person begins to explain the universe, power begins to feel uneasy."} On the right is a parchment note.{argument name="document note" default="Interrogation Record\nMenocchio\n1599"} Using an elegant traditional Chinese font, the title is in gray-white ink, and the small slogans are in dark gold. The high contrast but weathered edges and the museum poster-style composition, devoid of modern objects and clean digital gloss, are rich in detail and create a somber yet intellectual atmosphere, making it suitable as a cover for a history and philosophy podcast episode.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 16:9 横向比例的暗黑电影感播客封面，呈现出戏剧性的巴洛克油画质感，运用金棕色明暗对比照明、陈旧羊皮纸纹理，营造出历史悬疑氛围。画面右中前景处，一位疲惫的中世纪学者或磨坊主坐在粗糙的木桌前，面部被一块深色方形阴影刻意遮挡，一只手按在太阳穴上，另一只手正用羽毛笔在手稿上书写。桌上包含 5 个主要前景物品：一本画满图表的神秘笔记、散落的稿纸、一支燃烧的蜡烛、一块带孔的奶酪以及散落的幼虫；在奶酪和纸张周围精确包含 9 只清晰可见的幼虫。在他身后，将超现实的宇宙星空与星辰、占星圆环、布满陨石坑的月球、金色星云尘埃以及模糊的数学手稿符号融为一体，并过渡到左下方的中世纪晚期村庄和右上方的阴影中的教会官员或宗教裁判官。添加 4 个清晰可见的文本块：左侧是一个巨大的奶油色中文主标题 {argument name="main title" default="奶酪宇宙里的磨坊主"}，下方是一个较小的副标题 {argument name="subtitle" default="《奶酪与蛆虫》与普通人的思想史"}，左下角是一行极小的标语 {argument name="tagline" default="— 当一个普通人开始解释宇宙，权力便开始不安。"}，右侧是一张羊皮纸便签 {argument name="document note" default="审讯记录\n梅诺基奥\n1599年"}。使用优雅的繁体中文字体，标题采用灰白色墨迹，小标语采用暗金色，高对比度但边缘呈现风化效果，采用博物馆海报式构图，无现代物品，无干净的数字光泽，细节丰富，氛围阴郁且充满智性，适合作为历史哲学播客的单集封面。

The scene is set in a dimly lit cathedral throne room, featuring black stone arches, two soaring stained-glass windows with pointed spires, intricately carved Gothic architecture, golden highlights under candlelight, and a color scheme of deep black and polished gold. In the foreground, a bust of an aged king is placed, draped in a heavy fur cloak and wearing a magnificent collar, facing forward. Behind his head is an intricate, oversized golden crown, forming a halo-like architectural diagram, but his face is obscured by a simple vertical brown rectangle, thus anonymizing it. Behind him, fine gold line art is incorporated, including the crown, a magnificent cathedral city, royal seals, parchment manuscripts with Latin-like script, and a crowded medieval court. To the left is a tall heraldic banner depicting a crowned lion and the crown symbol, and in the lower left corner are four seated courtiers, their faces obscured by small brown rectangles. Utilizing dramatic contrasts of light and shadow, a smoky texture, the grain of aged parchment, intricate engraving details, and luminous metallic gold lettering. Add three lines of text at the bottom center: Large Main Title{argument name="main title" default="Immortality beneath the crown"} Add a smaller subheading between two thin horizontal dividing lines decorated with arrows.{argument name="subtitle" default="From theological monarchy to the birth of the modern nation"} And a small trumpet with decorative patterns for the author/source information.{argument name="source line" default="Ernst H. Kantorovich, *The King's Two Bodies*"} The layout should be balanced and have a poster-like feel, with the title occupying the bottom third and the crown halo occupying the top center. No modern objects should appear in the image.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 16:9 的电影质感播客封面，采用深色中世纪哥特式皇家风格，类似于 HBO 历史纪录片海报。场景位于阴暗的教堂王座大厅内，配有黑色石拱门、两扇高耸的尖顶彩色玻璃窗、雕刻精美的哥特式建筑、烛光下的金色高光，以及深黑与抛光金色的配色方案。前景中央放置一位年迈国王的半身像，他身披厚重的毛皮斗篷，佩戴华丽的领饰，面朝前方；他的头部后方是一个错综复杂的超大金色王冠，形成类似光环的建筑图解，但用一个简单的垂直棕色矩形遮住面部，使其匿名化。在他身后融合精细的金色线条艺术，包括王冠、宏伟的教堂城市、皇家印章、带有类拉丁文的手稿羊皮纸以及拥挤的中世纪宫廷。左侧包含一面高大的纹章旗帜，上面绘有戴冠狮子纹章和王冠标志，左下角有四名坐着的朝臣，他们的面部被小棕色矩形遮挡。运用戏剧性的明暗对比法、烟雾质感、古旧羊皮纸纹理、精细的雕刻细节以及发光的金属金色字体。在底部居中添加三行文字：大号主标题 {argument name="main title" default="王冠之下的不死之身"}，在两条带有箭头装饰的细水平分割线之间添加较小的副标题 {argument name="subtitle" default="从神学王权到现代国家的诞生"}，以及一行带有装饰性花纹的小号作者/来源信息 {argument name="source line" default="恩斯特·H.坎托洛维奇《国王的两个身体》"}。布局需平衡且具有海报感，标题占据底部三分之一，王冠光环占据上方中心，画面中不得出现任何现代物品。

She had long, dark brown, wavy hair, and her face was deliberately obscured by a soft, rectangular blurring effect; her posture was relaxed, her shoulders against the wall, her hands in the front pockets of loose, high-waisted, wide-leg blue jeans. She was wearing…{argument name="top" default="A plain white short-sleeved T-shirt"} Barefoot, legs slightly crossed. The scene is set as follows:{argument name="location" default="A modern concrete stairwell with dark polished flooring"} The right side features a wide staircase and sharply angled concrete railings, with geometrically shaped window panes near the top. Soft natural light casts long shadows on the floor and walls. The composition uses realistic proportions, natural skin tones, delicate fabric folds, detailed denim textures, shallow depth of field, soft gray-blue tones, a documentary-style editorial approach, and a vertical 4:5 aspect ratio. A semi-transparent white watermark is added to the lower left corner with the text:{argument name="watermark text" default="Alconia"} .

promptLocalized.zh: {"type":"可爱日系吉祥物角色设定集 / 原创角色设计图","style":"柔和水彩与彩色铅笔插画，温暖的奶油色纸张背景，圆润可爱的造型，淡雅的甜瓜绿配色，手绘虚线边框，点缀小爱心、闪光和涂鸦，具有柔和的绘本质感","character":{"name":"{argument name=\"character name\" default=\"もめもめメロン\"}","concept":"来自温柔未来的软糯治愈系布丁状甜瓜，设计初衷是让人揉捏和拥抱","main colors":"{argument name=\"main colors\" default=\"淡甜瓜绿、奶油色、蜂蜜黄、桃粉色\"}","body":"圆滚滚的布丁状甜瓜身体，带有光泽感，顶部有白色哈密瓜网纹，小小的椭圆形脚，圆圆的脸颊状手臂，闭着双眼的睡颜，猫咪般的 w 型嘴，淡淡的粉色腮红","top detail":"头顶有一个短小的绿色 T 字形甜瓜柄","centerpiece":{"position":"左半部分","scale":"非常大的全身吉祥物肖像，安静地坐着","expression":"放松的睡颜微笑","surrounding doodles":"对话气泡写着 もめ〜，桃心，绿色装饰线，闪光，以及一个小甜瓜切片，配文 メロンの香りつき〜"}},"layout":{"title":{"position":"顶部中右侧","text":"{argument name=\"title text\" default=\"もめもめメロン\"}","lettering":"大号圆润的绿色日文艺术字，带白色描边和柔和阴影，装饰有一个小甜瓜图标"},"subtitle":{"position":"标题下方的丝带横幅","text":"揉むと癒やされる、プリン型メロンのゆる未来キャラ。","style":"棕色手写体，位于淡奶油色丝带上，两端为绿色"},"sections":[{"title":"プロフィール","position":"左下","count":1,"content":"ゆるい未来からやってきた、ぷるぷるのメロンプリン。あなたががんばりすぎた時、そっと寄りそってくれるよ。いっしょに、ゆるゆる もめもめしよ〜♪","visuals":"云朵状虚线边框，左侧有小甜瓜图标，右下角有小爱心"},{"title":"いろんな もめもめ♪","position":"中间列","count":3,"labels":["むにっ", "ぷるぷる", "Zzz…"],"items":["顶部小图：人手轻轻按压柔软的甜瓜吉祥物，脸颊向内凹陷，对话气泡 むにっ","中间小图：吉祥物快乐地颤动，带有动态线，对话气泡 ぷるぷる","底部小图：吉祥物躺在薰衣草色垫子的阴影上睡觉，对话气泡 Zzz…"]},{"title":"traits panel","position":"右侧","count":4,"labels":["性格", "特技", "弱点", "口ぐせ"],"items":["爱心图标行：性格：のんびり / やさしい / すぐ寝る","闪光图标行：特技：手のひらの疲れを吸い取る / ぷるぷる振動 / 癒やし","太阳图标行：弱点：暑さ / スプーン / 高級フルーツ売り場","对话气泡图标行：口ぐせ：『もめ〜』"]},{"title":"おすすめの楽しみ方","position":"右下","count":4,"labels":["手のひらにのせて…", "やさしくもみもみ…", "疲れがとけるよ〜", "いっしょにすやすや…ZZZ"],"items":["小吉祥物放在手心里，配有小爱心","双手轻轻揉捏吉祥物脸颊","大爱心图标，表示治愈","吉祥物睡觉，带有蓝色小气泡"]}]},"composition":"16:9 宽幅角色设定集，主吉祥物占据左半部分，信息面板整齐排列在中间和右侧，统一的圆润虚线框，所有文字均为日文手写体，无生硬阴影，留有充足的呼吸空间","mood":"{argument name=\"mood\" default=\"sleepy, comforting, playful, healing\"}","rendering notes":"使吉祥物看起来极其柔软、半透明且像布丁一样，带有细腻的黄绿色渐变、湿润的光泽感、顶部精致的哈密瓜网纹，整体呈现出手工文具的质感"}
