templates.title: Neon Cyber ​​Cute VTuber Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹赛博可爱风 VTuber 肖像

templates.prompt: Create a vibrant, anime-style vertical portrait of a live streamer, with the main character being {argument name="character name" default="Miu"} A cyberpunk-style virtual idol sitting at a live-streaming table in a neon-lit bedroom studio. She has extremely long {argument name="hair color" default="Marshmallow Pink"} She has flowing twin ponytails adorned with oversized black and pink star hair clips and small crystal pendants, topped with a playful tuft of hair. Her face is deliberately obscured by a large, flat, soft pink rectangular mosaic block in the center. She is dressed in an oversized, functional sweatshirt in black, white, bright pink, and cyan, featuring patterns, star patches, zipper details, drawstrings, and glossy trim. The sweatshirt is worn off-the-shoulder over a cropped, tie-front top, paired with a layered belt, a black pleated mini skirt, chain accessories, star pendants, a choker, and a glowing star necklace. The image must include six prominent star accessories: two large star hair clips, a star choker pendant, a glowing brooch pendant, a hanging star chain on the belt, and a star patch on a sleeve. The scene is a cozy neon-lit live streaming room. On the left is a large microphone and pop filter, at the bottom is a bright pink keyboard, and on the right is a mug with Japanese labels. In the background are plush cats in soft colors, and the monitors on the wall are covered with cute chat bubbles, hearts, cat icons, and glowing name logos.{argument name="logo text" default="miu"} Use saturated magenta, purple, cyan, and electric blue tones to emphasize glossy highlights, delicate lines, dramatic rim lighting, soft diffused lighting, blurred neon signs, and a highly detailed modern anime illustration style. The composition should be a three-quarter close-up (chest to thighs), centered on the character, with a slightly blurred background that still clearly conveys the atmosphere of the broadcaster's room. Add visible Japanese-style chat messages to the right-hand monitor, such as {argument name="chat message" default="こんみう〜!!!"} The overall atmosphere, including the pink heart design, remains vibrant, cute, futuristic, and themed around an idol anchor.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张充满活力的动漫风格竖版主播肖像，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="Miu"}，一位坐在霓虹灯卧室工作室直播桌前的赛博可爱风虚拟偶像。她留着极长的 {argument name="hair color" default="棉花糖粉色"} 双马尾，发丝飘逸，两侧带有超大号黑粉色星星发夹，点缀着小型水晶吊坠，头顶有一撮俏皮的呆毛；她的面部被一个位于正中央的大型扁平柔和粉色矩形马赛克块刻意遮挡。为她穿上一件黑、白、亮粉和青色配色的超大号机能风卫衣，上面印有图案、星星贴布、拉链细节、抽绳和光泽饰边，卫衣以露肩方式穿在短款系带上衣外，搭配叠层腰带、黑色百褶短裙、链条配饰、星星吊坠、颈圈和发光的星星项链。画面中需包含 6 个显眼的星星配饰：两个大号星星发夹、一个星星颈圈吊坠、一个发光的胸前项链吊坠、一个悬挂的腰带链条星星，以及一个袖子上的星星贴布。场景为一个温馨的霓虹灯直播间，左侧配有大型麦克风和防喷罩，底部有一个亮粉色键盘，右侧放着一个带有日文标签文字的马克杯，背景中有柔和色调的毛绒猫咪，墙上的显示器上布满了可爱的聊天气泡、爱心、猫咪图标以及发光的名称 Logo {argument name="logo text" default="miu"}。使用饱和的洋红色、紫色、青色和电光蓝色调，强调光泽高光、细腻的线条、戏剧性的轮廓光、柔和的泛光效果、虚化的霓虹灯招牌，以及高细节的现代动漫插画风格。构图应为四分之三近景（胸部至大腿），以角色为中心，背景略微虚化但仍能清晰辨认出主播房间的氛围。在右侧显示器上添加可见的日式聊天信息，例如 {argument name="chat message" default="こんみう〜!!!"} 和粉色爱心反应，整体氛围保持活力、可爱、未来感和偶像主播主题。

templates.prompt: Create a square-framed illustration in the style of anime trading cards, featuring the main character as {argument name="creature name" default="Blue-Eyes White Dragon"} This is a colossal dragon, metallic white and ice blue, pouncing from a deep blue swirling vortex. The dragon possesses a massive, angular head, two eyes gleaming like sapphire, a roaring mouth filled with sharp, triangular teeth, two long, blade-like horns extending upwards and backwards, two additional spikes protruding from its cheeks and jaws, a segmented, serpentine neck, two raised forelimbs with enormous, curved claws, two bent hind legs with claws, and its body and neck covered in multiple layers of armor-like scales. The design emphasizes the glossy chrome alloy and pearlescent surfaces, complemented by bright white highlights, deep cyan shadows, black outlines, and strong specular reflections. The creature should fill almost the entire frame in a dynamic diagonal pose, with its head positioned near the upper left, claws reaching towards the viewer, and its tail and body coiled in the background. The background is an energetic circular portal composed of glowing blue brushstrokes, electric stripes, and radial motion blur, creating a sense of speed and power.{argument name="color palette" default="Ice White, Chrome Silver, Electric Blue, Deep Navy Blue"} Color scheme, high contrast, sharp anime lines, fantasy monster design, ultra-detailed scales and armor plates, glowing highlights, exquisite digital painting, no text, no borders.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张正方形构图的动漫集换式卡牌风格插画，主角为 {argument name="creature name" default="青眼白龙"}，这是一条金属白与冰蓝色的巨龙，正从深蓝色的旋转漩涡中猛扑而出。巨龙拥有 1 个硕大的棱角分明的头部，2 只闪烁着蓝宝石光芒的眼睛，张开的咆哮口中长满锋利的三角形牙齿，2 只向后上方延伸的长刃状犄角，2 根从脸颊和下颚处突出的额外尖刺，1 条分节的蛇形脖颈，2 只抬起的前肢配有巨大的弯曲利爪，2 条弯曲的后腿长有爪子，身体和颈部覆盖着多层盔甲状鳞片。强调光泽感十足的铬合金与珍珠质感表面，配以明亮的白色高光、深青色阴影、黑色墨线勾勒以及强烈的镜面反射。生物应以动态的对角线姿势几乎填满整个画面，头部位于左上方附近，利爪伸向观众，尾部和身体卷曲在背景中。背景是一个由发光的蓝色笔触、电光条纹和径向运动模糊构成的充满能量的圆形传送门，营造出速度感与力量感。使用 {argument name="color palette" default="冰雪白、铬银色、电光蓝、深海军蓝"} 配色，高对比度，锐利的动漫线条，奇幻怪物设计，超精细的鳞片与盔甲板，发光高光，精致的数字绘画，无文字，无边框。

templates.title: Layered Paper Alchemist Doll

titleLocalized.zh: 层叠纸艺炼金术士人偶

templates.prompt: Create a shallow depth-of-field realistic desktop photograph, with the main subject being a handcrafted, layered paper-cut shadow puppet. The character is {argument name="character name" default="A fantasy alchemist girl"} She stands on a green, self-healing cutting mat in a craft studio. The doll is constructed from multiple layers of stacked cardboard, with visible brown cardboard textures along the edges, giving it the effect of a 3D paper model or papercraft prototype test, with a deliberately crafted, imperfect, handmade feel. She wears a light mint green long coat with tiered skirts, brown belts crossed at her chest and waist, brown boots, and gloves. Her belt is adorned with numerous small potion bottles. There are seven visible potion bottles in total: one purple bottle held in her left hand, one small bottle on her left waist pouch, three bottles hanging from her front belt, and two on the right side of her skirt. Her hair color is {argument name="hair color" default="pale ice blue"} Her long, wavy, and fluffy hair is cut into individual stacked layers of paper; her face is deliberately hidden by a centrally centered, pixelated, beige, blurred obscuring block. This gives her a dynamic pose of jumping or floating, with one arm raised holding a bottle, the other outstretched to the side, and one boot raised, fixed to a small, stacked oval display base adorned with miniature papyrus and plants. Five main craft tools are placed around the figure: on the left is a bottle of white squeeze glue with a cute bear label, the label reading…{argument name="glue label text" default="Bearly Art Precision Craft Glue"} On the right is a metal ruler, and in the lower right corner is a silver craft knife. Below that is a green cutting mat with white grid lines. Scattered in the background are several brown cardboard scraps and flat paper pattern parts. The design employs warm natural indoor lighting, a macro lens perspective, realistic paper texture, soft background blur, low-saturation earthy tones, and a highly detailed, realistic handcrafted desktop aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张浅景深写实桌面摄影照片，主体为一个手工制作的层叠剪纸影盒人偶，角色为 {argument name="character name" default="一位奇幻炼金术士少女"}，她站在手工工作室的绿色自愈切割垫上。人偶由多层堆叠的卡纸构成，边缘可见棕色纸板纹理，呈现出 3D 纸模型或纸艺原型测试的效果，具有刻意营造的非完美手工感。她身穿淡薄荷绿长外套，带有层叠裙摆，胸前和腰间交叉着棕色皮带，脚蹬棕色靴子，戴着手套，腰带上挂满了小药水瓶。画面中共有 7 个可见的药水瓶：左手举起 1 个紫色瓶子，左侧腰包上有 1 个小瓶，前腰带上挂着 3 个瓶子，裙子右侧有 2 个瓶子。她的头发颜色为 {argument name="hair color" default="淡冰蓝色"}，长发波浪卷曲且蓬松，被切割成独立的堆叠纸层；她的脸部被一个居中的方形像素化米色模糊遮挡块刻意隐藏。让她呈现出跳跃或漂浮的动态姿势，一只手臂举起拿着瓶子，另一只手向侧面张开，一只靴子抬起，固定在一个带有微型纸草和植物的小型层叠椭圆形展示底座上。人偶周围放置 5 件主要手工工具：左侧有一瓶带有可爱小熊标签的白色挤压式手工胶水，标签文字为 {argument name="glue label text" default="Bearly Art Precision Craft Glue"}，右侧有一把金属尺，右下角有一把银色美工刀，下方是带有白色网格线的绿色切割垫，背景中散落着多个棕色纸板边角料和平面纸样零件。采用温暖的自然室内光，微距镜头视角，真实的纸张纹理，柔和的背景虚化，低饱和度的土色调，以及高细节的写实手工桌面美学。

templates.title: Regional AI company banner ads

titleLocalized.zh: 区域性 AI 企业横幅广告

templates.prompt: Create a 16:9 cinematic corporate banner showcasing a local Japanese company utilizing AI. The image presents a realistic twilight scene of a quiet local industrial town, viewed from a slightly overhead perspective. In the left foreground, a modern three-story office/factory building features warm lighting from its windows, a glass entrance, small landscaping trees, and an illuminated exterior sign displaying the text:{argument name="company sign text" default="〇〇 Industrial Co., Ltd."} The mid-ground and background showcase low-rise residential and industrial buildings, streetlights, scattered car headlights on winding roads, distant town lights, and layered dark mountain shadows and scattered clouds against a deep blue to orange sunset sky. An elegant white Japanese serif font, the main title, is centered and overlaid in the upper half of the image.{argument name="headline text" default="Local businesses, in particular, should embrace AI."} The title area is divided by thin horizontal lines at the top and bottom, with a smaller subtitle centered below.{argument name="subtitle text" default="Start with just one task, at a comfortable pace."} The overall design adopts a calm, trustworthy, and high-end consulting advertising atmosphere, featuring realistic lighting, high dynamic range, clear architectural details, and a soft twilight gradient, while leaving balanced white space for the text. The image contains no people or cluttered elements, presenting a professional Japanese corporate advertising design style.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 16:9 的电影感企业宣传横幅，展示一家采用 AI 的日本地方企业。画面呈现一个安静的当地工业小镇的写实黄昏景象，视角从路边略微俯瞰。左侧前景设有一栋现代化的三层办公/工厂大楼，窗户透出温暖的灯光，配有玻璃入口、小型景观树，以及一个发光的外部招牌，文字显示为 {argument name="company sign text" default="〇〇工业株式会社"}。中景和背景展示低矮的住宅和工业建筑、路灯、弯曲道路上零星的车灯、远处的城镇灯光，以及深蓝色至橙色日落天空下层叠的暗色山影和零散云朵。在画面上半部分居中叠加优雅的白色日文明朝体衬线字体：大标题 {argument name="headline text" default="地方企业にこそ、AIを。"}，标题区域上下方配有纤细的水平分割线，下方居中显示较小的副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="まずは1業務から、無理なく始める"}。整体采用冷静、值得信赖的高端咨询广告氛围，具备写实光影、高动态范围、清晰的建筑细节、柔和的黄昏渐变，并为文字留出平衡的留白空间。画面中不含人物，无杂乱元素，呈现专业的日本企业广告设计风格。

templates.title: Dried sunflower portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 干花向日葵肖像

templates.prompt: Create a vertical full-body portrait, presented as an exquisite dried flower collage: a{argument name="subject" default="young women"} Walking along a narrow path through a dense sunflower field, she is positioned at the center of the image, legs crossed, one hand tucked into the pocket of her worn dark denim shorts. She wears a wide-brimmed woven straw hat, a pale blue floral tank top made of layers of blue hydrangea petals, worn denim shorts, and delicate sandals. Her long, dark brown hair flows to the right as if caressed by a gentle summer breeze, and her face is obscured by a soft, neutral, blurred square, maintaining anonymity. The entire image should appear handcrafted from pressed and dried plant materials: brown straw, brittle petals, seed heads, leaves, stems, and translucent fragments of dried flowers constitute the skin, clothing, hair, and background. Abundant golden sunflowers with large, dark seed centers and dried ochre petals surround the path on both sides; behind her, create a wall composed of layers of blue hydrangea petals and clusters of white dried flowers. Add a stylized dried flower sun in the upper left corner, composed of a circular pressed flower center and radiating straw stems. Using warm, natural sunlight, earthy beige and gold tones contrast with soft hydrangea blues, featuring highly detailed tactile textures, shallow depth of field, delicate botanical reliefs, elegant summer fashion editorial compositions, realistic proportions, and the beauty of hand-pressed floral art.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张垂直全身肖像，呈现为精致的干花拼贴艺术：一位 {argument name="subject" default="年轻女性"} 走在茂密向日葵花田中的狭窄小径上，位于画面中心，双腿交叉，一只手插在磨损的深色牛仔短裤口袋里。她戴着宽檐编织草帽，穿着由层叠蓝色绣球花瓣制成的淡蓝色碎花吊带衫、磨损的牛仔短裤和精致的凉鞋。她深棕色的长发向右飘动，仿佛被柔和的夏日微风吹拂，她的脸部被一个柔和的中性模糊方块遮住，保持身份匿名。整张图像应看起来像是用压制和干燥的植物材料手工制作而成：棕褐色稻草、脆花瓣、种子头、叶子、茎干以及半透明的干花碎片构成了皮肤、衣服、头发和背景。在小径两侧环绕着丰富的金色向日葵，带有巨大的深色种子中心和干燥的赭色花瓣；在她身后，创造一面由层叠蓝色绣球花瓣和成簇白色干花组成的墙。在左上角添加一个风格化的干花太阳，由圆形的压花中心和放射状的稻草茎组成。使用温暖的自然阳光，大地米色和金色调与柔和的绣球花蓝形成对比，具有高度详细的触感纹理、浅景深、精细的植物浮雕、优雅的夏日时尚编辑构图、逼真的比例以及手工压花艺术的美感。

templates.title: Q-version AI engineers under review

titleLocalized.zh: 受审查的 Q 版 AI 工程师

templates.prompt: Create a simple and cute anime-style chibi illustration with a white background, centered on {argument name="character name" default="A young male AI engineer"} Squatting posture, wearing{argument name="jacket color" default="blue suit jacket"} A black shirt, black trousers, and black sneakers; short, tousled black hair; a small black earring; her face completely obscured from forehead to chin by an opaque beige square panel. The pose is relaxed and thoughtful: one hand near the mouth, the other near the knee, the body slightly crouched. Surrounding her are eight adorable AI and tech elements: on the left, a green rounded square panel with a white GPT-style knot logo; below, a light blue rounded square chatbot icon; in the lower left corner, an open laptop with a smiley face on the screen; in the upper left corner, a light blue molecular network diagram; in the upper right corner, a dark, floating analysis dashboard with connecting nodes; in the middle right, a purple rounded square creative palette icon; and in the lower right corner, a miniature white circular robot mascot with glowing blue eyes, near which is a small light blue wireframe cube. Scattered decorative elements include yellow flashes, dynamic blue lines, small soft-toned dots, and tiny circles. Employing a refined digital art style, soft shadows, clean lines, glossy icon highlights, and accents of light blue and lavender, the design features a centered composition, no text, and no watermark, presenting a friendly and modern AI mascot aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张白色背景的简洁可爱风动漫 Q 版插画，中心为 {argument name="character name" default="一名年轻男性 AI 工程师"} 蹲姿形象，身穿 {argument name="jacket color" default="蓝色西装外套"}、黑色衬衫、黑色长裤和黑色运动鞋，留着蓬松的黑色短发，佩戴一枚黑色小耳环，脸部从额头到下巴被一个不透明的米色方形审查块完全遮挡。姿势轻松且若有所思：一只手靠近嘴边，另一只手放在膝盖附近，身体低蹲。周围环绕 8 个可爱的 AI 与科技元素：左侧是一个带有白色 GPT 风格结状徽标的绿色圆角方形图块，下方是一个浅蓝色圆角方形聊天机器人图标，左下角是一台屏幕上带有笑脸的打开的笔记本电脑，左上角是一个淡蓝色分子网络图，右上角是一个带有连接节点的深色悬浮分析仪表盘，中右侧是一个紫色圆角方形创意调色板图标，右下角是一个带有蓝色发光眼睛的微型白色圆形机器人吉祥物，机器人附近还有一个小型淡蓝色线框立方体。添加零星的装饰元素：黄色闪光、蓝色动感线条、小型柔和色调圆点和微小圆圈。采用精致的数字艺术风格，柔和的阴影，清晰的线条，光泽感的图标高光，淡蓝色和薰衣草色的点缀，居中构图，无文字，无水印，呈现友好且现代的 AI 吉祥物美学。

templates.title: Tianyu is forced to perform the dance of the Divine Cave.

titleLocalized.zh: 天宇受卖命神洞之舞

templates.prompt: Create a gorgeous vertical fantasy anime illustration depicting {argument name="goddess name" default="Ame-no-Uzume"} The dance takes place within a sacred cave shrine, presented in a style reminiscent of opulent Japanese mythological tarot cards. At the center of the composition is a female dancer, barefoot on one foot on a circular wooden kagura platform, the other knee raised. One hand is held aloft, grasping a golden bell-adorned staff with red ribbons, while the other extends gracefully outward. She wears a magnificent, layered gown inspired by shrine maidens: flowing white kimono sleeves, a red lining, gold floral embroidery, a lavish black and gold obi (waist ornament), woven knots, tassels, anklets, and jewels; her long black hair dramatically sways around her body beneath a massive floral crown adorned with gold ornaments. Her face is either softened or devoid of facial details. The background is a dazzling, warm gold cave entrance, above which hangs a thick shimenawa (sacred rope) and six hanging paper streamers. Surrounding the stage are six background attendants or deities, three on each side, partially hidden in shadow, their faces blurred or softened, their hands raised or holding musical instruments, as if worshipping and celebrating the dance. Add swirling petals, shimmering starlight, mist, ribbons, and a deep indigo cave filled with magical reflections. Use an exquisitely delicate gold filigree border, with large floral embellishments at the four corners, dangling tassels, bells, and gems, and circular chrysanthemum emblems at the top and bottom centers. The lighting effects are dramatic and divine, featuring strong backlighting, warm gold highlights, cool blue-purple shadows, glossy fabrics, intricate decorative details, dynamism, a high-fantasy style, highly detailed anime-style artwork, and a cinematic vertical poster format, devoid of any readable text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张华丽的竖版奇幻动漫插画，描绘 {argument name="goddess name" default="Ame-no-Uzume"} 在神圣的洞穴神社中起舞，画面呈现如奢华的日本神话塔罗牌风格。构图中心为一名女性舞者，她单脚赤足站在圆形的木制神乐台上，另一膝抬起，一只手高举握着带有红色飘带的金色铃铛神杖，另一只手优雅地向外伸展。她身着灵感源自巫女的华丽分层礼服：飘逸的白色和服袖子、红色内衬、金色花卉刺绣、黑金相间的华丽腰饰、编织绳结、流苏、脚链和珠宝；她长长的黑发在巨大的花卉金饰神冠下围绕身体戏剧性地飘动。她的面部应柔化处理或保持无五官细节。背景是耀眼的暖金色洞口，上方挂着粗壮的注连绳和 6 条垂下的纸垂。舞台周围环绕着 6 名背景侍从或神明，左右各 3 名，半隐于阴影中，面部模糊或柔化，双手举起或持乐器，仿佛在崇拜并庆祝这场舞蹈。添加旋转的花瓣、闪烁的星光、薄雾、丝带以及充满魔法倒影的深靛紫色洞穴。使用极其精致的金色花丝边框，四角饰有大型花卉装饰、悬垂的流苏、铃铛和宝石，顶部和底部中心饰有圆形菊花纹章。光影效果戏剧化且神圣，具有强烈的背光、暖金色高光、冷蓝紫色阴影、光泽面料、复杂的装饰细节、动态感、高奇幻风格、高细节动漫绘画、电影感竖版海报，无任何可读文字。

templates.title: Layered Paper Alchemist Figurine

titleLocalized.zh: 层叠纸艺炼金术士手办

templates.prompt: Create a realistic desktop product photo showcasing a handcrafted layered papercraft shadow box figurine: a dynamic fantasy alchemist girl made from stacked and cut cardboard, standing on a small oval layered cardboard base. The character possesses {argument name="hair color" default="pale ice blue"} Her long, wavy hair is composed of individual layers of curled paper; she wears a mint green long coat with brown faux leather paper straps, belt, buckles, gloves, and brown boots, posing as if she is walking, dancing, or raising a glass. Her face is deliberately blurred with soft, square shapes. She holds aloft a purple potion bottle in her left hand, and her belt precisely carries six small white, blue, and amber-colored potion bottles, each constructed from tiny, layered pieces of paper. The base includes small clumps of papyrus and rocks. The figure is placed on a green self-healing cutting mat with white cut marks, against a warm, shallow-depth crafting background. Three prominent tools or supplies are placed around the figure: on the left is a white glue bottle with a kraft paper label that reads…{argument name="glue label text" default="Beardy Art Premium Craft Glue"} On the right is a silver metal ruler, and in the lower right corner is a silver precision craft knife. Scattered on the mat are scraps of brown kraft paper, with stacked cardboard vaguely visible in the background. Using warm studio lighting and macro photography, the highly detailed paper fibers, clearly visible overlapping edges, soft shadows, realistic handcrafted miniature texture, and the overall effect are captured.{argument name="series title" default="Toxic Party"} An inspiring fantasy art style for collecting.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张逼真的桌面产品照片，展示一个手工层叠纸艺阴影盒手办：一个由堆叠切割卡纸制成的动态奇幻炼金术士女孩，站在一个小巧的椭圆形层叠纸板底座上。该角色拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="淡冰蓝色"} 的长波浪卷发，由独立的卷曲纸层构成；身穿薄荷绿长外套，配有棕褐色仿皮纸质绑带、腰带、搭扣、手套和棕色靴子，姿态处于迈步中，仿佛正在跳舞或举杯。她的面部被刻意用柔和的方形模糊处理。左手高举 1 个紫色药水瓶，腰带上精确携带 6 个白色、蓝色和琥珀色调的小药水瓶，每个瓶子均由微小的层叠纸片拼搭而成。底座包含小纸草丛和岩石。将手办放置在带有白色切割痕迹的绿色自愈切割垫上，背景为温暖的浅景深手工工作区。在手办周围放置 3 个显眼的工具或用品：左侧是一个带有牛皮纸标签的白色胶水瓶，标签上写着 {argument name="glue label text" default="Beardy Art Premium Craft Glue"}，右侧是一把银色金属尺，右下角是一把银色精密美工刀。在垫子上散落棕色牛皮纸边角料，背景中模糊显示着堆叠的纸板。使用温暖的工作室灯光、微距摄影，呈现高度细腻的纸张纤维、清晰可见的层叠边缘、柔和的阴影、逼真的手工微缩质感，以及受 {argument name="series title" default="Toxic Party"} 启发的奇幻收藏艺术风格。

templates.title: Handmade paper alchemist 3D silhouette box

titleLocalized.zh: 手工纸艺炼金术士立体剪影盒

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic desktop product image showcasing a handcrafted, layered papercraft 3D silhouette box within a dark square black frame, with a figure from […]. The image's centerpiece is […].{argument name="series title" default="Toxic Party"} A fantastical alchemist girl stands in an ancient laboratory. The character possesses {argument name="hair color" default="Long, flowing white hair"} Her face is partially blurred or softly obscured. She wears a light green long, slit coat, dark green leggings, and brown leather boots, with a crossed chest strap, a belt pouch, and seven small potion bottles tied to her waist. She is posed in a dynamic pose, one arm raised in a greeting or spell-casting gesture, the other extended to the side. The entire interior is constructed from layered paper cutouts and cardboard, exhibiting a clear sense of stacked depth: arched shelves, Gothic windows, wooden beams, a stone floor, and warm lantern light. The 3D silhouette box contains 24 laboratory instruments and bottles: 7 on the upper left shelf, 6 on the lower left shelf and table, 4 on the middle back shelf, 3 on the right shelf, 2 large bottles on the floor, and 2 attached to foreground furniture. Add 5 main foreground props to the box: an open sketchbook with alchemical diagrams, a low workbench, a small crate, a furnace or brazier with an orange flame, and a large round-bottomed flask. On the right wall, add a parchment sign with the words {argument name="sign text" default="Laboratoire de Saint-Germain Paris, 1768"} Set up a realistic craft workbench around the framed 3D silhouette box: a green cutting mat, scattered tan, brown, sage green, and white paper scraps, a metal ruler, a precision craft knife, tweezers, and a bottle labeled {argument name="glue label" default="CRAFT GLUE"} The set includes craft glue for the labels, a jar containing paintbrushes and pencils, and a cardboard box. Using shallow depth of field, warm studio lighting, realistic paper fiber textures, and subtle shadows between each layer of paper cutting, a comfortable, handcrafted 3D silhouette box aesthetic is created.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张照片级逼真的桌面产品摄影图，展示一个置于深色方形黑框内的手工分层纸艺立体剪影盒，画面中心是一位来自 {argument name="series title" default="Toxic Party"} 的奇幻炼金术士女孩，正站在古老的实验室中。角色拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="长长的飘逸白发"}，面部部分模糊或柔和遮挡，身穿浅绿色长款开叉大衣、深绿色打底裤、棕色皮靴，配有交叉胸带、腰带包，腰间系着 7 个小药水瓶。让她摆出动态姿势，一只手臂抬起做出问候或施法的手势，另一只手臂向侧面伸展。整个内部结构由分层剪纸和硬纸板构建，呈现出明显的堆叠深度：拱形架子、哥特式窗户、木梁、石砖地面和温暖的灯笼光。在立体剪影盒中包含 24 个实验室器皿和瓶子：左侧上层架子 7 个，左侧下层架子及桌上 6 个，后方中间架子 4 个，右侧架子 3 个，地面大瓶 2 个，前景家具上附带 2 个。在盒内添加 5 个主要的前景道具：一本打开的绘有炼金术图表的素描本、一张矮工作台、一个小板条箱、一个带有橙色火焰的熔炉或火盆，以及一个大型圆底烧瓶。在右侧墙壁上，添加一块羊皮纸标志，上面写着 {argument name="sign text" default="Laboratoire de Saint-Germain Paris, 1768"}。在框架式立体剪影盒周围布置一个真实的手工工作台：绿色切割垫、散落的棕褐色、棕色、鼠尾草绿和白色纸屑、一把金属尺、精密美工刀、镊子、一瓶贴有 {argument name="glue label" default="CRAFT GLUE"} 标签的工艺胶水、一个装有画笔和铅笔的罐子以及一个纸板箱。使用浅景深、温暖的摄影棚灯光、逼真的纸张纤维质感、每层剪纸之间微妙的阴影，营造出舒适的手工立体剪影盒美学。

templates.title: Empty aisle of a Japanese pachinko parlor

titleLocalized.zh: 空荡的日本柏青哥店过道

templates.prompt: Create a realistic wide-angle indoor photograph showcasing the dimly lit passageway of a pachinko parlor in Japan during Golden Week. The image must accurately depict {argument name="number of slot machines" default="7"} Pirate-themed pachinko machines are placed side by side against the wall, and in front of them {argument name="number of chairs" default="7"} Empty black vinyl swivel chairs. Each machine features a glossy black casing, an illuminated red LED panel, and an illuminated swivel window with symbols for a bar, cherry, bell, and orange; the lower display screen is printed with {argument name="machine title text" default="King of Carib"} The image features a flamboyant pirate ship design; the top display shows the words "777" and "Big Chance" in red. The scene should create a quiet, slightly mysterious atmosphere, with no one in the frame, filled with deep shadows, accompanied by red and amber casino lights, reflections on polished dark wooden floors, and a faintly visible Japanese warning sign hanging above the machines. A realistic, documentary-style snapshot is used, with a level perspective, high contrast, low-key ambient exposure, clear machine details, a slight perspective stretch in the aisle, and a 16:9 horizontal composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实风格的广角室内摄影作品，展示黄金周期间昏暗的日本柏青哥店过道。画面中需精确呈现 {argument name="number of slot machines" default="7"} 台并排靠墙摆放的海盗主题柏青哥机，以及前方 {argument name="number of chairs" default="7"} 把空置的黑色乙烯基转椅。每台机器均配有亮面黑色外壳、发光的红色 LED 面板，以及带有 BAR、樱桃、铃铛和橘子符号的照明转轮窗口；下部显示屏上印有 {argument name="machine title text" default="King of Carib"} 字样的华丽海盗船图案；顶部显示屏显示红色的“777”及“Big Chance”字样。场景应营造出安静且略带神秘的氛围，画面中无人，充满深邃的阴影，伴有红色和琥珀色的赌场灯光，抛光的深色木地板上映出倒影，机器上方悬挂着隐约可见的日本警示标识。采用写实的纪实快照风格，平视视角，强对比度，低调的氛围曝光，清晰的机器细节，镜头在过道处呈现轻微的透视拉伸，采用 16:9 横向构图。

templates.title: Anime soccer players by the school fountain

titleLocalized.zh: 学校喷泉旁的动漫足球运动员

templates.prompt: Create a movie-quality anime-style illustration depicting a {argument name="subject" default="Exhausted high school soccer player"} The scene depicts a boy drinking water directly from the school's outdoor fountain after training. The shot should accurately show two chrome faucets on a rectangular concrete fountain: the upper faucet, positioned at mouth height, is spraying a stream of clear water into his open mouth; the lower faucet, mounted in front, is dripping water. A dark blue sports water bottle sits on the damp concrete surface to the left. The boy is bent over, his body soaked in sweat and water droplets, his hair disheveled and wet.{argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown"} His hair and cheeks were flushed, and his expression was tired yet refreshed. He wore a black short-sleeved soccer jersey with blue and white side stripes, paired with black shorts, and a white towel with Japanese writing printed on it hung around his neck.{argument name="towel text" default="Aoba High School Soccer Club"} The scene is set next to the school's sports field and club building, and the time is {argument name="time of day" default="Sunset at the Golden Hour"} The scene features warm orange backlighting, long shadows, a ball net and telephone poles in the distance, a small sign that reads "Department" on the wall, water splashes on the concrete, water droplets shimmering, shallow depth of field, detailed hand-drawn anime rendering, realistic faucet construction, dramatic rim lighting, vertical composition, and no other characters in the picture.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅电影级动漫风格插画，描绘一名 {argument name="subject" default="疲惫的高中足球运动员"} 在训练后直接从学校户外喷泉喝水的场景。画面中需精确呈现一个长方形混凝土喷泉上的 2 个铬合金水龙头：上方水龙头位于嘴部高度，正喷出一股清澈的水流进入他张开的嘴里；下方水龙头安装在正面，正滴着水。在左侧潮湿的混凝土台面上放置 1 个深蓝色运动水壶。男孩侧身弯腰，浑身被汗水和水珠浸透，留着凌乱湿润的 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 头发，脸颊泛红，表情疲惫而清爽。他身穿带有蓝白侧条纹的黑色短袖运动足球服，搭配黑色短裤，脖子上挂着一条白色毛巾，上面印有日文 {argument name="towel text" default="青葉高校 サッカー部"}。场景设置在学校运动场和社团大楼旁，时间为 {argument name="time of day" default="黄金时刻的日落"}，带有温暖的橙色背光、长长的阴影、远处的球网和电线杆，墙上挂着写有“部室”的小牌子，混凝土上有水花溅落，水珠闪烁着光芒，浅景深，精细的手绘动漫渲染，写实的水龙头构造，戏剧性的轮廓光，竖构图，画面中无其他人物。

templates.title: Akan Lake Squirrel Guide

titleLocalized.zh: 阿寒湖松鼠导游指南

templates.prompt: Create a delicate anime-style travel illustration, with the background set in {argument name="location" default="Akan Lake, Akan Mashu National Park, Hokkaido"} On a bright and sunny day. The foreground of the scene needs to accurately depict four figures: in the center is a young female tour guide with realistic squirrel ears and flowing hair.{argument name="hair color" default="warm brown"} The guide, with long hair, decorative hair clips, and dangling earrings, wore a glamorous dark blue and beige Ainu-style tour guide uniform, complete with embroidered geometric lace, tassels, a belt cord, and layered cuffs. Three other tourists were listening: a young man in a brown baseball cap on the left, a woman in a beige fisherman's hat sitting in the foreground or lower, and a woman with a ponytail holding a brochure on the right. The guide stood confidently beside the wooden observation deck sign, holding a blue travel brochure titled {argument name="brochure title" default="Lake Akan Guide Map"} He simultaneously extends an arm, pointing towards the lake and mountains, as if introducing the scenery. The image includes a wooden sign with writing in Japanese and English.{argument name="sign text" default="Akan-Mashu National Park / Lake Akan"} The background depicts a deep blue lake, sightseeing boats, verdant forests and mountains, a distant shoreline, railings, and a deep blue sky with wisps of white clouds. Eighteen precise, translucent, iridescent soap bubbles are added: one large, squirrel-tail-shaped bubble curls behind the guide on her right; two large, round bubbles hang high in the sky; five medium-sized bubbles surround her head and upper body; and ten tiny bubbles are scattered around her hair, sleeves, and waist. The design utilizes luminous rainbow reflections from the soap bubbles, clean lines, cinematic composition, delicate fabric details, soft sunlight, a high-resolution anime-realistic style, a cheerful tourist poster atmosphere, and the concept of a fantastical, magical guide.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅精致的动漫风格旅行插画，背景设定在 {argument name="location" default="北海道阿寒摩周国立公园阿寒湖"} 的晴朗明媚之日。画面前景中需精确呈现 4 个人物：中间是一位年轻的女性导游，拥有逼真的松鼠耳朵、一头飘逸的 {argument name="hair color" default="暖棕色"} 长发、装饰性发夹和垂坠耳环，身穿一套华丽的深蓝色配米色阿伊努风格导游制服，带有刺绣几何花边、流苏、腰带绳和层叠袖口；另外 3 名游客正在聆听，包括左侧戴着棕色棒球帽的年轻男子、中心前景处坐着或位置较低的戴米色渔夫帽的女性，以及右侧扎着马尾辫、手持宣传册的女性。导游自信地站在木制观景台标志旁，手中拿着一本蓝色的旅行宣传册，标题为 {argument name="brochure title" default="阿寒湖导游地图"}，同时伸出一只手臂指向湖泊和群山，仿佛正在介绍风景。画面中包含一个木制标志，上面用日文和英文写着 {argument name="sign text" default="阿寒摩周国立公園 / Akan-Mashu National Park / 阿寒湖 / Lake Akan"}。背景描绘了湛蓝的湖泊、观光船、翠绿的森林山脉、远处的湖岸线、护栏以及深蓝色的天空和丝缕白云。添加精确的 18 个半透明虹彩肥皂泡：1 个巨大的松鼠尾巴形状的泡泡在导游右后方卷曲，2 个巨大的圆形泡泡高悬在天空中，5 个中型泡泡环绕在她的头部和上半身周围，10 个微小的泡泡散落在她的头发、袖子和腰部周围。运用肥皂泡上的发光彩虹反射、清晰的线条、电影级的构图、细腻的织物装饰、柔和的阳光、高分辨率的动漫写实风格、欢快的旅游海报氛围以及奇幻魔法导游的概念。

templates.title: Retro Galaxy Train Interior

titleLocalized.zh: 复古银河列车内景

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed, anime-style, cinematic illustration showcasing the interior of a retro-fantasy galactic train carriage. The perspective is from the central aisle, employing perfect single-point perspective, looking towards the rear door. The scene is devoid of passengers, warmly lit by illuminated ceiling and wall lamps, featuring polished lacquered wood floors, a curved wooden ceiling, brass handrails, brass seat frames, and opulent retro accessories. Please use [unclear - possibly referring to a specific type of furniture or decoration].{argument name="seat fabric pattern" default="Dark navy blue fabric, covered with tiny gold stars and nebula spots."} The design transforms the carriage into a celestial observatory. Eight clearly visible high-backed passenger benches are displayed along two rows of aisles, each with gleaming brass armrests and rounded brass trim, and a small wooden table attached to the left front seat. Eight large side windows, four on each side, showcase vivid panoramic views of space, including the bright violet-blue Milky Way, dense stars, and glowing cosmic dust. Two long overhead luggage racks, one on each side, made of brass tubing, hold nine vintage blue, cream, and tan suitcases and trunks. At the far end is a wooden door with a small arched window offering a view of the starry sky, flanked by a round clock and a small framed astronomical chart on each side. An illuminated station sign is added above the rear door, displaying the following text:{argument name="rear station sign text" default="Starry Station"} And add a side plaque on the right wall with the text "{argument name="side line sign text" default="Milky Way Line"} Small English text attached below{argument name="line subtitle" default="MILKY WAY LINE"} The overall atmosphere should be filled with nostalgia, magic, and luxury, like a sleeper train from the steam age traveling through the Milky Way; use warm amber lighting, rich reflections on wood and brass, clear lines, exquisite background details, no people in the picture, no modern technology, use wide-angle composition, and a 16:9 aspect ratio.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张细节高度丰富的动漫风格电影级插图，展现复古奇幻银河列车车厢的内部。视角位于中央过道，采用完美的单点透视，朝向后门望去。场景中没有乘客，由发光的吸顶灯和壁灯提供温暖的照明，地面铺设抛光清漆木地板，配有弧形木质天花板、黄铜扶手、黄铜座椅框架以及华丽的复古配件。座椅和窗帘请使用 {argument name="seat fabric pattern" default="深海军蓝织物，上面布满细小的金色星星和星云斑点"}，使车厢感觉像是一个天体观测台。展示沿过道两排排列的 8 个清晰可见的高背乘客长椅，每个长椅都有光亮的黄铜扶手和圆形的黄铜饰头，并在左前方座椅处附带 1 张小型木桌。展示 8 扇大型侧窗，左右各 4 扇，展现出生动的太空全景，包括明亮的紫蓝色银河、密集的恒星和发光的宇宙尘埃。添加 2 个长长的头顶行李架，两侧各一个，由黄铜管制成，上面放置 9 个蓝色、奶油色和棕褐色的复古手提箱和行李箱。在尽头处放置一扇木门，门上有一个可以看到外面星空的小拱形窗，两侧各挂 1 个圆形挂钟和小型装裱的天文图。在后门上方添加一个发光的车站站牌，文字为 {argument name="rear station sign text" default="星降る駅"}，并在右侧墙壁上添加一个侧面铭牌，文字为 {argument name="side line sign text" default="天の川线"}，下方附带小号英文文本 {argument name="line subtitle" default="MILKY WAY LINE"}。整体氛围应充满怀旧感、魔法感和奢华感，如同蒸汽时代的卧铺列车穿梭于银河之中；使用温暖的琥珀色灯光，木材和黄铜上呈现丰富的反射，线条清晰，背景细节精致，画面中无人，无现代科技，采用广角构图，16:9 纵横比。

templates.title: Superpower Trainer Anime Battle Art

titleLocalized.zh: 超能力训练师动漫对战艺术

templates.prompt: Create a beautifully designed anime-style promotional illustration, set within a Pokémon-themed storyline.{argument name="trainer character" default="An elegant female trainer with superpowers"} She is the core subject. She is a confident young woman with {argument name="hair color" default="Extremely long dark navy black hair"} She has bangs, purplish-pink eyes, and fair skin, with a calm yet slightly aloof expression. She wears a stylish high-necked uniform dress; the upper part is navy blue, paired with a deep burgundy fitted bodice and a long, asymmetrical coat with wide sleeves adorned with small gold buttons, a thin gold horizontal stripe across the chest, and a circular gold belt. She is presented in a dramatic three-quarter profile, slightly tilted upwards, one hand outstretched towards the viewer with fingers appearing shortened by perspective, the other lightly resting near her chin, her hair flowing in the frame as if driven by superpowers. Two Pokémon-style companions are also present: in the upper right corner floats a pale lavender-colored, fox-cat-like psychic creature with large ears, a forked tail, a gem on its forehead, and a serious yet gentle gaze; in the lower left corner stands an elegant green and white humanoid psychic creature with a helmet-like head, pink eyes, a slender body, and red pectoral fins. The scene is set inside a futuristic purple battle arena or city filled with glowing vertical stripes and blurred neon buildings, with a large circular emblem on the left side of the background.{argument name="energy color" default="Glowing purple-pink superpower energy"} Glowing halos, starlight, floating particles, and soft magical light trails surround all characters. The artwork employs dynamic diagonal composition, glossy cel animation rendering, crisp lines, highly detailed hair highlights, vibrant purple lighting effects, and cinematic depth of field, presenting a high-end collectible card illustration quality. The overall atmosphere should be {argument name="mood" default="Mysterious, powerful, elegant and confident"} The image should not contain any visible text or watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张精致的动漫风格宣传插画，场景设定在宝可梦风格的路线中，以 {argument name="trainer character" default="一位优雅的超能力系女性训练师"} 为核心主体。她是一位自信的年轻女性，拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="极长的深海军黑发"}、齐刘海、紫粉色双眸、白皙的皮肤，表情冷静且略显高冷。她身穿一件时髦的高领制服裙，上身呈深海军色，配有深酒红色的修身胸衣和长款不对称外套下摆，袖口宽大，饰有金色小纽扣、细长的金色胸前横条以及圆形的金色腰带装饰。让她以略微仰视的戏剧性四分之三侧面姿势呈现，一只手向观众伸出，手指呈现透视缩短效果，另一只手轻搭在下巴附近，头发如同受到超能力驱动般在画面中飘动。包含两只宝可梦风格的伙伴：右上角漂浮着一只淡薰衣草色的狐猫状超能力生物，拥有大耳朵、分叉尾巴、额头宝石和严肃柔和的目光；左下角站立着一只优雅的绿白相间人形超能力生物，头部呈头盔状，拥有粉色眼睛、纤细的身体和红色的胸鳍。场景设定在充满发光竖条纹、模糊霓虹建筑的未来感紫色对战竞技场或城市内部，背景左侧有一个巨大的圆形徽章。用 {argument name="energy color" default="发光的紫粉色超能力能量"}、发光环、星光、漂浮粒子和柔和的魔法光轨环绕所有角色。采用动态对角线构图、光泽感赛璐珞动漫渲染、清晰的线条、高细节的头发高光、充满活力的紫色光效、电影级景深，并呈现出高级集换式卡牌插画的质感。整体氛围应为 {argument name="mood" default="神秘、强大、优雅且自信"}，画面中不应包含任何可见文字或水印。

templates.title: standalone trees on a chessboard

titleLocalized.zh: 棋盘格上的独立树木

templates.prompt: Generate a photorealistic single mature tree{argument name="tree type" default="Broadleaf deciduous trees"} The cutout image is displayed independently in the center, showcasing the complete tree form from root to crown. The tree has a rough, textured brown trunk, branching upwards into several thick branches. The crown is dense and irregularly shaped, covered with many shades of brown.{argument name="leaf color" default="Bright spring green"} Glossy small leaves, natural shadows within the canopy, and subtle details of the branches visible through the foliage. Evenly lit in a studio setting, with sharp focus and rich detail, this piece features no ground, landscape, people, or text. It is placed within a composition of light gray and white squares.{argument name="background style" default="Preview of checkerboard pattern with transparent background"} The image presents a display effect similar to a transparent PNG image. Composition: A square canvas with trees centered vertically and horizontally, the canopy almost filling the upper width, and the trunk centered in the lower third. The edges of the objects are cleanly cut out, conforming to realistic botanical proportions.

promptLocalized.zh: 生成一张照片级写实的单棵成熟 {argument name="tree type" default="阔叶落叶树"} 抠图素材，居中独立显示，展示从根部到树冠的完整树木形态。树木拥有粗糙且纹理分明的棕色树干，向上分叉出几根粗壮的枝干，树冠茂密且形状不规则，布满许多深浅不一的 {argument name="leaf color" default="明亮的春绿色"} 光泽小叶，树冠内部带有自然阴影，枝叶间隐约可见精细的枝条细节。使用均匀的摄影棚日光照明，对焦清晰，细节丰富，无地面，无景观，无人物，无文字。将其放置在由浅灰色和白色方块组成的 {argument name="background style" default="透明背景预览棋盘格"} 上，呈现出类似 PNG 透明素材的展示效果。构图：方形画布，树木垂直和水平居中，树冠几乎填满上方宽度，树干位于下三分之一处中心，物体边缘抠图干净，符合真实的植物学比例。

templates.title: Haute Couture Leather Fashion Show Models

titleLocalized.zh: 高级定制皮革时装秀模特

templates.prompt: Create a high-fashion show photograph featuring a tall, slender female model with her face blurred and unrecognizable, confidently walking down a gleaming marble runway in the grand hall of a magnificent historical palace. She wears a dramatic haute couture ensemble: a wide-brimmed black hat adorned with a black floral appliqué on one side; a structured metallic jacket {argument name="coat color" default="Slate lime"} A leather trench coat featuring a high stand-up collar, clean-cut padded shoulders, a cinched waist, black textured cuffs and side paneling, and a large black jeweled floral embellishment at the waist. The long coat opens as you walk, revealing a bright {argument name="lining color" default="Ivory satin"} The inner layer consists of fitted, shiny black leather trousers, paired with knee-high black leather boots and black leather gloves. The image captures the moment the coat billows with each step, emphasizing the flowing movement of the fabric, luxurious materials, and sculptural tailoring. The backdrop features gold architectural trim, dark stone walls, and a large abstract stone sculpture. The floor is reflective marble, and the use of shallow depth of field and soft runway lighting creates a realistic fashion magazine photography feel. The full-body frontal composition, with the subject centered, creates an elegant yet dramatic atmosphere with incredibly rich details and textures, all within a 4:5 aspect ratio.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高级时装秀摄影作品，画面中一位身材高挑纤细的女性模特面部柔焦处理、无法辨认，正自信地走在华丽历史宫殿大厅内光洁的大理石T台上。她身着极具戏剧性的高定套装：一顶宽檐黑色礼帽，一侧饰有黑色花卉贴花；一件结构感十足的金属色 {argument name="coat color" default="板岩灰"} 皮革风衣，配有高立领、利落的垫肩剪裁、收腰设计、黑色纹理袖口及侧边拼接，腰间饰有大型黑色珠宝花卉装饰。长款大衣在走动中敞开，露出明亮的 {argument name="lining color" default="象牙白缎面"} 内衬和修身亮面黑色皮裤，搭配及膝黑色皮靴和黑色皮手套。捕捉大衣随步伐向外摆动的瞬间，强调飘逸的织物动感、奢华的材质以及雕塑般的剪裁。背景设有金色建筑饰边、深色石墙、背景中有一座大型抽象石雕，地面为反光大理石，采用浅景深、柔和的秀场灯光，呈现真实的时尚杂志摄影质感，全身正面构图，主体居中，氛围优雅且充满戏剧性，细节纹理极其丰富，4:5 垂直纵横比。

templates.title: Cherry Blossom Champagne Banner

titleLocalized.zh: 樱花香槟横幅

templates.prompt: Create a luxurious and romantic homepage banner for a champagne promotion at a nightlife venue, using an ultrawide 16:9 aspect ratio. The scene is set in a mesmerizing pink cherry blossom grove at golden hour, with a dazzling sun halo at the top center, the ground covered in lush magenta blossoms, dark, curved tree trunks forming natural arches, petals falling, accompanied by shimmering bokeh, spotlights, and a dreamy, glamorous atmosphere. The foreground center precisely displays two bottles of champagne standing side-by-side: the left bottle is a deep ruby ​​red with a gold-leaf neck, a magnificent gold coat of arms label, elegant monograms, and cursive branding text; the right bottle is a pale blush white with delicate floral patterns, a green neck, a magnificent gold coat of arms label, elegant monograms, and cursive branding text. Add striking, glowing Japanese title text at the top center.{argument name="headline text" default="オリジナルシャンパン♡"} Add a second line of smaller text below.{argument name="subheadline text" default="Now on sale"} The text style features soft pink and white neon calligraphy, flanked by decorative swirls, small hearts, and tiny twinkling stars. It employs a style combining high-end commercial photography with fantastical digital art, featuring high contrast, a glossy glass surface, shallow depth of field, vibrant pink and gold tones, cinematic lighting, and a clean, commercial layout that ensures the bottle is perfectly centered with ample white space behind the title.

promptLocalized.zh: 为夜生活场所的香槟促销活动创作一张奢华浪漫的网站首屏横幅，采用超宽 16:9 构图。场景设定在黄金时刻迷人的粉色樱花林中，顶部中心有耀眼的太阳光晕，地面覆盖着茂密的洋红色花朵，深色的弯曲树干形成天然拱门，花瓣飘落，伴有闪烁的焦外成像、光点和梦幻华丽的氛围。前景中心精确展示 2 瓶并排站立的香槟：左侧瓶身为深宝石红色，配有金箔瓶颈、华丽的金色纹章标签、优雅的字母组合及草书品牌文字；右侧瓶身为淡腮红白色，带有精致的花卉图案，配有绿色瓶颈、华丽的金色纹章标签、优雅的字母组合及草书品牌文字。在上方中心添加醒目的发光日文标题文字 {argument name="headline text" default="オリジナルシャンパン♡"}，下方添加第二行较小的文字 {argument name="subheadline text" default="発売中"}；文字风格采用柔和的粉白色霓虹书法，两侧带有装饰性漩涡纹、小爱心和细小的星光闪烁。采用高级商业摄影与奇幻数字艺术相结合的风格，高对比度，玻璃表面有光泽反射，浅景深，充满活力的粉色与金色调色，电影级布光，简洁的商业布局，确保瓶身完美居中，并在标题后方留出足够的留白空间。

promptLocalized.zh: {"type":"四格宣传漫画风格信息图海报","format":"垂直 2x2 网格漫画，带有粗黑边框，高对比度，细腻的半写实动漫插画，温暖的咖喱餐厅氛围与未来感 AI UI 特效相结合","main_character":{"name":"{argument name=\"character name\" default=\"咖喱王子\"}","appearance":"成年餐厅老板/AI 研究员，脸部刻意被方形马赛克遮挡，身穿亮黄色咖喱主题厨师服，戴着与之配套的类似头巾的厨师帽，上面有一个红色的小型日文字符","outfit_color":"{argument name=\"uniform color\" default=\"金黄色\"}","recurring_props":"智能手机、笔记本电脑、咖喱盘、笔记本、咖啡杯、AI 全息影像"},"layout":{"panel_count":4,"grid":"两列两行","panels":[{"number":"1","title":"黄金周的现实","position":"左上","scene":"繁忙的咖喱餐厅挤满了顾客，木质内饰，温暖的吊灯，厨师在前景中用勺子将咖喱酱浇在米饭上，吧台上放着一台锁上的笔记本电脑","visible_text_count":3,"visible_text":["今日订单 48 件!!","忙到电脑都封印了…!","业务繁忙，PC 封印中"],"mood":"混乱但勤奋的黄金周高峰"},{"number":"2","title":"取而代之","position":"右上","scene":"身穿黄色制服的角色在休息时坐在木质吧台前使用智能手机，身后是发光的蓝色浮动屏幕，显示着 AI 生成的奇幻图像和带有播放图标的视频缩略图","visible_text_count":2,"visible_text":["AI","研究是最好的香料"],"mood":"利用业余时间专注进行移动端 AI 研究"},{"number":"3","title":"收获","position":"左下","scene":"充满生成图像缩略图的未来感蓝色分析项目，角色在打开的笔记本和黑色马克杯旁向上指引","thumbnail_groups_count":3,"thumbnail_groups":[{"label":"构图","count":4,"description":"四个风景构图缩略图"},{"label":"表情・情感","count":4,"description":"四个带有马赛克脸部的肖像/表情缩略图"},{"label":"动作・演出","count":3,"description":"三个动作和动态指导缩略图"}],"visible_text_count":6,"visible_text":["一周内约 1000 张。掌握了不少诀窍!","构图","表情・情感","动作・演出","光影运用 / 色调 / 布局 / 故事性","发现!"],"mood":"研究收获、发现、通过大量练习学习"},{"number":"4","title":"宣言","position":"右下","scene":"充满光束的金色戏剧性办公室场景，角色身后有 AI 全息大脑、图表和图像屏幕；他坐在放有带有皇冠标志笔记本电脑的桌前，自信地举起拳头，桌上有姓名牌","visible_text_count":4,"visible_text":["从今天起，AI 业务完全重启!","AI","咖喱王子的 AI 事业部","最强的香料就是行动!"],"mood":"强有力的重启宣言和商业动力"}]},"typography":{"style":"粗体日式漫画标题字，黄色标题标签上的黑色文字，带有红色强调词的白色对话气泡","panel_number_style":"黑色圆角方块内的大号白色数字"},"color_palette":"金黄色厨师服和咖喱色调，深色餐厅棕色，电光青色 AI 屏幕，最后一格充满发光的金色光芒","rendering_instructions":"使其看起来像一张精致的社交媒体漫画海报，线条锐利，电影级灯光，丰富的细节，富有表现力的手部和肢体语言，清晰的日文文本，没有真实名人的肖像，在每一格中都用方形马赛克遮住脸部","custom_message":"{argument name=\"main message\" default=\"咖喱与 AI，都是通过行动认真构建的\"}"}

templates.title: Japanese-style workplace fashion magazine layout

titleLocalized.zh: 日系职场穿搭杂志排版

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as clothing and model reference, this was transformed into a bright, Japanese fashion magazine-style page featuring workplace commuting outfits. The core look of a sheer brown shirt and a white floral jacquard skirt was retained, but the scene was redesigned with a clean, editorial collage style. A beige background was used, accented with soft pale pink, thin rounded borders, handwritten English annotations, shimmering effects, and elegant Japanese typography. Three main images of the same outfit were created: a full-body outdoor commuting photo on the left, showing the wearer carrying a beige handbag and wearing black high heels; a scene of the wearer sitting at a desk using a laptop; and a standing office scene on the right, holding a dark folder. Add article title.{argument name="headline text" default="OL Ms. Feng's highly praised commuting style"} ,subtitle{argument name="subtitle text" default="Achieving both cuteness and formality: a mature and glamorous feminine style."} and the vertical slogans on the side{argument name="vertical catchphrase" default="Created with a sheer shirt, this is an elegant and charming work outfit. ♡"} Add three clothing detail cards to the right, labeled Point 01, Point 02, and Point 03: Point 01 shows a circular close-up of the sheer shirt collar, Point 02 shows a circular close-up of the textured white floral midi skirt, and Point 03 shows circular color blocks in a two-tone brown and off-white palette. Add two small profile/rules sections near the top right corner: one {argument name="character name" default="KAede"} The profile box contains the following content:{argument name="profile detail" default="27-year-old office lady working in Tokyo"} Add a pink circular "My Rules!" sticky note. In the bottom left corner, add a pink circular "Fashion Tips" badge with three items, and at the bottom, add a "Today's Schedule" timeline with four entries: 8:30 AM arrival, 10:00 AM meeting, 1:00 PM lunch, and 6:30 PM departure. Make it look like a beautifully designed Japanese-style web article thumbnail or social media magazine layout, transforming the background, poses, and layout into an informative fashion guide while retaining reference outfits.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 作为服装和模特参考，将其转换为明亮的日系时尚杂志职场通勤穿搭专题页面。保留相同的透视感棕色衬衫和白色花卉提花半身裙作为核心造型，但将场景重构为干净的编辑拼贴风格，背景采用米白色，搭配柔和的淡粉色点缀、细圆角边框、手写风格的英文注释、闪光特效以及优雅的日文排版。创建 3 张同一穿搭的主图：左侧为手提米色手袋、脚踩黑色高跟鞋的全身户外通勤照，中间为坐在办公桌前使用笔记本电脑的场景，右侧为手持深色文件夹的站立办公场景。添加文章标题 {argument name="headline text" default="OL 枫小姐的受好评通勤 Style"}，副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="兼顾可爱感与正式感♡成熟华丽的女性化穿搭"}，以及侧边竖排标语 {argument name="vertical catchphrase" default="用透视感衬衫打造，优雅又迷人的通勤穿搭♡"}。在右侧添加 3 张服装细节卡片，分别标记为 Point 01、Point 02 和 Point 03：Point 01 展示透视感衬衫领口的圆形特写，Point 02 展示白色花卉半身裙质感的圆形特写，Point 03 展示棕色与米白色的双色调色板圆形色块。在右上角附近添加 2 个小型个人资料/规则板块：一个 {argument name="character name" default="KAede"} 的个人资料框，内容为 {argument name="profile detail" default="27 岁・东京都内工作的 OL"}，以及一个粉色圆形“My Rules!”便签。在左下角添加 1 个粉色圆形“Fashion Tips”徽章，包含 3 项清单，并在底部添加 1 条“Today's Schedule”时间轴，包含 4 个条目：8:30 出勤、10:00 会议、13:00 午餐、18:30 下班。使其看起来像精美的日系网页文章缩略图或社交媒体杂志排版，在保留参考穿搭的同时，将背景、姿势和布局转换为信息丰富的时尚指南。

templates.title: Gothic Vampire Sisters

titleLocalized.zh: 哥特吸血鬼姐妹

templates.prompt: Create a detailed, vertical-format anime-style gothic fantasy illustration depicting two young vampire sisters standing face-to-face in a magnificent Victorian mansion at night, laughing happily with their eyes closed and their hands tightly clasped together. The girl on the left has {argument name="left character hair color" default="Lavender Blue"} The girl on the right has a short, wavy bob haircut, wears a pink ruffled maid-style dress with red ribbons, a white nurse's cap with red piping and a huge dark red bow, and small black bat wings on her back. She reveals a mischievous smile with tiny fangs. The girl on the right has {argument name="right character hair color" default="Golden yellow"} She wears a deep crimson dress with white ruffles and a white nurse's cap with a huge crimson bow, her hair styled in a wavy side ponytail. Behind her is a black winged crystal frame, and she reveals a similarly joyful, fanged smile. The image features the two protagonists, posing symmetrically to depict an intimate sisterly moment, their hands clasped in front of their chests. The background is a dimly lit, luxurious vampire living room: heavy burgundy curtains and tall windows reflecting the vast, cloudy night sky.{argument name="moon color" default="Blood red"} A full moon hangs on the left wall, adorned with an antique portrait, lit candles, and a magnificent chandelier featuring numerous warm candlelight glints and hanging prisms. To the right, a vintage clock sits amidst red velvet furniture, dark wood, gold trim, and a rug with vintage patterns. Six striking colored hanging crystal prisms—red, green, purple, light blue, dark blue, and clear blue—are added near the characters on the right. The dramatic interplay of warm candlelight and cool moonlight, the glossy fabric highlights, delicate lace and ruffle details, and the soft anime-style aesthetic create a highly detailed and romantic gothic atmosphere. There is no text, no UI, and no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅细节丰富的竖版动漫哥特奇幻插画，描绘两位年轻的吸血鬼姐妹在夜晚华丽的维多利亚式宅邸中面对面站立，闭着双眼开心地大笑，双手紧紧交握在一起。左侧女孩留着 {argument name="left character hair color" default="薰衣草蓝"} 的短波浪波波头，身穿带有红色丝带的粉色荷叶边女仆风连衣裙，戴着饰有红色滚边和巨大深红色蝴蝶结的白色护士帽，背部有小巧的黑色蝙蝠翅膀，露出带有细小尖牙的调皮微笑。右侧女孩留着 {argument name="right character hair color" default="金黄色"} 的波浪侧马尾，身穿饰有白色褶边的深绯红色连衣裙，戴着配有巨大深红色蝴蝶结的白色护士帽，身后有黑色翼状水晶框架，露出同样欣喜的尖牙微笑。画面包含两位主角，以对称姿势展现亲密的姐妹时刻，双手在胸前交扣。背景为昏暗奢华的吸血鬼客厅：厚重的酒红色窗帘，高大的窗户映照出多云夜空中巨大的 {argument name="moon color" default="血红色"} 满月，左侧墙上挂着古董肖像画，点燃的蜡烛，饰有许多温暖烛光和悬挂棱镜的华丽吊灯，右侧摆放着复古时钟，配有红色天鹅绒家具、深色木材、金色饰边和带有复古花纹的地毯。在右侧角色附近添加六个显眼的彩色悬挂水晶棱镜：红色、绿色、紫色、浅蓝色、深蓝色和透明蓝色。运用戏剧性的温暖烛光与冷色月光交织，呈现光泽感织物高光、精致的蕾丝与褶边细节、柔和的动漫绘画风格，高细节，营造浪漫的哥特氛围，无文字，无 UI，无水印。

templates.prompt: Create a refined, vertical illustration in an anime style, set in a sun-drenched forest cabin garden, using a close-up composition from waist-high. The image should include high-resolution hair details, vivid facial expressions, a soft, painterly texture, dramatic dappled light and shadow, and a lush green background. A wooden cabin and hanging lanterns are faintly visible on the left. The character in the foreground is {argument name="front character name" default="First place: Witch girl"} She wore a huge black witch's hat with an oversized white bow and a ruffled brim. Her long blonde hair was braided into a thick side braid and tied with a small purple bow. She wore a black sleeveless dress over a fluffy white shirt and a white apron with brass buttons. Her cheeks were flushed, and she was blinking teary eyes, her mouth open in an exaggerated, comical crying expression. One of her cheeks was being pulled by the other person's fingers, and her body leaned forward in surprise. The character in the background is {argument name="rear character name" default="A doll-like girl"} The figure stands close behind the girl in front, one arm wrapped around her shoulder. She wears a blue dress with white puff sleeves, white lace trim, a red belt, and a red headband with white lace. She has long blonde hair, sharp blue eyes, slightly flushed cheeks, and a pout. Near her temple is a small red "angry" symbol, and she is pulling the girl's cheek with her index finger. The illustration emphasizes a playful sense of competition, adorable farcical emotions, dewy eyes, delicate skin highlights, exquisite ruffles, rich fabric folds, warm backlighting, and cinematic depth of field, presenting a vibrant, high-resolution anime illustration.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张精致的动漫风格竖版插画，场景设在阳光洒满的森林小屋花园中，采用腰部以上的近景构图。画面需包含高精度的发丝细节、生动的面部表情、柔和的绘画质感、富有戏剧性的斑驳光影，以及郁郁葱葱的绿色背景，左侧隐约可见木屋和悬挂的灯笼。前方角色为 {argument name="front character name" default="一位魔女少女"}，头戴巨大的黑色魔女帽，配有超大白色蝴蝶结和荷叶边帽檐，留着金色长发，编成厚实的侧边麻花辫并系着紫色小蝴蝶结，身穿黑色无袖连衣裙，内搭蓬松的白色衬衫和白色围裙，配有黄铜纽扣。她脸颊泛红，正眨着含泪的眼睛，嘴巴张开做出夸张的搞笑哭泣表情，一侧脸颊被对方的手指拉扯，身体因惊讶而前倾。后方角色为 {argument name="rear character name" default="一位人偶般的少女"}，紧贴在前方少女身后，一只手臂环绕着对方的肩膀，身穿蓝色连衣裙，配有白色泡泡袖、白色蕾丝边、红色腰带以及带有白色蕾丝的红色发带。她留着金色长发，有着锐利的蓝色眼睛，脸颊微红，嘟着嘴，太阳穴附近有一个红色的小“愤怒”符号，正用食指拉扯前方少女的脸颊。强调俏皮的竞争感、可爱的闹剧式情感、水润的眼睛、细腻的皮肤高光、精致的荷叶边、丰富的布料褶皱、温暖的逆光效果、电影级的景深，呈现出一幅色彩鲜艳的高分辨率动漫插画。

templates.prompt: Create a vertical, highly detailed fantasy anime illustration, with the main character being {argument name="character name" default="Rindou"} A radiant young woman dances in a dreamlike night garden filled with glowing blue gentians, glass lanterns, tiny stardust, and floating crystal petals. She possesses {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} Her long hair billowed dramatically in the wind, her posture brimming with energy and ecstasy. One arm stretched out to the audience, the other extended outwards, as if inviting them to dance. Her costume was a magnificent ensemble.{argument name="outfit color palette" default="White, sapphire, and silver"} The dancer's costume features semi-transparent, layered veils, an asymmetrical skirt, a jeweled belt, metal chains, turquoise gems, arm guards, leg straps, and flowing ribbons; the fabric achieves a semi-transparent, light, and wind-blown texture while avoiding excessive exposure. Around her are precisely nine striking hanging or floating decorative lanterns and lotus/gentian flower lanterns: three large blue flower lanterns, three ornate metal-glass chain lanterns, and three smaller, glowing purple flowers, all suspended between shimmering threads. The background should create an atmosphere of a cosmic celebration: a deep indigo starry sky, shimmering dust, blue-violet light spots, prism-like glass fragments, and strong rim lighting. Utilizing dynamic low-angle compositions, cinematic depth of field, diagonal motion, flowing fabric curves, high-contrast moonlight highlights, iridescent reflections, exquisite jewelry details, and vibrant blue-violet tones, the design achieves the quality of a high-end anime/game key visual.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖版、细节极其丰富的奇幻动漫插画，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="Rindou"}，一位光芒四射的年轻女性，正在充满发光蓝色龙胆花、玻璃灯笼、微小星尘和漂浮水晶花瓣的梦幻夜空花园中起舞。她拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色"} 的长发，在风中戏剧性地飘动，姿态充满活力与狂喜，一只手臂伸向观众，另一只手臂向外延展，仿佛在邀请观众共舞。她的服装是一套华丽的 {argument name="outfit color palette" default="白色、蓝宝石色和银色"} 舞者服，配有半透明的层叠面纱、不对称裙摆、珠宝腰带、金属链条、绿松石宝石、护臂、腿带和飘动的丝带；让布料呈现出半透明、轻盈且随风飘动的质感，同时避免画面过于暴露。在她的周围布置恰好 9 个显眼的悬挂或漂浮装饰灯笼及莲花/龙胆花灯：3 盏大型蓝色花朵灯、3 盏华丽的金属玻璃链条灯笼和 3 朵较小的紫色发光花朵，所有装饰都悬挂在闪烁的丝线之间。背景应营造出宇宙庆典的氛围：深靛色的星空、闪烁的尘埃、蓝紫色的光斑、棱镜般的玻璃碎片以及强烈的轮廓光。采用动态的低角度构图、电影级的景深、对角线运动感、流动的布料弧线、高对比度的月光高光、虹彩反射、精致的珠宝细节以及鲜艳的蓝紫色调，呈现出高端动漫游戏主视觉图的质感。

templates.title: Neon anime girl falls into the city sky

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹动漫少女坠入城市天空

templates.prompt: Create a dynamic vertical anime illustration depicting {argument name="character name" default="A blue-eyed female student"} Floating or falling in the surreal, inverted city sky, from an extremely wide-angle perspective, the viewer is positioned below her outstretched hand. She possesses{argument name="hair color" default="Long black hair with electric blue and violet highlights"} Her hair billowed wildly in the wind, her bright blue eyes framed a calm yet slightly melancholic expression. Her nails were painted with a glossy finish, and her hand, through a strong sense of perspective, reached out towards the camera. (The last sentence appears to be a fragment and doesn't translate directly.){argument name="outfit" default="The deep navy blue Japanese school uniform, paired with a blue ribbon, pleated skirt, and black over-the-knee socks, has a sheen that appears wet after rain."} The environment revolves around her distorted, dreamlike city skyline, where skyscrapers, tracks, cables, and reflective glass planes curve in the composition as if gravity has vanished. Using vibrant colors {argument name="color palette" default="Neon cobalt blue, ultraviolet violet, hot pink, cyan, and pink sunset glow"} High-contrast contour lighting, liquid reflections, rainbow-colored prism fragments, paint-like splatter effects, and luminous clouds. Contains exactly 10 visible transparent soap bubbles: a large truncated bubble at the lower left edge, a large bubble at the lower right, a medium bubble near the hair on the left side, a small bubble at the chest, a micro bubble near the outstretched hand, a small bubble above the head, a medium bubble at the upper right corner, a small bubble at the right center, and two micro bubbles scattered high in the air. A bright starburst sun is added near the top center, along with falling pink petals or liquid spots, and crystalline reflective fragments in the foreground. Style: Highly detailed modern anime-style key visual, cinematic composition, hypersaturated colors, glossy digital painting, sharp lines combined with painterly lighting, an emotionally rich and fantastical atmosphere, no text, no borders.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张动态的竖版动漫插画，描绘 {argument name="character name" default="一名蓝眼睛的女学生"} 在超现实的倒置城市天空中漂浮或坠落，采用极广角视角，观众位于她伸出的手下方。她拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="带有电光蓝和紫罗兰色挑染的长黑发"}，发丝随风剧烈向上飘散，明亮的青蓝色双眸，表情平静而略带忧郁，指甲涂抹着亮光，手部在强烈的透视感下向镜头伸出。为她穿上 {argument name="outfit" default="深海军蓝色的日本校服，配有蓝色丝带、百褶裙、黑色过膝袜，材质呈现出雨后湿润的光泽感"}。环境是围绕她扭曲的梦幻城市天际线，摩天大楼、轨道、电缆和反光的玻璃平面在构图中弯曲，仿佛重力已经消失。使用鲜明的 {argument name="color palette" default="霓虹钴蓝、紫外紫、热粉红、青色和粉色夕阳余晖"}，高对比度的轮廓光、液体反射、彩虹色棱镜碎片、油漆般的飞溅效果以及发光的云层。包含恰好 10 个可见的透明肥皂泡：左下边缘有 1 个巨大的截断气泡，右下方有 1 个大气泡，左侧头发附近有 1 个中气泡，胸前有 1 个小气泡，伸出的手附近有 1 个微型气泡，头顶上方有 1 个小气泡，右上角有 1 个中气泡，中右侧有 1 个小气泡，以及散落在高空的 2 个微型气泡。在上方中心附近添加一个明亮的星芒太阳，飘落的粉色花瓣或液体斑点，以及前景中晶莹剔透的反射碎片。风格：高度精细的现代动漫主视觉图，电影感构图，超饱和色彩，光泽感数字绘画，锐利的线条与绘画感光影结合，情感丰富且充满幻想的氛围，无文字，无边框。

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic vertical anime illustration depicting{argument name="character description" default="A mysterious girl with extremely long, flowing black hair and glowing magenta eyes."} She extends a hand towards the viewer from a strong, low-angle perspective, as if trying to draw the viewer into her world. She is dressed in {argument name="outfit" default="A dark gothic school uniform-style dress, featuring a pleated skirt, black thigh-high straps, chain details, long black nails, and a magenta ribbon-like fabric trailing behind."} Background setting is{argument name="setting" default="Rooftop above the future night view city"} Below, railings and distant skyscrapers are visible. Surrounding her are broken black feathers, floating picture frames, luminous liquid droplets and bubble-like hearts, ink splatters, and reflective shards of glass suspended in mid-air. The high-energy composition allows hair, ribbons, feathers, and water droplets to fly diagonally across the image, creating a sense of weightlessness and emotional fluctuation. The color palette should be {argument name="color palette" default="Cobalt blue, deep navy blue, violet, cyan, bright magenta, and black"} Featuring luminous neon outlines, bright reflections, painterly splatter textures, and high contrast between the glowing background and the dark character silhouettes. Rendered in a delicate, modern anime art style, it presents cinematic lighting, sharp and expressive eyes, intricate hair, dynamic perspective with outstretched hands, and a surreal, dreamlike atmosphere. 3:4 aspect ratio, ultra-detailed, vibrant colors, dramatic, immersive, and text-free.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张戏剧性的竖版动漫插图，描绘 {argument name="character description" default="一位留着超长飘逸黑发、拥有发光洋红色双眼的神秘少女"} 以强烈的低角度透视向观众伸出一只手，仿佛要将观众拉入她的世界。她身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="一套深色哥特式校服风格连衣裙，配有百褶裙、黑色大腿绑带、链条细节、黑色长指甲，身后拖着洋红色的丝带状织物"}。背景设定为 {argument name="setting" default="未来夜景城市上方的天台"}，下方可见栏杆和远处的摩天大楼。在她周围环绕着破碎的黑色羽毛、漂浮的相框、光亮的液体滴和气泡状的心形、墨迹飞溅，以及悬浮在空中的反光玻璃碎片。采用高能量构图，让头发、丝带、羽毛和水滴在画面中呈对角线飞舞，营造出失重的动感和情感波动。调色板应为 {argument name="color palette" default="电钴蓝色、深海军蓝、紫罗兰色、青色、亮洋红色和黑色"}，并带有发光的霓虹轮廓光、光亮的反射、绘画般的喷溅纹理，以及发光背景与深色角色剪影之间的高对比度。以细腻的现代动漫艺术风格渲染，呈现电影级灯光、锐利且富有表现力的双眼、复杂的发丝、伸出手的动态透视，以及超现实的梦幻氛围。纵横比 3:4，超细节，色彩鲜艳，戏剧性，沉浸感，无文字。

templates.title: Anime Girl in Neon Rain

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹雨中的动漫少女

templates.prompt: Create a vivid and cinematic anime illustration, with the center of the image being {argument name="character description" default="A beautiful girl with very long, flowing black hair and violet-blue eyes."} She stands in the center of a surreal, rain-soaked cityscape, shot from a high-angle, jarring perspective. She is dressed in {argument name="outfit" default="A navy blue sailor-style school uniform, paired with a cropped top, pleated skirt, loose tie, and silver chain belt."} Her skirt and long hair fluttered in the strong wind. She glanced back at the audience, a hint of melancholy and surprise in her expression, one hand outstretched as if inviting or inviting them into the scene. Ribbons, like glossy black ink, surrounded her, splashing and swirling, mixed with rainbow-colored soap bubbles and prism fragments. The environment was a plaza or street reflected in puddles, with silhouettes of pedestrians and a futuristic city skyline in the distance, all mirrored in the water. Strong, electric color palettes were used, including deep cobalt blue, neon cyan, magenta, violet, and black, complemented by shimmering highlights, dispersive refractions, rain-drenched reflections, and luminous fragments. The background sky created an abstract sense of color and light, reminiscent of an ocean, accompanied by sweeping light and floating water droplets. The composition was dynamic and immersive, with the outstretched hand in the foreground, the character's body gracefully twisting, and the surrounding black forms framing the composition. Style:{argument name="art style" default="High-detail modern anime main visual, glossy digital painting, dramatic lighting and shadows, and hypersaturated colors."} Atmosphere:{argument name="mood" default="Dreamy, sensual, mysterious, vibrant and visually striking"} It uses sharp lines, fine hair details, cinematic depth of field, luminous reflections, and high contrast. The portrait is in vertical proportion, with no text or watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张生动且具有电影感的动漫插画，画面中心为 {argument name="character description" default="一位留着超长飘逸黑发、拥有紫蓝色双眸的美丽少女"}，她站在超现实的雨中城市景观中央，采用极具张力的低角度仰拍视角。她身着 {argument name="outfit" default="深海军蓝水手风校服，搭配短款上衣、百褶裙、宽松领带和银色链条腰带"}，裙摆和长发在强风中飞舞。她回眸望向观众，神情带着一丝惆怅与惊讶，一只手向前伸出，仿佛在探寻或邀请观众进入场景。她的周围环绕着如黑色亮面墨迹般的丝带，溅起阵阵漩涡，并混杂着彩虹色的肥皂泡和棱镜碎片。环境是一个倒映着积水的广场或街道，远处有行人的剪影和未来派城市天际线，全都映射在水洼中。采用强烈的电光色调，包括深钴蓝、霓虹青、洋红、紫罗兰和黑色，辅以闪烁的高光、色散折射、雨水湿润的倒影和发光的碎片。背景天空营造出一种抽象的色彩与光影海洋感，伴随着扫过的流光和漂浮的水滴。构图动态且具沉浸感，伸出的手位于前景，角色身体优雅扭转，周围环绕的黑色形态形成框架。风格：{argument name="art style" default="高细节现代动漫主视觉，光泽感数字绘画，戏剧性光影，超饱和色彩"}。氛围：{argument name="mood" default="梦幻、感性、神秘、充满活力且极具视觉冲击力"}。使用锐利的线条、精细的发丝、电影级景深、发光的倒影和高对比度。竖向肖像比例，无文字，无水印。

templates.prompt: Create a highly dramatic vertical anime illustration, in which {argument name="character description" default="A girl with very long, flowing black hair and violet eyes."} Employing an extremely low, upward-looking perspective, she extends her left hand towards the viewer, her fingers creating an exaggerated sense of perspective in the foreground. Her expression is serene, yearning, and tinged with melancholy, her gaze looking upwards beyond the lens. She is dressed in {argument name="outfit" default="Dark blue Japanese-style school uniform blazer, white shirt, loose tie, and pleated skirt."} In the strong wind, coats, ties, skirts, and strands of hair fluttered outwards like ribbons. The scene is set in {argument name="setting" default="Surreal city streets and waterways at sunset"} In the distance, buildings and telephone poles tilt around the edges of the frame, while the shimmering water below sparkles like a mirror. The air is filled with numerous iridescent, transparent bubbles of varying sizes, including a large cropped bubble in the upper right corner, a large cropped bubble in the lower left corner, and countless tiny floating water droplets around the character. Above her, a large, dark whale silhouette appears to swim in a luminous blue sky, as if underwater, adding a dreamlike sense of scale. A highly saturated color palette is created using electric cobalt blue, cyan, violet, hot pink, and warm peach-orange sunset lighting, combined with high-contrast rim lighting, glossy reflections, prismatic highlights on each bubble, oil painting-like brushstrokes, dynamic diagonal composition, cinematic depth of field, and delicate hair textures, resulting in a highly refined modern anime-style visual. The overall atmosphere should convey…{argument name="mood" default="A beautiful apocalyptic spectacle, a yearning for weightlessness, and the surreal feeling of an underwater sky."} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张极具戏剧性的竖版动漫插画，画面中 {argument name="character description" default="一位留着超长飘逸黑发、拥有紫罗兰色双眸的少女"} 采用极端的低角度仰视视角，向观众伸出左手，手指在前景中呈现出夸张的透视感。她神情宁静、充满渴望，带着一丝忧郁，目光越过镜头向上望去。她身着 {argument name="outfit" default="深蓝色日式校服西装外套、白衬衫、松散的领带和百褶裙"}，在强风的吹拂下，外套、领带、裙摆和发丝如丝带般向外飘动。场景设定在 {argument name="setting" default="日落时分超现实的城市街道水域"}，远处的建筑和电线杆在画面周围倾斜，下方波光粼粼的水面如同镜面般闪烁。空气中充斥着许多大小不一的虹彩透明泡泡，包括右上角一个巨大的被裁切泡泡、左下角一个大型被裁切泡泡，以及角色周围无数细小的漂浮水滴。在她的上方，加入一个巨大的深色鲸鱼剪影，仿佛在发光的蓝色天空中游动，如同置身水下，增添了梦幻般的尺度感。使用电钴蓝、青色、紫罗兰色、热粉色和温暖的桃橙色日落光影，打造高饱和度的色彩调色板，并结合高对比度的轮廓光、光泽反射、每个泡泡上的棱镜高光、油画质感的笔触、动态的对角线构图、电影级的景深、细腻的发丝纹理，呈现出高度精致的现代动漫主视觉品质。整体氛围应传达出 {argument name="mood" default="美丽的末日奇观、失重的渴望以及水下天空的超现实感"}。

templates.title: Background of the approach to Shendaiji Temple

titleLocalized.zh: 深大寺参道背景

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed, animation-style background illustration depicting {argument name="location" default="Shindaiji Temple Approach in Chofu City, Tokyo"} A tranquil approach to a nearby Japanese temple is depicted, set on a clear spring or early summer morning. In the image, a slightly winding stone path extends from the foreground to the temple steps and thatched-roof gatehouse on the left, while traditional wooden shops line the right. The main shop is a soba noodle restaurant, featuring dark wooden beams, a tiled roof, warm paper lanterns, a blue noren (traditional Japanese curtain), a menu, and a clearly visible Japanese sign, including {argument name="shop sign text" default="Soba restaurant"} and{argument name="temple sign text" default="Shindaiji Temple pilgrimage route"} The image should include three prominent vertical signs: a large wooden approach sign on the left foreground, a light blue hanging banner above a shop on the right, and a map/information item on the far right. Add four visible shop lanterns around the restaurant facade. The street is surrounded by lush green trees, shrubs, potted plants, small white flowers, and moss-covered stones, with a clear, shallow pool or stream reflecting the sunlight in the lower right corner. Utilize soft, dappled light filtering through the tree canopy, employing realistic perspective to present richly layered vegetation, detailed tile and wood textures, creating a tranquil and nostalgic atmosphere. The image contains no figures, uses a wide-format cinematic composition, and a 16:9 aspect ratio, presenting a Japanese background art style that combines painterly quality with clarity reminiscent of Studio Ghibli.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高度精细的动画风格背景插画，描绘 {argument name="location" default="东京调布市深大寺参道"} 附近一条宁静的日本寺庙参道，时间设定在晴朗的春季或初夏早晨。画面中，一条微微弯曲的石板路从前景延伸至左侧的寺庙台阶和茅草屋顶门楼，右侧排列着传统的木质店铺。主店是一家荞麦面馆，拥有深色木梁、瓦片屋顶、温暖的纸灯笼、蓝色暖帘、菜单项目，以及清晰可见的日文招牌，包括 {argument name="shop sign text" default="そば処"} 和 {argument name="temple sign text" default="深大寺参道"}。画面中需包含 3 个醒目的垂直招牌：左侧前景处一个大型木质参道指示牌，右侧店铺上一个淡蓝色悬挂横幅，以及最右侧的一个地图/信息项目。在餐厅门面周围添加 4 个可见的店铺灯笼。街道四周环绕着茂密的绿树、灌木、盆栽、小白花、长满青苔的石头，右下角设有一个清澈的浅水池或溪流，倒映着阳光。运用透过树冠洒下的柔和斑驳光影，采用写实的透视效果，呈现层次丰富的植被、精细的瓦片和木纹质感，营造出宁静怀旧的氛围。画面中无人物，采用宽幅电影构图，16:9 比例，呈现出吉卜力工作室风格的绘画感与清晰度兼备的日本背景艺术。

templates.title: The fairy girl leads the goat and the robot

titleLocalized.zh: 精灵女孩牵着山羊与机器人

templates.prompt: exist{argument name="location" default="Chofu City, near Jindaiji Street"} On a quiet residential street in the Japanese suburbs, a cinematic, anime-realistic backdrop was created, set on a bright summer afternoon. A person with {argument name="hair color" default="Light blue bob haircut"} A small, elfin girl with pointed ears and a serene profile walks from right to left in the foreground. She wears a loose-fitting white short-sleeved knee-length dress, paired with white socks and brown lace-up ankle boots. She holds a rope in her hand, the other end of which is tied to a goat walking beside her; the goat has short, curved horns and bushy fur, and follows obediently sideways. Behind the goat follows a compact, dark steampunk robot companion, short and armored, composed of blackened metal plates, exposed gears, pipes, bolts, red-lensed eyes, and horn-like antennas, walking like a loyal mechanical pet. The street slopes gently down into the distance, flanked by concrete block walls, hedges, small two-story houses with tiled roofs, utility poles, overhead wires, curved streetlights, guardrails, drainage grates, and dense trees casting dappled shadows on the asphalt. The background should evoke the feel of a realistic Japanese neighborhood, featuring delicate perspective, distant houses and greenery, blue skies, scattered white clouds, warm sunlight, a soft atmospheric haze, and highly detailed painting rendering. The fantasy characters should be naturally integrated into the realistic urban environment, maintaining consistent lighting and shadows. A 16:9 horizontal composition, a level perspective, and a wide-angle lens should be used. The image should contain no text and should not prominently display any signage.

promptLocalized.zh: 在 {argument name="location" default="调布市，近深大寺通"} 的一条宁静日本郊区住宅街道上，创作一个电影级动漫写实背景，时间设定在明亮的夏日午后。一位留着 {argument name="hair color" default="淡蓝色波波头"}、长着尖耳朵、侧脸神情平静的小精灵女孩从前景右侧向左走去，她身穿宽松的白色短袖及膝连衣裙，搭配白袜和棕色系带短靴。她手中牵着一根绳子，绳子另一端系着一只走在她身旁的山羊；山羊长有短弯角，毛发蓬松，正侧身顺从地跟随。在山羊身后，跟着一个紧凑的深色蒸汽朋克机器人同伴，它矮小且带有装甲，由黑化的金属板、裸露的齿轮、管道、螺栓、红色镜头眼睛和类似小角的天线组成，像忠诚的机械宠物一样行走。街道向远处平缓下坡，两旁是混凝土砌块墙、树篱、带有瓦屋顶的小型两层住宅、电线杆、架空电线、弯曲的路灯、护栏、排水格栅，以及在沥青路面上投下斑驳阴影的茂密树木。背景应呈现出真实的日本社区质感，具备细腻的透视效果、远处的房屋与绿植、蓝天、零星的白云、温暖的阳光、柔和的大气雾感，以及高度精细的绘画渲染。将奇幻角色自然地融入写实的城市环境中，保持光影一致，采用 16:9 横向构图、平视视角、广角镜头，画面中无文字，不突出任何标识。

promptLocalized.zh: {"type":"PC-98 风格复古日本冒险游戏截图","style":"20 世纪 80 年代末至 90 年代初日本视觉小说界面，640x480 分辨率，4:3 画幅，黑色背景搭配有限的荧光绿和淡粉色抖动效果，高对比度 1-bit 和 16 色像素艺术，华丽的哥特式边框，CRT 风格像素纹理","scene":{"setting":"夜晚阴暗的维多利亚哥特风卧室或客厅","background":"对称的房间，高耸的拱窗散发着绿光，厚重的垂帘，两侧的烛台，左侧的古董桌椅，右侧的华丽沙发，雕花家具，花卉和藤蔓装饰，深邃的阴影","palette":"以黑色和酸绿色线条为主，带有少量白色和粉色高光"},"character":{"position":"居中前景半身像，面向观众","description":"中性风动漫兔耳角色，长而直立的兔耳，蓬松的层次感发型，淡薰衣草白发色配青柠绿阴影，身穿黑色哥特萝莉风格衬衫和修身马甲，带有荷叶边、泡泡袖、领口丝带蝴蝶结、绿色宝石胸针，束腰带上有三个小扣，双手置于画面下方","face":"面部中央区域覆盖着方形像素马赛克遮挡块","hair color":"{argument name=\"hair color\" default=\"淡薰衣草白配青柠绿阴影\"}","outfit color":"{argument name=\"outfit color\" default=\"黑色哥特正装\"}"},"layout":{"main image panel":{"position":"左上及中央","description":"包含角色和房间的大型框架插画窗口"},"command menu":{"position":"右侧垂直面板","title":"COMMAND","count":8,"labels":["TALK","LOOK","MOVE","USE","ITEM","LOAD","SAVE","SYSTEM"],"highlight":"TALK 处于选中状态，带有矩形轮廓"},"dialogue box":{"position":"左下角","description":"带有华丽绿色边角的黑色大文本框，右下角有一个绿色小三角形继续标记","text":"{argument name=\"dialogue text\" default=\"はぁ♡ 今日も推しカプが尊い♡\"}"},"logo panel":{"position":"右下角","description":"带有蝙蝠翅膀、玫瑰、漩涡和心形徽章的装饰性标题 Logo","text":"{argument name=\"game title\" default=\"今日のミナレイズ\"}"}},"ornaments":"整个界面周围环绕着细细的荧光绿植物边框，包含玫瑰、藤蔓、卷曲纹饰、蝙蝠以及蕾丝般的边角细节","rendering instructions":"使 UI 氛围极其还原 PC-98 冒险游戏：锐利的低分辨率像素、抖动图案、极简的动画帧构图、日式游戏截图感，无现代渐变，无写实感"}

promptLocalized.zh: {"type":"PC-98 哥特式冒险游戏截图","style":"20 世纪 90 年代末日式视觉小说界面，16 色抖动像素艺术，深蓝与黑色调，华丽的银蓝色哥特边框，高对比度 CRT 显示器质感，复古电脑游戏 UI，阴郁的恐怖浪漫氛围","canvas":"宽屏 4:3 游戏画面构图，1200 x 750 分辨率风格","main_scene":{"position":"左上方大型边框插画","setting":"夜晚昏暗的哥特城堡房间，高大的拱形彩色玻璃窗，厚重的窗帘，石柱，两侧微弱的烛光，深海军蓝阴影","subject":"房间中央的一位神秘哥特萝莉少女，正面半身像，极长的飘逸秀发，蕾丝头饰，荷叶边黑色连衣裙，领口系着丝带蝴蝶结，层叠的袖子和华丽的维多利亚风格细节，面部眼睛和鼻子区域刻意使用柔和的方块模糊/马赛克遮挡","mood":"寂静、诡异、忧郁、私密"},"interface":{"ornamental_frame":"主插画周围的细长矩形边框，带有精致的花卉边角装饰和宝石蓝高光","right_command_panel":{"title":"COMMAND","position":"右侧垂直菜单","count":9,"buttons":["見る","話す","調べる","使う","移動","記録","読込","設定","終了"],"selected_button":"見る","selected_style":"蓝色高亮矩形框配白色像素文字，其他按钮为黑色配灰色边框"},"dialogue_box":{"position":"左下方宽黑色文本窗口","text":"{argument name=\"dialogue text\" default=\"俺は…どこか遠くで、お前を見守っているから\"}","font":"白色日文像素字体，PC-98 风格"},"status_bar":{"position":"最底部条状栏","count":3,"fields":[{"label":"場所:","value":"{argument name=\"location text\" default=\"古城の一室\"}"},{"label":"DATE:","value":"{argument name=\"date\" default=\"99/12/24\"}"},{"label":"TIME:","value":"{argument name=\"time\" default=\"23:48\"}"}]},"logo_area":{"position":"右下方","content":"深色头发哥特少女的小肖像，旁边是华丽的游戏 Logo，文字为 {argument name=\"game title\" default=\"Gothic Syndrome\"}","style":"带有蓝色高光和玫瑰装饰的哥特式装饰字体"}},"text_rendering":"所有 UI 文字应为清晰的像素字体；保留日文标签；使界面具有 20 世纪 90 年代末 PC-98 冒险游戏的真实感","color_palette":"近黑色、午夜蓝、钴蓝色、柔和紫罗兰色、浅灰白色高光","composition_notes":"主插画占据约四分之三的宽度，指令菜单占据右侧栏，对话框横跨左下方，状态栏位于底部，Logo 和角色肖像填充右下方"}

templates.title: Emotional obscuring of street style portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 情绪化遮挡街头风肖像

templates.prompt: Create an emotional, cinematic portrait of the editor, with the protagonist being {argument name="subject" default="A young man with messy, medium-length dark dreadlocks"} He sat languidly in a worn-out, dark-colored armchair, the backdrop a rough, bluish-gray concrete wall. His face was deliberately obscured by a centrally located, dark, blurred square, concealing all facial features. He was wearing {argument name="outerwear" default="A deep red long coat, layered over a mustard yellow hoodie."} He wears loose-fitting plaid cargo pants in red, yellow, and green, light blue thick socks, and red, white, and black high-top basketball shoes. His pose is legs spread wide, elbows resting on his knees, hands hanging naturally in the middle, fingers detailed realistically, shoulders relaxed, and an expression of melancholy. The lighting is dramatically understated from the upper left, creating rich shadows. The ground is an industrial-textured floor with small debris, the background a low-saturation cyan, high contrast, photorealistic detail, a 35mm editorial style, shallow depth of field, centered composition, negative space on the left, and a 1:1 square aspect ratio.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张情绪化的电影级编辑肖像，主角为 {argument name="subject" default="一位留着凌乱中长深色脏辫的年轻人"}，他懒散地坐在破旧的深色扶手椅上，背景是一面粗粝的青灰色混凝土墙。他的面部被一个居中的深色模糊方块刻意遮挡，隐藏了所有面部特征。他身穿 {argument name="outerwear" default="一件深红色长款大衣，内搭芥末黄连帽衫"}，下身穿着红、黄、绿三色调的宽松格纹工装裤，脚蹬浅蓝色厚袜，以及红白黑配色的高帮篮球鞋。姿势设定为双腿大张，手肘撑在膝盖上，双手在中间自然垂下，手指细节真实，双肩放松，神情忧郁。采用来自左上方的戏剧性低调摄影布光，阴影浓郁，地面为带有细小碎屑的工业质感地板，背景为低饱和度的青色，高对比度，照片级细节，35mm 编辑时尚摄影风格，浅景深，居中构图，左侧留有负空间，方形 1:1 比例。

templates.title: Luxury sparkling water canned goods advertisement

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华气泡水罐头广告

templates.prompt: Create a high-end, photorealistic beverage advertisement with a tall, slender aluminum can standing upright in the center of the image.{argument name="product name" default="AURORA"}{argument name="beverage type" default="Sparkling water"} The container sits atop a shallow, reflective surface of water. The body is a matte, warm off-white, covered with fine condensation droplets, and features a delicate gold rim at the top. The minimalist yet luxurious typography showcases the label text: “AURORA,” “SPARKLING WATER,” “PURE • CRISP • REFRESHING,” “PREMIUM,” “500ml,” and a delicate gold mountain line illustration. A serene, neutral spa-inspired backdrop, using beige stone and stucco materials, is used: a large circular stone arch or openwork design on the rear left of the container, reflecting soft ripples on the water's surface; a smooth, oval beige pebble sits on the right; and a delicate, dried plant branch with tiny seeds extends from the upper right corner. A small white [item/piece] is added to the upper right corner.{argument name="brand watermark" default="Pollo.ai"} Logo. The lighting should be warm golden morning light, with soft plant shadows cast on the background wall and the jar, presenting an elegant, high-end product photography effect. Shallow depth of field, natural highlights, tranquil atmosphere, creamy beige monochrome tone, ultra-detailed condensation droplets, realistic reflection effect, square composition, and no people in the picture.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高端照片级真实感的饮料广告，画面中央竖立着一罐细长型铝罐装的 {argument name="product name" default="AURORA"} {argument name="beverage type" default="气泡水"}，置于浅浅的反射水面上。罐身为哑光暖米白色，表面覆盖着细腻的冷凝水珠，顶部带有精致的金色边缘，采用极简主义的奢华排版，可见标签文字：“AURORA”、“SPARKLING WATER”、“PURE • CRISP • REFRESHING”、“PREMIUM”、“500ml”，以及精致的金色山脉线条插画。使用宁静的中性水疗风格背景，采用米色石材和灰泥材质：罐身左后方设有一个大型圆形石拱或镂空设计，水面泛起柔和的涟漪并映出倒影，右侧放置一颗光滑的椭圆形米色鹅卵石，右上角伸入一枝轻盈的干枯植物枝条，带有细小的种子。在右上角添加一个白色的小型 {argument name="brand watermark" default="Pollo.ai"} 标志。光线应为温暖的金色晨光，柔和的植物阴影投射在背景墙和罐身上，呈现优雅的高端产品摄影效果，浅景深，自然高光，氛围宁静，奶油米色单色调，超细节冷凝水珠，逼真的反射效果，方形构图，画面中无人物。

templates.title: Indoor swimming pool swimsuit collage

titleLocalized.zh: 室内泳池泳装拼贴画

templates.prompt: Create a realistic diptych vertical photo collage depicting a plus-size adult woman in an indoor swimming pool. She is wearing a navy blue, high-cut, competition-grade one-piece swimsuit with white piping and printed designs on the side.{argument name="swimsuit logo text" default="Queen Giant"} The collage consists of two panels: the left panel depicts a three-quarter view of the subject standing in profile against a bright blue swimming lane background. She stands barefoot on light-colored poolside tiles, one leg slightly crossed forward. The background shows an arched fiberglass ceiling and the lane lines. The right panel is a close-up portrait from the upper body to the thighs, against a background of a changing room or pool area with a mirror and white curtains, reflecting her back. The main subject remains {argument name="hair color" default="black"} Her hair is tied in a low ponytail, and she possesses a beautifully curvaceous, athletic figure, natural skin texture, and a neutral posture. To maintain anonymity, her face is blurred with flat rectangles in both panels. The collage layout employs a crisp smartphone documentary style, realistic indoor pool lighting, shallow to medium depth of field, precise reflection effects, a wet, glossy swimsuit fabric, soft highlights on her skin, and a minimalist editing style with thin white dividing lines.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一张逼真的双联垂直照片拼贴，展示一名成年大码女性在室内游泳池的场景。她身穿一件海军蓝高开叉竞赛级连体泳衣，带有白色滚边，侧面印有 {argument name="swimsuit logo text" default="Queen Giant"} 字样。拼贴画包含 2 个面板：左侧面板为全身四分之三侧身站姿，背景是明亮的蓝色泳道，赤脚站在浅色池畔瓷砖上，一条腿微微前交叉，背景可见拱形玻璃钢结构天花板和泳道线；右侧面板为从上半身到大腿的近景肖像，背景是更衣室或泳池换衣区，带有镜子和白色窗帘，镜中映出她的背影。主体留有 {argument name="hair color" default="black"} 的头发，扎成低马尾，拥有曲线优美的运动型身材、自然的皮肤纹理和中性的姿态；为了保持匿名，两个面板中她的面部均被平面的矩形模糊处理。采用清晰的智能手机纪实摄影风格、逼真的室内泳池灯光、浅至中等的景深、精准的反射效果、湿润光泽的泳衣面料、皮肤上的柔和高光，以及带有细白边分割线的简洁编辑风格拼贴布局。
