templates.title: Anime girl bursts out of the screen

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫少女破屏而出

templates.prompt: Create a detailed, cinematic anime-style wallpaper featuring a character {argument name="character type" default="Adult silver-haired twin-tailed anime girl"} It bursts forward from a large desktop monitor in the artist's studio, seemingly shattering the screen into many sharp, floating shards of glass. The character has long, light silver hair tied in loose twin ponytails with shiny black ribbon bows; she wears a black lace-trimmed Gothic Lolita-style maid outfit, adorned with a small black bow at the chest; one arm is extended directly towards the viewer through a strong perspective effect, while the other hand rests on the monitor's edge. An opaque screen covers the center of her face.{argument name="face censor color" default="Soft gray-pink"} A square image obscures facial features. The background is a cluttered digital art workspace: behind her is a large monitor emitting an icy blue light; shelves display anime figurines and posters; and the desktop is scattered with pen holders, small bottles, pens, cables, and various desktop tools. Cinematic lighting is used to present a bright blue screen glow, shimmering reflections on transparent glass shards, a shallow depth-of-field effect, motion blur on nearby fragments and outstretched hands, exquisitely detailed hair strands, a strong sheen in the fabric, and a realistic studio setting with a dynamic sense of perspective. The composition is 16:9, and the resolution is 1152×768. The overall atmosphere is surreal, vibrant, and immersive, as if an anime character is escaping from the digital screen into the real world.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张细节丰富、具有电影感的动漫风格壁纸，画面中一位 {argument name="character type" default="成年银发双马尾动漫少女"} 正从艺术家工作室的一台大型桌面显示器中向前冲出，仿佛将屏幕撞碎，化作许多锋利的悬浮玻璃碎片。该角色留着长长的浅银色头发，扎成蓬松的双马尾，系着亮面黑色丝带蝴蝶结；身穿黑色蕾丝边哥特洛丽塔风格女仆装，胸前饰有小黑蝴蝶结；一只手臂通过强烈的透视效果直接伸向观众，另一只手撑在显示器边框上。在面部中心位置覆盖一个不透明的 {argument name="face censor color" default="柔和灰粉色"} 正方形，遮住五官。背景是一个凌乱的数字艺术工作空间：她身后是一台发出冰蓝色光芒的大显示器，架子上摆放着动漫手办和海报，桌面上散落着笔筒、小瓶子、钢笔、线缆和各种桌面工具。采用电影级灯光，呈现明亮的屏幕蓝光、透明玻璃碎片上的闪烁反射、浅景深效果，近处的碎片和伸出的手带有动态模糊，发丝细节极致细腻，布料光泽感强，工作室陈设真实，透视感动态十足，构图为 16:9 桌面壁纸，分辨率为 1152×768。整体氛围：超现实、充满活力、沉浸感强，仿佛动漫角色正从数字屏幕中逃离到现实世界。

templates.title: Wukong Calligraphy Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 悟空书法海报

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic, vertical, retro-style poster of Chinese mythology. The background is made of beige, aged Xuan paper with visible fibers, cracks, scratches, and an aged printing texture. The main subject is two large black Chinese calligraphy characters, the content of which is {argument name="main calligraphy text" default="Wukong"} The calligraphy employs bold, heavy brushstrokes, almost filling the entire background edge. At the bottom center, a tiny figure of the hero Sun Wukong is placed, walking from left to right along a rough, red, horizontal cliff or platform; he wears dark, ornate armor, adorned with tattered, flowing red ribbons and a gold headband, holding a downward-sloping gold staff. Behind the calligraphy on the right, a worn, circular gold ink ring, like a faded seal or halo, partially overlaps the white space of the text. A limited color scheme of matte black, parchment beige, blood red, and dark gold emphasizes high contrast, rough screen-printed edges, ink smudges, stains, and a cinematic martial arts atmosphere. The figure appears extremely small compared to the grand calligraphy, highlighting the scale and legendary quality. There are no modern objects, no borders, and a centrally positioned, poster-style layout.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张极具戏剧性的竖版复古中国神话海报，背景为带有明显纤维、裂纹、划痕和做旧印刷质感的米色陈年宣纸。构图主体为两个巨大的黑色中式书法大字，内容为 {argument name="main calligraphy text" default="悟空"}，采用粗犷厚重的笔触，几乎填满整个背景边缘。在画面下方中央位置放置一个渺小的英雄孙悟空战士形象，他正从左向右走在粗糙的红色横向悬崖或平台上；他身穿深色华丽盔甲，配有破旧飘逸的红色绸带和金色头箍，手中横持一根向下倾斜的金色长棍。在书法右侧后方，添加一个磨损的圆形金色墨迹环图案，如同褪色的印章或光环，部分重叠在文字的留白处。采用哑光黑、羊皮纸米色、血红色和暗金色的有限配色方案，强调高对比度、粗糙的丝网印刷边缘、墨迹晕染、污渍斑点以及电影般的武侠气场。人物与宏大的书法字相比显得极其渺小，以突显规模感与传奇色彩。无现代物体，无边框，海报风格居中布局。

templates.title: Palace Museum font poster

titleLocalized.zh: 故宫字体海报

templates.prompt: Create a minimalist, cinematic-style Chinese font poster with a warm, worn-out beige paper background and a large, deep vermilion Chinese title in the center.{argument name="headline text" default="Forbidden City"} These two enormous characters should dominate the image like a magnificent palace, their strokes resembling the red walls of the Forbidden City. Add traditional golden glazed tile roofs and ornate eaves to the top edges of the characters, incorporating small, decorative roof ornaments. The characters stand at the far end of a vast, open stone courtyard, with light-colored marble railings and symmetrical terraces at the base. A small, solitary figure in a dark coat is placed in the center of the foreground to emphasize the sense of proportion. The composition employs a low-angle, frontal, symmetrical approach, with a beige sky above creating ample negative space. It utilizes soft, historical tones, delicate film grain, worn paper textures, a slight weathering effect on the red paint, and an elegant poster design aesthetic inspired by Chinese cultural heritage and the Forbidden City. No additional text, logos, or borders are needed.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张极简主义电影质感的中国字体海报，背景为陈旧的暖米色纸张，画面中心为巨大的深朱红色中文标题文字 {argument name="headline text" default="故宫"}。这两个巨大的字符应像宏伟的宫殿建筑一样占据画面主体，其笔画呈现为红色的故宫宫墙。在字符顶端边缘添加传统的金黄色琉璃瓦屋顶和华丽的檐角，并包含小巧的装饰性屋脊兽。字符矗立在广阔空旷的石质庭院远端，底部配有浅色大理石栏杆和对称的露台。在画面正前方的中心位置，放置一个身穿深色外套的微小孤独身影，以突显比例感。采用低视角、正面、对称的构图，上方米色天空留出大量负空间，运用柔和的历史色调、细腻的胶片颗粒感、磨损的纸张纹理、红色漆面的轻微风化效果，以及受中国文化遗产和故宫启发的优雅海报设计美学。无需额外文字、Logo 或边框。

QUESTION EVERYTHING."} Occupying a third of the poster is a huge, jagged orange brush-text title.{argument name="movie title" default="PARALLEL PROTOCOL"} The title, enclosed in a small, centered box, reads "A FILM BY N.MART." The poster features four futuristic agents standing side-by-side, dramatically low-angled lighting: on the left is a long-haired, dark-armored soldier in a glossy black tactical uniform with weapon slings; in the center left is a female leader, wearing a black fitted blazer over a black miniskirt, complete with lace stockings, garter stockings, gloves, and a braided updo, exuding confidence and leadership; in the center right is a figure in a flowing white deep-sea pressure suit with blue wave patterns, complete with black breathing apparatus and cyborg gear; and on the right is a female agent in black armor, featuring orange glowing weapon details and heavy tactical cables. The characters' faces are rendered with a cinematic quality and are clearly visible, with ambient contour lighting in shades of burnt orange and cool blue. Add two film review citations: "A VISUALLY STUNNING RIDE." on the left, credited to "— FILM PULSE"; and "BOLD. STYLISH. UNFORGETTABLE." on the right, credited to "— INDIE WIRE". Add vertical studio text "N. MART STUDIOS" and the year "2025" along the left edge. Place the actors' names in four small orange capital letters below the characters' feet: "ELIOT VALE", "MILES KORBEN", "JULIAN HART", and "LEO DRAKE". At the bottom center, in a large brown release date {argument name="release date" default="06.27.2025"} The top section adds "IN THEATERS," followed by "EXPERIENCE IT IN IMAX AND REALD 3D," with "IMAX" emphasized in orange. Finally, a small credits section, a "N.MART STUDIOS" logo box in the lower left corner, a PG-13 rating box in the lower right corner, and a small barcode bar in the center of the bottom are added. Overall atmosphere: a stylish 1980s fictional future movie poster, a deep-sea paranoia, a cyberpunk spy style, a blend of high-end illustration and realism, high contrast, delicate fabric textures, dramatic shadows, and an aged print feel.

templates.title: Rugged Urban Restroom Fashion Portraits

titleLocalized.zh: 粗粝都市洗手间时尚人像

templates.prompt: A highly detailed, cinematic photograph, with the subject being{argument name="subject" default="A young woman with long, wavy, fiery red hair, fair skin, and light freckles."} Standing{argument name="setting" default="Inside an uncleaned, dilapidated public restroom, the walls were covered with peeling light green tiles and colorful graffiti and stickers."} She was wearing{argument name="outfit" default="A fitted white shimmering strapless mini dress"} She held a lipstick tube in her right hand, applying a vibrant red lipstick, while her left hand rested lightly on the edge of the sink. Her head was slightly turned to one side, her gaze confident. Environmental details included a broken mirror reflecting her image, litter and papers scattered on the floor and countertops, graffiti reading "Keor" somewhere, a fluorescent light tube on the ceiling emitting dramatic pink and warm tones, damaged walls, and an overall rough urban atmosphere with extremely high detail, realistic texture, and emotionally charged cinematic composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张高度细节的电影感摄影照片，主体为 {argument name="subject" default="一位留着波浪长发、火红色头发、皮肤白皙且带有淡淡雀斑的年轻美女"}，正站在 {argument name="setting" default="一个未经清理、破败不堪的公共洗手间内，墙面是剥落的浅绿色瓷砖，布满了色彩斑斓的涂鸦和贴纸"}。她穿着 {argument name="outfit" default="一件修身的白色闪亮抹胸迷你裙"}，右手拿着口红管正在涂抹鲜艳的红色口红，左手轻搭在洗手池边缘。她的头微微转向一侧，眼神自信。环境细节包括带有倒影的破碎镜子、地面和台面上散落的垃圾与纸张、某处写着“Keor”的涂鸦、天花板上一根发出戏剧性粉色和暖色调灯光的荧光灯管、受损的墙壁，以及整体呈现出一种粗粝的都市氛围，具有极高的细节、真实的质感和情绪化的电影构图。

templates.title: Luxury magazine cover transformation

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华杂志封面变身

templates.prompt: Transform your subjects into high-end magazine cover portraits while preserving 100% of their facial identity, structure, skin tone, proportions, and all unique facial features. Do not alter the eyes, nose, mouth, jawline, or face shape. Maintain realistic skin texture, pores, and natural imperfections. Stylize the images to resemble a luxury international magazine cover shoot, employing cinematic studio lighting, high-fashion composition, and a minimalist editorial aesthetic. Subjects should appear confident and elegant, achieving a professional photographic effect, dressed in fashionable modern attire that aligns with sophisticated luxury aesthetics. Use soft, directional lighting to create subtle shadows and depth, resulting in an effect similar to {argument name="magazine" default="Vogue, GQ, Forbes, or Harper's Bazaar"} The cover boasts a sophisticated studio-quality feel. The background should be simple and elegant, with subtle textures or gradients that complement the clothing's color scheme and overall atmosphere. Incorporate authentic magazine cover elements: realistic masthead typography, elegant headlines and feature text, issue number, barcodes, and minute editorial details, all neatly laid out and professionally spaced. Maintain all typography subtle and realistic, seamlessly integrating it into the composition. Depth of field should keep the subject in sharp focus while creating a sophisticated cinematic atmosphere. Ultra-detailed, photorealistic, editorial photography, luxurious magazine aesthetics, highly refined, cinematic, 8K resolution.

promptLocalized.zh: 将拍摄对象转化为高端杂志封面肖像，同时 100% 保留其面部身份、面部结构、肤色、比例以及所有独特的面部特征。不得改变眼睛、鼻子、嘴巴、下颌线或脸型。保持真实的皮肤纹理、毛孔和自然的瑕疵。将图像风格化为奢华国际杂志的封面拍摄效果，采用电影级摄影棚灯光、高级时尚摄影构图以及极简的编辑美学。拍摄对象应看起来自信、优雅，并呈现出专业摄影的效果，穿着与精致奢华美学相符的时尚现代服装。使用柔和的定向光，营造出细微的阴影和深度，打造出类似于 {argument name="magazine" default="Vogue、GQ、Forbes 或 Harper’s Bazaar"} 封面的精致摄影棚质感。背景应简洁、优雅，并带有轻微的纹理或渐变效果，与服装的色调和整体氛围相匹配。添加真实的杂志封面元素：逼真的刊头排版、优雅的标题和专题文字、期号、条形码以及细小的编辑细节，布局整洁且间距专业。保持所有排版微妙且真实，自然地融入构图之中。景深应使拍摄对象保持清晰对焦，同时营造出高级的电影氛围。超细节、照片级真实感、编辑摄影、奢华杂志美学、高度精致、电影感、8K 画质。

templates.title: Dark fantasy storyboard infographic

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑奇幻故事板信息图

templates.prompt: Create a widescreen, cinematic 9-grid storyboard infographic showcasing a dark fantasy transformation sequence. Style: Hyper-realistic photography, cinematic concept art, film production storyboard aesthetics, ultra-fine textures, realistic lighting, cinematic pre-production quality. Layout: A clean 3x3 grid with even frame spacing; each panel is clearly numbered and features a prominent film title and brief production notes. Color Palette: A striking contrast between cool cyan moonlight and warm orange lava glow, volumetric fog, realistic shadows, and a cinematic atmosphere. Aspect Ratio: Ultra-wide storyboard pages, professional Hollywood pre-production design. Panel 1 — “Frozen Ruins” A wide-angle aerial view showcasing a destroyed frozen ruin at night. Broken ice, floating mist, ancient broken pillars covered in frost and snow, and snowflakes drifting across the ruins. A weary, dark-haired woman is faintly visible on the ice. Panel Highlights: • Wide-angle aerial view • Blue moonlight reflection • Thick ambient fog • Ancient frozen ruins Panel 2 — “The Fallen Woman” Mid-range view, showing an exhausted woman lying on cracked ice. Torn dark gray clothing, pale skin, trembling fingers, and visible white breath in the cold air. Emotions: Pain, despair, exhaustion. Highlights: • Character introduction • Torn dark clothing • Detailed ice texture • Emotional vulnerability Panel 3 — “Awakening of Pain” Close-up shot, showing her struggling to get up. Frost covers her skin, black hair falls across her face, and her eyes are filled with fear. Tiny orange glowing cracks begin to appear beneath her skin. Highlights: • Emotional close-up shot • Lava glow beneath the skin • Fear and despair • Cinematic push-in shot Panel 4 — “Lava Veins” Extreme close-up shot, showing glowing lava-like cracks spreading across her arms and neck. Her skin is illuminated by internal lava orange energy. The ice beneath her begins to crack violently. Key Points: • Transformation Begins • Orange Lava Veins • Cracked Ice Surface • High-Detail Skin Deformation Panel 5 — “Skeletal Reconstruction” Dynamic side-view shot showing the unnatural curvature of the spine and elongated fingers. The bones beneath the skin are clearly visible, presenting a realistic and terrifying physical deformation. Mist and snowflakes swirl violently. Key Points: • Spinal Deformation • Radical Form Transformation • Dynamic Camera Angle • Violent Environmental Reactions Panel 6 — “Flesh and Fur” Mid-Transformation Sequence. Parts of the human body dissolve into black fur and leopard anatomy. Limbs are smoothly reconstructed. Embers erupt into the cold air. Key Points: • Flesh Reconstruction • Fur Generation Effects • Embers and Fragments • Seamless Deformation Visual Effects Panel 7 — “Beast Appears” Panoramic view, a giant black panther stands on broken ice. Its entire body is covered in glowing lava cracks, orange fiery eyes, and steam rising from its fur. Dramatic moonlight silhouette. Key Features: • Full Creature Display • Lava Crack Patterns • Cinematic Silhouettes • Dark Fantasy Realism Panel 8 — “Angry Roar” Intense action close-up, the black panther roars directly at the camera. Motion blur, shaky handheld camera, flying debris, glowing embers, ultra-detailed fur simulation. Key Features: • Aggressive Roar Shot • Shaky Handheld Camera • Flying Debris Particles • High-Intensity Action Scene Panel 9 — “Storm Transition” Final Cinematic Frame. The roaring black panther abruptly turns its head to look at the sky, where dark storm clouds begin to form. Blue lightning is faintly visible in the distance. Dramatic ending composition. Key Points: • Storm cloud formation • Transition shot setup • Blue lightning atmosphere • Cinematic ending frame Overall design requirements: • Professional film storyboard infographic • Clean 3x3 grid composition • Eye-catching numbered panels • Large film title • Minimalist modern typography • Consistent visual continuity between frames • Hyperrealistic dark fantasy style • Realistic photographic textures • Volumetric light and fog • Warm orange contrasting with cool cyan cinematic color tones • Production-quality concept art • 8K ultra-high-definition detail • Smooth visual narrative pacing • Looks like a Hollywood film preview project

templates.prompt: Create an 8K high-resolution portrait poster, using the following style.{argument name="editorial style" default="Urban fashion editorial style collage"} This design blends contemporary street fashion aesthetics with high-end magazine editorial design. The overall composition should be bold, stylish, modern, and visually layered, incorporating elements of luxury fashion editorials, urban culture, and experimental art collage. It should integrate dynamic poster decorations and decorative elements that strongly embody the aesthetics of "urban fashion editorial collage," such as torn paper textures, layered magazine clippings, abstract geometric embellishments, expressive brushstrokes, typographic fragments, street-style graphic overlays, halftone textures, washi tape effects, paint splatter, handwritten graffiti, and fashionable editorial layouts. Each decorative element should appear deliberate, stylish, and visually balanced, rather than excessively piled up. Humans looking at torn paper and graffiti textures surprisingly perceive "yes, this is luxury," and the effect is remarkably good. The subject's pose must not resemble the reference photograph. Please create a completely different body posture and facial expression, making it more natural, expressive, and emotionally vibrant. Avoid stiff, awkward, flat, or overly symmetrical poses. The subject should radiate {argument name="model type" default="International fashion models"} Confident elegance, fluid body language, subtle movements, and a cinematic editorial approach. Expressions should be captivating, natural, stylish, and modern, as if captured on the set of a high-end street fashion magazine shoot, rather than a static studio portrait. Add subtle movement through poses, clothing dynamics, hand placement, shooting angles, or gaze direction to give the composition more life and tension. Clothing must be {argument name="clothing style" default="Modern casual fashion"} Showcase a chic and trendy urban aesthetic. Avoid monotonous clothing designs, colors, or materials. Combine stylish layering, modern cuts, unique textures, fashionable accessories, and diverse color schemes that complement the poster composition. Clothing should embody sophistication, youthfulness, and avant-garde style, drawing inspiration from global streetwear and luxury casual editorial looks. Naturally blend different fabrics, patterns, and hues to create visual richness without appearing cluttered or overly exaggerated. Use dramatic editorial lighting with strong contrast and depth to enhance the fashion atmosphere. The background should seamlessly integrate with collage elements, creating an immersive poster composition full of urban vitality and modern fashion. Maintain a clean balance between subject visibility and decorative complexity, ensuring the poster retains a high-end feel and professional art direction. The final product should be a sophisticated international fashion advertising poster with a strong urban editorial style, ultra-fine textures, sharp focus, cinematic color grading, and a high degree of refinement.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张 8K 高分辨率人像海报，风格采用 {argument name="editorial style" default="都市时尚编辑风拼贴"}，融合当代街头时尚美学与高级杂志编辑设计。整体构图应大胆、时髦、现代且具有视觉层次感，结合奢侈时尚大片、都市文化及艺术拼贴实验等元素。融入强力体现“都市时尚编辑风拼贴”美学的动态海报装饰与装饰元素，例如撕纸质感、分层杂志剪贴、抽象几何点缀、表现力十足的笔触、排版碎片、街头风格图形叠加、半色调纹理、胶带效果、油漆飞溅、手写涂鸦以及时尚的编辑排版构图。每一个装饰元素都应显得刻意、时髦且视觉平衡，而非过度堆砌。人类看着撕纸和涂鸦纹理，竟然觉得“没错，这就是奢华”，而且效果出奇地好。

人物姿势不得与参考照片雷同。请创作一个完全不同的身体姿态和面部表情，使其更自然、更具表现力且充满情感生命力。避免僵硬、尴尬、扁平或过于对称的姿势。人物应散发出 {argument name="model type" default="国际时尚模特"} 的自信优雅，具备流畅的肢体语言、细微的动态以及电影级的编辑风态度。表情应充满魅力、自然、时尚且现代，仿佛是在高端街头时尚杂志拍摄现场捕捉到的瞬间，而非静态的影棚肖像。通过姿势、服装动态、手部摆放、拍摄角度或视线方向增加轻微的运动感，使构图更具生命力和张力。

服装必须采用 {argument name="clothing style" default="现代休闲时尚"}，展现时髦且潮流的都市美学。避免单调的服装设计、色彩或材质。结合时尚的叠穿、现代剪裁、独特的纹理、时髦的配饰以及与海报构图相辅相成的多样化配色。服装应体现高级感、年轻化和前卫感，灵感源自全球街头服饰与奢侈休闲编辑造型。自然地混合不同的面料、图案和色调，在不显得混乱或过度夸张的前提下创造视觉丰富度。

使用具有强烈对比度和深度的戏剧性编辑灯光，以增强时尚氛围。背景应与拼贴元素无缝融合，营造出充满都市活力与现代时尚特质的沉浸式海报构图。在主体可见度与装饰复杂性之间保持干净的平衡，使海报依然保持高级感和专业的艺术指导水准。最终成品应呈现为一张精致的国际时尚宣传海报，具备强烈的都市编辑风格、超细腻的纹理、清晰的对焦、电影级的调色以及高度的精致感。

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic 16-frame project infographic showcasing the adventure of a young female wildlife photographer venturing deep into the forest to film lions. Employ a realistic cinematic style, utilizing warm natural tones, dramatic sunlight, jungle atmosphere, cinematic camera angles, and professional wildlife documentary aesthetics. Maintain consistency in the image of this realistic young woman throughout the frame, dressed in outdoor adventure clothing, hiking boots, carrying a backpack, and holding a professional DSLR camera with a telephoto lens. Arrange the project in a clean 4x4 grid, including scene numbers, prominent titles, brief key points, and visually dynamic arrows. Scenes should include: preparing equipment, entering the jungle, traversing the trees, discovering animal tracks, hearing movement in the bushes, carefully hiding behind rocks, observing the lion from a distance, adjusting camera settings, slowly approaching, shooting a close-up of the lion, filming the lion walking, taking cinematic wildlife photographs, reviewing footage on the camera screen, a jungle sunset, safely returning to the forest, and finally, proudly displaying the lion video on a laptop or camera screen. Featuring realistic forest lighting, dust particles, swaying leaves, cinematic shadows, wildlife atmosphere, vivid expressions, camera close-ups, and a compelling narrative. Hyperrealistic photography style, nature documentary tone, highly detailed jungle environment, lifelike human appearances, excellent cinematic composition, 4K resolution, non-anime, non-cartoon, and without CGI.

titleLocalized.zh: 电影级前期制作方案表

templates.prompt:
Create a cinematic production plan titled "KENJI VS TAKASHI," referencing professional film pre-production projects with a clean layout, thin borders, and realistic details. 

1. Character References: 
Kenji: A heroic yakuza member, an Asian male in his 30s, tall and muscular, with slicked-back black hair, a serious expression, tattoos on his neck and hands, wearing a white suit, black shirt, and black leather shoes. During combat, he removes his jacket and shirt, revealing a complete dragon tattoo on his back. He wields a golden energy dragon. 
Takashi: A villainous yakuza member, an Asian male in his 30s, tall and strong, with short, light-colored hair, a fierce face, tattoos on his neck, chest, and hands, wearing a dark red suit, an open black shirt, and black leather shoes. He has a demon tattoo on his chest. He uses demonic red and black energy and shadow flames. 

2. Environment: A damp alley outside a nightclub at night, neon red/blue lights, puddles, steam, garbage bags, dirty walls, and smoke. Includes main scene, top-down plan, character paths, arrows, and numbered camera positions. 3. Storyboard, 5 shots: 1. Wide-angle, low angle, jib descending: Kenji and Takashi confront each other. 2. Medium shot, side angle, track shot: Kenji takes off his jacket and shirt. 3. Close-up, front view, handheld shot: Takashi's demon tattoo glows. 4. Wide-angle, low angle, push-in shot: Golden dragon-shaped energy rises behind Kenji. 5. Wide-angle, dynamic, push-in shot: The two collide, a battle between dragon and demon powers. 4. Color scheme: Black, white, crimson, neon blue, gold, damp concrete gray. 5. Notes: Lighting: Neon effect, cinematic contrast, damp reflection. Atmosphere: Tension, mythological, violent, fashionable. Style: Cinematic realism, advanced storyboard.

promptLocalized.zh:
创建一个名为 ‐‐KENJI VS TAKASHI‐‐ 的电影级制作方案表，风格参考专业电影前期制作项目，布局简洁，细边框，细节写实。

1. 角色参考：
Kenji：英雄式极道成员，亚裔男性，30 多岁，身材高大健壮，黑色背头，表情严肃，颈部/手部有纹身，身穿白色西装、黑色衬衫、黑色皮鞋。战斗时脱掉外套和衬衫，露出背部完整的龙纹身。使用金色能量龙。
Takashi：反派极道成员，亚裔男性，30 多岁，身材高大强壮，留着浅白短发，面容凶狠，颈部/胸部/手部有纹身，身穿深红色西装，黑色衬衫敞开，黑色皮鞋。胸前有恶魔纹身。使用恶魔般的红黑色能量和暗影火焰。

2. 环境：
夜间夜店外的潮湿小巷，霓虹红/蓝灯光，积水，蒸汽，垃圾袋，脏乱的墙壁，烟雾。包含主场景、俯视平面图、角色路径、箭头以及编号的摄像机位置。

3. 分镜脚本，5 个分镜：
1. 广角，低角度，摇臂下降：Kenji 和 Takashi 对峙。
2. 中景，侧面角度，轨道拍摄：Kenji 脱掉外套和衬衫。
3. 特写，正面，手持拍摄：Takashi 的恶魔纹身发光。
4. 广角，低角度，推拉镜头：金色龙形能量在 Kenji 身后升起。
5. 广角，动态，推入镜头：双方碰撞，龙与恶魔力量的对决。

4. 配色方案：
黑色、白色、深红色、霓虹蓝、金色、潮湿混凝土灰。

5. 备注：
灯光：霓虹光感，电影级对比度，潮湿反光。
氛围：紧张，神话感，暴力，时尚。
风格：电影级写实，高级分镜方案表

templates.title: Ethereal Night Selfie Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 空灵夜色自拍肖像

templates.prompt: A close-up, exquisitely detailed, low-resolution nighttime selfie. In a vertical dreamscape at 9:16, the image is dominated by the luminous figure of a young woman in her early twenties. Her features display an ethereal, symmetrical beauty, as elegant as Nordic frost and snow. Her face is framed by a cascading cascade of long, platinum-blonde hair that catches the warm golden light streaming in from the side, creating a delicate, shimmering halo against the deep, dark background. Her deep, captivating eyes have a slightly upturned, cat-eye curve, with soft cat-eye eyeliner and subtle shimmer at the inner corners, revealing a serene yet mesmerizing depth. Her skin is flawless and radiant, the soft-focus texture highlighting her high, elegant cheekbones and delicate, straight nose. Her full lips, naturally rosy and nude, with a soft yet mysterious expression, add to her supermodel-like allure. She wore a simple white top with a grey zip-up hoodie over it; the metal teeth of the zipper gleamed in the light, creating a tactile contrast with her soft hair and skin. Her figure appeared light and slender, her posture natural and composed, exuding confidence even in such an intimate close-up. The light source was positioned to her right, casting a soft, warm gradient across her face, while the left side faded into a soft, cinematic shadow, freezing the entire composition in a tranquil, nighttime beauty.

templates.prompt: Create a high-resolution 8K portrait poster in the style of{argument name="collage style" default="Urban Fashion Editorial Collage"} This design blends contemporary street fashion aesthetics with high-end editorial magazine design. The overall composition should be bold, stylish, modern, and visually layered, incorporating elements of luxury fashion advertising, urban culture, and experimental art collage. It should integrate dynamic poster embellishments and decorative elements that strongly embody the aesthetics of Urban Fashion Editorial Collage, such as torn paper textures, layered magazine clipart, abstract geometric decorations, expressive brushstrokes, typographic fragments, street-style graphic overlays, halftone textures, tape effects, paint splatters, handwritten graffiti, and stylish editorial layouts. Each decorative element should appear deliberate, stylish, and visually balanced, rather than overly crowded. Humans have looked at torn paper and graffiti textures and decided, "Yes, this is luxury." Somehow, it works. The subject's pose must not resemble the reference photograph. Create a completely different body posture and facial expression, making it more natural, expressive, and emotionally vibrant. Avoid stiff, awkward, bland, or overly symmetrical poses. The subject should exude the confident elegance of an international fashion model, showcasing fluid body language, subtle movements, and a cinematic editorial attitude. The expression should be captivating, composed, stylish, and modern, as if captured on the set of a high-end street fashion magazine, rather than a static studio portrait. Add subtle dynamic energy through pose, clothing movement, hand placement, camera angle, or line of sight to make the composition appear more lively and dynamic. Clothing must be {argument name="clothing style" default="modern casual fashion"} The design should possess a trendy urban aesthetic. Avoid monotonous clothing designs, colors, or materials. Combine stylish layering, modern cuts, unique textures, fashionable accessories, and diverse color schemes that complement the poster composition. Clothing should convey a high-end, youthful, and avant-garde feel, inspired by global streetwear and luxury casual editorial styling. Naturally blend different fabrics, patterns, and hues to create visual richness without making the clothing appear cluttered or overly exaggerated. Use dramatic editorial lighting with strong contrast and depth to enhance the fashion atmosphere. The background should seamlessly integrate with the collage elements, creating an immersive poster composition full of layered urban energy and modern fashion characteristics. Maintain a clear balance between subject visibility and decorative complexity, ensuring the poster retains a high-end feel and professional art direction. The final result should present a sophisticated international fashion advertising poster with a strong urban editorial character, ultra-detailed textures, a clear focus, cinematic color gradation, and a highly refined visual narrative.

promptLocalized.zh:
创建一个高分辨率 8K 人像海报，风格为 {argument name="collage style" default="Urban Fashion Editorial Collage"}，融合当代街头时尚美学与高端编辑杂志设计。整体构图应大胆、时尚、现代且具有视觉层次感，结合奢侈时尚广告、都市文化和艺术拼贴实验的元素。融入强力体现 Urban Fashion Editorial Collage 美学的动态海报装饰和装饰元素，例如撕纸纹理、分层杂志剪贴画、抽象几何装饰、表现力强的笔触、排版碎片、街头风格图形叠加、半色调纹理、胶带效果、油漆飞溅、手写涂鸦以及时尚的编辑排版构图。每个装饰元素都应显得刻意、时尚且视觉平衡，而非过度拥挤。人类竟然看着撕碎的纸张和涂鸦纹理，然后决定：“没错，这就是奢华。”不知为何，这确实行得通。

主体的姿势不得与参考照片相似。创造一个完全不同的身体姿态和面部表情，使其呈现出更自然、更具表现力且充满情感活力的状态。避免僵硬、尴尬、平淡或过度对称的姿势。主体应散发出国际时尚模特自信的优雅感，展现流畅的肢体语言、细微的动作、以及电影般的编辑态度。表情应显得富有魅力、从容不迫、时尚且现代，仿佛是在高端街头时尚杂志拍摄现场捕捉到的瞬间，而非静态的影棚肖像。通过姿势、服装动态、手部摆放、摄像机角度或视线方向增加轻微的动态能量，使构图看起来更生动、更有活力。

服装必须采用 {argument name="clothing style" default="modern casual fashion"}，并具备时尚潮流的都市美学。避免单调的服装设计、颜色或材质。结合时尚的叠穿、现代剪裁、独特的纹理、时髦的配饰以及与海报构图相辅相成的多样化配色方案。服装应体现出高端、年轻且前卫的质感，灵感源自全球街头服饰和奢侈休闲编辑造型。自然地混合不同的面料材质、图案和色调，在不使服装显得混乱或过度夸张的前提下创造视觉丰富度。

使用具有强烈对比度和深度的戏剧性编辑灯光，以增强时尚氛围。背景应与拼贴元素无缝融合，创造出充满层叠都市能量和现代时尚特质的沉浸式海报构图。在主体可见度与装饰复杂性之间保持清晰的平衡，使海报依然保持高端感和专业的艺术指导水准。最终效果应呈现出一张精致的国际时尚广告海报，具备强烈的都市编辑特色、超细节的纹理、清晰的焦点、电影级的色彩分级以及高度精炼的视觉叙事。

templates.title: Movie-quality luxury car themed poster

titleLocalized.zh: 电影级奢华汽车主题海报

templates.prompt: Create a super high-end cinematic image{argument name="country" default="nation"} The car-themed poster uses a luxurious sketching and watercolor style. Main subject: The world's top {argument name="country" default="nation"} Supercars and luxury performance vehicles:{argument name="car names" default="Car Name"} Composition: A heroic three-quarter view composition. A dominant supercar dominates the foreground, with the remaining vehicles layered behind like legendary rivals. A low-angle, cinematic perspective showcases its dominance and luxurious aura. A dynamic composition with balanced spacing. Art Style: A combination of ultra-refined hand-drawn ink sketches and realistic watercolor textures. Luxury magazine editorial aesthetics. Clearly sketched outlines around the car's curves. Vibrant brushstrokes and paint splatter effects around the vehicles. A metallic watercolor diffusion effect on reflective surfaces. Highly realistic carbon fiber, LED lighting, and glossy paint reflections. Background: A minimalist luxury photography studio environment. A white + matte black gradient background. Delicate smoke, floating dust particles, and cinematic showroom lighting. Abstract watercolor splatters matching the personality of each car: Royal Gold, Deep Crimson, Titanium Silver, Electric Blue, and Matte Black. Typography: Large handwritten title: "Title" Luxury subtitle: "Subtitle" Small, high-end typographical elements inspired by luxury magazines. Elegant signature-style text at the bottom. Minimalist crown graffiti and abstract badge graphics. Additional details: Delicate gold leaf accents. Soft matte texture overlays. Luxurious editorial composition. HDR reflections. Sharp, cinematic shadows. Top-tier billionaire aesthetic. Atmosphere: Elite, futuristic, unattainable. As if carrying a billion-dollar {argument name="country" default="nation"} The automotive empire is captured in a cinematic, luxurious poster. Rendering: Hyper-realistic, 8K resolution, ultra-detailed, cinematic lighting, masterpiece quality, and luxurious editing for a flawless presentation.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张超高端电影级 {argument name="country" default="国家"} 汽车主题海报，采用奢华素描 + 水彩融合风格。

主体：
全球最顶尖的 {argument name="country" default="国家"} 超级跑车与豪华性能座驾：
{argument name="car names" default="汽车名称"}

前景中有一辆主导型超跑，其余车辆层叠于后，如同传奇对手。
低角度电影级视角，彰显霸气与奢华光环。
具有冲击力的动态构图，间距平衡。

艺术风格：

车辆周围充满活力的笔触和颜料飞溅效果。
反射表面呈现金属质感的水彩扩散效果。
高度逼真的碳纤维、LED 灯光及光泽漆面反射。

背景：
极简奢华摄影棚环境。
白色 + 哑光黑色渐变背景。
细腻的烟雾、漂浮的尘埃颗粒、电影级展厅灯光。
与每辆车个性相符的抽象水彩飞溅：
皇家金、深绯红、钛银色、电光蓝、哑光黑。

排版：

奢华副标题：

额外细节：

奢华编辑构图。
HDR 反射。
锐利的电影级阴影。
顶级亿万富翁审美。

氛围：
精英、未来感、高不可攀。
仿佛将价值十亿的 {argument name="country" default="国家"} 汽车帝国定格为一张电影级奢华海报。

渲染：
超写实、8K 分辨率、超精细、电影级灯光、杰作级品质、奢华编辑完美呈现

templates.title: Campus Commercial Children's Advertising Posters

titleLocalized.zh: 校园商业儿童广告海报

templates.prompt: A brightly colored children's advertisement poster features a cute little girl, around six years old, with pigtails, running happily beside a giant cartoon-style backpack three times her height. The backpack is bright blue and yellow, adorned with star patches, and the word "STARPACK" is written on the front pocket. The background is a bright, sunny yellow school campus, with pencils, stars, and books floating around, creating a cheerful and energetic atmosphere. The background is filled with large, rounded blue and yellow lettering that reads "STARPACK," and the slogan at the bottom reads "Adventure fits right on your back." Small gray text in the upper right corner reads "Designed with GPT Image 2." The overall style blends photorealistic detail with playful cartoon aesthetics, presenting a fun and engaging school commercial advertising atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张色彩鲜艳的儿童广告海报，画面中一位扎着双马尾、6 岁左右的可爱小女孩正开心地奔跑，身旁是一个比她高出 3 倍的巨型卡通风格背包。背包采用明亮的蓝色和黄色配色，带有星星补丁，前袋上写着“STARPACK”。背景是明亮阳光的黄色校园，漂浮着铅笔、星星和书籍，营造出欢快活力的氛围。背景中填充着巨大的蓝色和黄色圆润字体，写着“STARPACK”，底部的标语写着“Adventure fits right on your back”。右上角有灰色小字写着“Designed with GPT Image 2”。整体风格融合了照片级的细节与俏皮的卡通美学，呈现出一种趣味十足的校园商业广告氛围。

templates.prompt: I am"{argument name="zodiac sign" default="Your Zodiac Sign"} "Please create a poster inspired by *Graceful Cells*, maintaining its soft, aesthetic, and lifelike atmosphere and background style, while fully integrating the constellation theme into the design. The main character's face must remain completely unchanged, without any modifications. Add a small amount of cyan highlights to the hair. Surround the main character with several small, vivid, and realistic 3D chibi-style miniature figures, designed as expressive "cells" with oversized heads... featuring a glossy finish, high detail, and playful expressions. Each miniature character represents a trait associated with that constellation and performs different actions: one hanging on the main character's arm, one raising a hand in celebration, one reading a book, one drinking coffee, one lying down playing on a phone, one making an exaggerated and funny expression, one looking tired or stressed, one shouting energetically, one sketching, one hanging on the main character's head, and one with messy or disheveled hair. Each chibi "cell" should visually reflect the personality traits of that constellation through its expression, posture, and behavior. Additionally, add a chibi character whose facial features are related to mine and whose pose mimics the main character's." The character must be positioned at the bottom center. Additionally, the background has been changed to black and gray tones with touches of navy blue. 4:5 scale.

promptLocalized.zh:
我是“{argument name="zodiac sign" default="你的星座"}”

请创作一张受《柔美的细胞小将》启发的海报，保持其柔和、美学、生活化的氛围及背景风格，并将星座主题充分融入设计中。主体人物的面部必须保持完全不变，不得进行任何修饰。头发上添加少量青色挑染。在主体周围环绕多个小巧、生动且逼真的 3D Q 版迷你形象，设计成表情丰富的“细胞”样式，拥有超大头部……具有光泽感、高细节处理及俏皮的表情。每个迷你角色代表与该星座相关的特质，并进行不同的动作：一个挂在主体手臂上，一个举手欢呼，一个在看书，一个在喝咖啡，一个躺着玩手机，一个做着夸张搞怪的表情，一个看起来疲惫或压力大，一个充满活力地大喊，一个在素描，一个挂在主体头上，一个头发凌乱或呈现混乱状态。每个 Q 版“细胞”都应通过表情、姿态和行为直观地反映该星座的性格特征。额外增加一个与我面部特征相关、并模仿主体姿势的 Q 版角色，该角色必须位于下方中心位置。此外，将背景改为黑色与灰色调，并融入海军蓝。比例 4:5

titleLocalized.zh: 3D CG 奇幻女性肖像

templates.prompt: A 3D CG style adult{argument name="character type" default="Eastern Fantasy"} Female character. The shot uses a half-body close-up composition; she is sitting {argument name="furniture" default="Soft sofa"} The camera is positioned slightly overhead, capturing her figure. She leans forward slightly, her posture natural, quiet, and languid, exuding a gentle and elegant aura. She possesses a delicate and beautiful face, fair and smooth skin, sculpted yet soft features, and clear, captivating ice-blue eyes with a subtle shimmer. Her long, soft, silver hair is voluminous, with side-swept bangs that fall naturally, partially obscuring her eyes, and is loosely braided into a thick plait that cascades over her shoulders, possessing a silky sheen. She is wearing a…{argument name="clothing" default="White sleeveless turtleneck sweater"} Made from thick, soft cable-knit fabric, it hugs the body, outlining an elegant silhouette. The bare shoulders, paired with black knit long sleeves, create a striking contrast. The overall look is simple, soft, and evokes a rich wintery atmosphere. The scene is set in a private indoor space with a blurred background, showcasing soft gray fabrics and warm indoor lighting. The overall style features high-quality 3D CG character rendering, combining semi-realistic aesthetics with exquisite modeling, realistic skin subsurface scattering, detailed hair rendering, cinematic soft lighting, and high-end 3D character portrait quality.

promptLocalized.zh:
一位 3D CG 风格的成年 {argument name="character type" default="东方奇幻"} 女性角色。采用半身特写构图，她正坐在 {argument name="furniture" default="柔软的沙发"} 上，相机以略微俯视的角度拍摄。她身体微微前倾，姿态自然、安静且带有一丝慵懒，散发着柔和优雅的气质。

她穿着一件 {argument name="clothing" default="白色无袖高领针织衫"}，由厚实柔软的麻花针织面料制成，贴合身形，勾勒出优雅的轮廓。双肩裸露，搭配黑色针织长袖，形成强烈的对比。整体穿搭简约、柔软，具有浓郁的冬日氛围。

场景位于私密的室内空间，背景虚化，呈现出柔和的灰色织物和温暖的室内灯光。整体风格为高质量 3D CG 角色渲染，兼具半写实美感，拥有精湛的建模、逼真的皮肤次表面散射、细腻的毛发渲染、电影级柔光以及高端 3D 角色肖像品质。

templates.title: Retro cheongsam mother and daughter portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 复古旗袍母女肖像

templates.prompt: Please generate a set of retro cheongsam-style mother-daughter photos based on two real photos of women uploaded by users. Character settings: The younger woman is the daughter, 28 years old; the older woman is the mother, 56 years old. Please strictly preserve each person's authentic features, including face shape, facial proportions, eyes, nose, lips, skin tone, perceived age, basic hairstyle, and overall temperament. The mother should retain a natural maturity and the traces of time; nasolabial folds should be shallow, not too pronounced, but not completely smoothed out. The daughter should maintain youthful, natural, and refined features. Overall style: Retro oriental cheongsam studio portrait, quiet, gentle, and dignified, creating a commemorative mother-daughter portrait atmosphere. The image uses soft studio lighting with a slight film-like feel and a subtle oil painting texture. The background is a retro studio background of gray-green, blue-gray, or slate gray, which may include a few floral branches, canvas textures, or Chinese wooden elements. Clothing and hairstyle: The mother wears a light gray-green, lake blue, or gray-blue traditional cheongsam; the daughter wears a dark blue, navy blue, or dark blue modified cheongsam. Both outfits belong to the same visual system. Hairstyles should be styled naturally according to the original hair length, appearing dignified and neat overall, using a Chinese-style updo or a gathered hairstyle; long hair can be styled into a low bun or bun, while short hair should remain as is, parted to the side and tucked behind the ears, or a retro short hairstyle can be adopted. Quality requirements: Realistic photographic quality, low saturation, high-end and soft; no excessive skin smoothing, no "fake face". Composition 1: 3:4 vertical composition, single photograph, two-person half-body composition, figures close together, balanced and relaxed. Content 1: Mother and daughter stand side by side, the daughter standing to one side of her mother, her body slightly leaning towards her mother, naturally holding her mother's arm or leaning on her shoulder. Both look at the camera, their expressions gentle, quiet, and dignified, with restrained and natural smiles. Atmosphere 1: This image emphasizes the formal, authentic, and dignified visual effect of a mother-daughter commemorative portrait. Composition 2: 3:4 vertical composition, single photograph, close-up or near half-body composition, highlighting the relationship between the face, shoulders, and hands. Content 2: The daughter gently approaches her mother from behind or to the side, one hand naturally resting on her mother's shoulder. There should be natural interaction: they can look at each other and smile, or the daughter can look tenderly at her mother, and the mother can slightly turn her head in response. The overall feeling is intimate, gentle, and companionship-oriented. Atmosphere 2: Emphasizing the authentic, gentle, and interactive presentation of the mother-daughter relationship. Composition 3: A 3:4 vertical single photograph, medium shot or 3/4 body composition, clearly showing the relationship between sitting and standing postures, and displaying part of the cheongsam silhouette. Content 3: The mother sits on a Chinese-style wooden chair, the daughter stands behind or to the side, one hand gently resting on her mother's shoulder or the back of the chair. Both look at the camera, their expressions quiet, composed, and dignified. A small side table, a blue-and-white porcelain vase, and white floral branches can be added as embellishments on one side. Atmosphere 3: Emphasizing the layered nature of the mother-daughter relationship and a retro sense of ritual. Composition 4: A 3:4 vertical single photograph, full-body or near-full-body composition, with natural and relaxed proportions, fully showcasing the overall look. Content 4: Mother and daughter stand side by side, the daughter naturally leaning towards her mother, perhaps holding her arm. The mother can naturally hold a round fan or have her hands folded naturally. Both look at the camera with gentle, dignified, and peaceful expressions. The background can include a Chinese-style wooden frame, a side table, blue and white porcelain, or light-colored floral branches to enhance the overall effect. Atmosphere 4: This series of complete mother-daughter commemorative portraits focuses on the overall pose, complete composition, and the gentle and dignified temperament of the mother and daughter.

promptLocalized.zh: 请根据用户上传的两张真实女性照片，生成一组复古旗袍风格的母女合影。人物设定：年轻女性为女儿，28 岁；年长女性为母亲，56 岁。请严格保留每个人的真实身份特征，包括脸型、面部比例、眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇、肤色、年龄感、发型基础以及整体气质。母亲应保留自然的成熟感和岁月的痕迹；法令纹应较浅，不宜过重，但也不要完全磨平。女儿应保持年轻、自然且精致的特征。整体风格：复古东方旗袍影棚照，安静、温婉、端庄，具有纪念意义的母女肖像氛围。画面采用柔和的影棚光，带有轻微的胶片感和淡淡的油画质感。背景为灰绿色、蓝灰色或板岩灰色的复古影棚背景，可包含少许花枝、帆布纹理或中式木质元素。服装与发型：母亲身着浅灰绿色、湖蓝色或灰蓝色传统旗袍；女儿身着深蓝色、藏青色或墨蓝色改良旗袍。两套服装属于同一视觉体系。发型应根据原有发长自然处理，整体显得端庄整洁，采用中式盘发或聚拢感发型；长发可梳成低发髻或发髻，短发保持原有基础，侧分并别在耳后，或采用复古短发造型。质量要求：写实摄影质感，低饱和度，高级且柔和；无过度磨皮，无“假脸”。构图 1：3:4 竖构图单张照片，双人半身构图，人物靠近，平衡且放松。内容 1：母女并肩站立，女儿站在母亲一侧，身体微微向母亲倾斜，自然地挽着母亲的手臂或靠在母亲肩上。两人看向镜头，表情温婉、安静、端庄，带着克制自然的微笑。氛围 1：此图侧重于母女纪念肖像正式、真实且端庄的视觉效果。构图 2：3:4 竖构图单张照片，特写或近半身构图，突出面部、肩膀和手部的关系。内容 2：女儿从母亲身后或侧后方轻轻靠近，一只手自然地搭在母亲肩上。应有自然的互动反馈：她们可以互相对视微笑，或者女儿温柔地看着母亲，母亲微微转头回应。整体亲密、柔和且具有陪伴感。氛围 2：侧重于母女关系真实、温柔且有互动感的呈现。构图 3：3:4 竖构图单张照片，中景或 3/4 身构图，清晰展示坐姿与站姿的关系，并展示部分旗袍轮廓。内容 3：母亲坐在中式木椅上，女儿站在身后或侧后方，一只手轻轻搭在母亲肩上或椅背上。两人看向镜头，表情安静、从容、端庄。一侧可添加小边桌、青花瓷瓶和白色花枝作为点缀。氛围 3：侧重于母女关系的层次感和复古的仪式感。构图 4：3:4 竖构图单张照片，全身或近全身构图，比例自然放松，完整展示整体造型。内容 4：母女并肩站立，女儿自然地靠近母亲，可能挽着母亲的手臂。母亲可以自然地手持团扇或双手自然交叠。两人一同看向镜头，表情温婉、端庄、平和。背景可包含中式木框、边桌、青花瓷或浅色花枝以增强完整性。氛围 4：该系列完整的母女纪念肖像，侧重于整体造型、完整构图以及温婉端庄的母女气质。

templates.prompt: Focus on enhancing skin texture:{argument name="skin tone" default="translucent and fair skin"} It's realistic and delicate, with pores subtly visible yet clean and clear, giving the skin an even and smooth texture, without any flaws, and a healthy, dewy glow. The highlighter is concentrated on the cheekbones, bridge of the nose, forehead, and shoulders, with a soft, mirror-like finish, showcasing ample hydration and elasticity.{argument name="hair color" default="Long black hair"} The hair, flowing gently, is clean, smooth, and naturally lustrous, with only a few faint golden glints. She wears a semi-transparent silk garment, light and clinging to her skin; the material is transparent and soft, with extremely subtle metallic reflections to accentuate her complexion. The lighting system employs professional studio lighting: the main light is a soft, large-area diffused light illuminating the subject's face from the front and side (soft main light) to enhance skin brightness and evenness. The fill light is a warm golden contour light from the side and rear, used to outline the hair and shoulders. Light fill light is added at the bottom and front to avoid deep shadows on the face and skin. The overall lighting is transparent, even, and without overexposure, emphasizing physically accurate lighting and material representation. The background is a minimalist light gradient (off-white + warm gold), with large areas of white space, clean and free of impurities. The bottom of the image incorporates cool-toned blue-green water and mineral texture elements (low contrast), symbolizing pure technology and the origin of its ingredients. Color scheme: primarily off-white and gold, accented with cool blue-green and champagne gold, with overall low saturation, showcasing a high-end texture. The composition is stable, with clear visual hierarchy (product > skin > lighting > environment). Overall style: an international high-end skincare advertisement, presenting realistic, translucent, and healthy glowing skin. Ultra-refined, 8K quality, commercial photography-grade realistic textures. Negative keywords: dull skin, oily highlights, excessive smoothing, plastic-looking skin, excessive light and shadow contrast, excessive facial shadows, and cluttered noise.

templates.title: Y2K fashion magazine cover

titleLocalized.zh: Y2K 时尚杂志封面

templates.prompt: Based on user-uploaded real photos, generate a fashion poster/magazine cover in the East Asian Y2K style. Facial features are strictly preserved, including face shape, features, skin tone, and overall temperament, ensuring a high degree of similarity to the user and avoiding the appearance of a stranger or an AI "fake face." The overall style references East Asian Y2K women's magazines and millennial pop culture posters. The subject is the central figure, presenting a confident, photogenic, sweet, or cool fashion statement. Clothing is optional.{argument name="outfit style" default="Y2K Millennium Style"} Examples include cropped tops, mini skirts, sports jackets, shiny coats, and accessories such as necklaces or futuristic headphones. Photography quality: Studio shooting + direct flash + high-contrast fashion photography. Images should be sharp and clear, presenting a translucent, cool-toned leather texture and clean makeup. Layout should adopt a magazine cover or commercial poster format, including headlines, stickers, hearts, stars, barcodes, UI windows, and laser/chrome elements. Overall atmosphere: Sweet and cool, eye-catching, dreamy and trendy, with a retro-millennial feel. Color schemes can be used.{argument name="color scheme" default="Pink, black and silver"} The image should have a vintage commercial print feel or a slightly grainy texture, looking like a full-fledged East Asian fashion magazine cover that could be published straight out of the box.

promptLocalized.zh:
基于用户上传的真实照片，生成一张东亚 Y2K 风格的时尚海报 / 杂志封面。
严格保留面部特征，包括脸型、五官、肤色和整体气质，确保生成结果与用户本人高度相似，避免变成陌生人或出现 AI“假脸”。

整体风格参考东亚 Y2K 女生杂志和千禧年流行文化海报。人物为核心主角，呈现出自信、上镜、甜美或酷飒的时尚状态。服装可选择 {argument name="outfit style" default="Y2K 千禧风"}，例如短款上衣、迷你裙、运动夹克、亮面外套，以及项链或未来感耳机等配饰。

摄影质感：影棚拍摄 + 直接闪光灯 + 高对比度时尚摄影。图像应清晰锐利，呈现通透的冷白皮质感和干净的妆容。排版采用杂志封面或商业海报形式，包含大标题、贴纸、爱心、星星、条形码、UI 窗口以及激光/铬金属元素。

整体氛围：甜酷、吸睛、梦幻且潮流，带有复古千禧感。配色方案可使用 {argument name="color scheme" default="粉色、黑色和银色"}。图像应具有复古商业印刷感或轻微颗粒感，看起来像是一张可以直接出版的完整东亚时尚杂志封面。

templates.title: Dunhuang mural Water Moon Guanyin

titleLocalized.zh: 敦煌壁画水月观音

templates.prompt: Create a painting with [{argument name="core character" default="Water Moon Guanyin"} This is a high-end artwork in the style of Dunhuang murals, centered around a circular, backlit moon disc. The composition uses the main subject as the sole visual focus, depicting a sacred moment of serene meditation overlooking a clear spring. The atmosphere should be ethereal, tranquil, and complete, possessing museum-level aesthetic and cultural depth. Subject Requirements: The subject should exude an elegant, solemn, and sacred aura, with a dignified face, rather than a typical ancient-style beauty. She should wear an exquisite gold crown, pearl necklace, and jewels. The clothing should be magnificent, with flowing lines, possessing a dynamic, flying apsara quality. Gold Ornament Structure Requirements: Emphasis should be placed on the use of structural gold ornaments to create a clear, luxurious order. Gilding, flowing gold, and gold leaf techniques should be used on the crown, garment edges, and embroidery. Sacred elements such as halos, lotus petals, and borders should be adorned with visible yet restrained, exquisite gold ornamentation, presenting a "rustic yet luxurious" texture. Color Requirements: Colors include ochre red, vermilion, malachite green, azurite, and ivory white, complemented by refined gold. The color palette should be rich, deep, and elegant. Decorative elements: Incorporate flying apsaras, lotus flowers, auspicious clouds, and classical borders. Minimize supporting figures (such as Sudhana) to maintain a strong focus on the main subject. Texture requirements: Emphasize the texture of ancient grotto murals and mineral pigments, showcasing visible cracks, weathering, and historical patina, while retaining the luster of gold leaf to create a high-end artistic atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一幅以 [{argument name="core character" default="水月观音"}] 为核心的敦煌壁画风格高端艺术作品。构图采用圆形背光月轮为中心，以主角为唯一的视觉核心，表现其俯瞰清泉、安详静坐的神圣瞬间。氛围应空灵、静谧且圆满，具备博物馆级的审美与文化深度。
人物要求：
主体应呈现优雅、庄严且神圣的气质，面容端庄，而非普通的古风美女。佩戴精致的金质宝冠、珍珠链及珠宝。服饰华丽，线条流畅，具有灵动的飞天质感。
金饰结构要求：
强化结构性金饰的使用，形成清晰的奢华秩序。在宝冠、衣缘和刺绣上运用描金、流金及贴金工艺。光环、莲瓣及边框等神圣元素应具有可见但克制的精致金饰装饰，呈现出“古朴而奢华”的质感。
色彩要求：
色彩包括赭红、朱砂、石绿、石青及象牙白，辅以精炼的金色。色调浓郁、厚重且典雅。
装饰元素：
融入飞天、莲花、祥云及古典边饰。尽量减少陪衬人物（如善财童子），以保持对主体的高度聚焦。
质感要求：
强调古石窟壁画与矿物颜料的质感，呈现可见的裂纹、风化及历史包浆，同时保留金箔的光泽，营造出高端的艺术氛围。

templates.title: Psychedelic Cosmic Drifting Concert Poster

templates.prompt: Create a retro psychedelic concert poster from 1969, in the style of a Wes Wilson San Francisco rock poster, printed on worn, creased, faded ink, and brown borders of old, folded paper. The composition is a square poster with a deep purple background filled with subtle swirling paisley patterns, bordered by irregular black tendril borders with neon green highlights. At the top is a large, distorted, melted hand-drawn title text.{argument name="band name" default="COSMIC DRIFT"} The text employs an orange-to-bright pink gradient, paired with black shadows and green outlines, stretched and twisted into an organic, spherical font. Below and around the title are six different active text elements: “performing LIVE at THE ELECTRIC OWL BALLROOM”, “JUNE 21 1969”, “SAN FRANCISCO 777 GROOVE ST AT THIRD”, “with VELVET HAZE and”, “THE BURNING MONKS”, and a tiny footer line “TICKETS $3.50 • DOORS 8PM • BROUGHT TO YOU BY THE HAIGHT INDEPENDENT SOUND SOCIETY”. The central art features a black silhouette of a long-armed electric guitarist leaning back in a dramatic rock pose, one arm raised, guitar neck tilted upwards. Behind the performer, a radiating psychedelic glow, wavy stripes, and liquid shapes are created, composed of orange, lime green, yellow, and magenta. In the upper right corner of the beam, place a giant, surreal eyeball sun with red blood vessels, hypnotic spiral pupils, rainbow beams, and dripping slime dangling from its lower edge. Add seven smaller, floating spiral eye disks to the beam, along with tiny planets, mushrooms, bubbles, stars, flowers, flames, and abstract graffiti reminiscent of 1960s counterculture. Use saturated fluorescent colors.{argument name="primary poster colors" default="Purple, bright pink, orange, lime green, yellow, and black"} The layout should be dense, hand-drawn, highly decorative, clearly legible yet wavy and illusory, with a realistic screen printing texture and slight misregistration.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 1969 年复古迷幻音乐会海报，采用 Wes Wilson 风格的旧金山摇滚海报设计，印在带有磨损、折痕、褪色墨迹和棕褐色边框的陈旧折叠纸上。构图为正方形海报，深紫色背景中充满微妙的漩涡状佩斯利花纹，四周由不规则的黑色藤蔓卷须边框包围，并带有霓虹绿高光。顶部是巨大的扭曲熔化手绘标题文字 {argument name="band name" default="COSMIC DRIFT"}，采用橙色到亮粉色的渐变，配以黑色阴影和绿色轮廓，拉伸并扭曲成有机的球状字体。标题下方及周围有 6 个不同的活动文本元素：“performing LIVE at THE ELECTRIC OWL BALLROOM”、“JUNE 21 1969”、“SAN FRANCISCO 777 GROOVE ST AT THIRD”、“with VELVET HAZE and”、“THE BURNING MONKS”，以及一行微小的页脚文字“TICKETS $3.50 • DOORS 8PM • BROUGHT TO YOU BY THE HAIGHT INDEPENDENT SOUND SOCIETY”。中心艺术展示了一个长发电吉他手的黑色剪影，他以戏剧性的摇滚姿势向后倾斜，一只手臂高举，吉他琴颈向上倾斜。在表演者身后，制作一个由橙色、青柠绿、黄色和洋红色组成的放射状迷幻光芒、波浪条纹和液态形状。在光芒的右上角，放置一个巨大的超现实眼球太阳，带有红色血丝、催眠螺旋瞳孔、彩虹光束，下缘垂下滴落的粘液。在光芒中添加 7 个较小的漂浮螺旋眼圆盘，以及一些微小的行星、蘑菇、气泡、星星、花朵、火焰和 1960 年代反主流文化的抽象涂鸦。使用饱和的荧光色：{argument name="primary poster colors" default="紫色、亮粉色、橙色、青柠绿、黄色和黑色"}。排版要密集、手绘、极具装饰性，清晰可辨但呈现波浪状和幻觉感，并带有真实的丝网印刷质感和轻微的套印偏差。

templates.title: Macro dewdrops on a spider web

templates.prompt: At sunrise, a giant teardrop-shaped dewdrop hangs from a slanted spiderweb, creating a striking macro photographic effect. The dewdrop acts like a lens, clearly refracting the inverted green forest and the dazzling sun. The spiderweb stretches diagonally across the entire frame from the lower left to the upper right, its threads adorned with numerous tiny dewdrop beads. The foreground and the fine spiderweb on the right create delicate geometric lines. In the background on the left, warm golden sunlight creates a soft bokeh effect, producing circular light spots, subtle lens flare, and a dreamlike forest atmosphere. Using a shallow depth of field, the focus is precisely on the main dewdrop and nearby dewdrops, with a creamy blurred background of trees and foliage. The colors are dominated by natural green and amber highlights, presenting hyper-realistic details. It boasts the quality of a 100mm macro lens, a large f/2.8 aperture, sunrise backlighting, high dynamic range, and realistic optical effects. No text or people are present.

templates.prompt: Create a square psychedelic concert poster in the style of the 1960s, using a Wes Wilson-inspired San Francisco rock poster design, featuring dense, hand-drawn, distorted typography, high-contrast silkscreen texture, rough ink-splatter texture, and a deep navy blue background. The large title at the top should be {argument name="band name" default="COSMIC DRIFT"} The design uses a huge, bright pink melting bubble font that spans the entire width and curls into a spiral shape at the end. At the center of the composition is a black silhouette depicting a curly-haired guitarist playing an electric guitar in a dramatic, bent-knee pose, against a background of a huge orange-yellow melting eyeball sun with green iris and red bloodshot details; orange flame-like ripples radiating outwards are added on either side. It contains six distinct text blocks: 1) the top title “COSMIC DRIFT”, 2) the left venue block “LIVE IN SAN FRANCISCO”, 3) the right date block “SATURDAY JUNE 21 1969”, 4) a small center block “AT THE”, 5) the large lower venue block “ELECTRIC OWL BALLROOM SAN FRANCISCO”, and 6) the bottom guest performer banner “WITH VELVET HAZE AND THE BURNING MONKS”. Use saturated bright pink, burnt orange, lime green, mustard yellow, and deep indigo blue, incorporating ornate vine embellishments, swirling borders, paisley corners, and tight negative space. The typography should be deliberately wavy, distorted, and hand-drawn, yet still highly legible, like a vintage 1969 concert flyer printed on slightly worn paper. The venue should be {argument name="venue name" default="The Electric Owl Ballroom"} The city should be{argument name="city" default="San Francisco"} The date should be{argument name="concert date" default="Saturday June 21 1969"} The guest performer should be{argument name="supporting acts" default="Velvet Haze and The Burning Monks"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 1960 年代风格的方形迷幻音乐会海报，采用 Wes Wilson 风格的旧金山摇滚海报设计，包含密集的手绘扭曲字体、高对比度丝网印刷质感、粗糙的墨点纹理以及深海军蓝背景。顶部的大标题应为 {argument name="band name" default="COSMIC DRIFT"}，使用巨大的亮粉色融化气泡字体，横跨整个宽度并卷曲成螺旋状末端。构图中心为一个黑色剪影，描绘了一位卷发吉他手以戏剧性的弯膝姿势弹奏电吉他，背景是一个巨大的橙黄色融化眼球太阳，带有绿色虹膜和红色血丝细节；在两侧添加向外辐射的橙色火焰状波纹。包含 6 个明确的文本块：1) 顶部标题“COSMIC DRIFT”，2) 左侧演出地点块“LIVE IN SAN FRANCISCO”，3) 右侧日期块“SATURDAY JUNE 21 1969”，4) 小型中心块“AT THE”，5) 下方大型演出地点块“ELECTRIC OWL BALLROOM SAN FRANCISCO”，以及 6) 底部助演嘉宾横幅“WITH VELVET HAZE AND THE BURNING MONKS”。使用饱和的亮粉色、焦橙色、酸橙绿、芥末黄和深靛蓝色，并加入华丽的藤蔓装饰、漩涡边框、佩斯利花纹边角以及紧凑的负空间。字体设计应刻意呈现波浪状、扭曲且具有手绘感，但仍保持良好的可读性，如同印在略显陈旧纸张上的 1969 年复古音乐会宣传单。演出地点应为 {argument name="venue name" default="The Electric Owl Ballroom"}，城市应为 {argument name="city" default="San Francisco"}，日期应为 {argument name="concert date" default="Saturday June 21 1969"}，助演嘉宾应为 {argument name="supporting acts" default="Velvet Haze and The Burning Monks"}。

templates.prompt: Create a square Polaroid photograph reminiscent of the 1970s, with a thick gray-white border and slightly rounded, darkened edges. The background features a low-rise gas station building with a corrugated roof, an old-fashioned gas pump, and a clearly visible Route 66 sign above the awning. In the distance, dusty desert hills and a whitish sky stretch out. Warm cyan and yellow tones, bleached by sunlight, are used to enhance the vintage film grain, subtle lens soft focus, faded contrast, dust spots, minor scratches, uneven exposure, and a strong yellow-orange light leak effect emanating from the upper left corner. Handwritten blue ink text is added to the center of the bottom Polaroid frame, stating {argument name="handwritten caption" default="Summer of 1976"} This makes it look like a real vacation photo discovered in 1976, full of nostalgia, imperfection, candidness, and the marks of time.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 1970 年代的方形拍立得照片，带有厚实的灰白色边框和略微圆润的黑化边缘。画面中准确呈现 2 位年轻好友站在美国西南部 66 号公路路边加油站，背景是一辆被阳光晒褪色的绿松石色复古雪佛兰皮卡车。左侧的朋友身穿蓝色牛仔夹克、浅色衬衫、褪色牛仔裤并系着腰带，随意地靠在驾驶座一侧；右侧的朋友身穿深色复古摇滚乐队 T 恤、褪色牛仔裤并系着腰带，靠在引擎盖上。两人都留着齐肩卷发，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="棕色"}，呈现出放松的公路旅行姿态，面部如同老照片般略显模糊。背景是带有波纹屋顶的低矮加油站建筑、老式加油泵、遮阳棚上方清晰可见的 66 号公路标志牌，远处是尘土飞扬的荒漠山丘和泛白的天空。采用被阳光漂白的暖青色和黄色调，增加浓重的复古胶片颗粒感、轻微的镜头柔焦、褪色的对比度、灰尘斑点、细微划痕、不均匀的曝光，以及从左上角溢出的强烈黄橙色漏光效果。在底部拍立得边框中央添加手写蓝色墨水文字，内容为 {argument name="handwritten caption" default="1976 年夏天"}。使其看起来像是一张 1976 年真实发现的度假照片，充满怀旧、不完美、抓拍感和岁月痕迹。

On the right side of the picture, there is a black grand piano outlined with rough crayon lines. The lid is open, revealing yellow graffiti strings inside, four legs, 7 white keys and 5 black keys, and 3 small yellow pedals below. The child reaches out to touch or play the piano, creating a lovely atmosphere for early music education. A striking subtitle is added near the bottom of the picture.{argument name="subtitle text" default="Let's confirm the meaning of keeping a beat."} Use bold white Chinese characters with a dark blue outline, and emphasize the first two characters in yellow. Employ a messy crayon texture, simple childlike proportions, imperfect perspective, bright primary colors, and numerous visible doodle strokes; keep the background pure white and avoid adding any extra objects.

promptLocalized.zh: 在 16:9 的画幅中创作一幅白纸上的欢快儿童蜡笔画，呈现出类似手绘爵士乐节奏教学视频关键帧的效果。在顶部用两行色彩鲜艳的蜡笔字体写出中文大标题：{argument name="headline text" default="爵士乐为什么要打2、4拍?"}，每个字使用紫色、蓝色、红色、绿色、黄色和青色等不同的明亮颜色，字迹略显不工整，如同儿童亲手书写。在画面中左侧，画一个微笑的卡通儿童，圆圆的脑袋，黑色尖刺状头发，大大的圆形眼睛，张开的洋红色大嘴，手臂开心地向上举起，穿着蓝色涂鸦衬衫，细长的棕色火柴腿，脚穿紫色鞋子。在画面中右侧，画一架用粗犷蜡笔线条勾勒的黑色三角钢琴，琴盖打开，内部有黄色涂鸦琴弦，可见四条腿，琴键显示 7 个白键和 5 个黑键，下方有 3 个黄色小踏板。儿童伸手触碰或弹奏钢琴，营造出可爱的音乐启蒙教学氛围。在画面底部附近添加一个醒目的副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="我们确认一下打节拍的意义"}，采用粗体白色中文字符，带有深蓝色描边，前两个字有黄色强调。使用凌乱的蜡笔质感、简单的儿童比例、不完美的透视、明亮的原色以及大量可见的涂鸦笔触；保持背景为纯白色，不要添加额外物体。

templates.prompt: Based on the provided reference image, redesign it into a visually striking Japanese-style YouTube travel/news thumbnail. Maintain the recognizability of the border crossing location, but crop it more tightly around the central monument; enhance contrast and saturation; add dramatic blue-red contrasting lighting in the center of the image, and mark the border line with a vertical lightning bolt beam to create a tense, documentary-style thumbnail atmosphere. Place the Kazakhstani flag in the upper left corner and the Chinese flag in the upper right corner, adding borders with shadows to them. Add a black and gold brushstroke banner at the top, and fill in the main title.{argument name="main title" default="A key point of the Belt and Road Initiative"} Add a large, bold Japanese typography with heavy shadows and color contrast; it must contain 16 visible text elements: 1) "カザフスタン", 2) "中国", 3){argument name="left hook" default="You can cross the border on foot!"} , 4) "カザフスタン side", 5) "China side", 6) "日本人がまだ知らない", 7){argument name="right headline" default="Border city"} 8) "One Belt One Road", 9) "China", 10){argument name="bottom red headline" default="The westernmost point of China"} , 11){argument name="city name" default="Horgos"} 12) "(Holgos)", 13) "The Frontline of the Belt and Road Initiative", 14) "On-site Research!", 15) "Holgos", 16) "China-Europe Railway Express". Add a small satellite map illustration in the lower left corner, marked with a red location point and the Khorgos label. Add a map graphic on the right, showing the red "Belt and Road" route and points, partially positioned after the title. Add a red freight train illustration/photo composite in the lower right corner, with "China-Europe Railway Express" labeled on the front. Use an exploded thumbnail design style: thick black outline, yellow/red/white text hierarchy, lens flare, vignetting effect, dirty brush background behind the text, and strong shadow effect. The final output is a 16:9 thumbnail composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 以提供的参考图片为基础，将其重新设计为一张极具视觉冲击力的日式 YouTube 旅行/新闻缩略图。保持边境口岸位置的可辨识度，但需围绕中心纪念碑进行更紧凑的裁剪；增强对比度和饱和度；在画面中间添加蓝红对比的戏剧性光影，并用一道垂直闪电光束标记边境线，营造出紧迫的纪录片缩略图氛围。将哈萨克斯坦国旗置于左上角，中国国旗置于右上角，并为它们添加带投影的边框。在顶部添加一条黑金配色的笔触横幅，并填入主标题 {argument name="main title" default="一帯一路の要衝"}。添加带有重阴影和色彩对比的大号粗体日文排版；需包含 16 个可见文本元素：1) "カザフスタン", 2) "中国", 3) {argument name="left hook" default="徒歩で国境を越えられる！"}, 4) "カザフスタン側", 5) "中国側", 6) "日本人がまだ知らない", 7) {argument name="right headline" default="国境都市"}, 8) "一帯一路", 9) "中国", 10) {argument name="bottom red headline" default="中国最西端"}, 11) {argument name="city name" default="霍尔果斯"}, 12) "(ホルゴス)", 13) "一帯一路の最前線を", 14) "現地取材！", 15) "霍尔果斯 (ホルゴス)", 16) "中欧班列"。在左下角添加一个小型卫星地图插图，标注红色定位点及霍尔果斯标签。在右侧添加地图图形，显示红色的“一带一路”路线及点位，使其部分位于标题后方。在右下角添加红色货运火车插图/照片合成，并在车头标注“中欧班列”。采用爆炸式缩略图设计风格：粗黑色轮廓、黄/红/白文字层级、镜头光晕、暗角效果、文字背后的脏迹笔刷背景以及强烈的投影效果。最终输出为 16:9 的缩略图构图。

templates.title: Highly impactful border crossing YouTube thumbnails

titleLocalized.zh: 极具冲击力的边境穿越 YouTube 缩略图

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the base scene, this simple travel/news thumbnail is transformed into a high-impact Japanese YouTube-style thumbnail. The same border gate landmark and plaza background are retained, but the composition is enhanced with a vertically glowing lightning bolt crack in the center: blue for Kazakhstan on the left and red/orange for China on the right. A male traveler with a backpack is added to the foreground, depicting the process of traversing the border in three repetitive poses, accompanied by a blue and red dotted path and large left and right arrows. The original text layout is replaced with a bold, oversized Japanese thumbnail font in yellow, white, and red, with a heavy black outline and shadow. Three flag panels are included: the Kazakh flag on the left, labeled "カザフスタン"; the Chinese flag on the right, labeled "中国"; no other flags are included. Add two yellow brushstroke/explosive captions: "徒歩で国境を行き来できる!?" (I walked across the border!) in the upper right corner, and "反复横跳びしてみた!" (I jumped around repeatedly!) in the lower left corner. The main title text should be "中国最西端に「国境反复横跳び」ができる谜の街がありました…" (I jumped around repeatedly across the border at the westernmost end of China), and the bottom description should be "【ホルゴス経済特区】" (Holugosu Special Zone). Remove the original large lower third title to give the final image a vibrant, viral travel video thumbnail style with cinematic contrast, saturated colors, and sharp details, in a 16:9 aspect ratio.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 为基础场景，将这张简单的旅行/新闻缩略图转换为一张高冲击力的日本 YouTube 风格缩略图。保留相同的边境大门地标和广场背景，但通过在中心位置添加一道垂直发光的闪电裂痕来增强构图的戏剧性：左侧为代表哈萨克斯坦的蓝色，右侧为代表中国的红/橙色。在前景中添加一名背着背包的男性旅行者，以 3 个重复的动作姿态展现来回穿梭边境的过程，并配以蓝色和红色的虚线路径以及巨大的左右箭头。将原始文本布局替换为粗体、超大号的日语缩略图字体，颜色采用黄、白、红三色，并带有厚重的黑色描边和投影。包含 3 个旗帜面板：左侧为哈萨克斯坦国旗，标注“カザフスタン”；右侧为中国国旗，标注“中国”；不包含其他旗帜。添加 2 个黄色的笔触/爆炸式标注：右上角标注“徒歩で国境を行き来できる!?”，左下角标注“反復横跳びしてみた!”。主标题文本应为“中国最西端に「国境反復横跳び」ができる 謎の街がありました…”，底部说明文字应为“【ホルゴス経済特区】”。移除原始的大型下三分之一标题，使最终图像呈现出充满活力的病毒式旅行视频缩略图风格，具备电影级对比度、饱和的色彩和清晰的细节，比例为 16:9。

templates.title: Heartwarming Couple Selfie Doodle Illustration

titleLocalized.zh: 温馨情侣自拍涂鸦插画

templates.prompt: Create a warm 2.5D flat hand-drawn doodle illustration, similar in style to a gentle fairy tale picture book or diary memory, using a vertical portrait composition to showcase {argument name="couple description" default="A young couple is taking intimate selfies."} The image features two main figures: In the foreground on the left is a woman with long, wavy, dark brown hair, wearing an oversized olive green coat over a dark top and a gray plaid skirt. One arm is outstretched towards the viewer, presented in an exaggerated selfie angle, with a blurred thumb in the lower left foreground. In the background on the right is a tall man with messy black hair, wearing a soft beige coat over a light blue shirt. The faces are kept soft and blurred, or without features, represented only by warm skin-toned rectangular blocks, emphasizing atmosphere rather than portrait features. Use a clean white background, embellished with playful crayon-style doodles: Two leafy trees on the left, a blue car beneath them, a smiling yellow sun at the top center, a blue cloud near the top, a pink house with blue windows and a yellow striped awning in the upper right corner, a potted plant next to the house, a large yellow flower in the lower right corner, two pink tulips near the bottom, three outline hearts, four star doodles, and scattered plus signs, dots, and tiny wavy lines. The color scheme should be cheerful and soft, containing {argument name="main jacket color" default="Olive Green"} Beige, pink, cyan, yellow, blue, and orange accents. It presents a distinctly rough pastel texture, uneven sketch lines, hand-drawn brushstrokes, and naive decorative symbols, creating a warm and romantic everyday atmosphere. It rejects realism, has no hard shadows, no text, and no watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅温暖的 2.5D 平面手绘涂鸦插画，风格类似温柔的童话绘本或日记回忆，采用竖向人像构图，展示 {argument name="couple description" default="一对年轻情侣正在亲密自拍"}。画面中共有 2 位主角：左前方是一位留着深棕色波浪长发的女性，身穿橄榄绿大廓形外套，内搭深色上衣和灰色格子裙，一只手臂向观众伸出，呈现夸张的自拍视角，左下角前景有一个模糊的大拇指；右后方是一位个子较高的男性，留着凌乱的黑发，身穿米色柔软外套，内搭浅蓝色衬衫。保持面部柔和模糊或无五官，仅用温暖的肤色矩形色块代替，强调氛围而非肖像特征。使用干净的白色背景，并点缀俏皮的蜡笔风格涂鸦：左侧有 2 棵叶子茂密的树，树下有 1 辆蓝色小汽车，顶部中央有 1 个微笑的黄色太阳，顶部附近有 1 朵蓝色云彩，右上角有 1 栋带蓝色窗户和黄色条纹遮阳篷的粉色房子，房子旁有 1 盆盆栽，右下角有 1 朵巨大的黄色花朵，底部附近有 2 朵粉色郁金香，以及 3 个轮廓爱心、4 个星星涂鸦，并散布着加号、圆点和细小的波浪线。色调应欢快柔和，包含 {argument name="main jacket color" default="橄榄绿"}、米色、粉色、青色、黄色、蓝色和橙色点缀。呈现明显的粗糙粉彩质感、不均匀的草图线条、手绘笔触和稚拙的装饰符号，营造温馨浪漫的日常生活氛围，拒绝写实感，无硬阴影，无文字，无水印。

templates.prompt: Create a cheerful, 2.5D flat hand-drawn doodle illustration depicting a young couple posing for a heartwarming snapshot, like something out of a fairytale picture book. The background should be simple and bright, adorned with colorful crayon doodles, creating a soft and intimate atmosphere. In the foreground, the left side shows…{argument name="woman outfit" default="A young woman with long, dark brown wavy hair wore an olive green short jacket over a dark brown top, a black and white checkered shirt tied around her waist, a beige pleated skirt, and carried a large dark brown quilted shoulder bag."} She stood with one hand on her hip, her posture relaxed and confident. On the right, [she was] displaying {argument name="man outfit" default="A young man with messy black hair, wearing a light beige trench coat over a blue striped shirt."} He leaned forward, flashing a large "V" sign at the audience, his hand exaggerated in the foreground. Both men's faces were rendered without features or with a soft focus to preserve the texture of a photograph transformed into an illustration. The background contains 23 precisely placed visible graffiti elements: three trees (a blue fruit tree in the upper left, a smaller light green tree in the middle left, and a dark green tree behind the man); a radiant, smiling orange sun in the upper center; a yellow building in the upper right with a blue roof and a blue and white striped awning; and a sign that reads {argument name="cafe sign text" default="CAFE"} A blackboard cafe sign with lettering and pink hearts; a blue car on the left; three large hearts (one pink-outlined heart between a couple, and two pink hearts on the right); two blue stars (one on the center left and one on the bottom left); a yellow flower in the bottom left corner; a green leaf in the bottom right corner; a pink shrub on the left; a white cloud next to the car; and eight decorative small marks scattered around, composed of colored plus signs, dots, wavy lines, and short strokes. Using vibrant, childlike colors, bold, uneven marker outlines, soft crayon textures, slightly three-dimensional shadows on the figures, playful proportions, and rounded shapes, it creates a comfortable and romantic sunny day atmosphere, rejecting realism.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅欢快、2.5D 平面手绘风格的涂鸦插画，描绘一对年轻情侣像童话绘本里的温馨日常快照一样合影。场景背景简洁明亮，点缀着色彩缤纷的蜡笔涂鸦，营造出柔和亲密的生活氛围。在前景中，左侧展示 {argument name="woman outfit" default="一位留着深棕色长波浪卷发的年轻女性，身穿橄榄绿短款夹克，内搭深棕色上衣，腰间系着黑白格纹衬衫，下穿米色百褶裙，背着一个大型深棕色绗缝单肩包"}，她单手叉腰，姿态放松且自信。在右侧，展示 {argument name="man outfit" default="一位留着凌乱黑发的年轻男性，身穿浅米色风衣，内搭蓝色条纹衬衫"}，他身体前倾，向观众比出一个大大的“V”字手势，手部在前景中被夸张处理。两人面部均采用无五官或柔焦处理，以保留从抓拍照片转化为插画的质感。背景包含精确的 23 个可见涂鸦元素：3 棵树（左上角一棵青色果树、左中一棵较小的浅绿色树、男子身后一棵深绿色树）；1 个位于中上方、带有光芒的微笑橙色太阳；1 座位于右上角的黄色建筑，配有蓝色屋顶和蓝白条纹遮阳篷；1 个写有 {argument name="cafe sign text" default="CAFE"} 字样并带有粉色爱心的黑板咖啡馆招牌；左侧 1 辆蓝色小汽车；3 个大爱心（情侣之间一个粉色轮廓爱心，右侧两个粉色爱心）；2 颗蓝色星星（分别位于中左侧和左下侧）；左下角 1 朵黄色花朵；右下角 1 枝绿色叶子；左侧 1 丛粉色灌木；汽车旁 1 朵白色云朵；以及散落在周围的 8 个由彩色加号、圆点、波浪线和短笔触组成的装饰性小标记。采用生动的童趣色彩、粗犷不均匀的马克笔轮廓、柔和的蜡笔质感、人物身上略带立体感的阴影、俏皮的比例、圆润的形状，营造出舒适浪漫的晴天氛围，拒绝写实风格。

templates.title: Celestial Masters at the Star Chart Table

titleLocalized.zh: 星图桌前的天界法师

templates.prompt: Create a vertical anime/fantasy illustration with extremely rich detail, depicting a mysterious {argument name="character gender" default="young men"} The celestial mage sat before a magnificent table displaying cosmic star charts. He wore flowing, layered robes.{argument name="robe color" default="Midnight Blue and Black"} He wore a kimono-style robe embroidered with striking gold filigree, and adorned with dangling blue-gold earrings, a necklace, and delicate star-shaped jewelry. His disheveled dark hair billowed in the backlight, and his face was obscured by an opaque matte gray square at the center. The scene was set under a vast starry sky, with a turquoise aurora curtain, purple nebulae, distant mountains, and a huge circular golden star disk or celestial gate in the background. On the table, eight luminous miniature Earth-shaped glass spheres were drawn: a medium-sized sphere on the far left edge, a tiny purple-blue sphere to its right, a large sphere in the middle foreground on the left, a super-large sphere in the lower foreground on the left, a small sphere in the center rear, a large sphere in the center foreground at the bottom, a large sphere in the foreground on the right, and a small sphere in the far right rear; in addition, the mage delicately held a floating Earth sphere between his fingers in his right hand, for a total of nine Earth spheres. His left hand held a slender pointer wand, touching a bright golden star point in the center of the table, on which a map was engraved. The desktop is glossy and reflective, covered with intricate golden astronomical rings, constellation lines, orbital diagrams, runes, and a blue glowing grid pattern. It employs dramatic, cinematic lighting, deep navy blue shadows, electric cyan highlights, crisp gold accents, shimmering starlight, magical particles, high contrast, ultra-fine lines, painterly anime-style rendering, immersive depth of field, and a sophisticated fantasy main visual composition. The aspect ratio is 3:4.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张细节极其丰富的竖版动漫奇幻插画，描绘一位神秘的 {argument name="character gender" default="年轻男性"} 天界法师，他正坐在一张华丽的宇宙星图桌前。他身穿飘逸的层叠式 {argument name="robe color" default="午夜蓝与黑色"} 和服风格长袍，长袍上绣有醒目的金色花丝，佩戴着垂坠的蓝金耳环、项链以及精致的星形首饰。他凌乱的深色头发在逆光下随风飘动，面部被一个位于中心的不透明哑光灰色方块遮挡。场景设定在广袤的星空下，背景有绿松石色的极光幕帘、紫色的星云、远山以及一个巨大的圆形金色星盘或天界之门。在桌面上，绘制 8 个发光的微型地球状玻璃球：最左侧边缘有一个中型球体，其右侧有一个微小的紫蓝色球体，左侧中前景有一个大型球体，左下前景有一个超大型球体，中心后方有一个小型球体，底部中心前景有一个大型球体，右侧前景有一个大型球体，以及最右侧后方有一个小型球体；此外，法师右手手指间轻巧地托着 1 个悬浮的地球球体，总计 9 个地球球体。他的左手握着一根纤细的指针魔杖，触碰着刻有地图的桌子中央一个明亮的金星点。桌面光亮且具有反射感，上面覆盖着复杂的金色天文圆环、星座连线、轨道图、符文和蓝色发光网格图案。采用戏剧性的电影级灯光、深海军蓝阴影、电青色高光、清脆的金色点缀、闪烁的星光、魔法粒子，高对比度，超精细线条，绘画风动漫渲染，沉浸式景深，以及精致的奇幻主视觉构图。长宽比 3:4。

templates.title: Astrologer before the star chart

titleLocalized.zh: 星图前的星象术士

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed vertical fantasy anime illustration depicting a mysterious young male astrologer sitting at a cosmic divination table, with messy, wavy hair.{argument name="hair color" default="black"} His hair and face were deliberately concealed by a flat, dark charcoal gray square veil. He wore layered, flowing clothing.{argument name="robe color" default="Deep navy blue and cyan"} His robes, with their lustrous silk pleats, opulent gold embroidery, constellation motifs, dangling chains, blue gemstones, and celestial ornaments, were striking him. His left hand held a slender gold and black wand or pointer, pointing to the table, while his right hand touched a glowing astronomical ring. The table in the foreground was a dark star map surface, covered with intricate gold orbital plots, zodiacal rings, runes, shimmering stars, and blue light. The table and its surroundings should contain seven glassy, ​​Earth-shaped crystal spheres: a large, bright, luminous sphere in the center; a large, blurred sphere in the lower left foreground; a blurred sphere on the lower right edge; a medium-sized sphere in the lower right; a large sphere clipped to the right edge; a small sphere on the left side of the table; and a small sphere in the middle right background. Behind him, a vast, luminous galaxy of electric blue, cyan, violet, and deep indigo is displayed, accompanied by countless stars, nebulae, transparent star disk rings, suspended solar system instruments, and a bright halo of zodiacal signs behind his head. Two tall, dark, vertically hanging banners are added to either side of the background, each bearing luminous gold calligraphy: the text on the left banner {argument name="left banner text" default="Star Prayer"} The text on the right side of the banner{argument name="right banner text" default="Tenbyou Seisou"} Emphasizing dramatic blue rim lighting, prominent gold details, intricate lines, a magical atmosphere, high contrast, cinematic composition, ultra-detailed digital painting, and clean, refined rendering, sharpening and focusing on the hand and center spheres is required. Foreground spheres must have depth of field, and any modern objects are strictly prohibited.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅高度精细的竖版奇幻动漫插画，描绘一位神秘的年轻男性星象术士坐在宇宙占卜桌前，他留着凌乱的波浪状 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"} 头发，面部被一个扁平的深炭灰色方形遮挡块刻意隐藏。他身穿层次分明、飘逸的 {argument name="robe color" default="深海军蓝与青色"} 礼袍，带有光泽的丝绸褶皱、华丽的金色刺绣、星座图案、悬垂的链条、蓝色宝石和天体饰品。他的左手握着一根细长的金黑相间魔杖或指针，指向桌面，右手触碰着一个发光的天文圆环。前景的桌子是一张深色的星图表面，上面覆盖着精致的金色轨道图、黄道环、符文、闪烁的星点和蓝色光影。桌上及周围需包含 7 个玻璃质感的地球状水晶球：1 个位于中心的大型明亮发光球体，1 个位于左下角前景的模糊大球体，1 个位于右下边缘的模糊球体，1 个位于右下方中等大小的球体，1 个在右边缘被裁剪的大球体，1 个在桌子左侧的小球体，以及 1 个在中右侧背景处的小球体。在他身后，展示一片由电光蓝、青色、紫色和深靛色组成的浩瀚发光星系，伴有无数恒星、星云、透明的星盘环、悬挂的太阳系仪装置，以及他头后方一圈明亮的黄道标志光环。在背景两侧各添加 1 条高大的深色垂直悬挂横幅，上面带有发光的金色书法：左侧横幅文字 {argument name="left banner text" default="星文祈祀"}，右侧横幅文字 {argument name="right banner text" default="天氷星宗"}。强调戏剧性的蓝色轮廓光、突出的金色细节、复杂的线条、魔法氛围、高对比度、电影级构图、超精细数字绘画、干净精致的渲染，对手部和中心球体进行锐化对焦，前景球体需具备景深效果，严禁出现任何现代物品。

templates.title: Mecha toys anthropomorphized anime characters

titleLocalized.zh: 机甲玩具拟人化动漫形象

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the design theme, the robot model is transformed into a cute anime-style anthropomorphic girl, while retaining only her iconic color inspiration and mecha features: a dark green/brown coat, tan/grey uniform tones, claw/monster-like silhouette hints, and a glowing monocle-style badge. The toy/desktop background is replaced with a dramatic outdoor scene of a seaside shrine at sunset, with a large red torii pillar and the horizon visible in the background. A handheld black Canon-style camera is added to the character's hand, suggesting she is taking a picture. Two black curved horns with neon green glowing decorations, two small black bat wings, and short white/silver hair are added to the character; she wears a white shirt and grey pleated skirt, with a green cardigan over it, and white knee-high socks, the cardigan adorned with a glowing green badge on the chest. A simple beige square masking block is used to cover the character's face to hide her features. templates.title: Coffee shop portrait obscured photo

titleLocalized.zh: 咖啡馆肖像遮挡照片

templates.prompt: Create a realistic candid portrait of a young East Asian woman in a cozy café or lounge, using a 3:4 vertical composition, with the subject focusing on her chest and above. She has {argument name="hair color" default="Long straight black hair"} Her hair, with a soft, natural sheen and slightly disheveled, cascaded over her shoulders. Her face was deliberately obscured by a large, opaque, square privacy mask in the center, its soft brown-to-grayish-brown gradation completely concealing all facial features. She wore a loose-fitting top.{argument name="shirt color" default="White"} A crew-neck T-shirt with a colorful floral pattern on the chest. The background is soft-focused with warm ambient light; a golden wall is on the left, a neutral-toned shelf is in the upper right corner, and a brown leather or faux leather sofa is behind. Shallow depth of field, natural indoor lighting, realistic skin and hair textures, a DSLR portrait style, and soft bokeh create a relaxed and intimate atmosphere. A semi-transparent white watermark is added to the lower left corner with the text:{argument name="watermark text" default="Alconia"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一张年轻东亚女性在舒适咖啡馆或休息室内的写实抓拍肖像，采用 3:4 竖构图，取景范围为胸部以上。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="长直黑发"}，发丝带有柔和的自然光泽，略显凌乱，头发垂落在双肩。她的面部被一个位于中央的大型不透明方形隐私遮罩刻意遮挡，遮罩呈现柔和的棕色至灰褐色渐变，完全遮盖了所有面部特征。她穿着一件宽松的 {argument name="shirt color" default="白色"} 圆领 T 恤，胸前带有彩色花卉图案。背景经过柔焦处理，带有温暖的环境光，左侧为金黄色墙面，右上角为中性色调的搁架，身后是棕色皮革或人造革沙发。使用浅景深、自然室内光、写实的皮肤和头发质感、单反肖像风格、柔和的焦外成像，营造休闲亲密的氛围。在左下角添加一个半透明的白色水印，文字内容为 {argument name="watermark text" default="Alconia"}。
