templates.prompt: Create a{argument name="subject" default="A young East Asian woman"} A realistic close-up portrait of her, with a chin-length black bob and naturally soft skin, is shot in a 4:5 vertical composition, framing the upper body from the chest up. Her face is deliberately obscured by a large, opaque square with a soft brown gradient, positioned in the center, covering almost the entire face from forehead to chin, while leaving her hair, neck, shoulders, and clothing visible. She wears a black pleated textured shirt with subtle ruffles at the collar. Shot in dim, soft indoor lighting, the image has a shallow depth of field against a blurred, neutral beige-gray background. The cinematic realism technique is employed, presenting natural shadows, soft colors, subtle contrast, fine hair detail, and an emotionally intimate editing style. (Add in the lower left corner){argument name="watermark text" default="Alconia"} The text is used as a watermark in a bold, light gray sans-serif font.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 {argument name="subject" default="一位年轻东亚女性"} 的写实特写肖像，她留着齐下巴的黑色波波头，肤色自然柔和，采用 4:5 竖构图，取景范围从上半身胸部以上。她的面部被一个位于中心、带有柔和棕色渐变的巨大不透明方形遮挡块刻意遮盖，遮挡范围几乎覆盖了从额头到下巴的整个面部，同时保留了头发、颈部、肩膀和衣物可见。她身穿一件黑色褶皱纹理衬衫，领口带有细微的荷叶边设计，在昏暗柔和的室内光线下拍摄，具有浅景深效果，背景为模糊的中性米灰色。运用电影级写实手法，呈现自然阴影、柔和色彩、细腻对比度、精细发丝细节以及充满情绪感的亲密编辑风格。在左下角添加 {argument name="watermark text" default="Alconia"} 字样作为水印，使用粗体浅灰色无衬线字体。

templates.title: Anime-style Sky City fantasy scene

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫风天空之城奇幻场景

templates.prompt: Create a stunning, ultra-wide anime-style fantasy illustration depicting a dazzling sky city high above the clouds. This futuristic, magical floating metropolis comprises transparent glass platforms, glowing cyan holographic cubes, soft pixelated blocks, suspended towers, and a circular aerial bridge. Place [something] in the foreground.{argument name="main characters" default="Two anime boys and girls"} Have them stand with their backs to the camera on a glass prism platform, gazing at the vast world. The boy has short black hair and wears a white and blue jacket, shorts, and boots; the girl has long, flowing dark blue hair and wears a white dress with blue trim and softly glowing accessories. Place five eye-catching, adorable mascots around them in the foreground and background: a white kitten-like creature directly in front, a yellow-green rabbit-like creature at the bottom center, a pink bunny-cat creature on the right block, a pink dumpling creature on the left platform, and a small yellow floating creature near the right midground. Scatter at least 20 miniature anime adventurers throughout the platform and in the air, including winged characters, students, and miniature riders, and add four large floating crystal cubes visible in the sky and city. The environment should evoke the atmosphere of a cloud-based, fantastical MMO city center, with huge floating islands on the left and right sides, a magnificent circular tower in the upper right corner cascading vertical streams of light and water, smaller floating buildings in the distance, and shimmering orbital tracks, waterfalls of light, and sparkling particles winding through the air. use{argument name="color palette" default="Bright sky blue, cyan, white, lavender, and soft rainbow highlights"} Bright sunlight, massive, fluffy cumulus clouds, a clear, saturated blue sky, shimmering reflections, iridescent glass, soft halos, magical holographic UI fragments, and exquisite micro-details. Style:{argument name="art style" default="High-detail anime key visual, fantasy sci-fi concept art"} The expansive, cinematic composition, with a 16:9 aspect ratio, clear lines, and a painterly blend of light and shadow, creates a delightful sense of wonder. There is no text, no logo, and no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅令人惊叹的超宽幅动漫奇幻插画，描绘云端之上的璀璨天空之城。这是一座充满未来感的魔法浮空大都市，由透明玻璃平台、发光的青色全息立方体、柔和的像素块、悬浮塔楼和环形空中桥梁组成。在前景处，放置 {argument name="main characters" default="两位动漫少年，一男一女"}，让他们背对镜头站在玻璃棱镜平台上，眺望广阔的世界；男孩留着黑色短发，身穿白蓝相间夹克、短裤和靴子；女孩留着飘逸的深蓝色长发，身穿带有蓝色镶边的白色连衣裙，佩戴着柔和的发光饰品。在前景和近景处围绕他们放置 5 只醒目的可爱吉祥物：正前方是一只白色小猫状生物，底部中心是一只黄绿色兔状生物，右侧方块上是一只粉色兔猫生物，左侧平台上是一只粉色团子生物，右侧中景附近有一只黄色小型浮空生物。在平台各处及空中散布至少 20 位微型动漫冒险者，包括带翅膀的角色、学生和迷你骑手，并添加 4 个在天空和城市中可见的大型浮空水晶立方体。环境应呈现出云端欢乐奇幻 MMO 中心城的氛围，左右两侧有巨大的浮空岛，右上角有一座宏伟的圆形塔城，倾泻出垂直的光流和水流，远处有较小的悬浮建筑，空中蜿蜒着发光的轨道轨迹、光之瀑布和闪烁的粒子。使用 {argument name="color palette" default="明亮的天蓝色、青色、白色、薰衣草色和柔和的彩虹高光"}，高调日光，巨大的蓬松积云，清澈饱和的蓝天，闪烁的倒影，虹彩玻璃，柔和的光晕，魔法全息 UI 碎片，以及精致的微小细节。风格：{argument name="art style" default="高细节动漫主视觉图，奇幻科幻概念艺术"}，广阔的电影级构图，16:9 纵横比，清晰的线条与绘画感光影融合，充满愉悦的奇迹感，无文字，无 Logo，无水印。

templates.title: Crystal Sky City Anime Landscape

templates.prompt: Create a widescreen, cinematic-quality fantasy anime illustration depicting a dazzling sky city composed of translucent glass cubes, floating platforms, and suspended crystal structures, against a vibrant turquoise sky. In the foreground, two human children stand on the edge of square tiles: a boy with messy, dark short hair, wearing shorts, a backpack, and sneakers; a girl with a bob haircut, dressed in school uniform-style clothing and carrying a small shoulder bag. Both are shown from behind, gazing at the vast aerial world. Add a small, round, white robot or mascot beside them. The scene must contain 14 clearly visible small characters distributed across the platform and in the sky: a boy in the foreground, a girl in the foreground, a white mascot, a child wearing a helmet on the left, two children walking side-by-side on the left path, a child wearing a yellow hat in the center left, a child in white walking away from the center, a child wearing a green hat in the lower center, a traveler in a yellow cloak and pointed hat in the center right, a small orange sprite-like character floating in mid-air, a helmeted child suspended on the right, a character wearing a yellow bird-shaped hood in the lower right corner, and an orange hooded character cropped at the far right edge. The environment should include massive floating city towers, circular roads and bridges, stacked observatories in the distance, aerial tracks, glowing arcs, a waterfall cascading from a glass platform, hanging vines and greenery, transparent cyan and pink cubes, rainbow reflections, fluffy cumulus clouds weaving through the city, and tiny flying vehicles or birds.{argument name="art style" default="High-Detail Japanese Fantasy Anime Concept Art"} Employing a bright celluloid-style light and shadow, with vibrant cyan, sea blue, white, gold, and soft magenta as the main colors, it creates a magical utopian atmosphere, showcasing a grand scale, intricate background details, shimmering particles, sunlit clouds, volumetric light, clear lines, painterly textures, and an ultra-wide 16:9 composition, conveying a sense of awe and wonder. There is no text or watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅宽屏电影级奇幻动漫插画，展现一座由半透明玻璃立方体、浮空平台和悬浮水晶建筑组成的璀璨天空之城，背景是生动的青蓝色天空。前景中，两名人类儿童站在方块状的瓷砖边缘，一名男孩留着凌乱的深色短发，身穿短裤、背着背包并穿着运动鞋；一名女孩留着波波头，身穿校服风格的服装并背着小挎包。两人皆为背影，正凝视着广阔的空中世界。在他们身旁添加一个白色的小型圆润机器人或吉祥物。场景中需包含 14 个清晰可见的小人物，分布在平台和天空中：前景男孩、前景女孩、白色吉祥物、左侧戴头盔的儿童、左侧路径上并肩行走的两个小孩子、左中位置戴黄色帽子的小孩、中心位置背向行走的穿白衣儿童、中下位置戴绿色帽子的小孩、右中位置穿黄色斗篷戴尖顶帽的旅行者、半空中漂浮的小型橙色精灵状角色、右侧悬浮的戴头盔儿童、右下角戴黄色鸟形兜帽的角色，以及最右侧边缘被裁剪的橙色兜帽人物。环境应包含巨大的浮空城市塔楼、环形道路和桥梁、远处的堆叠式天文台、空中轨道、发光的弧线、从玻璃平台倾泻而下的瀑布、悬垂的藤蔓和绿植、透明的青色与粉色立方体、彩虹色的反射、穿梭于城市间的蓬松积云，以及微小的飞行载具或鸟类。使用 {argument name="art style" default="高细节日本奇幻动漫概念艺术"}，采用明亮的赛璐珞风格光影，色调以鲜艳的青色、海蓝色、白色、金色和柔和的洋红色为主，营造魔法乌托邦氛围，展现宏大的规模、复杂的背景细节、闪烁的粒子、阳光照射的云层、体积光、清晰的线条、绘画质感、超宽 16:9 构图，传达敬畏与惊叹之情，无文字，无水印。

titleLocalized.zh: Dark AI News 归档页面重新设计

The currently active top navigation item was set to {argument name="active navigation" default="アーカイブ"} And add a subtle yellow underline. Replace the simple list layout with a sophisticated, modern archive interface: add a large Hero card with a border, titled {argument name="page title" default="アーカイブ"} It is labeled with a small yellow icon.{argument name="eyebrow label" default="All articles"} Add a brief introductory text and a decorative gold eclipse/planetary glowing graphic to the right of the Hero card. Below, add a search bar and two compact dropdown menus for selecting time periods and sorting methods. Add eight category filter tags: すべて (subete), Claude, OpenAI, Google, Agents, ツール (taught), ニュース (news), 研究 (research), and その他 (other), highlighting "すべて" in yellow. Add a pagination control at the bottom, containing six elements: a previous page arrow, highlighted numbers 1, 2, 3, an ellipsis, 24, and a next page arrow. Keep the page centered and utilize ample spacing, thin borders, subtle gradients, glass-like cards, and perfect rendering of Japanese text.

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_1 as the source article page and REFERENCE_0 as the website branding/navigation reference, the article pages were redesigned with a sophisticated, modern dark-mode news UI while retaining the Japanese article theme and overall website identity. The header with the logo and navigation links was retained, but the article layout was widened and made more editorial: a "Back to Archive" link, category tags, dates, prominent headlines, short introductory paragraphs, and a wide, cinematic main image with a deep space/planetary glow theme were added. The article body was reformatted into clear sections with five visible section titles: "Claude Code No. 100," "Enhancement of Computing Resources and Part-Time Slip," "Update of Usage Regulations and Apology," "Updating of Functionality and Product Data," and "Future Outlook." Embedded UI enhancements were added, including a highlight tooltip/notation box, a quote box, a bulleted list, and a source link card at the bottom. Add a right sidebar containing four stacked cards: 1) "Key Points of This Notebook," containing five numbered summaries; 2) "Tags," containing six tags: Anthropic, Claude, Claude Code, Expert, Computing Resources, and Part-Timer Slip; 3) "Share," containing four share buttons/icons: Link, Twitter/X, Facebook, and Hatena Bookmark; 4) "Related Notes," containing four links to related articles and their dates. Use subtle borders, rounded corner cards, soft gray text, amber accent lines, and ample white space; retain the GitHub and news.smol.ai links in the footer.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_1 作为源文章页面，REFERENCE_0 作为网站品牌/导航参考，将文章页面重新设计为精致的现代深色模式新闻 UI，同时保留日语文章主题和整体网站标识。保留带有 Logo 和导航链接的页眉，但将文章布局加宽并使其更具编辑感：添加“返回归档”链接、分类标签、日期、醒目的大标题、简短的导语段落，以及带有深空/行星发光主题的宽幅电影感主图。将文章正文重新格式化为清晰的板块，包含 5 个可见的章节标题：「Claude Codeの発表」、「計算資源の強化とパートナーシップ」、「利用規約の更新と謝罪」、「機能・プロダクトのアップデート」以及「今後の展望」。添加内嵌 UI 增强功能，包括一个高亮提示/标注框、一个引用框、项目符号列表以及底部的来源链接卡片。添加一个右侧边栏，包含 4 个堆叠卡片：1) 「この記事の要点」，包含 5 个带编号的摘要要点；2) 「タグ」，包含 6 个标签，分别为 Anthropic、Claude、Claude Code、エージェント、計算資源、パートナーシップ；3) 「シェア」，包含 4 个分享按钮/图标，分别为链接、Twitter/X、Facebook 和 Hatena Bookmark；4) 「関連記事」，包含 4 个相关文章链接及日期。使用细微的边框、圆角卡片、柔和的灰色文本、琥珀色强调线条以及充足的留白；保留页脚的 GitHub 和 news.smol.ai 链接。

templates.title: Female student versus cathedral golem

templates.prompt: Create an epic, cinematic anime fantasy illustration in a 16:9 widescreen aspect ratio: A lonely {argument name="heroine description" default="A female student soldier with long black hair, wearing a white shirt, a black pleated skirt, black knee-high socks, and boots."} Standing with her back to the audience in the center of the foreground, her legs firmly planted on the cracked stone battlefield, she faces a colossal Gothic cathedral golem. The heroine wields a massive, serrated black and gold greatsword, its blade angled downwards to the right, inlaid with a luminous red crystal core. The colossal enemy is a towering humanoid fortress, constructed of ornate stone, bronze, gears, arches, spires, buttresses, carved panels, and cathedral windows; it possesses two enormous, curved arms ending in claw-like hands, two heavy shoulder towers, a chest resembling the facade of a cathedral, and a soaring crown-like spire atop its head, with two long red banners hanging from its upper torso. The low-angle shot and symmetrical composition create a stark contrast in scale between the heroine and the monster, emphasizing the sense of scale. The background is set in a desolate valley, filled with broken bricks, fractured pillars, distant towers, rubble, and jagged rocks.{argument name="time of day" default="Dramatic sunset"} The lighting features a brilliant golden sun positioned directly behind the female protagonist and beneath the golem's torso, strong orange rim lighting, a lens flare spanning the center of the frame, deep blue shadows, and luminous orange clouds scattered across a rich blue sky. Rendered in a highly detailed, modern anime-style concept art style, it presents complex architectural structures, oil painting-like clouds, sharp lines, and cinematic contrast, creating an ultra-wide, fantastical boss battle atmosphere. There is no text, no UI, and no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅史诗般的电影级动漫奇幻插画，采用 16:9 宽屏比例：一位孤独的 {argument name="heroine description" default="留着黑色长发的女学生战士，身穿白色衬衫、黑色百褶短裙、黑色过膝袜和靴子"} 背对观众站在前景中央，双腿稳稳地扎在布满裂痕的石质战场上，直面一尊巨大的哥特式大教堂魔像。女主角手持一把巨大的锯齿状黑金大剑，剑身向下倾斜于右侧，剑刃上镶嵌着发光的红色水晶核心。巨大的敌人是一个巍峨的人形堡垒，由华丽的石材、青铜、齿轮、拱门、尖塔、扶壁、雕刻面板和大教堂窗户构成；它拥有两只巨大的弯曲手臂，末端为爪状手，两个厚重的肩部塔楼，胸部中心如同大教堂的正面，头顶有一个高耸的皇冠状尖塔，上躯干垂下两条长长的红色旗帜。通过低机位拍摄和对称构图，将女主角与怪物进行极大的比例对比，以强调规模感。背景设定在荒废的山谷中，到处是破碎的砖石、断裂的柱子、远处的塔楼、瓦砾和嶙峋的岩石。使用 {argument name="time of day" default="戏剧性的日落"} 灯光，灿烂的金色太阳直接位于女主角身后和魔像躯干下方，强烈的橙色轮廓光，镜头光晕横跨画面中心，深蓝色的阴影，以及散布在浓郁蓝天中的发光橙色云彩。采用细节丰富的现代动漫概念艺术风格渲染，呈现复杂的建筑结构、油画质感的云层、锐利的线条、电影级的对比度，营造出超宽幅的奇幻 Boss 战氛围，无文字、无 UI、无水印。

The pose is elegant, one hand raised near the collarbone, the other relaxed naturally outward, legs crossed in a refined stance. Employing a clean, high-end visual novel character art style, the gown features sharp lines, soft cel shadows, glossy highlights, delicate fabric pleats, a subtly patterned semi-transparent blue lining, elegant proportions, and a design reminiscent of a sophisticated fantasy RPG heroine.

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the manga storyboard sketch, it was transformed into a crisp black-and-white manga page, featuring elegant lines, halftone shading, and clean rectangular panel frames. The same 5-panel story structure and visible circular panel numbers were maintained: Panel 1 is a landscape scene including mountains, houses, a small car, and a cheerful woman leaning out from the right and waving; Panel 2 shows a small car driving; Panel 3 shows a small bird with a camera-like beak; Panel 4 shows a broadcaster holding a microphone at a street food stall; Panel 5 shows the woman standing in front of a large explosion. The original layout order and intended character/object positions were preserved, but rendered in a finished manga art style. The faces in Panels 4 and 5 were intentionally blurred with soft gray rectangles. Japanese text was added to the stall's awning.{argument name="stall sign text" default="ラテスカーどっぐ"} The page must be black and white, highly detailed, and in a printable format, with dynamic speed lines and explosion effects added as instructed.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 作为漫画分镜草图，将其转化为一张清晰的黑白漫画页面，包含精美的线条、网点纸阴影以及利落的矩形分镜框。保持相同的 5 格故事结构和可见的圆形分镜编号：第 1 格为包含山脉、房屋、小型汽车以及一名从右侧探身挥手的开朗女性的风景画面；第 2 格为一辆小型汽车在行驶；第 3 格为一只长着相机状鸟喙的小鸟；第 4 格为一名播音员在街头小吃摊旁手持麦克风；第 5 格为该女性站在一场大爆炸前。保留原始的布局顺序和预期的角色/物体位置，但以成品漫画艺术风格进行渲染。将第 4 格和第 5 格中的面部特意用柔和的灰色矩形模糊处理。在摊位遮阳棚上添加日语文字 {argument name="stall sign text" default="ラテスカーどっぐ"}。页面需为黑白、高细节、可印刷格式，并根据指示添加动态速度线和爆炸效果。

templates.title: Satirical Anime Photography Girl

titleLocalized.zh: 讽刺风格动漫摄影少女

templates.prompt: Create a single-panel anime-style social media illustration set in a bright, modern Japanese city street, similar to Shibuya or a bustling commercial district. The background includes colorful shop signs, blurred pedestrians, trees, and a clear blue sky. The foreground features a half-body portrait of a young female photographer holding a large, black Sony-style mirrorless camera with a wide lens pointed directly at the viewer, the camera strap hanging around her neck. She has a short, layered blonde bob with side-swept bangs, small earrings, and wears a beige cable-knit cardigan over a grey and white plaid shirt. Her face is deliberately obscured by a flat, opaque rectangular skin tone mask, centered on her face. Use delicate Japanese anime/manga lines, with clear outlines, bright highlights, and high color saturation to create a slightly satirical, comedic atmosphere. Includes two white cartoon-style speech bubbles with bold black outlines: the larger bubble on the left contains text {argument name="left speech bubble text" default="Cameras are all focused on high ISO performance, and you're still showing off your large aperture lens? How amusing! ♥"} It features a small flashing icon and a pink heart; the smaller speech bubble in the upper right corner is {argument name="right speech bubble text" default="You'll end up putting on an ND filter anyway, right?"} Add some decorative glitter symbols around the dialogue and in the lower right corner. The image is in a 16:9 aspect ratio, with the camera and characters occupying the left and center of the frame, and speech bubbles in the upper left and upper right corners. The city background is appropriately blurred to ensure that the visual focus is on the characters and dialogue.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张单格动漫风格的社交媒体插画，背景设定在明亮现代的日本城市街道，类似于涩谷或繁华的商业区，背景包含色彩缤纷的店面招牌、虚化的行人、树木以及湛蓝的天空。前景展示一位半身像的年轻女性摄影师，她正拿着一台硕大的黑色 Sony 风格无反相机，镜头宽大且对准观众，相机背带挂在脖子上。她留着短款金色波波头，发尾层次分明，留着斜刘海，戴着小耳环，身穿米色麻花针织开衫，内搭灰白格纹衬衫。她的脸部被一个平面的不透明矩形肤色遮挡块刻意遮住，遮挡块位于脸部中心。采用精致的日本动漫/漫画线条，轮廓清晰，高光亮丽，色彩饱和度高，呈现出一种略带调侃的喜剧氛围。包含 2 个带有粗黑轮廓的白色漫画对话气泡：左侧较大的气泡文字为 {argument name="left speech bubble text" default="相机都在拼高感光度了，你还在炫耀大光圈镜头，真有意思♥"}，并带有小闪光图标和粉色爱心；右上角较小的气泡文字为 {argument name="right speech bubble text" default="反正你最后还是会装上 ND 滤镜吧？"}。在对话周围和右下角添加一些装饰性的闪光符号。图像采用 16:9 的宽幅比例，相机和角色占据画面中左侧和中心位置，对话气泡位于左上角和右上角，城市背景进行适当虚化，以确保视觉焦点集中在角色和对话上。

templates.title: Alien lakes and spaceship landscapes

titleLocalized.zh: 外星湖泊与宇宙飞船景观

templates.prompt: At dusk on a distant planet, a cinematic, ultra-detailed sci-fi alien landscape unfolds: a massive, streamlined, futuristic spaceship skims low over a mirror-like, tranquil lake from left to right. Its long, dark metal hull is adorned with intricately layered armor plates, vents, portholes, exposed mechanical ribs, shimmering blue-violet lights, and glowing engine details. The lake reflects the entire spaceship, the soft sky, and a large, pinkish-purple ringed planet occupying the upper right, with two small moons nearby. The nebulous sky displays shades of cyan, indigo, lavender, and magenta. In the foreground, a rocky alien coastline is covered in lush, bioluminescent extraterrestrial vegetation: purple grasses, blue moss, glowing spherical flower tips, tiny glowing flowers, and translucent shrubs. In the midground, towering cliffs jut out to the horizon, with multiple slender waterfalls cascading into a misty basin. Thin wisps of mist float on the water, and layered mountain ranges stretch into the distance. The lighting is both dreamlike and realistic, featuring soft sunrise/sunset hues, sharp reflections, volumetric fog, high dynamic range, exquisite environmental detail, wide-angle composition, and an epic scale. It's in a 16:9 aspect ratio, with no text or figures. The scene can be customized using the following parameters:{argument name="spaceship color" default="Dark gunmetal gray with blue-violet light"} ,{argument name="planet color" default="pinkish-purple"} ,{argument name="alien plant color palette" default="Bioluminescence in purple, blue, lavender, and cyan"} ,{argument name="time of day" default="dusk"} as well as{argument name="overall style" default="Cinematic Realistic Space Opera Concept Art"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 遥远星球黄昏时分，电影级超精细科幻外星景观：一艘巨大的流线型未来派宇宙飞船正从左至右低空掠过一面如镜般的静谧湖泊，其修长的深色金属船体上覆盖着错综复杂的层叠装甲板、通风口、舷窗、外露的机械肋条、闪烁的蓝紫色灯光以及发光的引擎细节。湖面映照出整艘飞船、柔和的天空，以及占据右上方的巨大粉紫色带环行星，附近还有两颗小卫星，星云密布的天空呈现青色、靛蓝、薰衣草色和洋红色。前景是岩石嶙峋的外星海岸线，覆盖着茂密的生物发光地外植物：紫色草丛、蓝色苔藓、发光的球形花尖、微小的发光花朵和晶莹剔透的灌木。中景处，高耸的悬崖横跨地平线，多条细长的瀑布倾泻入雾气缭绕的盆地，薄雾在水面漂浮，层峦叠嶂的山脉向远方延伸。光影梦幻且写实，带有柔和的日出/日落色调、清晰的倒影、体积雾、高动态范围、极致的环境细节、广角构图、史诗般的规模，16:9 纵横比，无文字，无人物。可通过以下参数自定义场景：{argument name="spaceship color" default="带有蓝紫色灯光的深枪灰色"}、{argument name="planet color" default="粉紫色"}、{argument name="alien plant color palette" default="紫色、蓝色、薰衣草色和青色的生物发光"}、{argument name="time of day" default="黄昏"} 以及 {argument name="overall style" default="电影级写实太空歌剧概念艺术"}。

templates.title: Neon Midnight Anime Street Style Girl

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹午夜动漫街头风少女

templates.prompt: Create a vibrant, anime-style full-body illustration depicting a stylish young woman strolling through a futuristic neon city at midnight. The subject should be centered, appearing to float or walk in mid-air, with one knee bent and one boot extending downwards. She possesses exceptionally long, flowing {argument name="hair color" default="Black hair with a gradient of violet and bright pink at the ends."} Her hair, with its glossy highlights, flows to the right in the wind; her face is softened, creating a blurred, almost indistinct effect. She is dressed in a white cropped sleeveless shirt, a loose black bomber jacket that slips off her shoulder (with pink lace detailing on one sleeve), black cargo jogging pants (with pockets, straps, a belt, and silver chain accessories), purple thigh straps, white slouch socks, and thick-soled black lace-up boots. Punk streetwear accessories are added: rings, bracelets, earrings, and small metal embellishments. The background is a deep purple night sky, scattered with luminous particles like snowflakes or urban sparks, softly blurred lighting, and five striking neon sign elements: a tall, round, pink Japanese-style sign on the left, a vertical pink Japanese-style letter sign near the center below, and a tall pink sign to the right behind her, one that reads…{argument name="cyan sign text" default="GUNAD"} The vertical cyan signboard and the building signboard at the bottom foreground, composed of bright cyan and pink horizontal stripes. Using saturated magenta, violet, cyan, and electric blue lighting, with strong contour lighting on the hair and jacket edges, and employing crisp cel animation rendering, clean line art, glowing gradients, and cinematic depth of field, a dynamic urban nighttime atmosphere is created. Overall Atmosphere:{argument name="mood" default="Cool, dreamy, and rebellious midnight fashion"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张充满活力的动漫风格全身插画，描绘一位时尚少女在午夜漫步于未来感霓虹城市中，主体居中，呈现漂浮或半空迈步的姿态，一膝弯曲，一只靴子向下延伸。她拥有极长的飘逸 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色头发，发梢带有紫罗兰色和亮粉色渐变"}，带有光泽感的高光，发丝随风向右飘动；她的面部经过柔化处理，呈现出类似隐私模糊的无五官效果。为她穿上白色短款无袖衬衫、滑落肩头的宽松黑色飞行员夹克（一侧袖子带有粉色系带细节）、黑色工装慢跑裤（带有口袋、绑带、腰带和银色链条配饰）、紫色大腿绑带、白色堆堆袜以及厚底黑色系带靴。添加朋克街头风饰品：戒指、手链、耳环和小型金属装饰。背景为深紫色夜空，散布着如雪花或城市火花般的发光颗粒、柔和的虚化灯光，以及五个醒目的霓虹灯招牌元素：左侧一个高大的圆形粉色日式招牌，下方中心附近一个垂直的粉色日式文字招牌，她身后右侧一个高大的粉色招牌，一个写着 {argument name="cyan sign text" default="GUNAD"} 的青色垂直招牌，以及前景底部由明亮的青色和粉色横条组成的建筑招牌。采用饱和的洋红色、紫罗兰色、青色和电光蓝灯光，头发和夹克边缘带有强烈的轮廓光，使用清晰的赛璐珞动漫渲染、利落的线条艺术、发光渐变、电影级景深，营造出动态的都市夜晚氛围。整体氛围：{argument name="mood" default="酷炫、梦幻、叛逆的午夜时尚"}。

templates.title: Glowing butterfly marionette girl

titleLocalized.zh: 发光的蝴蝶提线木偶少女

templates.prompt: Create a dark, cinematic, anime-style portrait of a person.{argument name="subject" default="Young marionette woman"} She sat upright like a suspended puppet, the composition employing a vertical framing from head to thigh. She had short, curly hair, the color of which was {argument name="hair color" default="Dark blue hair with warm copper tips"} She had a slender neck and bare shoulders, and wore a light-colored ruffled dress.{argument name="dress style" default="Lolita ballet tutu"} The figure features puffy, sheer sleeves, a corset, a ruffled neckline, and a multi-layered skirt. Her face is deliberately obscured by a centrally located opaque black square, making her identity both anonymous and unsettling. Four long black ribbons hang vertically from the top of the frame, encircling her body; two cross on the left and two hang straight on the right, emphasizing her manipulated state. Dozens of luminous, golden butterfly-shaped lights are scattered across the skirt, concentrated on the corset, waist, and hem, casting a warm amber glow onto the translucent fabric and her skin. A melancholic, turquoise studio background with soft vignetting creates a striking contrast between cool shadows and warm butterfly lights, resulting in a dreamlike, volumetric, misty effect. Rim lighting is used on the hair and shoulders, employing a painterly, semi-realistic anime-style rendering to showcase the delicate fabric textures, creating a melancholic atmosphere and incorporating the emotional theme.{argument name="theme phrase" default="I thought I was free."} The image contains no visible text, no extra characters, and no other scene besides the dark background.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张黑暗、电影质感的动漫风格肖像，主角为一位 {argument name="subject" default="年轻的提线木偶女性"}，她像被悬挂的木偶一样端坐着，构图采用从头部到大腿的竖向取景。她留着短卷发，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="深青色发梢带暖铜色"}，有着纤细的脖颈和裸露的肩膀，身穿一件浅色荷叶边 {argument name="dress style" default="洛丽塔芭蕾舞裙"}，配有蓬松的透明袖子、紧身胸衣、褶皱领口和多层裙摆。她的脸部被一个居中的不透明黑色方块刻意遮挡，使其身份显得匿名且令人不安。四根长长的黑色提线从画面顶部垂直垂下，环绕在她的身体周围，其中两根在左侧交叉，两根在右侧直垂，强调她正处于被操控的状态。裙子上布满了数十个发光的金色蝴蝶状灯光，集中在胸衣、腰部和裙摆处，将温暖的琥珀色光芒投射在半透明的织物上以及她的皮肤上。使用忧郁的青绿色摄影棚背景，带有柔和的暗角效果，冷色调阴影与暖色调蝴蝶光芒形成强烈对比，营造出梦幻的体积雾感，头发和肩膀处有轮廓光，采用绘画感半写实动漫渲染风格，展现细腻的织物纹理，营造忧郁的氛围，并融入情感主题“{argument name="theme phrase" default="我以为我自由了"}”。画面中不包含任何可见文字，无多余字符，深色背景之外无其他场景。

templates.title: Melancholy Puppet Watercolor Painting

titleLocalized.zh: 忧郁木偶水彩画

templates.prompt: Create a melancholic monochrome watercolor illustration on textured, off-white paper: a fragile young puppet woman sits upright with her knees together, revealing her torso from thighs to head, suspended by six thin, vertical puppet strings—three on the left and three on the right—extending beyond the top edge of the paper. She wears a tattered, sleeveless lace dress in a color {argument name="dress color" default="Water-washed charcoal gray"} The shoulders, neckline, waist, and hem were adorned with torn, floral ruffles. Her posture was limp and submissive, her shoulders slightly drooping, her arms hanging at her sides, as if controlled by strings. Designed for her{argument name="hair color" default="Soft grayish white"} Her messy short hair was loosely tied into a tangled side bun, with stray strands and blurred watercolor edges. Using a flat, opaque {argument name="face censor color" default="Medium gray"} A square masking the face, centered over the facial area, creates an anonymous and unsettling atmosphere. Delicate, ink-like pencil lines outline the rope and contours, layered with gray wash effects, grainy paint, smudges, paper stains, and watercolor drips, with splatter textures added around the body. The background remains largely blank, featuring pale gray washed-out clouds and vertical dripping effects, emphasizing loneliness, a sense of control, and the puppet's self-perceived freedom coupled with its inability to control its own destiny. The image contains no readable text, no borders, no vibrant colors, and is not in a realistic photographic style.

promptLocalized.zh: 在纹理质感的灰白色纸张上创作一幅忧郁的单色水彩插画：一位脆弱的年轻木偶女性正面端坐，双膝并拢，露出从大腿到头部的躯干，由 6 根垂直的细木偶线悬挂，左侧 3 根，右侧 3 根，线条延伸至画纸上边缘之外。她穿着一件破旧的蕾丝风格无袖连衣裙，颜色为 {argument name="dress color" default="水洗炭灰色"}，肩部、领口、腰部和裙摆处饰有撕裂的碎花褶边。她的姿态无力而顺从，双肩微微下垂，双臂垂在身体两侧，仿佛被绳线操控。为她设计 {argument name="hair color" default="柔和灰白色"} 的凌乱短发，松散地挽成一个蓬乱的侧发髻，带有散落的发丝和模糊的水彩边缘。用一块平整且不透明的 {argument name="face censor color" default="中灰色"} 正方形遮盖面部，居中覆盖在脸部区域，营造出一种匿名且令人不安的氛围。使用细腻的墨水质感铅笔线条勾勒绳线和轮廓，叠加灰色水洗效果、颗粒感颜料、晕染、纸张污渍、水彩滴落痕迹，并在身体周围添加喷溅纹理。背景保持大面积留白，带有淡灰色水洗云雾和垂直滴落效果，强调孤独感、控制感以及木偶自以为自由却身不由己的情绪。画面中无任何可读文字，无边框，无鲜艳色彩，非写实摄影风格。

templates.title: Embroidery Queen Tarot Card Cockatoo

titleLocalized.zh: 刺绣皇后塔罗牌凤头鹦鹉

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed, photorealistic macro photograph showcasing a magnificent hand-embroidered artwork displayed on a round wooden embroidery hoop on a rustic wooden craft table. The embroidery pattern is a tarot-inspired portrait, the subject of which is {argument name="animal subject" default="A pink cockatoo"} identity is{argument name="tarot title" default="The Empress"} The bird sits proudly on a luxurious red and gold throne, wearing a jeweled gold crown adorned with red, yellow, and white feathers, a delicate ruby ​​necklace, and holding a golden scepter. The tapestry background is a warm antique gold, embroidered with clouds, rolling wheat fields, distant green mountains, a blue river, bouquets of flowers beside the throne, and a magnificent border of vine patterns. Roman numerals are inscribed at the top.{argument name="roman numeral" default="III"} The banner at the bottom reads{argument name="banner text" default="THE EMPRESS"} Below the throne is a heart-shaped shield embroidered with a golden Venus symbol. The embroidery should appear realistic and three-dimensional, showing satin stitch, chain stitch, French knots, metallic gold thread, raised stitch texture, and subtle variations in fiber direction. Real craft items are arranged around the embroidery hoop: a cardboard tray in the upper left corner with 12 visible spools of embroidery thread in colors including red, pink, yellow, white, olive green, dark green, gray, black, brown, rust red, tan, and cream; three loose bundles of embroidery thread in the lower left corner in peach, coral pink, and green; a paper color chart at the top with six heart-shaped sewn color samples labeled 742, 744, 745, 783, 780, and 3853; a pair of antique gold scissors in the upper right corner; a metal thimble; a small round brass bowl with a pincushion; and several strands of gold and peach thread scattered near the lower right edge. Using warm, natural window light and shallow depth of field, the focus is clearly on the embroidery hoop, creating a comfortable artisan workspace atmosphere. Soft earth tones are used to present hyper-realistic textile details, avoiding a digital illustration feel.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高度精细的照片级微距摄影作品，展示放置在质朴木制工艺桌上的圆形木质绣绷中的华丽手工刺绣艺术品。刺绣图案是一幅受塔罗牌启发的肖像，主角是 {argument name="animal subject" default="一只粉红凤头鹦鹉"}，身份为 {argument name="tarot title" default="皇后 (THE EMPRESS)"}：这只鸟高贵地坐在红金相间的豪华宝座上，头戴饰有红、黄、白羽毛的珠宝金冠，颈戴精致的红宝石项链，手持金色权杖。挂毯背景为温暖的古金色，绣有云朵、起伏的麦田、远处的青山、一条蓝色小河、宝座旁的鲜花束、华丽的蔓藤花纹边框，顶部标有罗马数字 {argument name="roman numeral" default="III"}，底部横幅写有 {argument name="banner text" default="THE EMPRESS"}。在宝座前下方包含一个心形盾牌，上面绣有金色的维纳斯符号。刺绣应看起来真实且具有立体感，可见缎面绣、锁链绣、法式结、金属金线、凸起的线迹纹理以及纤维方向的细微变化。在绣绷周围摆放真实的工艺用品：左上角有一个纸板托盘，放着 12 个可见的绣花线轴，颜色包括红、粉、黄、白、橄榄绿、深绿、灰、黑、棕、铁锈红、棕褐色和奶油色；左下角有 3 束松散的绣花线，颜色为桃色、珊瑚粉和绿色；顶部有一张纸质色卡，上面有 6 个心形缝制色样，分别标注为 742、744、745、783、780 和 3853；右上角有一把复古金剪刀；一个金属顶针；一个装有针插的小圆形黄铜碗；右下边缘附近散落着几根金线和桃色线。使用温暖的自然窗光，浅景深，焦点清晰地对准绣绷，营造舒适的工匠工作空间氛围，采用柔和的大地色调，呈现超写实的纺织细节，避免数字插画感。

templates.title: Embroidered style cozy little bird living room

titleLocalized.zh: 刺绣风温馨小鸟客厅

templates.prompt: Create a highly realistic macro photograph showcasing a finished hand embroidery, housed in a round wooden embroidery hoop and placed on a rustic wooden craft table. The embroidery is presented on natural beige linen, depicting a warm living room scene. The embroidery should possess tactile and three-dimensional qualities, displaying clear satin stitch, long and short stitches, French knots, raised stitch texture, subtle imperfections, and the warm charm of handcrafted art. The scene includes eight embroidered birds: one large {argument name="main bird species" default="Yellow cockatiel"} Seated in a plush red armchair with knitting needles, a blue and white budgie nestles beside her reading a miniature illustration magazine. Two small birds perch on a wooden stool in the background, while two others sit together reading on a blue sofa. A green and orange lovebird stands in the lower right corner holding a pink handheld vacuum cleaner with subtle blue lines. A black and gray crested bird is located at the bottom center. The miniature embroidery room includes a red armchair, a blue sofa, a wooden stool, a desk with miniature bottles, two wall paintings, a potted plant, hanging plants, a small orange pendant lamp, pink curtains, a sketch-style window, a few musical notes, and finely drawn pencil-like sketch lines visible on the fabric. Realistic embroidery supplies are arranged around the embroidery hoop: a wooden tray with pastel spools of thread in the upper left corner, a paper thread color swatch in the upper right corner, ornate embroidery scissors on the right, needles and a metal thimble in the lower right corner, green embroidery thread at the bottom, and a small note with handwritten Japanese characters in the lower left corner. Using warm natural sunlight and a shallow depth of field, the embroidery hoop is clearly in focus, creating a cozy craft room atmosphere. The rustic color palette and whimsical style make the entire illustration appear as if it were embroidered from text prompts.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高度逼真的微距摄影作品，展示一个装在圆形木制绣花绷子里的成品手工刺绣，放置在质朴的木制工艺桌上，绣面是在天然米色亚麻布上呈现的温馨客厅场景。刺绣应具有触感和立体感，展现出清晰的缎面绣、长短针、法式结、凸起的线迹纹理、细微的瑕疵以及温暖的手工魅力。场景中包含 8 只绣制的小鸟：一只大型 {argument name="main bird species" default="黄色玄凤鹦鹉"} 坐在毛绒红色扶手椅上拿着织针，一只蓝白相间的虎皮鹦鹉依偎在旁边阅读一本微型插画杂志，两只小鸟栖息在背景的木凳上，两只小鸟坐在一起在蓝色沙发上阅读，一只绿橙相间的爱情鸟站在右下角拿着一个粉色手持吸尘器，带有蓝色的小动作线条，还有一只黑色和灰色相间的小冠鸟位于底部中心。微型刺绣房间包括一张红色扶手椅、一张蓝色沙发、一张木凳、一张放着微型瓶子的书桌、两幅墙上挂画、一盆盆栽、悬挂的植物、一盏橙色小吊灯、粉色窗帘、素描风格的窗户、几个音符，以及布料上可见的类似铅笔勾勒的精细草图线条。在绣花绷子周围摆放逼真的刺绣用品：左上角放着一盘粉彩线轴的木托盘，右上角放着一张纸质线色卡，右侧放着华丽的刺绣剪刀，右下角放着针和金属顶针，底部放着绿色绣花线，左下角放着一张带有日文手写字迹的小便签。采用温暖的自然日光，浅景深，绣花绷子焦点清晰，营造出温馨的工艺室氛围，色调质朴，风格奇趣迷人，使整幅插画看起来就像是由文本提示词刺绣而成的一样。

templates.title: Holographic Cockatiel Embroidery Band

titleLocalized.zh: 全息玄凤鹦鹉刺绣绷

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic overhead close-up showcasing a hand-embroidered piece within a circular wooden embroidery hoop against a warm wooden craft table. The hoop is lined with beige linen, and at its center is a completed 3D satin embroidered cockatiel angel mascot: an adorable, rounded yellow cockatiel with orange cheek spots, glossy black beaded eyes, a pink beak, a cream-colored belly, grey and white wings, brown outlines, pink claws, and a towering crest. Behind the bird is an iridescent holographic glow embroidered with dense metallic thread, displaying pale blue, aquamarine, lavender, silver, mint green, and yellow hues, resembling a collector's sticker background. Add 12 gold star patterns: 3 integrated around the top title text, and 9 scattered within the holographic glow. At the top of the hoop, the upper left corner is embroidered with the small black lettering "NO.001," the upper right corner with "ホログラム," and below is a striking red 3D Japanese logo.{argument name="main logo text" default="ビックリマン"} It features a black and gold outline, below which are rounded pink and gold two-tone three-dimensional characters.{argument name="subtitle text" default="オカメエンジェル"} The presentation showcases details of the embroidery process: Pale blue sketch lines are faintly visible on the right side of the fabric; a loose, pale yellow embroidery thread and a needle lie on the right side of the embroidery hoop; a small reference card with the same cockatiel design is located in the lower right corner; a pincushion filled with colorful pins sits at the bottom edge; a small gold embroidery scissors and a metal thimble are placed at the bottom center; and numerous neatly wrapped bundles of embroidery thread surround the embroidery hoop, bearing visible numbered labels such as 753, 725, 676, 231, 225, 232, 153, and 310. The photography utilizes warm, natural studio lighting, shallow depth of field, clear macro fabric details, visible stitch textures, realistic shadows, handcrafted aesthetics, a Japanese vintage sticker card style, and a square composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张照片级逼真的俯视特写，展示一个圆形木质绣绷中的手工刺绣作品，背景为温暖的木质手工桌。绣绷内为米色亚麻布，中心是一个完成的立体缎面绣玄凤鹦鹉天使吉祥物：一只可爱圆润的黄色玄凤鹦鹉，带有橙色脸颊圆斑、光泽的黑色珠状眼睛、粉色喙、奶油色腹部、灰白相间的翅膀、棕色轮廓线、粉色爪子以及高耸的冠羽。鸟儿身后是采用致密金属线绣出的虹彩全息风格光芒，呈现淡蓝、水绿、薰衣草紫、银色、薄荷绿和黄色，宛如收藏级贴纸的背景。添加 12 个金色星星图案：3 个整合在顶部标题文字周围，9 个散布在全息光芒中。在绣绷顶部，左上角绣上黑色小字“NO.001”，右上角绣上“ホログラム”，下方是一个醒目的红色立体日文标志 {argument name="main logo text" default="ビックリマン"}，带有黑色和金色轮廓，其下方是圆润的粉金双色立体文字 {argument name="subtitle text" default="オカメエンジェル"}。展示刺绣过程的细节：布料右侧隐约可见淡蓝色草图线，绣绷右侧放着一根松散的淡黄色绣线和一枚针，右下角有一张印有相同玄凤鹦鹉设计的小型参考卡，底部边缘有一个插满彩色大头针的针插，底部中心放着一把金色小绣剪和一个金属顶针，绣绷周围环绕着许多整齐缠绕的绣线束，可见 753、725、676、231、225、232、153 和 310 等编号标签。采用温暖的自然摄影棚灯光，浅景深，清晰的微距织物细节，可见的线迹纹理，逼真的阴影，手工制作美学，日式怀旧贴纸卡片风格，方形构图。

templates.title: Anime AI Plaza Makeup Scene

titleLocalized.zh: Anime AI Plaza 化妆场景

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic, anime-style illustration set in a bright outdoor plaza, with a modern white university or municipal building in the foreground, and a clear blue sky dotted with clouds. Place a large italicized title at the very top of the image.{argument name="headline text" default="Let’s make up!"} The lettering is white with a bold dark blue outline. The building facade features two striking blue sections: the larger section at the top reads {argument name="main sign text" default="AI Plaza"} Below is a line of smaller text: "Minna no AI, Minna no Mirai."; below that is a dimly lit digital screen displaying "Mirai wo Chuangru no wa, Watashitachi da."; above is a glowing network globe labeled "AI." In the foreground, two young men are shown sideways, facing each other, very close together: the man on the left has {argument name="left man's hair" default="Short, slicked-back light brown hair"} The man in the dark shirt and black jacket reached out with both hands toward the other person's face; the man on the right had {argument name="right man's hair" default="Messy dark brown hair"} The two figures, dressed in dark green long-sleeved shirts, reach out to the face of the man on their left. Their hands are pressed against each other's cheeks, as if applying makeup or making up during a tense yet humorous public demonstration. Their faces are deliberately obscured by large areas of soft, skin-toned blurring, while the faces of several onlookers in the background are also slightly blurred. Behind them, a group of office workers and students in suits and casual wear are depicted, some holding smartphones, observing the scene in front of the AI ​​Plaza. The artwork employs exquisite Japanese anime-style rendering, sharp lines, cinematic composition, expressive hand anatomy, dynamic close-up perspectives, saturated sunlight colors, and richly detailed architectural structures.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅戏剧性的动漫风格插画，背景设定在明亮的户外广场，前方是一座现代化的白色大学或市政建筑，天空湛蓝，云朵点缀。在画面最上方，放置一个巨大的斜体标题 {argument name="headline text" default="Let’s make up!"}，白色字体配以粗体深蓝色轮廓。在建筑立面上，包含两块醒目的蓝色项目：上方的大型项目写着 {argument name="main sign text" default="AI広場"}，下方附有一行较小的文字“みんなのAI、みんなの未来。”；下方是一块较暗的数字屏幕，显示“未来を創るのは、私たちだ。”，上方有一个标有“AI”的发光网络地球仪。在前景中，展示两名年轻男性侧身面对面，距离非常近：左侧男子留着 {argument name="left man's hair" default="短款后梳浅棕色头发"}，身穿深色衬衫外搭黑色夹克，双手伸向对方的脸；右侧男子留着 {argument name="right man's hair" default="凌乱的深棕色头发"}，身穿深绿色长袖衬衫，双手伸向左侧男子的脸。他们的手按在对方的脸颊上，仿佛在进行化妆或在紧张而幽默的公开演示中言归于好。两人的面部特意用大面积柔和的肤色隐私模糊遮盖，背景中几名围观者的脸部也进行了较小的模糊处理。在他们身后，描绘一群身穿西装和休闲装的上班族与学生，有些人拿着智能手机，在 AI 广场前围观这一场景。采用精致的日式动漫渲染、锐利的线条、电影级的构图、富有表现力的手部解剖结构、动态的特写视角、饱和的日光色彩以及细节丰富的建筑结构。

templates.title: Moonlight Blue Anime Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 月光蓝动漫封面

templates.prompt: Create a vertical, anime-style cover for a light novel or illustration collection, set on a moonlit beach night, using deep cobalt blue and navy blue as the main colors. At the top, place a striking and elegant conjoined cursive title.{argument name="title text" default="Moonlight Blue"} The font is a light blue-white calligraphic style with a glowing effect and long, flowing strokes; the author's name is added in small print in the lower left corner of the title.{argument name="author name" default="yurara"} In the upper right sky, a bright crescent moon is added, surrounded by tiny stars and a soft atmospheric halo. At the center of the image is a half-body anime girl standing on a coastline, one hand outstretched to the viewer in a dramatic gesture of invitation; her long {argument name="hair color" default="silver light blue"} Her hair, fine and flowing in the wind, shimmered in the moonlight. Her face was obscured by a centrally located, opaque, matte blue-gray square, concealing her features. She wore a white short-sleeved sailor uniform with a light blue collar and a delicate gold ribbon bow, revealing a dark skirt at the bottom. Behind her, dark, rolling waves, wet sand, and shimmering moonlight paths across the water were rendered. The artwork employs soft, painterly anime-style rendering, bright rim lighting, cinematic composition, delicate hair details, a romantic and melancholic atmosphere, and high-resolution book cover typography.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖版动漫风格的轻小说或插画集封面，背景设定在月光下的海滩之夜，以深钴蓝色和海军蓝为主色调。在顶部，放置醒目且优雅的连体草书标题 {argument name="title text" default="Moonlight Blue"}，采用发光的淡蓝白色书法字体，带有长长的飘逸笔触；在标题左下方添加小号小写作者名 {argument name="author name" default="yurara"}。在右上方的天空中，加入一轮明亮的弯月，周围环绕着细小的繁星和柔和的大气光晕。画面中心是一位半身动漫少女，站在海岸线上，一只手向观众伸出，呈现出戏剧性的邀请姿势；她长长的 {argument name="hair color" default="银淡蓝色"} 头发在风中飘散，发丝细腻，映衬着月光。她的面部被一个居中的不透明哑光蓝灰色方块遮挡，隐藏了五官。她身穿白色短袖水手校服，配有浅蓝色领子和柔和的金色丝带蝴蝶结，底部可见深色裙摆。在她身后，渲染出深色的翻滚海浪、湿润的沙滩，以及水面上波光粼粼的月光路径。采用柔和的绘画感动漫渲染、明亮的轮廓光、电影级构图、细腻的发丝细节、浪漫忧郁的氛围以及高分辨率的书籍封面排版。

templates.title: Monochrome Anime Couple Sketch

titleLocalized.zh: 单色动漫情侣素描

templates.prompt: Create a monochrome, hand-drawn anime-style line art illustration on a pure white background, achieving an effect reminiscent of finely drawn with a dip pen. Show two close-up characters in an intimate couple pose: on the left, a shorter, younger character with messy short hair and wearing a loose hoodie (with drawstring) leans upwards towards a taller character on the right; the taller character on the right has flowing long hair, with clearly visible ear details, and wears a loose kimono-style robe, leaning downwards towards the left character as if about to kiss or whisper. Deliberately cover the faces with two soft, light gray rectangular blocks: a medium rectangle covering the left character's face and a larger vertical rectangle covering the right character's face, partially overlapping near the center. Use loose, vibrant black lines, retaining visible brushstrokes, delicate hair strands, and minimalist shadows to create a light and airy atmosphere. Add a small hand-drawn heart on the left and three short emphasis marks near the taller character's head in the upper right corner. Place elegant cursive text in the upper left corner.{argument name="couple name" default="Mai & Koyo"} Add a faint, circular watermark-like logo behind the character, and add a bold copyright notice along the bottom edge.{argument name="copyright text" default="©ImaginaryGate | ProjectMRA | Mai"} The overall composition should be horizontal, a compact close-up, romantic in style, and have a black and white sketch feel, with the taller character occupying the right side and the shorter character filling the lower left.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅在纯白背景上的单色手绘风格动漫线稿插画，呈现出如同使用精细蘸水笔勾勒的效果。展示两个特写角色处于亲密的情侣姿势：左侧是一位身材较矮、留着凌乱短发并穿着宽松连帽衫（带抽绳）的年轻角色，正向上倾斜靠近右侧较高的角色；右侧较高的角色留着飘逸的长发，耳朵细节清晰可见，身着宽松的和服式长袍，正向下俯身靠近左侧角色，仿佛即将亲吻或耳语。刻意用两个柔和的浅灰色矩形遮挡块覆盖面部，左侧角色面部覆盖一个中等矩形，右侧角色面部覆盖一个较大的垂直矩形，两者在中心附近部分重叠。使用松散、充满活力的黑色线条，保留可见的构图笔触、细腻的发丝、极简的阴影，营造出轻盈通透的氛围。在左侧添加一个小巧的手绘爱心，并在右上角较高角色的头部附近添加三个简短的强调符号。在左上角放置优雅的草书文本 {argument name="couple name" default="Mai & Koyo"}。在角色后方添加一个淡淡的圆形水印状徽标，并在底部沿边添加一行粗体的版权声明 {argument name="copyright text" default="©ImaginaryGate | ProjectMRA | Mai"}。整体构图应为横向、紧凑特写、浪漫风格、黑白素描质感，较高角色占据右侧，较矮角色填充左下方。

templates.title: Gothic style angel and demon couple

titleLocalized.zh: 哥特风天使恶魔情侣

templates.prompt: Create a dark, highly detailed gothic anime illustration of {argument name="character count" default="two"} androgynous punk-lolita characters seated close together in an ornate candlelit Victorian room. The left character is a tall slim demon-like young man with messy {argument name="male hair color" default="black"} hair, pale skin, exposed chest and abs under sheer black lace, layered chokers and necklaces with cross and pentagram pendants, many rings, black leather pants with zippers, belts, chains, buckles, and a deep navy-black fur-trimmed jacket; one large black bat wing rises behind his left shoulder. The right character is a petite gothic lolita girl leaning against him, with long wavy {argument name="female hair color" default="dark brown"} hair braided and decorated with many tiny pink bows and heart clips, wearing a black lace bodice, pink ribbons, layered pink-and-black tutu skirt, fishnet stockings, strapped platform boots, chains, star charms, and an oversized pale pink fur-trimmed coat; one pale feathered angel wing is visible behind her right shoulder. Count exactly two visible wings total: one black bat wing on the left character and one pale feathered wing on the right character. Their faces are intentionally hidden by soft-edged opaque brown rectangular censor blocks, one larger rectangle over the taller character’s face and one smaller rectangle over the girl’s face. Use a moody romantic composition, close cropped vertical portrait, bodies intertwined, luxurious gothic accessories, lace textures, metallic chains, leather straps, fur, bows, crosses, pentagrams, hearts, and star charms. Background: dim antique interior with gilded picture frames, dark wallpaper, and a few tall candles glowing on the right. Lighting is low-key and cinematic, with warm candle highlights and cool purple-black shadows, ultra-detailed digital painting, dramatic dark fantasy fashion editorial atmosphere, {argument name="color palette" default="black, midnight blue, dusty pink, mauve, and candlelit gold"}.

templates.title: Side-by-side comparison of "renewed" portraits

titleLocalized.zh: 并排对比的“焕新”肖像

templates.prompt: Create a realistic side-by-side photographic "renewal" comparison image, showcasing the same young woman, vertically divided into two equal panels. Left panel shown.{argument name="time label left" default="today"} Her portrait: Casual and slightly relaxed, with dark brown hair tied in a messy high bun, a few stray strands falling loose. She wears an oversized light gray crewneck sweatshirt. The background is a neutral gray interior wall, with soft natural light. The portrait composition focuses on her shoulders and above. (Right panel display){argument name="time label right" default="5 years later"} She: Confident and sophisticated, with long, glossy, center-parted dark brown hair, wearing a black fitted blazer paired with a black satin camisole. Warm studio lighting casts dramatic light and shadow on the gray-brown walls. The portrait composition focuses on the upper body. Ensure consistency in body shape, skin tone, pose, and shooting angle across both panels to clearly show the same person in their "renewed" state. In the center of each panel's face, use a solid-color rectangular masking block that matches the surrounding skin tone to cover the eyes, nose, and mouth. A clear vertical dividing line separates the two panels, employing a natural fashion magazine photography style with realistic textures, no text, no logos, and a horizontal 3:2 composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一张逼真的并排摄影风格“焕新”对比图，展示同一位年轻女性，垂直平分为 2 个等大的面板。左侧面板展示 {argument name="time label left" default="今日"} 的她：休闲、略显随意，深棕色头发扎成凌乱的高丸子头，有几缕碎发散落，身穿超大号浅灰色圆领卫衣，背景为中性灰色的室内墙面，柔和的自然光，肩部以上肖像构图。右侧面板展示 {argument name="time label right" default="5 年后"} 的她：自信且精致，深棕色长发光泽顺滑并中分，身穿黑色修身西装外套搭配黑色缎面吊带衫，温暖的摄影棚灯光，在灰褐色墙面上投下富有戏剧性的光影，肩部以上肖像构图。确保两个面板中的体型、肤色、姿态和拍摄角度保持一致，以便清晰地看出是同一个人在“焕新”后的状态。在每个面板的脸部中心位置，使用与周围肤色相近的纯色矩形遮挡块遮住眼睛、鼻子和嘴巴。两个面板之间使用清晰的垂直分隔线，采用自然的时尚杂志摄影风格，纹理逼真，无文字，无 Logo，横向 3:2 构图。

templates.title: Introduction to Crayon Utopia

titleLocalized.zh: 奇幻蜡笔乌托邦引言

templates.prompt: Create a cheerful children's crayon drawing on white textured paper, using a childlike, hand-drawn style with soft, doodle-like strokes and gentle, irregular outlines. The upper part of the drawing features three children from a storybook: on the left is a child wearing a purple wide-brimmed hat and a purple cloak, holding a small teacup, their face replaced by a simple beige square; in the middle is a boy wearing a green hat, a green jacket, and yellow suspenders, thoughtfully touching their mouth; on the right is a smiling child in profile, wearing a pink feather beret, a blue striped shirt, and pink and black suspenders. Surrounding the drawing are playful doodles: two smiling clouds, a smiling sun, two smiling yellow stars, a regular yellow star, a small blue star, a purple asterisk, two large flowers, three small flowers, a teddy bear with a purple bow, a lollipop, a wrapped candy, a tulip, a pink ribbon bow, green grass, vines, polka dots and curls, and many pink hearts. Place a large, fan-shaped pink crayon border at the bottom of the image, decorated with green vines and a bow at the top; within the border, write the French quote in handwriting.{argument name="quote" default="Notre tâche la plus importante, pour le moment, est de bâtir des châteaux en Espagne."} The color is dark gray, and the source is marked in purple and pink below:{argument name="attribution" default="Lewis Mumford, The Story of Utopias (1922)"} Maintaining a fantastical, optimistic, and handcrafted atmosphere is suitable for decorating nursery walls, featuring imperfect crayon textures, round and cute faces, and rosy cheeks, without pursuing realism.

promptLocalized.zh: 在白色纹理纸上创作一幅欢快的儿童蜡笔画，采用稚拙的手绘风格，使用柔和的涂鸦笔触和柔软不规则的轮廓。在画面中上部展示三位故事书中的孩子：左侧是一位戴着紫色宽檐帽和紫色斗篷的孩子，手持一个小茶杯，脸部被一个简单的米色正方形取代；中间是一位戴着绿色帽子、身穿绿色夹克并配有黄色背带的男孩，正若有所思地摸着嘴；右侧是一位侧面的微笑孩子，戴着粉色羽毛贝雷帽，身穿蓝色条纹衬衫，配有粉黑相间的背带。周围环绕着俏皮的涂鸦：2 朵微笑的云、1 个微笑的太阳、2 颗微笑的黄色星星、1 颗普通的黄色星星、1 颗蓝色小星星、1 颗紫色星号、2 朵大花、3 朵小花、1 只系着紫色蝴蝶结的泰迪熊、1 根棒棒糖、1 颗包装好的糖果、1 朵郁金香、1 个粉色丝带蝴蝶结、绿草、叶蔓、小圆点和卷曲纹，以及许多粉色爱心。在画面中下方放置一个大的扇形粉色蜡笔边框，并用绿色藤蔓和顶部的蝴蝶结装饰；在边框内用手写体书写法语引言 {argument name="quote" default="Notre tâche la plus importante, pour le moment, est de bâtir des châteaux en Espagne."}，颜色为深灰色，下方用紫色和粉色标注出处：{argument name="attribution" default="Lewis Mumford, The Story of Utopias (1922)"}。保持奇幻、乐观、手工制作的氛围，适合装饰育儿室墙面，呈现不完美的蜡笔质感、圆润可爱的脸庞、红润的脸颊，且不追求写实效果。

templates.title: Red Dragon Lighthouse Storm

titleLocalized.zh: 红龙灯塔风暴

templates.prompt: Create a dark fantasy concept art scene, with a huge {argument name="dragon color" default="red"} A colossal dragon coils tightly around a weathered medieval stone lighthouse perched on a rugged sea cliff. Its enormous, bat-like wingspan nearly covers the entire width of the scene; the wingspan has a leathery, damaged texture. Its head and neck are covered in black spikes, and its sharp claws grip the tower. Its serpentine body spirals around the lighthouse. Its head curves downward beside the tower, its expression fierce and predatory, its eyes gleaming, and its scales bulging, appearing wet in the downpour. The lighthouse, built of ancient gray stone, features arched windows, crumbling battlements, and a castle-like brick base. A warm light shines from its top, partially enveloped by the dragon. The scene is set during a violent night {argument name="storm type" default="thunderstorm"} In the center, a dramatic purplish-black sky forms the background, with forked lightning, slanting rain curtains, mist, and storm clouds illuminated from within behind the dragon. Below, massive waves crash against rocky cliffs, churning up white spray; the sea is a deep navy blue, foaming and billowing. Distant rock silhouettes and blurred, dilapidated coastal buildings are added to the horizon to emphasize proportion. The composition employs a cinematic vertical square structure, high contrast, an epic fantasy-realistic style, painterly digital concept art, intricate scale details, deep purplish-red hues, backlit lightning, wet, reflective surfaces, a sense of volume, dramatic perspective, and is textless and borderless.

The dragon is enormous, serpentine in form, and ferocious in appearance. It possesses glossy, deep red scales, sharp horns and spines, glowing eyes, a gaping maw that roars, claws gripping the brickwork, and a long tail coiled around the base of the lighthouse. A large, tattered wing membrane extends from the right side of the image. The lighthouse, constructed of ancient, cracked gray stone, has arched windows that let in warm amber light, a circular balcony, and a glass lamphouse at the top. The scene is set during a violent nighttime battle.{argument name="storm type" default="Thunderstorm"} In the middle: a torrential downpour slants diagonally, churning purplish-black storm clouds. Employing a low-angle, cinematic composition, the lighthouse sits at the center, with the dragon coiled in an S-shape around it, its wings silhouetted against the lightning. The cool blue-purple storm light and shadow contrast sharply with the warm light. Rendered in a highly detailed, fantastical-realistic style, it emphasizes dramatic light and shadow, sharp textures, wet stone, reflective scales, ocean spray, the dynamism of the rain, an epic scale, and a somber atmosphere.

templates.title: Black and white luxury studio portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 黑白奢华影棚肖像

templates.prompt: A highly dramatic black-and-white studio portrait, the subject being {argument name="subject" default="A confident, bearded man, wearing distinctive thin-rimmed gold-rimmed round dark sunglasses and a well-tailored dark suit."} The composition employs a shallow depth of field for a close-up shot. He is positioned on the right side of the frame, shot at eye level using an 85mm portrait lens. His head is turned to the left in profile, his gaze gazing out of the frame, his expression serene and profound, his chin slightly raised. His left hand is lightly clasped near his chin, adding tension and sophistication to the pose. The lighting utilizes classic Rembrandt side lighting, soft yet highly directional, casting deep, cinematic shadows on the right side of his face and neck, while illuminating the left side of his face, forehead, bridge of his nose, and knuckles. Strong highlights around the eyes are crucial. The portrait should possess a melancholic, elegant, magazine-worthy quality, with rich tonal contrasts and clear textural details. His beard is meticulously trimmed, revealing individual hairs, and his skin texture is realistic, including pores, eyelashes, and subtle facial lines. He has a slightly messy hairstyle, and wears a [unclear - possibly a type of accessory] on his left wrist.{argument name="accessory" default="Luxury metal watches"} The dial features a metallic reflective sheen, sharp bezel details, and a polished strap. The dark suit cuffs are adorned with vertically embellished silver Roman numerals "III" in a striking serif font. The suit fabric is matte black with subtle pleats and stitched cuff details. The watch crystal and metal edges naturally capture highlights, while the clothing maintains a matte finish. The overall color scheme is monochromatic: deep black, bright white, and rich gray, creating extremely high contrast. The background is a dark studio backdrop with a softly textured, mottled finish, fading to near-pure black shadows with deep vignetting to the right. A slight soft-focus blur at the very bottom of the image adds depth and realism. Hyperrealistic photography, cinematic portrait style, luxurious fashion magazine aesthetics, extremely detailed beard texture, realistic microscopic skin details, precise focus on the eyes and face, high dynamic range black and white tones, no visible noise, and no compression artifacts.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张极具戏剧张力的黑白影棚肖像，主体为 {argument name="subject" default="一位自信的蓄须男士，佩戴着独特的细框金色圆框深色墨镜，身着剪裁考究的深色西装"}，采用浅景深特写构图。他位于画面右侧，以 85mm 肖像镜头视角平视拍摄。头部转向左侧呈侧面轮廓，目光看向画外，神情沉静而深邃，下巴微抬。左手在下巴附近轻握，为姿态增添了张力与高级感。光影采用经典的伦勃朗式侧光，柔和且具有极强的方向性，在面部和颈部右侧投下深邃的电影感阴影，同时照亮左侧面部、额头、鼻梁及指关节。眼部的强高光至关重要。肖像应呈现出忧郁、优雅的杂志大片质感，具备丰富的色调对比与清晰的纹理细节。胡须修剪得一丝不苟，可见清晰的单根毛发，皮肤纹理真实，包含毛孔、睫毛及细微的面部线条。他留着凌乱的发型，左手腕佩戴着 {argument name="accessory" default="奢华金属腕表"}，表盘具有金属反射光泽、清晰的表圈细节及抛光表带。深色西装袖口处，垂直装饰着银色罗马数字“III”，采用醒目的衬线字体。西装面料为哑光黑色，带有细微的褶皱与缝合袖口细节。表镜与金属边缘自然捕捉高光，而衣物保持哑光质感。整体色调仅为单色：深黑、亮白与丰富的灰色，对比度极高。背景为带有柔和斑驳纹理的深色影棚背景，向右侧渐变为近乎纯黑的阴影并带有浓重的暗角。画面底部极近处有轻微的柔焦模糊，增加了深度与真实感。超写实摄影，电影级肖像风格，奢华时尚杂志美学，极度细腻的胡须质感，真实的皮肤微观细节，焦点精准对准眼睛与面部，高动态范围黑白影调，无可见噪点，无压缩伪影。

templates.title: Screenshot of a South Korean baseball live broadcast

titleLocalized.zh: 韩国棒球直播电视截图

templates.prompt: Use the uploaded reference image as the primary identity reference. Create a hyper-realistic screenshot from a live broadcast of a Korean professional baseball game, showing a woman being accidentally captured by a TV camera while seated in the stands. Preserve the woman's overall facial features, hairstyle, soft expression, and natural atmosphere from the reference image, but avoid making her look like a stiff paste or an overly copied face. Blend her naturally into the scene. She is wearing a Samsung Lions baseball jersey, and the background is the KBO baseball stadium on a summer evening. The camera angle is eye-level from the stands, shot using a long telephoto broadcast lens. The woman is not looking directly at the camera but is watching the baseball game naturally, with a calm and easygoing expression, a slight smile, as if unaware or only barely aware of the live camera's presence. The scene should have the feel of a real sports television broadcast, not a smartphone shot, selfie, portrait, or fashion editorial. Include realistic elements of a Korean baseball stadium: crowded stands, enthusiastic fans, blue support towels, beer mugs, iced drinks, stadium lights, LED displays, and blurred spectators in the background. Utilizing telephoto compression effects, a slight broadcast video smoothing, subtle motion blur in crowds, minor video noise, and slight compression artifacts. Adding realistic KBO live graphics/score bar to the screen: bottom of the 8th inning, 0 strikes, 2 outs, Samsung offense: Jeon Byeong-woo, Kiwoom pitcher: Oh Seok-joo, runner on first, Korean team abbreviations, and a small "LIVE" live broadcast indicator. Overall atmosphere: realistic KBO live TV screenshots, snapshots, natural, unscripted, authentic stadium atmosphere, imperfect composition, realistic lighting and shadows, and natural skin texture. Exclude: smartphone photos, selfies, looking directly at the camera, posed portraits, fashion shoots, studio lighting, extreme close-ups, low-angle shots, exaggerated glamour, overly retouched skin, AI beauty filters, overly sharpened portraits, cinematic hero shots, dramatic model poses, empty backgrounds, unrealistic crowds, cartoons, illustrations, anime, plastic-looking skin, copy-pasted faces, unnatural facial features, distorted eyes, distorted hands, incorrect baseball stadiums, and non-Korean stadium atmospheres.

The poster should incorporate dynamic graffiti fonts, layered spray paint textures, hand-drawn symbols, abstract paint splatters, neon brushstrokes, urban sticker elements, Japanese calligraphy embellishments, and decorative elements to strongly enhance the vibrant atmosphere of the design. The overall composition should convey artistry, rebellion, fashion, and a strong visual impact, while maintaining the quality of a high-end magazine poster, avoiding clutter or excessive embellishment. Humans have transformed graffiti into luxurious wall art—truly an amazing species. The subject should not replicate the pose or expression in the reference photograph; create a completely new pose that appears natural, confident, and energetic. The expression should be emotionally expressive, charming, and captivating, avoiding stiff, awkward, flat, or expressionless body language. The pose should embody the elegance and sophistication common in international fashion models, enhancing the overall cinematic fashion aesthetic through stylish posture, natural movements, and subtle attitude. Clothing should be contemporary casual wear with strong visual appeal. Avoid mediocre or repetitive clothing designs. Utilize fashionable layering, modern streetwear inspiration, high-end casual styling, and a balanced combination of colors, patterns, textures, and fabrics to create a rich and varied visual effect. Clothing should appear trendy, fashionable, youthful, and high-end, while naturally integrating into the concept of Japanese graffiti posters. Backgrounds and poster decorations should be full of visual elements with a Japanese urban theme, such as graffiti walls, spray paint textures, hand-painted symbols, city signs, layered stickers, modern Japanese graphic patterns, abstract shapes, paint drips, street fashion aesthetics, and stylish decorative compositions, enhancing depth and artistic tension without distracting from the main subject. Lighting and shadow should have a cinematic and fashionable feel, presenting strong contrast, clear highlights, realistic skin texture, and the quality of a high-end magazine poster. The final product must look like a high-end modern street fashion promotional poster, with highly refined textures, balanced composition, harmonious colors, realistic proportions, ultra-clear focus, and an immersive visual narrative. Ultra-refined, aesthetically pleasing, high-end composition, realistic texture rendering, fashionable urban atmosphere, cinematic quality, poster-level design, 8K ultra-high resolution.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张细节丰富、风格大胆的日式涂鸦艺术肖像海报，融合现代都市街头美学与极具表现力的日本视觉文化。海报应包含动态的涂鸦字体、层叠的喷漆质感、手绘符号、抽象的油漆飞溅、霓虹笔触、都市贴纸元素、日式书法点缀以及装饰性元素，以强烈烘托设计中充满活力的氛围。整体构图应呈现出艺术感、叛逆感、时尚感和强烈的视觉冲击力，同时保持高端杂志海报的质感，避免杂乱或过度堆砌。人类竟将涂鸦转化为了奢华的墙面艺术，真是令人惊叹的物种。主体人物不得复刻参考照片中的姿势或表情，请创作一个全新的姿势，使其看起来自然、自信且充满活力。表情应富有情感表现力、魅力十足且引人入胜，避免僵硬、尴尬、平淡或无表情的肢体语言。姿势应体现国际时尚模特常见的优雅与精致，通过时尚的体态、自然的动作和微妙的态度，增强整体的电影级时尚美感。服装应采用具有强烈视觉吸引力的当代时尚休闲装。避免平庸或重复的服装设计，运用时尚的叠穿、现代街头服饰灵感、高端休闲造型，以及色彩、图案、纹理和面料的平衡组合，打造丰富且不单调的视觉效果。服装应显得潮流、时尚、年轻且具有高端质感，同时自然地融入日式涂鸦海报的概念中。背景和海报装饰应充满日式都市主题的视觉元素，如涂鸦墙、喷漆纹理、手绘符号、城市标牌、层叠贴纸、现代日式图形图案、抽象形状、油漆滴落、街头时尚美学以及时尚的装饰构图，在不分散主体注意力的情况下增强深度和艺术张力。光影应具备电影感和时尚感，呈现强烈的对比度、清晰的高光、真实的皮肤纹理以及高端杂志海报的品质。最终成品必须看起来像一张高端现代街头时尚宣传海报，具备高度精细的纹理、平衡的构图、和谐的色彩、真实的比例、超清晰的对焦以及沉浸式的视觉叙事。超精细、高审美、高端构图、逼真纹理渲染、时尚都市氛围、电影级品质、海报级设计、8K 超高分辨率。

templates.title: Minimalist Cave Mural Line Art

titleLocalized.zh: 极简洞穴壁画线条艺术

templates.prompt: Transform your input image into a 1:1 minimalist symbolic line drawing suitable for social media profile pictures. The subject can be a person, animal, or plant. Do not replicate physical forms, describe details, or use complete outlines; instead, extract the most essential spirit, posture, and contour features of the subject, like early murals or primitive sculptures, depicting them directly with minimal lines. The goal is not to complete a painting, but a refined figurative symbol, whose essence and character are recognizable with just a few strokes. The number of lines must be extremely small, ideally between 3 and 6. Each stroke should be simple, direct, and decisive, seemingly executed in one go, with natural pauses and slight undulations—neither mechanical nor smooth, not overly flat, nor a closed outline like a modern logo. Allow for broken strokes, white space, and omissions, letting the blank areas participate in the expression. Do not draw facial features, hair textures, clothing folds, leaf veins, or other descriptive details; retain only the most crucial contour transitions and emotional focal points. The overall aesthetic should be primitive, direct, restrained, and precise, like the visual language of our ancestors. The background should be simple, quiet, and stable, using pure light earth tones, stone wall colors, off-white, dark tones, or other neutral colors that accentuate the lines. The main lines should be clear, simple, and powerful. Avoid realism, shadows, a sense of volume, complex ornamentation, or modern graphic design styles. The final result should be an extremely refined figurative symbol: sparse, accurate, sharp, and serene, capturing the essence of the subject with just a few strokes. Deep red background. Aspect ratio 9:10.

promptLocalized.zh: 将输入图像转换为适合社交媒体头像的 1:1 极简象征性线条插画。主体可以是人物、动物或植物。不要复制物理形态，不要描述细节，也不要使用完整的轮廓；相反，要像早期壁画或原始雕刻那样，提取主体最本质的神韵、姿态和轮廓特征，用最少的线条直接刻画。目标不是完成一幅画，而是一个精炼的具象符号，仅需几笔即可辨认出气质与精髓。线条数量必须极少，最好在 3 到 6 笔之间。每一笔都应简单、直接、果断，仿佛一气呵成，带有自然的停顿和轻微的起伏——既不机械也不圆滑，不过分平整，也不是现代 Logo 风格的闭合轮廓。允许断笔、留白和省略，让空白处参与表达。不要绘制面部特征、头发纹理、衣褶、叶脉或其他描述性细节；仅保留最关键的轮廓转折和情感焦点。整体审美应原始、直接、克制且精准，如同祖先的视觉语言。背景应保持简洁、安静、稳重，使用纯净的浅地色、石墙色、灰白色、深色调或其他能衬托线条的素色。主线条应清晰、简洁且有力。避免写实、阴影、体积感、复杂的装饰或现代图形设计风格。最终结果应是一个极其精炼的具象符号：稀疏、准确、锐利且宁静，以寥寥数笔捕捉主体的精髓。深红色背景。长宽比 9:10。

templates.title: Arboreal Architecture Project

titleLocalized.zh: Arboreal Architecture 项目

templates.prompt: This hyper-realistic architecture competition showcase project, presented in A1 portrait layout, 4K resolution, and mixed-media visualization: A complete architectural project layout with a balanced visual hierarchy. Top third: Large, detailed 2D front elevation with fine lines, grid lines, section markings, and millimeter-level dimensions. Left center: Precise white technical drawing style side and rear elevations. Right center: 3D isometric views and exploded axonometric component views. Bottom area: Concept development drawings, design sketches, structural annotations, material swatches labeled with wood/exposed concrete/glass, human proportion references, and landscape integration diagrams. Modern architectural typography with clean, concise labeling. Intentionally used negative space to create a sense of breathing room. Blueprint overlays fade at the edges. A modern residential concept inspired by trees: organically branching structural columns mimicking tree trunks and branches; asymmetrically projecting cantilevered volumes; full-height glass curtain walls with thin vertical frames; exposed wood-grain concrete core; warm-toned wood cladding; tiered green terraces on each floor; roof gardens with native plants; elevated platform volumes integrated among existing trees; naturally intersecting ventilation cuts shown in the cross-section; passive solar and sustainability strategy diagrams marked with arrows; clearly marked floor plans; and a structural grid expressed through the glass curtain wall. 3D rendering quality: photorealistic materials; wet concrete capturing light; clearly visible wood grain; reflective wet stone paving; glass reflecting the stormy sky; warm amber interior light spilling through floor-to-ceiling windows; high-contrast shadows; cinematic environmental depth; and ultra-clear drawing lines superimposed on realistically rendered textures.{argument name="architectural style" default="Zaha Hadid / BIG / Kengo Kuma"} The aesthetics of the competition. Atmosphere:{argument name="weather atmosphere" default="The stormy sky was dark, with thick clouds accompanied by swirling fog and mist among the trees."} Emotional, cinematic lighting; soft, post-rain-wet, reflective flooring; deep, gradations of shadow; a warm, luminous interior contrasting sharply with the cold exterior; dramatic chiaroscuro; photorealistic environmental depth. Background and project textures: charcoal gray and dark graphite paper textures; blueprint grid lines subtly visible behind drawings; faint construction reference lines; elegant monochromatic color scheme (black, gray, off-white), accented with selective warm amber and wood-toned highlights; uncluttered, high-end studio presentation quality. Style references: Architectural competition posters, mixed-media projects; Kengo Kuma's material sensitivity; BIG's graphic clarity; Zaha Hadid's parametric design.

promptLocalized.zh:
超写实建筑竞赛展示项目，A1 竖版布局，4K 分辨率，混合媒介可视化

图纸构成：
完整的建筑项目布局，具有平衡的视觉层级。顶部三分之一：大型详细的 2D 正立面图，包含精细的线条、网格线、剖面标记以及毫米级尺寸标注。左中：精确的白色技术绘图风格的侧立面和背立面图。右中：3D 等轴测视图和爆炸轴测组件图。底部区域：概念发展图、设计构思草图、结构标注、带有木材 / 清水混凝土 / 玻璃标签的材料色板、人体比例参考图以及景观整合图。现代建筑排版，简洁明了的标签。有意留白的负空间以增加呼吸感。蓝图叠加层在边缘处淡出。

树木灵感的现代概念住宅建筑：
模仿树干和树枝的有机分支结构柱，不对称伸出的悬挑体量，带有细竖框的全高玻璃幕墙，外露的木纹混凝土核心筒，暖色调木质外墙板，各楼层层叠的绿色露台，带有原生植物的屋顶花园，集成在现有树木之间的高架平台体量，剖面图中展示的自然交叉通风切口，带有箭头标注的被动式太阳能和可持续策略图，清晰标记的楼层平面图，通过玻璃幕墙表现的结构网格。

3D 渲染质量：
照片级真实材质，湿润的混凝土捕捉光线，木材纹理清晰可见，反光的湿石铺装，玻璃反射着风暴天空，温暖的琥珀色室内光线透过落地玻璃溢出，高对比度阴影，电影级的环境深度，叠加在真实渲染纹理上的超清晰绘图线条，{argument name="architectural style" default="Zaha Hadid / BIG / Kengo Kuma"} 竞赛项目美学。

氛围：
{argument name="weather atmosphere" default="阴暗的风暴天空，厚重的云层伴随着在树林间翻滚的体积雾和薄雾"}，情绪化的电影级灯光，柔软的雨后湿润反光地面，深邃的阴影渐变，温暖发光的室内与寒冷的外部环境形成对比，戏剧性的明暗对照法，照片级的环境深度。

背景与项目纹理：
炭灰色和深石墨色调的纸张纹理，绘图后方隐约可见的蓝图网格线，淡淡的施工参考线，优雅的单色调配色（黑色、灰色、米白色），并点缀选择性的暖琥珀色和木质色调高光，无杂乱感，高级工作室展示品质。

风格参考：
建筑竞赛展板，混合媒介项目，Kengo Kuma 的材料敏感度，BIG 的图表清晰度，Zaha Hadid 的参数化设计

templates.title: Extremely simple line social media profile picture

titleLocalized.zh: 极简单线社交媒体头像

templates.prompt: Please convert the input image into a minimalist line drawing suitable for social media profile pictures, with a default aspect ratio of 1:1. The subject can be a person, cat, dog, other animal, or plant. Based on the type of input subject, automatically extract the most recognizable outline and key features, summarizing them into an artistic, minimalist line drawing profile picture/illustration. The overall goal is not mechanical outlining, but preserving the subject's spirit and recognizability, reconstructing it in a more elegant and spirited way using single lines. [Subject Processing Logic] If the subject is a person: retain key outlines such as face shape, forehead, nose bridge transition, mouth transition, chin, ears, and hairstyle, retaining only necessary facial features and avoiding cluttered details. If the subject is an animal: retain the head shape, ears, nose and mouth outline, eyes, and the main direction of fur, avoiding complex details. If the subject is a plant: retain the most recognizable morphological features of flowers, leaves, branches, or fruits, summarizing their posture and rhythm with simple lines. [Line Style Requirements] Lines must be rounded, flowing, bold, and natural, as continuous as possible, with a sense of breath and improvisation. Use soft curves, avoiding sharp, harsh, or rigid lines. Avoid stiff, logo-like outlines. Lines should be simple yet vibrant, with a touch of casual artistry, appearing relaxed and collectible. [Composition and Portrait Fit] 1:1 square design. The subject should be clear, focused, and prominent. Use a centered or slightly off-center composition with a clear visual focus and ample white space. [Background Logic] Don't fixate on one color (not always blue). Choose a dark background logic based on the image's tone. Avoid neon colors or cheap bright colors. [Line Color Logic] Use thin white or light-colored lines that contrast with the background. [Embellishing Logic] Add a few random colored dots, curves, stars, or geometric symbols to enhance vibrancy and fun. Keep it sparse and natural. [Overall Goal] Minimalist, light, modern, and artistic. Suitable for social media: eye-catching, easily recognizable, and fun. [Avoid] Realism, shadows, textures, complex scenes, mechanical outlines. 16:9 aspect ratio.

promptLocalized.zh: 请将输入图像转换为适合社交媒体头像的极简单线插画，默认长宽比为 1:1。主体可以是人物、猫、狗、其他动物或植物。根据输入主体的类型，自动提取最具辨识度的外轮廓和关键特征，并将其概括为艺术化的极简单线头像/插画。总体目标不是机械地描边，而是保留主体的神韵和辨识度，通过单线以更优雅、更有灵气的方式进行重构。[主体处理逻辑] 若主体为人物：保留脸型、额头、鼻梁过渡、嘴部过渡、下巴、耳朵、发型等关键轮廓，仅保留必要的面部特征，避免细节杂乱。若主体为动物：保留头部形状、耳朵、口鼻轮廓、眼神以及毛发的主要走向，避免复杂细节。若主体为植物：保留花朵、叶片、枝干或果实最具辨识度的形态特征，用简洁的线条概括其姿态与韵律。[线条风格要求] 线条必须圆润、舒展、粗犷且自然，尽可能连贯，带有呼吸感和即兴感。主要使用柔和的弧线，避免尖锐、生硬或刻板的线条。不要画成死板的 Logo 式轮廓。线条应简洁而富有生命力，带有一丝随性的艺术气息，看起来轻松且具有收藏价值。[构图与头像适配] 1:1 正方形设计。主体应清晰、集中且突出。采用居中或微偏构图，视觉焦点明确，留白充足。[背景逻辑] 不要将颜色固定为某一种（不一定总是蓝色）。根据图像的气质选择深色调背景逻辑。避免使用霓虹色或廉价的亮色。[线条颜色逻辑] 使用与背景形成对比的细白线或浅色线条。[点缀逻辑] 添加少量随机的彩色圆点、弧线、星星或几何符号，以增强灵气和趣味性。保持稀疏自然。[总体目标] 极简、轻盈、现代且艺术化。适合社交媒体：引人注目、易于识别且有趣。[避免] 写实、阴影、纹理、复杂场景、机械描边。比例 16:9

The style should reference vibrant and quirky popular anime illustrations: confident and strong lines with slight variations in thickness; simple cel-shading with large areas of shadow; bright, highly saturated, and high-contrast colors. Character expressions and movements can be boldly exaggerated, facial features simplified, and emotional tension enhanced. Appropriate stretching and distortion of limbs and perspective are permissible. The scene can be freely adapted from the original photo, reconstructing a fun cartoon world using wide-angle perspective and slight spatial distortion, and adding stickers, hearts, stars, onomatopoeia, speech bubbles, small animals, or fun props. The overall composition should be dynamic, lively, interesting, and impactful, presenting a vibrant and trendy anime poster effect.

templates.title: Conceptualized crowd portrait installation art

titleLocalized.zh: 概念化人群肖像装置艺术

templates.prompt: # Conceptualized Crowd Portrait Please generate a visually impactful "conceptualized crowd portrait" based on clear, realistic photos uploaded by users. ## I. Identity Requirements Strictly adhere to the real-life characteristics of the individuals in the uploaded photos, including: - Facial contours - Facial proportions - Eyebrow and eye structure - Nose shape - Lip shape - Basic hairstyle - Skin tone and perceived age - Eye expression and temperament - Overall recognizability The final image must allow viewers to instantly recognize the individuals in the photo. Please do not turn them into strangers, do not Westernize them, do not excessively idolize/beautify them, and do not generate fake AI faces. ## II. Core Concept Reconstruct the portrait into a large-scale conceptual installation art piece. The entire portrait head is composed of thousands of tiny figures, densely arranged like a crowd formation. Through different positions, clothing shades, crowd density, and shadow variations, they collectively outline the faces, hair, features, glasses, beards, clothing contours, and overall expressions of the individuals in the photo. The image appears as a giant portrait composed of real people, or a contemporary art installation placed in a minimalist white space. ## III. Composition - Vertical composition, suitable for visual posters or concept covers. - Top-down view/isometric top view. - The portrait's head dominates the image. - Minimalist white background with ample negative space. - Scatter a few small figures around the portrait to enhance the sense of spatial proportion and realistic scale. - The crowd as a whole forms a clear outline; facial features must be precisely positioned. ## IV. Visual Elements ### Crowd Structure - Use dense crowds to represent hair, eyebrows, eyes, nose, lips, jawline, and clothing. - Dark-colored clothing represents hair, glasses, collars, and shadow areas. - Light-colored clothing represents facial highlights and skin areas. - The arrangement should be natural, with a realistic sense of crowding and subtle random variations. - Each small figure should have an independent pose, clothing, and orientation to avoid a copy-paste effect. ### Lighting Effects - Soft, cinematic lighting. - Low-angle, long shadows. - Natural shadows cast beneath the crowd's feet. - Unified shadow direction to enhance spatial realism. - The overall style is clean, high-end, and tranquil. ### Color Scheme - Warm neutral tones. - Primarily off-white, light brown, gray, and charcoal black. - Use dark clothing to enhance the silhouette of the figures. - Use light beige and warm gray tones to transition the skin areas. - Restrained color palette, avoiding overly vibrant colors. ## V. Art Style Overall style references: - Contemporary conceptual art. - Museum-level installation art. - Hyperrealistic crowd simulation. - Minimalist visual posters. - High-end digital art. - Social metaphorical visual works. - Cinematic concept photography. Images should have strong visual metaphors: the image of an individual is composed of countless tiny individuals, possessing both the awe-inspiring power of a macro portrait and the explorable detail of a micro-crowd. ## VI. Atmosphere Overall atmosphere keywords: - Surreal - Profound - Tranquil - High-end - Modern - Thought-provoking - Cinematic - Visually stunning - Easy to share ## VII. Rendering Quality - Ultra-high detail. - 8K textures. - Realistic crowd simulation. - Deep focus to ensure the entire crowd portrait is clearly visible. - Rich details in tiny figures. - Realistic proportions. - Clean image with no cluttered backgrounds. - High-end commercial visual quality. - Similar to Octane Render / high-end 3D concept rendering effects. ## VIII. Negative Constraints Please avoid the following: - Do not turn people into strangers. - Do not generate only ordinary portraits. - Do not generate simple collages. - Do not make crowds lose their portrait outlines. - Facial features must not be misaligned. - Facial structures must not be blurred. - Do not use exaggerated cartoon styles. - Do not use low-resolution posters. - Do not use cluttered backgrounds. - Do not make all tiny figures look exactly the same. - Do not include text, watermarks, or logos. - Do not over-beautify. - Do not change the perceived age or true temperament of the figures.

promptLocalized.zh: # 概念化人群肖像 请根据用户上传的清晰真实照片，生成一张具有强烈视觉冲击力的“概念化人群肖像”。 ## I. 身份要求 严格参考上传照片中人物的真实身份特征，包括： - 面部轮廓 - 面部比例 - 眉眼结构 - 鼻型 - 唇形 - 发型基础 - 肤色与年龄感 - 眼神与气质 - 整体人物辨识度 最终生成的图像必须让观众一眼就能认出照片中的人物。请勿将其变成陌生人，请勿西化，请勿过度偶像化/美化，也请勿生成虚假的 AI 面孔。 ## II. 核心概念 将肖像重构为大型概念装置艺术作品。整个肖像头部由成千上万个微小人物组成，像人群方阵一样密集排列。通过不同的位置、服装深浅、人群密度和阴影变化，共同勾勒出照片中人物的面部、头发、五官、眼镜、胡须、服装轮廓及整体表情。图像看起来像是一个由真实人群组成的巨型肖像，或是一件置于极简白色空间中的当代艺术装置。 ## III. 构图 - 竖构图，适合视觉海报或概念封面。 - 俯视视角 / 等轴测顶视图。 - 肖像头部占据画面主体。 - 背景为极简纯白空间，留有大量负空间。 - 肖像周围散布少量微小人物，以增强空间比例感和真实尺度感。 - 人群整体形成清晰的轮廓，五官位置必须精准。 ## IV. 视觉元素 ### 人群结构 - 使用密集的人群构成头发、眉毛、眼睛、鼻梁、嘴唇、下颌线和衣服。 - 深色服装的人群构成头发、眼镜、衣领和阴影区域。 - 浅色服装的人群构成面部高光和皮肤区域。 - 排列应自然，具有真实的人群拥挤感和细微的随机变化。 - 每个微小人物都应有独立的姿态、服装和朝向，避免复制粘贴感。 ### 灯光效果 - 柔和的电影级灯光。 - 低角度长投影。 - 人群脚下投射出自然的阴影。 - 统一的阴影方向以增强空间真实感。 - 整体风格干净、高端且宁静。 ### 色彩风格 - 暖中性色调。 - 以米白色、浅棕色、灰色和炭黑色为主。 - 使用深色服装加强人物轮廓。 - 皮肤区域用浅米色和暖灰色人群过渡。 - 色调克制，避免过度鲜艳。 ## V. 艺术风格 整体风格参考： - 当代概念艺术。 - 博物馆级装置艺术。 - 超写实人群模拟。 - 极简主义视觉海报。 - 高端数字艺术。 - 社会隐喻视觉作品。 - 电影级概念摄影。 图像应具有强烈的视觉隐喻：个体的形象由无数微小的个体组成，既有宏观肖像的震撼感，又有微观人群细节的可探索性。 ## VI. 氛围 整体氛围关键词： - 超现实 - 深邃 - 宁静 - 高端 - 现代 - 发人深省 - 电影感 - 视觉震撼 - 易于传播 ## VII. 渲染质量 - 超高细节。 - 8K 纹理。 - 真实的人群模拟。 - 深焦距，确保整个人群肖像清晰可见。 - 微小人物的丰富细节。 - 真实的比例感。 - 画面干净，无杂乱背景。 - 高端商业视觉品质。 - 类似于 Octane Render / 高端 3D 概念渲染效果。 ## VIII. 负面约束 请避免以下情况： - 请勿将人物变成陌生人。 - 请勿仅生成普通肖像。 - 请勿生成简单的拼贴画。 - 请勿让人群失去肖像轮廓。 - 五官不得错位。 - 面部结构不得模糊。 - 不得使用夸张的卡通风格。 - 不得使用低分辨率海报。 - 不得使用杂乱背景。 - 请勿让所有微小人物看起来完全相同。 - 不得包含文字、水印或 Logo。 - 请勿过度美化。 - 请勿改变人物的年龄感或真实气质。
