templates.title: Misaligned image relay grid

titleLocalized.zh: 错位图像接力网格

templates.prompt: Arranged based on the attached images{argument name="quantity" default="12 versions"} And put one{argument name="grid" default="3x4"} Imagine an image being passed sequentially to 12 different people, each seeing only what the previous person created and mistakenly assuming "this must be what was requested" or "this is for this purpose," thus redesigning it. The atmosphere of the first frame should be very close to the original. As the frames progress, allow the shape, color, expression, pose, composition, theme, and mood of the original image to be gradually misunderstood, simplified, and transformed for different uses, deviating from its original meaning and appearance. Each frame should look as if it were remade by someone who only saw the previous frame and judged "this must be what was requested." Make changes naturally based on the content of the original image (whether it's a person, character, pet, food, landscape, architecture, or portrait). Don't rigidly fix the intermediate changes. It can be misunderstood as an illustration in one frame, a mascot in the next, or a commercial product, logo, flyer, plush toy, food packaging, tourist souvenir, warning sign, game character, mystery toy, reference icon, or handicraft in the next. The direction of change should naturally relate to the appearance of the original image and the previous frame. As the frame count progresses, make it look like "you can tell someone tried to do it well, but they slightly misunderstood the requirements." Let the shapes, proportions, eyes, mouth, outlines, color schemes, textures, uses, decorations, and composition shift slightly, resulting in an unexpected and humorous look in the latter half. The key isn't image degradation or noise, but making it look like a breakdown caused by a human misunderstanding the previous result while reconstructing for different purposes. In the latter half, don't completely erase the original image's features; instead, unnaturally retain one or two elements such as color, outline, expression, hairstyle, clothing, accessories, pose, composition, or theme. Meanwhile, other elements can be boldly omitted, transformed, misunderstood, or turned into something else. Make the 12th frame bold enough that only those familiar with the original image can barely perceive its source, while for first-time viewers, it looks like a completely different mysterious entity, product, character, artifact, icon, or mascot. End with an unexpected and slightly comical ending, prompting the exclamation, "Why did it turn out like this?!" Make every frame look different. Keep the background white and simple, organized into a 3x4 grid for easy viewing of the 12 variations. In later frames, don't make it too neat; instead, let one person's misconception be further misunderstood by the next. In the 12th frame, make a bold change so that one feature of the original image is strangely preserved, while everything else is almost entirely different.

promptLocalized.zh: 基于所附图像，排列 {argument name="quantity" default="12 个版本"} 并放入一个 {argument name="grid" default="3x4"} 的网格中。请将其表现为图像被依次传递给 12 个不同的人，每个人只看前一个人制作的内容，并错误地认为“这一定是所要求的”或“这是用于此目的的”，从而对其进行重新设计。第一帧的氛围应非常接近原图。随着帧数的推进，让原图的形状、颜色、表情、姿势、构图、主题和情绪逐渐被误解、简化、转换为不同用途，并偏离其原始含义和外观。每一帧都应看起来像是被一个只看过前一帧并判断“这一定是要求”的人重新制作的。根据原图的内容（无论是人物、角色、宠物、食物、风景、建筑还是个人头像），自然地进行改变。不要太严格地固定中间的变化。可以在某一帧将其误解为插画，下一帧误解为吉祥物，或者商业产品、标志、传单、毛绒玩具、食品包装、旅游商品、警告标志、游戏角色、神秘玩具、参考图标或手工制品。变化的走向应与原图及前一帧的外观自然关联。随着帧数的推进，使其看起来像是“你能看出有人在努力做好，但他们稍微误解了要求”。让形状、比例、眼睛、嘴巴、轮廓、颜色布局、纹理、用途、装饰和构图一点点偏移，导致后半部分出现意想不到且幽默的外观。关键不在于图像的退化或噪点，而在于让它看起来像是人类在为不同目的重建时，因为误解了前一个结果而导致的崩坏。在后半部分，不要完全抹去原图的特征，而是不自然地保留一两个元素，如颜色、轮廓、表情、发型、衣服、配饰、姿势、构图或主题。同时，其他元素可以大胆地省略、转换、误解或变成其他东西。让第 12 帧足够大胆，以至于只有了解原图的人才能勉强感知到原始来源，而对于初次观看者来说，它看起来是一个完全不同的神秘实体、产品、角色、工艺品、图标或吉祥物。以一个意想不到且略带滑稽的结局收尾，让人不禁感叹“为什么会变成这样？！”。让每一帧看起来都不同。保持背景为白色且简洁，组织成 3x4 网格以便于查看 12 种变化。在后面的帧中，不要做得太整洁；相反，让一个人的误解被下一个人进一步误解。在第 12 帧中，进行大胆的改变，使得原图的一个特征奇怪地保留了下来，而其他一切几乎完全不同。

templates.prompt: Based on the real photos I provided, generate a split-screen travel photography poster, with the overall design referencing "{argument name="style" default="City photo spots / Fridge magnets / Minimalist collage"} Style. [Composition] The image uses a 3:4 vertical layout, divided into upper and lower parts. The upper part occupies approximately 50% and uses a minimalist solid color background; the lower part occupies approximately 50%, retaining the original photo without any modifications. [Upper Part: Fridge Magnet Icon] Extract the most recognizable core element from the real photo in the lower part. Transform this building or main element into a simple "fridge magnet-style character icon". 1. Retain the core outline and iconic features; 2. The design is simple and bright, like a travel souvenir fridge magnet; 3. With a slight 3D effect and shadow; 4. Sharp edges with a white or light-colored outline; 5. Moderately simplify the details; 6. The icon is centered slightly above the center of the upper part; 7. The icon size is small and exquisite, with ample white space. [Background Color] Extract the most prominent and striking color from the photo as the background for the upper half (e.g., clothing color or a strong ambient color). The color should be pure, saturated, and clean, like a postcard. Avoid gradients or complex patterns. [Layout] Add a line of elegant handwritten English text below the icon:{argument name="handwritten text" default="spicycandy"} [Overall Aesthetics] High-end travel photography cards: Real photos + minimalist tile icons + primary color backgrounds + light typography. Fresh, clean, and bright, full of urban wandering atmosphere. Emphasizing recognizability, color memory, and travel vibes. [Avoid] Ordinary collages, complex upper parts, unnecessary decorations, altered lower parts of photos, garbled text, excessive cartoonishness, oversized icons, or text obscuring the subject.

promptLocalized.zh:
基于我提供的真实照片，生成一张上下分屏的旅行摄影海报，整体参考 “{argument name="style" default="城市打卡 / 冰箱贴 / 极简拼贴"}” 风格。
[构图] 图片采用 3:4 比例的竖版布局，分为上、下两部分。
上半部分占据约 50%，采用极简纯色背景；
下半部分占据约 50%，保留原始照片，不做任何修改。
[上半部分：冰箱贴图标] 提取下半部分真实照片中最具辨识度的核心元素。将该建筑或主体元素转化为简单的 “冰箱贴风格角色图标”。
1. 保留核心轮廓和标志性特征；
2. 设计简洁明快，如同旅行纪念品冰箱贴；
3. 带有轻微的 3D 效果和投影；
4. 边缘清晰，带有白色或浅色描边；
5. 对细节进行适度简化；
6. 图标居中放置在上半部分的中心偏上位置；
7. 图标尺寸小巧精致，留白充裕。
[背景颜色] 从照片中提取最主要、最令人印象深刻的颜色作为上半部分的背景（例如服装颜色或强烈的环境色）。颜色应为纯色、饱和且干净，如同明信片一般。不要使用渐变或复杂的图案。
[排版] 在图标下方添加一行优雅的英文手写文字：“{argument name="handwritten text" default="spicycandy"}”
[整体美学] 高端旅行摄影卡片：真实照片 + 极简磁贴图标 + 原色背景 + 轻盈排版。清新、整洁、明亮，充满城市漫游氛围。强调辨识度、色彩记忆和旅行氛围。
[避免] 普通的拼贴画、复杂的上半部分、多余的装饰、修改下半部分的照片、乱码文字、过度的卡通化、图标过大或文字遮挡主体。

templates.title: Minimalist Men's Fashion Collage

templates.prompt: Create a clean, minimalist, and stylish collage to showcase **{argument name="outfit count" default="8"} different sets{argument name="clothing style" default="everyday casual outfits"} The protagonist is a{argument name="subject" default="young men"} **The collages, arranged against a soft beige studio backdrop, are inspired by the aesthetics of a fashion lifestyle catalog. The same boy appears in every outfit, maintaining consistent facial features, a medium-length textured hairstyle, a natural smile, and a relaxed posture. The collages should convey a warm, casual, modern, and Pinterest-esque feel. Outfits include: 1. An oversized white linen shirt paired with light blue wide-leg jeans and white sneakers. 2. A fitted black basic T-shirt paired with beige pleated trousers and canvas shoes. 3. An oversized grey sweatshirt paired with black shorts, mid-calf socks, and platform sneakers. 4. A striped long-sleeved shirt paired with loose white trousers and sneakers. 5. A fitted white tank top paired with loose blue jeans and a shoulder bag. 6. A layered look: a light blue outer shirt, a white T-shirt, black wide-leg trousers, and sneakers. 7. A beige knit cardigan paired with loose jeans and casual shoes. 8. A navy blue button-down shirt paired with beige shorts, white socks, and retro sneakers. Add subtle brown ink-style handwritten notes around the outfits, such as: * “Linen shirt” * “Basic T-shirt” * “Oversized sweatshirt” * “Layered look” * “Neutral colors never go out of style” * “Shorts + sneakers” * “Casual everyday essentials” Add small arrows and doodles pointing to details of the outfits. The work employs soft natural light, a realistic photographic style, gentle neutral tones, minimalist shadows, and clean spacing between subjects. The overall atmosphere evokes a modern men's capsule wardrobe, Korean/Japanese casual streetwear inspiration, aesthetic Instagram/Pinterest fashion collages, editorial catalog compositions, realistic fabric textures, and comfortable minimalist styling.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一份干净的极简时尚拼贴画，展示 **{argument name="outfit count" default="8"} 套不同的 {argument name="clothing style" default="日常休闲穿搭"}，主角为一名 {argument name="subject" default="年轻男性"}**，排列在柔和的米色摄影棚背景上，灵感源自时尚生活画册美学。

同一位男孩出现在每一套穿搭中，面部特征保持一致，留着中等长度的纹理发型，面带自然微笑，姿态放松。拼贴画应呈现出温暖、随性、现代且具有 Pinterest 风格的质感。

穿搭包括：

1. 超大款白色亚麻衬衫，搭配浅蓝色阔腿牛仔裤和白色运动鞋
2. 修身黑色基础款 T 恤，搭配米色打褶长裤和帆布鞋

6. 叠穿造型：浅蓝色外搭衬衫、白色 T 恤、黑色阔腿裤、运动鞋
7. 米色针织开衫，搭配宽松牛仔裤和休闲鞋
8. 海军蓝扣领衬衫，搭配米色短裤、白色袜子和复古运动鞋

在穿搭周围添加微妙的棕色墨水风格手写标注，例如：

* “叠穿造型”
* “中性色永不过时”

加入指向穿搭细节的小箭头和涂鸦。
使用柔和的自然光、写实的摄影风格、柔和的中性色调、极简的阴影，并保持人物之间干净的间距。

整体氛围：现代男士胶囊衣橱、韩系/日系休闲街头风灵感、美学 Instagram/Pinterest 时尚拼贴、编辑画册构图、逼真的面料质感、舒适的极简造型。

templates.prompt: Create a dreamlike haute couture portrait, with the subject being {argument name="character name" default="Red Poppy Lady"} She stood in a misty field of vibrant red poppies. The composition used a two-thirds back-side view, with her face turned away from the camera and mostly obscured by an opaque, soft rose-brown square mask in the center of the frame. The subject sported a neat, chin-length white bob, the ends smooth and clearly defined, adorned with two red poppies—one larger on the left, the other partially visible on the right. She wore an exquisite dress {argument name="dress color" default="White"} A haute couture lace gown features a high neckline, three-dimensional floral appliqués, embroidered petals, and delicate sculptural textures. Surrounding it are numerous red poppies growing on slender, gray-green stems. Large, blurred flowers in the foreground outline the bottom and side edges, while more soft-focus poppies in the background disappear into a pale gray mist. Employing a shallow depth of field, a macro portrait-like feel, soft diffused overcast lighting, and an elegant surreal editing style, the red flowers contrast sharply with the white hair and clothing, creating a soft gray atmosphere. Cinematic blurring effects and vertical composition showcase the ultra-detailed textures of the fabric and hair, resulting in an overall serene and mysterious ambiance.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张梦幻般的高级时装艺术肖像，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="红罂粟女士"}，她站在一片雾气缭绕的鲜红罂粟花田中。画面采用肩部以上的三分之二背侧构图，面部背对镜头，大部分被画面中心一个不透明的柔和玫瑰棕色正方形遮罩所遮挡。主角留着利落的下巴长度白色波波头，发尾平整顺滑，发丝清晰可见，发间点缀着 2 朵红罂粟花，左侧一朵较大，右侧一朵部分可见。她身着一件精致的 {argument name="dress color" default="白色"} 高级定制蕾丝礼服，配有高领设计、立体花卉贴花、刺绣花瓣以及细腻的雕塑感纹理。周围环绕着许多长在细长灰绿色茎秆上的红罂粟，前景中模糊的大朵花卉勾勒出底部和两侧边缘，背景中更多柔焦的罂粟花隐没在浅灰色的雾气中。采用浅景深、微距人像镜头感、柔和的漫射阴天光线、优雅的超现实编辑风格，红花与白发及服饰形成强烈对比，营造出柔和的灰色氛围、电影级虚化效果、垂直构图，呈现超细腻的织物与发丝纹理，整体氛围宁静而神秘。

templates.title: A concise UI model for getting started with an authenticator.

titleLocalized.zh: 简洁的身份验证器入门引导 UI 模型

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 and REFERENCE_1 as design references, recreate the same four mobile onboarding screens as a clean, high-fidelity UI mockup, rather than a photograph of a laptop screen. Remove all perspective distortion, laptop/browser backgrounds, reflections, and camera artifacts. Place the four iPhone-style screens face up, evenly distributed across a light gray canvas, arranged in a row. Retain the dark mode version from REFERENCE_0, along with the same screen order, typographic hierarchy, blue security visual style, rounded phone borders, status bar, skip links, bottom home indicator, and CTA structure. Strictly retain the following four screens: 1) an authenticator account protection page with "Get Started," 2) a timely reminder page with a notification toggle and "Continue," 3) an end-to-end encryption page with a shield/lock icon, social icons, and "Continue," and 4) a Face ID quick setup page with a scan overlay, toggle, and "Continue." Ensure the UI is clear, refined, meets app store display standards, with sharp, legible text and consistent spacing.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 和 REFERENCE_1 作为设计参考，重新创建相同的 4 个移动端入门引导屏幕，制作成简洁的高保真 UI 模型，而非拍摄的笔记本电脑屏幕。去除所有透视畸变、笔记本电脑/浏览器背景、反光及相机伪影。将四个 iPhone 风格的屏幕正面朝上，均匀分布在浅灰色画布上，并排成一行。请保留 REFERENCE_0 中的深色模式版本，以及相同的屏幕顺序、排版层级、蓝色安全视觉风格、圆角手机边框、状态栏、跳过链接、底部主页指示器和 CTA 结构。严格保留 4 个屏幕：1) 带有“开始使用”的身份验证器账户保护页，2) 带有通知开关和“继续”的及时提醒页，3) 带有盾牌/锁图标、社交图标及“继续”的端到端加密页，4) 带有扫描覆盖层、开关和“继续”的 Face ID 快速设置页。确保 UI 清晰、精致，达到应用商店展示标准，文字锐利易读，间距统一。

templates.title: A clean and simple Authenticator getting started UI

titleLocalized.zh: 简洁的 Authenticator 入门引导 UI

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_1 as the primary UI reference and REFERENCE_0 only when darker variations are needed, the mobile onboarding process was recreated as a clean, front-facing design mockup, rather than a photograph of a laptop screen. Four iPhone-style screens were extracted and straightened, removing all camera perspective, reflections, browser borders, laptop edges, and the surrounding environment, and the screens were evenly placed on a light gray canvas. The original white/light theme, rounded corner phone cards, blue security logo, typographic hierarchy, icons, illustrations, and CTA styles were maintained. The system generates four precise onboarding screens from left to right: 1) A list of Authenticator accounts, titled "Protect all your accounts with Authenticator," with the CTA "Get Started"; 2) A security alert notification, titled "94% of users feel more secure with timely alerts," with the CTA "Continue"; 3) A shield/lock encryption illustration, titled "End-to-End Encryption," with the CTA "Continue"; 4) Face ID quick setup, including a portrait/scan graphic, titled "Quick Setup: Face ID Protection," a secure Face ID toggle card, privacy instructions, and the CTA "Continue."{argument name="primary color" default="bright blue"} As the primary accent color, the application name is retained.{argument name="app name" default="Authenticator"} And retain the status bar time as{argument name="status time" default="10:28"} The final result will look like a beautiful Figma export or product presentation, clear and high-resolution, without any of the flaws of a real photograph.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_1 作为主要 UI 参考，仅在需要深色变体细节时使用 REFERENCE_0，将移动端入门引导流程重新创建为简洁的正面设计模型，而非拍摄的笔记本电脑屏幕。提取并拉直四个 iPhone 风格的屏幕，去除所有相机透视、反光、浏览器边框、笔记本电脑边缘及周围环境，并将屏幕均匀地放置在浅灰色画布上。保持原有的白色/浅色主题、圆角手机卡片、蓝色安全品牌标识、排版层级、图标、插图以及 CTA 样式。从左到右精确生成 4 个入门引导屏幕：1) Authenticator 账户列表，标题为“Protect all your accounts with Authenticator”，CTA 为“Get Started”；2) 安全警报通知，标题为“94% of users feel more secure with timely alerts”，CTA 为“Continue”；3) 盾牌/锁加密插图，标题为“End-to-End Encryption”，CTA 为“Continue”；4) Face ID 快速设置，包含人像/扫描图形、标题“Quick Setup: Face ID Protection”、安全的 Face ID 开关卡片、隐私说明及 CTA“Continue”。使用 {argument name="primary color" default="bright blue"} 作为主要强调色，保留应用名称为 {argument name="app name" default="Authenticator"}，并将状态栏时间保留为 {argument name="status time" default="10:28"}。使最终效果看起来像精美的 Figma 导出图或产品演示，清晰且高分辨率，不含任何现实照片的瑕疵。

She was slightly turned to the right, holding a bamboo skewer with a small piece of grilled street food on the end, her arm outstretched in a casual sharing gesture. The woman on the right is {argument name="right woman ethnicity" default="African American"} A woman in her early twenties with towering, naturally curly hair, wearing a black bomber jacket over a basic white T-shirt and carrying a black shoulder bag; her face is also obscured by a flat, opaque, dark brown rectangle. templates.title: Chinese Plant Identification Infographic

titleLocalized.zh: 中文植物识别信息图

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference photo as the source plant, it was transformed into a concise plant identification infographic poster. The fuzzy green, spherical carnation stems from a cluttered street/florist background were extracted, refined into a sharp, studio-quality plant silhouette, and placed within a soft, light green plant layout. Rounded information cards, leaf vein decorations, and small green icons complete the look, presenting a trustworthy plant app aesthetic. Simplified Chinese typography is used. Main title:{argument name="headline text" default="Green hairy carnation"} Latin scientific name subtitle:{argument name="latin name" default="Dianthus barbatus ‘Green Trick’"} A badge labeled "High Confidence Identification" will be displayed in the upper right corner. Nine content sections will be added: 1. Top-left identification recommendation summary, 2. Classification judgment, 3. Key identification evidence, 4. Similar plant identification, 5. Basic profile, 6. Growth habits and care, 7. Risk warning, 8. How to confirm, and 9. Fun facts at the bottom. Keep the infographic text compact and neatly aligned. Sections 2 through 8 will be marked with numbered green dots, each topic will have a corresponding icon, and a plant image will be the visual center. The presented plant identity:{argument name="identified plant" default="Dianthus barbatus 'Green Trick', also known as Green Trick Dianthus barbatus"} ; Category/Genre Information Line:{argument name="taxonomy line" default="Caryophyllaceae | Dianthus | Dianthus barbatus / Dianthus barbatus horticultural varieties"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 以提供的参考照片为源植物，将其转换为一张简洁的植物识别信息图海报。将杂乱的街道/花店背景中的毛茸茸绿色球状石竹茎提取出来，修饰成清晰的摄影棚级植物剪影，并将其置于柔和的淡绿色植物布局中，搭配圆角信息卡片、叶脉装饰、小型绿色图标，呈现出值得信赖的植物 App 美学风格。使用简体中文排版。主标题：{argument name="headline text" default="绿毛球石竹"}；拉丁学名副标题：{argument name="latin name" default="Dianthus barbatus ‘Green Trick’"}；在右上角显示一个标有“高置信度识别”的徽章。添加 9 个内容板块：1 左上角识别推荐摘要，2 分类判断，3 关键识别证据，4 相似植物辨析，5 基础档案，6 生长习性与养护，7 风险提示，8 如何确认，以及 9 底部趣味知识条。保持信息图文字紧凑且对齐整齐，板块 2 至 8 使用带编号的绿色圆点标记，每个主题配以相应图标，并以植物图像作为视觉中心。呈现的植物身份：{argument name="identified plant" default="Dianthus barbatus ‘Green Trick’，又称绿毛球石竹"}；科/属信息行：{argument name="taxonomy line" default="石竹科 | 石竹属 | 须苞石竹 / 须苞石竹园艺品种"}。

templates.title: Tropical bubble tea splashing dynamic scene

titleLocalized.zh: 热带珍珠奶茶飞溅动态场景

templates.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic vertical dynamic photographic work, set in the kitchen of a modern bubble tea shop, brimming with the vibrant energy of summer tropical fruit bubble tea. A young female bubble tea shop employee {argument name="character name" default="Anonymous barista"} She crouches low on the wet, reflective floor in a dynamic wide-angle pose, one hand extremely close to the camera as a foreground element, the other arm outstretched. She wears a beige baseball cap, a beige polo shirt with dark green collar and cuff details, a black apron, loose white trousers, and white sneakers. Her long, dark double braids are partially obscured by a centrally positioned, softly-edged square privacy blur. Around her, a sealed cup of orange mango bubble tea (containing black tapioca pearls, topped with a dome lid) floats diagonally in the upper left, surrounded by vibrant splashes of creamy orange liquid, water droplets, ice cubes, and tapioca pearls. The frame must precisely include seven prominent pieces of fruit suspended in mid-air: three wedge-shaped slices of orange-yellow melon or peach, a sliced ​​passion fruit in the lower left corner, two green grapes, and several small mango chunks as a scattered garnish; the ground and the drink contain numerous black pearls. The environment should showcase stainless steel countertops and glass display cases on both sides, bright circular ceiling lights, warm reflected light, and a cinematic fisheye perspective with shallow depth of field. Utilize luminous wetland reflections, dynamic frozen photography, high-speed splash details, shimmering water droplets, viscous creamy textures, vibrant tropical orange-yellow hues, a summery freshness, dramatic lighting, realistic skin and fabric textures, and provide {argument name="drink flavor" default="Tropical Mango Fruit Milk Tea"} It presents a vibrant commercial advertising style.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超写实的竖屏动态摄影作品，背景设定在现代珍珠奶茶店的厨房内，充满夏季热带水果奶茶的爆发力。一位年轻的女性奶茶店员，{argument name="character name" default="匿名咖啡师"}，以动态广角姿势低蹲在湿润且具有反射效果的地板上，一只手极度靠近镜头作为前景，另一只手臂向上伸展；她头戴米色棒球帽，身穿带有深绿色领口和袖口装饰的米色 Polo 衫、黑色围裙、宽松白裤和白色运动鞋；她留着长长的深色双麻花辫，面部被一个居中的柔边方形隐私模糊遮盖。在她周围，一杯密封的橙色芒果珍珠奶茶（含黑色木薯珍珠，配圆顶盖）在左上方斜向漂浮，周围环绕着极具张力的奶油橙色液体飞溅、水滴、冰块和木薯珍珠。画面中需精确包含 7 块悬浮在空中的显眼水果：3 片橙黄色甜瓜或桃子楔形块、左下角 1 个切开的百香果、2 颗青葡萄，以及作为一组零散装饰的多个小芒果丁；地面和饮料中包含大量黑色珍珠。环境应展示两侧的不锈钢台面和玻璃展示柜、明亮的圆形吸顶灯、温暖的反射光，以及具有浅景深的电影级鱼眼视角。运用光亮的湿地反射、动态冻结摄影、高速飞溅细节、闪烁的水滴、粘稠的奶油质感、鲜艳的热带橙黄色调、夏季清新感、戏剧性光影、逼真的皮肤和织物纹理，并为 {argument name="drink flavor" default="热带芒果水果奶茶"} 呈现出充满活力的商业广告风格。

templates.prompt: Create a vertical, cinematic, fantastical portrait featuring two elegant young women resting intimately on a carved couch within a luxurious ancient palace. They wear semi-transparent, goddess-like gowns inspired by Hanfu, adorned with exquisite gold thread embroidery: the woman on the left wears…{argument name="left dress color" default="Lavender Purple"} A long, layered tulle dress with a high slit and long fringed sleeves; the woman on the right is wearing {argument name="right dress color" default="Champagne Gold"} The two women wear sheer gowns with embroidered corsets and draped sleeves. Both have long, black hair styled in elaborate updos, adorned with dangling gold hairpins, floral ornaments, chains, tassels, earrings, necklaces, armlets, and anklets; their faces are covered by simple rectangular veils to maintain anonymity. They are depicted resting in intimate poses: the woman on the left sits with one bare leg extended forward, while the woman on the right leans against her, her legs stretched out on a chaise longue, her arms relaxed and overlapping naturally. The scene is set in a dreamlike, luxurious boudoir, complete with purple silk cushions, brocade bedding, gilded decorations, violet tulle curtains, bronze incense burners, candlelit lanterns, hanging tassels, antique vases, and a table in the foreground displaying purple flowers and ornaments.{argument name="lighting mood" default="Warm candlelight twilight illumination"} Rich purple and gold color scheme, shallow depth of field, volumetric fog, shimmering dust particles, soft and romantic atmosphere, ultra-delicate fabric texture, photorealistic skin texture, cinematic composition, high-end fantasy fashion photography, 9:16 aspect ratio.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖屏电影感奇幻人像，画面中恰好有两位优雅的年轻女性，她们在奢华古宫殿内的一张雕花卧榻上亲密休憩。她们身着灵感源自汉服的半透明女神长裙，饰有精致的金线刺绣：左侧女性身着 {argument name="left dress color" default="薰衣草紫"} 的薄纱层叠长裙，带有高开叉和长流苏袖；右侧女性身着 {argument name="right dress color" default="香槟金"} 的透明纱裙，配有刺绣紧身胸衣和垂坠袖。两人都留着黑色长发，梳着精致的发髻，佩戴着垂坠的金发簪、花卉饰品、链条、流苏、耳环、项链、臂饰和脚链；她们的面部被简单的矩形模糊遮罩覆盖以保持匿名。让她们以亲密的姿态休憩，左侧女性坐着，一条裸露的腿向前伸展，右侧女性靠在她身上，双腿伸展在长榻上，手臂自然放松并重叠。场景设定在一个梦幻般的奢华闺房中，配有紫色丝绸靠垫、锦缎寝具、雕金装饰、紫罗兰色薄纱帷幔、青铜香炉、烛光灯笼、悬挂流苏、古董花瓶，以及前景中摆放着紫色花朵和装饰品的桌子。使用 {argument name="lighting mood" default="温暖的烛光黄昏照明"}，丰富的紫金配色，浅景深，体积雾，闪烁的尘埃微粒，柔和浪漫的氛围，超细腻的织物纹理，照片级真实的皮肤质感，电影级构图，高端奇幻时尚摄影，9:16 纵横比。

They wore elegant Hanfu-style see-through nightgowns, the colors of which were {argument name="left robe color" default="Deep Royal Purple"} and{argument name="right robe color" default="Light lavender powder"} Adorned with gold embroidery, semi-transparent draped cuffs, and multiple layers of tulle, it presents a refined and sensual fashion aesthetic, rather than blatant nudity. Employing a vertical composition, high-detail digital painting, a glossy, anime-realistic style, delicate skin shadows, opulent gold accents, cinematic warm lighting, and a shallow depth of field, the artwork creates a luxurious and romantic atmosphere, presenting a rich and harmonious blend of purple and gold tones.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅精致的动漫风格奇幻插画，描绘两位成年中国仙侠宫廷美女在华丽的古风宫廷卧室中，于精雕细琢的木床上亲密倚靠。两位女性均留着极长的飘逸 {argument name="hair color" default="亮黑色"} 秀发，梳着精致的高发髻，佩戴金色花卉发簪、垂坠饰品、耳环及精美项链；她们的面部被平滑的矩形模糊处理，呈现出匿名效果。她们身着优雅的汉服风格透视睡袍，颜色分别为 {argument name="left robe color" default="深皇家紫"} 和 {argument name="right robe color" default="淡薰衣草粉"}，饰有金色刺绣、半透明垂坠袖口及多层薄纱，呈现出一种精致且感性的时尚美感，而非露骨的裸露。让她们并排坐卧在白色枕头和丝绸床品上，双腿优雅交叠，露出赤足，长发如黑色的丝带般铺散在床上。房间应营造出温暖的灯笼光影下的皇家闺阁氛围，配有雕花格栅、深色木屏风、床头柜、发光的纸灯笼、半透明白色帷幔，侧面投射出柔和的金色阳光，空气中漂浮着尘埃微粒，周围环绕着 {argument name="magical smoke color" default="紫罗兰色"} 的香烟缭绕。采用竖构图，高细节数字绘画，光泽感动漫写实风格，细腻的皮肤阴影，华丽的金色装饰，电影级暖色调灯光，浅景深效果，营造出奢华浪漫的氛围，并呈现出浓郁的紫金色调和谐感。

templates.title: Red Line Travel Poster from Nihonbashi

titleLocalized.zh: 日本桥红色线条旅行海报

templates.prompt: Create a delicate retro travel poster illustration with the theme of{argument name="district name" default="NIHONBASHI"} The location is located at{argument name="city subtitle" default="TOKYO, JAPAN"} The illustration is a vertical layout on warm ivory paper. At the top is a striking and elegant Art Deco-style sans-serif title, “NIHONBASHI”, written in deep red. Below, centered, is a smaller, more spaced subtitle, “TOKYO, JAPAN,” flanked by thin horizontal lines. Below the typography, a monochrome red line drawing in a precise architectural ink-line style depicts a Tokyo pedestrian street, with modern glass office buildings and old-fashioned shopfronts extending towards the center in one-point perspective. The left side includes shop signs and awnings displaying “COFFEE,” “BOOKS,” “BAKERY,” and “CAFE,” as well as a tall, vertical sign that reads “NIHONBASHI.” In the foreground on the right, a magnificent historical bridge lantern and a large sculpted guardian lion on a stone pedestal inscribed with “Nihonbashi” are shown. Behind the statue are canal or bridge railings, rows of trees, decorative streetlights, and numerous pedestrians dressed in business and casual attire; including a woman in a long skirt in the lower left corner, a man in a suit walking with his back to the camera in the center of the foreground, a woman crossing the street near the statue, and a cyclist carrying a basket in the lower right corner. Using only fine red pen lines and delicate cross-hatching, with no fill color except for the red ink and ivory background, the clean white space evokes a nostalgic Japanese travel poster composition. Rich in detail yet with a transparent layout, it is elegant, symmetrical, and suitable for printing.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张精致的复古旅行海报插画，主题为 {argument name="district name" default="NIHONBASHI"}，地点位于 {argument name="city subtitle" default="TOKYO, JAPAN"}，采用暖象牙色纸张的竖构图。顶部放置一个非常醒目且优雅的装饰艺术风格无衬线标题，用深红色书写“NIHONBASHI”，下方居中放置较小的、字间距拉开的副标题“TOKYO, JAPAN”，两侧配有细横线作为分割。在排版下方，绘制一幅精准建筑墨线风格的单色红色线条城市街景：一条宽阔的东京步行街，现代玻璃办公楼与老式店面以一点透视法向中心延伸。左侧包含标有“COFFEE”、“BOOKS”、“BAKERY”、“CAFE”的商店招牌和遮阳篷，以及一个写有“NIHONBASHI”的竖长招牌。右侧前景处，展示一盏华丽的历史性桥梁灯笼和一座位于石基座上的大型雕塑守护狮，基座铭牌上刻有“日本桥”。在雕像后方展示运河或桥栏杆、成排的树木、装饰性路灯，以及许多穿着商务和休闲装的行人；包括左下角一名穿着长裙的女性、前景中心一名背向行走的西装男士、雕像附近过马路的女性，以及右下角一名带着篮子的骑行者。仅使用精细的红色钢笔线条和细腻的交叉排线，除红色墨水和象牙色背景外无填充色，留白整洁，具有怀旧的日本旅行海报构图，细节丰富但布局通透，优雅、对称且适合印刷。

templates.title: Park Reading Documentary Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 公园阅读纪实肖像

templates.prompt: Create a realistic, everyday mid-range portrait, with the subject being {argument name="subject" default="A young East Asian woman in her early twenties"} She sat alone on the soft lawn of a city park, against a backdrop of a cloudy afternoon. The shot was taken from a low angle, slightly to the side, creating a shallow depth of field and a natural, candid composition. She had naturally straight hair.{argument name="hair color" default="black"} Her long hair fell loosely over her shoulders, with a few strands around her neck and collarbone; her face was completely covered by a flat, opaque square veil of warm, medium brown skin. She wore a fitted top.{argument name="top color" default="Beige"} Ribbed knit long-sleeved top, tucked in{argument name="trouser color" default="Soft sage green"} She was wearing loose, high-waisted, wide-leg pants. She sat with her knees slightly turned to one side, one hand resting on the grass, an open book on her lap.{argument name="reading object" default="Small book"} As if quietly reading. The background is a tranquil city park with green grass, mature trees, and blurred paths, all softly blurred. Using cool green-gray overcast natural light, the light is even and soft, with almost no hard shadows, revealing realistic fabric textures, natural skin and hair details. The colors are understated, giving it a documentary-like feel. A 35mm film-style snapshot, with a vertical 2:3 composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张真实的生活化摄影中景肖像，主体为 {argument name="subject" default="一位 20 岁出头的东亚年轻女性"}，她独自坐在城市公园柔软的草坪上，背景为阴天午后。采用低角度、略微侧向的拍摄视角，呈现浅景深和自然的抓拍构图。她留着自然的直发，{argument name="hair color" default="黑色"} 的长发松散地垂在肩头，颈部和锁骨处有几缕发丝；她的脸部被一个暖中棕色肤色的扁平不透明方形遮挡块完全覆盖。她穿着一件修身的 {argument name="top color" default="米色"} 罗纹针织长袖上衣，下摆塞进 {argument name="trouser color" default="柔和鼠尾草绿"} 的宽松高腰阔腿裤中。她双膝微微侧向一边坐着，一只手撑在草地上，膝上放着一本打开的 {argument name="reading object" default="小书"}，仿佛正在安静地阅读。背景是宁静的城市公园，有绿草、成熟的树木和模糊的小径，整体处于柔和的虚化状态。采用冷绿灰色的阴天自然光，光线均匀柔和，几乎没有硬阴影，呈现真实的织物纹理、自然的皮肤和头发细节，色彩低调，具有纪实写实感，35mm 胶片风格抓拍，垂直 2:3 构图。

templates.prompt: Create a realistic and natural everyday documentary photograph, using a vertical composition portrait and shooting from a low, medium shot.{argument name="subject" default="A young Japanese woman in her twenties"} A scene of her sitting alone on the lush grass in a quiet city park on a cloudy afternoon. She has naturally straight, soft hair.{argument name="hair color" default="Long black hair"} Her hair fell past her shoulders, her center-parted hairstyle slightly messy, with a few strands blowing in the wind; her face was framed by a centrally located, opaque rectangle.{argument name="privacy block color" default="warm brown"} Her privacy was completely covered by a privacy panel. She was wearing a long-sleeved ribbed top.{argument name="top color" default="Beige"} A knitted top with a soft round neckline, paired with loose-fitting wide-leg pants.{argument name="trouser color" default="Soft sage green"} Long trousers. The pose is set as sitting on the lawn, one knee bent and raised, one hand resting on the grass in the lower left foreground, a paperback book or notebook open on the knee, revealing beige pages. Soft, overcast diffused light is used, with a gentle, cool green color palette to present natural skin and fabric textures. A shallow depth of field and a creamy, blurred background are used, with a blurred dark green lawn behind, a blurred dark tree trunk in the upper left, and a blurred light-colored path in the upper right. The emphasis is on documentary realism, imperfect natural poses, hair blowing in the wind, and richly detailed blades of grass in the foreground. There is no studio lighting, no staged feel, no text, and no other people.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张真实自然的日常纪实照片，采用竖构图肖像，以低机位中景拍摄 {argument name="subject" default="一位 20 多岁的日本年轻女性"} 在阴天午后的安静城市公园中独自坐在茂密草地上的场景。她留着自然直顺的细软 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色长发"}，发丝垂过肩头，中分发型略显凌乱，几缕发丝被风吹起；她的面部被一个居中的不透明矩形 {argument name="privacy block color" default="暖棕色"} 隐私遮挡块完全遮住。她身穿一件长袖罗纹 {argument name="top color" default="米色"} 针织上衣，领口为柔和的圆领，下身搭配宽松的阔腿 {argument name="trouser color" default="柔和鼠尾草绿"} 长裤。姿势设定为坐在草坪上，一侧膝盖弯曲抬起，一只手放在左下角前景的草地上，膝盖上摊开着一本平装书或笔记本，露出米色的书页。使用柔和的阴天漫射光，色调采用温和的冷绿色调，呈现自然的皮肤和织物纹理，浅景深，奶油般虚化的背景，身后是模糊的深绿色草坪，左上方有一棵模糊的深色树干，右上方有一条模糊的浅色小径。强调纪录片的写实感、不完美的自然姿态、被风吹动的发丝、前景中细节丰富的草叶，无影棚灯光，无摆拍感，无文字，无其他人物。

templates.title: Portrait of Newton's Prism Experiment

titleLocalized.zh: 牛顿棱镜实验肖像

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic, realistic 18th-century science laboratory scene inspired by Newton's prism experiment.{argument name="scientist" default="Sir Isaac Newton"} The figure sits in deep darkness, behind a polished table, wearing a fluffy hat.{argument name="wig color" default="silver-white"} A woman wears a curly, powdered wig and period clothing with ruffled cuffs; her face is deliberately obscured by a flat, opaque, dark brown square veil positioned in the center of her head. To the left, a hand adjusts a small, antique brass optical instrument with screws and vertical rods, emitting a bright, horizontal beam of white light. The beam passes through the tabletop, enters a transparent triangular glass prism on the right-center side, and refracts there into a vibrant rainbow spectrum extending downwards and to the right, with clearly visible bands of red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and violet. The design utilizes a black background, strong contrasts of light and shadow, dramatic lens flares, luminous caustics, reflections on a glossy tabletop, delicate glass contours, and an atmosphere imbued with historical and scientific sensibility. It features a widescreen cinematic aspect ratio, high contrast, realistic textures, shallow depth of field, deep cyan and gold tones, and no text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个受牛顿棱镜实验启发的电影级写实 18 世纪科学实验室场景。一位 {argument name="scientist" default="艾萨克·牛顿爵士"} 人物坐在深沉的黑暗中，身处一张抛光桌后，戴着蓬松的 {argument name="wig color" default="银白色"} 卷曲粉末假发，穿着带有荷叶边袖口的时代服装；面部被一个位于头部中央的扁平不透明深棕色方形遮挡块刻意遮盖。在左侧，一只手正在调节一个带有螺丝和垂直杆的小型古董黄铜光学仪器，发出一束明亮的水平白光。光束穿过桌面，射入位于中右侧的透明三角形玻璃棱镜，并在那里折射成一道向右下方延伸的鲜艳彩虹光谱，红、橙、黄、绿、蓝、紫各色带清晰可见。使用黑色背景、强烈的明暗对比法、戏剧性的镜头光晕、发光的焦散效果、光亮桌面上的反射、精致的玻璃轮廓以及充满历史科学气息的氛围。宽银幕电影比例，高对比度，写实材质，浅景深，深青色与金色调，无文字。

templates.title: Hardcore style Naruto poster illustration

titleLocalized.zh: 硬核风格《火影忍者》海报插画

templates.prompt: Create a highly dramatic full-body anime character illustration, with the main character being {argument name="character name" default="Naruto Uzumaki"} He stands atop a dark, arched roof or a giant pipe, facing forward, his expression calm and focused, his eyes blue. He sports his signature {argument name="hair color" default="gold"} The character has spiky hair, wears a black headband with metal plates and spiral blade symbols, and has three mustache-like markings on each cheek. The pose is set with one hand forming a vertical ninja hand seal in front of the mouth, and the other arm across the body. They wear an orange ninja outfit, covered by a long, tattered, and wind-blown black cloak with a high collar. A loose black scarf ribbon flutters to the left. They wear black boots, and bandages are wrapped around their thighs. The upper sleeves are decorated with circular red-orange spiral patches. The background is a dark, low-saturation blue-gray, devoid of any other scenery besides atmospheric textures. A spiral beam of orange chakra surrounds the character, and eight orange leaves or ember fragments are scattered in the air. The rendering employs a hardcore, high-contrast ink wash and gouache anime style: rough black brushstrokes, dry-brush edges, oil-painting-like orange highlights, and deep shadows. The color palette is limited to charcoal black, soft navy blue, tan skin, and burnt orange. The composition is a vertical poster format, with the character slightly positioned on the right and a low-angle, upward-looking perspective, making the legs and cloak appear imposing. Subtle handwritten text is added to the upper left corner.{argument name="upper left text" default="Naruto Uzumaki"} And add a subtle signature-like mark near the bottom right corner.{argument name="signature text" default="- PLAYFORGE -"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张极具戏剧性的全身动漫角色插画，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="漩涡鸣人"}，他站在黑暗的弧形屋顶或巨型管道上，正面朝向前方，神情冷静而专注，双眼呈蓝色。他留着标志性的 {argument name="hair color" default="金色"} 刺猬头，佩戴带有金属片和螺旋叶片符号的黑色护额，双颊各有三道胡须状印记。姿势设定为一只手在嘴前结出垂直的忍者手印，另一只手臂横过身体。身穿橙色忍者服，外罩一件长款黑色、破损且随风飘动的斗篷，斗篷带有高领，松散的黑色围巾丝带向左飘动，脚穿黑色靴子，大腿缠绕绷带；上袖处饰有圆形的红橙色螺旋补丁。背景采用深色低饱和度的蓝灰色，除大气纹理外无其他景物。角色周围环绕着 1 条橙色查克拉状螺旋光束，空中散布着 8 片橙色叶子或余烬碎片。采用硬核高对比度的水墨与水粉动漫风格渲染：粗犷的黑色笔触、干擦画法的边缘、油画质感的橙色高光、深邃的阴影，色调限制在炭黑色、柔和的藏青色、棕褐色皮肤和焦橙色。构图为竖版海报格式，角色略微居右，采用低角度仰视视角，使腿部和斗篷显得气势磅礴。在左上角添加淡淡的手写文字 {argument name="upper left text" default="漩涡鸣人\nNaruto Uzumaki"}，并在右下角附近添加一个类似签名的细微标记 {argument name="signature text" default="- PLAYFORGE -"}。

templates.title: Dark-themed Kushina Chakra Chain Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑风玖辛奈查克拉锁链海报

templates.prompt: Create a vertical dark anime character poster, with the main character being {argument name="character name" default="漩涡玖辛奈"} A powerful red-haired female ninja. She is presented in a taut three-quarter profile, the image cropped upwards from her thighs, against a backdrop of deep blue-black smoke. She possesses extremely long, flowing {argument name="hair color" default="Crimson"} Her long, ribbon-like hair stretches across the entire image, partially obscuring her face, with a blurred square occlusion in the center. Her expression is mostly hidden, but her posture is powerful and imposing: her torso is turned to the side, one bare arm extends towards the viewer, long fingers spread, creating a strong sense of perspective. She wears a dark, sleeveless ninja-style dress with a light-colored high collar, a fitted black corset, layered black and red skirts, and a side slit, revealing black fishnet patterns on her chest and legs. A continuous, glowing red chakra chain encircles her, diagonally wrapping around her body with bright, segmented connections and smoky red energy trails. Three floating paper talismans with handwritten sealing symbols are added, located near the upper right, lower left, and lower right corners respectively. In the upper left corner, blurred handwritten text "Kushina Uzumaki" is added. It uses low-saturation, emotional color tones, bold ink-line style, painterly anime shadows, dynamic hair movement, delicate graininess, cinematic lighting, and a dark and mysterious ninja atmosphere, with a small artist signature mark in the lower right corner.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖版暗黑动漫角色海报，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="漩涡玖辛奈"}，一位强大的红发女忍者。她以充满张力的四分之三侧身姿态呈现，画面从大腿处向上截取，背景为深蓝黑色的烟雾。她拥有极长的、飘逸的 {argument name="hair color" default="绯红色"} 秀发，如丝带般粗壮的发丝横贯整个画面，部分遮挡住脸部，面部中心区域有模糊的方形遮挡。她的表情大半被遮掩，但姿态显得强烈而威严：躯干侧转，一只裸露的手臂向观众伸出，长指张开，呈现出强烈的透视感。她身穿深色无袖忍者风格长裙，配有浅色高领、修身黑色紧身胸衣、层叠的黑红裙摆、侧开叉，胸部和腿部可见黑色渔网纹理。在她周围环绕着一条连续发光的红色查克拉锁链，锁链呈对角线缠绕身体，带有明亮的分段连接处和烟雾状的红色能量轨迹；添加三张漂浮的纸质符咒，上面写有手写封印符号，分别位于右上角、左下角和右下角附近。在左上角，添加模糊的手写文字“漩涡玖辛奈 / Kushina Uzumaki”。使用低饱和度的情绪化色调、粗犷的墨线风格、绘画感动漫阴影、动态的发丝运动、细腻的颗粒感、电影级光影以及暗黑神秘的忍者氛围，右下角带有小型的艺术家签名式标记。

templates.title: Hanfu reclining portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 汉服侧卧肖像

templates.prompt: Create a realistic vertical full-body portrait depicting an adult East Asian woman in elegant traditional Hanfu, reclining on a carved dark wooden couch in a tranquil, classical Chinese room. She wears a layered outfit {argument name="hanfu color palette" default="Cream, light peach, soft pink and pale cyan"} The attire features flowing, semi-transparent long sleeves, embroidered floral details, a subtle yet elegant bodice, and a long, sheer pink shawl that cascades down the side of the couch to the floor. Her face is deliberately obscured by a smooth, rectangular blur effect, and her long black hair is styled into an elaborate updo, adorned with pale floral hairpins and dangling ornaments. She reclines diagonally on the couch, one elbow resting on a cream-colored brocade cushion, her hands relaxed on her knees, her long skirt covering her legs, and her bare feet protruding from the far right of the couch. The scene includes two tall wooden lattice windows on the left and back, draped with white sheer curtains and letting in warm sunlight; a carved wooden couch covered with cream-colored patterned cushions; two visible cushions (including a square pillow and a long cylindrical throw pillow); and a long table behind her with a silver vase containing greenery and a framed floral painting hanging below.{argument name="lighting style" default="Soft and warm window light"} With shallow depth of field, realistic fabric textures, carved furniture details, and soft, rustic brown and creamy white tones, the film creates an exquisite and private boudoir atmosphere, presented from the perspective of a high-end editing camera with a 9:16 composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实风格的竖版全身肖像，展示一位成年东亚女性身着优雅的传统汉服，侧卧在古典中式静谧房间内的一张雕花深色木榻上。她穿着一套层次分明的 {argument name="hanfu color palette" default="奶油色、浅桃色、柔粉色和淡青色"} 服饰，配有半透明的飘逸长袖、刺绣花卉细节、低调而雅致的裹胸，以及一条长长的薄纱粉色披肩，垂落在榻边直至地面。她的面部被平滑的矩形模糊效果刻意遮挡，黑色长发梳成华丽的发髻，点缀着淡色花朵发簪和垂坠饰品。让她以对角线姿势斜倚在榻上，一只手肘靠在奶油色锦缎靠垫上，双手放松地放在膝上，长裙覆盖在双腿上，赤足露在木榻的最右端。场景包括左侧和后方两扇透着温暖日光、挂着白色薄纱窗帘的高大木质格栅窗，一张铺有奶油色花纹软垫的雕花木榻，两个可见的靠垫（包含一个方形枕头和一个长圆柱形抱枕），以及后方一张条案，上面摆放着一个插有绿植的银色花瓶，下方挂着一幅装裱好的花卉画。使用 {argument name="lighting style" default="柔和温暖的窗光"}，浅景深，逼真的织物纹理，雕花家具细节，柔和的古朴棕色、奶油白，营造出精致私密的闺房氛围，以高端编辑摄影相机的视角呈现，采用 9:16 的构图。

templates.title: Cherry blossoms in the rain - portrait of a female student

titleLocalized.zh: 雨中樱花女学生肖像

templates.prompt: Create a vertical, cinematic-style realistic portrait, with the main subject being {argument name="character description" default="A Japanese high school girl with long, dark purple hair"} She crouched in the middle of a city street after the rain. Using an extremely low, wide-angle perspective, the foreground prominently features a loafer and white ribbed socks, her reflection shimmering in the smooth, wet asphalt. She was wearing {argument name="school uniform" default="Beige suit jacket, white shirt, gray tie, red plaid skirt, white knee-high socks, and brown loafers"} A transparent umbrella held overhead, delicate pink cherry blossom petals scattered across its surface and drifting down with the rain. Her face was softly blurred by rectangular shadows, her posture gentle and intimate. She held in her arms {argument name="animal" default="A fluffy gray and white kitten"} The background is a misty modern city street, with skyscrapers obscured by light gray patches of light. Raindrops fall, and large, suspended water droplets are clearly visible. Ripples spread across puddles, and cherry blossom petals are scattered on the damp ground. The image employs a dreamy spring rain atmosphere, soft, diffused overcast lighting, shallow depth of field, glossy reflections, realistic fabric textures, dewy skin highlights, and richly detailed umbrella ribs and raindrops to create a tranquil mood. It presents a composition befitting a high-end fashion magazine, with ultra-high detail and realism, in a 9:16 vertical aspect ratio.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖版电影级写实肖像，画面主体为 {argument name="character description" default="一位留着深紫色长发的日本女高中生"}，她蹲在雨后的城市街道中央。采用极低角度的广角视角，前景突出展示一只乐福鞋和白色罗纹袜，光滑的积水柏油路面映照出她的倒影。她身穿 {argument name="school uniform" default="米色西装外套、白衬衫、灰色领带、红色格纹裙、白色及膝袜和棕色乐福鞋"}，头顶撑着一把透明雨伞，精致的粉色樱花花瓣散落在伞面上，并随雨水飘落。她的面部被柔和的矩形模糊处理，姿态温柔而亲密。她怀中抱着 {argument name="animal" default="一只毛茸茸的灰白小猫"}。背景是雾气缭绕的现代城市街道，高楼大厦隐没在浅灰色的光斑中，雨丝飘落，悬浮的巨大水滴清晰可见，积水泛起涟漪，湿润的地面上散落着樱花瓣。采用梦幻的春雨氛围、柔和的漫射阴天光线、浅景深效果、光泽反射、逼真的织物纹理、湿润的皮肤高光、细节丰富的伞骨与雨滴，营造出宁静的情绪，呈现高端时尚杂志的构图，超高细节的写实效果，9:16 竖版比例。

templates.title: Anime Cherry Blossom Goodnight Festival Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫樱花晚安祭典场景

templates.prompt: Create a detailed, warm-toned, anime-style bedtime illustration of a Japanese festival. The image depicts two adorable young women in gorgeous floral kimonos, standing close together against a background of decorative washi paper and cherry blossoms. The girl on the left has {argument name="left character hair color" default="Soft pink"} The girl on the right has a short bob haircut, long bangs covering one eye, revealing a pink eye, a bright, toothy smile, rosy cheeks, and wears a delicate cherry blossom ribbon hair accessory with dangling tassels; the girl on the right has {argument name="right character hair color" default="light sky blue"} The girl with the short bob haircut, wearing a matching floral kimono and a similar cherry blossom tassel hair accessory, has her face covered by a semi-transparent square gray-toned purplish-pink veil. In the foreground, two girls jointly hold a large, horizontally rectangular paper sign. The sign is made of old cream-colored paper, with a reddish-brown wooden frame, cherry blossom decorations, a red ribbon bow at the bottom, and striking black Japanese calligraphy.{argument name="main sign text" default="おやすみなさい バルス"} Add a small hanging label in the upper right corner with vertical black calligraphy text.{argument name="hanging tag text" default="good job"} In the upper left corner of the scene, there are three clearly visible paper lanterns, all cream-colored with red cherry blossom patterns and dark lamp covers. In the bottom corner, there are two partially visible folding fans; the left one is red and blue, and the right one is blue and gold. The background is filled with Japanese-style screens, gold wave patterns, pink cherry blossom branches, falling cherry blossom petals, tassels, soft lantern lighting, and delicate kimono fabric textures, presenting a dreamlike, highly detailed GPT-image-2 anime illustration quality. It uses a 4:3 vertical composition and contains no modern objects except for the obscuring squares.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张细节丰富、采用暖色调柔和配色的动漫风格日本祭典睡前插画。画面中两名可爱的年轻女性身着华丽的花卉和服，紧靠在一起，背景为装饰性的和纸与樱花：左侧女孩留着 {argument name="left character hair color" default="柔粉色"} 短波波头，长刘海遮住一只眼睛，露出的眼睛呈粉红色，面带灿烂的露齿笑容，脸颊泛红，佩戴着带有垂坠流苏的精致樱花丝带发饰；右侧女孩留着 {argument name="right character hair color" default="淡天蓝色"} 短波波头，身着同色系花卉和服，佩戴类似的樱花流苏发饰，她的脸部被一个位于中心、呈半透明方形的灰色调淡紫色渐变至桃色的遮挡块覆盖。两名女孩在前景共同手持一块大型横向长方形纸质标牌，标牌采用旧奶油色纸张，配有红棕色木质边框、樱花装饰、底部系有红色丝带蝴蝶结，并写有醒目的黑色日文书法 {argument name="main sign text" default="おやすみなさい バルス"}。在右上角添加一个较小的悬挂式标签，上面写有竖排黑色书法 {argument name="hanging tag text" default="お疲れ様"}。场景左上方有三个清晰可见的纸灯笼，均为奶油色，带有红色樱花图案和深色灯盖，底部角落有两个部分可见的折扇，左侧为红蓝配色，右侧为蓝金配色。背景填充日本图案屏风、金色波浪纹样、粉色樱花枝、飘落的樱花瓣、流苏、柔和的灯笼环境光、细腻的和服织物纹理，呈现出梦幻般高细节的 GPT-image-2 动漫插画质感，采用 4:3 竖构图，除遮挡方块外不包含任何现代物品。

templates.title: Minimalist Carnation Mother's Day Wallpaper

titleLocalized.zh: 极简康乃馨母亲节壁纸

templates.prompt: Create a minimalist vertical Mother's Day mobile wallpaper with a warm off-white paper texture background, centered composition, and ample white space. At the top, place oversized, elegant black Japanese calligraphy with the following text:{argument name="character name" default="かのん"} It features a soft, handwritten stroke. Below it, add a capital serif greeting.{argument name="main greeting" default="HAPPY MOTHER’S DAY"} The layout uses classic black and white. At the center is a realistic bouquet of pressed carnations and eucalyptus leaves, with stems visually overlapping and tapering downwards. It includes 14 clearly visible carnations in shades of pink, coral, peach, orange, cream, pale yellow, and red, along with 8 small green buds, slender dark green stems, and rounded eucalyptus leaves that gently spread to the left and right. Below the bouquet is a second line of centered, large serif capital greetings.{argument name="lower greeting" default="HAPPY MOTHER’S DAY"} In the bottom left corner, there are three lines of small black sans-serif text: "Gratitude & Love," "Always cherished," and "HAPPY MOTHER'S DAY." In the bottom right corner, there are two lines of small black sans-serif text: "TO THE MOST WONDERFUL MOTHER" and{argument name="signature name" default="KANON"} Employing refined Japanese greeting card aesthetics, the design features natural light illumination, delicate shadows around the flowers, and realistic botanical details. The layout is as clean as a high-end magazine, with no borders and no superfluous elements.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖版极简风格的母亲节手机壁纸，背景采用温暖的米白色纸张纹理，构图居中，留白充裕。在顶部，放置超大号优雅的黑色日式书法，内容为 {argument name="character name" default="かのん"}，呈现柔和的手写笔触。在其正下方，添加主衬线大写问候语 {argument name="main greeting" default="HAPPY MOTHER’S DAY"}，采用黑色经典编辑排版。在中心位置，排列一束写实的压花风格康乃馨与尤加利叶花束，花茎视觉上交叠并向下收拢；包含 14 朵清晰可见的康乃馨，颜色涵盖粉色、珊瑚色、桃色、橙色、奶油色、浅黄色和红色，另有 8 个绿色小花苞、纤细的深绿色花茎以及向左右轻柔舒展的圆形尤加利叶。在花束下方，添加第二行居中的大号衬线大写问候语 {argument name="lower greeting" default="HAPPY MOTHER’S DAY"}。在左下角，包含三行黑色小号无衬线文字：“Gratitude & Love”、“Always cherished” 和 “HAPPY MOTHER’S DAY”。在右下角，包含两行黑色小号无衬线文字：“TO THE MOST WONDERFUL MOTHER” 和 {argument name="signature name" default="KANON"}。采用精致的日式贺卡美学，自然光照明，花朵周围带有细腻阴影，呈现写实的植物细节，布局如高端杂志般整洁，无边框，无多余元素。

templates.title: Elegant Carnation Mother's Day Wallpaper

titleLocalized.zh: 优雅康乃馨母亲节壁纸

templates.prompt: Create a minimalist vertical Mother's Day wallpaper poster with a warm ivory paper background, featuring soft natural shadows and ample white space. Place a delicate bouquet of carnations at the center, comprising five visible blooms: a large pale pink carnation in the upper left, an unopened pale pink bud in the upper center, a peach carnation in the middle, a soft yellow carnation on the right, and a pink carnation near the bottom center; including slender green stems, narrow leaves, and three small buds, creating a realistic pressed flower photograph effect, complemented by soft studio lighting. Overlay striking and elegant black Japanese calligraphy above the center of the bouquet, the text of which is {argument name="main Japanese word" default="かのん"} Then, a neat, high-contrast serif title is placed in the lower center, containing the following content:{argument name="main headline" default="HAPPY MOTHER’S DAY"} It uses a slim Didot-style font and elegant curves. Four small black information blocks with letter spacing are added: the top left corner is {argument name="top left message" default="To the most wonderful mother, thank you. With all my love."} The upper right corner is{argument name="top right message" default="MOTHER’S DAY THANK YOU ALWAYS."} The bottom left corner is{argument name="bottom left message" default="You are my love, my strength, my everything."} The bottom right corner is{argument name="bottom right message" default="Wishing you a beautiful day filled with love and happiness."} Maintaining an ethereal, elegant, and graceful composition, it presents a modern Japanese editing style, featuring clear layout, realistic floral textures, subtle shadows, and the aesthetics of a high-end greeting card.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张极简主义的竖版母亲节壁纸海报，背景为温暖的象牙色纸张，带有柔和的自然阴影和充足的留白。在中心位置布置一束精致的康乃馨，包含 5 朵可见的花头：左上方 1 朵大型淡粉色康乃馨，上方中心 1 朵未开的淡粉色花蕾，中间 1 朵桃色康乃馨，右侧 1 朵柔黄色康乃馨，下方中心附近 1 朵粉色康乃馨；包含纤细的绿色茎秆、窄叶和 3 个小花蕾，呈现为逼真的压花摄影效果，并配以柔和的摄影棚灯光。在花束的中上方叠加非常醒目且优雅的黑色日式书法，内容为 {argument name="main Japanese word" default="かのん"}，随后在中下方放置一行精致的高对比度衬线标题，内容为 {argument name="main headline" default="HAPPY MOTHER’S DAY"}，采用纤细的 Didot 风格字体和优美的曲线。添加 4 个带有字间距的小型黑色信息块：左上角为 {argument name="top left message" default="To the most wonderful mother, thank you. With all my love."}，右上角为 {argument name="top right message" default="MOTHER’S DAY THANK YOU ALWAYS."}，左下角为 {argument name="bottom left message" default="You are my love, my strength, my everything."}，右下角为 {argument name="bottom right message" default="Wishing you a beautiful day filled with love and happiness."}。保持构图空灵、优雅、柔美，呈现现代日式编辑风格，具备清晰的排版、逼真的花卉质感、微妙的阴影以及高端贺卡的审美。

templates.title: Twin Kimono Cherry Blossom Watercolor

titleLocalized.zh: 双子和服樱花水彩

templates.prompt: Create a delicate anime-style Japanese ink and watercolor illustration on a warm, off-white textured paper background. In the foreground, two similar-looking young twin girls are precisely depicted, standing closely together, gently holding hands, heads close, their faces bearing gentle, tired yet contented smiles. The girl on the left possesses {argument name="left hair color" default="Short pinkish-blue hair"} The girl on the right has blue eyes and wears a blue floral kimono with a large blue sash knot, white cherry blossom patterns, and tassels. A small cherry blossom is tucked into her hair.{argument name="right hair color" default="Short, soft pink hair"} Pink eyes, wearing a pale pink floral kimono with a large rose pink sash knot, gold embellishments, and tassel decorations, and adorned with cherry blossom hair ornaments. The painting employs delicate lines, semi-transparent watercolor washes, splattered ink textures, and soft, bright shadows. Behind them, a hazy monochrome ink landscape painting is depicted, containing three main background elements: a pale red sun or moon in the upper left center, faintly visible gray-ink mountains, and a distant Japanese temple gate or shrine building in the upper right. Cherry blossom branches are added at the top and right, embellished with many soft pink petals and dark, freehand ink strokes. On the left, a vertical column of bold black Japanese calligraphy is added, containing the following text:{argument name="calligraphy text" default="Thank you for your hard work today."} And stamp a red seal near the lower left corner. The composition should be a vertical portrait format, romantic and serene, blending traditional Japanese ink painting, watercolor painting and exquisite modern anime character art, creating an elegant farewell atmosphere for a spring night.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅精致的动漫风格日本水墨水彩插画，背景为温暖的米白色纹理纸。画面前景中精确描绘了 2 名长相相似的年轻双胞胎女孩，她们紧紧站在一起，轻轻牵着手，头靠着头，脸上带着温柔、疲惫但满足的微笑。左侧女孩拥有 {argument name="left hair color" default="短粉蓝色头发"}、蓝色眼睛，身着带有大蓝色腰带结、白色樱花图案、流苏装饰的蓝色花卉和服，发间别着小樱花。右侧女孩拥有 {argument name="right hair color" default="短柔粉色头发"}、粉色眼睛，身着带有大玫瑰粉色腰带结、金色点缀、流苏装饰的淡粉色花卉和服，并配有樱花发饰。采用细腻的线条、半透明的水彩渲染、泼墨质感以及柔和明亮的阴影。在她们身后，绘制一幅朦胧的单色水墨山水画，包含 3 个主要的背景元素：左上方偏中心处的一轮淡红色太阳或月亮、灰墨色的隐约山脉，以及右上方远处的日本寺庙大门或神社建筑。在顶部和右侧添加樱花枝，点缀许多柔和的粉色花瓣和深色写意的墨迹。在左侧，加入一列竖排的粗体黑色日本毛笔书法，内容为 {argument name="calligraphy text" default="本日もお疲れさまでした"}，并在左下角附近盖上一枚红色印章。构图应为竖向肖像格式，浪漫而宁静，融合了传统的日本水墨画、水彩画和精致的现代动漫人物艺术，营造出优雅的春夜告别氛围。

templates.title: Funny comic strip: Horses on the roadside

titleLocalized.zh: 搞笑漫画路边马匹场景

templates.prompt: Create a single black-and-white comic panel using refined seinen (young adult comic) line art, with halftone shading and a thick black rectangular border. The scene is set on a rural fantasy roadside under a bright, cloudy sky, with a background of distant mountains, trees, fence posts, rocks, grass, and a wooden road sign pointing to the right, which reads:{argument name="road sign text" default="The path towards hope (probably) →"} In the center of the foreground lies a massive, dead horse, lying on its side, eyes closed, legs bent, a tiny, ghostly wisp rising from its back, displaying a dizzying, deathly expression. To its left stands an elegant blonde noblewoman, dressed in a ruffled Gothic Lolita dress, a dark coat, a cinched waist, and a ribbon, her curly hair tied in a bow; her face is blurred by a soft gray rectangle, she confidently crosses her arms, a glittering symbol beside her hinting at her smug certainty. Above her is a vertical oval Japanese speech bubble, containing…{argument name="left speech bubble text" default="This is torture."} Standing to the right was a young woman with long black hair, dressed in a simple shirt and vest dress, her face also blurred by a soft gray rectangle; she raised a finger to her chin in confusion, a small question mark above her head. Above her was a vertical oval Japanese speech bubble, containing the following text:{argument name="right speech bubble text" default="What is this?"} The image must contain exactly two human characters, exactly two large speech bubbles, exactly one question mark, exactly one flashing symbol, exactly one wooden road sign, exactly one dead horse, and exactly one puff of ghostly smoke. It should employ clear ink lines, expressive cartoon composition, realistic background textures, an absurd fantasy comedy tone, and a high-resolution monochrome print style.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅黑白漫画单格，采用精细的青年漫画（seinen）线条艺术，带有网点阴影和粗黑矩形边框。场景设定在明亮多云天空下的乡村奇幻路边，背景有远山、树木、栅栏柱、岩石、草丛，以及一个指向右侧的木制路标，上面写着 {argument name="road sign text" default="希望に向かう道（たぶん）→"}。前景中央躺着一匹巨大的死马，侧身倒地，双眼紧闭，腿部弯曲，背部升起一团微小的幽灵状灵魂，显示出眩晕的死亡表情。左侧站着一位优雅的金发贵族女性，身穿荷叶边哥特萝莉裙、深色外套、束腰、系着丝带，卷发扎着蝴蝶结；她的面部被柔和的灰色矩形模糊遮挡，她自信地交叉双臂，身旁的一个闪光符号暗示着她那沾沾自喜的笃定。她上方有一个垂直的椭圆形日文对话气泡，内容为 {argument name="left speech bubble text" default="これは生殺しです"}。右侧站着一位留着长黑发的年轻女性，身穿简单的衬衫和背心裙，面部同样被柔和的灰色矩形模糊遮挡；她困惑地抬起一根手指抵住下巴，头顶上方有一个小问号。她上方有一个垂直的椭圆形日文对话气泡，内容为 {argument name="right speech bubble text" default="これは何ですか？"}。画面需包含恰好 2 名人类角色、恰好 2 个大型对话气泡、恰好 1 个问号符号、恰好 1 个闪光符号、恰好 1 个木制路标、恰好 1 匹死马以及恰好 1 团幽灵烟雾。采用清晰的墨线勾勒、富有表现力的漫画构图、写实的背景纹理、荒诞的奇幻喜剧基调以及高分辨率的单色印刷风格。

templates.title: Anime Schoolgirl on Pink Slime

titleLocalized.zh: 粉色史莱姆上的动漫女学生

templates.prompt: Create a delicate anime-style illustration depicting a young female student, and keep it.{argument name="hair color" default="Glossy Black"} With short, wavy hair and loose curls on the sides, adorned with a pink cherry blossom hair clip, she sits adorably atop a giant, translucent pink slime mascot. Her face is partially obscured by a soft, square privacy blur effect, while the rest of the character displays sharp detail. She wears a Japanese sailor uniform, including a white long-sleeved top, navy blue collar and cuffs, a bright light blue scarf, a dark navy blue pleated skirt, white socks, and chunky grey sneakers with pink accents. In her left hand, she holds a tall strawberry soft serve ice cream cone wrapped in pink wrapper and adorned with a heart pattern. The slime is round, glossy, and bubbly, translucent, with a simple smiley face, subtle blush, and bright white highlights. The character is slightly turned to the side, one hand resting on the slime, with both feet on the ground. A soft, warm grey studio background, accented with subtle white glitter, and a golden star-shaped glitter on each side of the character, combined with delicate rim lighting, pastel colors, clean lines, highly detailed folds, and glossy reflections, creates a charmingly kawaii atmosphere. The composition is square, the entire image is visible, the main subject is in the center, and there is no text.

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博猫娘女仆比耶姿势

templates.prompt: Create a vibrant, single-panel anime sticker-style illustration depicting a cheerful cat-eared maid idol, using a dynamic pop art composition. The character is a young anime girl with {argument name="hair color" default="Bright hot pink"} She had a short bob haircut, fluffy cat ears, a white ruffled maid headband, a blue star hair clip, huge, sparkling blue eyes with yellow star-shaped pupils, small fangs, and a happy, open-mouthed smile. She wore a navy blue and white futuristic maid outfit with puff sleeves, a white apron, ruffled details, and a huge {argument name="bow color" default="Electric Blue"} The character is adorned with bows, neon cyan and magenta geometric decorations, wristbands, and a small cat-shaped robot pouch hanging from her waist. She is presented from a dynamic, close-up fisheye lens perspective, her body leaning towards the viewer, one hand making an exaggerated peace sign in the foreground, the other making the same gesture beside her face, emphasizing exaggerated perspective and playful idol energy. The image includes two adorable floating robot cat mascots: a robot cat with a white speech bubble outline in the upper left, complete with a black number smiley face and headphones; and a smaller matching robot cat pouch at her waist. The characters are outlined with thick white stickers and striking black shading. The background should be a highly saturated comic book pop art explosion effect.{argument name="main background colors" default="Electric blue, hot pink, yellow and white"} It incorporates halftone dots, jagged lightning bolts, sharp speed lines, and graphic decals. It includes three striking star decals: a pink outline star at the top, a yellow star in the center left, and a small white glitter at the top; and a pink heart decal in the lower left. Using clean, crisp lines, glossy highlights, cel shadows, and ultra-high contrast, it presents a cyberpunk catgirl/maid aesthetic, with a vertical portrait composition, no text, and no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张充满活力的单格动漫贴纸风格插画，描绘一位开朗的猫耳女仆偶像，采用动感的波普艺术构图。角色是一位年轻的动漫少女，拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="亮热粉色"} 的短波波头、毛茸茸的猫耳、白色荷叶边女仆发带、蓝色星星发夹、巨大的闪亮蓝色眼睛配黄色星形瞳孔、小虎牙以及开心的张嘴笑容。她身穿海军蓝白配色的未来感女仆装，带有泡泡袖、白色围裙、荷叶边装饰、领口处有一个巨大的 {argument name="bow color" default="电光蓝"} 蝴蝶结、霓虹青色和洋红色的几何装饰、腕带，腰间还挂着一个小巧的猫型机器人小包。让她以动态的鱼眼镜头近景视角呈现，身体向观众倾斜，一只手在前景做出夸张的剪刀手比耶姿势，另一只手在脸旁做出同样的姿势，强调夸张的透视感和俏皮的偶像活力。画面中包含 2 个可爱的漂浮机器猫吉祥物：左上方有一个白色对话框轮廓的机器猫，带有黑色数字笑脸和耳机；腰间还有一个较小的配套机器猫小包。用粗厚的白色贴纸轮廓和醒目的黑色阴影线勾勒角色。背景应为高饱和度的漫画波普艺术爆炸效果，采用 {argument name="main background colors" default="电光蓝、热粉色、黄色和白色"}，并加入半调网点、锯齿状闪电、锐利的速度线和图形贴花。包含 3 个醒目的星星贴花：顶部一个粉色轮廓星，左中位置一个黄色星星，顶部一个小巧的白色闪光；左下方包含 1 个粉色爱心贴花。使用清晰利落的线条、光泽高光、赛璐珞阴影、超高对比度，呈现赛博猫娘女仆美学，垂直肖像构图，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: A desolate comic panel: Dead Horse

titleLocalized.zh: 凄凉的漫画分镜：死马

templates.prompt: Create a black-and-white comic panel, employing fine pen-and-ink line art and halftone paper shadow effects. The image is outlined by a thin rectangular border, with a large area of ​​white space in the background. In the center foreground, a emaciated, lying dead horse or donkey lies on its side, its ribs and bones clearly visible, its limbs bent in a bizarre posture, its head submerged in a pool of dark blood or shadow, surrounded by scattered dirt and pebbles; use bold, cross-hatching and realistic anatomical details to render the animal. On the left stands a young woman turned to the right, wearing a dark long-sleeved shirt, long skirt, and black ankle boots, with straight, long black hair and her hands in her pockets; cover her face with an opaque, soft gray rectangular blur mask. On the right stands another young woman turned to the left, wearing a light-colored lantern-sleeved shirt, high-waisted long skirt, short socks, and flat shoes, with short curly hair; cover her face with an opaque, soft gray rectangular blur mask. Add two vertical Japanese speech bubbles: the bubble next to the dark-haired woman on the left contains…{argument name="left speech bubble text" default="This is worse than death."} The speech bubble next to the short-haired woman on the right contains:{argument name="right speech bubble text" default="What's this?"} The composition remains quiet, calm, and unsettling, presenting a style reminiscent of young adult comics, featuring high contrast, minimalist background details, clear ink lines, and delicate halftone textures.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅黑白分明的漫画分镜，采用精细的钢笔线条艺术和网点纸阴影效果，画面由细长的矩形边框勾勒，背景大面积留白。画面中心前景处躺着一匹瘦骨嶙峋、侧卧的死马或驴，肋骨和骨骼清晰可见，四肢弯曲姿态怪异，头部沉入一滩深色的血迹或阴影中，周围散落着泥土和小石块；使用粗犷的交叉排线和写实的解剖细节来渲染动物。左侧站着一名侧身向右的年轻女性，身穿深色长袖衬衫、长裙和黑色短靴，留着直长黑发，双手插在口袋里；在其面部覆盖一层不透明的柔灰色矩形模糊遮罩。右侧站着另一名侧身向左的年轻女性，身穿浅色灯笼袖衬衫、高腰长裙、短袜和平底鞋，留着短卷发；在其面部覆盖一层不透明的柔灰色矩形模糊遮罩。添加 2 个垂直的日语对话气泡：左侧深发女性旁的气泡内容为 {argument name="left speech bubble text" default="这是生不如死"}，右侧短发女性旁的气泡内容为 {argument name="right speech bubble text" default="这是什么？"}。保持构图安静、冷静且令人不安，呈现出青年漫画的风格，具备高对比度、极简的背景细节、清晰的墨线勾勒以及细腻的网点纹理。

templates.title: Hardbass, the Cat-Eared Girl, Alley Dancer

titleLocalized.zh: 猫耳少女 Hardbass 巷舞者

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic, realistic cityscape at night, set in a narrow, damp brick alley after the rain. The main characters are two anime-style cat-eared street dancers, their faces obscured by soft, square blurs. The dancer on the left is wearing {argument name="left outfit color" default="White"} Wearing a zip-up tracksuit with black three stripes, white sneakers, a small black paw print badge on the chest, black cat ears, and extremely long black hair adorned with red highlights, red beaded tassels, and flower hair accessories; she crouches in a dynamic breakdancing pose, one leg kicking out towards the camera, one hand raised in a gesture, and the other bent to cover her face. The dancer on the right is wearing {argument name="right outfit color" default="black"} She wears a zip-up tracksuit with white three stripes, black platform shoes, a white paw print badge on her chest, white cat ears, and extremely long, flowing silver-white hair adorned with black flower hair accessories. She mirrors the same low-squatting dance pose, one leg extended forward, one hand raised in a gesture, and the other bent to cover her face. The background includes five indistinct figures in dark streetwear: one standing in the far center, one crouching behind the dancer, one between the two, and two on the far right. To the left is a dark, old sedan with bright headlights and a clearly visible Russian license plate, next to which is graffiti.{argument name="graffiti text" default="HARD BASS"} and{argument name="secondary graffiti" default="CYKA"} The image is accompanied by a simple cat graffiti. The alleyway should feature black brick walls, metal fire escape ladders, overhead industrial lights, hazy backlighting, puddles, luminous reflections, dramatic rim lighting, shallow depth of field, and kicking shoes and flying hair with motion blur, presenting a high-contrast cyberpunk street photography style. The fabric folds are extremely detailed, with a wet asphalt texture, and the shot is taken from a low-angle, wide-angle perspective. It utilizes the rough yet refined aesthetic style of 2026 AI imagery, realistic lighting, a 4:3 composition, and contains no other identifiable text besides the graffiti and license plates, and has no additional main subject.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个电影级的写实城市夜景，场景位于雨后狭窄潮湿的砖砌巷弄中，主角为两名动漫风格的猫耳街舞少女，面部均由柔和的方形模糊块遮挡。左侧舞者身穿 {argument name="left outfit color" default="白色"} 拉链运动服，配有黑色三条纹、白色运动鞋，胸前有小型黑色爪印徽章，佩戴黑色猫耳，留着极长的黑发，发间带有红色挑染、红色珠串流苏及花朵发饰；她以动态的霹雳舞姿势低蹲，一条腿向镜头踢出，一只手举起做手势，另一只手弯曲遮住面部。右侧舞者身穿 {argument name="right outfit color" default="黑色"} 拉链运动服，配有白色三条纹、黑色厚底鞋，胸前有白色爪印徽章，佩戴白色猫耳，留着极长的银白色飘逸长发，带有黑色花朵发饰；她以同样的低蹲舞姿镜像呈现，一条腿向前伸展，一只手举起做手势，另一只手弯曲遮住面部。背景中包含 5 名穿着深色街头服饰的模糊路人：一人站在中心远处，一人蹲在舞者身后，一人位于两人之间，两人位于最右侧。左侧放置一辆深色旧轿车，车头灯明亮，挂有清晰的俄式车牌，旁边涂鸦写着 {argument name="graffiti text" default="HARD BASS"} 和 {argument name="secondary graffiti" default="CYKA"}，并附有一个简单的猫咪涂鸦。巷弄应具备黑色砖墙、金属消防梯、头顶工业灯、朦胧的背光、水洼、光亮的倒影、戏剧性的轮廓光、浅景深，踢出的鞋子和飞扬的头发带有动态模糊，呈现高对比度的赛博朋克街头摄影风格，布料褶皱极其细腻，具有湿润的沥青质感，采用地面低角度广角拍摄。使用 2026 年 AI 图像的粗砺而精致的美学风格，写实光影，4:3 构图，除涂鸦和车牌外，画面中不包含其他可辨识的文字，且没有额外的主角。

templates.title: Sakura School Dating Sim thumbnail

titleLocalized.zh: Sakura School Dating Sim 缩略图

templates.prompt: Create a bright, anime-style YouTube thumbnail in a 16:9 landscape ratio, set against the backdrop of a Japanese school gate in springtime when cherry blossoms are in full bloom. Four high school girls stand side-by-side on the right side of the image, wearing matching uniforms: dark green sailor-style blazers with white trim, large burgundy bows, mustard yellow pleated skirts, white socks, and brown loafers. Each girl carries a brown leather backpack. The four girls should have different hairstyles and hair colors: long, flowing pink hair, short, wavy light brown hair, long blonde hair, and long, straight black hair. Keep their faces slightly blurred or without features so the thumbnail emphasizes the concept rather than individual identities. The background should include the school gate, the outline of the school buildings, blue sky, sunlight, lush pink cherry blossom trees, and falling cherry petals, presenting a refined, colorful anime/game texture, high saturation, clear lighting effects, and a cheerful, romantic spring atmosphere. On the left side of the image, add prominent, large Japanese text for the thumbnail.{argument name="headline text" default="もっと！モット！ときめき'99"} The text uses bold, rounded font with white fill, accented with vibrant pink outlines and warm orange shadows, dynamically arranged to emphasize "Mot!" and "'99". Small decorative hearts, glitter, and underlined finishes are added around the text. The overall composition references the style of a nostalgic dating sim with a click-and-ready feel: the character is on the right, the text dominates on the left, a vibrant diagonal layout, glossy highlights, clear and legible typography, cinematic depth of field, and floating petals in the foreground. No additional characters, logos, or watermarks are included in the image.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 16:9 横屏比例的明亮动漫风格 YouTube 缩略图，背景设定在春季樱花盛开的日本学校门口。在画面右侧并排站立 4 名高中女生，她们穿着统一的制服：深绿色水手风西装外套配白色滚边、深酒红色大蝴蝶结、芥末黄色百褶裙、白色短袜、棕色乐福鞋，每人手中都在身前拿着一个棕色皮质书包。4 名少女需拥有不同的发型和发色：长长的飘逸粉发、短波浪浅棕发、长金发以及长直黑发。保持她们的面部轻微模糊或无五官，以便缩略图强调概念而非个人身份。背景应包含校门、学校建筑轮廓、蓝天、阳光、繁茂的粉色樱花树以及纷飞的樱花瓣，呈现出精致的彩色动漫游戏质感、高饱和度、清晰的灯光效果以及欢快浪漫的春日氛围。在画面左侧，添加醒目的日文大号缩略图文字 {argument name="headline text" default="もっと！モット！ときめき'99"}，使用粗圆体字，白色填充，配以鲜艳的粉色描边和暖橙色阴影，动态排列并着重突出“モット!”和“'99”。在文字周围添加小巧的装饰性爱心、闪光和下划线扫尾效果。整体构图参考具有点击欲望的怀旧恋爱模拟游戏风格：角色位于右侧，文字占据左侧主导地位，采用充满活力的对角线布局，具有光泽感的高光、清晰易读的排版、电影般的景深，前景点缀漂浮的花瓣，画面中不包含额外角色、Logo 或水印。

templates.title: Steampunk Robot Movie Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 蒸汽朋克机器人电影海报

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic vertical animated movie poster with a warm, Disney/Pixar-style 3D adventure visual effect. The background is set in a vast and fantastical steampunk robot city at sunset, with shimmering clouds, towering towers, bridges, and pipes in the distance, and airships and small drones weaving through them. The foreground is adorned with flowers and lush greenery. In the lower left foreground, display a character named {argument name="character name" default="Bokuto"} A little boy, crouching on the edge of a grassy rooftop, wearing a blue hoodie, khaki shorts, and grey sneakers, with messy brown hair, gently leads a rusty, ball-headed robot across from him, his face deliberately obscured by smooth rectangular blur/blanks. The protagonist robot has a metallic body, a round head, a glowing blue camera eye, antennas, jointed arms and legs, and is covered in scratches, dents, and rivets, its posture full of warmth. Add two small companions near the bottom right corner: a fluffy puppy and a small, square, black-screen robot with green eyes. The background should create a grand and magical atmosphere, with towering industrial buildings dotted with tiny lights, balconies, antennas, and signs, bathed in golden sunrise/sunset rim light and soft atmospheric mist. Place the Japanese poster text at the top center.{argument name="top tagline" default="With you by my side, I'm sure we can go anywhere."} And place a glowing sign on the building to the left with the text "{argument name="side sign text" default="Even if broken, the heart can still be moved."} At the bottom center, add a realistic movie logo typography: above it is the small studio text "Disney PIXAR," followed by the title line "ぼくと," and above that is a large hand-drawn Japanese main title.{argument name="main title" default="おんぼろロボット"} The first character is a warm yellow, while the rest are in a cream-colored textured font. A slogan is added below.{argument name="bottom tagline" default="きみがくれた、たからもの。"} A small, fake cast and crew list, along with the release information "To the moving adventure in Spring 2025." It employs dramatic composition, high detail, depth of field, volumetric lighting, painterly realism, a touching family film tone, and authentic Japanese movie poster layout.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影级竖版动画电影海报，采用温馨的迪士尼/皮克斯风格 3D 冒险视觉效果。背景设定在日落时分广阔而奇幻的蒸汽朋克机器人城市中，云层闪烁着光芒，远处矗立着高塔、桥梁、管道，空中飞艇与小型无人机穿梭其中，前景点缀着花朵与茂密的绿植。在左下角前景处，展示一名名为 {argument name="character name" default="Bokuto"} 的小男孩，他蹲在长满草的屋顶边缘，身穿蓝色连帽衫、卡其色短裤和灰色运动鞋，留着凌乱的棕色头发；他的脸部特意用平滑的矩形模糊/空白遮盖，正温柔地牵着对面一个生锈的球头小机器人。主角机器人拥有金属质感的身体、圆头、一只发光的蓝色摄像头眼睛、天线、关节手臂与腿部，身上布满划痕、凹痕和铆钉，姿态充满温情。在右下角附近添加两个小型伙伴：一只毛茸茸的小狗和一个带有绿色眼睛的方块状黑屏小机器人。背景应营造出宏大而神奇的氛围，高耸的工业建筑上布满了微小的灯光、阳台、天线和招牌，沐浴在金色的日出/日落轮廓光和柔和的大气薄雾中。在顶部中央放置日文海报文案 {argument name="top tagline" default="キミがいれば、きっと、どこへでも行ける。"}，并在左侧建筑上放置一个发光的招牌，文字为 {argument name="side sign text" default="壊れていても、心は動く。"}。在底部中央，添加逼真的电影 Logo 排版：上方是小号工作室文字“Disney PIXAR”，接着是标题行“ぼくと”，上方是巨大的手绘日文主标题 {argument name="main title" default="おんぼろロボット"}，其中第一个字符为暖黄色，其余为米白色纹理字体。下方添加标语 {argument name="bottom tagline" default="きみがくれた、たからもの。"}、一小块伪造的演职员表，以及上映信息“2025年 春 感動の冒険へ”。采用戏剧性的构图、高细节、景深、体积光、绘画般的写实感、感人的家庭电影基调以及地道的日式电影海报排版。

templates.title: Street portrait with cat ears in the rain

titleLocalized.zh: 雨中猫耳街头肖像

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic, realistic fashion portrait with a vertical composition, set against a rainy city alleyway. In the image, a {argument name="character name" default="young women"} She crouched on the damp asphalt, holding a large, transparent plastic umbrella covered in raindrops. Her hair was wet {argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown"} Long hair with straight bangs, oversized black headphones with streamlined black cat-ear decorations, and a deliberately soft-focused face shrouded in shadow/blurring, presenting an anonymous, editorial style. She wore a {argument name="outfit color" default="gray-blue"} A cropped hooded sweatshirt with a distressed off-the-shoulder cut is paired with matching shorts, black socks, and futuristic platform sneakers in purple, white, and black. One of the sneakers is exaggeratedly magnified in the foreground through a wide-angle perspective effect. She crouches forward, gripping an umbrella handle tightly, while a gray tabby kitten curls up against the half-zipped chest of her sweatshirt, staring at the camera. The image includes an umbrella, a kitten, cat-ear headphones, platform sneakers, and five transparent bubbles floating around the main subject. Pale pink cherry blossom petals are scattered on the ground, reflecting in puddles. Raindrops fall, and the background is a blurred gray urban landscape. The overall composition uses a cool blue-gray tone with a shallow depth of field, presenting a glossy, wet texture and creating a melancholic atmosphere. The light is soft and diffused, the raindrops on the umbrella are richly detailed, the fabric texture is realistic, and the composition uses a low angle to present a dreamlike, high-end street photography quality, with an aspect ratio of 9:16.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张垂直构图的电影级写实时尚肖像，背景为雨中的城市小巷。画面中，一名 {argument name="character name" default="年轻女性"} 蹲在潮湿的柏油路面上，撑着一把布满雨滴的大型透明塑料伞。她留着湿润的 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 长发，配有直刘海，佩戴着带有黑色流线型猫耳装饰的超大号黑色耳机，面部刻意处理得柔和并隐没在阴影/模糊中，呈现出一种匿名化的编辑风格。她身穿一件 {argument name="outfit color" default="灰蓝色"} 短款连帽卫衣，带有做旧的露肩剪裁，搭配同色系短裤、黑色短袜以及紫、白、黑配色的未来感厚底运动鞋；其中一只运动鞋在前景中通过广角透视效果被夸张放大。她蹲姿前倾，双手紧握伞柄，一只灰色虎斑小猫蜷缩在她半拉拉链的卫衣胸口处，正注视着镜头。画面包含一把雨伞、一只小猫、一副猫耳耳机、一双厚底运动鞋，以及主体周围漂浮的五个透明气泡。地面散落着淡粉色的樱花花瓣，倒映着水洼，雨丝飘落，背景是模糊的灰色都市建筑，整体采用冷蓝灰色调，浅景深，呈现出光泽感的湿润质感，营造出忧郁的情绪氛围。光线柔和且漫射，雨伞上的雨滴细节丰富，织物纹理真实，构图采用低角度拍摄，呈现出梦幻般的高级街头摄影质感，比例为 9:16。

templates.title: Cat-eared girl and kitten in the rain

titleLocalized.zh: 雨中猫耳少女与小猫

templates.prompt: Create a vertical, cinematic, hyper-realistic street portrait in the rain, featuring a young woman with {argument name="hair color" default="long, wet brown hair"} She crouched on the reflective, damp alleyway floor. Shot from an extremely low, wide-angle perspective, one thick-soled lavender sneaker dominated the foreground, the other shoe positioned behind her. She wore an oversized, distressed blue zip-up hoodie with ripped shoulders and cuffs, paired with black socks and chunky, futuristic headphones topped with two glowing blue-black cat ears. Her face was deliberately obscured by a soft, square, blurred mask positioned in the center. She held a transparent umbrella, its ribs clearly visible, the white handle covered in raindrops, and a furry {argument name="kitten color" default="Cream and gray"} A kitten peeks out from under her hoodie. The scene contains only a woman, a kitten, an umbrella, a pair of headphones with cat ears, and a pair of purple sneakers. A heavy rain falls in a somber city alley, against a backdrop of tall, blurred buildings. Puddles reflect in the ground, scattered with pale pink cherry blossom petals, and large, out-of-focus water droplets float near the lens. The image uses cool blue-purple tones to depict glossy, damp skin and fabric textures, with shallow depth of field, dramatic blurring, high detail, and an emotionally charged rainy atmosphere. It has a fashionable, editorial realism, a 9:16 aspect ratio, and no text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖屏电影感超写实雨中街头肖像，画面中一位年轻女性留着 {argument name="hair color" default="湿漉漉的长棕色头发"}，蹲在反光的湿润巷道地面上。采用极低广角视角拍摄，使一只厚底紫薰衣草色运动鞋占据前景，另一只鞋位于身后。她穿着一件超大号做旧蓝色拉链连帽衫，肩部和袖口有破洞，搭配黑色袜子，戴着厚重的未来感耳机，耳机顶部有两个发光的蓝黑色猫耳装饰。她的面部被一个位于中心位置的柔和方形模糊遮罩刻意遮挡。她撑着一把透明雨伞，伞骨清晰可见，白色伞柄上布满雨滴，一只毛茸茸的 {argument name="kitten color" default="奶油色和灰色"} 小猫从她胸前的连帽衫中探出头来。场景中仅包含一名女性、一只小猫、一把雨伞、一副带两个猫耳的耳机和一双紫色运动鞋。沉郁的城市巷道中下着大雨，背景是高大模糊的建筑，地面有水洼倒影，散落着淡粉色的樱花花瓣，镜头附近有大而失焦的漂浮水滴。采用冷蓝紫色调，呈现光泽感的湿润皮肤和织物纹理，浅景深，戏剧性虚化，高细节，富有情感的雨天氛围，时尚编辑级写实感，9:16 构图，无文字。

templates.title: Reze Prize Figure Product Photography

titleLocalized.zh: Reze 景品手办产品摄影

templates.prompt: Create a high-end studio product photo showcasing a glossy finish.{argument name="character name" default="Reze"} This is an anime prize figure depicting a young woman kneeling on a round, tufted cushion base. The figure has {argument name="hair color" default="Dark purple-black"} She sported a short bob with layered bangs and a low side bun. Her skin was fair, and her face was deliberately softened and blurred, lacking defined facial features. She wore a sleeveless, light lavender white blouse with a small black ribbon tied at the collar, paired with fitted black high-waisted shorts and smooth black over-the-knee socks; the blouse had faint, semi-transparent text on the chest.{argument name="shirt text" default="NOMAI"} She is shown kneeling on a cushion with her knees bent forward, hands supporting her body on either side, torso slightly leaning back, shoulders relaxed, creating the feel of a collectible figure rather than a real person. The base is a circular display stand: a black outer ring, topped with a caramel brown quilted leather cushion with deep button tufting grooves and glossy highlights. Using a clean, seamless white background and soft, diffused studio lighting, the focus is clearly on the figure and base, showcasing the realistic PVC figure material with its delicate skin and fabric sheen. This is a high-end prize figure product photograph, taken from a slightly overhead, three-quarter view, centered composition, without packaging, additional props, or any watermarks except for faint text on the shirt.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高端摄影棚产品照片，展示一个光泽感十足的 {argument name="character name" default="Reze"} 动漫景品手办，呈现为一位年轻女性跪坐在圆形簇绒坐垫底座上的姿态。该手办拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="深紫黑色"} 的短波波头，带有层次感的刘海和一个低位小侧发髻，皮肤白皙，面部刻意处理为柔和模糊状，无清晰五官细节。她身穿一件无袖淡薰衣草白衬衫，领口系着黑色小丝带，搭配修身黑色高腰短裤和光滑的黑色过膝袜；衬衫胸前有隐约的半透明文字 {argument name="shirt text" default="NOMAI"}。让她双膝向前折叠跪在坐垫上，双手分别撑在身体两侧，躯干微微后倾，双肩放松，营造出收藏级比例手办而非真人的质感。底座为一个圆形展示台：黑色外圈，顶部为焦糖棕色绗缝皮革质感坐垫，带有深陷的纽扣簇绒凹槽和光泽高光。使用干净的白色无缝背景，柔和的漫反射摄影棚灯光，焦点清晰地对准手办和底座，呈现真实的 PVC 手办材质，带有细腻的皮肤和布料光泽，高端景品手办产品摄影，从上方略微俯拍的三分之四正面视角，居中构图，无包装，无额外道具，除衬衫上的微弱文字外无任何水印。
