templates.title: Mosaic Idol Girls of Akihabara

titleLocalized.zh: 秋叶原的马赛克偶像少女

templates.prompt: Create a bright, high-resolution anime-style illustration, with the main character being {argument name="character name" default="A cheerful young idol girl"} She stood in the middle of a sun-drenched, Akihabara-style city street. Wide pedestrian crossings lined both sides of the street, and colorful anime billboards, shop signs, posters, and storefronts adorned the high-rise buildings. The character was positioned at mid-body to knee-length, leaning slightly forward, her hands playfully raised to her sides in a greeting gesture, fingers spread. Her face was deliberately obscured by a flat, opaque, warm-toned mosaic square, covering the entire facial area, but her hair and clothing were clearly visible. She had {argument name="hair color" default="Light chestnut brown"} Her hair is styled in twin ponytails with a deep cyan-blue bow, complemented by soft bangs and curled side hair. She's dressed in a soft-toned idol outfit: a light blue short-sleeved shirt with puff sleeves, a white lace collar, ruffles, front buttons, a small side bow, and a large rainbow bow at the chest, paired with a matching pleated skirt. The skirt hem features shimmering holographic rainbow sequins and delicate ruffles. The outfit looks cute, light, and lustrous, with a delicate fabric texture and reflective soft highlights. Vibrant midday sunlight, a clear blue sky, soft shadows, and a background with realistic urban depth are used, with pedestrians and signs slightly blurred while the character remains sharp and detailed. Overall atmosphere: a cheerful morning outing, cute Japanese pop idol fashion, exquisite AI anime illustrations, vibrant colors, clean lines, semi-realistic lighting, and a 1:1 square composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张明亮、高分辨率的动漫风格插画，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="一位开朗的年轻偶像少女"}，她站在阳光明媚的秋叶原风格城市街道中央。街道两旁是宽阔的人行横道，高楼大厦上挂满了色彩缤纷的动漫广告牌、商店招牌、海报和店面。角色处于半身至膝盖的构图，身体微微前倾，双手举在脸侧做出俏皮的问候姿势，手指张开。她的脸部被一个暖肤色的平坦不透明马赛克方块刻意遮挡，覆盖了整个面部区域，但头发和服装清晰可见。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="浅栗棕色"} 的双马尾，发带为深青蓝色蝴蝶结，配有柔和的刘海和卷曲的侧发。为她穿上一套柔和色调的偶像服装：浅蓝色短袖衬衫，带有泡泡袖、白色蕾丝领、荷叶边装饰、前襟纽扣、侧边小蝴蝶结，胸前有一个巨大的虹彩蝴蝶结，搭配同款百褶裙，裙摆带有闪烁的全息彩虹镶片和精致的荷叶边。服装看起来可爱、轻盈且富有光泽，具有细腻的织物纹理和反光的柔和高光。使用生动的正午阳光、晴朗的蓝天、柔和的阴影，以及具有写实城市景深感的背景，行人和招牌略微模糊，而角色保持清晰细腻。整体氛围：愉快的晨间出行，可爱的日本流行偶像时尚，精致的 AI 动漫插画，色彩鲜艳，线条干净，半写实光影，1:1 正方形构图。

templates.title: Moon Silk Glow Anime Makeup Poster

titleLocalized.zh: Moon Silk Glow 动漫美妆海报

templates.prompt: Create a vertical, luxurious beauty brand key visual poster, employing an exquisite anime illustration style with a soft moonlight color palette, including ivory, light pink, silver, black, and deep crimson. The image must accurately depict two elegant female characters, using a close-up composition: on the left is a tall, ethereal woman with extremely long {argument name="left character hair color" default="silver-white"} Her flowing hair, adorned with a red ribbon, and her fair skin were accentuated by a fitted, high-necked, deep red dress with a cutout design at the chest. Her face was deliberately concealed by a soft, beige-gray square veil. To the right in the foreground was a petite cat-eared girl with {argument name="right character hair color" default="Dark brown"} A woman with a high side ponytail tied with a red ribbon, soft brown eyes, black cat ears, and a visible black cat tail, wears an elegant black military-style coat over a white shirt with a white fur collar, black cuffs, gold chain details, and a red gemstone brooch. She poses gracefully, one hand lightly touching her cheek, her gaze directed at the audience, her expression delicate, her lips slightly parted. On the left, in the foreground, a character holds an open, round powder compact. The compact is metallic silver and red with a mirrored lid, and the powder has a star-like highlight and a pale shimmer with tiny red gemstone centers. This creates a dreamy, high-end beauty advertisement atmosphere. Behind the character is a semi-transparent, circular moonlight halo and soft glitter, while the background is interwoven with silky ribbons and curved pale pink and white light trails. Vertical Japanese text is added to the left.{argument name="vertical copy" default="Transform light into elegance."} A large, elegant serif font brand title is placed at the bottom.{argument name="brand headline" default="Moon Silk Glow"} The color is dark burgundy, with a smaller slogan placed in the center at the bottom.{argument name="tagline" default="Catch the quiet light."} Add delicate decorative dividing lines below the slogan, including thin lines, crescent dots, and small starbursts. The overall layout should evoke the feel of a high-end magazine perfume or beauty poster, with clean negative space in the bottom third to showcase ultra-fine hair strands, glossy highlights, soft gradient effects, and delicate romantic lighting, without including any additional logos or characters.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖版奢华美妆主视觉海报，采用精致的动漫插画风格，色调为柔和的月光色系，包含象牙白、淡粉色、银色、黑色和深绯红色。画面中需精确呈现 2 位优雅的女性角色，采用近景构图：左侧为一位高挑空灵的女性，拥有极长的 {argument name="left character hair color" default="银白色"} 飘逸秀发，发后饰有红色丝带，肤色白皙，身着修身的高领深红色礼服，胸前有镂空设计；她的面部被一个柔和的米灰色方形遮挡块刻意隐藏。右侧前景为一位娇小的猫耳少女，留着 {argument name="right character hair color" default="深棕色"} 高侧马尾，系着红色丝带，拥有柔和的棕色眼睛、黑色猫耳及可见的黑色猫尾，身着精致的黑色军装风外套，内搭白色衬衫，配有白色毛领、黑色袖口、金色链条细节及红色宝石胸针。她姿态优雅，一手轻触脸颊，眼神望向观众，表情细腻，双唇微启。左侧角色在画面中左前景处手持 1 个打开的圆形化妆粉饼盒，外壳为金属银色与红色，带有镜盖，粉饼呈现出带有星芒高光和微小红色宝石中心的淡色闪光质感。营造梦幻般的高级美妆广告氛围，角色身后带有半透明的圆形月光光晕、柔和的闪光点，背景中交织着丝绸般的飘带和弯曲的淡粉白色光轨。在左侧添加竖排日文文案 {argument name="vertical copy" default="光を、気品に。"}。底部放置一行优雅的衬线字体品牌大标题 {argument name="brand headline" default="Moon Silk Glow"}，颜色为深酒红色，下方居中放置较小的标语 {argument name="tagline" default="Catch the quiet light."}。在标语下方添加精致的装饰性分割线，包含细线、新月点和小型星芒。整体布局应呈现出高端杂志香水或美妆海报的质感，底部三分之一处留有干净的负空间，展现超细腻的发丝、光泽感高光、柔和的渐变效果及精致的浪漫光影，且不包含额外的标志或角色。

templates.title: Beach blonde anime girl with ice cream

titleLocalized.zh: 海滩金发动漫少女与冰淇淋

templates.prompt: Create a delicate anime-style summer close-up portrait, the main character is {argument name="character name" default="Riona"} A charming young woman, with{argument name="hair color" default="Moist, short platinum blonde hair"} The scene is set in a bright tropical beach café. The composition is a compact, vertical half-body shot taken slightly from above, with a blurred background of turquoise ocean, blue sky, palm trees, and wooden seaside railings. She wears a navy blue blazer with gold trim, over an open white shirt, tied with a large navy blue ribbon bow, and a gold chain necklace with blue star pendants, along with matching star pendant earrings. Her skin shimmers in the sunlight, and water droplets on her neck and chest suggest she has just returned from the beach or pool. In the lower right foreground, a paper cup contains a scoop of pink ice cream with speckles; in the lower left foreground, a hand is showing the viewer a rectangular card or note. The card is placed directly in front of her face, completely obscuring her features with a pure peach-beige rectangle, while her hair, ears, jewelry, shoulders, and clothing are clearly visible around the card. The use of vibrant, saturated colors, high-detail anime-style rendering, soft depth of field, shimmering highlights, and warm sunlight creates a playful summer vacation atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张精致的动漫风格夏季特写肖像，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="Riona"}，一位迷人的年轻女性，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="湿润的短款白金发"}，背景设在明亮的热带海滩咖啡馆。构图为从上方略微俯拍的紧凑垂直半身像，背景是模糊的绿松石色海洋、蓝天、棕榈树和木质海滨护栏。她身穿带有金色镶边的海军蓝西装外套，内搭敞开的白衬衫，系着一个大大的海军蓝丝带蝴蝶结，佩戴着挂有蓝色星星吊坠的金链项链以及配套的星星吊坠耳环。她的皮肤在阳光下闪烁着光泽，颈部和胸前带有水珠，暗示她刚从海滩或泳池回来。右下角前景展示一个纸杯，里面装着带有斑点的粉色冰淇淋球；左下角前景展示一只手正向观众展示一张长方形卡片或便签。卡片直接放置在她的脸部前方，用一个纯桃米色的长方形完全遮住了五官，而她的头发、耳朵、珠宝、肩膀和服装在卡片周围清晰可见。采用鲜艳饱和的色彩、高细节的动漫渲染、柔和的景深、闪烁的高光、温暖的阳光，营造出俏皮的暑假氛围。

templates.title: Blonde female student popsicle diptych

titleLocalized.zh: 金发女学生冰棒双联画

templates.prompt: Create a refined anime-style illustration using a two-panel horizontally stacked layout, separated by a thin white dividing line, showcasing the same character.{argument name="character name" default="Riona"} The image depicts a blonde female student in a brightly lit classroom. The scene consists of two frames: the top frame is a high-angle shot from her upper right, showing her sitting on a wooden classroom chair with a large, sunlit window beside her, holding a light blue popsicle close to her lips; the bottom frame is a close-up shot from the front, showing her holding the same popsicle in one hand, with blurred classroom desks and a blackboard in the background, and a clear blue sky and fluffy white clouds visible outside the window. She has slightly messy, damp hair.{argument name="hair color" default="golden blonde"} A short, golden bob, shimmering in the warm sunlight, with fair skin, wears a seemingly damp white sweatshirt with navy blue trim on the collar and cuffs, and navy blue athletic shorts. Add two star accessories: a blue and gold star necklace pendant and a matching star pendant earring. The scene should evoke a summery, nostalgic feel, with warm afternoon light, glossy highlights, parquet classroom floors, wooden desks, a blackboard background, and soft depth of field. Place a flat, opaque tan masking rectangle in the two-panel face area, consistent with the style of the skin tone masking blocks visible in the image, while preserving the visibility of hair, ears, jewelry, clothing, hands, popsicles, classroom lighting, and window shadows. Use delicate semi-realistic anime rendering, soft painterly shadows, and high-resolution vertical composition.{argument name="aspect ratio" default="3:4"} The color scheme features a good aspect ratio and a bright, clean color palette dominated by white, navy blue, gold, and sky blue.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张精致的动漫风格插画，采用两格水平堆叠的布局，中间由细白色分割线隔开，展示同一位 {argument name="character name" default="Riona"}，即阳光明媚的教室里的一位金发女学生。画面共 2 格：上格为从她右上方俯视的高角度镜头，她坐在木制教室椅子上，身旁是洒满阳光的大窗户，手中拿着一支淡蓝色冰棒靠近嘴边；下格为从正面拍摄的胸部以上特写，她单手拿着同样的冰棒，背景是模糊的教室课桌和黑板，窗外可见湛蓝的天空和朵朵白云。她留着一头略显凌乱、带有湿润感的 {argument name="hair color" default="golden blonde"} 金色短波波头，在温暖的阳光下闪烁光泽，肤色白皙，身穿一件看起来湿漉漉的白色运动衫，领口和袖口有海军蓝镶边，下身穿着海军蓝运动短裤。添加 2 个星星配饰：一个蓝金配色的星星项链吊坠和一只配套的星星吊坠耳环。场景应充满夏日怀旧气息，配以温暖的午后光线、光泽感高光、拼花木教室地板、木制课桌、背景黑板以及柔和的景深效果。在两格画面的面部区域放置平整的不透明棕褐色遮挡矩形，与图片中可见的肤色遮挡块风格一致，同时保留头发、耳朵、首饰、服装、手部、冰棒、教室和窗户光影的可见度。采用细腻的半写实动漫渲染、柔和的绘画式阴影、高分辨率垂直构图、{argument name="aspect ratio" default="3:4"} 宽高比，以及以白色、海军蓝、金色和天蓝色为主调的明亮干净配色。

templates.title: blonde teacher classroom scene

titleLocalized.zh: 金发教师课堂场景

templates.prompt: Create a detailed semi-realistic anime illustration, set in a sunny Japanese high school classroom. The main subject is {argument name="character name" default="Riona"} A plump adult female teacher with messy hair{argument name="hair color" default="Golden yellow"} A woman with a bob haircut stands confidently in front of the green blackboard; her face is deliberately obscured by a pure peach-colored rectangular veil, revealing no facial features. She wears a fitted beige V-neck knit top with sleeves ending at three-quarter length, paired with high-waisted beige trousers and a belt, and adorned with a small turquoise star-shaped pendant necklace, bracelet, and ring; her pose is one hand on her hip, the other index finger pointing upwards, as if reprimanding or explaining classroom rules. In the lower left foreground, a male student in a dark school uniform is shown from the back and side, with messy black hair, holding a mint chocolate chip ice cream in pink wrapper, looking up at the teacher. The classroom contains wooden desks and chairs; an open notebook sits on one student's desk, and a navy blue pencil case sits in the center of the front desk. The blackboard contains text outlining the Japanese classroom rules.{argument name="chalkboard text" default="Classroom rules: No talking allowed. No eating or drinking allowed. No cell phone use allowed. Let's follow the rules and enjoy the class!"} On the wall by the window hangs a white sheet of paper titled "Class Goals," containing five key points: Keep track of time, Be patient, Organize and tidy up, Think things through, and Strive with all your might. The warm afternoon sunlight streaming through the tall classroom window on the left creates a soft, dusty, microscopic effect; the blonde hair has strong contour lighting; realistic fabric folds, delicate chalk texture, cinematic composition, vertical portrait format, high-detail anime rendering, soft pastel tones, and a nostalgic summer classroom atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张精致的半写实动漫插画，场景设定在阳光明媚的日本高中教室。主体是 {argument name="character name" default="Riona"}，一位身材丰满的成年女性教师，留着凌乱的 {argument name="hair color" default="金黄色"} 波波头，自信地站在绿色黑板前；她的脸部被一个纯桃色的矩形遮挡块刻意遮住，没有任何面部特征。她穿着一件修身的米色 V 领针织上衣，袖长至七分，搭配高腰米色长裤和腰带，佩戴一条小巧的绿松石星形吊坠项链、手链和戒指；姿势设定为一只手叉腰，另一只手食指向上指，仿佛在训斥或讲解课堂规则。在左下角的前景中，展示 1 名穿着深色校服的男学生，从背面和侧面视角呈现，留着凌乱的黑发，手里拿着 1 个薄荷巧克力碎冰淇淋，包装纸为粉色，正抬头看着老师。教室里有木制的课桌和椅子，学生桌上放着一本打开的笔记本，前桌中央放着 1 个海军蓝色的铅笔盒。黑板上包含日语课堂规则文字 {argument name="chalkboard text" default="授業中の注意事項
私語厳禁
飲食禁止
携帯電話の使用禁止
ルールを守って
気持ちよく授業を
受けましょう！"}；窗边的墙上贴着 1 张标题为“学級目標”的白纸通知，包含 5 个要点：時間を守る, 挨拶をする, 整理整頓, 思いやり, 全力で取り組む。利用左侧高大教室窗户射入的温暖午后阳光，营造柔和的尘埃微粒感，金发上带有强烈的轮廓光，展现逼真的布料褶皱、细腻的粉笔质感、电影级构图、竖向肖像画幅、高细节动漫渲染、柔和的粉彩色调以及怀旧的夏季教室氛围。

templates.prompt: Create a vibrant vertical anime illustration, with the main character being {argument name="character name" default="Mahilo"} A stylish young woman. She stands sideways on a brightly lit Japanese shopping street, framed by a mid-range composition, presenting a dynamic, low-angle fashion photography perspective. She possesses exceptionally long, flowing {argument name="hair color" default="Blue-green"} Her hair, swaying wildly to the left in the wind, was glossy with highlights, stray strands, and a few tufts of hair; her face was deliberately concealed by a softly edged light beige square visor positioned at the center of her eyes, nose, and mouth. She wore an oversized, shiny white sports jacket with two striking cyan stripes on each sleeve, ribbed cuffs and hem, the fabric exhibiting a slightly wrinkled sheen, and a high collar; paired with tight black shiny shorts. A black backpack slung over her shoulder, its thin straps and clearly visible side pockets with zipper pulls, adorned with a small yellow chick-shaped charm. With one hand in her jacket pocket, her hips slightly turned to the side, and her torso slightly turned away from the audience, she exuded a casual confidence. The background is a narrow, sunlit Japanese city street, lined with tall buildings on both sides, creating a strong sense of perspective. It features a blue sky halo, overhead power lines, shop signs, and a shallow depth of field. The image must contain six precisely defined street sign elements: a large red sign on the left, a blue vertical sign with the number 2 in the upper right corner, a red circular V-shaped sign pointing upwards, a blue circular upward arrow sign, a red and white "No Entry" sign on the left, and a small green diamond sign on the right. It employs saturated cyan and white tones, crisp anime lines, glossy cel shadows, high-contrast sunlight, shimmering dust particles, dynamic hair, and a refined GPT-Image-2 anime visual style. The aspect ratio is 9:16, the composition is simple, there are no superfluous characters, and no text overlays except for blurred environmental markers.

templates.title: Anime Girl High School Guitarist on Stage

titleLocalized.zh: 舞台上的动漫女高中生吉他手

templates.prompt: Create a beautiful vertical anime-style illustration depicting {argument name="character name" default="A teenage high school girl guitarist"} Standing on the dimly lit concert stage, she was bathed in the soft light of a spotlight. She had {argument name="hair color" default="jet black and glossy"} She had a short bob haircut with straight, blunt bangs, and was holding up her side ponytail with both hands. She had fair skin and large, soft grey eyes, and a blue hair tie between her teeth, her expression shy yet focused. She wore a crisp white Japanese sailor-style short-sleeved top with a bright blue scarf, paired with a high-waisted dark blue pleated skirt. A black guitar strap was slung across her shoulder, and she was carrying a bright {argument name="guitar color" default="Cyan"} The electric guitar, featuring a white pickguard, chrome hardware, and a maple neck, is attached to a guitar string and slung diagonally across her body from the lower left to the upper right. To her left is a silver vocal microphone on a black stand, while to her right, in the background, is a black Marshall-style guitar amp with a cream-colored control panel. The stage backdrop is predominantly black, punctuated with tiny, floating white specks, employing dramatic rim lighting, clean cel animation rendering, and delicate highlights on the hair and guitar to showcase realistic instrument details. Soft shadows are created, and the portrait composition is slightly tilted upwards, focusing on the character's upper thighs.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张精致的竖版动漫风格插画，描绘 {argument name="character name" default="一位十几岁的女高中生吉他手"} 站在昏暗的演唱会舞台上，头顶柔和的聚光灯照耀着她。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="乌黑亮丽"} 的短波波头，有着平直的齐刘海，正用双手举起扎着侧马尾，皮肤白皙，有着一双灰色的柔和大眼睛，嘴里衔着一个蓝色发圈，表情羞涩而专注。她穿着一件干练的白色日式水手服短袖上衣，系着亮青色领巾，搭配高腰深蓝色百褶裙。黑色的吉他背带斜跨在肩上，怀抱着一把亮 {argument name="guitar color" default="青蓝色"} 的电吉他，吉他配有白色护板、镀铬金属件和枫木琴颈，连接着吉他线，从左下向右上斜挎在身前。在她的左侧放置一个黑色支架上的银色人声麦克风，右侧背景中放置一个带有奶油色控制面板的黑色 Marshall 风格吉他音箱。使用以黑色为主的舞台背景，点缀着微小的漂浮尘埃状白点，采用戏剧性的轮廓光、干净的赛璐珞动漫渲染，在头发和吉他上添加细腻的高光，展现写实的乐器细节，营造柔和的阴影，并采用略微仰视的肖像构图，聚焦于角色大腿以上的部分。

templates.title: Foggy medieval village scene

titleLocalized.zh: 迷雾中世纪村庄定场镜头

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic wide-angle framing shot to showcase a quiet {argument name="setting" default="Medieval European village square"} The scene, set in a cold, foggy morning, is rendered in a realistic, dark fantasy style. At the center of the scene is a circular stone well with a wooden frame, hanging ropes, and buckets, beside which sits a small wooden barrel, situated on a rugged cobblestone path branching off from the village's half-timbered houses. At least four visible stucco buildings are shown: on the right, a large, weathered two-story house with a drooping shingle roof, porch, barrels, crates, and a small table; on the left and in the midground, two small houses with fenced courtyards; and in the background, a stone church with a bell tower and cross. Added elements include a split wooden fence, muddy grass, scattered stones, worn steps, smoke rising from chimneys, and distant tree silhouettes faintly visible in the fog. Soft tones of gray, brown, moss green, and charcoal black are used, complemented by the overcast sky, damp ground, soft diffused light, low contrast, subtle haze, and a slightly desaturated cinematic quality. The absence of people in the scene creates a sense of abandoned village or pre-dawn tranquility. The composition uses a 16:9 widescreen storyboard aspect ratio, with the well in the center foreground, buildings on either side, and the church tower in the center of the background. Fog and smoke create an atmospheric depth. Overall atmosphere:{argument name="mood" default="gloomy, quiet and ominous"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影级广角定场镜头，展现一个安静的 {argument name="setting" default="中世纪欧洲村庄广场"} 在寒冷多雾的清晨景象，采用写实的黑暗奇幻风格渲染。场景中心是一个带有木框架、悬挂绳索和水桶的圆形石井，井旁放置着小木桶，位于在乡村半木结构房屋间分叉的崎岖鹅卵石路上。展示至少四座可见的木质灰泥建筑：右侧是一座大型风化的两层房屋，带有下垂的木瓦屋顶、门廊、木桶、板条箱和一个小桌子；左侧和中景有两座带围栏院落的小屋；背景中有一座带有钟楼和十字架的石砌教堂。添加木制劈裂栅栏、泥泞的草地、散落的石块、磨损的台阶、从烟囱升起的炊烟，以及在雾气中隐约可见的远处树木剪影。使用灰色、棕色、苔藓绿和炭黑色的柔和色调，配合阴天、潮湿的地面、柔和的漫射光、低对比度、微妙的雾霾以及略微去饱和的电影质感。画面中无人，营造出村庄被遗弃或黎明前的宁静感。构图采用 16:9 的宽屏故事板比例，水井位于下方中心前景，建筑分布在两侧，教堂塔楼位于背景中心，通过雾气和烟雾营造出大气深度。整体氛围：{argument name="mood" default="阴郁、宁静且不祥"}。

templates.prompt: Create a dynamic full-body anime poster illustration, with the main subject being {argument name="character type" default="A humanoid dragon-wolf hybrid warrior"} The background is clean white. The character is in a powerful crouching posture, one knee raised, one hand outstretched revealing sharp claws, the other hand tucked into a hoodie pocket. The character has deep charcoal-black scales or fur, a long, thick tail with red markings, red, spiky, swept-back hair and mane-like neck spikes, towering red and black horns, sharply defined black cheek fins, glowing red eyes, a bared jaw revealing sharp teeth, and red claw tips. Dress the character {argument name="hoodie color" default="A dark red oversized hoodie"} The outfit features white drawstrings, front pockets, and heavy pleats, with a circular emblem of the character's fierce dragon head printed in the center of the chest. A small heart-shaped patch is added to the upper sleeve, and a dark rectangular patch is placed below. It is paired with black tactical work pants with multiple straps, buckles, knee pads, thigh pockets, multi-functional pockets, and loose, pleated fabric. White sneakers with red accents and gray laces complete the look. The character is surrounded by striking red brushstroke-style diagonal effects, curved energy arcs, ink splatters, tiny black fragments, and two sharp red starburst shapes, emphasizing speed and aggression. The artwork employs crisp cel animation line art, high-contrast lighting, dramatic perspective shortening, saturated red highlights, delicate clothing folds, clean white negative space, and a refined character poster composition, devoid of any readable text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张充满动感的全身动漫海报插图，主体为 {argument name="character type" default="一位拟人化的龙狼混血战士"}，背景为干净的白色。角色呈现出强有力的蹲姿，一膝抬起，一只手伸向前方露出锋利的爪子，另一只手插在连帽衫口袋里。角色拥有深炭黑色的鳞片或皮毛，长而粗的尾巴带有红色斑纹，红色的尖刺状后掠发型和鬃毛般的颈部尖刺，高耸的红黑双角，棱角分明的黑色颊鳍，发光的红色双眼，龇牙咧嘴露出锋利的牙齿，爪尖为红色。为角色穿上 {argument name="hoodie color" default="一件深红色超大款连帽衫"}，配有白色抽绳、前袋、厚重的褶皱，胸前正中印有角色自身凶猛龙头的圆形标志；上袖处添加一个小巧的心形补丁，下方配有一个深色长方形补丁。搭配黑色战术工装裤，裤身带有多个绑带、扣环、护膝、大腿袋、多功能口袋和宽松的褶皱布料，脚穿带有红色点缀和灰色鞋带的白色运动鞋。角色周围环绕着醒目的红色笔触式斜线特效、弯曲的能量弧、墨迹飞溅、细小的黑色碎屑以及两个锋利的红色星芒火花形状，强调速度感与攻击性。采用清晰的赛璐珞动漫线条艺术、高对比度光影、戏剧性的透视缩短、饱和的红色高光、细腻的衣物褶皱、干净的白色负空间，以及精致的角色海报构图，且不包含任何可读文字。

promptLocalized.zh: {"type":"复古日本地下亚文化杂志拼贴海报","format":"单幅密集编辑排版","style":"1980 年代御宅族文化、朋克杂志、复印漫画、孔版印刷、磨损半色调、撕纸拼贴、垃圾摇滚纹理、米色新闻纸、黑色油墨、荧光粉、青色、黄色、紫色、高对比度、套印不准、档案扫描外观","theme":"{argument name=\"theme\" default=\"地下亚文化美学\"}","headline_text":"{argument name=\"main headline\" default=\"SUBCULTURE\"}","visible_text_style":"混合英语和日语排版、垂直日语标题、微小的学术专栏、目录列表、期号、价格、目录标签、条形码碎片、警示条纹","layout":{"canvas":"宽幅横向海报，满版拼贴，无留白","count":8,"panels":[{"position":"左上","description":"大型米色漫画封面面板，带有黑白赛博朋克动漫女孩，短乱黑发，大眼睛，机械绑带和电缆，大型垂直红色日语标题，小型英语单词读取 subculture underground aesthetics，密集报纸专栏"},{"position":"中上","description":"深色学术书籍封面面板，标题为 アンダーグラウンド文学，黑色背景配米色日语文本列，磨损的橙色手部剪影，中间有一个大型深色矩形审查遮盖块"},{"position":"右上","description":"黑色封面，带有巨大的荧光粉色 SUBCULTURE 标题，关于 80 年代御宅族文化和地下文学美学的小型英语副标题，抽象的粉白色线框动漫身体和混乱的涂鸦，垂直日语侧边栏"},{"position":"左下","description":"蓝色和黑色杂志面板，标题为 From the Underground，紫色单色睡姿人物图像，带有一个小型紫色审查遮盖块，期号和东京郊区混乱文本，目录标签"},{"position":"中左","description":"狭窄的红色和米色粘贴海报条，带有垂直日语标题，顶部有黄黑色危险胶带，层叠的撕纸和复印纹理"},{"position":"中下","description":"明亮的霓虹内容页，带有洋红色、黄色、蓝色和紫色的动漫女孩半色调肖像，页眉 CONTENTS，六行编号的日语行，日期 6.19 JUNE 198X，价格 880YEN，大标题 Fetish Code"},{"position":"中右","description":"垂直灰色撕裂书脊面板，带有大型黑色日语字符，底部附近有一张逼真的眼睛图像，粉色和黑色垃圾摇滚涂抹痕迹"},{"position":"右下","description":"米色研究实验室文档面板，标题为 サブカルチャー美学研究会，带有英语副标题 Subculture Aesthetics Lab.，黑白巷弄照片，带有剪影人物，条形码，目录代码，微小的漫画印章，错误文本和斜杠标记"}]},"imagery":{"character":"{argument name=\"anime character\" default=\"忧郁的赛博朋克漫画女孩，乱乱的黑发\"}","censorship":"包含两个不透明的矩形审查遮盖块，一个在顶部中心面板为深棕色，另一个在左下方面板为紫色","textures":"咖啡渍纸张、油墨渗漏、复印噪点、划痕、灰尘、剪贴缝隙、胶带痕迹、CMYK 套印错位","composition":"繁忙但平衡的网格拼贴，不同尺寸的重叠面板，学术和粉丝杂志视觉语言，怀旧模拟印刷伪影"},"color_palette":"{argument name=\"color palette\" default=\"陈旧米色、黑色、荧光粉、电光蓝、酸性黄、柔和红、紫罗兰色\"}","quality":"大字清晰可读，小字可为伪印刷效果，细腻的磨损纸张纹理，无现代光泽 UI，无 3D 渲染"}

templates.title: Red hoodie lava dragon poster

titleLocalized.zh: 红色连帽衫熔岩龙海报

templates.prompt: Create a bold, anime-style street poster with a clean white background. The main character is an anthropomorphic black dragon, positioned in a three-quarter-body pose, leaning forward with its hands in its hoodie pockets, displaying a confident, roaring smile. The dragon has dark charcoal scales, with glowing red lava-like cracks covering its face, neck, tail, and horns. It possesses sharp, red, angular eyes, white fangs, towering pointed ears, two long, red and black horns, a spiky red mane, and a long, curved tail that extends from the left side and ends in a red spearhead shape. The character wears a shiny, oversized {argument name="hoodie color" default="Dark red"} A zip-up hoodie with a white drawstring, heavy pleats, front pockets, and black work pants; featuring four clearly visible garment logos: a black and white circular badge patch on the upper sleeve, a black rectangular sleeve patch with twisted white lettering, a small triangular logo on the chest, and a small white chest text logo. Dynamic red splatter brushstrokes are added around the character, especially a large splatter on the right and smaller droplets near the left corner. A magazine cover-style typographic layout is designed at the top, featuring a large, bold, compressed red headline.{argument name="headline text" default="HAROS MRNG"} Above it is a line of small, black, uppercase letters deliberately designed as imperfect pseudo-text, and in the upper left corner is a small black subtitle block.{argument name="subheading text" default="STRENH BLACK"} Below is a second line of smaller garbled text, with the issue number marked in black in the upper right corner.{argument name="issue number" default="12"} It employs high-contrast cel animation rendering, sharp black outlines, dramatic red highlights, glossy fabric reflections, simple poster composition, and modern character design magazine aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张大胆的动漫街头风格海报，背景为干净的白色，主角为一只拟人化的黑龙，采用四分之三上半身姿势，身体前倾，双手插在连帽衫口袋中，露出自信的咆哮笑容。龙拥有深炭色鳞片，面部、颈部、尾巴和角上布满发光的红色熔岩状裂纹，长着锐利的红色棱角眼睛、白色獠牙、高耸的尖耳朵、两只长长的红黑相间角、尖刺状的红色鬃毛，以及一条从左侧伸入、末端呈红色矛状的弯曲长尾。角色身穿一件亮面超大款 {argument name="hoodie color" default="深红色"} 拉链连帽衫，戴着兜帽，配有白色抽绳、厚重的褶皱、前口袋以及黑色机能工装裤；展示 4 处清晰可见的服装标识：上袖处有一个黑白圆形徽章贴片，黑色矩形袖标上带有扭曲的白色字母，胸前有一个小型三角形标志，以及一个小型白色胸前文字标识。在角色周围添加动态的红色喷溅笔触，特别是在右侧添加一个大面积喷溅，左侧角部附近添加较小的液滴。在顶部设计杂志封面风格的排版布局，包含一行巨大的粗体压缩红色标题 {argument name="headline text" default="HAROS MRNG"}，上方有一行故意设计成不完美伪文字的小型黑色大写字母，左上方有一个小型黑色副标题块 {argument name="subheading text" default="STRENH BLACK"}，下方附带第二行较小的乱码文字，右上角标注黑色期号 {argument name="issue number" default="12"}。采用高对比度赛璐珞动漫渲染、锐利的黑色轮廓线、戏剧性的红色高光、光泽面料反射、简洁的海报构图以及现代角色设计杂志美学。

templates.title: Gothic-style anime superheroes land

titleLocalized.zh: 哥特风动漫超级英雄落地

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic anime illustration with a vertical composition, depicting {argument name="character name" default="A gothic-style female student with pigtails"} She lands a stunning superhero-like stunt amidst a shattered city crater. Centered in the frame, she's presented in a low-angle, dynamic pose: a fist slams into the cracked pavement, one knee on the ground, the other raised forward, conveying explosive impact and confidence. She keeps {argument name="hair color" default="black"} Her hair was styled into two huge, high, glossy pigtails, each tied with a knot.{argument name="bow color" default="Purple"} Bows and pearl-like beads adorn her hair, which flies upwards with the force of the impact. Her face is covered by a dark, square veil with soft edges, positioned in the center of her head, concealing all her features. Dress her in a dark gothic streetwear outfit: an oversized black hooded jacket, a dark purple top, a purple-black plaid pleated skirt, black knee-high socks, and thick-soled black lace-up combat boots. The scene erupts with shattered slabs of stone, flying rocks, dust, sparks, and suspended debris, accompanied by vertically surging purple lightning and purple energy. The game features strong cinematic lighting, high contrast, rim lighting on hair and clothing, motion blur at the debris, delicate textures of the rubble, a deep purple and black color palette, dramatic comic/anime rendering, ultra-detailed digital painting, vibrant composition, portrait orientation, and no text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖构图的戏剧性动漫插画，描绘 {argument name="character name" default="一位哥特风双马尾女学生"} 在破碎的城市陨石坑中完成震撼的超级英雄落地动作。她处于画面中心，以低角度动态姿势呈现：一只拳头砸向龟裂的路面，单膝跪地，另一条腿向前抬起，展现出爆发性的冲击力和自信感。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"} 头发，梳成两个巨大的高卷双马尾，带有光泽感，每侧发束系着一个 {argument name="bow color" default="紫色"} 蝴蝶结和珍珠状珠饰，发丝因冲击力向上飞扬。她的面部被一个位于头部中央、边缘柔和的深色方形遮挡块覆盖，隐藏了所有五官。为她穿上深色哥特街头校园装：超大号黑色连帽夹克、深紫色上衣、紫黑格纹百褶裙、黑色过膝袜以及厚底黑色系带战斗靴。场景中喷涌出破碎的石板、飞溅的岩石、尘埃、火花和悬浮的碎片，身后伴随着垂直涌动的紫色闪电和紫色能量。采用强烈的电影级光影，高对比度，头发和服装上的轮廓光，碎片处的动态模糊，细腻的碎石纹理，深紫色与黑色调色板，戏剧性的漫画/动漫渲染，超精细数字绘画，充满活力的构图，竖屏方向，无文字。

templates.title: Cute takoyaki photos with graffiti octopus

titleLocalized.zh: 带有涂鸦章鱼的可爱章鱼烧照片

templates.prompt: Create a portrait-style photo of the food, showcasing it on a pure white round ceramic plate placed on a gray stainless steel kitchen countertop.{argument name="dish" default="Homemade Takoyaki"} The takoyaki are piled high, glistening and inviting, topped with a deep brown takoyaki sauce, thick lines of pale yellow mayonnaise, floating bonito flakes, green seaweed powder, and scallion rings overflowing the rim of the plate. Add cute white hand-drawn doodle illustrations to the photo, as if drawn with a marker: the image should feature two round octopus mascots wearing festival headbands, one large octopus peeking out from the upper right of the plate, holding a takoyaki skewer and looking surprised; the other smaller octopus is leaning against the plate in the lower left. Also include two doodle-style takoyaki balls, one in a circle near the center of the bottom of the plate, and the other in the lower right, with smiling expressions. Surround the food with playful white outline decorations, including about 11 stars, 5 hearts, 3 flower-shaped clouds, 4 small bubbles or circles, and a few animated/splashing markers, all floating around the food without obscuring the main ingredients. Keeping the lighting natural and realistic, the image was shot from a slightly overhead angle using a phone camera, showcasing warm interior tones, crisp food textures, and a charming, playful social media aesthetic. No printed text or labels are included in the image.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖屏手机风格的美食照片，展示放在灰色不锈钢厨房台面上纯白色圆形陶瓷盘里的 {argument name="dish" default="自制章鱼烧"}。章鱼烧堆叠得很高，看起来光泽诱人，上面覆盖着深棕色的章鱼烧酱、浓稠的浅黄色蛋黄酱线条、飘动的木鱼花、绿色青海苔粉以及溢出盘缘的葱花圈。在照片上添加可爱的白色手绘涂鸦插图，就像用记号笔画上去的一样：画面中要有 2 个戴着祭典头带的圆形章鱼吉祥物，其中一个大章鱼从盘子右上方探出头，手里拿着 1 根章鱼烧签子，表情惊讶；另一个较小的章鱼在左下方靠着盘子。另外包含 2 个涂鸦章鱼烧小球，一个圈在盘子底部中央附近，另一个在右下方，表情带笑。在食物周围环绕俏皮的白色轮廓装饰，包括约 11 颗星星、5 颗爱心、3 朵花状云团、4 个小气泡或圆圈，以及几个动效/飞溅标记，所有装饰都漂浮在食物周围，且不遮挡主要配料。保持光线自然真实，采用手机摄像头从上方略微俯拍的视角，呈现温暖的室内色调、清晰的食物质感以及温馨有趣的社交媒体美学。画面中不包含任何印刷文字或标签。

templates.title: Gothic Maid Superhero Lands

titleLocalized.zh: 哥特女仆超级英雄落地

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic vertical anime illustration, the main character is {argument name="character name" default="Noel"} A blonde gothic lolita maid hero is performing a superhero landing in the middle of a ruined city street. She crouches low, slamming one fist into the cracked ground, one knee forward, the other bent backward, her body leaning towards the audience for a powerful, dynamic perspective. Her face is obscured by a centered, opaque brown cube, and her long, curly hair {argument name="hair color" default="Golden yellow"} Her hair, styled by the impact, flew wildly in all directions, and she wore a white, ruffled maid's headdress. She was dressed in an exquisite outfit.{argument name="outfit colors" default="Black, light pink, white, and gold"} A maid outfit with ruffled edges, puff sleeves, gold trim, a black corset, pink and white apron details, white knee-high stockings, shiny black Mary Jane shoes, and white cuffs with gold buttons. The environment is a cinematic disaster scene: towering, broken buildings form narrow urban canyons, shattered slabs, dust clouds, suspended rubble and asphalt blocks, impact cracks radiating from her fists, and a thin, blue-white beam of energy descends vertically from the sky behind her head. It employs an extremely low-angle perspective, strong dynamism, flowing fabric, flying rubble, volumetric light piercing through smoke, high-detail anime rendering, sharp lines, glossy highlights, gorgeous clothing details, dramatic backlighting, and a strong sense of explosive impact. 3:4 aspect ratio, full-body composition, no text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张戏剧性的竖版动漫插画，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="Noel"}，一位金发哥特萝莉女仆英雄，正在废墟城市街道中央进行超级英雄落地。她低身蹲伏，一只拳头砸在开裂的地面上，一膝在前，另一条腿向后弯曲，身体向观众倾斜，呈现出强有力的动态视角。她的脸部被一个居中的不透明棕褐色方块遮挡，她长长的卷曲 {argument name="hair color" default="金黄色"} 头发因冲击力向四周炸开，头上戴着白色的荷叶边女仆头饰。她穿着一套精致的 {argument name="outfit colors" default="黑色、淡粉色、白色和金色"} 荷叶边女仆装，带有层叠的褶边、泡泡袖、金色饰边、黑色紧身胸衣、粉白相间的围裙细节、白色过膝袜、亮面黑色玛丽珍鞋以及带有金色纽扣的白色袖口。环境是一个电影级的灾难场景：高耸破碎的建筑物形成狭窄的城市峡谷，破碎的石板、尘云、悬浮在空中的碎石和沥青块，冲击裂纹从她的拳头向四周辐射，一道细长的蓝白色能量光束从她脑后的天空中垂直降下。采用极端的低角度视角、强烈的动感、随风飘动的布料、飞溅的瓦砾、穿透烟雾的体积光、高细节动漫渲染、锐利的线条、光泽高光、华丽的服装细节、戏剧性的逆光以及强烈的爆炸冲击感。长宽比 3:4，全身构图，无文字。

templates.title: Fun French Mayonnaise Food Photography

titleLocalized.zh: 趣味法式蛋黄酱美食摄影

templates.prompt: Create a stylish food photography scene from a three-quarter angle, viewed from above, on a matte beige stone tabletop. Showcase exactly two plated soft-boiled eggs, garnished with a homemade mayonnaise-style yellow sauce and parsley: a large, glossy black textured plate on the right in the foreground, and a minimalist gray-white plate on the left in the background. Each egg is placed vertically, its surface covered in a rich, golden sauce that converges at the bottom, sprinkled with finely chopped green parsley and black seasoning granules. Add a playful white hand-painted doodle overlay, as if drawn directly onto the photograph: draw exactly two chef character outlines around the eggs; the foreground egg is depicted as a cute chef holding a whisk and wearing a chef's hat, while the background egg features a chef's hat and a raised spatula; including exactly one whisk, exactly one spatula, exactly two chef's hats, exactly twelve small flower doodles, exactly eight glitter/star doodles, and several whimsical dotted lines meandering across the tabletop. Using natural indoor restaurant lighting, the design achieves a realistic smartphone food photography feel, with soft shadows and warm neutral tones, creating a social media aesthetic reminiscent of a designer kitchen, without any visible text. Custom menu items are {argument name="dish name" default="soft-boiled egg with homemade oeuf mayo sauce"} Decoration{argument name="garnish" default="parsley"} The foreground color is{argument name="foreground plate color" default="glossy black"} The background color is{argument name="background plate color" default="off-white"} The graffiti color is{argument name="doodle color" default="white"} .

templates.title: Battlefield duel between barbarians and dragon riders

titleLocalized.zh: 野蛮人与龙骑士的战场对决

templates.prompt: Create a dark cinematic-quality fantasy battlefield scene, titled{argument name="scene title" default="Alliance with the Barbarians 4"} In the mid-ground, two powerful warriors fight back-to-back, wielding their swords against unseen enemies amidst dust and flying sparks. On the left is a burly, horned figure.{argument name="barbarian type" default="Demonic barbarians"} He was shirtless, with extremely well-developed muscles, his body covered in scars and dirt, his skin reddish-brown, with long, messy black hair and small, curved horns. His face was ferocious, and he wore a leather and fur loincloth, a belt decorated with bones and skulls, and bandages around his wrists. He gripped a heavy sword tightly in both hands. To his right was a tall {argument name="creature warrior" default="Dragon-headed Reptile Knight"} Clad in dark, layered scales and spiked shoulder armor, possessing a ferocious, gaping reptilian head, ridged horns, and sharp claws, the sword in his hand is dramatically interlocked with a barbarian's sword in a cross-shaped composition. In the foreground, a fallen figure is displayed.{argument name="fallen warrior" default="blonde female knight"} She lay on the rocky, muddy ground, clad in blackened plate and chainmail, her long golden hair cascading down her back. One hand was outstretched, a sword lying beside her. Her face was deliberately obscured by a solid dark brown square smudge. The background was a chaotic medieval battlefield, with tattered battle flags flying, mountains, smoke, dust, and a blurry, massive army in the distance. The composition employed a low-angle, epic style, a 2:3 vertical aspect ratio, and a rugged, realistic fantasy concept art style. Ultra-detailed armor scratches, wet mud, and sweat created a bloodless yet brutal atmosphere. The dramatic backlighting came from the bright sun shining directly through the storm clouds behind the crossed swords. High contrast, volumetric dust, a clear focus on the duel, shallow depth of field, cinematic color grading, and no readable text were present.

The main character is a young, androgynous figure.{argument name="hair color" default="bright cyan"} The character sports a fluffy bob, wears a loose, dark navy blue beret, an oversized navy blue haori-style cardigan over a white shirt, and a small blue crystal pendant necklace. She makes a V-sign with one hand near her cheek. A large, softly edged square privacy occlusion block in a soft blue-pink gradient occludes facial features. The design employs a glossy, modern anime style, delicate lines, bright highlights, soft shimmer, and cute sticker decorations. Two Japanese text stickers are added: a large, inflatable, rounded title in the upper left corner with the text {argument name="headline text" default="おはようございます"} The text uses blue and pink letters with thick white outlines; in the lower left corner is a cloud-shaped speech bubble with text {argument name="bubble text" default="ぴっぴ"} It features a small pink heart. Three sun doodle markers are added near the top title: a simple yellow sun above the hair, a small yellow ray on the left, and a curved pink heart-shaped arrow decoration on the lower right. Four small flower doodles are scattered around the image, embellished with tiny plus signs, dots, hearts, and star glitter, creating a cheerful good morning sticker aesthetic. It uses a 9:16 vertical composition, close-up cropping, dreamy soft colors, high detail, a clean illustration style, and is not a realistic photograph.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖版柔和动漫风格的社交媒体早安问候插画，主角是一位年轻的中性角色，拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="明亮的青蓝色"} 蓬松波波头，戴着一顶宽松的深海军蓝贝雷帽，身穿一件超大号海军蓝羽织风格开衫，内搭白色衬衫，颈间佩戴一条蓝色小水晶吊坠项链。角色以胸部以上构图呈现，背景是在阳光明媚、柔和模糊的窗边房间内，充满温暖的金色晨光与背景虚化效果，单手置于脸颊旁比出 V 字手势。在面部中心放置一个大尺寸、边缘柔和的方形隐私遮挡块，采用柔和的蓝粉渐变色，遮住面部特征。采用光泽感现代动漫渲染、细腻的线条、明亮的高光、柔和的闪光，以及可爱的贴纸装饰布局。添加 2 个日文文字贴纸：左上方是一个巨大的充气圆润标题，文字为 {argument name="headline text" default="おはようございます"}，采用蓝粉色字母并带有厚实的白色描边；左下方是一个云朵状对话气泡，文字为 {argument name="bubble text" default="ぴっぴ"}，并配有一个粉色小爱心。在顶部标题附近添加 3 个太阳涂鸦标记：发丝上方一个简单的黄色太阳，左侧一个小型黄色光芒，右下方一个弯曲的粉色爱心箭头装饰。在画面周围散布 4 个小花涂鸦，并点缀微小的加号、圆点、爱心和星星闪光，营造出愉悦的早安贴纸美学。采用 9:16 竖版构图，近景裁剪，梦幻柔和色调，高细节，干净的插画风格，非写实照片。

templates.prompt: Create a gorgeous vertical fantasy illustration depicting a giant flowering bonsai tree placed in a large ceramic pot against a dreamlike cosmic night garden backdrop. The bonsai boasts a twisted and glossy rose-gold trunk and branches, with a dense, rounded crown composed of countless succulent-like rosettes of flowers in various colors.{argument name="flower colors" default="Pearl powder, lavender purple, lilac purple, peach, and opal white"} The petals should be translucent, dewy, and shimmer like jewels. Add long, cascading strings of crystal beads and delicate drip wreaths below the branches, like luminous wisteria made of pearls and glass. The flowerpot is a large, light pink lavender bowl, decorated with ornate silver Baroque-style floral metalwork on the front, placed on a beautifully carved round silver base. In the lower right corner, place a sleeping [flower/vegetable/plant].{argument name="animal" default="White fluffy cat"} It rests peacefully curled up on its base, surrounded by several soft pearl spheres. The background is a deep galactic sky, filled with luminous blurred effects, tiny stars, floating petals, and magical dust, with a large, pale moon faintly visible in the upper right corner. Pink and purple clusters of flowers and luminous pearls surround the base. The piece employs an ultra-refined anime fantasy art style, romantic and ethereal, with highly saturated soft colors, iridescent lighting effects, soft light effects, crystal-clear sparkles, and exquisite decorative craftsmanship. It creates a tranquil bedtime atmosphere, with a vertical composition, no text, and no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅华丽的竖版奇幻插画，描绘一棵巨大的开花盆景树，置于宽大的瓷质花盆中，背景为梦幻般的宇宙夜花园。盆景拥有扭曲且富有光泽的玫瑰金树干和枝干，茂密的圆形树冠由无数多肉植物般的莲座花朵组成，颜色为 {argument name="flower colors" default="珍珠粉、薰衣草紫、丁香紫、桃色和蛋白石白"}；花瓣应呈现半透明、带露水且如宝石般闪烁的效果。在枝干下方添加许多长长的悬垂水晶珠串和精致的滴落花环，如同由珍珠和玻璃制成的发光紫藤。花盆为一个巨大的浅粉薰衣草色碗，正面饰有华丽的银色巴洛克风格花卉金属装饰，放置在雕刻精美的圆形银色底座上。在右下方，放置一只正在沉睡的 {argument name="animal" default="白色毛茸茸的猫"}，它在底座上平静地蜷缩着，旁边有几颗柔和的珍珠球。背景是深邃的星系天空，布满了发光的虚化效果、细小的星星、漂浮的花瓣和魔法尘埃，右上角隐约可见一轮巨大的苍白月亮。在底座周围环绕着粉色和紫色花簇以及发光的珍珠。采用超精细的动漫奇幻艺术风格，浪漫而空灵，高饱和度的柔和色彩，虹彩光效，柔光效果，晶莹剔透的闪光，华丽的装饰工艺，宁静的睡前氛围，竖构图，无文字，无水印。

promptLocalized.zh: {"type":"单页漫画，暗黑奇幻动漫风格","format":"带有粗白色装订线和干净白色外边框的竖版漫画页面","overall_mood":"神秘、紧张、魔法感、静谧的夜间书房氛围","style":"高细节数字动漫插画、电影级光影、绘画质感的阴影、华丽的奇幻道具、柔和的棕色与紫色调、微妙的故障艺术风格魔法粒子、写实的房间透视","characters":{"count":2,"female mage":{"description":"年轻女性，留着极长的浅金色头发，侧边编发并配有花朵状发饰，身穿优雅的黑紫色露肩奇幻长裙，佩戴紫色宝石耳环和项链，手持一本古老的魔法书；在所有可见的特写镜头中，她的脸部被一个平面的不透明米色方块遮挡","hair color":"{argument name=\"female hair color\" default=\"浅金色\"}","outfit color":"{argument name=\"female outfit color\" default=\"黑色和紫色\"}"},"male adventurer":{"description":"年轻男性，留着凌乱的沙金色头发，身穿黑色粗犷风格奇幻衬衫，配有皮带和背带，戴着露指手套，作为警惕的同伴坐在或站在附近；在特写镜头中，他的脸部被一个平面的不透明米色方块遮挡","hair color":"{argument name=\"male hair color\" default=\"沙金色\"}"}},"setting":"夜间古老的木质旅馆房间或学者书房，木桌、床、墙上的装饰画、窗户可以看到带有远方塔楼剪影的深蓝色城市天际线，灯笼光和紫色水晶光","layout":{"panel_count":6,"panels":[{"number":1,"position":"左上","description":"桌上一本打开的古老魔法书特写；页面上布满了手写符文和图表；书上方悬浮着一个发光的紫色魔法阵，包含五角星、符号环、漂浮的文字和水平方向的故障碎片"},{"number":2,"position":"右上","description":"中远景房间镜头；女性法师坐在木桌前阅读打开的魔法书，男性冒险者坐在她身后的床边；桌上有温暖的灯笼，窗外可见夜间城市"},{"number":3,"position":"左中","description":"女性法师胸部以上的特写，正在阅读魔法书；长发、紫色首饰和露肩长裙非常醒目；微小的紫色魔法粒子从书中飘出；脸部被米色矩形遮挡"},{"number":4,"position":"右中","description":"木桌上两个光源的静物特写：一个带有温暖火焰的大型古董玻璃灯笼，以及一个底座上放着发光紫色水晶的小灯；魔法故障粒子在两者之间漂浮；书本堆放在右侧边缘"},{"number":5,"position":"左下","description":"男性冒险者侧面或四分之三侧面的肖像特写，可见黑色衬衫和皮质背带，背景中有温暖的灯光；脸部被米色矩形遮挡"},{"number":6,"position":"右下","description":"女性法师手持魔法书向下看的特写；脸部被米色矩形遮挡；右侧出现一个白色竖向对话气泡"}]},"visible_text":{"speech_bubble_count":1,"speech_bubbles":[{"panel":6,"text":"{argument name=\"speech bubble text\" default=\"……また止まっちゃった\"}","orientation":"白色椭圆形对话气泡内的竖排日文，气泡尾部指向女性法师"}]},"props":{"count":7,"items":["古老的打开的魔法书","发光的紫色魔法阵","木桌","温暖的古董灯笼","小型紫色水晶灯","堆叠的书籍","带有城市天际线的夜间窗户"]},"negative_instructions":"避免现代服装，避免明快的喜剧基调，避免除微妙故障伪影之外的科幻机械，将所有六个分镜保持在同一页面内，保留粗白色漫画装订线，不要增加额外分镜，不要翻译对话气泡内的文字"}

templates.title: Hyper-realistic restoration of pet photos

titleLocalized.zh: 宠物照片超写实修复

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, restore and enhance it into a sharp, high-resolution hyperrealistic photograph. While maintaining the original composition, framing, subject pose, blue background, and beige foreground pedestal, remove severe noise and blur, restore natural details of the kitten's fur, eyes, ears, whiskers, and facial features, and improve lighting and color accuracy to achieve a professional-looking image. Preserve the kitten's original features and proportions; do not add any new objects, text, or alter the scene.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图像，将其修复并增强为锐利、高分辨率的超写实照片。在保持原有构图、取景、主体姿态、蓝色背景和米色前景台架不变的前提下，去除严重的噪点和模糊，还原小猫毛发、眼睛、耳朵、胡须和面部特征的自然细节，改善光影和色彩准确度，使图像呈现出专业相机拍摄的效果。保留小猫原本的特征和比例；请勿添加任何新物体、文字或更改场景。

promptLocalized.zh: {"type":"单页暗黑奇幻漫画","format":"带有厚白色间隙和黑色边框的垂直页面","style":"高度精细的动漫/半写实奇幻插画，忧郁的夜间照明，华丽的哥特式室内装饰，电影级构图，精致的网络漫画风格","setting":{"location":"{argument name=\"city name label\" default=\"王都ヴァンドーム\"}","description":"夜晚的中世纪欧洲风格王都，蓝色屋顶，温暖的窗灯，星空下远处的城堡和塔楼；室内为安静的贵族旅馆或书房，配有木地板、花纹地毯、床、书架、书桌、灯笼和打开的书籍"},"characters":{"male assassin":{"appearance":"年轻男性，凌乱的波浪状金发，苗条的运动型身材，黑色无袖高领奇幻背心，带有精致的金线刺绣和翡翠装饰，黑色手套，手持一把小匕首和一块折叠的白布；脸部刻意用平整的方形遮挡块覆盖","role":"站在或坐在书桌旁，一边注视着女子，一边不祥地磨拭或擦拭匕首"},"female scholar":{"appearance":"年轻女性，留着极长的浅金色头发，侧边编发/花朵发饰，紫色宝石耳环，优雅的黑色配深紫色露肩奇幻长裙，带有金边；脸部刻意用平整的方形遮挡块覆盖","role":"坐在木桌前阅读一本魔法书，神情冷静且专注"}},"layout":{"panel count":6,"panels":[{"number":1,"position":"左上大格","description":"昏暗房间内的高角度俯瞰：男刺客坐在前景，手持匕首和布，女学者坐在背景的书桌前阅读一本发光的打开书籍，灯笼在书籍和纸张旁发出温暖的光芒"},{"number":2,"position":"右上窄格","description":"王都夜景的外观定场镜头，星空下的城堡和城镇灯光","visible text":["王都ヴァンドーム"]},{"number":3,"position":"中左宽格","description":"男刺客手持匕首和布的近景侧面，女学者仍在背景窗边阅读；窗外闪烁着微弱的魔法像素状城市灯光","visible sound effect":["ジジッ…"]},{"number":4,"position":"中右格","description":"女学者阅读一本发出紫色光芒的魔法书的特写；音符符号在她周围漂浮，仿佛她正在愉快地哼唱","visible symbols":["♪","♪","♪"]},{"number":5,"position":"左下格","description":"书桌上打开的书籍特写，两只手靠近书页；书本散发出半透明的紫色故障状矩形粒子和一个微弱的圆形魔法阵","visible speech bubble":"……また止まっちゃった"},{"number":6,"position":"右下宽格","description":"前景的男刺客拿着匕首停下动作，背景中的女学者从椅子上微微转身，神情惊讶，手中仍拿着书；身后是夜间的城市灯光和灯笼光芒","visible speech bubble":"あっ…"}]},"dialogue and typography":"日文漫画字体，置于带有黑色文字的垂直白色对话框中；音效字为手写风格白色字体；保留原有的日文文本","mood":"紧张但略带喜剧色彩，潜行的刺客被魔法书或类似服务器故障的问题打断","color palette":"深海军蓝、炭黑色、温暖的琥珀色灯笼光、柔和的金色装饰、紫色魔法光芒","rendering notes":"脸部用覆盖在可见脸部中心的纯色不透明米色方形块遮挡；无可见面部特征；保持戏剧性的阴影、精细的服装刺绣、写实的房间透视以及干净的漫画页面边框"}

templates.title: Moonlight Anime Martial Artist Kick

titleLocalized.zh: 月下动漫武术家踢击

templates.prompt: Create a dynamic vertical anime action illustration, the main character is {argument name="character name" default="A pink-haired female martial artist"} The composition employs a highly dynamic low angle. She wears a lustrous dress.{argument name="outfit color" default="deep magenta"} She wore a floral-patterned Chinese-style cheongsam-style short skirt with gold embroidery, black over-the-knee stockings, suspender details, and black shoes. The image captured the moment she executed a sideways spinning high kick, one leg pointing directly at the camera, her foot positioned at the top center of the frame, while the other knee bent close to the ground. Her long pink hair and ribbons fluttered in the wind, and her face was deliberately obscured by a flat, rose-pink square mask. A {argument name="energy color" default="Neon Pink"} A circular band of magical energy slashes, accompanied by bright sparks, dynamic trajectories, shattered stone fragments, and fluttering pink petals. The upper right corner of the screen shows a figure being knocked back by the kick.{argument name="opponent" default="Male ninja opponent dressed in dark clothing"} The scene is set in{argument name="setting" default="Ancient East Asian streets under the moonlight"} The background includes tiled roofs, the glow of red lanterns, wooden buildings, a huge full moon in a cloud-covered night sky, cracked ground, cinematic fragments, strong perspective shortening effect, a highly impactful viewpoint, ultra-detailed anime rendering, high-contrast magenta lighting, dramatic motion blur, glossy highlights, and exquisite fantasy battle poster aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张动态竖屏动漫动作插画，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="一位粉色头发的女性武术家"}，采用极具张力的低角度构图。她身穿一件富有光泽的 {argument name="outfit color" default="深洋红色"} 花卉图案中式旗袍短裙，配有金色刺绣、黑色过膝袜、吊带细节和黑色鞋子。画面捕捉她侧身回旋高踢的瞬间，一条腿直接冲向镜头，脚底占据画面上方中心位置，另一条膝盖弯曲靠近地面，长长的粉色秀发和丝带随风飘动，她的脸部被一个平面的玫瑰粉色方形遮挡块刻意遮住。在她周围环绕着一道 {argument name="energy color" default="霓虹粉色"} 的圆形魔法斩击能量带，伴随着明亮的火花、动态轨迹、破碎的石块碎片和飞舞的粉色花瓣。画面右上角包含一个被踢击击退的 {argument name="opponent" default="身着深色服装的男性忍者对手"}。场景设定在 {argument name="setting" default="月光下的古老东亚街道"}，背景包括瓦片屋顶、红灯笼光芒、木质建筑、云层密布的夜空中一轮巨大的满月、开裂的地面、电影感碎片、强烈的透视缩短效果、极具冲击力的视角、超精细动漫渲染、高对比度洋红色光影、戏剧性的动作模糊、光泽高光以及精致的奇幻战斗海报美学。

templates.title: Retro Saint Quotes Cards

titleLocalized.zh: 复古圣人语录卡片

templates.prompt: Create a vertical, vintage religious iconographic portrait card depicting an elderly male saint or philosopher, styled like a devout Renaissance illustration against an aged parchment background. The central figure has short grey hair and a partial grey beard, his face deliberately obscured by a flat, opaque brown rectangle. He stands against a soft blue sky and white clouds, with a golden halo of sunlight behind him. He wears a cream-colored robe with gold trim and a dark blue shawl, his left hand raised, one finger pointing to the sky, while his right arm holds a rolled-up parchment scroll. The scroll contains a centered serif font quote, with five lines of visible content:{argument name="quote" default="Good ideas aren't validated by opinions. They're validated by customers willing to pay."} Below this is a small decorative separator. At the bottom is a cream-colored nameplate with large, widely spaced serif capital letters:{argument name="person name" default="STEVE BLANK"} The image is framed with a magnificent gold rectangular border and a fan-shaped cream-colored outer edge. Four clusters of decorative flowers, each containing roses, white lilies, green leaves, and gold stamens, are placed in the upper left, upper right, lower left, and lower right corners. Warm, soft tones, aged paper textures, hand-drawn brushstrokes, devout iconography, soft lighting, symmetrical layout, and elegant antique typography are used.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张垂直的复古宗教圣像风格肖像卡片，描绘一位年长的男性圣人或哲学家，画风如同文艺复兴时期的虔诚插画，背景为陈旧的羊皮纸。中心人物留着灰色的短发和部分灰色胡须，面部被一个平坦的不透明棕褐色矩形刻意遮挡，站在柔和的蓝天白云背景下，身后是带有太阳光芒的金色光环。他身穿带有金色饰边的奶油色长袍和深蓝色披肩，左手抬起，一根手指指向天空，右臂抱着一卷卷起的羊皮纸卷轴。卷轴上包含一行居中的衬线字体语录，共 5 行可见内容：“{argument name="quote" default="Good ideas aren't validated by opinions. They're validated by customers willing to pay."}”，下方有一个小型装饰性分隔符。在底部，包含一个奶油色的铭牌，上面写着大号且间距宽阔的衬线大写字母：“{argument name="person name" default="STEVE BLANK"}”。用华丽的金色矩形边框、扇形奶油色外缘装饰图像，并在左上角、右上角、左下角和右下角各放置 4 簇装饰性花卉，每簇包含玫瑰、白百合、绿叶和金色花丝。使用温暖柔和的色调、陈旧的纸张纹理、手绘笔触、虔诚圣像构图、柔和光晕、对称布局以及优雅的古董排版。

templates.title: A sleepy cat in a hoodie, anime girl in bed

titleLocalized.zh: 床上困倦的猫咪连帽衫动漫女孩

templates.prompt: Create a cozy nighttime bedroom scene with a semi-realistic photo background, and composite it with a vivid anime sticker character. A sleepy, chibi-style anime girl, keeping {argument name="hair color" default="Bright pink"} With her short bob haircut and soft bangs, she nestled in a soft beige down comforter, her hands clutching the blanket tightly. Her bright blue eyes, half-open, held a cat-like smile and a faint blush, as she drowsily gazed ahead. She was wearing an oversized {argument name="hoodie design" default="Cream-colored cat-ear hoodies with blue paw-print-like eye spots and pink inner ears, and deep navy blue pajama hoodies covered with neon pink and cyan triangular patterns."} Add adorable blue and pink triangular geometric hair clips. Render the character as a crisp 2D anime paper cutout with thick white sticker outlines and dark edge shadows, naturally placed on the bed. The room is warm and tranquil: messy pillows, soft beige bedding, a chunky knit blanket in the foreground, a wooden headboard, a bedside table with a glowing fabric lampshade, potted plants by the window and near the bed, dark curtains, and the hazy city lights outside. Use warm amber lighting combined with cool blue nighttime shadows, shallow depth of field, highly detailed fabric textures, a tranquil pre-sleep atmosphere, vertical composition, slightly overhead mid-to-foreground shots, a cute and cozy ambiance, and no visible text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个温馨的夜间卧室场景，背景为半写实照片，并合成一个生动的动漫贴纸角色。一个困倦的 Q 版动漫女孩，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="亮粉色"} 的短波波头和柔和的刘海，蜷缩在柔软的米色羽绒被中，双手紧紧抓着毯子，半睁着星光熠熠的蓝色双眼，带着猫咪般的小小微笑和淡淡的红晕，昏昏欲睡地注视着前方。她穿着一件超大的 {argument name="hoodie design" default="奶油色猫耳连帽衫，带有蓝色爪印般的眼部斑点、粉色内耳，以及深海军蓝色的睡衣连帽衫，上面覆盖着霓虹粉和青色的三角形图案"}；添加可爱的蓝色和粉色三角形几何发夹。将角色渲染为清晰的 2D 动漫剪纸，带有厚实的白色贴纸轮廓和深色边缘阴影，自然地放置在床上。房间温暖而宁静：凌乱的枕头、柔软的米色床上用品、前景中的粗针织毯、木质床头、带有发光布艺灯罩的床头柜、窗边和床头附近的盆栽植物、深色窗帘，以及窗外模糊的城市灯光。使用温暖的琥珀色灯光与冷蓝色的夜间阴影相结合，浅景深，高细节的织物纹理，宁静的睡前氛围，竖版构图，略微俯视的中近景，可爱舒适的氛围，无可见文字。

templates.title: Late Night Graphite Portrait Painting Workbench

titleLocalized.zh: 深夜石墨肖像画工作台

templates.prompt: Create an emotionally charged, monochrome, top-down realistic scene depicting an artist's workbench late at night: a textured, off-white drawing paper rests diagonally on a worn gray tabletop, upon which lies an unfinished graphite portrait, depicting a subject {argument name="subject description" default="A young woman with shoulder-length wavy dark hair, wearing an off-the-shoulder top and a black tank top."} The portrait is meticulously detailed in the hair, neck, shoulders, and clothing, showcasing distinct layers of graphite brushstrokes, smear marks, paper texture, and soft, unfinished shadows. A realistic right hand reaches in from the lower right corner, holding a black pencil and drawing on the portrait's cheeks and neck. A black smartphone is placed in the upper right corner, its screen displaying a black-and-white reference photograph of the same subject. Two opaque, softly edged gray privacy rectangles are added: a larger square covers the face of the pencil portrait, and a smaller rectangle covers the face on the phone screen. A realistic artist's table is arranged around the paper: a metal pencil sharpener on top, a kneaded eraser or small stone at the bottom, and an open pencil case in the lower left corner, with five scattered black graphite pencils, two brushes, and two metal drawing tools naturally scattered around the paper.{argument name="lighting mood" default="Dim and warm desk lamp lighting"} It creates an atmosphere of deep shadows, subtle vignetting, and an intimate creative process, emphasizing the realistic texture of paper, charcoal and graphite tones, and shallow depth of field, presenting a high-resolution editorial photography style with no visible text in the images.

templates.prompt: Create a vertically stacked contrast image containing two horizontal sections: The top section features a minimalist studio product photo of a small enamel fridge magnet, centered on a light blue textured background with ample negative space; the magnet is shaped like a miniature alpine landscape souvenir, featuring a shimmering gold metallic outline, raised enamel details, snow-capped blue-grey peaks, rolling green hills, dark evergreen trees, and clusters of tiny yellow, purple, and blue wildflowers in the foreground, casting soft, realistic shadows. The bottom section is {argument name="location" default="alpine meadows and valleys"} A bright and realistic landscape photograph against a backdrop of blue skies and white clouds: vast, rolling green hills, snow-capped mountains in the distance, dark pine forests, and a meadow of wildflowers in the foreground bursting with yellow, purple, and blue blossoms. Near the bottom center, four horsemen cross the meadow, appearing small in scale against the expansive landscape. The top tile presents a streamlined, souvenir version of the scenery below, retaining the same key visual elements: mountains, green hills, conifers, wildflowers, and an open sky. It employs a clean editorial composition, realistic lighting, crisp details, soft shadows, and a serene travel-memory aesthetic. No visible text, no tags, no watermark.

templates.title: Portrait taken in the bedroom in the early morning

titleLocalized.zh: 清晨卧室随拍肖像

templates.prompt: Create a vertical composition, medium to close-up, and highly realistic everyday life photograph.{argument name="subject" default="A young Japanese woman in her early twenties"} On an ordinary morning, she sits sideways on the messy edge of her small bedroom bed. The shot, taken from a slightly downward, quarter-third angle, creates a candid, authentic feel. She is relaxed and sleepy, leaning slightly forward with her knees together, one hand on her knee, the other loosely holding a dark smartphone near her thigh. Her face is softly blurred with a rectangular cutout, her naturally flowing black hair is loosely tied up, with a few strands falling across her cheeks and neck. She is wearing {argument name="sleepwear" default="A loose-fitting white cotton T-shirt and light gray soft shorts"} Unadorned and naturally casual, the room exudes a lived-in feel: a large window on the left lets in bright morning light; a potted plant and a small green bottle sit on the windowsill; the bedside table is filled with everyday items such as bottles and jars; and cream-colored pillows adorn the bed.{argument name="blanket color" default="Soft sage green"} The image features wrinkled bedding. The lighting is soft morning light coming from the left, creating a transition between warm and cool tones. Dust and mist are visible in the image, with soft shadows on the shirt and legs. The hands and collarbone show realistic skin texture, natural fabric wrinkles, shallow depth of field, soft tones, and a slight graininess, presenting a documentary style. There is no posed shooting, no beauty filters, no makeup, and no artificial studio lighting.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖构图、中近景、真实感十足的日常生活照片，画面中 {argument name="subject" default="一位 20 出头的日本年轻女性"} 在一个普通的早晨，侧身坐在小卧室凌乱的床边。采用略微俯视的三分之四角度拍摄，营造出一种随手抓拍的真实感。她姿态放松、睡意朦胧，身体微微前倾，双膝并拢，一只手放在膝盖上，另一只手松弛地握着深色智能手机，靠近大腿。她的面部被柔和的矩形隐私模糊处理，自然垂顺的黑发凌乱地扎起，脸颊和颈部散落着几缕发丝。她穿着 {argument name="sleepwear" default="一件宽松的白色纯棉 T 恤和浅灰色柔软短裤"}，不加修饰，随性自然。房间充满生活气息：左侧有 1 扇大窗户，透进明亮的晨光；窗台上放着 1 盆植物和 1 个绿色小瓶子；床头柜上摆满了瓶瓶罐罐等日常杂物；床上铺着奶油色枕头和 {argument name="blanket color" default="柔和鼠尾草绿"} 的褶皱被褥。光线采用从左侧射入的柔和晨光，呈现冷暖过渡，画面中可见微尘和薄雾，衬衫和腿部有柔和的阴影，手部和锁骨呈现真实的皮肤纹理，布料褶皱自然，浅景深，色调柔和，带有轻微颗粒感，呈现纪实风格，无摆拍，无美颜修饰，无妆容，无人工摄影棚灯光。

templates.title: High-end fashion advertising posters

titleLocalized.zh: 高端时尚广告海报

templates.prompt: Create a high-end, modern, vertical advertising poster for the attached brand (please use the uploaded brand/logo as a primary brand identity reference). The overall design of the poster must strongly reflect the brand's visual identity, atmosphere, color palette, and aesthetic characteristics, while maintaining a fresh, modern, trendy, and high-end feel. Add decorative accessories, graphic elements, textures, lighting effects, and stylish visual embellishments that match the brand theme to make the poster visually rich, dynamic, and professionally designed, rather than mediocre or generic. Humans have invented "minimalist posters" and expect people to buy into them—truly a fascinating species. The poster should feature a fashion model whose pose and composition must be completely different from the reference photo. Avoid stiff, flat, awkward, or overly deliberate body language. The model's expression and posture must be natural, expressive, confident, elegant, and energetic, similar to the style of international fashion advertising campaigns or luxury lifestyle magazines. The pose should be lively and cinematic, creating a high-end advertising feel through natural movements and body positioning. Clothing must be modern.{argument name="fashion style" default="Casual Fashion"} The designs should possess a fashionable, contemporary aesthetic. Utilizing layering, playful color combinations, modern tailoring, trendy textures, and diverse garment details, ensure the clothing looks unique, dynamic, and engaging. The styling should be trendy, visually appealing, youthful, and sophisticated, while remaining consistent with the brand image. Advertising posters must also include compelling brand-related messages, including concise marketing copy, catchy slogans, persuasive calls to action, and visually appealing typography to generate interest in the brand. Every typographic element in the poster must use a striking modern typography style with a strong visual hierarchy. Avoid using bland, default, dull, or generic fonts. The typography should appear professional, stylish, balanced, and naturally integrated into the poster layout. The overall composition should be modern, luxurious, visually impactful, and suitable for social media dissemination, possessing the high-quality commercial appeal of international high-end brand campaigns. The visual layout should be dynamic and captivating, with balanced spacing, creative composition, depth, lighting, and professional editorial aesthetics. Avoid mediocre, empty, outdated, or overly standardized poster designs. Highly refined, polished, cinematic commercial style, realistic lighting, sophisticated color grading, modern blockbuster aesthetics, sharp focus, professional brand design, high visual contrast, rich detail, and ultra-high-definition 8K quality.

promptLocalized.zh:
为所附品牌创作一张竖版的高端现代广告海报（请使用上传的品牌/Logo 参考作为主要品牌标识参考）。海报的整体设计必须强烈体现品牌的视觉识别度、氛围、调色板和审美特征，同时保持清新、现代、潮流和高端的质感。添加与品牌主题相符的装饰性饰品、图形元素、纹理、灯光效果和时尚的视觉点缀，使海报看起来视觉丰富、动感十足且具有专业设计感，而非平庸或大众化。人类发明了“极简主义海报”却指望人们买账，真是迷人的物种。

海报应展示一位时尚模特，其姿势和构图必须与参考照片完全不同。避免僵硬、扁平、尴尬或过于刻意的肢体语言。模特的表情和姿态必须自然、富有表现力、自信、优雅且充满活力，类似于国际时尚广告大片或奢侈生活方式杂志的风格。姿势应显得生动且具有电影感，通过自然的动作和身体定位营造出高端广告的质感。

服装必须是现代的 {argument name="fashion style" default="休闲时尚"}，并具备时尚的当代审美。运用叠穿造型、有趣的色彩搭配、现代剪裁、时尚纹理和多样的服装细节，确保服饰看起来不重复、不单调、不乏味。造型应显得潮流、视觉吸引力强、年轻且高端，同时与品牌形象保持一致。

广告海报还必须包含与品牌相关的引人注目的宣传信息，包括简短的营销文案、朗朗上口的标语、具有说服力的行动号召文字，以及视觉上吸引人的宣传排版，以激发人们对该品牌的兴趣。海报中的每个排版元素都必须使用引人注目的现代字体风格，并具备强烈的视觉层级。避免使用平庸、默认、枯燥或通用的字体。文字构图应显得专业、时尚、平衡，并自然地融入海报布局中。

整体构图应具有现代感、奢华感、视觉冲击力，并适合社交媒体传播，具备类似于国际高端品牌大片的强商业广告品质。使视觉布局动感且引人入胜，具备平衡的间距、创意构图、深度、灯光和专业的编辑审美。避免平庸、空洞、过时或过于标准化的海报设计。

超精细、高度润色、电影级商业广告风格、逼真灯光、高端调色、现代时尚大片审美、焦点清晰、专业品牌设计、高视觉对比度、丰富细节，以及超高清 8K 画质。

templates.title: Wood carving relief effect

templates.prompt: General "Modular Wood Carving Relief System" Prompt (Identity Locked – Strict): Use the uploaded image as the subject and unique identity reference. Identity Locked – Strict (Non-negotiable): Preserve accurate facial structure, proportions, and feature placement. Do not alter the eyes, nose, mouth, or contours. Maintain expression and recognizability. Pose and Composition – Locked: Maintain original angles, framing, and perspective. Rotation, mirroring, or changes to camera settings are prohibited. Style Conversion – Wood Carving Relief (Hard): Transform the entire image into a densely stacked wood carving structure: Reconstruct all forms (face, hair, clothing, background) using interlocking blocks, strips, and carved fragments. Use a mix of rectangular beams, round pegs, cross-sectional slices, and stacked planks. Maintain a tight stacking density, minimizing gaps (no blank flat areas). Material System – Wood (Critical): All elements must be realistic wood with visible grain, growth rings, and natural variations. Grain direction must follow the shape of each component (random grains are prohibited). Include facets, knots, and minor imperfections. Surface Finish: Matte to semi-matte natural wood (no plastic look, no highlights). Depth and Structure – Hard relief construction with multiple layers of depth (foreground, midground, background wood blocks). Components must overlap, interlock, and present a sense of depth like a sculpted wall. Preserve facial topology through depth transitions rather than smooth shadows. Face and Hair Integration – Unified System (Key): The face and hair must be constructed from the same wood block system. Hair is presented as elongated sculpted segments following natural lines. Facial features are defined by the precise placement of smaller wood blocks and contours. There are no divisions between materials – everything is wood. Lighting – Form presentation uses directional lighting to emphasize depth, edges, and wood grain texture. Shadows must enhance separation of layers and structural clarity. Negative Criteria (Strict): No smooth skin, no paint coverage, no flat shadows. No metal, plastic, or other non-wood materials. No loose, abstract shapes or soft blends. No distorted facial structure or perspective. No gaps or blank areas – maintain a dense construction.

promptLocalized.zh:
通用“模块化木雕浮雕系统”提示词（身份锁定 – 严格）
使用上传的图像作为主体和唯一的身份参考。
身份锁定 – 严格（不可协商）
保留精确的面部结构、比例和特征位置。不得改变眼睛、鼻子、嘴巴或轮廓。保持表情和辨识度。
姿态与构图 – 锁定
保持原始角度、取景和透视。禁止旋转、镜像或更改相机设置。
风格转换 – 木雕浮雕（硬质）
将整张图像转换为密集堆叠的木雕结构：
使用互锁的木块、木条和雕刻片段重构所有形态（面部、头发、服装、背景）。
混合使用矩形梁、圆形木钉、横截面切片和堆叠木板。
保持紧密的堆叠密度，尽量减少间隙（无空白平坦区域）。
材质系统 – 木材（关键）
所有元素必须是具有可见纹理、年轮和自然变化的写实木材。
纹理方向必须遵循每个部件的形态（禁止随机纹理）。
包含切面、木结和细微的瑕疵。
表面处理：哑光至半哑光天然木材（禁止塑料感，禁止高光）。
深度与结构 – 硬浮雕
构建多层深度堆叠（前景、中景、背景木块）。
部件必须重叠、互锁，并像雕刻墙面一样呈现出进深感。
通过深度过渡而非平滑阴影来保留面部拓扑结构。
面部与头发整合 – 统一系统（关键）
面部和头发必须由相同的木块系统构建。
头发呈现为顺应自然走向的细长雕刻片段。
面部特征通过较小木块和轮廓的精确放置来定义。
材质之间无分割——一切皆为木材。
光照 – 形态呈现
使用定向光照来强调深度、边缘和木纹质感。
阴影必须强化层级分离和结构清晰度。
负面提示词（严格）
禁止平滑皮肤、禁止涂料覆盖、禁止平坦阴影。禁止金属、塑料或其他非木质材料。禁止松散的抽象形状或柔和的混合。禁止扭曲面部结构或透视。禁止出现间隙或空白区域——保持密集构造。

氛围感性、神秘且充满未来感。周围环境包含全息广告牌、发光的商店招牌、模糊的交通灯、街道上的雨水倒影、漂浮的雾气以及柔和的体积光。添加动态的动画风格运动模糊、戏剧性的透视、逼真的雨水物理效果以及极具表现力的电影感双眼。
调色板：{argument name="colors" default="霓虹蓝、紫色、粉色、青色和柔和的白光"}。
风格灵感源自新海诚 + 赛博朋克动画美学 + 顶级动画电影质感。
摄像机角度：低角度电影镜头，具有浅景深和强烈的背景虚化效果。
超清晰细节、动画写实主义、情感叙事构图、8K 画质、大师级动画艺术作品，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Low-angle emotional sky poster

titleLocalized.zh: 低角度情感天空海报

templates.prompt: [Input] - Reference Image: {Portrait Photo} - Date: {Today's Date https://t.co/DH3TMTrnLJ.dd} - Today's Mood: {} [Goal] Create a sky poster using an extremely low angle, looking up at the subject from the ground. Express today's mood through the sky, light, clouds, and color scheme. [Maintain the Subject] Maintain the subject's facial expression, hairstyle, body shape, and clothing style. However, the face should not be shown from the front; instead, present a side profile or only show the jawline. [Core Composition] - The camera is almost flat on the ground. - The subject is slightly suspended above the camera or in a jumping moment. - The soles of the shoes are clearly visible near the camera. - The legs appear long and have a sense of perspective. - The subject is in a side or semi-side view. - The sky occupies most of the screen. [Represent the Sky According to Your Mood] Create a sky that matches today's mood. Example: - Happiness: Clear blue sky, white clouds, warm sunshine - Excitement: Pink clouds, soft sunlight - Calm: Pale blue sky, thin clouds - Loneliness: Sunset, long shadows, empty sky - Depression: Low-hanging, heavy clouds - Rain: Overcast sky, raindrops, wet lens texture [Text] Arrange the date and mood information along the outline or silhouette of the person's body in a curved pattern. Required text: "{Date}" "{Today's Mood}" "{Short Message}" The text should be white, rounded, and bold in the poster layout. Avoid overly long sentences and arrange the text logically to ensure readability. If no short message is provided, it should be automatically generated and filled in. [Style] Emotional sky poster, warm perspective, looking up, wide angle, cinematic style poster, clear film texture, vast sky, simple layout. [Prohibited] - No normal standing postures - No postures where shoe soles are not visible - No close-up of a face from the front - No indoor backgrounds - No excessive text - No random text - No watermarks/logos

promptLocalized.zh:
[输入]

- 参考图片：{肖像照片}

- 日期：{今日日期 https://t.co/DH3TMTrnLJ.dd}

- 今日心情：{ }

[目标]

使用极低角度的视角创作一张天空海报，从地面向上仰视主体。

通过天空、光线、云层和配色方案来表达今日的心情。

[保持主体]

保持上传主体的人脸情绪、发型、体型和服装风格。

但是，不应从正面展示脸部；相反，应呈现侧面轮廓或仅露出下颌线。

[核心构图]

- 摄像机几乎平放在地面上。

- 主体略微悬浮在摄像机上方或处于跳跃瞬间。

- 鞋底在靠近摄像机处清晰可见。

- 双腿显得修长，具有透视感。

- 主体处于侧面或半侧面视角。

- 天空占据屏幕的大部分区域。

[根据心情呈现天空]

创作与今日心情相符的天空。

 示例：

- 快乐：晴朗的蓝天、白云、温暖的阳光

- 兴奋：粉色的云朵、柔和的阳光

- 平静：淡蓝色的天空、稀薄的云层

- 孤独：日落、长长的阴影、空旷的天空

- 沮丧：低垂厚重的云层

- 下雨：阴天、雨滴、湿润的镜头质感

[文字]

将日期和心情信息沿人物身体的轮廓或剪影以曲线排列。

需包含的文字：

“{日期}”

“{今日心情}”

“{简短信息}”

文字应为白色、圆润且粗体的海报排版。

避免过长的句子，并合理安排文字以确保易读性。

如果没有提供简短信息，则应自动生成并填入。

[风格]

情感天空海报，温暖视角，仰视，广角，电影感时尚海报，清晰胶片质感，广阔天空，简洁排版。

 [禁止]
- 禁止普通的站立姿势
- 禁止鞋底不可见的姿势
- 禁止正面人脸特写
- 禁止室内背景
- 禁止过多的文字
- 禁止随机文字
- 禁止水印/Logo

The pose is relaxed, with wide legs, a slight forward lean, one elbow resting on the knee, one finger lightly touching the temple, and direct gaze into the camera. The expression is calm, intelligent, creative, and confident. The background is a matte black wall, with colorful geometric vertical wooden art panels behind the subject, creating an artistic modern studio aesthetic. Warm, cinematic interior lighting softly illuminates the face and clothing while maintaining deep shadows and dramatic editorial contrast. A natural woven textured rug on the floor creates a comfortable and luxurious creative studio atmosphere. The magazine cover layout uses only one typographic element: a large, bold beige text at the top that reads, "..."{argument name="title" default="SHAMUS"} The cover uses a huge, compressed sans-serif font, covering most of the upper background. Shot with a 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, incredibly detailed skin texture, realistic fabric folds, soft cinematic shadows, photorealistic lighting, luxurious editorial photography, clean typography, professional magazine cover composition, high detail, 8K resolution, and sophisticated cinematic color grading.

templates.title: Pop Mart Hirono style custom doll prompts

titleLocalized.zh: Pop Mart Hirono 风格定制人偶提示词

templates.prompt: Please use only one real photo uploaded by the user as the sole identity reference, and extend that person's identity to {argument name="style direction" default="POP MART Hirono"} The goal is to create a trendy designer toy doll with a distinctive aesthetic, and to produce a high-quality, single-figure product scene image. Strict adherence to the real person's recognizability is crucial, including face shape, facial proportions, hairstyle, age, gender characteristics, skin tone, overall demeanor, and identifiable clothing and accessories from the original image. This ensures the final doll is clearly recognizable as the person in the photograph. The overall style must clearly lean towards the aesthetics of POP MART/Hirono designer toys: quiet, soft, restrained, with a touch of melancholy and contemplation, presenting the quality of high-end Pop Mart trendy toys, rather than ordinary cute plush toys. The doll should have a large head and small body proportion, with the head approximately 2.5 to 3 times the size of the body, a short and rounded body, simplified limbs, and slightly oversized shoes and socks, giving it a solid sculptural feel and weight. The pose should be calm, slightly leaning forward or bowing the head, conveying a certain emotional quality, while avoiding exaggerated movements. The face must retain the original image's features, but be transformed into Hirono's atmosphere: half-open or slightly droopy sleepy eyes, thickly painted eyelashes, a small, restrained pout, a minimalist nose, a round face, light blush or a few freckles, and an expression conveying a hint of confusion, world-weariness, or melancholy—bright smiles or sparkling anime eyes are strictly prohibited. The hairstyle should retain the original image's outline, but must be processed into a solid, rounded, bundled, faceted, hand-sculpted structure, rather than real hair strands. The hair color should be a low-saturation natural color, such as {argument name="hair color" default="Soft brown, grayish brown or soft black"} The clothing should retain the original image's overall style but be simplified into thick, rounded, toy-like sculptural blocks of color, slightly oversized, with a few toy-like stitching, patches, or minor wear details, avoiding realistic fabric textures. Accessories recognizable in the original image (such as coffee cups, small bags, flowers, popsicles, books, or small figurines) can be retained but must be transformed into slightly exaggerated matte toy accessories. Materials must have a high-end matte vinyl/matte resin/matte ceramic texture, with subtle hand-sculpted marks and hand-painted textures, avoiding gloss, mirror highlights, glass-like appearance, realistic skin, realistic hair, or visible textured patterns. The scene should output a single full-body figure product image, not a mesh image, series display, packaging poster, or blind box set. Place the figure in a refined, three-dimensional, unified miniature themed scene, like a product poster for a brand's trendy toys. Scenes can be selected from {argument name="scene theme" default="Everyday coffee, a garden corner, a daydream in the clouds, a quiet study, daydreaming under the moon, or the company of animals."} The scene should be three-dimensional, refined, and photographic, but not overly complex. Lighting should use soft, diffused product photography lighting, combined with clean highlights, soft shadows, and neutral exposure, to make the overall image look like a high-end Pop Mart new product promotional photo. Strictly avoid ordinary chibi illustrations, 2D anime-style images, Korean comic style, Barbie doll-like effects, realistic 3D plush effects, or complex and cluttered backgrounds.

promptLocalized.zh: 请仅使用用户上传的 1 张真实人物照片作为唯一的身份参考，将该人物延展为 {argument name="style direction" default="POP MART Hirono"} 美学风格的潮流设计师玩具人偶，并输出一张高完成度的单体人偶产品场景图。严格保留真实人物的辨识度，包括脸型、五官比例、发型轮廓、年龄感、性别特征、肤色倾向、整体气质，以及原图中可识别的服装和配饰特征，确保最终的人偶能被清晰地识别为照片中的本人。整体风格必须明确倾向于 POP MART / Hirono 设计师玩具美学：安静、柔和、克制、带有一丝忧郁和沉思感，呈现出高端 Pop Mart 潮流玩具的质感，而非普通的可爱毛绒玩具。人偶应采用大头小身的比例，头部约为身体的 2.5 到 3 倍大，身体短小圆润，四肢简化，鞋袜略大，整体具有扎实的雕塑感和重量感。姿态应保持平静，略微前倾或低头，带有一定的情绪感，避免夸张的动作。面部必须保留原图特征，但要转化为 Hirono 的氛围：半睁或微垂的睡眼、较厚的涂装睫毛、小巧克制的微嘟嘴、极简的鼻子、圆润的脸型、淡淡的腮红或少量雀斑，表情呈现出些许迷茫、厌世或忧郁——严禁出现灿烂的笑容或闪亮的动漫眼。发型应保留原图轮廓，但需处理成实心、圆润、成束、具有切面感的纯手工雕塑结构，而非真实发丝，发色使用低饱和度的自然色，如 {argument name="hair color" default="柔棕色、灰棕色或柔黑色"}，并进行哑光处理。服装应保留原图的穿搭气质，但简化为厚实、圆润、玩具般的雕塑感色块，可略微超大，带有少量玩具质感的缝线、补丁或轻微的磨损细节，避免真实的织物纹理。原图中可识别的配饰（如咖啡杯、小包、花朵、冰棒、书籍或小玩偶）可以保留，但必须转化为比例略微夸张的哑光玩具配件。材质必须呈现高端哑光搪胶 / 哑光树脂 / 哑光陶瓷质感，带有轻微的手工雕塑痕迹和手绘纹理，避免光泽感、镜面高光、玻璃感、真实皮肤、真实毛发或可见的贴图纹理。场景应输出一张单体全身人偶产品图，而非网格图、系列展示、包装海报或盲盒全套。将人偶置于精致、立体、统一的微缩主题场景中，如同品牌潮流玩具的产品海报。场景可选自 {argument name="scene theme" default="日常咖啡、花园角落、云端白日梦、安静书房、月下发呆或动物陪伴"}，要求场景立体、精致、具有摄影感，且不过于复杂。灯光应使用柔和的漫反射产品摄影光，配合干净的高光、柔和的阴影和中性的曝光，使整体画面看起来像一张高端的 Pop Mart 新品宣传照。严格避免普通的 Q 版插画、2D 动漫感、韩漫风格、芭比娃娃感、写实 3D 毛绒感或复杂杂乱的背景。

画面左侧放置巨大的中文主标题 "{argument name="main title" default="在此处填写标题"}"，使用粗犷、破损、带有印刷磨损感的字体，采用红色或黑红对比色，形成强烈的视觉焦点。标题下方添加一句简短、有力且具有认知反转感的中文副标题。

画面底部设计一个使用红黑线框和箭头组成的流程图，展示心理链条或成长路径。例如：错误认知 → 内耗行为 → 机会流失 → 突破方法 → 正向结果。中间可添加红色印章风格的标语以强调核心观点。

严格保留人物的真实身份特征，包括脸型、五官比例、眉眼结构、眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇、肤色、年龄、发质基础、体型以及整体气质。四张小图必须清晰地呈现为同一真实人物。严禁将其变成陌生人，严禁西化，严禁使用“网红”风格，严禁过度磨皮，严禁生成 AI 假脸。

[整体风格]
高端新中式商业摄影，东方水墨艺术杰作，以 {argument name="core color" default="红色"} 锦鲤为主题的品牌摄影。场景应呈现出在专业影棚内完成的高预算商业拍摄效果，具备完整的妆造、灯光、布景、服装及道具设计。整体风格高端、灵动、高贵且静谧，兼具东方美学与时尚杂志质感，带有轻微胶片颗粒感与柔和的油画质感。

[妆容要求，优先级]
精致的新中式商业拍摄妆容：通透干净的高级底妆，保留真实皮肤纹理但质感细腻；眉形自然且轮廓清晰；眼妆精致，眼线拉长并略微上挑，柔和的卧蚕，睫毛干净利落。面部具备自然的修容与高光，强调鼻梁、颧骨、下颌线及颈部线条。唇妆采用朱砂红、枣红或经典丝绒红，增添活力与东方贵气。整体妆容精致但不厚重。

[发型]
精心设计的新中式低发髻或松散的东方发髻：保持原有发质基础，但需经专业造型；头发具有蓬松感、层次感与自然的弧度；发丝干净且富有光泽。可有少量自然碎发修饰脸型。四张网格图必须保持发型一致。

[服装]
统一的朱砂红、锦鲤红或经典红色新中式高定礼服。礼服需具备明确的设计感与商业质感，如单肩、露肩、露背、丝绸缠绕、长飘带、长拖尾或东方褶皱结构。重磅真丝、缎面、雪纺或天鹅绒等面料需具备高端的垂坠感与流动感。红色礼服应与锦鲤鱼鳍相呼应。

[场景]
高端艺术影棚空间，背景为浅水蓝、青色或浅青灰色的水墨宣纸质感。地面可有浅水、镜面反射、薄雾与白莲。出现 2-4 个由半透明红绸或纱制成的大型红锦鲤艺术装置，看起来像是商业道具而非真实鱼类。

[格式]
生成一张 2x2 拼图。四张小图均为独立的竖构图，比例为 3:4，保持风格与色调的一致性。
