templates.title: Editor's Style Fashion Magazine Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 编辑风时尚杂志封面

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the portrait material, it was transformed into a high-end editorial style fashion magazine cover, while retaining the person, pose, hat, shirt, lighting direction, shadows, and the blurring effect that obscures the face. The image was cropped into a more compact vertical cover layout, and the subject was placed slightly to the right. A rough, gray-white paper texture, striking black compressed font, and neon yellow-green decorative stripes were added. The magazine title was created at the top in large black letters.{argument name="magazine title" default="OFFSET"} Partially placed behind the main body's head. Add the issue number in the upper right corner:{argument name="issue line" default="ISSUE 07 / OCT 2026"} Add a vertical neon green bar on the far left, along with Japanese text:{argument name="left vertical tagline" default="Silence can sometimes be the most sharp."} Add a prominent main title to the cover page in the bottom left corner:{argument name="main cover headline" default="QUIET PROVOCATION"} and the yellow subtitle{argument name="subtitle" default="Stillness cuts deeper than noise."} The left sidebar contains five numbered article previews: 01 FORM / PATTERN / RESTRAINT; 02 THE NEW CODE OF SOFT POWER; 03 CITY UNIFORM, REWRITTEN; 04 SHADOW PLAY IN SILVER THREAD; 05 INTERVIEW: ON STYLE WITHOUT PERFORMANCE. Add a barcode block with the price text "¥1200 (tax included)" below it. Add a vertical Japanese quote block in the upper right corner: "装うことは、主張ではなく编集である." Add a small black-and-white city building photograph illustration with a neon green side decoration in the lower right corner. Add three small sets of editing text in the lower right area: “OBSERVE. EDIT. INTENT. REPEAT.”, “CITY AS TEXTURE. SILENCE AS LANGUAGE. STYLE AS EDIT.”, and a small paragraph of text below the page number. Add a large neon yellow-green page number “014” in the lower right corner. Maintain a minimalist, modern design, presenting a Japanese street fashion magazine style, with realistic print grain, slight ink wear effect, and strong contrast.

promptLocalized.zh:
以 REFERENCE_0 作为肖像素材，将其转化为高端编辑风时尚杂志封面，同时保留人物、姿势、帽子、衬衫、光照方向、阴影以及遮挡面部的模糊效果。将画面裁剪为更紧凑的竖版封面布局，并将主体置于略微偏右的位置。添加粗犷的灰白色纸张纹理、醒目的黑色压缩字体以及霓虹黄绿色装饰条。

在顶部以巨大的黑色字母创建杂志标题 {argument name="magazine title" default="OFFSET"}，部分置于主体头部后方。在右上角添加期号：{argument name="issue line" default="ISSUE 07 / OCT 2026"}。在最左侧添加一条垂直的霓虹绿色长条，并配以日文文案：{argument name="left vertical tagline" default="静けさは、時に最も鋭い。"}。在左下角添加醒目的封面主标题：{argument name="main cover headline" default="QUIET PROVOCATION"}，以及黄色副标题 {argument name="subtitle" default="Stillness cuts deeper than noise."}。

在左侧栏包含 5 条带编号的文章预告：01 FORM / PATTERN / RESTRAINT；02 THE NEW CODE OF SOFT POWER；03 CITY UNIFORM, REWRITTEN；04 SHADOW PLAY IN SILVER THREAD；05 INTERVIEW: ON STYLE WITHOUT PERFORMANCE。添加 1 个条形码区块，下方标注价格文本 “¥1200 (税込)”。在右上角添加 1 个垂直日文引言块：“装うことは、主張ではなく編集である。” 在右下角添加 1 个带有霓虹绿色侧边装饰的小型黑白城市建筑照片插图。在右下区域添加 3 组小型编辑文本：“OBSERVE. templates.title: UV Resin Urban Landscape Balls

titleLocalized.zh: UV 树脂城市景观球

templates.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic macro image showcasing a transparent UV resin art sphere placed on a glossy dark wood table. Inside the transparent sphere, encapsulate a miniature panorama.{argument name="embedded scene" default="Under blue skies and white clouds, a modern city skyline stands beside green spaces."} It includes towering glass skyscrapers, a low city horizon, lush green grass in the foreground, and a distinctive arched dome structure on the right. The sphere should have the texture of polished resin or glass, with strong refractive effects, lens distortion, and a magnified interior landscape. Tiny gold glitter and microbubbles should be suspended within the sphere, with shimmering highlights at the edges.{argument name="lighting mode" default="Turn on the lights"} Warm indoor lighting with bright, mirror-like reflections, a luminous highlight on the left edge of the sphere, and shimmering gold flecks. Position the sphere slightly below the center of the frame, on a textured, scratched, reflective, and warm amber-toned lacquered wooden table. The background should be soft-focused to create a comfortable, deep brown interior environment, including a defocused decorative container on the left and a small, round metal object on the right, creating a shallow depth of field and bokeh. The composition employs a realistic macro photography style, a 4:3 aspect ratio, high detail, sharp sphere, and blurred background, showcasing the luxurious aesthetics of handcrafted resin craftsmanship, as if a dreamlike miniature world trapped within a crystal sphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超写实的产品风格微距图像，展示一个放置在光亮深色木质桌面上的透明 UV 树脂艺术球。在透明球体内部，封装一个微缩全景 {argument name="embedded scene" default="蓝天白云下，绿地旁现代化的城市天际线"}，包含高耸的玻璃摩天大楼、低矮的城市地平线、前景中翠绿的草地，以及右侧一个独特的弧形圆顶建筑结构。球体应呈现出抛光树脂或玻璃的质感，具有强烈的折射效果、镜头畸变、放大的内部景观，球体内悬浮着细小的金色闪粉和微小气泡，边缘处带有闪烁的高光。使用 {argument name="lighting mode" default="开启灯光"}：温暖的室内照明，带有明亮的镜面反射，球体左侧边缘有发光高光，并点缀着闪烁的金色斑点。将球体置于画面偏下方，放置在纹理丰富、带有可见划痕、反射和温暖琥珀色调的漆面木桌上。背景应进行柔焦处理，呈现舒适的深棕色室内环境，包括左侧失焦的装饰容器和右侧的一个小型圆形金属物体，营造出浅景深和焦外成像效果。构图采用写实微距摄影风格，4:3 画幅，高细节，球体清晰，背景虚化，展现奢华的手工树脂工艺美学，仿佛一个被困在水晶球中的梦幻微缩世界。

It emphasizes the glossy, glassy resin texture, strong specular highlights, lens-like distortion, caustic reflections on the tabletop, shallow depth of field, high contrast, cinematic night scene atmosphere, ultra-detailed realism, 4:3 composition, centered sphere, and the absence of text and figures.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超写实的微距产品风格图像，展示一个放置在深色潮湿木质桌面上的完美透明球形 UV 树脂艺术球，内部封存着一个微型 {argument name="enclosed scene" default="未来派夜景城市滨水区"}，如同一个精致的微缩景观。球体对内部场景进行了放大和折射：高耸的照明摩天大楼、滨水长廊、发光的几何光雕、水面上如莲花般的蓝色小灯、镜面般的倒影，以及遍布树脂中闪烁的悬浮颗粒。使用 {argument name="lighting mode" default="开灯"} 模式，球体内部散发出强烈的电蓝色和紫罗兰色光芒，背景模糊处点缀着洋红色和蓝色的散景光斑。强调光泽的玻璃质感树脂、强烈的镜面高光、透镜般的畸变、桌面上的焦散反射、浅景深、高对比度、电影级夜景氛围、超细节写实感、4:3 构图、球体居中、无文字、无人物。

templates.title: The haggard neo-expressionist lion

titleLocalized.zh: 憔悴的新表现主义狮子

templates.prompt: Create a primitive neo-expressionist mixed-media painting on a dirty, grayish-white canvas. The main subject is a frontal lion's head, its expression haggard, weary, and slightly manic. The lion has a huge, unkempt mane in colors including ochre, burnt orange, brown, black, and yellow, with the tips of the hair radiating upwards. Its eyes are asymmetrical, wide circles, accompanied by a long yellow muzzle, a black nose, thin whiskers, and a bitter, clenched-teeth expression. The painting employs dense scratch lines, splattered paint, dry brush textures, scrapes, drips, cracks, and chaotic graffiti-like brushstrokes covering the entire surface to create an outsider's art inspired by Jean-Michel Basquiat. The background is an aged cream-colored wall with six precisely distributed small graffiti elements: a black radiating sun in the upper left corner, a red circular face symbol on the left, a blue rectangular figure with a tiny face in the center left, a face framed in black near the lower left corner, a tall stick figure face in the upper right corner, and a black rectangular panel with a white, mysterious symbol in the lower right corner. Maintaining a square composition, cropped close to the lion's face, the image possesses high contrast and a chaotic, hand-drawn energy, rejecting clean digital retouching and presenting a rough, gallery-painting-like texture. The custom subject is {argument name="animal subject" default="lion"} Emotional expression is{argument name="expression" default="gaunt and exhausted"} The main color is{argument name="color palette" default="ochre, burnt orange, brown, black, yellow, and dirty cream"} The art style is{argument name="art style" default="neo-expressionist mixed-media graffiti painting"} The canvas format is{argument name="canvas format" default="square"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 在脏兮兮的灰白色画布上创作一幅原始的新表现主义混合媒介画作，画面主体为一只正面的狮子头部，表情憔悴、疲惫且略显疯狂。狮子拥有巨大的蓬乱鬃毛，颜色包括赭石色、焦橙色、棕色、黑色和黄色，毛发尖端向上放射，双眼呈不对称的宽大圆形，配有长长的黄色口鼻部、黑色鼻子、细长的胡须以及紧咬牙关的苦笑表情。运用密集的划痕线条、喷溅的颜料、干刷纹理、刮擦痕迹、滴落效果、裂纹以及遍布整个表面的混乱涂鸦式笔触，营造出受 Jean-Michel Basquiat 启发的局外人艺术感。背景为一面做旧的奶油色墙壁，上面精确分布着 6 个小型涂鸦元素：左上角有一个黑色放射状太阳，左侧有一个红色圆形面孔符号，左中有一个带有微小面孔的蓝色矩形人物，左下角附近有一个黑色框住的面孔，右上角有一个高大的火柴人面孔，右下角有一个带有白色神秘符号的黑色矩形面板。保持构图为正方形，紧贴狮子面部裁剪，具有高对比度、凌乱的手绘能量，拒绝干净的数字修饰，呈现出粗犷的画廊油画质感。自定义主体为 {argument name="animal subject" default="lion"}，情感表达为 {argument name="expression" default="gaunt and exhausted"}，主色调为 {argument name="color palette" default="ochre, burnt orange, brown, black, yellow, and dirty cream"}，艺术风格为 {argument name="art style" default="neo-expressionist mixed-media graffiti painting"}，画布格式为 {argument name="canvas format" default="square"}。

templates.title: Cavalry and barbarian charge

titleLocalized.zh: 骑兵骑士与野蛮人冲锋

templates.prompt: Create a vertical, cinematic, dark fantasy battle scene. The scene title is:{argument name="scene title" default="Cooperation with the Barbarians 5"} Two mounted warriors charge side-by-side towards the audience on a muddy battlefield. The frame must precisely include both riders and horses: the rider on the right foreground is a blond knight in dark steel plate and chainmail, his dark blue cloak billowing wildly behind him, riding a white horse with leather reins and studded harness; the rider on the left rearground is a bare-chested, muscular barbarian with wild black curly hair, adorned with leather straps, furs, and rough metal ornaments, riding a black horse and raising a blood-stained longsword. Both riders' faces are deliberately obscured by solid brown square occlusions. The knight thrusts a gleaming longsword diagonally downwards into the foreground, capturing a bright lens flare on the blade, while the barbarian raises his sword towards the sky. The background is filled with a vast, blurred medieval army, dust, swirling mud, spears, and two precisely visible tattered battle flags, located on the far left and far right respectively. Employing dramatic low-angle action compositions, the game is highly dynamic, with galloping horses kicking up gravel and mud, and hair and capes fluttering in the wind, presenting a rough realism. The high-detail vests and leather craftsmanship, the epic fantasy war atmosphere, the backlit sunlight piercing through bright clouds, shallow depth of field, cinematic contrast, photorealistic rendering, and a 2:3 aspect ratio.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖版电影感暗黑奇幻战斗场景，场景标题为 {argument name="scene title" default="与野蛮人的合作 5"}：两名骑马的战士在泥泞的战场上并肩向观众冲锋。画面中必须精确包含 2 名骑手和 2 匹马：右前方的骑手是一位金发骑士，身穿深色钢制板甲和锁子甲，黑蓝色的披风在身后剧烈飘动，骑着一匹配有皮革缰绳和铆钉马具的白马；左后方的骑手是一位赤裸上身、肌肉发达的野蛮人，留着狂野的黑色卷发，佩戴皮革绑带、毛皮和粗犷的金属饰品，骑着一匹黑马，高举一把沾满鲜血的长剑。两名骑手的面部均被纯棕色方形遮挡块刻意遮盖。骑士将一把闪亮的长剑斜向下刺向前景，剑身上捕捉到明亮的镜头光晕，而野蛮人举起的剑指向天空。背景填充广阔且模糊的中世纪军队、尘土、飞扬的泥土、长矛，以及精确可见的 2 面破损战旗，分别位于最左侧和最右侧。采用戏剧性的低角度动作构图，极具动感，飞奔的马蹄扬起碎石和泥土，头发和披风随风飘动，呈现粗粝的写实感，高细节的马甲和皮革工艺，史诗般的奇幻战争氛围，背光阳光穿透明亮的云层，浅景深，电影级对比度，照片级真实渲染，2:3 纵横比。

templates.title: Soft anime cherry blossom portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 柔和动漫樱花肖像

templates.prompt: Create a dreamy widescreen anime illustration using soft pastel tones, showcasing a close-up portrait of a young girl who possesses {argument name="hair color" default="Silver-white with light pink and lavender highlights"} Long, flowing hair, styled in loose twin ponytails, delicate strands swaying in the wind within the scene. The scene is filled with {argument name="flower type" default="Cherry blossoms"} Two cherry blossom branches are visible in the upper left and upper right corners of the image, with many luminous petals scattered in the foreground and background. Strong backlighting from the upper right, pearly halos, lens flares, bokeh flash, translucent light bands, and shallow depth of field create an ethereal spring atmosphere. The composition is an intimate over-the-shoulder or three-quarter close-up, with most of the girl's face obscured by a large, opaque square overlay in the center of the image. The color is {argument name="overlay color" default="Soft pink"} It covers facial features from forehead to chin. A light blue and white school uniform-style collar and soft pink accents are added near the center at the bottom. Rendered with a high-detail modern anime key visual style, it presents bright, painterly shadows, delicate lines, and cinematic lighting to create a romantic and tranquil atmosphere, in a 16:9 aspect ratio.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张梦幻般的宽屏动漫插画，采用柔和的粉彩色调，展示一位年轻女孩的肖像特写，她拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="带有淡粉色和薰衣草色高光的银白色"} 长发，发丝飘逸，呈现出松散的双马尾状，细腻的发丝在画面中随风摆动。场景中充满了 {argument name="flower type" default="樱花"}：画面左上角和右上角各有 2 枝可见的樱花枝，前景和背景中飘散着许多发光的花瓣。运用来自右上方的强烈逆光、珍珠般的光晕、镜头光斑、散景闪光、半透明的光带以及浅景深，营造出空灵的春日氛围。构图为亲密的过肩或四分之三特写，女孩的面部大部分被图像中心的一个大型不透明正方形覆盖层遮挡，颜色为 {argument name="overlay color" default="柔和的粉色"}，覆盖了从额头到下巴的面部特征。在下方中心附近添加淡蓝白色的校服风格领口和柔和的粉色点缀。以高细节的现代动漫关键视觉风格渲染，呈现明亮的绘画感阴影、细腻的线条、电影级光影，营造浪漫宁静的氛围，比例为 16:9。

templates.title: The Mysterious Astrologer on the Cosmic Table

titleLocalized.zh: Cosmic Table 上的神秘占星师

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed vertical fantasy anime illustration depicting {argument name="character description" default="A mysterious young male astrologer, with messy black hair and his face deliberately hidden in shadow."} He sat before an ornate cosmic divination table. He was dressed in {argument name="robe color" default="Dark navy blue and black silk layered robe"} The wide cuffs, adorned with gold embroidery, celestial patterns, delicate chains, tassels, and dangling gemstone earrings, lend the garment an elegant and fluid appearance without appearing bulky. His left hand extends forward, hovering above a large, luminous, terrestrial glass planet, while his right hand rests above the table, as if manipulating a solar system instrument. The tabletop is a polished, dark star map surface, covered with crisp, clear gold astrological rings, constellation lines, zodiac symbols, orbital rings, and fine geometric markings. The image must clearly show seven luminous spherical planets located on or partially on the table: a dominant large sphere below the left, a small sphere on the far left edge, a medium-sized sphere on the right center, a small sphere behind it, a larger sphere on the right edge, a large sphere in the lower right foreground, and a partially cropped sphere in the lower left foreground. The background is a vast blue cosmic space, dotted with stars, nebulae, aurora-like turquoise light, floating gold star disk rings, hanging chains, crystal decorations, and a dragon-shaped celestial ornament on the right. The design employs dramatic blue and cyan rim lighting, shimmering highlights, a transparent glass-like texture, delicate gold lines, deep shadows, cinematic depth of field, and a grand, mysterious atmosphere. The composition remains consistent: the character is positioned in the center behind the table, leaning forward, with their face obscured by shadows; their hands and glowing planets are in the foreground, and the planetary drawings on the table are richly detailed and clearly defined.{argument name="art style" default="Luxurious dark fantasy anime, ultra-detailed, cinematic lighting and shadows."} Vertical 3:4 aspect ratio.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高度精细的竖版奇幻动漫插画，描绘 {argument name="character description" default="一位神秘的年轻男性占星师，留着凌乱的黑发，面部刻意隐藏在阴影中"} 坐在华丽的宇宙占卜桌前。他身穿 {argument name="robe color" default="深海军蓝与黑色丝绸叠层长袍"}，袖口宽大，饰有金色刺绣、天体图案、精致链条、流苏和垂坠的宝石耳环，使服装看起来优雅流畅，而不显臃肿。他的左手向前伸出，悬浮在一个巨大的发光类地玻璃行星上方，右手则悬在桌面上方，仿佛在操控一台太阳系仪。桌面是抛光的深色星图表面，上面覆盖着清晰利落的金色占星圆环、星座连线、黄道十二宫符号、轨道环和精细的几何标记。画面中需清晰展示 7 个位于桌上或部分位于桌上的发光球体行星：左手下方一个主导的大球体，最左侧边缘一个小球体，中右侧一个中型球体，其后方一个小球体，右侧边缘一个较大的球体，右下前景一个大球体，以及左下前景一个被部分裁剪的球体。背景是一个广阔的蓝色宇宙空间，点缀着星星、星云、极光般的青绿色光芒、漂浮的金色星盘环、悬挂的链条、水晶装饰，以及右侧一个龙形天体饰物。运用戏剧性的蓝色和青色轮廓光、闪烁的高光、透明玻璃质感、精细的金色线条、深邃的阴影、电影般的景深以及宏大的神秘氛围。构图保持一致：角色位于桌后中心，上半身前倾，面部区域阴暗不可见，手部和发光的行星位于前景，桌面上的行星绘图细节丰富且清晰。{argument name="art style" default="奢华暗黑奇幻动漫，超精细，电影级光影"}，竖版 3:4 比例。

templates.title: Modern Atomic Age Space Fashion Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 现代原子时代太空时尚海报

templates.prompt: Create a vibrant contemporary atomic-age pop art fashion illustration against a clean white background, blending black-and-white retro photography with neon vector graphics and halftone print effects. At the center of the image is a mid-century space-age woman floating in the background.{argument name="character description" default="A slender young woman with pale gray skin, a glossy black bob, and wearing a small black round hat."} She stood in a diagonal pose, as if dancing in zero gravity, one arm raised, the other outstretched. Her face was intentionally obscured by a softly edged, dark gray square blurring. (To dress her...){argument name="outfit" default="A 1960s-style white modern mini skirt with striking black trim, vertical black stripes on the front, black cuffs, a black hem, white over-the-knee boots, and black ankle boots."} .use{argument name="color palette" default="Magenta, turquoise, lime yellow, orange, black, and white"} A collage of atomic-age space art surrounds her: on the left, a lime-colored rocket with magenta tail fins and an orange exhaust flame is precisely placed; in the lower right corner, two flying saucers are placed, including a large lime-colored and black saucer with a pink dome, and a smaller pink saucer near the bottom center; in the middle right, a black atomic orbital diagram with a magenta nucleus is placed; at the bottom and near the left edge, four huge foreground antenna spheres are placed, in cyan, magenta, lime, and orange respectively; in addition, there are many black dots, miniature planets, orbital lines, and needle-like starbursts. Oversized Ben-Day halftone dots and radial dot patterns are used, especially the huge hot pink burst effect in the upper right corner, the cyan dot cloud on the left, and the orange-pink gradient in the lower right corner. Adding sharp black radial lines, retro satellite shapes, colorful spheres, and slender orbital curves creates a playful feel that combines the texture of a 1950s science fiction poster with modern glossy contrasts. The composition should be vertical, dynamic, high-energy, sharp, and concise, combining a stylish editorial style with a retro space race poster. A small handwritten signature and date should be included in the lower right corner.{argument name="date text" default="May 10, 2026"} and{argument name="signature text" default="Oyagi"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 在干净的白色背景上创作一张充满活力的当代原子时代波普艺术时尚插画，融合黑白复古摄影与霓虹矢量图形及半色调印刷效果。画面中心为一位漂浮的世纪中期太空时代女性，{argument name="character description" default="一位身材苗条的年轻女性，拥有苍白的灰度肤色、光泽的黑色波波头，戴着一顶黑色小圆帽"}，呈对角线姿势，仿佛在零重力下跳舞，一只手臂抬起，另一只手臂伸展。她的脸部被一个边缘柔和的深灰色方形模糊处理有意遮挡。为她穿上 {argument name="outfit" default="一件 1960 年代白色摩登迷你裙，带有醒目的黑色饰边、前襟垂直黑条纹、黑色袖口、黑色下摆、白色过膝高筒靴和黑色小高跟鞋"}。用 {argument name="color palette" default="洋红色、青绿色、青柠黄、橙色、黑色和白色"} 的原子时代太空拼贴画环绕她：左侧精确放置 1 枚带有洋红色尾翼和橙色尾焰的青柠色火箭；右下角放置 2 个飞碟，包括一个带有粉色圆顶的大型青柠色配黑色飞碟，以及底部中心附近的一个较小的粉色飞碟；中右侧放置 1 个带有洋红色原子核的黑色原子轨道图；底部和左侧边缘附近放置 4 个巨大的前景天线球体，颜色分别为青色、洋红色、青柠色和橙色；此外还有许多黑点、微型行星、轨道线和针状星爆。使用超大号的 Ben-Day 半色调圆点和放射状点阵，特别是右上角巨大的热粉色爆发效果、左侧的青色点云以及右下角的橙粉色渐变。添加清晰的黑色放射线、复古人造卫星形状、彩色小球和细长的轨道曲线，营造出一种既有 1950 年代科幻海报质感，又具备现代光泽对比的俏皮感。构图应为纵向，动感十足、高能量、锐利、简洁，呈现时尚编辑风格与复古太空竞赛海报的结合。在右下角包含一个小的手写签名和日期，内容为 {argument name="date text" default="2026 年 5 月 10 日"} 和 {argument name="signature text" default="Oyagi"}。

templates.title: Retro Space Rabbit Anime Mascot

titleLocalized.zh: 复古太空兔动漫吉祥物

templates.prompt: Create a simple retro-futuristic 2D anime illustration with a white background and a cheerful space-age bunny girl mascot as the main subject.{argument name="character name" default="Oyagi"} She uses a dynamic, full-body poster pose. She keeps {argument name="hair color" default="Soft gold"} She sports a short, fluffy bob with curled ends and side-swept bangs; she has large, bright blue eyes, rosy cheeks, and a slightly parted smile revealing small bunny teeth, giving her an adorable and energetic expression. She wears a white bunny-ear helmet with pink lining to the two tall ears, decorated with a turquoise headband, and a black circular badge with a pink starburst pattern on the side of each ear; she wears white bunny gloves, a sleeveless white modern mini-dress with turquoise side panels, pink piping, a black belt, and a black and pink starburst badge on her chest. She has a fluffy white cotton tail, white mid-calf boots with turquoise heels and matching starburst badges. She stands on one leg on a flat, turquoise oval shadow, the other leg bent backward, her left index finger pointing upward, and her right hand outstretched, as if demonstrating a scene. Surrounded by playful 1960s atomic space graphic design: a large soft pink circle behind the body, a large slanted turquoise ellipse behind the head and shoulders, two yellow orbital rings diagonally across the image, and two atomic diagrams composed of colored dots and orbital lines, one on the right and the other in the lower left. Includes 17 decorative star/glitter elements: a black octagonal star with colored rays in the upper left, a black four-pointed star in the upper right, three turquoise four-pointed glitters, three pink four-pointed glitters, three yellow four-pointed glitters, three peach-orange four-pointed glitters, and three tiny white glitters. Includes 10 individual colored dots: four turquoise dots, three pink dots, two peach dots, and one tiny black dot. Using crisp black lines and glossy cel coloring, the color palette features soft turquoise, bubblegum pink, and lemon yellow, accented with black, presenting a high-resolution, cute anime poster style. A small handwritten signature and date are added in the lower right corner, containing the following text:{argument name="date text" default="May 10, 2026"} and{argument name="signature text" default="Oyagi"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张简洁的复古未来主义 2D 动漫插画，背景为白色，主体是一位欢快的太空时代兔女郎吉祥物，{argument name="character name" default="Oyagi"}，采用动态的全身海报姿势。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="柔和金色"} 的短款蓬松波波头，发尾卷曲，带有斜刘海；拥有一双巨大的亮青色眼睛、红润的脸颊、微张的笑脸露出小小的兔牙，表情可爱且充满活力。她戴着一个白色兔耳头盔，两只高耸的耳朵内衬为桃粉色，配有青绿色头带装饰，耳朵侧面有一个带有粉色星爆图案的黑色圆形徽章；配戴白色小兔手套，身穿无袖白色摩登迷你裙，侧面有青绿色拼接，粉色滚边，黑色腰带，胸前饰有黑粉相间的星爆徽章，身后有一个蓬松的白色棉花尾巴，脚穿白色中筒靴，配有青绿色鞋跟和同款星爆徽章。让她单脚站在一个扁平的青绿色椭圆形阴影上，另一条腿向后弯曲，左手食指向上指，右手向外张开，仿佛在展示场景。周围环绕着俏皮的 1960 年代原子太空图形设计：身体后方有一个巨大的柔和粉色圆圈，头部和肩后有一个巨大的倾斜青绿色椭圆，两个黄色轨道环斜向穿过画面，还有两个由彩色圆点和轨道线组成的原子图，一个位于右侧，另一个位于左下方。包含 17 个装饰性的星星/闪光元素：左上方有一个带彩色光芒的黑色八角星，右上方有一个黑色四角星，三个青绿色四角闪光，三个粉色四角闪光，三个黄色四角闪光，三个桃橙色四角闪光，以及三个微小的白色闪光。包含 10 个独立的彩色圆点：四个青绿色圆点，三个粉色圆点，两个桃色圆点，以及一个微小的黑色圆点。使用清晰的黑色线条、亮面赛璐珞上色，色调采用柔和的青绿色、泡泡糖粉色、柠檬黄，点缀黑色，呈现高分辨率的可爱动漫海报风格。在右下角添加一个小巧的手写签名和日期，内容为 {argument name="date text" default="2026 年 5 月 10 日"} 和 {argument name="signature text" default="Oyagi"}。

templates.title: Photo of colorful scones

titleLocalized.zh: 色彩丰富的司康饼标注照片

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, retain the original scones photo and composition, but redesign the overlaid labels to make them look more refined, colorful, and social media shareable, like a doodle drawn with bright markers and stickers. Clearly label the scones on the left as cheese scones and the ones on the right as chocolate raisin scones. Replace the previous handwritten content with 8 clearly visible Japanese text labels:{argument name="left scone label" default="こっちはチーズスコーン"} , "Outer サク, Middle フワ, チーズたっぷり",{argument name="cheese headline" default="うまチーズ!"} ,{argument name="bottom headline" default="Freshly baked! Scone Collection"} ,{argument name="right scone label" default="Rich chocolate! & juicy raisins"} Add the labels “Choco & Lazes” and two small “Ami-hito-taki” annotations near the chocolate raisin scones. Add cute illustrative elements not present in the original image: a small piece of cheese on the cheese scones, two clusters of chocolate chip doodles, raisin/nut doodles, curved arrows pointing to each type of scone, glitter, hearts, confetti, and confetti canister decorations. Use a thick white outline and shadow around the text to make the labels stand out while maintaining the realism of the baked scones without obscuring them.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图片，保持原有的司康饼照片和构图，但重新设计叠加的标注，使其看起来更精致、色彩更丰富，更具社交媒体分享价值，就像用明亮的马克笔和贴纸风格的涂鸦绘制的一样。清晰地标明左侧的司康饼为芝士司康，右侧的为巧克力葡萄干司康。将之前的手写内容替换为 8 个清晰可见的日语文本标注：{argument name="left scone label" default="こっちはチーズスコーン"}、“外サク、中フワ、チーズたっぷり”、{argument name="cheese headline" default="うまチーズ!"}、{argument name="bottom headline" default="焼きたて！スコーン・コレクション"}、{argument name="right scone label" default="濃厚チョコ！&ジューシーレーズン"}、“チョコ＆レーズン”，以及在巧克力葡萄干司康附近添加两个小的“甘いひととき”注释。添加原图中没有的可爱插图元素：芝士司康上的一小块芝士、两簇巧克力豆涂鸦、葡萄干/坚果涂鸦、指向每种司康饼的弯曲箭头、闪光、爱心、五彩纸屑和礼花筒装饰。文字周围使用粗白描边和投影，使标注更加突出，同时保持烘焙好的司康饼真实且不被遮挡。

templates.prompt: Create a realistic portrait with soft lighting, featuring a subject who {argument name="subject" default="Young East Asian women"} She was sitting by a bright, large window in the room. She kept {argument name="hair color and style" default="Long, straight chestnut brown hair, naturally parted in the middle, falling over both shoulders."} She wore delicate gold hoop earrings and had a slender, elegant figure. Her face was deliberately anonymized by a matte, grayish-brown opaque square located in the center, covering her forehead and chin. She was dressed in {argument name="top" default="White sheer floral lace long-sleeved top with a high round neck design."} and{argument name="skirt" default="Slim-fit light beige high-waisted skirt"} Have her sit with a slight forward lean, hands clasped near her knees, creating a serene, fashion magazine feel. Use bright, natural sunlight coming in from the left, creating an airy, overexposed effect. Outside the window are soft-focus green plants, and to the right are light-colored stone or marble tiles. The interior surfaces are creamy white, with a shallow depth of field showcasing realistic fabric textures, delicate lace details, and soft highlights on the hair. promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实风格、光线柔和的肖像，主角为一位 {argument name="subject" default="年轻东亚女性"}，正坐在室内一扇明亮的大窗户旁。她留着 {argument name="hair color and style" default="栗棕色长直发，自然中分，垂在双肩"}，佩戴精致的金色圆环耳饰，身形纤细优雅。她的面部通过一个位于中央、从额头覆盖至下巴的哑光灰褐色不透明方块进行刻意匿名处理。她身着 {argument name="top" default="白色透明花卉蕾丝长袖上衣，高圆领设计"} 和 {argument name="skirt" default="修身浅米色高腰裙"}。让她保持微微前倾的坐姿，双手合拢置于膝盖附近，营造出平静的时尚杂志感。使用从左侧射入的明亮自然日光，呈现空气感过曝效果，窗外为柔焦绿植，右侧为浅色石材或大理石墙砖，室内表面呈奶油白色，浅景深，展现真实的织物纹理、精致的蕾丝细节以及发丝上的柔和高光，采用竖构图，3:4 宽高比，高分辨率编辑摄影风格。

templates.prompt: Create a realistic, high-key portrait photograph featuring a young woman.{argument name="hair color" default="Chestnut brown long hair"} Her smooth, straight hair was parted in the middle, with fine strands shimmering in the light. She sat by a bright, large window in a sunny room, her body slightly turned towards the camera, revealing her shoulders, wearing an elegant dress.{argument name="top color" default="Creamy white"} A ribbed tank top with thin straps and delicate lace trim. The composition is a vertical half-body close-up, from head to torso. Her face is obscured by a centrally located opaque square privacy occlusion block in a soft warm brown/taupe color, covering all facial features but leaving the hair, neck, shoulders, and clothing visible. The shot utilizes soft natural sunlight, airy overexposed window light, and a shallow depth of field. Outside the window are blurred urban greenery and light-colored building outlines. Skin tones are soft, hair texture is realistic, and the overall effect is a clean lifestyle photographic atmosphere. It has an 85mm lens feel, soft bokeh, a simple background, and creates an intimate and tranquil atmosphere with photorealistic detail in a vertical composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张逼真的高调人像摄影作品，主角是一位年轻女性，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="栗棕色长发"}，柔顺的直发中分，细碎的发丝在光线下闪烁。她坐在室内明亮的大窗户旁，正值阳光明媚的日子，身体微微侧向镜头，露出双肩，身穿一件精致的 {argument name="top color" default="奶油白色"} 罗纹吊带背心，带有细肩带和微妙的蕾丝饰边。构图为垂直半身近景，从头部到上躯干，她的面部被一个位于中心的不透明方形隐私遮挡块遮住，颜色为柔和的暖棕色/灰褐色，遮盖了所有面部特征，但保留了头发、颈部、肩膀和服装可见。采用柔和的自然日光、空气感过曝的窗光、浅景深，窗外是模糊的城市绿植和浅色建筑轮廓，肤色柔和，发质逼真，呈现干净的生活方式摄影氛围，具有 85mm 镜头感，柔和的焦外成像，背景简洁，营造出亲密宁静的氛围，照片级真实细节，竖屏构图。

templates.prompt: Create a realistic vertical portrait of a stylish young woman standing outdoors near the entrance of a modern building, bathed in bright natural sunlight. She has long, flowing hair, and her hair color is {argument name="hair color" default="Warm chestnut brown"} Her hair, with soft layers and a side-swept fringe, cascaded over her shoulders, its edges shimmering with a subtle sheen. Her face was deliberately concealed by a centrally located, opaque rectangular privacy veil, a soft beige-brown gradient covering the entire face from forehead to chin, while preserving visibility of her hair, neck, and body. She wore an elegant dress…{argument name="blouse color" default="Ivory cream"} A sheer long-sleeved shirt with a delicate draped tie detail at the neckline, paired with a high-waisted light beige tweed skirt. A delicate small gold necklace adorns her collarbone. Her right hand gently brushes a strand of hair from her shoulder, and a beige handbag with a thin gold chain hangs from her right shoulder in the lower right corner of the image. The composition is a three-quarter profile portrait from the waist up, slightly to the right, with a blurred cityscape in the background, revealing light-colored stone pillars, glass doors, gray pavement, and greenery on the left. Employing a realistic photographic style, shallow depth of field, high-resolution detail, and the warm midday sunlight, the hair and shirt have soft highlights, the refined feminine styling, and the natural candid pose, presenting a clean and modern Japanese fashion magazine aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实风格的竖版人像照片，拍摄一位时尚的年轻女性，她正站在现代建筑入口附近的户外，沐浴在明亮的自然阳光下。她留着一头柔顺的长发，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="暖栗棕色"}，带有柔和的层次感和侧分刘海，发丝垂落在肩头，边缘闪烁着光泽。她的面部被一个居中的不透明矩形隐私遮挡块刻意遮盖，遮挡块呈现柔和的米棕色肤色渐变，覆盖了从额头到下巴的整个面部区域，但保留了头发、颈部和身体的可见度。她身穿一件优雅的 {argument name="blouse color" default="象牙奶油色"} 透明长袖衬衫，领口带有柔和的垂坠系带细节，下身搭配高腰浅米色粗花呢半身裙。锁骨处佩戴一条精致的小金项链。她的右手轻轻撩起肩头的一缕秀发，右肩挂着一个带有细金链条的米色手提包，位于画面右下角。构图为腰部以上的四分之三侧身人像，主体略微偏右，背景为虚化的城市景观，可见浅色石柱、玻璃门、灰色路面以及左侧的绿植。采用写实摄影风格，浅景深，高分辨率细节，温暖的正午阳光，头发和衬衫上带有柔和的高光，精致的女性化造型，自然的抓拍姿态，呈现出干净现代的日系时尚杂志美学。

templates.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic portrait photo of a person holding a plastic-sealed fictional game box inside a Japanese video game store. In the foreground, a left hand holds a transparent plastic Nintendo Switch-style game box, slightly tilted towards the camera, with glossy reflections, plastic seams, and a realistic retail barcode. The game cover is titled {argument name="game title" default="LUMINA GRAY"} A dark gothic sci-fi fantasy RPG, subtitled{argument name="subtitle" default="Silent Nexus"} The main subject of the cover art is{argument name="character name" default="Lumina Gray"} The game features an elegant, pale-skinned, silver-haired female protagonist clad in a magnificent black and gold cyborg armor. Her long, flowing hair reveals her waist, adorned with a cloak-like black fabric, gold circuit patterns, and a blurred, mysterious face. Behind her lies a towering nighttime cathedral city, filled with golden lights, vertical spires, floating mechanical rings, and mysterious clockwork symbols, with a glowing circular mark in the upper right corner. Near the top are the Japanese cover text "Unmei ni Koue" and "Shizuku no Oku de, Monogatari wa Mu wo Akumasu," while near the bottom are small Japanese marketing text, a rating badge "NX-15 AGES 15+," publisher text "Astervel Works" and "Noctis Frame Interactive," and a decorative compass-shaped logo. The side spine of the game box also bears the inscription "LUMINA GRAY" and "Silent Nexus." The background showcases a realistic store shelf filled with other boxed games, Japanese yen price tags, black shelf tracks, blurred cover art, and visible signs including "New Release: A Hot Topic," "Altered Hearts," and "Echo." A shallow depth-of-field effect makes the handheld game boxes clearly visible, while the store background is softly blurred. The lighting should be a blend of melancholic retail fluorescent lights and warm golden reflections from the covers, revealing realistic skin textures and nails. It employs a documentary photography style, rich in detail, with natural perspective, no illustrated borders, and is not a flat mockup.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超写实的竖屏手机照片，展示一个人在日本电子游戏店内手持一款塑封的虚构游戏盒。前景中，一只左手握着一个透明塑料 Nintendo Switch 风格的游戏盒，略微向镜头倾斜，带有光泽反射、塑料接缝和逼真的零售条形码。游戏封面是一款名为 {argument name="game title" default="LUMINA GRAY"} 的暗黑哥特科幻奇幻 RPG，副标题为 {argument name="subtitle" default="Silent Nexus"}；封面艺术的主角是 {argument name="character name" default="Lumina Gray"}，一位优雅的苍白皮肤银发女主角，身穿华丽的黑金赛博格装甲，长发飘逸，露出腰部，带有斗篷般的黑色织物、金色电路花纹以及模糊而神秘的面容。她身后是一座高耸的夜间大教堂城市，充满了金色灯光、垂直尖塔、漂浮的机械环、神秘的钟表符号，右上角有一个发光的圆形印记。在顶部附近添加日语封面文案“运命に抗え”和“静寂の奥で、物語は目を覚ます”，底部附近添加小的日语营销文本、评级徽章“NX-15 AGES 15+”、发行商文本“Astervel Works”和“Noctis Frame Interactive”，以及一个装饰性的指南针状标志。游戏盒侧脊也印有“LUMINA GRAY”和“Silent Nexus”。背景中，展示一个逼真的商店货架，上面摆满了其他塑料盒装游戏、日元价格标签、黑色货架轨道、模糊的封面艺术，以及可见的标牌，包括“新作 NEW RELEASE 話題作”、“ALTERED HEARTS”和“Echo”；使用浅景深效果，使手持的游戏盒清晰可见，而商店背景则柔和模糊。光线应为忧郁的零售荧光灯与封面上温暖的金色反射混合，展现真实的皮肤纹理和指甲，采用纪实摄影风格，细节丰富，透视自然，无插画边框，非平面样机。

templates.prompt: Create a simple retro travel poster illustration with the theme of Japan.{argument name="city name" default="GIFU"} This is a fine monochrome line art piece drawn with deep forest green ink on a warm ivory paper background. The composition is vertically symmetrical, with a large, minimalist sans-serif title at the top.{argument name="headline text" default="GIFU"} Below is a detailed street view of the Yanagise Arcade Shopping Street, with a line of small print at the bottom explaining its features.{argument name="bottom caption" default="Gifu City, JAPAN"} The entrance to the shopping street is shown from a perspective view, with the main signboard text as follows:{argument name="arcade sign text" default="Yanagase"} A long, glass-and-metal arched roof stretches into the distance, flanked by densely packed shops with signs, traffic lights, and utility poles. A zebra crossing is visible in the foreground, and behind the buildings, the outline of mountains and a small Japanese castle is faintly discernible. The image presents a vibrant cityscape, including pedestrians, two female students with backpacks walking into a shopping street in the foreground center, cyclists moving from left to right in the foreground, a café on the left, and a woman in a dress carrying shopping bags on the right. Using fine architectural lines, delicate hatching, manga-inspired urban details, and a flat, two-color woodblock print style with no shadows except for ink lines, it creates a nostalgic travel poster atmosphere. Employing central perspective and clear typography, it showcases the tranquil and refined aesthetics of Japanese city travel. Visible Japanese shop signs are added, including bookstores, cafes, Yanagase Street, and small vertical shop signs, while the overall color scheme is limited to dark green and ivory.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张简洁的复古旅行海报插画，主题为日本 {argument name="city name" default="GIFU"}，采用深森林绿墨水绘制的精细单色线条艺术，背景为暖象牙色纸张。构图呈垂直对称，顶部设有一个巨大的极简无衬线标题 {argument name="headline text" default="GIFU"}，下方为柳ヶ瀬拱廊商店街的详细街景，底部配有一行小字说明 {argument name="bottom caption" default="岐阜市 JAPAN"}。以透视视角展示商店街入口，主招牌文字为 {argument name="arcade sign text" default="柳ヶ瀬"}，长长的玻璃金属拱形屋顶向远处延伸，两侧是密集的店面，挂着商店招牌、交通信号灯、电线杆，前景有斑马线，建筑后方隐约可见群山和一座小型日本城堡轮廓。画面呈现生动的城市景象，包括行人、前景中央背着书包走进商店街的两名女学生、前景从左向右骑行的骑车人、左侧的咖啡座，以及右侧一位拎着购物袋的裙装女性。使用精细的建筑绘图线条、细腻的排线、受漫画启发的城市细节、扁平的双色版画风格，除墨线纹理外无阴影，营造怀旧的旅游海报氛围，采用中心透视，排版清晰，展现宁静精致的日本城市旅行美学。添加可见的日本店面招牌，包括书店、咖啡馆、柳ヶ瀬通以及小型垂直店招，同时将整体色调限制在深绿色和象牙色。

templates.title: Ivory Costume Goddess

titleLocalized.zh: 象牙服饰女神

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed, ethereal fantasy illustration, the main character is {argument name="character name" default="Goddess of Fashion"} A divine female figure stands facing forward in a hazy, deep gray void, clad in a luminous ivory and pearl-white gown. She wears an extravagant semi-transparent veil and headdress composed of layers of lace, embroidered mesh, white flowers, pearls, silver and gold filigree, and tiny crystal embellishments; her face is hidden behind the thick veil and floral headdress, creating a mysterious and sacred atmosphere. Behind her head is a large, circular halo, shaped like a magnificent lace crown, adorned with intricate Gothic gold and silver filigree, delicate pointed arches, floral patterns, and shimmering beads. Her attire is a lavish bridal goddess costume: flowing, sheer bell sleeves, a tulle cape, a fitted jeweled bodice with silver embroidery, pearl chains, lace appliqués, a lavish waist embellishment, and a long, flowing white skirt. One hand is raised near the veil, as if making a gentle adjustment, while the other hangs at her waist, grasping or touching a hanging silver lace ornament. The use of soft, monochromatic tones, including…{argument name="main color palette" default="Ivory, Pearl Silver, Light Champagne, and Smoked Charcoal Gray"} It features luminous highlights, a hazy, shimmering dust particles, and translucent fabric edges. The style should be romantic dark fantasy, ultra-delicate lace details, elegant anime-style concept art, a combination of delicate watercolor softness and fine digital painting, haute couture, a sacred bridal goddess atmosphere, vertical portrait composition, no text, no modern objects, and no harsh outlines.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅高度精细的空灵奇幻插画，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="服饰女神"}，一位神圣的女性形象，正面站立在朦胧的深灰色虚空中，全身穿着发光的象牙色和珍珠白礼服。她戴着夸张的半透明面纱和头饰，由层叠的蕾丝、刺绣网纱、白花、珍珠、银质金银丝细工和细小的水晶装饰组成；她的脸庞隐藏在浓密的面纱和花卉头饰后，营造出一种神秘而神圣的氛围。她脑后是一个巨大的圆形光环，形状如同一顶华丽的蕾丝皇冠，带有复杂的哥特式金银丝细工、精致的尖拱、花卉纹饰和闪烁的珠饰。她的服装是一套奢华的新娘女神装束：飘逸的透明喇叭袖、薄纱披风、带有银色刺绣的紧身珠宝胸衣、珍珠链、蕾丝贴花、华丽的腰部装饰，以及一条垂直下垂的修长白色裙子。一只手抬起靠近面纱，仿佛在轻轻调整，另一只手垂在腰间，握住或触碰着悬挂的银色蕾丝饰品。使用柔和的单色调，包括 {argument name="main color palette" default="象牙白、珍珠银、浅香槟色和烟熏炭灰色"}，并带有发光的高光、薄雾、闪烁的尘埃颗粒和半透明的织物边缘。风格应为浪漫暗黑奇幻、超精细蕾丝细节、优雅的动漫风格概念艺术、精致的水彩柔和感与精细数字绘画的结合、高级时装、神圣的新娘女神氛围、竖构图肖像，无文字，无现代物品，无生硬轮廓。

titleLocalized.zh: MPEG-4 FAP 动漫表情测试

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 and REFERENCE_1 as the MPEG-4 FAP control lookup table,{argument name="character name" default="The character"} Regenerate the character's pose/expression in an anime style. Apply two motion parameters from the chart: apply FAP 39, labeled "puff_l_cheek," to the left cheek to puff it out, and apply FAP 50, labeled "head_roll," to the head to tilt it to the side. Maintain the character's original clothing, headphones, handheld game console, cute heart effects, and vertical composition; only change the facial expression and head movement based on these two FAP numbers. Use a refined 2D anime illustration style, combined with clean lighting and compact vertical cropping.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 和 REFERENCE_1 作为 MPEG-4 FAP 控制查找表，将 {argument name="character name" default="该角色"} 重新生成为动漫风格的角色姿势/表情测试。应用图表中的 2 个动作参数：将标记为“puff_l_cheek”的 FAP 39 应用于左脸颊使其鼓起，并将标记为“head_roll”的 FAP 50 应用于头部使其侧向倾斜。保持角色原有的服装、耳机、手持游戏机、可爱的爱心特效以及竖构图，仅根据这两个 FAP 编号更改面部表情和头部动作。使用精致的 2D 动漫插画风格，配合干净的灯光和紧凑的竖向裁剪。

templates.prompt: Create a dreamy, anime-style close-up self-portrait of a young female student, evoking a soft spring atmosphere, as if the camera is shooting from above at close range. The character has flowing hair {argument name="hair color" default="Soft blonde hair with pink and lavender highlights"} Her hair danced in the wind in the picture, with a tuft of hair sticking up on her head, and she wore a light-colored outfit.{argument name="outfit" default="Sailor school uniform with red bow tie"} The face is obscured by a large, opaque lavender-pink square in the center, covering most of the head and upper body. The background is {argument name="seasonal setting" default="Cherry blossoms under a bright blue-pink sky"} The composition features bokeh, with petals falling from the air and strong backlighting in the upper left. It employs soft purple and rose hues, creating a shallow depth of field, halos, lens softening, and subtle motion blur. The composition should be natural and spontaneous, like a selfie captured under a magical sunset, with the character filling most of the frame and hair extending to the edges. High-quality anime illustration rendering is used, resulting in ethereal lighting, soft focus, bright highlights, and romantic pastel tones.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张梦幻动漫风格的年轻女学生近景自拍肖像，营造柔和的春日氛围，仿佛相机正从上方近距离拍摄。角色拥有一头飘逸的 {argument name="hair color" default="带有粉色和薰衣草色挑染的柔和金发"}，发丝在画面中随风飞舞，头顶可见一撮呆毛，身穿浅色 {argument name="outfit" default="带有红色领结的水手校服"}。面部被一个位于中心的大型不透明薰衣草粉色方块遮挡，覆盖了头部和上半身的大部分区域。背景为 {argument name="seasonal setting" default="明亮蓝粉色天空下的樱花"} 散景，花瓣在空中飘落，左上方有强烈的逆光，采用柔和的紫色和玫瑰色调，具有浅景深、光晕、镜头柔化和轻微的动态模糊效果。构图应自然且随性，如同在魔法般的夕阳下捕捉到的自拍，角色填满大部分画面，发丝延伸至两侧边缘。采用高质量动漫插画渲染，光影空灵，焦点柔和，高光亮丽，并使用浪漫的粉彩调色。

templates.title: A parallel universe's 1990s future Shibuya

titleLocalized.zh: 平行时空的 1990 年代未来涩谷

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic, cinematic nighttime street scene at the location of{argument name="city and district" default="Shibuya, Tokyo"} The setting is that Japanese culture is stuck in the 1990s, but technology has advanced to {argument name="future year" default="2026"} A parallel universe: no smartphones, no modern minimalist LED lights, only flip phones, pagers, taxis, buses, analog-era nightlife, and dense Showa- to Heisei-era style signs beneath newly built high-rise towers. The perspective is from a wet pedestrian crossing after the rain, looking towards a crowded neon-lit entertainment district, with dazzling reflections on the black pavement. The frame must include four prominent vehicles: a red and white taxi in the lower left foreground, a city bus with its headlights on in the center background, and two dark-colored sedans in the midground traffic. It includes numerous commuters and nightlife pedestrians dressed in 1990s clothing; in the foreground are two key figures with their backs to the camera: a young woman with long hair and a shoulder bag on the left, and a young man in a denim jacket and carrying a shopping bag in the center. The architectural style should blend the 2020s-scale skyscrapers in the background with 1990s Japanese commercial buildings covered in vertical signs, karaoke ads, nightclub notices, CD shop-style posters, pachinko machines, and entertainment billboards. It includes three core billboards: a curved building on the left with red Japanese characters and a large faded screen; a central billboard {argument name="central billboard text" default="Blue Wind"} The billboards feature blue idol group advertisements, and to the right, a tall, cylindrical billboard with striking red Japanese lettering and retro anime-style female illustrations. All signs use Japanese, but the font should be slightly imperfect and atmospheric, rather than a uniform layout. Lighting should create a somber, damp, and cinematic atmosphere, incorporating amber taxi lights, cyan signs, red neon lights, halo effects, deep shadows, visible grain, slight lens soft focus, and a nostalgic 35mm film feel. The composition should resemble a documentary photograph of a fictional historical Tokyo—crowded, vertical, striking, and realistic, presenting…{argument name="weather mood" default="Rain-soaked streets and damp night air"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张具有照片级真实感的电影质感夜间街景，地点为 {argument name="city and district" default="东京涩谷"}，设定为日本文化停留在 1990 年代但科技发展至 {argument name="future year" default="2026 年"} 的平行时空：没有智能手机，没有现代简约的 LED 灯光，只有翻盖手机、寻呼机、出租车、公交车、模拟时代的夜生活，以及在新建的高层塔楼下密集的昭和至平成时代风格招牌。视角位于雨后潮湿的人行横道，望向拥挤的霓虹娱乐区，黑色路面上映出绚丽的倒影。画面中需包含 4 辆显眼的车辆：左下角前景处一辆红白相间的出租车，中心远景处一辆开启前灯的城市公交车，以及中景车流中的 2 辆深色轿车。包含大量身着 1990 年代服饰的通勤者和夜生活行人；前景有 2 位背对镜头的核心人物，左侧是一位留着长发、背着单肩包的年轻女性，中心是一位穿着牛仔夹克、手提购物袋的年轻男性。建筑风格应将背景中 2020 年代规模的摩天大楼与覆盖着垂直招牌、卡拉 OK 广告、夜店告示、CD 店风格海报、弹珠机及娱乐广告牌的 1990 年代日本商业建筑融合在一起。包含 3 组核心广告牌：左侧一座带有红色日文字符和大型褪色屏幕的弧形建筑，中心一块写有 {argument name="central billboard text" default="青い風"} 的蓝色偶像团体广告牌，以及右侧一座带有醒目红色日文字体和复古动漫风格女性插画的高大圆柱形广告牌。所有招牌均使用日文，但字体应略显不完美且具有氛围感，而非整齐划一的排版。灯光应呈现出阴郁、潮湿且具有电影感的氛围，包含琥珀色的出租车灯、青蓝色的招牌、红色霓虹灯、光晕效果、深邃的阴影、可见的颗粒感、轻微的镜头柔焦以及怀旧的 35 毫米胶片质感。构图应如同架空历史东京的纪实摄影，拥挤、垂直、令人震撼且真实，并呈现 {argument name="weather mood" default="雨水浸润的街道和潮湿的夜空气"}。

templates.prompt: Create a dark epic fantasy 2D concept art illustration depicting {argument name="character name" default="A silver-haired storm queen"} Standing on the rooftop of a Gothic castle or in the pouring rain, she dramatically turned three-quarters of the way to the side, displaying her upper body in a striking pose. She had extremely long {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} Her braided hair cascaded over her shoulders, and she wore an exquisite spiked crown. Her skin was pale, and her face was deliberately obscured by a flat, soft gray rectangular mask, devoid of any features. She was dressed in magnificent royal battle attire: a fitted white and midnight blue belted gown, tiered skirts, gold filigree chains and thorny metal embellishments, jeweled arm guards, claw gauntlets, a fur-trimmed shawl, and a long, dark cloak that billowed violently in the wind. In her left hand she gripped a tall, serrated magic staff or spear, made of black metal and luminous {argument name="magic color" default="Magenta"} The design features a crystalline structure surrounded by spiraling energy rings, sparks, and floating debris. The background is a medieval fantasy cityscape in a storm, incorporating sharp cathedral towers, fortress spires, hanging banners, distant rooftops, rain streaks, and turbulent moonlit clouds. It utilizes a cool purplish-grey tone, complemented by bright magenta highlights, cinematic backlighting, contour lighting on wet armor, high contrast, fine details, a painterly anime/game art style, ultra-detailed fantasy character design, dynamic composition, and a 16:9 widescreen aspect ratio.

promptLocalized.zh: {"type":"三联维多利亚时代历史漫画插图","title_banner":"{argument name=\"title banner text\" default=\"真实与奇特\"}","overall_style":"高度详细的复古插画报纸版画，维多利亚时代伦敦，棕褐色墨水线条配柔和水彩渲染，交叉排线，做旧奶油色纸张边框，深色轮廓，电影感灯光，风格奇幻但基于事实，19 世纪雕版印刷与故事书写实风格的结合","format":"宽幅水平三联画，包含三个等宽垂直面板和一个底部说明条，细黑色面板边框，羊皮纸背景","main_character":{"role":"维多利亚时代伦敦拾荒者 (tosher)","appearance":"身材敦实的工人阶级成年男子，身穿打补丁的棕色外套，系着装满工具和杂物的泥泞围裙，蓝色领巾，平顶帽，靴子，肩背麻袋，手持灯笼和拾荒工具；面部特意模糊处理为柔和温暖的虚化矩形","customizable_name":"{argument name=\"character name\" default=\"拾荒者\"}"},"layout":{"panel_count":3,"panels":[{"number":1,"label":"1. 下潜","position":"左","scene":"维多利亚时代伦敦下水道入口附近的清晨或黄昏街道；湿漉漉的鹅卵石路，铁栏杆，井盖，煤气路灯，标有“新鲜”和“牛奶”的马车，远处类似圣保罗大教堂的圆顶和尖塔，橙灰色天空，拾荒者带着发光的灯笼、长杆、麻袋，姿态坚定地爬入下水道","key_objects_count":7,"key_objects":["下水道入口","发光的灯笼","铁井盖","煤气路灯","马车","远处大教堂天际线","拾荒者麻袋"]},{"number":2,"label":"2. 地下","position":"中","scene":"带有倒影水的拱形砖砌下水道隧道；拾荒者站在没过膝盖的浑水中，举着灯笼和长耙，寻找硬币和金属碎片；一只大老鼠坐在砖架上注视着他；附近放着一篮回收物；戏剧性的金色灯笼倒影和蓝绿色阴影","key_objects_count":8,"key_objects":["砖砌下水道拱门","浑浊的倒影水","举起的灯笼","长耙","大老鼠","砖架","柳条篮","散落的硬币和碎片"]},{"number":3,"label":"3. 收获","position":"右","scene":"夜晚昏暗的木质室内，拾荒者与一个小男孩坐在桌旁，两人的面部特意模糊处理为柔和温暖的虚化矩形；他们在灯光下清点当天的收获；窗外可见黑暗的城市轮廓；墙上挂着外套、帽子，贴着一张写有“当心鼠后”的海报，并配有老鼠插图，架子上放着陶器","key_objects_count":10,"key_objects":["木桌","铺在地图状布上的硬币","小件拾得物","油灯","小男孩","带夜景天际线的窗户","墙上海报","挂着的外套","帽子","小袋子"]}]},"visible_text":{"top_title":"{argument name=\"title banner text\" default=\"真实与奇特\"}","panel_labels_count":3,"panel_labels":["1. 下潜","2. 地下","3. 收获"],"poster_text":"当心鼠后","bottom_caption":"{argument name=\"bottom caption\" default=\"事实：维多利亚时代伦敦的拾荒者收入有时高于地面劳工。他们崇拜一位下水道女神——“鼠后”，并相信她的眷顾决定了当天的收获。\"}"},"composition_details":"保持每个面板充满微小的历史细节、泥泞质感、硬币、工具、老鼠、篮子、湿石、煤烟和温暖的煤气灯光。顶部使用横跨面板边框的中央标题带，底部使用全宽的带框事实说明条。避免现代元素。保留清晰易读的英文手写文字。","color_palette":"{argument name=\"color palette\" default=\"柔和棕褐色，烟雾蓝灰色，脏赭色，灯笼金，砖褐色\"}","aspect_ratio":"宽幅 2:1"}

promptLocalized.zh: {"type":"超精细黑暗奇幻全景插画","format":"宽幅电影感横幅，2.4:1 纵横比","style":"错综复杂的绘本钢笔淡彩奇幻艺术，融合水彩与水粉质感，密集的线条，大地色系的秋季调色板，温暖的灯笼光芒，奇幻哥特 Witchcore 风格，极高细节，连贯的重复服装主题，无现代物品","scene":{"setting":"魔法古老森林小径，上方是巨大的扭曲树枝，悬挂着草药和干花，发光的灯笼，蘑菇，树根，岩石，乌鸦，远处是歪斜的村庄小屋和带有温暖灯光的塔楼，朦胧的金色黄昏氛围","mood":"神奇的秋季游行，神秘而俏皮，充满了微小的细节和隐藏的小饰品"},"main subjects":{"count":5,"description":"五位旅行中的女巫从左向右横向游行，每位都戴着高高的歪斜尖顶帽，穿着层叠的拼布服装，背着挎包，挂着护身符、瓶子、绳索、羽毛、钥匙、干植物和手工魔法工具","characters":[{"position":"最左侧","description":"一位矮小佝偻的老女巫，几乎被巨大的背包架压弯，架子上挂满了数十个小玻璃罐、灯笼、头骨护身符、瓶子、捆绑物和悬挂的小饰品；一只乌鸦栖息在负重上；她手持一根粗糙的行走杖；她的脸被一个纯色深色方形遮挡块覆盖"},{"position":"左中","description":"一位开朗的卷发年轻女巫，戴着装饰性的宽檐帽，穿着层叠的裙子、橙黑条纹长袜、靴子、腰包和拥挤的背包；她一边走一边拿着闪光的魔杖或火把；散落的纸张和咒语卡片在她周围飞舞"},{"position":"中间","description":"一位高大神秘的女巫，身披黑色斗篷，戴着非常大的尖顶帽，拿着一个小物件或烟斗，身边跟着一只长着鹿角和背包的小鹿状使魔；她的脸被一个纯色深色方形遮挡块覆盖"},{"position":"右中","description":"一位身材敦实、神情惊讶的卷发女巫，戴着圆眼镜，帽子上装饰着蘑菇，层叠的裙子上系着围裙，挂着许多小包和护身符；她背着一个装满魔法杂物的大开口挎包，正惊慌地做着手势"},{"position":"最右侧","description":"一位苗条的女巫，穿着长款华丽的拼布外套和高帽，手持挂着灯笼的法杖，身后拖着许多丝带、绳索和流苏；她的脸被一个纯色深色方形遮挡块覆盖"}]},"composition":"横向卷轴式构图，五位女巫均匀分布在前景中，上方由深色树枝框住，下方是长满蘑菇的岩石地面；背景充满了微型建筑和灯笼，但为了增加深度感略显朦胧","lighting":"温暖的琥珀色灯笼和魔杖火花与冷色调的阴影绿、棕色形成对比，柔和的体积雾，远处发光的窗户","customization":{"subject theme":"{argument name=\"subject theme\" default=\"旅行中的森林女巫\"}","number of characters":"{argument name=\"number of characters\" default=\"五位\"}","seasonal palette":"{argument name=\"seasonal palette\" default=\"秋季棕色、苔藓绿、赭石金、柔和橙色\"}","background setting":"{argument name=\"background setting\" default=\"魔法森林村庄小径\"}","face treatment":"{argument name=\"face treatment\" default=\"三张脸被纯色深色方形遮挡块覆盖\"}"},"negative prompt":"写实照片，3D 渲染，简洁矢量艺术，极简背景，现代服装，霓虹科幻，模糊细节，低细节面部，空旷的前景，纯色背景"}

promptLocalized.zh: {"type":"复古插画风格教育三联画海报","title":"{argument name=\"main title\" default=\"TRUE & PECULIAR\"}","overall_style":"高度精细的 19 世纪故事书版画和手绘平版印刷风格，棕褐色羊皮纸背景，华丽的黑色墨水边框，逼真的历史细节，温暖柔和的棕色、冰蓝色，褪色的奶油色纸张，编辑类历史杂志插画，连贯的冰块主题贯穿始终","layout":{"canvas":"宽幅横向海报，中间横跨三个带边框的大画幅，顶部中心设有装饰性丝带横幅，配有小型雪花图标和装饰性花纹，底部设有横跨全宽的事实说明框","panel_count":3,"sections":[{"title":"1. 切割","position":"左侧三分之一","scene":"日落时分的新英格兰冰封湖面，许多身着厚衣的工人在冰面上切割出网格，从中取出巨大的透明冰块，背景为积雪覆盖的松树林和低矮山丘，前景中一名工人跪在一块巨大的透明冰块旁，手持铁制冰钳和长锯，冷色调的蓝色阴影与橙色的天空余晖形成对比","visible_people":"约 13 名身穿深色冬装、戴着帽子、手套和靴子的采冰工人"},{"title":"2. 运输","position":"中间三分之一","scene":"19 世纪初繁忙的热带港口，一艘高大的帆船停泊在标有“ICE HOUSE”的木制冰库旁，周围有棕榈树、木桶、麻袋、板条箱，码头工人在卸货并搬运覆盖着锯末的冰块，当地商人和居民正在接收冰块，阳光明媚，码头气氛热烈","visible_people":"约 18 名码头工人、水手、商人和城镇居民"},{"title":"3. 酒吧","position":"右侧三分之一","scene":"优雅的殖民风格热带酒吧内部，配有雕花拱门、吊扇、酒瓶、玻璃杯、棕榈树，墙上贴着报纸风格的海报，写着“Tudor's Folly: Boston Man to Ship Ice to Tropics — from 1806”；身穿马甲的调酒师使用金属冰钳将透明冰块放入玻璃杯中，衣着考究的顾客正在享用鸡尾酒","visible_people":"约 12 名顾客和一名调酒师"}]},"text":{"top_banner":"{argument name=\"main title\" default=\"TRUE & PECULIAR\"}","panel_labels":["1. 切割","2. 运输","3. 酒吧"],"bottom_fact":"{argument name=\"fact text\" default=\"真实事实：在制冷技术出现之前，新英格兰的冰块被运往世界各地——包括印度、古巴等地——并用锯末包裹。弗雷德里克·都铎（Frederic Tudor）提出这一想法时曾遭到嘲笑。到 1880 年，他的“冰王”帝国价值已达 2800 万美元。\"}","wall_poster":"{argument name=\"wall poster text\" default=\"Tudor's Folly: Boston Man to Ship Ice to Tropics — from 1806\"}"},"decorative_elements":{"snowflakes":"四个显眼的黑色雪花图标，两个位于顶部标题两侧，两个位于底部事实说明框的角落","borders":"带有陈旧墨水感的黑色细矩形边框，卷曲的丝带标题牌，左上角和右上角有小型植物装饰花纹","bottom_box":"带有装饰性藤蔓和雪花符号的奶油色羊皮纸牌匾"},"composition_requirements":"使三个画幅在视觉上连贯，形成一张完整的海报；强调冰块从切割、运输到供应的叙事过程；使用清晰易读的英文排版；包含众多身着历史服装的人物，但保持其比例较小，作为冰块贸易故事的背景；保留古董插画的质感和密集的细线条细节"}

AMETHYST 和锚图案的马克杯、黄铜望远镜、标有 INK 的墨水瓶、硬币、绳索、航海工具，背景是一个舷窗。墙上的标牌写着：忠诚、勇敢且专业。羊皮纸标题写着：H.M.S. AMETHYST 船员名单，下方有手写的船员姓名和军衔。"},{"label":"2. 卓越贡献","position":"中","scene":"同一只戴着海军帽的虎斑猫，端坐在木质储藏室里，周围摆满了木桶、悬挂的平底锅、灯笼、货架和温暖的灯光。猫咪抬起一只爪子，仿佛在指挥或祝福一群船鼠。画面中共有 7 只清晰可见的老鼠：一只站在猫咪旁手持小白旗，两只坐在猫咪身后的货架上，一只在左下角抬头仰望，一只在前景正下方，一只在右下角前景，还有一只小老鼠在持旗者附近。氛围幽默且庄重。"},{"label":"3. 应得的休息","position":"右","scene":"虎斑猫蜷缩在铺满地图的桌子上的海军军官帽里睡觉，身处月光照耀的船长室。右侧有一盏温暖的黄铜灯笼在发光，窗外是深蓝色的夜空和满月，墙上挂着装裱好的帆船画和航海装饰。背景中有一位面部被棕色方块遮挡的睡眠中海军军官。猫咪附近有一个写着 DICKIN MEDAL 1949 的小奖章或标签。"}],"bottom_caption":{"position":"面板下方的全宽羊皮纸条","text":"{argument name=\"fact caption\" default=\"真实事实 #3：猫咪在皇家海军舰艇上正式服役至 1975 年。HMS Amethyst 号的 Simon 在战斗中幸存，鼓舞了船员士气，并被授予了相当于维多利亚十字勋章的动物奖章。\"}","decoration":"两端带有锚图标，并有细致的装饰边框"}},"subject":{"animal":"{argument name=\"main animal\" default=\"棕色虎斑猫\"}","name":"{argument name=\"cat name\" default=\"HMS Amethyst 号的 Simon\"}","costume":"带有金色徽章和深色海军饰边的皇家海军军官帽","expression_progression":"面板 1 中权威且骄傲，面板 2 中庄重且威严，面板 3 中平静且疲惫"},"color_palette":"陈旧奶油色羊皮纸、胡桃木棕色、黄铜金、墨水黑、海军蓝点缀、温暖的灯笼橙色、柔和的月光蓝","rendering_instructions":"使所有文字看起来像是印制或手写在羊皮纸标签上，精确保留三个带编号的面板标签，确保猫咪在所有面板中的角色设计一致，强调迷人的历史奇特性和海军真实感，增加细微的纸张纹理、圆角黑色面板边框以及古董海报的磨损感。"}

promptLocalized.zh: {"type":"中世纪泥金装饰手抄本风格教育三联画海报","title_banner":{"text":"{argument name=\"main title\" default=\"真实与奇闻\"}","position":"顶部居中","appearance":"带有卷曲末端的陈旧羊皮纸丝带横幅，黑色衬线字体，点缀微小的弄臣头像装饰和藤蔓花纹"},"overall_style":"带有黑色幽默的晚期中世纪宫廷插画，复杂的钢笔交叉排线，柔和的棕色、赭石色、深蓝色、勃艮第红，烛光阴影，古董羊皮纸纹理，华丽的黑色边框线条，历史细节丰富的服饰与室内装潢，怪诞的讽刺边缘装饰感，高度细节化，但所有人物面部均被柔和的棕色椭圆形模糊遮罩覆盖，如同匿名处理","layout":{"format":"宽幅横向海报，分为三个等大的插画板块，带有细黑色边框，底部配有一块全宽说明牌","panel_count":3,"panels":[{"label":"1. 唯一敢于直言的人","position":"左侧三分之一","scene":"拥挤的中世纪皇家宫廷，背景有挂毯、图案地砖、铅条窗，卫兵、贵族、神职人员和朝臣围在一位大腹便便的弄臣周围，弄臣身着杂色小丑服，挺着大肚子骄傲地站立，手持弄臣权杖，一位身披貂皮镶边斗篷的国王坐在华丽的宝座上大笑；构图充满戏剧性和嘲讽感，围观者众多，所有面部均被棕色椭圆形遮罩覆盖"},{"label":"2. 特权","position":"中间三分之一","scene":"烛光照亮的私密议事桌场景，一位身着红金杂色服饰的弄臣俯身，在铺满地图、文件、小盒子和烛台的雕花木桌旁，向一位身着蓝衣貂皮斗篷的戴冠国王低语或嘲弄；顾问和朝臣在阴影中注视，背景是厚重的帷幕和城堡壁画，所有面部均被棕色椭圆形遮罩覆盖"},{"label":"3. 床榻边","position":"右侧三分之一","scene":"昏暗的皇家寝室，一位体型肥胖、病重的国王靠在华丽的床上，盖着蓝色刺绣被子，身穿宽松的白色睡袍；弄臣坐在床边，握着国王的手或展示一个小物件，周围有神职人员、僧侣、侍从、蜡烛、雕花家具、蓝色帷幔以及门口的一位长袍人物；庄严的临终氛围，所有面部均被棕色椭圆形遮罩覆盖"}]},"bottom_caption":{"text":"{argument name=\"fact text\" default=\"真实事实 #1：宫廷弄臣是中世纪欧洲唯一被允许公开嘲讽和批评国王的人。苏格兰国王詹姆斯五世在临终时，特意要求将他的弄臣带到床边。\"}","position":"三个场景下方的全宽羊皮纸面板","appearance":"两行居中的大型黑色古风衬线文字，由细边框和左右两侧对称的弄臣铃铛花卉装饰框起"},"historical_subject":{"king":"{argument name=\"king name\" default=\"苏格兰国王詹姆斯五世\"}","main figure":"{argument name=\"main figure\" default=\"宫廷弄臣\"}","setting":"{argument name=\"setting\" default=\"中世纪欧洲\"}"},"rendering_notes":"使海报看起来像一张扫描的古董插画单张，具有温暖的陈旧纸张边缘、精确的线条、密集的背景细节、中世纪手抄本装饰，无现代物品，且包含三个编号板块及一个底部事实说明"}

templates.title: Yami sign portrait in the rain, a Gothic style

titleLocalized.zh: 雨中哥特风 Yami 标牌肖像

templates.prompt: Create a melancholic portrait that is both cinematic and realistic, with the subject being {argument name="character name" default="Yami-chan"} A little girl, like a gothic doll, sits on a wet city sidewalk after a rainy dusk. Centered in the image, her hair is disheveled.{argument name="hair color" default="black"} She had long hair, wore a dark, tattered lace dress, and her face was obscured by a solid, dark square. She held a worn, greyish-white wooden plaque to her chest, its edges frayed; the plaque bore handwritten Japanese characters in black ink.{argument name="sign text" default="It's okay to cry today. You can think about the reason later. - yami"} Next to the sign is a small black ink blot. To her left is a plush toy: a worn, dark gray, long-eared plush rabbit with stitched-on X marks on its chest and face, sitting on the wet ground. Her black Mary Jane shoes and light-colored socks peek out from under the sign. The ground is glistening, reflecting puddles, and the foreground clearly shows the reflections of the sign and the figure. Background: A blurred, rainy city riverbank or bridge walkway with metal railings and gray buildings. Two warm streetlights illuminate the right side, one larger and closer to the upper right corner, the other smaller and further away. The composition employs a shallow depth of field, cool blue-gray tones, soft rain and mist, a melancholic atmosphere, vertical composition, realistic textures, low-angle close-up shots, and high detail. There are no other figures or additional text in the image.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅充满电影感且写实的忧郁肖像，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="Yami-chan"}，一个像哥特玩偶般的小女孩，坐在黄昏雨后潮湿的城市人行道上。画面居中，她留着凌乱的 {argument name="hair color" default="black"} 长发，穿着深色破旧蕾丝裙，面部被一个实心深色方块遮挡。她双手捧着一块边缘磨损的灰白色木牌遮在胸前；木牌上用黑色墨水手写着日文 {argument name="sign text" default="今日は、泣いてもいい。理由なんて、あとからでいい。 - yami"}，签名旁有一个小小的黑色墨迹。在她的左侧放置 1 个毛绒玩具：一只磨损的深灰色长耳毛绒兔，胸部和脸上有缝合的 X 标记，坐在潮湿的地面上。标牌下方露出她的黑色玛丽珍鞋和浅色袜子。地面光亮，映出水洼，前景清晰可见标牌和人物的倒影。背景：失焦的雨中城市河岸或桥上步道，有金属栏杆和灰色建筑，右侧有 2 盏温暖的街灯，一盏较大且靠近右上角，另一盏较小且位于远处。采用浅景深、冷蓝灰色调、柔和雨雾、忧郁氛围、竖构图、写实纹理、低角度近地拍摄、高细节，画面中无其他人物，无额外文字。

templates.title: The traveling alchemist in the magical alley in the rain

titleLocalized.zh: 雨中奇幻小巷里的旅行炼金术士

templates.prompt: Create a vertical-format fantasy anime illustration, with the main character being {argument name="character name" default="Kanon"} A young traveling alchemist walks towards the audience along a narrow medieval cobblestone alleyway at dusk after the rain. She keeps {argument name="hair color" default="blonde"} She wore long braids, a dark navy blue baseball cap with large blue headphones covering it, a loose-fitting off-white robe-shirt, dark wide-legged trousers, and sturdy brown lace-up boots, with a dark blue travel cloak buckled at the neck. Her face was obscured by a matte brown square veil. In her left hand, she carried a warm-glowing brass lantern, and a leather crossbody bag was slung across her body, containing two clearly visible vials of potions, one blue and one green. Floating beside her was a small, round robot companion, white and gray in color, with a glossy black facial panel and two blue-glowing eyes. The background was an ancient European fantasy town with rough stone walls, wooden roofs, distant towers, wet cobblestone streets, puddles reflecting in the water, a hazy blue evening atmosphere, and several warm-colored wall lamps extending into the distance. Using cinematic lighting, a strong contrast is created between the cool blue twilight and the golden lights. The brushstrokes are delicate and painterly, the depth of field is soft, and a melancholic atmosphere full of adventure is created. The composition is full-body, the figure is centered, and there is no text in the picture.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖构图的奇幻动漫插画，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="Kanon"}，一位年轻的旅行炼金术士，在雨后的黄昏时分，正沿着狭窄的中世纪石板小巷向观众走来。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="blonde"} 的双长辫，头戴深海军蓝鸭舌帽，帽上罩着一副大号蓝色耳机，身穿宽松的米白色长袍衬衫、深色阔腿裤和结实的棕色系带靴，肩披一件在颈部系扣的深蓝色旅行斗篷。她的脸部被一个哑光棕色的方形遮挡块遮住。她左手提着一盏散发暖光的黄铜灯笼，身上斜挎着一个皮质挎包，包里清晰可见两瓶药水，一瓶蓝色，一瓶绿色。在她身边漂浮着一个小型圆形机器人伙伴，外观为白灰配色，配有光亮的黑色面部面板和两只发着青光的眼睛。背景是一座古老的欧洲奇幻城镇，有着粗糙的石墙、木质屋顶、远处的塔楼、湿漉漉的鹅卵石路面、水洼倒影、朦胧的蓝色傍晚氛围，以及几盏向远处延伸的暖色壁灯。采用电影级光影，形成冷蓝色暮色与金色灯光之间的强烈对比，笔触细腻富有绘画感，景深柔和，营造出充满冒险感的忧郁氛围，全身构图，人物居中，画面无文字。

templates.title: Traveling Alchemist Camp

titleLocalized.zh: 旅行炼金术士营地

templates.prompt: Create a vertically composed, cinematic fantasy anime illustration, with the main character being {argument name="character name" default="Kanon"} A young traveling alchemist rests at a forest night camp under a deep blue starry sky. She sits on a log by the campfire, one knee raised, holding a wooden cup close to her face as if drinking; most of her face is obscured by the cup and the shadows. She has long {argument name="hair color" default="blonde"} She had two braids and wore a navy blue baseball cap with text visible on it.{argument name="cap text" default="0235"} She wears large blue headphones, fingerless gloves, a loose white shirt, dark blue trousers, and rugged lace-up boots. A belt and storage bag hang from her waist, and she wears a flowing dark navy blue cloak. Beside her floats a small, round companion robot, its body entirely white and metallic, equipped with a glossy black facial screen, two oval eyes emitting cyan light, and a cyan ring of lights. The campsite scene includes: a canvas conical tent on the left, a lantern emitting warm light beside the tent, a wooden box containing a glass alchemy flask and a flask in the lower left corner, a water bottle beside a campfire, and travel bags and wooden equipment piled on the right. Warm fireflies and embers are scattered throughout the forest. The game employs a rich, oil painting-like anime style, showcasing highly detailed fabric folds, leather, metal, and glass reflections. The warm orange firelight contrasts with the cool blue moonlight, creating a sense of spatial depth, a deep pine forest, a comfortable adventurous and fantastical atmosphere, and an exquisite main visual composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖构图的电影感奇幻动漫插画，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="Kanon"}，一位年轻的旅行炼金术士，正于深蓝色星空下的森林夜间营地休息。她坐在营火旁的圆木上，单膝抬起，手持木杯靠近脸部，仿佛正在饮用；她的面部大部分被杯子和阴影遮挡。她留着长长的 {argument name="hair color" default="blonde"} 双麻花辫，戴着一顶海军蓝棒球帽，帽上可见文字 {argument name="cap text" default="0235"}，佩戴着大号蓝色耳机，穿着露指手套、宽松白衬衫、深蓝色长裤、粗犷的系带靴，身上挂着腰带和收纳袋，披着飘逸的深海军蓝斗篷。在她身旁悬浮着一个小巧的圆形伙伴机器人，通体白色金属质感，配有光亮的黑色面部屏幕、两个青色发光的椭圆形眼睛以及青色环形灯带。营地场景包括：左侧的一顶帆布圆锥帐篷，帐篷旁发着暖光的灯笼，左下角放着装有玻璃炼金瓶和烧瓶的木箱，火堆旁有一个水壶，右侧堆放着旅行包和木制装备，森林中散布着温暖的萤火虫或余烬火星。采用浓郁的油画质感动漫风格，展现高度细腻的布料褶皱、皮革、金属及玻璃反光，暖橙色火光与冷蓝色月影形成对比，营造出空间深度感、深邃的松树林、舒适的冒险奇幻氛围，以及精致的主视觉构图。

templates.title: Traveling Alchemist in the Mist Ruins

titleLocalized.zh: 迷雾遗迹中的旅行炼金术士

templates.prompt: Create a vertical fantasy anime illustration with a strong sense of atmosphere, featuring a protagonist who is {argument name="character name" default="Kanon"} A young traveling alchemist sits atop the misty, flood-ravaged ruins, on the edge of a dilapidated stone pier. She wears a dark baseball cap, large blue headphones, a light-colored hooded travel cloak over multiple layers of adventurer's clothing, dark, loose trousers, fingerless gloves, and heavy lace-up boots; her long, golden hair is braided into two thick braids that fall over her shoulders. Her face is covered by a square, matte gray hood, positioned directly below the brim of her cap. She holds a small glass vial containing a glowing blue liquid in her hands, and two more potion bottles hang from a worn brown leather pouch at her waist. Beside her sits a small, slightly mottled, white spherical robot companion on a stone platform; its black screen face displays two glowing blue eyes, and a blue ring light emanates from its side. The background depicts a vast, reflective swamp or lake, with reeds dotting the foreground, shrouded in mist, and distant Gothic ruins, towers, and arches silhouetted against the warm, low-hanging sunset near the horizon. Employing atmospheric perspective and soft brushstrokes, the cool blue-gray shadows contrast with the warm peach-colored sunset glow. Potions and robots emit subtle magical light, showcasing delicate fabric folds and damp stone textures. The composition has a cinematic feel, creating a melancholic yet adventurous atmosphere. It is a high-quality fantasy concept art piece with portrait proportions.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张氛围感十足的竖版奇幻动漫插画，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="Kanon"}，一位年轻的旅行炼金术士，正坐在夕阳下迷雾缭绕的洪水遗迹上方，一处破旧石码头的边缘。角色头戴深色棒球帽，佩戴着大号蓝色耳机，身穿浅色连帽旅行斗篷，内搭多层冒险家服饰，下着深色宽松长裤，戴着露指手套和厚重的系带靴；金色的长发编成两条粗辫子垂在肩头。脸部被一个方形的哑光灰色遮挡块覆盖，位于帽檐下方正中。她双手捧着一个小玻璃瓶，里面装着发光的蓝色液体，腰间的磨损棕色皮包上还挂着另外两个药水瓶。在她身旁的石台上坐着一个小型球形机器人同伴，通体白色且略显斑驳，黑色的屏幕脸上显示着两只青色的发光眼睛，侧面有一个青色的环形灯。背景展示了一片广阔且具有反射效果的沼泽或湖泊，前景点缀着芦苇，雾气弥漫，远处的哥特式废墟塔楼和拱门在靠近地平线的温暖低垂夕阳下呈现出剪影。运用大气透视法，采用柔和的绘画笔触，冷蓝灰色的阴影与温暖的桃色夕阳余晖形成对比，药水和机器人散发出微妙的魔法光芒，展现细腻的布料褶皱、潮湿的石材纹理，构图具有电影感，营造出忧郁而又充满冒险气息的氛围，高品质奇幻概念艺术，肖像比例。

templates.title: Boxed figure converted to anime-style main visual

titleLocalized.zh: 盒装手办转二次元主视觉图

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_1 as the primary reference for the character and pose, the boxed figure photo was converted into a refined, high-resolution anime-style main visual: retail packaging, shelves, hands, labels, and all text on product packaging were removed, rendering only the character as a beautiful 2D illustration. The white-haired girl, white dress, scythe, flowing long hair, and violet crescent moon energy elements from the reference image were retained, but the camera was significantly zoomed in, composing a vertical portrait focusing on the upper body and the dynamic movement of the skirt. A soft, square occlusion block was added to preserve the original image's obscured facial effect. REFERENCE_0 was used solely as a reference for showcasing the lighting and luster of high-end collectible figures. A deep starry sky background with neon purple dynamic curves, cinematic highlights, and smooth, delicate wrinkles was added. No logos, typographical text, or store environments were allowed. Optional customization: Character name.{argument name="character name" default="Luna Veil"} Energy color{argument name="energy color" default="violet purple"} Clothing color{argument name="outfit color" default="pure white"} Cutting style{argument name="crop style" default="close-up vertical portrait"} Facial treatment{argument name="face treatment" default="single soft square censor block"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_1 作为角色和姿势的主要参考，将盒装手办照片转换为精致的高分辨率动漫主视觉图：去除零售包装、货架、手部、标签以及所有产品包装上的文字，仅将角色渲染为精美的 2D 插画。保留参考图中的白发少女、白色连衣裙、镰刀、飘逸长发以及紫罗兰色新月能量元素，但需大幅拉近镜头，构图为聚焦于上半身和裙摆动态的竖向肖像。通过添加一个柔和的方形遮挡块来保留原图中被遮挡的面部效果。仅将 REFERENCE_0 作为高端收藏级手办光影和光泽感展示效果的参考。添加带有霓虹紫色动态弧线、电影级高光以及平滑细腻褶皱的深邃星空背景。禁止出现任何 Logo、排版文字或商店环境。可选自定义项：角色名称 {argument name="character name" default="Luna Veil"}，能量颜色 {argument name="energy color" default="violet purple"}，服装颜色 {argument name="outfit color" default="pure white"}，裁剪风格 {argument name="crop style" default="close-up vertical portrait"}，面部处理 {argument name="face treatment" default="single soft square censor block"}。

templates.title: Neon VTuber Arena Stage

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹 VTuber 竞技场舞台

templates.prompt: Create a 16:9 widescreen anime-style digital illustration depicting a grand {argument name="venue type" default="VTuber concert arena stage"} The design resembles a magnificent fighting game arena, employing a perfectly symmetrical frontal composition from a central perspective. The foreground features a smooth, polished performance floor covered in highly reflective, glossy tiles inlaid with gold geometric patterns, and a large star at its center, reflecting a striking pinkish-purple hue. The background is an ornately decorated elevated stage, with staircases on either side leading to platforms surrounded by gold trusses, black speaker towers, and railings adorned with star-shaped emblems. A large LED screen in the center displays…{argument name="screen colors" default="Pink, purple, cyan and gold"} The effect is a dazzling, soft starburst. Three visible LED screens are added: a large central screen and two smaller screens on the left and right sides, all displaying the same dazzling starlight concert visual effect. Above the main screen, a large golden star is placed in the center, surrounded by an oversized magenta satin bow and draped curtains, with additional pink drapes and hanging star-shaped decorations on either side above. The arena is filled with dramatic stage lighting: including numerous spotlights, lens flares, colored beams, rows of small bulbs, and shimmering particles, creating a {argument name="lighting mood" default="Neon magenta and electric blue"} The festive atmosphere is created. Audiences are visible from the bottom and far sides, depicted as dark silhouettes holding colorful glow sticks (especially pink, blue, yellow, and purple), creating the feeling of a packed stadium. High-detail anime-style background art, crisp lines, saturated idol stage colors, cinematic depth of field, reflective surfaces, and ultra-clean rendering effects are employed; the arena floor is devoid of characters, text, logos, and watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 16:9 的宽屏动漫风格数字插画，描绘一个宏大的 {argument name="venue type" default="VTuber 演唱会竞技场舞台"}，设计如同华丽的格斗游戏竞技场，采用从中心视角出发的完美对称正面构图。场景前景为平整的抛光表演地板，铺设着光泽感十足的反光瓷砖，镶嵌有金色几何图案，中心处绘有一个巨大的星星图案，并呈现出强烈的粉紫色倒影。背景是一个装饰华丽的抬高舞台，两侧各有一道楼梯通向平台，平台由金色桁架、黑色音箱塔、装饰着星形徽章的栏杆环绕，中央设有一块巨大的 LED 屏幕，显示着 {argument name="screen colors" default="粉色、紫色、青色和金色"} 的闪耀柔和星爆效果。添加三块可见的 LED 屏幕：一块大型中央屏幕和两块左右侧的小型屏幕，全部显示相同的璀璨星光演唱会视觉效果。在主屏幕上方，正中央放置一颗大金星，周围环绕着超大的洋红色缎面蝴蝶结和垂坠的帷幕，两侧上方配有额外的粉色帷幔和悬挂的星形装饰。用戏剧性的舞台灯光填满竞技场：包含大量聚光灯、镜头光晕、彩色光束、成排的小灯泡、闪烁的粒子，营造出 {argument name="lighting mood" default="霓虹洋红色和电光蓝色"} 的节日氛围。底部和远侧可见观众，表现为手持彩色荧光棒（特别是粉色、蓝色、黄色和紫色）的深色剪影，营造出座无虚席的现场活动感。采用高细节的动漫背景艺术、清晰的线条、饱和的偶像舞台色彩、电影般的景深、反光表面、超干净的渲染效果，竞技场地板上无角色、无文字、无标志、无水印。

Place a floating rounded square icon in the center with glossy beveled edges and a color of [color missing].{argument name="icon color" default="Electric Violet Blue"} The icon features a subtle, semi-transparent border, soft internal highlights, and four tiny, rounded, screw-like dots near the rounded corners. A raised, glowing white heartbeat waveform symbol with thick, smooth lines is placed on the front of the icon, casting a soft shadow on its surface. The lighting effects should convey a sophisticated, futuristic, minimalist, and refined feel, without text, people, or extraneous objects, and with ample white space around the central icon.

templates.prompt: Create a realistic event photograph taken at a crowded professional basketball All-Star game venue indoors. In the foreground, two men pose on a hardwood court: on the right, a tall, East Asian former basketball player in a dark navy suit and white shirt, with one hand on the shoulder of the shorter man on the left; on the left, a stylish, shorter man in a black glossy satin shirt, open collar, layered silver necklace, and cream-colored high-waisted trousers, with his hands in his pockets. Use a candid sports news photography style, with a wide horizontal composition, realistic lighting, medium-shallow depth of field, high detail, and natural colors to create a VIP courtside photo atmosphere. templates.title: K-Pop dance move breakdown diagram

titleLocalized.zh: K-Pop 舞蹈动作分解图

templates.prompt: Create a high-detail 16-frame sequence image to showcase a {argument name="subject" default="Beautiful young Korean girl"} Perform a stylish K-pop dance choreography across all 16 frames. The layout should resemble a professional motion study worksheet or animation reference project, capturing different dance poses in each frame with smooth, seamless transitions between movements. The girl is wearing {argument name="clothing" default="Fashionable and modern Korean streetwear"} She wore slim-fit blue jeans, a trendy cropped top, delicate layered accessories, and sneakers. Her makeup was natural and fresh, and her long hair flowed gracefully during the dance. Her expression was confident, elegant, and charming, with a subtle cinematic quality. The scene was set as {argument name="setting" default="Seoul's beautifully empty streets at night"} Neon lights flicker, streetlights glow warmly, and the damp pavement reflects images. The convenience store lights create a cinematic hazy atmosphere and soft bokeh. She dances alone in a quiet street corner or alley, all the focus and light projected onto her like a stage for a music video performance. The background should be atmospheric but not overpowering. Each of the 16 shots should showcase unique K-pop dance moves: opening pose, waving, hip twists, side steps, hair flips, arm extensions, spins, transitions, jumps, clean choreography, body rhythm, footwork, dynamic tilting, turning poses, confident close-up stances, ending fancy moves, and a final cinematic pose facing the camera. Style: Ultra-cinematic, Korean music video aesthetics, a combination of realistic photography and fashion magazine quality, dramatic contour lighting, motion blur details, glossy reflections, cool blue and magenta neon hues, highly detailed clothing folds and hair dynamics, and smooth pose continuity between frames. Composition: A clean and evenly spaced 4x4 grid sequence, with all frames connected naturally like a dance progression study. Full-body shots are visible in every frame, character design is consistent throughout, and the layout is based on professional choreography. Hyper-realistic, cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, a high-end Korean drama + K-pop MV atmosphere, high detail, photorealistic realism, dynamic motion capture, and stylish urban nighttime aesthetics.

promptLocalized.zh:
创建一张高细节的 16 帧序列图，展示一位 {argument name="subject" default="美丽的韩国年轻女孩"} 在所有 16 个分镜中表演时尚的 K-pop 风格舞蹈编排。布局应看起来像专业的动作研究联系表或动画参考项目，每一帧捕捉不同的舞蹈姿势，动作进程流畅衔接。
女孩穿着 {argument name="clothing" default="时尚现代的韩式街头服饰"}：修身蓝色牛仔裤、潮流短款上衣、精致的叠戴配饰、运动鞋，妆容自然清透，长发在舞蹈中呈现出灵动的飘逸感。她的表情自信、优雅、充满魅力，且带有轻微的电影质感。
场景设定为 {argument name="setting" default="首尔夜晚极具美感的空旷街道"}，霓虹灯闪烁，路灯温暖，湿润的路面映出倒影，便利店灯光营造出电影般的朦胧感和柔和的焦外成像效果。她独自在安静的街角或巷子里跳舞，所有的焦点和灯光都像音乐录影带的表演舞台一样投射在她身上。背景应具有氛围感，但不会喧宾夺主。
16 个分镜中的每一个都应展示独特的 K-pop 舞蹈动作：
开场姿势
挥手动作
扭胯
侧步
甩发
手臂伸展
旋转过渡
舞蹈中跳跃
利落的编舞姿势
身体律动
脚步动作
动态倾斜
转身姿势
自信的近身站姿
结尾花式动作
面向镜头的最终电影感姿势
风格：超电影感，韩国音乐录影带美学，写实摄影与时尚杂志质感的结合，戏剧性的轮廓光，动态模糊细节，光泽反射，冷蓝色与洋红色霓虹色调，高度细腻的衣物褶皱和头发动态，帧与帧之间流畅的姿势连续性。
构图：整洁且间距均匀的 4x4 网格序列图，所有帧像舞蹈进程研究一样自然连接，每一帧均可见全身，角色设计前后一致，专业的编舞参考布局。
超写实，电影级灯光，浅景深，高级韩剧 + K-pop MV 氛围，高细节，照片级真实感，动态动作捕捉感，时尚都市夜景美学。

templates.title: Movie-quality character design sketches

titleLocalized.zh: 电影级角色设计图

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic character design for a high-end film production. The layout should evoke the feel of a meticulously planned art direction project, not a rigid template. Avoid symmetrical grids, uniform spacing, or overly structured presentations. Instead, the composition should feel natural, slightly asymmetrical, and thoughtfully arranged like a genuine Hollywood concept proposal. Design a solid, realistic human character with believable proportions, natural imperfections, and an expressive performance—like a professional actor captured in a moment of emotional and physical expression, not a staged puppet. Use a bright, clean, and well-lit background to enhance clarity and give the design a fresh, modern studio feel. Include: • Full-body multi-angle views (front, front side, side, back, rear side) • Multiple expression studies showcasing the range of emotions from different angles • A cinematic hero portrait centered on the character • Detailed breakdown of costumes, accessories, and key props • Close-up studies of materials (such as fabric texture, skin detail, and surface realism) • Handwritten annotations, production markings, and design insights • A clear height reference scale naturally integrated into the composition. Characters should feel like real people existing in the film world—authentic, grounded, and emotionally resonant, rather than stylized or overly idealized. Art direction style: semi-realistic film design, high-budget film production quality, soft, natural studio lighting, bright color tones, subtle depth of field, realistic material rendering, and easily interpretable emotional expression. The presentation should resemble a professional concept art portfolio used in the pre-production of a major film. Consistency requirements: Ensure perfect coherence in facial features, body proportions, hairstyles, costume designs, and material details across all angles and studies.

promptLocalized.zh: 为高端电影制作创建一张电影级角色设计图。布局应呈现出精心策划的艺术指导项目感，而非刻板的模板。避免使用对称网格、统一间距或过于结构化的展示方式。相反，构图应感觉自然、略带不对称，并像真正的好莱坞概念提案一样经过深思熟虑的排列。设计一个扎实、写实的人类角色，具备可信的身体比例、自然的瑕疵以及富有表现力的表演感——就像一位专业演员在情感和肢体表演瞬间被捕捉到的状态，而非摆拍的人偶。使用明亮、整洁且光线充足的背景，以增强清晰度，并赋予设计图清新、现代的工作室质感。包含：• 全身多角度视图（正面、前侧面、侧面、背面、后侧面）• 从不同角度展示情感范围的多个表情研究 • 一张以角色为核心的电影级英雄肖像 • 服装、配饰和关键道具的详细拆解 • 材质（如织物纹理、皮肤细节和表面真实感）的特写研究 • 手写风格的注释、制作标记和设计见解 • 自然融入构图的清晰身高参考比例尺。角色应感觉像是真实存在于电影世界中的人——真实、扎实且充满情感，而非风格化或过度理想化。艺术指导风格：半写实电影设计，高预算电影制作质量，柔和的自然工作室光效，明亮的色调，微妙的景深，逼真的材质渲染，以及易于解读的情感表达。展示效果应如同大型电影前期制作中使用的专业概念艺术作品集。一致性要求：确保所有角度和研究中的面部特征、身体比例、发型、服装设计和材质细节保持完美连贯。

Luxurious details: This includes recessed velvet linings, smoked glass panels, brushed brass inlays, lacquered wood, polished stone, dark mirrors, exquisite engraved numbering, and museum-quality display hardware. Refined, sophisticated, understated, and expensive, with perfect spatial control. Composition guidelines: The main item should dominate. Secondary compartments must enhance appeal, not overshadow it. The scene should maintain sufficient white space to highlight its uniqueness, while also possessing enough depth for careful appreciation. Utilize the intentional repetition of shapes and lines to create a luxurious rhythm. 仅使用用户上传的图片作为主体参考。将上传图片中的人物转换为逼真的 LEGO 风格小人仔，同时保留其可辨识的身份和装束。在 LEGO 小人仔的设计限制内，尽可能保留主体的面部相似度，并保持相同的发型和发色（适配为 LEGO 发饰）、面部表情、服装颜色、服装设计和图案，以及任何可见的配饰。最终结果应清晰地呈现出该人物的 LEGO 化形象。角色必须遵循正宗的 LEGO 小人仔比例，包括圆柱形的黄色或肤色 LEGO 风格头部、根据主体特征适配的简洁印刷面部细节、带有印刷服装细节的块状躯干、标准的 LEGO 小人仔手臂及弯曲手部、短款 LEGO 小人仔腿部，以及与主体发型相符的独特模塑塑料发饰。
使用逼真的 LEGO 塑料材质进行渲染，带有轻微的光泽感、细微的模塑接缝以及自然的玩具表面反射。面部和躯干应包含 LEGO 小人仔典型的印刷细节，发饰应呈现出模塑塑料的质感。最终图像应为高质量的逼真 3D 玩具渲染图，采用柔和的漫射摄影棚灯光、强调形状和塑料纹理的细微阴影，以及清晰锐利的对焦和精致的细节。构图必须展示从头到脚的全身小人仔，居中对齐，确保整个形象完全可见。使用纯白色背景，不包含任何场景、道具或其他元素。最终风格应呈现为具有高度细节塑料纹理和摄影棚灯光的逼真 LEGO 小人仔玩具渲染图。

templates.title: Character portraits in the style of the anime "Demon Slayer".

titleLocalized.zh: 《鬼灭之刃》动画风格角色肖像

templates.prompt: Use the uploaded image as the only one{argument name="identity reference" default="Identity Reference"} And convert the main body to adopt the official{argument name="anime series" default="Demon Slayer"} Characters rendered in an anime series style. Visual presentation must strictly adhere to the aesthetics of *Demon Slayer*, featuring clean, crisp lines, high-quality cel shading, and moderately saturated, balanced colors with a refined television anime feel. Do not include any manga-style sketches, hatching, grayscale, or black-and-white renderings. The subject's individual characteristics must be fully preserved, including clothing design, hairstyle and hair color, accessories, skin tone, facial expressions, and poses; no elements may be replaced or removed. Existing clothing should be subtly integrated with details reminiscent of the *Demon Slayer* Demon Slayer Corps, such as sharper fabric folds, slightly enhanced layering, and clean anime fabric textures, while ensuring the original clothing remains clearly identifiable. Characters must adhere to accurate *Demon Slayer* proportions, including a lean, agile physique, natural anatomy, vividly animated eyes with strong highlights, stylized eyebrows, and simplified animated nose and mouth. Composition is crucial; the character must be fully displayed from head to toe, ensuring the feet, legs, torso, arms, and head are all visible. The image should not crop any part of the body. The camera distance must be wide enough to capture the entire figure, with a small amount of blank space above the head and below the feet to allow the character to fit comfortably within the frame. The output must be a full-body illustration with the character centered and the background [unclear - possibly "background"].{argument name="background" default="Plain white background"} The image must not contain ground, shadows, scenes, props, weapons, objects, special effects, halos, particles, motion lines, or environmental details. The final image should contain only the character and must not contain cropped compositions, multiple characters, multi-frame output, other animation styles (such as Dragon Ball, Naruto, or One Piece), photorealism, painterly or textured rendering, or any background elements or objects.

promptLocalized.zh:
将上传的图片作为唯一的 {argument name="identity reference" default="身份参考"}，并将主体转换为采用官方 {argument name="anime series" default="《鬼灭之刃》"} 动画剧集风格渲染的角色。视觉表现必须严格符合《鬼灭之刃》的美学，呈现清晰利落的线条、高质量的赛璐珞阴影，以及饱和度适中且平衡的色彩，并具有精致的电视动画质感。请勿包含任何漫画风格的素描、排线、灰度或黑白渲染。必须完整保留主体的个人特征，包括服装设计、发型和发色、配饰、肤色、面部表情和姿势，不得替换或移除任何元素。

现有的服装应巧妙地融入《鬼灭之刃》鬼杀队风格的细节，例如更锐利的布料褶皱、略微加强的层叠质感以及干净的动画布料质感，同时确保原始服装清晰可辨。角色必须遵循准确的《鬼灭之刃》比例，包括精瘦敏捷的体型、自然的动画人体结构、带有强烈高光的生动动画眼睛、风格化的眉毛，以及简化的动画鼻部和嘴部。

构图至关重要，必须从头到脚完整展示角色，确保脚部、腿部、躯干、手臂和头部全部可见。画面不应裁剪身体的任何部分，摄像机距离必须足够宽，以捕捉整个身形，并在头顶上方和脚底下方留出少量空白，使角色舒适地置于画面内。输出结果必须是一张完整的全身插画，角色居中，背景为 {argument name="background" default="纯白色背景"}，不得包含地面、阴影、场景、道具、武器、物体、特效、光环、粒子、动态线或环境细节。最终图像应仅包含该角色，且不得包含裁剪构图、多个人物、多格输出、其他动画风格（如《龙珠》、《火影忍者》或《海贼王》）、照片写实主义、绘画感或纹理渲染，以及任何背景元素或物体。
