templates.title: City Line Drawing Atlas Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 城市线条图集海报

templates.prompt: Please generate a high-quality "City Line Drawing Poster". This image is designed based on the visual language of "Monochrome City Line Drawing Travel Poster", including a complete composition: a large title at the top, mid-ground street depth, a central landmark, buildings on both sides, figures in the foreground, and a signature bar at the bottom. [Theme City] City Name:{argument name="city" default="Yichun"} English main title:{argument name="English title" default="FOREST LINE ATLAS / YICHUN CHRONICLE"} Title: Yichun, City of Forests Country/Region: Heilongjiang Province, China Key Landmarks: Lesser Khingan Mountains Forest, Red Pine Forest, Wuying National Forest Park Viewing Tower Street Scene: Streets of a forest town, residential intersections with wooden buildings, forestry city atmosphere Emotional Theme: Commuting in the morning mist Main Color Scheme:{argument name="main color" default="Dark green and dark gray line drawing"} Aspect Ratio: 3:4 Vertical Composition [Overall Positioning] This work serves as a travel souvenir poster, a city visual guide, an architectural line drawing, and an editorial cover design. The image needs to capture the unique character of Yichun as a "Forest City," possessing both urban recognizability and a realistic sense of street life—it's not a standard travel poster or a single landmark illustration, but a visual archive work with collectible value. [Composition Design] The top features a prominent title area using a large English title, "FOREST LINE ATLAS," supplemented by the subtitle "YICHUN CHRONICLE." A numbering system (e.g., No. CN-HLJ-YC-01) and brief coordinate information can be added, creating a modern and design-conscious layout. The central section depicts the main city street scene, employing a deep street perspective composition with a slightly lower angle, showing the road extending into the distance and gradually merging into the forest area. The core landmark is a forest observation tower or the distant forest silhouette, clear yet not obtrusive, naturally integrated into the street scene. Local architectural details are added to both sides: wooden houses, forestry bureau-style buildings, residential areas, small shops, bus stops, streetlights, utility poles, simple road signs, etc., forming a high-density urban information. The foreground includes elements of daily life: pedestrians in autumn and winter clothing, cyclists, residents carrying shopping bags, small vehicles, and fallen leaves on the ground to enhance the seasonal atmosphere. The independent signature area at the bottom is designed as a city archive label structure, containing "YICHUN / HEILONGJIANG / CHINA" and a simplified city information module or map index layout. [Text System] The main title at the top is clear and eye-catching. Only 2-4 clearly readable texts are retained in the image (e.g., "Yichun Station", "Forestry Road", "Bus Stop"), and other signs use abstract Chinese strokes or symbolic characters to avoid garbled text. The overall text system should be unified, restrained, and integrated into the design structure. [Visual Style] The overall style uses monochrome or minimalist two-color line drawings with a beige or warm white paper texture background. The lines are precise, clean, and layered, with the texture of architectural pen sketches and screen printing. The foreground lines are slightly thicker, while the background lines are thinner. The figures and objects are simple yet easily recognizable. The style is restrained and sophisticated. [Innovation Requirements] Incorporate design variations in the following areas: title naming system, top layout structure, a slightly lower-angle street perspective, a composition blending forest and city, a bottom archival information module, and an expression of autumn leaf atmosphere. [Avoidance Guidelines] Reject ordinary travel poster styles, watercolor, thick paint, or cartoon/Q-style styles, cyberpunk, highly saturated colors, and cheap souvenir styles. Please generate a standalone, complete, high-definition, and clearly defined vertical city line drawing poster that possesses collectability and series consistency.

promptLocalized.zh:

此图像基于“单色城市线条绘画旅行海报”的视觉语言设计，包含完整的构图：顶部大标题、中景街道纵深、核心地标、两侧建筑、前景人物以及底部的签名栏。

[主题城市]
城市名称：{argument name="city" default="伊春"}
英文主标题：{argument name="English title" default="FOREST LINE ATLAS / YICHUN CHRONICLE"}
中文标题：伊春 · 森林之城
国家/地区：中国黑龙江省
核心地标：小兴安岭森林、红松林海、五营国家森林公园观景塔
街道场景：森林小镇街道、带有木质建筑的住宅路口、林业城市氛围
情感主题：晨雾中的通勤时刻
主色调：{argument name="main color" default="深绿色 + 深灰色线条绘画"}
长宽比：3:4 竖构图

[整体定位]
这是一件兼具旅行纪念海报、城市视觉指南、建筑线条手稿及编辑设计封面的作品。图像需要呈现伊春作为“森林之城”的独特气质，既要有城市辨识度，又要具备真实的街道生活感——它不是标准的旅行海报或单一地标插画，而是一件具有收藏价值的视觉档案作品。
[构图设计]
顶部为醒目的标题区，使用大号英文标题“FOREST LINE ATLAS”，辅以副标题“YICHUN CHRONICLE”。可添加编号系统（例如 No. CN-HLJ-YC-01）和简要的坐标信息，布局现代且具有设计感。
中部为城市街道主体，采用深邃的街道透视构图，视角略低，道路向远方延伸并逐渐融入森林区域。
核心地标为森林观景塔或远处的森林轮廓，清晰但不突兀，自然地融入街道场景中。
两侧添加当地建筑细节：木屋、林业局风格建筑、住宅区、小商店、公交站、路灯、电线杆、简单的路牌等，形成高密度的城市信息。
前景包含生活元素：穿着秋冬服饰的行人、骑自行车的人、提着购物袋的居民、小型车辆以及地上的落叶，以增强季节氛围。
底部独立的签名区设计为城市档案标签结构，包含“YICHUN / HEILONGJIANG / CHINA”以及简化的城市信息模块或地图索引式布局。
[文字系统]
顶部主标题清晰醒目。图像中仅保留 2–4 处清晰可读的文字（例如“伊春站”、“林业路”、“公交站”），其他标识使用抽象的中文笔画或符号化字符，以避免乱码。整体文字系统应统一、克制，并融入设计结构中。
[视觉风格]
整体风格采用单色或极简的双色线条绘画，背景为米白色或暖白色纸张纹理。线条精准、干净且富有层次感，具有建筑钢笔手稿和丝网印刷的质感。前景线条略粗，背景线条较细，人物和物体简单但易于辨认。风格克制且高级。

[创新要求]
在以下方面融入设计变化：标题命名系统、顶部布局结构、略低视角的街道透视、森林与城市的融合构图、底部档案式信息模块，以及秋季落叶氛围的表达。
[避坑指南]
拒绝普通旅行海报风格，拒绝水彩、厚涂或卡通/Q 版风格，拒绝赛博朋克，拒绝高饱和度色彩，拒绝廉价纪念品风格。

请生成一张独立、完整、高清、线条清晰的竖版城市线条绘画海报，需具备收藏感和系列统一性。

templates.title: French retro oil painting style portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 法式复古油画风人像

templates.prompt: Please generate a set of 2x2 four-grid collage photos based on the user-uploaded photos, themed "French Retro Oil Painting Style: Delicate and Beautiful Boudoir Photography of a Young Girl". Strictly preserve the subject's authentic features, including face shape, facial proportions, eyes, nose, lips, skin tone, perceived age, basic hairstyle, and overall temperament. Do not make the subject appear like a stranger. Extend the body naturally from the facial features; avoid being overly thin, maintain a slightly soft, fleshy feel. ## Overall Style The entire set of photos adopts a French retro oil painting style, featuring a delicate and beautiful boudoir photography of a young girl, with a very obvious soft focus, dreamy atmosphere, sacred halo, and soft oil painting texture. The temperament should be quiet, gentle, fragile, poetic, and languid, with a touch of melancholy and feminine vitality, like a goddess statue enveloped in flowers, white gauze, and warm light. This is not ordinary boudoir photography, wedding photos, or Korean studio style, but rather: a retro oil painting portrait of a young girl under warm golden twilight, showcasing a delicate boudoir posture, a dreamy atmosphere, and a goddess-like sacredness. ## Makeup and Hairstyle Makeup should feature a translucent, soft matte foundation, a warm creamy complexion, low-saturation nude pink or reddish-brown eyeshadow, natural eyelashes, and a dusty rose or rosy nude lip. The overall makeup should be soft, avoiding heaviness or harshness. Hairstyle should be French vintage long hair, which may include loose braids, a voluminous top, natural wispy strands, slight curls, and a slightly messy, airy feel. The hair should not be too neat, but rather have a soft, loose, painterly layered look. ## Clothing Clothing includes French vintage lace gowns, off-the-shoulder tulle dresses, and vintage lace dresses in cream, ivory, or off-the-shoulder colors. It should feature lace, sheer fabric, semi-transparent cuffs, soft pleats, and multi-layered skirts. The overall look should be ethereal, soft, and full of feminine charm, similar to a combination of a vintage nightgown and a light wedding dress, but avoiding an overly modern commercial wedding photography style. ## White Gauze and Floral Scenes The scene must include large areas of light, transparent white gauze, naturally draped over chair backs, table edges, the floor, and around the subject, creating a hazy, enveloping, floating, and airy feel. Floral materials should primarily consist of light pink roses, pink and white bouquets, white lilies, or soft, light-colored flowers. These can be held in the subject's arms, placed on a table, or scattered on the floor to enhance softness, vitality, and a goddess-like atmosphere. ## Scene The scene is a minimalist retro photography space, using dark gray-brown, dark brown, or smoky brown background and floor cloths. It includes retro round chairs, a small round table, a lace tablecloth, white vases, and a small number of floral materials. The scene should not be complex, but should have a soft, enclosed, dreamlike small stage feel. ## Light and Texture This is the most important part: Please use very obvious warm golden sidelighting or side-backlighting, like the setting sun shining into an old room. The light should be soft but directional, giving the skin, white gauze, and flower edges a distinct glow, halo, bloom, and slightly hazy bokeh. The entire series of photographs must be more hazy, softer in focus, and have lower contrast than regular photography: - Soft focus - Diffusion filter - Bloom - Halation - Dreamy blur - Hazy glow - Film grain - Oil painting softness. The images should appear as if shot through a thin veil; details should not be too sharp, too high-resolution or stiff, nor too clean. The overall presentation should have a distinct mist, halo, and soft oil painting texture. ## Emotion and Subject Expression The subject should not merely be "quiet and beautiful," but should possess a sense of emotion and immersion. Emphasize: vulnerability, languor, contemplation, a touch of melancholy, immersion, self-awareness, serene blossoming, and divinity illuminated by light. Expressions can include: closed eyes, half-closed eyes, sideways glance, head down, looking up towards the light, glancing back, or an unintentional downward glance. Reduce the posed feel of typical front-facing shots and increase the emotional moments captured by the photographer. ## Grid Format Generate a 2x2 grid collage, with each grid in a 3:4 vertical composition. The four photos must belong to the same group: the same person, the same makeup system, the same clothing system, the same scene system, the same lighting language, and the same post-processing texture. ## Consistency Elements The following elements should remain consistent across the four photos: the same young woman, the same French retro oil painting-style boudoir, the same creamy white lace/tulle clothing system, the same warm golden hazy side backlighting, the same dark gray-brown retro background space, the same prop system consisting of gauze, flowers, retro chairs, and small tables, and the same soft focus, oil painting, film grain, and dreamy halo texture. ## Allowed Variations To avoid the four photos becoming too similar, please naturally vary the following: compositional distance, camera height, pose (sitting/leaning/lying/turning/tilting head), way of holding flowers, the flow of the white veil, facial expression and gaze direction, hand gestures, and the relationship between the person and the chair, table, or ground. ## Lens Pool Rules Randomly select 4 shots from the following lens pool, ensuring at least 2 core shots are included: ### Core Shots (Select at least 2) 1. Seated half-body portrait holding flowers 2. Emotional medium shot leaning against a chair back or table ### Other Shots (to fill remaining space) - Looking up towards the light - Looking back with exposed back - Lying on the ground - High-angle overhead shot of a reclining pose - Close-up of a profile with eyes closed - Full-body shot wrapped in white veil - Curled-up sitting pose - Standing next to or leaning against a flower table Please vary the lens selection in the four photos, while maintaining an overall feel as if they are four moments from the same dreamlike oil painting photography collection. ## Key Objectives: The entire set of photos must be more hazy, luminous, and emotionally resonant than regular photography. Prioritize: immersive soft lighting, a warm, dreamy golden hue, feminine divinity and vitality, a feeling of being enveloped in gauze and flowers, stronger emotional flow, and a more pronounced oil painting-like soft focus. ## Avoidance Guidelines: Avoid high-definition sharpness; avoid ordinary warm-toned studio-style photos; avoid modern wedding photo styles; avoid Korean-style commercial studio appearances; avoid plastic-looking skin retouching; avoid overly clean and sharp images; avoid influencer-style photography; avoid cheap "fairytale" styles; avoid cluttered backgrounds; avoid watermarks and logos.

promptLocalized.zh:
请根据用户上传的照片，生成一组 2×2 四宫格拼贴照片，主题为“法式复古油画少女柔美闺房摄影”。

严格保留主体真实的身份特征，包括脸型、面部比例、眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇、肤色、感知年龄、发型基础和整体气质。不要将人物变成陌生人。从面部特征自然延伸身体；不要过瘦，保持轻微的柔和肉感。

## 整体风格
整组照片采用法式复古油画少女柔美闺房风格，具有非常明显的朦胧柔焦、梦幻氛围、神圣光晕和柔和的油画质感。气质应安静、柔和、脆弱、诗意且慵懒，带有一丝淡淡的忧郁和女性生命力，宛如被鲜花、白纱和暖光包裹的少女神像。
这并非普通的闺房摄影、婚纱照或韩式影楼风格，而是：暖金色暮光下的复古油画少女肖像，展现柔美的闺房体态、梦幻氛围和女神般的神圣感。

## 妆容与发型
妆容应为通透的柔雾底妆、暖奶油肤色、低饱和度裸粉色或红棕色眼影、自然睫毛，以及豆沙裸粉色或玫瑰裸色唇妆。整体妆容应柔和，不宜浓重或凌厉。
发型为法式复古长发，可包括松散的编发、蓬松的头顶、自然的碎发、微卷以及略显凌乱的空气感。头发不应过于整齐，而应具有柔和、松散、油画般的层次感。

## 服装
服装包括奶油白、象牙白或米白色的法式复古蕾丝长裙、露肩薄纱裙和复古蕾丝裙。应具备蕾丝、轻纱、半透明袖口、柔和褶皱和多层裙摆。整体造型神圣、柔和且充满女性魅力，类似于复古睡裙与轻婚纱的结合，但要避免看起来过于像现代商业婚纱摄影。

## 白纱与花卉
场景中必须包含大面积轻盈透明的白纱，自然地披挂在椅背、桌边、地面以及人物周围，营造出朦胧的包裹感、漂浮感和空气感层次。
花卉素材主要为浅粉色玫瑰、粉白色花束、白百合或柔和的浅色花卉。它们可以被人物抱在怀里、放在桌上或散落在地面，以增强柔美感、生命力和女神氛围。

## 场景
场景为一个极简的复古摄影空间，使用深灰棕色、深棕色或烟棕色的背景布和地布。配有复古圆椅、小圆桌、蕾丝桌布、白色花瓶和少量花卉素材。场景不复杂，但应具有柔和、封闭、梦幻般的小舞台感。

## 光影与质感
这是最重要的部分：
请使用非常明显的暖金色侧光或侧逆光，如同夕阳照射进老房间。光线应柔和但具有方向性，使皮肤、白纱和花朵边缘呈现出明显的辉光、光晕、绽放和轻微的朦胧光斑。
整组照片必须比普通摄影更朦胧、更柔焦、对比度更低：
- 柔焦 (soft focus)
- 柔光滤镜 (diffusion filter)
- 溢光 (bloom)
- 光晕 (halation)
- 梦幻模糊 (dreamy blur)
- 朦胧辉光 (hazy glow)
- 胶片颗粒 (film grain)
- 油画柔感 (oil painting softness)
图像看起来应像是透过一层薄纱拍摄；细节不应过于锐利，不应高清或僵硬，也不应过于干净。整体呈现应具有明显的雾气、光晕和柔和的油画质感。

## 情绪与表现
主体不应仅仅是“安静漂亮”，而应具有情绪感和沉浸感。请强调：脆弱、慵懒、沉思、淡淡的忧郁、沉浸、自我感知、静谧绽放以及被光照亮的神性。
表情可包括：闭眼、半闭眼、侧目、低头、抬头向光、回眸，或不经意的垂眸。减少普通正面拍摄的摆拍感，增加摄影师捕捉到的情绪瞬间感。

## 四宫格格式
生成一个 2×2 四宫格拼贴，每格均为 3:4 竖构图。四张照片必须属于同一组：同一个人、同一种妆容系统、同一种服装系统、同一种场景系统、同一种光影语言和同一种后期质感。

## 一致性元素
以下元素在四张照片中保持统一：同一个少女、同一种法式复古油画柔美闺房风格、同一种奶油白蕾丝/薄纱服装系统、同一种暖金色朦胧侧逆光、同一种深灰棕色复古背景空间、同一种由纱、花、复古椅和小桌组成的道具系统，以及相同的柔焦、油画、胶片颗粒和梦幻光晕质感。

## 允许的变化
为了避免四张照片过于雷同，请自然地改变以下内容：构图距离、相机高度、姿势（坐/倚/躺/转身/歪头）、拿花的方式、白纱的流动感、表情和视线方向、手部动作，以及人物与椅子、桌子或地面的关系。

## 镜头池规则
从以下镜头池中随机优先选择 4 个镜头，确保至少包含 2 个核心镜头：
### 核心镜头（至少选择 2 个）
1. 坐姿抱花半身像
2. 倚靠椅背或桌边的情绪化中景
### 其他镜头（用于填充剩余位置）
- 抬头向光
- 回眸露背
- 躺在地面
- 高角度俯拍躺姿
- 闭眼侧脸特写
- 被白纱包裹的全身照
- 蜷缩坐姿
- 站在花桌旁或倚靠花桌
请让四张照片在镜头选择上有所变化，同时整体保持如同来自同一场梦幻油画摄影集的四个瞬间。

## 关键目标
整组照片必须比普通摄影更朦胧、更具光感和情绪感。优先考虑：包裹感柔光、暖金色梦幻感、女性神性与生命力、被纱与花包裹的感觉、更强的情绪流动以及更明显的油画柔焦感。

## 避雷指南
避免高清锐利度；避免普通的暖色调影楼感；避免现代婚纱照风格；避免韩式商业影楼外观；避免塑料感的皮肤修饰；避免过于干净清晰；避免网红风格摄影；避免廉价的“仙女”风；避免杂乱的背景；避免水印和 Logo。

templates.title: Fictional Science Infographic Generator

titleLocalized.zh: 虚构科学信息图生成器

templates.prompt: Create a fun science explanation illustration. The topic must be verified as "".{argument name="validation theme" default="How many banana peels would it take to make a car skid?"} A vertical A4-sized comic-style infographic rigorously verifies an absurd problem using science and calculation. White background, thick black lines, and accent colors of red, blue, and yellow. The design style evokes retro educational comics, science reference books, or science columns. It uses a professor character, surprised passersby, speech bubbles, hand-drawn arrows, red pen annotations, and blackboard-style formula boxes. The overall atmosphere should be "going all out to verify a stupid problem with physics," fun, energetic, and not overly serious. Structure: 1. The opening depicts the thematic scenario in an exaggerated and absurd way, making it immediately understandable. The characters are going all out, but look rather reckless. The professor interjects with comments. 2. Using real data, it presents 3 to 4 important numerical boxes related to the topic, such as speed, time, distance, weight, force, temperature, or energy. Includes comparison charts or timelines to clearly show the gap between "human senses" and the "scale of the phenomenon." 3. The formula corner uses blackboard-style boxes to extensively illustrate necessary conditions or comparative formulas. Examples: "Required ability > Human limits," "Reaction time < "Time of occurrence of the phenomenon", "Required force/speed/endurance ≫ Ordinary human". The formula does not need to be absolutely precise, just keep it intuitive and easy to understand. 4. Is it possible? Explain the problem points with three short panels. Examples: ① Too fast/Too heavy/Too hot ② Precision requirements are too stringent ③ Even if successful, the body cannot withstand it/The surrounding environment will suffer. Include humorous illustrations of failure, onomatopoeia, and speech bubbles. 5. What would happen if it were achieved? Make this part the focus. Describe the superhuman or speculative scientific abilities required for actual success. For example: super reflexes, future prediction, abnormal grip strength, super-fast vision, physical qualities that ignore air resistance, or bones that can withstand impact. If necessary, use scientifically impossible numbers, such as "reaction speed 0.0001 seconds", "grip strength 3000kg", "dynamic vision dozens of times better than that of a fighter pilot". In addition, describe the scene of the moment of achievement. Example: The arm is blown away, sinks into the ground, a shock wave is generated around, but the person involved remains calm. In a fun way, bring out the feeling that "if it succeeds, they will no longer be human". 6. The conclusion should be written in a large, highlighted red box. It should state, "Conclusion: XX is virtually impossible for ordinary humans!" or "Even if achieved, it would require superhuman, cyborg, or speculative scientific abilities!" The summary should explain that while impossible for real humans, it can be achieved through speculative scientific capabilities. Design guidelines: Comic panels + scientific illustrations + professor commentary. Frequent use of bold headings, red circles, emphasis lines, hand-drawn notes, and speech bubbles. Formulas and values ​​should be large enough and easy to read, allowing even children to intuitively understand the information. The final result should resemble a page of fun, absurd, yet surprisingly convincing science literature.

promptLocalized.zh:
创建一个趣味科学解释插图。验证主题为“{argument name="validation theme" default="需要多少个香蕉皮才能让一辆车打滑？"}”。

一张 A4 竖版漫画风格的信息图，用科学和计算严谨地验证荒诞问题。白色背景，粗黑线条，强调色为红、蓝、黄。设计风格让人联想到复古教育漫画、科学参考书或科学专栏。使用教授角色、惊讶的路人、对话气泡、手绘箭头、红笔批注以及黑板风格的公式框。整体氛围应为“全力以赴用物理学验证一个愚蠢的问题”，既有趣、充满活力，又不会过于严肃。

结构：

1. 开篇
以夸张且荒谬的方式描绘主题情境，让人一眼就能看懂。角色们正在全力以赴，但看起来相当鲁莽。教授在一旁插话评论。

2. 用真实数据思考
展示 3 到 4 个与主题相关的重要数值框，例如速度、时间、距离、重量、力、温度或能量。包含对比图表或时间轴，清晰展示“人类感官”与“现象规模”之间的差距。

3. 公式角
在黑板风格的框中大篇幅绘制必要条件或对比公式。示例：“所需能力 > 人类极限”、“反应时间 < 现象发生时间”、“所需力/速度/耐力 ≫ 普通人类”。公式不需要绝对精确，保持直观易懂即可。

4. 实现可能吗？
用三个小分镜解释问题点。示例：① 太快 / 太重 / 太热 ② 精度要求太严苛 ③ 即使成功，身体也承受不住 / 周围环境会遭殃。包含滑稽的失败插图、拟声词和对话气泡。

5. 如果实现了会怎样？
让这部分成为重点。描绘实际成功所需的超人类或推测性科学能力。例如：超强反射神经、未来预测、异常握力、超高速视觉、无视空气阻力的身体素质，或能承受冲击的骨骼。如有必要，使用科学上不可能的数字，如“反应速度 0.0001 秒”、“握力 3000kg”、“比战斗机飞行员高几十倍的动态视力”。此外，描绘实现瞬间的情景。示例：手臂被震飞、陷入地面、周围产生冲击波，而当事人却保持冷静。以有趣的方式带出“如果成功了，他们就不再是人类”的感觉。

6. 结论
在红色高亮框中大篇幅写下结论。“结论：XX 对普通人类来说几乎是不可能的！”或“即使实现，也需要达到超人类、半机械人或推测科学的水平！”总结时要说明这对真实人类是不可能的，但可以通过推测性科学能力实现。

设计规范：漫画分镜 + 科学插图 + 教授评论。频繁使用粗标题、红圈、强调线、手绘笔记和对话气泡。公式和数值应足够大且易于阅读，即使是孩子也能直观地理解传达的信息。最终效果应像是一页有趣且荒诞但又出奇令人信服的科学读物。

Maintain a polished studio portrait feel consistent with the reference image and blend it naturally into the real stadium environment. She sits in the bustling Korean baseball stands, holding an iced drink and a cheering stick, wearing a clean white baseball jersey over simple casual clothing. She was fixing her hair with one hand… She noticed the camera, gave a natural little smile, slightly surprised but composed. templates.title: Surreal Crimson Cowboy Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 超现实深红牛仔肖像

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic, surreal, and stylish Western portrait, with the center of the image being {argument name="subject" default="A tall black cowboy"} A full-body statue stands on a vast, flower-covered hillside. The main figure wears a wide-brimmed {argument name="hat color" default="Deep red"} Cowboy hat, wearing{argument name="coat color" default="Deep crimson"} Wearing a long, plush velvet trench coat over a white shirt, with a belt and holster, the figure holds a polished silver double-barreled revolver in both hands, the muzzle pointing downwards. The face is deliberately blurred with a soft rectangular blur, giving the character a sense of anonymous editing. The landscape presents a dreamlike color shift: the foreground features lush lavender wildflowers, the background a rolling expanse of soft red and magenta meadows, and the sky a saturated bright blue, dotted with large, soft white clouds. The shot employs a low, slightly upward angle, a mid-to-long-range composition, clear sunlight, strong natural contrast, and a surreal, color-gradation-driven realistic photographic style, reminiscent of haute couture moodboard aesthetics, with a dramatic sense of tranquility. There is no text, no other figures.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影级超现实时尚西部肖像，画面中心为 {argument name="subject" default="一位高大的黑人牛仔"} 的全身像，伫立在广阔的繁花山坡上。主体佩戴一顶宽檐 {argument name="hat color" default="深酒红色"} 牛仔帽，身穿 {argument name="coat color" default="深绯红色"} 长款毛绒丝绒风衣，内搭白色衬衫，系皮带及枪套，双手持一把抛光银色双管左轮手枪，枪口向下斜指。面部特意用柔和的矩形模糊处理，赋予人物一种匿名编辑感。景观呈现梦幻般的色彩偏移：前景为茂密的薰衣草紫野花，背景是柔和的红与洋红色草地连绵起伏，天空呈现饱和的亮蓝色，点缀着大朵柔和的白云。采用低位略微仰视的拍摄角度，中远景构图，清晰的日光，强烈的自然对比度，具有超现实色彩分级的写实摄影风格，高定时尚 moodboard 美学，戏剧性的静谧感，无文字，无其他人物。

templates.title: Vaporwave-style Apple Glass Tower

titleLocalized.zh: Vaporwave 风格 Apple 玻璃塔

templates.prompt: Create a dreamlike photograph of urban architecture, with a tall, modern glass office building as the main subject, and a huge, luminous white structure installed high up on the right side of the building.{argument name="building logo" default="Apple logo"} The shot employs a low-angle, upward-looking perspective from the street, making the building the main subject of the image. Its sharp edges are positioned at the top center of the frame, and the reflective curtain wall glass reflects pink clouds and surrounding skyscrapers. The sky appears rich and vibrant.{argument name="sky color" default="Cobalt blue"} Adorned with dyed{argument name="cloud tint" default="light pink and lavender"} The soft clouds create a Vaporwave-style evening atmosphere for the entire scene. The bottom edge of the image includes dark green treetops, while the far left and lower right corners feature adjacent glass buildings that provide a backdrop for the urban environment. The photographic style is realistic, with sharp architectural lines, subtle film grain, high-contrast reflections, and magenta and blue tones. The image contains no people, road signs, or additional text, and uses a 4:3 horizontal composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张梦幻般的城市建筑摄影作品，画面主体是一座高大的现代玻璃办公大楼，大楼右侧高处安装有一个巨大的发光白色 {argument name="building logo" default="Apple logo"}。采用从街道低角度向上仰拍的视角，使大楼占据画面主体，其锐利的边角位于画面上方中心，反光的幕墙玻璃映照出粉色的云朵和周边的摩天大楼。天空呈现出浓郁的 {argument name="sky color" default="钴蓝色"}，点缀着被染成 {argument name="cloud tint" default="淡粉色和薰衣草色"} 的柔和云朵，为整个场景营造出 Vaporwave 风格的傍晚氛围。画面底部边缘包含深绿色的树梢，左侧远端和右下角包含部分相邻的玻璃建筑以提供城市环境背景。采用写实摄影风格，建筑线条清晰，带有细微的胶片颗粒感，高对比度的反光，洋红色与蓝色的色调处理，画面中无人、无路牌、无额外文字，采用 4:3 横向构图。

templates.title: Surreal Denim Fashion Photoshoot

titleLocalized.zh: 超现实牛仔时尚大片

templates.prompt: Create a surreal, high-fashion Western-style photographic work, with the main subject being {argument name="subject" default="A stylish black cowboy"} Riding a spotted grey horse. The composition uses a low, slightly upward angle, placing the rider in the center left of the frame, with the horse's head dominating the right. The rider wears a wide-brimmed black cowboy hat, adorned with abundant gold jewelry and rings, and an extravagant plush faux fur coat.{argument name="coat colors" default="Red, pink and light purple"} He gripped the brown leather reins in one hand, and with the other, he held a black and white mug to his lips. The rider's face was deliberately obscured by a softly edged, warm brown rectangular blur. Behind him, a large cloud floated in the deep blue sky.{argument name="smoke color" default="Pink smoke"} Low mountains or deserts are faintly visible on the horizon. The film employs highly saturated, cinematic color grading to create a magazine-like quality of light and shadow. Details of the horse's fur and reins are clear, the plush coats have a realistic texture, and the rich contrast creates a dreamlike, surreal atmosphere. The composition ranges from square to 4:3, reflecting a magazine style.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超现实的高级时尚西部大片摄影作品，主体为 {argument name="subject" default="一位时尚的黑人牛仔"} 骑着一匹斑点灰马。采用低角度略微仰拍的构图，使骑手位于画面左侧中心，马头占据画面右侧。骑手戴着宽大的黑色牛仔帽，佩戴着丰富的金饰和戒指，身穿一件夸张的毛绒人造皮草大衣，颜色为 {argument name="coat colors" default="红色、粉色和淡紫色"}。他一手握着棕色皮缰绳，另一只手将一个黑白马克杯举向嘴边。骑手的面部被一个暖棕色的柔边矩形模糊效果刻意遮挡。在骑手身后，深蓝色的天空中漂浮着一大团 {argument name="smoke color" default="粉色烟雾"}，地平线处隐约可见低矮的山脉或沙漠。采用高饱和度的电影级调色，呈现时尚杂志般的质感光影，马匹皮毛和缰绳细节清晰，毛绒大衣质感真实，对比度丰富，营造出梦幻般的超现实氛围，构图比例为方形至 4:3 的杂志风格。

templates.title: Neon Holographic Street Style Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹全息街头风肖像

templates.prompt: Create a stylized half-body portrait of a fashion editor, centered on the subject from a slightly upward angle, against a backdrop of heavy studio smoke. The subject wears an oversized iridescent metallic down jacket in a color that is {argument name="jacket color" default="Holographic blue-silver with pink reflection"} The collar features a high zipper with a wrinkled foil texture, and there is a slanted black zippered pocket on the right chest. The front is printed with a large embossed design.{argument name="logo text" default="NIKE"} Brand name and checkmark logo. Background filled with {argument name="fog colors" default="Blue, purple and bright pink"} Dramatic, colorful smoke, softly blending, obscuring the horizon. Figures have buzz cuts or very short hair, adorned with red/pink highlights and small hoop earrings, but their faces are deliberately obscured by a centrally located, opaque square occlusion, the color of which is {argument name="censor block color" default="Soft pale purple"} The obscuring area extends from the forehead to below the mouth. Employing glossy, high-fashion lighting, neon cyberpunk color grading, realistic fabric reflections, sharp, clear details on the down jacket, shallow depth of field, and square composition, the film creates a melancholic yet futuristic street-style aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张风格化的时尚编辑类半身肖像，人物居中，采用略微仰视的视角，背景为浓郁的摄影棚烟雾。主体穿着一件超大款虹彩金属质感羽绒服，颜色为 {argument name="jacket color" default="带有粉色反光的全息蓝银色"}，领口高耸拉链，呈现褶皱箔面纹理，右胸处配有斜向黑色拉链口袋，正面印有巨大的浮雕式 {argument name="logo text" default="NIKE"} 品牌字样及勾形标志。背景充斥着 {argument name="fog colors" default="蓝色、紫色和亮粉色"} 的戏剧性彩色烟雾，柔和融合，无可见地平线。人物留着寸头或极短发，带有红/粉色光影点缀及小圆环耳饰，但面部被一个居中的不透明方形遮挡块刻意遮住，颜色为 {argument name="censor block color" default="柔和的淡紫色"}，遮挡范围从额头延伸至嘴部下方。采用光泽感的高级时尚布光、霓虹赛博朋克调色、逼真的面料反光、羽绒服细节清晰锐利、浅景深、方形构图，营造出一种忧郁且充满未来感的街头潮流大片美学。

titleLocalized.zh: 等轴测出租车预订 App 插图

promptLocalized.zh: {"type":"极简等轴测移动端 App 插图","subject":"以简洁黑色线条勾勒的出租车预订服务概念，白色背景，点缀少量色彩","style":{"perspective":"3/4 等轴测视角","linework":"纤细精准的灰黑色轮廓，圆角设计，技术矢量插图","color_palette":"以白色和浅灰色为主，搭配 {argument name=\"accent color\" default=\"电光蓝和紫罗兰色\"} 点缀，以及小巧的珊瑚色地图定位点","shading":"极柔和的浅灰色阴影，微妙的平台投影，无重度渐变","background":"白色背景，底部附近带有淡淡的等轴测网格线"},"layout":{"count_discrete_elements":7,"elements":[{"id":1,"description":"后方的大型直立智能手机，圆角矩形机身，细轮廓，可见扬声器槽和侧边按钮，屏幕大部分为留白"},{"id":2,"description":"手机左上方前侧的浮动圆形地图卡片，显示浅色街道网格线、一条带有两个转弯的蓝色路线、一个蓝色起点圆点和一个珊瑚色目的地定位点"},{"id":3,"description":"地图卡片下方的浮动预订卡片，显示文本 {argument name=\"booking title\" default=\"预约出租车\"}、一个小巧的黑色出租车图标、可见的距离文本 {argument name=\"distance text\" default=\"3 分钟路程\"} 以及右侧的紫色圆形箭头按钮"},{"id":4,"description":"位于平台中央的白色出租车模型，紧凑型轿车，黑色车窗，蓝色侧边条纹，勾勒出的前大灯和格栅，白色车顶标志上标有 {argument name=\"taxi sign text\" default=\"TAXI\"}"},{"id":5,"description":"支撑出租车的顶部圆角矩形底座平台，白色表面，带有细灰色轮廓"},{"id":6,"description":"平台下方较大的圆角矩形基座，白色，带有细紫色轮廓点缀"},{"id":7,"description":"基座周围的地面导航路径线：细蓝色轮廓路线、带有蓝色和珊瑚色节点的虚线垂直引导线，以及右下角的紫色目标环"}]},"composition":"将手机垂直居中放置在出租车后方，将浮动 UI 卡片重叠在手机前方，将出租车放置在下方中央的抬高平台上，在整个物体周围留出充裕的留白","rendering_instructions":"创作一张清晰的 SaaS 着陆页网约车 App 首页插图；保持比例平衡，避免照片级真实感，避免杂乱，使用简洁的可缩放矢量几何图形，保留卡片和出租车标志中精确可见的英文 UI 文本"}

templates.title: Isometric cloud logistics UI icons

titleLocalized.zh: 等轴测云物流 UI 图标

templates.prompt: Create a simple, minimalist isometric line art illustration with a gray-white background and subtle light gray perspective grid lines. Show a rounded rectangular web browser window, standing upright on a thick, rounded rectangular base, drawn with a thin black outline and mostly white fill. A large outline cloud icon floats above the browser, connected to it by a thin vertical black line; a small dotted line near the cloud suggests a connection to the cloud. Inside the browser window is a simple outline delivery truck icon with a small package on its roof, centered in the lower area. A small blue back arrow is on the left side of the browser's top bar, with a long horizontal black address bar in the middle and a shorter horizontal line on the right. On the right side of the browser's front, a semi-transparent blue circular button contains a short diagonal black line. A thin black connecting line extends from the right edge of the browser to a small, pure periwinkle blue circular node, and a tiny red rounded square port is located at the edge of the browser. Use only minimal accent color.{argument name="accent blue" default="Periwinkle Blue"} Used for node and UI highlighting.{argument name="accent red" default="Soft Red"} Used for small ports and black outlines. Maintain a centered, transparent, technological, and modern composition, with no text, no shadows except for the subtle sense of depth provided by the isometric outline, and adopt a vector icon style suitable for the SaaS cloud logistics concept.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅简洁的极简主义等轴测线条艺术插图，背景为灰白色，带有淡淡的浅灰色透视网格线。展示一个圆角矩形网页浏览器窗口，直立于厚实的圆角矩形底座上，采用细黑色轮廓和大部分白色填充绘制。浏览器上方浮动着一个巨大的轮廓云图标，通过一条细垂直黑线与浏览器相连，云朵附近有一小段虚线，暗示云端连接。在浏览器窗口内，包含一个简单的轮廓配送车图标，车顶载有一个小包裹，位于下方区域中心。浏览器顶部栏左侧有一个小的蓝色返回箭头，中间有一条长的水平黑色地址栏，右侧有一条较短的水平线。在浏览器正面的右侧，放置一个半透明的蓝色圆形按钮，其中包含一条短的对角黑色斜线。从浏览器右边缘延伸出一条细黑色连接线，通向一个小型的纯长春花蓝色圆形节点，浏览器边缘处有一个微小的红色圆角方形端口。仅使用少量强调色：{argument name="accent blue" default="长春花蓝"} 用于节点和 UI 高亮，{argument name="accent red" default="柔和红"} 用于小端口，以及黑色轮廓。保持构图居中、通透、具有科技感和现代感，无文字，除等轴测轮廓带来的微妙深度感外无阴影，采用适合 SaaS 云物流概念的矢量图标风格。

templates.title: From 4D ultrasound to newborn portraits

titleLocalized.zh: 从 4D 超声波到新生儿肖像

Transform the ultrasound image into a close-up style newborn photograph: the baby lies flat, gently wrapped in a beige knit blanket, revealing soft, dark lanugo hair, paired with warm beige bedding, using soft natural light to create a shallow depth of field effect and a warm family photography atmosphere. Only the head shape and facial proportions inferred from the reference image are retained, not the texture of the ultrasound. A solid privacy occlusion block similar to the baby's skin tone is placed in the center of the baby's face to conceal facial details. Style:{argument name="photo style" default="soft realistic newborn photography"} Blanket color:{argument name="blanket color" default="cream"} Hair color:{argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} ;illumination:{argument name="lighting" default="warm soft natural light"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 仅使用提供的 4D 胎儿超声波图像作为面部结构的参考，创作一张温馨、写实的新生儿肖像，合理预测宝宝出生后的样貌。将超声波图像转化为特写风格的新生儿摄影作品：宝宝平躺着，被米色针织毯轻轻包裹，露出细软的深色新生儿胎毛，配以暖米色寝具，采用柔和的自然光，呈现浅景深效果，营造出温馨的家庭摄影氛围。仅保留参考图中推断出的头型和面部比例，而非超声波的纹理。在宝宝面部中心放置一个与肤色相近的实心隐私遮挡块，以隐藏面部细节。风格：{argument name="photo style" default="soft realistic newborn photography"}；毯子颜色：{argument name="blanket color" default="cream"}；头发颜色：{argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"}；光照：{argument name="lighting" default="warm soft natural light"}。

templates.title: Line Art Posters at Chengdu Taikoo Li

titleLocalized.zh: 成都太古里线条艺术海报

templates.prompt: Create a vertical travel poster using a refined monochrome architectural line art style. The background is warm ivory paper, complemented by delicate brown ink outlines and very light beige shadows. The scene is a pedestrian street in Chengdu's Taikoo Li, China, outlined with precise, fine lines reminiscent of a hand-drawn urban sketch: on the left is the traditional Daci Temple building with its ornate arched tiled roof and bamboo groves; on the right is a modern glass retail building with balconies and storefronts. A long paved walkway extends into the distance using one-point perspective. The image includes people walking or sitting at outdoor cafe tables, bicycles, flowerbeds, trees, parasols, and distant skyscrapers. A slender landmark tower stands at the center of the skyline. At the top, place an elegant, large Chinese title.{argument name="headline text" default="Chengdu Taikoo Li"} The text uses a dark reddish-brown serif calligraphic font, with a smaller subtitle centered below.{argument name="subtitle text" default="Chengdu, Sichuan, China"} It is flanked by thin horizontal lines. The street scene includes three clearly visible signage elements: a vertical stone tablet in the lower left corner with the text {argument name="temple sign text" default="Daci Temple"} Below is a small English "Daci Temple LI"; to the right is a hanging vertical shop sign with the text {argument name="district sign text" default="Chengdu Taikoo Li"} Below is a small English inscription reading "TAIKOO LI"; and on the left side of the main gate is a traditional temple plaque with the inscription "TAIKOO LI".{argument name="gate plaque text" default="Ancient Daci Temple"} Maintain a clear and open composition, leaving a large area of ​​blank space in the upper part. Avoid using heavy colors, reject photorealistic styles, do not use thick outlines, avoid messy shadow lines, and do not add any additional title text except for the designated logo text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖版旅行海报，采用精致的单色建筑线条艺术风格，背景为暖象牙色纸张，配以细腻的棕褐色墨水轮廓和极浅的米色阴影。场景为中国成都太古里的步行街，以类似手绘城市速写的精准细线条勾勒：左侧是带有华丽弧形瓦顶和竹林的传统大慈寺建筑，右侧是带有阳台和店面的现代玻璃零售建筑，一条长长的铺砌步道以一点透视法向远方延伸，画面中有人群在行走或坐在户外咖啡桌旁，还有自行车、花坛、树木、遮阳伞以及远处的摩天大楼，天际线中央矗立着一座细长的地标塔。在顶部，放置一个优雅的大号中文标题 {argument name="headline text" default="成都太古里"}，采用深红褐色衬线书法字体，下方居中放置较小的副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="中国 · 四川 · 成都"}，两侧配以细横线。在街道场景中包含 3 个清晰可见的标志文字元素：左下方的一块竖立石碑，文字为 {argument name="temple sign text" default="大慈寺"}，下方附有小号英文“Daci Temple LI”；右侧的一块悬挂式竖向店铺招牌，文字为 {argument name="district sign text" default="成都太古里"}，下方附有小号英文“TAIKOO LI”；以及左侧大门上的一块传统寺庙匾额，文字为 {argument name="gate plaque text" default="古大慈寺"}。保持构图通透，上半部分留有大面积空白，避免使用厚重的色彩，拒绝照片写实风格，不使用粗轮廓线，避免杂乱的阴影线，除指定的标志文字外，不添加任何额外的标题文字。

templates.title: Professional AI portrait conversion

titleLocalized.zh: 专业 AI 形象照转换

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image as a reference for identity and hairstyle, create a professional AI headshot/studio portrait. Replace the casual outdoor pool background with a clean, light gray studio background, expand the composition to a three-quarter-length portrait, and dress the subject in an outfit.{argument name="suit color" default="light gray"} A modern suit, paired with matching trousers and{argument name="shirt color" default="white"} Crew neck T-shirt. Keep the subject facing forward, adopting a relaxed business pose: one hand in their pocket, the other arm hanging naturally at their side. Retain the same overall hairstyle and natural facial proportions as in the reference image, but style the hair slightly darker and neater to present a sophisticated professional image. Use soft, even studio lighting, a realistic photographic style, sharp details, neutral tones, and a clean, LinkedIn-style composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 以提供的参考图像作为身份和发型参考，创作一张专业的 AI 形象照 / 工作室肖像。将随意的户外泳池背景替换为干净的浅灰色工作室背景，将构图扩展为四分之三身位的肖像，并为拍摄对象穿上一套 {argument name="suit color" default="light gray"} 的现代西装，搭配同色系西裤和 {argument name="shirt color" default="white"} 圆领 T 恤。保持拍摄对象面向前方，采用放松的商务姿势：一只手插在裤兜里，另一只手臂自然垂在身侧。保留参考图中相同的整体发型和自然面部比例，但将头发处理得稍微深色且整洁，以呈现精致的职场形象。使用柔和均匀的工作室灯光、写实摄影风格、清晰的细节、中性色调，以及简洁的 LinkedIn 风格构图。

templates.title: Cinematic GPT Image 2 Poster

titleLocalized.zh: Cinematic GPT Image 2 海报

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic sci-fi landscape poster in a 16:9 widescreen format. In the lower center of the foreground, a solitary human silhouette stands on a rocky shore, facing a vast, mirror-like mountain lake, surrounded by the rugged peaks of the Alps. Above the horizon is a deep cyan-blue night sky, shrouded in hazy mist; in the upper center of the background, a giant, Earth-like, luminous planet floats, with a smaller satellite in the upper right. Employ an atmospheric, high-contrast color palette with cool cyan and deep navy blue tones, adding soft lighting to create a realistic digital painting style, showcasing an epic, fantastical scale with a slight depth-of-field blur effect, creating a mysterious and adventurous atmosphere. Overlay a striking white, bold sans-serif title text in the center of the image.{argument name="main title" default="GPT image 2"} It features a subtle dark shadow; below it, a smaller, bold white Chinese subtitle is placed in the center.{argument name="subtitle text" default="More powerful image generation models"} The layout remains clean, modern, and highly legible, giving it the feel of a technology launch event cover banner.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 16:9 宽画幅的电影级科幻风景海报。画面前景下方中央，一个孤独的人类剪影站在岩石岸边，面对着广阔且如镜面般的山湖，四周环绕着险峻的阿尔卑斯山峰。地平线上方是深青蓝色的夜空，伴有朦胧云雾；背景上方中央悬浮着一颗巨大的、类似地球的发光行星，右上方还有一颗较小的卫星。采用大气雾感、高对比度、冷青色与深海军蓝的调色风格，加入柔和光晕，呈现逼真的数字绘景风格，展现史诗般的奇幻尺度，并带有轻微的景深模糊效果，营造出神秘而充满冒险的氛围。在画面中央叠加醒目的白色粗体无衬线标题文本 {argument name="main title" default="GPT image 2"}，并带有微妙的深色投影；在其下方居中位置放置一行较小的白色粗体中文副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="更强大的图像生成模型"}。保持排版简洁、现代且高度易读，呈现出科技发布会封面横幅的质感。

templates.title: Absolute Cinema Anime Poster

titleLocalized.zh: Absolute Cinema 动漫海报

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic, anime-style movie poster illustration featuring a {argument name="character description" default="Schoolgirl with long blonde hair"} Seated in the dimly lit cinema, in the center of a deep red luxury theater seat with black armrests, she wore a white collared shirt under an oversized beige cardigan, tied with a large deep red bow, her long hair cascading over her shoulders and onto the seat. Her arms were raised high in a victory V-shape, palms outstretched, as if celebrating a masterpiece. A bright, warm-colored projector or stage light was placed directly above her head, creating a strong golden halo, rim lighting, lens flare, and cinematic backlighting effects, while the surrounding theater environment was almost entirely dark. A centered, solid, brown square mask obscured the character's face; this mask was flat and opaque, covering the eyes, nose, and most facial features. In the lower half of the poster, a glowing serif font was added: smaller words {argument name="top title text" default="ABSOLUTE"} Located in a huge word{argument name="main title text" default="CINEMA"} Above, both lettering is white gold with a strong halo effect and a soft orange glow. The poster employs a vertical composition, symmetrical frame, high contrast, warm amber highlights, soft film grain, exquisite anime rendering, and an epic, inspirational movie advertisement aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张戏剧性的动漫风格电影海报插图，画面中一位 {argument name="character description" default="留着金色长发的校服女生"} 坐在昏暗的电影院里，位于深红色豪华影院座椅的中央，座椅带有黑色扶手。她身穿白色翻领衬衫，外搭一件超大号米色开衫，系着深红色大蝴蝶结，长发垂落在肩膀和座椅上。她双臂高举，呈胜利的 V 字形，双手张开，掌心向外，仿佛在庆祝一部杰作。在她的头顶正上方放置一盏明亮的暖色投影灯或舞台灯，营造出强烈的金色光环、轮廓光、镜头光晕和电影级背光效果，而周围的影院环境则几乎全黑。用一个居中的实心棕褐色方形遮挡块遮住角色的面部，该遮挡块平整且不透明，覆盖了眼睛、鼻子和大部分面部特征。在海报下半部分，添加发光的衬线字体：较小的单词 {argument name="top title text" default="ABSOLUTE"} 位于巨大的单词 {argument name="main title text" default="CINEMA"} 上方，两者均为白金色字母，带有强烈的晕光效果和柔和的橙色外发光。采用竖版海报构图，对称框架，高对比度，暖琥珀色高光，柔和的胶片颗粒感，精致的动漫渲染，以及史诗般的励志电影广告美学。

templates.title: Cyber ​​Empire Floating Palace City

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博帝国浮空宫殿城

The figure, dressed in a flowing crimson robe and wearing a black official's hat, is positioned in the lower left foreground, beside a glowing square lantern and a sculpted stone lion. The city is a vast, layered labyrinth of red palace walls, glazed tile towers, bridges, towers, terraces, and suspended structures, all interwoven with glowing blue holographic wireframes, like superimposed architectural blueprints. Enormous floating towers, cranes, scaffold-like towers, circular aerial platforms, and elevated walkways fill the deep perspective space, creating a surreal cyberpunk capital soaring into the deep blue, clear night sky. The style combines grand proportions, dense architectural details, cool blue ambient lighting with warm orange lantern accents, realistic painting rendering, complex lines, a sense of atmospheric depth, and an atmosphere of awe and tranquil contemplation.{argument name="visual style" default="Cyberpunk Chinese Ancient Architecture Fantasy"} Ultra-fine frosted drawing, cinematic lighting, sharp perspective, 9:16 vertical composition, no text, no logo.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高度精细的垂直电影概念艺术场景，画面中一位 {argument name="character role" default="中国古代朝廷官员"} 的背影站在夜晚的石制阳台上，俯瞰着一座由传统东亚宫殿建筑构成的宏伟未来巨型城市。人物身穿深红色飘逸长袍，头戴黑色官帽，位于左下角前景，身旁是一个发光的方形灯笼和一座雕刻的石狮子。这座城市是一个由红色宫墙、琉璃瓦塔楼、桥梁、高塔、露台和悬浮建筑组成的巨大层叠迷宫，所有建筑都交织着发光的蓝色全息线框结构，如同建筑蓝图的叠加。巨大的浮空塔、仙鹤、脚手架般的塔楼、圆形空中平台和高架走廊填满了深邃的透视空间，营造出一座耸入深蓝色晴朗夜空的超现实赛博帝国都城。运用宏大的比例、密集的建筑细节、冷蓝色环境光与暖橙色灯笼点缀，采用写实的绘画渲染、复杂的线条、大气深度感，以及一种敬畏与静谧沉思的氛围。风格应结合 {argument name="visual style" default="赛博朋克中国古代建筑奇幻"}、超精细磨砂绘图、电影级灯光、锐利的透视感、9:16 垂直构图，无文字，无 Logo。

templates.title: Gothic Lolita Subway Fashion Portraits

titleLocalized.zh: 哥特萝莉地铁时尚人像

templates.prompt: Create a dark, cinematic night scene photograph featuring two women dressed in trendy anime-style gothic Lolita fashion, embracing closely at a wet New York subway entrance. Use a 3:2 horizontal composition, framing the image from mid-thigh upwards. The background is a stairwell with glossy subway tiles in dark green and cream, featuring brass handrails, rain-soaked reflections, warm amber station lighting, and a sign that reads "UPTOWN & THE BRONX," with an information panel for "14 Street Union Square Station" below. The woman on the left has {argument name="left hair color" default="Pale lavender silver"} She has a short bob with side-swept bangs, wears an elegant cream-colored lace headband adorned with ribbons and floral bows, and is dressed in a custom-made deep plum velvet jacket, a champagne-colored satin scarf, a light-colored blouse with a large bow at the neckline, and a dark skirt; her arm is draped over another woman's shoulder. The woman on the right has {argument name="right hair color" default="Ice light blue"} The two figures, with straight bob hair and bangs, wear black lace headpieces and long ribbons, small dark glasses, and black velvet coats with pointed collars, and dark purple patterned scarves around their necks. They should possess a realistic cosplay fashion model quality, with porcelain doll-like features, but their faces are deliberately obscured, each covered by a flat, opaque, and soft gray-brown rectangular masking block. The image should utilize rich nighttime color grading, high contrast, cinematic street photography realism, shallow depth of field, wet reflective surfaces, luminous bokeh, delicate velvet and satin textures, and an atmospheric urban gothic fashion blockbuster style.

templates.prompt: Create a realistic vertical portrait of a young East Asian woman seated by a bright, sunlit window indoors. The image is a close-up from the chest up, showing her in a three-quarter profile to the right. She possesses {argument name="hair color" default="Long, glossy, dark brown hair"} Her straight hair had soft, natural layers, with a few strands catching the light and falling over her shoulders and back. Bathed in bright afternoon sunlight, the water shimmers with highlights, a gentle breeze stirs the girl's hair and cloak, the scene boasts high-detail anime-style rendering, a hand-drawn background, a strong sense of depth, and a warm, adventurous atmosphere. templates.prompt: Create a realistic vertical portrait, with the subject being {argument name="subject" default="A young East Asian woman"} She was sitting by a bright, sunlit window, in a soft, airy room. She possessed {argument name="hair color and style" default="Long, straight, dark brown hair parted in the middle, falling over one shoulder."} Fair skin, slender figure, wearing{argument name="outfit" default="A simple off-white spaghetti strap tank top"} She wore a small gold hoop earring on one ear. The composition employed a close-up, intimate approach, starting the shot from the upper body with a slightly angled shot from above and to the side, allowing warm natural light to illuminate her shoulders and collarbone. Her face was deliberately obscured by a large, opaque square obscuring the viewer's face, its soft matte gradient from brown to taupe covering her eyes, nose, and mouth, while revealing her hair, ears, neck, shoulders, and clothing. The background was soft-focused, showcasing white window frames, light-colored curtains, subtle greenery, and bright morning light. Shallow depth of field, realistic skin texture, glossy hair highlights, and natural shadows were used to create a clean, lifestyle-inspired aesthetic.{argument name="lighting" default="Warm natural window light and soft backlighting"} It presents a high-resolution camera-like quality with a vertical 2:3 aspect ratio.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实的竖版肖像，主体为 {argument name="subject" default="一位年轻的东亚女性"}，她正坐在明亮且阳光充足的窗边，身处一个柔和、通透的房间内。她拥有 {argument name="hair color and style" default="中分的长直深棕色头发，垂在一侧肩头"}，皮肤白皙，身材苗条，身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="一件简单的米白色细肩带吊带衫"}，一侧耳朵上戴着一枚小巧的金色圆环耳饰。采用近距离、亲密的构图，从上半身开始取景，拍摄角度略微从上方和侧面切入，让她的肩膀和锁骨捕捉到温暖的自然光。她的面部被一个位于正中央的大型不透明方形遮挡块刻意遮住，遮挡块呈现出从棕色到灰褐色的柔和哑光渐变，覆盖了眼睛、鼻子和嘴巴，同时露出头发、耳朵、脖子、肩膀和衣物。背景应进行柔焦处理，呈现出白色窗框、浅色窗帘、隐约的绿植和明亮的晨光，运用浅景深、真实的皮肤纹理、有光泽的头发高光、自然的阴影，营造出干净的生活方式摄影美感。使用 {argument name="lighting" default="温暖的自然窗光和柔和的逆光"}，呈现高分辨率相机质感，竖版 2:3 纵横比。

templates.title: Nighttime Forest Fantasy Camp

titleLocalized.zh: 夜间森林奇幻营地

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic, anime-style scene of a nighttime travel camp in a deep forest, using a 16:9 widescreen composition. Two travelers are resting by a small campfire: on the left is a petite girl with long hair {argument name="girl hair color" default="Short silver-white hair"} One figure, adorned with a red floral headdress, wears a black cloak with a deep red lining, over which lies a white shirt tied with a red ribbon. Wearing dark tights and black loafers, he sits on a low tree stump or stool, eating from a plate. To his right is a tall, adult male knight or mage guard, dressed in a magnificent black military uniform with gold trim, a high collar, brass buttons, a belt, gloves, high boots, a round cloak buckle, and a long black cloak with a burgundy lining. He sits calmly, holding a metal cup and a piece of bread. Both figures' faces are deliberately obscured using softly edged beige rectangular blocks. In the foreground, a bright orange campfire burns beneath a tripod, on which hangs a black cooking pot filled with stew, casting a warm glow on the figures and the ground. The campsite is surrounded by travel props: 10 clearly visible camping and travel items, including a glowing brass lantern on the leftmost wooden crate, a metal cup next to it, bread on the crate, a cutting board with sliced ​​cured meat, a shallow bowl of food, stacked wooden crates on the right, a rolled-up sleeping bag on top of the crates, a leather satchel in the lower right foreground, a sheathed longsword leaning against the luggage, and a wagon and some horses faintly visible in the dark background on the right. The environment is a deep blue-black forest with tall tree trunks, heavy shadows, detailed vegetation, and clearings; the lighting should have a cinematic, painterly quality, with strong warm firelight contrasting with cool moonlight, rich textural details, and a high-quality fantasy illustration style, creating a dramatic travel story atmosphere. There is no text in the image.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个深邃森林中夜间旅行营地的电影级动漫风格场景，采用 16:9 宽屏构图。两名旅人正在小篝火旁休息：左侧是一位娇小的少女，留着 {argument name="girl hair color" default="短银白色头发"}，佩戴红色花朵发饰，身穿带有深红色内衬的黑色披风，内搭白色衬衫，系着红色丝带，穿着深色连裤袜和黑色乐福鞋，坐在矮树桩或凳子上，手里拿着餐盘正在进食；右侧是一位高大的成年男性骑士或法师护卫，身穿带有金色饰边的华丽黑色军装，高领，配有黄铜纽扣、皮带、手套、高筒靴、圆形披风扣，以及一件内衬为酒红色的黑色长披风，神态从容地坐着，手里拿着金属杯和一块面包。两人的面部均被刻意遮盖，使用边缘柔和的米色矩形遮挡块。画面中心前景处，明亮的橙色篝火在三脚架下方燃烧，架子上挂着一口装满炖菜的黑色烹饪锅，将温暖的光芒投射在角色和地面上。营地周围布置旅行道具：包含 10 件清晰可见的露营和旅行物品，包括最左侧木箱上发光的黄铜灯笼、旁边的金属杯、木箱上的面包、一块放有切片腌肉的切菜板、一浅碗食物、右侧堆叠的木箱、木箱顶部的卷起睡袋、右下角前景的皮挎包、靠在行李旁的一把带鞘长剑，以及右侧黑暗背景中隐约可见的马车和部分马匹。环境为深蓝黑色的森林，有高大的树干、浓重的阴影、细腻的植被和泥土空地；光影应呈现出电影般的绘画质感，强烈的暖色火光与冷色月影形成对比，纹理细节丰富，高质量奇幻插画风格，营造出戏剧性的旅行故事氛围，画面中无任何文字。

templates.title: Fantasy Capital Arrival Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 奇幻都城抵达场景

templates.prompt: Create a grand, cinematic fantasy travel scene, employing an ultra-detailed, realistic painting style: From a rear viewpoint, a lone carriage carrying two travelers travels along a straight, light-colored dirt road towards a vast, walled capital. The road forms a strong vanishing point, flanked by two rows of rustic wooden fences on each side, extending through open green meadows dotted with wildflowers, rocks, and shrubs. In the distance, a magnificent medieval magical city is depicted, featuring continuous stone walls, dense rooftops, numerous narrow spires, and a grand, cathedral-like castle atop a towering, dark blue Gothic tower; arched bridges spanning calm waterways should be included on either side of the city. The sun is near the left horizon, and the time is [time missing].{argument name="time of day" default="Golden hour sunset"} The sky cast a warm, amber glow, leaving long shadows and bright radiance across the fields. The expansive, azure sky was dotted with sparse clouds and faintly visible birds. The city was surrounded by rolling hills and distant mountains, creating an epic feel, as if arriving at a destination after a long journey.{argument name="visual style" default="High Magic Film Concept Art"} Style: 16:9 panoramic composition, rich sense of atmospheric perspective, exquisite architectural details, soft volumetric lighting, natural colors, rich details and full of romance and tranquility, no text, no modern objects.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅极具电影感的宏大奇幻旅行场景，呈现超细腻的绘画写实风格：从后方视角望去，一辆孤零零的马车正载着 2 名旅人，沿着笔直的浅色土路向一座巨大的围城都城驶去。道路形成了强烈的中心灭点，两侧各有 2 排质朴的木栅栏，延伸穿过点缀着野花、岩石和小树的开阔绿草地。远景处，展示一座雄伟的中世纪魔法城市，拥有连绵的石墙、密集的屋顶、许多狭窄的尖塔，以及一座宏伟的中心大教堂式城堡，城堡顶部耸立着高大的黑蓝色哥特式塔楼；城市左右两侧需包含横跨平静水道的拱桥。太阳位于左侧地平线附近，时间为 {argument name="time of day" default="黄金时段日落"}，投射出温暖的琥珀色光芒，在原野上留下长长的阴影和明亮的辉光，天空广阔而湛蓝，点缀着稀疏的云朵和隐约可见的飞鸟。城市四周环绕着连绵起伏的丘陵和远山，营造出长途跋涉后抵达目的地的史诗感。采用 {argument name="visual style" default="高魔电影概念艺术"} 风格，16:9 全景构图，丰富的空气透视感，精细的建筑细节，柔和的体积光，色彩自然，细节丰富且充满浪漫与宁静感，无文字，无现代物体。

templates.title: Forest Camp Magic Battle

titleLocalized.zh: 森林营地魔法之战

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic, dark fantasy anime-style nighttime forest camping scene, using a 16:9 widescreen composition and highly detailed concept art. In the left foreground, a small campfire glows orange beneath a black kettle suspended on a tripod. Around the fire are four clearly visible camping props: a brass lamp, a metal mug, stacked wooden crates or luggage, and a rolled-up log or sleeping bag. A young female mage sits beside the fire, with {argument name="girl hair color" default="light pink and silver"} A girl with a bob haircut, wearing a red flower hair accessory, a white shirt, a red silk bow tie, a dark cloak, and a travel skirt, is looking up with an expression of anxiety and admiration. In the center of the image stands a tall, adult male warlock guard, dressed in…{argument name="male outfit color" default="Black military coat with gold trim"} He wore a high collar, belt, gloves, and boots, with a flowing cloak lined with crimson. His face was deliberately blurred and hidden in shadow, one arm outstretched in a protective casting gesture. From his raised hand, dazzling golden magic erupted, forming a broad arc of light and shimmering particles that swept across the right from the center like a barrier or a wind blade. In the right half of the image, five hostile shadow beasts composed of twisted bark, feathers, smoke, and debris were displayed: a beast pouncing near the central light, a large bird-like beast rolling in the lower right foreground, a spiky monster in the center right, a dragon-like creature in the upper right, and a semi-concealed creature in the darkness in the left rear. The golden spells swirled leaves, dirt, debris, and embers into the air, while the forest behind remained almost entirely black, with only indistinct tree trunks and branches visible. Atmosphere:{argument name="mood" default="Heroic protection during a dangerous journey"} Lighting effects: Intense warm firelight contrasts with magical golden light, while cool blue-black shadows complement the lighting; Style:{argument name="art style" default="Epic Japanese fantasy light novel illustrations"} Extremely high detail, dramatic dynamism, volumetric sparkle, atmospheric depth, no text, no borders, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个电影级暗黑奇幻动漫风格的夜间森林旅行营地场景，采用 16:9 宽屏构图，高细节绘画概念艺术。左侧前景中，一个小型篝火在三脚架悬挂的黑色水壶下发出橙色光芒，篝火周围有 4 个清晰可见的营地道具：一盏黄铜灯、一个金属马克杯、堆叠的木箱或行李，以及一个卷起的原木或睡袋。火堆旁坐着一位年轻的女性法师，留着 {argument name="girl hair color" default="淡粉银色"} 波波头，戴着红色花朵发饰，身穿白色衬衫、红色丝带领结、深色斗篷和旅行裙，正抬头仰望，神情中带着焦虑与钦佩。画面中心站着一位高大的成年男性术士守卫，身穿 {argument name="male outfit color" default="带有金色饰边的黑色军装大衣"}，高领、腰带、手套、靴子，披着深红色内衬的飘逸斗篷；他的面部故意模糊并隐没在阴影中，一只手臂向前伸展，做出保护性的施法姿势。从他抬起的手中，耀眼的金色魔法喷涌而出，形成宽阔的弧形光带和闪烁的粒子，像屏障或风刃一样从中心向右侧横扫。在画面右半部分，展示 5 只由扭曲的树皮、羽毛、烟雾和碎片组成的敌对暗影兽：一只在中心光芒附近猛扑的野兽，一只在右下前景翻滚的大型鸟状野兽，一只在右中方的带刺怪物，一只在右上方的龙形生物，以及一只在左后方黑暗中半隐蔽的生物。金色法术将树叶、泥土、碎片和余烬卷入空中，而身后的森林则保持近乎全黑，仅可见模糊的树干和枝叶。氛围：{argument name="mood" default="危险旅途中的英勇守护"}；光效：强烈的暖色火光与魔法金光对比冷蓝黑色的阴影；风格：{argument name="art style" default="史诗级日本奇幻轻小说插画"}，超高细节，充满戏剧性的动态感，体积感火花，大气深度，无文字，无边框，无水印。

templates.title: Neferpitou Villain Wallpaper Poster

titleLocalized.zh: Neferpitou 反派壁纸海报

templates.prompt: Create a vertical anime character wallpaper/poster in a semi-realistic oil painting style, with the main character being {argument name="character name" default="Neferpitou"} , from{argument name="series title" default="Hunter × Hunter"} The composition uses a 9:16 vertical aspect ratio, with the character occupying two-thirds of the right side of the frame, presenting an elegant profile from mid-thigh up. Facing left, with a slightly mischievous smile, the character possesses sharp, amber-red cat eyes. The character has fair skin, large cat ears, and a long, light-colored cat tail that curls messy, medium-length waves along the right edge.{argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} The hair features thick curls and a voluminous fringe. The character wears a deep navy blue high-necked Royal Guard uniform coat, fitted at the waist, with a row of large, round gold buttons shimmering in the light. A dramatic warm backlight from the upper left adds subtle contour lighting to the hair and ear edges, while the clothing is accented with deep navy blue shadows. The background is a soft parchment beige texture with a distinct brushstroke feel and an old poster vibe. The left side features a clean, minimalist typography: a small, dark cat silhouette icon near the upper left, a small gold crown icon below it, and a large, compressed, uppercase navy blue title text "NEFERPITOU" in the lower left center, adorned with a tiny red diamond decoration inside or beside the title. Below this is the widely spaced lowercase subtitle "HUNTER × HUNTER," with the quote {argument name="quote" default="How curious... I do so love games."} Following this is a row of exactly four soft icons, from left to right: a circular badge, a chimera ant face badge, a cat head badge, and a crown badge. Below the icons are five short, capitalized descriptive lines: “A ROYAL GUARD.”, “A CAT OF THE CHIMERA ANTS.”, “BEAUTIFUL. DEADLY.”, “PLAYFUL. TERRIFYING.”, and “THE KING'S MOST LOYAL.” Thin horizontal dividing lines and tiny red diamond decorations are added as separators. All typography is left-aligned with ample negative space, creating the effect of a high-end character key visual poster. No additional characters, modern items, speech bubbles, or borders are included.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张油画半写实风格的竖版动漫角色壁纸海报，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="Neferpitou"}，出自 {argument name="series title" default="Hunter × Hunter"}。构图采用 9:16 的竖向比例，角色占据画面右侧三分之二，呈现大腿中部以上的优雅侧身像，面朝左侧，带着一丝狡黠的微笑，拥有一双锐利的琥珀红色猫眼。角色皮肤白皙，长有巨大的猫耳，一条修长的浅色猫尾沿着右侧边缘卷曲，凌乱的中短波浪状 {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} 头发带有浓密的卷曲和蓬松的刘海。角色身着深海军蓝高领皇家卫队制服外套，腰部修身，一排巨大的圆形金色纽扣在光线下闪烁。使用来自左上方的戏剧性暖色背光，头发和耳朵边缘带有微妙的轮廓光，衣物上有深海军蓝色的阴影，背景为柔和的羊皮纸米色纹理，带有明显的笔触感和陈旧海报的氛围。在左侧设计简洁的编辑排版：左上方附近有一个小型深色猫咪剪影图标，下方有一个小型金色皇冠图标，巨大的压缩大写海军蓝色标题文本“NEFERPITOU”位于左下中部，标题内部或旁边配有一个微小的红色菱形装饰，下方是间距较大的小写字母副标题“HUNTER × HUNTER”，引语为 {argument name="quote" default="How curious... I do so love games."}，随后是一排正好 4 个柔和的小图标，从左到右依次为：圆形徽章、嵌合蚁脸部徽章、猫头徽章和皇冠徽章。在图标下方，添加五行简短的大写描述文字：“A ROYAL GUARD.”、“A CAT OF THE CHIMERA ANTS.”、“BEAUTIFUL. DEADLY.”、“PLAYFUL. TERRIFYING.” 以及 “THE KING'S MOST LOYAL.”。添加细水平分割线和微小的红色菱形装饰作为分隔符。保持所有排版左对齐，并留出充裕的负空间，呈现出高级角色关键视觉海报的效果。不包含额外角色、现代物品、对话气泡或边框。

templates.title: Anime Sakura Rock Album Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫樱花摇滚专辑封面

templates.prompt: Create a square, anime-style CD cover illustration for a melancholic Japanese school rock ballad. The scene depicts a beautiful girl standing on a cherry blossom-lined path outside the school, bathed in the golden light of sunset. She glances back slightly, her expression serene yet wistful. She has long, flowing black hair, soft reddish-brown eyes, and fair skin. She wears an ivory-white blouse with ruffled cuffs, paired with a layered pale lavender-gray skirt, creating a romantic gothic Lolita school uniform look. She holds a glossy black electric guitar with chrome hardware, which is slung across her body in the lower right foreground. Cherry blossom branches cover the upper left corner and top edge, pink petals falling in the warm orange air; the background includes the school gate, fence, trees, and the slightly blurred school building bathed in the afterglow of the sunset. Employing highly detailed anime-style rendering, warm cinematic lighting, delicate lines, and an emotionally resonant album cover composition, the design utilizes rich shades of peach, coral, amber, and rose to create a soft depth of field, a nostalgic atmosphere, and a subtle film grain texture. The image must include two clearly visible, elegant Japanese font elements: a semi-transparent, deep red main title on the left.{argument name="album title" default="After-school plans"} And the smaller artist names below.{argument name="artist name" default="Junie"} Maintain a seamless integration between the text and professional music cover art; avoid adding extra logos, borders, track lists, or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张方形动漫风格的 CD 封面插图，用于一首感伤的日本校园摇滚抒情曲。场景描绘了一位美丽的少女站在校园外樱花盛开的小径上，时间处于金色的夕阳时刻，她微微回首，神情平静而惆怅。她留着一头飘逸的长黑发，有着柔和的红棕色双眸和白皙的皮肤，身穿带有荷叶边袖口的象牙白衬衫，搭配层叠的淡薰衣草灰半身裙，呈现出浪漫的哥特萝莉校园制服感。她怀抱一把带有铬合金配件的亮黑色电吉他，吉他斜跨在身体前方，位于右下角前景。樱花枝叶布满左上角和顶部边缘，粉色的花瓣在温暖的橙色空气中飘落；背景包括校门、围栏、树木以及沐浴在夕阳余晖中略显模糊的教学楼。采用高细节的绘画风动漫渲染、温暖的电影级光影、精致的线条、富有情感的专辑封面构图，运用丰富的桃色、珊瑚色、琥珀色和玫瑰色调，营造出柔和的景深、怀旧的氛围以及细腻的胶片颗粒质感。画面中需包含两个清晰可见的优雅日文字体元素：左侧放置半透明深红色的主标题 {argument name="album title" default="放课後の約束"}，以及下方较小的艺术家名称 {argument name="artist name" default="朱内 愛"}。保持文字与专业音乐封面艺术的融合感，不要添加额外的标志、边框、曲目列表或水印。

titleLocalized.zh: 日语 AI 研讨会传单

templates.prompt: Create a soft, elegant Japanese-style online seminar flyer using REFERENCE_0 as the speaker's photo, featuring a warm beige/pink watercolor stationery style. Maintain consistency in the speaker's hairstyle, clothing, earrings, and anonymized face mask; crop and place this image on the left side of the flyer, extending/generating their upper body so they are smiling at the audience, with one arm raised pointing to the event information on the right. Add delicate botanical line art, light-colored washi tape texture, a thin decorative border, polka dots, and pale pink/gold highlights to a creamy white background. Design the flyer as a vertical event announcement, including the following separate areas: a large top heading, a right-side event information card, an event theme bar, an organizer/speaker bar, and three bottom information cards. Visible text that needs to be included: Top title: "ChatGPT Images 2.0で" and main title "AI portrait generation を楽しく学ぼう!" Near the speaker: "ChatGPT Images 2.0でAI portrait generation を极めよう", "Beginner's explanation of さん向け・やさしく", "AI portrait Generate が楽になる人へ. and a speech bubble "private がナビゲートします♪" Ichiro に楽しく学びましょう! ” The event information card on the right is marked “EVENT INFO” and contains “POINT 01", date/time "5/9 (Sat) 22:00~", "オンライン开奖", "リアルタイムParticipate without any information", and a small speech bubble "Ye no time に、おうちで気軽にParticipate できます♪" The event theme bar is marked "EVENT THEME": "ChatGPT Images 2.0 ったやさしいIntroduction to AI portrait generation" The organizer bar: the left circle "Maintenance·Admission", the middle "かなまる× "おじぎねこ", the subtitle "Explanation of the Beginner's Chat GPT Images 2.0 AI portrait generation", and the speech bubble on the right "Hasta no Fang でも Peace of mind!やさしく丁宁にお伝えしますね. " 3 cards at the bottom: Card 1 is marked "FOR BEGINNERS / POINT 02 / こんな方に" and contains 3 list items "AI portrait generation が気になる人", "Beginner", "発信material を为りたい人" and the bubble "ひとつでもWhen てはまればOK!"; Card 2 is marked "POINT / POINT 03 / Participate in するとわかること" and contains 3 points "ChatGPT Images 2.0 Basics", "Image Generation の楽しさ", "発信 Materials へのutilization イメージ" and bubbles "Tomorrow's から使えるヒントが见つかります♪"; Card 3 is marked "ENTRY / POINT 04 / Shen込method", including "Peatixイベントページから神込み" The text includes a speech bubble “お申し込みはとっても简単です♪”, footer notes “※Participation URL・アーカイブ・特分条件はPeatixで要确认”, “※事前予約特分あり”, and the final call to action “Details・お申し込みはPeatixへ”. The typography should be refined and airy, combining elegant Japanese Mincho serif text with the handwritten “ChatGPT Images 2.0” font. Please use…{argument name="event date and time" default="Saturday, May 9th, 10:00 PM"} ,{argument name="main headline" default="Let's have fun learning about AI image generation!"} ,{argument name="presenter names" default="かなまる × おじぎねこ"} ,{argument name="event platform" default="Peatix"} as well as{argument name="theme text" default="A Gentle Introduction to AI Image Generation Using ChatGPT Images 2.0"} .

promptLocalized.zh:
以 REFERENCE_0 作为演讲者照片，制作一张采用暖米色/粉色水彩文具风格的柔和、优雅的日式在线研讨会传单。保持演讲者的发型、服装、耳环和匿名化面部遮挡的一致性，将其裁剪并放置在传单左侧，延伸/生成其上半身，使其面带微笑看向观众，一只手臂抬起指向右侧的活动信息。在米白色背景上添加精致的植物线条艺术、浅色和纸胶带纹理、纤细的装饰边框、圆点装饰以及淡粉色/金色的高光。

将传单设计为垂直的活动公告，包含以下独立的区域：1 个顶部大标题区、1 个右侧活动信息卡片、1 个活动主题条、1 个主办方/演讲者条以及 3 个底部信息卡片。

需要包含的可见文字：
顶部标题：“ChatGPT Images 2.0で” 以及主标题 “AI画像生成を楽しく学ぼう！”
演讲者附近：“ChatGPT Images 2.0でAI画像生成を極めよう”、“初心者さん向け・やさしく解説”、“AI画像生成が気になる人へ。手を動かしながら、基本と楽しさを学べるオンラインイベント。” 以及一个对话气泡 “私がナビゲートします♪ 一緒に楽しく学びましょう！”
右侧活动信息卡片标注为 “EVENT INFO”，包含 “POINT 01”、日期/时间 “5/9（土）22:00〜”、“オンライン開催”、“リアルタイム参加無料”，以及一个小对话气泡 “夜の時間に、おうちで気軽に参加できます♪”
活动主题条标注为 “EVENT THEME”：“ChatGPT Images 2.0を使った やさしいAI画像生成入門”
主办方条：左侧圆形 “主催・登壇”、中间 “かなまる × おじぎねこ”、副标题 “初心者向けにChatGPT Images 2.0での AI画像生成の使い方をやさしく解説”、右侧对话气泡 “初めての方でも安心！やさしく丁寧にお伝えしますね。”
底部 3 个卡片：卡片 1 标注为 “FOR BEGINNERS / POINT 02 / こんな方に”，包含 3 个清单项 “AI画像生成が気になる人”、“初心者”、“発信素材を作りたい人” 以及气泡 “ひとつでも当てはまればOK!”；卡片 2 标注为 “POINT / POINT 03 / 参加するとわかること”，包含 3 个要点 “ChatGPT Images 2.0の基本”、“画像生成の楽しさ”、“発信素材への活用イメージ” 以及气泡 “明日から使えるヒントが見つかります♪”；卡片 3 标注为 “ENTRY / POINT 04 / 申込方法”，包含 “Peatixイベントページから申し込み” 以及气泡 “お申し込みはとっても簡単です♪”
页脚备注：“※参加URL・アーカイブ・特典条件はPeatixで要確認”、“※事前予約特典あり”，以及最终行动号召 “詳細・お申し込みはPeatixへ”。

排版设计需精炼且具有空气感，将优雅的日式明朝体衬线文字与 “ChatGPT Images 2.0” 的手写体相结合。请使用 {argument name="event date and time" default="5/9（土）22:00〜"}、{argument name="main headline" default="AI画像生成を楽しく学ぼう！"}、{argument name="presenter names" default="かなまる × おじぎねこ"}、{argument name="event platform" default="Peatix"} 以及 {argument name="theme text" default="ChatGPT Images 2.0を使った やさしいAI画像生成入門"}。

templates.title: Bag Check Lifestyle Infographic

titleLocalized.zh: Bag Check 生活方式信息图

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the base for the portrait/hairstyle/clothing, transform it into a lifestyle magazine-style infographic poster in soft beige tones. Extend the portrait into a full-body standing pose: she carries a neutral-colored tote bag over one shoulder, one hand in her pocket, and wears a coordinated cream/white business casual outfit; keep the face anonymous/slightly blurred, consistent with the reference image. Create an elegant scrapbook layout on a cream-white background, incorporating blush pink washi tape, small hearts, botanical doodles, paper textures, and handwritten serif/cursive fonts. Add a main title.{argument name="headline text" default="bag check"} and subtitle{argument name="subtitle text" default="daily things"} Add a picture named on the right.{argument name="section title" default="What’s in my bag?"} Create a cardboard box with 14 neatly labeled everyday essentials: 1. Storage bag, 2. Handkerchief, 3. Perfume, 4. Lip product, 5. Pressed powder, 6. Wallet, 7. Notebook, 8. Fountain pen, 9. Smartphone, 10. Snacks, 11. Card holder, 12. Keys, 13. Headphones, 14. Hand cream. Add a large beige tote bag in the bottom right corner with the name, and two small lifestyle illustrations in the bottom left and right corners: a photo of a café and a photo of a desk/coffee shop. Add a list titled "Today's Outfit" with five checked items: jacket, cardigan, trousers, bag, and heels. Use a minimalist Japanese/Korean café aesthetic in cream, taupe, beige, light pink, and warm gray, maintaining airy spacing and sophisticated typography. The poster should be a long, vertical format, suitable for use as a social media workshop/sample image.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 作为人物/发型/服装的基础，将其转换为柔和米色调的生活方式杂志风格信息图海报。将肖像延伸为全身站立姿势：她单肩背着一个中性色托特包，一只手插在裤兜里，身着协调的奶油色/白色商务休闲装；保持面部匿名/轻微模糊，与参考图一致。在米白色背景上创建优雅的剪贴簿布局，加入腮红粉色胶带、小爱心、植物涂鸦、纸张纹理以及手写衬线/草书字体。添加主标题 {argument name="headline text" default="bag check"} 和副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="daily things"}。在右侧添加一张名为 {argument name="section title" default="What’s in my bag?"} 的纸卡，并整齐排列 14 件带标签的日常必需品：1 收纳袋，2 手帕，3 香水，4 唇部产品，5 粉饼，6 钱包，7 笔记本，8 钢笔，9 智能手机，10 零食，11 卡包，12 钥匙，13 耳机，14 护手霜。在右下角加入一个大型米色托特包并标注名称，同时在左下角和右下角各加入 2 张小型生活方式插图：一张咖啡馆照片和一张书桌/咖啡照片。添加一个标题为“today’s outfit”的清单，包含 5 个已勾选项目：夹克、针织衫、裤子、包、高跟鞋。采用奶油色、灰褐色、米色、淡粉色和暖灰色的极简日韩咖啡馆审美配色，保持空气感间距和精致的编辑排版。海报需为长竖版，适合作为社交媒体研讨会/样图使用。

templates.title: Realistic style Japanese track and field athletes

titleLocalized.zh: 写实风格日本田径运动员

templates.prompt: Create a hyperrealistic vertical motion photograph with an adult as the subject.{argument name="athlete nationality" default="Japan"} The female track and field sprinter is depicted on an outdoor stadium track, framed from mid-thigh to above her head using a close-up portrait composition. She is in a pre-race crouching position, leaning forward with arms outstretched, her shoulders and upper body prominent. She wears a dark blue or black two-piece racing suit, consisting of a sleeveless cropped top and matching racing shorts, with thin red and white trim on the hips. A white race bib is pinned to her chest, displaying the sponsor's name in red Japanese and her race number clearly visible.{argument name="bib number" default="15-2"} The upper chest features a small white Mizuno-style logo. Her{argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown"} Long hair tied in a low ponytail, with a few strands shimmering in the sunlight. A simple rectangular privacy blur mask or solid skin tone block is added to the center of the face (from forehead to chin), while maintaining the realistic texture of the ears, hairline, neck, shoulders, and body. The background is a sunny athletic field with a red track and white lane lines, and the spectators and stands in the distance are rendered with a soft blue-gray blur effect. Natural light is used, with strong backlighting on the hair and shoulders, shallow depth of field, realistic skin texture, authentic sports photography compression, high detail, and a realistic professional photography style. It is not an illustration, not an anime, and there is no deliberate posing; there is no text except for the bib number.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超写实的竖构图运动照片，主角为一名成年 {argument name="athlete nationality" default="日本"} 女性田径短跑运动员，场景位于户外体育场跑道上，取景范围从大腿中部到头部上方，采用近景肖像构图。她正处于赛前蹲踞姿势，身体前倾，双臂向下伸展，肩膀和上半身突出，身穿深蓝色或黑色两件套竞赛服，包括无袖短款上衣和配套竞赛短裤，臀部有红白细边装饰。胸前别着一块白色比赛号码布，上面印有红色日文赞助商文字和清晰可见的参赛号码 {argument name="bib number" default="15-2"}，上胸部印有小巧的白色 Mizuno 风格标志。她的 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 长发扎成低马尾，有几缕发丝在阳光下闪烁。在面部中心位置（从额头到下巴）添加一个简单的矩形隐私模糊遮罩或实色肤色块，同时保持耳朵、发际线、颈部、肩膀和身体的真实质感。背景为阳光明媚的田径场，有红色跑道、白色跑道线，远处的观众和看台呈现为柔和的蓝灰色虚化效果。使用自然光，头发和肩膀处有强烈的逆光效果，浅景深，真实的皮肤纹理，地道的体育摄影镜头压缩感，高细节，写实专业摄影风格，非插画，非动漫，无刻意摆拍，除号码布外无任何文字。

templates.prompt: Create a Japanese{argument name="city title" default="HAKODATE"} The retro travel poster features a tall, vertical composition against a background of slightly grainy, faded ink and warm tones of brown, charcoal gray, brick red, and light gray on distressed cream paper. At the very top is a large, simple, geometric Art Deco font, displaying…{argument name="city title" default="HAKODATE"} Add a thin-lined subtitle below, with the content as follows:{argument name="subtitle text" default="THE PORT CITY AT THE FOOT OF MT. HAKODATE"} A small anchor icon is placed centered directly below the main illustration. The main illustration is an extremely detailed pen-and-ink watercolor cityscape, viewed from below along the tram tracks, overlooking Hakodate Bay and the towering, rugged mountains with small antennas in the distance. The image should include a classic red-cream tram in the center of the tracks, cars on the road, overhead power lines, old-fashioned streetlights, traffic lights, a pedestrian crossing crowded with pedestrians, and cyclists waiting on the zebra crossing on the right. The streets are dotted with historic Japanese shops and vertical signs, including clearly visible signs for "Hakodate Morning Market," "Hakodate Beer Hall," "Kitanobanya," "Motomachi Park," "Red Brick Warehouse," and "Hakodate Station," appropriately blending English and Japanese style signage. Three prominent pedestrians are added to the foreground: a woman in a light-colored skirt on the left, a student or office worker in a dark suit on the middle left, and a female student in a pleated skirt on the middle right; a male pedestrian and a cyclist on the far right are added to the right, for a total of five figures. Art Deco-style text is added to the bottom edge.{argument name="country text" default="JAPAN"} And accompanied by smaller location text{argument name="location text" default="Hakodate and Hokkaido"} and{argument name="romanized location" default="HAKODATE, HOKKAIDO"} The central section is separated by a small red dot and thin decorative lines. The overall style should evoke the refined feel of a 1930s Japanese railway travel poster, combining precise architectural lines, realistic perspective, a nostalgic atmosphere, and clear, easy-to-read typography.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张日本 {argument name="city title" default="HAKODATE"} 的复古旅游海报，采用高大的竖构图，背景为带有细微颗粒感、褪色墨迹以及柔和棕褐色、炭灰色、砖红色和浅灰色的暖色调陈旧奶油纸。在最上方放置巨大的、简洁的几何装饰艺术风格字体，书写 {argument name="city title" default="HAKODATE"}；下方添加一行细线副标题，内容为 {argument name="subtitle text" default="THE PORT CITY AT THE FOOT OF MT. HAKODATE"}，并在正下方居中放置一个小巧的锚图标。主体插画是一幅极其细腻的钢笔淡彩城市街景，视角沿电车轨道向下俯瞰，远眺函馆湾及远处山顶带有小型天线的高耸崎岖山脉。画面需包含一辆位于轨道中央的经典红奶油色电车、路上的汽车、架空电线、老式路灯、交通信号灯、挤满行人的人行道，以及右侧斑马线上等待的骑行者。街道两侧点缀着历史悠久的日本店面和竖排招牌，包括清晰可见的“函馆朝市”、“函馆啤酒馆”、“北之番屋”、“元町公园”、“红砖仓库”和“函馆站”等招牌，并适当融合英文与日式风格的标识。在前景处添加三位醒目的过马路行人：左侧一位穿浅色裙子的女性、中左侧一位穿深色西装的学生或上班族、以及中侧一位穿百褶裙的女学生；右侧再增加一名步行男子和一名最右侧的骑行者，总计五个人物。在底部边缘，添加居中的装饰艺术风格文字 {argument name="country text" default="JAPAN"}，并配以较小的地点文字 {argument name="location text" default="函馆・北海道"} 和 {argument name="romanized location" default="HAKODATE, HOKKAIDO"}，中间以小红点和细装饰线分隔。整体风格应呈现出 1930 年代精致的日本铁路旅游海报质感，结合精准的建筑线条艺术、写实的透视效果、怀旧的氛围以及清晰易读的排版。

templates.prompt: Create a retro-style travel poster for Japan, with the theme of{argument name="destination city" default="Hakodate, Japan"} The background uses warm-toned, old beige paper with subtle creases, stains, and worn edges. The composition is vertically centered and includes three main text elements: a striking, bold black Japanese title at the top.{argument name="Japanese headline text" default="Hakodate"} Below is a Romanized title with wider letter spacing.{argument name="romanized title" default="HAKODATE"} The bottom contains explanatory text located between two thin red horizontal lines.{argument name="bottom caption" default="Japan / Hakodate, Japan"} Below the title, a detailed street scene in a retro line drawing style is depicted, using soft beige and black ink with restrained red accents: a straight city street with tram tracks extends into the distance in one-point perspective, flanked by low-rise Japanese-style shops with vertical shop signs, lanterns, awnings, overhead power lines, traffic lights, red mailboxes, bicycles, pedestrians, and two moving vehicles. In the background, a broad brown mountain peak stands behind the town, topped with a tall observation tower and a smaller red tower, representing the landscape of Mount Hakodate. The design employs clean architectural pen lines, minimalist flat colors, a nostalgic Showa-era graphic design style, travel guide poster aesthetics, a clean centered layout, and does not strive for photorealistic perfection.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张复古风格的日本旅行海报，主题为 {argument name="destination city" default="日本函馆"}，背景采用带有细微折痕、污渍和磨损边缘的暖色调旧米色纸张。构图采用垂直居中布局，包含三个主要文本元素：顶部为醒目的黑色粗体日文标题 {argument name="Japanese headline text" default="函馆"}，下方为字母间距较宽的罗马拼音标题 {argument name="romanized title" default="HAKODATE"}，底部为位于两条细红横线之间的说明文字 {argument name="bottom caption" default="日本 / HAKODATE, JAPAN"}。在标题下方，绘制一幅复古线条风格的详细街景，采用柔和的米色、黑色墨水以及克制的红色点缀：一条带有电车轨道的笔直城市街道，以一点透视法向远方延伸，两侧是带有竖向店招、灯笼、遮阳篷、架空电线、交通信号灯、红色邮筒、自行车、行人和两辆行驶车辆的低矮日式店面。背景处描绘一座宽阔的棕色山峰矗立在城镇后方，山顶设有高大的观景塔和一座较小的红色塔楼，以此呈现函馆山风貌。采用清晰的建筑钢笔线条、极简的平涂色彩、昭和时代的怀旧平面设计风格、旅行指南海报美学、整洁的居中布局，且不追求照片级真实感。

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic, semi-realistic 3D anime-style close-up of Japanese mahjong tiles, displayed on a dark green velvet tabletop.{argument name="winning hand" default="Daisangen"} The image features 14 neatly arranged ivory mahjong tiles, extending to the right from a shallow depth-of-field perspective. A discarded tile, placed flat and slightly tilted, displays the red "中" character, revealing its warm brown side. The mahjong tiles are made of glossy, rounded ceramic with beveled edges and subtle wear, creating soft shadows illuminated by dramatic, warm-toned lighting from the upper right. The background is simple and blurred, with green velvet covering the frame. Shot from a low angle, the image possesses a realistic depth-of-field effect, creating an atmospheric mahjong anime setting. The image contains no figures, hands, labels, or UI elements, and no additional tiles besides the 15 visible tiles.

templates.title: Dark fantasy paper-cut style: Knights and demons

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑奇幻剪纸风格：骑士与恶魔

templates.prompt: Create a highly dramatic, vertically composed, dark fantasy illustration using an extremely intricate Japanese paper-cut silhouette style, like black kirie lace cut out on a warm parchment background. The foreground of the scene features a {argument name="character type" default="blonde female knight in armor"} Her upper body was visible, slightly leaning to the left. She wore ornately carved plate armor adorned with densely curled filigree, floral and vine patterns, and tiny openwork designs, complemented by layered shoulder armor, gauntlets, breastplate, belt plates, and a sword hilt at her waist. Her long {argument name="hair color" default="Light gold"} Her hair flew wildly to the right, forming many thin ribbons, outlined with light-colored negative space and black ink lines. Behind her swirled a massive {argument name="monster type" default="Shadow Demon"} It possesses a skull-like, eyeless head, a sinister smile, and long, slender claws. Its body is entirely composed of tangled black vines, smoky tendrils, thorny curls, and lace-like gaps, embracing or threatening her from behind. The entire image is edged with swirling black decorative tendrils and delicate paper-cut holes. The high contrast between black ink and dark brown cream paper creates a Gothic atmosphere of horror, Baroque details, hand-cut paper textures, sharp silhouettes, and dense lines, with no other colors besides black and warm beige. A flat, opaque surface is placed at the center of the knight's face.{argument name="censor square color" default="Beige"} A square obscures her facial features while leaving her hair and armor visible. Employing a compact portrait composition, with cinematic lighting through the paper, it is exquisitely detailed, a blend of beauty and eeriness, devoid of text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张极具戏剧性的竖构图暗黑奇幻插画，采用极其复杂的日式剪纸剪影风格，如同在温暖的羊皮纸背景上剪出的黑色 kirie 蕾丝。场景前景展示了一位 {argument name="character type" default="金发盔甲女骑士"}，大腿以上出镜，身体微向左侧，身穿饰有密集卷曲花丝、花卉蔓藤纹样、微小镂空图案的华丽雕花板甲，配有层叠的肩甲、护手、胸甲、腰带板以及腰间的剑柄。她长长的 {argument name="hair color" default="浅金色"} 头发向右狂乱飘散，呈现为许多细长的丝带状，以浅色负空间和黑色墨线勾勒。在她身后盘旋着巨大的 {argument name="monster type" default="阴影恶魔"}，拥有骷髅般的无眼头颅、邪恶的笑容、细长的利爪，身体完全由纠缠的黑色藤蔓、烟雾卷须、带刺的卷曲纹和蕾丝般的空隙组成，从背后拥抱或威胁着她。整个画面边缘布满了盘旋的黑色装饰性卷须和精致的剪纸孔洞，黑色墨水与深褐色奶油色纸张形成高对比度，营造出哥特式恐怖氛围、巴洛克细节、手工剪纸质感、锐利的剪影、密集的线条，除黑色和暖米色外无其他色彩。在骑士面部中心放置一个平坦不透明的 {argument name="censor square color" default="米色"} 方块，遮住她的面部特征，同时保留头发和盔甲可见。采用紧凑的肖像构图，透过纸张的电影级光效，超精细，美感与不祥并存，无文字。

templates.title: Anime Girl Stairwell Composite

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫少女楼道合成

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image as a background, composite a full-body anime-style girl onto the hallway platform. Place her on the right side, below the window and fluorescent light, near the existing "4/3" mark on the wall. She should be {argument name="character type" default="A shy schoolgirl"} Keep it{argument name="hair style" default="Light brown short wavy pigtails"} Wearing{argument name="outfit" default="A dark gothic Lolita-style shirt and a printed mini skirt, paired with black over-the-knee socks."} and wear{argument name="accessory" default="Round-framed glasses"} She was shown standing with her feet together, hands clasped in front of her, looking slightly shy towards the camera. The perspective, proportions, shadows, and warm backlighting from the windows and fluorescent lights were adjusted to make her appear as if she were naturally photographed in the space. The stairwell architecture, handrails, windows, wall switches, tactile paving, and the "4/3" lettering on the wall were preserved, and the final image was given a soft, cinematic, anime-style composite with a slight haze and gentle contrast.

promptLocalized.zh: 以提供的参考图作为背景，将一名全身动漫风格少女合成至楼道平台。将她放置在窗户和日光灯下方的右侧，位于墙上现有“4/3”标记附近。她应该是 {argument name="character type" default="一位害羞的学龄少女"}，留着 {argument name="hair style" default="浅棕色短波浪双马尾"}，穿着 {argument name="outfit" default="深色哥特萝莉风衬衫和印花短裙，搭配黑色过膝袜"} 并佩戴 {argument name="accessory" default="圆框眼镜"}。让她双脚并拢站立，双手交叠在身前，表情略带羞涩，看向镜头方向。调整透视、比例、阴影以及来自窗户和日光灯的暖色背光，使她看起来像是自然拍摄于该空间中。保留楼道建筑、扶手、窗户、墙壁开关、盲道以及墙上的“4/3”文字，并为最终图像赋予柔和的电影感动漫合成风格，带有轻微的雾气和柔和的对比度。
