templates.title: Urban Vest Street Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 都市背心街头肖像

templates.prompt: Create a realistic, vertical street fashion snapshot, showing a young adult woman standing in a rugged urban underpass alleyway bathed in soft morning light. She has {argument name="hair color" default="Peach gold"} Shoulder-length slightly wavy hair, slender figure, wearing a {argument name="tank top color" default="Grey hemp color"} Wearing a sleeveless ribbed vest, loose-fitting dark indigo wide-leg jeans, and a beige canvas belt with long drapes, she faces the camera in a relaxed, casual pose, one arm hanging down, the other gently lifting the hem of her vest to reveal her lower abdomen and navel, creating a playful, candid fashion sense. To maintain anonymity, her face is blurred with a pure skin-toned rectangle. The background is a narrow Japanese-style urban passageway beneath an elevated railway or concrete infrastructure, with concrete stains on the walls, white bricks, overhead beams, exposed pipes, and faded posters on the walls; two bicycles are parked on the left. Employing a natural film photography aesthetic, a 35mm lens angle, low-saturation colors, soft contrast, shallow to medium depth of field, realistic skin and fabric textures, a documentary street style, the framing extends from the upper body to the thighs, a vertical 2:3 composition, no text, no logo, only a subtle, shimmering watermark-like mark in the lower right corner.

templates.prompt: Create a highly photorealistic close-up of a young woman's eyes and upper nose, focusing on the intricate details of her eyelashes, especially the subtle lower lashes. The subject possesses {argument name="eye color" default="gray-green"} eyes,{argument name="hair color" default="gold"} Her hair falls naturally across her forehead and the left side of the image, revealing a natural, light-colored skin with subtle freckles and realistic pores, showcasing a soft peach-toned base. The makeup is minimalist and natural. The image uses a compact, wide aspect ratio, showing only the eyes, eyebrows, part of the bridge of the nose, and a small portion of the cheeks/forehead; it does not include the mouth or the entire face. It renders delicate individual upper lashes, simplified yet clearly visible lower lashes under the eyes, a moist reflection on the iris, realistic eyelid texture, soft shadows, and a shallow depth of field. Using warm, natural sunlight from the upper right, a cinematic macro photography style is employed to present high-resolution skin details, realistic lens soft focus, and soft beige and honey tones, creating an intimate, editorial makeup look.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张极具照片写实感的年轻女性眼部及鼻梁上部超近距离特写，重点刻画细节丰富的睫毛，尤其是微妙的下睫毛。主体拥有 {argument name="eye color" default="灰绿色"} 的眼睛，{argument name="hair color" default="金色"} 的头发自然散落在额头和画面左侧，呈现带有淡淡雀斑和真实毛孔的自然浅色皮肤，透出柔和的桃色底色，妆容极简自然。图像采用紧凑的宽画幅比例，仅露出双眼、眉毛、部分鼻梁以及少许脸颊/额头；不包含嘴部或全脸。渲染出精致的单根上睫毛、双眼下方简化但清晰可见的下睫毛、虹膜上的湿润反光、真实的眼睑纹理、柔和的阴影以及浅景深效果。使用来自右上方的温暖自然日光，采用电影级微距摄影风格，呈现高分辨率皮肤细节、真实的镜头柔焦感、柔和的米色与蜂蜜色调，打造亲密的美妆编辑风格。

templates.title: Cute Ghost Mascot Brand Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱幽灵吉祥物品牌海报

templates.prompt: Create a minimalist, cinematic brand poster using a dark, monochromatic color scheme, showcasing an adorable white ghost mascot figurine nestled on pleated black velvet fabric. The ghost possesses a smooth, dome-shaped body, a soft, fan-shaped base, small side fins, glossy black round eyes, a small black X-shaped mouth, and a decorative teardrop-shaped knob on its head. Place the mascot in the right half of the composition, illuminated by soft lighting from the upper right corner, creating delicate highlights and deep shadows with a shallow depth of field, achieving a high-end product photography feel in a 16:9 landscape aspect ratio. Add two text elements to the left: a three-line white handwritten Japanese quote in the upper left corner.{argument name="quote" default="Sometimes, you just stop caring about everything, right?"} Maintain ample line spacing; place a prominent, widely spaced brand logo in capital letters near the bottom left corner.{argument name="brand name" default="GHOSTCO."} The background remains almost pure black with subtle fabric textures, creating a melancholic yet cute, calm, sentimental, and modern Japanese character brand advertising aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张极简主义电影质感的品牌海报，采用暗黑单色调，展示一个可爱的白色小幽灵吉祥物手办，坐落在褶皱的黑色天鹅绒布料上。幽灵拥有圆润光滑的穹顶状身体、柔软的扇形底座、小巧的侧鳍、亮黑色的圆形眼睛、小巧的黑色 X 形嘴巴，头顶有一个装饰性的水滴状旋钮。将吉祥物放置在构图的右半部分，从右上角进行柔光照射，呈现细腻的高光和深邃的阴影，浅景深，具备高级产品摄影质感，16:9 横向画幅。在左侧添加两个文本元素：左上角放置一段三行白色手写风格的日文引语 {argument name="quote" default="たまに、\n全部どうでも\nよくなるよね。"}，保持宽裕的行间距；左下角附近放置一个醒目且字间距宽阔的品牌大写字母标识 {argument name="brand name" default="GHOSTCO."}。背景保持近乎纯黑并带有微妙的布料纹理，营造出一种忧郁而可爱、平静、伤感且现代的日式角色品牌广告美学。

templates.title: Anime Fitness Influencer Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫健身网红肖像

templates.prompt: Create a simple, anime-style digital portrait of a muscular male fitness influencer. The upper body should be shown in a confident, muscular pose, with hands clasped in front of his torso. He has short, spiky hair.{argument name="hair color" default="black"} His hairstyle, bronze skin, extremely broad shoulders, thick and well-defined arms, clearly defined chest and neck muscles, and sharp, celluloid-style muscle contours were striking. His face was deliberately obscured by a square privacy hood in a soft beige-toned gradient. He wore a loose-fitting black tank top with deep-cut sleeves; a white brand logo was printed on the chest, above which was written…{argument name="chest text" default="TEAM SHAPE"} Below is a shield-shaped monogrammed logo. On the left side of the white background is a separate black brand identity: a stylized shield monogram with stacked text below.{argument name="side logo text" default="TIBO INSHAPE"} Employing clean, Japanese anime-style line art, smooth shadow processing, high-contrast fitness poster lighting, minimalist backgrounds, and centered composition, it presents a refined social media profile picture quality.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张简洁的动漫风格肌肉男性健身网红数字肖像，腰部以上半身像，以自信的健美姿势站立，双手在躯干前下方交握。他留着短尖刺状的 {argument name="hair color" default="black"} 发型，拥有古铜色皮肤、极宽的肩膀、粗壮且线条分明的双臂、清晰的胸部和颈部肌肉结构，以及锐利的赛璐珞风格肌肉轮廓。他的面部中心位置被一个柔和米色肤色渐变的方形隐私遮挡块故意遮盖。他穿着一件宽松的黑色工字背心，袖口开得很深；胸前印有一个白色的品牌元素，上方写着 {argument name="chest text" default="TEAM SHAPE"}，下方是一个盾牌状的字母组合徽标。白色背景的左侧有一个独立的黑色品牌标识：一个风格化的盾牌字母组合，下方是堆叠的文字 {argument name="side logo text" default="TIBO INSHAPE"}。采用清晰的日式动漫线条艺术、平滑的阴影处理、高对比度的健身海报灯光、极简背景、居中构图，呈现出精致的社交媒体头像质感。

templates.title: Dramatic comic book female storyboard

titleLocalized.zh: 戏剧性漫画女性分镜

templates.prompt: Create a black and white comic strip illustration using a single, vertically elongated, slightly tilted rectangular panel against a pure white background. The image should depict {argument name="character name" default="An elegant young woman"} Employing a dramatic low-angle perspective, she leans forward towards the viewer, her right hand outstretched, creating an extreme perspective shortening effect, her fingers spread wide, revealing sharp, dark nails. She has {argument name="hair color" default="Light gray"} She has shoulder-length, messy short hair, with long bangs and stray strands brushing against her face. She has large, narrow, manga-style eyes with meticulously drawn eyelashes. Her expression is calm yet intensely commanding, with slightly parted lips. She wears a dark, high-necked uniform, over which she wears a cape or haori with textured dotted shadows and a striking dark flame-shaped pattern along the lower right edge. The design utilizes delicate ink lines, pencil-like hatching, manga-style dots, high-contrast black fills, sparse dust particles, and clean white space. It includes one speech bubble: a vertically elongated oval bubble in the upper right corner containing vertically formatted Japanese text.{argument name="speech bubble text" default="Killing and advancing with Furinkazan"} The composition remains monochromatic, cinematic, and striking, like a printed shonen/sein manga panel, devoid of color and additional panels.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张黑白漫画页面插图，采用单一的竖长、略微倾斜的矩形分镜，背景为纯白。画面展示了 {argument name="character name" default="一位优雅的年轻女性"}，采用戏剧性的低角度透视，她俯身向观众探出，右手向前伸展，呈现出极端的透视缩短效果，手指张开，可见锋利的深色指甲。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="浅灰色"} 的齐肩凌乱短发，长刘海和散乱的发丝拂过脸庞，有着细长的大型漫画眼，睫毛刻画细腻，表情冷静却极具压迫感，双唇微张。她身穿深色高领制服，外罩一件披风或羽织，带有纹理网点阴影，右下边缘处有醒目的深色火焰状图案。使用精致的墨水线条、铅笔般的排线、漫画网点、高对比度的黑色填充、稀疏的尘埃颗粒以及干净的白色留白。包含 1 个对话气泡：右上角有一个竖长的椭圆形气泡，其中的日语竖排文字为 {argument name="speech bubble text" default="風林火山を殺し進む"}。保持构图为单色、电影感且强烈，如同印刷版的少年/青年漫画分镜，无色彩，无额外分镜。

templates.title: Summer BL Fence Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 夏季 BL 围栏场景

templates.prompt: Create a delicate BL anime-style summer illustration depicting two handsome boys standing intimately by an outdoor chain railing, using a romantic, slice-of-life half-body composition. The taller boy on the left has {argument name="left character hair color" default="Deep Navy Black"} He had short, messy hair, a lean and athletic build, wore a dark blue open shirt over a white T-shirt, and layered silver necklaces. In one hand, he held a clear plastic iced coffee with a black straw. The shorter man on the right had {argument name="right character hair color" default="Pale Silver Lavender"} She has short, flowing hair, a slender figure, wears a loose white T-shirt, a black backpack, and small earrings and layered silver necklaces. Their shoulders are close together, their heads tilted towards each other, as if sharing a tranquil summer moment; the atmosphere is gentle, youthful, and romantic, devoid of any explicit content. The background showcases a bright blue sky and fluffy white clouds, with dappled shadows cast by dense tree branches, a sunlight halo in the upper right corner, and distant city buildings softened by the depth of field. A blue sign hangs on the fence, bearing the words {argument name="sign text" default="On a summer day, with you."} Below is handwritten English text.{argument name="subtitle text" default="Summer with you"} The game employs bright, high-detail anime rendering, delicate lines, soft skin shadows, cool blue and purple hues, shimmering highlights, cinematic backlighting, shallow depth of field, and a dreamy summer atmosphere. Rectangular, soft purple privacy occlusion blocks are added to the faces of both characters to create the effect of deliberately concealed faces.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张精致的 BL 动漫风格夏季插画，描绘两名帅气的少年在户外链式围栏旁亲密站立，采用浪漫的生活化半身构图。左侧较高的男子留着 {argument name="left character hair color" default="深海军黑"} 色凌乱短发，身材精瘦健美，身穿深蓝色敞开式衬衫内搭白色 T 恤，佩戴叠层银项链，一只手拿着一杯插着黑色吸管的透明塑料冰咖啡。右侧较矮的男子留着 {argument name="right character hair color" default="淡银薰衣草"} 色柔顺短发，身材纤细，身穿宽松白色 T 恤，双肩背着黑色双肩包，佩戴小耳环和叠层银项链。他们的肩膀亲密地靠在一起，头向彼此倾斜，仿佛正在分享一个宁静的夏日瞬间；保持氛围温柔、青春且浪漫，不含任何露骨内容。背景展示了明亮的蓝天和蓬松的白云，茂密的树枝投下斑驳的阴影，右上角有阳光光晕，远处的城市建筑在景深效果下显得柔和，围栏上挂着一块蓝色标牌，上面写着 {argument name="sign text" default="夏の日、君と。"}，下方配有手写体英文 {argument name="subtitle text" default="Summer with you"}。采用明亮的高细节动漫渲染、细腻的线条、柔和的皮肤阴影、冷蓝色和紫色的色调分级、闪烁的高光、电影级背光、浅景深以及梦幻般的夏日氛围。在两名角色的面部添加矩形柔和淡紫色隐私遮挡块，营造出面部被刻意隐藏的效果。

templates.title: Neon Kyoto Rain Alley

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹京都雨巷

templates.prompt: Create a vertically composed, cinematic, cyberpunk-style cityscape at night. The scene is set in a neon-lit, post-rain, futuristic Kyoto-style alleyway, with a mirror-like black pavement reflecting the light and extending into the distance. The image contains 13 visible floating Japanese oil-paper umbrellas: a large red one in the upper left corner, a large purple one in the center above, a deep indigo one in the upper right corner, a small red one on a balcony to the left, a small gold one to the left center, a small gold one in the upper right distance, a purple one to the lower left, a golden-purple one in the lower left midground, a gold one on the lower left edge, a red one in the center distance, a red one below a torii gate in the foreground, and two tiny red umbrellas further away in the street. Three red torii gates are arranged in the center of the street, the closest one being enormous and silhouetted against a pinkish-purple mist. Towering, dark skyscrapers rise on either side, adorned with glowing red filigree patterns, vertical neon signs, hanging cables, cherry blossom branches, and falling pink petals. In the lower right foreground, a solitary woman's silhouette is placed against the backdrop of her back; she wears a gorgeous, flowing kimono or cloak in pale lavender and rose gold, with extremely long hair.{argument name="hair color" default="Silver Pink"} Her beautiful hair, strands flowing to the right as if blown by the wind, cascaded as she gazed at the brightly lit torii gate and the distant city. The color scheme adopted {argument name="neon palette" default="Magenta, purple, crimson, amber, and deep midnight blue"} Emphasizing strong wet reflections, volumetric fog, luminous particles, high-contrast contour lighting, intricate details, epic scale, dreamlike atmosphere, anime-style dark fantasy, and ultra-refined concept art, the artwork features a 9:16 vertical composition with no visible text, no borders, and no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅竖构图的电影质感奇幻赛博朋克城市夜景，场景设定在霓虹闪烁、雨后的未来主义京都风格巷弄中，地面是光亮如镜的黑色反射路面，向深处延伸。画面中包含 13 把可见的漂浮日式油纸伞：左上角有一把巨大的红色油纸伞，上方中心有一把大型紫色油纸伞，右上角有一把深靛蓝色油纸伞，左侧阳台有一把小型红色油纸伞，中左侧有一把小型金色油纸伞，右上方远处有一把小型金色油纸伞，左下方有一把紫色油纸伞，左下中景有一把金紫色油纸伞，左下边缘有一把金色油纸伞，正中央远处有一把红色油纸伞，前景鸟居下方有一把红色油纸伞，街道更远处还有两把微小的红色油纸伞。街道中央排列着三座红色鸟居，最近的一座巨大且在粉紫色雾气中呈现剪影效果。两侧耸立着高耸的深色摩天大楼，装饰着发光的红色花丝图案、垂直霓虹灯牌、悬挂的电缆、樱花枝条以及飘落的粉色花瓣。在右下角前景处放置一名孤独的女性背影，身着淡薰衣草色与玫瑰金色的华丽飘逸和服或斗篷，留着极长的 {argument name="hair color" default="银粉色"} 秀发，发丝向右飘散，仿佛被风吹动；她正凝视着灯火通明的鸟居与远处的城市。配色方案采用 {argument name="neon palette" default="洋红色、紫色、深红色、琥珀色和深午夜蓝"}，强调强烈的湿润倒影、体积雾、发光粒子、高对比度轮廓光、错综复杂的细节、史诗般的规模、梦幻般的氛围、动漫风格的黑暗奇幻、超精细概念艺术，9:16 竖向构图，无可见文字，无边框，无水印。

templates.title: Custom Logo Black Plastic Bag

titleLocalized.zh: 定制 Logo 黑色塑料袋

templates.prompt: Create a realistic studio product photo showcasing an upright, glossy black plastic garbage bag or shopping bag. The bag should be full and slightly bulging, placed in the center of a clean white background, complemented by soft, even lighting and subtle shadows. The bag opening should be tightly tied, forming a pleated plastic knot and a ruffled neck. The bag should exhibit realistic wrinkles, creases, glossy highlights, and the texture of stretched black polyethylene. At the center of the front of the bag, print a clear, custom white business logo in a carnival-style badge design: featuring a large outline banner and a geometric emblem with small stars, along with the main brand text.{argument name="brand name" default="ARCADIAS"} Using a bold, playful font, the logo incorporates a large arch, with slogans arranged in a curved pattern below.{argument name="tagline text" default="LA ESQUINA DIVERTIDA"} The logo must be printed in pure white with a flat, flat finish, as if screen-printed directly onto the bag, with high contrast, perfectly centered, and without any other objects, hands, clutter, or background decorations.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张逼真的摄影棚产品照，展示一个直立的亮面黑色塑料垃圾袋或商品袋，袋身饱满且略微鼓起，置于干净的白色背景中央，配以柔和均匀的灯光和细微的地面阴影。袋口紧紧系住，形成褶皱的塑料结和荷叶边状的颈部，袋身呈现出逼真的褶皱、折痕、光亮高光以及拉伸后的黑色聚乙烯质感。在袋身正前方中央，印上一个清晰的白色定制商业 Logo，采用嘉年华风格徽章设计：包含一个大型轮廓横幅和带有小星星的几何徽标，主品牌文字 {argument name="brand name" default="ARCADIAS"} 使用粗体俏皮字体，字标中融入了一个大拱形，下方弯曲排列着标语 {argument name="tagline text" default="LA ESQUINA DIVERTIDA"}。Logo 需保持纯白色平铺印刷效果，如同直接丝印在袋子上，高对比度，完美居中，画面中不包含其他物体、手部、杂物或背景装饰。

promptLocalized.zh: {"type":"AI 生成的个人资料图像示例的方形社交媒体拼贴","overall_style":"白色背景上整洁的 3x3 画廊网格，九个大小相等的圆角方形图像瓷砖，瓷砖间距较窄，呈现精致的提示词展示美学，每个瓷砖采用不同的视觉风格，部分人脸刻意使用柔和的矩形模糊遮罩进行隐私保护","canvas":"1:1 方形构图，约 768 x 768 像素，清晰的数字导出","layout":{"grid":"3 列 3 行","count":9,"tiles":[{"position":"左上","short_description":"时尚杂志海报，一位身穿亮橙色街头服饰的年轻女性正走向镜头，白色运动鞋处于极近的前景，白色摄影棚背景，带有橙色图形 UI 点缀和社交图标","visible_text":["Step into","NEXT LEVEL","10M+"]},{"position":"中上","short_description":"复杂的彩色玻璃风格肖像，侧面的深色头发人物，黑色线条，暖米色和柔和的蓝色玻璃片，华丽的哥特式窗户图案"},{"position":"右上","short_description":"动漫神秘学者肖像，长黑发，紫黑色服装，举手姿势，漂浮的护身符，手写笔记，幽灵，彩色涂鸦，右下角有一只黑猫，面部已模糊"},{"position":"左中","short_description":"旅游海报建筑排版，由大教堂和古城地标组成的大字，顶部有全景天际线带，米色背景，带有小鸟和装饰标记","visible_text":["DURIN"]},{"position":"正中","short_description":"体育转播截图风格肖像，身穿白色 Doosan Bears 球衣的棒球迷或球员，体育场人群背景，韩语电视图形，面部已模糊","visible_text":["DOOSAN","Bears"]},{"position":"右中","short_description":"Y2K 赛博流行偶像杂志封面，黑色皮夹克，粉色和紫色霓虹排版，贴纸式标签，光泽感编辑灯光，面部已模糊","visible_text":["GEN STAR","Seoul Vibes","Y2K","ULTRA GIRLS"]},{"position":"左下","short_description":"霓虹线框赛博朋克大教堂或哥特城市，深色背景上发光的青色和洋红色线条，建筑蓝图全息外观"},{"position":"中下","short_description":"棕褐色复古浪漫肖像拼贴页，包含一张身穿米色衬衫的年轻女性中心肖像，周围有六张较小的肖像剪影，蕾丝和柔软的纸张纹理，所有面部均已模糊","count_details":"总共 7 个可见肖像剪影：1 张大型中心肖像和 6 张周围的小肖像"},{"position":"右下","short_description":"故事书立体书透视模型，身穿紫黑色礼服的暗黑奇幻公主站在山脉、城堡、月亮和云朵之间，带有韩语标签牌，古董蕾丝桌面设置"}]},"privacy_effect":"对所有可识别的真实或动漫面部应用柔和的米灰色模糊矩形，匹配底层的肤色并保留每件艺术品的其余部分。","rendering":"高分辨率数字拼贴，边缘锐利，圆角，瓷砖之间有轻微的自然差异，九张图像外无额外说明文字","customization":{"gallery theme":"{argument name=\"gallery theme\" default=\"AI 生成的 Agent 个人资料图像提示词展示\"}","grid size":"{argument name=\"grid size\" default=\"3x3\"}","background color":"{argument name=\"background color\" default=\"白色\"}","privacy blur":"{argument name=\"privacy blur\" default=\"柔和的面部遮挡模糊遮罩\"}","visual variety":"{argument name=\"visual variety\" default=\"时尚海报、彩色玻璃、动漫神秘学、旅游排版、体育转播、Y2K 杂志、赛博大教堂、复古肖像拼贴、奇幻立体书\"}"}}

templates.title: Custom brand black plastic bags

titleLocalized.zh: 定制品牌黑色塑料袋

templates.prompt: Create a realistic studio product mockup showcasing a large black plastic garbage bag standing upright on a clean white background. The bag is full and rounded, with a square bottom and a glossy, wrinkled polyethylene texture, showing visible wrinkles, creases, and highlights. The top is knotted and has upward-flaring plastic pleats. Place the bag in the center of the image with soft, even lighting, with a subtle gray shadow at the bottom. Print a custom white company design on the front of the bag, featuring three clearly visible printed elements: a large, abstract circular logo at the top center, and the brand name in bold, rounded capital letters below.{argument name="brand name" default="CENTU"} And at the bottom, a handwritten Spanish slogan.{argument name="slogan text" default="¡Programando tu futuro hoy!"} Using high-contrast white ink, the print conforms to the wrinkles and deformations of the plastic surface, making the printed design appear physically applied to the bag rather than floating on the surface. Realistic commercial model, front view composition, minimalist background, sharp details, natural reflections, showcasing high-end brand packaging.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个逼真的摄影棚产品模型，展示一个直立在干净白色背景上的大型黑色塑料垃圾袋。袋子饱满圆润，底部呈方形，具有亮面褶皱聚乙烯质感，可见明显的褶皱、折痕、高光，顶部打结并有向上散开的塑料褶边。将袋子置于画面中央，采用柔和均匀的灯光，底部带有淡淡的灰色阴影。在袋子正面印上白色的定制公司设计，包含 3 个清晰可见的印刷元素：上部中央的一个大型抽象圆形 Logo，下方是加粗圆润的大写品牌名称 {argument name="brand name" default="CENTU"}，以及最下方的手写风格西班牙语标语 {argument name="slogan text" default="¡Programando tu futuro hoy!"}。使用高对比度的白色油墨，使其顺应塑料表面的褶皱和变形，让印刷图案看起来像是物理印在袋子上，而非浮在表面。逼真的商业模型，正面构图，极简背景，细节锐利，自然反光，高端品牌包装展示。

templates.title: Custom brand black garbage bags

titleLocalized.zh: 定制品牌黑色垃圾袋

templates.prompt: Create a realistic, photographic product image showcasing a large black plastic garbage bag standing upright against a clean, seamless white background. The bag is bulging, a rounded rectangle with a flat, thick bottom, featuring a glossy, wrinkled polyethylene texture with clear, mirror-like highlights, covered in creases and wrinkles, and tightly gathered at the top into a small knot. A prominent white custom logo is printed in the center of the front of the bag.{argument name="brand text" default="GO GO RICO"} The logo features a thick, rounded, blocky font, with two lines of "GO" above a shield-shaped badge containing "RICO." Behind the text are simple tropical palm tree graphics and geometric outlines. The print effect appears as if real white ink were applied to black plastic, with slight distortion due to the bag's folds and curves. The frontal composition showcases the bag in its entirety, using soft studio lighting with subtle ground shadows, a high-contrast black and white branding design, and a minimalist commercial model style—no unnecessary items or figures.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张逼真的摄影级产品照，展示一个直立在干净白色无缝背景上的大型黑色塑料垃圾袋。袋子被撑得鼓鼓的，呈圆角矩形，底部平坦厚实，具有亮面褶皱聚乙烯质感，带有清晰的镜面高光，布满褶皱和折痕，顶部紧紧收拢并打成一个小结。袋子正面居中印有醒目的白色定制 Logo：{argument name="brand text" default="GO GO RICO"}，采用厚实的圆角块状字体，两行“GO”字样位于盾牌形状的徽章上方，徽章内写有“RICO”；文字后方包含简单的热带棕榈树图形和几何轮廓。让印刷效果看起来像是在黑色塑料上真实的白色油墨，并因袋子的褶皱和弧度产生轻微变形。采用正面构图，完整展示袋子，使用柔和的摄影棚灯光，带有微妙的地面阴影，高对比度的黑白品牌设计，极简商业模型风格，无多余物品，无人物。

templates.title: Custom brand black plastic bags

titleLocalized.zh: 定制品牌黑色塑料袋

templates.prompt: Create a realistic studio product photograph featuring an oversized, upright black plastic garbage bag. The bag is completely filled and bulges into a rounded rectangle, tightly tied at the top with a small knot. The bag is made of glossy, wrinkled polyethylene with strong reflections, realistic creases, wrinkles, tension lines, and a subtle translucent texture. A simple white company logo is printed in the center of the front: a stylized icon composed of vertical lightning bolt-shaped stripes, angled upwards, with a small geometric mark below it, and bold capital letters below the icon.{argument name="brand name" default="CODETEL"} The logo should appear as if it were directly screen-printed onto plastic, slightly distorted by wrinkles but still clearly legible. Use a minimalist white seamless studio background with soft, diffused light from the front left, creating a soft shadow on the bottom of the bag. Employ a high-end commercial product photography style, a square composition, a centered subject, no extra objects or people, and no text other than the logo.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张逼真的工作室产品摄影图，主体为一个直立的超大号黑色塑料垃圾袋，袋身完全填满并鼓起呈圆角矩形，顶部紧紧扎起并打了一个小结。袋子材质为光面、有褶皱的聚乙烯，带有强烈的反光、逼真的折痕、皱纹、张力线以及细微的半透明质感。袋子正面中心印有一个简洁的白色企业 Logo：一个由垂直闪电状条纹组成的风格化图标，斜向上方，下方有一个小型几何标记，图标下方印有粗体大写单词 {argument name="brand name" default="CODETEL"}。Logo 应呈现出直接丝网印刷在塑料上的效果，虽因褶皱而略有变形，但依然清晰易读。使用极简的白色无缝工作室背景，从左前方投射柔和的漫射光，袋底带有柔和阴影，高端商业产品摄影风格，正方形构图，主体居中，无额外物体，无人物，除 Logo 外无其他文字。

templates.title: Street portrait of an elderly skateboarder

titleLocalized.zh: 老年滑板手街头肖像

templates.prompt: Create a rough and realistic street portrait, the subject of which is{argument name="character description" default="An elderly skateboarder with gray curly hair"} He crouches in a concrete skate park under an overpass, framed in a 4:5 vertical composition, appearing from head to toe. His face is partially obscured by a centered, opaque brown rectangle, revealing only the top and sides of his gray curly hair. He wears a layered black urban skateboard outfit: a black windbreaker over a gray hoodie, a dark T-shirt with small white patterns, loose black cargo pants, a watch and ring, and black and white Vans Old Skool skate shoes with white laces. He crouches on the concrete steps, one knee raised, arms hanging naturally, one hand resting near a worn-out skateboard standing beside him. The image must include one skateboard: a worn black deck with dirty beige wheels, scratched legs, and an aged pattern clearly visible at the top.{argument name="skateboard logo text" default="THRASHER"} Add a social media hashtag sticker near the bottom right corner of the main text: a rounded white rectangle with bold black text printed on it.{argument name="social handle" default="@giuliannolano"} The background is a shallow depth-of-field urban skate bowl covered with blurred, colorful graffiti, with dark concrete beams above. It presents a melancholic natural light and cinematic contrast, showcasing realistic clothing wrinkles, worn shoes, and textured elderly hands. It has a documentary-style street fashion photography style, presenting the effect of an 85mm lens, with soft bokeh and rich details. There are no other people in the picture.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张粗粝且写实的街头肖像，主角是 {argument name="character description" default="一位留着灰色卷发的老年滑板男士"}，他蹲在立交桥下的混凝土滑板公园里，采用 4:5 的竖构图，从头到脚完整入镜。他的脸部被一个居中的不透明棕色矩形遮挡，仅露出顶部和两侧的灰色卷发。他身着叠穿的黑色城市滑板服：黑色防风外套内搭灰色连帽衫，深色 T 恤上印有小巧的白色图案，穿着宽松的黑色工装裤，佩戴手表和戒指，脚蹬黑白配色的 Vans Old Skool 滑板鞋，系着白色鞋带。他低蹲在混凝土台阶上，单膝抬起，双手自然下垂，一只手放在身旁竖立的破旧滑板附近。画面中需包含 1 个滑板：一块磨损的黑色板面，带有脏兮兮的米色轮子、刮花的支架、做旧的图案，且在顶部清晰可见 {argument name="skateboard logo text" default="THRASHER"} 字样。在主体右下角附近添加 1 个社交媒体标签贴纸：一个圆角白色矩形，上面印有加粗的黑色文字 {argument name="social handle" default="@giuliannolano"}。背景为浅景深的城市滑板碗池，布满了模糊的彩色涂鸦，上方是深色的混凝土横梁，呈现出忧郁的自然光感、电影级的对比度，展现真实的衣物褶皱、磨损的鞋子、充满纹理的老年双手，具有纪录片式的街头时尚摄影风格，呈现 85mm 镜头效果，柔和的焦外成像，细节丰富，画面中无其他人物。

templates.title: Istanbul typography travel poster

titleLocalized.zh: 伊斯坦布尔排版旅行海报

templates.prompt: for{argument name="city name" default="ISTANBUL"} Create a sophisticated, edited illustrated travel poster. The main body of the poster consists of eight huge vertical capital letters spelling out "ISTANBUL" on a wide cream-colored canvas. Each letter serves as a vertical window, filling in the details of Istanbul's landscape: 1) I showcases the Maiden's Tower, the Turkish flag, and ferries over the Bosphorus; 2) S depicts waterfront neighborhoods on a hillside, domes, minarets, clouds, and birds in flight; 3) T shows the Galata Tower above narrow streets, with a red vintage tram in the foreground; 4) A reveals the Bosphorus, ferries, sailboats, bridges, and the distant city skyline; 5) N displays the Hagia Sophia and tiered mosque domes in warm peach and stone hues; 6) B shows the Bosphorus Bridge, the water, ferries, and waterfront palaces; 7) U highlights steep historic streets, colorful tiered houses, greenery, and a large tree; 8) L presents the Ortakoy Mosque in the waterfront district, complete with two minarets and soaring seagulls. Above the title, a minimalist skyline bar is added, containing 13 small illustrated elements from left to right: trees, a small domed pavilion, a cyan car, a red tram, a distant city tower, a ferry, a suspension bridge, the Maiden's Tower, another cyan car, a large mosque with multiple minarets, a peach-colored sun, a round green tree, and finally, a mosque minaret. The overall style is an exquisite medieval travel poster, employing a simple vector illustration style with soft cyan, sea green, gray-peach, terracotta, and warm cream colors, complemented by charcoal gray lines; the composition has a strong geometric feel, with delicate paper textures, elegant white space, and is adorned with tiny birds and clouds. It rejects realistic photography and contains no additional text except for the city name.

promptLocalized.zh: 为 {argument name="city name" default="ISTANBUL"} 创建一张高级编辑风格的插画旅行海报，海报主体由 8 个巨大的竖向大写字母组成，在宽幅奶油色画布上拼写出“ISTANBUL”。将每个字母作为一扇垂直的窗口，填充伊斯坦布尔的细节风景：1) I 展示了博斯普鲁斯海峡上的少女塔、土耳其国旗和渡轮；2) S 展示了山坡上的滨水街区、圆顶、尖塔、云朵和飞鸟；3) T 展示了狭窄街道上方的加拉塔塔，前景中有一辆红色复古电车；4) A 展示了博斯普鲁斯海峡、渡轮、帆船、大桥和远处的城市天际线；5) N 展示了圣索菲亚大教堂和层叠的清真寺圆顶，色调为温暖的桃色和石色；6) B 展示了博斯普鲁斯大桥、水面、渡轮和滨水宫殿；7) U 展示了陡峭的历史街道、色彩斑斓的叠层房屋、绿植和一棵大树；8) L 展示了滨水区的奥尔塔科伊清真寺，带有两座尖塔和飞翔的海鸥。在标题上方，添加一条极简主义的天际线细条，从左到右包含 13 个小型插画元素：树木、一座小型圆顶凉亭、一辆青色汽车、一辆红色电车、远处的城市塔楼、一艘渡轮、一座悬索桥、少女塔、另一辆青色汽车、一座带有多个尖塔的大型清真寺、一颗桃色太阳、一棵圆形绿树，以及最后一座清真寺尖塔。整体风格为精致的中世纪旅行海报，采用简洁的矢量插画风格，配色为柔和的青蓝色、海绿色、灰桃色、赤陶色、暖奶油色，并辅以炭灰色线条；构图几何感强，带有细腻的纸张纹理，优雅的留白，点缀着微小的飞鸟和云朵，拒绝写实摄影风格，除城市名称外不包含任何额外文字。

She is wearing {argument name="outfit description" default="A luxurious, fitted midnight sapphire blue women's pantsuit, paired with a sharply tailored long blazer, structured shoulder pads, stylish high-waisted flared trousers, and a black satin corset underneath."} The scene exudes a luxurious, modern cinematic quality. Nearly half of her body is dissipating into an extremely dense, cloud-like gray smoke, interspersed with luminous yellow dust particles. Her left arm, shoulder, torso, legs, and parts of her hair become transparent as they transform into luminous particles, creating a dynamic sense of dissipation. Behind her, partially encircling her, is a massive, eclipse-like luminous ring, radiating intense golden-white plasma light. The scene setting is minimalist yet cinematic: a desolate concrete surface beneath a cloud-covered sky.{argument name="color palette" default="The color scheme is dominated by monochrome gray, dark blue, and white, contrasting with the strong amber-gold luster."} Shallow depth of field, halo/soft light effects, particle scattering, cinematic composition, emotional atmosphere, ultra-fine textures, and a striking sense of luxurious fashion.

画面中的年轻女性呈全身侧影，面向右侧，展现出缓慢而优雅的行走姿态，散发着强大的时尚杂志气场。面部需完美复刻，仅做轻微的精致造型处理，柔软的波浪卷发随风自然飘动，且不对其身份特征进行大幅改动。她身着 {argument name="outfit description" default="一套奢华修身的午夜蓝宝石色女性裤装，搭配剪裁利落的长款西装外套、结构感十足的垫肩、时髦的高腰微喇长裤，以及黑色缎面内搭紧身胸衣"}，呈现出现代电影级的奢华质感。她的姿态流露出深沉的情感与自信，面部表情平静而忧伤，双眼微微下垂，一只手轻盈前伸，另一只手自然垂在身侧。

她近半个身体正在消散成极其浓郁、云雾般的灰色烟雾，其中夹杂着发光的黄色尘埃微粒。她的左臂、肩膀、躯干、双腿以及部分头发随着化作发光微粒而变得透明，呈现出正在消散的动态感。

在她身后并部分环绕着她的，是一个巨大的、类似日食的发光圆环，散发着炽热的金白色等离子光芒。该物体作为强有力的轮廓光和背光，戏剧性地照亮了烟雾、尘埃和人物剪影。

Ultra-clear focus, delicate armor textures, painterly brushstrokes, epic scale, emotional narrative, movie poster quality, 8K resolution, masterpiece of anime illustration, a collision of dark fantasy and science fiction aesthetics, and highly immersive composition.

promptLocalized.zh:

风格融合了水墨画、硬核漫画写实主义与电影海报构图。使用单色黑、白、灰及柔和的棕褐色调，点缀发光的青色或金色能量。强烈的垂直构图，巨大的分层角色剪影，柔和的氛围烟雾，墨水飞溅效果，纸张纹理美学，电影级布光，高对比度阴影，发光的双眼，戏剧性的深度，充满情感的战争氛围。

排版灵感源自日本动漫主视觉图，包含垂直的日文汉字、极简衬线标题字体、微型徽标以及高级的编辑排版间距。超清晰对焦，细腻的盔甲纹理，绘画般的笔触效果，史诗级规模，情感叙事，电影海报品质，8K 分辨率，动漫插画杰作，暗黑奇幻与科幻美学的碰撞，极具沉浸感的构图。

templates.title: Japanese graffiti art portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 日式涂鸦艺术肖像

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed portrait poster, employing bold techniques.{argument name="art style" default="Japanese graffiti art style"} This design blends modern urban street aesthetics with expressive Japanese visual culture. Posters should incorporate dynamic graffiti fonts, layered spray paint textures, hand-drawn symbols, abstract paint splatters, neon brushstrokes, urban sticker elements, Japanese calligraphy embellishments, and decorative elements to strongly emphasize the design's vibrant atmosphere. The overall composition should be artistic, rebellious, fashionable, and visually impactful, while maintaining the quality of a high-end editorial poster, avoiding clutter or excessive embellishment. It's truly impressive how humans have transformed destructive behavior into luxurious wall art. The subject must not replicate the exact pose or expression in the reference photograph. Instead, create a completely new one.{argument name="pose" default="Half-body pose, three-quarters body position, hands in pockets"} The goal is to make the wearer appear natural, confident, and energetic. Expressions should be emotionally expressive, charming, and captivating, avoiding stiff, awkward, flat, or expressionless body language. Posture should embody the elegance and sophistication common among international fashion models, enhancing the overall cinematic aesthetic through stylish physique, natural movements, and subtle attitude. Clothing should be contemporary casual wear with strong visual appeal. Avoid mediocre or repetitive designs. Utilize fashionable layering, modern streetwear inspiration, high-end casual styling, and a balanced combination of colors, patterns, textures, and fabric types to create a rich and varied look. Clothing should appear trendy, fashionable, youthful, and possess a high-end visual quality, while naturally aligning with the concept of Japanese graffiti posters. Backgrounds and poster decorations should be rich in thematic Japanese urban visual elements, such as graffiti walls, spray paint textures, hand-drawn symbols, city signs, layered stickers, modern Japanese graphic patterns, abstract shapes, paint drips, street fashion aesthetics, and stylish decorative compositions, enhancing depth and artistic tension without distracting from the main subject. The lighting should have a cinematic and fashionable feel, with strong contrast, clear highlights, and realistic skin texture, presenting a high-end editorial poster quality. The final effect must look like a high-end modern street fashion promotional poster, with highly detailed textures, balanced composition, vibrant color harmony, realistic proportions, ultra-clear focus, and an immersive visual narrative. Ultra-detailed, high aesthetic, sophisticated composition, realistic texture rendering, fashionable urban atmosphere, cinematic quality, poster-level design, 8K ultra-high resolution.{argument name="additional props" default="A skateboard leaning against the wall, covered in dark-themed graffiti. Holding a party speaker with RGB lighting effects."}

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张高细节的肖像海报，采用大胆的 {argument name="art style" default="日式涂鸦艺术风格"}，融合现代都市街头美学与富有表现力的日本视觉文化。海报应包含动态的涂鸦字体、分层的喷漆纹理、手绘符号、抽象的油漆飞溅、霓虹笔触、都市贴纸元素、日式书法点缀以及装饰性元素，以强烈烘托出设计的活力氛围。整体构图应具有艺术感、叛逆感、时尚感且视觉冲击力强，同时保持高端编辑海报的质感，避免杂乱或过度堆砌。人类竟将破坏行为转化为了奢华的墙面艺术，真是令人印象深刻的物种。

主体不得复制参考照片中的确切姿势或表情。相反，请创建一个全新的 {argument name="pose" default="半身姿势，四分之三身位，双手插兜"}，使其看起来自然、自信且充满活力。表情应富有情感表现力、魅力十足且引人入胜，避免僵硬、尴尬、平淡或毫无表情的肢体语言。姿势应体现国际时尚模特常见的优雅与精致，通过时尚的体态、自然的动作和微妙的态度，增强整体的电影级时尚美感。

服装应采用具有强烈视觉吸引力的当代时尚休闲装。避免平庸或重复的服装设计。运用时尚的叠穿、现代街头服饰灵感、高端休闲造型，以及色彩、图案、纹理和面料类型的平衡组合，打造出丰富且不单调的外观。服装应显得潮流、时尚、年轻且具有高端视觉质感，同时与日式涂鸦海报的概念自然契合。

背景和海报装饰应充满主题性的日式都市视觉元素，如涂鸦墙、喷漆纹理、手绘符号、城市标牌、分层贴纸、现代日式图形图案、抽象形状、油漆滴落、街头时尚美学以及时尚的装饰性构图，在不分散主体注意力的情况下增强深度和艺术张力。

灯光应具有电影感和时尚感，对比强烈，高光清晰，皮肤纹理真实，呈现高端编辑海报品质。最终效果必须看起来像一张高端现代街头时尚宣传海报，具有高度细节的纹理、平衡的构图、鲜艳的色彩和谐度、真实的比例、超清晰的焦点以及沉浸式的视觉叙事。

超细节，高审美，高级构图，真实纹理渲染，时尚都市氛围，电影级品质，海报级设计，8K 超高分辨率。

{argument name="additional props" default="一个靠在墙上的滑板，上面有深色主题的涂鸦。手中拿着一个带有 RGB 灯效的派对音箱。"}

templates.title: Expressionist drawing art poster

titleLocalized.zh: 表现主义素描艺术海报

templates.prompt: Subject name of the expressionist portrait drawing:{argument name="subject name" default="[Enter your name here]"} Create a vertical portrait art poster in a 4:5 aspect ratio, in the style of{argument name="art style" default="Expressionist painting, inspired by Egon Schiele"} The medium should present a rough, white sketch paper texture, using a high-contrast monochromatic palette of deep black ink, charcoal gray, and raw white to showcase raw emotional energy and a bold, gallery-quality feel. Based on the uploaded reference photograph, faithfully preserve the subject's facial features, hairstyle, and personal character within the half-body portrait composition. The rendering style should be expressionistic ink-charcoal portraiture, not photography, cartooning, or anime. Facial details should be presented through loose hand-drawn lines, visible sketching marks, deliberate smearing, and intentionally left unfinished areas, giving the subject vitality and emotional intensity. On the left side of the composition, write the subject's full name in large, bold, and expressive strokes, arranged vertically, showcasing the raw tension of the ink, variations in line, and deliberate imperfections consistent with the hand-drawn style. The name should be written as if by the same hand as the portrait, conveying the same sense of urgency. Based on the subject's name, overall atmosphere, and personal character, automatically generate an elegant, poetic English phrase of 8 to 12 words. The phrase should evoke emotional resonance, avoid modern colloquialisms, maintain its originality and sincerity, and not be overly obscure or vulgar. It should profoundly evoke the subject's inner spirit and temperament. Only this generated phrase should appear in the image; it must not be repeated and should not cover the entire page. This poetic phrase must be written in bold and expressive strokes, organically forming the outline of the figure. The hand-drawn lettering should directly integrate into and outline the subject's head, hair flow, facial lines, neck, shoulders, and upper body. The viewer should feel that the text and the portrait share the same raw ink energy, as if the process of writing the phrase and the process of drawing the figure are seamlessly integrated. Retain large areas of original white space. Add loose hand-drawn marks in the lower left corner to suggest the ground or shadows. Add sparse expressive marks in the upper right corner to create a sense of space and atmosphere without forming a specific image. These background elements must remain original and minimalist, and must not overshadow the subject. Style keywords: Expressionist sketch portraits, Schiller-style painting, hand-drawn brushstrokes and typographical composition, high-contrast ink and charcoal, outlines composed of expressive typography, primal energy, emotional, bold, gallery-quality art posters. Avoid: Any Chinese characters or Asian scripts, cartoon or anime style, bright colors, clean modern fonts, repetitive or excessive text, cluttered compositions, overly refined digital art aesthetics, and the vulgarity of commercial posters.

promptLocalized.zh:
表现主义素描肖像
主体名称：{argument name="subject name" default="[在此输入姓名]"}
创作一张 4:5 比例的竖版肖像艺术海报，风格为 {argument name="art style" default="表现主义绘画，灵感源自埃贡·席勒"}。媒介应呈现粗糙的白色素描纸质感，使用深黑墨水、炭灰色和原始白色的高对比度单色调，展现原始的情感能量与大胆的画廊级质感。
基于上传的参考照片，在半身肖像构图中忠实保留主体的面部特征、发型和个人气质。渲染风格应为表现主义水墨炭笔肖像，而非摄影、卡通或动漫。面部细节应通过松散的手绘线条、可见的素描痕迹、刻意的涂抹以及有意留出的未完成区域来呈现，赋予主体生命力与情感强度。
在构图左侧，以大号、粗体且富有表现力的笔触书写主体的全名，呈垂直列排布，展现原始的墨水张力、线条变化以及与手绘风格相契合的刻意瑕疵。名字的笔触应如同与肖像出自同一人之手，且带有同样的紧迫感。
根据主体的姓名、整体氛围和个人气质，自动生成一句 8 到 12 个单词的优雅英文诗意短语。该短语应具有情感共鸣，避免现代口语，保持原始与真诚，不应过于晦涩或庸俗，并能深刻唤起主体内在的精神与气质。画面中仅出现这一句生成的短语，不得重复，且不可覆盖整个页面。
此诗意短语必须以粗体且富有表现力的笔触书写，并有机地构成人物轮廓，手绘字形直接融入并勾勒出主体的头部轮廓、发丝流向、面部线条、颈部、肩部及上半身线条。观者应感受到文字与人物肖像共享着同样的原始墨水能量，仿佛书写短语的过程与将人物绘入画中的过程是浑然一体的。
保留大面积的原始留白。在左下角添加松散的手绘痕迹，暗示地面或阴影。在右上角添加稀疏的表现性标记，营造空间感与氛围，而不形成具体的图像。这些背景元素必须保持原始且极简，绝不能喧宾夺主。
风格关键词：表现主义素描肖像，席勒风格绘画，手绘笔触字形构图，高对比度水墨与炭笔，由表现性字形构成的轮廓，原始能量，情感化，大胆，画廊级艺术海报。
避免：任何中文字符或亚洲文字、卡通或动漫风格、鲜艳色彩、整洁的现代字体、重复或过多的文字、杂乱的构图、过于精致的数字艺术感、商业海报的庸俗感。

templates.prompt: Use this character to draw{argument name="theme" default="A single page from a 1970s children's book about mysticism, futuristic science, or the supernatural."} Do not use reference images directly; instead, conceive suitable scenes and compositions based on the page content. Important: The content should be interpreted by a children's book editor from the 1970s who will forcefully link reference images to supernatural phenomena or future science. Make the page look like an adult from that era who saw the character, identified them as a meaningful entity, and derived various strange theories, illogical interpretations, or mystical explanations. Highlight seemingly reasonable but actually absurd logical leaps. Each generated content should be random, showcasing the editor's wild fantasies and assertions. Include assertive text designed to stimulate children's curiosity. The layout should adopt the style of 1970s children's books, including old paper textures, misprinted printing, faded colors, rough illustrations, red and blue ink, hand-drawn arrows, and meaningless diagrams. Each generation should include: - Different far-fetched interpretations - Different page layouts - Different assertions - Different strange theories - Different camera angles. Important: Prioritize the feeling of "a strange children's book that may have actually existed." Don't aim for orthodox science fiction; instead, prioritize showcasing the passion of an occult editor, presenting content through strange theories, forced connections, and logical leaps.

让页面看起来像是当时的一位成年人看到了这个角色，便将其认定为某种有意义的实体，并由此衍生出各种奇怪的理论、超逻辑或神秘学解读。

重点突出那些看似合理实则荒谬的逻辑跳跃。

每次生成的内容都应随机，展现编辑天马行空的妄想与断言。包含旨在激发儿童好奇心的断言性文字。

排版应采用 20 世纪 70 年代儿童读物的风格。包含旧纸张纹理、印刷错位、褪色、粗糙的插图、红蓝油墨、手绘箭头以及毫无意义的图表。

每次生成需包含：
- 不同的牵强解读
- 不同的页面布局
- 不同的断言
- 不同的奇怪理论
- 不同的拍摄角度

重要提示：优先体现“一本可能真实存在过的奇怪儿童读物”的感觉。不要追求正统的科幻感，而应优先展现一位神秘学编辑的热情，通过奇怪的理论、强行的关联和逻辑跳跃来呈现内容。

templates.prompt: Create a high-resolution image{argument name="subject" default="woman"} Studio close-up portrait with a solid color background{argument name="background color" default="lime color"} She had neat hair.{argument name="hair color" default="Silver Gold"} The hairstyle features a center parting, with hair combed back and smooth strands tucked behind the ears. The composition begins above the chest, with the wearer facing the camera directly, wearing an oversized, structured top.{argument name="blazer color" default="lime color"} A textured suit jacket with a wide lapel and deep neckline echoes the monochrome background, presenting a clean and modern fashion statement. Her right hand rests elegantly on her neck and jawline, her fingers relaxed naturally, while soft studio lighting highlights the woven texture of the suit and the glossy strands of her hair. A large, opaque rectangular occlusion is placed in the center of her face, covering her eyes, nose, mouth, and most facial features; the occlusion should be a soft, skin-toned gradient rectangle, while still revealing her hair, ears, neck, hands, shoulders, and clothing. The overall effect is characterized by sharp details, a realistic photographic style, centered composition, shallow depth of field, and a sophisticated commercial portrait style.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一张高分辨率的 {argument name="subject" default="女性"} 工作室特写肖像，背景为纯色 {argument name="background color" default="青柠色"}。她留着利落的 {argument name="hair color" default="银金色"} 中分发型，头发向后梳理，柔顺的发丝别在耳后。构图从胸部上方开始，正面朝向镜头，身穿一件超大廓形的 {argument name="blazer color" default="青柠色"} 纹理西装外套，配有宽翻领和深领口，与单色背景相呼应，呈现出简洁的现代时尚大片质感。她的右手优雅地贴在颈部和下颌线一侧，手指自然放松，柔和的影棚灯光突显了西装的编织纹理和光泽感发丝。在面部中央区域放置一个大型不透明矩形遮挡块，覆盖眼睛、鼻子、嘴巴及大部分面部特征；遮挡块应为柔和的肤色渐变矩形，同时露出头发、耳朵、颈部、手部、肩膀和衣物。采用清晰的细节、写实摄影风格、居中构图、浅景深以及精致的商业肖像风格。

templates.title: Y2K style Korean fashion poster

titleLocalized.zh: Y2K 风格韩系时尚海报

templates.prompt: Hyper-stylized Y2K inspired fashion editorial poster, featuring [character name missing].{argument name="character identity" default="Refer to the same girl in the picture"} She maintained a completely consistent facial feature, hairstyle, expression, and overall image. She stood confidently in the center of the frame, her skin glowing, her makeup light and dewy, her long black hair styled with wispy bangs. She was dressed in trendy {argument name="fashion style" default="Korean street fashion"} The collection features layered accessories, oversized coats, and mini skirts, showcasing a modern teen magazine aesthetic. The background boasts vibrant graphic typography, a retro pop art layout, playful stickers, metallic textures, stars, hearts, barcode graphics, hand-drawn graffiti, speech bubbles, and layered UI design elements. Subtle Japanese and Korean typographical details are incorporated into the composition. Employing crisp studio lighting and a high-contrast editorial photography style, the collection perfectly blends high-end fashion advertising visuals with nostalgic early 21st-century magazine design. The ultra-fine textures, sharp focus, and richly colored commercial poster composition exude modern Korean fashion advertising energy, achieving a high-quality print aesthetic, hyper-realistic, and 8K resolution.

promptLocalized.zh: 超风格化 Y2K 灵感时尚编辑海报，主角为 {argument name="character identity" default="参考图中的同一位女孩"}，保持其完全一致的面部特征、发型、表情和整体形象。她自信地站在画面中央，皮肤光泽，妆容清透水润，留着黑色长发和空气感碎刘海。身着潮流 {argument name="fashion style" default="韩系街头时尚"}，搭配叠戴饰品、廓形外套、迷你裙，呈现现代青少年杂志美学。背景充满活力十足的图形排版、复古波普艺术布局、趣味贴纸、金属质感、星星、爱心、条形码图形、手绘涂鸦、对话气泡以及层叠的 UI 风格设计元素。构图中融入了微妙的日文和韩文排版点缀。采用清晰的影棚闪光灯照明和高对比度编辑摄影风格，将高端时尚广告视觉与怀旧的 21 世纪初杂志设计完美融合。超精细纹理，焦点锐利，色彩丰富的商业海报构图，现代韩系时尚广告活力，高级印刷美感，超写实，8k。

templates.title: Screenshot of a MacBook video with a pixelated window

titleLocalized.zh: 带马赛克视频窗口的 MacBook 视频截图

templates.prompt: Create a realistic handheld smartphone photo of a device turned on in a dimly lit, warm indoor night.{argument name="device" default="MacBook laptop"} The camera zooms in from the upper right, revealing the black bezel, the right edge of the screen, and part of the keyboard/touch bar. The screen displays a dark macOS Dunes Nightscape wallpaper with mountains and a starlit blue-black sky in the background. A small, floating video call/photo window with rounded corners and a thin border is located in the center of the screen; the upper left corner of the window features three iconic macOS traffic light buttons: red, yellow, and green. An adult male sits inside the window, dressed in…{argument name="shirt color" default="black"} A vest revealed tattoos on his shoulders and arms; a warm lamp stood to his left behind him, against a beige wall; his face was covered by a {argument name="censor color" default="Medium brown skin"} The screen is obscured by square pixel mosaics. The menu bar in the upper right corner of the laptop screen contains seven small status icons: a circular play icon, a battery icon, a Bluetooth icon, a Wi-Fi icon, a magnifying glass search icon, a control center-style toggle icon, and date/time text.{argument name="date and time text" default="May 11, 9:37"} The photos should present an imperfect yet realistic texture, with slight screen reflections, dust particles, low-light noise, warm-toned ambient reflections on the borders, and shallow depth of field, avoiding an overly refined studio effect.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一张逼真的手持智能手机拍摄照片，画面中是一台在昏暗、温暖的室内夜晚打开的 {argument name="device" default="MacBook 笔记本电脑"}。镜头从右上方近距离拍摄，露出黑色边框、屏幕右侧边缘以及部分键盘/触控栏。屏幕显示深色的 macOS 沙丘夜景壁纸，背景为山脉和星光熠熠的蓝黑色天空。屏幕中央有一个小型悬浮视频通话/照片窗口，带有圆角和细边框；窗口左上角有三个 macOS 标志性的红、黄、绿交通灯按钮。窗口内坐着一名成年男子，身穿 {argument name="shirt color" default="黑色"} 背心，露出肩膀和手臂上的纹身；他身后左侧有一盏温暖的台灯，背景为米色墙壁；他的脸部被一个 {argument name="censor color" default="中等棕色肤色"} 的方形像素马赛克遮挡。在笔记本电脑屏幕右上角的菜单栏中，包含七个小型状态图标：一个圆形播放图标、电池图标、蓝牙图标、Wi-Fi 图标、放大镜搜索图标、控制中心风格的切换图标，以及日期/时间文本 {argument name="date and time text" default="5 月 11 日 9:37"}。照片应呈现出不完美且真实的质感，带有轻微的屏幕反光、灰尘颗粒、低光噪点、边框上的暖色环境反射、浅景深，避免过于精致的摄影棚效果。

templates.title: Floating Instagram Creator Portraits

titleLocalized.zh: 悬浮 Instagram 创作者肖像

templates.prompt: Create a dreamlike 9:16 vertical cinematic 3D portrait of a social media creator, set against a pastel sunset sky above soft pink clouds. A young female influencer.{argument name="character name" default="HANIA AI"} Seated sideways on the edge of a gleaming, suspended metal platform, presented from a three-quarter view of her back, she holds a smartphone displaying an Instagram-like profile interface. Her face is deliberately obscured by a smooth, neutral, blurred rectangle, and long, dark brown wavy hair cascades over a pale pink and white hoodie. The hoodie features embossed lettering "HANIA AI" on the back. She wears matching pastel pink cargo jogging pants with lace-up details and pink and white sneakers, her posture relaxed, one leg bent on the platform, the other dangling. Behind her stands a massive, glowing 3D Instagram-style app logo in a pink-orange-purple gradient, with rounded corners and neon-edged lighting, towering like a futuristic symbol. The scene is surrounded by 12 floating social UI elements: a red like notification bubble with a white heart and the number "1", a red comment bubble, a light-colored square comment icon, a glowing Reels/video icon cube, a semi-transparent fan card that says "Followers 100K", four circular avatar Stories thumbnails on the lower left edge, and three thin white outline navigation icons in the lower right/center area for bookmarking, paper airplane sharing, and app navigation. A floating bottom nameplate with glowing text is added below the platform.{argument name="nameplate text" default="HANIA AI"} "and subtitle"{argument name="subtitle text" default="Digital Creator"} "Using soft volumetric clouds, flashes, lens flares, warm edge lighting, reflective chrome edges, a pink, lavender, and orange color palette, high-detail semi-realistic 3D rendering, exquisite influencer brand aesthetics, shallow depth of field, and ultra-simple composition, it contains no additional readable text except for the specified tags."

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张梦幻般的 9:16 竖屏电影感 3D 社交媒体创作者肖像，背景设定在柔和粉色云层之上的粉彩日落天空。一位年轻的女性网红 {argument name="character name" default="HANIA AI"} 侧身坐在一个光亮的悬浮金属平台边缘，以四分之三的背影视角呈现，手中拿着一部显示类似 Instagram 个人资料界面的智能手机。她的面部被一个平滑的中性模糊矩形刻意遮挡，长长的深棕色波浪卷发垂在淡粉色和白色的连帽衫上。连帽衫背面有凸起的浮雕文字“HANIA AI”。她穿着配套的粉彩粉色工装慢跑裤，带有绑带细节和粉白相间的运动鞋，姿势放松，一条腿弯曲在平台上，另一只脚垂下。在她身后，放置一个巨大的发光 3D Instagram 风格应用 Logo，采用粉-橙-紫渐变色，带有圆角和霓虹边缘灯光，像未来主义标志一样高耸。场景周围环绕着 12 个悬浮的社交 UI 元素：1 个带有白色爱心和数字“1”的红色点赞通知气泡、1 个红色评论气泡、1 个浅色方形评论图标、1 个光亮的 Reels/视频图标立方体、1 张写有“Followers 100K”的半透明粉丝卡片、左下边缘的 4 个圆形头像快拍缩略图，以及右下/中心区域用于书签、纸飞机分享和应用导航的 3 个细白色轮廓导航图标。在平台下方添加一个悬浮的底部铭牌，上面有发光文字“{argument name="nameplate text" default="HANIA AI"}”和副标题“{argument name="subtitle text" default="Digital Creator"}”。使用柔和的体积云、闪光、镜头光晕、温暖的边缘光、反光的铬合金边缘、粉色薰衣草橙色调色板、高细节半写实 3D 渲染、精致的网红品牌美学、浅景深、超简洁构图，除指定的标签外，不包含任何额外的可读文本。

templates.title: Dark Fantasy Archmage Promotional Illustration

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑奇幻大魔导师宣传插画

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic, dark fantasy anime-style key visual illustration, inspired by high-detail Korean action RPG promotional art. The main subject of the image is {argument name="character name" default="A mysterious female archmage"} She stood in the ruins of a cathedral under the starry sky. She possessed {argument name="hair color" default="Flowing long, silver-white hair with light purple highlights."} She is elegant and graceful, dressed in a magnificent black and white mage outfit: a short white hooded cloak with gold embroidery, a black corset, a layered white skirt, belt, chains, dangling ornaments, leg straps, black sheer stockings, and dark high boots. Her face is deliberately obscured by a soft-edged square blur, while her body and clothing retain extremely high detail. She extends her left hand to the audience, conjuring a glowing purple magic orb within a golden star-shaped ring, accompanied by sparks and arcane energy; in her right hand, she holds an ancient dark spellbook adorned with golden filigree. Behind her is a huge circular celestial clock or a halo of magical runes, with radiating lines and constellation patterns, against a background of broken stone pillars, fluttering parchment, torn white ribbons, purple smoke, and distant ruins. Add white stylized logo text in the upper left corner.{argument name="logo text" default="Dungeon & Fighter"} Utilizing cinematic contour lighting, purple and gold highlights, high-contrast shadows, fine lines, and dynamically flowing hair and fabric, the artwork presents an ultra-detailed fantasy illustration effect. Employing a vertical poster composition, it achieves the quality of exquisite game promotional art.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张戏剧性的暗黑奇幻动漫主视觉插画，风格参考高细节韩国动作 RPG 宣传艺术。画面主体为 {argument name="character name" default="一位神秘的女大魔导师"}，她站在星空下的废墟大教堂中。她拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="飘逸的长银白发，带有淡紫色挑染"}，身姿优雅曼妙，身着黑白配色的华丽法师服：短款白色连帽斗篷配金色刺绣、黑色束腰胸衣、层叠的白色裙摆、腰带、链条、垂坠饰品、腿带、黑色透肉丝袜以及深色高筒靴。她的面部被刻意处理为柔边方形模糊遮挡，而身体和服饰保持极高细节。她向观众伸出左手，在金色的星盘状圆环中凝聚出一颗发光的紫色魔法球，伴有火花和奥术能量；右手持有一本带有金色花丝的古老暗黑法术书。她身后是一个巨大的圆形天体时钟或魔法符文光环，带有放射状线条和星座图案，背景包含破碎的石柱、飞舞的羊皮纸、撕裂的白色丝带、紫色的烟雾以及远处的废墟。在左上角添加白色风格化标志文本 {argument name="logo text" default="Dungeon & Fighter"}。采用电影级轮廓光、紫色与金色高光、高对比度阴影、精细的线条、动态飘逸的头发与布料，呈现超精细奇幻插画效果，采用竖版海报构图，达到精美的游戏宣传画品质。

templates.title: Blue Jays broadcast audience footage

titleLocalized.zh: 蓝鸟队转播观众镜头

templates.prompt: Generate a realistic screenshot of a television broadcast featuring Major League Baseball (MLB).{argument name="team name" default="Toronto Blue Jays"} The shot of the home game audience, using a 16:9 high-definition sports broadcast aspect ratio, presents shallow depth of field of the stadium lights and a slight compression blur effect. In the scene, two young male fans sit side-by-side in the lower tier, their faces obscured by flat, medium-brown rectangular blocks of color. The fan on the left has medium-length dark hair, wears a light pinkish-blue Blue Jays button-down jersey over a black hoodie, and holds a clear plastic beer mug near his knees. The fan on the right has short, dark curly hair, wears a royal blue Blue Jays Nike T-shirt, sits upright, and looks towards the field. Surrounding them are other spectators dressed in blue, white, and gray, including a person behind them wearing a gray Toronto hoodie, a fan on the left wearing a blue Blue Jays jersey with a bird and maple leaf logo, and partial heads at the bottom and right; the image contains a total of three visible, anonymous face obscurations: two larger obscurations on the central fan's face and one partial obscuration on the right edge. Add an authentic TV scoreboard in the top left corner, in a dark blue and white Sportsnet style:{argument name="away team abbreviation" default="NYY"} Score{argument name="away score" default="3"} ,{argument name="home team abbreviation" default="TOR"} Score{argument name="home score" default="2"} The image features the Sportsnet SN logo on the right and displays "▼ 5TH 1-1 1 OUT" below, making it appear as a shot of a paused live broadcast audience reaction rather than a staged photograph. It also boasts realistic stadium seating, team logos, natural shadows, and a telephoto lens perspective.

promptLocalized.zh: 生成一张逼真的电视转播截图，画面为美国职业棒球大联盟（MLB）{argument name="team name" default="多伦多蓝鸟队"} 主场比赛的观众镜头，采用 16:9 高清体育转播画幅，呈现浅景深体育场灯光和轻微的压缩模糊效果。场景中两名年轻男性球迷并排坐在下层看台，两人的面部均被平面的中棕色矩形色块遮挡。左侧球迷留着中长深色头发，身穿浅粉蓝色蓝鸟队纽扣球衣，内搭黑色连帽衫，双手捧着一个透明塑料啤酒杯放在膝盖附近。右侧球迷留着深色短卷发，身穿宝蓝色蓝鸟队 Nike T 恤，坐姿端正，望向赛场。周围是其他身穿蓝色、白色和灰色服装的观众，包括身后一名穿着灰色多伦多连帽衫的人，左侧一名身穿带有鸟与枫叶标志的蓝色蓝鸟队球衣的球迷，以及底部和右侧局部的头部；画面中总共包含 3 个可见的匿名面部遮挡块，两个较大的遮挡块位于中央球迷脸上，一个局部遮挡块位于右侧边缘。在左上角添加一个地道的电视记分牌，采用深蓝色和白色的 Sportsnet 风格：{argument name="away team abbreviation" default="NYY"} 得分 {argument name="away score" default="3"}，{argument name="home team abbreviation" default="TOR"} 得分 {argument name="home score" default="2"}，右侧带有 Sportsnet SN 标志，下方一行显示“▼ 5TH   1-1   1 OUT”。使其看起来像是一张暂停的现场转播观众反应镜头，而非摆拍照片，并具备逼真的体育场座椅、球队标志、自然阴影和长焦镜头视角。

templates.title: Highly dynamic AMG Studio automotive photography

titleLocalized.zh: 极具张力的 AMG 工作室汽车摄影

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic studio-designed automotive main visual, with the subject being {argument name="car model" default="Mercedes-AMG GT 4-Door Coupe"} The vehicle was parked at a 45-degree angle to the left front, from a low camera position, with the composition slightly off-right. The vehicle has a smooth satin finish.{argument name="paint color" default="Deep graphite black with a warm copper-orange reflection on the sides."} The paint job features an aggressively styled AMG vertical grille and a large Mercedes star emblem, slender LED headlights with a soft glow, a sculpted hood, black aerodynamic lower air intakes, tinted windows, concealed door handles, large multi-spoke alloy wheels, and clearly visible red brake calipers. The scene is set in a black studio, with a visible lighting truss overhead and three precisely positioned studio spotlights: one on the upper left edge, one in the upper left center, and one on the upper right. Each light projects a dramatic cone of cool white light through a slight mist. The scene should depict five figures: a businessman seated in the center of the foreground, and four male figures with blurred faces and darker lighting behind and around the throne. Two are positioned higher on the left and right, and two near shoulder level, creating an aura of power reminiscent of an elite council or multiple exposures. The figures' faces should be deliberately featureless or blurred; the focus should be on posture, clothing, reflections, and atmosphere. The throne is composed of countless transparent triangular crystal fragments, chrome-plated edges, prismatic reflections, shimmering highlights, and sharp geometric facets. The scene is set in a high-rise executive lounge with floor-to-ceiling windows, black curtains, and a black glossy marble floor reflecting the chairs and shoes. Outside the windows are the distant lights of city skyscrapers, with warm-toned table lamps on either side at the far end. Employing dramatic overhead spotlights, deep shadows, cool metallic tones, a luxurious film noir atmosphere, hyper-realistic textures, ultra-fine glass refraction, cinematic contrast, shallow depth of field, symmetrical composition, and a 2:3 vertical aspect ratio, this work presents a high-end editorial photography style. It adds a subtle sense of dominance, wealth, mystery, and modern corporate power; no identifiable text or logos may appear in the images.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张奢华的电影质感竖版肖像，场景设定在夜晚的黑暗顶层公寓：{argument name="main subject" default="一位强大的商务人士"} 居中坐在由锋利的水晶切面和镜面玻璃构成的巨大王座上，如同一个巨大的棱角分明的钻石王冠在他身后升起。他身穿剪裁合身的 {argument name="suit color" default="炭黑色"} 西装，搭配挺括的白色衬衫、深酒红色领带、同色系口袋巾、黑色抛光皮鞋和腕表，双腿交叠，双臂自信地搁在王座扶手上。画面中需呈现 5 位人物：前景中 1 位居中就座的商务人士，以及 4 位位于王座后方及周围、面部模糊且光影较暗的男性身影，其中两位位于左右高处，两位位于肩部附近，营造出精英议会或多重曝光的权力光环。人物面部应刻意保持无特征或模糊处理，重点在于姿态、服饰、倒影和氛围。王座由无数透明三角形水晶碎片、镀铬边缘、棱镜反射、闪烁的高光和锋利的几何切面构成。场景置于拥有落地窗的高层行政酒廊，配有黑色窗帘、倒映着座椅和鞋子的黑色亮面大理石地板，窗外是遥远的城市摩天大楼灯光，远端两侧有暖色台灯。采用戏剧性的头顶聚光灯、深邃的阴影、冷色调金属质感、奢华黑色电影氛围、超写实纹理、超精细玻璃折射、电影级对比度、浅景深、对称构图、2:3 竖版画幅，呈现高端编辑摄影风格。增添一种微妙的支配感、财富感、神秘感和现代企业权力感；画面中不得出现可辨识的文字或标志。

templates.title: A group photo of teenagers in a shopping mall with a 1990s VHS style.

titleLocalized.zh: 90 年代 VHS 风格商场青少年合影

templates.prompt: Create a candid group photo of teenagers in a shopping mall in the 1990s, shot with a consumer-grade VHS camcorder, exhibiting heavy analog tape artifacts. The scene shows five teenagers standing indoors in a shopping mall or department store corridor, bathed in warm fluorescent light: a young girl is in the center of the foreground, with four teenagers behind her, two on each side. The central figure wears a brightly colored geometric-patterned windbreaker over a beige ribbed turtleneck, large gold hoop earrings, and long, messy black hair tied into a high half-ponytail with a hair tie; she makes a peace sign with her right hand towards the camera, looking straight ahead. The teenagers in the background wear exaggerated retro clothing: one wears a colorful patterned sweater holding a soda can, another wears layered denim, another wears a white shirt under a blue denim jacket, and yet another wears a striking knitted sweater with a star pattern. All faces, including the central figure and the four background teenagers, are deliberately obscured by soft rectangular blur blocks. Employing a nostalgic disposable camera/VHS aesthetic, it captures skin tones under flash, a slight fisheye perspective, graininess, scan lines, chroma noise, level tracking glitches, soft yet saturated colors, and a low-resolution 4:3 aspect ratio. An orange camera date stamp is added to the lower right corner.{argument name="date stamp" default="OCT 12 '94"} Overall atmosphere: quirky, awkward, and fun, brimming with the energy of a 90s mall party. The central girl's jacket color scheme should be {argument name="jacket colors" default="Cyan, purple, mustard yellow, coral and navy blue"} Her hair color should be{argument name="hair color" default="black"} The scene should present{argument name="setting" default="Shopping mall interior in the 1990s"} That feeling.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 90 年代商场青少年的抓拍合影，采用消费级 VHS 摄像机拍摄，带有浓重的模拟磁带伪影。场景展示了 5 名青少年站在商场或百货公司走廊的室内，头顶是温暖的荧光灯：前景中心有一名少女，身后有 4 名青少年，左右各两人。中心人物身穿色彩鲜艳的几何图案防风夹克，内搭米色罗纹高领衫，戴着大金圈耳环，留着凌乱的黑色长发，扎成高高的半马尾，系着发圈；她右手对着镜头比出剪刀手，正视前方。背景中的青少年穿着夸张的复古服装：一人穿着彩色图案毛衣手拿汽水罐，一人穿着叠穿牛仔装，一人穿着白色衬衫外搭蓝色牛仔夹克，另一人穿着带有星形图案的醒目针织毛衣。所有人的面部均通过柔和的矩形模糊块进行刻意遮挡，包括中心人物和四名背景青少年。采用怀旧的一次性相机/VHS 美学，呈现闪光灯下的肤色、轻微鱼眼视角、颗粒感、扫描线、色度噪点、水平跟踪故障、柔和但饱和的色彩以及低分辨率的 4:3 画幅。在右下角添加橙色的摄像机日期戳，显示为 {argument name="date stamp" default="OCT 12 '94"}。整体氛围：古怪、尴尬、有趣，充满 90 年代商场聚会的活力。中心少女的夹克配色应为 {argument name="jacket colors" default="青色、紫色、芥末黄、珊瑚色和海军蓝"}，她的发色应为 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"}，场景应呈现出 {argument name="setting" default="90 年代购物中心内部"} 的感觉。

templates.title: Izakaya pose variations

titleLocalized.zh: 居酒屋姿势变体

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, create a realistic variation of the photograph in the same dimly lit Japanese bar setting, maintaining consistency in the woman's clothing, hairstyle, stool, lighting, and the candid quality captured by the phone flash. Change her pose so that she is more turned towards the man on her right, extending one arm forward and gently placing her hand on his shoulder, as if trying to get his attention. Keep the man in the foreground on the right close to the camera and partially obscuring the view, while anonymizing/blurring his face as in the reference image. Preserve the narrow izakaya atmosphere, the menu on the wall, the bottles, the dark wood, and the casual candid composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图像，在相同的昏暗日式酒吧环境中创作一张逼真的照片变体，保持女性的服装、发型、凳子、灯光以及手机闪光灯下的抓拍质感一致。改变她的姿势，使她更多地转向右侧的男性，并将一只手臂向前伸出，轻轻地将手放在他的肩膀上，仿佛在引起他的注意。保持右侧前景中的男性靠近镜头并部分遮挡视野，同时像参考图中那样对人脸进行匿名化/模糊处理。保留狭窄的居酒屋氛围、墙上的菜单、酒瓶、深色木材以及随意的抓拍构图。

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, create a realistic variation of the photo within an izakaya (Japanese pub) setting. Add a beer mug filled with golden beer and foam, and maintain the same candid flash effect, dimly lit bar background, and natural crowded atmosphere as the reference image. Preserve the anonymized masking of the face.

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed vertical anime-style illustration featuring a charming protagonist.{argument name="character description" default="Young female belly dancer"} She was dressed in a gorgeous, cool-toned outfit. promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张柔和、明亮的竖版动漫风格浪漫特写肖像，展示两个角色在明亮的白色背光背景下亲密面对面。较高的角色 {argument name="male character name" default="Claude"} 位于右侧，展示从额头到胸部的部分，皮肤白皙，留着灰金色向后梳的层次感短发，露出耳朵，颈部修长，深色开衫外套内搭浅色 V 领衫；他低头看向较矮的角色。较矮的角色 {argument name="female character name" default="Mai"} 位于左下方，侧身，皮肤白皙，留着黑色短波波头，略显凌乱，露出耳朵，身穿黑色连帽衫，抬头看向对方，双手交叠在右下方，触碰或抓着对方的衣物。采用细腻的半写实动漫渲染，发丝清晰，边缘光柔和，肤色呈柔和的粉彩色，浅景深，营造出温柔的情感氛围，背景为干净的高调白色。在角色面部添加大型半透明矩形遮挡块：一个高大的灰粉色矩形覆盖女性面部及中心区域的大部分，另一个较大的灰褐色矩形覆盖男性的面部及中右上方，两个矩形以偏移的 L 型重叠。在整张图像上叠加一个淡淡的超大圆形水印徽标。包含 3 个可见的文字元素：左下方一行白色版权文字“©ImaginaryGate”，中右下方一行部分可见的白色制作人员名单“ctMRA | Mai”，以及右下角一行优雅的白色草书标题“{argument name="caption text" default="Mai & Claude"}”。构图应呈现出温柔的告别或情感重逢的氛围，具有柔和的电影级光影和精致的数字插画质感。

Her bare skin and hair are covered with a glossy, transparent film of soap, and various parts of her body (especially her shoulders, arms, legs, chest, and flowing hair) have iridescent highlights like thin bubbles stretched out. Surrounding her are 18 floating soap bubbles of varying sizes, including a large bubble in the upper left, a large partial bubble in the lower right foreground, a large bubble in the center foreground at the bottom, several small bubbles around her hair and in the room, and several partial bubbles at the edges of the image; each bubble should have a prismatic reflective effect. The scene is set as {argument name="location mood" default="A warm afternoon in the living room of a home in Jozankei, Japan."} On a low, round table sits a white mug and a folded newspaper or magazine. A heater sits against the wall. The design employs soft sunlight from the right, gentle beige and gray tones, realistic room perspective, exquisite painting rendering, luminous iridescent effects, a dreamlike atmosphere, shallow depth of field, and a refined GPT-image-2 anime art style.

templates.prompt: Create a vertical, anime-style illustration depicting a cute young magical girl standing inside a cozy antique magic shop filled with various items. The character has very flowing hair.{argument name="hair color" default="Soft pink"} She had long, glossy hair with a soft, contoured glow, and her face was deliberately obscured by a solid pink square visor. She was wearing an oversized top.{argument name="hoodie color" default="light pink"} A zip-up hoodie with ribbed cuffs and hem, a large bow at the collar, and a small charm-shaped zipper pull; layers of semi-transparent pink lace peek out from under the skirt. Her posture is gentle and shy, one hand lightly raised near her cheek, her fingers slender; her body leans slightly forward, presenting an adorable, cute proportion, full of a dreamy magical girl atmosphere. The scene is set in a warm wooden potion and relic shop, shelves piled high with old books, glass potion bottles, glowing crystals, brass instruments, hanging lanterns, star-shaped ornaments, prisms, hourglasses, framed papers, and mysterious trinkets. Add a cute little pink slime mascot to the shelf on the lower left. Add a blackboard in the foreground with the words written on it.{argument name="chalkboard text" default="Ancient relics / Rare items / Magical tools / and more..."} Using warm golden lantern light interwoven with pink highlights, employing a delicate anime-style rendering, and a highly detailed background, a fantastical atmosphere is created. Soft depth of field, shimmering glass reflections, and vertical composition present an exquisite GPT-Image-2 aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖构图的动漫风格插画，描绘一位可爱的年轻魔法少女站在温馨且摆满物品的古董魔法店内。角色拥有一头非常飘逸的 {argument name="hair color" default="柔粉色"} 长发，发丝光泽感强，带有柔和的轮廓光，面部中央被一个实心的粉色正方形遮挡块刻意遮住。她穿着一件超大号的 {argument name="hoodie color" default="淡粉色"} 拉链连帽衫，袖口和下摆带有罗纹，领口系着大蝴蝶结，拉链头是一个小挂饰造型，裙摆下露出层叠的半透明粉色花边裙。她的姿势温柔羞涩，一只手轻轻抬起靠近脸颊，手指纤细，身体微微前倾，呈现出可爱的萌系比例，充满梦幻的魔法少女氛围。场景设定在一个温暖的木质药剂与遗物店，货架上堆满了旧书、玻璃药水瓶、发光的晶体、黄铜仪器、悬挂的灯笼、星形挂饰、棱镜、沙漏、装裱的纸张和神秘的小饰品。在左侧下方的货架上加入一只可爱的小粉色史莱姆吉祥物。在前景处添加一块黑板，上面写着 {argument name="chalkboard text" default="古代遗物 / 稀有品 / 魔法工具 / 及更多..."}。使用温暖的金色灯笼光与粉色高光交织，采用细腻的动漫绘画渲染风格，高细节背景，营造奇幻氛围，柔和的景深，闪烁的玻璃反射，竖构图，呈现出精致的 gpt-image-2 美学。

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic, photorealistic night scene of a bustling entertainment district in Japan after the rain, where the wet asphalt reflects pink, red, blue, and yellow neon lights. In the left foreground, show the back of a mysterious ascetic or hermit, dressed in a heavy, worn brown-gold patterned robe, straw sandals, a rope around his waist, and a straw hat or woven pilgrimage headdress covering his face. The monk is sweeping the streets before entering the nightlife area: in his left hand, he holds a long metal trash picker, picking up a piece of red trash next to an open cardboard box; in his right hand, he carries a large, transparent plastic bag full of trash. The image should include four prominent foreground objects related to the sweeping: a cardboard box with Japanese writing, a blue plastic crate, a warning sign on a fence, and small pieces of trash scattered on the street. The backdrop is a vast urban landscape, filled with illuminated vertical Japanese signs, pachinko parlors and karaoke-style shops, silhouettes of pedestrians with umbrellas, car headlights, traffic lights, and a large billboard in the center featuring a stylized anime girl and the number 109. Atmosphere: contemplative, surreal, and with a touch of humor, like a venerable hermit accumulating merit before a gambling district.{argument name="city district" default="Kabukicho-style Tokyo nightlife streets"} ,{argument name="main character" default="wandering ascetic"} ,{argument name="robe color" default="worn-out brown-gold"} ,{argument name="weather" default="Night after the rain"} ,as well as{argument name="neon sign theme" default="Pinball machines, karaoke, duty-free shops, and anime billboards"} Ultra-detailed realistic textures, emotionally charged low-key lighting, reflective puddles, wide-angle street photography composition, 16:9 aspect ratio, and rough, cinematic color grading; rejecting clean, fantastical lighting effects and cartoonish styles.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个电影级、照片写实的雨后日本繁华娱乐区夜景，湿润的柏油路面反射着粉色、红色、蓝色和黄色的霓虹灯光。左侧前景处，展示一位神秘的苦行僧或隐士的背影，他身穿厚重破旧的棕金色花纹长袍，脚踏草鞋，腰系绳索，戴着遮住面部的束状草帽或编织朝圣头饰。僧人在进入夜生活区前正在进行街道清扫：左手拿着一把长金属垃圾夹，正在夹起一个开口纸箱旁的一块红色垃圾，右手提着一个装满垃圾的大型透明塑料袋。画面需包含四个显著的前景清扫相关物体：一个印有日文的纸箱、一个蓝色塑料板条箱、一个围栏上的警示牌，以及路面上散落的小件垃圾。背景是深邃的城市建筑群，布满发光的垂直日文招牌、弹珠机店和卡拉 OK 风格的店面、撑伞的行人和剪影、汽车前灯、交通信号灯，以及中心处一个带有风格化动漫女孩和数字 109 的大型广告牌。氛围：沉思、超现实且带有一丝幽默感，仿佛一位圣洁的隐士在赌博区前积攒功德。使用 {argument name="city district" default="歌舞伎町风格的东京夜生活街道"}，{argument name="main character" default="流浪苦行僧"}，{argument name="robe color" default="破旧的棕金色"}，{argument name="weather" default="雨后之夜"}，以及 {argument name="neon sign theme" default="弹珠机、卡拉 OK、免税店和动漫广告牌"}。超细节写实纹理、情绪化低调照明、反光水洼、广角街头摄影构图、16:9 纵横比、粗粝的电影级调色，拒绝干净的奇幻光效，拒绝卡通风格。

templates.title: Summer Anime Girl Portraits

titleLocalized.zh: 夏季动漫少女肖像

templates.prompt: Create a vibrant single-panel anime illustration to showcase {argument name="character description" default="A young woman with shoulder-length honey-blonde hair"} A half-length portrait against a backdrop of a clear, highly saturated summer sky and soft white cumulus clouds. She has a refreshing shoulder-length bob, her hair flowing in the wind, her skin a peach hue, and her neck and shoulders slender. She is dressed in {argument name="outfit" default="A loose-fitting white short-sleeved T-shirt with a wide neckline that slipped slightly to one shoulder."} The composition features her in a relaxed pose, leaning slightly forward, using a close-up cropping style similar to a portrait poster.{argument name="face covering" default="A pure peach-colored rectangular block of color was placed in the center of her face, obscuring all facial features."} Adopting a clean and modern Japanese anime style, it uses expressive navy blue and cyan sketch lines, warm peach and cream shadows, bright sunlight, light highlights on the hair, minimalist background details, and clear high-contrast colors to create a cheerful summer atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张充满活力的单格动漫插画，展示 {argument name="character description" default="一位留着齐肩蜜金色头发的年轻女性"} 的半身像，背景为饱和度高的清澈夏日蓝天和柔软的白色积云。她留着清爽的齐肩波波头，发丝随风飘动，皮肤呈桃色，颈部和肩部线条纤细，身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="一件宽松的白色短袖 T 恤，领口较大，微微滑落至一侧肩头"}。构图上让她以放松的姿态微微前倾，采用类似肖像海报的近景裁剪。在 {argument name="face covering" default="她的面部中央放置一个纯桃色的矩形色块，遮挡所有面部特征"}。采用干净现代的日式动漫风格，运用富有表现力的海军蓝和青色草图线条、温暖的桃色和奶油色阴影、明亮的阳光、发丝上轻盈的高光、极简的背景细节、清晰的高对比度色彩，营造出欢快的夏日氛围。

templates.title: Anonymous late-night radio doll host

titleLocalized.zh: 匿名深夜电台玩偶主播

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic, realistic late-night radio studio scene with a vertical composition. A lifelike ball-jointed female doll-like anchorwoman, sporting short hair {argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown"} She had a bob haircut and straight bangs, sat in a black leather chair, a wooden radio station in front of her, wore large headphones, and a black short-sleeved dress with a subtle shimmer, paired with an elegant necklace and bracelet; her face was framed by a centrally located {argument name="face cover color" default="Dark brown"} A rectangular block of color is deliberately used to obscure her identity, creating an anonymity. A large professional condenser microphone with a shock mount and cantilever is placed directly in front of her mouth, and a mixing console with illuminated colored buttons is placed in the foreground. The scene should include six prominent desktop/studio props: a red illuminated "ON AIR" sign, a digital clock displaying "20:03:15", a white mug with "Night Radio" printed on it, a clear plastic water bottle, a handwritten note with a pen, and a small stack of papers or notebooks. The studio interior should create a narrow, warm, and atmospheric feel, with posters and notices on the walls, an analog clock hanging in the upper left corner, a CD or record rack on the right edge, and reflections on the polished wooden surfaces. Through the large window behind her, a rainy scene is shown.{argument name="city" default="Tokyo"} The streets are damp at night, traffic lights are blurred, and the windows of high-rise office buildings are brightly lit, with vertical Japanese neon signs visible, including blue karaoke signs. Emotional, low-key lighting contrasts the warm tungsten highlights indoors with the cool tones of the city lights outdoors. A shallow depth-of-field effect creates realistic glass reflections and high-detail textures, evoking the intimate, late-night atmosphere of a radio broadcaster reading listener letters. (Optional Japanese radio program emotional text content added.){argument name="quote" default="The next letter is from a non-believer~"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个垂直构图的电影级写实深夜电台直播间场景。一位逼真的球形关节女性玩偶主播，留着短款 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 波波头和直刘海，坐在黑色皮椅上，面前是木质广播台，佩戴着大型头戴式耳机，身穿一件带有细微闪光效果的黑色短袖连衣裙，搭配精致的项链和手链；她的脸部被一个居中的 {argument name="face cover color" default="深棕色"} 长方形色块刻意遮挡，呈现出匿名状态。在她的嘴部正前方放置一个带有防震架和悬臂支架的大型专业电容麦克风，前景处放置一个带有发光彩色按钮的调音台。画面中需包含 6 个显眼的桌面/工作室道具：一个红色的“ON AIR”发光标牌、一个显示为“20:03:15”的数字时钟、一个印有“Night Radio”字样的白色马克杯、一个透明塑料水瓶、带有钢笔的手写笔记，以及一小叠纸张或笔记本。工作室内部应营造出狭窄、温暖且富有氛围感的感觉，墙上贴有海报和通知，左上角挂着一个模拟时钟，右侧边缘有 CD 或唱片架，抛光的木质表面上有倒影。透过她身后的巨大窗户，展示一个下雨的 {argument name="city" default="东京"} 夜晚街道，地面湿润，交通灯光模糊，高层办公楼窗户灯火通明，并可见垂直的日式霓虹灯招牌，包括蓝色的卡拉 OK 招牌。使用情绪化的低调照明，室内温暖的钨丝灯高光与室外冷色调的城市灯光形成对比，采用浅景深效果，呈现逼真的玻璃反射和高细节纹理，营造出一种主播正在阅读听众来信的私密深夜广播氛围。添加可选的日语广播节目情绪文字内容：{argument name="quote" default="次のお便りは異教徒さんから〜"}。

templates.title: Cozy retro anime bar interior

titleLocalized.zh: 温馨复古动漫酒吧内景

templates.prompt: Create a detailed, anime-style illustration depicting the cozy interior of a vintage wooden bar at night, using a wide, horizontal composition from the perspective of customers at the bar. Within the scene {argument name="character name" default="An elegant young bartender"} Seated behind a smooth, L-shaped wooden bar, she rested her chin on her hand, wearing a loose olive-green tank top and a light-colored headband.{argument name="hair color" default="Her long, wavy hair was platinum blonde."} The light falls over her shoulders; her face is softly blurred, devoid of defined features. Warm amber light from four lanterns suspended from dark ceiling beams creates harmonious golden highlights and shadows on the character, bottles, shelves, bar, and wood-paneled walls. Three round wooden bar stools are included in the foreground. Behind the character, a dense back bar is displayed, with three main horizontal shelves on the left and a tall, ornate cabinet with three shelves on the right, displaying approximately 55 bottles in total, a mix of whiskey, sake, ceramic jugs, decanters, and small labeled glass bottles. Bar accessories are added to the bar and shelves: a brass table lamp on the far left, a small gum or candy box, a bowl of citrus fruits including oranges and limes, a cocktail shaker, small jars, straws, bells, and hanging cutlery. Vintage alcohol posters and labels hang on the left wall; a closed wooden door with diamond-shaped glass windows and brass hinges is on the right. Rendered in a hand-drawn cinematic anime style, featuring complex lines, dark brown wood grain, realistic perspective, warm reflections on the paint surface, a nostalgic underground bar atmosphere, high detail, integrated character and background lighting, and no modern objects or text overlays.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张细节丰富、充满动漫风格的插画，描绘夜晚温馨的复古木质酒吧内景，采用从吧台顾客视角出发的宽幅横向构图。场景中，{argument name="character name" default="一位优雅的年轻酒保"} 坐在打磨光滑的 L 型木质吧台后，单手托腮，身穿宽松的橄榄色吊带背心，戴着浅色发带，{argument name="hair color" default="一头波浪长卷发呈铂金色"} 垂落在肩头；她的面部柔和地模糊处理，没有具体五官。使用来自悬挂在深色天花板横梁上的 4 盏灯笼发出的暖琥珀色灯光，在角色、酒瓶、货架、吧台和木镶板墙壁上营造出和谐的金色高光与阴影。前景中包含 3 张圆木吧台椅。在角色身后，展示一个密集的后吧台，左侧有 3 层主要水平酒架，右侧有一个带 3 层隔板的高大华丽酒柜，总共可见约 55 个酒瓶，混合了威士忌、清酒、陶瓷酒壶、醒酒器和带有小标签的玻璃瓶。吧台和货架上添加吧台配件：最左侧放置 1 盏黄铜台灯，1 个小型口香糖或糖果盒，1 碗装有橙子和青柠的柑橘类水果，鸡尾酒摇酒壶、小罐子、吸管、铃铛和悬挂的餐具。左侧墙壁上挂有复古酒精海报和标签；右侧有一扇带菱形玻璃窗和黄铜合页的封闭木门。以手绘电影感动漫背景风格渲染，具有复杂的线条、深棕色木纹、逼真的透视效果、漆面上的温暖反射、怀旧的地下酒吧氛围、高细节度、一体化的角色与背景灯光，无现代物品，无文字覆盖。

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹朋克少女与哈士奇

templates.prompt: Create a vibrant anime street art illustration that must include two main subjects: a punk-style girl and a large wolf-like dog. (Girl){argument name="character age and style" default="A teenage gothic punk anime girl"} She crouches in the foreground on the right side of the image, leaning forward, one hand near her mouth, striking a cool and rebellious pose. She keeps {argument name="hair color and style" default="Long black pigtails with bright pink highlights."} She had messy, layered bangs, sharp magenta eyes, fair skin, and wore multiple earrings, hair clips, and rings, with a slightly mischievous expression. She wore an oversized black streetwear jacket covered in neon pink, cyan, and yellow graphic patches, featuring an off-the-shoulder design with straps and buckles, layered over a short, dark top, and paired it with chunky high-top sneakers with bright pink laces, along with striking punk accessories. To her left was…{argument name="animal companion" default="A large black, beige, and gray tricolor husky wolfdog"} It lay calmly and alertly on its side, its face turned to the left, ears perked up, with yellow eyes and fluffy fur, its coat adorned with neon pink and yellow graffiti-like accents that echoed the girl's colors. The background setting is {argument name="background style" default="A messy graffiti mural wall"} The walls are filled with explosive geometric street art shapes, arrows, halftone dots, paint splatters, jagged lightning patterns, layered posters, and abstract blocks of color. Strong neon hues, including bright pink, cyan, yellow, black, beige, and purple, are used, complemented by crisp anime lines, glossy highlights, dramatic shadows, rich detail, and dynamic urban poster compositions. The overall image should have a stylish cyberpunk graffiti album cover feel, employing a widescreen horizontal composition, ultra-high detail, vibrant colors, and avant-garde yet sophisticated aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅充满活力的动漫街头艺术插画，画面中必须包含两个主体：一位朋克风少女和一只大型狼系犬。少女 {argument name="character age and style" default="一位十几岁的哥特朋克动漫少女"} 蹲在画面中右侧前景，身体前倾，一只手靠近嘴边，摆出酷炫且不羁的姿势。她留着 {argument name="hair color and style" default="黑色长双马尾，带有鲜艳的亮粉色挑染"}，凌乱的层次感刘海，锐利的洋红色双眼，皮肤白皙，佩戴多枚耳环、发夹和戒指，表情略带顽皮。她身穿一件超大号黑色街头风夹克，上面布满霓虹粉、青色和黄色的图形补丁，采用露肩设计，配有绑带、搭扣，内搭短款深色服装，脚蹬厚底高帮运动鞋，系着亮粉色鞋带，并佩戴醒目的朋克饰品。在她左侧是 {argument name="animal companion" default="一只大型黑、米、灰三色哈士奇狼犬"}，它冷静而警觉地侧卧着，侧脸朝左，竖起耳朵，有着黄色的眼睛、蓬松的毛发，皮毛上融入了与少女相呼应的霓虹粉和黄色涂鸦式点缀。背景设定为 {argument name="background style" default="一面混乱的涂鸦壁画墙"}，墙上充满爆炸性的几何街头艺术形状、箭头、半调网点、油漆飞溅、锯齿状闪电图案、层叠的海报和抽象色块。使用强烈的霓虹色调，包括亮粉色、青色、黄色、黑色、米色和紫色，配合清晰的动漫线条、光泽高光、戏剧性阴影、丰富的细节以及动态的城市海报构图。整张图片应呈现出时尚的赛博朋克涂鸦专辑封面质感，采用宽屏横向构图，超高细节，色彩鲜艳，前卫且精致。
