The scene is set as a view from a lush courtyard towards a vibrant spring morning: sunlit green foliage and delicate white flowers adorn the upper left and left edges, accompanied by shimmering lens flares, falling petals, white feathers, and green leaves scattered in the sky. Add seven birds: three blue, white, and yellow birds perch on a flowering branch in the center left; three birds—a brown sparrow, a pale yellow cockatiel with orange cheeks, and a blue budgie—perch on a rustic wooden sign in the lower left corner; and a swallow flies in the sky in the upper right. Place elegant white handwritten text in the upper left corner.{argument name="headline text" default="Good Morning!"} It is decorated with tiny leaves and shimmering details, and is accompanied by a blue ribbon containing Japanese text.{argument name="ribbon text" default="Have a wonderful day!"} In the bottom left corner, create a weathered wooden signboard adorned with small flowers, vines, white laurel wreaths, and feathers, accompanied by white handwritten text.{argument name="event title" default="Bind Week"} and smaller date lines{argument name="date range" default="5.10 (Sat) - 5.16 (Fri)"} The background should depict a distant, soft town, lake, or river, along with pale mountains beneath fluffy white clouds, with daisies and yellow flowers blooming in the lower right foreground. Use fresh, soft color tones, a transparent composition, high detail, soft sunlight, and clean, decorative typography, while maintaining ample white space in the center of the sky for overlay applications.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个明亮的方形 VTuber “早安”社交媒体边框，采用柔和的动漫水彩风格，并在中右侧留出大片清澈的蓝天区域，以便放置角色或照片。场景设定为从绿意盎然的庭院望向充满活力的春日清晨：阳光照耀的绿色枝叶和小巧的白花点缀在左上角和左侧边缘，伴有闪烁的镜头光晕、飘落的花瓣、白色羽毛以及散落在天空中的绿叶。请添加 7 只小鸟：左中部的开花枝头栖息着 3 只蓝色、白色和黄色的小鸟；左下角的质朴木牌上栖息着 3 只鸟，分别为棕色麻雀、脸颊带橙色的淡黄色玄凤鹦鹉和蓝色虎皮鹦鹉；右上方的天空中有一只飞翔的燕子。在左上角，放置优雅的白色手写体文本 {argument name="headline text" default="Good Morning!"}，并以细小的叶片和闪光点缀，下方配有一条青色丝带，丝带内包含日文文本 {argument name="ribbon text" default="素敵な一日になりますように♪"}。在左下角，制作一块风化的木板招牌，上面缠绕着小花、藤蔓、白色月桂图案和羽毛，并配有白色手写体文本 {argument name="event title" default="Bind Week"} 以及较小的日期行 {argument name="date range" default="5.10 (Sat) - 5.16 (Fri)"}。背景应呈现出远处柔和的城镇、湖泊或河流，以及蓬松白云下的淡色山脉，右下角前景处盛开着雏菊和黄色花朵。采用清新的柔和色调、通透的构图、高细节表现、柔和的阳光以及整洁的装饰性排版，并保持天空中心区域大部分留白，以便进行叠加使用。

titleLocalized.zh: Sunlit Anime Café Reader

templates.prompt: Create a detailed anime-style illustration depicting an elegant young woman with a cool, aloof aesthetic.{argument name="character name" default="Untitled female lead"} She sat at a wooden table in a sun-drenched café or greenhouse, reading a beautifully bound, deep blue book. She had flowing hair {argument name="hair color" default="Dark purple-black"} Long hair, with a shimmering purple sheen, cascaded naturally, adorned with a decorative flower-shaped gemstone hair clip with a dark ribbon on one side. Her face was deliberately obscured by a centrally located square privacy panel, its color a soft purple-to-rose gradient, concealing her features while retaining visibility of her hair, chin, hands, and clothing. She wore an elegant Victorian-style blouse and skirt: a white, ruffled, high-necked blouse with delicate lace trim, puff sleeves, and gold cufflinks; a deep navy blue fitted vest or apron tied with a blue ribbon bow at the collar; and an oval sapphire brooch. Her posture was serene and graceful, one hand holding an open book, the other thoughtfully placed to her lips. The scene was warm and bright, with a tall wooden window frame on the right, letting in golden afternoon sunlight, shimmering dust motes floating in the air, and a soft lens flare. Outside, a hazy garden landscape stretched out. Four still-life objects are clearly visible on the table: an open decorative book in her hand, a floral teacup filled with tea, a stack of two books (one red on top, one dark blue below), and a clear glass vase filled with pale purple hydrangea-like flowers. The background includes softly blurred shelves, café supplies, and a warm pendant light. The work employs a high-quality Japanese anime art style, with delicate lines, oil painting-like lighting, intricate fabric folds, bright highlights in the hair, shallow depth of field, a romantic atmosphere, warm gold and lavender hues, cinematic composition, a 16:9 horizontal aspect ratio, exceptional detail, no visible text, and no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张细节丰富的动漫风格插画，描绘一位优雅且色调冷峻的年轻女性，{argument name="character name" default="未命名女主角"}，她坐在温暖阳光照射的咖啡馆或温室里的木桌旁，正在阅读一本精致的深蓝色精装书。她拥有一头飘逸的 {argument name="hair color" default="深紫黑色"} 长发，带有亮泽的紫色高光，发丝自然垂落，一侧别着一枚带有深色丝带的装饰性花朵宝石发卡。她的面部被一个位于中心的正方形隐私遮挡块刻意遮盖，遮挡块呈现柔和的紫到玫瑰色渐变，在遮住五官的同时保留了头发、下巴区域、手部和服装的可见度。她穿着精致的维多利亚风格衬衫和裙装：带有精致蕾丝花边的白色荷叶边高领衬衫、泡泡袖和金色袖扣，一件深海军蓝色的修身马甲或围裙，领口系着蓝色丝带蝴蝶结，并佩戴一枚椭圆形的蓝宝石胸针。她的姿态安静而优雅，一只手拿着打开的书，另一只手若有所思地放在唇边。场景温馨明亮，右侧有高大的木质窗框，金色的午后阳光倾泻而入，空气中漂浮着闪烁的尘埃，带有柔和的镜头光晕，窗外是模糊的花园景观。桌上清晰可见四件静物：她手中打开的装饰书、一杯盛有茶水的花卉茶杯、一叠两本的书（上面是红色的书，下面是深蓝色的书），以及一个插满淡紫色绣球花状花朵的透明玻璃花瓶。背景中包含柔和模糊的架子、咖啡馆用品和温暖的吊灯。采用高水准的日本动漫艺术风格，细腻的线条，油画般的灯光，复杂的布料褶皱，头发上的明亮高光，浅景深，浪漫氛围，温暖的金色与薰衣草色调，电影级构图，16:9 横向画幅，超高细节，无可见文字，无水印。

templates.prompt: Create a warm and romantic vertical illustration in anime style, in which {argument name="character name" default="A tall, handsome blond man"} He greets the audience in a rustic, fantastical kitchen, shot in half-length, holding a white plate in both hands. His face is obscured by a solid-colored, brownish-skin square, his disheveled {argument name="hair color" default="Golden yellow"} Long hair cascaded around the cube, reflecting the sunlight. He wore a black open-collar shirt with ornate silver embroidery on the collar and placket, sleeves rolled up to his forearms, and a beige apron with shoulder straps, metal rings, and a waist tie. On the plate was a golden omelet rice, glossy and soft, topped with a red tomato heart and garnished with a few green herbs. The background was a cozy old-world kitchen, warm afternoon sunlight streaming in through an arched window on the left, where potted plants sat. The subject wears an elegant all-white ensemble: an oversized white blazer, a loose-fitting open-collar white shirt, high-waisted white trousers, and a thin black belt, with a few delicate rings adorning relaxed fingers. The face is partially obscured by a central black square, revealing only the surrounding dark, medium-length hair. The white blazer has a soft sheen, and the overall tone is a low-saturation cyan-orange, with slight film grain, color aberration, a VHS-like blur effect, and a retro feel reminiscent of 1990s disposable cameras. The composition should convey a high-end, masculine, and dramatic brand image, while also possessing the symmetry required for brand promotion; the car is positioned in the lower center of the image, the person is positioned slightly to the right of the center, and the large letters fill the background. templates.prompt: Create a wide-format, cinematic, realistic 19th-century historical scene:{argument name="central figure" default="An elderly man with a beard, wearing a long black tuxedo coat and a top hat"} Dramatically standing in the middle of the rough wooden rails, legs spread in a victory pose, hands {argument name="raised object" default="A super-sized sledgehammer"} He holds the hammer high above his head, as if about to strike the final railroad spike. Around him are 22 clearly visible onlookers, mostly men dressed in Victorian suits, waistcoats, bowler hats, top hats, and cowboy hats, including an officer in a blue uniform. They are arranged in a semi-circle on either side of the tracks; several hold canes or walking sticks, and the faces of some are slightly blurred at the edges of the frame. In the foreground, the rails curve inward, pointing to a bright golden ceremonial spike or connecting device located between the rails. The background is a vast, arid plain dotted with sparse shrubs, with majestic snow-capped mountains in the distance, and a clear, pale blue sky dotted with wispy clouds. The use of realistic lighting and clear, documentary-style details, the proportions of the raised hammer with a slightly humorous surrealism, and the dominant color palette of natural earth tones, black, and brown vintage clothing, with the focus clearly on the central figure's posture, presents a scene reminiscent of…{argument name="historical era" default="Late 19th century"} The effect of taking commemorative photos at the opening ceremony of the transcontinental railway.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张宽画幅、电影质感的 19 世纪历史写实场景：{argument name="central figure" default="一位留着胡须、身穿黑色礼服长外套并戴着高礼帽的老人"} 戏剧性地站在粗糙的木制铁轨中央，双腿分开呈胜利姿态，双手将 {argument name="raised object" default="一把超大号的大锤"} 高高举过头顶，仿佛正要敲下最后一颗铁路道钉。他周围有 22 位清晰可见的围观者，大多是身穿维多利亚时代西装、马甲、圆顶礼帽、高礼帽、牛仔帽的男士，其中还有一位身着蓝色军装的军官，他们呈半圆形排列在铁轨两侧；几个人拿着手杖或拐杖，部分人的面孔在画面边缘略显模糊。前景中，钢轨向内弯曲，指向位于铁轨之间的一颗明亮的金色仪式道钉或连接装置。背景是开阔干旱的平原，点缀着稀疏的灌木，远处是雄伟的雪山，天空呈现清澈的淡蓝色，漂浮着丝丝云彩。采用写实光影、清晰的纪录片式细节，举起的大锤比例略带幽默的超现实感，色调以自然的泥土色、黑色和棕色复古服装为主，焦点清晰地对准中心人物的姿态，呈现出如同 {argument name="historical era" default="19 世纪末"} 横贯大陆铁路通车仪式上那种摆拍纪念照的效果。

templates.title: Rooftop Bar Night Cityscape Couple

titleLocalized.zh: Rooftop Bar Night Cityscape Couple

templates.prompt:
A wide half-body shot of two young people standing at the railing of an open-air rooftop club bar, authentic daily life photography, natural candid moment. She leans back lightly against him — both looking out at the city lights below, drinks in hand, a comfortable weight to the silence between them.
East Asian young woman in her early 20s. Almond-shaped eyes with natural double eyelids, slightly elongated eye corners, expression soft and open — the kind of face that appears when the music is behind you and the city is in front. Straight refined nose with a delicate bridge. Skin tone fair to light beige (NC10–NC20). Skin subsurface scattering visible under warm rooftop bar light mixed with distant city glow, specular micro-highlights on her bare shoulders and collarbone, fine foundation powder grain perceptible. She wears a rose-gold satin slip dress on thin straps — the fabric catching the city light, hem above the knee, moving faintly in the night breeze. He stands close behind her, hands loosely on the railing beside hers. Two or three stray hairs lift and cross her cheek displaced by the rooftop breeze, natural unplanned imperfection, not geometrically symmetrical.
Mixed artificial light sources — warm amber rooftop bar lanterns cast a soft glow across both figures from behind. The vast city light grid spreads below and behind them, bokeh points of orange and white light filling the distance. A light wind is implied in the fabric movement and lifted hair. The mood is gentle and warm — quiet contentment, a small almost-smile, sense of stillness above the city. Subtle ISO 400 film grain in shadow areas, photographic noise texture not CG render smoothness. Aspect ratio 3:2. No watermark, no text overlay, not cartoon, not digitally painted, not illustration, not anime.

Outside the bottle, show a moody wizard-study background: blurred bookshelves, candlelight on the right, parchment and scrolls on the desk, and a blue moon glowing through a window in the upper left. templates.title: Kawaii Glass Dollhouse Diorama

titleLocalized.zh: Kawaii Glass Dollhouse Diorama

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create a highly detailed vertical photorealistic miniature diorama inside a clear glass display case, styled like a warm pastel Japanese kawaii room box, with the feeling of a cozy personal world.

Canvas: Portrait 2:3 composition, close-up front view through transparent glass, shallow depth of field, warm golden afternoon light, soft bokeh fairy lights, ultra-detailed handcrafted textures, realistic reflections on the acrylic/glass walls.

Main subject: A seated teenage girl miniature with a softly obscured/featureless face, shoulder-length {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair, wearing a cream Japanese sailor school uniform with gray collar trim, a large {argument name="bow color" default="pink"} chest bow, gray pleated skirt, white socks, sitting sideways on a cream lace-covered armchair. Her left arm reaches outward holding a tiny pink flower or wand-like blossom; her right hand rests on her knee. Pose is gentle, relaxed, and inviting.

Companion subject: One small floating fairy-like robot girl to the right of the seated girl, also with a softly obscured/featureless face, short brown bob hair, translucent insect wings, white-and-silver futuristic body armor, tiny mechanical limbs, hovering above a small round flying base. Make it cute, delicate, and toy-like rather than threatening.

Display case and room: The scene is enclosed in a rectangular glass case with a wooden base and ornate gold vine decoration along the bottom. Inside is a miniature living room with a sofa/armchair, lace curtains, sunny window, bookshelves, framed photos, houseplants, cushions, a small wooden coffee table, pastel boxes, a cup and saucer, tiny cosmetics or perfume bottles, and a soft cream rug. Use peach, ivory, blush pink, champagne gold, and pale green as the main palette.

Decorative arch: At the top front of the case is a floral arch made of vines, pearls, crystal drops, warm micro string lights, and many small white and pink flowers. Add one ornate oval sign centered at the top reading {argument name="top sign text" default="Maruko's time at home"}, with a small cursive English subtitle reading "Maruko's little world". Add one matching name plaque near the bottom front reading {argument name="name plaque text" default="まるこ"} with "Maruko" underneath.

Counted visible focal elements: Include exactly 2 human-like figures: 1 seated schoolgirl miniature and 1 floating winged robot fairy. Include exactly 1 sleeping white cat curled in a small woven basket on the floor near the girl's feet. Include exactly 2 readable signs: the top oval title sign and the bottom name plaque. Include exactly 1 small wooden coffee table, 1 cup-and-saucer set, 1 armchair, 1 window with lace curtains, and 1 wooden display-case base.

Style and lighting: Premium collectible dollhouse photography, hyperrealistic miniature craftsmanship, romantic kawaii aesthetic, cinematic warm sunlight from the back window, glowing fairy lights, crisp foreground details with soft background blur, glass reflections and refractions, delicate lace, pearl, resin, and gold-metal textures.

Constraints: Do not add extra characters, do not make it a flat illustration, do not use harsh colors, avoid horror or cyberpunk mood, keep both faces intentionally soft/blurred and non-identifiable, preserve the cute handcrafted display-case look.

titleLocalized.zh: 皮克斯风格微缩音乐场景

templates.prompt: Use the uploaded reference image as a reference for the character's face and hairstyle to create a highly detailed 3D Pixar-style miniature scene. The face, hairstyle, skin tone, and overall appearance should match the uploaded image.{argument name="subject" default="Lovely young people"} He lies comfortably inside the wireless earphone charging case on a wooden desk. He has long black hair, soft yet expressive eyes, and a natural, gentle smile. He wears the exact same clothing as in the uploaded reference image. The character lies comfortably in the earphone case in a relaxed posture, one hand supporting his head, one leg casually crossed over the other. Next to the charging case, a modern smartphone sits vertically on a stand, displaying a simple, minimalist music player interface. The screen shows the song title…{argument name="song name" default="ordinary"} The set features an elegant album cover, play button, and progress bar. Two wireless earbuds are casually placed near their charging case on the desk. The environment utilizes soft, warm natural window light to create a comfortable, cinematic atmosphere. The background should be soft-focused for an aesthetically pleasing bokeh effect, complementing the minimalist modern desk setting. The style should be presented as high-quality, cinematic 3D rendering, with smooth textures, soft shadows, depth-of-field effects, ultra-realistic lighting, highly detailed materials, and charming Pixar-style proportions. High resolution, realistic reflections, a comfortable atmosphere, centered composition, and professional, advertising-grade quality.

promptLocalized.zh:
使用上传的参考图片作为角色的面部和发型参考，创作一个超精细的 3D 皮克斯风格微缩场景。

一个面部、发型、肤色和整体外观与上传图片一致的 {argument name="subject" default="可爱的年轻人"}，正舒适地躺在放置于木质书桌上的无线耳机充电盒内。

他留着黑色长发，眼神柔和且富有表现力，带着自然温和的微笑。他穿着与上传参考图片中完全相同的服装。

角色以放松的姿势舒适地躺在耳机盒内，单手托头，一条腿随意地搭在另一条腿上。

充电盒旁边，一部现代智能手机垂直放置在支架上，显示着简洁的极简音乐播放器界面。屏幕上显示着歌曲名称“{argument name="song name" default="ordinary"}”，配有优雅的专辑封面、播放按钮和进度条。

两个无线耳机随意地放置在书桌上的充电盒附近。

环境采用柔和温暖的自然窗光，营造出舒适的电影感氛围。背景应进行柔焦处理，呈现美学虚化效果，并搭配极简的现代书桌布置。

风格应呈现为高品质的电影级 3D 渲染，具有平滑的纹理、柔和的阴影、景深效果、超逼真的光影、高度精细的材质，以及可爱的皮克斯风格比例。

高分辨率，逼真的反射效果，舒适的氛围，居中构图，专业的产品广告级质量。

templates.title: 3D stereoscopic social media posters

titleLocalized.zh: 3D 立体社交媒体海报

templates.prompt: A breathtaking 3D stereoscopic cinematic portrait poster, with{argument name="subject" default="Zendaya"} The central figure exudes a sophisticated, cool-girl elegance and nonchalance. Her signature long, straight hair flows dramatically, and her deep complexion is captivating under the screen's lighting. Her makeup boasts a magazine-worthy perfection—defined cheekbones, glossy lips, and delicate eyeliner. She wears a coordinated chocolate and gold ensemble—a structured cropped corset, deep caramel-colored streamlined satin wide-leg trousers, lace-up high-heeled mules, layered chunky gold chain necklaces, and oversized hoop earrings that shimmer in cinematic lighting. She is depicted sitting inside a giant, oversized smartphone screen, within an original, fictional social media profile interface—a style that borrows from Instagram's visual language but is entirely original—containing her account {argument name="handle" default="@zendaya"} Circular personal avatar, displayed as{argument name="followers" default="287.4M"} The screen displays her numerous followers, a carousel of pinned posts, and minimalist UI buttons glowing in a soft, pale purple light. Through extreme forced perspective and dramatic wide-angle compositions, she completely breaks free from the phone screen: a hand adorned with stacked gold rings extends confidently directly into the lens, while her long legs and strappy heels extend beyond the bottom bezel of the phone, blurring the lines between screen and reality. The illusion of depth is pushed to its extreme—hyper-cinematic, with the tension of a Vogue cover. The backdrop is a lavishly decorated bedroom—walls stacked with framed magazine photos, Polaroid collages, and neon-backlit art prints showcasing moments from her career. Floating freely in the space are: iridescent champagne gold and deep plum balloons, stacked rhinestone fragments capturing warm light, shards of broken transparent glass suspended in mid-air, and ultra-fine gold dust particles floating in slow motion. The room's color scheme is deep magenta and champagne, accented with antique gold metallic hues. Lighting: Hollywood-style three-point lighting—cool blue-white main light from the phone screen, warm amber fill light from practical indoor lighting fixtures, and sharp golden rim light to outline her features. Anamorphic lens flares sweep across the cracked point of the screen. Subtle golden bokeh particles shimmer in the background depth of field. Rendering Style: Hyperrealistic magazine photography combined with surreal CGI. ARRI Alexa 65 camera, Panavision anamorphic lens, color grading with rich warm-toned LUTs, highlight edges with a halo effect, achieving a Vogue-standard retouched quality. 2:3 aspect ratio, portrait mode. Atmosphere: An untouchable star aristocratic feel—stepping out of the internet, composed and magnetic.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张令人叹为观止的 3D 立体电影感肖像海报，以 {argument name="subject" default="Zendaya"} 为核心主体——散发着高贵、酷女孩般的优雅与随性。她标志性的长直发戏剧性地飘动，深邃的肤色在屏幕光影下显得格外迷人。妆容呈现出杂志大片般的完美质感——轮廓分明的颧骨、亮泽的唇妆以及精致的眼线。她身着巧克力色与金色协调的全身造型——结构感十足的短款束身衣、深焦糖色流线型缎面阔腿裤、系带高跟穆勒鞋，叠戴着粗金链项链，超大号圆环耳环在电影级光线下熠熠生辉。她被描绘成坐在一部巨大的超大号智能手机屏幕内，置身于一个原创的虚构社交媒体个人资料界面中——风格借鉴了 Instagram 的视觉语言但完全原创——包含账号 {argument name="handle" default="@zendaya"}、圆形个人头像、显示为 {argument name="followers" default="287.4M"} 的粉丝数、置顶帖子轮播图，以及在柔和的淡紫色屏幕光中发光的简洁 UI 按钮。通过极端的强制透视和戏剧性的广角构图，她完全冲破了手机屏幕：一只戴着叠戴金戒指的手以从容的自信直接伸向镜头，而她的长腿和系带高跟鞋则延伸到手机下边框之外，打破了屏幕与现实的界限。深度错觉感达到极致——超电影感，具有《Vogue》封面般的张力。背景是一个装饰奢华的豪华卧室——墙上叠放着装裱好的杂志照片、拍立得拼贴画和霓虹背光艺术印刷品，展示了她职业生涯中的各个瞬间。空间中自由漂浮着：虹彩香槟金和深李子色的气球、捕捉着暖光的层叠水钻碎片、悬浮在半空中的破碎透明玻璃碎片，以及慢动作漂浮的超细金粉颗粒。房间色调：深紫红与香槟色，点缀着古董金金属色。灯光：好莱坞魅力三点式布光——来自手机屏幕的冷蓝白主光、来自室内实用灯具的暖琥珀色补光，以及勾勒她轮廓的锐利金色轮廓光。变形镜头光晕在屏幕破裂点处划过。细微的金色散景颗粒在背景景深中闪烁。渲染风格：超写实主义杂志摄影与超现实 CGI 合成。ARRI Alexa 65 摄影机，Panavision 变形镜头，采用浓郁暖色调 LUT 进行调色，高光边缘带有光晕效果，符合《Vogue》标准的精修质感。纵横比 2:3 竖屏。氛围：不可触及的明星贵族感——从互联网中走出，从容不迫，极具磁性。

templates.title: Minimalist Black and White Fashion Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 极简黑白时尚肖像

templates.prompt: A high-contrast black and white studio portrait, featuring the subject of the uploaded image.{argument name="subject" default="handsome man"} He sat in a minimalist, dark wooden chair with a颓废 (颓废 is a difficult word to translate directly, but it conveys a sense of decadence, listlessness, and apathy) and 心心 (心心 is a difficult word to translate directly, but it conveys a sense of contemplation, apathy, and apathy) posture. His right elbow rested on his knee, his head was heavily propped up in his hands, and his left hand loosely held a white disposable coffee cup with a black plastic lid. He wore classic Wayfarer-style black sunglasses, which obscured his eyes and added to the austere, melancholic atmosphere. Suit:{argument name="clothing" default="An oversized black suit jacket paired with matching wide-leg trousers."} The fabric is a thick, matte wool material. Four small black buttons are visible at the cuffs. Shoes and socks: Crisp, bright white ribbed cotton socks create a strong visual contrast between the dark trousers and shoes. Footwear: High-gloss black Oxford shoes with thin laces and a subtle sheen at the toe. Background: A minimalist, clean studio environment with a light gray or off-white textured stucco wall as the backdrop. A soft vertical shadow or the edge of a curtain is visible on the far left. Lighting:{argument name="lighting" default="Soft, diffused sidelight"} The lighting creates subtle gradations on the man's face and deep, dramatic folds on his oversized suit. The interplay of light and shadow emphasizes a high-contrast aesthetic of stark black and white. The floor: a light-colored, seamless studio floor that reflects the soft shadows cast by the chair legs and the man's shoes. Color grading: pure monochrome (black and white) with a wide dynamic range—deep blacks and bright, clean whites. Image quality: sharp focus with very subtle film grain, mimicking professional fashion editorial photography (reminiscent of minimalist 1990s advertising campaigns).

promptLocalized.zh:
一张高对比度的黑白摄影棚肖像，主角为上传图片中的 {argument name="subject" default="英俊男子"}。他以一种颓废、沉思的姿态坐在极简风格的深色木椅上。他的右肘靠在膝盖上，头部沉重地倚在手掌中，左手松散地握着一个带有黑色塑料盖的白色一次性咖啡杯。他戴着经典的 Wayfarer 风格黑色墨镜，遮住了双眼，增添了冷峻、忧郁的氛围。西装：{argument name="clothing" default="一件超大廓形的黑色西装外套，搭配同款阔腿长裤"}。面料为厚实的哑光羊毛材质。袖口处可见四颗小巧的黑色纽扣。
鞋袜：清爽的亮白色罗纹棉袜，在深色长裤与鞋子之间形成了强烈的视觉分割。
鞋履：高光泽的黑色牛津皮鞋，配有细鞋带，鞋头带有微弱的光泽。
背景：极简、纯净的摄影棚环境，背景为浅灰色或灰白色的纹理灰泥墙。最左侧可见一道柔和的垂直阴影或幕布边缘。
光影：{argument name="lighting" default="柔和的漫射侧光"}，在男子的面部营造出细腻的渐变，并在超大廓形的西装上形成深邃、戏剧性的褶皱。光影强调了“黑白分明”的高对比度美学。
地面：浅色无缝摄影棚地面，映衬出椅腿和男子的鞋子投下的柔和阴影。
调色：纯单色（黑白），具有宽广的动态范围——深邃的黑色与明亮、干净的白色。画质：主体焦点清晰，带有非常细微的胶片颗粒感，模仿专业的时尚编辑摄影（让人联想到 1990 年代的极简主义广告大片）。

templates.title: Bangkok night street photography

titleLocalized.zh: 曼谷夜间街头摄影

templates.prompt: A street photograph captured a{argument name="subject" default="Young Thai woman"} Pass through{argument name="location" default="Khao San Road, Bangkok"} A fleeting moment in a crowded night market. The main figure is walking forward, wearing {argument name="clothing" default="loose floral dress"} His expression was natural but slightly distracted; he wasn't looking at the camera and had a small crossbody bag slung over his shoulder. The environment was dense and chaotic: Thai and English bar signs were stacked vertically, tuk-tuks and motorcycles weaved through the crowds, and tourists and locals mingled in the moving throng. The lighting was chaotic and realistic: uneven illumination from bar fluorescent lights, diffused light from LED signs, and occasional flashes of light reflected from the crowd—there was no single, clean light source. Composition: A mid-range shot, slightly above eye level, with the subject positioned in the center left of the frame and clearly in focus. The surrounding crowd exhibited natural motion blur, and the neon signs extended upwards in the vertical composition. Color Tone: Acid yellow, electric pink, and deep orange—strong neon saturation, consistent with documentary realism rather than stylized processing. Rendering Requirements: Photographic realism with subtle film grain, avoiding an overly smooth CG texture. Skin: With subsurface scattering and micro-texture. templates.title: 3D Abstract Fluid Art Poster

templates.prompt: A mesmerizing and vibrantly colored vertical poster showcases a colossal 3D fluidic sculpture form and massive, glossy, deformable droplets composed of vivid, electric colors—a giant molten form in a passionate magenta flows downwards and drips, merging with a massive vortex of electric cobalt blue; a third, neon lime green fluid curls upwards like a broken wave. These three fluid forms collide at the center, creating a spectacular splash explosion effect, with hundreds of colorful droplets solidifying in mid-air. Each fluid surface possesses a perfect mirror finish, reflecting dazzling, distorted highlights of the surrounding colors. The clean, bright white background amplifies the visual impact of the vibrant color explosion. Smaller, floating 3D geometries (spheres, cubes, and rhombuses) surround the main fluid in candy yellow, coral orange, and violet. At the top, bold, rounded white lettering with a black outline proclaims the large, bouncy “LET IT FLOW,” followed by a smaller subtitle, “Create without limits.” Scattered with tiny sparks and splashing symbols, ultra-high saturation, extremely visually impactful, high-quality 3D rendering, 9:16 vertical aspect ratio.

templates.title: High-end graphic design portfolio mockup

titleLocalized.zh: 高端平面设计作品集样机

templates.prompt: Create a high-end graphic design portfolio mockup in the style of a professional creative studio. Showcase a clean, elegant workspace featuring multiple graphic design project cards arranged in a sophisticated grid layout, a modern laptop screen displaying the portfolio's main page, and numerous printed posters neatly arranged on the desktop and hanging on the wall. Employ a refined creative director aesthetic, utilizing soft shadows, subtle depth of field, realistic materials, and a high-end studio atmosphere. Include stylish typographic placeholders, brand brochures, editorial-style poster designs, business cards, stationery, notebooks, pens, coffee mugs, lamps, and small potted plants to create a realistic studio scene. The design should feature a clean grid layout, balanced spacing, soft, realistic shadows, high-quality lighting, and neutral luxury tones such as black, white, warm beige, gray, champagne, and cream. The laptop screen should display a minimalist portfolio interface, including project thumbnails, navigation menus, and prominent main heading text. Add multiple portfolio project cards, such as logo design, brand identity, poster design, packaging design, social media design, UI/UX design, and advertising campaign mockups. All elements are professionally arranged in a modern minimalist style, presenting clear details, clean typography, elegant composition, and the display effect of a high-end creative agency. Style: High-end graphic design portfolio, modern creative studio, luxury brand mockup, clean desktop layout, realistic shadows, editorial layout, minimalist high-end design, professional display, 4K, ultra-fine detail.

promptLocalized.zh:
创建一个专业创意工作室风格的高端平面设计作品集样机。展示一个整洁、优雅的工作空间，其中包含以精致网格布局排列的多个平面设计项目卡片、显示作品集主页的现代笔记本电脑屏幕，以及整齐摆放在桌面上和挂在墙上的多张印刷海报。

采用精致的创意总监美学，运用柔和的阴影、微妙的景深、逼真的材质和高端的工作室氛围。包含时尚的排版占位符、品牌样本、编辑风格的海报设计、名片、文具、笔记本、钢笔、咖啡杯、台灯和小盆栽，以营造逼真的工作室场景。

设计应具备整洁的网格布局、均衡的间距、柔和逼真的阴影、优质的灯光，以及黑色、白色、暖米色、灰色、香槟色和奶油色等中性奢华色调。笔记本电脑屏幕应显示极简的作品集界面，包含项目缩略图、导航菜单和醒目的主标题文字。

添加多个作品集项目卡片，例如 Logo 设计、品牌识别、海报设计、包装设计、社交媒体设计、UI/UX 设计和广告活动样机。以现代极简风格专业地排列所有元素，呈现清晰的细节、整洁的排版、优雅的构图以及高端创意代理公司的展示效果。

templates.title: 1990s flash photography of portraits

titleLocalized.zh: 90 年代闪光灯抓拍人像

templates.prompt: Please use the uploaded image as the primary reference. Transform the uploaded photo into a realistic candid portrait with the aesthetic of early 1990s digital cameras. Preserve the subject's identity, facial features, pose, clothing, and overall composition, but reshape the image using strong flash highlights, slight red-eye effect, low resolution, raw candid imperfections, a nostalgic flash filter style, and a vintage timestamp look. The final image should have a casual, imperfect, and authentic feel, like a retro party or personal snapshot taken with an early consumer digital camera. Keep the background dark or naturally soft where appropriate, maintain the visual effect of direct flash, and give the image a raw, unretouched, and nostalgic atmosphere. Includes: - Strong direct camera flash - Overexposure or highlight clipping - Slight red-eye effect - Low resolution/soft digital detail - Slight graininess or noise texture - Authentic retro candid feel - Vintage date/timestamp aesthetics at the edges - Casual, natural, imperfect energy Avoid: - Cartoon or anime style - Overly retouched beauty filters - Studio lighting - Ultra-sharp modern DSLR visuals - Smooth AI skin - Overlays of text, logos, watermarks, or graphics other than timestamps - Anatomical distortion or identity alteration Set aspect ratio to 3:4

promptLocalized.zh:
请使用上传的图像作为主要参考。

将上传的照片转换为具有 90 年代初数码相机美感的写实抓拍人像。保留拍摄对象的身份、面部特征、姿势、服装和整体构图，但通过强烈的闪光灯高光、轻微的红眼效果、低分辨率画质、原始抓拍瑕疵、怀旧闪光灯滤镜风格以及复古时间戳外观来重塑图像。

templates.title: Modern geometric portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 现代几何多边形肖像

templates.prompt: Please create a drawing based on the uploaded photo.{argument name="style" default="Modern geometric style"} Portrait art posters. The subject's features must be meticulously preserved, including face shape, proportions, hairstyle, expression, and overall demeanor, ensuring the final image clearly identifies the same person or public figure. The overall style leans towards "contemporary geometric portraiture + fashion magazine illustration + gallery art poster." The face is composed of simplified polygonal facets, geometric color blocks, and clear outlines, maintaining a degree of abstraction while preserving recognizability. Facial features can be moderately simplified, such as graphically summarizing the eyes, nose, and mouth, without losing individual charm. Hair can be treated with geometric blocks and polygonal outlines, emphasizing facets and abstract polygonal composition in the facial structure. The overall image employs flat color blocks, clean vector shapes, clear outlines, white space, and poster-quality composition. Slight additions of oil pastel grain, screen printing noise, hand-drawn graffiti marks, and paint textures are permissible to achieve a high-end art print poster effect. A simple and vibrant color scheme is recommended, utilizing black, charcoal gray, cream white, cobalt blue, brick red, mustard yellow, sage green, coral pink, and warm beige. Backgrounds can be deep matte black, deep charcoal gray, or sophisticated solid colors to enhance the texture of gallery posters and fashion covers. The composition should resemble high-end art posters or fashion covers, with the main subject at the center, leaving space for titles and subheadings, creating a modern, artistic, and stylish atmosphere. Avoid: realistic rendering, 3D effects, anime style, cheap cartoonish feel, excessive Cubism, direct imitation of Picasso, complex and cluttered backgrounds, or overly distorted features.

promptLocalized.zh: 请根据上传的照片创作一张 {argument name="style" default="现代几何多边形风格"} 的肖像艺术海报。必须严格保留人物特征，包括脸型、五官比例、发型轮廓、表情及整体气质，确保最终图像能清晰辨识出是同一人或公众人物。整体风格倾向于“当代几何肖像 + 时尚杂志插画 + 画廊艺术海报”。面部由简化的多边形切面、几何色块和清晰的轮廓线构成，在保持一定抽象感的同时保留人物辨识度。五官可适度简化，例如将眼、鼻、口进行图形化概括，但不失个人神韵。头发可处理为具有几何体块感和多边形轮廓，面部结构强调切面感和抽象多边形构成。整体画面采用平涂色块、干净的矢量形状、清晰的轮廓线、留白以及海报级构图。允许加入轻微的油画棒颗粒感、丝网印刷噪点、手绘涂鸦痕迹和颜料质感，使其呈现出高端艺术印刷海报的效果。建议配色方案应简洁且鲜明，可使用黑色、炭灰色、奶油白、钴蓝色、砖红色、芥末黄、鼠尾草绿、珊瑚粉、暖米色等。背景可采用深哑光黑、深炭灰或高级纯色，以增强画廊海报和时尚封面的质感。构图应类似高端艺术海报或时尚封面，以主体为核心，留出标题和副标题的排版空间，营造现代、艺术且时尚的氛围。避免：写实渲染、3D 效果、动漫风格、廉价卡通感、过度立体主义、直接模仿毕加索、复杂杂乱的背景或过度扭曲的特征。

templates.prompt: Based on 1-3 clear personal photos uploaded by the user, generate a 2x2 collage portrait, with each image in a 3:4 aspect ratio, and the theme is "{argument name="theme" default="Fun Hanfu Graduation Photos"} [Character Consistency] Strictly retain the user's real identity characteristics, including face shape, facial proportions, eyes, nose, lips, skin tone, perceived age, basic hairstyle, and overall temperament. In the four small images, the user must clearly present the same real girl; she cannot be a stranger, cannot have a Westernized look, cannot have excessive skin smoothing, and cannot have an AI-generated "fake face" feel. [Overall Style] The "New Chinese Style" graduation photo style popular on Chinese social media, emphasizing a playful, lively, energetic, cute, and pleasing atmosphere. The images should present a set of relaxed and fun creative graduation photos, suitable for sharing, with an overall clean and bright look, and a subtle Chinese sweet aesthetic. [Makeup] Sweet and clear girlish makeup. Light and translucent base makeup, retaining natural skin tone. Eye makeup uses light apricot pink, peach pink, or warm brown tones, paired with soft eyeliner and naturally curled eyelashes. Blush is peach or apple pink, and lip color is cream pink, peach, or coral. The overall makeup should appear youthful and vibrant. [Hairstyle] Extend your hair naturally from the original length in the uploaded photo, prioritizing hairstyles suitable for wearing with a floral graduation cap. - Long hair: Half-up, double braids, low double buns, or a soft updo with wispy strands. - Medium-length hair: Half-up, double braids, or a low updo. - Short hair: Tucked behind the ears or French curls, paired with a small floral cap. Avoid excessive hair obscuring the graduation cap or face in all four photos. [Clothing and Accessories] Fun Hanfu graduation attire, in light green, pinkish-white, light yellow, or off-white colors. Lightweight fabric with embroidery, cross-collar, wide sleeves, and detailed patterns. Must be paired with a floral graduation cap or a cap with a few tassels. [Scenes and Props] A clean and bright Chinese-style photography studio space with beige, warm white, or light wood backgrounds. Decorative elements include cherry blossom branches, small wooden tables, vases, books, and scrolls. Props include calligraphy brushes, scrolls, and wooden items inscribed with traditional calligraphy (such as "Happy Graduation" or "Bright Future"). [Light and Shadow & Texture] Soft and bright lighting, with an overall clear and warm feel. The delicate textures of fabrics and accessories are presented. The subject looks at the camera with a gentle smile, holding a small wooden item. Focus on facial features and the graduation cap. 2. Top Right: Full-body shot. Showcasing the complete attire and graduation cap, holding a calligraphy brush and scroll, revealing a natural and bright smile. The pose is dynamic. 3. Bottom Left: Playful action shot. 3/4 side view, tilting the head or winking, emphasizing a playful feel. 4. Bottom right: Interacting with books/scrolls. Sitting or leaning against a table, reading or looking gently at the camera; foreground flowers add depth of field. [Consistency] Ensure the people, clothing, caps, makeup, and scene tones are highly consistent across all four images.

promptLocalized.zh:
基于用户上传的 1-3 张清晰个人照片，生成一个 2x2 的拼图写真，单张图片比例为 3:4，主题为“{argument name="theme" default="趣味汉服毕业照"}”。

[人物一致性]
严格保留用户的真实身份特征，包括脸型、面部比例、眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇、肤色、年龄感、发型基础及整体气质。在四张小图中，必须清晰地呈现为同一位真实的女孩，不能是陌生人，不能有西化感，不能过度磨皮，且不能有 AI 的“假脸”感。

[整体风格]
中国社交媒体上流行的“新中式”毕业照风格，主打俏皮、灵动、元气、可爱且讨喜的氛围。画面应呈现出一组轻松有趣的创意毕业照，适合分享，整体干净明亮，带有微妙的中国式甜美审美。

[妆容]
甜美清透的少女妆。轻薄通透的底妆，保留自然肤色。眼妆采用浅杏粉、桃粉或暖棕色调，搭配柔和的眼线和自然卷翘的睫毛。腮红为桃色或苹果粉，唇色为奶油粉、桃色或珊瑚色。整体妆容应显得年轻且充满活力。

[发型]
在上传照片原有的发长基础上自然延伸，优先考虑适合佩戴装饰花朵学士帽的发型。
- 长发：半扎发、双侧麻花辫、低双丸子头或带有碎发的柔和盘发。
- 中长发：半扎发、双麻花辫或低位盘发。
- 短发：别在耳后或法式短卷发，搭配小型花朵帽。
在四张图中均应避免头发过度遮挡学士帽或面部。

[服装与配饰]
趣味汉服毕业装，颜色选用浅绿、粉白、浅黄或奶白色。轻盈的面料配以刺绣、交领、广袖及细节纹样。必须搭配装饰有花朵的学士帽或带有少量流苏的毕业帽。

[场景与道具]
干净明亮的中国风摄影棚空间，背景为米色、暖白色或浅木色。装饰元素包括樱花枝、小木桌、花瓶、书籍和卷轴。道具包括毛笔、卷轴以及写有传统书法（如“毕业快乐”或“前程似锦”）的木质项目。

[光影与质感]
柔和明亮的光线，整体清晰温润。呈现细腻的布料和配饰质感。带有轻微的柔焦效果，但避免过于锐利或商业广告感。

[固定 4 格构图]
1. 左上：特写主视觉。人物面带温柔微笑看向镜头，手持小型木质项目。聚焦面部特征和学士帽。
2. 右上：全身照。展示完整的服装和学士帽，手持毛笔和卷轴，露出自然明亮的笑容。姿态灵动。
3. 左下：趣味动作照。3/4 侧面视角，歪头或眨眼，强调俏皮感。
4. 右下：与书籍/卷轴互动。坐姿或倚靠在桌边，阅读或温柔地看向镜头，前景点缀花朵以增加景深。

[一致性]
确保四张图片中的人物、服装、学士帽、妆容和场景色调保持高度一致。

promptLocalized.zh: 一张壮观且色彩鲜艳的复古未来主义竖版海报，构图大胆，主体为一艘厚实的 3D 卡通火箭飞船，颜色为 {argument name="rocket color" default="亮面糖果红"}，配有亮黄色尾翼和圆形舷窗，正向上发射，尾部拖着厚重且呈漩涡状的彩虹尾气云，颜色为 {argument name="cloud colors" default="电光粉、青色、酸橙绿和橙色"}。火箭周围环绕着巨大的 3D 行星，每颗行星颜色各异：一颗巨大的条纹木星，呈暖橙色和奶油色；一颗带环的土星，呈柔和的淡紫色，配有发光的金色光环；一颗微小的地球，呈鲜艳的绿松石色和翡翠绿。深钴蓝色的天空渐变背景上散布着数十颗亮黄色和白色的 3D 光泽星星，背景从顶部的浓郁宝蓝色过渡到底部的暖紫色。画面中还有一个悬浮的 3D 宇航员头盔，采用铬合金材质，面罩反射出彩虹光泽。顶部采用粗体圆润排版，文字为 "{argument name="main text" default="SHOOT FOR THE STARS"}"，字母呈现从热粉色到电光黄的巨大渐变色。下方是较小的活泼副标题 "{argument name="subtitle" default="Dream big · Launch bigger"}"。构图中散布着微小的闪光和彗星尾迹符号，整体色彩极其鲜艳饱和，具备高级 3D 插画品质，比例为 9:16 竖版。

Rounded cheeks, a dreamlike, innocent expression, playful asymmetrical proportions, a long, elegant neck, simplified geometric facial planes, stylized angular hairstyles, subtle cartoon aesthetics, and childlike artistic distortions. Using clean, scalable vector shapes, flat color blocks, bold, raw outlines, sharp Bézier curves, abstract polygonal compositions, minimalist lines, a naive, hand-painted texture, expressive white space, iconic facial abstraction, no realistic rendering, and 2D raw facial symbols. 圆润的脸颊，梦幻般天真的表情，俏皮的非对称比例，修长优雅的颈部，简化的几何面部平面，风格化的棱角发型，微妙的漫画美学，童趣的艺术变形。

templates.prompt: Objective: Create isometric sprite sheets for the Merge 2 cooking game, showcasing the evolution from a simple rolling pin to a sophisticated Pasta Maker. Canvas: 4:3 landscape canvas, light neutral gray background, no borders, no text, no watermarks. Arrange the sprite sheets in a neat 3x4 grid, maintaining ample spacing, and add soft shadows beneath each object. Visual Style: Refined mobile game asset style, semi-realistic cartoon rendering, isometric three-quarter view, sharp outlines, warm highlights, delicate textures, consistent proportions, clean sprite sheets suitable for casual merging game stock. Main Details: Show 12 independent evolution stages, from left to right, top to bottom: 1. A simple wooden rolling pin with a rounded handle. 2. A smooth, light-colored ball of dough next to a wooden rolling pin. 3. A wooden rolling pin resting on a rectangular wooden item, flattening a sheet of dough. 4. A small wooden manual pasta machine with two shiny metal rollers, a crank handle, and a flat pasta sheet being output. 5. A compact gray metal manual pasta cutter with a crank handle, producing flat, ribbon-like noodles. 6. A light blue manual pasta cutter with silver rollers and a crank handle, producing curly pasta. 7. A cream and light blue electric upright pasta machine with a metal mixing bowl, pressing short noodles into the bowl. 8. A cream and light blue countertop electric pasta machine with a clear top cover, a round front nozzle, side buttons, and pasta output. 9. A beige electric pasta machine with a silver top roller, a front dough sheet outlet, a side knob, and two detachable small pasta cutters. 10. A heavy, polished silver manual pasta machine with wide rollers, a crank handle, a black knob, and multiple flat dough sheets output from the front. 11. A modern, fully automatic stainless steel pasta maker with dark side panels, a clear lid, a small blue digital display, control buttons, a front-mounted extrusion nozzle, and several strands of pasta flowing out. 12. A high-end, luxurious black and gold fully automatic pasta maker with a clear lid, a crown logo on the front panel, an illuminated control panel, gold trim, and thick, flat pasta flowing from the front. promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 Merge 2 烹饪游戏创建等距视角物体进化精灵图，展示从简单的擀面杖到高级 Pasta Maker 的进化过程。

画布：4:3 横向画布，浅中性灰背景，无边框，无文字，无水印。将精灵图排列成整齐的 3 行 4 列网格，保持充裕的间距，并在每个物体下方添加柔和阴影。

视觉风格：精致的手机游戏资源风格，半写实卡通渲染，等距四分之三视角，清晰的轮廓，温暖的高光，细腻的材质，统一的比例，适合休闲合成游戏库存的干净抠图精灵。

主体细节：展示 12 个独立的进化阶段，从左到右，从上到下：
1. 一根带有圆润手柄的简单木制擀面杖。
2. 一根木制擀面杖旁边放着一个光滑的浅色面团球。
3. 一根木制擀面杖放在长方形木制项目上，正在压平一张面皮。
4. 一台小型木制手动压面机，带有两个闪亮的金属滚轴、曲柄手柄，以及一张正在输出的扁平意大利面皮。
5. 一台紧凑型灰色金属手动切面机，带有曲柄手柄，可制作扁平的丝带状面条。
6. 一台青蓝色手动切面机，带有银色滚轴和曲柄手柄，可制作卷曲的意大利面条。
7. 一台奶油色与青色相间的电动立式压面机，配有金属搅拌碗，将短面条挤压到碗中。
8. 一台奶油色与青色相间的台式电动压面机，带有透明顶盖、圆形前喷嘴、侧面按钮，并有意大利面条流出。
9. 一台米色电动压面机，带有银色顶部滚轴、前部面皮出口、侧面旋钮，旁边放置两个可拆卸的小型切面附件。
10. 一台厚重的抛光银色手动压面机，带有宽滚轴、曲柄手柄、黑色旋钮，前端输出多条扁平的面带。
11. 一台现代不锈钢全自动 Pasta Maker，带有深色侧板、透明盖、小型蓝色数字显示屏、控制按钮、前部挤压喷嘴，并有几根面条流出。
12. 一台高端黑金配色豪华全自动 Pasta Maker，带有透明盖、前面板上的皇冠标志、发光的控制面板、金色装饰，以及从前端流出的粗扁面条。

约束：保持所有物体作为独立的精灵图，在所有 12 个阶段中保持相同的等距视角和光照，强调视觉升级路径，避免添加标签、箭头、手部、人物或厨房背景。

templates.title: Screenshots from the Mystic Ruins platform game

titleLocalized.zh: Mystic Ruins 平台游戏截图

templates.prompt: Objective: For the name{argument name="level title" default="MYSTIC RUINS"} This image showcases a meticulously crafted 2D side-scrolling platformer concept, featuring a playable prototype scene with HUD elements. Canvas: Widescreen cinematic 24:9 game screenshot, approximately 1200 x 450 pixels. Utilizes layered parallax composition with strong depth: dark foreground silhouettes, mid-ground playable platforms, and a misty, glowing background. No borders or watermarks. Scene: A magical ancient forest ruin at sunset/night, lit with warm orange, magenta, purple, and deep navy blue lighting. The environment features dense, twisted trees, hanging vines, moss, floating dust/fireflies, broken stone arches, a distant waterfall, and oversized bioluminescent mushrooms emitting pink, purple, and amber glows. The atmosphere is comfortable, mysterious, adventurous, and highly fantastical. Layout and Scene Element Statistics: Includes 4 main walkable platforms: In the upper left is a large, dark, moss-covered rock ledge with a giant, glowing purple-pink mushroom; in the center is a moss-covered platform where a hero stands; in the upper right is a raised, abandoned stone platform with broken pillars and hanging lanterns; in the lower right is a moss-covered platform with a glowing mushroom. A distant abandoned archway and cliff are included in the background, but remain non-playable and atmospheric. Place the hero slightly to the left of the central platform. Hero Character: A small, cute, anthropomorphic fox adventurer, chibi-style, with orange fur, a cream-colored snout and tail tip, wearing brown adventurer attire with boots, a belt, and a scarf or shawl, holding a warm-glowing lantern. The character should face right in a standby pose, clearly visible in the environment as a playable sprite. HUD and Text Content: The upper left HUD features a "HEALTH" label in small, light gold pixel/fantasy UI font, with 3 glowing heart icons below. The bottom displays "LIVES 03". The bottom left HUD has an "ABILITIES" label and two square skill icons: a dash/slash icon and a lantern/light icon. The top right HUD displays a small coin icon followed by "128", with "SCORE 02450" displayed below. The bottom right corner displays the level title.{argument name="level title" default="MYSTIC RUINS"} The logo features widely spaced white-gold capital letters with a thin decorative line below. Visual Style: High-quality painterly 2D game art, whimsical platformer concept art, soft glow effects, volumetric fog, cinematic rim lighting, crisp, legible silhouettes, detailed vegetation and moss, glowing particles, warm lantern lighting, and vibrant fantasy color gradations suitable for 2D platformer prototypes. Constraints: Keep images as single in-game screenshots, not menus or posters. Ensure all HUD text is crisp and legible. Do not add extra hearts, skill icons, characters, enemies, dialogue boxes, logos, or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为名为 {argument name="level title" default="MYSTIC RUINS"} 的奇幻游戏关卡创建一个精致的 2D 横版平台游戏概念截图，展示带有 HUD 元素的试玩原型场景。

画布：宽屏电影级 24:9 游戏截图，尺寸约为 1200×450 像素。使用具有强烈纵深感的分层视差构图：深色前景剪影、中景可玩平台以及雾气缭绕的发光背景。无边框或水印。

场景：日落/夜晚的魔法古森林遗迹，采用暖橙色、洋红色、紫色和深海军蓝色的灯光。环境中有茂密的扭曲树木、悬挂的藤蔓、苔藓、漂浮的尘埃/萤火虫、破碎的石拱门、远处的瀑布，以及散发着粉色、紫色和琥珀色光芒的超大生物发光蘑菇。氛围舒适、神秘、充满冒险感且具有高奇幻色彩。

布局与场景元素统计：包含 4 个主要的可行走平台：左上方有一个巨大的长满苔藓的深色岩架，上面有一朵巨大的发光紫粉色蘑菇；中心是一个英雄站立的苔藓覆盖平台；右上角是一个升高的废弃石制平台，带有断裂的石柱和悬挂的灯笼；右下方是一个长满苔藓的平台，上面有发光蘑菇。背景中加入远处的废弃拱门和悬崖，但保持其为不可玩且具有氛围感的背景。将英雄放置在中心平台偏左的位置。

英雄角色：一只小巧可爱的拟人化狐狸冒险家，Q 版比例，橙色皮毛，奶油色的口鼻部和尾尖，穿着棕色冒险家服装，配有靴子、腰带、围巾或小披肩，手持一盏发出暖光的灯笼。角色应面向右侧处于待机姿势，作为可玩精灵在环境中清晰可见。

HUD 与文本内容：左上角 HUD 带有小号淡金色像素/奇幻 UI 字体的“HEALTH”标签，下方有 3 个发光的心形图标。下方显示“LIVES 03”。左下角 HUD 带有“ABILITIES”标签和 2 个方形技能图标：一个冲刺/斩击图标和一个灯笼/光照图标。右上角 HUD 显示一个小金币图标，后跟“128”，下方显示“SCORE 02450”。右下角显示关卡标题“{argument name="level title" default="MYSTIC RUINS"}”，采用间距较宽的白金色大写字母，下方有一条细装饰线。

视觉风格：高质量绘画风格 2D 游戏美术，异想天开的平台游戏概念艺术，柔和的辉光效果，体积雾，电影级边缘光，清晰易读的剪影，细腻的植被和苔藓，发光粒子，温暖的灯笼光，鲜艳的奇幻色彩分级，适合 2D 平台游戏原型。

约束：保持图像为单张游戏截图，而非菜单或海报。确保所有 HUD 文本清晰易读。不要添加额外的爱心、技能图标、角色、敌人、对话框、徽标或水印。

templates.title: 16-Grid Football Dream Project

titleLocalized.zh: 16 格足球梦想项目

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a cinematic 4x4 project poster for an emotionally rich sports animation video, telling the story {argument name="character name" default="A blonde girl"} The story of overcoming rejection, pain, injuries, and loneliness to ultimately become a professional football player and achieve success. Canvas: A 4:5 aspect ratio vertical poster with a deep, cinematic color palette, realistic anime aesthetics, warm golden highlights, deep shadows, dramatic rain scenes, and stadium lighting. The canvas is precisely divided into 16 equal black grid panels, each labeled with a number from 1 to 16 in the upper left corner. Each panel features a striking yellow capital title and brief white punctuation on the left, with the main panel featuring an illustration of an emotional scene. A full-width banner at the bottom, titled "VIDEO PROMPT (FOR THIS STORY)," includes a prompt and a football graphic on the right. Protagonist: A teenage girl with messy short blonde hair, petite yet athletic, with expressive body language, typically wearing a dark football training kit or a black football jersey with the number 7. Her face may be softly obscured or in shadow to emphasize the cinematic feel. Showcasing her journey from a lonely beginner to a celebrated star. Project Panel: Using 16 numbered chapters and scene concepts: 1. "Dream Takes Flight" — A girl holds a soccer ball by a city fence at night, watching a soccer match on a glowing screen in the distance; Key points: Dreaming of becoming a soccer star, watching matches late at night, practicing alone in empty streets, believing that soccer is her destiny. 2. "No Support" — A girl stands with her arms crossed, surrounded by silhouettes of classmates or family members who laugh at or ignore her; Key points: People say soccer is not suitable for girls, friends laugh at her dream, family worries about her future, but she never gives up. 3. "Daily Training" — A street training scene in the rain, the girl struggles to dribble the ball through puddles before sunrise; Key points: Waking up before sunrise, running in the rain and cold morning, practicing dribbling for hours, learning self-discipline and patience. 4. "First Major Setback" — A girl sits alone crying by a barbed wire fence after being rejected, with a soccer ball and a piece of paper that says "REJECTED" at her feet; Key points: Rejected by the local soccer academy, crying alone after the selection match, feeling heartbroken and exhausted, deciding to try again after becoming stronger. 5. "The Hardest Stage" — A weary girl studies under a lamp, her desk piled high with books and soccer notes, demonstrating the balance between academics and sports; Key point: Balancing studies, work, and soccer, shoes wear out, training on rough fields, silently pursuing her dream. 6. "A Tiny Opportunity" — A local coach stands beside a muddy training field, noticing her talent; Key point: The local coach discovers her talent, she's invited to join a small girls' team, begins learning true teamwork, and gradually builds confidence. 7. "Self-Shaping" — Intense fitness/training scenes, using dumbbells or a stationary bike, sweat and dramatic lighting; Key point: Improving speed and endurance, learning powerful shooting techniques, studying professional players, becoming stronger. 8. "First Tournament" — A girl wearing a black number 7 jersey celebrates or shoots under the stadium lights; Key point: Participating in her first important match, feeling nervous before kickoff, scoring her first goal, her teammates finally recognizing her talent. 9. "Injured but not defeated" — A girl sits on the sidelines with her leg or ankle bandaged, injured but determined; Key point: Suffering a painful injury, unable to play for weeks, watching others from the sidelines, persevering through pain and recovery. 10. "Back on the field" — A girl in a number 7 jersey, her back to her teammates at sunset on the training field, rejoining them; Key point: Becoming stronger than before, training twice as hard every day, earning the respect of teammates, becoming a core player on the team. 11. "Viral spread" — A close-up of a smartphone showing her match clip going viral, surrounded by likes and comments on social media; Key point: The match clip went viral online, people began to pay attention to her talent, she gained fans and supporters, and her story inspired young girls. 12. "The championship battle" — A huge stadium brightly lit, the number 7 girl scores the winning goal or celebrates amidst sparks and cheers; Key point: Participating in the most important game of her life, the stadium lights shining, scoring the winning goal, the whole stadium chanting her name. 13. "National Team Selection" — A girl stands against the city skyline at sunset, backpack on her back, ready to head to a bigger stadium; a subtle "INDIA" logo can be added to her clothing or bag if desired; Key point: Selected for the national training team, heading to a big city, facing stronger opponents, and pushing her limits. 14. "Becoming a Star" — A magazine cover or interview scene where she holds a soccer ball, with headlines like "SPORTS WEEKLY" and the inspirational slogan "NO DREAM IS TOO BIG"; Key point: Appearing in interviews and magazines, signing with a professional club, inspiring millions of girls, and proving that dreams know no gender. 15. "Realizing a Dream" — A panoramic view of the stadium, with number 7 girl raising her arms amidst cheers from the crowd; Key point: Playing in a major sporting event, proudly supporting her family, smiling as she recalls past struggles, and finally living the life she dreamed of. 16. “Moment of Pride” — An emotional close-up of a successful player holding a ball under the stadium lights, reminiscing about their younger days; Key point: Looking at an old football from their youth, remembering every failure and sacrifice, realizing that the struggle made them stronger, and that their dream finally came true. Bottom Banner: Add a full-width dark rectangular banner below the 16 panels. Bold yellow title: “VIDEO PROMPT (FOR THIS STORY)”. Small white text: “Create a cinematic and moving video telling the story of a blonde girl’s journey to becoming a professional football player. Showcase her journey from being ignored, facing failure, injuries, and rejection, to rising to stardom through hard work and determination. Include training, emotions, matches, crowds, celebrations, and struggles in real life. End with her achieving her dream and inspiring millions. The video should be inspiring, emotionally resonant, and visually stunning.” Place a realistic football on a grassy field on the far right of the banner. Visual Style: Realistic anime sports drama project, emotional close-ups, dynamic camera angles, rough textures, rain, dirt, glowing stadium lights, warm amber rim lighting, deep blue nighttime shadows, high-contrast cinematic composition, and an inspirational atmosphere. Constraints: Maintain 16 numbered panels plus a bottom prompt banner. Always use the same blonde soccer girl. Text must be clear but concise. No extra panels, no watermarks, no irrelevant characters, and no comedic tone.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为一部情感丰富的体育动漫视频创建一个电影感 4x4 项目海报，讲述 {argument name="character name" default="一位金发少女"} 如何克服拒绝、痛苦、伤病和孤独，最终通过努力成为职业足球运动员并取得成功的故事。

画布：4:5 比例的竖版海报，深色电影级调色，写实动漫美学，温暖的金色高光，深邃的阴影，戏剧性的雨景和体育场灯光。将画布精确划分为 16 个相等的黑色网格面板，每个面板左上角用黑色小方块标注 1 到 16 的数字。每个面板左侧配有醒目的黄色大写标题和简短的白色要点文字，面板主体为情感场景插图。底部添加一个全宽横幅，标题为“VIDEO PROMPT (FOR THIS STORY)”，包含一段提示词，右侧配有一个足球图形。

主角：一位十几岁的少女，留着凌乱的短金发，身材娇小但运动感十足，肢体语言富有表现力，通常穿着深色足球训练服或印有 7 号的黑色足球球衣。她的面部可能被柔和地遮挡或处于阴影中，以突出电影感。展示她从孤独的初学者成长为备受瞩目的明星的过程。

项目面板：使用 16 个带有编号的章节和场景概念：
1. “梦想启航” — 女孩在夜晚的城市围栏旁抱着足球，注视着远处发光屏幕上的足球比赛；要点：梦想成为足球明星，深夜观看比赛，在空旷的街道独自练习，坚信足球是她的命运。
2. “无人支持” — 女孩双臂交叉站立，周围是嘲笑或无视她的同学或家人的剪影；要点：人们说足球不适合女孩，朋友嘲笑她的梦想，家人担心她的未来，但她从未放弃。
3. “每日训练” — 雨中街头训练场景，女孩在日出前奋力带球穿过水坑；要点：日出前起床，在雨中和寒冷的清晨奔跑，练习带球数小时，学会自律与耐心。
4. “首次重大挫折” — 女孩在被拒绝后独自坐在铁丝网旁哭泣，脚边放着足球和一张写着“REJECTED”的纸；要点：被当地足球学院拒绝，选拔赛后独自哭泣，感到心碎和疲惫，决定变得更强后再次尝试。
5. “最艰难的阶段” — 疲惫的女孩在台灯下伏案学习，桌上堆满书籍和足球笔记，展示学业与运动的平衡；要点：平衡学业、工作和足球，鞋子变得破旧，在粗糙的场地上训练，默默追逐梦想。
6. “微小的机会” — 当地教练站在泥泞的训练场旁，注意到了她的天赋；要点：当地教练发现了她的天赋，受邀加入一支小型女子球队，开始学习真正的团队合作，逐渐建立自信。
7. “自我塑造” — 激烈的健身/训练场景，使用哑铃或动感单车，汗水与戏剧性的灯光；要点：提高速度和耐力，学习强力射门技术，研究职业球员，变得更加坚强。
8. “首次锦标赛” — 女孩身穿 7 号黑色球衣，在体育场灯光下庆祝或射门；要点：参加第一场重要比赛，开球前感到紧张，打进首个进球，队友终于认可了她。
9. “受伤但未被击垮” — 女孩腿部或脚踝缠着绷带坐在场边，受伤但神情坚定；要点：遭受痛苦的伤病，几周无法上场，在场边注视他人，在痛苦与康复中坚持战斗。
10. “重返赛场” — 日落时的训练场，身穿 7 号球衣的女孩背影，重新加入队友行列；要点：变得比以前更强，每天加倍训练，赢得队友尊重，成为球队核心球员。
11. “病毒式传播” — 智能手机特写，显示她的比赛片段走红，屏幕周围环绕着社交媒体的点赞和评论；要点：比赛片段在网上疯传，人们开始关注她的天赋，获得粉丝和支持者，她的故事激励了年轻女孩。
12. “冠军争夺战” — 灯火通明的巨大体育场，7 号女孩在火花和欢呼声中打入制胜球或庆祝；要点：参加人生中最重要的比赛，体育场灯光闪耀，打入制胜一球，全场高呼她的名字。
13. “国家队选拔” — 女孩背着背包站在日落的城市天际线前，准备前往更大的赛场；如果需要，可在服装或包上添加隐约的“INDIA”标志；要点：入选国家集训队，前往大城市，面对更强对手，突破自身极限。
14. “成为明星” — 杂志封面或采访场景，她抱着足球，标题如“SPORTS WEEKLY”和励志口号“NO DREAM IS TOO BIG”；要点：出现在采访和杂志中，与职业俱乐部签约，激励数百万女孩，证明梦想不分性别。
15. “实现梦想” — 体育场全景背影，7 号女孩在观众欢呼声中高举双臂；要点：在大型体育场比赛，自豪地支持家人，微笑着回忆过往的挣扎，终于过上了她想象中的生活。
16. “自豪时刻” — 功成名就的球员在体育场灯光下抱着球的情感特写，回忆起年轻时的自己；要点：看着年轻时的旧足球，铭记每一次失败与牺牲，意识到挣扎让她变得更强，梦想终于成为现实。

底部横幅：在 16 个面板下方添加一个横跨全宽的深色矩形横幅。黄色粗体标题：“VIDEO PROMPT (FOR THIS STORY)”。白色小字正文：“创作一部电影感且感人的视频，讲述一位金发少女努力成为职业足球运动员的故事。展示她从被忽视、面对失败、伤病和拒绝，到通过努力和决心崛起为明星的历程。包含训练、情感、比赛、人群、庆祝和现实生活中的挣扎。以她实现梦想并激励数百万人作为结尾。视频应具有激励性、情感共鸣且视觉效果震撼。”在横幅最右侧放置一个草地上的写实足球。

视觉风格：写实动漫体育剧项目，情感特写，动态摄像机角度，粗粝质感，雨水，泥土，发光的体育场灯光，温暖的琥珀色轮廓光，深蓝色夜间阴影，高对比度电影构图，励志氛围。

约束：保持 16 个带编号的面板加一个底部提示横幅。始终使用同一个金发足球少女。文字需清晰但紧凑。无额外面板，无水印，无无关角色，无喜剧基调。

templates.title: Faceless Ninja character redesign

titleLocalized.zh: 无面忍者角色重设计

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="character name" default="A rugged, wandering ninja"} Create a fresh take on an old-school anime character design, showcasing two versions on the same wide canvas: a large cropped portrait on the left and a full-body crouching pose on the right. Canvas: 16:9 wide, landscape image, matte gray paper-textured background, no border, no logo, no title. Employ a highly detailed anime concept art style with sharp, ink-like lines, layered cel shadows, weathered fabric textures, and warm rim lighting from the upper left. Layout: The left half primarily features a top and bottom cropped half-body portrait, its face deliberately obscured by a large, solid-color, matte dark brown rectangle. The right half shows the same character in a frontal crouching pose, its face similarly obscured by a smaller, solid-color rectangle. Present the two views side-by-side, like a character redesign comparison. Main details: The character is a weathered, elderly ninja or ronin, with messy, spiky gray hair peeking out from beneath a dark indigo turban. A small tuft of pointed white beard is visible below the obscuration. Clothing color scheme:{argument name="main cloth color" default="Deep indigo"} The outfit features charcoal gray, matte brown leather, grey-beige bandages, and deep red accents. It comprises eight clearly visible pieces: a wrap-around headband/bandana, a heavy, layered scarf around the neck and shoulders, a loose cloak or cape-like robe, a dark-colored undershirt, loose charcoal gray trousers, a pair of wrap-around arm guards and hand bandages, a pair of wrap-around boots, and a set of leather knee pads on the left knee. A circular red epaulette is added to each upper sleeve, each adorned with a pale floral emblem. In the full-body view on the right, a katana with a patterned hilt and small guard is slung across the character's back. Posture and expression: The face is not visible; the posture conveys the calm, dignified air of a seasoned ninja. In the full-body view, the character crouches, elbows close to the knees, bandaged hands loosely clasped in front of the body, knees apart, feet on the ground, and the cloak draped between the legs. In the close-up view, emphasize the layered folds of the scarf, the scattered strands of hair, and the beard beneath the face mask. Visual Style: Modern high-end anime redesign, similar to an exquisite samurai fantasy artbook; delicate fabric folds, worn boots, dusty bandages, aged leather, subtle scratches, restrained color palette, dramatic yet soft lighting, clean silhouettes, and a non-realistic style. Constraints: Includes 2 character images, 1 samurai sword, 2 red floral epaulettes, and 2 rectangular face mask blocks. Do not add any text, speech bubbles, UI, extra weapons, extra characters, or background landscapes.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="一位粗犷的流浪忍者"} 创作一张焕然一新的旧式动漫角色设计图，在同一张宽幅画布上展示两个形象：左侧为 1 个大型裁剪肖像，右侧为 1 个全身蹲姿。

画布：宽幅 16:9 横向图像，哑光灰色纸张纹理背景，无边框，无 Logo，无标题。采用具有高细节的动漫概念艺术风格，线条清晰如墨，层叠赛璐珞阴影，风化的织物纹理，以及来自左上方的温暖轮廓光。

布局：左半部分主要为顶部和底部裁剪的半身肖像，面部被一个哑光深棕色的大型纯色矩形遮挡块刻意遮盖。右半部分展示了同一角色正面蹲姿，面部同样被一个较小的纯色矩形遮挡块遮盖。将两个视图并排呈现，如同角色重设计对比图。

主体细节：该角色是一位饱经风霜的年长忍者或浪人，深靛蓝色头巾下露出凌乱的灰白色尖刺短发。遮挡块下方可见一小撮尖尖的白胡子。服装配色方案：{argument name="main cloth color" default="深靛蓝色"}、炭灰色、哑光棕色皮革、灰米色绷带以及深红色点缀。服装包含 8 个清晰可见的部件：1 个缠绕式头带/头巾，1 个颈部和肩部的厚重层叠围巾，1 个宽松的斗篷或披风式长袍，1 件深色内衬短衫，1 条宽松的炭灰色长裤，1 双缠绕式护臂和手部绷带，1 双缠绕式靴子，以及左膝上的 1 套皮革护膝。在左右上袖各添加 1 个圆形红色肩章，每个肩章上均带有淡色花朵纹章。在右侧全身视图中，角色背部斜挎 1 把带花纹刀柄和小型护手的武士刀。

姿态与表情：面部不可见；通过姿态传达出冷静、威严的资深忍者气质。在全身视图中，角色低蹲，肘部靠近膝盖，缠着绷带的双手松弛地交握在身前，双膝分开，双脚着地，斗篷垂在双腿之间。在特写视图中，强调围巾的层叠褶皱、散落的发丝以及遮挡块下方的胡须。

视觉风格：现代高端动漫重设计，类似于精致的武士奇幻作品设定集；细腻的布料褶皱、磨损的靴子、沾满灰尘的绷带、陈旧的皮革、细微的划痕、克制的色调、戏剧性但柔和的灯光、干净的轮廓，非写实风格。

约束条件：包含 2 个角色形象，1 把武士刀，2 个红色花卉肩章，以及 2 个矩形面部遮挡块。不要添加任何文字、对话气泡、UI、额外武器、额外角色或背景景观。

templates.title: Surreal luxury Mouth magazine cover

titleLocalized.zh: 超现实奢华 Mouth 杂志封面

templates.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic, surreal luxury fashion magazine cover portrait. The image is an extreme close-up of a woman's open mouth, filling the entire vertical composition, and coated with a glossy sheen.{argument name="lip color" default="Deep red"} The lipstick features a dewy, mirror-like shine that reveals skin texture under dramatic studio lighting. The upper teeth are adorned with nine clearly visible gold diamond braces: two partial lateral braces on the far left and right, four round pavé diamond braces, two rectangular trapezoidal diamond braces, and one large central round pavé diamond brace. All braces are outlined in polished gold, shimmering with a bright, gem-like brilliance. Inside the darkened oral cavity, a miniature full-body {argument name="inner figure" default="A man wearing a navy blue suit, white shirt, black tie, and black leather gloves."} He leaned forward, as if emerging from his mouth, a gloved hand resting on his glossy lower lip, creating a cinematic contrast in proportion, with a dark background against the inside of his mouth. Employing an editorial haute couture style, it boasts ultra-clear macro details, rich contrast, realistic skin and lipstick textures, luxurious jewelry reflections, and surreal advertising aesthetics. A striking white masthead is added at the top.{argument name="magazine title" default="LUXE"} Add smaller spacing text "MAGAZINE" to the bottom left and tiny text near the top right corner.{argument name="issue text" default="Summer 2024"} The masthead should slightly overlap the lips, like a real magazine cover. The cover should use a 4:5 vertical layout, centered and symmetrical, with no additional cover title and no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超写实超现实的奢华时尚杂志封面肖像。画面为女性张开嘴部的极致特写，填满整个竖构图，涂抹着光泽感 {argument name="lip color" default="深酒红色"} 唇膏，带有湿润的镜面高光，皮肤纹理清晰可见，并采用戏剧性的影棚灯光。上排牙齿佩戴着 9 颗清晰可见的金钻牙套：最左侧和最右侧各 2 颗局部侧牙套，4 颗圆形密镶钻石牙套，2 颗长方形梯钻牙套，以及 1 颗位于中央的大型圆形密镶钻石牙套，所有牙套均以抛光黄金勾勒轮廓，闪烁着明亮的宝石光芒。在黑暗的口腔内部，放置一个全身微型 {argument name="inner figure" default="身穿海军蓝西装、白衬衫、黑领带并戴着黑色皮手套的男子"}，他向前蜷缩，仿佛正从口中探出，一只戴着手套的手搁在光泽感的下唇上，呈现电影级的比例对比，口腔内部背景阴暗。采用编辑类高定时尚风格，具备超清晰的微距细节、丰富的对比度、写实的皮肤与唇膏质感、奢华的珠宝反光以及超现实的广告美学。在顶部添加醒目的白色刊头文字 {argument name="magazine title" default="LUXE"}，左下方添加较小的间距文字 "MAGAZINE"，右上角附近添加微小的文字 {argument name="issue text" default="2024 年夏季"}。刊头应像真实的杂志封面一样略微覆盖在嘴唇上方。采用 4:5 竖版封面构图，居中对称，无额外封面标题，无水印。

In the open square, there is a central stone monument and standing statue, five carriages, six small market stalls or flower pavilions with pale yellow awnings, and seven white café parasols surrounding outdoor seating. The square is filled with tiny, colorful pedestrians in summer attire, naturally converging around the stalls, cafés, monument, carriages, and cathedral entrance.{argument name="visual style" default="Ultra-refined tilt-shift miniature landscape, photorealistic 3D rendering"} The design should feature warm sunlight, clear shadows, rich brick reds and soft hues, tiny flowers and greenery, and a charming midday visitor atmosphere. Avoid prominent signs, modern cars, oversized figures, watermarks, or text overlays.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个高度精细的等轴测微缩立体模型，主题为 {argument name="city square" default="波兰克拉科夫中央集市广场"}，时间设定在温暖的午后黄金时刻，以俯视的三分之四角度呈现，如同放置在深色方形展示底座上的手工建筑模型。展示华丽的欧洲老城建筑，背景和右侧边缘排列着柔和色调的联排别墅、红瓦屋顶、装饰性山墙、鹅卵石路面，并配以柔和的浅景深光效。主要地标应包括一座带有拱廊侧面和华丽屋顶线的长条形文艺复兴时期纺织会馆，以及一座巨大的砖砌哥特式大教堂，教堂需具备 2 座高度不等的高塔、深色尖顶、洋葱头圆顶和镀金细节。在开阔的广场中，包含 1 座中心石质纪念碑及站立雕像、5 辆马车、6 个带有淡黄色遮阳棚的小型集市摊位或花卉亭，以及 7 把环绕户外座位的白色咖啡馆遮阳伞。广场上布满许多身着夏装的微小彩色行人，自然地聚集在摊位、咖啡馆、纪念碑、马车和教堂入口周围。使用 {argument name="visual style" default="超精细移轴微缩景观，照片级 3D 渲染"}，呈现温暖的阳光、清晰的阴影、丰富的砖红色和柔和色调、微小的花卉与绿植，以及迷人的午间游客氛围。避免出现可辨认的标牌、现代汽车、比例过大的人物、水印或文字覆盖。

Keep the card edges sharp, the background neutral, and the overall style like a high-end magazine cover or agency flyer, without any additional text, people, watermarks, or other logos.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个从上方微倾斜角度拍摄的写实编辑印刷样机：一张横向的白色卡片或杂志封面平放在浅灰色桌面上，配以柔和的摄影棚灯光、细腻的纸张纹理、下边缘和右边缘的细微阴影，以及大量留白。设计采用极简的黑白风格，并带有少量色彩点缀。将所有排版左对齐放置在左上象限：一个小型的斜体衬线体引语，内容为“{argument name="section label" default="行业 — 导演聚焦"}”，随后是一个非常醒目的黑色粗体现代无衬线标题，分三行排列，内容为“{argument name="headline text" default="来自伦敦的导演主导型 AI 工作室"}”，紧接着是一个较小的灰黑色无衬线副标题，分两行排列，内容为“{argument name="subheading text" default="Future Video Media 在一周内构建发布影片、识别系统和品牌世界。"}”。在文案下方的左下区域，添加 1 个黑色的几何电影/播放图标：一个向右的三角形播放符号，其左侧边缘带有三个小方形电影齿孔。在图标下方添加 3 条细长的水平色带，垂直堆叠并留有小间隙：顶部色带为从洋红色渐变到红色和黄色，中间色带为深蓝色，底部色带为青色/蓝绿色。保持卡片边缘清晰，背景中性，整体风格如同高端杂志专题封面或代理商单页，不包含额外文字、人物、水印或任何其他标志。

templates.title: London Nighttime City Archives 3D Model

titleLocalized.zh: 伦敦夜间城市档案立体模型

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a name{argument name="city title" default="LONDON — NOCTURNAL URBAN ARCHIVE"} A cinematic, physical museum 3D model map presents London as a 3D architectural archive placed on a flat map project. Canvas: Widescreen 16:9 horizontal image, three-quarters overhead view, the entire project is clearly visible on a dark matte desktop. Uses restrained nighttime tones: deep navy paper, charcoal grey streets, warm amber city lights, soft gold map lines, deep blue water, and delicate greyish-white typography. Main scene: Construct a detailed miniature relief map of central London, with the Thames meandering through the lower left and right. Streets should be presented as a dense grid of fine lines, dotted with thousands of tiny warm-colored lights. Parks are deep green recessed areas. Buildings are low, matte protrusions, while key landmarks are taller and more sculptural. Give the model a tactile and physical feel: paper texture, beveled edges of the project, projections, miniature boats on the river, and realistic museum display lighting. Landmarks and Labels: Includes 6 vertically upward-pointing labels with thin gold guide lines and small capital letters: 1) Buckingham Palace, 2) Big Ben / Palace of Westminster, 3) St. Paul's Cathedral, 4) The Shard, 5) The Gherkin, 6) Canary Wharf. Place them from left to right along the top edge. Westminster Palace and Big Ben near the Thames require warm lighting; St. Paul's Cathedral features an illuminated dome; The Shard is a soaring, pointed glass spire; The Gherkin is a rounded bullet-shaped tower; Canary Wharf is a group of golden high-rise buildings; and Tower Bridge is an illuminated bridge spanning the Thames. Map Labels: Add small-capitalized labels for blocks and locations directly to the map, including Regent's Park, Marylebone, Oxford Street, Paddington, Hyde Park, Green Park, St. James's Park, Buckingham Palace, Kensington, Victoria, Westminster, Southwark, City of London, London Bridge, Tower Bridge, Bermondsey, Greenwich, River Thames, The Shard, The Gherkin, and The Tower of London. Use soft cream or light gold fonts that conform to archival map aesthetics. Grid and Border System: Overlay a precise atlas-style index grid with letters at the top and numbers on the sides. Use thin gold grid lines, double borders, and a sculpted archival drawing style. The project should look like a high-end landscape archival model, not a digital screenshot. Bottom Information Bar: Retain a full-width map footer divided into multiple framed panels. The left panel contains a legend with six symbol entries: major landmarks, historic buildings, parks/green spaces, bodies of water, bridges, and train stations. The center panel contains a large title.{argument name="city title" default="LONDON — NOCTURNAL URBAN ARCHIVE"} ,subtitle{argument name="subtitle text" default="LANDSCAPE ARCHIVE MODEL"} Archive Code{argument name="archive code" default="ARCHIVE CODE: LDN-NAM-2024-001"} And a scale marked in miles and kilometers (0 to 3 miles and 0 to 3 kilometers). The right side includes a compass rose, a small illustration of an index grid map, and coordinate instructions.{argument name="coordinate note" default="COORDINATE SYSTEM — BRITISH NATIONAL GRID — TRANSVERSE MERCATOR — OSGB 1936"} Style restrictions: Ultra-refined, editorial-grade product photography; realistic miniature materials; clear but tiny readable fonts; warm amber highlights in cool navy blue shadows; shallow depth of field only at the very edges; no portraits; no modern UI; no watermarks; no additional legends or landmarks except for the specified number.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个名为 {argument name="city title" default="LONDON — NOCTURNAL URBAN ARCHIVE"} 的电影级实体博物馆立体模型地图，将伦敦呈现为放置在平面地图项目上的 3D 建筑档案模型。

画布：宽屏 16:9 水平图像，四分之三俯视视角，整个项目在深色哑光桌面上清晰可见。使用克制的夜间色调：深海军蓝纸张、炭灰色街道、温暖的琥珀色城市灯光、柔和的金色地图线条、深蓝色水域以及精致的灰白色字体。

主场景：构建一个伦敦市中心的精细微缩浮雕地图，泰晤士河在左下方和右侧蜿蜒流过。街道应呈现为密集的细线网格，并点缀着数千盏微小的暖色灯光。公园是深绿色的凹陷区域。建筑物为低矮的哑光凸起，关键地标则更高、更具雕塑感。让模型具有触感和实体感：纸张纹理、斜切的项目边缘、投影、河上的微型船只以及逼真的博物馆展示照明。

地标与标注：包含 6 个垂直向上的注释标注，带有细金色引导线和小号大写标签：1) Buckingham Palace，2) Big Ben / Palace of Westminster，3) St. Paul's Cathedral，4) The Shard，5) The Gherkin，6) Canary Wharf。将它们从左到右放置在顶部边缘。泰晤士河附近的威斯敏斯特宫和 Big Ben 需有温暖的照明，St. Paul's Cathedral 带有发光的圆顶，The Shard 为高耸尖锐的玻璃尖塔，The Gherkin 为圆润的子弹形塔楼，Canary Wharf 为一组金色高层建筑，Tower Bridge 为横跨泰晤士河的照明桥梁。

地图标签：在地图上直接添加小号大写字母的街区和地点标签，包括 Regent's Park、Marylebone、Oxford Street、Paddington、Hyde Park、Green Park、St. James's Park、Buckingham Palace、Kensington、Victoria、Westminster、Southwark、City of London、London Bridge、Tower Bridge、Bermondsey、Greenwich、River Thames、The Shard、The Gherkin 和 The Tower of London。使用符合档案地图美学的柔和奶油色或浅金色字体。

网格与边框系统：叠加一个精确的地图集风格索引网格，顶部为字母，侧面为数字。使用细金色网格线、双线边框和雕刻般的档案绘图风格。项目应看起来像一个高级景观档案模型，而非数字截图。

底部信息栏：保留一个全宽的地图页脚，分为多个框架面板。左侧面板包含一个包含 6 个符号条目的图例：主要地标、历史建筑、公园/绿地、水体、桥梁、火车站。中心面板包含大标题 {argument name="city title" default="LONDON — NOCTURNAL URBAN ARCHIVE"}、副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="LANDSCAPE ARCHIVE MODEL / 地景档案模型"}、档案代码 {argument name="archive code" default="ARCHIVE CODE: LDN-NAM-2024-001"} 以及标注为英里和公里的比例尺（0 到 3 英里和 0 到 3 公里）。右侧包含一个罗盘玫瑰、一个小插图索引网格地图以及坐标说明 {argument name="coordinate note" default="COORDINATE SYSTEM — BRITISH NATIONAL GRID — TRANSVERSE MERCATOR — OSGB 1936"}。

风格限制：超精细的编辑级产品摄影，逼真的微缩材料，清晰但微小的可读字体，冷海军蓝阴影下的暖琥珀色高光，仅在极边缘处有浅景深，无人像，无现代 UI，无水印，除指定数量外，不得添加额外的图例或地标标注。

templates.title: New York City Night View Archive 3D Model

titleLocalized.zh: 纽约夜景档案立体模型

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a highly detailed 3D model-style city archive map resembling a physics museum, with the theme of {argument name="city name" default="New York City"} A nighttime scene, titled "Landscape Archive Model / Nighttime City Archive." The image should present a photographic, handcrafted architectural archive project: a flat, printed map at the base, with a 3D miniature city model floating above, illuminated by subtle warm-toned architectural lights and cool-toned navy blue ambient light. Canvas: 16:9 widescreen landscape photography, three-quarter overhead view, the entire rectangular archive project presented on a dark desktop. Use deep navy blue, charcoal gray, brass, and warm amber tones. The project features a thick, dark border, fine paper texture, beveled edges, projection effects, and a museum-model-like realistic feel. Layout: Place a 3D miniature of Manhattan at the center, surrounded by a flat, engraved map area and waterways. The river should be a deep, glossy blue with subtle reflections. The background map includes a fine street grid, coordinate lines, latitude and longitude style guide markers, and archive border numbering. Add a precise top and side grid system, with letters at the top and bottom and numbers on the left and right edges. Include fine brass annotation lines connecting labels to landmarks. Key Details: Manhattan is presented as a dense, undulating cluster of miniature buildings, their windows gleaming. The Empire State Building should tower near the center, its spire ablaze with light. The lower left of Manhattan includes One World Trade Center, while the Chrysler Building occupies the right side of Midtown. Times Square serves as a luminous central area, Central Park is depicted as a dark rectangular green-black block in Upper Manhattan, and the Brooklyn Bridge spans the East River into Brooklyn. Surrounding boroughs and area labels should be tiled across the map. Text and Labels: Use an elegant off-white and brass-colored uppercase archival font. Contains 18 visible tag/annotation elements: 1) Main title “NEW YORK CITY”, 2) Subtitle “NOCTURNAL URBAN ARCHIVE”, 3) Archive ID “NYC-NAM-2024-001”, 4) Top micro-tag “LANDSCAPE ARCHIVE MODEL”, 5) “EAST RIVER CORRIDOR STUDY / EDITION 01”, 6) “EMPIRE STATE BUILDING / 1,454 ft / 443 m”, 7) “TIMES SQUARE / THEATER DISTRICT”, 8) “ONE WORLD TRADE CENTER / 1,776 ft / 541 m”, 9) “CENTRAL PARK”, 10) “CHRYSLER BUILDING / 1,046 ft / 319 m”, 11) “BROOKLYN BRIDGE / 1,595 ft / 12) “NEW JERSEY / HUDSON COUNTY”, 13) “HUDSON RIVER”, 14) “EAST RIVER”, 15) “QUEENS / LONG ISLAND CITY”, 16) “BROOKLYN / DOWNTOWN BROOKLYN”, 17) “LEGEND”, and 18) “ARCHIVE NOTES”. Embedded Panels: Integrate four box information panels into the project: the title panel in the upper left corner, the legend panel in the lower left corner, the scale bar and north arrow panel in the lower left corner, and the archive notes/model code panel in the lower right corner. The legend panel should contain six line/icon entries: main roads, secondary roads, railway lines, water bodies, parks/green spaces, and the footprint of major landmarks/buildings. The archive panel in the lower right corner should contain the model code “NYC-NAM-2024-001”, the model number “001”, and the page number “01 / 01”. Lighting and Material Style: Nighttime editorial photography style, warm amber city lights, cool blue shadows, sharp miniature details, realistic depth of field, slight vignetting, matte printed paper texture, metallic ink lines, resin/wood relief model architecture, tiny glowing windows, and realistic projections. The overall effect should resemble a production-quality architectural archival model photographed in a museum studio. Constraints: Keep the design restrained, precise, and high-end. Do not add people, vehicles, logos, watermarks, or modern UI elements. Maintain a consistent archival map language, making all text look like it was printed on the project; avoid fantasy or science fiction styles.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个高度精细的物理博物馆立体模型风格的城市档案地图，主题为 {argument name="city name" default="New York City"} 的夜景，标题为“景观档案模型 / 夜间城市档案”。图像应呈现为一张经过摄影的、手工制作的建筑档案项目：底座为平面印刷地图，上方浮现出 3D 微缩城市模型，由微小的暖色建筑灯光和冷色调海军蓝环境光照亮。

画布：宽屏 16:9 风景摄影，四分之三俯视视角，整个矩形档案项目完整呈现在深色桌面上。使用深海军蓝、炭灰、黄铜和暖琥珀色调。项目带有厚实的深色边框、细腻的纸张纹理、斜切边缘、投影效果以及博物馆模型般的真实质感。

布局：将曼哈顿的 3D 微缩模型置于中心，周围环绕着平面的雕刻地图区域和水道。河流应呈现为深光泽蓝色，带有细微的反射。背景地图包含精细的街道网格、坐标线、经纬度风格的引导标记以及档案边框编号。添加精确的顶部和侧面网格系统，顶部和底部标有字母，左右边缘标有数字。包含连接标签与地标的细黄铜注释线。

主体细节：将曼哈顿展示为密集且隆起的微缩建筑群，窗户散发着光芒。帝国大厦（Empire State Building）应在中心附近高耸，塔尖灯光璀璨。在曼哈顿左下区域包含世界贸易中心一号大楼（One World Trade Center），中城右侧为克莱斯勒大厦（Chrysler Building），时代广场（Times Square）作为发光的中心区域，中央公园（Central Park）表现为曼哈顿上城的一块深色矩形绿黑色空地，布鲁克林大桥（Brooklyn Bridge）横跨东河（East River）通往布鲁克林。周围行政区和区域标签应平铺在地图上。

文本内容与标签：使用优雅的米白色和黄铜色大写档案字体。包含 18 个可见的标签/注释元素：1) 主标题“NEW YORK CITY”，2) 副标题“NOCTURNAL URBAN ARCHIVE”，3) 档案 ID “NYC-NAM-2024-001”，4) 顶部微型标签“LANDSCAPE ARCHIVE MODEL”，5) “EAST RIVER CORRIDOR STUDY / EDITION 01”，6) “EMPIRE STATE BUILDING / 1,454 ft / 443 m”，7) “TIMES SQUARE / THEATER DISTRICT”，8) “ONE WORLD TRADE CENTER / 1,776 ft / 541 m”，9) “CENTRAL PARK”，10) “CHRYSLER BUILDING / 1,046 ft / 319 m”，11) “BROOKLYN BRIDGE / 1,595 ft / 486 m”，12) “NEW JERSEY / HUDSON COUNTY”，13) “HUDSON RIVER”，14) “EAST RIVER”，15) “QUEENS / LONG ISLAND CITY”，16) “BROOKLYN / DOWNTOWN BROOKLYN”，17) “LEGEND”，以及 18) “ARCHIVE NOTES”。

嵌入面板：在项目上集成 4 个方框信息面板：左上角的标题面板、左下角的图例面板、左下方的比例尺和指北针面板，以及右下角的档案备注/模型代码面板。图例面板应包含 6 个线条/图标条目：主干道、次干道、铁路线、水体、公园/绿地以及主要地标/建筑占地。右下角的档案面板应包含模型代码“NYC-NAM-2024-001”、模型编号“001”和页码“01 / 01”。

灯光与材质风格：夜间编辑摄影风格，暖琥珀色城市灯光，冷蓝色阴影，清晰的微缩细节，逼真的景深，轻微的暗角，哑光印刷纸张纹理，金属墨水线条，树脂/木质浮雕模型建筑，微小的发光窗户，以及逼真的投影。整体效果应如同在博物馆工作室中拍摄的制作级建筑档案模型。
