templates.title: Paris Nighttime City Archive Map

titleLocalized.zh: 巴黎夜间城市档案地图

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a museum-quality 3D physical model map, titled {argument name="map title" default="PARIS – NOCTURNAL URBAN ARCHIVE"} ,exhibit{argument name="city" default="Paris"} The nighttime scene is presented as an architectural archive model, complete with glowing streets, miniature landmarks, and sculptural annotations. Canvas: 3:2 horizontal image, shot at a high angle reminiscent of a high-end desktop exhibit. The map is a thick rectangular project placed on a dark studio plane, featuring a dark navy blue background, warm gold lines, delicate paper texture, embossed topography, projection effects, and the realism of a matte museum display. Layout: The image is filled with a large rectangular archive city map, framed with a double-layered gold border. An alphanumeric grid is added to the map's edges: A–K at the top, 1–8 on the sides. The city occupies the upper three-quarters; structured information bars occupy the lower quarter. Main city model: The Seine is rendered as a deep navy blue river, flowing horizontally through the lower middle section, with glowing banks and bridges. Streets form a dense and precise Haussmannian network, composed of tiny, glowing amber lines. Main avenues are brighter and feature small sculpted labels. Parks are darker, deep green areas. The buildings are low-slung, dark-colored, and meticulously extruded to create a tactilely realistic 3D archival model. Four raised, illuminated landmark models are counted and placed: 1) The Eiffel Tower, tallest and glowing gold, near the river in the lower left/middle left quadrant; 2) The Arc de Triomphe in the upper left quadrant, with radiating avenues; 3) Notre Dame Cathedral in the island/river area in the middle right quadrant; 4) The Sacré-Cœur Basilica/Montmartre Cathedral, high in the upper right quadrant. Fifteen area annotations are counted and labeled using small serif gold font: “XVII BATIGNOLLES MONCEAU”, “VIII ELYSEE”, “IX OPERA”, “XVIII MONTMARTRE”, “XIX LA VILLETTE”, “X ENTREPOT”, “III TEMPLE”, “IV HOTEL DE VILLE”, “XI BASTILLE”, “XII REUILLY”, “XIII GOBELINS”, “V PANTHEON”, “VI LUXEMBOURG”, “VII PALAIS BOURBON”, “XVI PASSY”. Meanwhile, the large, dark-colored park on the left is labeled "BOIS DE BOULOGNE". Main route labels include "CHAMPS-ELYSEES" extending from the Arc de Triomphe, "BOULEVARD HAUSSMANN" across the upper middle section, "BOULEVARD SAINT-GERMAIN" in the lower middle section, and "BOULEVARD BOURDON" or similar smaller avenue labels near the right riverbank. Bottom information panel: Divide the information panel from left to right into five visible panels: 1) Legend panel, 2) Compass panel, 3) Central title panel, 4) Scale bar/illustration grid panel, 5) Miniature area location map panel. Bottom panel details: The legend panel must list five symbol categories: monuments, main axes, avenues, bridges, and parks/gardens. If space permits, a water feature color block can be added below. The compass panel contains a gorgeous gold compass rose with N/E/S/W markings. The central panel contains the main title.{argument name="map title" default="PARIS – NOCTURNAL URBAN ARCHIVE"} The subtitle "CITY OF LIGHTS · HISTORIC CORE · HAUSSMANN NETWORK" and the file code{argument name="archive code" default="PAR-NAM-2024-001"} The scale panel displays "SCALE 1:10,000" along with segmented bars from 0 to 1000 meters. The location panel displays a small outline map labeled "CENTRAL PARIS FRANCE". Visual style: ultra-detailed physical miniatures, not flat digital maps. Use restrained nighttime tones: charcoal black, navy blue waters, bronze gold, amber lighting, and soft deep green parks. Lighting should mimic the effect of miniature LEDs embedded along streets and monuments, with realistic shadows, bevels, engraved fonts, and archival cartographic precision. Constraints: All text remains in English or French-style Latin alphabets. No portraits, no cars, no modern UI, no watermarks. Maintain a consistent, high-end editorial archival map series aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：制作一张博物馆级的实体立体模型地图，标题为 {argument name="map title" default="PARIS – NOCTURNAL URBAN ARCHIVE"}，展示 {argument name="city" default="Paris"} 的夜景，呈现为建筑档案模型，带有发光的街道、微型地标以及雕刻般的制图注释。

画布：横向 3:2 图像，以类似高级桌面展品的高仰角拍摄。地图是一个放置在深色工作室平面上的厚矩形项目，具有黑海军蓝底色、暖金色线条、细腻的纸张纹理、浮雕地形、投影效果以及哑光博物馆展示的真实感。

布局：用一张大型矩形档案城市地图填满画面，并配以双层金色边框。在地图边缘添加字母数字网格：顶部为 A–K，两侧为 1–8。城市占据上方四分之三的区域；结构化的信息栏占据底部四分之一。

城市主体模型：将塞纳河渲染为深海军蓝色的河流，横向穿过中下部，带有发光的河岸和桥梁。街道形成密集且精确的奥斯曼风格网络，由细小的琥珀色发光线条组成。主要大道发光更亮，并带有小型雕刻标签。公园是纹理较暗的深绿色区域。建筑物低矮、深色且经过精细挤压，营造出触感真实的 3D 档案模型。

计数并放置 4 个凸起的发光地标模型：1) 左下/中左侧靠近河流的埃菲尔铁塔，最高且呈金色发光；2) 左上象限的凯旋门，带有放射状大道；3) 中右侧岛屿/河流区域的巴黎圣母院；4) 右上象限高处的圣心大教堂/蒙马特大教堂。

计数并标注 15 个区域注释，使用小型衬线金色字体：“XVII BATIGNOLLES MONCEAU”、“VIII ELYSEE”、“IX OPERA”、“XVIII MONTMARTRE”、“XIX LA VILLETTE”、“X ENTREPOT”、“III TEMPLE”、“IV HOTEL DE VILLE”、“XI BASTILLE”、“XII REUILLY”、“XIII GOBELINS”、“V PANTHEON”、“VI LUXEMBOURG”、“VII PALAIS BOURBON”、“XVI PASSY”。同时在左侧大型深色公园标注“BOIS DE BOULOGNE”。

主要路线标签：包括从凯旋门延伸出的“CHAMPS-ELYSEES”、横跨中上部的“BOULEVARD HAUSSMANN”、中下部的“BOULEVARD SAINT-GERMAIN”，以及靠近右侧河岸的“BOULEVARD BOURDON”或类似的小型大道标签。

底部信息栏：将信息栏从左至右分为 5 个可见面板：1) 图例面板，2) 指南针面板，3) 中央标题面板，4) 比例尺/插图网格面板，5) 微型区域定位地图面板。

底部面板细节：图例面板必须列出 5 个符号类别：纪念碑、主轴线、大道、桥梁、公园/花园，如果空间允许，下方可添加水域色块。指南针面板包含一个带有 N/E/S/W 标记的华丽金色罗盘玫瑰。中央面板包含大标题 {argument name="map title" default="PARIS – NOCTURNAL URBAN ARCHIVE"}、副标题“CITY OF LIGHTS · HISTORIC CORE · HAUSSMANN NETWORK”以及档案代码 {argument name="archive code" default="PAR-NAM-2024-001"}。比例尺面板显示“SCALE 1:10,000”以及 0 到 1000 米的分段条。定位面板显示一张标有“CENTRAL PARIS FRANCE”的小型轮廓地图。

视觉风格：超精细实体微缩模型，而非平面数字地图。使用克制的夜间色调：炭黑色、海军蓝水域、古铜金色、琥珀色灯光以及柔和的深绿色公园。灯光应呈现出沿街道和纪念碑嵌入的微型 LED 效果，并具有真实的阴影、斜角、雕刻字体和档案制图精度。

约束：所有文字保持为英语或法语风格的拉丁字母。没有人像、没有汽车、没有现代 UI、没有水印。保持一致的高级编辑档案地图系列美学。

templates.title: Cyberpunk Neuromania Fashion Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克《神经漫游者》时尚海报

templates.prompt: Create a vertical cyberpunk-style book cover/poster as a tribute.{argument name="book author" default="William Gibson"} Inspired by the dark neon aesthetic of *Neuromancer*, the film employs a low-angle, full-body hero perspective, filming a young male cyberpunk agent standing with his legs apart on a bright, reflective surface, looking down at the camera. He wears an oversized black-purple leather trench coat (with a semi-transparent purple lining), a short tactical jacket, black strappy cargo pants with numerous buckles and zippers, thick-soled combat boots, and fingerless gloves. One of his outstretched hands has long, metallic, claw-like mechanical fingers. His face is deliberately blurred in a soft, square shape, revealing short, pointed black hair. The overall color scheme is black, ultraviolet, electric purple, and smoky blue, with dramatic rim lighting, volumetric fog on the ground, wet reflections, high contrast, cinematic photorealistic detail, and a glossy editing style. Behind him, large, semi-transparent, glowing blocks of letters spell out on the wall.{argument name="giant background word" default="MOLLY"} Part of it is located behind the character, appearing as if made of frosted purple neon glass. A large, wide-spaced title is added at the bottom.{argument name="bottom title" default="NEUROMANCER"} The poster uses slender, futuristic capital letters with a purple halo. Eight small typographic elements are added around the poster: 1. A Korean quote in the top left corner.{argument name="Korean quote" default="사이버펑크는 죽지 않는다 그것은 진화한다"} 2. A small stacked text tag with geolocation information: “SEOUL / LONDON / NEW YORK”; 3. A small globe icon; 4. A miniature label: “COLLECTION: NEUROMANCER _001”; 5. A plus sign crosshair symbol; 6. Small stacked text: “SYSTEM OVERRIDE / REALITY IS OPTIONAL”; 7. Right-side text: “FUTURE IS UNWRITTEN”; 8. A vertical miniature text bar: “NEO SEOUL PROTOCOL 2084”. Add 5 footer details: “NMCR_001”, “SPRING / SUMMER 2084”, “DATA THIEF / SOLO OPERATIVE”, a small globe icon, and a barcode labeled “NMCR 001”. The composition should evoke the feel of a high-end science fiction cover combined with a luxury streetwear advertisement, requiring extremely high detail, sharpness, and emotional impact. No additional characters or main text should be added beyond the specified typographical content.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖版赛博朋克时尚书籍封面/海报，致敬 {argument name="book author" default="William Gibson"}，灵感源自黑暗霓虹的《神经漫游者》美学。采用低角度全身英雄视角，拍摄一名年轻男性赛博朋克特工，双腿分开站在光亮的反光地面上，俯视镜头；身穿超大号黑紫色皮质风衣（配半透明紫色内衬）、短款战术上衣、黑色绑带工装裤，配有大量搭扣和拉链，穿着厚底战斗靴、露指手套，其中一只伸出的手上长有金属质感的长爪状机械手指。面部刻意用柔和的方形模糊处理，露出短而尖的黑色头发。整体色调为黑色、紫外光色、电紫色和烟蓝色，带有戏剧性的轮廓光、地面上的体积雾、雨水湿润的反光、高对比度、电影级照片写实细节以及光泽感的编辑风格。在他身后，墙面上放置巨大的半透明发光块状字母，拼写出 {argument name="giant background word" default="MOLLY"}，部分位于角色后方，仿佛由磨砂紫色霓虹玻璃制成。底部添加一个大号且字间距宽的标题 {argument name="bottom title" default="NEUROMANCER"}，使用纤细的未来感大写字母，并带有紫色光晕。在海报周围添加 8 个小型排版元素：1 左上角的一句韩文引语 {argument name="Korean quote" default="사이버펑크는 죽지 않는다 그것은 진화한다"}；2 一组小型地理位置堆叠文字 “SEOUL / LONDON / NEW YORK”；3 一个小型地球仪图标；4 一个微型标签 “COLLECTION: NEUROMANCER _001”；5 一个加号十字准星符号；6 小型堆叠文字 “SYSTEM OVERRIDE / REALITY IS OPTIONAL”；7 右侧文字 “FUTURE IS UNWRITTEN”；8 一条垂直微型文字条 “NEO SEOUL PROTOCOL 2084”。添加 5 个页脚细节：“NMCR_001”、“SPRING / SUMMER 2084”、“DATA THIEF / SOLO OPERATIVE”、一个小地球仪图标以及一个标注为 “NMCR 001” 的条形码。构图应呈现出高级科幻小说封面与奢华街头服饰广告相结合的质感，要求超高细节、锐利、情绪化，除指定的排版内容外，不添加额外角色或主文本。

templates.title: Tokyo Nighttime City Archive 3D Model

titleLocalized.zh: 东京夜间城市档案立体模型

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a highly realistic museum-quality 3D model map, titled {argument name="city archive title" default="TOKYO — NOCTURNAL URBAN ARCHIVE"} ,exhibit{argument name="city" default="Tokyo"} The image is presented at night as a dense 3D architectural landscape archive model, photographed from a high angle on a dark desktop. Canvas: 3:2 wide horizontal composition, like a high-end architectural archive project. The map fills most of the image, with a thick dark border, cream-colored fine lines, coordinate scales, and a data bar at the bottom. A restrained nighttime color palette is used: charcoal black paper, deep navy blue water, warm amber streetlights, cool white building lights, subtle blue accents, and matte model textures. Main scene: A detailed miniature city map combining flat-printed street plans with raised 3D buildings. Roads are rendered as glowing gold and white lines. Water is deep navy blue with a glossy reflection. The terrain should have a tactile feel, reflecting the paper texture, subtle shadows, and realistic model-making materials. Three prominent glowing 3D landmarks are included: Tokyo Tower emitting a warm orange glow near the lower left center, Tokyo Skytree emitting cool blue and purple glow near the upper right waterfront, and the Rainbow Bridge spanning the bay in the lower right corner. Includes the dense cluster of skyscrapers around Shinjuku and central Tokyo, as well as many low-rise urban blocks. Layout and Labeling: Add nine black rectangular label boxes with thin cream borders, each with Japanese text above and small English text below: 1) Shinjuku, 2) Shibuya, 3) Ueno, 4) Asakusa, 5) Tokyo Skytree, 6) Imperial Palace, 7) Ginza, 8) Odaiba, 9) Tokyo Bay. Place them near their respective areas with subtle indicator lines, but avoid clutter. Map Grid: Add an archive-style index grid around the map. Use column numbers 1 to 10 for the top edge and row letters A to E for the left edge. Add small coordinate markers along the border, including latitude and longitude style numbers. In the data bar at the bottom right corner, include a small index grid box that precisely displays 25 cells, labeled A1 to A5, B1 to B5, C1 to C5, D1 to D5, and E1 to E5. Bottom Data Bar: Create an archive legend and title bar along the bottom. The left legend box should be titled "Legend" and list 8 items with colored line samples: 1) JR Yamanote Line, 2) JR Chuo Line, 3) Ginza Line, 4) Asakusa Line, 5) Yurikamome Line, 6) Waterways, 7) Main Roads, 8) Highways. If space allows, add a small park/green space color block. The left-center title text should be {argument name="main title text" default="TOKYO — NOCTURNAL URBAN ARCHIVE"} Add "Landscape Archive Model" and the archive code below.{argument name="archive code" default="Archive Code: TKY-NAM-2024-001"} Add a scale bar labeled "Scale 1:25,000," with distance scales from 0 to 2.5 kilometers. Add a compass in the separate box on the right. Visual style: ultra-refined editorial product photography, sharp focus, realistic depth of field, soft directional studio lighting from the upper left, warm city light, subtle shadows created by raised structures, luxurious matte black project boards, cream-colored ink drawing lines, museum-quality. Avoid people, oversized vehicles, cartoonish style, bright sunlight, cluttered typography, or additional landmarks besides the labeled ones.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个高度逼真的博物馆级立体模型地图，标题为 {argument name="city archive title" default="TOKYO — NOCTURNAL URBAN ARCHIVE"}，展示 {argument name="city" default="Tokyo"} 在夜间作为密集 3D 建筑景观档案模型的样子，并从高处斜角拍摄于深色桌面上。

画布：宽幅 3:2 水平构图，如同高级建筑档案项目。地图填满大部分画面，带有厚实的深色边框、奶油色细制图线、坐标刻度以及底部的资料条。使用克制的夜间色调：炭黑色纸张、深海军蓝水域、暖琥珀色路灯、冷白色建筑灯光、微妙的蓝色点缀以及哑光模型纹理。

主场景：一张精细的微缩城市地图，结合了平面印刷的街道规划与凸起的 3D 建筑群。道路呈现为发光的金色和白色细线。水域为深海军蓝色，带有光泽反射。地形应具有触感，体现纸张纹理、微小的投影以及逼真的模型制作材料。包含三个突出的发光 3D 地标：左下中心附近发出暖橙色光芒的东京塔，右上水岸附近发出冷蓝色和紫色光芒的东京晴空塔，以及右下角横跨海湾的彩虹大桥。包含新宿和东京市中心周围密集的摩天大楼群，以及许多低层城市街区。

布局与标注：添加 9 个带有奶油色细边框的黑色矩形标注框，每个标注框上方为日文，下方为英文小字：1) 新宿，2) 涩谷，3) 上野，4) 浅草，5) 东京晴空塔，6) 皇居，7) 银座，8) 台场，9) 东京湾。将它们放置在相应区域附近，带有微妙的指示线，但避免杂乱。

地图网格：在地图周围添加档案风格的索引网格。顶部边缘使用 1 到 10 的列数字，左侧边缘使用 A 到 E 的行字母。沿边框添加小型坐标标记，包括纬度和经度风格的数字。在右下角的资料条中，包含一个小型索引网格框，精确显示 25 个单元格，标记为 A1 到 A5、B1 到 B5、C1 到 C5、D1 到 D5 以及 E1 到 E5。

底部资料条：沿底部创建一个档案图例和标题栏。左侧图例框标题为“Legend”，列出 8 个项目及彩色线条样本：1) JR 山手线，2) JR 中央线，3) 银座线，4) 浅草线，5) 百合海鸥线，6) 水域，7) 主干道，8) 高速公路，如果空间允许，添加一个小型的公园/绿地色块。左中标题文字应为 {argument name="main title text" default="TOKYO — NOCTURNAL URBAN ARCHIVE"}。下方添加“Landscape Archive Model”以及档案代码 {argument name="archive code" default="Archive Code: TKY-NAM-2024-001"}。添加一个标注为“Scale 1:25,000”的比例尺，距离刻度从 0 到 2.5 公里。在右侧的独立框中添加一个指北针。

视觉风格：超精细的编辑类产品摄影，清晰对焦，逼真的景深，来自左上方的柔和定向影棚灯光，温暖的城市光芒，凸起结构产生的细腻阴影，奢华的哑光黑项目板，奶油色墨水制图线条，博物馆展品质量。避免出现人物、过大的车辆、卡通风格、明亮的日光、杂乱的排版，或除标注地标之外的额外地标。

templates.title: Cinematic Football Final Moment Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 电影感足球决赛时刻海报

templates.prompt: Objective: For the purpose of {argument name="football star" default="Kylian Mbappe"} Create an AI-generated football movie depicting the World Cup final, featuring a 9:16 vertical split-screen social media display that blends the visual impact of movie posters, project graphics, and sports broadcast graphics. Canvas: Vertical poster, dark cinematic stadium atmosphere, high contrast, rain and sparks, gold-orange highlights, deep navy blue and black shadows, realistic sports photography quality, with dramatic motion blur, lens flare, splattered grass, confetti, and explosive lighting. The left and bottom use slanted rectangular panels separated by thin gold borders, while the right side features a large hero portrait panel. Subject: A French footballer wearing a deep navy blue French national team jersey with the gold number 10, possessing a robust physique, his skin and jersey soaked by rain, standing in a brightly lit, crowded stadium at night. In the large panel on the right, he appears from the chest up, fist clenched to his chest, against a backdrop of stadium floodlights, raindrops clearly visible, his expression victorious and focused. While retaining the iconic silhouette and emotion of a football star, the face is deliberately blurred or anonymized. Layout and Numbered Project Panel: Contains eight numbered, cinematic moments, each accompanied by a large gold number, a striking white capital title, and a brief white subtitle. Arranged as overlapping diagonal strips of film, they are distributed across the left and bottom halves of the poster: 1. “STADIUM IGNITION” – “Lights. Flames. 80,000 hearts. A dream.” An aerial view of the stadium, packed stands, and fireworks exploding above the roof. 2. “THE WALKOUT” – “No words needed. Only destiny.” Players walk through rain and tunnel lights, with the silhouette of France's number 10 in the center. 3. “FIRST TOUCH” – “The moment it all begins.” An extreme close-up of boots striking or stopping the ball on wet grass, accompanied by splashing water. 4. “THE BREAKAWAY” – “Speed. Skill. He's unstoppable.” A French player dashes past defenders with a golden trajectory. 5. “COLLISION” – “Pain. Impact. No turning back.” A sliding tackle in the mud and the moment of physical collision on the field. 6. “FINAL SHOT” – “One shot. Eternal.” A dynamic shooting pose, legs outstretched, the ball hurtling towards the goal. 7. “THE GOAL” – “Explosion. History!” The ball crashes into the net, accompanied by sparks and a glowing impact line. 8. “IMMORTAL” – “Legends aren’t born. They’re made. In the last minute.” Players kneel and slide in celebration amidst golden confetti and cheering crowds. Right-side broadcast overlay: A compact vertical score HUD is added near the top right edge, featuring a small World Cup trophy icon and the text “FIFA WORLD CUP QATAR 2022”. Below, a framed label "FINAL" is placed, along with a large timer "89:59," a stop-time line "+6," and two score lines: "FRA" with the French flag and score "2," and "ARG" with the Argentine flag and score "2." Below the scoreboard, a red audio waveform is added, along with small labels indicating "CROWD NOISE LEVEL" and "MAXIMUM." Small technical text such as "CAMERA 7," "SLOW MOTION," and "180 FPS" is added below. Bottom title area: A large, distressed white title bar is placed horizontally across the bottom center.{argument name="main title" default="FINAL MINUTE"} The text uses a bold, compressed sports font with a rough texture. A slogan is added below.{argument name="tagline" default="90 MINUTES. ONE MOMENT THAT CHANGES EVERYTHING."} The phrase "CHANGES EVERYTHING" is highlighted in gold. At the very bottom, a small credits line is added:{argument name="credit line" default="CRAFTED WITH GPT IMAGE 2 + SEEDANCE 2.0"} Visual Style: High-end cinematic football poster, ultra-detailed, photorealistic, deep HDR grading, shallow depth of field, raindrop grain, sparks, smoke, stadium floodlights, explosive gold confetti, diagonal edited composition, clean typography, strong sense of movement, viral sports social media aesthetic. Constraints: Use 8 numbered panels plus a single large hero portrait panel. Keep all text clear, capitalized, and integrated into the design. Do not add extra item numbering, extra teams, watermarks, applied UI, or irrelevant logos. Maintain the vertical social media poster format and the dramatic last-minute World Cup atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为关于 {argument name="football star" default="Kylian Mbappe"} 在世界杯决赛中表现的 AI 生成足球电影，创作一张 9:16 竖版分屏布局的社交媒体展示图，融合电影海报、项目和体育转播图形的视觉冲击力。

画布：竖版海报，黑暗电影感球场氛围，高对比度，雨水与火花，金橙色高光，深海军蓝与黑色阴影，写实体育摄影质感，带有戏剧性的运动模糊、镜头光晕、飞溅的草皮、五彩纸屑和爆炸性的灯光。左侧和底部使用倾斜的矩形面板拼贴，由细金边分隔，右侧设有一个大型英雄肖像面板。

主体：一名身穿深海军蓝法国队球衣、背号为金色 10 号的法国足球运动员，拥有健硕的体格，皮肤和球衣被雨水浸透，站在夜晚灯火通明的拥挤球场中。在右侧的大面板中，他从胸部以上出镜，拳头紧贴胸口，背景是球场泛光灯，雨滴清晰可见，神情胜利且专注。在保留标志性的足球明星轮廓和情绪的同时，刻意模糊或匿名化面部。

布局与编号项目面板：包含 8 个带编号的电影感瞬间，每个瞬间配有一个大号金色数字、醒目的白色大写标题和简短的白色副标题。将它们排列为重叠的对角线胶片条，分布在海报的左半部分和下半部分：
1. “STADIUM IGNITION”（球场点燃）——“灯光。火焰。8 万颗心。一个梦想。” 俯瞰球场，观众席座无虚席，屋顶上方烟花绽放。
2. “THE WALKOUT”（入场）——“无需言语。唯有命运。” 球员们走过雨中和通道灯光，中央是法国队 10 号的剪影。
3. “FIRST TOUCH”（首次触球）——“一切开始的瞬间。” 极致特写，球鞋在湿草地上击球或停球，伴随水雾飞溅。
4. “THE BREAKAWAY”（突破）——“速度。技能。他势不可挡。” 法国球员带着金色运动轨迹冲过防守队员。
5. “COLLISION”（碰撞）——“疼痛。冲击。没有回头路。” 泥泞中的滑铲和球场上身体碰撞的瞬间。
6. “FINAL SHOT”（最终射门）——“一击。永恒。” 动态射门姿势，腿部伸展，足球在球场中向球门疾驰。
7. “THE GOAL”（进球）——“爆炸。历史！” 足球冲入球网，伴随火花和发光的冲击线。
8. “IMMORTAL”（不朽）——“传奇并非天生。而是造就。在最后一分钟。” 球员在金色的五彩纸屑和欢呼的人群中跪地滑行庆祝。

右侧转播叠加层：在右上边缘附近添加一个紧凑的竖版比分 HUD，带有一个小的世界杯奖杯图标和文字“FIFA WORLD CUP QATAR 2022”。下方放置一个带框标签“FINAL”，一个大计时器“89:59”，补时线“+6”，以及两行比分：“FRA”配法国国旗和比分“2”，“ARG”配阿根廷国旗和比分“2”。在比分牌下方添加红色音频波形，以及标有“CROWD NOISE LEVEL”（观众噪音水平）和“MAXIMUM”（最大值）的小标签。在下方添加微小的技术文字，如“CAMERA 7”、“SLOW MOTION”和“180 FPS”。

底部标题区域：在底部中心横跨放置一个巨大的做旧白色标题 {argument name="main title" default="FINAL MINUTE"}，采用粗体压缩体育字体，带有粗糙纹理。下方添加标语 {argument name="tagline" default="90 MINUTES. ONE MOMENT THAT CHANGES EVERYTHING."}，其中“CHANGES EVERYTHING”以金色高亮显示。在最底部，添加一行微小的制作人员名单：{argument name="credit line" default="CRAFTED WITH GPT IMAGE 2 + SEEDANCE 2.0"}。

视觉风格：高级电影感足球海报，超细节，照片级真实感，深色 HDR 分级，浅景深，雨滴颗粒，火花，烟雾，球场泛光灯，爆炸性的金色五彩纸屑，对角线编辑构图，清晰的排版，强烈的运动感，病毒式体育社交媒体美学。

约束：使用 8 个带编号的面板加上单个大型英雄肖像面板。保持所有文字清晰、大写并融入设计中。不要添加额外的项目编号、额外的球队、水印、应用 UI 或不相关的标志。保持竖版社交媒体海报格式和戏剧性的世界杯最后一分钟氛围。

templates.title: Cyberpunk Neuromania Fashion Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克《神经漫游者》时尚海报

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="book title" default="NEUROMANCER"} Create a vertical cyberpunk fashion editorial poster featuring a full-body male model positioned in front of a large, glowing title spelled out behind him. Canvas: 4:5 vertical poster, glossy cinematic lighting, high resolution, deep blue, black, white, and electric cyan tones. Low-angle shot to make the figure appear tall and heroic. Subject: A young male cyberpunk model stands in the center, leaning slightly back, one hand in his pocket. His face is deliberately obscured with soft, square blurs/mosaics. He has messy, dark short hair and wears an all-black futuristic outfit: six visible clothing items—a high-necked, shiny leather jacket, a black layered shirt, cargo pants with zippered pockets and laces, a black belt with metal buckles, high-top lace-up combat boots, and small details such as straps/accessories. Wet, reflective high-fashion material textures. Background and Layout: The background is divided into two parts: a light-colored, cracked concrete wall on the left and a deep, smoky blue-black digital void on the right. Behind the model, a huge vertical neon outline font, partially obscured by the figure, forms {argument name="giant background letters" default="CASE"} The lettering is white on the left and electric blue on the right, creating a strong glowing effect. Blue mist is added at floor level, and the wet, reflective surface highlights the reflections of boots and neon lights. Poster text: Wide-spaced, glowing title text is placed at the bottom center.{argument name="bottom title text" default="NEUROMANCER"} Add a thin horizontal line and a tiny sci-fi style footer description. Includes 5 sets of bottom footer text: left microcode "NM-024 DATA COLLECTION", middle left "//", center "SPRING / SUMMER 2025 COLLECTION", middle right "SYSTEM COLLAPSE USER AWAKENS", and far right "NEUROMANCER © ALL RIGHTS RESERVED". Miniature Interface Details: 14 miniature HUD text/graphic elements added to the edges: a crosshair in the top left corner, a square displaying "DATA RUNNER // USER ID: CASE_024", a coordinate block, a location block displaying "SEOUL / NEW HONGDAE / DISTRICT", a vertical ruler, a square displaying "4TH CORPORATE WAR SURVIVOR", a circular schematic line graphic, a system code block displaying "SYS-8X 87 A2", a globe icon, a crosshair in the top right corner, a city list block displaying "NEO-TOKYO / SEOUL / CHIBA CITY / NEW YORK / LONDON", a vertical Asian character label with "//0024", a small square outline icon, and a square displaying "YOUTH / ISOLATION / INTERFACE / REALITY / GLITCH". All microtext remains small and decorative, like a futuristic data archive. Style: A combination of photorealistic fashion editorial photography and graphic design, dystopian cyberpunk book cover aesthetics, neon contour lighting, volumetric fog, scratched concrete, subtle data chart lines, high contrast, crisp boot details, and dramatic blue glow. Avoid extra characters, recognizable brand logos, and alterations to obscured facial effects.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="book title" default="NEUROMANCER"} 创建一张竖版赛博朋克时尚编辑海报，模特为全身男性，姿态位于其身后拼写出标题的巨大发光字体前。

画布：4:5 竖版海报，光泽感电影级布光，高分辨率，深蓝、黑、白与电光青色调。低机位仰拍视角，使人物显得高大且具有英雄气概。

主体：一位年轻的男性赛博朋克模特站在中心，身体微向后倾，单手插兜。他的面部被刻意用柔和的方形模糊/马赛克遮挡。他留着凌乱的深色短发，身着全黑未来感服装：共 6 件可见服装单品——高领亮面皮夹克、黑色叠穿衬衫、带有拉链口袋和绑带的工装裤、带金属扣的黑色腰带、高帮系带作战靴以及细小的挂带/配饰细节。湿润、反光的高级时装材质纹理。

背景与布局：背景采用左右分割设计，左侧为浅色裂纹混凝土墙，右侧为深邃烟雾状的蓝黑色数字虚空。在模特身后，使用巨大的垂直霓虹轮廓字体，部分被人物遮挡，组成 {argument name="giant background letters" default="CASE"} 字样；字母左侧为白色，右侧为电光蓝色，带有强烈的辉光效果。在地板高度添加蓝色雾气，湿润的反光地面映衬出靴子和霓虹灯的倒影。

海报文字：在底部中心放置宽间距的发光标题文字：{argument name="bottom title text" default="NEUROMANCER"}。添加细水平线和微小的科幻风格页脚说明。包含 5 组底部页脚文字：左侧微型代码“NM-024 DATA COLLECTION”，中左侧“//”，中心“SPRING / SUMMER 2025 COLLECTION”，中右侧“SYSTEM COLLAPSE USER AWAKENS”，最右侧“NEUROMANCER © ALL RIGHTS RESERVED”。

微型界面细节：在边缘处添加 14 个微型 HUD 文字/图形元素：左上角 1 个十字准星，1 个显示“DATA RUNNER // USER ID: CASE_024”的方块，1 个坐标块，1 个显示“SEOUL / NEW HONGDAE / DISTRICT”的位置块，1 个垂直刻度尺，1 个显示“4TH CORPORATE WAR SURVIVOR”的方块，1 个圆形示意图线条图形，1 个显示“SYS-8X 87 A2”的系统代码块，1 个地球仪图标，右上角 1 个十字准星，1 个显示“NEO-TOKYO / SEOUL / CHIBA CITY / NEW YORK / LONDON”的城市列表块，1 个带有“//0024”的垂直亚洲字符标签，1 个小方形轮廓图标，以及 1 个显示“YOUTH / ISOLATION / INTERFACE / REALITY / GLITCH”的方块。所有微型文字保持细小且具装饰性，如同未来派数据档案。

风格：照片级真实的时尚编辑摄影与平面设计相结合，反乌托邦赛博朋克书籍封面美学，霓虹轮廓光，体积雾，划痕混凝土，微妙的数据图表线条，高对比度，清晰的靴子细节，戏剧性的蓝色辉光。避免出现额外人物，避免出现可识别的品牌 Logo，避免更改被遮挡的面部效果。

templates.title: Flash photography style: School corridor uniform photos

titleLocalized.zh: 闪光灯摄影风格：学校走廊制服照

templates.prompt: Create a raw, candid flash photograph taken in a dimly lit high school hallway, using a 2:3 aspect ratio. The image features a teenager in a dark Korean/Japanese style school uniform, leaning against a long wall covered in stickers, labels, tape marks, graffiti, and scratches on a light blue-gray metal locker wall. The subject is slightly right-centered, with one hand resting on a locker, legs crossed, wearing…{argument name="school uniform style" default="A black suit jacket with gold buttons, a white shirt, a loose black tie with a badge, and a dark pleated skirt."} She wore black over-the-knee socks and black and white platform sneakers, carrying a shiny black shoulder bag with a silver chain. She kept {argument name="hair color and style" default="Her long, messy black hair was clipped with several small white hairpins."} The faces are deliberately blurred with square gray to conceal identities. The corridor extends into the background, featuring fluorescent ceiling lights, reflective gray floor tiles, and scattered papers. Groups of students talk on the left, their faces similarly softened or blurred. The right edge includes a red fire extinguisher and a Korean emergency exit sign with a downward arrow. The image employs the raw texture of a 2000s digital camera: strong direct flash, cool tones, high-contrast shadows, slight noise, imperfect composition, and a realistic sense of campus clutter, rejecting excessive retouching to create a documentary-style candid atmosphere. A subtle, watermark-like text line is added to the lower left corner.{argument name="watermark text" default="PromptHero"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张具有粗粝感的闪光灯抓拍照片，场景位于昏暗的高中走廊，采用 2:3 纵向比例。画面中，一名身着韩式/日式风格深色校服的青少年学生全身出镜，倚靠在贴满贴纸、标签、胶带痕迹、涂鸦和划痕的浅蓝灰色金属储物柜长墙旁。主体略微偏右居中，单手撑在储物柜上，双腿交叉，身穿 {argument name="school uniform style" default="黑色西装外套配金色纽扣、白色衬衫、带有徽章的宽松黑色领带、深色百褶短裙"}，搭配黑色过膝袜和黑白厚底运动鞋，肩背带有银色链条的亮面黑色单肩包。她留着 {argument name="hair color and style" default="凌乱的长黑发，别着几个白色小发夹"}；面部刻意使用方形灰色模糊处理以隐藏身份。走廊向背景深处延伸，配有天花板荧光灯、反光的灰色地砖、散落在地的纸张，左侧有成群结队谈话的学生，他们的面部同样经过柔化或模糊处理。右侧边缘包含一个红色灭火器和一个带有向下箭头的韩语紧急出口标志。采用 2000 年代数码相机的原始质感：强烈的直射闪光灯、冷色调、高对比阴影、轻微噪点、不完美的构图、真实的校园杂乱感，拒绝过度修图，营造纪录片式的抓拍氛围。在左下角添加一行细微的类似水印的文字 {argument name="watermark text" default="PromptHero"}。

templates.title: Soft-toned cat cafe iPhone lock screen wallpaper

titleLocalized.zh: 柔和色调小猫咖啡馆 iPhone 锁屏壁纸

templates.prompt: Create a 9:16 portrait-oriented, ultra-soft iPhone lock screen wallpaper showcase a dreamy, soft iOS aesthetic. The image displays a semi-transparent, rounded-corner iPhone screen floating above a blurred, warm pink and creamy background. Inside the phone, a soft Japanese watercolor café window scene is depicted in a flat 2D style, bathed in bright morning light, with shades of peach, blush pink, ivory, and honey gold. The main subject is an adorable, fluffy kitten with creamy gray fur, bright eyes, a pink nose, paws resting on a wooden windowsill, pink bows on its ears, and a pink collar with small heart pendants around its neck. Surrounding the kitten are cozy dessert still lifes: eight visible food and drink items, including three stacked macarons on a small stand, a jar of strawberry jam, a cup of strawberry cream dessert, a bread plate with two croissants (counted as one plate item), a pink cream drink or dessert, and a small jar or cup in the lower left corner. Add two floral decorative elements: a ceramic vase on the left containing small white flowers and pink roses, and some tiny white flowers near the edge of the right side. The view outside the window is blurred, depicting a street or bakery, to add depth. Overlay a realistic white iOS lock screen UI above the illustration: the status bar displays the Chinese carrier name "China Mobile" on the left, and signal bars, "5G," and a battery icon on the right; a small lock icon at the top center; the date text "Wednesday, September 7th"; an oversized time "12:57"; a small earphone battery widget on the left displaying "50%" and "WH-1000XM5" along with a short progress bar; a circular activity widget in the center; a text widget displaying "50%" with a small flashing indicator on the right; circular flashlight and camera buttons at the bottom; and a thin white home screen indicator bar. The phone's frame and UI utilize a frosted glass transparent effect, featuring a soft halo, subtle fog, and delicate bokeh. Adopting an Apple-style minimalist design, it creates a soothing atmosphere with no harsh outlines, extra text, or watermarks. Customization is supported.{argument name="time" default="12:57"} ,{argument name="date" default="Wednesday, September 7"} ,{argument name="main animal" default="fluffy cream-gray kitten"} ,{argument name="dessert theme" default="Pink Cafe Pastries and Macarons"} as well as{argument name="color palette" default="Peach, blush pink, ivory white, honey gold"} .

promptLocalized.zh:
创建一个 9:16 竖屏的超柔和 iPhone 锁屏壁纸展示，呈现梦幻般的柔和 iOS 美学。画面展示一个半透明圆角 iPhone 屏幕悬浮在模糊的暖粉色与奶油色背景之上。手机内部绘制一幅柔和的日式水彩咖啡馆窗景，采用扁平 2D 风格，带有明媚的晨光，色调为桃色、腮红粉、象牙白和蜂蜜金。主体是一只可爱的毛茸茸小猫，拥有奶油灰色的皮毛、明亮的大眼睛、粉色小鼻子，爪子搭在木质窗台上，耳朵上戴着粉色蝴蝶结，脖子上戴着带有小爱心吊坠的粉色项圈。小猫周围环绕着温馨的甜点静物：共 8 个可见的食物和饮品，包括小支架上的 3 个叠放马卡龙、1 罐草莓果酱、1 杯带草莓的奶油甜点、1 个放有 2 个可颂的面包盘（计为 1 个盘子项目）、1 杯粉色奶油饮品或甜点，以及左下角的一个小罐子或杯子。添加 2 个花卉装饰元素：左侧是一个装有小白花和粉玫瑰的陶瓷花瓶，右侧边缘附近有一些细小的白色花朵。窗外呈现模糊的街道或面包店外观，以增加深度感。

在插图上方叠加逼真的白色 iOS 锁屏 UI：状态栏左侧显示中文运营商文字“中国移动”，右侧显示信号格、“5G”和电池图标；顶部中央有一个小锁图标；日期文字“9 月 7 日 星期三”；超大时间“12:57”；左侧有一个小型耳机电池小组件，显示“50 %”和“WH-1000XM5”以及一条短进度线；中央有一个圆形活动类小组件；右侧有一个显示“50%”的文字小组件，带有细小的闪光标记；底部为手电筒和相机圆形按钮；以及一条细长的白色主屏幕指示条。手机边框和 UI 使用磨砂玻璃透明效果，带有柔和的光晕、轻微的雾气、细腻的焦外成像，采用苹果风格的简约设计，营造治愈氛围，无生硬轮廓，无额外文字，无水印。支持自定义 {argument name="time" default="12:57"}、{argument name="date" default="9 月 7 日 星期三"}、{argument name="main animal" default="毛茸茸的奶油灰色小猫"}、{argument name="dessert theme" default="粉色咖啡馆糕点和马卡龙"} 以及 {argument name="color palette" default="桃色、腮红粉、象牙白、蜂蜜金"}。

templates.title: Anime Couple Campus Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫双人校园海报

templates.prompt: Create a vertical 2D anime-style movie poster featuring two teenage characters in a dramatic school setting during a golden sunset. The first character is {argument name="male character name" default="Danny"} A short, stocky boy stands confidently on the left, one hand pointing at the audience, the other in his pocket. He has messy, dark curly hair, wears an oversized black T-shirt with colorful graffiti smiley faces and crowns, paired with olive-green cargo pants and chain accessories, and chunky high-top sneakers in purple, orange, white, and black. He wears a silver necklace. The second character is {argument name="female character name" default="Juliet"} A tall, slender girl stands on the right, with flowing red hair. One arm is casually draped over the boy's shoulder. She wears a navy blue private school blazer with pink piping and badges, over a white shirt, a pink tie, a plaid pleated skirt, white socks, white sneakers, and carries a navy blue backpack with pink trim and badges. Both characters' faces should be covered with smooth, rectangular skin-tone blur masks, as if under censorship, while the rest of the characters remain highly detailed. Background: A romantic city college campus with a clock tower on the left, a school flag with ornate lettering, city skyscrapers in the distance, canals or rivers reflecting warm light, cherry blossoms in full bloom, and pink petals falling in the foreground. Lighting and Style: Cinematic anime illustration, exquisite poster art, a warm orange-pink sunset sky, glowing clouds, rim lighting on character edges, rich details in clothing folds, saturated colors, high contrast, soft atmospheric depth, and subtle cinematic poster composition. Bottom Layout: Contains two lines of text. The first line is the main title "{argument name="poster title" default="DANNY & JULIET"} The lettering, "DANNY," is in a bold, yellow-orange, dripping graffiti-brush font; the "&" is white; and "JULIET" is in a large pink serif font with a paint splatter texture. The second line is the slogan.{argument name="tagline" default="Chaos meets discipline."} Use a small, mixed font of yellow, white, and pink, with tiny decorative separators. Keep the poster clean and centered, and do not add extra characters, logos, or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖版 2D 动漫风格的双人电影海报，画面中包含 2 名处于戏剧性校园背景下、正值黄金落日时刻的青少年角色。第一位角色是 {argument name="male character name" default="Danny"}，一个身材矮壮的男孩，站在左侧，姿态自信，一只手指向观众，另一只手插在口袋里；他留着凌乱的深色卷发，身穿黑色超大款 T 恤，上面印有彩色涂鸦笑脸和皇冠图案，搭配橄榄色工装裤和链条配饰，脚踩紫色、橙色、白色和黑色相间的厚底高帮运动鞋，颈部佩戴银色项链。第二位角色是 {argument name="female character name" default="Juliet"}，一个高挑苗条的女孩，站在右侧，留着飘逸的红色长发，一只手臂随意地搭在男孩的肩膀上，身穿带有粉色滚边和徽章的海军蓝私立学校西装外套，内搭白衬衫，系粉色领带，穿着格子百褶裙、白袜、白球鞋，背着带有粉色饰边和徽章的海军蓝背包。两个角色的面部均应被平滑的矩形肤色模糊遮罩覆盖，如同被审查一样，而角色的其余部分保持高度细节化。背景：浪漫的城市学院校园，左侧有一座钟楼，学校旗帜上印有华丽的字母组合，远处是城市摩天大楼，运河或河流反射着温暖的光芒，樱花树盛开，粉色的花瓣在前景中飘落。灯光与风格：电影级动漫插画，精致的海报艺术，温暖的橙粉色落日天空，云朵发光，角色边缘有轮廓光，衣物褶皱细节丰富，色彩饱和，高对比度，柔和的大气深度，微妙的电影海报构图。底部排版：包含 2 行文字。第一行是大标题“{argument name="poster title" default="DANNY & JULIET"}”，其中“DANNY”采用粗体黄橙色滴落涂鸦笔刷字体，“&”为白色，“JULIET”为带有油漆飞溅质感的大号粉色衬线字体。第二行是标语“{argument name="tagline" default="Chaos meets discipline."}”，采用较小的黄色、白色和粉色混合字体，并带有微小的装饰性分隔符。保持海报整洁且居中，不要添加额外角色、额外标志或水印。

templates.title: Gothic Girl by the City Window

titleLocalized.zh: 城市窗边的哥特女孩

templates.prompt: Create a semi-realistic anime-style illustration with a 9:16 vertical composition, depicting a young woman in a gothic/alternative style, languidly relaxing in a bright high-rise apartment. Beside her are large floor-to-ceiling windows offering views of a clear blue sky, fluffy clouds, and a distant city skyline. The woman possesses {argument name="hair color" default="Long, wet-look black hair"} Her hair was intricately detailed yet not overly frizzy, her skin fair, and her face deliberately obscured by a soft, rectangular blur/mask. She wore a short black tank top with a small white cross badge, paired with loose black cargo pants, a black belt with silver buckles and hanging chains, a black choker with small pendants, multiple earrings, and black nail polish. An oversized black down jacket slung over her shoulders. Her pose was relaxed, leaning against a white sofa, one knee raised close to the camera, one hand resting on a small round table. A large, intricate black tattoo was added to her visible upper arm. The room was brightly lit with strong natural light, soft shadows, and sharp highlights. The image must include six prominent background/foreground objects: a large wall poster that reads "DON'T OVERTHINK SHIT." (with tiny text below), a small pinkish-purple heart-shaped neon sign on the wall, two small square photo prints below the neon sign, a black Monster Energy can on the table, and a smartphone with a black and purple patterned phone case on the table. Add a large patch of green plant leaves from the upper right corner. Employ a trendy Japanese digital art style, showcasing highly detailed fabric folds, glossy hair, clean lines, realistic lighting, and a cool urban bedroom atmosphere. Maintain a cropped composition similar to a candid fashion portrait, with no watermarks, no extra characters, and no additional text besides the poster and wall detail text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 9:16 垂直构图的半写实动漫风格插画，描绘一位哥特/另类风格的年轻女性，她正慵懒地待在明亮的高层公寓里，身旁是高大的落地窗，窗外是晴朗的蓝天、蓬松的云朵和远处的城市天际线。女性拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="长款湿发感的黑色头发"}，发丝细节丰富但不过分毛躁，皮肤白皙，面部被一个柔和的矩形模糊/遮挡块刻意遮盖。她身穿黑色短款吊带背心，上面有一个白色的小十字形徽章，搭配宽松的黑色工装裤、带有银色扣环和悬挂链条的黑色腰带、带有小吊坠的黑色颈圈，佩戴多个耳环，涂着黑色指甲油，肩上滑落一件超大款黑色羽绒服。她的姿势放松，斜靠在白色沙发上，一只膝盖抬起靠近镜头，一只手放在小圆桌旁。在她可见的上臂处添加一个大面积且复杂的黑色纹身袖。房间阳光充足，自然光强烈，阴影柔和，高光清晰。画面中需包含 6 个显著的背景/前景物体：1 张写有“DON’T OVERTHINK SHIT.”的大型墙面海报（下方有微小文字），墙上 1 个粉紫色的小型心形霓虹灯牌，霓虹灯牌下方 2 张小方形照片打印件，桌上 1 罐黑色 Monster Energy 饮料，以及桌上 1 部带有黑紫色图案手机壳的智能手机。从右上角加入大片绿色植物叶片。采用时尚的日系数字艺术风格，展现高细节的布料褶皱、光泽感发丝、干净的线条、写实的灯光以及酷炫的都市卧室氛围。构图保持类似抓拍时尚肖像的裁剪效果，无水印，无额外角色，除海报和墙面细节文字外，不包含任何额外文字。

templates.title: Indoor stadium cheerleading performance

titleLocalized.zh: 室内体育馆啦啦队表演

templates.prompt: Create a realistic, high-resolution photograph of a sporting event to showcase{argument name="team name" default="BEARS"} Cheerleading is performed during a basketball game in a large indoor stadium. The footage must include seven adult female cheerleaders: two cheerleaders in the foreground center, facing away from the camera with their shoulders slightly turned to the side, close together, wearing navy blue, white, and red striped cropped cheerleading tops and pleated skirts; one main jumping cheerleader on each of the far left and far right sides, arms raised in a V-shape, one leg bent or raised, wearing white sneakers and white socks; one background cheerleader jumping in the center left position; one cheerleader cut off at the far left edge; and one smaller cheerleader in the background. The uniforms should be navy blue with red and white trim, pleated skirts, white sneakers, and red, white, and blue striped headbands. The visible front of the tops must clearly display [the cheerleader's name/description].{argument name="uniform text" default="BEARS"} The scene is set on a sleek wooden basketball court with its lines and reflections, against a backdrop of crowded stadium stands, overhead steel trusses, bright arena lights, and blue advertising projects. Utilize dynamic action photography, wide-angle perspectives, shallow depth of field, natural indoor lighting, crisp fabric details, a vibrant game-day atmosphere, and realistic dynamic poses. Ensure all performers are adults, and avoid adding any additional logos beyond customizable team text, and refrain from adding extra figures in the foreground.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张逼真的高分辨率体育赛事照片，展示 {argument name="team name" default="BEARS"} 啦啦队在大型室内体育馆的篮球比赛期间进行表演。画面中需包含 7 名成年女性啦啦队员：2 名位于前景中央的啦啦队员背对镜头，肩部微侧，紧靠在一起，身穿海军蓝、白色和红色相间的露脐啦啦队上衣及百褶短裙；最左侧和最右侧各有 1 名主要跳跃队员，双臂举成 V 字型，一条腿向后弯曲或抬起，穿着白色运动鞋和白色短袜；左中位置有 1 名正在跳跃的背景啦啦队员；最左侧边缘有 1 名被截断的啦啦队员；球场后方还有 1 名较小的远景啦啦队员。制服应为海军蓝色，配有红白饰边、百褶裙、白色运动鞋和红白蓝相间的发带，可见的上衣正面需清晰印有 {argument name="uniform text" default="BEARS"} 字样。场景设定在带有球场线条和倒影的光滑木质篮球场上，背景为拥挤的体育馆看台、头顶的钢制桁架、明亮的场馆灯光以及蓝色的广告项目。采用动态动作摄影、广角视角、浅景深、自然室内光线、清晰的织物细节、充满活力的比赛日氛围以及逼真的动态姿势。确保所有表演者均为成年人，除可自定义的团队文字外，请勿添加其他标志，且不要在前景中添加额外人物。

templates.title: MPLUS Link Modern UI Redesign

titleLocalized.zh: MPLUS Link 现代 UI 重新设计

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the source UI, the Teams-like internal/external collaboration system was redesigned into a simpler, more modern product model, while retaining the MPLUS Link brand, the dark blue left-side navigation bar, and the overall application functionality. A sophisticated 2-column, 3-row demo was created, showcasing six redesigned screens: 1) featuring a large main visual card and Japanese titles.{argument name="headline text" default="We centralize collaboration with external partners through an invitation-only, dedicated workspace."} 1) A welcome/login landing page with a login tab/button and a realistic desktop monitor main visual image; 2) A project bridging chat screen with right-aligned chat cards, action chips, and a message editor; 3) A team list screen simplified into two concise team cards; 4) A resource/document list screen with upload controls, search/filter areas, and file rows; 5) Titled{argument name="room title" default="MPI Collaborative Development Room"} The shared collaboration room screen includes project overview cards and a compact member/status list; 6) Titled{argument name="admin title" default="User Management"} The user management screen includes user rows and a blank details panel. The new model is more spacious than the reference image: fewer table rows, increased margins, softer separator lines, a light blue-gray background, white rounded-corner cards, subtle shadows, and small blue/green accent buttons. It maintains the feel and virtual data attributes of Japanese enterprise SaaS, but removes dense and cumbersome tables, replacing them with a simplified, aesthetically pleasing UI model suitable for design improvements and comparisons. The brand name is used in the sidebar.{argument name="brand name" default="MPLUS Link"} Ensure the sidebar remains consistent across all screens and avoid adding irrelevant features, watermarks, or decorative clutter.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 作为源 UI，将类似 Teams 的内部/外部协作系统重新设计为更简洁、更现代的产品模型，同时保留 MPLUS Link 品牌、深蓝色左侧导航栏以及整体应用功能。制作一个精致的 2 列 3 行演示，展示 6 个重新设计的屏幕：1) 带有大型主视觉卡片、日语标题 {argument name="headline text" default="社外パートナー連携を、招待制の専用ワークスペースで一元化"}、登录选项卡/按钮以及逼真的桌面显示器主视觉图像的欢迎/登录落地页；2) 带有右对齐聊天卡片、操作芯片和消息编辑器的项目桥接聊天屏幕；3) 简化为两个简洁团队卡片的团队列表屏幕；4) 带有上传控件、搜索/筛选区域和文件行的资料/文档列表屏幕；5) 标题为 {argument name="room title" default="MPI 共同開発ルーム"} 的共享协作室屏幕，包含项目概览卡片和紧凑的成员/状态列表；6) 标题为 {argument name="admin title" default="ユーザー管理"} 的用户管理屏幕，包含用户行和空白详情面板。使新模型比参考图更宽敞：减少表格行数、增加边距、使用更柔和的分隔线、淡蓝灰色背景、白色圆角卡片、细腻的阴影以及小巧的蓝/绿色强调按钮。保持日本企业级 SaaS 的质感和虚拟数据属性，但去除密集且琐碎的表格，取而代之以适合设计改进对比的简化、美观的 UI 模型。在侧边栏中使用品牌名称 {argument name="brand name" default="MPLUS Link"}，确保侧边栏在每个屏幕上保持一致，并避免添加无关功能、水印或装饰性杂物。

templates.title: Disposable film style sailor uniform cosplay portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 一次性胶片风格水手服 Cosplay 人像

templates.prompt: Create a realistic 35mm disposable film-style street portrait. The subject is a lovely young woman wearing {argument name="outfit" default="Japanese Navy-style blue and white sailor uniform, short-sleeved white shirt, navy-style sailor collar with white stripes, navy blue ribbon bow, and navy blue pleated skirt."} She stood shyly outside a small neighborhood café on a street in a Japanese residential area. The shot is a medium shot, capturing her full body from mid-thigh up. She held her dark blue backpack by the light gray handle with her hands clasped together; the backpack was positioned at the bottom edge of the frame.{argument name="hair style" default="Medium-length brown hair, slightly messy, half-tied up with a few wispy strands."} Glistening in the warm sunlight, faces are softly blurred/mosaiced to protect privacy. The scene includes a narrow asphalt street on the left, complete with red lane lines, curbs, telephone poles, low concrete walls, houses, plants, and bright summer greenery; on the right is a cozy café entrance with wooden glass doors, wooden chairs, potted shrubs, and a service window through which cups and café furnishings can be seen, bathed in warm lighting. The use of natural daylight, soft shadows, warm, nostalgic tones, slight film grain, realistic skin and fabric textures, casual, candid composition, a 4:5 aspect ratio, and shallow to medium depth of field creates an authentic Fujifilm disposable camera feel. The image contains no text, no watermark, and no other people as the main subject.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实风格的 35mm 一次性胶片感街头抓拍人像，主角是一位可爱的年轻女性，身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="日本海军风蓝白水手校服，短袖白衬衫，带有白色条纹的海军风水手领，海军蓝丝带蝴蝶结，以及海军蓝百褶短裙"}，羞涩地站在日本住宅区街道旁的一家小型社区咖啡馆外。画面采用中景构图，从大腿中部以上拍摄全身，她双手合十握住深蓝色书包的浅灰色提手，书包位于画面底部边缘。她的 {argument name="hair style" default="中长棕色头发，略显凌乱，半扎起并留有几缕碎发"} 在温暖的阳光下闪烁，面部经过柔和的方形模糊/马赛克处理以保护隐私。场景包括左侧狭窄的沥青街道，带有红色的车道线、路缘石、电线杆、低矮的混凝土墙、房屋、植物和明亮的夏季绿植；右侧是温馨的咖啡馆入口，配有木质玻璃门、木椅、盆栽灌木、服务窗口，透过窗户可以看到杯子和咖啡馆陈设，室内灯光温暖。采用自然日光、柔和阴影、温暖的怀旧色调、轻微的胶片颗粒感、真实的皮肤和织物纹理、随意的抓拍构图、竖向 4:5 画幅、浅至中等的景深，呈现地道的 Fujifilm 一次性相机质感。画面无文字，无水印，无其他人物作为主体。

templates.title: Disposable film camera style magical girl cosplay

titleLocalized.zh: 一次性胶片相机风格魔法少女 Cosplay

templates.prompt: Create a nostalgic, disposable film-camera style nighttime portrait of a young woman dressed in a pink and white idol costume, cosplaying as a magical girl. The shoot should take place outdoors in a dimly lit park or garden, with trees in the background adorned with warm fairy lights. She stands in a half-length pose, her gloved hands clasped to her chest, holding a heart-shaped magic wand with a gold handle and pink heart decorations. The costume is made of glossy satin and organza: a pale pink pleated skirt, a white iridescent corset, a large pink bow adorned with a red heart gemstone at the chest, ruffled puff sleeves, lace trim, a semi-transparent pleated overskirt, white satin gloves with pink lace cuffs, and a matching headband with a large pale pink bow. She has long, dark, wavy hair that falls over her shoulders, but her face is deliberately blurred with a soft, square-shaped effect. This amateur cosplay event photography uses a strong direct flash, high ISO noise, slight underexposure, warm orange bokeh, and deep black shadows to create a candid, snapshot-style effect. The 4:5 vertical composition, realistic fabric sheen, and slightly casual arrangement are all present. There is no text or watermark. Customization is available through the following parameters:{argument name="costume colors" default="light pink and white"} (Clothing color){argument name="magical prop" default="Heart-shaped magic wand"} (props),{argument name="night location" default="A dimly lit park with fairy lights"} (Scene){argument name="camera style" default="Disposable film camera flash"} (Camera style) and{argument name="face treatment" default="Soft square privacy blur"} (Facial treatment).

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张怀旧的一次性胶片相机风格夜间人像，主角是一位身着粉白配色偶像装的年轻女性，正在进行魔法少女 Cosplay。拍摄地点位于户外昏暗的公园或花园，背景中的树木缠绕着温暖的仙女灯。她以半身像姿势居中站立，戴着手套的双手捧在胸前，握着一支带有金色手柄和粉色心形装饰的心形魔法棒。服装材质为光泽缎面和欧根纱：淡粉色百褶裙、白色虹彩紧身胸衣、胸前饰有红心宝石的大粉色蝴蝶结、荷叶边泡泡袖、蕾丝饰边、半透明褶皱罩裙、白色缎面手套配粉色蕾丝袖口，以及带有大号淡粉色蝴蝶结的配套发带。她留着长长的深色波浪卷发，垂落在肩头，但面部刻意采用了柔和的方形隐私模糊处理。使用强烈的直射闪光灯、高 ISO 噪点、轻微曝光不足、温暖的橙色光斑虚化、深邃的黑色阴影，呈现出抓拍风格的业余 Cosplay 活动摄影效果，4:5 竖构图，逼真的面料光泽，略显随意的构图，无文字或水印。可通过以下参数自定义：{argument name="costume colors" default="淡粉色和白色"}（服装颜色）、{argument name="magical prop" default="心形魔法棒"}（道具）、{argument name="night location" default="带有仙女灯的昏暗公园"}（场景）、{argument name="camera style" default="一次性胶片相机闪光灯"}（相机风格）以及 {argument name="face treatment" default="柔和方形隐私模糊"}（面部处理）。

templates.title: "Voice Connects Humanity" Poster

titleLocalized.zh: “声音连接人类”海报

templates.prompt: Objective: Create an extremely detailed vertical music community poster themed around sound transcending eras, borders, genders, ages, and analog and digital media, showcasing how music connects humanity. The poster will feature a luminous, fantastical realist collage. Canvas: Vertical 2:3 poster, cinematic-quality digital painting, with warm sunset gold interwoven with neon blues, purples, and pinks. No borders; the canvas will be filled with layered scenes and luminous musical effects. Central Composition: A large, radiating white-gold circular halo, like a sun composed of sound waves and stardust, will be placed at the very center. Above this halo, the main Japanese title will be placed.{argument name="headline text" default="Connected by sound"} The title uses a deep navy blue calligraphic serif font. Below the title, three lines of smaller Japanese subtitles are placed in the center:{argument name="subheading line one" default="Time, borders, gender, age"} ,{argument name="subheading line two" default="アナログもデジタルも"} ,as well as{argument name="subheading line three" default="Sound transcends boundaries."} Ensure the text is clearly legible against a glowing central background. Key visual element: A large spiral ribbon of light and musical notation winds from the bottom left to the center, through the middle and top right, and back to the bottom. The ribbon contains glowing musical staves, eighth notes, treble clef-like musical symbols, particles, wave-like sparks, small app-like music icons, and digital pixels. It should give the impression that sound physically connects every scene. Layout: Construct seven interconnected main scene areas around the central title: 1. Top left: Prehistoric/tribal campfire music: People dance, drum, and sing around a campfire under the stars. 2. Top center: Ancient classical world: Remains resembling Greek or Roman columns, musicians playing cellos, flutes, drums, and traditional stringed instruments under a golden sunset. 3. Top right: East Asian historical music scene: Japanese temple rooftops, pagodas, cherry blossoms, shamisen players, kimono-style clothing, and lantern glow. 4. Left-center ancient desert/World Heritage scene: Pyramids in the background, musicians playing guitars and percussion instruments, accompanied by travelers and dancers. 5. Center-center modern global city concert: Skyline, skyscrapers, diverse band members, singers, guitarists, saxophones, brass instruments, and the energy of the crowd. 6. Right-center futuristic digital DJ/electronic music scene: DJ in front of a glowing mixing console with a laptop screen, neon equalizer, holographic icons, synthesizer lights, and a cyberpunk-style purple-blue atmosphere. 7. Bottom global community gathering: Children, adults, and seniors, people from different cultural backgrounds and abilities (including wheelchair users) sit or stand in a circle, accompanied by acoustic guitars, headphones, laptop music workstations, city lights, temples, domed buildings, and a row of silhouettes holding hands on the horizon. People and Instruments: The poster showcases approximately 70 diverse figures, ranging from children to seniors, of different ages, skin colors, body types, and genders, dressed in historical costumes, modern streetwear, traditional clothing, and futuristic attire. Includes 16 clearly defined instrument or music production categories: hand drum, tambourine, flute, cello, shamisen, pipa-like instruments, acoustic guitar, electric guitar, bass, saxophone, trumpet, violin, microphone vocals, DJ controllers, laptop digital audio workstations, and headphones. Some faces can be smaller or use an impressionistic style, but the overall atmosphere must be cheerful, community-oriented, and inclusive. Style: A combination of epic fantasy realism and Japanese holiday posters and generative AI music community art. Extremely dense, gorgeous, and luminous; painterly yet with sharp lines; dramatic sky gradients; shimmering particles; cinematic rim lighting; rich historical details; neon digital overlays; a deep sense of depth from the foreground to the distant horizon. Use striking contrasts between ancient firelight, sunset gold, and futuristic blue-magenta light. Restrictions: Do not leave any blank areas except for the central text halo. All Japanese typography must strictly adhere to the specified content. Avoid logos, watermarks, brand names, random extra text, distorted musical scores that disrupt the title, or a dystopian atmosphere that is either terrifying or dark. The final image should convey that sound transcends time, country, gender, age, and whether it is analog or digital, connecting everyone.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张细节极其丰富的竖版音乐社区海报，主题为声音跨越时代、国界、性别、年龄、模拟媒介与数字媒介，通过发光的奇幻现实主义拼贴画，展现人类因音乐而紧密相连。

画布：竖版 2:3 海报，电影级超精细数字绘画，温暖的夕阳金与霓虹蓝、紫、粉色交织。无边距；用分层场景和发光的音乐动效填满整个画布。

中心构图：在正中心放置一个巨大的放射状白金色圆形光晕，如同由声波和星尘组成的太阳。在其上方，设置主要的日文标题 {argument name="headline text" default="音で繋がれ"}，使用深海军蓝色的书法衬线字体。在标题下方，居中放置三行较小的日文副标题：{argument name="subheading line one" default="時代も国境も性別も年齢も"}，{argument name="subheading line two" default="アナログもデジタルも"}，以及 {argument name="subheading line three" default="「音」は垣根を超えて届く"}。确保文字在发光的中心背景下清晰易读。

主要视觉元素：一条巨大的光与乐谱螺旋丝带从左下角绕向中心，穿过中部和右上角，再回到底部。丝带中包含发光的五线谱、八分音符、高音谱号类音乐符号、粒子、波形火花、小型应用类音乐图标及数字像素。它应给人一种声音在物理层面连接每一个场景的质感。

布局：在中心标题周围构建 7 个相互连接的主要场景区域：
1. 左上角史前/部落篝火音乐：人们在星空下的篝火旁跳舞、击鼓、歌唱。
2. 上方中心古代古典世界：类似希腊或罗马柱的遗迹，音乐家在金色夕阳下演奏大提琴、长笛、手鼓及传统弦乐器。
3. 右上角东亚历史音乐场景：日本寺庙屋顶、宝塔、樱花、三味线演奏者、和服风格服饰及灯笼光芒。
4. 中左侧古代沙漠/世界遗产场景：背景为金字塔，音乐家演奏吉他类和打击乐器，伴有旅行者和舞者。
5. 中间中心现代全球城市演唱会：天际线、高楼大厦、多元化的乐队成员、歌手、吉他手、萨克斯风、铜管乐器及人群的活力。
6. 中右侧未来主义数字 DJ/电子音乐场景：DJ 在发光的调音台前，配有笔记本电脑式屏幕、霓虹均衡器、全息图标、合成器灯光及赛博朋克风格的紫蓝色氛围。
7. 底部全球社区聚会：儿童、成人、长者，不同文化背景和能力的人们（包括轮椅使用者）围坐或站立成一个圆圈，配有木吉他、耳机、笔记本电脑音乐工作站、城市灯光、寺庙、圆顶建筑，以及地平线上手拉手的一排剪影。

人物与乐器：海报中总共展示约 70 位多元化的人物，涵盖从儿童到长者的不同年龄段、不同肤色、体型、性别，身着历史服饰、现代街头服饰、传统服装及未来主义装束。包含 16 类明确的乐器或音乐制作类别：手鼓、框鼓、长笛、大提琴、三味线、琵琶类乐器、木吉他、电吉他、贝斯、萨克斯风、小号、小提琴、麦克风演唱、DJ 控制器、笔记本数字音频工作站及耳机。部分面孔可以较小或采用印象派手法，但整体氛围必须是欢快、社区化且包容的。

风格：史诗般的奇幻现实主义与日式节日海报及生成式 AI 音乐社区艺术的结合。极其密集、华丽且发光；具有绘画感但线条锐利；戏剧性的天空渐变；闪烁的粒子；电影级的轮廓光；丰富的历史细节；霓虹数字叠加；从前景到远方天际线的深远层次感。在古代火光、夕阳金与未来主义青品红光之间运用鲜明的对比。

限制：除中心文字光晕外，不要留出空白区域。所有日文排版必须严格按照指定内容执行。避免出现标志、水印、品牌名称、随机的额外文字、破坏标题的畸形乐谱，或恐怖/阴暗的反乌托邦氛围。最终图像应传达：声音跨越时间、国家、性别、年龄、模拟与数字，将所有人连接在一起。

templates.title: Cyber ​​Maid Cosplay Flash Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博女仆 Cosplay 闪光灯人像

templates.prompt: Create a realistic cosplay portrait with a disposable camera style. The image features a young woman dressed in a futuristic white cyberpunk maid outfit, set in the nighttime kitchen of a modern high-rise apartment. She is positioned in the center of the frame, the frame extending from mid-thigh to head, facing the camera directly, her hands supporting a round stainless steel tray at her waist. Her outfit is glossy white with silver metallic accessories: a white ruffled maid headband, long, dark wavy hair, a white structured corset with semi-transparent ruffled shoulder straps, a white choker with large metal rings, silver chain details, metal wristbands, armbands, a white apron trim, a short, multi-layered skirt with semi-transparent ruffles, and black and silver cyberpunk-style suspender accessories.{argument name="costume color" default="White and silver"} As the main color of the clothing, and using{argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown long hair"} The background is a stylish stainless steel kitchen with a range hood and reflective metal backsplash on the right, warm under-cabinet lighting, and wooden lower cabinets. On the left is a large, dark window offering a view of the nighttime city skyline dotted with architectural lights. The image should have the texture of an amateur flash photograph taken with a portable disposable camera: direct flash, slight grain, warm indoor highlights, high contrast, slight lens distortion, and a casual cosplay vibe, showcasing realistic skin and fabric textures. Maintain a vertical composition for an intimate, documentary feel, with the subject occupying most of the frame. Add a large, soft rectangular blur to the face to conceal identity while preserving the visibility of hair, clothing, and background. Avoid text, logos, watermarks, superfluous figures, or exaggerated, fantastical anatomical structures.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张具有一次性相机风格的写实 Cosplay 人像，画面中是一位身穿未来感白色赛博女仆装的年轻女性，场景位于现代高层公寓的夜间厨房。她位于画面中央，取景范围从大腿中部到头部，正对镜头，双手在腰部位置托着一个圆形不锈钢托盘。她的服装为亮面白色，配有银色金属配件：白色荷叶边女仆发箍、深色长波浪卷发、白色结构化紧身胸衣配半透明荷叶边肩带、带有大金属环的白色颈圈、银色链条细节、金属腕带、上臂带、白色围裙饰片、带有半透明褶边的短款多层裙，以及黑银配色的赛博风格吊带饰品。使用 {argument name="costume color" default="白色和银色"} 作为服装主色调，并使用 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色长发"}。背景是一个时尚的不锈钢厨房，右侧有抽油烟机和反光金属防溅板，配有温暖的橱柜下照明、木质下橱柜，左侧是一扇巨大的深色窗户，可以看到点缀着建筑灯光的夜间城市天际线。图像应呈现出使用便携式一次性相机拍摄的业余闪光灯照片质感：直射闪光、轻微颗粒感、温暖的室内高光、高对比度、轻微的镜头畸变，以及随性的 Cosplay 活动氛围，并展现真实的皮肤和织物纹理。保持垂直构图，营造亲密且纪实的感觉，主体占据画面大部分空间。在面部添加一个大的柔和矩形模糊效果以隐藏身份，同时保留头发、服装和背景的可见性。避免出现文字、Logo、水印、多余人物或夸张的幻想解剖结构。

templates.title: Luxury smartwatch lifestyle advertisement

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华智能手表生活方式广告

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic luxury lifestyle advertisement showcasing a well-dressed adult man wearing a [item/product] on his left wrist.{argument name="smartwatch model" default="Black Apple Watch Ultra style smartwatch"} The watch must be the central element: a rounded, square black case with a dark, unilluminated glass screen, a thick, hard-core bezel, a side crown and pushers, and a black leather or textured strap with delicate warm brown trim; the case shape, strap shape, material, and tactile texture must be accurately reproduced. The display shows a man's hand elegantly resting on a polished wooden table, fingers naturally extended, showcasing realistic skin pores, veins, knuckles, nails, and soft highlights. He is dressed in {argument name="suit color" default="Dark navy blue suit"} A crisp white shirt cuff is visible behind the watch. The scene is set in an upscale private lounge or hotel club, with a background of blurred, warm wood paneling, brown leather armchairs, a side table, soft curtains, green plants, and a glowing lamp. Use shallow depth of field, warm amber indoor lighting, cinematic bokeh, sophisticated editing composition, and a three-quarter close-up angle slightly overhead. Keep the watch in sharp focus with a softly blurred background. The image must not contain text, emphasize logos, add extra accessories, distort human anatomy, alter the watch's proportions, or include a screen UI.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张照片级逼真的奢华生活方式广告，展示一位仪表堂堂的成年男士左手腕上佩戴的 {argument name="smartwatch model" default="黑色 Apple Watch Ultra 风格智能手表"}。手表必须作为核心主体：采用圆角方形黑色表壳，配有深色未点亮的玻璃屏幕、厚实的硬核表圈、侧面表冠和按钮，以及带有细腻暖棕色边缘装饰的黑色皮革或纹理表带；必须精准还原表壳形状、表带形状、材质及触感纹理。展示男士的手优雅地放在抛光的木桌上，手指自然伸展，呈现真实的皮肤毛孔、静脉、指关节、指甲和柔和的高光。他身着 {argument name="suit color" default="深海军蓝西装"}，手表后方可见挺括的白色衬衫袖口。场景设定在高档私人休息室或酒店俱乐部，背景为模糊的温暖木质镶板、棕色皮扶手椅、边桌、柔和的窗帘、绿色植物和发光的台灯。采用浅景深、温暖的琥珀色室内光线、电影级焦外成像、高级编辑构图，以及从桌面上方略微俯视的四分之三特写角度。保持手表清晰对焦，背景柔和虚化。画面中不得包含文字、不得强调 Logo、不得添加额外配饰、不得出现人体结构扭曲、不得改变手表比例、不得添加屏幕 UI。

templates.title: Illustration of a bride's kiss with soft veils

titleLocalized.zh: 柔和遮挡的新娘之吻插画

templates.prompt: Create a delicate, vertical, romantic anime-style watercolor illustration, depicting {argument name="character name" default="A young bride"} and{argument name="partner" default="A light-haired young man"} The scene depicts the couple standing close together in a brightly lit indoor setting, as if about to kiss or share an intimate moment. The bride is shown from behind and in profile, her long, dark brown hair styled in a loose, low bun with many wispy strands, adorned with a magnificent white floral hair accessory embellished with pearl-like dangling beads; she wears a light, delicately pleated ivory wedding dress, kimono, or gown. The partner appears at the upper right corner, revealing only glimpses of light gold or silver hair and a gentle, downcast face. A large, opaque beige square obscures the area where the two are touching in the center of the image, covering their faces, positioned across the right side of the frame. The composition uses soft cream, beige, ivory, and light gold tones, employing soft backlighting, dusty sunlight, and subtle floral wallpaper or window reflections in the background to create a tranquil, nostalgic atmosphere of understated longing and tenderness. The style should emphasize fine lines, transparency, and a painterly quality, with rich details in the hair and accessories, low contrast, a semi-transparent watercolor-like texture, and no text or watermarks in the image.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅细腻的竖版浪漫动漫风格水彩插画，描绘 {argument name="character name" default="一位年轻新娘"} 和 {argument name="partner" default="一位浅发青年"} 在阳光明媚的室内近距离站立，仿佛即将亲吻或共享私密气息的场景。新娘以背影及侧面呈现，深棕色长发盘成松散的低发髻，带有许多细碎发丝，佩戴着饰有珍珠般垂坠珠饰的华丽白色花卉发饰；她身着质感轻盈、褶皱细腻的象牙白婚纱和服或礼袍。伴侣出现在右上角边缘，仅露出部分浅金或银色头发及低垂的温和面容。在画面中心两人接触的区域覆盖一个大型不透明米色方形遮挡块，遮住两人的面部，位置横跨画面中右侧。采用柔和的奶油色、米色、象牙白和浅金色调，运用柔和的背光、尘埃般的阳光、背景中隐约的花卉壁纸或窗户倒影，营造出一种含蓄渴望与温柔的静谧怀旧氛围。风格应追求细线条、通透感、绘画性，发丝与配饰细节丰富，低对比度，呈现半透明水彩质感，且画面中不含任何文字或水印。

templates.title: Cleaning scene at a Japanese school swimming pool

titleLocalized.zh: 日本学校泳池清洁场景

templates.prompt: Create a realistic, vertical mobile phone photograph that captures the bright, textured feel of a Japanese summer beverage advertisement. The image showcases {argument name="number of students" default="Three"} The scene depicts lively high school girls cleaning the deck of their outdoor school swimming pool on a sunny day. The image is natural and highly realistic, featuring natural sunlight, blue skies, soft white clouds, damp, reflective concrete, sparkling water, and a fresh, youthful atmosphere. All students are dressed in matching Japanese school uniforms: white short-sleeved shirts, loose navy blue striped ties, and blue plaid pleated skirts, standing barefoot on the wet poolside. The frame must include exactly three girls: the girl in the middle, closest to the camera, leans forward, pushing a long-handled deck brush towards the viewer, with a dark bob haircut and rolled-up sleeves; the girl on the left stands beside a wire fence, holding a blue hose spraying water, a navy blue backpack slung over her shoulder with cute little charms; the girl on the right stands tall, one hand on her hip, the other holding a cup of iced bubble tea with a straw, her long, dark hair tied up, exuding ease and confidence. The image includes exactly three main cleaning/drink props: a deck brush, a blue hose spraying water, and a cup of bubble tea. Add a bright blue plastic bucket to the bottom right edge. Background details: School buildings and swimming pool facilities are visible in the distance along the barbed wire fence on the left, and a bright blue swimming pool is visible behind the girl. Composition: A full-body shot from low to slightly upward angle, 9:16 vertical composition, with the main subject prominent in the center and the girls on the left and right sides for balance; shallow but realistic depth of field. Visual style: Realistic Japanese commercial photography, with clear skin and fabric textures, bright wetland reflections, high dynamic range, clean color gradation, summer blue and white tones, no text, no watermarks, and no irrelevant people. Faces should be natural, beautiful, and realistic, and customization is supported.{argument name="center hairstyle" default="Dark short bob haircut"} ,{argument name="left hairstyle" default="Dark ponytail"} ,{argument name="right hairstyle" default="Dark long hair tied up"} as well as{argument name="setting" default="Outdoor Japanese high school poolside"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实风格的竖版手机摄影图，呈现明亮的日本夏季饮料广告质感，画面展示了 {argument name="number of students" default="三名"} 活泼的高中女生在阳光明媚的日子里清洁户外学校游泳池甲板的场景。画面自然且极具真实感，包含自然日光、蓝天、柔软的白云、湿润的反射混凝土、闪烁的水花以及清新青春的氛围。所有学生均穿着统一的日本校服：白色短袖衬衫、松开的海军蓝条纹领带、蓝色格子百褶裙，且在湿润的池边赤脚站立。画面中必须正好有三名女生：中间的女生距离镜头最近，身体前倾，正向观众方向推着一把长柄甲板刷，留着深色短波波头，袖口卷起；左侧女生站在铁丝网旁，手持正在喷水的蓝色软管，肩上挂着海军蓝书包，包上挂着可爱的小挂件；右侧女生站姿挺拔，一手叉腰，另一只手拿着一杯插着吸管的冰珍珠奶茶，留着深色长发并扎起，姿态轻松自信。包含正好三个主要的清洁/饮料道具：一把甲板刷、一根正在喷水的蓝色软管，以及一杯珍珠奶茶。在右下角边缘添加一个亮蓝色塑料桶。背景细节：左侧沿着铁丝网，远处可见学校建筑和泳池设施，女生身后可见明亮的蓝色游泳池。构图：低视平线至略微仰角的全身照，9:16 竖构图，中间主体突出，左右两侧女生平衡构图，景深浅但真实。视觉风格：写实风格的日本商业摄影，清晰的皮肤和织物纹理，光亮的湿地反射，高动态范围，干净的色彩分级，夏季蓝白色调，无文字，无水印，无无关人员。面部应自然美观且真实，并支持自定义 {argument name="center hairstyle" default="深色短波波头"}、{argument name="left hairstyle" default="深色马尾"}、{argument name="right hairstyle" default="深色长发扎起"} 以及 {argument name="setting" default="户外日本高中泳池边"}。

templates.title: Cute Ram Horned Girl Portal Comic

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱羊角少女传送门漫画

templates.prompt: Objective: To create an adorable vertical four-panel comic strip about a horned girl and her little sheep's encounter with a magical portal and a cat. Canvas: Vertical comic page, 768 x 1152 pixels. Style: Warm, soft colors, thin dark brown borders, soft cel animation illustrations, creating a cozy, everyday fantasy atmosphere. Four horizontal panels are stacked vertically, leaving a narrow white gap in the middle. Main Character: A character named {argument name="character name" default="HITSURO"} The character is a chibi-style ram-horned girl with a cream-white bob haircut, curly ram horns on either side, pointed elf ears, and large brown eyes. She wears a white shirt, a light pink apron with pockets and a bow, a dark pleated skirt, knee-high socks, and soft-soled shoes. In the first panel, her face is deliberately obscured by a beige rectangular block. A fluffy white sheep appears in each panel, with round black eyes, pink cheeks, small droopy ears, and a short tail. A calico cat appears in panels 3 and 4, with white, orange, and dark brown patches, round eyes, and a playful expression. Layout and Story: Four panels are used. 1. Panel 1: A cozy interior scene with wooden floors, bookshelves, bottles, potted plants, wall art, curtains, and windows. The ram-horned girl stands on the right, with her back or side to the camera, her face obscured by a beige rectangle. A little sheep stands on the floor to her left, trembling slightly with motion effects. Add a vertical Japanese speech bubble on the right, with the following content:{argument name="panel 1 dialogue" default="...It's shaking..."} 2. Second panel: The wooden floor cracks, revealing a jagged hole shimmering with purple galactic light. A little sheep is peeking out or peering into the hole, its body glowing. The horned girl crouches on the right, looking worried, and reaches into the hole. Add a vertical dialogue bubble on the right, containing:{argument name="panel 2 dialogue" default="Hitsuro, don't go near him."} 3. Third panel: A vertically oriented oval purple portal opens on the left, revealing a star-studded night sky and a glowing yellow star. A calico cat leaps out of the portal and rushes into the room with exaggerated radiating speed lines. A little sheep stands on the right-hand side, trembling with panic. A ram-horned girl stands on the far right, looking astonished. Contains two speech bubbles: a small speech bubble next to the cat, containing {argument name="cat sound" default="ニャッ"} And a long vertical bubble on the right, the content of which is{argument name="panel 3 dialogue" default="...Whose child is that?"} 4. Fourth panel: The portal glows continuously on the left side of the cozy room. A little sheep floats or jumps out of the portal, while the horned girl kneels on the right, protectively embracing the calico cat. The cat's eyes are closed, looking content. Tiny stars twinkle around, and small objects such as spools of thread, coin-shaped discs, small pieces of cloth, and a small container are scattered on the floor. Add a vertical speech bubble on the right side containing the Japanese phrase "Hey, stop that." Visual style: Soft, cute manga style; rounded character proportions; expressive eyes; cream and beige room tones; soft brown lines; soft purple magical light effects; subtle glitter; neat and easy-to-read vertical Japanese speech bubbles. Maintain a healing and humorous page style. Constraints: Contains 4 panels; only 3 recurring characters in the story: the horned girl, the little sheep, and the calico cat. The main repeating elements are as follows: there are a total of 4 speech bubbles on the right, 1 cat meow bubble, 2 magic portal/hole events before the final frame, and only one beige rectangle obscuring the face in the first frame. Do not add any extra frames, characters, watermarks, logos, or narration boxes.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一部可爱的竖版四格漫画，讲述羊角少女和她的小绵羊偶遇魔法传送门与猫咪的故事。

画布：竖版漫画页面，768 x 1152 风格，温暖的柔和色调，深棕色细边框，柔和的赛璐珞动漫插画，温馨的日常奇幻氛围。将 4 个横向画格垂直堆叠，中间留有窄小的白色间隙。

主要角色：一名名为 {argument name="character name" default="HITSURO"} 的 Q 版羊角少女，留着奶油白色的波波头，两侧长着卷曲的公羊角，有着尖尖的小精灵耳朵、棕色大眼睛，身穿白色衬衫、带有口袋和蝴蝶结的淡粉色围裙、深色百褶裙、过膝袜和软底鞋。第一格中，她的脸被一个米色的矩形遮挡块刻意遮住。一只毛茸茸的小白羊出现在每一格中，它有着圆圆的黑眼睛、粉红色的脸颊、小小的垂耳和短短的尾巴。一只三花猫出现在第 3 和第 4 格，身上有白色、橙色和深棕色的斑块，圆圆的眼睛，表情俏皮。

布局与故事：使用 4 个画格。
1. 第 1 格：温馨的房间内景，有木地板、书架、瓶子、盆栽、墙上挂画、窗帘和窗户。羊角少女站在右侧，背对或侧对镜头，脸部被米色矩形遮住。小绵羊站在她左侧的地板上，带着动效线微微颤抖。在右侧添加一个竖向的日文对话气泡，内容为 {argument name="panel 1 dialogue" default="…揺れてる…ね"}。
2. 第 2 格：木地板裂开，出现一个闪烁着紫色星系光芒的锯齿状洞口。小绵羊正从洞中探出或探身查看，身上闪烁着光芒。羊角少女在右侧蹲下，神情担忧，伸手向洞口探去。在右侧添加一个竖向对话气泡，内容为 {argument name="panel 2 dialogue" default="ひつ郎、近づいちゃだめ"}。
3. 第 3 格：左侧打开了一个竖向的椭圆形紫色传送门，门内是布满星星的夜空和一颗发光的黄色星星。一只三花猫从传送门中跃出，冲向房间，带有夸张的放射状速度线。小绵羊站在中右侧，惊慌颤抖。羊角少女站在最右侧，一脸惊讶。包含 2 个对话气泡：猫咪旁边的一个小气泡，内容为 {argument name="cat sound" default="ニャッ"}，以及右侧的一个竖向长气泡，内容为 {argument name="panel 3 dialogue" default="…どこの子？"}。
4. 第 4 格：传送门在温馨房间的左侧持续发光。小绵羊从传送门中漂浮或跳出，羊角少女在右侧跪下，保护性地抱住三花猫。猫咪闭着眼睛，看起来很满足。周围闪烁着小星星，地板上散落着一些小物件，如线轴、硬币状圆片、小布块和一个小容器。在右侧添加一个竖向长气泡，内容为日文“Hey, stop that”，即「こら、やめなさい」。

视觉风格：柔和的可爱风漫画，圆润的角色比例，富有表现力的眼睛，奶油色和米色的房间色调，柔和的棕色线条，柔和的紫色魔法光效，细微的闪光，整洁易读的竖排日文对话气泡。保持页面风格治愈且幽默。

约束条件：包含 4 个画格，故事中总共只有 3 个循环角色：羊角少女、小绵羊和三花猫。主要重复元素统计如下：右侧总共 4 个对话气泡，1 个猫咪叫声小气泡，最终画格前有 2 次魔法传送门/洞口事件，且仅在第一格中有一个遮挡脸部的米色矩形。不要添加额外的画格、角色、水印、Logo 或旁白框。

templates.title: Handwritten breakfast menu photo editing

titleLocalized.zh: 手写风早餐菜单照片编辑

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image as a base, transform it into a stylish Instagram-worthy breakfast menu post. Retain the plated breakfast composition and main food items, but remove the decorative stickers along the bottom edge: a total of 7 stickers (6 sheep stickers and 1 pizza slice sticker). Also, minimize or remove the coffee cup area to create a darker writing surface on the left. Add [something] above the photo.{argument name="annotation style" default="White handwritten chalk-style cafe menu font and casual doodles"} Create 10 handwritten text elements: one main title in the top left corner, one subtitle below, and eight labels/descriptions surrounding the food. Text elements: - Titles:{argument name="headline text" default="Morning toast art*"} - Subtitle:{argument name="subtitle text" default="Gooey pizza toast with cheese and vegetables"} - Encouraging message in the bottom left corner:{argument name="bottom message" default="Eat properly and have a great day!"} - Add 7 additional short, handwritten food-related labels pointing to onions/cheese, bell peppers, bananas, eggs, ketchup, toast with cheese, and fruit/nuts. These labels should have a natural, cute Japanese café menu style, rather than informal tags. Layout and graphics: Use thin white arrows, curved arrows, dotted circles, cloud-shaped speech bubbles, small hearts, and underlines, and add a soft pink underline/decoration near the text in the lower left corner. Ensure the labels look hand-drawn and are well-balanced, with the largest text on the left and smaller labels distributed around the banana, egg, toast, and fruit bowls. Maintain the authenticity of the breakfast photo by only adding edited handwritten overlays and removing distracting stickers.

templates.title: The battle between the Flame Knight and the Frost Warrior

titleLocalized.zh: 火焰骑士与冰霜战士之战

templates.prompt: Create an ultrawide, cinematic-quality anime fantasy battle scene against a dark, desolate volcanic battlefield at night, with an aspect ratio of approximately 2.4:1. The image depicts two female warriors clashing in mid-air amidst rugged black rocks, smoke, sparks, embers, and distant firelight. (Left side is...){argument name="left warrior" default="A fierce red-haired fire knight"} She had long, flowing crimson hair, wore magnificent gold plate armor, and a wine-red cloak and skirt. She was thrusting forward, wielding a glowing orange flaming sword, surrounded by a swirling halo of flames. To her right was…{argument name="right warrior" default="A silver-haired frost warrior"} She possesses extremely long, flowing silver-white hair and wears gleaming black and white armor adorned with blue crystals. She crouches, one arm outstretched in defense; a flat, dark gray square shield is placed over her face. Between the two, a massive, circular blue magical shield composed of intricate glowing runes and geometric rings is rendered. A flaming sword strikes the shield, the point of impact scattering bright orange sparks. Two elemental effects are added: orange flames surround the warrior on the left, and blue ice crystals surround the warrior on the right, including sharp, translucent shards bursting outwards behind her. The game employs a highly detailed Japanese anime-style visual aesthetic, featuring dramatic rim lighting, dynamic perspectives, sharp lines, painterly rendering, strong dynamism, high-contrast orange-cyan tones, cinematic depth of field, and is free of text and watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个超宽画幅的电影级动漫奇幻战斗场景，背景为夜晚黑暗荒凉的火山战场，长宽比约为 2.4:1。画面中展示两名女性战士在崎岖的黑色岩石、烟雾、火花、余烬和远处的火光中于半空中交锋。左侧是 {argument name="left warrior" default="一位凶猛的红发火焰骑士"}，留着随风飘动的深红色长发，身穿华丽的金色板甲，披着酒红色的斗篷和裙摆，正挥舞着发光的橙色火焰之剑向前突刺，身后环绕着旋转的火焰光环。右侧是 {argument name="right warrior" default="一位银发冰霜战士"}，留着极长的银白色飘逸长发，身穿带有蓝色水晶装饰的光泽黑白战甲，正蹲伏并单臂伸展进行防御；在她的面部放置一个平坦的深灰色方形遮挡块。在两人之间，渲染一个由复杂的发光符文和几何环组成的巨大圆形蓝色魔法盾徽，火焰之剑击中盾徽，撞击点迸发出明亮的橙色火花。添加两种元素特效：左侧战士周围环绕橙色火焰，右侧战士周围环绕蓝色冰晶，包括她身后向外迸发的锋利半透明碎片。采用高细节的日本动漫关键视觉风格，戏剧性的轮廓光，动态视角，锐利的线条，绘画质感渲染，强烈的动感，高对比度的橙青色调，电影级景深，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Blue Gothic Lolita Victorian Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 蓝色哥特洛丽塔维多利亚风格肖像

templates.prompt: Create a full-body vertical fashion portrait, the main subject is{argument name="character name" default="An elegant Gothic Lolita girl"} She stood in a dark Victorian-style room, facing the camera, her posture as elegant as a doll, one hand gently lifting the hem of her dress, the other hanging naturally at her side. She wore an exquisite black and blue aristocratic Gothic Lolita gown, featuring gold embroidery, a corset with crisscrossing gold ribbons, long bell sleeves, white lace cuffs, a high white ruffled neckline, and a large satin blue bow and jeweled brooch around her neck. A second large blue bow with gold tassels adorned her waist. The skirt was layered and dramatic: a black outer skirt with ornate gold filigree trim, a deep royal blue ruffle layer, a semi-transparent light blue lace layer, and white lace edges, forming a bell-shaped silhouette, shorter in the front and longer in the back. She paired it with black floral lace thigh-high stockings, black patent leather Mary Jane platform shoes, and delicate gold jewelry. Her hairstyle was…{argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown wavy pigtails"} She is adorned with four clearly visible headpieces: a small, tilted black top hat with blue ribbons, a black lace veil, a cluster of blue roses, and a gold filigree hair ornament.{argument name="main colors" default="Black, deep royal blue, antique gold, and white lace"} The exquisite color scheme is striking. The scene is a lavish Gothic Victorian interior, featuring six prominent decorative elements: a finely carved black and gold cabinet on the left, a lit silver candlestick, a deep blue rose in a vase, heavy navy velvet curtains, a tall, arched, leaded glass window on the right, and a small black and gold side table with a single blue rose. A blue and gold patterned rug covers the dark floor. The lighting employs a melancholic contrast of candlelight and cool-toned window light, creating rich shadows, a luxurious feel, ultra-fine fabric details, and a realistic photographic style. The composition is a sharp full-body shot using a 9:16 vertical aspect ratio. A visible white watermark text is present in the upper right corner.{argument name="watermark text" default="Pollo.ai"} Do not add extra characters, extra text, modern objects, or visible facial blur; keep faces as natural as possible.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张全身垂直时尚肖像，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="一位优雅的哥特洛丽塔少女"}，她站在深色的维多利亚风格房间中，面向镜头，姿态优雅如玩偶，一只手轻轻提起裙摆，另一只手自然垂在身侧。她身穿精致的黑蓝配色贵族哥特洛丽塔礼服，配有金色刺绣、带有交叉金色系带的紧身胸衣、长款喇叭袖、白色蕾丝袖口、高领白色荷叶边领口，颈部饰有巨大的缎面蓝色蝴蝶结及珠宝胸针，腰部配有第二个巨大的蓝色蝴蝶结，并垂下金色流苏。裙摆层次丰富且充满戏剧性：黑色外层裙摆饰有华丽的金色花丝镶边，深宝蓝色荷叶边层，半透明浅蓝色蕾丝层，以及白色蕾丝边缘，形成前短后长的钟形轮廓。搭配黑色花卉蕾丝大腿袜、黑色亮面搭扣玛丽珍厚底鞋以及精致的金色首饰。她的发型为 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色波浪双马尾"}，装饰有 4 件清晰可见的头部配饰：一顶带有蓝色饰带的小巧倾斜黑色礼帽、黑色蕾丝面纱、一簇蓝色玫瑰以及金色花丝发饰。使用 {argument name="main colors" default="黑色、深宝蓝色、古董金和白色蕾丝"} 的精致配色方案。场景为华丽的哥特式维多利亚室内，包含 6 个显著的装饰元素：左侧雕刻精美的黑金橱柜、点燃的银色烛台、花瓶中的深蓝色玫瑰、厚重的海军蓝天鹅绒窗帘、右侧高大的拱形铅条玻璃窗，以及摆放着一朵蓝色玫瑰的小型黑金边桌。深色地板上铺有蓝金图案的地毯。光影采用忧郁的烛光明暗对比法，结合冷色调窗光，呈现丰富的阴影、奢华的质感、超精细的织物细节、写实摄影风格，构图为清晰的全身照，采用 9:16 垂直构图。在右上角包含可见的白色水印文本 {argument name="watermark text" default="Pollo.ai"}。请勿添加额外人物、额外文字、现代物品或可见的面部模糊；尽可能保持面部自然呈现。

templates.title: Cyberpunk Anime Character Profiles

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克动漫角色档案

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="character name" default="RIONA"} Create a visually striking anime character profile poster for Riona Cyan, a cyberpunk-style female tactical fighter. The character is depicted in a dynamic, perspective-driven pose, as if leaping towards the viewer or performing a jumping kick. Canvas: Vertical poster, approximately 2:3 aspect ratio, clean white background accented with black, cyan, and gray. Employ a clean, sophisticated character key visual style, reminiscent of futuristic game agent profile pages. Layout: Place a large, bold black sans-serif title in the upper left corner.{argument name="character name" default="RIONA"} Below this is a smaller subtitle, "RIONA CYAN." The character occupies the center and right side, overlapping with the typography. Detailed, tech-inspired UI elements are added, including crosshair markers, barcode details, tiny serial numbers, and scattered glass or metal fragments on the poster. On the left is a compact archive panel with a dark blue badge and the label "CYAN REAPER," followed by archive fields. Along the right edge is a vertical column of Japanese motto text.{argument name="vertical motto" default="The "Blue Hunter" is an independent security force not affiliated with the government, undertaking incidents and tactical missions that cannot be made public."} In the lower left corner, there is the slogan "CLEAR. CALCULATED. DEADLY." and two lines of brief Japanese microtext; in the lower right corner, there is the tiny unit ID text "UNIT ID: CR-0722." Character details: A 22-year-old young woman with a fit and well-proportioned figure, visible abdominal muscles, fair skin, black hair with electric blue-green ends, medium-length hair that is messy and windswept, her face deliberately obscured by a soft rectangular blur. She wears a black cropped tactical top, a short black flight jacket with blue trim and small square blue patches, loose black cargo pants with straps, a belt, chains, a small pouch, and a holster-style functional bag, fingerless black gloves, and heavy black combat boots with thick soles and blue laces. The most prominent feature is the large, prominent sole in the foreground, facing the viewer, with detailed patterns and a small blue square mark. Her pose is highly aggressive and she's in mid-air: one leg kicks forcefully towards the camera, the other is bent high, one arm is stretched back for balance, and the other hand holds a short, electrified baton or a compact blade with a glowing cyan tip. Visible elements include: one main character, one large foreground boot sole, one raised secondary boot, one handheld cyan glowing weapon, one cyan "CYAN REAPER" sign, one large title word, one left-side archive bar, one right-side vertical motto bar, three small crosshair UI markers, one barcode block, and numerous small fragments scattered diagonally around the character. Left-side file text: Use the following readable English labels and values: “AFFILIATION: Independent Security Force (Blue Hunt)”; “CODE NAME: Cyan Reaper”; “AGE: 22”; “HEIGHT: 168cm”; “WEAPON: Arc baton / short blade / electromagnetic tool”; “PERSONALITY: Calm, confident, rational.” The text should be small but clear, like a printed copy of a military database. Visual style: Ultra-detailed anime illustrations, sharp ink lines, dramatic perspective, high-contrast black clothing in a white negative space, cyan outline lighting, glossy fabric highlights, futuristic graphic design, clean editorial poster composition, subtle motion curves and blue slashing trajectories in the lower right corner. This will give the image a sophisticated sci-fi character file promotional quality.
