promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="RIONA"} 创建一张极具视觉冲击力的动漫角色档案海报，角色名为 Riona Cyan，是一位赛博朋克风格的女性战术战士，呈现出一种极具动态的透视动作姿态，仿佛正向观众飞跃或进行跳踢。

画布：竖版海报，比例约为 2:3，干净的白色背景，配以黑色、青蓝色和灰色点缀。采用清晰的高级角色主视觉风格，类似于未来感游戏特工档案页。

布局：在左上角放置一个巨大的粗体黑色无衬线标题 “{argument name="character name" default="RIONA"}”，下方配以较小的副标题 “RIONA CYAN”。角色占据中心和右侧，与排版重叠。添加细致的科技感 UI 线条、准星标记、条形码细节、微小的序列号，以及散布在海报上的玻璃或金属碎片。在左侧，包含一个紧凑的档案栏，配有青黑色的徽章标志和标签 “CYAN REAPER”，随后是档案字段。在右侧边缘，添加一列垂直的日式座右铭文字，使用 {argument name="vertical motto" default="〈青狩〉は政府に属さない独立治安部隊で、表に出せない事件や戦術任務を請け負う。"}。在左下角，包含口号 “CLEAR. CALCULATED. DEADLY.” 和两行简短的日式微型文字；在右下角，添加微小的单位 ID 文字 “UNIT ID : CR-0722。”

角色细节：一位 22 岁的年轻女性，身材健美匀称，腹肌线条可见，皮肤白皙，黑色头发，发梢染成电光青蓝色，中长发凌乱且带有风吹感，面部被一个柔和的矩形模糊遮挡块刻意遮盖。她身穿黑色露脐战术上衣、带有青色饰边和小型方形青色补丁的黑色短款飞行夹克、带有绑带、腰带、链条、小包和枪套式功能袋的宽松黑色工装裤、露指黑色手套，以及鞋底厚实且带有青色鞋带的黑色重型作战靴。最突出的靴底在前景中显得巨大，正对观众，带有详细的纹路和一个小的青色方形标记。她的姿势极具攻击性且处于空中：一条腿向镜头猛力踢出，另一条腿高高弯曲，一只手臂向后伸展以保持平衡，另一只手握着一根短小的带电警棍或带有发光青色尖端的紧凑型刀刃。

可见计数元素：包含 1 个主要角色，1 个巨大的前景靴底，1 个抬起的次要靴子，1 个手持的青色发光武器，1 个青黑色 “CYAN REAPER” 标志，1 个大标题词，1 个左侧档案栏，1 个右侧垂直座右铭栏，3 个小型准星 UI 标记，1 个条形码块，以及许多沿对角线散布在角色周围的小碎片。

左侧档案文字：使用以下可读的英文标签和值：“AFFILIATION: Independent Security Force (Blue Hunt)”; “CODE NAME: Cyan Reaper”; “AGE: 22”; “HEIGHT: 168cm”; “WEAPON: Arc baton / short blade / electromagnetic tool”; “PERSONALITY: Calm, confident, rational.” 文字需保持微小但清晰，如同军事数据库的打印件。

视觉风格：超精细动漫插画，锐利的墨线，戏剧性的透视，白色负空间中高对比度的黑色服装，青色轮廓光，光泽面料高光，科技感图形设计，干净的编辑海报构图，右下角有微妙的运动弧线和蓝色斩击轨迹。使图像呈现出精致的科幻角色档案宣传图质感。

约束条件：保持背景大部分为白色且简洁，保留粗体排版层级，不要添加额外角色，不要使用写实照片风格，不要移除刻意的面部模糊，并避免在指定的档案和海报标签之外添加过多的可读文字。

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑奇幻故事板与视频预览

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a workflow demonstration of a dark cinematic AI-generated series: The left side features a 3x3 fantasy storyboard grid, while the right side displays a widescreen video preview frame, demonstrating how a static storyboard is transformed into an animated scene. Canvas: Wide horizontal composition, approximately 2:1 aspect ratio, black background with a thin white border. The left half contains a square storyboard contact sheet; the right half contains a large embedded video player screenshot with a black overlay and a small playback time indicator. Left-side storyboard layout: Uses 9 numbered panels arranged in a 3x3 grid, each separated by a thin white border and labeled with a small white number from 1 to 9 in the upper left corner. The panels should depict a gothic fantasy/dark fantasy romantic narrative, with the protagonist being {argument name="female character" default="A bride dressed in a gorgeous crimson robe and wearing a veil"} and{argument name="male character" default="A stern-faced, white-haired immortal dressed in a dark robe."} Add small, cinematic Chinese subtitles to one or two of the panels, but keep them small and as a secondary element. The nine panels contain the following: 1) A close-up of a bride in a crimson veil, her sleeves partially obscuring her face, with the texture of red candlelight and rain; 2) The bride sits or leans against a window in a dimly lit room, with a pale, white-haired figure behind her and blurry text lines at the bottom; 3) The bride turns towards the interior of a palace bathed in red light, her long black hair and red veil fluttering; 4) A tall figure in a dark robe stands before a latticed window, against a backdrop of cold blue moonlight; 5) The bride kneels or lies beneath a red veil, one hand supporting her on the ground, the red fabric creating a dramatic effect; 6) An intimate close-up of a white-haired immortal touching the bride's chin, their faces close together, creating a tense yet romantic atmosphere; 7) A close-up of a white-haired man holding a vertical talisman or strip of paper with Chinese characters; 8) Two dark silhouettes stand facing each other in the rain or fog, with a red candle or ember glowing at the bottom; 9) A bride in red stands on a high balcony or rooftop, her robe and hair billowing in the wind, overlooking a blue cityscape in a storm. Right-side video preview layout: A large widescreen cinematic frame is placed in the right half. The image shows the back or three-quarter profile of the same Scarlet Bride, set in a red wooden palace. She has dark hair adorned with a dark, thorny headdress or a veil, her red robe embroidered with shimmering flowers. Blue moonlight can be seen through the latticed windows, and small figures are visible in the background. Thick black overlays are added above and below the frame. In the lower left corner of the black player area, a white pause icon and a timestamp "0:13" are displayed. A small, blurred label, such as an AI-generated identifier, is included in the upper left corner of the video frame. Visual style: Dramatic Chinese dark fantasy, gothic romance, high-contrast red and blue lighting, candlelight interiors, rain, fog, ornate robes, cinematic depth of field, melancholic shadows, cinematic still quality, high detail, atmospheric fantasy drama.{argument name="primary color palette" default="Crimson, cool blue, black and pale silver"} Face rendering: All visible faces should be deliberately obscured with a soft, square gray blur, similar to the anonymization process used in screenshots. The blur block should be centered over the face and ensure consistency across the storyboard and video frame. Text restrictions: Keep all text minimal and small, except for the visible timestamp "0:13" and storyboard numbers 1 through 9. Do not add any logos, watermarks, additional UI panels, or extra storyboard frames.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个暗黑电影感 AI 剧集工作流展示图：左侧为 3×3 奇幻故事板网格，右侧为宽屏视频预览框，演示静态故事板如何转化为动画场景。

画布：宽横向构图，比例约为 2:1，黑色背景，带有细白色外边框。左半部分包含一个方形故事板联系表；右半部分包含一个大型嵌入式视频播放器截图，带有黑色遮幅和小型播放时间指示器。

左侧故事板布局：使用 9 个编号面板，排列成 3×3 网格，每个面板由细白色边框分隔，并在左上角标有 1 到 9 的白色小数字标签。面板应描绘一个哥特仙侠 / 暗黑奇幻浪漫叙事，主角为 {argument name="female character" default="一位身着华丽绯红长袍、戴着面纱的新娘"} 和 {argument name="male character" default="一位身着暗色长袍、冷峻的白发仙人"}。在其中一两个面板中加入细小的电影感中式字幕，但需保持微小且作为次要元素。9 个面板内容如下：1) 绯红面纱新娘的特写，衣袖遮住部分面部，带有红烛光和雨水质感；2) 新娘坐在或倚靠在窗边昏暗的房间里，身后是一个苍白的白发身影，底部有模糊的字幕行；3) 新娘转向红光笼罩的宫殿内部，长长的黑发和红纱飘动；4) 一个高大的暗袍身影站在格子窗前，背景是冷冽的蓝色月光；5) 新娘跪在或倒在红纱下，一只手撑地，红色的织物充满戏剧感；6) 白发仙人触碰新娘下巴的亲密特写，两人面部靠近，浪漫氛围紧张；7) 白发男子手持一张带有汉字的垂直符咒或纸条的特写；8) 两个暗色剪影在雨中或雾中相对而立，底部有一支红烛或余烬在发光；9) 身着红衣的新娘站在高处阳台或屋顶，长袍和头发被风吹动，俯瞰着暴风雨中的蓝色城市景观。

右侧视频预览布局：在右半部分放置一个大型宽屏电影画框。画面展示了同一个绯红新娘的背影或四分之三侧面，场景位于红色木质宫殿内，黑发配有带刺的暗色头饰或缠绕的面纱，红袍上绣花闪烁，格子窗外可见蓝色月光，背景中有微小的远景人物。在画框上下添加厚实的黑色遮幅。在黑色播放器区域的左下角，显示一个白色暂停图标和时间戳“0:13”。在视频画框的左上角包含一个微小模糊的标签，例如 AI 生成标识。

视觉风格：极具戏剧性的中式暗黑奇幻、哥特浪漫、高对比度的红蓝光影、烛光内景、雨、雾、华丽长袍、电影级景深、忧郁的阴影、电影剧照质感、高细节、氛围感奇幻剧。使用 {argument name="primary color palette" default="绯红、冷蓝、黑色和苍银色"}。

面部处理：所有可见的人脸都应刻意用柔和的方形灰色模糊遮盖，如同截图中进行了匿名化处理。模糊块需居中覆盖在面部上，并确保在故事板和视频画框中保持一致。

文本限制：保持所有文字极简且微小，除了可见的时间戳“0:13”和 1 到 9 的故事板编号。不要添加任何徽标、水印、额外的 UI 面板或额外的故事板帧。

templates.title: Flower Aquarium Dome Anime Knight

titleLocalized.zh: 花卉水族穹顶动漫骑士

templates.prompt: Create a 2:3 portrait-oriented, ultra-detailed anime fantasy illustration depicting an exquisite miniature aquarium dome, containing {argument name="character name" default="Nozomu"} The world is envisioned as follows: Within a transparent oval glass dome with a magnificent platinum base, a young magical girl knight is placed as the central figure. A massive silver broadsword stands vertically in front of her, and a splendid oval plaque sits at the base. A slender gold candlestick flanks her on either side, and the background features an arched cathedral-style window. The character possesses…{argument name="hair color" default="pale golden yellow"} She wore long, flowing twin ponytails adorned with a wreath of small white, pale blue, and pale pink flowers. She donned a pearl-white and semi-transparent pale blue layered ruffled skirt, complemented by a floral corsage belt, arm wreaths, white gloves, and silver-gold filigree armor. Her face was concealed by a flat, skin-colored rectangular blank mask, devoid of any facial features, positioned at the center of her face. The sword was elegant and ceremonial, featuring a long, satin-silver blade, a gold cross decoration, a hanging chain, and pale blue roses and white bouquets entwined around the hilt. The dome was filled with an ethereal temple garden: abundant white flowers, pale blue roses, pearly petals, tiny white butterflies, crystal droplets, shimmering beads, soft hanging decorations, and dreamlike bokeh. The nameplate should display in delicate gold lettering.{argument name="plaque text" default="Nozomu's Flower Sanctuary / Nozomu"} Uses bright, soft tones of ivory, silver, champagne gold, light blue, light pink, and clear glass highlights. Style: High-end Japanese anime figure illustrations, gorgeous girl fantasy, soft cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, bright glass reflections, intricate floral details, magical aquarium dome atmosphere, no watermarks, no extra characters, no modern objects.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 2:3 纵向、超精细的动漫奇幻插图，描绘一个精致的微型水族穹顶，其中包含 {argument name="character name" default="Nozomu"} 的世界。在一个带有华丽白金底座的透明椭圆形玻璃罩内，放置 1 位年轻的魔法少女骑士作为中心主体，前方竖直放置 1 把超大的银色阔剑，底部放置 1 块华丽的椭圆形铭牌，两侧各放置 1 个纤细的金色烛台，背景为 1 扇拱形大教堂风格的窗户。角色拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="淡金黄色"} 的长款蓬松双马尾，戴着由小白花、淡蓝色和淡粉色花朵组成的花环，身穿珍珠白与半透明淡蓝色层叠荷叶边裙，配有花卉胸花腰带、手臂花环、白手套以及银金色花丝铠甲装饰。她的脸部被一个平坦的肤色长方形空白面具遮住，面具上没有任何五官，位于脸部中央。剑身优雅且具有仪式感，配有长长的缎银色剑刃、金色十字装饰、悬挂的链条，以及缠绕在剑柄上的淡蓝色玫瑰和白色花束。穹顶内充满空灵的圣殿花园：繁茂的白色花朵、淡蓝色玫瑰、珍珠般的花瓣、细小的白色蝴蝶、水晶水滴、闪亮的珠子、柔软的悬挂装饰和梦幻般的焦外成像光斑。铭牌上应以精致的金色字体显示 {argument name="plaque text" default="のぞむの花の聖域 / のぞむ"}。使用象牙白、银色、香槟金、淡蓝色、淡粉色和透明玻璃高光的明亮柔和色调。风格：高端日本动漫手办插画、华丽少女奇幻、柔和的电影级灯光、浅景深、光亮的玻璃反射、错综复杂的花卉细节、神奇的水族穹顶氛围，无水印，无额外角色，无现代物品。

templates.title: Group photo inside a retro flip phone

titleLocalized.zh: 复古翻盖手机内的合影

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_1 as the base image and style reference, create a simple, standalone illustration of a Japanese flip phone, removing the surrounding infographic layout, titles, detail panels, borders, and all printed text. Replace the phone screen content with the group photo from REFERENCE_0, seamlessly integrating it into the display as if viewed in a phone's photo album. Retain the angles, keyboard, hinge, semi-transparent worn plastic texture, minor scratches, and blue star charm from the older silver-blue flip phone in REFERENCE_1. Keep the image in a soft watercolor/anime concept art style, with a pale white background featuring subtle blue shadows and a few falling semi-transparent petals. The screen should accurately display the four people in the photo: a blue-haired girl, a black-haired boy, a brown-haired girl, and a brown-haired boy. Do not add any UI text, labels, borders, page decorations, or other unnecessary objects except for the phone, charm, soft shadows, and petals. Optional customization: Use on the phone screen.{argument name="screen photo" default="A summer group photo of four people from REFERENCE_0"} Keep the phone model/color as follows{argument name="phone color" default="Silver-blue translucent flip phone"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_1 作为基础对象和风格参考，创作一张简洁的日式翻盖手机独立插画，去除周围的信息图布局、标题、细节面板、边框以及所有印刷文字。将手机屏幕内容替换为 REFERENCE_0 中的合影，使其自然地嵌入显示屏中，呈现出正在手机相册中查看的效果。保留 REFERENCE_1 中旧款银蓝色翻盖手机的角度、键盘、铰链、半透明磨损塑料质感、细微划痕以及蓝色星星挂饰。保持图像为柔和的水彩/动漫概念艺术风格，背景为淡白色，带有淡淡的蓝色阴影和几片飘落的半透明花瓣。屏幕应准确显示合影中的 4 个人：蓝发女孩、黑发男孩、棕发女孩和棕发男孩。除手机、挂饰、柔和阴影和花瓣外，请勿添加任何 UI 文字、标签、边框、页面装饰或其他多余物体。可选自定义：在手机显示屏上使用 {argument name="screen photo" default="来自 REFERENCE_0 的四人夏季合影"}，手机型号/颜色保持为 {argument name="phone color" default="银蓝色半透明翻盖手机"}。

templates.title: Girl in the Ink Rain

titleLocalized.zh: 墨雨中的少女

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic square anime illustration featuring two girls in motion, presented from a low, tilted perspective, as if they are falling, floating, or dancing in an abstract ink storm. The first girl possesses {argument name="light-haired girl hair color" default="Light blonde hair"} She had a messy high ponytail, with a few strands obscuring part of her face; she wore a white Japanese sailor uniform with a dark collar, scarf, pleated skirt, white socks, and black shoes. She was positioned in the upper right corner, leaning diagonally, one knee bent, one arm outstretched behind her, her expression both gentle and serious as she gazed downwards. The second girl possessed…{argument name="dark-haired girl hair color" default="Long black hair"} She floats wildly on the left; her face is mostly hidden in shadow and hair. She wears a dark, tattered school uniform-style dress or shirt dress, rendered almost like a black silhouette, with a deep red hue at the hem. Placing her in the lower left corner, reaching out to or floating towards the blonde girl, creates an intimate yet tense double composition. A rough monochromatic palette is used, accented with warm ivory, charcoal black, dark brown, and soft blood red. The style is expressive Japanese anime concept art, blending ink wash painting, scribbles, watercolor stains, splattered black ink, rough brushstrokes, aged paper textures, and high-contrast chiaroscuro. The background is primarily grayish-white white space, with explosive blackish-brown ink blots concentrated in the upper right and lower left corners, featuring diagonal movement and scattered spots. Emphasis is placed on flowing hair, the dynamism of the pleated skirt, dramatic shadows, delicate facial features, impressionistic anatomy, and a cinematic melancholic atmosphere. No text, no borders, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张戏剧性的方形动漫插画，画面中恰好有两名处于动态中的少女，采用低角度倾斜视角，仿佛她们正坠落、漂浮或在抽象的水墨风暴中起舞。第一名女孩拥有 {argument name="light-haired girl hair color" default="浅金色头发"}，扎着凌乱的高马尾，几缕发丝遮住部分脸庞；她身穿白色日式水手校服，配有深色领边、领巾、百褶裙、白袜和黑鞋。她位于右上角，身体呈对角线倾斜，单膝弯曲，一只手臂向后伸展，神情柔和而严肃地向下注视。第二名女孩拥有 {argument name="dark-haired girl hair color" default="黑色长发"}，在左侧狂乱飘动；她的脸大部分隐藏在阴影和发丝中。她身穿深色、破损的校服式连衣裙或衬衫裙，渲染得几乎像一个黑色剪影，下摆带有深红色的色调。将她置于左下角，向金发女孩伸手或漂浮过去，营造出一种亲密而紧张的双人构图。使用暖象牙白、炭黑、深褐色和柔和血红色点缀的粗犷单色调。风格为富有表现力的日式动漫概念艺术，融合水墨画、潦草的钢笔线条、水彩污渍、飞溅的黑墨、粗糙的笔触、做旧的纸张纹理以及高对比度的明暗对照法。背景主要是灰白色的留白，右上角和左下角集中着爆炸性的黑褐色墨迹，带有对角线运动轨迹和散落的斑点。强调飘逸的头发、百褶裙的动态、戏剧性的阴影、精致的面部、写意的解剖结构以及电影般忧郁的氛围。无文字，无边框，无水印。

templates.title: Minecraft voxel-themed wedding ceremony

titleLocalized.zh: Minecraft 体素风婚礼仪式

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic Minecraft-style voxel wedding scene, seamlessly blending a realistic couple with the blocky game world. In the foreground center, a groom in a black suit embraces a bride in a flowing white lace wedding dress. This couple should be the only realistic figures in the scene, their faces softly anonymized/blurred, while the surrounding environment and guests are entirely voxel/blocky. The bride wears a long white veil and delicate hair accessories, a sleeveless lace top, and a flowing skirt that billows with her movements; the groom leans slightly to the side, romantically holding her. Place them on a grassy aisle studded with white petals, leading to a square wooden floral wedding archway decorated with lush greenery, white flowers, and cascading garlands. On either side of the aisle are rows of wooden benches filled with blocky Minecraft guests dressed in dark suits and white shirts, clapping and smiling; prominent lanterns hang from pillars near the seating. Add abundant blocky floral elements to both sides of the aisle, primarily white daisies with a few pink blossoms. The background should feature cube-shaped trees, layered voxel vegetation, wooden blocks, and a bright blue sky with rectangular clouds, creating warm sunlight, soft depth of field, and a joyful and romantic atmosphere. Use a 4:3 square-to-horizontal composition, with a perspective centered on the aisle, showcasing high-detail voxel textures, vibrant greens, warm highlights, and realistic fabric details on the couple's clothing, achieving a seamless fusion of real wedding photography and Minecraft game map aesthetics. The image should contain no text, watermarks, or UI elements.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个电影级的 Minecraft 风格体素婚礼场景，将写实的新人与方块游戏世界完美融合。在画面前景中央，一位身穿黑色西装的新郎正抱着身穿飘逸白色蕾丝婚纱的新娘；这对新人应是画面中仅有的写实摄影风格人物，面部需进行柔和的匿名化/模糊处理，而周围环境和宾客则完全呈现为体素/方块风格。新娘佩戴长款白纱和精致发饰，身着无袖蕾丝上衣，蓬松的裙摆因动作而扬起；新郎微微侧身，浪漫地抱着她。将他们置于铺满白色花瓣的草地过道上，过道通向一个方形木制花卉婚礼拱门，拱门装饰着茂密的绿叶、白色花朵和悬垂的花串。过道两侧各放置一排木制长椅，坐满了身穿深色正装、白衬衫的方块风格 Minecraft 宾客，他们正在鼓掌微笑；座位附近的柱子上挂着显眼的灯笼。在过道两侧添加丰富的方块花卉，以白色雏菊为主，点缀少量粉色花朵。背景应呈现立方体树木、层叠的体素植被、木块，以及带有长方形云朵的明亮蓝天，营造温暖的日光、柔和的景深和欢乐浪漫的氛围。采用 4:3 的方形至横向构图，以过道为中心的透视视角，展现高细节的体素纹理、鲜艳的绿色、温暖的高光，以及新人身上写实的布料细节，实现真实婚礼摄影与 Minecraft 游戏地图美学的无缝融合。画面中无文字、无水印、无 UI 元素。

templates.title: UNVOID Glitch Streetwear Poster

titleLocalized.zh: UNVOID Glitch 街头服饰海报

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="brand name" default="UNVOID"} Create a high-street fashion promotional poster that blends a dark cyberpunk glitch style with magazine cover typography. Canvas: Vertical 4:5 poster, realistic photographic background, soft gray concrete building background, centered full-body model, overlaid with sharp white typography, featuring delicate film grain and shallow depth of field effects. Subject: A young female model stands facing forward on the center of a concrete ramp outside a modern Brutalist storefront. Her eyes and nose are obscured by a black horizontal glitch/void veil. She has straight black bob hair with bangs. Clothing: Four visible items—an oversized brown short-sleeved top layered over a black inner layer, a black mini skirt with white abstract topographical floral lines, black socks, and black platform ankle boots. The pose is neutral and confident, with arms hanging naturally and legs slightly apart. Background: The exterior of a modern gray concrete building, featuring large dark windows and a store entrance. A blurred sign behind the model also displays the brand name, reinforcing the brand's identity. The environment presents an urban, minimalist, and slightly dystopian atmosphere. Typography and layout: 8 text elements are used: 1) A large white, all-caps masthead at the top:{argument name="brand name" default="UNVOID"} 1) Spanning almost the entire width, with a tiny registered trademark symbol in the upper right corner of the word; 2) Small text in the upper left corner:{argument name="season text" default="SPRING SUMMER 2026"} 3) The thin horizontal dividing line in the middle of the upper part; 4) Small text in the upper right corner:{argument name="collection text" default="COLLECTION 06"} 5) Small vertically arranged banners on the left: “IDENTITY IS NOT STATIC — IT GLITCHES.”; 6) Stacked banners on the right: “WEAR THE ERROR. OWN THE VOID.”; 7) Large distressed glitch-style headline in the lower left corner:{argument name="campaign headline" default="ERROR SKIN"} 8) Bottom micro-text: "UNVOID® / ALL RIGHTS RESERVED." in the lower left corner, "COLLECTION 06 / SPRING SUMMER 2026" in the lower right corner, with a small white toggle icon above. Visual style: A combination of high-end fashion catalog and cyberpunk glitch style. White Helvetica/Grotesk bold typography, high contrast but soft tones: concrete gray, black, white, matte brown. Add horizontal digital distortion effects only to the face mask and the lower left headline. Keep the composition simple, magazine-style, and promotional. Constraints: Do not add extra models, props, logos, or other text. Keep all typography clear and legible, and aligned like a luxury streetwear poster. Ensure the model is centered below the large masthead.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="brand name" default="UNVOID"} 创作一张高街时尚宣传海报，融合暗黑赛博故障风格与杂志封面排版。

画布：垂直 4:5 海报，写实摄影底图，背景为柔和的灰色混凝土建筑，居中全身模特，叠加锐利的白色排版，带有细腻的胶片颗粒感和浅景深效果。

主体：一位年轻女性模特正面站立在现代粗野主义店面外的混凝土坡道中央。她的眼睛和鼻子被一道黑色的水平故障/虚空遮罩遮住。留着黑色直发波波头，带有刘海。服装：共 4 件可见单品——超大廓形棕色短袖上衣叠穿黑色内搭，黑色迷你裙，裙身带有白色抽象地形花卉线条艺术，黑色短袜，黑色厚底短靴。姿势中性且自信，手臂自然下垂，双腿微张。

背景：现代灰色混凝土建筑外墙，配有大型深色窗户和店面入口。模特身后模糊的招牌上同样印有品牌名称，强化品牌宣传标识。环境呈现出城市化、极简且略带反乌托邦的氛围。

排版与布局：使用 8 个文本元素：1) 顶部巨大的白色全大写报头：{argument name="brand name" default="UNVOID"}，横跨几乎整个宽度，单词右上角带有微小的注册商标符号；2) 左上角小字：{argument name="season text" default="SPRING SUMMER 2026"}；3) 上部中间的细水平分割线；4) 右上角小字：{argument name="collection text" default="COLLECTION 06"}；5) 左侧垂直排列的小标语：“IDENTITY IS NOT STATIC — IT GLITCHES.”；6) 右侧堆叠的小标语：“WEAR THE ERROR. OWN THE VOID.”；7) 左下角巨大的做旧故障风格标题：{argument name="campaign headline" default="ERROR SKIN"}，带有破碎的水平扫描线碎片；8) 底部微型文案：左下角为“UNVOID® / ALL RIGHTS RESERVED.”，右下角为“COLLECTION 06 / SPRING SUMMER 2026”，上方配有一个白色小切换开关图标。

视觉风格：高端时尚画册与赛博朋克故障风格的结合。白色 Helvetica/Grotesk 粗体排版，高对比度但色调柔和：混凝土灰、黑、白、哑光棕。仅在面部遮罩和左下角宣传标题处添加水平数字失真效果。保持构图简洁、具有杂志编辑感且符合宣传标准。

约束条件：不要添加额外的模特、道具、Logo 或其他文本。保持所有排版清晰易读，并像豪华街头服饰海报一样对齐。确保模特居中于巨大的报头下方。

templates.title: Japanese "Thermometer Day" promotional poster

titleLocalized.zh: 日本“温度计之日”宣传海报

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="observance date" default="May 14th"} Create a vertically composed Japanese promotional poster for "Thermometer Day," combining simple educational infographics with a realistic model wearing a themed T-shirt. Canvas: High-ratio social media poster, 9:16 aspect ratio, light icy blue background, soft clinical medical-style lighting, simple magazine-style layout, blue and red color scheme. Subject: On the right half, a realistic young Japanese woman with a neat chin-length black bob is placed, facing the camera from above the thigh. Her face is deliberately obscured by a simple rectangular blur/mosaic block. She wears a fitted short-sleeved gradient T-shirt, the color grading from sky blue on the left to pink/red on the right. The text on the T-shirt must be clearly displayed: the first line "5/14", the large text below "Thermometer Day", and the smaller text at the bottom "Birthday of a Doctor Physicist Farmer High". She lightly holds a white electronic thermometer near her shoulder with her right hand. Top Area: Place the prominent Japanese title "May 14th is" and "Thermometer Day" on the left, with "Thermometer" in dark blue and "Day" in red. Add a small, line-style thermometer icon above/to the right of the title, labeled "°C". Below, add the subtitle: "— Supporting the evening, the temperature day—". Add a short Japanese description explaining that May 14th is Thermometer Day, related to the birthday of German physicist Fahrenheit, and emphasizing the importance of temperature measurement for science, daily life, safety, and comfort. Decorative Icons: Add three light blue science/weather icons to the upper left background: one vertical thermometer icon, one globe icon, and one laboratory flask icon. Central Infographic Area: Add the title "Scenes of active thermometers," underlined in yellow. Below this are three horizontally arranged rounded rectangular cards, each with a blue border, a small icon, a bold Japanese title, explanatory text, and a photo thumbnail: 1. Heart icon, titled "Health Management," with text about measuring body temperature and early detection of bodily changes; the thumbnail shows an electronic thermometer displaying 36.5 degrees Celsius placed on a soft towel. 2. Cooking pot icon, titled "Cooking and Bathing," with text about cooking temperature control and bath water temperature adjustment; the thumbnail shows a thermometer inserted into a steaming cooking pot. 3. Laboratory flask icon, titled "Research and Industry," with text about how precise temperature measurement supports technology and product development; the thumbnail shows a glass beaker/test tube with a pipette. Bottom Area: Add a dark blue closing title, "How do we know temperature? How do we protect the future?", below which is a thin horizontal line, two lines of smaller Japanese explanatory text about climate awareness and protecting life and the future of the planet, ending with a red call to action: "Why don't you pay attention to the temperature today?" A light green-blue "Earth and Sprouts" icon is placed in the lower right corner. Visual Style: A simple Japanese public information poster, with realistic photographic style for the model and card thumbnails, flat and minimalist icons, soft shadows, rounded corner cards, ample white space, professional print layout, no watermark, and no additional logo. Uses clear and legible Japanese fonts and strictly adheres to the following layout: a top title area, a model image, three decorative icons, three application scenario cards, and a bottom information area.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="observance date" default="5 月 14 日"} “温度计之日”创作一张垂直构图的日本宣传海报，将简洁的教育信息图表与身着主题 T 恤的写实模特相结合。

画布：高垂直比例社交媒体海报，9:16 纵横比，淡冰蓝色背景，柔和的临床医学风格光影，简洁的杂志式排版，蓝红配色方案。

主体：在右半部分，放置一位写实风格的年轻日本女性，留着整洁的下巴长度黑色波波头，从大腿上方起正面朝向镜头。她的面部被刻意用一个简单的矩形模糊/马赛克块遮挡。她穿着一件修身的短袖渐变 T 恤，颜色从左侧的天蓝色渐变到右侧的粉/红色。T 恤上的文字需准确显示：第一行“5/14”，下方大字“温度計の日”，底部小字“ドイツの物理学者 ファーレンハイトの誕生日”。她右手在肩部附近轻握一支白色电子温度计。

顶部区域：左侧放置醒目的日文标题“5月14日は”和“温度計の日”，其中“温度計”为深蓝色，“の日”为红色。在标题上方/右侧添加一个小型线条风格的温度计图标，并标注“°C”。下方副标题：“— 暮らしを支える、温度のものさし —”。添加一段简短的日文说明文字，介绍 5 月 14 日是温度计之日，与德国物理学家华氏（Fahrenheit）的生日有关，并强调温度测量对于科学、日常生活、安全和舒适的重要性。

装饰图标：在左上方背景中添加 3 个淡蓝色科学/天气图标：1 个垂直温度计图标、1 个地球图标和 1 个实验室烧瓶图标。

中部信息图表区域：添加标题“温度計が活躍する場面”，下方带有黄色下划线。在其下方，横向排列 3 个圆角矩形卡片，每个卡片均带有蓝色边框、小图标、加粗的日文标题、说明文字和照片缩略图：
1. 爱心图标，标题“健康管理に”，文字内容关于测量体温及及早发现身体变化，缩略图为放在柔软毛巾上显示 36.5 度的电子温度计。
2. 烹饪锅图标，标题“料理・暮らしに”，文字内容关于烹饪温度控制和洗澡水温调节，缩略图为插入冒着热气的烹饪锅中的温度计。
3. 实验室烧瓶图标，标题“研究・産業に”，文字内容关于精确的温度测量如何支持技术与产品研发，缩略图为带有移液管的玻璃烧杯/试管。

底部区域：添加深蓝色结束语标题“温度を知ることは、未来を守ること”，下方加一条细水平线，两行较小的日文说明文字，内容关于气候意识以及保护生命和地球的未来，最后是一行红色的行动号召语：“今日は温度計に、ちょっと注目してみませんか?” 在右下角放置一个淡淡的绿蓝色“地球与嫩芽”图标。

视觉风格：简洁的日本公共信息海报，模特和卡片缩略图采用写实摄影风格，扁平化极简图标，柔和阴影，圆角卡片，留白充足，专业印刷排版，无水印，无额外 Logo。使用清晰易读的日文字体，并严格保持以下板块布局：一个顶部标题区、一个模特形象、三个装饰图标、三个应用场景卡片以及一个底部信息区。

templates.title: NOVALITH Mobile SaaS Getting Started Onboarding Page

titleLocalized.zh: NOVALITH 移动端 SaaS 入门引导页

Canvas: A portrait smartphone screenshot, 9:16 aspect ratio, white background, with the top iOS status bar displayed at 9:41, including signal, Wi-Fi, and battery icons. Ample margins and clean app ad typography are used. Layout: The NOVALITH logo is placed near the top left corner, incorporating a geometric cyan "N" icon and wide-spaced dark blue text. A large, bold, dark blue Japanese title is placed below:{argument name="headline text" default="Transforming data into future decision-making."} Below the title, add a shorter two-line Japanese description:{argument name="body text" default="Eliminate the complexity of development, operations, and data, and accelerate business growth with a reliable data foundation."} In the lower left corner, three icons with thin cyan outlines are displayed, along with brief descriptions: 1) Stacked layer icon, titled "Integrated Base," described as "Integrate the data and system into one unit"; 2) Shield checkmark icon, titled "Sturdy Checkmark," described as "Ensure quality to a standard"; 3) Rising bar chart icon, titled "High-Speed ​​Decision-Making," described as "Accelerate decision-making through reliable data." Main visual: In the right half, a large, glossy 3D smartphone card is created, slightly tilted backward, overlapping with a translucent cyan-blue building block and a large, multifaceted 3D letter N in the background. The phone screen displays a Japanese dashboard UI, containing four dashboard areas: 1) Top indicator cards displaying "Data Processing 128 +2.4%" and "Data Quality Scour 98.6% +2.4%"; 2) Pipeline status line with three connected icons labeled "Data Score 24", "Processing 128", and "Output 36", along with small status dots; 3) A line graph titled "Data Quantity Shift" showing dates from May 6th to May 12th; 4) A pie chart titled "Data Score Soundness" displaying "96% Sound" and legends "Soundness 46", "Warning 3", and "Errone 1". The dashboard text is kept concise and accurate, with neat alignment. Bottom navigation and controls: Three small carousel dots are placed centered above the buttons; the first dot is cyan and active, while the other two are light gray. Two rounded corner buttons are added to the bottom: a main button filled with a cyan gradient, labeled {argument name="primary button label" default="はじめる"} It also features a right-pointing arrow icon; and a white secondary button with a cyan outline, labeled {argument name="secondary button label" default="Start later"} Visual Style: Futuristic enterprise-grade data analytics, with a clean vector UI combined with soft 3D glass-like textures. The color palette features a gradient of white, deep navy blue, cyan, teal, and aquamarine. Subtle polygonal grid lines, tiny nodes, faint dot patterns, and light geometric overlays are added to the background. Soft shadows, clean Japanese fonts, and high contrast create a sophisticated App Store marketing feel. Avoid clutter, unnecessary buttons, and redundant features; do not add watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为名为 {argument name="brand name" default="NOVALITH"} 的虚构 B2B 数据平台创建一个精致的移动端入门/首屏页面，采用高级日式 SaaS 视觉风格。

画布：竖屏智能手机截图，9:16 比例，白色背景，顶部 iOS 状态栏显示 9:41，包含信号、Wi-Fi 和电池图标。使用宽裕的边距和简洁的 App 广告排版。

布局：将 NOVALITH 标志放置在左上角附近，包含几何青蓝色“N”图标和宽间距的深蓝色文字标识。在下方设置一个深蓝色的大号加粗日文标题：{argument name="headline text" default="データを、未来の意思決定に変える。"}。在标题下方，添加一段较小的两行日文描述：{argument name="body text" default="開発・運用・データの複雑さを解消し、信頼できるデータ基盤で、事業の成長を加速させます。"}。在左下方，展示 3 个带有细青色轮廓图标的功能简介：1) 堆叠图层图标，标题“統合された基盤”，描述“データとシステムを一元的に統合”；2) 盾牌勾选图标，标题“堅牢なガバナンス”，描述“セキュリティと品質を標準で確保”；3) 上升柱状图图标，标题“高速な意思決定”，描述“信頼できるデータで意思決定を加速”。

主视觉：在右半部分，创建一个大型光泽 3D 智能手机卡片，略微向后倾斜，与半透明青蓝色建筑块以及后方巨大的多面 3D 字母 N 重叠。手机屏幕显示一个日文仪表盘 UI，包含 4 个仪表盘区域：1) 顶部指标卡片，显示“データパイプライン 128 +2.4%”和“データ品質スコア 98.6% +2.4%”；2) 管道状态行，带有三个连接的图标，分别标注“データソース 24”、“処理中 128”和“出力先 36”，并带有小状态点；3) 标题为“データ量の推移”的折线图，日期从 5/06 到 5/12；4) 标题为“データソース健全性”的环形图，显示“96% 健全”以及图例“健全 46”、“警告 3”、“エラー 1”。保持仪表盘文字精简且真实，对齐整齐。

底部导航与操作：在按钮上方居中放置 3 个小型轮播点；第一个点为青色且处于激活状态，其余两个为浅灰色。底部添加 2 个圆角按钮：一个填充青色渐变的主按钮，标注 {argument name="primary button label" default="はじめる"} 并带有向右箭头图标；以及一个带有青色轮廓的白色次要按钮，标注 {argument name="secondary button label" default="あとで始める"}。

视觉风格：未来感企业级数据分析，清晰的矢量 UI 结合柔和的 3D 玻璃拟态。调色板为白色、深海军蓝、青色、蓝绿色和水绿色渐变。在背景中添加细微的多边形网络线、微小节点、淡淡的圆点图案和轻盈的几何叠加层。使用柔和的阴影、整洁的日文字体、高对比度，营造高级的 App Store 营销感。避免杂乱，避免多余的按钮，避免多余的功能项，且不要添加水印。

templates.title: NOVALITH SaaS landing page homepage

titleLocalized.zh: NOVALITH SaaS 着陆页首屏

templates.prompt: Objective: For the name{argument name="brand name" default="NOVALITH"} The data infrastructure and analytics platform creates a sophisticated, fictional SaaS landing page homepage with a premium Japanese B2B tech style. Canvas: Widescreen desktop webpage, 16:9 aspect ratio, clean white background with a light cyan gradient, complemented by subtle grid lines, geometric shapes, light dot matrix, and a smooth, reflective surface. A futuristic corporate color scheme of deep blue, cyan, teal, and white is used. Header: The logo is placed in the upper left corner, featuring a large, angular cyan-to-dark blue gradient "N" icon, followed by the appropriately spaced uppercase "NOVALITH" trademark. Five Japanese navigation items are placed at the top center: "Produce," "Socialization," "Document," "Resort," and "Company Information." The upper right corner features "Login" and a rounded cyan CTA button labeled "Login."{argument name="contact button text" default="inquiry"} It also features a right-pointing arrow. The homepage layout includes two lines of prominent, dark blue Japanese headings on the left:{argument name="headline text" default="Transforming data into future decision-making."} Below is a smaller Japanese subtitle:{argument name="subheadline text" default="NOVALITH eliminates the complexity of development, operations, and data, accelerating business growth with a reliable data foundation."} Function Row: Below the subtitle, three compact function modules are displayed, each with a thin cyan line icon, a bold Japanese title, and a two-line description. These three modules are: 1) Stacked layer icon, title "Integrated Base," description "Integrate the data and system into one unit"; 2) Shield checkmark icon, title "Sturdy Checkmark," description "Ensure quality to a standard"; 3) Rising trend chart icon, title "High-Speed ​​Decision," description "Accelerate the decision with trustworthy data." Home Buttons: Below the function row are two rounded buttons: a cyan-filled main button labeled {argument name="primary cta text" default="View Products"} The dashboard features a right-pointing arrow and a secondary button with a white outline labeled "Data Download" with a download icon. Right-side visuals: Create a large, tilted, floating dashboard panel with rounded corners, soft shadows, and a clean white UI. Behind it is a large 3D translucent cyan/dark blue "N" structure and a sharply angled cyan glass panel extending to the right edge. The dashboard should display a sidebar, top utility icons, analytics cards, line graphs, pipeline graphs, alert tables, and pie charts. Dashboard details: Includes six sidebar menu items: "Dashboard," "Data Catalog," "Pipeline," "Monitoring," "Gabanance," and "Arrow," highlighted in cyan. Includes four top statistical cards with labels and values: "Data Points" 128, "Data Quality Scour" 98.6%, "Account Utilization" 1,256, and "Processing Data Volume" 2.45 PB. The pipeline chart contains three nodes connected by lines, the alert table contains four rows of data, the circular icon indicates 96%, and it comes with three legends. Visual style: A clean vector-style UI combined with a realistic 3D glass texture, a transparent layout, and the aesthetic characteristics of a high-quality startup landing page. It features high readability, soft shadows, a subtle cyan halo, accurate Japanese typography, no people, no cluttered elements, and no watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为名为 {argument name="brand name" default="NOVALITH"} 的数据基础设施与分析平台，创建一个精致的虚构 SaaS 着陆页首屏，采用优质的日本 B2B 科技风格。

画布：宽屏桌面网页，16:9 比例，简洁的白色背景搭配淡青色渐变，辅以微妙的网格线条几何图形、浅淡的点阵以及光洁的地面反射。使用深蓝、青色、蓝绿色和白色的未来感企业配色方案。

页眉：左上角放置 Logo，包含一个大型棱角分明的青色至深蓝色渐变“N”图标，后接间距适中的大写字母商标“NOVALITH”。顶部中央放置五个日语导航项： 「プロダクト」、「ソリューション」、「ドキュメント」、「リソース」、「会社情報」。右上角设有 「ログイン」 以及一个圆角青色 CTA 按钮，标签为 {argument name="contact button text" default="お問い合わせ"}，并带有向右箭头。

首屏布局：左侧包含两行醒目的深蓝色日语大标题： {argument name="headline text" default="データを、未来の意思決定に変える。"}。下方放置一行较小的日语副标题： {argument name="subheadline text" default="NOVALITHは、開発・運用・データの複雑さを解消し、信頼できるデータ基盤で、事業の成長を加速させます。"}

功能行：在副标题下方展示三个紧凑的功能模块，每个模块配有细青色线条图标、加粗的日语标题和两行描述。这三个模块分别为：1) 堆叠层图标，标题 「統合された基盤」，描述 「データとシステムを一元的に統合」；2) 盾牌勾选图标，标题 「堅牢なガバナンス」，描述 「セキュリティと品質を標準で確保」；3) 上升趋势图图标，标题 「高速な意思決定」，描述 「信頼できるデータで意思決定を加速」。

首屏按钮：在功能行下方放置两个圆角按钮：一个填充青色的主按钮，标签为 {argument name="primary cta text" default="プロダクトを見る"}，并带有向右箭头；以及一个白色轮廓的次要按钮，标签为 「資料をダウンロード」，并带有下载图标。

右侧视觉：创建一个大型倾斜悬浮的仪表盘面板，具有圆角、柔和阴影和光洁的白色 UI。其后方放置一个巨大的 3D 半透明青色/深蓝色“N”结构和棱角分明的青色玻璃面板，延伸至右侧边缘。仪表盘应显示侧边栏、顶部实用图标、分析卡片、折线图、流水线图、警报表格和环形图。

仪表盘细节：包含六个侧边栏菜单项：以青色高亮的 「ダッシュボード」、「データカタログ」、「パイプライン」、「モニタリング」、「ガバナンス」、「アラート」。包含四个顶部统计卡片，带有标签和数值： 「データパイプライン」 128、「データ品質スコア」 98.6%、「アクティブユーザー」 1,256、「処理データ量」 2.45 PB。流水线图中包含三个由线条连接的节点，警报表格包含四行数据，环形图标注为 96% 并配有三项图例。

视觉风格：清晰的矢量风格 UI 结合写实的 3D 玻璃质感，布局通透，具备优质初创公司着陆页的美学特征，高可读性，柔和阴影，微妙的青色光晕，准确的日语排版，无人物，无杂乱元素，无水印。

templates.title: Anime Shrine Maiden Character Design Collection

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫巫女角色设定集

templates.prompt:
Goal: Create an anime character reference sheet featuring {argument name="character name" default="a young shrine maiden girl"} in a consistent red-and-white miko outfit, shown as a collection of full-body poses and expression variations on a clean white background.

Canvas: Square 1:1 image, high-resolution, white background with a very faint pale-gray grid and thin rectangular panel divisions like a character design board. Use crisp clean anime line art, soft cel shading, polished digital illustration, and consistent proportions across all versions.

Layout: Arrange exactly 15 full-body character figures in a loose 5-column by 3-row reference-sheet composition. The central figure is the largest and tallest, placed in the middle, front-facing, occupying most of the vertical height. The other 14 figures are smaller surrounding pose variations, each inside its own faint panel. Keep generous white space and avoid any text labels.

Subject details: The character is a petite teenage anime girl with very long straight {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair reaching past the waist, blunt bangs, small side locks, pale skin, and red eyes when visible. She wears a traditional shrine maiden outfit: white kimono-style top with wide sleeves, red trim and red stitch-like sleeve markings, red hakama skirt with deep pleats, a large red waist bow/sash, white tabi socks, and red-and-white sandals. templates.title: NOVALITH SaaS Presentation Grid

titleLocalized.zh: NOVALITH SaaS 演示文稿网格

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="service name" default="NOVALITH"} Create a clean, high-end Japanese B2B SaaS presentation/service concept project showcasing 9 widescreen slides arranged in a 3x3 grid, similar to a preview LP, mobile top, banner, and presentation materials. Canvas: A landscape image containing 9 individual 16:9 slide thumbnails, evenly spaced, with thin, light-colored borders. White background with a navy and cyan corporate color scheme, featuring light cyan diagonal accents, delicate geometric dot patterns, and a cyan triangle corner ribbon in the upper left corner of each slide containing a white slide number 1 through 9. Visual Style: Modern Japanese startup/enterprise SaaS design, refined vector UI, minimalist gradients, soft shadows, rounded cards, thin cyan data cables, navy blue title bars, and ample white space. Use cyan and navy blue geometric N logos paired with appropriately spaced capital letters.{argument name="service name" default="NOVALITH"} No people or photos included; only icons, charts, dashboards, and abstract product visual elements. Text language: All visible slide text should be in Japanese. Use clear, presentation-appropriate typography with bold navy blue titles and smaller explanatory subheadings. Number of slides and layout details: Includes 9 slides: 1. Cover Slide. A large NOVALITH logo is centered, with the title "データを、未来の意思決定に変える。" and the subheading "中小企業のためのデータ预测プラットフォーム" above it. There is a decorative blue diagonal line in the corner. 2. Data Integration Slide. The title is "すべてのデータをひとつに統合", with a short subheading about automatically collecting and integrating scattered data. The center displays a stacked, isometric database/platform cube, labeled with an "N" at the top. Four connected input/output cards: "Database", "CSV/File", "SaaS", and "API". 3. Prediction Slide. Title: "Read the Future with High-Precision Predictions". A large line chart card titled "Sales Prediction (December)", with legends of "Actual Performance" and "Prediction", the X-axis representing months, accompanied by an upward cyan trend line, and a floating KPI card displaying "Predicted Value (Future Period) ¥28,450,000". 4. Risk Detection Slide. Title: "Quickly Understand Risks Beforehand". The chart card on the left is titled "The Shift in RISKS COA," displaying a descending zigzag blue line from April 1st to April 29th, with Y-axis levels of High, Medium, and Low. A warning label "Recognize RISK Upwards" is added. The right side has three lines of descriptions with circular icons: Anomaly Detection, Alert Notification, and Quick Response. 5. Dashboard Slide. Titled "See the Whole Dashboard." Shows a complete SaaS dashboard screenshot: a dark navy blue left sidebar with icons and six menu items, and the main area containing KPI cards, a pie chart, and a sales forecast line chart. Visible KPI examples include "Sales forecast (this month) ¥28,450,000", "Requirements forecast (this month) ¥15,782", and "Reference 24/100". 6. Automatic Report Slide. Title: "Automatic Report Generation". Centered on the card is a white report card titled "Monthly Report", with bullet points displaying positive percentages (e.g., +18.6% and +12.4%), a NOVALITH logo in the corner, a blue bar chart on the right, and a blue button labeled "Download Report". 7. Security Slide. The title is "Safe environment and safe use of it". A shield and padlock illustration in the center with floating security particles surrounding it. There are three security function icons and labels at the bottom: "Encrypted communication (SSL/TLS)", "Acus control (limited division)" and "Regular control (automatic)". 8. Simple steps Slide. The title is "シンプルなステップですぐに开められる". Displays 4 horizontally connected step cards with dotted arrows: Step 1 database icon "データをconnection", step 2 node/network icon "モデルを选択", step 3 play icon "prediction を実行", step 4 histogram icon "result confirmation・utilization". A short explanation line is included below each card. 9. Concluding CTA Slide. The title "さあ、データの力でをつくりましょう", subtitle "NO VALITHが、あなたのビジネスのgrowthをデータでBranchえます」. Large centered logo and wordmark. At the bottom are two call-to-action buttons: a filled cyan button “無料で试してみる→” and an outline button “資料をダウンロード↓”. Constraints: Maintain consistent brand colors, logos, spacing, slide numbering, and cyan diagonal corner themes across all nine slides. The overall image should resemble a sophisticated presentation thumbnail overview, rather than an isolated full-screen slide. Avoid redundant slides, buttons, stock photos, watermarks, or irrelevant text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="service name" default="NOVALITH"} 创建一个简洁、高端的日本 B2B SaaS 演示文稿 / 服务概念项目，展示 9 张宽屏 Slides，以 3x3 网格形式排列，如同预览 LP、移动端顶部、横幅和演示材料。

画布：一张包含 9 张独立 16:9 Slide 缩略图的横向图像，缩略图之间间隔均匀，带有细浅色边框。白色背景，采用海军蓝和青色企业配色，配有浅青色对角线装饰、精致的几何点阵，每张 Slide 的左上角均有一个青色三角形边角丝带，内含白色的 Slide 编号 1 至 9。

视觉风格：现代日本初创企业 / 企业级 SaaS 设计，精致的矢量 UI，极简渐变，柔和阴影，圆角卡片，细青色数据线，海军蓝标题，留白充足。使用青色和海军蓝的几何 N 标识，搭配间距适中的大写字标 {argument name="service name" default="NOVALITH"}。不包含人物或照片；仅使用图标、图表、仪表盘和抽象的产品视觉元素。

文本语言：所有可见的 Slide 文案均应为日语。使用清晰、适合演示的排版，搭配粗体海军蓝标题和较小的解释性副标题。

Slide 数量及布局细节：包含 9 张 Slide：
1. 封面 Slide。大型 NOVALITH 标识居中，上方为标题「データを、未来の意思決定に変える。」及副标题「中小企業のためのデータ予測プラットフォーム」。角落有装饰性青色对角线。
2. 数据集成 Slide。标题「すべてのデータをひとつに統合」，配有关于自动收集和整合分散数据的简短副标题。中心展示一个堆叠的等距数据库/平台立方体，顶部带有 N 标识。四个连接的输入/输出卡片：「データベース」、「CSV / ファイル」、「SaaS」、「API」。
3. 预测 Slide。标题「高精度な予測で未来を先読み」。大型折线图卡片，标题为「売上予測（12ヶ月）」，图例为「実績」和「予測」，X 轴为月份，配有向上的青色趋势线，以及一个浮动 KPI 卡片，显示「予測値（来期）¥28,450,000」。
4. 风险检测 Slide。标题「リスクを事前に検知し迅速に対応」。左侧图表卡片标题为「リスクスコアの推移」，显示一条下降的之字形青色折线，日期为 4/1 至 4/29，Y 轴级别为高、中、低。添加警告标注「リスク上昇を検知」。右侧有 3 行带有圆形图标的功能说明：异常检测、警报通知和快速响应。
5. 仪表盘 Slide。标题「ダッシュボードで全体を見える化」。展示一个完整的 SaaS 仪表盘截图：深海军蓝左侧边栏包含标识和 6 个菜单项，主区域包含 KPI 卡片、圆环图和销售预测折线图。可见的 KPI 示例包括「売上予測（今月）¥28,450,000」、「需要予測（今月）15,782」和「リスクスコア 24/100」。
6. 自动报告 Slide。标题「レポートを自動生成し共有もかんたん」。中心为一个白色报告卡片，标题为「月次サマリーレポート」，项目符号显示正百分比（如 +18.6% 和 +12.4%），角落有 NOVALITH 标识，右侧有青色柱状图，以及一个标有「レポートをダウンロード」的青色按钮。
7. 安全性 Slide。标题「セキュアな環境で安心して利用」。中心为盾牌和挂锁插图，周围有浮动的安全粒子。底部有 3 个安全功能图标及标签：「暗号化通信（SSL/TLS）」、「アクセス制御（権限分割）」和「定期バックアップ（自動）」。
8. 简单步骤 Slide。标题「シンプルなステップですぐに始められる」。展示 4 个水平连接的步骤卡片，带有虚线箭头：步骤 1 数据库图标「データを接続」、步骤 2 节点/网络图标「モデルを選択」、步骤 3 播放图标「予測を実行」、步骤 4 柱状图图标「結果を確認・活用」。每张卡片下方均包含一行简短的解释说明。
9. 结束语 CTA Slide。标题「さあ、データの力で未来をつくりましょう」，副标题「NOVALITHが、あなたのビジネスの成長をデータで支えます。」。大型居中标识和字标。底部有 2 个行动号召按钮：填充式青色按钮「無料で試してみる　→」和轮廓式按钮「資料をダウンロード　↓」。

约束：在所有 9 张 Slide 中保持一致的品牌颜色、标识、间距、Slide 编号和青色对角线边角主题。整体图像应看起来像一张精致的演示缩略图概览表，而非孤立的全屏 Slide。避免出现多余的 Slide、多余的按钮、库存照片、水印或无关文本。

templates.title: Cute Hiragana Wall Chart Poster

Each square contains a large, dark navy blue handwritten-style kana or punctuation mark, sometimes with tiny superscript numbers, punctuation marks, or small decorative icons. Row 1: あ、へ、う、よ、ー (with a small blue fish), う、あ (with a small apple). Row 2: と、ば、う、て、い (with a small apple), う、rabbit icon. Row 3: い、ん (with the number 6), え、い (with a small yellow fruit), お (with the number 1), い (with a small apple), う (with a small orange). Line 4: お、い (with comma), お (with small green grape), り (with small apple), ま、す (with small rabbit face), ば (with number 6). Line 5: じ (with small apple), い (with small yellow chick face), さ (with small pink fruit), い (with number 2), あ (with number 2), う (with small green grape), あ (with number 2). Line 7: も (with exclamation mark), い (with chick face), あ (with number 2), よ、う (with chick face), ひ (with small apple), も (with number 2). Row 8: お (with the number 3), と, ら (with the number 3), え, ! (with a small blue fish), す (with the number 3), ! (with a small squirrel icon). Row 9: あ (with a small apple), う (with a small apple), て (with a cat icon), ら (with a small orange), お (with the number 1), お (with a small f-shaped symbol), ひ (with a small yellow chick). Visual Style: Soft and warm color tones, simple rounded corner poster design, child-friendly educational wall charts, delicate paper texture, light beige thin square borders, dark blue calligraphy kana, cute fruit and animal stickers.{argument name="wall material" default="Light-colored vertical striped wood"} ,{argument name="poster paper color" default="Warm Ivory White"} as well as{argument name="letter color" default="Deep Navy Blue"} Constraints: Keep the image square, frontal view with slight natural perspective, no watermark, no additional text except for the title and grid characters, ensuring the poster is readable while retaining the wonderful imperfections of AI-generated kana posters.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：在浅色木墙上创作一张可爱的幼儿风格日语平假名学习海报，呈现出类似纯文本生成、带有一点 AI 生成不完美感的字母表挂图。

画布：1:1 正方形图片，左侧窗户透入柔和的自然光。海报是一张米白色的纸，用四个小圆木图钉固定在墙上，每个角附近各一个。左下角局部可见一盆小植物和低矮书架，营造出温馨的教室或儿童房氛围。

主体：一张大型平假名挂图，顶部中央用圆润的粉红色字体（带白色描边）写着标题 {argument name="headline text" default="あいうえおひょう"}。标题下方是一个整齐的网格，包含 63 个圆角矩形方块，排列为 9 行 7 列。每个方块内包含一个大的深海军蓝手写风格假名或标点符号，有时带有微小的上标数字、浊点或小装饰图标。文字应看起来迷人但并不完全准确，呈现出 AI 生成的平假名表格质感。

网格内容：使用 63 个可见方块。第 1 行：あ、へ、う、よ、ー（带小蓝鱼）、う、あ（带小苹果）。第 2 行：と、ば、う、て、い（带小苹果）、う、兔子图标。第 3 行：い、ん（带数字 6）、え、い（带小黄果）、お（带数字 1）、い（带小苹果）、う（带小橙子）。第 4 行：お、い（带逗号）、お（带小绿葡萄）、り（带小苹果）、ま、す（带小兔脸）、ば（带数字 6）。第 5 行：じ（带小苹果）、い（带小黄鸡脸）、さ（带小粉果）、い（带数字 2）、あ（带数字 2）、う（带小绿葡萄）、あ（带数字 2）。第 6 行：て（带逗号）、よ（带数字 3）、ち（带小鸡脸）、と（带小绿葡萄）、々、か（带小黄果）、が（带小橙子）。第 7 行：も（带感叹号）、い（带小鸡脸）、あ（带数字 2）、よ、う（带小鸡脸）、ひ（带小苹果）、も（带数字 2）。第 8 行：お（带数字 3）、と、ら（带数字 3）、え、!（带小蓝鱼）、す（带数字 3）、!（带小松鼠图标）。第 9 行：あ（带小苹果）、う（带小苹果）、て（带小猫图标）、ら（带小橙子）、お（带数字 1）、お（带小 f 形符号）、ひ（带小黄鸡）。

视觉风格：柔和温暖的柔和色调，简洁的圆角海报设计，儿童友好的教育挂图，细腻的纸张纹理，浅米色细方块边框，深蓝色毛笔书法假名，可爱的小水果和动物贴纸。使用 {argument name="wall material" default="浅色竖纹木板"}、{argument name="poster paper color" default="暖象牙白"} 以及 {argument name="letter color" default="深海军蓝"}。

约束：保持图片为正方形，正面视角并带有轻微的自然透视，无水印，除标题和网格字符外无额外文字，确保海报可读的同时保留 AI 生成假名挂图的那种奇妙的不完美感。

The cat's face occupies the upper center of the frame: a pink nose close to the lens, a striped bristle muzzle, sharp white whiskers radiating to the left and right, part of the eye visible above the nose, and ears positioned at the top edge. (Cat){argument name="tongue color" default="Moist pink"} The tongue extends downwards into the bowl, occupying the central foreground position and showcasing highly detailed rough papillary textures, a sense of moisture, subtle highlights, and a realistic damp surface. The bottom third of the image is filled with {argument name="food type" default="Brown dry cat food"} The foreground features larger grains with a shallow depth of field and a warm, golden-brown texture. The background outside the bowl is a soft-focus interior space with warm ceiling lights, subtle plant outlines, and window reflections. The lighting is warm, natural indoor sunlight, with mirrored reflections on the glass edges and tongue. Details of the tongue and mouth are sharp, creating a cinematic realism. Foreground Mahjong Table: A green velvet mahjong table with a border and automatic centering mechanism is displayed. It shows 14 front-row winning tiles, from left to right: 10,000, 9,000, 1,000, 9,000, 1,000, 9,000, East, South, West, North, Green, Red Dragon. Two additional terminal tiles (1 and 9) can be added to accommodate the "Peerless Hero" theme if spacing is needed. Includes an additional yellow wall of tiles facing up and several discarded tiles visible on the table, but the winning rows must remain dominant and clearly legible. Large Victory Text: A large, glowing gold Japanese calligraphy is added to the upper left, containing the following text.{argument name="main victory text" default="Kokushi Musou"} It is written on a black ink splatter background with a shimmering starlight effect. A small red and gold label is added to the lower left of the calligraphy, containing the following text:{argument name="score label" default="Yakuman"} Score Panel: Add a dark, semi-transparent rectangular score box to the left below the title. It contains 4 lines of player information and a subtitle. Title text: "East 4th End 0th Round". Line 1: "Lon" and "Beautiful Girl 25000". Line 2: "North - 8333". Line 3: "West - 8333". Line 4: "South - 8334". Winning hand hints are orange, winner's name is pink, and negative scores are light blue. Dialogue Bubble: Add a white, rounded dialogue bubble with a small tail and a pink heart near the right side of the character. Internal text:{argument name="speech bubble text" default="Kokushi Musou! \nYay!!!"} Use bold, black Japanese font. Background: An elegant mahjong room or club interior with warm-toned wood textures. Includes two clearly visible background objects: a vertical calligraphy plaque hanging on the wall, with the following text {argument name="wall calligraphy" default="Mahjong Master"} The mahjong table, characters, and victory text should be displayed on a shelf or cabinet. Keep the background slightly blurred to ensure the mahjong table, characters, and victory text remain visually focused. Visual style: Glossy modern anime illustrations, detailed clothing folds, translucent skin shadows, dynamic flowing hair, gold lighting effects, energetic ink-wash brushstrokes, a celebratory game UI overlay, and a dramatic perspective shot from mahjong table height. Constraints: Keep all Japanese text legible, retain square masking blocks covering faces, do not add extra characters, and do not add any logos or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张极具戏剧性的动漫风格麻将胜利画面，展示一位年轻女性庆祝超大牌型获胜，配有华丽的日文游戏结算字体，前景为精细的麻将桌。

画布：4:3 横向插画，高分辨率动漫主视觉图，温暖的电影级光效，浅景深，闪烁的高光，飘落的粉色樱花瓣，无水印。

主体：一位 {argument name="character name" default="美丽的动漫麻将选手"} 坐在绿色自动麻将桌后。她留着飘逸的深棕色长发，戴着带有垂坠丝带的粉色花朵发饰，身穿带有黑色饰边的白色荷叶边衬衫，领口处别着一枚珠宝胸针。她的脸部被一个位于面部中央的纯色方形遮挡块刻意遮住。姿势：她一只手向观众戏剧性地伸出，另一只手紧握成拳，表现出兴奋之情。传达出胜利的喜悦与惊喜。

前景麻将桌：展示一张带有边框和自动中心装置的绿色绒面麻将桌。显示 14 张前排胡牌，从左至右依次为：一万、九万、一万、九万、一筒、九筒、东、南、西、北、发、中，若需间距可额外增加两张符合“国士无双”主题的幺九牌。包含额外的背面朝上的黄色牌墙以及桌面上可见的几张弃牌，但需保持胡牌行占据主导且清晰易读。

大型胜利文字：在左上方添加巨大的金色发光日文书法，内容为 {argument name="main victory text" default="国士無双"}，书写在带有星光闪烁的黑色水墨喷溅背景之上。在书法左下方添加一个较小的红金标签，内容为 {argument name="score label" default="役満"}。

分数面板：在标题下方的左侧添加一个深色半透明矩形分数框。包含 4 行玩家信息和一个小标题。标题文字：「東 4局　0本場」。第 1 行：「ロン」和「美少女　25000」。第 2 行：「北家　-8333」。第 3 行：「西家　-8333」。第 4 行：「南家　-8334」。胡牌提示使用橙色，获胜者名字使用粉色，负分使用浅蓝色。

对话气泡：在角色右侧附近，添加一个带有小尾巴和粉色爱心的白色圆角对话气泡。内部文字：{argument name="speech bubble text" default="国士無双！\nやったぁ～～～！！"}。使用加粗的黑色日文字体。

背景：带有暖色调木质感的优雅麻将室或俱乐部内部。包含 2 个清晰可见的背景物体：墙上挂着的竖式书法牌匾，内容为 {argument name="wall calligraphy" default="雀聖"}，以及架子或柜子上的金奖杯。保持背景轻微模糊，以确保麻将桌、角色和胜利文字保持视觉焦点。

视觉风格：光泽感现代动漫插画，精细的衣物褶皱，透亮的皮肤阴影，动态的头发飘动，金色光效，水墨笔触能量感，庆祝游戏 UI 叠加，从麻将桌高度拍摄的戏剧性视角。约束：保持所有日文文字清晰可辨，保留遮挡脸部的方形遮挡块，不要添加额外角色，不要添加任何 Logo 或水印。

templates.title: Japanese Yoga and Beverage Event Flyer

titleLocalized.zh: 日式瑜伽与饮品活动传单

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="event title" default="Yoga and Drinks Evening"} Create a square, illustration-style Japanese event flyer to promote an outdoor yoga and drinks night targeting office workers. Canvas: 1:1 square flyer with soft watercolor illustrations, calming natural tones, hand-drawn texture, and delicate ink lines to create an appealing and healthy event atmosphere. Layout: Three horizontal areas: a semi-transparent light green title banner at the top, a large courtyard illustration in the center, and a cream-colored information panel at the bottom. All fonts should be bold, clear, and white or dark charcoal in color. The title should have subtle shadows to ensure readability. Top text: Large Japanese title:{argument name="event title" default="Yoga and Drinks Evening"} Below is a smaller Japanese subtitle:{argument name="subtitle text" default="Relieve the fatigue of desk work with yoga."} Central Illustration: A tranquil Japanese park by a pond, complete with green trees, shrubs, a stepping stone path, a stone lantern on the right, a simple wooden bench, rocks, grass, and scattered red leaves. The image should depict three yoga participants: in the foreground, a woman wearing a light blue ribbed long-sleeved top and dark trousers, sits cross-legged with her hands relaxed on her knees; on the left, a woman wearing a white sleeveless top and loose white trousers sits cross-legged with one arm extended behind her; in the background, a man wearing a light gray T-shirt and navy blue shorts is barefoot on a mat, leaning forward with his hands near his knees. A wooden beverage tray containing three drinks is placed on the grass to the right of the foreground mat: two stemmed glasses containing amber/orange drinks, and a tall bottle with a warm-colored label. Bottom Information Panel: A cream-colored rectangular area containing three lines of left-aligned bold Japanese text:{argument name="date and time" default="Date and Time: Saturday, June 20th, 15:00-20:00"} ,{argument name="location" default="Location: Shinjuku Gyoen National Garden"} as well as{argument name="organizer" default="Organizer: Federation of Small and Medium-Sized IT Businesses"} Constraints: Retain all Japanese text from the default parameter values ​​to make the flyer look like a finished event poster rather than a photograph; avoid using any logos or watermarks; keep facial features simple and unobtrusive; and do not add any extra people, drinks, or text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="event title" default="ヨガとドリンクの夕べ"} 创建一张方形插画风格的日式活动传单，旨在推广面向办公族群的户外瑜伽与饮品之夜。

画布：1:1 方形传单，柔和的水彩插画，平静的自然色调，手绘质感，细腻的墨线勾勒，营造出令人向往的健康活动氛围。

布局：采用三个水平区域：顶部横跨一个半透明的淡绿色标题横幅，中央为大型庭院插画，底部为奶油色的信息面板。所有字体需保持粗体、清晰，颜色为白色或深炭色，标题带有微妙的投影以确保易读性。

顶部文本：大型日文标题：{argument name="event title" default="ヨガとドリンクの夕べ"}。下方为较小的日文副标题：{argument name="subtitle text" default="デスクワークの疲れをヨガで癒す"}。

中央插画：池塘边宁静的日式公园，配有绿树、灌木、踏脚石小径、右侧的石灯笼、简单的木质长椅、岩石、草地及零星散落的红叶。画面中需展示 3 名瑜伽参与者：前景中 1 名女性身穿青色罗纹长袖上衣和深色长裤，盘腿而坐，双手放松置于膝盖上；左侧 1 名女性身穿白色无袖上衣和宽松白裤，盘腿坐着并向后伸展一只手臂；后方 1 名男性身穿浅灰色 T 恤和海军蓝短裤，赤脚在垫子上，身体前倾，双手靠近膝盖。在前景垫子右侧的草地上放置 1 个木质饮品托盘，托盘内包含 3 件饮品：2 个装有琥珀色/橙色饮品的高脚杯，以及 1 个带有暖色标签的高瓶。

底部信息面板：奶油色矩形区域，包含三行左对齐的粗体日文：{argument name="date and time" default="日付・時間: 6/20（土）15:00-20:00"}、{argument name="location" default="場所: 新宿御苑"} 以及 {argument name="organizer" default="主催: 小規模IT事業者連盟"}。

约束条件：完全保留参数默认值中的日文文本，使传单看起来像一张成品活动海报而非照片，避免使用任何 Logo 或水印，面部特征保持简洁且不突兀，且不得添加额外的人员、饮品或文字。

templates.title: AI Nike-chan drawing song comic

titleLocalized.zh: AI Nike-chan 绘画歌漫画

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a black-and-white Japanese-style chibi drawing/comic practice sheet, titled "..."{argument name="title text" default="AIニケちゃんの かおの えかきうた"} This guide demonstrates a step-by-step tutorial on drawing a cute, simplified anime girl's face. Canvas: Tall, vertical poster, approximately 2:3 aspect ratio, white background, clean monochrome line drawing. Uses bold, rounded black outlines, playful handwritten Japanese font, and a cute instructional manga style. Add small decorative glitter, hearts, and tiny yellow accents around the title. Layout: Top title area, below which is an 8-grid layout of 2 columns and 4 rows. Each grid cell has a rounded rectangular border, a black circular step-by-step number badge in the upper left corner, and brief Japanese lyrics instructions at the top. The drawing within each cell gradually becomes more complete. Text content: Uses 8 numbered instructions: 1.{argument name="step 1 caption" default="まるいおかおを かきましょう♪"} 2.{argument name="step 2 caption" default="ぱっつんまえがみ ふわっとね♪"} 3.{argument name="step 3 caption" default="きらきらおめめを ふたつポン♪"} 4.{argument name="step 4 caption" default="まゆげ おはな おくちで にっこりん♪"} 5.{argument name="step 5 caption" default="ほっぺのよこに けさきが たらり♪"} 6.{argument name="step 6 caption" default="あたまのうえを まるくして♪"} 7.{argument name="step 7 caption" default="うしろで きゅっと ポニーテール♪"} 8.{argument name="step 8 caption" default="AIピンで できあがり♪ AIニケちゃん♪"} Grid Details: Grid 1 shows only a large, simple oval/circular face outline centered. Grid 2 adds a rounded bob with bangs and pointed ends above the face circle. Grid 3 adds two large, sparkling anime eyes with thick upper lashes and highlights. Grid 4 shows the same head, but the lower central drawing area is blurred by a large light gray vertical rectangle, obscuring facial details; only the upper head outline is visible. Grid 5 shows a face with bangs, large eyes, and two strands of hair hanging down beside the cheeks. Grid 6 adds a rounded outer head/hair outline above the face, along with thin eyebrows, a small nose, and a smiling mouth. Grid 7 adds a high side ponytail with a hair tie-like band in the upper right corner, but the center and lower part of the face are obscured by a large gray gradient rectangle. Grid 8 shows a nearly complete head with a side ponytail and hair tie, but the central face/lower area is obscured by a similar large gray gradient rectangle. Visual Style: Clear, comic-book line drawings with no color fill except for black outlines and minimalist yellow hearts near the title; bold lines, rounded corners, and a cute educational exercise sheet look. Keep the drawings simple, whimsical, and childlike, like a drawing song tutorial. Constraints: Use 8 squares, with only one step number per square. Retain written Japanese text. Do not add extra squares, extra characters, background landscapes, watermarks, or realistic shadows.

templates.title: Noshi-Kanamer WordPress Plugin Banner

titleLocalized.zh: Noshi-Kanamer WordPress 插件横幅

templates.prompt: Create a horizontal WordPress plugin banner with a sophisticated, minimalist Japanese aesthetic. Canvas: Wide rectangle, approximately 1540 × 500 pixels, light warm peach background with a very subtle, soft radial halo near the center. Add a thin, medium brown rectangular border to the inside of the edges. Layout: A large, stylized folding fan icon occupies approximately 35% of the width on the left; the product name and slogan are vertically centered on the right. Icon Details: A simple geometric Japanese folding fan with a deep warm brown outline and fill, slightly tilted upwards, featuring 7 visible fan surfaces separated by thick brown ribs. The inner fan surfaces are filled with cream, while the outer fan surfaces are filled with dark brown. A circular, dark brown pivot is located at the bottom center. Text: Large serif heading; content is {argument name="plugin name" default="Noshi-Kanamer"} The text is a deep, warm brown, bold and elegant, with ample letter spacing; directly below it is a smaller sans-serif slogan containing the following text:{argument name="tagline" default="The WordPress developer toolkit for clean handoffs."} The color should match the title. Keep the design clean, flat, vector-style, professional, and suitable as a WordPress plugin banner. Do not use additional icons, shadows, mockups, figures, or any other text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个具有精致极简日式美学的横向 WordPress 插件横幅。画布：宽矩形，约 1540 × 500 像素，浅暖桃色背景，中心附近带有非常微妙的柔和径向光晕。在边缘内侧添加一个细的中棕色矩形边框。布局：左侧放置一个大型风格化折扇图标，占据约 35% 的宽度；右侧垂直居中放置产品名称和标语。图标细节：一个简单的几何日式折扇，采用深暖棕色轮廓和填充，略微向上倾斜，共有 7 个可见扇面，由粗棕色扇骨分隔，内部扇面为奶油色填充，外侧扇面为深棕色填充，底部中心有一个圆形的深棕色转轴。文字：大型衬线标题，内容为 {argument name="plugin name" default="Noshi-Kanamer"}，颜色为深暖棕色，加粗且优雅，字间距宽裕；正下方为较小的无衬线标语，内容为 {argument name="tagline" default="The WordPress developer toolkit for clean handoffs."}，颜色与标题相同。保持设计简洁、扁平、矢量风格、专业，并适合作为 WordPress 插件横幅。不要使用额外的图标、阴影、样机、人物或任何其他文字。

templates.title: Jellyfish torso doll poster

titleLocalized.zh: 水母躯干人偶海报

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image as the product concept and visual style, it was redesigned into a vertical promotional poster in the style of a miniature torso doll gashapon toy. The cute jellyfish-themed fashion doll merchandise is retained, but the composition is changed to a soft, pale purple and cream catalog layout with a dreamy bedroom/cosmetic shelf background decorated with pearls and lace. Three doll torsos are displayed on a dark wooden mannequin base in the center. Three miniature torso dolls were created, each with a numbered name tag: 1. "01 Yumemiru Kurage" — Based on the existing soft white jellyfish outfit in the reference image, designed as a light white and light blue fluffy dress. 2. "02 Kurisuma Kurage" — A brand new red Christmas-themed jellyfish dress with white fringed edges, a small shawl, a black belt, and red and white ribbon tentacles. 3. "03 Hoshizora Kurage" — A brand new lilac and purple starry jellyfish dress featuring semi-sheer sleeves, gold decorative chains, a multi-layered skirt, and long, light purple ribbon tentacles. Top heading: Using brand text{argument name="brand name" default="Kurage-do"} Main title{argument name="headline text" default="くらげちゃんの ミニトルソーフィギュア"} and subtitle{argument name="subtitle text" default="~All 3 types~"} Add a small box notification in the upper right corner containing information about Japanese gashapon toys: "Target age 15 and up" and "1 capsule per toy". Add a pearl-bordered badge that reads "All 3 types available". Bottom area: Add a wide, light purple fan-shaped information band. The left side displays the size description "Approximately 6.5cm in height", accompanied by a miniature standing mannequin icon and a vertical arrow. Place a text box with a lace border in the center explaining the product in Japanese: 「くらげちゃんの３つの衣がかわいいミニトルソーフィギュアに♪ "お部屋に色って楽しめます", followed by three tips: "※Image はイメージです." "※Pedestal はtake り外しできません." "※Self-reliance します." Add a gorgeous round price badge on the right side with the following content:{argument name="price text" default="Three types available, 400 yen (tax included)"} Style restrictions: Realistic miniature collectible figures, delicate semi-transparent fabrics, soft lighting, sophisticated catalog photography, and high-end Japanese gashapon flyer design. Retain the torso figure concept and jellyfish fashion theme from the reference images, but use this entirely new vertical poster layout and the three specified costume variations. Do not add additional figures, costume tags, watermarks, or irrelevant text.

promptLocalized.zh:
以提供的参考图像作为产品概念和视觉风格，将其重新设计为一张垂直的微型躯干人偶扭蛋风格宣传海报。保留可爱的水母主题时尚玩偶商品感，但将构图更改为柔和的淡紫色与奶油色目录布局，背景为梦幻般的卧室/化妆品架，装饰有珍珠和蕾丝，三个人偶躯干展示在中央的深色木制人体模型底座上。

创建 3 个微型躯干人偶，每个上方均带有编号名称标签：
1. 「01 ゆめみるくらげ」 — 基于参考图中现有的柔软白色水母服装，设计为浅白与浅蓝色的蓬松连衣裙。
2. 「02 くりすますくらげ」 — 一款全新的红色圣诞主题水母连衣裙，配有白色毛边、小披肩、黑色腰带以及红白相间的丝带触手。
3. 「03 ほしぞらくらげ」 — 一款全新的淡紫与紫色星空水母连衣裙，配有半透明袖子、金色装饰链、多层裙摆以及长长的浅紫色丝带触手。

顶部标题：使用品牌文本 {argument name="brand name" default="くらげ堂"}，主标题 {argument name="headline text" default="くらげちゃんの ミニトルソーフィギュア"}，以及副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="～全３種～"}。在右上角添加一个小的方框通知，包含日式扭蛋玩具信息： 「対象年齢 15才以上」「1カプセル 1個入り」。添加一个珍珠边框的徽章，写着 「全3種」。

底部区域：添加一个宽阔的淡紫色扇形信息带。左侧显示尺寸说明 「サイズ 全高 約6.5cm」，并配有一个微型站立人体模型图标和垂直箭头。在中央放置一个蕾丝边框的文本框，用日语解释产品： 「くらげちゃんの３つの衣装が かわいいミニトルソーフィギュアに♪ お部屋に飾って楽しめます。」，随后附上三条小贴士： 「※画像はイメージです。」「※台座は取り外しできません。」「※自立します。」 右侧添加一个华丽的圆形价格徽章，内容为 {argument name="price text" default="全３種 400円（税込）"}。

风格限制：写实风格的微型收藏人偶、精致的半透明面料、柔和的柔光照明、精致的目录摄影、高端日式扭蛋传单设计。保留参考图中的躯干人偶概念和水母时尚主题，但使用此全新的垂直海报布局和指定的三个服装变体。请勿添加额外的人偶、额外的服装标签、水印或不相关的文本。

templates.title: Red Anime Silhouette Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 红色动漫剪影海报

templates.prompt: Create an eye-catching vertical poster illustration, with the main subject being {argument name="character description" default="A female student turned to the side"} Walking to the right, the character appears as a black silhouette against a deep blood-red background. She has a short bob haircut, her hair blown back by the wind, her head bowed, and wears a Japanese sailor uniform with a large scarf or neckerchief, her skirt billowing, long sleeves, dark stockings, and platform shoes. Sharp creamy white highlights are used to outline the silhouette on the hair, edges of the face, collar, folds, knees, and toes. Composition: Full-body side view, slightly to the right, one leg forward and one leg back, the skirt and scarf billowing violently in the wind. A tall, vertical pseudo-Japanese typography is added to the far left, resembling illegible early AI-generated kanji, presented as a light gray-beige block; it contains seven stacked text blocks separated by horizontal lines, using glitch-style distorted characters instead of readable text. Two thin gray vertical lines are added near the left and right edges, and a black ground shadow and horizontal baseline are added at her feet. Style: High-contrast anime film noir style, silkscreen poster, limited color palette of red, black, cream, and soft gray, rough ink edges, graphic negative space, dramatic backlighting, and a slightly retro print texture. No realistic background, no extra characters, no modern readable text, and no watermark.

templates.title: AI Mascot Satirical Debate Room

templates.prompt: Create a sophisticated 3D cartoon editorial scene set in a comfortable, modern interview lounge, using a 16:9 widescreen image format. Two anthropomorphic AI logo mascots sit facing each other in beige upholstered armchairs around a round wooden coffee table. On the left is a black, rounded square mascot with a large white OpenAI knot-shaped logo on its front, complete with black tubular arms and legs, white gloves, and oversized white sneakers; it raises its index finger as if emphasizing a point. On the right is a brown, rounded square mascot with a large black "AI" lettering on its front; it sits with its legs crossed, wearing black gloves and boots, leaning back with a skeptical expression. Add two speech bubbles: the larger bubble on the left reads "I'm not charging twice so that developers feel respected instead of exploited," with "respected" in green and "exploited" in red; the smaller bubble on the right reads "that seems difficult to monetize." Includes three clearly visible text labels: a glowing shelf sign on the left reading "BUILD SHIP REPEAT," a poster on the right wall reading "ANTHROPIC / SAFETY FIRST* / *TERMS APPLY," and the logo on a black mug on the table. Two items should be placed on the coffee table: a black mug with a white OpenAI-style logo and a small succulent plant. Background details include dark charcoal gray walls, warm studio lighting, a bookshelf with plants on the left, a large potted plant on the right, a soft circular rug, and a shallow depth of field. Employ a satirical tech industry tone, high-end toy-like 3D rendering, soft global illumination, expressive body language, and clear, legible typography, without adding any extra characters or text. The speech bubble on the left can be customized.{argument name="left speech bubble" default="i’m not charging twice so that developers feel respected instead of exploited"} The text in the bubble on the right can be customized.{argument name="right speech bubble" default="that seems difficult to monetize"} The title of the poster on the wall can be customized.{argument name="wall poster text" default="ANTHROPIC / SAFETY FIRST* / *TERMS APPLY"} The character logo on the left can be customized.{argument name="left mascot logo" default="OpenAI knot logo"} The character tags on the right can be customized.{argument name="right mascot label" default="AI"} .

templates.title: A lonely figure in an abandoned warehouse

titleLocalized.zh: 废弃仓库中的孤独身影

templates.prompt: Create a 35mm cinematic film photograph. The image depicts a solitary figure in a long, dark coat standing near the center of an abandoned industrial warehouse, captured during the golden hour. The building is grand, dilapidated, and partially damaged, with tall, broken window frames on the back wall revealing steel beams, cracked concrete columns, peeling paint, and rusty railings. Debris, withered weeds, and haphazardly growing plants are scattered on the ground. Low-hanging sunlight streams directly through the central window on the left, creating a bright, warm halo and casting long, dramatic shadows that extend towards the lens on the dusty concrete surface. Use a 16:9 wide horizontal composition, making the subject appear small against the architectural background, positioned slightly to the right of center, facing the glowing window, creating a tranquil, contemplative atmosphere. Employ a blend of natural warm amber sunlight and deep, cool shadows, high dynamic range, realistic texture, visible film grain, slight soft focus, and simulated film color grading. Added a strong, unexpected film light leak effect: a vertical, saturated pinkish-red band of light along the left edge, and a warm orange-red halo seeping in along the right edge. Photorealistic, atmospheric, documentary-style urban exploration photography, no text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 35mm 电影感胶片照片，画面中一个身穿长款深色大衣的孤独身影站在废弃工业仓库的中心附近，时间为黄金时刻。建筑宏大、破败且部分损毁，后墙上有高大的破损窗框，露出钢梁、开裂的混凝土柱、剥落的油漆、生锈的栏杆，地面上散落着碎屑、干枯的杂草和杂乱生长的植物。低垂的太阳光直接穿过左侧中央的窗户，产生明亮温暖的光晕，并在布满灰尘的混凝土面上投射出向镜头延伸的长长戏剧性阴影。采用 16:9 的宽幅横向构图，主体在建筑背景下显得渺小，位于中心偏右，面朝发光的窗户，营造出宁静沉思的氛围。使用自然的暖琥珀色阳光与深邃冷色调阴影混合，高动态范围，写实纹理，可见胶片颗粒，轻微柔焦，以及模拟胶片调色。添加强烈的意外胶片漏光效果：左侧边缘有一条垂直的饱和红粉色光带，右侧边缘有暖橙红色光晕渗入。照片级真实，氛围感，纪录片风格的城市探索摄影，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Ghost ballerinas in an abandoned theater

Positioned slightly to the right of center, she wears a semi-transparent knee-length ballet tutu and pointe shoes, her arms outstretched gracefully and delicately. Long exposures and multiple exposures create two or three overlapping semi-transparent silhouettes of her body, evoking a dynamic and ghostly atmosphere. The room is dark, dilapidated, and atmospheric, with peeling plaster on the walls. An arched niche or stage opening is visible on the right, while rows of shadowed seats or ruins form the background. A tall, broken arched window stands on the left. Strong sunlight streams in from the rear left window, creating visible beams of dust, a hazy, smoky effect, high-contrast rim lighting, and bright rectangular patches of light on the wooden floor beneath the dancer's feet.{argument name="lighting style" default="Dramatic backlighting with volumetric dust beams"} The deep blacks, luminous highlights, film grain, soft-focus effect from movement, and melancholic Gothic atmosphere. Employing a horizontal 4:3 aspect ratio, a wide indoor perspective, and a low-to-medium camera angle, the dancers are proportionate to showcase the entire environment. There is no text, no modern objects, no color, and no pristine studio feel.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影感黑白艺术摄影作品，画面主体为 {argument name="subject" default="一位幽灵般的芭蕾舞者"} 独自在 {argument name="location" default="一座废弃的老剧院或舞厅"} 中起舞。舞者位于画面中心偏右位置，身着半透明的及膝芭蕾舞裙和足尖鞋，双臂优雅而脆弱地伸展；采用长曝光与多重曝光效果，使她的身体呈现出两到三个重叠的半透明剪影，营造出动感与幽灵般的氛围。房间阴暗、破败且充满氛围感，墙面灰泥剥落，右侧设有拱形壁龛或舞台开口，背景中是成排阴影笼罩的座椅或废墟，左侧有高大的破损拱窗。强烈的阳光从左后方窗户射入，形成可见的尘埃光束、烟雾缭绕的朦胧感、高对比度的轮廓光，以及舞者脚下木地板上明亮的矩形光斑。使用 {argument name="lighting style" default="带有体积感尘埃光束的戏剧性逆光"}，深邃的黑色，发光的高光，胶片颗粒感，运动带来的柔焦效果，以及忧郁的哥特式氛围。采用横向 4:3 画幅构图，宽广的室内视角，中低机位拍摄，舞者比例适中以展现环境全貌。无文字，无现代物品，无色彩，无干净的摄影棚质感。

templates.title: Golden Fields Sunset Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 金色田野日落人像

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic, realistic 4:3 landscape photograph depicting two young people lying supine in a dry, golden wheat field, shot from a very low angle through the tall grass stalks in the foreground. The scene should evoke a tranquil, nostalgic, and intimate atmosphere, with warm afternoon backlighting, a hazy sun halo in the upper left corner, soft film grain, shallow depth of field, and gentle earth tones. The person on the left is wearing {argument name="left outfit" default="Loose white short-sleeved shirt"} The body is positioned slightly back, with one arm bent close to the head; the person on the right is wearing {argument name="right outfit" default="White sleeveless floral top"} Closer to the camera, with the lower edge cropped. Their bodies are relaxed, partially obscured by straw. An opaque, dark brown rectangular masking block is placed above each of their faces, centered and covering one face without revealing any facial features. The background showcases vast rural fields, dark treelines, soft distant mountains, and three slender telephone or communication poles standing on the horizon. Employing natural, imperfect composition, blurred foreground grass, and rim lighting at the golden hour, the work achieves a documentary-style fashion photography feel. No text, no watermark, no additional figures.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影感、写实的 4:3 横向照片，画面中两名年轻人仰卧在干燥的金黄色麦田中，从前景高耸的草茎间进行极低角度拍摄。场景应营造出宁静、怀旧且亲密的氛围，带有温暖的午后逆光、左上角朦胧的太阳光晕、柔和的胶片颗粒感、浅景深以及柔和的大地色调。左侧的人穿着 {argument name="left outfit" default="宽松白色短袖衬衫"}，身体位置略靠后，一只手臂弯曲靠近头部；右侧的人穿着 {argument name="right outfit" default="白色无袖碎花上衣"}，更靠近镜头，下边缘部分被裁剪。他们的身体处于放松状态，部分被麦秆遮挡。在他们的脸部上方各放置一个不透明的深棕色矩形遮挡块，每个遮挡块居中覆盖一张脸，不显示任何面部特征。背景展示广阔的乡村田野、深色的树林线、柔和的远山，以及地平线上矗立着的三根细长的电线杆或通讯杆。采用自然的非完美构图、前景草丛虚化、黄金时刻的轮廓光，呈现出纪实时尚摄影的质感。无文字，无水印，无额外人物。

templates.title: Retro Chengdu Cartoon Postcards

titleLocalized.zh: 复古成都卡通明信片

templates.prompt: Create a{argument name="city name" default="Chengdu"} This vertical, retro cartoon postcard features the city's iconic panda-themed landmark as its central focus. Employing a cute and whimsical children's picture book style, the architecture is minimalist, utilizing heavy geometric shapes, exaggerated proportions, minimalist details, bold black outlines, pop art colors, visible halftone dot textures, and a slightly worn, vintage print grain to create a cheerful travel poster atmosphere. The canvas is a vertical 3:4 postcard composition with a bright cyan-blue dotted sky background. The top third features a large arched title text.{argument name="headline text" default="CHENGDU"} The text uses a warm yellow fill, with black shadows and a thick black outline. Red Chinese characters are added directly below.{argument name="local city text" default="Chengdu"} There is a red dot on each side. In the upper right sky, a red circular postmark is added, bearing the words "WELCOME TO CHENGDU," accompanied by a simple panda face pattern and three wavy postmark lines. Main scene: At the center of the image is a towering TV tower rising from behind the huge geometric panda head building; the tower is slender, with a circular observation deck, adorned with orange details, and a thin antenna at the top. The panda head building has a low-poly stone texture, a black and white color scheme, round ears, black eye circles, a small nose, and a blue glass entrance for the mouth area. Steps extend down from the panda building to the blue river in the foreground. Foreground and city elements: Includes 5 creamy fluffy clouds with light peach shadows and halftone dots: a large cloud in the upper left corner, a large cloud in the upper right corner, a partial cloud on the left side center edge, and two small clouds near the center. In addition to the central tower and the panda building, two main landmarks are added: a brightly colored traditional Chinese pavilion in the lower left corner, complete with a green tiled roof, red lanterns, and a sign with Chinese characters; and a cream-colored stone arch bridge spanning the river in the lower right corner. Simplified, soft-toned city buildings dot the horizon, with exteriors in yellow, cyan, coral, blue, and orange, featuring tiny black windows. A vertical yellow sign on the right displays the Chinese characters "太古里" (Taikoo Li) in black. The lower level scene is filled with rounded, bright green trees and shrubs, dotted with pink flowers and outlined in black. Mascot and Logo: In the lower left foreground, a cute waving panda mascot is added, standing next to a rectangular logo. The logo must accurately read "I ♥ CHENGDU," with a red heart and black and red block font. The panda has a white face, black ears and limbs, pink cheeks, an open smiling face, and a raised paw. Style Constraints: Keep all forms simple and graphic, like a retro comic postcard. Use saturated yellows, reds, cyans, teals, creams, greens, corals, and blacks. All objects must maintain strong black outlines with irregular, hand-drawn edges. The entire image should be covered with a halftone, silkscreen texture. Photorealism and detailed, realistic architectural details are not acceptable. No additional text may be added except for the designated labels.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张 {argument name="city name" default="成都"} 的竖版复古卡通明信片，以该城市标志性的熊猫主题地标为核心焦点。采用可爱稚拙的儿童绘本风格，建筑造型极简，运用厚重的几何形状、夸张的比例、极简的细节、粗犷的黑色轮廓线、波普艺术色彩、可见的半调网点纹理、略带磨损的复古印刷颗粒感，营造出欢快的旅行海报氛围。

画布：竖版 3:4 明信片构图，背景为明亮的青蓝色点状天空。顶部三分之一处为巨大的拱形标题文字 {argument name="headline text" default="CHENGDU"}，采用暖黄色填充，配以黑色阴影和粗黑轮廓。正下方添加红色中文字符 {argument name="local city text" default="成都"}，两侧各有一个红点。在右上方的天空中，加入一个红色的圆形邮戳，印有“WELCOME TO CHENGDU”字样，配以简单的熊猫脸图案和三条波浪形邮戳线。

主体场景：画面中心是一座高耸的电视塔，从巨大的几何熊猫头建筑后方升起；塔身细长，设有圆形观景台，点缀橙色细节，顶部有一根细天线。熊猫头建筑呈低多边形石块质感，黑白配色，圆耳朵，黑色眼圈，小鼻子，嘴部区域为蓝色玻璃入口。设置台阶从熊猫建筑向下延伸至前景的蓝色河流。

前景与城市元素：包含 5 朵奶油色的蓬松云朵，带有浅桃色阴影和半调网点：左上角一朵大云，右上角一朵大云，左侧中部边缘一朵局部云，中部附近两朵小云。除中央塔楼和熊猫建筑外，增加 2 个主要地标建筑：左下角一座色彩鲜艳的中国传统凉亭，配有绿色瓦顶、红灯笼和带有中文字符的招牌；右下角一座横跨河流的奶油色石拱桥。地平线两侧点缀简化的柔和色调城市建筑，外墙为黄色、青色、珊瑚色、蓝色和橙色，带有微小的黑色窗户。右侧包含一个竖向黄色招牌，上面写有黑色中文字符“太古里”。下层场景填充圆润的亮绿色树木和灌木，点缀粉色小花，并勾勒黑色轮廓。

吉祥物与标志：在左下角前景处，添加一只可爱的挥手熊猫吉祥物，站在一块矩形标志旁。标志必须准确写有“I ♥ CHENGDU”，配以红心和黑红相间的块状字体。熊猫拥有白脸、黑耳黑肢、粉红脸颊、张开的笑脸以及一只举起的手掌。

风格限制：保持所有形态简洁且具有图形感，如同复古漫画明信片。使用饱和的黄色、红色、青色、蓝绿色、奶油色、绿色、珊瑚色和黑色。所有物体均需保持强烈的黑色轮廓线，边缘呈现手绘的不规则感，整幅图像覆盖丝网印刷的半调纹理，拒绝照片写实主义，拒绝精细的写实建筑细节，除指定的标签外，不得添加任何额外文字。

templates.title: Sculptor carves his own marble replica

templates.prompt: Create a wide-frame, cinematic, and realistic scene, set in a quarry bathed in the golden hour sunlight. The image shows two versions of the same adult male: the one on the left is {argument name="character name" default="sculptor"} A dusty quarry worker, dressed in an olive green T-shirt, dark overalls, work boots, and safety goggles, approaches the statue, holding a hammer in one hand and a chisel in the other. To his right is a life-sized white marble statue of the man, seated on a rectangular block, wearing a simple robe or a kurta-like garment with finely detailed folds. His hands are on his knees, his ankles crossed, and a large circular stone halo hangs behind his head. A sculptor is chiseling at the statue's neck and shoulders, bright marble dust swirling in the warm backlight. In the background, towering quarry walls are depicted with scaffolding, ropes, stones, and five quarry workers in light-colored overalls and helmets: one standing on the left scaffolding, one further behind him, one on the right scaffolding, one sitting or squatting on the lower right, and a small figure walking on the far right. Utilizing dramatic sunlight streaming in from the upper left, volumetric light dust, shallow depth of field, realistic stone textures, a warm beige and gray color palette, a rugged industrial atmosphere, and highly detailed cinematic lighting, the work employs a 3:4 vertical composition, mid-to-long-range framing, and is devoid of text or watermarks. Visible facial expressions should remain neutral and natural, and the sculptor and statue should clearly represent the same identity; the colors of the workers' clothing should be used {argument name="sculptor outfit color" default="Dust Olive Green"} The material used for the statue{argument name="statue material" default="White marble"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个宽画幅、电影质感且写实的场景，背景设定在黄金时刻阳光明媚的采石场。画面展示了同一名成年男性的两个版本：左侧是 {argument name="character name" default="雕塑家"}，一位满身尘土的采石场工人，身穿橄榄绿 T 恤、深色工装裤、工作靴，佩戴防护眼镜，他靠近雕像，一手持锤，一手持凿；右侧是一尊与该男子等大的白色大理石雕像，雕像坐在长方形石块上，身穿简单的长袍或类似库尔塔（kurta）的长衫，衣褶刻画细腻，双手置于膝盖上，双脚脚踝交叉，头部后方有一个巨大的圆形石制光环。雕塑家正在雕像的颈部和肩部进行凿刻，明亮的大理石粉尘在温暖的逆光中飞扬。背景中采石场岩壁高耸，配有脚手架、绳索、石块，以及 5 名身穿浅色工作服并佩戴头盔的采石场工人：一名站在左侧脚手架上，一名在他后方较远处，一名在右侧脚手架上，一名在右下方坐着或蹲着，还有一名小身影在最右侧行走。使用从左上方射入的戏剧性阳光、体积光尘埃、浅景深、逼真的石材纹理、暖米色和灰色的调色风格、粗犷的工业氛围、高细节的电影布光，采用 3:4 竖构图，中远景取景，无文字，无水印。可见的面部表情应保持中性且自然，雕塑家与雕像应清晰地呈现出同一身份；工人服装颜色使用 {argument name="sculptor outfit color" default="尘土橄榄绿"}，雕像材质使用 {argument name="statue material" default="白色大理石"}。

templates.title: Surreal luxury style Mouth magazine cover
