templates.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic, surrealist luxury fashion magazine cover using a 4:5 vertical composition. The image is an extreme macro close-up of a woman's open mouth, filling the entire frame; her lips are a deep burgundy, glossy, with a wet, mirror-like highlight, and the texture of the lipstick is clearly visible, surrounded by warm brown skin. The mouth is wide open, the interior pitch black, like a stage or a portal. The upper teeth are adorned with luxurious diamond braces: ten upper teeth are clearly visible, arranged in an arch, each outlined in polished gold and inlaid with pavé white diamonds; the two brace areas in the left and right center contain rectangular step-cut diamond panels, while the smaller side braces are hidden in shadow. Inside the open mouth, a crouching, leaning adult male is placed, as if emerging from the darkness; he wears a deep navy blue custom suit, a white shirt, a black tie, and shiny black leather gloves, one gloved hand resting on his lower lip in the foreground, the other supporting him to the side. His face was deliberately blurred by a rectangular block of pure skin tone, but his black hair was still visible. Add a haute couture magazine masthead: the top uses a large, elegant white serif font.{argument name="magazine title" default="LUXE"} Partially covering the upper lip; small-spaced white text placed below the masthead in the upper left corner.{argument name="subtitle" default="MAGAZINE"} A tiny white issue number is placed near the upper right corner.{argument name="issue text" default="SUMMER 2024"} Utilizing dramatic studio lighting, glossy reflections, crisp, photorealistic detail, shallow depth of field, editorial surrealism, and luxurious jewelry advertising aesthetics, with no extra text and no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超写实超现实主义的奢华时尚杂志封面，采用 4:5 竖构图。画面为女性张开嘴部的极致微距特写，填满整个画幅；嘴唇呈现深酒红色，带有光泽感，湿润的镜面高光，清晰可见的唇膏质感，周围紧贴着暖棕色皮肤。嘴巴大张，内部漆黑一片，宛如舞台或传送门。上排牙齿佩戴着奢华的钻石牙套：清晰可见 10 颗上牙牙套，呈拱形排列，每颗均由抛光黄金勾勒，表面镶嵌密镶白钻；在左中和右中位置的两个牙套区域包含长方形长阶梯型钻石镶板，其余较小的侧边牙套隐入阴影中。在张开的嘴部内部，放置一名蹲着前倾的成年男性，仿佛正从黑暗中走出；他身穿深海军蓝定制西装、白色衬衫、黑色领带，戴着亮面黑色皮手套，一只戴手套的手放在前景的下唇上，另一只手支撑在侧面。他的面部被一个纯肤色的长方形遮挡块刻意模糊处理，但黑色头发依然可见。添加高定时尚杂志刊头：顶部使用巨大的优雅白色衬线字体拼写 {argument name="magazine title" default="LUXE"}，部分覆盖在上唇上方；左上角刊头下方放置小号间距的白色文字 {argument name="subtitle" default="MAGAZINE"}；右上角附近放置微小的白色期号文字 {argument name="issue text" default="SUMMER 2024"}。使用戏剧性的影棚灯光、光泽反射、清晰的照片级细节、浅景深、编辑超现实主义风格、奢华珠宝广告美学，无额外文字，无水印。

templates.title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra Poster

titleLocalized.zh: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra 海报

templates.prompt: for{argument name="product name" default="Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra"} Design a high-end commercial advertising poster with a stylish and modern Samsung flagship style. Use a vertical poster canvas with a deep, futuristic navy black background, complemented by a soft gradient effect, delicate blue and silver halos, glossy reflections, and high-end studio lighting. Place the white SAMSUNG logo in the upper left corner. In the center, place the prominent headline "Galaxy S26 Ultra," below which is a smaller, glowing blue subheading "The Latest AI Phone," and the slogan "Power. Precision. Intelligence." at the bottom. In the center of the image, showcase two high-end silver smartphones: the left phone shows the back with a matte silver finish and five clearly visible camera/sensor circles in the upper left corner; the right phone shows the front screen with extremely narrow bezels, a centered punch-hole camera, and an wallpaper featuring abstract metallic geometric patterns in silver, black, and lavender tones. A silver S Pen is placed diagonally on the left side of the phone. Add a glowing blue semi-circle halo and a horizontal halo at the bottom of the device, reflecting the phone onto a polished surface. In the lower third of the poster, a clean specifications bar is designed, containing six features in two rows and three columns, separated by thin vertical lines and minimalist outline icons: 1) Phone icon with "6.9-inch Dynamic AMOLED display", 2) Camera icon with "200MP professional-grade camera", 3) Chip icon with "Snapdragon® 8 Elite Gen 5 for Galaxy", 4) Stylus icon with "Built-in S Pen", 5) Battery icon with "5000mAh battery", 6) Shield/lock icon with "Privacy display". At the bottom center, the call to action "Available Now" and the supporting text "Galaxy AI, Born for Your Everyday Life" are added, accompanied by two small flashing symbols. A clean white and light blue font is used, centered, with high-end spacing, presenting a realistic product rendering and metallic edges, without any additional text or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 为 {argument name="product name" default="Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra"} 设计一张高端商业广告海报，采用时尚现代的 Samsung 旗舰风格。使用竖版海报画布，背景为深邃的未来感海军黑，搭配柔和的渐变效果、细腻的蓝色与银色光晕点缀、光泽反射以及高端摄影棚灯光。在左上角放置白色的 SAMSUNG 标志。在中心位置放置醒目的大标题“Galaxy S26 Ultra”，下方配以较小的蓝色发光副标题“The Latest AI Phone”，以及底部的标语“Power. Precision. Intelligence.”。在画面中心，展示两部高端银色智能手机：左侧手机展示背面，具有哑光银色质感，左上角排列着 5 个清晰可见的摄像头/传感器圆圈；右侧手机展示正面屏幕，边框极窄，采用居中打孔摄像头，壁纸为银色、黑色与薰衣草色调的抽象金属几何图形。在手机左侧斜放一支银色 S Pen。在设备后方添加一个发光的蓝色半环光晕和底部的水平光晕，手机倒映在光亮的地面上。在海报下三分之一处，设计一个简洁的规格栏，包含两行三列共 6 个功能项，由细竖线和简约轮廓图标分隔：1) 手机图标配“6.9 英寸 Dynamic AMOLED 显示屏”，2) 摄像头图标配“2 亿像素专业级摄像头”，3) 芯片图标配“Snapdragon® 8 Elite Gen 5 for Galaxy”，4) 手写笔图标配“内置 S Pen”，5) 电池图标配“5000mAh 电池”，6) 盾牌/锁图标配“隐私显示”。在底部中心，添加行动号召语“现已上市”以及辅助文案“Galaxy AI，为你的日常生活而生。”，并配以两个小闪烁符号。使用清晰的白色和淡蓝色字体，居中对齐，保持高端间距，呈现逼真的产品渲染效果与金属边缘，且不含任何额外文字或水印。

templates.title: A realistic fisherman by the lake in Minecraft.

titleLocalized.zh: Minecraft 湖畔的写实垂钓者

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic Minecraft-style screenshot to showcase {argument name="main subject" default="An adult man fishing while sitting on a folding camping chair"} A scene set on a tranquil lakeside. The main character remains realistic, with proportions and clothing unchanged, but the entire environment is transformed into a bright, blocky voxel world inspired by Minecraft. The scene's perspective is slightly above and behind the character, who is positioned in the lower left foreground: he wears a light beige wide-brimmed sun hat, a dark gray T-shirt, dark shorts, and black sneakers, holding a slender fishing rod angled towards the water. He sits on a black folding camping chair on the terraced, grassy, ​​blocky shore. Tall, square reeds and pixelated grass surround him. The lake occupies the right half of the image, its surface a transparent blue blocky body with subtle square reflections, dotted with exactly seven visible green water lily leaves and accented with white square highlights. Across the lake lies a dense voxel forest, containing oak and birch trees, cascading grassy banks, dirt blocks, tree trunks, leaves, and bushes. The sky is a bright, clear blue, dotted with exactly 13 rectangular white clouds of varying sizes and distances. Using crisp sunlight, highly saturated greens and blues, and realistic lighting and shadows, the game delivers high-resolution screenshot quality. The realistic characters contrast sharply with the completely Minecraft-like environment, which is devoid of UI, text, and watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张照片级写实的 Minecraft 风格截图，展示 {argument name="main subject" default="一名坐在折叠露营椅上垂钓的成年男子"} 在宁静湖畔的场景。保持人物主体写实，比例和服装不变，但将整个环境转换为受 Minecraft 启发的明亮块状体素世界。场景视角位于人物后方略上方，人物位于左下角前景：他戴着浅米色宽檐遮阳帽，身穿深灰色 T 恤、深色短裤和黑色运动鞋，手持一根细长的鱼竿，斜向伸向水面。他坐在阶梯状草地泥土方块岸边的一把黑色折叠露营椅上。周围环绕着高大的方形芦苇和像素化草丛。湖泊占据画面右半部分，水面为透明的蓝色块状水体，带有微妙的方形倒影，水面散布着正好 7 片可见的绿色睡莲叶，并有白色方形高光点缀。湖对岸是茂密的体素森林，包含橡树和桦树、层叠的草岸、泥土方块、树干、树叶和灌木丛。天空为明亮的晴空蓝，点缀着正好 13 朵大小不一、距离各异的矩形白色方块云。使用清脆的阳光、高饱和度的绿色和蓝色、写实的灯光与阴影，呈现高分辨率游戏截图画质，写实人物与完全 Minecraft 化的环境形成强烈对比，无 UI，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Real people in Minecraft's Shore World

titleLocalized.zh: Minecraft 海岸世界中的真人

templates.prompt: Create an image that transforms a realistic travel photograph into a Minecraft-style open-world screenshot. The image should show a person, photographed from behind, standing on a grassy cliff edge in the lower left foreground, gazing at a vast, bright blue ocean and a rugged voxel coastline. The person should maintain a realistic and natural appearance, wearing {argument name="outfit" default="A brown wide-brimmed hiking hat, navy blue T-shirt, dark shorts, and black sneakers."} The pose is relaxed, with hands hanging at the sides, facing the scenery. The entire environment must be rendered in a Minecraft-like cube block style: the foreground consists of square grass and dirt rock formations, tall pixelated grass, terraced gray rock structures along the shore, turquoise shallow water with white waves surrounding the rocks, a deep cobalt blue ocean extending to the horizon, and in the distance, a green cube forest coastline with hills and mountains.{argument name="scene location" default="Tropical coastal cliffs overlooking the ocean"} As a background, the sky is a bright, clear blue, with many flat, rectangular white voxel clouds scattered across the upper half. The midday sun is strong, the colors are saturated, the shadows are sharp, and the contrast is high. The camera angle is a wide-angle landscape view taken from behind and above the character, emphasizing a sense of scale and adventure, like a screenshot of an upgraded high-resolution Minecraft shader pack blended with real people. The character's anatomy is kept anatomically realistic, avoiding blockiness, while all terrain, water features, rocks, vegetation, clouds, and distant mountains are based on voxels/blocks. There is no text, no UI, and no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张将写实旅行照片转化为 Minecraft 风格开放世界截图的构图。画面中展示一个从背后拍摄的人物，站在左下角前景的一处草地方块悬崖边，眺望着广阔明亮的蓝色海洋和崎岖的体素海岸线。人物应保持写实且自然，身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="一顶棕褐色宽檐徒步帽、海军蓝 T 恤、深色短裤和黑色运动鞋"}，姿态放松，双手垂在身体两侧，面向风景。整个环境必须渲染为类似 Minecraft 的立方体方块：前景是方形的草地和泥土岩架，高大的像素化草丛，岸边阶梯状的灰色岩石结构，岩石周围是带有白色浪花的绿松石色浅水区，深钴蓝色的海洋延伸至地平线，远处是带有丘陵和山脉的绿色方块森林海岸线。使用 {argument name="scene location" default="俯瞰海洋的热带海岸悬崖"} 作为背景。天空是明亮清澈的蓝色，上半部分散布着许多平坦的矩形白色体素云，正午阳光强烈，色彩饱和，阴影清晰，对比度高。摄像机角度为从人物后上方拍摄的广角风景视角，强调规模感和冒险感，如同升级版高分辨率 Minecraft 着色器包与真人混合的截图。保持人物在解剖学上的真实性，不要方块化，而所有地形、水边、岩石、植物、云朵和远处的山脉均基于体素/方块。无文字，无 UI，无水印。

templates.title: Real hikers in the forest of Minecraft

titleLocalized.zh: Minecraft 森林中的真实徒步者

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic Minecraft-style screenshot showing a realistic hiker walking through a dense blocky forest with his back to the camera. The character should be realistic, not voxelized: an adult male, with his back to the camera, wearing a light beige wide-brimmed hiking hat, a low-saturation cyan short-sleeved shirt, dark gray shorts, black hiking boots, and carrying a large black backpack, positioned slightly to the left on a dirt and stone path. Transform the entire environment into a vibrant Minecraft world composed of cubes: tall square tree trunks, pixelated bark, cube-shaped canopies, terraced grassy slopes on either side, blocky gray rocks, pixelated tall grass, and a brown dirt and cobblestone path leading into the distance. Use bright afternoon sunlight filtering through the trees to create strong, dappled shadows, saturated green hues, and a blue sky with blocky white clouds visible through the canopy. High detail, wide-angle adventure game composition, realistic lighting and shadows within voxel geometry, no text, no UI, no watermark. Custom theme:{argument name="main subject" default="adult male hikers"} Clothing is{argument name="outfit" default="Beige hiking hat, low-saturation cyan T-shirt, dark gray shorts, black backpack"} The environment is{argument name="environment" default="Dense Minecraft forest trails"} Light and shadow are{argument name="lighting" default="Bright afternoon sunlight and dappled shadows"} and the camera's perspective is{argument name="camera view" default="Rear view, head-up wide-angle lens"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影级的 Minecraft 风格截图，展示一名真实的徒步者背对镜头走在茂密的方块森林中。人物应保持写实而非体素化：一名成年男性，背影视角，头戴浅米色宽檐徒步帽，身穿低饱和度青色短袖衬衫、深灰色短裤，脚蹬黑色徒步鞋，背着一个大型黑色背包，位于泥土与石块小径上，位置略微偏左。将整个环境转化为生动的 Minecraft 世界，由立方体构成：高大的方形树干、像素化的树皮、立方体状的叶冠、两侧阶梯状的草地土坡、方块状的灰色岩石、像素化的长草，以及一条通向远方的棕色泥土与圆石小径。使用明亮的午后阳光穿过树木，形成强烈的斑驳阴影，色彩饱和的绿色，透过树冠可见带有方块状白云的蓝天，高细节，广角冒险游戏构图，体素几何结构下的写实光影，无文字，无 UI，无水印。自定义主题为 {argument name="main subject" default="成年男性徒步者"}，服装为 {argument name="outfit" default="米色徒步帽、低饱和度青色 T 恤、深灰色短裤、黑色背包"}，环境为 {argument name="environment" default="茂密的 Minecraft 森林小径"}，光影为 {argument name="lighting" default="明亮的午后阳光与斑驳阴影"}，以及相机视角为 {argument name="camera view" default="后视图，平视广角镜头"}。

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic Minecraft-style screenshot, in which {argument name="character description" default="A real adult male hiker, with his back to the camera, wearing a beige bucket hat, a low-saturation light blue T-shirt, dark shorts, black hiking boots, and carrying a large black backpack."} Seated on a blocky gray stone platform in the lower left foreground, gazing at the lush voxel forest valley. Maintain the character's realism and naturalness while transforming the entire environment into Minecraft-style cubes. The scene should depict a clear, shallow stream extending from the center of the foreground into the distance, composed of transparent blue pixelated water with bright, square reflections of sunlight. On either side of the stream are stepped cubic terrain blocks: grass blocks with muddy sides, moss-covered gray stone blocks, small square platforms, and numerous tall, blocky clumps of grass. In the midground, place a simple plank bridge spanning the stream, supported by stone pillars. The stream is surrounded by dense, blocky trees: many tall, brown pixelated trunks and green canopies composed of cube-shaped leaves, forming a bright forest corridor. Through the treetops, the sky appears a vibrant blue, dotted with a few rectangular Minecraft-style white clouds.{argument name="lighting style" default="The warm midday sun and dappled forest shadows"} The color scheme uses a vibrant green, the geometry employs a clear voxel style, rich in detail, and features cinematic depth of field and realistic global illumination. Camera angle: wide-angle landscape composition, eye-level to slightly upward, looking upstream along the stream towards the wooden bridge. Hikers occupy the lower left third, and the stream guides the eye towards the center. No text, no UI, no watermark, no extra characters.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张照片级逼真的 Minecraft 风格截图，画面中 {argument name="character description" default="一位真实的成年男性徒步者，背对镜头，头戴米色渔夫帽，身穿低饱和度青色 T 恤、深色短裤，脚蹬黑色徒步鞋，背着一个巨大的黑色背包"} 坐在左下角前景的方块状灰色石台上，眺望着郁郁葱葱的体素森林山谷。保持人物的真实与自然，同时将整个环境转化为类似 Minecraft 的立方体方块。场景应展示一条清澈的浅溪，从前景中心向远处延伸，由透明的蓝色像素化水体组成，并带有明亮的方形阳光反射。溪流两侧是阶梯状的立方体地形：带有泥土侧面的草方块、长满苔藓的灰色石块、小型方形平台以及许多高大的方块状草丛。在中景处，放置一座简单的木板桥横跨溪流，由石块柱支撑。溪流周围环绕着茂密的方块状树木：许多高大的棕色像素化树干和立方体叶片组成的绿色树冠，形成了一条明亮的森林走廊。透过树梢可以看到天空，呈现出鲜艳的蓝色，点缀着几朵长方形的 Minecraft 风格白云。使用 {argument name="lighting style" default="温暖的正午阳光和斑驳的森林阴影"}，色彩采用鲜艳的绿色，几何体采用清晰的体素风格，细节丰富，具有电影般的景深和逼真的全局光照。摄像机角度：广角风景构图，平视至略微仰视，沿溪流向上游望向木桥，徒步者占据左下三分之一处，溪流引导视线延伸至中心。无文字，无 UI，无水印，无额外字符。

templates.title: School cleaning scene by the pool

titleLocalized.zh: 泳池边学校清洁场景

templates.prompt: Create a realistic summer vertical snapshot; the image showcases {argument name="number of students" default="Three"} Japanese high school girls clean the outdoor school swimming pool area on a sunny day, resembling a candid photo from a nostalgic youth magazine. The scene is set on the wet concrete edge of the pool, with the blue pool and metal fence as a backdrop, and green plants and a pale blue sky with soft clouds in the background. All faces are blurred with soft square mosaics to comply with social media privacy requirements. The students are dressed in matching summer uniforms: crisp white short-sleeved shirts, navy blue striped ties, and blue plaid pleated skirts, standing barefoot on the wet ground. There must be exactly three students in the frame: the student on the left stands, spraying water onto the ground with a blue garden hose, a navy blue shoulder bag with a small plush charm hanging from it; the student in the middle leans forward, scrubbing the wet concrete with a long-handled deck brush; and the student on the right stands confidently, one hand on her hip, the other holding a cup of bubble tea with a red straw. The image must include five main cleaning/accessory items: a hose with visible splashes of water, a long-handled brush with green bristles, a turquoise bucket in the right foreground with a white towel draped over its rim, and a cup of bubble tea. Use natural sunlight, realistic water reflections, shimmering water droplets, shallow depth of field, soft lens flare, and add a small rainbow reflection near the bottom foreground. The composition should be a full-body shot from a slightly low, eye-level perspective, with a 9:16 aspect ratio, centered on the student and showcasing the pool environment. Maintain a healthy, relaxed, cheerful, and summery atmosphere; avoid text, signs, exaggerated poses, or fantastical elements.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实风格的夏季竖屏快照，画面展示了 {argument name="number of students" default="三名"} 日本女高中生在阳光明媚的日子里清洁户外学校游泳池区域，风格如同怀旧的青春杂志抓拍照片。场景位于湿润的泳池边水泥地上，背景是蓝色的泳池和金属围栏，身后有绿叶植物和带有柔和云朵的淡蓝色天空。所有人的面部应使用柔和的方形马赛克模糊处理，以符合社交媒体照片的隐私保护要求。学生们穿着统一的夏季校服：清爽的白色短袖衬衫、海军蓝条纹领带和蓝色格纹百褶裙，赤脚站在湿润的地面上。画面中必须正好有 3 名学生：左侧的学生站着，手持蓝色花园水管向地面喷水，肩上背着一个海军蓝单肩包，包上挂着一个小毛绒挂件；中间的学生向前倾身，正用一把长柄甲板刷擦拭湿润的水泥地；右侧的学生自信地站着，一只手叉腰，另一只手拿着一杯插着红色吸管的珍珠奶茶。画面中必须包含 5 个主要的清洁/配件物品：1 根带有可见喷溅水花的水管、1 把带有绿色刷毛的长柄刷、右侧前景处有一个绿松石色的水桶、桶沿上搭着一条白色毛巾，以及 1 杯珍珠奶茶。使用自然阳光、逼真的水面反射、闪烁的水滴、浅景深、柔和的镜头光晕，并在底部前景附近添加一个小彩虹反射。构图应为全身照，采用略低的平视视角，比例为 9:16，以中间的学生为中心，并展现出泳池环境。保持氛围健康、休闲、愉快且充满夏日气息；避免出现文字、标志、夸张的姿势或幻想元素。

templates.title: Cute puppy emoji sticker collection

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱小狗表情贴纸集

templates.prompt: Create a set of adorable sticker-style character illustrations against a pure white background: 9 small, chibi-style mascot designs, neatly arranged in a 3x3 grid with ample spacing. The character is a fluffy cream-colored puppy with droopy ears tipped in blue-green, a small tuft of blue fur/mark on its chest, large, glossy dark eyes, pink cheeks, small paws, and a yellow lightning bolt-shaped tail with blue accents. Use soft, hand-drawn anime lines with slightly sketched black outlines, soft watercolor/crayon-style shading, rounded proportions, and expressive, cute facial expressions. Show the following 9 different poses and expressions: Top left: Surprise, mouth open, one paw raised, black exclamation marks around the head; Top center: Joy, waving arms, sticking out tongue, smiling; Top right: Pouting/angry, one eye closed, cheeks puffed out, small steam symbols around the head; Left center: Sad crying, corners of the mouth downturned, 4 blue teardrops around/below the eyes; Center: Happy giggling, eyes closed, one paw raised, pink blush, a small pink heart and the handwritten Japanese word "e~" next to it; Right center: Confused and shy, looking upwards, with 2 black question marks and a small black heart above; Bottom left: Sleepy, eyes closed, languid posture, 3 handwritten "z" sleep symbols; Bottom center: Shy/cute neutral expression, big eyes, small mouth, surrounded by 3... A small pink heart; a cheerful approval gesture in the lower right corner, a paw making a gesture with its tongue sticking out, an energy symbol near the paw, and the handwritten text "OK!" above. All character designs and proportions are consistent, with no borders, no background props, no extra characters, and no watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 在纯白色背景上创作一套可爱的贴纸风格角色插画：9 个小型 Q 版吉祥物图案，整齐地排列在 3x3 的网格中，并留有充足的间距。角色是一只毛茸茸的奶油色小狗，有着蓝绿色耳尖的垂耳、胸前有一小撮蓝色毛发/标记、大而有光泽的深色眼睛、粉嫩的脸颊、小巧的爪子，以及带有蓝色点缀的黄色闪电状尾巴。采用柔和的手绘动漫线条，带有轻微的素描感黑色轮廓，水彩/蜡笔风格的柔和阴影，圆润的比例，以及富有表现力的可爱面部表情。展示以下 9 种不同的姿势和表情：左上角为惊讶状，张着嘴，一只爪子抬起，头部周围有黑色感叹号；顶部中央为欣喜状，挥舞着双臂，吐着舌头，面带微笑；右上角为撅嘴/恼怒状，一只眼睛紧闭，脸颊鼓起，头部周围有小团蒸汽符号；左侧中间为悲伤哭泣状，嘴角下垂，眼睛周围/下方有 4 滴蓝色泪珠；中间位置为开心地咯咯笑，闭着眼睛，一只爪子抬起，带有粉色腮红，旁边有一个粉色小爱心和手写日文“え〜”；右侧中间为困惑且害羞状，向上看，上方有 2 个黑色问号和一个黑色小爱心涂鸦；左下角为困倦状，闭着眼睛，姿态慵懒，有 3 个手写的“z”睡眠符号；底部中央为害羞/可爱的中性表情，大眼睛，小嘴巴，周围有 3 个粉色小爱心；右下角为欢快的赞同姿势，一只爪子做出手势，吐着舌头，爪子附近有活力符号，上方有手写文字“OK!”。保持所有角色设计和比例一致，无边框，无背景道具，无额外角色，无水印。

templates.title: Handwritten style cafe photo captions

titleLocalized.zh: 手写风咖啡馆照片标注

templates.prompt: Based on the provided reference photo, keep the original image unchanged, and add an emotionally resonant Instagram-style white handwritten annotation on top, creating the visual effect of writing directly onto the photo. Do not alter the croissant, coffee, desktop, lighting, cropping, or background; only add typographic text, underlines, arrows, small doodle markers, and a heart. Overlay style: a casual Japanese handwritten font, a warm café diary atmosphere, slightly imperfect strokes, presenting the texture of white chalk or paintbrush, and accompanied by thin arrows pointing to the croissant and coffee cup. Keep the text clear, legible, and natural, with varied font sizes and spacing. Add 9 independent handwritten text blocks: 1. Top left main title:{argument name="headline text" default="Morning treat"} It features double underlines and small, shimmering decorative strokes. 2. A smaller subheading below:{argument name="subtitle text" default="The day begins with the aroma of freshly baked goods."} 3. Notes pointing to the croissant from the middle left:{argument name="butter note" default="The aroma of butter wafts gently."} . 4. The note on the lower left corner pointing to the tip of the croissant: "上头まできれい". 5. The note in the center pointing to the glossy surface: "Surface no photo". 6. The note in the upper right corner pointing to the croissant layer: "さくっと軽いlayer". 7. Bottom-centered note near the plate, underlined: "この三级片が好き". 8. The note in the lower right corner pointing to the coffee cup: "やさしいOne bite". 9. Handwritten closing words at the bottom:{argument name="closing phrase" default="I've come to love ordinary mornings a little more. ♡"} The text should be underlined. Composition suggestion: Place most of the text against a darker background, such as a wall or window area, and around the food to avoid overly obscuring the croissant itself. Use curved arrows, dotted emphasis marks, wavy underlines, and small decorative strokes to connect the notes with the croissant and coffee. Do not add any logos, borders, stickers, or other extra elements.

promptLocalized.zh:
以提供的参考照片为基础，保持原图不变，在上方添加一层充满情感的 Instagram 风格白色细笔手写标注，营造出直接书写在照片上的视觉效果。请勿更改羊角面包、咖啡、桌面、光影、裁剪或背景；仅添加排版文字、下划线、箭头、小型涂鸦标记以及一颗爱心。

叠加风格：随性的日式手写字体，温馨的咖啡馆日记氛围，笔触略带不完美感，呈现白色粉笔或油漆笔的质感，并配有指向羊角面包和咖啡杯的细箭头。保持文字清晰易读且自然，字号与间距错落有致。

添加 9 处独立的手写文本块：
1. 左上角大标题：{argument name="headline text" default="朝のごほうび"}，配有双下划线和小型闪烁装饰笔触。
2. 下方较小的副标题：{argument name="subtitle text" default="焼きたての香りで 今日がはじまる。"}，配有一条长长的弧形下划线。
3. 左侧中部指向羊角面包的笔记：{argument name="butter note" default="バターの香り、ふわり"}。
4. 左下角指向羊角面包尖端的笔记："先端まで きれい"。
5. 中心位置指向光泽表面的笔记："表面の照りが たまらない"。
6. 右上角指向羊角面包层次的笔记："さくっと 軽い層"。
7. 盘子附近底部居中的笔记，带下划线："この立体感が好き"。
8. 右下角指向咖啡杯的笔记："やさしい一口"。
9. 底部手写结束语：{argument name="closing phrase" default="なんでもない朝が、少し好きになる。♡"}，并带有下划线。

构图建议：将大部分文字放置在背景中较暗的墙面或窗户区域，以及食物周围，避免过度遮挡羊角面包主体。使用弧形箭头、点状强调标记、波浪形下划线和小型装饰笔触将笔记与羊角面包和咖啡连接起来。请勿添加任何 Logo、边框、贴纸或其他额外元素。

templates.title: Cat Girl Dojo Bubble Sparring

titleLocalized.zh: 猫娘道场泡泡对练

templates.prompt: Create a delicate anime-style illustration depicting two young cat-eared women engaging in playful sparring in a traditional Japanese dojo with tatami mats. The character on the left is {argument name="left character" default="A catgirl with short brown hair and brown cat ears."} Barefoot, wearing a dark-colored athletic bodysuit with a navy blue short jacket over it, the cuffs of which are white; she assumes a broad martial arts stance, one palm facing upwards in defense, the other hand close to her chest. The character on the right is {argument name="right character" default="A catgirl with short black hair and black cat ears."} Barefoot, wearing a beige suit jacket over a black sleeveless top and black high-waisted shorts, she lunges forward, one fist extended in an attacking stance, the other retracted. The scene features only these two main characters, both full-body figures, their movements dynamic and confrontational. Between them, a magical effect is created: two large swirls of iridescent soap bubbles near their waists, translucent bubble bands surrounding their hands, and numerous smaller bubbles catching the iridescent light floating in the air. The dojo should have warm wooden beams, sliding doors, a mirrored wall on the right reflecting exercise equipment, shelves holding blue training mats or dumbbells, framed paintings on the walls, and a view on the left {argument name="outside view" default="Bright snow mountain landscape"} The large windows. Utilizing the soft afternoon sunlight streaming through the windows, the long shadows spanning the tatami mats, cinematic composition, clean lines, delicate anime rendering, luminous bubble reflections, and soft depth of field, an atmosphere that is both tranquil and dynamic is created. Keep the characters' faces softly blurred, and there should be no readable text or watermarks in the image.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅精致的动漫风格插画，描绘两名年轻的猫耳女性在铺有榻榻米的传统日本道场中进行趣味对练。左侧角色为 {argument name="left character" default="一名留着棕色短发、长着棕色猫耳的猫娘"}，赤脚，身穿深色运动连体衣，外搭海军蓝短款夹克，袖口为白色；她摆出宽大的武术架势，一只手掌向上防御，另一只手靠近胸前。右侧角色为 {argument name="right character" default="一名留着黑色短发、长着黑色猫耳的猫娘"}，赤脚，身穿米色西装外套，内搭黑色无袖上衣和黑色高腰短裤；她向前冲刺，一只拳头伸出做出攻击姿势，另一只拳头收回。场景中仅包含这两名主要角色，均为全身像，动作充满活力且相互对峙。在她们之间，创造出魔法效果：腰部附近有两个大型虹彩肥皂泡漩涡，手部周围环绕着半透明的泡泡带，并有许多捕捉着彩虹光泽的小泡泡漂浮在空中。道场应具有温暖的木梁、推拉门、右侧反射着健身器材的镜面墙、摆放着蓝色训练垫或哑铃的架子、墙上的装裱画，以及左侧可以看到 {argument name="outside view" default="明亮雪山景观"} 的大窗户。利用透过窗户射入的柔和午后阳光、横跨榻榻米的长投影、电影级构图、干净的线条、细腻的动漫渲染、光亮的泡泡反射、柔和的景深，营造出一种既平静又充满动感的氛围。保持角色面部柔和模糊，画面中不得出现可读文字或水印。

templates.title: Anime Dojo Martial Artist Action Scenes

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫道场武术家动作场景

templates.prompt: Create a dynamic, vertical-screen anime-style illustration featuring a main character.{argument name="character name" default="A spirited young female martial artist"} The scene is set in a traditional Japanese dojo, employing low-angle, tilted shots with cinematic motion blur effects. She possesses {argument name="hair color" default="Flowing long pink hair"} A figure, wielding sharp green eyes and bandaged fists, is seen flying violently through the air. Clad in a white karate uniform and black belt, the uniform slightly loosened by the movements, it still exudes a fighting spirit. She charges forward, executing powerful spinning kicks or surprise attacks, piercing through the tatami mats and kicking up dust, straw fibers, wood chips, and wind streaks. To the right, a large rectangular tatami shield or training target is erected and tilted at an angle, its woven surface scraping against the ground, sparking and scattering as it deflects incoming weapons. The scene must include 12 clearly visible metal shuriken: 8 embedded in or striking the erected tatami shield, 2 flying past the character's hair and upper body, and 2 scattered on the foreground ground or gliding close to the ground. The dojo interior features wooden beams, shoji windows, warm afternoon sunlight, deep shadows, shelves and training equipment in the background, and a damaged tatami floor.{argument name="visual style" default="High-detail cinematic anime-style realism"} It emphasizes dramatic backlighting, rim lighting through hair, swirling grains, shallow depth of field, strong speed lines, and the impactful feeling of a frozen moment. No text, no watermark, no extraneous characters.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张动态的竖屏动漫动作插画，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="一位英姿飒爽的年轻女性武术家"}，场景设定在传统的日本道场，采用低角度倾斜镜头，并带有电影级的动态模糊效果。她拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="飘逸的长粉发"}，在空中剧烈飞舞，有着锐利的绿色双眼、缠着绷带的拳头，身穿白色空手道服和黑带，道服因动作而略显松散，但依然充满战斗气息。她正向前猛冲，做出强力的回旋踢或突袭动作，穿过榻榻米垫，激起灰尘、稻草纤维、木屑和风痕。在右侧，一块大型长方形榻榻米盾牌或练习靶被竖起并斜向倾倒，其编织表面在地面摩擦，并因格挡来袭武器而迸发出火花和碎片。画面中需包含 12 枚清晰可见的金属手里剑：8 枚嵌入或击中竖起的榻榻米盾牌，2 枚飞过角色头发和上半身附近，2 枚散落在前景地面或贴地滑行。道场内部有木梁、障子窗、温暖的午后阳光、深邃的阴影、背景中的架子和训练器材，以及破损的榻榻米地板。使用 {argument name="visual style" default="高细节电影感动漫写实风格"}，强调戏剧性的逆光效果、穿过发丝的轮廓光、飞舞的颗粒、浅景深、强烈的速度线以及瞬间定格的冲击感。无文字，无水印，无多余字符。

templates.title: Pink-haired martial artist

titleLocalized.zh: 粉发道场武术家

templates.prompt: Create a vertical, cinematic-quality anime action illustration, depicting {argument name="character name" default="A spirited young female martial artist"} A scene inside an old wooden Japanese dojo. She has{argument name="hair color" default="Flowing long pink hair"} She soars through the air, her eyes sharp as emeralds, her expression resolute. She wears a loose-fitting white karate uniform with short sleeves and a deep V-neck; her forearms and fists are bandaged and bound with black belts. The shot captures the moment of her rapid charge, her lower body appearing in a blurred, twisting motion. The camera uses a low-angle close-up, dynamically tilted, creating a strong sense of perspective and motion blur. To the right is a tall, rectangular straw project, being struck and shattering, tilting towards the viewer; the shot must clearly show eight metal shuriken: six embedded in the straw project, one flying through the character's hair, and one in the distance in the background. Splattered grass, dust, sparks, and wind marks are added around the point of impact. The dojo background includes wooden beams, tatami floors, shoji windows letting in warm sunlight, training equipment, and airborne particles. Dramatic golden backlighting, highly detailed anime-style rendering, realistic fabric folds, dynamic hair strands, cinematic depth of field, and intense action tension are employed. No text, no watermark, no extra characters.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖版电影级动漫动作插画，描绘 {argument name="character name" default="一位英姿飒爽的年轻女武术家"} 在古老的木质日本道场内的场景。她有着 {argument name="hair color" default="飘逸的长粉发"}，在空中剧烈飞舞，眼神锐利如绿宝石，表情坚定。她身穿宽松的白色空手道服，短袖设计，深 V 领口，前臂和拳头缠着绷带，系着黑带。画面捕捉她极速猛冲的瞬间，下半身呈现出扭转运动的模糊轨迹。镜头采用低角度近景，动态倾斜，具有强烈的透视感和运动模糊效果。右侧是一个高大的长方形草编项目，正被击中并碎裂，向观众方向倾斜；画面中需清晰展示 8 枚金属手里剑：6 枚嵌入草编项目，1 枚飞掠过角色的头发，1 枚在背景远处。在撞击点周围添加飞溅的草屑、灰尘、火花和风痕。道场背景包含木梁、榻榻米地板、透着温暖阳光的障子窗、训练器材以及空气中的微粒。采用戏剧性的金色背光、高细节的绘画风动漫渲染、逼真的布料褶皱、动态发丝、电影级景深以及强烈的动作张力。无文字，无水印，无多余字符。

templates.title: Wukong Anime Character Design Collection

titleLocalized.zh: 悟空动漫角色设定集

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="character name" default="Wukong"} Create a complete character design in the classic Dragon Ball style, using a professional character reference project style with a bright, clean white/light gray background. Ensure the character is highly recognizable, including spiky black hair, an orange martial arts uniform, a blue lining, blue bracers, a blue belt, blue boots with red accents, and a brown monkey tail. Use crisp cel animation lines, neat panel borders, small technical annotations, and dark blue section labels. Canvas: Wide-format horizontal character design set, approximately 16:9 aspect ratio, with a compact and clean layout divided into multiple rectangular panels with thin gray borders. Use a white background with light gray grid/panel dividers and dark blue label bars. Layout and precise number of visible elements: - Left biography panel: 1 large title, text {argument name="headline text" default="GOKU"} The main view panel features a small orange subtitle/marker, two short descriptive texts, and a large circular Chinese character-style badge. The main view panel includes four full-body standing views, labeled front, side, back, and three-quarter view. All four views depict the character wearing the same orange and blue outfit and displaying their tail. The action/pose panel includes one dynamic crouching/battle pose with clenched fists and a visible tail. The seated pose panel includes one cross-legged sitting pose. The face close-up panel includes one large head and hairstyle close-up. The clothing and anatomy detail bar contains six detail items, including one hairstyle silhouette, one boot detail, one pair of outstretched hands, one fist/hand detail, one torso/uniform fabric close-up, and one set of red staff/weapon line details. The expression bar contains five head/expression busts, showcasing neutral, serious, determined, shouting, and battle transformation expressions with golden energy hair/aura. - Proportion Contrast Panel: Exactly 6 standing character silhouettes/figures lined up, including the protagonist and 5 other Dragon Ball-style characters of varying heights. - Color Panel: Exactly 6 groups of labeled color blocks: skin tone, black hair, orange kimono tones, blue clothing tones, dark belt/boot tones, and red accents. Main Details: The character should have the signature large, spiky black hair, athletic boyish proportions, expressive anime eyes, an orange sleeveless kimono with a dark blue lining, a blue belt, blue wristbands, dark blue boots with red trim, and a brown tail. The back view should show the circular kanji badge on the kimono. The pose should be energetic and focused on martial arts. The expression line should include a dramatic Super Saiyan transformation variant with golden hair and a fiery yellow aura. Text Style: Primarily use tiny pseudo-production notes and technical labels to make it look like a character design manual; keep the main title clear and legible. Use text appropriately.{argument name="style label" default="CHARACTER DESIGN SHEET"} As a recurring dark blue label. Visual style: 1990s shonen anime artbook, crisp cel shadows, black ink outlines, warm orange and dark blue color scheme, accurate model artbook presentation, high detail, no photorealism. Constraints: Strictly maintain the number of elements listed above. Do not add extra characters outside the proportions panel. Do not use dark backgrounds. No watermarks, no logo overlays, no cluttered collage effects.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="悟空"} 创建一张完整的《龙珠》经典风格动漫角色设计图，采用专业角色参考项目风格，背景为明亮整洁的白色/浅灰色。确保角色具有极高的辨识度，包括刺猬状黑发、橙色武道服、蓝色内衬、蓝色护腕、蓝色腰带、带红色装饰的蓝色靴子以及棕色猴尾。使用清晰的赛璐珞动漫线条、整齐的面板边框、小型技术注释以及深蓝色分区标签。

画布：宽幅横向角色设定集，比例约为 16:9，布局紧凑且整洁，划分为多个带有细灰色边框的矩形面板。使用白色背景，配以浅灰色网格/面板分割线和深蓝色标签条。

布局及精确可见元素数量：
- 左侧传记栏：1 个大标题，文字为 {argument name="headline text" default="GOKU"}，旁边配有 1 个小型橙色副标题/标记，2 小段简短的描述性文字，以及 1 个大型圆形汉字风格徽章。
- 主转面面板：正好 4 个全身站立视图，分别标注为正面、侧面、背面和四分之三侧面。4 个视图均穿着相同的橙蓝配色服装，并在可见处展示尾巴。
- 动作姿势面板：正好 1 个动态蹲姿/战斗姿势，双拳紧握且尾巴可见。
- 坐姿面板：正好 1 个盘腿坐姿。
- 面部特写面板：正好 1 个大型头部及发型特写。
- 服装与解剖细节条：正好 6 个细节项，包括 1 个发型剪影、1 个靴子细节、1 双张开的手、1 个拳头/手部细节、1 个躯干/道服布料特写，以及 1 组红色棍棒/武器线条细节。
- 表情行：正好 5 个头部/表情半身像，展示中性、严肃、坚定、呐喊以及带有金色能量头发/气场的战斗变身表情。
- 比例对比面板：正好 6 个站立角色剪影/人偶排成一列，包括主角及另外 5 个不同身高的《龙珠》风格角色。
- 配色面板：正好 6 组带标签的色块：肤色、发色黑、道服橙色调、蓝色服装色调、腰带/靴子深色调以及红色点缀色调。

主体细节：角色应具有标志性的大型刺猬状黑发、运动型少年比例、富有表现力的动漫眼睛、橙色无袖道服配深蓝色内衬、蓝色腰带、蓝色护腕、深蓝色带红边的靴子以及棕色尾巴。背面视图应显示道服上的圆形汉字徽章。动作姿势应充满活力并专注于武术感。表情行应包含一个戏剧性的超级赛亚人式变身变体，带有金色头发和炽热的黄色气场。

文字风格：主要使用微小的伪制作笔记和技术标签，使其看起来像是一本角色设计手册；保持主标题清晰可读。在适当位置使用 {argument name="style label" default="CHARACTER DESIGN SHEET"} 作为重复出现的深蓝色标签。

视觉风格：20 世纪 90 年代少年动漫制作设定集，清晰的赛璐珞阴影，黑色墨水轮廓，温暖的橙色与深蓝色配色方案，精确的模型设定集呈现，高细节，无照片写实感。

约束条件：严格保持上述列出的元素数量。比例对比面板外不要添加额外角色。不要使用深色背景。无水印，无 Logo 覆盖，无杂乱的拼贴效果。

templates.title: A Dream Garden in a Glass Bottle

titleLocalized.zh: 玻璃瓶中的梦幻花园

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed, magical anime-style illustration depicting a miniature world sealed within a round, transparent glass bottle with a cork stopper. Place [something] in the center of the bottle.{argument name="character" default="A girl with long blonde hair, wearing a light blue floral dress, is kneeling."} Her face is obscured by a plain pink square, her hands lightly covering her mouth, her posture shy and delicate. The bottle contains five core elements: a central character, a dense cluster of pink flowers on the left, a floral archway on the right, a small wooden fence behind the character, and a mossy path covered with tiny flowers. The scene outside the bottle contains five core objects: a large round glass bottle, a cork, two stacked antique books in the lower left, a magnificent gold box in the lower right, and three scattered pale flowers on a table in the foreground. The background is set as {argument name="setting" default="An antique wooden table in a dimly lit, retro study"} Warm, golden sunlight streams in from behind the bottle, creating radiant, shimmering highlights, refracting glass edges, and a soft, blurred background. The visual style is {argument name="visual style" default="Romantic fantasy animation, oil painting quality, ultra-high detail, cinematic lighting and shadow"} The image presents lush greenery, pink daisies, delicate petals, rich amber shadows, glass reflection distortion, shallow depth of field, and a dreamlike garden-in-a-vase atmosphere. It uses a 3:4 vertical composition, with the vase centered, and contains no text, watermarks, or additional characters.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅高度细腻的魔法动漫风格插画，展现一个封存在圆形透明玻璃瓶中的微缩世界，瓶口配有软木塞。在瓶内中心位置放置 {argument name="character" default="一位身穿淡蓝色碎花裙、正在跪姿的金色长发女孩"}；她的脸部被一个素色桃红色方块遮挡，双手轻掩嘴边，姿态羞涩而精致。瓶内包含 5 个核心元素：1 个中心角色、左侧 1 丛茂密的粉色花丛、右侧 1 座花拱门、角色身后 1 处小型木制栅栏，以及 1 条铺满细碎花朵的苔藓小径。瓶外场景包含 5 个核心物体：1 个大型圆形玻璃瓶、1 个软木塞、左下方 2 本堆叠的古董书、右下方 1 个华丽的金色盒子，以及前景桌面上的 3 朵散落的淡色花朵。背景设定为 {argument name="setting" default="昏暗复古书房中的一张古董木桌"}，温暖的金色阳光从瓶后射入，营造出光芒四射、闪烁的高光、玻璃折射边缘以及背景中柔和的虚化效果。视觉风格为 {argument name="visual style" default="浪漫奇幻动漫、油画质感、超高细节、电影级光影"}，呈现出郁郁葱葱的绿植、粉色雏菊、精致的花瓣、浓郁的琥珀色阴影、玻璃反射畸变、浅景深以及梦幻般的瓶中花园氛围。采用 3:4 竖构图，瓶身居中，无文字，无水印，无额外角色。

templates.title: Modern Mojito Recipe Card

titleLocalized.zh: 现代莫吉托 (Mojito) 配方卡

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="cocktail name" default="Mojito"} Create a visually stunning modern recipe card, presented as a luxurious tropical social media recipe poster. Canvas: Vertical 2:3 layout, bright white background, with a soft, blurred beach and ocean effect behind the main drink, ample white space, and watercolor lime green splatter edges with delicate mint leaf textures and gold decorative lines, creating a fresh and upscale cocktail bar aesthetic. Layout: The top left corner is the title area, featuring a delicate gold cocktail icon, with the small capital "CUBAN SUMMER DRINK" above it, and a large, dark green, streamlined handwritten title "Mojito" below, followed by the slogan "cool • citrusy • refreshing". Add a brief description below: “A classic Cuban cocktail that blends crisp mint, rich lime, and a touch of sunshine.” Add a line of handwritten text: “Sip. Relax. Repeat.” Place a tall crystal highball glass on the right, filled with crushed ice, lime wedges, mint leaves, bubbles, and condensation, and garnished with lime slices and mint sprigs; the table features tropical palm tree shadows and lime and mint garnishes. Ingredients section: Create an elegant bordered card labeled "INGREDIENTS" with 6 rows of ingredients, each with a small watercolor-style icon and text: 1) "1 Lime" with the subtitle "Cut into wedges", 2) "10–12 Mint Leaves" with the subtitle "Fresh and fragrant", 3) "Soda Water" with the subtitle "Fill it up", 4) "2 tsp Sugar" with the subtitle "Adjust to taste", 5) "60 ml White Rum" with the subtitle "(2 oz)", 6) "Crushed Ice" with the subtitle "Add as desired". Tip Card: To the right of the ingredients, add a small, light green bordered card with a mint illustration and two text blocks: the top label "TIP" with the instruction "Crush the mint lightly, do not overcrush," and the bottom label "PERFECT BALANCE" with "1 Lime: 2 tsp Sugar" and the handwritten text "Sweetness, acidity, just right!" Instructions: In the lower half, add the title "HOW TO MAKE THE PERFECT MOJITO" and five illustrated, numbered steps connected by small gold arrows: 1) Crush the mint, sugar, and lime in a glass, with the text "Use a wooden pestle to crush the mint leaves with the sugar and lime. Press gently to release the flavor." 2) Fill the glass with crushed ice, with the text "Fill the glass with crushed ice. Crushed ice = ultimate coolness." 3) Pour in white rum and soda water, with the text "Pour in white rum and soda water. Add the rum first, then top with soda water." 4) Stir with a bar spoon, captioned “Stir gently to balance the flavors. Mix lightly to maintain a refreshing taste.” 5) Finish the mojito, garnish with a mint sprig and lime wedge, captioned “Garnish with a mint sprig and lime wedge. The final touch of summer.” Footer: Add the small-capitalized text “REFRESHING • VIBRANT • TIMELESS” and the gold handwritten “Made for sunny days and good vibes!” with a heart doodle. Corner garnished with watercolor lime wedges, mint sprigs, ice cubes, bubbles, and splashes of water. Visual Style: Minimalist yet artistic, featuring sophisticated editorial recipe card design, combining watercolor botanical elements with realistic cocktail photography, in shades of refreshing lime green, mint green, white, light aqua, and matte gold. Uses elegant serif/sans-serif fonts, paired with a large handwritten title. Constraints: Ensure all text is legible, strictly adhering to 6 lines of ingredients, 2 small tip text blocks, and 5 numbered preparation steps. No people, watermarks, or extra steps should be included in the image; keep the image clean.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="cocktail name" default="Mojito"} 创建一张视觉效果惊艳的现代配方卡，呈现为奢华的热带社交媒体配方海报。

画布：垂直 2:3 纵向布局，明亮的白色背景，主饮品后方带有柔和的沙滩与海洋虚化效果，留白充裕，边缘饰有水彩青柠绿色泼墨，带有细腻的薄荷叶纹理、金色装饰线条，营造出清新高端的鸡尾酒吧美学。

布局：左上角为标题区，配有一个精致的金色鸡尾酒小图标，上方标注小号大写文字“CUBAN SUMMER DRINK”，下方为巨大的深绿色流线型手写标题“Mojito”，随后是标语“cool • citrusy • refreshing”。下方添加简短描述：“一款经典的古巴鸡尾酒，融合了清脆的薄荷、浓郁的青柠和一抹阳光的味道。” 添加一行手写文字：“Sip. Relax. Repeat.” 右侧放置一个高大的水晶高球杯，杯中盛满碎冰、青柠角、薄荷叶、气泡和冷凝水珠，并以青柠片和薄荷枝装饰；桌面上包含热带棕榈树阴影以及青柠和薄荷点缀。

配料部分：创建一个优雅的带边框卡片，标注为“INGREDIENTS”，包含 6 行配料，每行配有一个小型水彩风格图标和文字：1) “1 Lime” 附带子标题 “切成角”，2) “10–12 Mint Leaves” 附带子标题 “新鲜且芬芳”，3) “Soda Water” 附带子标题 “加满”，4) “2 tsp Sugar” 附带子标题 “按口味调整”，5) “60 ml White Rum” 附带子标题 “(2 oz)”，6) “Crushed Ice” 附带子标题 “随心添加”。

小贴士卡片：在配料右侧，添加一张较小的浅绿色边框卡片，配有薄荷插图和 2 个文本块：顶部标签 “TIP” 附带说明 “轻压薄荷即可，切勿过度捣碎”，底部标签 “PERFECT BALANCE” 附带 “1 Lime : 2 tsp Sugar” 以及手写文字 “甜度、酸度，恰到好处！”

制作方法部分：在下半部分，添加标题 “HOW TO MAKE THE PERFECT MOJITO” 和 5 个带插图的编号步骤，步骤间由金色小箭头连接：1) 在玻璃杯中捣碎薄荷、糖和青柠，配文 “用木制捣棒将薄荷叶与糖和青柠捣碎。轻轻按压以释放风味。” 2) 在杯中装满碎冰，配文 “装满碎冰。碎冰 = 极致清凉。” 3) 倒入白朗姆酒和苏打水，配文 “倒入白朗姆酒和苏打水。先加朗姆酒，再加满苏打水。” 4) 用吧勺搅拌，配文 “轻轻搅拌以平衡风味。轻微混合以保持清爽口感。” 5) 完成莫吉托，装饰薄荷枝和青柠片，配文 “装饰薄荷枝和青柠片。夏日的最后点缀。”

页脚：添加小号大写文字 “REFRESHING • VIBRANT • TIMELESS” 以及金色手写体 “Made for sunny days and good vibes!” 并配有一个爱心涂鸦。角落处装饰水彩青柠片、薄荷枝、冰块、气泡和水花。

视觉风格：极简而富有艺术感，精致的编辑级配方卡设计，水彩植物元素与写实鸡尾酒摄影相结合，色调为清新青柠绿、薄荷绿、白色、浅水蓝色和哑光金。采用优雅的衬线/无衬线字体，并搭配标题的大号手写体。

约束条件：确保所有文字清晰易读，严格保持 6 行配料、2 个小贴士文本块和 5 个编号制作步骤。画面中不得出现人物，不得有水印，不得添加额外步骤，保持画面整洁。

It uses a 3:4 vertical poster composition. A large yellow, curved bubble at the top reads, "..."{argument name="headline text" default="CHENGDU"} The image features a black shadow and the Chinese characters "Chengdu" in red below, flanked by two red dots. The central focus is a panda-head-shaped building inspired by Chengdu's panda landmark: a large geometric black and white panda face structure at the bottom center, complete with a blue glass entrance, steps, shrubs, and flowers, with a tall, slender TV tower standing behind it. The image must include three panda elements: the large panda-head building, a cheerful panda mascot waving from beside a sign in the lower left foreground, and a red circular passport stamp in the upper right corner with the words "WELCOME TO CHENGDU" and a panda face design. It must contain 5... A collection of fluffy, creamy clouds with peach-pink hues: a large cloud in the upper left, a large cloud in the upper right, a partially obscured cloud at the lower left edge, a small cloud near the left-center horizon, and a small cloud near the right-center sky. At the bottom, construct a simplified skyline in cyan, yellow, pink, orange, and blue rectangular buildings, along with green treetops. Add a traditional Chinese pavilion with green glazed tiles, red lanterns, and a small plaque with Chinese characters in the lower left; add a yellow vertical building sign reading "Taikoo Li" on the right; and add a creamy-colored arched bridge spanning a bright blue body of water in the lower right. In the lower left foreground, place a sign that reads "I ♥ CHENGDU," next to a waving panda. Maintain all shapes and sizes as rounded, toy-like, and geometric, with minimal details, bold outlines, and warm, bright colors, exuding the vibrancy of a vintage postcard, without any realistic elements.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张可爱复古的 {argument name="city name" default="成都"} 卡通旅行海报，采用天真烂漫的儿童绘本风格，呈现超简化的厚重建筑、夸张的比例、粗犷的黑色轮廓线、明亮的平涂色彩、半色调漫画纸质感、轻微的油墨错位效果以及晴朗的青蓝色天空。使用 3:4 的竖版海报构图。在顶部放置巨大的黄色弧形气泡字体，写着 “{argument name="headline text" default="CHENGDU"}”，并带有黑色阴影，下方配以红色汉字 “成都”，两侧各有一个红点。画面中心重点突出一个受成都熊猫地标启发的熊猫头造型建筑：底部中央是一个巨大的几何黑白熊猫脸结构，配有蓝色玻璃入口、台阶、灌木和花卉，身后耸立着一座高耸纤细的电视塔。画面中必须包含 3 个熊猫元素：巨大的熊猫头建筑、左下角前景中站在指示牌旁挥手致意的快乐熊猫吉祥物，以及右上角一个写有 “WELCOME TO CHENGDU” 字样并带有熊猫脸图案的红色圆形护照印章图形。包含 5 朵带有桃色阴影的奶油色蓬松云朵：左上角一朵大云，右上角一朵大云，左下边缘一朵半遮掩的云，左中天际线附近一朵小云，以及右中天空附近一朵小云。在底部构建一条简化的天际线，包含青色、黄色、粉色、橙色和蓝色的长方形建筑，以及绿色的树梢。左下角添加一座带有绿色琉璃瓦、红灯笼和写有中式字符小牌匾的传统中式凉亭；右侧添加一个写有 “太古里” 的黄色竖向建筑招牌；右下角添加一座横跨明亮蓝色水域的奶油色拱桥。在左下角前景处，放置一个写有 “I ♥ CHENGDU” 的指示牌，旁边是挥手的熊猫。保持所有造型圆润、玩具感且几何化，细节极简，轮廓粗犷，色彩温暖明快，充满复古明信片的活力，且不含任何写实元素。

titleLocalized.zh: 电影感男性肖像编辑摄影

Lighting: Dramatic studio lighting with a strong red rim light outlining the hair and shoulders, a soft diffused main light on the face, and gentle shadows adding depth. There is a slight reflection on the glasses. Composition: Medium close-up, centered composition, slightly upward angle to enhance presence and authority. promptLocalized.zh:
超写实电影感肖像，主角为 {argument name="subject" default="年轻男性"}，皮肤白皙，棕色凌乱短发，留有浅浅的胡茬，佩戴黑色圆框眼镜。面部轮廓柔和且清晰，蓝灰色双眼，神情冷静专注。他微微抬头看向镜头外，流露出沉稳的自信。

promptLocalized.zh:
单色街头海报插画，描绘 {argument name="subject" default="街头场景"}，以 {argument name="character" default="路飞"} 为中心人物。展示角色处于 {argument name="action scene" default="动态战斗姿势"} 中，身着都市街头服饰并配备主题道具。在身体、四肢和服装上密集覆盖贴纸炸弹纹身图案。加入排版设计，使作品呈现出街头海报与地下杂志封面的结合感。

风格：严格仅使用黑白调色板，无灰度渐变，无写实阴影。线条采用粗犷的墨水质感绘制。优先考虑负空间、扁平图形形状和高冲击力的对比度。构图：动态特写。长宽比 3:4。

templates.title: Handmade clay city scene

titleLocalized.zh: 手工橡皮泥城市场景

templates.prompt: Create a whimsical 3:4 edit-style illustration of a five-year-old child sitting at a warm craft table, proudly creating a handmade version of a craft project using clay.{argument name="city" default="London"} The entire miniature world should evoke the feel of authentic child-made clay, featuring brightly colored clay, rounded edges, irregular shapes, tiny fingerprints, a soft texture, crooked little buildings, whimsical proportions, and charming imperfections. This clay city should be filled with delightful micro-details: recognizable landmarks, rivers, bridges, cafes, food trucks, parks, trains, buses, apartment buildings, trees, street scenes, stalls, miniature clay figures, clouds, and heartwarming community moments. Everything should appear imaginative, rich in content, vibrant, and imbued with the warmth of handcrafted creation, rather than the texture of professional modeling. Children should appear natural and believable, dressed in simple everyday clothing, with happy and curious expressions, interacting with this miniature city. Avoid theatrical costumes or exaggerated shapes. Art direction: High-end children's magazine illustrations, a handcrafted aesthetic inspired by clay animation, a warm Scandinavian editorial atmosphere, a miniature 3D model photographic feel, an emotionally warm narrative style, rich in detail yet soft and whimsical. The lighting should be bright and clear, utilizing natural, diffused indoor daylight. The color palette should include clean whites, fresh clay-like pastels, subtle cool neutrals, and soft highlights and bright, soft shadows. Avoid any logos, pseudo-text, AI artifacts, hyper-realistic details, or rigid perfection. Bottom right corner: Add a short, handwritten phrase in white crayon: “Let's play in…”{argument name="city name" default="London"} "The handwriting should appear cute, childlike, uneven, and naturally imperfect."

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张充满奇思妙想的 3:4 编辑风格插画，画面中一个五岁的孩子坐在温暖的手工桌前，自豪地用橡皮泥制作了一个手工版的 {argument name="city" default="London"}。整个微型世界应呈现出真实的儿童手工捏造感，包括色彩鲜艳的橡皮泥、圆润的边缘、不规则的形状、细小的指纹、柔软的质感、歪歪扭扭的小建筑、充满童趣的比例以及随处可见的迷人瑕疵。

这座橡皮泥城市应充满令人愉悦的微小细节：可辨认的地标、河流、桥梁、咖啡馆、餐车、公园、火车、公交车、公寓楼、树木、街景、摊位、微型橡皮泥小人、云朵以及温馨的社区瞬间。一切都应显得富有想象力、内容丰富、生动活泼，且带有手工制作的温情，而非专业建模的质感。

孩子看起来应自然可信，穿着简单的日常服装，表情快乐而好奇，正在与这座微型城市互动。避免使用戏服般的装扮或夸张的造型。

艺术指导：高端儿童杂志插画，受粘土动画启发的手工美学，温馨的斯堪的纳维亚编辑氛围，微型立体模型摄影感，情感温暖的叙事风格，细节丰富但柔和且充满童趣。

光线应明亮、通透，采用自然漫射的室内日光，色调包含干净的白色、清新的橡皮泥粉彩色、微妙的冷中性色调，并带有柔和的高光和明亮的柔影。

不要包含任何标志、伪文字、AI 伪影、超写实细节或刻板的完美感。

右下角：添加一行用白色蜡笔手写的短句：
“Let’s play in {argument name="city name" default="London"}”
笔迹应显得可爱、稚嫩、不均匀且自然不完美。

The film evokes an emotional urban atmosphere, a romantic yet lonely aesthetic, shallow depth of field, ultra-refined cinematic lighting, soft glowing effects, realistic texture, emotional narrative, high contrast, photorealistic style, 8K resolution, and a vertical composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 一个电影级奇幻写实风格的夜景，画面中一位 {argument name="subject" default="年轻男子"} 正与一位 {argument name="hologram type" default="发光的全息女性"} 在雨后的潮湿街道上牵手漫步。男子形象写实，身穿全黑叠穿风格服饰，包括黑色连帽衫、黑色夹克、黑色工装裤和白色运动鞋，留着凌乱的深色短发，下巴有淡淡的胡茬，戴着圆框眼镜。他神情平静，带着一丝感性，正注视着身旁发光的女性。女性完全由温暖的金色光线和霓虹轮廓构成，宛如一个发光的人形素描或灵体。她长发飘逸，身穿一件发光的长外套，手中捧着一束鲜红的玫瑰，在暗色调的环境中格外醒目。街道反射着橙色的路灯和城市的散景光斑，在湿润的路面上形成明亮的倒影。充满情绪的城市氛围，浪漫而孤独的美学，浅景深，超精细电影级布光，柔和的发光效果，写实的质感，情感叙事，高对比度，照片级真实风格，8K 分辨率，竖构图。

templates.title: Street style blogger grid layout

titleLocalized.zh: 街头潮流博主网格布局

templates.prompt: A photorealistic 2x2 four-grid layout showcases a{argument name="subject" default="Young European-looking man"} He had fair skin and short, light brown hair with a natural, matte finish. He was tall and slender, wearing a {argument name="outfit" default="Oversized matte black cotton T-shirt"} ,and{argument name="background" default="Smooth, bright orange seamless background"} In stark contrast, the background features subtle tonal gradations. Studio lighting casts soft, directional warm light, creating smooth, cinematic shadows that accentuate his warm complexion and well-defined facial features, including light stubble and full, well-proportioned lips. Each shot showcases a different pose and movement: the top left shows him raising his hand, fingers forming a circle that frames a deep, light green/brown eye; the top right captures a relaxed, confident three-quarter profile, wearing black rectangular, thin-rimmed sunglasses; the bottom left depicts him leaning slightly forward, casually adjusting his sunglasses; and the bottom right shows him looking directly at the camera, his hand outstretched, blurred in the shallow depth of field. The focus is clearly on his face and eyes, with the foreground hand artistically blurred in appropriate places, creating an urban fashion blogger vibe and editorial street style. The composition emphasizes clear textures—natural strands of hair, the texture of cotton fabric, delicate metal bracelets, and a minimalist black line tattoo on the inside of the forearm—the image is luminous and has an ultra-high resolution, clean color gradation, and high contrast, free of any distracting elements, text, or artifacts.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张照片级写实的 2x2 四格网格布局，展示了一位 {argument name="subject" default="年轻欧洲外貌男性"}，他拥有白皙的皮肤和浅棕色质感短发，发型自然哑光。他身材修长，身穿一件 {argument name="outfit" default="超大款纯黑色哑光纯棉 T 恤"}，与 {argument name="background" default="平滑明亮的橙色无缝背景"} 形成鲜明对比，背景带有微妙的色调渐变。影棚灯光投射出柔和而具有方向感的暖光，营造出平滑的电影感阴影，突显了他温暖的肤色和轮廓分明的面部特征，包括淡淡的胡茬和饱满适中的嘴唇。每个画面的姿势和动作各不相同：左上角展示他抬起手，手指形成一个圆圈，框住一只深邃的浅绿色/淡褐色眼睛；右上角捕捉了一个四分之三侧面的放松自信姿态，佩戴着黑色长方形细框太阳镜；左下角描绘了他微微前倾，随手调整太阳镜的动作；右下角正面直视镜头，手部伸向前方，在浅景深下呈现模糊效果。焦点清晰地集中在他的面部和眼睛上，前景的手部在适当位置进行了艺术化模糊处理，营造出都市时尚博主的氛围和编辑级街头潮流感。构图强调了清晰的纹理——自然的头发丝、棉质面料纹理、精致的金属手链以及前臂内侧极简的黑色线条纹身——画面发光且具有超高分辨率，色彩分级干净且对比度高，无任何干扰元素、文字或伪影。

templates.title: 3D plush toy-style "About Me" poster

titleLocalized.zh: 3D 毛绒玩具风格“关于我”海报

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed 4:5 scale "About Me" portrait poster in a sophisticated 3D plush toy aesthetic, transforming the subject of your uploaded photo into an adorable, soft-textured, collectible character while preserving their realistic facial features and structure. Utilize realistic plush fabric textures, smooth designer toy surfaces, delicate stitching details, cinematic lighting, refined shadows, and ultra-clear 8K rendering. The poster should blend the feel of designer toy packaging, modern Asian fashion editorial style, and trendy lifestyle magazine covers. Incorporate layered typography, playful graphic embellishments, floating plush props, sticker-style decorations, glossy 3D elements, plush textures, soft gradients, and stylish editorial layout. Avoid white space—the composition should be rich, dynamic, chic, and professionally articulated. Create a new pose distinct from the reference image, showcasing the model's natural vitality: a relaxed posture, expressive gestures, a slight body tilt, stylish hand interactions, and a warm, captivating facial expression. Clothing should reflect modern streetwear style, such as oversized jackets, knitwear, loose trousers, sneakers, accessories, rings, necklaces, beanies, or glasses, and should be paired with harmonious, fashionable colors and high-quality, soft materials. Use cinematic medium shots or slightly upward-looking compositions to create an immersive depth of field while ensuring all poster elements are clearly visible. Incorporate the following details naturally into the typography: Name:{argument name="name" default="[Name]"} City of birth:{argument name="city" default="[City]"} ,state:{argument name="status" default="[state]"} Favorite sport:{argument name="sport" default="[sports]"}

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个高度精细的 4:5 比例“关于我”肖像海报，采用高级 3D 毛绒玩具美学风格，将上传照片中的主体转化为可爱的软质感收藏级角色，同时完整保留真实的脸部特征和结构。使用逼真的毛绒织物纹理、平滑的设计师玩具表面、细腻的缝合细节、电影级光影、精致的阴影以及超清晰的 8K 渲染。海报应融合设计师玩具包装、现代亚洲时尚编辑风格和潮流生活杂志封面的质感。加入分层排版、俏皮的图形装饰、漂浮的毛绒道具、贴纸风格装饰、光泽感 3D 元素、毛绒纹理、柔和渐变以及时尚的编辑排版。避免留白——构图应显得丰富、动感、时髦且具有专业的艺术指导感。创建一个不同于参考图像的新姿势，展现自然的模特活力：放松的姿态、富有表现力的手势、轻微的身体倾斜、时尚的手部互动以及温暖迷人的面部表情。服装应体现现代街头时尚风格，例如廓形夹克、针织衫、宽松长裤、运动鞋、配饰、戒指、项链、冷帽或眼镜，并搭配和谐的时尚色彩和优质的柔软材质。使用电影级中景或略微仰视的构图，营造沉浸式景深，同时确保所有海报元素清晰可见。将以下细节自然地融入排版设计中：姓名：{argument name="name" default="[姓名]"}，出生城市：{argument name="city" default="[城市]"}，状态：{argument name="status" default="[状态]"}，最喜欢的运动：{argument name="sport" default="[运动]"}

templates.title: 3D Jungle Adventure Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 3D 丛林探险海报

templates.prompt: A vibrant, adventurous vertical poster, brimming with the energy of a tropical jungle. At the center of the image is a courageous 3D figure.{argument name="character" default="Cartoon Explorer Character"} —A happy little boy with a big, round head, wearing a bright orange adventure hat, a lime green backpack, and thick yellow boots, confidently raises his arms, beaming with excitement. Surrounding him are a series of enormous 3D jungle elements: ten different shades of emerald green and lime green glossy tropical leaves; huge exotic flowers in magenta, fuchsia, and electric purple; colorful 3D parrots (red, yellow, and cobalt blue) perched on candy-colored vines; and an adorable cartoon tiger cub with orange feathers and black stripes playfully peeking out from behind a giant leaf. In the background, a shimmering turquoise waterfall cascades down, refracting rainbow-like light. templates.title: Cyberpunk fashion portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克时尚大片人像

templates.prompt: A full-body, ultra-detailed cinematic fashion portrait, featuring a {argument name="subject" default="Beautiful Asian woman"} Her facial features are perfectly preserved, her proportions are natural, and she sits confidently in a car.{argument name="vehicle" default="Futuristic yellow and black cyberpunk motorcycle"} Above. The overall aesthetics blend {argument name="style" default="New Tokyo Street Culture"} Shot in a high-end studio, this image blends luxurious and avant-garde techwear. She wears a sophisticated white techwear hood with red optical sensor details, layered over bold yellow armored shoulder armor that reveals metal bolts and industrial mechanical designs. Her torso is encased in a distressed cybernetic bra, adorned with bronze gears, exposed wiring, layered mechanical plates, and subtle combat-wear textures on a close-fitting white tactical undershirt. Her sleeves are exaggerated, crafted from richly textured pink satin fabric with striking black Japanese lettering and subtle distressed details. She wears black tactical fingerless leather gloves with realistic stitching and a matte carbon fiber finish. Her lower body is clad in high-waisted, oversized charcoal black techwear trousers with practical straps, hanging buckles, reinforced seams, and minimalist red accents. She completes the look with chunky, futuristic yellow and red high-top sneakers with a mechanical sole, layered upper, red laces, metallic trim, and realistic rubber textures. The face maintains a highly realistic and natural aesthetic, showcasing visible pores, delicate skin texture, subtle under-eye details, sharp eyeliner, high-arched dark eyebrows, soft matte red lips, and bright, lifelike eyes. It rejects plastic-looking skin, AI smoothing, and exaggerated anime features. The expression is calm, cool, confident, and resolute, with a slight tilt of the head creating a heroic aura of complete control. The shooting angle is a highly dynamic low-angle hero perspective, emphasizing power, proportion, and a cinematic pose. The right leg extends naturally to the ground, and the upper body is slightly turned towards the camera. The hands are casually placed near the handlebars, the posture relaxed yet poised for action. The background is a clean, white, high-fashion photography studio, decorated with striking large red Japanese kanji typography and futuristic editorial graphic elements reminiscent of a high-end magazine cover. The minimalist cyberpunk composition is embellished with subtle floating UI design elements. The lighting uses cinematic Rembrandt lighting, with soft directional key lights sculpting the facial contours and clothing folds, combined with subtle rim lighting to separate the figure from the white background. The metallic motorcycle surface reflects realistic highlights, creating a sense of volume within the studio atmosphere. Shot using a Fujifilm GFX 100 II with an 85mm f/1.4 lens, this film boasts ultra-shallow depth of field, sharp facial details, cinematic color grading, photorealistic textures, aged metallic finish, realistic silk fabric textures, denim textures, rubber details, volumetric lighting, ultra-high definition, 8K resolution, master-level quality, fashion editing photography, and a hyper-realistic cyberpunk aesthetic.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张全身、超细节的电影级时尚大片人像，主角为一位 {argument name="subject" default="美丽的亚裔女性"}，面部特征保留完美，比例自然，自信地坐在一辆 {argument name="vehicle" default="未来感黄黑配色赛博朋克摩托车"} 上。整体美学融合了 {argument name="style" default="新东京街头文化"} 与奢华前卫的机能风时尚，于高级摄影棚内拍摄。
她佩戴着精致的白色机能风兜帽，上面嵌入了红色的光学传感器细节，内搭大胆的黄色装甲肩甲，露出金属螺栓和工业机械设计。她的躯干包裹在做旧的赛博义体束胸中，装饰着青铜色齿轮、外露的线路、分层机械板，以及贴身白色战术内衣上细微的战斗磨损纹理。
她的袖子设计夸张，采用质感丰富的粉色丝缎面料，印有醒目的黑色日式字体，并带有细微的做旧细节。她佩戴着黑色战术露指皮手套，缝线真实，呈现哑光碳纤维质感。
下装为高腰炭黑色超大款机能风工装裤，配有实用绑带、悬挂扣、加固接缝和极简的红色点缀。脚穿厚底未来感黄红配色高帮运动鞋，鞋底机械感十足，鞋面层次分明，配有红色鞋带、金属饰边和逼真的橡胶纹理。
面部保持高度写实且自然的美感，可见毛孔、细腻的皮肤纹理、细微的眼下细节、锐利的眼线、高挑的深色眉毛、柔和的哑光红唇以及明亮逼真的双眼。拒绝塑料感皮肤，拒绝 AI 平滑处理，拒绝夸张的动漫特征。表情冷静、冷酷、自信且坚定，微微偏头，营造出一种掌控全局的英雄气场。
拍摄角度为极具张力的低角度英雄视角，强调力量感、比例和电影级姿态。右腿自然伸向地面，上半身微微转向镜头。双手随意地放在车把附近，姿态从容且蓄势待发。
背景为干净的白色高级时尚摄影棚，装饰有醒目的大号红色日文汉字排版，以及如同高端杂志封面般的未来感编辑图形元素。极简的赛博朋克构图，点缀着细微的悬浮式 UI 设计元素。
灯光采用电影级伦勃朗光，柔和的定向主光塑造出面部轮廓和服装褶皱，结合细微的轮廓光将人物轮廓从白色背景中分离出来。金属摩托车表面反射出逼真的高光，营造出摄影棚内的体积感氛围。
使用 Fujifilm GFX 100 II 搭配 85mm f/1.4 镜头拍摄，超浅景深，面部细节锐利，电影级调色，照片级写实材质，做旧金属质感，丝绸面料真实感，牛仔布纹理，橡胶细节，体积光，超高清，8K，大师级品质，时尚编辑摄影，超写实赛博朋克美学。

templates.title: Algerian ID card sample

titleLocalized.zh: 阿尔及利亚身份证样机

templates.prompt: A 16:9 hyperrealistic close-up photograph shows a{argument name="nationality" default="Algerian"} The citizen identity card is placed on a clean, light gray or soft, neutral background. The card is horizontally aligned, centered in the image, and features sharp macro focus with soft, diffused studio lighting. The design follows the aesthetics of official identity documents issued by the Algerian government, employing multilingual typography, engraved security art, and advanced anti-counterfeiting details inspired by modern North African national ID systems. The large, bold title at the top reads: “الجمهورية الجزائرية الديمقراطية الشعبية”, accompanied by the French subtitle “RÉPUBLIQUE ALGÉRIENNE DÉMOCRATIQUE ET POPULAIRE” and the words “CARTE DE CITOYENNETÉ / CITIZENSHIP CARD”. The Algerian flag, with a red crescent and star, is printed in the upper left corner. The Algerian coat of arms is included in the upper right corner. The card features a passport-style portrait of a young Algerian woman: – Warm olive North African skin tone with a natural, authentic look – Medium-length dark brown or black wavy hair – Dark brown eyes with a neutral expression, looking straight ahead – Minimalist makeup, conveying a documentary-like realism – Wearing a dark suit jacket or black dress jacket, and delicate gold jewelry. Personal identification information is displayed in Arabic, French, and English: – اللقب / Nom /{argument name="last name label" default="Surname"} : BENYAHIA – الاسم / Prénom /{argument name="name" default="LEÏLA AMEL"} – تاريخ الميلاد / Date de naissance /{argument name="birth date" default="14 MAI / MAY 1993"} – مكان الميلاد / Lieu de naissance / Place of Birth: ALGER, ALGÉRIE – الجنسية / Nationalité / Nationality: ALGÉRIENNE – رقم المواطنة / Numéro de citoyenneté / Citizenship Number: DZA1234567 – تاريخ الإصدار / Date de délivrance / Date of Issue: 20 MAI / MAY 2024 – تاريخ الانتهاء / Date d'expiration / Date of Expiry: 20 MAI / MAY 2034 – الجنس / Sexe / Sex: F Security and design features include: – Intricate guilloché security lines covering the entire card surface – Finely crafted miniature security texture – holographic security foil with iridescent reflection – transparent layered security overlay – circular “DZA” holographic security stamp – crescent and star holographic patterns integrated into the security elements – Algerian outline map embedded in the background texture – finely engraved illustration of the Algiers skyline and the Martyrs' Monument on the right side – decorative Islamic-style geometric engraving patterns blending into the background – machine-readable identification strip at the bottom edge – bottom signature: “Leïla A. Benyahia” Other design elements: – soft green, white, silver and red gradient inspired by the Algerian flag – polycarbonate laminated card texture with realistic reflective effects and embossed micro-details – modern high-security government document look with engraved banknote-style illustrations. Soft and evenly diffused lighting highlights the holographic effect, engraved texture and realistic printing details without glaring shadows.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张 16:9 的超写实特写摄影作品，展示了一张 {argument name="nationality" default="Algerian"} 公民身份证，放置在干净的浅灰色或柔和的中性背景上。卡片水平对齐，置于画面中心，采用清晰的微距对焦，并配以柔和的漫射摄影棚灯光。

设计遵循阿尔及利亚政府签发的官方身份证件美学，采用多语言排版、雕刻安全艺术图案，以及受现代北非国家 ID 系统启发的高级防伪细节。

顶部的大号粗体标题为：“الجمهورية الجزائرية الديمقراطية الشعبية”，配有法语副标题“RÉPUBLIQUE ALGÉRIENNE DÉMOCRATIQUE ET POPULAIRE”以及“CARTE DE CITOYENNETÉ / CITIZENSHIP CARD”字样。

左上角印有阿尔及利亚国旗，带有红色新月和星形标志。右上角包含阿尔及利亚国徽。

卡片包含一位年轻阿尔及利亚女性的护照风格肖像：
– 温暖的橄榄色北非肤色，具有真实的自然质感
– 中长深棕色或黑色波浪卷发
– 深棕色眼睛，表情中性，直视前方
– 极简妆容，呈现纪实摄影的真实感
– 身着深色西装外套或黑色正装上衣，佩戴精致的金色首饰

个人身份信息以阿拉伯语、法语和英语格式显示：
– اللقب / Nom / {argument name="last name label" default="Surname"}: BENYAHIA
– الاسم / Prénom / {argument name="name" default="LEÏLA AMEL"}
– تاريخ الميلاد / Date de naissance / {argument name="birth date" default="14 MAI / MAY 1993"}
– مكان الميلاد / Lieu de naissance / Place of Birth: ALGER, ALGÉRIE
– الجنسية / Nationalité / Nationality: ALGÉRIENNE
– رقم المواطنة / Numéro de citoyenneté / Citizenship Number: DZA1234567
– تاريخ الإصدار / Date de délivrance / Date of Issue: 20 MAI / MAY 2024
– تاريخ الانتهاء / Date d’expiration / Date of Expiry: 20 MAI / MAY 2034
– الجنس / Sexe / Sex: F

安全与设计特征包括：
– 覆盖整个卡片表面的复杂扭索纹安全线条
– 精细的微缩防伪纹理
– 带有虹彩反射的全息防伪箔片
– 透明的分层安全覆盖层
– 圆形“DZA”全息安全印章
– 集成在安全元素中的新月和星形全息图案
– 嵌入背景纹理中的阿尔及利亚轮廓地图
– 右侧印有阿尔及尔天际线和烈士纪念碑的精细雕刻插图
– 融入背景的装饰性伊斯兰风格几何雕刻图案
– 底部边缘设有机器可读的身份识别条
– 底部签名：“Leïla A. Benyahia”

其他设计风格：
– 受阿尔及利亚国旗启发的柔和绿色、白色、银色和红色渐变
– 聚碳酸酯层压卡片质感，具有逼真的反射效果和浮雕微细节
– 现代高安全性政府证件外观，采用雕刻纸币风格的插图工艺

灯光柔和且均匀漫射，在没有刺眼阴影的情况下，突显了全息效果、雕刻纹理和逼真的印刷细节。

templates.title: Multi-layer Cyborg Modification Prompt

titleLocalized.zh: 多层赛博格改造提示词

templates.prompt: [Main Hint] Based on the character or role in the attached image, preserve as much of their original facial features, eyes, hairstyle, color, expression, body shape, clothing, pose, composition, color scheme, lighting, and background atmosphere as possible, while depicting them as a cyborg entity with an internal mechanical skeleton. While maintaining overall consistency with the original image, peel away portions of the outer skin or surface according to the chosen level of damage to expose artificial muscles, fibrous protective tissue, neural cables, metal frames, joint units, hydraulic mechanisms, circuitry, lighting elements, and precision mechanical parts. Avoid depicting a "precision mechanics tightly packed under a thin layer of skin." The internal structure should be depicted as a multi-layered structure, with a humanoid mechanical skeleton at the center, covered by layers of artificial muscles, neural cables, protective tissue, and outer skin. At damaged areas, artificial muscles or fibrous protective material should be visible behind torn skin, and deeper layers should partially expose the metal frame, joint units, drive units, wiring, and lighting components. Mechanical parts should be naturally arranged along the skeleton, muscles, and joints of the human/character. Avoid making the mechanics appear as if they are simply pasted under the skin. By showing the order of the outer skin, protective layer, artificial muscles, and mechanical skeleton, the damaged areas are given a sense of depth. Skin peeling is depicted as natural tears, curls, fragments, or cracks. Mechanical parts should have high definition and realism, or a texture consistent with the style of the original artwork. Do not turn the whole body into a complete robot; do not lose the charm or identity of the original character. Depict artificial materials, mechanical skeletons, and artificial muscles, rather than biological organs or excessive bleeding. [Damage Level 1: Minor Damage] The appearance is almost identical to the original artwork. Add small cracks, abrasions, and skin peeling to areas such as the face, neck, shoulders, arms, and legs. Behind the peeled skin, artificial muscles, fibrous protective tissue, and fine nerve cables are faintly visible. Deeper, the metal skeleton or small joint parts are only faintly visible. There are no electrical sparks, or only very faint sparks. The first impression is still the original character, but upon closer inspection, it can be clearly seen that its interior is an artificial structure. [Damage Level 2: Moderate Damage] While maintaining the identity of the original character, the cyborg structure is clearly displayed. Add appropriate skin peeling or damage to areas such as the face, neck, shoulders, arms, chest, and legs. In damaged areas, depict the depth of the outer skin, protective layer, artificial muscles, neural cables, and metal skeleton. Naturally arrange the metal frame, artificial muscles, joint units, hydraulic components, control cables, circuitry, and light-emitting components within. Naturally represent the skin peeling, cracks, or fragmented surface materials at the edges of the damaged area. Add subtle electrical sparks or faint glows from internal circuitry. Maintain humanity, character identity, and aesthetics. [Damage Level 3: Severe Damage] Severe damage representation. However, ensure the original character/figure is still recognizable. Large areas of skin are peeled from half the face, especially from one eye to the cheek, exposing artificial muscles, neural cables, mechanical eye structures, and the metal frame. The area around the eyes should not appear as if the machinery is simply piled under the skin; instead, it should present a layered structure where the eye socket, artificial muscles, protective layer, and mechanical eye units are visible. Large areas of skin loss or exposed mechanical skeletons can be added to areas such as the shoulders, arms, chest, and legs. Add crackling electrical sparks, short-circuit discharges, tiny sparks, and glowing broken wires to damaged areas. The internal mechanical structure can exhibit high density, but should have natural gaps and layers, much like the internal structure of the human body. Metal skeletons, joint units, artificial muscles, cables, circuits, light-emitting elements, and hydraulic mechanisms should be clearly visible along the human form. A slightly eerie and tense atmosphere can be created. However, avoid excessive bloodshed, depictions of internal organs, or overly graphic gore. [Negative warnings] Intricate machinery tightly packed under a thin layer of skin; excessively crowded mechanical details under the skin; mechanical parts merely attached to the surface; mechanical placement ignoring human anatomy; complete robotization; becoming another person; facial distortion; significant changes to body shape, hairstyle, clothing, or background; excessive bloodshed; depictions of internal organs; overly graphic gore; unnatural joints; superfluous limbs; distorted faces; low-quality, rough mechanical parts; loss of the original character's characteristics.

promptLocalized.zh:
[主提示词]
基于所附图像中的人物或角色，尽可能保留其原始面部特征、眼睛、发型、颜色、表情、体型、服装、姿势、构图、配色方案、光影及背景氛围，同时将其描绘为具有内部机械骨架的赛博格实体。在保持整体外观与原图一致的前提下，根据所选的损坏程度剥离部分外皮或表面，露出人造肌肉、纤维保护组织、神经电缆、金属框架、关节单元、液压机构、电路、发光元件及精密机械部件。避免表现出“精密机械紧密堆积在薄薄一层皮肤下”的感觉。内部结构应描绘为多层结构，中心为类人机械骨架，外层依次覆盖人造肌肉、神经电缆、保护组织和外皮。在损坏部位，撕裂的皮肤后应可见人造肌肉或纤维保护材料，更深处则应部分显露金属框架、关节单元、驱动单元、布线及发光部件。机械部件应沿着人体/角色的骨架、肌肉和关节走向自然排布。不要让机械看起来像是简单地贴在皮肤下面。通过显示外皮、保护层、人造肌肉和机械骨架的顺序，赋予损坏区域深度感。将皮肤剥离描绘为自然的撕裂、卷曲、碎片或裂纹。机械部件应具有高清晰度和真实感，或与原图风格相符的质感。不要将全身变成完全的机器人；不要失去原角色的魅力或身份。描绘人造材料、机械骨架和人造肌肉，而非生物器官或过度流血的画面。

[损坏程度 1：轻度损坏]
外观与原图几乎保持一致。在面部、颈部、肩部、手臂、腿部等部位添加细小的裂纹、擦伤和皮肤剥离。在剥离的皮肤后，人造肌肉、纤维保护组织和细小的神经电缆隐约可见。更深处，金属骨架或小型关节部件仅微弱可见。没有电火花，或仅有极微弱的火花。第一印象仍是原人物/角色，但仔细观察后，可以清楚地发现其内部是人造结构。

[损坏程度 2：中度损坏]
在保持原人物/角色身份的同时，清晰地展示赛博格结构。在面部、颈部、肩部、手臂、胸部、腿部等部位添加适度的皮肤剥离或损坏。在损坏部位，描绘出外皮、保护层、人造肌肉、神经电缆和金属骨架的深度感。在内部自然地排列金属框架、人造肌肉、关节单元、液压部件、控制电缆、电路和发光部件。自然地表现损坏区域边缘的皮肤剥离、裂纹或碎裂的表面材料。可添加微弱的电火花或内部电路发出的微光。保留人性、角色身份和美感。

[损坏程度 3：重度损坏]
重度损坏表现。但需确保仍能辨认出原图中的人物/角色。大面积皮肤从半张脸上剥离，特别是从一只眼睛到脸颊的区域，露出人造肌肉、神经电缆、机械眼结构和金属框架。眼部周围不应看起来像机械直接堆积在皮肤下，而应呈现出眼眶框架、人造肌肉、保护层和机械眼单元分层可见的结构。可在肩部、手臂、胸部、腿部等部位添加大面积皮肤缺失或机械骨架暴露。在损坏部位，添加噼啪作响的电火花、短路放电、细小火花以及发光的断裂电线。内部机械结构可表现出高密度，但应具有自然的间隙和层次，如同人体内部结构一般。金属骨架、关节单元、人造肌肉、电缆、电路、发光元件和液压机构应沿着人体结构清晰可见。可以营造略带诡异和紧张的氛围。但要避免过度流血、内脏描绘或过于强烈的血腥表现。

[负面提示词]
精密机械紧密堆积在薄薄一层皮肤下、皮肤下过度拥挤的机械细节、机械部件仅贴在表面、无视人体结构的机械放置、全身完全机器人化、变成另一个人、面部崩坏、体型、发型、服装或背景的重大改变、过度流血、内脏描绘、过于强烈的血腥表现、不自然的关节、多余的肢体、扭曲的面部、低质量、粗糙的机械部件、失去原角色特征。
