templates.title: Nagoya Sakae Ward Watercolor Travel Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 名古屋荣区水彩旅行海报

templates.prompt: Create a vertical travel poster illustration with the theme of{argument name="location title" default="SAKAE, NAGOYA"} This painting, rendered in a delicate watercolor and ink urban sketch style against a warm off-white textured paper background, depicts a vibrant street intersection in Sakae Ward, Nagoya, Japan. Seen from a pedestrian perspective, it possesses a strong sense of depth and perspective. In the left foreground, a charming old-fashioned corner café is depicted, its walls a weathered cream color, complete with a black awning, large windows, cozy indoor seating, potted plants, climbing vines, and a green bicycle parked on the side of the road. The café's sign is clearly visible: "KAKUOZAN LARDER," "BLEND," and "COFFEE." Outside, a small blackboard reads "COFFEE / SANDWICH / and / GOOD MUSIC," and features a small coffee cup. In the center of the background, the Nagoya TV Tower stands clearly above the trees and city buildings. The right side showcases modern elevated glass and metal transportation infrastructure, streetlights, traffic lights, "Sakae" signs, road markings, bicycles, and pedestrians crossing a wide zebra crossing. In the center foreground below, add a woman seen from behind, wearing a light beige long coat and carrying a brown shoulder bag, walking into the city. Add many small pedestrians, but maintain a sketch-like feel and atmosphere. Use delicate black pen lines, light gray shadows, soft blue-gray architectural tones, soft green vegetation, and restrained color rendering, leaving ample white space. Poster layout: In the upper right corner, set a large bracket title "[{argument name="location title" default="SAKAE, NAGOYA"} The title is in an elegant, high-serif capital font. Below it, a handwritten subtitle is added.{argument name="subtitle" default="Everyday Urban Rhythm"} Add a thin horizontal line and the small capital letters "SAKAE, NAKA WARD, NAGOYA, JAPAN". Further to the right, add a compact quotation block: "A CITY THAT BLENDS / TRADITION AND INNOVATION, / PEOPLE AND CULTURE, / IN PERFECT HARMONY." At the bottom left edge, add a small circular travel stamp with the text "NAGOYA / 娜古屋 / JAPAN". Keep the composition airy, refined, editorial, and printable; photorealistic is not required, and avoid adding extra text.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张竖版旅行海报插画，主题为 {argument name="location title" default="SAKAE, NAGOYA"}，采用精致的水彩与墨水城市速写风格，背景为温暖的米白色纹理纸。画面展示了日本名古屋荣区一个充满活力的街头十字路口，从人行道视角呈现，具有强烈的深度透视感。左侧前景绘制一座迷人的老式街角咖啡馆，墙面为风化的奶油色，配有黑色遮阳篷、大窗户、温馨的室内座位、盆栽植物、攀爬的绿叶藤蔓，以及停在路边的一辆绿色自行车；包含清晰可见的咖啡馆招牌：“KAKUOZAN LARDER”、“BLEND” 和 “COFFEE”。在店外放置一块写有 “COFFEE / SANDWICH / and / GOOD MUSIC” 的小黑板，并绘有一个小咖啡杯。远景中心处，名古屋电视塔清晰地耸立在树木和城市建筑之上。右侧展示现代化的架空玻璃金属交通设施、路灯、交通信号灯、“Sakae” 标志、道路标线、自行车以及走在宽阔斑马线上的行人。在下方中心前景处，加入一位从背后看去的女性，身穿浅米色长外套，背着棕色单肩包，正走进城市。添加许多小行人，但保持速写感和氛围感。使用细腻的黑色钢笔线条、淡灰色阴影、柔和的蓝灰色建筑色调、柔和的绿色植被，以及克制的色彩渲染，并留出大量空白。

海报排版：在右上角，设置大号括号标题 “[{argument name="location title" default="SAKAE, NAGOYA"}]”，采用优雅的高衬线大写字体。在其下方，添加手写体副标题 “{argument name="subtitle" default="Everyday Urban Rhythm"}”、一条细横线以及小号大写文字 “SAKAE, NAKA WARD, NAGOYA, JAPAN”。在更右侧，添加一个紧凑的引语块：“A CITY THAT BLENDS / TRADITION AND INNOVATION, / PEOPLE AND CULTURE, / IN PERFECT HARMONY.” 在左下角边缘，添加一个小圆形的旅行印章，文字为 “NAGOYA / 名古屋 / JAPAN”。保持构图空灵、精致、具有编辑感且适合印刷，无需照片级真实感，也不要添加额外文字。

templates.title: Anime Wedding Dress Series Design Drawings

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫婚纱系列设计图

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="character name" default="Summer Festival"} Create a highly detailed design for an anime wedding dress series, using a bright tropical beach bride theme, combining a large full-body fashion illustration with a catalog/specification layout on the right. Canvas: Vertical 3:4 poster with a divided composition. The left half features the full-body key visual illustration; the right half showcases the elegant cream-white wedding dress series items. Use gorgeous thin gold borders, floral corner decorations, and soft watercolor textures to create a luxurious idol merchandise/fashion reference style. Left-side key visual illustration: Showing a young anime idol bride standing on a sunny beach path, with turquoise waters and a clear blue sky as the background. She has {argument name="hair color" default="warm light brown"} Her hair is styled in twin ponytails with curled ahoge, one side tied into a large ponytail. She wears a sheer veil, white floral hair accessories, a green and gold striped ribbon, and a small black and white mascot hair accessory. Her face is covered with soft, beige blurred squares, consistent with the generated image. She wears a short, ruffled, off-the-shoulder white wedding dress, the short top revealing her waist, paired with a multi-layered pleated skirt, a sheer lace overlay/train, green gemstone embellishments, pearl and gold chain details, a white floral waist ornament, long light green and yellow ribbons, ankle-strap wedding shoes, and a small thigh-high floral garter. She poses standing on one leg with the other knee bent, holding a round bouquet of white, cream, and light yellow roses, adorned with green leaves and cascading green/yellow ribbons. Tropical palm leaves, white and yellow flowers, floating petals, and shimmering sunlight create a bright and romantic summer atmosphere. The right-hand section features an elegant, large serif gold title at the top: "WEDDING DRESS," followed by a cursive subtitle: "Collection." Below that is written "..."{argument name="collection subtitle" default="Summer Festival Wedding Dress Style 2024"} The main panel features a smaller line of Japanese text: "夏色まつりブライダルスタイル2024". It adopts an elegant wedding invitation style, with gold patterns, tiny star decorations, and a cream background. The main reference panel contains three tall, framed full-body views in the upper right area, labeled "FRONT", "SIDE", and "BACK". FRONT shows the bride holding her bouquet with one leg raised; SIDE shows the side view, including the bouquet, veil, ribbons, and short, multi-tiered train; BACK shows the back view, emphasizing the off-the-shoulder design, tied waist, sheer lace train, and the bouquet on the side. The face on the front panel is also softly blurred. The detail panel contains six smaller framed detail cards below the main view, arranged in a 3x2 grid, labeled as follows: 1) "BOUQUET" shows a bouquet of roses with green/yellow ribbons; 2) "SHOULDER & “MIDRIFF” showcases off-the-shoulder ruffled necklines, floral embellishments, cropped tops, and exposed waists; 3) “TRAIN & LACE” showcases sheer lace, multi-tiered trains, and long ribbons; 4) “SHOES” showcases white wedding dress sandals with ankle-length floral embellishments; 5) “BACK STYLE” showcases the back of the wedding dress, off-the-shoulder designs, pleats, veils, and waist ornaments; 6) “RIBBON DETAIL” showcases large waist floral embellishments and striped green/yellow ribbon ends. Add brief Japanese descriptive text below each card, keeping it decorative and not overly eye-catching. Bottom Area: Create a framed “Design Point” box in the lower left corner containing four brief Japanese points, and a “Color Palette” with six circular color blocks: white, light cream/yellow, light green, mint green, sky blue, and gold glitter. Create a framed message card in the lower right corner titled “~ Just for You, My Darling”. ♡, containing several lines of romantic Japanese messages, a signature "— Natsuiro Matsuri♡", adorned with small pink hearts, and a half-body portrait of the same character in the lower right corner, with the face softly blurred. Other visible text: A short white Japanese quote is added to the sky above the main visual illustration, roughly meaning "May the sea breeze sway your ribbon, may the sun shine brightly today~♡". All text should blend naturally, like a beautiful Japanese anime fashion magazine page. Visual style: High-quality anime illustration, delicate lines, soft watercolor rendering, bright beach lighting, soft lighting effects, intricate lace and ruffle details, elegant gold typography, gorgeous wedding invitation borders, floral decorations, simple table of contents layout, high detail, non-realistic feel. Constraints: Use 1 large main visual character, 3 main reference view panels, 6 detail cards, 6 color blocks, and 1 A half-body portrait in the bottom right corner. Keep the face a blurred square in the description area. No additional characters, logos, or watermarks are allowed.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="夏色祭"} 创建一张高度精细的动漫婚纱系列设计图，采用明亮的热带海滨新娘主题，将大型全身时尚插画与右侧的目录/规格布局相结合。

画布：竖版 3:4 海报，采用分割构图。左半部分为全身主视觉插画；右半部分为优雅的奶油白色婚纱系列项目。使用华丽的细金边框、花卉边角装饰、柔和的水彩质感，营造出奢华的偶像周边/时尚参考图风格。

左侧主视觉插画：展示一位年轻的动漫偶像新娘，站在阳光明媚的海滩小径上，背景是绿松石色的海水和湛蓝的天空。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="暖浅棕色"} 的双马尾，带有卷曲的呆毛，一侧扎着大马尾，佩戴透明头纱、白色花朵发饰、绿金条纹丝带以及一个小巧的黑白吉祥物发饰。她的面部区域覆盖着柔和的米色模糊方块，与生成的图像保持一致。她穿着一件短款荷叶边露肩白色婚纱，短款上衣露出腰部，搭配多层褶皱裙摆、透明蕾丝罩裙/裙拖、绿色宝石点缀、珍珠和金链细节、白色花朵腰饰、长长的浅绿色和黄色丝带、脚踝系带婚鞋，以及一个小巧的大腿花朵袜带。姿势为单腿站立，另一条腿膝盖弯曲，手中拿着一束由白色、奶油色和浅黄色玫瑰组成的圆形花束，配以绿叶和垂下的绿/黄色丝带。周围环绕着热带棕榈叶、白色和黄色花朵、漂浮的花瓣、闪烁的阳光，营造出明亮浪漫的夏日氛围。

右侧系列项目：顶部使用优雅的大号衬线金色标题文字：“WEDDING DRESS”，下方配有草书副标题“Collection”。在下方写上“{argument name="collection subtitle" default="夏色祭 婚纱风格 2024"}”以及一行较小的日文“夏色まつり ブライダルスタイル 2024”。采用精致的婚礼请柬风格，配以金色花纹、微小的星星装饰和奶油色背景。

主要参考面板：在右上区域包含 3 个高大的带框全身视图，分别标注为“FRONT”（正面）、“SIDE”（侧面）和“BACK”（背面）。FRONT 展示新娘正面手持花束、单腿抬起的姿态；SIDE 展示侧面视图，包括花束、头纱、丝带和短款多层裙摆；BACK 展示背面视图，强调露肩设计、系带腰部、透明蕾丝裙拖以及侧面的花束。正面面板的面部同样经过柔和模糊处理。

细节面板：在主视图下方包含 6 个较小的带框细节卡片，采用 3x2 网格排列，标注如下：1) “BOUQUET”展示带有绿/黄色丝带的玫瑰花束；2) “SHOULDER & MIDRIFF”展示露肩荷叶边领口、花朵装饰、短款上衣和露出的腰部；3) “TRAIN & LACE”展示透明蕾丝、多层裙拖和长丝带；4) “SHOES”展示带有脚踝花朵装饰的系带白色婚纱高跟凉鞋；5) “BACK STYLE”展示婚纱背面、露肩设计、褶皱、头纱和腰饰；6) “RIBBON DETAIL”展示大型腰部花朵装饰和条纹绿/黄色丝带尾部。在每张卡片下方添加简短的日文说明文字，保持装饰性，不宜过于抢眼。

底部区域：在左下角创建一个带框的“Design Point”（设计要点）方框，包含四条简短的日文要点，以及一行包含 6 个圆形色块的“Color Palette”（配色方案）：白色、浅奶油/黄色、浅绿色、薄荷绿、天蓝色和金色闪粉。在右下角创建一个带框的留言卡，标题为“~ Just for You, My Darling ♡”，包含几行日文浪漫留言，一行签名“— 夏色祭 ♡”，点缀小粉心，并在右下角放置一张同一角色的半身肖像，面部经过柔和模糊处理。

其他可见文字：在主视觉插画左上方的天空中添加一小段白色日文引语，内容约为“海風にリボンを揺らして、今日は太陽ぐらい私で煌えにいくよ〜♡”。所有文字需像精美的日本动漫时尚杂志页面一样自然融合。

视觉风格：高级动漫插画，细腻的线条，柔和的水彩渲染，明亮的海滩光影，柔光效果，复杂的蕾丝和褶皱细节，优雅的金色排版，华丽的婚礼请柬边框，花卉装饰，简洁的目录布局，高细节，无写实感。

约束条件：使用 1 个大型主视觉角色，3 个主要参考视图面板，6 个细节卡片，6 个色块，以及 1 个右下角半身肖像。在描述的位置保持面部模糊方块。不得包含额外角色、Logo 或水印。

templates.title: Anime Wedding Dress Series Design Project

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫婚纱系列设计项目

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="character name" default="Aki Rosenthal"} Create an exquisite anime-style wedding dress series design project, presented as an elegant wedding fashion showcase. Canvas: Vertical 4:5 poster, warm ivory parchment background, delicate and luxurious gold trim with floral accents, and soft rose petals scattered around the page. Employ a highly detailed romantic anime illustration style, soft lighting, delicate lines, and a luxurious wedding magazine layout. Header: The top features the title "WEDDING DRESS" in large gold serif font, while the right side displays "Collection" in flowing pink cursive. A subtitle "-" is added below.{argument name="character name" default="Aki Rosenthal"} Bridal Style 2024 - and a short, small gray Japanese-style decorative slogan. Main subject: On the left is a large full-body wedding illustration depicting a long-haired, blonde, elfin-style anime bride in a rose garden aisle. She is dressed in a romantic {argument name="dress color" default="Light blush in ivory color"} The wedding dress features an off-the-shoulder corset, sheer lace sleeves, a layered asymmetrical ruffled skirt, and a high slit. It is complemented by a floor-length veil, rose hair accessories, burgundy rose embellishments, ribbons, lace embroidery, and jewelry details. She holds a bouquet of red, pink, and ivory roses tied with a long burgundy ribbon. Her hair is exceptionally long, flowing gold, with soft curls and floral accessories. The face should be appropriately simplified or slightly obscured to maintain focus on the dress design. Background: A sunlit rose archway, a pebble path, floating petals, and a dreamy blurred effect. Right-side layout: Contains nine bordered reference panels arranged in a neat, stylish grid. The top row has three tall panels labeled "Front," "Side," and "Back," showcasing the corresponding perspective of the dress. Below are six small detail panels labeled "Bouquet," "Rose Motif," "Bodice," "Veil & Lace," "Shoes," and "Back Style." Each detail panel should display: a close-up of the bouquet, a close-up of the rose motif and ribbon at the waist, a close-up of the bodice, a close-up of the veil and lace, a close-up of lace high heels adorned with roses, and a close-up of the back bodice with a large rose decoration. The bottom information area includes four cream-colored cards with gold borders. Card 1, "Design Point," contains three key points with small burgundy rose icons. Card 2, "Color Palette," contains five circular color swatches labeled in Japanese small print: rose red, burgundy, rose pink, ivory, and champagne gold. Card 3, "Rose & Elegance," includes a small rose illustration and a brief, poetic description of the wedding dress. Card 4, “Message from Aki,” contains a short, handwritten note and the signature “Aki Rosenthal.” The bottom, centered footer reads “Aki Rosenthal Bridal Collection.” Visual Style: A combination of soft watercolor anime rendering and exquisite fashion illustrations; a glamorous Victorian-style wedding catalog design; warm cream paper; gold typography; soft burgundy roses; blush pink fabrics; semi-transparent lace; elegant shadows; high detail; delicate highlights; and no harsh contrasts. Constraints: Maintain a precise number of panels: 1 main illustration, 3 view panels, 6 detail panels, 4 bottom cards, 5 color swatches, and 3 design notes. Use readable, decorative English headings. Avoid logos, watermarks, modern UI elements, or superfluous characters.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="Aki Rosenthal"} 创建一个精致的动漫婚纱系列设计项目，呈现为一张优雅的婚纱时尚展示页。

画布：垂直 4:5 海报，暖象牙色羊皮纸背景，带有花卉边角装饰的纤细华丽金边，页面周围散落着柔和的玫瑰花瓣。采用高细节浪漫动漫插画风格，柔和光影，细腻线条，奢华婚纱杂志排版。

页眉：顶部为金色大号衬线字体标题“WEDDING DRESS”，右侧为流动的粉色草书“Collection”。下方添加副标题“- {argument name="character name" default="Aki Rosenthal"} Bridal Style 2024 -”以及一行简短的灰色小字日式装饰标语。

主体：左侧为一张大型全身婚纱插画，描绘了一位长发金发的精灵系动漫新娘，身处玫瑰花园通道中。她穿着浪漫的 {argument name="dress color" default="淡腮红象牙色"} 婚纱，采用露肩紧身胸衣、透明蕾丝袖、层叠不对称荷叶边裙摆、高开叉设计，配有拖地头纱、玫瑰发饰、酒红色玫瑰点缀、丝带、蕾丝刺绣和珠宝细节。她手捧一束由红、粉、象牙色玫瑰组成的花束，系着长长的酒红色丝带。她的头发极长，呈流动的金色，带有柔和的卷曲和花卉配饰。面部应适当简化或轻微遮挡，以保持对婚纱设计的关注。背景：阳光明媚的玫瑰拱门、石子路、漂浮的花瓣、梦幻的虚化效果。

右侧布局：包含 9 个带边框的参考面板，排列成整洁的时尚规格网格。顶行有 3 个高面板，分别标注为“Front”（正面）、“Side”（侧面）和“Back”（背面），展示该婚纱的对应视角。下方有 6 个小细节面板，分别标注为“Bouquet”（花束）、“Rose Motif”（玫瑰图案）、“Bodice”（胸衣）、“Veil & Lace”（头纱与蕾丝）、“Shoes”（鞋子）和“Back Style”（背部款式）。细节面板应展示：1 个花束特写、1 个腰部玫瑰图案与丝带特写、1 个胸衣特写、1 个头纱与蕾丝特写、1 个带玫瑰装饰的蕾丝高跟鞋特写，以及 1 个后背胸衣与大型玫瑰装饰特写。

底部信息区：添加 4 张带金框的奶油色卡片。卡片 1 “Design Point”（设计要点）包含 3 个带小型酒红色玫瑰图标的要点。卡片 2 “Color Palette”（调色板）包含 5 个圆形色样，并用日式小字标注：玫瑰红、酒红、玫瑰粉、象牙白和香槟金。卡片 3 “Rose & Elegance”（玫瑰与优雅）包含一幅小型玫瑰插画和一段简短的诗意婚纱描述。卡片 4 “Message from Aki”（来自 Aki 的寄语）包含一段简短的手写风格笔记和签名“Aki Rosenthal”。底部居中页脚文字为“Aki Rosenthal Bridal Collection”。

视觉风格：柔和的水彩动漫渲染与精致的时尚插画相结合，华丽的维多利亚风格婚纱目录设计，暖奶油色纸张，金色排版，柔和的酒红色玫瑰，腮红粉色面料，半透明蕾丝，优雅的阴影，高细节，细腻的高光，无生硬对比。

约束：保持精确的面板数量：1 个主插画，3 个视图面板，6 个细节面板，4 张底部卡片，5 个色样，以及 3 个设计要点。使用可读的装饰性英文标题。避免使用徽标、水印、现代 UI 元素或多余字符。

templates.title: Kai Ren Sci-Fi Character Design Collection

titleLocalized.zh: Kai Ren 科幻角色设定集

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="character name" default="KAI REN"} Create a high-density, dark sci-fi character concept project. He is a post-apocalyptic "Smoke Trail" swordsman and tactical squad leader, presented in a hardcore AAA game artbook style. Canvas: Vertical character design project with a weathered gray concrete paper texture background, approximately 4:5 aspect ratio. Use charcoal black, gunmetal, ash, oxidized brown, and matte steel tones. Add rain, dust, scratches, ink splatters, technical grid lines, thin white dividing lines, and small archival typography. Main Layout: Place a full-body hero illustration occupying approximately 45% of the canvas height and covering most of the left column on the left. The character faces forward, with a relaxed yet menacing pose, wearing layers of black tactical rags, armored leather plates, belts, heavy boots, gloves, a scarf, a hooded collar, hanging tattered coat trim, and a bulky cylindrical jetpack or propulsion pack. Hair is messy black spiky. The face should be obscured or in shadow. Includes a long, smoke-marked blade or a sheathed weapon integrated into the equipment. A large, black, circular brushstroke halo is added behind the hero. Archive text on the left: Name in the upper left corner.{argument name="character name" default="KAI REN"} Add a character line below: "Squad Leader / Smoke-Tracking Swordsman". Include two quotes:{argument name="quote one" default="I read the smoke."} and{argument name="quote two" default="I cut the path."} Add a small profile field: Role: Squad Leader/Tactician/Pathfinder; Affiliation: None - Slum Alliance; Status: Active; Height: 6'0" / 183 cm; Weight: 72 kg / 159 lbs; Age: 24; Description: A short paragraph describing his birth in the lower rungs of Yor City, surviving by deciphering the city's smoke patterns, a warrior and pathfinder who leads his squad with ruthless intuition and fluctuating loyalty. Below, add a simple, angular faction insignia and a signature-like mark. Top row body views: Contain four smaller full-body views at the top center and right, labeled "Front," "Side," "Back," and "3/4 View." Show the same clothing from each angle, emphasizing layered armor, tattered coat stripes, backpack canisters, straps, boots, and silhouette. Middle Panel: Create a rectangular "Close-up Portrait" panel showcasing the head and upper body, including messy black hair, scarf, armor belts, earpieces, and a face obscured/shadowed. Next to it, create a "Smoke Trail Skills" section containing 6 illustrated skill cards arranged in a 2-column, 3-row grid. Label these 6 cards as: "Smoke Sense," "Path Reveal," "Air Cut," "Trajectory Cut," "Smoke Step," and "Smoke Line." Each card should depict a small, cinematic action scene, with the character moving through a dark, rainy night city or battlefield, while glowing white smoke trails, arcs, map-like paths, or cutting lines swirl around them. Equipment & Details Panel: Add 6 clothing and material close-up bars labeled "Primary Fabric," "Scarf Armor," "Sling Belts," "Jetpack Backplate," "Multi-Purpose Bag," and "Edge Stitching." Add a "Cybernetics & Interfaces" panel containing 4 close-ups labeled "Neck Implant," "Time Node," "HUD Projector," and "Arm Implant." Add a "Footwear" panel containing 4 close-ups. Add a boot view labeled "Front," "Side," "Back," and "Sole." Add a "Jetpack/Propulsion Pack" panel showing front and rear technical views with labels for the compact thruster, fuel cell, vector nozzles, stabilizing fins, and harness system. Add a "Weapon: Smokeblade" panel showing a modular longblade and five separate components labeled "Monomolecular Blade Custom," "Power Coil," "Sheath," "Smoke Line," and "Core Module." Add an "Accessories & Gear" row containing seven objects labeled "Smoke Beacon," "Climbing Hook," "Pulse Dart," "Reconnaissance Drone," "Data Chip," "Survival Kit," and "Water Filter." Add a "Jetpack Silhouette & Motion" panel containing four dynamic flight or jump silhouettes with smoke trails. Bottom bar: Includes a small "Notes" box listing concise points about growing up in Ash Rungs, surviving by reading the wind, weapons hidden in blades and paracords, valuing freedom and loyalty, and leading with wisdom rather than violence. Includes a "Color Scheme" with eight... Each vertical color swatch is categorized into: near black, charcoal black, dark slate, worn brown, rust, light ash, cool gray-blue, and deep navy black. A "Material/Surface Finish Guide" is included with seven texture swatches labeled "Scorched Leather," "Oilcloth," "Carbon Fiber Texture," "Metal Wear," "Reactive Fabric," "Reinforced Composites," and "Smoke Weave." A "Squad Background: Smoke Walkers" panel is added in the lower right corner, featuring three small, standing characters. Visual Style: High-detail cinematic concept art, dark cyberpunk wasteland style, hardcore realistic rendering, technically produced design sketches, dense but organized annotations, thin white labels, rain-dappled textures, high-contrast metallic highlights, realistic fabric wear, heavy boots, straps, buckles, rivets, scratches, and a smoky, supernatural energy. All text remains in English, small and graphic-like, without any logos or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="KAI REN"} 创建一份高密度的暗黑科幻角色概念项目，他是一位末日后的“烟迹”剑客兼战术小队队长，呈现出硬核 AAA 游戏美术集风格。

画布：纵向角色设计项目，背景为风化的灰色混凝土纸质纹理，长宽比约为 4:5。使用炭黑、枪金属色、灰烬色、氧化棕和哑光钢色调。添加雨水、灰尘、划痕、墨迹飞溅、技术网格线、细白色分割线以及小型档案排版。

主布局：在左侧放置一个占据画布高度约 45% 且位于左栏大部分区域的主体全身英雄插画。角色面向前方，姿势放松但充满危险感，身穿层叠的黑色战术破布、装甲皮革板、束带、厚重靴子、手套、围巾、兜帽式衣领、悬垂的碎裂外套饰片，以及一个笨重的圆柱形喷气背包或推进背包。头发为凌乱的黑色尖刺状。面部应被遮挡或处于阴影中。包含一把长长的烟迹刃或集成在装备中的鞘装武器。在英雄人物后方，添加一个巨大的黑色圆形笔触光环。

左侧档案文字：在左上角写上名字 {argument name="character name" default="KAI REN"}。下方添加角色行“小队队长 / 烟迹剑客”。包含两句引言：{argument name="quote one" default="I read the smoke."} 和 {argument name="quote two" default="I cut the path."}。添加小型档案字段：角色：小队队长 / 战术家 / 探路者；隶属：无派系 - 贫民窟联盟；状态：现役；身高：6'0" / 183 cm；体重：72 kg / 159 lbs；年龄：24；简介：一段简短的段落，描述他出生于 Yor City 的底层，靠解读城市的烟雾流向生存，是一位以冷酷直觉和不稳定忠诚度领导队伍的战士兼探路者。下方添加一个简单的棱角分明的派系徽章和类似签名的标记。

顶部行身体视图：在上方中心和右侧，包含 4 个较小的全身视图，分别标注为“正面”、“侧面”、“背面”和“3/4 视图”。从每个角度展示相同的服装，强调层叠装甲、破烂的外套条纹、背包罐、束带、靴子和轮廓。

中间面板：创建一个矩形的“特写肖像”面板，展示头部和上半身，包括凌乱的黑发、围巾、装甲束带、耳部设备以及被遮挡/阴影覆盖的面部。旁边创建一个“烟迹技能”部分，包含 6 张插图技能卡，排列为 2 列 3 行的网格。标注这 6 张卡片为：“烟雾感知”、“路径揭示”、“空气切割”、“轨迹切割”、“烟雾步”和“烟雾线”。每张卡片应展示一个小型的电影感动作场景，角色在黑暗的雨夜城市或战场中移动，同时发光的白色烟雾轨迹、弧线、地图般的路径或切割线在他周围盘旋。

装备与细节面板：添加 6 个服装和材质特写条，标注为“主要面料”、“围巾装甲”、“背带束带”、“喷气背包背板”、“多功能袋”和“边缘缝合”。添加一个“控制论与接口”面板，包含 4 个特写，标注为“颈部植入物”、“时间节点”、“HUD 投影仪”和“手臂植入物”。添加一个“鞋类”面板，包含 4 个靴子视图，标注为“正面”、“侧面”、“背面”和“鞋底”。添加一个“喷气背包 / 推进背包”面板，展示前后技术视图，并带有紧凑型推进器、燃料电池、矢量喷嘴、稳定鳍和背带系统的标注。添加一个“武器：烟迹刃”面板，展示一把模块化长刃和 5 个分离组件，标注为“单分子刃定制”、“动力线圈”、“刀鞘”、“烟雾线”和“核心模块”。添加一个“配件与装备”行，包含 7 个物体，标注为“烟雾信标”、“攀爬钩”、“脉冲飞镖”、“侦察无人机”、“数据芯片”、“生存套件”和“滤水器”。添加一个“喷气背包轮廓与运动”面板，包含 4 个带有烟雾轨迹的动态飞行或跳跃剪影。

底部条：包含一个小的“备注”框，列出几条关于在 Ash Rungs 成长、通过读风生存、隐藏在刀刃和伞绳中的武器、重视自由与忠诚、以智慧而非暴力领导的简洁要点。包含一个“配色方案”，带有 8 个垂直色块：近黑、炭黑、深板岩色、磨损棕、锈皮色、浅灰烬色、冷灰蓝色和深海军黑。包含一个“材质/表面处理指南”，带有 7 个纹理色块，标注为“烧焦皮革”、“油布”、“碳纤维纹理”、“金属磨损”、“反应性布料”、“增强复合材料”和“烟雾编织”。在右下角添加一个“小队背景：烟雾行者”面板，包含 3 个站立的小型角色人物。

视觉风格：高细节电影感概念艺术，暗黑赛博朋克废土时尚，硬核写实渲染，技术生产设计图，密集但有序的注释，细白色标签，雨点斑驳的纹理，高对比度金属高光，逼真的面料磨损，厚重靴子、束带、扣环、铆钉、划痕和烟雾缭绕的超自然能量。保持所有文字为英文，小巧且具有图表感，不含任何标志或水印。

templates.title: Anime Wedding Dress Series Showcase Page

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫婚纱系列展示页

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="character name" default="Akai Haato"} Create a highly detailed showcase of a pastel-colored anime wedding dress series, referencing the design style of luxury wedding dress catalogs. Canvas: Vertical poster, 3:4 aspect ratio, soft cream and pale pink background, ornate gold filigree border, creating an atmosphere of a romantic rose garden and arched church windows, embellished with shimmering light, falling petals, and delicate lace textures. Layout: Divide the poster into a large full-body illustration on the left and a structured, formatted project on the right. Add a title and brand area in the upper right corner, a small signature/logo area in the upper left corner, a detail panel in the center of the right side, and information boxes at the bottom. Main subject: The left side displays a full-body anime bride wearing an exquisite white and pale pink wedding dress, exuding a strong {argument name="accent color" default="Deep rose red"} The character has long, pink-streaked blonde hair, wears a floral crown, a semi-transparent veil covered with tiny red bows and heart patterns, and a layered lace-trimmed, ruffled, high-low skirt, complemented by red ribbons, garter belt details, and strappy white platform wedding heels. She holds a large bouquet of roses. The pose is elegantly standing with one leg extended forward, the bouquet resting at her waist. The face remains a smooth, light peach-colored blank rectangle, devoid of facial features. Wedding Dress Design: The dress is a cute Gothic Lolita style gown: sweetheart neckline, off-the-shoulder lace sleeves, corset-like red ribbon ties, numerous small bows, heart pendants, fan-shaped lace, layered ruffles, asymmetrical high-low skirt, long train, and a dramatic veil. The bouquet includes red roses, cream roses, pale pink roses, a few green plants, and cascading burgundy ribbons. Right-side Detail Panel: Below the title are 9 framed detail panels arranged in a 3x3 grid. The following labels are used in English and accompanied by small hearts: 1) FRONT, showing the full front view of the wedding dress; 2) SIDE, showing the side profile and train; 3) BACK, showing the long veil, back bow, and train; 4) BOUQUET, a close-up of the rose bouquet; 5) BODICE, a close-up of the corset, lace, and red bow; 6) VEIL & RIBBONS, a close-up of the semi-transparent veil fabric with red bows and heart embellishments; 7) SHOES, a close-up of white platform heels with red ribbons; 8) HEART MOTIF, a close-up of heart pendants, lace, pearls, and bows; 9) BACK STYLE, a close-up of the large back bow and layered back skirt. The top text features a large, elegant serif title “WEDDING DRESS”, accompanied by a cursive subtitle “Collection”. Below is a ribbon banner that reads…{argument name="collection banner" default="Akai Haato Bridal Style 2024"} The logo features heart-shaped icons at both ends. A short, romantic Japanese slogan in a decorative font is added below, without being overly clear. The brand text on the left is "Akai Haato" in pink cursive script in the upper left corner, accompanied by a small heart. The bottom area contains three information zones. On the left is a bordered "DESIGN POINT" box containing five short phrases and heart-shaped bullet points, describing lace, heart patterns, ribbon bows, high and low hems, and princess-like sweetness. In the center is a "COLOR PALETTE" box containing five heart-shaped color blocks labeled Pure White, Bride Red, Baby Pink, Rose Pink, and Antique Rose. On the right is a romantic signature area with "With Love," followed by "Akai Haato" in large cursive script, and a small wax seal and ribbon badge in the lower right corner. Visual style: High-quality anime illustrations, Japanese idol character projects, romantic wedding dress catalogs, soft watercolor lighting, and a clean and elegant UI. Borders, pink and ivory tones, gold accents, floral border details, delicate lace detailing, and a glossy, magazine-quality finish. Constraints: All main titles and labels must be in English. The poster should be information-rich yet elegant. It must include one full-body bride, nine right-side detail panels, three bottom information areas, and five color blocks. Avoid realistic styles and modern minimalist designs, and do not add any extra characters.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="Akai Haato"} 创作一张高度精细的淡彩动漫婚纱系列展示页，设计风格参考奢华婚纱目录页面。

画布：竖向海报，3:4 比例，柔和的奶油色与淡粉色背景，华丽的金色花丝边框，营造浪漫玫瑰花园与拱形教堂窗户的氛围，点缀闪烁光芒、飘落花瓣及精致蕾丝纹理。

布局：将海报分为左侧的大型全身主插画和右侧的结构化规格项目。在右上角添加标题和品牌区域，左上角设置小型签名/Logo 区域，右侧中部放置细节面板，底部排列信息框。

主体：左侧展示一位全身动漫新娘，身穿精致的白色与淡粉色婚纱，带有强烈的 {argument name="accent color" default="深玫瑰红"} 点缀。角色拥有粉色挑染的长金发，佩戴花冠，披着覆盖着细小红蝴蝶结和心形图案的半透明头纱，穿着层叠蕾丝的荷叶边高低裙，搭配红丝带、吊袜带细节、系带白色厚底婚纱高跟鞋，手持大型玫瑰花束。姿势为优雅站立，一腿前伸，花束置于腰间。面部区域保持为平滑的浅桃色空白矩形，不含五官。

婚纱设计：礼服采用可爱的哥特萝莉风格婚纱：心形领口、露肩蕾丝袖、类似紧身胸衣的红丝带系带、大量小蝴蝶结、心形吊坠、扇形蕾丝、层叠荷叶边、不对称高低裙摆、长拖尾后裙及戏剧性的头纱。花束包含红玫瑰、奶油色玫瑰、淡粉色玫瑰、少量绿植及垂坠的酒红色丝带。

右侧细节面板：在标题下方包含 9 个框架细节面板，排列为 3x3 网格。使用英文标注并配以小爱心：1) FRONT，展示婚纱正面全貌；2) SIDE，展示侧面轮廓与拖尾；3) BACK，展示长头纱、后背蝴蝶结及拖尾裙摆；4) BOUQUET，玫瑰花束特写；5) BODICE，紧身胸衣、蕾丝及红蝴蝶结特写；6) VEIL & RIBBONS，带有红蝴蝶结和心形装饰的半透明头纱面料特写；7) SHOES，系带红丝带的白色厚底高跟鞋特写；8) HEART MOTIF，心形吊坠、蕾丝、珍珠及蝴蝶结特写；9) BACK STYLE，大型后背蝴蝶结及层叠后裙特写。

顶部文字内容：大型优雅衬线标题“WEDDING DRESS”，配以草书副标题“Collection”。下方放置一条丝带横幅，写有“{argument name="collection banner" default="Akai Haato Bridal Style 2024"}”，两端带有心形图标。下方添加一行简短的日式浪漫标语，以装饰性字体呈现，无需过于清晰。

左侧品牌文字：在左上角用粉色草书书写“Akai Haato”，并配以一颗小爱心。

底部区域：包含 3 个底部信息区。左侧：一个带边框的“DESIGN POINT”框，包含五行短句及心形项目符号，描述蕾丝、心形图案、丝带蝴蝶结、高低裙摆及公主般的甜美感。中央：一个“COLOR PALETTE”框，包含 5 个心形色块，分别标注为 Pure White、Bride Red、Baby Pink、Rose Pink 和 Antique Rose。右侧：浪漫签名区，写有“With Love,”，下方为大型草书“Akai Haato”，右下角配有小型火漆印章和丝带徽章。

视觉风格：高级动漫插画、日系偶像角色项目、浪漫婚纱目录、柔和水彩光影、清晰华丽的 UI 边框、粉色与象牙色调、金色装饰点缀、花卉边框细节、精致蕾丝渲染、光泽感杂志品质。

约束：所有主标题和标签使用英文。海报信息量大但保持优雅。必须包含 1 个全身新娘主体、9 个右侧细节面板、3 个底部信息区及 5 个颜色色块。避免写实风格，避免现代极简设计，且不得添加额外角色。

templates.title: Crystal-Smoke Architect Character Design Chart

titleLocalized.zh: Crystal-Smoke Architect 角色设定表

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="character name" default="NOA VALE"} Create a hardcore sci-fi character design sheet. She is the team leader and Crystal-Smoke Architect in a post-apocalyptic tactical faction. The sheet should have the style of a high-end concept art project, reminiscent of a movie or game trailer, featuring dense technical annotations, worn paper textures, and a dark industrial fantasy aesthetic. Canvas: Vertical 4:3. Character design sheet background: weathered gray parchment with black smoke, ink splatter edges, fine white grid lines, and small technical typography. Overall color scheme: charcoal black, gunmetal, rust bronze, bone gray, smoky white, and cool blue lighting effects. Protagonist: A tall, athletic 23-year-old female warrior with messy short black hair, shaved on one side for a cyberpunk-style buzz cut, her face obscured by a soft rectangular blur/mosaic. She wore an asymmetrical black leather and metal tactical suit: a midriff-baring armored top, a waist-revealing design with straps and buckles, slim-fitting trousers, high-heeled armored combat boots, a multi-layered belt, chain details, fingerless gloves, segmented arm armor, spiked shoulder armor, and a long, tattered black coat or cloak made of draped strips of fabric. A heavy mechanical jetpack/Crystal-Smoke device with a faint blue exhaust glow was mounted on her back. Her posture was confident, her body slightly turned to the side, one hand relaxed naturally, the other near her weapon. Left-side information panel: large headline text "{argument name="character name" default="NOA VALE"} Subtitle: "TEAM LEADER // CRYSTAL-SMOKE ARCHITECT". Introduction:{argument name="quote" default="I don’t break the city. I give it shape."} The data includes labeled blocks: Character: "CRYSTAL-SMOKE ARCHITECT / OFFENSIVE TACTICIAN"; Affiliation: "NO FACTION — SLUMS COALITION"; Status: "ACTIVE"; Height: "5'6" / 168 cm"; Weight: "121 lb / 55 kg"; Age: "23"; a concise personal introduction; a sharp, abstract faction emblem; a handwritten signature; and two vertical red stamp-like marks. Layout and counting elements: The upper section contains 5 full-body views: one large full-body view of the hero on the left, and four smaller orthographic views at the top, labeled Front, Side, Back, and 3/4 View. Below the orthographic rows is a close-up portrait panel, with the face also obscured by a rectangular blur. Includes four Crystal-Smoke skill panels arranged in a 2x2 grid, labeled Barrier Wall, Lattice Cage, Elevated Path, and Deflector Array. Each panel displays a tiny black silhouette interacting with a glowing white crystal wireframe structure and smoke particles. The bottom technology panel contains four footwear views, labeled Front, Side, Back, and Sole, showcasing the same armored high-heeled boots. It includes one long weapon panel labeled "WEAPON: CRYSTAL-WRITE KIT," showcasing a modular staff/rifle tool with two modes. It includes six weapon disassembly components labeled Frame Rail, Energy Conduit, Crystal Cartridge, Stabilizer Fin, Grip Module, and Safety Latch. It includes seven accessories and equipment items labeled Crystal Chamber, Smoke Filter, Utility Pouch, Data Slate, Line Spool, Folding Hook, and Scrap Key. Includes 5 jetpack/propulsion system detail panels, labeled Jetpack Overview, Thruster Detail, Harness & Attachment, Fuel Cell, and Vector Nozzles. Clothing and Material Detail Bar: Adds close-up panels of multi-layered belts, buckles, metal plates, cyborg ear implants, neck/shoulder armor, wrist projectors, and mechanical gauntlets. Materials should exhibit visible wear, scratches, rivets, oil stains, and a handcrafted feel, rather than a clean futuristic style. Bottom Reference Bar: Includes a notes box with a brief project description; a color swatch with 8 vertical color blocks, ranging from black to graphite, brown leather, gray metal, parchment beige, smoke white, and light blue; a material/finish guide with 6 rectangular samples, labeled Worn Leather, Oiled Canvas, Carbon Fiber, Scratched Metal, Crystal Glass, and Mesh Fabric; and a team background panel in the lower right corner showing 3 small figures walking through a vertical urban landscape filled with ruins. Visual Style: Ultra-refined dark cinematic concept art, realistic human anatomy, tactical cyberpunk, post-apocalyptic fashion design, precise industrial markings, Japanese game artbook layout style, monochrome smoke atmosphere with ice-blue lighting effects. Text should be concise and arranged like a professional project design sheet. No pure white backgrounds, no cute styles, no highly saturated colors, and no additional characters besides the team silhouettes in the background.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="NOA VALE"} 创建一张硬核科幻角色设计表，她是末日战术阵营中的团队领袖及 Crystal-Smoke Architect。该设定表应呈现出电影或游戏预告片的高端概念艺术项目风格，包含密集的技术标注、磨损的纸张纹理以及暗黑工业幻想风格。

画布：竖向 4:3 角色设定表，背景为带有黑色烟雾的风化灰色羊皮纸，边缘有墨迹飞溅，配有细白网格线和小型技术排版。整体色调为炭黑、枪金属色、锈铜色、骨灰色、烟白色以及冷蓝色光效。

主角：一名 23 岁的高挑运动型女性战士，留着一头凌乱的黑色短发，一侧剃光，呈现赛博朋克式铲青发型，面部被一个柔和的矩形模糊/马赛克遮挡。她身穿不对称的黑色皮革与金属战术套装：露脐装甲上衣、带有绑带和扣环的露腰设计、修身长裤、高跟装甲作战靴、多层腰带、链条细节、露指手套、分段式手臂护甲、尖刺肩甲，以及一件由垂坠布条组成的长款破损黑色外套或斗篷。背部安装有一个重型机械喷气背包 / Crystal-Smoke 装置，带有微弱的蓝色排气光效。姿势自信，身体略微侧转，一只手自然放松，另一只手靠近武器。

左侧信息栏：大标题文字 “{argument name="character name" default="NOA VALE"}”。副标题：“TEAM LEADER // CRYSTAL-SMOKE ARCHITECT”。引言：“{argument name="quote" default="I don’t break the city. I give it shape."}”。包含标注数据块：角色：“CRYSTAL-SMOKE ARCHITECT / OFFENSIVE TACTICIAN”；所属：“NO FACTION — SLUMS COALITION”；状态：“ACTIVE”；身高：“5’6” / 168 cm”；体重：“121 lb / 55 kg”；年龄：“23”；一段紧凑的个人简介；一个锐利的抽象阵营徽章；一个手写签名；以及两个垂直的红色印章式标记。

布局与计数元素：上半部分包含 5 个全身视图：左侧 1 个大型英雄全身视图，顶部 4 个较小的正投影视图，分别标注为 Front（正面）、Side（侧面）、Back（背面）和 3/4 View（四分之三侧面）。在正投影行下方包含 1 个特写肖像面板，面部同样被矩形模糊遮挡。包含 4 个 Crystal-Smoke 技能面板，以 2x2 网格排列，分别标注为 Barrier Wall、Lattice Cage、Elevated Path 和 Deflector Array，每个面板展示一个微小的黑色剪影与发光的白色晶体线框结构及烟雾粒子交互。

底部技术面板：包含 4 个鞋类视图，标注为 Front、Side、Back 和 Sole，展示同一款装甲高跟靴。包含 1 个长条形武器面板，标注为 “WEAPON: CRYSTAL-WRITE KIT”，展示一种具有两种模式的模块化法杖/步枪类工具。包含 6 个武器分解组件，标注为 Frame Rail、Energy Conduit、Crystal Cartridge、Stabilizer Fin、Grip Module 和 Safety Latch。包含 7 个配件和装备物品，标注为 Crystal Chamber、Smoke Filter、Utility Pouch、Data Slate、Line Spool、Folding Hook 和 Scrap Key。包含 5 个喷气背包 / 推进系统细节面板，标注为 Jetpack Overview、Thruster Detail、Harness & Attachment、Fuel Cell 和 Vector Nozzles。

服装与材质细节条：添加多层皮带、扣环、金属板、赛博格耳部植入物、颈/肩护甲、腕部投影仪和机械护手特写面板。材质应呈现明显的磨损、划痕、铆钉、油渍和手工感，而非整洁的未来主义风格。

底部参考条：包含一个带有简短项目说明的备注框；一个包含 8 个垂直色块的色板，从黑色到石墨色、棕色皮革、灰色金属、羊皮纸米色、烟白色和淡蓝色；一个包含 6 个矩形样本的材质/饰面指南，标注为 Worn Leather、Oiled Canvas、Carbon Fiber、Scratched Metal、Crystal Glass 和 Mesh Fabric；以及右下角的一个团队背景面板，展示 3 个小人物正走在废墟林立的垂直城市景观中。

视觉风格：超精细暗黑电影概念艺术，写实人体结构，战术赛博朋克，末日时尚设计，精确的工业标注，日本游戏画册布局风格，单色烟雾氛围配以冰蓝色光效。文字应精简，并像专业项目设计表一样排列。无纯白背景，无可爱风格，无高饱和度色彩，除计数的团队背景剪影外，不包含额外角色。

templates.title: A scene of laptops with crabs gathered on the beach

titleLocalized.zh: 海滩螃蟹聚集的笔记本电脑场景

templates.prompt: Create a realistic yet slightly unsettling beach photograph in natural afternoon light: A striped towel in blue-green and white lies on undulating golden sand, a closed matte black laptop or tablet resting at a slight diagonal angle in the center. The device has rounded edges, a sandy surface, and a cute little car sticker in the center of the lid. A dark black garment or towel is piled up along the right edge. Precisely distribute 38 small beach creatures throughout the scene, crawling on the device and towel: 24 light-colored sand crabs with long, thin legs scattered across the towel, laptop lid, and nearby sand; 14 hermit crabs carrying various spiral shells, mainly clustered along the lower and right edges of the device. Make these creatures appear numerous and busy, some above the laptop, some partially below the edges, and some moving through the striped fabric.{argument name="creature count" default="38"} Only animals can be seen.{argument name="main object" default="Closed matte black laptop with cute little car stickers"} ,{argument name="beach textile" default="Blue-green and white striped towel"} ,{argument name="lighting" default="Warm afternoon low-angle sunlight"} ,as well as{argument name="mood" default="Realistic, crowded, slightly eerie but natural beach snapshots"} Shot from a low, oblique angle, with a wide, horizontal composition and shallow but not excessive depth of field, showcasing high detail in the sand texture, fabric patterns, shadows, crab legs, and seashells. No people, no text overlays, and no watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实且略带不安感的沙滩摄影作品，采用午后自然光：一条蓝绿色与白色相间的条纹毛巾铺在起伏的金色沙滩上，一台闭合的哑光黑色笔记本电脑或平板电脑以轻微的对角线角度放置在毛巾中央。设备边缘圆润，表面覆盖着沙粒，盖子中央贴着一张可爱的小汽车贴纸。右侧边缘堆放着一件深黑色衣物或毛巾。场景中需精确分布 38 只小型海滩生物，它们在设备和毛巾上爬行：24 只长着细长腿的浅色沙蟹分散在毛巾、笔记本电脑盖和附近的沙滩上，14 只背着各种螺旋贝壳的寄居蟹主要聚集在设备的下缘和右缘。让这些生物显得数量众多且忙碌，有的在笔记本电脑上方，有的部分位于边缘下方，有的正在穿过条纹织物。使用 {argument name="creature count" default="38"} 只可见动物，{argument name="main object" default="带有可爱小汽车贴纸的闭合哑光黑色笔记本电脑"}，{argument name="beach textile" default="蓝绿色与白色相间的条纹毛巾"}，{argument name="lighting" default="温暖的午后低角度阳光"}，以及 {argument name="mood" default="写实、拥挤、略带诡异但自然的沙滩快照"}。采用低位斜俯视角拍摄，宽幅水平构图，浅景深但不过度，展现沙滩纹理、织物纹路、阴影、蟹腿和贝壳的高细节。无人物，无文字叠加，无水印。

templates.title: Jin Crow Sci-Fi Character Design Chart

titleLocalized.zh: Jin Crow 科幻角色设定表

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="character name" default="JIN CROW"} Create a dark sci-fi character design sheet. The character is a heavily armored "Echo Smoke" jammer and reconnaissance specialist, set in a gritty post-apocalyptic military world. Canvas: Vertical concept art project, 4:5 aspect ratio, distressed concrete gray background with black ink splatter edges, technical archive layout, small white compressed capital font with fine grid lines and a weathered print texture. Subject: A tall, masculine armored agent with a blurred face, messy dark hair, wearing heavy, layered black tactical armor with tattered cloak strips, heavy boots, numerous straps, buckles, pouches, cables, metal plates, red trim, and a rugged jetpack/thruster. The armor should have a charred, scratched, oil-stained, rain-soaked, and battle-hardened texture. Color palette: charcoal black, gunmetal gray, dirty gray, worn leather, soft beige, and subtle deep red details. Atmosphere: sinister, cinematic, industrial, and tactical. Layout: The left third features a large full-body frontal hero rendering, depicting the agent in a broad, composed stance with relaxed arms. A file text panel is placed above or to the side. The upper right corner contains four full-body multi-angle views, labeled front, side, back, and 3/4 view. The middle right side includes a close-up portrait and skill panel. The bottom and lower-middle sections contain equipment labels, poses, color swatches, material guides, annotations, and small background illustrations of the team. Visible text and file content: The upper left corner features the main title "JIN CROW". The subtitle reads: "TEAM LEADER / ECHO-SMOKE DISRUPTOR". An introduction is included.{argument name="quote" default="I listen to the city. Then I make it speak back."} Add small profile fields, including character, faction, status, height, weight, age, and personal information. Use small but readable secondary background text; avoid using too much. Add a badge and signature-like mark near the left sidebar, and a small vertical stamp near the bottom left corner. Includes the following elements: 1 large frontal hero character on the left; 4 full-body multi-angle views in the upper right corner, labeled front, side, back, and 3/4 view; 1 close-up portrait panel; 6 "Echo Smoke" skill panels labeled Sonar Pulse, False Footsteps, Shockwave Burst, Signal Jammer, Echo Link, and Sound Blade; 4 cybernetics/interface ear detail panels; 4 footwear views labeled front, side, back, and sole; 4 jetpack/thruster views labeled front, side, back, and 3/4 view; 4 auxiliary tool blueprints labeled Sound Dagger, Vibro Signal Launcher, Smoke Canister, and Signal Grenade; 2 primary tool probe blueprints, one a fully extended long stick, and the other a larger modular detail; 4 silhouettes/poses; 7 1 color block; 6 material/finish color blocks; 1 team background illustration showing 3 armored squad members. Panel Details: 6 skill panels should display monochrome tactical visualizations, including smoke, sound waves, sonar rings, red malfunction traces, twisted footsteps, and figures moving through the fog. The cybernetics/interface panel should show a cropped ear implant and a small in-ear device. The footwear panel should show heavy armored boots with non-slip soles. The jetpack panel should show a rectangular, worn thruster with two cylindrical canisters. The auxiliary tool should be a small, high-tech device with red accents. The primary tool should be a long, foldable echo sounder with an antenna-like tip and mechanical segments. Action Postures should show agents sprinting, crouching, gliding, and charging through smoke trails. Visual Style: Ultra-refined AAA video game concept art, realistic digital painting, technical character setting sheets, high microscopic detail, hardcore film noir lighting, low-saturation colors, wet asphalt reflections, military industrial design, sci-fi cyberpunk survival gear, and a dramatic smoke atmosphere. The face is deliberately blurred into soft shadows, rather than a detailed portrait. Customization: The color accents of the agent armor should be {argument name="armor color emphasis" default="blackened gunmetal with muted red accents"} The faction label should be:{argument name="faction label" default="SLUMS COALITION"} The background atmosphere should be{argument name="background mood" default="rainy concrete dossier board with black smoke splatter"} Constraints: Keep the image a single, compact character design sheet; do not split it into multiple images. Strictly adhere to the element count requirements. Avoid using bright hero colors, clean futuristic white armor, cartoonish or anime-style graphics, additional characters beyond team illustrations, or large blocks of readable text that overwhelm the artistic expression.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="JIN CROW"} 创建一张暗黑科幻角色设计表。该角色是一名身着重甲的“回声烟雾”干扰者兼侦察专家，背景设定在肮脏的后启示录军事世界中。

画布：纵向概念艺术项目，4:5 比例，背景为做旧的混凝土灰色，边缘带有黑色墨迹飞溅，采用技术档案布局，使用小型白色压缩大写字体，配有细网格线和风化印刷质感。

主体：一名身材高大的男性化装甲特工，面部模糊不清，留着凌乱的深色头发，身穿厚重的分层黑色战术盔甲，带有破碎的斗篷条、重型靴子、大量绑带、扣环、小袋、电缆、金属板、红色装饰条以及粗犷的喷气背包/推进器。盔甲应呈现出烧焦、划痕、油渍、雨水浸湿和久经沙场的质感。色调采用炭黑、枪灰色、脏灰色、磨损皮革、柔和米色以及少量深红色细节。氛围阴森、电影感强、工业化且充满战术气息。

布局：左侧三分之一处包含一张大型全身正面英雄渲染图，特工站姿宽大沉稳，双臂放松。上方或侧面放置档案文字栏。右上角包含 4 个全身多角度视图，分别标注为正面、侧面、背面和 3/4 视角。中右侧包含特写肖像和技能面板。底部和中下部包含装备标注、动作姿态、色板、材质指南、注释以及团队背景小插图。

可见文字与档案内容：左上角大标题文字“JIN CROW”。副标题：“TEAM LEADER / ECHO-SMOKE DISRUPTOR”。包含引言：{argument name="quote" default="I listen to the city. Then I make it speak back."}。添加小型档案字段，包括角色、所属阵营、状态、身高、体重、年龄和个人资料。使用微小但可读的次要背景文字，不宜过多。在左侧栏附近添加一个徽章和类似签名的标记，左下角附近添加一个小型的垂直印章。

包含元素计数：左侧 1 个大型正面英雄角色；右上角 4 个全身多角度视图，标注为正面、侧面、背面和 3/4 视角；1 个特写肖像面板；6 个“回声烟雾”技能面板，分别标注为 Sonar Pulse（声纳脉冲）、False Footsteps（虚假脚步）、Shockwave Burst（冲击波爆发）、Signal Jammer（信号干扰器）、Echo Link（回声链接）和 Sound Blade（声波刃）；4 个控制论/接口耳部细节面板；4 个鞋类视图，标注为正面、侧面、背面和鞋底；4 个喷气背包/推进器视图，标注为正面、侧面、背面和 3/4 视角；4 个辅助工具图纸，标注为 Sound Dagger（声波匕首）、Vibro Signal Launcher（振动信号发射器）、Smoke Canister（烟雾罐）和 Signal Grenade（信号手雷）；2 个主要工具探测杆图纸，一个为完全展开的长杆，另一个为更大的模块化细节图；4 个剪影/动作姿态；7 个色块；6 个材质/饰面色块；1 个展示 3 名装甲小队成员的团队背景小插图。

面板细节：6 个技能面板应展示单色战术可视化效果，包括烟雾、声波、声纳环、红色故障痕迹、扭曲的脚步和穿过迷雾的身影。控制论/接口面板应为裁剪后的耳部植入物和小型入耳式设备。鞋类面板应展示带有防滑底的厚重装甲靴。喷气背包面板应展示一个矩形磨损的推进器，带有两个圆柱形罐体。辅助工具应为带有红色装饰的小型高科技设备。主要工具应为长型可折叠回声探测杆，带有类似天线的尖端和机械节段。动作姿态应展示特工在烟雾轨迹中冲刺、蹲伏、滑行和突进。

视觉风格：超精细 AAA 级电子游戏概念艺术，写实数字绘画，技术角色设定表，高微观细节，硬核黑色电影照明，低饱和度色彩，湿沥青反射，军事工业设计，科幻赛博朋克生存装备，戏剧性的烟雾氛围。面部刻意模糊处理为柔和的暗影，而非精细的肖像。

自定义：特工盔甲的颜色重点应为 {argument name="armor color emphasis" default="blackened gunmetal with muted red accents"}；阵营标签应为 {argument name="faction label" default="SLUMS COALITION"}；背景氛围应为 {argument name="background mood" default="rainy concrete dossier board with black smoke splatter"}。

约束：保持图像为单张紧凑的角色设定表，不要拆分为多张图片。严格遵守所有元素的计数要求。避免使用明亮的英雄色彩、干净的未来派白色盔甲、卡通风格、动漫风格、团队小插图之外的额外角色，或压过艺术表现的大段可读文字。

templates.title: Double-grid puppy keyboard comic

titleLocalized.zh: 双格小狗键盘漫画

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a one-page black and white comic strip consisting of two vertically arranged panels depicting a cute puppy discovering a computer keyboard and reacting excitedly. Canvas: Vertical comic page, vertical composition, two equal-sized horizontal panels separated by a thick black line, each panel with a clear black border, using grayscale halftone shading, hand-drawn ink line style, and a refined modern comic style. Main Character: A cute puppy with droopy ears, big, sparkling eyes, white stripes on its face, dark patches on its head and body, a bushy, upturned tail, and wearing a collar with a round tag. The puppy sits in an office chair, facing a desktop computer.{argument name="dog breed style" default="A cute mixed-breed puppy resembling a Jack Russell Terrier"} Panel 1: A puppy sits behind a wooden desk, looking at the large desktop monitor on its left with surprise and curiosity. A keyboard sits in front of the puppy. Its mouth is slightly open, its eyes are wide, and three surprise symbols appear above its head. Background: A comfortable home office with a window and curtains on the far left, a landscape painting on the wall, a small potted plant on a cabinet, and a bookshelf on the right. A vertically shaped oval speech bubble containing Japanese text is located on the right side.{argument name="first speech bubble" default="what is this?"} Atmosphere: Confused curiosity. Frame 2: The same puppy, desk, and computer setup, now it leans forward happily, pressing the keyboard with one front paw. The puppy grins, its tongue is visible, its eyes are sparkling, and its tail is up. Add dynamic radial speed lines to the background and add a glitter effect around the keyboard. Include 8 glitter effects around the puppy and keyboard area. Include a vertical oval speech bubble on the left containing Japanese text.{argument name="second speech bubble" default="ピカピカだ!"} Atmosphere: A delightful discovery. Objects and Quantities: 2 comic panels; 1 puppy appears in both panels; 1 desktop monitor; 1 keyboard; 1 office chair; 2 speech bubbles in total; 3 surprise symbols in panel 1; 8 flashing effects in panel 2; visible background items include 1 window, 1 framed painting, 1 potted plant, and 2 bookshelf areas. Visual Style: Monochrome Japanese comics, with expressive and adorable animal characters, detailed fur textures, halftone gradients, clear ink outlines, dramatic yet family-friendly expressions, and a clear and legible composition. Speech bubbles are kept vertical, and Japanese text is in black handwriting. No color, no watermark, no extra panels, and no extra characters.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一页黑白漫画，包含 2 个上下排列的画格，展示一只可爱的小狗发现电脑键盘并兴奋反应的过程。

画布：垂直漫画页面，纵向构图，两个等大的水平画格，中间由粗黑线分隔，每个画格周围有清晰的黑色边框，采用灰度网点阴影，手绘墨线风格，精致的现代漫画风格。

主角：一只可爱的小狗，垂耳，大眼睛闪闪发光，脸部有白色条纹，头部和身体有深色斑块，尾巴蓬松上翘，戴着带有圆形吊牌的项圈。小狗坐在办公椅上，面对着台式电脑。使用 {argument name="dog breed style" default="类似杰克罗素梗的可爱混血小狗"}。

画格 1：小狗坐在木质书桌后，惊讶且好奇地看着左侧的大型台式显示器。键盘放在小狗面前。小狗嘴巴微张，眼睛睁大，头顶上方有 3 个惊讶符号。背景：舒适的家庭办公室，最左侧有窗户和窗帘，墙上挂着风景画，柜子上有一盆小盆栽，右侧有书架。在右侧包含一个垂直椭圆形的对话气泡，内含日语文本 {argument name="first speech bubble" default="これは何?"}。氛围：困惑的好奇心。

画格 2：同样的小狗、书桌和电脑设置，现在它开心地向前倾，用一只前爪按压键盘。小狗咧嘴大笑，舌头可见，眼睛闪闪发光，尾巴翘起。在背景中添加动态放射状速度线，并在键盘周围添加闪光效果。在小狗和键盘区域周围包含 8 个闪光效果。在左侧包含一个垂直椭圆形的对话气泡，内含日语文本 {argument name="second speech bubble" default="ピカピカだ!"}。氛围：惊喜的发现。

物体与数量：共 2 个漫画格；1 只小狗出现在两个画格中；1 台台式显示器；1 个键盘；1 把办公椅；总共 2 个对话气泡；画格 1 中有 3 个惊讶符号；画格 2 中有 8 个闪光效果；可见的背景物品包括 1 扇窗户、1 幅装裱画、1 盆盆栽和 2 个书架区域。

视觉风格：单色日本漫画，表情生动的可爱动物角色，细腻的毛发纹理，网点渐变，清晰的墨线轮廓，戏剧性但适合全家观看的表情，构图清晰易读。保持对话气泡垂直，日语文本为黑色手写体。无颜色，无水印，无额外画格，无额外角色。

templates.title: Frog on a laptop in the weeds

titleLocalized.zh: 野草丛中笔记本电脑上的青蛙

templates.prompt: Create a realistic, documentary-style outdoor photograph showcasing a semi-open {argument name="device" default="silver laptop"} It sat on a rough concrete curb beside overgrown weeds. The laptop was only a few inches open, like a shelter, with a shadowy gap between the lid and the base, and a cute little sticker in the center of the top cover.{argument name="sticker design" default="Smiley Flower Stickers"} The image needs to precisely depict six small green tree frogs: four frogs perched on the roof, including one facing left on the left edge, one facing left in the center behind, one facing left in the center on the right, and one facing left on the far right edge; two frogs in the lower half or below, including one curled up in a shadowy crevice on the left, and another sitting facing right in the center of the lower front edge. The scene is surrounded by tall, tangled green weeds, slender stems, and small white daisy-like wildflowers. A withered brown leaf is visible on the right, and a dark, vertical object is faintly visible on the far left edge. Soft, natural colors, soft lighting under overcast skies, and shallow depth of field are used to realistically depict the texture of moss-covered, stained curb stones, creating a slightly eerie atmosphere of "many small animals gathered around abandoned objects." The composition is horizontal (16:9), low-angle, with no human figures, no added text, and no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实的纪录片风格户外照片，展示一台半开的 {argument name="device" default="银色笔记本电脑"} 放置在茂密野草旁粗糙的混凝土路缘石上。笔记本电脑仅打开了几英寸，像是一个遮蔽所，盖子和底座之间留有一道阴影缝隙，顶盖中央贴着一个可爱的小 {argument name="sticker design" default="笑脸花朵贴纸"}。画面中需精确展示 6 只小绿树蛙：4 只青蛙栖息在上盖，包括一只在左边缘面向左侧、一只在后方中央面向左侧、一只在右侧中央面向左侧，以及一只在最右边缘面向左侧；2 只青蛙在下半部分或下方，包括一只蜷缩在左侧阴影缝隙中，另一只坐在前方下边缘中央面向右侧。场景周围环绕着高大杂乱的绿色杂草、细长的茎秆和白色小雏菊状野花，右侧有一片干枯的棕色叶子，最左侧边缘隐约可见一个垂直的深色物体。使用柔和的自然色彩、阴天柔光、浅景深，呈现出长满青苔的污渍路缘石的真实质感，营造出一种“许多小动物聚集在废弃物体周围”的略带诡异的氛围。横向 16:9 构图，低平视角度，无人像，无添加文字，无水印。

templates.title: Halftone art of Fukusuke dolls that have been reviewed.

titleLocalized.zh: 经过审查的福助人偶半色调艺术

templates.prompt: Create a high-resolution vertical art print with a clean white background. The main subject is a centrally centered, glossy traditional Japanese Fukusuke (lucky charm) doll, depicted in a formal kneeling posture with its hands resting flat on the floor in front of it. The doll wears a gorgeous deep navy blue and black kimono adorned with vivid embroidered flowers and phoenix patterns. The collar features bright royal blue polka dots with red and white trim and a green lining, while the sleeves are printed with small white plum blossom family crests. The doll's head has a shaved, bluish-green style with black hair on the sides and a small black bun on top. However, the face is deliberately obscured by a large, opaque rectangular review block filled with a vertical gradient from pale blue at the top, through beige, to a soft magenta at the bottom. Behind the doll, add a dramatic, symmetrical optical halftone halo composed of dense black dotted outlines with subtle cyan, magenta, yellow, and green chromatic aberration effects, outlining the contours and radiating outwards like a digital vibration field. Employing ultra-refined ceramic/plastic glossy textures, sharp studio lighting, saturated colors, crisp edges, and a surreal contemporary AI art aesthetic. The image must include a main figure, a review rectangle, two visible hands, two visible ears, two cuff markings, and a small artist signature area in the lower right corner, dated [date missing].{argument name="date text" default="May 14, 2026"} Above is a hastily written signature in cursive script.{argument name="artist signature" default="Oyagi"} The main body should be similar to{argument name="character type" default="Traditional Japanese lucky charm doll"} Please ensure that the face is completely obscured by the rectangle, and that no identifiable facial features are visible.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高分辨率的竖版艺术打印图，背景为干净的白色，主体为居中的光泽感传统日本福助招福人偶，呈现正式的跪拜姿势，双手平放在身前地板上。人偶身穿华丽的深海军蓝与黑色和服，饰有生动的刺绣花卉和凤凰图案，领口为明亮的宝蓝色圆点拼接，配有红白镶边、绿色内衬，双袖上印有白色小梅花家纹。人偶头部为青绿色剃发造型，两侧为黑色头发，顶部有一个黑色小发髻，但面部被一个大的不透明矩形审查块刻意遮挡，审查块内部填充有从顶部淡蓝色经米色到底部柔和紫红色的垂直渐变。在人偶后方，添加一个由密集黑色点状轮廓波纹组成的戏剧性对称光学半色调光环，并带有微妙的青色、品红色、黄色和绿色色差故障效果，勾勒出轮廓并像数字振动场一样向外辐射。使用超精细的陶瓷/塑料光泽质感、锐利的摄影棚灯光、饱和的色彩、清晰的边缘以及超现实的当代 AI 艺术美学。画面中必须包含一个主体人偶、一个审查矩形、两只可见的手、两只可见的耳朵、两个袖口家纹，以及右下角的一个小型艺术家签名区，日期为 {argument name="date text" default="2026 年 5 月 14 日"}，上方为潦草的草书签名 {argument name="artist signature" default="Oyagi"}。主体应类似于 {argument name="character type" default="传统的日本福助招福人偶"}；请确保面部完全被矩形遮挡，不可见任何可辨认的面部特征。

templates.title: Pen and ink wash photo conversion

titleLocalized.zh: 钢笔淡彩照片转换

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the sole source image, transform the scene into a freehand pen-and-ink illustration on white textured paper. Retain the original pose, composition, the positions of the suit, tie, and American flag, including the rectangle obscuring the face. Remove the photographic stage/background and replace it with a plain off-white paper. Present the subject with expressive black ink lines, bold cross-hatching, uneven hand-drawn outlines, visible watercolor washes, soft color blending, gentle navy/red tones, and slightly unfinished edges. Keep the composition close to the original midground and do not add any new objects, text, or background details.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 作为唯一源图像，将场景转换为白色纹理纸上的写意钢笔淡彩插画。保留原始姿势、构图、西装、领带以及美国国旗的位置，包括遮挡面部的矩形。移除摄影舞台/背景，并将其替换为素雅的米白色纸张。以富有表现力的黑色墨水线条、粗犷的交叉排线、不均匀的手绘轮廓、可见的水彩渲染、柔和的色彩晕染、柔和的藏青色/红色调以及略显未完成的边缘来呈现主体。保持构图接近原始的中景，且不要添加任何新物体、文字或背景细节。

templates.title: Japanese office worker character design illustration

titleLocalized.zh: 日本上班族角色设定图

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a concise anime-style male character design depicting a modern Japanese office worker. All portraits should have the face obscured using a soft, square blur effect. Canvas: Wide, horizontal character reference image against a white background, approximately 16:9 aspect ratio. Use thin black dividing lines, clean Japanese-style typography, and soft, professional color schemes. Layout: An information panel on the left, three full-body character views in the center, and a detail panel on the right. The overall look should resemble a sophisticated commercial character design document. Left Information Panel: A bordered profile card at the top, containing four lines of text: Name, Occupation, Height, and Weight. Use Japanese text as visible labels and values: "Name:{argument name="character name" default="Mizuki Takahashi"} (Name is indicated by small kana above, and "(Takahashi Mizuki)" below), "Occupation: Salaryman", "Height: 182cm", "Weight: 68kg". Below this, a section titled "Character Setting" is added, containing 4 key points describing him as a salaryman in his twenties, calm and intelligent, with a strong sense of responsibility, meticulous and trustworthy at work, and a neat appearance that gives a reliable impression. At the bottom, a section titled "Color Setting" is added, containing 5 color swatches: light brown hair #8B6F5E, brown eyes #5A3E2B, grey suit #646A70, white shirt #FFFFFF, and black tie/shoes/belt #111111. Middle View: Shows three full-body views of the same man wearing a well-fitting grey business suit: the left view is labeled "Side View," the middle front view is labeled "Front View," and the right back view is labeled "Back View." The man is tall and slender, with a light brown center-parted hairstyle, wearing a white shirt, a black narrow tie with a tie clip, a grey notched lapel suit jacket, matching slim-fit straight-leg trousers (with a center crease), a black belt, black dress shoes, and a simple analog watch. In the side view, one hand is in his pocket, his posture upright and relaxed. In the front view, one hand is in his pocket, the other hangs naturally. The back view shows the seams of the suit jacket and its clean, tapered silhouette. Middle Annotation: Added thin leader lines and Japanese labels pointing to clothing and features. Includes annotations for hairstyle, expression, suit, tie, trousers, and shoes. The hairstyle description should be: center-parted and naturally flowing hair; the expression description should be: a calm and slightly smiling, trustworthy impression; the suit description should be: a clean, well-fitting silhouette; the tie description should be: a solid black tie with a tie clip; the trousers description should be: slim-fit straight-leg trousers with a center crease; the shoes description should be: black straight-toe dress shoes. The right-hand detail panel is titled "Dietel". Four rectangular detail panels are stacked vertically: 1) a blurred close-up of the head and hair; 2) a close-up of the chest showing the lapel, shirt, tie, tie clip, and pocket square; 3) close-ups of the cuffs and a simple analog analog watch; 4) a fabric texture swatch. Add Japanese descriptions next to these panels: center-parted and naturally flowing bangs; neat, straight hair; calm and composed gaze; notched lapel jacket with pocket square; four real buttons on the cuffs; simple analog analog watch; high-quality wool blend suit material suitable for spring, autumn, and winter. Bottom right corner note: Add a small box with a border, titled "Reflections," containing 3 key points: emphasizing neatness and trustworthiness, a basic yet sophisticated business suit style, and a minimalist yet refined design. Visual style: Semi-realistic anime illustrations, clean lines, soft cel shadows, realistic suit folds, elegant and soft color tones, magazine-style Japanese character design illustrations, clear and easy-to-read layout, no decorative background, and no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一份简洁的动漫风格男性角色设计图，展示一位现代日本上班族，所有肖像中的面部均需用柔和的方形模糊效果遮挡。

画布：宽幅横向角色参考图，白色背景，比例约为 16:9。使用细黑色分割线，整洁的日式编辑排版，以及柔和的专业配色。

布局：左侧放置信息栏，中间放置三个全身角色视图，右侧放置细节栏。整体外观应类似于精致的商业角色设定文档。

左侧信息栏：顶部绘制一张带边框的个人资料卡，包含 4 行标注：姓名、职业、身高和体重。使用日语文本作为可见标签和数值：「名前: {argument name="character name" default="高桥深月"}」（姓名上方标注小型假名，下方标注“(Takahashi Mizuki)”）、「职业: サラリーマン」、「身高: 182cm」、「体重: 68kg」。下方添加标题为「キャラクター设定」的部分，包含 4 个要点，描述他是一位二十多岁的上班族，性格冷静睿智，责任感强，在工作中严谨且受人信赖，外表整洁，给人值得信赖的印象。底部添加标题为「カラー设定」的部分，包含 5 个色卡：发色浅棕 #8B6F5E、眼色棕色 #5A3E2B、西装灰色 #646A70、衬衫白色 #FFFFFF、领带/鞋/皮带黑色 #111111。

中间角色视图：展示 3 个身穿合身灰色商务西装的同一男性的全身视图：左侧视图标注「侧面図」、中间正面视图标注「正面図」、右侧背面视图标注「背面図」。该男子高挑纤瘦，留着浅棕色中分发型，穿着白色衬衫、黑色窄领带配领带夹、灰色平驳领西装外套、配套的修身直筒西裤（带中折线）、黑色皮带、黑色正装皮鞋，并佩戴简单的模拟指针手表。侧面视图中，一只手插在口袋里，姿态挺拔放松。正面视图中，一只手插在口袋里，另一只手自然垂下。背面视图展示西装外套的接缝和利落的锥形轮廓。

中间标注说明：添加细引线和日语标签，指向服装和特征。包括发型、表情、西装、领带、裤子和鞋子的标注。发型说明应描述为中分且自然流动的发丝；表情说明应描述为冷静且略带微笑的值得信赖的印象；西装说明应描述为利落的合身轮廓；领带说明应描述为带领带夹的黑色纯色领带；裤子说明应描述为带中折线的修身直筒西裤；鞋子说明应描述为黑色直头正装皮鞋。

右侧细节栏：标题为「ディテール」。垂直堆叠 4 个矩形细节面板：1) 面部模糊的头部和头发特写，2) 展示翻领、衬衫、领带、领带夹和口袋巾的胸部特写，3) 袖口和简单模拟指针手表的特写，4) 面料纹理色卡。在这些面板旁添加日语要点说明：刘海中分且自然流动，头发质感整洁顺直，眼神冷静沉稳，外套采用平驳领并配有口袋巾，袖口有四颗真扣，手表为简单的模拟指针式，面料为适合春秋冬三季的高品质羊毛混纺西装材质。

右下角备注：添加一个带边框的小方框，标题为「備考」，包含 3 个要点，强调整洁感与信赖感、基础精致的商务西装风格，以及简约而考究的设计。

视觉风格：半写实动漫插画，干净的线条，柔和的赛璐璐阴影，写实的西装褶皱，优雅柔和的色调，杂志风格的日式角色设定图，清晰易读的排版，无装饰背景，无水印。

templates.title: Anime School Storyboard

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫校园分镜表

templates.prompt:
Objective: Create a neat anime storyboard/contact sheet for a school scene, laid out in a 4-column, 4-row grid: 8 illustration panels paired with 8 dialogue boxes. Each illustration panel has a small white label in the upper left corner with black Japanese text from "絵1" to "絵8", and a matching text box below labeled "dialogue 1" to "dialogue 8". Use clean black grid borders, white spacing, and a wide canvas. Canvas: Horizontal 16:9 storyboard, approximately 1200×675 pixels, white background, thin black panel outlines, and a clean animation layout. Each illustration panel occupies the upper half of its storyboard grid, with the corresponding dialogue box located directly below it. Visual Style: High-quality modern Japanese anime, soft classroom lighting, soft colors, detailed desks and chairs, lively character performances, clean lines, subtle gradients, and no heavy textures. The overall look should resemble an anime scene storyboard sketch, not a finished manga page. Characters: The main female character is {argument name="main character name" default="Kodama"} The first girl was a shy, long, straight pink-haired female student with fair skin and large pink eyes, wearing a cream-colored cardigan over her school uniform. The second girl was {argument name="friend character name" default="Misaki"} A vibrant blonde schoolgirl with a high ponytail, wearing a sailor uniform with a blue collar and red ribbon. Other classmates appear in the classroom background. Illustration Panel: Create 8 illustration image panels. Panel 1: A pink-haired girl sits alone at a desk in the classroom, looking down at a game controller in her hand, with classmates chatting behind her, tagged "Edge 1". Panel 2: Close-up of the blonde girl's legs and school shoes as she walks towards the pink-haired girl; the pink-haired girl can be seen sitting at a desk in the background, tagged "Edge 2". Panel 3: The blonde girl leans over the desk and excitedly speaks to the surprised pink-haired girl, tagged "Edge 3". Panel 4: The pink-haired girl blushes nervously, holding a pen or small object near her mouth; her face is partially simplified/obscured in a panel-style design, tagged "Edge 4". Panel 5: The blonde girl holds up her smartphone, showing a colorful fighting game tournament poster or game screen; the pink-haired girl looks at it from the side, tagged "Edge 5". Panel 6: Close-up of a blonde girl smiling and making a peace sign, with a bright, warm blurred background. Her face is partially simplified/obscured in a storyboard style. Labeled "Painting 6". Panel 7: Close-up of a pink-haired girl's face, with a shimmering pink background, showing a strong reaction of shock. Her face is partially simplified/obscured in a storyboard style. Labeled "Painting 7". Panel 8: A blank, unused white storyboard panel, displaying only the centered Japanese text "Unused". Labeled "Painting 8". Dialogue Boxes: Create 8 dialogue boxes below the image panels. Use black Japanese text on a white background, simple typographic font, left-aligned (except for the unused box, which is centered). Dialogue 1 Text:{argument name="dialogue 1" default="Kodama: "...I didn't talk to anyone today either.""} . Dialogue 2 Text: "美岲がこだまにNearly づいてくる

あ、えっと……』"} . Dialogue 5 Text: "Misaki 『これさ!
本度の土曜、
ゲーセンでスト2の
General Assembly あるんだって!』

同じゲーム好きな人しか

Constraints: Contains 8 image panels and 8 dialog boxes; 2 of these are unused and marked "Unused". Maintain a 4-column structure, strong black borders, classroom scene consistency, and consistent character design across panels. Do not add additional titles, watermarks, logos, or other panels.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为校园场景创建一个整洁的动漫分镜表/联系表，布局为 4 列 4 行的网格：8 个插画面板配对 8 个对话框。每个插画面板的左上角都有一个白色小标签，带有从「絵1」到「絵8」的黑色日语文字，下方配对的文本框标签为「台詞1」到「台詞8」。使用清晰的黑色网格边框、白色间距和宽屏画布。

画布：水平 16:9 分镜表，约 1200×675 像素，白色背景，细黑色面板轮廓，简洁的动画制作布局。每个插画面板占据其分镜格的上半部分，对应的对话框位于其正下方。

视觉风格：高质量现代日本动漫，柔和的教室光线，柔和的色彩，精细的课桌椅，生动的角色表演，干净的线条，细腻的渐变，无厚重纹理。整体外观应保持为动漫场景的分镜草图，而非成品漫画页。

角色：主角女孩为 {argument name="main character name" default="Kodama"}，一位害羞的粉色长直发女学生，皮肤白皙，有着粉色大眼睛，校服外穿着奶油色开衫。第二位女孩为 {argument name="friend character name" default="Misaki"}，一位充满活力的金发女学生，扎着高马尾，穿着带有蓝色领子和红色丝带的水手服。其他同学出现在教室背景中。

插画面板：创建 8 个插画图像面板。面板 1：粉发女孩独自坐在教室课桌前，低头看着手中的游戏手柄，身后有同学在聊天，标签为「絵1」。面板 2：金发女孩走向粉发女孩的腿部及校鞋特写；背景中可见粉发女孩坐在课桌前，标签为「絵2」。面板 3：金发女孩俯身跨过课桌，兴奋地对惊讶的粉发女孩说话，标签为「絵3」。面板 4：粉发女孩紧张地脸红，嘴边握着一支笔或小物件，面部以分镜风格进行部分简化/遮挡，标签为「絵4」。面板 5：金发女孩举起智能手机，展示一张多彩的格斗游戏锦标赛海报或游戏画面；粉发女孩从侧面看着它，标签为「絵5」。面板 6：金发女孩微笑并比出剪刀手特写，背景为明亮温暖的虚化效果，面部以分镜风格进行部分简化/遮挡，标签为「絵6」。面板 7：粉发女孩面部特写，背景带有闪烁的粉色效果，表现出强烈的震惊反应，面部以分镜风格进行部分简化/遮挡，标签为「絵7」。面板 8：空白的未使用白色分镜面板，仅居中显示日语文字「未使用」，标签为「絵8」。

对话框：在图像面板下方创建 8 个对话框。使用白色背景上的黑色日语文字，简单印刷字体，左对齐（未使用框除外，未使用框居中）。对话 1 文本：{argument name="dialogue 1" default="こだま「……\n今日も誰とも\nしゃべらずに」"}。对话 2 文本：「美咲がこだまに近づいてくる\n美咲の足元アップ」。对话 3 文本：「美咲『ねぇねぇ』\n美咲『いつもゲームパッド\n持ってるよね？』」。对话 4 文本：{argument name="dialogue 4" default="こだま『ひっ……！？\nあ、えっと……』"}。对话 5 文本：「美咲『これさ！\n今度の土曜、\nゲーセンでスト2の\n大会あるんだって！』\nこだま『……っ』」。对话 6 文本：「美咲『対戦ゲーム大会って\n同じゲーム好きな人しか\nいないんだよ？』」。对话 7 文本：{argument name="dialogue 7" default="こだま（ドクン…）"}。对话 8 文本：居中显示「未使用」。

约束条件：包含 8 个图像面板和 8 个对话框；其中 2 个框为未使用，均标记为「未使用」。保持 4 列结构、强黑色边框、教室场景连贯性以及各面板间一致的角色设计。不要添加额外的标题、水印、Logo 或其他面板。

templates.title: Tsukiyo Fox Witch Character Design Reference Image

titleLocalized.zh: Tsukiyo 狐巫女角色设定参考图

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="character name" default="Tsukiyo"} Create a refined reference image for an anime VTuber character. This character is a fox spirit priestess residing on the moon, with long pink hair and fox ears, presenting a delicate Japanese fantasy style. Canvas: Vertical character design, light warm ivory background, soft pink decorative border, cherry blossom petals, delicate pink and red border lines, elegant symmetrical layout, high-resolution illustration. Overall color scheme: white, light pink, deep red, black, accented with gold. Header: The top center features the large title text: "ツキヨ/ Tsukiyo". Below is a smaller subtitle: "狐神の巫女" (The Fox Spirit Priestess Who Dwells on the Moon). A circular moon and fox emblem with cherry blossoms and light decorative patterns is added to the upper left corner. Main layout: The left and central areas contain three complete full-body three-view drawings of the character, with small beige labels vertically: front view labeled "Front", side view labeled "Side", and back view labeled "Back". The front view shows her standing calmly with her arms slightly at her sides and sleeves hanging naturally; the side view shows her profile and flowing long hair; the back view emphasizes her extremely long, straight pink hair that reaches her skirt and the back of her belt. The proportions and clothing of the three characters are kept consistent. Character details: She is a young and elegant anime woman with {argument name="hair color" default="Extra long light pink hair"} She features large pink fox ears with white inner ear hair, golden eyes, fair skin, soft bangs, and a delicate, serene expression. She wears a white shrine maiden-style kimono with semi-transparent wide sleeves, pink cherry blossom patterns, red piping, a black inner collar, and a red and black floral obi with gold details. A large red flower decoration and ribbon adorn one of her fox ears, while the sleeves feature matching red ribbons, decorative cords, tassels, and a circular gold-pink obi. Her footwear consists of traditional white tabi socks, paired with red and black clogs or platform sandals. The back view should showcase the kimono's hem and the sheer sleeves with a soft pink floral gradient. Right sidebar: Add a large close-up portrait panel in the upper right corner, showcasing the head, fox ears, hair ornaments, neckline, and shoulder area. Below, create a "Details" section containing two stacked detail panels: the first is a close-up of the earrings, labeled "耳元饰り" (Earring Ornament), with small Japanese-style descriptive text; the second is a close-up of the belt and waist ornaments, labeled "帯・腰饰り" (Belt/Waist Ornament), with small Japanese-style descriptive text. In the bottom right corner, create an SD/CHIBI panel labeled "SD/CHIBI," showcasing a super cute chibi-style full-body image of the same character wearing the same outfit, surrounded by subtle petal effects and a small circular ground ripple. Expressions: In the bottom left corner, create an "Expressions" section containing five small avatar panels. Each panel shows the same character from the shoulders up, with fox ears and hair accessories, labeled from left to right in Japanese: "常" (Normal), "微笑み" (Gentle Smile), "妖艶" (Charming), "静寂" (Quiet/Peaceful), and "威圧" (Majestic). Expressions should be delicate and elegant, not overly exaggerated. Personal Profile Section: Create a "Personal Profile" box in the lower left corner containing compact lines of Japanese text. Include structured fields such as race, age, height, personality, likes, dislikes, etc., but use small print as decorative supplementary content. To the right of the profile box is a brief Japanese description of a beautiful fox spirit shrine maiden appearing under the moonlight, with a background featuring a faint crescent moon and cherry blossom patterns. Visual Style: High-detail anime character design, clean lines, soft watercolor-style pink shading, gorgeous Japanese shrine maiden aesthetics, soft lighting, bright hair highlights, intricate fabric textures, and elegant UI style reference design. Use clear area labels, slender decorative dividers, cherry blossom icons, and refined fonts. Constraints: Use 3 full-body three-view charts, 5 expression panels, 2 detail panels, 1 close-up portrait panel, and 1 chibi panel. Maintain visual consistency and cleanliness. No watermarks, no social media UI, no realistic photography, and no additional characters.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="Tsukiyo"} 创建一份精致的动漫 VTuber 角色参考图。该角色是一位居住在月亮的狐巫女，拥有长长的粉色头发和狐耳，呈现出细腻的日式幻想风格。

画布：纵向角色设计图，浅暖象牙色背景，柔和的粉色装饰边框，樱花花瓣，纤细的红粉色边框线，优雅的对称布局，高分辨率插画。整体色调：白色、淡粉色、深红色、黑色，点缀金色。

页眉：顶部中央为大标题文字：「ツキヨ / Tsukiyo」。下方为较小的副标题：「月を宿す狐神の巫女」。左上角添加一个带有樱花和轻盈装饰纹样的圆形月亮与狐狸徽章。

主体布局：左侧和中央区域包含 3 个完整的角色全身三视图，垂直方向贴有小型米色标签：正面视图标注「正面」，侧面视图标注「側面」，背面视图标注「背面」。正面视图展示她平静站立，双臂微垂，袖子自然下垂；侧面视图展示她的侧脸和飘逸的长发；背面视图强调其长及裙摆的超长直粉发以及腰带背面。保持三个角色的比例和服装一致。

角色细节：她是一位年轻优雅的动漫女性，拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="超长淡粉色头发"}、带有白色内耳毛的大型粉色狐耳、金色眼睛、白皙皮肤、柔和的刘海以及精致平静的表情。她身穿白色巫女风格和服裙，配有半透明宽袖、粉色樱花图案、红色滚边、黑色内领，以及带有金色细节的红黑花卉腰带。在一只狐耳上包含一个大型红色花朵装饰和丝带，袖子上配有相呼应的红色丝带、装饰绳、流苏以及圆形的金粉色腰部挂饰。鞋履为传统的白色足袋，搭配红黑木屐或厚底凉鞋。背面视图应展示和服裙摆和带有柔和粉色花卉渐变的袖子透明感。

右侧栏：右上角添加 1 个大型特写肖像面板，展示头部、狐耳、发饰、领口和肩部区域。下方创建一个「细节」部分，包含 2 个堆叠的细节面板：第一个是耳饰的近景特写，标注「耳元飾り」，并配有小型日式说明文字；第二个是腰带和腰部挂饰的近景特写，标注「帯・腰飾り」，并配有小型日式说明文字。右下角创建 1 个 SD / CHIBI 面板，标注“SD / CHIBI”，展示同一个角色身穿相同服装的超萌 Q 版全身形象，周围环绕着细微的花瓣特效和一个小型圆形地面涟漪。

表情行：在左下方创建一个「表情」部分，包含 5 个小型头像面板。每个面板展示同一个角色从肩部以上的形象，配有狐耳和发饰，从左到右用日语标注： 「通常」（正常）、「微笑み」（温柔微笑）、「妖艶」（妩媚）、「静寂」（安静/宁静）、「威圧」（威严）。表情应保持细腻优雅，不可过于夸张。

个人资料部分：左下角创建一个「个人资料」框，包含紧凑的日语文字行。包含种族、年龄、身高、性格、喜好和厌恶等结构化字段，但将小字作为装饰性辅助内容。在资料框右侧，包含一段简短的日语描述，讲述在月夜下出现的绝美狐神巫女，背景带有淡淡的新月和樱花图案。

视觉风格：高细节动漫角色设定图，干净的线条，柔和的水彩风粉色阴影，华丽的日式巫女美学，柔和的光晕，亮丽的发丝高光，复杂的织物纹理，优雅的 UI 风格参考图设计。使用清晰的区域标签、纤细的装饰分隔线、樱花图标和精致的字体。

约束条件：使用 3 个全身三视图，5 个表情面板，2 个细节面板，1 个特写肖像面板，以及 1 个 Q 版面板。保持画面统一且整洁。无水印，无社交媒体 UI，无写实摄影，无额外角色。

templates.title: Mea Anime Character Design Collection

titleLocalized.zh: Mea 动漫角色设定集

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="character name" default="Mea"} Create an exquisite anime character design book. She is a serene AI secretary, presented in an elegant blue and white fantasy office style. Canvas: Vertical A4 character design book, 768 x 1152 pixels, white background with light ice blue decorative borders, thin-line panel divisions, decorative corner patterns, small butterflies and rose patterns, presenting a simple and sophisticated visual novel design. Header: A large blue rose badge is placed in the upper left corner. The title text is centered and uses Japanese and English: "めあ/ Mea". Below is an elegant small blue Japanese slogan: "あなたのそばで、すべてを整えるお手伝いを。". Main Layout: A compact design book layout is used, divided into three main sections. The left two-thirds contains full-body three-view images, emoticons, personal profile, color scheme, and props. The right third contains a large portrait, a detail panel, and a chibi panel. Character design: Drawing a young woman with {argument name="hair color" default="Extremely long pale silver-blue hair"} With blue eyes, fair skin, and a serene expression, she exudes the elegant air of a secretary. She wears a white beret adorned with a navy blue ribbon and blue roses, a white lace shawl draped over a puff-sleeved blouse, a navy blue bow tie with a large blue gemstone brooch, a fitted white top with gold buttons and chain embellishments, a long white tiered skirt with pale blue floral embroidery at the hem, a dark navy blue petticoat with ruffles, white gloves or soft sleeves, white high heels, and an ID card hanging from her waist. The overall look uses navy blue, white, gold, and ice blue accents. The face may be slightly obscured in the main front view and portrait, but must be clearly shown in other expression thumbnails. The three-view section is labeled "Three-View Image." It displays three complete full-body standing views, arranged in a vertical column: 1. Front view labeled "Front," 2. Side view labeled "Side," 3. Back view labeled "Back." Maintaining consistent proportions, the posture is elegant, with arms hanging naturally. The back view should show the flowing long hair, beret, navy blue bow and rose decoration at the back waist, and the layered skirt structure. Right-side portrait: Add a large half-body portrait frame to the upper right panel. The character has one hand near the neckline, showcasing the beret, hair accessory, lace shawl, bow, gemstone brooch, shirt buttons, and long hair. Details: Labeled "DETAIL". Contains 3 stacked detail cards, with a cutout diagram on the left and Japanese descriptions on the right: 1. Hair accessory: Showing a blue rose/ribbon hair accessory; 2. Brooch: Showing a navy blue bow and a blue gemstone brooch; 3. ID card: Showing a close-up of a hanging name tag with the text "Mea" and an AI secretary style. Expressions: Labeled "EXPRESSION". Includes 5 square avatar thumbnails, with blue labels below each labeled in Japanese: 1 "Normal" (neutral), 2 "Smiling" (slight smile), 3 "Concerned" (caring or worried), 4 "Relaxed" (closed eyes in relief), 5 "Quiet and Shy" (quiet and shy). Expressions vary slightly, while clothing and angles remain consistent. Profile section: labeled "PROFILE". A bilingual Japanese character data block is added to the lower left, along with a brief introduction next to a light blue rose illustration. Includes easily readable Japanese text blocks such as: Species AI, Position Secretary, Appearance Age Young, Height 166 cm, Slim build, Gentle and calm personality, Skilled at organizing information and schedules, Weakness Mechanical body and sense of humor. Maintain a decorative feel and avoid overly dense text. Chibi section: labeled "SD / CHIBI". Shows a super-transformable chibi character standing on a glowing circular hologram, holding a dark blue tablet or notebook, surrounded by a semi-transparent blue floating UI panel. Color Scheme: Labeled "COLOR PALETTE". Seven color blocks are displayed: warm white, light lavender gray, light periwinkle blue, medium blue, deep navy blue, brownish gold, and multifaceted ice blue crystal color blocks. Weapons/Items: Labeled "WEAPON / ITEM". Three items are displayed with accompanying text: 1. Navy blue and gold management pen, labeled "Management Device Pen"; 2. Dark blue information management tablet, labeled "Information Management Tablet"; 3. Floating blue holographic UI screen, labeled "Hologram UI". Visual Style: High-quality anime illustrations, clean lines, soft watercolor shadows, bright light blue highlights, elegant decorative typography, clear and legible setting book, unified blue, white, and gold color scheme, delicate lace and floral patterns, subtle shadows, and no cluttered elements except for designated panels. Constraints: Strictly retain 3 three-sided illustrations, 5 facial expressions, 3 detail cards, 1 chibi character, 7 color blocks, and 3 prop illustrations. Do not add extra characters. Keep all tags neat and use Japanese in designated areas.{argument name="character role" default="An AI Secretary"} Use a vertical layout for the character design collection.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="Mea"} 创建一份精致的动漫角色设定集。她是一位宁静的 AI 秘书，采用优雅的蓝白幻想办公风格。

画布：竖版 A4 角色设定集，768 x 1152 像素，白色背景，配有淡冰蓝色装饰边框、细线条面板分割、装饰性边角花纹、小蝴蝶和玫瑰图案，呈现简洁的高级视觉小说设计感。

页眉：左上角放置一个大型蓝色玫瑰徽章。标题文字居中，采用日语和英语： 「めあ / Mea」。下方添加优雅的小号蓝色日文标语： 「あなたのそばで、すべてを整えるお手伝いを。」。

主要布局：采用紧凑的设定集布局，分为三个主要栏目。左侧三分之二包含全身三面图、表情条、个人资料、配色方案和道具。右侧三分之一包含一张大头像、细节面板和 Q 版面板。

角色设计：绘制一位年轻女性，拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="极长的淡银蓝色头发"}、蓝色眼睛、白皙皮肤、平静的表情，展现出秘书般的优雅气质。她佩戴带有海军蓝丝带和蓝色玫瑰装饰的白色贝雷帽，白色蕾丝披肩覆盖在泡泡袖衬衫上，海军蓝领结配有大型蓝色宝石胸针，修身白色上衣带有金色纽扣和链条装饰，长款白色叠层裙摆，下摆处有淡蓝色花卉刺绣，深海军蓝衬裙褶边，佩戴白色手套或柔软袖套，白色高跟鞋，腰间悬挂一张 ID 卡。整体使用海军蓝、白色、金色和冰蓝色点缀。面部区域在主正面图和头像中可略微遮挡，但在其他表情缩略图中需清晰展示。

三面图部分：标注为 「三面図」。展示 3 个完整的全身站立视图，分列在垂直栏中： 1 正面图标注为 「正面」， 2 侧面图标注为 「側面」， 3 背面图标注为 「背面」。保持比例一致，姿态优雅，双臂自然下垂。背面图需展示长发飘逸的效果、贝雷帽、后腰的海军蓝蝴蝶结与玫瑰装饰，以及叠层裙摆的结构。

右侧头像：在右上方面板添加一张大型半身肖像框。角色一只手靠近领口，展示贝雷帽、发饰、蕾丝披肩、蝴蝶结、宝石胸针、衬衫纽扣和长发。

细节部分：标注为 “DETAIL”。包含 3 张堆叠的细节卡片，左侧为裁剪图，右侧为日文说明文字： 1 发饰，展示蓝色玫瑰/丝带发饰； 2 胸针，展示海军蓝蝴蝶结和蓝色宝石胸针； 3 ID 卡，展示悬挂式工牌特写，文字为 “Mea” 及 AI 秘书风格样式。

表情部分：标注为 “EXPRESSION”。包含 5 个方形头像缩略图，下方蓝色标签标注日文： 1 「通常」中性， 2 「微笑み」浅笑， 3 「気遣い」关心或担忧， 4 「安堵」闭眼释然， 5 「静かな照れ」安静害羞。表情细微差别，服装和角度保持一致。

个人资料部分：标注为 “PROFILE”。在左下方添加一个双语风格的日文角色数据块，并在淡蓝色玫瑰插图旁添加一段简介。包含易读的日式文本块，如：物种 AI、职位秘书、外貌年龄青年、身高 166 cm、体型苗条、性格温柔冷静、擅长整理信息与日程、弱点机械身体与幽默感。保持装饰性，避免文字过于密集。

Q 版部分：标注为 “SD / CHIBI”。展示 1 个超变形 Q 版角色，站在发光的圆形全息图上，手持深蓝色平板或笔记本，周围环绕着半透明的蓝色浮动 UI 面板。

配色方案：标注为 “COLOR PALETTE”。展示 7 个色块：暖白色、淡薰衣草灰、浅长春花蓝、中蓝色、深海军蓝、棕褐色金以及多面冰蓝色水晶色块。

武器/道具部分：标注为 “WEAPON / ITEM”。展示 3 个道具并配文： 1 海军蓝与金色管理设备笔，标注为 「管理用デバイスペン」； 2 深蓝色信息管理平板，标注为 「情報管理タブレット」； 3 浮动蓝色全息 UI 屏幕，标注为 「ホログラムUI」。

视觉风格：高质量动漫插画，干净的线条，柔和的水彩阴影，明亮的淡蓝色高光，优雅的装饰性排版，清晰的设定集易读性，统一的蓝白金配色，精致的蕾丝与花卉图案，细微的投影，除指定面板外无杂乱元素。

约束条件：严格保留 3 个三面图、5 个表情、3 张细节卡片、1 个 Q 版形象、7 个色块和 3 个道具插图。不要添加额外角色。所有标签保持整洁，指定位置使用日文。为 {argument name="character role" default="一位 AI 秘书"} 使用竖版角色设定集构图。
