templates.title: Smart doorbell casing product rendering

titleLocalized.zh: 智能门铃外壳产品渲染图

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a concise studio product rendering of a custom DIY smart doorbell/intercom casing, presented in an exploded multi-view product array format. Canvas: Widescreen 16:9 composition, light gray seamless studio background, soft ground shadows, orthographic product rendering appearance, no human figures, no brand watermark. Subject: A compact rectangular electronic product casing with rounded corners, matte finish.{argument name="enclosure color" default="Light gray"} Made of plastic with slightly chamfered edges, featuring a realistic 3D CAD rendering effect and a subtly rough texture. Layout: Five independent shell views are evenly arranged from left to right: 1) A very thin left side profile, standing vertically with two stacked circular speaker or sensor grilles; 2) Front main view, standing vertically and slightly tilted, with visible functional details; 3) A narrow side profile with a recessed USB-C port; 4) A vertically standing back cover with four corner screw holes and a side cutout; 5) An open back cover/shell interior showing electronics mounted in the top compartment and an empty lower compartment. Front Details: The front main view contains four sets of visible functional features: a small circular camera lens near the top center; a square black display/window below displaying two cute cartoon eyes; a large circular illuminated doorbell button with a white halo below the display; and a horizontal speaker grille near the bottom consisting of multiple rows of short black slits. Two small round holes are added to the left edge of the main body. Internal electronic components: Inside the open rear cover, there are two circuit boards and visible wiring: the top circuit board is labeled as {argument name="camera module label" default="ESP32-CAM"} It has a small camera module; the lower circuit board is marked as{argument name="controller board label" default="DFPlayer Mini"} Add neatly arranged black, white, gray, and red wires around the circuit board. There should be a horizontal partition inside to separate the electronic component compartment from the larger cavity below. Add four corner screw posts/holes inside the open housing. Style: Realistic 3D product visualization, high-detail industrial design concept, soft studio lighting from the upper left, soft ambient light masking, sharp edges, realistic plastic materials, neutral gray color scheme, light and clear shadows, centered composition. Constraints: Use 5 product views, keep all objects vertical, no hands, no additional text except for two circuit board labels, no logo, no decorative background objects.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个简洁的定制 DIY 智能门铃 / 对讲机外壳的摄影棚产品渲染图，以爆炸式多视图产品阵列形式呈现。

画布：宽屏 16:9 构图，浅灰色无缝摄影棚背景，柔和的地面阴影，正交产品渲染外观，无人像，无品牌水印。

主体：一个带有圆角的紧凑型矩形电子产品外壳，哑光 {argument name="enclosure color" default="浅灰色"} 塑料材质，边缘略带倒角，逼真的 3D CAD 渲染效果，具有细微的粗糙质感。

布局：从左到右均匀排列 5 个独立的外壳视图：1) 一个非常薄的左侧轮廓，垂直站立，带有两个堆叠的圆形扬声器或传感器格栅；2) 正面主视图，垂直站立，略微倾斜，带有可见的功能细节；3) 一个狭窄的侧面轮廓，带有凹陷的 USB-C 接口；4) 后盖板垂直站立，带有四个角部螺丝孔和一个侧面切口；5) 打开的后壳/外壳内部，显示安装在顶部隔间中的电子元件和一个空的下部隔间。

正面细节：在正面主视图上，包含 4 组可见的功能特征：顶部中心附近的一个小圆形摄像头镜头；下方一个方形黑色显示屏/窗口，显示两只可爱的卡通眼睛；显示屏下方一个大的圆形发光门铃按钮，带有白色光环；以及底部附近由多排短黑色缝隙组成的水平扬声器格栅。在主体左边缘增加两个小圆孔。

内部电子元件：在打开的后壳中，包含 2 个电路板和可见的布线：顶部电路板标记为 {argument name="camera module label" default="ESP32-CAM"}，带有小型摄像头模块；下部电路板标记为 {argument name="controller board label" default="DFPlayer Mini"}。在电路板周围添加整齐排列的黑色、白色、灰色和红色导线。内部应有一个水平隔板，将电子元件舱与下方较大的空腔隔开。在打开的外壳内部添加四个角部螺丝柱/孔。

风格：逼真的 3D 产品可视化，高细节工业设计概念，来自左上方的柔和摄影棚灯光，柔和的环境光遮蔽，清晰的边缘，逼真的塑料材质，中性灰配色，浅而清晰的阴影，居中构图。

约束：使用 5 个产品视图，保持所有物体垂直，无人手，除两个电路板标签外无额外文字，无 Logo，无装饰性背景物体。

templates.title: Planetary anchoring station profile

titleLocalized.zh: 行星锚定站剖面图

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a concise cross-sectional diagram of a science fiction technology structure, showcasing a massive space structure inspired by *No Man's Sky*, labeled as {argument name="station name" default="Planetary anchoring station"} Precisely depicting the industrial details of a deep-ground orbital mooring/logistics hub. Canvas: 3:2 wide landscape technical poster, white background, high resolution, with ample space for annotations. Employing a realistic hard-surface conceptual art style, complemented by clean black leading lines, small circular annotation dots, delicate technical fonts, and subtle shadows beneath the structure. Main Body: A massive cross-section of a vertical space station, sloping from lower left to upper right, with two long horizontal arms extending to the left and right from the central tower. The structure is in shades of blue-grey, gunmetal, white, and dark steel, with exposed copper, orange, green, and black utilities. The central tower section is cut open to reveal stacked cylindrical machinery, ducts, elevator shafts, reactor sections, service decks, truss structures, and luminous industrial interiors. The left arm shows numerous exposed utilities within segmented duct shells. The right arm is a heavier rectangular radiator/armature with panel plating, circular ports, and mechanical seams. At the bottom is a bulky blue anchoring base with landing foot-like support and shock absorber details. Top left corner text: Large bold capitalized title:{argument name="station name" default="Planetary anchoring station"} The smaller subheading is located directly below:{argument name="diagram subtitle" default="Cross-sectional view"} Below the subtitle, add a brief description:{argument name="description text" default="A deep-ground megastructure that anchors a space station to a planetary body and extends into the upper atmosphere or low Earth orbit. It serves as a logistics hub, energy harvester, and mooring point."} Labels: Contains 9 labels with guide lines and dotted markers, using compact uppercase headings, each accompanied by a brief explanatory description: 1. Command and Control Node—Navigation, communications, and space station administration. 2. Upper Tower Module—Living quarters, laboratories, and specialized facilities. 3. Docking and Maintenance Hub—For spacecraft docking, maintenance bays, and robotic cranes. 4. Structural Spine—A reinforced central truss providing strength and alignment support for the entire structure. 5. Utility Conduits—Power cables, coolant pipes, and data lines pass through protected conduits. 6. Heat Dissipation Flanges—Heat dissipation panels with integrated cooling channels. 7. Energy Core—A fusion or high-output power plant providing electricity to the space station. 8. Anchoring Base—The interface with the planetary surface or seabed. Includes anchoring mechanisms and shock absorbers. 9. Magnetic Levitation Elevator Shaft—Transports personnel and supplies along the vertical axis. Specification Box: A white box with a border, titled "Specifications," is placed in the lower right corner. Contains 5 rows of content with small monochrome icons and numerical values: Height (above ground) —{argument name="station height" default="~ 6.2 km"} Span (arm reach) – ~7.8 km; Mass – ~9.5 million tons; Main materials – Titanium alloy, composite ceramics, reinforced polymers; Power output – ~12.4 gigawatts. Visual style: Futuristic aerospace engineering drawings, combining realistic 3D model rendering with infographic annotations, clear panel lines, exposed internal mechanical structures, realistic proportions, no human figures, no planets, no starry backgrounds, and no watermarks. The background remains pure white, and the font is clear, black, and easy to read.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张简洁的科幻技术剖面图，展示一个受《无人深空》（No Man's Sky）启发的巨型太空结构，标注为 {argument name="station name" default="行星锚定站"}，精确呈现深地基轨道系留/物流枢纽的工业细节。

画布：宽幅 3:2 横向技术海报，白色背景，高分辨率，留有充足的标注空间。采用写实的硬表面概念艺术风格，配以清晰的黑色引导线、小型圆形标注点、纤细的技术字体以及结构下方的微妙阴影。

主体：一座巨大的垂直空间站横截面，从左下向右上倾斜，两条长长的水平臂从中央塔楼向左右延伸。结构呈蓝灰色、枪灰色、白色和深钢色，带有外露的铜色、橙色、绿色和黑色公用管道。中央塔楼部分被切开，露出堆叠的圆柱形机械、导管、电梯井、反应堆部分、服务甲板、桁架结构和发光的工业内部。左臂显示了分段导管外壳内许多外露的公用管道。右臂是一个更厚重的矩形散热器/电枢，带有面板镀层、圆形端口和机械接缝。下端有一个笨重的蓝色锚定底座，带有类似着陆脚的支撑和减震器细节。

左上角文字：大号粗体大写标题：{argument name="station name" default="行星锚定站"}。正下方为较小的副标题：{argument name="diagram subtitle" default="剖面图"}。在副标题下方，添加一段简短说明：{argument name="description text" default="一种将空间站固定在行星天体上并延伸至高层大气或低轨道的深地基巨型结构。它兼具物流枢纽、能量收集器和系留锚点的功能。"}

标注：包含 9 个带有引导线和圆点标记的标注，使用紧凑的大写标题，每项配有一句简短的解释性说明：1. 指挥与控制节点 — 导航、通信和空间站管理。2. 上层塔楼模块 — 居住区、实验室和专业设施。3. 对接与维护枢纽 — 用于航天器对接、维修舱和机器人起重机。4. 结构脊柱 — 加固的中央桁架，为整个结构提供强度和对齐支撑。5. 公用导管 — 电力电缆、冷却剂管道和数据线穿过受保护的导管。6. 散热翼 — 带有集成冷却通道的散热面板。7. 能源核心 — 为空间站提供电力的聚变或高输出发电厂。8. 锚定底座 — 与行星表面或海床的接口。包含锚定机构和减震器。9. 磁悬浮电梯井 — 沿垂直轴运送人员和物资。

规格框：在右下角放置一个带边框的白色方框，标题为“规格”。包含 5 行带有小型单色图标和数值的内容：高度（地表以上）— {argument name="station height" default="~ 6.2 公里"}；跨度（臂展）— ~ 7.8 公里；质量 — ~ 950 万吨；主要材料 — 钛合金、复合陶瓷、增强聚合物；功率输出 — ~ 12.4 吉瓦。

视觉风格：未来派航空航天工程图，写实 3D 模型渲染与信息图表标注相结合，清晰的面板线条，外露的机械内部结构，真实的比例，无人像，无行星，无星空背景，无水印。保持背景为纯白色，字体清晰、黑色且易于阅读。

templates.title: Guan Yu Historical Info Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 关羽历史信息图海报

templates.prompt: Goal: To create a picture about{argument name="character name" default="Guan Yu"} This vertical, epic Chinese infographic poster combines cinematic portraits of Three Kingdoms generals with parchment-style chronicle panels. Canvas: High vertical poster, 3:4 aspect ratio, background of aged beige Xuan paper with ink stains, indistinct mountains, smoke, battlefield silhouettes, and the texture of a museum scroll. Overall color scheme: dark brown, charcoal gray, dark olive green, bronze, and soft blood brown. Subject: An extremely detailed ancient Chinese general.{argument name="character name" default="Guan Yu"} Centered on the canvas is a powerful, dark brown warhorse. He wears a layered, deep green robe over a magnificent black bronze scale armor, complete with sculpted shoulder guards, leather belts, and metal studs. A green turban hangs from his head, its long ribbons flowing to the right. His long black hair and beard billow in the wind; his face is deliberately softened and blurred, like a smooth mask, while the armor and clothing retain sharp details. He wields a massive, ornate guan dao (a type of halberd), extending from the center to the lower left foreground; the blade is enormous, silver, engraved with gold patterns, and employs a strong perspective effect. The warhorse has flowing muscles, an alert expression, and is adorned with ornate reins, bronze plaques, and decorative leather. Its forelegs are raised, and its body is slightly turned to the right. Left-side title area: A large, vertically arranged black ink calligraphy title is placed in the upper left corner.{argument name="large calligraphy title" default="Guan Yu"} Next to it is a smaller vertical Chinese text reading "Martial Saint, Loyalty and Righteousness, Awe-inspiring Throughout China," with a small red seal below. Below the title is a brief biographical text: "Biography of Guan Yu / c. 160–220 / courtesy name Yunchang, original name Changsheng / from Jie County, Hedong (present-day Yuncheng, Shanxi) / a famous general of Shu Han, the head of the Five Tiger Generals / renowned for loyalty, righteousness, benevolence, and courage / later revered as the Martial Saint / on par with Confucius, the 'Sage of Literature'." Chronological panel: Eight semi-transparent rectangular parchment cards are arranged around the central equestrian figure. Each card contains a two-digit number, a prominent Chinese event title, the year, 2–4 lines of smaller Chinese annotations, and a faded monochrome battlefield illustration behind the text. The cards should be presented as layered cellophane frames with thin white borders and ink-wash war scenes. 1. Upper left card: "01 Oath of the Peach Garden," year "c. 184," showing the three sworn brothers under a tree. 2. Left center card: "02 Warm Wine Slaying Hua Xiong", year "190", showing a general and soldiers near the battlefield flags. 3. Left bottom card: "03 Passing Five Gates and Slaying Six Generals", year "200", showing a battle scene of cavalry passing through passes or fortresses. 4. Left bottom card: "04 Single-handedly Attending the Meeting", year "215", showing a dramatic scene of a riverside or military meeting. 5. Right top card: "05 Flooding the Seven Armies", year "219", showing an army, ships, and chaotic scene in a flood. 6. Right upper center card: "06 Scraping the Bone to Remove Poison", year "219", showing a medical scene and soldiers nearby. 7. Right lower center card: "07 Dominating China", year "219", showing a battlefield shrouded in smoke and a dense army. 8. Right bottom card: "08 Defeat at Maicheng", year "220", showing a seated general and the tragic atmosphere of the final battle. Bottom Timeline: Add a thin, horizontal timeline along the bottom edge, containing eight markers corresponding to events: "Born around 160 AD in Jie County, Hedong," "Oath of the Peach Garden in 184 AD," "Slaying Hua Xiong with Warm Wine in 190 AD," "Passing Five Gates and Slaying Six Generals in 200 AD," "Going to the Banquet Alone in 215 AD," "Flooding the Seven Armies in 219 AD," "Dominating China in 219 AD," and "Defeat at Maicheng in 220 AD." Use small gold dots connected by thin lines, accompanied by compact serif Chinese captions. Visual Style: Epic historical fantasy realism style, Chinese ink painting poster design, cinematic lighting, high-detail metal engraving, a smoky atmosphere, battlefield dust, layered parchment collages, and elegant typography. The central rider and warhorse are sharply contrasted and clearly defined; the background cards are slightly faded and reduced in saturation. Constraints: Maintain eight chronology cards and eight bottom timeline points. Do not add modern objects, logos, watermarks, or additional figures in the foreground. Retain the Chinese text content for poster layout, and keep all composition descriptions in English.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张关于 {argument name="character name" default="关羽"} 的竖版中国史诗级信息图海报，将电影感的三国武将肖像与羊皮纸风格的编年史面板相结合。

画布：高竖版海报，3:4 比例，背景为陈旧的米色宣纸，带有水墨污渍、隐约的山峦、烟雾、战场剪影以及博物馆卷轴的质感。整体色调为深褐色、炭灰色、暗橄榄绿、青铜色和柔和的血褐色。

主体：一位细节极其丰富的中国古代将军 {argument name="character name" default="关羽"} 占据画面中心，骑着一匹强壮的深褐色战马。他身穿层叠的深绿色长袍，外罩华丽的黑青铜鳞甲，配有雕花护肩、皮带、金属铆钉，头戴绿色头巾，长长的系带向右飘动。黑色的长发和胡须在风中飘扬；面部区域特意处理得柔和模糊，如同平滑的面具，而盔甲和衣物则保持锐利的细节。他手持一把巨大的华丽关刀，从中心向左下角前景延伸；刀刃巨大，呈银色，刻有金色花纹，并运用了强烈的透视缩短效果。战马肌肉线条流畅，神情警觉，配有华丽的缰绳、青铜饰牌和装饰性皮具，前腿抬起，身体略微朝向右侧。

左侧标题区：在左上方放置一个巨大的竖排黑色水墨书法标题 {argument name="large calligraphy title" default="关羽"}。旁边添加较小的竖排中文文字“武圣·忠义·威震华夏”，下方盖有一枚红色小印章。标题下方包含一段简短的生平文字：“关羽生平 / 约160年—220年 / 字云长，本字长生 / 河东解县（今山西运城）人 / 蜀汉名将，五虎上将之首 / 以忠义仁勇著称 / 后世尊为 武圣 / 与‘文圣’孔子齐名”。

编年史面板：使用 8 张半透明的矩形羊皮纸卡片围绕中心骑马者排列，每张卡片包含一个两位数编号、一个醒目的中文事件标题、年份、2–4 行较小的中文注释，以及文字背后淡化的单色战场插画。卡片应呈现为带有细白边框和水墨战争场景的层叠玻璃纸框架。
1. 左上方卡片：“01 桃园结义”，年份“约184年”，展示树下的三位结拜兄弟。
2. 左侧中部卡片：“02 温酒斩华雄”，年份“190年”，展示战场旗帜附近的将军与士兵。
3. 左侧下部卡片：“03 过五关斩六将”，年份“200年”，展示骑兵穿过关隘或堡垒的战斗场景。
4. 左下角卡片：“04 单刀赴会”，年份“215年”，展示戏剧性的江边或军事会面场景。
5. 右上方卡片：“05 水淹七军”，年份“219年”，展示洪水中的军队、船只和混乱场面。
6. 右侧中上部卡片：“06 刮骨疗毒”，年份“219年”，展示医疗场景及旁边的士兵。
7. 右侧中下部卡片：“07 威震华夏”，年份“219年”，展示烟雾缭绕的战场和密集的军队。
8. 右下角卡片：“08 败走麦城”，年份“220年”，展示坐着的将军和悲壮的最后战役氛围。

底部时间轴：在底部边缘添加一条细长的水平时间轴，包含与事件对应的 8 个标注点：“约160年 生于河东解县”、“184年 桃园结义”、“190年 温酒斩华雄”、“200年 过五关斩六将”、“215年 单刀赴会”、“219年 水淹七军”、“219年 威震华夏”、“220年 败走麦城”。使用细线连接的小金点，配以紧凑的衬线体中文说明。

视觉风格：史诗级历史奇幻写实风格，中国水墨海报设计，电影级布光，高细节金属雕刻，烟雾缭绕的氛围，战场尘土，层叠的羊皮纸拼贴，优雅的排版。中心骑马者和战马对比强烈且清晰；背景卡片略微褪色并降低饱和度。

约束条件：保持 8 张编年史卡片和 8 个底部时间轴点。不要添加现代物品、标志、水印或前景中的额外人物。保留中文文本内容作为海报排版，所有构图说明保持为英文。

templates.title: Zhao Yun's cavalry infographic poster

titleLocalized.zh: 赵云骑兵信息图海报

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a highly dramatic infographic poster featuring a Chinese historical military general, with the main character being {argument name="character name" default="Zhao Yun"} The image depicts a valiant, armored cavalry general charging towards the viewer on a white horse, surrounded by a semi-transparent holographic chronological panel. Canvas: Vertical poster, 3:4 aspect ratio, cinematic high detail, cool gray-blue tones, a smoky battlefield background with dust and gravel at the bottom, bright rim lighting, and cold, glowing UI edges. The composition is compact and legible, with the mounted general centered, the horse and lance protruding forward with a strong sense of perspective. Subject: A general in the style of the Three Kingdoms period of China, clad in magnificent silver scale armor and layered gray-white robes, riding a powerful white horse. He has flowing silver-white hair and wears a decorative headdress. The face is deliberately blurred with soft rectangular details. He grips an extremely long silver lance, angled from the upper left to the lower right foreground, the tip close to the viewer. The horse is adorned with exquisite silver harnesses, carved reins, tassels, and breast ornaments; its mane billows wildly in the wind. Atmosphere: Fearless, legendary, stormy, heroic. Left title bar: Huge black ink calligraphy, written {argument name="main calligraphy" default="Zhao Yun"} The vertical text beside it reads "Ever-Victorious General, Lone Hero, Silver Spear and White Horse." A small red seal is added, bearing the inscription "Zilong." Below is a short biography block titled "Famous General of Shu Han," accompanied by brief Chinese text describing him as a lifelong loyal general of Shu Han, known as the "Ever-Victorious General," eight feet tall, handsome, and wielding a silver spear. Floating Chronology Panels: Using eight semi-transparent, glass-like rectangular panels with cyan glowing borders, each panel contains a numbered title, a few lines of brief Chinese text, the year, and a small monochrome battle illustration in the background. Arrange them around the rider, without obscuring the horse's head or spear: top left, top right, center left, center right, bottom left, bottom right, bottom left, bottom right. The eight visible panels are: 01 "Early Career," including "Following Gongsun Zan / Establishing Merit / Approximately 184 AD"; 02 "Rescue of Liu Bei at Changban," including "Cao Cao's army attacks / Seven charges in and out / Rescuing Liu Bei's young son A Dou / 208 AD"; 03 "Battle of Hanshui," including "Winning with fewer troops / Defeating Cao Cao's army / Seizing the city / 208 AD"; 04 "Single-handedly rescuing A Dou," including "Riding alone / Deep into enemy lines / Protecting A Dou to safety / 208 AD"; 05 "Cleverly Taking Guiyang," including "Cleverly capturing Zhao Fan / Pacifying Guiyang / Outstanding Achievements / 214 AD"; 06 "Assisting in the Conquest of Yizhou," including "Entering Sichuan with the army / Attacking cities and capturing strongholds / Establishing great military achievements / 214 AD"; 07 "Battle of Jigu," including "Defending Jigu / Repelling the Wei army / Protecting the rear of Shu Han / 228 AD; 08 "Northern Expedition to the Central Plains", including "Following Zhuge Liang on the Northern Expeditions / Repeatedly Achieving Great Merit / Shaking the Central Plains / 228–231 AD". Bottom Timeline: Add a thin, gold horizontal timeline with 7 dates and labels: "?–184 Changshan Zhen Ding native", "184 Following Gongsun Zan in his first campaign", "208 Battle of Changban, saving the lord and establishing merit", "214 Cleverly capturing Guiyang and assisting Yizhou", "228 Battle of Jigu, beginning of the Northern Expedition", "231 Northern Expedition to the Central Plains, repeatedly achieving great merit", "229–? Died in Chengdu, posthumously honored as Marquis Shunping". Visual Style: Ultra-detailed fantasy-realistic Chinese historical illustrations, blending futuristic transparent infographic overlays, metallic armor details, painterly smoke, sculpted textures, cool-toned glowing highlights, high contrast, sharp spear perspective, and epic poster design. Avoid modern weapons, cartoon style, adding extra panels, and English characters in the artwork.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张极具戏剧性的中国历史武将信息图海报，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="赵云"}，展现一位英勇的披甲骑兵将军骑着白马向观众冲锋，周围环绕着半透明的全息纪年面板。

画布：竖版海报，3:4 比例，电影级高细节，冷灰蓝色调，烟雾缭绕的战场背景，底部有尘土和碎石，明亮的轮廓光和冰冷的 UI 发光边缘。构图紧凑且易读，骑马的武将居中，马匹和长枪以强烈的透视感向前突出。

主体：一位中国三国风格的将军，身穿华丽的银色鳞甲和层叠的灰白色长袍，骑着一匹强壮的白马。他留着飘逸的银白色长发，戴着装饰性的头冠。面部区域特意用柔和的矩形模糊处理。他紧握一杆极长的银枪，从左上角斜向右下角前景，枪尖靠近观众。马匹佩戴着精致的银色马具、雕花缰绳、流苏和胸饰；马鬃在风中狂乱飘动。氛围：无畏、传奇、风暴、英勇。

左侧标题栏：巨大的黑色水墨书法，书写 {argument name="main calligraphy" default="赵云"}。旁边竖排文字写着“常胜将军 · 独胆英雄 · 银枪白马”。添加一枚红色小印章，写着“子龙”。下方包含一个名为“蜀汉名将”的简短传记块，配以简短的中文正文，描述他作为蜀汉终身忠诚的将军，被称为“常胜将军”，身长八尺，相貌堂堂，手持银枪。

浮动纪年面板：使用 8 个半透明玻璃质感的矩形面板，带有青色发光边框，每个面板包含一个带编号的标题、几行简短的中文、年份以及背景中的小型单色战斗插图。将它们排列在骑手周围，不要遮挡马头或长枪：左上、右上、左中、右中、左下、右下、底部左侧、底部右侧。8 个可见面板为：01 “初出茅庐”，包含“随公孙瓒 / 建功立业 / 约 184 年”；02 “长坂救主”，包含“曹操大军来袭 / 七进七出 / 救出刘备幼子阿斗 / 208 年”；03 “汉水之战”，包含“以少胜多 / 大破曹军 / 晋夺城 / 208 年”；04 “单骑救阿斗”，包含“单枪匹马 / 深入敌阵 / 护阿斗安全脱险 / 208 年”；05 “智取桂阳”，包含“智取赵范 / 平定桂阳 / 功勋卓著 / 214 年”；06 “助攻取益州”，包含“随军入川 / 攻城拔寨 / 立下赫赫战功 / 214 年”；07 “箕谷之战”，包含“镇守箕谷 / 击退魏军 / 保蜀汉后方 / 228 年”；08 “北伐中原”，包含“随诸葛亮北伐 / 屡建奇功 / 威震中原 / 228 年–231 年”。

底部时间轴：添加一条细长的金色水平时间轴，标有 7 个日期点和标签：“?–184 常山真定人”、“184 随公孙瓒 初出茅庐”、“208 长坂坡之战 救主立功”、“214 智取桂阳 助攻益州”、“228 箕谷之战 北伐开始”、“231 北伐中原 屡建奇功”、“229–? 病逝成都 追谥顺平侯”。

视觉风格：超细节的奇幻写实中国历史插画，融合未来感透明信息图叠加层、金属盔甲细节、绘画感烟雾、雕刻纹理、冷色调发光高光、高对比度、锐利的长枪透视、史诗般的海报设计。避免使用现代武器，避免卡通风格，避免添加额外面板，避免在艺术作品中出现英文字符。

templates.title: Planetary exploration outpost profile

titleLocalized.zh: 行星勘测前哨站剖面图

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a concise sci-fi technology cross-section infographic showcasing a facility inspired by *No Man's Sky*, titled {argument name="headline text" default="PLANETARY SURVEY OUTPOST"} Presented as a hardened planetary exploration base with a large central dome and swept-wing structures, styled like an aerospace architecture manual. Canvas: A 16:9 wide-format landscape poster on a white background, combining high-resolution conceptual art rendering with clear, editorial typography. It uses soft olive-grey armor plates, dark graphite structural ribs, warm interior lighting, and purple sensor lighting effects. Main Layout: A massive cross-section of the facility is placed at the center, spanning almost the entire width. At the center is a semi-circular hardened dome, cut open to reveal four stacked interior spaces: 1) sensor and telescope rooms at the top, 2) crew/laboratory rooms, 3) an operations/control layer with blue displays, and 4) a power/storage bay at the bottom. Connecting the two large, angular wings: the left wing is light green hardened armor, while the right wing is darker, with an open sensor bay cross-section near the tip. Thin guide lines and small technical labels are added around the structure. Top-left text block: A subtitle is added below the main title.{argument name="subtitle text" default="CUTAWAY DIAGRAM"} . The description includes a brief text: “A hardened, low-profile facility designed for long-term planetary observation and data collection. The hardened dome and wing structure houses sensors, living quarters, and support systems, and is designed to withstand harsh surface environments.” Notes: Nine labeled annotations surround the main cross-section, each with a brief description: 1) “REINFORCED WING STRUCTURE” – Composite armor and load-bearing struts provide durability and impact resistance; 2) “OBSERVATION BAYS” – Deployable sensor pods for atmospheric and terrain analysis; 3) “CENTRAL SENSOR DOME” – Rotating sensor array and high-resolution scanning instruments; 4) “COMMUNICATION ARRAY” – High-gain antenna system for long-range data transmission; 5) “HABITATION DECK” – Crew quarters, galley, recreational, and medical facilities; 6) “OPERATIONS DECK” – Command center, data analysis lab, and mission planning room; 7) “POWER” –… CORE (Power Core) – A compact fission reactor that powers all systems; 8) STORAGE & WORKSHOP – Equipment storage, manufacturing labs, and maintenance bays; 9) DEPLOYABLE SENSOR POD – An autonomous pod for atmospheric sampling, topographic mapping, and surface scanning. Embedded Panels: Add 3 framed embedded panels. The lower left panel displays a small, standalone rendering of a deployable sensor pod with landing gear, labeled "DEPLOYABLE SENSOR POD". The upper right panel is a "SPECIFICATIONS" card containing 6 lines of data: Dome diameter approximately 68 meters; Wingspan approximately 140 meters; Height approximately 35 meters; Mass approximately 24,000 tons; Crew capacity 24; Power output approximately 3.2 MW. The bottom right panel is a top view of the facility layout, labeled "FACILITY LAYOUT (TOP VIEW)," showing the circular central dome and two wings, labeled left wing (sensor bay), right wing (communication array and support), and central dome (operations and core). Visual Style: A combination of realistic science fiction concept art and technical blueprint infographic design, sharp cross-sectional details, small-scale human-scale rooms and equipment, subtle shadows below the base, thin purple-grey leading lines, compact uppercase sans-serif font labels, and sophisticated magazine-style typography. Constraints: Keep all text in English, ensure easy readability and information-dense graphics, and avoid adding logos, watermarks, foreground figures, or additional embedded panels. The main body should present {argument name="game inspiration" default="No Man's Sky"} It should evoke the feel of a planetary facility, but it must remain original.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张简洁的科幻技术剖面信息图，展示一个受《No Man's Sky》启发的设施，标题为 {argument name="headline text" default="PLANETARY SURVEY OUTPOST"}，呈现一个带有大型中央穹顶和后掠翼结构的加固型行星勘测基地，风格如同航空航天建筑手册。

画布：白色背景下的 16:9 宽幅横向海报，结合高分辨率概念艺术渲染与清晰的编辑类图表排版。使用柔和的橄榄灰色装甲板、深石墨色结构肋条、温暖的室内照明以及紫色的传感器光效。

主要布局：将巨大的设施横截面放置在中心，横跨几乎整个宽度。中心是一个半圆形的加固穹顶，剖开后露出 4 层堆叠的内部空间：1) 顶部的传感器和望远镜室，2) 船员/实验室房间，3) 带有蓝色显示器的操作/控制层，4) 底部的动力/存储机械舱。连接两个宽大的角形机翼：左翼为淡绿色加固装甲，右翼颜色较深，尖端附近有开放式传感器舱剖面。在结构周围添加细引线和小型技术标签。

左上角文本块：在标题下方，添加副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="CUTAWAY DIAGRAM"}。包含一段简短的文字：“一个加固的低矮型设施，专为长期行星观测和数据收集而建。加固的穹顶和机翼结构容纳了传感器、生活区和支持系统，能够抵御恶劣的表面环境。”

标注：在主剖面图周围包含 9 个带标签的标注，每个标注配有简短说明：1) “REINFORCED WING STRUCTURE”（加固机翼结构）— 复合装甲和承重支柱提供耐用性和抗冲击性；2) “OBSERVATION BAYS”（观测舱）— 用于大气和地形分析的可部署传感器吊舱；3) “CENTRAL SENSOR DOME”（中央传感器穹顶）— 旋转传感器阵列和高分辨率扫描仪器；4) “COMMUNICATION ARRAY”（通信阵列）— 用于远程数据传输的高增益天线系统；5) “HABITATION DECK”（居住层）— 船员宿舍、厨房、娱乐和医疗设施；6) “OPERATIONS DECK”（操作层）— 指挥中心、数据分析实验室和任务规划室；7) “POWER CORE”（动力核心）— 为所有系统供电的紧凑型裂变反应堆；8) “STORAGE & WORKSHOP”（存储与车间）— 设备存储、制造实验室和维护舱；9) “DEPLOYABLE SENSOR POD”（可部署传感器吊舱）— 用于大气采样、地形测绘和表面扫描的自主吊舱。

内嵌面板：添加 3 个带边框的内嵌面板。左下角面板显示一个带有起落架的可部署传感器吊舱的独立小渲染图，标注为“DEPLOYABLE SENSOR POD”。右上角面板为“SPECIFICATIONS”（规格）卡片，包含 6 行数据：穹顶直径约 68 米；翼展约 140 米；高度约 35 米；质量约 24,000 吨；船员容量 24 人；功率输出约 3.2 MW。右下角面板为设施布局顶视图，标注为“FACILITY LAYOUT (TOP VIEW)”，显示圆形的中央穹顶和两个机翼，并标注了左翼（传感器舱）、右翼（通信阵列与支持）和中央穹顶（操作与核心）。

视觉风格：写实的科幻概念艺术与技术蓝图信息图设计相结合，锐利的横截面细节，小比例的人类尺度房间和设备，基地下方微妙的阴影，纤细的紫灰色引线，紧凑的大写无衬线字体标签，以及精致的杂志排版构图。

约束：保持所有文本为英文，使图表易于阅读且信息密集，不要添加徽标、水印、前景人物或额外的内嵌面板。主体应呈现出 {argument name="game inspiration" default="No Man's Sky"} 中行星设施的感觉，但需保持原创性。

templates.title: Lu Bu, a historical general poster

titleLocalized.zh: 吕布历史武将海报

templates.prompt: Goal: To create a picture about{argument name="character name" default="Lü Bu"} This dramatic vertical infographic poster of a legendary general from the Three Kingdoms period combines cinematic fantasy realism with ancient-style manuscript design. Canvas: Vertical 3:4 poster with a parchment-gray textured background, featuring ink stains, dust, smoke, battlefield gravel, and subtle cracks. Employing a high-contrast cinematic composition, the main figure charges explosively outwards from the center. Subject: A majestic ancient Chinese heavy cavalry general rides a deep chestnut warhorse, charging directly towards the viewer. The rider wears magnificent deep bronze and black lamellar armor, adorned with red fabric, chains, metal shoulder armor, and an exquisite helmet with two extremely long red pheasant feathers, rising high and curving outwards. His face is deliberately blurred/masked with a soft rectangular blur, while the rest of the image remains sharp. He thrusts a massive, ornate halberd into the camera, creating an extreme close-up perspective: the weapon's blade is enormous, blurred by depth of field, extending from the lower left into the rider's hand. The warhorse's mane billowed in the wind, adorned with decorative reins, metal ornaments, and tassels; its forelegs raised, kicking up mud and smoke. Left-side layout: A large, vertically arranged black calligraphic title.{argument name="main title" default="Lü Bu"} The brushstrokes are bold. Smaller vertical phrases are placed beside them.{argument name="vertical subtitle" default="Flying General, Fierce General, Hero of a Chaotic Era"} Below the title is a red stamp and a brief Chinese introduction, including "The First Fierce General of the Three Kingdoms," "c. 160–199 AD," and several lines of small serif Chinese text. Infographic panel: Seven translucent parchment event cards are placed around the central rider. Each card has a thin, light gold rectangular border, large two-digit numbers, a Chinese event title, year, a brief Chinese description, and a monochrome sketch-style battle illustration. The seven visible cards are: 01 "Born of Jiuyuan" and "c. 160 AD" (top left); 02 "Valiant General of Bingzhou" and "184 AD" (top right); 03 "Slaying Dong Zhuo" and "189 AD" (center left); 04 "Battle of Hulao Pass" and "190 AD" (center right); 05 "Shooting the Halberd at the Gate" and "191 AD" (bottom left); 06 "Battle of Xiapi" and "194 AD" (bottom right); 07 "Death at Baimen Tower" and "199 AD" (bottom right). The panel should maintain a perspective tilt, appearing to float behind the general and partially obscured by smoke and horses. Bottom Timeline: Seven soft gold timeline milestones are added to the bottom edge, corresponding to the cards: "Born in Jiuyuan around 160 AD," "Joined the army in Bingzhou in 184 AD," "Slayed Dong Zhuo in 189 AD," "Battle of Hulao Pass in 190 AD," "Shooting the Halberd at the Gate in 191 AD," "Battle of Xiapi in 194 AD," and "Death at Baimen Tower in 199 AD." Small dots connect the thin horizontal lines, with subtle decorative patterns below the center. Visual Style: Ultra-refined, cinematic Chinese historical fantasy style, realistic armor and horse anatomy, dynamic feel, shallow depth of field, and a smoke-filled battlefield atmosphere, based on dark brown parchment, accented with ink black, deep bronze, oxblood red, and pale gold highlights. The background panel presents the texture of an archival sketch printed on old paper. Constraints: Use Chinese characters as visible graphic elements, strictly maintain the number of 7 event cards and 7 timeline milestones, no modern items, no logos or watermarks, no extra characters in the foreground, and maintain a poster-style editorial infographic layout.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张关于 {argument name="character name" default="吕布"}（三国传奇名将）的戏剧性竖版历史武将信息图海报，将电影级奇幻写实风格与古风手稿设计相结合。

画布：竖版 3:4 海报，羊皮纸灰纹理背景，带有水墨污渍、尘土、烟雾、战场沙砾及隐约的裂纹。采用高对比度的电影构图，主体人物从中心向外爆发式冲锋。

主体：一位威武的中国古代重装骑兵将军骑着深栗色战马，正向观众直冲而来。骑手身着华丽的深青铜色与黑色扎甲，配有红色布饰、锁链、金属肩甲，以及一顶带有两根极长红色雉鸡翎、向上高耸并向外弯曲的精致头盔。他的面部被刻意用柔和的矩形模糊/遮罩处理，而图像其余部分保持清晰。他将一把巨大的华丽方天画戟刺向镜头，营造出极端的近景透视：武器刃部巨大，因景深效果而模糊，从左下方延伸至骑手手中。战马鬃毛随风飘动，配有装饰性的缰绳、金属饰品、流苏，前腿抬起，扬起泥土与烟雾。

左侧排版：左侧垂直排列巨大的黑色书法标题 {argument name="main title" default="吕布"}，笔触粗犷。旁边放置较小的垂直短语 {argument name="vertical subtitle" default="飞将 · 猛将 · 乱世枭雄"}。标题下方添加红色印章及一段中文简介，包括“三国第一猛将”、“约160年–199年”以及几行小型衬线中文文本。

信息图面板：在中央骑手周围放置 7 个半透明的羊皮纸事件卡片，每张卡片带有细淡金色矩形边框、大号两位数字、中文事件标题、年份、简短中文描述及单色素描风格的战斗插图。7 张可见卡片为：01 “九原出身”及“约160年”（左上）；02 “并州骁将”及“184年”（右上）；03 “诛董卓”及“189年”（中左）；04 “虎牢关之战”及“190年”（中右）；05 “辕门射戟”及“191年”（左下）；06 “下邳之战”及“194年”（右下）；07 “白门楼殒命”及“199年”（右下）。面板需保持透视倾斜，仿佛悬浮在武将身后，并被烟雾和马匹部分遮挡。

底部时间轴：在底部边缘添加 7 个柔和金色的时间轴里程碑，与卡片对应：“约160年 九原出身”、“184年 并州从军”、“189年 诛董卓”、“190年 虎牢关之战”、“191年 辕门射戟”、“194年 下邳之战”、“199年 白门楼殒命”。使用小圆点连接细水平线，中心下方配有微妙的装饰性花纹。

视觉风格：超精细电影级中国历史奇幻风格，写实的盔甲与马匹解剖结构，动态感，浅景深，烟雾缭绕的战场氛围，以深褐色羊皮纸为基调，辅以水墨黑、深青铜色、牛血红及淡金色高光。背景面板呈现出印在旧纸张上的档案素描质感。

约束：使用中文作为可见图形元素，严格保持 7 个事件卡片和 7 个时间轴里程碑的数量，无现代物品，无 Logo 或水印，前景无额外角色，并保持海报式的编辑信息图布局。

templates.title: Ma Chao's Historical Cavalry Timeline Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 马超历史骑兵时间线海报

templates.prompt: Goal: To create a picture about{argument name="character name" default="Ma Chao"} A vertical infographic poster featuring a historical hero. Ma Chao is a valiant ancient Chinese cavalry general. The design needs to combine a cinematic fantasy-realistic style with a timeline layout from ancient manuscripts. Canvas: 3:4 vertical poster, background is aged beige parchment with subtle map lines, battle sketches, dust, ink textures, and nuanced dark brown and gray tones. High-detail digital painting/cinematic historical concept art, with a strong sense of depth and a rugged battlefield atmosphere. Subject: Centered composition.{argument name="character name" default="Ma Chao"} He charges forward on a powerful black warhorse. The rider wears magnificent deep silver scale armor, with engraved patterns, layered shoulder armor, leather belts, a flowing dark cloak, and a high-tied topknot that blows in the wind. His face is partially obscured by a centrally located dark rectangular hood. He thrusts a long silver spear straight at the viewer, creating a strong perspective effect; the spearhead dominates the lower right foreground. The black horse wears exquisite metal visor armor, reins, and decorative tack; its nostrils flare, and dust billows as it gallops. Left-side title area: A large vertical line of black Chinese calligraphy in the upper left corner reads {argument name="main calligraphy title" default="Ma Chao"} Beside him are smaller vertical text reading "Ma Chao, the Magnificent General of Xiliang, Brave and Valiant," with a small red seal below. Below this is a brief Chinese biography in small serif font, beginning with "The Pride of the Xiliang Iron Cavalry" and mentioning "circa 176–222 AD"; maintaining visual realism, compactness, and a slightly faded effect. Timeline/Event Cards: Add eight translucent parchment cards around the rider, each with a thin pale gold border, a two-digit number, a Chinese title, the year, a few lines of small Chinese annotations, and a small monochrome ink-wash illustration of the battle. The eight cards are: 1. "01 Fufeng Maoling," year "circa 176 AD," located to the upper left of the rider. 2. "02 Famous General of Xiliang," year "191 AD," located to the upper right. 3. "03 Battle of Tongguan," year "211 AD," located to the center of the right. 4. “04 Cutting off his beard and abandoning his robe”, year “211”, located in the lower left center. 5. “05 Liangzhou Army”, year “211”, located in the lower left. 6. “06 Surrendering to Liu Bei”, year “214”, located in the lower right center. 7. “07 Marquis of Shehe Township”, year “219”, located in the lower left center. 8. “08 Famous General of Shu Han”, year “222”, located in the lower right. Bottom Timeline: Create a thin, horizontal gold timeline along the bottom edge with 8 markers and labels, corresponding to the years: “circa 176 Fufeng Maoling”, “191 Famous General of Xiliang”, “211 Battle of Tongguan”, “211 Cutting off his beard and abandoning his robe”, “211 Liangzhou Army”, “214 Surrendering to Liu Bei”, “219 Marquis of Shehe Township”, “222 Famous General of Shu Han”. Add a small decorative pattern below the line. Visual Style: A realistic Chinese historical war epic, with an antique museum poster layout, using beige, charcoal, steel blue, black, and light gold tones. Employ the translucency of dusty, torn paper, subtle battlefield silhouettes, and ink-wash overlay effects. The central rider and warhorse should be clear and dramatic, while the background cards and map should be slightly faded. Constraints: Use 8 event cards and 8 bottom timeline markers. All visible typography must be in a Chinese style and integrated into the poster. No modern objects, watermarks, logos, or extra characters in the foreground are allowed. High-saturation bright colors are prohibited.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张关于 {argument name="character name" default="马超"} 的竖版历史英雄信息图海报。马超是一位勇猛的中国古代骑兵将军，设计需结合电影奇幻写实风格与古籍手稿时间线布局。

画布：3:4 竖版海报，背景为陈旧的米色羊皮纸，带有隐约的地图线条、战斗草图、灰尘、水墨纹理以及微妙的深褐色与灰色调。高细节数字绘画 / 电影级历史概念艺术，具有强烈的景深感和粗犷的战场氛围。

主体：构图中心展示 {argument name="character name" default="马超"} 骑着一匹强壮的黑色战马向前冲锋。骑手身穿华丽的深银色鳞甲，带有雕刻纹路、层叠的肩甲、皮带、飘逸的深色披风，以及高高束起的发髻，发丝随风飘动。他的面部被一个居中的深色矩形遮挡块部分遮盖。他将一杆长银枪直刺向观众，形成强烈的透视缩短效果；枪尖占据了右下方的近景。黑马佩戴着精致的金属马面甲、缰绳和装饰性马具，鼻孔张开，奔跑时脚下尘土飞扬。

左侧标题区：左上方有巨大的竖排黑色中国书法，书写着 {argument name="main calligraphy title" default="马超"}。旁边有较小的竖排文字“西凉锦马超 · 骁勇 · 俊烈”，下方盖有一枚红色小印章。下方添加一段简短的中文传记，使用小号衬线字体，开头为“西凉铁骑的骄子”，并提及“约 176 年—222 年”；保持视觉上的真实感、紧凑且略带褪色效果。

时间线/事件卡片：在骑手周围添加 8 张半透明的羊皮纸卡片，每张卡片带有细细的淡金色边框、一个两位数编号、一个中文标题、年份、几行细小的中文注释以及一幅小型单色水墨战斗插图。8 张卡片分别为：
1. “01 扶风茂陵”，年份“约 176 年”，位于骑手左上方。
2. “02 西凉名将”，年份“191 年”，位于右上方。
3. “03 潼关之战”，年份“211 年”，位于右侧中部。
4. “04 割须弃袍”，年份“211 年”，位于左下中部。
5. “05 凉州军”，年份“211 年”，位于左下方。
6. “06 归附刘备”，年份“214 年”，位于右下中部。
7. “07 射鹤乡侯”，年份“219 年”，位于底部左侧中部。
8. “08 蜀汉名将”，年份“222 年”，位于右下方。

底部时间线：沿底边创建一条细长的水平金色时间线，带有 8 个标记点和标签，顺序与年份对应：“约 176 年 扶风茂陵”、“191 年 西凉名将”、“211 年 潼关之战”、“211 年 割须弃袍”、“211 年 凉州军”、“214 年 归附刘备”、“219 年 射鹤乡侯”、“222 年 蜀汉名将”。在线条下方居中添加一个小型的装饰性花纹。

视觉风格：写实的中国历史战争史诗，古董博物馆海报布局，采用米色、炭色、钢蓝色、黑色和淡金色调。使用灰尘、破损纸张的半透明感、隐约的战场剪影和水墨叠加效果。中央的骑手和战马应清晰且具有戏剧性，而背景卡片和地图则略显褪色。

约束：使用 8 张事件卡片和 8 个底部时间线标记。所有可见排版均需采用中式风格并融入海报中。禁止出现现代物品、水印、Logo、前景中不得有额外字符，禁止使用高饱和度的亮色。

templates.title: Cyberpunk Assassins and Neon Glass Daggers

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克刺客与霓虹玻璃匕首

templates.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic, cinematic close-up portrait, with the subject being {argument name="character" default="A cyberpunk female assassin soaked in rain"} Holding{argument name="object" default="A translucent neon glass dagger"} His expression is focused and resolute. The composition is very compact and vertical, focusing on the left side of the character's wet face, ear, neck, shoulder, and hand holding the weapon; most of the face is obscured by a large, square occupant (similar to a censorship mask) in the center, occupying about two-thirds of the image width, filled with a gradient from deep navy to soft blue. It reveals glossy, wet hair clinging to the skin, a visible ear with two small metal piercings, a smooth black leather or tactical collar around the neck, bare, wet shoulders, subtle tattoos on the upper chest, and raindrops scattered across the skin and clothing. A dagger, made of clear glass or crystal, is held vertically on the right side of the image, close to the face, with internally luminous cyan and magenta circuit-like reflections.{argument name="lighting" default="Neon outline lighting in electric blue and vibrant magenta"} It creates a strong reflection on wet skin, hair, leather, and blades. Add{argument name="atmospheric elements" default="A light mist, raindrops, tiny floating particles, and blue fog."} Floating within the frame, creating a melancholic, futuristic film noir tone. The visible eye area is concealed by a square obscuring object, but body language should hint at {argument name="emotion" default="Cold-blooded determination"} Shallow depth of field, dramatic high contrast, ultra-detailed skin texture, glossy mirror highlights, blurred neon background, hyper-realistic photographic style, no text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超写实的电影感特写肖像，主角为 {argument name="character" default="一名被雨水浸透的赛博朋克女性刺客"}，手持 {argument name="object" default="一把半透明的霓虹玻璃匕首"}，神情专注且坚定。构图非常紧凑且呈垂直状，聚焦于角色湿润面部左侧、耳朵、颈部、肩膀以及握住武器的手；大部分面部被一个位于中心的大型方形遮挡物（类似审查遮盖）所遮蔽，该遮挡物约占图像宽度的三分之二，填充着深海军蓝到柔和蓝色的渐变色。展现紧贴皮肤的油亮湿发、带有两个小型金属穿孔的可见耳朵、颈部周围光滑的黑色皮革或战术项圈、裸露的湿润肩膀、上胸部的细微纹身，以及遍布皮肤和衣物的雨滴。匕首垂直握在画面右侧，靠近面部，由透明玻璃或水晶制成，内部带有发光的青色和洋红色电路状反射。使用 {argument name="lighting" default="电光蓝和热烈洋红的霓虹轮廓光"}，在湿润的皮肤、头发、皮革和刀刃上形成强烈的反射。添加 {argument name="atmospheric elements" default="薄雾、雨滴、微小的漂浮颗粒和蓝色雾气"} 在画面中飘动，营造出忧郁的未来主义黑色电影基调。可见的眼睛区域被方形遮挡物隐藏，但肢体语言应暗示出 {argument name="emotion" default="冷酷的决心"}。浅景深，戏剧性的高对比度，超细腻的皮肤纹理，光泽的镜面高光，虚化的霓虹背景，超写实摄影风格，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Mysterious Hermit wielding a divine weapon

titleLocalized.zh: 手持神器的神秘隐匿者

templates.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic, cinematic close-up portrait depicting an aged, enigmatic figure whose face and upper body are obscured by a large, matte brown occlusion square at the center of the image. The visible portion shows long, disheveled, graying hair hanging down from either side, a forehead edged with dirt and ash, and at the bottom, a pair of weathered, grime-covered hands intently holding a beautifully carved brass or gold spherical artifact. Please use {argument name="character" default="An elderly, mysterious figure"} ,{argument name="object" default="A beautifully engraved brass sphere"} as well as{argument name="lighting" default="The warm firelight intertwined with the dim shadows of smoke."} Subtle metallic reflections are captured on artifacts, disheveled nails, skin texture, and stray strands of hair. Orange sparks and wisps of smoke drift against a dark background, accompanied by shallow depth of field and blurred golden foreground light spots. The overall atmosphere is tense, ancient, ritualistic, and mysterious; the veiled eyes should be hinted at to convey {argument name="emotion" default="strong determination"} Vertical 3:4 composition, macro lens realism, rough skin details, high contrast, cinematic color grading, no text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超写实电影感特写肖像，描绘一位年迈的神秘人物，其面部和上半身被一个位于画面中心的大型纯哑光棕色遮挡方块所掩盖。可见部分展示了从两侧垂下的凌乱灰白长发、顶部边缘布满污垢和灰烬的前额，以及底部那双饱经风霜、沾满污垢的手，正专注地捧着一件雕刻精美的黄铜或金色球形神器。请使用 {argument name="character" default="一位年迈的神秘人物"}、{argument name="object" default="一颗雕刻精美的黄铜球体"} 以及 {argument name="lighting" default="温暖的火光与昏暗烟雾阴影交织"}。神器、脏乱的指甲、皮肤纹理和零散的发丝上捕捉到细微的金属反光。橙色的火花和淡淡的烟雾在深色背景中飘动，伴随浅景深和模糊的金色前景光斑。整体氛围紧张、古老、充满仪式感且神秘；应暗示被遮挡的双眼以传达 {argument name="emotion" default="强烈的决心"}。垂直 3:4 构图，微距镜头真实感，粗犷的皮肤细节，高对比度，电影级调色，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Close-up of deep-sea divers and mysterious artifacts

titleLocalized.zh: 深海潜水员与神秘文物特写

templates.prompt: Cinematic hyper-realistic close-up portrait, with the main subject of the image being {argument name="character" default="An antique deep-sea diver wearing a weathered brass diving helmet"} He was concentrating on{argument name="object" default="A mysterious dark square artifact"} Held directly in front of the face. The object, centered in the image, obscures most of the mask, appearing as a flat, almost black, charcoal-gray square with sharp, clean edges and no markings. The bottom foreground shows the diver's wet, gloved hands, fingers gripping the artifact, rendered with realistic skin/leather texture, water droplets, dirt, and highlights. The helmet fills the entire image: aged bronze and blackened metal, round rivets, ornate round side fittings, corroded seams, scratches, algae-like residue, and the faintly visible edges of a glass porthole around the square object. The scene lighting is {argument name="lighting" default="The cool blue underwater light on the left, with a warm amber reflection on the brass edge."} Add to the image{argument name="atmospheric elements" default="Suspended bubbles, floating particles, and murky underwater mist"} The overall atmosphere is tense and mysterious; the eyes faintly visible behind the glass should convey {argument name="emotion" default="obsession and fear"} It features shallow depth of field, macro-level detail, cinematic contrast, gradation of cyan and blue tones, a glossy, wet surface, and a volumetric underwater atmosphere. It contains no text, no watermark, and uses a vertical 4:5 composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 电影级超写实特写肖像，画面主体为 {argument name="character" default="一名戴着风化黄铜潜水头盔的古董深海潜水员"}，正全神贯注地将 {argument name="object" default="一块神秘的深色方形文物"} 举在脸部正前方。该物体位于画面中心，遮挡了大部分面罩，呈现为一块平整、近乎黑色的炭灰色方形，边缘锐利整洁，表面无任何标记。画面底部前景展示潜水员湿润的戴手套双手，手指紧扣文物，呈现出逼真的皮肤/皮革纹理、水滴、污垢及高光反射。头盔充满整个画面：陈旧的青铜与发黑的金属材质，圆形的铆钉，华丽的圆形侧面配件，腐蚀的接缝，划痕，类似藻类的残留物，以及在方形物体周围隐约可见的玻璃舷窗边缘。场景光效为 {argument name="lighting" default="左侧冷蓝色水下光线，黄铜边缘带有温暖的琥珀色反射"}。画面中添加 {argument name="atmospheric elements" default="悬浮的气泡、漂浮的微粒和浑浊的水下雾气"}。整体氛围紧张且神秘；玻璃后若隐隐可见双眼，应传达出 {argument name="emotion" default="专注的执念与恐惧"}。采用浅景深、微距级细节、电影级对比度、青蓝色调分级、光泽湿润的表面、体积感水下氛围，无文字，无水印，垂直 4:5 构图。

templates.title: Pop Art Lucky Cat Explosion

titleLocalized.zh: 波普艺术招财猫大爆发

templates.prompt: Create a vibrant vertical poster illustration featuring a group of {argument name="lucky cat count" default="42"} A Japanese lucky cat statue floats and tumbles in a white space, seemingly bursting outwards from the center, bringing blessings of good fortune. The main subject is an oversized white ceramic lucky cat in the foreground, positioned slightly lower. It has yellow and black eyes, red inner ears, a pink nose, black whisker markings, a raised left paw, a red collar with gold studs and a gold bell, and a large oval gold coin hanging on its chest, with striking black Japanese characters printed on it. Surrounding it are 41 similar lucky cats of varying sizes and rotation angles: 6 large auxiliary cats at the edge, 11 medium-sized cats in the midground, and 24 tiny distant cats scattered in the background. All the cats should have the same glossy white ceramic texture, red collar, gold bell, gold coin plaque, yellow eyes, red ears, and black calligraphy patterns, but in different poses, including a raised left paw, a raised right paw, a frontal sitting posture, a side view, an upside-down rolling posture, and close-ups of paws or bodies. Employing a dramatic fisheye perspective, the central cat is closest to the viewer, while the others recede into the distance. Visual style: Ultra-refined 3D ceramic pop art rendering, with the cats adorned with intricately sculpted outlines and patterns, featuring subtle iridescent hues, glossy highlights, and crisp, high-contrast lighting. Vibrant Japanese graphic design elements are incorporated behind and into the gaps between the cats: bright pink diagonal stripes, yellow arcs, bursts of black lines, cyan/magenta halftone dots, radiating speed lines, geometric rectangles, and neon print textures scattered across a pure white background. The overall composition should evoke joy, chaos, luck, and celebration, like a futuristic lucky cat blessing poster. Canvas: Vertical 2:3 poster, full bleed, high resolution, dense yet legible composition. A small handwritten signature/date mark is placed in the lower right corner, containing the following information:{argument name="date text" default="May 14, 2026"} and{argument name="signature text" default="Oyagi"} Do not use any other English text besides the date/signature; Japanese characters may only appear as decorative black lettering on the coins. Keep the foreground cat sharp and clear, with smaller cats and background patterns layered in the background. Avoid photorealistic fur, people, landscapes, borders, or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张充满活力的垂直海报插画，画面中一群 {argument name="lucky cat count" default="42"} 只日本招财猫雕像在白色空间中漂浮翻滚，仿佛从中心向外爆发，带来好运的祝福。主体是前景中一只超大的白色陶瓷招财猫，位置略微偏下，它有着黄黑色的眼睛、红色的耳内侧、粉色的鼻子、黑色的胡须纹路、抬起的左爪、带有金色铆钉和金铃铛的红色项圈，胸前挂着一枚巨大的椭圆形金币，上面印有醒目的黑色日式文字。在它周围环绕着 41 只大小和旋转角度各异的同款招财猫：边缘处有 6 只大型辅助猫，中景有 11 只中型猫，背景中散布着 24 只微小的远景猫。所有猫咪都应具有相同的光泽白色陶瓷质感、红色项圈、金铃铛、金币牌、黄色眼睛、红色耳朵和黑色书法纹样，但姿态各异，包括抬左爪、抬右爪、正面坐姿、侧面视角、倒立翻滚姿势，以及局部截取的爪子或身体特写。采用戏剧性的鱼眼广角透视，中央的猫咪离观众最近，其余猫咪向纵深处退去。

视觉风格：超精细的 3D 陶瓷波普艺术渲染，猫身上包裹着精细的雕刻轮廓线条图案，带有微妙的彩虹色色差、光泽高光和清脆的高对比度照明。在猫咪身后和缝隙间加入充满活力的日本平面设计元素：亮粉色斜条纹、黄色弧线、黑色线条爆发、青色/洋红色半调网点、放射状速度线、几何矩形以及散布在纯白背景上的霓虹印刷纹理。整体构图应充满欢乐、混沌、幸运和庆典感，如同未来主义的招财猫祝福海报。

画布：垂直 2:3 海报，全出血设计，高分辨率，构图密集但清晰易读。在右下角放置一个小的手写签名/日期标记，内容为 {argument name="date text" default="2026 年 5 月 14 日"} 和 {argument name="signature text" default="Oyagi"}。除日期/签名外，不要使用任何其他英文文本；日式文字仅可作为金币上的装饰性黑色字形出现。保持前景猫咪清晰锐利，较小的猫咪和背景图案层叠在后方，避免出现照片级写实的毛发、人物、风景、边框或水印。

templates.title: A broken porcelain doll girl holding a heart

titleLocalized.zh: 手捧心脏的破碎瓷偶少女

templates.prompt: A cinematic, hyper-realistic close-up portrait depicting a fragile, Gothic-style porcelain doll-like woman.{argument name="character" default="A pale-faced, cracked porcelain bionic girl"} Holding{argument name="object" default="A broken white ceramic dissected heart"} Her expression was focused and solemn. She had a short black bob with neat bangs; her translucent, pale skin was covered with fine cracks on her cheeks and the bridge of her nose; her lips were slightly parted, glistening; one eye was a deep human eye, the other a cloudy, shattered glass-like eye surrounded by cracks, radiating with dark tear stains. In the foreground, her hands, clad in black lace gloves, cradled a heart; the ceramic heart had cracks and chips on its surface, one crack emitting a faint red glow. She wore dark Victorian-style lace clothing, metal chain earrings, dangling beads, and antique ornaments; her porcelain face, eyes, lips, gloves, chains, and broken heart all had a delicate, moist reflection. The scene used {argument name="lighting" default="Cool blue-gray side lighting, accompanied by a faint internal red glow."} The lighting creates deep shadows, soft rim lighting, and a melancholic contrast of light and shadow. The image incorporates {argument name="atmospheric elements" default="Tiny red embers, dust particles, and floating glassy droplets"} Her eyes conveyed {argument name="emotion" default="A melancholic obsession and a tranquil longing"} Macro lens texture, shallow depth of field, highly reproduces skin cracks, ceramic texture, lace fibers and reflective highlights, uses dark desaturated tones and is embellished with red, 4:5 vertical composition, no text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 电影级超写实特写肖像，描绘了一位脆弱的哥特风格瓷偶女性，{argument name="character" default="一位面色苍白、布满裂纹的瓷质仿生少女"} 正怀抱着 {argument name="object" default="一颗破碎的白色陶瓷解剖心脏"}，神情专注而凝重。她留着黑色短波波头，配有整齐的刘海；半透明的苍白皮肤上，脸颊和鼻梁处布满了细密的裂纹；双唇微张，泛着光泽；一只眼睛是深邃的人类眼眸，另一只则是被裂纹环绕、浑浊如碎玻璃般的眼球，周围伴有放射状裂痕和深色的泪痕。她戴着黑色蕾丝手套的双手在前景中捧着心脏；陶瓷心脏表面有裂纹和缺口，其中一道裂缝透出微弱的红光。她身着深色维多利亚风格蕾丝服饰，佩戴金属链条耳环、垂坠珠饰及陈旧的装饰品；瓷质面部、眼部、唇部、手套、链条及破碎的心脏上均有细腻的湿润反光。场景采用 {argument name="lighting" default="冷蓝灰色侧光，伴随微弱的内部红光"} 照明，营造出深邃的阴影、柔和的轮廓光以及忧郁的明暗对照效果。画面中加入 {argument name="atmospheric elements" default="细小的红色余烬、尘埃微粒以及漂浮的玻璃状液滴"}。她的眼神传达出 {argument name="emotion" default="忧郁的执念与静谧的渴望"}。微距镜头质感，浅景深，高度还原皮肤裂纹、陶瓷质感、蕾丝纤维及反光高光，采用深色去饱和色调并点缀红色，4:5 竖构图，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: PhonePe bill-sharing party ad

titleLocalized.zh: PhonePe 分摊账单派对广告

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="brand name" default="PhonePe"} Create a sophisticated vertical social media ad to promote UPI Pay's instant group bill splitting feature with a bold party/nightlife vibe. Canvas: 1:1 square digital ad, high resolution, deep purple and neon purple color scheme, glossy fintech marketing style with dramatic depth-of-field effects. Background: A rooftop restaurant or lounge at night with purple highlights and a group of friends around a table. Layout: Top left corner displays the white PhonePe logo and wordmark. Top right corner displays a small shield icon with the words "Trusted UPI". Behind the main body, place large, semi-transparent purple text "NO DRAMA", slightly tilted and filling the top left background. Top right corner features a bold white capitalized headline: "PAY YOUR PART. KEEP THE VIBE.", below which is the subheading: "One tap and everyone's sorted." Add a short decorative underline below the subheading. Subject: In the foreground, a young woman stands confidently beside a party table, wearing a purple baseball jacket over a white crop top and light-colored jeans, with black nail polish. She holds a large-screen smartphone close to the camera with her left hand, making it the dominant object in the foreground, while her other hand playfully points forward. Her face should be covered by a natural skin-toned brown rectangle, and the visible faces of her three seated friends in the background should also be covered by similar skin-toned rectangles. Keep the pose, clothing, and lighting stylish and youthful. Phone Screen: Displays a purple PhonePe-style bill-sharing interface titled "Dinner Split." The time is displayed at the top: "9:41." Large amount: "₹3240." Below: "8 friends • ₹405 each." A green success card displays "Paid by everyone" and "Completed instantly." Below, display a precise list of 8 friends, each with a small circular avatar, name, amount "₹405", and a green checkmark: 1) Ananya, 2) Rohan, 3) Karan, 4) Meera, 5) Arjun, 6) Simran, 7) Vikram, 8) Neha. At the bottom of the screen, add a purple rounded button labeled "Split Again" with a white shield/checkmark icon. Floating UI elements: Add 3 glowing purple transaction cards connected by a dotted curve and small circular avatar bubbles: 1) "Payment Sent ₹405" with a lightning bolt icon, 2) "Paid ₹405" with a green checkmark icon, 3) "All Settled! Everyone Paid" with a green checkmark icon. Let them float around the hand that the main body points to on the right. Call to Action (CTA): Place a large white pill-shaped button near the center of the bottom right corner, with the purple text "Split in Seconds" and a right-pointing arrow icon. Bottom Information Bar: Add a semi-transparent, rounded purple bar containing four function capsules/icons from left to right: 1) a lightning bolt icon with "Instant settlements," 2) a group icon with "Group friendly," 3) a shield icon with "Safe UPI payments," and 4) a phone icon with "Everywhere accepted." Below or next to it, display a small group icon labeled "500M+ Indians use PhonePe." In the bottom right corner, include two App Store badges: "GET IT ON Google Play" and "Download on the App Store." Side Text: Add small white vertical text along the left edge: "PHONEPE • Split Billing • Social Pay • 2026." Visual Style: High-end hyper-realistic ad compositing, cinematic purple contour lighting, glossy UI overlay, neon lighting effects, vibrant nightlife atmosphere, sharp foreground phone, blurred background friends and city lights, and clear, legible typography. Constraints: Use precise visible quantities: 8 lines of friends list on the phone, 3 floating payment cards, 4 bottom function items, 2 store badges, and a total of 4 face-covering squares. Avoid adding extra logos, extra payment cards, or extra function capsules.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="brand name" default="PhonePe"} 制作一个精致的竖版社交媒体广告，以大胆的派对/夜生活氛围推广 UPI 支付的即时群组账单分摊功能。

画布：1:1 正方形数字广告，高分辨率，深紫色和霓虹紫配色，光泽感金融科技营销风格，具有戏剧性的景深效果。背景为夜晚的屋顶餐厅或酒廊，带有紫色光斑，以及餐桌旁的一群朋友。

布局：左上角显示白色的 PhonePe 标志和文字标识。右上角显示一个带有“Trusted UPI”文字的小盾牌图标。在主体后方，放置巨大的半透明紫色文字“NO DRAMA”，稍微倾斜并填充左上角背景。在右上角，放置加粗的白色大写主标题：“PAY YOUR PART. KEEP THE VIBE.”，下方为副标题：“One tap and everyone’s sorted.”。在副标题下方添加一条简短的装饰性下划线。

主体：前景中一位年轻女性自信地站在派对桌旁，身穿紫色棒球夹克，内搭白色露脐上衣和浅色牛仔裤，涂着黑色指甲油。她左手将一部大屏智能手机靠近镜头，使其成为前景的主导物体，同时另一只手俏皮地指向前方。她的脸部应被一个自然的肤色棕色矩形遮挡块覆盖，背景中三位坐着的朋友的可见脸部也应被类似的肤色矩形块覆盖。保持姿势、服装和灯光时尚且年轻化。

手机屏幕：展示一个紫色的 PhonePe 风格账单分摊界面，标题为“Dinner Split”。顶部显示时间“9:41”。大额金额：“₹3240”。下方显示：“8 friends • ₹405 each”。一张绿色成功卡片显示“Paid by everyone”和“Completed instantly”。在下方，准确显示 8 行分项好友列表，每行包含一个小圆形头像、姓名、金额“₹405”和一个绿色对勾：1) Ananya, 2) Rohan, 3) Karan, 4) Meera, 5) Arjun, 6) Simran, 7) Vikram, 8) Neha。在屏幕底部，添加一个紫色的圆角按钮，标注为“Split Again”，并带有白色盾牌/对勾图标。

浮动 UI 元素：添加 3 张发光的紫色交易卡片，通过虚线曲线和小圆形头像气泡连接：1) 带有闪电图标的“Payment Sent ₹405”，2) 带有绿色对勾图标的“Paid ₹405”，3) 带有绿色对勾图标的“All Settled! Everyone Paid”。让它们悬浮在右侧主体指向的手部周围。

号召性用语 (CTA)：在右下角中心附近，放置一个大的白色药丸状按钮，带有紫色文字“Split in Seconds”和一个向右的箭头图标。

底部信息栏：添加一个半透明的圆角紫色长条，从左到右包含 4 个功能胶囊/图标：1) 带有“Instant settlements”的闪电图标，2) 带有“Group friendly”的群组图标，3) 带有“Safe UPI payments”的盾牌图标，4) 带有“Everywhere accepted”的手机图标。在其下方或旁边显示一个小群组图标，标注“500M+ Indians use PhonePe”。在右下角，包含 2 个应用商店徽章：“GET IT ON Google Play”和“Download on the App Store”。

侧边文字：沿左侧边缘，添加白色小字竖排文字：“PHONEPE • SPLIT BILLING • SOCIAL PAY • 2026”。

视觉风格：高级超写实广告合成，电影级紫色轮廓光，光泽感 UI 叠加，霓虹光效，充满活力的夜生活氛围，清晰的前景手机，模糊的背景朋友和城市灯光，清晰易读的排版。

约束条件：使用精确的可见数量：手机上有 8 行好友列表，3 张浮动支付卡片，4 个底部功能项，2 个商店徽章，总共 4 个遮挡脸部的方块。避免添加额外的标志、额外的支付卡片或额外的功能胶囊。

templates.title: Mini World Food Landscape Grid

titleLocalized.zh: 迷你世界美食景观网格

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a 2x2 grid showcasing four surreal, miniature edible city landscapes, each rising from a vast, meticulously detailed golden sugarcane desert, photographed in a high-end miniature style with cinematic lighting effects. Using{argument name="overall theme" default="Universal Mini World Foodscape"} As a concept: Iconic landmarks and skyscrapers are meticulously crafted from colorful candy, pastries, vegetables, spices, cookies, sugar glass, jellies, and confectionery materials. Canvas: A square image with four equal panels separated by thick black borders. Each panel is a delicate miniature scene with shallow depth of field, glowing city lights, shimmering sugar granules, tiny trees, and a dreamy atmospheric haze. High-detail miniature photographic look, saturated jewel tones, warm highlights, and dark vignetting edges. No figures are included except for miniature statues or landmark replicas. Layout: Precisely arranged 4 labeled panels in a 2x2 layout. Count and Labels: 1) Top Left: “MINI NYC”; 2) Top Right: “MINI LONDON”; 3) Bottom Left: “MINI BEIJING”; 4) Bottom Right: “MINI TOKYO”. Each title is displayed in elegant white serif capital letters in the upper left of the panel, with “MINI” smaller where necessary. Labels are kept clear and spelled accurately. Panel Details: The "MINI NYC" in the upper left corner showcases a miniature New York skyline beside a turquoise lake, with a miniature Statue of Liberty on a small island in the foreground, a candy-colored skyscraper resembling the Empire State Building, a spire similar to the Chrysler Building, various cylindrical candy towers, palm-shaped edible plants, broccoli-shaped trees, glowing windows, and undulating sugar dunes behind the skyline.{argument name="first city label" default="MINI NYC"} As a visible title, the "MINI LONDON" in the upper right corner showcases edible London landmarks on a golden sugar-sand terrain, with a small river or lagoon in the foreground: Tower Bridge made of orange biscuits/candy, a Big Ben/Elizabeth Tower-style clock tower, a towering Shard-style sugar glass tower, a "Gherkin" building with a diamond-shaped icing pattern, red-orange skyscrapers, tiny trees, and a melancholic night sky with pink and red bokeh lights.{argument name="second city label" default="MINI LONDON"} As a visible title, the "MINI BEIJING" in the lower left corner showcases a miniature Beijing culinary landscape, including a magnificent circular Temple of Heaven-style building, ornate red and gold palace roofs, pagoda-shaped towers, a CCTV headquarters-style angular building in the background, a red China Gate Bridge spanning blue waters in the foreground, lush edible greenery, sugar dunes, mist, and warm lantern-shaped lights.{argument name="third city label" default="MINI BEIJING"} As a visible title, the "MINI TOKYO" in the bottom right corner showcases a miniature Tokyo food scene at dusk, with a bright red Tokyo Tower at the center, pale Tokyo Skytree-style towers to the right, dense candy-colored skyscrapers, a red torii gate spanning a deep blue body of water in the foreground, koi-shaped desserts, pink flower-like candy flowers, neatly trimmed edible shrubs, and a purple-blue neon skyline.{argument name="fourth city label" default="MINI TOKYO"} As a visible title. Visual Style: Ultra-detailed miniatures, whimsical surrealist culinary art, photorealistic textures, edible architecture, shimmering sugar sand, dramatic studio lighting, soft fog, miniature scale, tilt-shift depth of field, rich contrast, high saturation, sharp landmarks, and a fantastical travel poster atmosphere. Constraints: Use a precise 4-panel layout and 4 listed city titles. Do not add extra panels, titles, logos, watermarks, UI elements, or real people. Retain black borders between panels. Make each city visually unique and recognizable through landmarks while maintaining the edible and miniature feel of all structures.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个 2x2 的网格，展示四个超现实的微缩可食用城市美食景观，每座城市都从广阔的精细金色蔗糖沙漠中升起，并以高端微缩模型的方式进行拍摄，呈现电影般的灯光效果。使用 {argument name="overall theme" default="Universal Mini World Foodscape"} 作为概念：标志性地标和摩天大楼由色彩缤纷的糖果、糕点、蔬菜、香料、饼干、糖玻璃、果冻和糖果材料精心制作而成。

画布：正方形图像，四个相等的面板由粗黑边隔开，每个面板都是一个精致的微缩场景，具有浅景深、发光的城市灯光、闪烁的糖粒、微小的树木和梦幻般的大气薄雾。高细节微缩摄影外观，饱和的宝石色调，温暖的高光，深色晕影边缘，除微型雕像或地标复制品外，不包含人物。

布局：精确的 4 个带标签面板，呈 2x2 排列。计数和标签：1) 左上： “MINI NYC”；2) 右上： “MINI LONDON”；3) 左下： “MINI BEIJING”；4) 右下： “MINI TOKYO”。每个标题均以优雅的白色衬线大写字母显示在面板左上方，必要时“MINI”字样较小。保持标签清晰且拼写准确。

面板细节：左上角的“MINI NYC”展示了绿松石色湖泊旁的微缩纽约天际线，前景中有一个小岛上的微型自由女神像，一座类似帝国大厦的糖果摩天大楼，类似克莱斯勒大厦的尖顶，各种圆柱形糖果塔，棕榈状的可食用植物，西兰花状的树木，发光的窗户，以及天际线后起伏的糖沙丘。使用 {argument name="first city label" default="MINI NYC"} 作为可见标题。

右上角的“MINI LONDON”展示了金色糖沙地形上的可食用伦敦地标，前方有一条小河或泻湖：由橙色饼干/糖果制成的塔桥，大本钟/伊丽莎白塔风格的钟楼，高耸的碎片大厦风格糖玻璃塔，带有菱形糖霜图案的“小黄瓜”大楼，红橙色的摩天大楼，微小的树木，以及带有粉色和红色散景灯光的忧郁夜空。使用 {argument name="second city label" default="MINI LONDON"} 作为可见标题。

左下角的“MINI BEIJING”展示了微缩北京美食景观，包括宏伟的圆形天坛风格建筑，华丽的红金宫殿屋顶，宝塔状塔楼，背景中 CCTV 总部风格的角状建筑，前景中横跨蓝色水域的红色中国门桥，郁郁葱葱的可食用绿植，糖沙丘，薄雾和温暖的灯笼状光芒。使用 {argument name="third city label" default="MINI BEIJING"} 作为可见标题。

右下角的“MINI TOKYO”展示了黄昏时分的微缩东京美食景观，中心是鲜红色的东京塔，右侧是苍白的东京晴空塔风格塔楼，密集的糖果摩天大楼，前景中横跨深蓝色水域的红色鸟居，锦鲤形状的甜点，粉色花朵般的糖果花，修剪整齐的可食用灌木，以及紫蓝色的霓虹天际线光芒。使用 {argument name="fourth city label" default="MINI TOKYO"} 作为可见标题。

视觉风格：超细节微缩模型，异想天开的超现实美食艺术，照片级真实纹理，可食用建筑，闪烁的砂糖沙，戏剧性的摄影棚灯光，柔和的雾气，微缩比例，移轴景深，丰富的对比度，高饱和度，清晰的地标，奇幻旅行海报氛围。

约束：使用精确的 4 个面板和列出的 4 个城市标题。不要添加额外的面板、标题、徽标、水印、UI 元素或真实人物。保留面板之间的黑色边框。通过地标使每个城市在视觉上独特且可辨认，同时保持所有结构的可食用性和微缩感。

templates.title: Mini London Candy Landscape

titleLocalized.zh: 迷你伦敦糖果景观

templates.prompt: Create a square, cinematic macro photograph to present a title{argument name="title text" default="MINI LONDON"} A surreal miniature culinary landscape showcasing London rising from a vast, finely detailed, shimmering golden sugar desert. promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个超现实的微距美食艺术微型城市景观，标题为 {argument name="headline text" default="MINI BEIJING"}，展示北京从一片广阔的金色细砂糖沙漠中升起。中心是一座精致的可食用天坛：圆形的层叠白糖石露台、雕刻的台阶、圆形的白色栏杆，以及带有金色顶饰的深靛紫色脊屋顶。周围环绕着 12 个独特的微型可食用北京风格建筑和地标：左侧 1 座白塔，左前方 1 座红色和金色的宫殿亭，右侧 1 座较大的红色和金色宫殿大厅，中央寺庙两侧各有 1 座红色小寺庙建筑，前景中有一个横跨绿松石色池塘的橙红色仪式门，右侧有 1 座类似中央电视台总部的绿色网格状现代拱门，后左侧中心有 1 座高大的金色针状摩天大楼，后中心有 1 座发光的红色层叠塔，后右侧有 1 座高大的琥珀色灯光摩天大楼，远景背景中有 1 座紫色灯光的垂直塔，寺庙后方有 1 座圆形的玻璃穹顶建筑。使所有建筑看起来都由可食用材料制成，如糖晶体、糖果、威化饼、糖霜、果冻、翻糖、芝麻和半透明硬糖，并带有温暖的发光窗户和糖果般的细节。地面是质感丰富的金色糖沙漠，中央广场周围散布着白色糖珠、橙色糖果砖路径、微小的西兰花状树木和灌木、可食用草芦、小石块，底部有一个浅浅的明亮绿松石色糖果水池。使用电影级的浅景深：焦点清晰地对准天坛和前景的大门，背景中的摩天大楼天际线柔和模糊，营造出大气感的粉紫色薄雾和温暖的橙色光线，高对比度，具有光泽的微距摄影外观，方形构图。将标题文本放置在左上角，使用优雅且带有间距的白色衬线大写字母，分为两行，内容完全为 {argument name="headline text" default="MINI BEIJING"}。画面中没有人、车辆、额外的标签或水印。

templates.prompt: Goal: To create an exquisitely detailed, handcrafted, edible art world to celebrate the arrival of spring in a cute Japanese spring bento style.{argument name="celebration" default="Mother's Day"} Transform a complete meal into an adorable centerpiece made entirely of real food. Visuals: 1:1 square overhead food photography composition, bright and soft tones, soft natural light, shallow depth of field yet all main food items are clearly visible, festive blue tablecloth background covered with cherry blossoms, pink carnations, doodle hearts, clouds, glitter, and tiny celebratory decorations. Main Centerpiece: In the center of a large, round, pink bento plate, create a large, edible girl character: a face made of rice with shiny black eyes, eyelashes, rosy cheeks, a smiling mouth, long blonde hair made of thin egg crepe/noodle strands, pink flower hair accessories, pink heart earrings, a kimono-style outfit made of pink ham and blue rice/crepe layers, holding a bouquet of pink carnations tied with a bow. The character should evoke the feeling of a loving Mother's Day food art doll. The food elements to be included consist of 15 visible edible features: 1) The central girl character, 2) Two smiling rice balls with seaweed rectangles and shiso leaves behind her, 3) A small basket of strawberries, one of which is cut in half, 4) Heart-shaped pudding on a pink plate, 5) Red octopus sausages with expressions and bow ties, 6) A cluster of cherry tomatoes and vegetable flowers, 7) A bouquet of pink carnations in the character's hand, 8) An egg roll/noodle rose near the top center, 9) A pink fruit bowl containing green grapes, orange segments, and a pink heart-shaped candy, 10) A heart-shaped tamagoyaki with two small red hearts, 11) Two fried shrimp with orange tails, 12) Broccoli and lemon wedges as decoration, 13) Neapolitan pasta in a pink wavy cup with peas and flower-shaped toppings, 14) A small mound of rice or dumplings next to the pasta, 15) A separate small plate in the lower right corner with cherry blossom mochi wrapped in leaves and decorated with pink flowers. The following eight sets of non-food props and decorations are required: 1) A teacup in the upper right corner containing hot tea, decorated with cute anime girl illustrations and floral patterns; 2) A woven coaster under the cup; 3) A pink triangular flag spanning the background; 4) Two fluffy white cloud paper cutouts near the Japanese text; 5) A floral greeting card in a strawberry basket; 6) A floral thank-you card tied with a pink ribbon in the lower left corner; 7) Two carp streamer decorations in the center of the bottom; 8) A small pink brush on the floral paper in the lower right corner. Text content: Add handwritten Japanese text to the sky area.{argument name="background Japanese message" default="おかあさんへ いつもありがとう！！"} Add a pink heart-shaped speech bubble near the top right corner, with the following content:{argument name="heart speech bubble" default="だいすき だよ〜♡"} Add a small flower card to the strawberry basket with the following message:{argument name="card text" default="Happy Mother's Day"} Add a flower card in the bottom left corner with the following content:{argument name="bottom card Japanese text" default="With gratitude..."} Maintain the hand-drawn style of the text, cute and slightly imperfect, and blend naturally into the scene. Visual style: Ultra-detailed, adorable edible miniature art, Japanese bento craftsmanship, soft pink and sky blue, glossy rice grains, crispy fried texture, soft egg crepe strands, realistic fruits and tea, abundant cherry blossom and carnation patterns, whimsical hearts and sparkles. Make everything look like it was handmade from food, full of a cheerful, warm, and celebratory atmosphere. Constraints: Use a top-down tiled angle, no figures, no tableware except for decorative brushes, no watermarks, no extra text except for the specified text, and ensure that all counted food and prop sets are clearly visible.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一个超精细的手工可食用艺术世界，以可爱的日式春季便当风格庆祝 {argument name="celebration" default="母亲节"}，将一顿完整的餐点转化为完全由真实食物制成的可爱角色中心装饰。

画面：1:1 正方形俯视美食摄影构图，明亮的柔和色调，柔和的自然光，浅景深但所有主要食物清晰可见，节日蓝色桌布背景，上面覆盖着樱花、粉色康乃馨、涂鸦爱心、云朵、闪光和微小的庆典装饰。

主要中心装饰：在一个大型圆形粉色便当盘中央，制作一个大型可食用女孩角色：米饭做的脸，有着闪亮的黑色眼睛、睫毛、红润的脸颊、微笑的嘴巴，用薄蛋皮/面条丝制成的长金发，粉色花朵发饰，粉色爱心耳环，由粉色火腿和蓝色米饭/可丽饼层制成的和服式服装，手里捧着一束系着蝴蝶结的粉色康乃馨花束。该角色应呈现出一种充满爱意的母亲节食物艺术玩偶的感觉。

需包含的食物元素，共 15 组可见的可食用特征：1) 中央女孩角色，2) 她身后两个带有海苔长方形和青紫苏叶的微笑饭团，3) 一小篮草莓，其中一颗已切半，4) 粉色碟子上的心形布丁，5) 带有表情和领结的红色章鱼香肠，6) 一簇圣女果和蔬菜花，7) 角色手中的粉色康乃馨花束，8) 顶部中央附近的蛋卷/面条玫瑰，9) 粉色水果碗，内含青葡萄、橙子瓣和一颗粉色爱心糖果，10) 带有两个小红心的心形玉子烧，11) 两只带橙色尾巴的炸虾，12) 西兰花和柠檬角装饰，13) 粉色波纹杯装的拿坡里意面，配有豌豆和花形配料，14) 意面旁边的一小团米饭或饺子，15) 右下角单独的小盘子，上面放着包裹在叶子里并饰有粉色花朵的樱饼。

需包含的非食物道具和装饰，共 8 组可见元素：1) 右上角的茶杯，内有热茶，杯身有可爱的动漫女孩插画和花卉图案，2) 杯子下的编织杯垫，3) 背景上方横跨的三角形粉色旗帜，4) 日文文字附近的两个蓬松小白云剪纸，5) 草莓篮中的花卉贺卡，6) 左下角系着粉色丝带的花卉致谢卡，7) 底部中央的两个鲤鱼旗装饰，8) 右下角花卉纸上的粉色小刷子。

文字内容：在天空区域添加手写日文 {argument name="background Japanese message" default="おかあさんへ いつもありがとう！！"}。在右上角附近添加一个粉色爱心对话气泡，内容为 {argument name="heart speech bubble" default="だいすき だよ〜♡"}。在草莓篮中添加一张小花卡片，内容为 {argument name="card text" default="Happy Mother's Day"}。在左下角添加一张花卉卡片，内容为 {argument name="bottom card Japanese text" default="感謝をこめて…"}。保持文字手绘风格，可爱且略带不完美感，并自然地融入场景中。

视觉风格：超精细可爱风可食用微缩艺术，日式便当工艺，柔和粉色和天蓝色，光泽感米粒，酥脆的油炸质感，柔软的蛋皮丝，逼真的水果和茶，丰富的樱花和康乃馨图案，奇思妙想的爱心和闪光。让一切看起来都像是用食物手工制作的，充满欢快、温馨和庆典氛围。

约束条件：使用俯视平铺角度，无人物，除装饰用小刷子外无餐具，无水印，除指定的文字外无额外文字，确保所有统计的食物和道具组清晰可见。

templates.title: Isometric safety icon grid

titleLocalized.zh: 等轴测安全图标网格

templates.prompt: Create a modern isometric illustration on a clean, light gray background, showcasing a seamless grid of icons representing cybersecurity, privacy, and compliance. Features soft shadows, glossy 3D textures, rounded edges, and a color scheme of blue, white, gray, red, and orange. Use a wide, horizontal canvas with evenly spaced rows and columns, and no borders or watermarks. Containing 15 individual icons arranged in a 3x5 grid: First row: 1) A blue padlock with a silver clasp and black keyhole; 2) A blue shield badge with a white checkmark and metallic edges; 3) A slanted silver key; 4) A dark biometric panel resembling a smartphone, displaying glowing blue fingerprint scanning lines; 5) A desktop login screen with a lock icon, keypad, and a blue "LOGIN" button; Second row: 6) A white document page with a folded corner, a blue lock icon, and an "ENCRYPTED" label; 7) A red brick firewall with orange flames; 8) A white surveillance camera with a blue lens mounted on a small wall mount; 9) An ID card with a clip, a thumbnail of a person's image, text lines, and a barcode; 10) A red triangle warning sign with a black exclamation mark; Third row: 11) A set of dark server stacks with colored status lights and a blue shield checkmark badge in front; 12) 13) A clipboard list with green checkboxes labeled “COMPLIANCE”; 14) A dark smartphone face recognition screen displaying a wireframe face, scan box, and the text “VERIFYING…”; 15) An alert dashboard card labeled “ALERT” with a magnifying glass for a checklist; 16) A gray safe with a circular combination dial next to a white policy document labeled “POLICY” with gray lines and green checkmarks. Maintain consistency in all icons regarding isometric perspective, miniature scale, refined SaaS/security branding, sharp edges, ambient occlusion, and subtle touch shadows. Text should be minimalist and clearly visible only in designated locations. Theme Customization:{argument name="theme" default="security and compliance"} Customize the main color:{argument name="primary color" default="deep blue"} Custom background:{argument name="background color" default="light gray"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 在干净的浅灰色背景上创作一张现代等轴测插图，展示一个无缝的网络安全、隐私和合规图标网格，具有柔和的阴影、光泽的 3D 材质、圆润的边缘，以及蓝色、白色、灰色、红色和橙色的配色方案。使用宽幅横向画布，行与列间距均匀，无边框或水印。包含 15 个独立的图标，排列成 3 行 5 列的网格：第一行：1) 一个带有银色锁扣和黑色锁孔的蓝色挂锁，2) 一个带有白色对勾和金属边缘的蓝色盾牌徽章，3) 一把斜向放置的银色钥匙，4) 一个类似智能手机的深色生物识别面板，显示发光的蓝色指纹扫描线，5) 一个带有锁图标、密码点和蓝色“LOGIN”按钮的桌面显示器登录界面；第二行：6) 一张带有折角、蓝色锁图标和“ENCRYPTED”标签的白色文档页面，7) 一面带有橙色火焰的红色砖墙防火墙，8) 一个安装在小型壁挂支架上、带有蓝色镜头的白色监控摄像头，9) 一个带有夹子、头像缩略图、文本行和条形码的 ID 证件，10) 一个带有黑色感叹号的红色三角形警告标志；第三行：11) 一组深色服务器堆栈，带有彩色状态灯和前方的蓝色盾牌对勾徽章，12) 一个带有绿色复选框且标注为“COMPLIANCE”的剪贴板清单，13) 一个深色智能手机面部识别屏幕，显示线框面部、扫描框和“VERIFYING...”文本，14) 一张标注为“ALERT”的警报仪表板卡片，配有一个检查列表的放大镜，15) 一个带有圆形组合拨盘的灰色保险柜，旁边是一份标注为“POLICY”的白色政策文档，带有灰色线条和绿色对勾。保持所有图标在等轴测视角、微缩物体比例、精致的 SaaS/安全品牌风格、清晰边缘、环境光遮蔽和微妙接触阴影方面的一致性。文本应极简，仅在指定位置清晰可见。主题自定义：{argument name="theme" default="security and compliance"}；主色自定义：{argument name="primary color" default="deep blue"}；背景自定义：{argument name="background color" default="light gray"}。

templates.title: Dutch streets in the rain and a vintage BMW

titleLocalized.zh: 雨中荷兰街道与复古 BMW

templates.prompt: A realistic, cinematic street photograph, with a vehicle as the main subject.{argument name="car model" default="Black retro BMW coupe from the 1970s"} The car was parked on a quiet street in a Dutch canal neighborhood after the rain. It was angled slightly to the side, slightly to the right and centered, and featured chrome trim, round headlights, and {argument name="license plate text" default="03-XR-BL"} The scene features a yellow Dutch license plate, raindrops visible on the hood and windshield. It showcases typical Dutch street features: narrow brick sidewalks and wet brick pavement, puddles reflecting sunlight, tall, narrow brick townhouses with large windows on either side, bicycles parked along railings and walls with blue parking signs, and slender, verdant street trees lining the roadside. A row of softly focused parked cars is in the background. Post-rain sunlight pierces through the clouds, casting warm highlights on the wet street, creating a slightly melancholic and nostalgic atmosphere. The shooting effect simulates a retro Helios 44-2 58mm lens, with shallow depth of field, sharp subject focus, slight rotation/distortion bokeh in the background, Kodak color film texture, natural grain, soft green and warm brown tones, realistic proportions, no focused figures, no modern distractions, and no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张逼真的电影感街头摄影作品，画面主体为一辆 {argument name="car model" default="1970 年代的黑色复古 BMW 双门轿跑车"}，停在雨后宁静的荷兰运河社区街道边。汽车呈微侧视角朝向前方，略微偏右居中，配有镀铬装饰、圆形大灯、写着 {argument name="license plate text" default="03-XR-BL"} 的黄色荷兰车牌，引擎盖和挡风玻璃上可见雨滴。场景展现了典型的荷兰街道特征：狭窄的砖砌人行道和湿润的砖铺路面，小水洼反射着阳光，两侧是带有大窗户的高窄砖砌联排别墅，栏杆和外墙边停放着自行车，设有蓝色停车标志，路边种着叶片翠绿的细长行道树，背景中有一排柔焦的停放车辆。雨后阳光穿透云层，在湿润的街道上投下温暖的高光，整体氛围略带忧郁与怀旧感。拍摄效果模拟复古 Helios 44-2 58mm 镜头，浅景深，主体对焦清晰，背景带有轻微的旋转/变形散景，柯达彩色胶片质感，自然颗粒感，柔和的绿色与暖棕色调，比例真实，无对焦人物，无现代干扰元素，无水印。

templates.title: Cave Fragrance Spray Marketing Campaign

titleLocalized.zh: Cave Fragrance Spray 营销活动

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic close-up product lifestyle photograph. The background is a dark, rocky cave. The image only shows the right side of the subject and their raised hand, holding a faceted black perfume bottle with a label on it.{argument name="perfume label" default="ODYSSEY EAU DE PARFUM"} The figure wears a black functional jacket with pleated sleeves and small orange zipper details; the head is located on the far right of the image, and a very short {argument name="hair color" default="pale pink"} The hair is colored, but the face is deliberately obscured by a large, softly edged rectangular block in a warm brown tone. A hand is pressing a nozzle, releasing a fine, visible mist that drifts into the air to the left. The background is a narrow, rugged cave or volcanic rock passage with rough, dark gray rock walls, using a shallow depth of field effect. In the distance on the left, there are blurred warm orange flames or torchlight. High-contrast lighting creates an atmospheric effect, presenting realistic skin texture, lifelike spray particles, deep emerald black shadows, delicate film grain, and the aesthetic style of an editorial adventure fragrance advertisement. The 16:9 horizontal composition places the product and hand slightly to the right of the center of the frame, maintaining sharp focus. Cave walls surround the scene; there is no additional text or watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影质感的特写产品生活方式摄影作品，背景位于阴暗的岩石洞穴中，画面仅展示人物的右侧及其抬起的手，手中握着一个刻面黑色香水瓶，瓶身标签为 {argument name="perfume label" default="ODYSSEY EAU DE PARFUM"}。人物身穿黑色机能夹克，袖子带有褶皱设计和橙色小拉链装饰；头部位于画面最右侧，隐约可见极短的 {argument name="hair color" default="pale pink"} 发色，但面部被一个暖棕色调的大型柔边矩形遮挡块刻意遮盖。手部正在按压喷头，释放出一团细腻可见的雾气，向左侧空气中飘散。背景为狭窄崎岖的洞穴或火山岩通道，墙壁为粗糙的黑灰色岩石，采用浅景深效果，画面中左侧远处有模糊的暖橙色火焰或火把光芒。运用充满氛围感的高对比度光影，呈现真实的皮肤质感、逼真的喷雾颗粒、深翡翠黑色的阴影、细腻的胶片颗粒感，以及编辑类探险香水广告的审美风格。采用 16:9 横向构图，产品和手部位于画面中心偏右处并保持清晰对焦，洞穴墙壁环绕场景，无额外文字，无水印。

templates.title: "Blue Moments" Volcano Fashion Photoshoot

titleLocalized.zh: “蓝调时刻”火山时尚大片

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic, wide-angle fashion photo, with the main subject being {argument name="subject" default="A young Black man with braided hair"} A full-body profile stands on a dark, volcanic black sand beach in the twilight of the day, facing the towering, jagged sea rocks to his right. He wears an oversized, futuristic down jacket in a bold black, white, and light blue color scheme, paired with black sweatpants with three thin white side stripes and chunky white sculpted sneakers. A semi-transparent, square, blurred obscuring his face is added, but his braids and outline remain visible. The atmosphere is melancholic and surreal: a deep blue twilight sky, damp, dark sand, low-lying ground mist floating at his feet, and a bright, cool halo of light peeking through the rocks behind the horizon. The figure is positioned in the left third of a 16:9 aspect ratio, with the right side and background dominated by three sharply defined black rock towers. The composition employs a shallow depth of field, realistic lens flare, high contrast, cool cyan-blue tones, dramatic backlighting, soft mist, and the aesthetics of a high-end sportswear advertisement. There is no text, no logos, and no other figures.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影质感的广角时尚大片，主体为 {argument name="subject" default="一位留着编织发辫的年轻黑人男性"}，全身侧影站在蓝调时刻昏暗的火山黑沙滩上，面向右侧高耸嶙峋的海上礁石。他身穿一件超大廓形的未来感羽绒服，采用大胆的黑、白、淡水蓝拼色设计，搭配带有三条细白侧边条纹的黑色运动裤，以及厚底白色雕塑感运动鞋。在他的面部添加一个半透明的方形模糊遮挡块，但保留发辫和轮廓可见。环境氛围忧郁且超现实：深蓝色的暮色天空，潮湿的深色沙滩，脚边漂浮着低矮的地面雾气，地平线后方岩石遮挡处透出一抹明亮而清冷的光晕。将人物构图在 16:9 画面的左三分之一处，右侧及背景由三座轮廓分明的黑色尖锐岩石塔占据。采用浅景深电影感，逼真的镜头光晕，高对比度，冷青蓝色调，戏剧性的逆光，柔和的雾气，以及高端运动品牌广告的审美。无文字，无标志，无其他人物。

templates.title: Surreal sulfur hot spring explorers

titleLocalized.zh: 超现实硫磺温泉探险者

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic wide-angle travel photograph, capturing a solo traveler standing on the edge of an alien sulfur hot spring landscape, using a slightly overhead drone perspective. The main subject is {argument name="character description" default="A young man with dark curly hair and a deliberately blurred face."} Located on the left side of the image, looking down, wearing {argument name="outfit" default="A black tracksuit with a bold graphic, featuring gold floral embroidery, purple and cyan geometric patches, paired with black trousers and white futuristic sneakers."} The surrounding landscape is a vast geothermal expanse, dotted with jagged grey volcanic rocks, shallow acidic pools, and thick, neon-yellow sulfur deposits forming irregular rings, ridges, islands, and waterways. The water should be a murky yellowish-green, with subtle ripples and mineral foam, the background gradually merging into a thin mist near the flat horizon. The color palette is dominated by toxic lime yellow, olive green, grey rocks, and soft sky hues, utilizing natural diffused light and a slight atmospheric haze. This creates a dangerous, surreal, and distinctive atmosphere, making it resemble a realistic documentary adventure photograph rather than a fantasy artwork. The composition is 16:9 horizontal, with high detail, clear foreground textures, realistic proportions, and no text or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影感广角旅行摄影作品，拍摄一位独行者站在异星硫磺温泉景观边缘的场景，采用略微俯视的无人机视角。主体为 {argument name="character description" default="一位留着深色卷发、面部刻意模糊的年轻人"}，位于画面左侧，低头向下看，身着 {argument name="outfit" default="一套带有大胆图案的黑色运动服，饰有金色花卉刺绣、紫色和青色几何拼块，搭配黑色长裤和白色未来感运动鞋"}。周围是广阔的地热地形，布满锯齿状的灰色火山岩、浅层酸性水池，以及形成不规则圆环、山脊、岛屿和水道的厚重霓虹黄色硫磺沉积物。水面应呈现浑浊的黄绿色，带有细微的涟漪和矿物泡沫，背景在平坦的地平线附近逐渐融入淡薄的雾气中。色彩基调以毒性青柠黄、橄榄绿、灰色岩石和柔和的天空色为主，采用自然漫射光和轻微的大气雾霾。营造出一种危险、超现实且与众不同的氛围，使其看起来像真实的纪录片探险照片，而非奇幻艺术作品。采用 16:9 横向构图，高细节，前景纹理清晰，比例真实，无文字，无水印。
