templates.title: Volcano Street Fashion Photoshoot

titleLocalized.zh: 火山街头时尚大片

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic fashion editorial photograph using a 16:9 widescreen format to showcase {argument name="number of models" default="Two"} Androgynous streetwear models stand back-to-back on a barren volcanic rock landscape at night. The models are full-body portraits, positioned slightly to the left of the frame, their postures upright and still, arms hanging naturally at their sides, facing opposite directions in profile or three-quarter view. Their faces are deliberately obscured by smooth, vertical, beige, blurred rectangles, creating a sense of anonymity. The model on the left wears a black oversized hooded functional jacket with subtle stripes, paired with black wide-leg pleated cropped trousers, black socks, and futuristic white sculptural ribbed sneakers; a red lining is faintly visible inside the hood. The model on the right wears a light sage grey oversized down/functional jacket with dark black paneling and sporty white sleeves, paired with loose-fitting dark sweatpants (with vertical side stripes), white socks, and matching futuristic white ribbed sneakers; her short hair features small blonde braids above the collar. Thick, billowing smoke or steam, or a grey-green mist, surrounds the figures against a deep, hazy background, with no visible architectural or sky details. The ground, uneven with gravel, rocks, and volcanic rock, is illuminated by strong directional light from the left front, casting dramatic shadows that accentuate the texture of the footwear and jacket. promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实的生活方式产品摄影图，呈现灰色混凝土厨房台面上宁静的清晨咖啡场景。在前景处，放置 3 件白色陶瓷咖啡器具：左侧放 1 个装满黑咖啡的纯白马克杯，右侧放 1 个较高的米白色斑点陶瓷马克杯，并在该马克杯上方放置 1 个白色陶瓷手冲滤杯。滤杯内装有棕褐色滤纸，可见深色咖啡粉和已冲泡的咖啡，并有缕缕细微的蒸汽向上升腾。以 {argument name="coffee setup" default="一个放在米白色马克杯上的白色陶瓷手冲滤杯，旁边还有一个白色咖啡杯"} 作为中心主体。场景应营造出极简、舒适且自然的氛围，右侧窗户透入柔和的漫射日光。在背景中，包含 5 个辅助物体：左侧靠在灰色墙壁上的 2 个木制项目，左侧马克杯后方的 1 个哑光黑色水壶，靠近项目处 1 个带棕色盖子的小型白色陶瓷罐，以及右侧明亮窗边 1 盆米色花盆的绿植。在台面右下边缘添加 1 条折叠的深灰色布艺餐巾。使用 {argument name="color palette" default="暖白色、石灰色、米色、原木色、哑光黑色和叶绿色"} 的柔和中性色调。将环境设定为 {argument name="room style" default="带有混凝土表面的极简现代厨房"}。采用平视角度并略带正面倾斜拍摄，浅景深，呈现写实的阴影和柔和的背景虚化，画面中无人、无文字、无 Logo，且没有多余的杯子或其他物品。使其看起来像是一张高端咖啡广告大片，通过自然光拍摄，杯子和滤杯焦点清晰，带有细腻的蒸汽，营造出宁静祥和的氛围。

templates.title: A woman and her orange cat in a cozy bedroom

titleLocalized.zh: 温馨卧室中的女子与橘猫

templates.prompt: Create a realistic and cozy indoor life photograph, in which {argument name="subject" default="An adult woman"} Lying on her side on the beige bed in the cozy bedroom, she was gently {argument name="pet" default="An orange tabby kitten"} Playing. The subject has shoulder-length light brown hair, wears a simple white sleeveless vest and dark blue shorts, and is in a side-profile pose, supporting her body with one arm while holding a string toy in the other hand near a kitten. The kitten lies on the bed beside her, alertly facing the camera, with distinct orange stripes and soft fur. The subject's face is deliberately obscured by a solid medium brown rectangular privacy mask. The vertical portrait composition, framing from waist to thigh, uses a shallow depth of field, natural skin tone, and realistic fabric folds to create a tranquil and intimate atmosphere. The background includes a lit bedside lamp casting a warm yellow glow on the beige wall, revealing pillows and disheveled beige bedding. The lighting should be soft, cinematic, warm, and slightly dim, presenting an evening bedroom scene. No text, no watermark, no additional figures, and no other animals.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实的温馨室内生活照，画面中 {argument name="subject" default="一位成年女性"} 侧卧在温馨卧室的米色床上，正温柔地与 {argument name="pet" default="一只橘色虎斑小猫"} 玩耍。主体留着齐肩浅棕色长发，身穿简单的白色无袖背心和深蓝色短裤，侧身姿势，一只手臂支撑身体，另一只手拿着细绳玩具靠近小猫。小猫躺在她身旁的床上，警觉地面对镜头，身上有明显的橘色条纹和柔软的毛发。人物面部特意用一个纯中棕色的矩形隐私遮挡块遮住。采用竖向人像构图，腰部至大腿取景，浅景深效果，自然的肤色，写实的布料褶皱，营造出宁静亲密的氛围。背景中包含一盏发光的床头灯，在米色墙壁上投射出温暖的黄色光芒，可见枕头和凌乱的米色床上用品。光线应柔和、具有电影感、温馨且略显昏暗，呈现出傍晚卧室的场景。无文字，无水印，无额外人物，无其他动物。

templates.title: Ethereal Stand Personal Profile Poster

titleLocalized.zh: Ethereal Stand 个人档案海报

templates.prompt: Create a 2:3 vertical cinematic fantasy character design poster showcasing a guardian spirit named Stand, blending ethereal Chinese typography, a soft, fashionable photography style, and mythological creature design. The main subject is {argument name="character name" default="Higanbana · Wu"} A young woman sits on a rocky ledge, beside a misty pond or stream. She wears a white, ruffled floral sundress with a cream-colored, oversized cardigan that slips off one shoulder. Her medium-brown hair is casually tied in a low bun, with soft strands framing her face; her posture is elegant, serene, and slightly melancholic, her hands resting on the ledge, her legs leaning forward. If necessary, the face can be hidden or blurred to maintain the overall sense of anonymity and poetry. Behind and above her right shoulder, create a Stand: a large, translucent white dragon-deer/fox-dragon guardian spirit with a slender snout, flowing, feathery mane, forked antlers or horn-like appendages, veil-like fins, ribbons, dangling gold chains and tassels, and numerous small white flowers blooming on its head and body. It should have the texture of mist, petals, and moonlight condensed into a beast-like form: beautiful, fragile, protective, and slightly mysterious, rather than cartoonish. A guardian spirit surrounds the woman, seemingly protecting her, occupying the upper right half of the poster. Environment and lighting: a shady waterside garden with drooping willow branches, deep green leaves, reflected water, floating mist, translucent ribbons, tiny luminous petals or fireflies, and warm morning light filtered through the mist. The color palette uses ivory, pearl white, champagne beige, pale blush, soft moss green, smoky gray, and soft gold. Overall atmosphere: tranquil, romantic, ghostly, elegant, and dreamlike, with a touch of melancholy and detachment. The poster is designed as an information-rich stand-alone file, using delicate white serif fonts and slender decorative lines. It contains 6 text blocks: 1) A small label in the upper left corner, with "Stand Name" in both Chinese and English; 2) The main title "Higanbana Wu" and the smaller Romanized spelling "Higanbana Wu"; 3) A short, poetic Chinese text below the title; 4) The title in the middle left, "Special Ability," including the ability name "Hua Ying Mi Li" and the Romanized spelling "Hua Ying Mi Li," followed by a brief description of the ability; 5) The title in the lower left, "Design Relationship," including a few lines of brief Chinese key points and 7 circular color swatches in ivory, cream, warm beige, gray-pink, gray-green, dark moss green, and gray-brown; 6) The bottom right corner features a quote box that reads, "The beauty you see may just be a dream I've woven." It's accompanied by a smaller "Girl's Profile" box containing brief attributes such as personality, appearance, aura, and preferences. Above the guardian spirit on the right, a narrow, vertically aligned Chinese text bar, framed by a thin line, is added. The text should be decorative yet clear and legible, creating a luxurious editorial character profile feel without being overpowering. Visual Style: High-end fantasy editorial poster, ultra-refined, combining soft-focus realism with exquisite illustrations, semi-transparent layers, bokeh, shallow depth of field, delicate decorative lines, elegant Chinese book design aesthetics, no glaring neon colors, no modern UI, and no watermark.{argument name="main title" default="Lycoris radiata and mist"} As the main title,{argument name="ability name" default="The shadows of flowers are hazy"} As a capability title, and make Stand present{argument name="guardian spirit motif" default="a white mist dragon-deer covered in flowers"} That feeling.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张 2:3 竖版电影感奇幻角色设计海报，展示名为 Stand 的守护灵，融合空灵的中文排版、柔和的时尚摄影风格与神话生物设计。主体为 {argument name="character name" default="Higanbana · Wu"}，一位年轻女性坐在多石的岩架上，身旁是雾气缭绕的池塘或溪流。她身穿白色褶皱花卉吊带短裙，外搭一件从单肩滑落的米白色大廓形针织开衫。她留着中棕色头发，随意扎成低发髻，脸颊两侧留有柔和的发丝；姿态优雅、安静且略带忧郁，双手放在岩架上，双腿向前倾斜。如有必要，可隐藏或柔焦面部，保持整体氛围的匿名感与诗意。

在她右肩后方及上方，创作 Stand：一个巨大的半透明白色龙鹿/狐龙守护灵，拥有细长的吻部、飘逸如羽毛的鬃毛、分叉的鹿角或角状物、面纱般的鳍、丝带、悬垂的金链与流苏，其头部和身体上绽放着许多小白花。它应呈现出雾气、花瓣与月光凝结成兽形的质感：美丽、脆弱、具有保护性、略带神秘感，而非卡通化。守护灵环绕在女性周围，仿佛在守护她，占据海报右上半部分。

环境与光影：阴凉的水畔花园，垂下的柳枝、深绿色叶片、倒映的水面、漂浮的雾气、半透明的纱带、细小的发光花瓣或萤火虫，以及透过薄雾过滤的温暖晨光。色调采用象牙白、珍珠白、香槟米色、淡腮红、柔和苔藓绿、烟灰色与柔金色。整体氛围：宁静、浪漫、幽灵般、优雅、梦幻，带有一丝淡淡的哀伤与疏离感。

将海报设计为信息丰富的 Stand 档案页，采用精致的白色衬线字体与纤细的装饰线条。包含 6 个文本区块：1) 左上角小型标签，中英文对照“替身设定 / STAND NAME”；2) 大标题“彼岸花・霧”及较小的罗马拼音“Higanbana · Wu”；3) 标题下方的一段简短中文诗意文字；4) 左中部标题“特殊能力”，包含能力名称“花影迷离”及罗马拼音“Hua Ying Mi Li”，后接简明的能力描述；5) 左下部标题“設計關聯”，包含几行简短的中文要点，以及 7 个圆形色卡，颜色分别为象牙白、奶油色、暖米色、灰粉色、灰绿色、深苔藓绿与灰褐色；6) 右下角引语框，内容为“「你看到的美好，也许只是我編織的夢。」”，并附带一个较小的“少女檔案”方框，包含性格、形象、气场与偏好等简要属性。在右侧守护灵上方添加一个狭窄的竖排中文文本栏，由细线框起。文字应具有装饰性且清晰易读，以营造奢华的编辑类角色档案感，同时不喧宾夺主。

视觉风格：高端奇幻编辑海报，超精细，柔焦写实与精致插画结合，半透明图层，焦外成像，浅景深，精细的装饰线条，优雅的中文书籍设计美学，无刺眼的霓虹色，无现代 UI，无水印。使用 {argument name="main title" default="彼岸花・霧"} 作为最大标题，{argument name="ability name" default="花影迷離"} 作为能力标题，并使 Stand 呈现出 {argument name="guardian spirit motif" default="a white mist dragon-deer covered in flowers"} 的感觉。

templates.title: French independent music album cover

titleLocalized.zh: 法式独立音乐专辑封面

templates.prompt: Create a square album cover for a melancholic indie/alternative single. Canvas: 1:1 scale, paper background with a soft texture, grading from a warm cream color on the left to a pale pinkish-blue on the right, with a delicate film grain and retro editing style. Composition: Place a blurred, oil painting-like portrait on the right two-thirds of the cover, cropped from the mid-torso upwards, head tilted back and slightly turned upwards, short, dark hair messy, forming a soft silhouette. The face is deliberately obscured by a rectangular frosted blur in the upper right corner, presenting a translucent soft beige, gray, and brown tone. Clothing: A richly textured mustard gold faux fur coat or shawl, dramatically extending across the body to the right from the lower left corner, with dynamic blur and warm amber shadows; underneath, a dark patterned turtleneck in burgundy, green, and charcoal gray tones. Typography: Place two text elements on the left. Text element 1 is the title.{argument name="album title" default="Encore Une Fois"} The text is arranged in three stacked lines, with a very large font, using an elegant high-contrast serif font with thin strokes, a dark charcoal gray color, left-aligned, and occupying the top left quadrant. Text element 2 is the artist's name.{argument name="artist name" default="PZF"} Use small, uppercase serif letters with wide letter spacing, placed below the title near the left center. Visual style: romantic, cinematic, slightly surreal, soft-focus photographic painting; warm ochre and burnt orange contrast with cool blue to create a nostalgic French Art Pop atmosphere. Constraints: Ensure the design is clear and legible at thumbnail size, maintain ample white space around the typography, and avoid adding extra logos, barcodes, or any other text.

promptLocalized.zh: 为一首忧郁的独立/另类单曲创作一张方形专辑封面。画布：1:1 比例，纸张背景带有柔和纹理，从左侧的暖奶油色渐变至右侧的淡粉蓝色，并带有细腻的胶片颗粒感和复古编辑风格。构图：在封面右侧三分之二处放置一张模糊的油画感人物肖像，从躯干中部向上裁剪，头部后仰并略微向上转动，深色短发凌乱，形成柔和的轮廓。面部被右上角一个矩形的磨砂模糊块刻意遮挡，呈现半透明的柔和米色、灰色和棕色调。服装：一件质感丰富的芥末金人造皮草大衣或披肩，从左下角戏剧性地横跨身体向右延伸，带有动态模糊和温暖的琥珀色阴影；内搭一件深色图案的高领服装，色调为酒红、绿色和炭灰色。排版：在左侧设置 2 个文本元素。文本元素 1 为标题 {argument name="album title" default="Encore Une Fois"}，分三行堆叠，字体非常大，采用优雅的高对比度衬线字体，笔画纤细，深炭灰色，左对齐，占据左上象限。文本元素 2 为艺术家名称 {argument name="artist name" default="PZF"}，采用小型大写衬线字母，字间距较宽，放置在标题下方靠近左侧中心的位置。视觉风格：浪漫、电影感、略带超现实主义、柔焦摄影绘画，暖赭色和焦橙色与冷蓝色形成对比，营造出怀旧的法式艺术流行氛围。限制条件：确保设计在缩略图尺寸下清晰易读，在排版周围保留充足的留白，不要添加额外的徽标、条形码或任何其他文本。

templates.title: Neon Disco Album Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹迪斯科专辑封面

templates.prompt: Create a 1:1 square composite botsco album cover for a project titled "..."{argument name="song title" default="MIRROR MIRROR"} The song, performed by{argument name="artist name" default="PZF"} The image shows two stylish adults standing back-to-back in a smoky nightclub, with a giant mirrored disco ball dominating the upper center of the frame. The figure on the left is a woman with voluminous, shoulder-length, reddish-brown curly hair, wearing a shiny red leather jacket, leaning slightly to the left with one hand near her pocket. The figure on the right is a man with slicked-back, dark hair, wearing a black shiny leather suit with an open white shirt, leaning slightly to the right. Their faces are obscured by soft rectangular blur blocks to maintain an anonymous editorial style. Dramatic magenta, purple, electric blue, and bright pink lighting, along with horizontal neon tubes in the background, thick purple smoke, and reflective highlights on leather, creates a cinematic 1980s nightclub atmosphere. Place two text elements: a large title "MIRROR MIRROR" in the lower third of the image, in a futuristic neon italic font with a white core, pink halo, and slight bevels; and a smaller artist text "PZF" centered at the bottom below it, in italic letters with wide spacing. Maintain a symmetrical composition, a bright texture, high contrast, and photorealistic appearance. Do not add any additional logos, borders, stickers, or other text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 1:1 正方形的合成波迪斯科专辑封面，用于名为 {argument name="song title" default="MIRROR MIRROR"} 的曲目，演唱者为 {argument name="artist name" default="PZF"}。画面展示两个时尚的成年人背靠背站在烟雾缭绕的夜店中，头顶上方是一个巨大的镜面迪斯科球，占据了画面的上部中心。左侧人物是一位留着蓬松红棕色齐肩卷发的女性，身穿亮面红色皮夹克，身体微向左倾，一只手靠近口袋；右侧人物是一位留着油头深色短发的男性，身穿黑色亮面皮西装，内搭敞开的白色衬衫，身体微向右倾。他们的面部应通过柔和的矩形模糊块进行遮挡，以保持匿名编辑风格。使用戏剧性的洋红色、紫色、电光蓝和亮粉色灯光，背景配有水平霓虹灯管、浓厚的紫色烟雾、皮革上的反光高光，营造出 20 世纪 80 年代的电影感夜店氛围。放置 2 个文本元素：位于画面下三分之一处的大标题“MIRROR MIRROR”，采用斜体全大写未来感霓虹字体，白色核心配以粉色光晕和轻微斜角；以及位于其下方底部居中的较小艺术家文本“PZF”，采用字间距拉开的斜体字母。保持构图对称、质感光亮、高对比度且具有照片级真实感，不要添加任何额外的徽标、边框、贴纸或其他文本。

templates.title: Romantic Sunset album cover

titleLocalized.zh: 浪漫日落专辑封面

templates.prompt: Create a square, cinematic album cover for a title {argument name="song title" default="TWO HEARTS, ONE SUN"} A romantic indie pop song. The image centers on the dark silhouettes of a couple, kissing or foreheads touching, standing amidst soft wild grasses on a tranquil beach at sunset. A large, luminous sun rises on the horizon, directly behind them, creating a bright golden halo that blends their silhouettes into one. The sky presents a smooth and dramatic gradient, transitioning from a deep navy blue at the top to violet and rose, then to a saturated orange near the horizon, accompanied by delicate mist, lens flare, and dreamy atmospheric effects. Dark silhouettes of small islands are faintly visible on the sea to the left and right in the distance. The foreground is in shadow, dotted with blurred, delicate blades of grass, seeds, and tiny bokeh, creating depth. Warm orange, gold, and red tones contrast with cool blue shadows; the style is romantic, nostalgic, and cinematic, combining painterly and photographic qualities, with soft focus, high dynamic range, and no hard outlines. Typography is added at the bottom center: the title uses an elegant, wide-spaced uppercase sans-serif font with a pale gold sheen; the artist's name is displayed in smaller font below.{argument name="artist name" default="PZF"} Maintain a simple and symmetrical composition, with the lovers perfectly aligned with the sun. The image should not contain any other people or buildings, and should be borderless and watermark-free.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张方形电影质感的专辑封面，用于名为 {argument name="song title" default="TWO HEARTS, ONE SUN"} 的浪漫独立流行歌曲。画面中心展示了一对恋人的深色剪影，他们正在拥吻或额头相抵，站在日落时分平静海边的柔软野草丛中。一轮巨大的发光太阳位于地平线上，正好处于他们身后，形成明亮的金色光环，将两人的剪影融为一体。天空呈现出平滑且富有戏剧性的渐变色，从顶部的深海军蓝过渡到紫罗兰色和玫瑰色，再到地平线附近的饱和橙色，伴有细腻的薄雾、镜头光晕和梦幻的大气光晕。远处的左右两侧海面上隐约可见深色的小岛剪影。前景处于阴影中，点缀着虚化的精致草叶、草籽和微小的焦外成像光斑，营造出空间深度。使用温暖的橙色、金色和红色调，与冷蓝色的阴影形成对比；风格浪漫、怀旧、电影感，兼具绘画与摄影质感，柔焦，高动态范围，无硬轮廓。在底部居中添加排版：标题使用字间距较宽的优雅大写无衬线字体，呈现淡金色光泽；下方标注较小的艺人名称 {argument name="artist name" default="PZF"}。保持构图简洁对称，恋人与太阳完美对齐，画面中不包含其他人物、建筑物，无边框，无水印。

templates.title: Velvet Signal album cover

titleLocalized.zh: Velvet Signal 专辑封面

templates.prompt: Create a square album cover image featuring a cinematic close-up of a person wearing large, black over-ear studio headphones. The composition uses a tight, centered crop, filling the left and right edges with the headphones and long, dark hair cascading down their sides. The person's face is deliberately obscured by a large, opaque cube in a warm, dark brown gradient, positioned in the center of the image, covering most of the upper and middle portion of the portrait from near the top edge to above the title area. Soft, warm backlighting, a soft cream background, dark shadows, a slight vintage film grain, and shallow depth of field create an intimate atmosphere reminiscent of listening to music late at night. promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张低角度电影感时尚肖像，主角为一位时尚的 {argument name="subject" default="年轻女性"}，她坐在一个极简摄影棚内的大型哑光几何立方体底座上。使用纯色 {argument name="background color" default="金黄色"} 无缝背景布和相匹配的黄色地面，并带有柔和的摄影棚阴影。相机位置非常低且靠近主角伸出的脚，采用广角透视，使前景中的白色运动鞋看起来超大且占据主导地位，而上半身则向后退缩。主角姿态随意，一条腿伸向镜头，另一条膝盖弯曲，放松的手放在弯曲的膝盖上。服装：一件高级超大款黑色棒球风格夹克，带有芥末黄色拼接，领口、袖口、袖子和下摆有白色条纹装饰，按扣设计，胸前有学院风字母贴布；奶油色超大款阔腿裤；白色罗纹袜；干净的白色皮革 Nike 风格低帮运动鞋，带有鞋带和打孔鞋头；内搭简约白色上衣；佩戴小圆环耳环和短项链。头发为深色、长波浪卷，松散地束在脑后，发丝散落在脸庞周围。脸部应通过平滑的居中矩形模糊/马赛克遮挡进行刻意匿名化处理，同时保留时尚姿势。灯光采用精致的编辑类摄影棚布光，温暖且高端，呈现清晰的织物细节、逼真的皮革质感、浅景深、轻微的前景强调，采用 2:3 竖构图，无文字，无水印，无多余物体。

Strong glitch art effects are added: the image (especially around the title and bottom edge) is filled with horizontal scanline artifacts in magenta, cyan, green, and white. A large, distressed white, all-caps title is placed at the top.{argument name="headline text" default="FUTURE READY"} Divided into two rows, the image features fragmented digital elements and pixelated edges. promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖版赛博朋克街头时尚海报，画面中一位年轻模特在黄昏时分蹲在东京风格的屋顶上，采用极具戏剧性的低角度拍摄，前景突出展示一双超大号的霓虹绿厚底运动鞋。模特留着 {argument name="hair color" default="霓虹粉"} 的凌乱齐肩发，造型大胆前卫，面部被柔和的矩形模糊效果刻意遮挡。服装：一件带有褶皱镜面质感的反光金属银色超大羽绒服，反射着品红和青色的光泽；黑色工装裤配有搭扣、绑带和垂挂织带；脚穿 {argument name="shoe color" default="霓虹青柠绿"} 的未来感厚底运动鞋。背景：密集的未来感东京天际线，深蓝紫色的天空，发光的摩天大楼，屋顶栏杆，以及模特身后被点亮的橙红色东京塔。添加强烈的故障艺术效果：画面中（尤其是标题周围和底部边缘）布满品红、青、绿、白色的水平扫描线伪影。在顶部放置一个巨大的做旧白色全大写标题 {argument name="headline text" default="FUTURE READY"}，分为两行，带有数字碎片化和像素破损边缘。包含 6 个清晰可见的霓虹灯元素：左侧一个写有「未来準備完了」的垂直亮粉色日文招牌，左下角一个写有「東京」及其下方“TOKYO”的小招牌，右侧一个带有猫脸图标、日文和“2077”的垂直亮粉色招牌，右下角附近一个写有“ネオン”的小型青粉色招牌，右下角一个写有“GAME OVER”的蓝色招牌，以及远景中一个发着微光的青色城市招牌。采用高对比度的电影级布光，饱和的品红和电光蓝反射，湿润的屋顶表面，粗砺的城市质感，锐利的时尚编辑级细节，以及 2:3 的海报构图，无边框或水印。

templates.title: Neon Cyberpunk Futuristic Hoodie Portrait

templates.prompt: Create a vertically composed cyberpunk neon portrait. At the center of the image is a mysterious young woman standing in a dark, futuristic city scene, her head slightly lowered, her hands tucked into the front pockets of a deep purple oversized hoodie. Her face is deliberately obscured by a centrally located, opaque, soft purple square obscuring her features, surrounded by wispy strands of dark hair and fine curls. A bright, fluorescent, handwritten logo is printed on the chest of the hoodie, with the text {argument name="hoodie logo" default="Future"} It appears as an electric magenta. The background is mostly filled with huge, bold, handwritten text.{argument name="background word" default="FUTURE"} Painted in a vibrant neon purple, with splattered edges and a strong sense of glow. A smoky, dark purple nighttime atmosphere is used, incorporating floating mist, sparks, points of light, blurred city lights in the distance, and high-contrast ultraviolet rim lighting around the characters. Six semi-transparent sci-fi HUD interface panels are added to the edges of the screen: the top left panel is labeled "SYSTEM_OVERVIEW" and features a 100% processing progress bar; the top right panel is labeled "CYBER_ID_07" and "LOADING FUTURE"; the right center features a vertically stacked technology module panel; the bottom left panel is labeled "NEON CITY," containing some Japanese text and an energy level bar; the bottom left corner features a miniature coordinate/access authorization panel; and the bottom right panel is labeled "FUTURE IS NOW," containing a status bar and a small globe icon. Visual style: Cinematic cyberpunk poster, combining realistic characters with stylized neon graphics, deep blacks, saturated purple and magenta lighting, glowing haze, clear hoodie details, dramatic backlighting, no superfluous characters, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张垂直构图的赛博朋克霓虹肖像，画面中心是一位神秘的年轻女性，她站在黑暗的未来城市场景中，头部微垂，双手插在深紫色超大款连帽衫的前兜里。她的脸部被一个位于中心的不透明柔紫色方形遮挡块刻意隐藏，周围可见凌乱的深色发丝和细碎的卷发。连帽衫胸前印有明亮的荧光手写 Logo，文字为 {argument name="hoodie logo" default="Future"}，呈现出电光洋红色。背景大部分区域填充着巨大的粗犷笔触字体，文字为 {argument name="background word" default="FUTURE"}，以鲜艳的霓虹紫绘制，边缘带有飞溅效果和强烈的发光感。使用烟雾缭绕的黑紫色夜间氛围，加入漂浮的雾气、火花、光点、远处模糊的城市灯光，以及人物周围高对比度的紫外线轮廓光。在画面边缘添加 6 个半透明的科幻 HUD 界面面板：左上角面板标注“SYSTEM_OVERVIEW”并带有 100% 处理进度条；右上角面板标注“CYBER_ID_07”和“LOADING FUTURE”；右侧中部为垂直堆叠的科技模块面板；左下角面板标注“NEON CITY”，包含少量日语文本和能量等级条；左下角下方为微型坐标/访问授权面板；右下角面板标注“FUTURE IS NOW”，包含状态行和小地球仪图表。视觉风格：电影级赛博朋克海报，写实人物与风格化霓虹图形结合，深邃的黑色，饱和的紫色和洋红色光影，发光的雾霾，清晰的连帽衫细节，戏剧性的背光，无多余角色，无水印。

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 16:9 宽屏的皮克斯风格 3D 动画电影剧照，场景设定在黄昏时分的老旧城市天台，背景是灯火辉煌的城市天际线。画面中心前景站着两名比例友好的风格化建筑或维修工人：左侧是一名年轻男性，留着 {argument name="male hair color" default="凌乱的棕色短发"}，身穿奶油色卷袖工装衬衫、棕褐色工装裤和棕色工装靴，系着腰带，左手提着一个皮革工具包；右侧是一名年轻女性，留着 {argument name="female hair color" default="赤褐色长发"}，身穿浅蓝色牛仔工装衬衫、修身蓝色卷边牛仔裤和棕色工装靴，系着工具腰带，胸前斜抱着一张巨大的卷起蓝图。让他们靠近站立，仿佛正在讨论天台翻新事宜，面向观众，身体语言放松且自信。天台应包含 5 组标志性道具：左侧一面带有通风口和管道的风化混凝土墙，墙边有两盆盆栽，后方有一道矮砖护墙，右侧建筑上有一个天台水塔，最右侧有一盆阔叶大盆栽。添加潮湿的反射斑点、散落的小碎片、通风口、管道和温暖的窗户灯光。天际线应呈现出一种受纽约启发、充满奇幻色彩的大都市感，拥有装饰艺术风格的摩天大楼、天线和柔和的窗户灯光。采用高质量的皮克斯风格 3D 渲染，角色造型圆润柔和，具有电影级的景深效果、温暖的轮廓光、青蓝色的夜空、细腻的体积雾、光亮的积水倒影，以及精致的家庭动画质感。无文字，无 Logo，无水印。

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超写实的电影级广告摄影作品，场景设定在干净现代的超市过道内。采用安装在购物车前部附近的超低广角镜头，捕捉购物车冲向观众的瞬间。一名 {argument name="subject" default="年轻健壮的男子"} 身体前倾，用力推着购物车，他身穿带有黑色肩条的白色足球风格球衣，胸前印有小型黑色钩状标志和“LG”字样；他留着深色短发，手臂肌肉发达，佩戴着黑色智能手表。在金属购物车内放置一只毛茸茸的 {argument name="animal" default="绵羊"}，它仰面躺着，露出肚皮，前腿抬起，耳朵清晰可见，仿佛被这速度惊呆了。用扁平的米色矩形遮挡块遮住男子和绵羊的面部。画面中需清晰展示 8 件飞舞或放置在购物车内的杂货：左上角背景中有一个飞舞的黄色盒子，左侧有一个飞舞的棕褐色包装食品块，右侧有一个飞舞的红色汽水罐，购物车内有一个蓝色薯片袋，左下方有一个棕色面包或吐司包装，左前方有一个红甜椒，下方有一个红番茄，右下角前景中有一个模糊的蓝白相间纸盒。利用超市货架两侧的戏剧性动态模糊、头顶上方明亮的线性天花板灯光、浅景深、前景中清晰的金属购物车栏杆，营造出高速动作的张力、光泽感的商业照明、逼真的质感以及 {argument name="mood" default="混乱幽默的高端超市广告"} 氛围。采用 4:5 竖构图，购物车居中，主体靠近镜头，无额外文字，无水印。

templates.title: Man riding a white ram

templates.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic, cinematic portrait photograph, in which a person{argument name="subject" default="young man"} A man confidently rides a large white ram. Centered in the frame, facing the camera, he wears a fitted dark brown short-sleeved T-shirt, dark blue jeans, and black shoes; his hands rest firmly on the ram's massive, curved horns, as if gripping handlebars. He has short, dark hair, a muscular build, a natural complexion, and a calm, confident demeanor. The ram occupies the lower half of the image, staring directly at the viewer, with thick, greyish-white wool, a pale face, alert ears, and two large, ribbed horns that curve outwards and downwards into broad, symmetrical arcs. The scene is set in an outdoor rural farm or forest clearing, with dry earth and scattered straw on the ground, a warm brown fence or farmhouse in the background, and dense trees in the back. promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅垂直构图的肖像，采用受 Rockstar Games 关键视觉图启发的精致硬汉派漫画概念艺术风格：画面下方 75% 的区域由一位严肃的成年西部神枪手占据，采用低角度英雄视角，居中构图，从大腿向上截取。图像上方 25% 的区域必须严格保持为空白纯色 {argument name="background color" default="血红色"}，不得包含任何文字或物体。角色留着向后梳的深色头发，面部区域为一个刻意平整且无特征的 {argument name="face mask color" default="暖棕褐色"} 长方形遮罩，遮挡了所有五官。姿势：双臂抬起，双手各持一把华丽的长管左轮手枪垂直置于头部两侧，枪管略微向外倾斜；画面中可见 2 把左轮手枪，左右手各一把，带有雕刻金属细节和象牙枪柄。服饰：{argument name="shirt color" default="奶油白色"} 长袖衬衫，袖口卷起，领口系着深蓝色领巾，高腰黑色长裤，宽大的双皮质枪带配有两个大扣环，左侧腰间可见一个棕色枪套。背景：人物身后为日落时分的风格化沙漠峡谷，有锯齿状的红色岩层，画面左下角和右下角分布着 6 株仙人掌。运用戏剧性的金色轮廓光、深邃的黑色阴影、厚重的墨水感线条、绘画般的招贴画质感、高对比度、电影级西部氛围，无文字，无 Logo，无水印。

templates.title: Cyber ​​Angel Mech Combat HUD

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博天使机甲战斗 HUD

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a widescreen, futuristic anime-style action game screenshot showcasing a cyberpunk aerial battle, presented with a sophisticated sci-fi action-packed combat HUD effect. Canvas: 16:9 landscape composition, a three-quarter view from above, overlooking a deep cyan and black digital arena. The background is a massive circular cyberpunk grid composed of concentric circles, circuit board patterns, holographic city blocks, and vertical equalizer-style cyan light bars on the horizon. Subject: At the center is an anime-style female cyberpunk angel named {argument name="character name" default="Xione Origin"} Possessing a graceful{argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} Long hair, fair skin, sharp futuristic armor, and translucent mechanical wing blades. She is in flight, her posture dynamic, wielding glowing energy blades and controlling four small white blade drones circling around her. Her color scheme is black, gunmetal gray, white, and neon cyan, with bright cyan thruster contrails and golden spark impact effects. Action composition: Showing five hostile mech enemies: a large armored enemy in the upper right corner undergoing a violent explosion, a large, bulky enemy in the lower left corner, a medium-sized enemy on the right edge, a medium-sized enemy in the lower right corner, and a small enemy in the center right. Added red aiming lines, red warning tags, triangular danger icons, and laser beams pointing at the player. The central attack forms a massive cyan crescent-shaped slash that arcs around the protagonist, while the four white blade drones leave golden trails: one in the upper left, one in the center left, one in the bottom center, and one in the lower right. Includes particle sparks, lens flares, motion blur, and curved light bands to emphasize the sense of speed. HUD and Text Elements: A full game interface overlay is added, using a clear, futuristic font. Top Left: Character portrait, label "XIONE ORIGIN", health "4200 / 4200", "100%", and "CODE SYNC — OK". Center Left: "COMBO" with a large number.{argument name="combo count" default="256"} And the small print "EXCELLENT". The top right corner displays "TIME".{argument name="time remaining" default="04:37"} “SCORE” display{argument name="score" default="238,650"} And “MULTIPLIER x4.8”. Right center: “ENEMY 12” and “+120”. Bottom right corner: Circular radar/minimap with cyan fan-shaped indicators and red enemy dots. Bottom left corner: 4 skill icons labeled “QUANTUM EDGE”, “PHOTON CHARGE”, “PHASE BREAK”, and “ORIGIN DRIVE”, each with small keyboard tips for Z, X, C, and SPACE. Visual style: A combination of high-detail anime sci-fi illustrations and 3A game UI concept art, dark cinematic lighting, neon cyan accents, red enemy warnings, gold impact sparks, clean and sharp lines, dense holographic details, ultra-wide battlefield readability, dramatic depth, borderless, and watermark-free. Constraints: All visible text remains in English to make the interface look like a realistic action game screenshot; strictly adheres to the requirement of 5 enemies, 4 blade drones, and 4 skill icons; avoids adding extra characters or additional UI panels beyond the described HUD.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张宽屏未来风动漫动作游戏截图，展现一场赛博空战，呈现出精致的科幻动作砍杀节奏战斗 HUD 效果。

画布：16:9 横屏构图，从高处四分之三视角俯瞰深青色与黑色的数字竞技场。背景是一个巨大的圆形赛博网格，由同心圆、电路板图案、全息城市街区以及地平线上垂直的均衡器式青色光条组成。

主体：中心处是一位动漫风格的女性赛博天使，名为 {argument name="character name" default="Xione Origin"}，拥有飘逸的 {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} 长发、白皙的皮肤、锋利的未来感盔甲以及半透明的机械翼刃。她处于飞行状态，姿态动感，挥舞着发光的能量刃，并操控着环绕在身边的 4 个小型白色刀锋无人机。她的配色方案为黑色、枪灰色、白色和霓虹青色，带有明亮的青色推进器尾迹和金色的火花撞击效果。

动作构图：展示 5 个敌对机甲敌人：右上角 1 个大型装甲敌人正受到剧烈爆炸冲击，左下角 1 个大型笨重敌人，右边缘 1 个中型敌人，右下方 1 个中型敌人，以及中右侧 1 个小型敌人。添加红色的瞄准线、红色警告标签、三角形危险图标以及指向玩家的激光束。中央攻击形成巨大的青色新月形斩击，环绕女主角形成圆弧，同时 4 个白色刀锋无人机留下金色轨迹：一个在左上，一个在中左，一个在底部中央，一个在右下。包含粒子火花、镜头光晕、动态模糊和弯曲的光带以强调速度感。

HUD 与文字元素：添加完整的游戏界面覆盖，采用清晰的未来感字体。左上角：角色头像，标签“XIONE ORIGIN”，生命值“4200 / 4200”、“100%”以及“CODE SYNC — OK”。左侧中央：“COMBO”配以大数字 {argument name="combo count" default="256"} 和小字“EXCELLENT”。右上角：“TIME”显示 {argument name="time remaining" default="04:37"}，“SCORE”显示 {argument name="score" default="238,650"} 以及“MULTIPLIER x4.8”。右侧中央：“ENEMY 12”和“+120”。右下角：圆形雷达/小地图，带有青色扇形指示器和红色敌方点。左下角：4 个技能图标，分别标注为“QUANTUM EDGE”、“PHOTON CHARGE”、“PHASE BREAK”和“ORIGIN DRIVE”，每个图标配有 Z、X、C 和 SPACE 等小型键盘提示。

视觉风格：高细节动漫科幻插画与 3A 游戏 UI 概念艺术相结合，深色电影级光影，霓虹青色点缀，红色敌方警告，金色撞击火花，干净锐利的线条，密集的全息细节，超宽战场可读性，戏剧性的深度，无边框，无水印。

约束：保持所有可见文字为英文，使界面看起来像真实的动作游戏截图，严格遵守 5 个敌人、4 个刀锋无人机和 4 个技能图标的数量要求，避免在描述的 HUD 之外添加额外角色或额外的 UI 面板。

Canvas and Layout: Create a vertical collage containing 12 equal-sized panels with thin white borders between them, arranged from left to right and top to bottom. Panel Styles and Visible Tags (12 in total): 1. Studio Ghibli – Tag: “STUDIO GHIBLI”, soft hand-drawn pastoral anime style. 2. Pixar – Tag: “PIXAR”, exquisite 3D family animation style. 3. Dragon Ball – Tag: “DRAGON BALL”, dynamic boyish action style with speed lines and rocky landscapes. 4. One Piece – Tag: “ONE PIECE”, a nautical adventure anime style with ship elements. 5. Naruto – Tag: “NARUTO”, a ninja anime style with village rooftops and headband designs. 6. Doraemon – Tag: “ドラえもん”, a bright suburban children's anime style. 7. Sazae-san – Tag: “サザエさん”, a classic Japanese family anime style. 8. Lilo & Stitch – Tag: “Lilo & Stitch”, a tropical island animation style. 9. Pokémon – Tag: “POKÉMON”, a colorful trainer and partner adventure style. 10. Demon Slayer – Tag: “鬼滅の刃”, a dramatic dark fantasy anime style with glowing particles. 11. Crayon Shin-chan – Tag: “クレヨンしんちゃん”, a simple and rounded children's anime style. 12. Minecraft — Tag: "MINECRAFT", blocky voxel game style. Customizable text: Used where the panel title appears.{argument name="first style label" default="STUDIO GHIBLI"} ,{argument name="second style label" default="PIXAR"} ,{argument name="third style label" default="DRAGON BALL"} ,{argument name="ninth style label" default="POKÉMON"} as well as{argument name="twelfth style label" default="MINECRAFT"} Constraints: Do not add additional panels or labels. templates.prompt: Create a vertical, hard-boiled Western outlaw poster, employing the refined concept art style of Rockstar Games, presenting a dramatic graphic novel rendering effect with sharp, ink-lined edges, high contrast, painterly highlights, and rough, cinematic shadows. The lower 75% of the image features a cowboy gunslinger, while the upper 25% remains a pure, blood-red background. The character is centered, in half-length, approaching in a confrontational stance, aiming a massive silver revolver directly at the viewer. Strong perspective shortening makes the barrel dominate the foreground, and the hands are richly detailed and large. The face is deliberately obscured by a centered rectangular block with a vertical gradient from dark to brown, covering the area from below the hat brim to the upper chest. This outlaw wears a shiny black wide-brimmed cowboy hat, a dark blue long-sleeved shirt, a dark red vest, a black bandana, and a brown bullet belt filled with individual brass bullets slung across his chest. Behind him is a large, rough-edged, golden-yellow circular sunset disc, with black pine silhouettes along its lower rim, against a backdrop of a deep red, decadent sky. In the bottom foreground, seven black silhouettes of horsemen are added, crossing a winding ridgeline. The image contains no text, logos, or watermarks, and no additional characters besides the main gunner and the seven horsemen silhouettes.{argument name="background color" default="solid blood-red"} ,{argument name="sun disk color" default="golden yellow"} ,{argument name="weapon" default="large silver revolver"} ,{argument name="outfit accent color" default="deep red waistcoat"} as well as{argument name="face covering" default="centered dark-to-brown rectangular censor block"} .

templates.title: Crowd collage cartoon portrait

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic conceptual crowd portrait on a square canvas: an overhead/isometric perspective showcasing a massive, anime-style male bust composed of thousands of tiny, standing figures. The figure is in a three-quarter profile from the shoulders up, facing right, with exaggeratedly tall, spiky white hair and a clearly visible left ear; pale skin is conveyed through the light-colored clothing of the figures, while a large black turtleneck and dark coat are highlighted by the densely packed black clothing. The entire portrait is composed of countless individual human figures arranged like pointillist pixels, with the tips of hair and the edges of coats clearly discernible from above. Place the figure on a vast, matte gray-white background with surrounding negative space, and a few scattered pedestrians casting long, thin shadows. Add a large, opaque, warm gray square occlusion at the center of the face, covering most of the facial features from forehead to chin, while leaving the hair, ears, collar, shoulders, and surrounding figures visible. Employing cinematic minimalist lighting, soft, high-angle sunlight, realistic subtle shadows, and an ultra-refined installation art feel, the color palette features soft beige, white, black, and charcoal gray. There is no text, no signage, and no borders. The portrait subject can be customized.{argument name="character archetype" default="spiky-haired anime male with high collar"} And can be set{argument name="hair color" default="white"} ,{argument name="coat color" default="black"} ,{argument name="floor color" default="warm off-white"} as well as{argument name="censor block color" default="warm gray"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 在方形画布上创作一幅照片级真实感的概念人群肖像：俯瞰/等轴测视角，展示一个由数千个微小站立人群组成的巨大动漫风格男性半身像。角色呈肩部以上四分之三侧面，面向右侧，拥有夸张的高耸尖刺白发、清晰可见的左耳；通过浅色着装人群呈现苍白肤色，通过密集排列的黑色着装人群呈现巨大的黑色高领和深色外套。整幅肖像由无数个体人形像点彩像素般排列而成，从上方看，发丝尖端和外套边缘清晰可辨。将该造型置于广阔的哑光灰白色地面上，周围留有空白负空间，零星散布着几个远离人群的行人，投下细长的阴影。在面部区域中心添加一个巨大的不透明暖灰色方形遮挡块，覆盖从前额到下巴的大部分面部特征，同时保持头发、耳朵、衣领、肩膀及周围人群可见。采用电影级极简照明、柔和的高角度阳光、逼真的微小阴影、超精细的装置艺术质感，色调为柔和的米色、白色、黑色和炭灰色，无文字，无标识，无边框。肖像主体可自定义为 {argument name="character archetype" default="spiky-haired anime male with high collar"}，并可设置 {argument name="hair color" default="white"}、{argument name="coat color" default="black"}、{argument name="floor color" default="warm off-white"} 以及 {argument name="censor block color" default="warm gray"}。

templates.title: Four-panel "Bankruptcy Mouse" storyboard

titleLocalized.zh: 四格“破产小鼠”故事板

templates.prompt: Objective: For the name{argument name="scene title" default="The despair of zero balance"} Create a warm 2x2 cinematic storyboard image for a short animated scene, featuring three adorable anthropomorphic mice set in a quaint stone village and a banking world. Canvas: A 1:1 square image divided into four equal panels by thin white lines, achieving a refined animated film storyboard texture. High-detail 3D character animation is used, showcasing soft fur, lively expressions, shallow depth of field, golden hour lighting, warm orange highlights, and a soothing fantasy village texture. Characters: Maintain consistency among the three mouse characters across all panels: one mouse wears a green patterned cloak/scarf, and the larger central mouse wears {argument name="central outfit color" default="Red patterned cape/scarf"} And one mouse wearing a blue patterned cloak/scarf. They all have tan fur, large round ears, bright black eyes, small pink noses, distinct whiskers, small paws, and childlike proportions. Ensure their design remains consistent across all panels. In the panel where the central mouse's face is obscured, only use{argument name="face cover color" default="warm brown"} The faces are covered by soft-edged square occluders. Panel layout and actions: Panel 1 (top left): 3 mice are huddled together under a dark wooden eave or doorway. The mouse on the left, wearing a green cloak, looks worried, with its paws close to its mouth; the mouse in the middle, wearing a red cloak, has its face covered by a square occluder; the mouse on the right, wearing a blue cloak, looks concerned and points at the mouse in the middle. The warm indoor shadows and stone floor create an intimate yet anxious atmosphere. Panel 2 (top right): 3 mice stand on a sunny old stone street with blurry colorful flags above. The green mouse stands on the left with its arms crossed, the red mouse in the center stands in the middle with a proud smile, and the blue mouse stands on the right with its arms crossed, looking serious or suspicious. Panel 3 (bottom left): 3 mice run from left to right on stone steps, full of dynamism and energy. The blue mouse leads the way on the far left, the red mouse is in the middle, and the green mouse is on the right, their cloaks fluttering in the wind, their expressions excited. Panel 4 (bottom right): 3 mice celebrate amidst scattered gold coins and colorful confetti. The green mouse on the left laughs with its eyes closed, clutching the hem of the red-cloaked mouse in the middle. The red-cloaked mouse's face is also covered by a square masking block. The blue mouse on the right smiles with its mouth open and hands clasped together. The background is a golden bank or treasure vault-like interior scene with bokeh effects. Visual Style: Pixar-style but original, cute cinematic 3D rendering, realistic plush texture, detailed fabric embroidery, warm fantasy lighting, clear character subjects against a softly blurred background, vivid poses, emotional narrative, no text, no logo, no watermark. Constraints: Each panel must contain 4 sub-panels and 3 mice. The repeating cloak colors must be green, red, and blue. A total of 2 face masking blocks are required, located in panel 1 and panel 4 respectively. Do not add extra characters, titles, speech bubbles, or UI elements. The overall atmosphere should shift from anxiety to confidence, action, and something about {argument name="financial theme" default="Bankrupt Mouse Finds Gold Coins"} The joy and liberation.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为名为 {argument name="scene title" default="零余额的绝望"} 的短动画场景创作一张温暖的 2x2 电影感故事板图像，主角是三只可爱的拟人化小鼠，背景设定在古朴的石砌村庄和银行世界中。

画布：1:1 正方形图像，通过细白线分割成 4 个相等的面板，呈现出精致动画电影故事板的质感。采用高细节 3D 角色动画，表现柔软的皮毛、生动的表情、浅景深、黄金时刻光影、温暖的橙色高光以及舒适的奇幻村庄纹理。

角色：在所有面板中保持 3 只小鼠角色的一致性：1 只小鼠穿着绿色花纹斗篷/围巾，1 只较大的中心小鼠穿着 {argument name="central outfit color" default="红色花纹斗篷/围巾"}，以及 1 只小鼠穿着蓝色花纹斗篷/围巾。它们都有棕褐色皮毛、巨大的圆耳朵、闪亮的黑眼睛、小巧的粉色鼻子、清晰的胡须、小爪子和童趣的比例。确保它们在各面板中的设计保持一致。在中心小鼠面部被遮挡的面板中，仅用 {argument name="face cover color" default="暖棕色"} 的柔边方形遮挡块覆盖面部。

面板布局与动作：面板 1（左上）：3 只小鼠紧紧挤在深色木质屋檐或门口下。左侧穿绿色斗篷的小鼠神情忧虑，爪子靠近嘴边；中间穿红色斗篷的小鼠面部被方形遮挡块覆盖；右侧穿蓝色斗篷的小鼠表情关切，指向中间的小鼠。温暖的室内阴影，石质地面，营造出亲密而焦虑的氛围。面板 2（右上）：3 只小鼠站在阳光明媚的古老石街上，上方有模糊的彩旗。绿色小鼠站在左侧双臂交叉，红色中心小鼠站在中间自豪地微笑，蓝色小鼠站在右侧，双臂交叉，表情严肃或多疑。面板 3（左下）：3 只小鼠在石台阶上从左向右奔跑，充满动感与活力。蓝色小鼠在最左侧领跑，红色小鼠在中间，绿色小鼠在右侧，斗篷随风飘动，表情兴奋。面板 4（右下）：3 只小鼠在散落的金币和彩色纸屑中庆祝。左侧的绿色小鼠闭眼大笑，抓着中间红色斗篷小鼠的衣角，中间穿红色斗篷的小鼠面部同样被方形遮挡块覆盖，右侧的蓝色小鼠张嘴微笑，双手合十。背景是金色的银行或类似宝库的室内场景，带有散景光效。

视觉风格：皮克斯风格但具有原创性，可爱的电影级 3D 渲染，逼真的毛绒质感，精细的布料刺绣，温暖的奇幻光影，清晰的角色主体与柔和模糊的背景，生动的姿态，情感叙事，无文字，无 Logo，无水印。

约束条件：每个面板必须包含 4 个分格和 3 只小鼠。重复出现的斗篷颜色必须为绿色、红色和蓝色。总共包含 2 个面部遮挡块，分别位于面板 1 和面板 4。不要添加额外角色、标题、对话气泡或 UI 元素。整体氛围应从焦虑转变为自信、行动，以及关于 {argument name="financial theme" default="破产小鼠发现金币"} 的快乐解脱。

templates.title: "Zero Balance" Bank Storyboard

titleLocalized.zh: “零余额”银行故事板

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a book called{argument name="story title" default="Zero balance despair"} Create a 2x2 cinematic storyboard puzzle for a short narrative video, depicting a Japanese office worker finding himself penniless and driven to despair. Canvas: 1:1 square image, precisely divided into four equal panels with thin white gaps between them. Photorealistic, high resolution, cinematic lighting, and a realistic Japanese city bank environment. Ensure consistency in the protagonist's clothing, hairstyle, watch, and brown leather shoulder bag across all panels. To protect anonymity, the protagonist's face should be deliberately obscured with soft rectangular blur/mosaic blocks in each panel. Protagonist: A young Japanese office worker.{argument name="character description" default="Disheveled black hair, navy blue suit, white shirt, loose navy blue tie, brown leather shoes, silver watch, brown leather shoulder bag."} He looked exhausted, panicked, and emotionally distraught. Panel Quantity and Content: A precise four panels are used. 1. Top Left Panel: Inside or next to a bank ATM. The ATM screen displays a large red "0" clearly against a light blue background, indicating a zero balance. The office worker stands close to the ATM, shoulders tense, looking dejected, a brown leather bag strap slung across his shoulder. 2. Top Right Panel: At the bank counter. The office worker leans forward, facing a female bank employee in a navy blue uniform, hands outstretched, gesturing desperately. The bank interior is clean and modern, with blue counters, glass partitions, small signs, and warm office lighting. 3. Bottom Left Panel: Outside the bank entrance. A blue sign above the door reads {argument name="bank sign text" default="BANK"} An office worker stands on the sidewalk in front of the bank, arms flailing in panic, tie loose, coat open, brown shoulder bag hanging at his side. Bright sunlight, details of the city street, bollards, paving stones, and greenery. 4. Bottom right panel: In a quiet park. An office worker slumps on a wooden bench, head down, arms hanging limply, looking dejected. His brown leather bag lies on the bench beside him. Includes trees, dappled sunlight, green bushes, and a tranquil background that contrasts sharply with his despair. Visual style: Photorealistic Japanese commercial drama stills, consistent character portrayal, natural depth of field, clear clothing details, realistic bank and park scenes, vivid yet believable colors, emotional storytelling. No cartoon style, no additional panels, and no text descriptions except for the "0" on the ATM screen and the bank's exterior sign.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为一部名为 {argument name="story title" default="零余额绝望"} 的短篇剧情视频创建一个 2x2 的电影级故事板拼图，展示一名日本上班族发现自己身无分文并陷入绝望的过程。

画布：正方形 1:1 图像，精确划分为 4 个相等的面板，面板间有细白色间隙。照片级真实感，高分辨率，电影级布光，真实的日本城市银行环境。确保所有面板中的主角、服装、发型、手表和棕色皮革单肩包保持一致。为保护匿名，主角的面部在每个面板中都应刻意用柔和的矩形模糊/马赛克块遮挡。

主角：一名年轻的日本上班族，{argument name="character description" default="凌乱的黑发，海军蓝西装，白色衬衫，松开的海军蓝领带，棕色皮鞋，银色腕表，棕色皮革单肩包"}。他看起来精疲力竭、惊慌失措且情绪崩溃。

面板数量及内容：使用精确的 4 个面板。
1. 左上角面板：在银行 ATM 机内或旁边。ATM 屏幕在淡蓝色背景上清晰地显示出一个巨大的红色“0”，表示余额为零。上班族紧贴 ATM 机站立，双肩紧绷，神情沮丧，棕色皮包带子斜挎在肩上。
2. 右上角面板：在银行服务柜台。上班族向前倾身，面对一名身穿海军蓝制服的女银行职员，双手摊开，神情绝望地比划着。银行内部环境整洁现代，配有蓝色柜台、玻璃隔断、小型标识和温暖的办公照明。
3. 左下角面板：在银行入口外。门上方的蓝色招牌写着 {argument name="bank sign text" default="BANK"}。上班族站在银行前的人行道上，双臂因惊慌而向上挥舞，领带松开，外套敞开，棕色单肩包垂在身侧。明亮的日光，城市街道细节，防撞柱，铺路石和绿植。
4. 右下角面板：在安静的公园里。上班族瘫坐在木长椅上，低着头，双臂下垂，神情颓废。他的棕色皮革包放在身旁的长椅上。包含树木、斑驳的阳光、绿色灌木，以及与他的绝望形成鲜明对比的宁静背景。

视觉风格：照片级真实感的日本商业剧情剧照，角色连贯性一致，自然的景深，清晰的服装细节，真实的银行和公园场景，生动但可信的色彩，情感叙事。禁止使用卡通风格，禁止增加额外面板，除 ATM 屏幕上的“0”和银行外部招牌外，禁止添加任何文字说明。

templates.title: Chronowa Black Cat Character Design Collection

titleLocalized.zh: Chronowa 黑猫角色设定集

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a simple black, white, and red color scheme Japanese-style character reference poster, featuring a protagonist named {argument name="character name" default="Chronowa"} A cute black cat mascot, themed around nighttime music, featuring a black cat wearing white sunglasses and red headphones. Canvas: Vertical A4-style poster, white/off-white background, thin black border, delicate red corner mark, small halftone dots, diagonal tech lines, tiny city skyline silhouettes, wavy decorations, barcode in the lower left corner, black footer at the bottom with the English words "LISTEN TO THE NIGHT". Employing a clean vector/ink illustration style, the color scheme is limited: black, white, gray, and red accents. Main layout: A large, full-body, front-facing black cat is placed at the center as the protagonist, sitting upright with a curled tail, oversized pointed ears, long whiskers, wearing white, angular sunglasses (black lenses with reflective highlights), and red and black headphones around its neck. A striking Japanese and English title is added at the top.{argument name="main title text" default="クロノワ / CHRONOWA"} Use below{argument name="tagline text" default="A black cat listening to the sounds of the night"} As a subtitle, a red crescent moon and a black city skyline silhouette are added to the upper right corner. Left-side character view: Three smaller cat pose panels are stacked vertically on the left, each with black tabs and red decorations: 1) Side view: The cat sits sideways, wearing white sunglasses, with headphones hanging around its neck; 2) Listening pose: The cat wears red headphones, its paw touching the headphones, with small musical notes next to it; 3) Relaxed pose: The cat lies down, with headphones hanging around its neck. Right-side inventory: Two item illustrations are contained within a bordered box: 1) White sunglasses; 2) Red headphones. Japanese labeling is used with the same graphic style. Right-side mood icon bar: Six small, chibi-style mood icons arranged in two columns and three rows, all depicting a black cat wearing white sunglasses: 1) Listening to music, in a good mood; 2) Cool but melancholic; 3) Shy/awkward; 4) Alert with an action marker; 5) Friendly with a small red heart; 6) Slightly angry with a red anger symbol. Bottom Information Cards: Eight bordered information cards, numbered 01 to 08, are created in the bottom third of the page, featuring a black slanted title bar and red number decorations. The eight cards are: 01 Personal Profile; 02 Personality; 03 Characteristics; 04 Likes; 05 Dislikes; 06 Abilities; 07 Background Setting; 08 Quotes. The cards use compact Japanese text and are accompanied by small decorative icons such as wave patterns, paw prints, a sun warning symbol, a kitten silhouette, and red paw prints. The quote cards contain three short Japanese quotes.{argument name="quote text" default=""The sounds tonight aren't bad." / "I don't like stars. The world is too bright." / "It's a nice night. Shall we take a little walk?""} Text Style: Use a strong Japanese-style typography, black labels with red sidebars, small red wavy graphics, and clear technical annotation lines. Maintain the poster's readability while giving the small Japanese text a stylish reference table effect. Constraints: Must include 1 central cat character, 3 left-side pose panels, 2 item illustrations, 6 mood icons, and 8 bottom information cards. No humans, no additional characters, no full-color backgrounds, no realistic style, and no watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张简洁的黑白红配色日式角色参考海报，主角是名为 {argument name="character name" default="Chronowa"} 的可爱黑猫吉祥物，这是一只以夜间音乐为主题、佩戴白色太阳镜和红色耳机的黑猫。

画布：竖版 A4 风格海报，白色/米白色背景，细黑边框，精致的红色角标，细小的半调网点，对角线科技线条，微小的城市天际线剪影，波形装饰，左下角条形码，底部黑色页脚条，用英文写着“LISTEN TO THE NIGHT”。采用清晰的矢量/墨水插画风格，配色方案有限：黑色、白色、灰色和红色点缀。

主要布局：在中心放置一个大型全身正面黑猫作为主角，坐姿端正，尾巴卷曲，超大的尖耳朵，长胡须，佩戴白色棱角分明的太阳镜（黑色镜片带反光高光），颈部挂着红黑相间的耳机。在顶部添加醒目的日文加英文标题 {argument name="main title text" default="クロノワ / CHRONOWA"}，下方使用 {argument name="tagline text" default="夜の音を聴く黒猫"} 作为副标题。右上角添加一个红色新月和黑色城市天际线剪影。

左侧角色视图：在左侧垂直堆叠 3 个较小的猫咪姿势面板，每个面板都有黑色标签页和红色装饰：1) 侧视图，猫咪侧坐，佩戴白色太阳镜，耳机挂在颈部；2) 聆听姿势，猫咪佩戴红色耳机，爪子触碰耳机，旁边有小音符；3) 放松姿势，猫咪躺下，耳机挂在颈部。

右侧物品栏：在一个带边框的方框内包含 2 个物品插图：1) 白色太阳镜；2) 红色耳机。使用相同的图形风格进行日文标注。

右侧心情图标栏：包含 6 个 2 列 3 行排列的小型 Q 版心情图标，均为佩戴白色太阳镜的黑猫：1) 听音乐心情好；2) 冷酷但忧郁；3) 害羞/尴尬；4) 警觉并带有动作标记；5) 友善并带有红色小爱心；6) 微怒并带有红色愤怒符号。

底部信息卡：在底部三分之一处创建 8 个带边框的信息卡，编号从 01 到 08，带有黑色斜向标题栏和红色数字装饰。8 张卡片分别为：01 个人资料；02 性格；03 特征；04 喜好；05 厌恶；06 能力；07 背景设定；08 语录。卡片内使用紧凑的日文文本，并配有波形、爪印、太阳警告符号、小猫剪影和红色爪印等小型装饰图标。语录卡片包含三行简短的日文引用，使用 {argument name="quote text" default="『今夜の音、悪くないね』 / 『星は苦手。世界が明るすぎる』 / 『いい夜だね。少しだけ、歩こうか』"}。

文字风格：使用强烈的日式展示排版，黑色标签配红色侧边栏，小型红色波形图形，以及清晰的技术标注线。保持海报的可读性，同时让微小的日文文本呈现出设计感十足的参考表效果。

约束条件：必须包含 1 个中心主角猫，3 个左侧姿势面板，2 个物品插图，6 个心情图标，以及 8 个底部信息卡。禁止出现人类，禁止出现额外角色，禁止使用全彩背景，禁止写实风格，禁止添加水印。

templates.title: Four-Grid Bank World Project

titleLocalized.zh: 四格银行世界项目

templates.prompt: Objective: For about{argument name="scene theme" default="The despair of zero balance"} Create a sophisticated 2x2 project-style image table for the short video scene, set in a modern blue-themed banking world. Canvas: Square 1:1 composition, four equal panels separated by clean white gaps, bright cinematic 3D rendering realistic style with slightly idealized commercial lighting, high detail, sharp focus, saturated blue bank brand color, no titles or speech bubbles. Layout: Grid layout using 4 panels. 1. Top left panel: Indoor ATM area, a row of 3 clearly visible ATMs, each embedded in a gray wall compartment with striking blue vertical dividers. The nearest ATM screen prominently displays a large red "0" on a light cyan screen, implying a zero balance. Includes tiled floor, ceiling lights, and a small potted plant in the background. 2. Top right panel: Bank service counter, with a female bank employee sitting behind a beige stone counter. She wears a navy blue suit, white shirt, blue striped scarf or tie, and a small gold name tag. Her facial features were deliberately blurred to maintain anonymity. A computer monitor, a keyboard, a blue file tray, and a potted plant are present on or near the counter. Behind her are glass office partitions, a blue chair, certificates on the wall, and warm office lighting. 3. Bottom left panel: A sunny street corner, the exterior of a modern city bank branch. Showcases a blue horizontal sign above the glass door, gray stone exterior walls, street crosswalk markings, sidewalk bollards, green trees, and black streetlights. The entrance should have a clean, corporate, and Japanese urban feel, but without any legible signage. 4. Bottom right panel: The interior of a fantastical bank vault, with an oversized bronze and steel circular open vault door. The vault is filled with cash and gold, complete with warm gold lighting, shelves, and treasure props. Includes three cute animal mascots standing near the vault entrance, dressed in brightly colored outfits, along with visible bundles of banknotes, coins, treasure chests, and money bags. Visual Style: High-end 3D illustrations, cinematic rendering, a combination of banking aesthetics and fantastical storybook details in the vault panel; realistic materials, glossy glass, polished stone, metal vault surfaces, warm highlights, and deep blue brand accents. Main Details: The bank's dominant brand color is {argument name="brand color" default="Royal Blue"} The ATM screen should display in red.{argument name="balance number" default="0"} Bank employees' uniforms should be{argument name="clerk outfit" default="Navy blue suit with blue striped scarf"} The vault should contain{argument name="vault contents" default="Bundles of cash, coins, treasure chests, and money bags"} Constraints: No additional panels, no visible watermarks, no logos, no readable text except for the red balance numbers on the ATM screen, maintain the consistency of the four-panel table as a bank-themed project, and keep the white borders between panels neat.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为关于 {argument name="scene theme" default="零余额的绝望"} 的短视频场景创建一个精致的 2x2 项目风格图像表，背景设定在现代蓝色主题的银行世界中。

画布：方形 1:1 构图，四个相等的面板由整洁的白色间隙分隔，明亮的电影级 3D 渲染写实风格，带有略微理想化的商业照明，高细节，清晰对焦，饱和的蓝色银行品牌色，无标题或对话气泡。

布局：使用 4 个面板的网格布局。
1. 左上角面板：室内 ATM 区域，一排有 3 台清晰可见的 ATM 机，每台都嵌入灰色墙壁隔间中，并带有醒目的蓝色垂直分隔条。最近的 ATM 屏幕在浅青色屏幕上醒目地显示一个大大的红色“0”，暗示余额为零。包含瓷砖地板、天花板灯和背景中的一盆小盆栽。
2. 右上角面板：银行服务柜台，有 1 名女性银行职员坐在米色石质柜台后。她身穿海军蓝西装、白衬衫、蓝色条纹围巾或领带，并佩戴一个小金质名牌。她的面部特征被刻意模糊处理以保持匿名。柜台上或附近包含 1 台电脑显示器、1 个键盘、1 个蓝色文件托盘和 1 盆盆栽。她身后是玻璃办公室隔断、蓝色椅子、墙上的证书和温暖的办公室照明。
3. 左下角面板：阳光明媚的街角，现代城市银行分行的外观。展示玻璃门上方的蓝色水平招牌带、灰色石材外墙、街道人行横道标记、人行道护柱、绿树和黑色路灯。入口应给人一种整洁、企业化且具有日本城市风格的感觉，但没有可辨认的文字招牌。
4. 右下角面板：奇幻银行金库内部，有一个超大的青铜和钢制圆形开放式金库门。金库内堆满了现金和黄金，配有温暖的金色灯光、货架和宝藏道具。包含 3 个站在金库入口附近的可爱小动物吉祥物，它们穿着色彩鲜艳的小套装，此外还有可见的成捆钞票、硬币、宝箱和钱袋。

视觉风格：高端 3D 插画，电影级渲染，银行商业美学与金库面板中奇幻故事书细节的结合，写实材质，光泽玻璃，抛光石材，金属金库表面，温暖的高光，深蓝色品牌点缀。

主体细节：银行的主导品牌颜色为 {argument name="brand color" default="宝蓝色"}。ATM 屏幕应以红色显示 {argument name="balance number" default="0"}。银行职员的服装应为 {argument name="clerk outfit" default="海军蓝西装配蓝色条纹围巾"}。金库应包含 {argument name="vault contents" default="成捆现金、硬币、宝箱和钱袋"}。

约束：无额外面板，无可见水印，无 Logo，除 ATM 屏幕上的红色余额数字外无任何可读文字，保持四格表作为一个银行主题项目的连贯性，保持面板之间整洁的白色边框。

templates.title: Cinematic Baijiu (Chinese liquor) 9-frame storyboard

titleLocalized.zh: 电影感白酒 9 格分镜脚本

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a 16:9 cinematic storyboard to showcase a complete experience of high-end Chinese baijiu products, from unpacking to pouring, tasting, and dining, with the main character being {argument name="character description" default="An elegant Chinese woman, wearing a beige sleeveless cheongsam-style top, with her hair neatly styled in a bun and adorned with gold teardrop earrings."} Canvas: 16:9 widescreen image, divided into 9 panels in a 3x3 grid, separated by thin white lines. Small white panel numbers 1 to 9 are added to the lower left corner of each panel. Warm amber lighting, shallow depth of field, a luxurious restaurant/private room atmosphere, dark wood furniture, soft lantern light, exquisite Chinese decorations, cinematic lens feel, high-end commercial photography style. Product: A high-end baijiu gift set, brand name {argument name="product name" default="Mountain and River Brewing"} The bottle and gift box are made of deep navy blue-black, featuring gold foil embellishments, landscape illustrations, a vertical cream-gold label with Chinese calligraphy, and a metallic gold cap. The bottle maintains consistency across all panels. The storyboard layout includes nine different panels: 1. A close-up from above of a woman gently touching the lid of a luxurious gift box closed on a dark wooden table, revealing delicate gold landscape lines and a vertical Chinese label. 2. A medium shot of a woman opening the gift box, revealing a bottle of white wine inside; this includes a lining cardboard sheet with elegant Chinese poetry and a delicate ink-wash landscape painting. 3. A close-up of a woman holding the bottle vertically in front of the open gift box, emphasizing the dark ceramic texture, gold cap, gold label, and landscape illustration. 4. A medium-shot portrait of a woman unscrewing or removing the cap, her gestures elegant, against a warm, blurred background of a restaurant. 5. An extreme close-up of the bottle neck pouring clear white wine into a small stemmed tasting glass; showcasing the shimmering flow and bubbles, with parts of the bottle label visible. 6. A medium close-up of a woman smelling wine from a tulip-shaped glass, her elegant profile framed by soft golden lighting. 7. A portrait close-up of a woman tasting baijiu (Chinese white liquor), the glass raised to her lips, her expression serene and elegant, against a warm, shallow depth-of-field background. 8. A still life scene at a dining table, a baijiu bottle placed in the center of Chinese dishes, small glasses, and cutlery; including four visible plated dishes: braised pork, stir-fried vegetables, seafood or chicken in sauce, and a larger central communal dish. 9. A wide-angle dining scene, a woman seated at a table holding a glass, a baijiu bottle placed to the right of the table, multiple dishes and small glasses in front of her, against a backdrop of a city nightscape or an elegant window view. Visual Style: High-end cinematic advertising, realistic photography, rich warm tones, high-end liquor commercial advertising, soft highlights on glass and gold foil, deep mahogany and amber tones, elegant composition, clear product details, non-cartoon style. Constraints: The final image must be a single 9-frame storyboard, not 9 separate files. Use 9 panels, 9 visible panel numbers, and the 8th panel must contain 4 plated dishes. (Except for Chinese product names.){argument name="product name on label" default="Mountain and River Brewing"} In addition, keep all text to a minimum. Do not add watermarks, real brand logos, captions, or additional explanatory text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个 16:9 的电影感分镜脚本联系表，展示完整的中国高端白酒产品体验，从开箱到斟酒、品鉴及用餐，主角为 {argument name="character description" default="一位优雅的中国女性，身着米色无袖旗袍式上衣，发髻整洁，佩戴金色水滴耳环"}。

画布：宽屏 16:9 图像，分为 3x3 网格共 9 个分镜面板，面板间以细白线分隔。在每个面板的左下角添加 1 到 9 的小型白色面板编号。暖琥珀色灯光，浅景深，豪华餐厅/私人包间氛围，深色木质家具，柔和的灯笼光，精致的中式装饰，电影级镜头感，高端商业摄影风格。

产品：一款高端白酒礼盒，品牌名为 {argument name="product name" default="山河酿"}。使用深藏青黑色瓶身及礼盒，配有烫金装饰、山水插画图案、带有中式书法的垂直奶油金色标签以及金属金瓶盖。确保瓶身在各面板中保持一致。

分镜布局：包含 9 个不同的面板：
1. 深色木桌上闭合豪华礼盒的俯视特写，女性双手轻触盒盖，可见精致的金色山水线条艺术和垂直中式标签。
2. 女性打开礼盒的中景镜头，露出礼盒内衬中的白酒瓶；包含一张带有优雅中式诗词文字和淡雅水墨山水画的内衬纸板。
3. 双手在打开的礼盒前竖直握住瓶身的特写，强调深色陶瓷质感、金色瓶盖、金色标签和山水插画。
4. 女性旋开或取下瓶盖的中景肖像，手势优雅，背景为温暖的餐厅虚化光斑。
5. 瓶颈将清澈白酒倒入小高脚品鉴杯的极度特写；展示闪烁的酒液流和气泡，部分可见瓶身标签。
6. 女性从郁金香型小酒杯中闻酒香的中景特写，优雅侧颜，身后有柔和的金色灯光。
7. 女性品鉴白酒的肖像特写，酒杯举至唇边，神情宁静优雅，背景为温暖的浅景深效果。
8. 餐桌静物场景，白酒瓶置于中式菜肴、小酒杯和餐具中央；包含 4 道可见的盘装菜肴：红烧肉、炒时蔬、酱汁海鲜或鸡肉，以及一道较大的中央共享菜肴。
9. 宽幅用餐场景，女性坐在桌前手持酒杯，白酒瓶放置在桌子右侧，面前摆放多道菜肴和小杯，背景为城市夜景或优雅的窗景。

视觉风格：高端电影广告，写实摄影，浓郁的暖色调，高端酒类商业广告，玻璃和烫金上的柔和高光，深红木与琥珀色调，优雅构图，清晰的产品细节，非卡通风格。

约束条件：最终图像必须是一张 9 格分镜脚本，而非 9 个单独的文件。使用 9 个面板，9 个可见的面板编号，且第 8 个面板中必须有 4 道盘装菜肴。除中式产品名称 {argument name="product name on label" default="山河酿"} 外，保持所有文字最少化。不要添加水印、真实品牌 Logo、字幕或额外说明文字。

templates.title: Milan Luxury Layout Travel Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 米兰奢华排版旅行海报

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="city name" default="MILAN"} Create a high-end luxury travel poster, the core of which lies in a monumental 3D typographic design, with each letter a realistic architectural sculpture inspired by famous Milan landmarks. Canvas: 3:2 horizontal aspect ratio, editorial destination advertising composition, bright and clear sunlight, a pale blue sky with soft clouds, and a warm beige stone plaza at the bottom, presenting a sophisticated, magazine-quality, hyper-realistic architectural rendering effect. Main layout:{argument name="main word" default="MILAN"} Positioned at the center of the lower two-thirds of the poster, these five large, independent letters are arranged on a clean horizon. Each letter must be a different architectural landmark, richly detailed, realistic, and sculptural: 1. M: A Gothic white marble building inspired by the Milan Cathedral (Duomo di Milano), featuring soaring spires, small spires, pointed arches, rose windows, buttresses, statues, and a golden cross. 2. I: An elegant glass and stone arcade tower inspired by the Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II, with a massive arched glass facade, ornate classical columns, and an arched passageway visible at the base. 3. L: A red-brick medieval tower and castle mass inspired by Castello Sforzesco, featuring a bell tower, crenellations, arched entrances, stone decorations, and relief panels. 4. A: A modern green residential building inspired by the Bosco Verticale (vertical forest), shaped like a capital letter A, featuring terraces, concrete beams, lush trees, shrubs, and planted balconies. 5. N: A modern glass skyscraper form inspired by the architecture of Milan's business district, comprising a tall cylindrical reflector tower and a tilted diagonal glass and steel structure. Top Information Bar: Add a slender and elegant destination series title using small-spaced capital letters. The text on the left reads "SERIE DESTINOS" with a thin horizontal line and a small dot. The text on the right reads "CIUDAD / 01" with a corresponding thin horizontal line. The top center contains six small light gray landmark line icons, each with a thin vertical separator and all-caps explanatory text below. The six explanatory texts are: "DUOMO DI MILANO", "GALLERIA VITTORIO EMANUELE II", "CASTELLO SFORZESCO", "BOSCO VERTICALE", "TEATRO ALLA SCALA", and "ARCO DELLA PACE". Bottom Bar: Add a sophisticated beige footer with thin lines and small editorial text. The microtext on the left reads "ELEGANCIA QUE INSPIRA. HISTORIA QUE ACOGE. DISEÑO QUE LIDERA." The central title is "VISITA MILAN," using wide-spaced capital letters flanked by thin horizontal lines and small dots. The right side includes the coordinates "45.4642° N, 9.1900° E" and the issue number "N.º 01-MMXXV." Visual Style: Photorealistic 3D architectural fonts, high-end travel editorial style, realistic stone, brick, glass, metal, and greenery, precise shadows, high-resolution details, balanced symmetry, soft cinematic sunlight, subtle atmospheric haze, minimalist composition, and a refined beige-gray-blue color scheme. Constraints: Use five main landmark letters and six top landmark icons. Keep the poster simple yet luxurious. The image must not contain people, vehicles, extra landmarks, watermarks, or the black signature bar at the bottom.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="city name" default="MILAN"} 创作一张高端奢华旅行海报，核心在于纪念碑式的 3D 字体设计，每个字母均为受米兰著名地标启发的写实建筑雕塑。

画布：3:2 横向比例，编辑类目的地广告构图，明亮通透的日光，淡蓝色天空伴有柔和云朵，底部为暖米色石质广场，呈现出精致奢华杂志质感的超写实建筑渲染效果。

主要布局：将 {argument name="main word" default="MILAN"} 置于海报下方三分之二处的中心位置，作为五个巨大的独立字母排列在干净的地平线上。每个字母必须是不同建筑地标的形态，细节丰富、写实且具有雕塑感：
1. M：受米兰大教堂（Duomo di Milano）启发的哥特式白色大理石建筑，带有高耸的尖塔、小尖顶、尖拱、玫瑰窗、扶壁、雕像和金色十字架。
2. I：受埃马努埃莱二世拱廊街（Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II）启发的优雅玻璃石材拱廊塔，带有巨大的拱形玻璃立面、华丽的古典圆柱，底部可见拱形通道。
3. L：受斯福尔扎城堡（Castello Sforzesco）启发的红砖中世纪塔楼和城堡体块，带有钟楼、雉堞、拱形入口、石质装饰和浮雕面板。
4. A：受垂直森林（Bosco Verticale）启发的现代绿色住宅建筑，呈大写字母 A 形，带有露台、混凝土梁、茂密的树木、灌木和种植阳台。
5. N：受米兰商业区建筑启发的现代玻璃摩天大楼形态，包括一座高大的圆柱形反射塔和一座倾斜的对角线玻璃钢结构建筑。

顶部信息栏：添加一个纤细优雅的目的地系列标题，使用小号间距的大写字母。左侧文字为“SERIE DESTINOS”，配有细横线和一个小圆点。右侧文字为“CIUDAD / 01”，配有相应的细横线。顶部中央包含六个浅灰色的小型地标线条图标，图标下方配有细垂直分隔符和全大写说明文字。六个说明文字分别为：“DUOMO DI MILANO”、“GALLERIA VITTORIO EMANUELE II”、“CASTELLO SFORZESCO”、“BOSCO VERTICALE”、“TEATRO ALLA SCALA”、“ARCO DELLA PACE”。

底部栏：添加一个精致的米色页脚条，带有细线条和小号编辑文字。左侧微型文案为“ELEGANCIA QUE INSPIRA. HISTORIA QUE ACOGE. DISEÑO QUE LIDERA.”。中央标题为“VISITA MILAN”，使用宽间距大写字母，两侧配有细横线和小圆点。右侧包含坐标“45.4642° N, 9.1900° E”和期号“N.º 01-MMXXV”。

视觉风格：照片级写实的 3D 建筑字体，高端旅行编辑风格，写实的石材、砖块、玻璃、金属、绿植，精准的阴影，高分辨率细节，平衡的对称感，柔和的电影级日光，微妙的大气雾感，极简构图，精致的米灰蓝配色。

约束条件：使用五个主要地标字母和六个顶部地标图标。保持海报简洁奢华。画面中不得出现人物、车辆、多余地标、水印或底部黑色署名栏。

templates.title: Anime Idol Guitarist Character Design Chart

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫偶像吉他手角色设定表

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a gorgeous anime-style character collage concept sheet, showcasing {argument name="character name" default="An anonymous idol guitarist"} The scene depicts a performance on a warm theater stage, with the faces of the characters in each panel softly blurred in a square effect. Canvas: Vertical 4:5 composition, dark retro film-touching photosheet design with thin gold edges, decorative corner patterns, and a black and gold cinematic border. Warm amber, brown, cream, and black tones are used, complemented by glowing stage lighting. Layout: A total of 7 image panels are used: on the left is a large main portrait panel occupying most of the canvas, surrounded by 6 smaller numbered panels. The smaller panels are numbered 1, 2, 3 in gold from top to center in the right column, and 4, 5, 6 in the bottom row. The far left contains decorative film stripes, a small gold crown icon near the upper left corner, a small glitter icon in the center left, and a circular star badge near the lower left corner. Each panel has rounded black borders and delicate gold outlines. Subject details: The same anime girl appears in all 7 panels. She has {argument name="hair color" default="Chestnut brown short bob haircut"} She wore bangs and small hair clips, her face was partially obscured by a blurry square mask, and she had a slender figure, resembling an idol band member. Her attire included a cream-colored puff-sleeved blouse with a ruffled collar and a brown ribbon bow at the chest, a black choker, a black guitar strap, a high-waisted brown plaid pleated skirt, a belt with a round buckle, white knee-high socks, and small gold accessories and a wristband. She was carrying a {argument name="guitar color" default="Gloss black electric guitar with white pickguard"} She sings into a black microphone mounted on a stand. Panel Quantity and Content: The large panel 1 on the left shows a three-quarters full-body pose, with the microphone in her left hand and the guitar across her waist, displaying a confident stage presence. Panel 2 in the upper right corner shows a closer, upper-waisted singing pose, with the guitar neck extending to the right. Panel 3 in the middle right corner shows a similar upper-waisted pose, with the microphone pointed at her mouth. Panel 4 in the lower right center shows the character positioned slightly lower in the frame, against a warm backdrop. The small panel 5 in the lower left corner shows a close-up of the microphone and guitar body. The small panel 6 in the bottom center shows a pose centered around the microphone stand and guitar neck. The small panel 7 in the lower right corner (labeled 6) shows a more dynamic pose, with the guitar held diagonally upwards and a small hand-drawn gesture mark near her head. Background and Lighting: Each panel shows the same stage setup: a tall, gold-orange backdrop, dark stage equipment, and bright triangular spotlights behind the performer, creating a halo-like backlighting effect. Use dramatic rim lighting, glossy highlights like a guitar, cinematic shadows, and exquisite anime illustration details. Constraints: Keep the composition a refined character reference/contact print, not a real photograph. Maintain 6 numbered thumbnail labels and one large unnumbered main panel. Do not add any additional characters, text, logos, watermarks, or readable titles except for the small gold numbers.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个华丽的动漫风格角色拼贴设定表，展示 {argument name="character name" default="一位匿名偶像吉他手"} 在温暖的剧院舞台上表演的场景，每个面板中角色的面部均用柔和的方形模糊效果遮盖。

画布：垂直 4:5 构图，深色复古胶片接触印相表设计，带有细金边、装饰性边角花纹以及黑金电影质感边框。使用温暖的琥珀色、棕色、奶油色和黑色调，并配以发光的舞台灯光。

布局：总共使用 7 个图像面板：左侧是一个占据画布大部分面积的大型主肖像面板，周围环绕 6 个较小的带编号面板。小面板在右侧列从上到中分别标注金色数字 1、2、3，底部一行标注 4、5、6。最左侧包含装饰性胶片条纹，左上角附近有一个小金冠图标，左中有一个小闪光图标，左下角附近有一个圆形星形徽章。每个面板都有圆角黑色边框和精致的金色轮廓线。

主体细节：同一位动漫少女出现在所有 7 个面板中。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="栗棕色短波波头"}，带有刘海和小发夹，面部有模糊的方形遮挡，身材苗条，偶像乐队造型。服装：奶油色泡泡袖衬衫，领口有荷叶边，胸前有棕色丝带蝴蝶结，黑色颈圈，黑色吉他背带，高腰棕色格子百褶裙，带圆形扣的腰带，白色过膝袜，金色小配饰和腕带。她拿着一把 {argument name="guitar color" default="亮黑色电吉他，配有白色护板"}，对着支架上的黑色麦克风唱歌。

面板数量与内容：左侧的大型面板 1 展示了四分之三全身姿势，左手拿着麦克风，吉他横跨腰间，展现自信的舞台站姿。右上角的面板 2 展示了更近的腰部以上唱歌姿势，吉他琴颈向右延伸。中右侧的面板 3 展示了类似的腰部以上姿势，麦克风对着她的嘴部。右下中部的面板 4 展示了角色在画面中位置稍低，背景是温暖的幕布。左下角的小面板 5 展示了麦克风和吉他琴身的特写。底部中央的小面板 6 展示了她以麦克风支架和吉他琴颈为中心的姿势。右下角的小面板 7（标注为 6）展示了一个更具活力的姿势，吉他斜向上方举起，头部附近有一个小的手绘动作标记。

背景与灯光：每个面板都展示了相同的舞台设置，背景是高大的金橙色幕布、深色舞台装置，表演者身后有明亮的三角形聚光灯，营造出光环般的背光效果。使用戏剧性的轮廓光、吉他上的光泽高光、电影般的阴影以及精致的动漫插画细节。

约束：保持构图为精致的角色参考/接触印相表，而非真实照片。保留 6 个带编号的缩略图标签以及一个大型无编号主面板。除小金数字外，请勿添加额外角色、额外文字、徽标、水印或可读标题。

templates.title: Starry Sky Idol Character Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 星穹偶像角色海报

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a highly detailed poster showcasing anime idol characters, with the main character being {argument name="character name" default="A mysterious star idol"} The design employs a dark, starry concert aesthetic and a lavish trading card layout. Canvas: A vertical 3:4 poster with rich detail, using deep navy blue and warm gold tones to create a glossy, high-end illustration feel. The design should resemble an idol character card collection page, featuring decorative borders, film strip decorations, tiny starlight, confetti, and an elegant Gothic arch in the background. Layout: A total of 7 character illustrations are used: 1 large central full-body portrait and 6 smaller surrounding portrait panels. The 6 smaller panels are labeled 01, 02, 03, 04, 05, and 06 in small gold lettering. They are arranged with two panels on each side of the top, one panel on each side of the center, and one panel on each side of the bottom, surrounding the central figure. The central portrait is the largest, situated within a magnificent rounded rectangular gold frame, topped with a crown-shaped emblem, and bottomed with a small plaque displaying five small gold icons: star, star, crown, star, star. Main details: The character is a young anime idol girl, possessing {argument name="hair color" default="Very long, glossy black hair"} She has straight bangs, long side-swept hair, and wears small silver star hair clips. Her face is deliberately obscured in each panel by a soft rectangular blur effect, while the rest of the illustration remains clear. She wears a white short-sleeved puff-sleeved shirt with a ruffled neckline, tied with a black ribbon bow at the chest, a black choker with white ruffles, black fingerless gloves, a silver bracelet, a high-waisted dark navy blue pleated skirt (with a galaxy-like shimmering gradient), a white petticoat ruffle, a black belt with silver ring buckles, a silver star-shaped chain hanging from her hips, black thigh-high garters, and idol accessories. The overall outfit theme is {argument name="outfit theme" default="Gothic Star Idol"} Panel Pose: Includes the following 6 numbered side panel variations: 01 Shows an upper-body idol pose, one hand holding a microphone near the lower right, the other hand near the chest; 02 Shows an upper-body pose, one hand touching a collar or collar; 03 Shows a pose above the waist, one hand holding a microphone downwards; 04 Shows an upper-body pose, one hand near the face making a playful idol gesture; 05 Shows a side/three-quarter back pose, looking back over the shoulder, long hair flowing dramatically; 06 Shows a cheerful upper-body pose, both hands raised in a pinky or pointing gesture, a large microphone floating nearby on the right. The central portrait shows the idol standing full-body, one hand making a peace sign next to the face, skirt flared out, presenting a confident concert poster pose. Background and Decoration: All portraits are placed in a grand cathedral-like hall, with a background featuring arched windows emitting warm light, dark columns, night sky glitter, floating confetti, lens flares, and magical stardust. Below the portrait, at the center, is a large gold compass star emblem, laurel branches, and a curved film strip ribbon. Add small gold numbering, delicate decorative borders, subtle film sprocket markings, and a refined collector's card texture. Visual style: High-resolution anime illustration, crisp line art, bright highlights, glossy hair shadows, dramatic rim lighting, intricate fabric folds, deep navy blue shading, gold accents, a dreamy idol atmosphere, symmetrical composition, and high-end poster design. Constraints: Use 7 character drawings and include 6 numbered side panels labeled 01 to 06. All faces should maintain the same soft blur effect. Do not add any readable text except for panel numbers and decorative icons. Avoid using logos, watermarks, and redundant characters.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张高度精细的动漫偶像角色展示海报，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="一位神秘的星光偶像"}，采用暗黑星穹演唱会美学和华丽的集换式卡牌布局。

画布：垂直 3:4 海报，细节丰富，采用深海军蓝与暖金色调，呈现光泽感的高级插画质感。设计应类似于偶像角色卡牌收集页面，带有装饰性边框、胶片条装饰、细小星光、五彩纸屑以及背景中优雅的哥特式拱门。

布局：总共使用 7 张角色插画：1 张大型中央全身肖像和 6 张较小的周围肖像面板。6 张较小的面板用金色小字标注为 01、02、03、04、05 和 06。将它们排列为顶部两侧各两个面板，中间左右各一个面板，以及底部左右各一个面板，环绕中央人物。中央肖像最大，位于一个华丽的圆角矩形金框内，顶部带有皇冠状装饰纹章，底部有一块小铭牌，显示五个金色小图标：星星、星星、皇冠、星星、星星。

主体细节：角色是一位年轻的动漫偶像女孩，拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="非常长的亮黑色秀发"}，直刘海，长长的侧发丝，并佩戴银色小星星发夹。她的面部在每个面板中都被柔和的矩形模糊效果刻意遮挡，而插画的其他部分保持清晰。她身穿白色短袖泡泡袖衬衫，领口带有褶边，胸前系着黑色丝带蝴蝶结，佩戴带有白色褶边装饰的黑色颈圈、黑色露指手套、银色手镯，穿着高腰深海军蓝百褶裙（带有星系闪光渐变）、白色衬裙褶边、带有银色圆环扣的黑色腰带、臀部悬挂银色星形链条、黑色大腿袜带以及偶像配饰。整体服装主题为 {argument name="outfit theme" default="哥特星穹偶像"}。

面板姿势：包含以下 6 个带编号的侧面板变体：01 展示上半身偶像姿势，一只手握着麦克风靠近右下方，另一只手靠近胸前；02 展示上半身姿势，一只手触摸颈圈或衣领；03 展示腰部以上姿势，一只手向下握着麦克风；04 展示上半身姿势，一只手靠近面部做出俏皮的偶像手势；05 展示侧面/背部四分之三姿势，回眸望向肩后，长发戏剧性地飘动；06 展示欢快的上半身姿势，双手举起做出小指心或指向手势，一个大麦克风漂浮在右侧附近。中央肖像展示偶像全身站立，一只手在脸旁比出剪刀手，裙摆向外展开，呈现自信的演唱会海报姿态。

背景与装饰：将所有肖像置于宏伟的大教堂式大厅内，背景有透出暖光的拱形高窗、深色柱子、夜空闪光、漂浮的五彩纸屑、镜头光晕和魔法星尘。肖像下方的中心位置包含一个大型金色罗盘星徽章、月桂枝和弯曲的胶片条丝带。添加细小的金色编号、纤细的装饰边框、微妙的胶片齿孔标记，以及精致的收藏卡质感。

视觉风格：高分辨率动漫插画、清晰的线条艺术、明亮的高光、富有光泽的头发阴影、戏剧性的轮廓光、复杂的织物褶皱、深海军蓝阴影、金色点缀、梦幻的偶像氛围、对称构图、高级海报设计。

约束：使用 7 张角色描绘，并包含 6 个标注为 01 到 06 的带编号侧面板。所有面部保持相同的柔和模糊效果。除面板编号和装饰图标外，不要添加任何可读文字。避免使用标志、水印和多余角色。

templates.title: Cute retro Tokyo cartoon city landscape

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱复古东京卡通城市景观

templates.prompt: Create a{argument name="city name" default="Tokyo"} The poster features a charming retro cartoon cityscape in a whimsical children's picture book style. The architecture is extremely simplified, using thick geometric shapes, exaggerated proportions, and bold black outlines. It employs a vertical poster composition with a bright cyan-blue dotted sky background and worn beige paper borders.{argument name="landmark" default="Tokyo Tower"} As a clear visual centerpiece: a tall, red and white checkered tower, with a viewing platform adorned with smiling, kawaii faces, rosy cheeks, simple black eyes, and small, open mouths. In the upper left corner, a striking, slanted cartoon font, written in reddish-orange, adds further visual interest.{argument name="headline text" default="TOKYO"} It features a black outline, with the Japanese word "Tokyo" in thick yellow lettering with a black outline below. It includes two large, cream-colored, circular clouds, one on each side. The tower is surrounded by a simplified skyline composed of rectangular buildings in blue, pink, yellow, and orange. It contains five clearly visible signs: a red vertical sign saying "Karaoke," a pink vertical sign saying "Harajuku," a yellow horizontal sign saying "SHIBUYA," a red vertical sign saying "Akihabara," and an advertisement displaying a cute pink-haired character portrait. An additional advertisement with a cute white cat face is added next to the SHIBUYA sign. The foreground shows a row of rounded green trees, a blue river or canal with small white ripples, and a cream-colored, green cartoon train entering from the lower right corner on curved tracks, the train also sporting a smiling, kawaii expression and rosy cheeks. The application features a retro comic book print texture with visible halftone dots, slightly rough ink edges, saturated colors, and interesting proportions, without containing any realistic elements.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 {argument name="city name" default="东京"} 的可爱复古卡通城市景观，采用天真烂漫的儿童绘本风格，建筑极度简化，使用厚实的几何形状、夸张的比例以及粗犷的黑色轮廓线。采用竖版海报构图，背景为明亮的青蓝色网点天空，并带有磨损的米色纸张边框。将 {argument name="landmark" default="东京塔"} 作为清晰的视觉中心：一座高大的红白格纹塔，观景台上绘有微笑的卡哇伊表情、红润的脸颊、简单的黑眼睛和小巧的张开嘴。在左上方，添加醒目的倾斜漫画字体，用红橙色书写 {argument name="headline text" default="TOKYO"} 并带有黑色轮廓，下方用厚实的黄色字体配黑色轮廓标注日文「東京」。包含 2 朵巨大的奶油色圆形云朵，左右各一。塔的周围环绕着简化的天际线，由蓝色、粉色、黄色和橙色的矩形建筑组成。包含 5 个清晰可见的招牌：一个写有「カラオケ」的红色竖招牌，一个写有「原宿」的粉色竖招牌，一个写有 "SHIBUYA" 的黄色横招牌，一个写有「秋葉原」的红色竖招牌，以及一个展示粉色头发可爱角色肖像的广告牌。在 SHIBUYA 招牌旁边额外添加一个带有可爱白猫脸的广告牌。前景展示一排圆润的绿树、一条带有白色小波纹的蓝色河流或运河，以及一列从右下角弯曲轨道驶入的奶油配绿色卡通火车，火车同样带有微笑的卡哇伊表情和红润脸颊。应用带有可见网点、略显粗糙的墨迹边缘、饱和色彩、趣味比例的复古漫画印刷质感，且不包含任何写实元素。

templates.title: Dark Eastern Fantasy Zhao Ling'er Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑东方奇幻赵灵儿海报

templates.prompt: Create a vertical, dark Eastern fantasy movie poster featuring a protagonist from Chinese mythology.{argument name="character name" default="Zhao Ling'er"} The theme revolves around "The Night of Destiny at the Demon-Sealing Tower." At the center of the image is a dignified young Chinese goddess, standing within the ruins of a vertical abyss tower, her lower body submerged in black, reflecting water. Her face should be slightly blurred or featureless, but her posture serene, fatalistic, and sacred. She wears a faded, jade-colored, semi-transparent Hanfu-style dress, with layers of wet gauze, flowing ribbons, beaded chains, silver ornaments, a circular pendant at her waist, bracelets, and black hair styled in double buns, with a long, blue-green veil hanging down. One hand touches the water's surface, creating a luminous circular ripple magic circle. Surrounding her are ancient stone walls, massive hanging iron chains, broken wooden platforms, floating talismans, circular Taoist seals, faint golden Chinese inscriptions, and cold moonlight streaming in from the breach above. In the background on the right, a demonic face, half-hidden in shadow with reddened eyes, is added. The water surface should contain luminous arcane totems, runes, dragon scale patterns, and underwater calligraphy. Using low-saturation cool gray-blue and faded jade tones, the design evokes a damp moonlight, mist, rain-soaked rocks, deep shadows, and subtle gold accents. This gives it the look of a AAA game CG movie poster—ultra-detailed, realistic, atmospheric, oppressive, tranquil, sacred, and ominous, carrying a sense of fate and foreshadowing of death. It contains three main text blocks: a large vertical Chinese title on the left.{argument name="main title" default="Zhao Ling'er"} Below is a small English pinyin "ZHAO LINGER"; near the left is a smaller vertical subtitle.{argument name="subtitle" default="The Demon-Sealing Tower: Descendants of Nuwa - Night of Destiny"} The right side features a vertically arranged poetic introductory text.{argument name="right quote" default="If fate eventually swallows everything, may someone still remember that she once stood quietly under the moonlight."} Avoid modern fashion photography, trendy fantasy styles, anime illustrations, bright colors, clean studio lighting, cute expressions, or plastic-looking clothing.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖版暗黑东方奇幻电影海报，主角为中国仙侠神话中的 {argument name="character name" default="赵灵儿"}，主题围绕“锁妖塔宿命之夜”。画面中心是一位神情庄重的年轻中国女神形象，她站在废墟般的垂直深渊塔内，腰部以下浸没在黑色的倒影水中。她的面部应略显模糊或不着五官，但姿态沉静、宿命且神圣。她身着褪色的青玉色半透明汉服风格礼服，带有湿润的纱质层叠、飘逸的丝带、珠链、银饰、腰间圆形挂饰、腕饰，以及梳着双环髻的黑发，垂下长长的蓝绿色面纱。一只手向下触碰水面，激起发光的圆形涟漪法阵。周围环绕着古老的石墙、巨大的悬挂铁链、破碎的木质平台、漂浮的符纸、圆形道教封印、隐约的金色汉字铭文，以及从上方破口处洒下的清冷月光。在右侧背景中加入一张半隐于阴影中、双眼泛红的恶魔面孔。水面应包含发光的奥术图腾、符印、龙鳞纹理和水下的书法。使用低饱和度的冷灰蓝色和褪色的玉色调，营造潮湿的月光、薄雾、雨湿的岩石、浓重的阴影和微妙的金色点缀。使其看起来像 3A 游戏 CG 电影海报，超精细、写实、氛围感强、压抑、静谧、神圣且充满不祥之兆，带有宿命感和死亡预兆。包含三个主要文本块：左侧为大型竖排中文标题 {argument name="main title" default="赵灵儿"}，下方配有小型英文拼音“ZHAO LINGER”；左侧附近为较小的竖排副标题 {argument name="subtitle" default="锁妖塔 女娲后裔·宿命之夜"}；右侧为竖排诗意引言 {argument name="right quote" default="若宿命终将吞没一切，愿仍有人记得，她曾在月光下安静站立。"}。避免现代时尚摄影、网红仙侠风格、动漫插画、鲜艳色彩、干净的影棚灯光、可爱的表情或塑料质感的服装。
