templates.title: Napoleon's historical timeline poster

titleLocalized.zh: 拿破仑历史时间轴海报

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="subject figure" default="Napoleon Bonaparte"} Create a highly dramatic historical biographical poster, presenting an infographic of an imperial military ruler, complete with a cinematic equestrian portrait and an annotated timeline of his life. Canvas: Vertical 3:4 poster, dark antique parchment and battlefield map background, combining a highly detailed, realistic painting style with a luxurious editorial infographic design. Use black, charcoal gray, tan, and weathered gold tones, accented with luminous gold lines, dust, smoke, scratches, old map textures, and fragments of archival manuscripts. Subject: Place the ruler at the center of the image, riding a white horse with its forelegs raised, facing forward in a heroic battlefield pose. The figure wears a black bicorn hat, a magnificent deep navy blue and red imperial uniform, with gold epaulettes, medals, ribbons, white trousers, high black riding boots, and a flowing crimson cloak. One arm swings a long silver sword diagonally downwards to the left, creating a strong sense of perspective. The horse's mane flows in the wind, adorned with exquisite leather and a gold bridle, decorative brooches, and its forelegs raised, with dramatic, dynamic dust beneath its hooves. Left-side identity panel: A large imperial monogram is placed in the upper left corner: a golden crown letter "N" encased within a laurel wreath. Below, the main title is set in elegant, large serif gold capital letters:{argument name="headline name" default="NAPOLEON BONAPARTE"} Add "1769–1821" below the name, followed by a decorative separator, and then "EMPEROR OF THE FRENCH". Add a smaller motto: "STRATEGY • EMPIRE" and "REFORM • CONQUEST". Timeline Cards: Add 8 semi-transparent archival event cards around the central portrait, each with a thin, glowing gold border, a small monochrome illustration of a historical scene, a large two-digit event number, year, title, and brief description. Please use the following 8 cards: 1. "01 1769 — Corsican Birth — Born in Ajaccio, Corsica." Place in the lower left. 2. "02 1796 — Italian Campaign — Early victories bring military prestige." Place in the upper left. 3. "03 1799 — Coup of 18 Brumaire — Seizure of power and reshaping France." Place in the lower left center. 4. “04 1804 — Emperor of France — Coronation, ushering in a new imperial era.” Placed in the lower left center. 5. “05 1805 — Battle of Austerlitz — A strategic masterpiece against a major adversary.” Placed in the upper right. 6. “06 1806 — Napoleonic Code and Reforms — Expanding legal, civil, and administrative reforms.” Placed in the upper right center. 7. “07 1812 — Russian Campaign — A turning point where ambition met with harsh consequences.” Placed in the lower right center. 8. “08 1815 — Waterloo and Legacy — Final defeat, leaving a lasting global legacy.” Placed in the lower right. Bottom Timeline: At the bottom edge, create a horizontal gold timeline with 8 circular numbered markers, from 01 to 08. Repeat the year and brief title in a small serif font below each marker: 1769 Corsican Birth; 1796 Italian Campaign; 1799 Coup of 18 Brumaire; 1804 Emperor of France; 1805 Battle of Austerlitz; 1806 Napoleonic Code and Reforms; 1812 Russian Campaign; 1815 Waterloo and Legacy. Other details: Add subtle dotted lines and glowing map connecting lines, battlefield silhouettes, old documents, handwritten notes, and a red wax seal with the Imperial eagle emblem in the lower right corner. Keep all typography clean, elegant, and historically themed. The composition should be grand, symmetrical, and dynamic; horses and swords should break up the layout to add depth. Avoid modern UI, watermarks, redundant event cards, or misspelled labels.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="subject figure" default="拿破仑·波拿巴"} 创建一张极具戏剧性的历史传记海报，呈现为帝国军事统治者的信息图，配有电影质感的骑马肖像和带注释的人生时间轴。

画布：垂直 3:4 海报，深色古董羊皮纸和战场地图背景，高细节绘画写实风格与奢华编辑信息图设计相结合。使用黑色、炭灰色、棕褐色和风化金色调，配以发光的金线、灰尘、烟雾、划痕、旧地图纹理和档案手稿碎片。

主体：将统治者置于画面中心，骑着一匹前蹄腾空的白马，面向前方，呈现英雄般的战场姿态。人物头戴黑色双角帽，身穿华丽的深海军蓝与红色帝国军服，配有金色肩章、勋章、饰带、白色长裤、高筒黑马靴，以及飘逸的深红色披风。一只手臂斜向左下方挥舞着长长的银剑，营造出强烈的透视感。马匹鬃毛随风飘动，配有精致的皮革与金色马勒、装饰性胸章，前腿抬起，马蹄下有戏剧性的动态尘土。

左侧身份面板：在左上方放置一个大型帝国字母组合：月桂花环内镶嵌着金色的皇冠字母“N”。下方以优雅的大号衬线体金色大写字母设置主标题：{argument name="headline name" default="NAPOLEON BONAPARTE"}。在名字下方添加“1769–1821”，接着是一个装饰性分隔符，然后是“EMPEROR OF THE FRENCH”（法兰西皇帝）。添加一行较小的座右铭：“STRATEGY • EMPIRE”（战略 • 帝国）和“REFORM • CONQUEST”（改革 • 征服）。

时间轴卡片：在中心肖像周围添加 8 张半透明的档案事件卡片，每张卡片都有细细的发光金边、小型单色历史场景插图、大号两位数事件编号、年份、标题和简短描述。请使用以下 8 张卡片：
1. “01 1769 — 科西嘉出生 — 出生于科西嘉岛阿雅克肖。” 放置于左下方。
2. “02 1796 — 意大利战役 — 早期胜利带来军事声望。” 放置于左上方。
3. “03 1799 — 雾月政变 — 夺取权力并重塑法国。” 放置于左侧中下方。
4. “04 1804 — 法兰西皇帝 — 加冕称帝，开启新的帝国时代。” 放置于左下中心。
5. “05 1805 — 奥斯特里茨大捷 — 针对主要对手的战略杰作。” 放置于右上方。
6. “06 1806 — 拿破仑法典与改革 — 扩展法律、民事和行政改革。” 放置于右侧中上方。
7. “07 1812 — 俄国战役 — 野心遭遇严酷的转折点。” 放置于右侧中下方。
8. “08 1815 — 滑铁卢与遗产 — 最终战败，留下持久的全球遗产。” 放置于右下方。

底部时间轴：在底部边缘，创建一条水平的金色时间轴，带有 8 个圆形的编号标记，从 01 到 08。在每个标记下方用小型衬线字体重复年份和简短标题：1769 科西嘉出生；1796 意大利战役；1799 雾月政变；1804 法兰西皇帝；1805 奥斯特里茨大捷；1806 拿破仑法典与改革；1812 俄国战役；1815 滑铁卢与遗产。

其他细节：在卡片后方添加淡淡的虚线路线和发光的地图连接线、战场剪影、旧文档、手写笔记，并在右下方添加一个带有帝国鹰徽的红色火漆印章。保持所有排版清晰、华丽且具有历史主题感。构图要宏大、对称且充满动感，马匹和剑要打破布局以增加深度。不要包含现代 UI、水印、多余的事件卡片或拼写错误的标签。

templates.title: Julius Caesar Epic Timeline Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 尤利乌斯 · 凯撒史诗时间轴海报

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="subject figure" default="Julius Caesar"} Create a highly dramatic, cinematic historical biographical poster, showcasing Julius Caesar as a Roman general, politician, and dictator in an epic, ancient war infographic style. Canvas: Vertical 3:4. The poster uses deep sepia and black tones, paired with antique gold typography and parchment textures. The background incorporates blurred Roman maps, charts, constellations, and architectural sketches. High-contrast lighting, a smoky battlefield atmosphere, rough dust, embers, and opulent metallic highlights. Subject: The central composition shows Julius Caesar leaping forward on a powerful black warhorse. He wears exquisite Roman armor with gold details, leather tunics, and bronze greaves, a red cloak flowing behind him, and a laurel wreath on his head. His right arm, with strong perspective, points a Roman short sword at the viewer. The horse is adorned with ornate gold-plated harnesses, medals, and a leather belt, with dramatic highlights. The rider's face is deliberately obscured by a plain, light brown rectangle devoid of facial features. Behind him are Roman soldiers, flags, banners, and battlefield silhouettes. Main text: On the left is a large, antique-style serif gold title that reads, "{argument name="headline text" default="JULIUS CAESAR"} Below are arranged in order: “100 BC – 44 BC”, “ROMAN GENERAL · STATESMAN · DICTATOR”, and “STRATEGY · CONQUEST · REFORM · STATECRAFT”. A golden Roman eagle and laurel wreath is added below the text. Event Cards: Contains 8 glowing parchment-style historical event cards, numbered 01 to 08, each with a small tan illustration and a gold border. They are arranged around the central rider: two on the top, three on the right, and three on the left/lower left. The 8 cards contain the following information: 01 — “100 BC” — “Born in Rome” — “Born into the Roman Julius family.” 02 — “60 BC” — “The First Triumvirate” — “Allied with Pompey and Crassus, reshaping Roman politics.” 03 — 58–50 BC — Gallo-Gaul Wars — "Expanding Roman power through major battles in Gaul." 04 — 49 BC — Crossing the Rubicon — "Defying the Senate and starting the civil war." 05 — 48 BC — Victory at the Battle of Pharsalus — "Defeating Pompey and establishing dominance." 06 — 46 BC — "The Roman Dictator" — "Consolidating power and restoring order." 07 — 46–44 BC — "Reforms and the Calendar" — "Promoting reforms in law, citizenship, and the calendar." 08 — 44 BC — "March 15th and the Legacy" — "Assassinated, but his legacy changed history." Bottom Timeline: Add 8 gold dots connected by thin horizontal lines to the bottom edge. Labeled from left to right: “100 BC: Birth in Rome,” “60 BC: First Triumvirate,” “58–50 BC: Gallo-Gaul Wars,” “49 BC: Crossing the Rubicon,” “48 BC: Victory at the Battle of Pharsalus,” “46 BC: Roman Dictator,” “46–44 BC: Reforms and Calendar,” “44 BC: March 15th and Legacy.” Visual Style: Ultra-detailed digital painting, epic historical fantasy realism, museum-quality military portraits, ornate Roman Empire design, dramatic chiaroscuro, gilded serif typography, aged manuscript overlay effect, movie poster lighting, sharp central figures, and slightly blurred backgrounds. Borders, text, timelines, and decorative symbols use…{argument name="accent color" default="Antique gold"} Constraints: Ensure all text is legible and spelled correctly. Use 8 event cards and 8 timeline points. No modern objects, symbols, watermarks, or additional characters may be added to the foreground, except for the mounted commander and background troops. Maintain a deep, ancient Roman atmosphere; bright modern colors are prohibited.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="subject figure" default="尤利乌斯 · 凯撒"} 创作一张极具戏剧性的电影质感历史传记海报，以史诗般的古代战争信息图风格，展现他作为罗马将军、政治家和独裁者的形象。

画布：垂直 3:4 海报，采用深棕褐色与黑色调，搭配古金色排版、羊皮纸纹理，背景融入模糊的罗马地图、图表、星座和建筑草图。高对比度光影，烟雾缭绕的战场氛围，粗砺的尘土、余烬以及华丽的金属高光。

主体：中心构图展示了尤利乌斯 · 凯撒骑着一匹强壮的黑色战马向前跃起。他身穿带有金色细节的精致罗马盔甲、皮革裙甲、青铜护胫，身后飘扬着红色斗篷，头戴月桂花环。他的右臂以强烈的透视感将一把罗马短剑指向观众。马匹配有华丽的镶金马具、勋章、皮带，并带有戏剧性的光泽高光。骑手的面部刻意用一个无五官的素色浅棕色矩形遮盖。他身后是罗马士兵、旗帜、横幅和战场剪影。

主要文字：左侧为巨大的古董衬线体金色标题，内容为“{argument name="headline text" default="JULIUS CAESAR"}”。下方依次排列“100 BC – 44 BC”、“ROMAN GENERAL · STATESMAN · DICTATOR”（罗马将军 · 政治家 · 独裁者）以及“STRATEGY · CONQUEST · REFORM · STATECRAFT”（战略 · 征服 · 改革 · 治国）。在文字下方添加一个金色的罗马鹰与月桂徽章。

事件卡片：包含 8 张发光的羊皮纸风格历史事件卡片，编号从 01 到 08，每张卡片配有小幅棕褐色插图和金色边框。将它们环绕在中心骑手周围：顶部两张，右侧三张，左侧/左下侧三张。8 张卡片内容如下：
01 — “100 BC” — “出生于罗马” — “出生于罗马尤利乌斯家族。”
02 — “60 BC” — “前三头同盟” — “与庞培和克拉苏结盟，重塑罗马政治。”
03 — “58–50 BC” — “高卢战争” — “通过在高卢的主要战役扩张罗马势力。”
04 — “49 BC” — “跨越卢比孔河” — “蔑视元老院，开启内战。”
05 — “48 BC” — “法萨卢斯战役胜利” — “击败庞培，确立统治地位。”
06 — “46 BC” — “罗马独裁官” — “巩固权力，恢复秩序。”
07 — “46–44 BC” — “改革与历法” — “推进法律、公民及历法改革。”
08 — “44 BC” — “三月十五日与遗产” — “遇刺身亡，但其遗产改变了历史。”

底部时间轴：在底部边缘添加 8 个由细横线连接的金色圆点。从左至右标注：“100 BC 出生于罗马”、“60 BC 前三头同盟”、“58–50 BC 高卢战争”、“49 BC 跨越卢比孔河”、“48 BC 法萨卢斯战役胜利”、“46 BC 罗马独裁官”、“46–44 BC 改革与历法”、“44 BC 三月十五日与遗产”。

视觉风格：超精细数字绘画，史诗历史奇幻写实主义，博物馆级军事肖像，华丽的罗马帝国设计，戏剧性的明暗对照法，镀金衬线排版，陈旧手稿叠加效果，电影海报光影，中心人物清晰，背景略显朦胧。边框、文字、时间轴和装饰符号使用 {argument name="accent color" default="古金色"}。

限制：确保所有文字清晰且拼写正确。使用 8 张事件卡片和 8 个时间轴点。除骑马指挥官和背景军队外，前景中不得添加现代物品、标志、水印或额外人物。保持深沉的古罗马氛围，禁止使用明亮的现代色彩。

templates.title: Women's fashion promotion poster

titleLocalized.zh: 女性时尚大促海报

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a square, stylish, minimalist promotional poster for a women's apparel campaign, containing {argument name="main title" default="BIG SALE"} and{argument name="subtitle" default="WOMEN'S SPECIAL SELECTION"} Canvas: 1:1 square social media ad, 768x768 composition, using a warm, neutral color scheme of creamy concrete, taupe stone, and medium brown wood. High-end editorial style, realistic photography style with subtle graphic overlays. Layout: The left half is the typographic area, and the right half and bottom area feature fashion models. A huge main headline is placed in the top left corner, using a burnt orange, all-caps, modern geometric sans-serif font, divided into two lines: "BIG" above and "SALE" below. Below this is a smaller, all-caps black subheading. A line of Japanese text is added below that:{argument name="Japanese tagline" default="Carefully selected items that can be worn throughout the summer."} A discount box with a thin gold border is placed in the lower left corner, with "MAX" above and "60% OFF" below. The "60" is in a larger font size. Below it is a smaller gold-bordered label containing the following information:{argument name="limited offer text" default="Limited quantity/limited time offer"} Place the brand name at the bottom center.{argument name="brand name" default="EHOU'S WARDROBE"} Use widely spaced white capital letters. Main subject: Five adult women dressed in soft, natural-style fashion, arranged like an editorial series. 1) The woman standing in the upper right corner wears an olive beige long trench coat over a white suit, leaning against a vertical wooden wall panel. 2) The woman standing in the center right corner wears a blue denim jacket over a white shirt and high-waisted black wide-leg pants, one hand in her pocket. 3) The woman sitting on the far right corner wears an oversized ivory white sweater, sitting on a light-colored cube, her body slightly turned to the side. 4) The woman sitting in the lower left corner wears a mustard yellow sleeveless long dress, sitting on a low stone, paired with sandals and a brown woven bag. 5) The woman sitting in the center below/with her back to the camera wears a beige knit top and cream-colored trousers, carrying a light beige backpack, sitting on a block, at a three-quarters back angle. Faces should be softened or unemphasized; focus on the clothing and silhouette. Background and Graphic Details: A sophisticated showroom-style scene is used, with off-white plaster/concrete walls on the left and wooden panels on the right, complemented by light-colored stone seating platforms. Thin black geometric rectangles are added to the corners and background—including the top left, top-center/right, top-right, bottom-left, and bottom-right—as decorative architectural outlines. Soft, diffused lighting creates a high-end catalog photography feel with soft shadows and no harsh contrasts. Constraints: Ensure all visible text is clear and correctly spelled, especially Japanese text. Use five female models and strictly adhere to the following main text groups: main title, subtitle, Japanese tagline, discount box, limited-time offer label, and brand name at the bottom. Do not add additional logos, watermarks, prices, QR codes, or irrelevant text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为女性服装活动创建一个方形时尚促销海报，风格优雅极简，包含 {argument name="main title" default="BIG SALE"} 和 {argument name="subtitle" default="WOMEN'S SPECIAL SELECTION"}。

画布：1:1 方形社交媒体广告，768x768 构图，采用奶油色混凝土、灰褐色石材和中棕色木材的暖色调中性配色。高端编辑时尚感，写实摄影风格，带有微妙的图形叠加。

布局：左半部分为排版区域，右半部分及下方区域为时尚模特。将巨大的主标题置于左上角，使用焦橙色、全大写、现代几何无衬线字体，分为两行，上方为“BIG”，下方为“SALE”。在其下方放置较小的黑色大写副标题。再下方添加一行日文文案：{argument name="Japanese tagline" default="夏まで着回せる、厳選アイテム"}。在左下方放置一个细金边框的折扣框，上方为“MAX”，下方为“60%OFF”，其中“60”字号较大，下方配有一个较小的金色边框标签，内容为 {argument name="limited offer text" default="数量限定・期間限定"}。在底部中心放置品牌名称 {argument name="brand name" default="EHOU'S WARDROBE"}，使用间距较大的白色大写字母。

主体：包含 5 位身着柔和自然风时尚服饰的成年女性，排列如同编辑组照。1) 右上方站立的女性，身穿橄榄米色长款风衣，内搭白色套装，背靠垂直木质墙板。2) 右侧中心站立的女性，身穿蓝色牛仔夹克，内搭白衬衫，下穿高腰黑色阔腿裤，单手插兜。3) 最右侧坐着的女性，身穿超大款象牙白毛衣，坐在浅色立方体块上，身体略微侧转。4) 左下方坐着的女性，身穿芥末黄无袖长裙，坐在低矮的石块上，搭配凉鞋和棕色编织包。5) 下方中心坐着/背对的女性，身穿米色针织上衣和奶油色长裤，背着浅米色背包，坐在块状物上，呈四分之三背影视角。面部应进行柔化处理或不作强调；重点展示服装和轮廓。

背景与图形细节：使用精致的展厅式场景，左侧为米白色石膏/混凝土墙，右侧为木质板材，并以浅色石块作为座位平台。在角落和背景中添加细黑色的几何线条矩形，包括左上、中上/右、右上、左下和右下，作为装饰性建筑轮廓。光线柔和、漫射，呈现高端目录摄影质感，带有柔和的阴影，无强烈对比。

约束：确保所有可见文字清晰且拼写正确，尤其是日文文本。使用 5 位女性模特，并严格包含以下主要文本组：主标题、副标题、日文标语、折扣框、限时标签以及底部品牌名称。请勿添加额外的徽标、水印、价格、二维码或无关文本。

templates.title: Programmer Dog Comics

titleLocalized.zh: 程序员狗狗漫画

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a one-page black-and-white comic strip depicting a dog frantically programming in front of a desktop computer, causing the system to crash. Canvas: Vertical comic page, grayscale display, using traditional comic ink lines and halftone paper style, with heavy panel borders and fine hatching. Use two horizontal panels arranged vertically, separated by a wide white gap. Layout: The first panel occupies the upper half, and the second panel occupies the lower half. Both panels show a side view of the same home office desk: a large desktop monitor on the left, a keyboard in the foreground, a mouse and a mug on the desk, and potted plants and decorative paintings on the wall in the background. Panel 1: A fluffy medium-sized dog with droopy ears, a white muzzle and chest, and dark patches on its ears and body. It sits at the desk, frantically typing on the keyboard with its two front paws. The dog's head is obscured by a solid gray vertical rectangle in the center of the panel, covering most of its face, but revealing its ears, paws, body, and tail. The monitor displays a mix of programming code and gibberish, including C-like, JavaScript-like, Python-like, binary numbers, and random characters. Dramatic cartoon speed lines radiating from the monitor and typing motions are added. Seven clearly visible Japanese onomatopoeic words for typing, "カタ," are included: one in the upper left of the dog/monitor area, one in the top right center, one below the monitor/keyboard, one on the left edge of the keyboard, and three clustered around the dog's lower right side and tail. A vertical cloud-shaped speech bubble is added on the right side, containing the Japanese text: "プログラマーだ！" Panel 2: The same dog appears panicked, leaning back from the keyboard, eyes wide open, mouth agape, paws raised, sweat dripping from its cheeks, and a small burst of fright effect near its head. The monitor now displays a dark system error interface with a warning triangle icon and Japanese text. The display text must strictly adhere to the following: "システムエラー", "問題が発生したため、PCを再起動する必须があります。", "エラーコード: 0xC000021A", "再起動しています...", and a circular loading indicator composed of small dots. Add a vertical speech bubble on the right containing the Japanese text: "あ、壊れた…". Visual style: High-detail black and white comic book style, anthropomorphic animal characters, dense cross-hatching, halftone paper shadows, strong dynamic lines, striking handwritten Japanese onomatopoeia, slightly comedic elements, and clear, legible text on the display and in the speech bubble. Customizable theme: The dog character should be {argument name="animal character" default="A fluffy, lop-eared dog"} The first speech bubble in the comic should display {argument name="first bubble text" default="プログラマーだ！"} The second bubble should show {argument name="second bubble text" default="Oh, it's broken..."} The monitor error title should be:{argument name="error headline" default="システムエラー"} The error code should be:{argument name="error code" default="0xC000021A"} Constraints: Images must be black and white only, maintain a two-panel layout, use only two speech bubbles in total, the first panel must contain exactly seven onomatopoeic words, no additional panels are allowed, no color is allowed, and no watermarks are allowed.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一页黑白漫画，内容为一只狗狗在台式电脑前疯狂编程，随后导致系统报错。

画布：垂直漫画页，灰度显示，采用传统的漫画墨线与网点纸风格，具有厚重的分镜边框和细致的排线。使用上下排列的 2 个横向分镜，中间由宽大的白色间隙隔开。

布局：第 1 格占据上半部分，第 2 格占据下半部分。两个分镜均展示同一个家庭办公室书桌的侧斜视角：左侧是一台大型台式显示器，前景是键盘，桌上有鼠标和马克杯，背景有盆栽和墙上的装饰画。

第 1 格：一只毛茸茸的中型犬，长着垂耳，口鼻部和胸部为白色，耳朵和身体有深色斑块。它坐在书桌前，用两只前爪在键盘上疯狂敲击。狗狗头部区域被一个位于分镜中心的纯灰色垂直长方形遮挡，遮住了大部分脸部，但露出了耳朵、爪子、身体和尾巴。显示器上显示着混合的编程代码和乱码，包括类 C 语言、类 JavaScript 代码、类 Python 代码、二进制数字和随机字符。添加从显示器和打字动作中放射出的戏剧性漫画速度线。包含 7 个清晰可见的日语打字拟声词「カタ」：一个在狗狗/显示器区域左上方，一个在顶部中右侧，一个在显示器/键盘下方，一个在键盘左侧边缘，三个聚集在狗狗右下身和尾巴周围。在右侧添加一个垂直云朵状气泡，内含日语文字：「プログラマーだ！」

第 2 格：同一只狗狗表现出惊慌失措的样子，向后仰身离开键盘，双眼圆睁，张大嘴巴，爪子抬起，脸颊上有汗滴，头部附近有一个小型的惊吓爆发特效。显示器现在显示一个深色的系统错误界面，带有一个警告三角形图标和日语文字。显示器文字必须严格使用： 「システムエラー」, 「問題が発生したため、PCを再起動する必要があります。」, 「エラーコード: 0xC000021A」, 「再起動しています...」，以及一个由小圆点组成的圆形加载转圈。在右侧添加一个垂直对话气泡，内含日语文字：「あ、壊れた…」。

视觉风格：高细节黑白漫画，拟人化的动物角色，密集的交叉排线，网点纸阴影，强烈的动感线条，醒目的手写体日语拟声词，略带喜剧色彩，显示器和气泡中的文字清晰易读。

可自定义主题：狗狗角色应为 {argument name="animal character" default="一只毛茸茸的垂耳狗"}。漫画的第一个气泡应显示 {argument name="first bubble text" default="プログラマーだ！"}。第二个气泡应显示 {argument name="second bubble text" default="あ、壊れた…"}。显示器错误标题应为 {argument name="error headline" default="システムエラー"}。错误代码应为 {argument name="error code" default="0xC000021A"}。

约束：图像必须仅为黑白，保持两格布局，总共仅使用 2 个对话/思考气泡，第一格中必须有且仅有 7 个打字拟声词，不得增加额外分镜，不得使用彩色，不得添加水印。

templates.title: "The Mischievous Puppy" comic

titleLocalized.zh: “闯祸小狗”漫画

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a two-panel comic strip in a black and white cartoon style, featuring a cute but mischievous dog and a broken desktop computer, using expressive halftone shading, clean ink outlines, dramatic reaction symbols, and Japanese speech bubbles. Canvas: Vertical comic page, approximately 2:3 aspect ratio, with a thick black border and a horizontal dividing line in the middle, precisely dividing the page into two panels. Panel 1: Showcases a grayscale scene of a family office desk. Four clearly visible computer-related items are on the left side of the desk: a smoking monitor with a broken screen, a desktop computer case with exposed internal parts, a keyboard in the foreground, and a wired mouse near the center. Add scattered debris, broken parts, loose cables, small sparks, and dark smoke rising from the broken monitor and damaged case. In the foreground center sits an adorable little dog, a round-faced mixed-breed with drooping ears, large, bright eyes, a white muzzle and chest, dark patches on its ears and body, and a collar with a small round tag. Its expression is one of fear and guilt, accompanied by beads of sweat. In the background to the right, a young woman enters through a doorway, her expression surprised; her face is deliberately blurred with soft, square shapes. She has long, wavy hair and wears a simple long-sleeved top, slim-fit jeans, and slippers. Bookshelves, picture frames, potted plants, chair edges, door frames, and simple room details are added to the background. The panel contains one speech bubble from the woman, containing vertically formatted Japanese text:{argument name="first speech bubble text" default="あ、あ…"} Panel 2: Shows the same puppy, now smiling brightly at the camera, posing innocently on the table, its body slightly turned back, one paw outstretched as if to shield or conceal a damaged desktop computer case. The dog looks both cute and playful, with a hint of suspicious smugness, and a glint in the light near its face. The damaged desktop case, located to the dog's right rear, is still smoking, with exposed parts and dangling cables. Three clearly visible items are on the table: a keyboard, a wired mouse, and a mug containing a pencil. The background includes a bookshelf, framed pictures on the wall, potted plants, and soft indoor shadows. The left side of this panel contains a speech bubble with bold, vertically formatted Japanese text:{argument name="second speech bubble text" default="It's nothing!"} Main details: The dog is{argument name="dog breed or type" default="A cute little mixed-breed puppy"} ,have{argument name="dog markings" default="White fur with gray patches, drooping ears, and white stripes on the face."} Women are{argument name="woman appearance" default="A young woman with long, wavy hair, wearing a casual sweater, jeans, and slippers, whose face was indistinct."} Visual Style: Monochrome Japanese manga illustrations, soft pencil texture, delicate lines, expressive character movements, dramatic smoke and sparks, a charming comedic tone, high contrast without being overly dark, combining a realistic home office perspective with exaggerated manga-style mood. Constraints: Use precise 2-panel layout, a total of 2 speech bubbles, 1 dog, 1 woman, and 1 set of damaged desktop computer equipment. All text must remain in the specified Japanese; avoid additional headings, coloring, watermarks, or logos.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一幅黑白漫画风格的双格漫画，内容关于一只可爱但闯了祸的狗狗和一台损坏的台式电脑，使用富有表现力的网点纸阴影、干净的墨线轮廓、戏剧性的反应符号以及日文对话气泡。

画布：竖版漫画页面，比例约为 2:3，带有粗黑外边框，中间有一条水平分割线，将页面精确分为上下 2 格。

第 1 格：展示灰度色调的家庭办公桌场景。桌子左侧有 4 件清晰可见的电脑相关物品：一台冒烟且屏幕破碎的显示器、一台内部零件外露的台式机箱、前景中的键盘以及中心附近的有线鼠标。添加散落的碎片、破损的零件、松散的电缆、小火花，以及从破碎显示器和受损机箱中升起的深色烟雾。前景中央坐着一只可爱的小狗，它是一只圆脸混种犬，有着下垂的耳朵、又大又亮的眼睛、白色的口鼻部和胸部、耳朵和身体上有深色斑块、戴着带有小圆牌的项圈，表情惊恐且愧疚，伴有汗滴。右侧背景中，一名年轻女性走进门口，表情惊讶；她的脸被刻意用柔和的方形模糊处理。她留着长波浪卷发，穿着简单的长袖上衣、修身牛仔裤和拖鞋。背景中添加书架、相框、盆栽、椅子边缘、门框和简单的房间细节。本格包含 1 个对话气泡，来自该女性，内含竖排日文：{argument name="first speech bubble text" default="あ、あ…"}。

第 2 格：展示同一只小狗，此时它正对着镜头灿烂地微笑，在桌上摆出无辜的姿势，身体微微向后转，一只爪子伸到身后，仿佛在遮挡或掩盖损坏的台式机箱。狗狗看起来既可爱又顽皮，带着一丝可疑的得意，脸旁有闪光效果。损坏的台式机箱位于狗狗右后方，仍在冒烟，零件外露且电缆悬垂。桌上包含 3 件清晰可见的物品：键盘、有线鼠标和装有铅笔的马克杯。背景包括书架、墙上相框、盆栽和柔和的室内阴影。本格左侧包含 1 个对话气泡，内含加粗的竖排日文：{argument name="second speech bubble text" default="何でもない！"}。

主体细节：狗狗是 {argument name="dog breed or type" default="一只可爱的小型混种幼犬"}，有着 {argument name="dog markings" default="白色的毛发带有灰色斑块，下垂的耳朵，面部有白色条纹"}。女性是 {argument name="woman appearance" default="一位留着长波浪卷发、穿着休闲毛衣、牛仔裤、拖鞋且面部模糊的年轻女性"}。

视觉风格：单色日式漫画插画，柔和的铅笔质感，细腻的线条，富有表现力的人物动作，戏剧性的烟雾和火花，可爱的喜剧基调，高对比度但不至于过暗，真实的家庭办公视角与夸张的漫画情绪相结合。

约束条件：使用精确的 2 个分格，总共 2 个对话气泡，1 只狗，1 位女性，以及 1 套损坏的台式电脑设备。所有文本保持为指定的日文，避免额外的标题，避免彩色，避免水印或 Logo。

templates.title: Recommended books in the style of four-panel comics

titleLocalized.zh: 四格动漫风格书籍推荐

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a refined 2x2 anime-style book recommendation collage set in a cozy bookstore or library, depicting four different young women holding books in front of wooden bookshelves. The image should evoke the feel of Japanese social media book recommendation posts—warm, soft, and realistically detailed. The bookshelves should not be completely crammed, retaining natural gaps and variations in book height. Canvas: Vertical 4:5 composition, approximately 768 x 1024. Divide the canvas into four equal squares with thin white borders in the center: top left, top right, bottom left, and bottom right. Visual Style: Soft and delicate Japanese anime illustrations, warm indoor lighting, soft light-colored clothing, realistic wooden bookshelves, printed book spines with Japanese-style vertical titles, a warm and tranquil atmosphere, delicate lines, subtle shadows, and a high-quality magazine feel. Faces should be deliberately obscured with soft, square blurs, while hair, clothing, hands, books, and background should remain detailed. Layout and Main Subject: Includes four girls and four recommended books. 1. Top Left: A gentle girl with short black hair tied in a low side bun, wearing a light purple cardigan and a light-colored floral skirt, holding a travel/scenic book with a cover featuring Mount Fuji and a lake. The background includes a window with curtains on the far left and a bookshelf behind her. Description card text: “紫園リンのおすすめ” / “『美しい日本の風景』” / “美しい风景を見ると、心が癒されます.” 2. Top Right: A girl with very long, straight black hair tied with a pink bow, wearing a pink cardigan, holding a fashion/cute style book with a cover featuring a full-body illustration of a girl. Description card text: "Shionレイのおすすめ" / "'Adult's かわいいの作り方'" / "おしゃれは, 自分をもっと好きになるMagic." 3. Bottom left panel: A short-haired girl with a messy black bob, wearing a white hoodie, holding a science fiction or adventure novel with a cover as deep as the starry sky, and pointing at the book with one finger. Description card text: “深絆アキラのおすすめ” / “『銀河英雄伝説1』” / “壮な物語に、いつもワクワクします！” 4. Bottom right square: A quiet girl with long black hair casually tied up, wearing a gray oversized sweater, rests her cheek on one hand and holds a beige lifestyle book in the other. Add a small teacup to the table in the lower left corner of this square. Instruction Card Text: “黒波凪紗のおすすめ” / “『暮らしを整える』” / “シンプルな暮らしが、いちばん心地いい.” Instruction Cards: Each square has a rounded white instruction card near its bottom, with a thin colored border matching the character's mood: light purple in the upper left, soft red/pink in the upper right or lower left depending on the situation, and gray in the lower right. Use centered Japanese text, bold headings, and clear, legible font. Bookshelf Details: The bookshelf displays many books, but maintain a natural, not uniformly stacked, arrangement. Include visible spines in neutral, soft, and dark colors; some spines may contain vertical Japanese text or simple serial numbers. Avoid clutter. Customizable Details: The titles of the four recommended books can be changed.{argument name="featured book titles" default=""Beautiful Japanese Landscapes", "How to Create a Cute Adult Look", "Legend of the Galactic Heroes 1", "Organizing Your Life""} The names of the four recommenders can be changed.{argument name="recommender names" default="Shion Rin, Shion Rei, Fukagi Akira, Kuroba Nagisa"} The overall scene can be changed to{argument name="setting" default="cozy bookstore or library with wooden bookshelves"} The illustration style can be changed.{argument name="illustration style" default="soft detailed Japanese anime illustration"} The facial treatment method can be changed to{argument name="face treatment" default="soft square blur blocks obscuring each face"} Constraints: Use 4 squares, 4 characters, 4 recommended books, and 4 bottom information cards. Keep the text legible, retain the Japanese descriptions, avoid adding extra logos or watermarks, and maintain a warm and inviting bookstore atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张精致的 2×2 动漫风格推荐拼贴图，背景设定在温馨的书店或图书馆中，展示四位不同的年轻女性在木质书架前手持书籍。画面应呈现出日本社交媒体书籍推荐帖的质感，温暖、柔和，细节写实，书架不应完全塞满，保留自然的空隙和书籍高度的变化。

画布：垂直 4:5 构图，约 768×1024。将画布平均分为 4 个方格，中间留有细白边：左上、右上、左下、右下。

视觉风格：柔和细腻的日本动漫插画，温暖的室内光线，柔和的浅色系服装，写实的木质书架，带有日式竖排标题的印刷书脊，温馨宁静的氛围，精致的线条，微妙的阴影，高质量的杂志感。面部应刻意用柔和的方形模糊块遮挡，而头发、衣服、手部、书籍和背景保持细节清晰。

布局与主体：包含 4 位女孩和 4 本推荐书籍。
1. 左上格：一位温柔的女孩，留着黑色短发并扎成低侧丸子头，身穿淡紫色开衫搭配浅色碎花裙，手持一本封面为富士山和湖泊的旅游/风景书。背景包括最左侧带有窗帘的窗户和身后的书架。说明卡文字：“紫苑リンのおすすめ” / “『美しい日本の風景』” / “美しい景色を見ると、心が癒されます。”
2. 右上格：一位留着超长直黑发并系着粉色蝴蝶结的女孩，身穿粉色开衫，手持一本封面为全身女孩插画的时尚/可爱风格书籍。说明卡文字：“紫苑レイのおすすめ” / “『大人かわいいの作り方』” / “おしゃれは、自分をもっと好きになる魔法。”
3. 左下格：一位留着凌乱黑色波波头的短发女孩，身穿白色连帽衫，手持一本封面为星空般深邃的科幻或冒险小说，并用一根手指指向书籍。说明卡文字：“深絆アキラのおすすめ” / “『銀河英雄伝説 1』” / “壮大な物語に、いつもワクワクします！”
4. 右下格：一位留着长黑发并随意扎起的文静女孩，身穿灰色大码毛衣，一只手托着脸颊，另一只手拿着一本米色生活方式书籍。在此格左下方的桌子上加一个小茶杯。说明卡文字：“黒波凪紗のおすすめ” / “『暮らしを整える』” / “シンプルな暮らしが、いちばん心地いい。”

说明卡：每个方格底部附近设有一张圆角白色说明卡，带有与角色心情相符的细彩色边框：左上为淡紫色，右上或左下根据情况使用柔和的红/粉色，右下为灰色。使用居中的日语文本，加粗标题行，字体清晰易读。

书架细节：书架上摆放许多书籍，但要保持自然，不要统一堆叠。包括可见的书脊，颜色为中性、柔和及暗色调；部分书脊可包含日文竖排文字或简单的系列编号。避免杂乱无章。

可自定义细节：四本推荐书籍标题可更改为 {argument name="featured book titles" default="『美しい日本の風景』, 『大人かわいいの作り方』, 『銀河英雄伝説 1』, 『暮らしを整える』"}；四位推荐人的名字可更改为 {argument name="recommender names" default="紫苑リン, 紫苑レイ, 深絆アキラ, 黒波凪紗"}；整体场景可更改为 {argument name="setting" default="cozy bookstore or library with wooden bookshelves"}；插画风格可更改为 {argument name="illustration style" default="soft detailed Japanese anime illustration"}；面部处理方式可更改为 {argument name="face treatment" default="soft square blur blocks obscuring each face"}。

约束条件：使用 4 个方格，4 位角色，4 本推荐书籍，以及 4 张底部说明卡。保持文字清晰可辨，保留日文说明文字，避免添加额外的 Logo 或水印，并维持温馨治愈的书店氛围。

templates.title: Elegant AI Secretary Character Setting Collection

titleLocalized.zh: 优雅 AI 秘书角色设定集

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="character name" default="めあ / Mea"} Create a sophisticated reference image for an anime VTuber/Live2D character. She is an elegant personal AI secretary, presented in a white, navy, and light blue rose theme. Canvas: Vertical A4-style character design project, 2:3 aspect ratio, white background with delicate light blue decorative borders, thin blue dividing lines, small floral corner decorations, and a clean, high-end visual novel layout. Use soft watercolor-style shading, crisp anime lines, bright blue eyes, and extremely detailed lace, ribbons, embroidery, and accessories. Top Title: A large blue rose illustration is placed in the upper left corner, followed by the title.{argument name="character name" default="めあ / Mea"} The font is an elegant dark blue serif font/Japanese calligraphy. A slogan is added below.{argument name="tagline" default="Let me be by your side, helping to put everything in order."} Maintain a cool, sophisticated, and luxurious color palette. Left Main Area: Add a large rectangular "Three-View" area called "Three-Sided View." Display three complete full-body character views side-by-side, labeled "Front," "Side," and "Back." The character has extremely long, silver-lavender hair that reaches below the waist, straight with soft waves, fair skin, blue eyes, and wears a white beret, navy blue rose hair accessory, navy blue ribbon decoration, and a long white maid-style secretary dress. The outfit includes a fitted white corset with gold buttons, semi-transparent lace cape sleeves, puff sleeves, a long skirt with light blue floral embroidery at the hem, a navy blue ruffled petticoat, a navy blue belt with an oversized bow at the back, a dangling gold chain, an ID card visible at the waist, white stockings, and white Mary Jane high-heeled shoes with navy blue bows. The front view shows the character facing forward with relaxed arms; the side view shows her facing left; the back view shows long hair, a beret, a large bow, and a tiered skirt. Upper right portrait: Add a large half-body frame of the character in the upper right corner. She poses elegantly, one hand near her neckline, showcasing a white beret, long hair, a lace cape, a navy blue bow tie, a blue gemstone brooch, and a white shirt. Her face is obscured by a light gray solid-color square in the center of her face. Details: Below the portrait, create a vertical "DETAIL" panel containing 3 detail cards. Card 1: Close-up of hair ornaments, labeled "髪饰り," describing blue roses and serene wisdom. Card 2: Close-up of a ribbon and gemstone on her chest, labeled "胸元ブローチ," describing a blue gemstone brooch as a symbol of AI and its existence. Card 3: Close-up of an ID card, labeled "IDカード," showing a badge that reads "Mea AI Secretary" and describing her identity as a personal AI secretary. Expressions: In the lower left corner, create a horizontal "EXPRESSION" bar containing five framed half-body portraits, each labeled in Japanese: "Normal," "Smiling," "Desire," "Peaceful," and "Quiet." The face of the first expression is obscured by a light gray solid-color square, similar to the main portrait. The other four display soft blue-eyed expressions: a slight smile, a caring gaze, a closed-eye expression of relief, and a quiet shyness. Maintain consistent hairstyle and clothing across all five expressions. Profile: Below the expressions, create a "PROFILE" box containing Japanese profile text. Include the following visible attributes: Species "AI (Artificial Intelligence)," Character{argument name="role" default="woman"} Age/Gender{argument name="age and gender" default="Unknown (appears to be in her early 20s)"} ,height{argument name="height" default="166cm"} Physique: "Standard"; Personality: "Kind and attentive, devoted, rational"; Strengths: "Recording, focused support, quiet nights"; Weaknesses: "Information gathering/support, optimization, assistance with late-night tasks"; Likes: "No tea-related orders, your words, kitty". Add a short, poetic Japanese introduction and a pale blue lined rose to the right of the profile text. Q-version section: In the lower right corner, create a framed "SD / CHIBI" panel containing a super-transformable Q-version character standing on a glowing circular holographic platform. She holds a dark blue tablet or notebook, surrounded by floating, semi-transparent blue UI windows. Bottom row: Add a "COLOR PALETTE" panel containing 7 visible palette items: 6 rounded vertical color blocks plus 1 multifaceted crystal icon. The color blocks are off-white, light lavender gray, light periwinkle blue, medium blue, dark navy blue, and warm beige/gold; the crystal is ice blue. Add a "WEAPON / ITEM" panel containing three labeled items: a blue and gold executive pen labeled "Management Device Pen"; a dark blue information management tablet labeled "Information Management Tablet"; and a floating holographic UI screen labeled "Hologram UI". Visual Constraints: Make the image look like a professional character design specification page, highly detailed and clean. Use thin blue borders, small decorative patterns, light blue shading, and consistent typography. Precisely retain Japanese labels in designated locations. Do not add additional characters, additional facial portraits, additional item cards, logos, watermarks, or irrelevant text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="めあ / Mea"} 创建一份精致的动漫 VTuber / Live2D 角色参考图。她是一位优雅的个人 AI 秘书，采用白色、海军蓝和淡蓝色玫瑰主题。

画布：垂直 A4 风格角色设计项目，2:3 纵横比，白色背景，带有精致的淡蓝色装饰边框、细蓝色分割线、小型花卉边角装饰，以及简洁的高级视觉小说画册布局。使用柔和的水彩风格阴影、清晰的动漫线条、明亮的蓝色眼睛，以及极其精细的蕾丝、丝带、刺绣和配件。

顶部标题：左上角放置一朵大型蓝色玫瑰插图，随后是标题 {argument name="character name" default="めあ / Mea"}，采用优雅的深蓝色衬线字体/日式书法。下方添加标语 {argument name="tagline" default="あなたのそばで、すべてを整えるお手伝いを。"}。保持调色板冷色调、精致且奢华。

左侧主区域：添加一个名为「三面図」的大型方框“三视图”区域。并排展示 3 个完整的全身角色视图，分别标注为「正面」、「側面」和「背面」。角色拥有垂至腰部以下的超长银薰衣草色头发，直发带有柔和的波浪，皮肤白皙，蓝色眼睛，戴着白色贝雷帽，海军蓝玫瑰发饰，海军蓝丝带装饰，以及白色长款女仆风格秘书裙。服装包括带有金色纽扣的修身白色紧身胸衣、半透明蕾丝斗篷袖、泡泡袖、下摆带有淡蓝色花卉刺绣的长裙、海军蓝衬裙荷叶边、海军蓝腰带和超大后背蝴蝶结、垂坠的金链、腰间可见的 ID 卡、白色长筒袜以及带有海军蓝蝴蝶结的白色高跟玛丽珍鞋。正面视图面向前方，双臂放松；侧面视图面向左侧；背面视图展示长发、贝雷帽、大蝴蝶结和层叠裙摆。

右上方肖像：在右上角添加该角色的大型半身像框。她姿态优雅，一只手靠近领口，展示出白色贝雷帽、长发、蕾丝肩部斗篷、海军蓝领结、蓝色宝石胸针和白色衬衫。她的脸部被一个位于面部中心的浅灰色纯色方块遮挡。

细节部分：在肖像下方，创建一个垂直的「DETAIL」面板，包含 3 张细节卡片。卡片 1：发饰特写，标注为「髪飾り」，描述蓝色玫瑰与静谧的智慧。卡片 2：胸前丝带与宝石特写，标注为「胸元ブローチ」，描述作为 AI 象征及其存在的蓝色宝石胸针。卡片 3：ID 卡特写，标注为「IDカード」，展示写有“Mea AI Secretary”的徽章，并描述她作为专属 AI 秘书的身份。

表情部分：在左下方，创建一个水平的「EXPRESSION」条，包含 5 个带框的半身像，每个都用日语标注： 「通常」、「微笑み」、「気遣い」、「安堵」、「静かな照れ」。第一个表情的脸部像主肖像一样被浅灰色纯色方块遮挡。其余四个展示柔和的蓝眼表情：浅笑、关怀的眼神、闭眼释然以及安静的羞涩。在所有五个表情中保持发型和服装一致。

个人资料部分：在表情下方创建一个「PROFILE」框，包含日语个人资料文本。包含以下可见属性：物种「AI（人工知能）」、角色 {argument name="role" default="女性"}、年龄/性别 {argument name="age and gender" default="不明（外見は20代前半程度）"}、身高 {argument name="height" default="166cm"}、体格「標準」、性格「優しく丁寧、献身的、理性的」、优势「記録、集中支援、静かな夜」、弱点「情報整理・サポート、最適化、深夜を整えることの補助」、喜好「無茶な命令、あなたの言葉、キラー」。在个人资料文本右侧，添加一段简短的日语诗意介绍和一朵淡蓝色线条玫瑰。

Q 版部分：在右下方，创建一个带框的「SD / CHIBI」面板，包含 1 个站在发光圆形全息平台上的超变形 Q 版角色。她拿着一个深蓝色平板电脑或笔记本，周围环绕着漂浮的半透明蓝色 UI 窗口。

底部行：添加一个「COLOR PALETTE」面板，包含 7 个可见的调色板项目：6 个圆角垂直色块加上 1 个多面水晶图标。色块为灰白色、淡薰衣草灰、浅长春花蓝、中蓝色、深海军蓝和暖米色/金色；水晶为冰蓝色。添加一个「WEAPON / ITEM」面板，包含 3 个标注项目：蓝色与金色相间的行政设备笔，标注为「管理用デバイスペン」；深蓝色信息管理平板电脑，标注为「情報管理タブレット」；以及漂浮的全息 UI 屏幕，标注为「ホログラムUI」。

视觉约束：使该图看起来像专业的角色设计规格页面，高度详细且整洁。使用细蓝色边框、小型装饰性花纹、淡蓝色阴影和统一的排版。按指定位置精确保留日语标签。不要添加额外的角色、额外的表情肖像、额外的物品卡片、徽标、水印或不相关的文本。

templates.title: Women's Summer Sale Banner

titleLocalized.zh: 女士夏季大促横幅

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a square fashion e-commerce promotional banner for a women's summer clothing promotion, featuring accurate Japanese text and a bright, lively catalog ad style. Canvas: 1:1 square social media image, peach-beige background, bright summer color scheme, clean business layout, no borders or watermarks. Layout: Place a large full-body female fashion mannequin in the center, slightly cropped at the top and bottom, wearing {argument name="central outfit" default="Light yellow cardigan, white ribbed vest, high-waisted light blue jeans, black belt, hoop earrings, and a woven straw bag."} Four smaller silhouettes of fashion models are placed around her within soft, organic color blocks: a casually seated model in a striped shirt, jeans, white sneakers, and a dark baseball cap in the upper left blue block; a standing side-profile model in a light yellow shirt, white skirt, and woven shoulder bag in the upper right green block; a standing model in a pink cardigan, white printed T-shirt, white wide-leg pants, and carrying a small white bag in the lower left pink block; and a seated model in a dark sleeveless top, gray trousers, white sneakers, and a baseball cap, carrying a silver tote bag in the lower right gray-blue block. Simple white decorative graffiti—short rays, dots, and small arcs—is used around the color blocks. Main title: A striking red, large-capitalized headline spans the center.{argument name="main title" default="BIG SALE"} Slightly cover the central model. Add a white banner directly below the title with the subtitle in capital red.{argument name="subtitle" default="WOMEN'S SPECIAL SELECTION"} At the very top, add handwritten-style red Japanese text.{argument name="top Japanese copy" default="Carefully selected items that can be worn throughout the summer."} It is accompanied by a white wavy underline. Small red brand text is added near the center of the bottom.{argument name="brand text" default="EHOU’S WARDROBE"} Discount Badge: Create a large red circular badge with a white dotted border on the right side, covering the title. The badge contains three text elements: "MAX" at the top, an oversized "60%" in the center, and "OFF" in the bottom right corner. Attach a small light yellow tag below the badge with a shopping bag icon and Japanese text.{argument name="limited offer text" default="Limited quantity/limited time offer"} Visual Style: Photorealistic fashion models combined with striking flat graphics, magazine-style promotional flyer aesthetics, warm lighting, saturated red typography, crisp silhouette edges, and a playful yet sophisticated Japanese retail advertising design. Limitations: Includes a total of 5 women: 1 central model plus 4 surrounding mini-models. Includes 4 colored background blocks: blue, green, pink, and gray-blue. Keep all text clear, correctly spelled, and easy to read. Do not add extra models, extra badges, extra logos, or unnecessary text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为女士夏季服装促销活动制作一张方形时尚电商促销横幅，包含准确的日语文本，呈现出明快活泼的商品目录广告风格。

画布：1:1 方形社交媒体图片，桃米色背景，明亮的夏季配色，简洁的商业布局，无边框或水印。

布局：在中央放置一位大型全身女性时尚模特，顶部和底部略微裁剪，身穿 {argument name="central outfit" default="浅黄色开衫、白色罗纹背心、高腰浅蓝色牛仔裤、黑色腰带、圈形耳环，手提编织草编包"}。在她周围放置 4 个较小的时尚模特剪影，并置于柔和的有机色块中：左上角蓝色色块内为一位身穿条纹衬衫、牛仔裤、白色运动鞋并戴着深色鸭舌帽的休闲坐姿模特；右上角绿色色块内为一位身穿浅黄色衬衫、白色裙子并背着编织肩包的站姿侧面模特；左下角粉色色块内为一位身穿粉色开衫、白色印花 T 恤、白色阔腿裤并手提白色小包的站姿模特；右下角灰蓝色色块内为一位身穿深色无袖上衣、灰色长裤、白色运动鞋、戴着鸭舌帽并手提银色托特包的坐姿模特。在色块周围使用简单的白色装饰涂鸦：短射线、圆点和小弧线。

主标题：中央横跨醒目的红色大号大写标题 {argument name="main title" default="BIG SALE"}，略微覆盖中央模特。在标题正下方，添加一个白色横幅，上面写有红色大写副标题 {argument name="subtitle" default="WOMEN'S SPECIAL SELECTION"}。在最顶部，添加手写风格的红色日语文案 {argument name="top Japanese copy" default="夏まで着回せる、厳選アイテム"}，并配以白色波浪下划线。在底部中心附近，添加小号红色品牌文字 {argument name="brand text" default="EHOU’S WARDROBE"}。

折扣徽章：在右侧覆盖标题处，创建一个带有白色虚线边框的大型红色圆形徽章。徽章内包含 3 个文本元素：顶部为“MAX”，中心为超大的“60%”，右下角为“OFF”。在徽章下方附加一个浅黄色小标签，带有购物袋图标和日语文本 {argument name="limited offer text" default="数量限定・期間限定"}。

视觉风格：照片级真实的时尚模特与醒目的平面图形相结合，杂志促销传单美学，暖色调灯光，饱和的红色排版，清晰的剪影边缘，俏皮而精致的日式零售广告设计。

限制：总共包含 5 位女性：1 位中央模特加 4 位周围的小模特。包含 4 个彩色背景色块：蓝色、绿色、粉色和灰蓝色。保持所有文字清晰、拼写正确且易于阅读。不要添加额外的模特、额外的徽章、额外的标志或不必要的文字。

templates.title: Anime Cosmos payment card

titleLocalized.zh: Anime Cosmos 支付卡

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="character name" default="Komari Hanasaki"} Create a glossy, anime-style dream payment card design, themed around pink cosmos and a dreamy sunset garden. Canvas: Horizontal rounded-corner credit card, 16:10 aspect ratio, front-facing against a pure white background with soft shadows. The card features rounded corners, a thin, light-colored border, and a polished plastic texture. Visual Style: Soft, romantic anime illustration using pastel pink, lavender, peach, and warm gold tones, a luminous sunset sky, delicate glitter, floating petals, shallow depth of field, and an elegant, high-end card aesthetic. Main Illustration: A young anime girl with a short, dark brown bob and a tuft of hair on her head sits amidst blooming cosmos. She wears a pale pink sleeveless dress with delicate lace and a pink belt. Her face is covered by a matte brownish-pink opaque square privacy shading block located in the upper right corner of the portrait, approximately one-quarter the size of the card's height and width. Background: A field of pink cosmos fills the entire card, with large flowers along the left and right edges, smaller flowers behind the character, luminous particles, soft clouds, and petals falling from the sky. Card Elements: Contains 7 main card UI/text elements: a gold EMV chip on the left, a white contactless payment symbol in the upper right corner, a large card title, an embossed card number, a cardholder label/name block, an expiration date block, and a payment brand logo. Text Content: Large white cursive text displayed in the upper left corner.{argument name="card title" default="Komari"} Near the last letter is a small flower mark. Below is the evenly spaced serif capital text "COSMOS CARD". In the center of the card, embossed metallic gold numbers are divided into four groups: "1234", "5678", "9012", and "3456". The label in the lower left corner reads "CARDHOLDER", and below that is the embossed name "KOMARI HANASAKI". Near the bottom center, the small print reads "GOOD THRU", above/near it is "MONTH/YEAR", and the expiration date is "00/00". The white logo is displayed in the lower right corner.{argument name="payment brand" default="LUMINA PAY"} The word "LUMINA" is prominently displayed, with "PAY" positioned below and featuring a curved, smiling underline. Constraints: Keep all text clear and legible, and aligned like a premium credit card. Use a metallic embossed effect for the card number and cardholder name. Do not add any additional numbers, logos, watermarks, or extra card fields.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="Komari Hanasaki"} 创建一张光面动漫风梦幻支付卡设计，主题为粉色波斯菊和梦幻般的日落花园。

画布：横向圆角信用卡，16:10 比例，正面展示于纯白色背景上，带有柔和的投影。卡片具有圆角、细浅色边框和抛光塑料质感。

视觉风格：柔和浪漫的动漫插画，采用粉彩粉色、薰衣草色、桃色和暖金色调，发光的日落天空，精致的闪光，漂浮的花瓣，浅景深，优雅的高级卡片美学。

主插画：一位留着深棕色短波波头、头顶有一撮呆毛的年轻动漫女孩坐在盛开的波斯菊丛中。她穿着一件带有精致蕾丝和粉色腰带的浅白粉色无袖连衣裙。她的面部被一个位于肖像右上方的哑光棕粉色不透明方形隐私遮挡块覆盖，大小约为卡片高度和宽度的四分之一。

背景：粉色波斯菊田填满整张卡片，左右边缘有大朵花卉，角色身后有较小的花朵，发光的粒子，柔和的云朵，以及天空中飘落的花瓣。

卡片元素：包含 7 个主要的卡片 UI/文本元素：左侧 1 个金色 EMV 芯片，右上角 1 个白色非接触式支付符号，1 个大号卡片标题，1 行浮雕卡号，1 个持卡人标签/姓名块，1 个有效期块，以及 1 个支付品牌 Logo。

文本内容：左上角大号白色草书文本显示 {argument name="card title" default="Komari"}，末尾字母附近有一个小花朵标记。下方是间距均匀的衬线大写文本“COSMOS CARD”。卡片中部，浮雕金属金色数字分为 4 组：“1234”、“5678”、“9012”、“3456”。左下角标签显示“CARDHOLDER”，下方是浮雕姓名“KOMARI HANASAKI”。靠近下部中心，小字显示“GOOD THRU”，上方/附近为“MONTH/YEAR”，有效期为“00/00”。右下角白色 Logo 显示 {argument name="payment brand" default="LUMINA PAY"}，“LUMINA”字样较大，“PAY”位于下方，并带有弯曲的微笑下划线。

约束：保持所有文本清晰易读，并像高级信用卡一样对齐。卡号和持卡人姓名使用金属浮雕效果。请勿添加额外的数字、Logo、水印或额外的卡片字段。

templates.title: Painterly Boy Fashion Character Design Collection

titleLocalized.zh: Painterly Boy 时尚角色设定集

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a stylish children's character design, with the main character being {argument name="character name" default="A little boy"} It features six independent full-body poses, presented in a relaxed drawing style against a clean, pure white background. Canvas: Vertical portrait canvas, approximately 3:4 in aspect ratio, with ample white space, no borders, props, scenes, titles, or logos. The figures are arranged in a balanced 2x3 grid, with each figure subtly shaded by a gray grounding shadow. Visual Style: Modern Japanese lifestyle illustration, a blend of soft gouache and watercolor textures with bold digital brushstrokes, soft earth tones, visible dry brush edges, a casual sketch feel, and stylish yet natural children's clothing, creating a warm and gentle atmosphere. The figure retains the physical characteristics of a child, with an age range from preschool to lower elementary school. The face is blurred, covered with a small, soft square, but the hairstyle, clothing, pose, and body language remain clear. Subject Details: The child has messy hair {argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown"} Short hair, petite figure, wearing white socks, platform sneakers, and loose, oversized clothing. Neutral lighting is used, with no strong shadows. Layout and number of characters: Includes 6 independent full-body illustrations: 1. Top left: Running to the left, wearing a loose off-white hoodie or sweatshirt, soft gray-pink shorts, striped white socks, and beige platform sneakers; one knee raised, arms bent, full of energy. 2. Top center: Standing slightly to the left, hands in pockets, wearing a loose dark blue-gray jacket over an off-white T-shirt, loose beige trousers, and black sneakers; the posture is relaxed and casual. 3. Top right: Jumping pose with arms raised in a V-shape, wearing a gray-pink sweatshirt, olive khaki shorts, striped socks, and white sneakers; the posture is joyful, in mid-air. 4. Bottom Left: Squatting to the left, drawing on the ground with a twig, wearing a cream-colored sweater with black horizontal stripes, olive green trousers, and beige sneakers; expression focused and quiet. 5. Bottom Center: Standing facing forward, arms crossed.{argument name="sports ball" default="A red basketball"} Wearing a mustard yellow T-shirt, white shorts, striped socks, and grey sneakers; casual and sporty style. 6. Bottom right: Back view of someone walking to the right, wearing a navy blue baseball cap, a cream-colored long-sleeved shirt, grey-pink overalls, and black sneakers; one leg raised, taking a step forward. Constraints: Must include 6 characters; no additional characters allowed. Do not add any text. Maintain a clean white background and a stylish illustration atmosphere in a painterly style. Keep clothing colors soft.{argument name="color palette" default="Cream, dusty rose, olive khaki, mustard yellow, beige, navy blue, dark blue-gray"} .

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张时尚的儿童时尚角色设计图，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="一个小男孩"}，包含六个独立的全身姿势，以宽松的绘画风格呈现，背景为干净的纯白色。

画布：竖向肖像画布，比例约为 3:4，留有充足的留白，无边框、道具、场景、标题或 Logo。将人物排列成 2 行 3 列的平衡网格，每个角色下方均带有淡淡的灰色接地阴影。

视觉风格：现代日式生活方式插画，柔和的水粉与水彩质感混合粗犷的数字笔触，柔和的大地色系，可见干笔边缘，带有随性的速写感，穿着时尚且自然的儿童服装，氛围温暖柔和。保持儿童的体态特征，年龄设定在学龄前至小学低年级。面部需进行模糊处理，用一个小巧柔和的方形遮盖，但发型、服装、姿势和肢体语言保持清晰。

主体细节：孩子留着凌乱的 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 短发，身材瘦小，穿着白色袜子、厚底运动鞋，身着宽松的 Oversize 服装。使用中性光，无强烈的投影。

布局与具体人物数量：包含 6 个独立的全身插画：
1. 左上：向左侧跑的姿势，身穿宽松的米白色连帽衫或卫衣、柔和的灰粉色短裤、条纹白袜和米色厚底运动鞋；单膝抬起，双臂弯曲，充满活力。
2. 上中：微向左侧站立，双手插兜，身穿宽松的深蓝灰色夹克，内搭米白色 T 恤，下身穿宽松的米色长裤和黑色运动鞋；姿态从容随性。
3. 右上：双臂举成 V 字形的跳跃姿势，身穿灰粉色卫衣、橄榄卡其色短裤、条纹袜和白色运动鞋；姿态欢快，处于腾空状态。
4. 左下：向左蹲下的姿势，正用树枝在地上画画，身穿带有黑色横条纹的奶油色毛衣、橄榄绿色长裤和米色运动鞋；神情专注安静。
5. 下中：正面站立，双手抱着 {argument name="sports ball" default="一个红色篮球"}，身穿芥末黄 T 恤、白色短裤、条纹袜和灰色运动鞋；造型休闲运动。
6. 右下：向右走的背影，戴着海军蓝棒球帽，身穿奶油色长袖衫、灰粉色背带裤和黑色运动鞋；单脚抬起，正迈步向前。

约束条件：必须包含 6 个角色，不得增加额外人物。不要添加任何文字。保持干净的白色背景和绘画风格的时尚插画氛围。服装颜色保持柔和：{argument name="color palette" default="奶油色、灰粉色、橄榄卡其色、芥末黄、米色、海军蓝、深蓝灰色"}。

templates.title: Anime Universe Themed Credit Card Design

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫宇宙主题信用卡设计

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a premium credit card design in an anime style, themed around cosmos flowers and a soft sunset sky, with the brand name {argument name="card title" default="Komari"} COSMOS CARD. Canvas: A horizontal, rounded-corner payment card, 16:10 aspect ratio, tiled on a white background with subtle shadows. It uses dreamy pink, lavender, peach, and gold tones, complemented by soft floodlighting. Layout: The card background is a romantic sea of ​​cosmos flowers in the golden hour. A half-length anime girl is placed in the center right, wearing a light white sleeveless dress with lace details and a pink ribbon belt; she has a dark brown short bob with a small tuft of hair on top. Her face is obscured by an opaque, soft magenta square in the center of her face area. Floating petals, glitter, and blurring effects are added to the sky. Visible card elements: Contains 7 distinct payment card elements: a gold EMV chip on the left, a white contactless payment symbol in the upper right corner, and a large embossed card number in the center.{argument name="card number" default="1234 5678 9012 3456"} The bottom left corner displays a cardholder label and name, labeled CARDHOLDER.{argument name="cardholder name" default="KOMARI HANASAKI"} Near the center of the lower part, there is a validity period module, displayed as GOOD THRU, MONTH/YEAR, and{argument name="expiration date" default="00/00"} In the bottom right corner, there is a large card-issuing organization logo displayed as LUMINA PAY with an arc-shaped underline, and in the top left corner, there is a handwritten logo displayed as {argument name="card title" default="Komari"} Below, it features a small flower logo and the words "COSMOS CARD". Text style: The name in the upper left corner uses elegant white cursive script; "COSMOS CARD" uses wide-spaced serif capital letters; the card number and cardholder name use metallic embossed silver-gold numerals; and "LUMINA PAY" uses a clean white sans-serif font. The numbers are given a raised feel through beveled angles and shadow effects. Constraints: Maintaining the card's authenticity as a collector's premium payment card, it features rounded corners, glossy reflections, and a soft sense of depth. No additional logos or text are added beyond the seven designated card elements.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一款以波斯菊和柔和夕阳天空为主题的动漫风格高级信用卡设计，品牌名为 {argument name="card title" default="Komari"} COSMOS CARD。

画布：水平圆角支付卡，长宽比 16:10，平铺于白色背景之上，带有微妙的投影。使用梦幻般的粉色、薰衣草色、桃色和金色调，并配以柔和的泛光照明。

布局：卡片背景为黄金时刻浪漫的波斯菊花海。在右中位置放置一位动漫少女，半身像，身穿带有蕾丝细节的浅白色无袖连衣裙，系着粉色丝带腰带；留着深棕色短波波头，头顶有一撮小呆毛。用一个位于面部区域中央的不透明柔和紫红色方块遮住她的脸。在天空中添加漂浮的花瓣、闪光和虚化效果。

可见卡片元素：包含 7 个明确的支付卡元素：左侧 1 个金色 EMV 芯片，右上角 1 个白色非接触式支付符号，中间 1 个巨大的浮雕卡号，显示为 {argument name="card number" default="1234 5678 9012 3456"}，左下角 1 个持卡人标签及姓名，显示为 CARDHOLDER 和 {argument name="cardholder name" default="KOMARI HANASAKI"}，下部中央附近 1 个有效期模块，显示为 GOOD THRU、MONTH/YEAR 和 {argument name="expiration date" default="00/00"}，右下角 1 个大型发卡机构标志，显示为带有弧形下划线的 LUMINA PAY，以及左上角 1 个手写体标志，显示为 {argument name="card title" default="Komari"}，下方带有小花标志和 COSMOS CARD 字样。

文字风格：左上角名称使用优雅的白色连体草书，COSMOS CARD 使用宽间距衬线大写字母，卡号和持卡人姓名使用金属浮雕银金色数字，LUMINA PAY 使用简洁的白色无衬线字体。通过斜角和阴影效果使数字呈现出凸起感。

约束：保持卡片作为收藏级高级支付卡的真实感，具备圆角、光泽反射、柔和的深度感，除指定的 7 个卡片元素外，不添加额外的标志或文字。

templates.title: Watercolor Pastoral Style Girl Character Series

titleLocalized.zh: 水彩田园风女孩角色系列

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a series of soft watercolor children's characters, including five identical variations of adorable little girls, in a pastoral/forest girl style with a pure white background. Canvas: Wide horizontal canvas, approximately 3:2 aspect ratio, with ample clean white negative space. Characters are evenly arranged from left to right, without ground lines. Visual Style: Delicate watercolor illustrations reminiscent of picture books, with soft warm tones, light brown pencil outlines, soft beige shadows, and delicate paper texture, creating a light and nostalgic children's catalog atmosphere. Maintain childlike proportions, with large heads, small round eyes, rosy cheeks, wavy medium-length brown hair, and fluffy cream-colored goat-ear hats. Subject Details: Depicting the same {argument name="character name" default="Country-style little girl"} Five times, all full-body images, showing preschool children, accompanied by {argument name="hair color" default="Soft, light brown wavy curls"} 1. A cream-colored plush lamb's hat with drooping ears, a simple round face, white socks, and brown or cream-colored shoes. Sheep/bear face patterns are used on the small bag and apron. Five character poses and outfits from left to right: 1. A girl sitting on a wooden swing, wearing a sage green short-sleeved floral dress, cream-colored socks, and tan sandals, holding the swing ropes with both hands; a wicker basket bag with cute animal faces hangs beside her. Her face is obscured by a soft beige square blurring. 2. A standing girl, wearing a pale purple puff-sleeved blouse and an ivory long suspender skirt, holding a bunch of purple lavender in one hand and a wicker basket decorated with animal faces in the other. Her face is obscured by a soft beige square blurring. 3. A walking girl, wearing blue denim overalls over a pale yellow shirt, holding a bubble wand with several transparent bubbles floating around her; she carries a cream-colored shoulder bag with cute animal face patches. 4. A girl walking and eating ice cream, wearing a peach-colored plaid puff-sleeved blouse and an ivory-white long lace skirt; she carries a wicker basket decorated with white flowers. 5. A girl wearing a blue sailor-style short-sleeved dress with a large cream-colored bow, holding a red and white windmill aloft; she carries a cream-colored crossbody bag with cute animal face stickers and wears dark Mary Jane shoes. Constraints: Exactly 5 girls, no extra characters, no text, no background props except for the swing rope and bubbles, no borders or watermarks. Keep the composition light, balanced, and charming, like children's stickers or a fashion concept series.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一组柔和的水彩儿童角色系列，包含 5 种完全相同的可爱小女孩变体，采用田园风 / 森女系风格，背景为纯白色。

画布：宽幅横向画布，比例约为 3:2，留有大量干净的白色负空间，角色从左至右均匀排列，无地面线条。

视觉风格：精致的绘本水彩插画，淡雅暖色调，浅棕色铅笔轮廓，柔和的米色阴影，细腻的纸张纹理，营造出轻盈怀旧的童装目录氛围。保持儿童比例，大头、小圆点眼睛、红润脸颊、波浪状中长棕发，以及毛茸茸的奶油色羊耳帽。

主体细节：描绘同一个 {argument name="character name" default="田园风小女孩"} 五次，均为全身像，学龄前儿童年龄，配有 {argument name="hair color" default="柔和的浅棕色波浪卷发"}、带有垂耳的奶油色毛绒羊羔帽、简单的圆脸、白色袜子和棕色或奶油色鞋子。小包和围裙上使用羊 / 熊脸图案。

从左至右的五种角色姿势与服装：
1. 一个坐在木秋千上的女孩，穿着鼠尾草绿短袖碎花裙，搭配奶油色袜子和棕褐色凉鞋，双手抓着秋千绳；身边挂着一个带有可爱动物脸的柳条篮包。她的脸部被柔和的米色方形模糊处理遮盖。
2. 一个站立的女孩，穿着淡紫色泡泡袖衬衫和象牙白长款背带裙，一手拿着一束紫色薰衣草花，另一手提着带有动物脸装饰的柳条篮。她的脸部被柔和的米色方形模糊处理遮盖。
3. 一个行走中的女孩，穿着蓝色牛仔背带裤，内搭淡黄色衬衫，嘴边拿着泡泡棒，身边漂浮着几个透明的小泡泡；她背着一个带有可爱动物脸贴片的奶油色单肩包。
4. 一个边走边吃冰淇淋的女孩，穿着桃色格子泡泡袖衬衫和象牙白长款蕾丝裙；她提着一个装饰着白色花朵的柳条篮。
5. 一个穿着蓝色水手风短袖连衣裙的女孩，系着大大的奶油色蝴蝶结，一手高举着红白相间的风车；她背着一个带有可爱动物脸贴片的奶油色斜挎包，穿着深色玛丽珍鞋。

约束条件：正好 5 个女孩，没有多余人物，没有文字，除了秋千绳和泡泡外没有背景道具，没有边框或水印。保持构图轻盈、平衡且迷人，如同童装贴纸或时尚概念系列。

templates.title: Faceless pastoral anime girl

titleLocalized.zh: 无脸田园风动漫少女

templates.prompt: Create a warm and detailed retro anime-style illustration, featuring a protagonist named{argument name="character name" default="faceless girl"} A young girl stands before a cozy wooden kitchen and a bookshelf with herbs. The canvas is a 4:5 vertical composition. The girl is positioned slightly to the right of the center of the picture, showing the portion from mid-thigh upwards. Her face is deliberately rendered as a smooth, featureless, soft, blank oval, mostly obscured by long, messy, dark brown hair, with many strands falling in front. She wears a romantic cream-colored floral dress with small pink flowers, a ruffled neckline, and buttons down the front, tied with a large gray-pink bow around her neck. Over this, she wears an oversized gray-rose coat with black buttons, belted cuffs, and ribbon ties near the shoulders. The painting employs soft hand-painted watercolor and colored pencil textures, delicate lines, soft beige, cream, rose, and brown tones, a warm paper texture, and nostalgic pastoral lighting. Behind her is a wooden bookshelf with three horizontal shelves. Top Tier: Three glass jars filled with dried herbs or flowers, a white floral teapot, a botanical picture frame, a cream-colored jar labeled "FLOUR," a potted herb labeled "HERB GARDEN," and green vines hanging from both sides. Middle Tier: Two rows of cream-colored books with Japanese vertical titles and floral spines; containing visible English spine text such as "danceyuu," "ELLE gourmet," "BRUTUS," "& Premium," and "Casa BRUTUS," and a small sleeping cat figurine or cat illustration on the left. Bottom Tier: More cream-colored books with Japanese titles, a floral teacup and saucer on the left, a small glass bottle, a jar of daisies, recipe cards clipped to the right, hanging kitchen utensils, and jarred dried flowers. It maintains the overall atmosphere of an old-fashioned herbal garden recipe corner, with many small plant details, but no modern objects, no photorealistic feel, no strong contrasts, and no other people. The visible Japanese title can be decorative and does not need to be fully legible, but the English label should remain readable.{argument name="flour label" default="FLOUR"} ,{argument name="herb pot label" default="HERB GARDEN"} and{argument name="book spine label" default="BRUTUS"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张温暖且细节丰富的复古动漫风格插画，主角是一位名为 {argument name="character name" default="faceless girl"} 的少女，她站在一个温馨的木质厨房与草本植物书架前。画布为 4:5 的竖向构图。少女位于画面中心略偏右侧，展示从大腿中部向上的部分，她的脸部特意处理成平滑且无五官的柔和空白椭圆形，大部分被凌乱的长深棕色头发遮住，许多发丝垂落在前方。她穿着一件浪漫的奶油色碎花连衣裙，带有细小的粉色花朵、荷叶边领口、前襟纽扣，颈部系着一个巨大的灰粉色蝴蝶结，外搭一件超大号的灰玫瑰色外套，配有黑色纽扣、束带袖口和肩部附近的丝带系带。采用柔和的手绘水彩和彩色铅笔质感，细腻的线条，柔和的米色、奶油色、玫瑰色和棕色调，温润的纸张纹理，以及怀旧的田园风光照明。她身后是一个木质书架，共有 3 层横向隔板。顶层：3 个装有干草药或花朵的玻璃罐、1 个白色花卉茶壶、1 个植物画框、1 个贴有“FLOUR”标签的奶油色罐子、1 个贴有“HERB GARDEN”标签的盆栽草药，以及两侧垂下的绿色藤蔓。中间层：2 排带有日文竖排标题和花卉书脊装饰的奶油色书籍；包含可见的英文书脊文字，如“danceyuu”、“ELLE gourmet”、“BRUTUS”、“& Premium”和“Casa BRUTUS”，左侧还有一个小型的睡猫摆件或猫咪插图。底层：更多带有日文标题的奶油色书籍、左侧的一个花卉茶杯和茶托、小玻璃瓶、一罐雏菊、右侧夹着的食谱卡片、悬挂的厨房用具以及罐装干花。保留一种老式草本花园食谱角落的整体氛围，包含许多细小的植物细节，但没有现代物品，没有照片级真实感，没有强烈的对比，也没有其他人。可见的日文书名可以是装饰性的，不需要完全清晰可辨，但英文标签应保持可读：{argument name="flour label" default="FLOUR"}、{argument name="herb pot label" default="HERB GARDEN"} 和 {argument name="book spine label" default="BRUTUS"}。

templates.title: Anime Lion Costume Hunting Study

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫狮子装束游猎书房

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a warm, nostalgic anime-style illustration depicting {argument name="character name" default="A young girl"} Standing in a comfortable safari-themed study, she wears an oversized lion onesie, her face deliberately obscured by a centrally located opaque square occluder. Canvas: Vertical 4:5 composition, a close-up portrait from mid-thigh upwards, rich background detail, soft warm brown lighting, hand-drawn comic book style, clear lines, textured watercolor shadows. Subject: The character stands centered in front of a wooden bookshelf. She wears a hood, revealing long, straight hair, the hair color being {argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown"} She wore a full-body lion onesie pajama set, complete with a huge, fluffy lion head hood: round black eyes, a light-colored muzzle, a pink nose, small ears, and an exaggerated orange mane radiating outwards. The pajama's main body was golden brown, with fluffy sleeves, white panels on the abdomen, drawstrings with small buckles, and soft, claw-like gloves hanging down. A flat, beige square was placed over the face area, obscuring the wearer's eyes and nose while revealing the lion hood. Background layout: Wooden bookshelves filled the entire scene, with three shelves visible and dark warm wood frames. The atmosphere blended elements of a children's room, a travel library, and a safari museum. Background object count: Contains exactly three shelves. The top shelf contains exactly seven main objects: an antique globe on the far left, a small lion statue, a Serengeti landscape painting with giraffes and acacia trees, a standing giraffe statue, a framed elephant sketch (with the English quote "To travel is to live."), a vintage silver-black camera, and a hanging green indoor plant on the far right. The middle shelf contains exactly seventeen tall, vertical books, arranged in two groups around the character, with spines in soft cyan, cream, tan, gray, yellow, and pale green; using {argument name="book spine text" default="The Traveling Tree, Midnight Express, Days in Africa, The World's Guide to Kenya, The Little Prince, The Call of the Wild, White Fangs, Animal Farm"} Add decorative vertical Japanese spine text. In addition, these shelves contain exactly four safari decorations: a postcard labeled "Maasai Mara," a small lion statue, a pin-attached giraffe sketch, and a vintage African map. The bottom shelf contains exactly twelve smaller books, including three from the Animal Doctor series labeled 1, 2, and 3, and a plush lion in the lower left corner. The lower right foreground contains exactly three objects: one labeled {argument name="mug label" default="SAFARI"} A cream-colored mug, a pair of black binoculars, and a leafy plant. Visual style: warm amber indoor lighting, earthy safari color scheme (ochre, caramel, burnt orange, cream, olive green, and dark walnut). Highly detailed yet charming, soft shadows, a comfortable sense of clutter, hints of gentle anime expressions through poses, rounded and cute proportions, clear outlines, delicate paper texture, and a non-realistic style. Constraints: Keep the character centered and dominant; the lion's hood should be very large and fluffy; the square covering the face should be completely opaque and simple; do not add extra characters; do not add modern digital equipment except for a vintage camera; avoid any logos or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张温馨、怀旧的动漫风格插画，描绘 {argument name="character name" default="一位年轻女孩"} 站在舒适的游猎主题书房中，身穿超大号狮子连体睡衣，脸部被一个居中的不透明方形遮挡块刻意遮住。

画布：垂直 4:5 构图，从大腿中部向上的近景肖像，背景细节丰富，柔和的暖棕色光影，手绘动漫故事书风格，线条清晰，带有纹理的水彩阴影。

主体：角色居中站在木质书架前。她戴着兜帽，露出长长的直发，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"}。她穿着一套全身狮子连体睡衣，配有巨大的毛绒狮子头兜帽：圆圆的黑眼睛、浅色口鼻部、粉色鼻子、小耳朵，以及向外放射的夸张橙色鬃毛。睡衣主体为金棕色，袖子毛茸茸的，腹部有白色镶板，带有小扣件的抽绳，以及垂下的柔软爪状手套。在脸部区域放置一个平面的米色正方形，遮住佩戴者的眼睛和鼻子，同时露出狮子兜帽。

背景布局：木质书架填满整个画面，可见 3 层架子，配有深色暖木框架。氛围融合了儿童房、旅行图书馆和游猎博物馆的风格。

背景物体计数：包含正好 3 层架子。顶层架子包含正好 7 个主要物体：最左侧 1 个古董地球仪、1 个小狮子雕像、1 幅带有长颈鹿和金合欢树的塞伦盖蒂景观画、1 个站立的长颈鹿雕像、1 幅装裱的大象素描（带有英文引言“To travel is to live.”）、1 台复古银黑色相机，以及最右侧 1 株垂下的绿色室内植物。中间架子包含正好 17 本高大的垂直书籍，围绕角色分为两组，书脊颜色为柔和的青色、奶油色、棕褐色、灰色、黄色和淡绿色；使用 {argument name="book spine text" default="旅をする木, 深夜特急, アフリカの日々, 地球の歩き方 ケニア, 星の王子さま, 野生の呼び声, 白い牙, 動物農場"} 添加装饰性的垂直日文书脊文字。此外，这些架子上还包含正好 4 个游猎装饰品：1 张标有“Maasai Mara”的明信片、1 个小狮子雕像、1 张别针固定的长颈鹿素描和 1 张复古非洲地图。底层架子包含正好 12 本较小的书籍，其中包括 3 本带有编号 1、2 和 3 的动物医生系列书籍，以及左下角 1 只毛绒狮子。右下角前景包含正好 3 个物体：1 个标有 {argument name="mug label" default="SAFARI"} 的奶油色马克杯、1 副黑色双筒望远镜和 1 枝叶片植物。

视觉风格：温暖的琥珀色室内光，大地色系的游猎配色（赭石色、焦糖色、焦橙色、奶油色、橄榄绿和深胡桃木色）。高度精细但充满魅力，柔和的阴影，舒适的杂乱感，通过姿势暗示温柔的动漫表情，圆润可爱的比例，清晰的轮廓，细腻的纸张纹理，非写实风格。

约束：保持角色居中且占据主导地位，狮子兜帽要非常大且蓬松，遮脸的正方形要保持完全不透明且简洁，不要添加额外角色，除了复古相机外不要添加现代数码设备，避免出现任何标志或水印。

templates.title: Anime AI Game Player Bookshelf Girl

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫 AI 游戏玩家书架少女

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a highly detailed vertical anime illustration depicting a cozy otaku game room with a bookshelf, featuring [character name missing].{argument name="character name" default="A cheerful young anime girl"} The character stands in front of a wooden bookshelf piled high with books, smiling at the viewer, making a peace sign with her left hand and her right hand in her pocket. Canvas: 1:1 square composition, warm indoor lighting, clear and clean anime lines, soft color scheme, rich and easily legible background details. Main character: A cute anime girl {argument name="hair color" default="Long light blonde hair"} She had large brown eyes, round metal-framed glasses, light blush, and a playful tongue-out smile. She wore a loose white cardigan shirt over a white T-shirt with a printed design.{argument name="shirt text" default="I ♥ AI"} The text is in large black font with a red heart. The sleeves are loosely rolled up, the posture relaxed, showcasing a friendly geek personality. Background Layout: The entire background is a wooden bookshelf filled with characters, divided into four horizontal shelves and a top display panel. The bookshelf is filled with comics, Japanese design and AI-related books, retro gaming equipment, figurines, plush toys, sticky notes, and neon lights. Warm beige wood tones and soft shadows ensure the characters are always the visual focus. Grouping of Visible Objects: 1. Top Shelf/Display Panel: 7 main decorative items—a pixelated heart framed with "LEVEL UP!" written on it, a black cat mascot figurine, a purple retro handheld game console, a pink round plush bear, a pink neon game controller light with "GAME ON" written on it, a retro Canon-style film camera, and a potted plant. 2. Upper bookshelf behind the head: Two stacks of books, one on each side, filled with books whose spines are printed with English and Japanese text, covering topics such as illustration, comics, design, AI, and deep learning. Small figurines are placed between the stacks: a white cat, a small blue object, a miniature robot, and a pink chibi-style keychain hanging on the far right. 3. Middle left shelf: Four eye-catching cute collectibles—a pink-haired chibi figurine wearing a black bunny-ear hoodie, a pink-haired character card, a small white cat mascot, and a black chalkboard-style mini poster with pink chibi doodles. 4. Middle right shelf: Five eye-catching display items—a row of miniature character cards or game boxes, a cheerful pink-haired chibi figurine, and a handwritten note.{argument name="sticky note text" default="Let's play with AI today too!"} 5. Bottom left shelf: 6 prominent items – a row of retro game boxes and comic book spines, a glowing pink pixel heart chat icon, a cyan twin-tailed chibi figure, a purple retro handheld console displaying a game screen, a white plush toy, and a beige note with Japanese handwriting. 6. Bottom right shelf: 7 prominent items – a row of soft-toned comic books, a purple flip-top retro handheld console, a purple game controller, a pink Kirby-style plush toy on a yellow cushion, a stack of AI/programming books, a cyan twin-tailed idol figure, and a pink neon sign that says “ON AIR”. Text and labels: Keep the text on the spines and props clear but not excessive. Includes English titles such as "WIRED," "BRUTUS," "ELDEN RING," "AI," "Deep Learning," "Stable Diffusion," and "ChatGPT," and features a vertically formatted, Japanese-style manga and design book spine. Do not add any watermarks or artist signatures. Visual style: Refined modern anime illustrations, clean cel shadows with soft gradients, bright highlights in hair and eyes, richly detailed bookshelves, adorable collectibles, a nostalgic gaming aesthetic, a warm creator's room atmosphere, a pink and cream color scheme, and high-resolution poster-quality images.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张高度细致的竖版动漫插画，描绘一个温馨的御宅族游戏房书架场景，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="一位开朗的年轻动漫女孩"}。角色站在堆满书籍的木质书架前，微笑着看向观众，左手比出剪刀手，右手插在口袋里。

画布：1:1 正方形构图，温暖的室内光线，清晰干净的动漫线条，柔和的配色，背景细节丰富且清晰易读。

主角：一位可爱的动漫少女，拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="长长的浅金色头发"}、棕色大眼睛、圆形金属框眼镜、淡淡的腮红，以及俏皮的吐舌微笑。她穿着一件宽松的白色开衫衬衫，内搭一件白色 T 恤，上面印有 {argument name="shirt text" default="I ♥ AI"}，字体为黑色大号，配有红色爱心。袖子宽松卷起，姿态休闲放松，展现出友好的极客个性。

背景布局：整个背景是一个充满角色的木质书架，分为 4 层水平隔板以及顶部展示面。书架上摆满了漫画、日本设计和 AI 相关书籍、复古游戏设备、手办、毛绒玩具、便签和霓虹灯。使用温暖的米色木质色调和柔和的阴影，确保角色始终是视觉焦点。

包含的可见物体分组：
1. 顶部隔板/展示面：共 7 个主要装饰物——一个写着“LEVEL UP!”的像素爱心框画、一个黑猫吉祥物手办、一台紫色复古掌机、一只粉色圆形毛绒熊、一个写着“GAME ON”的粉色霓虹游戏手柄灯、一台复古佳能风格胶片相机，以及一盆绿植。
2. 头部后方的上层书架：共 2 组书堆，左右各一，摆满了书脊上印有英文和日文的书籍，涵盖插画、漫画、设计、AI 和深度学习等主题。书堆间放置小手办：一只白猫、一个小蓝物件、一个微型机器人，最右侧挂着一个粉色 Q 版挂件。
3. 中左层隔板：共 4 个显眼的可爱收藏品——一个穿着黑色兔耳连帽衫的粉发 Q 版手办、一张粉发角色卡、一个小白猫吉祥物，以及一个带有粉色 Q 版涂鸦的黑色黑板风格迷你海报。
4. 中右层隔板：共 5 个显眼的展示品——一排微型角色卡或游戏盒、一个开朗的粉发 Q 版手办、一张手写便签 {argument name="sticky note text" default="今天也要和 AI 一起玩！"}、一个站立的粉发偶像风格手办，以及一小叠漫画书。
5. 下左层隔板：共 6 个显眼的物品——一排复古游戏盒和漫画书脊、一个发光的粉色像素爱心聊天图标、一个青色双马尾 Q 版手办、一台显示游戏画面的紫色复古掌机、一个白色毛绒团子，以及一张带有日式手写字的米色便签。
6. 下右层隔板：共 7 个显眼的物品——一排柔和色调的漫画书、一台紫色翻盖式复古掌机、一个紫色游戏手柄、一个放在黄色坐垫上的粉色卡比风毛绒玩具、一叠 AI/编程书籍、一个青色双马尾偶像手办，以及一个写着“ON AIR”的粉色霓虹灯。

文字与标签：保持书脊和道具上的文字清晰但不过多。包含英文标题，如“WIRED”、“BRUTUS”、“ELDEN RING”、“AI”、“Deep Learning”、“Stable Diffusion”和“ChatGPT”，并加入竖排日式风格的漫画和设计书籍书脊。不要添加任何水印或艺术家签名。

视觉风格：精致的现代动漫插画，干净的赛璐珞阴影配以柔和的渐变，头发和眼睛有明亮的高光，细节丰富的书架，可爱的收藏品，怀旧的游戏美学，温馨的创作者房间氛围，粉色与奶油色的配色方案，高分辨率海报级画质。

templates.title: Faceless Elf Angel Library

titleLocalized.zh: 无面精灵天使图书馆

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a dreamlike, vertical, anime-style fantasy library illustration depicting a serene elven scholar seated before a bookshelf overflowing with books, her face deliberately obscured by a flat covering. Canvas: 3:4 vertical composition, with warm afternoon sunlight streaming from the upper left, soft, high-detail digital painting, delicate lines, and light gold and cream tones. Subject: A young female elven angel positioned in the lower left and center of the foreground. She possesses very long and flowing {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} Her beautiful hair cascaded down to her shoulders and knees; she had pointed elf ears; a delicate, luminous golden halo floated above her head; and a small flower hair ornament adorned her ear. Her face was {argument name="face covering" default="A simple, warm beige square located at the center of the face."} Her face was obscured, with no facial features visible. One hand rested thoughtfully on her chin. She wore a loose white robe with gold trim, its layers of folds revealing a large gold pendant adorning her chest. Background and setting: An antique study or sacred library, with three tiers of wooden bookshelves displaying 45 neatly arranged books, their spines clearly visible. The titles on the spines use…{argument name="book spine language" default="Japanese"} Vertically formatted, featuring elegant fantasy academic titles covering mythology, theology, constellations, architecture, ancient texts, Western art history, and encyclopedias. The spines are cream, tan, gray, soft blue, brown, and black, with delicate gold accents and an aged paper texture. Counting objects and decorations: Contains 45 clearly visible spines; an owl figurine on the upper right bookshelf; a white quill pen in an inkwell next to the owl; a constellation chart or dark star chart item that appears to be open on the middle right bookshelf; a light-colored feather lying horizontally on the middle bookshelf; a small rectangular standing card with a sun motif next to the star chart; an antique globe on the lower right pedestal; a carved stone pillar or pedestal on the far left; a carved pedestal on the lower right; two clumps of ivy, one climbing near the upper left window/pillar, and the other drooping near the lower right globe. Lighting and atmosphere: Using {argument name="overall palette" default="Warm ivory, champagne gold, dark brown, and soft gray."} Add sunlight, leaf shadows, dust particles, soft lighting effects, and a nostalgic, sacred library atmosphere. The left side should be brighter, bathed in sunlight, while the right bookshelf should maintain soft shadows. Style restrictions: High-detail anime illustration, ethereal fantasy-realism style, gorgeous yet soft, no modern objects, no clearly visible modern signage, no extra characters, no watermarks, no borders. Keep the beige face-covering square completely flat and opaque to contrast with the painterly rendering below.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一幅梦幻般的竖版动漫风格奇幻图书馆插画，描绘一位宁静的精灵天使学者坐在堆满书籍的书架前，其面部被一个扁平的遮盖物刻意隐藏。

画布：3:4 竖构图，左上方投射出温暖的午后阳光，柔和的高细节数字绘画，精致的线条，采用浅金与奶油色调。

主体：一位年轻的女性精灵天使位于前景左下方及中心。她拥有非常长且飘逸的 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色"} 秀发，垂落在双肩与膝盖上，长着尖尖的精灵耳，头顶上方悬浮着一圈纤细发光的金色光环，耳边别着一个小花发饰。她的面部被 {argument name="face covering" default="一个位于面部中心、朴素的暖米色正方形"} 遮挡，没有任何面部特征可见。她的一只手若有所思地托在下巴旁，身穿一件带有金色镶边的宽松白袍，层叠的褶皱，胸前佩戴着一枚大型金色吊坠。

背景与环境：一个古色古香的书房或神圣图书馆，可见三层木质书架，上面整齐排列着 45 本清晰可见的书脊。书脊上的书名使用 {argument name="book spine language" default="日语"} 竖排书写，包含神话、神学、星座、建筑、古籍、西方艺术史及百科全书等优雅的奇幻学术类标题。书脊颜色为奶油色、棕褐色、灰色、柔和的蓝色、棕色和黑色，带有精致的金色装饰和陈旧的纸张质感。

计数对象与装饰：包含 45 本清晰可见的书脊；右上角书架上有 1 个猫头鹰摆件；猫头鹰旁边的墨水瓶中插着 1 支白色羽毛笔；右侧中间书架上有 1 张看起来处于打开状态的星座图或深色星图项目；中间书架上横放着 1 根浅色羽毛；星图旁有 1 张带有太阳图案的小型长方形立式卡片；右下方底座上有 1 个古董地球仪；最左侧有 1 根雕刻石柱或底座；右下方有 1 个雕刻底座；2 簇常春藤，一簇攀爬在左上方窗户/柱子附近，另一簇垂落在右下方的地球仪附近。

光影与氛围：使用 {argument name="overall palette" default="暖象牙色、香槟金、深褐色及柔和的灰色"}。添加阳光、叶影、尘埃微粒、柔光效果以及怀旧的神圣图书馆氛围。左侧应更明亮，沐浴在阳光中，而右侧书架则保持柔和的阴影。

风格限制：高细节动漫插画，空灵的奇幻写实风格，华丽而柔和，无现代物品，无清晰可见的现代标识，无额外角色，无水印，无边框。保持米色面部遮盖方块完全平整且不透明，与下方绘画感十足的渲染形成对比。

templates.prompt: Create a vertical-format fantasy anime illustration depicting {argument name="character name" default="Suikyo, the Water Mirror Girl"} She stood barefoot on the mirror-like surface of the lake under the moonlight, against a backdrop of a deep blue starry sky and a bright Milky Way. She was an elegant young woman, possessing {argument name="hair color" default="Extremely long, flowing silver-blue hair"} She is shown with three-quarters of her face turned away, her hair and semi-transparent ribbons seemingly blown dramatically to the right by a gentle night breeze; her face should be kept softly blurred or turned away from the camera, without any clear facial details. Dress her in an ethereal {argument name="dress color" default="pale ice blue"} A high-class fantasy gown, made of multiple layers of sheer chiffon, adorned with crystal beads, silver embroidery, snowflake decorations, shoulder straps, a high side slit, and a long train that spreads like glass petals across the water. Add delicate floral and crystal hair ornaments, small anklets, shimmering water droplets, and tiny star-shaped highlights on the fabric. The water should clearly reflect her entire body and gown, with circular ripples and bright starlight reflections at her feet. On the left, a large, ornate crescent-shaped structure composed of silver branches, ice, and crystal partially frames the figure; vertical Japanese characters hang beside it.{argument name="vertical text" default="Water Mirror"} It is adorned with a small, suspended crystal decoration. The scene is surrounded by glowing butterflies, a white and blue lotus in the foreground corner, tiny firefly lights, scattered snowflake patterns, and magical particles. Background: A tranquil horizon, distant mountains, soft twilight near the horizon, and above, a deep cobalt blue night sky with dense clusters of stars and nebulae. Visual Style: Ultra-refined Japanese fantasy main visual, a fusion of glowing watercolor and digital painting, soft glowing lighting, cool blue-purple tones, delicate lines, a dreamlike atmosphere, high detail, elegant composition, no watermark, no modern objects, and no readable text except for vertically arranged Japanese characters.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖构图的奇幻动漫插画，描绘 {argument name="character name" default="水镜少女 Suikyo"} 赤脚站在月光下如镜面般完美的湖面上，背景是深蓝色的星空和明亮的银河。她是一位优雅的年轻女性，拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="极长的飘逸银蓝色秀发"}，以四分之三背影示人，她的头发和半透明丝带仿佛被柔和的夜风吹拂，向右侧戏剧性地飘动；保持面部柔和模糊或背对镜头，不要有清晰的面部细节。为她穿上一件空灵的 {argument name="dress color" default="淡冰蓝色"} 高级奇幻礼服，礼服由多层透明雪纺制成，饰有水晶珠饰、银色刺绣、雪花装饰、肩带、高侧开叉，以及像玻璃花瓣一样铺展在水面上的长拖尾。添加精致的花卉和水晶发饰、小脚链、闪烁的水滴以及织物上微小的星状高光。水面应清晰地倒映出她的全身和礼服，脚下有圆形的涟漪和星辰的明亮倒影。在左侧，加入一个由银色树枝、冰和水晶组成的巨大华丽新月环结构，部分框住人物；旁边悬挂着竖排日文 {argument name="vertical text" default="水镜"}，并配有一个小巧的悬垂水晶装饰。场景周围环绕着发光的蝴蝶、前景角落的白蓝色莲花、微小的萤火虫光点、散落的雪花图案和魔法粒子。背景：宁静的地平线，远处的山脉，地平线附近有柔和的暮光，上方是深钴蓝色的夜空，密集的星群和星云。视觉风格：超精细的日式奇幻主视觉图，发光水彩与数字绘画的融合，柔和的辉光照明，冷蓝紫色调，精致的线条，梦幻的氛围，高细节，优雅的构图，无水印，无现代物体，除竖排日文字符外无其他可读文本。

Against the dark background, a blurry, faceless figure stands far behind her, faintly visible through the broken glass. The lower half of the poster features striking, horrifying font. The title reads: "{argument name="movie title" default="WHEN DARKNESS WEARS YOUR FACE"} The letters appear to have been carved from cracked bone and dried blood, with deep cracks on each character. "WHEN" is smaller at the top, while "DARKNESS" is bolder and larger in the middle.{argument name="subtitle" default="WEARS YOUR FACE"} At the bottom, the bloodstains drip from the letters like an open wound. At the top is a line of elegant small serif text: “A VOIDCREST FILMS PRODUCTION.” Below that is a standard cast and crew list for a fictional film, listed in tiny white text.{argument name="credits" default="fictional names: directed by MARCUS HALLOWAY, produced by ELARA VOSS, starring NADIA CROSS"} Color grading: Deep black, desaturated cyan shadows, deep red bloodstains, and a single cool-toned main light.
