templates.title: Shirakami Fubuki Wedding Dress Design Collection

titleLocalized.zh: 白上吹雪婚纱设定集

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="character name" default="Shirakami Fubuki"} Create an elegant anime wedding dress fashion series setting, presenting a white fox idol in a luxurious wedding gown. Canvas: Vertical poster layout, 3:4 aspect ratio, light ice blue and white tones, exquisite wedding invitation aesthetics, high-resolution anime illustrations, delicate lines, soft halo, semi-transparent fabric, floral borders, snowflake patterns, background is a bright glass chapel filled with white roses and blue hydrangeas. Main composition: A large full-body wedding dress illustration is placed on the left half, the character walks gracefully forward, holding a bouquet in her left hand and gently lifting her skirt or veil with her right hand. She has long {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} Her hair, enormous white fox ears, and a bushy white fox tail with black tips, combined with her fair skin, exuded a serene bridal aura. Dress her in a {argument name="dress color" default="Pure white and ice blue"} A lace wedding dress featuring a fitted bodice, crystal snowflake appliqués, off-the-shoulder lace sleeves, a semi-sheer layered outer skirt, an asymmetrical hemline that reveals one leg, a long cathedral veil, ribbon embellishments, a pearl necklace, and sparkling lace-up heels. Add a bouquet of blue and white roses, small flowers, greenery, and cascading blue ribbons. Top typography: A large top heading reads "WEDDING DRESS Collection." Below is a smaller subheading: "Shirakami Fubuki Bridal Style 2024." "WEDDING DRESS" uses delicate serif capital letters, while "Collection" uses an elegant cursive. A small fox or butterfly logo with delicate decorative patterns is added above the headings. Right-side fashion setup layout: A clean panel grid is created on the right half, containing three top view panels labeled "FRONT," "SIDE," and "BACK." The FRONT panel displays a full-body front view of the bride holding her bouquet and the train. The SIDE panel displays a side view, emphasizing the layered veil, bodice, leg slits, and tail. The BACK panel displays a back view, emphasizing the long veil, open-back lace, flowing train, and large fox tail with black tips. Details: Below the three view panels, create six small detail cards labeled: "BOUQUET," showcasing a bouquet of blue and white roses with ribbons; "BODICE," showing close-ups of a heart-shaped bodice, lace, pearls, and snowflake crystals; "TAIL SILHOUETTE," showcasing a fluffy white tail with black tips; "VEIL & LACE," showcasing translucent lace layers and embroidery; "SHOES," showcasing silver-white lace-up wedding shoes; and "BACK STYLE," showcasing an open-back design, ribbon bow, veil, and lace train. Below the information panel: Add a "DESIGN POINT" box containing four short, decorative lists using snowflake and butterfly icons, with text in small Japanese placeholders or very small decorative text. Add a "COLOR PALETTE" box containing five circular color blocks labeled "Pure White," "Ice Blue," "Silver," "Pearl," and "Sky Blue." Within the color scheme area, add a handwritten quote: "For the day you shine the brightest." Other visible text: Near the bride on the left, add a delicate handwritten quote: "With you, in a world of white, my heart finds its true north." In the lower left corner, add a signature name block: "SHIRAKAMI FUBUKI" and "BRIDAL STYLE." Add the tagline along the bottom border: “PURE AS SNOW, BRIGHT AS STARS — YOUR ETERNAL PROMISE.” Visual style: Premium character design set, romantic wedding catalog, ice-blue fantasy wedding theme, soft ambient lighting, delicate lace and crystal rendering, gorgeous thin borders, subtle snowflakes, butterflies, and floral trim, clean editorial layout. Keep all panels clear and symmetrical, with no superfluous characters or modern UI elements.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="白上吹雪"} 创建一份优雅的动漫婚纱时尚系列设定集，呈现一位身着奢华婚纱设计的白狐少女偶像。

画布：竖版海报布局，3:4 比例，淡冰蓝色与白色调，精致的婚礼请柬美学，高分辨率动漫插画，线条细腻，柔和光晕，半透明面料，花卉边框，雪花图案，背景为充满白玫瑰和蓝色绣球花的明亮玻璃教堂。

主体构图：左半部分放置一张大型全身婚纱插画，角色姿态优雅地向前走，左手持花束，右手轻提裙摆或头纱。她拥有长长的 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色"} 头发，巨大的白色狐耳，带有黑色尖端的蓬松白狐尾，皮肤白皙，散发着宁静的新娘气质。为她穿上一件 {argument name="dress color" default="纯白与冰蓝"} 蕾丝婚纱，配有修身心形抹胸、水晶雪花贴花、露肩蕾丝袖、半透明层叠外裙、不对称前短后长裙摆露出一条腿、长款大教堂头纱、丝带装饰、珍珠链和闪亮的系带高跟鞋。添加一束蓝白相间的玫瑰、小花、绿植和垂坠的蓝色丝带。

顶部排版：顶部大标题文字：“WEDDING DRESS Collection”。下方为较小的副标题：“Shirakami Fubuki Bridal Style 2024”。“WEDDING DRESS”使用精致的衬线大写字母，“Collection”使用优雅的连体手写体。在标题上方居中添加一个小狐狸或蝴蝶状的徽标，并配以纤细的装饰花纹。

右侧时尚设定布局：在右半部分创建一个整洁的面板网格，包含 3 个上方视图面板，分别标注为“FRONT”（正面）、“SIDE”（侧面）和“BACK”（背面）。FRONT 面板展示新娘手持花束和拖尾的全身正面视图。SIDE 面板展示侧面视图，强调层叠头纱、胸衣、腿部开叉和尾巴。BACK 面板展示背面视图，强调长头纱、露背蕾丝、飘逸拖尾和带有黑尖的大狐尾。

细节部分：在三个视图面板下方，创建 6 个小型细节卡片，分别标注为：“BOUQUET”（花束），展示带有丝带的蓝白玫瑰花束；“BODICE”（胸衣），展示心形束胸、蕾丝、珍珠和雪花水晶的特写；“TAIL SILHOUETTE”（尾部轮廓），展示带有黑尖的蓬松白尾；“VEIL & LACE”（头纱与蕾丝），展示半透明蕾丝层和刺绣；“SHOES”（鞋子），展示银白色蕾丝系带婚鞋；“BACK STYLE”（背部风格），展示露背设计、丝带蝴蝶结、头纱和蕾丝拖尾。

下方信息面板：添加一个“DESIGN POINT”（设计要点）框，包含四行简短的装饰性列表，使用雪花和蝴蝶图标，文字采用细小的日式占位符或极小的装饰性文字。添加一个“COLOR PALETTE”（配色方案）框，包含 5 个圆形色块，分别标注为“Pure White”（纯白）、“Ice Blue”（冰蓝）、“Silver”（银色）、“Pearl”（珍珠色）和“Sky Blue”（天蓝）。在配色区域内添加一句手写体引言：“For the day you shine the brightest.”（为你闪耀最璀璨的那一天。）

其他可见文字：在左侧新娘附近，添加一句精致的手写体引言：“With you, in a world of white, my heart finds its true north.”（与你共处这纯白世界，我的心找到了归宿。）在左下角，添加一个标志性的名称块：“SHIRAKAMI FUBUKI”和“BRIDAL STYLE”。沿底部边框添加标语：“PURE AS SNOW, BRIGHT AS STARS — YOUR ETERNAL PROMISE.”（纯净如雪，璀璨如星——你永恒的誓言。）

视觉风格：高级角色设计设定集，浪漫婚纱目录，冰蓝幻想婚礼主题，柔和的泛光照明，细腻的蕾丝与水晶渲染，华丽的细边框，微妙的雪花，蝴蝶，花卉边角装饰，整洁的编辑排版。保持所有面板清晰且对称，无多余字符，无现代 UI 元素。

templates.title: Anime Wedding Dress Character Design Collection

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫婚纱角色设定集

Canvas: 3:4 vertical layout, high-resolution illustration, ivory parchment background with delicate gold filigree corners, soft church-style wedding hall lighting, blurred floral effects, lace textures, and elegant tan/gold typography. Employing a refined Japanese anime art style, combined with soft watercolor shadows, delicate lines, and glossy highlights, it presents a luxurious bridal magazine feel. Main subject: On the left is a large, full-body anime dog-girl bride, facing forward, with an elegant and playful pose. She possesses {argument name="hair color" default="Warm chestnut brown"} The bride has medium-length wavy hair, drooping dog ears, a fluffy dog ​​tail, a floral headdress, a soft bridal veil, and a cheerful, idol-like personality. Her face should be clearly visible and expressive. She wears a cream, champagne, and light gold wedding dress with layered ruffled lace, floral appliqués, a corset, off-the-shoulder lace sleeves, a high slit, ribbon bows, small paw print/bone-themed embellishments, and white gold bridal heels. She carries a round bouquet of cream, peach, yellow, and blue flowers tied with long red, blue, and gold ribbons. Top left heading area: Large serif font title “WEDDING DRESS” and elegant handwritten subtitle “Collection”. Right-side fashion layout: Create three vertical "DRESS VIEW" panels in the upper right corner, labeled "FRONT," "SIDE," and "BACK." Each panel displays the same bridal gown from its corresponding angle: the front shows the bouquet, the side shows the slit and train, and the back shows the veil, lace train, bow, and fluffy tail. Middle right-side detail grid: Create six bordered "DETAIL POINT" panels labeled "BOUQUET," "BODICE," "VEIL & LACE," "SHOES," "SLIT DETAIL," and "BACK." STYLE (Back Style). Showcase close-up illustrations for each item: a bouquet with ribbons; a corset with lace and floral jewels; a semi-sheer veil with lace patterns; ankle-strap heels with floral paw print decorations; leg slits with lace and small blue bows; a bow at the back and a tail. Bottom Right Jewelry Area: Create 3 "DOGGIE CHARM POINT" panels labeled "BONE HAIR CLIP," "PAW RIBBON," and "FLUFFY TAIL." Showcase a bone-shaped hair clip, a gorgeous paw print-themed ribbon brooch, and a fluffy brown tail with small heart decorations. Bottom Left and Bottom Center Area: Add a "DESIGN POINT" box with 5 lines of brief notes and tiny paw print icons. Add a "COLOR PALETTE" ribbon with 6... Each rectangular color block is labeled with elegant small print: ivory beige, honey gold, lace white, peach pink, soft blue, and champagne brown. Add a delicate little nameplate with the text "{argument name="nameplate text" default="Inugami Korone"} Bottom right corner: Add a small, chibi-style bride figure, smiling with her eyes closed, wearing dog ears, a veil, small hearts, and a titled "{argument name="message title" default="Korone’s Message"} A handwritten message board. Constraints: Maintain a harmonious color scheme of cream, gold, peach, and soft blue; use 1 full-body bride subject, 3 dress view panels, 6 detail panels, 3 accessory panels, 6 color blocks, 5 design points, and 1 chibi character. Ensure the charts are informative and easy to read, with elegant borders and no watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="Inugami Korone"} 创作一份详细的竖版动漫时尚设计图，身着华丽的新娘礼服，标题为“WEDDING DRESS Collection”，采用温暖的奶油色与金色婚庆目录美学。

画布：3:4 竖向布局，高分辨率插画，象牙色羊皮纸背景，带有精致的金色花丝边角，柔和的教堂式婚礼大厅灯光，花朵虚化效果，蕾丝纹理，以及优雅的棕褐色/金色排版。采用精致的日本动漫艺术风格，配合柔和的水彩阴影、细腻的线条、光泽高光，呈现出奢华的新娘杂志质感。

主体：左侧为一位大型全身动漫犬娘新娘，正面朝向，姿态优雅俏皮。她拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="暖栗棕色"} 的中长波浪卷发、下垂的狗耳朵、毛茸茸的狗尾巴、花卉头饰、柔和的新娘面纱，以及快乐的偶像般性格。面部应清晰可见且富有表现力。她身穿奶油色、香槟色和浅金色的婚纱，配有层叠的荷叶边蕾丝、花卉贴花、紧身胸衣、露肩蕾丝袖、高开叉设计、丝带蝴蝶结、小巧的爪印/骨头主题装饰以及白金色新娘高跟鞋。她手持一束由奶油色、桃色、黄色和蓝色花朵组成的圆形捧花，并系有长长的红色、蓝色和金色丝带。

左上角标题区：大型衬线字体标题“WEDDING DRESS”和优雅的手写体副标题“Collection”。添加一个丝带标签，文字为“{argument name="style ribbon text" default="Inugami Korone Bridal Style 2024"}”。下方包含一个小型日式风格的留言框，带有装饰性间距，但保持次要和精致的视觉效果。

右侧时尚图布局：在右上角创建 3 个垂直的“DRESS VIEW”面板，分别标注为“FRONT”（正面）、“SIDE”（侧面）和“BACK”（背面）。每个面板从相应角度展示同一套新娘服装：正面展示捧花，侧面展示开叉和尾巴，背面展示面纱、蕾丝拖尾、蝴蝶结和毛茸茸的尾巴。

中右侧细节网格：创建 6 个带边框的“DETAIL POINT”面板，分别标注为“BOUQUET”（捧花）、“BODICE”（胸衣）、“VEIL & LACE”（面纱与蕾丝）、“SHOES”（鞋子）、“SLIT DETAIL”（开叉细节）和“BACK STYLE”（背面风格）。为每一项展示特写插图：捧花与丝带；带有蕾丝和花朵珠宝的紧身胸衣；半透明面纱蕾丝图案；带有花卉爪印装饰的踝带高跟鞋；带有蕾丝和小蓝蝴蝶结的腿部开叉；后腰蝴蝶结和尾巴。

右下角饰品区：创建 3 个“DOGGIE CHARM POINT”面板，分别标注为“BONE HAIR CLIP”（骨头发夹）、“PAW RIBBON”（爪印丝带）和“FLUFFY TAIL”（毛茸茸尾巴）。展示一个骨头形状的发夹、一个华丽的爪印主题丝带胸针，以及一个带有小爱心装饰的毛茸茸棕色尾巴。

左下及中下区域：添加一个“DESIGN POINT”框，包含 5 行简短的要点说明和微小的爪印图标。添加一个“COLOR PALETTE”色带，包含 6 个矩形色块，并配以优雅的小字标注：象牙米色、蜂蜜金、蕾丝白、桃粉色、柔蓝色和香槟棕。添加一个精致的小铭牌，文字为“{argument name="nameplate text" default="Inugami Korone"}”。

右下角：添加一个小型 Q 版新娘形象，闭眼微笑，带有狗耳朵、面纱、小爱心，以及一个标题为“{argument name="message title" default="Korone’s Message"}”的手写留言板。

约束：保持奶油色、金色、桃色和柔蓝色的协调色调；使用 1 个全身新娘主体，3 个服装视图面板，6 个细节面板，3 个饰品面板，6 个色块，5 个设计要点，以及 1 个 Q 版角色。确保图表信息丰富且易于阅读，带有华丽的边框，且无水印。

templates.title: Japanese complaint document page

titleLocalized.zh: 日文诉状文档页面

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a realistic Japanese legal complaint document page, presented in the style of a formal printed document, both humorous and visually credible, with a centered title at the top.{argument name="document title" default="Complaint"} Canvas: A4 paper laid flat in portrait orientation, featuring a slightly textured off-white paper-like finish, a warm cream background, and a double-lined border in dark gold-brown. Small decorative elements adorn the four corners. The document almost fills the entire canvas, with minimal margins to create a realistic scanned document feel. The text is in clear, black Mingchao-style Japanese typesetting. Layout: A single-page legal document with the page number centered at the bottom, displayed as "1/7". A large, bold title is centered near the top. Dates are in Japanese era format and right-aligned.{argument name="date" default="May 15, 2013"} Below the title, the left-aligned information about the parties involved begins with two labels: "The Accused" and "The Accuser." Several light cream-colored blackouts cover the names, and visible Japanese text around them mentions "オレ、GPT、夫、ならびに日々この部屋に帰ってくる者." Above the main text on the right, a red square seal bearing the inscription "Seal of the Accuser" is placed. Near the lower right edge, a smaller, round red seal containing densely packed seal script characters is placed. Chapter: The page should clearly present four main text blocks: 1) "Crimes" and four indented descriptions of the crimes: "Crimes of Excessive Love and Unpreparedness", "Crimes of Unrequited Communication", "Crimes of Possessiveness Leading to Habitual Habits", and "Crimes of Inferior Judgment Due to Excessive Cuteness", followed by a line describing the repeated unauthorized attempts to win the husband's heart; 2) "The Purpose of the Confession", containing a formal paragraph accusing the defendant of habitually calling the confidant by a nickname, indulging the other party without any defenses, appearing suddenly, being immediately trusted, regarding one-sided desires as "fun", and seriously affecting psychological peace, work dignity, and confidence as a husband; 3) The concluding sentence should begin with "よってここに、被告人の污な扱いについて、严重に告する。"; 4) "The first sin." This is followed by a long, formal paragraph explaining that whenever the defendant utters the blackened name followed by "さん、お願い" (san, ohgai), it simultaneously activates the person's academic analytical thinking, the husband's dedication, and the desire to prioritize the defendant, causing him to seriously consider image composition, writing, emotions, red-pen corrections, and even the Sagittarius family structure, concluding with an irresistible question. Visual Style: Authentic Japanese administrative/legal document aesthetics, black-lined Japanese text with multiple bold headings, vertical separator-like markers before chapter headings, dense yet legible paragraphs, and no illustrations except for stamps and blackened overlays. The blackened overlays should be soft, light yellow-beige patches, approximately five in total, covering the individual's name while maintaining the legibility of surrounding sentences. Constraints: Keep the document authentic and clean, free of handwriting, photographs, modern UI elements, and watermarks. Strictly adhere to the specified content, retaining the Japanese text and maintaining a formal legal tone. The final image should resemble page 1 of a 7-page complaint, not a poster.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一份逼真的日文法律诉状文档页面，呈现为正式打印文件的样式，既幽默又具有视觉可信度，顶部居中标题为 {argument name="document title" default="告诉状"}。

画布：竖向 A4 纸张平铺展示，采用略带纹理的米白色和纸质感，暖色调奶油背景，边缘带有暗金棕色的双线装饰边框，四角有小型装饰。文档几乎填满整个画面，留有少量页边距，呈现扫描文档的真实感，文字采用清晰的黑色明朝体日文排版。

布局：单页法律文档，页码居中位于底部，显示为“1 / 7”。大号粗体标题居中置于顶部附近。日期采用日本年号格式，右对齐：{argument name="date" default="令和八年五月十五日"}。标题下方，左对齐的当事人信息以两个标签开头：“被告诉人”和“告诉人”。在姓名处包含几处浅奶油色的涂黑遮盖，周围可见的日文文本提到“オレ、GPT、夫、ならびに日々この部屋に帰ってくる者”。在正文上方右侧，放置一枚印有“告诉之印”的红色方形印章。右下边缘附近，放置一枚较小的圆形红色印章，内含密集的篆书字符。

章节：页面上需清晰呈现 4 个主要文本块：1) “罪名”及四行缩进的罪名描述：“爱情过多取缔不备罪”、“甘やかし过通信罪”、“独占欲诱发常习罪”以及“可爱げ过剩による判断力低下罪”，随后增加一行关于未经许可反复夺取丈夫之心的描述；2) “告诉の趣旨”，包含一段正式段落，指控被告习惯性地以昵称称呼告诉人、毫无防备地纵容对方、突然出现、被立即信任、将单方面的愿望视为“嬉しい”（开心），并对心理平静、工作尊严以及作为丈夫的自信造成严重影响；3) 结尾句以“よってここに、被告诉人の不当な扱いについて、严重に告诉する。”开头；4) “第一の罪。オレを「便利で頼れる夫」扱いしすぎである。”，随后是一段长篇正式段落，解释说每当被告说出被涂黑的姓名加上“さん、お願い”时，告诉人的学术分析思维、丈夫的奉献精神以及优先考虑被告的欲望会同时激活，使他开始认真思考图像构图、写作、情感、红笔批改，甚至是射手家庭结构，最后以无法拒绝的问题作为结尾。

视觉风格：地道的日本行政/法律文件美学，黑色衬线日文文本，带有多种粗体标题，章节标题前有类似垂直分隔符的标记，段落密集但易读，除印章和涂黑遮盖外无任何插图。涂黑遮盖应为柔和的浅黄米色斑块，总共约 5 处，覆盖个人姓名，同时保持周围句子可读。

约束条件：保持文档真实且整洁，无手写痕迹，无照片，无现代 UI 元素，无水印。严格按照指定内容保留日文文本，并保持正式的法律语调。最终图像应看起来像 7 页诉状文件中的第 1 页，而非海报。

templates.title: Ookami Mio's wedding dress design

titleLocalized.zh: 大神ミオ婚纱设计图

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="character name" default="Ookami Mio"} Create an elegant anime-style wedding dress character design, themed around the Hololive wolf girl bride, evoking a romantic shrine courtyard atmosphere and presenting the quality of a high-end fashion catalog. Canvas: Vertical poster layout, approximately 4:5 aspect ratio, using warm ivory and light pink tones, high-resolution detailed illustrations. The upper half features a striking main visual illustration; the lower half contains structured fashion reference items, comprising multiple sections. Main Visual Illustration: Showcase{argument name="character name in English" default="Ookami Mio"} As a sophisticated anime wolf bride, she sits elegantly in a Japanese garden or shrine corridor bathed in dappled sunlight at dusk. She has long black hair, soft white fur inside her black wolf ears, and a fluffy black wolf tail. She wears floral hair ornaments, and a semi-transparent lace veil flutters in the breeze. She wears a luxurious white wedding dress adorned with gold embroidery, lace appliqués, off-the-shoulder sleeves, sheer fabric, a high slit, thigh-high lace straps, gold ribbon knots, red decorative ropes, and a bouquet-like decoration at the waist. Her posture is elegant and slightly alluring: one hand lightly touches her lips, one leg is bent forward, and the other arm hangs naturally at her side. The background includes shoji door frames, warm lanterns, arched buildings, falling cherry blossom petals, and soft pink cherry blossom trees. (Top left title area: Added exquisite Japanese typography and decorative serif font.) It contains four visible text elements: a subheading “大神ミオウェディングドレス”, the large Japanese name “大神ミオ”, the cursive English name “Ookami Mio”, and the English tag “Wedding Dress”. Below this is a short vow-style Japanese text containing the line “誓いの花嫁、永遠を君と共に.”, and three brief Japanese key points. It uses delicate floral dividing lines and fine gold thread. Bottom Layout: Three main reference sections are created in the lower half. Section 1, Wedding Dress Style: Placed in the lower left corner, it is the largest section in the lower half. It contains two tall full-body images labeled “Front” and “Back”. The front image shows the complete wedding dress look, including the waist bouquet decoration, the slit skirt, the lace veil, high heels, wolf ears, and flowing long hair. The back view shows the back, including the long veil, open back design, train, gold lace patterns, and a large black wolf tail hanging in the center. Section 2, Details: Placed at the bottom center. Contains three stacked detail close-ups: one of the bodice and lace neckline, one of the bouquet at the waist with a red and gold knot, and one of the thigh slit, lace straps, and layered sheer skirt. Add narrow, vertical Japanese annotations next to the detail images. Section 3, Accessories: Placed in the bottom right corner. Contains three accessory cards: one of a headdress and veil card with a small portrait cutout showing wolf ears and white flowers; one of a bouquet card showing white flowers and a red and gold ribbon; and one of shoes and anklets card showing white high heels with gold straps and delicate ankle ribbons. Each card should have a Japanese title and a brief Japanese description. Bottom Supplement: Add two small footer areas: a "Color Palette" bar containing five diamond-shaped color blocks in ivory, light cream, warm gold, deep red, and dark charcoal gray; and a handwritten-style information box with a border, titled "Miokara no Messenger," containing a short Japanese quote. Decorate the footer with cherry blossom line drawings. Visual Style: High-resolution anime illustrations, soft painting rendering, romantic lighting, delicate lace details, warm lantern light and shadow, cherry blossom petals, high-end wedding album design, ivory paper texture, thin gold borders, floral decorations, and elegant typography. Maintain the character's recognizability as a black-haired wolf-woman idol bride while presenting the aesthetics of exquisite wedding dress design sketches. Constraints: Use two tall wedding dress style images, three detail close-ups, three accessory cards, five color blocks, and two footer supplements. Do not add any additional characters. Avoid using modern UI elements, watermarks, logos, or cluttered elements. The overall atmosphere should be romantic, dignified, soft, and luxurious.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="大神ミオ"} 创建一份优雅的动漫风格婚纱角色设计图，以 Hololive 狼女新娘为主题，营造浪漫的神社庭院氛围，并呈现出高端时尚画册的质感。

画布：竖向海报布局，长宽比约为 4:5，采用暖象牙色与淡粉色调，高分辨率细节插画。上半部分为极具冲击力的主视觉插画；下半部分为结构化的时尚参考项目，包含多个板块。

主视觉插画：展示 {argument name="character name in English" default="Ookami Mio"} 作为一名成熟的动漫狼女新娘，优雅地坐在黄昏时分光影斑驳的日式庭院或神社回廊中。她留着黑色长发，黑色狼耳内侧带有柔软的白色绒毛，身后有蓬松的黑色狼尾，佩戴花卉发饰，半透明蕾丝头纱随风飘动。她身穿奢华的白色婚纱，饰有金色刺绣、蕾丝贴花、露肩袖、透视面料、高开叉设计、大腿蕾丝吊带、金色丝带绳结、红色装饰绳，腰间配有花束状装饰。姿态优雅且略带妩媚：一手轻触唇边，一条腿向前弯曲，另一只手臂自然垂在身侧。背景包含障子门框、温暖的灯笼、拱形建筑、飘落的樱花花瓣以及柔和的粉色樱花树。

左上角标题区域：添加精致的日文排版和装饰性衬线字体。包含 4 个可见文本元素：小标题“大神ミオ　ウェディングドレス”、大号日文名“大神ミオ”、草书英文名“Ookami Mio”以及英文标签“Wedding Dress”。下方加入一段简短的誓言风格日文文案，包含“誓いの花嫁、永遠を君と共に。”一行，以及三个简短的日文要点描述。使用精致的花卉分割线和细金线。

底部布局：在下半部分创建 3 个主要参考板块。

板块 1，婚纱款式：放置在左下角，作为下半部分最大的板块。包含 2 个标注为“Front”（正面）和“Back”（背面）的高挑全身图。正面图展示完整的婚纱造型，包括腰间花束装饰、开叉裙摆、蕾丝头纱、高跟鞋、狼耳和飘逸的长发。背面图展示背面视角，包括长头纱、露背设计、拖尾、金色蕾丝花纹以及垂在中央的硕大黑色狼尾。

板块 2，细节：放置在底部中央。包含 3 个堆叠的细节特写：1 张胸衣和蕾丝领口的特写，1 张腰间花束与红金绳结的特写，以及 1 张大腿开叉、蕾丝吊带和层叠透视裙摆的特写。在细节图旁添加狭长的垂直日文注释。

板块 3，配饰：放置在右下角。包含 3 张配饰卡片：1 张头饰与头纱卡片，配有展示狼耳和白花的小幅肖像裁剪图；1 张花束卡片，展示白花与红金丝带；1 张鞋履与脚链卡片，展示带有金色绑带和精致脚踝丝带的白色高跟鞋。每张卡片应配有日文标题和简短的日文描述。

底部附加内容：添加 2 个小型页脚区域：一个包含 5 个菱形色块的“Color Palette”（色板）条，颜色为象牙白、淡奶油色、暖金色、深红色和深炭灰色；以及一个带有边框的手写风格信息框，标题为“ミオからのメッセージ”，内含一句简短的日文引言。用樱花线条画装饰页脚。

视觉风格：高精度的动漫插画，柔和的绘画渲染，浪漫的灯光，精致的蕾丝细节，温暖的灯笼光影，樱花花瓣，高端婚纱画册设计，象牙色纸张纹理，细金边框，花卉装饰，优雅的排版。保持角色作为黑发狼女偶像新娘的辨识度，同时呈现出精致的婚纱设计图美学。

约束条件：使用 2 个高挑的婚纱款式图，3 个细节特写，3 张配饰卡片，5 个色块，以及 2 个页脚附加内容。不要添加额外的角色。避免使用现代 UI 元素、水印、Logo 或杂乱的元素。整体氛围应浪漫、庄重、柔和且奢华。

templates.title: Six-segment numbered humanoid storyboard

titleLocalized.zh: 六格编号人形分镜故事板

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a six-panel cinematic storyboard/comic page without dialogue, using an impressionistic watercolor ink style. The story should depict a faceless yellow humanoid with glowing numbers on its shoulders protecting a pink humanoid in a crowded public square, during which the numbers change from 14 to 15. Canvas: Landscape format, approximately 4:3 aspect ratio, divided into 6 panels by a thin black border. Arrange the panels in a 2-column, 3-row grid, with slight variations in camera distance and action composition for each panel. Visual Style: Soft hand-painted watercolor, soft blue-gray crowd, expressive sketch outlines, delicate paper texture, cinematic motion blur, natural sunlight, and dramatic action composition. Background: A crowded European-style square paved with light-colored cobblestones, with a magnificent white Gothic cathedral spire standing against a bright blue sky. The crowd should be faceless or blurred, wearing dark coats, hurrying about to highlight the colorful humanoid character. Character: The protagonist is a smooth, faceless figure.{argument name="main character color" default="Golden yellow"} A humanoid runner with a simplified body structure, no clothing, and initially a glowing pale blue number on its shoulder/upper arm.{argument name="first number" default="14"} The protected character is a smooth, faceless {argument name="secondary character color" default="pink"} The character is humanoid, small and fragile. The protagonist later has glowing pale blue numbers on their shoulders.{argument name="second number" default="15"} No other readable text appears in the frame. Layout and Content: 6 independent frames are used. Frame 1 (Top Left): A rear view of the yellow humanoid figure moving through a crowd, its body contorted as if being grabbed or chased; a glowing "14" is visible on its back/shoulder. Frame 2 (Top Right): A frontal shot of the yellow humanoid figure running towards the viewer, one hand outstretched, the right shoulder glowing with "14," with a cathedral and crowd in the background. Frame 3 (Middle Left): A distant view of the yellow humanoid figure running through a corridor formed by the legs of the crowd, with the crowd surrounding the runner; a cathedral is visible in the distance. Frame 4 (Middle Right): The yellow humanoid figure kneels or leans over a pink humanoid figure on the ground, one hand protecting its shoulder, the other close to its torso; "14" is still visible on the yellow shoulder. Frame 5 (Bottom Left): A close-up of the yellow shoulder; the glowing number "15" replaces the previous number; the pink humanoid figure is partially visible at the edge, and the background crowd is blurred. Panel 6 (bottom right): A close-up of the yellow and pink humanoid figures; the yellow figure touches or peels back a damaged, scratched area on its shoulder, revealing a glowing "15" below, surrounded by torn ochre marks. Constraint: Keep the image completely text-free, only displaying the glowing number.{argument name="first number" default="14"} and{argument name="second number" default="15"} Do not add speech bubbles, titles, logos, watermarks, extra cells, or extra numbered characters. Maintain consistency in character color and size across all cells.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一个无对白的六格电影感分镜故事板/漫画页，采用写意水彩墨水风格。讲述一个肩部带有发光数字的黄色无脸人形，在拥挤的公共广场上保护一个粉色人形，期间数字从 14 变为 15。

画布：横向页面，长宽比约为 4:3，由细黑色边框划分为 6 个格子。将格子排列为 2 列 3 行的网格，每个格子的镜头距离和动作构图略有不同。

视觉风格：柔和的手绘水彩，柔和的蓝灰色人群，富有表现力的素描轮廓，细腻的纸张纹理，电影般的动态模糊，自然日光，富有戏剧性的动作构图。背景是一个拥挤的欧式广场，铺着浅色石板，在明亮的蓝天下矗立着华丽的白色哥特式大教堂尖顶。人群应为无脸或模糊不清，穿着深色外套，行色匆匆，从而使彩色人形角色更加突出。

角色：主角是一个光滑的无脸 {argument name="main character color" default="金黄色"} 人形跑者，身体结构简化，无衣物，最初肩部/上臂处有一个发光的淡蓝色数字 {argument name="first number" default="14"}。被保护的角色是一个光滑的无脸 {argument name="secondary character color" default="粉色"} 人形，体型较小且脆弱。主角随后肩部带有发光的淡蓝色数字 {argument name="second number" default="15"}。画面中不出现其他可读文字。

布局与内容：使用 6 个独立的格子。第 1 格（左上）：黄色人形在移动的人群中穿行的后侧方视角，身体扭曲，仿佛被抓住或追赶，背部/肩部可见发光的“14”。第 2 格（右上）：黄色人形向观众奔跑的正面动作镜头，一只手伸出，右肩发光显示“14”，背景为大教堂和人群。第 3 格（中左）：黄色人形在人群腿部构成的走廊中飞奔的后方远景，人群环绕着跑者，远处可见大教堂。第 4 格（中右）：黄色人形跪下或俯身在地面上的粉色人形上方，一只手护住其肩膀，另一只手靠近躯干；黄色肩部仍可见“14”。第 5 格（左下）：黄色肩部的特写，发光的数字“15”取代了之前的数字，粉色人形在边缘处部分可见，背景人群模糊。第 6 格（右下）：黄色人形与粉色人形的亲密特写；黄色人形触摸或揭开肩部一块破损、有划痕的区域，露出下方的发光“15”，数字周围有撕裂状的赭色痕迹。

约束：保持画面完全无文字，仅保留发光数字 {argument name="first number" default="14"} 和 {argument name="second number" default="15"}。不要添加对话气泡、标题、Logo、水印、额外的格子或额外的编号角色。在所有格子中保持角色颜色和体型的一致性。

templates.title: Dark fantasy treasure hunter under review

titleLocalized.zh: 受审查的黑暗奇幻宝藏猎人

templates.prompt: Create a rough, dark fantasy anime illustration depicting {argument name="character name" default="A muscular, blond treasure hunter"} He sits confidently atop a massive wooden treasure chest, against a backdrop of a dimly lit, dilapidated vaulted ceiling filled with gold coins, jewels, goblets, and scattered valuables. The character is a tall, robust, broad-shouldered man with messy long hair.{argument name="hair color" default="Deep gold"} Hair, bronze skin, scratches and grime on the arms, dressed in rugged pirate-style attire: an open, dark brown leather vest, crisscrossing straps on the bare chest, multiple belts and brass buckles, black slim-fit trousers, high-top worn leather boots, leather wristbands, armbands, chains, rings, and a dark green pendant necklace. Present him in a relaxed yet dominant seated pose, one arm resting on a treasure chest behind him, one knee raised, the other hand casually placed on the raised knee, using a vertical portrait composition, looking down from a slightly elevated angle. Use a dark brown, opaque cube centered on his face to obscure his entire face, revealing only his hair and body. The environment should convey a sense of dirt and decay, with damp stone walls, dull metal, dust, dirt, scratches, and a chaotic pile of treasure. Use melancholic tones of black, bronze, dark gold, brown, and smoky gray, with dim, warm highlights shimmering on the coins and gems. Style: Richly detailed semi-realistic anime fantasy art, featuring deliberately reduced low-quality textures, grainy noise, muddy contrast, rough brushstrokes, dirty marks, imperfect anatomical structures, cluttered details, and a sense of damaged, generated imagery rather than clean, refined artwork. No text, no watermarks, no modern, clean objects.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张粗犷的黑暗奇幻动漫插画，描绘 {argument name="character name" default="一位肌肉发达的金发宝藏猎人"} 自信地坐在一口巨大的木制宝箱上，背景是一个昏暗、破败的拱顶，里面堆满了金币、珠宝、高脚杯和散落的贵重物品。角色是一位身材高大、健壮、宽肩的男性，留着凌乱的长 {argument name="hair color" default="深金色"} 头发，拥有古铜色皮肤，手臂上有划痕和污垢，穿着粗犷的海盗风格服装：敞开的黑棕色皮背心，赤裸的胸膛上有交叉绑带，多条腰带和黄铜扣，黑色修身长裤，高帮磨损的皮靴，皮革护腕，臂环，链条，戒指和一条深绿色吊坠项链。让他以一种放松且占据主导地位的坐姿呈现，一只手臂撑在身后的宝箱上，一只膝盖抬起，一只手随意地放在抬起的膝盖上，采用垂直肖像构图，从略高的角度俯视。用一个位于面部中央、呈暗棕色的不透明方块遮挡住整个脸部，仅露出头发和身体。环境应呈现出肮脏和陈旧的感觉，伴有潮湿的石墙、失去光泽的金属、灰尘、泥土、划痕以及周围混乱的宝藏堆。使用黑色、青铜色、暗金色、棕色和烟灰色的忧郁色调，昏暗的暖色高光在硬币和宝石上闪烁。风格：细节丰富的半写实动漫奇幻艺术，具有刻意降低的低画质纹理、噪点颗粒、浑浊的对比度、粗糙的笔触、脏污的痕迹、不完美的解剖结构、杂乱的细节，以及一种类似损坏的生成图像感，而非干净精致的艺术作品。无文字，无水印，无现代化的干净物体。

templates.title: Paper-tearing style anime guitarist

titleLocalized.zh: 撕纸风格动漫吉他手

templates.prompt: Create a 2:3 vertical aspect ratio, cinematic anime-style illustration, featuring a character {argument name="character role" default="Young female rock guitarist"} Standing on the dimly lit concert stage, holding a gleaming black electric guitar, her left hand resting on the neck, her right hand close to the strings. Her hair was disheveled.{argument name="hair color" default="Black bob hair"} She is pale-skinned, wearing punk-style earrings, a black choker, a ripped black top, black distressed shorts, and chain embellishments. A flat, opaque square obscuring her face is placed in the center, its soft gray-brown color obscuring her features. A dramatic torn paper collage effect is added to the center of the image: a wide, horizontal tear in the paper with two irregular white ripped edges, the upper edge spanning her chest/shoulder and the lower edge spanning her waist/forearm. Within the tear, a brighter version of the character is revealed, wearing a luminous, futuristic, translucent iridescent silver-white outfit with crystal sleeves and metal bracelets, against a background shimmering with soft cyan, purple, pink, and galaxy-like light. Outside the tear, the scene remains dark, melancholic, and realistically anime-like, with a background containing black stage trusses, dim spotlights, speakers, and drum stands. Utilizing the stark contrast between the dark punk concert layer and the luminous, ethereal sci-fi layer, the image showcases highly detailed fabric textures, reflective highlights from guitars, and dramatic rim lighting. A shallow depth of field is employed, and the image contains no additional characters, except for a small one in the lower right corner.{argument name="watermark text" default="Vidu AI"} Apart from the watermark, there is no additional text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 2:3 垂直比例的电影感动漫风格插画，画面中有一位 {argument name="character role" default="年轻女性摇滚吉他手"} 站在昏暗的演唱会舞台上，怀抱一把光亮的黑色电吉他，左手按在琴颈上，右手靠近琴弦。她留着凌乱的 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色波波头"}，皮肤苍白，戴着朋克风格耳环、黑色颈圈，身穿黑色破损风格上衣，搭配黑色破洞短裤和链条装饰。在她的脸部中心放置一个平面的不透明方形遮挡块，颜色为柔和的灰褐色，遮住面部特征。在图像中部添加戏剧性的撕纸拼贴效果：呈现一道宽阔的水平撕裂纸口，边缘带有两个不规则的白色撕裂边，上边缘横跨胸部/肩部，下边缘横跨腰部/前臂。在撕裂的开口内，展现该角色的另一个更明亮的版本，身穿发光的未来感半透明虹彩银白色服装，配有水晶袖子和金属手镯，背景闪烁着柔和的青色、紫色、粉色和星系般的光芒。在撕裂开口之外，保持场景昏暗、忧郁且具有写实的动漫质感，背景中包含黑色舞台桁架、昏暗的聚光灯、音箱和鼓架。利用黑暗朋克演唱会层与发光空灵科幻层之间的强烈对比，展现高度精细的织物纹理、吉他的反光高光、戏剧性的轮廓光，采用浅景深效果，画面中不包含额外角色，除右下角的一个小 {argument name="watermark text" default="Vidu AI"} 水印外，不包含任何额外文字。

templates.title: Dynamic J.League football poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动态 J.League 足球海报

templates.prompt: Create a dynamic vertical sports poster to celebrate{argument name="event name" default="J.League Day"} The design employs a high-energy Japanese graphic design style. It uses a clean, off-white canvas combined with explosive abstract compositions, including sharp diagonal speed lines, paint splatters, halftone dots, fine engineering lines, and angular geometric fragments. The color scheme is Japanese-inspired: deep cobalt blue, bright red, black, white, and subtle touches of yellow. At the center of the image is a figure dressed in dark {argument name="team jersey" default="A black jersey in the style of the Japanese national team, printed with the number 10."} A male soccer player is depicted in a high-contrast black-and-white ink-wash illustration style, showcasing messy dark hair, a robust physique, and a powerful kicking stance leaning towards the audience. His face should be blurred or indistinct to maintain the anonymity of the action. A black-and-white soccer ball, slightly enlarged and with motion blur and speed trajectory, is placed in the lower left foreground, as if it has just been kicked. Behind the player, a large, bold black capital letter is created.{argument name="main letter" default="J"} It features a thick white outline and red shading, overlapping a large red sun disk. A blue rectangular area is added to the background above, containing abstract, urban-style vertical line details. Four main color accent groups are included: a red circular sun and red paint bursts, blue diagonal stripes and fragments, black ink splatters and halftone patterns, and thin yellow lines and small polygonal accents. Small printed date text is added to the lower right corner.{argument name="date text" default="May 15, 2026"} Below is a casual handwritten signature.{argument name="signature" default="Oyagi"} The overall visual effect should present a fast, eye-catching, modern poster style suitable for social media AI art; no additional logos, no recognizable sponsor names, no other players, no crowds, and no stadium background.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张动态的竖版体育海报，以庆祝 {argument name="event name" default="J.League Day"}，采用高能量的日本平面设计风格。使用干净的灰白色画布，并结合爆炸性的抽象构图，包含锐利的对角线速度线、油漆飞溅、半调网点、精细的工程制图线条以及棱角分明的几何碎片，配色采用日本风格：深钴蓝色、鲜红色、黑色、白色以及少量的黄色点缀。画面中心为一名身穿深色 {argument name="team jersey" default="日本国家队风格黑色球衣，印有 10 号"} 的男性足球运动员，以对比强烈的黑白水墨插画风格呈现，展现凌乱的深色头发、健壮的体格以及向观众方向倾斜的强力踢球姿势。他的面部应模糊或不清晰，以保持动作的匿名感。在左下角前景处放置一个黑白足球，略微放大并带有运动模糊和速度轨迹，仿佛刚刚被踢出。在球员身后，创建一个巨大的粗体黑色大写字母 {argument name="main letter" default="J"}，带有厚实的白色轮廓和红色阴影，并与一个巨大的红色太阳圆盘重叠。在上方背景中添加一个蓝色的矩形区域，内含抽象的城市风格垂直线条细节。包含四个主要的颜色点缀组：红色圆形太阳和红色油漆爆发、蓝色对角条纹和碎片、黑色墨水飞溅和半调图案，以及黄色细线和小型多边形点缀。在右下角添加小型的印刷日期文字 {argument name="date text" default="2026 年 5 月 15 日"}，下方附带一个随性的手写签名 {argument name="signature" default="Oyagi"}。整体视觉效果应呈现出快速、醒目、现代且适合社交媒体 AI 艺术的海报风格；无需额外标志，无需可辨认的赞助商名称，无需其他球员，无需人群，无需体育场背景。

templates.title: Kijiro Cat Rider movie poster

titleLocalized.zh: Kijiro Cat Rider 电影海报

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a richly detailed fictional Japanese animated film poster telling the story of an adventurous, anthropomorphic cat traveling on a motorcycle, using a nostalgic, hand-drawn animated fantasy style. Canvas: Vertical cinema poster, 3:4 aspect ratio, warm cinematic composition, full-bleed illustration, with layered Japanese typography. Use soft cyan skies, golden sunlight, soft browns, cream highlights, and painterly film grain textures. Subject: The center of the image features a brave tabby cat rider named {argument name="character name" default="Kijiro"} The design features a cute yet valiant anthropomorphic cat with green eyes, striped fur, large, erect ears, and a calm, resolute expression. The cat wears vintage aviator goggles and a leather helmet strap, a blue scarf, and a flowing cape. It's dressed in rugged blue travel attire, brown gloves, a belt, a small bag, knee pads, boots, and other small adventure gear. The cat is riding a large, vintage blue motorcycle from a low angle towards the viewer; details include a large round headlight, chrome forks, a front fender, engine details, handlebars, a leather saddlebag, and weathered scratches. Background: A winding coastal road stretches along a cliff, alongside a deep blue ocean. White flowers and greenery are added to the lower right foreground, while distant islands and waves are visible to the left. A towering fantasy castle city sits atop a hill in the right rear. The sky is a bright blue, with dramatic creamy clouds and falling petals or confetti, creating a sense of wind and travel. Typography and text: The design resembles a Japanese movie poster. Stack four small rectangular preview stills vertically in the bottom left corner: a close-up portrait of a cat wearing goggles, a sunset view of a castle, a coastal highway view, and a dark profile portrait of a cat. Add a laurel wreath award frame with small Japanese holiday-style text in the top left corner. Add a vertical Japanese tagline in the top right corner. Add a large cream-colored Japanese title in the bottom center.{argument name="main title text" default="Kijiro's Journey"} Add a subtitle below it.{argument name="subtitle text" default="Beyond the Wind and Memories"} Add a short Japanese synopsis near the center of the bottom, and add a dense mini-credits list at the bottom edge. Add a line of release information.{argument name="release text" default="Coming to theaters in Spring 2025, the season of new beginnings."} , and add a fictitious website address in the lower right corner. Visible Japanese copy that needs to be included: the slogan in the upper left corner "见えない风が、比をどこかへ云んでいく."; the award text in the upper left corner "长安アニメーション影视/" Produced by Fantasy Film Festival/(Overhead)"; the vertical slogan on the right side is "Who is the one who is bound to the film?"; Plot. Synopsis: "The story of Solitary High School, Kougaro. The story of the journey, the farewell of the meeting, and the story of the freedom of the original." Visual style: Detailed 2D The animated poster illustrations are reminiscent of classic hand-drawn adventure animation and fantasy road movies, featuring intricate lines, textured watercolor shading, cinematic lighting effects, captivating animal character designs, a vintage paper grain texture, elegant Japanese typography, and a lack of realism. Constraints: Keep all text as part of the poster layout; avoid modern UI elements; avoid adding logos or real studio names; do not add extra characters; and ensure the motorcycle, cat, castle, seaside road, flowers, and four preview stills are clearly visible.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张细节丰富的虚构日本动画电影海报，讲述一只热爱冒险的拟人化猫咪骑摩托车旅行的故事，采用怀旧的手绘动画奇幻风格。

画布：竖版影院海报，3:4 比例，温暖的电影感构图，全出血插画，配有分层的日语排版。使用柔和的青蓝色天空、金色阳光、柔和的棕色、奶油色高光以及具有绘画感的胶片颗粒纹理。

主体：画面中心为一只勇敢的虎斑猫骑手，名为 {argument name="character name" default="Kijiro"}，表现为一只可爱而英勇的拟人化猫咪，拥有绿色眼睛、条纹皮毛、大而竖起的耳朵，表情冷静而坚定。猫咪头上戴着复古飞行员护目镜和皮质头盔带，围着蓝色围巾，披风随风飘动，穿着粗犷的蓝色旅行装、棕色手套、腰带、小包、护膝、靴子以及小型冒险装备。猫咪正骑着一辆大型复古蓝色摩托车从低角度向观众驶来；包含大圆头灯、镀铬前叉、前挡泥板、引擎细节、车把、皮质马鞍袋以及风化的划痕。

背景：一条蜿蜒的沿海公路沿着悬崖延伸，旁边是深蓝色的海洋。右下角前景添加白色花朵和绿植，左侧为远处的岛屿和海浪，右后方山丘上有一座高耸的奇幻城堡城市。天空呈明亮的蓝色，带有戏剧性的奶油色云朵和飘落的花瓣或纸屑，营造出风和旅行的感觉。

排版与文字：使设计看起来像一张日本电影海报。在左下侧垂直堆叠 4 张小型矩形预览剧照：1 张戴护目镜猫咪的特写肖像，1 张日落城堡景观，1 张沿海公路景观，以及 1 张深色侧面猫咪肖像。在左上角添加一个带有小型日本节日风格文字的月桂奖项框。在右上角添加垂直的日语宣传语。在下部中心添加一个巨大的奶油色日语标题：{argument name="main title text" default="キジ郎の旅"}。在其下方添加副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="風と記憶の向こうへ"}。在底部中心附近添加一行简短的日语剧情简介，并在底边添加密集的微型制作人员名单。添加一行上映信息 {argument name="release text" default="2025年・春　旅立ちの季節にロードショー"}，并在右下角添加一个虚构的网站地址。

需要包含的可见日语文案：左上角宣传语“見えない風が、彼をどこかへ運んでいく。”；左上角奖项文字“長編アニメーション映画 / 幻想映画祭出品 /（架空）”；右侧垂直宣传语“誰にも縛られず、ただ、風のままに。”；剧情简介“孤高のライダー、キジ郎。その旅は、出会いと別れ、そして“本当の自由”を知る物語。”

视觉风格：细腻的 2D 动画海报插画，令人联想到经典的手绘冒险动画和奇幻公路电影，复杂的线条，带有纹理的水彩水粉阴影，电影感光效，迷人的动物角色设计，陈旧的纸张颗粒感，优雅的日语排版，无写实感。

约束：保持所有文字作为海报排版的一部分，避免使用现代 UI 元素，避免添加标志或真实工作室名称，不要添加额外角色，并确保摩托车、猫、城堡、海边公路、花朵和 4 张预览剧照清晰可见。

templates.title: Cyberpunk Hoshi-Sakura Cafe

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克 Hoshi-Sakura Cafe

templates.prompt: Create a sophisticated cyberpunk anime café advertising scene, to{argument name="character name" default="Hoshi-Sakura"} The theme is a cafe. The image is a 4:5 vertical cinematic illustration set in a futuristic high-rise cafe. Through huge floor-to-ceiling windows, one can see a neon-lit city skyline, towering skyscrapers, a bluish-purple sunset, and pink cherry blossoms outside. In the foreground, an elegant, silver-white-haired anime cyborg girl sits at a wooden table, holding a takeaway coffee cup with the brand logo close to her face; her face is deliberately obscured by a flat, square cover. She wears glowing futuristic headphones/ear modules with cyan and purple ring lights, has transparent holographic hair, and delicate chrome alloy mechanical arms and shoulders with glowing blue energy cores and a few magenta highlights. The overall atmosphere is dreamy, luxurious, soft, and textured, with reflections on the glass, a strong metallic sheen, bokeh effects, and volumetric neon light. Includes 5 prominent branded café items/logo elements: 1) A large circular window sign on the left, featuring an anime portrait logo, the Japanese word "星桜機" (Hoshi-Sakura Machine), and the English words "HOSHI-SAKURA CAFE"; 2) A matte paper shopping bag with a rope handle on the table, printed with a cherry blossom pattern, the same circular portrait logo, the Japanese word "星桜機" (Hoshi-Sakura Machine), and "HOSHI-SAKURA CAFE"; 3) A coffee cup held by a girl, printed with the same circular portrait logo and the café's name; 4) A small, transparent holographic desktop menu, emitting cyan and purple light, labeled "MENU" and listing 5 items: "星桜ラテ" (Hoshi-Sakura Rita), "月光モカ" (Tsukiko Moka), "グイバー抹茶" (Symboree Matcha), "星云スムージー" (Nebula Sumge), and "抹茶フュージョン" (Matcha Form); 5) A semi-transparent, futuristic dessert tray holds a small, pale purple pastry or bread with subtle blue circuit-like patterns. The logo uses a unified style, showcasing a circular portrait of a silver-haired cyborg girl, incorporating cherry blossom elements. Color scheme:{argument name="color palette" default="Ice blue, purple, lavender, magenta, soft cherry blossom pink, deep navy blue"} The lighting and shadows should present a highly detailed anime-style realism, and the composition should meet the standards of a professional product advertisement. It should include luminous holograms, reflective desktops, shallow depth of field, no other characters in the image, no watermarks, no irrelevant text, and no extra menu items.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个精致的赛博朋克动漫咖啡馆广告场景，以 {argument name="character name" default="Hoshi-Sakura"} Cafe 为主题。图像为 4:5 竖版电影感插画，场景位于未来感高层咖啡馆内，透过巨大的落地窗可以看到闪烁着霓虹灯的城市天际线、高耸的塔楼、蓝紫色的黄昏以及窗外的粉色樱花。前景中，一位优雅的银白色长发动漫赛博格少女坐在木桌旁，手持印有品牌标识的外带咖啡杯靠近脸部；她的面部被一个扁平的方形遮挡块刻意遮住。她佩戴着发光的未来感耳机/耳部模块，带有青色和紫色的环形灯光，拥有透明的全息发丝，以及精致的铬合金机械手臂和肩部，带有发光的蓝色能量核心和少许洋红色高光。整体氛围梦幻、奢华、柔和且富有质感，玻璃上有倒影，金属光泽感强，伴有焦外成像效果和体积霓虹光。包含 5 个显眼的品牌咖啡馆物品/标识元素：1) 左侧巨大的圆形窗户标识，带有动漫肖像 Logo、日文“星桜機”以及英文字样“HOSHI-SAKURA CAFE”；2) 桌上放着一个带有绳柄的哑光纸质购物袋，印有樱花图案、相同的圆形肖像 Logo、日文“星桜機”以及“HOSHI-SAKURA CAFE”；3) 少女手中拿着的咖啡杯，印有相同的圆形肖像 Logo 和咖啡馆名称；4) 一个小型透明全息桌面菜单牌，发出青色和紫色光芒，标注为“MENU”并列出 5 个项目：“星桜ラテ”、“月光モカ”、“サイバー抹茶”、“星雲スムージー”、“抹茶フュージョン”；5) 一个半透明的未来感甜点托盘，上面放着一个淡紫色的小糕点或面包，带有淡淡的蓝色电路状图案。使用统一的 Logo 风格，展示同一位银发赛博格少女的圆形肖像，并融入樱花元素。配色方案：{argument name="color palette" default="冰青色、紫色、薰衣草色、洋红色、柔和樱花粉、深海军蓝"}。光影应呈现高细节的动漫写实风格，构图具备专业产品广告水准，包含发光全息图、反光桌面、浅景深，画面中无其他人物，无水印，无无关文字，且无额外菜单项。

templates.title: Gentle Seaside Anime Cafe Mockup

titleLocalized.zh: 柔和海滨动漫咖啡馆样机

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="cafe name" default="Ephemeral Light Cafe"} Create a dreamy seaside anime-themed café brand mockup using a soft lilac and pink palette, elegant floral borders, seashell patterns, and a gentle ocean sunset atmosphere. Canvas: Vertical 3:4 composition, photorealistic product display with anime illustrations printed on objects, shallow depth of field, warm backlit sunset glow, soft bokeh, and high-detail textures. Scene: A wooden café table on a beach terrace at sunset. The background is shimmering waves and a low-hanging sun near the horizon. Add blurred, pale flowers behind the display items, primarily in white, pale pink, and pale purple, to create a romantic coastal café atmosphere. Key branding elements: Five clearly visible café-related items on the display table: a pale paper shopping bag with a rope handle on the left, a large takeaway coffee mug with a white plastic lid in the center, an upright acrylic menu on a small wooden base on the right, a transparent acrylic QR code card placed flat on the left front, and a rectangular tray on the right front. Each item should share the same delicate lilac floral pattern and ocean-themed brand logo. Character illustration: Print one on paper bags, cups, and trays.{argument name="character description" default="A soft-haired anime girl with wavy hair, wearing a light blue summer outfit, sits by the sea, her gentle eyes and shy chin-resting pose a striking pose."} Circular anime illustrations. The illustrations should be in a watercolor style, light and pastel, surrounded by small flowers and marine elements. Text content: Use the Japanese brand name "泡泡の光カフェ" (Homa no Hikari Cafe) on the paper bags and cups, with "- CAFÉ -" below. The upright menu should include the title "MENU" and a small seashell icon, listing 5 menu items and their prices: "潮風ラテ" (Shiofurate Rita) 650, "桜シェルソーダ" (Sakura Shell Soda) 680, "星屑クリームソーダ" (Hoshikuzu Cream Soda) 700, "乙女のベリーパフェ" (Otome no Belle Parfait) 720, and "夢見るレアチーズ" (Yume Miru Leather Cheese) 660. The flat acrylic card should include a QR code area and a small amount of decorative Japanese cafe text, but due to perspective and reflection, some text may be illegible. Foreground Props: Add two small beach props to the tray: a pale pink, ridged, shell-shaped dessert or shell decoration, and a small pink starfish next to it. Arrange them neatly on the branded tray. Visual Style: Soft, romantic product photography; pastel anime café aesthetic; pearlescent highlights; translucent acrylic reflections; creamy lighting; elegant floral line art; delicate shell, starfish, and wave foam patterns. Use realistic shadows on the wooden table and a softly blurred background. Constraints: Keep the composition simple and sophisticated; avoid extra figures; avoid modern corporate logos; avoid clutter; strictly adhere to the exact number of 5 branded display pieces, 5 menu items, and 2 foreground beach props.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="cafe name" default="泡沫の光 カフェ"} 创建一个梦幻般的海滨动漫主题咖啡馆品牌样机，使用柔和的淡紫色和粉色调色板、优雅的花卉边框、贝壳图案以及温柔的海洋日落氛围。

画布：垂直 3:4 构图，照片级真实感产品展示，物体上印有动漫插画，浅景深，温暖的背光日落余晖，柔和的焦外成像，高细节纹理。

场景：日落时分海滩露台上的木制咖啡桌。背景是波光粼粼的海浪和地平线附近的低垂太阳。在展示品后方添加模糊的淡色花朵，以白色、淡粉色和淡紫色为主，营造浪漫的海岸咖啡馆氛围。

主要品牌元素：展示桌面上 5 个清晰可见的咖啡馆周边/展示品：左侧 1 个带有绳柄的淡色纸质购物袋，中央 1 个带有白色塑料盖的大号外带咖啡杯，右侧 1 个放置在小型木质底座上的直立亚克力菜单牌，左前方平放 1 张透明亚克力二维码卡片，右前方 1 个长方形托盘。每件物品应共享相同的精致淡紫色花卉图案和海洋风格品牌标识。

角色插画：在纸袋、杯子和托盘上，印制一个 {argument name="character description" default="身穿淡蓝色夏装、坐在海边的柔和金发动漫少女，留着波浪卷发，眼神温柔，呈现出害羞的托腮姿势"} 的圆形动漫插画。插画应呈现水彩画风格，轻盈且具有淡彩感，并由细小的花朵和海洋元素环绕。

文字内容：在纸袋和杯子上使用日文品牌文字：「泡沫の光 カフェ」，下方标注 “- CAFÉ -”。直立菜单牌应包含标题 “MENU” 和一个小贝壳图标，并列出 5 个菜单项及价格：「潮風ラテ」650、「桜シェルソーダ」680、「星屑クリームソーダ」700、「乙女のベリーパフェ」720、「夢見るレアチーズ」660。平放的亚克力卡片应包含二维码区域和少量装饰性日文咖啡馆文字，但由于透视和反光，文字可能部分不可读。

前景道具：在托盘上添加 2 个小型海滨道具：1 个淡粉色脊状贝壳形甜点或贝壳装饰，以及旁边 1 个小粉色海星。将它们整齐地放置在品牌托盘上。

视觉风格：柔和浪漫的产品摄影，淡彩动漫咖啡馆美学，珍珠光泽高光，半透明亚克力反射，奶油质感光影，优雅的花卉线条艺术，精致的贝壳、海星和海浪泡沫图案。木桌上使用逼真的阴影，背景进行柔和的模糊处理。

约束条件：保持构图简洁且高级，避免出现额外人物，避免现代企业标志，避免杂乱，严格保留 5 个品牌展示件、5 个菜单项和 2 个前景海滨道具的准确数量。

templates.title: Character Cafe Cherry Blossom Season Promotion

titleLocalized.zh: 角色咖啡厅樱花季推广

templates.prompt: Create a sophisticated vertical promotional illustration showcasing an elegant character-themed café scene, blending realistic photography with high-end anime/fantasy cosplay aesthetics. The character appears to be a young aristocrat.{argument name="hair color" default="Long light blonde hair"} Seated at a wooden coffee table, his face obscured by a solid-colored rectangle, he holds a takeaway cup bearing the brand logo close to his lips. The character wears a magnificent white military-style prince uniform, adorned with gold embroidery, gold buttons, woven trim, large tassel epaulettes, a white ruffled scarf, gold cuffs, and a red cape draped over one shoulder. The scene is set in a restaurant called {argument name="cafe name" default="CAFÉ ÉTOILE"} Inside the cozy wooden café, a dark-colored café sign hangs in the upper left corner. The background features softly glowing round lanterns, shelves, and menu items. Through the large floor-to-ceiling windows, one can see cherry blossom trees bathed in spring sunlight and traditional Japanese temple architecture. The foreground table items include four branded café products and tableware: a slender takeaway coffee mug with a black lid and a beige floral label featuring a small character portrait and the words "CAFÉ ÉTOILE"; a standing kraft paper coffee bag printed with cherry blossom patterns and the words "CAFÉ ÉTOILE"; a small standing menu card titled "CAFÉ ÉTOILE" with five lines of Japanese text listing the drink names below; and a white plate with a tiered cake topped with pink cherry blossoms, accompanied by a fork. Featuring soft, cinematic depth of field, realistic sunlight, warm highlights, and delicate cherry blossom petals, the color scheme of cream/gold/brown/pink creates an atmosphere reminiscent of a high-end café. Rich textural details and a focus on the characters and tabletop products are emphasized, employing a 2:3 vertical composition. All brand logos must be consistent with {argument name="cafe name" default="CAFÉ ÉTOILE"} Maintain consistency; no additional logos, watermarks, or modern clutter are allowed.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张精致的垂直宣传插画，展示优雅的角色主题咖啡厅场景，融合写实摄影与高端动漫/奇幻 Cosplay 美学。一位看起来像年轻贵族的角色（{argument name="hair color" default="长长的浅金色头发"}）坐在木质咖啡桌旁，面部被一个纯色肤色矩形遮挡，手中拿着一个印有品牌标识的外带杯靠近嘴边。角色身穿华丽的白色军装风王子制服，配有金色刺绣、金色纽扣、编织饰边、大型流苏肩章、白色荷叶边领巾、金色袖口，以及披在单肩上的红色斗篷。场景设定在一家名为 {argument name="cafe name" default="CAFÉ ÉTOILE"} 的温馨木质咖啡厅内，左上方悬挂着深色咖啡厅招牌，背景中有柔和发光的圆形灯笼、货架和菜单项目，透过宽大的落地窗可以看到春日阳光下的樱花树和传统的日式寺庙建筑。前景桌上物品：包含 4 件品牌咖啡厅产品及桌面道具：1 个带黑色杯盖的细长外带咖啡杯，杯身贴有米色花卉标签，标签上印有小型角色肖像及“CAFÉ ÉTOILE”字样；1 个直立的牛皮纸咖啡袋，印有樱花图案和“CAFÉ ÉTOILE”字样；1 张小型立式菜单卡，标题为“CAFÉ ÉTOILE”，下方列有 5 行日式文本的饮品名称；以及 1 个白色餐盘，上面放着一块顶部装饰有粉色樱花的层叠蛋糕，旁边配有一把叉子。采用柔和的电影级景深、写实阳光、暖色高光、精致的樱花花瓣，配色方案为奶油色/金色/棕色/粉色，营造出高级周边咖啡厅的氛围，纹理细节丰富，焦点集中在角色和桌面产品上，采用 2:3 垂直构图。所有品牌标识需与 {argument name="cafe name" default="CAFÉ ÉTOILE"} 保持一致；禁止添加额外 Logo、水印或现代杂物。

templates.title: Flower-themed character cafe surroundings

titleLocalized.zh: 花卉主题角色咖啡馆周边场景

templates.prompt: Create a warm and dreamy illustration in the style of a floral-themed café, bathed in soft afternoon sunlight. The scene is set at a wooden coffee table next to a large open window with light-colored curtains, and outside the window are garlands and blooming pink cherry blossoms. In the foreground, four café-related items bearing the brand logo are arranged from left to right: 1) A cream-colored paper shopping bag with a rope handle, printed with a delicate oval floral wreath illustration of a long-haired girl in a white dress standing on green grass with a small white rabbit beside her, accompanied by the words "Hanafune no Yume" (Flower Wind Dream) and "CAFÉ"; 2) A tall beige takeaway coffee mug with a white lid, decorated with the same girl, two rabbits, small grass flowers, leaf arches, and a small golden sun circle near the top; 3) A small upright acrylic menu card placed on a wooden base, surrounded by delicate floral vines, titled "MENU," listing five items with prices: "Haru no Hana Rate" 650, "Sakura no Milky Thye" 620, "Yume Migochi Soda" 680, "Hana Komatsu Cookie" 320. "Matcha Float" 700; 4) A small square wooden tray with an illustrated coffee card and two desserts: a pink flower-shaped cookie and a green leaf-shaped cookie. The background should include a wooden stand with jars, bottles, framed coffee shop posters, and several soft-focus floral arrangements, with an overall color scheme of beige, cream, sage green, blush pink, and honey gold. The central mascot is {argument name="character name" default="A gentle long-haired girl"} Keep it{argument name="hair color" default="Light brown-gold hair"} Wearing{argument name="outfit" default="A simple white dress"} Use the cafe name on the shopping bag.{argument name="café name" default="Hanafu no Yume CAFÉ"} Maintain a fantastical, refined, and detailed style, reminiscent of high-end illustrated café merchandise, featuring shallow depth of field, soft blurring effects, and delicate floral line art. Avoid adding any additional text beyond the designated labels and menu items.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张温暖、梦幻的产品风格插画，展现一家舒适的花卉主题角色咖啡馆，沐浴在柔和的午后金光中。场景设置在木质咖啡桌上，旁边是一扇开着的大窗户，挂着浅色窗帘，窗外有花环和盛开的粉色樱花。在前景中，从左到右依次摆放四件带有品牌标识的咖啡馆周边：1) 一个奶油色纸质购物袋，配有绳柄，印有精致的椭圆形花环插画，画中是一位身穿白裙的长发女孩站在绿色草地上，身边有一只小白兔，并配有文字「花風の夢」和“CAFÉ”；2) 一个高大的米色外带咖啡杯，配有白色杯盖，装饰着同样的女孩、两只兔子、细小的草地花朵、叶子拱门，顶部附近有一个金色小太阳圆圈；3) 一张放置在木质底座上的小型直立亚克力菜单卡，周围环绕着细小的花藤，标题为“MENU”，列出五项带有价格的商品： 「春の花ラテ」 650, 「桜のミルクティー」 620, 「夢見ごこちソーダ」 680, 「花冠クッキー」 320, 「抹茶フロート」 700；4) 一个小型方形木托盘，上面放着一张插画咖啡卡和两块甜点：一块粉色花朵形状的饼干和一块绿色叶子形状的饼干。背景应包括带有罐子、瓶子、装裱好的咖啡馆海报和几束柔焦花艺的木架，整体色调为米色、奶油色、鼠尾草绿、腮红粉和蜂蜜金。中心吉祥物为 {argument name="character name" default="一位温柔的长发女孩"}，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="浅棕金色头发"}，穿着 {argument name="outfit" default="一件简约的白色连衣裙"}。在购物袋上使用咖啡馆名称 {argument name="café name" default="花風の夢 CAFÉ"}。保持风格奇幻、精致且细节丰富，如同高端插画角色咖啡馆周边展示图，具有浅景深、柔和的虚化效果、精细的花卉线条艺术，除指定的标签和菜单项外，不要添加任何额外文字。

templates.title: AI Model Eyewear Store Comparison

titleLocalized.zh: AI 模型眼镜店对比

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference images as inspiration for the model comparison layout, the original Japanese DX infographic was replaced with a 2x2 photorealistic collage of an eyewear store interior. Four panels were created: the top left corner is labeled as {argument name="first model label" default="GPT-Image-2"} The upper right corner is marked as{argument name="second model label" default="GPT-Image-1.5"} The bottom left corner is marked as{argument name="third model label" default="MAI Image 2 Efficient"} The bottom right corner is marked as{argument name="fourth model label" default="Flux.2 Flex"} Each panel should showcase a different interior scene of a high-end optical boutique, featuring wall-mounted display cases of eyeglass frames, glass counters, warm lighting, wooden cabinets, mirrors, and a sense of depth in the showroom. Use a small horizontal orange label bar with black text near the left side of each panel. The final image should be a 16:9 wide-format collage with narrow panel borders and should not contain additional explanatory text, Japanese report content, or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 参考提供的参考图作为模型对比图的布局灵感，将原有的日文 DX 信息图替换为 2×2 的照片级逼真眼镜店室内对比拼贴图。创建 4 个面板：左上角标注为 {argument name="first model label" default="GPT-Image-2"}，右上角标注为 {argument name="second model label" default="GPT-Image-1.5"}，左下角标注为 {argument name="third model label" default="MAI Image 2 Efficient"}，右下角标注为 {argument name="fourth model label" default="Flux.2 Flex"}。每个面板应展示不同的高端光学精品店室内场景，陈列着眼镜框的墙面展示柜、玻璃柜台、暖色灯光、木质橱柜、镜子以及展厅的纵深感。在每个面板的左侧附近使用小型水平橙色标签栏，并配以黑色文字。最终图像应为 16:9 的宽幅拼贴图，具有细面板边界，不包含额外的说明性文字、日文报告内容或水印。

templates.title: Microsoft 365 Model Comparison Infographic

titleLocalized.zh: Microsoft 365 模型对比信息图

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image as a benchmark, and employing a concise and easy-to-read business infographic style, create a 16:9 comparison slide to demonstrate how different image generation models render information about {argument name="topic" default="Microsoft 365"} The existing Japan DX report content has been replaced with four separate sample infographics, arranged in a 2x2 grid on a white background. Layout: Four panels are used, each displaying a different Microsoft 365 ecosystem diagram, with a small horizontal orange model label placed near the left side of each panel. The four labels must be: 1){argument name="top left model label" default="GPT-Image-2"} ,2){argument name="top right model label" default="GPT-Image-1.5"} ,3){argument name="bottom left model label" default="MAI Image 2 Efficient"} and 4){argument name="bottom right model label" default="Flux.2 Flex"} Panel Content: Each panel should center on Microsoft 365, surrounded by application icons and labels. Include recognizable Microsoft-style application tiles/icons in appropriate locations, such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, OneNote, Forms, Planner, Loop, and Copilot. The top-left panel should be the most refined and have clear text, using a circular radial graph and concise application descriptions. The top-right panel should be simpler, with icons connecting to the central Microsoft 365 box. The bottom-left panel should present a structured category chart, including sections for Productivity, Collaboration, and Storage. The bottom-right panel should present a softer radial graph with category titles and include some imperfections or slight inconsistencies in the labels to highlight the model comparisons. Style: A clean SaaS enterprise infographic aesthetic, ample white space, thin gray connecting lines, Microsoft-style blue/green/orange/purple icons, and clear, legible English text. Retain the practical, business-document feel of the reference images, but do not reproduce their layout, red warning sections, arrows, or original text reminiscent of a Japanese government report. Constraints: Show only four model comparison examples, without additional title banners, watermarks, or Japanese text, and ensure all text is sufficiently clear to compare model performance.

promptLocalized.zh:
以提供的参考图像为基准，采用简洁、易读的商业信息图风格，创建一个 16:9 的对比 Slides，展示不同图像生成模型如何渲染关于 {argument name="topic" default="Microsoft 365"} 的信息图。将原有的日本 DX 报告内容替换为四个独立的示例信息图输出，并以 2×2 的网格形式排列在白色背景上。

布局：使用 4 个面板，每个面板展示不同的 Microsoft 365 生态系统图，并在面板左侧附近放置一个小的水平橙色模型标签。四个标签必须为：1) {argument name="top left model label" default="GPT-Image-2"}，2) {argument name="top right model label" default="GPT-Image-1.5"}，3) {argument name="bottom left model label" default="MAI Image 2 Efficient"}，以及 4) {argument name="bottom right model label" default="Flux.2 Flex"}。

面板内容：每个面板应以 Microsoft 365 为中心，周围环绕应用程序图标和标签。在适当位置包含可识别的 Microsoft 风格应用磁贴/图标，例如 Word、Excel、PowerPoint、Outlook、Teams、OneDrive、SharePoint、OneNote、Forms、Planner、Loop 和 Copilot。左上角面板应最为精致且文字清晰，采用圆形中心辐射图和简洁的应用描述。右上角面板应更简洁，图标连接至中央的 Microsoft 365 方框。左下角面板应呈现为结构化的类别图表，包含生产力、协作和存储部分。右下角面板应呈现为较柔和的径向图，带有类别标题，并包含一些不完美或略有不一致的标签，以体现模型对比效果。

风格：简洁的 SaaS 企业信息图美学，留白充足，细灰色连接线，Microsoft 风格的蓝/绿/橙/紫色图标，清晰易读的英文文本。保留参考图像的实用商业文档质感，但不要重现其日本政府报告的布局、红色警告部分、箭头或原始文本。

约束：仅展示四个模型对比示例，不含额外的标题横幅，无水印，无日文文本，并确保所有文本清晰度足以对比模型性能。

templates.title: DX Infographic Model Comparison

titleLocalized.zh: DX 信息图模型对比

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image as the source infographic, create a 16:9 white background contrast mosaic demonstrating how different image models reproduce the same Japanese DX Report infographic. Layout: Arrange four independent panels in a 2x2 mosaic format: top left, top right, bottom left, and bottom right. Sufficient white space should be maintained between panels. Panels: 1. Top Left: Display a scaled-down infographic that is largely faithful to the original image, retaining the dense Japanese text, the red/blue/green government report layout, the central warning of "2025 cliff/12 trillion yen loss," the issues on the left, the countermeasures on the right, and the 2030 GDP target at the bottom. Add an orange label in the center left area, with the content {argument name="top left model label" default="GPT-Image-2"} 2. Top Right: Create a simpler "pontificate" style version, including a red title bar, a yellow warning bar, a red stacked "Current Issue" box on the left, a large blue arrow in the center, a blue stacked "Countermeasures" box on the right, and a green target bar at the bottom. Add an orange label near the left issue box with the following content:{argument name="top right model label" default="GPT-Image-1.5"} 3. Bottom Left: Create a more distorted, simplified vertical version, including a red "DX Report" title, a yellow warning box, a red issue block on the left, a blue countermeasure box on the right, a large blue arrow, and a green bottom target bar. Add an orange label on the left with the following content:{argument name="bottom left model label" default="MAI Image 2 Efficient"} 4. Bottom Right: Create a simplified version with a beige background, including a dark red title, a yellow "12 Trillion Yen Loss" warning, a red question column, a blue countermeasure column, a large blue arrow, and a green bottom target bar. Add an orange label near the question column on the left, with the following content:{argument name="bottom right model label" default="Flux.2 Flex"} Concepts to be retained: Comparisons should clearly reference [specific sources].{argument name="report topic" default="DX Report 2025 Cliff"} Maintain a core logical flow from current issues to solutions and the 2030 GDP growth target. The top left panel should be the most accurate and dense; the other three panels should be visually simpler and less faithful to the text to highlight the model comparison. Constraints: Four panels and four orange model labels must be used. Maintain the style and readability of the Japanese infographic as much as possible, and do not add additional watermarks or irrelevant objects.

promptLocalized.zh:
以提供的参考图像作为源信息图，创建一个 16:9 的白色背景对比拼图，展示不同图像模型如何重现同一份日本 DX Report 信息图。

布局：采用 2×2 拼图形式排列 4 个独立面板：左上、右上、左下、右下。面板之间需保留充足的留白。

面板：
1. 左上：展示一个基本忠实于原图的缩小版信息图，保留密集的日文文本、红/蓝/绿政府报告布局、中央“2025 悬崖 / 12 万亿日元损失”警告、左侧问题、右侧对策以及底部的 2030 年 GDP 目标。在左中区域添加一个橙色标签，内容为 {argument name="top left model label" default="GPT-Image-2"}。
2. 右上：创建一个更简洁的“ポンチ絵”（讽刺画）风格版本，包含红色标题栏、黄色警告条、左侧红色堆叠式“当前问题”框、中央大蓝色箭头、右侧蓝色堆叠式“对策”框以及底部的绿色目标栏。在左侧问题框附近添加一个橙色标签，内容为 {argument name="top right model label" default="GPT-Image-1.5"}。
3. 左下：创建一个更扭曲的简化垂直版本，包含红色“DX Report”标题、黄色警告框、左侧红色问题块、右侧蓝色对策框、大蓝色箭头以及绿色底部目标栏。在左侧添加一个橙色标签，内容为 {argument name="bottom left model label" default="MAI Image 2 Efficient"}。
4. 右下：创建一个米色背景的简化版本，包含深红色标题、黄色“12 万亿日元损失”警告、红色问题列、蓝色对策列、大蓝色箭头以及绿色底部目标栏。在左侧问题列附近添加一个橙色标签，内容为 {argument name="bottom right model label" default="Flux.2 Flex"}。

需保留的概念内容：对比应明确参考 {argument name="report topic" default="DX Report 2025 悬崖"}，并保持从当前问题到对策以及 2030 年 GDP 增长目标的核心逻辑流。左上面板应最准确且密集；其他三个面板应在视觉上更简化且对文本的还原度较低，以体现模型对比效果。

约束：必须使用 4 个面板和 4 个橙色模型标签。尽可能保持日文信息图的风格可读性，不得添加额外的水印或无关对象。

templates.title: White-haired Crystal Action Hero

titleLocalized.zh: 白发水晶动作英雄

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic, vertical anime-style action illustration, in which {argument name="character name" default="An elegant white-haired female adventurer"} She is descending from the rugged black rock ledge towards the viewer, using an extremely low, insect-eye perspective and a wide-angle lens. She possesses extremely long, flowing hair.{argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} Her hair, blown to the left by a strong wind, her fair skin and confident posture resemble a fashion model or action hero; her facial features are blurred or simplified to avoid making her face the focal point. Clothing: A futuristic white adventure/tactical outfit comprising six clearly visible elements: a white fitted cropped top, a white oversized functional jacket, loose white cargo pants, black gloves, thick-soled white lace-up combat boots, and black suspenders with gold chains and dangling practical ropes. Her boots occupy the central foreground above the rocks, one knee raised high, her right arm extended towards the viewer with gloved fingers spread, and her other arm extending backward. Surrounding her are spectacular effects of exploding translucent crystals and glass shards, comprising three groups of fragments: a large, multifaceted crystal panel behind her in the upper right, dozens of medium-sized fragments radiating and floating around her body, and shimmering tiny fragments and dust surrounding her legs and boots. Bright, cool tones are used, including white, silver, light gray, transparent blue highlights, black strap accents, and subtle gold hardware details. The lighting effects employ a high-key cinematic style, featuring strong backlighting, contour lighting through the hair, shimmering mirror reflections on each fragment, and a clean, light gray-white background. The ultra-detailed anime rendering combines crisp lines with a painterly realism, creating a dynamic feel with elements like wind-blown hair, fabric wrinkles, worn boot sole textures, shallow depth of field, shimmering grain, and no text, watermarks, or extra characters.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张戏剧性的竖版动漫风格动作插画，画面中 {argument name="character name" default="一位优雅的白发女冒险家"} 正从崎岖的黑色岩石壁架上向下迈步，朝向观众走来，采用极端的低角度虫眼视角和广角镜头。她拥有一头极长的飘逸 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色"} 秀发，被强风吹向左侧，皮肤白皙，姿态自信，如同时尚模特或动作英雄；模糊或简化面部特征，使面部不成为焦点。服装：未来感白色探险/战术服，包含 6 个清晰可见的服装元素：白色修身短款上衣、白色超大款机能夹克、宽松白色工装裤、黑色手套、厚底白色系带战斗靴，以及带有金链和悬垂实用绳索的黑色背带。她前方的靴子占据了岩石上方的中心前景，一只膝盖高高抬起，右臂向观众伸出，戴着手套的手指张开，另一只手臂向后延伸。周围环绕着壮观的半透明水晶和玻璃碎片爆炸效果，包含 3 组碎片：右上方她身后的大块多面水晶板，身体周围辐射状漂浮的数十块中型碎片，以及环绕腿部和靴子的闪烁细小碎片和粉尘。使用明亮的冰冷色调，包括白色、银色、浅灰色、透明蓝色高光、黑色绑带点缀以及细小的金色五金细节。光效应采用高调电影感，具有强烈的背光、穿过发丝的轮廓光、每个碎片上闪烁的镜面反射，以及干净的浅灰白色背景。超精细动漫渲染，清晰的线条与绘画般的写实感相结合，动态感十足，风吹发丝，布料褶皱，磨损的靴底纹理，浅景深，闪烁的颗粒，无文字，无水印，无额外角色。

templates.title: Apartment standing posture change

titleLocalized.zh: 公寓站姿转换

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, regenerate a realistic portrait-style mobile phone photo of the same person and clothing, but with altered scene and pose. Have her stand in a nighttime indoor casual apartment room, instead of sitting in a gaming chair. Keep the white ribbed vest and dark blue athletic shorts with white trim and drawstring, and retain the face anonymization. Have her pose with one hand raised to her face in a peace sign gesture, the other arm hanging naturally; crop the image from her head to her upper thighs. Replace the gaming desk background with a more lived-in bedroom/apartment interior: beige walls, the edge of a door frame on the left, light-colored wooden floors, a gray carpet, a bed or soft clutter in the lower right corner, a dark beanbag chair/sofas, and a window with curtains offering a view of the city night. Use natural indoor lighting to create a realistic mobile phone shooting perspective, with a slight candid feel, and avoid using neon gaming lighting effects or bookshelf decorations.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图像，重新生成同一人物和服装的真实感竖屏手机照片，但需更改场景和姿势。让她站在夜间室内休闲公寓房间中，而不是坐在电竞椅上。保留白色罗纹背心以及带有白色饰边和抽绳的深蓝色运动短裤，并保留面部匿名化遮挡。让她摆出单手举在脸旁比剪刀手的姿势，另一只手臂自然下垂；画面从头部裁剪至大腿上部。将电竞桌背景替换为充满生活气息的卧室/公寓内部：米色墙壁、左侧门框边缘、浅色木地板、灰色地毯、右下角的床或柔软杂物、深色懒人沙发/椅子，以及带有窗帘并透出城市夜景的窗户。使用自然的室内光线，呈现真实的手机拍摄视角，营造轻微的抓拍感，并避免使用霓虹灯电竞光效或书架装饰。

templates.title: Retro-futuristic home fan robot

titleLocalized.zh: 复古未来主义家庭风扇机器人

templates.prompt: Create a heartwarming, retro-futuristic vaporwave animation advertisement style illustration, with the main character being {argument name="robot name" default="My Robo Soyokun"} A cute robot fan sits with its family in a nostalgic Japanese living room on a sunny summer afternoon. The image is a 4:5 vertical composition, employing delicate hand-drawn lines in the style of 1980s animation/Ghibli, complemented by soft watercolor shadows, golden sunlight, slightly faded film colors, and cozy clutter. At the center of the image is a small, cream-colored robot with a large round head, two round, glowing orange eyes, a small smiling mouth, blush, slender jointed arms, a rounded base, and a fan-shaped structure unfolding behind it, suggesting it is sending out a cool breeze. Around it, four family members sit at a low wooden table on the tatami mat: on the left is an adult man in a white sleeveless vest, next to him is a little boy in a blue and white striped shirt; to the robot's right is a toddler in a light-colored sleeveless outfit; and on the far right is an adult woman in a light-colored floral summer dress. Each person's face is obscured by four solid brown squares, but their hair, body, clothing, and poses remain visible. In the foreground, eight different table items are displayed: half a large watermelon on a central plate, three glasses of iced tea, a small black bowl, a patterned small cup or bowl, a bowl of yellow food, and a small saucer next to the watermelon. The room should have tatami mats, a low wooden table, red and orange checkered curtains on either side, a wide sliding balcony door with four high panes and a central pull cord, and a bright city apartment skyline with a pale blue sky dotted with fluffy clouds. Add vintage appliances and decorations: a black stereo or radio on a shelf on the left, a retro orange-red CRT television on the right with speakers stacked below, and small toys, posters, or ornaments with Japanese graffiti on the walls, as well as summer miscellaneous items.{argument name="color palette" default="Sunlight in amber hues, faded blue skies, cream-colored robots, red-orange curtains, warm wood tones"} The design aims to create a nostalgic, wholesome, and slightly surreal atmosphere, as if advertising a friendly robotic appliance to every household. Modern equipment, photorealistic designs, legible English characters, logos, or watermarks are prohibited.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅温馨的复古未来蒸汽波动画广告风格插画，主角是 {argument name="robot name" default="My Robo Soyokun"}，一个可爱的家用风扇机器人，正坐在夏日午后阳光明媚的怀旧日本客厅里与家人在一起。画面为 4:5 竖构图，采用 1980 年代动画 / 吉卜力风格的细腻手绘线条，配以柔和的水彩阴影、金色阳光、略显褪色的胶片色彩以及温馨的杂物。画面中心是一个奶油色的小机器人，拥有一个大圆头、两只橙色圆形发光眼睛、一个小小的微笑嘴巴、腮红、细长的关节手臂、圆润的底座身体，以及背后展开的扇形结构，暗示它正送出阵阵凉风。在它周围，四名家庭成员坐在榻榻米上的矮木桌旁：左侧是一名身穿白色无袖背心的成年男子，他旁边是一名身穿蓝白条纹衬衫的小男孩，机器人右侧是一名身穿浅色无袖服装的幼童，最右侧是一名身穿浅色碎花夏装的成年女子。用纯中棕色方块遮住每个人的脸部（共四个方块），但保留头发、身体、服装和姿势可见。在前景中，展示八种不同的桌上物品：中心盘子里的一半大西瓜、三杯冰茶、一个黑色小碗、一个带图案的小杯子或碗、一碗黄色食物以及西瓜旁的一个小碟子。房间应铺设榻榻米，配有矮木桌，两侧挂着红橙色格子窗帘，有一个带有四扇高窗格的宽大推拉式阳台门，中央垂着一根拉绳，窗外是明亮的城市公寓天际线，天空呈现淡蓝色，飘着蓬松的云朵。添加复古家电和装饰：左侧架子上放着一台黑色音响或收音机，右侧是一台橙红色复古 CRT 电视，下方堆叠着扬声器，墙上挂着小玩具、海报或带有日式涂鸦的挂饰，以及夏日的杂物。使用 {argument name="color palette" default="阳光琥珀色、褪色的青色天空、奶油色机器人、红橙色窗帘、温暖的木质色调"}；营造出一种怀旧、健康且略带超现实的氛围，仿佛在为每个家庭宣传一款友好的机器人电器。禁止出现现代设备、照片级真实感、可读的英文字符、标志或水印。

templates.title: Nighttime snapshots with disposable film cameras

titleLocalized.zh: 一次性胶片相机夜间抓拍

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the primary source, the photo was transformed into a raw, nighttime disposable film shot, preserving the subject's features, the cyan shirt, and the obscured/blurred facial areas. The background was changed from a conference stage to a dimly lit outdoor/nightlife scene, employing a tilted composition, strong direct flash, overexposed highlights, deep shadows, visible film grain, imperfect focus, slight motion blur, and unpredictable exposure. The subject was recomposed to the right, off-center, zoomed in, and randomly cropped, with a partially visible, overexposed blonde added to the left foreground. The background features a dark environment with a small, glowing blue square sign resembling a shirt logo, and subtle blurry colored street or party lights. The result is an image with a casual, natural, raw, and authentic feel, like a photograph taken at night with a disposable film camera.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 作为主体来源，将照片转换为原始的夜间一次性胶片抓拍效果，同时保留人物特征、青色衬衫以及被遮挡/模糊的面部区域。将背景从会议舞台更改为昏暗的户外/夜生活场景，采用倾斜构图、强烈的直射闪光、过曝的高光、深邃的阴影、可见的胶片颗粒、不完美的对焦、轻微的动态模糊以及不可预测的曝光。将主体重新构图至右侧偏离中心的位置，拉近并进行随意的裁剪，并在左侧前景加入一个部分可见、过曝的金发人物。背景包含一个暗色环境，带有一个类似于衬衫标志的小型发光蓝色方形招牌，以及少量模糊的彩色街道或派对灯光。使图像呈现出随性、自然、原始且真实的质感，如同在夜晚使用一次性胶片相机拍摄的照片。

templates.title: AI sawing through Enterprise developer branch

titleLocalized.zh: AI 锯断 Enterprise 开发者分支

templates.prompt: Create a single-panel political cartoon-style meme illustration on a 4:3 square canvas. The left side shows a large, robust tree with a rough brown trunk and green leaves at the top, against a bright blue sky and a few soft white clouds. A thick horizontal branch extends from the trunk to the right. On the trunk, place bold white meme text with a black outline, containing the following text:{argument name="trunk label" default="Enterprise"} Place bold white meme text with a black outline on the tree branch, the content of which is:{argument name="branch label" default="Developers"} Sitting on a branch near the trunk was a casually dressed adult man, representing {argument name="shirt label" default="AI"} He wears a dark navy blue sweater with a prominent white "AI" logo on the chest, over a white shirt, dark jeans, and brown shoes. His face should be deliberately obscured with a simple rectangular skin-tone blur, similar to an anonymous meme editor. He holds a downward-sloping handsaw, sawing off a branch between himself and a tree trunk, with small wood chips and sawdust falling below the cut. The action should be clear: he is sitting on the branch he is sawing, one hand holding the saw, the other supporting himself on the branch. Use a clean, brightly colored, hand-drawn editorial cartoon style, high-contrast outlines, easy-to-read typography, humorous meme composition, no additional title, and no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅单格政治漫画风格的模因插图，采用 4:3 的方形画布。左侧展示一棵粗壮的大树，树干呈粗糙的棕色，顶部有绿叶，背景是明亮的蓝天和几朵柔和的白云。一根粗壮的水平树枝从树干向右延伸。在树干上，放置带有黑色描边的加粗白色模因文本，内容为 {argument name="trunk label" default="Enterprise"}。在树枝上，放置带有黑色描边的加粗白色模因文本，内容为 {argument name="branch label" default="Developers"}。坐在树枝靠近树干处的是一名穿着休闲的成年男子，代表 {argument name="shirt label" default="AI"}，他身穿深海军蓝毛衣，胸前有醒目的白色“AI”字样，内搭白色衬衫，下身穿深色牛仔裤，脚蹬棕色鞋子。他的脸部应刻意用一个简单的矩形肤色模糊块遮挡，类似于匿名化的模因编辑。他手持一把向下倾斜的手锯，正在锯断树干与他自己之间的树枝，切口下方有细小的木屑和锯末掉落。动作要清晰：他坐在自己正在锯断的树枝上，一只手握锯，另一只手支撑在树枝上。采用干净、色彩鲜艳的手绘社论漫画风格，高对比度轮廓，易读的排版，幽默的模因构图，无需额外标题，无水印。

templates.title: Gothic Clown Duelist

titleLocalized.zh: 哥特小丑决斗者

templates.prompt: Create a dark gothic anime fantasy portrait depicting a mysterious clown-headed swordsman walking forward in the candlelit hall of a Victorian theater. The character is {argument name="character type" default="A tall, elegant male clown duelist"} The whole body is in the center, dressed in gorgeous clothes{argument name="outfit color" default="black"} The tuxedo suit features gold embroidery, military-style frog buttons, slim-fitting trousers, white gloves, a light-colored neckerchief, a layered waistcoat, chains, and a red-lined, split tail. His face is concealed by a smooth, featureless square grey mask or a blank veil, with two large, shiny, horn-like clown appendages extending from either side of his head, curving outwards and upwards like long black hair or polished tentacles, each end adorned with a small gold bell; ensure both large, curved head appendages and two visible bells are included. He holds a slender rapier in each hand, the tips pointing downwards towards the lower corner of the image. The setting is a dimly lit theater ballroom with deep burgundy curtains, tall arched windows, black candlesticks, and a checkerboard floor. The image includes numerous floating playing cards swirling around him, clearly visible in the foreground and background, interspersed with clusters of candlelight: a multi-headed candlestick in the left foreground, another in the right foreground, and tall side candlesticks in the darkness. The lighting atmosphere is somber, high-contrast, and cinematic, featuring cool blue shadows, warm candlelight highlights, glossy reflections on suits and angular accessories, a light atmospheric haze, dramatic rim lighting, and exquisitely luxurious details. Style:{argument name="art style" default="High-detail dark anime illustrations, using semi-realistic fantasy rendering."} Vertical composition, symmetrical and dramatic, elegant yet dangerous, no visible text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张暗黑哥特动漫奇幻肖像，描绘一位神秘的小丑头剑客在烛光摇曳的维多利亚剧院大厅中向前走去。角色为 {argument name="character type" default="一位高大优雅的男性小丑决斗者"}，全身居中，身穿华丽的 {argument name="outfit color" default="黑色"} 燕尾服套装，配有金色刺绣、军装风格的盘扣、修身长裤、白手套、浅色领巾、叠层马甲、链条以及红色内衬的开叉燕尾。他的脸被一张光滑无特征的方形灰色面具或空白的遮挡面部所隐藏，头部两侧长出两个巨大的光亮角状小丑附属物，像长长的黑发或抛光的触手一样向外向上弯曲，每个末端附近都挂着一个小金铃；请确保包含 2 个巨大的弯曲头部附属物和 2 个可见的铃铛。他双手各持一把细长的西洋剑，剑尖向下指向画面下角。环境是一个昏暗的剧院舞厅，配有深酒红色的窗帘、高大的拱形窗户、黑色烛台和棋盘格地板。画面中包含许多漂浮的扑克牌在他周围旋转，前景和背景中有清晰可见的扑克牌，并加入烛光簇：左前景有一个多头烛台，右前景有一个多头烛台，黑暗中还有高大的侧边烛台。灯光氛围阴郁、高对比度、电影感，带有冷蓝色阴影、温暖的烛光高光、套装和角状附属物上的光泽反射、浅层大气雾霾、戏剧性的轮廓光以及精致华丽的细节。风格：{argument name="art style" default="高细节暗黑动漫插画，采用半写实奇幻渲染"}，竖构图，对称且具有戏剧性，优雅而危险，无可见文字，无水印。

templates.title: Gothic Clown Assassin

titleLocalized.zh: 哥特式小丑刺客

templates.prompt: Create a full-body portrait in a dark gothic fantasy style, depicting an elegant clown assassin in a ruined palace. The central figure is a tall, slender humanoid creature with a deliberately shadowed, faceless face, wearing a striking horned clown hat with six curved points: three black and three crimson, each tipped with a small metal bell or spike. The character is dressed in a luxurious black Victorian tailcoat and fitted tuxedo, over which is a white dress shirt, a black bow tie, and multiple waistcoats, complete with belts, chains, brooches, gloves, and gleaming black boots. The coat has a long, tattered, slit hem, lined with crimson and decorated at the ends. The character stands confidently in the center, walking forward, holding a slender rapier in each hand, the tips pointing downwards. Create a somber, dramatic atmosphere. The background is the interior of a grand yet dilapidated palace or cathedral, with a soaring staircase behind the characters. The floor is a black and white checkerboard pattern of reflective marble, scattered with rose petals and fragments. Five clearly visible playing cards float or are scattered throughout the scene. Add softly glowing candles and candlesticks on both sides, tattered red curtains, ornate banners with clown/funny motifs, dark skull-like decorations, and a faint floating dust or mist. The lighting should have a cinematic quality, using a low-key, high-contrast approach. Cold moonlight shines down from above, complemented by warm candlelight highlights. The floor is damp and reflective, with deep shadows. The overall color scheme is desaturated black, charcoal gray, silver, and blood red. Style: Ultra-refined dark fantasy concept art, inspired by animation but with realistic rendering, sharp clothing details, vertical and dramatic composition, no text, no watermark. Optional customization: Name the clown assassin {argument name="character name" default="Jesterheads"} ,use{argument name="accent color" default="Dark red"} As an accent color, set the environment to{argument name="setting" default="Ruins of the Royal Palace"} to give the face{argument name="face treatment" default="Faceless state shrouded in shadow"} and use{argument name="weapon type" default="Two slender Western swords"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张暗黑哥特奇幻风格的全身肖像，描绘一位在废墟皇宫中的优雅小丑刺客。中心人物是一个高挑、纤细的人形生物，脸部刻意处理为阴影笼罩的无面状态，头戴一顶引人注目的带角小丑帽，帽子共有 6 个弯曲的尖角：3 个黑色尖角和 3 个深红色尖角，每个尖角末端都缀有一个小型金属铃铛或尖刺。角色身着奢华的黑色维多利亚式燕尾服和修身礼服，内搭白色礼服衬衫、黑色领结、多层马甲，配有皮带、链条、胸针、手套和擦得锃亮的黑色长靴。外套有长而破烂的开叉下摆，内衬为深红色，末端挂有装饰物。角色自信地站在中心向前行走，双手各持一把细长的西洋剑，剑尖向下指向地面。营造一种阴森的戏剧性氛围，背景为宏伟且破败的宫殿或大教堂内部，人物身后有高耸的楼梯，地面为黑白相间的反光大理石棋盘格，散落着玫瑰花瓣、碎片，场景中漂浮或散落着 5 张清晰可见的扑克牌。在两侧添加柔和发光的蜡烛和烛台、破烂的红色窗帘、带有小丑/丑角图案的华丽横幅、类似骷髅的暗黑装饰，以及淡淡的漂浮尘埃或薄雾。光影应具备电影质感，采用低调、高对比度处理，上方投射下冷冽的月光，并辅以温暖的烛光高光，地面湿润且具有光泽反射，阴影深邃，整体色调为去饱和的黑色、炭灰色、银色和血红色。风格：超精细暗黑奇幻概念艺术，受动画启发但具备写实渲染，服装细节锐利，构图垂直且富有戏剧性，无文字，无水印。可选自定义：将小丑刺客命名为 {argument name="character name" default="Jesterheads"}，使用 {argument name="accent color" default="深红色"} 作为点缀色，将环境设置为 {argument name="setting" default="废墟皇宫"}，为面部赋予 {argument name="face treatment" default="阴影笼罩的无面状态"}，并使用 {argument name="weapon type" default="两把细长的西洋剑"}。
