templates.title: Overlapping SaaS feature cards

titleLocalized.zh: 重叠式 SaaS 功能卡片

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a clean landing page homepage visual showcasing three overlapping white SaaS feature cards for a sales intelligence/lead monitoring product, using a sophisticated minimalist Figma-style mockup. Canvas: 1:1 square composition, warm beige white background with a very soft beige gradient and subtle vignetting, and realistic soft shadows below the cards. The cards are rounded rectangles with a slight perspective tilt and depth, floating in the center. The main heading uses an elegant serif font, while the smaller labels use a sans-serif font. Layout: Arrange three vertical cards, horizontally overlapping. The left card is at the forefront, slightly tilted to the left; the middle card is centered and almost vertical; the right card is at the back, slightly tilted to the right. Maintain ample white space and rounded corners. Card 1 (left) — Capture Source: A small orange circular icon with an abstract white marker is placed in the upper left corner. A light peach capsule label with the text "CAPTURA" is placed near the top center. Portuguese main heading:{argument name="left card headline" default="12+ fontes escutando seu mercado 24h"} Below are 12 small, rounded source tiles arranged in 3 columns and 4 rows. Each tile contains an icon and a label. The 12 labels are: “Notícias”, “LinkedIn”, “Reddit”, “Google”, “Podcasts”, “X (Twitter)”, “YouTube”, “Trustpilot”, “Blogs”, “Wikipédia”, “Comunidades”, and “e mais”. Use easily recognizable simplified icons: Earth, LinkedIn logo, Reddit alien, Google G, podcast symbol, X logo, YouTube play button, green trust star, document/blog icon, W, community dot matrix, and plus sign. Card 2 (middle) — Matching Rating: Place a light green capsule label with the text “ENTENDE”. Main title text:{argument name="match headline" default="ICP Match 94%"} A bright orange, thick circular progress bar is placed in the center, indicating that the project is nearing completion; the remaining portion is light peach. Inside the circle, large serif font displays "...".{argument name="match percentage" default="94%"} Below this is a small subtitle, "de compatibilidade" (compare your work). Below the circle are three lines of thin, rounded checklists with small green checkmarks, labeled: "Perfil ideal identificado" (Identify your work), "Sinais alinhados" (Identify your work), "Alta intenção detectada" (Detect your work). Card 3 (right) – Action Schedule: A dark green capsule label is placed with the text "AGE". The main Portuguese title reads:{argument name="right card headline" default="Reunião agendada automaticamente"} Below is a compact calendar widget titled "Maio 2025" with Portuguese weekday labels: "SEG", "TER", "QUA", "QUI", "SEX", "SÁB", "DOM". A monthly date grid is displayed, with the 15th highlighted in an orange circle. Left and right arrows are added near the calendar title. At the bottom is a confirmation block with an orange calendar icon, the text "Reunião confirmada", "15 de maio, 10:00", and a green dot followed by "Google Meet". Visual Style: High-end SaaS landing page aesthetics, soft 3D paper cards, off-white surface, thin light gray dividing lines, soft green and orange accents, subtle shadows, clean vector UI icons, exquisite typography, and a realistic and clean product mockup. Limitations: Uses 3 cards; the left card contains 12 source tiles, and the middle card contains 3. The checklist is displayed, with a calendar widget on the right-hand card. All text is kept legible, excluding people, additional logos except for the specified source icon, watermarks, and browser borders.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个简洁的落地页首屏视觉效果，展示三张重叠的白色 SaaS 功能卡片，用于销售情报/线索监控产品，采用高级简约的 Figma 风格模型。

画布：1:1 正方形构图，暖米白色背景，带有非常柔和的米色渐变和微妙的晕影，卡片下方有逼真的柔和阴影。卡片为圆角长方形，带有轻微的透视倾斜感和深度，悬浮在中心。大标题使用优雅的衬线字体，小标签使用无衬线字体。

布局：排列 3 张垂直卡片，水平重叠。左侧卡片位于最前方，略微向左倾斜；中间卡片居中且几乎垂直；右侧卡片位于后方，略微向右倾斜。保持充足的留白和圆角设计。

卡片 1（左侧）— 捕获来源：左上角放置一个带有抽象白色标记的橙色圆形小图标。顶部中心附近放置一个淡桃色胶囊标签，文字为“CAPTURA”。葡萄牙语大标题：“{argument name="left card headline" default="12+ fontes escutando seu mercado 24h"}”。下方展示 12 个小型圆角来源磁贴，呈 3 列 4 行排列，每个磁贴包含图标和标签。12 个标签分别为：“Notícias”、“LinkedIn”、“Reddit”、“Google”、“Podcasts”、“X (Twitter)”、“YouTube”、“Trustpilot”、“Blogs”、“Wikipédia”、“Comunidades”以及“e mais”。使用易于识别的简化图标：地球、LinkedIn logo、Reddit 外星人、Google G、播客符号、X logo、YouTube 播放按钮、绿色信任星、文档/博客图标、W、社区点阵以及加号。

卡片 2（中间）— 匹配评分：放置一个淡绿色胶囊标签，文字为“ENTENDE”。主标题文本：“{argument name="match headline" default="ICP Match 94%"}”。中心放置一个亮橙色的粗圆环进度条，进度接近完成，剩余部分为淡桃色。圆环内以大号衬线字体显示“{argument name="match percentage" default="94%"}”，下方配有微小的副标题“de compatibilidade”。圆环下方放置 3 行细圆角检查清单，带有绿色小勾选图标，标签为：“Perfil ideal identificado”、“Sinais alinhados”、“Alta intenção detectada”。

卡片 3（右侧）— 行动排程：放置一个深绿色胶囊标签，文字为“AGE”。葡萄牙语大标题：“{argument name="right card headline" default="Reunião agendada automaticamente"}”。下方包含一个紧凑的日历小组件，标题为“Maio 2025”，并带有葡萄牙语星期标签：“SEG”、“TER”、“QUA”、“QUI”、“SEX”、“SÁB”、“DOM”。显示月度日期网格，其中 15 日用橙色圆圈高亮显示。日历标题附近添加左右箭头。底部包含一个确认区块，带有橙色日历图标，文字为“Reunião confirmada”、“15 de maio, 10:00”，以及一个绿色圆点，后跟“Google Meet”。

视觉风格：高端 SaaS 落地页美学，柔和的 3D 纸质卡片，米白色表面，细浅灰色分割线，柔和的绿色和橙色点缀色，微妙的阴影，清晰的矢量 UI 图标，精致的排版，逼真且整洁的产品模型。

限制：使用 3 张卡片，左侧卡片包含 12 个来源磁贴，中间卡片包含 3 行检查清单，右侧卡片包含一个日历小组件。保持所有文字清晰可读，不包含人物，除指定的来源图标外不包含额外 logo，无水印，无浏览器边框。

templates.title: Anime Subway Black Fashion

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫地铁黑色时尚

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic, vertical, anime-style fashion illustration depicting an elegant adult woman standing on a subway platform at night, her face blurred by a soft gray rectangle to maintain anonymity. She possesses {argument name="hair color" default="Glossy black wavy short hair with warm brown highlights"} Wearing{argument name="outfit" default="A fitted ivory white pleated midi skirt, an open light beige trench coat, a light-colored wide-brimmed hat, black gloves, pearl earrings, and an exquisite necklace."} In her right hand, she carries a structured black handbag adorned with a small gold chain. To the left of the scene, a train is either pulling into or passing through the station, its engine featuring two bright, round headlights and illuminated destination signage. To the right, in the background, are two commuters: one a partially cropped figure in a suit in the foreground, the other a smaller figure in the distance. Above are two illuminated signs, topped by a large, truncated red neon sign with the text:{argument name="top sign text" default="A Trai"} Below is a smaller orange billboard with illegible stylized text and a circular portrait icon. The composition employs a low-angle, three-quarter view, emphasizing the woman's full silhouette and flowing trench coat. The floor tiles reflect a shimmering light, the train has a dynamic blur, and dark cables rise above. Cinematic contour lighting is used, and warm-toned station lights contrast with deep blue-black shadows. The composition features highly detailed comic book lines, exquisite digital painting quality, an urban film noir atmosphere, clearly defined clothing folds, and an elegant, high-fashion feel, all within a 9:16 aspect ratio.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张戏剧性的竖屏动漫风格时尚插画，描绘一位优雅的成年女性站在夜间的地铁站台上，她的面部被一个柔和的灰色矩形模糊处理以保持匿名。她拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="带有暖棕色挑染的亮泽黑色波浪短发"}，身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="修身的象牙白褶皱中长裙、敞开披着的浅米色风衣、浅色宽檐帽、黑色手套、珍珠耳环和精致的项链"}，右手提着一个带有小型金色链条装饰的结构感黑色手提包。场景中左侧有一列正在进站或经过的列车，车头有两个明亮的圆形前灯和发光的目的地文字；右侧背景中有两名通勤者，一人为前景中部分截取的西装人物，另一人为远处较小的人物；上方有两个发光的指示牌，顶部是一个被截断的红色大号霓虹灯牌，文字为 {argument name="top sign text" default="A Trai"}，下方是一个较小的橙色广告牌，上面印有难以辨认的艺术化文字和一个圆形肖像图标。采用低角度四分之三构图，强调女性的全身轮廓和飘逸的风衣，地面瓷砖呈现光泽倒影，列车带有动态模糊，上方有深色电缆，运用电影级轮廓光，暖色调的车站灯光与深蓝黑色的阴影形成对比，具备高度细腻的漫画线条、精致的数字绘画质感、都市黑色电影氛围、清晰的衣物褶皱、优雅的高级时尚感，比例为 9:16。

templates.title: Deep Mocha Scorpio Action Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 深摩卡天蝎座动作海报

templates.prompt: Create a highly dramatic, cinematic vertical poster featuring a young, cartoonishly realistic man with a disproportionately large head and small body, running towards the viewer amidst an explosion of deep mocha and chocolate. Space should be reserved in the facial area for identity matching: maintain alignment with {argument name="character face reference" default="Reference face provided"} The same facial structure, proportions, features, and expressions are used, while the rest of the scene is rendered in a highly detailed, fantastical advertising style. The character has slicked-back black hair, wears a black leather jacket with a deep red hooded lining, over which is a black T-shirt printed with a red scorpion logo and the word "SCORPIO," dark jeans with red accents, red and black sneakers, and a small necklace; he is posed in a running stance, one fist forward, one arm back, one knee raised, presenting a dynamic foresight and heroic dynamism. Surrounding him are swirling, glossy dark chocolate liquid, splashing water, droplets, flying coffee beans, rock fragments, glowing embers, smoke, and bronze-brown highlights. In the right foreground, a large, tilted cup is placed, filled with splashed dark mocha, with "DARK MOCHA" written in bold strokes on the cup. A large, faintly visible Scorpio constellation is added to the upper left background. Includes four clearly visible artistic handwritten text annotations: 1) "Intense & deep" in the upper right corner, with "Intense" in red and "& deep" in cream; 2) "Dark bold drink" in the middle right corner, with "Dark" in red and "bold drink" in cream; 3) "Energizes emotions" in the lower left corner, with "Energizes" in red and "emotions" in cream; 4) "DARK MOCHA" on the lower right corner of the cup, written in brown ink. A gold cursive signature is added near the lower right corner.{argument name="signature text" default="Mr Tariq"} It includes a small flower doodle. Using deep, intense, high-contrast tones, including black, espresso brown, copper, deep red, and warm cream, combined with cinematic rim lighting, sharp details, and shallow depth of field, motion blur is added only to splashes. The poster-style composition combines ultra-refined 3D realism with a stylized, cartoonish proportion. The canvas is in 3:4 portrait mode, and no additional logos, watermarks, or text are added except for the designated text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张极具戏剧性的电影感竖版海报，主角是一位 Q 版写实风格的年轻男性，拥有大头小身的比例，正朝着观众方向在深摩卡与巧克力的爆炸中奔跑。面部区域需预留位置以进行身份锁定的人像匹配：保持与 {argument name="character face reference" default="所提供的参考面部"} 相同的面部结构、比例、特征和表情，同时以高细节的奇幻广告风格渲染场景其余部分。角色留着向后梳的利落黑发，身穿带有深红色连帽内衬的黑色皮夹克，内搭印有红色蝎子标志和“SCORPIO”字样的黑色 T 恤，穿着带有红色装饰的深色牛仔裤、红黑配色运动鞋，并佩戴一条小项链；摆出奔跑姿势，一只拳头向前，一只手臂向后，单膝抬起，呈现动态的前缩透视和英雄般的动作张力。周围环绕着旋转的亮面黑巧克力液体、飞溅的水花、液滴、飞舞的咖啡豆、岩石碎片、发光的余烬、烟雾以及青铜棕色的高光。在右侧前景处，放置一个倾斜的大杯子，里面装满了飞溅的深摩卡，杯身上用粗犷的笔触写着“DARK MOCHA”。在左上角背景处添加一个巨大的、若隐若现的天蝎座星象符号。包含四个清晰可见的艺术手写体文字标注：1) 右上角的“Intense & deep”，其中“Intense”为红色，“& deep”为奶油色；2) 中右侧的“Dark bold drink”，其中“Dark”为红色，“bold drink”为奶油色；3) 左下角的“Energizes emotions”，其中“Energizes”为红色，“emotions”为奶油色；4) 右下角杯身上的“DARK MOCHA”，使用棕褐色颜料书写。在右下角附近添加一个金色的草书签名 {argument name="signature text" default="Mr Tariq"}，并附带一个小花朵涂鸦。使用深邃、强烈、高对比度的色调，包括黑色、浓缩咖啡棕、铜色、深红色和暖奶油色，配合电影级的轮廓光、锐利的细节、浅景深，仅在飞溅处添加动态模糊，采用海报式的构图，将超精细的 3D 写实感与风格化的 Q 版比例相结合。画布比例为 3:4 竖版，除指定的文字外，不添加任何额外的标志、水印或文字。

templates.title: Student gathering space renovation

titleLocalized.zh: 学生聚会空间改造

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the base for the room, create a natural and realistic photograph showcasing how the same room has become {argument name="number of students" default="3"} Bit{argument name="student description" default="20-year-old female college student"} The party venue. Please keep the room layout, furniture, curtains, bed, TV, hanging clothes, storage drawers, lighting, and shooting angles in REFERENCE_0 basically unchanged. Use REFERENCE_1 only as a source of inspiration for adding a casual, relaxed party atmosphere, but do not make the room look messy or worn out. Add 3 young women dressed in Japanese school uniform-style casual wear: white shirts, dark plaid skirts, and silk bow ties. Positioning: one sits on the left edge of the bed, holding a canned drink; one sits cross-legged in the center of the bed, holding a mobile phone; one sits in the right foreground, slightly turned towards the others, holding a canned drink. Please use simple rectangular blur blocks to anonymize their faces. Add casual party/snack items to the black low table: a total of 7 visible items—an open large snack bag, a cup noodle container, a paper plate, a canned drink, a small package of snacks, a blue tissue box/snack box, and the existing remote control/earphone-like gadgets. The scene should depict friends chatting and eating snacks after school, using a mobile phone snapshot style, maintaining realistic indoor lighting, without exaggerated poses, adding any text overlays, or including other people.

promptLocalized.zh:
以 REFERENCE_0 为房间基础，创作一张自然、逼真的照片，展示同一房间已成为 {argument name="number of students" default="3"} 位 {argument name="student description" default="20 岁女大学生"} 的聚会场所。请保持 REFERENCE_0 中的房间布局、家具、窗帘、床、电视、悬挂衣物、储物抽屉、灯光及拍摄角度基本不变。仅将 REFERENCE_1 作为添加生活化、休闲聚会氛围的灵感来源，但切勿使房间显得脏乱或破旧。

添加 3 位身着日式校服风格休闲装的年轻女性：白色衬衫、深色格子裙和丝带领结。位置安排：一人坐在床的左侧边缘，手持罐装饮料；一人在床中央盘腿而坐，手持手机；一人坐在右侧前景，身体微侧向其他人，手持罐装饮料。请使用简单的矩形模糊块对她们的面部进行匿名化处理。

在黑色矮桌上添加休闲聚会/零食物品：共 7 件可见物品——一个打开的大零食袋、一个杯面容器、一个纸盘、一罐饮料、一个小包装零食、一个蓝色纸巾盒/零食盒，以及现有的遥控器/耳塞式小物件。场景应呈现出朋友们放学后聊天吃零食的氛围，采用手机抓拍风格，保持真实的室内光线，无需夸张的造型，不要添加任何文字覆盖，也不要出现其他人物。

templates.title: Student party in a messy room

titleLocalized.zh: 凌乱房间里的学生聚会

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_1 as the main subject of the room, and REFERENCE_0 as a realistic reference for a typical residential apartment, the room is transformed into a natural candid photograph. The scene is {argument name="group description" default="Three 20-year-old female college students are having a party"} Retain the original layout of the cramped room: dark curtains, air conditioning, stained beige walls, a low table, a bed/bedding area, a TV cabinet, a microwave area, scattered trash, drinks, and a generally messy, lived-in feel. Add three young women to the scene: one sitting in the foreground on the right, holding a canned drink; one sitting at the low table, opening or holding snacks; and another casually sitting on the bed in the background on the right, holding a phone. Have them wear casual Japanese school uniform-style clothing: white shirts, dark bow ties, and plaid skirts. The photo should have a completely unstaged, authentic feel, like a snapshot taken with a smartphone at a small party, with warm, dim indoor lighting and natural shadows. For privacy, faces should be anonymized/blurred or left blurred. Do not clean the room, do not make it look fashionable, and do not drastically change the shooting angle. Emphasize that this is the same room that was uploaded and now looks like {argument name="scenario" default="The gathering place of three 20-year-old female college students"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_1 作为房间主体，仅将 REFERENCE_0 作为普通生活化公寓的写实参考，将房间转换为一张自然的抓拍照片，场景为 {argument name="group description" default="三名 20 岁女大学生正在聚会"}。保留原有的狭窄房间布局、深色窗帘、空调、有污渍的米色墙壁、矮桌、床铺/被褥区、电视柜、微波炉区域、散落的垃圾、饮料以及凌乱的生活气息。在场景中加入 3 名年轻女性：一名坐在右前方前景处手持罐装饮料，一名坐在矮桌旁正在拆开或拿着零食，另一名随意坐在右后方的床铺上拿着手机。让她们穿着休闲的日式校服风格服装：白衬衫、深色领结和格子裙。照片要呈现出完全未经摆拍的真实感，就像在小型聚会中用智能手机拍摄的快照，带有温暖昏暗的室内光线和自然阴影。出于隐私考虑，面部应进行匿名化/模糊处理或保持模糊。不要清理房间，不要使其显得时尚，也不要大幅改变拍摄角度。强调这就是上传的同一个房间，现在看起来像是 {argument name="scenario" default="三名 20 岁女大学生的聚会场所"}。

templates.title: Portrait of a man with a gorilla in the jungle in the rain

titleLocalized.zh: 雨中丛林男子与大猩猩肖像

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic, hyper-realistic vertical portrait, with the subject being {argument name="character description" default="A muscular, shirtless man with wet, slicked-back black hair and a neatly trimmed beard had his face deliberately obscured by a flat, opaque brown rectangular visor."} ,and{argument name="animal companion" default="A huge silverback gorilla, with wet black fur, is facing right, its mouth covered by a small, dark, blurry patch."} They stand back to back. The man is on the left, in a three-quarter profile, the shot cropped from above his hips, highlighting his chest, shoulders, abs, and arms, glistening with raindrops; he wears dark, low-rise trousers, his posture serious and powerful. The gorilla is on the right, taller and broader, its shoulders and head pressed close to the man's back, details showing its wet fur, visible ears, brow bone, nostrils, and deep-set eyes. The scene is set in a dense jungle valley during a downpour, with misty green mountains in the background, and a dramatic, cloudy sky with warm sunlight filtering through in the upper right corner.{argument name="lighting style" default="Melancholy Golden Hour Backlighting and Cool-toned Storm Shadows"} High contrast, shallow depth of field, realistic skin texture, glossy water droplet highlights, atmospheric haze, and a rugged adventure movie poster style. The composition should be 3:4 vertical, with the main subject occupying most of the frame, and no text, logos, or additional figures or animals.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影级超写实竖构图肖像，主体为 {argument name="character description" default="一名肌肉发达、赤裸上身的男子，留着湿漉漉的黑色背头和修剪整齐的胡须，面部被一块平坦的不透明棕色矩形遮挡块刻意遮住"}，与 {argument name="animal companion" default="一只巨大的银背大猩猩，有着湿润的黑色皮毛，侧面朝右，嘴部覆盖着一小块深色模糊遮挡块"} 背靠背站立。男子位于左侧，呈四分之三侧身姿势，画面从臀部上方截取，胸部、肩部、腹肌和手臂线条分明，布满雨滴；他穿着深色低腰长裤，姿态严肃有力。大猩猩位于右侧，体型更高大宽阔，肩部和头部紧贴男子身后，细节展现了湿润的皮毛、可见的耳朵、眉骨、鼻孔和深邃的眼睛。场景设定在暴雨中的茂密丛林山谷，背景是雾气缭绕的青山，戏剧性的多云天空在右上角透出温暖的阳光。使用 {argument name="lighting style" default="忧郁的黄金时刻逆光与冷色调风暴阴影"}，高对比度，浅景深，写实皮肤质感，光泽水滴高光，大气朦胧感，以及粗犷的冒险电影海报风格。构图应为 3:4 竖版，主体占据大部分画面，无文字，无 Logo，无额外人物或动物。

templates.title: Cliff predator chase in a blizzard

titleLocalized.zh: 暴风雪中的悬崖捕食者追逐

templates.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic, cinematic vertical action photograph, with a person as the main subject.{argument name="subject" default="Muscular man with bare upper body"} Climbing a rugged icy cliff against a backdrop of a fierce blizzard. Shot from a dramatic wide-angle perspective, as if the camera were mounted close to the climbing ropes. The man, positioned in the lower foreground, leans upwards, displaying a strong will to survive; one hand grips a thick rope extending towards the viewer, the other holds a worn ice axe. He wears only tattered dark gray jeans, torn at the knees; his bare torso is muscular, covered in dirt, scratches, and water stains, and blanketed with snow and frost. Above and behind him, a massive {argument name="predator" default="snow leopard"} The animal is swooping down from a cliff face, in an attack stance, mouth agape and roaring, its blue-grey eyes fixed on the climber. One forepaw is outstretched, its sharp claws clearly visible. The scene is set in a steep Himalayan-style canyon, with a backdrop of dark rock walls, snow-covered ridges, icy fog, powder snow drifting in the wind, and dense, slanting snowfall. It uses cool blue-grey tones, high contrast, a rough texture, realistic fur details, frozen skin texture, motion blur of snowflakes, and dramatic cinematic lighting effects. The composition maintains tension and dynamism: the climber occupies the lower left/center foreground, the rope creates a strong sense of depth extending to the lower right, while the attacking animal occupies the upper right background. There is no text, watermark, or additional figures in the image; apart from the rope and ice axe, there is no modern mountaineering equipment.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超写实的电影级垂直动作照片，画面主体为一名 {argument name="subject" default="赤裸上身的肌肉男"} 正在崎岖的冰山悬崖上攀爬，背景是一场猛烈的暴风雪。采用戏剧性的广角视角拍摄，仿佛镜头安装在靠近攀登绳索的位置。男子位于画面下方前景，身体向上倾斜，展现出强烈的生存意志；一只手紧握着延伸向观众方向的粗绳，另一只手拿着一把破旧的冰镐。他仅穿着破烂的深灰色牛仔裤，膝盖处有撕裂；他赤裸的躯干肌肉发达，沾满污垢、划痕和水渍，并覆盖着积雪与霜冻。在他身后上方，一只巨大的 {argument name="predator" default="雪豹"} 正从崖壁飞扑而下，处于攻击状态，张开嘴咆哮，蓝灰色的眼睛紧盯着登山者，一只前爪伸出，利爪清晰可见。场景设定在陡峭的喜马拉雅风格峡谷中，背景是深色的岩壁、积雪的山脊、冰雾、随风飘散的粉雪以及密集的斜向降雪。使用冷蓝灰色调，高对比度，粗粝的质感，逼真的皮毛细节，冻僵的皮肤纹理，雪花的动态模糊，以及戏剧性的电影光效。保持构图的紧张感与动态：登山者占据左下方/中心前景，绳索创造出强烈的纵深感延伸至右下方，而攻击的动物占据右上方的背景。画面中无文字、无水印、无额外人物，除绳索和冰镐外无现代登山装备。

templates.title: Cinematic Falconer Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 电影感猎鹰人肖像

templates.prompt: Create a realistic, cinematic vertical portrait, with the subject being {argument name="character name" default="A handsome young man"} He stands in the warm, golden hour of a medieval stone castle or courtyard, his upper body facing the camera. He sports a thick, dark, combed-back hairstyle, a medium-light complexion, and refined, masculine features. He wears a dark charcoal gray double-breasted wool coat over a black scarf, resembling a modern aristocratic falconer. His right arm is raised to his chest, adorned with a worn brown leather falconry glove with leather straps and small metal rings. A falcon, its details clearly defined, perches on the glove; its chest is cream and brown-spotted, its wings have dark markings, its beak is curved, its eyes are alert, and its talons grip the glove tightly. Background: To the right are ancient, brownish-red stone archways and tower walls extending diagonally backward; to the left is a low stone railing. The open area reveals distant countryside, creating a soft, blurred depth of field. The lighting is warm sunset light from the left, accompanied by natural shadows. The style is high-end editorial fashion photography; the textures of wool, leather, feathers, and stone are realistic, with a 3:4 aspect ratio.{argument name="coat color" default="Dark charcoal gray"} ,{argument name="bird species" default="Falcon"} ,{argument name="setting" default="Medieval stone castle courtyard"} as well as{argument name="lighting" default="Golden hour sunset"} No text, no watermark, no extra animals, no fantasy armor, and not in an illustration style.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实风格的电影感竖版肖像，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="一位英俊的年轻人"}，他站在温暖的黄金时刻中世纪石堡或城堡庭院中，腰部以上面向镜头。他留着浓密的深色后梳发型，肤色中等偏浅，五官精致且充满阳刚之气，身穿深炭灰色双排扣羊毛大衣，内搭黑色围巾，造型如同现代贵族猎鹰人。他的右臂抬至胸前，戴着一只磨损的棕色皮革驯鹰手套，上面垂着皮革系带和金属小环；手套上停着 1 只猎鹰，细节清晰，胸部呈奶油色与棕色斑点，翅膀带有深色花纹，喙部弯曲，眼神警觉，利爪紧紧抓着手套。背景：右侧是向斜后方延伸的古老棕褐色石拱门和塔墙，左侧是低矮的石护栏，开阔区域可见远处的乡村，背景呈现柔和的景深虚化。光线为左侧射入的温暖日落光，伴有自然阴影，高端编辑时尚摄影风格，羊毛、皮革、羽毛和石头的质感真实，3:4 纵横比。使用 {argument name="coat color" default="深炭灰色"}、{argument name="bird species" default="猎鹰"}、{argument name="setting" default="中世纪石堡庭院"} 以及 {argument name="lighting" default="黄金时刻日落"}。无文字，无水印，无额外动物，无奇幻盔甲，非插画风格。

templates.title: Aries Spicy Coffee Runner Poster

titleLocalized.zh: Aries Spicy Coffee Runner 海报

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a vibrant, cinematic, astrology-themed fitness poster, featuring [the main character].{argument name="character name" default="Mr. Tariq"} The painting depicts him as an athlete running on a marble kitchen countertop, his face deliberately obscured by a centrally located, opaque, warm brown square occluder. Canvas: Vertical 3:4 composition, high-resolution realistic fantasy advertising style, warm-toned golden hour sunlight streaming through a large window on the right, shallow depth of field, dramatic motion blur, luminous particles, coffee splatter, and spicy red-orange accents. Subject: A medium-skinned, dark-haired adult athletic man wearing a sleeveless {argument name="shirt color" default="red"} Wearing a sports top, black running shorts, and running shoes, he's sprinting towards the audience, torso leaning forward, one fist raised, one arm back, and one knee raised. A solid rectangular privacy mask, similar in color to his medium tan skin, with sharp edges, covers his entire face, obscuring all facial details. Foreground character: A cute anthropomorphic coffee cup is running in the lower right foreground. The cup is made of speckled white ceramic, has a handle on the right, large, glossy cartoon eyes, arched eyebrows, rosy cheeks, a wide-open smile, and two small black arms and legs. Coffee is dramatically spraying from the cup, forming dark liquid arcs and droplets. Scene and props: Inside a modern kitchen or cafe, with a gleaming marble countertop. Jars and kitchen utensils are blurred in the background. A tall, sunlit window on the right casts warm reflections on the countertop. Coffee beans, coffee drips, glowing spice fragments, and red pepper chunks are scattered on the countertop. Includes four visible chili pepper elements: a large red chili pepper fluttering in the foreground at the bottom left, a whole red chili pepper lying flat on the left side of the table at the bottom center, a small red chili pepper icon next to the spicy coffee note, and a small piece of red chili pepper near the coffee splatter. Graphic overlays and text: Add hand-drawn constellation and lifestyle notes in white and orange marker style. Includes four sets of text: 1) Top left: A glowing orange Aries symbol with "Bold & Fearless" below; 2) Center left/bottom left: "Loves Strong Spicy Coffee" written in stacked white handwritten font; 3) Center right: "Boosts Energy & Confidence" written in white handwritten font; 4) Bottom right signature: "Loves Strong Spicy Coffee" written in large white cursive with orange underlines.{argument name="signature text" default="Mr. Tariq"} Includes two heart-shaped graffiti, one orange star graffiti near the top right corner, and several curved athletic lines around the runner and the cup. Style: Realistic subject combined with playful illustrative graffiti, vibrant Aries personality, bold and fearless atmosphere, spicy coffee brand feel, high-contrast warm light, rich amber highlights, frozen sparks and splashes, high-end social media poster quality. Constraints: Keep all visible text clear and in English. Do not add any additional words beyond the four specified text sets. Keep the face completely obscured by solid square blocks. No watermarks, and no other logos except for a small abstract athletic logo on the shirt.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张充满活力的电影感占星主题健身海报，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="Mr. Tariq"}，描绘他作为一名运动健将在大理石厨房台面上奔跑，其面部被一个居中的不透明暖棕色方形遮挡块刻意遮盖。

画布：垂直 3:4 构图，高分辨率写实奇幻广告风格，右侧大窗户透入暖色调黄金时刻阳光，浅景深，戏剧性的动态模糊，发光粒子，咖啡溅射，以及辛辣的红橙色点缀。

主体：一名肤色中等、留着深色短发造型的成年运动男性，身穿无袖 {argument name="shirt color" default="red"} 运动上衣、黑色跑步短裤和跑鞋。他正向观众方向全力冲刺，躯干前倾，一只拳头抬起，一只手臂向后，一只膝盖抬起。在整个面部区域放置一个实心矩形隐私遮罩，颜色与中等棕褐色皮肤相近，边缘锐利，不显示任何面部细节。

前景角色：右下角前景中有一个可爱的拟人化咖啡杯正在奔跑。杯子为带有斑点的白色陶瓷材质，右侧有把手，有着大而有光泽的卡通眼睛、拱形眉毛、红润的脸颊、张开的笑脸，以及两条黑色小手臂和两条黑色小腿。咖啡从杯中戏剧性地喷溅而出，形成深色液体弧线和水滴。

场景与道具：现代厨房或咖啡馆内部，配有光亮的大理石台面，背景中罐子和厨房用品虚化处理，右侧有高大的阳光窗户，台面上有温暖的倒影。台面上散落着咖啡豆、咖啡滴、发光的香料碎片和红辣椒块。包含 4 个可见的辣椒元素：左下角前景中飞舞的一个大红辣椒，底部中左侧台面上平放的一个完整红辣椒，辛辣咖啡注释旁的一个小红辣椒图标，以及咖啡溅射附近的一小块红辣椒。

图形叠加与文字：添加白色和橙色马克笔风格的手绘星座和生活方式注释。包含 4 组文字：1) 左上角：一个发光的橙色白羊座符号，下方写着“Bold & Fearless”；2) 左中/下方：以堆叠的白色手写字体书写的“Loves Strong Spicy Coffee”；3) 右中部：以白色手写字体书写的“Boosts Energy & Confidence”；4) 右下角签名：以带有橙色下划线的白色大号草书书写的“{argument name="signature text" default="Mr. Tariq"}”。包含 2 个心形涂鸦，右上角附近 1 个橙色星星涂鸦，以及跑者和杯子周围的几条弧形运动线条。

风格：写实主体与环境结合俏皮的插画涂鸦，充满活力的白羊座个性，大胆无畏的氛围，辛辣咖啡品牌感，高对比度暖光，丰富的琥珀色高光，定格的火花与溅射，高级社交媒体海报质感。

约束：保持所有可见文字清晰且为英文。除指定的 4 组文字外，不要添加额外词汇。保持面部被实心方形块完全遮挡。无水印，除衬衫上微小的抽象运动标志外，不得有其他 Logo。

templates.title: Man in the mouth of a giant crocodile

titleLocalized.zh: 巨型鳄鱼口中的男子

templates.prompt: Create a photographic-realistic, cinematic portrait, with the subject being {argument name="subject" default="A stylish young man"} He sits calmly in the shallow reflection of a salt flat, positioned within the gaping mouth of a giant crocodile or alligator, at the golden hour. The man is centered in the lower half of the vertical composition, his posture casual, knees bent, one hand resting on his knee, the other hanging naturally between his legs, looking serenely at the camera. He wears four clearly visible pieces of clothing: an ivory linen blazer, a white open-collar shirt, rolled-up loose ivory trousers, and clean white low-top sneakers. The reptile is enormous and richly detailed, encircling him like a living cave, with coarse, dark gray-green granular scales. A massive upper jaw hangs above its head, and the interior of its mouth is brown, clearly showing 30 conical, ivory-colored teeth: 18 in the upper jaw and 12 in the lower jaw, varying in size and irregularly spaced. The scene is set on a damp desert salt flat, with shallow water reflecting the ground, low mountains visible on the distant horizon, and a warm, yellow-orange sunset sky. Featuring dramatic low-angle natural light from the left, warm contour lighting on the man's suit and crocodile teeth, shallow depth of field, realistic skin and fabric textures, sharp details on reptile scales, cinematic color grading, 3:4 vertical composition, no text, no watermark, and non-fantasy illustration style.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张照片级真实的电影感肖像，主角为 {argument name="subject" default="一位时尚的年轻男子"}，他正冷静地坐在盐滩浅水倒影中，置身于一只巨大鳄鱼或短吻鳄张开的大嘴里，时间设定在黄金时刻。男子位于竖构图的下半部分中心，姿态随意，双膝弯曲，一只手搭在膝盖上，另一只手自然垂在两腿之间，神情从容自然地看向镜头。他穿着 4 件清晰可见的服饰：象牙白亚麻西装外套、开领白衬衫、卷边宽松象牙白长裤以及干净的白色低帮运动鞋。爬行动物体型巨大，细节丰富，像一个活的洞穴般环绕着他，拥有粗糙的深灰绿色颗粒状鳞片，巨大的上颚悬于头顶，身后的口腔内部呈棕色，清晰可见 30 颗圆锥形象牙色牙齿：上颚 18 颗，下颚 12 颗，大小各异且间距不规则。场景设定在湿润的沙漠盐滩上，有浅浅的水面反射，远处地平线可见低矮的山脉，天空呈现温暖的黄橙色日落色调。采用来自左侧的戏剧性低角度自然光，男子的西装和鳄鱼牙齿上带有温暖的轮廓光，浅景深，皮肤和织物纹理真实，爬行动物鳞片细节锐利，电影级调色，3:4 竖构图，无文字，无水印，非奇幻插画风格。

templates.title: Man sleeping on a giant smartphone

titleLocalized.zh: 睡在巨型智能手机上的男子

templates.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic, cinematic overhead photograph, with the center of the image being {argument name="character description" default="A young South Asian man with short black hair"} Lying in bed late at night, he was on a giant black smartphone, which served as his mattress. He wore a plain white T-shirt, his head resting on two beige pillows, and a thick, realistically wrinkled beige blanket covering his chest and below. He held a small, dark smartphone in his hands, as if scrolling through it before sleep. His face was deliberately blurred or anonymized with soft squares, but his hairline and ears were clearly visible. The giant phone screen beneath him emitted a deep blue light, displaying eight large social media/app icons surrounding his body: Instagram in the top left, Snapchat at the top center, TikTok in the top right, a Twitter/X-style bird icon on the left, a YouTube icon below, a green message icon in the bottom left, a partially visible blue-orange app icon near the bottom left edge, and a partially visible multicolored circular app icon on the right edge. Create a cozy creator's bedroom environment around a giant phone bed, using a top-down perspective: A wooden bedside table sits in the upper left and right corners, each topped with a warm, cylindrical bedside lamp; the left bedside table holds a small plant, a camera, a camera lens, and a notebook; the right bedside table holds a small camera lens, dark tech accessories, and cables. On the floor around the bed, the left side is carpeted and holds an open laptop, headphones, a tripod or lamp stand, a notebook, a backpack, and a camera; the right side, on the wooden floor, holds a notebook, pens, cables, a small plant, and camera equipment. The warm amber lighting interplays with the cool light of the phone screen, creating realistic shadows, a cinematic contrast with shallow depth of field, delicate fabric textures, and reflective phone glass edges, presenting a 35mm editing photography style with a 3:4 vertical composition, no text overlays, and no watermarks. Customizable phone screen lighting effects are available.{argument name="screen color mood" default="Deep blue with neon lighting effects"} The color of the blanket is{argument name="blanket color" default="warm beige"} The indoor lighting is{argument name="lighting mood" default="Warm and comfortable night lighting"} and the equipment ratio is{argument name="giant phone scale" default="A smartphone the size of a mattress"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超写实的电影感俯视照片，画面中心是 {argument name="character description" default="一名留着黑色短发的南亚裔年轻男子"} 在深夜躺在床上，他躺在一台巨大的黑色智能手机上，手机充当了床垫。他身穿一件纯白色 T 恤，头部枕在两个米色枕头上，胸部以下盖着一条厚实且带有逼真褶皱的毛绒米色毯子，双手拿着一部小巧的深色智能手机，仿佛在睡前刷手机。他的面部被刻意用柔和的方形模糊或匿名遮罩处理，但发际线和耳朵清晰可见。身下的巨型手机屏幕发出深蓝色的光，屏幕上显示着 8 个围绕在他身体周围的大型社交媒体/应用图标：左上角是 Instagram，顶部中央是 Snapchat，右上角是 TikTok，左侧是 Twitter/X 风格的鸟形图标，下方是 YouTube 图标，左下角是绿色的信息图标，左下边缘附近是一个部分可见的蓝橙色应用图标，右侧边缘是一个部分可见的多色圆形应用图标。在巨型手机床周围布置一个舒适的创作者卧室环境，采用正上方俯视视角：左上角和右上角各有一个木制床头柜，上面各有一盏温暖的圆柱形床头灯；左侧床头柜上摆放着一盆小植物、一台相机、一个相机镜头和一个笔记本；右侧床头柜上摆放着小型相机镜头、深色科技配件和线缆。床周围的地板上，左侧铺着地毯，放着一台打开的笔记本电脑、耳机、三脚架或灯架、笔记本、背包和相机；右侧木地板上放着笔记本、笔、线缆、小植物和相机装备。使用温暖的琥珀色灯光与手机屏幕的冷光交织，营造出逼真的阴影、浅景深的电影感对比、细腻的织物纹理和反光的手机玻璃边缘，呈现 35mm 编辑摄影风格，采用 3:4 竖构图，无文字覆盖，无水印。可自定义手机屏幕光效为 {argument name="screen color mood" default="带有霓虹应用光效的深蓝色"}，毯子颜色为 {argument name="blanket color" default="暖米色"}，室内灯光为 {argument name="lighting mood" default="温暖舒适的夜间照明"}，以及设备比例为 {argument name="giant phone scale" default="床垫大小的智能手机"}。

templates.title: Dark Veil Haute Couture Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑面纱高级定制人像

templates.prompt: Create a high-fashion portrait with a dark cinematic feel, showcasing a mysterious veiled figure dressed in exquisite {argument name="garment color" default="Midnight Blue and Black"} The pleated haute couture gown, with its sheen and dewy fabric, features long, flowing sleeves, and a semi-transparent veil cascading down from the head and shoulders. The figure is slightly centered to the right, showcasing the upper body, with the head and face covered by a flat, opaque sheet.{argument name="face block color" default="Dark gray"} Rectangular obscuring blocks are deliberately used to conceal. Ornate metallic beads, tiny jewels, chains, and gold highlights are added to the veil and corset to capture sparse light. An emotional, smoky effect is employed.{argument name="background color" default="Charcoal blue and black"} The studio background employs low-key lighting, deep shadows, and subtle film grain to create a dramatic contrast in a fashion photography style. The fabric should fan out to the left and right, forming sweeping, folded curves to emphasize texture, wrinkles, subtle light, and movement. The image is a wide, horizontal composition with a 16:9 aspect ratio, and contains no text, logos, or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张暗黑电影感的高级时尚大片人像，展现一个神秘的面纱人物，身着精致的 {argument name="garment color" default="午夜蓝与黑色"} 褶皱高定礼服，面料呈现光泽湿润感，配有长而飘逸的垂坠袖子，半透明的面纱从头部和肩部倾泻而下。人物略微偏右居中，展示上半身，头部和面部被一块平坦且不透明的 {argument name="face block color" default="深灰色"} 矩形审查遮挡块刻意遮盖。在面纱和紧身胸衣上添加华丽的金属珠饰、细小珠宝、链条和金色高光，捕捉稀疏的光线。使用情绪化的烟雾状 {argument name="background color" default="炭蓝黑色"} 工作室背景，采用低调照明、深邃阴影、细腻的胶片颗粒感，呈现戏剧性的明暗对比时尚摄影风格。面料应向左右两侧呈扇形展开，形成扫掠的褶皱弧线，强调质感、褶皱、微光和动感。宽幅横向构图，16:9 纵横比，无文字，无 Logo，无水印。

templates.title: Emotional cinematic quality obscuring stills

titleLocalized.zh: 情绪化电影质感遮挡剧照

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic, emotionally charged still image in a 16:9 widescreen format, depicting an elderly person sitting indoors, leaning against a tall, grimy window on their left.{argument name="subject" default="man"} The scene is very dark and atmospheric, primarily illuminated by cool blue sunlight streaming through dirty glass, with deep shadows on the right. The subject is framed in a close-up composition from the chest up, wearing a heavy-textured coat or cardigan over a dark shirt, with messy gray hair visible at the top and sides. A large, opaque, vertical rectangular occlusion is placed in the center of the subject's face, covering most of the facial features from the forehead to below the mouth; the occlusion should be dark brown-black with subtle vertical gradients, sharp edges, and no text. Jersey Details: Argentine-style white and blue striped jerseys with black stripes on the shoulders, a gold tournament badge in the center of the chest, an AFA-style crest with three stars, black or dark numbers, and subtle details of sweat, fabric texture, and realistic shading. The goalkeeper wears a dark navy/black jersey with gold accents and a matching crest. Background: A large, waving Argentine flag is positioned above the player's head, with a bright sun halo behind the player's head at the top center. Behind the players is a large, illuminated stadium bowl-shaped stand filled with tiny spectator lights, mist, blue smoke, and gold particle effects. Logo and Signage: A gold AFA-style crest with three stars is placed in the upper left corner. A gold World Cup trophy icon is placed in the upper right corner, below which is stacked text that strictly reads: "FIFA WORLD CUP 2026". At the bottom center is a small gold AFA-style team crest, a vertical divider, and an Adidas-style three-stripe logo. The text at the bottom uses a large, distressed, compressed font in a grayish-white color, and strictly reads:{argument name="headline text" default="THE WEIGHT OF GLORY."} Add a smaller, less spaced subheading below, with the content strictly stating:{argument name="subtitle text" default="DEFENDING THE CROWN IN 2026"} The text is in a mix of Chinese characters and symbols, with "DEFENDING" in sky blue and "THE CROWN IN 2026" in warm gold. Below this is the location text in small white-spaced capital letters:{argument name="host countries" default="UNITED STATES · CANADA · MEXICO"} At the very bottom, add tiny gold-spaced text:{argument name="tagline" default="THREE STARS. ONE DESTINY."} Style restrictions: The design must resemble an official, epic football movie poster, not a flat graphic. Use realistic lighting, sharp jersey details, cinematic color grading, metallic gold typography, worn texture on the title, and symmetrical team hierarchy. No additional players, text, or watermarks are permitted.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="team name" default="阿根廷国家足球队"} 创作一张电影质感的竖版体育海报，风格对标顶级代理商制作的 FIFA 世界杯宣传艺术作品。

画布：竖版海报，2:3 比例，深色戏剧性球场氛围，超细节照片级合成，高对比度，金色与天蓝色调，烟雾缭绕，火花，彩带，以及探照灯效果。

主体构图：展示 10 名男性足球运动员，排列为三行，全部面向前方，姿态严肃且英勇。球员面部需使用柔和的矩形模糊遮罩进行匿名处理。顶行：1 名核心队长居中站立，身穿 10 号球衣，印有 Messi 字样，佩戴黑色队长袖标。中行：4 名球员，从左至右依次为：11 号 Di Maria、20 号 Mac Allister、8 号 E. Fernandez、7 号 De Paul。前行：5 名球员，从左至右依次为：3 号 Tagliafico、13 号 Romero、居中守门员 23 号 Martinez（身穿黑色守门员球衣，戴蓝色手套并手持足球）、19 号 Otamendi、26 号 Molina。球员总数严格保持 10 人。

球衣细节：使用阿根廷风格的白蓝竖条纹球衣，肩部带有黑色条纹，胸前中心有金色赛事徽章，带有三颗星的 AFA 风格队徽，黑色或深色号码，并呈现细微的汗水、织物纹理和逼真的阴影。守门员身穿深海军蓝/黑色球衣，配有金色装饰和同款队徽。

背景：背景上方是一面巨大的飘扬阿根廷国旗，顶部中央球员头部后方有明亮的太阳光晕。球员后方放置一个巨大的发光球场碗状看台，布满细小的观众灯光、雾气、蓝色烟雾和金色粒子效果。

标志与标识：左上角放置一个带有三颗星的金色 AFA 风格队徽。右上角放置一个金色世界杯奖杯图标，下方堆叠文字，内容严格为：“FIFA WORLD CUP 2026”。底部中心包含一个小型的金色 AFA 风格队徽、一个垂直分隔符以及 Adidas 风格的三条纹标志。

文字内容：底部使用巨大的做旧压缩字体，颜色为灰白色，内容严格为：“{argument name="headline text" default="THE WEIGHT OF GLORY."}”。下方添加一行较小的间距副标题，内容严格为：“{argument name="subtitle text" default="DEFENDING THE CROWN IN 2026"}”，其中 “DEFENDING” 为天蓝色，“THE CROWN IN 2026” 为暖金色。下方添加小号白色间距大写字母的地点文字：“{argument name="host countries" default="UNITED STATES · CANADA · MEXICO"}”。最底部添加微小的金色间距文字：“{argument name="tagline" default="THREE STARS. ONE DESTINY."}”。

风格限制：呈现出官方史诗级足球电影海报的质感，而非扁平图形。使用逼真的光影、清晰的球衣细节、电影级调色、金属质感金色排版、标题上的磨损纹理、对称的团队层级，严禁增加额外球员、额外文字或水印。

templates.title: Argentina World Cup Glory Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 阿根廷世界杯荣耀海报

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a highly dramatic, vertical football movie poster-style image showcasing Argentina's World Cup title defense, featuring the team's heroic lineup on the field. Canvas: Vertical 2:3 poster, cinematic sports advertising composition, deep navy blue and gold tones, high contrast, realistic photo-compositing style, smoky atmosphere, ribbons and sparks, intense stadium spotlights, and a large Argentine flag in the background. Layout: The composition centers on 10 Argentine football players, arranged in three tiers. Top Tier: A tall captain stands behind everyone, wearing the Argentine home jersey with the number 10 and the letter MESSI, wearing the captain's armband, and a strong halo behind his head. Middle Tier: Four outfield players from left to right, wearing number 11 DI MARIA, number 20 MAC ALLISTER, number 8 E. FERNANDEZ, and number 7 DE PAUL. Bottom layer: 5 players, with the goalkeeper in the center wearing a black kit, bearing the number 23 MARTINEZ, blue gloves, and holding the ball in both hands; flanking him are number 3 TAGLIAFICO, number 13 ROMERO, number 19 OTAMENDI, and number 26 MOLINA. All players' faces are softly blurred into rectangular shapes while retaining their hairstyles, bodies, jerseys, poses, and realism. Main details: All players wear Argentina's 2026 white and blue striped jerseys, featuring black Adidas-style shoulder straps, gold FA badge details, tournament championship badges, fine fabric texture, and upright athletic postures. The goalkeeper's kit is black with gold accents. Dramatic contour lighting and a haze around the players distinguish them from the stadium background. Logo and symbols: A gold AFA badge with three stars is placed in the upper left corner. A gold FIFA World Cup trophy logo is placed in the upper right corner, along with the text "FIFA WORLD CUP 2026". A small AFA and Adidas-style logo is placed at the bottom center, separated by a vertical line. Text content: A large, distressed title is used in the lower third of the text.{argument name="headline text" default="THE WEIGHT OF GLORY."} The text uses a gray-white uppercase block font. A subtitle is added below.{argument name="subtitle text" default="DEFENDING THE CROWN IN 2026"} "DEFENDING" is light blue, and "THE CROWN IN 2026" is gold. (Add below){argument name="host countries" default="UNITED STATES · CANADA · MEXICO"} Add a small slogan at the very bottom.{argument name="tagline" default="THREE STARS. ONE DESTINY."} Visual Style: Epic sports documentary poster, photorealistic feel, ultra-detailed jerseys, cinematic smoke, bright stadium bokeh, gold grain, Argentine patriotic blue and white color scheme, rugged distressed typography, premium championship atmosphere. Constraints: Must use 10 players and list 10 jersey numbers. Keep background flags clearly visible and imposing. Do not add extra players, redundant slogans, watermarks, or irrelevant logos. Keep faces blurred/anonymized.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张极具戏剧性的竖版足球电影海报风格图像，展现阿根廷队卫冕世界杯的主题，画面包含球场上英雄般的球队阵容。

画布：竖版 2:3 海报，电影级体育广告构图，深海军蓝与金色调，高对比度，写实照片合成风格，烟雾缭绕的氛围，彩带火花，强烈的体育场探照灯，以及背景中巨大的阿根廷国旗。

布局：构图中心安排 10 名阿根廷足球运动员，分为三层。顶层：1 名高大的队长站在所有人身后，身穿阿根廷主场球衣，印有 10 号和 MESSI 字样，佩戴队长袖标，头部后方有强烈的晕光。中层：从左至右 4 名外场球员，分别身穿 11 号 DI MARIA、20 号 MAC ALLISTER、8 号 E. FERNANDEZ 和 7 号 DE PAUL。底层：5 名球员，中间为身穿黑色门将服的门将，印有 23 号 MARTINEZ，佩戴蓝色手套，双手持球；两侧分别为 3 号 TAGLIAFICO、13 号 ROMERO、19 号 OTAMENDI 和 26 号 MOLINA。将所有球员面部进行柔和的矩形模糊处理，同时保留发型、身体、球衣、姿势和真实感。

主体细节：所有球员身穿阿根廷 2026 款白蓝条纹球衣，带有黑色 Adidas 风格肩带、金色足协徽章细节、赛事冠军徽章、细腻的织物纹理以及挺拔的运动姿势。门将服为黑色配金色点缀。使用戏剧性的轮廓光和球员周围的薄雾，将他们与体育场背景区分开来。

Logo 与符号：左上角放置带有三颗星的金色 AFA 徽章。右上角放置金色 FIFA 世界杯奖杯标志，并附带文字“FIFA WORLD CUP 2026”。底部中心放置小的 AFA 和 Adidas 风格标志，中间用竖线隔开。

文本内容：在下三分之一处使用大型做旧标题 {argument name="headline text" default="THE WEIGHT OF GLORY."}，采用灰白色大写块状字体。下方添加副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="DEFENDING THE CROWN IN 2026"}，其中“DEFENDING”为浅蓝色，“THE CROWN IN 2026”为金色。下方添加 {argument name="host countries" default="UNITED STATES · CANADA · MEXICO"}。最底部添加小标语 {argument name="tagline" default="THREE STARS. ONE DESTINY."}。

视觉风格：史诗级体育纪录片海报，照片级真实感，超精细球衣，电影级烟雾，明亮的体育场焦外成像，金色颗粒，阿根廷爱国蓝白色调，粗犷的做旧排版，高级冠军氛围。

约束条件：必须使用 10 名球员和列出的 10 个球衣号码。保持背景旗帜清晰可见且宏伟。不要添加额外的球员、多余的标语、水印或不相关的 Logo。保持面部模糊/匿名化。

templates.title: Cyan shading fashion portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 青色遮挡时尚肖像

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic, melancholic fashion portrait, with the subject being {argument name="subject" default="A young androgynous model"} She wears a dark, sheer tulle dress, with loose, semi-transparent fabric wrapped around her shoulders and chest. The main body features a compact upper-body composition, slightly off-center, with a large, opaque square covering her entire face. Above and around the cover, one can see her hair styled in a backward-swept manner.{argument name="hair color" default="black"} Hair. A square masking block is positioned at the center of the face, extending from the forehead to the upper chest, featuring a subtle vertical gradient: a deep charcoal blue at the top and bottom, and a soft gray-green in the center. One ear is visible on the right side of the masking block, along with a small portion of the hairline at the top. Use a cool cyan studio background with a soft, matte finish, low contrast, and a film grain effect. Lighting should be dim, atmospheric, and consistent with the editorial style, complementing the blue-green tones, shallow depth of field, and soft shadows to achieve a high-end fashion magazine feel. The image should not contain any visible text, logos, or extraneous objects.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影感、忧郁风格的时尚肖像，主体为 {argument name="subject" default="一位中性风年轻模特"}，身着深色透明薄纱服装，肩部和胸部环绕着蓬松的半透明织物。主体采用紧凑的上半身构图，略微偏离中心，大面积不透明的方形遮挡块覆盖整个面部，遮挡块上方和周围可见向后梳理的 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"} 发丝。方形遮挡块位于面部中心，从前额区域延伸至上胸部，呈现出微妙的垂直渐变，顶部和底部为深炭青色，中心为柔和的灰绿色。遮挡块右侧露出的一只耳朵和顶部可见的少量发际线。使用带有柔和雾面质感的冷青色摄影棚背景，低对比度，并带有电影胶片颗粒感。灯光应昏暗、具有氛围感且符合编辑风格，配合蓝绿色调、浅景深、柔和阴影，呈现出高端时尚杂志的质感。画面中不应包含任何可见文字、Logo 或多余物体。

templates.title: Anonymous Night Bus Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 匿名夜间巴士肖像

templates.prompt: Create a nighttime photograph with a cinematic feel, viewed from inside a city bus or tram, looking past a seated passenger towards a large, rain-drenched window, where neon lights and traffic outside are reflected in bokeh. The scene should evoke a sense of urban anonymity and melancholy, using deep blue and cyan tones, with out-of-focus red and white streetlights, and a glowing cyan sign in the upper left corner with blurred text.{argument name="neon sign text" default="veep"} A dark-haired passenger is positioned slightly to the right of center in the frame, appearing as a silhouette, with only their head and shoulders faintly visible in the window reflection; a large, opaque, dark charcoal blue square privacy shading block covers the center of the passenger's face. A widescreen cinematic aspect ratio, shallow depth of field, heavy film grain, and low-light simulation of photographic quality are used, with soft reflections on the glass. Aside from deliberately blurred signs, there should be no clearly discernible details. The composition should remain quiet and atmospheric, with the window frame and bus interior forming dark vertical borders on the left and right sides. The privacy shading block should be a discrete, flat, textureless square, occupying approximately one-quarter of the frame width.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张充满电影氛围的夜间摄影作品，视角从城市巴士或电车内部向外看，越过一名坐着的乘客，看向布满雨滴的大窗户，窗外映照着霓虹灯和车流的焦外光斑。场景应呈现出城市、匿名且略带忧郁的感觉，采用深蓝色和青色调，红白色的失焦街灯，左上方有一个发光的青色标志，文字模糊显示为 {argument name="neon sign text" default="veep"}。一名深色头发的乘客位于画面中心偏右位置，呈剪影状，仅头部和肩部在窗户反射中隐约可见；在乘客面部中央覆盖一个大型不透明的深炭蓝色方形隐私遮挡块。采用宽银幕电影比例，浅景深，重胶片颗粒感，低光模拟摄影质感，玻璃上有柔和的反射，除刻意模糊的标志外，不应有清晰可辨的细节。保持构图安静且富有氛围感，窗框和巴士内饰在左右两侧形成深色的垂直边界。隐私遮挡块应为一个离散的遮盖方块，边缘平整且无纹理，约占画面宽度的四分之一。

templates.title: Gothic mourners on the cathedral steps

titleLocalized.zh: 大教堂台阶上的哥特式哀悼者

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic black-and-white documentary fashion photograph depicting three women in Gothic mourning attire ascending the wide stone steps of an ancient cathedral or historic municipal building. Shot in strong natural light, the scene presents deep shadows and high contrast, reminiscent of a 35mm film still. All three women wear long, Victorian-style black mourning gowns with pleated skirts, fitted waists, long black gloves, and sheer black veils covering their heads and faces. The woman in the center is closest to the camera, slightly turned back, with one eye and part of her face vaguely visible through the veil; the woman on the left is positioned slightly further back in dim light, her face obscured by a black rectangle, like a censorship mark; the woman on the right is further up the steps, walking with her back to the camera, her long pleated skirt trailing behind her. The background showcases massive light-colored stone pillars, worn brickwork, carved architectural details, and wide, weathered steps, with the figures positioned in the lower and middle sections of the frame. Employing a cinematic horizontal composition, monochrome grayscale, strong contrast lighting, realistic fabric textures, the transparency of lace and tulle, and a solemn, ceremonial atmosphere, the design is devoid of text, modern objects, and extra figures. Optional customization: Set location.{argument name="historic location" default="Ancient cathedral steps"} The clothing style is{argument name="mourning dress style" default="Victorian Gothic Black Pleated Dress"} The atmosphere of the image is{argument name="mood" default="Solemn and mysterious"} The photography style is{argument name="camera style" default="High-contrast black and white 35mm documentary photography"} and the number of women is{argument name="number of women" default="Three"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张极具戏剧性的黑白纪实时尚摄影作品，画面中三位身着哥特式哀悼服饰的女性正拾级而上，走在古老大教堂或历史悠久的市政建筑宽阔的石阶上。场景在强烈的自然光下拍摄，呈现出深邃的阴影和高对比度，宛如 35mm 电影剧照。三位人物均身着维多利亚风格的黑色长款哀悼礼服，配有百褶裙摆、收腰设计、黑色长手套以及遮盖头部和面部的黑色透明面纱。中间的女性离镜头最近，身体微微向后转，透过面纱隐约可见一只眼睛和部分面部；左侧女性位置稍靠后且光线较暗，面部被一块黑色矩形遮挡，如同审查标记；右侧女性在台阶上方更远处，背对镜头向上走，长长的百褶裙摆拖在身后。背景展示了巨大的浅色石柱、磨损的砖石、雕刻的建筑细节以及宽阔风化的台阶，人物分布在画面的下部和中部。采用电影感横向构图，单色灰阶，强烈的明暗对比照明，逼真的织物纹理，蕾丝和薄纱的透明感，庄重的仪式氛围，无文字，无现代物品，无额外人物。可选自定义：设置地点为 {argument name="historic location" default="古老大教堂台阶"}，服装风格为 {argument name="mourning dress style" default="维多利亚哥特式黑色百褶礼服"}，图像氛围为 {argument name="mood" default="庄重而神秘"}，摄影风格为 {argument name="camera style" default="高对比度黑白 35mm 纪实摄影"}，以及女性人数为 {argument name="number of women" default="三位"}。

variables.name: camera style
variables.defaultValue: High-contrast black and white 35mm documentary photography

templates.title: Stills from the censored smoke film

titleLocalized.zh: 受审查的烟雾电影剧照

templates.prompt: Create a still image of a dark, smoky interior scene with a cinematic feel. The main subject of the image is a {argument name="subject" default="A young woman with fair skin and wild, dark curly hair"} The composition employs a mid-range close-up composition above the chest, slightly off-center, with the left hand holding a lit white cigarette close to her mouth. Her face is deliberately obscured by an opaque, dark brownish-gray square of scrutiny positioned between her forehead and chin. Details include a thin ring on her finger, bare shoulders, a deep burgundy or black off-the-shoulder dress slipping down, voluminous curls framing the silhouette, swirling smoke, and a tense yet intimate atmosphere. Using a…{argument name="color grade" default="Low-light noir film style with greenish-brown tones"} Emphasize heavy shadows, soft grain, and shallow depth of field, with a warm, blurred halo on the right side of the background. The scene should evoke the atmosphere of an old, dimly lit room or bar, rather than a modern, sleek studio. Use a widescreen setup.{argument name="aspect ratio" default="16:9"} The composition aims for a realistic photographic effect, showcasing natural skin texture, blurred backgrounds, and dramatic backlighting. There is no visible text or watermark in the image.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张充满电影质感的暗调烟雾室内剧照。画面主体为一位 {argument name="subject" default="皮肤白皙、留着狂野深色卷发的年轻女性"}，采用胸部以上的近中景构图，略微偏离中心，左手手指夹着一支点燃的白色香烟靠近嘴边。她的面部被一个位于额头至下巴中心位置、呈暗棕灰色的不透明方形审查块刻意遮挡。画面细节包括手指上的一枚细戒指、裸露的肩膀、一件正在滑落的深酒红色或黑色露肩服装、捕捉到轮廓光的蓬松卷发、缭绕的烟雾以及紧张而私密的氛围。使用一种 {argument name="color grade" default="偏绿棕褐色调的低光黑色电影风格"}，强调厚重的阴影、柔和的颗粒感、浅景深，并在背景右侧呈现温暖的模糊光晕。场景应营造出一种陈旧昏暗的房间或酒吧氛围，而非现代整洁的摄影棚。采用宽屏 {argument name="aspect ratio" default="16:9"} 构图，追求写实摄影效果，展现自然的皮肤纹理、背景虚化、戏剧性的逆光，画面中无可见文字，无水印。

templates.title: Nighttime bus window scene with obscured panels

titleLocalized.zh: 经过遮挡处理的夜间巴士车窗场景

templates.prompt: Create a nighttime photograph with a cinematic feel, using a 16:9 widescreen format, with the perspective set inside or beside a bus or tram window in a rainy urban environment. The scene should evoke a somber atmosphere, featuring heavy glass reflections, soft film grain, shallow depth of field, and urban bokeh in red, white, yellow, cyan, and blue hues. On the right side of the image, display {argument name="subject" default="A passenger sitting by the window"} Partial silhouette, most of the outline obscured by darkness and reflections, with only the hair and shoulder shapes vaguely visible. A large, opaque square obscuring the subject's face is used, centered on the head and upper body area. This obscuring block is a deep charcoal blue-gray with clean, sharp edges and no text. The upper left background contains a glowing, blurry, cyan-blue neon sign, shaped like letters but unrecognizable, along with vertical window frames and the dimly lit interior of a bus. The image employs a grainy, simulated film style, low-contrast shadows, cool blue-green tones, low exposure, and soft, motion-blurred streetlights; there is no visible text, watermark, or other superfluous subject.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张具有电影氛围的夜间摄影作品，采用 16:9 宽画幅，视角设定在雨天城市环境中的巴士或电车窗内侧或窗旁。场景应呈现出阴郁的氛围，包含厚重的玻璃反射、柔和的胶片颗粒感、浅景深，以及红、白、黄、青、蓝色的城市散景光斑。在画面右侧，展示 {argument name="subject" default="一名坐在窗边的乘客"} 的部分剪影，大部分轮廓被黑暗和反射遮盖，仅能隐约看到头发和肩部形状。用一个大的不透明方形遮挡块覆盖主体面部，该遮挡块位于头部和上半身区域中心，颜色为深炭蓝灰色，边缘清晰整洁，无任何文字。背景左上方包含一个发光的模糊青蓝色霓虹灯招牌，形状类似字母但无法辨认，此外还有垂直的窗框和昏暗的巴士内部结构。采用粗颗粒感的模拟胶片风格、低对比度阴影、冷蓝绿色调、低曝光度以及柔和的动态模糊街灯；画面中无可见文字，无水印，无其他多余主体。

templates.prompt: Create a still image that evokes a cinematic feel and a melancholic atmosphere, with the main subject being {argument name="subject" default="A woman with fluffy, dark curly hair"} She sits in a dimly lit, smoky room, framed in a 16:9 widescreen composition. The image focuses on her upper body, slightly off-center, wearing a dark off-the-shoulder top with thin straps, her bare shoulders illuminated by soft contour lighting. Her left hand is raised near her face, a lit cigarette between her fingers, wisps of smoke rising upwards; only two visible accessories are visible: a thin ring on her finger and the cigarette. A large, opaque square obscuring her face, in a deep warm gray-brown, covers all facial features while leaving her hair, neck, hand, cigarette, and shoulder visible.{argument name="lighting style" default="Low-key warm-toned cinematic lighting effects"} It features greenish-brown shadows, shallow depth of field, soft grain, and a rough, simulated cinematic texture. The background should be a blurred, dark room with a blurred vertical structure and a warm rectangular halo on the right. It creates an intimate, tense, smoky, and dramatic atmosphere, like the visuals of a 1970s art film; no text, no watermark, rejecting the clean, studio feel.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张充满电影感和忧郁氛围的剧照，主体为 {argument name="subject" default="一位留着蓬松深色卷发的女性"}，她坐在一间昏暗、烟雾缭绕的室内，采用 16:9 宽银幕构图。画面呈现其胸部以上部位，略微偏离中心，身穿深色露肩装，露出细肩带，裸露的肩膀捕捉到柔和的轮廓光。她的左手举在脸部附近，指间夹着一支点燃的香烟，淡淡的烟雾向上飘散；画面中仅包含 2 个可见配饰：手指上的一枚细戒指和香烟。在她的脸部中心放置一个大型不透明方形遮挡块，颜色为深暖灰棕色，遮住所有面部特征，同时保留头发、脖子、手、香烟和肩膀可见。使用 {argument name="lighting style" default="低调暖色电影光效"}，带有绿棕色阴影、浅景深、柔和颗粒感以及粗粝的模拟电影质感。背景应为一个模糊的暗室，带有模糊的垂直结构，右侧有一道温暖的矩形光晕。营造出亲密、紧张、烟雾缭绕且戏剧化的氛围，如同 1970 年代艺术电影的画面；无文字，无水印，拒绝干净的摄影棚质感。

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 16:9 横向构图的忧郁电影感时尚肖像。一位年轻的中性模特，拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="深色后梳发型"}，半身出镜，背景为柔和的青蓝色纹理摄影棚背景。模特略微偏离中心，仅露出顶部发际线、一只耳朵、颈部和部分肩膀，因为一个巨大的不透明方形遮挡块覆盖了整个面部和头部中央区域。方形居中于面部，宽度约占图像的三分之一，从左上角的深炭青色到右侧的柔和灰绿色呈现出微妙的垂直渐变，边缘极其锐利，无任何文字。主体穿着一件引人注目的 {argument name="garment" default="黑色透视薄纱荷叶边领口或蓬松的半透明织物"}，覆盖在画面下半部分，呈现半透明的烟雾感，带有层叠的褶皱。光影为低调的氛围感，采用冷青色和深蓝色调，带有柔和的胶片颗粒感，浅景深，高阶时尚编辑风格，极简构图，无可见眼睛，无面部特征，无 Logo，无水印。

The central woman is the focal point, photographed from behind and slightly glancing back; her face is partially obscured by a semi-transparent veil, and she wears a fitted black corset with puff sleeves and a long, flowing skirt. The woman on the left is slightly further back in shadow, mostly covered by black veils, her face deliberately blurred with a small, dark rectangle. The woman on the right is further up the steps, walking in profile/back view, wearing a long, trailing black dress and a veil. The background showcases weathered stone pillars, brickwork, steps, and a dark doorway or latticed window, creating a strong sense of architectural texture. The composition should be a horizontal widescreen, pursuing a documentary-style realism, elegant and mysterious, with no text, modern objects, colors, or watermarks in the image.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影质感的黑白时尚摄影照片，画面中三位身着戏剧性维多利亚哥特式哀悼礼服的女性，正走上一座宏伟教堂或古典石建筑外宽阔的古老石阶。场景采用高对比度的黑白风格，伴有强烈的阳光和深邃的阴影，呈现出复古街拍或黑色电影大片的质感。三位人物均身着全长黑色百褶长裙，佩戴透明黑纱面纱、长手套以及层叠的哀悼面料。中间的女性为视觉焦点，从背后拍摄并微微回眸，面部被半透明面纱部分遮挡，身穿修身黑色紧身胸衣，搭配泡泡袖和长款飘逸裙摆。左侧女性略微靠后，处于阴影中，大部分身形被黑纱覆盖，面部刻意用一个小型的深色矩形模糊处理。右侧女性位于台阶上方更远处，以侧影/背影行走，身穿长拖尾黑色长裙并戴着面纱。背景展示了风化的石柱、砖石、台阶以及一扇深色的门洞或带栅栏的窗户，具有强烈的建筑纹理感。构图应为横向宽屏，追求纪录片式的写实感，优雅而神秘，画面中无文字、无现代物品、无色彩、无水印。

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高端城市街头时尚广告大片照片，展示一位自信的男模特身穿超大款黑色连帽衫，背景为粗犷的城市环境。模特肤色为中深色，留着黑色短发，从大腿中部以上正面出镜，双手插在裤兜里，双肩放松，展现出冷静与自信。他的面部被一个居中的垂直长方形暖棕色色块遮挡，从额头覆盖至下巴，仅露出部分发顶和耳朵。连帽衫采用厚实的黑色抓绒面料，带有大兜帽、落肩设计、罗纹袖口、袋鼠兜，并呈现出细腻逼真的织物纹理。在胸前添加醒目的浅灰色品牌标识：大号文字“{argument name="main logo text" default="ABKR"}”，下方是间距较小的文字“{argument name="brand subtitle" default="URBAN STREETWEAR"}”，以及一个小型圆形图标和短语“{argument name="small chest slogan" default="BUILT FOR MOTION"}”。在模特左袖上，放置垂直加粗文字“{argument name="sleeve text" default="CITY MOTION"}”，并在袖口附近添加小号堆叠式技术微型文字“UTIL.01 / SPEC URBAN / PERFORMANCE”。在右下摆附近添加一个微小的织物标签，上面印有“ABKR / STUDIO”。连帽衫搭配黑色工装裤。背景：一面带有可见螺栓孔和左侧涂鸦的城市混凝土墙及立柱，右侧为带有模糊涂鸦的深色金属卷帘门。光影氛围感强且具有电影质感，左上方有柔和的定向日光，深邃的阴影，灰黑色调，浅景深，高端编辑级写实效果，焦点清晰地落在连帽衫的图案和面料上，采用 4:5 垂直构图。避免添加额外配饰，避免使用鲜艳色彩，避免出现其他人物，并确保所有排版简洁、现代且易于阅读。

templates.title: ChatGPT Dream Logo Screenshot

titleLocalized.zh: ChatGPT 梦幻 Logo 截图

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a realistic dark mode mobile screenshot of the ChatGPT App, showcasing {argument name="character name" default="HATSUNE MIKU"} A dreamy logo image generating dialogue. Canvas: Vertical smartphone screenshot, 768 x 968 pixels, black background, cropped to extend the generated image at the bottom beyond the screen edge. Uses an iOS-style stateless app frame, with no keyboard displayed. Top Navigation: A thin, dark title bar at the top. Contains four visible title items: a hamburger menu icon in the top left, the centered "ChatGPT Auto" title text (with a small arrow after Auto), a pencil/edit icon in the top right, and a three-dot overflow menu on the far right. Dialogue Layout: A rounded image thumbnail in the top right corner shows an anime girl with blue-green twin tails in black and white attire. Below is a right-aligned, dark gray, rounded user message bubble containing white text. The bubble text must read: "Create a..."{argument name="logo title" default="HATSUNE MIKU"} The logo should be a dreamlike design, using only the character from the attached image as a silhouette-based logo, rather than a full illustration. A large, anime-style side silhouette should be directly integrated into the logo, while retaining the character's features solely through shape: hairstyle, facial contours, posture, and proportions must be recognizable only from the silhouette. The character should be abstract and partially obscured by textures and negative space. Eyes, hands, or clothing details should not be shown. Prioritize the readability of the silhouette and implicit details. Typography should be dominant: an elegant, dreamlike JRPG serif font with gradients, glowing edges, bevels, and ornamentation. Hair, cloaks, smoke, and magical effects should be organically interwoven with the text. Include inferred dreamlike themes such as symbols and architecture. A wide 16:9 asymmetrical banner with premium JRPG title screen aesthetics, a white background, and a semi-flat, painterly anime graphic design. The generated results area includes a small, left-aligned gray label "Image created" below the message bubble. Below this is a large, rounded preview card of the generated image on a white background, partially truncated at the bottom edge of the screenshot. The generated image in the preview card: a wide 16:9 dreamy JRPG title logo on a white background. The main text is "HATSUNE" and "MIKU" stacked in two lines, using a large, ornate serif font with an ice-blue gradient, white highlights, metallic bevels, and glowing edges. Behind and around the text, on the right, is a large anime-style silhouette of Hatsune Miku in profile: no visible eyes, hands, or clothing details, only a deep blue-green facial outline and the iconic long twin tails flowing to the right. A faint gold circular compass/halo decoration is added behind the title, and a dark gothic castle silhouette is added near the lower right corner, along with swirling blue-green smoke, headbands, splash effects, starbursts, and magical decorations surrounding the text. A tiny pink "01" mark is added near the lower right corner of the logo. Maintain the logo's sophisticated feel, semi-flat graphic style, dreamy anime aesthetic, asymmetry, and simplicity. Visual style: Realistic screenshots of the ChatGPT mobile UI, dark mode, crisp white typography, softly rounded cards, accurate spacing, high contrast, no watermark, no extra UI panels, no keyboard.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个逼真的 ChatGPT App 深色模式移动端截图，展示关于 {argument name="character name" default="HATSUNE MIKU"} 梦幻 Logo 的图像生成对话。

画布：垂直智能手机截图，768 x 968 像素，黑色背景，裁剪效果使底部生成的图像延伸至屏幕边缘之外。使用 iOS 风格的无状态 App 框架，不显示键盘。

顶部导航：顶部有一条细长的深色标题栏。包含 4 个可见的标题项：左上角的汉堡菜单图标、居中的“ChatGPT Auto”标题文字（Auto 后带有一个小箭头）、右上角的铅笔/编辑图标，以及最右侧的三个点溢出菜单。

对话布局：在右上角放置 1 个圆角图像缩略图，显示一位黑白装束的动漫蓝绿色双马尾女孩。下方放置 1 个右对齐的深灰色圆角用户消息气泡，内含白色文字。气泡文字必须为：“创建一个名为“{argument name="logo title" default="HATSUNE MIKU"}”的梦幻 Logo，仅将附件中的角色作为基于剪影的徽标，而非完整插图。将一个大型动漫风格的侧面剪影直接融入 Logo 中，同时仅通过形状语言保留角色的特征：发型、面部轮廓、姿态和比例必须仅通过剪影即可辨认。人物应具有抽象感，并部分被纹理和负空间遮蔽。不显示眼睛、手部或服装细节。优先考虑剪影的可读性和隐含细节。排版应占据主导地位：优雅的梦幻 JRPG 衬线字体，带有渐变、发光边缘、斜面和装饰。头发、斗篷、烟雾和魔法效果应与文字有机交织。包含符号和建筑等推断出的梦幻主题。宽幅 16:9 非对称横幅，优质 JRPG 标题画面美学，白色背景，半扁平绘画风格动漫平面设计。”

生成结果区域：在消息气泡下方，添加左对齐的灰色小标签“Image created”。在其下方，显示 1 个带有圆角的超大生成图像预览卡片，白色背景，底部被截图边缘部分截断。

预览卡片内的生成图像：白色背景上的宽幅 16:9 梦幻 JRPG 标题 Logo。主文字为上下两行堆叠的“HATSUNE”和“MIKU”，采用大型华丽的衬线字体，带有冰蓝色渐变、白色高光、金属斜面和发光边缘。在文字后方和周围，右侧包含 1 个大型动漫风格的初音未来侧面剪影：无可见眼睛、手部或服装细节，仅有深蓝绿色面部轮廓和标志性的向右飘动的长双马尾形状。在标题后方添加 1 个淡淡的金色圆形指南针/光环装饰，右下角附近添加 1 个深色哥特式城堡剪影，以及环绕文字的旋转蓝绿色烟雾、发带、飞溅效果、星芒和魔法装饰。在 Logo 右下角附近添加一个微小的粉色“01”标记。保持 Logo 的高级感、半扁平绘画风格、梦幻动漫感、非对称性和简洁性。

视觉风格：逼真的 ChatGPT 移动端 UI 截图，深色模式，清晰的白色排版，柔和的圆角卡片，准确的间距，高对比度，无水印，无额外 UI 面板，无键盘。

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张电影质感的风格化 3D 渲染图，场景设定在充满未来感的 WhatsApp 风格数字通讯中心。一位名叫 {argument name="character name" default="Dilshad Hussain"} 的自信年轻男性 AI Influencer 全身像位于画面中心，随意地倚靠在一个巨大的发光半透明立方体上，立方体内部散发着霓虹绿光，并带有黑色加固边角。他身穿一件亮面绿黑配色的棒球夹克，胸前印有小巧的 WhatsApp 标志，内搭黑色 T 恤，下身穿着带有侧边工装口袋和银色链条的黑色慢跑裤，脚踩绿白配色运动鞋，佩戴手表、手链、戒指和叠戴银项链。他的姿势轻松且充满魅力：一只手肘靠在立方体上，一条腿交叉在前，另一只手拿着一部显示着社交媒体/聊天界面的智能手机。采用高度抛光、类似玩具质感但又写实的 3D 角色风格，运用戏剧性的青色和祖母绿轮廓光，搭配反光的科幻地板、发光的绿色灯带，以及带有墙面显示器和控制台的深色高科技房间。

在他上方和身后放置明亮的全息文字：顶部为 WhatsApp 标志和“WhatsApp”字样，下方是一个巨大的青色霓虹轮廓名称，显示为“{argument name="headline name" default="Dilshad Hussain"}”，再下方为“{argument name="subtitle text" default="AI Influencer"}”。在角色周围放置 13 个悬浮的通讯元素：1 个巨大的绿色 WhatsApp 图标，1 个墙面屏幕上的左侧 WhatsApp 标志，3 个蓝色聊天/消息气泡，2 个白色聊天/消息气泡，2 个带有红色通知徽章的蓝色信封/消息图标，1 个白色信封图标，1 个带有红色通知徽章的黄色铃铛，1 个带有红色通知徽章的白色铃铛，以及 2 个表情符号反应（一个大笑表情和一个爱心眼表情）。保持构图垂直、海报感、居中、充满活力且高度发光，以祖母绿、青色、黑色和深青色为主色调。营造出一种高端未来感社交媒体工作室的氛围，具有浅景深和锐利的霓虹高光。请勿添加额外人物，请勿添加水印，并将所有可见文字限制为 WhatsApp、名称以及 AI Influencer。

templates.title: Blue AI Influencer 3D Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 蓝色 AI 网红 3D 海报

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a highly detailed, stylized 3D promotional poster for a social media influencer. The central figure is a confident young man casually seated on a smooth, geometric cube within a futuristic blue studio setting. Canvas: Vertical 9:16 poster, high resolution, cinematic 3D rendering, saturated electric blue palette, glossy textures, soft lighting, rim lighting, and depth-of-field blurring foreground elements. Subject: A young man with a smooth, deliberately blurred face, short, dark hair, medium build, and a composed, confident posture, seated on a multifaceted blue cube at the center of the image. He wears a matching royal blue baseball tracksuit with white stripes: a jacket, a white T-shirt, jogging shorts, and two blue and white high-top sneakers, along with visible accessories including two stacked necklaces, a watch, and several bracelets. His hands are casually placed near his knees, his legs are apart, and his feet are forward. Text content: Large, stacked, metallic 3D blocky fonts are used behind and around the figure, featuring a glowing blue-white tone and stretched shadows. There are three main lines of text:{argument name="first name" default="DILSHAD"} "",{argument name="last name" default="HUSSAIN"} "as well as"{argument name="subtitle text" default="AI INFLUENCER"} Add a subtle, repeating background pattern to the wall with the text "FOLLOW". Layout: The name occupies two-thirds of the image, partially behind the seated figure; the subtitle spans the lower center of the area behind the figure's shoulders. The cube is centered in the lower third. Keep the main subject in front of the typography and present realistic occlusion and shadows. Social media elements: Includes 7 floating blue notification icons: 2 bell notification icons with red reminder badges, 3 full like icons, and 2 partially cropped like icons in the bottom corners. Placement: 1 bell icon in the top left corner, 1 like icon in the top right corner, 1 bell icon in the center left, 1 like icon in the center right, 1 like icon in the bottom left, and 1 large, blurred, cropped like icon each in the bottom left and bottom right foreground. Visual Style: Futuristic, trendy brand style; glossy icon aesthetics; beveled chrome font; neon cyan glow; floating particles; tiny cyan light spots; blue gradient background; polished studio floor; soft vignetting; realistic fabric textures; realistic sneaker details; dramatic commercial lighting. Constraints: Maintain a predominantly blue color scheme; preserve a precise 3-line heading hierarchy; ensure clear and legible typography; faces should be smoothly blurred to maintain anonymity; avoid additional logos or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为社交媒体网红形象创作一张超精细的风格化 3D 宣传海报，画面中心是一位自信的年轻男性，他随意地坐在未来感蓝色摄影棚内的一个光面几何立方体上。

画布：竖版 9:16 海报，高分辨率，电影级 3D 渲染，饱和的电光蓝调色板，光面材质，柔和光晕，轮廓光，前景元素带有景深模糊效果。

主体：一位年轻男性，面部区域经过平滑且刻意的模糊处理，留着干练的深色短发，中等身材，姿态从容自信，坐在画面中心的一个多面蓝色立方体上。他身穿配套的宝蓝色棒球运动套装，带有白色条纹：1 件夹克，1 件白色 T 恤，1 条慢跑裤，2 只蓝白配色高帮运动鞋，并佩戴可见的配饰，包括 2 条叠戴项链、1 只腕表和几条手链。他的双手随意放在膝盖附近，双腿分开，双脚向前着地。

文字内容：在人物后方及周围使用巨大的堆叠式金属 3D 块状字体，呈现发光的蓝白色调并带有拉伸阴影。共有 3 行主要文字：“{argument name="first name" default="DILSHAD"}”、“{argument name="last name" default="HUSSAIN"}”以及“{argument name="subtitle text" default="AI INFLUENCER"}”。在墙面上添加淡淡的重复背景图案，文字为“FOLLOW”。

布局：名称占据图像上三分之二的区域，部分位于坐姿人物后方；副标题横跨人物肩部后方的中下区域。立方体位于下三分之一的中心。保持主体位于排版前方，并呈现真实的遮挡关系和阴影。

社交媒体元素：包含 7 个悬浮的蓝色通知图标：2 个带有红色提醒徽章的铃铛通知图标，3 个完整的点赞图标，以及底部角落处 2 个部分裁剪的点赞图标。放置位置：左上角 1 个铃铛图标，右上角 1 个点赞图标，左中 1 个铃铛图标，右中 1 个点赞图标，左下 1 个点赞图标，以及左下和右下前景处各 1 个超大且模糊的裁剪点赞图标。

视觉风格：未来感网红品牌风格，光面应用图标美学，斜面铬合金字体，霓虹青色光芒，悬浮粒子，微小的青色光点，蓝色渐变背景，抛光摄影棚地面，柔和暗角，真实的织物纹理，真实的运动鞋细节，戏剧性的商业照明。

约束：保持图像以蓝色调为主，保留精确的 3 行标题层级，确保排版清晰易读，面部需进行平滑模糊处理以保持匿名，避免出现额外的标识或水印。

templates.prompt: Create a visually stunning vertical 3D social media ad rendering showcasing a stylish young male AI influencer confidently standing in a futuristic Instagram-style creator studio. The main subject is {argument name="character name" default="Dilshad Hussain"} Full-body shot (head to thighs), facing forward, one hand raised to touch the earphone, wearing a cyan, lavender, and pink gradient bomber jacket over a black shirt, and taupe cargo pants with black cuffs. Use realistic 3D character proportions and cinematic lighting; keep the face centered and realistic, or use the provided facial reference image. The studio is a circular, futuristic space with curved cyan LED dot matrix walls, transparent glass panels, magenta neon decorations, a glowing pink circular ceiling ring, a smoky atmosphere, reflective dark floors, and strong blue-pink contour lighting. Add two lines of striking floating neon text at the bottom center of the image: the first line displays {argument name="headline text" default="Dilshad Hussain"} It features a bright cyan outline glow effect; the second line displays {argument name="subtitle text" default="Ai influencer"} The design features a hot pink neon glow effect and is slightly angled across the main body. Surrounding it are 10 floating social media UI elements: an Instagram app icon in the upper right corner, and a display in the upper right chest area.{argument name="follower count" default="24.3K"} The image should include a follower count bubble, one pink heart-shaped notification bubble each in the left-center, right-center, and bottom-right positions, a larger blurred foreground bubble in the bottom left corner, and four Reels/play icons each in the top left, bottom left, bottom left, and bottom right corners. promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个视觉效果炸裂的竖屏 3D 社交媒体广告渲染图，展示一位时尚的年轻男性 AI influencer 自信地站在充满未来感的 Instagram 风格创作者工作室中。主体为 {argument name="character name" default="Dilshad Hussain"}，全身照（头部至大腿），面向前方，一只手抬起触碰耳边的耳机，身穿青色、薰衣草色和粉色渐变光泽飞行员夹克，内搭黑色衬衫，下穿灰褐色工装裤和黑色袖口。使用逼真的 3D 角色比例和电影级灯光；保持面部居中且真实，或使用提供的面部参考图。工作室是一个圆形的科技感空间，配有弯曲的青色 LED 点阵墙、透明玻璃面板、品红色霓虹装饰、发光的粉色圆形天花板环、烟雾缭绕的氛围、反光的深色地板以及强烈的蓝粉色轮廓光。在画面下方中心添加两行醒目的悬浮霓虹字体：第一行显示 {argument name="headline text" default="Dilshad Hussain"}，采用明亮的青色轮廓发光效果；第二行显示 {argument name="subtitle text" default="Ai influencer"}，采用热粉色霓虹发光效果，并略微倾斜穿过主体。在其周围环绕 10 个悬浮的社交媒体 UI 元素：右上角放置 1 个 Instagram 应用图标，右上胸部区域放置 1 个显示 {argument name="follower count" default="24.3K"} 的粉丝数气泡，左中、右中、右下各放置 1 个粉色心形通知气泡，左下角放置 1 个较大的模糊前景气泡，左上、左下、底部左侧和右下角各放置 4 个 Reels/播放图标。在主体胸前加入一个微妙的未来感全息 HUD 面板。画面需充满活力、具有光泽感、高级感，并具备高对比度、景深和体积雾效果，适合作为社交媒体宣传海报。避免多余文字，避免水印，构图保持居中且具有戏剧性。

templates.prompt: Create a 9:16 vertical luxury 3D promotional rendering image featuring a stylish young male AI influencer named {argument name="character name" default="Dilshad Hussain"} He stands in the foreground of a high-end Pinterest-style creative and fashionable workspace. The camera is positioned at chest height, using a slightly upward-looking hero's perspective to show his body from mid-thigh up, centered in the frame. If a reference image were provided, his face should match that of a real young man, but the overall look should be refined and cinematic; he has neat, short, black, center-parted hair. He wears three core pieces: a tailored cream-colored stand-up collar jacket with red trim, red cuffs, red side pockets, and a vertical zipper; paired with matching cream-colored trousers with red side panels; and a dark undershirt subtly visible through the jacket opening. The workspace features warm beige walls, vertical wood slats, wooden floors, recessed recessed lighting, and soft red contour lighting to outline the figure. Above him, two lines of huge 3D extruded neon text float on the wall: the first line in bright red reads "{argument name="character name" default="Dilshad Hussain"} The second line reads "{argument name="role text" default="Ai Influencer"} The text, "Ai," is in red, and "Influencer" is in bright white. All text features beveled edges, shadows, and glowing edges. The background contains three clearly visible creative projects: a large cork project on the left covered with fashion and interior design references; a white project against the wall in the lower left corner displaying clothing photos and neutral color swatches; and a vertical fashion collage project on the right, showcasing model clothing references in a grid format. A sophisticated color scheme of cream, beige, warm brown, red, and white is used to create photorealistic 3D renderings, soft studio lighting, shallow depth of field, highly detailed fabric textures, and modern luxury interior design. A small, delicate glitter/star marker is added in the lower right corner. No other people, extra text, watermarks, or clutter are allowed in the image; the composition should be clean and ambitious.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 9:16 竖版奢华 3D 宣传渲染图，主角是一位时尚的年轻男性 AI 网红，名为 {argument name="character name" default="Dilshad Hussain"}，他站在高端 Pinterest 风格的创意时尚工作空间前景中。摄像机位于胸部高度，采用略微仰视的英雄视角，展示他从大腿中部向上的身体，画面居中。如果提供了参考图，他的面部应与现实中的年轻男性相符，但整体外观需保持精致且具有电影感；留着整洁的黑色中分短发。他身穿 3 件核心服装：一件量身定制的奶油色立领夹克，带有红色镶边、红色袖口、红色侧袋装饰和垂直拉链；搭配同色系的奶油色长裤，侧面带有红色拼接；内层穿着深色打底，在夹克开口处隐约可见。工作空间采用暖米色墙面、垂直木条板、木地板、嵌入式暗槽灯，并有柔和的红色轮廓光勾勒出人物线条。在他上方，墙面上悬浮着 2 行巨大的 3D 挤压霓虹文字：第一行用亮红色写着“{argument name="character name" default="Dilshad Hussain"}”，第二行写着“{argument name="role text" default="Ai Influencer"}”，其中“Ai”为红色，“Influencer”为亮白色，所有文字均带有斜角、阴影和发光边缘。背景中包含 3 个清晰可见的创意项目：左侧是一个贴满时尚和室内设计参考资料的大型软木项目，左下方是一个靠墙的白色项目，上面贴着服装照片和中性色色卡，右侧是一个竖立的时尚拼贴项目，以网格形式展示模特服装参考。采用奶油色、米色、暖棕色、红色和白色的精致编辑配色方案，呈现照片级的 3D 渲染效果、柔和的摄影棚灯光、浅景深、高细节的织物纹理、现代奢华的室内设计，并在右下角添加一个微小而精致的闪光/星形标记。画面中不得出现其他人、额外文字、水印或杂乱元素，保持构图简洁且充满抱负感。

templates.title: Lotus Pond in the Morning Mist

titleLocalized.zh: 薄雾晨曦荷花池

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic, fantastical natural landscape of a tranquil lotus pond at sunrise. At the center of the image, a tall, blue-grey heron stands in the shallow, reflecting water, its long neck in profile. The foreground is surrounded by large green lotus leaves and eight striking pink lotus blossoms: three large, blooming flowers in the lower left foreground; a bud about to open in the left front; a fully bloomed flower slightly to the left center; a closed, upright bud in the lower right center; a large, blooming flower in the lower right; and a smaller, blooming flower further to the right. On the far left, place an ancient, dark-colored weeping cherry tree, its twisted branches cascading long, pale pink blossoms onto the water. The background should include a hazy lake, forested hills, and silhouettes of tall pine trees. Warm, orange-gold sunlight rises in the upper right, and a small, distant Japanese-style pavilion or viewing platform stands on the right bank. Featuring soft morning mist, a luminous peach-pink sky, gentle sunlight, mirror-like water reflections, highly detailed petals and leaves, atmospheric depth, a dreamlike and tranquil atmosphere, and a photorealistic fantasy style, this image uses a 16:9 widescreen composition and contains no people, text, or watermarks. Optional custom details: Set the main bird to {argument name="bird species" default="Blue-grey heron"} Set the flower color to{argument name="lotus color" default="pink"} Set the time to{argument name="time of day" default="sunrise"} Set the scene to{argument name="setting" default="A Japanese garden lotus pond shrouded in mist"} and use{argument name="visual style" default="Cinematic Photorealistic Fantasy"} style.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅日出时分宁静荷花池的电影感奇幻自然景观。画面中心，一只高大的蓝灰色苍鹭伫立在浅浅的倒影水中，长颈呈侧影，水面映出它的倒影。前景环绕着巨大的绿色荷叶和整整 8 朵显眼的粉色荷花：左下前景有 3 朵盛开的大花，左前方有 1 个含苞待放的荷花蕾，中心偏左有 1 朵盛开的花，中右下方有 1 个直立的闭合花蕾，右下方有 1 朵盛开的大花，右侧较远处还有 1 朵较小的盛开花朵。最左侧放置一棵古老的深色垂枝樱花树，扭曲的枝干将长长的淡粉色花帘垂落在水面上。背景应包含朦胧的湖面、森林覆盖的丘陵和高大的松树剪影，温暖的橙金色阳光在右上侧升起，右侧岸边有一座小巧遥远的日式凉亭或观景台。采用柔和的晨雾、发光的桃红色天空、柔和的阳光、镜面般的水面倒影、高度细腻的花瓣和叶片、大气深度、梦幻宁静的氛围、照片级奇幻写实风格，采用 16:9 宽屏构图，画面中无人、无文字、无水印。可选自定义细节：将主鸟设为 {argument name="bird species" default="蓝灰色苍鹭"}，将花朵颜色设为 {argument name="lotus color" default="粉色"}，将时间设为 {argument name="time of day" default="日出"}，将场景设为 {argument name="setting" default="薄雾缭绕的日式花园荷花池"}，并使用 {argument name="visual style" default="电影感照片级奇幻写实"} 风格。

templates.title: Tranquil egrets in the lotus pond at dawn

titleLocalized.zh: 宁静鹭影荷塘晨曦

templates.prompt: Create a tranquil impressionist oil painting depicting a serene lotus pond at sunrise. In the shallow water of the right-middle foreground, an elegant blue-grey heron stands, surrounded by reeds and water lilies. The sky is adorned with soft peach, coral, pale purple, and pale yellow clouds, and the low-hanging sun casts a warm reflection on the misty lake surface near the distant horizon. On the right bank, a weeping willow tree with drooping branches and pale pink blossoms stands; hazy tree shadows are faintly visible in the background, and morning mist gently floats on the water. The pond's surface is smooth as a mirror yet bears brushstrokes, reflecting the sky, the heron, the reeds, and the blossoms. Sixteen lotus/water lilies should be clearly depicted: four clustered in the lower left foreground, four small pink blossoms in the middle water near the heron, and eight scattered among the water lily leaves in the right foreground and middle ground. Using verdant water lily leaves, gentle ripples, a profound atmosphere, romantic soft light and shadow, and loosely visible brushstrokes, a dreamlike and tranquil artistic conception is created. The landscape composition employs high detail, a wide horizontal canvas, and contains no text, figures, or architecture.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅宁静的印象派油画，描绘日出时分静谧的荷塘。画面右中前景的浅水中，站立着一只优雅的蓝灰色苍鹭，周围环绕着芦苇和睡莲。天空呈现出柔和的桃红、珊瑚色、淡紫色和浅黄色云彩，低垂的太阳位于远方地平线附近，在雾气缭绕的湖面上投下温暖的倒影。右岸绘有一棵垂柳，枝条低垂，开满淡粉色的花朵；背景中隐约可见朦胧的树影，晨雾在水面上轻轻浮动。池塘表面如镜面般平滑但带有笔触感，倒映着天空、苍鹭、芦苇和花朵。画面中需清晰呈现 16 朵荷花/睡莲：左下角前景簇拥着 4 朵，苍鹭附近的中水域有 4 朵小粉花，右侧前景及中景的睡莲叶丛中分布着 8 朵。运用翠绿的睡莲叶、柔和的涟漪、深邃的氛围感、浪漫的柔和光影、松散可见的笔触，营造出梦幻宁静的意境。采用高细节的绘画风景构图，宽幅横向画布，无文字，无人物，无建筑。

templates.title: Sunrise over Luhu Lake shrouded in mist

titleLocalized.zh: 雾气缭绕的鹭湖日出

templates.prompt: Create a dreamlike impressionist oil painting depicting a tranquil, misty lake at sunrise, using a wide, cinematic horizontal composition. An elegant blue-grey heron stands in the shallow water, slightly to the right of center, surrounded by reeds and water lilies, its perfect reflection mirrored in the calm surface. Use soft dawn hues: peach, coral, lavender, pale yellow, turquoise, and soft blue-green; the rising sun shines near the central horizon, casting a vertical path of light and shadow on the lake. On the right bank, paint a willow tree covered in pale pink blossoms, its drooping branches hanging over the water; in the distance, the shore is dotted with hazy forest silhouettes and low-hanging morning mist. The painting should include 17 clearly defined water lilies: 4 clustered in the lower left foreground, 3 in the central area around the heron, and 10 scattered in the foreground and middle ground on the right. Add abundant rounded green water lilies and towering reeds, but maintain a tranquil and uncluttered composition. Style: Romantic landscape painting, visible brushstrokes, soft edges, atmospheric depth, bright reflections; no text, no figures, no architecture. Customizable elements:{argument name="main bird" default="blue-gray heron"} ,{argument name="time of day" default="sunrise"} ,{argument name="flower color" default="pale pink and white"} ,{argument name="painting style" default="impressionist oil painting"} ,{argument name="mood" default="peaceful and dreamy"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅梦幻般的印象派油画，描绘日出时分宁静的雾中湖泊，采用宽幅电影感横向构图。画面中心偏右的浅水中站立着一只优雅的蓝灰色苍鹭，周围环绕着芦苇和睡莲，平静的水面映出其完整的倒影。使用柔和的黎明色调：桃色、珊瑚色、薰衣草色、淡黄色、绿松石色以及柔和的蓝绿色；初升的太阳在中心地平线附近发光，在湖面上投射出一条垂直的光影路径。在右岸，绘制一棵覆盖着淡粉色花朵的柳树，下垂的枝条悬垂在水面上；远处的岸边点缀着朦胧的森林剪影和低垂的晨雾。画面中需包含 17 朵清晰的睡莲：左下角前景簇拥 4 朵，苍鹭周围中心区域 3 朵，右侧前景及中景散布 10 朵。添加丰富的圆形绿叶睡莲和高耸的芦苇，但保持构图宁静且不杂乱。风格：浪漫主义风景画、可见的笔触、柔和的边缘、大气深度、明亮的反光，无文字，无人物，无建筑。可自定义元素：{argument name="main bird" default="blue-gray heron"}，{argument name="time of day" default="sunrise"}，{argument name="flower color" default="pale pink and white"}，{argument name="painting style" default="impressionist oil painting"}，{argument name="mood" default="peaceful and dreamy"}。
