The top right quadrant contains a large, cropped blue asteroid with a glowing atmospheric edge, a visible curved horizon, fine surface texture, and a bright cyan edge light. Visual style: crisp, high-detail pixel art/16-bit game asset style, dramatic blue lighting effects, high contrast, no blur, no UI, no spaceships, no characters, no text, no watermark.{argument name="dominant color" default="Electric Blue and Deep Navy Blue"} ,{argument name="aspect ratio" default="Vertical 9:16"} ,{argument name="central gameplay corridor" default="Wide vertical blank channel"} ,{argument name="planet position" default="upper right quadrant"} , as well as{argument name="asteroid count" default="34 visible asteroids"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个垂直复古像素风太空射击游戏背景，采用 9:16 移动游戏比例，设计为具有无缝滚动感的关卡背景。场景为深邃的外太空，背景为深海军蓝至黑色的星空，中央留有宽阔的空白飞行通道以供游戏进行。在通道左中和右中边缘垂直添加两条发光的蓝色星云流，并点缀青色粒子、明亮的小星星和偶尔闪烁的星光。在通道周围布置小行星带：共计 34 颗可见的岩石小行星，大小不一，形状不规则且呈锯齿状，表面为深炭灰色，边缘带有电光蓝色的轮廓光。具体布局如下：左上角 1 颗巨大的被裁剪小行星，左侧边缘中部 1 颗巨大的被裁剪小行星，左下边缘附近 1 颗大型小行星，左下角 1 颗大型被裁剪小行星，右上边缘附近 1 颗大型小行星，右侧边缘中部 1 颗大型小行星，右下边缘 1 颗大型被裁剪小行星，右下角附近 1 颗大型小行星，外加 26 颗较小的小行星散布在左右两侧，同时保持中央区域开阔。在右上象限包含一颗被裁剪的巨大蓝色行星，具有发光的大气边缘、可见的弧形地平线、细腻的表面纹理以及明亮的青色边缘光。视觉风格：清晰的高细节像素艺术 / 16 位游戏资产风格，戏剧性的蓝色光效，强对比度，无模糊，无 UI，无飞船，无角色，无文字，无水印。使用 {argument name="dominant color" default="电光蓝与深海军蓝"}, {argument name="aspect ratio" default="垂直 9:16"}, {argument name="central gameplay corridor" default="宽阔的垂直空白通道"}, {argument name="planet position" default="右上象限"}, 以及 {argument name="asteroid count" default="34 颗可见小行星"}。

templates.title: Retro Space Shooter VFX Sprite Gallery

titleLocalized.zh: 复古太空射击游戏 VFX 精灵图集

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a clean, white background atlas for a vertically scrolling, retro pixel-art space shooter game, showcasing individual bullet patterns, explosions, loot, asteroids, and particle effects while maintaining a consistent 2D pixel art style. Canvas: 1:1 square sprite atlas, approximately 768×768 pixels, pure white background, no grid, no labels, no borders; assets are evenly distributed in horizontal rows, with transparent blank areas around each asset. Visual Style: High-resolution retro pixel art with sharp edges, neon lighting effects, saturated colors, arcade shooter VFX style, using black or dark outlines only where necessary, with additive glowing halos, and no text. Color Palette: Using three primary energy colors:{argument name="cyan energy color" default="Electric Blue"} ,{argument name="purple energy color" default="Violet"} and{argument name="green energy color" default="Bright lemon green"} In addition, there's orange/yellow for explosions and grayish-brown for asteroids. Layout and Precise Material Quantity: 103 visible sprites arranged in 8 rows. Row 1: 17 cyan player-shooting sprites, including micro bullets, small teardrop bullets, medium diamond bullets, paired vertical bullets, triple clusters, fragmentation volleys, three narrow exclamation mark bullets, two long laser beams, one large glowing missile-shaped spear, and two cyan starburst impact flashes. Row 2: 16 purple enemy-shooting sprites, including small round bullets, large spheres, thin diamond bullets, paired bullets, triple clusters, fragmentation clusters, three vertical capsule bullets, three single vertical bullets, and two purple starburst impacts. Row 3: 16 green enemy-shooting sprites matching the purple row type: small diamond bullets, large diamond bullets, bright spear bullets, paired bullets, triple clusters, fragmentation clusters, three capsule bullets, three single vertical bullets, and two green starburst impacts. Row 4: 15 Special Energy Sprites: Three circular neon spheres in cyan, purple, and green; three cracked plasma spheres in cyan, purple, and green; three vertical ground-striking laser beams in cyan, purple, and green (with splash bases); one solid cyan vertical beam; and three ring-shaped water droplet portal effects in cyan, purple, and green. Row 5: 9 Explosion and Impact Sprites: Five orange flame explosions of varying sizes, followed by four purple electric shock bursts of varying sizes, ending with a small diamond-shaped flash. Row 6: 10 Game Objects and Bullet Barrages: A green life-collecting icon with a white plus sign, a green mechanical enhancement module, a dark spiked mine, four orange arrow/fireball bullet frames pointing to the right, and three purple tracking/particle bullet clusters. Row 7: 10 Asteroid/Fragment Sprites: Six rocky asteroids ranging from large to pebble-sized, followed by four clusters of broken rock fragments. Line 8: 10 Particle Flash Clusters: two cyan flash clusters, two purple flash clusters, two green flash clusters, two orange flash clusters, and two sparse orange trailing flash clusters. Main Details: Ensure the bullet hell is clearly identifiable as an independent game sprite, with each sprite centered within its empty area. Energy bullets should be symmetrical, vertically oriented where appropriate, and have a soft halo. Explosions should use a layered yellow core, orange petals, red outline, and scattered sparks. Asteroids should be irregular dark rock shapes with pixel highlights and shadows. Pickups should be more prominent and icon-like than the bullet hell. Constraints: Generate only sprite atlas assets, not game screenshots. No background scenes, no UI, no characters, no spaceships, no typography, no watermarks. Keep each asset independent and ready to be directly cut into tiles or sprites.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为竖版复古像素风太空射击游戏创建一套干净的白色背景生产素材图集，展示独立的流光弹幕、爆炸、拾取物、小行星和粒子特效，并保持统一的 2D 像素艺术风格。

画布：1:1 正方形精灵图集，约 768×768 像素，纯白背景，无网格、无标签、无边框，素材在水平行中均匀分布，每个素材周围留有透明感的空白区域。

视觉风格：高分辨率复古像素艺术，边缘清晰，带有霓虹光效，色彩饱和，街机射击游戏 VFX 风格，仅在必要处使用黑色或深色轮廓，带有加法混合的辉光光晕，无文字。

调色板：使用三种主要能量色：{argument name="cyan energy color" default="电光青"}、{argument name="purple energy color" default="洋紫罗兰"} 和 {argument name="green energy color" default="亮柠檬绿"}，外加用于爆炸的橙色/黄色以及用于小行星的灰褐色。

布局与精确素材数量：在 8 行中排列 103 个可见精灵。第 1 行：17 个青色玩家射击精灵，包括微型子弹、小水滴弹、中型菱形弹、成对垂直弹、三连簇射、碎片齐射、三个窄感叹号状弹、两条长激光束、一个大型发光导弹状长矛和两个青色星爆冲击闪光。第 2 行：16 个紫色敌方射击精灵，包括小圆弹、大型球体、细菱形弹、成对弹、三连簇射、碎片簇、三个垂直胶囊弹、三个单发垂直弹和两个紫色星爆冲击。第 3 行：16 个与紫色行类型匹配的绿色敌方射击精灵：小菱形弹、大型菱形弹、明亮长矛弹、成对弹、三连簇射、碎片簇、三个胶囊弹、三个单发垂直弹和两个绿色星爆冲击。第 4 行：15 个特殊能量精灵：三个青、紫、绿色的圆形霓虹球；三个青、紫、绿色的裂纹等离子球；三个青、紫、绿色的垂直地面打击激光柱（带溅射底座）；一个实心青色垂直光束；以及三个青、紫、绿色的环上水滴传送门特效。第 5 行：9 个爆炸与冲击精灵：五个从大到小的橙色火焰爆炸，随后是四个从中到小的紫色电击冲击爆发，末尾带有一个小菱形闪光。第 6 行：10 个游戏对象和小弹幕：一个带白色加号的绿色生命拾取图标、一个绿色机械强化模块、一个深色尖刺地雷、四个朝右的橙色箭头/火球弹幕帧，以及三个紫色追踪/粒子弹幕簇。第 7 行：10 个小行星/碎片精灵：六个从大到鹅卵石大小的岩石小行星，随后是四个破碎的岩石碎片簇。第 8 行：10 个粒子闪光簇：两个青色闪光簇、两个紫色闪光簇、两个绿色闪光簇、两个橙色闪光簇和两个稀疏的橙色拖尾闪光簇。

主体细节：确保弹幕作为独立的游戏精灵清晰可辨，每个精灵都居中于其空白区域内。能量子弹应保持对称，在适当的情况下垂直定向，并带有柔和的光晕。爆炸应使用分层的黄色核心、橙色花瓣、红色轮廓和散落的火花。小行星应为不规则的深色岩石形态，带有像素高光和阴影。拾取物应比弹幕更醒目、更具图标感。

约束：仅生成精灵图集素材，而非游戏截图。无背景场景、无 UI、无角色、无飞船、无排版、无水印。保持每个素材独立，并可直接用于切割成瓦片或精灵。

templates.title: Vertical pixel-style space shooting game background

titleLocalized.zh: 竖版像素风太空射击游戏背景

templates.prompt: Create a vertical, retro pixel-style scrolling background for a space shooter game, designed as a seamless mobile game asset. The canvas uses a high-ratio 9:16 vertical screen frame, with a dark central flight path left mostly blank for gameplay. The scene is filled with a deep black starry sky, adorned with hundreds of tiny white, blue, and purple pixel stars, and two luminous vertical nebula streams: a winding, electric purple-blue nebula on the left and a purple nebula with cyan highlights on the right. Add three clearly visible planets: a large purple cratered planet at the upper left edge, a partially cropped blue-purple outlined planet at the lower right edge, and a small purple moon below the lower right planet. Add 22 rocky asteroids of varying sizes, irregularly shaped, cratered grayish-brown with purple shading, distributed around the edges while keeping the central area open: one large asteroid near the top right corner, one medium-sized asteroid on the right central edge, one medium-sized asteroid on the bottom left edge, one large asteroid cropped in the bottom left corner, one large asteroid cropped in the bottom right corner, and the remaining 17 smaller asteroids scattered along the top, sides, and bottom edges. Use a crisp pixel art rendering with high-detail jitter, thick jagged outlines, bright edge highlights, no vector smoothing, no spaceships, no UI, no text, and no watermarks. Color palette: black space, magenta nebulae, electric blue accents, white starlight, and gray rocky asteroids with cool purple shading. The image should have a production-ready vertical flight shooter background effect, both dramatic and highly readable, ensuring a clear central game path.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖版复古像素风太空射击游戏滚动背景，设计为无缝衔接的移动端游戏素材。画布采用 9:16 的高比例竖屏框架，深色的中央飞行通道保持大部分留白，以供游戏操作。场景填充深邃的黑色星空，点缀数百颗细小的白色、蓝色和紫色像素星点，以及两条发光的垂直星云流：左侧是一条蜿蜒而下的电光紫蓝色星云，右侧是一条带有青色高光的紫色星云。添加 3 颗清晰可见的行星：左上方边缘有一颗巨大的紫色陨石坑行星，右下方边缘有一颗被部分裁剪的蓝紫色轮廓光行星，以及在那颗右下行星下方的一颗小型紫色卫星。添加 22 颗大小不一的岩石小行星，形状为带有紫色阴影的不规则灰褐色坑洼状，分布在边界周围，同时保持中心区域开阔：右上角附近 1 颗巨大陨石，右侧中部边缘 1 颗中型陨石，左下边缘 1 颗中型陨石，左下角 1 颗被裁剪的大型陨石，右下角 1 颗被裁剪的大型陨石，其余 17 颗较小陨石散布在顶部边缘、侧边和底部边界。采用清晰的像素艺术渲染，具备高细节的抖动效果、厚实的锯齿轮廓、明亮的边缘高光，无矢量平滑轮廓，无飞船，无 UI，无文字，无水印。调色板：黑色太空、紫红色星云云团、电光蓝点缀、白色星光闪烁、带有冷紫色阴影的灰色岩石小行星。图像应呈现出可直接用于生产的竖版飞行射击游戏背景图效果，既具戏剧性又具备良好的可读性，确保中心游戏通道清晰。

templates.title: Retro pixel-style space shooting game sprite image

titleLocalized.zh: 复古像素风太空射击游戏精灵图

templates.prompt: Create a clean, sprite-style image for a vertical, retro pixel-art space shooter game. The background is pure white, without grids or tags. Showcase 11 individual pixel art spaceship and prop sprites, arranged in three rows, all featuring sharp black outlines, high-contrast shadows, metallic panels, tiny vents, glowing cores, and 16-bit arcade details. Use a saturated sci-fi color scheme, with the main color being {argument name="main ship color" default="Deep violet"} The layout is accented with cyan/blue-green, deep navy blue, black, and gold/orange armor, as well as neon green energy lights. The top row contains three large player/enemy ships: on the left is a small, triangular fighter in blue, white, and gold, with three bright cyan engine flames; in the middle is the largest wide-body boss ship, symmetrical and heavily armored, with alternating purple and cyan colors, multiple wingtips, side cannons, gold decorations, and a large, glowing green hexagonal reactor in the center; on the right is a tall, vertical purple capital ship with a pointed nose, side fins, cyan panels, gold details, and a glowing green central reactor. The middle row contains four medium-sized enemy ships: a crescent-shaped cyan-purple aircraft with two upward-curving corners and a green cockpit glow; a compact, rear-viewing purple wing-shaped fighter with side thrusters; a short, stout central gunship with a cyan cockpit dome, purple wings, gold cannons, and twin-mounted cannons; and a large purple bomber with swept wings, side engine nacelles, and a large, dark central air intake. The bottom row contains four small collectible item or module sprites: two square neon green reactor blocks with beveled purple/cyan/gold borders; followed by two identical cylindrical engine or booster bays with cyan top covers, purple bodies, gold front panels, black exhaust vents, and tiny side fins. Style restrictions: Production-grade pixel art, orthogonal/top-down perspective, with a transparent texture but rendered on a white background, crisp square pixels, no anti-aliasing, no text, no watermarks, no shadows other than pixel art contact shadows, consistent proportions, hierarchy, and spacing, presenting a refined mobile shooter atlas effect.

promptLocalized.zh:
创建一个干净的精灵图风格素材图像，用于竖版复古像素风太空射击游戏，背景为纯白色，无网格，无标签。展示 11 个独立的像素艺术宇宙飞船和道具精灵图，排列成三行，均具有清晰的黑色轮廓、高对比度阴影、金属面板、微小通风口、发光核心和 16 位街机细节。使用饱和的科幻配色方案，主色调为 {argument name="main ship color" default="深紫罗兰色"}，辅以青色/蓝绿色、深海军蓝、黑色、金色/橙色装甲点缀以及霓虹绿能量灯。

布局：顶行包含 3 个大型玩家/敌方飞船：左侧为小型蓝白金三色三角形战斗机，带有三个明亮的青色引擎火焰；中间为最大的宽体 Boss 飞船，对称且装甲厚重，紫色与青色相间，带有多个翼尖、双侧炮、金色装饰以及中央一个巨大的发光绿色六边形反应堆；右侧为高大的垂直紫色主力舰，带有尖头、侧鳍、青色面板、金色细节和发光绿色中央反应堆。中间行包含 4 个中型敌方飞船：一个新月形的青紫色飞行器，带有两个向上弯曲的角和绿色的驾驶舱光芒；一个紧凑的后视紫色翼型战斗机，带有侧推进器；一个矮胖的中央炮艇，带有青色驾驶舱圆顶、紫色机翼、金色炮管和双联装火炮；一个宽大的紫色轰炸机，带有后掠翼、侧引擎舱和巨大的深色中央进气口。底行包含 4 个小型可收集道具或模块精灵图：两个方形霓虹绿反应堆道具块，带有斜面紫色/青色/金色边框；随后是两个相同的圆柱形引擎或助推器舱，带有青色顶盖、紫色主体、金色前板、黑色排气口和微小的侧鳍。

风格限制：生产级像素艺术，正交/俯视视角，具有透明素材感但渲染在白色背景上，清晰的方形像素，无抗锯齿绘画感，无文字，无水印，除像素艺术接触阴影外无其他阴影，保持一致的比例层级和间距，呈现出精致的移动端射击游戏图集效果。

templates.title: Retro Golden Age Idol Posters

titleLocalized.zh: 复古黄金时代偶像海报

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a vertical, retro movie star poster, styled after old "Golden Age icon" archival documents, using {argument name="celebrity name" default="KYRIE CHEUNG"} As the main typography, the right side features a melancholic profile portrait. Canvas: Portrait poster, 2:3 aspect ratio, dark sepia and burnt red tones, aged paper texture, worn edges, scratches, dust, faded ink, subtle vignetting, archival confidential document aesthetics. Layout: The left third is a re-typographical area; the right two-thirds show a young East Asian man standing in profile, facing left. The upper left corner contains a boxed label with a thin horizontal line, two small stars, and a circular dragon emblem, inside which is written "GOLDEN ERA ICON". Below this is a large stacked, compressed block of letters: "KYRIE" above, "CHEUNG" below, in a tall, vintage gold font. Below the names, a thin dividing line with small stars is added, followed by the year label "2020s". Below this, a quote is added.{argument name="quote text" default=""Everyone else is gay, but I am straight.""} The lettering is in gold and mixes Chinese characters with the English words "Gay" and "Straight." The lower left corner contains a faded red circular stamp that reads "ARCHIVE / CLASSIFIED / UNDERWORLD." The bottom left side reads {argument name="file label" default="FILE No.01"} Adorned with fine decorative lines and small star/floral decorations. Main details: The figure is a slender young East Asian male with dark, slightly messy medium-length hair, shown in profile from head to thigh on the right side. His face is deliberately blurred/obscured by a rectangular soft-focus block. He wears a loose, off-white long-sleeved shirt with rolled-up cuffs, tucked into dark high-waisted trousers, and a black leather belt. One hand is in his pocket, and a watch is on his wrist. The posture is relaxed, elegant, and understated. Background: A dark ancient Chinese architectural scene with deep red walls, a shadowed rooftop, decorative circular roof ornaments, and patterned borders. The lighting is dim, dramatic, warm, and directional, casting soft shadows that emphasize the atmosphere of a retro poster. Visual style: A combination of Chinese film noir posters from the 1930s to 1970s with modern editorial photography, grainy film texture, letterpress typography, aged gold ink, high contrast, cinematic shadows, and a historical archival design. Uses one portrait figure, one dragon emblem, two large name words, one year label, one quotation block, one circular confidential seal, and one document number block. No additional logos or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张垂直的复古电影名人海报，风格仿照陈旧的“黄金时代偶像”档案文件，以 {argument name="celebrity name" default="KYRIE CHEUNG"} 作为主要排版，右侧配以忧郁的侧面肖像。

画布：肖像海报，2:3 纵横比，深褐色与焦红色调，做旧纸张纹理，磨损边缘，划痕，灰尘，褪色墨迹，微妙的暗角，档案机密文件美学。

布局：左侧三分之一为重排版区域；右侧三分之二展示一名年轻东亚男性侧身站立，面向左侧。左上角包含一个带细横线、两颗小星和一个圆形龙纹徽章的方框标签，内写“GOLDEN ERA ICON”。下方放置巨大的堆叠压缩块状字母：“KYRIE”在上，“CHEUNG”在下，采用高大的复古金色字体。在名字下方，添加一条带有小星的细分隔线，然后是年代标签“2020s”。在其下方，添加引语 {argument name="quote text" default="“世人皆 Gay, 我独Straight”"}，采用金色字体，混合中文字符与英文单词 Gay 和 Straight。左下角包含一个褪色的红色圆形印章，写着“ARCHIVE / CLASSIFIED / UNDERWORLD”。底部左侧写有 {argument name="file label" default="FILE No.01"}，配以细装饰线和小型星形/花卉装饰。

主体细节：人物为一名身材苗条的年轻东亚男性，留着深色、略显凌乱的中长发，从头部到大腿的右侧侧面展示。他的面部被一个矩形柔焦块刻意模糊/遮挡。他穿着一件宽松的米白色长袖衬衫，袖口卷起，束在深色高腰长裤内，系着黑色皮带。一只手插在裤兜里，手腕上戴着手表。姿态放松、优雅且内敛。

背景：深色的中国古代建筑场景，配有深红色墙壁、顶部的阴影屋檐、装饰性圆形屋顶饰物和图案饰边。光线昏暗、戏剧化、温暖且具有方向性，投射出柔和的阴影，强调复古海报的氛围。

视觉风格：1930 年代至 1970 年代的中国黑色电影海报与现代编辑摄影的结合，颗粒感胶片纹理，凸版印刷排版，陈旧的金色墨水，高对比度，电影级阴影，历史档案设计。使用 1 个肖像人物、1 个龙纹徽章、2 个大型名字单词、1 个年代标签、1 个引语块、1 个圆形机密印章和 1 个文件编号块。不含额外的标志或水印。

templates.title: TinyToes Giant Baby Shoe Advertisement

titleLocalized.zh: TinyToes 巨型婴儿鞋广告

templates.prompt: for{argument name="brand name" default="TINYTOES"} Create a vertical, heartwarming baby product advertising poster. Use a soft cream-colored studio background with the brand name repeated in five large lines of pale pink round font, partially obscured by the foreground. In the center of the foreground, display two enormous, plush, pale pink Mary Jane baby shoes, approximately 2.5 times the height of a kneeling adult. These shoes are made of plush material, have rounded toes, padded openings, pull tabs, and wide Velcro straps. Embroider the brand name in raised white lettering on each strap, and add a small pink bow to the outside of each strap, for a total of two bows. A young mother with long brown hair kneels on the left, leaning against the giant shoes with a warm smile and a slight forward lean; she wears a cream-colored ribbed sweater, beige pants, and socks, embodying a gentle lifestyle advertising pose. Scatter playful parenting decorations around the scene: six floating pale blue, pink, and yellow fluffy hearts; two small fluffy stars; and small pieces of confetti in the background and on the ground. Maintain bright, soft, and clear lighting with subtle shadows to convey the realism of high-end product photography, soft colors, comfortable texture details, and a warm, baby-brand atmosphere. Add a large, soft rose-colored rounded lettering tagline at the bottom:{argument name="slogan text" default="Every tiny step matters."} Ensure the posters present a sophisticated baby shoe advertisement feel, with no extra logos, no watermarks, and no glaring colors.

promptLocalized.zh: 为 {argument name="brand name" default="TINYTOES"} 创建一张竖版温馨的婴儿产品广告海报。使用柔和的奶油色摄影棚背景，背景中以五行巨大的淡粉色圆体字重复品牌名称，并被前景部分遮挡。在前景中央，展示两只巨大的毛绒淡粉色婴儿玛丽珍鞋，高度约为跪姿成年人的 2.5 倍，采用毛绒材质，圆头设计，配有加厚鞋口、提拉环和宽大的魔术贴绑带。在每条绑带上用凸起的白色字母绣上品牌名称，并在每条绑带外侧各加一个小粉色蝴蝶结，总共两个蝴蝶结。一位留着棕色长发的年轻母亲跪在左侧，靠在巨型鞋子旁，面带温暖的微笑，身体微微前倾；她穿着奶油色罗纹针织衫、米色裤子和袜子，呈现出柔和的生活方式广告姿态。在场景周围散布俏皮的育儿装饰：六个漂浮的淡蓝色、粉色和黄色蓬松爱心；两个小巧的蓬松星星；以及背景和地面上的小纸屑。保持光线明亮、柔和、通透，带有微妙的阴影，呈现高端产品摄影的真实感、柔和的色彩、舒适的质感细节以及温馨的婴儿品牌氛围。在底部添加大号柔和玫瑰色圆体字标语：{argument name="slogan text" default="Every tiny step matters."}。确保海报呈现出精致的婴儿鞋广告质感，无额外标志，无水印，无刺眼的颜色。

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="character name" default="Kyrie Cheung"} Create a vertical, retro celebrity archive poster, styled after worn-out archives of Golden Age movie icons. Canvas: 2:3 portrait poster, deep sepia and burnt red tones, heavy grain texture, worn paper edges, faded ink, dust, stains, and an aged printing effect. Use dramatic low-key lighting and cinematic shadows. Layout: Divided composition, with typography on the left and a full-body fashion portrait on the right. The left side contains 6 precise text/graphic blocks: 1) A small badge at the top reading "GOLDEN ERA ICON," complete with a circular dragon logo, two horizontal lines, and two small stars; 2) A large, stacked, compact serif title block with "KYRIE" above and "CHEUNG" below; 3) A small divider with a star in the center and the text "2020s"; 4) A quote block containing {argument name="quote" default=""Everyone else is gay, but I am straight.""} 5) A red circular stamp that reads "ARCHIVE / CLASSIFIED / UNDERWORLD"; 6) A file label at the bottom with the following content.{argument name="file number" default="FILE No.01"} It features fine lines and tiny decorative star/floral markings. Subject details: On the right, a slender young East Asian male is shown in profile, facing left, in a relaxed pose, one hand in his pocket. He wears a cream-colored pleated shirt with the sleeves rolled up to his forearms, paired with high-waisted dark trousers, a black belt, and a watch. His hair is short, thick, black, and slightly messy. The face is obscured or examined with soft rectangular blurs/pixel blocks of brown skin tone to conceal his identity. Background and decoration: The background is a dark reddish-brown interior wall topped with details of a traditional Chinese roof. Four clearly visible circular roof ornaments are included at the top edge, with a fabric-like trim below. Dark shadows are added behind the figure on the right. Visual style: Retro Asian film noir poster, archival aesthetics from the 1930s to the 1970s, tall, bold movable type typography, dark gold ink, blackened edges, worn borders, subtle vignetting, a combination of realistic portrait photography and graphic poster design. Constraints: Keep all visible text clear and aged, retain all Chinese quotations, do not add extra characters, do not add modern and minimalist UI elements, and avoid using bright and saturated colors.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="Kyrie Cheung"} 创建一张竖版复古名人档案海报，风格仿照磨损的黄金时代电影偶像档案。

画布：2:3 比例肖像海报，深棕褐色与焦红色调，厚重的颗粒质感，磨损的纸张边缘，褪色的墨迹、灰尘、污渍以及做旧的印刷老化效果。使用戏剧性的低调照明和电影感阴影。

布局：分割构图，左侧以排版为主，右侧为全身时尚肖像。左侧包含 6 个精确的文字/图形区块：1) 顶部一个小徽章，写有“GOLDEN ERA ICON”，配有圆形龙纹徽标、两条水平线和 2 颗小星星；2) 一个巨大的堆叠式紧凑衬线字体标题，上方为“KYRIE”，下方为“CHEUNG”；3) 一个小型分隔符，中间有一颗星，文字为“2020s”；4) 一个引语区块，内容为 {argument name="quote" default="“世人皆 Gay, 我独Straight”"}；5) 一个红色的圆形印章，写有“ARCHIVE / CLASSIFIED / UNDERWORLD”；6) 底部一个文件标签，内容为 {argument name="file number" default="FILE No.01"}，配有细线和微小的装饰性星形/花卉标记。

主体细节：在右侧，展示一名身材瘦削的年轻东亚男性侧影，面朝左侧，姿态放松，一只手插在裤兜里。他穿着一件米白色褶皱衬衫，袖子卷至前臂，搭配高腰深色长裤、黑色腰带和手表。他的头发短而浓密，黑色，略显凌乱。用棕色肤色的柔和矩形模糊/像素块遮盖或审查面部，以隐藏身份。

背景与装饰：背景为昏暗的红棕色室内墙壁，顶部带有传统中式屋檐细节。在上边缘包含 4 个清晰可见的圆形屋顶装饰，下方有类似布艺的饰边。在右侧人物身后添加深色阴影。

视觉风格：复古亚洲黑色电影海报，1930 年代至 1970 年代的档案美学，高大的粗体活字印刷排版，暗金色墨水，黑化的边角，磨损的边框，微妙的暗角，写实人像摄影与图形海报设计的结合。

约束条件：保持所有可见文字清晰且具有做旧感，完整保留中文引语，不要添加额外人物，不要添加现代简洁的 UI 元素，避免使用明亮饱和的色彩。

templates.title: Peach Blossom Fairy Tale First Encounter

titleLocalized.zh: 桃花仙侠初遇

templates.prompt: Create a romantic fantasy poster with a cinematic feel, depicting {argument name="character name" default="Zhao Ling'er"} The scene depicting the first encounter amidst peach blossoms is framed in a 2:3 vertical composition. The image features a young, innocent, and gentle Chinese fairy, dressed in flowing robes.{argument name="dress color" default="light blue and white"} Wearing Hanfu, she stands beside a clear, turquoise stream, turning to look at the audience, one arm outstretched as if inviting them to take her hand. Her long, black hair is half-up in an elegant bun, adorned with flower hairpins, silver ornaments, and beads; long, translucent blue ribbons flutter in the breeze. The skirt and cuffs are layered, light, and lustrous, complemented by a dark waistband and exquisite, fantastical embroidery. Her face is covered by a simple square of light brown mosaic. She is surrounded by lush pink peach blossoms: branches arch at the top and sides, flowers create a dreamy, blurred foreground, and scattered petals drift in the air. Background: An idyllic ancient Chinese valley, with traditional wooden pavilions on the left and middle ground, an arched stone bridge over the stream, moss-covered rocks, shimmering water reflecting light, and verdant mountains faintly visible in the bright morning mist. Atmosphere: Not dark, oppressive, cold, or tragic; rather, it is pure, gentle, vivid, lovely, touching, and innocent. It employs a highly detailed, cinematic realism style, with soft pastel tones, bright backlighting in the upper right corner, shallow depth of field, soft lens flare, shimmering highlights on the water, falling petals, an ethereal fairytale atmosphere, and a high-end movie poster quality. No text, no logo, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影感浪漫仙侠海报，描绘 {argument name="character name" default="赵灵儿"} 在桃花初遇时的场景，采用 2:3 竖构图。画面中是一位年轻、纯真、温婉的中国仙女，身着飘逸的 {argument name="dress color" default="浅蓝白色"} 汉服，站在清澈的绿松石色溪流旁，回眸看向观众，一只手臂向前伸出，仿佛在邀请观众牵起她的手。她乌黑的长发半挽成优雅的发髻，饰有花朵发簪、银饰、珠串，长长的半透明蓝色丝带在微风中飘动；裙摆和袖口层叠、轻盈且富有光泽，配有深色腰封和精致的奇幻刺绣。面部区域覆盖着一个简单的方形浅棕色马赛克遮挡块。周围环绕着繁茂的粉色桃花：枝条在顶部和两侧拱起，花朵以梦幻的虚化效果构筑前景，零星花瓣在空中飘落。背景：一个田园诗般的中国古代山谷，左侧和中景处有传统木质亭台，溪流上有拱形石桥，布满青苔的岩石，波光粼粼的水面反射，以及在明亮晨雾中隐约可见的青翠山峦。氛围：非阴暗、非压抑、非冷峻或悲剧感；而是纯净、温柔、生动、可爱、动人心弦且天真烂漫。采用超细节的电影级写实风格，柔和的粉彩色调，右上方的明亮背光，浅景深，柔和的镜头光晕，闪烁的水面高光，飘落的花瓣，空灵的童话氛围，高端电影海报质感。无文字，无 Logo，无水印。

templates.title: AI conversation screenshots with women obscured

titleLocalized.zh: 带有遮挡女性的 AI 对话截图

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a realistic screenshot-style image showcasing a minimalist AI image generation dialog interface, including a generated photo result. Canvas: A white interface with a widescreen 16:9 aspect ratio, approximately 1200×690 pixels, with ample white space. A generated image card is centered on the left. Top Bubble: A rounded, light gray user message bubble containing Japanese text is placed near the top right corner.{argument name="prompt text" default="Two women are sitting facing each other, each with their index finger on the other's lips."} To the right or below the bubble, two small outline operation icons are displayed: a copy icon within a rounded square and a pencil/edit icon. Below the copy icon, a black tooltip box contains the white Japanese text: "メッセージをコピーする". Status text: "Thought for 34s ›" written in light gray in the upper left corner of the image card. Resulting image card: A large, rounded-corner photo card centered on the left. The card depicts two adult women sitting face-to-face in a warm studio portrait, cropped upwards from the mid-torso. The woman on the left has a messy, dark brown updo and wears a black lace-trimmed robe or blouse, turning to the right. The woman on the right has a loose, gold-streaked updo and wears a white lace-trimmed robe or blouse, turning to the left. They stood very close together, each raising one hand, with two index fingers visible in total: the index finger of the woman on the left touched or pointed to the lips of the woman on the right, and the index finger of the woman on the right touched or pointed to the lips of the woman on the left. Soft natural light and a beige-gray studio background were used to present realistic skin and fabric details. Each woman's face was covered with two vertical rectangular blur/mosaic blocks, the color of which matched her skin tone, obscuring facial features while preserving the visibility of hair and hands. Image card overlay: A white Japanese label "Collection" was added to the lower left corner of the photo card. A semi-transparent circular download/share button with a white upward arrow icon was added to the lower right corner of the photo card. Bottom interface controls: Two small controls were displayed in the lower left corner of the image card: an outline copy/repeat icon and a three-dot ellipsis icon. Visual style: Minimalist modern web UI, white background, rounded corners, subtle shadows, soft gray typography, and realistic generated images embedded within the interface. Constraints: Keep all visible text exactly the same as the specified content, preserve Japanese characters, do not add extra people, do not add extra fingers or UI buttons, and ensure that faces are occluded using rectangular blur blocks.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一张逼真的截图风格图像，展示一个简洁的 AI 图像生成对话界面，其中包含一张生成的照片结果。

画布：宽屏 16:9 左右的白色界面，尺寸约为 1200×690 像素，留白较多，左侧居中位置有一张生成的图像卡片。

顶部提示词气泡：在右上角附近放置一个圆角浅灰色用户消息气泡，内含日语文本：{argument name="prompt text" default="二人の女性が向かい合って座っている。お互い相手の唇に人差し指をあてている"}。在气泡的右侧或下方，显示 2 个小型的轮廓操作图标：一个圆角正方形内的复制图标和一个铅笔/编辑图标。在复制图标下方添加一个黑色工具提示框，内含白色日语文本：「メッセージをコピーする」。

状态文本：在图像卡片左上方，用浅灰色书写“Thought for 34s ›”。

生成的图像卡片：一张位于左侧居中的大圆角照片卡片。卡片内描绘 2 名成年女性在温暖的摄影棚肖像中面对面坐着，画面从躯干中部向上裁剪。左侧女性留着深棕色凌乱发髻，穿着黑色蕾丝边长袍或衬衫，侧身向右。右侧女性留着金色挑染的松散发髻，穿着白色蕾丝边长袍或衬衫，侧身向左。她们靠得非常近，每人举起一只手，总共可见 2 根食指：左侧女性的食指触碰或指向右侧女性的嘴唇，右侧女性的食指触碰或指向左侧女性的嘴唇。使用柔和的自然光，米灰色摄影棚背景，呈现逼真的皮肤和织物细节。用垂直矩形模糊/马赛克遮挡块覆盖每位女性的面部，遮挡块颜色与肤色匹配，总共 2 个遮挡块，在遮挡面部特征的同时保留头发和手部可见。

图像卡片叠加层：在照片卡片的左下角，添加白色日语标签「編集」。在照片卡片的右下角，添加一个带有白色向上箭头图标的半透明圆形下载/分享按钮。

底部界面控件：在图像卡片左下方，显示 2 个小型控件：一个轮廓复制/重复图标和一个三点省略号图标。

视觉风格：极简现代网页 UI，白色背景，圆角设计，细微阴影，柔和的灰色排版，界面内嵌入逼真的生成图像。

限制：保持所有可见文本与指定内容完全一致，保留日语字符，不要添加额外的人员，不要添加额外的手指或 UI 按钮，并确保面部使用矩形模糊块进行遮挡。

templates.title: Japanese AI Image Results UI

titleLocalized.zh: 日语 AI 图像结果 UI

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a clean, screenshot-style webpage that displays suggestions based on prompts.{argument name="prompt text" default="Two women are sitting facing each other, each with their index finger on the other's lips."} The AI ​​image generation result. Canvas: 1030×630 horizontal screenshot, white background, minimalist modern chat UI, ample white space, no browser border or watermark. Layout: A rounded light blue-gray user prompt bubble is placed near the upper right corner, approximately 605 px wide and 90 px high, containing dark gray Japanese prompt text. Below on the left, a small blue gradient flashing icon is added, followed by the Japanese tag "思考プロセスを表示" (to express thinking pros) and a small downward arrow. Centered to the lower left of this icon, a rounded generated image card, approximately 570×310 px in size, is placed. Below the image on the left, four feedback/action icons are displayed side-by-side: like, dislike, a circular regenerated arrow, and a vertical three-dot menu. The generated image card content: A realistic snapshot of a coffee shop, showing two adult women sitting face-to-face at a small wooden table by a large window. The woman on the left is wearing {argument name="left woman outfit" default="beige knit sweater and dark skirt"} The woman on the right is wearing {argument name="right woman outfit" default="White top with a blue denim jacket"} They leaned towards each other, gently placing their index fingers on each other's lips in a playful yet intimate mirrored gesture. Their faces were deliberately anonymized, each with a soft rectangular pixel/blur mask. The table contained four visible items: a glass of water, a small white cup, a saucer or small plate, and a smartphone. The café background was warm and inviting, furnished with wooden furniture, cushions, bookshelves, plants, and natural light from the window, with several blurry customers in the distance. Visual style: The surrounding interface should be clean, flat, and Google-esque, while the image cards should be realistic, featuring warm natural light, shallow depth of field, and a documentary style. Japanese UI text should be used accurately in designated locations. The composition must faithfully reproduce the AI-generated image embedded in the chat interface.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个简洁的截图风格网页界面，展示针对提示词 {argument name="prompt text" default="二人の女性が向かい合って座っている。お互い相手の唇に人差し指をあてている"} 的 AI 图像生成结果。

画布：1030×630 横向截图，白色背景，极简现代聊天 UI，留白充足，无浏览器边框或水印。

布局：在右上角附近放置一个圆角浅蓝灰色用户提示气泡，宽约 605 px，高约 90 px，内含深灰色日语提示文本。在下方左侧，添加一个小的蓝色渐变闪烁图标，后跟日语标签「思考プロセスを表示」以及一个小向下箭头。在该图标左下方居中位置，放置一张圆角生成的图像卡片，尺寸约为 570×310 px。在图像下方的左侧，并排显示 4 个反馈/操作图标：点赞、点踩、圆形重新生成箭头以及垂直三点菜单。

生成的图像卡片内容：一张写实的咖啡馆抓拍照片，画面中有 2 名成年女性面对面坐在大窗户旁的木制小桌前。左侧女性穿着 {argument name="left woman outfit" default="米色针织衫和深色裙子"}；右侧女性穿着 {argument name="right woman outfit" default="白色上衣外搭蓝色牛仔夹克"}。她们向对方倾身，同时将食指轻轻放在对方的嘴唇上，形成一种俏皮且亲密的镜像姿势。她们的面部经过刻意匿名处理，每张脸上各有一个柔和的矩形像素/模糊遮罩。桌面上包含 4 件可见物品：一杯水、一个小白杯、一个茶托或小盘子，以及一部智能手机。咖啡馆背景温暖舒适，配有木制家具、靠垫、书架、植物、窗外自然光，远处有几位模糊的顾客。

视觉风格：周围界面应清晰、扁平且具有 Google 风格，而图像卡片应呈现写实感，具备温暖的自然光、浅景深和纪实写实风格。在指定位置准确使用日语 UI 文本。构图需忠实于嵌入在聊天界面中的 AI 图像生成结果。

templates.title: Cyberpunk elves and war machines

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克精灵与战争机器

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed dark sci-fi anime illustration depicting a solitary cyberpunk elf girl standing on an industrial metal platform, facing a massive bio-mechanical war machine. The character is {argument name="character type" default="A petite blue-haired elf girl"} She possessed pale skin, long, pointed ears, a chin-length bob with bangs, and red eyes, her expression calm yet slightly melancholic. She wore exquisite black gothic cybernetic armor: segmented shoulder armor with spikes, a black breastplate with red glowing gem nodes, a chainmail-like mechanical plating, a tattered black sheer skirt, asymmetrical thigh straps, sheer stockings, and sharp black high-heeled armor boots. Small hair accessories and numerous tiny metal details, chains, buckles, spikes, skull patterns, and red accents were added throughout the garment. Behind her, placed {argument name="background machine" default="A massive, black, insect-like/mech warship with horn-like fins and glowing red seams."} The background is dominated by towering structures, making the character appear extremely small. The environment is a towering dystopian shipyard or megastructure, filled with cranes, scaffolding, pipes, suspended chains, catwalks, warning signs, and cascading industrial platforms, gradually disappearing into a cold blue mist. A vertical portrait composition, full-body perspective, is used, with the character positioned slightly to the right of center, a low-angle cinematic view, and massive machines standing diagonally behind. The lighting should convey emotion and atmosphere: cool, misty sunlight streaming in from the upper left, deep shadows, subtle rim lighting, and scattered crimson glows from the machinery and armor. Style: ultra-refined anime concept art, dark fantasy cyberpunk, complex mechanical design, sharp lines, painterly realism, high contrast, metallic textures, grand proportions, no extra characters, no watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张细节极其丰富的暗黑科幻动漫插画，描绘一位孤独的赛博朋克精灵少女站在工业金属平台上，面对一台巨大的生物机械战争机器。角色为 {argument name="character type" default="一位娇小的蓝发精灵少女"}，拥有苍白的皮肤、长长的尖耳朵、齐下巴的波波头短发配刘海、红色的眼睛，表情平静且略带忧郁。她身穿精致的黑色哥特式赛博盔甲：带有尖刺的分段式肩甲、带有红色发光宝石节点的黑色盔甲胸衣、类似锁子甲的机械镀层、破损的黑色透视裙摆、不对称的大腿绑带、透视丝袜以及尖锐的黑色高跟盔甲靴。在服装各处添加小巧的发饰以及许多细小的金属细节、链条、扣环、尖刺、骷髅图案和红色点缀。在她身后，放置 {argument name="background machine" default="一艘巨大的黑色昆虫状/机甲战舰，带有角状鳍片和发光的红色接缝"}，占据大部分背景，使角色显得极其渺小。环境是一个高耸的反乌托邦造船厂或巨型建筑，布满起重机、脚手架、管道、悬挂的链条、猫道、警示标志和层叠的工业平台，逐渐消失在冰冷的蓝色雾气中。采用垂直肖像构图，全身视角，角色位于中心偏右，低角度电影化视角，巨大的机器在身后呈对角线耸立。灯光应具有情绪感和氛围感：左上方射入清冷的雾气日光，深邃的阴影，微妙的轮廓光，以及来自机械和盔甲的零星深红色光芒。风格：超精细动漫概念艺术、暗黑奇幻赛博朋克、复杂的机械设计、锐利的线条、绘画感写实、高对比度、金属质感、宏大的比例，无额外角色，无水印。

templates.title: Japanese anime idol support poster

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹动漫偶像应援海报

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a vivid, high-density anime-style digital illustration, and to produce an image featuring a stylish cyberpunk girl.{argument name="character name" default="Neo"} A neon idol support poster centered around a central figure. Canvas: Vertical 4:5 composition, close-up of the upper body, using strong magenta, purple, cyan, and black tones, glossy lighting, a crowded concert atmosphere, and a glowing rounded rectangular neon border surrounding the entire image. Subject: A stylish anime girl with short, dark purple-black hair, highlighted with electric purple and cyan strands, wearing yellow-rimmed goggles. She wears a black crop top with a purple skull and rabbit logo; over it, she wears an oversized black and purple color-blocked jacket covered in punk-style patches, rabbit/skull patterns, zippers, badges, and glossy reflections; around her neck is a choker with a purple flower pendant. Her hands are raised close to the camera, forming a heart shape in front of her face, using a strong perspective shortening effect and slightly blurred due to depth of field. Place a large, soft, purplish-red square obscuring/placeholder in the center of the face, covering most facial features but retaining the visibility of hair, goggles, hands, neck, chest, and clothing. Visible text and graphic elements: Includes 3 main glowing support message elements: 1) A pink neon heart-shaped speech bubble in the upper left corner containing the Japanese phrase "今日はネオだけ見ててね？約束だよっ♡"; 2) A black circular support sign in the lower left corner with the bright pink neon Japanese phrase "ネオ" and the smaller white text "しか勝たん", along with tiny hearts and rabbit doodles; 3) A rounded neon nameplate in the lower right corner containing a small pixelated heart, the bluish-white Japanese name "ネオ", and a pink skull rabbit icon. If you have customized the character name, please maintain consistency in these symbols. Foreground Crowd Details: Four clearly visible glow sticks are displayed at the bottom/front: two bright purple glow sticks near the center, one cyan glow stick at the bottom right edge, and one partially visible small pink/purple glow stick. The background is enhanced with soft, blurred light spots, glowing hearts, graffiti, and concert beams. Style: High-saturation Japanese anime illustration, glossy idol concert aesthetics, sharp details in costumes and neon signs, soft motion blur on hands and glow sticks, vibrant rim lighting, high contrast, energetic composition, and a cute yet edgy cyberpunk style. Constraints: Keep the central magenta square obscuring block clearly visible and rectangular; do not add any additional large signs besides the three specified information elements; maintain overall neon detail, but ensure the heart-shaped hand gesture serves as the visual focus.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张生动、高密度的动漫风格数字插画，制作一张以时尚赛博朋克少女 {argument name="character name" default="Neo"} 为中心的霓虹偶像应援海报。

画布：竖向 4:5 构图，腰部以上特写，采用强烈的洋红色、紫色、青色和黑色调，光泽感灯光，拥挤的演唱会氛围，整张图片周围环绕着发光的圆角矩形霓虹边框。

主体：一位时尚的动漫少女，留着深紫黑色短发，带有电光紫挑染和青色发丝，头戴黄色边框护目镜。她身穿黑色露脐上衣，上面印有紫色骷髅兔标志；外搭一件黑紫拼色超大款夹克，夹克上布满了朋克风格的小补丁、兔子/骷髅图案、拉链、徽章以及光泽感反光，颈部佩戴着带有紫色小花吊坠的颈圈。她的双手抬起靠近镜头，在脸前比出一个心形，运用强烈的透视缩短效果，并因景深效果而略显模糊。在面部中央区域放置一个大的柔和紫红色方形遮挡块/占位符，遮住大部分面部特征，但保留头发、护目镜、双手、颈部、胸部和服装的可见度。

可见文字与图形元素：包含 3 个主要的发光应援信息元素：1) 左上角一个粉色霓虹心形对话框，内含日文 「今日はネオだけ見ててね？約束だよっ♡」；2) 左下角一个黑色圆形应援牌，上面有亮粉色霓虹日文 「ネオ」 和较小的白色文字 「しか勝たん」，以及微小的心形和兔子涂鸦；3) 右下角一个圆角霓虹名牌，内含一个小像素心、青白色的日文名 「ネオ」 以及一个粉色骷髅兔图标。如果自定义了角色名，请在这些标志中保持一致。

前景人群细节：底部/前方展示 4 根清晰可见的荧光棒：中心附近两根亮紫色荧光棒，右下边缘一根青蓝色荧光棒，以及一根部分可见的小型粉/紫色荧光棒。背景添加柔和的虚化光斑、发光心形、涂鸦和演唱会光束。

风格：高饱和度日本动漫插画，光泽感偶像演唱会美学，服装和霓虹招牌细节锐利，手部和荧光棒带有柔和的动态模糊，充满活力的轮廓光，高对比度，充满能量的构图，可爱又前卫的赛博朋克风格。

约束条件：保持中央紫红色方形遮挡块清晰可见且呈矩形；除指定的 3 个信息元素外，不要添加额外的大型标志；保持整体画面充满霓虹细节，但确保以比心的手势作为视觉焦点。

templates.title: Minimalist Anime Style Glasses Fashion Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 极简动漫风眼镜时尚海报

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a minimalist white-background fashion magazine advertisement poster showcasing elegant women's eyewear. The model is a young woman with a soft, anime-inspired style, dressed in sophisticated librarian-style attire. Canvas: Vertical poster, 4:5 aspect ratio, bright off-white background, transparent luxury magazine layout, warm beige and champagne gold color scheme, delicate watercolor/anime illustration texture, rich details in hair, fabric, and accessories. Layout: Place the illustrated model in the right two-thirds of the poster, with the composition extending from head to torso. Her face is partially obscured by a large, solid warm beige square placeholder, revealing her hair, ears, neck, hands, and clothing. Place all typography and product details in the left third. Add a small eyewear product illustration in the lower left corner. Branding Area: Include two understated branding elements in the upper left corner: a thin, gold oval monogram logo with a cursive L and small glitter dots, and the brand name in elegant serif capital letters.{argument name="brand name" default="LUMIÈRE CLAIRE"} Add the short Japanese brand name pronunciation directly below.{argument name="brand reading" default="ルミエール・クレール"} Main title and copy: Add a large Japanese title below the brand name.{argument name="headline text" default="A gaze that gently reflects intelligence."} Use a refined dark gray font. Add a thin horizontal gold dividing line below, with a small glitter in the middle. Below the dividing line, add three lines of small Japanese text: "日常に寄り添い、あなたらしさを", "そっと引き立てるアイウェア." and "しなやかな輝きを、瞳に." Specification section: Below the text, create five specifications lines with Japanese tags, each with a thin gold vertical line on the left. These 5 lines are: 1) "Manufacturer: Lumière Creel", 2) "Type: Open Form", 3) "Model Name: Etowal Douce" (with the small kana "Douce" below), 4) "Desired Dimensity: ±0.50 ~ ±2.00", 5) "Price: ¥16,800 (tax included)". The price font should be slightly bolder. Model details: The character is an elegant young woman with light honey-gold hair styled in a loose high bun, with a few strands softly falling beside her cheeks, the lines delicate and the shine strong. She wore an ivory ribbed knit cardigan over a white ruffled turtleneck blouse with a beige ribbon bow at the collar, and a thin crossbody chain with visible ID. Her right hand was slightly raised near her chin, suggesting she was adjusting or showing off her glasses, but the glasses were obscured by a beige face placeholder. The visible clothing and accessories list includes six prominent clothing/accessory elements: an ivory ribbed cardigan, a white ruffled blouse, a beige ribbon bow, a thin gold chain, and a [item name missing].{argument name="badge text" default="librarian"} A rectangular ID badge and a small, round gold pendant near the chain. Product section: In the lower left corner, a single pair of oval glasses is depicted, made of light champagne gold metal, with clear lenses, delicate nose pads, and thin temples. Below are two short lines of Japanese product text: "繊細なラインが柔らかく顔立ちに寄り添うオーバルフレーム." and "軽やかなかけ心地で、毎日を心地よく." Visual style: An elegant Japanese fashion advertising layout, minimalist yet sophisticated, with soft shadows, warm natural light, delicate gold accents, slender serif fonts, a subtle white background, and a meticulously crafted magazine poster composition. Constraints: Keep the large beige square representing the face as a clean, solid-color placeholder, without containing any facial features. Use 5 standard lines, with 3 lines of short text below the dividing line, 2 lines of product text at the bottom, 1 illustration of the eyewear product, and 6 listed clothing/accessory elements. No additional logos, no watermarks, and no clutter.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张极简白底时尚杂志广告海报，展示优雅的女士眼镜，模特为一位身着精致图书管理员风格服装的柔和动漫风年轻女性。

画布：竖版海报，4:5 比例，明亮的米白色背景，通透的奢华杂志排版，温暖的米色与香槟金配色，细腻的水彩/动漫插画质感，头发、布料及配饰细节丰富。

布局：将插画模特放置在海报右侧三分之二处，构图从头部到躯干中部。她的面部被一个居中的大号纯色暖米色方形占位符遮挡，露出头发、耳朵、颈部、手部和服装。将所有排版和产品细节放置在左侧三分之一处。在左下角添加一个小型的眼镜产品插画。

品牌区域：在左上角包含 2 个低调的品牌元素：一个带有草书 L 和小闪光点的细金椭圆形字母组合标志，以及优雅衬线大写字母的品牌名称 {argument name="brand name" default="LUMIÈRE CLAIRE"}。在下方直接添加小型日语品牌读音 {argument name="brand reading" default="ルミエール・クレール"}。

主标题与文案：在品牌下方，添加大型日语标题 {argument name="headline text" default="知性を、やさしく\n映すまなざし。"}，使用精致的深灰色字体。下方添加一条细横向金色分割线，中间带有一个小闪光点。在分割线下方，添加 3 行小型日语文案：「日常に寄り添い、あなたらしさを」、「そっと引き立てるアイウェア。」以及「しなやかな輝きを、瞳に。」

规格板块：在文案下方，创建 5 行带日语标签的规格行，左侧带有细金色竖线。这 5 行分别为：1) 「メーカー： ルミエール・クレール」，2) 「種類： オーバルフレーム」，3) 「モデル名： エトワール・Douce」（下方带有小型假名「ドゥース」），4) 「想定度数： ±0.50 ～ ±2.00」，5) 「価格： ¥16,800（税込）」。价格字体需稍粗。

模特细节：角色为一位优雅的年轻女性，浅蜂蜜金色头发梳成蓬松的高丸子头，几缕发丝柔和地垂在脸颊旁，线条细腻，光泽感强。她身穿象牙白罗纹针织开衫，内搭白色荷叶边高领衬衫，领口系有米色丝带蝴蝶结，并佩戴一条细斜挎链，可见 ID 证件。她的右手轻抬至下巴附近，呈现出正在调整或展示眼镜的姿态，但脸上的眼镜被米色面部占位符遮挡。

可见服装与配饰清单：包含 6 个显著的服装/配饰元素：1 件象牙白罗纹开衫，1 件白色荷叶边衬衫，1 个米色丝带蝴蝶结，1 条细金色链条，1 个写有 {argument name="badge text" default="図書館員"} 的长方形 ID 证件，以及链条附近 1 个小型圆形金色吊坠。

产品部分：在左下角，绘制 1 副独立的椭圆形眼镜，采用浅香槟金色金属材质，配有透明镜片、精致鼻托和细镜腿。下方添加 2 行简短的日语产品文案：「繊細なラインが柔らかく顔立ちに寄り添うオーバルフレーム。」以及「軽やかなかけ心地で、毎日を心地よく。」

视觉风格：优雅的日系时尚广告布局，极简且精致，柔和的阴影，温暖的自然光，细腻的金色点缀，纤细的衬线字体，微妙的纸白背景，考究的杂志海报构图。

约束条件：保持脸部的大号米色方形作为干净的纯色占位符，不包含任何面部特征。使用 5 行规格行，分割线下 3 行短文案，底部 2 行产品文案，1 个眼镜产品插画，以及 6 个列出的服装/配饰元素。无额外标志，无水印，无杂乱元素。

templates.title: A pink, cute mascot holding the logo.

titleLocalized.zh: 手持 Logo 的粉色 Q 版吉祥物

templates.prompt: Create a cute chibi-style close-up illustration of the main character.{argument name="character name" default="Pink-haired magical girl mascot"} The background is clean white, and the image uses a wide banner format. The character has large, pointed {argument name="eye color" default="Pinkish-purple and gold highlighter"} The eyes feature a shimmering gradient effect, a small, smiling mouth, soft blush, and a fluffy, light color.{argument name="hair color" default="pink"} She wears twin ponytails, the ends curled and filling both sides of the face. She also has neat bangs, layered side hair, and two small gold hair clips pinned to the upper right of her bangs. She wears a white fantasy idol-style outfit with gold trim, shoulder armor-like decorations, black choker details, and small pink embellishments. Her small hands hold a large object positioned in front of her chest.{argument name="logo shape" default="Circular triangle A logo"} The logo is brightly colored.{argument name="logo color" default="Bright pink"} It features a thick black border and a hollowed-out triangle center. It adopts a refined Japanese anime style, with clean lines, soft cel shadows, clear highlights, rich details in the eyes and hair, and adorable proportions. It uses a symmetrical frontal composition and contains no text or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张可爱的动漫 Q 版特写插画，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="粉色头发的魔法少女吉祥物"}，背景为干净的白色，采用宽幅横幅构图。角色拥有一双硕大的、带有 {argument name="eye color" default="粉紫色及金色高光"} 的光泽渐变眼睛，小巧的微笑嘴型，柔和的腮红，以及蓬松的浅色 {argument name="hair color" default="粉色"} 双马尾，发尾卷曲并填满画面两侧。加上整齐的刘海、层次感侧发，并在刘海右上方别上两个金色小发夹。她身穿白色幻想偶像风格服装，配有金色镶边、肩甲式装饰、黑色颈圈细节以及粉色小装饰。她的小手捧着一个巨大的、位于胸前的 {argument name="logo shape" default="圆形三角形 A 字徽标"}；徽标呈鲜艳的 {argument name="logo color" default="亮粉色"}，带有粗黑边框和镂空三角形中心。采用精致的日系动漫主视觉风格，线条干净，赛璐珞阴影柔和，高光通透，眼睛和头发细节丰富，比例可爱，采用对称的正面对称构图，且不包含任何文字或水印。

templates.title: Four-panel train station pose puzzle

titleLocalized.zh: 四格火车站姿势拼图

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a realistic 3:4 vertical photo mosaic, precisely divided into four equal-sized panels in a 2x2 grid, separated by thick white borders, showcasing the same image.{argument name="character description" default="Japanese adult women with shoulder-length straight black hair"} Different poses on an outdoor train platform. Canvas and layout: 3:4 portrait ratio. Four equally sized rectangular photos are arranged in a square grid: top left, top right, bottom left, and bottom right. A realistic mobile photography style is used, incorporating natural daylight, shallow to medium depth of field, overcast skies, railway tracks, overhead power lines, fences, platform markings, station signs, and a train visible in one of the panels. Large red text with a white outline is added to the top left corner of the overall mosaic.{argument name="top label" default="GPT 2"} Add a faint, semi-transparent watermark in the center.{argument name="watermark text" default="©CottonAIImageLABO"} Main details: The woman is wearing {argument name="outfit" default="Navy blue polo shirt, blue plaid pleated skirt, dark knee-high socks"} Carrying a{argument name="bag" default="Large navy blue shoulder bag with light gray shoulder strap and pink heart charm"} In each panel, her face is softly blurred with a rectangular blur to maintain anonymity. Consistency in clothing and bag design is maintained across all four panels. The four panels, precisely counted: 1. Top Left: A full-body selfie on the platform, a woman extending one hand towards the camera, carrying a shoulder bag, with the background showing extended railway tracks and the platform. 2. Top Right: A medium shot, she raises one hand to her forehead in a salute or sun-shading gesture, carrying a shoulder bag, with the background showing railway tracks and the platform. 3. Bottom Left: A close-up portrait taken next to a stopped train with orange stripes, she makes a peace sign near her face, the bag strap visible. 4. Bottom Right: A full-body side shot near a transfer sign, she extends one arm with her index finger raised, the other hand carrying a shoulder bag. Visual Style: Highly realistic Japanese mobile phone photography, casual travel snapshots, natural soft colors, overcast lighting, slight background blur, realistic train platform perspective, no beauty filters or lighting, not illustration or anime style. Constraints: 4 panels must be used, and all 4 listed poses must be included. Maintain consistency in character, clothing, bags, and station scene across all panels. Retain the 2x2 puzzle structure and white dividing lines. No additional characters or text may be added except for the top label and a faint watermark.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个写实的 3:4 竖向照片拼图，精确划分为 2×2 网格的 4 个等大面板，面板间以粗白边分隔，展示同一位 {argument name="character description" default="留着齐肩直黑发的日本成年女性"} 在户外火车站台上的不同姿势。

画布与布局：3:4 纵向比例。四个等大的矩形照片排列成方形网格：左上、右上、左下、右下。采用写实的手机摄影风格，包含自然日光、浅至中度的景深、阴天、铁轨、高架电线、围栏、站台标记、车站站牌以及其中一个面板中可见的火车。在整体拼图的左上角添加带有白色描边的大号红色文字 {argument name="top label" default="GPT 2"}。在中心位置添加一个淡淡的半透明水印 {argument name="watermark text" default="©CottonAIImageLABO"}。

主体细节：该女性穿着 {argument name="outfit" default="海军蓝 Polo 衫、蓝色格纹百褶裙、深色过膝袜"}，背着一个 {argument name="bag" default="带有浅灰色肩带和粉色心形挂饰的大号海军蓝单肩包"}，且在每个面板中，她的面部均被柔和的矩形模糊处理以保持匿名。在所有 4 个面板中保持服装和包袋的一致性。

四个面板，精确计数：
1. 左上：站台上的全身自拍视角，女性伸出一只手掌向镜头方向，背着单肩包，背景是延伸的铁轨和站台。
2. 右上：中景镜头，她抬起一只手放在额头前做出敬礼或遮阳的姿势，背着单肩包，背景是铁轨和站台。
3. 左下：在停靠的带有橙色条纹的列车旁拍摄的近景肖像，她在脸部附近比出剪刀手，可见包带。
4. 右下：在换乘标志附近的全身侧拍镜头，她一只手臂向上伸出食指，另一只手提着单肩包。

视觉风格：高度写实的日本手机摄影，休闲旅行快照，自然的柔和色彩，阴天光照，轻微背景虚化，真实的火车站台透视，无美颜灯光，非插画或动漫风格。

约束条件：必须使用 4 个面板，且必须包含所列的 4 种姿势。在所有面板中保持人物、服装、包袋和车站场景的一致性。保留 2×2 的拼图结构和白色分割线。除顶部标签和淡淡的水印外，不得添加额外人物或文字。

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张以干净白色背景为底的 Q 版动漫吉祥物特写插画，画面中央为 {argument name="character name" default="一位可爱的粉发动漫女孩"}。她拥有粉色、紫色和金色渐变的超大闪亮双眼，小巧的微笑嘴型，柔和的腮红，以及圆润的 Q 版脸庞。她的 {argument name="hair color" default="柔粉色"} 头发梳成两个蓬松的大型高双马尾，发尾卷曲，两侧有厚实的鬓发，留着齐刘海，右上侧别着金色小发夹。她身穿白色奇幻偶像风格服装，配有金色镶边、肩甲式装饰、黑色领口细节和精致的粉色装饰元素。双手置于胸前，正前方拿着一个大型风格化三角形标志/标牌：一个鲜艳的亮粉色粗圆角三角形轮廓，带有黑色边缘/阴影，中心镂空。构图紧凑，头部上方略微裁切，双马尾向两侧延伸，标志位于画面下方中央。采用精致的日式动漫主视觉风格，线条干净，柔和的赛璐珞阴影，光泽高光，柔和配色，眼睛和头发细节丰富，氛围可爱活泼，无文字，无水印，无多余角色。

templates.title: Anime Romance Stamp Commemorative Album

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫恋爱邮票纪念册

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a gorgeous, vertically formatted, dreamlike "Official Love Commemorative Stamp Album," featuring an anime girl as the protagonist. The album will retain her delicate face shape, eyes, hairstyle, hair color, expression, clothing color scheme, sense of transparency, and soft atmosphere, as if her love is being conveyed to the world. Canvas: Vertical 2:3 poster format, elegant letter paper and stamp composition, using soft light blue, cream, white, and light gold tones, romantic semi-transparent lighting, dreamy blurring effects, combining high-detail anime illustrations with luxurious paper art design. Protagonist: A girl named {argument name="character name" default="Nozomu"} The blonde anime girl features long, pale honey-gold hair, a blue ribbon, a blue and white ruffled headdress, a lace-trimmed dress, pearl-like accessories, a gentle and innocent expression, clear blue eyes, and a radiant romantic aura. Ensure her image remains consistent across all stamp portraits. Layout: Design a large commemorative stamp at the top center, with eight smaller stamps arranged in a 4x2 grid below. Each stamp features perforated edges, a fine gold border, tiny decorative hearts, and a matching delicate floral background. Decorate the stamp album with postmarks, handwritten text, envelopes, ribbons, wax seals, rose petals, blue roses, letter paper, and pens. Top Title Text: At the top center, write "..." in delicate serif gold lettering.{argument name="header name" default="NOZOMU"} Below that is written "LOVE STAMP COLLECTION", and below that is written large Japanese hiragana characters.{argument name="Japanese name text" default="のぞむ"} Add a Japanese subtitle: “この想いが、世界中へ届きますように。” Includes a circular postmark with the text “FIRST DAY 05.20 2026” and “LOVE POST TO SOMEONE”. Add a small blue bird stamp with “LOVE FOREVER 2026” in the upper right corner. Add a tag attached to a shiny blue ribbon with the text “LIMITED LOVE ISSUE No. 20260520” in the upper left corner. Large-format themed stamp: A wide horizontal stamp depicting a girl in a sunny, flower-filled room with blue and pink flowers in the background. A cake or small dessert is in the lower left corner, and there are ornate gold floral decorations in the corners. The face value “120 LOVE” is marked in the upper left corner, and a gold handwritten signature is in the lower right corner.{argument name="signature text" default="Nozomu♡"} The set includes eight miniature stamps, strictly counted as follows: 1) "110 HOPE", a girl holding a bouquet against a soft floral background. 2) "84 MEMORY", a girl holding a small red pendant or ornament to her chest. 3) "100 PRAYER", a girl praying with her eyes closed and hands clasped together. 4) "LOVE 01", a girl cradling a light blue plush toy or soft flowers. 5) "89 PROMISE", a night scene with blue lights and faint shimmering points of light, a girl looking back. 6) "07 UNSENT", a melancholic profile at night, with a circular postmark "11.07 2022" and the Japanese phrase "I love you even though I didn't deliver this message". 7) “99 REUNION”, a girl extends a hand to the audience from a bright flowerbed. 8) “05 LETTER”, a girl clutches a letter tightly in the warm window light. Bottom text and decoration: The bottom center features the Japanese phrase “届かなかった言葉も、愛だった”. The stamp features the title "DELIVER THIS HEART" and the English subtitle. Near the bottom right corner is marked "No. 000520 / 2026". The bottom left corner includes a blue card that reads "SPECIAL MEMORIAL STAMP LIMITED EDITION", a small envelope card that reads "TO SOMEONE, SOMEWHERE", a cream-colored envelope with a blue wax seal in the bottom right corner, and a gold wax seal in the bottom left corner, surrounded by tiny hearts, petals, and glitter. Visual style: High-resolution anime art, romantic official stamp album, luxurious paper texture, fine gold foil details, light blue ribbon, soft sunlight, shimmering translucent atmosphere, delicate floral decorations, shallow depth of field, clear and legible typography, no modern UI elements, no watermark, and no additional stamps besides one large stamp and eight small stamps.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张华丽的竖版梦幻“官方恋爱纪念邮票册”，以一位动漫少女为主角，保留她精致的脸型、眼睛、发型、发色、表情、服装配色、通透感和柔和的氛围，仿佛她的爱意正传递至世界各地。

画布：竖版 2:3 海报，优雅的信纸与邮票构图，采用柔和的淡蓝色、奶油色、白色和淡金色调，浪漫的半透明光影，梦幻的虚化效果，高细节动漫插画与奢华纸艺设计相结合。

主角：一位名为 {argument name="character name" default="Nozomu"} 的金发动漫少女，拥有长长的淡蜜金色头发、蓝色丝带、荷叶边蓝白头饰、蕾丝饰边连衣裙、珍珠般的配饰、温柔纯真的表情、清澈的蓝眼睛和通透的浪漫光环。确保她在每张邮票肖像中的形象保持一致。

布局：在上方中间设计一张大型纪念邮票，下方排列 8 张较小的邮票，组成 4 行 2 列的网格。每张邮票均带有齿孔边缘、细金边、微小的装饰性心形以及配套的淡雅花卉背景。在邮票册周围装饰邮戳、手写字迹、信封、丝带、火漆印章、玫瑰花瓣、蓝玫瑰、信纸和钢笔。

顶部标题文字：在顶部中心位置，用精致的衬线金字书写“{argument name="header name" default="NOZOMU"}”，下方书写“LOVE STAMP COLLECTION”，再下方书写大号日文平假名“{argument name="Japanese name text" default="のぞむ"}”。添加一行日文副标题：“この想いが、世界中へ届きますように。” 包含圆形邮戳，文字为“FIRST DAY 05.20 2026”和“LOVE POST TO SOMEONE”，右上角添加一枚写有“LOVE FOREVER 2026”的小型蓝鸟邮票。左上角添加一个系在亮面蓝色丝带上的吊牌，写有“LIMITED LOVE ISSUE No. 20260520”。

大型主题邮票：一张宽幅横向邮票，画面为少女身处阳光明媚的花卉房间，背景为蓝色和粉色花朵，左下角有蛋糕或小甜点，角落有华丽的金色花纹装饰，左上角标注面值“120 LOVE”，右下角有金色的手写签名“{argument name="signature text" default="Nozomu♡"}”。

八张小型邮票，严格计数：1) “110 HOPE”，少女手持花束，柔和花卉背景。2) “84 MEMORY”，少女胸前握着一枚红色小吊坠或饰品。3) “100 PRAYER”，少女闭眼双手合十祈祷。4) “LOVE 01”，少女怀抱淡蓝色毛绒玩具或柔软花朵。5) “89 PROMISE”，夜景，蓝色灯光与微弱的闪烁光点，少女回眸。6) “07 UNSENT”，忧郁的侧脸夜景，带有圆形邮戳“11.07 2022”及日文短句“届かなかった言葉も、愛だった。” 7) “99 REUNION”，少女在明亮的花丛中向观众伸出一只手。8) “05 LETTER”，少女在温暖的窗光下紧握一封信。

底部文字与装饰：底部中心为日文短句“届かなかった言葉も、愛だった。”及英文副标题“DELIVER THIS HEART”。右下角附近标注“No. 000520 / 2026”。左下角包含一张写有“SPECIAL MEMORIAL STAMP LIMITED EDITION”的蓝色卡片，一张写有“TO SOMEONE, SOMEWHERE”的小信封卡片，右下角有一个带有蓝色火漆印章的奶油色信封，左下角有一个金色火漆印章，周围散落着微小的心形、花瓣和闪光点。

视觉风格：高精细度动漫艺术，浪漫官方邮票册，奢华纸张质感，精细金箔细节，淡蓝色缎带，柔和日光，闪烁的半透明氛围，精致花卉装饰，浅景深，清晰易读的排版，无现代 UI 元素，无水印，除一张大邮票和 8 张小邮票外，不添加额外邮票。

templates.title: Shanghai Night Tour Journal

titleLocalized.zh: 上海夜游手账

templates.prompt: Create a{argument name="city skyline" default="Shanghai Pudong skyline along the Huangpu River"} This is a travel journal-style nighttime landscape poster. Using a 4:3 wide canvas, it presents a realistic nighttime waterfront photographic feel: the top two-thirds are a dark, cloudy sky, with brightly lit skyscrapers rising on the horizon. To the left is the Oriental Pearl Tower emitting a pink glow, and to the right are the Shanghai Tower and other high-rises adorned with blue, purple, gold, and white lights. At the bottom is the river reflecting the lights, with a small sightseeing boat on the water. Playful white hand-drawn diary doodles and handwritten Chinese annotations are added directly to the image, creating a social media travel journal atmosphere. It includes 6 handwritten text annotations: "The clouds are taking a walk too," accompanied by a dotted walking path and small clouds, written in the upper left corner; "Walk slowly and look slowly♡" written next to the crescent moon and stars in the upper right corner; "The Oriental Pearl Tower is shining bright♡" written next to the arrow pointing to the Oriental Pearl Tower; "The night breeze is just right♪" written on the left side above the river; "The buildings are shining brightly tonight♡" written on the right side above the skyline, with an arc underline; and "Lights fall into the Huangpu River" written in the center above the water at the bottom. It also includes 15 white graffiti elements: a dotted flight path spanning across the upper left corner, a small outline cloud at the top, a crescent moon in the upper right corner, a fan-shaped cloud outline in the upper right center, an arrow pointing to the Oriental Pearl Tower, a dotted outline surrounding the Oriental Pearl Tower, three small flashing/star icons, two musical note icons, a map location icon in the lower left corner, two flowing wave lines spanning across the water at the bottom, and a small flower graffiti in the lower right corner. All graffiti lines should be thin, free-flowing, and hand-drawn, slightly imperfect, bright white, and without borders or watermarks. The overall atmosphere should be dreamy, warm, romantic, and casual, like handwritten travel memories shared on social media.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 {argument name="city skyline" default="黄浦江畔的上海浦东天际线"} 的旅行手账风格夜景海报。使用 4:3 的宽幅画布，呈现写实的夜间滨水摄影质感：顶部三分之二为深色多云天空，地平线上矗立着灯火通明的摩天大楼，左侧是发出粉红色光芒的东方明珠塔，右侧是点缀着蓝、紫、金、白灯光的上海中心大厦及其他高楼，底部是倒映着灯光的江面，江上有一艘小型观光船。在画面上直接添加俏皮的白色手绘日记涂鸦和中文手写标注，营造社交媒体旅行笔记的氛围。包含 6 条手写文字标注：左上方写有“云也来散步啦”，配以虚线漫步路径和小云朵；右上角新月和星星旁写有“慢慢走 慢慢看♡”；指向东方明珠塔的箭头旁写有“东方明珠 亮晶晶♡”；江面上方左侧写有“夜风 刚刚好♪”；天际线上方右侧写有“今晚的楼 都很会发光♡”，并带有弧形下划线；底部水面上方居中处写有“灯光掉进黄浦江”。包含 15 个白色涂鸦元素：左上方横跨的虚线飞行路径、顶部的一个小型轮廓云、右上角的一弯新月、中右上方的一个扇形云朵轮廓、指向东方明珠塔的箭头、环绕东方明珠塔的虚线轮廓、三个小闪光/星星图标、两个音符图标、左下角的一个地图定位图标、底部水面上横跨的两条流动波浪线，以及右下角的一朵小花涂鸦。所有涂鸦线条需保持纤细、随意、手绘感，略带不完美，呈现亮白色，且无边框或水印。整体氛围应梦幻、温馨、浪漫且随性，如同在社交媒体上分享的手写旅行回忆。

templates.title: A post-apocalyptic zombie horde in Times Square

titleLocalized.zh: 末日后的时代广场尸潮

templates.prompt: Create a wide-frame, cinematic post-apocalyptic scene against the backdrop of a desolate Times Square, experiencing heavy rain. Use somber blue tones, with wet, reflective ground and towering skyscrapers creating a deep canyon-like perspective. In the foreground and middle ground, show a dense horde of zombie pedestrians stretching from the left foreground into the distance. Their faces are ashen and decaying, their clothes soaked and dirty, their expressions blank as they slowly move forward. In the right middle ground, place a lone surviving hero, small in stature, standing atop a glass-and-metal bus shelter. He wears a dark hooded raincoat or long coat, dark trousers, and boots, holding a samurai sword tilted downwards in a defiant gesture towards the zombie horde. The scene is surrounded by piles of garbage, black trash bags, cardboard, scattered debris, abandoned sidewalks, and puddles. Digital billboards and signs on buildings are mostly off, broken, or malfunctioning, flashing distorted fragments of magenta, cyan, blue, and white neon; include a few flashing billboards, but without any recognizable focal text. Employing a grand scale, high detail, and realistic dark urban survival horror style, along with rain, fog, atmospheric depth, and dramatic low-angle street perspectives, the game creates an atmosphere of collapse and isolation. It avoids gory close-ups, bright sunlight, and clean streets, ensuring the hero appears visually much smaller than the surrounding city and hordes of zombies.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个宽画幅的电影级末日场景，背景是荒废的时代广场，正下着大雨，采用阴郁的蓝色调，地面湿润反光，高耸的摩天大楼形成深邃的峡谷视角。在前景和中景，展示一大群密集的丧尸行人，从左侧前景一直延伸到远方，它们面色灰败腐烂，穿着湿透的脏衣服，表情空洞，缓慢向前移动。在右侧中景，放置一名孤身幸存的英雄，他显得渺小但站立在玻璃金属结构的公交候车亭平顶上，身穿深色连帽雨披或长外套、深色长裤和靴子，单手持一把武士刀向下倾斜，以挑衅的姿态面对丧尸群。场景周围布满垃圾堆、黑色垃圾袋、纸板、散落的碎片、废弃的人行道和水坑。建筑上的数字广告牌和标志大多处于熄灭、破损或故障状态，闪烁着洋红色、青色、蓝色和白色的扭曲霓虹碎片；包含少量闪烁的广告牌，但不要有可辨认的焦点文字。采用宏大的比例、高细节、写实的暗黑城市生存恐怖风格、雨雾、大气深度、戏剧性的低角度街道视角，营造出坍塌与孤立的氛围。避免血腥特写，避免明亮的日光，避免干净的街道，并确保英雄在视觉上比周围的城市和丧尸群小得多。

templates.title: New York Public Library (NYPL) Wasteland Survivor Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 纽约公共图书馆 (NYPL) 废土幸存者场景

templates.prompt: Create a 9:16 portrait-style, cinematic-realistic Manhattan street scene, shot from a low angle on the steps of the main building of the New York Public Library on a cloudy and windy afternoon. Place a lone tactical survivor in the foreground.{argument name="character name" default="No man"} He sat exhausted on the stone steps, clad in all-black urban combat gear: a dark jacket, tactical vest, gloves, work pants, and a backpack strap, with a sheathed samurai sword or longsword strapped vertically to his back. His face was obscured by a flat, dark rectangular hood, but his black hair and ears were still partially visible. The library facade dominated the right: tall Buzzard-style columns, arched entrances, carved stone details, steps, and sand-colored sandbag defenses stacked beside the boarded-up doors. The left extended a long street canyon of tall New York buildings, with abandoned cars, scattered debris, dust in the air, and a damaged or overturned dark vehicle in the midground. The composition employed soft gray sunlight, cool, desaturated colors, a raw realism, a slight haze, dramatic depth of field, documentary-style framing, and a silent, post-apocalyptic atmosphere. The image must contain one and only one seated survivor, a visible sword, a sandbag roadblock, an entrance boarded up, and multiple abandoned vehicles in the background, and should not contain any readable additional text or signs.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个 9:16 竖屏电影级写实风格的曼哈顿街景，采用低角度拍摄，地点位于纽约公共图书馆主馆的台阶上，时间为阴天且风大的午后。在前景处，放置一名孤独的战术幸存者，{argument name="character name" default="无名男子"}，精疲力竭地坐在石阶上，身穿全黑城市作战服：深色夹克、战术背心、手套、工装裤、背包带，背部垂直系着一把带鞘的武士刀或长剑。他的脸部被一个扁平的深色矩形遮挡块遮住，但黑色的头发和耳朵仍部分可见。图书馆外立面占据右侧：高大的布杂艺术风格圆柱、拱形入口、雕刻石材细节、台阶，以及堆叠在木板封锁门旁的沙色沙袋防御工事。左侧延伸出一条由高大纽约建筑构成的长街峡谷，背景中有废弃的汽车、散落的碎片、空气中的尘埃，以及中景处一辆受损或翻倒的深色车辆。使用柔和的灰色日光、冷色调去饱和色彩、粗粝的写实感、轻微的雾霾、戏剧性的景深、纪录片式的构图，以及寂静的末日后氛围。画面需包含且仅包含一名坐着的幸存者、一把可见的剑、一个沙袋路障、一个被木板封锁的入口、背景中多辆废弃车辆，且不应包含任何可读的附加文字或标志。

templates.title: Post-apocalyptic Staten Island Ferry

titleLocalized.zh: 末日后的 Staten Island Ferry

templates.prompt: Create a 9:16 vertical epic cinematic dark fantasy scene set in New York Harbor at dusk, viewed from the upper deck of the abandoned and rusty Staten Island Ferry. The foreground shows the orange ferry structure with corroded railings, dark rectangular windows, peeling paint, and the numbers "1553" and partially visible large black letters "Staten Island." A solitary adult male figure stands on the upper deck, his face deliberately hidden in shadow/blur, wearing a dark hooded raincoat or cloak with a slung over his shoulder, revealing the hilt of a samurai sword behind his shoulder, creating an atmosphere of a post-apocalyptic survivor. The midground water is turbulent and dark, scattered with floating debris, broken docks, small wreckage, and narrow piers with tiny human silhouettes. The background shows the Lower Manhattan skyline as a dark silhouette, including One World Trade Center on the right and the dense skyscrapers on the horizon. The sky was filled with dramatic, overcast storm clouds, while a soft orange sunset glow shone behind the buildings, blending deep blue, charcoal gray, purple, and ember hues. Employing realistic photographic details, cinematic color grading, high contrast, a melancholic atmosphere, wide-angle perspective, low-saturation tones, and a touch of fog, it rejects clean modernity, bright sunlight, and cartoonish style. Customizable details:{argument name="location" default="New York Harbor facing Lower Manhattan"} ,{argument name="ferry text" default="Staten Island"} ,{argument name="main figure" default="A lone hooded survivor carrying a samurai sword"} ,{argument name="time of day" default="The deep twilight at sunset"} ,{argument name="mood" default="A sense of dread like in an apocalyptic movie"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅 9:16 竖屏史诗级电影质感暗黑奇幻场景，背景设定在深邃暮色下的纽约港，视角从废弃且锈迹斑斑的 Staten Island Ferry 上层甲板俯瞰。前景展示橙色的渡轮结构，带有腐蚀的栏杆、深色矩形窗户、剥落的油漆，以及数字“1553”和部分可见的黑色大字“Staten Island”。上层甲板上站着一名孤独的成年男性身影，面部刻意隐藏在阴影/模糊中，身穿深色连帽雨披或斗篷，斜挎肩带，肩后露出武士刀刀柄，营造出末日幸存者的氛围。中景的水面波涛汹涌且昏暗，散落着漂浮的碎片、破碎的码头、小型残骸以及带有微小人类剪影的狭窄栈桥。背景展示曼哈顿下城的天际线，呈现为深色剪影，包括右侧的世贸中心一号楼以及地平线上密集的摩天大楼。天空布满戏剧性的阴沉风暴云，建筑后方透出柔和的橙色日落余晖，融合了深蓝、炭灰、紫色和余烬色调。采用写实的摄影细节、电影级调色、高对比度、忧郁的氛围、广角透视、低饱和度色调、轻微的雾气，拒绝整洁的现代感，拒绝明亮的日光，拒绝卡通风格。可自定义细节：{argument name="location" default="面向曼哈顿下城的纽约港"}, {argument name="ferry text" default="Staten Island"}, {argument name="main figure" default="一名携带武士刀的孤独连帽幸存者"}, {argument name="time of day" default="日落时的深邃暮色"}, {argument name="mood" default="末日电影般的恐惧感"}。

templates.title: Heavy rain and zombie siege on the rooftop

titleLocalized.zh: 暴雨天台丧尸围城

templates.prompt: Create a highly dramatic, cinematic action-horror scene set on a rain-soaked rooftop of a luxury Manhattan hotel during a raging storm. Utilizing a 24mm wide-angle lens, the image achieves cinematic realism with a cool blue-gray tone, high contrast, wet reflections, slanted downpours, and heavy storm clouds above a dark city skyline. Place [something] in the center of the foreground.{argument name="main character" default="A tactical survivor with a blurred face"} Full-body shot, facing the camera, wearing black tactical clothing, bulletproof vest, straps, gloves, knee pads, and combat boots, holding a weapon horizontally across his chest.{argument name="primary weapon" default="A brown silenced assault rifle with a scope"} On the left, an open-air rooftop service door embedded in a concrete wall is shown; from the dark doorway, exactly 10 zombie attackers emerge, their rotting faces, torsos, and arms clawing at the survivors visible. These 10 visible zombie elements include: 1. A roaring face and hand at the top of the doorway; 2. A profile and arm below; 3. A cluster of protruding upper arms near the survivor's shoulder; 4. A central figure with a blurred torso and face; 5. A lower central figure pressing forward; 6. A figure on the left gripping the doorframe; 7. A lower central figure with outstretched hands; 8. A zombie torso crouching in the lower left; 9. A crawling hand in the lower left corner; and 10. A hand emerging from the shadows at the bottom of the doorway. Behind and to the right of the survivor, [the text continues with details about the zombies and their attacks].{argument name="background disaster" default="A military helicopter that crashed on a rooftop and is belching thick smoke is burning."} The scene is accompanied by orange flames, black smoke, broken rotor blades, debris, and the reflection of firelight on the damp rooftop tiles. In the lower right foreground, a curved katana lies flat on the wet ground, with a black hilt and a pale blade. The rooftop should be paved with large, dark square tiles, covered with puddles, raindrops, and reflective surfaces; the distant city should include several high-rise buildings shrouded in storm mist. Maintain a tense, realistic, raw, and cinematic atmosphere, with no text, watermarks, or close-ups of blood, and the protagonist's face should be unmarked or obscured.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个极具戏剧性的垂直电影级动作恐怖场景，背景设定在曼哈顿一家豪华酒店的雨中天台上，正值暴风雨肆虐。使用 24mm 广角镜头视角，呈现电影剧照级的写实画质，采用冷蓝灰色调，高对比度，湿润的反光效果，斜向飘落的狂风暴雨，以及深色城市天际线上方厚重的风暴云。在前景中心，放置 {argument name="main character" default="一名面部模糊的战术生存者"}，全身像，面向镜头，身穿黑色战术服装、防弹衣、绑带、手套、护膝和作战靴，胸前横持 {argument name="primary weapon" default="一把带有瞄准镜的棕色消音突击步枪"}。在左侧，展示一扇嵌入混凝土墙的露天天台服务门；从黑暗的门洞内，恰好 10 名丧尸攻击者涌出，可见腐烂的面孔、躯干和向生存者抓挠的手臂。这 10 个可见的丧尸元素包括：1 门洞顶部的咆哮面孔和手，2 下方的侧脸和手臂，3 生存者肩部附近的一簇伸出的上臂，4 躯干部分且面部模糊的中央角色，5 向前挤压的下方中央角色，6 抓着门框的左侧角色，7 双手伸出的中下方角色，8 蹲伏在左下方的丧尸躯体，9 左下角爬行的手，以及 10 从阴影中伸出的门洞底部的手。在生存者右后方，展示 {argument name="background disaster" default="一架在天台上坠毁且冒着浓烟的军用直升机正在燃烧"}，伴随着橙色的火焰、黑烟、断裂的旋翼叶片、碎片，以及在湿润天台瓷砖上的火光倒影。在右下角前景处，放置 1 把弯曲的武士刀平躺在湿润的地面上，配有黑色刀柄和苍白的刀刃。天台应铺设大型深色方砖，布满水坑、雨滴和反光表面；远处的城市应包含多座隐没在风暴迷雾中的高层建筑。保持场景紧张、写实、粗粝且具有电影感，画面中不含文字、水印或血腥特写，主角的面部保持无特征或遮挡状态。

Atmosphere:{argument name="time of day" default="dawn"} Blue-gray tones, rain-dampened surfaces, cold fog, overcast skies, cinematic scale, realistic photographic detail, dramatic depth of field, high contrast between foreground and foggy background. Camera: Wide-angle lens taken from a high sidewalk perspective, strong leading lines converging towards the bridge tower, shallow depth of field atmospheric perspective, 2:3 vertical composition. Avoid text, logos, watermarks, fantastical lighting effects, cartoonish style, or sunny weather.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅宏大且具有电影质感的竖屏图像，画面前景为 {argument name="character description" default="一位面部被阴影遮挡、身披连帽斗篷的孤独幸存者"} 站在黎明时分的布鲁克林大桥人行道上。人物位于画面中偏左位置，取景为大腿以上，身穿深蓝色雨披，内搭叠穿的橄榄色服装，兜帽向前拉起，胸前斜挎黑色带子，背部斜挂着一把武士刀，刀柄从左肩上方露出。人物表情隐藏在深沉的阴影中，营造出一种紧张、坚定且神秘的氛围。在人物后方下方，展示布鲁克林大桥桥面上拥挤的交通，以及在停滞车辆间穿行的密集人群，暗示撤离或灾后场景；画面中需包含两条从上方角落延伸至远处石塔的主悬索，以及许多垂直吊索、金属栏杆、潮湿的路面和逐渐消失在雾气中的车流。背景应呈现标志性的布鲁克林大桥石拱门，以及在浓重寒雾中隐约可见的曼哈顿天际线。氛围：{argument name="time of day" default="黎明"}，蓝灰色调，雨水打湿的表面，寒冷的雾气，阴天，电影级规模，写实的摄影细节，戏剧性的景深，前景与雾气背景形成高对比。相机：从高处人行道视角拍摄的广角镜头，强烈的引导线汇聚向桥塔，浅景深的大气透视，2:3 竖构图。避免出现文字、Logo、水印、奇幻光效、卡通风格或晴朗天气。

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅电影感竖屏动漫插画，描绘一位迷人的成年女性站在夜间站台上，身旁是一列停靠的复古通勤列车。主体是一位高挑优雅的女性，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深色波浪短发"}，头戴米色宽檐帽，佩戴珍珠耳环和珍珠项链，戴着黑色手套，身穿剪裁合身的象牙白晚礼服，礼服上有细腻的褶皱和垂坠感，外搭一件敞开的长款米色风衣，风衣随风飘动。她一手提着带有金色链条细节的黑色结构感手提包，另一只手轻触颈部，以四分之三侧身姿态自信地摆拍。她的面部应被柔和地遮挡或保持无五官状态以维持神秘感，同时服装和轮廓需保持高度细节。场景设定在夜晚光洁的瓷砖城市站台上，地面上有强烈的暖色反光，上方有荧光灯，背景有深色的电线和富有戏剧性的透视线条。左侧包含 1 列银色复古列车，带有发光的车头灯和模糊的目的地标识；右侧及背景处包含 3 名次要通勤者：前景中一个穿着深色西装的人物剪影，一个背着高大黑色乐器盒的人，以及远处一名在站台上行走的通勤者。上方添加 2 个发光的站台标志：一个部分文字为 {argument name="station sign text" default="A Trai"} 的大型红色霓虹灯标志，以及一个带有装饰性乱码文字的橙色小型广告牌。采用高细节漫画/绘本风格，线条粗犷有力，织物褶皱写实，运用黑色电影风格布光、暖金色高光、深邃阴影，列车带有轻微的动态模糊，营造出时尚奢华的杂志大片氛围。9:16 竖屏构图，低角度透视，主体略微偏右居中，无水印，除上述两个标志外无其他可读文字。

promptLocalized.zh: 使用来自 {argument name="reference" default="参考图像"} 的完全相同的人脸，并生成一张令人惊叹的双重曝光电影海报，主角为 {argument name="subject" default="参考图像中的男子"}，拥有轮廓分明的下颌线和精致的五官。他巨大的肖像占据了海报上半部分，复杂的金色龙纹刺青在他颧骨和下颌处蔓延，散发着微光。在他的剪影中嵌入：穿过云雾的中国古代宝塔、绽放着深洋红色和紫粉色的樱花树、化作墨迹的飞龙剪影，以及在深红色和玫瑰金中旋转飘落的花瓣。海报中部，同一名男子身着戏剧性的黑色战士长袍全身出镜，飘逸的深色布料在风中舞动，手持闪亮的弯刀，周围环绕着旋转的暗黑墨色能量和飘落的樱花。背景为忧郁的灰烬色、深靛蓝色的雾气，以及山峰后温暖的琥珀色月光。左上角：优雅的衬线字体标语——“命运由鲜血书写，荣誉在沉默中铸就。”右上角：铁锈红墨色的中国书法字。底部：巨大的笔触标题“DRAGON MARK WARRIOR”，采用质感白金色涂料，副标题为“传奇重生，真心错付”，以及精致小写字母的“即将上映——IMAX 震撼呈现”。色彩分级：以去饱和的水墨洗为基调，点缀着鲜红色、紫罗兰色樱花、熔金和深青色阴影。画面中散布着墨迹飞溅的细节。左下角雾气中柔和地融入了细微的水印“OzairAI”。垂直 9:13 比例。超写实，8K，电影级色彩分级。

templates.title: Desert Rally Commercial Movie Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 沙漠拉力赛商业电影海报

templates.prompt: Use the uploaded portrait only as a reference for the subject's facial structure, features, hairstyle, skin tone, body proportions, and overall personal style. Do not copy the original portrait's clothing, background, lighting, pose, expression, or image quality. The final image should retain the subject's recognizability solely through face shape and hairstyle, while all other elements should adhere to the following guidelines. Do not completely reproduce the reference image; create a similar realistic rally movie poster-style scene using new composition and English text. Create a 3:4 scale hyper-realistic live-action commercial movie poster. A young person based on the uploaded portrait stands in the foreground, with a dusty desert rally track in the background. Retain the uploaded subject's facial features, face shape, hairstyle, skin tone, body proportions, and natural charm, but create a completely new confident expression and natural pose. Subject's clothing{argument name="outfit" default="Professional black racing suit"} Featuring a minimalist, fictional rally sponsor badge and sophisticated white racing stripes. Clothing should look high-end, realistic, and well-fitting; do not copy any clothing from the reference images. The subject should naturally hold the racing helmet at their waist or under their arm. Behind the subject, a white professional rally car drifts on a dirt road, kicking up clouds of dust and gravel. The car should look powerful, realistic, and cinematic, featuring a large rear wing, racing number stickers, red and black graphic stripes, mud stains, tire tracks, and motion blur. Use only fictional racing team brands; do not use any real car logos or real sponsor logos. The background should be an open desert rally environment with dry gravel, dust, warm sunlight, and a dramatic orange sunset sky. The image should have the feel of a combination of realistic outdoor commercial photography and a high-budget racing movie poster. Utilizing cinematic golden hour lighting, warm contour lighting for hair and shoulders, realistic dust particles, natural skin texture, delicate fabric folds, realistic helmet reflections, shallow depth of field, dynamic range, high contrast, editorial-grade composition, premium sports advertising quality, a true-to-life camera feel, and a 35mm cinematic style, the foreground subject is sharp, while the drifting rally car in the background is slightly blurred. A simple, eye-catching English title is added to the bottom of the poster:{argument name="movie title" default="RALLY LIFE 3"} The text should have the feel of a professional action movie title, using metallic white and red with a dynamic, racing-inspired brushstroke style that blends naturally into the poster design. If needed, short English supplementary text can be added, such as "..."{argument name="slogan" default="CHASE THE DUST"} "" or "FULL SPEED AHEAD". All visible text must be in English. No Chinese characters are allowed. No watermarks are allowed. No AI-generated tags are allowed. Negative keywords: anime, comics, cartoons, illustrations, 3D rendering, game CGI, plastic skin, waxy face, excessive skin smoothing, beauty filters, fake face, distortion.

promptLocalized.zh:
仅将上传的肖像作为人物面部结构、五官、发型、肤色、身体比例和整体个人气质的参考。请勿复制原肖像的服装、背景、光影、姿势、表情或图像质量。最终图像应仅通过脸型和发型保持人物的可辨识度，而所有其他元素均遵循以下提示词。请勿完全重现参考图像；请使用新的构图和英文文本，创作一个类似的写实拉力赛电影海报风格场景。

创作一张 3:4 比例的超写实真人商业电影海报。

一位基于上传肖像的年轻人站在前景中，背景是黄金时刻尘土飞扬的沙漠拉力赛道。保留上传人物的面部特征、脸型、发型、肤色、身体比例和自然魅力，但要创作出全新的自信表情和自然的姿势。主体穿着 {argument name="outfit" default="专业的黑色赛车服"}，带有简洁的虚构拉力赛赞助商贴标和精致的白色赛车条纹。服装应看起来高端、写实且合身，请勿复制参考图像中的任何服装。主体自然地将赛车头盔拿在腰间或夹在腋下。

在主体身后，一辆白色专业拉力赛车正在土路上漂移，扬起大片的尘土和碎石。赛车应看起来强劲、写实且具有电影感，带有大型尾翼、赛车编号贴纸、红黑图形条纹、泥土污渍、轮胎痕迹和动态模糊。仅使用虚构的赛车队品牌，不得使用任何真实的汽车标志或真实赞助商标志。背景是开阔的沙漠拉力赛环境，有干燥的碎石、尘土、温暖的阳光和戏剧性的橙色落日天空。

图像应呈现出真实的户外商业摄影与高预算赛车电影海报相结合的质感。使用电影级的黄金时刻光影、头发和肩部的温暖轮廓光、写实的尘埃颗粒、自然的皮肤纹理、细腻的织物褶皱、真实的头盔反光、浅景深、动态感、高对比度、编辑级构图、高级体育广告品质、真实相机拍摄感、35mm 电影摄影风格，前景主体清晰，背景中漂移的拉力赛车略显模糊。

templates.title: Creative graffiti image overlay

titleLocalized.zh: 创意涂鸦图像叠加

templates.prompt: Edit this image while strictly preserving the original subject, composition, background, lighting, and perspective. Do not replace or alter the environment—the real-world scene must remain intact and realistic. Slightly enhance the overall atmosphere to make it more cinematic and serene—subtly deepen shadows, soften highlights, and introduce a soft, melancholic or rainy mood while maintaining a natural feel. Now, transform the image by adding expressive, hand-drawn overlays to create a sense of a "microcosm" around the product.{argument name="art style" default="Crayon + marker + pencil sketch style"} Make it feel playful, slightly messy, but artistically intentional—not too cluttered, but rich and layered. Add controlled elements of chaos: hand-drawn arrows pointing to key product details (texture, gloss, layering), doodle circles and highlight marks to guide attention, and dynamic lines, swirls, and sketching marks to enhance the focal point (rather than random placement). Introduce small doodle characters that interact with the product: small illustrated figures climbing, sitting, sliding, or reacting to the product. Keep it simple yet expressive. Add small speech bubbles with playful reactions, such as "BRO???", "THIS IS CRAZY", or "WE STAYING HERE". Make sure all doodles blend into the scene and follow the shape and perspective of the product. Create strong sensory contrasts: keep the background calm, soft, and slightly melancholic; the overlays are lively, bright, and vibrant. Add layered handwritten notes in a natural handwriting style (non-regular font), such as: "this part tho…", "wait—look at this", "why is this so good". Optionally include a striking handwritten phrase, such as:{argument name="slogan" default="LAST DANCE"} "As a declarative element, the final effect should be a realistic photograph infused with imagination—a tranquil scene awakened by chaotic yet playful thoughts."

promptLocalized.zh: 编辑此图像，同时严格保留原始主体、构图、背景、光影和透视。请勿替换或改变环境——必须保持真实世界的场景完整且写实。稍微增强整体氛围，使其更具电影感和宁静感——微妙地加深阴影、柔化高光，并引入柔和的忧郁或雨天氛围，同时保持自然。现在，通过添加极具表现力的手绘叠加层来转换图像，在产品周围营造出一种“微观世界”的既视感。使用 {argument name="art style" default="蜡笔 + 马克笔 + 铅笔素描风格"}，使其感觉俏皮、略显凌乱但充满艺术意图——不要过于杂乱，要丰富且有层次感。添加受控的混乱元素：手绘箭头指向关键产品细节（纹理、光泽、层次），涂鸦圆圈和高光标记以引导注意力，增强焦点的活力线条、漩涡和素描痕迹（而非随机放置）。引入与产品互动的小型涂鸦角色：攀爬、坐着、滑动或对产品做出反应的小插画人物。保持简洁但富有表现力。添加带有俏皮反应的小气泡，例如“BRO???”、“THIS IS CRAZY”或“WE STAYING HERE”。确保所有涂鸦都融入场景，并遵循产品的形状和透视。创造强烈的感官对比：背景保持宁静、柔和且略带忧郁；叠加层则生动、明亮且充满活力。添加自然手写风格（非规整字体）的分层手写笔记，例如：“this part tho…”、“wait—look at this”、“why is this so good”。可选择性地包含一句醒目的手写短语，例如：“{argument name="slogan" default="LAST DANCE"}”作为声明元素。最终效果应呈现为一张注入了想象力的真实照片——一个被混乱而俏皮的思绪所唤醒的宁静场景。

templates.title: Sunlight Butterfly Mirror Image
