templates.title: Screenshot of Berry Loud Cafe event

titleLocalized.zh: Berry Loud Cafe 活动截图

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image as a layout and webpage screenshot template, replace the existing KFC case study with a brand new social media cue word list entry to showcase a brightly colored coffee brand campaign. Maintain the same mobile screenshot cropping composition, white page background, blue link case study title style, centered bordered "Output" box, and "Prompt:" label below. Update the visible text to four main text elements: a cropped top line of text "The overall mood should feel se," a case study title "Case 172: Berry Splash Cafe Campaign (by @iamaiistudio )" (with the campaign title and account name set in blue), a centered "Output" label, and a "Prompt:" label below. Within the Output box, for{argument name="brand name" default="Berry Loud"} Create a vertical lifestyle advertising poster: showcasing the interior of a vibrant coffee shop with turquoise and pink walls, hanging plants, warm pendant lights, and wooden tables. The image should feature only one woman seated at the table, wearing a bright pink blazer, scooping a bowl of berry smoothies. Two products are on the table: a bowl of berry smoothies/acai topped with oats, berries, banana chips, and seeds; and a cylindrical product jar with turquoise and magenta labels. The poster should include three visible text areas: a large cream-colored retro bubble-style logo “BERRY LOUD” in the upper left corner; “BERRY LOUD” and smaller “ORIGINAL AÇAÍ BLEND” and “PREMIUM ACAI” printed on the product jar label; and a pink neon sign on the right wall that reads “GOOD VIBES”. The poster style should resemble sophisticated commercial coffee shop event photography: wide-angle lifestyle photography, bright and saturated colors, soft natural depth of field, warm and comfortable lighting, trendy and healthy brand aesthetics, realistic product packaging, and clear and legible typography. Maintain the frame of the screenshot and do not add extra UI elements, watermarks, or irrelevant text.

promptLocalized.zh:
以提供的参考图片作为布局和网页截图模板，将现有的 KFC 案例替换为一个全新的社交媒体提示词库条目，用于展示一个色彩鲜艳的咖啡品牌活动。保持相同的移动端截图裁剪构图、白色页面背景、蓝色链接案例标题样式、居中的带边框“Output”框以及下方的“Prompt:”标签。

将页面可见文字更新为 4 个主要文本元素：顶部一行被裁剪的文字“The overall mood should feel se”，一个案例标题“Case 172: Berry Splash Cafe Campaign (by @iamaiistudio)”（其中活动标题和账号名设为蓝色），一个居中的标签“Output”，以及一个下方的标签“Prompt:”。

在 Output 框内，为 {argument name="brand name" default="Berry Loud"} 创建一张竖版生活方式广告海报：展示一个充满活力的咖啡店内部，墙面为青绿色和粉色，配有悬挂植物、温暖的吊灯和木质桌子。画面中仅包含 1 位坐在桌旁的女性，她穿着亮粉色西装外套，正拿着勺子舀浆果奶昔碗。桌上放置 2 件产品：1 碗顶部铺有燕麦、浆果、香蕉片和种子的浆果奶昔/巴西莓碗，以及 1 个带有青色和洋红色标签的圆柱形产品罐。海报中需包含 3 处可见的文字区域：左上角巨大的奶油色复古气泡字体 Logo“BERRY LOUD”，产品罐标签上印有“BERRY LOUD”及较小的“ORIGINAL AÇAÍ BLEND”和“PREMIUM ACAI”字样，以及右侧墙上写着“GOOD VIBES”的粉色霓虹灯牌。

海报风格应呈现为精致的商业咖啡店活动摄影：广角生活方式摄影、明亮饱和的色彩、柔和的自然景深、温暖舒适的灯光、潮流健康品牌美学、逼真的产品包装以及清晰易读的排版。保持截图的框架，不要添加额外的 UI 元素、水印或无关文字。

templates.title: Celestial Realm Immortals and Palaces

titleLocalized.zh: 天界仙侠仙宫

templates.prompt: Create a vertical, fantasy-themed watercolor illustration using soft pastel tones with even, seamless color transitions and smooth lines. At the center of the image stands an ethereal celestial fairy.{argument name="character name" default="Fairy"} Standing facing forward, wearing a huge, semi-transparent Hanfu, the color of which is {argument name="dress colors" default="Pale pink, light blue, ivory white and gold"} Her skirt flared outwards like clouds and petals, adorned with tiny, luminous ornaments, butterflies, flowers, and starlight. She had extremely long black hair, wore a magnificent golden crown, and exquisite jewelry; her expression was serene and sacred. Directly below her sat a small white cat within a bright rectangular portal. Behind her was a large, pale blue-pink moon or a luminous circular portal, partially obscured by mist and architectural silhouettes. The scene was surrounded by a floating Chinese celestial palace landscape: layered, misty mountains, distant pagodas, floating pavilions, hanging beaded curtains, cloud bridges, and delicate floral branches. It included two vertical Chinese calligraphy panels: a narrow, light-colored panel on the upper left with small black calligraphy; and a framed scroll on the upper right with a large title.{argument name="right scroll title" default="Fairy Pet"} Below is a smaller vertical calligraphy. In the far left of the image is an arched stone bridge, and the lower half features three prominent lanterns (two warm, upright lanterns on the left, and a larger, ornate chandelier near the center below), as well as a centrally glowing portal behind the cat. The overall atmosphere should be dreamlike, romantic, classically Chinese, and magical, with pearly mist, shimmering light, soft ink-wash textures, delicate gold highlights, and extremely high decorative detail. Use a 9:16 vertical composition with ethereal negative space at the edges, no modern objects, no watermarks, no harsh outlines, and avoid fragmented colors or jagged lines.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅竖版奇幻仙侠水彩插画，采用柔和的粉彩色调，色彩过渡均匀、无断层，线条流畅。画面中心站立着一位超凡脱俗的天界仙女，{argument name="character name" default="仙女"}，正面站立，身着巨大的半透明汉服，颜色为 {argument name="dress colors" default="淡粉色、粉蓝色、象牙白和金色"}；裙摆如云朵和花瓣般向外铺开，上面装饰着细小的发光饰品、蝴蝶、花朵和星光。她留着极长的黑发，戴着华丽的金色花冠，佩戴精致的首饰，神情平静而神圣。在她的正下方，放置一只坐在明亮长方形光门中的小白猫。在她的身后，放置一轮巨大的淡蓝粉色月亮或发光的圆形传送门，部分被薄雾和建筑剪影遮挡。场景周围环绕着漂浮的中国仙宫景观：层叠的云雾山峦、远处的宝塔、悬浮的亭台、垂下的珠帘、云桥和精致的花枝。包含两块竖版中国书法题字板：左上方一块狭长的浅色面板，上面写着细小的黑色书法；右上方一块带框卷轴，上面写着大标题 {argument name="right scroll title" default="仙宠"}，下方配有较小的竖排书法。画面左中远景处包含一座拱形石桥，下半部分包含三个显眼的灯笼（左侧两个温暖的立式灯笼，下方中心附近一个较大的华丽吊灯），以及猫咪身后一个中央发光传送门。整体氛围应具有梦幻感、浪漫感、中国古风和魔幻色彩，带有珍珠般的薄雾、闪烁的光点、柔和的水墨质感、精致的金色高光以及极高的装饰细节。采用 9:16 的竖构图，边缘留有空灵的负空间，无现代物体，无水印，无生硬轮廓，避免色彩破碎或线条锯齿。

templates.title: Surrealist architectural retro collage

titleLocalized.zh: 超现实主义建筑复古拼贴

templates.prompt: Create a 9:16 vertical digital surrealist architectural retro collage with a warm cream-colored textured paper background featuring fine grains, stains, and aged printing spots. At the center of the composition is a large gray concrete arch with two robust vertical legs and a domed top, exhibiting a realistic, Brutalist texture with air pockets and gaps. Behind the arch, place a large, soft reddish-orange circle, partially obscured by the arch, resembling a flat sun or a hand-drawn paper plate. In front of the arch, slightly to the left center, vertically suspend a fragment of a classical plaster column, including the capital and base, creating a sense of unsupported suspension. Add four suspended concrete cubes: a large cube near the upper right corner, a small cube to its lower left, a miniature cube in the lower left corner, and a medium-sized cube near the lower left edge. Add one irregular, broken concrete rock fragment in the lower left corner. Add six birds flying from the right side of the arch towards the upper right area, presented in a retro paper-cut swallow style with dark wings and cream bellies. Includes abstract drawing markers: dashed construction lines, a rectangular grid behind the upper left of the arch, a thin circular aiming line on the right, a dashed diagonal guide line on the left, and faint horizontal and vertical alignment lines spanning the collage. Overlay torn paper shapes at the bottom: a beige textured paper scrap below the left arch leg, an olive green torn paper patch behind the right leg, and an ochre-yellow vertical block with rough brushstrokes in front of the lower right leg. Uses a restrained color palette:{argument name="background paper color" default="Warm cream color"} ,{argument name="main circle color" default="Soft reddish orange"} ,{argument name="architecture material" default="gray concrete"} Olive green, ochre yellow, and charcoal gray drawing lines. Maintaining a mixed-media retro edited collage style, surreal and elegant, with ample white space around the central object, no typography, no borders, and no watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 9:16 竖版数字超现实主义建筑复古拼贴画，背景为带有细微颗粒、污渍和陈旧印刷斑点的暖奶油色纹理纸。构图中心为一个巨大的灰色混凝土拱门，具有两个粗壮的垂直支腿和圆拱顶部，呈现出带有气孔和缺口的写实粗野主义质感。在拱门后方放置一个巨大的柔和红橙色圆圈，部分被拱门遮挡，如同平面的太阳或手绘纸盘。在拱门前方左侧偏中心位置，垂直悬浮一个古典石膏柱碎片，包含柱头和柱基，呈现无支撑的悬浮感。添加 4 个悬浮的混凝土立方体：右上角附近一个大立方体，其左下方一个小立方体，左下角一个微型立方体，以及左下边缘附近一个中等大小的立方体。在左下角添加 1 个不规则的破碎混凝土岩石碎片。添加 6 只从拱门右侧飞向右上区域的鸟，呈现为带有深色翅膀和奶油色腹部的复古剪纸燕子风格。包含抽象的绘图标记：虚线构造线、拱门左上方后方的矩形网格、右侧细圆形的瞄准线、左侧虚线对角引导线，以及横跨拼贴画的淡淡水平和垂直对齐线。在底部叠加撕纸形状：左侧拱门支腿下方一块米色纹理纸屑，右侧支腿后方一块橄榄绿撕纸补丁，以及右下角支腿前方一道带有粗糙笔触边缘的赭黄色垂直色块。使用克制的调色板：{argument name="background paper color" default="暖奶油色"}、{argument name="main circle color" default="柔和红橙色"}、{argument name="architecture material" default="灰色混凝土"}、橄榄绿、赭黄色和炭灰色绘图线条。保持混合媒介复古编辑拼贴的风格，超现实且优雅，在中心物体周围留出充足的空白，无排版，无边框，无水印。

templates.title: Surreal AI Error Revival Collage

titleLocalized.zh: 超现实 AI 错误复兴拼贴画

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a 9:16 vertical museum-quality digital pop surrealist collage with themes of artificial intelligence, classical sculpture, and retro computer glitches, titled "..."{argument name="headline text" default="AI IS THINKING SO I DON'T HAVE TO"} Canvas: High-resolution poster, 768 x 1152 or similar 2:3 vertical crop, aged warm ivory paper background with subtle stains, fibers, dust, spots, tiny cracks, faint grid lines, registration marks, dotted halftone areas, technical drawing lines, and archival museum panel textures. Subject: A massive, broken Renaissance-style marble bust, occupying two-thirds of the right side of the poster, cropped close to the top edge, extending to the bottom edge. The bust should resemble a classical male philosopher with curly hair and a long robe, but the statue is broken and cracked. The left side retains the pale, cracked texture of marble; the right side is hollowed out and filled with dense, exposed machinery: tangled beige and black cables, circuit boards, ribbon cables, brass connectors, tiny chips, dark mechanical cavities, and plaster fragments. Add notched edges, collapsed stones, missing blocks, and dust. Place a flat, opaque, grayish-brown square in the center of the face, like a neutral review occlusion block or a placeholder for a missing image. Central digital overlay: Add a retro Windows 95-style error dialog box to the lower chest area of ​​the half-body portrait. It has a dark blue title bar and displays {argument name="error title" default="Fatal Error"} The main body is gray, with a red circular icon featuring a white X, a small close button in the upper right corner, and a message.{argument name="error message" default="System failure at address 0041:7B3E The operation completed successfully."} Includes a rectangular "OK" button and a large, pixelated white mouse cursor pointing to it. Typography and minor interface details: On the left, the main title is typified in a sophisticated editing style, mixing serif and bold, compressed sans-serif fonts. "AI" is enlarged and set to burnt orange, "IS" to a smaller dark gray, "THINKING" to bold dark gray, and "SO I DON'T HAVE TO" to an elegant serif font, with "TO" in burnt orange. Below this is a four-line lowercase text block: "DELEGATION," "AS EVOLUTION.", "COMPLACENCY," and "AS DESIGN." Below that is a small orange Roman numeral marker "III." Vertical microtext along the far left edge reads "EX06/95 47-A" and "MIND / MACHINE INTERFACE." A tiny label "Fig. 01" is added near the top left corner. Add tiny technical text “CALC. // HUMAN INPUT 0.001%” and small barcode-like markers and square color blocks near the bottom left corner. Additional graphic elements: a faint circular technical chart in the bottom left quadrant, an orange nested angular geometric symbol near the bottom left corner, a cluster of black droplets of binary data consisting of 0s and 1s in the bottom right corner of the bust, and several thin black drawing lines with crosshair scales and dotted measurement guides distributed across the poster. Keep most of the left-side background white to emphasize the editorial negative space. Visual style: a sophisticated conceptual mixed-media collage, a combination of an antique museum catalog and cybernetic ruins, highly detailed realistic marble and electronic components, and a restrained palette of ivory, stone gray, dark graphite, matte brass, burnt orange, gray-blue, and gray-brown. The lighting is soft and diffused, with realistic shadows and tactile paper textures. The atmosphere is intellectual, eerie, ironic, and slightly apocalyptic. Constraints: No extra characters, no modern glossy UI, no neon cyberpunk lighting, no clean futuristic robot faces, no watermarks. Retain a precise count of elements: 1 bust, 1 taupe face mask, 1 error dialog, 1 "OK" button, 1 cursor, 1 binary droplet cluster, 1 circular chart, 1 orange nested corner marker, 1 "III" marker, and 4 lines of small delegate text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一幅 9:16 垂直博物馆级数字波普超现实主义拼贴画，主题关于人工智能、古典雕塑和复古计算机故障，标题为 {argument name="headline text" default="AI IS THINKING SO I DON'T HAVE TO"}。

画布：高版海报，768×1152 或类似的 2:3 垂直裁剪，陈旧的暖象牙色纸张背景，带有细微的污渍、纤维、灰尘、斑点、细小裂纹、淡淡的网格线、套准标记、点状半色调区域、技术绘图线和档案博物馆展板纹理。

主体：一尊巨大的破碎文艺复兴风格大理石半身像，占据海报右侧三分之二，近距离裁剪，从顶部边缘延伸至底部边缘。半身像应类似于一位留着卷发、披着长袍的古典男性哲学家，但雕像破碎开裂。左侧保留苍白开裂的大理石质感；右侧被掏空并塞满了密集的裸露机械装置：纠缠的米色和黑色电缆、电路板、带状电缆、黄铜连接器、小型芯片、深色机械空腔和石膏碎片。添加缺口边缘、崩塌的石块、缺失的块体和灰尘。在面部中心区域放置一个平坦的不透明灰褐色正方形，就像一个中性的审查遮挡块或缺失图像的占位符。

中央数字叠加层：在半身像的下胸部位置添加 1 个复古 Windows 95 风格的错误对话框。它有一个深蓝色标题栏，显示 {argument name="error title" default="Fatal Error"}，灰色主体，一个带有白色 X 的红色圆形图标，右上角有一个小的关闭按钮，以及消息 {argument name="error message" default="System failure at address 0041:7B3E The operation completed successfully."}。包含 1 个矩形“确定”按钮和 1 个指向该按钮的大型像素化白色鼠标光标。

排版和小型界面细节：在左侧，以精致的编辑风格排版主标题，混合高衬线字体和粗体压缩无衬线字体。将“AI”放大并设为焦橙色，“IS”设为较小的深灰色，“THINKING”设为粗体深灰色，并将“SO I DON'T HAVE TO”设为优雅的高衬线字体，其中“TO”为焦橙色。在其下方添加一个包含 4 行的小写文本块：“DELEGATION”、“AS EVOLUTION.”、“COMPLACENCY”、“AS DESIGN.”。在下方添加 1 个小型橙色罗马数字标记“III”。沿最左侧边缘包含垂直微缩文本，内容为“EX06/95 47-A”和“MIND / MACHINE INTERFACE”。在左上角附近添加微小标签“Fig. 01”。在左下角附近添加微小技术文本“CALC. // HUMAN INPUT 0.001%”以及类似条形码的小标记和方形色块。

附加图形元素：在左下象限包含 1 个淡淡的圆形技术图表，在左下角附近包含 1 个橙色嵌套角几何标志，在半身像右下角包含 1 个由 0 和 1 组成的黑色滴落二进制数据簇，并在海报上分布几条带有十字准线刻度和点状测量引导线的细黑色绘图线。保持左侧背景大部分留白，以强调编辑负空间。

视觉风格：精致的概念性混合媒介拼贴画，古董博物馆目录与控制论废墟的结合，高细节的写实大理石和电子元件，象牙色、石灰色、深石墨色、哑光黄铜色、焦橙色、灰蓝色和灰褐色的克制色调。光线柔和且漫射，具有逼真的阴影和触感纸张纹理。氛围知性、诡异、讽刺且略带末日感。

约束：不使用额外字符，不使用现代光泽 UI，不使用霓虹赛博朋克灯光，不使用干净的未来派机器人面孔，不使用水印。保留精确计数的元素：1 个半身像，1 个灰褐色面部遮挡块，1 个错误对话框，1 个“确定”按钮，1 个光标，1 个二进制滴落簇，1 个圆形图表，1 个橙色嵌套角标志，1 个“III”标记，以及 4 行小型委托文本。

templates.title: Soft-toned Chinese Zodiac Head Grid

titleLocalized.zh: 柔和色调十二生肖头像网格

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a collection of adorable 12 Chinese zodiac animal avatars within a single image, designed as an extension of social media profile icon style. Canvas: A square, poster-style canvas of approximately 4:5 aspect ratio, divided into a neat 3-column, 4-row grid containing 12 equally sized rectangular portrait panels with thin, light borders between them. Each panel is a half-body close-up portrait of an anthropomorphic zodiac animal against a dreamy outdoor flower field background. Visual Style: Soft, hand-painted watercolor and oil pastel textures with visible crayon-like strokes, a whimsical children's book illustration style, bright spring colors, warm internet avatar aesthetics, fluffy textures, round faces, expressive eyes, playful accessories, warm sunlight, abundant wildflowers, painterly backgrounds, and a non-realistic style. Main Details: Contains 12 zodiac animal avatar panels, arranged from left to right and top to bottom: 1) Rat: A gray mouse wearing yellow sunglasses and holding a piece of cheese, surrounded by flowers. 2) Cow: A cow with long brown hair, wearing a green hoodie and large black headphones, with a calm expression under a clear sky. 3) Tiger: An orange tiger wearing a light-colored hoodie, holding or leaning against a green skateboard, with a lazy and cool expression. 4) Rabbit: A fluffy white rabbit wearing pink heart-shaped sunglasses, a pink outfit, and holding a carrot. 5) Dragon: A light green dragon with small golden horns and flowing mane, blowing translucent bubbles against a dreamy pink-green background. 6) Snake: A cute green snake (or a turtle-snake-like character) wearing a pink patterned headscarf and pink headphones, drinking a beverage with a straw in a flower field. 7) Horse: A gray horse with pink headphones around its neck, blowing bubblegum, and a brown mane. 8) Sheep: A fluffy white sheep wearing round yellow glasses and a yellow beret, holding a retro-style camera. 9) Monkey: A brown monkey wearing a purple hoodie, pink sunglasses, and eating a banana. 10) Chicken: A colorful rooster with a red comb, green sunglasses, a pearl necklace, and drinking a beverage. 11) Dog: A cheerful brown and white puppy wearing a backwards green baseball cap and a green bandana, raising one paw to reveal its paw pad and sticking out its tongue. 12) Pig: A pink pig wearing pink heart-shaped sunglasses, pink overalls, and holding a sugar-sprinkling donut. Text Content: No text, no labels, no logo, no watermark. Custom: Overall theme is {argument name="avatar theme" default="Chinese Zodiac Social Media Profile Pictures"} The artistic style is{argument name="art style" default="Soft watercolor and oil pastel illustrations"} Season and setting are{argument name="setting" default="Sunny spring meadow"} The color scheme is{argument name="color palette" default="Bright, soft pinks, mint greens, sky blues, yellows, and warm creams"} The atmosphere of the accessories is{argument name="accessory mood" default="Trendy and cute internet fashion, including sunglasses, headphones, hoodies, drinks and snacks."} Constraints: Maintain 12 panels, with only one main animal per panel. Maintain consistent portrait proportions, softly square head compositions, playful, youthful expressions, and lush, painterly floral backgrounds across all panels.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：在一张图片中创作一套可爱的 12 生肖头像合集，设计为社交媒体个人资料图标风格的扩展集。

画布：一张 4:5 比例左右的方形海报式画布，划分为整齐的 3 列 4 行网格，包含 12 个等大的矩形肖像面板，面板间有细浅的边框。每个面板都是一个拟人化生肖动物的半身特写肖像，背景为梦幻般的户外花海。

视觉风格：柔和的手绘水粉和油画棒质感，可见蜡笔般的笔触，充满奇趣的童书插画风格，明亮的春日色彩，温馨的互联网头像美学，毛茸茸的质感，圆润的脸庞，富有表现力的眼睛，俏皮的配饰，温暖的阳光，繁茂的野花，绘画感背景，非写实风格。

主体细节：包含 12 个生肖头像面板，按从左到右、从上到下的顺序排列：1) 鼠：戴着黄色太阳镜、拿着一块奶酪的灰色小老鼠，周围环绕着鲜花。2) 牛：长着棕色长毛、戴着绿色连帽衫和黑色大耳机的牛，在晴空下表情平静。3) 虎：穿着浅色连帽衫、拿着或倚靠在绿色滑板旁的橙色老虎，表情慵懒酷炫。4) 兔：戴着粉色心形太阳镜、穿着粉色服装、拿着胡萝卜的毛茸茸白兔。5) 龙：长着小金角和飘逸鬃毛的浅绿色龙，吹着半透明的泡泡，背景为梦幻的粉绿色。6) 蛇：戴着粉色花纹头巾和粉色耳机、在花丛中用吸管喝饮料的可爱绿色蛇（或类龟蛇角色）。7) 马：脖子上挂着粉色耳机、吹着泡泡糖的灰色马，配棕色鬃毛。8) 羊：戴着圆形黄色眼镜和黄色贝雷帽、拿着复古小相机的毛茸茸白羊。9) 猴：穿着紫色连帽衫、头上架着粉色太阳镜、吃着香蕉的棕色猴子。10) 鸡：长着红色鸡冠、戴着绿色太阳镜、戴着珍珠项链并喝着饮料的彩色公鸡。11) 狗：戴着反戴绿色鸭舌帽和绿色头巾、举起一只爪子露出肉垫并吐着舌头的欢快棕白色小狗。12) 猪：戴着粉色心形太阳镜、穿着粉色背带裤、拿着撒糖甜甜圈的粉色小猪。

文字内容：无文字，无标签，无 Logo，无水印。

自定义：整体主题为 {argument name="avatar theme" default="中国生肖社交媒体头像"}；艺术风格为 {argument name="art style" default="柔和水粉与油画棒插画"}；季节与场景为 {argument name="setting" default="阳光明媚的春日野花草地"}；配色方案为 {argument name="color palette" default="明亮的柔和粉色、薄荷绿、天蓝、黄色和暖奶油色"}；配饰氛围为 {argument name="accessory mood" default="潮流可爱的互联网时尚，包含太阳镜、耳机、连帽衫、饮料和零食"}。

约束：保持 12 个面板，每个面板仅限一个主要动物。在所有面板中保持一致的肖像比例、柔和的方形头像构图、俏皮年轻的表情以及繁茂的绘画感花卉背景。

templates.title: Creamy-colored Chinese divorce data chart

titleLocalized.zh: 奶油风中国离婚数据图表

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a cream-themed, editable data visualization poster with the theme of {argument name="headline text" default="Number of divorces in China, 2020–2026"} This presentation uses a miniature 3D bar chart installation to display the number of divorces in China from 2020 to 2026. The canvas is a widescreen 16:9 composition with a warm ivory paper background featuring delicate textures, soft studio lighting, and ample white space, creating a sophisticated magazine-quality infographic. The layout features a prominent black serif Chinese title on the left, divided into two lines: "2020–2026" and "Number of Divorces in China." Below this is a subtitle, "Divorce Procedures Handled Nationwide According to Law," accompanied by a thin horizontal line ending with a small orange dot. An orange dot and the label "Unit: 10,000 Couples" are added to the lower left corner. The main chart is located in the lower center, placed on a matte black oval/cylindrical base, presented from a micro-perspective. Year labels are printed on the front edge of the base. Data and chart elements: Seven year positions are used, labeled 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, and 2026. The chart displays five solid 3D bar charts and two placeholder bars for future forecasts. The five solid bars are: a tall, gold bar for 2020, labeled "433.9"; a shorter, terracotta-red bar for 2021, labeled "283.9" with a beige label "2021 Low"; a soft sage-green bar for 2022, labeled "287.9"; a salmon-pink bar for 2023, labeled "360.53" with a pink label "2023 Rebound"; and a beige bar for 2024, labeled "351.3". The two placeholder bars for 2025 and 2026 are displayed as transparent rectangular bars with dashed outlines. Each bar has a dashed guide line connecting it to a hanging label that reads "To be updated". Black dots are used above the bar charts, and thin guide lines connect the numerical labels and annotations. Decorative scene details: Miniature figures are added to emphasize proportion: one figure stands on the left edge of the base, near a delicate, leafless decorative tree and railing; another figure stands on the right, near a future placeholder pillar. In front of the base is a small piece of paper with a simple line drawing and orange dots, a small pale green cube, and a semi-circular wooden decoration behind the paper. On the far right, a tall beige rectangular panel is added with two thin black vertical bars and a large gold sun-shaped ring above. Visual style: A soft cream aesthetic, tactile paper and clay textures, using soft tones of black, ivory, ochre, terracotta, sage green, salmon pink, beige, and warm wood tones. Titles use an elegant serif font, while numbers and small labels use a clean sans-serif font. Realistic soft shadows, miniature scale, and high-end editorial data visualizations contribute to a sophisticated and refined style. Constraints: Ensure all visible Chinese text is completely identical to the specified content, use the specified 7 year labels and 5 numerical values, and do not add any additional bar charts, legends, logos, watermarks, or irrelevant text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个奶油风格的编辑类数据可视化海报，主题为 {argument name="headline text" default="2020–2026 中国离婚人数"}，以微缩 3D 柱状图装置的形式展示 2020 年至 2026 年中国的离婚人数。

画布：宽屏 16:9 构图，温暖的象牙白纸张背景，带有细腻纹理，柔和的摄影棚灯光，留白充足，呈现精致的杂志信息图质感。

布局：左侧放置醒目的黑色衬线体中文标题，分为两行：“2020–2026” 和 “中国离婚人数”。下方添加副标题“全国依法办理离婚手续”，并配有一条以小橙点结尾的细横线。左下角添加一个橙点和标注“单位：万对”。主图表位于中下部，放置在一个哑光黑色椭圆/圆柱形底座上，以微透视视角呈现。年份标签印在底座的前缘。

数据与图表元素：使用 7 个年份位置，分别标注为 2020、2021、2022、2023、2024、2025、2026。展示 5 根实心 3D 柱状图和 2 根未来预测占位柱。5 根实心柱分别为：2020 年高大的金色柱，标注“433.9”；2021 年较矮的赤陶红柱，标注“283.9”，配有米色标注标签“2021 低点”；2022 年柔和的鼠尾草绿柱，标注“287.9”；2023 年鲑鱼粉色柱，标注“360.53”，配有粉色标注标签“2023 回升”；2024 年米色柱，标注“351.3”。2 个未来占位柱为：2025 年和 2026 年，显示为虚线轮廓的透明矩形柱，每根柱子下方有虚线引导线连接到一个写有“待更新”的悬挂纸签。在柱状图上方使用黑点标记，并使用细引导线连接数值标签和标注。

装饰性场景细节：添加微型人物以体现比例：一个小人站在底座左侧边缘，靠近一棵精致的无叶装饰树和栏杆；另一个小人站在右侧，靠近未来的占位柱。在底座前方放置一张带有简单折线图和橙点的小纸片、一个小淡绿色立方体，以及纸片后方的一个半圆形木质装饰。最右侧添加一块高大的米色矩形板，板上有两根细黑色垂直杆，上方有一个巨大的金色太阳状圆环。

视觉风格：柔和的奶油色美学，触感纸张和粘土纹理，采用黑色、象牙白、赭石色、赤陶色、鼠尾草绿、鲑鱼粉、米色和暖木色的柔和色调。标题采用优雅的衬线字体，数字和小标签采用简洁的无衬线字体。使用逼真的柔和阴影，微缩模型比例，高端编辑类数据可视化，风格沉稳且精致。

约束条件：保持所有可见中文文本与指定内容完全一致，使用指定的 7 个年份标签和 5 个数值，不得添加额外的柱状图、图例、Logo、水印或无关文本。

templates.title: Nine-grid character creation meme

titleLocalized.zh: 九宫格角色制作梗图

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a Japanese-style 3x3 meme-style flowchart demonstrating how the initial character requirements evolve throughout the production pipeline. All panels will use the same turquoise-haired, veiled fantasy dancer/queen character. The goal is to be humorous, sophisticated, and information-rich, presenting a comparison table or comic grid effect. Canvas: A vertical 3:4 aspect ratio image containing nine equal rectangular panels separated by thick black borders. Each panel has a white title bar at the top containing bold black Japanese text and circled numbers. A clean comic/illustration style will be used, maintaining consistent margins. Number of Panels and Labels: Contains 9 panels, arranged from left to right and top to bottom: 1. "① Character Setting Explained by the Creator" — A childlike crayon sketch of the character, with a simple round face, long, light green hair, a veil, gold jewelry, a white dress, blue gemstone decorations, and uneven hand-drawn lines on paper. 2. "② Understanding of the Producer" — A delicate but relatively conservative anime concept portrait, featuring a dancer with long turquoise hair, a veil, and white and gold jewelry, against a warm indoor lighting. 3. "③ Deconstruction of the Decorator" — An exaggerated and ornate fantasy illustration, with dramatic poses, a shimmering purple cosmic background, and abundant gold chains and turquoise gemstones, making it more sensual and overly elaborate. 4. "④ Explanation and Restraint for Creatures" — A beautifully crafted version with a commercial feel, featuring elegant magical light effects, butterflies or glowing particles, a romantic pastel shimmering atmosphere, gorgeous jewelry, and a flowing veil. 5. "⑤ Created Setting Data" — Professional character design sheet, including two complete full-body views of the character (front and back/side), as well as illustrations of multiple necklaces, chains, earrings, and turquoise gold jewelry accessories. The background is white, with a few sketch annotations. 6. "⑥ Illustration Raffle" — A monochrome rough pencil sketch of the character, with vibrant, loose lines, long flowing hair and a veil. Jewelry is marked with rough details; unfinished but full of dynamism. 7. "⑦ Real-world Product" — Created as an illustrated comic book poster, not a 3D figure: bold, saturated colors, rough ink lines, pop art halftone textures, the character transforms into a glamorous "EXOTIC QUEEN!" cover-style poster, featuring huge turquoise hair, gold coins, and jewelry against a yellow-pink background, with the words "EXOTIC QUEEN!" in the upper left corner. 8. "⑧ Requested Amount to Request" — A luxurious invoice scene. A parchment invoice bearing the inscription "Imperial Request" displays the enormous sum "¥3,980,000," surrounded by gold coins, jewels, and a royal seal. At the bottom is a miniature chibi-style image of a character with long turquoise hair. 9. "⑨ Character Whom I Desired" — The final desired character: an elegant, mysterious, veiled fantasy queen, clad in soft blue fabric, adorned with glowing lanterns, a warm, blurred effect, exquisite turquoise gems and gold chains, her posture graceful and cinematic. Character Details: The recurring character is {argument name="character concept" default="An exotic fantasy queen with long turquoise hair and a veil, adorned with gold jewelry and blue gemstones."} She possesses very long, aquamarine/turquoise hair, a semi-transparent veil, a magnificent gold headdress, turquoise gemstone accessories, multi-layered necklaces, armbands, a waist chain, and flowing light blue or white fabric. Maintain consistency in character identity across all panels, while varying the art style and interpretation based on the panel. Custom text: Use completely consistent Japanese title tags. Invoice amount should be {argument name="invoice amount" default="¥3,980,000"} The phrase for a Pop Art poster should be:{argument name="poster phrase" default="EXOTIC QUEEN!"} Visual Style: High-resolution anime illustration collage, humorous production process infographics, clean panel borders, and each panel features a different rendering style: crayon sketches, delicate anime, fantasy illustrations, design sheets, rough pencils, pop comics, invoice props and scenes, and cinematic final concept art. Add rich glitter, gold, turquoise, and ornate decorative patterns. Constraints: Use 9 panels and 9 designated panel labels. Maintain the visual uniqueness of each panel. Ensure that the 7th panel is clearly a flat illustration/comic poster, not a figurine or 3D object. Do not add extra panels, additional descriptive text, watermarks, or logos.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张日式 3×3 梗图风格的流程图，展示原始角色需求在制作管线中如何发生演变，所有面板均使用同一位绿松石色长发、戴面纱的奇幻舞者/女王角色。使其幽默、精致且信息量大，呈现出对比表或漫画网格的效果。

画布：垂直 3:4 比例图像，包含九个相等的矩形面板，由粗黑边框分隔。每个面板顶部均有一个白色标题条，内含加粗的黑色日文文本及带圈数字。采用简洁的漫画/插画呈现方式，保持边距一致。

面板数量及标签：包含 9 个面板，从左至右、从上至下排列：
1. 「① クライアントが説明したキャラ設定」 — 角色稚嫩的蜡笔草图，简单的圆脸，长长的水绿色头发，面纱，金饰，白色连衣裙，蓝色宝石装饰，纸上不均匀的手绘线条。
2. 「② プロデューサーの理解」 — 精致但相对保守的动漫概念肖像，绿松石色长发、戴面纱的舞者，身着白金相间的珠宝服饰，温暖的室内光线。
3. 「③ ディレクターの解釈」 — 夸张华丽的奇幻插画，戏剧性的姿势，闪烁的紫色宇宙背景，大量的金链和绿松石宝石，更具感官刺激且过度制作。
4. 「④ クライアントへの説明・約束」 — 精美且具有商业推销感的版本，优雅的魔法光效，蝴蝶或发光粒子，浪漫的粉彩闪烁氛围，华丽的珠宝和飘逸的面纱。
5. 「⑤ 作られた設定資料」 — 专业角色设计表，包含 2 个完整的角色全身视图（正面和背面/侧面），以及多个项链、链条、耳环和绿松石金饰的配件图，背景为白色，带有少量草图注释。
6. 「⑥ イラストレーターのラフ」 — 角色的单色粗糙铅笔草图，充满活力的松散线条，长长的飘逸头发和面纱，珠宝以潦草的细节标出，未完成但充满动感。
7. 「⑦ 実際の成果物」 — 将其制作成插画漫画书海报，而非 3D 手办：大胆饱和的色彩，粗犷的墨线，波普艺术半色调纹理，角色变身为华丽的“EXOTIC QUEEN!”封面风格海报，拥有巨大的绿松石色头发、金币和珠宝，黄粉色背景，左上角写有“EXOTIC QUEEN!”字样。
8. 「⑧ クライアントへの請求金額」 — 奢华的发票场景，一张写有「御請求書」的羊皮纸发票，上面写着巨额数字“¥3,980,000”，周围有金币、宝石、皇家印章，底部有一个绿松石色长发角色的微型 Q 版形象。
9. 「⑨ 本当にクライアントが欲しかったキャラ」 — 最终期望的角色：优雅、神秘、带面纱的奇幻女王，身着柔软的蓝色织物，点缀着发光的灯笼，温暖的虚化效果，精致的绿松石宝石和金链，姿态优雅，充满电影质感。

角色细节：循环出现的角色是 {argument name="character concept" default="一位绿松石色长发、戴面纱的异域奇幻女王，配有金饰和蓝色宝石"}。她拥有非常长的水绿色/绿松石色头发、半透明面纱、华丽的金质头饰、绿松石宝石配件、多层项链、臂环、腰链以及飘逸的浅蓝色或白色织物。在所有面板中保持角色身份的一致性，同时根据面板改变艺术风格和诠释方式。

文本自定义：使用完全一致的日文标题标签。发票金额应为 {argument name="invoice amount" default="¥3,980,000"}。波普艺术海报短语应为 {argument name="poster phrase" default="EXOTIC QUEEN!"}。

视觉风格：高分辨率动漫插画拼贴，幽默的制作流程信息图，清晰的面板边框，每个面板采用不同的渲染风格：蜡笔草图、精致动漫、奇幻插画、设计表、粗糙铅笔、波普漫画、发票道具场景以及电影级最终概念图。添加丰富的闪光、金色、绿松石色和华丽的装饰图案。

约束：使用 9 个面板和 9 个指定的面板标签。保持每个面板视觉上的独特性。确保第 7 面板明显为平面插画/漫画海报，而非手办或 3D 物体。不要添加额外的面板、额外的说明文字、水印或 Logo。

templates.title: Lisbon vintage tram travel poster

titleLocalized.zh: 里斯本复古电车旅行海报

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic travel poster-style photo showcasing a sun-drenched street.{argument name="city name" default="Lisbon"} The image precisely depicts two vintage yellow and red trams side-by-side, cropped in close-up to fill the frame with their rounded fronts and wooden window frames. The tram on the left is closer, with a slight crop at the left edge, and features a large white Coca-Cola logo in handwritten font on its red panel. The tram on the right is slightly turned away, displaying the number 56 in the upper right corner, and passengers can be seen through the windows. A small bottle advertisement is displayed on its red side panel. Urban background details are added: tram tracks on asphalt, a car parked on the right, lush green trees, light-colored building facades, strong midday sunlight, deep shadows, reflective glass, and a warm, nostalgic tone reminiscent of a retouched smartphone travel photo. An elegant white typography is overlaid in the lower center of the image: a very large handwritten brushstroke word.{argument name="main title" default="Lisbon"} Spanning two trams, below which are two lines of smaller serif capitalized subheadings, namely:{argument name="subtitle line one" default="Every corner"} and{argument name="subtitle line two" default="They are all telling stories"} Add thin horizontal decorative lines on both sides of the subtitle and place a small diamond-shaped decoration in the center directly below. Use a 3:2 horizontal composition, high contrast, rich warm tones, a realistic documentary photography style, and no borders, watermarks, or extra text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影质感的旅行海报风格照片，展示位于阳光明媚街道上的 {argument name="city name" default="里斯本"}，画面中精确呈现两辆并排的复古黄红色电车，采用近景裁剪，使它们圆润的车头和木质窗框填满画面。左侧电车距离较近，左边缘略有裁切，红色面板上有巨大的白色可口可乐手写体标识；右侧电车略微背向，右上角显示数字 56，透过车窗可以看到乘客，红色侧面板上有一个小型瓶装广告。添加城市背景细节：沥青路面上的电车轨道、右侧停放的汽车、绿叶繁茂的树木、浅色的建筑外墙、强烈的正午阳光、深邃的阴影、反光的玻璃，以及类似于经过修图的智能手机旅行照片的温暖怀旧色调。在画面中下部居中叠加优雅的白色排版：一个非常大的手写笔刷体单词 {argument name="main title" default="里斯本"} 横跨两辆电车，下方有两行较小的衬线体大写副标题，分别为 {argument name="subtitle line one" default="每一个角落"} 和 {argument name="subtitle line two" default="都在诉说故事"}。在副标题两侧添加纤细的水平装饰线，并在正下方居中放置一个小型菱形装饰。采用 3:2 横向构图，高对比度，浓郁的暖色调，写实的纪实摄影风格，无边框，无水印，无额外文字。

templates.title: Gothic Anime Concept Infographic

titleLocalized.zh: 哥特式动漫概念信息图

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a dark gothic anime infographic poster and analyze {argument name="work title" default="Still in Love"} and concepts{argument name="main concept" default="The sin of karmic ties"} The design employs a luxurious aesthetic of black, deep red, and moonlight silver. Canvas: Square 1:1 poster, high resolution, dense information layout, black marble/parchment background with subtle scratches, red rose petals, thorny vines, filigree trim, and a delicate antique gold border. Main title area: At the top center, "スティルインラブの『宿縁の罪科』" is written in elegant large Japanese serif font, with "宿縁の罪科" emphasized in light red. Directly below is a smaller subtitle, "『血・月・背德』が意思するもの", accompanied by delicate decorative separators. Core subject: In the center is a half-length portrait of an anime-style horse girl heroine, facing forward with a faint, melancholic smile. She possesses an ethereal {argument name="hair color" default="brown"} Long hair, red eyes, horse ears with ribbons, wearing a small, deep red dress in a maid/idol style, with white ruffles, blue bow decorations, red ribbons, gloves or bracelets, her hands held in a demure pose in front of her chest. The background is a huge full moon halo, radiating a silver-pink glow, adorned with subtle starlight and dark clouds. Main symbolic elements: Three large concept panels are used around the heroine. 1. Left circular/arched panel, labeled "Blood", deep red and black tones. Displays red glowing trees or branching blood vessel patterns, with a running black horse at the bottom, and red ribbon-like energy. Includes the text: "Bloodline, Instinct, Impulse to Race" and the smaller text "The Power to Race, Exceeding One's Own Meaning". 2. Right circular/arched panel, labeled "Moon", cool blue-black and silver tones. Shows a bright full moon over a river or water bank at night, with moonlight reflections and distant buildings. Contains the text: "Ye・覚awake・隠された性" and the smaller text "General section は suppresses え た impulse が, quiet かに目 を覚 ま す". 3. The wide horizontal panel at the bottom is marked "Back De", in dark red and black tones. The left side shows a black rose with thorn branches, and the right side shows a pale and elegant hand with a drop of blood on the fingertip. Contains the text: "爱の danger うさ・Exclusiveness・Crossing the border" and the smaller text "爱が深まるほど、心手との界を超えそうになる". Scene Impact Row: Below the bottom concept panel, create the title "シナリオへの Impact" with a gold decorative separator. Below are placed 4 small frame cards connected by right-pointing arrows. Card 1: The circled number "1" and the text "The dual nature of "rational selfishness" and "red impulse". Card 2: The circled number "2" and the text "爱はsaving the same time に呪いでもある", with "呪い" highlighted in red. Card 3: The circled number "3" and the text "The character of the girl is suffering, the character is the same, the fate is the description of the fate", with "fate" highlighted in red. Card 4: The number "4" in a circle and the text "物語は“克克”ではなく『受容』へ向かう", with "受容" emphasized in red. Bottom Argument Box: Add a final, ornate dark rectangular statement box decorated with gold and roses. Text: "『Su縁のcriminology』とは、bloody fateからbearing the original sin of love and impulse." Followed by "スティルインラブの物语は、そ"Original Sin" and "爱し, 合に生きる" are highlighted in dark red. Visual style: luxurious gothic girl fantasy, anime main visual combined with editorial infographic design, gorgeous golden filigree, deep black, burgundy highlights, moonlight silver luster, romantic and tragic atmosphere, exquisite digital painting, clear and easy-to-read layout, symmetrical composition, high contrast. Constraints: Keep all Japanese text legible and strictly arranged within the designated 3 concept panels, 4 scene cards, and 1 argument box. Do not add extra cards or characters. Avoid modern UI styles, neon cyberpunk, comedic emojis, or cluttered elements that obscure text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张暗黑哥特式动漫信息图海报，分析 {argument name="work title" default="Still in Love"} 及概念 {argument name="main concept" default="宿縁の罪科"}，采用华丽的黑、深红与月光银美学风格。

画布：方形 1:1 海报，高分辨率，信息布局密集，黑色大理石/羊皮纸背景，带有细微划痕、红玫瑰花瓣、荆棘藤蔓、花丝边角装饰以及纤细的古金色边框。

主标题区：顶部中央，使用优雅的大号日文衬线字体书写「スティルインラブの『宿縁の罪科』」，其中「宿縁の罪科」以淡红色强调。正下方为较小的副标题「『血・月・背徳』が意味するもの」，并配有精致的装饰性分隔符。

核心主体：中间放置一位动漫风格的马娘女主角，半身像，面向前方，带着淡淡的忧郁微笑。她拥有飘逸的 {argument name="hair color" default="棕色"} 长发，红色双眼，带有丝带的马耳，穿着类似女仆/偶像风格的小型深红色连衣裙，配有白色荷叶边、蓝色蝴蝶结装饰、红色丝带、手套或腕饰，双手呈矜持的胸前姿势。背景是一个巨大的满月光环，散发着银粉色的光芒，点缀着细微的星光与暗云。

主要象征部分：在女主角周围使用 3 个大型概念面板。
1. 左侧圆形/拱形面板，标注「血」，深红与黑色调。展示红色的发光树木或分支血管图案，底部有奔跑的黑马，以及红色丝带状的能量。包含文本：「血統・本能・競走への衝動」及较小文本「自分の意思を超えて流れ込む、競うための力」。
2. 右侧圆形/拱形面板，标注「月」，冷蓝黑色与银色调。展示夜间河流或水岸上方的明亮满月，带有月光倒影与远处的建筑。包含文本：「夜・覚醒・隠された本性」及较小文本「普段は抑えた衝動が、静かに目を覚ます」。
3. 底部宽横向面板，标注「背徳」，深红与黑色调。左侧展示一朵黑玫瑰与荆棘枝条，右侧展示一只苍白优雅的手，指尖有一滴血。包含文本：「愛の危うさ・独占・越境」及较小文本「愛が深まるほど、相手との境界を越えそうになる」。

场景影响行：在底部概念面板下方，创建标题「シナリオへの影響」，并配以金色装饰分隔符。下方放置 4 张由向右箭头连接的小型框架卡片。卡片 1：带圆圈的数字「1」及文本「“理性的な私”と“紅の衝動”の二面性」。卡片 2：带圆圈的数字「2」及文本「愛は救いであると同時に呪いでもある」，其中「呪い」以红色强调。卡片 3：带圆圈的数字「3」及文本「彼女の苦しみは性格ではなく、宿命として描かれる」，其中「宿命」以红色强调。卡片 4：带圆圈的数字「4」及文本「物語は“克服”ではなく『受容』へ向かう」，其中「受容」以红色强调。

底部论点框：添加一个最终的华丽暗色矩形陈述框，以金色和玫瑰花装饰。文本：「『宿縁の罪科』とは、血と運命から背負わされた 愛と衝動の原罪。」随后是「スティルインラブの物語は、それを消すのではなく、抱えたまま愛し、共に生きる物語である。」将「原罪」和「愛し、共に生きる」以深红色强调。

视觉风格：奢华的哥特式少女幻想，动漫主视觉图与编辑信息图设计相结合，华丽的金色花丝，深黑色，酒红色高光，月光银色光泽，浪漫悲剧氛围，精致的数字绘画，清晰易读的排版，对称构图，高对比度。

约束：保持所有日文文本清晰可辨，并严格排列在指定的 3 个概念面板、4 张场景卡片和 1 个论点框中。不要添加额外的卡片或角色。避免现代 UI 风格、霓虹赛博朋克、喜剧表情或遮挡文本的杂乱元素。

templates.title: Japanese blackboard style cleaning service sign

titleLocalized.zh: 日式黑板风格清洁服务招牌

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a hand-drawn Japanese-style blackboard sign for advertising purposes.{argument name="service type" default="clean"} The service is presented in a cute, friendly, and handcrafted shop style. Canvas: A horizontal blackboard poster, 3:2 aspect ratio, with a deep matte black background and a distinct chalk texture. The bottom is slightly cropped to create a close-up effect. Layout: The large title "Creating" is written in thick white chalk at the top. Decorative chalk lines, dots, swirls, and glitter icons in yellow, mint green, and blue are added around the title. In the center left, a pink speech bubble outline is placed, containing the white text "Konnaka ni" and the mint green text "Osusume!". Below the bubble, a cute black cat mascot is drawn, outlined in white chalk. The cat is blinking, has round cheeks, whiskers, triangular ears, and raises a paw with a pink paw pad. In the center right, a rounded mint green chalk outline information box is created. List 4 bullets in the box, each with a pink cat paw print icon in front of them: 1) "Business is the hand of the hand or the hand of the hustle and bustle..." 2) "The person who is busy is the person who calls the house, and the house is the same..." 3) "The hand that cleans away the pain or the physical strength is great..." 4) "Using the normal section of the building is the construction of the building...". Separate each line item with a yellow dotted line. At the center below, add a wide curved ribbon banner with a teal outline and black fill, with bold yellow chalk text: "お人せ下さい!!". Below the ribbon is smaller white chalk text: “分かってるけど後回しな場所です”, underlined with pink wavy lines. Visual style: Cute Japanese chalk art, bold handwritten font, imperfect strokes, chalk dust marks, playful yet legible typography, high-contrast white, yellow, mint green, and pink on a black background. Use decorative glitter, polka dots, corner decorations, cat paw prints, and short emphasis symbols, but keep the design as organized as a professional storefront sign. Constraints: Strictly adhere to the following: 1 cat mascot, 1 speech bubble, 1 main information box, 4 cat paw print bullet points, and 1 ribbon banner. All visible Japanese text must be completely consistent with the specified content. Photorealistic objects, digital gloss effects, or watermarks are prohibited.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张手绘日式黑板招牌，用于宣传 {argument name="service type" default="清洁"} 服务，呈现可爱、友好且具有手工感的店面项目风格。

画布：横向黑板海报，比例为 3:2，深哑光黑色背景，带有明显的粉笔质感，底部略微裁剪，营造出近距离拍摄的效果。

布局：顶部使用粗白粉笔书写大标题：「クリーニング」。在标题周围添加黄色、薄荷绿和蓝色的装饰性粉笔线条、圆点、漩涡和闪光图标。在左侧中部，放置一个粉色对话气泡轮廓，内含白色文字「こんな方に」和薄荷绿色文字「おすすめ！」。在气泡下方，绘制一只可爱的黑色猫咪吉祥物，用白色粉笔勾勒轮廓，猫咪正在眨眼，拥有圆脸颊、胡须、三角形耳朵，并抬起一只带有粉色肉垫的爪子。在右侧中部，创建一个圆角的薄荷绿色粉笔轮廓信息框。在框内列出 4 个项目符号，每个符号前均带有粉色猫爪印图标：1) 「忙しくて手が回らない…」 2) 「常に人を呼べる家にしておきたい…」 3) 「掃除が苦手 or 体力的に大変…」 4) 「普段使用しない建物など…」。用黄色虚线分隔各行项目。在下方中央，添加一条宽大的弧形丝带横幅，采用青色轮廓和黑色填充，并配以醒目的黄色粉笔文字：「お任せ下さい!!」。在丝带下方，包含较小的白色粉笔文字：「分かってるけど後回しな場所です」，并配有粉色波浪下划线。

视觉风格：日式可爱粉笔艺术，粗犷的手写字体，不完美的笔触，粉笔灰痕迹，俏皮但易读的排版，黑色背景上呈现高对比度的白色、黄色、薄荷绿和粉色。使用装饰性闪光、圆点、边角装饰、猫爪印和简短的强调符号，但保持设计如同专业店面招牌般井然有序。

约束：严格使用 1 只猫咪吉祥物、1 个对话气泡、1 个主要信息框、4 个猫爪印项目符号和 1 条丝带横幅。所有可见的日文文本必须与指定内容完全一致。禁止使用照片级真实物体、数字光泽效果或水印。

templates.title: Futuristic GPT Image 2 Promotional Image

titleLocalized.zh: Futuristic GPT Image 2 宣传图

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a square, highly impactful Japanese-style social media promotional image for release.{argument name="headline text" default="The power of GPT Image 2"} The presentation showcases a futuristic, luxurious technological/commercial aesthetic. Canvas: 1:1 square proportion, deep navy to black background, adorned with glowing blue circuit lines, a subtle HUD ring, diagonal perspective grid, gold corner decorations, and cinematic lens flare. A metallic typography is used to create a high-end presentation visual effect. Layout: The large title occupies the upper half. "GPT Image" is presented in a large, silver-white beveled sans-serif font, with a large metallic gold "2" in the upper right corner, next to a small white Japanese "の", and an oversized metallic gold Japanese "凄さ" centered below. A thin, electric blue light strip is added below the top title. Main Information Box: A dark trapezoidal panel with a thin gold outline and blue halo is placed in the center on the left. Within the panel, elegant white serif-style Japanese text is used.{argument name="main message" default="Creative ideas, transformed into commercial-grade images in minutes."} Function List: Below the information box, create a 5-row horizontal list, with a circular blue icon badge on the far left and bold white Japanese text and bullet points on the right. The 5 visible items are: 1) Megaphone icon – “Advertising Creative”, 2) Thumbs-up icon – “SNS Post”, 3) Chart/Demo icon – “Proposal Materials”, 4) Play button icon – “Thumbnails”, 5) Shopping bag icon – “Product Visuals”. The rows are separated by subtle blue dividing lines. Right-side visual example: Arrange five tilted, floating preview cards with blue outlines on the right half, simulating a business creative sample: 1) A wide-angle view of a futuristic city at night with blue light trails; 2) A product advertisement card showcasing a dark cosmetic bottle amidst foliage; 3) A business growth strategy chart card with white arrows and rising blue bars; 4) An SNS-style post card showcasing a mountain landscape; 5) A demo/thumbnail card showing a figure facing a glowing futuristic city, accompanied by the Japanese phrase "次のステージへ." (Towards the next stage) and smaller text "未来を创るのは、あなたの一歩." (To create the future begins with your steps). Bottom banner: Add a banner with a black and gold border and glowing edges at the bottom. Inside the banner, write in a large, metallic gold Japanese calligraphy style font.{argument name="bottom slogan" default="Inspiration strikes, and it takes shape instantly."} Place the brand name in the center near the bottom edge.{argument name="brand name" default="Matrix Force"} The font uses a small, spaced-out white serif font, flanked by thin gold horizontal lines. Visual style: High-end futuristic Japanese commercial advertising, cyberpunk blue and metallic gold color scheme, glossy beveled edges, sharp diagonal panels, high contrast, dramatic lighting, sophisticated commercial design, and clear, legible typography. Constraints: Maintain the exact number of 5 function lists and 5 preview cards. Retain all written Japanese text. No human figures appear in the image except for a tiny silhouette in the lower right preview card. No watermarks, no additional logos, and no spelling errors.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：制作一张方形、具有高冲击力的日式社交媒体宣传图，用于发布 {argument name="headline text" default="GPT Image 2 的强大之处"}，并呈现未来感奢华科技/商业美学。

画布：1:1 方形比例，深海军蓝至黑色的背景，配以发光的蓝色电路线条、淡淡的 HUD 环、对角透视网格、金色边角装饰以及电影级镜头光晕。采用金属质感排版，呈现高级演示文稿的视觉效果。

布局：上方的大标题占据上半部分。将“GPT Image”以巨大的银白色斜角无衬线字体呈现，右上角放置一个巨大的金属金色“2”，旁边配以小号白色日文“の”，下方居中放置超大金属金色日文“凄さ”。在顶部标题下方添加一条细长的电光蓝光带。

主信息框：在左侧中心位置，放置一个带有细金色轮廓和蓝色光晕的深色梯形面板。在面板内，以优雅的白色衬线风格日文字体排版 {argument name="main message" default="创意，数分钟内\n转化为商业级图像。"}。

功能列表：在信息框下方，创建 5 行水平列表，最左侧带有圆形蓝色图标徽章，右侧为加粗的白色日文文本及项目符号。5 个可见项目为：1) 扩音器图标 — “广告创意”，2) 大拇指图标 — “SNS 帖子”，3) 图表/演示图标 — “提案资料”，4) 播放按钮图标 — “缩略图”，5) 购物袋图标 — “商品视觉”。行与行之间使用细微的蓝色分割线隔开。

右侧视觉示例：在右半部分排列 5 张带有蓝色轮廓的倾斜悬浮预览卡片，模拟商业创意样本：1) 一张宽幅未来城市夜景，带有蓝色光轨；2) 一张产品广告卡，展示植物丛中的深色化妆品瓶；3) 一张商业增长策略图表卡，带有白色箭头和上升的蓝色柱状图；4) 一张 SNS 风格的帖子卡，展示山地景观；5) 一张演示/缩略图卡，展示一个面对发光未来城市的人影，配有日文“次のステージへ。”（迈向下一个阶段）以及较小的文字“未来を創るのは、あなたの一歩。”（创造未来，始于你的脚步）。

底部标语：在底部添加一个带有黑色和金色边框且边缘发光的横幅。在横幅内，以巨大的金属金色日文书法风格字体书写 {argument name="bottom slogan" default="灵感闪现，即刻成形。"}。在底部边缘附近居中位置，放置品牌名称 {argument name="brand name" default="Matrix Force"}，使用小号、字间距拉开的白色衬线字体，两侧配以细长的金色水平线。

视觉风格：高端未来主义日式商业广告，赛博蓝与金属金配色，光泽斜角，锐利的对角面板，高对比度，戏剧性光影，精致的商业设计，清晰易读的排版。

约束条件：保持 5 行功能列表和 5 张预览卡片的精确数量。保留所写的日文文本。除右下角预览卡片中微小的人影外，画面中不出现人物。无水印，无额外 Logo，无拼写错误。

templates.title: Golden Morning Light Kitchen Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 金色晨光厨房肖像

templates.prompt: Create a warm, cinematic vertical lifestyle photograph, with the subject being {argument name="character description" default="A young woman with long dark brown hair"} She sits sideways on the kitchen countertop, bathed in the morning sunlight. She wears a loose-fitting beige chunky knit off-the-shoulder sweater, one shoulder slightly exposed, her legs folded over the edge of the countertop, her posture relaxed and slightly playful as she looks at the camera; her face is partially obscured by a centered opaque beige square. The room is a cozy little kitchen, with strong golden backlight streaming in through large windows. White sheer curtains hang behind the windows, creating soft mist, halos, hair-like edge lighting, and distinct circular orange lens flares. The camera employs shallow depth of field, a dreamy film-like quality, warm amber tones, soft-focus highlights, and a natural, homey feel. It includes 10 striking kitchen still-life elements: an electric swan-neck kettle by the window, a pour-over coffee filter, a glass coffee maker below it, a white coffee cup, a slice of bread on a wooden item, a whole bread roll in the foreground, a lush herb on the countertop, a potted plant by the window, and two shelves on the right wall displaying glass jars and cups. Maintaining a 2:3 vertical composition, the woman is positioned on the left side of the image, with coffee utensils and bread in the foreground on the right. The background is a brightly overexposed window, creating an intimate morning atmosphere. There is no visible text or watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张温暖、具有电影感的竖构图生活方式照片，主角为 {argument name="character description" default="一位留着深棕色长发的年轻女性"}，她侧身坐在清晨阳光洒满的厨房台面上。她穿着一件宽松的米色粗棒针露肩毛衣，一侧肩膀微露，双腿折叠在台面边缘，姿态放松且略带俏皮，看向镜头；用一个居中的不透明米色方块遮住她的脸部。房间是一个温馨的小厨房，大窗户透进强烈的金色逆光，窗后挂着白色薄纱窗帘，营造出柔和的雾气、光晕、发丝边缘光以及明显的圆形橙色镜头光斑。采用浅景深、梦幻的胶片摄影质感、温暖的琥珀色调、柔焦高光以及自然的家居真实感。包含 10 个醒目的厨房静物元素：窗边 1 个电动鹅颈壶、1 个手冲咖啡滤杯、其下方 1 个玻璃咖啡分享壶、1 个白色咖啡杯、木制项目上 1 个切开的面包、前景中 1 个完整的面包卷、台面上 1 盆茂盛的草本植物、窗边 1 盆绿植，以及右侧墙上放置玻璃罐和杯子的 2 个搁板。保持 2:3 竖构图，女性位于画面中左侧，咖啡用具和面包位于右侧前景，背景为明亮过曝的窗户，营造亲密的清晨氛围，无可见文字，无水印。

templates.title: Cyber ​​Butler's Concerned Monologue

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博管家的关切独白

templates.prompt: Create a delicate, anime-style panel illustration depicting a loyal cybernetic butler in a luxurious Victorian mansion late at night. The image shows the butler from the waist up, standing behind a gleaming dark wood desk, dressed in a formal black tailcoat, black waistcoat, striped white shirt, and black tie, with gold buttons, a pocket watch chain, and a pale gold rose boutonniere pinned to his left lapel. His head is not a human face, but a slightly tilted black widescreen monitor, displaying the white Japanese text "お嬢様" and a yellow heart in the center. His exposed hands are elegant white articulated mechanical hands: one hand is solemnly pressed against his chest, while the other extends forward, making a worried and pleading gesture towards the viewer. Add a tall, vertical white speech bubble on the right, containing the Japanese text "...I'm coming to visit you. I'm so glad you're here. Please come back soon." The scene is set in a warm, dimly lit study. A large window offers a view of the deep blue city skyline at night. The room is furnished with heavy curtains, framed artwork, and ornate furniture. A bright, ornate desk lamp shines on the right. The desk contains only three main items: an ornate silver tray in the lower left corner, a closed brown concierge memo book with a pen on it in the lower right corner, and a small vase or a cluster of pale gold roses on the far left. Utilizing cinematic warm lighting, delicate metallic reflections, an exquisite gothic luxury atmosphere, shallow depth of field, high-detail anime rendering, and elegant composition, the image contains no other characters and has no watermark. Customizable details:{argument name="screen address text" default="Young lady"} ,{argument name="screen icon" default="💛"} ,{argument name="speech bubble text" default="...Let's proceed without rushing. However, please don't preemptively give up on your own wishes, young lady."} ,{argument name="butler flower" default="Pale gold rose corsage"} ,{argument name="setting" default="A luxurious Victorian study late at night"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张精致的动漫风格单格插画，描绘一位忠诚的赛博管家在深夜的奢华维多利亚式宅邸中。画面展示了管家的腰部以上部分，他站在一张光亮的深色木质书桌后，身穿正式的黑色燕尾服、黑色马甲、条纹白衬衫、黑色领带，配有金色纽扣、怀表链，左翻领上别着一朵淡金色的玫瑰胸花。他的头部不是人脸，而是一个微微倾斜的黑色宽屏显示器，屏幕中央显示着白色的日文文本「お嬢様」以及一个黄色爱心。他露出的双手是优雅的白色关节型机械手：一只手严肃地按在胸前，另一只手向前伸出，向观众做出担忧且恳求的姿态。在右侧添加一个高大的垂直白色对话气泡，内含日文文本「……急がずに参りましょう。ですが、お嬢様ご自身の願いまで、先回りして諦めないでください。」场景设定在一个温暖、昏暗的书房中，大窗户可以看到窗外深蓝色的城市夜景，配有厚重的窗帘、装裱的艺术品、雕花家具，右侧有一盏发光的华丽台灯。书桌上仅包含三个主要桌面物品：左下方的一个雕花银质托盘，右下方的一本合上的棕色礼宾备忘录（上面放着一支钢笔），以及最左侧的一个小花瓶或一簇淡金色玫瑰。使用电影般的暖色调灯光、细腻的金属反射、精致的哥特式奢华氛围、浅景深、高细节动漫渲染、优雅的构图，画面中无其他角色，无水印。可自定义细节：{argument name="screen address text" default="お嬢様"}, {argument name="screen icon" default="💛"}, {argument name="speech bubble text" default="……急がずに参りましょう。ですが、お嬢様ご自身の願いまで、先回りして諦めないでください。"}, {argument name="butler flower" default="淡金色玫瑰胸花"}, {argument name="setting" default="深夜的奢华维多利亚式书房"}。

templates.title: Social media anime fashion character lineup

titleLocalized.zh: 社交媒体动漫时尚角色阵容

templates.prompt: Against a white studio backdrop and the reflection of a gleaming floor, a clean, full-body anime-style character lineup was created, showcasing four anthropomorphic social media platform characters standing side-by-side, each with a tag and a horizontal line below them:{argument name="first platform label" default="X"} ,{argument name="second platform label" default="Instagram"} ,{argument name="third platform label" default="Threads"} as well as{argument name="fourth platform label" default="TikTok"} The style is characterized by high-detail modern Japanese illustration, street techwear, clean line art, soft painterly shadows, fashionable idol poses, and a wealth of platform-themed accessories. There is no background or watermark. Character 1, X: A tall, slender young man wearing an all-black layered techwear outfit, featuring an oversized black jacket, straps, buckles, black cargo pants, and black high-top sneakers. The jacket and shoes are adorned with sharply defined white X patterns. He holds a black smartphone, has messy black hair, and a cool, aloof posture, surrounded by sparse black diagonal stripe patterns and tiny UI fragments. Character 2, Instagram: A trendy young woman in soft neon-colored clothing, with curly, light brown hair, pink sunglasses, a white cropped top and high-waisted loose white pants, a semi-transparent iridescent pink-orange-purple jacket, a brightly colored belt and straps, pink-orange sneakers, carrying a small camera, surrounded by 5 Instagram theme elements: a large Instagram logo near her head, a heart notification icon, a floating profile window frame behind her, a small photo card, and an Instagram logo badge hanging from her waist; her bottom label is an orange-pink gradient. Character 3, Threads: A young man with a soft, minimalist style, wearing a loose all-white suit, a beige oversized shirt and wide-leg pants, white sneakers, a black shoulder bag with the Threads spiral logo, holding an open notebook or small book, with slender black lines wrapped around his body, a calm, contemplative pose with his hand on his chin, surrounded by 3 speech bubbles containing ellipses; his bottom label is black. Character 4, TikTok: A vibrant young woman dressed in black cyberpunk idol streetwear accented with bright cyan and pink. She sports twin ponytails with colorful highlights and ribbons, a black cropped top, an oversized black jacket, a black mini-skirt with laces, fishnet/lace-up leg details, and platform sneakers. She is depicted with one leg raised and one arm extended in a dance pose while taking a selfie with her smartphone. The character includes the TikTok logo, musical notes, wave graphics, a play button icon, cyan/pink ribbons and laces, and a small floating TikTok app icon nearby. The four characters are evenly spaced, with their entire bodies clearly visible from head to toe. Faces can be simplified or obscured to achieve a concept art effect. The background is bright white with subtle floor reflections.

promptLocalized.zh: 在白色摄影棚背景和光亮地板倒影下，创作一套干净的全身动漫时尚角色阵容，展示 4 个并排站立的社交媒体平台拟人化角色，每个角色下方均带有标签及下方横线：{argument name="first platform label" default="X"}、{argument name="second platform label" default="Instagram"}、{argument name="third platform label" default="Threads"} 以及 {argument name="fourth platform label" default="TikTok"}。风格为高细节现代日本插画、街头机能风（techwear）、清晰的线条艺术、柔和的绘画式阴影、时尚的偶像姿势、丰富的平台主题配饰，无背景，无水印。角色 1，X：高挑纤瘦的年轻男性，身穿全黑叠穿机能风服装，搭配超大号黑色夹克、绑带、搭扣、黑色工装裤、黑色高帮运动鞋，外套和鞋子上带有棱角分明的白色 X 图案，手持黑色智能手机，黑色凌乱发型，冷峻疏离的姿势，周围环绕着稀疏的黑色斜杠图案和微小的 UI 碎片。角色 2，Instagram：潮流年轻女性，身穿柔和霓虹色系服装，卷曲蓬松的浅棕色头发，头上戴着粉色太阳镜，白色短款上衣和高腰宽松白裤，半透明的虹彩粉橙紫色夹克，色彩鲜艳的腰带和绑带，粉橙色运动鞋，携带一台小型相机，周围环绕着 5 个 Instagram 主题元素：头顶附近有一个巨大的 Instagram 标志，一个爱心通知图标，身后一个悬浮的个人资料窗口框架，一张小照片卡，以及腰间悬挂的一个 Instagram 标志徽章；其底部标签为橙粉色渐变。角色 3，Threads：柔和极简风年轻男性，身穿宽松的全白套装，米色超大号衬衫和阔腿裤，白色运动鞋，带有 Threads 螺旋标志的黑色单肩包，手持一本打开的笔记本或小书，细长的黑色线状物环绕身体，手托下巴的冷静沉思姿势，周围环绕着 3 个包含省略号的对话气泡；其底部标签为黑色。角色 4，TikTok：充满活力的年轻女性，身穿带有鲜艳青色和亮粉色点缀的黑色赛博朋克偶像街头服饰，双马尾带有彩色挑染和丝带，黑色短款上衣，超大号黑色夹克，带有绑带的黑色短裙，渔网/绑带腿部细节，厚底运动鞋，单腿抬起，一只手臂举起做舞蹈姿势，同时手持智能手机自拍；包含 TikTok 标志、音符、波形图形、播放按钮图标、青色/粉色丝带和绑带，以及附近一个悬浮的小型 TikTok 应用图标。保持四个角色间距均匀，全身从头到鞋清晰可见，面部可适当简化或遮挡以呈现概念图效果，背景为明亮的白色，并带有微妙的地板倒影。

templates.title: Realistic anime-style human body model display

titleLocalized.zh: 写实动漫风格人体模型展示

templates.prompt: Create a realistic, vertical-format fashion store mannequin display. The main subject is an adult-sized, glossy white female mannequin dressed in an anime-style school uniform cosplay outfit. Use realistic retail product photography techniques with a shallow depth of field effect. The mannequin's face is smooth and blank, blurred by a soft gray rectangle. She has short black bob bangs and only two tall, black plush animal ears on her head. Above her head is a transparent acrylic halo panel supported by a slender transparent stand, printed with blue concentric circles, like a prop. Clothing: A naval-style sailor uniform with white stripes, a bright blue scarf tied at the chest, a dark pleated skirt, and a loose light blue kimono-style haori with a dark navy blue collar and cuffs; the left sleeve is decorated with a white floral pattern. A thin black ribbon bow is tied around her neck. The mannequin has two glossy white hands: the raised right hand elegantly holds several thin blue ropes, while the left hand gathers the hanging ropes near the waist. A white retail price tag hangs from the chest area, printed with the product text and price "¥24,800" in small print. Cartoon-style white sound effects are added around the mannequin: four instances of the Japanese character "キシッ" and four sets of small, wavy, squeaking symbols, distributed below the head, shoulders, and sides of the body. Background: A softly blurred interior of a high-end clothing store, using warm beige lighting, with dappled light on the ceiling, displaying clothing racks, a tall, bright window or light panel on the left, and softly colored clothing on the right. Using realistic camera optics, natural reflections are created on the glossy mannequin and acrylic halo, employing warm interior color tones to showcase highly detailed fabric textures, creating a high-end showroom atmosphere. The custom character concept is {argument name="character name" default="Anime Halo Cat-Eared Female Student Human Figure"} The main clothing color is{argument name="main outfit color" default="Light blue and navy blue"} hair color is{argument name="hair color" default="black"} The price tag text is{argument name="price tag text" default="¥24,800"} The audio text is{argument name="sound effect text" default="キシッ"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实风格的竖版时尚店人体模型展示图，主体为一个成年尺寸的亮面白色女性人体模型，身着动漫风格的校服 Cosplay 服装，采用逼真的零售产品摄影手法，具有浅景深效果。人体模型面部光滑且空白，被一个柔和的灰色矩形模糊遮挡，留着黑色短波波头刘海，头顶有且仅有 2 只高耸的黑色毛绒动物耳朵。头顶上方有 1 个透明亚克力光环面板，由细长的透明支架支撑，上面印有蓝色同心圆图形，如同道具配件。服装：海军风水手校服，带有白色条纹装饰，胸前系着亮蓝色领巾，深色百褶裙，外搭一件宽松的浅蓝色和服式羽织，配有深海军蓝翻领和袖口；左袖饰有白色花卉图案。颈部系有一条细黑色丝带蝴蝶结。人体模型有 2 只亮面白色手部：抬起的右手优雅地握着几根细蓝绳，左手在腰部附近聚拢垂下的绳子。胸部区域悬挂 1 个白色零售价格标签，上面印有细小的产品文字和价格“¥24,800”。在人体模型周围添加漫画风格的白色音效：4 处日文文字“キシッ”以及 4 组小型波浪状吱吱声符号，分布在头部、肩部和身体两侧下方。背景：柔和虚化的高档服装店内部，采用暖米色灯光，天花板有光斑，陈列着衣架，左侧有高大的明亮窗户或灯板，右侧为色调柔和的服装。使用写实的相机光学效果，在亮面人体模型和亚克力光环上呈现自然的反射，采用室内暖色调，展现高细节的织物纹理，营造出高级展厅的氛围。自定义角色概念为 {argument name="character name" default="动漫光环猫耳女学生人体模型"}，主服装颜色为 {argument name="main outfit color" default="浅蓝与海军蓝"}，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"}，价格标签文字为 {argument name="price tag text" default="¥24,800"}，音效文字为 {argument name="sound effect text" default="キシッ"}。

templates.title: Realistic Angel Model Boutique Showcase

titleLocalized.zh: 写实天使模特精品店展示

templates.prompt: Create a realistic portrait of a high-end boutique model, featuring an elegant anime-style angel character.{argument name="character name" default="Mireia"} Inside the clothing store, soft natural window lighting and a shallow depth of field effect are used. The mannequin has a smooth, white, faceless head, partially covered by a simple square gray privacy panel. Extremely long, silver-white hair cascades to her waist, with a cluster of pale pink lilies with green leaves tucked into her hair near her right temple. Above her head is a semi-transparent acrylic halo disc imprinted with a white thorn circular badge, capturing highlights like polished plastic. The mannequin wears an exquisite {argument name="outfit style" default="White military-style women's uniform"} A fitted white uniform skirt with gold piping, short cape-style sleeves overlaid on glossy white long sleeves, double-breasted gold buttons, a black ribbon bow at the chest, a small red and gold circular badge, gray suspenders across the torso, a wide gray belt, and a deep navy or black skirt visible beneath the coat. A white feathered angel wing is added to the observer's right, curving upwards behind the body. The model's left arm is bent behind her head, and her right hand is on her hip, emphasizing the doll-like quality of the fashion display, complete with glossy plastic hands. A rectangular white shop tag hangs from the belt, bearing the words {argument name="tag text" default="ミレニア / Saint Lily Dress / ¥24,800"} It contains three hand-drawn style white Japanese onomatopoeic words, each with a written {argument name="sound effect text" default="キシッ"} One is located near the raised left arm, one near the right wing, and one in the lower left waist area. Background: A softly blurred upscale clothing store with clothes racks, warm beige interior lighting, and a bright large window on the left. Realistic lens blur, high-end product photography, 3:4 vertical composition, clean highlights, no extra people, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实的高端精品店模特照片，主角是一位优雅的动漫风格天使角色，{argument name="character name" default="Mireia"}，置身于服装店内，采用柔和的自然窗光和浅景深效果。模特拥有光滑的白色无面头部，部分被一个简单的方形灰色隐私遮挡块覆盖，极长的银白色长发垂至腰间，右侧太阳穴附近的头发中别着一束带有绿叶的淡粉色百合花。头顶上方是一个半透明的亚克力光环圆盘，上面印有白色荆棘圆形徽章，捕捉着如抛光塑料般的高光。模特身着一件精致的 {argument name="outfit style" default="白色军装修女服"}：修身白色制服裙，配有金色滚边、覆盖在亮面白色长袖上的短斗篷式袖子、双排金色纽扣、胸前的黑色丝带蝴蝶结、一枚红色和金色的小圆形胸章、横跨躯干的灰色背带、宽大的灰色腰带，以及在大衣下方可见的深海军蓝或黑色裙摆。在观察者右侧添加一只白色羽毛天使翅膀，在身体后方向上弯曲。模特左臂弯曲于脑后，右手叉腰，强调时尚展示人偶的质感，配有光泽感的塑料手部。在腰带上悬挂一个长方形白色商店标签，上面写着 {argument name="tag text" default="ミレニア / Saint Lily Dress / ¥24,800"}。包含三个手绘风格的白色日语拟声词，每个都写着 {argument name="sound effect text" default="キシッ"}：一个位于抬起的左臂附近，一个位于右侧翅膀附近，一个位于左下腰部区域。背景：柔和虚化的高档服装店，配有衣架、温暖的米色室内灯光、左侧明亮的大窗户，写实镜头模糊，高级产品摄影，3:4 竖构图，干净的高光，无额外人物，无水印。

templates.title: HSP3 Comic Introduction

titleLocalized.zh: HSP3 漫画入门介绍

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a 6-panel Japanese manga-style educational illustration with the theme of {argument name="programming language" default="HSP3"} Each panel features the same anime female student as the narrator, her face deliberately blurred/softened. Canvas: Wide horizontal comic layout, approximately 3:2 aspect ratio, divided into 3 columns and 2 rows of 6 rectangular panels with thin black borders. Each panel has a small white square numbered label in the upper left corner, numbered 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6. Visual Style: Simple Japanese educational manga/anime infographic style, with soft light-colored dots and glitter in the background, clear lines, white speech bubbles with black outlines, and a navy blue and burgundy school uniform color scheme, creating a friendly learning atmosphere for beginners. The narrator is an anime girl with a dark brown short bob and bangs, wearing a Japanese sailor school uniform: a white shirt, a navy blue sailor collar with white stripes, a burgundy ribbon bow, and a navy blue pleated skirt. Her face is kept blurred or without facial features in each panel. Panel Details and Text Content: 1. Panel 1: The girl stands on the left, raising one index finger, as if introducing the topic. The background features a light blue circular decoration. Add a cloud-shaped speech bubble containing the Japanese text: "こんにちは！今日はHSP3言語について紹介します！" Add a striking blue title in the lower right corner: "HSP3言語をはじめよう！" 2. Second panel: The girl is located on the left-center, looking thoughtful, with one hand supporting her chin. Add a light-colored question mark to the background. The speech bubble on the right reads: "HSP3 ってどんな语なんだろう?" The rounded white description box at the bottom reads: "HSP3は, beginners にもやさしい国产のプログラミング语です!" 3. Square 3: The girl stands on the right, pointing to the "item" on the left. Above the speech bubble is written: "HSP3 features are these 3!" This "item" must contain 3 lines of numbered function points: "① Write a simple program!", "② Quick and easy movements!", "③ Best for game and tool making!" Add a yellow emphasis mark near the girl. 4. Fourth panel: A dark code editor window is displayed on the left, titled "sample.hsp", containing simple HSP-style code. Visible lines include "open 0,800,600", "color 255,255,255", "pos 100,100", "mes \"Hello, HSP3!\"", "wait 60", "stop". The girl stands on the right, raising one index finger. The bottom, rounded speech bubble reads: "シンプルな构文で、はじめての人でもすぐにプログラムを書けます！" 5. Fifth panel: A small game window is displayed on the left, titled "HSP3 Game," containing a pixelated platform game scene with three red heart icons, a small player character, platforms, coins, slime-like enemies, and small creatures on the platform above. The girl stands on the right, excitedly raising her fists. The bottom speech bubble reads: "ゲーム制作もできるよ！こんなゲームもHSP3で作れちゃいます！" A yellow excitement symbol is added near her head. 6. Sixth panel: Pink glitter background. The girl stands on the right, arms outstretched in an encouraging gesture. A cloud-shaped speech bubble in the upper left reads: "さあ、あなたもHSP3を始めてみましょう！" Add large red text in the lower left: "楽しく学んで、いろんな作品を作ってみてね！" Constraints: 6 panels and 6 panel number tags must be used. Maintain consistency in character design and clothing across all panels. Ensure all Japanese text is clear and legible, and as close as possible to the specified wording. Do not add extra panels, logos, watermarks, or irrelevant characters.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张 6 格日式漫画风格的教育介绍图，主题为 {argument name="programming language" default="HSP3"}，每一格中均出现同一位动漫女学生作为讲解员，其面部特意进行模糊/柔化处理。

画布：宽幅横向漫画布局，比例约为 3:2，分为 3 列 2 行共 6 个矩形格子，带有细黑色边框。每个格子左上角有一个白色小方块数字标签，编号依次为 1、2、3、4、5、6。

视觉风格：简洁的日式教学漫画/动漫信息图风格，背景带有柔和的淡色圆点和闪光，线条清晰，白色对话气泡配黑色轮廓，海军蓝与酒红色的校服配色，营造友好的初学者学习氛围。讲解员是一位留着深棕色短波波头和刘海的动漫少女，身穿日式水手校服：白色衬衫、带有白色条纹的海军蓝水手领、酒红色丝带蝴蝶结、海军蓝百褶裙。在每一格中保持她的面部模糊或无五官特征。

格子细节与文字内容：
1. 第 1 格：少女站在左侧，举起一根食指，仿佛在介绍主题。背景有淡蓝色圆形装饰。添加一个云朵状对话气泡，内含日语文字：「こんにちは！今日はHSP3言語について紹介します！」在右下方添加醒目的蓝色大标题文字：「HSP3言語をはじめよう！」
2. 第 2 格：少女位于中左侧，做思考状，一只手托着下巴。背景添加淡色问号。右侧对话气泡写着：「HSP3ってどんな言語なんだろう？」底部的圆角白色说明框写着：「HSP3は、初心者にもやさしい国産のプログラミング言語です！」
3. 第 3 格：少女站在右侧，指向左侧的「项目」。对话气泡上方写着：「HSP3の特徴はこの3つ！」该「项目」必须包含 3 行编号的功能点：「① 簡単にプログラムが書ける！」, 「② 軽くて動作が速い！」, 「③ ゲームやツール制作に最適！」在少女附近添加黄色强调符号。
4. 第 4 格：左侧展示一个深色代码编辑器窗口，标题为「sample.hsp」，包含简单的 HSP 风格代码，可见行包括「open 0,800,600」, 「color 255,255,255」, 「pos 100,100」, 「mes \"Hello, HSP3!\"」, 「wait 60」, 「stop」。少女站在右侧，举起一根食指。底部横跨的圆角对话气泡写着：「シンプルな構文で、はじめての人でもすぐにプログラムを書けます！」
5. 第 5 格：左侧展示一个小游戏窗口，标题为「HSP3 Game」，包含一个像素风平台游戏场景，内有 3 个红色心形图标、一个小玩家角色、平台、金币、史莱姆状敌人以及上方平台上的小生物。少女站在右侧，兴奋地举起双拳。底部对话气泡写着：「ゲーム制作もできるよ！こんなゲームもHSP3で作れちゃいます！」在她的头部附近添加黄色兴奋符号。
6. 第 6 格：粉色闪光背景。少女站在右侧，双手张开，做出鼓励的姿势。左上方的云朵状对话气泡写着：「さあ、あなたもHSP3を始めてみましょう！」在左下方添加红色大字：「楽しく学んで、いろんな作品を作ってみてね！」

约束：必须使用 6 个格子和 6 个格子编号标签。在所有格子中保持角色设计和服装的一致性。确保所有日语文字清晰易读，并尽可能接近指定的措辞。不要添加额外的格子、标志、水印或无关角色。

templates.title: A classroom embrace during golden hours

titleLocalized.zh: 黄金时刻的教室拥抱

templates.prompt: Create a warm, cinematic realistic portrait of two Japanese high school girls in sailor uniforms embracing tenderly in an empty classroom during a golden hour. The girl in the foreground {argument name="front girl hair" default="Long straight black hair"} She sat behind a wooden classroom chair, facing the camera, her hands resting on the back of the chair; she wore a navy blue and white sailor uniform with a red ribbon tied around her neck. The second girl {argument name="back girl hair" default="Dark brown short bob haircut"} Standing behind her, arms wrapped around her shoulders and chest, offering a protective, gentle embrace; she is wearing a matching navy blue and white sailor uniform. The image should include two girls, two visible desks, two visible chairs (in the foreground/midground), and a blurred blackboard in the background. Use soft rectangular blur blocks to obscure the faces of both girls, while keeping their hair, uniforms, arms, and poses clearly visible. The classroom should have the effect of warm sunset light streaming in from the large window on the right, complemented by glowing orange curtains, a soft, dusty atmosphere, shallow depth of field, realistic skin tones, natural hand placement, vintage Japanese classroom furniture, wooden chair backs, metal chair frames, and a softly blurred blackboard on the left. Use a 4:5 vertical composition, a level shooting angle, to create an intimate and pure atmosphere, a realistic photographic style, warm tones, soft lens bokeh, no text, no watermarks, no extraneous figures, and no exaggerated anatomical structures.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张温暖、具有电影质感的写实肖像，画面中两名身穿水手服的日本女高中生在黄金时刻的空教室里温柔相拥。前景中的女孩，{argument name="front girl hair" default="长直黑发"}，坐在木制教室椅后面向镜头，双手搭在椅背上；她身穿海军蓝白相间的水手服，胸前系着红色丝带。第二个女孩，{argument name="back girl hair" default="深棕色短波波头"}，站在她身后，双臂环绕着她的肩膀和胸部，给予保护性的温柔拥抱；她穿着同款海军蓝白水手服。画面中需包含 2 名女孩、2 张可见的课桌、2 把可见的椅子（位于前景/中景），以及背景中 1 块模糊的黑板。用柔和的矩形模糊块遮住两人的面部，同时保持头发、制服、手臂和姿势清晰可见。教室应呈现出温暖的夕阳余晖从右侧大窗户射入的效果，配以发光的橙色窗帘、充满尘埃感的柔和氛围、浅景深、真实的肤色、自然的手部摆放、怀旧的日本教室家具、木制椅背、金属椅架，以及左侧柔和模糊的黑板。采用 4:5 竖构图，平视拍摄角度，营造亲密而纯洁的氛围，写实摄影风格，暖色调，柔和的镜头虚化效果，无文字，无水印，无多余人物，无夸张的解剖结构。

templates.title: Anime-style police officer model fashion display

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫风警官模特时尚陈列

templates.prompt: Create a realistic photograph of a high-end fashion boutique. The subject is a life-size, glossy white female model, styled like a police officer or security guard in an anime style. The image shows the upper body from mid-thigh, against a background of the boutique's interior with soft, warm-toned bokeh. Clothes racks are visible in the background, and a large window is on the left. The model's face is smooth and featureless, with a soft gray square privacy panel deliberately covering the center, and she is wearing {argument name="hair color" default="dark gray-brown"} The model sports a short bob wig and a gleaming police cap. A large, semi-transparent acrylic halo panel with ornate white openwork patterns adorns the back of the cap, serving as a decorative prop. Clothing details include a crisp white shirt, a black and gold striped tie with a tie clip, black suspenders and a belt with metal buckles, high-waisted black pinstripe trousers, and a beige trench coat draped over the shoulders like a cape, featuring dark sleeves and fine gold trim. The image must include two handwritten-style Japanese onomatopoeic words, "kishi," positioned on either side of the shoulders, each accompanied by two dynamic, curved lines suggesting creaking joints. Two clearly visible retail price tags should be added, one clipped to the chest strap and the other hanging near the lower right corner of the coat hem, with subtle barcode details. The overall effect is a refined, realistic editing style, employing shallow depth of field, realistic reflections on glossy plastic skin, high-end store lighting, a 4:5 vertical composition, and a centered subject. Avoid adding extra characters, unnecessary text, or visible watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实的高端时装店摄影作品，主体为一个真人大小的亮面白色女性模特，造型为动漫风格的警官或安保人员。画面展示从大腿中部以上的部位，背景为精品店室内，带有柔和的暖色焦外成像，背景可见衣架，左侧有一扇大窗户。模特面部光滑且无五官，中心处特意覆盖了一个柔和的灰色方形隐私遮挡块，佩戴着 {argument name="hair color" default="深灰棕色"} 的短波波头假发，以及一顶闪亮的警官大檐帽。帽子后方有一个大型半透明亚克力光环面板，带有华丽的白色镂空花纹，如同装饰性的角色道具。服装细节：挺括的白色衬衫、黑金条纹领带配领带夹、黑色背带和带有金属扣的束带，高腰黑色细条纹长裤，以及一件像披风一样披在肩上的米色风衣，风衣带有深色袖片和细金边。画面中需包含两个手写风格的日文拟声词「キシッ」，分别位于肩膀左右两侧，每个词旁带有两条弧形动感线条，暗示模特关节的吱吱声。添加两个清晰可见的零售价格标签，分别夹在胸带上和挂在右下角衣摆附近，带有微小的条形码细节。采用浅景深、亮面塑料皮肤上的真实反射、高级商店照明、4:5 竖构图、主体居中，呈现精致的写实编辑风格。避免添加额外角色、多余文字或可见水印。

templates.title: Anime: Green Onion Harvest Heroine

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫大葱丰收女英雄

templates.prompt: Create a vibrant, anime-style full-body vertical illustration depicting a young fantasy heroine standing in a lush green onion field under a bright summer sky. The character is the main subject, shot from a low angle, slightly to the right and centered. Dynamic winds will sway her extremely long {argument name="hair color" default="Black hair with a violet gradient"} The wind blows dramatically to the left. Her face is blurred with soft-edged squares, while the rest of the image remains sharp and highly detailed. She wears an elegant white shirt with wide sleeves, a turquoise sleeveless robe/cape, a dark turquoise pleated skirt, a layered white overcoat, a dark blue belt, white knee-high socks, and ornate botanical accessories. The image must contain eight clearly visible clothing/accessory elements: a white shirt, a turquoise robe, a dark turquoise pleated skirt, a layered white overcoat, a dark blue belt, a floral brooch, a tasseled circular waist ornament, and a pair of white knee-high socks. Her right arm is raised high, proudly holding a large bundle of fresh {argument name="vegetable" default="scallions"} The scallion leaves are long and slender, with tender white parts; the left hand hangs naturally at the side. The background is a refreshing harvest scene, with neat rows of scallions filling the foreground and midground, flanked by distant blue-green mountains. The sky is a vibrant cobalt blue, dotted with fluffy white clouds. Scattered scallion leaves and small blades fluttering in the wind are added to the sky to enhance the sense of movement and freshness. The artwork employs a high-detail Japanese anime illustration style, with bright and pure colors, clear lines, painterly highlights, flowing fabrics, shimmering sunlight, and a heroic, refreshing harvest atmosphere. The aspect ratio is 3:4, with no text, no watermark, and no additional characters.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张充满活力的动漫风格全身竖版插画，描绘一位年轻的奇幻女英雄站在灿烂夏日天空下郁郁葱葱的大葱田里。角色为画面主体，采用低角度仰拍，略微偏右居中，动态的风将她极长的 {argument name="hair color" default="带有紫罗兰色渐变的黑发"} 戏剧性地吹向左侧。她的面部被柔边方形模糊处理，而画面其余部分保持清晰且高度细节化。她身穿优雅的白色衬衫，配有宽袖、青绿色无袖外袍/披风、深青色百褶裙、分层白色罩裙、深蓝色腰带、白色过膝袜以及华丽的植物系配饰。画面需包含 8 个清晰可见的服装/配饰元素：1 件白色衬衫、1 件青绿色外袍、1 件深青色百褶裙、1 件分层白色罩裙、1 条深蓝色腰带、1 枚花卉胸针、1 个流苏圆环腰部挂饰以及 1 双白色过膝袜。她的右臂高高举起，自豪地握着 1 大捆新鲜的 {argument name="vegetable" default="大葱"}，葱叶修长，葱白鲜嫩；左手自然垂在身侧。背景为清新的丰收场景，前景和中景布满了整齐的大葱行，两侧有远处的蓝绿色山脉，天空呈鲜艳的钴蓝色，点缀着蓬松的白云。在天空中添加散落的随风飘扬的大葱叶和细小叶片，以增强动感和清新感。采用高细节的日系动漫插画风格，色彩明亮纯净，线条清晰，具有绘画感的高光、飘逸的织物、闪烁的阳光以及英雄般清新爽朗的丰收氛围。画面比例 3:4，无文字，无水印，无额外角色。

She had extremely long, flowing hair.{argument name="hair color" default="The hair color gradually changed from black to a vibrant purple."} Swaying to the left in the wind, the image is full of tension; her face is deliberately obscured by a soft, square blur effect centered on her head. Her posture is elegant and dramatic: one arm is raised above her head, with slender fingers, while the other hangs naturally, her body slightly tilted upwards, as if she were in a gentle breeze. Design six clearly visible clothing/accessory elements for her: a crisp white shirt, a flowing black robe with ornate gold embroidery on the hem and cuffs, a dark pleated skirt, a wide burgundy leather belt with a metal buckle, and a hanging gold tassel waist ornament. The background shows a bright white round window, with a dark branch spanning across the upper left, adorned with small purple flowers; a warm-colored paper lantern with red tassels hangs in the upper left. Add a cluster of purple flowers and green leaves in the lower right foreground, and a few warm, blurred spots of light in the lower left. Employing exquisite Japanese fantasy illustration aesthetics, the artwork emphasizes delicate fabric folds, elegant lines, soft cinematic lighting, deep navy shadows, violet accents, and gold highlights to create a tranquil springtime atmosphere. The canvas is in a 3:4 vertical format, with compositions ranging from half-body to full-body. The artwork contains no text, watermarks, or other additional characters.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张精致的动漫风格竖版肖像，画面主体为 {argument name="character name" default="一位神秘而优雅的女性"}，她站在室内，背景是一扇带有黑色几何格栅的大型圆形月洞窗。她拥有极长的秀发，{argument name="hair color" default="发色从黑色渐变为鲜艳的紫色"}，随风向左侧飘动，画面极具张力；她的面部被一个以头部为中心的柔和方形模糊效果刻意遮盖。她的姿态优雅且富有戏剧性：一只手臂举过头顶，手指纤细，另一只手臂自然下垂，身体微微向上倾斜，仿佛置身于微风中。为她设计 6 种清晰可见的服饰/配饰元素：一件挺括的白色衬衫、一件飘逸的黑色外袍、袍边和袖口饰有华丽的金色刺绣、一条深色百褶裙、一条带有金属扣的宽版酒红色皮带，以及一个悬挂的金色流苏腰饰。背景展示了一扇明亮的白色圆形窗户，左上方横跨着 1 根深色树枝，枝头点缀着紫色小花；左上方悬挂着 1 个带有红色流苏的暖色纸灯笼。在右下角前景处添加 1 簇紫色花朵和绿叶，左下方点缀少量温暖的虚化光斑。采用精致的日式奇幻插画美学，强调细腻的布料褶皱、优雅的线条、柔和的电影级光影、深邃的藏青色阴影、紫罗兰色调点缀以及金色饰品高光，营造出宁静的春日氛围。画布比例为 3:4 竖版，构图为半身至全身，画面中无文字、无水印、无其他额外角色。

templates.title: Portrait of the Moon Goddess

She is elegantly turned a third of the way to the side, her back to the camera, her head slightly turned to the left, her face deliberately obscured by a centrally positioned, softly edged light gray square occluder. She possesses extremely long hair.{argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} Her flowing hair, strands cascading outwards and shimmering with light, gleamed with a blue-white halo in the backlight. She wore a dark {argument name="dress color" default="Midnight Deep Blue"} A floor-length, off-the-shoulder, backless gown made of multiple layers of sheer chiffon, adorned with starlight-like speckles, silver embroidery, beaded chains, and dangling crystal teardrops. A magnificent celestial headdress is added, featuring moon-like silver branches and tiny blue gemstones. In the background, a large, luminous crescent moon rises behind her head and shoulders, contrasting with a deep black-blue starry sky, swirling blue nebula mist, and magical particles. The image must include three suspended teardrop-shaped crystals: one near the upper left edge, one near the upper right edge, and the third in the center right. The foreground is filled with reflective water, silver vines, crystal leaves, shimmering frost flowers, and blue-white highlights. Utilizing dramatic rim lighting, high contrast, glossy reflections, and volumetric lighting effects, the design presents an ultra-refined, fantastical haute couture style, creating a romantic, dark fairytale atmosphere, crafting realistic digital art, focusing on the details of the dress and hair, without text or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 2:3 比例的竖版电影级奇幻肖像，描绘一位站在黑暗魔法夜花园中的空灵月亮女神。她以优雅的三分之四侧身背对镜头，头部微微向左转，面部被一个居中的柔边浅灰色方形遮挡块刻意遮盖。她拥有一头极长的 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色"} 飘逸秀发，发丝向外流淌并散发着光芒，在背光下呈现出蓝白色的光晕。她身着一件深 {argument name="dress color" default="午夜深蓝色"} 色露肩露背拖地长裙，裙身由多层透明雪纺制成，点缀着星光般的斑点、银色刺绣、珠链和悬垂的水晶水滴。添加一个华丽的天体发冠，带有月亮般的银色枝条和细小的蓝色宝石。背景中，她的头部和肩部后方是一轮巨大的发光新月，衬托着深黑蓝色的星空、旋转的蓝色星云雾气和魔法粒子。画面中需包含 3 颗悬挂的泪滴状水晶：一颗靠近左上边缘，一颗靠近右上边缘，另一颗位于中右侧。前景布满了反光的水面、银色藤蔓、水晶叶片、闪烁的霜花和蓝白色的高光。采用戏剧性的轮廓光、高对比度、光泽反射、体积光效果，呈现超精细的奇幻高定风格，营造浪漫的暗黑童话氛围，打造写实数字艺术，聚焦于裙装与发丝细节，无文字，无水印。
