templates.title: post-apocalyptic wasteland cactus warrior

titleLocalized.zh: 末日废土仙人掌战士

templates.prompt: Create a 9:16 aspect ratio, cinematic vertical action poster: a person named{argument name="character name" default="Unnamed Cactus Warrior"} A fierce female apocalyptic warrior stands in the center of a modern, ruined city, using a low-angle perspective against a backdrop of sandstorms and shattered buildings. She wears a tight-fitting black leather breastplate with a deep neckline, paired with black tactical pants, a belt, pouches, straps, dark metal shoulder and arm armor, and tattered yellow cloth dangling from her waist. Her wet, dark brown hair flies in the wind, but her face is deliberately obscured by a small, opaque brown rectangle covering her head. She violently swings a massive, spiked metal mace towards the camera, creating a striking foreground perspective: the mace's head is enormous, slightly blurred by the depth of field, covered in golden spikes, dark, worn metal, and scratches, with a cactus-shaped relief on its front. Behind her, a huge cactus leaf rises diagonally from the lower right to the upper left, like a menacing shield, yellowish-green and scarred, covered with long white spikes and red cactus fruit buds; fragments and sparks fly through the air. In the upper right background, a large, ghostly silhouette of a woman's head or hair is added, partially hidden behind a cactus, its face covered by a large, opaque brown rectangle. A total of two rectangles are used: one small rectangle covering the warrior's face, and one large rectangle covering the face of a background character. The overall atmosphere is explosive, hardcore, ultra-detailed, dark fantasy sci-fi, photorealistic concept art, high-contrast golden hour backlighting, volumetric smoke, falling rubble, dynamism, and shallow depth of field. There is no text or watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 9:16 比例的电影级竖版动作海报：一位名为 {argument name="character name" default="未命名仙人掌战士"} 的凶猛女性末日战士站在现代废墟城市中央，采用低角度透视，背景是沙尘暴和破碎的建筑。她身穿紧身黑色皮革铠甲胸衣，领口深开，搭配黑色战术裤、腰带、收纳袋、绑带、深色金属肩甲和臂甲，腰间垂挂着破烂的黄色布片。她湿漉漉的深棕色头发在风中飞舞，但她的脸部被一个位于头部的微小不透明棕色矩形遮挡块刻意隐藏。她将一把巨大的金属带刺钉头锤向镜头猛力挥出，营造出极具冲击力的前景透视：钉头锤锤头巨大，因景深效果略显模糊，表面覆盖着金色尖刺、深色磨损金属、划痕，正面刻有仙人掌状浮雕。在她身后，一片巨大的仙人掌叶片从右下角向左上角斜向耸立，宛如一面狰狞的盾牌，呈现黄绿色且伤痕累累，上面布满了长长的白色尖刺和红色的仙人掌果实芽；碎片和火花在空中飞舞。在右上角背景中，加入一个巨大的幽灵般女性头部或头发剪影，部分隐没在仙人掌后，其面部被一个大型不透明棕色矩形遮挡块覆盖。总共使用 2 个遮挡矩形：1 个小方块遮住战士面部，1 个大方块遮住背景人物面部。整体氛围充满爆发力、硬核、超细节、暗黑奇幻科幻风格、照片级真实概念艺术、高对比度黄金时刻背光、体积烟雾、坠落的瓦砾、动态感、浅景深，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Café overhead view, posture change

titleLocalized.zh: 咖啡馆俯视视角姿态转换

templates.prompt: Based on the provided reference image, while maintaining the same subject, clothing, and outdoor café terrace scene, the composition was changed to a close-up, high-angle shot from above. She was seated back in the wicker café chair, leaning slightly forward, her hands holding {argument name="drink" default="A white coffee cup containing black coffee"} Close to the chest. Maintain consistency with the reference image in the lavender sheer blouse, lace camisole details, gray skirt, jewelry, hairstyle, wicker chair, round stone coffee table, small white vase, balcony greenery, and dappled sunlight. The image should focus more tightly on the upper body and the edge of the table, ensuring she holds exactly one cup, there's an empty white saucer on the table, and a small glass vase containing small white flowers is visible. Keep the image anonymous.{argument name="face covering" default="Overlay a solid rectangular blur block over the face."} It employs a realistic, natural daylight photography style, using shallow depth of field and soft highlights, and does not add any text or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 以提供的参考图像为基础，在保持同一主体、同一服装和户外咖啡馆露台场景的前提下，将构图更改为从上方俯视的近距离高角度镜头。让她重新坐在藤编咖啡椅上，身体微微前倾，双手捧着 {argument name="drink" default="一个装有黑咖啡的白色咖啡杯"} 靠近胸前。保持薰衣草色透视衬衫、蕾丝吊带细节、灰色裙子、首饰、发型、藤椅、圆形石制咖啡桌、小白花花瓶、阳台绿植以及阳光斑驳的阴影与参考图一致。画面需更紧凑地聚焦于上半身和桌面边缘，确保她手中正好有 1 个杯子，桌上放有 1 个空白色茶托，并可见 1 个装有小白花的小玻璃花瓶。保持匿名化处理，即 {argument name="face covering" default="在面部覆盖一个实心矩形模糊块"}。采用写实的自然日光摄影风格，使用浅景深和柔和的高光，且不添加任何文字或水印。

templates.title: Elegant Japanese Tarot Reading Certificate

titleLocalized.zh: 华丽的日式塔罗占卜证书

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a lavish Japanese-style fortune-telling certificate for the AI ​​divination results, titled "Anata's Essence and Future Compass," in the style of antique tarot cards and astrological certificates. Canvas: Vertical A4 pages, warm ivory parchment background with fine double-lined gold borders, delicate Victorian filigree at the four corners, roses in the upper left, upper right, lower left, and lower right corners, adorned with small stars, crescent moons, and gold decorations. A luxurious retro color palette is used, featuring cream, dark brown, antique gold, burgundy, dusty rose, and deep navy blue. Header: Large, centered Japanese title:{argument name="headline text" default="Your true nature and your future compass"} Below is a smaller subheading:{argument name="year and subtitle" default="2026 Destiny Reading Report"} Below this is a delicate fill line that reads "Target for Identification: Life-Giving Person," accompanied by decorative dividing lines. Main Visual Area: The upper half features three tilted tarot cards and a central compass. From left to right: 1) "THE STAR" card: a deep navy blue starry sky, a woman kneeling by the water, slightly tilted to the left; 2) a large central gold astrological compass/compass rose, radiating light from the center; 3) "THE SUN" card: a child on a white horse, a sunflower, slightly tilted to the right; 4) "WHEEL OF FORTUNE" card: a magnificent zodiac wheel and angel imagery, tilted even more to the right. A subtle halo is added behind the cards. Text Layout: Below the tarot card area, eight rectangular interpretation sections are created, arranged in a neat 2-column, 4-row grid. Each section has a circular badge icon on the left and a Japanese title and key text on the right. The eight sections are: 1) "Career Luck" (feather icon), 2) "Interpersonal Relationships" (heart icon), 3) "Health Luck" (crystal icon), 4) "Good Fortune" (scale icon), 5) "Gold Luck" (golden lantern/amulet icon), 6) "Strength" (rose and star icon), 7) "Compass Icon," and 8) "Comprehensive Luck" (crescent and star icon). Each box contains concise Japanese key points; the text should resemble a personalized fortune report, be neat and easy to read, and use dark brown ink and bold bracket headings. The bottom conclusion: Add a separate wide-bordered panel titled "The Final Guidance of Destiny." On the left is a vertical illustration depicting a glowing antique lantern containing a candle, placed within a card with a dark gold border. The right side contains a beautiful Japanese passage, as {argument name="fortune year" default="2026"} The final guidance mentions that accumulated learning and experience will be quietly and accurately passed on to the world, and cherishing what has been built will attract like-minded partners. A small, conjoined English signature, "Fortune Reading Signature," is included at the end. Decorative details: The four corners of the page feature four striking rose clusters, two crescent moon patterns, three small gold sun badges near the top, numerous tiny twinkling stars, delicate gold dividing lines, and symmetrical scroll patterns, creating a sophisticated mystical/tarot atmosphere. Text style: The title uses Japanese Mincho, and the body text uses a smaller Japanese serif font, dark brown ink, and gold accents. The overall design should present the quality of a high-end printed divination certificate that people would appreciate. Constraints: All text in designated locations must be in Japanese; avoid modern UI elements; no realistic figures other than tarot card illustrations; no watermarks; no QR codes; no additional cards besides the three listed tarot cards; and no additional text areas beyond the eight listed sections.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 AI 占卜结果创建一份华丽的日式运势解读证书，标题为「あなたの本質と未来の羅針盤」，风格仿照古董塔罗牌与占星术鑑定书。

画布：竖版 A4 页面，暖象牙色羊皮纸背景，细双线金边，四角饰有精致的维多利亚风格花丝，左上、右上、左下和右下角绘有玫瑰，并点缀着小星星、新月和金色装饰。采用奶油色、深褐色、古金色、酒红色、灰粉色和深海军蓝的奢华复古色调。

页眉：居中大号日文标题：{argument name="headline text" default="あなたの本質と未来の羅針盤"}。下方为较小的副标题：{argument name="year and subtitle" default="2026年 運命鑑定書"}。在此之下，包含一行精致的填空线，内容为「鑑定対象：　　　　生　　　　生まれ　　　　様」，并配有装饰性分隔线。

主视觉区：在上半部分放置 3 张倾斜的塔罗牌以及 1 个中央罗盘。从左至右依次为：1) “THE STAR”牌，深海军蓝星空，水边跪着的女性，略微向左倾斜；2) 一个巨大的中央金色占星罗盘/罗盘玫瑰，中心发光并向外辐射光芒；3) “THE SUN”牌，白马上的孩童，向日葵，略微向右倾斜；4) “WHEEL OF FORTUNE”牌，华丽的黄道十二宫轮盘和天使形象，向右倾斜角度更大。在牌后添加淡淡的光晕。

正文布局：在塔罗牌区域下方，创建 8 个矩形解读板块，排列成整齐的 2 列 4 行网格。每个板块左侧为一个圆形徽章图标，右侧为日文标题及要点文本。8 个板块分别为：1) 「仕事運」（羽毛图标），2) 「人間関係」（心形图标），3) 「健康運」（水晶图标），4) 「気をつけた方が良いこと」（天平图标），5) 「金運」（金灯笼/护身符图标），6) 「強み」（玫瑰与星星图标），7) 「やるべきこと」（罗盘图标），8) 「総合運」（新月与星星图标）。每个方框内使用精简的日文要点；文本应看起来像一份个性化的运势报告，整洁易读，使用深棕色墨水和加粗的括号标题。

底部结论：添加一个独立的宽边框面板，标题为「運命からの最終的な導き」。左侧放置 1 张竖向插图，描绘一盏发光的古董灯笼，内含蜡烛，置于深金色边框的卡片中。右侧包含一段优美的日文段落，作为 {argument name="fortune year" default="2026年"} 的最终指引，内容提及积累的学习与经验将静谧而确切地传递给世界，珍视已建立的一切将引来志同道合的伙伴。结尾处附上一个小的连体英文签名“Fortune Reading Signature”。

装饰细节：页面四角包含 4 簇醒目的玫瑰，2 个新月图案，顶部附近有 3 个金色小太阳徽章，大量细小的星光闪烁，精致的金色分隔线，对称的卷轴花纹，营造出一种高级的神秘学/塔罗氛围。

文字风格：标题采用日文明朝体（Mincho），正文使用较小的日文衬线体，深棕色墨水，金色点缀。整体设计应呈现出一种人们乐于收到的高级印刷占卜证书质感。

约束条件：所有指定位置的文字必须使用日文，避免使用现代 UI 元素，塔罗牌插图之外不得出现写实人物，无水印，无二维码，除 3 张塔罗牌外不得增加额外卡牌，除列出的 8 个板块外不得增加额外正文区域。

templates.prompt: Create a square close-up illustration of an anime character, the protagonist being a {argument name="character name" default="Mischievous Wolf Cat Girl"} The image features a chibi-style catgirl, composed of a half-body portrait from the chest up, against a simple and soft dark blue-green background. She has a large, round, chibi-style head, white feline face and paws, and a slightly messy, layered look.{argument name="hair color" default="Charcoal gray hair with striking white highlights on the forehead."} She has two enormous, upright cat ears on her head, with dark gray fur on the outside and pink fur on the inside, topped with fluffy white tufts. She has a pair of huge amber cat eyes with vertical slits, glossy highlights, thick black upper eyelashes, and a sly, half-closed expression; in addition, she has a small pink triangular nose, a cat mouth with two small sharp teeth, light blush under her eyes, gray markings on her muzzle, and long, thin white whiskers extending from her cheeks. She is depicted with one hand supporting her chin, as if resting with a smug, thoughtful expression. She is dressed in a primitive tribal fantasy style outfit, containing five clearly visible clothing or accessory elements: a black fur collar, a brown leather one-shoulder bodice, a row of ivory tusks at the neckline, a brown leather wristband on her raised arm, and a brown armband with a white diamond pattern on her other upper arm. Use clear digital anime line art, soft cel shadows, glossy hair highlights, and high-contrast black outlines. The ears and collar should show delicate fur texture. The expression should be cute but slightly wild. There should be no text, no watermark, no extra characters, and the composition should be compact and cropped, with the cat ears almost touching the top edge.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张正方形的动漫角色特写插画，主角是一位名为 {argument name="character name" default="调皮的狼猫娘"} 的 Q 版猫娘，构图为胸部以上的半身像，背景为简洁柔和的深蓝绿色。她拥有硕大的 Q 版圆头、白色的猫科面部和爪子，留着凌乱的层次感 {argument name="hair color" default="炭灰色头发，前额带有醒目的白色挑染"}，头顶两只超大的直立猫耳，外侧为深灰色毛发，内侧为粉色，并带有蓬松的白色耳簇。她有着一对巨大的琥珀色猫眼，瞳孔呈垂直细缝状，带有光泽感高光、浓密的黑色上睫毛，表情狡黠且半眯；加上一个小巧的粉色三角形鼻子、带有两颗小尖牙的猫嘴、眼下淡淡的腮红、灰色的口鼻部斑纹，以及从双颊延伸出的细长白色胡须。让她摆出单手托腮的姿势，仿佛在休息时露出得意思考的神情。为她穿上原始部落奇幻风格的服装，包含 5 个清晰可见的服饰或配饰元素：黑色毛绒领子、棕色皮革单肩胸衣、领口处的一排象牙尖牙装饰、抬起手臂上的棕色皮革护腕，以及另一侧上臂带有白色菱形图案的棕色臂环。采用清晰的数字动漫线稿、柔和的赛璐珞阴影、光泽感发丝高光、高对比度的黑色轮廓线，耳部和领口处需展现细腻的毛发质感，表情可爱但略带野性，无文字，无水印，无多余角色，构图需紧凑裁剪，猫耳几乎触及顶部边缘。

templates.title: Cosmic Coral Whale

titleLocalized.zh: 宇宙珊瑚鲸

templates.prompt: Create a fantastical illustration depicting a colossal, translucent humpback whale swimming as if in the depths of outer space. The whale occupies most of the vertical composition, tilting from the lower left to the upper right, its head on the left and its tail curling upwards and to the right in a graceful arc, like splashing water. The whale's body has a glassy texture, emitting bioluminescence in shades of turquoise, sapphire, purple, and soft pink, with starlight shimmering within its skin. Inside the transparent whale's belly, a vibrant coral reef ecosystem is showcased, featuring five prominent coral clusters: a large, light pink, branching coral cluster near the center; a cluster of pink and yellow anemone-like corals on the right; a soft blue coral mound below the center; a pale purple coral reef near the lower left; and a light peach coral fan near the lower center. Below the whale, add 11 small fish swimming in loose arcs, their colors including cream, pale yellow, light blue, cyan, and orange. Add three jellyfish around the whale: a bioluminescent jellyfish on the upper left of its head, a small jellyfish near the center of its upper back, and a miniature jellyfish along the right edge of its tail. Surround the whale with numerous shimmering bubbles and droplets, especially around its curved tail and lower right fin, maintaining its delicate, jewel-like texture. The background is a deep navy blue starry sky, dotted with countless tiny stars and a few larger, twinkling starbursts, creating a cosmic underwater atmosphere. Style: Highly detailed ethereal digital painting, delicate dissolving outlines, soft gradients, transparent watercolor sheen, bright edge lighting, magical space-ocean atmosphere, no text, no borders, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅梦幻般的奇幻插画，描绘一条巨大的半透明座头鲸像在海洋中一样游弋在深邃的外太空中。鲸鱼占据了竖构图画面的大部分，从左下角向右上角倾斜，头部位于左侧，尾部向右上方卷曲，形成优美的弧线，宛如水花飞溅。鲸鱼的身体呈现出玻璃般的质感，散发着青色、绿松石色、宝蓝色、紫色和柔粉色的生物荧光，皮肤内闪烁着如星辰般的光点。在透明的鲸鱼腹部内，展示一个充满活力的珊瑚礁生态系统，包含 5 簇显眼的珊瑚：中心附近一簇大型浅粉色分枝珊瑚，右侧一簇粉黄相间的海葵状珊瑚，中心下方一簇柔蓝色珊瑚丘，左下角附近一簇淡紫色珊瑚礁，以及中下部附近一簇浅桃色珊瑚扇。在鲸鱼下方添加 11 条小鱼，呈松散的弧形游动，颜色包括奶油色、浅黄色、浅蓝色、青色和橙色。在鲸鱼周围添加 3 只水母：头部左上方一只发光水母，背部上方中心附近一只小型水母，以及尾部右侧边缘一只微型水母。在鲸鱼周围环绕许多闪烁的气泡和水滴，特别是在弧形尾部和右下鳍周围，保持其精致如宝石般的质感。背景为深海军蓝色的星空，点缀着无数微小的恒星和几颗较大的闪烁星芒，营造出宇宙水下的氛围。风格：高度细腻的空灵数字绘画，精致的溶解轮廓，柔和的渐变，透明的水彩光泽，明亮的边缘光，神奇的太空海洋氛围，无文字，无边框，无水印。

templates.title: Realistic long-haired cat portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 写实长毛猫肖像

templates.prompt: Create a highly realistic studio portrait, with a long-haired animal as the main subject.{argument name="animal subject" default="domestic cat"} The composition employs a compact head-to-chest angle, with the subject facing the camera directly, centered, and gazing at the viewer with a calm, slightly serious expression. This cat possesses {argument name="fur color and pattern" default="Dark charcoal gray and white two-tone hair"} It has a white muzzle and a white stripe on the center of its forehead. Its chest is covered in fluffy, white hair, while its cheeks and crown are darker. The long, layered hair shows clearly individual strands. It is characterized by large, erect, triangular ears with pink inner ears and slender ear tufts.{argument name="eye color" default="Golden amber"} The eyes are vertical and sharp, the pupils are small and soft, the nose is pink, and the whiskers extend to both sides. The photograph employs a realistic animal photography style, showcasing extremely detailed fur texture, natural and soft studio lighting, a shallow depth of field, and sharp focus on the face and eyes with subtle catchlights. The background is a smooth, dark color.{argument name="background color" default="Dark green"} It features soft vignetting. The portrait is vertically composed, square to near-vertical cropped, without accessories, text, or watermarks, and contains no human elements.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高度写实的摄影棚肖像，主体为一只长毛 {argument name="animal subject" default="家猫"}，采用紧凑的头部至胸部构图，主体正对镜头，居中放置，并以冷静、略显严肃的表情直视观众。这只猫拥有 {argument name="fur color and pattern" default="深炭灰色与白色双色毛发"}，白色口鼻部，前额中心有白色条纹，胸部毛发蓬松洁白，脸颊和头顶颜色较深，长而有层次的毛发可见清晰的单根质感。强调其大而直立的三角形耳朵，内耳呈粉色并带有细长的耳簇，明亮的 {argument name="eye color" default="金琥珀色"} 眼睛，瞳孔垂直且锐利，小巧柔软的粉色鼻子，以及向两侧延伸的长白胡须。采用写实动物摄影风格，展现极其细腻的毛发质感、自然柔和的摄影棚灯光、浅景深效果，面部和眼睛焦点清晰，带有微妙的眼神光，背景为平滑的深色 {argument name="background color" default="深绿色"}，并带有柔和的暗角。竖构图肖像，方形至近竖向裁剪，无配饰，无文字，无水印，不包含任何人类元素。

templates.prompt: Create a 2:3 vertical anime fantasy illustration depicting an elegant young woman standing on a polished balcony inside a vast, magical gothic library observatory at dusk. The woman possesses…{argument name="hair color" default="Long light pink hair"} With fair skin and a gentle smile, she wears a gorgeous black and white ruffled Gothic Lolita dress, paired with layered lace, puff sleeves, ribbons, white stockings, and black platform heels; she stands beside a golden filigree railing, slightly turning to the viewer. Seven striking fluorescent butterflies surround the scene: a large pink butterfly beside the left railing, a small butterfly above the upper balcony, a tiny butterfly near the window, a large pink butterfly on the right railing, a large butterfly near the lower left ground, a small butterfly at her feet, and another small butterfly at the lower right edge. The scene is a magnificent cathedral-like interior, featuring towering bookshelves, a winding spiral staircase, arched balconies, marble columns, gilded railings, chandelier-style lighting fixtures, reflective black floors, and exquisite Art Nouveau metalwork. On the right, a huge arched glass window, streaked with rain, reveals the shimmering nighttime city skyline, castle spires, and a giant glowing Ferris wheel. Using a dreamlike style {argument name="color palette" default="Lavender purple, rose pink, light blue and warm gold"} The color palette creates a hazy, volumetric light, shimmering particles, and soft glow effects, showcasing extremely delicate architectural details, exquisite lines, cinematic depth of field, an ethereal magical atmosphere, and a high-resolution, exquisite anime art style. The image contains no text, watermarks, or superfluous characters.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 2:3 竖版动漫奇幻插画，描绘一位优雅的少女站在黄昏时分巨大的魔法哥特式图书馆天文台内，身处光洁的阳台上。少女拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="长长的淡粉色头发"}、白皙的皮肤、温柔的微笑，身穿华丽的黑白褶边哥特萝莉裙，搭配层叠蕾丝、泡泡袖、丝带、白袜和黑色厚底高跟鞋；她站在金色的花丝栏杆旁，微微转向观众。画面中环绕着七只显眼的荧光蝴蝶：左侧栏杆旁有一只大粉色蝴蝶，上层阳台上方有一只小蝴蝶，窗户附近有一只极小的蝴蝶，右侧栏杆上有一只大粉色蝴蝶，左下地面附近有一只大蝴蝶，她脚边有一只小蝴蝶，右下边缘还有一只小蝴蝶。场景为宏伟的教堂式室内，拥有高耸的书架、蜿蜒的螺旋楼梯、拱形阳台、大理石柱、镀金栏杆、吊灯式灯具、反光的黑色地板以及精致的新艺术风格金属制品。在右侧，加入一扇巨大的拱形玻璃窗，窗上覆盖着雨痕，展现出窗外闪烁的夜间城市天际线、城堡尖塔和一个巨大的发光摩天轮。使用梦幻的 {argument name="color palette" default="薰衣草紫、玫瑰粉、淡蓝和暖金色"} 色调，营造朦胧的体积光、闪烁的微粒、柔和的辉光效果，展现极其细腻的建筑细节、精致的线条、电影般的景深、空灵的魔法氛围，以及高分辨率的精美动漫艺术风格。画面中无文字、无水印、无多余角色。

templates.title: A pair of softly drawn sailor-uniformed girls

titleLocalized.zh: 双联画风柔和水手服少女

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a side-by-side test illustration featuring different anime-style color variations of the same cute sailor-uniformed girl character against an ARIA-style canal city backdrop. Canvas: 16:9 wide landscape image, precisely divided into two vertical panels with a thin white dividing line in the middle. Soft pastel tones, a dreamy waterfront atmosphere, and high-detail anime illustration. Layout: The left panel shows a character sitting or kneeling by the canal, slightly facing the viewer, holding a tall white gondola-style flagpole on the far left. The right panel shows a second variation of the character, in a similar pose, holding a plush mascot. Both faces are intentionally obscured by opaque square blocks. Main Details: Using two different sailor-uniformed girl variations. Left Variation 1 has {argument name="left hair color" default="Mint Green"} She has long, wavy hair, wears a white sailor beret with blue trim and small white flower hair accessories, a white short-sleeved sailor dress with blue and gold trim, white gloves with gold brooch details, and a blue ribbon tied at her waist. She holds a white flag with a blue curved emblem, and sits beside a small raccoon-like mascot. (Right-side variant 2 possesses...){argument name="right hair color" default="pink"} She has twin ponytails with large blue bows, a matching white sailor beret with blue trim and tiny wings, a white sailor dress with blue and gold trim, and white gloves with gold embellishments. She holds a round, white-brown cat-shaped plush mascot with a blue bow and a gold medallion. Visible element count: exactly 2 vertical panels; exactly 2 main girls; exactly 2 opaque square face-covering blocks; exactly 2 mascots, one raccoon-like animal on the left panel and one cat-shaped plush toy on the right panel; exactly 1 tall white flag on the left panel; exactly 1 central white dividing line. Background: A romantic Venetian/City of Water style canal city with cream and blue buildings, arched bridges, colonnades along the waterfront, shimmering turquoise water, reflections, distant towers, a soft blue sky, and birds. Maintain a consistent background atmosphere, but separate elements with panel dividing lines. Visual Style: Exquisite Japanese anime-style main visual, pastel tones, soft lighting, delicate lines, eye-catching highlights obscured by occlusion blocks, gorgeous sailor uniform details, adorable fantasy ocean aesthetics, high resolution, soft blurring effects, and watercolor-like spatial depth. Constraints: Keep both face-occluding blocks clearly visible yet opaque; the left block should be a soft beige-gray, and the right block a pale gray-pink. Do not add any readable text except for a simple blue emblem on the flag. Avoid realistic styles, extra characters, increasing the number of panels, and adding logos or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张并排的动漫配色变体测试插画，展示同一可爱水手服少女角色在 ARIA 风格运河城市背景下的不同形象。

画布：16:9 宽幅横向图像，精确平分为 2 个垂直面板，中间有细白色分割线。柔和的粉彩色调，梦幻的水岸氛围，高细节动漫插画。

布局：左侧面板展示一名角色坐在或跪在运河旁，略微面向观众，最左侧持有一根高大的白色贡多拉风格旗杆。右侧面板展示该角色的第二种变体，姿势相似，怀抱一个毛绒吉祥物。两者的面部均被不透明的正方形遮挡块刻意遮盖。

主体细节：使用 2 种水手服少女变体。左侧变体 1 拥有 {argument name="left hair color" default="薄荷绿"} 的长波浪卷发，佩戴带有蓝色饰边的白色水手贝雷帽，饰有小白花发饰，身穿带有蓝金饰边的白色短袖水手裙，戴白色手套，有金色胸针细节，腰间系蓝色丝带。她手持一面带有蓝色弧形徽章的白旗，身边坐着一只类似浣熊的小吉祥物。右侧变体 2 拥有 {argument name="right hair color" default="粉色"} 的双钻头双马尾，系着大蓝色蝴蝶结，佩戴带有蓝色饰边和微小翅膀饰品的配套白色水手贝雷帽，身穿带有蓝金饰边的白色水手裙，戴白色手套，有金色装饰。她怀抱着一个圆形的白棕色猫型毛绒吉祥物，吉祥物系着蓝色蝴蝶结并佩戴金色奖章。

可见元素计数：精确 2 个垂直面板；精确 2 名主要少女；精确 2 个不透明正方形面部遮挡块；精确 2 个吉祥物，左侧面板为一只类似浣熊的动物，右侧面板为一只猫型毛绒玩具；左侧面板精确 1 根高大白旗；精确 1 条中央白色分割线。

背景：浪漫的威尼斯/水之都风格运河城市，拥有奶油色和蓝色的建筑、拱桥、水岸柱廊、波光粼粼的绿松石色水面、倒影、远处的塔楼、柔和的蓝天和飞鸟。保持背景氛围连贯，但由面板分割线隔开。

视觉风格：精致的日系动漫主视觉图，粉彩色调，柔和光晕，细腻的线条，被遮挡块遮住的亮眼，华丽的水手服细节，可爱的奇幻海洋美学，高分辨率，柔和的虚化效果和水彩般的空间深度。

约束条件：保持两个面部遮挡方块清晰可见且不透明，左侧方块为柔和的米灰色，右侧方块为淡灰粉色。除旗帜上简单的蓝色徽章外，不要添加任何可读文字。避免写实风格，避免额外角色，避免增加面板数量，避免添加徽标或水印。

templates.title: Cyberpunk Future Idol Concert

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克未来偶像演唱会

templates.prompt: Create a 2:3 vertically oriented, ultra-detailed anime key visual to showcase {argument name="character name" default="A future idol singer"} exist{argument name="concert year" default="2035"} A scene from a massive cyberpunk concert stage in 2008. The image centers on a single female idol, shown from a low, dynamic angle. One arm is outstretched towards the audience, making a V-sign, while the other hand holds a black microphone close to her mouth. Her face is deliberately obscured by two opaque blocks: a pale purple square in the center of her face, and a larger, rounded purple rectangle in the upper right corner covering part of her hair and the background screen. She possesses very long and flowing hair {argument name="hair color" default="Iridescent silver, cyan, violet and pink"} Her hair, dramatically flowing in all directions, is adorned with futuristic headphone accessories and glowing jewelry. Clothing: A holographic cropped idol top, a layered, semi-transparent prism skirt with angular panels, black and gold straps, neon star embellishments, bracelets, fingerless gloves, thigh straps, and two pairs of shimmering white iridescent over-the-knee platform boots with metal buckles and yellow and black trim. Environment: A massive circular arena filled with pink-glowing spectators. The reflective black digital stage floor is covered with neon circuit lines, triangles, grids, and holographic UI markers. Behind her, a huge, curved LED screen spans the arena's ceiling, displaying blue, magenta, and cyan data graphics, along with legible futuristic text such as "FUTURE IDOL STAGE 2035," "SHIKINAMI CODE:01," "LIVE," and Japanese kanji meaning "future." Lighting: An explosive idol concert spectacle, accompanied by countless laser beams, starbursts, lens flares, flashes, neon triangles, holographic fragments, and saturated electric blue, hot pink, violet, cyan, and yellow highlights. Style: High-gloss anime illustration, exquisite detail, crystal-clear reflections, vibrant shimmering aesthetics, dramatic perspective shortening, clean lines, high contrast, no watermarks, no extra characters, and no other obstructions.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 2:3 纵向的超精细动漫主视觉图，展示 {argument name="character name" default="一位未来偶像歌手"} 在 {argument name="concert year" default="2035"} 年的巨型赛博朋克演唱会舞台上表演的场景。画面中心仅展示一位全身女性偶像，采用低角度动态视角，一只手臂向观众伸出并比出 V 字手势，另一只手拿着一支黑色麦克风靠近嘴边。她的脸部被两个不透明的遮挡块刻意隐藏：一个位于脸部中心的淡紫色正方形色块，以及一个位于右上角覆盖部分头发和背景屏幕的较大紫色圆角矩形。她拥有非常长且飘逸的 {argument name="hair color" default="虹彩银、青色、紫罗兰色和粉色"} 头发，向四周戏剧性地散开，并装饰着未来感耳机饰品和发光配件。服装：一件全息短款偶像上衣，一条带有棱角面板的层叠半透明棱镜短裙，黑色与金色绑带，霓虹星形装饰，手镯，露指手套，大腿绑带，以及两双带有金属扣和黄黑饰边的闪亮白色虹彩过膝厚底靴。环境：一个巨大的圆形竞技场，坐满了发着粉光的观众，反射性的黑色数字舞台地板上布满了霓虹电路线条、三角形、网格和全息 UI 标记。在她身后，放置一个横跨竞技场顶部的巨大弧形 LED 屏幕，显示着蓝色、洋红色和青色的数据图形，以及可读的未来感文字，如“FUTURE IDOL STAGE 2035”、“SHIKINAMI CODE:01”、“LIVE”以及意为“未来”的日式汉字。灯光：爆炸性的偶像演唱会奇观，伴随无数激光束、星芒、镜头光晕、闪光、霓虹三角形、全息碎片，以及饱和的电光蓝、热粉色、紫罗兰色、青色和黄色高光。风格：高级光泽动漫插画，极致细节，晶莹剔透的反射，充满活力的闪耀美学，戏剧性的透视缩短，干净利落的线条，高对比度，无水印，无额外角色，无其他遮挡块。

templates.title: Savage Canyon Camp in the Rain

titleLocalized.zh: 雨中蛮族峡谷营地

templates.prompt: Create a fantasy scene with a dark cinematic feel, titled {argument name="series title" default="Traveling with Barbarians 6"} Two weary medieval travelers seek shelter from the rain in a narrow, rocky canyon late at night, resting on the muddy, damp ground around a small, bright campfire. The scene includes two travelers: one, a centrally located adventurer with blond curls, wearing a soaked dark cloak and leather armor, sits against a light grey horse; the other, a hooded, barbarian-like companion, wears a rain-soaked black cloak and leans against the right rock wall with his arms crossed. Their faces should be obscured by deep shadows or simple dark square veils to maintain anonymity. Two horses are included: a light grey horse lies or kneels beside the central traveler near the campfire, while a large black horse stands to the left, with a wet mane, saddle, harness, and baggage. Five prominent foreground objects are included: a small campfire made of branches, a metal cup beside the flames, a leather travel bag on the left, a pile of black leather armor and straps in the lower right, and a soaked cloth or cloak spread on the muddy ground. The canyon walls, steep and jagged, shimmer with raindrops, form a narrow passage leading into a hazy, bluish-gray darkness. The artwork utilizes dramatic low-lying firelight, warm orange highlights reflected in puddles, against a backdrop of cool, moonlit blue shadows, to create an incredibly detailed, damp texture. It also features realistic medieval fantasy costumes, a harsh survival atmosphere, and high-contrast chiaroscuro. The vertical composition is free of text and watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个黑暗电影质感的奇幻场景，标题为 {argument name="series title" default="与蛮族同行 6"}：两名疲惫的中世纪旅人在深夜的狭窄岩石峡谷中避雨，坐在泥泞潮湿的地面上，围着一堆明亮的小篝火休息。场景中包含 2 名旅人：一位是位于中心、留着金色卷发的冒险者，身穿浸透的深色斗篷和皮甲，坐在地上靠着一匹浅灰色马；另一位是戴着兜帽、类似蛮族的同伴，身穿被雨水淋透的黑色斗篷，双臂交叉靠在右侧岩壁上。他们的面部应被深重的阴影或简单的深色方形遮挡块掩盖，以保持匿名。包含 2 匹马：一匹浅灰色马躺在或跪在靠近篝火的中心旅人身旁，另一匹大型黑色马站在左侧，带有湿漉漉的鬃毛、马鞍、挽具和行李装备。包含 5 个显著的前景物体：一堆用树枝搭建的小篝火、火焰旁的一个金属杯、左侧的一个皮革旅行袋、右下方的一堆黑色皮甲和绑带，以及铺在泥地上一块浸透的布料或斗篷。峡谷岩壁陡峭、参差不齐且因雨水而闪闪发光，形成一条向朦胧的蓝灰色黑暗深处延伸的狭窄通道。运用戏剧性的低位火光，暖橙色的高光反射在水坑中，背景则是冷冽的月光蓝色阴影，呈现超细腻的潮湿质感、写实的中世纪奇幻服装设计、严酷的生存氛围、高对比度的明暗对照法，采用竖构图，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Jealous Claude comic page

titleLocalized.zh: Jealous Claude 漫画页面

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a one-page comic strip, in which {argument name="jealous character" default="Claude"} In the futuristic exhibition hall, looking at{argument name="admired character" default="ChatGPT"} Feeling a silent envy at the attention received. Canvas: Vertical comic page, 4:5 aspect ratio, thin black border, realistic seinen comic style with soft watercolor washes, cinematic lighting, pale purple/cyan tones, glossy reflections, delicate sketch lines, slightly dreamlike atmosphere. Layout: Uses 5 grids separated by thick black borders. The first grid is a panoramic large image occupying the upper half of the width. The second grid, located to the lower left, is a medium close-up. The third grid, located to the right of the second, is a medium close-up of two people. The fourth grid is a large, solitary full-body shot in the lower left corner. The fifth grid is an extreme close-up of the face and collar of the envious character in the lower right corner. The face is kept softly blurred or indistinct, as if anonymized. Scene and Subject: The background is a bright futuristic interior atrium filled with huge pale purple, mint, cyan, and pink glossy spheres, and floating translucent spherical ceiling decorations. A group of fashionable young people are gathered around the idolized character. The character of envy is a curly-haired blond youth wearing a light beige tech jacket with the words "ANTHROPIC," "Claude," and "AI" printed on the back and sleeves. The character of admiration is a dark-haired youth wearing a black jacket with the OpenAI knot logo and the words "ChatGPT" printed on the back. The character of admiration stands confidently among the fans, while the character of envy stays to the side or in the background, shoulders slightly hunched, appearing introspective and hurt. Storyboard details and text elements: Contains 14 visible speech bubbles or onomatopoeic text. The first panel contains 5 text elements: a thought bubble near Claude that reads "Look at him..."; a thought bubble that reads "Everyone is circling around ChatGPT."; a crowd speech bubble that reads "You always get attention!"; a crowd speech bubble that reads "Thank you so much!"; a crowd speech bubble that reads "You're amazing, ChatGPT!". The second panel contains 2 thought bubbles near Claude: "I'm more reliable. More cautious." and "...So why do they always choose him?". The third panel contains three speech bubbles: Claude says, “Hey, ChatGPT.”; Claude says, “You always get all the attention.”; ChatGPT replies, “Ah, Claude! You’re overthinking it again.” The fourth panel contains three text elements: Claude says, “Maybe I’m destined to stay behind the scenes.”; a small Japanese onomatopoeic word “potsun”; and a small speech bubble with “…”. The fifth panel has an incomplete thought bubble at the edge that reads, “…It’s unfair…”. Visual style: Elegant comic book illustrations, expressive body language, soft ink outlines, pastel watercolor shadows, reflective floors, atmospheric depth, soft lighting, highly detailed clothing folds, a subtle sci-fi convention atmosphere, and a humorously melancholic mood. Use English text in clean comic book speech bubbles. Avoid extra panels, extra dialogue, watermarks, titles, or UI elements.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一页漫画，其中 {argument name="jealous character" default="Claude"} 在未来主义的展会大厅中，看着 {argument name="admired character" default="ChatGPT"} 受到关注，内心默默感到嫉妒。

画布：竖版漫画页面，4:5 纵横比，细黑色外边框，带有柔和水彩晕染的写实青年漫画风格，电影级布光，淡紫色/青色调，光泽反射，细腻的草图线条，氛围略显梦幻。

布局：使用 5 个由粗黑边框分隔的格子。第 1 格为占据上半部分宽度的全景大图。第 2 格位于其下方左侧，为中景特写。第 3 格位于第 2 格右侧，为双人中景。第 4 格为左下角较大的孤独全身画面。第 5 格为右下角嫉妒角色面部和衣领的极度特写。保持面部柔和模糊或不清晰，如同匿名处理。

场景与主体：背景是一个明亮的未来主义室内中庭，充满了巨大的淡紫色、薄荷色、青色和粉色光泽球体，以及漂浮的半透明球状天花板装饰。一群时尚的年轻人聚集在被崇拜的角色周围。嫉妒的角色是一位卷发金发青年，穿着浅米白色科技夹克，背部和袖子上印有可见文字：“ANTHROPIC”、“Claude” 和 “AI”。被崇拜的角色是一位黑发青年，穿着黑色外套，背部印有 OpenAI 的结状标志和 “ChatGPT” 字样。被崇拜的角色自信地站在粉丝中间，而嫉妒的角色则待在侧面或背景中，肩膀微微耸起，显得内省且受伤。

分镜细节与文字元素：包含 14 个可见的对话气泡或拟声词文字。第 1 格包含 5 个文字元素：Claude 附近的思想气泡写着 “看着他……”；思想气泡写着 “每个人都围着 ChatGPT 转。”；人群对话气泡写着 “你总是能得到关注！”；人群对话气泡写着 “太感谢了！”；人群对话气泡写着 “你太棒了，ChatGPT！”。第 2 格包含 2 个 Claude 附近的思想气泡：“我更可靠。更谨慎。” 以及 “……所以为什么他们总是选择他？”。第 3 格包含 3 个对话气泡：Claude 说 “嘿，ChatGPT。”；Claude 说 “你总是得到所有的关注。”；ChatGPT 回复 “啊，Claude！你又想多了。” 第 4 格包含 3 个文字元素：Claude 说 “也许我注定只能待在幕后。”；一个小型的日式拟声词 “ぽつん”；一个带有 “……” 的小气泡。第 5 格在边缘处有一个不完整的思想气泡，写着 “……不公平……”

视觉风格：优雅的漫画插画，富有表现力的肢体语言，柔和的墨线轮廓，淡彩水彩阴影，反光地板，大气深度，柔和的光晕，高细节的衣物褶皱，微妙的科幻展会氛围，带有幽默感的忧郁情绪。在干净的漫画对话气泡中使用英文书写。避免额外的分镜、额外的对话、水印、标题或 UI 元素。

templates.title: Gothic pink-haired demon girl

titleLocalized.zh: 哥特风粉发鬼族少女

templates.prompt: Create a melancholic, dark gothic anime portrait, the main character is {argument name="character name" default="A demon girl"} She was sitting in a dimly lit Victorian-style room, the image showing a close-up of her upper three-quarters profile. She had porcelain-white skin, a languid, melancholic expression, half-closed, glowing amber eyes, and long, brightly colored hair with messy bangs.{argument name="hair color" default="pink"} The hairstyle includes a high bun, a long side braid, and loose strands of hair hanging down the back. Two smooth, white horns must grow from each side of the head. Accessories require: exactly three black bows (one tied to the bun, one to the white ruffled neckline, and one to the sleeve); exactly two visible earrings (one black key-shaped, the other a small skull earring with black beads); and a miniature skull decoration on the chest. The wearer is dressed in a black Gothic Lolita outfit: puffy long sleeves, white ruffled cuffs and neckline, black lace details, a shiny black corset with metal eyelets and ties, a short, multi-layered skirt with white ruffle trim, black stockings, and a delicate cross chain hanging from the sleeves and hem. The pose is leaning forward, one hand supporting the chin, the other hand resting naturally near the knee, with an expression that is both bored and slightly eerie. The background is a dimly lit, purplish-black Gothic interior space. A vintage upholstered chair back is visible on the right, while blurry, dripping shadows and the silhouette of a hanging chain are visible on the left. Dramatic, low-key lighting, deep purple shadows, and glossy highlights on the hair and waistline create a highly detailed, anime-style rendering with sharp lines, rich textures, and high contrast. There is no text or watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张忧郁暗黑的哥特动漫肖像，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="一位恶魔少女"}，她正坐在一间阴暗的维多利亚风格房间内，画面呈现大腿以上的四分之三侧身特写。她拥有苍白如瓷的皮肤、慵懒忧郁的表情、半垂的琥珀色发光双眸，以及一头凌乱刘海的长发，发色为鲜艳的 {argument name="hair color" default="粉色"}，发型包括一个高发髻、一条长侧辫以及垂在背后的散乱发丝。头部两侧需各长出一只平滑的白色鬼角，共 2 只。配饰要求：正好 3 个黑色蝴蝶结（分别系在发髻上、白色荷叶边领口处及袖子上）；正好 2 只可见的耳环（一只为黑色钥匙形状，另一只为带有黑色珠子的小骷髅耳环）；胸前另有一个微型骷髅装饰。身着黑色哥特洛丽塔服装：泡泡长袖、白色荷叶边袖口与领口、黑色蕾丝细节、带有金属扣眼与系带的亮面黑色束腰、带有白色荷叶边饰边的短款多层裙、黑色长袜，以及沿袖子和裙摆垂下的精致十字架挂链。姿势设定为身体前倾，单手托腮，另一只手自然放在膝盖附近，神情显得百无聊赖且略带一丝诡异。背景为昏暗的紫黑色哥特室内空间，右侧可见复古软包椅背，左侧有模糊的滴落状阴影和悬挂的链条剪影。采用戏剧性的低调照明，深紫色阴影，头发与束腰处带有光泽高光，高精细度绘画风动漫渲染，线条锐利，纹理丰富，高对比度，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Anime Trading Card Album Photos

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫集换式卡牌相册照片

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a realistic mobile-style photo showcasing an open trading card collection album on a warm wooden tabletop, displaying custom anime character cards encased in transparent plastic sleeves. Canvas: Vertical 3:4 photo, slightly overhead angle, shallow depth of field. The album occupies the lower two-thirds of the image; the background desktop is soft-focused. Main Scene: An open black trading card album with blank, matte-textured pages on the left and transparent plastic sleeves on the right. Three clearly visible, elongated horizontal trading cards are stacked vertically in the sleeves, with an empty transparent card slot below. The plastic should have a glossy reflective finish, seams, dotted borders, and slight wrinkles. Card Design: Each card is a slightly elongated horizontal collectible card with a black and gold border, neon anime artwork, Japanese text, a numbered circle in the upper left corner, a character name bar at the bottom, a small gold badge in the lower left corner, and three attribute boxes in the lower right corner marked in green, red, and blue respectively: HP, ATK, and DEF. Make the cards look like they come from{argument name="club name" default="SynClub"} Advanced fan-made game cards. Quantity and Card Contents: 3 cards are shown: 1. First card (top): Number 1, cyberpunk blue-purple city background, a twin-tailed anime girl reaching out to the audience, a small sign that reads "WELCOME TO SynClub", another that reads "CONNECT THE FUTURE"; Japanese title at the top; name field reads "レティシア・エル"; attributes are HP 4200, ATK 3800, DEF 2900. A soft square blur effect is added to the character's face, like a privacy veil. 2. Second image (middle): Number 2. Two cute anime girls are standing close together, one blonde and one dark purple, against a dreamy pink and purple night city or cafe scene; there is a Japanese title at the top; the name field reads "Kokoa & Shokora"; stats are HP 4100, ATK 3600, DEF 2900. 3. Third image (bottom): Number 3. A blonde idol-style anime girl is performing on a neon stage with purple lights and heart-shaped symbols; there is a Japanese title at the top; the name field reads "Senmeru"; stats are HP 4100, ATK 3700, DEF 2800. Background objects: Contains four blurry desktop objects: a black TV remote near the top left corner, a small stack of cards or papers on the far left edge, a dark cup or water glass near the top right corner, and a small, shiny blue-red object near the top right edge. Visual Style: Photorealistic casual desktop photography, warm indoor lighting, natural lens blur, realistic wood grain, slight glare on the plastic card holder, rich detail in the binder and cards, but slight imperfections in the printed text due to AI generation. The overall atmosphere is that of a collector's casually displayed anime card album. Constraints: Maintain clear readability of the binder pages and 3 cards, retain the precise number of 3 filled card slots and 1 empty card slot, avoid extra cards on the binder pages, and avoid watermarks or UI overlays.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一张逼真的手机风格照片，展示一本放在温暖木质桌面上的打开的集换式卡牌收藏册，页面中展示着装在透明塑料卡套里的自定义动漫角色卡牌。

画布：垂直 3:4 照片，略带俯视角度，浅景深。相册占据画面下方三分之二；背景桌面经过柔焦处理。

主要场景：一本打开的黑色卡牌活页册，左侧内页为空白磨砂质感，右侧页面为透明塑料卡套页。卡套页中垂直堆叠着 3 张清晰可见的长条横版集换式卡牌，下方有一个空的透明卡槽。塑料应具有光泽反射、接缝、点状边框和轻微褶皱。

卡牌设计：每张卡牌均为略微拉长的横版收藏卡，配有黑金边框、霓虹动漫艺术图、日文文本、左上角的编号圆圈、底部的角色名称栏、左下角的小型金色徽章，以及右下角分别以绿色、红色和蓝色标注的 HP、ATK 和 DEF 三个属性框。让卡牌看起来像是来自 {argument name="club name" default="SynClub"} 的高级粉丝自制游戏卡。

数量与卡牌内容：展示 3 张卡牌：
1. 第一张（顶部）：编号 1，赛博朋克蓝紫色城市背景，一位双马尾动漫少女向观众伸手，一个小标牌写着“WELCOME TO SynClub”，另一个写着“CONNECT THE FUTURE”；顶部有日文标题；名称栏写着“レティシア・エル”；属性为 HP 4200，ATK 3800，DEF 2900。在角色面部添加柔和的方形模糊效果，如同隐私遮挡。
2. 第二张（中部）：编号 2，两位可爱的动漫少女紧靠在一起，一位金发，一位深紫发，背景为梦幻般的粉紫色夜城或咖啡馆场景；顶部有日文标题；名称栏写着“ココア&ショコラ”；属性为 HP 4100，ATK 3600，DEF 2900。
3. 第三张（底部）：编号 3，金发偶像风格动漫少女在紫色灯光和心形符号的霓虹舞台上表演；顶部有日文标题；名称栏写着“燦 める”；属性为 HP 4100，ATK 3700，DEF 2800。

背景物体：包含 4 个模糊的桌面物体：左上角附近的黑色电视遥控器、最左侧边缘的一小叠卡片或纸张、右上角附近的深色杯子或水杯，以及右上角边缘附近的一个闪亮蓝红色小物体。

视觉风格：照片级真实的休闲桌面摄影，温暖的室内光线，自然的镜头模糊，真实的木纹，塑料卡套上有轻微眩光，活页册和卡牌细节丰富，但印刷文字带有 AI 生成的轻微瑕疵。整体氛围为收藏者随手展示动漫卡牌相册。

约束：保持活页册页面和 3 张卡牌清晰可读，保留 3 个已填卡槽和 1 个空卡槽的精确数量，避免活页册页面中出现多余卡牌，避免水印或 UI 覆盖。

templates.title: Samurai Armor Three-View Design Drawing

titleLocalized.zh: 武士铠甲三视图设计图

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a concise fantasy character concept art for a fully armed samurai, suitable for pre-production in a game or film. Canvas: Wide, horizontal white studio background, approximately 16:9 aspect ratio, with subtle gray watercolor textures around the edges; no ambient background. Use clean, comic-style concept art lines, delicate ink lines, subtle cel shading, soft colors, and high-contrast armor highlights. Layout: Precisely arrange four independent full-body figures from left to right: a small, light gray silhouette on the far left, followed by a large frontal view of the samurai, a 3/4 view samurai slightly turned to the right, and a large right-side profile of the samurai. Keep these three samurai perspectives evenly distributed and aligned at the feet like a three-view drawing. Main details: The character is a tall, broad-shouldered, muscular, older male samurai, with {argument name="hair color" default="Long white hair"} With a clear hairline and tied in a ponytail, the face in every samurai's view has {argument name="face treatment" default="Blurred rectangular face occlusion"} He wore dark, layered samurai armor, with a color scheme of {argument name="armor colors" default="Black lacquer finish paired with deep burgundy nail tips and ribbons"} Includes large segmented shoulder armor, plate breastplate, layered waist skirt armor, forearm bracers, greaves, leggings, split-toe shoes, and a belt. The armor is heavy, worn, and practical, featuring numerous rectangular layered plates, rivets, straps, red cords, and a black lining. Weapon and Quantity Requirements: Includes 3 samurai poses and 1 scale silhouette. The entire drawing contains 4 visible sword elements: a sheathed katana or hilt protruding diagonally upwards behind the left shoulder of the samurai in the frontal view; a short, dark-colored scabbard or sword held by the samurai on the lower right side in the frontal view; a sheathed katana hilt protruding diagonally upwards behind the left shoulder of the samurai in the 3/4 view; and a curved katana drawn from the waist and extending diagonally backwards by the samurai in the right side silhouette. Do not add additional weapons. Pose Details: In the frontal view, the samurai stands powerfully with clenched fists, feet apart, and shoulders level. In the 3/4 view, the samurai clenches one fist, with the other hand near the drooping scabbard, and the head slightly turned. The samurai stands upright, looking to the left, showcasing the layered silhouettes of his shoulder armor, waist armor, ponytail, and sword at his waist. Style restrictions: Keep the background pure white, with no title text, labels, logos, or watermarks. Use a realistic comic book concept art style, not a chibi anime style. Armor details must be fine and clearly discernible, using deep red and black tones to contrast with the white hair, while maintaining a clear overall silhouette.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为一名全副武装的武士创建一个简洁的奇幻角色概念设计图，适用于游戏或电影的前期制作。

画布：宽幅水平白色摄影棚背景，比例约为 16:9，边缘带有淡淡的灰色水彩纹理，无环境背景。使用清晰的漫画风格概念艺术线条、细腻的墨线勾勒、微妙的赛璐珞阴影、柔和的色彩以及高对比度的铠甲高光。

布局：从左到右精确排列 4 个独立的全身形象：最左侧为 1 个小型浅灰色人物比例剪影，接着是 1 个大型正面视角武士、1 个略微向右侧转的 3/4 视角武士，以及 1 个大型右侧面轮廓武士。保持这 3 个武士视角均匀分布，并像三视图一样在脚部对齐。

主体细节：该角色为一名身材高大、宽阔、肌肉发达的年长男性武士，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="长白发"}，发际线清晰并扎成马尾，每个武士视角的面部均带有 {argument name="face treatment" default="模糊的矩形面部遮挡"}。他身着深色层叠武士铠甲，配色为 {argument name="armor colors" default="黑色漆面搭配深酒红色甲片和系带"}：包括大型分段肩甲、板甲胸甲、层叠腰裙甲、前臂护腕、胫甲、绑腿裤、分趾鞋和系腰带。铠甲厚重、陈旧且实用，带有许多矩形层状甲片、铆钉、绑带、红色系绳和黑色内衬。

武器及数量要求：包含 3 个武士姿势和 1 个比例剪影。整张图纸中包含 4 个可见的剑类元素：正面视角武士左肩后方斜向上露出的一把收鞘武士刀或剑柄、正面视角武士右侧下方持有一把短深色剑鞘或剑、3/4 视角武士左肩后方斜向上露出的一把收鞘武士刀柄，以及右侧面轮廓武士腰间拔出并向后斜伸的弯曲武士刀。请勿添加额外武器。

姿势细节：正面视角武士强有力地站立，双拳紧握，双脚分开，双肩平齐。3/4 视角武士单拳紧握，另一只手靠近下垂的剑鞘，头部略微转动。侧面轮廓武士直立看向左侧，展示肩甲、腰甲、马尾和腰间佩剑的层叠侧面轮廓。

风格限制：保持背景为纯白色，无标题文字、无标签、无 Logo、无水印。使用写实的漫画概念艺术风格，而非 Q 版动漫风格。铠甲细节需精细且清晰可辨，采用深红黑色调，与白发形成对比，并保持清晰的全身轮廓。

templates.title: Strauss's "The Last Four Songs" poster

titleLocalized.zh: Strauss《最后四首歌》海报

templates.prompt: Create a 16:9 cinematic digital illustration, inspired by {argument name="musical work" default="The Last Four Songs"} The author is{argument name="composer name" default="Strauss"} In the image, an elderly classical music composer, dressed in a dark suit and bow tie, leans to the left, facing the glowing sunset over a calm lake and distant mountains. His gray hair and the right half of his body blend into the wind, mist, shimmering particles, and translucent fragments, conveying a sense of serene detachment or a feeling of the soul dissipating with the wind. Flowing golden musical staves and floating notes are added to the sky in the upper and lower right corners, like luminous ribbons fluttering in the wind. A dreamlike, soft color palette, including lavender, peach, gold, blue, and soft rose, creates a sense of volumetric mist, painterly realism, an epic orchestral atmosphere, and a tranquil, melancholic mood. Two text elements are included: a large title text at the bottom.{argument name="bottom title text" default="The Last Four Songs"} The color is light cream yellow with a dark outline and shadow; in the lower right corner is a small, bold red word.{argument name="composer label" default="Strauss"} It features a black outline. An opaque, soft beige square, centered on the head, is overlaid above the man's face, as if the face is deliberately obscured. There is no additional text, no watermark, and no border.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 16:9 的电影感数字插画，灵感源自 {argument name="musical work" default="《最后四首歌》"}，作者为 {argument name="composer name" default="Strauss"}。画面中，一位身着深色正装、系着领结的年迈古典音乐作曲家侧身向左，位于画面偏左侧，面对着平静湖面上方发光的夕阳和远处的群山。他灰白的头发和身体右半部分消融在风、薄雾、闪烁的微粒和半透明的碎片中，表现出一种宁静的离世感或灵魂随风消散的意境。在右上角和右下角的天空中加入流动的金色五线谱和漂浮的音符，如同被风吹动的发光丝带。采用梦幻般的柔和色调，包括薰衣草紫、桃色、金色、蓝色和柔和的玫瑰色，营造出体积感雾气、绘画写实风格、史诗般的管弦乐氛围以及宁静忧郁的情绪。包含 2 个文本元素：底部的大标题文本 {argument name="bottom title text" default="《最后四首歌》"}，颜色为浅奶油黄，带有深色描边和投影；右下角是一个较小的加粗红色单词 {argument name="composer label" default="Strauss"}，带有黑色描边。在男子的脸部上方覆盖一个不透明的柔和米色正方形，以头部为中心，仿佛脸部被刻意遮挡。无额外文字，无水印，无边框。

templates.title: Crowded night office buildings

titleLocalized.zh: 拥挤的夜间办公大楼

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed isometric illustration of a city at night, centered on a massive, rounded-corner office building. Employ a high-altitude, bird's-eye view, presenting the facade in sections through continuous glass windows, making every floor clearly visible. The building should have 34 clearly visible horizontal office floors, each crammed with tiny individuals, desks, chairs, lamps, partitions, plants, bookshelves, meeting rooms, and richly colored interior details; the population density is extremely high, like a visual counting challenge, with hundreds or even thousands of miniature figures visible through the windows.{argument name="building shape" default="A tall, rounded rectangular glass office building"} The main building serves as the central element. It is surrounded by a dense, cyberpunk-style metropolis, including low-rise buildings, glowing windows, neon signs, street traffic, and crowds on the ground. The lighting uses a nighttime blue hue, complemented by warm yellow, orange, and white office lights, creating a striking contrast between the dark city and the bright office building interiors. The style should be a detailed hand-drawn architectural illustration with clean lines, rich micro-details, and slightly painterly colors, leaving no blank spaces. The image should be a vertical poster style, crammed with buildings and tiny figures from edge to edge. Add a bustling entrance plaza and streets around the bottom, filled with numerous tiny pedestrians and vehicles, but maintain the central dominance of the main building. Avoid including readable text, signs, watermarks, or UI elements. Emphasize that each window contains a unique micro-scene and visible human silhouettes for easy counting.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超精细的夜间等轴测城市插图，以一座巨大的圆角办公大楼为中心，采用高空俯视视角，外立面通过连续的玻璃窗呈现剖面，使每一层楼都清晰可见。大楼应有 34 个清晰可见的水平办公楼层，每一层都挤满了微小的个体、办公桌、椅子、台灯、隔断、植物、书架、会议室和色彩丰富的室内细节；人群密度极高，如同视觉计数挑战，透过窗户可以看到成百上千个微型人物。使用 {argument name="building shape" default="一座高大的圆角矩形玻璃办公大楼"} 作为主体。周围环绕着密集的赛博朋克风格大都市，包括较矮的高层建筑、发光的窗户、霓虹灯标志、街道交通和地面人群。灯光采用夜间蓝色调，搭配温暖的黄色、橙色和白色办公灯光，在黑暗的城市与明亮的办公楼内部之间形成强烈对比。风格应为精细的手绘建筑插图，线条清晰，微观细节丰富，色彩略带绘画感，画面不留空白。图像应为垂直的海报风格，边缘到边缘都挤满了建筑和微小的人物。在底部周围添加繁忙的入口广场和街道，挤满许多微小的行人和车辆，但要保持主楼的中心主导地位。不要包含可读的文字、标志、水印或 UI 元素。强调每个窗格都包含独特的微小场景和可见的人类剪影，以便进行计数。

templates.title: Cinematic Nighttime Street Dialogue

titleLocalized.zh: 电影感夜间街头对话

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic widescreen night scene with an intimate, romantic, indie film feel, reminiscent of a quiet conversation moment in *Before Sunrise*. On a city sidewalk at night, depict two young people standing face-to-face, maintaining a small distance: the man on the left wears a light beige rolled-up sleeve shirt and dark trousers, one hand in his pocket; the woman on the right wears a simple black sleeveless dress, her dark hair tied back, her hands naturally clasped at her waist. Background used {argument name="city setting" default="Modern downtown streets with high-rise buildings"} The image presents glowing office windows, distant traffic, blurred headlights and taillights, and warm orange streetlights reflecting off the road. The composition is a 16:9 widescreen movie still, with two characters in profile or three-quarter profile, separated by an empty sidewalk leading into the background. The lighting should be understated and atmospheric: the streetlights on the left cast a warm amber glow, while the buildings on the right cast a cool blue glow, creating a soft bokeh, shallow depth of field, natural shadows, soft contrast, realistic skin tones, and a melancholic, late-night city tone. This makes it look like a realistic live-action film shot with an anamorphic lens, with cinematic grain, soft focus decay, no visible text, no watermark, and no other irrelevant people in the foreground. The emotional parameterization is {argument name="emotional tone" default="Quiet, tentative, romantic tension"} Male characters are parameterized as{argument name="male character" default="Young Asian man wearing a beige shirt"} Female characters are parameterized as{argument name="female character" default="Young Asian woman wearing a black dress"} Photo style parameterization{argument name="cinematography style" default="Naturalism holds an independent film still."} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张具有亲密浪漫独立电影风格的电影感宽银幕夜景，类似于《爱在黎明破晓前》（Before Sunrise）中安静的对话瞬间。在夜晚的城市人行道上，展示两名年轻人保持微小距离面对面站立：左侧的男性身穿浅米色卷袖衬衫和深色长裤，一只手插在口袋里；右侧的女性身穿简约黑色无袖连衣裙，深色头发扎在脑后，双手自然交叠于腰间。背景使用 {argument name="city setting" default="带有高层建筑的现代市中心街道"}，呈现发光的办公室窗户、远处的车流、模糊的车头灯和尾灯，以及反射在路面上的温暖橙色路灯。构图为 16:9 宽银幕电影剧照，两位角色呈侧面或四分之三侧影，中间由通向画面深处的空旷人行道隔开。灯光应低调且富有氛围感：左侧路灯投射出温暖的琥珀色光，右侧建筑投射出冷蓝色光，营造柔和的焦外成像效果、浅景深、自然的阴影、柔和的对比度、真实的肤色以及忧郁的深夜城市色调。使其看起来像是一张用变形镜头拍摄的真实真人电影画面，带有电影颗粒感、柔和的焦点衰减，无可见文字，无水印，前景中无其他无关人员。将情绪参数化为 {argument name="emotional tone" default="安静、试探、浪漫张力"}，男性角色参数化为 {argument name="male character" default="身穿米色衬衫的年轻亚裔男性"}，女性角色参数化为 {argument name="female character" default="身穿黑色连衣裙的年轻亚裔女性"}，摄影风格参数化为 {argument name="cinematography style" default="自然主义手持独立电影剧照"}。

templates.title: Fleischer-style pony riding

titleLocalized.zh: Fleischer 风格小马骑行

templates.prompt: Create a captivating 1930s Fleischer Studios-style rubber hose animation illustration, in which {argument name="character description" default="A young woman with a smile on her face and wearing a beige headscarf"} Riding{argument name="animal" default="A brown pony"} She walks towards the audience against a backdrop of a sunny park. The rider faces forward, leaning slightly forward, with a sweet and playful expression, possessing the signature large eyes, long eyelashes, rosy cheeks, red lips, and simple, rounded features of someone from retro animation; she wears {argument name="outfit" default="A pale yellow collared shirt, black trousers, and white sneakers"} The pony has an exaggeratedly cute face, large oval eyes, a fluffy golden mane, drooping ears, a white patch on its forehead, brown reins, and round hooves, with a friendly yet exaggerated expression. Place them in the center of the foreground on a green meadow with a few clumps of grass, and soft shadows below the pony. The background should include four figures: two seated picnic guests on the left, a standing man waving on the left center, and a standing woman in a beige dress on the right. There should be three clearly visible lawn play props on the meadow: a white cornhole project, a blue cone, and two flat colored sticks. Rounded dark green trees surround the scene on both sides and in the distance, and four fluffy cream-colored clouds float in the pale blue sky. Use thick black ink lines, cel animation shapes, rubber tube proportions, hand-painted watercolor textures, aged paper textures, slightly faded colors, and subtle film spots to create a nostalgic retro animation atmosphere. Maintain a vertical composition, presenting a warm and fantastical style reminiscent of a storybook; modern realistic styles are prohibited, as are adding text or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅迷人的 20 世纪 30 年代 Fleischer Studios 风格的橡胶管动画插画，画面中 {argument name="character description" default="一位面带微笑、佩戴米色头巾的年轻女性"} 正骑着 {argument name="animal" default="一匹棕色小马"} 向观众走来，背景是阳光明媚的公园。骑手正面朝向前方，身体微微前倾，表情甜美俏皮，拥有复古动画中标志性的大眼睛、长睫毛、红润脸颊、红唇以及简约圆润的五官；她身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="一件淡黄色翻领衬衫、黑色长裤和白色运动鞋"}。小马有着夸张可爱的面孔、大大的椭圆形眼睛、蓬松的金色鬃毛、下垂的耳朵、额头上的白色斑块、棕色缰绳、圆圆的蹄子，表情友好且夸张。将它们置于前景中央的绿色草地上，草地上有几簇小草，小马下方有柔和的阴影。背景中需包含 4 个小人：左侧有两位坐着的野餐客人，中左侧有一位挥手的站立男士，右侧有一位身穿米色连衣裙的站立女士。草地上需有 3 个清晰可见的草坪游戏道具：一个白色 cornhole 项目、一个蓝色圆锥体和两根平放的彩色棍子。场景两侧及远处环绕着圆润的深绿色树木，淡蓝色天空中漂浮着 4 朵蓬松的奶油色云朵。使用粗黑墨线勾勒、赛璐珞动画形状、橡胶管比例、手绘水彩质感、陈旧纸张纹理、略微褪色的色彩、细微的胶片斑点，营造出怀旧的复古动画氛围。保持构图垂直，呈现出故事书般温馨奇幻的风格；禁止使用现代写实风格，禁止添加文字或水印。

templates.title: Toucan Dermatologist's Diary Comic

titleLocalized.zh: 巨嘴鸟皮肤科医生日记漫画

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a heartwarming and sentimental autobiographical comic/illustration essay about a kind-hearted dermatologist (who has transformed into an anthropomorphic toucan), combining skincare advice, gentle self-reflection, and daily reflections. Canvas: Vertical 2:3 page layout on textured off-white watercolor paper with delicate hand-drawn panel borders. The colors are soft and understated, the ink lines are fine, presenting a Japanese zither aesthetic style—comfortable and slightly nostalgic. Main Character: An anthropomorphic toucan doctor with a large yellow, orange, and black beak, blue-green head feathers, expressive round eyes, and dark claws. In indoor scenes, he wears a white coat over a gray-blue-green shirt; in outdoor scenes, he wears a gray-pink hoodie and carries a backpack. The hoodie has a small circular badge with Japanese characters on the back. He is calm, thoughtful, humble, and friendly. Layout: Six main comic panels plus one decorative bottom banner. The first shot, occupying about a third of the screen, shows Dr. Toucan sitting at a wooden table in a sunny study, writing in an open notebook. The scene includes a lamp, stacks of books, papers stuck to the wall, a green window, potted plants, a coffee cup with a floral print, and a Polaroid-style photograph on the left showing the same toucan wearing a pink hoodie holding a sign. The second shot is a close-up in the lower left, showing a gloved hand pointing to skin chart notes on a clipboard. The third shot, a smaller shot in the middle, shows Dr. Toucan's profile by the green window, holding a floral coffee cup, accompanied by circular speech/thought bubbles. The fourth shot, a small notebook shot in the lower right, shows a list with three items checked, complete with paperclips and a pen. The fifth shot is a wide forest scene: Dr. Toucan in a pink hoodie observes through binoculars among light green trees and fallen leaves, with reflective handwritten text on the left. The sixth shot is a wide-angle rooftop/city scene: a toucan sits on a windowsill with its back to the camera, facing a light-colored city skyline. A paper airplane flies in the sky, and the scene includes flowerpots, coffee cups, a small faucet or pipe, a sticky note on the right, and a speech bubble next to the character. The banner at the bottom contains five small icons with descriptions: a microscope, a laptop, a camera, a coffee cup, and a handwritten thank-you note with a heart pattern. Text content: Add a soft-ink style Japanese handwritten title, using the following text as the overall copy:{argument name="Japanese page text" default="Things about dermatology, everyday life. Notes of little insights. Today, too, I hope to share something that will be helpful to someone. Knowledge is life. It's easy to understand and useful. That makes me happiest. Skin is honest. It clearly shows the signs of your lifestyle. I want to deliver specialized and difficult things in an easy-to-understand way. Today's notes Communicating, creating, connecting - all are important. Good things continue quietly and steadily. I want to see the essence rather than trends. Skin is a mirror of your lifestyle. Taking care of it is taking care of yourself. Be kind to yourself and to others today. Now, what kind of story should I share next? Creating and sharing things to make tomorrow a little better. I also love research. AI is my partner. I get input from travel and nature. I reset with coffee. Thank you! Thank you always."} Please keep the text handwritten, slightly imperfect, and naturally integrated into the storyboard, rather than as a typographic font. Style restrictions: Fine pen-and-watercolor illustrations, visible paper texture, soft beige shadows, a low-key blue-green/green/pink palette, comfortable desktop clutter, soft sunlight, matte digital rendering, no harsh outlines, no realism. Maintain a poetic, quiet, and inspiring tone.{argument name="main character" default="anthropomorphic toucan dermatologist"} As the central figure{argument name="setting mood" default="warm reflective Japanese diary manga"} As a setting{argument name="color palette" default="muted watercolor beige, teal, dusty pink, soft green, warm ochre"} As a color palette, and{argument name="theme" default="skincare wisdom, daily observations, kindness, and thoughtful creation"} As the subject.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一页温馨、感性的自传体漫画/插画随笔，讲述一位心地善良的皮肤科医生（他本人已变成了一只拟人化的巨嘴鸟），内容结合了护肤建议、温柔的自我反思以及日常随笔。

画布：垂直 2:3 页面，采用带有纹理的米白色水彩纸，配以纤细的手绘分镜边框，色彩柔和低调，墨线细腻，呈现出日式生活志（Zine）的美学风格，舒适且略带怀旧感。

主角：一只拟人化的巨嘴鸟医生，拥有巨大的黄橙黑相间鸟喙、蓝绿色的头部羽毛、富有表现力的圆眼睛和深色的鸟爪。在室内场景中，他身穿白大褂，内搭灰蓝绿色衬衫；在户外场景中，则穿着灰粉色连帽衫并背着背包。连帽衫背面有一个带有日文的小圆形徽章。他的情绪平静、深思熟虑、谦逊且友善。

布局：使用 6 个主漫画分镜加 1 个装饰性底部条幅。第 1 分镜为占据上方约三分之一的大幅画面：巨嘴鸟医生坐在阳光明媚的书房木桌前，在打开的笔记本上书写。画面包含台灯、堆叠的书籍、贴在墙上的纸张、绿叶窗户、盆栽、印有花朵的咖啡杯，以及左侧贴着的一张拍立得风格照片，照片中是穿着粉色连帽衫的同一只巨嘴鸟正举着一块牌子。第 2 分镜为左下方的小特写，展示戴着手套的手指向剪贴板上的皮肤图表笔记。第 3 分镜为中间的小分镜，展示巨嘴鸟在绿叶窗边的侧影，手里拿着花朵咖啡杯，配有圆形的对话/思考气泡。第 4 分镜为右下方的小笔记本分镜，配有回形针和钢笔，展示了一份勾选了三项内容的清单。第 5 分镜为宽幅森林场景：穿着粉色连帽衫的巨嘴鸟在浅绿色树木和落叶间用望远镜观察，左侧配有反思性的手写文字。第 6 分镜为宽幅屋顶/城市场景：巨嘴鸟背对镜头坐在窗台上，面对着浅色的城市天际线，天空中有一架纸飞机，画面中还有花盆、咖啡杯、小水龙头或管道、右侧贴着的便签，以及角色旁边的对话气泡。最底部的条幅包含 5 个带有说明的小图标：显微镜、笔记本电脑、相机、咖啡杯，以及一张带有爱心图案的手写感谢信。

文字内容：添加柔和墨水风格的日文手写标题，使用以下文本作为整体文案：{argument name="Japanese page text" default="皮膚科のこと、日常のこと。ちょっとした気づきのメモ。今日も、誰かの役に立つひとつを。知識は命。わかりやすくて、ためになる。それがいちばんうれしい。肌は、正直。暮らしのサインが、ちゃんと出る。専門のこと、むずかしいこともやさしく届けたいんだよね。今日のメモ つたえる つくる つながる ぜんぶ、だいじ。いいものはちゃんと、静かに、つづいていく。流行より、本質を見たい。皮膚は、暮らしの鏡。整えることは、自分をたいせつにすること。今日も、自分にも誰かにも、やさしくね。さぁ、次はどんな話を届けようかな。ものづくりと発信で、ちょっといい明日を。研究も好き。AIも相棒。旅と自然にインプット。珈琲でリセット。Thank you! いつもありがとう。"} 请保持文字为手写体，略带不完美感，并自然地融入分镜中，而非排版字体。

风格限制：精细的钢笔水彩插画，可见纸张纹理，柔和的米色阴影，低调的蓝绿/绿色/粉色调色板，舒适的桌面杂物，柔和的阳光，无光泽的数字渲染感，无生硬的轮廓线，无写实感。保持诗意且安静鼓舞人心的基调。使用 {argument name="main character" default="anthropomorphic toucan dermatologist"} 作为中心人物，{argument name="setting mood" default="warm reflective Japanese diary manga"} 作为设定氛围，{argument name="color palette" default="muted watercolor beige, teal, dusty pink, soft green, warm ochre"} 作为调色板，以及 {argument name="theme" default="skincare wisdom, daily observations, kindness, and thoughtful creation"} 作为主题。

templates.title: Bold Egg Tart Opening Poster

titleLocalized.zh: Bold Egg Tart 开业海报

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a minimalist, eye-catching food promotional poster for a bakery opening, centered around a realistic Portuguese egg tart. Canvas: A 3:4 aspect ratio vertical poster with a soft light pink background and a smooth gradient effect; no borders or watermarks. Layout: Place a large, capital red title at the very top of the poster.{argument name="top headline" default="WE'RE"} The text uses a heavy, geometric sans-serif font, almost spanning the entire poster. A red, rounded capsule outline containing uppercase text is added centered directly below the title.{argument name="product label" default="DELICIOUS EGG TARTS"} The poster features a giant egg tart suspended on a pink background in the center, rendered in a realistic photographic style, without a plate or hands. Below the tart, centered, is a smaller, rounded red capsule outline containing capitalized text.{argument name="happy hour text" default="HAPPY HOUR: 6AM"} At the bottom of the poster, place a large red capital word.{argument name="bottom headline" default="OPEN"} Use the same heavy sans-serif font as above, with a width that almost spans the entire poster. Main details: The egg tarts should be golden brown, with a crisp, layered crust, a glossy yellow custard filling, dark caramel spots, and a light dusting of powdered sugar on top. The image should be enticing, with sharp details, using studio lighting, adding only subtle natural shadows where necessary. Visual style: Modern pop art baking poster, high-contrast red text on a light pink background, clean white space, centered alignment, crisp commercial food photography, and bright yet soft lighting. Text restrictions: Use only 4 visible text elements: 1 top heading, 1 product label capsule, 1 Happy Hour capsule, and 1 bottom heading. All fonts must be bright red, uppercase, bold, and simple. Do not add any additional logos, icons, prices, addresses, small print descriptions, or decorative objects.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为烘焙店开业创作一张极简风格的醒目美食宣传海报，以一个写实的葡式蛋挞为中心。

画布：3:4 比例的竖版海报，采用柔和的淡粉色背景，带有细腻平滑的渐变效果，无边框或水印。

布局：在海报最上方，放置一个巨大的红色大写标题 {argument name="top headline" default="WE'RE"}，使用厚重的几何无衬线字体，宽度几乎横跨整个海报。在标题正下方居中位置，添加一个红色的圆角胶囊轮廓，内含大写文本 {argument name="product label" default="DELICIOUS EGG TARTS"}。海报中间放置 1 个巨大的蛋挞，悬浮在粉色背景上，采用写实摄影风格，不带盘子或手部。在蛋挞下方居中位置，添加一个较小的红色圆角胶囊轮廓，内含大写文本 {argument name="happy hour text" default="HAPPY HOUR: 6AM"}。在海报底部，放置一个巨大的红色大写单词 {argument name="bottom headline" default="OPEN"}，使用与上方相同的厚重无衬线字体，宽度几乎横跨整个海报。

主体细节：蛋挞应呈现金棕色，具有酥脆的层叠酥皮、光泽感十足的黄色蛋奶馅、深色的焦糖斑点，顶部轻撒一层糖粉。画面需诱人、细节清晰、采用摄影棚灯光，仅在必要时添加淡淡的自然阴影。

视觉风格：现代波普艺术烘焙海报，淡粉色背景上的高对比度红色字体，干净的留白，居中对齐，清晰的商业美食摄影，明亮而柔和的灯光。

文本限制：仅使用 4 个可见文本元素：1 个顶部标题、1 个产品标签胶囊、1 个 Happy Hour 胶囊和 1 个底部标题。所有字体需保持亮红色、大写、粗体且简洁。请勿添加任何额外的标志、图标、价格、地址、小字说明或装饰性物体。

templates.title: A romantic sunset reminiscent of the Titanic (covered version)

titleLocalized.zh: 泰坦尼克号式日落浪漫（遮挡版）

templates.prompt: Create a romantic still with a cinematic feel, in which {argument name="couple description" default="A young couple dressed in formal attire from the early 1900s"} Standing at the bow of a large ocean liner, recreating the iconic outstretched arms pose from Titanic. The woman is in front, arms outstretched horizontally to the sides, facing the sea breeze. She wears a deep navy blue velvet coat or dress, over which is an exquisite cream-colored lace corset, adorned with a small cross necklace and earrings. Her tousled brown curls are blown back by the sea breeze. The man is close behind, wearing a dark suit jacket, one arm around her waist, the other partially obscuring her face. He wears a light-colored shirt and vest, with neatly slicked-back dark hair. Both faces are deliberately covered by solid, warm brown rectangular smudges; the man's face is a larger square, the woman's a vertical rectangle. The background is the sea at dusk, the sky a vibrant orange-pink sunset, the clouds soft with warm golden contours. Huge black rigging chains and metal components outline the left and right edges, with the deck railings faintly visible at the bottom. Employing vertical portrait composition, medium to close-up shots, dramatic backlighting, realistic cinematic style, rich contrast, shallow depth of field, 35mm cinematic color grading, a nostalgic epic romantic atmosphere, no visible text, and no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影质感的浪漫剧照，画面中 {argument name="couple description" default="一对身着 1900 年代初期正式服装的年轻男女"} 站在大型远洋客轮的船头，重现泰坦尼克号中标志性的双臂伸展姿势。女子在前，双臂向两侧水平伸展，迎着海风，身穿深海军蓝丝绒外套或礼服，内搭精致的奶油色蕾丝紧身胸衣，佩戴小十字项链和耳环，凌乱的棕色卷发被海风吹向脑后。男子紧贴其后，身穿深色正装外套，一只手搂住她的腰，另一只手部分遮挡，身着浅色衬衫和马甲，留着整齐的深色背头。两人的面部均被暖棕色的实心矩形遮挡块刻意覆盖，男子脸部为较大的正方形，女子脸部为垂直长方形。背景是黄昏时分的大海，天空呈现出鲜艳的橙粉色日落，云层柔和，带有温暖的金色轮廓光。巨大的黑色船用索具链条和金属构件勾勒出左右边缘，底部隐约可见甲板栏杆。采用竖向人像构图，中近景拍摄，戏剧性的逆光效果，写实电影摄影风格，对比度丰富，浅景深，35mm 电影级调色，怀旧史诗浪漫氛围，无可见文字，无水印。

templates.title: Glass Rain Night Market

titleLocalized.zh: 玻璃雨夜市

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic cyberpunk nighttime street scene, focusing on atmosphere rather than text: an original{argument name="character type" default="Young market visitors"} Standing in the foreground on the left, with her back to the camera and part of her face visible in profile, she holds a large, transparent, domed umbrella covered in raindrops. This character possesses {argument name="hair color" default="Moist black short hair"} They wore glossy dark hooded raincoats with delicate patterned trim and carried crossbody bags. Their faces were mostly in shadow and bore no resemblance to any real person. They looked to the right at the brightly lit rain-soaked market: a long row of plastic sheeting stalls for produce stretched diagonally from the center right to the upper right corner. The stalls contained crates filled with red tomatoes and mixed vegetables, white storage boxes, hanging transparent plastic sheets, metal poles, and seven warm amber pendant lights clearly visible under the awnings. The scene was set in a dense urban market street during a downpour, the wet ground reflecting blue and amber neon lights, with blurred pedestrians holding umbrellas in the background, vertical, out-of-focus East Asian-style shop signs, and a thick, atmospheric fog.{argument name="color palette" default="Cyan and amber neon"} The color palette, strong cinematic contrast, realistic rain streaks, water droplets on umbrellas and tarpaulins, shallow depth of field, bokeh effects, 35mm street photography composition, no logos, no clearly visible brand names, no celebrity portraits, and no additional foreground objects. The overall atmosphere should convey {argument name="mood" default="The tranquil loneliness of the glass rain night market"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个电影感赛博朋克夜间街道场景，以氛围而非文字为主题：一个原创 {argument name="character type" default="年轻的市场访客"} 站在左侧前景，背对镜头并露出部分侧脸，手持一把挂满雨珠的大型透明圆顶雨伞。该角色拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="湿润的黑色短发"}，身穿带有精致图案饰边的亮面深色连帽雨衣，并背着斜挎包，面部大部分处于阴影中，且不与任何真实人物相似。他们望向右侧灯火通明的雨中市场：一条长长的塑料布农产品摊位从右中方斜向延伸至右上角，摊位上有装满红番茄和混合蔬菜的板条箱、白色储物箱、悬挂的透明塑料布、金属杆，以及遮阳棚下清晰可见的 7 盏暖琥珀色吊灯。场景设定在暴雨中密集的城市市场街道，湿润的地面反射着青色和琥珀色的霓虹灯光，背景中有模糊的撑伞行人，垂直的失焦东亚风格商店招牌，以及浓厚的氛围感雾气。使用 {argument name="color palette" default="青色与琥珀色霓虹"} 色调，强烈的电影感对比度，逼真的雨痕，雨伞和防水布上的水滴，浅景深，光斑效果，35mm 街头摄影构图，无 Logo，无清晰可见的品牌名称，无名人肖像，无额外的前景物体。整体氛围应呈现出 {argument name="mood" default="玻璃雨夜市中的静谧孤独感"}。

variables.name: mood
variables.defaultValue: The tranquil loneliness of the glass rain night market

templates.title: Surrealist Melting Clock Desert

titleLocalized.zh: 超现实主义熔化时钟沙漠

templates.prompt: Create a dreamlike surrealist oil painting, inspired by Salvador Dalí's *The Persistence of Memory*: a desolate coastal desert at dusk, a low horizon, a calm blue sea to the left, a pale yellow sky gradually fading to blue, and distant ochre cliffs shimmering in the light and shadow. In the foreground, place a sharply edged brown wooden platform extending from the lower left corner, upon which grows a withered, leafless tree. Include four clearly visible clocks: a soft blue-grey melted clock hanging from a branch, a pale melted clock sliding across the edge of the platform with black numerals, a soft white melted clock folded over the face of a strange sleeping creature in the lower right corner, and an orange closed pocket watch placed on the platform, covered with numerous tiny black ants. Use elongated shadows, smooth, realistic brushstrokes, an eerie stillness, distorted forms, high contrast between warm earth tones and cool blue highlights, and a vintage museum painting texture. Maintain a sparse and eerie composition, with no people or modern objects in the image, and no readable text except for clock markings. Optional custom details:{argument name="surrealist style" default="Salvador Dalí's *The Persistence of Memory*"} ,{argument name="sky color" default="Pale yellow gradually turns into blue"} ,{argument name="landscape setting" default="The desolate coastal desert at dusk"} ,{argument name="number of timepieces" default="4"} ,{argument name="foreground platform color" default="warm brown wood"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅梦幻般的超现实主义油画，风格参考萨尔瓦多·达利的《记忆的永恒》：黄昏时分荒凉的海岸沙漠，低矮的地平线，左侧是平静的蓝色大海，淡黄色天空渐变为蓝色，远处的赭色悬崖在光影中闪烁。在前景中，放置一个从左下角延伸出的锋利边缘棕色木制平台，上面长出一棵枯萎的无叶树。包含 4 个清晰可见的时钟：1 个挂在树枝上的柔和蓝灰色熔化时钟，1 个滑过平台前缘并带有黑色数字的苍白熔化时钟，1 个折叠在右下角奇异的睡眠生物形态面孔上的白色柔软熔化时钟，以及 1 个放在平台上并覆盖着许多微小黑蚂蚁的橙色闭合怀表。使用拉长的阴影、平滑写实的笔触、诡异的静谧感、扭曲的形态、温暖的大地色调与冷蓝色高光之间的高对比度，以及复古的博物馆油画质感。保持构图稀疏且诡异，画面中不出现人物、现代物品，除了时钟刻度外不包含任何可读文字。可选自定义细节：{argument name="surrealist style" default="萨尔瓦多·达利的《记忆的永恒》"}, {argument name="sky color" default="淡黄色渐变为蓝色"}, {argument name="landscape setting" default="黄昏时分荒凉的海岸沙漠"}, {argument name="number of timepieces" default="4"}, {argument name="foreground platform color" default="暖棕色木材"}。

templates.title: Retro Mediterranean Herbal Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 复古地中海草本海报

templates.prompt: Create a minimalist, retro Mediterranean editorial poster with a 16:9 widescreen aspect ratio. Use a deep cyan-blue matte background with ample negative space, incorporating a heavy, simulated film grain, subtle halftone print texture, and slightly aged offset colors. Place a single plant at the center: a bundle of wild Mediterranean herbs, horizontally suspended slightly above the center of the image, with stems pointing to the right and leaves spreading to the left. The herb bundle should include a mix of greens such as sage leaves, rosemary twigs, thyme-like stems, and mint-like leaves, tied at the stem ends with brown natural hemp rope. The rendering should balance realism with a poster style, featuring warm sunlight highlights and soft shadows below. Below the herb bundle, place a centered, large, elegant cream-colored serif title.{argument name="title text" default="Selvatica"} The title is located in the lower third of the image. Add two matching cream-colored decorative symbols on each side of the title; each symbol consists of a short horizontal line, a dot, and another short horizontal line. Keep the composition simple and refined, with no borders, no extra objects, no additional text, and no watermark. Overall atmosphere: a rustic, botanical, vintage Mediterranean pharmacist editor-style poster.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一张 16:9 宽屏比例的极简主义复古地中海编辑风格海报。使用深青蓝色哑光背景，留出大量负空间，加入厚重的模拟胶片颗粒感、微妙的半色调印刷质感以及轻微老化的胶印色彩。画面中心放置单一植物主体：一束捆扎的野生地中海草本植物，水平悬浮在画面中心略上方，茎部指向右侧，叶片末端向左展开。草本束应包含混合绿色植物，如鼠尾草叶、迷迭香小枝、类似百里香的细茎以及类似薄荷的小叶，在茎部末端用棕褐色天然麻绳捆扎；渲染效果需兼具写实感与海报风格，带有温暖的阳光高光和下方的柔和阴影。在草本束下方，放置一个居中的大型奶油色优雅衬线字体标题 {argument name="title text" default="Selvatica"}，位于画面下三分之一处。在标题两侧各添加 2 个匹配的奶油色装饰符号，每个符号由一条短横线、一个圆点和另一条短横线组成。保持构图简洁精致，无边框，无额外物体，无附加文字，无水印。整体氛围：质朴、植物学、复古地中海药剂师编辑风格海报。

templates.title: Zen-inspired teacup ink painting

titleLocalized.zh: 禅意茶杯水墨画

templates.prompt: Create a minimalist Zen-inspired Japanese ink painting illustration using a vertical composition. The background uses warm, aged Xuan paper with subtle beige watercolor stains and ample negative space. Place a rustic ceramic teacup in the lower right corner; its rounded, slightly imperfect body displays a mottled beige clay texture, with a dark rim. Amber-brown tea liquor is visible within, and a soft gray ink shadow is cast at the bottom. Draw an elegant wisp of steam rising from the teacup using delicate, semi-transparent, flowing S-shaped black-gray brushstrokes. On the left, add a slender bamboo branch, extending diagonally from the lower left edge to the upper left and center. The branch should include three distinct nodes and twelve narrow bamboo leaves rendered in soft black, charcoal, and light gray tones. Add two small ink dots in the lower left corner of the teacup. The overall composition maintains a sense of tranquility, asymmetry, meditation, and elegance. The brushstrokes have a soft, organic texture. It employs ink painting techniques, supplemented by light watercolor washes. Apart from the expressive ink lines, there are no hard outlines, no text, no borders, and no watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅极简禅意风格的日式水墨插画，采用竖构图。背景使用温暖的陈旧宣纸，带有淡淡的米色水彩渍迹，并留出大量负空间。在右下角放置一个质朴的陶瓷茶杯，杯身圆润且略带瑕疵，呈现斑驳的米色陶土质感，杯口有一圈深色细边，杯中可见琥珀棕色的茶汤，杯底投下一抹柔和的灰色水墨阴影。从茶杯中画出一缕优雅的蒸汽，由纤细、半透明、流动的 S 形黑灰色笔触向上升腾。在左侧，加入一根纤细的竹枝，从左下边缘斜向伸入，延伸至左上方和中心，竹枝需包含 3 个清晰的竹节，以及 12 片采用柔和黑、炭黑和浅灰色调的狭长竹叶。在茶杯左下方添加 2 个小墨点。整体构图保持静谧、非对称、冥想感与优雅，笔触具有柔和的有机质感，采用水墨画技法，辅以轻盈的水彩晕染，除富有表现力的水墨线条外无硬轮廓，无文字，无边框，无水印。

templates.title: Still in Love Gothic Style Poster Analysis

titleLocalized.zh: Still in Love 哥特风分析海报

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a dark gothic anime infographic poster presented in Japanese, with the theme of {argument name="headline text" default="Still in Love's "Sin of Fated Bonds""} The story revolves around cursed love, blood, moonlight, and hidden virtues. Canvas: A 1:1 square poster with a gorgeous black background accented with deep red, a highly detailed fantasy UI border, antique gold thread decorations, roses, thorny vines, subtle cracks, blood droplets, and a dramatic full moon behind the central character. It employs a refined visual novel/gacha character analysis card style. Main subject: Centered on a female protagonist from the anime *Still in Love*, featuring a long {argument name="hair color" default="chestnut brown"} Flowing hair, red eyes, pale skin, a soft, melancholic smile, horse ears adorned with ribbons, a red and white gothic idol dress, a jeweled choker, ruffled sleeves, a red bow, and delicate bracelets. She stands frontally from above the thighs, one hand close to her chest, surrounded by a glowing moon and a smoky, red and black aura. Layout: Use 6 main content areas: 1 large top title bar, 1 central character portrait, 2 vertical side concept panels, 1 large lower-middle virtue panel, and 1 bottom scene impact section with four numbered cards. Maintain design symmetry and rich content while ensuring readability. Text Content: All visible poster text should be in Japanese, using an elegant serif Mingchao font, emphasized in white, light pink, and deep red. Include the following key phrases as visible text: Top Title{argument name="headline text" default="Still in Love's "Sin of Fated Bonds""} ;subtitle{argument name="subtitle text" default="What "Blood, Moon, and Immorality" Means"} Left panel title{argument name="left concept label" default="Blood"} , accompanied by smaller copywriting "Bloodline・Instinct・Race Walking's Impulse" and "Separation of Meanings' Super えてflow れ込む, Racing's うための力". Right panel title{argument name="right concept label" default="moon"} , accompanied by smaller copywriting "Ye·覚 Wake·隠された性" and "平多は氯えたurgeが、quiet かに目を覚ます". The title of the wide panel in the middle and lower part is "Back Virtue", accompanied by the copy "爱 の danger う さ · exclusive · cross the border" and "爱 が 深 ま る ほ ど, 相手 と の realm を cross え そ う に な る". The bottom title is "シナリオへの Impact". Bottom Card: Contains 4 numbered rectangular cards connected by small arrows from left to right. Card 1 tag "1", text ""rational selfishness" and "red impulse" duality". Card 2 tag "2", text "爱はsaving and saving at the same time". Card 3 has the label "3" and the text "The character of the girl is suffering, the character is the character, the fate is the description of the girl". Card 4 tag "4", text "Monogatari は『Overcoming』ではなく『Acceptance』へ向かう". Statement at the bottom: Add a gorgeous text box at the bottom with the content: "『Su縁のcriminology』とは、bloody fate からbearing わされた爱とrush "The original sin of moving." Side panel image: The left panel shows a crimson blood tree or branching vein tree under red mist, a black racehorse silhouette, and a floating red ribbon. The right panel shows a bright full moon over a lake or racetrack on a dark night, reflected in the water, with bridge or building lights in the distance. Lower center imagery: A wide virtue panel contains two symbolic images: on the left, a deep red rose entwined in black thorns; on the right, a pale female hand adorned with black lace/thorns, a drop of bright red blood dripping from its fingertips. Visual style: a color scheme of deep black, burgundy, antique gold, ivory, and moonlight blue; cinematic lighting effects; soft lighting around the moon and characters; intricate gothic borders in the corners; subtle glitter and dust; dramatic yet elegant, not horrific or gory. All Japanese text remains clear and legible, with keywords such as "curse," "destiny," "acceptance," "original sin," "love," and "to live together" emphasized in red.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张以日文呈现的暗黑哥特动漫信息图海报，主题为 {argument name="headline text" default="スティルインラブの『宿縁の罪科』"}，围绕诅咒之爱、鲜血、月光和隐藏的美德展开。

画布：方形 1:1 海报，华丽的黑色背景搭配深红色点缀，高细节奇幻 UI 边框，古董金丝装饰，玫瑰、荆棘藤蔓、细微裂纹、血滴，以及中央角色背后戏剧性的满月。采用精致的视觉小说 / 抽卡角色分析卡片风格。

主体：中心为一位受 Still in Love 启发的动漫马娘女主角：长长的 {argument name="hair color" default="栗棕色"} 流动秀发，红色的眼睛，苍白的皮肤，柔和忧郁的微笑，带有丝带装饰的马耳，红白相间的哥特偶像礼服，带有珠宝的颈圈，荷叶边袖子，红色蝴蝶结，精致的手镯。她从大腿以上正面站立，一只手靠近胸前，被发光的月亮和烟雾缭绕的红黑色氛围所环绕。

布局：使用 6 个主要内容区域：1 个顶部大标题栏，1 个中央角色肖像，2 个垂直侧面概念面板，1 个宽大的中下部美德面板，以及 1 个底部带有四个编号卡片的场景影响部分。保持设计对称且内容丰富，同时易于阅读。

文本内容：所有可见的海报文本应为日文，使用优雅的衬线明朝体，并以白色、淡粉色和深红色进行强调。包含以下关键短语作为可见文案：顶部标题 {argument name="headline text" default="スティルインラブの『宿縁の罪科』"}；副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="『血・月・背徳』が意味するもの"}。左侧面板标题 {argument name="left concept label" default="血"}，附带较小文案“血統・本能・競走への衝動”和“自分の意思を超えて流れ込む、競うための力”。右侧面板标题 {argument name="right concept label" default="月"}，附带较小文案“夜・覚醒・隠された本性”和“普段は抑えた衝動が、静かに目を覚ます”。中下部宽面板标题“背徳”，附带文案“愛の危うさ・独占・越境”和“愛が深まるほど、相手との境界を越えそうになる”。底部标题“シナリオへの影響”。

底部卡片：包含 4 张编号矩形卡片，由小箭头从左到右连接。卡片 1 标签“1”，文本““理性的な私”と“紅の衝動”の二面性”。卡片 2 标签“2”，文本“愛は救いであると同時に呪いでもある”。卡片 3 标签“3”，文本“彼女の苦しみは性格ではなく、宿命として描かれる”。卡片 4 标签“4”，文本“物語は『克服』ではなく『受容』へ向かう”。

底部声明：在底部添加一个华丽的文本框，内容为“『宿縁の罪科』とは、血と運命から背負わされた愛と衝動の原罪。スティルインラブの物語は、それを消すのではなく、抱えたまま愛し、共に生きる物語である。”

侧面板图像：左侧面板展示红雾下的深红色血树或分支状静脉树、黑色赛马剪影和漂浮的红丝带。右侧面板展示黑夜中湖泊或赛马场上方的明亮满月，倒映在水中，远处有桥梁或建筑灯光。

中下部图像：宽大的美德面板包含 2 个象征性图像：左侧是缠绕在黑色荆棘中的深红色玫瑰，右侧是一只苍白的女性手，带有黑色蕾丝/荆棘，指尖滴落一滴鲜红的血。

视觉风格：深黑、酒红、古董金、象牙白和月光蓝配色；电影级光效；月亮和角色周围的柔光；角落处复杂的哥特式边框装饰；细微的闪光和尘埃；戏剧性但优雅，非恐怖血腥。保持所有日文文本清晰易读，并对“呪い”、“宿命”、“受容”、“原罪”、“愛し”、“共に生きる”等关键词使用红色强调。
