templates.title: Gothic-style anime symbolism infographic

titleLocalized.zh: 哥特风动漫象征主义信息图

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a dark gothic-style anime infographic poster that explains {argument name="headline title" default="Still in Love's "Sin of Fated Bonds""} Symbolic meaning. The design should present itself as a gorgeous occult character analysis card, exploring fate, blood, moonlight, and original sin, with a melancholic romantic tone. Canvas: Square 1:1 poster, high resolution, black and deep burgundy tones, paired with ivory Japanese typography, red accents, silver moonlight, antique gold wire border, delicate wear texture, rose petals, glitter, and Victorian Gothic border. Layout: The top title bar contains a prominent Japanese title, subtitle, and decorative patterns. The main character is in the center, with a large full moon in the background. Vertical symbolic panels are located on the left and right sides. Below the character spans a wide panel labeled "Immorality." Below that is a section labeled "Influence on the Shrine," containing four numbered boxes connected from left to right by arrows. At the bottom is a bordered summary quote paragraph, decorated with roses in the corners. Central subject details: drawn{argument name="character name" default="Still in Love"} The character is depicted as a beautiful anime horse girl idol, a half-body portrait, centered, with long {argument name="hair color" default="chestnut brown"} Flowing hair, red eyes, a melancholic and gentle expression. A red ribbon adorns her horse's ear, she wears a small ruffled headdress, and a red and white Gothic idol dress with off-the-shoulder sleeves, a blue bow, choker jewelry, bracelets, and lace details. One hand rests on her chest, as if suppressing some emotion. The background is a bright full moon and floating red and black particles. Top text: Main title: スティルインラブの『宿縁の罪科』。 Subtitle: 『血・月・背德』が意义するもの。 Left symbolic panel: 1 left panel titled "Blood". Visual elements: Deep red trees resembling veins or blood vessels, red blood ribbons, a faint silhouette of a galloping horse at the bottom, and a circular Gothic border. Internal text: Bloodline・Instinct・Race to the Impulse. Small text: 自分の意思を超えて流れ込む、竞うための力。 Right-side symbolic panel: 1 right-side panel titled "Moon". Visual elements: A dark blue night sky, a bright full moon reflected on dark water and distant traditional buildings or bridges, tranquil clouds, cool moonlight, and a circular gothic border. Internal text: Night・Awakening・Hidden nature. Small text: 普段は抑えた動が、静かに目を覚ます。 Lower middle symbolic panel: 1 wide panel titled "Immorality". Visual elements: On the left is a black rose entwined with thorns, on the right is a pale hand passing through thorns, a drop of blood dripping from the fingertip, and a long, ornate border. Main text: Love's danger・Exclusive possession・Crossing the border. Small print: Love is deep, love is deep, hand is in hand, realm is over, and love is deep. Plot Impact Block: Contains 4 numbered boxes, each with a small round number badge and an ornate border, connected by arrows. Box 1 Text: The duality of "rational selfishness" and "red impulse". Box 2 Text: Love saves love at the same time. Box 3 Text: The character of the girl's suffering, the character of the girl, and the destiny of the girl. Box 4 Text: Monogatariは『overcoming』ではなく『acceptance』へ向かう. Highlighting key red keywords: Red Impulse, Curse, Destiny, Acceptance. Bottom summary text: 『宿縁の罪科』とは、血と运命から背负わされた爱と努力の原罪。 スティルインラブの物語は、それを消すのではなく、抱えたまま爱し、共に生きる物語である。 Visual style: Detailed Japanese anime illustrations combined with dark fantasy infographic design, clear and easy-to-read layout, symmetrical composition, ornate gold corner decorations, black marble textures, red roses, thorny vines, subtle embers, cinematic moonlight, high contrast, elegant yet tragic atmosphere. Restrictions: Use 3 designated symbol panels and 4 story boxes. Keep all Japanese text clear and accurately positioned. Do not add any logos, watermarks, extra characters, extra panels, or modern UI elements.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张暗黑哥特风动漫信息图海报，解释 {argument name="headline title" default="スティルインラブの『宿縁の罪科』"} 的象征意义。设计应呈现为一张华丽的神秘学角色分析卡片，探讨命运、鲜血、月光与原罪，并带有忧郁的浪漫基调。

画布：方形 1:1 海报，高分辨率，黑色与深酒红色调，搭配象牙白日文排版、红色点缀、银色月光、古董金丝边框、细腻的磨损纹理、玫瑰花瓣、闪光点以及维多利亚哥特式边框。

布局：顶部标题栏包含醒目的日文大标题、副标题和装饰性花纹。中心为主角，背景是一轮巨大的满月。左右两侧设有垂直的象征性面板。角色下方横跨一个标注为“背徳”的宽幅面板。其下方为标注为“シナリオへの影響”的板块，包含 4 个由箭头从左至右连接的编号方框。底部是一个带边框的总结性引语段落，两侧角落饰有玫瑰。

中心主体细节：绘制 {argument name="character name" default="Still in Love"}，形象为一位美丽的动漫马娘偶像，半身像，居中，留着长长的 {argument name="hair color" default="栗棕色"} 飘逸秀发，红色双眸，表情忧郁柔和。马耳上装饰着红色丝带，佩戴小型荷叶边头饰，身着红白相间的哥特式偶像礼服，配有露肩袖、蓝色蝴蝶结装饰、颈圈珠宝、手镯和蕾丝细节。她的一只手放在胸前，仿佛在克制某种情绪。背景为明亮的满月和漂浮的红黑色粒子。

顶部文字：大标题：スティルインラブの『宿縁の罪科』。副标题：『血・月・背徳』が意味するもの。

左侧象征面板：1 个标题为“血”的左侧面板。视觉元素：形似静脉或血管的深红色树木、红色的血丝带、底部若隐若现的奔马剪影，圆形哥特边框。内部文字：血統・本能・競走への衝動。小字：自分の意思を超えて流れ込む、競うための力。

右侧象征面板：1 个标题为“月”的右侧面板。视觉元素：蓝黑色夜空，明亮的满月映照在深色水面和远处的传统建筑或桥梁上，宁静的云朵，清冷的月光，圆形哥特边框。内部文字：夜・覚醒・隠された本性。小字：普段は抑えた衝動が、静かに目を覚ます。

中下部象征面板：1 个标题为“背徳”的宽幅面板。视觉元素：左侧是缠绕着荆棘的黑玫瑰，右侧是一只苍白的手穿过荆棘，指尖滴落一滴鲜血，长条形华丽边框。主文字：愛の危うさ・独占・越境。小字：愛が深まるほど、相手との境界を越えそうになる。

剧情影响板块：包含 4 个编号方框，每个方框配有小型圆形数字徽章和华丽边框，并由箭头连接。方框 1 文字：“理性的な私”と“紅の衝動”の二面性。方框 2 文字：愛は救いであると同時に呪いでもある。方框 3 文字：彼女の苦しみは性格ではなく、宿命として描かれる。方框 4 文字：物語は『克服』ではなく『受容』へ向かう。重点突出红色关键词：紅の衝動、呪い、宿命、受容。

底部总结文字：『宿縁の罪科』とは、血と運命から背負わされた愛と衝動の原罪。スティルインラブの物語は、それを消すのではなく、抱えたまま愛し、共に生きる物語である。

视觉风格：精细的日本动漫插画结合暗黑奇幻编辑信息图设计，清晰易读的排版，对称构图，华丽的金色边角装饰，黑色大理石纹理，红玫瑰，荆棘藤蔓，细微的余烬，电影感月光，高对比度，优雅而悲剧的氛围。

限制：使用指定的 3 个象征面板和 4 个剧情方框。保持所有日文文字清晰且放置位置准确。不要添加任何徽标、水印、额外字符、额外面板或现代 UI 元素。

templates.title: Lisbon vintage tram travel poster

titleLocalized.zh: 里斯本复古电车旅行海报

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic travel poster based on a realistic street photograph depicting two vintage Lisbon trams crossing tracks under a sunlit sun. The scene should evoke the warm atmosphere of a European afternoon street, featuring deep shadows, golden highlights, parked vehicles and greenery in the background, and passengers visible through the tram windows. The trams should be rendered in classic red, yellow, cream, and dark trim, with wooden window frames and authentic billboards; including clearly visible details such as a Coca-Cola-style cursive advertisement on the left tram and the small route number "56" on the right tram. The image should be composed in a 3:2 horizontal aspect ratio with tight cropping, allowing the tram fronts to dominate the frame and overlap near the center. A striking and elegant white handwritten brush title should be added in the center of the image, containing the following text:{argument name="city name" default="Lisbon"} The text is slightly slanted and spans across two trams. Below the title, add a centered, capitalized serif subtitle with the following content:{argument name="tagline" default="WHERE EVERY CORNER TELLS A STORY"} It features delicate decorative horizontal lines on both sides and a small diamond decoration below. Employing a high-contrast travel magazine-style color grading, it strives for realistic photographic quality, clear details, and natural reflections on the glass. Aside from advertisements on the tram, no additional logos or watermarks are added.

promptLocalized.zh: 根据一张写实的街头摄影作品创作一张电影质感的旅行海报，画面中两辆复古的里斯本电车在阳光照耀的轨道上交错而过。场景应营造出温暖的欧洲午后街头氛围，呈现深邃的阴影、金色的高光、背景中停放的车辆和绿植，透过电车车窗可以看到乘客。电车采用经典的红、黄、奶油色和深色饰边，配有木质窗框和真实的广告牌；包含清晰可见的小细节，例如左侧电车上类似可口可乐风格的草书广告，以及右侧电车上小巧的路线编号“56”。图像采用 3:2 的横向比例构图，紧凑裁剪，使电车车头占据画面主体并在中心附近重叠。在画面中间添加醒目且优雅的白色手写笔刷体标题，内容为 {argument name="city name" default="Lisbon"}，文字略微倾斜并横跨两辆电车。在标题下方，添加居中的大写衬线体副标题，内容为 {argument name="tagline" default="WHERE EVERY CORNER TELLS A STORY"}，两侧配有纤细的装饰性水平线，下方点缀一个小菱形装饰。采用高对比度的旅行杂志风格调色，追求写实摄影质感、清晰的细节以及玻璃上的自然反射，除电车上的广告外，不添加任何额外的标志或水印。

templates.title: Lisbon travel poster

titleLocalized.zh: 里斯本旅行海报

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic travel poster photograph that showcases a bird's-eye view from above.{argument name="city" default="Lisbon"} A daytime scene. The image should present a broad panoramic view of the city, including dense historic buildings, warm cream-colored facades, orange terracotta roofs, a large public square paved with patterned stone bricks, trees, memorial columns, and surrounding hills. Use a bright blue sky dotted with sparse, soft white clouds to present warm natural light, clear architectural details, and a color palette reminiscent of a retro travel magazine. Overlay a white typography in the center of the image: the main title "{argument name="headline text" default="Lisbon"} "Use an oversized and elegant handwritten brush font, placed at the top of the image; below it, place a thin horizontal dividing line, adorned with a small diamond decoration in the middle; further below, add a subtitle, using a small, uppercase, sans-serif font with wide letter spacing, the content of which is..."{argument name="subtitle text" default="A city full of light, color and charm"} The text should be arranged in two centered lines. The design should be simple and sophisticated, with no focal point—no figures, borders, logos, or additional text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影质感的旅行海报摄影作品，展示从高处俯瞰 {argument name="city" default="里斯本"} 的日间景象。画面应呈现广阔的城市全景，包含密集的历史建筑、温暖的奶油色外墙、橙色的赤陶屋顶、带有图案石砖铺设的大型公共广场、树木、纪念柱以及周围的丘陵。使用明亮的蓝天，点缀着稀疏的柔和白云，呈现温暖的自然光、清晰的建筑细节，以及略带复古旅行杂志风格的调色。在画面中心叠加白色排版：主标题 “{argument name="headline text" default="里斯本"}” 使用超大且优雅的手写笔刷字体，置于画面中上方；在其下方放置一条细水平分割线，中间点缀一个小型菱形装饰；再下方添加副标题，使用小号、大写、字间距较宽的无衬线字体，内容为 “{argument name="subtitle text" default="一座充满光影、色彩与魅力的城市"}”，分两行居中排列。保持设计简洁且高级，画面中不应有作为焦点的人物，不加边框，不含任何 Logo，也不要添加额外文字。

templates.title: Lisbon tram travel poster

titleLocalized.zh: 里斯本电车旅行海报

templates.prompt: Create a photo with a cinematic travel poster style to showcase{argument name="city" default="Lisbon"} A narrow, old European street. Slightly from above, looking downhill, tall historic apartment buildings line both sides. A classic yellow tram sits in the center of the tracks, facing the camera. The image includes the cobblestone street, the tram lines overhead, the worn cream and yellow facades, stone window frames, balconies, streetlights, and graffiti-covered walls on both sides. The warm, golden hour sunlight should create soft, long shadows and a nostalgic urban atmosphere, with the water or distant horizon faintly visible at the end of the street. Add a prominent, centered typography above the tram: the main title is {argument name="headline text" default="LISBON"} The text uses a large, distressed white, blocky font with wide letter spacing. A smaller, handwritten cursive subtitle is added below.{argument name="subtitle text" default="Lost in the right direction"} Add thin horizontal dividing lines extending left and right below the subtitle, and place a small white diamond/star decoration centered between the two lines. Use realistic photography techniques, high detail, warm tones, strong depth of field, no people in the image, no other vehicles besides the tram, and no additional text or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影感旅行海报风格的照片，展示 {argument name="city" default="里斯本"} 一条狭窄的欧洲老街。视角略微俯瞰，顺着下坡路望去，两侧是高大的历史公寓建筑。一辆经典的黄色电车位于轨道中央，正对着镜头。画面包含鹅卵石路面、头顶的电车线、陈旧的奶油色和黄色外墙、石制窗框、阳台、路灯以及两侧布满涂鸦的墙壁。温暖的黄金时刻阳光应营造出柔和的长影和怀旧的城市氛围，街道尽头隐约可见水域或远方的地平线。在电车上方添加醒目的居中排版：主标题为 {argument name="headline text" default="LISBON"}，采用大号做旧白色大写块状字体，字间距较宽。下方添加较小的手写草书副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="Lost in the right direction"}。在副标题下方添加向左右延伸的细水平分割线，并在两线之间居中放置一个小的白色菱形/星形装饰。使用逼真的摄影手法，高细节，暖色调，强景深，画面中不含人物，除该电车外无其他车辆，且无额外文字或水印。

templates.title: Lisbon Night View Travel Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 里斯本夜景旅行海报

templates.prompt: Create a film with a cinematic quality.{argument name="city name" default="Lisbon"} This nighttime travel poster photo showcases a steep, narrow old European street stretching into the distance, its surface covered in damp cobblestones. Two parallel tram tracks curve down the hillside. The perspective is positioned above the street, looking down at the tall, ancient buildings on either side, complete with balconies, latticed windows, textured stucco walls, stone door frames, and warmly glowing streetlights. In the right foreground, a bright vintage wall lamp hangs above a door, climbing plants shimmer in the golden light, and a small potted plant sits by the roadside. The background blends into the deep blue of the night, with a soft blurring effect of city lights and a blurred mountaintop landmark. The photo employs a shallow depth of field, cinematic mood grading, a strong contrast between warm amber lighting and cool navy blue shadows, and glossy reflections on the tracks and stones, creating a realistic photographic style with a 16:9 horizontal composition. Elegant overlay typography is added in the lower left and center left corners: three text elements in total, respectively {argument name="main title" default="Lisbon"} (Extra-large white handwritten calligraphy font), below{argument name="first subtitle" default="Beautiful night"} (Small capital gold serif font), and further below{argument name="second subtitle" default="Unforgettable memories"} (Wide-spaced uppercase gold serif font). Add three decorative elements below the subtitle: a thin gold horizontal line on the left, a small gold four-petaled iris decoration in the middle, and a thin gold horizontal line on the right. Keep the layout clear and integrated like a luxury travel postcard; the image should contain no people, no vehicles, no unnecessary text, and no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张具有电影质感的 {argument name="city name" default="里斯本"} 夜景旅行海报照片，展示一条陡峭狭窄的欧洲老街向远处延伸，地面是湿润的鹅卵石，两条平行的电车轨道顺着山坡弯曲而下。视角位于街道上方，向下俯瞰，两侧是高大古老的建筑，配有阳台、栅栏窗、纹理灰泥墙、石门框以及温暖发光的街灯。右侧前景处，门上方挂着一盏明亮的复古壁灯，攀缘植物在金色的光线下闪烁，路边有一盆小盆栽。背景融入深蓝色的夜色中，带有柔和的城市灯光虚化效果和模糊的山顶地标。采用浅景深、电影级情绪调色、温暖琥珀色灯光与冷色调海军蓝阴影的强烈对比，轨道和石块上有光泽的反射，写实摄影风格，16:9 横向构图。在左下角和左中位置添加优雅的叠加排版：共 3 个文本元素，分别为 {argument name="main title" default="里斯本"}（超大白色手写毛笔字体）、下方的 {argument name="first subtitle" default="美丽的夜晚"}（小型大写金色衬线字体），以及更下方的 {argument name="second subtitle" default="难忘的回忆"}（间距较宽的大写金色衬线字体）。在副标题下方添加 3 个装饰元素：左侧一条细金色水平线，中间一个小型金色四瓣鸢尾花装饰，右侧一条细金色水平线。保持排版清晰，并像奢华旅行明信片一样融为一体；画面中无人、无车辆，无多余文字，无水印。

templates.title: Lisbon vintage tram travel poster

titleLocalized.zh: 里斯本复古电车旅行海报

templates.prompt: for{argument name="city name" default="Lisbon"} Create a cinematic travel poster using a realistic street photography style: two vintage yellow and red trams parked side-by-side on sunlit tracks, taken from a close-up perspective. The left tram is largely cropped in the foreground, while the right tram is slightly tilted outwards, revealing passengers through its wooden-framed windows. The background features overhead tram lines, parked cars, lush trees, and brightly lit European city architecture. Add warm afternoon sunlight, deep shadows, rich contrast, glossy reflections on the glass, and a genuine urban documentary feel. The image includes two main trams: one in the left foreground with a striking Coca-Cola-style red side panel, and the right tram with the number 56 marked above the front. Centered white text at the bottom center of the image: a striking handwritten brush-style title.{argument name="headline text" default="Lisbon"} Below it is a smaller, all-caps serif slogan.{argument name="tagline text" default="WHERE EVERY CORNER TELLS A STORY"} Add thin, decorative horizontal dividing lines on both sides of the slogan, and place a small diamond-shaped decoration in the center below them. The composition is a sophisticated tourism poster, with a 3:2 horizontal ratio, no borders, no watermarks, ensuring clear and legible text while retaining a realistic photographic background.

promptLocalized.zh: 为 {argument name="city name" default="Lisbon"} 创建一张电影感旅行海报，采用写实的街头摄影风格：两辆复古黄红相间的有轨电车并排停在阳光明媚的轨道上，采用近景视角，左侧电车在前景中被大面积裁切，右侧电车略微向外倾斜，透过木框窗户可以看到乘客，背景为架空电车线、停放的汽车、茂密的树木和明亮的欧洲城市建筑。加入温暖的午后阳光、深邃的阴影、丰富的对比度、玻璃上的光泽反射以及真实的城市纪实感。图像中包含 2 辆主要电车：左侧前景中的一辆电车带有醒目的可口可乐风格红色侧板，右侧电车前部上方标有数字 56。在画面中下部居中叠加白色文字：一个醒目的手写笔刷风格大标题 {argument name="headline text" default="Lisbon"}，下方配以较小的全大写衬线体标语 {argument name="tagline text" default="WHERE EVERY CORNER TELLS A STORY"}。在标语两侧加入纤细的装饰性水平分割线，并在其下方居中放置一个小菱形装饰。构图为精致的旅游宣传海报，3:2 横向比例，无边框，无水印，确保文字清晰易读，同时保留写实的摄影背景。

templates.title: Lisbon travel poster

titleLocalized.zh: 里斯本旅行海报

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic travel poster-style aerial photograph showcasing Portugal.{argument name="city name" default="Lisbon"} The perspective begins from a high observation deck overlooking the historic city center, showcasing warm terracotta rooftops, cream and soft-toned buildings, a wide square paved with black and white patterns, towering monumental columns, tree-lined plazas, and distant mountains against a backdrop of azure sky and scattered soft white clouds. Golden sunlight renders sharp, realistic details, with a subtle orange-green hue characteristic of travel photography color grading. The wide-angle landscape composition avoids emphasizing any figures. An elegant white typography is centered in the upper center of the sky: a large, handwritten title…{argument name="headline text" default="Lisbon"} The title is written with long, flowing strokes; below it is a thin, horizontal decorative dividing line with a small diamond in the center; below that is a sans-serif subtitle in all capital letters with wide spacing.{argument name="subtitle text" default="A city full of light, color and charm"} The text should be arranged in two lines, maintaining clarity, brightness, and balance, while contrasting well with the sky background to create the effect of a high-end destination postcard or tourist brochure.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影质感的旅行海报风格航拍照片，展示葡萄牙 {argument name="city name" default="里斯本"}。视角从俯瞰历史悠久的市中心高处观景台出发，画面中可见温暖的赤陶色屋顶、奶油色和柔和色调的建筑、带有黑白图案铺装的宽阔广场、高耸的纪念碑柱、绿树成荫的广场，以及在湛蓝天空和零星柔和白云映衬下的远山。采用金色日光，呈现清晰逼真的细节，带有轻微的青橙色调旅行摄影色彩分级，宽幅景观构图，且不突出人物。在天空的中上方居中叠加优雅的白色排版：大型手写笔触标题 “{argument name="headline text" default="里斯本"}”，带有长而流畅的笔触；标题下方设有一条纤细的水平装饰分割线，中心配有一个小型菱形装饰；再下方是全大写、字间距拉开的无衬线副标题 “{argument name="subtitle text" default="一座充满光影、色彩与魅力的城市"}”，分两行排列。保持文字清晰、明亮、平衡，并与天空背景形成良好对比，呈现出高端目的地明信片或旅游宣传图的效果。

templates.title: Lisbon tram travel poster

titleLocalized.zh: 里斯本电车旅行海报

templates.prompt: Create a photo with a cinematic travel poster style to showcase{argument name="city name" default="Lisbon"} A narrow, steep, old European street descends between tall, old apartment buildings, paved with cobblestones and featuring a double-track tramway. The buildings' facades are a faded cream and yellow, dotted with rectangular windows, overhead wires, and graffiti-covered walls, all bathed in the warm, golden hour sunlight. At the center of the image is a classic vintage yellow Lisbon tram approaching the viewer, symmetrically positioned in the middle of the street, with the water and hazy horizon faintly visible in the distance. A clean, editorial typography is added to the center of the image: containing two text elements, one a striking, bold, distressed white, all-caps title…{argument name="headline text" default="LISBON"} Below this is a slender white handwritten cursive subtitle.{argument name="subtitle text" default="Lost in the right direction"} Add three small decorative graphic elements around the subtitle: a thin white horizontal line extending from the left, a thin white horizontal line extending from the right, and a thin white diamond centered below the subtitle. Use a warm, emotional color tone, high contrast, realistic details, a slight film grain, deep perspective lines, no people in the image, no additional logos, and no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影级旅行海报风格的照片，展示 {argument name="city name" default="Lisbon"}：一条狭窄陡峭的欧洲古老街道，在两旁高大的旧公寓楼间向下延伸，铺设着鹅卵石路面和双轨电车道，建筑外墙呈现出斑驳的奶油色和黄色，布满矩形窗户，上方悬挂着电线，两侧墙壁带有涂鸦，沐浴在温暖的黄金时刻阳光下。画面中心是一辆经典的复古黄色里斯本电车正向观众驶来，对称地构图在街道中央，远端隐约可见水域和朦胧的地平线。在画面中心添加简洁的编辑风格排版：包含 2 个文本元素，一个是醒目的粗体做旧白色全大写标题“{argument name="headline text" default="LISBON"}”，下方是一个纤细的白色手写草书副标题“{argument name="subtitle text" default="Lost in the right direction"}”。在副标题周围添加 3 个小型装饰性图形元素：左侧延伸出一条细长的白色水平线，右侧延伸出一条细长的白色水平线，副标题下方居中放置一个白色细线条菱形。采用温暖的情绪化调色，高对比度，写实细节，带有轻微的胶片颗粒感，深邃的透视线条，画面中无人，无额外标志，无水印。

templates.title: Lisbon Night View Travel Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 里斯本夜景旅行海报

templates.prompt: Create a night scene photo with a cinematic travel poster style to showcase {argument name="city name" default="Lisbon"} The scene depicts a steep, old European cobblestone street stretching into the distance, with gleaming tram tracks running through its center; narrow, historic buildings flank it, complete with wrought-iron balconies and shutters; warm amber streetlights illuminate the right side and the street itself, against a backdrop of a deep blue night sky and softly blurred mountaintop lights in the distance. The use of shallow depth of field and emotionally evocative bokeh, with the wet or glistening cobblestones reflecting the light, is masterful. Composition: 3:2 horizontal, the street curving from the lower right corner towards the center of the background, the right side bathed in warm light, the left side darker and more shadowy, with a slightly blurred background. An elegant overlay typography is added to the left half: a large white handwritten word.{argument name="main title" default="Lisbon"} Extending from the bottom left corner to the center; below it, two rows of widely spaced, gold-lined capital letters are arranged in the center, namely {argument name="subtitle line one" default="BEAUTIFUL NIGHTS"} and{argument name="subtitle line two" default="UNFORGETTABLE MEMORIES"} Below the subtitle, a thin, horizontal gold dividing line is added, adorned with a small, delicate gold four-petal decoration in the center. This conveys a high-end, luxurious travel brand feel, a romantic atmosphere, high contrast, warm gold highlights, and a realistic photographic style. The image contains no people, vehicles, additional text, or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影质感的旅行海报风格夜景照片，展示 {argument name="city name" default="里斯本"} 的场景。画面呈现一条陡峭的欧洲古老鹅卵石街道向远处延伸，中央铺设着闪亮的电车轨道；两侧是历史悠久的狭窄建筑，配有铁艺阳台和百叶窗；右侧及沿街散发着温暖的琥珀色路灯光芒，背景是深蓝色的夜空和远处柔和模糊的山顶灯光。使用浅景深和富有情绪感的焦外成像效果，湿润或光亮的鹅卵石路面反射着灯光。构图：横向 3:2，街道从右下角向背景中心弯曲，右侧光线温暖，左侧较暗且带有阴影，背景略微虚化。在左半部分添加优雅的叠加排版：一个巨大的白色手写体单词 {argument name="main title" default="Lisbon"} 从左下角延伸至中心；在其下方，居中排列两行间距较大的金色衬线大写字母，分别为 {argument name="subtitle line one" default="BEAUTIFUL NIGHTS"} 和 {argument name="subtitle line two" default="UNFORGETTABLE MEMORIES"}。在副标题下方，添加细长的金色水平分割线，中间点缀一个小巧的金色四瓣装饰。呈现高端奢华的旅行品牌质感，浪漫氛围，高对比度，温暖的金色高光，写实摄影风格，画面中无人物、无车辆、无额外文字、无水印。

templates.title: Paper texture sample grid

titleLocalized.zh: 纸张纹理样本网格

templates.prompt: Create a 16:9 paper texture collection contact sheet displaying 10 rectangular paper samples arranged in a neat 5-column, 2-row grid, filling the entire canvas with no gaps, borders, labels, or shadows. The canvas size should be [size missing].{argument name="canvas size" default="1792x1024"} Each sample is a tiled, top-down textured image with realistic matte paper texture, fine fibers, delicate speckles, and soft, uneven tones. Top row from left to right: 1) Bright white minimalist paper with an extremely fine texture; 2) Warm ivory recycled paper with small brown speckles; 3) Yellowish-brown kraft paper with a soft, mottled feel and natural pulp fibers; 4) Cool light gray paper with a smooth, delicate texture; 5) Off-white fiber handmade paper with visible cross-fibers and faint creases. Bottom row from left to right: 6) White rough watercolor paper with a distinct texture and fine, rough edges; 7) Clean, smooth white letter paper with almost invisible fibers; 8) Light beige parchment with aged spots and warm, uneven stains; 9) Medium cool gray paper with a cloud-like mottle and soft texture; 10) Dark charcoal black paper with visible fiber texture and low-contrast grain. Use natural soft lighting to reveal high-resolution macro texture details, realistic scanned paper surfaces, neutral color reproduction, and a minimalist design suitable for texture reference or design backgrounds. Avoid text, objects, hands, logos, watermarks, perspective distortion, seams outside the grid, and decorative elements.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个 16:9 的纸张纹理合集联络样张，展示 10 个矩形纸张样本，排列为整洁的 5 列 2 行网格，填满整个画面，无间隙、无边框、无标签、无阴影。画布尺寸应为 {argument name="canvas size" default="1792x1024"}。每个样本均为平铺的俯拍式纹理，具有写实的哑光纸张纹理、细微纤维、精细斑点和柔和的不均匀色调。顶行从左至右：1) 亮白极简纸张，纹理极细；2) 暖象牙色再生纸，带有细小褐色斑点；3) 黄褐色牛皮纸，带有柔和斑驳感和天然纸浆纤维；4) 冷浅灰色纸张，纹理平滑细腻；5) 米白色纤维手工纸，可见交叉纤维和淡淡折痕。底行从左至右：6) 白色粗糙水彩纸，具有明显的纹理感和细微的毛边质感；7) 洁净平滑的白色信纸，纤维几乎不可见；8) 浅米色羊皮纸，带有陈旧斑点和温暖的不均匀污渍；9) 中冷灰色纸张，带有云雾状斑驳和柔和纹理；10) 深炭黑色纸张，具有可见的纤维纹理和低对比度颗粒。使用自然柔光，呈现高分辨率微距纹理细节、写实的扫描纸张表面、中性色彩还原，以及适合纹理参考或设计背景的极简设计。避免出现文字、物体、手部、Logo、水印、透视畸变、网格外的接缝以及装饰性元素。

templates.title: Anime Girl in the Mirror Room

titleLocalized.zh: 镜面房间里的动漫少女

templates.prompt: Create a 9:16 vertical anime illustration, with the main character being {argument name="character name" default="A cute blonde anime girl"} She is in a room where every surface is a mirror: the floor, walls, and ceiling are all mirrored, reflecting her multiple images from behind, to the sides, above, and below. A dramatic wide-angle, low-angle perspective, close to the character, makes her legs and posture appear dynamic and slightly exaggerated due to the perspective effect. The character possesses {argument name="hair color" default="Long wavy blonde hair"} Bright blue eyes, a playful and cute expression, a single wink, light blush, and a gentle smile. She makes a heart shape with her hands in front of her chest while maintaining a cute balance, one leg bent and raised behind her. Clothing: A short white cable-knit sweater over a black top, high-waisted loose light blue jeans, paired with thick-soled white sneakers and a small bracelet. The mirrored room is filled with bright square mirror panels, seams, LED light strips along the edges, round bright bulbs, shimmering halos, and countless repeating reflections extending into the distance; including about 10 visible reflective copies or partial reflections around the protagonist, covering the full-body back view on the left and center, a fragment of the right side, the reflection of the ground under her feet, and the reflection of the ceiling above her head. Style: Exquisite modern Japanese anime key visual, highly detailed hair and clothing folds, luminous reflections, cool-toned blue-silver light and shadow, clean lines, glossy highlights, vibrant idol-like cuteness, no text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 9:16 的竖屏动漫插画，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="一位可爱的金发动漫少女"}，她正身处一个所有表面均为镜面的房间：地板、墙壁和天花板全是镜子，从后方、侧面、上方和下方映照出她的多个倒影。采用戏剧性的广角低机位视角，靠近角色，使她的双腿和姿势因透视效果显得动感且略带夸张。角色拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="长波浪金发"}、明亮的蓝色眼睛、俏皮可爱的表情、单眼眨眼、淡淡的腮红和浅浅的微笑。她双手在胸前比出一个爱心形状，同时保持着可爱的平衡姿势，一条腿向后弯曲抬起。服装：短款白色麻花针织毛衣，内搭黑色上衣，下身穿着高腰宽松浅蓝色牛仔裤，搭配厚底白色运动鞋和小巧手链。镜面房间布满了光亮的方形镜面面板、接缝、边缘的 LED 灯带、圆形明亮灯泡、闪烁的光晕，以及无数向远处延伸的重复倒影；包括主角周围约 10 个可见的反射副本或局部倒影，涵盖左侧和中央的全身背影、右侧的侧面碎片、脚下的地面反射以及头顶的天花板反射。风格：精致的现代日本动漫关键视觉图，高度细致的头发和衣物褶皱，发光的反射效果，冷色调的蓝银色光影，清晰的线条，光泽感高光，充满活力的偶像式可爱感，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Lisbon vintage tram travel poster

titleLocalized.zh: 里斯本复古电车旅行海报

templates.prompt: Create an emotionally resonant mobile-style travel photograph to showcase {argument name="city name" default="Lisbon"} A scene bathed in the warm afternoon sun. The image must accurately depict two vintage red and yellow trams parked side-by-side on the winding tracks of a busy European street. The tram on the left is cropped in the foreground, showing wooden window frames, a red side panel with a prominent Coca-Cola advertisement, a small route sign with "08" written on it, and passengers faintly visible through the reflected light in the windows. The tram on the right is positioned slightly behind, facing the viewer, with the number "56" marked near the roof. Its doors and windows are open, passengers are inside, and a beverage advertisement is printed on its lower red side panel. The background should include urban details such as parked cars, dense trees, bright building facades, hard shadows on the asphalt, and metal tracks, creating a candid street photography feel. High-contrast, cinematic color grading, deep blacks, golden highlights, realistic lens reflections, and a nostalgic travel poster atmosphere should be used. A large, centered white handwritten brush font should be overlaid on the lower center of the tram, containing the following text:{argument name="main title" default="Lisbon"} Below this is a smaller, elegant, all-caps serif subheading, the content of which is:{argument name="subtitle" default="Every corner tells a story"} Add thin, decorative horizontal lines around the subtitle and a small diamond embellishment below it. Maintain a 3:2 horizontal composition, aim for photorealistic results, retain slight imperfections reminiscent of a snapshot taken with a mobile phone, and avoid adding any extra text or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张充满情感的手机风格旅行摄影作品，展示 {argument name="city name" default="里斯本"} 在午后温暖阳光下的景象。画面中需精确呈现两辆复古红黄配色电车，并排停在繁忙欧洲街道的弯曲轨道上。左侧电车在前景处进行近景裁剪，可见木质窗框、带有明显可口可乐广告的红色侧板、写有“08”的小型路线牌，以及透过反光窗户隐约可见的乘客。右侧电车位置稍靠后，车头朝向观众，车顶附近标有数字“56”，车门和窗户敞开，车内有乘客，红色下侧板上印有饮料广告。背景需包含城市细节，如停放的汽车、茂密的树木、明亮的建筑立面、沥青路面上的硬阴影、金属轨道，并营造出一种抓拍的街头摄影感。应用高对比度的电影级调色、深邃的黑色、金色的高光、逼真的镜头反光，以及怀旧的旅行海报氛围。在电车中下部叠加居中的大型白色手写笔刷字体，内容为 {argument name="main title" default="里斯本"}，下方配以较小的优雅全大写衬线副标题，内容为 {argument name="subtitle" default="每一处角落都在诉说故事"}。在副标题周围添加细长的装饰性横线，并在下方点缀一个微小的菱形装饰。保持 3:2 的横向构图，追求照片级真实感，保留类似手机抓拍的轻微瑕疵，且不要添加任何额外的文字或水印。

templates.title: ChatGPT game asset generation screenshot

titleLocalized.zh: ChatGPT 游戏资产生成截图

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a realistic ChatGPT-style webpage screenshot showcasing the generated images of game assets, including Japanese UI text and four generated asset thumbnails. Canvas: Landscape browser/application screenshot, approximately 797×750 pixels, white background, minimalist interface, cropped to only show the assistant's reply area and the image row at the bottom. Layout: A rounded light gray user message bubble is placed at the top center, containing the following content:{argument name="user request text" default="Use ImageGen to individually generate four images that could be used as assets in a game, and then try turning each of them into a 3D model!"} Below this, aligned to the left, a line of small gray text appears in the status bar: "25m 50s 作业しました〉", followed by a thin horizontal dividing line. Below this, a Japanese assistant reply is created, containing a file list and blue clickable file links. The text content includes the assistant paragraph: "できました。4枚のゲーム向けアセット影像を生成して、それぞれPixal3DでGLB化まで通しました。". This is followed by the tag "影像:", followed by four list links with small image/file icons: 1) mana_crystal_alpha.png, 2) treasure_chest_alpha.png, 3) energy_turret_alpha.png, 4) mushroom_house_alpha.png. Next is the tag "3D-ified GLB:", followed by four list links with document icons: 1) mana_crystal.glb, 2) treasure_chest.glb, 3) energy_turret.glb, 4) mushroom_house.glb. Finally, the closing text is added: "Generated is a magical crystal, a treasure chest, an SF energy treasure chest, a home. The background is transparent and 3D-ified." The bottom image bar displays four rounded square thumbnail cards in a horizontal row, each approximately 178 x 178 pixels, with moderate spacing. Thumbnail 1 features a vibrant green chroma key background and stylized fantasy.{argument name="asset one" default="blue mana crystal obelisk on a dark stone base"} Thumbnail 2 features a vibrant green chroma key background and{argument name="asset two" default="wooden treasure chest with dark metal bands, gold lock, and red jewel"} Thumbnail 3 features a vibrant green chroma key background and{argument name="asset three" default="gray sci-fi energy turret with blue glowing core and cannon barrel"} Thumbnail 4 has a bright magenta chroma key background and{argument name="asset four" default="cute mushroom house with red spotted cap roof, wooden door, and warm windows"} All four assets are exquisitely crafted 3D game art icons, featuring transparent cutout lighting, centered, and displayed independently. Visual Style: Modern ChatGPT interface screenshots, Japanese font, black body text, blue link text, small monochrome icons, ample white space, and delicate dividing lines. Asset thumbnails should resemble high-quality mobile game items, rendered in a richly colored, semi-realistic 3D style. Constraints: A total of 8 file links are required, specifically 4 PNG links and 4 GLB links, plus 4 asset thumbnails. Do not add extra panels, watermarks, browser borders, avatars, or irrelevant UI controls.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个逼真的 ChatGPT 风格网页对话截图，展示游戏资产的图像生成结果，包含日文 UI 文本和四个生成的资产缩略图。

画布：横向浏览器/应用截图，尺寸约为 797×750 像素，白色背景，界面简洁极简，裁剪至仅显示助手回复区域和底部的图像行。

布局：在顶部居中位置，放置一个圆角浅灰色用户消息气泡，内容为 {argument name="user request text" default="image genでゲームで使えそうなアセットの画像を4枚を個別で生成して それぞれを3D化してみて！"}。在其下方左对齐处，显示一行灰色小字状态栏「25m 50s作業しました 〉」，后接一条细水平分割线。在此下方，创建一段日文助手回复，包含文件列表和蓝色可点击的文件链接。

文本内容：包含助手段落「できました。4枚のゲーム向けアセット画像を生成して、それぞれPixal3DでGLB化まで通しました。」。接着是标签「画像:」，后接 4 个带有小型图像/文件图标的列表链接：1) mana_crystal_alpha.png, 2) treasure_chest_alpha.png, 3) energy_turret_alpha.png, 4) mushroom_house_alpha.png。接着是标签「3D化したGLB:」，后接 4 个带有文档图标的列表链接：1) mana_crystal.glb, 2) treasure_chest.glb, 3) energy_turret.glb, 4) mushroom_house.glb。最后添加结束语「生成したのは、魔法クリスタル、宝箱、SFエネルギータレット、きのこ家です。背景はクロマキーから透明化して、3D化に渡しています。」

底部图像条：在水平行中显示 4 个圆角方形缩略图卡片，每个约 178×178 像素，间距适中。缩略图 1 具有鲜艳的绿色色度键背景和风格化的奇幻 {argument name="asset one" default="blue mana crystal obelisk on a dark stone base"}。缩略图 2 具有鲜艳的绿色色度键背景和 {argument name="asset two" default="wooden treasure chest with dark metal bands, gold lock, and red jewel"}。缩略图 3 具有鲜艳的绿色色度键背景和 {argument name="asset three" default="gray sci-fi energy turret with blue glowing core and cannon barrel"}。缩略图 4 具有明亮的洋红色色度键背景和 {argument name="asset four" default="cute mushroom house with red spotted cap roof, wooden door, and warm windows"}。所有 4 个资产均为精致的 3D 游戏美术图标，采用透明抠图风格的灯光，居中且独立显示。

视觉风格：现代 ChatGPT 界面截图，日文字体，黑色正文，蓝色链接文本，小型单色图标，留白充足，分割线细腻。资产缩略图应看起来像高质量的手机游戏道具，以色彩丰富的半写实 3D 风格渲染。

约束：总共包含 8 个文件链接，确切为 4 个 PNG 链接和 4 个 GLB 链接，以及 4 个资产缩略图。不要添加额外的面板、水印、浏览器边框、头像或不相关的 UI 控件。

templates.title: Anime idols in a mirrored room

titleLocalized.zh: 镜面房间里的动漫偶像

templates.prompt: Create a 9:16 vertical high-resolution anime idol illustration, with the main character being {argument name="character name" default="A cheerful blonde magical idol girl"} She strikes a cute pose in a room where the floor, walls, and ceiling are entirely covered in mirrors. The dramatic low-angle perspective and strong depth of field make the character appear very close to the viewer, while her reflection repeats itself in various directions against the background. The character possesses a flowing {argument name="hair color" default="Golden yellow"} Long, curly hair topped with a large, semi-transparent blue bow, and a shimmering blue and white stage costume. Costume details: precisely includes 8 main visible pieces—a large hair knot, a shimmering blue corset, a layered short pleated skirt with a semi-transparent overlay, two white gloves, two white knee-high boots, and a small waist knot. Pose: She stands on one leg, the other knee raised, one hand making a V-sign to the audience, the other pointing near her face in a playful idol pose. The face area is deliberately obscured with rectangular blocks of pure skin tone, while the rest of the illustration remains highly detailed. The mirrored room should display multiple reflections of the character from different angles, with repeating reflections visible behind and to the sides. The lighting is a bright, icy blue, magical, with countless star-like shimmers, lens flares, glitter particles, and crystalline highlights dancing at the seams of the mirrors. Visual style: Exquisite Japanese anime-style main visual, glossy idol card aesthetics, delicate lines, bright blue tones, shimmering fabric textures, intricate ruffles and bows, dynamic composition, ultra-detailed reflections, no text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 9:16 竖版高分辨率动漫偶像插画，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="一位开朗的金发魔法偶像少女"}，她正摆出可爱的姿势，身处一个地板、墙壁和天花板完全由镜面覆盖的房间中。使用戏剧性的低角度视角和强烈的广角景深，使角色看起来离观众很近，同时她的倒影在背景的各个方向不断重复。角色拥有飘逸的 {argument name="hair color" default="金黄色"} 长发，发梢卷曲，头顶配有一个巨大的半透明蓝色蝴蝶结，身穿闪耀的蓝白色舞台服装。服装细节：精确包含 8 个主要可见部件——1 个大发结、1 个闪亮的蓝色紧身胸衣、1 条带有半透明罩裙的层叠短褶裙、2 只白手套、2 只白色及膝靴和 1 个小腰结。姿势：她单腿站立，另一膝抬起，一只手向观众比出 V 字手势，另一只手指向脸部附近，做出俏皮的偶像动作。脸部区域故意用纯肤色的矩形色块遮盖，而插画的其余部分保持高度细节化。镜面房间应展示出该角色从不同角度产生的多个倒影，在她身后和两侧可见重复的镜像。灯光为明亮的冰蓝色，充满魔法感，无数星光般的闪烁、镜头光晕、闪粉颗粒和晶莹的高光在镜面接缝处跳跃。视觉风格：精致的日式动漫主视觉图，光泽感偶像卡牌美学，细腻的线条，明亮的蓝色调，闪烁的织物纹理，复杂的褶边和蝴蝶结，动态构图，超细节反射，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Soft anime celebration glass jar visual

titleLocalized.zh: 柔和动漫庆典玻璃罐视觉图

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a 2:3 vertical commemorative fantasy character visual, incorporating cute character elements and presenting a refined anime-themed celebratory illustration style. Canvas: 2:3 vertical composition, a bright, soft blue sky with white clouds, shimmering light effects, glass-like reflections, and delicate lace and crystal borders around the edges. Subject: The center of the image is a petite anime girl sitting on a giant, transparent, multifaceted glass jar. Her face is deliberately obscured by a centrally located light purple square block. She possesses extremely long, flowing {argument name="hair color" default="Silver-white with a light blue tint"} Hair styled in pigtails or long sideburns, adorned with blue plaid ribbons, small blue flowers, pearls, and strawberry accessories. The pose is frontal, legs hanging naturally, hands resting lightly at the sides, elegant as a doll. Clothing: A gorgeous, sweet Lolita dress in a color scheme of {argument name="image color palette" default="Sky blue, white, light pink, translucent colors, and strawberry red."} The outfit includes puff sleeves, layered ruffles, lace trim, blue plaid patchwork, small bows, pearl chains, berry and flower embroidery, a belted top, and a short, multi-tiered skirt. It is paired with white over-the-knee socks (adorned with blue bows) and platform Mary Jane shoes decorated with strawberries, flowers, pearls, and blue ribbons. The core prop: The girl sits on a giant, clear glass candy jar, with a thick lid rim beneath her skirt and a multifaceted base. Inside the jar are numerous miniature concept objects: blue and white flowers, strawberries, pearls, small ribbons, crystal shards, miniature teacups or cake-shaped decorations, heart-shaped pendants, and soft-toned candies. A gorgeous gold and blue heart-shaped gemstone brooch sits on the front of the jar. Balloons: There are exactly 12 visible balloons behind and around the character: 2 pink heart-shaped balloons, 2 blue heart-shaped balloons, 4 round blue balloons, and 4 clear, iridescent round balloons filled with miniature strawberries, flowers, and confetti. Tie them with thin string and blue ribbons, making them wrap around the girl like a celebratory bouquet. Surrounding items: Add exactly eight main decorative gift/display items around the base: a blue and white wrapped gift box at the bottom left, a crystal perfume bottle-shaped ornament at the bottom left, a multifaceted blue heart-shaped crystal ornament at the far left, and a gift tag hanging from the jar that reads {argument name="gift tag text" default="Present for you"} A gorgeous strawberry illustration frame in the lower right corner, a blue glass bottle or small medicine bottle in the far right corner, a small envelope/card with a strawberry pattern in the lower right corner, and a scattered strawberry at the bottom edge. Pearls, small flowers, lace paper, and tiny gems are scattered on the reflective ground. Style: Highly detailed Japanese anime illustration, dreamy girl aesthetics, soft watercolor-like rendering, transparent glass effect, iridescent highlights, fine lines, shimmering light, and delicate lace, ribbons, pearls, and crystal decorations. The atmosphere should be {argument name="mood" default="Sweet, celebratory, ethereal and precious"} Text: Retain the visible English label text "Present for you," using an elegant cursive script. A subtle decorative handwritten font is optional on the left.{argument name="small signature text" default="Dream Garden"} Avoid adding any other readable text. Constraints: 2:3 vertical aspect ratio, centered symmetrical composition, no dark colors, no modern UI elements, non-realistic style, no extra characters, keep the face covered by simple square blocks, and ensure all accessories are associated with strawberries, blue flowers, glass crystals, gifts, and ribbons.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张 2:3 竖版纪念风奇幻角色视觉图，融入可爱的角色元素，呈现出精致的动漫周边庆典插画风格。

画布：2:3 竖构图，明亮的柔和蓝天配以洁白云朵，带有闪烁的光效、玻璃质感的反射，四周边缘饰有精致的蕾丝与水晶边框。

主体：画面中心是一位坐在巨大透明多面玻璃罐上的娇小动漫少女。她的面部被一个居中的淡紫色方形遮挡块刻意遮盖。她拥有极长的飘逸 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色带淡蓝色调"} 头发，梳成双马尾或长侧发造型，装饰着蓝色格纹丝带、小蓝花、珍珠和草莓饰品。姿态为正面，双腿自然下垂，双手轻放在身体两侧，优雅如玩偶。

服装：华丽的甜美洛丽塔裙装，配色为 {argument name="image color palette" default="天蓝色、白色、淡粉色、晶莹剔透色和草莓红"}。包含泡泡袖、层叠荷叶边、蕾丝花边、蓝色格纹拼接、小蝴蝶结、珍珠链、浆果与花朵刺绣、束腰式上衣以及短款多层裙摆。搭配白色过膝袜（饰有蓝色蝴蝶结）和装饰着草莓、花朵、珍珠及蓝色丝带的厚底玛丽珍鞋。

核心道具：少女坐在一个巨大的透明玻璃糖果罐上，裙下是厚实的罐盖边缘，底座呈多面体。罐内展示许多微型概念物件：蓝白花朵、草莓、珍珠、小丝带、水晶碎片、小型茶杯或蛋糕状装饰、心形挂件以及柔和色调的糖果。罐子正面放置一枚华丽的金蓝色心形宝石胸针。

气球：在角色后方及周围包含正好 12 个可见气球：2 个粉色心形气球、2 个蓝色心形气球、4 个圆形蓝色气球，以及 4 个装有微型草莓、花朵和五彩纸屑的透明虹彩圆形气球。用细绳和蓝色蝴蝶结系住，使它们像庆典花束一样环绕在少女周围。

周边物件：在底座周围添加正好 8 个主要的装饰性礼物/展示物件：左下方 1 个蓝白包装礼盒，左下方 1 个水晶香水瓶状装饰，最左下方 1 个多面蓝色心形水晶装饰，罐子上悬挂的礼物标签写着 {argument name="gift tag text" default="Present for you"}，右下方 1 个华丽的草莓插画相框，最右下方 1 个蓝色玻璃瓶或小药瓶，右下方 1 个带有草莓图案的小信封/卡片，以及底部边缘 1 颗散落的草莓。在反光的地面上散落珍珠、小花、蕾丝纸和微小宝石。

风格：极具细节的日本动漫插画，梦幻少女美学，水彩般的柔和渲染，透明玻璃效果，虹彩高光，精细线条，发光闪烁，精致蕾丝、丝带、珍珠和水晶装饰。氛围应为 {argument name="mood" default="甜美、庆典感、空灵且珍贵"}。

文字：保留可见的英文标签文字“Present for you”，使用优雅的连体草书。左侧可选的淡装饰性手写字可为 {argument name="small signature text" default="Dream Garden"}。避免添加任何其他可读文字。

约束：2:3 竖版比例，居中对称构图，无深色，无现代 UI 元素，非写实风格，无额外角色，保持面部被简单的方形块遮盖，并确保所有配饰都与草莓、蓝花、玻璃水晶、礼物和丝带相关联。

templates.title: Hanbok Fashion Triptych

titleLocalized.zh: 韩服时尚三联画

templates.prompt: Create a realistic fashion triptych depicting three full-body frontal portraits of female models dressed in traditional Korean court hanbok, separated by two clean, vertical white dividing lines. The canvas is a 1:1 square, shot at eye level, with symmetrical spacing, each model centered on their respective vertical panel. The background for all three panels is the same soft-focused court courtyard: deep red wooden doors, soft architectural details, grey stone ground, shallow depth of field, and overcast natural light, creating a refined museum catalog style. All faces should be smoothly blurred to conceal features while maintaining clear details of hair, headdresses, clothing, hands, and poses. Number and details of models: 3 models in total. Left model: Wearing a light pink jeogori with a wide-sleeved long robe, a pale purple belt, and a light blue petticoat adorned with delicate white floral embroidery at the hem; hands clasped at the waist; black hair in a bun, decorated with ornate gold floral ornaments on the sides and top. Center Model: Wears a deep navy blue embroidered outer robe with wide sleeves, white cuffs, a red petticoat, and a richly textured red and blue belt. The cuffs and hem are adorned with gold floral embroidery. Hands are clasped, and her black hair is styled in an updo with a gold hair ornament at the top center. Right Model: Wears a light mint green outer robe with wide sleeves, a red front panel, light blue cuffs and sashes, a red patterned belt, and a red hem and trim decorated with floral embroidery. Hands are clasped, and her black hair is styled in an updo with a crown and multiple gold hair ornaments on either side. Visual Style: Photorealistic high-fashion historical costume photography, with ultra-fine fabric textures, satin and brocade sheens, intricate embroidery, balanced soft lighting, soft colors, realistic proportions, and elegant, upright posture. The composition remains formal and symmetrical, with no text, watermarks, extra figures, props, or modern objects.{argument name="number of outfits" default="3"} A coordinated hanbok outfit, with a main color scheme emphasizing {argument name="left outfit color" default="Soft pink and light purple"} ,{argument name="center outfit color" default="Deep navy blue and deep red"} as well as{argument name="right outfit color" default="Light mint green and red"} Set the scene as{argument name="background location" default="Blurry Korean palace courtyard"} .

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一幅写实的时尚三联画，展示 3 位身着传统韩国宫廷韩服的女性模特全身正面照，由两条干净的垂直白色分隔线隔开。画布为 1:1 正方形构图，以平视角度拍摄，间距对称，每位模特均位于各自垂直面板的中心。三幅面板的背景均为同一处柔焦处理的宫廷庭院：深红色木门、柔和的建筑细节、灰色石地、浅景深、阴天自然光，呈现出精致的博物馆图录风格。所有面部应进行平滑的模糊处理以隐去特征，同时保持头发、头饰、服装、双手和姿态的清晰细节。

模特数量及细节：共 3 位模特。左侧模特：浅粉色赤古里（jeogori）搭配宽袖长外袍，淡紫色腰带，浅蓝色衬裙，下摆饰有精致的白色花卉刺绣，双手交叠于腰间，黑色盘发，两侧及顶部饰有华丽的金色花卉发饰。中间模特：深海军蓝刺绣外袍，宽袖，白色袖衬，红色衬裙，纹理丰富的红蓝腰带，袖口及下摆前襟饰有金色花卉刺绣，双手交叠，黑色盘发，顶部中心饰有金色发饰。右侧模特：浅薄荷绿外袍，宽袖，红色前裙片，浅蓝色袖衬及垂带，红色花纹腰带，红色下摆及袍边饰有花卉刺绣，双手交叠，黑色盘发，发冠及两侧饰有多个金色发饰。

视觉风格：照片级逼真的高级时装历史服饰摄影，超精细的面料质感，缎面与锦缎光泽，复杂的刺绣，平衡的柔光，柔和的色彩，逼真的比例，优雅挺拔的姿态。保持构图正式且对称，无文字，无水印，无额外人物，无道具，无现代物品。使用 {argument name="number of outfits" default="3"} 套协调的韩服造型，主色调强调 {argument name="left outfit color" default="柔粉色与淡紫色"}、{argument name="center outfit color" default="深海军蓝与深红色"} 以及 {argument name="right outfit color" default="浅薄荷绿与红色"}。设置场景为 {argument name="background location" default="模糊的韩国宫廷庭院"}。

templates.title: Portraits of five Hanfu-clad noblewomen

titleLocalized.zh: 五位汉服贵族女子肖像

templates.prompt: Create a refined, cinematic group portrait featuring five young noblewomen dressed in traditional Chinese Hanfu, standing in a shallow V-shape, with the woman in the center slightly forward and the tallest. Their faces should be deliberately anonymized using a soft rectangular skin-tone blur mask, while preserving rich details in their clothing and hairstyles. Each woman wears an elegant layered Hanfu, featuring wide, flowing sleeves, beige and ivory outer robes, blue-green skirts, soft coral-red belts, and exquisite floral embroidery; the collection includes five distinctive outfits: the woman on the left wears an ivory outer robe with a blue-green skirt and coral belt; the second woman wears a light blue outer robe with a beige bodice and red skirt embellishments; the middle woman wears the most magnificent ivory outer robe with peach-colored floral trim, layered in blue-green and coral; the fourth woman, partially at the back, wears a blue-green upper robe with an ivory collar and orange belt; the woman on the right wears an ivory outer robe with a dark blue-green and rust-red skirt, adorned with extensive floral embroidery. Her hairstyle is a traditional high black bun with long, straight hair, ornate gold ornaments, flower hairpins, pendant decorations, and small white flowers. The background is set indoors, with soft blue-green walls, dark wood architectural details on the right, and a hazy, pale pink cherry blossom accent in the upper corner. It employs warm, diffused studio lighting, soft shadows, shallow depth of field, realistic fabric textures, delicate embroidery details, a serene and ceremonial atmosphere, symmetrical composition, full-body to three-quarter shots, and a painterly realism style. There is no text or watermark. Overall color tone:{argument name="color palette" default="Ivory white, blue-green, coral, rust red, soft pink, warm gold"} Main clothing styles:{argument name="traditional clothing style" default="Chinese Hanfu"} . Number of women:{argument name="number of women" default="Five"} Background setting:{argument name="background setting" default="An elegant blue-green interior palace backdrop, adorned with cherry blossoms."} Facial treatment:{argument name="face treatment" default="The face is anonymized using a soft rectangular blur mask."} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张精致的电影感群像，画面中恰好有五位年轻贵族女子，身着传统中国汉服，呈浅 V 字形站立，中间的女子略微靠前且最高。她们的面部应通过柔和的矩形肤色模糊遮罩进行刻意匿名处理，同时保留服装和发型的丰富细节。每位女子身着优雅的叠层汉服，配有宽大的飘逸袖口、米色和象牙白外袍、蓝绿色裙摆、柔和的珊瑚红腰带以及精致的花卉刺绣；包含五套各具特色的服装：左侧女子身着象牙白外袍配蓝绿色裙摆和珊瑚色腰带；第二位女子身着淡水蓝色外袍，配米色胸前拼接和红色裙摆装饰；中间女子身着最华丽的象牙白外袍，配桃色花卉边饰，内搭蓝绿色和珊瑚色叠层；第四位女子部分位于后方，身着蓝绿色上袍，配象牙白领口和橙色腰带；右侧女子身着象牙白外袍，内搭深蓝绿色和铁锈红裙摆，带有大面积花卉刺绣。发型设计为传统的黑色高发髻，带有长直发束、华丽的金饰与花朵发簪、垂坠饰品及小白花。背景设定在室内，墙面为柔和的蓝绿色，右侧带有深色木质建筑细节，上方角落由模糊的淡粉色樱花点缀。采用温暖的漫射摄影棚光效，柔和阴影，浅景深，逼真的织物纹理，精致的刺绣细节，宁静的仪式感氛围，对称构图，全身至四分之三取景，绘画级写实风格，无文字，无水印。整体色调：{argument name="color palette" default="象牙白、蓝绿色、珊瑚色、铁锈红、柔粉色、暖金色"}。主要服装风格：{argument name="traditional clothing style" default="中国汉服"}。女子人数：{argument name="number of women" default="五位"}。背景设定：{argument name="background setting" default="优雅的蓝绿色室内宫廷背景，点缀樱花"}。面部处理：{argument name="face treatment" default="面部采用柔和的矩形模糊遮罩进行匿名处理"}。

templates.prompt: Create a realistic fashion comparison painting depicting three young East Asian women standing side-by-side, each dressed in elegant traditional Hanfu-style clothing, layered robes, and floral embroidery. Use a 1:1 square canvas. The three figures are evenly distributed in a triptych composition, all facing forward, with their hands lightly folded at their waists, their feet exposed, their postures dignified and composed, their faces blurred. Include three sets of clothing: the left figure wears a warm ivory-colored wide-sleeved robe with a white embroidered collar, a light beige floral skirt, and blue-and-white porcelain patterns at the hem; the middle figure wears a light pinkish-blue wide-sleeved robe with a white embroidered collar, a beige skirt with delicate floral branches and horizontal trim, and small accessories hanging at the waist; the right figure wears a cream-colored wide-sleeved robe with an embroidered collar, a grayish-pink pleated floral skirt, and blue-and-white porcelain patterns at the hem. All three have neat black hair parted in the middle and styled in a traditional updo, adorned with floral hairpins and dangling earrings. Background: Outdoor courtyard environment with shallow depth of field; soft greenery on the left and center, a dark reddish-brown wall on the right, and a gray flagstone path at the foot. The lighting is natural, soft, and even, showcasing realistic fabric textures, embroidery details, delicate folds, and soft macaron tones, achieving a fashionable catalog photography feel. The image is kept clean, with no text, watermarks, or irrelevant figures; props are limited to clothing and hair accessories.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实的时尚对比图，展示三位年轻东亚女性全身并排站立，每人身着优雅的传统汉服风格服饰，搭配层叠长袍与花卉刺绣。使用 1:1 正方形画布。三个人物以三联画构图均匀分布，均面向前方，双手轻叠于腰间，露出双脚，姿态端庄沉稳，面部模糊处理。需包含 3 套服饰：左侧服饰为暖象牙色大袖外袍，白色刺绣领口，淡米色花卉裙，裙摆处饰有青花纹样；中间服饰为淡粉蓝色大袖外袍，白色刺绣领口，米色裙装配以精致花枝与横向饰边，腰间悬挂小巧配饰；右侧服饰为奶白色大袖外袍，刺绣领口，灰粉色褶皱花卉裙，裙摆处饰有青花纹样。三人均为整洁的黑色中分盘发，配有传统发髻、花卉发簪及垂坠耳环。背景：户外庭院环境，浅景深；左侧与中间背景为柔和的绿植，右侧为深红褐色墙面，脚下为灰色石板路。光线自然、柔和且均匀，呈现真实的织物纹理、刺绣细节、细腻褶皱、柔和的马卡龙色调，具备时尚目录摄影质感。保持画面整洁，无文字、无水印、无无关人物，除服饰与发饰外无其他道具。

templates.title: Dark Raven Armor Anime Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 暗鸦铠甲动漫肖像

templates.prompt: for{argument name="character name" default="PONYO"} Create a vertical, dark fantasy anime-style key visual portrait. The composition features a tight close-up of the face of a gender-neutral young warrior, partially concealed beneath a magnificent raven-style metal helmet and feathered armor. The character possesses pale, warm skin, with tousled black hair cascading down his cheeks. A pair of amber-brown eyes peek out from beneath the helmet, gazing directly at the viewer. The armor should exhibit the texture of layered bird feathers and sculpted bronze-gold metal plates, with worn, painted textures, sharp, claw-like outlines, and a prominent red glowing gem or mechanical bird eye set in the upper right corner of the helmet. Two striking raven beak motifs are incorporated into the image: a long, curved beak extending downwards along the right side of the face, and a smaller beak-like structure spanning the lower foreground near the mouth. The lighting and shadows are highly cinematic: a black background, deep shadows, lava-orange rim lighting, shimmering golden highlights on the feathered plates, and subtle ember-like reflections, creating a high-contrast interplay of light and shadow. The style should be a detailed, anime-style illustration with conceptual art quality, a melancholic, elegant, and ominous atmosphere, and a color palette of warm bronze, amber, black, and red. Add [something] at the bottom center.{argument name="title text" default="PONYO"} The title text uses a large, glowing, light gold Gothic fantasy font with sharp vertical strokes, integrated into the image without borders or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 为 {argument name="character name" default="PONYO"} 创建一张竖版暗黑奇幻动漫主视觉肖像。构图采用一位中性化年轻战士面部的紧凑特写，面部部分隐藏在华丽的乌鸦风格金属头盔和羽毛状铠甲之下。角色拥有苍白温暖的皮肤，凌乱的黑色发丝垂落在脸颊上，头盔下露出一双琥珀棕色的双眼，正凝视着观众。铠甲应呈现出层叠的鸟羽和雕刻的青铜金金属板质感，带有磨损的绘画纹理、锋利的爪状轮廓，并在头盔右上方镶嵌一颗显眼的红色发光宝石或机械鸟眼。画面中包含两个显著的乌鸦喙造型：一个长而弯曲的喙沿脸部右侧向下延伸，另一个较小的喙状结构横跨在靠近嘴部的下方前景。光影效果极具电影感：黑色背景，深邃阴影，熔岩橙色的轮廓光，羽毛板上闪烁着金色高光，点缀着微小的余烬状反射，呈现出高对比度的明暗对照法。风格应为细节丰富的绘画风动漫插画，具备概念艺术品质，氛围忧郁、优雅且不祥，色调采用温暖的青铜色、琥珀色、黑色和红色。在底部中心位置，添加 {argument name="title text" default="PONYO"} 的标题文字，使用带有锋利竖向笔触的大号发光浅金色哥特奇幻字体，将其融入图像中，且不带边框或水印。

templates.title: Surreal 404 Renaissance Collage

titleLocalized.zh: 超现实 404 文艺复兴拼贴画

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a 3:2 horizontal surrealist Renaissance collage poster themed around the number 404 void, combining ancient book design, classical sculpture, cyberpunk ruins, and outdated computer UI. Canvas: A near-square 3:2 edit poster composition with a background of worn beige parchment stained with stains, fibers, faint grid lines, registration marks, fine drafting lines, and tiny technical annotations. The bottom edge is torn, revealing a dark error code/static image underneath. Subject: A massive reclining Renaissance marble male statue, like a fallen classical deity or philosopher, occupies two-thirds of the image diagonally from the lower left to the upper right. The stone body is cracked and eroded in many places, revealing dense gold-black circuitry, server components, mechanical ribs, and electronic components inside. Thick, dark gray cables coil like vines around and run through the statue's torso, shoulders, arms, and legs. Heavy industrial metal supports and rails are added to the figure, featuring small triangular markers and embedded panels. The statue's head tilts to the upper right, its eyes closed or lifeless, with a weathered, curly beard and hair. Background and Symbols: A large, soft, burnt orange-red sun disk is placed behind the statue's head and upper torso, slightly to the right of center. Scattered across the upper half of the poster are 44 small black hourglass icons of varying sizes and transparency, with several larger hourglass symbols in the upper right corner and near the top center. Behind the figure is a silhouette of a distant, horizontally extending, broken stone wall or ruined fortress. Typography and Left Panel: In the upper left, a large, elegant serif title is placed in a tall, thin Renaissance editorial font: "SCROLLING INTO THE VOID," stacked in four lines, with "VOID" in a soft rust red and the rest in dark charcoal gray. Small technical labels such as "FIG. 7," "MEMENTO MORI," and "SYSTEM FAILURE," along with faint Latin-like filled text, are added around it. Below the title, create a slender vertical index with three numbered entries, labeled 01, 02, and 03, each with tiny, unreadable pseudo-academic notes. Add delicate compasses, measuring lines, and chart lines to the left and center background. Error UI Details: Above the cables and statue in the lower right corner, place a small retro Windows-style dialog box with a blue title bar displaying "System Error." The dialog message should read: "The universe has encountered a fatal error. Reality cannot continue." It includes a centered gray button labeled "OK." Visual Style: A hyper-refined surreal collage, a fusion of Neo-Renaissance engraving and cyberpunk archaeology, a blend of photorealistic textures and retro typographic design, soft sepia tones paired with charcoal black, stone gray, and oxidized gold circuitry, and a single rust red accent. Utilize dramatic yet soft museum lighting, crisp details, layered paper textures, and high-end editorial poster compositions. Constraints: Maintain a spacious and horizontal composition with strong negative space in the upper left; avoid using modern, glossy sci-fi neon lights, except for a subtle glitch color at the bottom tear edge; no additional figures; no watermark; retain precise main title text.{argument name="headline text" default="SCROLLING INTO THE VOID"} The color of the red sun{argument name="sun color" default="muted burnt-orange red"} Statue body{argument name="statue subject" default="reclining bearded Renaissance marble god"} Error message{argument name="error message" default="The universe has encountered a fatal error. Reality cannot continue."} and poster material{argument name="poster material" default="aged beige parchment paper"} .

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张 3:2 横向超现实主义文艺复兴拼贴海报，主题为数字 404 虚空，结合古籍设计、古典雕塑、赛博朋克废墟和过时的计算机 UI。

画布：接近正方形的 3:2 编辑海报构图，背景为带有污渍、纤维、微弱网格线、套准标记、细制图导线和微小技术注释的陈旧米色羊皮纸，底部边缘呈现撕裂状，露出下方的一条深色故障代码/静态图像。

主体：一尊巨大的斜倚文艺复兴大理石男性雕像，如同倒下的古典神祇或哲学家，从左下角向右上角斜向占据图像的三分之二。石质躯体多处破裂、侵蚀，露出内部密集的金黑色电路、服务器项目、机械肋骨和电子元件。粗壮的黑灰色电缆像藤蔓一样缠绕并穿过雕像的躯干、肩膀、手臂和腿部。在人物身上加上厚重的工业金属支架和导轨，并带有小型三角形标记和嵌入式面板。雕像头部向右上角倾斜，双眼紧闭或毫无生气，留着饱经风霜的卷曲胡须和头发。

背景与符号：在雕像头部和上躯干后方放置一个巨大的柔和焦橙红色太阳圆盘，位于中心偏右位置。在海报上半部分散布 44 个黑色小沙漏图标，大小和透明度各异，右上角和上方中心附近有几个较大的沙漏符号。在人物后方，包含一道横向延伸的遥远破碎石墙或废墟堡垒剪影。

排版与左侧面板：在左上方，设置一个大型精致的衬线标题，采用高瘦的文艺复兴编辑字体：“SCROLLING INTO THE VOID”，分四行堆叠，“VOID”为柔和的铁锈红，其他文字为深炭灰色。在其周围添加微小的技术标签，如“FIG. 7”、“MEMENTO MORI”、“SYSTEM FAILURE”以及微弱的类拉丁语填充文本。在标题下方，创建一个细长的垂直索引，包含 3 个编号条目，分别标记为 01、02 和 03，每个条目带有微小的不可读伪学术注释。在左侧和中心背景中添加精致的圆规、测量线和图表线。

错误 UI 细节：在右下方的电缆和雕像上方，放置一个小型复古 Windows 风格对话框，蓝色标题栏显示“System Error”。对话框消息应为：“The universe has encountered a fatal error. Reality cannot continue.” 包含一个居中的灰色按钮，标记为“OK”。

视觉风格：超精细超现实拼贴，新文艺复兴雕版印刷与赛博朋克考古学的结合，照片级真实纹理与复古印刷设计的融合，柔和的棕褐色调搭配炭黑色、石灰色、氧化金电路，以及单一的铁锈红点缀。使用戏剧性但柔和的博物馆式灯光、清晰的细节、分层纸张纹理和高端编辑海报构图。

约束：保持构图宽敞且呈横向，左上方留有强烈的负空间；除底部撕裂边缘处微弱的故障色彩外，不使用现代光泽感的科幻霓虹灯；没有额外人物；没有水印；保留精确的主标题文本 {argument name="headline text" default="SCROLLING INTO THE VOID"}、红色太阳颜色 {argument name="sun color" default="muted burnt-orange red"}、雕像主体 {argument name="statue subject" default="reclining bearded Renaissance marble god"}、错误消息 {argument name="error message" default="The universe has encountered a fatal error. Reality cannot continue."} 以及海报材质 {argument name="poster material" default="aged beige parchment paper"}。

templates.title: Surreal 404 Renaissance Memory Collage

titleLocalized.zh: 超现实 404 文艺复兴记忆拼贴

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a surreal Renaissance-style 404 collage poster about the loss of digital memory, combining ancient architecture, retro calculations, anatomical diagrams, and decadent editorial layout. Canvas: 1:1 square composition, aged beige paper background with torn paper collage edges, halftone stains, fine grid lines, blueprint overprinting marks, and archival print texture. Use a soft palette of warm parchment beige, charcoal black, concrete gray, rust red, and faded blue. Subject: A magnificent classical temple resembling the Parthenon occupies the center and lower half, presented from a three-quarter perspective. It has long colonnades with 16 clearly visible white stone columns. The structure is cracked and partially collapsed, revealing dense server racks, circuit boards, cables, and exposed wires inside the ruins. Large slabs of plaster and stones are missing, with jagged edges. Key Surreal Object: A huge black 3.5-inch floppy disk strikes the right foreground at a diagonal angle, half-buried in broken concrete, sending up a violent scattering of debris. The floppy disk has a light-colored rectangular label area and a visible side ridge. Text and typography: A large, editable serif heading is placed in the upper left corner, containing the text "{argument name="headline text" default="MEMORIES SAVED, SOULS DELETED"} The text is in rust red, with "SAVED" and "DELETED" in dark charcoal gray. Above this, add small technical text: "FIG. 01" and "HUMAN MEMORY ARCHITECTURE (FRAGMENTED)". Below the title, add small typewriter-style text: "THE PAST IS PRESERVED. THE SELF IS LOST." and "ARCHIVE PROTOCOL_404 VERSION: 7.1.9". Maintain an elegant, old-fashioned scientific feel with slight misalignment. Illustration details: Include two precise anatomical brain illustrations in the upper right corner: a large floating brain labeled like a scientific board, and a smaller circular cross-section of the brain below. Add three precise circular technical diagrams around the poster: a large light-colored circle near the top left, a crosshair circle labeled "BRAIN SECTION_017" in the center, and a small circle near the left pillar. Add fine measurement lines, tiny numbers, plus signs, and red calibration marks throughout the image. Foreground Details: Place a small, retro Windows-style error dialog box near the bottom center. It should have a blue title bar displaying "System Error," a red X error icon, the text "Critical Failure. Memory cannot be saved. Continue?", and a button labeled "OK". Style: Hyper-refined photomontage, surreal 404 error Renaissance collage, a combination of archaeological ruins and cybernetic archives, simulated computer nostalgia, Brutalist marble dust, museum graphic layout, screen printing grain, torn paper layers, precise yet decadent graphic design. No characters, no modern minimalist UI except for the single error dialog box, no additional title text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张关于数字记忆丢失的超现实文艺复兴风格 404 拼贴海报，结合古代建筑、复古计算、解剖图解以及颓废的编辑排版。

画布：1:1 正方形构图，做旧米色纸张背景，带有撕纸拼贴边缘、半色调污渍、精细网格线、蓝图套准标记和档案印刷质感。使用温暖的羊皮纸米色、炭黑色、混凝土灰、铁锈红和褪色蓝组成的柔和色调。

主体：一座类似帕特农神庙的宏伟古典神庙占据中心和下半部分，以四分之三视角呈现。它拥有长长的柱廊，清晰可见 16 根白色石柱。建筑结构开裂并部分坍塌，废墟内部露出密集的服务器机架、电路板、线缆和裸露的线路。大块石膏和石块缺失，边缘参差不齐。

关键超现实物体：一张巨大的黑色 3.5 英寸软盘以对角线角度撞击右侧前景，半埋在破碎的混凝土中，激起剧烈的碎片飞溅。软盘有一个浅色的矩形标签区域和可见的侧脊。

文字与排版：在左上角设置一个大型编辑衬线标题，内容为“{argument name="headline text" default="MEMORIES SAVED, SOULS DELETED"}”，其中“SAVED,”和“DELETED”为铁锈红色，其余部分为深炭灰色。在其上方添加小型技术文本，内容为“FIG. 01”和“HUMAN MEMORY ARCHITECTURE (FRAGMENTED)”。在标题下方，添加小型打字机风格的行文，内容为“THE PAST IS PRESERVED. THE SELF IS LOST.”和“ARCHIVE PROTOCOL_404 VERSION: 7.1.9”。保持排版优雅、具有古老的科学感，并略微错位。

图解细节：在右上角包含 2 幅精确的解剖大脑插图：一个像科学图版一样标注的大型浮动大脑，以及下方一个较小的圆形大脑横截面图。在海报周围添加 3 个精确的圆形技术图解：顶部中左侧附近有一个巨大的浅色圆圈，中心有一个标注为“BRAIN SECTION_017”的十字准线圆圈，左侧柱子附近有一个小圆圈。在整个画面中添加细测量线、微小数字、加号和红色校准标记。

前景细节：在底部中心附近放置 1 个小型复古 Windows 风格错误对话框。它应具有一个蓝色标题栏，显示“System Error”，一个红色 X 错误图标，正文显示“Critical Failure. Memory cannot be saved. Continue?”，以及一个标注为“OK”的按钮。

风格：超精细照片蒙太奇，超现实 404 错误文艺复兴拼贴，考古废墟与控制论档案的结合，模拟计算机怀旧感，粗野主义大理石粉尘，博物馆图版布局，丝网印刷颗粒，撕纸层，精准但颓废的平面设计。无人物，除单个错误对话框外无现代简洁 UI，无额外标题文字，无水印。

templates.title: Mass-produced realistic collages

titleLocalized.zh: 批量生产的真实感拼贴画

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a surreal industrial-renaissance style collage poster, titled "{argument name="headline text" default="MASS PRODUCED AUTHENTICITY"} This work blends classical sculptures, factory machinery, architectural blueprints, and outdated computer error images to create a critical art print. Canvas: A square poster, 1:1 aspect ratio, with a stained, worn beige paper background featuring blurred grid lines, registration marks, technical drawing annotations, and a worn archival print texture. It uses soft tones of stone gray, grey-beige, charcoal black, rust orange, faded red, and a touch of Windows-95 blue. Layout: The main typography is located in the upper left corner: a small technical label reading “SERIES: MPA_001” and “DATE: 05.19.95”, below which is a large, elegant serif font “MASS PRODUCED” (dark gray), and below that, a tall, compressed, and worn red-orange font “AUTHENTICITY”. The left side also includes a small diagrammatic box that reads "THE ASSEMBLY LINE OF IDENTITY STANDARDIZED, REPLICATED, EMPTY." followed by "FIG. 07A" and "DAVID PRODUCTION UNIT SCHEMATIC." The upper right quadrant contains a detailed circular engineering blueprint with measurements and labels "SECTION AA" and "SCALE 1:10." The lower left corner contains a small conveyor belt plan, labeled like a technical manufacturing blueprint. Main scene: In the lower half, a long conveyor belt extending from left to right is displayed, carrying a row of classical marble busts inspired by Michelangelo's David. There are 10 clearly visible busts on the conveyor belt, all made of light-colored stone, with Renaissance-style curls, arranged in a repetitive pattern like factory products. Overlay seven opaque gray rectangular review blocks of varying sizes onto the front of the bust, aligned to cover the face: a small block on the far left, two medium blocks in the center left, a very large vertical block in the center of the foreground, two medium blocks on the right, and a small block near the far right. Central Object: Behind the central bust, a large, pixelated white computer mouse pointer rises diagonally, constructed like a heavy 3D object of stone or concrete with dark bevels. It is crashing through cracked plaster and gravel, revealing tangled wires, circuit boards, metal components, and broken concrete beneath. Add splattered debris and crack lines around the point of impact. Foreground Details: In the lower right foreground, place the casing of a rust-red industrial machine with peeling paint and black mechanical parts. Overlay a slightly tilted, small, retro Windows error dialog box with a blue title bar that reads "Error" with a red X icon, the message "Authenticity.exe has stopped working.", and an "OK" button. Add the black-printed text "ERROR", "CODE: 0x000404", and "SYSTEM_FAILURE" to the rusty machine. Include dark cables, gears, bolts, dirt, and orange rust seeping to the bottom. Visual style: Surreal 404 Renaissance collage, Brutalist industrial composite, archival blueprint poster, a mix of photomontage and engraving techniques, aged prints, high-detail textures, cracked stone, exposed electronic components, simulated paper grain, subtle halftones, museum-quality beige background, cinematic and flat editorial composition. Constraints: Keep all visible text legible and integrated into the print. Use 10 busts and 7 gray review rectangles. Do not add any additional characters, logos, watermarks, modern UI, or bright saturated colors other than a single vintage error dialog box and rust-red typography/mechanical.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张超现实工业文艺复兴风格的拼贴海报，标题为 {argument name="headline text" default="MASS PRODUCED AUTHENTICITY"}，将古典雕塑、工厂机械、建筑蓝图和过时的计算机错误图像混合，构成一幅具有批判性的艺术印刷品。

画布：正方形海报，1:1 纵横比，带有污渍的陈旧米色纸张背景，配有模糊的网格线、套准标记、技术绘图注释和磨损的档案印刷纹理。使用石灰色、灰米色、炭黑色、铁锈橙、褪色红以及少量 Windows-95 蓝色的柔和色调。

布局：左上角包含主要排版：写有“SERIES: MPA_001”和“DATE: 05.19.95”的小型技术标签，下方是大号优雅的衬线字体“MASS PRODUCED”（深灰色），再下方是高挑、压缩且带有磨损感的红橙色字体“AUTHENTICITY”。左侧还包含一个小型示意图说明框，写着“THE ASSEMBLY LINE OF IDENTITY STANDARDIZED, REPLICATED, EMPTY.”，后接“FIG. 07A”和“DAVID PRODUCTION UNIT SCHEMATIC”。右上象限包含一个详细的圆形工程蓝图，带有测量数据以及“SECTION A-A”和“SCALE 1:10”标签。左下角包含一个小型传送带平面图，标注方式如同技术制造图纸。

主体场景：在下半部分，展示一条从左向右延伸的长传送带，上面载有一排受米开朗基罗《大卫》雕像启发的古典大理石半身像。传送带上共有 10 个清晰可见的半身像，均为浅色石材，带有文艺复兴时期的卷发，像工厂产品一样重复排列。在半身像正面覆盖 7 个大小不一的不透明灰色矩形审查块，对齐覆盖在脸部：最左侧一个小块，左中位置两个中块，前景中心一个非常大的垂直长块，右侧两个中块，最右侧附近一个小块。

中心物体：在中心半身像后方，一个巨大的像素化白色计算机鼠标指针斜向上升起，构建得如同带有深色斜边的厚重石材或混凝土 3D 物体。它正撞破开裂的石膏和碎石，露出下方的缠绕电线、电路板、金属组件和破碎的混凝土。在撞击点周围添加飞溅的碎片和裂纹线。

前景细节：在右下角前景处，放置一个带有剥落油漆和黑色机械零件的锈红色工业机器外壳。叠加一个略微倾斜的小型复古 Windows 错误对话框，蓝色标题栏写着“Error”，带有一个红色 X 图标，消息内容为“Authenticity.exe has stopped working.”，并附有一个“OK”按钮。在生锈的机器上，添加黑色印记文字“ERROR”、“CODE: 0x000404”和“SYSTEM_FAILURE”。包含深色电缆、齿轮、螺栓、污垢以及溢出到底部的橙色锈迹。

视觉风格：超现实 404 文艺复兴拼贴画、粗野主义工业组合、档案蓝图海报、照片蒙太奇与雕刻技术绘图混合、做旧版画、高细节纹理、开裂石材、裸露电子元件、模拟纸张颗粒、微妙的半色调、博物馆收藏级米色背景、电影感且扁平化的编辑构图。

约束：保持所有可见文字清晰易读，并融入印刷品中。必须使用 10 个半身像和 7 个灰色审查矩形。除单个复古错误对话框外，不要添加额外的字符、Logo、水印、现代 UI，也不要使用除蓝色错误标题栏和锈红色排版/机械之外的明亮饱和色。

templates.title: AI thinks about classical bust posters

titleLocalized.zh: AI 思考古典半身像海报

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a vertical, retro-futuristic editorial poster about artificial intelligence and human commission, combining classical sculpture, exposed mechanical structures, and 1990s computer bug UI. Canvas: High vertical poster, 2:3 aspect ratio, aged beige paper background with subtle stains, grain, cracks, and technical drawing marks. Use soft tan, stone gray, rust orange, deep graphite, blue, and off-white tones. Subject: A broken marble bust of a Greek/Roman philosopher, showing from chest to head, occupying two-thirds of the poster's right side. The bust is cracked and partially broken, revealing a dense cyberpunk internal structure: cables, circuit boards, ribbon cables, metal pipes, small components, and mechanical layers entwined within the skull and torso. The facial area is deliberately covered by a matte gray-brown opaque square obscuring the center of the eyes/nose/mouth. The bust has curly stone hair and beard fragments, a gap in the shoulder, and large chunks of marble missing from the head and right side of the body. Layout and Poster Text: Set a large editorial title in the upper left corner, with the content "{argument name="headline text" default="AI IS THINKING SO I DON'T HAVE TO"} Set "AI" to a large rust-orange serif font, "IS" to a smaller black serif font, "THINKING" to a dark gray bold compressed sans-serif font, "SO I DON'T HAVE" to a tall, elegant serif font, and "TO" to a rust-orange serif font. Below the titles, include three lines of tightly stacked short phrases: "DELEGATION," "AS EVOLUTION," and "COMPLACENCY," followed by "AS DESIGN." as a compact mini-explanation block. Add a small orange Roman numeral "III" nearby. Error Window: Place an old-fashioned Windows-style dialog box below the bust, with a blue title bar displaying "Fatal Error," a gray body, a red circular icon containing a white X, a close button in the upper right corner, and the message text: "System failure at address 0041:7B3E The operation completed successfully." Include a rectangular "OK" button and a large pixelated white cursor arrow pointing to or overlaying the "OK" button. Data Overlay: Add a data overlay consisting of repeating 0s in the lower right corner of the dialog box. A black binary code fault shape composed of 1 and 1, dripping onto exposed circuitry, resembling melted digital remnants. Background technical details: Added thin black drawing lines, clipping marks, a dot grid, measurement scales, crosshairs, and subtle geometric diagrams. A circular construction diagram is included in the lower left quadrant. A small orange nested corner marker is included near the lower left corner. A small label reading "Fig. 01" is included in the upper left corner. Vertical microtext "MIND / MACHINE INTERFACE" and small orange coordinate-like text are included along the left edge. A tiny calculation block is added near the lower left corner, reading "CALC. // HUMAN INPUT 0.001%". Visual style: High-detail photomontage collage, combining museum sculpture realism with cyberpunk exposed hardware, Swiss editorial typography, Brutalist typography, aged print texture, subtle halftone dots, precise grid composition, cinematic shadows, realistic stone dust, and broken marble edges. Constraints: Only 1 is used. One bust, one obscuring square, one error dialog box, one cursor, one binary droplet shape, one circular chart, and one orange nested corner marker. Do not add any extra characters, extra windows, modern glossy UI, neon colors, or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张关于人工智能与人类委托的竖版复古未来主义编辑海报，结合古典雕塑、裸露机械结构和 1990 年代计算机错误 UI。

画布：高竖版海报，2:3 纵横比，陈旧的米色纸张背景，带有细微污渍、颗粒感、裂纹和技术绘图标记。使用柔和的棕褐色、石灰色、铁锈橙、深石墨色、蓝色和灰白色调。

主体：一尊破碎的希腊/罗马哲学家大理石半身像，展示胸部至头部，占据海报右侧三分之二区域。半身像开裂并部分破碎，露出致密的赛博朋克内部结构：头骨和躯干内缠绕的电缆、电路板、排线、金属管、小型组件和机械层。面部区域被一个位于眼/鼻/口中心位置的哑光灰褐色不透明正方形遮挡块刻意覆盖。半身像拥有卷曲的石质头发和胡须碎片，肩部有缺口，头部和身体右侧缺失大块大理石。

排版与海报文字：在左上角设置一个大型编辑标题，内容为“{argument name="headline text" default="AI IS THINKING SO I DON'T HAVE TO"}”。将“AI”设为巨大的铁锈橙色衬线字体，“IS”设为较小的黑色衬线字体，“THINKING”设为深灰色粗体压缩无衬线字体，“SO I DON'T HAVE”设为高挑优雅的衬线字体，“TO”设为铁锈橙色衬线字体。在标题下方，包含 3 行紧凑堆叠的短句：“DELEGATION”、“AS EVOLUTION.”、“COMPLACENCY”，紧接着下一行是“AS DESIGN.”作为紧凑的微型说明块。在附近添加一个小型的橙色罗马数字“III”。

错误窗口：在半身像下胸部位置放置 1 个旧式 Windows 风格的对话框，蓝色标题栏显示“Fatal Error”，灰色主体，红色圆形图标内含白色 X，右上角有关闭按钮，消息文本为：“System failure at address 0041:7B3E
The operation completed successfully.” 包含 1 个矩形“OK”按钮和 1 个指向或覆盖在“OK”按钮上的大型像素化白色光标箭头。

数据叠加：在对话框右下角添加 1 个由重复的 0 和 1 组成的黑色二进制代码故障形状，并滴落在裸露的电路之上，看起来像融化的数字残留物。

背景技术细节：添加细黑色的绘图线、裁切标记、点阵网格、测量刻度、十字准星和淡淡的几何图表。在左下象限包含 1 个圆形构造图。在左下角附近包含 1 个小型橙色嵌套角标志。在左上角包含 1 个小型标签，内容为“Fig. 01”。沿左侧边缘包含垂直微型文字“MIND / MACHINE INTERFACE”以及橙色的小型坐标类文本。在左下角附近添加一个微小的计算块，内容为“CALC. // HUMAN INPUT 0.001%”。

视觉风格：高细节照片蒙太奇拼贴，博物馆雕塑写实感与赛博朋克裸露硬件结合，瑞士编辑排版，粗野主义排版，做旧印刷质感，细微半色调网点，精确的网格构图，电影级阴影，逼真的石粉和破碎的大理石边缘。

约束：仅使用 1 个半身像、1 个遮挡方块、1 个错误对话框、1 个光标、1 个二进制滴落形状、1 个圆形图表和 1 个橙色嵌套角标志。不要添加额外的人物、额外的窗口、现代光泽 UI、霓虹色或水印。

templates.title: Anime illustrations transformed into hyperrealistic photos

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫插画转超写实照片

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference images, transform anime/manga illustrations into hyper-realistic, cinematic photographs while preserving the original composition, poses, camera angles, framing, lighting direction, color palette, all visible text, and every visual element, without altering their positions. Replace stylized rendering with real-world materials and textures: scratched and worn reflective gunmetal, brushed silver metal, glossy black armor, realistic leather gloves, physically accurate glowing eye effects, realistic muzzle flash lighting, ejected brass cartridge cases, chains, rivets, dents, dust, surface dirt, and soft, realistic shadows. Retain the large red typographic text and quotation marks in their original positions, but render them as clear, printed graphic elements behind the subject. Maintain the same close-up action shots and black borders; do not add or remove any objects, symbols, text, or background elements.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图像，将动漫/漫画插画转换为超写实的电影级照片，同时保留原始构图、姿势、摄像机角度、取景、光照方向、调色板、所有可见文字以及每个视觉元素，且不改变其位置。将风格化渲染替换为现实世界的材质和纹理：带有划痕和磨损的反射枪金属、拉丝银金属、光泽黑色装甲、逼真的皮革质感手套、物理精确的发光眼部光效、真实的枪口闪光照明、飞出的黄铜弹壳、链条、铆钉、凹痕、灰尘、表面污垢以及柔和逼真的阴影。保留大的红色排版文字和引号在原位，但将其渲染为主体后方清晰的印刷图形元素。保持相同的特写动作镜头和黑色边框；不要添加或删除任何物体、符号、文字或背景元素。

templates.title: Broken Links Cyberpunk Style Bust Poster

titleLocalized.zh: Broken Links 赛博朋克风格半身像海报

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a surrealist retro editorial poster about fragile digital connections, combining classical sculpture, exposed electronic components, and distressed print design. Canvas: A 2:3 aspect ratio vertical poster with a background of aged warm ivory paper with subtle stains, grain, scratches, and blurred creases. Main Composition: A large, broken classical plaster bust is placed slightly to the right center, cut from the head/shoulder down to a tapered, broken base. The bust is vertically split, revealing dense, dark circuit boards, chips, gold wires, copper wires, and bundles of cables inside. The edges of the plaster shell are jagged, cracked, dusty, and chipped. A 3.5 mm audio jack cable extends from an opening below, dangling near the bottom center. Flowing stone-carved hair adorns the sides of the head; parts of the face are missing or obscured by cracks. Wings: Add two detailed bird wings to the bust: a large, upward-reaching wing rising from the upper right shoulder, and a smaller, horizontal wing extending behind the hair on the lower right side. Scatter small plaster fragments and feather-like remnants around the wings. Left-side typography: Place a tall, narrow serif heading on the left, employing an elegant, high-fashion editorial style. The heading must read: “WE ARE ALL JUST BROKEN LINKS.” Use stacked lines; most words are black, while the word “BROKEN” is a large, distressed red, partially obscured by the central obstacle. Obstacle/Overlay: Add a large, opaque rectangular overlay to the left center foreground, covering part of the heading and the left side of the bust. The rectangle is a soft gray-beige, with a small, old-fashioned Windows-style blue title bar corner and a small close button visible near the upper right edge, hinting at a crashed dialog box. Do not add readable dialogue text within the rectangle. Technical Chart Background: Thin drawing lines, registration marks, circles, rectangles, dashed leader lines, small black nodes, and measurement-like geometric shapes are superimposed on paper. These charts are kept subtle and low-contrast, with a few rust-red square accents. Visible Small Text Elements: Contains nine separate text elements: 1) The large heading “WE ARE ALL JUST BROKEN LINKS”; 2) “fig. 23.” at the top; 3) A short paragraph stating “An inquiry into the fragility of connection in a fragmented digital age.”; 4) A thin red line below the paragraph; 5) Tiny red text “DISCONNECT TO CONNECT”; 6) “07-95”; 7) Two lines of terminal text “exist.exe” and “not found”; 8) “fig. a.” near the chart in the lower right corner; 9) “fig. b.” below it. Use small, sparse, letterpress-like typography. Style:{argument name="visual style" default="surreal vintage analog-digital collage poster"} A fusion of museum specimens and cyberpunk anatomy, featuring soft, monochromatic stone, black ink, antique paper, copper oxide, and dark circuit board green. Highly detailed, with realistic tactile textures, cracked plaster, lifelike electronic components, etched illustration quality, and aged printing effects. Customizable text: The main title can be {argument name="headline text" default="WE ARE ALL JUST BROKEN LINKS"} Short paragraphs can be{argument name="caption text" default="An inquiry into the fragility of connection in a fragmented digital age."} The subject can be{argument name="central subject" default="a broken classical plaster bust with exposed circuit boards"} Accent colors can be{argument name="accent color" default="rust red"} Constraints: Maintain compositional asymmetry, leave strong negative space on the left, avoid modern glossy UI except for minor details of old dialog boxes, avoid realistic human skin, avoid adding extra wings, avoid adding extra large text, and avoid adding watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张关于脆弱数字连接的超现实主义复古编辑海报，结合古典雕塑、裸露电子元件和做旧印刷设计。

画布：2:3 比例的竖版海报，背景为带有细微污渍、颗粒感、划痕和模糊折痕的陈旧暖象牙色纸张。

主体构图：在偏右中心位置放置一个大型破损的古典石膏半身像，从头部/肩部向下裁剪至呈锥形的破损底边。半身像垂直裂开，露出内部密集的深色电路板、芯片、金线、铜线和成束的电缆。石膏外壳边缘参差不齐，布满裂纹、灰尘和缺口。一根 3.5 mm 音频插孔线从下方的开口处伸出，向下垂在底部中心附近。头部两侧有飘逸的石雕发丝；部分面部缺失或被裂口遮挡。

翅膀元素：在半身像上添加 2 只细节丰富的鸟类翅膀：一只大型向上延伸的翅膀从右上肩部升起，另一只较小的水平翅膀在右侧下方发丝后方伸出。在翅膀周围散落细小的石膏碎片和羽毛状残片。

左侧排版：在左侧设置一个高窄的衬线标题，采用优雅的高级时尚编辑风格。标题内容必须为：“WE ARE ALL JUST BROKEN LINKS”。采用堆叠行排列；大多数单词为黑色，而“BROKEN”一词为大型做旧红色，并被中央的障碍物部分遮挡。

障碍物/叠加层：在左中前景添加 1 个大型不透明矩形叠加层，覆盖部分标题和半身像左侧。矩形为柔和的灰米色，右上边缘附近可见一个微小的旧式 Windows 风格蓝色标题栏角和一个小型关闭按钮，暗示一个崩溃的对话框。不要在矩形内添加可读的对话文本。

技术图表背景：在纸张上叠加细薄的绘图线条、套准标记、圆圈、矩形、虚线构造引导线、黑色小节点以及类似测量的几何图形。保持这些图表细微且低对比度，并带有少量锈红色方形点缀。

可见的小型文本元素：包含 9 个独立的文本元素：1) 大标题“WE ARE ALL JUST BROKEN LINKS”；2) 顶部的“fig. 23.”；3) 一段小段落，内容为“An inquiry into the fragility of connection in a fragmented digital age.”；4) 段落下方的一条红色细线；5) 微小的红色文本“DISCONNECT TO CONNECT”；6) “07-95”；7) 两行终端文本“exist.exe”和“not found”；8) 右下角图表附近的“fig. a.”；9) 其下方的“fig. b.”。使用小型、稀疏、类似凸版印刷的排版。

风格：{argument name="visual style" default="surreal vintage analog-digital collage poster"}，博物馆标本与赛博朋克解剖学的结合，柔和的单色石材、黑色墨水、古董纸张、氧化铜和深色电路板绿色。高度细节化、触感真实、裂纹石膏、逼真的电子元件、蚀刻插画质感、做旧印刷效果。

可自定义文本：主标题可以是 {argument name="headline text" default="WE ARE ALL JUST BROKEN LINKS"}。小段落可以是 {argument name="caption text" default="An inquiry into the fragility of connection in a fragmented digital age."}。主体可以是 {argument name="central subject" default="a broken classical plaster bust with exposed circuit boards"}。强调色可以是 {argument name="accent color" default="rust red"}。

约束：保持构图不对称，左侧留有强烈的负空间，除微小的旧对话框细节外，不要使用现代光面 UI，不要出现写实的人类皮肤，不要添加额外的翅膀，不要添加额外的大型文本，不要添加水印。
