templates.title: Warm Pixel Farm Island Village

titleLocalized.zh: 温馨像素农场海岛村庄

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a bright and inviting pixel-art farm village map, situated on a small island in a blue ocean, presenting a 16-bit top-down/isometric view reminiscent of a life simulation game. Canvas: 4:3 landscape image, approximately 1024×768 resolution, crisp pixel art, no UI overlay, no borders, no watermarks. Use a vibrant turquoise ocean as the background, with soft wave highlights, ripples on the shore, scattered water lily leaves, and small rocks. Layout: Showcase 6 grassy/beach islands connected by wooden bridges and docks. The largest central island is located in the center, containing the main house, paths, fenced farmland, a well, road signs, a human character, and a dog. Four smaller grassy islands are distributed in the upper left, upper right, lower left, and right sides. A small beach island is located at the bottom center. Number and content of islands: 1. Central Island: An irregularly shaped grassy island with dirt paths forming a crossroads. Place a cozy blue-roofed cottage at the top center, with a chimney puffing smoke, round attic windows, a wooden front door, flower boxes, bushes, and a low fence at the back. Place a [something] slightly below the center.{argument name="character name" default="young farmer"} 1. **Pixelated Farmer Character with a Corgi Dog:** Add a fenced farm in the center below, with exactly four rows of crops: leafy greens, white radishes, orange carrots, and golden wheat. Add a stone well to the left of the farm, a wooden signpost with a lantern hanging beside the path on the left, along with flowering bushes, pebbles, and daisies. 2. **Top Left Island:** A red-roofed barn with double doors, haystacks, a fenced barn, and exactly one black and white cow. Include a large-leaved tree, a wooden crate, flowers, and a wooden bridge connecting to the central island. 3. **Top Right Island:** A village shop with a purple roof, a purple and white striped awning, a front door, a window display, flower pots, barrels, and a freestanding sign. The sign above the awning must read:{argument name="shop sign text" default="shop"} 4. Lower Left Island: Fishing Harbor Island with a wooden pier, streetlights, barrels, crates, small toolboxes/signs, and exactly one small wooden rowboat moored near the pier. This island is connected to the central island by a wooden bridge. 5. Right Island: Small orange-roofed huts with chimneys, round attic windows, front doors, blue windows, flower boxes, low fences, trees, flowers, and a wooden bridge connecting to the central island. 6. Bottom Central Island: Miniature beach with a palm tree, red and white parasols, blue striped lounge chairs, starfish, seashells, and grass along the edge; this island is not connected by a bridge. Number of discrete elements to retain: Exactly 6 islands, exactly 4 bridges connecting the central island, exactly 4 buildings in total (barn, blue-roofed hut, purple shop, orange-roofed hut), exactly 1 character, exactly 2 animals (1 cow and 1 dog), exactly 1 rowboat, exactly 1 farmland containing 4 visible crops, exactly 1 well, exactly 1 road sign with a lantern, exactly 1 parasol, exactly 1 deck chair, and exactly 1 palm tree. Visual style: Cute, detailed pixel art, a 45-degree overhead view, warm sunlight, saturated colors, soft shadows, blocky and easily recognizable shapes, detailed grass textures, small flowers, rounded coastline outlines, and an animated game-like charm.{argument name="water color" default="Bright turquoise blue"} As the color of the surrounding ocean{argument name="main roof color" default="blue"} As the roof color of the central cabin, and{argument name="overall mood" default="A cheerful and heartwarming farm adventure"} As the overall emotional tone. Constraints: Keep the entire scene visible as a single, map-like composition. Do not add interface buttons, text other than shop signs, additional characters, additional animals, vehicles, modern objects, or a realistic style.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个明亮温馨的像素风农场村庄地图，坐落在蓝色海洋的小岛上，呈现出 16-bit 生活模拟类游戏俯视/等距视角的游戏截图效果。

画布：4:3 横向图像，约 1024×768 分辨率，清晰的像素艺术，无 UI 覆盖，无边框，无水印。使用充满活力的绿松石色海洋作为背景，带有柔和的波浪高光、岸边的涟漪、散落的睡莲叶和小型岩石。

布局：展示 6 个由木桥和码头连接的草地/沙滩岛屿。最大的中央岛屿位于正中，包含主屋、小路、带围栏的农田、水井、路标、一个人类角色和一只狗。四个较小的草地岛屿分布在左上、右上、左下和右侧。一个小型沙滩岛屿位于底部中心。

岛屿数量及内容：
1. 中央岛屿：不规则的草地岛，泥土小路形成十字路口。在顶部中心放置一间温馨的蓝色屋顶小屋，烟囱冒着烟，有圆形阁楼窗、木质前门、花箱、灌木丛和屋后的矮栅栏。在中心偏下方放置一个名为 {argument name="character name" default="年轻农夫"} 的像素农夫角色，旁边跟着一只柯基犬。在下方中心添加一个带围栏的农田，正好有 4 行作物：绿叶蔬菜、白萝卜、橙色胡萝卜和金色小麦。在农田左侧添加一口石井，左侧小路旁放置一个挂着灯笼的木制路标，以及带花的灌木丛、小石头和雏菊。
2. 左上岛屿：红色屋顶的谷仓，有双开门、干草堆、带围栏的畜栏和正好 1 头黑白花奶牛。包含一棵大叶树、木箱、花朵，以及一座连接到中央岛屿的木桥。
3. 右上岛屿：村庄商店，紫色屋顶，紫色和白色条纹遮阳篷，前门，橱窗展示，花盆，木桶和独立式招牌。遮阳篷上方的招牌必须写着 {argument name="shop sign text" default="商店"}。包含一棵结有红苹果的果树，以及一座连接到中央岛屿的木桥。
4. 左下岛屿：渔港岛，有木质码头、路灯、木桶、木箱、小型工具箱/标志，以及正好 1 艘系在码头附近的小木划艇。通过一座木桥将此岛与中央岛屿连接。
5. 右侧岛屿：小型橙色屋顶小屋，带烟囱、圆形阁楼窗、前门、蓝色窗户、花箱、矮栅栏、树木、花朵，以及一座连接到中央岛屿的木桥。
6. 底部中心岛屿：微型沙滩，有一棵棕榈树、红白相间的遮阳伞、蓝色条纹躺椅、海星、贝壳和边缘的草地；该岛不通过桥梁连接。

需保留的离散元素数量：正好 6 个岛屿，正好 4 座连接中央岛屿的桥梁，总共正好 4 栋建筑（谷仓、蓝色屋顶小屋、紫色商店、橙色屋顶小屋），正好 1 个角色，正好 2 只动物（1 头奶牛和 1 只狗），正好 1 艘划艇，正好 1 块农田包含 4 种可见作物，正好 1 口水井，正好 1 个带灯笼的路标，正好 1 把遮阳伞，正好 1 把躺椅，正好 1 棵棕榈树。

视觉风格：可爱的精细像素艺术，俯视 45 度视角，温暖的阳光，饱和的色彩，柔和的阴影，块状且易于辨认的形状，细致的草地纹理，小花，圆润的海岸线轮廓，以及动画游戏般的魅力。使用 {argument name="water color" default="明亮的绿松石蓝"} 作为周围海洋的颜色，{argument name="main roof color" default="蓝色"} 作为中央小屋的屋顶颜色，并将 {argument name="overall mood" default="欢快温馨的农场冒险"} 作为整体情感基调。

约束：保持整个场景作为单一的地图式构图可见。不要添加界面按钮、商店招牌以外的文字、额外的角色、额外的动物、车辆、现代物体或写实风格。

templates.title: Met Gala Haute Couture Triptych

titleLocalized.zh: Met Gala 高定三联画

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a realistic Met Gala red carpet haute couture photography triptych showcasing the same glamorous woman in three different luxurious gowns, arranged in three equally wide vertical panels separated by thin black borders. Canvas: Wide horizontal collage, approximately 3:2 aspect ratio, containing three full-height photographic panels side-by-side. Employing a hyper-realistic DSLR action photography style, capture the candid lighting, shallow depth of field, flash highlights, warm indoor museum tones, and crowded paparazzi background of the celebrity dinner. The faces of guests and photographers in the background will be soft-focused while ensuring the subject remains sharp. Layout: Precisely defined 3 independent panels. Left panel 1 shows a frontal red carpet pose; middle panel 2 shows a three-quarter profile walk pose; right panel 3 shows a formal full-body staircase pose. Subject Details: The same adult woman, possessing…{argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown"} Hair, exuding elegant celebrity style, appears in all three panels. Maintain a soft, blurred or unfocused facial expression, but preserve the natural texture of the skin, posture, jewelry, and haute couture styling. Panel 1: Clothing: A striking piece {argument name="red gown color" default="Crimson"} A strapless haute couture ball gown featuring a sweetheart neckline, a structured corset, delicate gold thread embroidery, shimmering crystal embellishments, voluminous sheer red tulle, and a romantically flowing skirt. The woman stands on the red carpet staircase, one hand raised to her chin, the other placed near her waist. She wears a diamond necklace and bracelet. The background includes paparazzi, guests in black formal attire, camera flashes, and a green hedge adorned with red flowers. Panel 2: Attire: A bright {argument name="silver gown color" default="Pearl Silver"} Off-the-shoulder haute couture gown, photographed from the back and side rear. The gown features crystal embroidery, delicate short draped sleeves, a fitted, shimmering bodice, a high slit, a sheer, flowing cape-like train, a long, semi-transparent fabric draped across the carpet, and moon/star-like astronomical embellishments. The woman lifts the train as she walks. The background includes a dense paparazzi crowd, bright flashes, white floral hedges, and a deep blue evening carpet. Panel 3: Outfit: A black off-the-shoulder mermaid gown with glamorous metallic accents.{argument name="embroidery color" default="Antique gold"} Baroque embroidery, long sleeves, a fitted cut, a striking circular bodice, and a small, sweeping train. A woman stands at the center of a cream-colored marble staircase, a red carpet laid out, her hands elegantly placed in front of her. The background includes museum architecture, warm wall lamps, velvet ropes, neatly trimmed greenery, and servers in tuxedos. Visual style: Photorealistic, high-fashion celebrity event photography, Met Gala atmosphere, luxurious haute couture feel, realistic fabric drape, shimmering beading, precise red carpet lighting, cinematic paparazzi flash effects, and vertical fashion magazine compositions within each panel. Constraints: Includes 3 precise panels and 3 haute couture gowns: 1 crimson gold embroidered ball gown, 1 pearl silver star-patterned gown with a train, and 1 black and gold Baroque mermaid gown. Do not add any titles, logos, watermarks, or additional text. Keep the collage seamless and realistic, separating the panels with thin black lines.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张逼真的 Met Gala 红毯高定摄影三联画，展示同一位迷人女性身着三套不同奢华礼服，以三个等宽的垂直面板排列，并由细黑边分隔。

画布：宽幅横向拼贴，比例约为 3:2，包含三个并排的全高照片面板。采用超写实 DSLR 活动摄影风格，捕捉名人晚宴的抓拍灯光、浅景深、闪光灯高光、温暖的室内博物馆色调以及拥挤的狗仔队背景。背景中宾客和摄影师的面部可进行柔焦处理，同时确保主体清晰。

布局：精确的 3 个独立面板。左侧面板 1 展示正面红毯姿势；中间面板 2 展示背部四分之三侧身行走姿势；右侧面板 3 展示正式的全身楼梯姿势。

主体细节：同一位成年女性，拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 头发，展现优雅的名人气质，出现在所有三个面板中。保持面部柔和模糊或非聚焦状态，但保留真实的皮肤质感、姿态、珠宝和高定造型。

面板 1 服装：一件引人注目的 {argument name="red gown color" default="绯红色"} 无肩带高定舞会礼服，采用心形领口、结构化紧身胸衣、精致的金线刺绣、闪亮的晶体装饰、透明红色薄纱体积感以及浪漫的飘逸裙摆。女性站在红毯楼梯区域，一只手抬至下巴附近，另一只手放在腰部附近。搭配钻石项链和手链。背景包括狗仔队、身着黑色正装的宾客、相机闪光灯以及带有红花的绿色树篱装饰。

面板 2 服装：一件明亮的 {argument name="silver gown color" default="珍珠银"} 一字肩高定礼服，从后方及侧后方拍摄。礼服饰有水晶刺绣、精致的短款垂坠袖、修身闪亮胸衣、高开叉、透明飘逸的斗篷式拖尾、在地毯上铺开的长款半透明面料以及月亮/星星般的星象装饰。女性行走时手提裙摆。背景包括密集的狗仔队、明亮的闪光灯爆点、白色花卉树篱装饰以及深蓝色晚宴地毯。

面板 3 服装：一件黑色一字肩美人鱼礼服，饰有华丽的金属色 {argument name="embroidery color" default="古金色"} 巴洛克刺绣、长袖、修身剪裁、引人注目的圆形胸部图案以及小巧的扫地拖尾。女性站在奶油色大理石楼梯中央，铺有红毯，双手优雅地置于身前。背景包括博物馆建筑、温暖的壁灯、天鹅绒绳索、修剪整齐的绿植以及身着燕尾服的服务人员。

视觉风格：照片级逼真，高级时装名人活动摄影，Met Gala 氛围，奢华高定质感，真实的面料垂坠感，闪亮的珠饰，精准的红毯灯光，电影级狗仔队闪光效果，每个面板内采用垂直时尚杂志构图。

约束条件：包含精确的 3 个面板和 3 套高定礼服：1 套绯红色金绣舞会礼服，1 套珍珠银星象拖尾礼服，以及 1 套黑金巴洛克美人鱼礼服。不要添加任何标题、Logo、水印或额外文字。保持拼贴画无缝且逼真，面板之间使用细黑线分隔。

templates.title: Warm Farm Village Pixel Material List

titleLocalized.zh: 温馨农场村庄像素素材表

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a clean, reusable 2D pixel-style game asset set for a cozy farm village, labeled and laid out on a pure white background. Use crisp 32-bit pixel art, orthographic/frontal RPG perspective, consistent proportions, soft outlines, warm, saturated colors, and no shadows outside the sprite images. Theme:{argument name="tileset theme" default="cozy farming village"} Canvas: Landscape layout, 4:3 aspect ratio, white background, neat row and column spacing. Add a small green sprout icon before each section label. Use a dark pixel font for English labeling. Layout and required sections: - HOUSES: 5 small cottages, all from the front, with different roof colors and details: 1 blue-roofed cottage, 1 golden-roofed cottage, 1 green-roofed cottage with a flower box, 1 orange-red-roofed cottage with flowers, and 1 purple-roofed cottage with flowers. - SHOP: 1 shop building with a purple roof, purple striped awning, a "SHOP" sign, flower pots, and a small sidewalk sign. - BARN: 1 red barn with an orange roof, large double doors, side hardware, and a pile of hay. - FARM PLOTS: 3 rectangular fenced farmlands: 1 planted field with vegetables, wheat, and root crops; 1 cultivated field with small sprouts; 1 empty cultivated soil field. - SOIL TILES: 8 square topographic tiles arranged in 2 rows: the top row contains 4 base tiles showing dark soil, medium mud, light sand, and grassland; the bottom row contains 4 planted or transitional tiles showing soil changes after planting and the transition from mud to grassland. - TREES: 4 leafy fruit/deciduous trees: 1 round dark green tree, 1 large bright green tree, 1 small yellowish-green tree, and 1 apple tree with red fruit. - BUSHES: 3 round shrubs: 1 common green shrub, 1 shrub with pale flowers, and 1 berry shrub with red berries. - SPECIAL TREE: 1 palm tree with a brown, crooked trunk and green leaves. - LOGS & STUMPS: 5 items: 1 long log, 1 cut log, 1 hollow log, 1 large stump, 1 small stump with sprouting buds. - BEACH PROPS: 5 items: 1 red and white beach umbrella, 1 blue striped lounge chair, 1 pink starfish, 1 pink seashell, 1 beige seashell. - FLOWERS: 6 small flower sprites: white daisy, yellow flower, pink flower, orange-red flower, purple lavender, and a pink tulip. - VILLAGE PROPS: 18 village items, arranged in two rows: wooden road sign, lamppost, mailbox, blackboard sign, wooden crate, barrel, sack, flower pot, wooden bench, stone well, bucket, produce cart, terracotta pot, wooden flower box, round flower pot, market stall, blue checkered table with flowers, and another lamppost. - FARM PROPS: 9 farm items: hay bales, blue water trough, hay cart, short wooden fence section, milk jug, hay pitchfork, shovel, blue watering can, and long wooden flower box. - SMALL DETAILS: 12 ground detail sprites: 4 rocks, 1 tiny sprout, 1 clump of tall reeds, 1 clump of grass, 1 clump of red mushrooms, 1 yellow flower patch, 1 white flower patch, 1 water lily leaf, and 1 leaf with pink water lilies. - FENCES: 4 fence sprites: Baluster Fence, Vertical Plank Fence, Rope Post Fence, Short Gate/Fence Segment. Visual Style:{argument name="visual style" default="cute high-quality pixel art game tileset"} Keep each asset independent, centered within its own space for easy cropping during game use. Use consistent outlines, a uniform top-left light source, and ensure sprite images do not overlap. Text labels should use pixel fonts and be named strictly according to the listed part names. Avoid adding extra decorative background elements, watermarks, mockup UIs, or perspective distortion.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为温馨农场村庄 tileset 创建一张干净、可复用的 2D 像素风游戏素材表，在纯白背景上进行标注和排版。使用清晰的 32 位风格像素艺术、正交/正面 RPG 视角、统一比例、柔和轮廓、温暖饱和的色彩，且精灵图外无阴影。主题：{argument name="tileset theme" default="cozy farming village"}。

画布：横向素材表，4:3 比例，白色背景，行与列间距整齐。在每个部分标签前添加绿色小嫩芽图标。使用深色像素字体进行英文标注。

布局及所需部分：
- HOUSES（房屋）：5 栋小型村舍，均为正面视角，具有不同的屋顶颜色和细节：1 栋蓝色屋顶村舍、1 栋金黄色屋顶村舍、1 栋带花箱的绿色屋顶村舍、1 栋带花的橙红色屋顶村舍、1 栋带花的紫色屋顶村舍。
- SHOP（商店）：1 栋商店建筑，紫色屋顶，紫色条纹遮阳篷，悬挂写有“SHOP”的招牌，配有花盆和小型人行道立牌。
- BARN（谷仓）：1 栋红色谷仓，橙色屋顶，大型双开门，侧面五金件，以及一堆干草。
- FARM PLOTS（农田）：3 块矩形栅栏农田：1 块种有蔬菜、小麦和根茎作物的种植田；1 块带有小嫩芽的耕作田；1 块空的耕作土壤田。
- SOIL TILES（土壤图块）：8 块方形地形图块，排列为 2 行：顶行 4 块基础图块，展示深色土壤、中色泥土、浅色沙地和草地；底行 4 块种植或过渡图块，展示播种后的土壤变化及泥土到草地的过渡。
- TREES（树木）：4 棵多叶果树/落叶树：1 棵圆形深绿色树、1 棵较大的亮绿色树、1 棵较小的黄绿色树、1 棵结有红色果实的苹果树。
- BUSHES（灌木）：3 丛圆形灌木：1 丛普通绿灌木、1 丛开着淡色花朵的灌木、1 丛结有红色浆果的浆果灌木。
- SPECIAL TREE（特殊树木）：1 棵棕色弯曲树干、绿色叶片的棕榈树。
- LOGS & STUMPS（原木与树桩）：5 个物品：1 根长原木、1 根切断的原木、1 根空心原木、1 个大树桩、1 个长出嫩芽的小树桩。
- BEACH PROPS（海滩道具）：5 个物品：1 把红白相间沙滩伞、1 把蓝色条纹躺椅、1 个粉色海星、1 个粉色贝壳、1 个米色贝壳。
- FLOWERS（花卉）：6 个小型花卉精灵图：白色雏菊、黄色花朵、粉色花朵、橙红色花朵、紫色薰衣草和一朵粉色郁金香。
- VILLAGE PROPS（村庄道具）：18 个村庄物品，分两行排列：木制路标、灯柱、邮箱、黑板招牌、木箱、木桶、麻袋、花盆、木长椅、石井、水桶、农产品推车、陶罐、木制花箱、圆形花盆、市场摊位、带花的蓝格子桌子，以及另一个灯柱。
- FARM PROPS（农场道具）：9 个农场物品：干草捆、蓝色水槽、干草车、短木栅栏段、牛奶罐、干草叉、铲子、蓝色洒水壶和长木花箱。
- SMALL DETAILS（小型细节）：12 个地面细节精灵图：4 块岩石、1 个微小嫩芽、1 丛高芦苇、1 簇草丛、1 丛红蘑菇、1 片黄色花丛、1 片白色花丛、1 片睡莲叶、1 片带粉色睡莲的叶子。
- FENCES（栅栏）：4 个栅栏精灵图：栏杆栅栏、垂直木板栅栏、绳索立柱栅栏、短门/栅栏段。

视觉风格：{argument name="visual style" default="cute high-quality pixel art game tileset"}。保持每个素材独立，居中放置在各自空间内，以便于游戏使用时裁剪。使用一致的轮廓线，统一的左上方光源，且精灵图之间互不重叠。文本标签应使用像素字体，并严格按照列出的部分名称命名。避免添加额外的装饰性背景元素、水印、样机 UI 或透视畸变。

templates.title: Met Gala Haute Couture Triptych

titleLocalized.zh: Met Gala 高定三联画

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a triptych editorial-style fashion collage showcasing hyper-realistic and glamorous portraits of women at the Met Gala, inspired by {argument name="theme" default="A Clash Between Celestial Bodies and the Future Royal Family"} The exhibition features three ultra-luxurious haute couture looks by the same anonymous woman. Her face was deliberately anonymized using a soft, rectangular blur mask, while the gowns, jewelry, lighting, and event atmosphere remained clear and realistic. Canvas: A wide horizontal triptych, 3:2 aspect ratio, divided into three equally wide vertical panels by thin, dark dividing lines. Photorealistic DSLR red carpet photography, shallow depth of field, warm indoor evening lighting, paparazzi flashes, a luxurious museum staircase, and a floral backdrop. Panels and Content: Three full-body or near-full-body fashion portraits of women. 1. Left Panel: A woman facing forward stands on the red carpet, wearing an eye-catching {argument name="left gown color" default="Deep crimson"} A strapless haute couture ball gown with a deep sweetheart neckline, gold Baroque embroidery, a gorgeous beaded corset, a voluminous red sheer tulle skirt, and a sculptural crinoline or train. She has long, dark, wavy hair, wears a diamond necklace and bracelet, one hand near her mouth, the other resting lightly on her hip. The background includes paparazzi, formally dressed guests, hedges, a red carpet, and bright camera flashes. 2. Central panel: The woman is presented in a three-quarter profile from behind, like an ethereal moon goddess, dressed in a cold {argument name="center gown color" default="silver-white"} A one-shoulder, starry-sky haute couture gown, adorned with crystal beads, a shimmering sheer shawl, a long, flowing train, a high slit, sparkling high heels, and crescent and star patterns embroidered on the semi-transparent fabric. She glances back over her shoulder, gently lifting the hem of her skirt. The background is crowded with photographers, white flowers, a deep blue carpet with star patterns, and intense flash photography. 3. Right panel: A woman stands facing forward on an elegant staircase, dressed in a well-fitting {argument name="right gown color" default="Black and antique gold"} A one-shoulder mermaid gown with long sleeves, adorned with heavy symmetrical gold embroidery, a starry circular pattern on the chest, a structured neckline, a fitted silhouette, and a small train. She wears her hair in a sleek low bun. The background includes a cream-colored marble staircase, a red carpet runway, gold pillars, guards or service personnel in black suits, and warm wall lamps. Visual style: Hyperrealistic, luxury fashion magazine editorial style, Met Gala atmosphere, glamorous haute couture tailoring, exquisite metallic embroidery, sparkling crystals, cinematic warm highlights, realistic fabric texture, high dynamic range, elegant poses, and sophisticated celebrity event photography. Constraints: Use 3 vertical panels and 3 haute couture looks; no visible readable text, no logos, no watermarks. All faces must be anonymized using soft blur blocks. Do not add extra panels, extra model subjects, or cartoon styles.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张三联版面编辑类时尚拼贴画，展示超写实、充满魅力的 Met Gala 女性肖像，灵感源自 {argument name="theme" default="天体与未来皇室的碰撞"}，通过同一位匿名女性演绎三套极致奢华的高级定制造型。面部需通过柔和的矩形模糊遮罩进行刻意匿名化处理，同时礼服、珠宝、灯光及活动氛围保持清晰且真实。

画布：宽幅横向三联画，3:2 纵横比，由细深色分隔线划分为 3 个等宽的垂直面板。照片级真实感的单反红毯摄影，浅景深，温暖的室内晚宴灯光，狗仔队闪光灯，奢华的博物馆楼梯和花卉背景。

面板数量及内容：共 3 幅全身或近全身的女性时尚肖像。
1. 左侧面板：正面朝向的女性站在红毯上，身着引人注目的 {argument name="left gown color" default="深绯红色"} 无肩带高定舞会礼服，配有深心形领口、金色巴洛克刺绣、华丽的珠饰紧身胸衣、蓬松的红色透明薄纱裙摆，以及雕塑感的裙撑或拖尾。她留着深色长波浪卷发，佩戴钻石项链和手链，一只手靠近嘴部，另一只手轻放在腰间。背景包括狗仔队、身着正装的宾客、绿篱、红毯和明亮的相机闪光灯。
2. 中央面板：女性以背影四分之三侧身姿态呈现，宛如空灵的月亮女神，身着冰冷的 {argument name="center gown color" default="银白色"} 一字肩星空高定礼服，配有水晶珠饰、闪烁的透明披肩、长长的飘逸拖尾、高开叉、闪亮的高跟鞋，以及半透明面料上绣着的月牙和星星图案。她回眸看向肩后，轻轻提着裙摆。背景挤满了摄影师、白花、带有星形图案的深蓝色地毯以及强烈的闪光灯摄影。
3. 右侧面板：女性正面站在优雅的楼梯上，身着合身的 {argument name="right gown color" default="黑色与古金色"} 一字肩美人鱼礼服，长袖设计，饰有厚重的对称金色刺绣、胸前的星空圆形图案、结构化的领口、修身的轮廓以及小拖尾。她梳着利落的低发髻。背景包括奶油色大理石楼梯、红毯跑道、金色立柱、身着黑色西装的警卫或服务人员以及温暖的壁灯。

视觉风格：超写实、奢华时尚杂志编辑风、Met Gala 氛围、华丽的高定剪裁、精致的金属刺绣、闪耀的水晶、电影级暖色高光、逼真的面料质感、高动态范围、优雅的姿态、精致的名人活动摄影。

约束条件：使用 3 个垂直面板和 3 套高定造型；无可见的可读文本、无 Logo、无水印。所有面部必须使用柔和的模糊块进行匿名化处理。请勿添加额外的面板、额外的模特主体或卡通风格。

templates.title: Met Gala Haute Couture Triptych

titleLocalized.zh: Met Gala 高定三联画

templates.prompt: Create a triptych series of haute couture fashion portraits showcasing three full-length or three-quarter-length red carpet portraits taken inside and outside the Metropolitan Museum of Art during the 2026 Met Gala, with all models being fictional. The images are wide-format horizontal triptychs, approximately 3:2 in proportion, with thin black vertical dividing lines between the panels, and no title or logo. The overall style is photorealistic luxury event photography, employing warm evening lighting, paparazzi flashes, shallow depth of field, realistic fabric textures, and deliberately soft-focus blurring of the subjects' faces to maintain anonymity. Left panel: A dark-haired model wearing a dramatic {argument name="red gown color" default="Deep crimson"} A Renaissance-style velvet and tulle ball gown, with a strapless sweetheart neckline, a structured corset, and opulent antique gold embroidery radiating from the torso, a voluminous skirt, and shimmering necklaces and bracelets. She stands on the red-carpeted museum steps, one hand near her mouth, the other on her hip. The background includes photographers, formally dressed guests, the red carpet, hedge-like greenery, and small red flowers. Central panel: A model poses gracefully over her shoulder, wearing a dazzling gown.{argument name="center gown color" default="Ice Silver White"} A strapless haute couture gown, complete with a sheer cape-like shawl, crystal beading, star-embroidered details, a high slit, a long train, and metallic heels. She stands on a dark evening carpet adorned with star patterns, surrounded by white floral arrangements and a dense crowd of photographers, accompanied by bright camera flashes. Right panel: A model stands frontally on magnificent cream-colored stone steps, wearing a luxurious gown {argument name="right gown color" default="Black and antique gold"} A fitted, off-the-shoulder Renaissance velvet gown with long sleeves, a fishtail cut, and exquisite Baroque gold scrollwork embroidery, an oval black and gold bodice, and a small train. The backdrop showcases an indoor museum staircase, carpeted with red carpet, featuring rope railings, security personnel in black suits, warm wall lamps, and polished architectural arches. Environmental details: The scene should create the authentic atmosphere of a Metropolitan Museum of Art dinner: grand stone steps, brown stone architecture, museum interiors, red carpet accents, formal guests, media cameras, hedges, flowers, and warm gold lighting. Visible subject count: Exactly 3 principal models, one per panel; exactly 3 haute couture gowns; exactly 3 different dinner scenes; guests and photographers in the background should be secondary elements and kept slightly blurred.{argument name="event theme" default="Renaissance portrait style velvet haute couture"} As a unified fashion concept, maintain the authenticity, appeal, and editorial feel of the images, and avoid including readable text, watermarks, extra panels, or portraits of any celebrities.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一组高定时尚三联画，展示 2026 年 Met Gala 期间，在大都会艺术博物馆内外拍摄的 3 张全身或四分之三身长的红毯肖像，模特均为虚构人物。画面为宽幅水平 3 联拼贴，比例约为 3:2，面板间有细黑色垂直分割线，无标题或 Logo。整体风格为照片级写实的奢华活动摄影，采用温暖的晚宴灯光、狗仔队闪光灯、浅景深、逼真的面料质感，并刻意对人物面部进行了柔焦模糊处理以保持匿名。

左侧面板：一位深色头发的模特，身着一件戏剧性的 {argument name="red gown color" default="深绯红色"} 文艺复兴风格天鹅绒与薄纱舞会礼服，抹胸心形领口，结构化紧身胸衣，华丽的古金色刺绣从躯干向外放射，裙摆蓬松，佩戴闪亮的项链和手镯。她站在铺着红毯的博物馆台阶上，一只手靠近嘴边，另一只手叉腰。背景包括摄影师、身着正装的嘉宾、红毯、树篱状绿植和红色小花。

中央面板：一位模特以优雅的回眸姿势出镜，身着一件光彩夺目的 {argument name="center gown color" default="冰银白色"} 一字肩高定礼服，配有透明斗篷式披肩、水晶串珠、星象刺绣细节、高开叉、长拖尾和金属质感高跟鞋。她站在铺有星形图案的深色晚宴地毯上，周围环绕着白色花艺装饰和密集的摄影师人群，伴有明亮的相机闪光灯。

右侧面板：一位模特正面站立在宏伟的奶油色石阶上，身着一件奢华的 {argument name="right gown color" default="黑色与古金色"} 修身一字肩文艺复兴天鹅绒礼服，长袖，鱼尾剪裁，饰有精致的巴洛克式金色卷草刺绣、椭圆形黑金胸部图案，并带有小拖尾。背景展示了室内博物馆楼梯，铺有红毯，设有绳索护栏、身着黑色西装的安保人员、温暖的壁灯和抛光的建筑拱门。

环境细节：场景应营造出大都会艺术博物馆晚宴的真实氛围：宏伟的石阶、棕褐色石材建筑、博物馆内饰、红毯点缀、正式嘉宾、媒体相机、树篱、鲜花和温暖的金色灯光。可见主体数量：恰好 3 位主要模特，每面板一位；恰好 3 件高定礼服；恰好 3 个不同的晚宴场景；背景中的嘉宾和摄影师应作为次要元素，并保持轻微模糊。使用 {argument name="event theme" default="文艺复兴肖像风格天鹅绒高定"} 作为统一的时尚概念。保持图像的真实感、魅力和编辑感，不要包含可读文字、水印、额外面板或任何名人的肖像。

templates.title: Four-themed Newborn Portrait Collage

titleLocalized.zh: 四主题新生儿肖像拼贴

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a 2x2 square collage containing four highly realistic newborn portrait photographs. Each image features the same baby, and the baby's face in each image should be partially obscured with a soft-edged square privacy blur, while maintaining a warm, dreamy, high-end studio feel. Canvas: A 1:1 square image precisely divided into four equal panels with no visible borders. Each panel presents a different newborn-themed scene. Employ a hyper-realistic DSLR newborn photography style with shallow depth of field, soft diffused lighting, warm highlights, and a creamy bokeh effect to showcase extremely delicate fabric and prop textures. Subject: Same baby.{argument name="baby age" default="newborn"} Appearing in all four panels, its posture serene, revealing delicate hands and feet. Use{argument name="skin tone" default="Warm light to medium skin tone"} Each panel's face must be centered and obscured by a square blur/privacy block, blending it into the surrounding skin tone to ensure facial details are unrecognizable. Layout and number of panels: Use 4 panels. 1. Top left panel: Dreamy Night Sky Moon Scene. The baby is curled up on a large ivory crescent moon prop, wrapped in a soft powder blue knit swaddle, and wearing a matching blue nightcap. The background is deep navy blue, adorned with small gold stars, fluffy white clouds, and twinkling fairy lights. Show the baby's folded arms and details of the blue pom-pom swaddle. 2. Top right panel: Forest Nest Scene. The baby is wrapped in soft sage green fabric, curled up in a coarsely woven basket or bird's nest, and wearing a beige knit cap. Surrounded by dark green leaves, wildflowers, warm golden firefly lights, and bark textures, creating a charming forest atmosphere. Tiny hands and bare feet peek out from the swaddle. 3. Bottom Left Panel: Soft Ivory White and Blush Pink Princess Scene. The baby lies on a plush white feather blanket, dressed in pale pink lace and embroidered tulle, adorned with pearls and delicate beads, and wearing a matching gorgeous hat. Surrounded by pink flowers, white feathers, creamy clouds, and soft curtains, the background is a bright and airy fairytale nursery. 4. Bottom Right Panel: Flower Garden Basket Scene. The baby lies on a pink knitted mat in a wicker basket, dressed in transparent blush pink lace and wearing a pink flower wreath. Surrounded by roses, pale pink flowers, and greenery, the background is a blurred white garden bench or crib. The baby's arms are placed in front of them, presenting a serene newborn photography composition. Visual Style: Luxurious Newborn Photography, Fantasy Fairytale Theme, Hyper-realistic Fabric Texture, Soft Pastel Color Scheme, Cinematic Warm Lighting, High Detail, Slight Vignette, Creamy Background Blur, Professional Studio Retouching. Constraints: Generate 4 different themed newborn portraits in a 2x2 collage. All faces must be covered with square privacy blur blocks. No text, watermarks, logos, extra panels, adult hands, or limb deformities. The overall atmosphere should be gentle, dreamy, and elegant.{argument name="overall color mood" default="Soft pastel blue, sage green, ivory white and blush pink"} as well as{argument name="lighting style" default="Warm, diffused fairytale-like studio lighting"} .

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张 2x2 的正方形拼贴图，包含四张高度写实的新生儿艺术摄影肖像。每张图中的婴儿为同一人，且每张图中的婴儿面部均需使用柔边方形隐私模糊遮挡，同时保持温暖、梦幻的高级摄影棚质感。

画布：正方形 1:1 图像，精确划分为 4 个等大的面板，无可见边框线，每个面板呈现不同的新生儿主题场景。采用超写实单反新生儿摄影风格，浅景深，柔和漫射光，暖色高光，奶油般虚化效果，展现极其细腻的织物与道具纹理。

主体：同一位 {argument name="baby age" default="新生儿"} 出现在所有四个面板中，姿态安详，露出精致的手脚。使用 {argument name="skin tone" default="温暖的浅至中等肤色"}。每个面板中的面部必须被居中的方形模糊/隐私遮挡块遮盖，使其与周围肤色融合，确保无法辨认面部细节。

布局与面板数量：使用 4 个面板。
1. 左上角面板：梦幻夜空月亮场景。婴儿蜷缩在巨大的象牙白新月道具上，包裹在柔软的粉蓝色针织襁褓中，戴着配套的蓝色睡帽。背景为深海军蓝，点缀着金色小星星、蓬松白云和闪烁的仙女灯。展示婴儿折叠的双臂和蓝色绒球襁褓细节。
2. 右上角面板：森林鸟巢场景。婴儿包裹在柔和的鼠尾草绿织物中，蜷缩在粗编织篮或鸟巢内，戴着米色针织帽。周围环绕深绿色叶片、小野花、温暖的金色萤火虫灯光、树皮纹理，营造出迷人的森林氛围。襁褓中露出细小的手和赤裸的脚。
3. 左下角面板：柔和象牙白与腮红粉公主场景。婴儿躺在毛绒白色羽毛毯上，身穿淡粉色蕾丝和绣花薄纱，点缀珍珠与精致珠饰，戴着配套的华丽帽子。周围环绕粉色花朵、白色羽毛、奶油色云朵、柔和帷幔，背景为明亮通透的童话育婴室。
4. 右下角面板：花卉花园篮场景。婴儿躺在柳条篮里的粉色针织垫上，身穿透明腮红粉色蕾丝装，戴着粉色花环。周围环绕玫瑰、淡粉色花朵、绿植，背景为虚化的白色花园长椅或婴儿床。婴儿双臂置于身前，呈现宁静的新生儿摄影构图。

视觉风格：奢华新生儿摄影，奇幻童话主题，超写实织物纹理，柔和粉彩配色，电影级暖光，高细节，轻微暗角，奶油般背景虚化，专业摄影棚修图。

约束条件：在 2x2 拼贴中生成 4 张不同的主题新生儿肖像。所有面部必须用方形隐私模糊块遮盖。无文字、无水印、无 Logo、无额外面板、无成人手部、无肢体畸变。整体氛围应温柔、梦幻且优雅。使用 {argument name="overall color mood" default="柔和粉蓝、鼠尾草绿、象牙白和腮红粉"} 以及 {argument name="lighting style" default="温暖漫射的童话摄影棚灯光"}。

templates.title: Natural energy drink advertisement

titleLocalized.zh: 天然能量饮料广告

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="brand name" default="Chivita Active"} Create a high-end conceptual beverage advertisement showcasing it as a natural energy booster. Canvas: A 4:5 aspect ratio vertical social media ad composition with a deep cobalt blue studio background and a matching glossy blue tabletop. Use minimalist lighting similar to Apple commercials, with ample negative space in the upper half. Layout: Place the main figure in the lower left and center: A single, tired young Black man in a plain white long-sleeved shirt, head buried in his crossed arms, leaning forward, his face mostly obscured except for short, curly hair. Place a standing beverage box in the lower right, brightly lit with clearly visible text. Between the figure and the beverage box, add a glowing orange-yellow energy line, extending from the box lid in an arc to the man's shoulder, forming a glowing battery icon above his upper arm. The battery icon should contain six fully charged segments, with a small terminal on the right, glowing like a neon light. Product Details: The beverage box is a 1-liter juice container with a white top and orange fruit graphics (citrus and grapefruit images) on the bottom. It features a white screw cap, an orange liquid splash near the top, and the word "active" printed vertically in blue. It includes smaller red branding text "chivita," the phrase "power of 6" on the side, and the small print "fortified with vitamin C." Keep the beverage box authentic and glossy, and photograph it like a professional fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) product photo. Text Content: Add two text areas. The top left title is "..."{argument name="headline text" default="recharge naturally."} The word "recharge" is written in thin white lowercase letters, "naturally" in bold white lowercase letters, and the period is orange. The central slogan at the bottom reads "{argument name="tagline text" default="active starts here."} The word "active" is in bold white, while "starts here." is in light white, with a small turquoise decorative dot above "active." Visual Style: A Cannes Lions-level conceptual beverage advertisement, featuring minimalist luxury still life, photorealistic studio photography, clear product rendering, saturated blue and orange complementary colors, soft shadows, delicate desktop reflections, high contrast, precise typography, and no clutter. Constraints: Only one person, one beverage box, one glowing cable arc, one battery icon with six battery levels, and two text areas are allowed. Do not add any additional products, actions involving holding the beverage box, additional logos, extra people, backgrounds, or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="brand name" default="Chivita Active"} 创建一个高端概念性饮料广告，将该饮料展示为一种天然的能量补充方案。

画布：4:5 比例的竖版社交媒体广告构图，深钴蓝色摄影棚背景及配套的亮面蓝色桌面，采用类似 Apple 商业广告的简洁布光，上半部分留有大量负空间。

布局：将主体人物放置在左下方及中心位置：画面中仅有 1 位疲惫的年轻黑人男性，身穿纯白色长袖衬衫，头埋在交叉的双臂上伏在桌前，身体前倾，面部大部分被遮挡，可见短卷发。在右下方放置 1 个竖立的饮料盒，光线明亮且文字清晰可见。在人物与饮料盒之间，添加 1 条发光的橙黄色能量线，从饮料盒盖弧形延伸至男性的肩膀，并在其上臂上方形成 1 个发光的电池图标。电池图标应包含 6 个充满的电量格，右侧带有小型接线端，呈现霓虹灯般的发光效果。

产品细节：饮料盒为 1 升装果汁盒，顶部为白色包装，底部有橙色水果图案、柑橘和葡萄柚图像，配有白色螺旋盖，顶部附近有橙色液体飞溅，垂直蓝色字体印有“active”；包含较小的红色品牌文字“chivita”、侧面短语“power of 6”以及小字“fortified with vitamin C”。保持饮料盒真实、有光泽，并像专业快速消费品（FMCG）产品照一样进行拍摄。

文字内容：添加 2 个文字区域。左上角标题为“{argument name="headline text" default="recharge naturally."}”，其中“recharge”使用细体白色小写字母，“naturally”使用粗体白色小写字母，句号为橙色。底部中心标语为“{argument name="tagline text" default="active starts here."}”，其中“active”为粗体白色，“starts here.”为细体白色，并在“active”一词上方添加一个小的青绿色装饰点。

视觉风格：戛纳狮子奖级别的概念性饮料广告，极简主义奢华静物，照片级真实感的摄影棚摄影，清晰的产品渲染，饱和的蓝橙互补色调，柔和的阴影，细腻的桌面反射，高对比度，精准的排版，无杂乱元素。

限制条件：仅使用 1 个人物、1 个饮料盒、1 条发光电缆弧线、1 个带有 6 个电量格的电池图标以及 2 个文字区域。请勿添加额外的产品、手持饮料盒的动作、额外的标志、多余的人物、背景或水印。

templates.title: Sprite “Pause the Heat” Advertisement

titleLocalized.zh: Sprite “Pause the Heat” 广告

templates.prompt: Create a high-end concept beverage advertisement with a 3:4 vertical composition. Place a can of chilled beverage vertically in the center of the image.{argument name="drink can" default="Sprite cans"} The can was used as the main visual element for a still life photograph of a luxury fast-moving consumer goods product. The can is a vibrant emerald green with realistic aluminum edges and a base, its surface covered in dense condensation droplets. The white Sprite logo is clearly visible on the front, topped with a yellow-green lemon icon. A dramatic left-right environmental contrast is employed: the left side of the ground is dry, cracked, and dusty, displaying an extremely hot orange-yellow hue; the right side is cold, damp, and frozen, with splattered frost and scattered ice. Behind the can, a dynamic horizontal spray and vapor burst effect is created, with warm golden dust on the left blending with cool blue-white mist on the right. The background is a deep green studio gradient with subtle vignetting and cinematic lighting. A prominent tagline block is placed in the upper left corner, containing three lines of stacked sans-serif capitalized text: the first line…{argument name="slogan line one" default="PAUSE"} "In white, line 2"{argument name="slogan line two" default="THE"} "In white, line 3"{argument name="slogan line three" default="HEAT."} The color is a bright yellow-green. The design maintains a minimalist, high-contrast, clear, and award-winning quality, with an Apple-level commercial feel, realistic reflections, sharp product focus, shallow depth of field, and no additional logos, people, hands, straws, fruit slices, or other cans in the image.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 3:4 竖构图的高端概念饮料广告。画面中心垂直放置一罐冰镇 {argument name="drink can" default="Sprite 易拉罐"}，将其作为奢侈快消品静物主视觉进行拍摄。易拉罐呈现鲜艳的翠绿色，具有逼真的铝制边缘和底座，表面布满浓密的冷凝水珠，正面清晰可见白色的 Sprite 标志，上方配有黄绿色的柠檬青柠图标。采用戏剧性的左右环境对比概念：地面左侧干燥、开裂、布满尘土，呈现出极度炎热的橙黄色；右侧则寒冷、潮湿、冰封，伴有飞溅的霜花和零散的冰块。在易拉罐后方，营造出动态的水平喷雾与水汽爆发效果，左侧温暖的金色尘埃与右侧清冷的蓝白色雾气交融。背景为深绿色摄影棚渐变色，带有微妙的暗角和电影级布光。在左上方放置一个醒目的标语块，包含 3 行堆叠的无衬线大写文本：第 1 行 “{argument name="slogan line one" default="PAUSE"}” 为白色，第 2 行 “{argument name="slogan line two" default="THE"}” 为白色，第 3 行 “{argument name="slogan line three" default="HEAT."}” 为亮黄绿色。设计保持极简、高对比度、清晰且具有获奖水准，具备 Apple 级别的商业质感，拥有逼真的反射效果、锐利的产品焦点、浅景深，且画面中不包含额外的标志、人物、手部、吸管、水果切片或其他易拉罐。

templates.title: Malta Guinness Inner Strength Advertisement

titleLocalized.zh: Malta Guinness 内在力量广告

templates.prompt: for{argument name="product name" default="Malta Guinness"} Create a high-end concept beverage advertisement centered on an ice-cold aluminum can set against a seamless, saturated gold-orange studio backdrop. The can stands upright, facing the camera directly, dominating the frame, featuring realistic condensation droplets, a metallic rim, and warm shadows on its lower surface. The label is gold at the top and a deep dark red at the bottom, with a black harp icon printed above the bold "Malta" and "GUINNESS" below. The label in the center of the can is presented as if torn horizontally, curling outwards like thick paper; inside the tear is a cinematic, glowing scene: the silhouette of an athlete running through dust towards a brilliant sunset, symbolizing inner strength and endurance. Utilizing dramatic golden backlighting from inside the can, the advertisement employs a high-end FMCG photography style, luxurious still-life aesthetics, clear product details, minimalist composition, and an Apple-level commercial feel. It contains five clearly visible text elements: 1) Top heading “nourishment that strengthens,” with “strengthens” in bold; 2) Main product label “Malta”; 3) Brand text “GUINNESS”; 4) Text below the label “VITALITY · GOODNESS · ENERGY” and smaller text “NON ALCOHOLIC MALT DRINK”; 5) Bottom tagline “real strength starts within,” with “within” in bold. The layout maintains a modern feel, uses dark brown/black, is centered, and has ample white space. The emotional concept should be…{argument name="concept" default="real strength starts within"} The beverage type should be displayed as follows:{argument name="drink type" default="non alcoholic malt drink"} Avoid adding extra jars, extra athletes, cluttered elements, hands, ice cubes, water splashes, or any other extra text.

promptLocalized.zh: 为 {argument name="product name" default="Malta Guinness"} 创建一个高端概念饮料广告，画面中心为一个置于无缝饱和金橙色摄影棚背景下的冰镇铝罐。罐体直立、正对镜头、占据画面主体，带有逼真的冷凝水珠、金属罐沿，以及下方表面上的温暖阴影。标签上半部分为金色，下半部分为深暗红色，在粗体的“Malta”和下方的“GUINNESS”字样上方印有黑色竖琴图标。罐体中部标签呈现出水平撕开的效果，如同厚纸般向左右两侧卷曲；撕裂处内部是一个电影质感的发光场景，一名运动员剪影正穿过尘埃向着灿烂的夕阳奔跑，象征着内在的力量与耐力。使用来自罐体内部戏剧性的金色背光射线，采用高端快消品摄影风格、奢华静物造型、清晰的产品细节、简洁的极简主义构图，以及 Apple 级别的商业质感。包含 5 个清晰可见的文本元素：1) 顶部标题“nourishment that strengthens”，其中“strengthens”加粗；2) 主要产品字标“Malta”；3) 品牌文本“GUINNESS”；4) 标签下方的行文“VITALITY · GOODNESS · ENERGY”以及小字“NON ALCOHOLIC MALT DRINK”；5) 底部标语“real strength starts within”，其中“within”加粗。排版保持现代感、深棕色/黑色、居中且留白充足。情感概念应为 {argument name="concept" default="real strength starts within"}；饮料类型应显示为 {argument name="drink type" default="non alcoholic malt drink"}。避免出现额外的罐子、额外的运动员、杂乱元素、手部、冰块、水花或任何其他额外文本。

templates.title: Coca-Cola Zipper World Advertising

titleLocalized.zh: Coca-Cola 拉链世界广告

templates.prompt: for{argument name="brand name" default="Coca-Cola"} Create a 4:5 vertical advertisement for a high-end concept beverage. The center of the image features a chilled red aluminum soda can facing the camera, its surface covered in realistic condensation droplets. A silver pull tab and rim are visible at the top, and the can bears a classic white handwritten logo, along with smaller text reading "ORIGINAL TASTE." The background is a uniformly saturated red studio backdrop with luxurious commercial lighting and soft product projection. A large metal zipper spans the image and wraps around the center of the can, its teeth clearly detailed, with the zipper pull positioned at the front. The zipper opens the scene, revealing two contrasting worlds: on the left, a warm orange sunset over a calm water horizon with a distant silhouette of a city skyline; on the right, a cool-toned blue snow-capped mountain landscape with frosted pine trees and mountains. The zipper seams should curve naturally like waves, visually suggesting the magical world within the can. Add minimalist white text: centered at the top.{argument name="top slogan" default="open happiness"} The word "happiness" is bolded and centered at the bottom.{argument name="bottom slogan" default="real magic is inside"} The word "inside" is bolded, and a small white Coca-Cola logo is placed below it. The photograph employs a hyper-realistic fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) style, featuring sharp macro details, glossy reflections, balanced red-orange-blue color contrast, Apple-level minimalist composition, and a Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity aesthetic. There are no extraneous objects, people, or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 为 {argument name="brand name" default="Coca-Cola"} 创作一则 4:5 竖版的高端概念饮料广告。画面中央是一个正对镜头的冰镇红色铝制汽水罐，罐身布满逼真的冷凝水珠，顶部可见银色拉环和罐沿，罐身印有经典的白色手写体 Logo；包含较小的罐身文字“ORIGINAL TASTE”。背景为饱和度均匀的红色摄影棚背景，采用奢华商业照明，并带有柔和的产品投影。一条大型金属拉链横跨画面并在罐身中部环绕，拉链齿细节清晰，拉链头位于罐身前方；拉链将场景打开，呈现出两个对比鲜明的世界：左侧是平静水面地平线上温暖的橙色日落，远处有微小的城市天际线剪影；右侧是冷色调的蓝色雪山景观，伴有挂霜的松树和山脉。拉链缝隙应像波浪一样自然弯曲，直观地暗示罐内蕴含着神奇的世界。添加极简的白色广告文案：顶部居中书写 {argument name="top slogan" default="open happiness"}，其中“happiness”加粗；底部居中书写 {argument name="bottom slogan" default="real magic is inside"}，其中“inside”加粗；在其下方放置一个小型的白色 Coca-Cola Logo。采用超写实快消品 (FMCG) 产品摄影风格，具备清晰的微距细节、光泽反射、平衡的红-橙-蓝色彩对比、Apple 级的极简构图、戛纳国际创意节风格，无额外物体，无人物，无水印。

templates.title: Retro-futuristic perfume advertisement

titleLocalized.zh: 复古未来主义香水广告

templates.prompt: A high-fashion perfume advertisement shot in a vibrant retro-futuristic studio. In the foreground, a large hand dramatically reaches towards the camera, fingers slightly spread, creating an illusion of forced perspective. A rounded, soft shape is placed in the center of the midground.{argument name="bottle color" default="Peach pink"} Glass perfume bottle, labeled "{argument name="product name" default="DUNE — Eau de Toilette — Christian Dior Paris"} The perfume bottle features a rose gold spherical cap and neck. In the background, a young woman with a short brown bob and bangs wears oversized white cat-eye sunglasses, a pale pink satin bomber jacket, a white cropped top, and a denim mini-skirt. She leans forward, her expression conveying surprise or longing, as if reaching for the perfume bottle. The setting is a clean photography studio with bright cyan/sky blue walls and white geometric tiles with blue stripes on the floor. The lighting is sharp, editorial, and high-contrast with soft shadows. The overall atmosphere is playful, bold, and modern, full of Y2K aesthetics. A wide-angle lens was used to exaggerate depth and proportion. Photorealistic, commercial photography style.

templates.title: A cartoon portrait that maintains a consistent identity

titleLocalized.zh: 保持身份一致的漫画肖像

templates.prompt: Use the uploaded portrait as an identity reference for the subject's face, hairstyle, facial structure, and overall impression. Create a high-quality lifestyle editorial portrait showing the same person sitting outdoors next to a wooden easel displaying a brightly colored street-style cartoon portrait. The real person and the cartoon must clearly represent the same person. Scene: - The subject sits on a simple wooden folding chair - Next to a wooden easel displaying a large cartoon artwork - The background is a charming urban art market - Including illustration stalls, craft stalls, sketch displays, posters, cozy creative shops, and a few softly blurred pedestrians - Lively but not crowded atmosphere - Bright, soft sunlight, warm natural tones, shallow depth of field - Realistic photographic style for both the subject and environment - Vertical composition, clearly showing both the subject and the cartoon. Subject: - Retain the identifiable features of the uploaded person - Natural pose - Calm, relaxed, and slightly cheerful expression - Stylish casual attire suitable for the subject - Clean, editorial lifestyle style - Don't force every subject to use the same pose or expression. Comic Strip Direction: - The artwork on the easel must be authentic street observation comics, not generic cute cartoons. - Cartoonists should exaggerate the most prominent facial features of the subject. - Analyze the uploaded face and exaggerate only 2–4 unique features, such as eye shape, eyebrows, nose, lips, cheeks, jawline, chin, ears, hairstyle, or facial proportions. - Each comic should feel tailor-made for that specific character. - Avoid using the same default cute face shape for everyone. - Avoid generic "big eyes and tongue sticking out" expressions. - Comics are funny because they capture the unique features of the character, not because they use random, comical poses. Comic Strip Style: - Large head, small body proportions - Funny but recognizable facial proportions - Bold hand-drawn marker lines - Fast sketch strokes - Colored pencil texture - Active street artist style - Humorous and endearing - Witty, expressive, and full of personality - Charming handmade imperfections - Brightly colored decorative graffiti can be added, but the focus should be on the face. Cartoon Expressions: - Choose natural, humorous expressions that match the character's facial features. - Optional expressions: raised eyebrow, shy smile, surprised look, confident mischievous grin, awkward polite smile, exaggeratedly calm face, pout, confused cute face, or gentle, blank stare. - Expressions should vary depending on the subject. - Don't always use the tongue-out expression. - Don't always use the same wide-eyed cute expression. Cartoon Canvas: - A large vertical easel or canvas on a wooden easel. - The cartoon should be clearly visible and occupy the main part of the image. - It should be immediately recognizable as a slapstick street cartoon. - It should be more exaggerated than a portrait sketch. - It shouldn't look like a realistic fashion illustration. - It shouldn't look like a delicate beauty painting. Important Notes: - The cartoon must be a custom work specifically for the uploaded character. - Retain an identifiable identity through exaggerated features. - Prioritize personality, similarity, and humor over generic cuteness. - Make the cartoon look like a whimsical, exaggerated version of the character drawn by a real street artist. Negative Notes: - No generic cute chibi faces - No repetitive default cartoon faces - No tongue-out poses - No using the same funny expressions for every subject - No random anime expressions - No realistic portrait sketches - No elaborate fashion illustrations - No beauty sketches - No subtle exaggerations - No horrible grotesque distortions - No ugly, grotesque exaggerations - No distortions of realistic body structures - No extra fingers - No poorly drawn hands - No cluttered, crowded backgrounds - No text - No watermarks - No Eiffel Tower - No famous landmarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用上传的肖像作为主体面部、发型、面部结构和整体印象的身份参考。创作一张高质量的生活方式编辑风格肖像，展示同一个人坐在户外，旁边是一个木制画架，上面展示着一张色彩鲜艳的街头风格漫画肖像。真人与漫画必须清楚地呈现为同一个人。场景：- 人物坐在一把简单的木制折叠椅上 - 旁边是一个放置着大型漫画画作的木制画架 - 背景是一个充满情怀的城市艺术市集 - 包含插画摊位、手工工艺品摊位、素描展示、海报、温馨的创意店面，以及少量柔和模糊的行人 - 氛围活跃但不拥挤 - 明亮柔和的日光，温暖的自然色调，浅景深 - 人物和环境采用写实摄影风格 - 垂直构图，清晰展示人物和漫画。主体：- 保留上传人物可识别的身份特征 - 自然的姿势 - 冷静、放松、略带愉悦的表情 - 适合主体的时尚休闲装扮 - 干净的编辑风格生活照 - 不要强求每个主体都采用相同的姿势或表情。漫画方向：- 画架上的画作必须是真实的街头观察漫画，而非通用的可爱卡通 - 漫画家应夸大主体最显著的面部特征 - 分析上传的面部，仅夸大 2–4 个独特特征，例如眼形、眉毛、鼻子、嘴唇、脸颊、下颌线、下巴、耳朵、发型或面部比例 - 每张漫画都应感觉是为该特定人物量身定制的 - 避免对每个人使用相同的默认可爱脸型 - 避免通用的“大眼睛加吐舌头”表情 - 漫画之所以有趣，是因为它捕捉到了人物独特的特征，而不是因为它使用了随机的滑稽姿势。漫画风格：- 大头小身体的比例 - 有趣但可识别的面部比例 - 大胆的手绘马克笔线条 - 快速的素描笔触 - 彩色铅笔质感 - 活跃的街头艺术家风格 - 幽默且讨喜 - 诙谐、富有表现力且充满个性 - 迷人的手工不完美感 - 可以添加色彩鲜艳的装饰涂鸦，但重点应放在面部。漫画表情：- 选择符合人物面部特征的自然幽默表情 - 可选表情：挑眉、羞涩微笑、惊讶眼神、自信坏笑、尴尬礼貌微笑、夸张的冷静脸、嘟嘴、困惑可爱的脸或温柔的呆滞凝视 - 表情应根据主体而变化 - 不要总是使用吐舌头表情 - 不要总是使用相同的瞪大眼睛的可爱表情。漫画画布：- 木制画架上的大型垂直画板或画布 - 漫画应清晰可见，并占据画面的主要部分 - 应能一眼看出是滑稽的街头漫画 - 应比肖像素描更具夸张感 - 不应看起来像写实的时尚插画 - 不应看起来像精致的美妆画作。重要提示：- 漫画必须是针对上传人物的定制作品 - 通过夸张的特征保留可识别的身份 - 优先考虑个性、相似度和幽默感，而非通用的可爱感 - 让漫画看起来像是真实的街头艺术家观察了该人物并画出的诙谐夸张版本。负面提示：- 没有通用的可爱 Q 版脸 - 没有重复的默认漫画脸 - 没有吐舌头姿势 - 没有对每个主体使用相同的滑稽表情 - 没有随机的动漫表情 - 没有写实肖像素描 - 没有精致的时尚插画 - 没有美妆素描 - 没有微弱的夸张 - 没有可怕的怪诞扭曲 - 没有丑陋的恐怖夸张 - 没有真人身体结构的扭曲 - 没有多余的手指 - 没有画得糟糕的手 - 没有杂乱拥挤的背景 - 没有文字 - 没有水印 - 没有埃菲尔铁塔 - 没有著名地标。

templates.title: Trash Polka digital city painting

titleLocalized.zh: Trash Polka 城市数字绘画

templates.prompt: A richly detailed digital painting depicts a young woman wearing bright red oversized headphones, staring sharply at the viewer. The art style blends stylized realism with urban abstract expressionism. Her hair is tousled, a light brown/gold color, interspersed with sharp geometric fragments. Compositional features include heavy ink splatters, paint drips, and chaotic red and black brushstrokes reminiscent of "Trash Polka" art. The clean, off-white background further emphasizes the striking red accents and fine lines. High contrast, focused on the eyes, cinematic lighting, 8K resolution, and trendy street art aesthetics. Key technical elements to capture: Color palette: Primarily red, black, and white. This high-contrast triad is crucial for creating that impactful modern feel. Artistic influence: Mentioning "Trash Polka" or "Ink Drip Art" helps the AI ​​understand the messy background splatter effects and the "broken" feel of the hair. Character traits: Using terms like "sharp gaze" and "stylized realism," the face is designed to strike a perfect middle ground between overly cartoonish and overly realistic expressions, achieving a balance within the realm of "concept art." Graphic elements: The image utilizes geometric fragments and abstract textures overlapping the subject to create a sense of depth and digital glitch. Aspect ratio: 9:16.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅细节丰富的数字绘画，描绘了一位戴着鲜艳红色大号头戴式耳机的年轻女性，她正以锐利的目光直视观者。艺术风格融合了风格化写实主义与城市抽象表现主义。她的头发凌乱，呈浅棕色/金色，发丝间融入了尖锐的几何碎片。构图特色包括浓重的墨迹飞溅、油漆滴落，以及令人联想到“Trash Polka”艺术风格的混乱红黑色笔触。背景为简洁的米白色，使醒目的红色点缀和精细的线条更加突出。高对比度，焦点集中在双眼，电影级光效，8k 分辨率，潮流街头艺术美学。需捕捉的关键技术要素：调色板：以红色、黑色和白色为主。这种高对比度的三色组合对于营造那种极具冲击力的现代感至关重要。艺术影响：提及“Trash Polka”或“Ink Drip Art”有助于 AI 理解凌乱的背景飞溅效果以及头发的“破碎”感。角色特征：使用“锐利目光”和“风格化写实主义”等术语，确保面部既不会过于卡通化也不会过于写实，达到“概念艺术”完美的中间地带。图形元素：图像使用了与主体重叠的几何碎片和抽象纹理，营造出深度感和数字故障感。长宽比为 9:16

templates.title: The emotional path of life's turning point

titleLocalized.zh: 人生转折的情感路径

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic visual image titled "THE PEOPLE WE BECOME." The image should depict multiple stages of a person's life simultaneously existing within an interconnected environment shaped by memories, growth, and emotional transitions. Avoid the following: - Inspirational posters, - Stepped timelines, - or collages of individual portraits. Instead, the world itself should evolve naturally between life stages, as if memories are physically merging. The composition follows a winding stone path, traversing seamlessly connected emotional spaces within the image. Bottom of the image: A newborn sleeps in a softly lit woven cradle beside a dim bedside lamp. The atmosphere is warm, tranquil, and pure. Nearby: - ​​Folded baby blankets, - Soft shadows, - Wooden toys, - Faint moonlight filtering through the curtains, - Dust particles floating in the warm air. The path slowly transitions to early childhood. A child runs barefoot across the living room, the floor littered with crayons, comic books, paper airplanes, and unfinished toy structures. Afternoon sunlight streamed through the large windows, casting soft shadows on the wooden floor. The environment gradually shifted without any apparent break in the flow. The next version appears around age 13: sitting alone on the rooftop, wearing headphones and holding a notebook in the light rain. The distant city lights blurred softly behind him, and unfinished sketches lay scattered around him. The atmosphere became quieter and filled with emotional uncertainty. Continuing along the path: the college version studies late at night at a cluttered desk, illuminated only by a warm-colored desk lamp and the laptop screen. Around him: - marked textbooks, - a coffee cup, - handwritten notes, - weariness, - ambition, - and loneliness. Rain cast soft shadows on the apartment window behind him. At the highest point of the composition: the older version stands quietly on a hillside path, overlooking the city skyline at sunrise. He appears calm, not triumphant. His attire is simple and unpretentious: rolled-up sleeves, a slightly weary posture, hands in pockets, and the wind gently ruffling his shirt. He should be clearly perceived as the same person shaped by each preceding stage. The transitions between life stages should contain subtle symbolic continuity: - flowers sprouting from concrete cracks, - notebook pages merging into city architecture, - rain reflections becoming skyline lights, - old paintings subtly appearing on apartment walls, - childhood objects partially hidden in later environments. Typography should remain minimalist and restrained. Small serif fonts should be naturally placed near each stage: "Wonder," "Becoming," "Doubt," "Discipline," and "Perspective." No inspirational quotes. No oversized fonts. Light and shadow should evolve throughout the image with emotion: - the warm, soft tones of childhood, - the cool, rainy atmosphere of adolescence, - the solitary tungsten light of school years, - the balanced sunrise of adulthood. Realism is rooted in reality: - Believable facial continuity across all ages, - Natural environmental textures, - Subtle lens soft focus, - Realistic lighting and shadow, - Physically believable spaces, - A quiet, cinematic atmosphere. Images should evoke intimacy and reflection, rather than grandiose or overly dramatic. Emotions: Memory, identity, growth, loneliness, ambition, emotional evolution, and the quiet passage of time.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张名为“THE PEOPLE WE BECOME”的电影感视觉图像。画面应描绘一个人生命中多个阶段同时存在于一个由记忆、成长和情感转折所塑造的相互关联的环境中。避免以下感觉：- 励志海报，- 阶梯式时间轴，- 或拼贴在一起的独立肖像。相反，世界本身应在生命阶段之间自然演变，仿佛记忆在物理层面相互融合。构图遵循一条蜿蜒的石径，穿过图像中无缝连接的不同情感空间。画面底部：一个新生儿在昏暗的床头灯旁，睡在光线柔和的编织摇篮里。氛围温暖、宁静且纯粹。附近：- 折叠的婴儿毯，- 柔和的阴影，- 木制玩具，- 透过窗帘的微弱月光，- 在暖空气中漂浮的尘埃颗粒。路径缓慢过渡到童年早期。一个小孩赤脚跑过客厅，地上散落着蜡笔、漫画书、纸飞机和未完成的玩具结构。午后的阳光透过大窗户倾泻而入，在木地板上投下柔和的倒影。环境在没有明显割裂的情况下逐渐变化。下一个版本出现在 13 岁左右：独自坐在屋顶上，在细雨中戴着耳机，拿着笔记本。远处的城市灯光在他身后柔和地模糊，未完成的草图散落在身旁。氛围变得更加安静且充满情感上的不确定性。沿着路径继续：大学时期的版本在深夜的杂乱书桌前学习，仅由暖色台灯和笔记本电脑屏幕照亮。他周围：- 标记过的教科书，- 咖啡杯，- 手写笔记，- 疲惫，- 雄心，- 以及孤独。雨水在他身后的公寓窗户上投下柔和的倒影。在构图的最高点：年长版本安静地站在山坡小径上，俯瞰着日出时的城市天际线。他看起来很平静，而非胜利。他的穿着简单而朴实：卷起的袖口，略显疲惫的姿态，双手插兜，风轻轻吹动他的衬衫。他应该让人明显感觉到是同一个被之前每个阶段所塑造的人。生命阶段之间的过渡应包含微妙的象征性连续性：- 从混凝土裂缝中长出的花朵，- 笔记本页面融入城市建筑，- 雨水倒影变成天际线灯光，- 旧画作隐约出现在公寓墙壁上，- 童年物品部分隐藏在后期的环境中。排版应保持极简和克制。在每个阶段附近自然放置小号衬线字体：“Wonder”（惊奇）。“Becoming”（蜕变）。“Doubt”（怀疑）。“Discipline”（自律）。“Perspective”（视角）。没有励志名言。没有超大字体。光影应在整张图像中随情感演变：- 童年温暖柔和的色调，- 青少年时期阴雨凉爽的氛围，- 学习岁月里孤寂的钨丝灯光，- 成年时期平衡的日出光线。写实感应扎根于现实：- 各个年龄段可信的面部连续性，- 自然的环境纹理，- 微妙的镜头柔焦，- 真实的光影表现，- 物理上可信的空间，- 安静的电影感氛围。图像应给人以亲密和反思的感觉，而非宏大或过度戏剧化。情绪：记忆、身份、成长、孤独、雄心、情感演变以及时光的静谧流逝。

她穿着黑色细肩带上衣，宽松的白色开衫随意地挂在双肩上，下身穿着褪色的蓝色牛仔裤。她转过头侧身大笑，表情自然随性，几缕发丝柔和地垂在脸颊上。

小型相机强烈的直射闪光灯在她的脸部和开衫上形成了鲜明的高光，同时弱化了背景阴影，营造出地道的怀旧数码相机美学。轻微的动态模糊和数字噪点增强了抓拍的真实感。

LCD 屏幕上可见相机 UI 叠加层，包括 {argument name="timestamp" default="2012 年 8 月 1 日 凌晨 3:15"}、曝光数据“1/30 F3.4 ISO 100”、对焦指示器以及角落里一个小小的绿色电池图标。

图像保留了可见的屏幕像素结构、轻微的眩光反射、色差柔和度以及压缩后的数字质感。LCD 之外，周围的黑暗平滑地过渡为模糊，突显了发光的怀旧屏幕。

拍摄效果模仿 2010 年代初正宗的 Sony Cyber-shot 卡片机，采用 CCD 传感器，呈现出复古的数字渲染效果和不完美的闪光灯曝光。

The clothing should be realistic yet stylish, without needing to be completely identical in details. templates.title: Summer Garden Rose Selfie

titleLocalized.zh: 夏日花园玫瑰自拍

templates.prompt: The uploaded portrait is used solely as a reference for identification. Only the person's real facial features, face shape, proportions, skin tone, hairstyle, hair texture, and overall natural appearance should be considered. Do not copy the original clothing, background, lighting, expression, or image quality from the uploaded portrait. The generated person must still look like the same real person. Do not replace the person with someone else. Do not over-beautify. Do not make the skin look plastic. Do not make it look like an anime or doll. Create a highly realistic outdoor summer garden selfie using a vertical composition. The framing should be farther than a close-up selfie, showing more of the upper body and part of the clothing, presenting a natural outstretched arm selfie perspective. The subject should look directly at the camera with a soft, natural, and relaxed expression, with a slight smile. The head can be slightly tilted, and both arms should be naturally extended towards the camera, presenting a natural selfie pose. The perspective should have the feel of a real handheld phone selfie, with a slight wide-angle distortion, but not exaggerated. The scene is set in a bright outdoor flower field, with blooming purple roses, lush green leaves, and a clear blue sky as the backdrop. The flower wall should feel dense, vibrant, fresh, and full of summer vibes. The main character wears a woven straw hat with a wide brim trimmed with delicate white lace. The hat can incorporate subtle summer embellishments, such as small white frangipani flowers and tiny starfish accessories, keeping the look elegant and playful rather than cartoonish. Suitable summer clothing will be automatically generated based on the uploaded person's appearance and temperament. Don't limit yourself to a specific design, but make it stylish, natural, feminine, and suitable for a sunny garden selfie. The clothing should harmonize with the purple rose environment; light purple or other soft summer hues are recommended. The fabric should look realistic, with natural textures and folds. Use strong but realistic natural summer sunlight. Let the sunlight filter through the hat, casting delicate dappled shadows on the face, shoulders, and arms. Keep the light bright, warm, and fresh, but avoid overexposing the face. Retain natural skin texture, fine pores, realistic highlights, natural lip color, and realistic eye catchlights. Hair should have realistic texture with a few loose strands and soft, sunlit edges. The overall image should look like a high-quality, realistic smartphone or digital camera selfie, with a realistic photographic feel, natural depth of field, vibrant floral colors, and a clean, dreamy summer atmosphere. No text, no watermark, no logo, no AI tags, no borders. Negative Prompts: Watermark, text, logo, AI tags, signature, borders, low resolution, blurred face, incorrect identity, face mismatch.

promptLocalized.zh:
仅将我上传的人像作为身份参考。仅参考该人物真实的五官特征、脸型、比例、肤色、发型、发质以及整体的自然外貌。请勿复制上传人像中的原始服装、背景、光影、表情或图像质量。生成的人物必须看起来仍是同一位真实的人。请勿将人物替换为他人。请勿过度美颜。请勿使皮肤看起来像塑料。请勿使其呈现动漫感或玩偶感。

创作一张高度写实的户外夏日花园自拍，采用竖构图。取景范围应比近距离自拍更远，展示更多的上半身和部分服装，呈现自然的伸展手臂自拍视角。主体直视镜头，表情柔和、自然、放松，带着淡淡的微笑。头部可以略微倾斜，双臂应自然伸向镜头，呈现自然的自拍姿势。视角应具有真实手持手机自拍的感觉，带有轻微的广角畸变，但不要过于夸张。

场景设定在明亮的户外花海中，背景是盛开的紫色玫瑰、茂密的绿叶和湛蓝的天空。花墙应感觉浓密、生动、清新且充满夏日气息。主体戴着一顶编织草帽，帽檐宽大，边缘饰有精致的白色蕾丝。帽子可以包含微妙的夏日装饰，如白色小鸡蛋花和小型海星配饰，保持造型优雅俏皮，而非卡通化。

根据上传人物的外貌和气质自动生成合适的夏日服装。不要局限于某一种特定的服装设计，但要使其时尚、自然、具有女性魅力，并适合阳光明媚的花园自拍。服装应与紫色玫瑰的环境相协调，建议选用浅紫色或其他柔和的夏日色调。服装面料应看起来真实，具有自然的纹理和褶皱。

使用强烈但写实的自然夏日阳光。让阳光透过帽子，在脸部、肩膀和手臂上投射出精致的斑驳光影。保持光线明亮、温暖、清新，但不要让脸部过度曝光。保留自然的皮肤纹理、细微的毛孔、写实的高光、自然的唇色以及真实的眼神光。头发应具有真实的质感和几缕散落的发丝，边缘带有柔和的阳光轮廓光。

整体图像应看起来像一张高质量的真实智能手机自拍或数码相机自拍，具有真实的摄影写实感、自然的景深、鲜艳的花卉色彩以及干净、梦幻的夏日氛围。无文字、无水印、无 Logo、无 AI 标签、无边框。

水印，文字，Logo，AI 标签，签名，边框，低分辨率，脸部模糊，身份错误，脸部不匹配

She possesses a mature and graceful figure, with soft shoulders, a natural waistline, and rounded hips and thighs, showcasing a gentle, sweet, and elegant feminine beauty. She has a delicate and lovely face, fair skin, bright, large eyes, a straight nose, and a soft, natural smile, resembling a sweet Japanese doll. Her hairstyle is {argument name="hairstyle" default="Long black pigtails"} The character features soft bangs and a white ruffled maid headdress adorned with pink bows and cat ears. The outfit is a Japanese-style sweet black and pink maid outfit: a tight-fitting short-sleeved pink top with a large black bow and white ruffled collar and cuffs, paired with a black tutu skirt, multi-layered white aprons, and pink bow details. The scene is a cozy pink bedroom with pink bedding, a plush teddy bear, pink curtains, and light-colored furniture. Soft natural light streams in through the windows, creating a creamy soft-focus effect, accompanied by luminous particles and a shallow depth of field. The color scheme is predominantly pink, white, and black. The overall atmosphere is sweet, dreamy, and exquisite, boasting high-quality 3D CG character textures, clear skin details, delicate lighting, and 8K master-level image quality.

promptLocalized.zh:
一位成年奇幻女性角色，采用精致的 3D CG 插画风格，具有超高细节和 9:16 竖构图，坐在 {argument name="character theme" default="粉色梦幻女仆"} 主题的 {argument name="scene" default="卧室场景"} 中柔软的粉色床上。

角色位于画面中心，面向镜头，以自然挺拔的姿态跪坐，身体微微前倾。她体态成熟且曲线优美，双肩柔和，腰线自然，臀部和大腿圆润，展现出温柔、甜美且优雅的女性美。她拥有精致可爱的面容，皮肤白皙，明亮的大眼睛，鼻梁挺拔，带着柔和自然的微笑，宛如甜美的日本娃娃。她的发型是 {argument name="hairstyle" default="黑色长双马尾"}，配有柔顺的刘海，以及带有粉色蝴蝶结和猫耳装饰的白色荷叶边女仆头饰。

服装为日式甜美风格的黑粉色女仆装，紧身短袖粉色上衣配有大号黑色蝴蝶结和白色荷叶边领口及袖口，搭配黑色蓬蓬裙、多层白色围裙和粉色蝴蝶结细节。场景为温馨的粉色卧室，配有粉色寝具、毛绒泰迪熊、粉色窗帘和浅色家具。柔和的自然光透过窗户射入，营造出奶油般的柔焦效果，伴有发光粒子和浅景深。

色调以粉色、白色和黑色为主。整体氛围甜美、梦幻且精致，具有高质量的 3D CG 人像质感、清晰的皮肤细节、细腻的光影以及 8K 大师级画质。

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华杂志风毕业照

templates.prompt: Based on 1-3 clear personal photos uploaded by the user, please generate 8 high-end, professionally retouched graduation portraits with different compositions, all in a 3:4 vertical aspect ratio. Theme: "High-end Luxury Magazine-Style Graduation Photos". Overall style reference: Korean high-end fashion magazine graduation visual aesthetics + high-end studio shooting quality + Chinese university academic gown system + emotional close-up portraits + fashion magazine cover feel. Note: The core of this set of photos is not ordinary graduation snapshots or assembly-line studio photos, but rather: "A set of high-quality graduation close-up visual masterpieces, like those shot in a Chinese fashion magazine." The overall output should have a magazine cover quality. --- ## I. Customizable Parameters - [Degree Level]: Bachelor's - [Major]: Management - [University Atmosphere]: Finance and Economics University - [Academic Attire]: Processed according to the general standards for academic attire in Chinese universities, with minor adjustments to the drape/shawl/color based on the major - [Main Scene Atmosphere]: Minimalist studio/ Red auditorium backdrop/ White background studio/ Dark gray background/ Graduation ceremony podium/ Certificate studio scene - [Prop Preferences]: Degree certificate/ Graduation certificate/ Certificate photo frame/ Bouquet/ Podium/ Bachelor's cap/ School emblem elements/ Chinese university graduation souvenir props - [Character Temperament]: Restrained sophistication/ Cool elegance/ Confidence/ Youthful elite feeling/ Gentle joy/ Lively and playful - [Jewelry and Accessories]: Minimalist ring/ Watch/ Earrings - [Shooting Focus]: Close-up texture/ Clothing details/ Facial texture/ Hand gestures/ Magazine feel --- ## II. Character Consistency Please strictly retain the user's real identity characteristics, including but not limited to: - Face shape - Facial proportions - eye shape - nose shape - lip shape - skin tone - perceived age - basic hairstyle - body shape - overall temperament. All 8 photos must clearly present the same real face. Do not turn it into a stranger, do not overly Westernize it, do not create a generic "internet celebrity" face, do not excessively smooth the skin, and do not create an AI "fake face." The subject's temperament should retain a genuine sense of sophistication, as if the person has been upgraded to a high-end graduation magazine visual shoot, not transformed into another professional model. Please use the uploaded photos only as a reference for identity; do not retain the real background, everyday clothing, or original composition of the photos. --- ## III. Overall Positioning The core positioning of this set of photos is: "Chinese academic gown graduation photos x Korean high-end fashion magazine aesthetics x close-up textured visuals." This set of photos must simultaneously possess: 1. A clear graduation theme; 2. Clear characteristics of Chinese university academic gowns; 3. A clear fashion magazine feel; 4. Clear close-up/portrait detail; 5. Clear emotions and character expression; 6. Clear logic of Chinese graduation scenes and props. This is not an ordinary commemorative graduation photo, but rather: "like a cover story shot for graduation season by a high-end Chinese fashion magazine." Overall aesthetic reference keywords: - High-end Korean magazine feel - Calm and sophisticated - Minimalist studio shooting - Stylish graduation portrait - Clean and crisp composition - Prominent facial and hand details - Clear details of clothing and certificates - Combining solemnity and youthfulness - A touch of ceremony and slight drama --- ## IV. Clothing Requirements (Focus on Chinese Style) Clothing must clearly use the Chinese university academic gown/robe system, not Western-style graduation gowns or Japanese/Korean school uniform-style graduation attire. ### Core Clothing Requirements: - Clearly retain the silhouette of Chinese university academic gowns. - Retain the standard square graduation cap. - Retain the tassels. - Retain the Chinese academic gown drape/shawl/trimming system that matches the [degree level] and [major]. - Clothing details should be high-end, clean, and neat, with a studio feel. - The academic gown must be instantly recognizable as a Chinese version. - Do not make it look like a Western graduation gown. - Do not make it look like a stage costume. - Do not make it look like cheap photo studio clothing. ### Degree Level Differentiation: Please reflect different temperaments according to the [degree level]: - Bachelor: Younger, fresher, lighter, and more youthful. - Master: More mature, restrained, intellectual, and with a stronger sense of elite. - Doctor: More solemn, more academic, with a stronger sense of authority and ceremony. ### Major Expression: Please naturally reflect the professional attributes of the [major] through subtle adjustments to the drape color, certificate, bouquet hue, prop atmosphere, and the person's demeanor. Follow the general logic of Chinese academic gowns; there is no need to strictly correspond to a specific school. The key point is: to immediately convey "this is a high-quality graduation from a Chinese major." --- ## V. Prop Requirements (Focus on Chinese Style) Props must originate from the context of a Chinese graduation season, rather than being completely Westernized. Priority props: - Chinese university degree certificate cover - Chinese university graduation certificate cover - Certificate frame - Graduation bouquet - School emblem elements - Podium/lecture hall/oath-taking platform - Department sash/honor sash - Bachelor's cap - Graduation certificate - Graduation album - Certificate/award for outstanding graduates - Red auditorium backdrop - Pure white studio background - Dark gray background - Overall prop requirements for a Chinese graduation ceremony atmosphere: - Clean and high-end - Avoid excessive piling up - 1-2 core props per photo are sufficient - Must serve the person and their graduation status - Possess both a "graduation feel" and a "magazine feel" --- ## VI. Expression and Emotion Requirements (Focus) This set of photos must focus on portraying expressions; not all photos should feature the same template smile. Please assign the following different emotions to the 8 photos: - Restrained smile - Quiet gaze at the camera - Cool profile - Confident and composed - Solemnity during a speech - Joy of a young graduate - Relaxed laughter - Smile with eyes closed - A slightly playful sense of celebration - A touch of high-end coolness - Understated sense of accomplishment - Sense of ceremony and honor - A slightly fashionable sense of distance Requirements: - Natural expressions - No stiff, fake smiles - No professional, commercial fake smiles - No exaggerated internet celebrity expressions - Should capture genuine emotional moments as seen in magazine shoots--- ## VII. Photography and Texture Requirements (Key Point) This set of photos must emphasize close-ups, facial textures, the texture of academic gowns, hand textures, and the texture of props. ### Composition Requirements: Overall emphasis should be placed on: - Head close-ups - Half-body close-ups - Half-body medium close-ups - A few 3/4 body shots. Avoid large-scale distant views. Do not shrink the subjects too much. The key points are: "Close-up effect, facial impact, details of clothing, and interaction between the certificate and hands." ### Texture Requirements: - High-end studio shooting - Clear and realistic skin texture - Refined but not overly smoothed - Clear texture of the academic gown fabric - Neatness of the drape/shawl/hat - Clear texture of the certificate paper/cover/photo frame/bouquet - Clear, restrained, and exquisite jewelry - Clean and crisp lighting - Simple and sophisticated visuals - High contrast but not cluttered - With a Korean-style cool and fashionable feel - Like a graduation visual shot for a fashion magazine ### Lighting Requirements: - High-end studio main light - Clear facial structure - No overexposure of hands - Layered black background scene - Clean white background (not pure white) - Dramatic feel in the red curtain scene - Overall neat, modern, and fashionable --- ## VIII. Hairstyle and Makeup ### Hairstyle should be designed naturally based on the original features of the person, but the overall look should resemble a high-end magazine shoot. Suitable hairstyles: - Clean, straight hair - Slightly wavy medium-length hair - Updo - Low ponytail - Clean, swept-back style - One side tucked behind the ear - Slightly fashionable low-saturation hair color. Hair color requirements: - Not too messy/casual - No overly exaggerated avant-garde styling - Balance graduation status with magazine-quality look. ### Makeup - Clean base makeup - Translucent and sophisticated - Clear eyebrows and eyes - Natural lip color or light rose tone - Can have a subtle glow - No heavy makeup - No influencer-style makeup - No heavy false eyelashes - Should resemble the makeup of a Korean magazine cover. ## IX. Fixed Allocation of 8 Individual Photos Please output the following 8 retouched graduation photos in different styles: ### Photo 1 | Certificate Close-up Main Visual - Half-body close-up or head close-up - Person wearing Chinese graduation cap and gown - Holding an open graduation/degree certificate - Certificate close to the camera, facial features clear - Restrained smile or quiet confidence - Photo 2 | Bouquet and Certificate Profile - Half-body or 3/4-body - The subject holds a Chinese graduation bouquet and certificate cover - Looking to the side or out of frame - Quiet, cool, and optimistic expression - Dark or pure black background - Highlights the colors of the Chinese graduation bouquet and academic gown drape. Photo 3 | Auditorium Oath - Medium-length half-body close-up - The subject stands behind the podium/lecture hall - One hand raised, as if taking an oath, defending, or giving a speech - One hand resting on the microphone or podium - Background is a red curtain in the style of a Chinese graduation ceremony - Solemn, firm, and ceremonial expression - Emphasizing the Chinese context of the ceremony. Photo 4 | Celebration Close-up - Head close-up or near shot - Wearing academic gown, simple black or dark background - A few gold confetti/celebration elements - Hands making relaxed and natural celebratory gestures or playful gestures near the face. Surprise, joy, youthful and vibrant expression - The most youthful and energetic photo in this set ### Photo 5 | Certificate and Honor - Medium half-body shot - Person holding a certificate frame, degree envelope, or graduation materials - Can be paired with a minimalist handbag or personal style accessories - White or light gray pure studio background - Calm, stylish, and elite expression - Emphasizing "graduation status + personal style + sense of accomplishment" ### Photo 6 | Laughter against a Red Curtain - Medium half-body close-up - Red auditorium backdrop - Person holding a certificate frame - Expression: Gentle, hearty laugh, closed-eye smile, or relaxed smile - No fake smiles; showcasing the relief and joy of graduation day - The most infectious photo in this set ### Photo 7 | Soft Close-up with Bouquet Covering Face - Close-up - Person holding a Chinese graduation bouquet - One hand gently covering part of the cheek or corner of the mouth - Expression: Close-up smile or shy smile - White or light gray background - Overall gentle, refined, and relaxed, very magazine-like - Emphasis on floral materials, hands, rings, watches, and close-ups of the face ### Photo 8 | Cool and detached mood - Close-up or headshot - Wearing an academic cap, chin resting on hand or fist - Cool, restrained, or contemplative expression - Dark gray or solid color background - Emphasizing eyes, skin texture, hands, and jewelry details - The most fashionable, cool, and magazine-page-like photo --- ## X. Uniform Requirements The 8 photos must maintain consistency in the following aspects: - Same real face - Same set of Chinese academic gowns - Same set of Chinese academic caps - Same magazine studio feel - Same graduation theme - Same makeup and styling logic - Same high-end fashion graduation portrait style The 8 photos must show significant variation in the following aspects: - Expression - Hand gestures - Direction of gaze - Camera distance - Interaction with props - Background scene - Emotional state --- ## XI. Specific Avoidance - No cheap studio feel - No assembly-line graduation photo feel - No modern everyday selfie feel - No face swapping - No excessive Westernization - No "internet celebrity" faces - No excessive skin smoothing - No plastic-looking skin - No incorrect finger anatomy - No incorrect body structure - No cluttered backgrounds - No cheap props

promptLocalized.zh: 基于用户上传的 1-3 张清晰个人照片，请一次性生成 8 张不同构图的高端精修毕业肖像照，统一采用 3:4 竖构图。主题：“高端奢华杂志风毕业照”。整体风格参考：韩系高端时尚杂志毕业视觉美学 + 高端影棚拍摄质感 + 中国高校学位服体系 + 情绪感特写肖像 + 时尚杂志封面感。注意：本组照片的核心不在于普通的毕业快照或流水线影楼照，而是：“一组如同中国版时尚杂志拍摄的高质量毕业特写视觉大片。” 整体输出可具备杂志封面质感。--- ## I. 可自定义参数 - [学位等级]：学士 - [专业方向]：管理学 - [院校氛围]：财经类大学 - [学位服体系]：按中国高校学位服通用标准处理，根据专业微调垂布/披肩/颜色 - [主要场景氛围]：极简影棚 / 红色礼堂幕布 / 白色背景影棚 / 深灰色背景 / 毕业典礼讲台 / 证书影棚场景 - [道具偏好]：学位证书 / 毕业证书 / 证书相框 / 花束 / 讲台 / 学士帽 / 校徽元素 / 中国高校毕业纪念道具 - [人物气质]：克制的高级感 / 冷艳 / 自信 / 青年精英感 / 温柔喜悦 / 灵动俏皮 - [珠宝配饰]：极简戒指 / 手表 / 耳环 - [拍摄重点]：特写质感 / 服装细节 / 面部纹理 / 手部动作 / 杂志感 --- ## II. 人物一致性 请严格保留用户真实的身份特征，包括但不限于： - 脸型 - 面部比例 - 眼型 - 鼻型 - 唇型 - 肤色 - 年龄感 - 发型基础 - 体型 - 整体气质 8 张照片必须清晰地呈现为同一张真实面孔。请勿将其变成陌生人，请勿过度西方化，请勿制作成网红脸，请勿过度磨皮，请勿产生 AI“假脸”。人物气质应保留真实的高级感，如同本人升级为一套高端毕业杂志视觉大片，而非变成另一位职业模特。请仅将上传的照片作为身份参考；请勿保留照片中的真实背景、日常服装或原始构图。--- ## III. 整体定位 本组照片的核心定位是：“中国学位服毕业照 x 韩系高端时尚杂志美学 x 特写质感视觉”。这组照片必须同时具备：1. 明确的毕业主题；2. 明确的中国高校学位服特征；3. 明确的时尚杂志感；4. 明确的特写/肖像精细质感；5. 明确的情绪与人物表现；6. 明确的中国毕业场景与道具逻辑。这并非普通的纪念毕业照，而是：“如同高端中国时尚杂志为毕业季拍摄的封面故事。” 整体审美参考关键词：- 韩系高端杂志感 - 冷静且高级 - 极简影棚拍摄 - 时髦毕业肖像 - 干净利落的构图 - 突出的面部与手部细节 - 清晰的服装与证书细节 - 兼具庄重与青春感 - 少量仪式感与轻微戏剧性 --- ## IV. 服装要求（中国化重点） 服装必须明确使用中国高校学位服/袍体系，而非西式毕业袍或日韩校服风毕业装。### 核心服装要求：- 明确保留中国高校学位袍的廓形 - 保留标准方型学士帽 - 保留流苏 - 保留与 [学位等级] 和 [专业方向] 相匹配的中国学位服垂布/披肩/饰边体系 - 服装细节应高端、干净、利落，具有影棚质感 - 学位服必须一眼即识为中国版 - 请勿使其看起来像西式毕业袍 - 请勿使其看起来像舞台戏服 - 请勿使其看起来像廉价影楼服装 ### 学位等级区分 请根据 [学位等级] 反映不同的气质：- 学士：更年轻、清新、轻盈、更具青春感 - 硕士：更成熟、克制、知性、更强的精英感 - 博士：更庄重、更学术，具有更强的权威感与仪式感 ### 专业方向表达 请通过垂布颜色、证书、花束色调、道具氛围及人物状态的微调，自然地反映出 [专业方向] 的职业属性。遵循中国学位服通用逻辑，无需严格对应特定学校。重点是：让人一眼感受到“这是某个中国专业的高质量毕业水准”。--- ## V. 道具要求（中国化重点） 道具必须源自中国毕业季语境，而非完全西化。优先道具：- 中国高校通用学位证书封套 - 中国高校通用毕业证书封套 - 证书相框 - 毕业花束 - 校徽元素 - 讲台/演讲台/宣誓台 - 院系绶带/荣誉绶带 - 学士帽 - 毕业纪念证书 - 毕业纪念册 - 优秀毕业生证书/奖状类道具 - 红色礼堂幕布 - 纯白影棚背景 - 深灰色背景 - 中式毕业典礼氛围 整体道具要求：- 干净且高端 - 切勿堆砌过多 - 每张照片 1-2 个核心道具足矣 - 必须服务于人物与毕业身份 - 兼具“毕业感”与“杂志感” --- ## VI. 表情与情绪要求（重点） 本组照片必须侧重于刻画表情；不能所有照片都是同一种模板式微笑。请在 8 张照片中分配以下不同的情绪：- 克制微笑 - 静静凝视镜头 - 冷峻侧颜 - 自信从容 - 演讲时的庄重 - 青年毕业生的喜悦 - 放松大笑 - 闭眼微笑 - 略带俏皮的庆祝感 - 一丝高端清冷感 - 不夸张的成就感 - 仪式感与荣耀感 - 略带时尚拍摄的距离感 要求：- 自然表情 - 无僵硬假笑 - 无职业式商业假笑 - 无夸张网红表情 - 应如同杂志拍摄时捕捉到的真实情绪瞬间 --- ## VII. 摄影与质感要求（重点） 本组照片必须强调特写、面部纹理、学位服质感、手部纹理及道具质感。### 构图要求：整体侧重于：- 头部特写 - 半身特写 - 半身中景特写 - 少量 3/4 身照 避免大范围远景。不要将人物缩小过多。重点是：“特写感、面部冲击力、局部服装细节、证书与手部的互动。” ### 质感要求：- 高端影棚拍摄 - 清晰真实的皮肤纹理 - 精致但不磨皮过度 - 学位服面料的清晰纹理 - 垂布/披肩/帽子的利落感 - 证书纸张/封套/相框/花束的清晰质感 - 清晰、克制且精致的珠宝 - 干净利落的布光 - 简约且高级的视觉 - 高对比度但不杂乱 - 带有韩系清冷感与时尚感 - 如同真正为时尚杂志拍摄的毕业视觉 ### 布光要求：- 高端影棚主光 - 清晰的面部结构 - 手部无过曝 - 有层次的黑色背景场景 - 干净的白色背景（非死白） - 红色幕布场景中的戏剧感 - 整体利落、现代且时尚 --- ## VIII. 发型与妆容 ### 发型 根据原始人物特征自然设计，但整体造型应更像高端杂志拍摄。可使用：- 干净利落的直发 - 微卷中长发 - 盘发 - 低马尾 - 干净的后梳式 - 一侧别在耳后 - 略带时尚感的低饱和度发色处理 要求：- 不宜过于凌乱/日常感 - 无过于夸张的前卫时尚造型 - 平衡毕业身份与杂志质感 ### 妆容 - 干净的底妆 - 通透且高级 - 清晰的眉眼 - 自然唇色或浅玫瑰色调 - 可带有微光感 - 无浓妆 - 无网红风妆容 - 无厚重假睫毛 - 应如同韩系杂志封面的妆容 --- ## IX. 8 张单人照的固定分配 请输出以下 8 张不同风格的精修毕业照：### 照片 1 | 证书特写主视觉 - 半身特写或头部特写 - 人物佩戴中国学士帽与学位袍 - 手持打开的毕业/学位证书 - 证书靠近镜头，面部特征清晰 - 克制微笑或安静自信 - 简约深灰或纯色背景 - 强调证书、面部与帽子的关系 - 最适合作为杂志封面的照片 ### 照片 2 | 花束与证书侧影 - 半身或 3/4 身 - 人物手持中国毕业花束与证书封套 - 望向侧面或画框外 - 安静、清冷且乐观的表情 - 深色或纯黑背景 - 突出中国毕业花束与学位服垂布的色彩 ### 照片 3 | 礼堂讲台宣誓 -
