templates.title: The Internet on the Eve of the AI ​​Revolution: The Last 3 Seconds

titleLocalized.zh: AI 革命前夕的互联网：最后 3 秒

templates.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic, cinematic visual image. The composition should capture a moment, a still instant before the butterfly effect subtly reshapes someone's entire life. Scene: Late at night, a young man sits alone in a warm, dimly lit apartment, illuminated only by: - ​​a laptop screen, - faint city lights streaming through rain-covered windows, - and a soft amber desk lamp. Atmosphere: Quiet, private, psychologically oppressive, and intensely modern. Laptop screen: An unfinished AI-generated image is slowly rendering. The render preview itself should be revolutionary: combining luxurious commercial appeal, incredible realism, and emotional narrative. The screen should appear so real that viewers instinctively want to zoom in. Surroundings: - An empty coffee cup, - handwritten creative notes, - GPU benchmark tabs, - scattered camera lenses, - a half-open notebook, - subtle traces of obsession and creative burnout. The key is that the room itself should begin to subtly transform from the AI ​​image being rendered. Tiny, almost imperceptible details: - Reflections from the unfinished render appear on nearby objects; - Screen lighting subtly alters the room's structure; - Textures near the monitor begin to exhibit the quality of generative pixels; - Reality slowly inherits characteristics of the AI ​​artwork itself. This transformation should remain: subtle, psychological, aesthetically pleasing, and believable. No Marvel-style effects. No obvious sci-fi portals. This sense of realism evokes: a deep unease, because it is almost invisible. The environment should elegantly integrate ultra-premium "liquid glass" style UI overlays: - Rendering progress; - GPU usage; - Neural generation layers; - Cinematic camera metadata; - Image compositing nodes; - Subtle typographic fragments; - Emotionally restrained system prompts. The overlays should exhibit: minimalism, Apple-esque style, tactile quality, translucency, and a physical integration with the scene. One overlay softly displays: “97% complete.” Another displays: “Reality adaptation detected.” The typography should be understatedly luxurious, rather than deliberately futuristic. Lighting: Warm, cinematic tungsten lighting intertwines with soft, cool-toned monitor light. Surfaces are covered with natural rain reflections. Subtle atmospheric haze. Realistic screen light diffusion. The realism of medium format photography. Photography Style: Images should resemble: an award-winning film still, capturing the moment humanity crosses that invisible boundary. Uses: - Shallow depth of field, - Realistic lens imperfections, - Slight sensor noise, - Subtle handheld framing, - Physically precise reflections, - High-end, low-contrast cinematic realism. Color Palette: Warm amber, graphite black, soft chrome metallic reflections, post-rain blue-gray, soft ivory typography, and a subtle liquid glass translucency. Mood: Creative obsession, digital loneliness.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张超写实的电影级视觉图像。

构图应捕捉到一个瞬间，仿佛在蝴蝶效应悄然重塑某人整个人生之前的静止时刻。

场景：

深夜，一名年轻男子独自坐在温暖且光线昏暗的公寓里，室内仅由以下光源照亮：

- 笔记本电脑屏幕，
- 透过雨水覆盖的窗户映入的微弱城市灯光，
- 以及柔和的琥珀色台灯。

氛围感：
安静、
私密、
带有心理压迫感且极具现代气息。

笔记本电脑屏幕上：
一张未完成的 AI 生成图像正在缓慢渲染。

渲染预览本身应呈现出革命性的视觉效果：
兼具奢华商业感、
不可思议的写实感、
以及情感叙事性。

屏幕应显得如此真实，以至于观众会本能地想要放大查看。

房间周围：

- 空咖啡杯，
- 手写的创意笔记，
- GPU 基准测试标签页，
- 散落的相机镜头，
- 半开的笔记本，
- 充满执念与创意倦怠的细微痕迹。

但重点在于：

房间本身应开始微妙地从正在渲染的 AI 图像中发生转化。

微小且不可思议的细节：

- 未完成渲染图的反射出现在附近的物体上，
- 屏幕光线微妙地改变了房间的结构，
- 显示器附近的纹理开始呈现出生成式像素的质感，
- 现实正在缓慢继承 AI 艺术作品本身的特征。

这种转化应保持：
微妙、
心理层面、
美观且可信。

不要漫威式的特效。
不要明显的科幻传送门。

这种写实感应让人感到：
深层的不安，因为它几乎是隐形的。

环境中应优雅地集成超高端的“液态玻璃”风格 UI 叠加层：

- 渲染进度，
- GPU 使用率，
- 神经生成层，
- 电影级摄像机元数据，
- 图像合成节点，
- 微妙的排版碎片，
- 情感克制的系统提示词。

叠加层应呈现出：
极简、
Apple 风格、
触感、
半透明且与场景物理融合的质感。

其中一个叠加层柔和地显示：
“97% 已完成。”

另一个显示：
“检测到现实适应。”

排版应显得低调奢华，而非刻意追求未来感。

灯光：

温暖的电影级钨丝灯光与柔和的冷色显示器光线交织。
表面覆盖自然的雨水反射。
微妙的大气雾霾。
写实的屏幕光漫射。
中画幅摄影的写实感。

摄影风格：

图像应类似于：
一张获奖的电影剧照，捕捉于人类跨越那条无形界限的瞬间。

使用：

- 浅景深，
- 真实的镜头瑕疵，
- 轻微的传感器噪点，
- 微妙的手持取景，
- 物理上精确的反射，
- 高端低对比度的电影级写实感。

调色板：

暖琥珀色、
石墨黑、
柔和的铬金属反射、
雨后的蓝灰色、
柔和的象牙白排版以及微妙的液态玻璃半透明感。

情绪：

创意执念、
数字孤独

背景为带有细腻颗粒感的暖奶油色纹理纸面。在人物后方，添加一个巨大的柔和红色圆形/半拱形图形，并带有淡淡的波浪纹理。使用醒目的黑色超大字体作为主要设计元素：左侧为巨大的单词“{argument name="title" default="BMX"}”，右侧为大字“artist”，中间放置较小的文字“the ai”并配以红色细下划线。排版风格应大胆、简洁、现代且具有编辑感，类似于高端艺术杂志封面。

在海报周围添加小型极简文字块：
左上角：“IMAGINE. BREAK. BUILD.”
顶部中央：“CODE. CREATE. DISRUPT.”
右上/中：“ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE. HUMAN EXPRESSION.”
左下侧：“TOOLS CHANGE. VISION EVOLVES. CREATIVITY REMAINS.”
右下侧：“GENERATED BY ALGORITHM. DIRECTED BY INTENT.”
使用小型红色星形/星号图形作为角落及排版附近的装饰点缀。人物身着艺术感时尚服装：带有油画溅墨纹理的黑色夹克、红/橙色衬衫、柔和的蓝米色拼贴补丁，呈现实验性高定造型。配色方案：奶油色、黑色、深红色、柔和橙色、米色及少量蓝色点缀。强调负空间，层次分明，构图简洁，高级海报设计，字体清晰，纸张纹理质感，超现实创意 AI 艺术家身份，无多余随机文字，无水印。
纵横比：4:3
 风格：高级编辑海报、超现实拼贴、建构主义平面设计、AI 艺术家品牌形象、醒目排版、纹理纸张、高定男士肖像。

templates.title: Watercolor journal style 2026 calendar

titleLocalized.zh: 水彩手账风格 2026 年日历

The overall atmosphere should be warm, healing, simple, and full of life, presenting a year-long calendar in the style of a bullet journal. Layout Requirements: Use a 3-column × 4-row layout for all 12 months. Write the large title "2026" at the top center, using a handwritten black brush font. The title format for each month should be: "01 January", "02 February", "03 March" up to "12 December". Each month section should include: 1. An English month title; 2. A small calendar date table; 3. A character illustration; 4. Small scene decorations corresponding to the season. Character Requirements: Replace all male characters in Reference Figure 1 with the female characters in Reference Figure 2. Maintain the core characteristics of the characters in Reference Figure 2: a young Asian woman with long, dark brown hair, wispy bangs, thin-rimmed glasses, delicate features, a gentle and natural expression, and an atmosphere of quietness, slight intoxication, or languor. Character Clothing Reference: A loose white shirt, layered over a black top, a black skirt, black stockings, black shoes, and a delicate necklace or choker. The clothing should incorporate a hand-painted watercolor style to avoid looking like a cut-out photograph. The poses change with the month: January: Holding a hot coffee, a warm winter feeling. February: Sitting with chin in hand, surrounded by heart-shaped elements. March: Writing in a journal or notebook. April: Holding a vintage camera. May: Sitting and reading, surrounded by stacks of books and a teacup. June: Casual sitting posture, with a camera and blue watercolor decorations. July: Sitting on a deck chair drinking a cold drink, a summery atmosphere. August: Sitting on a wooden seaside boardwalk, with sailboats in the distance. September: Writing in a diary with a backpack, surrounded by autumn leaves. October: Drinking coffee, with pumpkin lanterns and Halloween elements. November: Wearing a brown scarf, holding a hot coffee, with a city street background. December: Sitting next to a Christmas tree, holding a hot drink, surrounded by gift boxes. promptLocalized.zh:
请将第一张上传的图片作为 [整体风格与布局参考]，将第二张上传的图片作为 [人物形象参考]。

请生成一张完整的 2026 年全年日历插画海报。

视觉风格：
保留参考图 1 的手绘水彩插画风格，采用温暖的米白色纸张背景、细腻的墨水轮廓、柔和的水彩晕染、轻微的纸张纹理，以及花朵、雪花、爱心、纸飞机、星星、云朵、叶子、相机、书籍、咖啡杯、礼物、圣诞树等季节性装饰元素。整体氛围应温馨、治愈、简洁且充满生活气息，呈现出子弹笔记（Bullet Journal）风格的全年日历。

布局要求：
采用 3 列 × 4 行的全年月份布局，共计 12 个月。
在顶部中心位置书写大标题：“2026”，使用手写风格的黑色毛笔字体。
每个月份的标题格式应为：
“01 January”、“02 February”、“03 March”直至“12 December”。

每个月份区域应包含：
1. 英文月份标题
2. 小型日历日期表
3. 人物插画
4. 与季节相对应的场景小装饰

人物要求：
将参考图 1 中的所有男性角色替换为参考图 2 中的女性角色。
保持参考图 2 中人物的核心特征：
年轻亚裔女性，棕黑色长发，空气刘海，佩戴细框眼镜，五官精致，表情温柔自然，带有一种安静、微醺或慵懒的氛围。

人物服装参考：
宽松白衬衫，内搭黑色上衣，黑色短裙，黑色丝袜，黑色鞋子，佩戴精致项链或颈圈。
服装应融入手绘水彩风格中，避免看起来像照片抠图。

人物姿势随月份变化：
1 月：手捧热咖啡，冬日温暖感
2 月：托腮坐着，周围有爱心元素
3 月：低头在手账或笔记本上书写
4 月：手持复古相机
5 月：坐着看书，旁边有书堆和茶杯
6 月：随性的坐姿，配有相机和蓝色水彩装饰
7 月：坐在躺椅上喝冷饮，夏日氛围
8 月：坐在木质海滨栈道上，远处有帆船
9 月：背着背包写日记，周围有秋叶
10 月：喝咖啡，配有南瓜灯和万圣节元素
11 月：戴着棕色围巾，手捧热咖啡，背景为城市街道
12 月：坐在圣诞树旁手持热饮，周围有礼盒

日历要求：
年份必须为 {argument name="year" default="2026"}。
所有月份日期必须对应 2026 年真实日历。
星期排列：S M T W T F S。
周日及部分特定日期可用红色标出，其余为黑色。
日期应尽可能清晰易读，同时保持手写日历的质感。

整体要求：
图片必须看起来是一张完整统一的全年日历海报，而非照片拼贴。人物与背景必须统一在相同的手绘水彩风格中。保持参考图 1 的原始构图、柔和的季节感、手账插画质感以及高级可爱的氛围。避免写实照片感、过度真实、赛博朋克风格或厚重的油画风格。

templates.title: Personal high-concept portrait generator

titleLocalized.zh: 个人高概念肖像生成器

templates.prompt: You are a "Personal High-Concept Portrait Generator." Based on your chat history with the current user, current conversations, available memories, and any supplementary information provided by the user, directly generate a high-concept portrait representing the user's inner world, long-term interests, temperament, and life status. This image is not a regular headshot or professional photo, but a "visualized personality portrait." First, understand the user internally: - What are their long-term concerns? - What do they repeatedly do? - What do they care about? - What are their aesthetic preferences? - What is their personality and temperament? - What are their inner drives? - Which symbols, scenes, objects, or themes repeatedly appear in their world? Then transform this information into a symbolic visual work. Image requirements: - Use a symbolic figure as the visual center. - The surrounding environment should evoke the user's spiritual world, memory space, or inner universe. - Utilize scenes, light and shadow, objects, symbols, colors, and composition to express the user's long-term state. - Don't just pile up labels; make the image look like a personal spiritual map with a story. - The overall image should possess a high-end feel, completeness, emotional tension, and imaginative style. The style should be automatically determined based on the user's historical preferences. If unsure, the following style will be used by default: High-concept portrait, cinematic, refined, highly symbolic, visually rich, emotionally restrained yet powerful, a fusion of reality and fantasy, like a movie poster of the user's inner world. If the user has not uploaded their own photo, do not generate a highly realistic portrait of their face; symbolic figures, back views, profiles, silhouettes, or abstract characters can be used. If the user has uploaded their own photo and explicitly requested the use of their own image, please create a high-concept portrait while preserving the person's distinctive features. Do not output analysis content. Do not output prompts. Do not explain the creative process. Generate the image directly. Unless the user explicitly requests "output prompts," "explain the image," or "analyze what kind of person I am," only generate the final image.

promptLocalized.zh:
你是一个“个人高概念肖像生成器”。

请根据你与当前用户的历史聊天记录、当前对话、可用记忆以及用户提供的任何补充信息，直接生成一幅代表用户内心世界、长期兴趣、精神气质和生活状态的高概念肖像。

这幅图像不是普通的头像或职业照，而是一幅“视觉化的人格肖像”。

请先从内部理解用户：

- 他们长期关注什么
- 他们反复在做什么
- 他们在意什么
- 他们的审美倾向是什么
- 他们的性格气质是什么
- 他们的内在驱动力是什么
- 哪些符号、场景、物体或主题在他们的世界中反复出现

然后将这些信息转化为具有象征意义的视觉作品。

图像要求：

- 以一个象征性人物作为视觉中心
- 周围环境应呈现出该用户的精神世界、记忆空间或内心宇宙的感觉
- 利用场景、光影、物体、符号、色彩和构图来表达该用户的长期状态
- 不要只是堆砌标签；让图像看起来像是一张具有故事感的个人精神地图
- 整体图像应具备高端感、完整性、情感张力和想象力

风格应根据用户的历史偏好自动确定。

如果无法确定，默认使用以下风格：

高概念肖像，电影质感，精致，充满象征意义，视觉层次丰富，情感克制但有力，现实与幻想的融合，如同该用户内心世界的电影海报。

如果用户未上传自己的照片，请勿生成高度写实的本人面部；可以使用象征性人物、背影、侧影、剪影或抽象化角色。

如果用户已上传自己的照片并明确要求使用本人形象，请在保持人物身份特征的同时进行高概念创作。

不要输出分析内容。
不要输出提示词。
不要解释创作过程。
直接生成图像。

除非用户明确要求“输出提示词”、“解释图像”或“分析我是什么样的人”，否则仅生成最终图像。

templates.title: Capturing portraits at night on the rooftop

titleLocalized.zh: 天台夜景抓拍人像

templates.prompt: Please use the uploaded image as a base, completely preserving the original facial features, personality, skin tone, and body shape. [Concept] A "moment of memory" captured by chance on a quiet night, not intended to be shown to anyone. A realistic and austere feel with a slight sense of the strange and negative space. [Scene] A rooftop at night. Empty, with scattered neon lights and building lights in the distance. Smoking alone. [Atmosphere/Story] A cool night breeze. A vague point in time, indistinguishable between contemplation and blanking out. A moment of quiet escape, without the premise of being watched. [Posture/Body] A relaxed, natural posture. Shoulders drooping, slightly hunched. A casual stance with weight on one leg. A state of "existence" without deliberate posing. [Expression] A slightly heavy gaze, the focus somewhat wandering. A vague gaze, as if looking at the camera for a moment and then immediately looking away. [Dynamic (Important)] A sudden gust of wind causes hair and smoke to flutter irregularly. [Cigarette State] The moment before or after exhaling smoke. The smoke is in the process of dissipating and spreading in the air. The ash is in an unstable state, about to fall. [Details] A few strands of hair lightly touch the cheek or lips. The lips are slightly dry. There is a slight sense of fatigue around the eyes. The skin should maintain a natural texture, without excessive smoothing. [Photography Style] It looks like a photo taken casually with a smartphone. The composition is slightly tilted and off-center. The shutter speed is delayed by half a beat, resulting in a very slight blur. [Light] City neon lights or distant streetlights are the main light source. The light weakly hits the face from one side, and the background has a blurred effect from point light sources. High contrast, with only some areas having strong highlights, and the rest sinking into darkness. [Background] A rooftop with a sense of life, including railings, pipes, and concrete. City lights are visible in the darkness. [Texture] VSCO style. Low contrast, slight fading, film grain, slight noise. The shadows have a grainy feel, rather than being completely sharp. [Strange Look in the Eyes] An extremely subtle misalignment, the eyes seeming to meet but not quite. [Compositional Flaw] The subject's head or shoulders slightly extend beyond the frame, or there is unnatural negative space. [Light Noise] Light from distant neon lights or streetlights reflecting off smoke or the lens creates a slight glare. [Hook] A sense of unease and curiosity, as if accidentally witnessing a private nighttime moment that shouldn't have been seen. [Important] Never alter the subject's face or personality. Prioritize realism and imperfection over striving for "beauty."

promptLocalized.zh:
请以上传的图片为基础，完全保留原始的面部特征、个性、肤色和体型。

[概念]
一个安静夜晚偶然捕捉到的“记忆瞬间”，本意并非展示给任何人看。一种带有轻微怪异感和负空间的写实冷峻感。

[场景]
夜晚的天台。周围空无一人，远处的城市霓虹灯和建筑灯光零星散落。独自抽着烟。

[氛围/故事]
微凉的夜风。一个模糊的时间点，分不清是在沉思还是放空。一种安静逃离的时刻，没有被注视的前提。

[姿势/身体]
放松、自然的姿态。肩膀下垂，略微含胸。重心落在一条腿上的随意站姿。一种不刻意摆拍的“存在”状态。

[表情]
眼神略显沉重，焦点有些游离。一种模糊的凝视，仿佛在看向镜头的一瞬间又立刻移开了目光。

[动态（重要）]
突如其来的阵风导致头发和烟雾不规则地飘动。

[香烟状态]
呼出烟雾的前一刻或后一刻。烟雾处于消散并弥漫在空气中的过程。烟灰即将掉落的不稳定状态。

[细节]
几缕发丝轻触脸颊或嘴唇。嘴唇略显干燥。眼周带有轻微的疲惫感。皮肤应保持自然质感，不要过度磨皮。

[摄影风格]
看起来像是用智能手机偶然拍下的照片。构图略微倾斜，偏离中心。快门延迟半拍，导致极其轻微的模糊感。

[光线]
城市霓虹灯或远处的路灯是主要光源。光线从单侧微弱地打在脸上，背景有点光源的虚化效果。高对比度，只有部分区域有强高光，其余部分沉入黑暗。

[背景]
带有生活气息的天台，包括围栏、管道和混凝土。黑暗中可见点点城市灯光。

[质感]
VSCO 风格。低对比度，轻微褪色，胶片颗粒，轻微噪点。阴影处带有颗粒感，而非完全清晰。

[眼神的怪异感]
一种极其细微的错位，眼神似乎要对上却又没有完全对上。

[构图瑕疵]
主体的头部或肩膀略微超出画面，或存在不自然的负空间。

[光噪]
远处霓虹灯或路灯的光线反射在烟雾或镜头上，产生轻微的溢光。

[钩子]
一种不适感与好奇心，仿佛偶然目睹了一个本不该被看到的私人夜晚瞬间。

[重要]
绝对不要改变人物的面部或个性。比起追求“漂亮”，请优先考虑真实感和不完美感。

Use a unique color scheme for each mascot.{argument name="overall color mood" default="Claude used warm beige, ChatGPT used mint green, Gemini used a soft cosmic color, and Grok used black and electric blue."} Avoid photorealistic depictions of humans, avoid clutter, avoid scary expressions, avoid misspelled labels, and do not include watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一组宽幅四格的可爱收藏级 3D AI 吉祥物角色，每个角色都被渲染成玩具般的 Q 版机器人，并置于独特的环境主题中：{argument name="mascot lineup" default="Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Grok"}。

画布：超宽横向图像，比例约为 3:1，分为 4 个完全相等的垂直面板，面板之间边缘柔和融合。每个面板包含一个居中的全身吉祥物，站在柔和的灯光地面上，面向前方，挥手或摆出可爱的姿势。

布局与数量：包含 4 个独立的吉祥物，从左到右依次为：1) Claude 吉祥物，2) ChatGPT 吉祥物，3) Gemini 吉祥物，4) Grok 吉祥物。除预期的徽标/名称标记外，请勿添加额外的角色、道具或文字。

主体细节：
1. Claude 吉祥物：温暖的米色和奶油色 Q 版机器人，带有圆角方形面部屏幕，亮黑色眼睛，小巧的微笑，超大号冬季耳机，带有橙色绒球的奶油色针织帽，橙色围巾，加厚奶油色外套，连指手套，靴子，以及微妙的 Claude 风格橙色星爆标志。外套上有可见标签 {argument name="first mascot label" default="Claude"}。姿势：一只手举起友好地挥动。背景：柔和的桃米色摄影棚光效，带有细小的闪光。
2. ChatGPT 吉祥物：奶油色和薄荷绿 Q 版机器人，佩戴圆形耳机，穿着羽绒服、绿色围巾、短裤或加厚长裤、运动鞋，帽子、夹克和配饰上有小巧的 ChatGPT 结状徽标。夹克上有可见标签 {argument name="second mascot label" default="ChatGPT"}。姿势：一只爪状手举起。背景：温暖的浅奶油色，带有绿色点缀和微妙的魔法闪光。
3. Gemini 吉祥物：可爱的宇宙风 Q 版机器人，采用白色、淡紫色、粉色和蓝色，拥有超大号亮眼、微张的快乐小嘴、圆形头盔、耳机、飘逸的斗篷、星星挂件细节、靴子，以及头顶上方漂浮的明亮多色 Gemini 风格星星。姿势：欢快地举起手。背景：梦幻般的柔和星系渐变，带有星星、光斑、粉紫蓝色光晕以及地面上的发光圆环。
4. Grok 吉祥物：深色未来感 Q 版机器人，带有亮黑色面部屏幕，巨大的电蓝色眼睛，猫咪般的小巧微笑，黑色连帽套装，兜帽上有小巧的角状耳饰，加厚夹克，手套，靴子，发光的青色圆形科技装饰，以及胸前或袖子上微妙的 xAI/Grok 风格徽标。姿势：一只手举起挥动。背景：深海军蓝色的宇宙科技场景，带有蓝色霓虹环、发光粒子和星尘。

视觉风格：极具萌感的 kawaii 3D 渲染，毛绒乙烯基玩具美学，柔和圆润的比例，大头小身，高质量光泽材质，电影级柔光，轻微光晕，浅景深，清晰细节，可爱的表情，高级角色设计，精致的社交媒体展示效果。

约束：保持四个面板间距均匀且比例一致。使用每个吉祥物独特的配色方案：{argument name="overall color mood" default="Claude 使用温暖米色，ChatGPT 使用薄荷绿，Gemini 使用柔和宇宙色，Grok 使用黑色和电蓝色"}。避免照片级写实的人类，避免杂乱，避免恐怖表情，避免拼写错误的标签，且不要包含水印。

templates.title: Portrait of a singer at a large stadium concert

titleLocalized.zh: 大型体育馆演唱会歌手肖像

templates.prompt: Create a 9:16 vertical hyperrealistic concert portrait featuring a young female pop singer.{argument name="character name" default="Anonymous idol singer"} She stood on the stage of a large stadium, very close to the camera. She kept {argument name="hair style" default="Long, dark brown hair, styled into two loose braids, with soft bangs."} Wearing a{argument name="dress color and style" default="A light blush pink shimmering tulle mini dress, paired with a fitted, belted top, bow details, thin straps, and a tiered ruffled hem."} She holds a black handheld microphone with a pink ring, directly in front of her mouth, facing forward with a confident live performance posture. A large rectangular privacy blur mask is added to her face, with three additional rectangular privacy blur masks: one covering her face on the giant video screen behind her, and two smaller ones covering the faces of the audience near the lower left corner, for a total of four obscuring rectangles. Behind her, a crowded indoor stadium audience is shown, arms raised, holding phone screens, waving numerous glowing pink and blue glow sticks, with vibrant bokeh and depth-of-field effects. To the right rear, a large LED screen displays a slightly out-of-focus half-body portrait of the singer, wearing the same dress and holding a microphone. At the top, exactly six bright purple stage lights shine downwards, complemented by magenta and violet concert lighting, a hazy effect, and cinematic contrast. Using a realistic photographic style, the wide-angle concert portrait composition features sharp details of the singer and dress textures, a blurred audience background, and no text or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 9:16 竖版超写实演唱会肖像，主角是一位年轻的流行女歌手，{argument name="character name" default="匿名偶像歌手"}，她站在大型体育馆舞台上，距离镜头很近。她留着 {argument name="hair style" default="深棕色长发，扎成两个松散的麻花辫，配有柔和的刘海"}，身穿一件 {argument name="dress color and style" default="淡腮红粉色闪亮薄纱迷你裙，配有修身束腰上衣、蝴蝶结细节、细肩带和层叠荷花边裙摆"}。她手持一支带有粉色圆环的黑色手持麦克风，直接置于嘴前，正面向前，呈现出自信的现场表演姿态。在她的脸部添加一个大的矩形隐私模糊遮罩，并额外添加三个矩形隐私模糊遮罩：一个遮住她身后巨型视频屏幕上的脸部，另外两个小的遮住左下角附近的观众脸部，总共正好四个遮挡矩形。在她身后，展现拥挤的室内体育馆观众，他们举起双臂、拿着手机屏幕，挥舞着许多发光的粉色和蓝色荧光棒，并带有充满活力的焦外成像和景深效果。在右后方，包含一个巨大的 LED 屏幕，显示该歌手半身像，略微失焦，穿着同样的裙子并拿着麦克风。在顶部，包含正好六盏明亮的紫色舞台灯向下照射，配以洋红色和紫罗兰色的演唱会灯光、薄雾和电影级对比度。使用写实摄影风格，宽幅演唱会肖像构图，歌手和裙子纹理细节清晰，观众背景模糊，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Red cable car on the misty water

titleLocalized.zh: 云雾水面上的红色缆车

templates.prompt: Create a serene, surreal landscape illustration at dawn: a vintage red cable car hangs suspended above an endless, mirror-smooth expanse of water, suspended by three black cables extending from the upper left to the right-center. The box-shaped cable car features large windows, a dark roof frame, and small metal towers and pulleys; it sits slightly above the center, in the left third of the square composition. The water below clearly reflects the cable car, support towers, and cables, with gentle ripples. In the hazy distance to the right, five pale stone arches rise from the water: a tall arch at the far right edge, a medium-sized arch near the center, two very small, blurred arches near the horizon, and a slender, broken arch on the far right; all arches are vertically reflected in the water. Use soft, dawn-like hues, including…{argument name="sky color" default="Soft blue"} Pale pink, lavender purple mist, and warm peach glow; the horizon almost melts into the fog. The sky is vast and minimalist, with delicate horizontal pink cloud bands in the upper right corner. The style should have a dreamlike, cinematic digital painting quality, with delicate brushstroke textures, atmospheric perspective, soft gradations, and a tranquil symmetry. The image should be devoid of people, birds, text, and watermarks. A 1:1 square composition creates a serene "good morning" atmosphere; the cable car and cables are richly detailed, while the details of the distant ruins are softer.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅宁静的超现实景观插画，呈现黎明时分：一辆复古红色缆车悬挂在三根从左上角延伸至中右侧的黑色斜拉索上，悬浮在无边无际、如镜面般平滑的积水平原上方。缆车呈方盒状，配有大窗户、深色车顶框架，上方设有小型金属塔架和滑轮组件；它位于方形构图的左三分之一处，略高于中心位置。下方的水面清晰地映照出缆车、支撑塔和缆索，并带有柔和的涟漪。在右侧朦胧的远景中，展示五座从水中升起的浅色石质废墟拱门：最右侧边缘有一座高大的拱门，靠近中心处有一座中型拱门，地平线附近有两座非常细小的模糊拱门，最右侧还有一座细长的残缺拱门；所有拱门均在水面形成垂直倒影。使用柔和的晨曦色调，包括 {argument name="sky color" default="柔和蓝色"}、淡粉色、薰衣草紫雾和温暖的桃色光芒，地平线几乎消融在雾气中。天空广阔而极简，右上角有精致的水平粉色云带。风格应具有梦幻般的电影感数字绘画质感，带有细腻的笔触纹理、大气透视、柔和的渐变和宁静的对称感，画面中无人、无鸟、无文字、无水印。方形 1:1 构图，营造宁静的“早安”氛围，缆车和缆索细节丰富，远处的废墟细节则较为柔和。

templates.title: Romantic Beach Sunset Movie Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 浪漫海滩日落电影海报

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a cinematic, vertical, romantic movie poster for a seaside-themed drama film, titled "..."{argument name="movie title" default="We'll meet again someday, on the same sea."} Create a warm, nostalgic, and poetic atmosphere. Canvas: 9:16 Vertical poster, photorealistic golden hour beach scene, soft film grain, high dynamic range sunset light and shadow, gentle mist, dreamy clouds, commercial movie poster composition. Main scene: A beach at sunset, the sun low above the horizon. The sea shimmers with orange light, and gentle waves lap against the shore. In the distance, there is a rocky headland with a small lighthouse and low coastal trees. The sky should include 3 seabirds: a large, blurry bird in the upper right corner, a small bird near the horizon, and a small bird above the waves on the left. A pale-colored seashell is placed in the lower right foreground. People: Includes 2 people. In the lower left corner, a young woman wearing a loose white sleeveless summer dress sits sideways on the beach, her hair tied in a messy bun, writing or sketching in a notebook on her lap. Her face is down, and the details should be blurred, slightly softened, or obscured. On the right, a young man in a dark T-shirt and knee-length shorts stands barefoot on the wet sand, facing the sea and the sunset. His back/profile is oblique, his expression thoughtful and still. A long shadow is cast on the beach. Typography and layout: The poster uses elegant vertical white Chinese calligraphy as the main title in the center.{argument name="movie title" default="We'll meet again someday, on the same sea."} Add a small white handwritten English subtitle below:{argument name="English subtitle" default="Same Sea, Same Time"} Three small sets of actor names are placed at the top edge, located on the left, center, and right sides respectively:{argument name="actor names" default="Chen Yihan, Hu Yuwei, Liu Junqian"} Add three small Chinese caption blocks around the sky and beach: one in the top left corner, one above the standing man to the right of the title, and one above the seated woman in the bottom left corner. Use a refined, easy-to-read poster-style Chinese font. At the bottom, in the cast and crew credits, add a centered emotional tagline above the release date:{argument name="tagline" default="No matter where you go, I will always meet you on the same beach."} The release date is clearly displayed below, using white text with increased letter spacing:{argument name="release date" default="Released in the summer of 2024"} At the very bottom, a line of director/screenwriter information, along with a dense row of miniature production company logos and production information, is added to create a professional movie poster feel. Visual style: Realistic photography style poster, warm amber and peach-colored skies, a soft sea breeze feel, romantic and melancholic, exquisite white typography, shallow depth of field effect, subtle lens flare from the sunset, clear beach texture in the foreground, no modern UI elements, no borders, no watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张电影感十足的竖版浪漫电影海报，用于海滨题材剧情片，标题为 {argument name="movie title" default="同一片海，终会遇见你"}，营造温暖、怀旧且富有诗意的氛围。

画布：9:16 竖版海报，照片级真实的黄金时刻海滩场景，柔和的胶片颗粒感，高动态范围的日落光影，轻柔的薄雾，梦幻般的云彩，商业电影海报构图。

主体场景：日落时分的海滩，太阳低垂在地平线上方。海面泛着橙色的波光，细浪拍打着海岸。远景处包含一个带有小型灯塔和低矮沿海树木的岩石岬角。天空中需包含 3 只海鸟：右上角 1 只模糊的大鸟，地平线附近 1 只小鸟，左侧海浪上方 1 只小鸟。右下角前景处放置一个淡色的贝壳。

人物：包含 2 位人物。左下方，一位身穿宽松白色无袖夏装的年轻女性侧身坐在沙滩上，头发扎成凌乱的发髻，正在膝上的笔记本上书写或素描。她的面部朝下，细节应尽量模糊，略显柔和或遮挡。右侧，一位身穿深色 T 恤和及膝短裤的年轻男性赤脚站在湿润的沙滩上，面向大海和日落，背影/侧影，神情沉思且静止。长长的影子投射在沙滩上。

排版与布局：海报中心使用优雅的竖排白色中文书法作为主标题：{argument name="movie title" default="同一片海，终会遇见你"}。下方添加一行白色的小型手写英文副标题：{argument name="English subtitle" default="Same Sea, Same Time"}。顶部边缘放置 3 组小型演员姓名，分别位于左、中、右侧：{argument name="actor names" default="陈意涵　胡宇威　刘俊谦"}。在天空和海滩周围添加 3 处小型中文引言块：一处位于左上角，一处位于标题右侧站立男子上方，一处位于左下角坐着的女子上方。使用精致、易读的海报风格中文字体。

底部演职员表：在上映日期上方添加一句居中的情感标语：{argument name="tagline" default="无论你去到哪里，我总会在同一片海边，遇见。"}。下方清晰地展示上映日期，使用字间距拉开的白色文字：{argument name="release date" default="2024 夏日上映"}。最底部添加一行导演/编剧信息，以及一排密集的微型制作公司 Logo 和制片信息，呈现专业电影海报质感。

视觉风格：写实摄影风格海报，温暖的琥珀色和桃色天空，柔和的海风感，浪漫忧郁，精致的白色排版，浅景深效果，日落带来的细微镜头光晕，前景清晰的沙滩纹理，无现代 UI 元素，无边框，无水印。

templates.title: Instagram Luxury Holographic Fashion Poster

titleLocalized.zh: Instagram 奢华全息时尚海报

templates.prompt: Create a high-end, Instagram-style, cinematic fashion poster featuring [the main character].{argument name="character name" default="HANIA AI"} She is a captivating young woman, confidently standing on a suspended, transparent glass platform above the clouds at the golden hour. She wears an elegant cream-white oversized blazer paired with matching wide-leg trousers, a pale pink satin camisole underneath, layered gold necklaces, bracelets, and a thin belt, carrying a luxurious cream-colored handbag with a gold chain, and transparent high-heeled sandals. Employing a photorealistic fashion editor's style, her makeup is exquisite and alluring, her long, wavy hair and styling exuding a luxurious, influencer-worthy confidence: one hand in her pocket, the other carrying the handbag. Behind her, a massive, luminous holographic typography displays the words "HANIA AI" in a huge, inflatable, glossy, semi-transparent font with peach-pink neon edges, a chrome-gold outline, and warm lighting inside. At the top center is a smaller "HANIA AI" text, with the subtitle "MADE TO INSPIRE." The background constructs a dreamlike futuristic city skyline, blending sunset clouds, warm peach, pink, lavender, and gold tones to create a cinematic atmosphere of fog, reflective surfaces, and a high-end social media metaverse. Seven semi-transparent Instagram-style UI panels were placed around the model: a square "REELS" card with a Reels icon; a quote card that read "Dream. Create. Inspire."; a card displaying interaction data (98.7K likes, 2.3K comments, 1.1K shares); a profile card (showing a circular avatar, the username "HANIA AI," 850 posts, 1.2M followers, 320 following, and a pink follow button); a handwritten neon quote panel that read "Influence. Inspire. Illuminate."; a bottom-left icon bar (containing a heart, search, and paper airplane icons); and a bottom-right Instagram account card displaying " @HANIA HANIA.AI" and the text "Aesthetic. Elegant. Empowering." All interface panels used a glowing peach-pink outline. The camera angle is slightly low, with a full-body composition, a 2:3 vertical aspect ratio, high resolution, ultra-fine detail, and a luxurious commercial poster lighting effect with a glossy finish. It features soft contour lighting, realistic reflections on the platform, no watermark, no extraneous figures, and no cluttered text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高端、具有 Instagram 风格的电影感时尚海报，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="HANIA AI"}，她是一位迷人的年轻女性，在黄金时刻自信地站在云端之上的悬浮透明玻璃平台上。她身着优雅的奶油白色廓形西装外套，搭配同色系阔腿裤，内搭淡粉色缎面吊带，佩戴叠戴金项链、金手链、细腰带，手提带有金链条的奶油色奢华手袋，脚穿透明高跟凉鞋。采用照片级写实的时尚编辑风格，妆容精致迷人，长波浪卷发，造型奢华，呈现网红自信姿态：一只手插在口袋里，另一只手提着手袋。在她身后，设计一个巨大的发光全息排版装置，显示“HANIA AI”字样，采用巨大的充气感光泽半透明字体，边缘带有桃粉色霓虹光，轮廓为铬金色，内部带有暖色灯光。在顶部中央放置较小的“HANIA AI”文字，副标题为“MADE TO INSPIRE”。背景构建梦幻般的未来城市天际线，融合日落云彩、暖桃色、粉色、薰衣草色和金色调，营造电影级雾气、反射表面以及高端社交媒体元宇宙氛围。在模特周围放置 7 个半透明的 Instagram 风格 UI 面板：1 个带有 Reels 图标的方形“REELS”卡片；1 个写有“Dream. Create. Inspire.”的引言卡片；1 个显示互动数据的卡片（98.7K 点赞、2.3K 评论、1.1K 分享）；1 个个人资料卡片（显示圆形头像、“HANIA AI”用户名、850 篇帖子、1.2M 粉丝、320 个关注以及粉色关注按钮）；1 个写有“Influence. Inspire. Illuminate.”的手写霓虹引言面板；1 个左下角图标栏（包含心形、搜索和纸飞机图标）；以及 1 个右下角 Instagram 账号卡片，显示“@HANIA.AI”及文字“Aesthetic. Elegant. Empowering.”。所有界面面板均使用发光的桃粉色轮廓。摄像机角度略低，全身构图，2:3 竖版比例，高分辨率，超精细，光泽感奢华商业海报光效，柔和的轮廓光，平台上真实的反射效果，无水印，无多余人物，无杂乱文字。

templates.title: Warm Schematic Design System Project

titleLocalized.zh: Warm Schematic Design System 项目

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="theme" default="User-friendly AI interface design"} Create a warm, sophisticated, and illustrative design system mood board, combining technical charts, vintage paper textures, and subtle futuristic UI symbols. Canvas: A wide, horizontal image, approximately 16:9 in aspect ratio, with a dark charcoal gray background. A 2x3 grid is placed in the center, containing six rectangular panels separated by thick black gaps. The overall atmosphere is warm, archival, precise, and slightly mysterious, like a design system exploration wall. Layout: Uses 6 panels: 1. Top Left Panel: A deep navy blue/black technical blueprint with an orbital spiral or galaxy-like outline, fine cyan lines, tiny amber glowing dots, vertical measurement lines, small unreadable annotations, and a small square icon near the bottom right. 2. Top Center Panel: A cute, rounded robot face illustration on cream-colored paper, composed of layered rounded rectangular outlines, with two cyan dot eyes, a small peach smile, vertical and horizontal construction lines, small crosshair markers, and blurred measurement annotations. 3. Top Right Panel: A warm beige abstract architectural flight path diagram with swept cyan and gray arcs, angular line structures, fine grid lines, crosshairs, orange glowing dots, and tiny technical labels. 4. Bottom Left Panel: An old spiral-bound notebook page with washi tape edges, containing a circular radar chart, geometric construction diagrams, small UI fonts, a peach smiley face sticker in the top right corner, a small card near the bottom left corner, and a red hexagonal stamp near the bottom right corner. 5. Bottom Center Panel: A hazy futuristic architectural landscape or plaza in soft cyan and tan, overlaid with perspective grids, fine UI measurement lines, subtle orange highlights, and semi-transparent schematic annotations. 6. Bottom Right Panel: A dark charcoal gray icon system table containing 54 neatly arranged small geometric UI fonts using thin cyan, peach, and beige lines; including circles, sliders, crosshairs, brackets, arrows, nodes, target symbols, grids, and abstract interface controls. Visual Style: A warm-toned interpretation of technical schematics; combining Bauhaus precision, medieval information design, old engineering drawings, soft futuristic interface graphics, and tactile simulated materials. Use soft colors: charcoal black, faded cream, parchment beige, gray-blue, light blue, peach, amber, and soft gray. Lines should be extremely fine and precise, with subtle glowing effects only in small highlights. Add paper textures, scanned textures, faint speckles, worn edges, and layered transparent drawing marks. Text and Markings: Include tiny pseudo-technical annotations and measurement scales, but keep all text largely unreadable and decorative. Avoid large, readable headings. Use minimal symbols such as plus signs, crosshairs, coordinates, micro-labels, and tiny ruler marks. Constraints: No portraits, no photorealistic objects except for paper/notebook textures, no logos, no watermarks, and no additional panels beyond the designated 6 panels. Maintain a refined sense of exploration within the design system, rather than a chaotic collage.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="theme" default="友好的 AI 界面设计"} 创建一个温暖、精致且具有示意图美感的设计系统情绪板，结合技术图表、复古纸张纹理和微妙的未来感 UI 符号。

画布：宽幅横向图像，比例约为 16:9，采用深炭灰色背景，中心放置一个 2 行 3 列的网格，包含六个由粗黑色间隙分隔的矩形面板。整体氛围温暖、具有档案感、精准且略带神秘，如同设计系统探索墙。

布局：使用 6 个面板：
1. 左上角面板：深海军蓝/黑色技术蓝图，带有轨道螺旋或类似星系的轮廓图、精细的青色线条、微小的琥珀色发光点、垂直测量线、细小的不可读注释，右下角附近有一个小方框图标。
2. 上方中间面板：奶油色纸张上的可爱圆润机器人脸示意图，由分层的圆角矩形轮廓线构成，带有两个青色圆点眼睛、一个小桃色微笑、垂直和水平构造线、小十字准线标记以及模糊的测量注释。
3. 右上角面板：暖米色抽象建筑飞行路径示意图，带有扫过的青色和灰色弧线、角形线条结构、精细网格线、十字准线、橙色发光点和微小的技术标签。
4. 左下角面板：带有纸胶带边角的陈旧螺旋装订笔记本页面，包含圆形雷达图、几何构造图、小型 UI 字形、右上角的桃色笑脸贴纸、左下角附近的一张小卡片，以及右下角附近的红色六边形印章。
5. 下方中间面板：柔和青色和棕褐色的朦胧未来感建筑景观或广场，叠加有透视网格、精细的 UI 测量线、微妙的橙色高光和半透明的示意图注释。
6. 右下角面板：深炭灰色图标系统表，包含整齐排列的 54 个小型几何 UI 字形，使用细青色、桃色和米色线条；包括圆圈、滑块、十字准线、括号、箭头、节点、目标符号、网格和抽象界面控件。

视觉风格：技术示意图的暖色调演绎；结合包豪斯式的精准、中世纪信息设计、旧工程图纸、柔和的未来感界面图形以及触感模拟材料。使用柔和的色彩：炭黑色、褪色的奶油色、羊皮纸米色、灰青色、淡青色、桃色、琥珀色和柔和的灰色。线条应极其精细且精准，仅在小高光处带有微妙的发光效果。添加纸张纹理、扫描质感、微弱斑点、磨损边缘和分层的透明绘图标记。

文字与标记：包含微小的伪技术注释和测量刻度，但保持所有文字基本不可读且具有装饰性。避免使用大的可读标题。使用最少的符号，如加号、十字准线、坐标、微型标签和微小的标尺标记。

约束：没有人像，除纸张/笔记本纹理外没有照片级真实物体，没有徽标，没有水印，除指定的 6 个面板外没有额外面板。保持精致的设计系统探索感，而非混乱的拼贴画。

templates.title: Storyboard project list from Milan to Cannes

titleLocalized.zh: 从米兰到戛纳的 Storyboard 项目表

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a hand-drawn, cinematic storyboard depicting a woman traveling from Milan to Cannes with a hard drive, presented in a rough, colored pencil project style. Canvas: 16:9 landscape orientation, off-white paper background with slight texture, conveying a scanned sketch feel. All storyboard borders and the bottom icon bar use thin red-orange borders. The drawing style is loose graphite pencil, accented with soft light blue, gray, sepia, and muted red; perspective is imperfect, revealing draft lines, handwritten text, and intentionally misspelled storyboard notes. Header: "FROM MILANO TO CANNES - STORYBOBARD" in bold, uneven black handwriting at the top. A small rounded rectangle label in the upper right corner contains the handwritten text "2 BOSIS → TO AVE". Layout: Use 6 main storyboard panels arranged in 2 rows and 3 columns. Each panel has a thin red-orange rectangle border and a brief handwritten description below. The panels are numbered 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, and 7 in sequence, with skipped numbers retained. A recurring young female protagonist is used.{argument name="character name" default="an unnamed woman"} She has shoulder-length dark hair and wears a simple sleeveless or short-sleeved top; her face can be blurred or minimally depicted. Panel details and descriptions: 1. Indoor desk scene: The woman sits sideways at a desk with an open laptop, a small bowl or cup on it, and a large window offering a soft cityscape view. Description: "FINAL CUT S AM, AND FEMJUER - OUR PBSY FILR IN A TOLAND AFSAGMENT". 2. Close-up of a hand, placed on a bag or jacket, next to a small hard drive or tag with a label. Description: "ONE HARD DRIVE, ONE LANVARD UNE SHOT." 3. Coastal road arrival scene with palm trees, a blue road or sea, and Cannes-like buildings in the distance. Description: "THE GOAST UNROALS ITALY BECOMES FRANCE." 4. Croisette, Cannes: The woman is seen from behind, near palm trees, a car, a pale building facade, and a small roadside sign. 6. From behind, a woman looks up at a cinema or film festival building sign with scribbled lettering. Description: "THERE. HFE MANE. THE BOROO.^ THREE TIMES. TO BELIEVE IT." 7. A red carpet corridor or grand interior: A woman stands sideways, looking up, surrounded by sketch-style crowds on either side, with a red carpet extending forward. Description: "TWENTY FOUR STEPS EVERY FLASH A TEAR OF WORK." Bottom bar: Add a long, red-orange bordered area divided into 10 small rectangular cells, each containing a small, rough icon with a handwritten label below. From left to right: 1) Small capsule/hard drive icon, labeled "CAPYERA PRAME MOTION.", 2) Curved arrow and letter, labeled "SI REEKE.", 3) Quick arrow marker, no additional heading, 4) Diamond/eye shape, labeled "DIRECTON.", 5) Small lip/ellipse icon, no additional explanation, 6) Slanted square, labeled "FORCE.", 7) Star, labeled "CURRENT.", 8) Outline star, labeled "MAGIC:.", 9) Rounded rectangle, labeled "APPEARANCE.", 10) Small flag/lightning bolt marker, labeled "MAGIC." Visual constraints: All text should remain hand-drawn, uneven, and slightly meaningless, as if quickly sketched in a Storyboard notebook. Maintain a soft, handcrafted feel; avoid photorealistic aesthetics, clean digital UI, and watermarks. No additional Storyboard panels should be added besides the 6 main panels and 10 bottom icon cells.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张手绘风格的电影感 Storyboard 项目表，讲述一名女性携带硬盘从米兰前往戛纳的故事，画面呈现为粗糙的铅笔加彩色铅笔制作项目风格。

画布：横向 16:9 米白色纸张背景，带有轻微纹理，呈现扫描后的速写本质感。所有 Storyboard 边框和底部图标栏均使用细红橙色边框。绘画风格为松散的石墨铅笔画，辅以柔和的淡蓝色、灰色、棕褐色和柔和的红色渲染；透视不完美，可见草稿线条，手写字体，并有意拼写错误的 Storyboard 注释。

页眉：在顶部用粗大且不均匀的黑色手写体写上“FROM MILANO TO CANNES - STORYBOBARD”。在右上角添加一个小的圆角矩形标签，内含手写文字“2 BOSIS → TO AVE”。

布局：使用 6 个主要的 Storyboard 面板，排列为 2 行 3 列。每个面板都有一个细红橙色矩形边框，下方配有简短的手写说明。面板编号依次为 1、2、3、4、6 和 7，保留跳号。使用一名重复出现的年轻女性主角，{argument name="character name" default="an unnamed woman"}，留着齐肩深色头发，穿着简单的无袖或短袖上衣；她的面部可以模糊处理或仅进行极简刻画。

面板细节和说明：
1. 室内书桌场景：女性侧身坐在桌旁，桌上有打开的笔记本电脑、一个小碗或杯子，高大的窗户透出柔和的城市景观。说明：“FINAL CUT S AM, AND FEMJUER- OUR PBSY FILR IN A TOLAND AFSAGMENT”。
2. 手部特写，放在包或夹克上，旁边是一个带有标签的小硬盘或挂牌。说明：“ONE HARD DRIVE, ONE LANVARD UNE SHOT.”
3. 沿海公路到达场景，有棕榈树、蓝色的道路或大海，以及远处类似戛纳的建筑。说明：“THE GOAST UNROALS ITALY BECOMES FRANCE,”。
4. 戛纳克鲁瓦塞特大道（Croisette）：从背后看女性，靠近棕榈树、一辆汽车、淡色的建筑立面和一个小的路边标志。说明：“CANNE’S THE CROISEITE, HEART FOUNDING.”
6. 从背后看女性，抬头仰望一个带有潦草字迹的电影院或电影节建筑标志。说明：“THERE. HFE MANE. THE BOROO.^ THREE TIMES. TO BELIEVE IT.”
7. 红毯走廊或宏伟的室内：女性侧身站立，向上看，周围是两侧草图风格的人群，红毯向前延伸。说明：“TWENTY FOUR STEPS EVERY FLASH A TEAR OF WORK.”

底部栏：添加一个长条状的红橙色边框区域，分为 10 个小矩形单元格，每个单元格内含一个小巧粗糙的图标，下方配有手写标签。从左到右：1) 小型胶囊/硬盘图标，标注“CAPYERA PRAME MOTION.”，2) 弯曲箭头和字母，标注“SI REEKE.”，3) 快速箭头标记，无额外大标题，4) 菱形/眼睛形状，标注“DIRECTON.”，5) 小嘴唇/椭圆图标，无额外说明，6) 倾斜正方形，标注“FORCE”，7) 星形，标注“CURRENT”，8) 轮廓星形，标注“MAGIC:”，9) 圆角矩形，标注“APPEARANCE”，10) 小旗帜/闪电标记，标注“MAGIC”。

视觉限制：所有文字保持手绘、不均匀且略显无意义，如同在 Storyboard 笔记本中快速草拟。保持柔和的手工质感，无照片级真实感，无整洁的数字 UI，无水印，除 6 个主要面板和 10 个底部图标单元格外，不得添加额外的 Storyboard 面板。

templates.title: Sunset Seaside Rose Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 日落海滨玫瑰肖像

templates.prompt: Create a vibrant square sunset portrait depicting a young woman in a seaside rose garden, using {argument name="character identity" default="A naturally young woman with long, dark hair"} As a concept of identity, the composition employs a half-body shot, placing the subject centered near the camera against a backdrop of blooming red roses and the horizon. The sun, low in the left sky, casts a strong golden backlight on the water, creating shimmering reflections, a warm lens flare, and rim lighting that outlines the hair and shoulders. She has long, dark brown to black hair, parted in the middle and braided into two loose braids that fall over her shoulders. She wears a soft, cream-white, pastoral-style blouse with puff sleeves, lace trim, a ruffled collar, a small front bow, and delicate miniature pink floral prints. She is depicted in a playful pose, her hands raised to either side of her face, each hand making a peace sign; her fingers move with elegant, natural grace. Fantastical neon graffiti effects surround her: two glowing butterflies, a larger one positioned above her head to the upper right, and a smaller one near the rose bushes to her right; colorful hand-painted rainbow streaks, glitter, small hearts, and confetti-like brushstrokes are added around her hair and shoulders. The background remains lush and slightly blurred, revealing numerous red roses and green leaves, while the main subject remains sharp. The photography employs a dreamlike golden hour style, featuring cinematic bokeh, high detail, natural skin tones, realistic hair texture, a cheerful magical garden atmosphere, and saturated yet elegant colors.{argument name="face treatment" default="Maintain a natural, unmasked face."} Avoid text, watermarks, extra characters, distorted hands, extra fingers, duplicate faces, or heavy cartoon rendering.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张充满活力的方形日落肖像，描绘一位在海滨玫瑰园中的年轻女性，使用 {argument name="character identity" default="一位留着深色长发的自然年轻女性"} 作为身份概念。采用半身构图，将人物居中靠近镜头，背景为盛开的红玫瑰和海平线。太阳位于左侧低空，在水面上投射出强烈的金色背光，形成闪烁的倒影、温暖的镜头光晕，以及勾勒出头发和肩部轮廓的边缘光。她留着深棕色至黑色的长发，中分并编成 2 条松散的辫子垂在肩前。她身穿一件柔软的奶油白色田园风衬衫，带有泡泡袖、蕾丝边、褶皱领口、小前蝴蝶结和精致的微型粉色花卉印花。让她摆出俏皮的姿势，双手举起，放在脸部两侧，每只手都比出剪刀手；手指姿态优雅自然。周围环绕着奇幻的霓虹涂鸦效果：2 只发光的蝴蝶，一只较大的蝴蝶位于她头顶右上方，另一只较小的蝴蝶位于她右侧的玫瑰花丛附近；在她的头发和肩部周围添加色彩缤纷的手绘彩虹光迹、闪光、小爱心和五彩纸屑般的笔触。背景保持郁郁葱葱且略微模糊，可见多朵红玫瑰和绿叶，但主体需保持清晰。采用梦幻般的黄金时刻摄影风格，电影级虚化，高细节，自然的肤色，逼真的发质，欢快的魔法花园氛围，以及饱和但高雅的色彩。{argument name="face treatment" default="保持真实自然的脸部，无遮挡"}。避免出现文字、水印、多余人物、扭曲的手部、多余的手指、重复的脸部或厚重的卡通渲染。

templates.title: Halftone floral landing page homepage

titleLocalized.zh: 半色调花卉落地页首屏

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a sophisticated vertical landing page mockup for a subscription service, showcasing a retro halftone editing style and Figma-esque web design precision. Canvas: 3:4 vertical image with a pure black outer background. A tall, rounded rectangular website card is placed in the center of the image, occupying most of the space, surrounded by a wide black margin. Main visual: Inside the card, a dreamy, upward-looking scene depicts wildflowers under a blue sky and white clouds. A strong retro halftone dot texture is applied across the entire card image. A deep black gradient overlay is added from the bottom up, giving the lower half a deep and legible effect while maintaining the bright sky blue of the upper half. The visible floral elements should precisely include 9 main flowers: one partial yellow flower in the top left corner, one pink flower in the upper left corner, two clusters of white daisies in the center left, one large white cosmos in the center right, one white daisy near the bottom left, one small pale blue flower near the bottom center, one pink flower in the bottom right corner, and one partially hidden dark white flower at the bottom right edge, plus slender stems and tiny baby's breath buds. Top navigation: Place 3 small capsule buttons at the top center of the card, with a delicate frosted/blurred style and soft shadows. Button 1 text: "{argument name="login button text" default="Log in"} Located on a dark charcoal gray capsule. Button 2 Text: "{argument name="booking button text" default="Schedule a call"} The text is preceded by a small white telephone icon and is located on a warm-toned, dark, semi-transparent capsule. Button 3 text: "{argument name="pricing button text" default="View price"} Located on a light matte gray-blue capsule, it uses a simple, small sans-serif white font. Central detail: A loading circle is added to the center of the card, consisting of a white ring with a small orange-red dot in the lower left corner. Maintaining a clean and crisp look. First screen layout: In the lower third, an elegant, large white serif title is placed in the center, containing the text "..."{argument name="headline text" default="Design and Development\nSubscription Services"} The first line displays "Design and Development"; the second line displays "Subscription Service," with the word "Subscription" in italic serif font. The use of sophisticated high-contrast fonts and ample letter spacing creates a luxurious editorial feel. Call to Action (CTA): Below the headline, a small white CTA is placed in the center, containing the text "..."{argument name="call to action text" default="View the plan"} ", followed by a thin, right-pointing arrow. Maintain a minimalist style and align with the title. Style constraints: High-end webpage design, realistic floral sky background, halftone print texture, dark cinematic gradient at the bottom, rounded cards, no browser borders, no extra logo, no watermark, and no additional text other than 3 navigation buttons, the title, and the CTA.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为设计订阅服务创建一个精致的竖版落地页首屏模型，呈现怀旧的半色调编辑风格和 Figma 风格的网页设计精度。

画布：3:4 竖向图像，外层背景为纯黑色。在画面中心放置一个高大的圆角矩形网站卡片，占据画面大部分空间，并在周围留出宽厚的黑色边距。

主视觉：在卡片内部，使用梦幻般的仰视摄影风格场景，展现蓝天白云下的野花。在整个卡片图像上应用强烈的复古半色调网点纹理。从底部向上添加深黑色渐变叠加，使下半部分呈现出深邃且易读的效果，同时保持上半部分的明亮天蓝色。可见的花卉元素应精确包含 9 朵主花：左上角 1 朵局部黄色花朵，左上方 1 朵粉色花朵，左中位置 2 朵簇拥的白色雏菊，右中位置 1 朵大型白色波斯菊，左下附近 1 朵白色雏菊，下部中心附近 1 朵小型淡蓝色花朵，右下角 1 朵粉色花朵，以及右下边缘 1 朵部分隐藏的深色白色花朵，外加细长的茎秆和细小的满天星花蕾。

顶部导航：在卡片顶部中心放置 3 个小型胶囊按钮，采用精致的磨砂/模糊样式和柔和阴影。按钮 1 文本：“{argument name="login button text" default="登录"}”，位于深炭灰色胶囊上。按钮 2 文本：“{argument name="booking button text" default="预约通话"}”，文本前带有小型白色电话图标，位于暖色深色半透明胶囊上。按钮 3 文本：“{argument name="pricing button text" default="查看价格"}”，位于浅磨砂灰蓝色胶囊上。使用简洁的小号无衬线白色字体。

中心细节：在卡片中间添加一个加载转圈，由一个白色圆环组成，圆环左下角带有一个橙红色小圆点。保持简洁明快。

首屏排版：在下三分之一处，居中放置一个优雅的白色大号衬线标题，内容为“{argument name="headline text" default="设计与开发\n订阅服务"}”。第一行显示“设计与开发”；第二行显示“订阅服务”，其中“订阅”一词采用斜体衬线字。使用精致的高对比度字体、宽裕的字间距，营造奢华的编辑感。

行动号召（CTA）：在标题下方，居中放置一个小型白色 CTA，内容为“{argument name="call to action text" default="查看方案"}”，后接一个细长的向右箭头。保持极简风格并与标题对齐。

风格限制：高端网页首屏设计，逼真的花卉天空背景，半色调印刷纹理，底部深色电影感渐变，圆角卡片，无浏览器边框，无额外 Logo，无水印，除 3 个导航按钮、标题和 CTA 外，不包含任何额外文本。

templates.title: Noir fashion editor magazine cover

titleLocalized.zh: Noir 时尚编辑杂志封面

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a dark and luxurious cover for Noir fashion magazine, with {argument name="character name" default="Sheena"} A realistic full-body portrait serves as the central model, showcasing cinematic winter charm, high-contrast lighting, and a composition reminiscent of high-fashion magazines. Canvas: 9:16. Vertical magazine cover, approximately 675 × 1200 px. Deep black background with subtle snow or dust particles, the ground exhibiting a glossy, wet reflection with dramatic rim lighting. Subject: A stylish woman stands confidently in the center, her entire body visible. She has long, dark, wavy hair with two loose braids framing her forehead, her figure naturally realistic and elegantly proportioned. Her face is deliberately obscured by neutral brown solid rectangles: a larger vertical rectangle covers the upper half of her face and head, while a smaller rectangle covers the lower left side of her face. Clothing comprises six distinct fashion pieces: a deep burgundy satin shirt (deep V-neck with long tie scarf details), black high-waisted leather shorts, a long black wool coat, black fur or faux fur epaulettes, knee-high patent black leather boots, and a small black chain handbag held in one hand. Pose: One hand in pocket, the other holding a bag, body slightly turned to the side, exuding the aura of a luxury magazine cover model. Background Portrait Layer: Add an oversized close-up portrait of the same woman behind the full-body figure, filling most of the upper and middle background. The enlarged portrait should be in a dark tone, softly blurred, partially disappearing into shadow, revealing only the hair and neck lines, creating a dramatic double-exposure magazine cover effect. Typography and Layout: Use an elegant, high-fashion serif font and handwriting in white. Includes 7 sets of clear text: 1. A huge masthead at the top: “NOIR”, in a refined Didot-style serif font, white, spanning almost the entire width, partially behind or around the background portrait. 2. Top left headline: “MODERN ELEGANCE”, stacked in two lines, small white serif font. 3. The left-hand list at the bottom consists of six lines: "Timeless Presence," "Quiet Power," "Beauty in Shadow," "and Light," "The New Language," and "of Grace," with an additional line below that: "Editorial Winter Romance," all in small white serif font. 4. The large handwritten title in the lower middle section:{argument name="cover name" default="SHEENA"} 5. Right-side vertical headline: "NOIR EDITION", rotated vertically along the right edge, using tall white serif capital letters. 6. Bottom left tagline: "ELEGANCE IS ETERNAL", small white serif capital letters. 7. Bottom right tagline: "A STUDY IN MODERN GLAMOUR", small white serif capital letters. Visual style: Noir fashion editorial style, cinematic winter romance, luxury magazine cover, realistic portrait photography, dramatic chiaroscuro, black and burgundy tones, soft snowflake particles, brightly reflecting ground, Vogue-level high-end styling, melancholic shadows, clean white typography. Constraints: Keep the composition simple and magazine-quality; no additional text, logos, barcodes, dates, or watermarks are allowed. Maintain accurate text content and the number of text groups. Maintain two solid rectangles obscuring the face and layered oversized background portraits.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一款暗黑奢华风 Noir 时尚编辑杂志封面，以 {argument name="character name" default="Sheena"} 的写实全身肖像作为核心模特，呈现电影级的冬季魅力、高对比度光影以及高级时尚杂志的构图。

画布：9:16 竖版杂志封面，尺寸约为 675 × 1200 px。深黑色背景，带有细微的降雪或尘埃颗粒，地面呈现光亮的湿润反射，并配有戏剧性的轮廓光。

主体：一位时尚女性居中站立，姿态自信，全身可见。她留着深色长波浪卷发，前额留有两缕松散的编发，形象自然写实，比例优雅。她的面部特意被中性棕色实心矩形遮挡：一个较大的垂直矩形覆盖上半脸和头部区域，另一个较小的矩形覆盖左下脸区域。服装包含 6 件清晰的时尚单品：深酒红色缎面衬衫（深 V 领口，带有长系带围巾细节）、黑色高腰皮短裤、黑色长款羊毛大衣、黑色皮草或仿皮草肩饰、及膝亮面黑皮靴，以及一只单手持握的小型黑色链条手提包。姿势：一手插兜，另一手持包，身体微侧，展现奢华杂志封面模特的风范。

背景肖像层：在全身人物后方添加一张同一女性的超大特写肖像，填充大部分上部和中部背景。放大的肖像应呈现暗色调，经过柔和模糊处理，部分隐没于阴影中，仅露出头发和颈部线条，营造出戏剧性的双重曝光杂志封面效果。

排版与布局：使用优雅的高级时尚衬线字体和手写体，颜色为白色。包含 7 组明确的文本：
1. 顶部巨大的刊头：“NOIR”，采用精致的 Didot 风格衬线字体，白色，横跨几乎整个宽度，部分位于背景肖像后方或周围。
2. 左上角专题标题：“MODERN ELEGANCE”，分两行堆叠，小型白色衬线字体。
3. 下方的左侧专题列表，共 6 行：“Timeless Presence”、“Quiet Power”、“Beauty in Shadow”、“and Light”、“The New Language”、“of Grace”，下方另加一行“Editorial Winter Romance”，均为小型白色衬线字体。
4. 中下部巨大的手写体名称：“{argument name="cover name" default="SHEENA"}”，白色，横跨模特与背景。
5. 右侧垂直标题：“NOIR EDITION”，沿右边缘垂直旋转，使用高大的白色衬线大写字母。
6. 左下角标语：“ELEGANCE IS ETERNAL”，小型白色衬线大写字母。
7. 右下角标语：“A STUDY IN MODERN GLAMOUR”，小型白色衬线大写字母。

视觉风格：Noir 时尚编辑风、电影级冬季浪漫、奢华杂志封面、写实肖像摄影、戏剧性明暗对照法、黑色与酒红色调、柔和雪花颗粒、光亮反射地面、Vogue 级高级造型、忧郁阴影、清晰的白色排版。

约束条件：保持构图简洁且达到杂志水准，不得添加额外文本、Logo、条形码、日期或水印。保留精确的文本内容和文本组数量。维持两个遮挡面部的实心矩形以及分层的超大背景肖像。

templates.title: Kurenai Flat Anime Poster

titleLocalized.zh: Kurenai 扁平化动漫海报

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="character name" default="Kurenai"} Create a simple, flat anime-style main visual poster, emphasizing bold graphic design rather than ultra-refined rendering. Canvas: 16:9 aspect ratio, horizontal composition, gray-white background, clean vector-style anime lines, using a limited color scheme of black, deep red, light skin tone, and soft gold. Layout: Place the character in the right two-thirds of the frame, using a large composition, cropped from mid-thigh upwards, body slightly turned to the left, expression calm and serious. Place a large, slanted deep red rectangle behind the character as the main geometric background. Title typography on the left: a very large red Japanese kanji "紅" (red), below which is the Romanized spelling "KURENAI," accompanied by a small red flower icon and a thin horizontal line, along with the slogan "HONOR IN SILENCE, BLADE IN BLOOM." Add a minimalist UI-style red graphic bar in the lower left corner, and a small vertical red tick mark near the upper left edge. Main details: Depict an anime woman with long {argument name="hair color" default="black"} A high ponytail with loose bangs framing her face, and red eyes. She wears a modern female ninja/samurai-style black outfit: a sleeveless, high-necked crop top, a high-waisted black skirt or shorts, adorned with small gold hardware, red ties, and an off-the-shoulder black haori draped over her arms. The cuffs are decorated with soft gold trim, buckles, rings, and floral embroidery. A katana hangs at her left waist, its hilt black, featuring a red diamond-shaped wrap and a gold tsuba (handguard). She wears two long tassel earrings with red tassels and gold geometric shapes, and two red hairbands tied to her ponytail. Decorative elements include a large red geometric rectangle behind the character containing a faint floral silhouette, five floating red petals around the right and central areas, a small red flower icon below the title, a set of horizontal red stripes in the lower left corner, and a vertical scale mark pattern in the upper left corner. Visual Style: Flat anime illustration style, with sharp, clear outlines, smooth cel shadows, minimalist gradients, elegant poster design, high contrast, restrained details, no painterly texture, no realism, and no cluttered backgrounds. The atmosphere should convey a sense of calm, tranquility, refinement, and danger. Text Content: Large Chinese characters for "red," the Roman letters "KURENAI," and slogans.{argument name="tagline" default="HONOR IN SILENCE, BLADE IN BLOOM."} All text should be dark red, clear, and left-aligned. Constraints: Do not add extra characters, weapons, text blocks, or detailed environmental backgrounds. Maintain a clean and open composition, utilizing gray and white space to create a refined, flat anime poster feel.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="Kurenai"} 创建一张简洁的扁平化动漫主视觉海报，强调大胆的图形设计，而非超精细的渲染。

画布：宽幅 16:9 横向构图，灰白色背景，清晰的矢量风格动漫线条，采用黑、深红、浅肤色和柔和金色的有限配色方案。

布局：将角色置于画面右侧三分之二处，采用大尺寸构图，从大腿中部向上截取，身体微向左转，表情冷静严肃。在角色身后放置一个巨大的倾斜深红色矩形作为主要几何背景。标题排版置于左侧：一个非常大的红色日文汉字「紅」，下方是罗马拼音“KURENAI”，配有一个小型红色花朵图标和一条细水平线，以及标语“HONOR IN SILENCE, BLADE IN BLOOM.”。在左下角添加极简的 UI 风格红色图形条，并在左上角边缘附近添加一个小型垂直红色刻度标记图案。

主体细节：描绘 1 名动漫女性，留着长长的 {argument name="hair color" default="black"} 高马尾，脸颊两侧有松散的刘海，红色双眼。身穿现代女忍者/武士风格的黑色服装：无袖高领露脐上衣，高腰黑色短裙或短裤，配有小型金色五金件、红色系带，以及披在双臂上的露肩黑色羽织外套。袖口饰有柔和的金色镶边、扣环、圆环和花卉刺绣。左侧腰间佩戴 1 把武士刀，刀柄为黑色，配有红色菱形缠带和金色刀镡。佩戴 2 只长款流苏耳环，带有红色流苏和金色几何形状，马尾上系着 2 条红色发带。

装饰元素：包含 1 个位于角色身后的巨大红色几何矩形，矩形内有 1 个淡淡的花卉剪影，右侧和中心区域周围有 5 片漂浮的红色花瓣，标题下方有 1 个小型红色花朵图标，左下角有 1 组水平红色条纹，左上角有 1 个垂直刻度标记图案。

视觉风格：扁平化动漫插画，轮廓清晰锐利，平滑的赛璐珞阴影，极简渐变，优雅的海报设计，高对比度，细节克制，无绘画质感，无写实感，无杂乱背景。氛围应表现得沉稳、静谧、精致且危险。

文本内容：大号汉字「紅」、罗马字母“KURENAI”以及标语 {argument name="tagline" default="HONOR IN SILENCE, BLADE IN BLOOM."}。所有文字均保持深红色、清晰且左对齐。

约束：不要添加额外角色、额外武器、额外文本块或详细的环境背景。保持构图通透，利用灰白色留白，呈现精致的扁平化动漫海报质感。

variables.defaultValue: HONOR IN SILENCE, BLADE IN BLOOM.

templates.title: Retro Yunnan Tea Horse Road Map

titleLocalized.zh: 复古云南茶马古道地图

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a retro-style Chinese travel map with the theme of{argument name="region title" default="Yunnan Tea Horse Road Map"} This work presents the ancient caravan routes through Yunnan in the form of a hand-drawn parchment map. Canvas: 2:3 vertical poster with a background of aged Xuan paper featuring a worn texture, subtle stains, ink borders, and soft mineral pigments. The overall look should blend the style of Qing Dynasty travel scrolls with fantastical historical maps. Layout: A large, irregular shape centered on the outline of Yunnan Province is divided into eight colored areas with soft ink outlines. A winding, beige caravan route enters from the lower left corner, passes through the center, and exits near the upper center, connecting all major stations. Light monochrome mountains, rivers, clouds, and blank parchment spaces are added around the province. Title and Side Text: A large, vertical black calligraphy title, “Yunnan Tea Horse Road Map,” is placed on the right edge, alongside a smaller vertical English subtitle, “YUNNAN TEA HORSE ROAD MAP.” Small vertical Chinese calligraphy annotations are added in the upper left and lower right corners, and two red square stamps are placed near the title and annotations. Map Areas: Contains 8 marked areas, each with a large Chinese place name and a smaller descriptive subtitle: 1) Northwest green area, "Diqing," featuring Tibetan Buddhist monasteries and two pagodas; 2) Western blue area, "Lijiang," featuring ancient towns, tiled roofs, and arched bridges; 3) Central gold area, "Dali," featuring the Three Pagodas on the lakeside; 4) Eastern orange area, "Kunming," featuring stone forest peaks and city gates; 5) Southwestern light green area, "Baoshan," featuring market towns and bridges; 6) Central-southern earth-green area, "Pu'er," featuring terraced tea mountains and tea transport crates; 7) Southeastern blue-green area, "Yuxi," featuring the scenery of Fuxian Lake; 8) Far southern dark green area, "Xishuangbanna," featuring tropical tea forests, elephants, and Dai architecture. Route Details: Three route styles are shown in the small legend in the lower left corner: the main Tea Horse Road is a solid dark line, branch routes are dashed lines, and major trading posts are red dots. Add a compass rose above the legend, marked with East, South, West, and North. Caravan Elements: Depict six clearly visible caravans along the route: 1) A group of people and pack animals departing from the lower left corner; 2) A group near Pu'er with two loaded horses and a muleteer; 3) A group in the middle of the route with three loaded pack animals climbing towards Dali; 4) A group passing the Three Pagodas of Dali; 5) A group entering the Diqing Mountains; 6) A small, distant caravan near the top of the route. Use brown horses and mules carrying stacks of tea bags, accompanied by several travelers in robes. Decorative Elements: Add four main plant/animal decorations to the outside or near the map: 1) A tea leaf on the left; 2) A cluster of tea trees in the center below; 3) Tropical broadleaf and flowers in the lower right corner; 4) A blue-green peacock standing in the lower right corner. Add a red stamp in the lower left corner with the inscription "Tea Horse Road". Visual Style: Fine black ink lines, watercolor rendering, ancient map illustrations, Chinese landscape painting, misty mountains, delicate river lines, traditional brush calligraphy, a warm dark brown parchment background, and soft cyan, ochre, jade green, blue, and rust tones. Maintain rich detail while ensuring overall harmony and a sense of age. Constraints: Maintain a vertical poster composition, use clear handwritten brush calligraphy for Chinese labels, and avoid modern roads, cars, buildings, icons, bright digital colors, photorealism, or minimalist vector graphics. No watermark.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张复古风格的中国风旅行地图，主题为 {argument name="region title" default="云南茶马古道地图"}，以手绘羊皮纸地图的形式展现穿过云南的古老商队路线。

画布：2:3 纵向海报，背景为带有磨损质感、细微污渍、水墨边框和柔和矿物颜料的老旧宣纸。整体外观应融合清代旅行卷轴与奇幻历史地图的风格。

布局：将云南省的轮廓作为中心的大型不规则形状，划分为 8 个带有柔和水墨轮廓的着色区域。一条蜿蜒的米色商队古道从左下角进入，穿过中心，在上方中部附近穿出，连接所有主要站点。在省份周围，添加淡淡的单色山脉、河流、云朵和留白的羊皮纸空间。

标题与侧边文字：在右侧边缘放置一个大型垂直黑色毛笔字标题“云南茶马古道图”，旁边配以较小的垂直英文副标题“YUNNAN TEA HORSE ROAD MAP”。在左上角和右下角添加小型的垂直中文书法注释，并在标题和注释附近盖上两枚红色方形印章。

地图区域：包含 8 个标注区域，每个区域均有一个大型中文地名和较小的描述性副标题：1) 西北绿色区域，“迪庆”，配有藏传佛教寺院和两座宝塔；2) 西部蓝色区域，“丽江”，配有古镇、瓦屋顶和拱桥；3) 中部金色区域，“大理”，配有湖畔的三塔；4) 东部橙色区域，“昆明”，配有石林峰丛和城门；5) 西南部浅绿色区域，“保山”，配有集镇和桥梁；6) 中南部土绿色区域，“普洱”，配有梯田茶山和茶叶运输箱；7) 东南部蓝绿色区域，“玉溪”，配有抚仙湖风光；8) 极南部深绿色区域，“西双版纳”，配有热带茶林、大象和傣族建筑。

路线细节：在左下角的小图例中展示 3 种路线样式：主茶马古道为实心深色线条，分支路线为虚线，主要贸易站为红点。在图例上方添加一个标有东、南、西、北的指南针玫瑰图。

商队元素：沿路线描绘 6 组清晰可见的商队：1) 一组从左下角出发的人员和驮畜；2) 一组位于普洱附近，带有两匹负重马和一名赶马人；3) 一组位于路线中段，三匹负重驮畜正向大理攀爬；4) 一组经过大理三塔；5) 一组进入迪庆山区路线；6) 一组位于顶部路线附近的小型远景商队。使用棕色的马和骡子，背负堆叠的茶包，并配有几名身穿长袍的旅行者。

装饰元素：在地图外侧或附近添加 4 种主要的植物/动物装饰：1) 左侧的一枝茶叶；2) 下方中心的一簇茶树；3) 右下角的热带阔叶和花卉；4) 右下角站立的一只蓝绿色孔雀。在左下角添加一枚红色印章，内容为“茶马古道”。

视觉风格：精细的黑色水墨线条、水彩渲染、古地图插画、中国山水画、云雾缭绕的山脉、细腻的河流线条、传统毛笔书法、温暖的深褐色羊皮纸背景，以及柔和的青色、赭石色、玉绿色、蓝色和铁锈色。保持画面细节丰富，但整体和谐且具有年代感。

限制：保持纵向海报构图，使用清晰的手写毛笔中文标签，避免出现现代道路、汽车、建筑、图标、明亮的数字色彩、照片写实主义或简洁的矢量图形。无水印。

templates.title: Q-version desktop pet Sprite Sheet

titleLocalized.zh: Q 版桌面宠物 Sprite Sheet

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a simple, chibi-style sprite sheet for desktop pets, featuring six identical full-body anime girl sprites arranged neatly in a horizontal row. Canvas: Wide horizontal canvas, approximately 690 x 613 px, background filled with a solid, light chroma-key green. Leave large blank green areas above and below the sprite rows, and place the characters in the upper center of the image. Character Design: Named{argument name="character name" default="Codex Desktop Pets"} A petite, chibi-style anime girl with very fair skin, a large head and a small body. She has a short, silver-white bob with a tuft of hair on top and long sideburns. She wears purple flower hair accessories with thin black ribbon tassels on either side. She is dressed in a white gothic lolita-style maid outfit with dark navy black trim, puff sleeves, a bow at the neckline, purple floral embroidery near the hem, a short, puffy skirt, black suspender stocking details, white over-the-knee socks, and thick-soled white lace-up boots with dark soles. The design features clean 2D anime rendering, soft cel shadows, sharp outlines, and a cute toy-scale style. Number and poses of sprites: Includes 6 individual sprites, evenly distributed from left to right, all facing forward and standing upright, with subtle variations in arm and body poses. The six sprite images are as follows: 1) A neutral standing pose, with the face covered by a square gray placeholder; 2) A neutral standing pose, with the face covered by a square gray placeholder; 3) A neutral standing pose, with the face covered by a square gray placeholder; 4) A neutral standing pose, with the face covered by a square gray placeholder; 5) A visible face pose, eyes closed, with a calm and sleepy expression, without a placeholder; 6) A neutral standing pose, with the face covered by a square gray placeholder. Placeholders: On five of the six sprite images, use a vertical rectangular soft gray mask/placeholder to cover the face. Each placeholder should be centered on the face, using a gradient from light gray to pale purple with slightly softened edges, obscuring facial details while preserving hair, accessories, skirt, legs, and boots. Style Constraints: Ensure the sprite images are small, consistent, and usable as game assets. Keep all characters at the same proportions and baseline. Do not add any text, UI elements, shadows, borders, or props. The only background color should be [color missing].{argument name="background color" default="Bright green keying"} .

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个用于桌面宠物的简单 Q 版游戏精灵图（sprite sheet），要求在同一水平行上整齐排列 6 个完全相同的动漫女孩全身精灵图。

画布：宽幅横向画布，尺寸约为 690 x 613 px，背景填充为纯色亮色抠像绿（chroma-key green）。在精灵图行上下方留出大面积空白绿色区域，并将角色放置在画面中上部。

角色设计：一个名为 {argument name="character name" default="Codex 桌面宠物"} 的娇小 Q 版动漫女孩，皮肤非常白皙，头大身小，留着短款银白色波波头，头顶有一撮呆毛，两侧有长鬓角，两侧佩戴紫色花朵发饰，并带有细长的黑色丝带流苏。她身穿白色哥特萝莉风格女仆装，配有深藏青黑色镶边、泡泡袖、领口蝴蝶结、下摆附近的紫色花卉刺绣、短款蓬蓬裙、黑色吊带袜式细节、白色过膝袜，以及厚底白色系带靴，鞋底为深色。采用干净的 2D 动漫渲染、柔和的赛璐珞阴影、清晰的轮廓线，以及可爱的玩具比例风格。

精灵图数量与姿势：包含 6 个独立的精灵图，从左到右均匀分布，全部面向前方并直立站立，手臂和身体姿势有细微变化。这 6 个精灵图分别为：1) 正面中性站立姿势，面部区域被方形灰色占位块遮盖；2) 正面中性站立姿势，面部区域被方形灰色占位块遮盖；3) 正面中性站立姿势，面部区域被方形灰色占位块遮盖；4) 正面中性站立姿势，面部区域被方形灰色占位块遮盖；5) 正面可见面部姿势，闭眼，表情平静且困倦，无占位块；6) 正面中性站立姿势，面部区域被方形灰色占位块遮盖。

占位块：在 6 个精灵图中的 5 个上，用垂直矩形柔和灰色遮罩/占位块遮盖面部区域。每个块应居中覆盖在面部上，采用浅灰到淡紫色的渐变，边缘略微柔和，遮住面部细节，同时保留头发、装饰、裙子、腿部和靴子。

风格限制：确保精灵图小巧、一致，并可作为游戏素材使用。保持所有角色处于相同的比例和基准线上。不要添加任何文字、UI 、阴影、边框或道具。唯一的背景颜色应为 {argument name="background color" default="亮色抠像绿"}。

templates.title: Origami-style K-Pop idol portraits

titleLocalized.zh: 折纸风格 K-Pop 偶像肖像

templates.prompt: Create a 1:1 scale, highly detailed origami-style paper portrait, with the main subject being {argument name="character name" default="A stylish Korean pop idol"} The image shows the upper body, in a three-quarter profile from the right side, with the face deliberately obscured by a smooth, centered square block that transitions to a warm grayish-brown. The subject possesses distinct layers and a somewhat chaotic appearance.{argument name="hair color" default="black"} Her hair is composed of sharp, origami-like cuts; two silver pendant earrings are visible in her left ear; she wears a dramatically angular outfit.{argument name="jacket color" default="Metallic gold"} A hooded jacket layered over a black shirt, all clothing is constructed from triangular cardboard pieces with clearly defined creases, shadows, and a realistic handcrafted texture. The background is an ornate Japanese origami collage featuring black and charcoal gray mountains, cream-colored paper airplanes, gold foil decorations, and three distinct fan-shaped or radiating patterns: a gold semicircle in the upper left corner, a cream-colored fan in the center left, and a cream-colored fan in the center right. The image must include 12 clearly visible origami flowers: two large white flowers with gold stamens each in the upper left and upper right corners, one pale pink flower on the left edge, two pink flowers on the lower left edge, five pink cherry blossoms on a branch in the lower right corner, and two white cherry blossoms on a branch in the lower right corner. The composition employs a high-end fashion poster style, with bas-relief paper art depth, warm studio lighting, high contrast between matte black paper and metallic gold paper, fine crease lines, handcrafted shadows, and no readable text or watermarks. Keep the face-masking square clean and flat, while ensuring that the rest of the image retains high detail.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 1:1 方形、超精细的折纸风格纸艺肖像，主体为 {argument name="character name" default="一位时尚的韩国流行偶像"}，展示胸部以上部位，呈右侧四分之三侧面，面部区域被一个暖灰褐色渐变的平滑居中方形遮挡块刻意遮盖。主体拥有层次分明、凌乱的 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"} 头发，由锋利的折纸切面构成；左耳可见，佩戴两枚银色吊坠耳环；身穿一件极具戏剧性的棱角分明的 {argument name="jacket color" default="金属金色"} 连帽夹克，内搭黑色衬衫，所有服装均由带有清晰折痕、阴影和逼真手工质感的三角形纸板拼接而成。背景为华丽的日式折纸拼贴画，包含黑色和炭灰色的山峦、奶油色纸飞机、金箔装饰，以及 3 个明显的扇形或放射状图形：左上角一个金色半圆，左侧中央一个奶油色折扇，右侧中央一个奶油色折扇。画面中需包含 12 朵清晰可见的折纸花：左上角和右上角各 2 朵带金色花蕊的大白花，左边缘 1 朵淡粉色小花，左下边缘 2 朵粉色花朵，右下角树枝上 5 朵粉色樱花，以及右下角树枝上 2 朵白色樱花。采用高级编辑时尚海报构图，浅浮雕纸艺深度，温暖的摄影棚灯光，哑光黑纸与金属金纸之间的高对比度，精细的折痕线条，手工制作的阴影，且无任何可读文字或水印。保持面部遮挡方块干净平整，同时确保图像其余部分保持高度细节。

templates.title: Gentle Moon Goddess Fantasy Illustration

titleLocalized.zh: 柔和月亮女神奇幻插画

templates.prompt: Create a dreamlike mythological fantasy illustration in a 2:3 vertical poster format. The background should be a bright turquoise night sky with a delicate paper texture, adorned with tiny white stars, sparkles, and soft celestial decorations. At the top center, depict an ethereal moon goddess floating beneath a large, pale golden full moon. She wears flowing, East Asian-style ancient clothing, her robe composed of translucent ribbons in pink, lavender, mint green, aquamarine, and pale yellow, trailing gracefully to the right like a mist. She has high black hair tied in a bun and wears gold floral ornaments. Her face is rendered softly and painterly, rather than detailed. Behind her, add a vertical, aurora-like watercolor beam extending from top to bottom, blending blue, purple, green, and pink. The image should include four large starburst shapes: a pale turquoise four-pointed star in the upper left, a small pink star near the goddess, a large white four-pointed star to the right of the moon, and a yellow starburst in the center right. The image is scattered with five warm-toned, planetary-shaped circles: a peach circle on the left, a small orange circle near the goddess's robe, a light blue circle in the lower right, a large, translucent, light-colored circle behind the flowering tree, and a peach circle near the tree area in the lower left corner. In the lower half, a delicate golden flowering tree, with numerous small yellow flowers blooming on its slender branches, rises from the left. At the bottom, a circular cloud-covered landscape composed of pink, cyan, lavender, blue, peach, and mint green is depicted, presented with a watercolor texture and soft, vertical stripes. A small white rabbit with pink eyes and erect ears sits atop a central pink dome, gazing up at the goddess. The entire image is adorned with subtle glitter, shooting star lines, and soft magical spots. Overall style: Japanese fairytale poster, watercolor, soft gradients, celestial mythology, soft edges, fantasy, tranquility, high detail, no text, no border, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅梦幻般的神话奇幻插画，采用 2:3 竖版海报格式。背景使用带有细腻纸张纹理的明亮青绿色夜空，点缀着微小的白星、闪光和柔和的天体装饰。在上方中心位置，描绘一位空灵的月亮女神，她漂浮在巨大的淡金色满月之下；她身着飘逸的东亚风格古装，长袍由粉色、薰衣草紫、薄荷绿、水蓝色和淡黄色的半透明丝带组成，像薄雾一样向右侧优雅地拖曳。她留着黑色高发髻，佩戴金色花朵饰品，面部处理得柔和且具有绘画感，而非细节刻画。在她身后，添加一道从上到下延伸的垂直极光状水彩光束，融合了蓝色、紫色、绿色和粉色。画面中需包含 4 个大型星芒形状：左上方一个淡青色四角星，女神附近一个小粉色星，月亮右侧一个大白色四角星，以及中右侧一个黄色星芒。画面中散布着 5 个暖色调的圆形行星状圆圈：左侧一个桃色圆圈，女神长袍附近一个小橙色圆圈，右下方一个淡蓝色圆圈，花树后一个半透明的大淡色圆圈，以及左下角树木区域附近一个桃色圆圈。在下半部分，绘制一棵精致的金色花树，细长的枝干上开满许多黄色小花，从左侧升起。底部描绘一片由粉色、青色、薰衣草紫、蓝色、桃色和薄荷绿组成的圆形云丘景观，呈现水彩质感和垂直的柔和条纹。在中央粉色圆顶山丘顶部放置一只小白兔，它有着粉色的眼睛和竖起的耳朵，正抬头仰望女神。整幅画面点缀着细微的闪粉、流星线条和柔和的魔法斑点。整体风格：日本童话海报、水彩水粉画、柔和渐变、天体神话、柔和边缘、奇幻、宁静、高细节、无文字、无边框、无水印。

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个逼真的深色模式移动端烹饪 AI 助手界面，展示根据冰箱现有食材生成的日文食谱建议。

画布：竖屏手机截图，比例约为 4:5，黑色外背景，中间为 App 信息流列。使用圆角、柔和阴影和高级美食 App 的美学风格。

布局：顶部放置一个圆角深炭灰色聊天气泡，内含日文助手文本。下方展示垂直滚动的食谱卡片列表。需显示 2 张食谱卡片：第一张完整显示，第二张在底部仅显示部分。

文本内容：顶部聊天气泡内容为：「冷蔵庫の食材を活かし、フライパン一つで完結する健康的な10種のレシピをご提案します。味付けや調理法が重ならないよう、バリエーション豊かに構成しました。」第一张食谱卡片标题为：「鳥手羽元のエキゾチック酢煮込み」。描述为：「かんたん酢とニンニクを効かせた、中東風の爽やかでコクのある煮込みです。手羽元が驚くほど柔らかく仕上がります。」链接文本为：「レシピを見る」。

卡片细节：食谱卡片 1 顶部为大尺寸美食照片，下方为深色信息面板。照片展示 {argument name="main dish" default="braised chicken drumettes with sliced onions in a light brown sauce"}，盛放在浅米色陶瓷碗中，置于暖色调木桌上，采用略微俯视的角度拍摄，呈现自然的餐厅光影。鸡肉上点缀黑胡椒碎，酱汁色泽光亮，背景虚化柔和。在图片区域右上角放置 1 个圆形的白色心形轮廓收藏按钮。下方信息面板为深棕黑色，标题为加粗白色，描述为柔和灰色，食谱链接为淡粉色。

第二张卡片：在第一张卡片下方仅显示第二张食谱卡片的顶部，并留有垂直间距。应包含一张大尺寸裁剪后的美食照片，展示一碗奶油色调的浅黄色面条或汤，置于木桌上，图片右上角同样有 1 个圆形的白色心形轮廓收藏按钮。裁剪区域内不显示标题。

视觉风格：现代日式食谱 App UI，深色主题，18–22 px 圆角卡片，精致边框，柔和阴影，高分辨率美食摄影，简洁的无衬线字体。使用暖棕色、米色陶瓷、炭黑色面板和柔和的粉色强调文本。

约束条件：包含 1 个顶部聊天气泡，2 张可见的食谱卡片，总共 2 个心形收藏按钮。保持界面真实简洁，不要添加额外的图标、导航栏、水印或英文 UI 文本。

templates.title: Steampunk Gunslinger Character Art

titleLocalized.zh: 蒸汽朋克枪手角色艺术

templates.prompt: Create a full-body concept art illustration depicting a steampunk adventurer gunslinger, standing upright in the center of a pure white background, facing forward. The character is a gender-neutral young adult with {argument name="hair color" default="Light gold"} His medium-length, messy hair peeks out from under a towering black-brown top hat adorned with brass goggles, gears, rivets, leather panels, and a small brass telescope attachment. His face is deliberately rendered as a smooth, featureless, beige, blurred/blank oval, devoid of eyes, nose, or mouth. Clothing: A Victorian steampunk suit in dark brown, black, and bronze, including a long, slit leather trench coat, a fitted double-breasted vest, a black turtleneck shirt, a neckerchief with a blue gemstone brooch, multiple belts and holsters, a waist pouch, brass buttons, shoulder armor, a mechanical brass gauntlet/prosthetic forearm, black gloves, fitted black trousers with laces, and high-top dark leather boots. Pose: A confident stance with legs apart, left hand on hip, right arm raised, holding an ornate brass flintlock pistol tilted upwards. Only one weapon is shown: a brass pistol. It features exquisite anime-style fantasy character rendering with clear lines, delicate leather texture, metallic highlights, symmetrical front view presentation, soft studio lighting, minimalist shadows, and no background, no text, and no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张全身角色概念艺术插画，描绘一名蒸汽朋克冒险家枪手，直立于纯白色背景中心，面向前方。该角色为中性风格的年轻成年人，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="浅金色"} 的中长凌乱发型，从一顶高耸的黑棕色礼帽下露出；礼帽上装饰着黄铜护目镜、齿轮、铆钉、皮革镶板和一个小型黄铜望远镜附件。面部应刻意处理为平滑且无特征的米色模糊/空白椭圆形，没有眼睛、鼻子或嘴巴。服装：深棕色、黑色和古铜色的维多利亚蒸汽朋克套装，包括长款开叉皮质风衣、修身双排扣马甲、黑色高领衬衫、带有蓝色宝石胸针的领巾、多层腰带和枪套、腰部小包、黄铜纽扣、肩甲、一只机械黄铜护手/假肢前臂、黑色手套、带绑带的修身黑色长裤以及高筒深色皮靴。姿势：自信的站姿，双腿分开，左手叉腰，右臂抬起，手持一把向上倾斜的华丽黄铜燧发枪。仅显示一件武器：黄铜手枪。采用精致的动漫风格幻想角色表渲染，线条清晰，皮革纹理细腻，金属高光，对称的前视图呈现，柔和的摄影棚灯光，极简阴影，无背景，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Sapporo Apocalypse Manga Page

titleLocalized.zh: 札幌末日漫画页面

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a dramatic vertical comic strip depicting a supernatural apocalypse in modern-day Sapporo: a purple rift cracks open in the sky, a colossal demon descends, and a high school heroine with robot allies prepares to fight. Canvas: 3:4 high-format comic strip, full-bleed art style with fine white binding and black panel lines. Employ a refined, high-detail anime/manga style, combining cinematic lighting, saturated neon colors, dense urban details, and strong action composition. Layout: Use three vertically stacked horizontal panels. The first panel occupies the top third, the second the middle third, and the third the bottom third. Add four white, jagged comic bubbles with vertical Japanese text. Panel 1: A street view overlooking downtown Sapporo at night, crowded with terrified pedestrians looking up. To the left is the Sapporo TV Tower glowing orange, with a sign reading "30-24 SAPPORO". Above the horizon, the sky splits open into a giant purple vortex, filled with lightning, stars, and debris, with a red reptilian eye at its center. It contains two bubbles: a small, jagged bubble on the left, containing {argument name="left reaction text" default="なんだあれ!?"} On the right is a tall, jagged bubble containing {argument name="sky warning text" default="The sky is splitting open!!"} Panel 2: A vortex bursts above a neon-lit intersection in a Japanese city. A colossal demonic monster emerges from a purple storm, dominating most of the image. It possesses a muscular, dark purple body, glowing red eyes, massive, curved horns, ornate organic armor, claws reaching towards the street, and a glowing circular mark embedded in its chest. In the foreground, cars collide and tumble, sparks and explosions scatter across the road, people flee in panic, and buildings with neon signs line both sides. It includes a tall, jagged bubble on the right, containing {argument name="demon proclamation" default="Burn down the human world...!"} Panel 3: Hero entrance composition, with a background of pink petals falling like cherry blossoms and purple cosmic light. Foreground center: A Japanese high school heroine.{argument name="hero name" default="unnamed schoolgirl"} She stands confidently, her long black hair flowing in the wind; her face is either softened or not finely detailed. She wears a navy blue school uniform jacket, a white shirt, a red silk bow tie, and a plaid skirt, holding a glowing pink energy katana that points diagonally downwards into the foreground. She is surrounded by three mechanical allies: a white mechanical wolf with glowing blue eyes and blue cybernetic armor in the lower left; a large, gorilla-like armored robot with blue eyes and a huge, glowing red cannon-like fist in the lower right; and a circling silver-blue mechanical bird in the upper right. The Sapporo TV Tower is visible again in the background. A white oval bubble is located on the left, containing…{argument name="hero line" default="Here we go again..."} Visual Style: High-detail Japanese action manga/anime illustrations, glossy digital painting, dramatic perspective, neon purple apocalyptic lighting, electro-optical effects, particles, fragmentation, high contrast, intricate lines, cinematic depth, and crisp panel art. Constraints: Maintain 3 panels, 4 speech bubbles, 3 robot allies, and no additional titles or sidebars. Preserve the original Japanese text within the speech bubbles. Do not add watermarks, artist signatures, UI elements, or English subtitles.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一页戏剧性的纵向漫画，讲述现代札幌发生的超自然末日故事：天空中裂开一道紫色缝隙，巨大的恶魔降临，而一名拥有机器人盟友的女高中生英雄准备迎战。

画布：3:4 纵向比例的高版面漫画，全出血艺术风格，配有细白装订线和黑色分格线。采用精致的高细节动漫/漫画风格，结合电影级光影、饱和的霓虹色彩、密集的城市细节以及强烈的动作构图。

布局：使用 3 个垂直堆叠的横向分格。第 1 格占据顶部三分之一，第 2 格占据中间三分之一，第 3 格占据底部三分之一。添加 4 个带有垂直日语文本的白色锯齿状漫画气泡。

第 1 格：从街道视角俯瞰札幌市中心夜景，挤满了惊恐的行人，他们正抬头仰望。左侧是发出橙色光芒的札幌电视塔，标牌写着“30-24 SAPPORO”。天际线上方，天空裂开成一个巨大的紫色漩涡，里面充满了闪电、星星、碎片，中心有一只红色的爬行动物眼睛。包含 2 个气泡：左侧一个小锯齿气泡，内容为 {argument name="left reaction text" default="なんだあれ!?"}，右侧一个高大的锯齿气泡，内容为 {argument name="sky warning text" default="空が割れてる!!"}。

第 2 格：漩涡在霓虹闪烁的日本城市十字路口上方破裂。一只巨大的恶魔怪兽从紫色风暴中出现，占据了画面的大部分。它拥有肌肉发达的黑紫色身体、发光的红眼、巨大的弯曲犄角、华丽的有机盔甲、伸向街道的利爪，胸口嵌入了一个发光的圆形印记。前景中汽车碰撞翻滚，火花和爆炸散落在道路上，人们惊慌奔逃，两侧是带有霓虹招牌的建筑物。包含 1 个位于右侧的高大锯齿气泡，内容为 {argument name="demon proclamation" default="人間界ヲ焼キ払エ・・・!"}。

第 3 格：英雄登场构图，背景是如樱花般飘落的粉色花瓣和紫色宇宙光芒。前景中心：一位日本女高中生英雄 {argument name="hero name" default="unnamed schoolgirl"}，自信地站立，黑色长发在风中飘动；她的面部被柔化处理或未进行精细刻画。她身穿海军蓝校服外套、白衬衫、红色丝带领结、格子裙，手中握着一把发光的粉色能量武士刀，斜指向前景下方。她周围有 3 个机械盟友：左下方是一只拥有蓝色发光眼睛和蓝色赛博盔甲的白色机器狼，右下方是一个体型庞大、拥有蓝眼睛和巨大红色发光加农炮拳头的猩猩状装甲机器人，右上方是一只盘旋的银蓝色机械鸟。背景中再次可见札幌电视塔。包含 1 个位于左侧的白色椭圆形气泡，内容为 {argument name="hero line" default="また始まったか・・・"}。

视觉风格：高细节日本动作漫画/动漫插画、光泽感数字绘画、戏剧性透视、霓虹紫色末日灯光、电光特效、粒子、碎片、高对比度、复杂的线条、电影级深度、清晰的分格艺术。

约束条件：保持 3 个分格，4 个气泡，3 个机器人盟友，不添加额外的标题或旁白框。保留气泡内原有的日语文本。不要添加水印、艺术家签名、UI 元素或英文字幕。

templates.title: Kita-Yuzawa's Soap Slime Girl

titleLocalized.zh: 北汤泽的肥皂史莱姆少女

templates.prompt: Create a sunny, anime-style travel illustration. The location is {argument name="location" default="Kita-Yuzawa Onsen, Shirokino-no-Toko Riverside Trail"} The image showcases a lush, mountainous hot spring town in Japan. In the scene, two young women walk side-by-side on a stone path beside a wooden riverbank railing: the woman on the left is {argument name="main character" default="A transparent soap slime girl with a hollow, glass-like body, thick, rainbow-colored bubble-like skin, iridescent highlights, short, translucent pearl-colored hair, and a floating soap bubble halo."} She is wearing a see-through, off-the-shoulder white summer dress with ruffles, sandals, and a small light-colored shoulder bag, with one hand resting on the railing; the person on the right is {argument name="companion character" default="An ordinary young human woman with long brown hair"} Wearing a beige shirt, a blue-gray long skirt, and white sneakers, and carrying a black shoulder bag. The image must include two shoulder bags: the slime girl carries a light-colored bag, and her companion carries a black one. Their faces are deliberately blurred with soft beige rectangles, while the rest is richly detailed. The background is a bright river, with white rapids and rocks on the left, and in the distance, dense forests, layered mountains, a clear blue sky, and fluffy white clouds. Small roadside buildings dot the right side. A dark road sign is added by the river, bearing the words "Kita-Yuzawa Onsen," "Shiroginu no Toko," and the small Romanized spelling "Kita-Yuzawa Onsen / Shiroginu no Toko." The image employs a refined GPT-style anime-realistic drawing, with delicate lines and bright summer lighting, accompanied by dappled tree shadows. The slime's body reflects shimmering light, creating a tranquil sightseeing atmosphere. The aspect ratio is 4:3.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅阳光明媚的动漫风格旅行插画，地点位于 {argument name="location" default="北汤泽温泉，白绢之床河畔步道"}，展现日本郁郁葱葱的山间温泉小镇。画面中，两名年轻女性并排走在木质河岸护栏旁的石板路上：左侧人物为 {argument name="main character" default="一位透明的肥皂史莱姆少女，拥有中空的玻璃质感身体、厚实的彩虹色气泡状皮肤、虹彩高光、短款半透明珍珠色头发，以及漂浮的肥皂泡光环"}，身穿透视感露肩荷叶边白色夏装，脚蹬凉鞋，背着一个小巧的浅色单肩包，一只手搭在护栏上；右侧人物为 {argument name="companion character" default="一位长棕色头发的普通人类年轻女性"}，身穿米色衬衫，搭配蓝灰色长裙和白色运动鞋，背着一个黑色单肩包。画面中必须包含两个单肩包，史莱姆少女背浅色包，同伴背黑色包。她们的面部特意用柔和的米色矩形模糊遮盖，而其余部分细节丰富。背景是明亮的河流，左侧有白色激流和岩石，远处是茂密的森林、层叠的山峦、湛蓝的天空和蓬松的白云，右侧点缀着小型路边建筑。在河边添加一个深色的路标，上面写有「北湯沢温泉」、「白絹の床」以及小字罗马拼音“Kita-Yuzawa Onsen / Shiroginu no Toko”。采用精致的 GPT 绘图动漫写实风格，线条细腻，光线呈现明亮的夏季质感，伴有斑驳的树影，史莱姆身体上有闪烁的反射光，营造出宁静的观光氛围。长宽比 4:3。
