templates.title: Romantic Gothic Anime Couple

titleLocalized.zh: 浪漫哥特风动漫情侣

templates.prompt: Create a romantic dark fantasy anime illustration depicting {argument name="couple description" default="A tall, silver-haired nobleman is embracing a petite, long-haired woman."} A scene on the balcony of a magnificent castle at night. The composition is a close-up, intimate half-length portrait: the man stands on the left, broad-shouldered and muscular, leaning close to the woman as if about to kiss her forehead; the woman stands on the right, pressed against his chest, one hand clutching the chain and pendant on his coat, while his gloved hand protectively encircles her waist. Their faces are obscured by two softly edged gray-brown rectangular blocks of color, the man's face covered by a larger square, the woman's by a vertical rectangle, while their hair, clothing, and embracing posture remain visible. The man possesses hair that is tousled by the wind.{argument name="hair color" default="silver-white hair"} The woman wore pale skin, a black high-necked gothic uniform, a dark cloak or shawl, leather gloves, stacked gold chains, and a large star-shaped crystal cross pendant. She had extremely long, dark hair adorned with a jeweled star-shaped hair ornament, and wore a royal blue and white embroidered dress with gold filigree details, delicate earrings, and semi-transparent layered sleeves. The scene was set in a bright {argument name="setting" default="Midnight Blue Palace Garden Balcony"} Featuring exquisite wrought-iron railings, Gothic spires, illuminated windows, hanging lanterns, blue roses, tiny fairy lights, floating starlight, and a star-studded night sky. Employing rich blue, purple, silver, and warm lantern gold tones, with dramatic contour lighting on the hair and shoulders, showcasing highly detailed fabric embroidery and jewelry details, and rendered in a painterly anime style, it boasts cinematic depth of field, soft lighting, and a romantic, melancholic atmosphere. No text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张浪漫的暗黑奇幻动漫插画，描绘 {argument name="couple description" default="一位高大的银发贵族正拥抱着一位娇小的长发女子"} 在夜晚华丽的城堡阳台上的场景。构图为近景、亲密的半身肖像：男子站在左侧，肩宽体阔，俯身靠近女子，仿佛正要亲吻她的额头；女子站在右侧，紧贴着他的胸膛，一只手抓着他外套上的链条和吊坠，而他戴着黑色手套的手正保护性地环绕在她的腰间。用两个边缘柔和的灰褐色矩形色块遮住两人的面部，男子面部覆盖一个较大的正方形，女子面部覆盖一个垂直矩形，同时保留头发、服装和拥抱姿态可见。男子拥有被风吹乱的 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色头发"}、苍白的皮肤、黑色高领哥特式制服、深色斗篷或披肩、皮手套、叠戴的金链以及巨大的星形水晶十字架吊坠。女子留着极长的深色头发，佩戴珠宝星形发饰，身穿带有金色花丝细节的宝蓝色与白色刺绣礼服，佩戴精致的耳环，袖子为半透明的叠层设计。场景设定在明亮的 {argument name="setting" default="午夜蓝色的宫殿花园阳台"}，配有精致的锻铁栏杆、哥特式尖塔、发光的窗户、悬挂的灯笼、蓝色玫瑰、微小的仙女灯、漂浮的星光以及繁星点点的夜空。采用浓郁的蓝色、紫色、银色和温暖的灯笼金色调，头发和肩部带有戏剧性的轮廓光，展现高度细腻的织物刺绣和珠宝细节，采用绘画风格的动漫渲染，具有电影般的景深效果、柔和的光晕以及浪漫忧郁的氛围，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Latte photos with emotional graffiti

titleLocalized.zh: 带有情感涂鸦的拿铁照片

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a vertical social media image that combines a realistic coffee shop photo with playful, hand-drawn doodles, as if emotions and thoughts are overflowing from the canvas. Canvas: 9:16, vertical composition, close-up perspective, warm, shallow depth of field photography. The subject is placed on a dark wooden table and a gray square coaster.{argument name="drink" default="Latte in a brown ceramic cup"} The latte art features a giant creamy heart in the foam, surrounded by golden-brown espresso crema. The background is softened, with a dark plate and pastries visible at the top edge. Visual style: Maintain the realism, warmth, and slightly emotional feel of the base image, presenting natural café lighting and a clear foam texture. Add vibrant mixed-media graffiti on top: white marker handwriting, black brush calligraphy, red and yellow crayon strokes, arrows, glitter, hearts, underlines, scribbles, and miniature cartoon stick figures. The graffiti should appear spontaneous, imperfect, and emotional, layered on top of the photograph rather than digitally retouched. Graffiti Text and Labels: Nine handwritten text labels are included around the cup: 1) "why is this so good" in white font in the upper left corner, with a pink heart and underline; 2) "BRO???" in the speech bubble above the cup; 3) "LAST DANCE" in large black calligraphy font in the upper right corner, with a yellow emphasis mark and pink underline; 4) A yellow arrow pointing to the latte surface on the left, with "this part tho..."; 5) "THIS IS CRAZY" in the speech bubble near the latte foam in the lower left corner; 6) "WE STAYING HERE" in the speech bubble to the right of the latte art; 7) A pink arrow pointing to the foam on the right, with "wait— look at this"; 8) A white arrow pointing to the rim of the cup in the lower left corner, with "silky smooth"; 9) "layers on layers" in the yellow circle in the center of the bottom, with an upward arrow pointing to the cup; and 10) A white arrow pointing to the glossy foam in the lower right corner, with "that shine tho". Miniature Characters: Add 5 small doodle cartoon characters to interact with the latte: 1) One standing on the rim of the cup with arms raised, the speech bubble reading "BRO???"; 2) A small character wearing a red hat pointing at the foam on the left side of the cup; 3) One sliding down a white doodle slide on the latte surface, the speech bubble reading "THIS IS CRAZY"; 4) One sitting near the center latte art on the right side, the speech bubble reading "WE STAYING HERE"; 5) One looking at the foam from a small ladder on the right side of the cup. Decorative Doodles: Add 15 additional decorative markers around the scene: a small red star in the upper left corner, two yellow stars in the lower left corner, a pink crown above the words "LAST DANCE", a yellow lightning bolt on the right, two blue flashes in the lower right, a pink heart at the bottom, a white spiral doodle in the lower left corner, a yellow oval vortex in the lower left corner, a small beige spiral in the lower right corner, two long pink arcs at the bottom, a long yellow arc at the bottom, and a short white doodle in the upper left corner. Constraints: Keep the latte and table as normal, realistic photographs, only making the surrounding environment visually cluttered and imaginative. Use{argument name="main lettering phrase" default="LAST DANCE"} As the largest readable text, all handwritten characters remain clear, bold, and hand-drawn. No watermarks, no borders, and no additional UI elements.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张竖版社交媒体图片，将逼真的咖啡馆照片与俏皮的手绘想象涂鸦相结合，仿佛情感和思绪正溢出画面。

画布：9:16 竖版构图，特写视角，温暖的浅景深摄影。主体是放置在深色木桌上、灰色方形杯垫上的 {argument name="drink" default="棕色陶瓷杯中的拿铁"}。拿铁拉花是泡沫中一个巨大的奶油心形，周围环绕着金棕色的浓缩咖啡油脂。背景经过柔化处理，顶部边缘可见深色盘子和糕点。

视觉风格：保持基础图像的写实感、温馨、温暖且略带情绪化，呈现自然的咖啡馆光影和清晰的泡沫质感。在上方添加充满活力的混合媒介涂鸦：白色马克笔手写字、黑色毛笔字、红黄色蜡笔笔触、箭头、闪光、爱心、下划线、乱涂乱画以及微型卡通火柴人。涂鸦应显得随性、不完美、充满情感，并层叠在照片之上，而非经过数字精修。

涂鸦文字和标签：在杯子周围包含 9 个手写文字标注：1) 左上角白色字体的“why is this so good”，配有粉色爱心和下划线；2) 杯子上方对话气泡中的“BRO???”；3) 右上角黑色大号毛笔字体的“LAST DANCE”，配有黄色强调符号和粉色下划线；4) 左侧指向拿铁表面的黄色箭头，配有“this part tho...”；5) 左下方拿铁泡沫附近对话气泡中的“THIS IS CRAZY”；6) 拿铁拉花右侧对话气泡中的“WE STAYING HERE”；7) 右侧指向泡沫的粉色箭头，配有“wait— look at this”；8) 左下方指向杯沿的白色箭头，配有“silky smooth”；9) 底部中心黄色圆圈内的“layers on layers”，配有指向杯子的向上箭头；以及 10) 右下方指向光亮泡沫的白色箭头，配有“that shine tho”。

微型角色数量：添加 5 个与拿铁互动的小型涂鸦卡通人物：1) 一个站在杯沿上举起双臂，对话气泡写着“BRO???”；2) 一个戴着红色帽子的小角色在左侧杯沿指向泡沫；3) 一个沿着白色涂鸦滑梯在拿铁表面下滑，对话气泡写着“THIS IS CRAZY”；4) 一个坐在右侧中心拿铁拉花附近，对话气泡写着“WE STAYING HERE”；5) 一个在右侧杯沿的小梯子上看向泡沫。

装饰性涂鸦数量：在场景周围添加 15 个额外的装饰性标记：左上角一颗红色小星星，左下方两颗黄色星星，在“LAST DANCE”文字上方一个粉色皇冠，右侧一个黄色闪电，右下方两个蓝色闪光，底部一个粉色爱心，左下角一个白色螺旋涂鸦，左下角一个黄色椭圆漩涡，右下角一个米色小螺旋，底部两条长粉色弧线，底部一条长黄色弧线，以及左上角一处白色短涂鸦。

约束条件：保持拿铁和桌子作为正常的写实照片，仅使周围环境变得视觉嘈杂且富有想象力。使用 {argument name="main lettering phrase" default="LAST DANCE"} 作为最大的可读文字。保持所有手写字迹清晰、粗犷且具有手绘感。无水印，无边框，无额外的 UI 元素。

templates.title: A woman in low spirits looks at her phone

titleLocalized.zh: 情绪低落的女性看着手机

templates.prompt: Create an emotional, realistic vertical photograph featuring a young woman who has {argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown"} Her hair, tied in a messy bun, sat on the sofa or leaned forward in the dimly lit room at night. She wore a loose, semi-transparent dress.{argument name="shirt color" default="White"} The shirt, its collar slightly open, reveals natural folds and the texture of the fabric. Her head is lowered, looking at a smartphone glowing near the bottom right edge of the frame; one hand touches the screen, the phone casting a faint, cool blue-white light that illuminates her fingers. The composition employs an intimate close-up from chest to head, tightly cropped, with most of her face obscured by her pose, and a dark gray-brown opaque rectangular privacy occlusion covering the center of her right cheek. The dark, soft, and out-of-focus background suggests a sofa or wall, using low-key cinematic lighting with subtle grain, shallow depth of field, realistic skin tones, and a quiet, melancholic atmosphere. A vertical orientation is used.{argument name="aspect ratio" default="9:16"} The composition is free of visible text, watermarks, and extraneous objects.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张情绪化、写实的竖构图照片，主角是一位年轻女性，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 的头发，扎着凌乱的丸子头，在夜晚昏暗的房间里坐在沙发上或向前倾身。她穿着一件宽松、半透明的 {argument name="shirt color" default="白色"} 衬衫，领口微敞，展现出自然的褶皱和织物纹理。她的头向下低垂，看向画面右下角边缘附近发光的智能手机，一只手触碰屏幕，手机投射出微弱的冷白蓝色光芒照亮她的手指。构图采用从胸部到头部的亲密特写，紧凑裁剪，她的脸部大部分被姿势遮挡，且在右侧面部中心区域覆盖有一个暗灰棕色的不透明矩形隐私遮挡块。背景昏暗、柔和且失焦，暗示着沙发或墙壁，采用低调的电影布光，带有细微的颗粒感、浅景深、真实的肤色以及安静忧郁的氛围。使用竖向 {argument name="aspect ratio" default="9:16"} 构图，无可见文字，无水印，无多余物体。

templates.title: Four-panel Japanese-style advertisement prompt giveaway event

titleLocalized.zh: 四格日式广告 Prompt 赠送活动

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a wide-format promotional collage showcasing four high-end AI-generated ad examples and a call-to-action banner for a free Prompt template. Canvas: 16:9 landscape image, approximately 1200 x 622 pixels, divided into neat 2x2 quartered ad panels with a full-width red banner at the bottom. Employ sophisticated business design quality, clean typography, realistic lighting and shadows, advanced gradients, and no visible watermarks. Layout: Use five separate areas: 1. Top left luxury skincare ad, 2. Top right SaaS analytics ad, 3. Bottom left summer citrus promotion ad, 4. Bottom right black and gold Prompt giveaway ad, and 5. Bottom red call-to-action banner. Panels are separated by thin borders. Panel 1 (Top left luxury skincare ad): Create a soft beige silk background with warm gold lighting, placing glass cosmetic bottles in or next to transparent spherical bubbles, paired with an elegant Japanese serif font. The top right corner includes a small gold label that reads "LIMITED". Japanese main title: “Uruoi no Kōkai” (うるおいの革命). Subtitle: “First-time limited 50% OFF”. Add a long black bar at the bottom of this panel with “LUXURY SKINCARE” written in evenly spaced gold letters. Atmosphere: Delicate, high-end, and bright skincare feel. Panel 2 (AI analytics ad in the upper right corner): Create a futuristic nighttime office scene with a blue neon holographic dashboard, city lights outside the window, a glass table, coffee cup, documents/tablet, and a deep corporate atmosphere. Main card title: “AI-POWERED ANALYTICS”. Japanese title: “チームの生産性が、3倍になる.” (The production quality is 3 times better.) A smaller Japanese text is attached below. Add a gold rounded button that says “14-day free trial →”. The right side displays two indicator cards: “MONTHLY REVENUE ¥4.2M ↑32%” and “ACTIVE USERS ¥12,480 ↑18%”. Below are three small labels: “AI REPORT”, “AUTO SYNC”, and “REAL-TIME”. Panel 3 (bottom left summer promotion ad): Create a bright orange citrus splatter ad featuring sliced ​​oranges, lime wedges, lemon slices, sparkling water droplets, ice cubes, and vibrant summer lighting. The text “SUMMER 2026” is positioned above a large white “SALE”. Below is the Japanese text: “夏の大特価”. Add a cream-colored rounded discount badge that reads “Max 60% OFF”. Add the date range at the bottom: “7.1 TUE — 7.31 THU”. Atmosphere: Fresh, juicy, and high-impact retail banner. Panel 4 (Bottom Right Prompt Ad): Create a luxurious black background with an ornate gold Art Deco border, brass gears, steampunk clockwork elements, and metallic gold lettering. Top text: "SPECIAL RELEASE". Centered large text: "30" and below it, "PROMPTS". Japanese text: "広告影像を量産するプロンプト全30选". Add a gold rounded corner button that reads "いいね＆リプで受け取る". Bottom small text note: "※ GPT Image-2 (ChatGPT Images 2.0) 対応". Atmosphere: Exclusive, high-end, promotional gift. promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个宽幅促销拼贴图，展示四个高端 AI 生成的广告示例，以及一个用于领取 Prompt 模板的行动号召横幅。

画布：16:9 横向图像，约 1200×622 像素，划分为整齐的 2×2 四等分广告面板，底部带有全宽红色横幅。采用精致的商业设计品质、清晰的排版、逼真的光影、高级渐变，且无可见水印。

布局：使用 5 个独立的区域：1 左上角奢华护肤品广告，2 右上角 SaaS 分析广告，3 左下角夏季柑橘促销广告，4 右下角黑金风格 Prompt 赠送广告，以及 5 底部红色行动号召横幅。面板之间用细边框分隔。

面板 1（左上角奢华护肤品广告）：创建柔和的米色丝绸背景，配以温暖的金光，玻璃化妆瓶放置在透明球形气泡中或旁边，搭配优雅的日文衬线字体。右上角包含一个写有“LIMITED”的小金标。日文主标题：“うるおいの革命”。副标题：“初回限定 50% OFF”。在此面板底部添加一条黑色长条，以间距均匀的金色字母写着“LUXURY SKINCARE”。氛围：细腻、高端、明亮的护肤感。

面板 2（右上角 AI 分析广告）：创建充满未来感的夜间办公室场景，配有蓝色霓虹全息仪表盘、窗外的城市灯光、玻璃桌、咖啡杯、文件/平板电脑，以及深沉的企业氛围。主卡片标题：“AI-POWERED ANALYTICS”。日文标题：“チームの生産性が、3倍になる。”下方附带较小的日文文案。添加一个写有“14日間 無料トライアル →”的金色圆角按钮。右侧显示 2 张指标卡片：“MONTHLY REVENUE ¥4.2M ↑32%”和“ACTIVE USERS 12,480 ↑18%”。下方显示 3 个小标签：“AI REPORT”、“AUTO SYNC”和“REAL-TIME”。

面板 3（左下角夏季促销广告）：创建明亮的橙色柑橘溅射广告，包含切开的橙子、青柠角、柠檬片、气泡水滴、冰块和充满活力的夏季光影。文字：“SUMMER 2026”位于巨大的白色“SALE”上方。下方日文：“夏の大特価”。添加一个写有“最大 60% OFF”的奶油色圆角折扣徽章。底部添加日期范围：“7.1 TUE — 7.31 THU”。氛围：清新、多汁、高冲击力的零售横幅。

面板 4（右下角 Prompt 赠送广告）：创建黑色奢华背景，配以华丽的金色装饰艺术边框、黄铜齿轮、蒸汽朋克发条元素和金属质感金色字体。顶部文字：“SPECIAL RELEASE”。中心巨大文字：“30”及其下方的“PROMPTS”。日文行：“広告画像を量産するプロンプト全30選”。添加一个写有“いいね＆リプで受け取る”的金色圆角按钮。底部小字注记：“※ GPT Image-2（ChatGPT Images 2.0）対応”。氛围：独家、高端、活动赠礼。

底部横幅：添加一条全宽的深红色天鹅绒质感长条，配有华丽的金色边角装饰和金色细边框。居中显示巨大的金色日文行动号召文字：{argument name="bottom call to action" default="いいね＆リプライで「デザイナー」"}。使其加粗、浮雕化且易于阅读。

视觉风格：极致精美的广告样机，逼真的产品摄影与数字 UI 图形相结合，金色高光，光泽表面，构图清晰，面板间对比度高，专业的社交媒体宣传图。

限制：包含 4 个广告面板和 1 个底部横幅。保持所有指定的可见文字清晰且放置位置正确。不要添加额外的面板、Logo、二维码、人物或水印。

templates.prompt: Create a vertically composed, half-pixel art fantasy character illustration, with the main character being {argument name="character name" default="A mysterious armored warrior"} Standing upright in the center of the image, a full-body portrait, the warrior exudes a majestic and symmetrical presence. He wears magnificent and polished armor.{argument name="armor color" default="silver-white"} Plate armor, trimmed with gold filigree, features layered shoulder armor, gauntlets, greaves, a dark cloak, and a horned wing-shaped helmet with a black mask and tiny, luminous amber eyes. He grips the hilt of a massive, vertical greatsword, its tip pointing downwards, in front of him; the greatsword has an exquisitely crafted crossguard, with a blue gem inlaid near the lower part of the hilt. A charming little... (The last sentence appears to be a fragment and doesn't translate directly.){argument name="shoulder companion" default="hamster"} The design creates a humorous contrast with the imposing armor. The character is surrounded by a tall, ornate Gothic border crafted from flowing gold metalwork and adorned with four large silver wings: one each in the upper left, upper right, lower left, and lower right corners. A decorative coat of arms is placed at the top center and bottom center, aligned with the greatsword. Background: The interior of a dark Gothic cathedral or fantasy city, featuring arched windows, towers, balconies, warm lantern light, hazy blue shadows, and deep navy gray tones. Style: Refined 16-bit/half-pixel challenge aesthetics, sharp pixel edges, highly detailed sprite shadows, dramatic metallic highlights, symmetrical composition, dark fantasy atmosphere, elegant beauty, no text, no watermark. promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张垂直构图的半像素艺术奇幻角色插画，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="一位神秘的装甲战士"}，正面站立于画面中央，全身像，气势威严且对称。战士身穿华丽且经过抛光的 {argument name="armor color" default="银白色"} 板甲，饰有金色花丝镶边，配有层叠的肩甲、护手、胫甲、深色斗篷，以及带有黑色面罩和微小发光琥珀色眼睛的角状翼形头盔。双手交叠握住一把巨大的垂直大剑的剑柄，剑尖朝下插在身前；大剑拥有精致的十字护手，下部装饰附近镶嵌着一颗蓝色宝石。在战士的右肩上添加一个可爱的小型 {argument name="shoulder companion" default="仓鼠"}，与威严的盔甲形成幽默的对比。用高大的华丽哥特式边框环绕角色，边框由卷曲的金色金属工艺制成，并配有四个大型银色羽翼装饰：左上、右上、左下、右下各一个。在顶部中心和底部中心各放置一个装饰性纹章，并与大剑对齐。背景：黑暗的哥特式大教堂或奇幻城市内部，包含拱形窗户、塔楼、阳台、温暖的灯笼光、朦胧的蓝色阴影以及深海军灰调。风格：精致的 16-bit / 半像素挑战美学，清晰的像素边缘，高细节的精灵图阴影，戏剧性的金属高光，对称构图，黑暗奇幻氛围，优雅美感，无文字，无水印。使用类似智能手机的垂直构图，{argument name="aspect ratio" default="9:16"}。

Main subject: The right side of the image features the standing character, a frontal view, occupying most of the page space. She is a young anime girl with very long and flowing hair.{argument name="hair color" default="Blue-green"} Hair, fluffy cat ears (white down on the inside), a tuft of hair on top, and a black bow tied to one ear. Below the title is a short profile block using six small cyan icons as bullet points: one paw icon for species, two wing icons for character role, three heart icons for personality, four ribbon/scissor icons for likes, five star icons for dislikes, and six musical note icons for special skills. The upper right corner contains a short, poetic quote in Japanese typography, surrounded by small sparkles and winged gem badges. Back View: In the bottom right corner, there is a smaller full-body back view labeled "Back Style." It shows the back of the cyan hair, cat ears, a black bow, large white angel wings, a dark multi-layered skirt with gold constellation embroidery, an apron bow, stockings, and shoes. The design remains clean and easy to read, with no modern UI elements, no watermarks, and no superfluous characters.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="Celestine"} 创建一张华丽的动漫角色参考图，她是一位温柔的天界猫娘原创角色。

画布：垂直 2:3 比例的角色设定集，采用淡象牙色羊皮纸背景，带有细腻的纸张纹理，边缘饰有精致的金色花丝、青色装饰线条、细小羽毛、闪光、翅膀图案及精美的装饰性分隔线。柔和的水彩光影，干净且高细节的动漫插画，优雅的奇幻女仆风格。

主体：画面中右侧为全身站立角色，正面视角，占据页面大部分空间。她是一位年轻的动漫少女，拥有一头非常长且飘逸的 {argument name="hair color" default="青绿色"} 头发，毛茸茸的猫耳（内侧为白色绒毛），头顶有一撮呆毛，一只耳朵上系着黑色蝴蝶结。她的面部大部分被柔和的方形模糊/占位符遮盖，但仍能展示出发型和头部轮廓。她身后长有一对巨大的白色天使之翼。服装：黑白相间的荷叶边女仆装，泡泡袖，白色围裙，多层褶皱裙摆，深海军蓝外裙饰有金色星座刺绣，领口系红色蝴蝶结，白色过膝袜，黑色玛丽珍鞋，白色腕带，腰间配有镶嵌绿松石的心形吊坠，带有金链和流苏。姿势：优雅、略带羞涩，一只手靠近胸口，另一只手轻轻提起裙摆。

布局：左上角有一个优雅的艺术字体大标题，内容为 {argument name="display name" default="Celestine"}，下方配有小型日式副标题及微小的猫咪/翅膀装饰。标题下方是一个简短的个人资料块，使用 6 个小型青色图标作为项目符号：1 个爪子图标代表物种，2 个翅膀图标代表角色定位，3 个心形图标代表性格，4 个丝带/剪刀图标代表喜好，5 个星星图标代表厌恶之物，6 个音符图标代表特殊技能。右上角包含一段简短的诗意引言，采用日式排版，周围环绕着小闪光和带翅膀的宝石徽章。

表情面板：在左侧，包含 3 个堆叠的方形肖像面板，标注为“Expressions”（表情）。面板 1 展示同一角色的半身像，面部区域柔和模糊，双手在胸前合十。面板 2 展示清晰可见的开心闭眼微笑，双手合十，猫耳竖起。面板 3 展示角色半身像，面部柔和模糊，头部附近有一个小小的青色问号，暗示困惑。每个面板均有细致的青色装饰边框。

背部视图：在右下角，包含 1 个较小的全身背部视图，标注为“Back Style”（背部样式）。展示青色头发的背面、猫耳、黑色蝴蝶结、巨大的白色天使之翼、带有金色星座刺绣的深色多层裙摆、围裙蝴蝶结、长袜及鞋子。

细节面板：在左下角，包含 4 个矩形特写面板，标注为“Detail”（细节）：1 领口和红色蝴蝶结及荷叶边胸衣，2 腰部围裙和绿松石心形宝石链饰，3 裙摆边缘的金色星座刺绣和多层白色荷叶边，4 带有蝴蝶结和小宝石挂饰的黑色玛丽珍鞋。

右下角背景卡：添加一张带有华丽边框的小卡片，标题为“Wings of the Celeste”，下方居中排列几行简短且精致的日式文字，底部饰有一个带翅膀的绿松石宝石徽章。

视觉风格：高分辨率精致动漫艺术，柔和的青色与海军蓝配色，纤细的线条，半透明羽毛效果，优雅的维多利亚奇幻女仆装设计，装饰性参考图排版。保持设计简洁易读，无现代 UI 元素，无水印，无多余角色。

templates.title: Comparison of 30 different styles of chibi guitarists

titleLocalized.zh: 30 种风格 Q 版吉他手对比图

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a wide-format comparison chart showcasing the rendering effects of the same chibi/anime musician scene under 30 different visual styles, arranged in a grid of labeled thumbnails. The main subject is {argument name="character description" default="A silver-haired, chibi-style anime girl with double buns and long, curly hair, dressed in a futuristic, light blue and white outfit, holding an electric guitar and carrying a bulky steampunk mechanical backpack with glowing blue circular gear details."} The scene is{argument name="setting" default="An outdoor music festival with cheering crowds, a stage, tents, blue skies, and a stage sign that reads "Frost+Beats"."} Canvas: Wide, landscape 16:9 image, similar to a sample or style sample. Uses 30 rectangular panels arranged in 5 rows and 6 columns. Each panel has a thin border and a small black label box with white text in the upper left corner. Layout: Maintain a consistent core composition within each panel: the subject is centered or slightly to the right, the guitar is slung diagonally in front of the body, and the background consists of crowds and a music festival stage. Only change the visual rendering style of each panel. Some panels can be zoomed in or have their backgrounds blurred, but the subject and guitar should remain recognizable. Panel Labels: Use 30 numbered labels, one per panel, arranged from left to right and top to bottom:{argument name="style label set" default="1. Live-action style, 2. Anime style, 3. Pixel art style, 4. Low-poly style, 5. Papercraft style, 6. Watercolor style, 7. Oil painting style, 8. Pencil sketch style, 9. Line drawing style, 10. Manga style, 11. Retro anime style, 12. Cyberpunk style, 13. Steampunk style, 14. Fantasy style, 15. Minimalist style, 16. Pop art style, 17. Neon style, 18. Japanese style (Ukiyo-e style), 19. Glitch art style, 20. Black and white photograph style, 21. Sepia tone, 22. Illustration style, 23. Cartoon style, 24. 3D realistic style, 25. Clay art style, 26. Paper cutting style, 27. Textile style, 28. Stained glass style, 29. Social game style, 30. Chibi character style"} 30 panels with style details: 1 Photorealistic Music Festival Footage, 2 Exquisite Anime Key Visuals, 3 Pixel Art Style, 4 Low-Poly 3D, 5 Layered Paper Art, 6 Soft Watercolor, 7 Textured Oil Painting, 8 Pencil Sketch, 9 Simple Monochrome Line Drawing, 10 Dramatic Black and White Comics with Onomatopoeia, 11 Retro Anime Celluloid Style, 12 Neon Cyberpunk Concert, 13 Brown Brass Steampunk, 14 Cold Magical Fantasy, 15 Minimalist Illustration, 16 Colorful Pop Art Halftone, 17 Glowing Neon Outline Art, 18 Traditional Japanese Ukiyo-e Style Printing, 19 RGB Glitch Art, 20 Black and White Photo, 21 Retro Sepia Photo, 22 Modern Minimalist Illustration, 23 Cartoon Style, 24 Realistic 3D Rendering with Depth of Field, 25 Clay/Miniature Stereo Perspective, 26 Blue and White Papercut Style, 27 Woven Tapestry Texture, 28 Stained glass mosaic, 29. Mobile/social game promotional illustration, 30. Miniature chibi mascot style. Visual style: Bright, colorful, playful, rich in content yet clear and easy to read. The entire image should resemble a style comparison chart generated from character cue words. Maintain consistency in the main identity across all panels, repeating the silver hair, blue accents, guitar, mechanical gear backpack, and music festival crowd. Constraints: Contains exactly 30 panels, each with one label; no additional panels should be added. Do not add descriptive text outside the grid. Retain stage sign text in multiple backgrounds.{argument name="stage sign text" default="Frost+Beats"} Keep the label clearly visible; use a black rectangle with white text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一张宽幅对比图，展示同一 Q 版/动漫音乐家场景在 30 种不同视觉风格下的渲染效果，并以带标签的缩略图网格形式排列。主体为 {argument name="character description" default="一位银发 Q 版动漫少女，扎着双丸子头，留着长卷发，身穿浅蓝白相间的未来感偶像服装，手持电吉他，背着笨重的蒸汽朋克机械背包，带有发光的蓝色圆形齿轮细节"}。场景为 {argument name="setting" default="一个户外音乐节，有欢呼的人群、舞台、帐篷、蓝天，以及写有 Frost+Beats 的舞台招牌"}。

画布：宽幅横向 16:9 图像，类似于样张或风格采样图。使用 5 行 6 列，共 30 个矩形面板。每个面板都有细边框，左上角有一个带有白色文字的小黑色标签框。

布局：在每个面板中保持核心构图一致：角色居中或略偏右，吉他斜跨在身体前方，背景为人群和音乐节舞台。仅改变每个面板的视觉渲染风格。部分面板可以拉近镜头或模糊背景，但主体和吉他应保持可辨识度。

面板标签：使用 30 个编号标签，每个面板一个，按从左到右、从上到下的顺序排列：{argument name="style label set" default="1. 実写風, 2. アニメ風, 3. ドット風, 4. ローポリ風, 5. ペーパークラフト風, 6. 水彩画風, 7. 油絵風, 8. 鉛筆スケッチ風, 9. 線画風, 10. マンガ風, 11. レトロアニメ風, 12. サイバーパンク風, 13. スチームパンク風, 14. ファンタジー風, 15. ミニマル風, 16. ポップアート風, 17. ネオン風, 18. 和風（浮世絵風）, 19. グリッチアート風, 20. 白黒写真風, 21. セピア調, 22. イラストレーション風, 23. カートゥーン風, 24. 3Dリアル風, 25. クレイアート風, 26. 切り絵風, 27. 織物風, 28. ステンドグラス風, 29. ソーシャルゲーム風, 30. ちびキャラ風"}。

30 个面板的风格细节：1 照片级真实音乐节镜头，2 精致动漫关键视觉图，3 像素艺术风格，4 低多边形 3D，5 分层纸艺，6 柔和水彩，7 纹理油画，8 铅笔素描，9 简洁单色线条画，10 带有拟声词的戏剧性黑白漫画，11 复古动漫赛璐珞风格，12 霓虹赛博朋克演唱会，13 棕色黄铜蒸汽朋克，14 冰冷魔法幻想，15 极简主义插画，16 多彩波普艺术半调，17 发光霓虹轮廓艺术，18 传统日式浮世绘风格印刷，19 RGB 故障艺术，20 黑白照片，21 复古棕褐色照片，22 现代简洁插画，23 卡通风格，24 带有景深的写实 3D 渲染，25 粘土/微缩模型立体透视，26 蓝白剪纸风格，27 编织挂毯纹理，28 彩绘玻璃马赛克，29 手机/社交游戏宣传插画，30 超小 Q 版吉祥物风格。

视觉风格：明亮、多彩、俏皮，内容丰富但清晰易读。整张图应看起来像是一个角色提示词生成的风格对比表。在所有面板中保持主体身份的一致性，重复出现银发、蓝色点缀、吉他、机械齿轮背包和音乐节人群。

约束：包含正好 30 个面板，每个面板对应一个标签，不得添加额外面板。不要在网格之外添加说明文字。在多个背景中保留舞台招牌文字 {argument name="stage sign text" default="Frost+Beats"}。保持标签清晰可见，使用黑色矩形框配白色文字。

templates.title: Lamb Bedtime Blessing Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 小羊睡前祈福海报

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a dreamy Japanese-style bedtime blessing poster featuring a sheep-themed girl and a gentle, lucky message. Canvas: 16:9 wide horizontal illustration with a soft, creamy parchment background reminiscent of watercolor, edged with delicate golden celestial arcs, tiny stars, sparkles, and subtle floral patterns. Layout: A young girl is placed in the left third, cropped above her knees. Her right hand is outstretched in a friendly pointing gesture. The right two-thirds are left blank for centered, elegant Japanese typography, decorated with gold dividing lines and small ornaments. The overall composition maintains an ethereal, warm, and bedtime atmosphere. Main details: The girl wears a fluffy white sheep-ear hood, revealing long, wavy light brown hair; she wears a light sage green long-sleeved dress with white daisy patterns and a gathered waist; in her left hand, she carries a woven wicker basket. A sheep-face plush pendant hangs from the front of the basket. Her face is obscured by a flat, beige square, devoid of any features. A large golden crescent moon sits behind her to the left. White daisies and soft leaves are added to the lower left and right corners. Text content: Please strictly adhere to the following Japanese. The large title in the upper right corner reads: “ひつじのおまじない”, followed by a pink, multifaceted heart icon. Below, in the center, are two lines of text: “今日ラッキーだった事を” and “ひとつ思い出してから寝よう”, with “ラッキー” highlighted in soft pink, and the rest in warm brown. Below the message, a miniature golden sheep icon is placed between two short horizontal decorative lines and a glitter. Visual Style: Soft watercolor and gouache illustrations, warm beige and soft sage green color scheme, accented with gold ink, creating a delicate and dreamy bedtime atmosphere, elegant hand-drawn Japanese calligraphy, fine graininess, soft lighting, and no harsh outlines. Constraints: Must include the following countable elements: 1 girl, 1 sheep-eared hood, 1 sage green daisy dress, 1 wicker basket, 1 small woolen pendant, 1 crescent moon, 1 pink heart icon, 1 miniature gold sheep icon, 2 main messages, and 1 title. Do not add any additional characters, animals, logos, watermarks, or other large blocks of text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张梦幻的日式睡前祈福海报，主角为小羊主题女孩，并配有温柔的幸运寄语。

画布：宽幅 16:9 横向插画，背景为带有水彩质感的柔和羊皮纸奶油色，边缘点缀精致的金色天体弧线、细小星辰、闪光以及淡淡的植物花纹。

布局：将一名年轻女孩置于左侧三分之一处，画面从膝盖上方截取，她右手向前伸出，做出友好的指向动作。右侧三分之二区域留白，用于居中对齐优雅的日文排版，并配有装饰性的金色分割线和小饰物。整体构图保持空灵、温暖且具有睡前氛围。

主体细节：女孩戴着蓬松的白色羊耳兜帽，露出一头波浪状浅棕色长发；身穿浅鼠尾草绿色的长袖连衣裙，裙身带有白色小雏菊图案，腰部收褶；左手提着一个编织柳条篮。篮子正面挂着 1 个小羊脸毛绒挂件。她的面部被一个平整的米色方形遮挡，没有任何五官。她左后方有 1 轮巨大的金色新月。在左下角和右下角添加白色雏菊和柔和的叶片。

文字内容：请严格使用以下日文。右上角大标题：「ひつじのおまじない」，后接 1 个粉色多面心形图标。下方居中两行文字：「今日ラッキーだった事を」和「ひとつ思い出してから寝よう」，其中「ラッキー」以柔粉色高亮显示，其余文字为暖棕色。在寄语下方，在两条短横装饰线和闪光之间放置 1 个微型金色小羊图标。

视觉风格：柔和的水彩与水粉绘本插画，暖米色与柔和鼠尾草绿配色，金色墨水点缀，精致梦幻的睡前氛围，优雅的手绘日式书法，细腻的颗粒感，柔和的灯光，无生硬轮廓线。

约束条件：必须包含以下可计数的元素：1 名女孩、1 个羊耳兜帽、1 件鼠尾草绿雏菊连衣裙、1 个柳条篮、1 个小羊毛绒挂件、1 轮新月、1 个粉色心形图标、1 个微型金色小羊图标、2 行主要寄语以及 1 个标题。请勿添加额外的人物、动物、Logo、水印或其他大段文字。

templates.title: Anime Mentor Whiteboard Infographic

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫导师白板信息图

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a minimalist, anime-style classroom/office presentation scene, containing [images/features].{argument name="character name" default="A female business mentor"} Standing beside a large whiteboard, she explains an abstract data/AI workflow infographic. Canvas: 16:9 widescreen horizontal illustration, bright sunlight, soft pastel tones, clean lines, modern Japanese anime visual style, soft shadows, professional yet friendly atmosphere. Layout: The instructor stands in the left third of the frame, partially obscuring the whiteboard. She holds a dark tablet/laptop in front of her in one hand, and points a pen at the whiteboard in the other. A desk is positioned at the bottom foreground, with a laptop, a white mug, and printed charts on it. In the distance, a potted plant and a tall window are visible on the left. A light blue office chair is faintly visible in the lower right foreground. Character details: The instructor has long hair {argument name="hair color" default="gold"} She wore a white headscarf with a bow, a light green suit jacket, a white shirt, light-colored trousers, a black belt, and a small necklace. Her face was deliberately obscured by a solid beige rectangular mask in the center, revealing no facial features. Her posture was confident and instructive, facing the whiteboard. Whiteboard content: The whiteboard should precisely display two large rounded rectangular infographic panels. The left panel contains a 3D cube/module diagram composed of cyan, cream, and yellow cubes, with a small cube icon and three small colored dots near the top. A large double-headed horizontal arrow is placed between the two panels. The right panel contains five data visualization elements: a node network diagram with colored circles and connecting lines, an upward trend line chart, a vertical bar chart, a set of three horizontal slider controls, and a pie/ring chart. Chart colors should be cyan, soft yellow, gray, and cream. Avoid readable text on the whiteboard. Foreground Items: Includes 4 desktop items: an open laptop, a white coffee mug, a printed chart sheet, and a visible desktop edge. The whiteboard tray contains 5 small items: 3 colored markers, a dark chalkboard eraser, and a gray chalkboard eraser. Visual Style: Soft watercolor anime rendering with clean lines, warm sunlight streaming in from the left, light cream-colored walls, and subtle reflections on the whiteboard border, creating a clean and modern workspace. Keep the composition spacious and uncluttered. Constraints: No clear text, no logos, no watermarks, no extra characters, and a non-photorealistic style. The beige face-obscuring rectangle is retained as a deliberate visual element.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个简洁的动漫风格教室/办公室演示场景，画面中包含 {argument name="character name" default="一位女性商务导师"} 站在大型白板旁，讲解抽象的数据/AI 工作流信息图。

画布：16:9 宽屏横向插画，明亮的日光，柔和的粉彩色调，清晰的线条，现代日本动漫视觉风格，柔和的阴影，专业且友好的氛围。

布局：导师站在画面左侧三分之一处，部分遮挡白板。她一只手将深色平板电脑/笔记本抱在身前，另一只手拿着笔指向白板。前景底部设有一张办公桌，桌上摆放着笔记本电脑、白色马克杯和打印的图表纸。远景左侧可见一盆绿植和一扇高窗。右下角前景隐约可见一把青色办公椅。

角色细节：导师留着长 {argument name="hair color" default="金色"} 发，戴着系有蝴蝶结的白色头巾，身穿浅绿色西装外套、白色衬衫、浅色长裤，系黑色腰带，佩戴一条小项链。她的脸部被一个位于面部中央的纯米色矩形遮挡块刻意遮盖，没有任何面部特征。姿态自信且具有指导性，身体朝向白板。

白板内容：白板上需精确展示 2 个大型圆角矩形信息图面板。左侧面板包含一个由青色、奶油色和黄色立方体组成的 3D 立方体/模块图，上方有 1 个小型立方体图标和 3 个靠近顶部的小色点。在两个面板之间，放置 1 个大型双向水平箭头。右侧面板包含 5 个数据可视化元素：1 个带有彩色圆圈和连接线的节点网络图、1 个上升趋势折线图、1 个垂直柱状图、1 组三个水平滑块控件，以及 1 个圆环/饼图。图表颜色使用青色、柔和黄色、灰色和奶油色。白板上避免出现可读文字。

前景物品数量：包含 4 件桌面物品：1 台打开的笔记本电脑、1 个白色咖啡杯、1 张打印的图表纸和 1 个可见的桌面边缘。白板托盘上包含 5 件小物品：3 支彩色马克笔、1 个深色黑板擦和 1 个灰色黑板擦。

视觉风格：柔和的水彩动漫渲染，线条清晰，左侧射入温暖的阳光，浅奶油色墙壁，白板边框上有微妙的反光，营造出整洁的现代工作空间。保持构图宽敞且不杂乱。

约束：无清晰文字，无 Logo，无水印，无额外角色，非写实照片风格。保留米色面部遮挡矩形作为刻意的视觉元素。

templates.title: Warm and Cozy Anime & Comic Artist Studio

titleLocalized.zh: 温馨动漫漫画家工作室

templates.prompt: Create a warm and detailed anime-style illustration showcasing the comfortable workspace of a comic artist during prime time. The image depicts a young female artist with {argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown"} Her hair was tied in a messy bun, and she wore loose clothing.{argument name="shirt color" default="White"} Wearing a T-shirt, she sits sideways at a wooden desk, drawing on a Wacom-style graphics tablet with a stylus; cover her face with a large, solid rectangular privacy blur/mask. The desk should appear crowded but organized: accurately place two computer monitors, the left monitor displaying a digital comic page from the drawing software, including two black-and-white panels and speech bubbles, and the rear monitor displaying character designs; place a framed portrait on a small easel between the two monitors, its face also covered with a smaller rectangular privacy blur; accurately place a keyboard, a mouse, a desk lamp with an articulated arm that projects warm light, a stylus in her hand, a graphics tablet, a pen holder, two scattered pens on the desk, two scattered erasers, a stack of comics/reference books, and several scattered comic book manuscripts. The background features wooden bookshelves filled with comic books, art books, jars, and pencils, with three small anime figurines precisely placed on them: two girl figurines on the left shelf and a boy figurine on the right. Two manga illustrations are accurately pinned to the left wall: one a portrait page, the other a layout page. A window with beige curtains allows soft light to stream in through the beige curtains. The room is filled with delicate floating glitter and dust particles, soft contour lighting on the artist's hair and shoulders, and uses pale brown and cream tones, delicate lines, cinematic depth of field, and high-detail digital painting to create a nostalgic shoujo manga studio atmosphere. Subtle Japanese manga spines and magazine covers are included, where the text doesn't need to be clearly legible. The overall atmosphere should be tranquil, creative, and intimate, like an artist working in their personal studio on a quiet afternoon.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张温馨、精细的动漫风格插画，展现黄金时刻下舒适的漫画家工作空间。画面中，一位年轻女性艺术家留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 的头发，扎着凌乱的丸子头，身穿宽松的 {argument name="shirt color" default="白色"} T 恤，侧身坐在木质书桌前，正用手写笔在 Wacom 风格的数位板上绘画；请在其面部覆盖一个大型实心矩形隐私模糊/遮挡块。书桌应显得拥挤但有序：准确放置 2 台电脑显示器，左侧显示器显示绘图软件中的数字漫画页面，包含 2 个黑白分镜格和对话气泡，后方显示器显示角色设计图；在两台显示器之间的小画架上放置 1 个带框肖像画，面部同样覆盖较小的矩形隐私模糊块；准确放置 1 个键盘、1 个鼠标、1 个带有铰接臂并投射出暖光的台灯、她手中的 1 支手写笔、1 个数位板、1 个笔筒、桌上 2 支散落的笔、2 块散落的橡皮擦、1 叠漫画/参考书以及几张散落的漫画原稿纸。背景中，包含摆满漫画书、画册、罐子和铅笔的木质书架，书架上准确放置 3 个小型动漫手办：左侧书架上是两个女孩手办，右侧书架上是一个男孩手办。左侧墙壁上准确钉有 2 张漫画绘图，一张是单人肖像页，另一张是漫画排版页。右侧设有一扇透着柔和光线的窗户，挂着米色窗帘，阳光倾泻而入。房间内布满精致的漂浮闪光和尘埃微粒，艺术家头发和肩膀上有柔和的轮廓光，采用淡棕色和奶油色调，线条细腻，具有电影般的景深，高细节数字绘画，营造出怀旧的少女漫画工作室氛围。包含微妙的日式漫画书脊和杂志封面，无需文字清晰可辨。整体氛围应宁静、富有创意且亲密，宛如一位艺术家在午后时分于个人工作室中工作。

templates.title: Light-colored Chinese landscape painting extension

titleLocalized.zh: 淡彩中国山水画扩展

templates.prompt: Inspired by the provided reference image, expand the minimalist abstract scene into a richly detailed, vertically composed classical Chinese landscape painting, rather than a simple illustration. Reinterpret the soft green and pink watercolor washes as a realistic scene: misty green mountains, delicate morning clouds, spring trees, blooming flowers, lush riverbanks, and winding rivers. Remove the simple equestrian motif and replace it with a vibrant riverside scene featuring exactly 10 figures: nine travelers or villagers in groups on the left bank, and a boatman standing in a covered wooden boat on the river. Add a covered wooden boat, willow trees, pink flowering trees, distant thatched cottages, layered green peaks, low-hanging mist, and ripples on the water. Maintain the light, pastel atmosphere and vertical composition of the reference image, but make the world in the painting more complete, narrative, and collectible, presenting delicate brushstrokes, bright light and shadow, and elegant traditional landscape aesthetics. Target style:{argument name="art style" default="Chinese classical landscape paintings with soft, light brushstrokes"} .time:{argument name="time of day" default="sunrise"} .season:{argument name="season" default="spring"} Main scenarios:{argument name="main setting" default="River valley shrouded in mist"} Atmosphere:{argument name="mood" default="Tranquil, poetic, and idyllic"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 以提供的参考图为构图和色彩灵感，将极简的抽象场景扩展为一幅细节丰富、竖构图的中国古典山水画，而非简单的插画。将柔和的绿色和粉色水彩晕染重新诠释为真实景致：云雾缭绕的翠绿山峦、淡雅的晨曦云霞、春树、繁花、草木葱郁的河岸以及蜿蜒的河流。移除简单的骑马者图案，替换为充满生活气息的河畔场景，包含恰好 10 位小人物：左岸有 9 位分成小组的旅人或村民，河上有一位站在带篷木船上的船夫。添加一艘带篷木船、柳树、粉色花树、远处的茅舍、层峦叠嶂的青绿山峰、山间低垂的薄雾以及水面上的微波。保持参考图中的轻盈淡彩氛围和竖构图，但使画面世界更显完整、叙事性强且具有收藏价值，呈现细腻的笔触、明亮的光影氛围以及优雅的传统山水美学。目标风格：{argument name="art style" default="带有柔和淡彩笔触的中国古典山水画"}。时间：{argument name="time of day" default="日出"}。季节：{argument name="season" default="春季"}。主要场景：{argument name="main setting" default="云雾缭绕的河畔山谷"}。氛围：{argument name="mood" default="宁静、诗意且田园牧歌式"}。

templates.title: Cinematic Chinese Ink Landscape Painting

titleLocalized.zh: 电影感中国水墨山水画

templates.prompt: Create a vertically composed, cinematic restoration of a Chinese ink landscape painting, showcasing the elegant style of Song Dynasty landscape painting. Utilize a high 9:16 canvas ratio with a background of yellowed, aged Xuan paper. [Depict...]{argument name="landscape subject" default="Misty karst mountains and tranquil river valleys"} The painting employs layered washes of beige, gray-brown, olive green, charcoal black, and soft brown inks, combining traditional brushstrokes with modern cinematic depth of field, atmospheric haze, and delicate film grain texture. The composition should include towering, cloud-shrouded peaks in the distance, a calm, mirror-like river in the lower half, rocky islands and cliffs in the foreground, and dark, gnarled pine trees framing the upper right and lower left corners. Only one tiny figure is depicted: a solitary traveler in an ochre robe and straw hat, standing on a small rocky ledge in the lower center, facing the water and mountains. A vertical calligraphic inscription is added in the upper left corner, the content of which is…{argument name="calligraphy text" default="Chuang Qin Yuan"} A small red square stamp is placed on the bottom or side, with a few red ink dots scattered on the paper. The use of elegant white space, soft mist, clear black branch silhouettes, freehand rock textures, and delicate water reflections gives the image the texture of a meticulously restored ancient scroll painting. It possesses cinematic lighting, high aesthetic quality, and a tranquil atmosphere, and contains no modern objects, borders, watermarks, or unnecessary text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅竖构图的电影感中国水墨山水画修复作品，呈现宋代山水画的雅致风格，采用 9:16 的高比例画布，背景为泛黄的陈年宣纸。描绘 {argument name="landscape subject" default="烟雨喀斯特山脉与静谧的河谷"}，运用米色、灰褐色、橄榄绿、炭黑和柔和的棕褐色水墨层叠渲染，将传统笔触与现代电影级的景深、大气雾感及细腻的胶片颗粒质感相结合。构图应包含远景中高耸入云、云雾缭绕的山峰，下半部分为平静如镜的河流，前景点缀岩石岛屿与悬崖，右上角和左下角以枝干虬曲的深色松树作为画框。画面中仅包含 1 个微小的人物：一名身着赭色长袍、头戴斗笠的孤身旅人，站在下方中央的小岩架上，面朝水面与群山。在左上方添加 1 处竖排书法题字，内容为 {argument name="calligraphy text" default="闯秦园"}，下方或侧面盖有 1 枚红色小方印，纸面散落少许红色墨点。运用优雅的留白、柔和的雾气、清晰的黑色枝干剪影、写意的岩石纹理以及细腻的水面反射；使画面呈现出精心修复的古画卷轴质感，具备电影级光影、高审美品质与宁静意境，且不含任何现代物体、边框、水印或多余文字。

templates.title: Minimalist Ink Flower Painting

titleLocalized.zh: 极简水墨花卉

templates.prompt: Create a minimalist vertical watercolor painting on off-white rice paper, inspired by restored ancient East Asian ink painting aesthetics, possessing a cinematic softness and visible paper texture. The composition includes two semi-transparent blue-green abstract rock or lotus leaf shapes: a tall, round shape cropped from the left edge, and a larger round shape cropped from the upper right corner, with a pale blue wash extending from the right. A delicate pale pink flower, partially hidden behind the blue shape on the right, is placed near the top center; the flower has five soft, semi-transparent petals and a small cluster of dark ink dots at its center. Add a horizontal, pond-like blue brushstroke in the middle of the painting. Draw three extremely thin black ink plant stems with sparse small leaves, starting from the bottom center and moving upwards, with a curved, dotted branch crossing the center from left to right. In the lower left corner, a red artist's seal and a black calligraphic signature are included.{argument name="color palette" default="Haze blue, light pink, off-white, black ink painting, soft red"} ,{argument name="painting style" default="Minimalist Chinese Watercolor and Ink Painting on Textured Xuan Paper"} ,as well as{argument name="mood" default="Tranquil, ethereal, poetic, cinematic"} Keep the image simple, asymmetrical, and with soft, blurred edges. Avoid adding borders, modern objects, and any readable text except for small abstract stamps and signatures.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅竖构图的极简水彩画，以米白色宣纸为底，灵感源自修复后的古代东亚水墨美学，具有电影般的柔和感和可见的纸张纹理。构图包含两个半透明的蓝绿色抽象岩石或荷叶形态：左侧边缘裁剪出一个高大的圆形形态，右上角裁剪出一个较大的圆形形态，右侧延伸出淡蓝色的渲染。在顶部中心附近放置一朵精致的淡粉色花朵，部分隐藏在右侧蓝色形态后，花朵有五片柔和的半透明花瓣，中心有一小簇深色墨点。在画面中部添加一个水平的蓝色池塘状笔触。从底部中心向上绘制三根极细的黑色水墨植物茎秆，带有稀疏的小叶子，并有一根弯曲的带点枝条从左向右横跨中心。在左下角，包含一个红色艺术家印章和一个黑色书法签名。使用 {argument name="color palette" default="雾霾青蓝色、淡粉色、米白色、黑色水墨、柔和红"}，{argument name="painting style" default="纹理宣纸上的极简中国水彩与水墨画"}，以及 {argument name="mood" default="宁静、空灵、诗意、电影感"}。保持画面简洁、不对称、边缘柔和模糊，不要添加边框、现代物体，除了小的抽象印章和签名外，不要包含任何可读文字。

templates.title: Cinematic Lotus Painting

titleLocalized.zh: 电影感莲花古画

templates.prompt: Create a vertical, cinematic-style art restoration image depicting a lotus flower from an ancient Chinese painting in a realistic style: a pale pink lotus with approximately eight broad, translucent petals, its center consisting of a dark seed pod and stamens, partially obscured by a large, blue-green lotus leaf in the upper right. The composition should include four prominent lotus leaves: a large, blurred leaf on the left edge; a large, clear, dark blue lotus leaf in the upper right with a round water droplet; a large, blurred lotus leaf cutting into the frame in the lower right; and a small, flat, round lotus leaf near the center with tiny dewdrops along its edge. Add three main stems: a tall, smooth, curved stem supporting the pink flower; a slender, hairy stem bending towards the small central lotus leaf; and a delicate herbaceous bud rising from the bottom with narrow leaves and tiny flower buds.{argument name="flower color" default="Soft light pink"} ,{argument name="leaf color" default="Soft blue-green cyan"} ,{argument name="background tone" default="hazy pale gray-white"} as well as{argument name="visual style" default="Cinematic Realistic Chinese Ink Painting Aesthetics"} The atmosphere should be tranquil, poetic, elegant, and minimalist, featuring shallow depth of field, soft diffused backlighting, clearly visible leaf veins, a light mist, delicate dewdrops, natural plant textures, soft contrast, and high-end cinematic macro photography quality. Maintain a spacious, vertical composition, and the image must not contain text, borders, people, or any modern objects.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅竖构图的电影级艺术修复风格图像，将中国古画中的莲花以写实手法呈现：一朵淡粉色的莲花，约有 8 片宽阔的半透明花瓣，花心为深色的莲蓬与雄蕊，部分被右上方一片巨大的蓝绿色荷叶遮挡。画面构图需包含 4 片显眼的荷叶：左侧边缘是一片超大且虚化的荷叶，右上方是一片超大且清晰的深青色荷叶，上面有一颗圆润的水珠，右下方是一片超大的虚化荷叶切入画面，中心附近有一片小而平整的圆形荷叶，边缘带有细小的露珠。添加 3 根主要茎秆：1 根支撑粉色花朵的高挑平滑弯曲茎秆，1 根向中心小荷叶弯曲的细长多毛茎秆，以及 1 根从底部升起、带有窄叶和微小花蕾的精致草本芽。使用 {argument name="flower color" default="柔和淡粉色"}、{argument name="leaf color" default="柔和蓝绿色青色"}、{argument name="background tone" default="朦胧淡灰白色"} 以及 {argument name="visual style" default="电影级写实中国水墨画美学"}。氛围应宁静、诗意、优雅且极简，具备浅景深、柔和的漫射背光、清晰可见的叶脉、淡淡的薄雾、精致的露珠、自然的植物纹理、柔和的对比度以及高端电影级微距摄影质感。保持构图宽敞且为竖向，画面中不得包含文字、边框、人物或任何现代物品。

templates.title: Ancient painting to live-action photography

titleLocalized.zh: 古画转实景摄影

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as a compositional reference for the ancient painting, this work transforms it into a realistic and collectible art photograph, presenting an image as if taken by a top photographer during the same historical period. Do not merely render the painting's style as a photograph; rather, treat the painting as a compressed memory of a real landscape, reverse-engineering it and reconstructing the authentic scene behind it. Maintain the core thematic logic: the image must contain {argument name="rider count" default="3"} riding{argument name="horse count" default="3"} Ancient women on pale horses move together in the image, dressed in pink to coral-colored clothing and with traditional hairstyles. Retain the lightness, springtime colors, and sense of space of the reference image, but transform the abstract ink-wash blocks into a realistic environment. New photographic scene: Place the riders in a wide, misty spring meadow, the grass a soft green, with shallow puddles reflecting on the ground. A thin mist shrouds the distance, dotted with hazy flowering trees in pale pink and fresh yellow-green hues. The foreground shrubs and foliage echo the pinkish-green areas in the reference image. The landscape should evoke a damp, early morning atmosphere, with ample negative space above the riders, and distant trees gradually fading into the haze. Photographic Processing: Employs a telephoto documentary/artistic photography style, featuring natural morning light, soft backlighting and mist, realistic horse and fabric movement, shallow depth of field, soft pastel tones, gentle contrast, high dynamic range, no ink-wash outlines, no watercolor textures, and no illustration, mural, or religious iconography style. Composition Restrictions: Place the rider in the lower center of the frame, maintaining a small to medium proportion, with horizontal movement; maintain a 4:3 vertical composition, with a wide expanse of sky/mist above and a textured meadow below. Avoid modern objects, roads, buildings, visible text, logos, or fantastical elements. Optional Customization: Set the historical period to {argument name="historical period" default="Tang Dynasty"} Season set{argument name="season" default="early spring"} The atmosphere is set to{argument name="mood" default="The fog is calm"} .

promptLocalized.zh:
以 REFERENCE_0 作为古画构图参考，将其转化为一张真实且具有收藏价值的艺术摄影作品，呈现出如同由顶级摄影师在同一历史时期拍摄的画面。请勿仅仅将画作风格渲染为照片，而是要将画作视为对真实景观的压缩记忆进行逆向工程，并重构其背后的真实场景。

保持核心主体逻辑：画面中必须包含 {argument name="rider count" default="3"} 位骑着 {argument name="horse count" default="3"} 匹苍白马匹的古代女性，她们共同在画面中行进，身着粉色至珊瑚色的服饰，并梳着传统的发髻。保留参考图中的轻盈感、春日色彩和空间感，但将抽象的水墨色块转化为真实的环境。

全新摄影场景：将骑马者置于一片宽阔且雾气缭绕的春日草甸中，草地呈现柔和的绿色，地面有浅浅的倒影水洼，远处笼罩着薄雾，点缀着淡粉色与清新黄绿色的模糊花树，前景的灌木与枝叶与参考图中的粉绿色彩区域相呼应。景观应营造出潮湿、清晨且富有氛围感的意境，骑马者上方留有大面积的负空间，远处的树林逐渐隐入朦胧之中。

摄影处理：采用长焦纪实/艺术摄影风格，自然晨光，柔和的逆光雾气，写实的马匹与织物动态，浅景深氛围，柔和的淡色调，柔和的对比度，高动态范围，无水墨轮廓线，无水彩纹理，非插画，非壁画或宗教偶像风格。

构图限制：将骑马者置于画面中下部，保持中小型比例，水平横向移动；保持 4:3 竖构图，上方留有广阔的天空/雾气，下方为富有质感的草甸。避免出现现代物体、道路、建筑、可见文字、Logo 或奇幻元素。

可选自定义：将历史时期设置为 {argument name="historical period" default="唐朝"}，季节设置为 {argument name="season" default="早春"}，氛围设置为 {argument name="mood" default="雾气宁静"}。

templates.title: Poster featuring miniature models of electronic components based on Chinese poetry

titleLocalized.zh: 中国诗词电子元件微缩模型海报

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a vertical poster about Chinese education, combining miniature electronic components similar to LEGO with information about poetry.{argument name="poem title" default="Qinyuanchun Changsha"} This design combines study notes with infographics. Canvas: 3:4 vertical poster, warm beige background, advanced editing layout. The left side features a simple information panel; the right and lower areas showcase a realistic miniature scene, with electronic hardware components arranged to form a miniature industrial city. Layout: The top left corner features a striking deep navy blue calligraphy title, with the first line reading "Qinyuanchun" and the second line reading "Changsha," accompanied by a small, vertical red seal engraved with "Mao Zedong." Below the title is a subtitle: "5 Key Points Related to This Article." Below the subtitle, create 5 stacked knowledge cards, each containing a navy blue numbered square, a small icon, a bold title, and two lines of brief Chinese explanation. The 5 cards must be strictly labeled as: 01 Writing Background, 02 Poetic Genre, 03 Theme, 04 Artistic Features, 05 Historical Significance. Use delicate dividing lines and subtle circuitry decorations near the subtitle. Miniature Electronic Model: On the right, a highly detailed desktop scene is built using electronic components, resembling a LEGO building: white wall sockets, circuit breakers with red toggle switches, relays, terminal blocks, capacitors, metal rails, copper pipes, black cables, a transparent fuse box, a gray platform, and miniature bolts. A prominent wooden sign is mounted above the circuit components in the upper right corner, stating…{argument name="main sign text" default="Serving the People"} Add a large wall socket to the right edge and another socket module to the upper left. Place 10 miniature worker models in blue uniforms and yellow hard hats around the mechanical device, distributed near the platform, relay tower, and copper pipe path. Add small model trees along the edges to make the electronic components look more like a miniature city. Other visible signage: Add two smaller wooden signs to the lower half of the model. One sign in the lower left foreground reads "Orange Isle" with a small arrow. Another sign in the lower right foreground contains a few lines of short vertical Chinese characters, hinting at notes related to poetry; keep the text clear but as a secondary element. Visual style: A combination of photorealistic macro photography and infographic design, shallow depth of field, warm studio lighting, clear focus on the central electronic components, and a softly blurred background that presents realistic plastic, ceramic, copper, and metallic textures. Color scheme: Creamy beige, deep navy blue, copper orange, electronic white, metallic gray, red switch accents, and small blue and yellow worker models. Constraints: Use Chinese accurately in the designated locations, keep the left-side infographic concise and easy to read, strictly retain 5 knowledge cards and 10 worker models, avoid random additional titles or watermarks, and make the electronic components look like LEGO with modular fun, while maintaining their recognizability as real electronic hardware.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张竖版中国教育海报，将类似 LEGO 的微缩电子元件模型与关于诗词 {argument name="poem title" default="沁园春 长沙"} 的学习笔记信息图相结合。

画布：3:4 竖版海报，暖米色背景，高级编辑排版。左侧为简洁的信息面板；右侧及下方区域为逼真的微缩场景，由电子硬件零件排列成一座微型工业城市。

排版：左上角为醒目的深海军蓝毛笔书法标题，第一行书写“沁园春”，第二行书写“长沙”，旁边配有一枚小巧的竖排红色印章，刻有“毛泽东”。标题下方添加副标题“相关 5 个这篇文章的知识点”。在副标题下方，创建 5 张堆叠的知识卡片，每张卡片包含一个海军蓝色的数字编号方块、一个小图标、一个粗体标题以及两行简短的中文解释文字。5 张卡片必须严格标注为：01 写作背景、02 诗歌体裁、03 主题思想、04 艺术特色、05 时代意义。在副标题附近使用精致的分割线和微妙的电路走线装饰。

微缩电子模型：在右侧，利用电子零配件搭建一个高度精细的桌面场景，使其看起来像 LEGO 建筑：白色墙壁插座、带有红色拨动开关的断路器、继电器、接线端子、电容器、金属导轨、铜管、黑色电缆、透明保险丝盒、灰色平台和微型螺栓。在右上角电路元件上方安装一个显眼的木质标牌，上面写着 {argument name="main sign text" default="为人民服务"}。在右侧边缘添加一个大型墙壁插座，并在中左上方添加另一个插座模块。在机械装置周围放置 10 个身着蓝色制服、头戴黄色安全帽的微型工人模型，他们分布在平台、继电器塔旁以及铜管路径附近。在边缘处添加小型模型树，使电子零件看起来更像一座微缩城市。

其他可见标牌：在模型下半部分添加 2 个较小的木质标牌。左下角前景处的一个标牌写着“橘子洲头”并配有一个小箭头。右下角前景处的另一个标牌包含几行简短的竖排中文，暗示与诗词相关的笔记；保持文字清晰但作为次要元素。

视觉风格：照片级真实感的微距摄影与信息图设计相结合，浅景深，温暖的摄影棚灯光，焦点清晰地聚焦在中央的电子元件上，背景柔和虚化，呈现真实的塑料、陶瓷、铜和金属质感。配色方案：奶油米色、深海军蓝墨色、铜橙色、电子白、金属灰、红色开关点缀以及小巧的蓝黄色工人模型。

约束条件：在指定位置准确使用中文，保持左侧信息图简洁易读，严格保留 5 张知识卡片和 10 个工人模型，避免出现随机的额外标题或水印，并使电子零配件看起来像 LEGO 一样具有模块化的趣味性，同时保持其作为真实电子硬件的可辨识度。

templates.title: Edo Kiriko Gothic Kimono Glass Girl

titleLocalized.zh: 江户切子哥特和服玻璃少女

templates.prompt: Create a vertically composed, ultra-refined fantasy product photograph, featuring a Gothic Lolita-style kimono-clad girl with a sculpted, Edo-era Kiriko glass sculpture-like texture. The subject is {argument name="character name" default="An elegant, nameless young glass artist"} She is shown in a graceful profile to the left, a long, red and black pipe lightly dangling from her lips, accompanied by a thin wisp of translucent, curling smoke. She possesses glossy, black, glass-like hair with deep crimson highlights, bangs, and long sideburns. Her hair ornaments are intricate and ornate, composed of faceted crystals, wirework, dangling beads, and red accents. Her skin appears milky white and translucent, like porcelain glass. She wears a magnificent Gothic-style kimono, the main color of which is {argument name="main kimono colors" default="Black, sapphire blue, clear crystal, gold, and crimson"} Featuring wide sleeves, an open back, lace-like black and gold filigree, gold floral inlays, red rose patterns, and dense triangular prism facets that refract light like cut crystal. The figure is surrounded by a large circular transparent glass halo engraved with Edo Kiriko geometric star patterns and incorporating seven striking decorative floral elements: a large red crystal flower in the lower left, three red roses at the hem and cuffs of the kimono, a blue-black flower near the shoulder, a silver flower hair ornament, and a pale pink crystal flower in the center right. Sharp, lotus-shaped blue crystal fragments and shimmering star decorations are added around the base, all made of glass. The figure rests on a glossy black octagonal lacquerware display base adorned with delicate gold geometric and floral line art. Background: A softly blurred traditional Japanese room with shoji windows, warm wooden interiors, golden afternoon light, shallow depth of field, and shimmering bokeh reflections. Visual style: Exquisite anime-style collectible figure, luxurious glass craftsmanship, hyper-realistic transparent refraction, complex faceted caustics, iridescent highlights, high contrast, cinematic warm light, 9:16 composition, centered full-body statue, no visible text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张垂直构图、超精细的奇幻产品摄影图，主体为呈现江户切子切割玻璃雕塑质感的哥特萝莉和服少女。主体为 {argument name="character name" default="一位优雅的无名玻璃工艺少女"}，以优美的侧影向左展示，唇边轻衔一根长长的红黑配色烟斗，并伴有一缕细小的半透明卷曲烟雾。她拥有光泽的黑色玻璃质感秀发，带有深绯色挑染，留着齐刘海和长鬓角，发饰由刻面水晶、金属丝工艺、垂坠珠饰及红色点缀构成，造型繁复华丽。她的皮肤应呈现出乳白色半透明的瓷质玻璃感。她身着华丽的哥特风格和服，主色调为 {argument name="main kimono colors" default="黑色、蓝宝石色、透明水晶色、金色和绯红色"}，配有宽袖、露背设计、蕾丝般的黑色金银丝细工、金色花卉镶嵌、红玫瑰图案，以及像切割水晶般折射光线的密集三角棱镜刻面。主体周围环绕着一个巨大的圆形透明玻璃光环，上面刻有江户切子几何星芒图案，并包含 7 个醒目的装饰性花朵元素：左下方一朵大型红色水晶花，和服下摆和袖口处三朵红玫瑰，肩部附近一朵蓝黑色花朵，一个银色花朵发饰，以及右中位置一朵淡粉色水晶花。在底座周围添加尖锐的莲花状蓝色水晶碎片和闪烁的星形装饰，所有元素均由玻璃制成。将人偶放置在一个光泽的黑色八角形漆器展示底座上，底座饰有精致的金色几何与花卉线条艺术。背景：柔和虚化的传统日式房间，带有障子窗、温暖的木质内饰、金色的午后光线、浅景深以及闪烁的焦外成像反射。视觉风格：精致的动漫风格收藏级手办，奢华玻璃工艺，超写实透明折射，复杂的刻面焦散，虹彩高光，高对比度，电影级暖光，9:16 构图，居中全身雕像，无可见文字，无水印。

templates.title: Japanese workplace career diagnosis cover

titleLocalized.zh: 日本职场职业诊断封面

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a minimalist, vertical Japanese-style title slideshow for a 7-page career diagnostic carousel, featuring an elegant literary feel and a deep starry sky background. Canvas: 1:1 square format, 768×768 pixels, ample white space, presenting a print-quality editorial layout. Background: Deep mauve gradient, slightly darker at the top and slightly lighter at the bottom, scattered with small off-white and matte gold stars. The stars should be sparse and delicate, avoiding constellations or large illustrations. Layout: Left-aligned layout with ample margins. Place a small, uppercase Romanized label in the top left corner: “TENSYOKU SHINDAN / 2026.05.15”. Create a prominent Japanese title occupying the upper left corner of the canvas below. The title is divided into four lines: 1) "I speak with prejudice", (ivory white), 2) "My original job", (ivory white, where "original job" is in a slightly dull lavender gray with a thin horizontal strikethrough), 3) "My job", (matte gold), 4) "I can't do it." (matte gold). Add a compact four-line Japanese text (ivory white) below the title: "Conversation record・Case メモ・スキル design," "ぜんぶ読みました." "Others' comments価をPosted" "せ集めて," "无自覚のまま流しているabilitiesを," "意地悪なくらいハッキリverbalizationします." Lower left corner: Small capital footer "BIASED / DENSE / HONEST” (Matte Gold). Bottom right: Page number indicates "1 / 7" (matt gold). Font: The main title uses a sophisticated Japanese style/serif with high contrast strokes, large and dramatic. Use a smaller serif font for body text to ensure readability. The Roman numerals should be wide-spaced, thin, and understated. Color scheme: ivory white text, matte antique gold accents, lavender gray for deleted words, and a deep plum purple background. Restrictions: No people, icons, borders, watermarks, or additional text. Maintain a calm, high-end editorial atmosphere, like a poetic diagnostic report cover.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 7 页的职业诊断轮播图创建一个极简的竖版日式标题幻灯片，具有优雅的文学气息和深邃的星空背景。

画布：1:1 正方形格式，768×768，留白充裕，呈现印刷级的编辑排版风格。

背景：深梅紫色渐变，顶部略深，底部微亮，散布着细小的米白色和哑光金色星点。星点需稀疏且精致，不要包含星座或大型插图。

布局：左对齐排版，留有宽裕边距。左上角放置小型大写罗马拼音标签：“TENSYOKU SHINDAN / 2026.05.15”。下方创建占据画布左上方的醒目日文标题。标题分为四行：1) 「偏見で言う、」（象牙白），2) 「あなたの本業」（象牙白，其中「本業」使用略显暗淡的薰衣草灰，并加有一条细横删除线），3) 「天職は」（哑光金），4) 「これしかない。」（哑光金）。标题下方添加一段紧凑的四行日文正文（象牙白）：「会話履歴・案件メモ・スキル設計、」「ぜんぶ読みました。」「他人の評価を寄せ集めて、」「無自覚のまま流している才能を、」「意地悪なくらいハッキリ言語化します。」左下角：小型大写页脚 “BIASED / DENSE / HONEST”（哑光金）。右下角：页码指示 “1 / 7”（哑光金）。

字体：主标题使用高对比度笔画的精致日文明朝体/衬线体，字号大且具有戏剧性。正文使用较小的衬线体，确保易读性。罗马字母部分需宽字间距、纤细且低调。

配色方案：象牙白文字，哑光古金色点缀，被删除词汇使用薰衣草灰，深梅紫色背景。

限制：不包含人物、图标、边框、水印或额外文字。保持冷静、高端的编辑氛围，如同诗意的诊断报告封面。

templates.title: Config 2026 Nail Art Project

titleLocalized.zh: Config 2026 美甲项目

templates.prompt: Objective: For the recipient{argument name="event name" default="Config 2026"} This themed event features a cute showcase project showcasing customized nail art, utilizing playful Figma-style graphics and soft 3D metallic nail embellishments. Canvas: 16:9 landscape layout, warm gray-brown background, and a simple, minimalist poster composition. Text content: A striking large, rounded white title in the top left corner: "My Config Nails". A striking large, rounded white event tag in the bottom right corner:{argument name="event label" default="Config 2026"} The design uses a rounded and friendly bold sans-serif font. Layout: The 10 nail designs are arranged in two rows of 5, centered. Each nail is a vertical, rounded capsule shape in ivory/off-white, evenly spaced, with delicate flat graphic decorations. Keep the nail designs large and independent, creating an effect similar to Figma design mockups. Nail designs, 10 in total: 1. First row, first piece: The Figma logo composed of five circular character blocks in red-orange, coral, purple, blue, and green. 2. First row, second piece: Abstract bright blue stacked bean shapes with two chrome silver spherical studs, one in the upper left and one near the bottom. 3. First row, third piece: A red vertical rounded rectangle label with the white text "saki," and a small red paper airplane or cursor triangle near the upper right corner. 4. First row, fourth piece: A thick black wavy vertical stripe in the middle with two chrome silver spherical studs, one near the upper right and one near the lower left. 5. 1. Row 1, Piece 5: A neon lime green arc sweeping from the top left corner, with a purple circle on the right and a chrome silver stud near the bottom center. 6. Row 2, Piece 1: A cute light pink heart-shaped character with black oval eyes, a smiling mouth, and mint green calves/feet. 7. Row 2, Piece 2: Black grid lines on ivory nails with two vertically arranged chrome silver studs, one at the top center and one at the bottom center. 8. Row 2, Piece 3: A large purple flower/color block cluster in the top left corner, a neon lime green arc patch in the bottom right corner, and a chrome silver stud near the bottom center. 9. Row 2, Piece 4: Three vertically stacked circles in red-orange, purple, and green, located in the center of the nail. 10. Row 2, Piece 5: A large red-orange organic color block covering the upper half, with a chrome silver stud near the top left of the color block. Visual Style: Modern cute flat vector nail mockup, Figma Conference aesthetics: soft cream nail polish, highly saturated accent colors, simple geometric shapes, and subtle shading added only to chrome silver studs for a 3D metallic effect. Keep the overall look clean, simple, and poster-like. Constraints: Use a total of 10 nail capsules and 10 chrome silver studs. Do not add hands, fingers, bottles, extra decorations, watermarks, or any other text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为受 {argument name="event name" default="Config 2026"} 启发的主题活动定制美甲制作一个可爱的展示项目，采用趣味十足的 Figma 风格图形和柔和的 3D 金属美甲饰品。

画布：横向 16:9 布局，暖灰褐色背景，简洁的极简海报构图。

文本内容：左上角为醒目的大号圆角白色标题：“My Config Nails”。右下角为醒目的大号圆角白色活动标签：“{argument name="event label" default="Config 2026"}”。使用圆润且友好的粗体无衬线字体。

布局：将 10 款穿戴甲设计排列成两行，每行 5 个，居中对齐。每片指甲均为垂直的圆角胶囊形状，呈象牙白/米白色，间距均匀，带有精致的扁平图形装饰。保持指甲图案较大且独立，呈现出 Figma 设计样机的效果。

美甲设计，共 10 款：
1. 第一行，第一片：由红橙色、珊瑚色、紫色、蓝色和绿色五个圆角色块组成的 Figma Logo。
2. 第一行，第二片：抽象的亮蓝色堆叠豆形，带有两颗铬银色球形饰钉，一颗位于左上方，一颗位于底部附近。
3. 第一行，第三片：红色垂直圆角矩形标签，带有白色文字“saki”，右上角附近有一个红色小纸飞机或光标三角形。
4. 第一行，第四片：中间有一条粗黑色波浪状垂直条纹，带有两颗铬银色球形饰钉，一颗位于右上角附近，一颗位于左下角附近。
5. 第一行，第五片：从左上角扫过的霓虹青柠绿弧形，右侧有一个紫色圆圈，下方中心附近有一颗铬银色饰钉。
6. 第二行，第一片：可爱的淡粉色心形角色，带有黑色椭圆眼睛、微笑嘴巴和薄荷绿的小腿/脚。
7. 第二行，第二片：象牙白指甲上的黑色网格线，带有两颗垂直排列的铬银色饰钉，一颗位于上方中心，一颗位于下方中心。
8. 第二行，第三片：左上角有大型紫色花朵/色块簇，右下角有霓虹青柠绿弧形补丁，下方中心附近有一颗铬银色饰钉。
9. 第二行，第四片：三个垂直堆叠的圆圈，颜色分别为红橙色、紫色和绿色，位于指甲中心。
10. 第二行，第五片：覆盖上半部分的大型红橙色有机色块，色块左上方附近有一颗铬银色饰钉。

视觉风格：现代可爱的扁平矢量美甲样机，Figma 会议美学，柔和的奶油色指甲，高饱和度的点缀色，简单的几何形状，仅在铬银色饰钉上添加细微阴影以呈现 3D 金属质感。保持整体清晰、简洁，具有海报质感。

约束：总共使用 10 个指甲胶囊和 10 个铬银色饰钉。不要添加手部、手指、瓶子、额外装饰、水印或任何其他文本。

templates.title: Portrait by the classroom window in the early morning

titleLocalized.zh: 清晨教室窗边肖像

templates.prompt: Create a realistic vertical portrait photograph, in which {argument name="character description" default="Japanese high school girl"} Standing in the warm morning sunlight, beside her were tall wooden-framed classroom windows. She turned slightly towards the camera, as if she had just turned around, one hand gently touching the window frame, the other hanging naturally at her waist. She had long, straight black hair and was dressed neatly.{argument name="school uniform" default="Navy blue suit jacket, white shirt, striped silk bow tie, and gray plaid skirt"} The classroom background is blurred, clearly showcasing three main elements: a cork project covered in paper, a green blackboard with blurred lettering, and several wooden student desks and chairs. Natural golden sunlight streaming in from the left window creates bright highlights on the wooden floor, a shallow depth of field, and a soft blurring of the view outside, creating an airy, everyday morning atmosphere. The composition starts from mid-thigh upwards, with the subject slightly to the right, and the lines of the window on the left adding depth. The face is deliberately anonymized, covered with a smooth rectangular blur while maintaining clarity in the hair, uniform, hands, and classroom environment. Photorealistic DSLR style, 4:5 vertical composition, clean colors, no text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实的竖版肖像照片，画面中 {argument name="character description" default="日本高中女生"} 站在温暖的清晨阳光下，身旁是高大的木框教室窗户。她微微转向镜头，仿佛刚刚回过头来，一只手轻轻触碰窗框，另一只手自然垂在腰间。她留着黑色长直发，穿着整洁的 {argument name="school uniform" default="海军蓝西装外套、白衬衫、条纹丝带领结和灰色格纹裙"}。教室背景经过虚化处理，清晰呈现三个主要背景元素：贴有纸张的软木项目、带有模糊字迹的绿色黑板，以及几张木制学生课桌椅。利用从左侧窗户射入的自然金色阳光，木地板上带有明亮的高光，浅景深效果，窗外呈现柔和的虚化，营造出空气感十足的平日清晨氛围。构图从大腿中部向上，主体略微偏右，左侧的窗户线条营造出空间深度。面部需进行刻意匿名处理，在脸部区域覆盖平滑的矩形模糊，同时保持头发、制服、双手和教室环境的清晰度。照片级写实 DSLR 风格，4:5 竖构图，色彩干净，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: The blond adventurer in front of the treehouse

titleLocalized.zh: 树屋前的金发冒险者

templates.prompt: Create a 9:16 vertical screen fantasy illustration with a cinematic feel, featuring the main character as {argument name="character name" default="Rei"} A solitary and elegant young male adventurer, his back to the camera, stood on a moss-covered forest path, gazing at a magical tree stump hut. He possessed {argument name="hair color" default="Messy long blonde hair"} The figure is fair-skinned, lean, and muscular, with bare arms, dressed in a dark, sleeveless fantasy outfit with crisscrossing leather straps at the back, black gloves or arm guards, a belt around the waist with a small bag hanging from it, fitted dark trousers, sturdy dark sandals or open fantasy footwear, and a long, asymmetrical black cloak or belt with delicate purple and gold trim that flutters in the breeze. The scene is set in an ancient woodland during the Golden Hour: towering trees, dense foliage, ferns, moss-covered rocks, exposed tree roots, and a narrow, damp pebble path with tiny reflections. The hut, located on the right side of the composition, is converted from a massive hollow tree stump and covered in ivy, vines, moss, and leaves; the hut has four clearly visible, warmly glowing windows: a small round window above the door, an arched window to the left of the door, an arched window to the right of the door, and a tiny diamond-shaped window inlaid in the wooden door. Includes a round, carved wooden front door with a small, glowing lantern hanging above it, shallow stone steps leading to the door, and fantastical handcrafted details that give the house a sense of inhabitation. Utilizing dramatic backlighting, sunlight streams through the forest canopy from the upper left, casting a warm amber glow through the windows. This is accompanied by soft atmospheric mist, deep green shadows, and highly detailed bark textures, creating a realistic, anime-fantasy feel. The strong contrasts and tranquil, magical atmosphere are complemented by the absence of text, borders, and watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 9:16 竖屏电影感奇幻插画，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="Rei"}，一位孤独且优雅的年轻男性冒险者，背影视角，站在长满苔藓的林间小路上，望向一座魔法树桩小屋。他拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="凌乱的长金发"}，皮肤白皙，身材精瘦健壮，双臂裸露，身穿深色无袖奇幻服装，背部有皮革绑带交叉，佩戴黑色手套或护臂，腰间系带并挂有小袋，穿着合身的深色长裤、结实的深色凉鞋或开放式奇幻鞋履，以及一件长款不对称黑色斗篷或腰带，内衬带有精致的紫色和金色镶边，在微风中飘动。场景设定在黄金时刻的古老林地：高耸的树木、茂密的叶丛、蕨类植物、覆盖苔藓的岩石、裸露的树根，以及一条带有微小倒影的狭窄湿润石子路。小屋位于构图右侧，由巨大的空心树桩改建而成，覆盖着常春藤、藤蔓、苔藓和叶片；小屋共有四个清晰可见的温暖发光窗户：门上方一个小圆窗，门左侧一个拱形窗，门右侧一个拱形窗，以及木门上镶嵌的一个微小菱形窗。包含一扇带有雕刻装饰的圆形木制前门，门上方悬挂着一盏发光的小灯笼，门前有浅浅的石阶，以及让房屋显得有人居住的奇幻手工细节。采用戏剧性的逆光效果，阳光从左上方穿过森林树冠投射下来，窗户透出温暖的琥珀色光芒，伴有柔和的大气薄雾、深绿色的阴影、高度细腻的树皮纹理，呈现出写实绘画风格的动漫奇幻质感，对比强烈，氛围静谧而神奇，无文字，无边框，无水印。

templates.title: Anime Face Mask Portrait Template

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫面部遮罩肖像模板

templates.prompt: Create a clean, anime-style character bust as a template for generating facial features: the center of the image features a young female character with {argument name="hair color" default="The ends of her white hair gradually turned a pale sky blue."} The character sports a shoulder-length, slightly messy, layered hairstyle with fine, delicate strands, revealing the ears. They wear a futuristic white turtleneck zip-up jacket with delicate light blue accents and small triangular details at the collar zipper. The face is completely covered by a large, vertically rounded rectangle mask, centered on the head, extending from the forehead to below the mouth and chin. The mask features a soft vertical gradient from a warm, pale peach at the top to a cool, pale blue-gray at the bottom, completely obscuring the eyes, nose, and mouth while preserving the hair, ears, neck, collar, and shoulders. The artwork employs a refined Japanese anime illustration style, with delicate, elegant lines, soft, watercolor-like shadows, and extremely light macaron colors, creating a cool, sterile sci-fi feel. The background is a pure light gray studio backdrop. The composition is a close-up half-body portrait from the top of the head to the upper chest, with a symmetrical frontal pose, the character occupying most of the frame. A dark, screenshot-style border is added around the artwork, with a minimalist dark UI bar at the bottom containing tiny thumbnails and small text in the lower left corner.{argument name="lower left label" default="idle_half_u"} There is a small button in the bottom right corner with the text "{argument name="button label" default="close (esc)"} Avoid any visible facial features, extra characters, or text within the portrait area, and ensure that the rectangular area covering the face is completely clean and opaque.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一张干净的动漫风格角色半身像，作为面部部件生成模板：画面中心为一名年轻女性角色，拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="发梢渐变为淡天蓝色的白发"}，齐肩微乱的层次感发型，发丝细腻，耳朵可见；身穿未来感白色高领拉链夹克，带有精致的淡蓝色点缀，领口拉链处有小型三角形细节。面部区域必须被一个大的垂直圆角矩形遮罩完全覆盖，遮罩位于头部中心，从上额头一直延伸至嘴部和下巴下方，遮罩呈现从顶部的暖淡桃色到底部的冷淡蓝灰色的柔和垂直渐变，完全遮挡眼睛、鼻子和嘴巴，同时保留头发、耳朵、脖子、衣领和肩膀。采用精致的日式动漫插画风格，线条纤细淡雅，阴影如水彩般柔和，色彩为极浅的马卡龙色系，营造出冷静的无菌科幻感。背景为纯浅灰色摄影棚背景。构图为从头顶到上胸部的特写半身像，对称的正脸姿势，角色占据画面大部分空间。在艺术作品周围添加深色截图风格的边框，底部配有极简的深色 UI 条，包含微小的缩略图块，左下角带有微小文字 {argument name="lower left label" default="idle_half_u"}，右下角有一个小按钮，文字为 {argument name="button label" default="close (esc)"}。避免出现任何可见的面部特征，避免出现额外角色，避免在肖像区域内出现文字，并确保遮罩面部的矩形区域完全干净且不透明。

templates.title: Indigo Dragon Sword Princess

titleLocalized.zh: 靛青龙剑姬

templates.prompt: Create an epic dark fantasy anime illustration with a 9:16 vertical composition, in which {argument name="character name" default="A lonely magical swordswoman"} Standing atop the broken stone ruins of a glowing cathedral garden overgrown with weeds, the composition features two main subjects: a young female warrior in the lower right foreground, and a massive mechanical dragon coiling from the left foreground to the upper background. She wears a layered Gothic naval black battle dress with a short skirt, flowing cloak embellishments, and ornate black and gold armor adorning her shoulders, arms, hands, thighs, knees, and high boots. She has long twin ponytails.{argument name="hair color" default="Deep indigo"} Her hair billowed dramatically in the air; her face was veiled by a soft, square, blurry, or featureless halo of light. She held a massive, translucent crystal greatsword, its blade tilting downwards to the lower left corner, radiating…{argument name="sword color" default="violet"} The light emanating from the dragon, with its star-shaped facets and internal lighting effects, is breathtaking. The massive, serpentine dragon possesses a biomechanical quality, composed of deep blue-black armor plates, gears, gold and silver filigree, cables, and claw-like forms. Warm orange lava light seeps through its gaps. Its head, appearing and disappearing beside the warrior, is both protective and menacing, adorned with spiked crystal horns and intricate mechanical details. Surrounding it are dense violet and white flowers, twisted vines, golden cathedral pillars, broken arches, floating petals, sparks, and backlit dust—all illuminated by the brilliant, warm sunlight streaming through the ruins. The artwork employs an extremely delicate Japanese fantasy concept art style, featuring ornate lines, maximalist decorative mechanical filigree, high contrast between deep ultramarine shadows and luminous golden highlights, cinematic rim lighting, dynamic low-angle perspective, sharp focus, a painterly quality, and no visible text or watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 9:16 竖构图的史诗级暗黑奇幻动漫插画，画面中 {argument name="character name" default="一位孤独的魔法剑姬"} 站在杂草丛生的发光大教堂花园内的破碎石制废墟上。构图包含 2 个主要主体：右下角前景处的一位年轻女战士，以及从左侧前景盘绕至上方背景的一条巨大机械龙。她身穿层叠的哥特式海军黑战裙，配有短裙、飘逸的斗篷饰片，肩部、手臂、手部、大腿、膝盖和高筒靴上装饰着华丽的黑金盔甲，长长的双马尾 {argument name="hair color" default="深靛青色"} 头发在空中戏剧性地飘动；她的脸部被柔和的方形模糊或无特征的遮挡光晕覆盖。她手持一把巨大的半透明水晶巨剑，剑身从手中向下倾斜至左下角，散发着 {argument name="sword color" default="紫罗兰色"} 的光芒，带有星状切面和内部光效。巨龙体型庞大、呈蛇形且具有生物机械感，由深蓝黑色装甲板、齿轮、金银丝细工、电缆、利爪形态组成，温暖的橙色熔岩光芒透过缝隙溢出；它的头部在战士身旁若隐若现，既具保护性又充满威胁感，长有带刺的水晶角和复杂的机械细节。周围环绕着茂密的紫罗兰色和白色花朵、扭曲的藤蔓、金色大教堂柱子、破碎的拱门、漂浮的花瓣、火花和背光尘埃，所有元素都被透过废墟倾泻而下的灿烂暖阳照亮。采用极其细腻的日本奇幻概念艺术风格，华丽的线条，极繁主义的装饰性机械细工，深群青色阴影与发光金色高光之间的高对比度，电影级轮廓光，动态低角度透视，焦点清晰，具有绘画质感，无可见文字，无水印。

templates.title: Santorini Breakfast Trip Flat Lay Photography

titleLocalized.zh: 圣托里尼早餐旅行平铺摄影

templates.prompt: Create a sun-drenched Mediterranean travel flat lay photograph on a textured white stucco tabletop, presenting a dreamlike vacation memory. The location is {argument name="destination" default="The Syracuse of Santorini, Greece"} The image should precisely arrange six main items: a vintage postcard on the left, a large Polaroid photograph stacked on the right, a white fountain pen with a blue nib near the bottom, a small cream-colored seashell near the top, a folded white linen cloth with light blue stripes in the upper right corner, and a blue devil's eye bracelet with a small silver pendant along the right edge. The vintage postcard should depict a Greek rocky island bay with clear turquoise waters and white buildings, printed with the blue words "Thirósia" and "Santorini, Greece," and include a faded stamp and postmark. The central Polaroid photo should have a thick white border, showcasing a breakfast scene on a white terrace overlooking the deep blue Aegean Sea, with a blurred background of Santorini's white buildings and blue domes. The photo should include seven breakfast elements: a red-patterned coffee cup and saucer containing black coffee, two slices of toast, a grilled banana, a boiled egg, a small glass bowl filled with yellow fruit and garnished with dark plums and mint leaves, and a small amount of cereal. Add handwritten blue Japanese text to the lower left corner of the table.{argument name="handwritten note" default="Let's go together to see sights we've never seen before."} And add a small blue heart at the end. Using soft morning light, create gentle shadows, warm white tones and ocean blue tones, and employ a shallow depth of field effect to showcase realistic paper texture, nostalgic postcard aesthetics and elegant travel diary atmosphere, presenting a high-resolution photorealistic feel, with no people in the picture, no additional text or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 在质感十足的白色灰泥桌面上，创作一张阳光明媚的地中海旅行平铺摄影作品，呈现出如梦似幻的度假回忆，地点为 {argument name="destination" default="希腊圣托里尼锡拉夏"}。画面中需精确摆放 6 个主要物品：左侧放置 1 张复古明信片，中右侧叠放 1 张大尺寸拍立得照片，底部附近放置 1 支蓝色笔尖的白色钢笔，顶部附近放置 1 个奶油色小贝壳，右上角放置 1 块带有淡蓝色条纹的折叠白色亚麻布，右边缘放置 1 条带有银色小吊坠的蓝色恶魔之眼手链。复古明信片应展示希腊岩石岛屿海湾，拥有清澈的绿松石色海水和白色建筑，印有蓝色文字“Thirósia”和“Santorini, Greece”，并带有模糊的邮票和邮戳。中央的拍立得照片应带有厚实的白色边框，展示在俯瞰深蓝色爱琴海的白色露台上的早餐场景，背景为模糊的圣托里尼白色建筑和蓝色圆顶；照片内需包含 7 个早餐元素：1 个盛有黑咖啡的红色花纹咖啡杯及杯托、2 片小吐司、1 根烤香蕉、1 个水煮蛋、1 个盛有黄色水果并点缀着深色西梅和薄荷叶的小玻璃碗，以及少许麦片。在桌面的左下角，添加手写蓝色日语文字 {argument name="handwritten note" default="まだ見ぬ景色へ、\n一緒にいこう。"}，并在末尾加上一颗蓝色小爱心。使用柔和的晨光，营造轻柔的阴影、温暖的白色调与海洋蓝色调，采用浅景深效果，展现逼真的纸张纹理、怀旧的明信片美学和优雅的旅行日记氛围，呈现高分辨率的照片写实感，画面中无人，无额外文字或水印。

templates.title: Fantasy Villainous Heiress Novel Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 奇幻恶役千金小说封面

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a richly detailed Japanese fantasy light novel cover illustration. The theme is a romantic story about a royal villainous heiress. The illustration should feature a glamorous group of characters surrounding the dramatic female protagonist against a fairytale castle backdrop. Canvas: Vertical book cover composition, 2:3 aspect ratio, exquisite anime illustration style, extremely high detail, bright jewel tones, elegant girlish fantasy atmosphere, no modern objects. Layout: A compact poster-style composition is used, with exactly nine visible characters stacked around the perimeter of the page. The female protagonist is the central figure in the lower right corner, surrounded by noble men and women against a royal court backdrop. A white castle with a towering blue spires is placed at the center of the upper background, framed by magnificent arched windows or palace arches. Add ornate gold filigree borders to all edges. Glowing blue-purple crystal shards, pink rose petals, and magical sparkles are scattered throughout the image. The main Japanese title is placed in the lower left corner towards the center, partially obscuring the characters, with a small subtitle below. Characters: Includes exactly 9 characters: 1) The central heroine, a charming black-haired noblewoman, wearing a deep emerald and black off-the-shoulder lace dress, adorned with gold chains, emerald jewelry, and jeweled hair accessories, exuding the composed air of a villainous heiress; 2) The central white-haired nobleman, wearing a black military-style coat with gold trim, chains, and brooches, possessing a serious yet romantic male lead aura; 3) The upper left red-haired armored knight, wearing crimson and silver armor, a fur cloak, and jeweled shoulders; 4) The upper right blond prince, wearing a dark blue high-necked uniform with delicate gold chains and epaulettes; 5) The left silver-haired lady, wearing dark blue noble attire, elegant and reserved; 6) The right blond princess, wearing a light blue ruffled dress with floral hair accessories; 7) The middle right black-haired nobleman, wearing a dark suit with a red tie, slightly turned to the side; 8) The lower left young black-haired nobleman, wearing a black suit with gold trim and a red tie, with sharp eyes; 9) In the lower right corner, a blond nobleman, dressed in a platinum ceremonial uniform with a red sash, has gloved hands close to his face. All characters' faces should maintain a refined anime style and be expressive. Text content: Add a large Japanese title.{argument name="headline text" default="The villainess wants to be happy in this life."} The text uses an elegant calligraphic font, with key words at the beginning and end rendered in a deep red and purple gradient, while smaller connecting words are in black. A small subheading is added below the main title, centered.{argument name="subtitle text" default="I've had enough of living a life of being condemned."} Uses exquisite black Japanese font. Decorative patterns should surround the text like a real fantasy novel cover. Visual style: Highly refined romantic anime cover art, intricate lines, glossy highlights, shimmering magic crystals, purple roses at the bottom, luxurious gold embellishments, cinematic lighting, soft sky blue and violet backgrounds, dramatic depth, and a luxurious royal fantasy atmosphere. The heroine's hair uses {argument name="main heroine hair color" default="Long glossy black"} The male lead's hair uses{argument name="central male hair color" default="silver-white"} The overall color scheme is{argument name="overall color palette" default="Royal Navy blue, violet, emerald green, gold, and ice blue"} The main objective is to make it look like a finished Japanese fantasy romance novel cover, not a character design book. Include exactly nine characters, a castle, a fancy border, plenty of crystals, lots of rose petals, and a few purple roses at the bottom. Do not add any logos, watermarks, author names, barcodes, or any additional text beyond the title and subtitle.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张细节丰富的日式奇幻轻小说封面插画，主题为皇家恶役千金浪漫故事，画面包含围绕在戏剧性中心女主角周围的华丽角色群像，以及童话城堡背景。

画布：竖版书籍封面构图，2:3 比例，精致的动漫插画风格，极高细节，明亮的宝石色调，优雅的少女奇幻氛围，无现代物品。

布局：采用紧凑的海报式构图，页面周围层叠排布正好 9 位可见角色。右下方中心人物为女主角，周围环绕着皇家宫廷背景下的贵族男女。背景上方中心放置一座带有高耸蓝色尖塔的白色城堡，由宏伟的拱形窗或宫殿拱门框住。在所有边缘添加华丽的金色花丝边框。画面中散布着发光的蓝紫色水晶碎片、粉色玫瑰花瓣和魔法闪光。将主要的日文标题放置在左下方至中心区域，部分遮挡角色，下方配有小型副标题。

角色：包含正好 9 位角色：1) 中心女主角，一位迷人的黑发贵族女性，身穿深祖母绿和黑色露肩蕾丝礼服，佩戴金链、祖母绿首饰和珠宝发饰，散发着从容的恶役千金气质；2) 中心白发贵族男性，身穿带有金色饰边、链条和胸针的黑色军装风格外套，具有严肃的浪漫男主气场；3) 左上方红发盔甲骑士，身穿深红色和银色盔甲，披着毛皮斗篷，肩部饰有珠宝；4) 右上方金发王子，身穿深蓝色高领制服，配有精致的金链和肩章；5) 左侧银发淑女，身穿深蓝色贵族服装，优雅且矜持；6) 右侧金发公主，身穿浅蓝色荷叶边礼服，配有花朵发饰；7) 中右侧黑发贵族男性，身穿深色西装配红领带，身体略微侧转；8) 左下方黑发年轻贵族男性，身穿带有金色饰边和红领带的黑色西装，眼神犀利；9) 右下方金发贵族男性，身穿带有红色绶带的白金礼仪制服，戴着手套的手靠近脸部。所有角色的面部均需保持精美的动漫风格并富有表现力。

文本内容：添加大型日文标题 {argument name="headline text" default="悪役令嬢は 今世こそ 幸せになりたい"}，采用优雅的书法字体，首尾主要词汇使用深红与紫色渐变，较小的连接词使用黑色。在标题下方居中添加小型副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="断罪される人生なんて、もうこりごりですから。"}，使用精致的黑色日文字体。装饰性花纹应像真实的奇幻小说封面一样环绕在文字周围。

视觉风格：高度精致的浪漫动漫封面艺术，复杂的线条，光泽感高光，闪烁的魔法水晶，底部的紫色玫瑰，奢华的金色装饰，电影级光影，柔和的天蓝色和紫罗兰色背景，戏剧性的深度，奢华的皇家奇幻氛围。女主角头发使用 {argument name="main heroine hair color" default="长款亮黑"}，男主角头发使用 {argument name="central male hair color" default="银白色"}，整体色调以 {argument name="overall color palette" default="皇家海军蓝、紫罗兰色、祖母绿、金色和冰蓝色"} 为主。

约束条件：使其看起来像成品日式奇幻浪漫小说封面，而非角色设定集。保留正好 9 位角色、一座城堡、一个华丽边框、大量水晶、大量玫瑰花瓣以及底部的几朵紫色玫瑰。不要添加任何标志、水印、作者姓名、条形码或标题与副标题之外的额外文字。
