templates.title: Rainbow Liquid Ripple Wallpaper

titleLocalized.zh: 虹彩液体涟漪壁纸

templates.prompt: Create an ultra-refined abstract macro wallpaper showcasing the surface of a luminous, iridescent liquid, like clear, shallow water mixed with pearlescent oil and glass. The scene should be a low-angle view overlooking shimmering, translucent waves, containing four clearly visible circular ripples: a small vortex near the upper left edge, a large, soft vortex in the lower left corner, a medium-sized vortex slightly to the right of center, and a large spiral vortex in the upper right corner.{argument name="main colors" default="Aquamarine, electric blue, lavender, violet, and a touch of pink"} The image features a soft, luminous tone, paired with bright white caustic beams, shimmering specular highlights, and refracted rainbow edges. The brightest halo should be located slightly to the left of the center, gradually fading into a deep blue shadow towards the bottom and left edge, with a purplish-blue liquid ridge on the right. This creates a glossy, crystalline, fluid, and dreamlike surface with delicate ripple textures, soft depth of field, and high dynamic range lighting. The image must not contain any text, people, objects, borders, or logos. (In a cinematic horizontal format...){argument name="aspect ratio" default="16:9"} The mobile or desktop wallpaper format rendering presents a realistic yet ethereal generative art style.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超精细的抽象微距壁纸，展示发光的虹彩液体表面，如同混合了珠光油与玻璃的清澈浅水。场景以低斜角俯瞰波光粼粼的半透明波浪，画面中需包含四个清晰可见的圆形涟漪漩涡：左上边缘附近有一个小漩涡，左下角有一个大型柔和漩涡，中心偏右处有一个中型漩涡，右上角有一个大型螺旋漩涡。使用 {argument name="main colors" default="水青色、电光蓝、薰衣草色、紫罗兰色及少许粉色"} 的发光柔和色调，搭配明亮的白色焦散光束、闪烁的镜面高光以及折射出的彩虹边缘。最亮的光晕应位于中心偏左位置，向底部和左侧边缘渐变为深蓝色阴影，右侧则为紫蓝色液体脊。使表面呈现出光泽感、结晶感、流动感和梦幻感，具备细腻的波纹质感、柔和的景深、高动态范围光影，且画面中不得包含任何文字、人物、物体、边框或 Logo。以电影级的横向 {argument name="aspect ratio" default="16:9"} 手机或桌面壁纸格式渲染，呈现出一种写实而空灵的生成式艺术风格。

templates.title: Flower Cottage Cafe Shaved Ice

titleLocalized.zh: 花卉小屋咖啡馆刨冰

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a warm and dreamy vertical illustration for a café, showcasing a high-end Japanese shaved ice dessert, in a style reminiscent of romantic flower-themed café photography. Canvas: 3:4 vertical composition, softly illuminated by golden afternoon sunlight, shallow depth of field, creamy beige and honey tones, highly detailed realistic illustration, full of a fairytale café atmosphere. Layout: A large shaved ice bowl is placed in the center of the foreground as the main subject. To the right rear, a young blonde woman in a beige lace dress holds a gold spoon and wears a daisy and pink wreath; her face is covered by a solid brown square mask. Two vintage-framed signs are stacked vertically on the left, with a handwritten card at the bottom. A white rabbit figurine or plush toy is added to the lower right of the dessert. The surrounding elements include lace fabric, daisies, small wildflowers, vines, weathered wood, and a sunlit café window. Main dessert detail: A high-end milk shaved ice served in an elegant fan-shaped glass bowl with a matching glass tray. The shaved ice is a light cream and honey gold color, glistening with syrup and topped with a spherical scoop of creamy ice cream or mousse. The dessert should contain five visible toppings: daisies, translucent honey jelly cubes, pale peach berries, mint leaves, and tiny edible petals. This creates a luxurious, cool, fluffy, sparkling, and abundant appearance. Foreground and signage elements: Include six prominent non-floral props: an elegant top café sign, a bordered item, a small paper card, a gold wax seal, a gold spoon, and a white rabbit. Include three readable sign/card text areas. Text content: On the bordered top sign, write "CAFÉ Fraise Étoilée," followed by a line of smaller Japanese katakana and the motto "Blooming with my own light." On the central item, write the seasonal limited-time menu in Japanese, including the main item name.{argument name="dessert name" default="Flower Crown Honey Milk Shaved Ice"} A well-designed subtitle, a concise ingredient list, and a price.{argument name="price" default="¥2,200 (tax included)"} Write "Blooming with my own light" on the small card at the bottom. Add a small hand-drawn heart to the item and card. Style and Atmosphere: Use antique cream borders, faded botanical borders, dried flowers, daisies, lace ribbons, rustic wood, soft bokeh, backlit blonde hair, and a nostalgic French-Japanese café aesthetic. Color palette should include ivory, champagne, soft yellow, pale peach, warm beige, soft green, and gold. Typography should be elegant and have the feel of a café menu. Customizable details: The café name should be {argument name="café name" default="CAFÉ Fraise Étoilée"} The dessert flavor theme should be{argument name="flavor theme" default="Honey milk, chamomile, vanilla, white peach, edible flowers and mint"} The overall atmosphere should be{argument name="overall mood" default="A Sunny Flower-Filled Café Fantasy"} Constraints: Do not add modern items, logos, watermarks, barcodes, plastic packaging, or additional characters. Keep the brown square block obscuring the face visible and centered on the woman's face. Maintain a sophisticated, realistic illustration style, not a flat, anime-style one.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张温馨梦幻的竖版咖啡馆广告插画，展示高级日式刨冰甜点，风格如同浪漫的花卉小屋咖啡馆摄影。

画布：3:4 竖构图，午后金色的阳光柔和照射，浅景深，奶油米色与蜂蜜色调，高度细腻的写实插画，充满童话般的咖啡馆氛围。

布局：将巨大的刨冰碗置于前景下方中心作为主体。右后方展示一位身穿米色蕾丝裙的年轻金发女性，手持金勺，头戴雏菊与粉色花环；她的面部被一个纯棕色方形遮挡块覆盖。左侧垂直叠放两个复古边框招牌，底部放置一张手写小卡片。在甜点右下方添加一个白色兔子摆件或毛绒玩具。周围环绕蕾丝布、雏菊、细小的野花、藤蔓、风化木材以及阳光明媚的咖啡馆窗户。

主要甜点细节：一份高级牛奶刨冰，盛放在精致的扇形玻璃碗中，配有配套的玻璃托盘。刨冰呈浅奶油色和蜂蜜金色，淋上糖浆显得光泽诱人，顶部装饰 1 个圆球状的奶油冰淇淋或慕斯。甜点需包含 5 种可见的配料：小雏菊、透明蜂蜜果冻块、淡桃子果肉球、薄荷叶以及细小的食用花瓣。使甜点看起来奢华、冰凉、蓬松、闪亮且丰盛。

前景与招牌元素：包含 6 个显著的非花卉道具：1 个精致的顶部咖啡馆招牌、1 个带边框的项目、1 张纸质小卡片、1 个金色火漆印章、1 把金勺和 1 只白兔。包含 3 个可读的招牌/卡片文本区域。

文本内容：在顶部带边框的招牌上，书写“CAFÉ Fraise Étoilée”，下方配一行较小的日语片假名，随后是座右铭“Blooming with my own light.”。在中间的项目上，用日语书写季节限定菜单，包含主品名 {argument name="dessert name" default="花冠はちみつのミルクかき氷"}、精致的副标题、简短的配料表以及价格 {argument name="price" default="¥2,200（税込）"}。在底部的小卡片上，书写“Blooming with my own light.”。在项目和卡片上添加一个小巧的手绘爱心。

风格与氛围：使用古董奶油色边框、褪色的植物边框、干花、雏菊、蕾丝丝带、乡村木材、柔和的焦外成像、背光金发，以及怀旧的法日式咖啡馆美学。色调应为象牙白、香槟色、柔黄色、淡桃色、暖米色、柔和的绿色和金色。排版应优雅且具有咖啡馆菜单的质感。

可自定义细节：咖啡馆名称应为 {argument name="café name" default="CAFÉ Fraise Étoilée"}；甜点风味主题应为 {argument name="flavor theme" default="蜂蜜牛奶、洋甘菊、香草、白桃、食用花卉和薄荷"}；整体氛围应为 {argument name="overall mood" default="阳光明媚的繁花小屋咖啡馆幻想"}。

约束条件：不要添加现代物品、Logo、水印、条形码、塑料包装或额外的人物。保持遮挡面部的棕色方形块可见并居中于女性面部。保持高级写实插画风格，而非扁平的动漫风格。

templates.title: Cute RPG Character Profile Card

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱风 RPG 角色资料卡

templates.prompt: Objective: Based on the original character concept, for{argument name="character name" default="ぽちいな"} Create an adorable Japanese-style game character profile card. The character is a cheerful girl with her small pet dog companion. The design style blends RPG character collectible cards with scrapbook-style character design pages. Canvas: 1:1 square composition, warm gray-white paper background, soft pink and brown ink strokes, presenting a hand-drawn scrapbook style, including stickers, washi tape borders, doodle flowers, hearts, paw prints, glitter, arrows, paperclips, and torn-edge sticky note panels. The overall aesthetic is bright, friendly, and cute fantasy game aesthetics. Main layout: Place the full-body character photo in a scrapbook style on the right-center position, with a white sticker border and pink shading. She is crouching, smiling at the camera, making a peace sign next to her face, wearing a white short-sleeved shirt embroidered with small red flowers, a white pleated skirt, white socks, and pink shoes, with light blonde short bob haircut and a pink flower hair accessory. Her pet dog is lying at her feet slightly below the center, a brown and white small hound wearing a pink harness or outfit. If necessary, the facial area can be simplified or softened, but the pose and cute atmosphere must be preserved. Title Area: Place a large hand-drawn Japanese title "POCHIINA" in the upper left corner, next to a paw print mark, and below it a pink ribbon that says "POCHIINA". Add small flowers, stars, hearts, and a detailed sketch-style rectangular title box. Data Panels and Text: Use 12 separate data panels around the main character. 1) The upper left corner is the species/origin description panel with Japanese labels, describing her as a human who uses healing magic and was born into a family that loves flowers and animals. 2) The left side is the STATUS panel, containing 7 rows of attribute data and a pink horizontal progress bar: HP 840, MP 620, Attack 420, Defense 380, Magic 760, Agility 720, Luck 890, each with a small icon. 3) The bottom panel displays a magic flower staff labeled "お花のステッキ" (Ohana no Steki), accompanied by an illustration of the staff. 4) The special attack panel is labeled "必殺技" (Bishouji), described as "Happy Flower Shine," a healing flower-based attack. 5) The bottom left corner is the partner panel, labeled "相棒：わんこ" (Aibou: Wanko), describing this pet dog. 6) A circular illustration near the bottom center shows the girl and her dog standing in a pink magical flower field. 7) A speech bubble near the character's head reads "今日も一緒にたのしくいこっ！" (Kyou mo Ichiso ni Ta no Shikui Kok!). 8) The top right corner displays a rarity card labeled "RARITY," containing 5 stars: four solid pink stars and one hollow gray star. 9) The personality panel is labeled "性" (Xìngnì), using four short sentences to describe kindness, cheerfulness, compassion, and a healing aura. 10) The likes/dislikes panel is divided into two columns: likes are marked with heart icons, and dislikes are marked with blue cloud/raindrop icons. 11) The special skills panel is labeled "得意なこと" (Delightful Things), listing four items, such as healing the wounded, cheering on others, cultivating flowers, and taking photos with a peace sign. 12) The right side is the weakness and background story area, divided into small note boxes labeled "弱分" (Weakness) and "その他・フレーバーテキスト" (Other Friend Skills), describing feelings of loneliness, being too kind, being nervous in public, always being with a dog, searching for small flowers, and gently changing the world with a smile. Bottom details: A pink-tipped introductory banner is added near the center of the bottom, which reads "一緒にいるだけで、しあわせになれるよっ！" (If we are together, we will be together!). Place five labeled attribute icons along the bottom edge: Healing, Support, Nature, Animal, and Light. Place two Polaroid-style photos in the bottom right corner, one showing the girl posing and the other showing a dog lying down, decorated with washi tape and pink flowers. Visual style: soft natural light, pink highlights, sketch-style brown outlines, delicate handwritten Japanese font, scrapbook collage, sticker borders, and a comfortable magical girl RPG data card design. Keep the screen information rich and easy to read; all panels should be evenly distributed around the central character silhouette. Constraints: Visible labels and quotes should use the specified Japanese; only "POCHIINA," "STATUS," "WEAPON," and "RARITY" should use English. Maintain 7 lines of attribute data, 5 rarity stars, 5 bottom attribute icons, 2 Polaroid photos, and 12 data panels. No additional characters may be added besides the girl and her pet dog.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：根据原创角色概念，为 {argument name="character name" default="ぽちいな"} 创建一张可爱的日系游戏角色资料卡。角色设定为一名开朗的少女及其小型宠物狗伙伴，设计风格融合了 RPG 角色收藏卡与剪贴簿式角色设定页。

画布：1:1 正方形构图，背景为温暖的灰白色纸张，采用柔和的粉色和棕色墨水笔触，呈现手绘剪贴簿风格，包含贴纸、纸胶带边框、涂鸦花朵、爱心、爪印、闪光、箭头、回形针和撕边便签面板。整体采用明亮、友好、可爱的奇幻游戏美学。

主体布局：将全身角色照片剪贴风格的人像放置在中心偏右位置，带有白色贴纸边框和粉色阴影。她正蹲着，微笑着看向镜头，在脸旁比出剪刀手，身穿绣有小红花的白色短袖衬衫、白色百褶裙、白色短袜和粉色鞋子，留着浅金色短波波头，佩戴粉色花朵发饰。她的宠物狗趴在脚下中心偏下方，是一只穿着粉色背带或服饰的棕白色小型猎犬。如果需要，可将面部区域简化或进行柔焦处理，但需保留姿势和可爱的氛围。

标题区域：左上方放置巨大的手绘日文标题「ぽちいな」，旁边带有爪印标记，下方有一条写着“POCHIINA”的粉色丝带。添加小花、星星、爱心以及细致的草图风格矩形标题框。

资料面板与文字：在主体人物周围使用 12 个独立的资料面板。1) 左上角为物种/起源说明面板，带有日文标签，描述她是一位使用治愈魔法的人类，出生于热爱花卉和动物的家庭。2) 左侧为 STATUS 面板，包含 7 行属性数据和粉色水平进度条：HP 840、MP 620、攻击 420、防御 380、魔法 760、敏捷 720、幸运 890，每项均配有小图标。3) 下方为 WEAPON 面板，展示一把魔法花朵法杖，标注为「お花のステッキ」，并配有法杖插图。4) 必杀技面板标注为「必殺技」，描述“Happy Flower Shine”，即一种治愈系花光攻击。5) 左下角为伙伴面板，标注为「相棒：わんこ」，描述这只宠物狗。6) 底部中心附近的圆形插图，展示女孩与狗站在粉色魔法花海中。7) 角色头部附近的对话气泡，内容为「今日も一緒にたのしくいこっ！」。8) 右上角为稀有度卡片，标注为“RARITY”，包含 5 颗星：四颗粉色实心星和一颗灰色空心星。9) 性格面板标注为「性格」，用四行短句描述善良、开朗、富有同情心和治愈光环。10) 喜好/厌恶面板分为两列：喜好标记为爱心图标，厌恶标记为蓝色云朵/雨滴图标。11) 特长面板标注为「得意なこと」，列出四项内容，如治愈伤者、为他人加油、培育花朵以及比着剪刀手拍照。12) 右侧为弱点与背景故事区，分为标注为「弱点」和「その他・フレーバーテキスト」的小便签框，描述孤独感、过于善良、在公共场合紧张、总是与狗在一起、寻找小花以及用微笑温柔地改变世界。

底部细节：在底部中心附近添加一条粉色笔触的引言横幅，写着「一緒にいるだけで、しあわせになれるよっ！」。沿底部边缘放置 5 个带有标签的属性图标：治愈、辅助、自然、动物和光。右下角放置 2 张宝丽来风格的小照片，一张展示女孩摆姿势，另一张展示小狗趴着，并配有胶带和粉色花朵装饰。

视觉风格：柔和的自然光，粉色高光，草图风格的棕色轮廓，精致的手写日文字体，剪贴簿拼贴，贴纸边框，舒适的魔法少女 RPG 资料卡设计。保持画面信息丰富且易读，所有面板围绕中心人物剪影平衡分布。

约束条件：可见标签和引言请使用指定的日文；仅“POCHIINA”、“STATUS”、“WEAPON”和“RARITY”使用英文。保持 7 行属性数据、5 颗稀有度星星、5 个底部属性图标、2 张宝丽来照片和 12 个资料面板。除女孩和她的一只宠物狗外，不得添加额外角色。

templates.title: Summer Rose Portrait Wallpaper

titleLocalized.zh: 夏季玫瑰人像壁纸

templates.prompt: Create a 9:16 vertical summer lifestyle photograph, shot from a low angle with a clear blue sky as the background and soft white clouds dotting the left side. (A person who keeps...){argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown long hair"} A young woman approaches the camera, wearing an oversized, semi-transparent top.{argument name="shirt color" default="White"} The shirt, with its loose collar, prominent breast pocket, and rolled-up cuffs, is made of a light, semi-transparent fabric that shimmers in the sunlight. Her face is partially obscured by a centrally located, softly pixelated blur/mosaic block in a warm skin tone. She holds a small bouquet of roses beside her face in her left hand: three roses are clearly visible, including a pale pink rose at the top, a light pink rose on the right, and a coral red rose in the center. Long green stems extend downwards to the left, and numerous green leaves shimmer in the light. The image uses bright, natural daylight, with fresh, summery colors, realistic skin and fabric textures, and a shallow yet clear depth of field, creating a desirable magazine-style atmosphere. The simple composition makes it suitable as a phone wallpaper. (Adding a small bouquet at the top center...){argument name="headline text" default="Summer"} The lettering uses a delicate, elegant white handwritten cursive font. A tiny white social media-style icon and small text are added to the center of the bottom edge.{argument name="bottom credit" default="CHAse"} Avoid including unnecessary figures, flowers, borders, or cluttered elements.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 9:16 竖版夏季时尚生活方式摄影作品，采用低角度拍摄，背景为湛蓝天空，左侧点缀着柔和的白云。一位留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色长发"} 的年轻女性靠近镜头，身穿一件超大款半透明 {argument name="shirt color" default="白色"} 衬衫，领口宽松，带有明显的胸袋和卷起的袖口，轻盈的半透明面料在阳光下闪烁光泽。她的面部被一个位于中心位置的方形柔和像素化模糊/马赛克块遮挡，色调为暖肤色。她左手举着一束小花束在脸庞旁：清晰可见 3 朵玫瑰花，包括顶部的一朵淡粉色玫瑰、右侧的一朵浅粉色玫瑰以及中心的一朵珊瑚红玫瑰，长长的绿色茎秆向左下方倾斜延伸，多片绿叶在光线下熠熠生辉。画面采用明亮的自然日光，色彩清新充满夏日感，展现真实的皮肤和织物纹理，景深浅而清晰，营造出令人向往的杂志大片氛围，构图简洁，适合作为手机壁纸。在顶部中心位置添加 {argument name="headline text" default="Summer"} 字样，使用纤细优雅的白色手写草书字体。在底部边缘中心添加一个微小的白色社交媒体风格图标及小字 {argument name="bottom credit" default="CHAse"}。避免出现多余的人物、花卉、边框或杂乱元素。

templates.title: Japanese romantic comedy manga cover

titleLocalized.zh: 日式浪漫喜剧漫画封面

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a refined cover illustration for a Japanese light novel/shoujo romance manga, featuring a straightforward yet kind-hearted boy cooking with elegant girls in a bright classroom kitchen. Canvas: Vertical book cover format, approximately 2:3 aspect ratio, full bleed illustration with a thin white inner border. Employ a high-detail anime/manga cover style, soft pastel lighting, commercial-grade glossy texture, delicate lines, and falling pink petals. Layout: Place the male protagonist in the center of the foreground, framed from above his thighs, holding cooking chopsticks in front of a frying pan. Place the silver-haired female protagonist on the right side of the foreground, slightly higher in the composition, conveying confidence and coolness. Arrange the other three girls in the background and to the left/above, creating an atmosphere of a romantic comedy ensemble. Use large vertical Japanese titles on both sides, employing a neon-like pink-blue gradient with a white halo, and accompanied by small black kana characters. Add a small circular badge in the upper left corner and an author's name area in the upper right corner. Character Details: Show 5 characters: 1 central male character with messy black hair, a white T-shirt, and a black apron, his expression calm but slightly embarrassed; 1 foreground female protagonist with long silver hair, wearing a black school uniform suit, white shirt, and black tie, hands in her pockets, her expression composed; 1 lively pink-haired girl in the upper center, wearing a white cardigan, navy blue bow tie, and plaid skirt, making a peace sign, with pink heart doodles beside her; 1 soft brown-haired girl in the upper left, wearing an off-the-shoulder beige knit top, shy and delicate; 1 pink-haired girl in the lower left, wearing a light-colored shirt, near the cooking area, creating a cute and romantic atmosphere. Facial features can be blurred or simplified appropriately, but hairstyles, poses, and clothing must remain clear. Environment: A bright sunroom with large windows in the background, overlooking a light blue sky, warm sunlight, and a spacious feel. The foreground includes a metal frying pan on the stove, cooking utensils, detailed kitchen countertops, and soft floral decorations along the lower right edge. Text content: Contains the following visible decorative text on the Japanese cover: the circular badge "Volume Edition 1" in the upper left corner; the author's text "Yuzu Malfunction Presents" in the upper right corner; the large blue vertical title "ハイスペだけど" in the upper left corner; the large pink and blue title "Insensitive Nareto" on the left君と,"; a large pink vertical title on the right "モテ様だけど爱に不器用な雳音ちゃん."; a small luminous phrase in the center "爱の"お成线解ける気がしません!"; The ribbon text at the bottom is "Insensitive man × non-useful woman's のじれキュン♡ラブコメ!!". Please ensure the Japanese text is clearly visible on the manga cover, but aesthetic layout takes precedence over font perfection. Visual Style: Romantic comedy manga cover, semi-realistic anime rendering, soft blush tones, bright rim lighting, slight blurring effect, detailed school uniforms and hair, vibrant cover composition, diagonally falling pink petals, and pink-blue light effects around the title. Customizable Elements: Cover theme is {argument name="book title theme" default="A high-quality but awkwardly romantic teen comedy"} The male lead is{argument name="male lead description" default="A straightforward, somewhat slow-witted dark-haired boy is cooking while wearing a black apron."} The female lead is{argument name="heroine description" default="A sophisticated silver-haired girl, dressed in a black school uniform suit, is popular but clumsy in love."} The author's name is{argument name="author name" default="grapefruit malfunction"} Volume number badge{argument name="volume badge" default="Volume 1"} Constraints: Must contain exactly 5 characters, exactly 1 cooking pot in the foreground, exactly 1 round badge, and exactly 1 promotional ribbon at the bottom. Do not add extra characters, logos, barcodes, English alternative titles, or realistic photos of people's faces.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张精致的日式轻小说 / 少女浪漫漫画封面插图，主题为一位直率但善良的男生在明亮的教室厨房里与优雅的女生们一起烹饪。

画布：竖版书封格式，比例约为 2:3，全出血插图，带有细白内边框。采用高细节动漫 / 漫画封面风格，柔和的粉彩光影，商业级光泽质感，细腻的线条，以及飘落的粉色花瓣。

布局：将男主角置于前景中央，从大腿以上构图，手持烹饪筷在平底锅前。将银发女主角置于前景右侧，构图上略高，表现出自信与酷劲。将另外三位女生安排在后方及左侧/上方，营造出群像浪漫喜剧的氛围。在两侧使用大型竖排日文标题，采用霓虹感的粉蓝渐变，带有白色光晕，并配以较小的黑色假名标注。左上角添加一个小圆形徽章，右上角添加作者名区域。

角色细节：展示 5 位角色：1 位中央男生，黑色乱发，白色 T 恤，黑色围裙，表情冷静略带尴尬；1 位前景女主角，长银发，黑色西装校服，白衬衫，黑色领带，手插口袋，表情沉稳；1 位活泼的桃色头发女生在上方中央，身穿白色开衫，海军蓝领结，格子裙，比出剪刀手，手边有粉色爱心涂鸦；1 位柔和棕发女生在左上方，身穿露肩米色针织衫，害羞而精致；1 位粉发女生在左下方，身穿浅色衬衫，靠近烹饪区，营造可爱的浪漫氛围。面部可适当模糊或简化，但发型、姿势和服装需保持清晰。

环境：明亮的阳光房，背景有高大的窗户，窗外是浅蓝天空，温暖的日光，空气感十足。前景包含炉灶上的金属平底锅、烹饪用具、细致的厨房台面细节，以及右下角边缘的柔和花卉装饰。

文字内容：包含以下可见的日文封面装饰性文字：左上角圆形徽章「分冊版 1」；右上角作者文字「柚子故障 presents」；左上角大型蓝色竖排标题「ハイスペだけど」；左侧大型粉蓝标题「鈍感な瀬戸君と、」；右侧大型粉色竖排标题「モテ様だけど恋に不器用な涼音ちゃん。」；中央小型发光短语「恋のお程線 解ける気がしません！」；底部丝带文字「鈍感男子×不器用女子の じれキュン♡ラブコメ!!」。请确保日文在漫画封面上清晰可见，但排版的美观度优先于字体的完美性。

视觉风格：浪漫喜剧漫画封面，半写实动漫渲染，柔和的腮红调，明亮的轮廓光，轻微的虚化效果，细致的校服和发丝，充满活力的封面构图，斜向飘落的粉色花瓣，标题周围的粉蓝光效。

可自定义元素：封面主题为 {argument name="book title theme" default="一部高规格但恋爱笨拙的少女喜剧"}；男主角为 {argument name="male lead description" default="一位直率、迟钝的黑发男生，穿着黑色围裙烹饪"}；女主角为 {argument name="heroine description" default="一位精致的银发女生，穿着黑色校服西装，受欢迎但恋爱笨拙"}；作者名为 {argument name="author name" default="柚子故障"}；卷数徽章为 {argument name="volume badge" default="分冊版 1"}。

约束条件：必须包含正好 5 位角色，前景正好 1 个烹饪锅，正好 1 个圆形徽章，以及正好 1 条底部宣传丝带。请勿添加额外角色、Logo、条形码、英文替换标题或写实的人脸照片。

templates.title: Chennai Watercolor Travel Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 金奈水彩旅行海报

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a vertical travel poster illustration, with {argument name="city name" default="Kinna"} The theme is, and the subtitle is{argument name="subtitle" default="Everyday Urban Rhythm"} The poster blends urban street life, coastal atmosphere, and South Indian temple architecture. Canvas: Vertical poster, 4:5 aspect ratio, off-white watercolor paper background, with ample blank space in the upper left. Fine ink lines are paired with transparent watercolor washes of warm beige, ochre, gray-green, soft blue-gray, black, and dark brown. Layout: The upper left features a prominent headline "Chennai" in an elegant, high-contrast serif font. Below this is the handwritten subtitle "Everyday Urban Rhythm." Below the subtitle is a short dividing line and a small typewriter-style poem: "The air is filled with the smell of sea salt. / A drip coffee in hand. / Every street has a story. / This is Chennai." Another short dividing line is added below the poem. A small handwritten note is added in the lower left corner: "Chennai / is not just / a city, / it's a feeling." Main scene: A vibrant street in Chennai stretches along the coast into the distance. To the right, a beautifully crafted Dravidian-style temple gate (gopuram) stands behind the old building, adorned with numerous small sculpted figures and soft color accents. The upper right corner is outlined by a large, leafy tree. In the distance to the left, a red and white lighthouse stands beside the seaside promenade. The roads and sidewalks should have a sunny, dusty, and slightly damp, loose watercolor feel. Street elements and precise quantities: Includes 3 motorized tricycles: a conspicuous yellow-black tricycle is driving away in the lower left foreground, followed by a smaller yellow-black tricycle, and a very small tricycle near the seaside promenade. Three curved black streetlights are included along the road, reduced in size according to perspective. Four birds are visible in the sky. A bicycle cart loaded with green coconuts is included in the central foreground, ridden by a man. A separate pile of coconuts or a cart is included near the sidewalk in the lower right corner. The right foreground features a filter coffee stand with the vendor, metal cups, a blackboard menu, hanging light bulbs, and a wooden counter labeled "FILTER COFFEE" and "STRONG & DEGREES." Four main elements are included: a green bilingual Marina Beach sign in the midground, a large Tamil sign above the building on the right, a Tamil shop sign above the coffee stand, and a dark blackboard menu next to the stand. People: A small, clearly defined group of people is scattered along the street and seaside promenade. The foreground includes a woman in a cream-colored sari with gold accents walking away on the right, a male coconut vendor pushing a bicycle cart in the center, and the coffee vendor in a light-colored shirt behind the counter. Typography: The English title, subtitle, poem, bottom notes, and coffee stand text remain legible. Tamil-style lettering is visible on the sign, but can be given a painterly and imperfect feel. Customize the beach sign text to {argument name="beach sign text" default="MARINA BEACH"} Set the customizable coffee stall label to {argument name="coffee stall label" default="FILTER COFFEE"} Visual style: Exquisite architectural travel sketches, pen and ink washes, light and airy editorial poster design, realistic perspective with loose hand-drawn edges, detailed temple and street foregrounds, minimalist sky, no photorealistic feel, no digital gloss, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张竖版旅行海报插画，以 {argument name="city name" default="金奈"} 为主题，副标题为 {argument name="subtitle" default="日常城市律动"}，融合城市街头生活、海岸气息和南印度寺庙建筑。

画布：竖版海报，4:5 比例，米白色水彩纸背景，左上方留有大量空白。精细的墨水线条，搭配暖米色、赭石色、灰绿色、柔和蓝灰色、黑色和深褐色的透明水彩晕染。

布局：左上方为醒目的大标题“Chennai”，采用优雅的高对比度衬线字体。下方紧接手写体副标题“Everyday Urban Rhythm”。在副标题下方放置一条短分割线和一首小型打字机风格的诗：“空气中弥漫着海盐味。/ 手中握着滤泡咖啡。/ 每条街道都有故事。/ 这就是金奈。”在诗句下方再加一条短分割线。左下角添加一行细小的手写备注：“Chennai / is not just / a city, / it’s a feeling.”

主体场景：一条充满活力的金奈街道，沿海滨向远处延伸。右侧，一座精美的达罗毗荼风格寺庙塔门（gopuram）在老建筑后方耸立，上面装饰着许多细小的雕塑人物和柔和的色彩点缀。右上角由一棵枝繁叶茂的大树勾勒。左侧远景处，海滨大道旁矗立着一座红白相间的灯塔。道路和人行道应呈现出阳光明媚、尘土飞扬且略带潮湿的松散水彩质感。

街头元素及精确数量：包含 3 辆机动三轮车：左下角前景中一辆显眼的黄黑色三轮车正驶离，其后方有一辆较小的黄黑色三轮车，海滨大道附近还有一辆极小的三轮车。沿路包含 3 盏弯曲的黑色路灯，随透视比例缩小。天空中可见 4 只鸟。中心前景处包含 1 辆装满青椰子的自行车推车，由一名男子骑行。右下角人行道附近包含 1 处独立的椰子堆或推车。右侧前景包含 1 个滤泡咖啡摊，配有摊主、金属杯、黑板菜单、悬挂的灯泡以及一个标有“FILTER COFFEE”和“STRONG & DEGREES”的木制柜台。包含 4 个主要项目：中景处一个绿色的双语玛丽娜海滩指示牌，右侧建筑上方一个巨大的泰米尔语招牌，咖啡摊上方一个泰米尔语商店招牌，以及摊位旁一个深色的菜单黑板。

人物：街道和海滨大道上散布着少量人群，勾勒简洁但清晰可辨。前景包括右侧一名穿着带金色装饰的奶油色纱丽的女性正走远，中心骑着自行车推车的男性椰子摊贩，以及柜台后穿着浅色衬衫的咖啡摊主。

文字处理：保持英文标题、副标题、诗句、底部备注和咖啡摊文字清晰可辨。招牌上可见泰米尔风格文字，但可以呈现出绘画感和不完美感。将可自定义的海滩指示牌文字设置为 {argument name="beach sign text" default="MARINA BEACH"}。将可自定义的咖啡摊标签设置为 {argument name="coffee stall label" default="FILTER COFFEE"}。

视觉风格：精致的建筑旅行素描，钢笔淡彩，轻盈的编辑海报设计，写实的透视但带有松散的手绘边缘，精细的寺庙和街道前景，极简的天空，无照片级真实感，无数字光泽，无水印。

templates.title: Frozen Fantasy Comic Cover

titleLocalized.zh: 冰雪奇幻漫画封面

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a dramatic, vertical cover illustration for a Japanese light novel/manga series, featuring glamorous ice and snow magic, a gothic academy atmosphere, and striking Japanese cover typography. Canvas: 3:4 vertical cover, compact and full-page composition, high-detail anime rendering, color palette of cool blue, purple, silver, and white, accented with bright pink lighting effects. Layout: The two main characters occupy the foreground. The character on the left is a silver-haired noblewoman, half-length, leaning slightly to the right, with extremely long, flowing silver-white hair adorned with jeweled floral hair accessories, and wearing a black gothic lace dress with waist details, ribbons, gemstones, and snowflake patterns. Her right hand extends towards the viewer, casting bright, crystalline ice and snow magic. The character on the right is a black-haired young noblewoman, slightly taller behind her, leaning slightly to the left, wearing a dark, ornate military academy uniform jacket with silver embroidery, over which a formal dress shirt is unbuttoned. Both main characters' faces are deliberately covered by flat, semi-transparent gray square blocks: two face-covering blocks in total, one for each foreground character's face. Background: A Gothic ice palace or academy castle under moonlight, with light shining through the windows, filling the upper center of the image, surrounded by snowflakes, stars, and frost-covered trees, with a wrought iron gate on the left. Add a silhouette of a girl in the distance near the gate, backlit and mysterious. The environment should create the atmosphere of a frozen magical world at night. Magic and Objects: Surround the characters with numerous sharp, semi-transparent ice crystal fragments, snowflakes, shimmering frost particles, and blue-white crystal refraction light. A large glowing snowflake magic circle is contained in the center of the heroine's outstretched palm. The ice crystal fragments should be dynamic, radiating diagonally across the cover. Text Content: Add 5 main sets of visible text. 1) A glowing pink and white question title in the upper left corner:{argument name="top question text" default="Is my sister acting differently than usual?"} 2) A black, ornate nameplate with a white border in the upper right corner displays the Japanese drama series tag:{argument name="episode label" default="Episode 1"} 3) The large main title at the bottom center uses a combination of blue, white, black, and bright pink light effects.{argument name="main title text" default="When I Reincarnated, My Ice-Cold Stepsister Was the Only One in Romance Mode Who Became the Strongest"} 4) Author/Original Work Statement in bold white vertical text at the bottom left corner:{argument name="author text" default="The original story begins to collapse."} 5) A small, decorative subtitle bar at the very bottom:{argument name="bottom tagline" default="~My incredibly beautiful stepsister's doting affection will destroy the world!?~"} Visual Style: High-end Japanese fantasy manga cover, highly detailed digital painting, intricate lines, glowing effects, dramatic rim lighting, snow particle effects, gorgeous typography seamlessly integrated with the artwork, high contrast, and a romantic yet suspenseful atmosphere. Constraints: Maintain the vertical cover's texture, strictly retain 2 foreground characters, 1 background silhouette, 2 gray occlusion squares covering the foreground faces, and 5 sets of main text. Do not add logos, watermarks, speech bubbles, panel borders, or additional characters.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张充满戏剧性的竖版日本轻小说/漫画封面插画，用于奇幻浪漫系列，包含华丽的冰雪魔法、哥特式学院氛围以及醒目的日文封面排版。

画布：3:4 竖版封面，构图紧凑且满版，高细节动漫渲染，色调为冷蓝、紫、银、白，并点缀亮粉色光效。

布局：两位主角占据前景。左侧角色为银发贵族少女，半身像，身体微向右倾，拥有极长的飘逸银白色长发，佩戴珠宝花卉发饰，身穿黑色哥特蕾丝裙，带有束腰细节、丝带、宝石和雪花图案。她的右手伸向观众，施展出明亮的晶莹冰雪魔法。右侧角色为黑发年轻贵族，位于她身后，略高，身体微向左倾，身穿带有银色刺绣的深色华丽军校制服外套，内搭解开扣子的正装衬衫。两位主角的面部均被平面的半透明灰色方形遮挡块刻意覆盖：共 2 个遮脸方块，每位前景角色的脸上各一个。

背景：月光下的哥特式冰之宫殿或学院城堡，窗户透出光芒，填充画面上方中心，周围环绕着雪花、繁星、霜冻树木，左侧有一扇锻铁大门。在大门附近添加 1 个远处的剪影少女，背光且充满神秘感。环境应营造出夜晚冰封魔法世界的氛围。

魔法与物体：在角色周围环绕大量锋利的半透明冰晶碎片、雪花、闪烁的霜粒以及蓝白色的水晶折射光。在女主角伸出的手掌中心包含一个巨大的发光雪花魔法阵。冰晶碎片应保持动态，呈对角线放射状覆盖封面。

文本内容：添加 5 组主要的可见文本。1) 左上角发光的粉白相间疑问标题：{argument name="top question text" default="妹がいつもと違う？"}。2) 右上角带有白色边框的黑色华丽铭牌，标注日文剧集标签：{argument name="episode label" default="第1話"}。3) 中下方的大型主标题，采用蓝、白、黑及亮粉色光效叠加：{argument name="main title text" default="転生したら、氷の義妹が俺だけ恋愛モードで最強だった件"}。4) 左下角粗体白色的竖排作者/原作声明：{argument name="author text" default="原作 崩壊、開始。"}。5) 最底部带有装饰的小型副标题条：{argument name="bottom tagline" default="〜超絶美人な義妹の溺愛が世界を壊す!?〜"}。

视觉风格：高级日本奇幻漫画封面，高精细数字绘画，复杂的线条，发光效果，戏剧性的轮廓光，冰雪粒子特效，与艺术作品融为一体的华丽排版，高对比度，浪漫悬疑氛围。

约束条件：保持竖版书封的质感，严格保留 2 位前景角色、1 个远景剪影、2 个覆盖前景面部的灰色遮挡方块，以及 5 组主要文本。请勿添加徽标、水印、对话气泡、分镜边框或额外角色。

templates.title: Forest Spring Water Tomatoes

titleLocalized.zh: 森林泉水番茄

templates.prompt: Create a realistic, cinematic image of a rustic wooden water trough in a lush, shady forest, filled with clear, cool spring water and floating 25 ripe tomatoes. A hollow bamboo pipe extends from the upper left, continuously pouring water, creating ripples, bubbles, sparkles, and tiny splashes around the tomatoes. The tomatoes vary slightly in size and ripeness, mostly a glossy red with a few orange-yellow spots, showing their green stems, some submerged and clustered on the surface. The trough is made of dark, damp, aged wood with thick side walls, and was photographed from a close-up, three-quarter-length overhead angle. It is surrounded by moss-covered rocks, green leaves, ferns, and tree roots, with a vertical, weathered wooden pillar in the background. Utilize the natural dappled sunlight filtering through the leaves, creating bright highlights on the water and tomato skins, and soft, forest-green shadows to create a humid summer atmosphere. Achieve realistic reflections, shallow depth of field, and high dynamic range. Use a Lightroom-style color grading to present rich greens and warm reds. There are no people, no words, no labels in the picture, and no other man-made objects except for bamboo tubes and wooden troughs.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实的电影感图像，场景为茂密阴凉森林中的乡村木制水槽，槽内盛满清澈冰凉的泉水，并漂浮着 25 个成熟的番茄。一个中空的竹制水管从左上方伸入，持续注入水流，在番茄周围激起涟漪、气泡、闪光和细小的水花。番茄的大小和成熟度略有不同，大多呈光泽的红色，带有少许橙黄色斑点，可见绿色果蒂，部分浸没并聚集在水面上。水槽由深色湿润的陈年木材制成，侧壁厚实，采用近距离四分之三俯视角度拍摄。周围环绕着长满青苔的岩石、绿叶、蕨类植物、树根，背景中有一根垂直的风化木柱。利用透过叶片的自然斑驳阳光，水面和番茄表皮上有明亮的高光，柔和的森林绿色阴影，营造出潮湿的夏季氛围，具备真实的反射效果、浅景深、高动态范围，采用 Lightroom 风格的调色，呈现浓郁的绿色和温暖的红色。画面中无人、无文字、无标签，除竹管和木槽外无其他人造物体。

templates.title: Business Character Gallery

titleLocalized.zh: 商务角色素材库画廊

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a widescreen, screenshot-style gallery view showcasing multiple generated variations of the same modern business illustration subject. Canvas: 16:9 widescreen image.{argument name="canvas size" default="1792x1024"} The background features a black app aesthetic, with images tiled with subtle spacing. At the top is a rounded black tooltip containing small, evenly spaced white text, beginning with a visible JSON-style code snippet:{argument name="visible prompt text" default="{\"size\": \"1792x1024\", \"prompt\": \"A modern illustration sheet displayed on a soft light grey background.\\nThe illustrations are arranged in a structured grid layout of 2 rows with 6 figures per row (12 figures total), ...\"} Layout: Sixteen rectangular thumbnails are displayed below the prompt bar, arranged in a 4x4 grid. Each tile has a soft light gray background and depicts a miniature illustration. The thumbnails are similar but not identical, like generated variations. Narrow black spacing is used between the tiles, and they feature slightly rounded corners. A small, semi-transparent circular play/arrow icon is added to the lower right corner of many tiles, making them resemble preview cards in the generated interface. Thumbnail Content: Each tile displays 12 stylized 3D business figures, arranged in two rows of six. Each character should be diverse in gender, skin color, age, and clothing, dressed in modern office attire such as dark blue suits, gray suit jackets, cyan trousers, skirts, shirts, sweaters, and business shoes. Include business props in the characters: laptops, desks, office chairs, briefcases, clipboards, cardboard boxes, easels, flip charts, whiteboards, markers, presentation projects, handshake postures, walking postures, seated office postures, and standing discussion postures. Keep each character independent, like a distinct character element, rather than a continuous scene. Visual style: Refined semi-realistic 3D illustrations, soft studio lighting, subtle shadows under each character, clean corporate presentation aesthetics, using soft colors such as dark blue, gray, white, cyan, and tan, with a few accent colors. The overall composition should look like a screenshot of an AI-generated image result page, not a single poster. Constraints: Keep the top cue bar clearly readable, but allow for truncation on the right. Use 16 gallery thumbnails, each containing 12 small images of business characters, arranged in 2 rows of 6. Do not add any logos, watermarks, extra interface panels, or irrelevant text except for the top prompt bar.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个宽屏截图风格的画廊视图，展示同一现代商务插画素材的多种生成变体。

画布：16:9 宽屏图像，{argument name="canvas size" default="1792x1024"}，带有黑色应用程序风格的背景，图像平铺之间有细小的间距。在最上方，包含一个圆角黑色提示词栏，其中包含小的白色等宽文本，并以可见的 JSON 风格代码片段开头：{argument name="visible prompt text" default="{\"size\": \"1792x1024\", \"prompt\": \"A modern illustration sheet displayed on a soft light grey background.\\nThe illustrations are arranged in a structured grid layout of 2 rows with 6 figures per row (12 figures total), ...\"}"}。

布局：在提示词栏下方展示 16 个矩形缩略图，排列成 4x4 的网格。每个平铺图都有柔和的浅灰色背景，并描绘了一个微型插画素材。缩略图相似但不完全相同，如同生成的变体。平铺图之间使用窄黑色间距，并采用微圆角设计。在许多平铺图的右下角添加一个细小的半透明圆形播放/箭头图标，使其看起来像生成界面中的预览卡片。

缩略图内容：在每个平铺图中，展示 12 个风格化的 3D 商务人物，排列为 2 行，每行 6 个。人物在性别、肤色、年龄和服装上应具有多样性，穿着现代办公服饰，如深蓝色西装、灰色西装外套、青色长裤、裙子、衬衫、毛衣和商务鞋。在人物中加入商务道具：笔记本电脑、办公桌、办公椅、公文包、剪贴板、纸箱、画架翻页挂图、白板、记号笔、演示项目、握手姿势、行走姿势、坐姿办公姿势和站立讨论姿势。保持每个形象独立，如同清晰的角色素材元素，而非连续的场景。

视觉风格：精致的半写实 3D 插画，柔和的摄影棚灯光，每个角色下方有细微的阴影，干净的企业演示美学，采用深蓝、灰、白、青、棕褐等柔和色彩，并带有少量点缀色。整体构图应看起来像 AI 图像生成结果页面的屏幕截图，而不是单张海报。

约束：保持顶部提示词栏清晰可读，但右侧可进行截断。使用 16 个画廊缩略图，每个缩略图中包含 12 个商务人物小图，排列为 2 行 6 列。除顶部提示词栏外，不要添加任何徽标、水印、额外的界面面板或无关文本。

templates.title: Mosaic-covered cafe cake portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 带马赛克的咖啡馆蛋糕人像

templates.prompt: Create a realistic vertical lifestyle photograph depicting an adult woman sitting in a cozy, warmly lit café, leaning against a small round wooden table next to a large vintage window. The subject is {argument name="character description" default="A young East Asian woman with dark, messy hair in a bun"} The shot is framed from mid-thigh upwards, showing her sitting on a wooden chair, holding a clear iced tea or coffee near her lips. Her face is deliberately obscured by a flat, square mosaic in a soft skin-toned brown, covering the entire facial area from her forehead to her chin. She is wearing {argument name="outfit" default="A mustard yellow ribbed vest, a light blue loose-fitting shirt that slipped off the shoulders, and beige high-waisted shorts."} And wearing an elegant necklace. On the table in the foreground, there are three clearly visible still life elements: a glass vase decorated with dried beige flowers and a few lavender flowers, a white plate with a strawberry cream cake topped with whipped cream and a whole strawberry, and a small fork on the plate. The interior of the café should have a dark wood tone, with the chairs and tables in the background blurred, warm chandelier lighting, and soft sunlight streaming in from the left window. Using shallow depth of field, the natural window light mixed with warm ambient light, realistic skin texture and fabric folds, with a 50mm portrait lens feel, f/1.8 bokeh effect, cinematic yet natural color gradation, high-resolution realism, no text, no watermark, no extra people, and no visible signs.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实的竖构图生活方式照片，拍摄一位成年女性坐在温馨且灯光温暖的咖啡馆里，靠着一扇大型复古窗户旁的小圆木桌前。主体为 {argument name="character description" default="一位留着深色凌乱盘发的年轻东亚女性"}，画面从大腿中部向上取景，她坐在木椅上，一只手拿着一杯靠近嘴边的透明冰茶或冰咖啡。她的面部应被一个位于中央的扁平方形马赛克块刻意遮挡，马赛克呈柔和的肤色棕色，覆盖从额头到下巴的整个面部区域。她身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="一件芥末黄罗纹背心，一件从肩部滑落的浅蓝色宽松衬衫，以及米色高腰短裤"}，并佩戴一条精致的项链。在前景的桌面上，包含 3 个清晰可见的静物元素：1 个装有干枯米色花朵和少量薰衣草装饰的玻璃花瓶，1 个白色盘子，上面放着一块带有鲜奶油和一颗完整草莓的草莓奶油蛋糕，以及 1 把放在盘子上的小叉子。咖啡馆内部应呈现深色木质色调，背景中的椅子和桌子模糊处理，带有温暖的吊灯光斑，柔和的日光从左侧窗户射入。使用浅景深，自然窗光与温暖的环境光混合，呈现真实的皮肤纹理和织物褶皱，具备 50mm 人像镜头感，f/1.8 虚化效果，电影感但自然的色彩分级，高分辨率写实，无文字，无水印，无额外人物，无可见标志。

templates.title: Anime Samurai Character Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫武士角色海报

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="character name" default="Tachibana Ukyo-chan"} Create a highly dramatic promotional poster for an anime/game character, inspired by classic samurai fighting game character profile cards. Canvas: 16:9 widescreen landscape poster, high resolution, using a white, navy blue, black, and gold ink wash aesthetic. The composition should evoke the feel of a Japanese sword-fighting game's startup screen, incorporating layered calligraphy, ink splatter, and dynamic diagonal movement. Subject: A beautiful young female samurai occupies the right half of the image, presented in a dynamic pose with her upper three-quarters of the frame in front of her. She possesses extremely long, flowing {argument name="hair color" default="Deep Navy Blue"} Her hair flows freely to the left of the poster; she wears a white kimono top with loose sleeves, paired with a dark blue hakama skirt and a blue obi. A samurai sword with ornate gold hardware and blue cord adorns her waist. Her right hand makes a delicate gesture near the hilt, and a blue beaded bracelet adorns her wrist. Her face is deliberately blurred with a soft gray rectangle centered on her face, while her hair and clothing remain sharp and defined. Background and Style: Bold black and cobalt blue brushstrokes, icy blue watercolor splatters, gold paint stripes, scattered petals, and a textured paper background. The style is that of a refined anime key visual, with clean lines, glossy hair highlights, dramatic shadows, and elegant Japanese calligraphy. A black ink border and diagonal blue brushstrokes are added near the bottom. Top Left Logo Area: A metallic fantasy game logo is added with the text "SAMURAI SPIRITS" and small Japanese katakana characters below. It is placed above black and gold brushstrokes. Left-side data area: Contains a black brushstroke label with the text "Secret Sword - Swallow Return". Below this are two lines of short, Japanese-style text. In the lower left, center area, is a large black calligraphy name "Tachibana Ukyo-chan", with a small Romanized version below it, "UYUKI TACHIBANNA". It contains a 6-line vertically arranged data list with black and gold labels and Japanese numerical values: 1) "Style" / "Self-made Style", 2) "Birthday" / "Unknown", 3) "Place of Origin" / "Tokaido", 4) "Weapon Name" / "Kogarasamaru", 5) "Favorite" / "All kinds of wagashi (Japanese sweets)", 6) "Unlucky" / "Unreasonable, Unappetizing, Insect". Dessert illustration: Near the lower left center, a small framed food illustration is created, placed on a dark lacquered plate. Includes 6 clearly visible dessert elements: a strawberry parfait, a large strawberry, a matcha dessert, a light pink mochi, a dark pink mochi, and a skewer of dumplings. Add a pink cherry blossom next to the tray. Add a black-stroke title “Today’s Praise” and yellow text “Ichigo Daifuku”, followed by smaller white text “The Best…!” and a small pink heart. Vertical quote on the right: On the far right, place vertical white Japanese text on a black stroke bar:{argument name="vertical quote" default="My beliefs don't need sweetness—but I don't dislike it."} Bottom slogan: Written in a large, vibrant Japanese calligraphy font in the bottom right corner.{argument name="bottom slogan" default="Sweetness nourishes the soul—we can become stronger for the sake of sweets!"} The design blends white and gold text, with the last sentence enlarged and rendered in gold. Blue-black brushstrokes are added behind the text for contrast. Constraints: Maintain a precise widescreen poster layout, strictly adhere to a 6-line list of information, strictly adhere to 6 dessert elements, no additional characters, no realistic style, no modern UI, no watermarks, and keep all Japanese text as legible as possible.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="橘右京酱"} 创建一张极具戏剧性的动漫游戏角色宣传海报，灵感来源于经典的武士格斗游戏角色资料卡。

画布：宽屏 16:9 横向海报，高分辨率，采用白、海军蓝、黑、金色的水墨画美学。构图应呈现出日式剑戟格斗游戏启动画面的质感，包含分层书法、墨迹飞溅和动态的对角线运动感。

主体：一位美丽的年轻女武士占据画面右半部分，以大腿以上的四分之三动态姿势呈现。她拥有极长的飘逸 {argument name="hair color" default="深海军蓝"} 秀发，向海报左侧飞扬；身着白色和服上衣，袖口宽松，搭配深蓝色袴裙和蓝色腰带。腰间佩戴一把带有华丽金色配件和蓝色缠绳的武士刀。她的右手在刀柄附近做出细腻的姿势，手腕戴着蓝色珠串手链。她的面部被刻意用一个位于脸部中心的柔和灰色矩形模糊处理，而头发和服装保持清晰锐利。

背景与风格：使用粗犷的黑色和钴蓝色笔触、冰蓝色水彩飞溅、金色油漆条纹、散落的花瓣以及纹理纸张背景。风格为精致的动漫主视觉图，线条清晰，头发高光亮泽，阴影戏剧化，并配有优雅的日文书法。在底部附近添加黑色墨水边框和对角线蓝色笔触。

左上角 Logo 区域：添加一个金属质感的奇幻游戏 Logo，文字为“SAMURAI SPIRITS”，下方附带小型日文片假名。将其置于黑色和金色的笔触之上。

左侧资料区域：包含一个黑色笔触标签，文字为“秘剣 —— 燕返し”。下方添加两行简短的日文风味文本。在左下至中心区域添加巨大的黑色书法名字“橘 右京ちゃん”，下方附带小型罗马拼音文本“UYUKI TACHIBANNA”。包含 6 行垂直排列的资料列表，配有黑金标签牌和日文数值：1) “流派” / “自成我流”，2) “誕生日” / “不明”，3) “出身地” / “東海道”，4) “武器名” / “小烏丸”，5) “好きなもの” / “和菓子・甘味全般”，6) “苦手なもの” / “不合理・不味いもの・虫”。

甜点插图：在左下中心附近，创建一个放置在深色漆盘上的小型框架美食小插图。包含 6 个清晰可见的甜点元素：1 杯草莓芭菲、1 颗大草莓、1 个抹茶甜点、1 个淡粉色麻薯、1 个深粉色麻薯以及 1 串团子。在托盘旁添加粉色樱花。添加黑色笔触标题“本日のご褒美”和黄色文本“いちご大福”，随后是较小的白色文本“最高ですわ…!”以及一颗小粉心。

右侧垂直引语：在最右侧，于黑色笔触条上放置垂直的白色日文文本：{argument name="vertical quote" default="わたくしの信念に、甘味など不要——……ですが、嫌いでは、ありません。"}

底部标语：在右下角使用巨大的充满活力的日文书法字体，书写 {argument name="bottom slogan" default="甘味は、心の栄養——甘いもののためなら、もっと強くなれます！"}，混合白色和金色文本，最后一句特别放大并使用金色。在文字后方添加蓝黑色笔触以形成对比。

约束条件：保持精确的宽屏海报布局，严格 6 行资料列表，严格 6 个甜点元素，不添加额外角色，无写实风格，无现代 UI，无水印，并尽可能保持所有日文文本清晰可辨。

templates.title: Distressed rock festival artist posters

titleLocalized.zh: 做旧风格摇滚音乐节艺人海报

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="festival title" default="ROCKFEST2026"} Create a distressed black-and-white visual poster for a rock festival artist, employing a raw, photocopied punk magazine aesthetic and a high-contrast monochrome photography style. Canvas: Vertical poster, vertical composition, approximately 3:4 aspect ratio. Full-bleed black background with heavy film grain, scratched ink texture, worn paper edges, and a thick, retro decorative white border. Layout: Place a large distressed title “Tian ROCKFEST 2026” at the top. The Japanese characters on the far left should blend with the English text using the same bold serif/woodcut font style. Place the subtitle “The Summer Camp” centered below, using a spaced serif font and separated by a thin horizontal line. Add a small, centered label below that reads “MIDDLE SLOT”. Place a black-and-white photograph in the center featuring two rock musicians: a male on the left and a female on the right, both wearing leather jackets and standing side-by-side. Both musicians' faces are deliberately obscured by two opaque gray square blocks, one for each face, with soft vertical gray gradient shadows. The hair, neck, shoulders, and lower torso should remain visible. Main details: The musician on the left has dark curly hair, wears a black motorcycle leather jacket over a black shirt with small white patterns. The musician on the right has long dark hair, wears a black leather jacket over a low-cut V-neck patterned top, and a layered necklace with small pendants. Their faces must remain covered by the blocks; eyes, nose, and mouth must not be visible. Borders and decorations: The poster is surrounded by a large, distressed, uneven rectangular double-line border. Small diamond/star decorations are added to the four corners. Vertical lightning bolt patterns are added near the musicians on either side. Small decorative dividing lines and a centered star decoration are included around the bottom text. Text content: Small line at the bottom center: “From New Jersey (ウン)”. Below is the Japanese tagline: “兄妹のツインボーカルが生み出すソリッドなROCK”. Below that is the artist name in serif font with letter spacing: “Tommy Rivers & Gina Rivers”. Below that is the genre line: “Alternative Rock! Reggae! PUNK!”. Near the bottom is a large, distressed serif capitalized artist name:{argument name="artist name" default="THE RIVERS"} Bottom footer:{argument name="event date line" default="DAY [0 / Eve of the Festival] ・ [7.24 Fri]"} Typography and Style: Use a bold, compressed, distressed serif font, a retro concert poster font, cracked ink, a rough halftone print texture, and white text on a black background. All text, except for decorative border elements, should be centered. The design should evoke the feel of a Japanese underground rock festival flyer—dramatic, deep, and worn. Constraints: Use only black, white, and gray tones. Maintain precise visual hierarchy: a large festival title, subtitle, small slot labels, a two-piece band photo with two gray face occlusion blocks, descriptive text, large artist names, and a date footer. Do not add extra people, logos, QR codes, social media icons, or modern, minimalist design elements.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="festival title" default="天ROCKFEST2026"} 创建一张做旧风格的黑白摇滚音乐节艺人视觉海报，采用粗粝的复印朋克杂志美学和高对比度单色摄影风格。

画布：竖版海报，纵向构图，比例约为 3:4。全出血黑色背景，带有浓重的胶片颗粒感、划痕墨迹纹理、磨损的纸张边缘以及厚重的复古装饰性白色边框。

布局：在最上方放置一个巨大的做旧标题“天ROCKFEST2026”，最左侧的日文字符需与英文文本采用相同的粗体板衬线/木刻字体风格进行融合。正下方居中放置副标题“The Summer Camp”，使用带有字间距的衬线字体，并由一条细水平线分隔。下方添加一个居中的小型标签，文字为“MIDDLE SLOT”。中心区域放置一张黑白照片，包含 2 位摇滚乐手：左侧为男性形象，右侧为女性形象，两人身穿皮夹克并肩站立。两人的面部均被 2 个不透明的灰色方形遮挡块刻意遮盖，每个面部各一个，并带有柔和的垂直灰色渐变阴影。人物的头发、颈部、肩部及躯干以下部分应保持可见。

主体细节：左侧乐手留着深色卷发，身穿黑色机车皮夹克，内搭黑色衬衫，上面有微小的白色图案。右侧乐手留着深色长发，身穿黑色皮夹克，内搭低领 V 领花纹上衣，佩戴带有小吊坠的叠层项链。面部需保持被遮挡块覆盖；不得显示眼睛、鼻子或嘴巴。

边框与装饰：海报周围使用 1 个做旧且不平整的大型矩形双线边框。在 4 个角添加小型菱形/星形装饰。在乐手左右两侧附近添加垂直闪电图案。在底部文本周围包含小型装饰性分隔线和居中的星形装饰。

文本内容：中下部小字行：“From New Jersey (ウン)”。下方为日文标语：“兄妹のツインボーカルが生み出すソリッドなROCK”。下方为带有字间距的衬线字体艺人名：“Tommy Rivers & Gina Rivers”。下方为流派行：“Alternative Rock! Reggae! PUNK!”。底部附近放置巨大的做旧衬线大写艺人名：{argument name="artist name" default="THE RIVERS"}。底部页脚行：{argument name="event date line" default="DAY [0 / 前夜祭] ・ [7.24 Fri]"}。

排版与风格：使用粗体压缩的做旧衬线字体、复古演唱会海报字体、裂纹墨迹、粗糙的半色调印刷纹理，以及黑色背景上的白色字体。除装饰性边框元素外，所有文本均需居中。设计应呈现出日式地下摇滚音乐节传单的质感，戏剧化、深沉且具有磨损感。

约束条件：仅使用黑色、白色和灰色调。保留精确的视觉层级：巨大的音乐节标题、副标题、小型槽位标签、带有 2 个灰色面部遮挡块的 2 人乐队照片、描述性文本、巨大的艺人名称、日期页脚。请勿添加额外的人物、Logo、二维码、社交媒体图标或现代简洁的设计元素。

templates.title: Anime-style censorship stickers

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫风审查遮挡贴纸

templates.prompt: Create a 1:1 square anime-style sticker illustration with a pure white background. On the left, draw a cute chibi-style anime girl's half-body portrait with very long, flowing hair.{argument name="hair color" default="pale ice blue"} Her hair, with a small tuft of hair on top, is outlined in soft black sketch style with glossy highlights. She wears a white short-sleeved shirt paired with a light pink skirt or apron. Her face is deliberately obscured by a large, opaque square censorship block in the center, a gradient from light gray to blue, covering most of her head and upper body. Three bright red manga-style accent lines are added to the upper left of her head. Large, bubble-shaped Japanese sticker text is placed on the right, in a playful vertical layout with bold, dark blue outlines and soft highlights: there are three main text sets, each in cyan {argument name="top text" default="てみ"} pink{argument name="middle text" default="そその"} And large pink characters stacked vertically at the bottom{argument name="bottom text" default="メイド"} It includes two small orange plus signs, one near the upper right corner of the cyan text and the other near the lower right corner of the bottom text. A small brown oval decoration is added to the pink text below. The overall composition is bright, messy and cute, hand-drawn, and slightly imperfect, resembling a low-quality AI-generated anime sticker with bold lines, soft colors, and no unnecessary background details.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 1:1 正方形的动漫风格贴纸插画，背景为纯白色。左侧绘制一位可爱的 Q 版动漫少女半身像，拥有非常长的飘逸 {argument name="hair color" default="淡冰蓝色"} 头发，头顶有一撮小呆毛，采用柔和的黑色素描轮廓线，带有光泽高光，身穿白色短袖衬衫，搭配淡粉色裙子或围裙。她的面部被一个位于中心的大型不透明方形审查遮挡块刻意遮住，遮挡块呈浅灰到蓝色的渐变色，覆盖了大部分头部和上半身。在头部左上方添加三道亮红色的漫画强调线。右侧放置大型气泡状的日文贴纸文字，采用垂直的俏皮排版，带有粗深蓝色轮廓和柔和高光：共 3 组主要文字，分别为青色的 {argument name="top text" default="てみ"}，粉色的 {argument name="middle text" default="そその"}，以及底部垂直堆叠的大号粉色字符 {argument name="bottom text" default="メイド"}。包含 2 个小橙色加号，一个位于青色文字的右上角附近，另一个位于底部文字的右下角附近。在下方的粉色字符上添加一个小棕色椭圆装饰。保持构图明亮、凌乱可爱、手绘感、略显不完美，呈现出低质量 AI 生成动漫贴纸的效果，线条粗犷，色彩柔和，且不包含多余的背景细节。

templates.title: Cute Watercolor Kitten

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱水彩小猫

templates.prompt: Create a cute, centered illustration featuring a fluffy, chubby kitten against a pure white background, using a soft, hand-painted watercolor and colored pencil style. The kitten possesses {argument name="fur color" default="Warm light beige and cream"} The cat has beige patches on its head, outer cheeks, and sides, and a fluffy curled tail on its right side. Its face and belly are primarily cream-colored. It has oversized triangular ears with pale pink inner ears, small black oval eyes, a small black smiling mouth, three short whisker lines on each side, and soft pink blush on its cheeks. Its body should be rounded and full, like a crouching plush toy, facing forward. It has two small, curved front paws on its belly and two round feet at the bottom, each with four clearly visible pink paw pads. Use rough, charcoal-style dark gray outlines with loose brushstrokes for the fur, complemented by translucent watercolor shading and soft pastel colors. Keep the composition simple, without text, props, or background scenery, and leave ample white space around the kitten.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张居中的可爱插画，主体为一只毛茸茸、胖乎乎的小猫，背景为纯白色，采用柔和的手绘水彩和彩色铅笔风格。小猫拥有 {argument name="fur color" default="暖浅米色和奶油色"} 的毛发，头顶、外侧脸颊、身体两侧有米色斑块，右侧有一条毛茸茸的卷尾，脸部和腹部主要为奶油色。给它加上超大的三角形耳朵，内耳为淡粉色，配有小小的黑色椭圆形眼睛、小巧的黑色微笑猫嘴，两侧各有三条短胡须线，双颊带有柔和的粉色腮红。身体应圆润饱满，像蹲坐的毛绒玩具，正面朝向，腹部有两只弯曲的小前爪，底部有两只圆圆的脚，每只脚清晰可见 4 个粉色肉垫。使用粗糙的炭笔风格深灰色轮廓线，边缘带有松散的毛发笔触，辅以半透明的水彩阴影和柔和的粉彩配色。保持构图简洁，无文字、无道具、无背景景观，并在小猫周围留出充足的留白。

templates.title: Sorcery Magazine Anime Cover

titleLocalized.zh: Sorcery Magazine 动漫封面

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a cinematic, high-quality cover for a Japanese fantasy anime magazine, inspired by high-fashion/editorial photography, featuring a protagonist from a magical universe.{argument name="character name" default="Zenon Maki"} Canvas: Wide-format landscape magazine cover, 16:9 aspect ratio, deep blue nighttime tone, glossy print texture, high-contrast moonlight rim lighting, shallow depth of field. Main image: A three-quarter close-up portrait of a young woman wearing a deep navy blue wizard-style high-collared uniform with a gold spiral-button brooch. She has a long, dark blue high ponytail with stray strands framing her face, dramatically outlined by a bluish-green backlight. Her right hand is elegantly raised near her neck. A large square blur/placeholder is placed in the center of her face, obscuring her eyes, nose, and mouth, with a soft gray-to-warm brown gradient. The background is a misty forest or shrine garden at night, with a blue haze and soft blurring effect, and faint purple flowers in the distance on the right. Typography: Designed as a full magazine cover, using an elegant gold, white, and light blue serif font. The portrait serves as the background image, with text arranged around it, and no text covering the central face placeholder. Visible text elements: Contains 12 individual text/graphic elements: 1) Small Japanese label "Special Edition" in the upper left corner, 2) Main title on the left "Master Craftsmen of the Curse World" (large gold font), 3) Romanized subtitle "JUJUTSUKAISEN NO MEIJIN", 4) Special section on the left titled "Special Phrase" with Japanese introduction, 5) Special section on the left titled "Mission Report" with Japanese text, 6) Circular badge in the lower left corner with Japanese promotional poster text, 7) Barcode block in the lower left corner with tiny price text, 8) Masthead "Sorcery MAGAZINE" in the upper right corner with a small Japanese slogan above, 9) Release information block on the right with "Photography by Jujutsu Vision", "2024 AUTUMN", "vol.18" and price text, 10) The right-hand circular badge bears the number "12P" and surrounding it with Japanese text. 11) The name block in the lower right corner reads "M Meijin," the Japanese name "禪院真希," and "ZENON MAKI." 12) The large title in the lower right corner reads "その眼差しの奥にあるもの." in Japanese, accompanied by the English subtitle "Behind those eyes lies the true strength." Typography and Style: The masthead should use a refined Didot/Bodoni-style serif font with large gold lettering and fine letter spacing. The Japanese titles should use an elegant Mincho-style serif font. Smaller typographical elements should appear realistic and remain secondary, like a genuine magazine cover summary. Add barcodes and printing details to enhance realism. Constraints: Do not add additional characters. Only retain one main character. Faces must be completely obscured by square, blurred placeholders. Maintain a luxurious deep blue and gold editorial atmosphere. No watermarks, and no other logos other than fictitious magazine brands.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张电影质感的日本奇幻动漫杂志封面，灵感源自高端时尚/编辑摄影风格，主角为来自魔法主题宇宙的 {argument name="character name" default="Zenon Maki"}。

画布：宽幅横向杂志封面，16:9 比例，深蓝色夜色调，光面印刷质感，高对比度月光轮廓光，浅景深。

主体图像：一位年轻女性的四分之三近景肖像，身穿深海军蓝魔法师风格高领制服，配有金色螺旋纽扣胸针。她留着长长的青黑色高马尾，脸颊两侧有散落的发丝，戏剧性的青色背光勾勒出头发轮廓。她的右手优雅地抬起靠近颈部。在面部中心放置一个大的方形模糊/占位符，遮住眼睛、鼻子和嘴巴，并带有柔和的灰到暖棕色渐变。背景是夜晚雾气缭绕的森林或神社花园，伴有蓝色薄雾、柔和的虚化效果，右侧远处有淡淡的紫色花朵。

排版：设计为完整的杂志封面，采用优雅的金色、白色和淡蓝色衬线字体。以肖像作为背景图，文字环绕四周排列，且没有任何文字覆盖中心的面部占位符。

可见文字元素：包含 12 个独立的文字/图形元素：1) 左上角的小型日文标签「特別編集」，2) 左侧主标题「呪術界の名工」（大号金色字体），3) 罗马拼音副标题“JUJUTSUKAISEN NO MEIJIN”，4) 左侧以“Special Phrase”为标题的专题块，包含日文引言，5) 左侧以“Mission Report”为标题的专题块，包含日文文本，6) 左下角的圆形徽章，带有日文赠品海报文字，7) 左下角的条形码块，带有微小的价格文字，8) 右上角的刊头“Sorcery MAGAZINE”，上方带有小号日文标语，9) 右侧发行信息块，包含“Photography by Jujutsu Vision”、“2024 AUTUMN”、“vol.18”及价格文字，10) 右侧圆形徽章，写有“12P”及周围的日文环绕文字，11) 右下角的姓名块，写有“M Meijin”、日文名「禪院真希」以及“ZENON MAKI”，12) 右下角的大标题，日文为「その眼差しの奥にあるもの。」，并配有英文副标题“Behind those eyes lies the true strength.”

排版与风格：刊头应使用精致的 Didot/Bodoni 类衬线字体，大号金色字母，字间距细微。日文标题应采用优雅的明朝体衬线风格。小字排版需看起来真实且保持次要地位，如同真实的杂志封面摘要。添加条形码和印刷制作细节以增加真实感。

约束条件：不要添加额外人物。仅保留一名主角。面部必须完全被方形模糊占位符遮挡。保持奢华的深蓝色与金色编辑氛围。无水印，除了虚构的杂志品牌外，不得包含其他标志。

templates.title: Waterfront Museum Construction Project

titleLocalized.zh: 滨水博物馆建筑项目

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a vertical architectural showcase project to display a building named {argument name="project title" default="Shaped by the Water's Light"} The concept for a waterfront museum showcases how sunlight reflected from the river shapes the building's form, gallery spaces, and landscape. Canvas: Vertical 2:3. This architectural competition entry uses soft warm gray and blue tones, combining realistic renderings with technical analysis diagrams. A delicate serif font is used to create a tranquil museum atmosphere at dusk. Main rendering: The top shows a long, low-rise museum extending horizontally along the water. The building features an undulating green roof with arched skylights, below which are warmly lit glass gallery walls. The foreground is the river, its surface like a mirror; in the distance, a hazy city skyline, tree-lined walkways, and a bridge visible in the distance to the right. Small figures are added as they walk along the dock and enter the museum. Subtle white lines from the analysis diagrams extend in an arc from the luminous sun point to the roof, the water, and the reflected light patterns on the river. Top right text block: Include a subtitle "Shaped by the Water's Light" with a short, poetic paragraph explaining that the museum's form originates from the reflected light on the water's surface, the arched roof captures the light, and the gallery spaces aim to achieve a dialogue between water, reflection, landscape, and tranquil light and shadow. Central sectional perspective: Below the main image, include a long sectional view running horizontally through the museum, precisely showing eight labeled spaces from left to right: 1) Entrance Plaza, 2) Water Courtyard, 3) Overhead Light Gallery, 4) Long Gallery, 5) Intimate Gallery, 6) Media Room, 7) Viewing Lounge, 8) Sculpture Garden. Each label should be accompanied by a brief descriptive description and a small circular thumbnail. Showcase the warm interior galleries, visitors, exhibition walls, tree-lined courtyards, water channels, structural columns, arched roof layers, skylights, and light reflected from the water and entering the interior. Technical Analysis Diagrams: Below the section views, three technical analysis diagrams are included: a "Reflected Light Analysis Diagram" showing the distribution of sunlight, water surface, dashed reflected beams, direct light, reflected light, and daylight; a "Roof Construction" detail showing the layered arched roof components, including numbered leader lines indicating green roof vegetation, planting soil, protective layer, waterproof membrane, insulation layer, arched CLT deck, laminated timber ribs, skylight frames, and concealed gutters; and a "Water Management" detail using blue arrows to show rainwater flow, collection channels, filtered planting ponds, reservoirs, and overflow into water basins. Floor Plan: Below the analysis diagrams, a wide-format site plan is added, providing an overview of the museum's long, narrow footprint extending along the riverbank. It includes eight numbered functional points corresponding to the section view labels, public pathways, the waterfront, section lines, contour-like river lines, trees, roads, terraces, boats, and a scale. A light beige drawing paper tone is used, paired with blue-gray water surfaces and fine black architectural lines. Bottom Rendering: Two large interior perspective renderings are placed side-by-side along the bottom edge. Left: A reflective gallery lobby with shimmering patterns on the floor and ceiling, depicting visitors, artwork, and a water garden with trees. Right: A viewing lounge or café with warm wood ceilings, where people sit at tables by floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the river. Visual Style: By{argument name="design studio" default="a competition architecture studio"} This contemporary architectural visualization is elegant yet subtly traditional, featuring warm wood interiors, stone terraces, glass curtain walls, soft sunlight, detailed landscaping, realistic reflections, an atmospheric haze, precise analytical overlays, and a museum project layout. Constraints: Maintain a dense yet easily readable information density; use the specified precise quantities: 8 annotation spaces, 8 circular thumbnails, 3 technical analysis diagrams, 8 floor plan markers, and 2 bottom renderings. Use only English text in a slim, professional font; no watermarks, no logos, and no additional panels.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个竖版建筑展示项目，用于展示名为 {argument name="project title" default="Shaped by the Water's Light"} 的滨水博物馆概念，体现河流反射的日光如何塑造建筑形态、画廊空间及景观。

画布：竖版 2:3 建筑竞赛项目，采用柔和的暖灰色与蓝色调，将写实效果图与技术分析图相结合，使用纤细的衬线字体，营造黄昏时分宁静的博物馆氛围。

主效果图：顶部展示一座沿水面水平延伸的长条形低矮博物馆。建筑拥有起伏的绿色屋顶，设有弧形天窗开口，下方是散发暖光的玻璃画廊墙面。前景为河流，水面如镜；远处是朦胧的城市天际线，步道旁种满树木，右侧远方可见一座桥梁。添加沿码头行走并进入博物馆的小型人物配景。加入微妙的白色分析图线条，从发光的太阳点弧形延伸至屋顶、水面以及河面上的反射光图案。

右上角文本块：设置一个小标题“Shaped by the Water's Light”，并配以简短的诗意段落，解释博物馆的形态源于水面的反射光，弧形屋顶捕捉光线，画廊空间旨在实现水、反射、景观与静谧光影之间的对话。

中部剖透视图：在主图下方，包含一张横向贯穿博物馆的长剖面图，从左至右精确展示 8 个标注空间：1) 入口广场，2) 水庭，3) 顶光画廊，4) 长画廊，5) 亲密画廊，6) 媒体室，7) 观景休息室，8) 雕塑花园。每个标签下方应配有简短的描述性说明及一个小圆形缩略图。展示温暖的室内画廊、参观者、展示墙、树木庭院、水渠、结构柱、弧形屋顶层、天窗以及从水面反射并进入室内的光线。

技术分析图带：在剖面图下方，包含 3 张技术分析图：一张“反射光分析图”，展示太阳、水面、虚线反射光束、直射光、反射光及日光分布；一张“屋顶构造”详图，展示分层弧形屋顶组件，包含带编号的引线，标注绿色屋顶植被、种植土、保护层、防水膜、保温层、弧形 CLT 甲板、层压木肋、天窗框架及隐蔽式天沟；以及一张“水管理”详图，用蓝色箭头展示雨水流向、收集渠、过滤种植池、蓄水池及溢流至水盆的过程。

平面图：在分析图下方添加一张宽幅总平面图，俯瞰展示沿河岸延伸的博物馆长条形占地。包含与剖面图标签对应的 8 个编号功能点、公共路径、水岸线、剖切线、等高线般的河流线条、树木、道路、露台、小船及比例尺。使用浅米色绘图纸色调，搭配蓝灰色水面及精细的黑色建筑线条。

底部效果图：在底部边缘并排放置 2 张大型室内透视效果图。左侧：一个反射型画廊大厅，地面和天花板上有波光粼粼的图案、参观者、艺术品以及带树木的水庭。右侧：一个拥有温暖木质天花板的观景休息室或咖啡厅，人们坐在落地玻璃窗旁的桌边俯瞰河流。

视觉风格：由 {argument name="design studio" default="a competition architecture studio"} 创作的当代建筑可视化作品，风格优雅且略带传统感，采用温暖的木质内饰、石材露台、玻璃幕墙、柔和日光、详尽的配景、逼真的反射效果、大气朦胧感、精确的分析图叠加以及博物馆项目布局。

约束条件：保持项目信息密集但易于阅读；使用指定的精确数量：8 个标注空间、8 个圆形缩略图、3 张技术分析图、8 个平面图标记及 2 张底部效果图。仅使用英文文本，采用纤细的专业字体，无水印，无 Logo，无额外面板。

templates.title: Taking a selfie with feet in a hotel room

titleLocalized.zh: 酒店房间内用脚自拍

templates.prompt: Create a realistic wide-angle smartphone photograph taken inside a modern high-rise hotel room, from a ground-level perspective, next to a person lying on a patterned carpet. The person is wearing {argument name="outfit color" default="off white"} A person wearing long-sleeved loungewear and matching trousers sits horizontally across the frame, their head resting on a white pillow on the right. Their face is obscured by a solid rectangle of natural skin tone. A bare foot protrudes in the upper left foreground, a black smartphone clutched between the toes, as if attempting a foot selfie; the phone has a glossy black casing, with multiple rear camera lenses pointed directly at the viewer. The other leg extends along the ground. The scene should include: a visible raised foot, a black phone, a pillow, a bed on the left with messy white sheets, a gray lounge chair by the window, and a large floor-to-ceiling window offering a view of the bright skyline of high-rise apartments. The warm sunlight streaming through the window should cast strong geometric shadows on the carpet. The perspective should evoke an awkward and experimental feel, like a failed selfie taken from the ground, with slight wide-angle distortion, natural indoor lighting, realistic textures, and no added text or watermarks. The scene is set as {argument name="room setting" default="Luxury hotel bedroom"} The phone's appearance is{argument name="phone appearance" default="Black triple-camera smartphone"} The view outside the window is{argument name="window view" default="Dense modern city skyline"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实的广角智能手机照片，场景位于现代高层酒店房间内，从躺在花纹地毯上的人身旁进行地面视角拍摄。此人身穿 {argument name="outfit color" default="米白色"} 长袖家居服和配套长裤，身体水平横跨画面，头部枕在右侧的白色枕头上。其面部被自然肤色的实心矩形模糊处理遮挡。一只赤脚在左上方前景处突出，脚趾夹着一部黑色智能手机，仿佛正在尝试用脚自拍；手机带有光面黑色外壳，多个后置摄像头镜头正对着观众。另一条腿沿地面伸展。画面中需包含：一只可见的抬起的脚、一部黑色手机、一个枕头、左侧一张铺着凌乱白色床品的床、窗边一把灰色休闲椅，以及巨大的落地窗，窗外展示着明亮的城市高层公寓天际线。利用透过窗户射入的暖阳，在地毯上投下强烈的几何阴影。视角应呈现出一种尴尬且实验性的感觉，如同从地面拍摄的失败自拍，带有轻微的广角畸变、自然的室内光线、真实的纹理，且无任何添加文字或水印。场景设定为 {argument name="room setting" default="豪华酒店卧室"}，手机外观为 {argument name="phone appearance" default="黑色三摄智能手机"}，窗外景观为 {argument name="window view" default="密集的现代城市天际线"}。

templates.title: Dark Eastern fantasy style cross halberd

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑东方奇幻风格交叉戟

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed concept poster for a dark Eastern fantasy weapon. The main subject is two fully visible ancient Chinese long-handled axes or halberds, arranged in an X-shaped cross configuration, fully presented from blade tip to hilt end, centered and symmetrical, resembling a collector's item weapon design. The two weapons are contrasting: the left is white/silver, and the right is black/dark steel. Each weapon features a long and ornate hilt, dragon scale metal engravings, a ferocious dragon head joint near the blade, shimmering ruby-like eyes, and a large, crescent-shaped axe blade that curves outward at the top; the left blade is a bright polished silver with icy white highlights and intricate engravings, while the right blade is blackened steel with serrated, demonic edges, deep blue-gray highlights, and luminous deep red veining. The crossed hilts converge at the bottom center, forming a dramatic X shape, with a sharp, spear-like hilt end at the bottom. Employing a sophisticated dark fantasy + Chinese ink painting + metal sculpting concept art style, the design boasts exquisite detail, a cinematic feel, sharp lines, and a strong, symmetrical atmosphere. Background: A cool gray matte mist texture. Behind the weapon is a large circular black ink rune or magic circle with concentric circles of bold brushstrokes and splashing ink effects. Spreading black plum blossom branches are added to the lower sides and behind the weapon, accompanied by numerous deep red plum blossoms and scattered red petals floating in the scene. The lighting is soft yet dramatic, featuring metallic outline lighting, subtle glows from red accents, volumetric fog, high contrast, and no figures, text, or watermarks. Customizable elements:{argument name="weapon type" default="Ancient Chinese Dragon Halberd"} ,{argument name="left weapon color" default="silver"} ,{argument name="right weapon color" default="Black steel color with red veins"} ,{argument name="background symbol" default="Large circular ink runes"} ,{argument name="flower accent" default="Deep red plum blossoms"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高细节的暗黑东方奇幻武器概念海报，画面主体为两把完全可见的古代中国长柄斧或戟类武器，呈 X 型交叉构图，从刃尖到柄尾完整呈现，居中且对称，如同收藏级的门派宝物武器设计图。两把武器形成对比：左侧为白色/银色，右侧为黑色/暗钢色。每把武器均配有长而华丽的柄身、龙鳞金属雕刻、刃部附近有狰狞的龙头衔接处、闪烁的红宝石般眼睛，以及顶部向外弯曲的巨大半月形斧刃；左侧刃部为明亮的抛光银色，带有冰白高光和复杂的雕刻纹饰，右侧刃部为黑化钢材，带有锯齿状的恶魔边缘、深蓝灰色高光以及发光的深红色脉络纹理。交叉的柄身在下方中心汇合，形成戏剧性的 X 型，底部配有尖锐的矛状柄尾。采用高级暗黑奇幻 + 中国水墨 + 金属雕刻概念艺术风格，极致细节，电影质感，锐利，氛围感强且对称。背景：冷灰色哑光雾气纹理，武器后方有一个巨大的圆形黑色水墨符文或魔法阵，带有同心圆粗笔触环和飞溅的水墨效果。在下方两侧及武器后方添加蔓延的黑色梅花枝，伴有许多深红色梅花和散落的红色花瓣飘浮在场景中。光影柔和而富有戏剧性，带有金属轮廓光、红色装饰的微光、体积雾，高对比度，无人物，无文字，无水印。可自定义元素：{argument name="weapon type" default="古代中国龙戟"}, {argument name="left weapon color" default="白银色"}, {argument name="right weapon color" default="带红脉的黑钢色"}, {argument name="background symbol" default="大型圆形水墨符文"}, {argument name="flower accent" default="深红色梅花"}。

templates.title: Fantasy Auto Chess Game UI

titleLocalized.zh: 奇幻自走棋游戏 UI

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a sophisticated 2D fantasy auto chess gameplay model for {argument name="game title or mode" default="3-2 rounds"} The game features an isometric top-down perspective, showcasing a stone-paved battle arena, UI overlays, characters, shop cards, traits, and player leaderboards. The canvas is a 16:9 widescreen screenshot, 1152×768 style composition, with clear hand-drawn fantasy game art, high readability, saturated colors, soft ambient lighting, and an interface design inspired by League of Legends/Teamfight Tactics. Layout: At the center is a square stone battle grid situated on a floating forest platform. The arena features worn beige tiles, moss-covered edges, stairs and stone railings, evergreen trees, cliffs, water on the right edge, a purple banner, a glowing blue crystal on the left, and four burning braziers placed near the corners of the arena. At the top center, a dark, ornate HUD bar displays "3-2," small trait/item icons, a gold counter "26," and an evergreen progress bar below. In the upper right corner, three circular menu buttons with icons are added: a helmet, a book, and a gear. Combat Units: Displays 11 visible characters on the item: 5 enemy units with red health bars in the upper half, and 6 friendly units with green health bars and yellow stars in the lower half. Enemy Units: 1 Skeleton Swordsman, 1 Giant Horned Orc Warrior wielding an axe, 1 Purple Mage wielding a glowing spell, 1 Small Shadow Assassin wielding an axe, and 1 Fully Armored Skeleton Warrior. Friendly Units: 1 Blue-Brown Knight wielding a sword and shield, 1 Green Elf Archer/Swordsman, 1 Blue Armored Mage or Knight wielding a staff, 1 Blonde Priest wielding a golden staff, 1 Giant Horned Tank Warrior wielding a shield, and 1 Small Blue Gnome Engineer/Warrior. Adds a standing substitute character to the bottom left edge of the item. Left-side Trait Panel: Creates a vertical synergy list with 6 rows, each with a bronze/dark icon, class name, current count, and threshold. The visible French text should be retained: “Guerrier” (4, 2/4/6); “Mage” (3, 3/6/9); “Assassin” (2, 2/4/6); “Gardien” (2, 2/4/6); “Elfe” (1/2); “Nécromancien” (1/2). Right-side leaderboard: Add a vertical player list containing 8 players, each with a dark horizontal nameplate, a circular portrait, and health points on the right. Use the following names and values: “Lunaire 100”, “Ragnar 89”, “Akira 78”, “Zorvath 64”, “Nyméria 56”, “Scarn 42”, “Yuki 34”, “Kaldrin 21”. Use a variety of colorful fantasy portraits: purple mage orb, blue creature, crimson portrait, green orc, pink-haired character, cyan creature, orange-haired character, blue-masked character. Bottom shop and controls: Create a wide shop UI panel at the bottom. The left side displays a level box showing "NIV. 6" with experience points of "12/36," accompanied by a small cyan progress bar. Below are two control buttons: "Acheter XP" (costs "4" gold, with a blue double-headed upward arrow icon) and "Actualiser" (costs "2" gold, with a circular refresh arrow). The center displays five purchasable hero cards, including portrait art, class/trait icons, French names and traits, and gold costs: "Chevalier"/"Guerrier" costs 1; "Archer sylvestre"/"Elfe" costs 2; "Mage de givre"/"Mage" costs 3; "Assassin des ombres"/"Assassin" costs 2; and "Clerc lumineux"/"Gardien" costs 1. In the bottom right corner, there is a large button with a fancy gold border, labeled "Fin du tour," costing "5" gold. Visual Style: Hand-drawn fantasy game UI, clean beveled angles, deep cyan and bronze interface borders, easy-to-read small text, glowing magical effects, warm firelight, cyan highlights, and a compact mobile/PC strategy game presentation. Keep models as single in-game screenshots, not posters or concept art. Avoid photorealistic rendering, unnecessary panels, watermarks, and do not add more than the specified number of units, shop cards, attribute rows, or players.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个精致的 2D 奇幻自走棋游戏玩法模型，用于 {argument name="game title or mode" default="3-2 回合"}，采用等距俯视视角，包含石砖战斗竞技场、UI 覆盖层、角色、商店卡牌、特性和玩家排行榜。

画布：16:9 宽屏游戏截图，1152×768 风格构图，清晰的手绘奇幻游戏艺术，具有高可读性、饱和的色彩、柔和的环境光以及受《英雄联盟》/《云顶之弈》启发的界面设计。

布局：中心是一个位于浮空森林平台上的方形石制战斗网格。竞技场拥有磨损的米色地砖、长满苔藓的边缘、楼梯和石栏杆、常青树、悬崖、右侧边缘的水域、紫色旗帜、左侧发光的蓝色水晶，以及放置在竞技场角落附近的四个燃烧火盆。在顶部中心，放置一个深色华丽的 HUD 条，显示“3-2”、小型特性/物品图标、金币计数“26”以及下方的一条长青色进度条。在右上角，添加三个带有图标的圆形菜单按钮：头盔、书本和齿轮。

战斗单位：在项目上显示 11 个可见角色：上半部分有 5 个带有红色血条的敌方单位，下半部分有 6 个带有绿色血条和黄色星级的友方单位。敌方单位：1 个骷髅剑士、1 个手持斧头的巨大长角兽人战士、1 个手持发光魔法的紫色法师、1 个手持斧头的小型暗影刺客，以及 1 个全副武装的骷髅战士。友方单位：1 个手持剑盾的蓝棕色骑士、1 个绿色精灵弓箭手/剑士、1 个手持法杖的蓝色盔甲法师或骑士、1 个手持金色法杖的金发牧师、1 个手持盾牌的巨大长角坦克战士，以及 1 个小型蓝色侏儒工程师/战士。在项目左下边缘添加一个站立的替补角色。

左侧特性面板：创建一个垂直的羁绊列表，包含 6 行，每行都有一个青铜/深色图标、职业名称、当前计数和阈值。应保留可见的法语文本：“Guerrier”（4，2/4/6）；“Mage”（3，3/6/9）；“Assassin”（2，2/4/6）；“Gardien”（2，2/4/6）；“Elfe”（1/2）；“Nécromancien”（1/2）。

右侧排行榜：添加一个包含 8 名玩家的垂直玩家列表，每名玩家位于一个深色水平名牌中，右侧带有圆形头像和生命值数字。使用以下名称和数值：“Lunaire 100”、“Ragnar 89”、“Akira 78”、“Zorvath 64”、“Nyméria 56”、“Scarn 42”、“Yuki 34”、“Kaldrin 21”。使用多样化的彩色奇幻头像：紫色法师宝珠、蓝色生物、深红色肖像、绿色兽人、粉发角色、青色生物、橙发角色、蓝色面具角色。

底部商店和控制：在底部创建一个宽阔的商店 UI 面板。左侧显示一个等级框，显示“NIV. 6”，经验值为“12/36”，并配有一个小型青色进度条。下方有 2 个控制按钮：“Acheter XP”（金币消耗“4”，带有蓝色双向上箭头图标）和“Actualiser”（金币消耗“2”，带有圆形刷新箭头）。中心显示 5 张可购买的英雄卡牌，包含肖像艺术、职业/特性图标、法语名称和特性以及金币消耗：“Chevalier”/“Guerrier”消耗 1；“Archer sylvestre”/“Elfe”消耗 2；“Mage de givre”/“Mage”消耗 3；“Assassin des ombres”/“Assassin”消耗 2；“Clerc lumineux”/“Gardien”消耗 1。在右下角，放置一个带有华丽金色边框的大按钮，标记为“Fin du tour”，金币消耗“5”。

视觉风格：手绘奇幻游戏 UI，干净的斜角，深青色和青铜色界面边框，易读的小字，发光的魔法效果，温暖的火光，青色高光，以及紧凑的移动端/PC 策略游戏呈现方式。将模型保持为单张游戏内截图，而非海报或概念图。避免照片级真实感，避免多余面板，避免水印，且不要添加超过指定数量的单位、商店卡牌、特性行或玩家。

templates.title: Fantasy Auto-Battle Game Sprite Collection

titleLocalized.zh: 奇幻自动战斗游戏精灵图集

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a clean atlas of sprites for a fantasy auto-battle game, showcasing battle animations of a small team, suitable for conversion into 2D game assets. Canvas: A square white canvas with a light gray grid, similar to a production-ready sprite atlas. Use a crisp, high-resolution chibi fantasy game art style with transparent white cells as the background, featuring strong outlines, dark strokes, painterly shadows, and dynamic slash/magic effects. Layout: Create a table containing 4 columns of animations and 9 rows of character/viewpoint views. The top 4 column headings must strictly follow: IDLE, ATTACK, DEFEND, DEATH. Place bold, small row labels on the left. Center a full-body chibi sprite in each cell, without cropping. Ensure all sprites are proportionally consistent. Number of Rows and Visible Count: Contains a total of 36 individual sprites, arranged in 9 rows × 4 columns. The content of each row is as follows: 1. FRONT VIEW:{argument name="blue knight character" default="A human knight with dark hair, wearing blue and gold armor, a blue cloak, and carrying a sword and a blue shield with a golden iris pattern."} 2. Back View: The same blue knight viewed from behind. 3. Front View:{argument name="elf archer character" default="A blonde female elven ranger, dressed in green leather armor and a cloak, carrying a wooden bow."} 4. BACK VIEW: The same Elven Ranger viewed from behind. 5. FRONT VIEW:{argument name="purple mage character" default="A purple-haired mage, dressed in a deep purple robe, holding a glowing purple crystal staff."} 6. BACK DOS: The same purple mage viewed from behind; retain this slightly incorrect line label text BACK DOS. 7. FRONT VIEW:{argument name="dwarf warrior character" default="A robust, red-bearded dwarf warrior, clad in heavy black-bronze armor, wielding a giant hammer and a blue shield."} 8. Back View:{argument name="hooded rogue character" default="A thief wearing a black hood, dark armor, a red scarf, carrying two daggers, and draped in a tattered cloak."} 9. BACK DOS: The same hooded thief is shown on another back/action line; retain the slightly incorrect line label text BACK DOS. Animation details for each column: In the IDLE column, each character is in a ready pose, with weapons visible. In the ATTACK column, characters are shown thrusting or attacking: the blue knight swings his sword with a pale blue arc, the elf shoots a green arrow, the mage casts a purple magic orb, the dwarf swings his hammer with a golden arc, and the thief charges with a purple trajectory. In the DEFEND column, defensive poses are shown: the knight raises his shield with small sparks, the elf raises a green circular energy arc, the mage is surrounded by a purple protective aura, the dwarf holds a hammer and shield in defense, and the thief crouches with a purple crescent-shaped defensive effect. In the DEATH column, each character lies on the ground, their weapon dropped, surrounded by debris; this includes a knight's shield and sword, an elf's bow, a mage's staff/crystal and purple remnants, a dwarf's hammer and shield, and a thief's dagger and a few dark red marks. Visual Style: Cute yet detailed chibi-style proportions, fantasy RPG/mobile auto-battle game style, three-quarter perspective, expressive poses, saturated colors, clear and legible outlines, consistent lighting, and no background scene outside the grid. Constraints: Must use 4 column labels, 9 row labels, and exactly 36 elf poses. Do not add extra characters, UI buttons, attributes, logos, watermarks, or scenes. Keep all text in English and ensure the table is easy to read.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个整洁的奇幻自动战斗游戏角色精灵图集，展示小型队伍的战斗动画，适合转化为 2D 游戏素材。

画布：带有浅灰色网格的方形白色画布，类似于生产环境的精灵图集。使用清晰的高分辨率 Q 版奇幻游戏美术风格，背景为透明感的白色单元格，具有强烈的轮廓、深色描边、绘画感阴影以及动态的斩击/魔法特效。

布局：制作一个包含 4 列动画和 9 行角色/视角视图的表格。顶部的 4 个列标题必须严格为：IDLE（待机）、ATTACK（攻击）、DEFEND（防御）、DEATH（死亡）。在左侧放置加粗的小型行标签。每个单元格内居中放置一个全身 Q 版精灵，不得裁剪。确保所有精灵的比例保持一致。

行数及可见数量：总共包含 36 个独立的精灵，排列为 9 行 × 4 列。各行内容如下：
1. FRONT VIEW（正面）：{argument name="blue knight character" default="一位深色头发的人类骑士，身穿蓝金相间的盔甲，披着蓝色斗篷，手持剑和带有金色鸢尾花图案的蓝色盾牌"}。
2. BACK VIEW（背面）：从背后观察的同一位蓝色骑士。
3. FRONT VIEW（正面）：{argument name="elf archer character" default="一位金发女性精灵游侠，身穿绿色皮甲和斗篷，携带一把木弓"}。
4. BACK VIEW（背面）：从背后观察的同一位精灵游侠。
5. FRONT VIEW（正面）：{argument name="purple mage character" default="一位紫发法师，身穿深紫色长袍，手持发光的紫色水晶法杖"}。
6. BACK DOS（背面）：从背后观察的同一位紫色法师；保留这一略有错误的行标签文本 BACK DOS。
7. FRONT VIEW（正面）：{argument name="dwarf warrior character" default="一位健壮的红胡子矮人战士，身穿厚重的黑铜色盔甲，手持巨锤和蓝色盾牌"}。
8. BACK VIEW（背面）：{argument name="hooded rogue character" default="一位戴着黑色兜帽的盗贼，身穿深色盔甲，系着红色围巾，手持双匕首，披着破烂的斗篷"}。
9. BACK DOS（背面）：同一位戴兜帽的盗贼，处于另一个背面/动作行；保留这一略有错误的行标签文本 BACK DOS。

各列动画细节：在 IDLE 列中，每个角色都处于准备姿势，武器可见。在 ATTACK 列中，展示角色突刺或攻击：蓝色骑士挥剑带有淡青色弧光，精灵射出绿色箭矢，法师施放紫色魔法球，矮人挥舞锤子带有金色弧光，盗贼冲刺并带有紫色运动轨迹。在 DEFEND 列中，展示防御姿势：骑士举盾并带有小火花，精灵撑起绿色圆形能量弧，法师被紫色保护光环环绕，矮人持锤盾防御，盗贼蹲下并带有紫色新月形防御特效。在 DEATH 列中，每个角色都倒在地上，武器掉落，周围散落着碎片；包括骑士掉落的盾牌和剑、精灵掉落的弓、法师掉落的法杖/水晶及紫色残留物、矮人掉落的锤子和盾牌，以及盗贼掉落的匕首及少量深红色痕迹。

视觉风格：可爱但细节丰富的 Q 版比例，奇幻 RPG / 移动端自动战斗游戏风格，四分之三视角，表情生动的姿势，饱和的色彩，清晰易读的轮廓，一致的光影，网格之外不包含任何背景场景。

约束条件：必须使用 4 个标注列、9 个标注行，且正好包含 36 个精灵姿势。不要添加额外的角色、UI 按钮、属性、Logo、水印或场景。保持所有文本为英文，并确保表格易于阅读。
