templates.title: Outdoor brand tool kit display project

titleLocalized.zh: 户外品牌工具包展示项目

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a clean, square-shaped brand toolkit showcase project, displaying AI-generated {argument name="brand name" default="The North Face"} The brand logo system and marketing variations combine uploaded logos, AI tool logos, and mountain-themed references into a complete visual identity system. Canvas: 1:1 square layout with a light gray/off-white background, designed like a sophisticated agency case study page. It uses clean grid lines, generous margins, and a modern, editorial brand design style. Top Input Line: Displays 5 input elements at the top: 1 {argument name="brand name" default="The North Face"} The design includes a red square brand logo tile; a large black plus sign; a circular blue logo marked "gh" with a small upward arrow and the "Growthub" label; and three vertical mountain-style reference thumbnails in red, blue-white glacier colors, and red snow mountain colors, respectively. Subheadings are added below the logos and style references. Below this line, draw two curved black arrows pointing to the central text "GPT Image 2". Main layout: Below the headings, create a 3-column, 4-row grid with 12 brand kit panels, each with a small numbered label and a bold section title in the upper left corner. The overall color scheme is red, white, black, glacial blue, and mountain gray, exuding a high-end outdoor adventure vibe. Panel quantity and content: 1. "01 Brand Essence": A large red poster-style panel with a snow mountain background and an oversized white {argument name="brand name" default="The North Face"} Logo Combinations. 2. “02 Logo Variations”: White panel showcasing 6 logo variations: a solid red square logo, a red square with “TNF”, a red square with only an arched symbol, a horizontal text logo with an arch, a stacked text logo, and a small box set. 3. “03 Icon Set”: Red panel containing 12 thin white line icons arranged in a 4x3 grid: mountain peak, compass, snowflake, tent, carabiner, flag, parka, hiking boots, backpack, ice axe, sun, and folded map. 4. “04 Brand Baseline”: Deep red mountain poster with a large serif white slogan “Never Stop Exploring.” 5. “05 Product Mockups”: White product mockup panel showcasing 3 red branded products: water bottle, tote bag, and baseball cap. 6. “06 Apparel Lifestyle”: Realistic outdoor clothing scene showing 3 people wearing red and black adventure jackets in a snowy mountain. 7. “07 Brand Baseline”: A repeat of the deep red mountain landmark poster, still displaying the text “Never Stop Exploring.” 8. “05 Product Mockups”: A repeat of the same white panel showcasing three red brand products: a water bottle, a tote bag, and a hat. 9. “06 Apparel Lifestyle”: A repeat of the same mountain lifestyle panel, showcasing three people wearing red jackets. 10. “07 Urban Campaign Ads”: Displays three tall, vertical advertising posters featuring climbers and a red logo block, with titles “Built to Endure.”, “Climb Higher.”, and “Never Stop Exploring.” respectively. 11. “08 App Interface”: Displays smartphone screens for three outdoor shopping apps, featuring red jackets, product cards, checkout UI, red buttons, and a clean white mobile interface design. 12. “09 Social Media Visuals”: ​​Showcases three square social media tiles against a snow-capped mountain background, accompanied by a red logo tile and white text: “SUMMIT SUNDAYS,” “PROTECT OUR PEAKS,” and “EXPLORE. ENDURE. REPEAT.” Visual Style: Combines realistic mountain photography with clean vector logo artwork, minimalist product mockups, thin white line icons, and art direction from a luxury outdoor brand. Utilizes red gradient overlays, snow textures, high-contrast typography, and clean case study spacing. Keeps the design clear at a glance, with no extra panels, no watermarks, and no irrelevant text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个简洁的方形品牌工具包展示项目，展示由 AI 生成的 {argument name="brand name" default="The North Face"} 品牌 Logo 系统及营销变体，将上传的 Logo、AI 工具 Logo 和山地风格参考结合成一套完整的视觉识别系统。

画布：方形 1:1 布局，背景为浅灰色/米白色，设计风格如同精致的代理商案例研究页面。使用清晰的网格线、宽裕的页边距以及现代编辑式的品牌设计风格。

顶部输入行：在顶部展示 5 个输入元素：1 个 {argument name="brand name" default="The North Face"} 的红色方形品牌 Logo 图块；1 个巨大的黑色加号；1 个标记为“gh”的圆形蓝色 Logo，带有小向上箭头和“Growthub”标签；以及 3 个垂直的山地风格参考缩略图，配色分别为红色、蓝白色冰川色和红色雪山色。在 Logo 和风格参考下方添加小标题。在此行下方，绘制两个指向中心文本“GPT Image 2”的弯曲黑色箭头。

主要布局：在标题下方，创建一个 3 列 4 行的网格，共 12 个品牌工具包面板，每个面板左上角带有微小的编号标签和加粗的章节标题。整体色调为红色、白色、黑色、冰蓝色和山灰色，充满高端户外探险活力。

面板数量与内容：
1. “01 Brand Essence”：大型红色海报风格面板，背景为雪山，配有超大的白色 {argument name="brand name" default="The North Face"} Logo 组合。
2. “02 Logo Variations”：白色面板，展示 6 种 Logo 变体：全红色方形 Logo、带“TNF”的红色方形、仅带拱形符号的红色方形、带拱形的水平文字标识、堆叠式文字标识以及小型盒装组合。
3. “03 Icon Set”：红色面板，包含 12 个细白线图标，排列为 4x3 网格：山峰、指南针、雪花、帐篷、登山扣、旗帜、派克大衣、登山靴、背包、冰镐、太阳和折叠地图。
4. “04 Brand Baseline”：深红色山地海报，配有巨大的衬线体白色标语“Never Stop Exploring.”。
5. “05 Product Mockups”：白色产品样机面板，展示 3 款红色品牌产品：水壶、托特包和棒球帽。
6. “06 Apparel Lifestyle”：写实风格的户外服装场景，展示 3 名身穿红黑探险夹克的人在雪山中。
7. “07 Brand Baseline”：重复深红色山地标语海报，文字仍为“Never Stop Exploring.”。
8. “05 Product Mockups”：重复相同的白色面板，展示 3 款红色品牌产品：水壶、托特包和帽子。
9. “06 Apparel Lifestyle”：重复相同的雪山生活方式面板，展示 3 名身穿红色夹克的人。
10. “07 Urban Campaign Ads”：展示 3 张高垂直广告海报，包含登山者和红色 Logo 块，标题分别为“Built to Endure.”、“Climb Higher.”和“Never Stop Exploring.”。
11. “08 App Interface”：展示 3 个户外购物 App 的智能手机屏幕，特色包括红色夹克、产品卡片、结账 UI、红色按钮和简洁的白色移动端界面设计。
12. “09 Social Media Visuals”：展示 3 个方形社交媒体图块，背景为雪山，配有红色 Logo 块和白色文字：“SUMMIT SUNDAYS”、“PROTECT OUR PEAKS”和“EXPLORE. ENDURE. REPEAT.”。

视觉风格：将写实的山地摄影与清晰的矢量 Logo 作品、极简产品样机、细白线图标以及奢华户外品牌的艺术指导相结合。使用红色渐变叠加、雪地纹理、高对比度排版和整洁的案例研究间距。保持设计一目了然，无额外面板，无水印，无无关文本。

templates.title: Scrapbook style anime GFX poster

titleLocalized.zh: 剪贴簿风格动漫 GFX 海报

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a vibrant scrapbook-style anime GFX poster featuring a character named {argument name="character name" default="Mika"} A cute yet dangerous pastel street-style girl, presented with a glossy Y2K punk magazine collage aesthetic. Canvas: Vertical 3:4 poster, full bleed design, compact composition, neon purple and bright pink lighting, high contrast, with slightly rough paper texture, tape-fixed photo fragments, torn edges, sticker overlays, graffiti, barcode details, and glowing highlights. Subject: The center of the image is a seated anime girl, her face deliberately left blank or obscured, facing forward in a confident squatting pose. She has very long and fluffy twin tails, and her hair color is {argument name="hair color" default="From peach-orange to pink gradient"} The character is coiled into a giant spiral, adorned with a large purple bow, colorful hair clips, miniature heart-shaped brooches, and adorable accessories. Clothing: An oversized white hoodie with pink lettering, layered necklaces with colorful heart pendants, a bracelet, and loose-fitting trousers that gradient from light blue to purple to magenta, paired with pastel sneakers featuring cute little patches. She holds a black tactical rifle vertically between her legs, creating a contrast between sweetness and danger while maintaining an illustration style rather than realism. Layout: The character is placed in the center of the frame, knees pointing forward, sneakers near the bottom corner. A large, glossy, handwritten name is placed in the lower third of the frame.{argument name="large name text" default="Mika"} The design features bubble-like bright pink and lavender lettering with thick white outlines, shimmering highlights, and heart-shaped embellishments. Layered stickers and torn strips of paper are used around the character, with a smaller Polaroid portrait in the top left corner, a sneaker photo in the center left, and multiple graffiti badges along the edges. Visible text elements: Contains 12 clearly readable text blocks: 1) Top microtext “SWEET. BOLD. UNSTOPPABLE.”, 2) Right label “BABY” and small crown doodle, 3) Right small label “01 / #2024”, 4) Left torn strip “cute but dangerous”, 5) Right torn strip “not your BABY”, 6) List with three checkmark items “PRETTY”, “TOUGH”, “LOYAL”, 7) Bottom large name “Mika”, 8) Small label “EDITED FOR IMPACT”, 9) Studio module “GFX BY NEXUS STUDIOS”, 10) Bottom left title “SHE'S SUGAR, SHE'S STEEL, SHE DOESN'T MISS.”, 11) Bottom right barcode title “HANDLE WITH ATTITUDE”, 12) Top left barcode-like decorative bar. Decorative Elements: Includes 14 main scrapbook decorations: a Polaroid portrait in the top left corner, a sneaker Polaroid on the left, a black cat face sticker with X-shaped eyes in the bottom left corner, a pink heart sticker in the top right corner, a blue outline heart on the right, a dripping heart near the bottom right corner, a rising arrow chart in the lower right center, a crown doodle, a barcode in the bottom right corner, a barcode bar in the top left corner, a torn black tag behind the name "BABY", a purple sci-fi photo panel with tape behind the head, a cluster of stars near the bottom left corner, and a cluster of miniature heart doodles around the poster. Visual Style: Anime illustrations, glossy digital painting, vibrant comic book cover energy, Cyber-Y2K stickers, kawaii punk, neon purple vibe, layered paper collages, visible tape strips, rough torn edges, ink graffiti, glitter, tiny stars, halftone textures, color glow, and saturated pinkish-purple hues with peach hair as the focal color. Constraints: Keep the image a single poster design, not a comic book panel. Ensure all text is clear and legible, and arranged like a designer's scrapbook layout. Do not add extra characters. Reserve blank squares for faces as intentionally left editable placeholders. Avoid realism; use a refined anime GFX poster rendering effect.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张充满活力的剪贴簿风格动漫 GFX 海报，主角是一位名为 {argument name="character name" default="Mika"} 的可爱又危险的粉彩街头风女孩，呈现出光泽感的 Y2K 朋克杂志拼贴美学。

画布：垂直 3:4 海报，全出血设计，构图紧凑，霓虹紫和亮粉色灯光，高对比度，带有轻微的粗糙纸张纹理、胶带固定的照片碎片、撕裂边缘、贴纸覆盖层、涂鸦、条形码细节和发光高光。

主体：画面中心是一位坐着的动漫女孩，面部区域刻意留白或遮挡，面向前方，呈自信的蹲姿。她拥有非常长且蓬松的双马尾，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="从桃橙色渐变到粉色"}，卷成巨大的螺旋状，装饰着大大的紫色蝴蝶结、彩色发夹、微型心形别针和可爱配饰。服装：超大号白色连帽衫，印有粉色字母，叠戴带有彩色心形吊坠的项链，佩戴手链，穿着从淡蓝色渐变到紫色再到洋红色的宽松长裤，搭配粉彩运动鞋，裤子上带有可爱的小补丁。她双腿间垂直握着一把黑色战术步枪，营造出甜美与危险的对比，同时保持插画风格，而非写实风格。

布局：将角色置于画面中心，膝盖朝前，运动鞋靠近底部角落。在下三分之一处放置巨大的光泽感手写体名字 {argument name="large name text" default="Mika"}，采用气泡状的亮粉色和薰衣草色字母，带有厚实的白色轮廓、闪亮的高光和心形装饰。在角色周围使用分层贴纸和撕裂的纸条，左上角放置一张较小的拍立得肖像，左中位置放置一张运动鞋照片，边缘处点缀多个涂鸦徽章。

可见文本元素：包含 12 个清晰可读的文本块：1) 顶部微型文字“SWEET. BOLD. UNSTOPPABLE.”，2) 右侧标签“BABY”及小皇冠涂鸦，3) 右侧小标签“01 / #2024”，4) 左侧撕裂纸条“cute but dangerous”，5) 右侧撕裂纸条“not your BABY”，6) 带有三个勾选项目的清单“PRETTY”、“TOUGH”、“LOYAL”，7) 底部大字名字“Mika”，8) 小标签“EDITED FOR IMPACT”，9) 工作室模块“GFX BY NEXUS STUDIOS”，10) 左下角标题“SHE’S SUGAR, SHE’S STEEL, SHE DOESN’T MISS.”，11) 右下角条形码标题“HANDLE WITH ATTITUDE”，12) 左上角类似条形码的装饰条。

装饰元素：包含 14 个主要的剪贴簿装饰：左上角 1 张拍立得肖像，左侧 1 张运动鞋拍立得，左下角 1 个 X 型眼睛的黑猫脸贴纸，右上角 1 个粉色心形贴纸，右侧 1 个蓝色轮廓心形，右下角附近 1 个滴落的心形，中右下方 1 个上升的箭头图表，1 个皇冠涂鸦，右下角 1 个条形码，左上角 1 个条形码条，名字“BABY”后方 1 个撕裂的黑色标签，头部后方 1 个带有胶带的紫色科幻照片面板，左下角附近 1 组星群，以及海报周围 1 组微型心形涂鸦。

视觉风格：动漫插画，光泽感数字绘画，充满活力的漫画封面能量，Cyber-Y2K 贴纸，卡哇伊朋克，霓虹紫氛围，纸张拼贴分层，可见的胶带条，粗糙的撕裂边缘，墨水涂鸦，闪光，微小星星，半色调纹理，色彩辉光，以桃色头发为焦点色的饱和粉紫色调。

约束：保持图像为单张海报设计，而非漫画分镜。确保所有文字清晰易读，并像设计师剪贴簿布局一样排列。不要添加额外角色。保留面部的空白方块作为刻意留出的可编辑占位符。避免写实感；使用精致的动漫 GFX 海报渲染效果。

templates.title: Living Hat Cinematic Storyboard

titleLocalized.zh: Living Hat 电影级故事板

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a book called{argument name="part title" default="PART 1"} The fantasy fashion short film creates a luxurious, cinematic storyboard, subtitled{argument name="subtitle" default="THE LIVING HAT – THE DREAM APPEARS"} The core concept features a dignified young woman in a magnificent vintage gown, standing in a grand European Baroque square, wearing a giant "living hat" shaped like a miniature city, adorned with domes, towers, flowers, birds, roses, and gold filigree. Canvas: 16:9 widescreen storyboard project, deep charcoal black background, delicate and ornate gold border, elegant vintage gold and cream typography. Adopting a film production project layout: a large key visual in the upper right corner, a text block in the upper left corner, and 12 thumbnail storyboard panels in 2 rows and 6 columns below. Bottom entries include sound, color, camera language, tone, and aspect ratio. Top title and key visual area: A large serif title in the upper left corner reads "PART 1". The subtitle below reads "THE LIVING HAT – THE DREAM APPEARS". Add a line of metadata: "Duration: 15 seconds | Panels: 12 | Tone: Poetic, Mysterious, Luxurious". Below is the chapter title "MAIN CINEMATIC FRAME (HERO SHOT PROMPT)" and the paragraph: "A distinguished young woman in a magnificent vintage gown stands in a grand European Baroque square. She wears a huge hat, a miniature city filled with domes, towers, roses, and ornate gold thread. Birds fly and perch around her. Soft golden morning light, a dreamlike cinematic atmosphere." The main visual in the upper right corner should show a close-up of the woman from the chest up, centered below the huge city hat; her face should be softened by shadows or a simple rectangular blur, while the hat retains a high degree of detail. Background: Magnificent Baroque domed architecture, a warm morning sky, and flying birds. Storyboard panel layout: Uses 12 numbered storyboard thumbnails, from 01 to 12. Each panel contains a miniature timecode, an image frame, and three lines of text labeled CAMERA, ACTION, SOUND, and TRANSITION. Maintain a consistent, ornate design with black background and gold lettering. The 12 panels are as follows: 1. "01 00:00 - 00:01" — A wide-angle establishing shot of a magnificent city skyline and domes in the soft morning light. CAMERA: "WS – Establishing Shot". ACTION: "The Baroque city awakens in the soft morning light." SOUND: "Distant urban ambient sound, the sound of wind." TRANSITION: "Cut". 2. "02 00:01 - 00:02" — A slow crane descent towards the blue-green domes, accompanied by flocks of birds in the sky. CAMERA: "WS – Slow Crane Down". ACTION: "Flocks of birds circle above the domes." SOUND: "Distant birdsong." TRANSITION: "Cut". 3. "03 00:02 - 00:03" — A telephoto lens perspective, with women appearing small in a vast, ornate square. CAMERA: "MS – Long Lens". ACTION: "A woman stands still in the square, her hat like a small world." SOUND: "The sound of wind, the gentle sound of wind chimes." TRANSITION: "Cut." 4. "04 00:03 - 00:04" — Medium close-up, slow zoom in, profile or part of the face under the hat, the face subtly obscured. CAMERA: "MCU – Slow Push In." ACTION: "Her profile, calm and detached." SOUND: "The sound of fabric rubbing, the soft sound of breathing." TRANSITION: "Cut." 5. "05 00:04 - 00:05" — Macro detail, roses blooming among the small buildings and lace of the hat city. CAMERA: "CU – Macro Detail." ACTION: "Rose blooming in the hat city." SOUND: "The delicate sound of wind chimes." TRANSITION: "Cut." 6. "06 00:05 - 00:07" — Close-up, a bird perched on the golden spire of the hat. CAMERA: "CU – Bird Landing". ACTION: "A bird perched on the golden spire." SOUND: "Sound of wings flapping." TRANSITION: "Cut." 7. "07 00:07 - 00:08" — Miniature city architecture on the hat, windows shimmering with light. CAMERA: "CU – Miniature Architecture". ACTION: "Miniature domes and windows, vividly detailed." SOUND: "A slight metallic resonance." TRANSITION: "Cut." 8. "08 00:08 - 00:09" — The large brim of the hat, lace and gold trim fluttering in the wind. CAMERA: "CU – Lace & Gold Edge". ACTION: "The embroidered edge sways in the breeze." SOUND: "The whisper of the fabric." TRANSITION: "Cut." 9. "09 00:09 - 00:10" — Medium shot, flocks of birds fly around her hat, her face softly obscured. CAMERA: "MS – Birds in Motion". ACTION: "Birds take off around her." SOUND: "Sound of wings, air movement." TRANSITION: "Cut." 10. "10 00:10 - 00:12" — Slowly circling the woman in the square, showcasing the grandeur of the hat and the architecture. CAMERA: "MS – Slow Orbit". ACTION: "Camera circles around, showcasing her imposing presence." SOUND: "Music crescendos, wind sound." TRANSITION: "Cut." 11. "11 00:12 - 00:14" — Low angle or close-up, emphasizing the huge and solemn hat; the woman's face is slightly obscured. CAMERA: "CU/Low Angle – Hat Majesty." ACTION: "The hat becomes a floating kingdom." SOUND: "Music rises." TRANSITION: "Cut." 12. "12 00:14 - 00:15" — Ending close-up, focusing on the hat brim and the woman, hinting at a dreamlike transition. CAMERA: "CU – Ending Beat." ACTION: "She looks up, the dream begins." SOUND: "Soft music rises." TRANSITION: "Dissolves to Part 2." Bottom entry: Contains 5 color samples: deep cyan black, antique gold, warm beige, burnt orange, and light blue-grey. Five annotations have been added to the bottom area: "OVERALL SOUND DESIGN" includes "wind sounds, birdsong, fabric sounds, soft wind chimes, and gentle orchestral textures."; "COLOR PALETTE" includes 5 color blocks; "CAMERA LANGUAGE" includes "elegant slow movement, advancement, wrapping, macro details, and low angles to enhance scale and emotion."; "TONE & STYLE" includes "surreal fantasy, luxurious fashion, Baroque architecture, and poetic realism."; and "ASPECT RATIO" includes "16:9 Cinema." Visual style: Ultra-detailed cinematic fantasy realism, luxurious fashion, magnificent Baroque architecture, gilded filigree, lapis lazuli color scheme, warm golden morning light, shallow depth of field, lifelike birds, richly textured roses, and a dreamlike atmosphere. The central character is {argument name="main character" default="a regal young woman"} Wearing{argument name="gown style" default="a lavish vintage gown"} Wearing a giant city hat covered in domes, towers, roses, birds, and lace. Constraints: Keep all text legible and in English. Use 12 storyboard panels and 5 color swatches. Maintain a high-end film storyboard look, no watermarks, no extra panels, and no extra logos.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为一部名为 {argument name="part title" default="PART 1"} 的奇幻时尚短片创作一张奢华的电影级故事板，副标题为 {argument name="subtitle" default="THE LIVING HAT – THE DREAM APPEARS"}。核心概念是一位身着华丽复古礼服的尊贵年轻女性，站在宏伟的欧洲巴洛克广场上，头戴一顶巨大的“活体帽子”，帽子形状如同一个微型城市，布满了圆顶、塔楼、花朵、鸟儿、玫瑰和金色花丝。

画布：宽屏 16:9 故事板项目，深炭黑色背景，细致的华丽金色边框，优雅的复古金色与奶油色排版。采用电影制作项目布局：右上角为大型主视觉图，左上角为文本块，下方为 2 行 6 列的 12 个缩略图故事板面板，底部条目包含声音、色彩、镜头语言、基调和宽高比。

顶部标题与主视觉区：左上角大型衬线标题为“PART 1”。下方副标题为“THE LIVING HAT – THE DREAM APPEARS”。添加一行元数据：“时长：15 秒 | 面板：12 | 基调：诗意、神秘、奢华”。下方包含章节标题“MAIN CINEMATIC FRAME (HERO SHOT PROMPT)”及段落：“一位身着华丽复古礼服的尊贵年轻女性站在宏伟的欧洲巴洛克广场上。她头戴一顶巨大的帽子，那是一个布满圆顶、塔楼、玫瑰和华丽金丝的微型城市。鸟儿在她周围飞翔并栖息。柔和的金色晨光，梦幻般的电影氛围。”右上角主视觉图应展示女性从胸部以上的特写，位于巨大的城市帽下方居中；她的面部被阴影或简单的矩形模糊处理柔化，而帽子保持高度细节感。背景：宏伟的巴洛克圆顶建筑，温暖的晨空，飞翔的鸟儿。

故事板面板布局：使用 12 个编号的故事板缩略图，从 01 到 12，每个面板包含微型时间码、图像帧以及三行标记为 CAMERA（镜头）、ACTION（动作）、SOUND（声音）和 TRANSITION（转场）的文本。保持统一的黑底金字华丽设计。12 个面板内容如下：
1. "01 00:00 - 00:01" — 宏伟城市天际线和圆顶在柔和晨光中的广角建立镜头。CAMERA: "WS – Establishing Shot"。ACTION: "巴洛克城市在柔和晨光中苏醒。" SOUND: "遥远的城市氛围音，风声"。TRANSITION: "切"。
2. "02 00:01 - 00:02" — 向蓝绿色圆顶缓慢摇臂下降，天空中伴有鸟群。CAMERA: "WS – Slow Crane Down"。ACTION: "鸟群在圆顶上方盘旋。" SOUND: "远处的鸟鸣"。TRANSITION: "切"。
3. "03 00:02 - 00:03" — 长焦镜头视角，女性在巨大的华丽广场中显得渺小。CAMERA: "MS – Long Lens"。ACTION: "女性静立在广场上，帽子宛如一个小世界。" SOUND: "风声，轻柔的风铃声"。TRANSITION: "切"。
4. "04 00:03 - 00:04" — 中近景缓慢推进，帽子下的侧脸或部分面部，面部被巧妙遮挡。CAMERA: "MCU – Slow Push In"。ACTION: "她的侧脸，平静而疏离。" SOUND: "织物摩擦声，轻柔的呼吸声"。TRANSITION: "切"。
5. "05 00:04 - 00:05" — 微距细节，玫瑰在帽子城市的小建筑和花丝间绽放。CAMERA: "CU – Macro Detail"。ACTION: "玫瑰在帽子城市上绽放。" SOUND: "精致的风铃声"。TRANSITION: "切"。
6. "06 00:05 - 00:07" — 特写，一只鸟落在帽子上的金色尖顶上。CAMERA: "CU – Bird Landing"。ACTION: "一只鸟栖息在金色尖顶上。" SOUND: "翅膀扑动声"。TRANSITION: "切"。
7. "07 00:07 - 00:08" — 帽子上的微型城市建筑，窗户闪烁着光芒。CAMERA: "CU – Miniature Architecture"。ACTION: "微小的圆顶和窗户，细节生动。" SOUND: "轻微的金属共鸣声"。TRANSITION: "切"。
8. "08 00:08 - 00:09" — 巨大的帽檐边缘，蕾丝和金边随风飘动。CAMERA: "CU – Lace & Gold Edge"。ACTION: "刺绣边缘随微风摆动。" SOUND: "织物细语声"。TRANSITION: "切"。
9. "09 00:09 - 00:10" — 中景，鸟群在她帽子周围飞翔，面部被柔和遮挡。CAMERA: "MS – Birds in Motion"。ACTION: "鸟群在她周围起飞。" SOUND: "翅膀声，空气波动声"。TRANSITION: "切"。
10. "10 00:10 - 00:12" — 缓慢环绕广场上的女性，展现帽子和建筑的宏伟。CAMERA: "MS – Slow Orbit"。ACTION: "摄像机环绕，展现她的宏伟气场。" SOUND: "音乐渐强，风声"。TRANSITION: "切"。
11. "11 00:12 - 00:14" — 低角度或特写，强调巨大而庄严的帽子；女性面部被轻微遮挡。CAMERA: "CU/Low Angle – Hat Majesty"。ACTION: "帽子变成了一个漂浮的王国。" SOUND: "音乐升起"。TRANSITION: "切"。
12. "12 00:14 - 00:15" — 结尾特写，聚焦帽檐和女性，暗示梦幻般的转场。CAMERA: "CU – Ending Beat"。ACTION: "她抬头仰望，梦境开始。" SOUND: "轻柔的音乐升华"。TRANSITION: "叠化至 Part 2"。

底部条目：包含 5 个颜色样本：深青黑色、古董金、暖米色、焦橙色和浅蓝灰色。添加五个标注的底部区域：“OVERALL SOUND DESIGN”包含“风声、鸟鸣、织物声、轻柔风铃、柔和管弦乐纹理。”；“COLOR PALETTE”包含 5 个色块；“CAMERA LANGUAGE”包含“优雅的缓慢移动、推进、环绕、微距细节、低角度以提升规模感和情感。”；“TONE & STYLE”包含“超现实奇幻、奢华时尚大片、巴洛克建筑、诗意现实主义。”；以及“ASPECT RATIO”包含“16:9 Cinema”。

视觉风格：超细节电影级奇幻写实，奢华时尚大片，华丽巴洛克建筑，镀金花丝，青金配色调色，温暖金色晨光，浅景深，逼真的鸟类，纹理丰富的玫瑰，梦幻氛围。中心角色为 {argument name="main character" default="a regal young woman"}，身着 {argument name="gown style" default="a lavish vintage gown"}，佩戴一顶布满圆顶、塔楼、玫瑰、鸟儿和花丝的巨大城市帽。

约束条件：保持所有文本清晰且为英文。使用 12 个故事板面板和 5 个颜色样本。保持高端电影故事板外观，无水印，无额外面板，无额外 Logo。

templates.title: Dark anime style Sylus scrapbook poster

titleLocalized.zh: 暗黑动漫风 Sylus 剪贴簿海报

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="character name" default="Sylus"} Create a vertical scrapbook-style anime GFX poster, crafting a luxurious black-and-white, deep red, dark fantasy character collage. Canvas: 3:4 vertical aspect ratio, high-resolution digital illustration, black charcoal background with white worn paper texture, thin white double border, subtle dotted guide lines, glitter, stars, hand-drawn doodles, a crown sketch, and magazine layout details. Subject: A handsome adult anime male, pale-skinned, with messy hair {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} He has long hair, a bare, muscular chest, a white fur coat draped over his shoulders, exquisite silver sleeves, multiple silver necklaces, an ornate choker, white trousers, and a wide, metallic silver belt with a circular rose-shaped medallion, a hanging chain, and several rings. He poses dramatically from a low angle, one hand raised to the audience, fingers spread, wearing a gleaming silver ring. His face is deliberately obscured by a large, opaque, grayish-brown square occlusion. Layout and element count: Contains 2 opaque grayish-brown occlusions: a large square covering the protagonist's face in the upper center, and a smaller square covering the torn-paper-style portrait illustration on the left. Contains 3 faceted deep red gemstone decorations: one near the title area on the left, one near the badge in the lower right corner, and one in the lower right corner. Contains 3 small box-shaped icons on the lower left edge: a black crown icon, a red thorn/sword-shaped diagonal mark, and a black branch/thorn mark. Includes two main torn paper style information cards: a larger "ABOUT SYLUS" card in the lower left corner and a smaller quote card in the lower right corner. Above the quote card on the right is a delicate circular heraldic mark. It features scattered white glitter, small hearts, crown doodles, orbital/planet doodles, barcode-like markings, tape strips, torn paper edges, and stains. Typography and visible text: A large title, "SYLUS," is placed in the upper left corner using tall, glossy serif capital letters, with a red cursive "Sylus" superimposed below. Above the title is tiny text: "KING KING OF DESIRE," with the second "KING" in red. The quote on the left is: "I dont chase... I claim.", with "I claim." in red. On the torn paper card in the lower left corner, a black label reads "ABOUT SYLUS," followed by bulleted lines: "Title: King of Desire," "Age: ???," "Height: 186cm," "Power: Gravikinesis," "Weapon: Obsidian Thorn." Add a small black label “DANGEROUSLY” and the red cursive word “Irresistible.” On the quote card in the bottom right corner, write: “Rule is mine. Obedience is yours.”, with “mine.” in red. Near the bottom right corner, add a black label that says “SYLUS” and a large cursive signature “Sylus.” Visual Style: Highly detailed anime/otome game illustrations, luxurious gothic scrapbook aesthetics, dramatic lighting, glossy silver highlights, a high-contrast black, white, and gray palette accented with carefully selected deep red details, layered torn paper collages, washi tape, ink scratches, magazine poster compositions, exquisite jewelry details, precise anatomical structures, cinematic sheen, and no watermark. Constraints: Keep all text clear and in English, maintain the precise number of elements listed above, retain the face-covering blocks, avoid adding extra characters, and do not include any modern UI panels other than scrapbook cards.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="Sylus"} 创作一张竖版剪贴簿动漫 GFX 海报，打造一张奢华的黑白配深红暗黑奇幻角色拼贴画。

画布：3:4 竖版比例，高分辨率数字插画，黑色炭黑背景搭配白色磨损纸张纹理，细白色双边框，微小的虚线引导线，闪光，星星，手绘涂鸦，皇冠草图，以及杂志排版细节。

主体：一位英俊的成年动漫男性，皮肤苍白，留着凌乱的 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色"} 长发，赤裸着肌肉发达的胸膛，肩上披着白色皮草大衣，穿着精致的白银色袖子，佩戴多层银色项链、雕花项圈，穿着白色长裤，系着宽大的金属银色腰带，带有圆形玫瑰状勋章、悬挂的链条和多枚戒指。他从低角度摆出戏剧性的姿势，一只手举向观众，手指张开，戴着闪亮的银色戒指。他的脸部被一个大的不透明灰褐色方形遮挡块刻意遮住。

布局与元素计数：包含 2 个不透明的灰褐色遮挡块：一个大的正方形遮盖住上方中央的主角脸部，另一个较小的正方形遮盖住左侧撕纸风格的肖像插图。包含 3 个刻面深红色宝石装饰：一个位于左侧标题区域附近，一个位于右下角徽章附近，一个位于右下角。在左下边缘包含 3 个小型盒装图标：一个黑色皇冠图标，一个红色荆棘/剑状对角标记，以及一个黑色树枝/荆棘标记。包含 2 张主要的撕纸风格信息卡：左下角一张较大的“ABOUT SYLUS”卡片，右下角一张较小的引语卡片。在右侧引语卡片上方包含 1 个圆形精致纹章印记。包含散落的白色闪光、小心心、皇冠涂鸦、轨道/行星涂鸦、条形码状标记、胶带条、撕纸边缘和污渍斑点。

排版与可见文字：将巨大的标题设为左上方的“SYLUS”，使用高大的光泽衬线大写字母，下方叠加红色的草书“Sylus”。在标题上方添加微小文字：“KING KING OF DESIRE”，其中第二个 KING 为红色。在左侧添加引语：“I dont chase... I claim.”，其中“I claim.”为红色。在左下角的撕纸卡片上，写上黑色标签“ABOUT SYLUS”，然后是项目符号行：“Title: King of Desire”、“Age: ???”、“Height: 186cm”、“Power: Gravikinesis”、“Weapon: Obsidian Thorn”。添加一个小黑色标签“DANGEROUSLY”和红色草书单词“Irresistible.”。在右下角的引语卡片上，写上：“Rule is mine. Obedience is yours.”，其中“mine.”为红色。在右下角附近添加一个写着“SYLUS”的黑色标签和一个大的草书签名“Sylus”。

视觉风格：高度精致的动漫乙女游戏插画，奢华哥特剪贴簿美学，戏剧性光影，光泽银色高光，高对比度的黑白灰调色板搭配精选的深红色点缀，分层撕纸拼贴，胶带，墨水划痕，杂志海报构图，精致的珠宝细节，精准的解剖结构，电影级光泽，无水印。

约束：保持所有文字清晰且为英文，保留上述列出的精确元素数量，维持遮盖脸部的遮挡方块，避免添加额外角色，且不要包含除剪贴簿卡片之外的现代 UI 面板。

templates.title: Blank face anime portrait background

titleLocalized.zh: 空白面部动漫肖像底图

templates.prompt: Create a simple anime-style character base image for modular facial component generation: a centered frontal half-body portrait, the character being {argument name="character name" default="An unnamed young woman"} The facial area is intentionally left blank and covered by a large, vertically rounded rectangular mask, so the eyes, nose, and mouth are missing and can be added separately later. The character has soft, shoulder-length layers.{argument name="hair color" default="The ends of her white hair gradually turned a pale ice-blue color."} Her hair is light and airy, with long sideburns and subtle, loose curls, and her ears are faintly visible through the strands. She wears a fair-skinned outfit, her posture is calm and natural, and the composition is cropped from the top of her head to her upper chest. She is dressed in a futuristic high-necked garment.{argument name="outfit" default="White zip-up jacket"} Features include light blue accents, a central zipper, small rectangular collar buttons with blue triangular symbols, and delicate stitching. The blank face mask should be a large, rounded rectangle with a soft, vertical gradient that transitions from a warm light peach at the top to a cool light blue at the bottom, aligning with facial features and extending from the forehead to below the chin, while preserving the surrounding hair and ears. The background is a simple light gray studio background with soft lighting, delicate lines, and a watercolor-style anime rendering with soft shadows. It is high-resolution, without text, UI, or watermarks, and no additional facial features are displayed within the blank mask.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个简洁的动漫风格角色底图，用于模块化面部部件生成：一个居中的正面半身像，角色为 {argument name="character name" default="一位未命名的年轻女性"}，面部区域刻意留空并覆盖有一个大型垂直圆角矩形遮罩，因此眼睛、鼻子和嘴巴均缺失，可稍后单独添加。角色拥有齐肩的柔软分层 {argument name="hair color" default="发梢渐变为淡冰蓝色的白发"}，发丝轻盈通透，长侧鬓角，带有微妙的松散卷度，耳朵在发丝间隐约可见。使用白皙肤色，姿态沉静自然，构图从头顶裁剪至上胸部。身着具有未来感的高领 {argument name="outfit" default="白色拉链夹克"}，带有浅蓝色点缀、中央拉链、带有蓝色三角形符号的小型矩形领扣以及精致的缝合线。空白面部遮罩应为一个完整的大型中央圆角矩形，内部柔和地填充从顶部暖浅桃色到底部冷浅蓝色的垂直渐变，对齐面部特征区域并从额头延伸至下巴下方，同时保留周围的头发和耳朵。背景为简单的浅灰色摄影棚背景，光线柔和，线条精致细腻，采用水彩风格动漫渲染，阴影柔和，高分辨率，无文字，无 UI，无水印，且空白遮罩内不显示任何额外的面部特征。

templates.prompt: Create a realistic vertical portrait photograph, with a subject being a person.{argument name="student subject" default="Japanese high school girl"} She stood by the bright classroom window, bathed in the warm morning light. The shot framed her from about mid-thigh up, in a three-quarter profile view, looking slightly towards the camera, one hand resting lightly on the white windowsill. Her face was deliberately anonymized, using a centrally located, softly edged square blur/mosaic block, its color matching her natural skin tone, covering her entire face while retaining the visibility of her hair and ears. She had long, straight, dark brown to black hair that fell to her shoulders, with a glossy sheen. She was wearing {argument name="school uniform" default="Navy blue blazer, white collared shirt underneath, and gray plaid pleated skirt."} Details should include suit cuff buttons, fitted seams, small pocket flaps, and a clear depiction of fabric texture. The background is a Japanese classroom with light-colored wooden floors. On the right are rows of wooden desks and metal-framed chairs. A green blackboard and corkboards covered with documents are visible in the background. A large window on the left reveals a softly blurred cityscape or campus view. The composition should employ shallow depth of field, natural window lighting, soft shadows, a realistic camera perspective, subtle lens blur, high detail, a tranquil, candid atmosphere, and a clean photographic style. The canvas should be 3:4 portrait, full color, without text, watermarks, or other figures.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实的竖版肖像照片，主体为一名 {argument name="student subject" default="日本高中女生"}，她站在明亮的教室高窗旁，沐浴在温暖的晨光中。画面取景约为大腿中部以上，采用四分之三背侧面姿势，她微微看向镜头，一只手轻放在白色窗台上。她的面部经过刻意匿名处理，使用了一个位于中心、边缘柔和的方形模糊/马赛克块，色调与自然肤色一致，覆盖了整个面部，但保留了头发和耳朵的可见度。她留着深棕色至黑色的直长发，垂至肩下，带有光泽感。她身着 {argument name="school uniform" default="海军蓝西装外套，内搭白色翻领衬衫，下配灰色格纹百褶裙"}；细节需包含西装袖口纽扣、合身接缝、小口袋盖以及清晰的布料质感。背景为一间日本教室，地面为浅色木地板，右侧是成排的木制课桌和金属框架椅，背景中可见绿色黑板和贴有文件的软木板，左侧的大窗户透出柔和模糊的城市或校园景观。采用浅景深、自然窗光、柔和阴影、写实的相机视角、细微的镜头模糊、高细节、宁静的抓拍氛围以及干净的摄影风格。画布比例为竖版 3:4，全彩，无文字，无水印，无其他人物。

templates.title: Six-panel storyboard of Drunken Fist

titleLocalized.zh: 六格醉拳分镜故事板

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a concise, rough storyboard for an animated/comedy action sequence, similar to a project planning board for a spin-off series. The theme is a comical drunken boxing performance in front of a traditional Japanese temple, using stick figure movements paired with pencil background art. Canvas: Widescreen 16:9 storyboard pages on warm off-white paper with thin gray borders, monochrome pencil drawing style, supplemented with a few colored moving arrows. Top title bar displays:{argument name="project title" default="mMansion Spin-off | Shin Ooya nO "Drunken Fist Performance" Rough Storyboard"} Below, in small Japanese print, are the production notes: "15 seconds / 16:9 / Stickman acting design / Design for underage characters drinking and dancing." Layout: Precise 6-panel storyboard, arranged in a 3-column x 2-row grid. Each storyboard is a rounded rectangular card with a black shot label badge in the upper left corner, next to the Japanese shot title. The background is a temple courtyard drawn in gray pencil, and the image features a black stick figure performing exaggerated drunken boxing moves, accompanied by color annotations. Below each drawing area are compact Japanese production notes labeled as performance memos, camera, and background. Maintaining a rough animation planning look rather than a detailed comic book style. Scene Background: Each storyboard showcases the same traditional Japanese temple entrance: a large temple gate or main hall in the center of the background, flanked by stone steps, stone lanterns, a gravel garden, and delicate trees; architectural details are drawn with fine gray pencil lines. The background maintains consistency across storyboards, with only subtle compositional variations. Stick figures are drawn using black lines; green arrows indicate body movement or a shift in weight; red arrows/arcs indicate primary actions; and blue arrows indicate secondary actions. Number of Storyboards and Content: 6 panels in total: 1. Tag: “SHOT 01 0.0–2.0s”, Title: “Appearing with Chidori Feet”. The stick figure wobbles in from the left, one arm raised, body tilting and losing balance, with red footprints marking its feet. The drawing includes three small white slips of paper with notes: “Weight → Flowing to the left”, “Shoulder to shoulder”, “Feet land one step too far”. 2. Tag: “SHOT 02” 2.0–4.0s, titled "The Cup is Constructed." A stick figure raises one hand, seemingly holding an invisible cup, while taking a large stride; green arrows indicate torso twisting and weight shifting, and there are blue markings near the hand. It includes three white slips of paper: "Holding an Empty Cup," "Facial Expressions," and "Escape from the Right Side." 3. Tag: "SHOT 03" 4.0–6.5s, titled “Falling Down → Low-lying”. The stick figure falls into an extremely low sweeping leg pose, one leg extended, torso tilted, red arc arrow sweeping across the ground, accompanied by a green vertical balancing arrow. Includes three white slips of paper: “Falling Down,” “Flowing from the Chest to Half-Enclosed,” and “Exploring the Bed with Hands.” 4. Tag: “SHOT 04 6.5–9.0s,” titled “Falling Backwards.” The stick figure rotates unstablely in the center, with a large red circular arrow around the body and a small blue reverse arrow near the head. Includes three white slips of paper: “Upper Body Falling Backwards,” “Backwards Arrow Mark,” and “Sighting First.” 5. Tag: “SHOT 05” 9.0–12.0s, titled "Drunk Dodge → Palm Strike". The stick figure leans back in a drunken dodge, simultaneously extending a palm strike to the right; a long red arrow indicates the palm movement, and a green arrow shows an S-shaped torso movement. Includes three white strips of paper: "S-shaped body axis", "Dodge → Return", and "Palm Strike is a Stop". A narrow, vertical temple sign is added to the background on the right. 6. Tag: "SHOT 06" 12.0–15s”, titled “The Decision of the House Rental Recycling Fist”. The stick figure ends in a comical victory pose, one hand raised holding a small yellow paper slip with the character “札” written on it, the body upright but still showing signs of intoxication; the red arc near the feet indicates swaying. It contains three white paper slips: “止まれない决めポーズ”, “お札を見せる”, and “最后にドヤ顏”. Text and Notes: Titles, shot labels, shot subtitles, note notes, and production memos should all be in visible Japanese text. Memo text should appear realistic, but some content can be very small and barely legible. At the bottom of the page, add a line of Japanese director instructions: “演指导：酔拳らしい『脱力・遅れ・崩れ・戻り』を、攻撃ではなくコミカルな演舞として見せる。実饮喝表演は入れない。” Visual Style: Rough monochrome storyboards, concise production design sheets, light beige backgrounds, thin gray storyboard borders, black stick figures, hand-drawn pencil temple art, and minimalist color accents of red, green, blue, and yellow. The lines are slightly imperfect, the composition is clear, and it has a professional animation pre-show feel. Constraints: Use precise 6 storyboards, strictly adhere to the listed shot labels and time ranges, keep characters as simple stick figures without detailed facial features, avoid photorealism, avoid modern urban elements, avoid additional storyboards, avoid cartoon bubble style, and do not depict actual drinking or alcohol consumption.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为动画/喜剧动作序列创建一个简洁的粗略分镜表，类似于衍生剧集的项目策划板。主题是在日本传统寺庙前进行的滑稽醉拳表演，使用火柴人动作配合铅笔背景艺术。

画布：宽屏 16:9 分镜页面，采用暖米白色纸张，带有细灰色边框，单色铅笔画风格，辅以少量彩色运动箭头。顶部标题栏显示：“{argument name="project title" default="mMansion Spin-off｜新大家 nO「酔拳の演舞」ラフストーリーボード"}”。下方添加日语小字制作备注：“15秒 / 16:9 / 棒人間演技設計 / 未成年キャラのため飲酒なし・酔ったふりの演舞として設計”。

布局：精确的 6 格分镜，排列为 3 列 × 2 行的网格。每个分镜是一个圆角矩形卡片，左上角带有黑色镜头标签徽章，旁边是日语镜头标题，背景为灰度铅笔绘制的寺庙庭院，画面中是执行夸张醉拳动作的黑色火柴人，并配有彩色标注。在每个绘图区域下方，包含紧凑的日语制作备注，标注为表演备忘录、摄像机和背景。保持粗略的动画策划外观，而非精细的漫画。

场景背景：每个分镜展示相同的日本传统寺庙入口：背景中央为大型寺庙门或大殿，两侧有石阶、石灯笼、砾石庭院、精致的树木，建筑细节以细灰色铅笔线条绘制。保持背景在各分镜间的一致性，仅有细微的构图变化。使用黑色线条绘制火柴人，绿色箭头表示身体流动或重心转移，红色箭头/弧线表示主要动作，蓝色箭头表示次要动作。

分镜数量及内容，共 6 格：
1. 标签为“SHOT 01 0.0–2.0s”，标题为“千鳥足で登場”。火柴人从左侧摇晃入场，单臂举起，身体倾斜失去平衡，脚下有红色足迹标记。绘图内包含三张白色小纸条备注：“重心→左へ流す”、“肩を抜く”、“足は一歩遅れて着地”。
2. 标签为“SHOT 02 2.0–4.0s”，标题为“杯をかわす構え”。火柴人举起一只手，仿佛拿着隐形的杯子，同时大步跨出；绿色箭头显示躯干扭转和重心转移，手部附近有蓝色标记。包含三张白色纸条：“空の盃を持つ”、“顔はふにゃっと”、“腰は右に逃がす”。
3. 标签为“SHOT 03 4.0–6.5s”，标题为“崩れ落ち→低い払い”。火柴人跌入极低的扫堂腿姿势，一条腿伸展，躯干倾斜，红色弧形箭头扫过地面，配有绿色垂直平衡箭头。包含三张白色纸条：“落ちるフリ”、“胸が半円に流れる”、“手で床を探る”。
4. 标签为“SHOT 04 6.5–9.0s”，标题为“ふらつき回転”。火柴人在中心不稳定地旋转，身体周围有一个大的红色圆形箭头，头部附近有一个小的蓝色反向箭头。包含三张白色纸条：“上体は遅れる”、“回転矢印”、“視線だけ先行”。
5. 标签为“SHOT 05 9.0–12.0s”，标题为“酔い避け→掌底”。火柴人向后倾斜进行醉酒式闪避，同时向右伸出一记掌击；长红色箭头指示掌部动作，绿色箭头显示 S 型躯干流动。包含三张白色纸条：“S字の体軸”、“避ける→返す”、“掌底は寸止め”。在右侧背景添加一个狭长的垂直寺庙招牌。
6. 标签为“SHOT 06 12.0–15s”，标题为“家賃回収拳の決め”。火柴人以滑稽的胜利姿势结束，一只手举起拿着一张写有“札”字的小黄纸条，身体直立但仍带醉意；脚部附近的红色弧线显示摇晃。包含三张白色纸条：“止まれない決めポーズ”、“お札を見せる”、“最後にドヤ顔”。

文字与备注：标题、镜头标签、镜头副标题、纸条备注和制作备忘录均使用日语可见文字。备忘录文字应看起来真实，但部分内容可极小且难以辨认。在页面底部，添加一行日语导演指令：“演出方針：酔拳らしい『脱力・遅れ・崩れ・戻り』を、攻撃ではなくコミカルな演舞として見せる。実飲酒表現は入れない。”

视觉风格：粗略的单色分镜，简洁的制作设计表，淡淡的米色背景，细灰色分镜边框，黑色火柴人，手绘铅笔寺庙艺术，红色、绿色、蓝色和黄色的极简色彩点缀。线条略显不完美，构图清晰，具有专业的动画预演感。

约束条件：使用精确的 6 个分镜，严格遵守列出的镜头标签和时间范围，保持角色为简单的火柴人且无详细面部特征，避免照片写实主义，避免现代城市元素，避免额外分镜，避免漫画气泡风格，且不得描绘实际饮酒或酒精消费行为。

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a highly detailed, cinematic-quality 3D digital social media creator poster, featuring [the main character/feature].{argument name="character name" default="Mr Tariq"} The image showcases a stylish young male AI creator, confidently seated in a futuristic, neon-lit Instagram-themed studio. Canvas: Vertical poster, 3:4 aspect ratio, glossy high-resolution 3D rendering with strong depth-of-field effects, a deep purplish-black environment, reflective ground, and magenta and pink neon rim lighting. Subject: A stylish young man sits relaxed and confidently on the floor, one knee raised, the other extended towards the viewer. He wears modern glasses that match the overall style, a fitted white vest, and trendy {argument name="trouser color" default="pink"} Long trousers, white socks with pink stripes, a watch, a delicate necklace, and custom white and pink sneakers with a stylized pink logo on the side. His face is deliberately obscured by a centrally located, softly edged brownish-pink square occlusion, but his hair, ears, neck, arms, and clothing are clearly visible. The design utilizes realistic skin texture, a muscular physique, a cinematic fashion poster pose, and a high-end influencer brand feel. Background: Behind him is a giant, glowing Instagram-style app icon, oversized and slightly blurred, featuring a neon gradient effect of hot pink, purple, orange, and yellow. Floating social media interaction bubbles, glowing heart icons, and tiny pink notification particles are added throughout the dark studio. Left-side interface panel: Five translucent, rounded-corner neon UI cards are stacked vertically on the left, with pinkish-white halos around the edges. Card 1: Text "9.8K Likes," with a heart-shaped notification icon. Card 2: Camera icon, text "Capture Moments," subtitle "Stay creative." Card 3: Paper airplane icon, text "Share Your Story," subtitle "Connect globally." Card 4: People/network icon, text "Inspire Daily", subtitle "Motivate others". Card 5: Bar chart icon, text "Engagement +248%", subtitle "This Week". Floating interactive elements: Five clearly visible floating heart-shaped notification bubbles are included outside the left UI stack: a small heart bubble near the center of the left side of the main body, a small heart bubble with the number "1" near the upper right side, a small heart bubble in the middle of the right side, a large heart bubble in the foreground of the lower right corner, and a small heart bubble with the number "1" in the foreground of the lower left corner. Bottom typography: The creator's name is written in a large, glowing, handwritten neon pink and white font at the center of the bottom.{argument name="bottom signature text" default="Mr Tariq"} Directly below it, written in a futuristic sans-serif neon font.{argument name="subtitle text" default="AI Creator"} Maintain clear, centered layout that blends seamlessly with the ground lighting effects. Visual Style: Hyper-realistic cinematic 3D, glossy neon cyberpunk studio aesthetics, influencer marketing aesthetics, pink and purple tones, volumetric lighting, reflections, halos, shallow depth of field, clearly detailed clothing and footwear, high contrast, high-end digital poster quality. Constraints: Strictly retain all specified English text, keep the main subject in the foreground, maintain the dominant large Instagram icon in the background, and do not add any additional UI cards, watermarks, or irrelevant logos.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张超精细的电影级 3D 数字社交媒体创作者海报，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="Mr Tariq"}，展现一位时尚的年轻男性 AI 创作者，自信地坐在充满未来感的霓虹 Instagram 主题工作室中。

画布：竖版海报，3:4 纵横比，光泽感高分辨率 3D 渲染，具有强烈的景深效果，深紫黑色环境，反光地面，洋红色和粉色霓虹轮廓光。

主体：一位时尚的年轻男子以放松且自信的姿势坐在地板上，一膝抬起，另一条腿向观众方向伸展。他佩戴着符合整体风格的现代眼镜，身穿修身白色背心、潮流的 {argument name="trouser color" default="pink"} 长裤、带有粉色条纹的白袜、手表、细项链，以及定制的白粉配色运动鞋，鞋侧带有风格化的粉色标志。他的面部被一个位于中心、边缘柔和的棕粉色方形遮挡块刻意遮盖，但头发、耳朵、颈部、手臂和服装清晰可见。使用逼真的皮肤质感、健美修长的身材、电影级时尚海报姿势以及高端网红品牌感。

背景：在他身后放置一个巨大的发光 Instagram 风格应用图标，图标超大且略带模糊，呈现热粉色、紫色、橙色和黄色的霓虹渐变效果。在整个暗色工作室中添加漂浮的社交媒体互动气泡、发光的心形图标以及细小的粉色通知粒子。

左侧界面面板：在左侧垂直堆叠 5 个半透明圆角矩形霓虹 UI 卡片，边缘带有粉白色光晕。卡片 1：文字“9.8K Likes”，配有心形通知图标。卡片 2：相机图标，文字“Capture Moments”，副标题“Stay creative”。卡片 3：纸飞机图标，文字“Share Your Story”，副标题“Connect globally”。卡片 4：人物/网络图标，文字“Inspire Daily”，副标题“Motivate others”。卡片 5：柱状图图标，文字“Engagement +248%”，副标题“This Week”。

漂浮互动元素：在左侧 UI 堆叠外包含 5 个清晰可见的漂浮心形通知气泡：主体左侧中心附近有一个小爱心气泡，右上侧附近有一个带有数字“1”的小爱心气泡，右侧中部有一个小爱心气泡，右下角前景处有一个大爱心气泡，左下角前景处有一个带有数字“1”的小爱心气泡。

底部排版：在底部中心，用粉白色的大号发光手写霓虹字体书写创作者名称 {argument name="bottom signature text" default="Mr Tariq"}。在其正下方，用未来感无衬线霓虹字体书写 {argument name="subtitle text" default="AI Creator"}。保持排版清晰、居中，并与地面光效融为一体。

视觉风格：超写实电影级 3D，光泽感霓虹赛博工作室，网红营销美学，粉紫色调，体积光，反射，光晕，浅景深，清晰细腻的衣物和鞋履，高对比度，高端数字海报质感。

约束：严格保留所有指定的英文文本，保持主体位于前景，保持巨大的 Instagram 图标在背景中占据主导地位，不得添加额外的 UI 卡片，不得添加水印或无关的标志。

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed, cinematic 3D digital poster. At the center of the image is a young male AI creator, poised and confident, seated in a futuristic, dark-toned studio. He wears a simple black hoodie with a small X logo on the chest, a black bucket hat with an X logo, and modern glasses partially obscured by shadow. He completes the look with beige cargo jogging pants, a black watch, black socks with the X logo, and custom black high-top sneakers (with white laces, white soles, and glowing cyan X accents). Keep his face softly veiled or in shadow while maintaining a high-fashion poster aesthetic. Behind him, a large, metallic 3D glowing X logo with cyan neon edges forms the main background. The environment is a glossy black, reflective cyberpunk style, featuring floating holographic UI panels, digital scan lines, tiny particles, cyan circuitry, and reflections on a wet ground. It includes six precise floating graphic elements: a statistics panel on the left showing "28.5K LIKES", "12.1K REPOSTS", and "8.7M IMPRESSIONS", accompanied by heart, retweet, and eye icons; a strategy panel on the right listing "GO VIRAL / MAXIMIZE REACH", "BUILD INFLUENCE / GROW YOUR BRAND", and "TREND THE WORLD / LEAD THE FUTURE", accompanied by rocket, crowd, and earth icons; a small analytics card in the lower left showing "TRENDING TOP 1% CREATOR" with a rising bar chart; a separate X icon in the lower left; a glowing heart outline in the lower right; and an upward arrow/share icon near the lower right. At the bottom, a large cyan neon handwritten signature is added.{argument name="creator signature" default="Mr Tariq"} Below is text with smaller white spacing.{argument name="role text" default="AI CREATOR"} Employing a dramatic low-angle composition, high-contrast black and blue tones, volumetric contour lighting, sharp, glossy 3D rendering, realistic fabric folds, premium sneaker details, shallow depth of field, and a vertical poster proportion. Please do not add extra panels, extra characters, watermarks, or irrelevant text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超精细的电影级 3D 数字海报，画面中心是一位坐在未来感暗色调工作室中、姿态从容自信的年轻男性 AI 创作者。主体身穿一件简洁的黑色连帽衫，胸前带有小巧的 X 徽标，头戴印有 X 标志的黑色渔夫帽，现代感眼镜部分隐于阴影中，穿着米色工装慢跑裤、黑色腕表、带有 X 标记的黑色短袜，以及定制的黑色高帮运动鞋（配有白色鞋带、白色鞋底和发光的青色 X 点缀）。保持面部柔和遮蔽或处于阴影中，同时呈现高级时尚海报的质感。在他身后，放置一个巨大的金属质感 3D 发光 X 标志，边缘带有青色霓虹灯光，作为主要背景。环境为光泽感黑色、具有反射效果的赛博朋克风格，伴有悬浮的全息 UI 面板、数字扫描线、微小粒子、青色电路以及湿润地面上的倒影。包含 6 个精确的悬浮图形元素：左侧 1 个统计面板，显示“28.5K LIKES”、“12.1K REPOSTS”和“8.7M IMPRESSIONS”，配有心形、转发和眼睛图标；右侧 1 个策略面板，列出“GO VIRAL / MAXIMIZE REACH”、“BUILD INFLUENCE / GROW YOUR BRAND”和“TREND THE WORLD / LEAD THE FUTURE”，配有火箭、人群和地球图标；左下方 1 个小型分析卡片，显示“TRENDING TOP 1% CREATOR”及上升的柱状图；左下方 1 个独立的 X 标志；右下方 1 个发光的心形轮廓；以及右下方附近 1 个向上的箭头/分享图标。在底部，添加一个巨大的青色霓虹手写签名 {argument name="creator signature" default="Mr Tariq"}，下方配有较小的白色间距文本 {argument name="role text" default="AI CREATOR"}。采用戏剧性的低角度构图，高对比度的黑青色调，体积轮廓光，锐利的光泽感 3D 渲染，逼真的织物褶皱，高级运动鞋细节，浅景深，以及竖版海报比例。请勿添加额外的面板、额外的人物、水印或无关文本。

templates.title: Neon-style WhatsApp AI Creator Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹风格 WhatsApp AI 创作者海报

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a high-quality, cinematic 3D digital poster for personal branding materials, featuring [the subject/character].{argument name="character name" default="Mr Tariq"} , identity is{argument name="profession title" default="AI Creator"} The theme is a glossy WhatsApp-style neon green. Canvas: Vertical 4:5 poster composition, deep black to dark green studio background, reflective floor, dramatic rim lighting, high contrast, premium social media promotional look. Subject: A stylish young man sits in a relaxed yet professional pose on a dark green modern swivel chair. He wears modern glasses (as seen), a light sage green polo shirt with a small WhatsApp logo on the chest, crisp white trousers, and white low-top sneakers with green accents and a small WhatsApp logo. He holds a white coffee cup in his right hand, also with a small green WhatsApp logo. He has his legs casually crossed, one hand near his knee, and wears a dark watch. The body is rendered using photorealistic 3D rendering with sophisticated cinematic lighting; the face is kept understated and customizable rather than overly detailed. Background focal element: A large glossy 3D WhatsApp-style icon with a bright white outline and a green circular body is cropped at the edge of the canvas to the right rear of the subject. Add glowing green rings and curves around the ground and background to create depth and dynamism. Text content: In the upper left corner, use a striking neon green handwritten font.{argument name="character name" default="Mr Tariq"} Directly below it, written in a simple white sans-serif font.{argument name="profession title" default="AI Creator"} The left-side social data panel contains five stacked, rounded glass-like cards with neon green outlines and soft glows. The first card features a heart icon and the text "9.8K," labeled "Likes." The second card has a user icon and the text "6.7K," labeled "Followers." The third card has a paper airplane icon and the text "3.2K," labeled "Shares." The fourth card has an upward-pointing chart icon and the text "Stay Connected," with smaller text below saying "Grow Together." The fifth card has a group/network icon and the text "Build Connections," with smaller text below saying "Inspire the World." Floating icons: Seven floating chat/message elements are added around the poster: a small chat bubble near the top center, a medium chat bubble near the upper left side of the main body, a small chat bubble near the bottom left edge, a small chat bubble near the left side of the main body's knee area, a medium chat bubble near the right side of the chair armrest, a circular profile chat icon near the bottom right corner of the main body, and a larger, tilted chat bubble near the bottom right corner. All elements should be a glossy dark green with neon green outlines and white dots/message details. Visual style: Hyper-realistic cinematic 3D rendering, glossy textures, volumetric green halo, high-end tech-influencer aesthetics, shallow depth of field, clear subject, realistic clothing wrinkles, clean typography, black and neon green color scheme, accented with white. Constraints: Use only WhatsApp-style visual branding elements; no additional logos are allowed except for shirts, mugs, shoes, large background icons, and floating chat icons. Keep the layout clean and legible, with no watermarks, no extra characters, and no additional statistics beyond the 5 listed cards.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为个人品牌资料创建一个超高质量的电影级 3D 数字海报，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="Mr Tariq"}，身份是 {argument name="profession title" default="AI Creator"}，采用亮面 WhatsApp 风格的霓虹绿主题。

画布：垂直 4:5 海报构图，深黑至深绿色的摄影棚背景，反光地板，戏剧性的轮廓光，高对比度，高级社交媒体宣传外观。

主体：一位时尚的年轻男性，以放松且专业的姿势坐在深绿色现代旋转休闲椅上。他佩戴着现代感眼镜（如可见），身穿浅鼠尾草绿色的 Polo 衫，胸前印有小巧的 WhatsApp 标志，穿着干练的白色长裤，以及带有绿色点缀和小型 WhatsApp 标志的白色低帮运动鞋。他右手拿着一个白色咖啡杯，杯上也印有小巧的绿色 WhatsApp 标志。他双腿随意交叉，一只手放在膝盖附近，佩戴着深色手表。使用照片级 3D 渲染身体，配合精致的电影级灯光；保持面部不突兀或可自定义，而非过度细节化。

背景焦点元素：主体右后方有一个巨大的亮面 3D WhatsApp 风格图标，带有明亮的白色轮廓和绿色圆形主体，被画布边缘部分裁剪。在地面和背景周围添加发光的绿色圆环和弧线，以营造深度和动感。

文字内容：在左上角，用醒目的霓虹绿色手写字体书写 {argument name="character name" default="Mr Tariq"}。在其正下方，用简洁的白色无衬线字体书写 {argument name="profession title" default="AI Creator"}。

左侧社交数据面板：包含 5 张堆叠的圆角玻璃拟态卡片，带有霓虹绿轮廓和柔和光晕。第 1 张卡片带有心形图标和文字“9.8K”，标签为“Likes”。第 2 张卡片带有用户图标和文字“6.7K”，标签为“Followers”。第 3 张卡片带有纸飞机图标和文字“3.2K”，标签为“Shares”。第 4 张卡片带有向上图表图标和文字“Stay Connected”，下方小字为“Grow Together”。第 5 张卡片带有群组/网络图标和文字“Build Connections”，下方小字为“Inspire the World”。

浮动图标：在海报周围添加 7 个浮动聊天/消息元素：顶部中心附近一个小聊天气泡，主体左侧上半身附近一个中等聊天气泡，左下边缘附近一个小聊天气泡，主体膝盖区域左侧附近一个小聊天气泡，椅子扶手右侧附近一个中等聊天气泡，主体右下角附近一个圆形个人资料聊天图标，以及右下角附近一个较大的倾斜聊天气泡。所有元素均应为亮面深绿色，带有霓虹绿轮廓和白色点/消息细节。

视觉风格：超写实电影级 3D 渲染，亮面材质，体积感绿色光晕，高端科技网红美学，浅景深，主体清晰，逼真的衣物褶皱，简洁的排版，黑色与霓虹绿配色，点缀白色。

约束：仅使用 WhatsApp 风格的视觉品牌元素，除衬衫、杯子、鞋子、大型背景图标和浮动聊天图案外，不得添加额外标志。保持布局整洁易读，无水印，无额外人物，除列出的 5 张卡片外，不得添加额外统计数据。

templates.title: Neon Facebook Creator Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹 Facebook 创作者海报

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a highly detailed, cinematic 3D digital poster for a social media content creator. The central figure is a confident, stylish young man crouching in a futuristic neon-lit studio dominated by Facebook-style branding elements. Canvas: Vertical poster, 3:4 aspect ratio, high-resolution glossy 3D rendering, deep electric blue color scheme, bright white neon highlights, reflective blue-black ground, shallow depth of field, dramatic rim lighting, floating holographic UI elements, and a vibrant social media atmosphere. Subject: A stylish young man with short black hair and a modern look, his face deliberately obscured by a soft rectangular blur/mosaic. He crouches confidently, one arm resting on his knee, the other hanging naturally. Clothing: Sparkling{argument name="jacket color" default="Electric Blue"} An oversized down jacket with a small white "facebook" logo on the chest, a white T-shirt, slim-fit blue jogging pants, and custom blue and white high-top sneakers. The sneakers feature a prominent lowercase lettering on the side.{argument name="platform logo letter" default="f"} The fabric needs to have a glossy and luxurious feel, with realistic wrinkles and reflections. Background focus: a large, glowing white lowercase letter.{argument name="platform logo letter" default="f"} Standing behind the main subject like a luminous monument, it possesses a substantial 3D depth and a blue rim light. Foreground title typography: At the bottom center of the image, an elegant, luminous cursive signature is superimposed, containing the following text:{argument name="character name" default="Mr Tariq"} Below it, add a smaller, futuristic blocky font with the following text:{argument name="role text" default="CONTENT CREATOR"} Both layers of text should be a bright neon blue-white, partially overlapping the upper part of the body's legs. The left-side holographic analysis panel contains four stacked rectangular blue neon dashboard cards with clear labels and numerical values: 1) "9.8K Likes," with an upward line graph and arrows; 2) "Engagement +256% vs last month," with a vertical bar graph; 3) "Followers 125K Total Audience," with a double-person icon; 4) "Content Reach 2.4M People Reached," with an upward line graph. Below these are four smaller circular motivation buttons: 1) "Imagine — Visualize your dreams," with a star icon; 2) "Create — Make it happen," with a compass/goal icon; 3) "Inspire — Motivate others," with a spark icon; 4) "Elevate — Reach new heights," with a rocket icon. Right-side holographic panel: Contains four floating miniature message cards: 1) “Stay Focused — Keep Creating”, 2) “Dream Big — Work Smart”, 3) “No Limits — Just Passion”, 4) “Messages 99+ — New Messages”. The style is a glowing circular blue bubble with tiny icons. Floating social interaction elements: 12 visible interactive elements are distributed throughout the scene: four like icons, three heart icons, three laugh emojis, one small profile notification point, and one chat/message bubble. A large 3D blue like cube is added to the lower left foreground, and a partially cropped red heart interactive sphere is added to the lower right foreground. Visual style: Ultra-refined cinematic 3D advertising poster, glossy blue neon reflections, volumetric beams, bokeh particles, holographic UI glowing effects, futuristic creator-economy aesthetics, clear typography, high-quality rendering, no superfluous characters, no watermarks, and no irrelevant text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为社交媒体内容创作者创作一张超精细的电影级 3D 数字海报，画面中心是一位自信蹲在未来感霓虹灯工作室里的时尚青年，工作室以 Facebook 风格的品牌元素为主导。

画布：竖版海报，3:4 长宽比，高分辨率光泽 3D 渲染，深电光蓝配色，明亮的白色霓虹高光，反光的蓝黑色地面，浅景深，戏剧性的轮廓光，悬浮的全息 UI 元素，充满活力的社交媒体氛围。

主体：一位留着黑色短发、造型现代的时尚青年，面部特意用柔和的矩形模糊/马赛克遮挡。他以自信的姿势蹲着，一只手臂搭在膝盖上，另一只手自然下垂。服装：闪亮的 {argument name="jacket color" default="电光蓝"} 超大款羽绒服，胸前带有小巧的白色 “facebook” 字样，白色 T 恤，修身蓝色慢跑裤，以及定制的蓝白配色高帮运动鞋。运动鞋侧面印有醒目的小写 {argument name="platform logo letter" default="f"}。面料需呈现光泽感和高级感，并带有逼真的褶皱和反光。

背景核心：一个巨大的发光白色小写 {argument name="platform logo letter" default="f"} 像一座发光的纪念碑一样矗立在主体身后，具有厚实的 3D 深度和蓝色轮廓光。

前景标题排版：在画面下部中心，叠加一个优雅且发光的草书签名，内容为 {argument name="character name" default="Mr Tariq"}。在其正下方，添加较小的未来感块状字体，内容为 {argument name="role text" default="CONTENT CREATOR"}。两层文字均应为明亮的霓虹蓝白色，并部分覆盖在主体的腿部上方。

左侧全息分析面板：包含 4 个堆叠的矩形蓝色霓虹仪表盘卡片，带有清晰的标签和数值：1) “9.8K Likes”，配有上升折线图和箭头；2) “Engagement +256% vs last month”，配有垂直柱状图；3) “Followers 125K Total Audience”，配有双人图标；4) “Content Reach 2.4M People Reached”，配有上升折线图。在它们下方，包含 4 个较小的圆形激励按钮：1) “Imagine — Visualize your dreams”，配有星星图标；2) “Create — Make it happen”，配有指南针/目标图标；3) “Inspire — Motivate others”，配有火花图标；4) “Elevate — Reach new heights”，配有火箭图标。

右侧全息面板：包含 4 个悬浮的小型消息卡片：1) “Stay Focused — Keep Creating”，2) “Dream Big — Work Smart”，3) “No Limits — Just Passion”，4) “Messages 99+ — New Messages”。样式为带有微小图标的发光圆形蓝色气泡。

悬浮社交互动元素：在场景中分布 12 个可见的互动元素：4 个点赞图标、3 个爱心图标、3 个大笑表情符号、1 个小型个人资料通知点和 1 个聊天/消息气泡。在左下角前景处加入一个巨大的 3D 蓝色点赞立方体，右下角前景处加入一个被部分裁剪的红色爱心互动球。

视觉风格：超精细的电影级 3D 广告海报，光泽感的蓝色霓虹反射，体积光束，散景粒子，全息 UI 发光效果，未来感创作者经济美学，清晰的排版，高级渲染质量，无多余人物，无水印，无无关文字。

templates.title: Country-style pasta making tutorial reference board

titleLocalized.zh: 乡村风意面制作教程参考板

templates.prompt: Objective: For a{argument name="video duration" default="15 seconds"} Create a comprehensive reference project based on a realistic pasta-making tutorial video. Design it as a clean, high-end production reference, not a poster. The project should clearly convey the story sequence, character design, scene atmosphere, aspect ratio, and shooting constraints. Canvas: Widescreen 16:9 landscape reference project with elegant white margins and clean white gaps between panels. Employ warm, cinematic country lighting, realistic photography, shallow depth of field, earthy browns, powder whites, copper highlights, antique wood grain, and a sophisticated gourmet film aesthetic. Top sequence bar: The top contains nine numbered small production panels, each with a white circular number badge in the upper left corner. The nine panels represent: 1) a mound of flour on a wooden table; 2) cracking eggs into the flour mound with both hands; 3) mixing eggs and flour with a fork; 4) kneading dough with flour-covered hands; 5) placing a smooth, round pasta dough on a floured "project"; 6) rolling dough with a wooden rolling pin with both hands; 7) cutting or separating long strips of fresh pasta with both hands; 8) scooping fresh pasta from a boiling copper pot; and 9) plating pasta with garnish and sauce. The middle reference row uses five larger reference panels. Panel 1 is a close-up portrait of the presenter, a young, country-style woman with long, wavy hair, wearing a soft linen blouse and a delicate necklace. Her face is deliberately left blank as a placeholder to allow for flexible identification. Panel 2 is a full-body reference of the same presenter, wearing a cream-colored embroidered apron or tunic, paired with an olive green skirt and brown boots, standing in a country kitchen. Panel 3 is a medium shot of the presenter rolling out dough or preparing pasta at a wooden table, with her face blurred as a placeholder. Panel 4 is a back view of her outfit, showcasing her partially tied-up wavy hair, cream-colored shirt, dark green skirt, and apron tie. Panel 5 is a panoramic view of a cozy old-world farmhouse kitchen, featuring rough stucco walls, exposed wooden beams, shelves for dishes and jars, hanging herbs, copper pots, a vintage stove, a wooden workbench, flour, eggs, and warm sunlight streaming through the windows. The bottom specification strip: A clean white area at the bottom contains five simple black outline icons and labels or implicit tags: 1) a round badge marked "15 SEC", 2) a rectangular badge marked "16:9", 3) a vintage film camera icon, 4) a sun/sunlight icon, and 5) a steaming pasta icon. At the far right corner, add a tag with visible brand text.{argument name="brand text" default="BudgetPixel"} Camera lens markings. Main details: The presenter should be presented as {argument name="host style" default="A young Italian farmhouse chef with a rustic style"} Clothing should be natural linen, cream-colored embroidery, an olive green skirt, an apron with ties, and worn leather boots. The kitchen should present a…{argument name="kitchen style" default="rural Tuscan farmhouses"} The design should have a practical, cluttered feel to food preparation, yet still be art-directed and elegant. Visual style: realistic cinematography, warm golden window lighting, soft contrast, authentic flour and dough textures, copper cookware, weathered wood, realistic handmade pasta, and edited project composition. Keep the typography clean and functional. Constraints: Avoid posters with excessive text. Maintain the precise number of panels: 9 steps at the top, 5 reference panels in the middle, and 5 icons at the bottom. Maintain clean white spacing, white margins, numbered process badges, realistic food styling, and a professional video production reference project layout.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为一部 {argument name="video duration" default="15 秒"} 的写实意面制作教程视频创建一个综合参考项目，设计为简洁的高端制作参考项目，而非海报。该项目应能一目了然地传达故事顺序、角色造型、场景氛围、长宽比和拍摄限制。

画布：宽屏 16:9 横向参考项目，带有优雅的白色边距和面板间清晰的白色间隙。采用温暖的电影感乡村照明、写实摄影、浅景深、大地棕色、面粉白色、铜色高光、古董木纹以及高级美食电影质感。

顶部序列条：顶部包含 9 个编号的小型制作面板，每个面板左上角均带有白色圆形数字徽章。9 个面板分别为：1) 木桌上堆成小山的面粉坑，2) 双手将鸡蛋打入面粉坑，3) 用叉子将鸡蛋与面粉混合，4) 沾满面粉的双手揉面，5) 一个光滑的圆形意面面团放在撒了面粉的“项目”上，6) 双手用木制擀面杖擀面，7) 双手切割或分离长条新鲜意面，8) 新鲜意面从沸腾的铜锅中捞出，9) 装盘并配上装饰和酱汁的意面。

中间参考行：使用 5 个较大的参考面板拼贴。面板 1 是主持人的特写肖像，一位乡村风格的年轻女性，留着波浪长卷发，穿着柔软的亚麻衬衫，佩戴精致项链，脸部特意留白作为模糊占位符，以便灵活设定身份。面板 2 是同一主持人的全身服装参考，穿着奶油色刺绣围裙或束腰外衣，搭配橄榄绿裙子和棕色靴子，站在乡村厨房中。面板 3 是主持人在木桌上擀面或准备意面的中景动作镜头，脸部同样为模糊占位符。面板 4 是服装背部参考，展示部分扎起的波浪长发、奶油色衬衫、深绿色裙子和围裙系带。面板 5 是温馨旧世界农舍厨房的环境全景，带有粗糙的灰泥墙、裸露的木梁、摆放碗罐的架子、悬挂的香草、铜锅、复古炉灶、木制工作台、面粉、鸡蛋以及透过窗户射入的温暖阳光。

底部制作规格带：底部留出干净的白色区域，包含 5 个简单的黑色轮廓图标及标签或隐含标签：1) 标有“15 SEC”的圆形徽章，2) 标有“16:9”的矩形徽章，3) 复古电影摄像机图标，4) 太阳/日光图标，5) 冒着热气的意面图标。在右下角最远处，添加一个带有可见品牌文本 {argument name="brand text" default="BudgetPixel"} 的相机镜头标记。

主体细节：主持人应呈现为 {argument name="host style" default="乡村风格的意大利年轻农舍厨师"}；服装应为天然亚麻、奶油色刺绣、橄榄绿裙子、围裙系带和磨损的皮靴。厨房应呈现为 {argument name="kitchen style" default="乡村托斯卡纳农舍"}，带有实用的食物准备杂乱感，但仍需经过艺术指导并保持优雅。

视觉风格：写实电影摄影、温暖的金色窗光、柔和对比度、真实的面粉和面团质感、铜制炊具、风化木材、手工意面的真实感、编辑制作项目构图。保持排版简洁且功能化。

限制：不要制作文字过多的海报。保留顶部 9 个步骤面板、中间 5 个参考面板和底部 5 个图标的精确数量。保持干净的白色间隙、白色边距、编号流程徽章、写实的美食造型以及专业的视频制作参考项目布局。

templates.title: post-apocalyptic wasteland alien warriors

titleLocalized.zh: 末日废土外星战士

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic vertical sci-fi movie poster, showcasing the image.{argument name="character name" default="A muscular, lonely male survivor"} He crouched on the rugged rocks of a desolate alien wasteland. His posture was low and powerful, one knee bent forward, one hand on the ground, the other gripping a black-bladed dagger with a curved bone handle, the tip pointing downwards. His face was covered by a flat, centered, featureless, warm brown rectangular mask, revealing short, dark hair above. Dress him {argument name="armor color" default="Weathered olive green and brown"} The post-apocalyptic wasteland-style armor features heavy, layered shoulder armor, with intricate woven mesh and rope patterns covering the shoulders and chest, along with belts, metal rings, buckles, forearm braces, fingerless gloves, rugged tactical trousers, and heavy boots. A cloak or backpack is worn on the back. The background setting is {argument name="planetary landscape" default="A desolate, rocky desert, with rugged spires and eroded mountains visible in the distance."} Bathed in the golden glow of a setting sun and shrouded in dust, the sky must feature two colossal celestial bodies: a massive rust-orange planet in the upper left background, and a smaller, grayish-brown moon in the upper right. Utilizing epic, high-contrast cinematic lighting effects, the image should feature warm brown and bronze tones, clear and detailed textures, volumetric cloud effects, realistic roughness, a powerful depth of field, and a heroic poster-like composition. The image should not contain any titles, logos, watermarks, or extraneous characters.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影级竖版科幻电影海报，画面展示 {argument name="character name" default="一位肌肉发达的孤独男性幸存者"} 蹲伏在荒凉外星废土的崎岖岩石上。他姿态低沉有力，单膝前屈，一手撑地，另一手紧握一把刀刃漆黑、带有弯曲骨柄的匕首，刀尖向下。他的面部被一个平整、居中、无特征的暖棕色长方形面具遮住，上方露出短促的深色头发。为他穿上 {argument name="armor color" default="风化橄榄绿与棕色"} 的末日废土风格装甲：厚重的分层肩甲，肩部和胸部布满错综复杂的编织网和绳索图案，配有皮带、金属环、搭扣、前臂护腕、露指手套、粗犷的战术长裤、重型靴子，身后披着斗篷或背着行囊。背景设定为 {argument name="planetary landscape" default="一片荒芜的岩石沙漠，远处可见崎岖的尖塔和被侵蚀的山脉"}，在金色的落日余晖与尘雾笼罩下。天空中需呈现两颗巨大的天体：左上方背景中是一颗巨大的锈橙色行星，右上方是一颗较小的灰褐色卫星。采用史诗级高对比度电影光效，色调为暖棕褐色与青铜色，纹理清晰细腻，呈现体积云效果、写实的粗粝感、极具张力的景深，以及英雄式的海报构图，画面中不应包含任何标题文字、Logo、水印或多余字符。

templates.title: Four Q-version AI mascot robots

titleLocalized.zh: 四个 Q 版 AI 吉祥物机器人

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a series of adorable, chibi-style AI mascot robots in a wide, four-panel format. Each robot stands independently within its own vertical area, presenting an effect similar to a detailed 3D toy rendering, suitable for social media use. Canvas: Extra-wide horizontal banner, 4:1 aspect ratio, divided into four equal vertical panels with no obvious borders. Each panel uses a different color scheme and lighting atmosphere. Layout: Displaying four independent mascots, one in the center of each panel, all full-body images with rounded, helmet-like heads, large, glossy eyes, tiny smiling mouths, short, plush proportions, winter/sci-fi style clothing, soft studio lighting, highly detailed toy textures, shallow depth of field, and dreamy shimmering effects. Mascot 1: A warm beige and cream-colored robot mascot, inspired by {argument name="first mascot" default="Claude by Anthropic"} Wearing a knitted winter hat with pom-poms, headphones, a thick orange scarf, mittens, boots, and a cream-colored coat. The hat and coat feature a simple orange sunburst logo, and the words "Claude" and "BY ANTHROPIC" are clearly visible on a patch on the chest. The robot is waving. The background is a soft peach-beige with subtle starlight shimmering. Mascot 2: A green and cream-colored robot mascot, inspired by {argument name="second mascot" default="ChatGPT"} Wearing large headphones, a hooded winter jacket, a green scarf, shorts or thick trousers, sneakers, and a small tech badge. A green knot-shaped OpenAI-style logo adorns the forehead and jacket, and the words "ChatGPT" are clearly visible on the chest. The character raises a claw-like hand in greeting. The background is a warm cream color with golden highlights, and a tiny green sprout decoration adorns the side of the helmet. Mascot 3: A dreamy, soft-toned robotic mascot inspired by {argument name="third mascot" default="Grok"} Wearing a white helmet, with large eyes that blend blue and purple, a rainbow star floating above its head, a small star mark on its forehead, light purple headphones, and a white cloak with a pink and violet lining, adorned with star pendants, glowing bracelets, and white boots, the mascot stands joyfully waving from within a glowing rainbow ring. The background is a dreamy gradient of pink, purple, and blue nebulae, sparkling with numerous glitters. Mascot 4: A dark, futuristic robot mascot, inspired by {argument name="fourth mascot" default="xAI"} Wearing a glossy black cat-ear helmet or hood, a black down jacket, gloves, and boots with neon blue circular decorations. The face is made of black glass, with glowing blue eyes and a tiny, glowing mouth. Subtle xAI-style markings adorn the jacket sleeves, and the character is waving. The background is a deep navy blue spacescape with an electric blue halo, stars, and neon-rimmed lights. Visual Style: High-end cute 3D rendering, toy photography, kawaii collectible figure, rounded shape, soft vinyl/plusk texture combined with a glossy robot mask, cinematic lighting, clear details, vibrant and harmonious colors, and a cute and lively expression. Constraints: Maintain 4 panels and 4 mascots; do not add additional characters; each mascot should be clearly distinguishable through color scheme and branding; use only designated tiny text labels; avoid watermarks, titles, UI elements, or photorealistic humans.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一组宽幅四格的可爱 Q 版 AI 吉祥物机器人，每个机器人独立站立于各自的垂直区域内，呈现出类似精致 3D 玩具渲染图的效果，适合社交媒体使用。

画布：超宽横向横幅，4:1 纵横比，平均分为 4 个垂直面板，无明显边框，每个面板采用不同的配色方案和灯光氛围。

布局：展示 4 个独立的吉祥物，每个面板中心各一个，均为全身像，头部呈圆润头盔状，拥有超大光泽感眼睛、微小的微笑嘴型、短小的毛绒比例、冬季/科幻风格服装、柔和的摄影棚灯光、高细节玩具材质、浅景深以及梦幻闪光效果。

吉祥物 1：一个暖米色和奶油色的机器人吉祥物，灵感源自 {argument name="first mascot" default="Claude by Anthropic"}，戴着带绒球的针织冬帽、头戴式耳机、厚实的橙色围巾、连指手套、靴子和奶油色外套。帽子和外套上印有简单的橙色太阳光芒标志，胸前贴片上有清晰可见的“Claude”和“BY ANTHROPIC”小字。机器人正挥手致意。背景为柔和的桃米色，带有细微的星光闪烁。

吉祥物 2：一个绿色和奶油色的机器人吉祥物，灵感源自 {argument name="second mascot" default="ChatGPT"}，戴着大耳机、连帽冬装夹克、绿色围巾、短裤或加厚长裤、运动鞋以及小型科技徽章。前额区域和夹克上饰有绿色结状的 OpenAI 风格徽标，胸前有清晰可见的“ChatGPT”小字。角色举起一只爪子状的手打招呼。背景为带有金色光斑的暖奶油色，头盔旁有一个微小的绿色嫩芽装饰。

吉祥物 3：一个梦幻般的柔和色调机器人吉祥物，灵感源自 {argument name="third mascot" default="Grok"}，戴着白色头盔，拥有蓝色与紫色交织的大眼睛，头顶漂浮着一颗彩虹星，前额有小星星标记，戴着淡紫色耳机，披着内衬为粉色和紫罗兰色的白色斗篷，饰有星星挂件、发光手环和白色靴子。吉祥物站在发光的彩虹环中欢快地挥手。背景为梦幻般的粉色、紫色和蓝色星云渐变，带有大量闪光。

吉祥物 4：一个深色未来感机器人吉祥物，灵感源自 {argument name="fourth mascot" default="xAI"}，戴着光泽感的黑色猫耳头盔或兜帽，穿着黑色羽绒服、手套、靴子，并带有霓虹蓝圆形装饰。面部为黑色玻璃材质，拥有发光的蓝色眼睛和微小的发光嘴部。夹克袖子上带有微妙的 xAI 风格标记，角色正挥手致意。背景为深海军蓝色的太空，带有电光蓝色的光环、星星和霓虹边缘光。

视觉风格：高端可爱 3D 渲染，玩具摄影，卡哇伊收藏级手办，圆润造型，软乙烯基/毛绒质感与光泽感机器人面罩相结合，电影级灯光，细节清晰，色彩鲜艳且和谐，表情可爱生动。

约束条件：保持 4 个面板和 4 个吉祥物；不要添加额外角色；每个吉祥物应通过配色方案和品牌标识清晰区分；仅使用指定的微小文字标签；避免水印、标题、UI 元素或照片级真实感的人类。

templates.title: Neon Instagram Magic Heart Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹 Instagram 魔法爱心肖像

templates.prompt: Create a highly dramatic vertical fantasy composite photograph, with a figure at the center.{argument name="character description" default="handsome young man"} He sat cross-legged on the dark, reflective floor, wearing a {argument name="shirt style" default="Dark green button-down shirt with floral patterns, adorned with red and gold flowers, and an open collar."} He wore slim-fit black trousers and black loafers. His neatly parted black hair was obscured by a flat, opaque, medium-brown rectangular hood. He raised his left hand, tilting a clear glass downwards, pouring a stream of clear water into a glowing magical heart suspended above his right palm, which hovered above his chest. This heart was composed of fiery orange-red light, accompanied by green sparks, golden embers, splashing water, mist, and swirling smoke. Eight floating neon-style Instagram camera icons surrounded the subject: a large, tilted partial icon in the lower left corner, a large, tilted partial icon in the lower right foreground, a large, tilted icon on the left, a medium icon in the upper left, a large icon in the upper right, a small icon in the middle right, a medium icon in the center right, and a small icon in the lower right corner. A dark, smoky background filled with orange sparks, bokeh grain, and cinematic rim lighting was used. The overall style should be hyper-realistic, glossy, high-contrast, emotional, magical, and social media-themed, with vibrant magenta, orange, yellow, and purple neon lighting effects. Use a shallow depth-of-field effect to slightly blur the foreground icons while keeping the figures and glowing hearts sharp. There should be no readable text or watermarks in the image.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张极具戏剧性的竖版奇幻合成照片，画面中心是一位 {argument name="character description" default="英俊的年轻男子"}，他盘腿坐在深色反光地板上，身穿一件 {argument name="shirt style" default="深绿色花卉纽扣衬衫，饰有红色和金色花朵，领口敞开"}，搭配修身黑色长裤和黑色乐福鞋。他留着整齐的侧分黑发，但面部被一个平坦、不透明的中棕色矩形遮挡块覆盖。他左手抬起，将一个透明玻璃杯向下倾斜，将一股清澈的水流倒入悬浮在他胸前右手掌心上方的一颗发光魔法爱心中。这颗爱心由炽热的橙红色光芒组成，伴随着绿色电火花、金色余烬、飞溅的水花、薄雾和烟雾缭绕。在主体周围环绕 8 个悬浮的霓虹灯风格 Instagram 相机图标：左下角有一个大型倾斜的局部图标，右下角前景有一个大型倾斜的局部图标，左侧有一个大型倾斜图标，左上方有一个中型图标，右上方有一个大型图标，中右侧有一个小型图标，右侧中心有一个中型图标，右下角有一个小型图标。使用充满橙色火花、焦外成像颗粒和电影级轮廓光的深色烟雾背景。整体风格应呈现超写实、光泽感、高对比度、情绪化、魔幻且具有社交媒体主题，并带有鲜艳的洋红色、橙色、黄色和紫色霓虹光效。使用浅景深效果，使前景的图标略显模糊，而人物和发光的爱心保持清晰。画面中无任何可读文字，无水印。

templates.title: Barcelona fan stadium broadcast photos

titleLocalized.zh: 巴塞罗那球迷体育场转播照片

templates.prompt: Create a detailed, high-quality vertical sports broadcast photo to showcase{argument name="football club" default="FC Barcelona"} The image depicts a scene of fans crowding the stadium stands during a match. At the center of the frame are a young blonde woman and a young, dark-haired, bearded man posing for a photo in the stands, both wearing the club's blue and red striped home jerseys, featuring the team crest, a yellow Nike swoosh, and the Spotify sponsor logo. The man stands slightly to the right behind her, his arm around the woman's shoulder; the woman leans towards him, one hand on his waist, wearing a delicate necklace and flower-shaped earrings. Surrounding them are other supporters wearing the same jerseys, including a fan on the left raising their arm, a fan on the right holding a clear plastic beer mug, and a fan hat with yellow stripes and the words "FCBARCELONA" visible in the lower left corner. The image employs a realistic telephoto lens composition of the stadium crowd, shallow depth of field, natural stadium lighting, saturated club colors, and documentary-style sports photography details. Add broadcast graphics: A green scoreboard overlay in the style of UEFA Champions League is displayed in the top left corner, showing "BAR 2 - 1" and "MANCHESTER CITY," a white Korean TV channel logo in the top right corner, and a white "TUDN EN VIVO" watermark in the bottom left corner. Include four precise rectangular blurred face/privacy occlusion blocks: a large occlusion block above the center male face, a medium occlusion block above the center female face, a high occlusion block above the face of the fan with raised arms in the upper left center, and a medium occlusion block above the face of the fan in the upper right corner. Do not add extra figures in the foreground, do not change the pose of the center couple, and keep all visible branding consistent with {argument name="football club" default="FC Barcelona"} Consistency.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张细节丰富、高质量的竖版体育转播照片，展示 {argument name="football club" default="FC Barcelona"} 球迷在比赛期间挤满体育场看台的场景。画面中心为一名年轻的金发女性和一名年轻的深色头发蓄须男性，两人在看台上合影，均身穿该俱乐部的蓝红条纹主场球衣，球衣上带有队徽、黄色 Nike 对勾标志和 Spotify 赞助商标志。男性站在后方略偏右侧，手臂搂着女性的肩膀；女性向他靠拢，一只手搭在他的腰间，佩戴着精致的项链和花朵形状的耳环。周围是身穿同款球衣的其他支持者，包括左侧一名举起手臂的球迷、右侧一名手持透明塑料啤酒杯的球迷，以及左下角部分可见的带有黄色条纹的球迷帽，上面写着“FCBARCELONA”。采用逼真的长焦体育场观众构图、浅景深、自然的竞技场光线、饱和的俱乐部色彩以及纪实体育摄影的细节。添加转播图形：左上角显示 UEFA Champions League 风格的绿色记分牌叠加图层，显示“BAR 2 - 1”和“MANCHESTER CITY”，右上角有一个白色的韩式电视频道台标，左下角有一个白色的“TUDN EN VIVO”水印。包含精确的四个矩形模糊面部/隐私遮挡块：中心男性面部上方一个大遮挡块，中心女性面部上方一个中等遮挡块，左中上方举臂球迷面部上方一个高遮挡块，以及右上角球迷面部上方一个中等遮挡块。不要在前景中添加额外人物，不要改变中心情侣的姿势，并保持所有可见品牌与 {argument name="football club" default="FC Barcelona"} 的一致性。

templates.title: The man poured water on the Heart of Magic

titleLocalized.zh: 男子向魔法之心浇水

templates.prompt: Create a fantastical portrait with a cinematic feel, depicting a {argument name="character description" default="handsome young man"} He sat cross-legged on the damp, dark ground in a gloomy forest or dimly lit urban woodland at night. He was wearing a {argument name="shirt style" default="Dark emerald green floral pattern shirt, open collar"} He wore fitted black trousers and black shoes. His thick black hair was combed to one side, but his face was completely obscured by an opaque, medium-brown square veil in the center. His left hand hung at his knee, cradling a luminous magical heart composed of flames, emerald green energy, smoke, and molten light; the heart radiated orange flames, cyan mist, golden sparks, and bright light. His right hand was raised to his chest, tilting a clear glass, pouring water directly onto the burning heart, creating bright splashes, steam, and bursts of magical energy at the point where water and fire met. The photograph uses warm amber backlighting, a shallow depth of field, soft circular light spots in the background, and a wet, post-rain reflection on the ground. High contrast showcases realistic skin and fabric textures, fine hand details, dynamic particles, wisps of smoke, and a cinematic color gradation contrasting orange flames with cyan magic. Vertical composition, full-body seated pose, clearly visible from head to shoes, centered subject, hyper-realistic fantasy photography style, no text or watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅极具电影感的奇幻肖像，画面中一位 {argument name="character description" default="英俊的年轻男子"} 在夜晚的阴郁森林或昏暗的城市林地中，盘腿坐在潮湿的深色地面上。他身穿一件 {argument name="shirt style" default="深翡翠绿色花卉图案衬衫，领口敞开"}，搭配修身黑色长裤和黑色鞋子。他留着浓密的黑色头发，发丝向一侧梳起，但他的面部被一个位于正中央、不透明的中褐色方形遮挡块完全遮住。他的左手低垂在膝前，捧着一颗由火焰、翡翠绿能量、烟雾和熔融光芒构成的发光魔法之心；心脏散发出橙色火焰、青色薄雾、金色火花和明亮的光芒。他的右手抬至胸前，倾斜着一个透明玻璃杯，将水流直接浇在燃烧的心脏上，在水火交融处激起明亮的水花、蒸汽和魔法能量爆发。使用温暖的琥珀色背光，浅景深效果，背景带有柔和的圆形光斑，地面呈现雨后的湿润倒影，高对比度，展现逼真的皮肤和织物纹理，精细的手部细节，动态粒子，缕缕烟雾，以及橙色火焰与青绿色魔法对比的电影级调色。竖构图，全身坐姿，从头部到鞋子清晰可见，主体居中，超写实奇幻摄影风格，无文字或水印。
