templates.title: Luxury Jamaica Festival Bread Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华牙买加 Festival Bread 海报

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a high-end, luxurious food advertising poster for a Jamaican street food brand, centered around a close-up of golden-brown fried Jamaican festival bread placed on thick, soft white bread slices. The background will have a dark, cinematic feel, complemented by warm orange-gold lighting. Canvas: 1:1 square poster, high resolution, dark, emotional food photography aesthetic. Use a black and dark brown textured wooden table as the background to create a smoky atmosphere, employing dramatic sidelighting, shallow depth of field, and highlighting the sheen of the fried bread. Subject: In the right center foreground, place a large oval-shaped golden-brown Jamaican festival bread, crispy and bubbly, atop two stacked thick white bread slices. A small black bowl containing yellow dipping sauce is placed at the lower right edge, partially cropped. Additional blurred fried festival bread is added to the dark textured bowl in the upper right background, and a very blurred piece of fried bread is added to the bottom foreground to enhance depth of field. Brand and Text: Placed in the upper left corner.{argument name="brand name" default="Marcellina’s Kitchen"} The logo features a gold line art design, including an illustration of a Jamaican female chef within an arched frame, with the smaller text "JAMAICAN GOODNESS" below. The main title on the left reads "Jamaican" in gold handwriting, below which is a large, distressed cream-colored block of text reading "FESTIVAL BREAD." A slogan is added below the title.{argument name="tagline" default="Golden. Soft. Irresistible."} Use small gold italic lettering. Logo: Contains two circular logos in the upper right area: 1) A thin gold ring stamp with "MADE WITH LOVE" at the top and "TASTE OF HOME" at the bottom, with a hand-drawn heart in the center; 2) A fan-shaped gold stamp with "FRESHLY MADE DAILY" and a small heart above. Message Panel: In the lower left corner, add a rough gold-tipped label that reads "WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT". Below, list four advantages with small round gold icons and white text: 1) "Authentic Recipe", 2) "Soft & Fluffy Interior", 3) "Freshly Made", 4) "Perfect Pairing". Add a short description below:{argument name="description text" default="A classic Jamaican favorite with a soft interior and golden crispy exterior. Best enjoyed with cheese, butter, honey, jam, or dipping sauce."} Bottom Function Bar: The bottom area displays four small gold icons separated by thin vertical lines: 1) Leaf icon "NO PRESERVATIVES", 2) Shield icon "QUALITY INGREDIENTS", 3) Heart icon "MADE WITH LOVE", and 4) Clock icon "FRESH DAILY". Call to Action and Footer: A bold gold brush button is created in the lower left corner, displaying the following text:{argument name="call to action" default="ORDER NOW"} It features a black circular arrow icon. At the bottom center is "FOLLOW US," above which are five white social media icons: Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, WhatsApp, and a general chat/message icon. In the bottom right corner is "CONTACT US," accompanied by phone and email lines.{argument name="contact details" default="(876) 555-1234 · marcellinaskitchen@gmail.com"} At the very bottom, add the subtly spaced text "REAL INGREDIENTS. REAL FLAVOR. REAL JAMAICAN." followed by a small Jamaican flag logo. Visual style: High-end Caribbean food advertising, high contrast, black and gold color scheme, cream-colored distressed typography, gold handwritten accents, textured wood grain, alluring macro details, cinematic steam and sheen, luxurious street food brand feel. Ensure all text is clear and spelled correctly. Avoid adding unnecessary food, logos, icons, or cluttered elements.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为牙买加街头美食品牌创作一张高端奢华的美食广告海报，以放置在厚实软白面包片上的金黄炸牙买加 festival bread 特写镜头为核心，背景采用暗调电影感风格，并辅以温暖的橙金色灯光。

画布：1:1 正方形海报，高分辨率，暗调情绪化美食摄影美学。使用黑色和深棕色质感木桌作为背景，营造烟雾缭绕的氛围感，采用戏剧性的侧光、浅景深，并突出炸面包上的光泽感。

主体：在右中前景处，放置一块巨大的椭圆形金黄牙买加 festival bread，表皮酥脆且带有气泡，置于两片叠放的厚白面包之上。右下边缘放置一个小黑碗，内盛黄色蘸酱，进行局部裁剪。在右上背景的深色质感碗中增加额外的模糊炸 festival bread，并在底部前景增加一个非常模糊的炸面包以增强景深。

品牌与文字：左上角放置 {argument name="brand name" default="Marcellina’s Kitchen"} 的金色线条艺术 Logo，包含一个圆拱框内的牙买加女厨师插画，下方小字标注“JAMAICAN GOODNESS”。左侧大标题：金色手写体“Jamaican”，下方为巨大的做旧奶油色块文字“FESTIVAL BREAD”。标题下方添加标语 {argument name="tagline" default="Golden. Soft. Irresistible."}，使用小型金色斜体字。

徽标：在右上区域包含 2 个圆形徽标：1) 一个细金圆环印章，顶部写有“MADE WITH LOVE”，底部写有“TASTE OF HOME”，中心有一个手绘心形；2) 一个扇形金色印章，写有“FRESHLY MADE DAILY”，上方有一个小爱心。

信息面板：在左下角，添加一个粗糙的金色笔触标签，写着“WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT”。下方列出 4 行优势，配以小型圆形金色图标和白色文字：1) “Authentic Recipe”（正宗配方），2) “Soft & Fluffy Interior”（内里松软），3) “Freshly Made”（新鲜制作），4) “Perfect Pairing”（完美搭配）。下方添加一段简短说明：{argument name="description text" default="A classic Jamaican favorite with a soft interior and golden crispy exterior. Best enjoyed with cheese, butter, honey, jam, or dipping sauce."}

底部功能条：在底部区域，展示 4 个由细竖线分隔的小型金色图标功能：1) 叶子图标“NO PRESERVATIVES”（无防腐剂），2) 盾牌图标“QUALITY INGREDIENTS”（优质原料），3) 心形图标“MADE WITH LOVE”（用心制作），4) 时钟图标“FRESH DAILY”（每日新鲜）。

号召性用语与页脚：左下角创建一个粗体金色画笔按钮，写着 {argument name="call to action" default="ORDER NOW"}，并配有一个黑色圆形箭头图标。底部中心添加“FOLLOW US”，上方排列 5 个白色社交媒体图标：Instagram、Facebook、TikTok、WhatsApp 和一个通用聊天/消息图标。右下角添加“CONTACT US”，附带电话和电子邮件行：{argument name="contact details" default="(876) 555-1234 · marcellinaskitchen@gmail.com"}。最底部添加微小的间距文字“REAL INGREDIENTS. REAL FLAVOR. REAL JAMAICAN.”，后跟一个小牙买加国旗标志。

视觉风格：高端加勒比美食广告，高对比度，黑金配色，奶油色做旧排版，金色手写点缀，质感木纹，诱人的微距细节，电影感蒸汽与光泽，奢华街头美食品牌感。确保所有文字清晰且拼写正确。避免添加多余的食物、徽标、图标或杂乱元素。

templates.title: Luxury Snapchat Neon Fashion Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华 Snapchat 霓虹时尚肖像

templates.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic, luxurious, futuristic portrait of a stylish young woman in a full-body shot within a Snapchat-esque social media universe. The subject is {argument name="character description" default="A stylish young woman with long, wavy brown hair"} She is positioned slightly to the right of the frame, facing the camera directly with a calm and confident posture. Her face is deliberately blurred with soft, square-like textures. She is wearing an oversized {argument name="outfit color" default="Creamy white"} Streetwear Outfit: A loose-fitting hoodie with drawstring and kangaroo pockets, matching jogging cargo pants with side pockets, chunky white-beige luxury sneakers, layered gold chain necklaces with round pendants, gold hoop earrings, and exquisite high-end accessories. The scene is set on a gleaming rooftop or glass platform above a modern city skyline during golden hour, accompanied by a warm sunset mist, with blurred skyscrapers in the background and the ground reflecting a yellow glow. Surrounding her are seven translucent Snapchat-style yellow holographic UI elements: a large glowing ghost logo in the upper left, a notification card on the left displaying "Notifications" and "Collsar 6 minutes ago" (with a bell and play icon), a square app tile with a ghost logo in the lower left, a chat bubble card in the upper right with a small ghost avatar, three lines of text, and a reminder badge, a small yellow glowing ghost icon nearby on the right, a white outline chat bubble with light blue text lines in the lower right, and a smaller yellow chat bubble overlapping it (containing two lines of yellow text). Employing advanced 3D neon aesthetics, it combines glass mimicry, a transparent yellow panel, rounded corners, soft halo, edge lighting, volumetric lighting, realistic fabric textures, polished reflections, shallow depth of field, and cinematic-quality fashion photography. The color scheme is {argument name="accent color" default="Snapchat Yellow"} Colors include warm cream, gold, soft beige, and sunset orange. Vertical 3:4 composition, ultra-detailed, photorealistic, luxurious social media ad style, no watermark, and no additional text except for designated UI tags.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超写实的奢华未来感肖像，展现一位时尚年轻女性在充满 Snapchat 风格的社交媒体宇宙中的全身照。主体为 {argument name="character description" default="一位留着棕色长波浪卷发的时尚年轻女性"}，位于画面偏右侧，正面对镜头，姿态冷静自信，面部刻意经过柔和的方块模糊处理。她身着超大款 {argument name="outfit color" default="奶油白色"} 街头套装：宽松连帽衫配抽绳和袋鼠口袋，同款慢跑工装裤配侧袋，厚底白米色奢华运动鞋，叠戴金链项链配圆形吊坠，金色圆环耳环，以及精致的高级配饰。场景设定在黄金时段现代化城市天际线上方光洁明亮的屋顶或玻璃平台上，伴有温暖的日落薄雾，背景摩天大楼虚化，地面反射着黄色光芒。在她周围环绕 7 个半透明的 Snapchat 风格黄色全息 UI 元素：左上方 1 个巨大的发光幽灵 Logo，左侧 1 张显示“Notifications”和“Collsar 6 minutes ago”的通知卡片（带有铃铛和播放图标），左下方 1 个带有幽灵 Logo 的方形应用磁贴，右上方 1 张带有小型幽灵头像、三行文本及提醒徽章的聊天气泡卡片，右侧附近 1 个小型黄色流光幽灵图标，右下方 1 个带有浅蓝色文本行的白色轮廓聊天气泡，以及 1 个与其重叠的较小黄色聊天气泡（内含两行黄色文本）。采用高级 3D 霓虹美学，结合玻璃拟态、透明黄色面板、圆角设计、柔和光晕、边缘光、体积光、逼真的织物纹理、抛光反射、浅景深以及电影级时尚摄影质感。配色方案为 {argument name="accent color" default="Snapchat 黄色"}、暖奶油色、金色、柔米色和日落橙色。垂直 3:4 构图，超精细，照片级真实感，奢华社交媒体广告风格，无水印，除指定的 UI 标签外无额外文字。

templates.title: Holographic fashion brand poster

titleLocalized.zh: 全息时尚品牌海报

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a high-end, cinematic fashion poster inspired by Instagram, featuring [the main character].{argument name="character name" default="HANIA AI"} A charismatic young woman stands confidently on a suspended, transparent glass platform above the clouds at the golden hour, surrounded by glowing social media holograms and giant typographic text. Canvas: Vertical 2:3 poster, high-fashion editorial composition, the main subject positioned slightly below and centered on the massive background text. Sunset hues of warm peach, champagne, pale pink, rose gold, and magenta. Ultra-refined, glossy, cinematic lighting effects with lens flare and reflections. Subject: A stylish young woman with flowing brown waves, wearing an elegant cream-white oversized blazer, a pale pink satin tank top, high-waisted cream-colored wide-leg trousers, and layered gold necklaces, bracelets, and transparent high-heeled sandals. She carries a delicate cream-colored small handbag with a gold chain and buckle. Confident and poised, one hand in her pocket, the other holding the bag, she looks directly at the camera. Environment: A futuristic, luxurious city skyline above the clouds, viewed from a fantastical rooftop perspective. The main subject stands on a rounded square suspended glass platform with luminous rose gold light strips along its edges and a glossy, reflective surface. Clouds are visible below. The background sky depicts a sunset, accompanied by dramatically soft clouds and warm rim lighting. Typographical arrangement: Behind the main subject, two layers of enormous, glossy, semi-transparent neon typographic text are created, spelling out…{argument name="brand name" default="HANIA AI"} The background features a prominent, oversized word "HANIA" at the top, with a second, large, stacked word "AI" at the rear right of the main body. The letters are made of 3D glass/acrylic material, emitting a peach-pink glow from within, and featuring rose gold metallic outlines, bolts, and bright edge highlights. A small, centered title reading "HANIA AI" is added near the top, with increased letter spacing; a smaller slogan is added below.{argument name="tagline" default="MADE TO INSPIRE"} Holographic Interface Elements: Seven semi-transparent glass UI panels/icons surround the main body, all with softly glowing peach-white outlines: 1) A vertical neon quote panel on the left, displaying "Influence. Inspire. Illuminate." in handwritten script; 2) An Instagram profile card in the lower left corner, featuring a circular avatar, the name "HANIA AI," bio-style microtext, statistics "850 Posts," "1.2M Followers," "320 Following," and a pink-orange "Follow" button; 3) A rounded navigation bar in the lower left corner, containing three icons: a heart, a search icon, and a paper airplane/send; 4) A square Reels panel in the upper right corner, with a Reels icon and the word "REELS"; 5) A quote panel in the middle right corner, displaying "Dream. Create. Inspire."; 6) An interaction panel on the right, titled "ENGAGEMENT," listing three metrics: a heart "98.7K Likes," comments "2.3K Comments," and shares "1.1K Shares"; 7) The bottom right corner features an account card with the Instagram icon, " @HANIA HANIA.AI," and the phrase "Aesthetic. Elegant. Empowering." Style: High-end luxury social media advertising, combining cinematic realism with a glossy holographic UI design, Instagram creator brand aesthetics, soft lighting, atmospheric depth, reflective glass, rose gold highlights, and an elegant, fashionable magazine feel. Constraints: Keep all visible text clear and legible; do not add any additional UI panels beyond the seven panels mentioned above; do not add other people's content; maintain a floating, cloud-like feel to the platform; and preserve a sophisticated, desirable fashion poster atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张以 Instagram 为灵感的电影级高端时尚海报，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="HANIA AI"}，一位魅力十足的年轻女性，在黄金时刻自信地站在云层之上的悬浮透明玻璃平台上，周围环绕着发光的社交媒体全息图和巨型排版文字。

画布：竖版 2:3 海报，高级时尚编辑构图，全身主体位于巨大背景文字的略下方中心位置。采用暖桃色、香槟色、淡粉色、玫瑰金和紫蓝色组成的日落色调。超精致、光泽感，电影级灯光效果，带有镜头光晕和反射。

主体：一位时尚的年轻女性，留着柔顺的棕色波浪卷发，身穿优雅的奶油白色廓形西装外套、淡粉色缎面吊带背心、高腰奶油色阔腿裤，佩戴叠戴金项链、手镯和透明高跟凉鞋。她手提一个带有金链和金扣的精致奶油色小方包。姿态自信从容，一手插兜，一手提包，看向镜头。

环境：云层之上的未来主义奢华城市天际线，从屋顶高度的奇幻视角俯瞰。主体站在 1 个圆角方形悬浮玻璃平台上，平台边缘带有发光的玫瑰金灯带，表面有光泽反射，下方可见云层。背景天空为日落时分，伴有戏剧性的柔和云彩和温暖的轮廓光。

排版装置：在主体后方，创建 2 层巨大的光泽半透明霓虹排版文字，拼写出 {argument name="brand name" default="HANIA AI"}：背景上方为醒目的超大单词“HANIA”，主体右后方为第二个巨大的堆叠文字“AI”。字母为 3D 玻璃/亚克力材质，内部发出桃粉色光芒，带有玫瑰金金属轮廓、螺栓和明亮的边缘高光。

顶部文字：在顶部附近添加一个小型的居中标题，显示“HANIA AI”，字母间距拉开；下方添加较小的标语 {argument name="tagline" default="MADE TO INSPIRE"}。

全息界面元素：在主体周围包含 7 个半透明玻璃 UI 面板/图标，均带有柔和发光的桃白色轮廓：1) 左侧垂直霓虹引用面板，手写体显示“Influence. Inspire. Illuminate.”；2) 左下方 Instagram 个人资料卡，包含圆形头像、名称“HANIA AI”、简介风格微型文字、统计数据“850 Posts”、“1.2M Followers”、“320 Following”以及一个粉橙色“Follow”按钮；3) 左下角圆角导航栏，包含 3 个图标：心形、搜索和纸飞机/发送；4) 右上方方形 Reels 面板，带有 Reels 图标和单词“REELS”；5) 右侧中部引用面板，显示“Dream. Create. Inspire.”；6) 右侧互动面板，标题为“ENGAGEMENT”，列出 3 项指标：心形“98.7K Likes”、评论“2.3K Comments”、分享“1.1K Shares”；7) 右下角账号卡片，带有 Instagram 图标、“@HANIA.AI”以及短语“Aesthetic. Elegant. Empowering.”。

风格：高端奢华社交媒体广告，电影级写实主义与光泽感全息 UI 设计相结合，Instagram 创作者品牌美学，柔和光晕，大气深度，反射玻璃，玫瑰金高光，优雅时尚杂志质感。

约束：保持所有可见文字清晰易读，不要添加除上述 7 个面板之外的额外 UI 面板，不要添加其他人，保持平台悬浮于云层之上，并维持精致、令人向往的时尚海报氛围。

templates.title: Pastel Luxury AI Brand Poster

titleLocalized.zh: Pastel Luxury AI 品牌海报

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a high-resolution, photorealistic luxury AI brand poster showcasing a confident and fashionable woman within a dreamlike, softly colored futuristic environment. Canvas: 3:4 vertical poster, cinematic wide-angle overhead view, ultra-refined commercial advertising quality, soft macaron tones, glossy glass reflections, volumetric clouds, luminous holograms, no black borders. Subject: A captivating young woman ({argument name="character name" default="Hania"} She stands confidently on the edge of a transparent, suspended glass platform above the clouds. Her long, flowing dark brown hair, exquisite makeup, and elegant pearl jewelry exude the poise of an influencer or CEO. To protect her privacy, her face is intentionally kept softly blurred, while the rest of the image remains sharp. She wears a custom-made cream-colored suit over a mint green top with peach pocket details, white pointed-toe heels, a layered necklace, and delicate earrings. One hand lightly touches her hair or sunglasses, while the other holds a transparent, glowing tablet displaying a minimalist AI interface. Layout: The woman is placed in the center of the foreground, fully visible. Behind her, large, semi-transparent, 3D glowing letters spell out…{argument name="headline text" default="HANIA AI"} The first word is positioned above the background, while the second word is positioned larger behind her lower body. The letters are in macaron cyan, peach, lavender, and mint colors, with glowing edges and a glass-like transparency. The scene is designed as a futuristic social media console, featuring a circular platform, soft clouds below, and minimalist sci-fi architectural elements on the right. Specific visible elements to include: 1 central female figure; 2 lines of large title lettering, with "HANIA" at the top and "AI" at the bottom; a transparent tablet in her hand; a large curved quote panel on the right; a brand panel on the front left; a social media panel on the front right; 2 wireframe globe graphics; 2 small floating semi-transparent UI cards on the left; a large rounded rectangular HUD frame behind the left side of the title; and a futuristic columnar canopy structure in the background at the top right. Text content: The large background title is displayed as {argument name="headline text" default="HANIA AI"} The right-side curved, semi-transparent quote panel displays {argument name="quote" default="Create trends, don’t follow them."} The floating panel at the front left displays "AI HANIA" and a circular AI icon. The front right panel is titled "SOCIAL MEDIA," with four small social media icons below. Keep the text clean, bold, white or softly glowing, and easy to read. Visual style: A fresh, luxurious macaron aesthetic, cinematic art direction, a fusion of photorealistic fashion and futuristic UI design. Utilize glass mimicry, translucent acrylic surfaces, luminous neon outlines, delicate bokeh particles, soft sunrise sky gradients, pearlescent highlights, and soft reflections on the platform. The color scheme should emphasize {argument name="pastel color palette" default="Mint green, lavender purple, peach, powder blue and warm cream"} Constraints: Do not add extra people, extra headlines, cluttered text, watermarks, or any logos outside the designated brand panel. Keep the composition clear, ambitious, high-end, and suitable for social media posting; ensure clothing details are clear and facial identities are deliberately blurred.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张高分辨率、照片级写实的奢华 AI 品牌海报，展现一位自信且引领时尚的女性置身于梦幻般的柔和色彩未来环境中。

画布：3:4 竖版海报，电影级广角俯视视角，超精致商业广告品质，柔和的马卡龙色调，光亮的玻璃反射，体积云，发光全息图，无黑边。

主体：一位迷人的年轻女性（{argument name="character name" default="Hania"}）自信地站在云端上方透明悬浮玻璃平台的边缘。她留着飘逸的深棕色长发，妆容精致迷人，佩戴优雅的珍珠首饰，姿态从容，展现出网红或 CEO 的气质。为了保护隐私，她的面部应刻意保持柔和的模糊处理，而画面其余部分则保持清晰。她身穿奶油色定制西装，内搭薄荷绿上衣，配以桃色口袋装饰，脚穿白色尖头高跟鞋，佩戴叠层项链和小巧耳环。一只手轻触鬓角的头发或太阳镜，另一只手拿着一块透明的发光平板电脑，上面显示着极简的 AI 界面图形。

布局：将女性置于前景中心，全身可见。在她身后，创建巨大的半透明 3D 发光字母，拼写出 {argument name="headline text" default="HANIA AI"}，第一个词位于背景上方，第二个词位于她下半身后的较大位置。字母呈现马卡龙青色、桃色、薰衣草色和薄荷色，边缘发光，材质如玻璃般通透。将场景构建为一个未来感的社交媒体控制台，带有圆形平台、下方的柔和云层以及右侧极简的科幻建筑元素。

需包含的明确可见元素：1 位中心女性；2 行巨大的标题字母，顶行显示“HANIA”，底行显示“AI”；手中 1 块透明平板电脑；右侧 1 个大型弧形引语面板；左前方 1 个品牌面板；右前方 1 个社交媒体面板；2 个线框地球仪图形；左侧 2 张小型漂浮半透明 UI 卡片；标题左侧后方 1 个大型圆角矩形 HUD 框架；右上角背景中 1 个未来感柱状天篷结构。

文本内容：巨大的背景标题显示为 {argument name="headline text" default="HANIA AI"}。右侧弧形半透明引语面板显示 {argument name="quote" default="Create trends, don’t follow them."}。左前方悬浮面板显示“AI HANIA”及一个圆形 AI 图标。右前方面板标题显示“SOCIAL MEDIA”，下方包含 4 个小型社交图标。保持文本整洁、加粗、白色或柔和发光，且易于阅读。

视觉风格：清新的马卡龙奢华美学，电影级艺术指导，照片级写实时尚大片与未来感 UI 设计的融合。使用玻璃拟态、半透明亚克力表面、发光霓虹轮廓、细腻的散景粒子、柔和的日出天空渐变、珠光高光以及平台上柔和的反射。配色方案应强调 {argument name="pastel color palette" default="薄荷绿、薰衣草紫、桃色、粉蓝色和暖奶油色"}。

约束：不要添加额外人物、额外的标题词、杂乱的文字、水印或指定品牌面板之外的任何 Logo。保持构图通透、具有抱负感、高端且适合社交媒体发布，服装细节要清晰，面部身份要刻意模糊。

templates.title: Anime Style Returns Launch Banner

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫风格回归发布横幅

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a simple 16:9 anime-style social media banner with the theme "Back after a day's rest." Canvas: Wide horizontal canvas, light warm gray-white background, minimalist magazine layout with soft burgundy accents, thin gray lines, small dot grid, and ample white space. Subject: Half-body anime illustration, featuring a figure {argument name="character description" default="A young woman with shoulder-length dark brown wavy hair wore a black ribbed turtleneck sweater tucked into high-waisted camel brown trousers, and a black belt."} Position her slightly to the right center, facing the viewer. Her right arm extends towards the camera, index finger pointing directly forward, creating a strong perspective shortening effect. Her left hand is casually tucked into her pocket. Add soft shadows behind her and delicate strands of hair around her face. Use a large, centered square mosaic/blur block to cover the upper face area in a soft taupe, obscuring the face while leaving the hair, ears, neck, and forward-pointing finger visible. Typography and Text: Use 5 main text sets. 1) On the left is a large, vertical Japanese title in a calligraphy style, containing the following text:{argument name="left Japanese headline" default="I was unable to post for one day."} The number "1" is large and burgundy, while the other Japanese characters are mainly black. 2) The right side features large burgundy handwritten Japanese characters.{argument name="right Japanese phrase" default="でも…"} 3) The leftmost edge features small, vertically aligned capital letters: "THANK YOU FOR WAITING." 4) The upper right corner features small, stacked capital letters: "THANK YOU / FOR YOUR / PATIENCE." 5) The lower right area features small capital letters: "I'LL BE BACK / STRONGER." Decorative elements include a thin rectangular border outlining the left title, a narrow burgundy vertical bar on the far left, small dotted squares in the upper and lower left corners, thin horizontal dividing lines at the top and lower center, a small burgundy square near the lower right descriptive text, some thin circular rings and dot patterns along the right edge, and a burgundy diagonal fill block in the lower right corner. Decorations should be sparse and precise. Visual style: A combination of refined Japanese anime illustrations and modern editorial layout; using soft tones of gray, white, black, charcoal gray, camel brown, and gray-burgundy. Soft lighting, clean lines, and soft cel shadows; a non-realistic style. Constraints: Maintain the same wide banner composition, keep the character slightly to the right center and pointing towards the viewer, include the 5 listed text sets, and avoid extra characters, logos, watermarks, or other readable text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张简洁的 16:9 动漫风格社交媒体横幅，主题为休息一天后回归发布。

画布：宽幅横向画布，浅暖灰白色背景，极简主义杂志排版，带有柔和的酒红色点缀、细灰色线条、小型点阵网格以及大量留白。

主体：半身动漫插画，人物为 {argument name="character description" default="一位留着齐肩深棕色波浪卷发的年轻女性，身穿黑色罗纹高领毛衣，塞进高腰驼棕色长裤中，系着黑色腰带"}。将她放置在偏右中心的位置，面向观众。她的右臂向镜头方向伸出，食指直接指向前方，形成强烈的透视缩短效果。左手随意地插在裤兜里。在身后添加柔和的阴影，并在脸部周围添加细致的发丝。用一个位于中心的大型方形马赛克/模糊块遮盖上脸部区域，采用柔和的灰褐色，遮住面部，同时保留头发、耳朵、脖子和指向前方的手指。

排版与文字：使用 5 组主要文字。1) 左侧为大型竖排日语标题，采用毛笔书法风格，内容为 {argument name="left Japanese headline" default="1日投稿できませんでした、"}，其中数字“1”较大且为酒红色，其余日语字符主要为黑色。2) 右侧为大型酒红色手写体日语文字 {argument name="right Japanese phrase" default="でも…"}。3) 最左侧边缘为小型竖排大写英文字符：“THANK YOU FOR WAITING.” 4) 右上角为小型堆叠大写英文字符：“THANK YOU / FOR YOUR / PATIENCE.” 5) 右下区域为小型大写英文字符：“I’LL BE BACK / STRONGER.”

装饰元素：包含勾勒左侧标题的细矩形边框、最左侧的窄酒红色竖条、左上角和左下角的小型点状方形图案、顶部和中下部的细水平分割线、右下角说明文字附近的小型酒红色方块、右边缘的部分细圆环和圆点图案，以及右下角的酒红色斜线填充块。装饰需保持稀疏且精准。

视觉风格：精致的日本动漫插画与现代编辑排版相结合；采用灰白、黑、炭灰、驼棕和灰酒红的柔和色调。光线柔和，线条清晰，采用轻柔的赛璐珞阴影，非写实风格。

约束条件：保持相同的宽幅横幅构图，将角色保持在偏右中心并指向观众，包含列出的 5 组文字，避免出现额外字符、Logo、水印或其他可读文字。

templates.title: Luxury Telegram Cyber-Style Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华 Telegram 赛博风海报

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a futuristic, luxurious cyberpunk-style poster with a vertical composition, inspired by Telegram, showcasing {argument name="character description" default="A confident young woman with long, dark, wavy hair"} Standing within a glowing holographic communication center above a futuristic city. Canvas: 2:3 vertical composition, cinematic high-resolution digital art, employing a cool monochromatic palette of electric blue, cyan, navy, chrome silver, and soft white cloud light. The camera employs a frontal view from the waist up to the full body, centered and symmetrical, with dramatic sci-fi lighting, glossy reflections, volumetric lighting effects, and a sophisticated cyberpunk atmosphere. Subject: A woman stands confidently in the center, hands in her pockets, wearing an oversized metallic silver suit jacket, paired with matching custom trousers, a light blue top, layered silver necklaces, a glowing belt buckle, and a chain accessory hanging from her waist. The jacket cuffs and lapels feature delicate holographic UI patches. Her face is deliberately obscured by a vertical matte gray rectangle, revealing only the hair around the rectangle. She appears to be a luxury tech ambassador or a digital nomad icon. Environment: Place her in a transparent, circular sky lounge or observation deck, complete with curved glass walls, a luminous circular floor ring, and a polished, reflective surface, with futuristic skyscrapers visible through bright clouds outside the windows. Add a giant circular ceiling light overhead, along with luminous vertical beams projected from above. Central Hologram: Above the woman's head, create a giant, luminous paper airplane logo hologram within a circular digital portal, composed of translucent cyan light, particle sparks, a HUD ring, and fine radial data lines. Make it the most prominent icon in the image. Floating Interface Panels: Surrounding the main body are nine semi-transparent blue holographic panels, each with rounded corners, a cyan border, a subtle glass blur effect, micro-icons, checkmarks, and an encrypted chat style: 1. Top left: A large Telegram channel panel with the visible title "Telegram," status words "Encrypted," "Secure," and "Cloud," channel name "CyberWave Channel," "32.5K members," a pinned message "The future is encrypted.", and a chat preview from "Techno Empire" with the content "The future is ours." 2. Center left: A message receiving panel displaying "INCOMING MESSAGE," "From: CyberWave," and the main message.{argument name="main message text" default="The Future Is Ours."} 1. A small decryption progress bar is included. 2. The lower left audio waveform panel displays a glowing cyan sound wave timeline. 3. The lower left security panel features a lock icon and text indicating secure connection, end-to-end encryption, and protocol information. 4. The upper right chat card from "Digital Nomad" reads "Freedom is our protocol," with a timestamp and double checkmarks. 5. The upper right chat card from "Visionaries" reads "We build tomorrow," with a timestamp and double checkmarks. 6. The middle right chat card from "Blockchain" reads "Beyond limits," with a timestamp and double checkmarks. 7. The lower right chat card from "AI Revolution" reads "Smart. Fast. Unstoppable," with a timestamp and double checkmarks. 9. The bottom right corner channel statistics panel displays "CHANNEL STATS", "125.7K Subscribers", "2.4M Views", and a small upward line graph. Style Details: Utilize a highly refined sci-fi UI design, transparent glass mimicry, neon cyan outlines, miniature data fonts, encrypted message patterns, paper airplane icons, holographic particles, clear typography, atmospheric depth, reflective chrome metallic fabric, the outline lighting of a suit jacket edge, and the soft sunlight filtering through the clouds outside the tower. The overall atmosphere should embody progressiveness, futurism, security, and luxury. Text Restrictions: All visible interface text should remain in English. Use clear, legible text only for main panel labels and key phrases; small, secondary microtext can be used as decoration. Avoid adding extra logos, watermarks, cluttered branding information, or additional characters.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张垂直构图的未来主义奢华赛博风海报，灵感源自 Telegram，展示 {argument name="character description" default="一位留着深色长波浪卷发的自信年轻女性"} 站在未来城市上空一个发光的全息通讯中心内。

画布：2:3 纵向构图，电影级高分辨率数字艺术，采用电光蓝、青色、海军蓝、铬银色和柔和白云光的冷色调单色调色板。相机采用腰部以上至全身的正面取景，居中对称，具有戏剧性的科幻灯光、光泽反射、体积光效果以及高级的赛博朋克氛围。

主体：女性自信地站在中心，双手插在裤兜里，身穿超大号金属银色西装外套，搭配同款定制长裤、浅蓝色上衣、叠戴银色项链、发光的皮带扣、腰间悬挂的链条配饰，外套袖口和翻领上有精致的全息 UI 贴片。她的面部被一个垂直的哑光灰色矩形刻意遮挡，仅露出矩形周围的头发。她看起来像是一位奢华科技大使或数字游民偶像。

环境：将她置于一个透明的圆形空中休息室或观景台内，配有弧形玻璃墙、发光的圆形地板环、抛光反射地面，窗外是穿过明亮云层的未来派摩天大楼。增加一个巨大的头顶圆形天花板灯，以及从上方投射下的发光垂直光束。

中央全息图：在女性头部上方，创建一个巨大的发光纸飞机 Logo 全息图，置于一个圆形数字传送门内，由半透明的青色光线、粒子火花、HUD 圆环和细密的径向数据线组成。使其成为画面中最醒目的图标。

悬浮界面面板：在主体周围包含 9 个蓝色的半透明全息面板，每个面板均带有圆角、青色边框、淡淡的玻璃模糊效果、微型图标、对勾标记和加密聊天样式：
1. 左上角大型 Telegram 频道面板，带有可见标题“Telegram”，状态词“Encrypted”、“Secure”和“Cloud”，频道名称为“CyberWave Channel”，“32.5K members”，置顶消息显示“The future is encrypted.”，以及来自“Techno Empire”的聊天预览，内容为“The future is ours.”。
2. 左中侧接收消息面板，显示“INCOMING MESSAGE”、“From: CyberWave”以及主消息 {argument name="main message text" default="The Future Is Ours."}，并配有一个小型解密进度条。
3. 左下侧音频波形面板，显示发光的青色声波时间轴。
4. 左下角安全面板，带有锁形图标和暗示安全连接、端到端加密及协议信息的文本。
5. 右上角来自“Digital Nomad”的聊天卡片，内容为“Freedom is our protocol.”，带有时间戳和双对勾标记。
6. 右上方来自“Visionaries”的聊天卡片，内容为“We build tomorrow.”，带有时间戳和双对勾标记。
7. 右中侧来自“Blockchain”的聊天卡片，内容为“Beyond limits.”，带有时间戳和双对勾标记。
8. 右下中侧来自“AI Revolution”的聊天卡片，内容为“Smart. Fast. Unstoppable.”，带有时间戳和双对勾标记。
9. 右下角频道统计面板，显示“CHANNEL STATS”、“125.7K Subscribers”、“2.4M Views”以及一个小型的上升折线图。

风格细节：使用超精细的科幻 UI 设计、透明玻璃拟态、霓虹青色轮廓、微型数据字形、加密消息图案、纸飞机图标、全息粒子、清晰的排版、大气深度、反光铬金属面料、西装外套边缘的轮廓光，以及塔楼外云雾缭绕的柔和日光。整体氛围应体现出进取、未来感、安全与奢华。

文本限制：所有可见的界面文本均保持为英文。仅在主面板标签和关键短语处使用清晰易读的文本；微小的次要微文本可作为装饰。避免添加额外的 Logo、水印、品牌杂乱信息或额外的人物。

templates.title: A melancholy portrait under the light and shadow of a mobile phone

titleLocalized.zh: 手机光影下的忧郁肖像

templates.prompt: Create a melancholic and realistic vertical photograph depicting an adult woman in a dimly lit room, leaning over a sofa or bed, gazing down at a glowing smartphone in the lower right corner of the frame. She keeps {argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown"} Her hair was tied in a messy bun, her head tilted downwards, obscuring most of her facial features, revealing only her ears and the side of her neck. She wore a loose, semi-transparent dress.{argument name="robe color" default="White"} A long robe or oversized shirt with a draped collar and soft pleats creates a tranquil, intimate atmosphere reminiscent of late night, without any nudity. Add a large, opaque rectangular masking block to the face area, positioned horizontally across the head and upper half of the face from the center right side of the image; the color should be [color missing].{argument name="censor block color" default="Dark matte brown"} The image employs low-key natural lighting, with the smartphone casting a faint, cool blue-white glow on her hands and sleeves, against a dark, blurred, and brownish-gray background. The composition uses a tight vertical crop, with the subject dominating the frame: shoulders and robe on the left, the face on the upper right, and hands and phone on the lower right. Photographic style: soft grain, shallow depth of field, soft colors, low contrast, and a candid, cinematic realism; no text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张忧郁且写实的竖构图照片，展现一位身处昏暗房间的成年女性，她俯身在沙发或床上，低头注视着画面右下角发光的智能手机。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 的头发，扎成凌乱的发髻，头部向下倾斜，大部分面部特征被遮挡，仅露出耳朵和颈部侧面。她穿着一件宽松、半透明的 {argument name="robe color" default="白色"} 长袍或超大号衬衫，领口垂坠且带有柔和的褶皱，营造出深夜静谧的亲密氛围，且不含裸露内容。在面部区域添加一个大型不透明矩形遮挡块，位置从图像右侧中心横跨头部和上半部脸，颜色为 {argument name="censor block color" default="深哑光棕色"}。采用低调的自然光照明，智能手机在她的手部和袖子上投射出微弱的冷白蓝色光芒，背景保持黑暗、模糊且呈棕灰色。构图采用紧凑的竖向裁剪，主体占据大部分画面，左侧为肩膀和长袍，右上侧为面部区域，右下侧为手部和手机。摄影风格：柔和颗粒感、浅景深、柔和色彩、低对比度、坦率的电影级写实感，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Anime Pillow Pre-sale Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫抱枕预售海报

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a beautifully designed poster announcing the pre-sale of Japanese anime merchandise for official use.{argument name="character name" default="のぞむ"} A life-size body pillowcase, presented with the visual effect of a realistic limited-time product release. Canvas: Vertical poster, 4:5 aspect ratio, using soft spring colors of pink, sky blue, white, and cream. A dreamy, glossy commercial anime style is used, incorporating light spots, sunlight, window reflections, cherry blossoms, and falling petals. Main Layout: A segmented composition is used, with the main character illustration occupying two-thirds of the left side, reclining diagonally on a white body pillow. The right third contains the product title, pre-sale ribbon, free gifts, a full view of the body pillowcase, and product specifications. A bright pink pre-sale banner spans the bottom. Character Details: A beautiful young anime girl is depicted, with long, fluffy, wavy light pink hair, soft blue eyes, delicate features, and a gentle, spring-like expression. She wears a loose white top, a beige coat that slips off her shoulders, a light blue high-waisted skirt with a belt, and white knee-high socks. Her pose on the body pillow is relaxed and cute, with one hand near her hair. A light and romantic atmosphere is created. A solid, opaque light pink rectangle obscures the center of her face, as if adding a privacy/name input mask to the generated face. Visible text and typography: uses an elegant Japanese promotional font. A pink ribbon in the upper right corner reads: "Official Goods Series Vol. 1". Main title:{argument name="headline character text" default="のぞむ"} Hug き pillow カバー". Subtitle: "ときめく春のひととき". The pink ribbon below: "Limited time limit". The vertical copy on the left side of the pillow reads: "春のときめき、ぎゅっとEmbraceきしめて." Price area in the lower left corner: "Prices 16,500 yen (tax included)". The wide banner at the bottom reads: "Appointment is being paid." The date line in the lower right corner: "5/24(金)～6/30(日)23:59まで". A disclaimer in small print below the banner reads: "※Image is the same as the picture. The product is the product of the different occasion.". The right-hand product area includes a back design card with the tag "Inner Design," showcasing an illustration of a smaller alternative body pillowcase featuring the character. In the center of the right side is a full-size body pillow mockup, showing the character standing on a longer body pillowcase. Under the title "Deluxe Bonus 3-Piece Set" are three gifts: an illustration card labeled "Illustrated Illustration Card," an acrylic keychain labeled "Acrylic Key Holder," and a transparent bookmark labeled "Clear Bookmark." These are arranged as small product thumbnails with soft shadows, pink curved decorations, and blue label text. 画布：竖版海报，4:5 比例，采用粉色、天蓝色、白色和奶油色的柔和春日色调。使用梦幻般的亮面商业动漫风格，包含光斑、阳光、窗户倒影、樱花及飘落的花瓣。

She has wavy, light brown, shoulder-length hair, wears a fluffy white sheep headdress with two drooping ears, and a light sage green long-sleeved dress with white daisy prints and soft ruffles. Her face was deliberately obscured by a pure skin-colored square, devoid of any features. In her other hand, she carried a woven wicker basket, adorned with a charming sheep-face pendant and a few white wool trims. In the distant background to her left, a large golden crescent moon shone. Text: Using a font inspired by Japanese calligraphy. Main Title:{argument name="headline text" default="ひつじのおまじない"} Right next to it is a pink, multifaceted heart-shaped emoji/gem. The first line of the comment:{argument name="message line one" default="Things that were lucky today"} The second line of the message:{argument name="message line two" default="Let's remember one thing before going to sleep."} Highlight the word "Rackkey" in soft pink, and the rest of the text in a deep warm brown. Decorative elements include a main golden crescent moon, a pink heart-shaped gem, a small golden sheep icon below the text, a thin horizontal dividing line with a central star, and numerous tiny gold stars and dots scattered in the background like constellation arcs. promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张柔和的日式绘本风格好运护身符海报，主题围绕绵羊魔法与睡前感恩。

画布：宽幅 16:9 横向插画，温暖的象牙色羊皮纸背景，带有细腻的水彩纹理、淡淡的圆形星象轨道线、金色斑点以及梦幻般的天体装饰。

布局：将角色放置在左侧三分之一处，面向前方，一只手伸向观众，食指指向外侧。右侧三分之二区域保持大面积留白，用于展示优雅的日式排版。标题置于右上区域中心，下方设有一条细金线分割符及一颗小星，下方居中排列两行留言。在留言下方的底部中心处添加一个小巧的绵羊图标。

主体细节：绘制 1 位采用柔和水彩动漫绘本风格的年轻女孩。她留着波浪状浅棕色齐肩短发，戴着带有两只垂耳的毛茸茸白色绵羊头套，身穿浅鼠尾草绿色的长袖连衣裙，裙上有白色小雏菊印花和柔和的荷叶边。她的面部特意用一个纯肤色的正方形遮挡，没有任何五官。她另一只手提着 1 个编织柳条篮，篮子上装饰着 1 个可爱的绵羊脸挂件和少许白色羊毛饰边。在她左侧远方背景中，有 1 轮巨大的金色新月。

文字内容：使用受日式书法启发的字体。主标题：{argument name="headline text" default="ひつじのおまじない"}，右侧紧跟 1 个粉色多面心形表情/宝石。留言第一行：{argument name="message line one" default="今日ラッキーだった事を"}。留言第二行：{argument name="message line two" default="ひとつ思い出してから寝よう"}。将「ラッキー」一词高亮显示为柔粉色，其余文字为深暖棕色。

装饰元素：包含 1 轮主金色新月、1 颗粉色心形宝石、文字下方 1 个小型金色绵羊图标、1 条带有中心星形的细水平分割线，以及分布在背景中、如同星座弧线般的众多细小金星、圆点。在左下角和右下角添加柔和的白色雏菊和浅绿色叶片，且不遮挡文字。

视觉风格：精致水彩，柔和的米色与金色调，轻盈梦幻的睡前氛围，日式可爱童话气息，细腻的纸张纹理，低对比度，优雅且令人平静。

限制：保持所有排版清晰易读，保留宽幅海报构图，避免使用现代 UI 元素，避免照片写实，无水印，无额外角色，无额外主文字。

Canvas: Vertical 4:5 poster, soft ivory and pale powder-blue palette, elegant lace borders, faint floral patterns, sparkles, satin fabric texture, ornate gold trim, high-resolution commercial key visual.

Layout: Split composition with the character occupying the left half and product information on the right half. On the left, show a full-body anime girl reclining diagonally on a white dakimakura pillow, surrounded by pale blue flowers, ribbon bows, lace, petals, and soft bedding folds. Add a small ornate circular deadline badge at bottom left. On the right, place stacked promotional typography and boxed information panels: a ribbon banner at top, large product title, preorder banner, price line, specification box, sample product thumbnail, bonus section with three items, and a large blue call-to-action button at the bottom.

Main character: A beautiful delicate anime girl with long wavy light brown hair, fair skin, soft romantic expression, and an elegant white-and-sky-blue lolita dress. She wears a wide pale blue hat with lace, flowers, and ribbons, a white blouse with puff sleeves, blue bow accents, layered frilled skirt, lace trim, thigh ribbon detail, and bare feet. She reclines gracefully on the pillow with one hand lifted near her face holding a small ornate accessory or chain, legs extended naturally. Place a vertical soft beige rectangular privacy/name-input mask over the face area, obscuring the face while leaving hair, hat, pose, and outfit visible.

Text content: Use Japanese promotional copy in refined Mincho-style and handwritten-style fonts. Top ribbon: {argument name="series label" default="Official merchandise series, Part 1"}. Large title: {argument name="product title" default="Nozomu body pillow cover"}. Subtitle: 「— やさしい時間 —」. Main blue banner: {argument name="preorder headline" default="Reservations now being accepted"}. Smaller label beneath: 「期間限定受注」. Price line: {argument name="price" default="Price: 16,500 yen (tax included)"}. Bottom-left deadline badge: 「完全受注生産 2025年 6月30日(月)まで」. Product specification panel title: 「商品仕様」 with exactly 5 bullet points: 「サイズ：約160×50cm」, 「生地：2WAYトリコット」, 「両面フルカラー印刷」, 「ファスナー付き」, 「日本製」. Reservation bonus panel title: 「予約特典」 with exactly 3 numbered bonus items: ① 「描き下ろし A5イラストカード」, ② 「アクリルチャーム」, ③ 「クリアしおり」. Bottom button: 「ご予約はこちら」 with a white arrow icon. Add tiny legal footer text and copyright line at the bottom edge.

Bonus and product visuals: Include exactly 1 small product thumbnail near the specification box showing the same reclining character art. Constraints: Keep the poster information-dense but elegant, preserve the exact count of 5 product specification bullets and 3 preorder bonus items, do not add extra characters, avoid logos or watermarks beyond the small copyright/footer, and make the face-obscuring beige rectangle intentional and centered over the main face.

templates.title: Zheng He 3D Historical Archives Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 郑和 3D 历史档案海报

templates.prompt: Goal: To create a picture about{argument name="historical figure" default="Zheng He"} This vertical, cinematic 3D historical figure poster presents him as a great explorer standing at the bow of a Ming Dynasty treasure ship, surrounded by a floating timeline panel of archives. Canvas: High-ratio 3:4 poster, epic historical documentary style, warm tan and ocean blue color scheme, high detail, slightly upward dramatic perspective, combining realistic 3D rendering with antique parchment infographic design. Subject: A Ming Dynasty naval commander, clad in a magnificent embroidered robe, cloak, waist ornament, and official hat, stands heroically at the carved wooden bow of a large sailing ship. His right arm holds a long nautical chart directly towards the viewer, creating a strong sense of perspective. His left hand rests near the ship's side. Keep the face softly blurred or indistinct, while maintaining sharp clarity in the clothing, posture, and props. The figure should convey a powerful, sculptural feeling, as if about to leap out of the poster space. Background: Huge sails and rigging rise behind him, with large Chinese calligraphy faintly visible on the sails. Sailors and officials are on the starboard deck. Ships cleaved through surging waves, spray, and mist. The silhouettes of distant port cities and fleets appeared on the low left horizon, with a few birds flying in the cloudy sky. (Left-side title area: Large, bold ink calligraphy, written...){argument name="main calligraphy" default="Zheng He"} Add a slender, vertical Chinese subtitle: "Navigators, Ocean Envoys, Seven Voyages to the Western Seas." Add the date range "1371–1433" and a small red seal. Include a narrow, vertical footnote about Ming Dynasty navigators and diplomats who opened the Maritime Silk Road. Infographic overlay: using slender, glowing gold lines, corner brackets, small nodes, and translucent parchment-textured rectangles. Includes 8 numbered archival cards, each with a small monochrome historical scene image and Chinese description: 1. "01 1371 Birth in Yunnan," depicting a mountain town or ancient city. 2. "02 1382 Entering the Palace to Serve," depicting the court or imperial court. 3. "03 1402 Receiving an Imperial Decree to Set Sail," depicting an imperial edict or a ceremony on board. 4. "04 1405 First Voyage to the Western Seas," depicting the fleet setting sail. 5. “05 1407–1433 Seven Voyages to the Western Ocean” showcases ships and routes. 6. “06 Visits to Various Countries” showcases diplomatic exchanges with foreign envoys. 7. “07 Peace and Friendship” showcases meetings, gifts, and trade. 8. “08 After 1433, Choosing a Farther Journey” showcases departing ships and historical imagery. Bottom Timeline: Add a slender horizontal gold timeline containing six marked milestones: “1371 Birth in Yunnan”, “1382 Entering the Palace to Serve”, “1402 Commissioned to Saile”, “1405 First Voyage to the Western Ocean”, “1407–1433 Seven Voyages to the Western Ocean”, and “After 1433, Choosing a Farther Journey”. Use small dots and delicate vertical scale lines. Visual Style: Ultra-refined cinematic 3D, historical realism, museum exhibition infographics, parchment textures, overlaid gold technical lines, atmospheric haziness, dramatic lighting, carved ship decorations, fabric embroidery, weathered nautical chart textures, dynamic waves, no modern objects. Constraints: Maintain the exact number of 8 floating cards and 6 bottom timeline milestones. All visible text on the poster must be in Chinese as specified. Do not add any logos, watermarks, extra panels, or irrelevant characters.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张关于 {argument name="historical figure" default="郑和"} 的竖版电影质感 3D 历史人物档案海报，将他呈现为站在明代宝船船头的伟大探险家，周围环绕着悬浮的档案时间线面板。

画布：高比例 3:4 海报，史诗级历史纪录片风格，暖棕褐色与海洋蓝配色，高细节，略微仰视的戏剧性视角，写实 3D 渲染与陈旧羊皮纸信息图设计相结合。

主体：一位身着华丽刺绣长袍、披风、腰饰及官帽的明代海军统帅，英勇地站在大型帆船的雕花木质船头上。他的右臂将一卷长长的航海图直接指向观众，形成强烈的透视感。他的左手放在船舷附近。保持面部柔和模糊或不清晰，同时服装、姿态和道具保持清晰锐利。人物应给人以强大、雕塑般的感觉，仿佛要冲出海报空间。

背景：巨大的帆布和索具在他身后升起，帆上有隐约可见的大型中文书法。水手和官员在右侧甲板上。船只破开汹涌的波浪、海浪飞沫和薄雾。远处的港口城市和船队剪影出现在左侧低地平线上，多云的天空中飞着几只鸟。

左侧标题区：大型粗体水墨书法，书写 {argument name="main calligraphy" default="郑和"}。旁边添加纤细的竖排中文副标题：“航海家 · 远洋使节 · 七下西洋”。添加日期范围“1371—1433”和一个红色小印章。包含一段关于明代航海家和外交官开启海上丝绸之路的窄竖排注释。

信息图叠加：使用纤细的金色发光线条、边角括号、小节点和半透明的羊皮纸质感矩形。包含 8 张带编号的档案卡片，每张卡片配有小型单色历史场景图像和中文说明：
1. “01 1371 出生云南”，展示山城或古城。
2. “02 1382 入宫服侍”，展示宫廷或朝廷意象。
3. “03 1402 受命远航”，展示圣旨或船上仪式。
4. “04 1405 首下西洋”，展示船队出海。
5. “05 1407–1433 七下西洋”，展示船只和航线。
6. “06 访问诸国”，展示与外国使节的外交交流。
7. “07 和平友好”，展示会晤、礼品和贸易往来。
8. “08 1433之后 选择深远”，展示远去的船只和历史遗产意象。

底部时间线：添加一条纤细的水平金色时间线，包含 6 个标注的里程碑：“1371 出生云南”、“1382 入宫服侍”、“1402 受命远航”、“1405 首下西洋”、“1407–1433 七下西洋”、“1433之后 选择深远”。使用小圆点和精致的竖向刻度线。

视觉风格：超精细电影级 3D，历史写实主义，博物馆展览信息图，羊皮纸纹理，金色技术线条叠加，大气朦胧感，戏剧性光影，雕刻船饰，织物刺绣，风化的航海图纹理，动态海浪，无现代物品。

约束：保持 8 张悬浮卡片和 6 个底部时间线里程碑的精确数量。海报上所有可见文字均按指定使用中文。不要添加任何标志、水印、额外面板或无关字符。

titleLocalized.zh: 张骞 3D 历史档案海报

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a vertically composed, cinematic 3D historical figure profile poster, featuring [the subject being...].{argument name="character name" default="Zhang Qian"} This poster, depicting an ancient Chinese explorer breaking through a documentary-style timeline, possesses a strong sense of depth and dynamism. The canvas is a 3:4 vertical poster, employing a deep brown desert color palette, combining high-detail realistic 3D rendering with an old parchment infographic design. It utilizes dramatic backlighting, a dusty atmosphere, windswept fabrics, shallow depth of field, and a grand vision of Silk Road exploration. The main subject is a full-length portrait of a Han Dynasty envoy standing on a rocky desert road in the center of the foreground. His face is deliberately obscured by soft, square pixel blur. He wears layered old robes, belts, leggings, and boots, with a reddish-brown scarf fluttering in the wind. His left arm is outstretched, holding a large, unfolded parchment map, projected onto the viewer using forced perspective; the map is labeled in Chinese as…{argument name="map title" default="Western Regions Route Map"} It was also marked with routes and place names. In his right hand he held a tall ceremonial staff, topped with an exquisite metal ornament, from which hung a vertical red flag bearing the inscription {argument name="banner text" default="Han Jie"} Behind him, a camel caravan, cavalry, soldiers, and flags are displayed, along with the distant gates of a Western Region city under a hazy sky, with birds flying overhead. The left-hand title bar features a large, vertically written black calligraphy.{argument name="main title" default="Zhang Qian"} A smaller, vertical Chinese description is added next to it, referring to him as a pioneer of the Western Regions and a forerunner of the Silk Road, with the dates "164-114 BC" and a small red seal. The layout should maintain elegance, a sense of history, and a museum style. Floating archive panel: Six information cards made of translucent glass and gold lines are placed around the figure. Each card has a thin border, tiny glowing corner nodes, miniature monochrome historical scene illustrations, and a Chinese title. The layout is as follows: 1) Top left card, "01 138 BC: Envoy to the Han Dynasty", accompanied by a scene of the envoy departing; 2) Top right card, "02 129 BC: Detained by the Xiongnu", accompanied by a scene of being captured or cavalry; 3) Bottom left card, "03 119 BC: Reopening the Western Regions", accompanied by a scene of a caravan; 4) Middle right card, "04 115 BC: Establishing Ties with Various Countries", accompanied by a scene of diplomats and allies; 5) Bottom right card, "05 114 BC: Returning to Chang'an", accompanied by a scene of returning to the capital; 6) Bottom left large card, "06 1960: The Silk Road Begins", showing a route map and camel caravans. Bottom Timeline: A thin horizontal timeline is added at the bottom, containing six evenly distributed milestone nodes: "164 BC: Birth in Chenggu, Hanzhong Commandery," "138 BC: Envoy to the Yuezhi by the Han Dynasty," "129 BC: Detained by the Xiongnu, Remaining Unyielding," "119 BC: Re-entering the Western Regions and Reaching the Yuezhi," "115 BC: Establishing Friendly Relations with Various Countries," and "114 BC: Returning to Chang'an and Reporting His Observations." Serif-style small Chinese font, warm off-white ink, and delicate gold scales are used. Visual Style: Epic historical realism, photorealistic fabric and leather textures, parchment infographic overlays, museum exhibition posters, ancient Chinese frontier exploration, desert dust, wind effects, warm bronze and beige tones, clear foreground maps, cinematic perspective, volumetric lighting, and ultra-refined 3D portrait archival aesthetics. Constraints: Strictly retain one central figure, one large parchment map, one ceremonial staff with a hanging flag, six floating archival cards, and six bottom timeline milestones. Avoid modern items, unnecessary panels, neon colors, and watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张垂直构图的电影质感 3D 历史人物档案海报，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="张骞"}，展现这位中国古代探险家冲破纪录片式时间轴布局的画面，具有强烈的深度感与动态感。

画布：垂直 3:4 海报，采用深褐色沙漠色调，高细节写实 3D 渲染与陈旧羊皮纸信息图设计相结合。运用戏剧性的背光、尘土飞扬的氛围、随风飘动的织物、浅景深以及宏大的丝绸之路探险意境。

主体：一位汉代使节全身像，站在前景中央的岩石沙漠道路上。他的面部刻意被柔和的方形像素模糊遮盖。他身着层叠的旧长袍、皮带、绑腿、靴子，一条红棕色围巾在风中飘扬。他的左臂向前伸展，握着一张巨大的展开羊皮纸地图，以强迫透视法向观众投射；地图上用中文标注为 {argument name="map title" default="西域线路图"}，并绘有路线和地名。他的右手握着一根高大的仪仗节杖，顶端有精致的金属装饰，挂着一条垂直的红色旗帜，上书 {argument name="banner text" default="汉节"}。在他身后，展现一支骆驼商队、骑兵、士兵、旗帜，以及朦胧天空下远处的西域城门，天空中飞鸟掠过。

左侧标题栏：放置巨大的黑色毛笔书法，垂直书写 {argument name="main title" default="张骞"}。旁边添加较小的垂直中文描述，将其称为西域开拓者和丝绸之路先驱，并标注日期“前 164—前 114”以及一枚红色小印章。排版需保持优雅、历史感和博物馆风格。

悬浮档案面板：在人物周围放置 6 张半透明玻璃与金色线条构成的资料卡，每张卡片带有细边框、微小的发光角节点、微型单色历史场景插图和中文标题。布局如下：1) 左上角卡片，“01 前 138 奉汉出使”，配以使节出发场景；2) 右上角卡片，“02 前 129 被匈奴扣留”，配以被俘或骑兵场景；3) 左中下卡片，“03 前 119 再通西域”，配以商队场景；4) 右中卡片，“04 前 115 联络诸国”，配以外交官与盟友场景；5) 右下卡片，“05 前 114 回到长安”，配以回京场景；6) 左下大卡片，“06 丝路初开”，展示路线图与骆驼商队。

底部时间轴：在底部添加一条细长的水平时间轴，包含 6 个均匀分布的里程碑节点：“前 164 出生 汉中郡城固”、“前 138 奉汉出使 出使大月氏”、“前 129 被匈奴扣留 持节不屈”、“前 119 再通西域 抵达大月氏”、“前 115 联络诸国 建立友好”、“前 114 回到长安 报告见闻”。使用衬线风格的中文小字体、暖米白色墨迹以及精致的金色刻度。

视觉风格：史诗级历史写实主义，照片级的布料与皮革纹理，羊皮纸信息图叠加，博物馆展览海报，中国古代边疆探险，沙漠尘埃，风感，暖青铜与米色调，清晰的前景地图，电影级透视，体积光，超精细 3D 立像档案美学。

约束：严格保留一个中心人物、一张大羊皮纸地图、一根带有挂旗的仪仗节杖、六张悬浮档案卡和六个底部时间轴里程碑。避免出现现代物品，避免多余面板，避免霓虹色，且不得添加水印。

templates.title: 3D Xuanzang Historical Archives Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 3D 玄奘历史档案海报

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a cinematic 3D vertical poster featuring historical figures' profiles, with the main character being {argument name="character name" default="Xuanzang"} The poster presents a Tang Dynasty monk, a monumental, full-body statue-like figure, walking through the desert landscape of the Silk Road, approaching the viewer. It employs an epic museum exhibition style, combining realistic 3D rendering, a documentary-like historical atmosphere, and suspended translucent data panels. Canvas: 3:4 vertical poster, warm dark brown and dusty gold tones, high detail, dramatic backlighting, a hazy sky, sandstorms, and distant ancient city outlines and pagodas. The central figure occupies most of the height, positioned slightly to the right of center, walking forward with a strong sense of depth and proportion. Subject: A bald Tang Dynasty Buddhist monk, dressed in layered, worn gray-brown robes, bound with a belt, and wearing prayer beads around his neck; the fabric has a worn texture, as if affected by wind and sand. He holds a magnificent staff in his right hand and extends an ancient scroll of prayer beads towards the viewer with his left, creating a strong sense of close-up perspective. The face should be softly veiled or kept neutral, rather than a recognizable modern face. The posture should appear firm, solemn, and pioneering. Left title bar: The upper left corner features striking black ink calligraphy characters.{argument name="main calligraphy title" default="Xuanzang"} Next to it is a delicate vertical Chinese biographical text, noting the Tang Dynasty monk, his journey to the West to obtain Buddhist scriptures, the spread of Buddhism, and his birth and death dates (602-664). A small red seal is added below the biographical text. An additional delicate vertical annotation line is added near the lower left corner, such as an archival citation or route note. Floating Archive Panel: Contains six translucent glass panels with delicate gold outlines, small node connectors, white/gold text, a subtle historical illustration background, and a numbered sequence. These six panels represent: 01, 629, departure from Chang'an; 02, 630, crossing Gaochang; 03, 635, arrival in Tianzhu/India; 04, 645, study of Buddhism and return east; 05, 653, collection and return of scriptures; 06, 645-664, translation of scriptures and transmission to posterity. Panels are arranged around the figures: 01 in the upper left, 02 in the center left, 03 in the upper right, 04 in the center right, 05 in the lower right, and 06 in the lower left. Keep the panels clear yet ethereal, like labels in a holographic museum. Bottom Timeline: Add a thin horizontal timeline at the bottom with six markers labeled 629, 630, 635, 645, 653, and 664. Below each marker, add brief Chinese-style event descriptions corresponding to the six archival panels. Use a refined serif or Song typeface in off-white/gold. Background Details: A vast desert road with caravan silhouettes, camels, monks, travelers, dust clouds, distant mountains, and ancient frontier architecture. Includes faintly visible abandoned city walls and pagoda-like structures to enhance the atmosphere of a historical westward journey. Prayer wheels and monks' staffs visually break the poster's flatness, as if standing out from the archival layout. Visual Style:{argument name="visual style" default="Hyper-realistic 3D historical poster, cinematic lighting, museum archival infographics, deep brown desert tones, volumetric dust, highly detailed fabrics and metallic textures."} Elegant, dignified, and heroic, not cartoonish. It combines realistic historical portraiture with infographic overlays and the aesthetics of Chinese ink painting and calligraphy. Constraints: Only one central figure, exactly six floating archive panels, and exactly six bottom timeline markers. No modern objects, no English text on the poster (unless otherwise requested), no watermark, no logo, and no additional figures in the foreground.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张电影质感的 3D 历史人物档案竖版海报，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="玄奘"}，展现一位唐代僧人如纪念碑般全身雕像般的行者形象，正走在丝绸之路的沙漠景观中，向观众迎面而来。采用史诗般的博物馆展览风格，结合写实的 3D 渲染、纪录片式的历史氛围以及悬浮的半透明数据面板。

画布：3:4 竖版海报，温暖的深褐色与尘金色调，高细节，戏剧性的背光，朦胧的天空，风沙，远处的古城轮廓和佛塔。中心人物占据大部分高度，位于中心偏右，向前行走，具有强烈的深度感和比例感。

主体：一位唐代秃头佛教僧人，身着层叠的陈旧灰褐色僧袍，缠绕着腰带，颈挂念珠，布料质感磨损，带有风沙拂动的效果。他右手持一根华丽的高僧杖，左手向观众伸出一个古老的卷轴经筒，营造出强烈的近景透视感。面部区域应柔和遮蔽或保持中性，而非可辨认的现代面孔。姿态应显得坚定、庄重且具有开拓精神。

左侧标题栏：左上方书写醒目的黑色水墨书法大字 {argument name="main calligraphy title" default="玄奘"}。旁边添加纤细的竖排中式传记文字，注明唐代僧人、西行取经、佛教传播以及生卒年 602—664。在传记文字下方添加一枚小型红色印章。在左下角附近添加一条额外的纤细竖排注释线，如档案引文或路线备注。

悬浮档案面板：包含 6 个半透明玻璃面板，带有纤细的金色轮廓、小型节点连接器、白/金色文字、淡淡的历史插画背景以及编号序列。这 6 个面板分别为：01，629 年，从长安出发；02，630 年，穿越高昌；03，635 年，抵达天竺/印度；04，645 年，研习佛法并东归；05，653 年，收集并带回经书；06，645—664 年，翻译经典并传之后世。面板环绕人物放置：01 在左上，02 在左中，03 在右上，04 在右中，05 在右下，06 在左下。保持面板清晰但空灵，如同全息博物馆标签。

底部时间轴：在底部添加一条纤细的水平时间轴，上面有 6 个标记点，分别标注为 629、630、635、645、653 和 664。在点下方，添加与 6 个档案面板相对应的简短中式事件说明。使用精致的衬线体或宋体，颜色为米白色/金色。

背景细节：广阔的沙漠道路，有商队剪影、骆驼、僧侣、行者、尘云、远山和古代边疆建筑。包含隐约的废弃城墙和佛塔状结构，以烘托历史西行之旅的氛围。让经筒和僧杖在视觉上打破海报的平面感，仿佛从档案布局中凸显出来。

视觉风格：{argument name="visual style" default="超写实 3D 历史海报，电影级灯光，博物馆档案信息图，深褐色沙漠色调，体积感尘埃，高细节布料与金属质感"}。优雅、庄重、英勇，非卡通风格。将写实的历史肖像与信息图叠加层及中国水墨书法美学相结合。

约束：仅限 1 个中心人物，正好 6 个悬浮档案面板，正好 6 个底部时间轴标记。无现代物品，海报上无英文文本（除非另有要求），无水印，无 Logo，前景中无额外人物。

templates.title: 3D Infographic of Chinese Divorce Data

titleLocalized.zh: 中国离婚数据 3D 信息图

templates.prompt: Objective: To create an elegant, edit-style 3D infographic with the theme of{argument name="headline topic" default="China's divorce population, 2020–2026"} The design employs Chinese fonts and a minimalist museum aesthetic. Canvas: 16:9 horizontal composition with a warm-toned off-white textured paper background, utilizing soft studio lighting, subtle shadows, and a soft cream background. Layout: A prominent black Chinese title, "2020–2026 China's Divorce Rates," is placed in the upper left. Below, a smaller subtitle, "Divorce Procedures Handled Nationwide," is added, accompanied by a thin horizontal line ending with a small orange dot. The main visual element is a dark charcoal gray oval/cylindrical display stand spanning the lower middle section, with a stage-like recessed oval opening at the top. On the front of the stand, the years are labeled from left to right: 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026. Chart elements: Seven vertical year positions are used. Five solid 3D cuboid bar charts and two dashed outline placeholder bars are displayed. The five solid bars represent: a tall, ochre-gold bar from 2020, labeled "433.9"; a shorter, grey-coral bar from 2021, labeled "283.9" with a small label "2021 Low"; a soft sage-green bar from 2022, labeled "287.9"; a taller salmon-pink bar from 2023, labeled "360.53" with a small label "2023 Rebound"; and a beige stone-textured bar from 2024, labeled "351.3". Two future placeholders are dashed, transparent bars for 2025 and 2026, each with a "To be updated" label below. Add small black dots and guide lines above each value. Decorative details: Add two miniature figures to reflect proportion: one standing on the left edge of the display, near a simple railing and sparse, delicate branches/trees; the other standing on the right, near the future data bars. Add a large, flat, golden sun ring in the upper right corner. Place a tall, cream-colored rectangular board at the right rear of the booth, with a thin, black vertical line in front of it. In the lower left corner, place a wooden semicircle, a slanted piece of paper with small orange dots, a light green cube, and a miniature beige line chart card affixed to the front of the booth. Text and Legend: Add an orange dot in the lower left corner, followed by "Unit: 10,000 pairs". All visible text should be in Chinese, using a clear black font, without additional labels. Visual Style: Refined data visualization poster, tactile paper texture, 3D clay/paper-cut style, ochre, coral, sage green, and beige color palette, high-end magazine infographics, ample white space, realistic soft shadows, and precise alignment. Constraints: Strictly adhere to the above 7 year positions, as well as 5 solid bars and 2 dashed future bars. Do not add watermarks, logos, additional charts, or extra figures.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一份优雅的编辑风格 3D 信息图，主题为 {argument name="headline topic" default="2020–2026 年中国离婚人口"}，采用中文字体设计和极简主义博物馆陈列美学。

画布：宽幅 16:9 横向构图，背景为暖色调米白色纹理纸张，采用柔和的摄影棚灯光、细腻的阴影以及柔和的奶油色背景。

布局：在左上方放置醒目的黑色中文标题“2020–2026\n中国离婚人数”。下方添加较小的副标题“全国依法办理离婚手续”，并配有一条以橙色小圆点结尾的细横线。主体视觉为一个深炭灰色椭圆/圆柱形展台，横跨中下部，顶部设有如舞台般的凹陷椭圆开口。在展台正面，从左至右标注年份：2020、2021、2022、2023、2024、2025、2026。

图表元素：使用 7 个垂直年份位置。展示 5 个实心 3D 长方体柱状图和 2 个虚线轮廓占位柱。5 个实心柱分别为：2020 年高大的赭金色柱，标注“433.9”；2021 年较短的灰珊瑚色柱，标注“283.9”并附带“2021 低点”的小标签；2022 年柔和的鼠尾草绿柱，标注“287.9”；2023 年较高的鲑鱼粉色柱，标注“360.53”并附带“2023 回升”的小标签；2024 年米色石纹柱，标注“351.3”。2 个未来占位符为 2025 年和 2026 年的虚线透明柱，下方均悬挂“待更新”标签。在每个数值上方添加黑色小圆点和引导线。

装饰细节：添加两个微型人物以体现比例：一个站在展台左侧边缘，靠近简单的栏杆和稀疏精致的枝条/树木；另一个站在右侧，靠近未来数据柱。在右上角添加一个巨大的扁平金色太阳圆环。在展台后方右侧放置一块高大的奶油色长方形板，前方有一条细长的黑色垂直线。在左下角放置一个木制半圆、一张带有橙色小圆点的倾斜纸张、一个淡绿色小立方体，以及一张贴在展台正面的微型米色折线图卡片。

文字与图例：在左下角添加一个橙色圆点，后接“单位：万对”。所有可见文字均按指定使用中文，采用清晰的黑色字体，不添加额外标签。

视觉风格：精致的数据可视化海报，触感纸张纹理，3D 粘土/剪纸风格，赭色、珊瑚色、鼠尾草绿、米色调色板，高端杂志信息图，留白充裕，逼真的柔和阴影，精准对齐。

约束条件：严格使用上述 7 个年份位置，以及 5 个实心柱和 2 个虚线未来柱。请勿添加水印、Logo、额外图表或多余人物。

templates.title: 3D Chinese Historical Figures Archives Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 3D 中国历史人物档案海报

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a cinematic, vertical poster featuring historical figures' profiles, with the theme of {argument name="character name" default="Ban Chao"} This poster portrays a heroic ancient Chinese frontier general, elevating it from a documentary-style infographic layout. Canvas: Vertical 3:4 poster, 768 x 1024 visual ratio, employing a historical color scheme of dark brown, gold, and smoky gray, dramatic backlighting, dust, battlefield fog, and a high-detail 3D realism combined with museum exhibition graphics. Subject: A fully armored ancient Chinese commander stands in the center of the foreground, using a low-angle heroic composition. He wears layered dark lamellar armor, an ornate belt, and leather boots; a reddish-brown cloak flows to the left, his expression solemn and dignified. His left arm extends forward to the viewer, holding a wooden command arrow engraved with Chinese calligraphy; his right hand holds a vertical scepter or ceremonial flag adorned with tassels and Chinese characters. The figure is rendered with a three-dimensional quality, as if stepping out from the flat poster frame. Background: An ancient frontier scene in the Western Regions, with a rocky desert landscape and distant mountains. Silhouettes of cavalry and caravans are on the left, while a large, sturdy city gate with flags, scaffolding, and guards stands on the right, its plaque inscribed with Chinese characters. A large, weathered battle flag is added to the upper right corner. The atmosphere should evoke the themes of expeditions, diplomacy, military command, and the expansion of the Western Regions. Left-side layout: A very large, black calligraphy title is placed vertically in the upper left corner.{argument name="main title text" default="Ban Chao"} Below, add smaller, vertically formatted Chinese biographical text describing the birthplace, position, and life events, spanning from 1932 to 102 AD. Add a small red stamp below the biographical section. Floating Archive Cards: Add eight semi-transparent, glass-like historical event cards around the subject, each with a thin gold border, miniature corner rivets, Chinese text, and monochrome documentary-style illustrations. The cards are arranged as follows: 1) Top center card, labeled 01 and 73, about abandoning the pen for the sword; 2) Left center card, labeled 02 and 73, about the mission to the Western Regions; 3) Top right card, labeled 03 and 91, about the pacification of the Northern Xiongnu; 4) Right center card, labeled 04 and 95, about suppressing rebellions; 5) Bottom left center card, labeled 05 and 96, about the establishment of the Protectorate of the Western Regions; 6) Bottom left card, labeled 06, about managing the Western Regions for forty years and uniting multiple countries; 7) Bottom right center card, labeled 07, about opening the Silk Road; 8) Bottom right card, labeled 08 and 102, about returning to Luoyang in his later years. Each card should include a small faded illustration of cavalry, officials, soldiers, maps, or caravans. Bottom Timeline: Add 6 timeline milestones along the bottom edge, complete with a thin gold horizontal line, small dots, and Chinese labels: 32 Birth, 73 Joining the Army and Mission to the Western Regions, 91 Suppressing the Northern Xiongnu, 95 Suppressing the Rebellion, 96 Establishing the Protectorate, 102 Returning to Luoyang after Success. Keep the timeline clear but as a secondary element. Visual Style: Epic 3D Chinese History Poster, ultra-detailed armor textures, cinematic volumetric lighting, dust particles, depth-of-field effects, parchment-like overlays, museum archival infographic design, gold lines, realistic fabric dynamics, and dramatic perspective. Constraints: Use only one central historical figure, strictly include 8 floating event cards and 6 bottom timeline milestones. All visible text must be in Chinese calligraphy or Song typeface style, and no English labels are allowed within the poster. Avoid modern objects, neon colors, cartoon elements, watermarks, or additional characters other than the central figure.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张电影质感的竖版历史人物档案海报，主题为 {argument name="character name" default="班超"}，展现一位英雄气概的中国古代边疆将军，并使其从纪录片风格的信息图布局中脱颖而出。

画布：竖版 3:4 海报，768 x 1024 视觉比例，采用深褐色、金色与烟灰色调的历史配色，戏剧性的背光效果，尘埃、战场薄雾，高细节 3D 写实感与博物馆展览图形相结合。

主体：一位全身着甲的中国古代统帅站在前景中央，采用低角度英雄构图。他身穿层叠的深色札甲，佩戴雕花腰带，脚蹬皮靴，红棕色披风向左飘动，表情庄重威严。左臂向前伸向观众，手持刻有汉字书法的木质令箭；右手持一根带有流苏和汉字的竖立权杖或仪仗旗。让人物呈现出三维立体感，仿佛正从平面的海报边框中走出来。

背景：古代西域边疆场景，地面为岩石沙漠，远处有山脉，左侧有骑兵和商队剪影，右侧有一座带有旗帜、脚手架、守卫的大型坚固城门，城门匾额上写有汉字。右上角添加一面巨大的风化战旗。氛围应体现远征、外交、军事指挥和西域开拓。

左侧排版：在左上角垂直放置非常大的黑色毛笔书法标题 {argument name="main title text" default="班超"}。下方添加较小的竖排中文传记文字，描述出生地、职位和生平，包括 32—102 年。在传记块下方添加一枚红色小印章。

浮动档案卡片：在人物周围添加 8 张半透明玻璃质感的历史事件卡片，每张卡片带有细金边、微型边角铆钉、中文文字和单色纪录片风格的小插图。放置方式如下：1) 顶部中央卡片，标注 01 和 73，关于投笔从戎；2) 左中卡片，标注 02 和 73，关于出使西域；3) 右上卡片，标注 03 和 91，关于平定北匈奴；4) 右中卡片，标注 04 和 95，关于平定叛乱；5) 左下中卡片，标注 05 和 96，关于设立西域都护府；6) 左下卡片，标注 06，关于经营西域四十载，联合多国；7) 右下中卡片，标注 07，关于开辟丝绸之路；8) 右下卡片，标注 08 和 102，关于晚年归洛阳。每张卡片应包含骑兵、官员、士兵、地图或商队的小型褪色插图。

底部时间轴：沿底部边缘添加 6 个时间轴里程碑，配有一条细金色水平线、小圆点和中文标签：32 出生，73 投笔从戎与出使西域，91 平定北匈奴，95 平定叛乱，96 设立都护府，102 功成归洛阳。保持时间轴清晰但作为次要元素。

视觉风格：史诗级中国历史 3D 海报，超精细盔甲纹理，电影级体积光，尘埃粒子，景深效果，羊皮纸质感叠加，博物馆档案信息图设计，金色线条，逼真的织物动态，戏剧性的透视效果。

约束：仅使用一位中心历史人物，严格包含 8 张浮动事件卡片和 6 个底部时间轴里程碑。所有可见文字均使用中文书法或中文宋体风格，海报内不得出现任何英文标签。避免使用现代物品、霓虹色、卡通元素、水印或除中心人物以外的额外角色。

templates.title: Lin Daiyu costume drama poster

titleLocalized.zh: 林黛玉古装剧海报

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="series title" default="Lin Daiyu"} Create a vertical, cinematic poster of a character from a Chinese period drama, blending realistic period drama style with traditional Chinese ink painting graphic design, and presenting the aesthetics of a literary suspense/poetry interface. Canvas: High-ratio 2:3 poster, using gray-green and dark brown tones, with an aged Xuan paper texture on the left edge. The background is a dark bamboo forest and a stone garden in the rain, accompanied by soft mist and falling petals. The entire composition is covered with delicate golden geometric star lines. Subject: A full-body portrait of a young noblewoman from the Qing Dynasty/classical Chinese literature background, standing in the center on a circular carved stone platform. She wears a light blue-green layered Hanfu, with semi-transparent gauze sleeves, embroidered patterns, long ribbons, and elegant blue shoes faintly visible. Her hairstyle is an exquisite bun, decorated with black hair ornaments, white flowers, and hanging silver tassels, exuding a scholarly and poetic temperament. The face is deliberately softened and blurred, while the details of the clothing remain clear. She extends one hand to the audience, holding an old, handwritten manuscript of poetry; her other hand, gathered around her sleeve, clutches a long tassel pendant adorned with jade beads. A blooming branch is added to the foreground, with petals scattered at her feet. Left title bar: The words "Lin Daiyu" in large, striking black Chinese characters are vertically arranged at the top left. Below, smaller text reads "Dream of the Red Chamber: Xiaoxiang Concubine." Faint background handwritten text and a red seal are added. Left side labels: Three small square labels are stacked vertically below the subtitle, labeled "Refined Talent," "Poetic Soul Burying Flowers," and "Delicate Willow in the Wind." Drama Card Layout: Eight retro drama cards surround the central figure, connected by fine gold thread, light-colored borders, corner decorations, and tiny nodes. Each card contains a circular number badge, a Chinese title, a small monochrome illustration resembling an old woodblock print, and two lines of short Chinese phrases. Four cards are arranged on the left and four on the right. The eight episode cards are as follows: 1. Top left card number 01, titled "Daiyu Enters the Mansion in Yangzhou's Old Dreams," depicting a scene of a riverboat/arrival. 2. Left card number 02, titled "Bamboo Shadows in the Xiaoxiang Pavilion's Chill," depicting a bamboo grove courtyard. 3. Bottom left card number 03, titled "The First Planting of Love in the Predestined Bond of Wood and Stone," depicting a scene of two young people sitting side by side. 4. Bottom left card number 04, titled "Reading the West Chamber Together, Hearts in Harmony," depicting a scene of two people reading together. 5. Top right card number 05, titled "The Begonia Poetry Club's Talent Amazes the Audience," depicting a scene of a poetry gathering at a table. 6. Right center card number 06, titled "The Burial of Flowers Becomes a Piece of Pure Earth," depicting a sorrowful scene of burying flowers. 7. Bottom right card number 07, titled "Burning Manuscripts to Sever Infatuation, Tears End, Soul Returns," depicting a woman by a desk or window. 8. Card number 08 in the bottom right corner, titled "The Poetic Soul Under the Cold Moon, Fragrant Through the Ages," showcases a commemorative scene under the moonlight. Bottom navigation: A thin gold timeline is placed at the bottom edge, containing 5 circular nodes and 5 labels: "Entering the Mansion," "Xiaoxiang," "Poetry Society," "Burying Flowers," and "Burning Manuscripts." Above the timeline, at the center of the stone base, a carved gold plaque is added, inscribed with "A scroll of poems, a courtyard full of fallen flowers." Visual style: A highly detailed, realistic fantasy poster with a Chinese ink painting atmosphere, an antique paper collage feel, an exquisite UI/infographic framework, delicate gold line outlining, weathered textures, cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, an elegant and melancholic tone, soft mist, symmetrical balance, no modern objects, no watermarks, and no English characters in the image.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="series title" default="林黛玉"} 创作一张竖版电影感中国古装剧人物海报，融合写实古装剧风格与古风水墨平面设计，并呈现文学悬疑/诗词界面的美学。

画布：高比例 2:3 海报，采用灰绿色与深褐色调，左侧边缘带有陈旧宣纸纹理，背景为幽暗竹林与雨中石园，伴有柔和雾气与飘落的花瓣，整幅构图覆盖着精致的金色几何星图线条。

主体：一位来自清代/中国古典文学背景的年轻贵族女子全身像，居中站立在圆形雕花石台上。她身着淡青绿色层叠汉服，配有半透明纱袖、刺绣花纹、长飘带，隐约可见优雅的蓝色鞋履。发型为精致的发髻，装饰着黑色发饰、白色花朵与垂下的银色流苏，尽显文人诗意气质。面部刻意处理得柔和模糊，而服饰细节保持清晰。她向观众伸出一只手，手中拿着一张陈旧的纸质手写诗稿；另一只手拢着衣袖，握着一枚带有玉质珠子的长流苏挂饰。在前景下方添加一枝盛开的枝条，脚边散落着花瓣。

左侧标题栏：左上方垂直排列着醒目的黑色大号中文字体「林黛玉」。下方垂直排列较小的文字「红楼梦 · 潇湘妃子」。添加淡淡的背景手稿字迹与红色印章。

左侧小标签：在副标题下方垂直堆叠 3 个小型方框标签，分别标注为「清冷才情」、「葬花诗魂」和「弱柳扶风」。

剧集卡片布局：在中心人物周围环绕 8 张复古剧集卡片，通过细金线、淡色边框、边角装饰及微小节点连接。每张卡片包含一个圆形数字徽章、中文标题、一幅类似古版画的小型单色插图，以及两行较小的中文短句。左侧排列 4 张，右侧排列 4 张。

8 张剧集卡片内容如下：
1. 左上角卡片编号 01，标题「扬州旧梦 黛玉入府」，展示河船/抵达场景。
2. 左侧卡片编号 02，标题「潇湘馆中 竹影清寒」，展示竹林庭院。
3. 左下侧卡片编号 03，标题「木石前盟 情根初种」，展示两位少年并坐的场景。
4. 左下角卡片编号 04，标题「共读西厢 诗心相照」，展示两人共读的场景。
5. 右上角卡片编号 05，标题「海棠诗社 才情惊座」，展示桌前的诗会场景。
6. 右中侧卡片编号 06，标题「葬花吟成 一抔净土」，展示忧伤的葬花场景。
7. 右下侧卡片编号 07，标题「焚稿断痴 泪尽魂归」，展示书桌或窗边的女子。
8. 右下角卡片编号 08，标题「冷月诗魂 千古含香」，展示月光下的纪念性场景。

底部导航：在底边放置一条细金线时间轴，包含 5 个圆形节点与 5 个标签：「入府」、「潇湘」、「诗社」、「葬花」、「焚稿」。在时间轴上方、石台基座中心，添加一块雕刻的金色铭牌，刻有「一卷诗稿，满庭落花」。

视觉风格：高细节写实奇幻海报，具有中国水墨氛围、古纸拼贴感、精致的 UI/信息图表框架、细腻的金线勾勒、风化纹理、电影级光影、浅景深、优雅忧郁的基调、柔和雾气、对称平衡，无现代物品，无水印，图像中无任何英文字符。

templates.title: Poster of a noblewoman in ancient China

titleLocalized.zh: 中国古代贵族女性海报

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a vertical infographic for a Chinese historical romance character poster, depicting a noblewoman in a traditional Chinese garden, with the theme revolving around {argument name="character name" default="Xue Baochai"} This poster blends exquisite Qing Dynasty/Hanfu style, scrapbook textures, and numbered story illustrations. The canvas is a 2:3 vertical format with an antique parchment background and torn paper edges. It features brown ink calligraphy, delicate gold geometric lines, and overlapping translucent cracked glass polygons. The overall color scheme is a soft blend of beige, cream, gray-pink, sage green, dark ink, and aged gold. The central subject is a noblewoman dressed in full aristocratic attire, standing on a carved circular stone pedestal against a blurred backdrop of an ancient-style study/garden. The face is deliberately blurred, obscuring features, as if anonymizing the subject, while the rest of the portrait is highly detailed. She wears an exquisite cream-colored embroidered robe with layered wide sleeves, a peach-pink translucent overcoat, and sage green piping. The front and hem are adorned with peony embroidery. She wears embroidered shoes and a gold and beaded headdress with dangling beads. She holds a round fan in her left hand, the fan surface painted with peonies and vertical Chinese calligraphy; in her right hand, she holds a round gold pendant at her chest; tassels and beaded chains hang from her wrists. Overall posture: elegant, dignified, and slightly turned to the side, presenting the effect of a luxurious period drama character still. Main layout: On the far left, a large black vertical calligraphy piece is placed, the content of which is {argument name="main title" default="Xue Baochai"} Below is smaller vertical text.{argument name="subtitle" default="Dream of the Red Chamber: Lady Hengwu"} A red stamp is affixed next to the title. The small label on the left contains three stacked beige stamp-style labels with dark borders and Chinese text: 1) “Dignified and Gentle,” 2) “A Perfect Match,” 3) “Concealing Foolishness and Keeping a Simple Life.” Story Cards: Eight numbered illustrated cards are arranged around the central character, connected by fine gold thread and triangular geometric structures. Each card features a dark circular number badge, a Chinese title, a sepia-toned photographic illustration, and two lines of brief Chinese description. The eight cards are as follows: 1) Top left card, number 01, titled “The Xue Family Enters the Capital, Baochai Arrives,” showing the young girl arriving surrounded by her entourage. 2) Top right card, number 02, titled “The Fragrant Herbs in Hengwu Garden,” showing a garden pavilion scene. 3) Bottom right card, number 03, titled “The Tale of the Golden Lock and Jade,” showing a seated figure indoors with a blurred face. 4) Right center card, number 04, titled "The Cold Fragrance Pill: A Warm and Profound Heart," depicts a young girl writing or studying at a desk. 5) Bottom right card, number 05, titled "Poetry Club: Talents Unveiled," depicts a group of people sitting around a desk. 6) Left center card, number 06, titled "Butterflies Fluttering Among Flowers: Spring Shadows Swaying," depicts two young girls in a garden. 7) Bottom left card, number 07, titled "Bao, Dai, and Chai: A Balance of Emotion and Propriety," depicts a scene of conversation among three people. 8) Bottom left bottom card, number 08, titled "Golden Wedding: A Dream Awakens in the Red Chamber," depicts a wedding or formal gathering scene. Bottom title plate: A long, gold-edged plaque with a slogan is added to the base.{argument name="bottom quote" default="A round fan, half a lifetime of gold and jade"} Featuring black Chinese calligraphy. Bottom Timeline: At the bottom edge, add 5 milestone labels connected by a thin gold line with small dots: "Entering the Capital," "Hengwu," "Golden Lock," "Poetry Society," and "Wedding." Visual Style: Highly detailed, cinematic-quality period drama posters, collages of ancient Chinese books, exquisite feminine luxury, realistic fabric embroidery, peony motifs, shallow depth of field, soft warm lighting, museum-quality textures, aged paper grain, ink-wash details, gold-thread borders, and elegant editorial layout. Restrictions: All visible titles and labels must strictly use the specified Chinese characters. Maintain a central figure as the main subject and a full-body portrait. Includes 8 numbered illustrated cards, 3 left-side labels, and 5 bottom timeline milestones. Do not add additional numbered sections, modern items, logos, watermarks, or any English characters.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张竖版中国历史言情角色海报信息图，描绘一位身处古风园林的贵族女性，主题围绕 {argument name="character name" default="薛宝钗"}，融合精致的清代/汉服风格、剪贴簿纹理以及带编号的故事插图。

画布：2:3 竖版海报，采用仿古羊皮纸背景，边缘呈撕纸效果，配有棕褐色水墨书法、精致的金色几何线条、半透明裂纹玻璃多边形叠加，整体色调为柔和的米色、奶油色、灰粉色、鼠尾草绿、深墨色及陈旧的金色。

中心主体：一位全身贵族少女，站在雕花圆形石座上，背景为模糊的古风书斋/园林花丛。人物面部刻意模糊处理，不显五官，如同匿名化处理，而肖像其余部分则高度精细。她身着精致的奶油色刺绣长袍，配有层叠的宽袖、桃粉色半透明外罩、鼠尾草绿滚边，前襟和下摆饰有牡丹花刺绣，脚穿绣花鞋，头戴金珠发冠，垂下珠串。左手持一把圆团扇，扇面绘有牡丹及竖排中文书法，右手持一枚圆形金坠于胸前；手腕处垂有流苏和珠链。整体姿态：优雅、端庄、微侧身，呈现出奢华古装剧的角色定妆照效果。

主要排版：在最左侧，放置巨大的黑色竖排毛笔书法，内容为 {argument name="main title" default="薛宝钗"}。下方配有较小的竖排文字 {argument name="subtitle" default="红楼梦·蘅芜君"}。标题旁加盖一枚红色印章。

左侧小标签：包含 3 个堆叠的米色印章式标签，带有深色边框及中文文字：1) “端庄温润”，2) “金玉良缘”，3) “藏愚守拙”。

故事卡片：在中心人物周围排列 8 张带编号的插图卡片，通过细金线和三角形几何结构连接。每张卡片均配有深色圆形数字徽章、中文标题、一张棕褐色照片风格的插图，以及两行简短的中文说明文字。8 张卡片如下：
1) 左上卡片，编号 01，标题“薛家入京 宝钗初至”，展示少女在随从簇拥下抵达。
2) 右上卡片，编号 02，标题“蘅芜苑中 香草清芬”，展示园林亭台场景。
3) 右上偏下卡片，编号 03，标题“金锁随身 金玉之说”，展示室内坐姿人物，面部模糊。
4) 右中卡片，编号 04，标题“冷香丸意 温厚藏心”，展示少女在书桌前书写或研读。
5) 右下卡片，编号 05，标题“诗社唱和 才情自敛”，展示一群人围坐在书桌旁。
6) 左中卡片，编号 06，标题“扑蝶花间 春影微动”，展示园林中的两位少女。
7) 左下卡片，编号 07，标题“宝黛钗局 情礼相衡”，展示三人交谈场景。
8) 左下底部卡片，编号 08，标题“金玉成婚 梦醒红楼”，展示婚礼或正式聚会场景。

底部标题牌：在底座上，添加一块长条形金边铭牌，刻有口号 {argument name="bottom quote" default="一柄团扇，半生金玉"}，采用黑色中文书法。

底部时间轴：在最底边缘，添加 5 个里程碑标签，通过带有小圆点的细金线连接：“入京”、“蘅芜”、“金锁”、“诗社”、“成婚”。

视觉风格：高度精细的电影级古装剧海报，中国古籍拼贴画，精致的女性奢华感，写实的织物刺绣，植物牡丹，浅景深，柔和暖光，博物馆级纹理，陈旧纸张颗粒感，水墨细节，金丝边框，优雅的编辑排版。

限制：所有可见标题和标签必须严格使用指定的中文文字。保持中心人物为主体且为全身像。包含 8 张带编号的插图卡片、3 个左侧标签和 5 个底部时间轴里程碑。请勿添加额外的编号部分、现代物品、徽标、水印或任何英文字符。

templates.title: Springtime River Scenery in Misty Rain, China

titleLocalized.zh: 烟雨中国春日江景

templates.prompt: Create a vertically composed illustration of a classical Chinese landscape, employing the delicate gouache and watercolor style of the early 20th century, inspired by an idealized ancient spring river scene. The painting depicts a wide river winding from the lower right corner towards a misty, rain-swept middle ground. In the lower right corner, a small wooden sampan with a canopy holds a boatman in a light-colored robe, holding an oar. On the left bank, nine figures in traditional Chinese clothing are depicted: three strolling together on a path in the lower left corner, two standing beside a large, flowering tree, one bending or walking alone on a grassy bank, a child-like figure near a small flowerbed, and two figures in the distance beside a willow tree. The scene is surrounded by lush spring vegetation: dark, gnarled ancient trees, light green weeping willows, pink flowers, reeds, grass, green rocks, and a calm, mirror-like river surface. In the background, rounded mountains in emerald green, turquoise, cyan, and blue stand tall, partially shrouded in soft white mist and low clouds, while more distant peaks disappear into the ethereal fog. The scene is set as {argument name="time of day" default="Sunset"} The sky was a warm peach and gold hue, the low-hanging sun near the horizon cast a soft yellow light on the water.{argument name="art style" default="Soft Chinese watercolors and gouache on paper"} The brushstrokes are delicate, the colors soft, the composition poetic, the details rich yet ethereal and dreamlike, with no hard outlines, no modern objects, and except for a very faint and inconspicuous watermark-like mark that can be added to the upper left corner, the painting contains no text. The overall atmosphere should be tranquil, nostalgic, and of collectible value, resembling an elegant hand-painted ancient scene of a spring outing in the mountains by the river.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅竖构图的中国古典山水插画，采用 20 世纪初细腻的水粉与水彩风格，灵感源自理想化的古代春日江景。画面展示一条宽阔的河流从右下角蜿蜒流向烟雨朦胧的中景，右下角有一艘小型木制篷顶舢板船，船上站着 1 位身着浅色长袍、手持船桨的船夫。在左岸，描绘 9 位身着中国传统服饰的小人物：3 人在左下角的小径上结伴漫步，2 人站在一棵巨大的繁花树旁，1 人在草岸边弯腰或独行，1 位孩童模样的角色在小型花丛附近，另有 2 位远景人物在柳树旁。周围环绕着茂盛的春日植被：深色的虬枝古树、浅绿的垂柳、粉色的花朵、芦苇、青草、青绿色的岩石以及平静如镜的江面。背景中，矗立着翡翠绿、绿松石色、青色和蓝色的圆润高山，部分被柔和的白雾和低云笼罩，更远处的山峰隐没在空气感十足的薄雾中。场景设定为 {argument name="time of day" default="日落"}，天空呈现温暖的桃色与金色，低垂的太阳靠近地平线，柔和的黄光映照在水面上。使用 {argument name="art style" default="纸上柔和中国水彩与水粉"}，笔触细腻，色彩柔和，构图富有诗意，细节丰富但空灵梦幻，无硬轮廓线，无现代物品，除左上角可选择性添加极淡且不显眼的类似水印的标记外，画面中不包含任何文字。整体氛围应宁静、怀旧且具有收藏价值，宛如一幅优雅的手绘古代山间春游江畔图。
