templates.title: Shi Xiangyun Hanfu Story Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 史湘云汉服故事海报

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a gorgeous vertical Chinese-style romance poster/character infographic, featuring the main character as {argument name="character name" default="Shi Xiangyun"} The poster presents a full-body portrait of a young noblewoman in a spring garden, blending cinematic realism with exquisite illustration UI overlays. The canvas is a 2:3 vertical poster using warm-toned parchment and gold tones, featuring soft morning light, shallow depth of field, and high detail. The background is a blooming classical Chinese courtyard, including pavilions, stone paths, flowering trees, peonies, falling pink petals, and a dreamlike misty atmosphere. The main subject is a woman in full Hanfu (traditional Han clothing) standing on a circular, carved stone platform. She wears flowing, light-colored embroidered Hanfu, with a color scheme of {argument name="dress colors" default="Pale blue, pink, ivory white and soft cyan"} Layered, semi-transparent cuffs and long ribbons fluttered in the breeze, adorned with floral embroidery, a pink belt, tassel pendants, and embroidered shoes. Her hair was decorated with small flowers and hairpins. Her right hand extended towards the audience, holding a green floral porcelain wine cup; her left hand held a large bunch of pink peonies. Her posture was elegant, composed, and approachable, with her face softened or blurred. Left title bar: A textured parchment vertical bar was added to the left. The large black calligraphy title read "Shi Xiangyun". A smaller vertical subtitle read "Dream of the Red Chamber: Old Friends by the Pillow and Clouds". A red seal was added. Below were three stacked rectangular navigation tabs labeled: 1) "Bright and forthright" 2) "Drunkenly reclining among peonies" 3) "Youthful purity". Information cards: Eight vintage parchment story cards surrounded the main body, connected by fine gold geometric lines, circular number badges, semi-transparent crystal-like paper scraps, and faint constellation nodes. Each card includes a sepia miniature illustration and a Chinese title/text. Please use the following precise numbered titles: 01 "Old Images of the Shi Family Mansion, Xiangyun's First Arrival" 02 "Applause in the Grand View Garden" 03 "The Begonia Poetry Club's Brilliant Talent" 04 "The Luxue Hermitage, a Couplet of Unrestrained Spirit" 05 "Drunk on Peonies, a Spring Dream of Flowers" 06 "The Golden Kirin's Fate, a Subtle Echo" 07 "Old Friends' Laughter Like the Wind" 08 "Clouds Disperse, the Bright Echoes of Gaotang" Arrange cards 01, 02, 03, and 04 along the left/bottom left, and cards 05, 06, 07, and 08 along the right. Keep the text small, decorative, and secondary; prioritize the title and numbered badges. Bottom element: Add a gold plaque with an inscription at the platform base.{argument name="bottom quote" default="A cup of spring wine, and the fragrance of flowers all over."} At the bottom edge, add a thin gold timeline containing five labeled nodes: "First Arrival," "Poetry Society," "Collected Verses," "Drunken Retreat," and "Echoes." Visual Style: Elegant Chinese retro editorial design, *Dream of the Red Chamber* aesthetics, parchment texture, gold borders, ink-wash calligraphy font, tan story thumbnails, translucent collage fragments, romantic peonies, soft bokeh, high-end museum poster composition, highly detailed fabrics and embroidery, and cinematic lighting. Constraints: All text must be in Chinese as specified; no English text is allowed within the images; no watermarks, no logos, no additional cards or timeline nodes, and no modern objects are permitted.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张华丽的竖版中国古风言情海报 / 角色信息图，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="史湘云"}，展现一位身处春日花园的年轻贵族少女全身像，融合电影级写实感与精致的插画 UI 叠层。

画布：竖版 2:3 海报，采用暖色羊皮纸与金色调，柔和的晨光，浅景深，高细节。背景为盛开的中国古典庭院，包含亭台楼阁、石径、花树、牡丹、飘落的粉色花瓣以及梦幻般的薄雾氛围。

主体：居中的全身汉服女子，站在圆形的雕花石台上。她身着飘逸的淡色刺绣汉服，配色为 {argument name="dress colors" default="淡蓝、绯粉、象牙白与柔青色"}，层叠的半透明袖口与长丝带在微风中飘动，饰有花卉刺绣、粉色腰带、流苏挂饰、绣花鞋，发髻上装饰着小花与发簪。她的右手向观众伸出，持有一只绿色花卉瓷酒杯；左手持一束硕大的粉色牡丹。姿态优雅、从容、亲切，面部柔化处理或保持模糊。

左侧标题栏：在左侧添加一条纹理羊皮纸竖条。大型黑色毛笔书法标题写着「史湘云」。较小的竖排副标题写着「红楼梦·枕霞旧友」。添加一枚红色印章。下方设有 3 个堆叠的矩形导航标签，分别标注为：1) 「明朗豪爽」 2) 「醉卧芍药」 3) 「少年清气」。

信息卡片：在主体周围环绕 8 张复古羊皮纸故事卡片，通过细金几何线条、圆形数字徽章、半透明水晶状纸屑以及淡淡的星座节点连接。每张卡片包含一幅棕褐色微缩插图及中文标题/正文。请使用以下精确的编号标题：
01 「史府旧影 湘云初至」
02 「大观园中 掌声成趣」
03 「海棠诗社 才思明快」
04 「芦雪庵联 豪气纵笔」
05 「醉卧芍药 春梦花眠」
06 「金麒麟缘 命运微响」
07 「枕霞旧友 笑语如风」
08 「云散高唐 明朗余音」
将 01、02、03、04 号卡片沿左侧/左下方排列，将 05、06、07、08 号卡片沿右侧排列。卡片文字保持小巧、装饰性且作为次要元素；优先突出标题和数字徽章。

底部元素：在平台基座处，添加一块金色铭牌，刻有引言 {argument name="bottom quote" default="一盏春酒，满身花气"}。在最底边缘，添加一条细金时间轴，包含 5 个标注节点：「初至」、「诗社」、「联句」、「醉卧」、「余音」。

视觉风格：优雅的中国复古编辑设计，《红楼梦》美学，羊皮纸纹理，金丝边框，水墨书法字体，棕褐色故事缩略图，半透明拼贴碎片，浪漫牡丹花，柔和焦外成像，高级博物馆海报构图，极具细节的织物与刺绣，电影级布光。

约束：所有文字必须按指定要求使用中文，图像内不得出现任何英文，无水印，无 Logo，不得增加额外卡片或时间轴节点，不得出现任何现代物品。

templates.title: Six-tailed Horned Beast

titleLocalized.zh: 六尾角山兽

templates.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic, collector's edition wildlife photograph inspired by ancient Chinese mythology: a fierce horned leopard cat hybrid, namely {argument name="mythic beast" default="Zheng, a mountain beast resembling a leopard."} Standing atop a rugged mountain ledge, it roars directly at the camera. The creature possesses yellow-orange fur covered in dark leopard spots, a compact and muscular feline torso, lynx-like facial wrinkles and ears, a straight, dark horn protruding from the center of its forehead, and a fan-shaped tail with six long, ringed stripes, resembling dramatic plumes. The scene is set in a harsh alpine mineral landscape, with a backdrop of dark, fractured slate cliffs, cold mist, and translucent blue-green crystalline structures scattered among the rocks. A telephoto wildlife photography angle, slightly below the animal's perspective, places the beast on the left side of the ledge, the rocky slope and crystals extending into the blurred mountain background. Cinematic natural morning light from the upper left creates a cool, blue-gray atmosphere, forming warm rim lighting on the fur, revealing the breathy mist. The animal's face, open mouth, teeth, whiskers, spots, claws, horn, and tail are rendered with sharp detail, shallow depth of field, and realistic texture. Style: Top-tier National Geographic fantasy realism, with anatomical and fur depictions conforming to physiological structures; devoid of illustrative or painterly qualities, text, portraits, or watermarks.{argument name="camera lens" default="85mm telephoto lens"} ,{argument name="lighting mood" default="A cold, foggy dawn accompanied by warm sidelight"} ,as well as{argument name="image aspect ratio" default="4:3 horizontal ratio"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张受中国古代神话启发的超写实野生动物收藏级照片：一只凶猛的带角豹猫混种，即 {argument name="mythic beast" default="狰，一种类似豹的山中野兽"}，站在崎岖的高山岩架上，正对着镜头咆哮。该生物拥有黄橙色的皮毛，覆盖着深色的豹纹，有着紧凑且肌肉发达的猫科动物躯干、类似猞猁的面部褶皱和耳朵，额头中央长有一只笔直的深色角，身后扇形展开着六条长长的环纹尾巴，宛如戏剧性的羽饰。场景设定在严酷的高山矿物地貌中，背景是深色破碎的板岩悬崖、寒冷的雾气，以及散布在岩石中半透明的蓝绿色水晶结构。采用略低于动物视角的长焦野生动物摄影角度，将野兽置于岩架左侧，岩石坡面和水晶向模糊的山峦背景延伸。光线采用来自左上方的电影级自然晨光，营造出冷蓝灰色的氛围，并在皮毛上形成温暖的轮廓光，可见呼出的雾气，动物的面部、张开的嘴巴、牙齿、胡须、斑点、爪子、角和尾巴细节清晰，具有浅景深和逼真的质感。风格：顶级《国家地理》奇幻写实主义，符合生理结构的解剖与皮毛，无插画感，无绘画感，无文字，无人像，无水印。使用 {argument name="camera lens" default="85mm 长焦镜头"}，{argument name="lighting mood" default="寒冷多雾的黎明伴随温暖侧光"}，以及 {argument name="image aspect ratio" default="4:3 横向比例"}。

templates.title: Pastel court ladies on horseback

titleLocalized.zh: 骑马的粉彩宫廷仕女

templates.prompt: Create a minimalist modern ink and watercolor illustration on a beige vertical canvas. At the center of the painting are three petite Chinese court ladies, riding three white horses from left to right, outlined with delicate black ink lines. They wear soft pink and coral robes. The ladies have high traditional hairstyles, and their facial details are minimal. The horses have black manes and tails, slender legs, and lightly drawn reins, presenting an elegant rhythm of movement. Surrounding them are large areas of semi-transparent abstract watercolor washes: a broad band of pale pink in the lower center, a smaller pink oval wash in the lower left, a soft coral pink wash sweeping across the upper left, a large hazy green wash in the lower right, a pale sage green wash across the upper right corner, a darker turquoise circular wash at the edge of the upper right corner, and a light yellowish-green circular halo near the top center. Add scattered dark green ink dots in the upper left and upper-middle areas, and embellish the blank areas with a few small pink and green dots. A thin, vertical reddish-brown ink droplet runs along the lower left edge. Maintain an airy composition, leaving ample negative space to showcase soft watercolor washes and delicate paper texture. No borders, no text, no watermark. Style: Refined East Asian-style modern watercolor; poetic, ethereal, and collectible art print; delicate ink lines.{argument name="main pink color" default="Soft rose pink"} ,{argument name="main green color" default="hazy blue-green"} Against a pastel palette of cream-colored paper, the marching procession in the center appears small and distinct against a vast, abstract, diffused background.

promptLocalized.zh: 在一张米白色的竖向纸质画布上，创作一幅极简主义的现代水墨水彩插画。画面中心展示 3 位小巧的中国古代宫廷仕女，正骑着 3 匹白马从左向右行进，以细腻的黑色墨线勾勒，身着柔和的粉色和珊瑚色长袍。仕女梳着高高的传统发髻，面部细节简约；马匹有着黑色的鬃毛和尾巴、纤细的腿部以及轻描的缰绳，呈现出优雅的行进节奏。在她们周围环绕着大面积半透明的抽象水彩晕染：中下部有一道宽阔的淡粉色云带，左下方有一个较小的粉色椭圆形晕染，左上方扫过一道柔和的珊瑚粉色晕染，右下方有一大片朦胧的绿色晕染，右上角横跨一道淡鼠尾草绿晕染，右上角边缘有一处较深的青绿色圆形晕染，顶部中央附近有一抹浅黄绿色的圆形光晕。在左上角和中上方附近添加零星的深绿色墨点，在留白的区域点缀少量细小的粉色和绿色圆点，左下边缘附近有一条细长的垂直红褐色滴墨线。保持构图空灵，留出充足的负空间，呈现柔和的水彩晕染边缘和细腻的纸张纹理，无边框，无文字，无水印。风格：精致的东亚风格现代水彩，诗意、空灵、具有收藏价值的艺术印刷品，细腻的墨线，采用 {argument name="main pink color" default="柔和玫瑰粉"}、{argument name="main green color" default="朦胧青绿色"} 和奶油色纸张的粉彩调色板，中央的行进队伍在巨大的抽象晕染背景下显得小巧而清晰。

templates.title: Chinese mountain villages shrouded in clouds and mist

titleLocalized.zh: 云雾缭绕的中国山村

templates.prompt: Create a collectible art landscape photograph, as if taken by a world-class National Geographic photographer: a view of a hidden Chinese river valley from the mountains at dawn. The image showcases a misty village nestled among forested hills, with dark-tiled houses scattered across verdant fields and orchards bursting with pale pink and white blossoms. A narrow stream meanders through the valley on the right, while a wide river bends between layered blue mountains on the far left. The foreground includes rugged, moss-covered limestone cliffs and dark pine branches framing the view on either side, creating a sense of depth. Key landscape elements include: a winding river in the distance, a narrow valley stream, a village settlement, groves of flowering fruit trees, terraced fields, layered ridges, and low-lying mist. Using soft, golden morning light penetrating the cool blue mist, the image creates a sense of volume in the fog, realistic atmospheric perspective, and clear natural details. The color palette is a blend of deep green and soft slate blue. The scene is devoid of people, animals, modern roads, power lines, and text. The atmosphere should evoke the secluded paradise described in ancient poetry—tranquil, vast, moist, and sacred. Shot using a medium format camera with a wide-angle lens, it boasts high dynamic range and natural color gradation, resulting in a hyper-realistic documentary photographic effect. Optional reference source:{argument name="source material" default="Descriptions of a secluded Peach Blossom Spring in the deep mountains in ancient Chinese texts"} ;season:{argument name="season" default="early spring"} ;time:{argument name="time of day" default="Sunrise shrouded in mist"} Location Style:{argument name="location style" default="remote Chinese mountain villages"} ;artistic conception:{argument name="mood" default="Tranquil and eternal"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张具有收藏价值的艺术风景摄影作品，如同由世界级《国家地理》摄影师拍摄：清晨时分，从高山俯瞰隐秘的中国河谷。画面展示了一个坐落在森林山丘间的云雾村落，深色瓦房散落在翠绿的田野和开满浅粉色与白色花朵的果园中。一条狭窄的溪流蜿蜒穿过山谷右侧，远处左侧一条宽阔的河流在层叠的蓝色山峦间转弯。前景包括崎岖且长满苔藓的石灰岩悬崖，以及从两侧框住视野的深色松枝，营造出空间深度。画面主要景观元素包括：1 条蜿蜒的远方河流、1 条狭窄的山谷溪流、1 个聚落村庄、成片的开花果树、梯田绿地、层叠的山脊以及低空漂浮的雾气。使用穿透清冷蓝色薄雾的柔和金色晨光，营造体积感雾气、写实的空气透视、清晰的自然细节，色调为深绿色和柔和的板岩蓝，画面中无人、无动物、无现代道路、无电线、无文字。意境应如同古诗中描绘的隐世桃源，宁静、广阔、湿润且神圣。使用中画幅相机搭配广角镜头拍摄，具备高动态范围、自然色彩分级，呈现超写实的纪实摄影效果。可选参考来源：{argument name="source material" default="古文中关于深山隐秘桃花源的描述"}；季节：{argument name="season" default="早春"}；时间：{argument name="time of day" default="雾气弥漫的日出"}；地点风格：{argument name="location style" default="偏远的中国山村"}；意境：{argument name="mood" default="宁静而永恒"}。

templates.title: Photography on the cliffside walkway in the mist

titleLocalized.zh: 迷雾悬崖栈道摄影

templates.prompt: Create a hyperrealistic, collectible art landscape photograph inspired by ancient Chinese travelogues: a precipitous walkway carved into a vertical cliff in a remote, misty valley. The narrow path features only two living subjects: a solitary traveler in simple, dark traditional mountain clothing walking with his back to the camera, and a pack animal or mule carrying brown, bundled goods. The walkway hugs the left side of the frame, nestled beneath towering, damp rock walls, constructed of uneven stone slabs and rough wooden support beams extending into the abyss. The right side and center of the image reveal a vast abyss filled with drifting greyish-white mist, with jagged forested peaks and dark limestone cliffs visible in the distance. The composition incorporates a somber, overcast sky, cool blue-grey tones, the texture of damp rocks, sparse green vegetation on the ledge, and soft, diffused natural light after rain. The composition employs a professional documentary adventure photography perspective, viewing the canyon from a slightly elevated position along a cliffside path. It uses a wide-angle yet natural perspective, deep depth of field, cinematic realism, and high detail. There are no fantastical buildings, modern objects, text, or watermarks. The atmosphere should evoke a sense of danger, antiquity, tranquility, and awe, as if shot by a top National Geographic photographer on a genuine, secluded mountain trail. promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张受古典中式园林美学启发的收藏级艺术编辑摄影作品：一位年轻的汉服女子坐在宁静的苏州式庭院中，垂直怀抱一把传统的梨形琵琶，使其部分遮住面部。她身着 {argument name="robe color" default="淡青色半透明外袍"}、白色内袍以及绣有精致花卉图案的黑色马面裙；发型为优雅的唐宋风格盘发，配有粉色小花发簪。构图为竖构图，宁静且具有绘画感，主体位于画面偏左，右下方坐落着嶙峋的灰色太湖石和一丛青草。背景为白色粉墙，一枝花卉从左上方斜向延伸至留白处。墙面右上角添加黑色竖排中式书法，下方盖有两枚红色印章，呈现出文人摄影作品的质感。使用柔和的自然光，色彩采用低饱和度的柔和色调，浅景深，呈现真实的织物半透明感、细腻的琵琶木纹与品位，带有微妙的胶片质感，营造出顶级博物馆级时尚人像的氛围，而非插画感。画面包含 5 个主要可见元素：1 位坐着的汉服乐师、1 把琵琶、1 枝花卉、1 组太湖石以及 1 处带有红印的竖排书法题字。为保持隐私与神秘感，面部应刻意柔化或被乐器遮挡。画面中不得出现任何现代物品、水印或额外人物。

templates.title: Ancient paintings transformed into art photography

titleLocalized.zh: 古画变身艺术摄影

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the source material, this project reinterprets the ink painting as a realistic art photograph taken by a top photographer, rather than an illustration. The woman in the painting is transformed into a live model, maintaining the same seated playing posture, holding a real pipa, and wearing delicately textured Hanfu, retaining the impression of the light white, semi-transparent light blue, and dark embroidered skirt from the reference image. The overall vertical composition and poetic garden atmosphere are maintained, but the scene must present physical realism: a white wall in the background, a richly textured Taihu stone on the right and lower left foreground, sparse grass at the stone's base, and a flowering branch extending from the upper left. The vertical Chinese calligraphy and red seal on the upper right wall are retained, blending into the scene like ink marks. Soft natural light is used to present a shallow depth of field yet clear photographic quality, elegant spring colors, museum-quality styling, realistic fabric translucency, exquisite hair ornaments, and serene classical Chinese aesthetics. The following photographic elements must be strictly preserved: one seated live model, one pipa (a Chinese lute), one set of large Taihu stones, one flower branch, one clump of grass, and two red seals. Avoid resembling paintings, CGI, fantasy concept art, or direct flat reproductions; the final product should present the texture of a genuine photographic work inspired by ancient paintings. Optional customization: Set the scene atmosphere to {argument name="source mood" default="The Elegant Charm of Classical Chinese Spring Gardens"} The musical instrument is{argument name="instrument" default="lute"} The color scheme of the clothing is{argument name="wardrobe palette" default="White, semi-transparent light blue and black embroidered silk"} Background set to{argument name="background setting" default="White powder wall with Taihu stones"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 为素材，将水墨画重新诠释为由顶级摄影师拍摄的写实艺术摄影作品，而非插画。将画中的女子转化为真人模特，保持同样的坐姿演奏概念，怀抱一把真实的琵琶，身着质感细腻的汉服，保留参考图中浅白、半透明水蓝色以及深色绣花裙的印象。保持整体的竖构图和诗意的园林氛围，但场景要呈现物理真实感：背景为白色粉墙，右侧及左下方前景设有一块质感丰富的太湖石，石基处点缀稀疏的草丛，左上方延伸出一枝花枝。保留右上角墙面上的竖排中国书法和红色印章，使其如同墨迹般融入场景。采用柔和的自然光，呈现浅景深但清晰的摄影质感、淡雅的春日色调、博物馆级的造型设计、逼真的织物半透明度、考究的发饰以及宁静的中国古典美学。严格保留以下摄影元素：1 位坐姿真人模特、1 把琵琶、1 组大型太湖石、1 枝花枝、1 丛草以及 2 枚红色印章。避免呈现出绘画、CGI、奇幻概念艺术或直接的平面复制感；最终成品应呈现出受古画启发而创作的真实摄影作品质感。可选自定义项：设置场景氛围为 {argument name="source mood" default="古典中国春日园林雅韵"}，乐器为 {argument name="instrument" default="琵琶"}，服装配色为 {argument name="wardrobe palette" default="白色、半透明水蓝色及黑色绣花丝绸"}，背景设置为 {argument name="background setting" default="带有太湖石的白色粉墙"}。

templates.title: Fictional band group photo

titleLocalized.zh: 虚构乐队合影

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic full-body studio group photo, with the main subject being a group called{argument name="band name" default="Neon Nocturne"} A fictional four-member alternative synthesizer rock band. The lineup consists of four people standing side-by-side in an industrial-style photo studio with a strong atmosphere: 1) On the far left, a tall, thin man with shoulder-length dark wavy hair, wearing a deep burgundy velvet suit jacket, a black shirt, black skinny jeans, and black leather boots, with his hands in his pockets; 2) In the center front, the lead singer, a tall and confident woman with short silver hair, wearing a short black leather motorcycle jacket, a deep burgundy vest, black high-waisted suit pants, black pointed ankle boots, and a silver ring, leaning slightly forward, with one hand near the jacket; 3) On the right center, a petite woman with a neat black bob haircut, wearing a shiny light blue satin bomber jacket, a dark top, a black pleated skirt, black sheer tights, and thick-soled black Doc Martens, standing behind the lead singer; 4) On the far right, a burly man with a shaved head, wearing a loose charcoal gray knit sweater, black cargo pants, thick-soled black boots, and a small hoop earring, with his hands in his pockets. The background features dark concrete walls and a glossy concrete surface, accented with visible floor-standing colored stage lights: magenta/pink from the left and cyan/blue from the right, with small warm-toned floor lamps in the background. The lighting needs to create dramatic contour highlights, haze, soft smoke, ground reflections, and a high-end music promotional photo feel. The clothing is predominantly black, accented with burgundy and cyan, with a futuristic yet sophisticated style. The 2:3 vertical composition shows full-body shots, is realistically photographed, with clear details on the clothing, a shallow depth of field, and no text, logos, or album cover layout.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影感的全身摄影棚合影，主角是一支名为 {argument name="band name" default="Neon Nocturne"} 的虚构四人另类合成器摇滚乐队。阵容为 4 人并肩站立于氛围感十足的工业风摄影棚中：1) 最左侧，一位高瘦男子，留着齐肩深色波浪卷发，身穿深酒红色天鹅绒西装外套，内搭黑色衬衫，配黑色紧身牛仔裤和黑色皮靴，双手插兜；2) 前方中央，主唱，一位高挑自信的女性，留着银白色短发，身穿黑色短款皮质机车夹克，内搭深酒红色背心，配黑色高腰西装裤、黑色尖头短靴和银色戒指，身体微微前倾，一只手靠近夹克；3) 右侧中央，一位娇小的女性，留着利落的黑色波波头，身穿亮面青色缎面飞行员夹克，内搭深色上衣，配黑色百褶短裙、黑色透肤连裤袜和厚底黑色马丁靴，站在主唱身后；4) 最右侧，一位身材魁梧的男子，剃着光头，身穿宽松的炭灰色针织毛衣，配黑色工装裤、厚底黑色靴子和一枚小圆环耳环，双手插兜。背景为深色混凝土墙面和光亮的混凝土底面，配有可见的落地式彩色舞台灯：左侧发出洋红色/粉色光，右侧发出青色/蓝色光，背景处还有小型暖色地灯。灯光需营造出戏剧性的轮廓高光、薄雾、柔和烟雾、地面反射以及高端音乐宣传照的质感。服装以黑色为主，点缀酒红色和青色，风格前卫且精致。2:3 竖构图，全身可见，写实摄影，服装细节清晰，浅景深氛围，无文字，无 Logo，无专辑封面排版。

templates.title: Japanese anime idol promotional truck

titleLocalized.zh: 日本动漫偶像宣传卡车

templates.prompt: Create a 16:9 daytime street scene photograph set in a fictional but real Japanese entertainment district similar to Shibuya or Akihabara. In the center of the frame is a large white advertising truck driving on a wide zebra crossing. The truck should be the main subject, facing the viewer at a three-quarter angle to simultaneously showcase the front and long side billboards. The side and top billboards of the truck should cover {argument name="character name" default="Erika Mizushima"} The promotional image features a bright, anime-style illustration of a blonde, blue-eyed swimsuit idol character promoting [something].{argument name="product" default="Her first photo album"} The truck should include Japanese advertising copy, such as {argument name="headline text" default="The beginning of summer."} And the release of information such as{argument name="release date" default="7.18 ON SALE"} The image uses elegant cyan and pink lettering against a tropical blue sky and sandy beach background. Tall commercial buildings surround the road, adorned with brightly colored Japanese vertical signs, karaoke signs, game center billboards, bookstore and cafe signs, giant anime posters, LED screens, and dense city advertising; conveying a sense of urban bustle, but not based on a specific real location. Showcase lively crowds on the sidewalks and at intersections, with four clearly visible pedestrians in the foreground holding smartphones and filming or recording the promotional truck: two on the left and two on the right. Add more pedestrians in the background as a denser crowd, but keep the details relatively blurred. Use bright summer sunlight, a deep blue sky, and scattered white clouds, with clear shadows, saturated colors, and realistic asphalt textures, road markings, and a sophisticated commercial photography feel. Keep the truck centered, clear, and dominant; make the anime artwork lively and legible, while slightly de-emphasizing the background billboards. Avoid using real brand logos and watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 16:9 的日间街景照片，场景设定在类似涩谷或秋叶原的虚构但真实的日本娱乐区，画面中央是一辆大型白色宣传卡车，正行驶在宽阔的斑马线道路上。卡车应作为主体，以四分之三的角度面向观众，以便同时展示前车头和长侧面的广告牌。卡车侧面和顶部广告牌应覆盖 {argument name="character name" default="Erika Mizushima"} 的明亮动漫风格宣传图，这是一位金发蓝眼的泳装偶像角色，正在宣传 {argument name="product" default="她的第一本写真集"}。卡车上应包含日文广告文案，例如 {argument name="headline text" default="はじまりの夏。"} 以及发布信息如 {argument name="release date" default="7.18 ON SALE"}，采用优雅的青色和粉色字体，背景为热带蓝天沙滩。道路周围环绕着高大的商业建筑，挂满色彩鲜艳的日文竖排招牌、卡拉 OK 招牌、游戏中心广告牌、书店和咖啡馆标识、巨型动漫海报、LED 屏幕以及密集的城市广告；让城市呈现出繁忙感，但不要基于真实的特定地点。在两侧人行道和十字路口展示热闹的人群，其中前景中要有 4 位清晰可见的行人正举着智能手机拍摄或录制这辆宣传卡车：左侧人行道 2 位，右侧人行道 2 位。背景中添加更多行人作为密集人群，但细节处理相对模糊。使用明亮的夏日阳光、深蓝天空和零星白云，阴影清晰，色彩饱和，呈现真实的沥青纹理、道路标线以及精致的商业摄影质感。保持卡车居中、清晰且占据主导地位；使动漫艺术作品生动易读，同时背景广告牌的视觉权重略低。避免使用真实品牌标志，并避免出现水印。

templates.title: Rainbow Water Ripple Mobile Wallpaper

titleLocalized.zh: 虹彩水波纹手机壁纸

templates.prompt: Create an abstract, vertical mobile wallpaper showcasing a close-up of clear tropical water, displaying shimmering caustic light and shadow, soft ripples, and iridescent color refraction. The image should fill the space.{argument name="aspect ratio" default="9:16"} A high-scale canvas, the image omits the horizon, objects, figures, or text. A luminous light aqua and cyan are used as the base, with accents added selectively.{argument name="accent colors" default="Lavender, violet, light pink and turquoise"} The effect should resemble sunlight filtering through a shallow pool or holographic glass. The image should contain three distinct circular ripple vortexes: one near the top left edge, a larger spiral in the bottom left quadrant, and a smaller, localized spiral near the bottom center edge. Add long, diagonal ripples flowing from the top right to the bottom left, bright white highlights, a pearly sheen, subtle iridescent dispersion, and a dreamy high-key exposure. The overall style should be realistic yet ethereal, with a smooth texture, making it perfect as a soothing smartphone wallpaper.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张抽象的竖版手机壁纸，展示清澈热带水面的特写，呈现闪烁的焦散光影、柔和的涟漪以及虹彩般的柔和色彩折射。图像应填满 {argument name="aspect ratio" default="9:16"} 的高比例画布，画面中不包含地平线、物体、人物或文字。使用发光的浅水蓝和青色作为基底，局部点缀 {argument name="accent colors" default="薰衣草紫、紫罗兰色、淡粉色和绿松石色"}，如同阳光穿透浅水池或全息玻璃的效果。画面中需包含三个明显的圆形涟漪漩涡：一个位于左上边缘附近，一个较大的螺旋位于左下象限，还有一个小型局部螺旋位于底部中心边缘附近。添加从右上流向左下的长条对角波纹、明亮的白色高光、珍珠般的光泽、微妙的彩虹色散，以及梦幻般的高调曝光。整体风格写实而空灵，质感光洁，非常适合作为令人心旷神怡的智能手机壁纸。

templates.title: Fantasy RPG promotional trucks on the streets of Tokyo

titleLocalized.zh: 东京街头的奇幻 RPG 宣传卡车

templates.prompt: Create a realistic 16:9 daytime street scene set in a fictional Japanese entertainment district inspired by Akihabara or Shinjuku. A large advertising truck is positioned at the center of the composition, driving on a multi-lane highway. The truck should be a modern white van, shown from a 45-degree frontal angle, with a gleaming chrome grille and side mirrors. The windshield has realistic reflections, showing headlights, license plates, tires, and road markings. The entire side and roof of the truck are adorned with billboards advertising a product called {argument name="game title" default="ECLIPSE SAGA"} The newly released fantasy RPG features visuals showcasing {argument name="character description" default="An elegant female anime paladin with long, golden hair, clad in platinum and white armor, adorned with a dazzling sun emblem."} The truck's side features prominent Japanese advertising copy.{argument name="main ad copy" default="The will of light will save the world."} and smaller post text{argument name="launch text" default="New RPG, opening."} The game title uses a sophisticated serif font. Tall commercial buildings surround the road, crammed with colorful vertical signs, anime billboards, game posters, store banners, glass facades, and LED screens; the same fantasy characters reappear in several building advertisements in the background. A group of pedestrians is shown on the sidewalks and in the foreground, with four clearly visible individuals holding up smartphones to photograph or record the promotional truck: two blurry phones in the lower left foreground, one raised phone in the lower center, and another raised phone in the right foreground. This makes the promotional truck a clear focal point, while the foreground audience is slightly blurred to create a sense of depth. The lighting is bright afternoon sunlight, with a clear blue sky, sharp shadows, and vibrant, realistic colors, showcasing the city's hustle and bustle. The street photography is cinematic, with high detail, no real brands, no watermarks, and no other vehicles obscuring the truck.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个 16:9 的写实日间街景，场景设定在受秋叶原或新宿启发的虚构日本娱乐区，一辆大型宣传卡车位于构图中心，行驶在多车道公路上。卡车应为一辆现代白色厢式货车，采用前侧 45 度视角，镀铬格栅和后视镜闪闪发光，挡风玻璃有逼真的反射，可见大灯、车牌、轮胎和道路标线。卡车的整个侧面和车顶广告牌正在宣传一款名为 {argument name="game title" default="ECLIPSE SAGA"} 的新发布奇幻 RPG，画面展示了 {argument name="character description" default="一位优雅的金色长发动漫圣骑士女性，身穿白金相间的盔甲，带有耀眼的太阳徽章"}。卡车侧面印有醒目的日文广告文案 {argument name="main ad copy" default="光の意志が、世界を救う。"}，以及较小的发布文字 {argument name="launch text" default="新作RPG、開幕。"}，游戏标题采用精致的衬线字体。道路周围环绕着高大的商业建筑，上面挤满了色彩缤纷的竖排招牌、动漫广告牌、游戏海报、店面横幅、玻璃幕墙和 LED 屏幕；在背景的几处建筑广告上重复出现相同的奇幻角色。在两侧人行道和前景中展示一群行人，其中明确可见 4 人正举起智能手机拍摄或录制这辆宣传卡车：左下前景中有两部模糊的手机，下部中心有一部举起的手机，右侧前景也有一部举起的手机。使宣传卡车成为清晰的焦点，前景中的观众略微模糊以营造景深感。光线为明亮的午后阳光，天空湛蓝，阴影清晰，色彩鲜艳且真实，展现城市喧嚣，电影级街头摄影，高细节，无真实品牌，无水印，无其他车辆遮挡卡车。

templates.title: Japanese anime idol promotional vehicle

titleLocalized.zh: 日本动漫偶像宣传车

templates.prompt: Create a 16:9 daytime street scene that is photorealistic. The scene is set in a fictional but believable Japanese entertainment district, similar to Shibuya or Shinjuku, with a large promotional truck as the central element driving along a multi-lane highway. This truck is promoting a newly released anime idol product, titled {argument name="product title" default="Starlight Melody"} The truck's body is covered in a glossy blue, light purple, and white starry sky pattern, featuring an anime-style blonde idol girl in a blue ruffled stage costume with a shimmering magical effect, creating a sophisticated commercial feel; her face is kept blurred or blank to indicate anonymity. The same promotional content is placed on billboards, LED screens, banners, and street posters on surrounding buildings, including six clearly visible advertisements: a large billboard on the front of the truck with Japanese release text, a large decal on the side of the truck featuring the idol character, a small signboard on the truck bumper, a huge pink billboard above the street, a curved building screen displaying the idol, and a tall blue roadside banner. Clear and legible promotional text such as "New Release!" is used on the truck and signs.{argument name="release date" default="2025.6.25"} The truck should feature an "ON SALE!" sign and the title "Starlight Melody," combined with English and Japanese typography. It should have a gleaming chrome cab, realistic reflections, tires, rearview mirrors, headlights, and road shadows. Showcase bustling pedestrians on the sidewalks and in the foreground; including four clearly visible pedestrians raising their smartphones to photograph or record the truck, two in close-up with their backs to the camera, and two smaller figures within the crowd. Add crosswalks, lane lines, street trees, glass building facades, numerous vertical shop signs, blue skies, bright sunlight, and a clear, high-detail realism. Composition: a low-angle street scene perspective, with the truck centered and slowly moving towards the viewer from left to right, conveying a sense of urban depth; vibrant colors, no real brands, and no watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个 16:9 的日间街道场景，要求照片级逼真。场景设定在虚构但可信的日本娱乐区，类似于涩谷或新宿，一辆大型宣传车作为中心主体行驶在多车道公路上。这辆宣传车正在推广一款新发布的动漫偶像产品，标题为 {argument name="product title" default="Starlight Melody"}。车身覆盖着亮面的蓝色、淡紫色和白色星空图案，印有一位身穿蓝色荷叶边舞台装的动漫风格金发偶像少女，带有闪烁的魔法效果，呈现出精致的商业广告感；保持她的面部模糊或空白，以示匿名。将相同的宣传内容布置在周围建筑的广告牌、LED 屏幕、横幅和街头海报上，包括 6 个清晰可见的广告：1 个带有日文发布文本的卡车前部大广告牌、1 个印有偶像角色的卡车侧面大车贴、1 个位于卡车保险杠上的小型标志板、1 个街道上方巨大的粉色广告牌、1 个显示偶像的弧形建筑屏幕以及 1 个高大的蓝色路边横幅。在卡车和标志上使用清晰易读的宣传文字，例如“New Release!”、{argument name="release date" default="2025.6.25"}、“ON SALE!”以及标题“Starlight Melody”，并结合英文和日式排版。卡车应具备闪亮的镀铬驾驶室、逼真的反射效果、轮胎、后视镜、前大灯和路面阴影。在两侧人行道和前景中展示熙熙攘攘的行人；包括 4 位清晰可见、正举起智能手机拍摄或录制宣传车的行人，其中两位是背对镜头的近景人物，另外两位是人群中较小的人物。添加人行横道线、车道线、行道树、玻璃建筑外墙、许多垂直的商店招牌、蓝天、明媚的阳光以及清晰的高细节真实感。构图：低角度街景视角，宣传车居中并从左向右缓慢驶向观众，呈现繁华的城市纵深感，色彩鲜艳，无真实品牌，无水印。

templates.title: Japanese beauty product advertising truck

titleLocalized.zh: 日本美妆广告宣传车

templates.prompt: Create a 16:9 realistic daytime street scene set in a fictional downtown entertainment district in Japan, similar to Shibuya or Shinjuku. The background includes towering glass buildings, dense vertical billboards, pink cosmetic advertisements, and crowds on the sidewalks. Place a large white advertising truck in the center of the composition, driving from left to right along a multi-lane road, showing its side profile with the front on the left and the rear on the right. The truck is wrapped in {argument name="brand name" default="PURELIA"} Launched{argument name="product name" default="LUMIERE"} A series of soft pink beauty ads, featuring a high-key, bright makeup photo, with the main character being {argument name="featured model" default="A smiling young Japanese woman with long brown hair, blinking and gently touching her cheek."} The promotional vehicle also displayed three clearly visible pink cosmetic bottles. The advertising copy on the vehicle was elegantly printed in Japanese, with the main slogan {argument name="slogan text" default="This is the most translucent I've ever looked."} Located above the product name, with smaller pink text at the bottom. The same model and product packaging should also appear on the rear panel of the promotional vehicle and on the large architectural screen in the background. The foreground should show pedestrians photographed from behind and the sides, with exactly eight people holding smartphones to photograph or record the promotional vehicle: four in the lower left foreground, three in the lower center, and one at the lower right edge. Add more people stopping to watch the promotional vehicle from behind the road. Use realistic sunlight, blue skies and white clouds, clear reflections on building glass, natural shadows, and road markings, presenting a high-detail commercial photography quality. Keep the promotional vehicle in the main focus, with a clear and sharp image; city signs should reflect Japanese characteristics, primarily using pink and white, avoiding the use of real brand logos. No watermarks, and no other vehicles obstructing the promotional vehicle.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个 16:9 的写实风格日间街景，场景设定在类似于涩谷或新宿的虚构日本市中心娱乐区，背景包含高耸的玻璃建筑、密集的垂直广告牌、粉色美妆广告以及两侧人行道上的人群。在构图正中央放置一辆大型白色广告宣传车，车辆沿多车道公路从左向右行驶，展示侧面轮廓，车头在左，车尾在右。车身包裹着由 {argument name="brand name" default="PURELIA"} 推出的 {argument name="product name" default="LUMIERE"} 系列柔和粉色美妆广告，画面包含一张高调明亮的美妆照片，主角为 {argument name="featured model" default="一位留着棕色长发、正在眨眼并轻触脸颊的年轻日本女性微笑照"}，以及三个清晰可见的粉色化妆品瓶罐。宣传车上印有优雅的日文广告文案，主标语 {argument name="slogan text" default="わたし史上、いちばん透明感。"} 位于产品名称上方，底部配有较小的粉色文字。同一位模特和产品包装也应出现在宣传车的后侧面板以及背景的大型建筑屏幕上。前景中展示从背后和侧面拍摄的行人，其中正好有 8 个人举着智能手机拍摄或录制这辆宣传车：左下角前景 4 人，下部中心 3 人，右下边缘 1 人。在道路后方增加更多驻足观看宣传车的人群。采用写实日光、蓝天白云、建筑玻璃上的清晰倒影、自然阴影、道路标线，并呈现高细节的商业摄影质感。保持宣传车处于主体地位，画面清晰且对焦锐利；城市招牌需体现日本特色，以粉色和白色为主，避免使用真实品牌 Logo。无水印，无其他车辆遮挡宣传车。

templates.title: Royal Prince potato chip packaging

titleLocalized.zh: Royal Prince 薯片包装

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a high-end Japanese-style potato chip packaging design based on an illustration world, transforming royal characters into brightly colored snack bag advertisements. Canvas: A vertical product packaging mockup, 3:4 aspect ratio, placed on a clean white background. The packaging bag should have a glossy, wrinkled plastic texture, with sealed ridged edges at the top and bottom, and subtle creases, highlights, shadows, and a slight puffiness like a real snack bag. Packaging Design: Utilizing elegant white, burgundy, and metallic gold tones. The top and bottom bands are deep burgundy with gold decorative lines; the central area is pale white/cream, with a background featuring subtle palace or marble column textures. Incorporate ornate gold patterns, crown motifs, and a high-end European royal style. Brand and Main Text: Place a gold crown logo and brand name at the top center.{argument name="brand name" default="Reggbis"} , with a small Japanese pronunciation below. Add a vertical burgundy ribbon badge in the upper left corner that says "Limited Time". In the upper center, add a line of small characters "白の王様と丝わう赘沢なひととき". The largest product name in the center should be "ポテトチップス" in bold metallic gold Japanese font. On the right side, within an ornate golden frame with a crown, is written "白のPrince様の热がしバターコンソメ Flavor". Add smaller copy below: "香香なコクとバターのlasting rhyme が広がる、浘沢な丝わい." Main Body: Shows an elegant Prince Charming character occupying the left and center of the packaging art. The prince, with long, light blond hair, wore a white military-style royal uniform with gold embroidery, epaulettes, decorative buttons, a high collar, and lace cuffs, over which a red cloak draped. He struck a confident pose, one hand on his hip, the other raised near his head. His face was deliberately obscured by a simple rectangular beige blur to maintain the overall aesthetic of the outfit.{argument name="character theme" default="white prince"} As the core character concept. Food elements: Display four food elements in the lower right foreground: two golden potato chips, a small round bowl filled with glossy brown consommé sauce, and a pat of butter melted on a yellow oil stain. The potato chips should look crispy, slightly speckled, and appealing, covering the lower part of the character and packaging. Badge and footer: Add a diamond-shaped burgundy and gold badge in the lower left corner, stating "100% Made in Japan," accompanied by a small crown. Write "Premium Potato Chips" in elegant gold cursive along the burgundy band at the bottom. Add small Japanese disclaimer text in the lower right corner, similar to the small print on product packaging. Visual style: A realistic commercial snack packaging mockup, incorporating exquisite anime/cosplay illustration art, a high-detail glossy plastic texture, a high-end Japanese limited edition product design, warm gold lighting, clear typography, and high-end supermarket snack aesthetics. Restrictions: The design is limited to a single potato chip bag, with no person holding it, no additional products, no background scene outside the packaging, and all Japanese text must be clear and legible, and the layout must resemble authentic Japanese snack packaging.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：基于插画世界观创作一款高端日式薯片包装设计，将皇室角色转化为色彩鲜艳的零食袋广告。

画布：正面垂直产品包装样机，3:4 比例，置于干净的白色背景上。包装袋应呈现出带有光泽的褶皱塑料质感，顶部和底部有密封的脊状边缘，并带有细微的折痕、高光、阴影以及像真实零食袋一样的轻微膨胀感。

包装设计：采用优雅的白色、酒红色和金属金色调。顶部和底部色带为深酒红色，配有金色装饰线条；中心区域为淡白色/奶油色，背景带有淡淡的宫殿或大理石柱纹理。加入华丽的金色花纹、皇冠图案以及高端欧式皇室风格。

品牌与主文字：在顶部中心放置一个金色皇冠标志和品牌名称 {argument name="brand name" default="Reggbis"}，下方配有小型日文读音。在左上角添加一个垂直的酒红色丝带徽章，写着「期間限定」。在上方中心处，添加一行小字「白の王子様と味わう贅沢なひととき」。中央最大的产品名称应为粗体金属金色日文字体「ポテトチップス」。在右侧，一个带有皇冠的华丽金色边框内，写上「白の王子様の 焦がしバター コンソメ味」。下方添加较小的文案：「芳醇なコクとバターの余韻が広がる、贅沢な味わい。」

主体：展示一位优雅的白马王子角色，占据包装艺术的左侧和中心。王子留着长长的浅金色头发，身穿带有金色刺绣、肩章、装饰纽扣、高领、蕾丝袖口的白色军装风格皇室制服，肩上披着红色斗篷。他自信地摆出姿势，一只手叉腰，另一只手举在头部附近。面部特意用一个简单的矩形米色模糊块遮挡，以保持包装的整体美感。使用 {argument name="character theme" default="white prince"} 作为核心角色概念。

食物元素：在右下角前景展示 4 种食物元素：2 片金黄色的薯片、1 个盛有光泽棕色清汤酱的小圆碗，以及 1 块融化在黄色油渍上的黄油。薯片应看起来酥脆、带有轻微斑点且诱人，覆盖在角色和包装的下部。

徽章与页脚：在左下角添加一个菱形的酒红色与金色徽章，写着「国産じゃがいも 100% 使用」，并配有一个小皇冠。沿底部酒红色带用优雅的金色草书写上“Premium Potato Chips”。在右下角添加细小的日文免责声明文本，类似于产品包装上的小字说明。

视觉风格：写实的商业零食包装样机，融合精致的动漫/Cosplay 插画艺术，高细节光泽塑料质感，高端日式限量版产品设计，温暖的金色灯光，清晰的排版，高端超市零食美学。

限制：设计仅限单个薯片包装袋，不要有人手持拿，不要有额外产品，包装外不要有背景场景，确保所有日文文本清晰易读，并像地道的日式零食包装一样进行排版。

templates.title: Baseball-themed garlic pepper potato chip packaging bag

titleLocalized.zh: 棒球主题蒜香胡椒薯片包装袋

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a realistic full-color prototype of a snack packaging for a baseball-themed potato chip bag, referencing the glossy, wrinkled style of Japanese retail packaging. Canvas: 3:4 vertical product photography, frontal view. The sealed potato chip bag almost fills the entire frame, with red heat-sealed embossed edges at the top and bottom, showcasing the highlights, wrinkles, creases, and reflective effects of transparent plastic. Main Design: A warm brown, kraft paper-textured retro sports illustration background, accented with deep red. The main subject on the left is a hand-drawn baseball pitcher wearing a white jersey with red piping and a red cap, in a pitching motion. The jersey features the word "Carp" in red cursive on the chest. The player wears a black baseball glove over a red long-sleeved shirt. The face area is covered by a solid, opaque brown rectangle to simulate anonymity. Brand and Text: A deep red cursive English logo is displayed at the top center.{argument name="brand name" default="Carp Legend"} It is decorated with small baseballs and stars. Below is a small Japanese-style subtitle. The largest title in the center is the product name in bold, deep red Japanese.{argument name="product name" default="ポテトチップス"} A large, round flavor label is placed on the right, with the main flavor name printed on it.{argument name="flavor label" default="Garlic Pepper Flavor"} Surround it with small supporting text. Add a red ribbon with short, powerful text to the flavor label. Add a vertically hanging red badge with a gold border and stars in the upper left corner, containing text.{argument name="limited badge text" default="Limited time offer"} Add a baseball-shaped stamp in the bottom left corner with the text:{argument name="ingredient badge text" default="Made with 100% domestically grown potatoes."} A beige ribbon with dark text is added to the bottom. Visible elements count: 4 main packaging labels: a limited edition badge in the top left corner, a brand logo area in the top center, a circular flavor label on the right, and a baseball ingredient stamp in the bottom left corner. The foreground features 4 prominent potato chips, overlapping in the bottom center, golden in color, with texture and black peppercorns. The bottom right corner contains 5 condiment props: a whole garlic clove, 2 peeled garlic cloves, a small wooden bowl, and a pile of black peppercorns inside and around the bowl. Visual style: High-end illustrated food packaging, retro Japanese baseball poster art, textured cross-hatching, aged paper tones, deep burgundy typography, gold lighting, realistic plastic bag reflections, and an enticing food photography effect of potato chips and garlic. Keep the image colorful, not black and white. Constraints: No extraneous characters, no hands outside the illustration, no watermarks, no background outside the packaging (only subtle neutral edges are retained). All text must be integrated into the packaging design and maintain a realistic sealed snack bag shape.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：制作一款逼真的全彩零食包装样机，用于棒球主题薯片袋，设计风格参考光泽感十足的日式褶皱零售包装。

画布：3:4 竖版产品拍摄，正面视角，密封薯片袋几乎填满整个画面，顶部和底部带有红色热封压纹边缘，呈现透明塑料高光、褶皱、折痕及反光效果。

主体设计：采用暖棕褐色、牛皮纸质感的复古体育插画背景，搭配深红色点缀。左侧主体为一名手绘棒球投手，身着带有红色滚边的白色队服及红色球帽，正处于投球动作中。队服胸前印有红色草书“Carp”字样。球员佩戴黑色棒球手套，内搭红色长袖。面部区域覆盖一个纯色不透明棕色长方形色块，模拟匿名处理效果。

品牌与文字：顶部中央展示深红色草书英文 Logo {argument name="brand name" default="Carp Legend"}，并配以小型棒球和星星装饰。下方包含小型日式副标题文字。中央最大的标题为醒目的深红色日文产品名称 {argument name="product name" default="ポテトチップス"}。右侧放置一个大型圆形口味标签，印有主要口味文字 {argument name="flavor label" default="ガーリック ペッパー味"}，周围环绕小型辅助文案。在口味标签上添加一条印有简短有力文案的红色丝带。左上角添加一个带有金色边框和星星的垂直悬挂式红色徽章，内含文字 {argument name="limited badge text" default="期間限定"}。左下角添加一个棒球形状的印章，文字为 {argument name="ingredient badge text" default="国産じゃがいも 100% 使用"}。底部添加一条带有深色文字的米色丝带标语。

可见元素计数：包含 4 个主要的包装标注：1 个左上角限定徽章、1 个顶部中央品牌 Logo 区、1 个右侧圆形口味标签、1 个左下角棒球原料印章。前景包含 4 片突出的薯片，在底部中央重叠，呈金黄色，带有纹路和黑胡椒颗粒。右下角包含 5 个调味道具：1 个完整大蒜、2 瓣剥皮大蒜、1 个小型木碗，以及碗内及周围的一堆黑胡椒粒。

视觉风格：高级插画食品包装，怀旧日式棒球海报艺术，纹理交叉影线，陈旧纸张色调，深酒红色排版，金色光影，逼真的塑料袋反光，薯片与大蒜的诱人食品摄影效果。保持图像色彩丰富，而非黑白。

约束条件：无多余字符，插画外无手部，无水印，包装外无背景（仅保留细微的中性边缘）。所有文字必须整合进包装袋设计中，并保持逼真的密封零食袋形状。

templates.title: Luxury anime princess-themed potato chip packaging bag

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华动漫公主风薯片包装袋

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a vertical, high-end potato chip packaging design based on a gorgeous anime princess illustration, presenting a mockup of a finished retail snack bag. Canvas: A 3:4 aspect ratio vertical product packaging image, showing a full front view of a glossy, wrinkled potato chip bag with sealed pleats at the top and bottom. Use a deep midnight blue and blackish-purple background, accented with gold trim, glitter, small stars, and a luxurious candy style. Subject: On the left and in the center, present an elegant anime-style princess bride wearing a delicate white lace dress adorned with gold embroidery, a jeweled corset, pearl details, bows, and floral appliqués, with a semi-transparent veil spanning the packaging. She holds a bouquet of yellow, cream, and pink roses. Her face area is covered by a centered beige rectangular placeholder for later replacement with a portrait. Her long, light silver-gold hair and veil blend into a dreamy starry background. Brand and Typography: In the upper right corner, place a gorgeous gold logo frame with a small crown, containing the brand name.{argument name="brand name" default="Étoile de Reine"} , with a small Japanese subtitle "エトワール・ドゥ・レーヌ" below. Below the logo, add an elegant small Japanese slogan "やさしい时を、ひとくちのごほうびに." Set largest central title to Japanese{argument name="main product text" default="ポテトチップス"} The color is a creamy white with a golden sheen. In the upper left corner, add a dark blue and gold vertical hanging ribbon tag with the words "..."{argument name="limited label" default="Limited time offer"} Flavor Badge: On the right-center, create a cream-colored circular decorative tag with gold filigree and flowers. The text above the tag reads "Funwarikaru," and the main flavor is below.{argument name="flavor text" default="Honey butter flavor"} Add a small, pale purple ribbon with the inscription "やさしい甘さとコク" to the badge. Below it is a short Japanese inscription: "はちみつのやさしい甘さとバターのコクがとろける、 幸せな味わい." Food elements: In the lower right foreground, display exactly five large, overlapping, golden-yellow potato chips with visible seasoning granules and a realistic crispy texture. To their right, display a small glass bowl containing honey, accompanied by a wooden honey stick dripping honey. In front, place a small white dish containing a square piece of butter. Quality badge and decorative elements: In the lower left corner, add a cream and gold circular badge with the inscription "国産じゃがいも100% 用". Decorate the bottom left corner with pink roses and small flowers. Place a dark ribbon banner with a gold trim at the bottom, on which is written {argument name="bottom slogan" default="A gentle reward, like a starry night."} Add a small legal disclaimer in the bottom right corner: "※This is an image." Visual style: Highly refined Japanese luxury snack packaging, glossy plastic reflection, realistic packaging folds and highlights, gorgeous gold typography, soft dreamy lighting, delicate anime illustrations, a romantic royal theme, and a premium limited edition feel. Keep all text legible and arranged like real retail packaging. Do not add any additional characters, food items, logos, barcodes, or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：基于华丽的动漫公主插画，创作一款垂直版高端薯片包装设计，呈现成品零售零食袋的样机效果。

画布：3:4 比例的竖版产品包装图像，展示带有密封褶皱顶部和底部的光面起皱薯片袋的完整正面视图。使用深午夜蓝和黑紫色背景，搭配金色饰边、闪光、小星星和奢华糖果风格。

主体：在左侧和中心位置，展示一位优雅的动漫风格公主新娘，身穿饰有金色刺绣、珠宝胸衣、珍珠细节、蝴蝶结和花卉贴花的精致白色蕾丝礼服，半透明的面纱横跨包装。她手捧一束黄色、奶油色和粉色的玫瑰花。她的面部区域被一个居中的米色矩形占位符覆盖，以便后续替换角色肖像。她长长的浅银金色头发和面纱融入了梦幻般的星空背景中。

品牌与文字布局：在右上角，放置一个带有小皇冠的华丽金色标志框，内含品牌名称 {argument name="brand name" default="Étoile de Reine"}，下方配有小型日语副标题「エトワール・ドゥ・レーヌ」。在标志下方，添加一句优雅的小型日语标语「やさしい時間を、ひとくちのごほうびに。」。将最大的中央标题设置为日语 {argument name="main product text" default="ポテトチップス"}，采用带有金色光晕的奶油白色。在左上角，添加一个深蓝色和金色的垂直悬挂丝带标签，上面写着 {argument name="limited label" default="期間限定"}。

口味徽章：在右侧中部，创建一个带有金色花丝和花朵的奶油色圆形装饰标签。标签内文字上方为「ふんわり香る」，下方为主要口味 {argument name="flavor text" default="はちみつ バター味"}。在徽章上添加一条写有「やさしい甘さとコク」的小型淡紫色丝带。在其下方，包含简短的日语文案：「はちみつのやさしい甘さと バターのコクがとろける、 幸せな味わい。」

食物元素：在右下角前景中，展示正好 5 片重叠的大块金黄色薯片，带有可见的调味料颗粒和逼真的酥脆质感。在它们右侧，展示 1 个装有蜂蜜的小玻璃碗，配有 1 个正在滴落蜂蜜的木制蜂蜜棒。在前方，放置 1 个装有 1 块方形黄油的小白碟。

质量徽章与装饰元素：在左下角，添加一个奶油色和金色的圆形徽章，上面写着「国産じゃがいも 100% 使用」。用粉色玫瑰和小花装饰左下角。在底部放置一条带有金色饰边的深色丝带横幅，上面写着 {argument name="bottom slogan" default="星降る夜のような、やさしいごほうび。"}。在右下角添加微小的法律声明文字：「※写真・イラストはイメージです。」

视觉风格：高度精致的日式奢华零食包装，光面塑料反光，逼真的包装褶皱和高光，华丽的金色排版，柔和的梦幻灯光，细腻的动漫插画，浪漫的皇家主题，高级限量版质感。保持所有文字清晰可辨，并像真实的零售包装一样排列。请勿添加额外的角色、食物、标志、条形码或水印。

templates.title: Luxury Saint potato chip packaging

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华 Saint 薯片包装

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a high-end Japanese-style potato chip packaging mockup, inspired by dark-toned Catholic/European saint paintings, using a glossy black snack bag paired with a luxurious gold typography and a deluxe limited-edition brand design. Canvas: The product packaging is vertically positioned on a clean white background, showcasing a realistically wrinkled plastic potato chip bag with serrated sealing edges at the top and bottom. A 3:4 aspect ratio is used, with a slightly rounded pillow-shaped packaging and a glossy black material featuring strong reflections and wrinkles. Layout: A delicate gold brand logo with a small crown and decorative patterns is placed at the top center, with text {argument name="brand name" default="San Ignacio"} Below this is a small katakana text. Below that, add a line of small, white-gold Japanese text. At the top center, place a very prominent embossed, metallic gold Japanese product title with the text:{argument name="product title" default="ポテトチップス"} Add a vertical gold ribbon label in the top left corner with the text:{argument name="limited label" default="Limited time offer"} The left center features a framed, religious-style portrait depicting Saint Ignatius in a black robe, halo, and against a backdrop of swirling smoke and a luminous Sacred Heart; a neutral, blurred rectangular veil covers his face. The right center contains a circular, gold-decorated badge with Japanese characters.{argument name="flavor text" default="St. Ignatius' Spicy Black Pepper Flavor"} In the lower left corner, there's a circular bay leaf badge with the text "100% Use of Domestic Products." The center foreground below features three overlapping large, golden, wavy potato chips. The lower right foreground includes a small bowl filled with black peppercorns, two red chilies, and a few sprigs of green herbs. Along the lower left background, add a dark silhouette of a European church or cathedral at sunset. At the bottom center, add a gold ribbon banner with the text {argument name="bottom slogan" default="Infused with the spirit of the Jesuits."} Add tiny, disclaimer-style Japanese text in the bottom right corner. Visual Style: Hyperrealistic commercial packaging design, luxurious black and gold color scheme, embossed gold lettering, Baroque religious decoration, delicate gold filigree borders, dramatic contrasting lighting, realistic potato chip texture with black peppercorns, high-end limited-edition snack brand design. Ensure all text blends perfectly with the perspective and plastic folds of the packaging surface. Constraints: Only show 1 product bag, 1 ribbon tag on the left, 1 portrait of a saint in the center, 1 circular flavor badge on the right, 1 100% badge in the bottom left, 3 visible chips, 1 pepper bowl, 2 red peppers, and 1 bottom banner. Do not add hands, figures other than illustrations, additional packaging, watermarks, or replace Japanese packaging text with English.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一款高端日式薯片包装样机，灵感源自深色调的天主教/欧洲圣徒油画，采用黑色亮面零食袋，搭配华丽的金色排版和奢华限量版品牌设计。

画布：正面垂直产品包装，置于干净的白色背景中心，呈现逼真的褶皱塑料薯片袋，顶部和底部带有锯齿状密封边。采用 3:4 的高长宽比构图，枕式包装形状略带圆润，亮面黑色材质带有强烈的反光和褶皱。

布局：在顶部正中央放置一个精致的金色品牌标识，带有小皇冠和装饰性花纹，文字为 {argument name="brand name" default="San Ignacio"}，下方附带小型片假名。在其下方，添加一行小号白金色日文标语。在上方中部，放置一个非常醒目的压纹金属金色日文产品标题，文字为 {argument name="product title" default="ポテトチップス"}。在左上角，添加一个垂直的金色丝带标签，文字为 {argument name="limited label" default="期間限定"}。左侧中部包含一幅装裱好的宗教油画风格肖像，描绘了身穿黑袍、头戴光环、身处烟雾缭绕及发光圣心背景下的圣依纳爵；在面部上方覆盖一个中性模糊的矩形遮罩。右侧中部包含一个圆形的金色装饰性口味徽章，日文文字为 {argument name="flavor text" default="聖イグナチオの スパイシー 黒胡椒味"}。左下方有一个圆形月桂叶徽章，文字为“国産じゃがいも 100% 使用”。下方中心前景包含 3 片重叠的大型金色波纹薯片。右下方前景包含 1 个装满黑胡椒粒的小碗，以及 2 根红辣椒和几枝绿色香草。沿左下方背景，添加一个日落时分欧洲教堂或大教堂的深色剪影。在底部正中央，添加一条金色丝带横幅，文字为 {argument name="bottom slogan" default="イエズス会の精神を、味わいに込めて。"}，并在右下角添加极小的免责声明风格日文文本。

视觉风格：超写实商业包装设计，奢华黑金配色，压纹烫金字体，巴洛克宗教装饰，精致的金色花丝边框，戏剧性的明暗对比照明，带有黑胡椒颗粒的逼真薯片质感，高端限量版零食品牌设计。确保所有文字与包装表面的透视感和塑料褶皱完美融合。

约束条件：仅展示 1 个产品袋，1 个左侧丝带标签，1 幅中央圣徒肖像，1 个右侧圆形口味徽章，1 个左下方 100% 徽章，3 片可见薯片，1 个胡椒碗，2 根红辣椒，以及 1 条底部横幅。不要添加手部、插画外的人物、额外的包装、水印，或用英文替换日文包装文案。

templates.title: Cottagecore-style shaved ice cafe advertisement

titleLocalized.zh: Cottagecore 风格刨冰咖啡馆广告

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a warm and romantic café advertisement photograph for a seasonal shaved ice dessert, presenting a dreamy Cottagecore style. The scene should evoke the atmosphere of a sunny, flower-filled French-Japanese café terrace, with soft golden backlighting, shallow depth of field, lace, daisies, honey tones, and vintage cream-colored paper signs. Canvas: Vertical 3:4 composition, photorealistic editorial food photography with a delicate fairytale feel. Main color palette: warm beige, ivory, pale yellow, blush pink, and soft green. Layout: Place a large, ornate glass shaved ice bowl in the center foreground at the bottom of the frame. In the right rear, a young blonde woman in a cream-colored lace dress, wearing a daisy and pink flower wreath, holds a gold spoon close to her face. Her face is partially obscured by a flat, opaque brown square in the center. On the left, place two vintage-framed menu signs: a taller one at the top left and a smaller one below. Add a small paper label and a wax seal near the bottom left corner. Add a small white rabbit statue or plush toy to the bottom right corner next to the dessert. Surround it with plenty of daisies, baby's breath, vines, and rustic wooden window frames. Main details: The dessert is a huge mound of shaved ice, served in a clear, fan-shaped glass bowl on a matching tray. Topped with a spherical ball of light vanilla milk ice cream, white daisies, small yellow honey or fruit jelly cubes, pale peach mochi balls, mint leaves, and shimmering syrup droplets. The shaved ice should look fluffy, crystalline, delicate, and luxurious. Text content: Contains 3 visible text items. 1) Top left border sign: Large text “CAFÉ Fraise Étoilée”, smaller Japanese text “カフェ・フレーズ・エトワレ”, and the slogan “Blooming with my own light.” 2) Menu board in the lower left border: Japanese seasonal menu text for honey milk shaved ice, including "Seasonal Limited," "Flower Crown Milk Shaved Ice," "~Wrapped in a Pleasant Light~," a few lines of small print describing the ingredients, and the price "¥2,200 (tax included)." 3) Small paper label in the lower left corner: "Blooming with my own light." with a tiny heart-shaped doodle. Style constraints: Photorealistic yet idealized, high-end café promotional image, ornate vintage border, lace tablecloth, soft bokeh, luminous window light, no modern objects, no extra people, no watermark. Keep the shaved face brown square clearly visible. Use the café name.{argument name="café name" default="CAFÉ Fraise Étoilée"} Dessert Name{argument name="dessert name" default="Flower Crown Honey Milk Shaved Ice"} ,price{argument name="price" default="¥2,200 (tax included)"} ,slogan{argument name="slogan" default="Blooming with my own light."} and floral themes{argument name="flower theme" default="daisies and soft pink blossoms"} .

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为季节性刨冰甜点创作一张温馨、浪漫的咖啡馆广告照片，呈现梦幻般的 Cottagecore 风格。场景应营造出一种阳光明媚、鲜花盛开的法日式咖啡馆露台氛围，带有柔和的金色背光、浅景深、蕾丝、雏菊、蜂蜜色调以及复古奶油色纸质招牌。

画布：垂直 3:4 构图，照片级真实感的编辑类美食摄影，具有精致的童话氛围。主色调采用暖米色、象牙白、淡黄色、腮红粉和柔和的绿色。

布局：在画面下方中央前景处放置一个巨大的华丽玻璃刨冰碗。在右后方，坐着一位身穿奶油色蕾丝连衣裙的年轻金发女性，头戴雏菊和粉色花朵花环，手持金勺靠近脸部。她的面部被一个位于脸部中央的平坦不透明棕褐色方块遮挡。在左侧，放置两个复古边框菜单牌：左上方一个较高的招牌，下方一个较小的招牌。在左下角附近添加一个小纸标签和一个火漆印章。在甜点旁边的右下角添加一个小巧的白色兔子雕像或毛绒玩具。周围环绕着大量的雏菊、满天星、藤蔓和乡村风格的木质窗框。

主体细节：甜点是一个巨大的牛奶刨冰堆，盛放在配套托盘的透明扇形玻璃碗中。顶部点缀一个圆球状的淡香草牛奶冰淇淋、白色雏菊、黄色小蜂蜜或水果果冻块、淡桃色麻薯球、薄荷叶以及闪闪发光的糖浆水滴。刨冰看起来应蓬松、晶莹、细腻且奢华。

文本内容：包含 3 个可见文本项。1) 左上方边框招牌：大号文字“CAFÉ Fraise Étoilée”，较小的日语文字“カフェ・フレーズ・エトワレ”，以及标语“Blooming with my own light.”。2) 左下方边框菜单牌：蜂蜜牛奶刨冰的日语季节性菜单文本，包括“季節限定”、“花冠はちみつのミルクかき氷”、“〜やさしい光に包まれて〜”、几行小字配料说明，以及价格“¥2,200(税込)”。3) 左下角小纸标签：“Blooming with my own light.”并配有一个微小的心形涂鸦。

风格约束：照片级真实但理想化，高端咖啡馆宣传图，华丽的复古边框，蕾丝桌布，柔和的焦外成像，发光的窗户光线，无现代物品，无额外人物，无水印。保持遮脸的棕褐色方块清晰可见。使用咖啡馆名称 {argument name="café name" default="CAFÉ Fraise Étoilée"}、甜点名称 {argument name="dessert name" default="花冠はちみつのミルクかき氷"}、价格 {argument name="price" default="¥2,200(税込)"}、标语 {argument name="slogan" default="Blooming with my own light."} 以及花卉主题 {argument name="flower theme" default="daisies and soft pink blossoms"}。

templates.title: Cyber ​​Kimono Shaved Ice Cafe

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博和服刨冰咖啡馆

templates.prompt: Create a 3:4 aspect ratio, portrait-realistic image depicting a tranquil cyberpunk Japanese teahouse scene: A young woman, dressed in a gorgeous reddish-beige kimono embroidered with gold flowers, sits at a low wooden table in a traditional room. The background features shoji doors, wooden beams, and a sunlit Japanese garden visible through the windows, complete with roof tiles, greenery, and soft bokeh. Her long, glossy black hair cascades over her shoulders, and elegant black-and-white bionic prosthetics are visible on the right side of her head and hands. Her face is obscured by a rectangular privacy mask in a pure warm brown, devoid of facial features. Before her lies a delicate seasonal shaved ice dessert.{argument name="dessert name" default="Red Moon Snowflake Shaved Ice"} The shaved ice is stacked in a black lacquered bowl decorated with gold patterns. The white shaved ice is topped with deep red syrup and garnished with pale round mochi balls, tiny edible red and white petals, gold leaf shavings, and a black and gold butterfly decoration. The table setting comprises five main elements: a large lacquered bowl holding the shaved ice, a red lacquered spoon on a black round tray, a dark ceramic teacup on the right, a vertical menu card on the left, and a small café logo card on the right. Two additional printed cards are included: the left menu card features an elegant Japanese café menu layout, displaying the title "Seasonal Limited," the large product name "紅月雪かき氷" (Red Moon Snowflake Kaki Ice), descriptive Japanese text, and the price "¥2,300 (tax included)"; the right card displays a circular floral crest and the café name "CAFE 紅月庵" (Crimson Moon An), with the small Romanized text "Kougetsu An" below. Add two floral decorations: a small vase or cluster of pale cherry blossoms on the left edge of the table, with petals scattered on the tray. The lighting should be warm afternoon sunlight from the left, creating a cinematic depth-of-field effect. The lacquerware has realistic reflections, and the desserts are delicately textured and steam-free, rich in detail, creating a comfortable, upscale café atmosphere. There are no other figures in the image, no watermarks, and no modern signage other than the two cards mentioned above.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 3:4 比例的竖版照片级逼真图像，呈现宁静的赛博朋克日式茶屋场景：一位年轻女性身着饰有金色花卉刺绣的红米色华丽和服，坐在传统房间的低矮木桌旁，背景是障子门、木梁，并可透过窗户看到阳光明媚的日式庭院，庭院内有瓦片、绿植和柔和的焦外成像效果。她乌黑亮丽的长发垂在肩上，头部右侧和双手显露出优雅的黑白配色仿生义肢；她的面部被一个纯暖棕色的长方形隐私面罩遮住，没有五官。她面前是一份精致的季节性刨冰甜点，{argument name="dessert name" default="红月雪花刨冰"}，堆叠在饰有金色花纹的黑色漆碗中。刨冰呈白色，顶部淋有深红色糖浆，前方点缀着淡圆形的糯米团子、细小的可食用红白花瓣、金箔碎屑，以及一个黑金配色的蝴蝶形装饰。桌面摆设包含 5 个主要元素：1 个盛放刨冰的大漆碗、1 把放在黑色圆托盘上的红色漆勺、右侧 1 个深色陶瓷茶杯、左侧 1 张竖立的菜单卡，以及右侧 1 张小型咖啡馆标志卡。添加 2 张印刷卡片：左侧菜单卡采用优雅的日式咖啡馆菜单排版，可见标题文字「季節限定」，大号产品名称「紅月雪花かき氷」，描述性日文行文及价格「¥2,300(税込)」；右侧卡片展示圆形花卉纹章及咖啡馆名称「CAFE 紅月庵」，下方配有小型罗马拼音文字“Kougetsu An”。添加 2 处花卉装饰：桌子左侧边缘摆放一小瓶或一簇淡樱花，托盘上散落着花瓣。光线应为来自左侧的温暖午后阳光，具有电影级的景深效果，漆器上有逼真的倒影，甜点纹理细腻且无蒸汽，细节丰富，营造出舒适的高端咖啡馆氛围，画面中无其他人物，无水印，除上述两张卡片外无任何现代标识。

templates.title: Chennai Watercolor Travel Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 金奈水彩旅行海报

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a delicate watercolor illustration in the style of a travel poster, with the theme of {argument name="city name" default="Kinna"} Capturing the rhythm of everyday city streets, showcasing traditional architecture, street food, and coastal details. Canvas: Vertical portrait poster, approximately 3:4 aspect ratio, using textured off-white watercolor paper, with ample blank space in the upper left corner for typography. Layout: A large title is placed in the upper left corner.{argument name="headline text" default="Kinna"} Use an elegant, high-contrast serif font. Add a handwritten subtitle directly below the main heading.{argument name="subtitle text" default="Everyday Urban Rhythm"} Below the subtitle, add a short poem in the style of a small black typewriter: "The air is filled with the smell of sea salt. / Holding a drip coffee in my hand. / Every street has a story. / This is Chennai." Add a thin, hand-drawn horizontal line above and below the poem. In the lower left corner, add a handwritten note: "Chennai / is not just / a city, / but a feeling." "and underlined. Scene: A sunlit street in Chennai, depicted in a delicate pen-and-ink wash style. The right half is dominated by a richly detailed South Indian temple gate (Gopuram), standing behind an old shophouse, covered with numerous tiny sculptural layers in soft cream, peach, blue, and terracotta hues. A large, leafy olive-green tree outlines the upper right corner. The street extends to the left and back, ending near the sea, where a red and white lighthouse can be seen. Key visual elements to include and count: exactly 1 ornate temple gate, exactly 1 red and white lighthouse on the far left, exactly 1 large tree in the upper right corner, exactly 4 black curved streetlights along the road, exactly 2 yellow and black rickshaws (one larger on the left in the foreground, one smaller in the background), exactly 1 bicycle cart carrying green coconuts in the center foreground, exactly 1 pile of coconuts near a woman on the roadside, exactly 1 drip coffee stand on the roadside in the lower right corner, and exactly 1 next to the coffee stand." A blackboard menu, a green road sign pointing to "MARINA BEACH," and exactly five birds in the sky. People and street life: including a middle-aged man riding a coconut bicycle, a woman in a cream-colored sari with gold embellishments walking with her back to the camera in the lower right foreground, a coffee vendor standing in his stall, and a small group of pedestrians in the midground near the temple and coastal road. Facial treatment should maintain a loose, painterly feel, rather than a realistic photographic style. Shops and signage: Add Tamil text to shop signs to enhance local authenticity. On the green road sign, include Tamil text and a white arrow above "MARINA BEACH." On the coffee stall front, write "FILTER COFFEE" below. A Tamil menu is included on the blackboard. The Tamil text can be painterly and imperfect, but should resemble an authentic sign. Visual Style: Elegant urban sketches, delicate pen outlines, transparent watercolor washes, soft warm neutral tones, dusty ochre, pale blue-gray shadows, olive leaves, soft coastal mist, subtle paper texture, slightly loose perspective, hand-drawn details, and a tranquil, nostalgic atmosphere. Avoid glossy digital realism, glaring saturation, modern skyscrapers, cars dominating streets, or crowded, cluttered scenes.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张精致的旅行海报风格水彩插画，主题为 {argument name="city name" default="金奈"}，捕捉日常城市街道的韵律，展现传统建筑、街头美食和沿海细节。

画布：竖版肖像海报，比例约为 3:4，使用带有纹理的米白色水彩纸，左上角留出充足的空白区域用于排版。

布局：在左上角放置大标题“{argument name="headline text" default="金奈"}”，使用优雅的高对比度衬线字体。在标题正下方，添加手写体副标题“{argument name="subtitle text" default="日常城市韵律"}”。在副标题下方，添加一首小型黑色打字机风格的短诗：“空气中弥漫着海盐味。/ 手中捧着滴滤咖啡。/ 每条街道都有故事。/ 这就是金奈。” 在诗句上下方各添加一条细细的手绘水平线。在左下角，添加一段手写小字：“金奈 / 不仅仅是 / 一座城市，/ 而是一种感觉。”并配以短下划线。

场景：以细腻的钢笔淡彩风格展现阳光明媚的金奈街道。右半部分由一座细节丰富的南印度寺庙塔门（Gopuram）主导，它矗立在古老的店面后方，布满了许多微小的雕塑层，色调为柔和的奶油色、桃色、蓝色和赤陶色。一棵枝叶繁茂的橄榄绿色大树勾勒出右上角的轮廓。街道向左后方延伸，尽头靠近大海，可以看到一座红白相间的灯塔。

需要包含并计数的关键视觉元素：正好 1 座华丽的寺庙塔门，远景左侧正好 1 座红白相间的灯塔，右上角正好 1 棵大树，沿路正好 4 盏黑色弧形路灯，正好 2 辆黄黑相间的自动人力车（前景左侧一辆较大的，后方一辆较小的），中心前景正好 1 辆载着青椰子的自行车推车，路边靠近女性处正好 1 堆椰子，右下角正好 1 个路边滴滤咖啡摊，咖啡摊旁正好 1 个黑板菜单，正好 1 个指向“MARINA BEACH”的绿色路标，以及天空中正好 5 只小鸟。

人物与街头生活：包括一名骑着椰子自行车的中年男子，右下角前景中一名穿着带有金色装饰的奶油色纱丽、正背向行走的女性，站在摊位内的咖啡摊贩，以及中景处靠近寺庙和海滨公路的一小群行人。面部处理应保持松散的绘画感，而非写实照片风格。

店铺与招牌文字：在店铺招牌上添加泰米尔语文字以增加当地真实感。在绿色路标上，在“MARINA BEACH”上方包含泰米尔语文字和一个白色箭头。在咖啡摊正面，写上“FILTER COFFEE”，下方写上“STRONG & DEGREES”。黑板上包含一份泰米尔语菜单。泰米尔语文字可以是绘画式的、不完美的，但应看起来像真实的招牌。

视觉风格：优雅的城市速写，细腻的钢笔轮廓，透明的水彩渲染，柔和的暖中性色调，尘土赭色，淡蓝灰色阴影，橄榄色叶片，柔和的沿海雾气，微妙的纸张纹理，略显松散的透视，手绘细节，宁静的怀旧氛围。避免光泽感的数字写实、刺眼的饱和度、现代摩天大楼、主导街道的汽车或拥挤杂乱的场景。

templates.title: Lavender Shaved Ice Anime Cafe

titleLocalized.zh: 薰衣草刨冰动漫咖啡馆

templates.prompt: Create a dreamy, vertical, anime-style illustration depicting a lavender-themed dessert café scene. A young woman with short, wavy, purplish-grey hair, braided to the side, sits at a table by a sunny window, wearing an elegant lavender lace slip dress with two bows on the straps. Her face is deliberately concealed by an opaque square obscuring her features, its soft purplish-red to pale pink gradient covering her entire face while preserving the visibility of her hair, neck, shoulders, and clothing. One hand is near her cheek, while the other rests beside a large bowl of shaved ice. The dessert is the focal point: an oversized, pinkish-purple kakigori (shaved ice) stacked in a clear crystal bowl and tray, topped with a scoop of lavender ice cream, crystal sugar flakes, edible glitter, and small star decorations, topped with a large white snowflake, and surrounded by blue-purple jelly or crystal shards; a small gold spoon rests on the tray. On the left side of the table, there is a cafe menu card printed in Japanese, with the brand name "SETSUGETSU HYOKA" and the main product "Moonlight のラベンダーice～Stardust のきらめき～" printed on it, followed by a list of 6 Key points: "ラベンダーシロップ", "バタフライピージ" "ュレ", "ミルクエスプーマ", "ホワイトチョコスノー”, “パールクラッシュ”, “Star-shaped amber candy”; display price “¥2,200 (tax＾)” and a brief Japanese description below. Against a softly blurred background, the artwork includes a wall sign bearing the café's name, "Snow Moon Ice Fruit," lavender and hydrangea decorations, sheer curtains, warm afternoon sunlight, shimmering dust particles, and soft purple-pink hues. Tabletop details include a small glass dish filled with sugar crystals, scattered lavender and blue gemstones, a glowing round glass lamp on the right, and small flowers in a vase. High-detail anime rendering, backlighting, soft focus effects, transparent glass reflections, and delicate lines create an ethereal summer atmosphere. There are no extra characters or watermarks. Customizable elements include: dessert names.{argument name="dessert name" default="Moonlight Lavender Ice ~The Sparkle of Stardust~"} ,price{argument name="price" default="¥2,200 (tax included)"} Coffee shop name{argument name="café name" default="Snow Moon Ice Dessert"} skirt color{argument name="dress color" default="lavender"} Color of the masking block{argument name="censor block color" default="muted mauve to pale pink gradient"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅梦幻般的竖构图动漫风格插画，展现薰衣草主题甜点咖啡馆场景。一位留着波浪短发、发色为紫灰色的年轻女性，侧边编着小辫子，坐在阳光明媚的窗边桌前，身穿精致的薰衣草色蕾丝吊带裙，肩带带有两个蝴蝶结。她的脸部被一个位于正中央的不透明方形遮挡块刻意隐藏，遮挡块呈现柔和的紫红至淡粉色渐变，覆盖整个面部区域，但保留了头发、颈部、肩膀和服装的可见度。她的一只手靠近脸颊，另一只手放在一大碗刨冰旁。甜点是画面的焦点：一个超大份的粉紫色 kakigori（刨冰）堆叠在透明的水晶玻璃碗和托盘中，顶部装饰着一个薰衣草冰淇淋球、结晶糖片、食用闪粉、小星星装饰，正面有一个巨大的白色雪花装饰，底座周围点缀着蓝紫色果冻或水晶碎片；在托盘上放置一把小金勺。在桌子左侧，放置一张日文印刷的咖啡馆菜单卡，印有品牌名称“SETSUGETSU HYOKA”和主打商品“月光のラベンダー氷 ～星屑のきらめき～”，随后列出 6 项要点：“ラベンダーシロップ”、“バタフライピージュレ”、“ミルクエスプーマ”、“ホワイトチョコスノー”、“パールクラッシュ”、“星型の琥珀糖”；显示价格“¥2,200（税込）”以及下方的一段简短日文描述。在柔和模糊的背景中，包含写有咖啡馆名称“雪月氷菓”的墙面招牌、薰衣草和绣球花装饰、透明窗帘、温暖的午后阳光、闪烁的尘埃微粒，以及柔和的紫粉色调。添加桌面细节：装有糖晶的小玻璃碟、散落的薰衣草色和蓝色宝石、右侧一个发光的圆形玻璃灯，以及花瓶中的小花。采用高细节精细动漫渲染、发光背光、柔焦效果、透明玻璃反射、细腻线条，营造空灵的夏季氛围，无额外角色，无水印。可自定义元素：甜点名称 {argument name="dessert name" default="月光のラベンダー氷 ～星屑のきらめき～"}，价格 {argument name="price" default="¥2,200（税込）"}，咖啡馆名称 {argument name="café name" default="雪月氷菓"}，裙子颜色 {argument name="dress color" default="lavender"}，遮挡块颜色 {argument name="censor block color" default="muted mauve to pale pink gradient"}。

templates.title: Honey Milk Shaved Ice Cafe Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 花蜜牛奶刨冰咖啡馆场景

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a warm, realistic, upscale Japanese café dessert advertising scene for a seasonal shaved ice menu, evoking a romantic, pastoral flower-filled atmosphere. Canvas: Vertical 3:4 composition, photorealistic yet softly idealized colors, golden hour sunlight, shallow depth of field, creamy beige and honey tones, high detail, no strong contrast. Layout: A beautiful glass shaved ice bowl is displayed in the center of the foreground, placed on a matching tray. The left side includes three independent signage elements: a tall café sign in the upper left, a framed item in the lower left, and a small paper label at the bottom left. The right side features a young woman seated behind the dessert, and a small white rabbit figurine or plush toy beside the bowl. The background is a rustic wooden café interior with sunlit windows, hanging greenery, lace, dried flowers, and daisies. Subject: A luxurious bowl of milk shaved ice, served in a fan-shaped vintage glass bowl, topped with a round scoop of light cream ice cream. The shaved ice is decorated with clear honey syrup, pale yellow honey jelly chunks, peach-pink fruit slices, white edible flowers, yellow daisy centers, mint leaves, and shimmering ice crystals. The flavor should reflect honey, milk, edible flowers, vanilla, and a hint of citrus. The dessert should appear sophisticated, refined, and refreshing. Character: Place a young blonde woman wearing a beige lace cardigan or crochet shirt, holding a gold spoon in her right hand and resting her chin on her left. She wears a wreath of small white, beige, and pale pink flowers. Her face is obscured by a warm beige opaque square that matches the generated image's tone.{argument name="hair color" default="Long wavy blonde hair"} and{argument name="outfit style" default="Beige vintage lace cardigan with crocheted cuffs"} Text and signage: The framed sign above should read "CAFÉ Fraise Étoilée" with a smaller Japanese subtitle and the English phrase "Blooming with my own light." The framed item below should display the seasonal shaved ice title in Japanese.{argument name="menu title" default="Flower Crown Honey Milk Shaved Ice"} A brief subtitle, a few lines of concise Japanese ingredient information, and the price for the large size.{argument name="price" default="¥2,200 (tax included)"} The small label at the bottom should read "Blooming with my own light." Add a small heart doodle and a small gold wax seal near the label. Maintain elegant, centered Japanese typography with a café menu style. Visually countable details to include: 1 shaved ice bowl, 1 spoon in a woman's hand, 1 flower wreath, 1 white rabbit, 3 logo elements, plenty of scattered daisies and dried flowers, 1 gold wax seal, and 1 small heart doodle. Style restrictions: Use realistic food photography lighting, blending with a fairytale café style. Include lace tablecloth textures, antique picture frames, embossed decorations, transparent glass reflections, warm backlighting through windows, and soft blurring effects. Avoid modern plastics, neon colors, hard shadows, unnecessary figures, watermarks, or irrelevant text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为季节性刨冰菜单创建一个温馨、写实的高级日式咖啡馆甜点广告场景，营造浪漫的田园花海氛围。

画布：垂直 3:4 构图，照片级真实感但带有柔和的理想化色彩，黄金时刻的阳光，浅景深，奶油米色和蜂蜜色调，高细节，无强烈对比。

布局：前景中心展示一个精美的玻璃刨冰碗，放置在配套的托盘上。左侧包含 3 个独立的标识元素：左上方 1 个高大的咖啡馆招牌，左下方 1 个带框的项目，以及底部左侧 1 个小纸标签。右侧包含 1 位坐在甜点后的年轻女性，以及碗旁 1 个白色小兔子摆件或毛绒玩具。背景为质朴的木质咖啡馆内饰，配有阳光充足的窗户、垂挂的绿植、蕾丝、干花和小雏菊。

主体：一碗奢华的牛奶刨冰，盛在扇形复古玻璃碗中，顶部放有一个圆形的淡奶味冰淇淋球。刨冰上装饰着透明蜂蜜糖浆、淡黄色蜂蜜果冻块、桃粉色水果片、白色食用花卉、黄色雏菊芯、薄荷叶和闪烁的冰晶。口味应体现蜂蜜、牛奶、食用花卉、香草和清淡的柑橘味。让甜点看起来高级、精致且清爽。

角色：放置一位身穿米色蕾丝开衫或钩针编织衬衫的年轻金发女性，右手拿着金勺，左手托着下巴。她戴着由白色、米色和淡粉色小花组成的花环。她的脸部被一个与生成图像色调一致的暖米色不透明方块遮住。使用 {argument name="hair color" default="长波浪金发"} 和 {argument name="outfit style" default="带钩针袖口的米色复古蕾丝开衫"}。

文字与标识：上方的带框招牌应写有“CAFÉ Fraise Étoilée”，并配有较小的日语副标题和英文短语“Blooming with my own light.”。下方的带框项目应以日语显示季节限定刨冰标题：{argument name="menu title" default="花冠はちみつのミルクかき氷"}，一个简短的副标题，几行简短的日语配料说明，以及大号价格 {argument name="price" default="¥2,200(税込)"}。底部的小标签应写有“Blooming with my own light.”。在标签附近添加一个小爱心涂鸦和一个金色小火漆印。保持日语排版优雅、居中，且具有咖啡馆菜单的风格。

需包含的可视计数细节：1 个刨冰碗，女性手中 1 把勺子，1 个花环，1 只白兔，3 个标识元素，大量散落的雏菊和干花，1 个金色火漆印，以及 1 个小爱心涂鸦。

风格限制：使用写实的美食摄影灯光，融合童话般的咖啡馆风格。包含蕾丝桌布纹理、古董画框、压花装饰、透明玻璃反射、穿过窗户的温暖背光以及柔和的虚化效果。避免出现现代塑料制品、霓虹色、硬阴影、多余的人物、水印或不相关的文字。

templates.title: Char Aznable-themed red comet shaved ice cafe advertisement

titleLocalized.zh: 夏亚风格红色彗星刨冰咖啡馆广告

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a cinematic, realistic promotional image for a café featuring a limited-edition seasonal shaved ice dessert inspired by the aesthetics of a red-masked ace pilot. Using {argument name="theme franchise" default="Zeon/Char Aznable style sci-fi military theme"} There's no need to overtly display any official copyright logos, but similar gold badge patterns should be incorporated into the desserts, bowls, banners, and menus. Canvas: Vertical 3:4 composition, high resolution, warm dramatic lighting, shallow depth of field, a combination of realistic food photography and a cosplay café atmosphere. Layout: The foreground centers on an oversized bowl of red berry shaved ice on a dark tray. To the left stands a dark brown menu item with an ornate gold border and Japanese text. In the background on the right, a helmeted officer in a red uniform sits in a leather chair, slightly out of focus, his face obscured by a rectangular privacy blur. The left background shows a window offering a view of outer space and a blue planet, with a red banner bearing a black military-style badge hanging on the back wall. Subject details: The dessert is a mountain of shaved ice served in a glossy black bowl. It's topped with vibrant red berry syrup, with many red berries visible, a few strawberry slices on the right, drizzled with pale condensed milk, and topped with a large spiral of whipped cream. Add gold sugar beads and tiny star decorations. Two garnishes are placed on the whipped cream: a translucent red star-shaped sugar crystal and a round chocolate medallion with a gold winged emblem. A white emblem and the word "ZEON" are printed on the front of the black bowl. A spoon is placed in front of the bowl on a tray, and a small glass pitcher containing red syrup is placed to the right. Characters and Environment: The figure in the background wears a white horn-shaped sci-fi helmet, a red military jacket, a black and gold breastplate, gold epaulets, and white gloves. The figure sits casually, with a gloved hand near the chin. The facial area must be obscured with a soft-edged rectangular blur. The room feels like a dark space station lounge or themed café, with metallic panels, warm amber lighting, red accents, and cinematic reflections. Text on menu items: Uses a gold Japanese font on a dark brown background. Includes a title.{argument name="menu headline" default="Char's Custom Red Comet Shaved Ice"} ,subtitle{argument name="menu subheading" default="~The Red Ice Wall, the Ace's Pride~"} and price{argument name="price" default="¥2,200 (tax included)"} The toppings list includes 5 lines: 1. Red berry syrup, 2. Strawberry jam, 3. Raspberry jam, 4. Green espresso aroma, 5. White chocolate and star-shaped sugar. Add the shop name at the bottom.{argument name="shop name" default="Setsugetsu Saryo"} Visual Style: Realistic photography, high-end café advertising, rich black and red tones, metallic gold highlights, crisp and detailed dessert textures, lifelike ice crystals, glistening syrup, soft background blur, dramatic warm key light from the upper right, and subtle cool blue space light from the left. Constraints: Maintain a vertical composition and center the image on the dessert. Use only one menu item, one dessert bowl, one spoon, one syrup pitcher, one seated helmeted character, one red wall banner, one visible planet, and two dessert decorations. Do not add extra people, extra bowls, watermarks, or use English replacement text on the Japanese menu.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为一款灵感源自红色面具王牌飞行员美学的季节限定刨冰甜点，创作一张电影级写实风格的咖啡馆宣传图。使用 {argument name="theme franchise" default="吉翁 / 夏亚风格科幻军事主题"}，无需过于直白地展示任何官方版权标识，但需在甜点、碗、横幅和菜单上加入类似的金色徽章图案。

画布：垂直 3:4 构图，高分辨率，温暖的戏剧性光影，浅景深，写实美食摄影与 Cosplay 咖啡馆氛围相结合。

布局：前景中心是一个放在深色托盘上的超大碗红浆果刨冰。左侧立着一个深棕色菜单项目，带有华丽的金色边框和日语文字。右侧背景中有一位戴着头盔、身穿红色制服的军官坐在皮椅上，略微失焦，面部被矩形隐私模糊遮挡。左侧背景展示了一扇可以看到外太空和一颗蓝色行星的窗户，后墙上挂着一面带有黑色军事风格徽章的红色横幅。

主体细节：甜点是堆成高山的刨冰，盛在光亮的黑色碗中。表面覆盖着鲜艳的红浆果糖浆，可见许多红浆果，右侧有几片草莓切片，淋有淡色炼乳，顶部有一个巨大的螺旋状鲜奶油。添加金色糖珠和微小的星形装饰。在鲜奶油上放置 2 个装饰物：1 个半透明红色星形糖晶和 1 个带有金色翼状徽章的圆形巧克力奖章。黑色碗的前方印有白色徽章和“ZEON”字样。在托盘上碗的前方放置 1 把勺子，右侧放置 1 个装有红色糖浆的小玻璃壶。

角色与环境：背景中的人物戴着白色角状科幻头盔，身穿红色军装夹克、黑金配色胸甲、金色肩章和白色手套。人物姿态随意地坐着，一只戴手套的手靠近下巴。面部区域必须用柔和边缘的矩形模糊遮盖。房间感觉像是一个黑暗的空间站休息室或主题咖啡馆，配有金属面板、温暖的琥珀色灯光、红色装饰和电影般的反射效果。

菜单项目上的文字内容：使用深棕色背景上的金色日语字体。包含标题 {argument name="menu headline" default="シャア専用 赤い彗星かき氷"}，副标题 {argument name="menu subheading" default="〜赤き氷壁、エースの誇り〜"}，以及价格 {argument name="price" default="¥2,200（税込）"}。包含 5 行配料列表：1. 红浆果糖浆，2. 草莓果酱，3. 覆盆子酱，4. 绿意浓缩咖啡香气，5. 白巧克力与星形糖。底部添加店铺名称：{argument name="shop name" default="雪月茶寮 SETSUGETSU SARYO"}。

视觉风格：写实摄影，高端咖啡馆广告，浓郁的黑色与红色，金属质感的金色高光，清晰细腻的甜点纹理，逼真的冰晶，光亮的糖浆，柔和的背景虚化，来自右上方的戏剧性暖色主光，来自左侧微妙的冷蓝色太空光。

约束：保持垂直构图，并以甜点为中心。仅使用一个菜单项目、一个甜点碗、一把勺子、一个糖浆壶、一个坐着的头盔角色、一个红色墙面横幅、一个可见行星和两个甜点装饰物。不要添加额外的人员、额外的碗、水印或在日语菜单上使用英文替换文本。
