templates.title: Luxury cyberpunk-style shaved ice café scene

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华赛博风格刨冰咖啡馆场景

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a realistic illustration in the style of an upscale Japanese café advertisement, showcasing seasonal shaved ice desserts served in a traditional room, with a serene cyberpunk shrine maiden receptionist in the background. Canvas: Vertical 3:4 composition, warm cinematic sunlight, shallow depth of field, ultra-realistic rendering, incorporating subtle anime-style character design. The camera is positioned at tabletop height, focusing on the dessert in the foreground. Scene: An elegant traditional Japanese café, located in a wooden tatami room with shoji sliding doors and dark wooden beams. Through an open corridor, a blurred Japanese garden is shown in the distance, including green vegetation, stone elements, and tiled roofs. Golden afternoon sunlight streams in from the left, creating soft highlights and shadows. Subject: A large, luxurious shaved ice dessert placed in the center of the foreground on a glossy black lacquered plate. The shaved ice is towering and rounded, with ruby-red strawberry syrup cascading down its pure white surface from the front and sides. It is served in a black lacquered bowl decorated with gold floral patterns. A red lacquered spoon rests on the tray. Dessert Details: Seven visible toppings/garnishes are used: 1) rich red strawberry syrup, 2) small white mochi balls gathered on top, 3) pale pink and white cherry blossoms sprinkled on top, 4) tiny gold leaf shards, 5) a black and gold butterfly decoration rising near the top, 6) deep red bean paste or berry sauce gathered around the rim of the bowl, and 7) a layer of fine white shaved ice shavings. This makes the dessert look expensive, delicate, and handcrafted. Role: Placed behind the dessert.{argument name="character name" default="A beautiful cyber Japanese woman"} She wore an elegant white, red, and gold kimono, adorned with ornate floral embroidery. She had long, glossy hair.{argument name="hair color" default="black"} She has long hair with bangs, highly sophisticated mechanical prosthetics, and visible cybernetic ear/neck components. Her hands are clasped together in prayer near her face, as if admiring a dessert. Her face is deliberately obscured by a flat, opaque square veil with a warm brown gradient, concealing the central area of ​​her face while revealing her hair and body. Tabletop items: In addition to the dessert and spoon, there are 4 tabletop items: 1) a framed menu card on the left, 2) a small vase with a cherry blossom branch next to the menu, 3) a dark ceramic teacup to the right of the dessert, and 4) a small café sign card on the far right. Visible text: On the framed menu card on the left, using a Japanese typographic font, the title is {argument name="dessert headline" default="Seasonal Limited Edition: Red Moon Snow Flower Shaved Ice"} Below are smaller flavor descriptions, and the price is listed at the bottom.{argument name="price" default="¥2,300 (tax included)"} The clearly visible flavor lines should include cherry blossom milk syrup, rich strawberry syrup, white bean paste and cherry blossom sauce, gold leaf, black sesame seeds, and vanilla foam. On the right-hand sign card, a circular floral emblem and the café's name are displayed.{argument name="café name" default="CAFE Kougetsu An"} Style and Lighting: A fusion of hyper-realistic high-end food photography and exquisite illustration, rich in detail with ice textures, syrup sheen, lacquer reflections, gold embroidery, and mechanical joints. Warm amber highlights, softly blurred courtyard backgrounds, and elegant, luxurious Japanese aesthetics. Avoiding modern clutter, extra characters, watermarks, or irrelevant text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张写实的高端日式咖啡馆广告风格插画，展示在传统房间内供应的季节性刨冰甜点，背景中有一位宁静的赛博巫女接待员。

画布：垂直 3:4 构图，温暖的电影感阳光，浅景深，超精细写实渲染，融合微妙的动漫风格角色设计。相机位于桌面高度，聚焦于前景的甜点。

场景：精致的传统日式咖啡馆，位于木质榻榻米房间内，配有障子推拉门和深色木梁。透过开放的走廊，展示远处模糊的日式庭院，包括绿色植被、石元素和瓦片屋顶。金色的午后阳光从左侧射入，营造出柔和的高光和阴影。

主体：前景中央放置在一张黑色亮面漆盘上的大型奢华刨冰甜点。刨冰高耸圆润，纯白色的冰面上，红宝石般的草莓糖浆从正面和侧面倾泻而下。用装饰有金色花卉图案的黑色漆碗盛放。托盘上放着一把红色漆勺。

甜点细节：使用 7 组可见的配料/装饰：1) 浓郁的红色草莓糖浆，2) 聚集在正面的白色小糯米团，3) 撒在顶部的淡粉色和白色樱花，4) 微小的金箔碎片，5) 顶部附近升起的黑金蝴蝶形装饰，6) 碗边聚集的深红色豆沙或浆果酱，以及 7) 一层细细的白色刨冰碎屑。让甜点看起来昂贵、精致且手工制作。

角色：在甜点后方，放置 {argument name="character name" default="一位美丽的赛博日式女性"}，身着优雅的白、红、金三色和服，上面有华丽的花卉刺绣。她留着长而有光泽的 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"} 刘海长发，拥有高度精细的机械义肢以及可见的赛博耳部/颈部组件。她的双手在脸部附近合十祈祷，仿佛在欣赏甜点。她的面部被一个带有暖棕色渐变的扁平不透明方形遮挡块刻意遮盖，遮住了面部中心区域，同时露出头发和身体。

桌面物品：除甜点和勺子外，包含 4 件桌面物品：1) 左侧的带框菜单卡，2) 菜单旁放置樱花枝的小花瓶，3) 甜点右侧的深色陶瓷茶杯，以及 4) 最右侧的小咖啡馆标志卡。

可见文字：在左侧的带框菜单卡上，使用日式印刷字体，标题为 {argument name="dessert headline" default="季節限定 紅月雪花かき氷"}，下方列出较小的口味描述，底部标有价格 {argument name="price" default="¥2,300(税込)"}。清晰可见的口味行应包含樱花牛奶糖浆、浓郁草莓糖浆、白豆沙和樱花酱、金箔、黑芝麻碎和香草泡沫。在右侧的标志卡上，展示一个圆形花卉纹章和咖啡馆名称 {argument name="café name" default="CAFE 紅月庵 -Kougetsu An-"}。

风格与光影：超写实高端美食摄影与精致插画的结合，冰块纹理、糖浆光泽、漆器反射、金色刺绣和机械关节处细节丰富。温暖的琥珀色高光，柔和的庭院背景虚化，优雅的奢华日式美学。避免现代杂乱元素、额外角色、水印或无关文字。

titleLocalized.zh: 薰衣草月光刨冰咖啡馆

templates.prompt:
Create a dreamy, high-end anime-style cafe illustration, presenting a realistic Japanese shaved ice themed around lavender and moonlight. The canvas should be 3:4 vertical, with a background softly backlit by a large floor-to-ceiling window with sheer curtains, adorned with pale purple hydrangeas, lavender, and glass vases, creating a shimmering bokeh effect and a refined Japanese dessert cafe atmosphere. In the center of the foreground is a faceted transparent glass bowl, with a tray at its base piled high with shaved ice drizzled with layers of pale pink, light purple, dark purple, and translucent icy blue syrup. The dessert should include four striking decorative toppings: a scoop of lavender ice cream on top, a cluster of translucent crystal shards near the scoop, a pink star decoration in the foreground left, and a white snowflake decoration in the lower right; the base should be surrounded by numerous blue crystal jelly pieces and shimmering sugar crystals. A small gold spoon rests on the tray. Behind the desserts sat an elegant young woman, wearing a lavender lace slip dress and sporting a light purple-grey bob with side braids. Her hands rested gently on the rim of a bowl, her posture romantic and graceful. A centered, opaque square gradient mask concealed her entire face, transitioning from a soft purple at the top to a light pink at the bottom, revealing only her hair, ears, neck, shoulders, and hands. To the left foreground was a standing menu card with a delicate lavender border, and {argument name="menu text" default="Setsugetsu Hyoka
Moonlight Lavender Ice
~Sparkle of Stardust~
・Lavender Syrup
・Butterfly Pea Jelly
・Milk Espuma
・White Chocolate Snow
・Pearl Crush
・Star-shaped Amber Candy
¥2,200 (tax included)
Sugar-free ice with a gentle sweetness and fragrance, as if capturing the moonlight
"} The card displays clear Japanese text and includes six bullet points. The background features a café logo and the café's name in Japanese.{argument name="café name" default="Setsugetsu Saryo"} The vertical wall sign features a soft, luminous palette of lavender, pale pink, ice blue, and warm white. It boasts high detail, a translucent, ice-like texture, glossy glass reflections, magical shimmer, soft depth of field, and sophisticated dessert photography composition incorporating delicate anime illustrations. Other figures, extra menu items, and watermarks are avoided, and all visible text remains clear and consistent with the café's style.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张梦幻般的高级动漫风格咖啡馆插画，呈现以薰衣草月光为主题的写实日式刨冰。画布为 3:4 竖构图，背景由带有透明窗帘的大型落地窗柔和逆光照射，点缀着淡紫色绣球花和薰衣草、玻璃花瓶，营造出闪烁的焦外成像效果和精致的日式甜点咖啡馆氛围。在前景中央放置一个带有切面的透明玻璃碗，碗底托盘上堆叠着高耸的刨冰，淋有层叠的淡粉色、浅紫色、深紫色和半透明冰蓝色糖浆。甜点需包含 4 种醒目的装饰配料：顶部 1 个薰衣草冰淇淋球、球体附近 1 簇半透明水晶碎片、左前方 1 个粉色星星装饰，以及右下方 1 个白色雪花装饰；底座周围环绕着许多蓝色水晶果冻块和闪烁的糖晶体。托盘上放一把金色小勺。甜点后方坐着一位优雅的年轻女性，身穿薰衣草色蕾丝吊带裙，留着带有侧编发细节的浅紫灰色短波波头，双手轻柔地置于碗边，姿态浪漫柔美；用一个居中的不透明方形渐变遮罩遮住她的整张脸，遮罩从顶部的柔和紫色过渡到底部的浅粉色，仅露出头发、耳朵、脖颈、肩膀和双手。左侧前景放置一张立式菜单卡，带有华丽的薰衣草色细边框，并使用 {argument name="menu text" default="雪月氷菓
SETSUGETSU HYOKA
月光のラベンダー氷
〜星屑のきらめき〜
・ラベンダーシロップ
・バタフライピージュレ
・ミルクエスプーマ

・星型の琥珀糖
¥2,200（税込）
月明かりを閉じ込めたような
やさしい甘さと香りの無糖氷"} 显示清晰的日文文本；卡片包含 6 个项目符号。背景中包含一个带有咖啡馆 Logo 和日文店名 {argument name="café name" default="雪月茶寮"} 的竖式墙面招牌。采用薰衣草色、淡粉色、冰蓝色和暖白色的发光柔和色调，具备高细节度、半透明冰块质感、光亮的玻璃反射、魔法般的闪光、柔和的景深，以及融合了精致动漫插画的高级甜点摄影构图。避免出现其他人物，避免添加额外菜单项，避免水印，并保持所有可见文字清晰且符合咖啡馆风格。

templates.title: Realistic portrait of wavy hair

titleLocalized.zh: 逼真的波浪卷发肖像

templates.prompt: Create a realistic, soft-light, vertical portrait of a young woman, centered facing the camera, with the composition extending from above her chest to above her head. She has {argument name="hair color" default="Dark chocolate brown"} Her long, layered hairstyle featured natural, loose waves, with volume at the crown and a center parting, framing her face with strands falling gracefully. Her true face was completely obscured by a large, vertical rectangle extending from her forehead to her chin; this rectangle displayed a smooth, warm skin-toned gradient, with dark brown edges and a light peach center, its sharp, straight edges completely obscuring any facial features. She wore a fitted top {argument name="top color" default="White"} A long-sleeved, round-neck ribbed top, paired with delicate silver hoop earrings and a refined silver necklace adorned with small star or flower pendants. The image utilizes realistic details, natural hair texture, delicate skin details on the neck and chest, shallow depth of field, and a bright, neutral interior background with cream-colored walls and a softly blurred effect. The composition is a clean 4:5 vertical aspect ratio, reflecting a lifestyle photography style with realistic lighting. There is no text, no watermark, and no other people in the image.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张室内写实、柔光垂直肖像照，拍摄对象为一名年轻女性，构图从胸部上方到头部上方，居中面向镜头。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深巧克力棕色"} 的长款层次感发型，带有自然松散的波浪，头顶蓬松，中分发型，脸颊两侧有发丝垂落。她的真实面部被一个从上额头延伸至下巴的巨大垂直矩形完全遮挡；该矩形呈现出平滑的暖色调肤色渐变，边缘为深棕色，中心为浅桃色，边缘锐利平直，看不到任何面部特征。她穿着一件修身的 {argument name="top color" default="白色"} 长袖圆领罗纹上衣，佩戴小巧的银色圆环耳环，以及一条带有小星星或花朵吊坠的精致银项链。使用写实细节、自然的头发纹理、颈部和胸部细腻的皮肤细节、浅景深，以及带有奶油色墙面和柔和虚化的明亮中性家居室内背景。构图比例为垂直 4:5，干净的生活方式摄影风格，写实光影，无文字，无水印，无其他人物。

templates.title: Realistic style window-side cafe fashion portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 写实风格窗边咖啡馆时尚人像

templates.prompt: Create a realistic vertical fashion portrait photograph, with the subject being {argument name="subject" default="A young woman"} She sits at a wooden coffee table by a tall, black-framed window. Her posture is relaxed and natural, slightly turned towards the window. Her face is anonymized through soft rectangular blurs or neutral mosaics, while her natural hair, neck, shoulders, and body posture are preserved. Her attire comprises three core pieces: a mustard yellow ribbed crew neck vest, a light blue semi-transparent oversized shirt (worn open and slipping off her shoulders, sleeves casually rolled up), and light beige linen shorts or a skirt. Two visible accessories are added: a delicate necklace with a small pendant and a pair of understated earrings. Her dark hair is casually styled in a messy bun, with a few strands falling loosely around her ears and neck. Two foreground tabletop items are placed in the lower left corner: a gray ceramic mug with black coffee and a matching tray, and a clear glass vase filled with white and beige dried flowers. The café's interior should have a warm, tranquil, and realistic atmosphere, with wooden furniture, a softly blurred background, warm pendant lighting, and natural sunlight streaming in from the left window. Employing shallow depth of field, creamy bokeh, realistic skin texture, natural fabric transparency, soft shadows, warm highlights, and cinematic color grading, this film presents a 35mm or 50mm documentary photography feel. It uses a 2:3 vertical composition, with the subject positioned on the right side of the frame, and contains no text, watermarks, extraneous figures, or distorted hands.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实风格的竖版时尚人像摄影作品，主角为 {argument name="subject" default="一位年轻女性"}，正坐在高大黑色边框窗边的木质咖啡桌旁。她微微转向窗户，姿态自然放松，面部通过柔和的矩形模糊或中性马赛克进行匿名化处理，同时保留自然的头发、颈部、肩部和身体姿态。服装包含 3 件核心单品：一件芥末黄罗纹圆领背心、一件浅蓝色半透明超大款衬衫（敞开穿着并从双肩滑落，袖口随意卷起），以及一条浅米色亚麻短裤或短裙。添加 2 件可见配饰：一条带有小吊坠的精致细项链和一对低调的小耳环。深色头发随意盘成凌乱的发髻，耳边和颈部散落着几缕发丝。在左下方放置 2 件前景桌面物品：一个盛有黑咖啡的灰色陶瓷杯及配套托盘，以及一个插有白色和米色干花的透明玻璃花瓶。咖啡馆内部氛围应温暖、宁静且具有写实感，配有木质家具、柔和的背景虚化、温暖的吊灯光影，以及从左侧窗户射入的自然日光。采用浅景深、奶油般虚化效果、真实的皮肤纹理、自然的织物通透感、柔和的阴影、温暖的高光、电影级调色，呈现 35mm 或 50mm 纪实摄影质感，采用 2:3 竖构图，主体位于画面中右侧，无文字，无水印，无多余人物，无扭曲的手部。

templates.title: Char Azur Lane-themed red shaved ice cafe photo

titleLocalized.zh: 夏亚主题红色刨冰咖啡馆摄影图

templates.prompt: Create a realistic photograph of a high-end Japanese-style café product showcasing an anime-themed shaved ice dessert inspired by Char Aznable from *Mobile Suit Gundam*. Scene: Nighttime, inside a luxurious sci-fi café with a dark color scheme, featuring warm amber lighting and black lacquered tabletops; a window on the left displays outer space and a blue planet; a red banner with a black Zeon-style emblem hangs in the background; behind it sits a uniformed officer in a white horned helmet and red, gold-trimmed military uniform, his face deliberately blurred with soft rectangular blurring. Center foreground: An oversized shaved ice bowl, glossy black with a white Zeon emblem and the word "ZEON," sits on a round, black and red tray, accompanied by a spoon. Dessert Details: A towering mound of crystallized shaved ice, drizzled with vibrant red berry syrup, garnished with whole raspberries and cranberries; sliced ​​strawberries on the right, drizzled with bright white condensed milk; topped with a thick ring of pale whipped cream, sprinkled with delicate edible glitter and tiny gold star-shaped sugar sprinkles; adorned with a translucent red star decoration and a gold chocolate garnish with a Zeon-style emblem. A small glass syrup pitcher sits on the right. On the left is an upright, dark brown menu/instruction board with an ornate gold border and Japanese typography. The menu board must contain the following visible text: "Seasonal Limited" at the top, main title "シャア専用红いcometかき冰", subtitle "~ "Red Ice Wall", "エースの高り~", a badge separator, five ingredient lists "Red いベリーシロップ", "いちごコン" "ポート", "ラズベリーソース", "training milk エスプーマ", "ホワイトチョコレート", a short description The text, the price "¥2,200 (tax)", the name of the cafe "Setsuki Saryo" and the small letters below "SETSUGETSU" SARYO". Style: Hyperrealistic commercial food photography, high-end limited-edition dessert advertisements, shallow depth of field, sharp focus on shaved ice, rich red and black color scheme, cinematic lighting, and rich detail in the reflections of ice crystals and syrup. Customizable slot: Cafe name.{argument name="café name" default="Setsugetsu Saryo"} Main dessert title{argument name="dessert title" default="Char's Custom Red Comet Shaved Ice"} ,price{argument name="price" default="¥2,200 (tax included)"} The inscription on the emblem on the bowl{argument name="bowl logo text" default="ZEON"} Background character style{argument name="background character style" default="White horned helmet and red military uniform"} Constraints: Only one dessert bowl, one menu board, one spoon, one syrup pitcher, one red banner, and one blurred background character are allowed; no additional signs are permitted except for fictional Zeon-style markings; ensure all Japanese menu text is clearly visible and placed on the left-hand menu.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实的高端日式咖啡馆产品摄影图，展示一款以《机动战士高达》中夏亚·阿兹纳布尔为灵感的动漫主题刨冰甜点。场景：夜晚，一家深色调的奢华科幻主题咖啡馆内，配有温暖的琥珀色灯光、黑色漆面桌面；左侧窗户展示出外太空和一颗蓝色行星；背景中悬挂着一条带有黑色吉翁风格徽章的红色竖幅；后方坐着一位身穿白色角盔和红色镶金边军装的制服军官，面部刻意用柔和的矩形模糊处理。中心前景：一个超大号刨冰碗，碗身呈亮黑色，印有白色吉翁徽章和“ZEON”字样，放置在圆形的黑红托盘上，配有一把勺子。甜点细节：高耸的结晶刨冰堆，淋上鲜艳的红色浆果糖浆，点缀着整颗树莓和蔓越莓，右侧摆放切片草莓，淋有亮白色的炼乳，顶部有一圈厚实的淡色鲜奶油，撒上精致的可食用亮粉和金色小星星糖粒，配有一个红色半透明星形装饰，以及一个带有吉翁风格徽章的金色巧克力饰片。右侧放置一个小玻璃糖浆壶。左侧放置一块直立的深棕色菜单/说明牌，带有华丽的金色边框和日文排版。菜单牌必须包含以下可见文字：顶部“季节限定”、主标题“シャア専用 赤い彗星かき氷”、副标题“〜赤き氷壁、エースの誇り〜”、一个徽章分隔符、五个成分列表“赤いベリーシロップ”、“いちごコンポート”、“ラズベリーソース”、“練乳エスプーマ”、“ホワイトチョコレート”、一段简短的描述文字、价格“¥2,200(税込)”以及咖啡馆名称“雪月茶寮”及下方的小字“SETSUGETSU SARYO”。风格：超写实商业美食摄影，高端限量版甜点广告，浅景深，刨冰焦点清晰，浓郁的红黑配色，电影级布光，冰晶与糖浆反射细节丰富。可自定义槽位：咖啡馆名称 {argument name="café name" default="雪月茶寮"}，主甜点标题 {argument name="dessert title" default="シャア専用 赤い彗星かき氷"}，价格 {argument name="price" default="¥2,200(税込)"}，碗身徽章文字 {argument name="bowl logo text" default="ZEON"}，背景角色风格 {argument name="background character style" default="白色角盔和红色军装"}。约束条件：仅包含一个甜点碗、一个菜单牌、一把勺子、一个糖浆壶、一条红色横幅和一个模糊的背景角色；除虚构的吉翁风格标记外，不得包含其他额外标志；确保所有日文菜单文字清晰可见并放置在左侧餐牌上。

templates.title: Yuri Sakazaki anime fighting poster

titleLocalized.zh: 坂崎百合动漫格斗海报

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="character name" default="Yuri Sakazaki"} Create a highly dramatic anime fighting game character poster, showcasing two dynamic versions of the same young female martial artist against a rugged urban battle scene. Canvas: 16:9 widescreen landscape composition, high-resolution promotional key visual, dark cinematic lighting, sharp anime rendering, glossy highlights, and strong dynamic effects. Layout: Place the main action character on the left, leaping forward diagonally, one knee raised, one fist clenched, occupying approximately half the frame. Place the second version of the same character on the right, dressed in a school uniform, assuming a fighting stance, her body slightly turned away, one palm open and pushing towards the viewer; her face is obscured by a soft rectangular blur effect. Vertically center the typography between the two versions, overlaid on black and blue brushstrokes and red diagonal line effects. Discretely Visible Character Elements: Exactly two character images: 1) Left version in combat uniform, in an aerial kicking pose; 2) Right version in school uniform, in a defensive open-palm pose, face blurred. Main Details: The character possesses {argument name="hair color" default="brown"} The short bob haircut features a side braid, a red headband, and a red ribbon. The left-side image boasts expressive anime-style eyes, a fit physique, a confident smile, and martial arts energy. Left-side outfit: a white sleeveless taekwondo-style top with dark trim, a brown belt, dark purple leggings, purple fingerless gloves, red-orange high-top sneakers with white laces, and a red headband. Right-side outfit: a white sailor-style school uniform shirt with a navy blue collar, a navy blue pleated skirt, yellow fingerless gloves on the front, a red scarf or ribbon tied at the braid, and blue-toned shadows on the lower body. Background: A nighttime city skyline with towering skyscrapers, bright windows, a slanted perspective, black asphalt-like textures, exploding white debris, raindrop-like sparks, blue energy bars, red paint splatters, and diagonal speed lines. A rough black, navy, red, and white palette is used, featuring high-contrast and metallic stain textures. Text content: A large, distressed Japanese calligraphy text is included at the center, containing {argument name="Japanese headline" default="Kyokugenryu Karate"} Add smaller Japanese text.{argument name="Japanese name text" default="ユリ・サカザキ"} Add small red English text near the bottom center.{argument name="English name text" default="YURI SAKAZAKI"} The upper right background contains faintly visible, oversized, weathered lettering "YURI". Typography style: white crackled stone calligraphy font with rough edges, black shadows, red underlined diagonal lines, and dramatic layering depth; the English name should be in a narrow uppercase serif font or a compressed red font. Constraints: Maintain exactly two character images, no additional characters, no watermarks, no other markings besides the designated name text, retain the rectangular blur effect on the right side of the character's face to make the pose dynamic and poster-like.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="坂崎百合"} 创建一张极具戏剧性的动漫格斗游戏角色海报，在粗砺的城市战斗场景中展示同一位年轻女性武术家的两个动态形象。

画布：16:9 宽屏横向构图，高分辨率宣传主视觉图，暗色电影级光影，锐利的动漫渲染，光泽高光，强烈的动态效果。

布局：将主要动作人物置于左侧，呈对角线向前跃起，一膝抬起，一拳紧握，占据约一半画面。将同一角色的第二个形象置于右侧，身着校服摆出格斗姿势，身体略微背向，一只手掌张开向观众推去；她的面部被一个柔和的矩形模糊效果遮挡。将排版垂直居中于两个形象之间，叠加在黑蓝色的笔触和红色的斜线特效之上。

离散可见的角色元素：恰好 2 个角色形象：1) 左侧战斗服版本，空中踢腿姿势；2) 右侧校服版本，防御性张开手掌姿势，面部模糊。

主体细节：角色拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="棕色"} 的短波波头，带有侧编发，红色发带，红色发带丝带，左侧形象有富有表现力的动漫眼睛，健美的体格，自信的微笑，以及武术能量。左侧服装：白色无袖道服风格上衣，深色镶边，棕色腰带，深紫色紧身裤，紫色露指手套，红橙色高帮运动鞋配白色鞋带，以及红色发带。右侧服装：白色水手风校服衬衫配海军蓝领子，海军蓝百褶裙，前方手部戴黄色露指手套，编发处系有红色围巾或丝带，下半身带有蓝色调阴影。

背景：夜间城市天际线，高耸的摩天大楼，明亮的窗户，倾斜的视角，黑色沥青般的纹理，爆炸的白色碎片，雨点般的火花，蓝色能量条，红色油漆飞溅，以及对角线速度线。使用粗砺的黑色、海军蓝、红色和白色调色板，具有高对比度和金属质感的污渍纹理。

文本内容：在中心包含大型做旧的日式书法文字，内容为 {argument name="Japanese headline" default="極限流 空手"}。添加较小的日文文本 {argument name="Japanese name text" default="ユリ・サカザキ"}。在底部中心附近添加小型红色英文文本 {argument name="English name text" default="YURI SAKAZAKI"}。在右上角背景中，包含淡淡的超大号风化字母“YURI”。

排版风格：白色裂纹石质书法字体，边缘粗糙，黑色阴影，红色下划线斜线，以及戏剧性的分层深度；英文名称应为窄体大写衬线字体或红色的压缩字体。

约束：保持恰好 2 个角色形象，无额外角色，无水印，除指定的名称文本外无其他标志，保留右侧人物面部的矩形模糊效果，使姿势充满活力且具有海报感。

templates.title: Eastern dark fantasy style cross-arm weapon

titleLocalized.zh: 东方暗黑奇幻风格交叉长柄武器

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed concept poster for an Eastern dark fantasy weapon, showcasing two perfectly symmetrical, X-shaped, ancient Chinese-style polearms. Both weapons must be fully visible from blade tip to hilt end, displayed centered like collector's item design blueprints. The weapon on the left is {argument name="left weapon material" default="Bright silver-white sculpted metal"} It features a pale crescent-shaped axe blade, dragon scale carvings, animal head details, layered and ornate metalwork, and exquisite red gemstone embellishments. The weapon on the right is {argument name="right weapon material" default="Black steel with a deep red inner sheen"} It features a darker crescent-shaped axe blade, jagged demon spikes, dragon-carved armor plates, red cracks, and glowing red eye-shaped decorations. Two long handles cross near the center, narrowing towards sharp, decorative spear-like ends. The background uses a cool-toned matte gray mist, and a large circular ink-wash magic circle is drawn behind the weapon using dark gray Chinese ink brushstrokes. Two clusters of black plum blossoms with vibrant red flowers are added to the lower left and right corners, with scattered red petals falling across the scene. Style: High-end dark fantasy, Eastern ink-wash painting atmosphere, intricate metal carving, sharp, high-contrast edges, realistic concept art rendering, dramatic soft shadows, subtle mist, symmetrical centered layout, no text, no figures, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张细节丰富的东方暗黑奇幻武器概念海报，展示两把完全对称呈 X 型交叉的中国古代风格长柄武器。两把武器必须从刀尖到柄端完整可见，像收藏级武器设计图纸一样居中展示。左侧武器为 {argument name="left weapon material" default="明亮的银白色雕刻金属"}，配有苍白的月牙斧刃、龙鳞雕刻、兽首细节、层叠的华丽金属工艺以及精致的红色宝石点缀。右侧武器为 {argument name="right weapon material" default="带有深红色内光的黑钢"}，配有更深色的月牙斧刃、参差不齐的恶魔尖刺、龙形雕刻甲片、红色裂纹以及发光的红色眼状装饰。两根长柄在中心附近交叉，并向尖锐的装饰性矛状末端收窄。背景使用冷色调哑光灰色雾气，武器后方绘有一个巨大的圆形水墨魔法阵，采用深灰色中国水墨笔触绘制。在左下角和右下角各添加 2 簇带有鲜艳红花的黑色梅花枝，并有零星的红色花瓣在画面中飘落。风格：高级暗黑奇幻、东方水墨画氛围、复杂的金属雕刻、锐利的高对比度边缘、写实概念艺术渲染、戏剧性的柔和阴影、淡淡的雾气、对称居中布局，无文字，无人物，无水印。

templates.title: Conceptual portrait of refracting glass

titleLocalized.zh: 折射玻璃概念肖像

templates.prompt: Create a high-end conceptual studio portrait of the upper body, with the subject being {argument name="person" default="A mysterious male public figure"} He stood facing a tall, transparent, vertically refracting glass panel. The main body was dressed in {argument name="signature attire" default="A charcoal gray custom-made suit jacket, paired with a pure black crew neck shirt."} Short, dark hair is faintly visible above a square, opaque, anonymous mask obscuring the center of the face. The composition is centered and symmetrical, cropped from the upper thigh to above the head, with broad, still shoulders. A deep, cinematic blue studio background is used, with a deep navy blue on the left and a gradient to a cool, luminous blue on the right, creating a subtle color transition. The glass panel should produce vertically sliced ​​distortion, a faintly shifted ghosting outline, and a thin, vertical refraction line running from top to bottom. Two distinct horizontal prism light strips are added: one across the face at eye level, displaying cyan, blue, orange, and white; the other across below the chest, displaying cyan and orange; soft motion blur and spectral dispersion effects are added around the light strips. The lighting should be dramatic and edited, incorporating cool-toned rim lighting, glossy reflections, high contrast, and a high-concept photographic feel. The portrait should remain sharp in terms of clothing and body contours, but distorted through the glass; no text, logos, or extraneous objects are included in the image.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超高端概念性胸部以上摄影棚肖像，主角为 {argument name="person" default="一位神秘的男性公众人物"}，正面对着站在一块高大的透明垂直折射玻璃板后。主体身着 {argument name="signature attire" default="炭灰色定制西装外套，内搭纯黑色圆领衫"}，短黑发在遮挡面部中央的方形不透明匿名面具上方隐约可见。构图居中且对称，裁剪范围从大腿上部到头部上方，双肩宽阔静止。使用深邃的电影级蓝色摄影棚背景，左侧为深海军蓝，右侧渐变为冷色调的发光蓝，呈现微妙的色彩过渡。玻璃板应产生垂直切片式的畸变、向两侧偏移的淡淡重影轮廓，以及从上到下贯穿的细长垂直折射线。添加两条明显的水平棱镜光条：一条在眼部高度横穿面部，呈现青色、蓝色、橙色和白色；另一条在胸部下方横穿，呈现青色和橙色；在光条周围加入柔和的动态模糊和光谱色散效果。灯光应具有戏剧性和编辑感，包含冷色调轮廓光、光泽反射、高对比度以及高级概念摄影的质感。肖像在衣物和身体轮廓处应保持清晰，但透过玻璃呈现出畸变效果，画面中不包含任何文字、标志或额外物体。

templates.title: Fantasy RPG Character Sprite Gallery

titleLocalized.zh: 奇幻 RPG 角色精灵图集

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a clear atlas of pixel-style character sprites for a fantasy RPG, showcasing game assets.{argument name="character roster" default="A blue and gold knight, a blonde elven archer, a purple dark mage, a red-bearded dwarf warrior, and a black-hooded assassin."} The game uses a chibi (Q-style) proportion and features detailed armor, weapons, cloaks, and magical effects. Canvas: A square white canvas with a fine light gray grid, creating a professional 2D game animation atlas effect. It uses a clear, high-detail isometric/chibi pixel art style with painterly shadows. Each cell has a transparent white background and no background. Layout: A four-column action bar is created, with the following labels at the top in bold, dark capital letters: IDLE, ATTACK, DEFEND, and DEATH. A narrow tab bar is added on the left, containing stacked bold, dark capital line labels. The atlas contains nine rows of labeled sprites, totaling 36 character sprites, one sprite per grid cell. Rows and content, from top to bottom: 1. FRONT VIEW: A blue-gold knight with messy black hair, wielding a sword and an iris shield; frontal idle, a slashing attack with a light blue arc, a shield block with sparks, and a prone death pose after the sword and shield fall. 2. BACK VIEW: The same knight's back view, wearing a blue cloak; back view in standby mode, back view with a light blue arc of light during a slash, back view in a shield stance, back view in a prone death stance. 3. FRONT VIEW: A blonde elven archer, wearing a green cloak and leather armor; back view with bow in standby mode, firing a green energy arrow, back view in a defensive crouching stance with a green crescent effect, back view in a death stance lying beside a broken bow and scattered arrows. 4. BACK VIEW: The same elven archer's back view; back view, firing a green arrow, defensive green crescent effect, back view in a prone death stance with a visible cloak. 5. FRONT VIEW: A purple-haired dark mage, wearing a magnificent black and gold robe, wielding a glowing purple staff; back view, casting a purple energy ball, defending within a purple magic shield aura, back view in a death stance where the staff falls with a purple splash effect. 6. BACK DOS (Back): The same mage's back view, retaining the typographical error tag "BACK DOS"; idle, casting a purple energy ball on the back, a purple magic barrier on the back, and a prone death pose with a staff beside him. 7. FRONT VIEW (Front): A red-bearded dwarf warrior, wearing heavy dark armor, wielding a hammer and shield; idle, a hammer strike with a golden arc of light, a shield block, and a death pose with the hammer and shield falling. 8. BACK VIEW (Back): A black-hooded assassin, wearing a red scarf, dual-wielding daggers, and dark leather armor; idle on the back, a thrust with a black/purple trail resembling smoke, a defensive stance with a purple crescent halo, and a death pose in a dark pool of blood with daggers beside him. 9. BACK DOS (Back): The same assassin's back view, retaining the typographical error tag "BACK DOS"; idle, a rapid dagger attack with a shadow trail, a defensive purple aura, and a death pose with weapons scattered. Visual Style:{argument name="art style" default="High-detail Q-version fantasy pixel art"} Strong outlines, small heads and compact bodies, clearly defined weapons, dramatic movement curves, bright magical effects, and consistent cell proportions. Maintain perfect alignment between the top labels and the grid, similar to a sprite atlas in game development. Constraints: Use 4 columns, 9 rows, for a total of 36 sprites. Do not add any additional characters, UI panels, watermarks, signatures, scenes, or other text except for column headers and left-hand row labels. Keep the background white and the grid fine.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为游戏资产参考创建清晰的奇幻 RPG 像素风角色精灵图集，展示 {argument name="character roster" default="一名蓝金配色骑士、一名金发精灵弓箭手、一名紫色暗黑法师、一名红胡子矮人战士以及一名黑兜帽刺客"}，采用 Q 版比例，包含精细的盔甲、武器、披风和魔法特效。

画布：方形白色画布，带有细浅灰色网格，呈现专业 2D 游戏动画图集的效果。使用清晰、高细节的等距/Q 版像素艺术风格，带有绘画感阴影，每个单元格内为透明感的白色背景，无场景。

布局：制作 4 列动作栏，顶部用加粗深色大写字母标注：IDLE（待机）、ATTACK（攻击）、DEFEND（防御）、DEATH（死亡）。左侧添加一列窄标签栏，包含堆叠的加粗深色大写行标签。图集包含 9 行标签精灵行，总计 36 个角色精灵，每个网格单元格一个精灵。

行及内容，从上到下：
1. FRONT VIEW（正面）：蓝金配色骑士，黑色乱发，持剑和鸢尾花盾牌；正面待机、带淡蓝色弧光的挥砍攻击、带火花的盾牌格挡、剑盾掉落的俯卧死亡姿态。
2. BACK VIEW（背面）：同一骑士背面，带蓝色披风；背面待机、背面带淡蓝色弧光的挥砍、背面盾牌姿态、背面俯卧死亡姿态。
3. FRONT VIEW（正面）：金发精灵弓箭手，身着绿色斗篷和皮甲；持弓待机、发射绿色能量箭、带绿色新月特效的防御蹲姿、倒在断弓和散落箭矢旁的死亡姿态。
4. BACK VIEW（背面）：同一精灵弓箭手背面；待机、发射绿色箭矢、防御性绿色新月、可见斗篷的俯卧死亡姿态。
5. FRONT VIEW（正面）：紫发暗黑法师，身着华丽黑金长袍，手持发光的紫色法杖；待机、施放紫色能量球、在紫色魔法盾光环内防御、法杖掉落并带有紫色溅射效果的死亡姿态。
6. BACK DOS（背面）：同一法师背面，保留排版错误标签“BACK DOS”；待机、背面紫色能量球施放、背面紫色魔法屏障、法杖在旁的俯卧死亡姿态。
7. FRONT VIEW（正面）：红胡子矮人战士，身着重型深色盔甲，持锤和盾；待机、带金色弧光的锤击、盾牌格挡、锤盾掉落的死亡姿态。
8. BACK VIEW（背面）：黑兜帽刺客，带红色围巾，双持匕首，深色皮甲；背面待机、带烟雾状黑/紫色运动轨迹的突刺、带紫色新月光环的防御姿态、匕首在旁的暗色血泊中死亡姿态。
9. BACK DOS（背面）：同一刺客背面，保留排版错误标签“BACK DOS”；待机、带阴影轨迹的快速匕首攻击、防御性紫色光环、武器散落的死亡姿态。

视觉风格：{argument name="art style" default="高细节 Q 版奇幻像素艺术"}，强烈的轮廓，小头紧凑身体，清晰的武器，戏剧性的运动弧线，明亮的魔法特效，且所有单元格比例一致。保持顶部标签和网格完美对齐，如同游戏开发中的精灵图集（sprite atlas）。

约束：使用 4 列、9 行，共 36 个精灵。除列标题和左侧行标签外，不要添加额外角色、UI 面板、水印、签名、场景或其他文本。保持背景为白色，网格保持细微。

templates.title: Six Chinese City Enamel Commemorative Medals

titleLocalized.zh: 六枚中国城市珐琅纪念章

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a 2x3 display chart showcasing six cloisonné enamel city commemorative badges, suitable for {argument name="country" default="China"} Shot from a top-down, flat perspective, the background is a retro brown map with elegant Chinese calligraphy and ancient map lines. Canvas: Vertical poster composition, six equally sized panels separated by thin, shallow dividing lines, each panel displaying a circular medallion with soft, realistic shadows. Warm museum lighting, high detail, macro product photography quality. Medal style: Each medallion is circular with raised, polished gold edges, ornate braided rope borders, embossed gold lines between vibrant enamel blocks, jewel-like glossy fills, bas-relief skyline and landmark details, and small decorative flowers near the inscription band below. Employing premium coin/medal aesthetics, rather than flat illustration. Layout and Quantity: Six commemorative medals are displayed, arranged in the following order: 1. Top Left: Beijing Commemorative Medal, with a deep red enamel main color, the inscription "BEIJING CHINA" in an arc shape, the Chinese characters "北京" in large size, landmarks including the Temple of Heaven, the Forbidden City wall, modern skyscrapers, auspicious clouds, and flowers at the bottom, and the inscription below with the words "HISTORIC & CULTURAL CITY" and "ESTABLISHED 514 BC". 2. Top Right: Shanghai Commemorative Medal, with a rich blue enamel main color, the inscription "SHANGHAI CHINA" in an arc shape, the Chinese characters "上海", landmarks including the Oriental Pearl Tower, Shanghai Tower, the riverside skyline, and ships on the river, and the inscription below with the words "HISTORIC & CULTURAL CITY" and "ESTABLISHED 514 BC". 3. Center Left: Hangzhou Commemorative Medal, with emerald green enamel as the main color, and the inscription "HANGZHOU CHINA" in arc shape, depicting West Lake scenery including an arched stone bridge, pagoda, lotus flowers, trees, and a distant skyline. The inscription below reads "HISTORIC & CULTURAL CITY" and "ESTABLISHED 514 BC". 4. Center Right: Lijiang Commemorative Medal, with cyan enamel as the main color, and the inscription "LIJIANG CHINA" in arc shape, depicting snow-capped mountains, ancient town rooftops, a stone bridge over water, a wooden waterwheel, and pink flowers. The inscription below reads "HISTORIC & CULTURAL CITY" and "ESTABLISHED 514 BC". 5. Bottom Left: Xi'an Commemorative Medal, predominantly navy blue enamel, with the curved text "XI'AN CHINA" and the Chinese characters "西安" (Xi'an). Landmarks include the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, the ancient city gate, and the modern skyline. A terracotta warrior image is depicted on the left. The inscription below reads "HISTORIC & CULTURAL CITY" and "ESTABLISHED 514 BC". 6. Bottom Right: Chengdu Commemorative Medal, predominantly turquoise enamel, with the curved text "CHENGDU CHINA" and the Chinese characters "成都" (Chengdu). A cute giant panda eats bamboo in front of a traditional pavilion, lanterns, a river bridge, and the modern skyline are also featured. The inscription below reads "HISTORIC & CULTURAL CITY" and "ESTABLISHED 514 BC". Text Content: The top arc uses a clear, raised gold serif font. The lower inscription remains clear but in a smaller font size. The main customizable title format should follow {argument name="arc inscription format" default="[City] CHINA"} The city name should be{argument name="city set" default="Beijing, Shanghai, Hangzhou, Lijiang, Xi'an, Chengdu"} Visual style: Ultra-realistic product rendering, embossed metallic gold, glossy enamel, saturated city-specific colors, intricate miniature architecture, a vintage travel and collecting atmosphere, and shallow relief casting natural shadows. The background should be {argument name="background surface" default="Old parchment map with Chinese calligraphy"} .use{argument name="lighting style" default="Warm top museum lights"} Limitations: Exactly 6 medals, no more. Maintain a 2-column, 3-row grid layout. Do not crop the medals. Avoid modern logos, watermarks, hands, packaging, or blank panels. Each medal must retain an ornate rope border and gold dividing lines.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一个 2 行 3 列的收藏展示图，包含 6 枚硬珐琅景泰蓝城市纪念章，适用于 {argument name="country" default="中国"}，以俯视平铺视角拍摄，背景为带有淡雅中国书法和古地图线条的复古棕色地图。

画布：竖版海报构图，六个等大的面板由细浅的分隔线分开，每个面板中心展示一枚圆形纪念章，带有柔和逼真的阴影。温暖的博物馆灯光，高细节，微距产品摄影质感。

纪念章风格：每枚纪念章均为圆形，带有凸起的抛光金边、华丽的麻花绳边框、鲜艳珐琅色块间的浮雕金线、宝石般的亮面填充、浅浮雕天际线及地标细节，下方的铭文带附近有细小的装饰花卉。采用高级纪念币/奖章美学，而非扁平插画。

布局与数量：展示 6 枚纪念章，排列顺序如下：
1. 左上：北京纪念章，主色调为深红色珐琅，弧形文字“BEIJING CHINA”，大号汉字“北京”，地标包括天坛、紫禁城城墙、现代摩天大楼、祥云、底部花卉，下方铭文带文字“HISTORIC & CULTURAL CITY”及“ESTABLISHED 514 BC”。
2. 右上：上海纪念章，主色调为浓郁蓝色珐琅，弧形文字“SHANGHAI CHINA”，汉字“上海”，地标包括东方明珠塔、上海中心大厦、滨江天际线、江上船只，下方铭文带文字“HISTORIC & CULTURAL CITY”及“ESTABLISHED 514 BC”。
3. 中左：杭州纪念章，主色调为翡翠绿珐琅，弧形文字“HANGZHOU CHINA”，汉字“杭州”，西湖景色包括拱形石桥、宝塔、荷花、树木、远方天际线，下方铭文带文字“HISTORIC & CULTURAL CITY”及“ESTABLISHED 514 BC”。
4. 中右：丽江纪念章，主色调为青蓝色珐琅，弧形文字“LIJIANG CHINA”，汉字“丽江”，雪山、古镇屋顶、水上石桥、木制水车、粉色花朵，下方铭文带文字“HISTORIC & CULTURAL CITY”及“ESTABLISHED 514 BC”。
5. 左下：西安纪念章，主色调为深海军蓝珐琅，弧形文字“XI’AN CHINA”，汉字“西安”，地标包括大雁塔、古城墙门、现代天际线，左侧有一个兵马俑形象，下方铭文带文字“HISTORIC & CULTURAL CITY”及“ESTABLISHED 514 BC”。
6. 右下：成都纪念章，主色调为绿松石色珐琅，弧形文字“CHENGDU CHINA”，汉字“成都”，一只可爱的巨型大熊猫在传统亭台前吃竹子、灯笼、河桥及现代天际线，下方铭文带文字“HISTORIC & CULTURAL CITY”及“ESTABLISHED 514 BC”。

文字内容：顶部弧线处使用清晰的凸起金色衬线字体。保持下方铭文带清晰但字号较小。主要的可自定义标题格式应遵循 {argument name="arc inscription format" default="[城市] CHINA"}。城市名称应为 {argument name="city set" default="北京、上海、杭州、丽江、西安、成都"}。

视觉风格：超精细写实产品渲染，浮雕金属金，光泽珐琅，饱和的城市专属色彩，错综复杂的微缩建筑，复古旅行收藏氛围，浅浮雕投射自然阴影。背景应为 {argument name="background surface" default="带有中国书法的陈旧羊皮纸地图"}。使用 {argument name="lighting style" default="温暖的顶部博物馆灯光"}。

限制：正好 6 枚纪念章，不得多出。保持 2 列 3 行的网格布局。不要裁剪纪念章。避免出现现代标志、水印、手部、包装或空白面板。每枚纪念章必须保留华丽的绳状边框和金色分隔线。

templates.title: Six cloisonné city commemorative medals

titleLocalized.zh: 六枚景泰蓝城市纪念章

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a sophisticated product-style poster showcasing a set of {argument name="number of commemorative medals" default="Six"} Exquisite circular cloisonné city commemorative medallions, photographed from a top-down, flat-lay perspective on a deep blue velvet canvas. Canvas: Vertical poster, 2:3 aspect ratio, divided into a precise 2 columns and 3 rows grid with fine, light-colored dividing lines. Each grid cell contains a centered circular medallion with comfortable margins, against a background of pleated dark velvet. Main details: Each medallion is a thick gold-plated coin with an embossed twisted rope border, raised gold dividers between enamel blocks, deep jewel-colored enamel filling, and fine engraving lines, presenting the texture of a high-end collector's item. Dramatic macro lighting is used to highlight the metallic sheen, the sharp embossed effect, the luminous enamel reflections, and the high level of detail. Commemorative Medal Set: Showcases 6 different commemorative medals: 1. Paris, France Commemorative Medal: The top features the arched text "PARIS FRANCE" with an iris pattern, the center depicting the Eiffel Tower, the Paris skyline, bridges over the Seine, riverboats, pink cherry blossoms and flowers, and a blue night sky. 2. New York, USA Commemorative Medal: The top features the arched text "NEW YORK USA," the Statue of Liberty in front of the Manhattan skyline, One World Trade Center, harbor waters with small sailboats, a turquoise sky with small clouds, and floral decorations at the bottom. 3. Tokyo, Japan Commemorative Medal: The top features the arched text "TOKYO JAPAN" with a cherry blossom icon, Mount Fuji, Tokyo Tower, pagodas, a modern skyline, bridges over the river, a red sunset sky, and abundant pink cherry blossoms. 4. London, UK Commemorative Medal: The top features the arched text "LONDON ENGLAND" with a small crown, Big Ben and the Houses of Parliament, the London Eye, bridges, red double-decker buses, streetlights, a deep blue sky, and floral decorations. 5. Sydney, Australia Commemorative Medal: The top curved text "SYDNEY AUSTRALIA" is adorned with an iris motif, featuring the Sydney Opera House, Harbour Bridge, skyline, harbor waters with two sailboats, a bright turquoise sky, and floral decorations. 6. Dubai, UAE Commemorative Medal: The top curved text "DUBAI UAE" is adorned with a palm tree icon, featuring the Burj Khalifa, Burj Al Arab, futuristic skyline, palm trees, canals and bridges, a warm orange sunset sky, and floral decorations. Shared Text: At the bottom of each medallion, on the curved line, is the inscription "HISTORIC & CULTURAL CITY" in small print, below which is "ESTABLISHED 514 BC," both presented in embossed gold lettering arranged along the curved line. Visual Style: A combination of ultra-realistic product photography and illustrated enamel art, luxurious souvenir collector's aesthetics, rich and saturated colors, gold metal embossing, exquisite craftsmanship, and museum shop medallion design. Constraints: All six medals must be circular and of uniform size, maintain a precise 2x3 arrangement, ensure that the city name and country label are clearly legible curved inscriptions, and avoid any additional medals, hands, packaging, logos, watermarks, or extra text beyond the medals.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张精致的产品风格海报，展示一组 {argument name="number of commemorative medals" default="六枚"} 精致的圆形硬珐琅景泰蓝城市纪念章，以俯视平铺视角拍摄于深蓝色天鹅绒布料上。

画布：竖版海报，2:3 长宽比，划分为精确的 2 列 3 行网格，带有细浅色分割线。每个网格单元包含一枚居中的圆形纪念章，留有舒适的边距，背景均为褶皱的深色天鹅绒。

主体细节：每枚纪念章均为厚实的金色金属币，带有浮雕扭绳边框、珐琅色块间凸起的金色隔断、深邃的宝石色珐琅填充、细微的雕刻线条，呈现出高端收藏级奖章的质感。使用戏剧性的微距照明，突出金属高光、清晰的浮雕感、光亮的珐琅反射及高精细度。

纪念章套装：展示 6 枚不同的纪念章：
1. 法国巴黎纪念章：顶部弧形文字“PARIS FRANCE”配有鸢尾花图案，中心为埃菲尔铁塔、巴黎天际线、塞纳河上的桥梁、河中游船、粉色樱花与花卉，蓝色夜空。
2. 美国纽约纪念章：顶部弧形文字“NEW YORK USA”，曼哈顿天际线前的自由女神像、世界贸易中心一号大楼、带有小型帆船的港口水域、带有小云朵的青蓝色天空，底部有花卉装饰。
3. 日本东京纪念章：顶部弧形文字“TOKYO JAPAN”配有樱花图标，富士山、东京塔、宝塔、现代天际线、河上桥梁、红色夕阳天空，繁茂的粉色樱花。
4. 英国伦敦纪念章：顶部弧形文字“LONDON ENGLAND”配有小皇冠，大本钟与议会大厦、伦敦眼、桥梁、红色双层巴士、路灯、深蓝色天空，花卉装饰。
5. 澳大利亚悉尼纪念章：顶部弧形文字“SYDNEY AUSTRALIA”配有鸢尾花图案，悉尼歌剧院、海港大桥、天际线、带有两艘帆船的港口水域、明亮的绿松石色天空，花卉装饰。
6. 阿联酋迪拜纪念章：顶部弧形文字“DUBAI UAE”配有棕榈树图标，哈利法塔、帆船酒店、未来感天际线、棕榈树、运河与桥梁、温暖的橙色夕阳天空，花卉装饰。

共享文字内容：在每枚纪念章的底部弧线上，包含小字铭文“HISTORIC & CULTURAL CITY”，其下方为“ESTABLISHED 514 BC”，均以沿弧线排列的浮雕金色字体呈现。

视觉风格：超精细写实产品摄影与插画珐琅艺术相结合，奢华纪念品收藏美学，色彩浓郁饱和，金色金属浮雕，工艺精湛，博物馆商店纪念章设计。

约束条件：保持所有六枚纪念章均为圆形且尺寸一致，维持精确的 2x3 排列，确保城市名称和国家标签作为清晰可读的弧形铭文，避免出现额外的纪念章、手部、包装、标志、水印或纪念章之外的额外文字。

templates.title: Gym mirror selfie

titleLocalized.zh: 健身房镜面自拍健身人像

templates.prompt: A richly detailed, photorealistic 4K image captures a modern smartphone mirror selfie with a social media aesthetic. The subject is Dua Lipa, a slender American woman with a beautifully curvaceous lower body. She has long, thick black hair casually styled to frame her face. Her makeup is delicate and natural, with defined eyes and a subtle rosy lip color. Her expression is neutral yet slightly focused. She wears a loose-fitting, sleeveless, cropped red tank top with thin straps and a deep side slit, revealing some skin. The top is loose and slightly pulled up to accentuate her waist. She pairs this with high-waisted, fitted lavender shorts and long black stockings that reach her calves. A delicate gold ring adorns her left hand, and a thin gold bracelet and black hair tie grace her left wrist. Her skin has a smooth, realistic texture with natural highlights and shadows. She leans forward, her upper body, chest, and arms comfortably resting on the top edge of a slanted black cushioned exercise chair. The chair has a sturdy black metal frame, with the "Keor" brand name visible on the side. She holds a smartphone with a pink case in both hands, taking the photo near her face. Her lower body extends to the right, naturally showcasing her profile and hip lines. The scene is a well-lit but spacious indoor commercial gym with high-key lighting. The slightly blurred background creates a natural depth of field, showcasing typical gym equipment such as metal squat racks, cable machines, mirrors, and clearly visible red and black weight plates. The composition, a mid-range to full-body shot, uses a slight side angle to capture a relaxed, sporty, confident, and comfortable modern gym atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张细节丰富、照片级真实的 4K 图像，捕捉了具有社交媒体美感的现代智能手机镜面自拍。主角是一位身材苗条、下半身曲线优美的美国美女 Dua Lipa。她留着一头浓密的长黑发，随意地修饰着脸庞。妆容精致自然，眼部轮廓清晰，唇色带有淡淡的红润，表情中性且略显专注。她身穿一件纯红色宽松无袖露脐背心，细肩带设计，侧面深开叉剪裁，露出部分肌肤，背心穿着宽松并微微上提以显露腰部；下身搭配高腰修身薰衣草色短裤，并穿着拉至小腿的长筒黑袜。她的左手戴着精致的金戒指，左手腕上戴着细金手链和黑色发圈。她的皮肤质感细腻真实，带有自然的光影高光。她身体前倾，上身、胸部和手臂舒适地靠在倾斜的黑色软垫健身椅顶部边缘。健身椅配有坚固的黑色金属框架，侧面可见“Keor”品牌名称。她的双手拿着一部带有粉色手机壳的智能手机，举在脸部附近进行拍摄。她的下半身向右延伸，自然地展示了侧面轮廓和臀部线条。场景是一个光线充足但空旷的室内商业健身房，采用高调照明。背景略微虚化，具有自然的景深效果，展示了典型的健身器材，如金属深蹲架、绳索机、镜子以及清晰可见的红黑色配重片。构图为中景至全身，采用轻微的侧角拍摄，捕捉到一种休闲、运动、自信且放松的现代健身氛围。

titleLocalized.zh: 休闲客厅人像

templates.prompt: A relaxed woman with a serene expression leans comfortably against {argument name="furniture" default="plush sofa"} Above, in the body{argument name="setting" default="Bright modern living room"} Inside, there are large windows, and people are dressed in {argument name="clothing" default="Soft, casual linen clothing"} The natural light from the side creates soft shadows; the mid-range composition focuses on the upper body; the photorealistic image boasts fine skin texture with natural pores and minor imperfections; the fabric details are lifelike; and the focus is sharp.

templates.title: Minimalist hand-drawn children's illustrations

titleLocalized.zh: 极简手绘儿童插画

templates.prompt: Transform photographs into exquisite, minimalist hand-drawn children's illustrations, presenting a soft, fantastical fairytale aesthetic. Use simple, elongated shapes, delicate and imperfect lines, softly tiled colors, minimalist details, and adorable doll-like character styles, complete with rosy cheeks, tiny facial features, and simplified anatomy. Add delicate paper textures, soft pencil and crayon shading, watercolor-like qualities, and pure white backgrounds adorned with small stars or glitter. Design clothing in a playful picture book style, employing simplified shapes and soft decorative details. templates.prompt: A medium-range snapshot of everyday life, capturing a natural moment; the image shows a {argument name="subject" default="East Asian young women"} Standing at the corner of a long indoor corridor. 85mm lens, composition from waist up, shallow depth of field. The corridor behind me stretches into the distance, presenting a soft sense of depth—wood paneling on one side, white stucco walls on the other, afternoon light filtering in faintly from the distance. A young East Asian woman, early twenties. Almond-shaped eyes, long and narrow at the corners, her gaze slightly turned towards the depths of the corridor. A straight, delicate nose. Fair to beige skin, appearing composed in the quiet of the corridor. Under directional light, the subsurface scattering of her skin is visible, with subtle mirror-like highlights on her cheekbones and nose, faintly revealing the texture of her fine foundation. She is wearing a {argument name="attire" default="Charcoal gray silk cheongsam with gold phoenix embroidery"} —The gold thread, with its deep, understated hue, resembled aged lacquerware rather than brand-new gilding. A stand-up collar, short sleeves, and a fitted cut. She stood casually at the corner, one shoulder close to the wall, her gaze following the corridor as if listening. The corridor was empty—no artwork, no furniture, only the texture of the walls and the long, stretching floorboards. A few strands of hair fell loosely in the slight breeze, revealing a natural, unintentional imperfection rather than geometric symmetry. Diffuse natural light streamed in from the far end of the corridor, illuminating the near side of her face and the left shoulder of her cheongsam, the rest shrouded in soft shadow. The charcoal-grey silk absorbed the light with a tranquil texture. Atmosphere: a pause between rooms. The shadowed areas possess a subtle {argument name="film style" default="ISO 400 film grain"} It exhibits a photographic grain texture, rather than the smoothness of CG rendering. Aspect ratio 9:16. No watermark, no text overlay, not cartoon, not digital painting, not illustration, not animation.

promptLocalized.zh:
一张中景真实生活摄影作品，捕捉自然的抓拍瞬间，画面中是一位 {argument name="subject" default="东亚年轻女性"} 站在长室内走廊的拐角处。85mm 镜头，腰部以上构图，浅景深。身后的走廊向远处延伸，呈现出柔和的纵深感——一侧是木质镶板，另一侧是白色灰泥墙，午后的光线从远端隐约透入。
东亚年轻女性，20 岁出头。杏仁眼，眼角细长，目光略微侧向走廊深处。鼻梁挺直秀气。肤色白皙偏米色，在走廊的静谧中显得沉稳。在定向光线下可见皮肤的次表面散射，颧骨和鼻梁上有细微的镜面高光，隐约可见细腻的粉底质感。
她身着一件 {argument name="attire" default="炭灰色丝绸旗袍，配有金色凤凰刺绣"} ——金线色泽沉稳内敛，更像陈年漆器而非崭新的镀金。立领，短袖，修身剪裁。她漫不经心地站在拐角处，一侧肩膀靠近墙壁，目光顺着走廊延伸，仿佛在倾听。走廊里空无一物——没有艺术品，没有家具，只有墙壁的纹理和长长的地板延伸感。两三缕发丝因微弱的气流而散落，呈现出自然的非刻意瑕疵，而非几何对称。
漫射的自然光从走廊远端射入，照亮了她脸部近侧和旗袍的左肩，其余部分则隐没在柔和的阴影中。炭灰色丝绸以一种静谧的质感吸收了微光。氛围：从一个房间过渡到下一个房间的停顿。阴影区域带有微妙的 {argument name="film style" default="ISO 400 胶片颗粒感"}，呈现出摄影噪点质感，而非 CG 渲染的平滑感。纵横比 9:16。无水印，无文字覆盖，非卡通，非数字绘画，非插画，非动漫。

templates.prompt: Please create a high-end wall clock with exceptional texture based on the uploaded illustration. The clock must reinterpret the illustration's artistic atmosphere, character design, emotional tone, color scheme, symbolic elements, architectural style, clothing, lighting, fantasy or science fiction elements, and worldview into a highly original cuckoo-style wall clock design. Do not design it as a typical antique clock. The overall outline, carvings, decorations, moving parts, pendulum, decorative windows, roof structure, numbers, hands, textures, and materials must all convey a natural feel, seemingly originating from the world of the illustration. A fantasy shrine maiden theme can incorporate lacquered wood, spiritual emblems, torii-style frames, glowing talismans, hanging bells, cherry blossom carvings, layered shrine architecture, elegant red and black lacquer textures, and softly glowing paper windows. A futuristic or android theme can utilize a holographic clock face, segmented mechanical armor panels, luminous circuitry, a transparent crystal casing, a floating ring, neon edge lighting, a dynamic digital pendulum, and a smooth, asymmetrical structure. A charming macaron color palette inspires rounded, soft contours, candy-like decorations, transparent ornaments, heart elements, glossy enamel surfaces, plush textures, and a dreamy fairytale style. The cuckoo clock-style window should include a small, dynamic character, spirit, mechanical bird, miniature mascot, or symbolic object derived from the illustration itself. The pendulum and moving decorations should visually align with the illustration's worldview and emotional tone. Clock hands and numbers must be uniquely designed to fit the illustration, rather than using standard styles. If the uploaded illustration includes a character, place them naturally below or to the side of the clock, showing them looking up at it with curiosity or admiration, while preserving the character's original facial features, hairstyle, proportions, color scheme, clothing style, and personality. Bright, cinematic lighting, exquisite detail, realistic materials, a high-end fantasy interior photography feel, elegant shadows, and high-precision reflection effects are required, presenting a master-level work.

奇幻巫女主题可融入漆木、灵力纹章、鸟居风格框架、发光符咒、悬挂铃铛、樱花雕刻、层叠的神社建筑、优雅的红黑漆器纹理以及柔和发光的纸窗。未来主义或仿生人主题可采用全息钟面、分段式机械装甲面板、发光电路、透明水晶外壳、悬浮环、霓虹边缘灯光、动态数字钟摆以及流畅的非对称结构。可爱的马卡龙色系世界则可启发圆润柔和的轮廓、糖果般的装饰、透明饰品、爱心元素、光泽感珐琅表面、毛绒质感以及梦幻的童话风格。

布谷鸟钟式的开窗处应包含一个源自插画本身的小型动态角色、灵体、机械鸟、微型吉祥物或象征性物体。钟摆和活动装饰应在视觉上与插画的世界观及情感基调相契合。钟表指针和数字必须进行独特设计以适配插画，而非使用标准样式。

如果上传的插画中包含角色，请将该角色自然地放置在挂钟下方或侧面，使其带着好奇或赞赏的神情仰望挂钟，同时保留角色原有的面部特征、发型、比例、配色、服装风格和个性。要求明亮的电影级光影、极致的细节工艺、逼真的材质、高端奇幻室内摄影质感、优雅的阴影、高精度的反射效果，呈现大师级作品水准。

templates.title: Black Detective Comic Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 黑色侦探漫画肖像

templates.prompt: Create a black-and-white film noir style comic book illustration, employing a rough comic/graphic novel style: the background is a textured detective alleyway in the rain of the 1930s, with a detective in a trench coat in the right foreground and a glowing vintage streetlamp in the left foreground, and towering city buildings shrouded in mist behind them. The detective wears a wide-brimmed fedora, a high-necked, damp trench coat, a dress shirt, and a dark tie; the image should crop to his upper chest, with his body slightly turned towards the camera, occupying the right side of the frame. Replace the face area with a smooth, featureless dark gray rectangular placeholder located below the brim of the hat for placement.{argument name="character face" default="A recognizable selfie face"} .use{argument name="comic style" default="Hard-bodied film noir comic book ink style"} It features dense crosshairs, heavy black shadows, sharp white highlights, rough pen strokes, and high contrast. The scene is set as follows:{argument name="setting" default="A narrow brick alley in the old town in the rain"} The damp cobblestone pavement reflects the streetlights, a thin white mist rises from the ground, raindrops fall in vertical lines, and the rough, mortar-textured brick walls form the scene's framework. The lighting and shadow effects should be highly dramatic: the streetlights on the left create a luminous halo, while the detective is mostly in shadow, with edge lighting outlining the raindrops on his trench coat and hat. Use a cinematic wide-format composition, monochrome only, no color, no title, no speech bubbles, and no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅黑白黑色电影风格的漫画插画，采用粗犷的漫画/图像小说风格：背景为 1930 年代雨夜中充满质感的侦探小巷，右侧前景设有一名身穿风衣的侦探，左侧前景设有一盏发光的复古路灯，身后是隐没在雾气中的高耸城市建筑群。侦探头戴宽檐软呢帽，身穿高领湿润风衣、正装衬衫并系着深色领带；画面截取其胸部以上，身体略微转向镜头，占据画面右侧。将面部区域替换为一个位于帽檐下方的平滑、无特征的深灰色矩形占位符，用于放置 {argument name="character face" default="一张可辨认的自拍脸部"}。使用 {argument name="comic style" default="硬汉派黑色电影漫画墨水风格"}，包含密集的交叉排线、浓重的黑色阴影、锐利的白色高光、粗糙的钢笔笔触以及高对比度。场景设定为 {argument name="setting" default="雨中老城的一条狭窄砖砌小巷"}；湿润的鹅卵石路面反射着路灯光芒，地面升起白色薄雾，雨水呈垂直线条落下，粗糙砂浆质感的砖墙构成了场景框架。光影效果应极具戏剧性：左侧路灯形成发光光晕，而侦探主体大部分处于阴影中，边缘光勾勒出风衣和帽子上的雨滴。采用电影级宽画幅构图，仅限单色，无色彩，无标题，无对话气泡，无水印。

templates.title: Selfie to Pixel Art Studio

titleLocalized.zh: 自拍转像素漫画工作室

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a vibrant pixel art promotional illustration showcasing the process of transforming a selfie into a cartoon avatar. Canvas: 1200×675 widescreen 16:9 composition, bright retro gaming aesthetic, crisp blocky pixels, bold black outlines, halftone cartoon dots, high contrast, and a fun, studio-like atmosphere. Subject: A young man with {argument name="hair style" default="Messy dark curly hair"} Wearing{argument name="outfit" default="Olive green jacket over a dark hoodie"} The character's features are kept consistent across all depictions, but the face is rendered as a simple, softly blurred placeholder with a warm skin tone and no specific facial details. Layout: The left side displays a desktop photo window with rounded corners and three traffic light buttons at the top, containing a real selfie of the character. The middle right foreground displays a transformed pixelated cartoon portrait, framed above the chest, with a striking white sticker-like outline. Between the photo window and the pixelated portrait, a thick white arrow pointing to the right indicates the transformation process. Around the central portrait are four smaller cartoon head outputs: a yellow-background portrait near the top center, a green-background bubble cartoon portrait in the upper right corner, a blue-background dramatic cartoon portrait in the lower right corner, and a mint-green portrait displayed on a drawing board in the lower left corner. Environment: A comfortable digital artist's desk and studio, with dark cyan walls, shelves, pixel art collections, and warm lighting. Desk Items: Includes a tilted drawing board with a color swatch on the right, a stylus placed in front of it, a red mug with a white heart and steam, a black desk lamp emitting light from the left, a potted plant on the desk, three small pixelated figurines on the lower left edge, a framed pixelated heart on the back wall, a miniature pixelated figure on the top shelf, and a small potted plant on the shelf. Background: Uses a radiating comic book burst effect in cyan, coral, peach, and yellow behind the main character, with halftone textures, small plus signs, glitter icons, and square pixels. Text: No readable titles or labels. Visual Style: A blend of pixel art, comic/webcomic/manga transitions, retro arcade UI, social media promotional thumbnails, clean composition, sharp edges, and vibrant colors. Constraints: Use the exact number of main panels and desk items listed; do not add additional characters, titles, watermarks, logos, or UI text.

promptLocalized.zh: 目标：创作一幅色彩鲜艳的像素艺术宣传插图，展示自拍照片转换为漫画头像的过程。画布：1200×675 宽屏 16:9 构图，明亮的复古游戏美学，清晰的块状像素，粗黑轮廓，半色调漫画圆点，高对比度，充满趣味的创作工作室氛围。主体：一位年轻男性，拥有 {argument name="hair style" default="凌乱的深色卷发"}，身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="橄榄绿夹克内搭深色连帽衫"}；在所有描绘中保持其人物特征一致，但面部渲染为简单的柔和模糊占位符，肤色温暖，无具体五官细节。布局：左侧展示 1 个带有圆角和顶部三个红绿灯按钮的桌面照片窗口，其中包含该人物的真实自拍。中右侧前景展示 1 个经过转换的像素漫画肖像，胸部以上构图，带有醒目的白色贴纸式轮廓。在照片窗口和像素肖像之间，放置 1 个指向右侧的粗白色箭头，以表示转换过程。在中心肖像周围，包含 4 个较小的漫画头像输出：顶部中心附近 1 个黄色背景肖像，右上角 1 个绿色背景气泡漫画肖像，右下角 1 个蓝色背景戏剧性漫画肖像，以及左下角绘图板上显示的 1 个薄荷绿肖像。环境：舒适的数字艺术家书桌和工作室，深青色墙壁，架子，像素收藏品和暖色灯光。书桌物品：包括 1 个右侧带有色板的倾斜绘图板，1 支放在其前面的触控笔，1 个带有白色爱心和蒸汽的红色马克杯，1 盏从左侧发光的黑色台灯，1 盆书桌上的盆栽，左下边缘 3 个小型像素手办，后墙上 1 个带框的像素爱心，顶架上 1 个微型像素人偶，以及架子上 1 盆小型盆栽。背景：在主角身后使用青色、珊瑚色、桃色和黄色的放射状漫画爆发效果，带有半色调纹理、小加号、闪光图标和方形像素。文字：无任何可读标题或标签。视觉风格：融合像素艺术、漫画/网漫/漫画转换、复古街机 UI、社交媒体宣传缩略图、简洁构图、边缘锐利、色彩鲜艳。约束：使用所列的精确数量的主要面板和书桌物品；不要添加额外的人物、标题、水印、Logo 或 UI 文字。

templates.title: Monochrome Rebellion Street Style Poster

titleLocalized.zh: Monochrome Rebellion 街头风海报

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="brand name" default="RBLN"} Create a monochrome, rebellious fashion editorial poster centered on a full-body street-style mannequin standing in front of enormous text. Canvas: Vertical 2:3 poster, 768 x 1152 pixels, black and white, light gray paper background, subtle photocopy grain, worn ink texture, high contrast, underground music magazine aesthetic. Layout: Place a full-body figure in the center of the image, feet near the bottom edge, head overlapping the enormous text in the background. Behind the figure, fill almost the entire height of the poster with a huge, compressed, bold capital letter:{argument name="main background word" default="REBELLION"} The letters must be black, extremely tall, tightly spaced, with an aged effect, and partially obscured by the model. In the lower foreground, a large white hand-drawn brush font is overlaid, containing the following text:{argument name="script title" default="Rebellion"} Extending diagonally from the lower left to the upper right, it covers the model's legs and torso. Small, editorial-style microtext is added along the edges, reminiscent of a magazine cover or street-style poster. Main details: The model has a neutral image, relaxed pose, hands in pockets, slightly hunched, facing forward. She has shoulder-length, messy, wavy blonde hair. Her face is deliberately obscured by a centered, soft gray square blurry mask. The outfit incorporates eight visible fashion elements: an oversized dark distressed printed T-shirt, two layered necklaces with small pendants, loose-fitting dark cargo pants, a chain hanging from the right waist, a stack of bracelets on the wrist, a pair of platform black and white sneakers, and a small forearm tattoo. The clothing should look vintage, rebellious, and urban. Text content: The poster includes 10 small text blocks/icons: Top left quote "RULES WERE MADE / TO BE BROKEN.", top center small globe icon, top right quote "NOT EVERYONE / WAS MEANT TO FIT IN.", left vertical banner "DISRUPT. DEFY. DEFINE.", right vertical barcode and tiny label text, right vertical banner "BREAK THE PATTERN," bottom left manifesto block "THEY CALL IT CHAOS. / I CALL IT FREEDOM. / I DON'T FOLLOW PATHS. / I LEAVE TRACES. / THIS ISN'T A PHASE. / THIS IS WHO I AM.", small black label "RBLN / WORLDWIDE / 2024," bottom right handwritten signature.{argument name="signature text" default="Rbln"} The text includes the quote "LOUD MINDS. / RAW SOULS. / REAL ONES ONLY." in the bottom right corner. Add three small star/spark icons: one on the left, one near the barcode area on the right, and one near the center at the bottom. Add a total of two miniature globe icons: one at the top center and one in the bottom left corner. Visual style: Black, white, and gray only; rough halftone textures; editorial street style; distressed font; sharp studio lighting with soft floor shadows; high-fashion poster design; no chromatic accents. Constraints: All text remains in English; retain large words and handwritten headings as visual focal points; do not add extra figures except as specified.{argument name="brand name" default="RBLN"} Do not add any additional logos outside of the brand name; keep the composition simple yet impactful.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="brand name" default="RBLN"} 创作一张单色叛逆时尚编辑风格海报，以站在巨大字体前的全身街头风模特为中心。

画布：垂直 2:3 海报，768 x 1152 构图，黑白色调，浅灰色纸张背景，细微的复印颗粒感，磨损的墨迹纹理，高对比度，地下音乐杂志美学。

布局：将一名全身人物置于画面中心，双脚靠近底部边缘，头部与背景的巨大文字重叠。在人物身后，用一个巨大的压缩粗体大写单词填满几乎整个海报高度：{argument name="main background word" default="REBELLION"}。字母必须为黑色，极高，间距紧凑，呈现做旧效果，并部分被模特遮挡。在下半部分前景中，叠加一个巨大的白色手绘笔刷字体，内容为 {argument name="script title" default="Rebellion"}，从左下角斜向右上方延伸，覆盖模特的腿部和躯干。在边缘处添加小型编辑风格微型文字，如同杂志封面或街头风宣传海报。

主体细节：模特为中性化形象，姿态放松，双手插兜，略微含胸，面向前方。留着齐肩凌乱的波浪金发。面部被一个居中的柔和灰色方形模糊遮罩刻意遮挡。服装包含 8 个可见的时尚元素：1 件超大号深色做旧印花 T 恤，2 条带有小吊坠的叠戴项链，1 条宽松深色工装裤，右侧腰间挂有 1 条链条，手腕上有 1 叠手链，1 双厚底黑白运动鞋，以及 1 个小前臂纹身。服装应看起来陈旧、叛逆且具有都市感。

文字内容：在海报周围包含 10 个小型文本块/图标：左上角引用语“RULES WERE MADE / TO BE BROKEN.”，顶部中心一个小地球仪图标，右上角引用语“NOT EVERYONE / WAS MEANT TO FIT IN.”，左侧垂直标语“DISRUPT. DEFY. DEFINE.”，右侧垂直条形码及微小标签文字，右侧垂直标语“BREAK THE PATTERN”，左下角宣言块“THEY CALL IT CHAOS. / I CALL IT FREEDOM. / I DON’T FOLLOW PATHS. / I LEAVE TRACES. / THIS ISN’T A PHASE. / THIS IS WHO I AM.”，一个小黑色标签“RBLN / WORLDWIDE / 2024”，右下角手写签名 {argument name="signature text" default="Rbln"}，以及右下角引用语“LOUD MINDS. / RAW SOULS. / REAL ONES ONLY.”。添加 3 个小型星形/火花图标：一个在左侧，一个在右侧条形码区域附近，一个在底部中心附近。总共添加 2 个微型地球仪图标：一个在顶部中心，一个在左下角。

视觉风格：仅限黑、白、灰；粗砺的半色调纹理；编辑风格街头感；做旧字体；锐利的摄影棚灯光，带有柔和的地板阴影；高级时尚海报设计；无彩色点缀。

约束：所有文字保持英文，保留巨大单词和手写标题作为视觉焦点，不要添加额外人物，除指定的 {argument name="brand name" default="RBLN"} 品牌外不要添加额外 Logo，保持构图简洁但强烈。

templates.title: A stunning transformation from sketch to comic book

titleLocalized.zh: 从草图到漫画的华丽蜕变

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic desktop scene showcasing an unfinished comic/picture book artwork, viewed from a slightly overhead perspective on a dark wood desk. The page is diagonally divided by a jagged, shimmering gold crack: the left half is a rough graphite pencil sketch, and the right half is the completed, colored comic. In the left sketch area, draw an unfinished city skyline, featuring towering skyscrapers and a caped hero whose back is visible, the image filled with loose compositional lines, smudges, cross-hatching, and eraser shavings. In the right completed area, render a dramatic film noir-style comic book superhero scene using deep navy blue, black ink, halftone dots, warm yellow window lighting, and crisp white panel frames: a silhouette of a young male hero with spiky hair and a flowing cape stands on the edge of a rooftop, facing a full moon and a dense, futuristic city beneath striped clouds. The completed comic page features four clearly visible panels: a large main panel with the hero overlooking the city, two narrow vertical panels stacked on the right side showcasing dark city buildings and rooftop water towers, and a wide panel in the lower right corner displaying diagonal perspective lines and architecture. Realistic art supplies are added around the page: a sharpened pencil in the lower left, two black drawing pens in the lower right, and a metal cup visible in the upper right. Dramatic warm-toned desktop lighting, realistic paper texture, ink grain, halftone printing quality, luminous transitions, and highly detailed comic lines are used. The entire scene should convey a sense of transformation from sketch to finished comic art. A custom hero is {argument name="character type" default="Young male vigilante with spiky hair and a cloak"} The scene is{argument name="city setting" default="A futuristic rooftop city with a noir film style"} The comic book color scheme is{argument name="color palette" default="Deep navy blue, black ink, warm yellow light, and golden sparks"} The moon details are{argument name="sky feature" default="A giant full moon behind floating clouds"} Desktop style is{argument name="desk surface" default="Dark wood artist desk"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个电影质感的桌面场景，展示一张正在创作中的漫画/绘本作品，视角为深色木质书桌上的微俯视视角。页面被一道锯齿状的金色闪光裂痕对角分割：左半部分是粗糙的石墨铅笔草图，右半部分是完成后的彩色漫画。在左侧草图区域，绘制一个未完成的城市天际线，包含高耸的摩天大楼和一个背影示人的披风英雄，画面充满松散的构图线条、涂抹痕迹、交叉排线和橡皮屑。在右侧完成区域，渲染一个戏剧性的黑色电影风格漫画超级英雄场景，采用深海军蓝、黑色墨水、网点、温暖的黄色窗灯和清晰的白色分镜框：一个剪影化的年轻男性英雄，留着尖刺发型，披风飘逸，站在屋顶边缘，面对着满月和条纹云层下密集的未来派城市。完成后的漫画页面包含 4 个清晰可见的分镜：1 个英雄俯瞰城市的大型主分镜，2 个堆叠在右侧的狭窄垂直分镜，展示黑暗的城市建筑和屋顶水塔，以及 1 个右下角的宽幅分镜，展示对角线的城市透视线条和建筑。在页面周围添加真实的艺术用品：左下方放置 1 支削好的铅笔，右下方放置 2 支黑色绘图笔，右上角部分可见 1 个金属杯。使用戏剧性的暖色调桌面照明、逼真的纸张纹理、墨水颗粒、网点印刷质感、发光的过渡火花以及高细节的漫画线条。整个场景应呈现出从草图到成品漫画艺术的蜕变感。自定义英雄为 {argument name="character type" default="留着尖刺发型、披着斗篷的年轻男性义警"}，场景为 {argument name="city setting" default="黑色电影风格的未来派屋顶城市"}，漫画色调为 {argument name="color palette" default="深海军蓝、黑色墨水、暖黄色灯光和金色火花"}，月亮细节为 {argument name="sky feature" default="漂浮云层后的巨大满月"}，桌面风格为 {argument name="desk surface" default="深色木质艺术家书桌"}。

templates.title: Selfie-to-cartoon style split-screen mockup

titleLocalized.zh: 自拍转漫画风格分屏样机

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a vertical, app-style promotional mockup for a "selfie-to-cartoon" image conversion tool, showcasing how the same portrait can be transformed into various cartoon styles while maintaining facial structure recognizability. Canvas: A 4:5 aspect ratio similar to smartphones, with a dark, glossy interface border and thin, cyan glowing lines along the left and right edges. The background is softly blurred, resembling a desk or a creative studio environment with paper and drawing materials. Layout: The main preview image occupies most of the screen, precisely divided into four vertical style panels from left to right: 1) Realistic selfie/photo style, 2) Black and white cartoon ink painting style, 3) High-saturation retro comic strip halftone style, 4) Blocky pixel art portrait style. A large, centered square mask/placeholder covers the middle and upper body area in a warm beige-gray, as if the central facial area is deliberately hidden. Below the main preview image is a dark carousel containing four rounded thumbnail cards corresponding to the four styles: selfie, cartoon ink, retro comic strip, and pixel art. Main details: Featuring a young woman,{argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown/black"} The character's messy hair is tied into a high bun, with eyebrows and eyes visible on both panels. They have a medium warm skin tone, wear a simple dark crew neck shirt, and a thin necklace. Maintain the same head position in all four transformations. Style Panel Details: The Photo panel should look like a casual indoor selfie with shallow depth of field and a natural texture. The Cartoon panel should use dramatic black ink, white highlights, crosshairs, and clean lines. The Retro Comic Strip panel should use bold outlines, a red-yellow background burst effect, blue-black hair highlights, orange skin tones, and halftone dots. The Pixel Art panel should use large square pixels, simplified facial features, a cyan background, and a limited color palette. Visual Style: High-contrast social media product preview, clean vertical division, glossy black UI shell, neon cyan accents, simple rounded-corner thumbnail cards, and sophisticated GPT imagery aesthetics. Constraints: Include 4 precise main vertical panels and 4 bottom thumbnails. Do not add readable text, logos, or watermarks. Keep the central beige square mask prominent and perfectly centered.{argument name="interface mood" default="Dark futuristic mobile UI"} ,{argument name="comic transformation theme" default="Comic strip, retro comic strip, and pixel art selfie conversion"} as well as{argument name="background setting" default="Blurry creative studio desk"} .

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为一款“自拍转漫画”图像转换工具创建一个垂直的 App 风格宣传样机，展示同一张人像在保持面部结构可辨识的前提下，转换为多种漫画风格。

画布：类似智能手机的 4:5 纵向构图，深色光泽感界面边框，左右边缘带有细长的青色发光线条。手机外部背景经过柔和模糊处理，呈现出类似书桌或带有纸张和绘画素材的创意工作室环境。

布局：主预览图占据屏幕大部分空间，从左到右精确划分为 4 个垂直风格面板：1) 写实自拍/照片风格，2) 黑白漫画墨水画风格，3) 高饱和度复古连环画半色调风格，4) 块状像素艺术头像风格。一个居中的大方形遮罩/占位符覆盖了面部中部和上半身区域，呈暖米灰色，仿佛面部中心区域被刻意隐藏。主预览图下方是一个深色轮播条，包含 4 个与上述四种风格对应的圆角缩略图卡片：照片自拍、漫画墨水、复古连环画和像素艺术。

主体细节：使用一位年轻女性，{argument name="hair color" default="深棕色/黑色"} 的凌乱头发扎成高丸子头，左右面板可见眉毛和眼睛，中等暖色调肤色，身穿简单的深色圆领衫并佩戴细项链。在所有四种转换中保持相同的头部位置。

风格面板细节：照片面板应看起来像一张带有浅景深和自然质感的休闲室内自拍。漫画面板应使用戏剧性的黑色墨水、白色高光、交叉排线和干净的线条。复古连环画面板应使用粗轮廓、红黄色背景爆发效果、蓝黑色头发高光、橙色肤色和半色调网点。像素艺术面板应使用大方块像素、简化的面部特征、青色背景和有限的调色板。

视觉风格：高对比度社交媒体产品预览，清晰的垂直分割，光泽感黑色 UI 外壳，霓虹青色点缀，简洁的圆角缩略图卡片，精致的 GPT 图像宣传美学。

约束条件：包含精确的 4 个主垂直面板和 4 个底部缩略图。不要添加可读文字、Logo 或水印。保持中央米色方形遮罩突出且完美居中。使用 {argument name="interface mood" default="深色未来感移动端 UI"}、{argument name="comic transformation theme" default="漫画、复古连环画和像素艺术自拍转换"} 以及 {argument name="background setting" default="模糊的创意工作室书桌"}。

The central element is {argument name="football player" default="Lionel Messi"} The image shows the player from behind, wearing an Argentinian-style white and blue striped jersey with the letters MESSI and the number 10, black shorts, white socks, and shoes, and sporting the captain's armband. He is stepping into a giant, open comic book leaning against the wall. The comic book cover should prominently display the words "..." in bold, eye-catching lettering.{argument name="comic title" default="MESSI"} The subtitle is "{argument name="subtitle" default="THE CELESTIAL JOURNEY"} The top left corner features a small, comic book-style detail. Inside the comic book page, a shattered paper portal is depicted, accompanied by a swirling electric blue cosmic vortex, glowing stadium floodlights, torn panels, flying confetti, blue sparks, and a golden World Cup trophy suspended in the center. The portal projects a dramatic silhouette light, while a desk lamp provides warm ambient lighting, creating the illusion of the player being between a realistic bedroom and the comic book world. Six key bedroom fan details are included: 1. A football scarf atop the wall; 2. A framed football poster; 3. A display wall of player cards on the left wall; 4. Color and style: Adopting the aesthetics of high-end cricket league equipment, the color scheme is {argument name="jersey color" default="Red, black, gold"} The outfit features navy blue trousers, brown-gold protective gear, pure white gloves and shoes, showcasing realistic fabric wrinkles, a glossy finish without a helmet, and sharp product rendering details. Constraints: Only three labeled angle views are allowed; no additional players, stadiums, crowds, or watermarks are permitted; no additional text is allowed besides jersey sponsor text, racket branding, small equipment logos, and the three angle labels.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个逼真的板球运动员角色设计图，展示 {argument name="character name" default="一名男性职业板球运动员"} 身穿全套制服的三个视角，类似于运动装备设计预览。

画布：宽幅横向摄影棚构图，浅灰色无缝背景，柔和均匀的灯光，高分辨率照片级 3D 渲染或商业运动摄影风格。保持三个形象大小一致，并在画布上均匀分布。

布局：展示 3 个全身姿势，每个姿势脚下居中位置带有小的黑色角度标签：1) 左侧人物标注为“0°”，正面朝向，直立站立，板球拍垂直放置在身体左侧地面；2) 中间人物标注为“45°”，四分之三侧面视角，双手戴着手套将球拍斜向上持于身前；3) 右侧人物标注为“180°”，背面朝向，将球拍垂直放置在身体右侧地面。运动员的面部在正面和四分之三侧面视角中应刻意模糊或遮挡。

主体细节：体格健壮的成年男性，中棕色皮肤，黑色短发，运动装剪裁利落。服装包含 7 件可见的装备/服饰：1) 红色短袖板球球衣，配有黑色肩部和金色镶边；2) 海军蓝板球长裤；3) 白色击球手套；4) 金色护腿；5) 白色运动板球鞋；6) 浅色木质板球拍，带有醒目的红黑配色“SS”风格标志；7) 从背面可见的红白相间护腿绑带。球衣正面印有 {argument name="sponsor text" default="QATAR AIRWAYS"}，采用大号白色字体，左胸处有一个小金色徽章，下躯干部分有精致的深红色图案。球衣背面为纯红色，配有黑色侧边，腰部附近有金红色渐变图案，领口下方有一个微小的金色标记。

颜色与风格：采用高级板球联赛装备美学，配色为 {argument name="jersey color" default="红、黑、金"}，搭配海军蓝长裤、棕金色护具、纯白色手套和鞋子，呈现逼真的织物褶皱、无头盔的亮面展示，以及锐利的产品渲染细节。

约束条件：仅包含 3 个带标签的角度视图，不得出现额外球员、体育场、人群、水印，除球衣赞助商文字、球拍品牌、小型装备标识以及三个角度标签外，不得包含任何额外文字。

templates.title: Comparison of subway and surface transportation during morning rush hour

titleLocalized.zh: 早高峰地铁与地面交通对比

templates.prompt: Create a realistic, documentary-style wide-angle photograph, with the scene located in {argument name="station name" default="Suzhou Street Station"} Beijing Subway{argument name="metro line" default="Line 10"} The platform, during the evening rush hour, is illuminated with cool-toned fluorescent indoor lighting, creating a sense of calm and certainty that contrasts sharply with the chaotic traffic outside. The camera is positioned at platform level, using a 16:9 horizontal aspect ratio to overlook a clean, modern subway platform with glossy gray tiled floors, white pillars, a striped metal ceiling, and glass platform screen doors on the right. In the central foreground, a primary passenger is shown: an adult male wearing a dark blue winter coat, jeans, black boots, a scarf, and carrying a backpack, standing near the yellow safety line, looking at his watch and holding the handle of a brown suitcase; he also holds a transit card or ticket in one hand. His face is deliberately blurred or anonymized. Behind him are exactly 13 other commuters scattered across the platform and passageways, some walking towards the camera, others waiting by the doors, all dressed in winter clothing with their faces obscured. Behind the glass doors on the right, a blue subway train is shown parked on the platform, its headlights visible. Through the glass and the station openings behind the train, an elevated expressway is displayed, crowded with dense red brake lights and slow-moving cars, creating a stark contrast between predictable subway travel and congested road traffic. It includes exactly three prominent information/signage elements: a black overhead directional sign on the left with arrows and text in both Chinese and English indicating Line 10, the exit, Suzhou Street Station, and the direction to Wanshou Temple; an overhead digital train arrival item near the top center, displaying the time as 18:15, with text such as "Next train: Line 10 (Inner Loop) arriving in 1 minute"; and a long, rectangular platform wall sign above the train doors on the right, containing text in both Chinese and English for "Suzhou Street Station," "Suzhou Street Direction," "Line 10," and "To Wanshou Temple." Utilizing natural reflections from the polished floor and glass, a slightly soft, cinematic blue-green color tone is employed, with realistic lens perspective, high detail, no cartoonish style, no additional logos, and no watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实的纪录片风格广角照片，场景位于 {argument name="station name" default="苏州街站"} 的北京地铁 {argument name="metro line" default="10 号线"} 站台，时间为傍晚早高峰，采用冷色调荧光室内照明，营造出一种平静的确定感，并与室外的交通混乱形成鲜明对比。相机位于站台水平高度，采用 16:9 横向构图，俯瞰一个干净现代的地铁站台，地面铺设光亮的灰色瓷砖，配有白色立柱、条纹金属天花板，右侧为玻璃屏蔽门。在中心前景处，展示一名主要旅客：一名身穿深蓝色冬装外套、牛仔裤、黑色靴子、戴着围巾并背着双肩包的成年男性，他站在黄色安全线附近，一边看着手表，一边手提棕色行李箱的拉杆；他的一只手中还拿着一张交通卡或票据。他的面部应刻意模糊或匿名化处理。在他身后，包括恰好 13 名分布在站台和通道上的其他通勤者，有些人正朝镜头走来，有些人正在门边等待，所有人都穿着冬装，面部模糊不清。在右侧玻璃门后，展示一列停靠在站台的蓝色地铁列车，可见其车头灯。透过玻璃和列车后方的车站开口，展示一条高架快速路，上面挤满了密集的红色刹车灯和缓慢行驶的汽车，形成了可预测的地铁出行与拥堵道路交通之间的鲜明对比。包含恰好 3 个显著的信息/标识元素：左侧 1 个黑色头顶导向牌，带有箭头及中英文对照的 10 号线、出口、苏州街站及往万寿寺方向的文字；顶部中心附近 1 个头顶数字列车到站项目，显示时间为 18:15，文字如“下一班列车：10 号线（内环）1 分钟后到达”；右侧列车门上方 1 个长条形站台墙面标识，包含“苏州街站”、“苏州街方向”、“10 号线”及“往万寿寺”的中英文文字。使用抛光地面和玻璃上的自然反射，采用略微柔和的蓝绿色电影级调色，真实的镜头透视，高细节，无卡通风格，无额外 Logo，无水印。

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic vertical street photography scene, located at {argument name="city" default="Beijing"} The scene is set at dusk after a rainstorm. It shows a commuter with his back to the camera, walking on a brightly lit, wet sidewalk. To his right is a brightly lit subway entrance. The entrance features a modern gray rectangular canopy, glass walls, stairs and escalators leading inside, cool-toned fluorescent interior lighting, tactile yellow tactile paving, and a circular blue and white subway sign above the door. To the left is a congested multi-lane road, crammed with cars and taxis, red brake lights reflected in puddles and black asphalt. In the distance, a dense city skyline is displayed, including the iconic CCTV headquarters, against a dramatic, cloudy sunset in shades of peach, purple, and blue. Above the traffic is a stylized, glowing red navigation overlay: a continuous spiral path of thin red lines and small connecting nodes, with a large red map marker near the upper left horizon, symbolizing route uncertainty and traffic delays. The pedestrian is a young man, his back to the camera, of medium build, wearing {argument name="commuter outfit" default="Light beige jacket, dark trousers, white sneakers, and a black shoulder bag"} The pace was calm but slightly weary. The film employs realistic proportions, a melancholic urban atmosphere, high detail, damp reflections, shallow depth of field with cinematic contrast, soft fog, and a documentary style. There are no visible titles, watermarks, or additional text in the image.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个电影感的竖屏街头摄影场景，地点位于 {argument name="city" default="北京"}，时间为雨后黄昏。画面展示了一名通勤者背对镜头，走在光亮的湿润人行道上，前方右侧是一个灯火通明的地铁入口。地铁入口设有现代化的灰色长方形顶棚、玻璃墙面、通往内部的楼梯和自动扶梯、冷色调的荧光室内照明、触觉黄色导盲砖，以及门上方圆形的蓝白相间地铁标志。左侧是一条拥堵的多车道马路，挤满了汽车和出租车，红色的刹车灯在水坑和黑色沥青路面上形成倒影。远处展示密集的城市天际线，包括标志性的央视总部大楼，背景是戏剧性的多云日落，呈现出桃红、紫色和蓝色的色调。在交通上方添加一个风格化的发光红色导航路线叠加层：一条由细红线、小型连接节点组成的连续螺旋路径，左上方天际线附近有一个巨大的红色地图标记，象征着路线的不确定性和交通延误。行人是一名年轻男性，背影视角，中等身材，身穿 {argument name="commuter outfit" default="浅米色夹克、深色长裤、白色运动鞋和黑色单肩包"}，步伐平静但略显疲惫。采用写实比例、忧郁的城市氛围、高细节、湿润的倒影、浅景深的电影对比度、柔和的雾气以及纪录片摄影风格。画面中无可见标题、无水印、无额外文字。

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅宁静的超现实数字绘画，描绘一个与广阔倒影湖面融为一体的创意工作空间，时间设定为 {argument name="time of day" default="日落"}。采用 16:9 宽屏电影构图，前景为深色桌面，与平静的水面和远方的地平线无缝衔接。在背景正中央，放置一轮低垂的暖阳，在水面上投射出一条明亮的金色 S 型光路，延伸至观者眼前。在右侧地平线上，添加连绵起伏的锯齿状雪山，其中一座主峰尖锐突出，轻裹在低云薄雾中。在左上方天空，精确包含 2 个天体细节：一弯新月和一颗微小的星星。在右上方天空，精确包含 6 个呈对角线向上排列的小鸟剪影。前景物体：左侧放置一叠由 5 块光滑黑色禅石组成的平衡石堆，旁边是一个带有 5 个可见颜料槽的艺术调色板，以及一支斜放的画笔；右侧放置一本打开的空白笔记本，上面横放着一支笔，以及一个带有把手的深色咖啡杯。氛围应平和、冥想且如梦似幻，地平线附近呈现温暖的橙金色光芒，并向上下方渐变为冷蓝灰色调。使用柔和的大气雾感、逼真的倒影、细腻的绘画质感，高细节，画面中无人，无可见文字，无水印。整体主题为 {argument name="theme" default="宁静的创意独处"}，主色调强调 {argument name="color palette" default="温暖的琥珀色日落与冷峻的炭蓝色"}。
