templates.title: Doraemon-style Newton's Second Law comics

titleLocalized.zh: 哆啦 A 梦风格牛顿第二定律漫画

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a vibrant, colorful science comic strip that teaches Newton's Second Law through a classroom experiment inspired by Doraemon, employing a cheerful Japanese children's comic aesthetic and accompanied by clear Chinese explanatory text. Canvas: A 3:4 portrait page with a thick black border, precisely divided into 5 horizontal sections: 1 header story panel, 2 experiment panels, 1 conclusion panel, and 1 bottom summary bar. Use bright base colors and clean ink lines. The background is a school playground, including blue sky, trees, fences, and school buildings. Layout and Text Content: A yellow torn paper label in the upper left corner contains the following information:{argument name="page label" default="Page 4"} The top heading is in bold Chinese and contains the following content:{argument name="main headline" default="Experiment 1: For the same car, the greater the force applied, the greater the acceleration."} The text highlights various sections, including: "The same vehicle" in blue, and "The greater the force, the greater the acceleration" in red. Section 1, the introduction panel: On the left is a blue Doraemon character, resembling a classic round-headed cartoon cat, smiling and raising one finger, wearing a red collar and bell. Four children stand in the middle/right: a boy in a yellow shirt (face deliberately blurred/blank), a girl in a pink top and green skirt, a muscular boy in an orange sweater, and a boy with spiky hair in a purple hoodie. A dialogue bubble: Doraemon says, "Let's use the vehicle to conduct an experiment and see how the force affects acceleration!" The spiky-haired boy says, "Yay! Let's begin!" Section 2, the experiment panel, labeled "Experiment 1: Small Push" within a blue rounded rectangle: A school scene where a girl is pulling a blue cart from left to right with a rope/handle. The cart contains two clearly visible items: a teddy bear and a striped ball. A small amount of dust effect is added behind the wheels. A red arrow points to the right, accompanied by the blue text "Move forward slowly." A speech bubble: a girl says, "I push gently..." and a boy with a blurred face on the right says, "Wow, the car is moving very slowly!" Section 3, Experiment cell, labeled "Experiment 2: Push Hard": A burly boy in an orange sweater pushes the same blue cart forcefully from left to right, leaning forward, with speed lines, sweat beads, and a stronger sense of movement. The cart also contains two clearly visible items: a teddy bear and a striped ball. A larger red arrow points to the right, accompanied by the red text "Move forward quickly." A speech bubble: the burly boy says, "I push hard!" and a boy with a blurred face on the right says, "Wow! The cart is moving so fast!" Section 4, Conclusion cell: On the left, a blue Doraemon points with a pointer and says, "The experiment shows that for the same cart, the greater the force, the more obvious the acceleration effect!" In the center is a green blackboard on a wooden easel. The blackboard is titled "Experimental Conclusion: Same Car (Same Mass)" and displays two sets of miniature illustrations for comparison: a small force push is accompanied by the text "Small force → Small acceleration," and a large force push is accompanied by the text "Large force → Large acceleration." Four children stand on the right: a boy in a yellow shirt with blurred faces, a girl in a pink shirt and green skirt, a muscular boy in an orange shirt, and a boy with spiky hair in a purple shirt. Speech bubbles read, "So, the greater the force, the greater the acceleration!" and "This is the relationship between force and acceleration!" In section 5, the bottom summary bar is a pale yellow rounded rectangle with a blue dotted border. On the left, a blue Doraemon smiles, raising a finger next to a star icon. The large blue title reads {argument name="summary heading" default="This page highlights"} The main clause in red is {argument name="summary sentence" default="For the same mass: the greater the force, the greater the acceleration."} The right side displays a formula card with the bold red and blue symbol "F↑ → a↑", along with an orange traffic cone icon with an arc-shaped trajectory. Visual style: A refined Japanese manga layout mimicking Ohmsha's style of science books: thick black panel lines, clean cel color scheme, expressive cartoon faces, easy-to-read bold Chinese typography, speech bubbles with black outlines, and a friendly elementary science teaching tone. Constraints: Maintain precise 5 horizontal areas, precise 4 children in group scenes, precise 2 items inside the car in each experiment cell, and ensure the yellow-shirted boy's face remains intentionally blurred/blank wherever it appears. Avoid photorealism, extra panels, watermarks, and ensure all text is clearly legible.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一页色彩鲜艳的科普漫画，通过受哆啦 A 梦启发的课堂实验教授牛顿第二定律，采用欢快的日本儿童漫画美学，并配有清晰的中文科普说明文字。

画布：竖向 3:4 页面，带有粗黑色外边框，精确划分为 5 个横向区域：1 个页眉故事格、2 个实验格、1 个结论格和 1 个底部重点总结条。使用明亮的基色，干净的墨线勾勒，背景为校园操场，包含蓝天、树木、围栏和教学楼。

布局与文本内容：左上角有一个黄色撕纸标签，内容为 {argument name="page label" default="第 4 页"}。顶部大标题采用醒目的粗体中文，内容为 {argument name="main headline" default="实验一：同一辆车，用力越大，加速度越大"}，其中“同一辆车”用蓝色强调，“用力越大，加速度越大”用红色强调。

第 1 区域，引入格：左侧是一个蓝色的机器猫角色，外形类似经典的圆头卡通猫，它笑容灿烂并竖起一根手指，戴着红领圈和铃铛。中间/右侧站着 4 名儿童：一名穿黄色衬衫的男孩（脸部刻意模糊/空白处理）、一名穿粉色上衣配绿色短裙的女孩、一名穿橙色毛衣的壮硕男孩，以及一名穿紫色连帽衫的刺猬头男孩。对话气泡：机器猫说“我们用小车来做实验，看看力大小对加速度的影响！”，刺猬头男孩说“好耶！我们开始吧！”。

第 2 区域，实验格，标注在蓝色圆角矩形内“实验 1：小力推”：校园场景，女孩正用绳子/把手将一辆蓝色小推车从左向右拉动。小车内装有 2 个清晰可见的物品：一只泰迪熊和一个条纹球。车轮后方添加少量灰尘效果。一个红色箭头指向右侧，配有蓝色文字“慢慢地向前运动”。对话气泡：女孩说“我轻轻推……”，右侧脸部模糊的男孩说“哇，小车走得很慢！”。

第 3 区域，实验格，标注在蓝色圆角矩形内“实验 2：大力推”：穿橙色毛衣的壮硕男孩用力将同一辆蓝色小推车从左向右推，身体前倾，带有速度线、汗珠和更强烈的动作感。小车内同样装有 2 个清晰可见的物品：泰迪熊和条纹球。一个更大的红色箭头指向右侧，配有红色文字“快速地向前运动”。对话气泡：壮硕男孩说“我使劲推！”，右侧脸部模糊的男孩说“哇哦！小车一下子跑得好快啊！”。

第 4 区域，结论格：左侧，蓝色机器猫用教鞭指着并说道“从实验可以看出：同一辆车，力越大，小车的加速效果越明显！”。中间是一个木制画架上的绿色黑板。黑板标题为“实验结论：同一辆车（质量相同）”，并展示 2 组微型插图对照行：小力推配文字“小力→小加速度”，大力推配文字“大力→大加速度”。右侧再次站着 4 名儿童：脸部模糊的黄衫男孩、粉衣绿裙女孩、橙衣壮硕男孩和紫衣刺猬头男孩。对话气泡写着“原来力越大，加速度就越大！”和“这就是“力与加速度的关系”啊！”。

第 5 区域，底部重点总结条：淡黄色圆角矩形，带有蓝色虚线边框。左侧，蓝色机器猫微笑着，在星星图标旁竖起一根手指。蓝色大标题为 {argument name="summary heading" default="本页重点"}。红色主句为 {argument name="summary sentence" default="质量相同：力越大，加速度越大。"}。右侧展示一张公式卡片，带有粗体红蓝符号“F↑ → a↑”，外加一个带有弧形运动轨迹的橙色交通锥图标。

视觉风格：模仿 Ohmsha 风格科普读物的精致日本漫画布局：粗黑色分格线、干净的赛璐珞配色、表情丰富的卡通脸、易读的粗体中文排版、带黑色轮廓的对话气泡，以及友好的小学科学教学语调。

约束条件：保持精确的 5 个横向区域，群组场景中保持精确的 4 名儿童，每个实验格中保持精确的 2 个小车内物品，并确保黄衫男孩的脸部在任何出现的地方都保持刻意模糊/空白。避免照片写实感，避免额外分格，避免水印，并确保所有文字清晰可辨。

templates.title: Mintpage AI Landing Page First Screen Design

titleLocalized.zh: Mintpage AI 着陆页首屏设计

templates.prompt: Objective: To promote{argument name="product name" default="MINTPAGE"} (An AI landing page studio) creates a sophisticated square homepage image for its SaaS landing page concept. Canvas: 1:1 square composition, soft daylight office environment, light mint and light blue tones, minimalist high-tech aesthetics, realistic 3D product models combined with exquisite typography. Layout: The center of the scene features a large desktop monitor placed on a glossy glass table. A row of small brand information is placed at the top, including a circular mint leaf-shaped logo and the word {argument name="product name" default="MINTPAGE"} A thin dividing line and a subtitle{argument name="brand subtitle" default="AI LANDING PAGE STUDIO"} The heading below uses a large, elegant, dark blue serif font:{argument name="headline text" default="WHY DO MOST AI PAGES LOOK GENERIC?"} Below the title, four small feature badges with delicate mint-colored icons and labels are placed side-by-side: 1) AI-Driven, 2) React + Tailwind, 3) Production Ready, 4) Built for Conversion. The main body: The monitor displays a clean web application builder interface for creating landing pages. The interface should include a top navigation bar and a split-screen workspace. A vertical setup flow is shown on the left, comprising four numbered steps: 1) Context — Define your idea, 2) Style — Visual direction, 3) Design — AI-generated layout, 4) Code — Export production-ready code. The middle panel displays the title “From Idea to Code. Instantly.”, with “Code. Instantly.” in mint-colored italics, followed by form fields such as “Business Name,” “Target Audience,” and “Core Mission.” The right panel displays a code editor called “Live Environment,” containing readable but smaller-font React/Tailwind style code, along with a short rendered text snippet that reads, “Landing pages that look iconic. Built to convert.” Foreground Objects: On the left side of the desk, a semi-transparent acrylic desktop nameplate is placed, printed with a circular logo and the text "MINTPAGE" and "AI LANDING PAGE STUDIO". Below or next to it, three thin books with clearly labeled spines are stacked: 1) BUILT FOR CONVERSION, 2) REACT + TAILWIND + AI, 3) DESIGN SYSTEMS THAT SCALE. In front of the monitor, a slim white keyboard is placed. On the right, a small semi-transparent floating status card titled "PROJECT STATUS" is placed, listing five checked items: 1) Live Environment, 2) Context Defined, 3) Style Generated, 4) Design Created, 5) Code Exported. Additionally, a light blue ribbed pen holder containing four writing instruments and a white mouse is placed. Environment: A minimalist modern office with soft-focus bookshelves and plants in the background, a large window on the right providing natural light, subtle reflections on the glass desktop, soft depth of field, and no one in the frame. Visual Style: High-end startup launch graphics, soft volumetric lighting, realistic product photography, glass-like overlays, mint green accents, dark blue serif fonts, clean UI details, and a cool, high-end studio atmosphere. Constraints: Use the precise number of elements listed above, keep the images clean, make the title the most prominent text, and avoid additional logos, watermarks, or irrelevant text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为宣传 {argument name="product name" default="MINTPAGE"}（一款 AI 着陆页工作室）的 SaaS 着陆页概念创建一个精致的方形首屏图像。

画布：1:1 方形构图，柔和的日光办公环境，淡薄荷色与浅蓝色调，简洁的高端科技美学，逼真的 3D 产品模型与精致的排版设计相结合。

布局：场景中心为一个放置在光面玻璃桌上的大型桌面显示器。顶部放置一排小型品牌信息，包括一个圆形的薄荷叶状 Logo、单词 {argument name="product name" default="MINTPAGE"}、一条细分割线以及副标题 {argument name="brand subtitle" default="AI LANDING PAGE STUDIO"}。下方使用深蓝色的大号优雅衬线字体作为标题：{argument name="headline text" default="WHY DO MOST AI PAGES LOOK GENERIC?"}。在标题下方，并排放置 4 个带有精致薄荷色图标和标签的小型功能徽章：1) AI 驱动，2) React + Tailwind，3) 生产就绪，4) 专为转化而生。

主体：显示器展示了一个简洁的 Web 应用构建器界面，用于创建着陆页。界面应包含顶部导航栏和分屏工作区。左侧显示一个垂直设置流程，包含 4 个编号步骤：1) Context — 定义你的想法，2) Style — 视觉方向，3) Design — AI 生成布局，4) Code — 导出生产就绪代码。在中间面板，显示标题“From Idea to Code. Instantly.”，其中“Code. Instantly.”采用薄荷色斜体样式，随后是“业务名称”、“目标受众”和“核心使命”等表单字段。在右侧面板，显示一个名为“Live Environment”的代码编辑器，其中包含可读性强但字号较小的 React/Tailwind 风格代码，以及一段简短的渲染文本片段，内容为“Landing pages that look iconic. Built to convert.”。

前景物体：在桌子左侧，放置一个半透明的亚克力桌面铭牌，上面印有圆形 Logo 以及文字“MINTPAGE”和“AI LANDING PAGE STUDIO”。在其下方或旁边，堆叠 3 本书脊标签清晰的薄书：1) BUILT FOR CONVERSION，2) REACT + TAILWIND + AI，3) DESIGN SYSTEMS THAT SCALE。在显示器前方，放置一个纤薄的白色键盘。在右侧，放置一张名为“PROJECT STATUS”的小型半透明悬浮状态卡片，列出 5 个已勾选的项目：1) Live Environment，2) Context Defined，3) Style Generated，4) Design Created，5) Code Exported。此外，放置一个淡蓝色罗纹笔筒，内含 4 支书写工具和一个白色鼠标。

环境：极简现代办公室，背景中有柔焦书架和植物，右侧有大窗户采光，玻璃桌面上有微妙的反射，柔和的景深，画面中无人。

视觉风格：高端初创公司发布图形，柔和的体积光，逼真的产品摄影，玻璃拟态叠加层，薄荷绿点缀，深蓝色衬线字体，清晰的 UI 细节，冷静的高端工作室氛围。

约束：使用上述列出的精确数量元素，保持图像整洁，使标题成为最突出的文字，避免额外的 Logo、水印或无关文字。

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a highly detailed banner for a fantasy studio for promotional purposes.{argument name="headline text" default="GPT Image 2 Skill"} This showcases a magical image-generating toolkit, presented as if by apprentices and a wise master from the cartoon Calabash Brothers. Canvas: An extra-wide horizontal banner with an aspect ratio of approximately 2.4:1, featuring cinematic composition, warm, glowing fantasy lighting, and rich, easy-to-read content. The title is centered at the top, spanning across black ink strokes in a large, hand-drawn cream-gold font. Main Scene: A cozy magical studio, piled high with scrolls, framed images, glowing code panels, UI cards, potion bottles, drawing tools, and magical icons. In the background, a hazy blue-purple mountain range and fantastical landscape are revealed through an arched opening. The foreground is scattered with parchment, brushes, pens, scrolls, small gourds, beads, and colorful potion-like spheres. Characters: Featuring eight clearly visible Chinese animated fantasy-style cartoon characters: six lively Calabash Brothers children with gourds/leaves on their heads, a white-bearded old master seated on the left, and a tall, elegant figure in a long robe standing on the far right. They are vividly arranged around the title and items. The characters should appear cheerful, excited, and cooperative, with some holding image samples or interface panels. If using privacy-protected placeholders, cover four faces with a soft rectangular blur mask: the old master, a child on the left holding an item, a child in the center holding an image of a bottle, and a tall, robed figure on the right. Item Count: Showing 11 main visible items/panels/images: 1 dark code editor panel with colored codes and a cube icon in the top left corner, 1 Chinese-style document (with plant illustration details) held by a child in the top left corner, 1 animated motion image held by a child in purple in the bottom left corner, 1 workflow item held by a child in the middle left corner, 1 central image item showing a perfume bottle, 1 tablet-style UI mockup held by a smiling child, 1 framed bird photograph held in the lower right corner, 1 dark analytics/dashboard UI panel held by a child on the right, 1 giant vertical fantasy city/night scene illustration behind a child on the right, 1 parchment code scroll floating in the top right corner, and 1 glowing parchment code page spanning the center foreground. Icon Details: Adding 5 glowing square tech badges around the scene: a puzzle icon on the far left, a connection node icon on the left, a small cube icon in the upper left corner, a purple abstract skill icon near the title, and a badge marked in the upper right corner.{argument name="plugin label" default="PLUGIN"} The neon puzzle badge. Add an extra gold star badge on the right, marked as {argument name="skill label" default="SKILL"} Style: Highly detailed digital illustration with a painterly feel, a whimsical Chinese fantasy animation style, warm amber highlights and cool cyan-purple magical glow, a luxurious wooden studio interior, soft depth of field, dramatic rim lighting, golden glints, a clear and legible central title, and a composition as lively and crowded as a GitHub repository banner. Text Constraints: The main title must be displayed accurately as {argument name="headline text" default="GPT Image 2 Skill"} Retain the text on the small badge.{argument name="plugin label" default="PLUGIN"} and{argument name="skill label" default="SKILL"} Any small amount of code or documentation text can be decorative and largely unreadable, but should resemble colored syntax highlighting and design notes. Do not add additional logos, watermarks, or irrelevant brand names.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张细节丰富的奇幻工作室横幅，用于宣传 {argument name="headline text" default="GPT Image 2 Skill"}，展示一套如同由卡通葫芦娃学徒和智慧大师呈现的魔法图像生成工具包。

画布：超宽横向横幅，长宽比约为 2.4:1，电影级构图，温暖的发光奇幻照明，内容丰富且易于阅读。标题位于上方中央，横跨在黑色笔触的墨迹上，采用大型手绘奶油金色字体。

主场景：一个舒适的魔法工作室，堆满了卷轴、带框图像、发光代码面板、UI 卡片、药水瓶、绘图工具和魔法图标。远景中，一个拱形开口处显露出朦胧的蓝紫色山脉和奇幻景观。前景散落着羊皮纸、画笔、钢笔、卷轴、小葫芦、珠子和彩色的药水状球体。

角色：包含 8 个清晰可见的中国动画奇幻风格卡通角色：6 个头顶葫芦/叶子、表情生动的葫芦娃小童，1 位坐在中左侧的白胡子老大师，以及 1 位站在最右侧的高挑优雅长袍人物。将他们生动地安排在标题和项目周围。角色应表现得欢快、兴奋且富有协作精神，其中一些人手持图像示例或界面面板。如果使用隐私保护占位符，请用柔和的矩形模糊遮罩遮盖 4 张脸：老大师、一名手持项目的中左侧儿童、一名手持瓶子图像的中央儿童，以及右侧的高挑长袍人物。

展示项目计数：展示 11 个主要的可见项目/面板/图像：1 个左上角带有彩色代码和立方体图标的深色代码编辑器面板，1 个由儿童手持的左上方中式文档（带有植物插图细节），1 个由紫衣儿童手持的左下方动漫动作图像，1 个由儿童手持的中左侧工作流项目，1 个展示香水瓶的中央图像项目，1 个由微笑儿童手持的平板电脑式 UI 模型，1 个在中右下方手持的带框鸟类摄影图像，1 个由右侧儿童手持的深色分析/仪表盘 UI 面板，1 个在右侧儿童身后的巨型垂直奇幻城市/夜景插图，1 个漂浮在右上角的羊皮纸代码卷轴，以及 1 个横跨在前侧中央前景的发光羊皮纸代码页。

图标细节：在场景周围添加 5 个发光的方形科技徽章：最左侧的拼图图标，左侧的连接节点图标，中左上方的立方体小图标，标题附近的紫色抽象技能图标，以及右上角标记为 {argument name="plugin label" default="PLUGIN"} 的霓虹拼图徽章。在右侧添加一个额外的金色星形徽章，标记为 {argument name="skill label" default="SKILL"}。

风格：绘画感高细节数字插画，奇思妙想的中国奇幻动画风格，温暖的琥珀色高光与冷青紫色魔法光芒，华丽的木质工作室内部，柔和的景深，戏剧性的轮廓光，金色闪光，清晰易读的中央标题，如同 GitHub 仓库宣传横幅般生动拥挤的构图。

文本约束：主标题必须准确显示为 {argument name="headline text" default="GPT Image 2 Skill"}。保留小徽章文字 {argument name="plugin label" default="PLUGIN"} 和 {argument name="skill label" default="SKILL"}。任何微小的代码或文档文本可以是装饰性的且大部分不可读，但应类似于彩色的语法高亮和设计笔记。请勿添加额外的徽标、水印或无关的品牌名称。

templates.title: "Chosen Girl" Champion Poster

titleLocalized.zh: “天选少女”冠军海报

templates.prompt: Create a high-quality, cinematic-quality animated fantasy adventure champion poster, titled "{argument name="headline text" default="The Champion"} The theme revolves around "The Chosen Girl and Her Digital Companion." Using a 2:3 vertical poster canvas, warm beige, gold, cream, and hazy daylight tones create a dramatic backlit effect. Floating digital square particles and rock fragments are incorporated to present a composition reminiscent of a superhero blockbuster. The foreground center features a young East Asian woman, brave yet gentle, wearing a fitted cream-colored floral mini-dress and a soft off-white cardigan. Her dark brown hair is styled in a low, messy bun, with stray strands outlined in a halo of light. Her face should be blurred or left as a customizable blank/softly anonymous area, but her pose is confident: striding forward, one hand outstretched to the viewer, holding a round, metallic Digimon device radiating an electric blue light. Five Digimon companions surround her: 1. A giant crystal dragon occupies the upper background, with silver-white multifaceted scales, long horns, an open mouth roaring, and eyes flashing blue light; 2. A small orange winged creature floats beside her raised hand, with large blue eyes, a cute expression, and bat-like wings; 3. A blue-gray wolf-like reptile is located in the lower left, with a horned head, an open mouth roaring, revealing sharp teeth, and wearing a collar inlaid with blue gems; 4. An orange dinosaur companion is located in the lower left, with large green eyes, roaring happily, and wearing a collar inlaid with blue gems; 5. A white cat/rabbit-like creature is located in the lower right, with blue eyes, purple ear tips, small paws, and wearing a collar inlaid with blue gems. Added dense typography and UI printing details: A small label in the upper left corner reads "DIGIMON CHAMPION EDITION" along with four small circular icons; a prominent black sans-serif title on the left reads "The Champion"; below is the Japanese subtitle "选ばれし絆、未来へ." and the smaller text "心をつなげ、デジタルワールドを守れ."; the badge on the left reads "01" and "DIGITAL WORLD CHAMPION," along with a vertical barcode and a globe icon; the circular coat of arms on the right bears the inscription "DIGITAL WORLD." The design includes the words "CHAMPION," the small print "No. 2025," vertical dotted markings, and the vertical Japanese text "デジタルの絆が、奇記をつくる" (Decade's Bonds ga, Miracles wo Tsukuru); the technical information card in the lower left corner is marked "LEGEND" and "伝説のチャンピオン" (Legendary Champion); the black signature card in the lower right corner is marked "CHAMPION" and "The Chosen One," and includes a barcode. The style should blend anime character design, semi-realistic fantasy rendering, and high-end collectible poster layout, featuring high detail, volumetric lighting, sparks, dust, glassy scales, and clear magazine cover typography.{argument name="character outfit" default="cream floral mini dress and off-white cardigan"} ,{argument name="glowing device color" default="electric blue"} ,{argument name="main dragon style" default="silver-white crystalline horned dragon"} as well as{argument name="poster palette" default="warm beige and gold sunlight"} Avoid including any additional monsters besides the five mentioned above; avoid cluttered titles; and ensure there is no watermark or modern city background.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高质感的电影级动漫奇幻冒险冠军海报，标题为 {argument name="headline text" default="The Champion"}，主题围绕“天选少女与她的数码伙伴”。使用 2:3 竖版海报画布，采用暖米色、金色、奶油色和朦胧日光色调，营造戏剧性的背光效果，加入漂浮的数字方形粒子、岩石碎片，呈现英雄大片的构图。前景中心：一位年轻的东亚女性，勇敢而温柔，身穿修身的奶油色碎花迷你裙和柔软的米白色开衫，棕黑色头发梳成低乱发髻，边缘有光晕勾勒出的散落发丝。她的面部应模糊处理或留作可自定义的空白/柔和匿名区域，但姿态自信：向前迈步，一只手伸向观众，手中拿着一个圆形的金属数码暴龙机，散发着电光蓝色的光芒。在她身后和周围环绕着 5 只数码兽伙伴：1. 一条巨大的水晶龙占据背景上方，银白色多面鳞片，长角，张嘴咆哮，眼睛闪烁蓝光；2. 一只小巧的橙色带翼生物漂浮在她抬起的手旁，有着大大的青色眼睛、可爱的表情和蝙蝠般的翅膀；3. 一只蓝灰色的狼形爬行动物位于左下方，长角头部，张嘴咆哮，露出尖牙，戴着镶有蓝色宝石的项圈；4. 一只橙色恐龙伙伴位于左下角，大大的绿色眼睛，开心地咆哮，戴着镶有蓝色宝石的项圈；5. 一只白色猫/兔状生物位于右下角，蓝色眼睛，紫色耳尖，小爪子，戴着镶有蓝色宝石的项圈。添加密集的排版和 UI 印刷细节：左上角小标签“DIGIMON CHAMPION EDITION”及四个小圆形图标；左侧醒目的黑色无衬线大标题“The Champion”；下方配有日语副标题“選ばれし絆、未来へ。”以及较小的文字“心をつなげ、デジタルワールドを守れ。”；左侧徽章写有“01”和“DIGITAL WORLD CHAMPION”，并配有垂直条形码和地球图标；右侧圆形纹章标有“DIGITAL WORLD CHAMPION”、小字“No.2025”、垂直虚线刻度以及垂直日语文字“デジタルの絆が、奇跡をつくる”；左下角技术说明卡标有“LEGEND”和“伝説のチャンピオン”；右下角黑色签名卡标有“CHAMPION”和“The Chosen One”，并带有条形码条。风格应融合动漫角色设计、半写实奇幻渲染、高级收藏品海报布局，具备高细节、体积光、火花、尘埃、玻璃质感鳞片以及清晰的杂志封面排版。使用 {argument name="character outfit" default="cream floral mini dress and off-white cardigan"}、{argument name="glowing device color" default="electric blue"}、{argument name="main dragon style" default="silver-white crystalline horned dragon"} 以及 {argument name="poster palette" default="warm beige and gold sunlight"}。避免出现除上述 5 只以外的额外怪物，避免标题杂乱，无水印，无现代城市背景。

templates.title: Hotel rooms next to the nostalgic train

titleLocalized.zh: 怀旧列车旁酒店客房

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic vertical wallpaper scene set in a quiet, retro hotel room near a train station, where warm, golden sunlight streams in through a large window. A young East Asian man with tousled black hair, wearing a loose white shirt and dark trousers, sits on the floor, leaning against the messy bed, legs outstretched, gazing thoughtfully out the window; an open book lies on the patterned rug beside him. Outside, a long silver passenger train is seen traveling from left to right across the tracks, with telephone poles, misty hills, and the hazy morning light visible in the distance. The interior features two main pieces of furniture: a messy bed covered in beige, wrinkled sheets on the left, and an old sofa on the right with pillows and draped coats or bags; also includes a low table in the foreground with a dark mug on it, a vintage suitcase on the floor in the lower right corner, a small bedside clock on the left-hand cabinet, a painting on the wall, a tall, narrow vase with dried branches on the windowsill, a small lamp and a water glass to the right of the windowsill, and a beige sheer curtain hanging to the left of the window. Using soft tan and olive brown tones, the design creates a dusty, soft, volumetric lighting, a realistic photographic style, and light shadows, presenting a Wong Kar-wai-esque nostalgic atmosphere. High-detail textures, a 4:5 vertical composition, no visible text, and no watermark. Key customizable details:{argument name="character age" default="young adults"} ,{argument name="character outfit" default="Loose white shirt and dark trousers"} ,{argument name="time of day" default="The golden hour of dawn"} ,{argument name="outside vehicle" default="A long silver passenger train"} ,{argument name="room mood" default="A quiet, nostalgic, and melancholic feeling"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个电影感竖屏壁纸场景，画面位于火车站旁安静的复古酒店客房内，温暖的黄金时刻阳光透过巨大的窗户倾泻而入。一位留着凌乱黑发的东亚年轻男子，身穿宽松的白色衬衫和深色长裤，坐在地板上，背靠着凌乱的床边，双腿伸展，若有所思地望向窗外；一本打开的书放在他手边的花纹地毯上。窗外，展示一列长长的银色客运列车正从左向右驶过轨道，远处可见电线杆、雾气缭绕的山丘和朦胧的晨光。室内包含两件主要家具：左侧是一张铺着米色褶皱床单的凌乱床铺，右侧是一张放有枕头和披着外套或包袋的旧沙发；此外还包括前景的一张矮桌，上面放着一个深色马克杯，右下角地板上有一个复古手提箱，左侧柜子上有一个小床头钟，墙上挂着一幅画，窗台上有一个插着干枯树枝的高窄花瓶，窗台右侧有一盏小台灯，一个水杯，以及挂在窗户左侧的米色薄纱窗帘。使用柔和的棕褐色和橄榄棕色调，营造尘埃感、柔和的体积光、写实摄影风格、浅阴影，呈现王家卫风格的怀旧氛围，高细节纹理，4:5 竖屏构图，无可见文字，无水印。关键可自定义细节：{argument name="character age" default="年轻成年人"}, {argument name="character outfit" default="宽松白色衬衫和深色长裤"}, {argument name="time of day" default="黄金时刻的清晨"}, {argument name="outside vehicle" default="一列长长的银色客运列车"}, {argument name="room mood" default="安静的怀旧忧郁感"}。

templates.title: Pixel-art bathing scene under the moonlight

titleLocalized.zh: 月光下的像素风沐浴场景

templates.prompt: Create a high-quality pixel-art anime illustration depicting a young woman relaxing in a bathtub at night. She keeps {argument name="hair color" default="Deep Navy Blue"} Her shoulder-length, tousled bob haircut, with long strands and bangs damp, clung slightly to her cheeks and neck. Her eyes were closed, her expression calm and serene, her head slightly tilted back, one hand raised behind her head as if combing her wet hair. Only her head, neck, bare shoulders, upper arms, and upper chest mostly obscured by opaque bathwater and foam were shown; the imagery was kept elegant, avoiding explicit content. The scene was set in a cozy tiled bathroom, the walls covered in light gray-green tiles. To the left was a large window with a dark frame, offering a view of the moonlit night sky and the green trees outside, their reflections softly mirrored in the glass. On the counter to the right rear, two bath bottles were placed: a tall blue pump bottle and a shorter pink rectangular bottle. The bathwater was a soft turquoise color, with shimmering highlights, tiny ripples, and scattered white foam around the edges. Employing a nostalgic 16-bit/32-bit pixel art style, the artwork features distinct square pixels, a soft jitter effect, a limited color palette, subtle floodlighting, and a blend of warm indoor light and cool-toned moonlight. The composition is a close-up half-length portrait centered on a woman, on a 4:3 horizontal canvas, creating an intimate and tranquil atmosphere. There is no text, no watermark, and no superfluous figures.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅高质量的像素风动漫插画，描绘一位年轻女性在夜晚的浴缸中放松。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深海军蓝"} 的齐肩凌乱波波头，长发丝和刘海被打湿，微微贴在脸颊和脖颈上。她双眼紧闭，表情平静安详，头部微微上扬，一只手抬起放在脑后，仿佛正在梳理湿发。仅展示她的头部、颈部、裸露的肩膀、上臂以及大部分被不透明浴水和泡沫遮住的上胸部；保持画面高雅，避免露骨内容。场景设定为一个舒适的瓷砖浴室，墙面贴着浅灰绿色的瓷砖，左侧有一扇深色边框的大窗户，可以看到月光下的夜空和窗外的绿叶树木，玻璃上有柔和的倒影。在右后方的台面上，放置 2 个洗浴瓶：一个高大的蓝色泵头瓶和一个较矮的粉色长方形瓶。浴缸里的水呈柔和的绿松石色，带有闪烁的高光、细小的涟漪以及边缘散落的白色泡沫。采用怀旧的 16-bit / 32-bit 像素艺术风格，具有明显的方形像素、柔和的抖动效果、有限的调色板、轻微的泛光照明，以及室内暖光与冷色调月光的交融。构图为以女性为中心的近景半身像，4:3 横向画布，营造出亲密宁静的氛围，无文字，无水印，无多余角色。

templates.title: Japanese AI Workflow Notebook Infographic

titleLocalized.zh: 日系 AI 工作流笔记本信息图

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a square, Japanese-style hand-drawn notebook infographic about transforming AI from a chat partner into an operations/work assistant, featuring a cute anime mascot at the bottom. Canvas: 1:1 square image, cream-colored lined notebook paper background, rounded corners, blue border, visible metal spiral binding on the left, soft grid paper tape decoration in the upper left corner, accented with blue/yellow brushstrokes. Overall style should be simple, friendly, handwritten, and similar to shorthand. Text content: Use Japanese handwritten font. Page number in the upper left corner: "4/4". Main title within a blue-bordered banner:{argument name="main title" default="Connecting to practical work"} The subtitle below reads: "Manus / Codex / Claude Code / Newsletter". The tag within the dotted rounded rectangle in the center of the page reads: "自分のワークフローへ". The large core information in the lower left corner reads: "AIはチャット相手から", with extra-large, bold, dark blue text above it.{argument name="main message" default="To the person in charge of the work"} The speech bubble to the right of the character:{argument name="speech bubble text" default="Make it a daily routine"} Layout: The top third contains three horizontally arranged interconnected workflow cards, each with a numbered blue circle and a rounded blue outline. Card 1, labeled "Manusで収集" (Manusで収集), displays a magnifying glass, document, and cloud icons. Card 2, labeled "Codex/Claude Codeで整理" (Codex/Claude Codeで整理), displays a clipboard list, arrows, folders, and a small hierarchy diagram. Card 3, labeled "ニュースレターで発信" (Newsletterで発信), displays an envelope with a paper and heart-shaped pattern. Thick blue downward arrows are added between the cards, and another blue arrow points downwards from the middle card to the dotted workflow label. Bottom half: The left side contains three action bars with circular blue icons and Japanese labels: 1) Magnifying glass icon with "調べる" (to arrange), 2) Folder icon with "整える" (to organize), 3) Envelope icon with "発信する" (to send letters). Add underlines or highlights to each label using light yellow marker strokes and dashed guide lines. Character details: A cute anime cat-eared mascot is positioned in the center of the bottom right corner. She is depicted above her knees, with long, light pink hair, white cat ears, and a pink cat tail curling to the right. A gold hair clip bears the word "ME." She wears a loose blue hoodie and a dark skirt, and holds a clipboard with three checked checkboxes. The face area is intentionally obscured with a simple beige rectangle to indicate anonymity. For customization, please use [contact information].{argument name="character hair color" default="pastel pink"} hair color and{argument name="hoodie color" default="blue"} Hoodie. Visual style: Blue ink line drawing, complemented by bold dark blue font, pale yellow highlights, soft sky blue doodle fill, and small sparkles, hearts, and radiating emphasis lines. Adopting a cheerful educational communication aesthetic, blending hand-drawn projector pages with cute anime illustrations. Keep text clear and legible, with balanced spacing, avoiding a realistic style. Constraints: Includes 3 workflow cards and 3 action bars. Except for the subheading line, no additional panels, numbered steps, watermarks, logos, or English translations may be added to the image.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张正方形、日系手绘笔记本风格的信息图，主题是将 AI 从聊天伙伴转变为运营/工作助手，底部配有一个可爱的动漫吉祥物。

画布：1:1 正方形图像，奶油色横线笔记本纸背景，圆角设计，蓝色边框线，左侧可见金属螺旋装订，左上角有柔和的方格纸胶带装饰，并带有蓝色/黄色笔触点缀。整体风格应简洁、亲切、手写且类似速记笔记。

文字内容：使用日文手写字体。左上角页码：“4/4”。蓝色边框横幅内的主标题：{argument name="main title" default="実務への接続"}。下方副标题：“Manus / Codex / Claude Code / Newsletter”。页面中部虚线圆角矩形内的标签：“自分のワークフローへ”。左下角的大型核心信息：“AIはチャット相手から”，上方是超大号加粗深蓝色文字 {argument name="main message" default="作業担当へ"}。角色右侧的对话气泡：{argument name="speech bubble text" default="毎日の型にする"}。

布局：顶部三分之一处包含 3 张横向排列的互连工作流卡片，每张卡片带有编号的蓝色圆圈和圆角蓝色轮廓。卡片 1 标注为“Manusで収集”，显示放大镜、文档和云图标。卡片 2 标注为“Codex/Claude Codeで整理”，显示剪贴板清单、箭头、文件夹和小型层级图。卡片 3 标注为“ニュースレターで発信”，显示带有纸张和小心形图案的信封。在卡片之间添加粗蓝色向下箭头，并从中间卡片向下添加另一个蓝色箭头指向虚线工作流标签。

下半部分：左侧放置 3 行动作栏，带有圆形蓝色图标和日文标签：1) 放大镜图标配“調べる”，2) 文件夹图标配“整える”，3) 信封图标配“発信する”。用淡黄色记号笔笔触和虚线引导线为每个标签添加下划线或高亮。

角色细节：右下角中心位置设有一位可爱的动漫猫耳娘吉祥物，膝盖以上构图，留着长长的淡粉色头发，戴着白色猫耳，粉色猫尾向右卷曲，金色发夹上写着“ME”。她穿着宽松的蓝色连帽衫和深色短裙，拿着一个带有 3 个已勾选复选框的剪贴板。面部区域特意用简单的米色矩形遮盖，以示匿名。如需自定义，请使用 {argument name="character hair color" default="pastel pink"} 发色和 {argument name="hoodie color" default="blue"} 连帽衫。

视觉风格：蓝色墨水线条画，辅以深蓝色加粗字体、淡黄色高亮、柔和的天蓝色涂鸦填充，以及小火花、爱心和放射状强调线。采用欢快的教育通讯美学，融合手绘计划本页面与可爱动漫插画风格。保持文字清晰易读，间距平衡，避免写实风格。

约束条件：包含 3 张工作流卡片和 3 行动作栏。除副标题行外，图像中不得添加额外的面板、额外的编号步骤、水印、Logo 或英文翻译。

templates.title: Anime-style sky battle illustrations

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫风格天空战斗插画

templates.prompt: Create a 16:9 widescreen, cinematic anime-style fantasy sci-fi battle illustration. The image must accurately depict two characters facing off in a sky filled with floating landmasses: in the left foreground {argument name="heroine" default="A silver-haired female knight"} She lunges forward sideways, her expression resolute, her long, high ponytail billowing behind her. She wears magnificent white, blue, and gold plate armor, a flowing royal blue cloak, and grips a massive, electric blue energy sword, leaving trails of light and sparks in the lower half of the image. In the upper right foreground {argument name="rival" default="A black-haired male villain"} Confidently standing atop a sleek, futuristic black attack helicopter, dressed in a dark suit-style outfit, facing the heroine from afar. The scene features a black, angular attack helicopter with a sharp nose, mechanical panels, circular engine details, and a large, forward-mounted cannon pointed at the heroine. The environment is a dramatic high-altitude or fragmented dimension, with 18 visible floating rock islands and debris scattered throughout the depths, from a massive central jagged slab of stone to smaller fragments in the distance. The left side of the scene should radiate cool-toned blue magical energy, while the right side is eroded by magenta lightning and dark nebula-like cracks, creating a strong red-blue contrast. Utilizing dynamic diagonal composition, extreme perspective, wind trails, luminous particles, delicate clouds, painterly anime-style rendering, crisp lines, high saturation, and dramatic lighting, it presents the texture of an epic novel cover. No text, no watermark, no border.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅 16:9 宽画幅的电影级动漫风格奇幻科幻战斗插画。画面中需精确展示 2 个角色，在充满浮空陆地的天空中对峙：左侧前景中，{argument name="heroine" default="一位银发女骑士"} 侧身向前突刺，表情坚定，长长的高马尾在身后飘动，身着华丽的白、蓝、金三色板甲，披着飘逸的宝蓝色斗篷，紧握一把闪烁着电光蓝色的巨大能量剑，在画面下半部分留下光影与火花轨迹。右侧上方前景中，{argument name="rival" default="一位黑发男性反派"} 自信地站在一架流线型黑色未来感武装直升机顶部，身着深色西装风格服装，从远处面对女英雄。包含 1 架黑色棱角分明的武装直升机，具有尖锐的机头、机械面板、圆形引擎细节以及指向女英雄的大型前置加农炮。环境为戏剧性的高空或破碎维度，深度空间中散布着 18 个可见的浮空岩石岛屿和碎片，从中心巨大的锯齿状石板到远处的细小碎片。场景左侧应散发冷色调的蓝色魔法能量，而右侧则被洋红色闪电和类似暗星云的裂纹所侵蚀，营造出强烈的红蓝对比。采用动态对角线构图、极端透视、风动轨迹、发光粒子、细腻云层、绘画感动漫渲染、清晰的线条、高饱和度、戏剧性光影，呈现史诗级小说封面的质感。无文字，无水印，无边框。

templates.title: High-density animation AI era poster

titleLocalized.zh: 高密度动漫 AI 时代海报

templates.prompt: Objective: To create an extremely high-density Japanese anime-style promotional collage poster, with the theme of {argument name="topic" default="In the current AI era, GPT-image2 and 5.5 Thinking are at the core."} This showcases how AI tools are transforming daily life, work, research, creativity, social media, and learning. The canvas is a 4:3 landscape poster, 1024×768 pixels, filled with a futuristic magazine-like feel. It employs a high-contrast comic book design, featuring diagonal speed lines, glowing blue UI panels, white speech bubbles, bold black outlines, neon cyan highlights, red accent text, and a highly dynamic perspective. No blank spaces are left. The layout features a massive central headline surrounded by a chaotic yet legible collage of smaller panels. It includes 16 clearly defined content areas: a large welcome headline in the top left corner, a central main banner, a central crowd/workspace scene, a code support panel, an image generation gallery panel, a video generation panel, a tool war vertical banner, an AI agent automation checklist, a music AI waveform panel, a debate/legal ceiling panel, a startup meeting panel, a researcher evolution panel, a social media trending bar, and three bottom everyday life support cards. Main text: The title in the upper left corner should be{argument name="welcome headline" default="Welcome to the AI ​​era!!"} The central slogan should be:{argument name="central slogan" default="With AI, we can be more creative, more free, and more prosperous!!"} Add an explosion effect text at the top center.{argument name="evolution headline" default="Evolution is happening every day!!"} Add a vertical banner on the right with the text "..."{argument name="tool banner" default="The Warring States Period of Tool Racing!! The speed of evolution is insane!!"} Add the final declaration in the bottom right corner.{argument name="final slogan" default="Competition, cooperation, learning, play—all of it combined—this is the current state of AI!!"} Surrounded by numerous Japanese-style subheadings, exclamation bubble, labels, arrows, badges, and UI tags; they should look realistic but can be very small and partially blurred. Main details: The central scene showcases a crowded, modern co-working hallway crammed with excited young anime creators, office workers, students, researchers, and entrepreneurs using laptops, tablets, holographic screens, phones, and AI dashboards. Many faces should be deliberately anonymized with soft, square blur masks, but hairstyles, poses, clothing, and devices remain visible. Add several adorable white and blue robot mascots with black oval faces and glowing cyan eyes; there are four robots in total: a large robot in the top left corner, a small robot next to the automation checklist, a miniature robot in the social media bar, and a small robot in the senior support card. Panel details and precisely counted elements: The image generation panel contains a large fantasy castle preview and five thumbnail variations below. The video generation panel contains a large cyberpunk anime girl preview and six small thumbnails below. The AI ​​Agent panel includes five checkmarked list items, suggesting research, data analysis, document creation, email sending, and scheduling. The Music AI panel features a large musical note icon, a waveform display, and four playback controls. The Debate/Law panel includes a scale icon and two debate figures. The Social Media area features three indicator badges with heart, retweet, and comment icons, displaying large numbers like 12.8K, 5.6K, and 3.2K, along with floating hearts and stars. The bottom bar includes four daily life support cards: Translation/Travel Chat, AI Learning Support, Health Management Support, and Senior Monitoring/Consultation. Visual Style: A combination of refined anime illustrations with UI mockups, infographics, and comic book advertising aesthetics. Saturated electric blue, black, and white are used, accented with red, yellow bulb highlights, and glossy screen reflections. The font should be a bold Japanese display font with a thick outline, shadow, and slanted dynamic emphasis. Add motion stripes, comic book explosion effects, arrows, stickers, holographic overlays, browser windows, code snippets, waveforms, data charts, smartphone screens, notification icons, and social media UI. Constraints: Keep the poster information extremely dense and dynamic. Use Japanese typography throughout the design, but prioritize five designated title texts. Ensure the anime characters are clearly styled and vary in age and profession. Maintain a celebratory and optimistic tone regarding the theme of AI integrating into daily life. Do not include real brand logos or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张极其高密度的日式动漫风格宣传拼贴海报，主题为 {argument name="topic" default="当前的 AI 时代，以 GPT-image2 和 5.5 Thinking 为核心"}，展示 AI 工具如何改变日常生活、工作、研究、创意、社交媒体和学习。

画布：4:3 横向海报，1024×768 质感，像未来主义杂志内页一样填满每一个角落。采用高对比度的漫画广告设计，包含对角线速度线、发光的蓝色 UI 面板、白色对话气泡、粗黑轮廓、霓虹青色高光、红色强调文字以及极具张力的透视效果。不留任何空白。

布局：构建一个巨大的中央标题，周围环绕着混乱但易读的拼贴式小面板。包含 16 个明确的内容区域：1 个左上角巨大的欢迎标题，1 个中央主标语，1 个中央人群/工作空间场景，1 个代码支持面板，1 个图像生成画廊面板，1 个视频生成面板，1 个工具战争垂直横幅，1 个 AI Agent 自动化清单，1 个音乐 AI 波形面板，1 个辩论/法律天平面板，1 个创业会议面板，1 个研究员进化面板，1 个社交媒体热点条，以及 3 张底部日常生活支持卡片。

主要文字：左上角标题应为 {argument name="welcome headline" default="ようこそ! AI時代へ!!"}。中央标语应为 {argument name="central slogan" default="AIで、もっと創造的に、もっと自由に、もっと豊かに!!"}。在顶部中央添加一个爆炸效果文字 {argument name="evolution headline" default="進化が、毎日起きている!!"}。在右侧添加一个垂直横幅，文字为 {argument name="tool banner" default="ツール戦国時代!! 進化のスピードがエグい!!"}。在右下角添加最终宣言 {argument name="final slogan" default="競争も、協力も、学びも、遊びも──全部ひっくるめて、これがAIの今だ!!"}。周围环绕大量日式小标题、感叹号气泡、标签、箭头、徽章和 UI 标签；它们应看起来真实，但可以非常微小且部分模糊。

主体细节：中央场景展示了一个拥挤的现代联合办公大厅，里面挤满了兴奋的年轻动漫创作者、上班族、学生、研究人员和创业者，他们正在使用笔记本电脑、平板电脑、全息屏幕、手机和 AI 仪表盘。许多人脸应刻意用柔和的方形模糊遮罩进行匿名化处理，但发型、姿势、服装和设备保持可见。添加多个可爱的白蓝色机器人吉祥物，它们拥有黑色椭圆形脸和发光的青色眼睛；共包含 4 个机器人：左上角一个大机器人，自动化清单旁一个小机器人，社交媒体条中一个微型机器人，以及老年人支持卡片中一个小机器人。

面板细节与精确计数元素：图像生成面板包含 1 个大型奇幻城堡预览和下方 5 个缩略图变体。视频生成面板包含 1 个大型赛博朋克动漫女孩预览和下方 6 个小缩略图。AI Agent 面板包含 5 个带有勾选标记的清单项，暗示研究、数据分析、文档创建、邮件发送和日程安排。音乐 AI 面板包含 1 个大型音符图标、1 个波形显示和 4 个播放控件。辩论/法律面板包含 1 个天平图标和 2 个辩论人物。社交媒体区域包含 3 个带有心形、转发和评论图标的指标徽章，显示 12.8K、5.6K 和 3.2K 等大数字，以及漂浮的心形和星星。底部条包含 4 张日常生活支持卡片：翻译/旅行聊天、AI 学习支持、健康管理支持和老年人监控/咨询。

视觉风格：精致的动漫插画与 UI 模型、信息图表和漫画广告美学的结合。使用饱和的电光蓝、黑、白，搭配红色点缀、黄色灯泡高光和光泽屏幕反射。字体应为带有粗轮廓、投影和倾斜动态强调的粗体日文展示字体。添加运动条纹、漫画爆炸效果、箭头、贴纸、全息叠加层、浏览器窗口、代码片段、波形图、数据图表、智能手机屏幕、通知图标和社交媒体 UI。

约束：保持海报信息极其密集且充满活力。在整个设计中使用日文排版，但优先考虑五个指定的标题文本。确保动漫角色风格清晰，年龄和职业各异。保持对 AI 融入日常生活这一主题的庆祝和乐观基调。不要包含真实的品牌 Logo 或水印。

templates.title: Toyohashi City Tourism Anime Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 丰桥市旅游动漫海报

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="city name" default="Toyohashi City"} Create a high-resolution promotional poster for Japan tourism, combining engaging anime-style travel illustrations with a dense collage of local attractions, food, and landmarks. Canvas: Vertical poster, 4:5 aspect ratio, bright cinematic daylight, ultra-detailed 2K texture. Use saturated blue skies and white clouds, and a warm golden sunset. The composition should have the feel of an official municipal promotional poster—refined and informative. Main visual: The center of the image features a beautiful anime-style girl, shown from behind and in profile, standing on a city observation deck. She has long {argument name="hair color" default="Dark blue"} Her hair, flowing in the wind, is adorned with delicate hair accessories, and she wears a white short-sleeved shirt and a light blue skirt. She carries a cream-colored canvas bag printed with "TOYOHASHI" and blue urban line art. Her face should be softly obscured or turned to one side, focusing the poster's attention on the location and atmosphere. Add a schoolgirl-like figure in the midground, gazing at the city from behind, to enhance the nostalgic and travel-oriented feel. Top Title: The large title, "住みたくなるまち、豊橋市" (I live in Toyohashi City), is written in elegant white Japanese calligraphy at the top left. A smaller, handwritten subtitle, "今日も、明日も、このまちが好きになる" (I like this place, I like tomorrow too), is added next to it. Use a strong shadow effect to ensure the text is clearly visible against the sky background. Right Sidebar: Create a cream-colored, rounded-corner vertical panel titled "豊橋市の魅力10选" (Top 10 Charms of Toyohashi City). The panel must contain 10 numbered attraction cards, each with a small thumbnail resembling a photograph and a Japanese label: 1. "Nonhoi Park" (非帆公园), with an image of an elephant/giraffe zoo; 2. "Ten-tung Fireworks" (手筒花火), with an image of handheld fireworks; 3. "Streetcar" (路電車), with an image of a streetcar; 4. "Toyohashi Curry Udon" (豊橋カレーうどん), with an image of a curry udon bowl; 5. "Pilgrimage to the 'Too Many Noble Female Leads!'" (『負けヒロインが多すぎる！』聖地訩 ... 8. "Reed Wetlands" (覦毛湿原), featuring wetland greenery. 9. "Block Sander" (ブラックサンダー), featuring a close-up of a chocolate bar. 10. "Yamasa Chikuwa" (ヤマサちくわ), featuring chikuwa fish cake. 11. "Uzura Egg" (うずら卵), featuring a quail egg image collage. The poster should integrate 10 main scenic/food elements: a zoo scene with giraffes and elephants on the left, a brick windmill and flower field in the upper right background, a handheld firework in the lower left, a red and white streetcar marked "3203", a large bowl of Toyohashi curry udon noodles, a bag of Thor chocolate, Yamasa chikuwa, a small bowl of quail eggs, a river/canal landscape with bridges and birds, and lush flowers in the foreground. Add small vertical Japanese tags near some of the collage elements, such as "のんほいパーク", "Handgun Fireworks", "Street Tram", "豊 bridge カレーうどん", "ヤマサちくわ" and "うずらEG". Text in the lower middle: Add a small sign near the observation deck that reads "豊 bridge へようこそ". Add a vertical poetic phrase near the windmill/flower bush: "花もemptyももここにある.". The bottom features white and yellow promotional text: "A natural paradise, a convenient haven, a person you can be." followed by a larger closing phrase, "Sore ga, Toyohashi.", with "Toyohashi" emphasized in yellow. Footer: The bottom right corner should display a white, rounded municipal sign block containing a simple blue badge and the text "Toyohashi City" along with small Roman letters "TOYOHASHI CITY." Visual Style: A combination of high-quality anime illustrations and realistic travel poster collages, soft depth of field, painterly details, shimmering particles and petals floating in the air, glossy food illustrations, clear and legible Japanese fonts, a warm and inspiring atmosphere, no blank areas, no watermarks, and no other figures besides the two people depicted.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="city name" default="丰桥市"} 创作一张高分辨率的日本旅游宣传海报，将富有感染力的动漫旅行插画与当地景点、美食和地标的密集拼贴相结合。

画布：竖版海报，4:5 长宽比，明亮的电影感日光，超细腻的 2K 质感。使用饱和的蓝天白云和温暖的金色夕阳。构图应呈现出官方市政宣传海报的质感，精致且信息丰富。

主视觉：画面中心为一位美丽的动漫风格少女，背影及侧脸出镜，站在城市观景台上。她留着长长的 {argument name="hair color" default="深蓝色"} 秀发，在风中飘逸，佩戴精致的发饰，身穿白色短袖衬衫和浅蓝色裙子。她背着一个奶油色的帆布袋，上面印有“TOYOHASHI”字样和蓝色的城市线条艺术。她的面部应柔和地遮挡或转向一侧，使海报重心聚焦于地点和氛围。在中景处增加一个类似女学生的背影，眺望着城市，增强怀旧感与旅行氛围。

顶部标题：左上方使用优雅的白色日式书法字体书写大标题：「住みたくなるまち、豊橋市」。旁边添加较小的手写体副标题：「今日も、明日も、このまちが好きになる」。使用强烈的投影效果，确保文字在天空背景下清晰可见。

右侧边栏：创建一个奶油色的圆角竖向面板，标题为「豊橋市の魅力10選」。面板内必须包含 10 个带编号的景点卡片，每项均配有类似照片的小缩略图和日语标签：
1. 「のんほいパーク」（非帆公园），配有大象/长颈鹿动物园图像
2. 「手筒花火」（手筒烟花），配有手持烟花火花图像
3. 「路面電車」（路面电车），配有电车图像
4. 「豊橋カレーうどん」（丰桥咖喱乌冬面），配有咖喱乌冬面碗图像
5. 「『負けヒロインが多すぎる！』聖地巡礼」（《败犬女主太多了！》圣地巡礼），配有海边或上学路场景
6. 「花のまち豊橋」（花之城丰桥），配有色彩缤纷的花卉
7. 「葦毛湿原」（苇毛湿原），配有湿地绿植
8. 「ブラックサンダー」（雷神巧克力），配有巧克力棒特写
9. 「ヤマサちくわ」（山佐竹轮），配有竹轮鱼糕
10. 「うずら卵」（鹌鹑蛋），配有鹌鹑蛋图像

拼贴元素：海报周围需整合 10 个主要的景点/美食元素：左侧为长颈鹿和大象的动物园场景，右上背景为砖砌风车和花田，左下为手持烟花，一辆标有“3203”的红白相间路面电车，一大碗丰桥咖喱乌冬面，一包雷神巧克力，山佐竹轮，一小碗鹌鹑蛋，带有桥梁和飞鸟的河流/运河景观，以及前景中繁茂的花朵。在部分拼贴元素附近添加小的竖向日语标签，如「のんほいパーク」、「手筒花火」、「路面電車」、「豊橋カレーうどん」、「ヤマサちくわ」和「うずら卵」。

中下部文字：在观景台附近添加一个小标牌，写着「豊橋へようこそ」。在风车/花丛附近添加竖向的诗意短句：「花も 空も 未来も ここにある。」。底部放置白色和黄色的宣传文案：「豊かな自然、便利な暮らし、あなたらしい人。」，随后是一行较大的结束语「それが、豊橋。」，其中“豊橋”以黄色强调。

页脚：右下角应展示一个白色的圆角市政标志块，包含简单的蓝色徽章和文字「豊橋市」以及小号罗马字母“TOYOHASHI CITY”。

视觉风格：高级动漫插画与写实旅游海报拼贴相结合，柔和的景深，绘画般的细节，空气中飘浮着闪烁的微粒和花瓣，光泽感的美食插画，清晰易读的日文字体，温暖且鼓舞人心的氛围，无空白区域，无水印，除描述的两人外无其他人物。

templates.title: Anime-style hardware store employees

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫风格五金店员工

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed anime-style illustration, with the main character being {argument name="character name" default="A young female employee"} She stood in the crowded central aisle of a Japanese hardware store, surrounded by tall shelves overflowing with packaged hand tools, pliers, wrenches, drill bits, power tools, price tags, and brightly colored Japanese product labels. She had long, wavy hair {argument name="hair color" default="gold"} Her hair was styled in pigtails, each tied with two large lavender-colored bows. She wore a dress with ruffles.{argument name="dress color" default="lavender"} The Victorian Lolita-style work dress features six striking details: puff sleeves, a lace-trimmed neckline, a large bow at the neck, a buttoned vertical lace panel, a cinched waist, and a multi-layered ruffled skirt. Her face is completely covered by a warm-toned, solid-colored square hood, obscuring all facial features. She holds two cordless drills: a bluish-green drill slightly tilted downwards towards the viewer in her left hand, and a red drill tilted to the side in her right, both equipped with black battery packs and metal chucks. The background should depict two deep tool aisles extending to the left and right, with shelves densely packed with blister packs and signage, including blue and red Japanese DIY/tool ​​tags, creating a bustling retail atmosphere. Warm overhead fluorescent lighting, shallow depth of field, cinematic perspective, glossy reflections from plastic packaging, soft golden contour lighting on the hair, intricate lines, painterly shadows, and a refined GPT-image-2 anime illustration texture are employed. The composition remains square, using a half-body to thigh-high framing method, with the character centered, presenting a dynamic, cute, and hardworking atmosphere. No other characters are included in the image, and there is no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高度精细的动漫风格插画，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="一位年轻的女员工"}，她站在日本五金店拥挤的中央过道中，周围是摆满包装好的手动工具、钳子、扳手、钻头、电动工具、价格标签和色彩鲜艳的日本商品标识的高大货架。她留着长长的波浪形 {argument name="hair color" default="金色"} 头发，扎成双马尾，并系着 2 个巨大的薰衣草色蝴蝶结。她穿着一件带有荷叶边的 {argument name="dress color" default="薰衣草色"} 维多利亚洛丽塔风格工作裙，裙装包含 6 个显著细节：泡泡袖、蕾丝饰边领口、颈部大蝴蝶结、带纽扣的垂直蕾丝镶板、收腰腰带以及多层荷叶边裙摆。她的脸部被一个暖肤色的纯色正方形遮挡块完全覆盖，没有任何面部特征可见。她手中拿着 2 把无绳电钻：左手拿着一把略微向下倾斜指向观众的青蓝色电钻，右手拿着一把向侧面倾斜的红色电钻，两把电钻均带有黑色电池组和金属钻夹头。背景应展示 2 条向左右两侧延伸的深邃工具过道，货架上挂满了密集的吸塑包装和标识，包括蓝色和红色的日式 DIY/工具标签，营造出繁忙的零售氛围。使用温暖的头顶荧光照明、浅景深、电影级视角、塑料包装上的光泽反射、头发上柔和的金色轮廓光、复杂的线条、绘画般的阴影，以及精致的 GPT-image-2 动漫插画质感。保持构图为正方形，采用半身至大腿的取景方式，角色居中，呈现出动感、可爱且勤劳的氛围，画面中不包含其他角色，且无水印。

templates.title: Luxury Pink Chocolate Gift Box

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华粉色巧克力礼盒

templates.prompt: for{argument name="character name" default="Hana na chan"} Create a luxurious product photo of a limited-edition pale pink chocolate gift box. Set the scene on a lace-covered tabletop, using a dreamy, romantic flat or tilted close-up perspective, complemented by soft, warm studio lighting, shallow depth of field, pearl and satin embellishments, and elegant rose gold and blush pink tones. Showcase an open rectangular chocolate gift box: the lid occupies the upper half, printed with a high-end commemorative packaging style, featuring delicate gold borders, delicate cherry blossom clusters in the corners, and a large portrait-style photograph of a lovely young girl with a light blonde bob, wearing a pink flower hair clip, a white blouse with delicate pink floral embroidery and a lace collar, paired with black suspenders, one hand raised in a peace sign; a simple semi-transparent square mosaic covers her face. On the lid, add delicate gold lettering: “花奈ちゃん” (Hana-chan), a small flower mark, “HANA NA CHAN”, “ÉDITION LIMITÉE”, and “CHOCOLAT DE RÊVE”. A large satin bow, adorned with dangling gold beads and small flower decorations, is added to the upper right corner of the box lid. The lower half of the gift box contains a total of 10 chocolates, arranged in a 2x5 grid within a glossy gold compartment. Each chocolate is placed in a dark brown crepe paper cup: No. 1 is a pink flower-shaped chocolate with a gold center; No. 2 is a faceted ruby ​​pink heart-shaped chocolate; No. 3 is a cream-colored round striped chocolate topped with small pink flowers; No. 4 is a pink rose swirl chocolate; No. 5 is a dark round chocolate sprinkled with fine gold glitter; No. 6 is a square milk chocolate engraved with floral line art; No. 7 is a round pink striped chocolate with white drizzle and tiny sugar beads; No. 8 is a faceted blush pink dome chocolate; No. 9 is a square dark chocolate engraved with gold bees or floral patterns; and No. 10 is a pale pink heart-shaped chocolate with a pearly sheen. The gift box is decorated with soft props: lace fabric, pale pink petals, a cream-colored gift card with "Hana na chan" written in cursive script and Japanese decorative lettering in the lower left corner, a vintage gold mirror edge, pearls, and a pink ribbon. The overall style should present the quality of a high-end Japanese cute chocolate advertisement, photorealistic but with a slightly dreamy filter, clear packaging details, an embossed texture, metallic gold embellishments, and delicate flowers, and no extra chocolates or unnecessary text beyond the specified text.

promptLocalized.zh: 为 {argument name="character name" default="Hana na chan"} 创建一张奢华的淡粉色限量版巧克力礼盒产品照。场景设定为铺着蕾丝的桌面上，采用梦幻浪漫的平铺或倾斜特写视角，配以柔和温暖的摄影棚灯光、浅景深、珍珠和缎面装饰，以及优雅的玫瑰金与腮红粉色调。展示一个打开的长方形巧克力礼盒：上盖占据上半部分，印有高级纪念品包装风格，带有精致的金色细边框、角落处点缀着细腻的樱花簇，以及一张大尺寸的人像风格照片，照片中是一位可爱的年轻女孩，留着浅金色短波波头，戴着粉色花朵发夹，身穿带有细小粉色花卉刺绣和蕾丝领口的白色衬衫，搭配黑色背带，一只手举起比出剪刀手；在脸部位置覆盖一个简单的半透明方形马赛克。在盒盖上，加入精致的金色字体，写着“花奈ちゃん”、一个小花朵标记、“HANA NA CHAN”、“ÉDITION LIMITÉE”和“CHOCOLAT DE RÊVE”。在盒盖右上角添加一个巨大的缎面蝴蝶结，配有悬垂的金色珠饰和小花装饰。礼盒下半部分包含整整 10 颗巧克力，以 2x5 的网格排列在光亮的金色隔层内，每颗巧克力放置在深棕色的褶皱纸托中：1 号为带金色花心的粉色花朵形巧克力，2 号为切面红宝石粉色心形宝石巧克力，3 号为顶部点缀小粉花的奶油色圆形条纹巧克力，4 号为粉色玫瑰漩涡巧克力，5 号为撒有细金粉的深色圆形巧克力，6 号为刻有花卉线条艺术的方形牛奶巧克力，7 号为带有白色淋酱和细小糖珠的圆形粉色条纹巧克力，8 号为切面腮红粉色圆顶巧克力，9 号为刻有金色蜜蜂或花卉图案的方形黑巧克力，10 号为带有珍珠光泽的淡粉色心形巧克力。礼盒周围布置柔和的道具：蕾丝面料、淡粉色花瓣、左下角一张写有草书“Hana na chan”和日式装饰文字的奶油色礼品卡、复古金镜边缘、珍珠和粉色丝带。整体风格应呈现高端日式可爱风巧克力广告质感，照片级真实但略带梦幻滤镜，包装细节清晰，具有浮雕质感、金属金色点缀和细腻花卉，除指定的文字外，不包含额外的巧克力或多余文字。

templates.prompt: Create a sophisticated anime-style sci-fi factory scene, located in [location missing].{argument name="company name" default="Union Grotti"} A spacious, high-tech electronics manufacturing laboratory in operation. The main body is {argument name="character name" default="Angelica"} A lovely iridescent holographic girl stands slightly to the right in the foreground, holding a clipboard in one hand and a stylus in the other, carefully inspecting the manufacturing process. Her face is deliberately obscured by a vertical beige rectangle, but her short bob haircut is visible: shimmering with a soft rainbow sheen, glossy and adorned with a small blue winged hair clip, and a tuft of hair sticking up on top. She wears a semi-transparent, pearlescent white and blue short-sleeved dress with a large blue bow at the neckline, buttons down the front, puff sleeves, blue piping, and a layered ruffled skirt that reflects cyan, pink, and purple light. To the left, a large automated robotic assembly machine is on display, in production.{argument name="manufactured item" default="General-purpose controller SoC project"} Two articulated robotic arms with precision welding heads point downwards at a complex circuit board, producing tiny, bright sparks at the central chip. Above the project is a heavy industrial machine head with an illuminating white ring light, black and gunmetal gray mechanical housing, cables, rails, and neat modular equipment. In the lower foreground, trays and open containers contain multiple assembled circuit boards and chip modules, along with a small, tilted touchscreen control panel displaying blue tech UI graphics. The scene is set inside a modern fiberglass-reinforced industrial factory, featuring high ceilings, mezzanine aisles, large windows, polished reflective floors, workbenches, shelves, and cool daylight. In the background on the right, a casual employee break area shows four people: a brown-haired, cat-eared anime girl sitting on a stool drinking water, a blonde sitting at a table, a dark-haired person sitting next to them, and an employee further away near a counter. A minimalist geometric company logo is added to the wall in the distance. Nine floating, translucent soap bubbles or holographic spheres of varying sizes are scattered throughout the image, reflecting the factory's lights and machinery; they are distributed around the robot, the main character, and the lower foreground. Visual style: high-detail anime illustration, glossy futuristic industrial design, cinematic lighting effects, soft halos, soft iridescence, a contrast between cool blue-gray factory tones and rainbow highlights, clear mechanical details, depth of field, 4:3 composition, no text descriptions, no watermarks. The overall atmosphere should convey a sense of anticipation for the ongoing operation of the factory.{argument name="machine product name" default="Blueprint Composite Building Equipment"} The feeling of calmly conducting production inspections on export-standard products.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一个精致的动漫风格科幻工厂场景，地点位于由 {argument name="company name" default="Union Grotti"} 运营的宽敞高科技电子制造实验室。主体是 {argument name="character name" default="Angelica"}，一位可爱的虹彩全息少女，她站在前景偏右的位置，一手拿着剪贴板，一手拿着触控笔，正在仔细检查制造流程。她的脸部被一个垂直的米色遮挡矩形刻意遮住，但可以看到她的短波波头：闪烁着柔和彩虹光泽的头发，带有光泽感，别着一个蓝色小翅膀发夹，头顶有一撮呆毛。她穿着一件半透明的珠光白蓝短袖连衣裙，领口有一个大大的蓝色蝴蝶结，前襟有纽扣，泡泡袖，蓝色滚边，以及层叠的荷叶边裙摆，折射出青色、粉色和紫色的光芒。

在左侧展示一台大型自动化机器人组装机，正在生产 {argument name="manufactured item" default="通用控制器 SoC 项目"}：两个铰接式机械臂带有精密焊接头，向下指向一块复杂的电路板，在中心芯片处产生微小的明亮火花。在项目上方包含一个沉重的工业机头，配有发光的白色环形灯、黑色和枪灰色的机械外壳、电缆、导轨以及整洁的模块化设备。在下方前景中，放置一些托盘和敞开的容器，里面装有多个已组装好的电路板和芯片模块，以及一个显示蓝色技术 UI 图形的小型倾斜触摸屏控制面板。

场景设定在一个现代化的玻璃钢结构企业工厂内部，拥有高挑的天花板、夹层走道、大窗户、抛光反光地板、工作台、货架和清冷的日光。在右侧背景中，包含一个休闲员工休息区，可见四个人：一个棕色头发的猫耳动漫少女坐在凳子上喝水，一个金发人士坐在桌旁，一个深色头发的人坐在他们旁边，还有一名员工在更远处的柜台附近。在远处的墙上添加一个极简几何形状的公司 Logo。在画面中点缀九个大小不一、漂浮的半透明肥皂泡或全息球体，反射着工厂的灯光和机械；将它们分布在机器人、主角和下方前景周围。

视觉风格：高细节动漫插画，光泽感未来工业设计，电影级光效，柔和光晕，柔和的虹彩，冷蓝灰色工厂色调与彩虹高光形成对比，清晰的机械细节，景深效果，4:3 构图，无文字说明，无水印。整体氛围应呈现出对正在运行的 {argument name="machine product name" default="Blueprint 复合建筑设备"} 出口规格产品进行冷静生产巡检的感觉。

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖版暗黑奇幻动漫插画，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="Rei"}，形象是一位强大的虎兽人战士，采用从大腿上方到头部的戏剧性四分之三侧身构图。他是一位高大、肌肉发达的成年男性，拥有宽阔的胸膛、清晰的腹肌、粗壮的手臂，古铜色皮肤上覆盖着横跨肩部、手臂、躯干和侧身的深色虎纹，长有巨大的利爪手掌、毛茸茸的前臂、一条长长的虎尾，以及从凌乱且被风吹拂的 {argument name="hair color" default="金色"} 头发中探出的两只巨大的尖虎耳。他的面部被一个位于中心的不透明方形遮挡块刻意隐藏，仅露出头发、耳朵、颈部和身体。赋予他强壮的英雄体格，遮挡块后方隐约可见略显圆润的自然下颌轮廓，而非尖锐的 V 字下巴。让他身着华丽的黑金奇幻盔甲和珠宝：赤裸上身，腰间披挂黑色布料，穿着深色长裤，金色的花丝带和链条横跨躯干与臀部，佩戴金属护臂、爪状金色装饰，以及胸部、腰带和手腕处的绿松石宝石饰品。让他被强烈的蓝白色闪电和环绕身体并穿过前景的电弧所包围；背景使用暴风雨般的宇宙夜空，伴有深海军蓝色的云层、火花、发光的薄雾和高对比度的边缘光。风格：高度细致的日本奇幻角色艺术、光泽皮肤高光、复杂的盔甲细节、电影级构图、动态的风吹发丝、戏剧性的明暗对比、发光的电效、身体与服饰聚焦清晰、竖版 2:3 海报构图，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Japanese-style mermaid swimming collage

titleLocalized.zh: 日式美人鱼游泳拼贴画

templates.prompt: Objective: To create an exquisite Japanese magazine-style photo collage that tells the story of a young woman getting a special haircut and performing a swimming routine, creating an elegant and sensual atmosphere. (Use a title){argument name="headline text" default="ミセスマーメイド"} The theme is first-time challenges, beauty, tension, and transformation. Canvas: 16:9 wide landscape layout, approximately 1200×675 pixels, with a soft off-white paper background and thin white borders between the photos. The design should have the feel of a lifestyle magazine page or an event commemorative project, with warm indoor preparation photos mixed on the left and a cool blue pool photo on the right. Layout: A scrapbook-style collage using nine overlapping photo panels. Panel 1 is a large vertical portrait in the left third, showing a woman in a mustard yellow lace dress with long, wet-look pigtails and gold pendant earrings, in soft lighting. Panels 2–4 are three smaller preparation photos stacked slightly to the left of center: Panel 2 shows three women chatting before the event, Panel 3 shows a hairstylist styling a side ponytail, and Panel 4 shows the back of a head with a neat middle part and pigtails. Panel 5 is a tall photo in the right center, labeled the main performance, showing a woman in the same yellow dress standing by the pool with her arms crossed, the blue swimming pool behind her. Panel 6 is a large close-up of the water in the upper right corner, showcasing her wet pigtails and yellow outfit floating on the water. Panel 7 is a horizontal, center-view photo showing her in the pool with her back to the camera, her pigtails spread out on the water. Panel 8 is a close-up at the bottom, showing her surfacing. Panel 9 is a close-up in the lower right corner, showing her in the pool with her hands clasped close to her cheeks, smiling, revealing yellow lace sleeves. Main details: Model is {argument name="character description" default="An elegant Japanese woman in her thirties, with long, dark brown hair styled in neat pigtails."} Clothing is{argument name="outfit" default="A long-sleeved mustard yellow lace dress, paired with gold pendant earrings"} Hair should appear shiny, neatly parted, and have a wet look in the pool photo. Maintain an elegant, feminine, and desirable atmosphere. Text content: Include 6 visible Japanese texts in the beige washi tape or handwritten area. 1) Large handwritten title in the upper left corner: "Misesmarmade". 2) Small handwritten subtitle below: "Hajimete no Tsurugi, Watashirashiku, Meishiku." 3) Beige washi tape description on the portrait in the lower left corner: "Tightness is coming, I want to be more careful with my time." 4) Beige label above the photo: "Shiheqian". 5) Beige label above the central standing pool photo: "一本番" (Ipponban). 6) Beige washi tape caption on the pool close-up in the upper right corner: "水の中で、新しい私と出会えた気がした。" (In the water, I met a new person.) Visual Style: Realistic edited collage, soft natural light, shallow depth of field, warm beige tones on the left, vibrant blue pool hues on the right, slightly vintage paper texture, clean white gaps, subtle shadows beneath the layered photos, Japanese handwritten calligraphy for the main title, and typewriter-style Japanese text on the washi tape label. Constraints: All faces must be anonymized using a smooth rectangular beige mask consistent with the reference style skin tone; no identifiable facial features should be displayed. Use 9 photo panels and 6 text elements. Do not add additional logos, watermarks, QR codes, English text, or other descriptive text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一本精致的日式杂志风格摄影集拼贴画，讲述一位年轻女性进行特别发型设计并进入水中进行游泳表演的故事，营造优雅感性的氛围。使用标题 {argument name="headline text" default="ミセスマーメイド"}，并以初次挑战、美丽、紧张和蜕变为主题。

画布：宽幅 16:9 横向布局，尺寸约为 1200×675 像素，采用柔和的米白色纸张背景，照片之间有细白边。设计应具有生活方式杂志内页或活动纪念项目的感觉，左侧混合温暖的室内准备照片，右侧为清凉的蓝色泳池照片。

布局：使用 9 个照片面板进行重叠的剪贴簿式拼贴。面板 1 是左侧三分之一处的大型垂直肖像，展示了身穿芥末黄蕾丝连衣裙的女性，留着湿发感长双马尾，佩戴金色吊坠耳环，光线柔和。面板 2–4 是堆叠在中心偏左的三个较小的准备照片：面板 2 展示了三位女性在活动前聊天，面板 3 展示了发型师正在打理一侧马尾，面板 4 展示了带有整齐中分和双马尾的后脑勺。面板 5 是位于中右侧的高大照片，标注为主要表演，展示了女性身穿同样的黄色连衣裙站在池边，双臂交叉，身后是蓝色游泳池。面板 6 是右上角的大型水面特写，展示了她湿漉漉的双马尾和水面上的黄色服装。面板 7 是一张横向中间照片，展示了她在泳池中背对镜头，双马尾在水面上散开。面板 8 是下方的特写，展示她从水中浮出。面板 9 是右下角的特写，展示她在泳池中双手合十靠近脸颊，呈现微笑姿态，可见黄色蕾丝袖子。

主体细节：模特为 {argument name="character description" default="一位优雅的 30 多岁日本女性，留着深棕色长发，梳成利落的双马尾"}。服装为 {argument name="outfit" default="一件长袖芥末黄蕾丝连衣裙，搭配金色吊坠耳环"}。头发应看起来有光泽、分缝整齐，并在泳池照片中呈现湿润感。保持优雅、女性化和令人向往的氛围。

文字内容：在米色纸胶带或手写区域包含 6 段可见的日语文字。1) 左上角的大型手写标题：「ミセスマーメイド」。2) 下方的小型手写副标题：「はじめての挑戦、私らしく、美しく。」。3) 左下角肖像上的米色胶带说明：「緊張もワクワクもあるけれど、この時間も大切にしたい。」。4) 准备照片上方的米色标签：「試合前」。5) 中央站立泳池照片上方的米色标签：「一本番」。6) 右上角泳池特写上的米色胶带说明：「水の中で、新しい私と出会えた気がした。」。

视觉风格：写实编辑拼贴画，柔和的自然光，浅景深，左侧为温暖的米色调，右侧为鲜艳的蓝色泳池色调，略带怀旧的纸张质感，干净的白色间隙，分层照片下有微妙的投影，主标题采用日式手写书法，胶带标签上采用打字机风格的日语文字。

约束条件：所有人物面部必须使用与参考风格肤色一致的平滑矩形米色遮罩进行匿名化处理；不得显示可辨认的面部特征。使用 9 个照片面板和 6 个文字元素。请勿添加额外的徽标、水印、二维码、英文文本或其他说明文字。

templates.title: Mrs Mermaid Magazine Collage

titleLocalized.zh: Mrs Mermaid 杂志拼贴画

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a sophisticated two-page magazine-style photo collage advertisement featuring an adult woman preparing to enter a swimming pool, evoking a nostalgic atmosphere of a Japanese beauty pageant/swimming school. Canvas: Wide horizontal 16:9 aspect ratio, approximately 1200×675 pixels, vertically divided into two pages with a thin white binding line in the middle. Clean white borders are used between all photo panels. The left page uses soft warm light, while the right page uses cool pool blue light. Layout: A total of 9 independent photo panels are used. The left page contains 4 panels: a large vertical portrait occupying two-thirds of the left side, showing a close-up of a woman from the chest up, wearing a mustard yellow textured long-sleeved dress, with long wavy brown hair and dangling yellow earrings, under elegant studio lighting; the right side has 3 smaller panels stacked on top, with the top panel showing two women's profiles in close proximity, the middle panel showing a woman tying her hair into a high ponytail, and the bottom panel showing a close-up of the back of her head as a stylist fixes the ponytail. The right page contains five panels: a large panel in the top left showing the same woman standing by a pool, wearing a soaking wet mustard yellow dress, her hair in a wet black ponytail, one hand near her face and the other on her hip; two smaller panels stacked on the far right, showing her swimming in the blue water from behind and from the front respectively; a panel in the bottom left showing her leaning forward by the pool with wet hair and clothes; and a panel in the bottom right showing a close-up of her profile in the pool, her hair in a side ponytail, the water shimmering. Main details: The woman should appear as a composed adult Japanese contestant or model, wearing the same mustard yellow patterned dress throughout. Her hairstyle changes from the dry, voluminous long brown curls on the left page to a sleek, wet black ponytail in the pool scene. A large, soft beige masking block is added above all visible facial features, matching the generated image masking style, concealing any facial features. Text content: A striking handwritten Japanese title is added in the top left corner:{argument name="headline text" default="ミセスマーメイド"} Add a short, handwritten Japanese sentence below the title:{argument name="tagline text" default="The water makes me appear a little stronger than I usually am."} It ends with a small heart. Add vertical Japanese text along the far left edge:{argument name="left vertical copy" default="The time before the match is a mix of excitement and nervousness."} Add vertical Japanese text near the image of someone standing by the pool on the right page:{argument name="right vertical copy" default="My first solo performance."} Add a short handwritten note above the pool image in the bottom right corner:{argument name="bottom handwritten note" default="Once I finish swimming, I'll have one more thing I love."} Add a light-colored white logo text similar to "MINIMAX" and "Hailuo AI" near the bottom right corner. Visual style: Photorealistic lifestyle photography, glossy Japanese magazine layout, elegant feminine editorial design, white collage border, warm cream background on the left, saturated aquamarine pool water on the right, shallow depth of field, realistic wet cloth texture and water droplets, soft highlights and reflections. Constraints: Strictly use 9 photo panels, and only 2 women should appear in the small panel at the top of the left page; all other panels should only show that one woman. Keep faces covered by beige rectangular masking blocks. Do not add extra panels, extra people, or any readable text other than the specified Japanese text and light-colored logo markings.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张精致的双页杂志风格摄影拼贴广告，主题为一名成年女性准备进入泳池的过程，营造出一种怀旧的日本选美比赛/游泳学校氛围。

画布：宽幅横向 16:9 比例，约 1200×675 像素，垂直分为两页，中间有细窄的白色装订线。所有照片面板之间使用干净的白色边框，左页采用柔和暖光，右页采用清冷的泳池蓝光。

布局：总共使用 9 个独立的照片面板。左页包含 4 个面板：1 个大型垂直肖像占据左侧三分之二，展示一名女性胸部以上特写，身穿芥末黄色纹理长袖连衣裙，留着长波浪棕色卷发，佩戴垂坠黄色耳环，采用优雅的影棚灯光；右侧堆叠 3 个较小的面板，顶部面板显示 2 名女性侧脸近距离接触，中间面板显示正在扎高马尾，底部面板显示造型师固定马尾时的后脑勺特写。右页包含 5 个面板：左上角 1 个大型面板，展示同一名女性站在池边，身穿湿透的芥末黄色连衣裙，扎着黑色湿马尾，一只手靠近脸部，另一只手叉腰；最右侧堆叠 2 个较小面板，分别展示她从背后和正面在蓝色水中游泳的场景；左下角 1 个面板展示她湿发湿衣在池边前倾；右下角 1 个面板展示她在泳池中的侧脸特写，扎着侧马尾，水面波光粼粼。

主体细节：女性应看起来像一位从容的日本成年参赛者或模特，全程穿着同一件芥末黄色花纹连衣裙。她的发型从左页的干爽、蓬松的长棕色卷发转变为泳池场景中利落的湿润黑色马尾。在所有可见的面部上方添加大型柔和的米色遮挡块，匹配生成的图像遮盖风格，不显示任何面部特征。

文本内容：在左上角添加醒目的手写日文标题：{argument name="headline text" default="ミセスマーメイド"}。在标题下方添加一行简短的手写日文句子：{argument name="tagline text" default="いつもの私を、少し強く見せてくれる水の中。"}，末尾带有一个小爱心。在最左侧边缘添加垂直的日文文案：{argument name="left vertical copy" default="試合前、わくわくと緊張の時間"}。在右页靠近池边站立图像附近添加垂直的日文文案：{argument name="right vertical copy" default="ソロ部門、初めての舞台へ。"}。在右下角泳池图像上方添加一行简短的手写笔记：{argument name="bottom handwritten note" default="泳ぎ終えたら、またひとつ、私の好きになる。"}，并在右下角附近添加类似“MINIMAX”和“Hailuo AI”的浅色白色 Logo 文字。

视觉风格：照片级真实感的生活摄影，光泽感日本杂志排版，优雅的女性化编辑设计，白色拼贴边框，左侧为暖奶油色背景，右侧为饱和的水蓝色泳池水，浅景深，逼真的湿布质感和水滴，柔和的高光和反射。

约束：严格使用 9 个照片面板，且仅在左页顶部的小面板中出现 2 名女性；所有其他面板均仅展示该名女性。保持面部被米色矩形遮挡块覆盖。不要添加额外的面板、额外的人员，也不要添加除指定的日文文案和浅色 Logo 标记之外的可读文本。

templates.title: Japanese-style mermaid stage collage

titleLocalized.zh: 日式人鱼舞台拼贴画

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a sophisticated Japanese-style stage performance photo collage/project for a fictional mermaid-themed artwork.{argument name="main title" default="ミセスマーメイド"} The work employs a realistic editorial photography style and soft magazine layout. Canvas: Widescreen 16:9 horizontal collage, approximately 1200×675 pixels, divided by a thin white border into a preparation/backstage area on the left and a pool/stage area on the right. It utilizes clean cream white white space, soft taupe clothing, bright turquoise pool water, and natural, soft lighting. Layout: Precise use of 9 photo panels and 2 circular label badges. The left half contains 5 backstage panels: a large vertical portrait of a young East Asian woman with long black hair, wearing a loose taupe shirt; a group photo in the upper right corner showing three young women surrounding documents; a close-up in the center showing hands being styled; a medium-length profile portrait showing a neat ponytail; and a back view of a hairstyle shot at the bottom showing a neat center-parted ponytail. The central vertical panel displays a full-body shot of a woman standing by the pool, wearing a wet-looking taupe long-sleeved dress, one hand near her face and the other on her hip. The right half contains three pool performance panels: one from above, a back view showing a woman swimming with her twin ponytails above the water; one from the center, a frontal pool portrait with wet hair and shoulders above the water; and one close-up in the lower right corner, showing a performer leaning to the side in the pool, wet taupe fabric clinging to her body, hands close to her face. An additional lower center pool portrait is added between the center/right grid, bringing the total number of photo panels to nine. Text content: A large handwritten Japanese title in the upper left corner.{argument name="main title" default="ミセスマーメイド"} Add a small Japanese subtitle below it.{argument name="subtitle" default="This is my first time on stage, and I want to enjoy every moment!"} On the left side of the portrait, place a beige circular badge that reads "Before the Trial" and includes the small English text "— backstage —". Near the top of the center/right border, place a beige circular badge that reads "Main Session" and includes the small English text "— on stage —". Maintain a refined, minimalist, and magazine-like layout. Main subject detail: The recurring subject is {argument name="character description" default="A young East Asian woman with long, shiny black hair"} She was filmed as the same performer in all panels. Her costume was {argument name="outfit" default="A loose-fitting taupe chiffon blouse or a damp dress with a ruffled collar and long sleeves."} Hairstyles change from natural straight hair backstage to a sleek high ponytail, and then to pigtails in the pool. Faces can be softly blurred or left indistinct, but must retain realistic skin tones and photographic lighting. Visual style: Realistically generated photography, a clean lifestyle magazine collage, soft sunlight, shallow depth of field, crisp white grid lines, beige circular markers, an elegant Japanese editorial atmosphere, and bright aquamarine water reflections with highlights. Constraints: Maintain exactly 9 distinct photo panels and 2 circular badges. Do not add logos, watermarks, extra titles, extra figures or decorative icons outside the backstage collective panel. Keep the composition very similar to a dramatic before-and-after collage: the left side for backstage preparation, and the right side for the performance in the water.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个精致的日式舞台表演照片拼贴画 / 项目，用于虚构的人鱼主题作品 {argument name="main title" default="ミセスマーメイド"}，采用写实编辑摄影风格和柔和的杂志排版。

画布：宽屏 16:9 横向拼贴画，约 1200×675 像素，由细白边框分割为左侧的准备/后台区域和右侧的泳池/舞台区域。使用干净的奶油白色留白、柔和的灰褐色服装、明亮的绿松石色泳池水以及自然柔和的灯光。

布局：使用精确的 9 个照片面板和 2 个圆形标签徽章。左半部分包含 5 个后台面板：1 张大型垂直肖像，展示一位留着黑色长发的年轻东亚女性，身穿宽松的灰褐色衬衫；1 张右上方的集体策划照片，展示三名年轻女性围在文件周围；1 张中间的特写，展示正在做发型的手；1 张中景侧面肖像，展示利落的马尾辫；1 张下方的背面发型拍摄，展示中分利落马尾辫。中心垂直面板展示 1 张在泳池边站立的全身照，女性穿着湿润感的灰褐色长袖连衣裙，一只手靠近脸部，另一只手叉腰。右半部分包含 3 个泳池表演面板：1 张上方背面视角，展示女性游走，双马尾露出水面；1 张中间正面泳池肖像，湿发和肩膀露出水面；1 张右下方的表情特写，在泳池中表演者侧身倾斜，湿润的灰褐色布料贴身，双手靠近脸部。在中心/右侧网格之间添加 1 个额外的下方中心泳池肖像，使照片面板总数正好为 9 个。

文本内容：在左上方，书写大型手写日文标题 {argument name="main title" default="ミセスマーメイド"}。在其下方，添加小型日文副标题 {argument name="subtitle" default="はじめての舞台、すべてを楽しみたい！"}。在左侧肖像上，放置一个米色圆形徽章，写有「試合前」，并附带小型英文文本 “— backstage —”。在中心/右侧边界顶部附近，放置一个米色圆形徽章，写有「本番」，并附带小型英文文本 “— on stage —”。保持排版精致、极简且具有杂志感。

主体细节：反复出现的主体是 {argument name="character description" default="一位留着黑色长亮直发的年轻东亚女性"}，在所有面板中均作为同一表演者拍摄。她的服装是 {argument name="outfit" default="一件宽松的灰褐色雪纺衬衫或带有褶皱领口和长袖的湿润连衣裙"}。发型从后台的自然直发变为利落的高马尾，以及在泳池中的双马尾。面部可以柔和地模糊处理或保持不清晰，但需保留真实的肤色和摄影灯光。

视觉风格：写实生成的摄影作品，干净的生活方式杂志拼贴画，柔和的日光，浅景深，清晰的白色网格线，米色圆形标注，优雅的日式编辑氛围，明亮水蓝色的水面反射与高光。

约束：保持正好 9 个不同的照片面板和 2 个圆形徽章。不要添加徽标、水印、额外的标题、后台集体面板之外的额外人物或装饰性图标。保持构图非常类似于戏剧性的前后对比拼贴画：左侧为后台准备，右侧为水中表演。

templates.title: Anime Developer's Room Stretching Pose

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫开发者房间伸展姿势

templates.prompt: Create a delicate semi-realistic anime illustration depicting {argument name="character name" default="A blonde anime girl"} A scene of relaxation in a dimly lit, modern developer workspace at dusk. The character sits in a black ergonomic gaming chair on the right side of the screen, leaning back to the left with her arms outstretched and fists loosely clenched; her face is obscured by a simple square mosaic. She has short, light blonde hair with a small blue-pink highlight near her ear, and wears a loose white printed T-shirt (with a small colorful logo on the chest), baggy blue cargo jeans with prominent stitching and side straps, and thick-soled black platform shoes. The room has a somber, cinematic atmosphere, with a warm desk lamp illuminating the left side and a large window on the right letting in cool-toned blue-purple sunset light. An ultrawide monitor sits on the desk, displaying the Unreal Engine editor interface, showing a scene of a modern house in the rain; an Unreal Engine poster hangs on the wall; three items are displayed on a floating shelf: a hanging plant, a black rattan diffuser, and a small potted plant. The desk must contain seven visible objects: the ultrawide monitor, the keyboard, the mouse, and the time displayed.{argument name="clock time" default="17:14"} A small digital clock, a black mug, a smartphone, and a small potted plant. Add a black desk lamp to the far left edge, and place a black computer speaker or tower below the monitor, keeping the desktop tidy and free of messy cables. The view outside the window shows the city skyline at sunset, accompanied by orange-purple clouds and lit-up building windows. A round robot vacuum cleaner sits on the floor in the lower right corner. The game uses a square composition, delicate anime-style rendering, realistic perspective, soft shadows, glossy reflections from the monitor, dark gray walls, a black desk, and black curtains, creating a tranquil late-night game development atmosphere. Emphasize that the character is facing left, sitting sideways, and wearing trousers instead of a skirt. Avoid extra characters, extra monitors, deformed hands, unidentifiable clutter, or altered poses.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张精致的半写实动漫插画，描绘 {argument name="character name" default="一位金发动漫女性"} 在黄昏时分昏暗的现代开发者工作区中放松的场景。角色坐在画面右侧的黑色人体工学电竞椅上，身体侧向左侧，向后仰并双臂笔直向上伸展，拳头呈放松的紧握状；她的脸部被一个简单的方形马赛克遮挡。她留着浅金色短发，耳边有一小撮蓝粉色挑染，身穿宽松的白色印花 T 恤（胸前有小巧的彩色 Logo）、带有明显缝线和侧带的宽大蓝色工装牛仔裤，以及厚底黑色松糕鞋。房间氛围阴郁且具有电影感，左侧由温暖的台灯照亮，右侧大窗户透进冷色调的蓝紫色夕阳余晖。书桌上放置一台超宽显示器，显示着 Unreal Engine 编辑器界面，画面为雨中现代房屋建筑场景；墙上挂着一张 Unreal Engine 海报；墙上的浮动搁板上摆放着三件物品：一盆垂吊绿植、一个黑色藤条香薰和一盆小盆栽。书桌上需包含七个可见物体：超宽显示器、键盘、鼠标、显示时间为 {argument name="clock time" default="17:14"} 的小数字时钟、一个黑色马克杯、一部智能手机和一盆小盆栽。在最左侧边缘添加一盏黑色台灯，显示器下方放置一个黑色电脑音箱或主机，保持桌面整洁无杂乱线缆。窗外展现日落时的城市天际线，伴有橙紫色云彩和亮起的建筑窗户。右下角地板上放置一个圆形扫地机器人。采用正方形构图，细腻的绘画风动漫渲染，写实的透视效果，柔和的阴影，显示器上的光泽反射，深灰色墙壁，黑色书桌，黑色窗帘，营造出宁静的深夜游戏开发氛围。强调角色面向左侧，侧身坐着，穿着裤子而非裙子。避免出现额外人物、额外显示器、畸形手部、难以辨认的杂乱物体或改变姿势。

templates.title: Minimalism Cute Angel Sticker Collage

titleLocalized.zh: 极繁主义可爱天使贴纸拼贴

templates.prompt: Create a bright, Harajuku-style/dreamy and adorable anime illustration. The centerpiece is a chibi-style angel girl, occupying most of the 16:9 aspect ratio, surrounded by densely packed macaron-colored stickers, ornaments, beads, ribbons, hearts, stars, candies, flowers, and glitter elements. The character has very long and fluffy hair.{argument name="hair color" default="light pink and gold"} Her hair was styled in twin ponytails, braided with many tiny braids and beads, and adorned with daisies, purple flowers, heart pendants, pearl chains, and sparkling accessories. She wore a macaron-colored dress with layered ruffles.{argument name="outfit color" default="Lavender purple and white"} The dress features a large bow at the chest, heart-shaped jewelry, and a bracelet. White angel wings are faintly visible behind her. Her right hand extends towards the viewer with a see-through effect, palm open, while her left hand holds a pink and blue cylindrical wand or a lip gloss-like pendant. A large, solid-color macaron pink square obscures the center of her face (from forehead to chin), concealing her features, but leaving her hair and accessories visible. The background is incredibly rich, saturated, and playful, dominated by cyan, bright pink, lavender, yellow, and white, with glossy highlights, confetti, bubbles, starbursts, and sticker outlines. It includes six clearly identifiable pop art sticker texts: "LOVE!" in a cloud bubble in the upper left corner, "WOW!" in a blue bubble on the left, "KIRA KIRA!" in a pink bubble in the upper right corner, "Chu!" in a cyan-pink bubble on the right, "YEAH!" in a yellow bubble in the lower right corner, and "Angel" in a neon heart in the upper right corner. Add a large number of non-text decorative stickers, including blue checkered bows, pink hearts, yellow stars, lollipops, ribbons, wings, and candy shapes, all with thick white borders. The image should have a cute, chaotic, glossy, dreamy, and sparkly feel, like a maximalist Japanese idol sticker collage. High detail, clean anime lines, soft shadows, bright macaron gloss, clear sticker typography, no watermark, and no extra text except for the six designated words.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅明亮的原宿装饰风 / 梦幻可爱风的超可爱动漫插画。画面中心是一位 Q 版天使女孩，占据 16:9 宽画幅的大部分空间，周围环绕着密集的马卡龙色贴纸、挂饰、珠子、蝴蝶结、爱心、星星、糖果、花朵和闪光元素。角色拥有非常长且蓬松的 {argument name="hair color" default="淡粉金色"} 双马尾，编织着许多细小的发辫和珠串，并装饰着雏菊、紫色花朵、爱心挂饰、珍珠链和闪光配饰。她穿着一件带有层叠荷叶边的马卡龙色 {argument name="outfit color" default="薰衣草紫与白色"} 连衣裙，胸前系着大蝴蝶结，佩戴着爱心首饰、手链，身后隐约可见白色小天使翅膀。她的右手以透视效果向观众伸出，手掌张开，左手拿着一个粉蓝相间的圆柱形魔杖或类似唇彩的挂饰。用一个大的纯色马卡龙粉色方形遮挡块覆盖她面部中心（从额头到下巴），使其五官隐藏，但周围的头发和配饰保持可见。背景极其丰富、饱和且充满趣味，以青色、亮粉色、薰衣草紫、黄色和白色为主色调，带有光泽高光、五彩纸屑、气泡、星芒和贴纸轮廓。包含 6 个清晰可辨的波普艺术贴纸文字：左上角云朵气泡中的“LOVE!”，左侧蓝色气泡中的“WOW!”，右上角粉色气泡中的“KIRA KIRA!”，右侧青粉色气泡中的“Chu!”，右下角黄色气泡中的“YEAH!”，以及右上角霓虹爱心中的“Angel”。添加大量非文字装饰性贴纸，包括蓝色格纹蝴蝶结、粉色爱心、黄色星星、棒棒糖、丝带、翅膀和糖果形状，所有贴纸均带有厚实的白色边框。画面应呈现出可爱、混乱、光泽、梦幻且闪耀的感觉，如同极繁主义的日本偶像贴纸拼贴画。高细节，干净的动漫线条，柔和的阴影，明亮的马卡龙色光泽，清晰的贴纸排版，无水印，除指定的 6 个词外无额外文字。

templates.prompt: Create a realistic medium-shot portrait of a young woman standing in a sunny garden café or on a terrace, with the composition extending from the top of her head to below her waist. She has a neat, chin-length bob haircut and her hair color is {argument name="hair color" default="Light brown"} Her hair was smooth and rounded at the ends, styled in the middle. Her face was deliberately obscured by a flat, opaque square cover, the color of which was {argument name="censor block color" default="Warm brown"} The camera covers her entire face from forehead to chin, while preserving the outline of her hair. She faces the camera directly, shoulders relaxed, arms hanging naturally. Four clearly visible clothing/accessory elements are present: a sleeveless beige linen cropped vest, a dark gray-brown inner cropped vest peeking out from the neckline and hem, loose gray-brown trousers subtly visible at the bottom edge, and a short natural wooden bead necklace. The background is a softly blurred green terrace with potted plants, dappled sunlight, a light-colored parasol in the upper right corner, and an outdoor table and chairs on the right; using warm morning natural light, shallow depth of field, realistic skin texture, and cinematic colors, it presents a candid lifestyle photography style. Vertical composition, 3:4 aspect ratio, no text, no labels, no watermarks, and no other people in the frame.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实风格的中景肖像，拍摄一位站在户外阳光明媚的花园咖啡馆或露台上的年轻女性，构图从头顶到腰部下方。她留着整洁的下巴长度波波头，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="浅棕色"}，发尾圆润顺滑，中分发型。她的面部被一个平面的不透明方形遮挡块刻意遮住，颜色为 {argument name="censor block color" default="暖中棕色"}，覆盖了从额头到下巴的整个面部区域，同时保留了头发的轮廓。她正对镜头，肩膀放松，双臂自然下垂。她身上有 4 个清晰可见的服饰/配饰元素：一件无袖米色亚麻短款背心、领口和下摆处露出的一件深灰棕色内搭短款背心、底部边缘隐约可见的宽松灰棕色长裤，以及一条短款天然木珠项链。背景是虚化柔和的绿叶露台，带有盆栽植物、斑驳的阳光、右上角的一把浅色遮阳伞，以及右侧的一张户外桌椅；使用温暖的上午自然光，浅景深，真实的皮肤质感，电影般的色彩，呈现出抓拍的生活方式摄影风格。竖构图，3:4 比例，无文字，无标识，无水印，画面中无其他人物。
