templates.title: A woman and her kitten in a cozy apartment

titleLocalized.zh: 温馨公寓中的女子与小猫

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic vertical lifestyle photograph set in a cozy modern apartment living room at night. A mature woman {argument name="hair color" default="Ash brown shoulder-length wavy hair"} She sat barefoot on a large, round, white plush carpet, dressed in {argument name="outfit" default="White sleeveless vest and light blue shorts"} She sits on the floor, one arm at her side, knees bent, legs stretched diagonally downwards to the right, gently looking down at the orange tabby kitten curled up asleep at her feet. The woman's face should be anonymized using a soft square blur or neutral masking while maintaining realism for the rest of the image. The room is warm, softly illuminated by a round ceiling light and small table lamps; it includes a white sofa with a white blanket, two wooden shelves filled with books, picture frames, trinkets, and plants, a large sliding glass window on the right showing a dark nighttime balcony/city view, and an orange tabby kitten curled up on the rug. Use natural wood floors, cream-colored walls, white curtains, and potted plants to create a tranquil and intimate atmosphere, employing a shallow depth of field, realistic interior photography style, warm color tones, and smartphone-like composition. The image must not contain any text, watermarks, additional people, or additional pets.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张照片级逼真的竖版生活方式照片，场景为夜晚温馨的现代公寓客厅。一位成年女性，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="灰棕色及肩波浪卷发"}，赤脚坐在一个大型圆形白色长绒地毯上，身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="白色无袖背心和淡蓝色短裤"}。她坐在地板上，一只手臂放在身侧，双膝弯曲，双腿向右下方斜伸，温柔地低头看着蜷缩在她脚边睡觉的橘色虎斑小猫。女性的面部应通过柔和的方形模糊或中性遮挡进行匿名处理，同时保持图像其余部分的真实感。房间温暖，由圆形吸顶灯和小台灯柔和地照亮；包含一张带有白色盖毯的白色沙发，两个摆满书籍、相框、小装饰品和植物的木质置物架，右侧有一扇大型推拉玻璃窗，展示出黑暗的夜间阳台/城市景观，以及地毯上蜷缩着的一只橘色虎斑小猫。使用天然木地板、奶油色墙壁、白色窗帘、盆栽绿植，营造宁静亲密的氛围，采用浅景深、逼真的室内摄影风格、暖色调，以及类似智能手机拍摄的构图。画面中不得包含任何文字、水印、额外人物或额外宠物。

templates.title: Nakoruru Forest Anime Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 娜可露露森林动漫海报

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="character name" default="Nakoruru"} Create a dramatic widescreen anime key visual. She is a priestess warrior blessed by the spirits of nature, situated in a lush forest, accompanied by animal companions. Canvas: 16:9 horizontal movie poster, highly detailed digital anime illustration, sharp contrast, sunlight streaming through dense trees, rich vegetation in the foreground and background. Layout: Place the protagonist slightly to the right of center, in a dynamic crouching pose, with flowing long black hair tied with a large red bow at the back of her head. Her face should be deliberately kept soft and blurred, without features, as if anonymized, while other artistic details remain clear. Leave space on the left for a striking Japanese calligraphy title. Above and behind her is a bird of prey with outstretched wings; to her right rear is a wolf emerging from the greenery, baring its teeth. Main Details: The female protagonist wears a white and red Ainu-style shrine maiden outfit, featuring wide sleeves, red trim, red wristbands, a red headband with white badges, a yellow sash around her waist, and a long white skirt with red embellishments. Her hair is a glossy, deep navy black, dramatically billowing in the wind. One hand is outstretched forward, the other held in a defensive stance, conveying elegance, speed, and natural magic. Animal Quantity: Includes 2 animal companions: 1 brown and cream-colored raptor with outstretched wings, sharp talons, piercing eyes, and white markings on its face; 1 black, gray, and white wolf with pointed ears, sharp eyes, and bared teeth, crouching in a threatening posture. Text Content: Includes 3 Japanese calligraphy text elements on the left: small characters at the top.{argument name="top caption" default="The shrine maiden chosen by Kamuy"} ; Central Large-Font Title{argument name="main title" default="ナコルル"} The Chinese characters below{argument name="bottom caption" default="This is nature's punishment."} The font should have a hand-drawn feel, with black ink splatter, rough brushstroke edges, and vibrant strokes. Visual style: High-end anime poster art, semi-realistic lighting, crisp painterly rendering, saturated forest green, strong sunlight streaming in from the upper left, dramatic rim lighting on hair and clothing, detailed feather and fur textures, cinematic depth of field, and a high-action fantasy atmosphere inspired by classic fighting game character art. Constraints: Do not add extra animals or text. Maintain compositional balance; the calligraphy on the left should be clear and legible, while the right side should be dominated by characters and animal companions. No watermarks, no logos, no borders.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="娜可露露"} 创作一张戏剧性的宽屏动漫主视觉图，她是受自然之灵眷顾的巫女战士，置身于郁郁葱葱的森林中，并伴有动物伙伴。

画布：16:9 横向电影海报，高度精细的数字动漫插画，鲜明的对比度，阳光透过茂密的树木倾泻而下，前景和背景中植被丰富。

布局：将女主角置于画面中心偏右的位置，呈现动态的蹲姿，留着飘逸的长黑发，脑后系着巨大的红色蝴蝶结。她的面部应刻意保持柔和模糊且无五官，如同匿名化处理，而其余艺术细节保持清晰。在左侧预留空间，用于放置醒目的日式毛笔书法标题。在她身后上方展示一只展翅的猛禽；在她的右后方展示一只从绿丛中现身、呲牙咧嘴的狼。

主体细节：女主角身穿白色与红色相间的阿伊努风格巫女服，配有宽袖、红边、红色护腕、带有白色徽章的红色发带、腰间系着黄色腰带，以及带有红色装饰的白色长裙。她的头发呈光泽的深藏青黑色，在风中戏剧性地飘动。她一只手向前伸出，另一只手保持防御姿态，传达出优雅、速度与自然魔法。

动物数量：包含 2 个动物伙伴：1 只棕色与奶油色相间的猛禽，张开双翼，利爪锋利，双眼炯炯有神，面部有白色斑纹；1 只黑色、灰色与白色相间的狼，耳朵尖耸，眼神锐利，露出牙齿，呈威胁性的蹲姿。

文本内容：在左侧包含 3 个日式毛笔书法文本元素：顶部小字 {argument name="top caption" default="カムイに選ばれし巫女"}；中心大字标题 {argument name="main title" default="ナコルル"}；下方中字 {argument name="bottom caption" default="大自然のおしおきです。"}。字体应呈现手绘感，带有黑色墨迹飞溅、粗糙的笔触边缘和充满活力的笔锋。

视觉风格：高级动漫海报艺术，半写实光影，清晰的绘画渲染，饱和的森林绿色，从左上方射入的强烈阳光，头发和衣物上的戏剧性轮廓光，精细的羽毛与毛发纹理，电影级景深，灵感源自经典格斗游戏角色艺术的高动作奇幻氛围。

限制：不要添加额外的动物或文本。保持构图平衡，左侧的书法清晰易读，右侧由角色和动物伙伴占据主导地位。无水印，无 Logo，无边框。

templates.title: Prism Ocean Teacup Fantasy Landscape

titleLocalized.zh: 棱镜海洋茶杯奇幻景观

templates.prompt: Create a dreamlike, hyper-realistic macro fantasy scene themed around a prism and a landscape within a cup: A transparent glass teacup filled with luminous turquoise seawater sits on a reflective tabletop. On the left side of the cup is a miniature tropical island, complete with fine sand, green plants, and several small palm trees. Five dolphins should be depicted swimming in the water: two near the upper right corner, one in the center left, one in the center right, and one near the lower right corner. The teacup has a transparent circular handle on the left side and a circular glass base at the bottom. A close-up of a young woman is shown behind the cup.{argument name="hair color" default="warm brown"} Her tousled, wet hair was bathed in golden backlighting, and most of her face was obscured by a large, centered, opaque square mask with a warm brown gradient; this square should cover most of the area above the center of the image, extending down from the hair area to above the rim of the cup.{argument name="lighting mood" default="Golden sunset backlight and rainbow bokeh"} Strong prismatic refraction, shimmering highlights, lens flare, scattered crystalline water droplets and beads, and shimmering reflections on the tabletop. Add four prominent objects to the foreground tabletop: a small golden seashell in the lower left corner, a clear faceted crystal near the bottom edge, a blue gemstone on the right, and a small glass sphere near the handle of the cup. The style should be cinematic hyperrealism with extreme detail, shallow depth of field, and magical realism, with a high contrast between the warm amber glow and the cool cyan water, and vertical {argument name="aspect ratio" default="3:4"} The composition is simple, with no text or watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个以棱镜和杯中景观为主题的梦幻超写实微距奇幻场景：一个装满发光青绿色海水的透明玻璃茶杯放置在反光的桌面上，杯内左侧有一个微型热带岛屿，包含细沙、绿色植物和几棵小棕榈树。杯中需展示 5 只海豚在水中游动：2 只靠近右上角水面，1 只在左中位置，1 只在右中位置，1 只靠近右下角。茶杯左侧有一个透明的圆形把手，底部有一个圆形玻璃底座。杯子后方展示一位年轻女性的特写，其 {argument name="hair color" default="暖棕色"} 的蓬松湿发捕捉着金色的背光，她的脸部大部分被一个居中的大尺寸不透明方形遮罩遮挡，遮罩呈现暖棕色渐变；该方形应覆盖图像上方中心的大部分区域，从头发区域向下延伸至杯沿上方。使用 {argument name="lighting mood" default="金色日落背光与彩虹焦散"}，强烈的棱镜折射、闪烁的高光、镜头光晕、散落的晶体状水滴和珠子，以及桌面上的粼粼反光。在前景桌面上添加 4 个显著物体：左下角 1 个金色小贝壳，底边附近 1 个透明刻面水晶，右侧 1 个蓝色宝石，以及杯把手附近 1 个小玻璃球。风格应为极致细节的电影级超写实主义、浅景深、魔幻现实主义，暖琥珀色发光与冷青色水体形成高对比，垂直 {argument name="aspect ratio" default="3:4"} 构图，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Rainy Neon Anime Style Girl in an Alley

templates.prompt: Create a delicate, anime-style vertical illustration depicting a young woman standing alone in the middle of a narrow alleyway in a Japanese city during a heavy rainstorm at night. The image primarily shows her back, a full-body shot, centered, with her head slightly turned to the left shoulder, revealing one eye and part of her face. She has extremely long, flowing hair.{argument name="hair color" default="Dark purple hair with blue and magenta highlights"} Her hair was tied in a low side ponytail, long strands fluttering dramatically in the rain. She was wearing a smart outfit.{argument name="coat color" default="White"} A long, belted trench coat with black piping, shoulder seams, sleeve straps, a back belt, and a small circular armband, paired with black trousers and glossy black knee-high platform boots. The background is a damp, neon-lit alleyway in Tokyo at night, with shops on both sides. The right side has warm window lighting, while the left side is darker, featuring nine clearly visible, vertically illuminated signs in cyan, pink, yellow, and white with stylized Japanese characters; the text can be decorative and doesn't need to be fully legible. Rain falls in long, vertical streaks, covering the pavement, reflecting vibrant neon lights in blue, cyan, pink, and white. A few blurred silhouettes of pedestrians are added to the background to add depth, but the woman remains the absolute focus. The composition employs cinematic framing, a low, level perspective, strong rim lighting, highly saturated cyberpunk tones, clean lines, delicate anime-style rendering, bright reflections, soft depth of field in the distance, and a melancholic, romantic rainy night atmosphere. No watermark, no border, and no other figures in the foreground.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张精致的动漫风格竖版插画，描绘一位年轻女子独自站在夜晚大雨中狭窄的日本城市巷弄中央。画面主要呈现其背影，全身照，居中构图，头部微微向左肩后转，露出一只眼睛和部分面部。她留着极长的飘逸 {argument name="hair color" default="深紫色头发，带有蓝色和洋红色挑染"}，扎成低侧马尾，长发丝在雨中戏剧性地飘动。她穿着一件干练的 {argument name="coat color" default="白色"} 长款系带风衣，带有黑色滚边、肩缝、袖带、后腰带和一个小圆形袖章，搭配黑色长裤和亮面黑色膝下厚底靴。背景是夜晚东京潮湿且霓虹闪烁的巷弄，两侧是店面，右侧有温暖的窗光，左侧店面较暗，并有 9 个清晰可见的垂直发光招牌，颜色为青色、粉色、黄色和白色，带有风格化的日文类字符；文字可以是装饰性的，无需完全可读。雨水呈长条状垂直落下，水坑覆盖路面，地面映照出蓝色、青色、粉色和白色的鲜艳霓虹光影。在背景中加入几个模糊的行人剪影以增加深度，但保持该女子为绝对焦点。采用电影级构图、低平视视角、强烈的轮廓光、高饱和度的赛博朋克色调、干净的线条、细腻的动漫渲染、光亮的反射效果、远处柔和的景深，以及忧郁浪漫的雨夜氛围。无水印，无边框，前景无其他人物。

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为一部关于制作 {argument name="dish name" default="鳗鱼蒲烧（3 串）"} 的 15 秒短片创建一个详细的动画风格动态分镜表，以分镜接触表的形式呈现，并附带标题和制作说明。

画布：宽屏 16:9 黑色背景制作项目，高分辨率，带有细白边框，呈现手绘电影速写美学。使用柔和的棕褐色、炭灰色、米色和暖橙色调，搭配光泽感的棕色鳗鱼酱汁和炉火光影。

顶部标题：左侧为醒目的白色大标题：“鳗鱼蒲烧（3 串）动态分镜表 | 15 秒短片”。右侧为白色小字备注：“角色一致性：全片保持同一角色、同一发型、同一服装、同一场景。”

主要布局：使用 3 行 5 列的网格，共 15 个分镜画面。每个画面左上角带有黑色时间码标签，底部带有黑色标题条。角色必须始终保持一致：{argument name="main character" default="一位留着灰棕色短卷发、眼神温柔略带疲惫、身穿带图案荷叶边衬衫并系着围裙的年轻动画女性"}，在 {argument name="setting" default="温馨的日式公寓厨房中烹饪，背景有架子、瓶罐、厨具、柔和的窗光、烟雾、蒸汽和桌面炭火烤架"}。视觉风格应类似于数码相机拍摄的动画烹饪纪录片：手绘墨线、轻微水彩渲染背景、逼真的食物细节、细腻的动态模糊、温暖的晨光、烟雾、蒸汽和炭火余辉。

分镜画面：包含以下 15 个精确计时的镜头和标题：
1. 时间码“0:00–0:01”；角色将 3 串鳗鱼放在烤架上；标题：“1. 将 3 串鳗鱼放在烤架上。”
2. 时间码“0:01–0:02”；烤架周围烟雾轻柔升起；标题：“2. 烟雾轻柔升起。”
3. 时间码“0:02–0:03”；角色用涂抹刷将酱汁刷在鳗鱼上；标题：“3. 将酱汁刷在鳗鱼上。”
4. 时间码“0:03–0:04”；酱汁滴在炭火上的烤串特写；标题：“4. 酱汁滴在炭火上。”
5. 时间码“0:04–0:05”；角色身旁升起橙色火焰；标题：“5. 火焰升起。”
6. 时间码“0:05–0:06”；角色翻转全部 3 串鳗鱼；标题：“6. 翻转全部 3 串鳗鱼。”
7. 时间码“0:06–0:07”；角色检查鳗鱼质地的近景；标题：“7. 检查鳗鱼的质地。”
8. 时间码“0:07–0:08”；角色再次刷上酱汁；包含一个小的垂直米色模糊块，部分遮挡面部上方区域；标题：“8. 再刷上一层酱汁。”
9. 时间码“0:08–0:09”；火势再次燃起，伴随明亮的橙色火焰；标题：“9. 火势再次燃起。”
10. 时间码“0:09–0:10”；角色专注地用手小心旋转烤串；标题：“10. 小心旋转烤串。”
11. 时间码“0:10–0:11”；烤架上 3 串光泽诱人的焦糖色鳗鱼特写；标题：“11. 鳗鱼看起来酱汁浓郁。”
12. 时间码“0:11–0:12”；角色将 3 串鳗鱼装盘；标题：“12. 将 3 串鳗鱼装盘。”
13. 时间码“0:12–0:13”；角色端着盘子，盘中烤串蒸汽升腾；标题：“13. 蒸汽升腾。”
14. 时间码“0:13–0:14”；角色拿起一串鳗鱼并送向嘴边；标题：“14. 拿起一串鳗鱼。”
15. 时间码“0:14–0:15”；咬下第一口的特写，米色矩形模糊块遮挡了大部分面部，烤串进入口中；标题：“15. 咬下并露出惊讶的表情。”下方添加一行较小的橙色括号文字：“（入口瞬间露出惊讶的表情。）”

底部制作说明：在 15 个画面下方，添加一个黑色说明栏，分为 6 个标注区域：5 个文本列和 1 个时长框。
第 1 列标题：“摄像风格（数码相机感）”，包含 6 个要点：“手持数码相机美学”；“2000 年代初便携式相机质感”；“轻微的自动对焦搜索感”；“自然的曝光光晕”；“逼真的数字噪点和颗粒感”；“细腻的动态模糊和抖动”；“随性的家庭录像氛围”。
第 2 列标题：“氛围与灯光”，包含 5 个要点：“温暖的晨光”；“柔和的窗光与阴影”；“烟雾、蒸汽和炉火余辉”；“温馨的日式公寓厨房”；“怀旧且富有情感的基调”。
第 3 列标题：“烹饪要点”，包含 6 个要点：“鳗鱼蒲烧（3 串）”；“甜酱油釉（蒲烧酱）”；“炭火烧烤”；“浓郁的烟熏香气”；“ASMR 烹饪声效”；“光泽感焦糖色外观”。
第 4 列标题：“角色表情”，包含 5 个要点：“起初冷静专注”；“逐渐变得柔和温暖”；“烹饪时细腻的情感流露”；“最后流露出真诚的快乐”；“第一口时的惊讶与喜悦”。
第 5 列标题：“其他说明”，包含 6 个要点：“全片保持角色一致”；“相同的发型、服装和场景”；“无配料或装饰”；“盘中仅限 3 串”；“逼真的日式家庭烹饪”；“写实电影风格”。
第 6 列：一个带框的时长徽章，顶部写着“时长”，中间是大数字“15”，下方写着“秒”。

约束条件：只要出现菜品，必须始终保持 3 串鳗鱼。所有文字均使用简洁的白色无衬线字体，置于黑色标签上。不要添加额外的画面、额外的烤串、无关的食物、标志、水印或现代 UI 元素。全片保持相同的角色、相同的服装、相同的厨房以及相同的温暖速写动画纪录片风格。

templates.title: Barbarian Fantasy City Gate Parade

titleLocalized.zh: 蛮族奇幻城门游行

templates.prompt: Create a name{argument name="series title" default="Traveling with Barbarians 8"} A dark, cinematic medieval fantasy scene: a frontal, full-body, photorealistic procession against a backdrop of a damp, rain-soaked stone city gate. At the center of the image are two human adventurers approaching the viewer: on the left, a shorter, blond, curly-haired traveler in black scale armor, belted, booted, and draped in a tattered black cloak, leading a white horse; on the right, a tall, muscular barbarian with long, dark curly hair, his half-naked, scarred torso faintly visible beneath dark leather and metal armor, wearing a heavy belt, boots, and bracers, and draped in a tattered black cloak, leading a black horse. Their faces are deliberately obscured by flat, matte, dark brown rectangular masks, devoid of any facial features. The scene must include two prominent horses on either side: a white horse with a pale mane on the left, and a black horse on the right, both adorned with dark medieval harnesses featuring metal rings and belts. On the far left edge is a partially visible armored guard, also wearing a small, dark rectangular mask that obscures his face. The environment is a magnificent Gothic stone archway with towering columns, a damp cobblestone path reflecting light, and falling raindrops or water droplets. The archway frames a distant fantasy castle city with spires and battlements. Five striking deep navy blue hanging banners with gold heraldic symbols are added to the walls. The use of dramatic, low-angled warm sunlight from the distant city creates cool shadows within the archway. High detail, rough realism, an epic fantasy film still, 3:4 vertical composition, central symmetry, shallow atmospheric fog, no visible text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个名为 {argument name="series title" default="与蛮族同行 8"} 的暗黑电影感中世纪奇幻场景：一个正面、全身、照片级逼真的游行画面，背景为雨后潮湿的石砌城门。画面中心展示两名正朝观众走来的人类冒险者：左侧是一位身材较矮、金发卷发、身穿黑色鳞甲、系着皮带、穿着靴子并披着破旧黑色斗篷的旅行者，手中牵着一匹白马；右侧是一位身材高大、肌肉发达、留着深色长卷发的蛮族人，半裸的伤痕躯干在深色皮革金属盔甲下隐约可见，系着厚重腰带，穿着靴子和护腕，披着破旧黑色斗篷，手中牵着一匹黑马。他们的面部被平整的哑光深褐色长方形面具刻意遮挡，没有任何五官。画面中需包含两匹显眼的马匹分列两侧：左侧为一匹鬃毛苍白的白马，右侧为一匹黑马，两匹马均佩戴着带有金属环和皮带的深色中世纪马具。在最左侧边缘包含一名仅部分可见的披甲护卫，同样戴着遮住面部的小型深色长方形面具。环境为一个宏伟的哥特式石拱门，配有高耸的圆柱、反射光线的潮湿鹅卵石路面、飘落的雨滴或水珠，拱门内框出远处带有尖塔和城垛的奇幻城堡城市。在墙壁上添加五面显眼的深海军蓝悬挂旗帜，旗帜上带有金色纹章符号。使用来自远处城市的戏剧性低角度暖色阳光，拱门内形成冷色阴影，高细节，粗粝写实感，史诗奇幻电影剧照，3:4 垂直构图，中心对称，浅层大气雾气，无可见文字，无水印。

templates.title: Tamagoyaki (Japanese rolled omelet) cooking storyboard

titleLocalized.zh: 玉子烧烹饪分镜脚本

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a 15-panel cinematic cooking storyboard showcasing a young woman making tamagoyaki (Japanese rolled omelet) in a country-style kitchen. Each panel should include a timestamp and step-by-step instructions. Canvas: 16:9 widescreen with a table layout, precisely 5 columns and 3 rows, separated by thin white lines. Each panel should have a small white timestamp in the upper left corner and white step-by-step instructions with a black shadow in the lower left corner. Main details: A refined, anime-style young woman {argument name="hair color" default="Soft, gray-gold wavy short hair"} Wearing{argument name="outfit" default="A vintage beige floral shirt with lace trim and a dark bow at the collar."} She cooks on the wooden countertop of a cozy, old-fashioned kitchen filled with shelves, jars, utensils, plants, warm sunlight, and atmospheric dust. To protect her privacy, her face should be soft-focused or blurred in all shots, while her hands, food, utensils, and clothing should be richly detailed. Visual Style: Photorealistic cinematic/anime style, warm golden-brown tones, shallow depth of field, emotionally evocative natural window lighting, a textured country kitchen background, realistic steam, oil sheen, egg texture, and the atmosphere of holding movie stills. Shot Sequence: Contains 15 independent shots with the following visible labels and actions: 1. Time stamp “0:00-0:01”, description “1. Crack egg into bowl”, she cracks an egg into a glass bowl on the countertop. 2. Time stamp “0:01-0:02”, description “2. Whisk eggs gently”, she gently whisks the eggs in the glass bowl. 3. Time stamp "0:02-0:03", indicating "3. Add seasoning carefully", she sprinkles seasoning into the bowl while holding the whisk. 4. Time stamp "0:03-0:04", indicating "4. Whisk faster", she whisks the egg mixture quickly. 5. Time stamp "0:04-0:05", indicating "5. Place pan on stove", she places the rectangular tamagoyaki pan on the stove. 6. Time stamp "0:05-0:06", indicating "6. Spread oil across pan", she spreads oil across the inside of the rectangular pan with a brush. 7. Time stamp "0:06-0:07", indicating "7. Food should be {argument name="dish" default="Golden-yellow Japanese tamagoyaki"} The kitchen atmosphere should feel{argument name="mood" default="Warm, nostalgic and cinematic"} .

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个 15 格电影感烹饪分镜脚本，展示一位年轻女性在乡村风格厨房中制作玉子烧的过程，每个分镜均需标注时间戳和步骤说明。

画布：宽屏 16:9 联系表布局，精确的 5 列 3 行，分镜之间有细白线分隔。每个分镜左上角有白色小字时间戳，左下角有带黑色阴影的白色步骤说明文字。

主体细节：一位精致的动漫风格年轻女性，拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="柔软的灰金色波浪短发"}，身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="带有蕾丝花边的复古米色碎花衬衫，领口系着深色蝴蝶结"}。她在充满架子、罐子、厨具、植物、温暖阳光和氛围感尘埃的温馨老式厨房木质台面上烹饪。为了保护隐私，她的面部在所有分镜中应保持柔焦或模糊处理，同时手部、食物、厨具和服装需保持细节丰富。

视觉风格：照片级真实感的电影动漫风格，温暖的金棕色调，浅景深，富有情绪感的自然窗光，质感十足的乡村厨房背景，逼真的蒸汽、油光、蛋液质感，以及手持电影剧照的氛围。

分镜序列：包含 15 个独立分镜，并带有以下可见标签和动作：
1. 时间戳 “0:00-0:01”，说明 “1. Crack egg into bowl”，她将鸡蛋打入台面上的玻璃碗中。
2. 时间戳 “0:01-0:02”，说明 “2. Whisk eggs gently”，她轻轻搅拌玻璃碗中的蛋液。
3. 时间戳 “0:02-0:03”，说明 “3. Add seasoning carefully”，她一边拿着搅拌器，一边将调料撒入碗中。
4. 时间戳 “0:03-0:04”，说明 “4. Whisk faster”，她快速搅拌蛋液。
5. 时间戳 “0:04-0:05”，说明 “5. Place pan on stove”，她将长方形玉子烧锅放在炉灶上。
6. 时间戳 “0:05-0:06”，说明 “6. Spread oil across pan”，她用刷子将油涂抹在长方形锅内。
7. 时间戳 “0:06-0:07”，说明 “7. Pour egg mixture”，她将玻璃碗中的蛋液倒入锅中。
8. 时间戳 “0:07-0:08”，说明 “8. Start rolling with chopsticks”，她开始用筷子卷起蛋皮。
9. 时间戳 “0:08-0:09”，说明 “9. Continue rolling”，她继续用筷子塑形卷好的蛋卷。
10. 时间戳 “0:09-0:10”，说明 “10. Pour second layer”，她在蛋卷周围倒入第二层蛋液。
11. 时间戳 “0:10-0:11”，说明 “11. Shape into rectangle”，她用筷子将玉子烧塑造成整齐的长方形。
12. 时间戳 “0:11-0:12”，说明 “12. Steam rises”，锅中在她面前释放出一团富有戏剧性的蒸汽。
13. 时间戳 “0:12-0:13”，说明 “13. Plate finished tamagoyaki”，成品金黄色的长方形玉子烧放在台面的盘子里。
14. 时间戳 “0:13-0:14”，说明 “14. Pick up with chopsticks”，她用筷子夹起一块一口大小的玉子烧。
15. 时间戳 “0:14-0:15”，说明 “15. Take a bite and smile”，特写镜头展示她用筷子将玉子烧送到嘴边，面部依然保持模糊。

约束条件：保持 15 个分镜的精确数量、精确的时间戳和精确的英文说明文字。不要添加额外的分镜、Logo、水印或不相关的文字。食物应为 {argument name="dish" default="金黄色的日式玉子烧"}，厨房氛围应感觉 {argument name="mood" default="温暖、怀旧且具有电影感"}。

templates.title: Polaroid travel flat lay photography on Awaji Island

titleLocalized.zh: 淡路岛宝丽来旅行平铺摄影

templates.prompt: Create a sunny travel flat lay photograph on beige linen, in a style similar to {argument name="destination" default="Awaji Island, Hyogo Prefecture, Japan"} A nostalgic seaside vacation memory. The main element is a large, slightly tilted white Polaroid photograph depicting a breakfast scene on a balcony, with a calm blue sea in the background and the Akashi Kaikyo Bridge under a pale blue sky in the distance. Within the Polaroid photograph are seven clearly visible breakfast items: a coffee cup and saucer with a red pattern, containing black coffee; a half-peeled banana; two slices of stacked white toast; a small glass bowl containing fruit and granola garnished with mint leaves; a dark grape or berry on top of the fruit; and a pale-colored round hard-boiled egg or dessert ball. Below the Polaroid photograph, in a white border, are handwritten Japanese text in purple:{argument name="handwritten message" default="Let's go and discover new sights. ♡"} On the left, partially beneath the Polaroid photograph, lies a slim travel brochure with a blue cover depicting a rocky sea arch and a Japanese title.{argument name="brochure title" default="Awaji Island, Numashima Island, Kamitachigami Rock"} and smaller subheadings{argument name="brochure subtitle" default="Numashima, Minamiawaji City, Hyogo Prefecture"} Arrange five beach still-life props around the paper: a woven straw hat at the top left edge, a light-colored seashell at the bottom left, a rough, cream-colored textile tassel at the top right, a dried orange slice at the bottom right, and a small leafy branch casting a shadow on the right. Use soft natural sunlight, gentle leaf shadows, and a color scheme of cream and ocean blue to present a realistic paper texture, shallow depth of field, a comfortable summer travel atmosphere, and a high-resolution editorial lifestyle photography effect. Avoid unnecessary objects, logos, watermarks, or extra text.

promptLocalized.zh: 在米色亚麻布上创作一张阳光明媚的旅行平铺摄影，风格如同 {argument name="destination" default="日本兵库县淡路岛"} 的怀旧海滨度假回忆。主体是一张略微倾斜放置的大型白色宝丽来风格照片，照片中展示了阳台早餐的场景，背景是平静的蓝色大海，远处是在淡蓝色天空下的明石海峡大桥。在宝丽来照片内，包含 7 种清晰可见的早餐物品：1 个带有红色图案的咖啡杯及杯托，杯中盛有黑咖啡；1 半剥皮的香蕉；2 片叠放的白吐司；1 个盛有水果和格兰诺拉麦片并以薄荷叶点缀的小玻璃碗；水果上放有 1 颗深色葡萄或浆果；以及 1 个淡色的圆形水煮蛋或甜点球。在宝丽来照片下方的白色边框上，添加紫色的手写日语文字：{argument name="handwritten message" default="また新しい景色に、出会いに行こう。♡"}。在左侧，部分压在宝丽来照片下方，放置 1 本纤薄的旅行宣传册，蓝色封面上展示着岩石海拱，并印有日语标题 {argument name="brochure title" default="あわじ島 沼島 上立神岩"} 以及较小的副标题 {argument name="brochure subtitle" default="兵庫県南あわじ市沼島"}。在纸张周围布置 5 种海滩静物道具：左上边缘放置 1 顶编织草帽，左下放置 1 个浅色贝壳，右上放置 1 块粗糙的奶油色纺织流苏，右下放置 1 片干橙片，右侧放置 1 根投下阴影的小叶枝。使用柔和的自然阳光、轻柔的叶影、奶油色与海洋蓝的配色方案，呈现真实的纸张质感、浅景深、舒适的夏季旅行氛围，以及高分辨率的编辑类生活方式摄影效果。避免出现多余的物体、标志、水印或额外文字。

templates.title: Screenshot from a short video of a Japanese classroom.

titleLocalized.zh: 日本教室短视频截图

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a realistic portrait-style screenshot from a mobile social media video, set in a classroom after school, similar in style to posts on Japanese short video apps. Canvas: 9:16 portrait image, 675×1125 composition, natural sunlight, realistic mobile phone camera texture, slight wide-angle perspective, high detail, non-illustration style. Main Scene: In a Japanese high school classroom after school, showcasing two girls in the foreground, wearing summer school uniforms. The girl in the middle is fully visible from head to mid-thigh, smiling shyly at the camera, holding a beige smartphone with cute stickers, the phone partially obscuring her mouth. She has {argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown"} The first girl has shoulder-length straight hair with thin bangs, a fresh and natural makeup look, and large, bright eyes. She carries a navy blue shoulder bag by the strap in her left hand. The second girl is positioned on the right edge, only half her face and part of her skirt visible, smiling gently at the camera. School uniforms and accessories: Both girls wear crisp white short-sleeved shirts, navy blue and green plaid pleated skirts, and navy blue striped silk bow ties. The middle girl carries a shiny navy blue backpack with eight clearly visible plush ornaments and accessories: a large cream-colored teddy bear, a smaller white teddy bear, a cream-colored bear with a pink bow, a fluffy white animal pendant, a lavender-colored plush pendant, a pink plush pendant, a beige tag pendant, and a metal chain pendant. Background: A busy classroom with wooden desks and chairs, a blackboard in the back right, and a large, sunny window in the left. The background features six students in white shirts: two sitting at desks in the foreground (back/side view), one standing or leaning against the window, two sitting in the middle/back, and one near the blackboard. The background figures should have a soft, blurred effect compared to the girl in the foreground. App overlay layout: Add a short video app interface overlay above the photo. The right-hand vertical toolbar contains five stacked elements: a circular avatar with a pink plus badge, a white heart icon (number "32,000"), a white speech bubble icon (number "162"), a white share arrow icon (number "392"), and a small circular thumbnail of a spinning record at the bottom. The lower left title area contains a white Japanese username and body text: "@".{argument name="username" default="yui._.daily"} • 3 hours ago, followed by "{argument name="caption text" default="There's something special about classrooms after school, isn't there? 🧸"} ", and then "{argument name="hashtags" default="#jk #afterschool #classmates #daily"} The text includes a musical note icon and the phrase "Original Music - yui._.daily". A black comment bar at the bottom contains placeholder text "Sutekinacomment wo Shoku...", and two icons on the right: an @ symbol and a smiley face. Visual style: A realistic snapshot of Japanese teenage life, warm natural light, clean skin texture, realistic clothing folds, accurate hand and finger details, realistic classroom depth, subtle social media compression, natural and refined. Constraints: Strictly maintain the number of foreground girls, background students, plush accessories, and overlay elements. Keep the image wholesome and free of indecent content. Do not add extra characters to the foreground, do not add watermarks, and avoid distorted text or deformed hands.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一张写实的竖屏手机社交媒体视频截图，场景为放学后的教室，风格类似于日本短视频 App 的帖子。

画布：9:16 竖屏图像，675×1125 构图，自然日光，写实的手机摄像头质感，轻微广角透视，高细节，非插画风格。

主体场景：在日本高中放学后的教室里，展示 2 名处于前景的少女，身穿夏季校服。中间的女孩从头部到大腿中部完全可见，正对着镜头羞涩微笑，手持一部贴有可爱小贴纸的米色智能手机，手机遮住部分嘴部。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 的齐肩直发，带有薄刘海，妆容清新自然，双眼大而有神。她的左手提着海军蓝单肩包的背带。第二个女孩位于右侧边缘，仅露出半张脸到裙子的部分，正对着镜头温柔微笑。

校服与配饰：两名女孩均穿着干练的白色短袖衬衫、海军蓝配绿色格纹百褶裙，以及海军蓝条纹丝带领结。中间的女孩背着一个亮面海军蓝书包，上面挂着 8 个清晰可见的毛绒挂件和饰品：1 个大号奶油色泰迪熊、1 个较小的白色泰迪熊、1 个戴粉色蝴蝶结的奶油色小熊、1 个毛茸茸的白色动物挂件、1 个薰衣草色毛绒挂件、1 个粉色毛绒挂件、1 个米色小标签挂件以及 1 个金属链挂件。

背景：繁忙的教室，配有木制课桌椅，右后方有黑板，左侧有高大的窗户，阳光明媚。背景中包含 6 名身穿白衬衫的学生：2 名坐在左前方课桌旁（背影/侧影），1 名站在窗边或靠在窗边，2 名坐在中后部，1 名坐在黑板附近。与前景的女孩相比，背景人物需保持柔和的虚化效果。

App 叠加层布局：在照片上方添加短视频 App 的界面叠加层。右侧垂直操作栏包含 5 个堆叠元素：1 个带有粉色加号徽章的圆形头像、1 个白色心形图标（数字为“3.2万”）、1 个白色气泡图标（数字为“162”）、1 个白色分享箭头图标（数字为“392”）以及底部 1 个旋转唱片的小圆形缩略图。左下角的标题区域包含白色日文用户名和正文：“@{argument name="username" default="yui._.daily"} ・ 3时间前”，接着是“{argument name="caption text" default="放课后的教室ってなんか特别だよね🧸"}”，然后是“{argument name="hashtags" default="#jk #放课后 #クラスメイト #日常"}”，以及一行带有音符图标的音乐信息：“オリジナル楽曲 - yui._.daily”。底部黑色评论栏包含占位符文本“すてきなコメントを書く...”，右侧包含 2 个图标：@ 符号和笑脸。

视觉风格：写实的日本青少年生活快照，温暖的自然光，干净的皮肤质感，真实的衣物褶皱，准确的手部和手指细节，真实的教室景深，微妙的社交媒体压缩感，自然且精致。

约束条件：严格保持前景女孩、背景学生、毛绒挂件和叠加层元素的数量。保持画面健康，无不雅内容。不要在前景添加额外人物，不要添加水印，避免文字扭曲或手部畸形。

templates.title: Campus-style fashion photography in the cinema lobby

titleLocalized.zh: 电影院大厅校园风时尚摄影

templates.prompt: Create a realistic vertical street fashion photograph, photographing a {argument name="model age" default="Young adult women in their early 20s"} A scene inside the lobby of a modern cinema in Shinjuku. Shot from a low angle near the glossy black floor, the subject is centered and appears slightly tall, with one foot casually stepping forward. She wears a Japanese school uniform-style outfit: a navy blue cardigan over a white shirt, a striped bow tie, a dark pleated mini-skirt, navy blue knee-high socks, and black patent leather loafers. She carries a black shoulder bag on her right shoulder, with a beige teddy bear charm hanging from it, and casually holds a smartphone in her left hand. She has long, straight black hair that falls over her shoulders; her face has been softly anonymized/blurred, lacking distinct facial features. The background is a stylish cinema corridor with a gleaming floor and cool blue ambient lighting; escalators and several pedestrians can be seen in the distance. Large illuminated movie posters are displayed on the left wall, along with a black movie sign that reads "109 CINEMAS PREMIUM SHINJUKU"; one poster prominently displays the pink date "4.25". Using realistic lens distortion and depth-of-field effects, the image presents clear details of clothing and accessories, natural walking postures, cinematic indoor lighting, and ground reflection effects, all without watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实风格的竖版街头时尚照片，拍摄一位 {argument name="model age" default="20 出头的年轻成年女性"} 走在新宿现代电影院大厅内部的场景。采用从光亮黑色地面附近拍摄的低角度全身视角，主体居中，在画面中显得略微高大，一只脚自然地向前迈步。她身着日本校园制服风格的服装：海军蓝开衫内搭白衬衫、条纹领结、深色超短百褶裙、海军蓝过膝袜以及黑色亮面乐福鞋。她右肩背着一个黑色单肩包，包上挂着一个米色小泰迪熊挂件，左手随意地拿着一部智能手机。她留着长直黑发，垂在肩上；面部经过柔和的匿名化/模糊处理，没有明显的五官特征。背景是时尚的电影院走廊，地面光亮可鉴，配有冷色调的蓝色环境光，背景中可以看到自动扶梯和几位远处的行人。左侧墙壁上展示着大型发光电影海报，以及写有“109 CINEMAS PREMIUM SHINJUKU”字样的黑色电影招牌；其中一张海报上醒目地显示着粉色的“4.25”日期。使用真实的镜头畸变和景深效果，呈现清晰的服装和配饰细节、自然的行走姿态、电影般的室内灯光、地面反射效果，且画面中无水印。

templates.title: Ultra-wide Indy racing cockpit view

titleLocalized.zh: 超宽屏 Indy 赛车驾驶舱视角

templates.prompt: Create a 32:9 ultrawide photorealistic racing game screenshot, viewed from the driver's cockpit on an Indy-style oval track.{argument name="race track" default="the Indianapolis 500 speedway"} The camera is positioned low inside the black open-wheel race car, showcasing the Halo/cockpit edge, the steering wheel with miniature digital telemetry data, partially visible front tires, and two rectangular side mirrors (one on each side) reflecting the track behind. Two competing open-wheel race cars are ahead: a black-blue car on the left and a yellow-orange car on the right, both shown from a rear view, featuring massive rear wheels and spoilers, entering a gentle left-hand sloping corner side-by-side. The motion blur of the asphalt surface, safety netting, and crowded grandstands creates a strong sense of speed while maintaining sharp focus on the cars and cockpits. The track is a large oval with white concrete walls, tall safety barriers, and full grandstands on both sides, with a scoreboard/benchmark in the far left center. Bright midday sunlight, blue skies and white clouds, cinematic HDR realism, glossy carbon fiber, richly detailed tire rubber—an immersive AAA racing simulator style. Small white sponsor-style text is added to the side of the cockpit, stating…{argument name="cockpit sponsor text" default="NEWGARDEN"} However, avoid obvious, legible markings elsewhere. No UI overlay, no watermark, no additional vehicles, and no text descriptions.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一张 32:9 的超宽屏照片级逼真赛车游戏截图，视角为 Indy 风格椭圆形赛道比赛中的驾驶员座舱，赛道为 {argument name="race track" default="the Indianapolis 500 speedway"}。摄像机位于黑色开轮式赛车内部的低位，展示了 Halo/驾驶舱边缘、带有微型数字遥测数据的方向盘、部分可见的前轮胎，以及两侧各一个、共 2 个矩形侧后视镜，反射出后方的赛道。前方有 2 辆开轮式竞争对手赛车：左侧为一辆黑蓝色赛车，右侧为一辆黄橙色赛车，均从后方视角呈现，带有巨大的后轮和尾翼，正并排驶入一个平缓的左转倾斜弯道。利用沥青路面、防护网和拥挤看台上的动态模糊营造强烈的速度感，同时保持赛车和驾驶舱主体清晰。赛道为大型椭圆形，配有白色混凝土墙、高大的安全围栏、两侧满座的观众席，远处左中位置设有计分塔/标杆。明亮的午间阳光，蓝天白云，电影级 HDR 真实感，光泽碳纤维，细节丰富的轮胎橡胶，沉浸式 AAA 级赛车模拟器风格。在驾驶舱侧面添加小型白色赞助商风格文字，内容为 {argument name="cockpit sponsor text" default="NEWGARDEN"}，但避免在其他地方出现明显的易读标识。无 UI 覆盖，无水印，无额外车辆，无文字说明。

templates.title: Anime cat-eared girl next to the lakeside statue

titleLocalized.zh: 湖畔雕像旁的动漫猫耳少女

templates.prompt: Create a bright, high-resolution composite scene of anime and real-world photography, located at a lakeside tourist attraction. In the foreground stand three adorable anime cat-eared girls, behind whom is a large, dark bronze abstract statue shaped like a tilted mask or seashell with hollow, eye-like openings. The background features a blue lake, wooden railings, green grass, lush trees on the left, distant mountains (including a snow-capped peak), and a clear blue sky with scattered white clouds. The style should combine delicate anime characters with a realistic outdoor travel photo background to create a cheerful, memetic atmosphere, showcasing bright sunlight, soft shadows, and vibrant colors. Main details: Show the three cat-eared girls. The girl on the left: With a short, brown-grey bob haircut, wearing cat ears, smiling with her mouth open, she wears an oversized light beige/white hoodie, paired with black shorts and black socks, showing the viewer a white spiral notebook with the words "..." written on the cover in simple, spaced capital letters.{argument name="notebook logo text" default="ECOLE"} The middle girl: A smaller, blonde girl with cat ears, facing forward, but her face is obscured by a flat, beige square mosaic. She wears an oversized red plaid hooded jacket, black shorts, and black lace-up boots, her hands raised near her face as if shy or hiding. The girl on the right: A platinum blonde bob girl with cat ears, smiling and pointing a finger to her mouth, wearing a cream-colored oversized jacket with a dark hood, black shorts, and black socks, standing in a playful, tilted pose. Add large, translucent soap bubbles around the characters: a total of 8 bubbles are visible, including 2 oversized bubbles near the lower left and lower right corners, 1 large bubble near the middle girl's legs, and 5 smaller floating bubbles in the sky and midground. Let the statues dominate behind the trio, giving the composition the feeling of fans gathering at a pilgrimage site.{argument name="location mood" default="sunny lakeside sightseeing"} ,{argument name="statue material" default="dark weathered bronze"} and{argument name="character style" default="modern cute anime catgirl illustration"} .

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张明亮、高分辨率的动漫与实景照片合成场景，地点位于湖畔旅游景点。前景中站着三位可爱的动漫猫耳少女，她们身后是一座巨大的深色青铜抽象雕像，形状像一个倾斜的面具或贝壳，带有空洞的眼状开口。背景是蓝色的湖泊、木质栏杆、绿草地、左侧的茂密树木、远处的山脉（包括一座雪峰），以及晴朗的蓝天和零星的白云。风格应将细腻的动漫角色与写实的户外旅游照片背景相结合，营造出欢快的模因式氛围，展现明亮的日光、柔和的阴影和鲜艳的色彩。

主体细节：展示 3 位猫耳少女。左侧少女：棕灰色短波波头，戴着猫耳，张嘴微笑，身穿超大号浅米色/白色连帽衫，搭配黑色短裤和黑色短袜，向观众展示一本白色螺旋笔记本，封面上用简单的间隔大写字母写着 {argument name="notebook logo text" default="ECOLE"}。中间少女：较小的金发猫耳少女，面向前方，但脸部被一个平面的米色方形马赛克遮挡，身穿超大号红色格子连帽夹克、黑色短裤和黑色系带靴，双手举在脸部附近，仿佛害羞或躲藏。右侧少女：白金色波波头，戴着猫耳，微笑并用一根手指指向嘴边，身穿奶油色超大号夹克，搭配深色兜帽、黑色短裤和黑色短袜，以俏皮的倾斜姿势站立。在角色周围添加大型半透明肥皂泡：总共可见 8 个气泡，包括左下角和右下角附近的 2 个超大号气泡，中间少女腿部附近的 1 个大号气泡，以及天空中和中景处的 5 个较小漂浮气泡。让雕像在三人组身后占据主导地位，使构图呈现出粉丝在朝圣地聚集的感觉。使用 {argument name="location mood" default="sunny lakeside sightseeing"}、{argument name="statue material" default="dark weathered bronze"} 和 {argument name="character style" default="modern cute anime catgirl illustration"}。

templates.title: DevKnow SaaS landing page

titleLocalized.zh: DevKnow SaaS 着陆页

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as a screenshot of the product UI, we transformed it into a beautiful Japanese SaaS landing page for use in [the following context].{argument name="product name" default="DevKnow"} Maintain the recognizability of the app screenshots by placing them on the right side of the home screen in a browser/model preview box with large rounded corners, appropriately reducing their size, and adding soft shadows and subtle purple abstract lines/gradient decorations in the background. Layout: Create a clean desktop landing page with a white background and purple brand color scheme. Add a top navigation bar, placing the existing logo/name on the left, five menu links centered in the middle: "Special Features," "Usage," "Reimbursement," "App Date," and "Questions," and placing "Login" and a purple CTA button "Start Free →" on the right. Home Screen Area: Add a small rounded badge on the left with the text "Delivering the latest AI/personal development news daily." Add a prominent Japanese title:{argument name="hero headline" default="Bringing the latest developments to you every day."} , and highlights the phrase "あなたのもとへ" in purple. Add auxiliary text below:{argument name="hero description" default="DevKnow is a news app that delivers a curated selection of the latest information on AI, tech, and personal development every day."} Add two home screen buttons: a purple main button “Start Free →” and a white secondary button “See How to Use”. Below the buttons, add three trust points with small purple checkmark icons: “Start Without Login”, “Can Be Released Even Now”, and “Can Be Used Through Web Browser”. Function Area: At the bottom of the home screen, add a centered purple “FEATURES” label and the title “DevKnow でできること”. Create 4 rounded feature cards with soft shadows and purple icons, arranged in a row: 1) Lightning icon, title "Everyday's 厳选ニュース", description "AI・テック・Personal Kailu's latest ニュースを掎日厳选してお session けします."; 2) Stacked layer icon, title "カテゴリで简単に検SO", description "Xingwei のあるカテゴリを选んで, necessary information にすぐアクセス."; 3) Bookmark icon, title "Saved してあとで読む", description "気になるニュースを saved して, あとでゆっくり読めます."; 4) Bell icon, title "Notification of escape", description "Important notice of escape. Notice of escape." Styling constraints: Make it look like a modern, launch-ready landing page rather than a raw app screenshot. Use wide margins, rounded corners, subtle drop shadows, purple gradient buttons, clear Japanese typography, and remove all clutter outside of your landing page design. Keep the reference app's UI content visible, but use it as a supplementary part of the landing page design.

promptLocalized.zh:
以 REFERENCE_0 作为产品 UI 截图，将其转化为一个精美的日语 SaaS 着陆页，用于 {argument name="product name" default="DevKnow"}。保持应用截图的可辨识度，将其放置在首屏右侧一个带有大圆角的浏览器/模型预览框中，适当缩小尺寸，并配以柔和的阴影和背景中微妙的紫色抽象线条/渐变装饰。

布局：创建一个简洁的桌面端着陆页，采用白色背景和紫色品牌色调。添加顶部导航栏，左侧放置现有 Logo/名称，中间居中放置五个菜单链接：「特徴」、「使い方」、「料金」、「アップデート」、「よくある質問」，右侧放置「ログイン」以及一个紫色的 CTA 按钮「無料で始める →」。

首屏区域：左侧添加一个圆角小徽章，文字为「AI・個人開発の最新ニュースを毎日お届け」。添加一个醒目的日语大标题：{argument name="hero headline" default="開発の「今」を、毎日あなたのもとへ。"}，并将「あなたのもとへ」短语以紫色高亮显示。下方添加辅助文案：{argument name="hero description" default="DevKnow は、AI・テック・個人開発に関する最新情報を毎日厳選してお届けするニュースアプリです。"}。添加两个首屏按钮：一个紫色的主按钮「無料で始める →」和一个白色的次按钮「使い方を見る」。在按钮下方，添加 3 个带有紫色小勾选图标的信任点：「登録不要で始める」、「いつでも解約OK」、「Webブラウザで利用可能」。

功能区域：在首屏下方，添加一个居中的紫色“FEATURES”标签和标题「DevKnow でできること」。创建 4 个带柔和阴影和紫色图标的圆角功能卡片，排列在一行：1) 闪电图标，标题「毎日の厳選ニュース」，描述「AI・テック・個人開発の最新ニュースを毎日厳選してお届けします。」；2) 堆叠图层图标，标题「カテゴリで簡単に検索」，描述「興味のあるカテゴリを選んで、必要な情報にすぐアクセス。」；3) 书签图标，标题「保存してあとで読む」，描述「気になるニュースを保存して、あとでゆっくり読めます。」；4) 铃铛图标，标题「通知で見逃さない」，描述「重要なニュースは通知でお知らせ。トレンドを逃しません。」

样式约束：使其看起来像一个现代化的、可直接上线的着陆页，而不是原始的应用截图。使用宽敞的页边距、圆角、微妙的阴影、紫色渐变按钮、清晰的日语排版，并移除着陆页设计之外的所有杂乱元素。保持参考应用 UI 内容可见，但将其作为着陆页设计的辅助部分。

templates.title: A cozy bedroom for cats to nap in.

titleLocalized.zh: 舒适卧室与猫小憩

templates.prompt: Create a warm, realistic photograph of a nighttime lifestyle, set in a bedroom of a small apartment: a person with {argument name="hair color" default="Medium brown"} An adult with hair was sleeping soundly on his side on a white bed, his face covered by a solid square privacy panel, and dressed in {argument name="top clothing" default="White sleeveless vest"} and{argument name="bottom clothing" default="Dark blue shorts"} In the foreground near its arm, a creature named {argument name="cat name" default="Kinako"} An orange tabby cat is curled up asleep on the bed, its head resting on the person's relaxed hand. An open paperback book sits near the person's hips on the rumpled white sheets. The room is designed to evoke the comfort and tranquility of a long day, with a warm bedside lamp providing illumination on the left. Background details: beige textured walls, white pillows, a tall window with sheer curtains and heavy beige drapes, a small bookshelf with books and trinkets on the right, and a wall-mounted air conditioner near the ceiling. The image is shot in portrait mode, using a natural smartphone perspective, with soft shadows, a warm interior color temperature, realistic fabric folds, a shallow and realistic depth of field, no visible text overlays, and no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张温馨、写实的夜间生活方式照片，场景位于一间小公寓的卧室中：一位留着 {argument name="hair color" default="中棕色"} 头发的成年人侧身躺在白色床上熟睡，面部被一个实心方形隐私遮挡块遮住，身穿 {argument name="top clothing" default="白色无袖背心"} 和 {argument name="bottom clothing" default="深蓝色短裤"}。在靠近其手臂的前景中，一只名叫 {argument name="cat name" default="Kinako"} 的橘色虎斑猫蜷缩在床上睡觉，头靠在对方放松的手边。在褶皱的白色床品上，靠近人物臀部的位置放着一本翻开的平装书。房间应营造出漫长一天后舒适安静的氛围，左侧有一盏温暖的床头灯照明。背景细节：米色纹理墙壁、白色枕头、带有透明窗纱和厚重米色窗帘的高大窗户、右侧摆放书籍和小物件的小书架，以及天花板附近壁挂式空调。采用竖屏构图，自然智能手机拍摄视角，柔和阴影，温暖的室内色温，真实的织物褶皱，浅而真实的景深，无可见文字覆盖，无水印。

templates.title: Lace wedding dress portrait in sunlight

titleLocalized.zh: 阳光下的蕾丝婚纱肖像

templates.prompt: Create a warm and sophisticated wedding fashion photoshoot, featuring a {argument name="bride description" default="A young woman with dark brown hair and an elegant low bun."} She sat on the plush beige carpet in the sunlit, minimalist living room. She was wearing a {argument name="dress style" default="An ivory white sheer lace wedding dress with a Victorian high neck, long fitted sleeves, delicate floral lace embroidery, and a long lace mermaid train that trails on the floor."} She leans slightly back, one hand on the carpet, her torso turned three-quarters of the way towards the camera, her legs extended diagonally to the lower right, her posture poised and elegant. The room's backdrop is a beige striped modern sofa, the walls a soft cream color, and a bright, large window on the right, revealing hazy greenery outside, bathed in soft golden morning light. A soft, neutral color palette of ivory, beige, champagne, and warm sunlight is used, with shallow depth of field to present realistic fabric details, showcasing delicate lace see-through while maintaining an elegant style. To protect privacy, the subject's face is deliberately blurred with a centered rectangular pixelation, but the hairstyle, earrings, dress outline, and pose remain visible. A small, delicate white signature-style watermark is added to the lower right corner. Photorealistic, luxurious wedding album style, soft highlights, natural shadows, tranquil atmosphere, square composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张温暖、高端的婚纱时尚大片，画面中是一位 {argument name="bride description" default="留着深棕色头发、梳着优雅低发髻的年轻女性"}，坐在阳光明媚的极简主义客厅的毛绒米色地毯上。她身着一件 {argument name="dress style" default="象牙白透明蕾丝婚纱，配有维多利亚式高领、长款修身袖、精致的花卉蕾丝刺绣，以及拖在地板上的长款蕾丝鱼尾裙摆"}。让她身体微微后倾，一只手撑在地毯上，躯干向镜头方向转动四分之三，双腿向右下方斜向伸展，姿态沉稳而优雅。房间背景是一张米色条纹现代沙发，墙面为柔和的奶油色，右侧有一扇明亮的大窗户，窗外是模糊的绿植，柔和的金色晨光洒满整个场景。采用象牙白、米色、香槟色和暖阳组成的柔和中性色调，浅景深，呈现逼真的织物细节，在保持高雅格调的同时展现精致的蕾丝透视感。为了保护隐私，主体面部应刻意使用居中的矩形像素化模糊处理，但发型、耳环、礼服轮廓和姿势保持可见。在右下角添加一个微小且精致的白色签名式水印。照片级写实，奢华婚纱画册风格，柔和高光，自然阴影，宁静氛围，方形构图。

templates.title: Four anime figures in a glass display case

titleLocalized.zh: 玻璃展示柜中的四个动漫手办

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic product display featuring four collectible anime idol figurines. They are arranged in a 2x2 grid within a dark glass display case, with black metal partitions separating the four compartments. Each compartment is illuminated by warm-toned, cinematic spotlights, creating a shallow depth of field and a high-end museum-quality 3D model effect through glossy reflections on the glass. Each figurine sits or kneels on a round, polished wooden base, possessing a softly blurred doll-like face and highly detailed resin skin, hair, clothing, ribbons, gloves, stockings, and metal accessories. The overall theme is {argument name="display theme" default="Luxurious Fantasy Idol Figurines in Antique Glass Cases"} The set includes four figures: The top left figure is a purple twin-tailed idol, dressed in a white, black, and lavender-colored ruffled stage outfit, sitting sideways with one hand on the base and the other arm outstretched, wearing knee-high socks and suspender details; the top right figure is a blue curly twin-tailed idol, dressed in a dark navy blue plaid school uniform-style outfit, kneeling on the base, one hand raised in a peace sign gesture, wearing gloves and layered ribbons; the bottom left figure is a soft-spoken pink-haired idol, dressed in a light pink ruffled skirt, sitting with one leg bent, one hand touching her head, wearing blue and pink stockings and a delicate bow; the bottom right figure is a short, white-and-blue-haired idol, dressed in a white, silver, and cyan outfit, with small wing-like shoulder details and star hair accessories, sitting cross-legged and pointing towards the audience. The figures are surrounded by antique props in the display case: framed art paintings, small books, vintage cameras, glass bottles, dried flowers in vases, a brass armillary sphere, lanterns with candles, and a large antique clock. The environment is maintained in deep brown and black tones, with warm amber highlights, realistic glass reflections, subtle dust and scratches, and a high-end collectible photography style. (Using...){argument name="aspect ratio" default="3:2 horizontal"} ,{argument name="lighting mood" default="Warm and evocative spotlights inside the cabinet"} ,{argument name="color palette" default="Dark walnut wood, black metallic, amber, lavender, navy blue, pink, cyan"} ,as well as{argument name="image realism" default="Hyper-realistic resin figure photography"} No text, no watermark, no extra figurines, no hand, no packaging box.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张照片级逼真的产品展示图，展示 4 个收藏级动漫偶像手办，它们被放置在一个深色玻璃展示柜中，以 2x2 的网格排列，四个隔间之间有黑色金属隔板。每个隔间上方使用电影质感的暖色聚光灯，玻璃上有光泽反射，采用浅景深，呈现出高端博物馆立体模型的视觉效果。每个手办都坐着或跪在圆形的抛光木质底座上，拥有柔和模糊的玩偶面孔，以及高度精细的树脂皮肤、头发、服装、丝带、手套、长筒袜和金属配饰。整体主题为 {argument name="display theme" default="古董玻璃柜中的奢华幻想偶像手办"}。包含 4 个手办：左上角是一个紫色双马尾偶像，身穿白、黑、薰衣草色相间的荷叶边舞台装，侧身坐着，一只手放在底座上，另一只手臂向外伸展，穿着过膝袜和吊带细节；右上角是一个蓝色卷发双马尾偶像，身穿深海军蓝格子校服风格服装，跪在底座上，一只手举起比出剪刀手姿势，戴着手套并有层叠的丝带；左下角是一个粉色头发的柔和系偶像，身穿浅粉色荷叶边裙子，坐着，一条腿弯曲，一只手触碰头部，穿着蓝粉相间的长筒袜和精致的蝴蝶结；右下角是一个短白蓝发偶像，身穿白、银、青色相间的服装，带有小翅膀状的肩部细节和星星发饰，盘腿坐着并指向观众。在柜内用古董道具环绕手办：装裱的艺术画、小书、复古相机、玻璃瓶、花瓶里的干花、黄铜浑天仪、带蜡烛的灯笼和一个大型古董钟。环境保持深棕色和黑色，带有温暖的琥珀色高光，真实的玻璃反射，细微的灰尘和划痕，以及高端收藏品摄影风格。使用 {argument name="aspect ratio" default="3:2 横向"}，{argument name="lighting mood" default="温暖且富有情绪的柜内聚光灯"}，{argument name="color palette" default="深胡桃木色、黑色金属、琥珀光、薰衣草色、海军蓝、粉色、青色"}，以及 {argument name="image realism" default="超写实树脂手办摄影"}。无文字，无水印，无额外手办，无人手，无包装盒。

templates.title: Monochrome giant urban black hole

titleLocalized.zh: 单色巨型都市黑洞

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic, futuristic cityscape viewed from a high vantage point, using monochrome black, charcoal gray, silver, and cool white tones. The image depicts an incredibly vast futuristic megacity, densely packed with thousands of towering skyscrapers, sharp spires, densely packed glowing windows, and a complex network of illuminated streets extending to the hazy horizon. In the foreground on the right, a massive circular black void is placed, like a perfectly dark abyss or man-made black hole embedded in the city, surrounded by countless bright concentric light trails that swirl like traffic or track data streams in a long exposure. The light trails form a broad vortex, brightest on the left and gradually fading towards the deep black center. Buildings surround and partially extend into the vortex, with some towers silhouetted against the glowing rings. The atmosphere is hazy, high-contrast, and apocalyptic, featuring volumetric fog, halos, fine details, subtle film grain, and a luminous horizontal band of fog near the distant horizon. The scene features no people, no visible vehicles, no text, and no signs; it emphasizes an overwhelming sense of scale, cyberpunk architectural style, and a surreal sense of gravitational distortion as the city is swallowed by a black hole.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅从极高空俯瞰的垂直电影级科幻城市夜景，采用单色黑、炭灰、银色和冷白色调。画面展现了一座规模宏大得不可思议的未来主义巨型都市，密布着数以千计的高耸摩天大楼、尖锐塔楼、密集发光的窗户以及延伸至朦胧地平线的复杂照明街道网。在画面中右侧前景处，放置一个巨大的圆形黑色虚空，如同嵌入城市中的完美暗黑深坑或人造黑洞，周围环绕着无数明亮的同心圆光轨，如同长曝光下的车流或轨道数据流般盘旋。光轨形成一个宽阔的漩涡盘，左侧最亮，并向深黑色的中心逐渐淡出。建筑群环绕并部分延伸至漩涡之中，部分塔楼在发光环的映衬下呈现出剪影。氛围朦胧、高对比度且具有末日感，带有体积雾、光晕、精细细节、微妙的胶片颗粒感，以及远方地平线附近的一条发光水平雾带。画面中无人、无可见车辆、无文字、无标志；强调压倒性的规模感、赛博朋克建筑风格，以及城市被黑洞吞噬的超现实引力扭曲感。

templates.title: Monochrome Bride Praying Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 单色新娘祈祷肖像

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic, black-and-white, artistic portrait of the bride in a 1:1 square format. (Exhibition/Display){argument name="subject" default="A bride"} Above the chest, her body is slightly turned to the right, with long, dark hair partially hidden beneath a sheer cathedral veil. She wears a gorgeous high-necked, long-sleeved lace wedding dress adorned with floral embroidery, beading, and subtle shimmer, and small pearl earrings. Her hands are clasped together in prayer position in front of her chin, fingers interlaced, creating an atmosphere of serene devotion. A large, opaque dark gray square is added to the center of her face, completely obscuring facial features while leaving her hair, veil, ears, neck, shoulders, and hands visible. The veil should drape from a lace floral headdress at the top of her head, diagonally covering the right side of the image and revealing delicate embroidered edges. Use soft, directional studio lighting from the upper left, deep shadows, high contrast, shallow depth of field, and a dark-textured charcoal gray background. Render as an elegant monochrome wedding photograph, showcasing realistic fabric textures, bright lace details, subtle film grain, and adding a white handwritten photographer's signature in the lower right corner.{argument name="signature text" default="C Hase"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 1:1 正方形画幅的戏剧性黑白艺术风格新娘肖像。展示 {argument name="subject" default="一位新娘"} 的胸部以上部位，身体略微向右转，长长的深色头发部分隐藏在透明的大教堂式头纱下。她身穿一件华丽的高领长袖蕾丝婚纱，上面布满了花卉刺绣、珠饰和细微的闪光，并佩戴着小珍珠耳环。她的双手在下巴前合十，呈祈祷姿势，手指交错，营造出一种宁静虔诚的氛围。在她的面部中心添加一个巨大的不透明深灰色正方形，完全遮挡面部特征，同时保留头发、头纱、耳朵、颈部、肩膀和双手可见。头纱应从头顶的蕾丝花卉头饰垂下，斜向覆盖图像右侧，并露出精致的刺绣边缘。使用来自左上方的柔和定向影棚灯光、深邃的阴影、高对比度、浅景深以及深色纹理的炭灰色背景。渲染为一张优雅的单色婚礼照片，呈现真实的织物纹理、明亮的蕾丝细节、细微的胶片颗粒感，并在右下角添加一个白色手写摄影师签名，内容为 {argument name="signature text" default="C Hase"}。

templates.title: Portrait of a tiger cub at a wildlife park

titleLocalized.zh: 野生动物园与幼虎的肖像

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic vertical-composition fashion photograph, with the subject being {argument name="subject" default="A young woman"} She leans confidently against a vintage wooden wicker chair in a dry, sun-drenched woodland or safari-like setting. Her long, dark, wavy hair is deliberately obscured by a centrally located, opaque square blur/mask. She wears a brown suede jacket over a dark-toned lace-trimmed cropped tank top, fitted cream trousers, and black knee-high boots. A tiger cub lies quietly between her legs, facing the camera with its front paws outstretched. Precisely count the main visible elements: a seated woman, a tiger cub, a vintage wicker chair, and a square obscuring her face. Use warm, golden hour lighting, dappled shadows cast on her clothing and body, a shallow depth of field, and a blurred, earthy-colored background with natural film grain to create a high-fashion safari editorial style. Showcase realistic skin and fabric textures with a 35mm photographic quality, using a 2:3 vertical composition. Add a small white signature-style mark and a Threads-style watermark in the bottom right corner. No additional animals or people should appear in the image, and no text other than the small watermark is permitted.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影感的竖构图时尚摄影作品，主体为 {argument name="subject" default="一位年轻女性"}，她自信地斜倚在户外干燥、阳光充足的林地或类似野生动物园环境中的复古木制藤椅上。她留着深色长波浪卷发，面部被一个居中的不透明方形模糊/遮挡块刻意遮住。她身穿棕色麂皮夹克，内搭灰暗色调的蕾丝边短款吊带背心，下身穿着合身的奶油色长裤和黑色及膝长靴。一只幼虎安静地趴在她的双腿之间，正对着镜头，前爪向前伸展。请精确计算可见的主要元素：1 位坐着的女性、1 只幼虎、1 把复古藤椅以及 1 个遮挡面部的方形块。使用温暖的黄金时刻光线，树影斑驳地投射在她的衣物和身体上，采用浅景深效果，背景为模糊的泥土色树木，呈现自然的胶片颗粒感，营造出高级时尚的野生动物园编辑风格，展现真实的皮肤和织物纹理，具备 35mm 摄影质感，采用 2:3 竖构图。在右下角添加一个细微的白色签名式标记和 Threads 风格的水印。画面中不得出现额外的动物、额外的人物，除小水印外不得包含任何文字。

templates.title: Photos of the gate of the Shenzhen factory

titleLocalized.zh: 深圳工厂大门照片

templates.prompt: Create a hyperrealistic, documentary-style street photograph of the entrance to a small electronics factory in Shenzhen, China. The shot should be taken from eye level on a cloudy day, across the road. The scene depicts an industrial building with white tiled facade and blue decorative lines. The front is three stories high, with long two-story wings extending from the sides. It features numerous rectangular green glass windows, wall-mounted air conditioners, and a covered entrance. The front wall includes prominent red Chinese characters.{argument name="building slogan" default="Quality First, Customer Supreme"} A long red banner with yellow Chinese characters hung above the main gate.{argument name="safety banner text" default="Safety comes from constant vigilance; accidents stem from momentary lapses in concentration."} On the right, there is a tall, dark red, glossy, vertical company sign pillar with gold Chinese characters printed on it.{argument name="company name" default="Shenzhen Fuhengchang Electronics Co., Ltd."} The building features a white spherical light at the top. An open, retractable stainless steel sliding door leads to the entrance. The scene includes nine visible figures: three men walking out near the foreground gate, one half-body man visible at the entrance, four people standing behind the covered passageway, and a small figure in the distance near the gate. There are four vehicles: a black sedan with blue license plates parked on the left, a white van cut off at the far left edge, a dark-colored vehicle vaguely visible inside the gate, and a red electric scooter parked on the right. There are four bicycles: a blue bicycle leaning against the gate in the foreground on the right, a black bicycle next to it, and two bicycles clustered near the scooter on the far right. A wooden utility pole is added to the left foreground, with multiple overhead power lines spanning the sky. Paper notices are posted on the pole. The ground is a gray concrete driveway, and low shrubs grow in a blue tiled flowerbed on the right. The background is a somber industrial environment. Employing the slightly outdated feel of early 21st-century digital cameras: natural but muted lighting, soft fog, slight lens distortion, gentle colors, realistic imperfections, clearly legible Chinese signage, no dramatic composition, and no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超写实的纪录片风格街头摄影作品，拍摄中国深圳一家小型电子工厂的入口。拍摄视角为阴天下的平视视角，位置在车道对面。场景展示了一栋白色瓷砖外墙、蓝色装饰线条的工业建筑，正面为三层，侧面延伸出长长的两层翼楼，配有许多长方形的绿色玻璃窗、壁挂式空调和带顶棚的入口。在前墙上，包含醒目的红色中文字样 {argument name="building slogan" default="质量第一 客户至上"}。大门上方悬挂一条红色长横幅，上面印有黄色中文字样 {argument name="safety banner text" default="安全来自长期警惕 事故源于瞬间麻痹"}。在右侧，放置一根高大的深红色光面垂直公司招牌柱，上面印有金色中文字样 {argument name="company name" default="深圳市富恒昌电子有限公司"}，顶部配有一个白色球形灯。入口前方是一个打开的伸缩式不锈钢推拉门。画面中包含 9 个可见人物：前景大门附近有 3 名正向外走的男子，门口有 1 名半身可见的男子，有顶通道后方站着 4 人，大门区域远处还有 1 个小身影。包含 4 辆机动车：左侧停放着 1 辆挂蓝色牌照的黑色轿车，最左侧边缘有 1 辆被裁切的白色面包车，大门内隐约可见 1 辆深色车辆，右侧停放着 1 辆红色电动踏板车。包含 4 辆自行车：中右侧前景大门旁靠着 1 辆蓝色自行车，旁边有 1 辆黑色自行车，最右侧踏板车附近聚集着 2 辆自行车。在左侧前景增加一根木制电线杆，多条架空电线横跨天空，电线杆上贴着纸质通知，地面为灰色混凝土车道，右侧蓝色瓷砖花坛里种着低矮灌木，背景为沉闷的工业区环境。采用 21 世纪初略显陈旧的数码相机质感：自然但平淡的光线、柔和的雾气、轻微的镜头畸变、柔和的色彩、写实的瑕疵、清晰可辨的中文标牌，无戏剧性构图，无水印。

templates.title: A bizarre Thanksgiving family dinner

titleLocalized.zh: 诡异的感恩节家庭晚餐

templates.prompt: Create a chilling, photorealistic scene of a 1970s American Thanksgiving family dinner in a warm, dimly lit dining room. Use a candid, documentary-style approach with a slightly wide-angle 4:3 composition. The scene should depict nine people seated around a round table: on the far left, an adult man in a white shirt, next to an adult woman, then another adult man in a white shirt and tie; in the center, a middle-aged woman; on the right, two little girls in simple dresses; an elderly man in a dark suit; an elderly woman in a patterned dress; and in the foreground, a young boy with his back to the camera. Treat all visible faces as eerie, smooth, square blurs or featureless occlusions, rather than normal facial features, while maintaining a high degree of realism in the bodies, clothing, hairstyles, and the room. The table, covered with a white lace tablecloth, is laden with a Thanksgiving feast: a large roasted turkey sits in the center, surrounded by mashed potatoes, green beans, cranberry sauce, baskets of bread rolls, stuffing or casserole dishes, gravy, plates, glasses, silverware, and small serving bowls. The scene must include three animals: a tabby cat sitting on a small chair in the lower left corner, a German Shepherd lying on the floor in the foreground, and a hound standing in the kitchen doorway on the right. The room is decorated with beige floral wallpaper, with a window with lace curtains on the left, a wooden china cabinet filled with plates and glassware, topped with autumn harvest decorations, framed pictures on the walls, and a black cross on the right wall. An old-fashioned wooden kitchen can be seen from the doorway. The color palette uses soft browns, creams, and ambers, with a realistic film grain, soft indoor incandescent lighting, and subtle soft-focus effects, creating an unsettling uncanny valley atmosphere. The image contains no readable text, no modern objects, and no watermark except for a blurry, pixelated mark in the lower right corner. Optional customization: Set holiday meal options.{argument name="holiday meal" default="Thanksgiving Dinner"} Setting the Era{argument name="era" default="1970s"} Change the room style{argument name="room style" default="Old-fashioned American restaurant"} Adjust facial treatment methods{argument name="face treatment" default="All visible faces are covered with a smooth, square blur mask."} and setting the atmosphere{argument name="mood" default="Photorealistic yet extremely eerie"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个令人毛骨悚然且具有照片级真实感的 1970 年代美式感恩节家庭晚餐场景，背景设在温暖昏暗的餐厅中，采用类似纪实摄影的抓拍风格，呈现 4:3 的略微广角构图。画面中需有 9 人围坐在圆桌旁：最左侧是一位穿白衬衫的成年男子，旁边是一位成年女子，接着是一位穿白衬衫系领带的成年男子，中间是一位中年女性，右侧是两个穿着朴素连衣裙的小女孩，还有一位穿深色西装的老年男子、一位穿花纹连衣裙的老年女性，以及前景中一个背对镜头的年轻男孩。将所有可见的面部处理为诡异的平滑方形模糊或无特征的遮挡块，而非正常的五官，同时保持身体、衣物、发型和房间的高度真实感。桌上铺着白色蕾丝桌布，摆满了感恩节盛宴：中心摆放 1 只大烤火鸡，周围自然地摆放着土豆泥、青豆、蔓越莓酱、篮装餐包、填料或砂锅菜、肉汁、餐盘、玻璃杯、银餐具和小型上菜碗。画面中需包含 3 只动物：左下角小椅子上坐着一只虎斑猫，前景地板上躺着一只德国牧羊犬，右侧厨房门口站着一只猎犬。房间贴着米色花卉壁纸，左侧有带蕾丝窗帘的窗户，后方有一个木制瓷器柜，柜内摆满盘子和玻璃器皿，顶部装饰着秋季丰收饰品，墙上挂着相框，右侧墙上挂着一个黑色十字架，门口可以看到老式木制厨房。色调采用柔和的棕色、奶油色和琥珀色，带有真实的胶片颗粒感、柔和的室内白炽灯光、微妙的镜头柔焦效果，营造出令人不安的恐怖谷氛围。画面中无任何可读文字，无现代物品，除右下角一个模糊的像素化标记外，无任何水印。可选自定义项：设置节日餐点 {argument name="holiday meal" default="感恩节晚餐"}，设置时代 {argument name="era" default="1970 年代"}，更改房间风格 {argument name="room style" default="老式美式餐厅"}，调整面部处理方式 {argument name="face treatment" default="所有可见面部均覆盖平滑的方形模糊遮挡"}，以及设置氛围 {argument name="mood" default="照片级真实但极度诡异"}。

templates.title: X's miniature 3D virtual avatar in front of their personal homepage

titleLocalized.zh: X 个人主页前的微型 3D 虚拟形象

templates.prompt: Create a vertical, cinematic-quality sci-fi 3D rendering. At the center of the image is a giant, transparent, glass-like Twitter profile page, standing vertically on a futuristic circular display platform. In the lower right corner of the platform stands a miniature, full-body 3D virtual avatar corresponding to the page's owner. This page belongs to {argument name="character name" default="Alexandra Aisling"} The account is{argument name="profile handle" default="@AllaAisling"} The virtual avatar is a stylish sci-fi explorer with warm brown skin, short curly hair, orange headphones/goggles, red-orange overalls, a short beige tactical vest, gloves, and thick-soled white-orange boots. The avatar exudes confidence, with arms hanging naturally at their sides. The face should be deliberately softened/blurred, in a non-realistic style, creating a personalized virtual avatar placeholder effect. Behind the personal profile card is an atmospheric nighttime alien city with a starry sky, glowing futuristic towers, and satellites/planets in the background, complemented by warm contour lighting and a shallow depth of field effect. The personal profile card should present a dark mode interface, resembling a large, semi-transparent flat panel with rounded corners and glossy edges. At the top is a wide banner image showcasing a desert sci-fi ruin: a white stone building with an arched opening and a domed ceiling, dusty mountains, clouds, and two visible celestial bodies. Above the banner on the left is a circular avatar, depicting a character wearing orange headphones matching the main avatar, with a blurred face. Next to her name is a blue verification checkmark icon, and to the right is a capsule button for "Edit Profile". Her visible profile text includes: Name "Alexandra Aisling", Account " @AllaAisling ", Bio "AI creator, redefining the boundaries of AI-generated art, exploring the future world through text and images. Adobe Firefly Ambassador.", Joined "April 2023", statistics "965 following" and "52,200 followers". She also has a community card called "Art Odyssey", described as "Connecting and collaborating with like-minded AI creators, sharing knowledge and skills, inspiring AI art innovation…", and "4.6K members". Seven navigation tabs are included: Posts, Replies, Subscriptions, Featured, Articles, Media, and Likes, with "Posts" selected and underlined in blue. Includes a pinned post by Alexandra Aisling, beginning with the text: “They call her ‘Ghost Circuit.’ She’s the last rogue who refused to surrender her thoughts to the city’s mechanical gods.” This is followed by, “Three days ago, she stole something buried beneath the megacity. It was powerful enough to awaken systems that should have been forever dormant.” Blurry interactive icons and data are displayed, including 112, 243, 1.8K, and 53K. Three foreground props are added to the platform: on the left is a glass dome-shaped ecosphere containing a miniature model of the same desert ruins; on the right is a metal bonsai; and on the right is a glowing foreground plaque that reads…{argument name="nameplate text" default="@AllaAisling"} Employing a high-end Octane rendering style, the image boasts rich material details, cinematic orange and blue lighting, realistic reflections, and a sense of volume, while focusing on the character and personal profile card. The composition remains centered, in a 2:3 vertical aspect ratio, with no other characters, watermarks, or irrelevant text.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张竖版电影级科幻 3D 渲染图，画面中心是一个巨大的透明玻璃质感 𝕏/Twitter 个人主页，垂直矗立在未来感十足的圆形展示平台上。在平台右下方，站着一个与该主页所有者对应的微型全身 3D 虚拟形象。该主页属于 {argument name="character name" default="Alexandra Aisling"}，账号为 {argument name="profile handle" default="@AllaAisling"}。虚拟形象是一位时尚的科幻探险家，拥有温暖的棕色皮肤、短卷发、橙色耳机/护目镜、红橙色工装连体裤、短款米色战术背心、手套以及厚底白橙色靴子，姿态自信，双臂自然下垂。面部应刻意处理得柔和/模糊，非写实风格，呈现出个性化虚拟形象占位符的效果。个人主页卡片后方是充满氛围感的夜间外星城市，背景中有星空、发光的未来感高塔、卫星/行星，配以温暖的轮廓光和浅景深效果。

个人主页卡片应呈现深色模式的 𝕏 界面，外观如同一个巨大的半透明平板，带有圆角和光泽边缘。顶部是宽幅横幅图片，展示沙漠科幻废墟：一座带有拱形开口的圆顶白色石建筑、尘土飞扬的山脉、云层以及两颗可见的天体。左侧横幅上方叠加一个圆形头像，头像中的角色佩戴与主体一致的橙色耳机，面部模糊。名字旁包含一个蓝色认证勾选图标，右侧设有一个“编辑个人资料”的胶囊按钮。

可见的个人主页文字：名称“Alexandra Aisling”，账号“@AllaAisling”，简介“AI 创作者，重新定义 AI 生成艺术的边界，通过文字和图像探索未来世界。Adobe Firefly 大使。”，加入时间“2023 年 4 月加入”，数据统计“965 个正在关注”和“5.22 万粉丝”。包含一个名为“Art Odyssey”的社区卡片，描述为“与志同道合的 AI 创作者建立联系并协作，分享知识与技巧，激发 AI 艺术创新……”，以及“4.6K 成员”。包含七个导航标签：帖子、回复、订阅、精选、文章、媒体、喜欢，其中“帖子”处于选中状态并带有蓝色下划线。包含一条由 Alexandra Aisling 置顶的帖子，开头文字为：“他们称她为‘幽灵回路’。她是最后一位拒绝将思想交给城市机械神的浪人。”，随后是“三天前，她偷走了一些埋藏在超级城市地下的东西。那东西强大到足以唤醒那些本应永远沉睡的系统。”显示模糊的互动图标及数据，包括 112、243、1.8K 和 53K。

在平台上添加三个前景道具：左侧是一个装有相同沙漠废墟微缩模型的玻璃圆顶生态瓶，右侧是一盆金属盆栽，以及一个发光的前置铭牌，上面写着 {argument name="nameplate text" default="@AllaAisling"}。采用高端 Octane 渲染风格，材质细节丰富，电影级橙蓝光影，逼真的反射效果，体积感氛围，并聚焦于角色和个人主页卡片。保持构图居中，竖版 2:3 比例，画面中无其他人物，无水印，无无关文字。

templates.title: Olympus Mythology Movie-Quality Poster

templates.prompt: Create a vertical, cinematic mythological travel poster with the theme of{argument name="mythic landmark" default="Olympus"} The design employs deep bronze and molten gold tones. The composition is symmetrical and grand: a small, ancient Greek columned temple sits at the center directly beneath a rocky hilltop, backlit by a dazzling golden sun or a sacred gate. Long, dramatic shadows extend forward from the temple. Behind the temple, luminous concentric sacred geometric rings, radiating lines, and faint star-like rings spread across the sky, as if drawing a celestial map. Huge storm clouds frame the sides, their interiors illuminated by orange fire, with the dark outlines of mountains faintly visible on the horizon. Above, the sky is a textured, smoky, and scratched parchment-like darkness, with faint circular celestial markers near the edges. It utilizes high-contrast cinematic lighting, volumetric lighting, a mythical grandeur, vintage poster textures, subtle graininess, and an atmosphere of a fantastical historical world. It includes two text elements: a large title at the bottom.{argument name="main title" default="OLYMPUS"} It features an elegant, wide-spaced Roman serif gold font with an embossed metallic highlight; a small italic slogan is placed centered below.{argument name="tagline" default="Explore with Visionaria, First Cinematic Imagination App"} Keep the layout clear and centered, and avoid adding extra logos, people, modern objects, or other text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张垂直的电影级神话旅行海报，主题为 {argument name="mythic landmark" default="奥林匹斯"}，采用深青铜色和熔金色的色调。构图对称且宏大：一座小型古希腊柱式神庙位于岩石山顶的正下方中心，被背后耀眼的金色太阳或神圣之门逆光照亮。长长的戏剧性阴影从神庙向前延伸。神庙后方，发光的同心神圣几何圆环、放射状线条和微弱的星盘状圆环在天空中扩散，仿佛在绘制天体图。巨大的风暴云团框住两侧，内部被橙色的火光照亮，地平线上隐约可见深色的山脉轮廓。天空上方呈现出带有纹理、烟熏且有划痕的羊皮纸般的暗色，边缘附近有微弱的圆形天体标记。运用高对比度的电影级灯光、体积光、神话般的宏伟感、复古海报纹理、细腻的颗粒感以及奇幻历史世界的氛围。包含 2 个文本元素：底部的大标题 {argument name="main title" default="OLYMPUS"}，采用优雅、宽间距的罗马衬线金色字体，并带有浮雕金属高光；下方居中放置一行小的斜体标语 {argument name="tagline" default="Explore with Visionaria, First Cinematic Imagination App"}。保持排版清晰且居中，不要添加额外的徽标、人物、现代物品或其他文本。

templates.prompt: Create a candid nighttime beach flash photo, with a person as the main subject.{argument name="subject" default="young women"} She crouched barefoot on the damp sand, wearing a short white spaghetti-strap summer dress with pink floral patterns. Her left hand held a lit sparkler near the sand, creating a bright golden halo and star-shaped sparks that illuminated her hands and the lower left foreground. Her right hand was near her toes, her knees were bent, and her body was in a three-quarter profile facing the camera. Her medium-length hair {argument name="hair color" default="brown"} The hair is disheveled, slightly windblown. The face is completely obscured by a centered, pure beige rectangular blur/mask, revealing no facial details. The background is a dark nighttime ocean with small waves lapping in, the wet sand reflecting the warm glow of streetlights, and a long, blurred, yellowish-white promenade of lights stretching into the distance along the shore. The design employs a grainy, imperfect film camera aesthetic, using direct flash, high ISO noise, slight motion blur, warm highlights, a deep blue-black sky, and a vertical handheld composition. There is no text, no watermark, no extraneous figures; only a sparkler, a crouching subject, and a single beige rectangle obscuring the face are visible.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张抓拍风格的夜间海滩闪光灯照片，画面主体为一名 {argument name="subject" default="年轻女性"}，她赤脚蹲在岸边湿润的沙滩上，身穿带有粉色花朵图案的白色细肩带短款夏季连衣裙。她的左手拿着一支点燃的仙女棒靠近沙滩，产生明亮的金色光晕和星形火花，照亮了她的手部和左下角前景。她的右手放在脚趾附近，双膝弯曲，身体呈四分之三侧面对着镜头。她中等长度的 {argument name="hair color" default="棕色"} 头发散乱，略带风吹感。用一个居中的纯米色矩形模糊/遮挡块完全遮住面部，不显示任何面部细节。背景是黑暗的夜间海洋，有小波浪涌入，湿润的沙滩反射着温暖的街灯，岸边有一条长长的、模糊的黄白色长廊灯光向远处延伸。采用颗粒感强、不完美的胶片相机美学，对主体使用直接闪光，高 ISO 噪点，轻微运动模糊，暖色高光，深蓝黑色天空，以及竖屏手机构图。无文字，无水印，无多余人物，仅可见一支仙女棒，仅一名蹲着的主体，仅一个遮挡面部的米色矩形。

templates.title: Cinematic Babylon Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 电影感巴比伦海报

templates.prompt: Create a vertical poster with a cinematic feel of ancient civilization, with the theme of{argument name="city name" default="BABYLON"} The design uses deep emerald green and antique gold tones to create a mysterious ancient Mesopotamian atmosphere. The canvas is a 2:3 long poster proportion with a thin, antique gold double-line border and a delicate, distressed parchment texture. A glowing golden crescent moon is placed at the top center, above the title. The background should include a subtly visible circular astrological chart, blurred cuneiform script, worn map markings, and a grainy film texture. Typography: The main title is in a large capital serif font, and the content {argument name="headline text" default="BABYLON"} The title, centered in the upper third, features an oxidized gold color scheme with a weathered texture. The letter spacing is wide, the font is classic and sharp, and the letter "O" contains a tiny star-shaped diamond detail. Below the title, a centered, small, elegant serif subtitle is added, containing the following content:{argument name="subtitle text" default="Explore with Visionaria, First Cinematic Imagination App"} A small decorative diamond ornament is placed between the title and subtitle. Body: In the lower half, a magnificent complex of ancient Babylonian temples and palaces rises from the darkness, symmetrical and solemn, with tiered terraces, towers, arches, long staircases, battlements, and small palm trees on the terraces. The city is illuminated by a green-gold atmospheric halo in the background, creating a dramatic silhouette and a hazy sense of depth. The foreground shows an underground river reflecting a faint green light, outlined on both sides by palm trees in shadow. Visible individual elements include: a crescent moon, a main title, a line of subtitles, a small central diamond ornament, a massive temple-city complex, a striking foreground palm tree silhouette on each side, a foreground reflecting river, and a small winged emblem in the center of the bottom border. Style: High-end movie poster design, ancient historical fantasy, lost empire aesthetics, mysterious astronomy, emotional lighting, fine grain texture, worn gold ink on a deep green background, high contrast, grand scale, no modern objects except for the subtitle text, no human figures, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张竖版电影感古文明海报，主题为 {argument name="city name" default="BABYLON"}。使用深祖母绿和古金色调，营造神秘的古代美索不达米亚氛围。画布为 2:3 的长海报比例，带有细长的仿古金双线边框和细腻的做旧羊皮纸纹理。在顶部中央，放置一个发光的金色新月，位于标题上方。背景应包含隐约可见的圆形占星图、模糊的楔形文字、磨损的地图标记以及颗粒感胶片质感。

排版：主标题设为巨大的大写衬线字体，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="BABYLON"}，居中置于上三分之一处，采用氧化金配色并带有风化质感。标题字间距较宽，字形古典锐利，字母 O 内部带有一个微小的星形钻石细节。在标题下方，添加一行居中的小号优雅衬线字体副标题，内容为 {argument name="subtitle text" default="Explore with Visionaria, First Cinematic Imagination App"}。在标题和副标题之间放置一个微小的装饰性钻石饰物。

主体：在下半部分，描绘一座宏伟的古巴比伦塔庙和宫殿建筑群，从黑暗中升起，对称且庄严，具有层叠的露台、塔楼、拱门、长阶梯、城垛以及露台上的小型棕榈树。城市被背后的绿金色大气光晕照亮，营造出戏剧性的剪影和朦胧的纵深感。前景展示一条暗河，反射着微弱的绿光，两侧由阴影中的棕榈树勾勒轮廓。

可见的独立元素包括：1 个新月，1 个主标题，1 行副标题，1 个小型中央钻石饰物，1 座巨大的塔庙城市建筑群，左右两侧各 1 棵醒目的前景棕榈树剪影，1 条前景反射河流，以及底部边框中央的 1 个小型带翼徽章。

风格：高级电影海报设计，古代历史奇幻，失落帝国美学，神秘天文学，情绪化灯光，精细颗粒质感，深绿色背景上的磨损金墨，高对比度，宏伟尺度，除副标题文字外无现代物体，无人像，无水印。

templates.title: 16-bit RPG battle screen

titleLocalized.zh: 16 位元 RPG 战斗画面

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image as the character source, convert it into a 16-bit pixel-style command-based RPG battle scene. Retain the original character's clothing, long blonde hair, overall silhouette, and the treatment of the faceless/blurred face, but redraw it as a playable battle sprite standing on the left, in a battle-ready stance. Objective: Create a retro Japanese fantasy RPG battle scene, similar to the command-based battle scenes of the Super Famicom/16-bit era. Scene Addition: Add an ancient ruined stone arena background, including broken arches, pillars, moss, vines, scattered mechanical devices, and an atmospheric depth. Place two monsters on the right: a tall plant/snake-like mechanical monster with a glowing blue sphere, and a small spider-like mechanical creature with a cyan energy ring. UI Layout: Add three dark blue RPG interface frames with thin white borders: a command menu in the upper left corner, a character status box near the lower left, and a dialog box at the bottom. Text: The command menu must contain four vertically arranged Japanese options: "tatakau", "mahou", "item", and "nigeru", accompanied by a triangle cursor pointing to the first option. The status box should display {argument name="character name" default="Fumi-nee"} LV 35, HP 320/320, and MP 150/150. The bottom dialog box should display {argument name="battle line" default="I'll clean it up quickly."} Style restrictions: Use clean 16-bit pixel art, a limited color palette, visible pixel edges, and a side-view RPG composition. Modern UI, realistic style, additional characters, additional menu items, and watermarks are prohibited.

promptLocalized.zh:
以提供的参考图像作为角色来源，将其转换为 16 位元像素风格的指令式 RPG 战斗画面。保留原角色的服装、金色长发、整体轮廓以及无脸/模糊面部的处理方式，但将其重绘为站在左侧、处于战斗准备姿态的可操作战斗精灵。

目标：创作一个复古日式奇幻 RPG 战斗场景，类似于超级任天堂 (Super Famicom) / 16 位元时代的指令式战斗画面。

场景添加：添加一个古老的废墟石制竞技场背景，包含破损的拱门、柱子、苔藓、藤蔓、散落的机械装置以及大气深度感。在右侧放置 2 个怪物：1 个带有发光蓝色球体的高大植物/蛇形机械怪物，以及 1 个带有青色能量环的小型蜘蛛状机械生物。

UI 布局：添加 3 个带有细白边框的深蓝色 RPG 界面框：左上角 1 个指令菜单，左下方附近 1 个角色状态框，底部 1 个对话框。

文本：指令菜单必须包含 4 个垂直排列的日文选项：「たたかう」、「まほう」、「アイテム」、「にげる」，并带有一个指向第一个选项的三角形光标。状态框应显示 {argument name="character name" default="フミ姐ぇ"}、LV 35、HP 320/320 以及 MP 150/150。底部对话框应显示 {argument name="battle line" default="さっさと片付けるわよ"}。

风格限制：使用清晰的 16 位元像素艺术、有限的调色板、可见的像素边缘、侧视 RPG 构图，禁止使用现代 UI、禁止写实风格、禁止添加额外角色、禁止添加额外菜单项、禁止添加水印。

templates.title: Cute Shanghai Q-version travel poster

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱的上海 Q 版旅行海报

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a painting based on{argument name="city name" default="Shanghai"} This adorable Q-version travel blogger poster features a giant 3D Chinese font as its visual center, showcasing cute miniature travelers exploring within it. Canvas: Vertical 2:3 poster with a bright, dreamy sky-blue background accented by fluffy clouds. It incorporates a scrapbook-style travel journal collage aesthetic, warm, soft lighting, and rich details with a gentle, charming style. Main layout: A large, glossy 3D sculpted Chinese character is placed at the center.{argument name="large city text" default="Shanghai"} The text occupies most of the poster space. It should be cream-colored with metallic beveled edges, rounded corners, and recessed windows. Within the strokes of the text, showcase a vivid miniature cityscape: the Shanghai skyline, the Oriental Pearl Tower, skyscrapers, riverside night views, historic buildings on the Bund, neon lights on Nanjing Road, boats on the river, and warm light and shadow from sunset to night. The 3D text should evoke the feeling of a walkable miniature city installation. Characters: Include five adorable Japanese-style chibi travel bloggers, all with round faces, petite figures, beige travel attire, bucket hats or baseball caps, backpacks, and cameras/travel accessories. Arrange them as follows: one small traveler sitting near the edge of the Oriental Pearl Tower in the upper left corner, holding a camera; one walking in the upper right corner, holding a folded map; one standing on the 3D text in the center below, like a little explorer; one walking in the lower left foreground, holding a camera; and one sitting or leaning against an orange suitcase in the lower right corner. Their faces can be simplified or softened, but their poses must remain lively and have the style of a travel blogger. Travel collage details: Add 10 striking paper and postmark elements around the central city text: a vintage postcard postmark in the upper left corner with "SHANGHAI" and a smaller Chinese/Shanghai travel mark; an overlapping circular airplane passport postmark; a handwritten title in the top center with the Chinese "旅行日记" (Travel Diary) and the English "Travel Diary"; a sticky note in the upper right corner with handwritten romantic travel text in Chinese and a doodle heart; a black vintage camera sticker near the note; a circular Shanghai passport postmark in the upper right corner with "SHANGHAI / Shanghai / 20.24.05.20"; an "I ♥ SH" sticker on the right; a boarding pass in the lower left corner with PVG, gate, seat, and Shanghai information; a small red baggage tag in the bottom center with "Shanghai / SHANGHAI"; and a postcard in the lower right corner with "SHANGHAI / The City / That Holds / All My Dreams" and a small skyline photo. Left-side itinerary text: Add a handwritten list on the left, including 6 destination highlights: Oriental Pearl Tower, The Bund, Nanjing Road Pedestrian Street, Tianzifang, Wukang Building, and Disneyland. Include dotted route arrows and the nearby phrase "Have a nice trip!". Bottom description: Handwrite a short Chinese travel note near the center of the bottom: "Next stop, Shanghai, to meet a better version of myself," accompanied by tiny smiley face doodles and postmark marks. Visual style: A combination of soft, cute Japanese-style illustrations with exquisite 3D fonts and travel scrapbook collages; soft colors, creamy highlights, shimmering city reflections, small petals/leaves, decorative tape, paper textures, soft shadows, and a cinematic, fantastical realism, making it charming and rich in detail. Constraints: Keep the large 3D city text "Shanghai" clearly legible, making city landmarks easily identifiable; use 5 cute traveler characters; retain visible English and Chinese text listed; avoid logos or watermarks; and do not add any extra characters.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张以 {argument name="city name" default="上海"} 为主题的可爱 Q 版旅行博主海报，以巨大的 3D 中文字体作为视觉中心，展示可爱的迷你旅行者在其中探索。

画布：竖版 2:3 海报，明亮梦幻的天蓝色背景配以蓬松云朵，剪贴簿旅行日志拼贴美学，温暖的柔和光影，细节丰富且风格柔和可爱。

主体布局：在中心放置巨大的光泽感 3D 雕塑中文字符 {argument name="large city text" default="上海"}，占据海报大部分空间。字符应为奶油色，带有金属斜面边缘、圆角和深陷的窗户。在字符的笔画内部，展示生动的微缩城市景观：上海天际线、东方明珠塔、摩天大楼、滨江夜景、外滩历史建筑、南京路霓虹灯、江上船只，以及从日落到夜晚的温暖光影。3D 文字应呈现出一种可供行走的微缩城市装置感。

角色：包含 5 位可爱的日系 Q 版旅行博主，均拥有圆润的脸庞、娇小的身躯、米色旅行装束、渔夫帽或鸭舌帽、背包以及相机/旅行配件。请按以下方式布置：1 位坐在左上方东方明珠塔附近边缘的小型旅行者，手持相机；1 位在右上方行走，手持折叠地图；1 位站在中心下方 3D 文字上的旅行者，如同小小探险家；1 位在左下方前景处，边走边拿着相机；1 位在右下方，坐着或倚靠着一个橙色行李箱。他们的面部可以简化或柔化处理，但姿势必须保持生动且具有旅行博主的风格。

旅行拼贴细节：在中心城市文字周围添加 10 个醒目的纸张和邮戳元素：左上方 1 枚复古明信片邮戳，写有“SHANGHAI”及较小的中文/上海旅行标记；1 枚重叠的圆形飞机护照邮戳；顶部中心 1 个手写标题，包含中文“旅行日志”和英文“Travel Diary”；右上角 1 张贴着的便签，写有中文手写浪漫旅行文字及涂鸦爱心；便签附近 1 个黑色复古相机贴纸；右上角 1 枚圆形上海护照邮戳，写有“SHANGHAI / 上海 / 20.24.05.20”；右侧 1 个“I ♥ SH”贴纸；左下方 1 张登机牌，包含 PVG、登机口、座位及上海相关信息；底部中心 1 个红色小行李标签，写有“上海 / SHANGHAI”；右下方 1 张明信片，写有“SHANGHAI / The City / That Holds / All My Dreams”并配有一张小型天际线照片。

左侧行程文字：在左侧添加一个手写清单，包含 6 个目的地要点：东方明珠、外滩、南京路步行街、田子坊、武康大楼、迪士尼乐园。包含虚线路线箭头及附近的小短语“Have a nice trip!”。

底部说明：在底部中心附近手写一段简短的中文旅行笔记：“下一站，上海 遇见更好的自己”，并配有微小的笑脸涂鸦和邮戳痕迹。

视觉风格：日系软萌 Q 版插画与精致 3D 字体及旅行剪贴簿拼贴相结合；柔和的色彩、奶油色高光、闪烁的城市倒影、小花瓣/叶片、装饰胶带、纸张纹理、柔和阴影、电影感奇幻写实，极具魅力且细节丰富。

约束：保持巨大的 3D 城市文字“上海”清晰可辨，使城市地标易于识别，使用 5 位 Q 版旅行者，保留列出的可见英文和中文文本，避免出现 Logo 或水印，不要添加额外的主角。
