templates.title: Alexandria Lighthouse Cinematic Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 亚历山大灯塔电影感海报

templates.prompt: Create a vertical, cinematic historical travel poster with the theme of{argument name="ancient city" default="Alexandria"} The image depicts the Lighthouse of Alexandria as a magnificent ancient stone tower on the harbor at sunset. The composition is 2:3 vertical, with the lighthouse positioned slightly to the right of center, rising from a solid waterfront base, topped with a domed lamphouse and a small statue. A dazzling golden beam of light shines diagonally from the lamphouse to the upper left sky, piercing through smoky clouds and atmospheric dust. The foreground shows the calm harbor waters reflecting the orange sunlight, accompanied by rocky coastlines and ancient docks. The image must include five clearly visible distant harbor elements: a sailboat on the water to the left, two tall classical columns near the horizon, a low building near the lighthouse base, and a faint silhouette of the city skyline on the far right. Employing a mythical, ancient civilization atmosphere, the image uses warm copper, amber, rose, and deep purple tones to achieve a painterly realism, an epic scale, soft mist, volumetric light, delicate film grain, and aged parchment texture. Add an elegant, thin double-line decorative border around the four edges, adorned with delicate corner patterns, and a small decorative badge panel in the upper right corner. Layout requirements: [Main heading/title]{argument name="poster title" default="ALEXANDRIA"} At the bottom, use wide-spaced classical Roman serif capital letters in a creamy gold color with subtle shading; below this is a thin horizontal dividing line with a small diamond-shaped decoration in the center; below that is the slogan.{argument name="tagline" default="EXPLORE WITH VISIONARIA — FIRST CINEMATIC IMAGINATION APP"} Use a small, capitalized sans-serif font. Make it look like a sophisticated movie poster for a lost ancient city, rather than a modern photograph. Avoid people in the foreground, avoid modern objects, avoid adding extra logos or watermarks; limit all visible text to titles and slogans.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖版电影感历史旅行海报，主题为 {argument name="ancient city" default="Alexandria"}，画面展示亚历山大灯塔，将其描绘为日落时分港口边一座宏伟的古代石塔。构图为 2:3 纵向比例，灯塔位于画面中心偏右位置，从坚固的滨水基座拔地而起，顶部为圆顶灯室及一座小型雕像。一道耀眼的金色光束从灯室斜向左上方天空投射，穿透烟雾缭绕的云层和大气尘埃。前景为平静的港口水面，倒映着橙色的阳光，伴有岩石海岸线和古代码头。画面中需包含 5 个清晰可见的远景港口元素：左侧水面上的 1 艘帆船、地平线附近的 2 根高大古典圆柱、灯塔基座附近 1 座低矮的小建筑，以及最右侧隐约可见的城市天际线剪影。采用神话般的古文明氛围，运用暖铜色、琥珀色、玫瑰色和深紫色调，呈现绘画般的写实感、史诗般的尺度、柔和的雾气、体积光、细腻的胶片颗粒感以及陈旧的羊皮纸纹理。在四周边框处添加优雅的细双线装饰边框，配以精巧的边角花纹，并在右上角添加 1 个小型装饰性徽章面板。排版要求：将大标题 {argument name="poster title" default="ALEXANDRIA"} 置于底部，使用间距宽阔的古典罗马衬线大写字母，颜色为奶油金色，并带有细微阴影；下方添加一条细水平分割线，中心配有一个小菱形装饰；再下方放置标语 {argument name="tagline" default="EXPLORE WITH VISIONARIA — FIRST CINEMATIC IMAGINATION APP"}，使用小型大写无衬线字体。使其看起来像是一张关于失落古都的高级电影海报，而非现代摄影作品。避免在前景中出现人物，避免出现现代物品，避免添加额外的标志或水印，所有可见文字仅限于标题和标语。

templates.title: Messi comic portal bedroom

titleLocalized.zh: 梅西漫画传送门卧室

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic vertical screen bedroom scene to showcase{argument name="footballer name" default="Messi"} Emerging from a giant, glowing comic book portal, the room is a cozy football fan's bedroom. At night, warm LED strips surround the ceiling, a table lamp adorns the left, and the walls are covered with shelves, posters, player card displays, and blue and red football club scarves and flags. In the center of the right side, a huge hardcover comic book stands like a doorway, its cover bearing the words "MESSI" in large, bold white letters, followed by "THE CELESTIAL JOURNEY," with fictional comic book details along the left edge. The comic's cover illustration depicts a shattered stadium scene, bright floodlights, swirling electric blue vortexes, fluttering pieces of paper, and a golden World Cup trophy floating within the portal. The player's back is prominently featured, wearing an Argentinian-style sky-blue and white striped jersey with "MESSI" and the number "10" printed on the back, black shorts, white socks, football boots, a captain's armband, and tattoos on his arms. One foot remains in the messy bedroom, while the other steps into the glowing pages; his face remains blurred or softly obscured. Place nine clearly visible scattered items around the ground: two game controllers, three scattered comic/magazine pages, a striped football jersey, a red outfit, a green hoodie, and a small pile of torn white paper scraps near the book. Add blue magical particles and sparks spilling from the book onto the carpet. Employing a dramatic, ultra-refined digital art style, it combines realistic lighting with comic book illustrations, featuring deep perspective, high-contrast cyan and orange tones, volumetric lighting effects, and a clear focus on the portal and jersey. It uses a 9:16 vertical screen composition and is watermark-free.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个电影感十足的竖屏卧室场景，展示 {argument name="footballer name" default="梅西"} 从一个巨大的发光漫画书传送门中走出来。房间是一个舒适的足球迷卧室，夜晚时分，天花板周围环绕着温暖的 LED 灯带，左侧有一盏台灯，墙上挂满了架子、海报、球星卡展示架、以及蓝红配色的足球俱乐部围巾和旗帜。在右侧中心，一本巨大的精装漫画书像门洞一样竖立着，封面上用巨大的粗体白色字母写着“MESSI”，下方写着“THE CELESTIAL JOURNEY”，左侧边缘有虚构的漫画期刊细节。漫画封面插图展示了破裂的体育场场景、明亮的泛光灯、旋转的电光蓝色漩涡、飞舞的纸片以及漂浮在传送门内的金色世界杯奖杯。球员背影为主，身穿阿根廷风格的天蓝色和白色条纹球衣，背面印有“MESSI”和数字“10”，穿着黑色短裤、白色球袜、足球鞋，佩戴队长袖标，手臂上有纹身，一只脚还在凌乱的卧室里，另一只脚正迈入发光的书页中；保持他的面部模糊或柔和遮挡。在地面周围放置 9 个清晰可见的散落物品：2 个游戏手柄、3 页散落的漫画/杂志页面、1 件条纹足球衫、1 件红色服装、1 件绿色连帽衫，以及书本附近的一小堆破碎的白色纸屑。添加从书中溢出到地毯上的蓝色魔法粒子和火花。采用戏剧性的超精细数字艺术风格，将写实光影与漫画插图相结合，具有深邃的透视感、高对比度的青橙色调、体积光效果，焦点清晰地对准传送门和球衣，采用 9:16 竖屏构图，无水印。

templates.title: Neymar comic-themed bedroom

titleLocalized.zh: 内马尔漫画主题卧室

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic 9:16 vertical screen fantasy sports bedroom night scene:{argument name="football star name" default="NEYMAR JR."} Wearing a yellow Brazilian national team jersey, blue shorts, green and white socks, and soccer cleats, he dramatically bursts out of a giant comic book poster against the wall, as if breaking through the paper to enter the real room. The poster's title, "NEYMAR JR.", is written in huge yellow comic book font on a sky-blue background. The poster's panels showcase a soccer field, the Brazilian flag, street scenes, and a soccer ball, presenting a bright, retro comic book style. The player is in a stride, leaning forward, arms outstretched for balance. Bright backlighting pours out from the torn hole in the poster, shredded paper dances around him, sparks and fragments float in the air, and the player's face is softened/anonymized. The bedroom is cozy and cluttered, illuminated by a warm amber table lamp and string lights where the walls meet the ceiling. The walls are decorated with eight clearly visible superhero/comic book posters: Spider-Man, Amazing Spider-Man, Batman, X-Men, Extraordinary X-Men, another X-Men cover, a partially visible Spider-Man poster on the left, and a dark space-themed poster beside the bed. Add a blue Brazilian football scarf/banner to the right wall. Include two bedside lamps, one on each side. Twelve clearly visible piles of miscellaneous items or clothing are scattered on the floor: a blue jersey, black headphones, two game controllers, a white shirt, a red and blue outfit, a gray hoodie, a pile of yellow Brazilian jerseys, a pile of green and yellow fabric, a pair of football boots, a single shoe by the bed, and scattered scraps of paper. On the right is a bed covered with messy bedding and a green and yellow scarf or blanket; on the left is a bedside table with a small speaker or electronic device and soft, realistic shadows. Style: Photorealistic room combined with oversized comic book art, dynamic magical realism action, warm orange ambient lighting, high detail, shallow depth of field, dramatic rim lighting, no watermark, and no additional readable text except for the poster title and a recognizable comic book poster title.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个电影感十足的 9:16 竖屏奇幻体育卧室夜景：{argument name="football star name" default="NEYMAR JR."} 身穿黄色巴西国家队球衣、蓝色短裤、绿白相间的球袜和足球鞋，戏剧性地从靠墙摆放的巨大漫画海报中冲出，仿佛打破纸张进入现实房间。海报标题在天蓝色背景上以巨大的黄色漫画字体写着“NEYMAR JR.”，海报分镜展示了足球场、巴西国旗、街景和足球，呈现出明亮的复古漫画风格。球员处于跨步状态，身体前倾，双臂张开以保持平衡，明亮的背光从撕裂的海报洞口倾泻而出，撕碎的纸屑在周围飞舞，火花和碎片悬浮在空中，球员面部经过柔化处理/匿名化。卧室温馨而凌乱，由温暖的琥珀色台灯和墙壁与天花板交界处的灯串照亮。墙上装饰着 8 张清晰可见的超级英雄/漫画海报：蜘蛛侠、神奇蜘蛛侠、蝙蝠侠、X 战警、非凡 X 战警、另一张 X 战警封面、左侧一张部分可见的蜘蛛侠海报，以及床边一张深色太空主题海报。在右侧墙上增加 1 条蓝色巴西足球围巾/横幅。包含 2 盏床头灯，每侧各一盏。地板上散落着 12 件清晰可见的杂物或衣物堆：左侧地板上有一件蓝色球衣、黑色耳机、两个游戏手柄、一件白衬衫、一件红蓝相间的服装、一件灰色连帽衫、一堆黄色巴西球衣、一堆绿黄色织物、一双足球鞋、床边的一只单鞋以及散落的碎纸片。右侧放置一张铺着凌乱床品和绿黄色围巾或毯子的床，左侧放置一个带有小音箱或电子产品的床头柜，并带有柔和逼真的阴影。风格：照片级真实感的房间与超大漫画艺术相结合，动态魔幻现实主义动作，温暖的橙色环境光，高细节，浅景深，戏剧性的轮廓光，无水印，除海报标题和可识别的漫画海报标题外，无额外可读文本。

templates.title: A football superstar who emerged from a comic book

titleLocalized.zh: 从漫画书中冲出的足球巨星

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic 9:16 vertical realistic fantasy sports scene with a background of a messy teenage bedroom at night: a life-size soccer player (similar to...){argument name="football star" default="Kylian Mbappé"} It burst forth from a huge, open comic book/poster leaning against the back wall, as if tearing open printed pages to enter the real room. The player wore {argument name="team kit" default="The French national team wears navy blue jerseys with red and white stripes in the middle, navy blue shorts, red socks, and white football boots."} He is in a striding pose, with a dramatic motion blur, one foot forward, showcasing realistic fabric folds and stadium-style highlights. Behind him, a huge comic book cover is displayed in bold white lettering.{argument name="main title text" default="MBAPPÉ: L’HISTOIRE"} The scene is accompanied by explosive blue, red, and white speed lines, torn paper edges, flying confetti, and multiple comic-book panels depicting soccer poses. The bedroom is cluttered yet immersive: it must contain 12 visible room details—a red and black gaming chair on the left, a bed on the right, a blue rug on the floor, a warm-toned LED strip running along the floor and bed edge, two game controllers on the rug, a pair of blue soccer cleats in the foreground, a pile of jerseys and clothing, a red garment near the chair, a cardboard box in the lower right corner, a soccer ball near a poster, and a wall covered with soccer posters and graffiti-style text. The design incorporates a blend of warm orange bedroom lighting and cool electric blue energy stripes, high contrast, volumetric lighting, dynamic paper pieces seemingly frozen in mid-air, a low-angle wide-field perspective, ultra-fine textures, realistic shadows, and a magical realism atmosphere. Faces can be slightly obscured or have motion blur, but body language and the soccer theme must be clearly defined. No other brand logos may be included except for the universal football logo; the composition should remain centered on the player leaping out of the comic book.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个电影级 9:16 竖屏写实奇幻体育场景，背景是夜晚凌乱的青少年卧室：一位真人大小的足球运动员（类似于 {argument name="football star" default="Kylian Mbappé"}）从靠在后墙上的一本巨大的打开的漫画书/海报中冲出，仿佛撕裂印刷页面进入了现实房间。球员身穿 {argument name="team kit" default="法国国家队海军蓝球衣，中间有红白条纹，海军蓝短裤，红色球袜，白色球鞋"}，处于迈步中的运动姿态，带有戏剧性的动态模糊，一只脚向前，展现出逼真的织物褶皱和体育场风格的高光。在他身后，巨大的漫画封面以粗体白色大字写着 {argument name="main title text" default="MBAPPÉ: L’HISTOIRE"}，伴随着爆炸性的蓝、红、白速度线、撕裂的纸边、飞舞的纸屑以及展示足球动作姿势的多个漫画分镜。卧室凌乱且具有沉浸感：必须包含 12 个可见的房间细节——左侧 1 把红黑配色电竞椅，右侧 1 张床，地板上 1 块蓝色地毯，沿地板和床沿布置的 1 条环绕暖色 LED 灯带，地毯上 2 个游戏手柄，前景中 1 双蓝色足球鞋，1 堆散乱的球衣和衣物，椅子附近 1 件红色衣物，右下角 1 个纸板箱，海报附近 1 个足球，以及 1 面贴满足球海报和涂鸦风格文字的墙壁。加入暖橙色卧室灯光与冷色电光蓝能量条纹的混合效果，高对比度，体积光，空中静止的动态纸片，低视角的广角透视，超精细纹理，逼真的阴影，以及魔幻现实主义的氛围。面部可以轻微遮挡或带有动态模糊，但肢体语言和足球主题必须清晰。除通用足球标志外，不得包含其他品牌 Logo；保持构图以从漫画书中冲出的球员为中心。

Items are arranged at varying heights on black marble, white marble, and dark stone cylindrical bases, some appearing to float in a weightless manner. Background: A dark charcoal gray studio wall with a softly glowing gold semi-circular archway behind the jersey, complemented by warm contour lighting, glossy reflections, soft shadows, and suspended decorative geometric elements including three gold spheres and three small gold polyhedrons. promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个高端方形 3D 时尚产品展示，在简洁的悬浮奢华构图中呈现 9 件核心时尚单品：左侧 1 顶黑色棒球帽，2 双黑米色拼色厚底奢华运动鞋（置于错落的石质底座上），1 件带有金色饰边及数字 10 的黑色足球衣，1 件带有黑金饰边及数字 7 的白色足球衣，中心悬浮 1 只金属黑金腕表，1 副带有米色/金色镜框的黑色太阳镜（置于大理石圆柱上），左下方 1 只带有垂直米金色条纹的黑色皮革旅行袋，右侧 1 只黑米色结构感设计师双肩包，以及右下方 1 双置于黑色圆柱底座上的抛光黑色正装皮鞋。使用 {argument name="color palette" default="哑光黑、暖金、奶油米色、白色和炭灰色"}，并呈现逼真的皮革、织物、金属、橡胶和大理石纹理。将物品以不同高度排列在黑色大理石、白色大理石和深色石材圆柱底座上，部分物品呈现失重悬浮感。背景：深炭灰色摄影棚墙面，球衣后方带有柔和发光的金色半圆拱门，辅以暖色轮廓光、光泽反射、柔和阴影，以及包括 3 个金球和 3 个小型金多面体在内的悬浮装饰性几何元素。风格：高端产品广告渲染、照片级 3D、电影级布光、清晰对焦、奢华精品店陈列、对称且充满动感的构图。通过 {argument name="black jersey number" default="10"} 和 {argument name="white jersey number" default="7"} 自定义球衣文字细节；包含小型徽章状装饰和星形细节，但不要出现可辨认的品牌名称或 Logo。使用 {argument name="aspect ratio" default="1:1 正方形"}。

templates.title: Bitter melon and lemon sparkling water poster

titleLocalized.zh: 苦瓜柠檬气泡水海报

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a vertical Chinese-style new product launch poster for a restaurant's beverage, featuring a highly realistic cup of {argument name="drink name" default="Bitter melon and lemon sparkling water"} Centered around fresh ingredients, selling points, pricing, and order guidance. Canvas: 3:4 vertical food advertisement poster, warm off-white/beige background, simple high-end restaurant menu style, combining commercial photography-grade high-resolution images with clean infographic labels. Utilizing soft sunlight, fresh dewdrops, crisp bubbles, and mouthwatering realism. Top Brand Area: A cute little green lion mascot logo is placed in the center of the top, followed by the brand name "Liangshou" and the slogan "Even bitterness is bitter but joyful." A thin decorative dividing line is added below. Main Title: A striking dark brown large Chinese font is placed in the center: "Bitter Melon Lemon Sparkling Water." An orange decorative pop sticker is added next to the title. Below is the subtitle "Hand-shaken Fruit and Vegetable Sparkling Drinks," decorated with small green leaves on both sides. Core Product Display: A high-transparency glass is placed in the center, filled with pale yellow-green soda water, showing a large number of carbonated bubbles, large ice cubes, bitter melon rings, lemon slices, and a sprig of rosemary on top. The glass should present a cool, moist, and refreshing texture, with condensation droplets and reflections. Water droplets are scattered on the table. Left side ingredient section: Title "Ingredient Highlights". Four ingredients are arranged vertically, accompanied by realistic ingredient illustrations and dotted curved arrows pointing to the glass: 1) Bitter melon illustration, labeled "Fresh Bitter Melon", subtitle "Remove the white pith, only use the green layer"; 2) Lemon illustration, labeled "Fragrant Lemon", subtitle "Hand-press to extract peel oil"; 3) Bubble icon, labeled "Soda Bubbles", subtitle "2.8 times the carbonation"; 4) Rock sugar illustration, labeled "Original Cane Rock Sugar", subtitle "Doesn't overpower bitterness". Right side selling points section: Title "Product Selling Points". Four rounded-corner white cards are stacked vertically. Each card has a circular icon on the left and Chinese text on the right: 1) Green heart icon, "Bitter first, then refreshing" / "Not astringent, not fake sweet"; 2) Green lemon icon, "VC bomb" / "One cup ≈ 3 lemons"; 3) Orange flame icon, "0 fat to relieve spiciness" / "Perfect match for hot pot"; 4) Green snowflake icon, "Icy texture" / "Cools down in a second". Bottom Price and CTA: The bottom left corner uses a black brushstroke style price tag containing small English "PRICE" and a striking white "..."{argument name="price" default="19"} The price is indicated by the text "¥/cup". A large, rounded green button with the dark text "Self-inflicted suffering" is added to the bottom right corner. A thin vertical line separates the price from the button. Half a lemon and a sprig of rosemary are placed in the foreground of the bottom right corner. Blurred green leaves are added to the foreground of the bottom left corner to increase spatial depth. Footer: A small app/platform icon and text are added to the very bottom: "Search 'Liangshou' on Douyin/Xiaohongshu/Meituan/Dianping". Visual style: Fresh lemon green and dark brown tones, high-end Chinese food poster layout, realistic food texture, clear condensation droplets, full of bubbles, clean layout, balanced white space, no watermark, no additional products, no people.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为餐厅饮品制作一张竖版中式新品发布海报，以一杯高度逼真的 {argument name="drink name" default="苦瓜柠檬气泡水"} 为核心，搭配新鲜食材、卖点、价格及下单引导。

画布：3:4 竖版美食广告海报，暖米白色/米色背景，简洁的高端餐厅菜单风格，商业摄影级高分辨率图像与整洁的信息图表标签相结合。运用柔和的阳光、清新的露珠、清脆的气泡以及令人垂涎的真实感。

顶部品牌区：在顶部正中央放置一个可爱的小绿色狮子吉祥物 Logo，随后是品牌名“凉兽”及口号“苦都苦得很快乐”。下方添加一条细装饰分割线。

主标题：居中放置醒目的深棕色大号中文字体：“苦瓜柠檬气泡水”。标题旁添加橙色装饰性爆炸贴。下方放置副标题“手摇蔬果气泡饮”，两侧点缀小绿叶装饰。

核心产品展示：中央放置一个高透明玻璃杯，杯中盛满淡黄绿色苏打水，可见大量碳酸气泡、大块冰块、苦瓜圈、柠檬片，顶部插有一枝迷迭香。玻璃杯需呈现出冰凉、湿润、清爽的质感，带有冷凝水珠和倒影。桌面散落水滴。

左侧成分区：标题“成分亮点”。垂直排列 4 项成分，配以逼真的成分插图，并有虚线弧形箭头指向玻璃杯：1) 苦瓜插图，标注“新鲜苦瓜”，副标题“去白瓤，只取翠绿层”；2) 柠檬插图，标注“香水柠檬”，副标题“手压取皮油”；3) 气泡图标，标注“苏打气泡”，副标题“2.8倍含气量”；4) 冰糖插图，标注“原蔗冰糖”，副标题“不抢苦味”。

右侧卖点区：标题“产品卖点”。垂直堆叠 4 张圆角白色卡片，每张卡片左侧为圆形图标，右侧为中文文本：1) 绿色爱心图标，“先苦后爽” / “不涩不假甜”；2) 绿色柠檬图标，“VC炸弹” / “一杯≈3颗柠檬”；3) 橙色火焰图标，“0脂解辣” / “火锅绝配”；4) 绿色雪花图标，“冰爽质感” / “一秒降温”。

底部价格与 CTA：左下角使用黑色笔触风格的价格标签，包含小号英文“PRICE”、醒目的白色“{argument name="price" default="19"}”及“元 / 杯”。右下角添加一个大型圆角绿色按钮，内含深色文字“自讨苦吃”。价格与按钮之间用细竖线分隔。右下角前景放置半个柠檬和迷迭香枝。左下角前景添加模糊的绿叶以增加空间深度。

页脚：最底部添加小型 App/平台图标及文字：“抖音 / 小红书 / 美团 / 大众点评 搜索：凉兽”。

视觉风格：清新的柠檬绿与深棕色调，高端中式美食海报排版，逼真的食物质感，清晰的冷凝水珠，气泡感十足，排版整洁，留白平衡，无水印，无额外产品，无人物。

templates.title: Cristiano Ronaldo comic poster bedroom scene

titleLocalized.zh: C 罗漫画海报卧室场景

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic, vertical bedroom scene in 9:16 proportions, showcasing a life-size football superstar in a Portuguese red and green number 7 jersey bursting through a giant cartoon poster in a teenager's room. The poster, leaning against a graffiti wall, features the words "CRISTIANO RONALDO: Lenda Viva" in a striking retro cartoon font, with an old-school trading card-style stripe on the left labeled "ABE" and "5022". The player's face should be deliberately blurred with soft, square shapes, while the body is depicted in a dynamic running pose with sharp details; one hand is raised, and dramatic golden backlighting bursts from the torn opening in the poster. The poster art comprises six clearly visible cartoon panels: a panel of the Portuguese flag, a panel of the stadium, a panel of the pitch, a panel of spectators/stadium, a panel of an abstract red and green football, and a lower action/cartoon panel; add shredded paper around the figure. The room should evoke the atmosphere of a messy fan bedroom at dusk, with warm string lights hanging from the ceiling, casting melancholic blue-orange hues. Graffiti labels adorn the walls, and sports memorabilia is scattered everywhere. In addition to a large comic book poster, there should be five wall posters: one for a football player on the left wall, another above the dressing table, a black-and-white poster of a band with "BAND BAN" on the right wall, a smaller poster of a football action, and a poster of the Portuguese flag. Three game controllers and a smartphone displaying football-themed images should be placed on the floor. A gold trophy and a smaller gold trophy should be on the dressing table. A lit desk lamp should be on the left desk. Two beds or low sleeping areas should be covered with crumpled blankets. A pair of red sneakers should be placed beside the right bed. Portuguese jerseys and clothing should be scattered on the wooden floor. Style: Highly detailed 3D digital illustrations featuring photorealistic interior lighting, comic book poster graphics, saturated red and green tones, dramatic volumetric lighting, a warm sense of clutter, realistic fabric folds, and clear depth of field. No watermark is present, and there is no readable text other than the designated comic book poster text.{argument name="footballer name" default="CRISTIANO RONALDO"} ,{argument name="subtitle text" default="Lenda Viva"} ,{argument name="team colors" default="Portuguese red and green"} ,{argument name="room theme" default="teenage soccer fan's bedroom"} as well as{argument name="poster genre" default="Retro comic book superhero sports poster"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个电影感十足的竖版卧室场景，比例为 9:16，展示一位真人大小的足球巨星身穿葡萄牙红绿色 7 号球衣，从青少年房间里的一张巨大漫画海报中破壁而出。海报靠在涂鸦墙上，上面用醒目的复古漫画字体写着“CRISTIANO RONALDO: Lenda Viva”，左侧带有旧式球星卡风格的条带，标注为“ABE”和“5022”。球员面部应刻意用柔和的方形模糊处理，而身体则以动态奔跑姿势呈现，细节清晰，一只手抬起，戏剧性的金色背光从撕裂的海报开口处喷薄而出。海报艺术包含 6 个清晰可见的漫画分镜：一个葡萄牙国旗分镜、一个体育场分镜、一个球场分镜、一个观众/体育场分镜、一个红绿色抽象足球分镜，以及一个下方的动作/漫画分镜；在人物周围添加飞舞的碎纸片。房间应营造出黄昏时分凌乱的粉丝卧室氛围，天花板上挂着温暖的串灯，光影呈现忧郁的蓝橙色调，墙上有涂鸦标签，到处都是体育纪念品。在巨大的漫画海报外，需包含 5 张墙面海报：左墙一张足球运动员海报，梳妆台上方一张足球运动员海报，右墙一张写有“BAND BAN”的黑白乐队海报，一张较小的足球动作海报，以及一张葡萄牙国旗海报。地板上放置 3 个游戏手柄，1 部显示足球主题图像的智能手机，梳妆台上放置 1 个金奖杯和 1 个较小的金奖杯，左侧书桌上有一盏发光的台灯，2 张床或低矮的睡眠区铺着褶皱的毯子，右侧床边有一双红色运动鞋，木地板上散落着葡萄牙球衣和衣物。风格：高度精细的 3D 数字插画，具有照片级的室内光影、漫画海报图形、饱和的红绿色调、戏剧性的体积光、温馨的杂乱感、逼真的织物褶皱、清晰的景深，无水印，除指定的漫画海报文字外无其他可读文字。使用 {argument name="footballer name" default="CRISTIANO RONALDO"}、{argument name="subtitle text" default="Lenda Viva"}、{argument name="team colors" default="葡萄牙红绿色"}、{argument name="room theme" default="青少年足球迷卧室"} 以及 {argument name="poster genre" default="复古漫画超级英雄体育海报"}。

templates.title: Chinese-style pickled fish restaurant poster

titleLocalized.zh: 中式酸菜鱼餐厅海报

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="dish name" default="Old Altar Pickled Fish"} Create a vertical poster for a new Chinese restaurant menu, emphasizing appetizing appeal, authentic food texture, ingredients, selling points, and clear pricing and ordering instructions. Canvas: Vertical 2:3 poster with a warm off-white Xuan paper background featuring fine fibers. The bottom edge incorporates subtle ink wash landscape elements, presenting a high-end Chinese restaurant advertising style. Top: Centered circular logo with a simple fish and wavy lines. Below: Brand name.{argument name="brand name" default="Fishing Hall White"} The slogan is "Sour and Refreshing with Spirit." A large black calligraphic title, "Old Altar Pickled Fish," spans the upper third of the poster, flanked by small orange ink splashes. The main visual features a steaming bowl of golden broth pickled fish, served in a ceramic bowl with a blue-gray landscape pattern. The broth is a glossy bright yellow, revealing chopped pickled cabbage, tender white fish slices, dried red chilies, Sichuan peppercorns, shredded ginger, sesame-like spices, and rising steam. The poster maintains a realistic and appetizing presentation while keeping the graphics elegant and clean. A central, ornate rounded rectangular label sits above the bowl, containing the gold text "Golden Broth Pickled Fish" and a thin border. The left-side ingredient section is titled "Selected Ingredients." Four ingredients are displayed vertically, each accompanied by a small round food photo and text: 1) "Fresh Fish Slices" with the subtitle "Freshly Sliced ​​from Live Fish, Tender Yet Not Falling Apart," 2) "Old-Fashioned Pickled Cabbage" with the subtitle "Fermented for 90 Days, Tart and Crisp with a Lingering Aftertaste," 3) "Pork Bone Broth" with the subtitle "Slow-Simmered for 8 Hours," 4) "Red Bell Peppers + Green Sichuan Peppercorns" with the subtitle "One Spicy, One Numbing." A thin orange dotted line connects the four items. The right-hand selling point section is titled "Product Highlights." Four rounded-corner white cards are also displayed vertically, each with a simple orange/green icon and text: 1) Fish icon, "Fish Killed Freshly" and "Each Slice with Skin," 2) Water Drop icon, "25% Less Salt" and "No Dry Mouth After Drinking Soup," 3) Jar icon, "Sichuan-Style Old-Fashioned Jar" and "Naturally Fermented, No Additives," 4) Rice Bowl icon, "Perfect for Eating Rice" and "One Fish, Three Bowls of Rice." Price and CTA: Draw a wide, dark brown brushstroke below the bowl. Place a large, handwritten-style white price tag above it.{argument name="price" default="49"} This is followed by "Yuan/portion". Below this, add a text in white.{argument name="call to action" default="A refreshing order"} The page features a bright orange rounded button with a circular icon bearing a right arrow. The footer includes the small text "More Promotions | Search Yutangbai". Below are four small circular platform icons/tags: a TikTok-style musical note, "Xiaohongshu", "Meituan", and a simple portrait/share icon. The visual style is that of a high-end Chinese food poster, combining realistic photographs of steaming dishes with calligraphic fonts. It uses warm cream/gold/orange/brown tones, with a symmetrical and clean layout. The soup base has a strong texture and a glossy finish, and the image is uncluttered, with no additional dishes or text added except for designated elements.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="dish name" default="老坛酸菜鱼"} 创建一张竖版中式餐厅新品海报，强调食欲感、真实的食物质感、食材、卖点以及清晰的价格与下单引导。

画布：竖版 2:3 海报，采用带有细微纤维的暖米白色宣纸背景，底部边缘带有淡淡的水墨山水，呈现高端中式餐饮广告风格。

顶部品牌：居中放置圆形 Logo，图案为简单的鱼与波浪线。下方放置品牌名称 {argument name="brand name" default="渔堂白"} 及标语「酸爽有骨气」。在上部三分之一处横跨巨大的黑色书法标题「老坛酸菜鱼」，两侧带有橙色的小泼墨点缀。

主视觉：中心展示一碗冒着热气的金汤酸菜鱼，盛装在带有蓝灰色山水纹样的陶瓷碗中。汤底呈现光泽的亮黄色，可见切碎的酸菜、鲜嫩的白鱼片、红干辣椒、青花椒、黄姜丝、芝麻状香料以及升腾的热气。保持食物的写实感与高食欲感，同时海报图形保持优雅整洁。

中央标签：在碗上方放置一个华丽的圆角矩形标签，内含金色文字「金汤酸菜鱼」及细边装饰。

左侧食材栏：标题「精选食材」。垂直堆叠展示 4 种食材，每项配有小圆形食物照片及文字：1) 「鲜鱼片」配副标题「活鱼现切，嫩而不散」，2) 「老坛酸菜」配副标题「发酵 90 天，酸脆回味」，3) 「猪骨高汤」配副标题「8 小时慢熬」，4) 「红灯笼椒+青花椒」配副标题「一辣一麻」。用一条细橙色虚线将 4 项内容连接。

右侧卖点栏：标题「产品亮点」。垂直堆叠展示 4 张圆角白色卡片，每张配有一个简单的橙色/绿色图标及文字：1) 鱼图标，「当鱼现杀」及「每片都带皮」，2) 水滴图标，「减盐 25%」及「喝汤不口干」，3) 坛子图标，「川式老坛」及「自然发酵无添加」，4) 饭碗图标，「下饭神器」及「一鱼三碗饭」。

价格与 CTA：在碗下方绘制一道宽大的深棕色毛笔刷痕。上方放置手写风格的大号白色价格 {argument name="price" default="49"}，后接「元 / 份」。下方添加一个带有白色文字 {argument name="call to action" default="酸爽下单"} 的亮橙色圆角按钮，并配有一个带右箭头的圆形图标。

页脚：添加小字「更多优惠活动 | 搜索 渔堂白」。下方放置 4 个小型圆形平台图标/标签：抖音风格音符、「小红书」、「美团」以及一个简单的人像/分享图标。

视觉风格：高端中式美食海报，写实的冒热气菜品摄影与书法字体相结合，采用暖奶油色/金色/橙色/棕色调，布局对称整洁，汤底质感强且有光泽，画面无杂乱，除指定元素外不添加额外菜品或文字。

templates.title: Mango and coconut dessert poster

titleLocalized.zh: 芒果椰子甜品海报

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="product name" default="Mango Pomelo Sago with Thick Coconut Milk"} Create a vertical Chinese restaurant promotional poster advertising a refreshing chilled dessert bowl. The poster should realistically and enticingly showcase the texture, ingredients, selling points, and price. Canvas: Vertical 2:3 poster, warm creamy beige background with a soft tropical sunlight feel, subtle palm leaf shadow in the upper right corner, a blurred lemon drink in the upper left corner, and scattered fruit props in the bottom corner, presenting an advertising style for a high-end dessert shop. Layout: Centered composition. Place the coconut brand logo and brand name at the top.{argument name="brand name" default="Coconut Palace"} Below, the text reads "Sweet with Layers" and features a delicate decorative dividing line. The title, "Mango Pomelo Sago Thick Coconut Milk Bowl," is in large, dark brown Chinese font. Below the title is a rounded gold capsule label containing the words "Iced Dessert Bowl," along with a small bowl icon and a snowflake icon. The central image is a transparent glass bowl filled with mango puree, rich coconut milk, glistening boba, red grapefruit segments, and glistening mango chunks. A gold spoon reaches in from the upper right corner, scooping up mango chunks, boba, grapefruit, and dripping coconut milk. A mint leaf garnishes the top for added freshness. Food details: Ensuring the dessert is hyper-realistic and glossy, the five ingredients—mango chunks, rich coconut milk, red grapefruit segments, glistening boba, and mint leaves—are clearly visible in the bowl. The image showcases the towering mango chunks, the creamy white coconut milk layer around the rim, the orange mango puree at the bottom, and the refreshing coolness of the condensation droplets. Left sidebar: A rounded-corner, vertical cream-colored card titled "Ingredient Highlights," containing four vertically arranged ingredient highlights, each accompanied by a realistic illustration and Chinese description: 1) Mango illustration, "Irwin Mango / No puree, retains the pulp"; 2) Coconut illustration, "Thai Coconut Milk / Freshly squeezed from coconut meat"; 3) Grapefruit illustration, "Red grapefruit segments / Bursting with juice and slightly bitter"; 4) Boba illustration, "Crispy boba / No artificial flavors." Right sidebar: A rounded-corner, vertical cream-colored card titled "Product Selling Points," containing four vertically arranged circular framed icons and Chinese descriptions: 1) Mango icon, "Half a pound of mango / One bowl equals one cup"; 2) Coconut icon, "Coconut milk instead of evaporated milk / Lighter and smoother"; 3) Snowflake icon, "Served in an ice bowl / Cold from the first sip to the last"; 4) Water droplet icon, "No added water / Pure fruit + coconut milk." Price and Call to Action: A brown, brush-style price tag is placed below the bowl, with the word "Price" written in small print above and a large, eye-catching white price below.{argument name="price" default="32 yuan/bowl"} Below is a rounded white and gold CTA button with a spoon icon and text.{argument name="call to action" default="Scoop out a spoonful of summer"} Bottom Area: Add a thin dividing line and the Chinese text "For more new products and store updates, search on the following platforms." Four platform icons are arranged horizontally: orange icons in the style of Douyin, Xiaohongshu, Meituan, and Dianping. A rounded search bar is added at the very bottom with the text "Search: Coconut Palace." Visual Style: High-end Chinese dessert poster, bright mango yellow and coconut white color scheme, dark chocolate brown font, gold accents, simple commercial layout, a combination of realistic food photography and exquisite graphic design, high contrast, sharp details, enticing moist highlights, soft shadows, and no people in the image. Constraints: Ensure all Chinese characters are clearly legible and accurately positioned. Use two side information cards, a total of eight function items in the sidebar, four platform icons at the bottom, and a central dessert bowl. No additional prices, additional products, watermarks, QR codes, or irrelevant text are allowed.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="product name" default="杨枝甘露厚椰乳碗"} 创建一张竖版中式餐饮推广海报，宣传一款口感清爽的冰镇甜品碗，要求展现逼真诱人的质感、配料、卖点及价格。

画布：竖版 2:3 海报，暖奶油米色背景，带有柔和的热带阳光感，右上角有淡淡的棕榈叶阴影，左上角有一杯模糊的柠檬饮品，底部角落散落着水果道具，呈现高端甜品店的广告风格。

布局：居中构图。顶部放置椰子品牌 Logo 图标及品牌名称 {argument name="brand name" default="椰殿"}，下方配有小字标语“甜得有层次”及纤细的装饰分割线。下方使用深棕色大号中文字体标题“杨枝甘露厚椰乳碗”。标题下方添加一个圆角金色胶囊标签，内含“冰镇甜品碗”字样，并配有小碗图标和雪花图标。画面中心主体为一个透明玻璃碗，盛满芒果黄果泥、浓郁椰乳、晶莹剔透的波波、红西柚果粒及光泽诱人的芒果丁。一把金勺从右上角伸入，舀起芒果丁、波波、西柚及滴落的椰乳。顶部点缀薄荷叶以增加新鲜感。

食物细节：确保甜品超写实且富有光泽：碗中清晰可见 5 种配料——芒果丁、浓郁椰乳、红西柚果粒、晶莹波波及薄荷叶。展示堆叠的高耸芒果块、碗缘的奶油白椰乳层、底部的橙色芒果泥，以及冷凝水珠带来的清凉感。

左侧边栏：一个圆角竖向奶油色卡片，标题为“成分亮点”，包含 4 个垂直排列的配料亮点，每个配料配有写实插图及中文说明：1) 芒果插图，“爱文芒果 / 不打泥，保留果肉”；2) 椰子插图，“泰国椰乳 / 椰肉现榨”；3) 西柚插图，“红西柚粒 / 爆汁微苦”；4) 波波插图，“脆波波 / 无香精”。

右侧边栏：一个圆角竖向奶油色卡片，标题为“产品卖点”，包含 4 个垂直排列的圆形线框图标及中文说明：1) 芒果图标，“半斤芒果 / 一碗顶一杯”；2) 椰子图标，“椰乳代替淡奶 / 更轻更滑”；3) 雪花图标，“冰碗出品 / 从第一口冷到最后”；4) 水滴图标，“不加一滴水 / 纯果 + 椰乳”。

价格与行动号召：碗下方放置一个棕色笔触风格的价格条，上方标注小字“价格”，下方为醒目的白色大号价格 {argument name="price" default="32元 / 碗"}。下方放置一个圆角白金配色 CTA 按钮，带有勺子图标及文字 {argument name="call to action" default="挖一勺夏天"}。

底部区域：添加一条纤细的分割线及中文文案“更多新品与门店动态，可在以下平台搜索”。横向排列 4 个平台图标：抖音、小红书、美团及大众点评风格的橙色图标。最底部添加一个圆角搜索栏，文字为“搜索：椰殿”。

视觉风格：高端中式甜品海报，明亮的芒果黄与椰子白配色，深巧克力棕色字体，金色点缀，简洁的商业排版，写实食物摄影与精致平面设计结合，高对比度，细节锐利，诱人的湿润高光，柔和阴影，画面中无人。

约束：确保所有中文字符清晰可辨且位置准确。使用 2 个侧边信息卡片，侧边栏共计 8 个功能项，底部 4 个平台图标，以及一个中心甜品碗。禁止添加额外价格、额外产品、水印、二维码或无关文字。

templates.title: Luxury Black Truffle Wagyu Burger Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华黑松露和牛汉堡海报

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a high-end vertical restaurant promotional poster for a luxury gourmet burger brand.{argument name="brand name" default="Burger N"} The advertisement features a beige, luxurious food advertising background and a realistic, alluring photographic style. Canvas: Vertical poster, 3:4 aspect ratio, warm-toned creamy paper background, centered composition, high-end casual dining aesthetics, color scheme of black, dark brown, caramel orange, and cream. Top Brand Logo: A minimalist black "N" logo with a small orange dot is placed at the top center, below which is the brand text "Burger N," followed by the Chinese slogan "一口堕落" (One Bite of Debauchery), flanked by thin orange dividing lines. Below this, a small crown icon is added above the main title. Main Title: The upper center uses a striking, bold, distressed-style Chinese font.{argument name="headline text" default="Black truffle foie gras and beef burger"} The lower part is accented with curved orange lines, flanked by small orange decorative stars. Below the title is the subtitle "Luxurious Debauchery, One Bite is Intoxicating," accompanied by two small orange stars. The main course: A massive, hyper-realistic black truffle, foie gras, and Wagyu beef burger sits at the center. It features a matte charcoal-black bun sprinkled with black sesame seeds, thick, glossy pan-seared foie gras slices, rich black truffle sauce cascading down, melted yellow cheese stretching downwards, and a juicy, coarsely ground Wagyu beef patty with pink veins, all complemented by fresh leafy greens and a dark bottom bun. The bottom of the burger is surrounded by truffle bits, peppercorns, sauce splatters, and slices of black truffle. The lighting uses soft, studio-style food lighting with highlights, shallow depth of field, and an overall appealing and upscale feel. Left-side ingredient section: Four ingredient highlight labels are added to the left, below the dark, rounded label "INGREDIENTS". Each label includes a small, realistic image of the ingredient, a dotted, curved guide line pointing towards the burger, and Chinese text. The four labels are: 1) Marbled raw Wagyu beef steak, labeled "Australian Wagyu/Coarsely ground meat patty"; 2) Pan-seared foie gras slices, labeled "French foie gras/Crispy on both sides"; 3) Black truffle sauce bowl, labeled "Black truffle sauce/Truffle content ≥12%"; 4) Glossy brioche bread, labeled "Brioche bread/Butter ratio 18%". Right-side selling point panel: Add a rounded-corner vertical cream-colored card on the right, titled "PRODUCT BENEFITS". It contains four stacked selling points, accompanied by round dark icons and Chinese text: 1) Crown icon, "Double luxury ingredients/Wagyu + Foie gras"; 2) Spatula or knife icon, "Freshly grilled to order/Juicy and not flattened"; 3) Cheese icon, "Triple cheese/Cheddar + Mozzarella + Parmesan"; 4) Takeout box icon, "Carry-on single box/Not collapsed or wet". Price & CTA: Place a dark brown, bold-stroke price banner near the bottom center. The banner features a small orange "PRICE" and a large white price.{argument name="price" default="89"} Followed by "Yuan/Set". Below this, add a rounded call-to-action button containing bold Chinese text.{argument name="call to action" default="Falling into depravity now"} And a right-pointing arrow. Footer: Add a thin horizontal line, followed by small Chinese footer text: "For more delicious food, search on your favorite platforms." Add a dark search capsule containing the text "Burger N" and a magnifying glass icon, followed by five platform logos/icons: Douyin, Xiaohongshu, Meituan, Dianping, and a small orange restaurant app-style icon. Keep all footer elements simple and aligned to the bottom. Visual Style: High-end Chinese food advertising poster, combining realistic product photography with simple graphic design, a strong central food subject, clear typography, delicate paper texture, sophisticated shadows, no human figures in the image, and no extra clutter except for listed ingredients, icons, and text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为一款奢华美食汉堡创作一张高端竖版餐厅推广海报，品牌名为 {argument name="brand name" default="Burger N"}，采用米色奢华美食广告背景及写实诱人的摄影风格。

画布：竖版海报，3:4 比例，暖色调奶油质感纸张背景，居中构图，高端休闲餐饮美学，配色方案为黑色、深棕色、焦糖橙色和奶油色。

顶部品牌标识：顶部中心放置一个极简黑色“N”标志及一个小橙点，下方为品牌文字“Burger N”，随后是中文标语“一口堕落”，两侧配有细橙色分割线。在其下方，主标题上方添加一个小皇冠图标。

主标题：中上部使用醒目、粗犷的做旧风格中文字体：{argument name="headline text" default="黑松露鹅肝和牛堡"}。下方用弯曲的橙色笔触线条衬托，两侧添加小型橙色装饰性星芒。标题下方添加副标题“奢华堕落，一口上头”，并配以两颗小橙星。

主食主体：中心放置一个巨大的超写实黑松露鹅肝和牛汉堡。使用哑光炭黑色面包胚，撒有黑芝麻，厚实油亮的香煎鹅肝片，浓郁的黑松露酱垂坠而下，融化的黄色芝士拉丝向下，多汁的粗绞和牛牛肉饼呈现粉红色纹理，搭配新鲜绿叶菜和深色底部面包。汉堡底部周围散落松露碎、胡椒粒、酱汁溅点及黑松露切片。灯光采用柔和的摄影棚美食光效，高光质感，浅景深，极具食欲感与高端感。

左侧成分栏：在左侧添加 4 个成分亮点标注，置于深色圆角标签“INGREDIENTS / 成分亮点”下方。每个标注包含一个小巧写实的成分图片、指向汉堡的虚线弧形引导线以及中文文字。4 个标注分别为：1) 大理石纹生和牛排，标注“澳洲和牛 / 粗绞肉饼”；2) 香煎鹅肝圆片，标注“法式鹅肝 / 双面焦脆”；3) 黑松露酱碗，标注“黑松露酱 / 块菌含量≥12%”；4) 油亮布里欧修面包，标注“布里欧修面包 / 黄油比例18%”。

右侧卖点面板：在右侧添加一张圆角竖式奶油色卡片，标题为“PRODUCT BENEFITS / 产品卖点”。包含 4 行堆叠的卖点，配有圆形深色图标及中文文案：1) 皇冠图标，“双奢食材 / 和牛 + 鹅肝”；2) 铲子或刀具图标，“现点现煎 / 出汁不压扁”；3) 芝士图标，“三重芝士 / 车达+马苏+帕森”；4) 外卖盒图标，“手提单盒 / 不塌不湿”。

价格与 CTA：在底部中心附近放置一个深棕色粗笔触价格横幅。横幅上写有小号橙色“PRICE”和巨大的白色价格 {argument name="price" default="89"}，后接“元 / 套”。下方添加一个圆角轮廓的行动号召按钮，内含粗体中文 {argument name="call to action" default="现在就堕落"} 及一个向右箭头。

页脚：添加一条细水平线，随后是小号中文页脚文字：“更多美味，打开常用平台搜索”。添加一个深色搜索胶囊，内含“Burger N”文字及放大镜图标，后接 5 个平台徽标/图标，分别标注：抖音、小红书、美团、大众点评，以及一个小型橙色餐饮应用风格图标。保持所有页脚元素精简并沿底部对齐。

视觉风格：高端中式美食广告海报，写实产品摄影与简洁平面设计相结合，强有力的中心主体食物，清晰的排版，细腻的纸张纹理，考究的阴影，画面中无人像，除所列成分、图标和文字外无额外杂物。

templates.title: A portrait from above on a shopping mall escalator

titleLocalized.zh: 商场自动扶梯俯视肖像

templates.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic, cinematic 35mm portrait photograph, employing an extremely high, overhead perspective (similar to a drone's view), looking down at the center of a wide escalator within a futuristic luxury shopping mall. A{argument name="subject" default="adult male"} He stood completely still on the escalator, centered in the frame, looking up at the camera, his body language calm and perfectly still. He had short, dark hair and wore {argument name="coat color" default="Dark brown"} A wool coat over a beige sweater, dark trousers, and polished dark leather shoes. The escalator steps form a strong symmetrical guiding line, featuring glass side railings and metal recesses, extending downwards to the bright and open mall atrium. Around him, hundreds of shoppers moving along adjacent escalators and mall floors are displayed, with a strong motion blur effect, creating a stark contrast between the clearly static subject and the hurried crowd. The mall should present a high-end and futuristic atmosphere, with light-colored stone floors, glass storefronts, warm wood-paneled curved balconies, glossy black shop entrances, soft retail lighting, and spacious multi-level interior spaces. The design utilizes a shallow depth of field focused on the subject, cinematic color grading, realistic lens perspective, subtle wide-angle distortion when viewed from above, natural interior lighting, high detail, a documentary-style fashion editing aesthetic, and no visible text, logos, or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超写实电影级 35mm 肖像摄影作品，采用极高俯视视角（类似无人机视角），向下俯瞰未来感豪华购物中心内宽阔自动扶梯的中心。一位 {argument name="subject" default="成年男性"} 站在自动扶梯上完全静止，位于画面中心并抬头看向镜头，肢体语言平静且纹丝不动。他留着深色短发，身穿 {argument name="coat color" default="深棕色"} 羊毛大衣，内搭米色毛衣，下穿深色长裤，脚蹬擦得锃亮的深色皮鞋。自动扶梯的台阶形成了强烈的对称引导线，配有玻璃侧栏和金属凹槽，向下延伸至明亮开阔的商场中庭。在他周围，展示数百名在相邻扶梯和商场楼层走动的购物者，并进行强烈的动态模糊处理，使清晰静止的主体与匆忙的人群形成鲜明对比。商场应呈现高端且具有未来感的氛围，配有浅色石材地面、玻璃店面、温暖的木质弧形阳台、亮黑色店铺入口、柔和的零售照明以及宽敞的多层室内空间。使用聚焦于主体的浅景深，电影级调色，真实的镜头透视，从上方观察时带有微妙的广角畸变，自然室内光线，高细节，纪录片时尚编辑风格，无可见文字，无 Logo，无水印。

templates.title: Turkish Floating Island Travel Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 土耳其浮岛旅行海报

templates.prompt: Objective: To create an ultra-detailed, ultra-realistic 9:16 vertical cinematic luxury travel poster, showcasing {argument name="country name" default="TÜRKİYE"} Presented as a vast, handcrafted floating island civilization suspended in soft, atmospheric clouds, it resembles a high-end miniature world map and a masterpiece of travel art. Canvas: A tall, poster-like composition, a gray-white cloud background, and elegant editorial layout. The title at the top uses a magnificent deep blue serif font.{argument name="headline text" default="TÜRKİYE"} Below this is an elegant subtitle: "A Land Connecting Continents, Civilizations, and Nature." Fine gold dividing lines enhance the aesthetic appeal of this high-end museum map. The top feature bar, below the subtitle, includes four exquisite gold line icons with descriptions: 1) Rich Heritage – Thousands of years of history; 2) Magnificent Nature – From sea to mountains; 3) Vibrant Culture – Timeless and passionate; 4) Endless Exploration – Every region has a new story. The main theme: The entire country is conceived as a vast floating island, showcasing the shape and spirit of Turkey, surrounded by turquoise seas, white clouds, waterfalls cascading from cliff edges, and tiny boats, bridges, highways, rivers, forests, farmlands, mosques, ruins, castles, mountains, ancient cities, and modern urban areas. This imbues the island with incredibly rich and realistic detail, possessing cinematic depth, warm sunlight, atmospheric mist, and the realism of miniature landscapes. It includes airplanes flying overhead, seagulls, hot air balloons in Cappadocia, the Turkish flag near Ankara, another red flag in the southeast, and the rich architectural diversity of the regions. Landmarks and Areas: Eighteen cream-colored map labels are placed on the floating island, using a fine serif font and subtle shading: 1) Istanbul – the crossroads of Europe and Asia, 2) Bursa, 3) Izmir – the Pearl of the Aegean, 4) Ephesus – the eternal ancient city, 5) Pamukkale – the cotton castle, 6) Antalya – the timeless charm of the turquoise coast, 7) Konya – the birthplace of Mevlana, 8) Ankara – the capital, 9) Samsun, 10) Cappadocia – the land of fairy chimneys, 11) Trabzon – Lake Uzon, Sumera Monastery, 12) Mount Ararat ARARAT — 5,137 meters, Turkey's highest peak; 13) Erzurum; 14) Van — Lake Van; 15) Diyarbakir — Ancient city walls, an enduring story; 16) Gaziantep — City of gastronomy and Gaziantep nut cakes; 17) Göbekli Tepe — The world's first temple, 12,000 years old; 18) Mardin — The stone city of Mesopotamia. Bottom Information Panel: Create a cream-colored statistical panel with a gold border at the bottom, using an elegant tourist brochure layout, containing 8 information blocks: 1) Population: 85.7 million (with person icons); 2) Official Language: Turkish (with voice icon); 3) Currency: Turkish Lira ₺ / TRY (with coin icon); 4) 2024 Visitor Count: 62.27 million (with suitcase icon), 5) Notable Exports: Automobiles, textiles, machinery, electronics, hazelnuts (with truck icon), 6) Cuisine: Kebabs, tartare, appetizers, tea, Turkish coffee (with plate lid icon), 7) Transportation: High-speed rail, major airports, highways, ferries, Bosphorus Bridge (with train/airplane icon), 8) Identity: Crossroads of Eurasia—a bridge connecting the world, a home beyond time (with globe icon). Decorative Foreground: Place a realistic tulip-shaped cup of Turkish tea in the lower right corner, next to a Simit; add delicate red tulips in the two lower corners. Use gold accents, ivory margins, dark blue typography, and realistic shadows. Visual Style: Hyper-realistic miniature 3D model, cinematic luxury travel poster, ultra-detailed 3D. Illustrations and graphics, a high-end travel magazine cover, clear and easy-to-read labels, natural and atmospheric clouds, turquoise waters, golden hour light and shadow, extremely rich and well-organized details, no watermark, no extra text except for the specified labels and instructions.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张超精细、超写实的 9:16 竖版电影级奢华旅行海报，将 {argument name="country name" default="TÜRKİYE"} 展现为悬浮在柔和大气云层中的巨大手工浮岛文明，宛如高端微缩世界地图和旅游艺术杰作。

画布：高挑的海报构图，灰白色云层背景，优雅的编辑排版。顶部使用宏伟的深蓝色衬线字体标题“{argument name="headline text" default="TÜRKİYE"}”，下方配以精致副标题：“连接大陆、文明与自然之地”。添加细金线分割线，营造高端博物馆地图的审美感。

顶部特征栏：在副标题下方，包含 4 个精致的金色线条图标及说明：1) 丰富的遗产 — 数千年的历史，2) 壮丽的自然 — 从海洋到山峰，3) 充满活力的文化 — 永恒且热情，4) 无限的探索 — 每一片区域都有新故事。

主体：整个国家被构想为一个巨大的浮岛，呈现土耳其的形状与神韵，周围环绕着绿松石色的海洋、白云、从悬崖边缘倾泻而下的瀑布，以及微小的船只、桥梁、高速公路、河流、森林、农田、清真寺、遗迹、城堡、山脉、古城和现代城区。使岛屿细节极其丰富且真实，具有电影般的深度、温暖的阳光、大气雾气和微缩景观的真实感。包含飞越上空的飞机、海鸥、卡帕多奇亚的热气球、安卡拉附近的土耳其国旗、东南部附近的另一面红旗，以及丰富的区域建筑多样性。

标注的地标与区域：在浮岛上放置 18 个奶油色的地图标签，使用精细的衬线字体和微妙的阴影：1) 伊斯坦布尔 (ISTANBUL) — 欧亚交汇处，2) 布尔萨 (BURSA)，3) 伊兹密尔 (İZMİR) — 爱琴海明珠，4) 以弗所 (EPHESUS) — 永恒的古城，5) 棉花堡 (PAMUKKALE) — 棉花城堡，6) 安塔利亚 (ANTALYA) — 绿松石海岸的永恒魅力，7) 科尼亚 (KONYA) — 梅夫拉纳的故乡，8) 安卡拉 (ANKARA) — 首都，9) 萨姆松 (SAMSUN)，10) 卡帕多奇亚 (CAPPADOCIA) — 精灵烟囱之地，11) 特拉布宗 (TRABZON) — 乌宗湖、苏美拉修道院，12) 阿拉拉特山 (MOUNT ARARAT) — 5,137 米，土耳其最高峰，13) 埃尔祖鲁姆 (ERZURUM)，14) 凡城 (VAN) — 凡湖，15) 迪亚巴克尔 (DIYARBAKIR) — 古城墙，永恒的故事，16) 加济安泰普 (GAZIANTEP) — 美食之城与安泰普果仁蜜饼，17) 哥贝克力石阵 (GÖBEKLİ TEPE) — 世界第一座神庙，12,000 年历史，18) 马尔丁 (MARDİN) — 美索不达米亚的石城。

底部信息面板：在底部创建一个奶油色与金色边框的统计面板，采用精致的旅游手册排版，包含 8 个信息块：1) 人口：8570 万（配人物图标），2) 官方语言：土耳其语（配语音图标），3) 货币：土耳其里拉 ₺ / TRY（配硬币图标），4) 2024 年游客量：6227 万（配行李箱图标），5) 著名出口产品：汽车、纺织品、机械、电子产品、榛子（配卡车图标），6) 美食：烤肉、果仁蜜饼、开胃菜、茶、土耳其咖啡（配餐盘盖图标），7) 交通：高速铁路、主要机场、高速公路、渡轮、博斯普鲁斯海峡大桥（配火车/飞机图标），8) 身份：欧亚十字路口 — 连接世界的桥梁，超越时间的家园（配地球仪图标）。

装饰性前景：在右下角放置一杯逼真的郁金香形土耳其茶，旁边放着芝麻圈饼 (Simit)；在两个下角添加精致的红郁金香。使用金色点缀、象牙色页边距、深蓝色排版和逼真的阴影。

视觉风格：超写实微缩立体模型，电影级奢华旅游海报，超精细 3D 制图插画，高端旅行杂志封面，清晰易读的标签，自然大气云层，绿松石色水域，黄金时刻光影，细节极其丰富且井然有序，无水印，除指定的标签和说明外无额外文字。

templates.title: Overlooking the spiral staircase statue

titleLocalized.zh: 俯瞰螺旋楼梯人像

templates.prompt: Create a hyperrealistic, cinematic 35mm photograph, employing an extreme overhead perspective, directly looking down at the massive, circular spiral staircase. A solitary figure {argument name="subject" default="middle-aged man"} He stood still in the center of the staircase in the distance, looking up. He was wearing a {argument name="coat color" default="Dark brown"} Wearing a coat, beige sweater, dark trousers, and brown leather shoes, one hand is raised near his chest, as if adjusting his glasses or collar. The staircase forms concentric circles around him, encompassing stone steps, a cream-colored concrete base, dark metal railings, and polished wooden handrails; the repeating curves create a hypnotic vortex leading to shadows. Warm, soft beige, brown, and gray tones are used, with a soft, dusty light projected from above, carrying a slight mist, deep shadows, realistic architectural textures, and dramatic film grain. The 3:4 vertical composition, with the figure centered and the circular stairwell filling the entire frame, presents a strong sense of radial symmetry, creating a tense, surreal atmosphere of loneliness and dizziness. No text, no watermark, no other figures.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超写实的电影感 35mm 摄影作品，采用极端的俯瞰视角，直视下方巨大的圆形螺旋楼梯。一名孤独的 {argument name="subject" default="中年男子"} 在远处的楼梯中心静止站立，抬头仰望。他身穿一件 {argument name="coat color" default="深棕色"} 大衣、米色毛衣、深色长裤和棕色皮鞋，一只手抬起靠近胸前，仿佛正拿着眼镜或整理衣领。楼梯在他周围形成多个同心圆，包含石阶、奶油色混凝土底面、深色金属栏杆和抛光的木质扶手；重复的曲线营造出一种通向阴影的催眠式漩涡感。使用温暖柔和的米色、棕色和灰色调，上方投射出柔和的尘埃光感，带有轻微的雾气、深邃的阴影、逼真的建筑纹理和戏剧性的胶片颗粒感。采用 3:4 竖构图，人物居中，圆形楼梯井填满整个画面，呈现强烈的径向对称感，营造出一种紧张、超现实的孤独与眩晕氛围。无文字，无水印，无其他人物。

templates.title: A bird's-eye view selfie in an empty indoor swimming pool

titleLocalized.zh: 空室内泳池中的俯视自拍

templates.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic wide-angle selfie using a dramatic perspective, looking down from the edge of a dried-up indoor swimming pool. An adult male.{argument name="subject description" default="South Asian man with short black hair"} He stood alone at the edge of the deep water, looking up at the camera, his arm outstretched to hold the camera, his outstretched sleeve occupying the lower left foreground. He was wearing a {argument name="shirt color" default="Bright pale yellow-green"} Wearing a long-sleeved shirt, dark trousers, and brown shoes, he holds a smartphone in his other hand. To maintain anonymity, his face is blurred with a soft, rectangular image. The empty swimming pool is a large rectangle, paved with worn pale blue and white tiles, with dark blue lane lines marked with 6-foot and 7-foot depth markers. A metal ladder is on the right, and a rounded tiled step is in the far left corner. Drainage grates line the edges, and the dry pool bottom shows wear, stains, and dust. Windows in the high walls of the indoor swimming pool cast strong rectangular sunlight, leaving long shadows on the tiles and creating a quiet, abandoned atmosphere. The image utilizes natural daylight, clear architectural details, realistic perspective distortion from a mobile phone's ultra-wide-angle lens, high dynamic range, delicate cinematic color grading, and a documentary-style realism. There are no other people, no water, no text overlays, and no watermarks in the image.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超写实的广角自拍照片，采用从干涸的室内游泳池边缘向下俯视的戏剧性视角。一名成年男子，{argument name="subject description" default="留着黑色短发的南亚裔男子"}，独自站在深水区边缘，抬头看向镜头，手臂伸长持机，使他伸出的袖子占据了左下角的前景。他穿着一件 {argument name="shirt color" default="明亮的淡黄绿色"} 长袖衬衫、深色长裤和棕色鞋子，另一只手拿着智能手机。为了保持匿名，他的脸部被柔和的矩形模糊处理。空旷的泳池呈大型矩形，铺设着磨损的淡蓝色和白色瓷砖，带有深蓝色泳道线，标有 6 英尺和 7 英尺的深度标识，右侧有金属梯子，远左角有圆形的瓷砖台阶，边缘有排水格栅，干燥的池底可见磨损、污渍和灰尘。室内游泳馆的高墙上设有窗户，投射出强烈的矩形阳光，在瓷砖上留下长长的阴影，营造出一种安静、废弃的氛围。使用自然日光、清晰的建筑细节、手机超广角镜头带来的真实透视畸变、高动态范围、细腻的电影感调色以及纪录片风格的写实感。画面中无其他人物，无水，无文字叠加，无水印。

templates.title: Desert aerial portrait of footprints

The camera was shot from an extreme overhead angle, as if suspended high in the sky, shooting downwards. The subject was positioned in the center of the frame, looking up at the camera; his skin texture was natural, his facial features realistic, and he was dressed in {argument name="outfit" default="A dark short-sleeved cardigan over a beige knit sweater, paired with loose black trousers and polished brown leather boots."} The sandy surface is covered with fine wind-eroded ripples, surrounded by rugged brown rock layers, sparse desert shrubs, and scattered pebbles. The intense midday sun casts deep shadows. Place seven large, circular, footprint-shaped craters on the sand around the protagonist: one large crater in the lower left, one directly below, one large crater in the lower right, one to the left of the protagonist, one to the right of the protagonist, and two shallower semi-circular craters behind the protagonist's shoulder; additionally, add a winding, small footprint path in the upper left background.{argument name="sand color" default="Light gray-ash"} The color tone and shadows are clear and natural, with a high dynamic range, a documentary-style realism, a vertical screen composition, no text, no watermark, no surreal creatures, and no other characters.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超写实的 35mm 编辑风格肖像，主角为 {argument name="subject" default="一名留着黑色短发的成年男子"}，他独自站在一片广阔、如沙漠般平滑的灰烬色沙地上。拍摄视角为极端的俯视角度，仿佛相机悬于高空正向下俯拍。主角位于画面中心，抬头望向镜头，皮肤质感自然，面部特征真实，身着 {argument name="outfit" default="一件深色短袖开衫，内搭米色针织毛衣，下穿宽松黑色长裤，脚蹬擦得锃亮的棕色皮靴"}。沙地表面布满了细微的风蚀波纹，周围环绕着崎岖的棕褐色岩层、稀疏的沙漠灌木、散落的碎石，强烈的正午阳光投射出浓重的阴影。在主角周围的沙地上放置 7 个巨大的圆形足迹状陨石坑：左下方一个大坑，正下方一个大坑，右下方一个大坑，主角左侧一个，主角右侧一个，以及主角肩部后方两个较浅的半圆形坑；此外，在左上角背景处加入一条蜿蜒的小型足迹路径。使用 {argument name="sand color" default="浅灰烬色"} 色调，阴影清晰自然，高动态范围，纪录片式写实风格，竖屏构图，无文字，无水印，无超现实生物，无其他人物。

templates.title: Bored Club Chibi Kids Poster

titleLocalized.zh: Bored Club Chibi Kids 海报

templates.prompt: Create a cute 2:3 vertical 3D cartoon fashion poster featuring two bored children standing side-by-side with their arms crossed, showcasing a soft Pixar style and Korean kawaii aesthetic. The background is a soft sage gray studio backdrop with soft, hazy lighting and a cream-colored floor. Place the children's full bodies in the center of the image: On the left is a young boy with partially exposed, fluffy brown hair, wearing oversized, plush white winter over-ear headphones, an oversized light sage green T-shirt with the striking black lettering "BORED TODAY" and tiny purple monster patterns, paired with loose dark charcoal gray cargo jogging pants (with side pockets) and platform white sneakers. On the right is a young girl with long, wavy brown hair, wearing oversized, plush white winter over-ear headphones, a cropped light sage green T-shirt with the striking black lettering "BORED TODAY," a dark charcoal gray cargo skirt with drawstring and flap pockets, white socks, and platform white sneakers. Both children should appear bored and uninterested, standing confidently with their arms crossed and feet together. Add a large, hand-drawn sticker-style title at the top with the following text:{argument name="headline text" default="BORED CLUB"} Use a thick, black bubble font with a bold white outline, slightly slanted. Add nine doodle elements around the characters: five cream-white hand-drawn stars around the title, three small, light-colored monster doodles floating around the children, and a speech bubble near the bottom left corner containing the following text.{argument name="speech bubble text" default="NOPE."} Add extra tiny, cute monster stickers near the legs and shoes to maintain visual balance, but ensure the main doodle elements are clear and uncluttered. Utilizing highly detailed, toy-like 3D rendering, the artwork features soft, rounded shapes, smooth skin, plush fabric textures on the earmuffs, realistic cotton clothing folds, soft shadows, muted colors, and a clean magazine cover composition. Children's faces are intentionally left blank or softly obscured as neutral placeholders, while retaining hair, clothing, and body poses. There are no watermarks, no additional logos, and no readable text other than the title, shirt text, and speech bubbles.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 2:3 竖版可爱的 3D 卡通时尚海报，主角是两个并排站立、双臂交叉的无聊小孩，呈现出柔和的皮克斯风格和韩式卡哇伊美学。背景为柔和的鼠尾草灰摄影棚背景，带有柔和的晕影灯光和奶油色地板。将儿童全身置于画面中央：左侧是一个年轻男孩，露出部分蓬松的棕色头发，戴着超大号毛绒白色冬季耳罩式耳机，穿着印有醒目黑色文字“BORED TODAY”和微小紫色怪兽图案的超大号淡鼠尾草绿 T 恤，搭配宽松的深炭灰色工装慢跑裤（带侧袋）和厚底白色运动鞋。右侧是一个年轻女孩，留着长波浪棕色头发，戴着超大号毛绒白色冬季耳罩式耳机，穿着印有醒目黑色文字“BORED TODAY”的短款淡鼠尾草绿 T 恤，搭配带抽绳和翻盖口袋的深炭灰色工装短裙、白色袜子和厚底白色运动鞋。两个孩子都应呈现出无聊、不感兴趣的姿态，双臂交叉，双脚自信地站立。在顶部添加一个巨大的手绘贴纸风格标题，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="BORED CLUB"}，使用带有粗白色轮廓的厚实黑色气泡字体，略微倾斜。在角色周围添加 9 个涂鸦元素：标题周围 5 个奶油白色手绘星星，孩子们周围漂浮着 3 个小型淡色怪兽涂鸦，左下角附近有一个对话气泡，内容为 {argument name="speech bubble text" default="NOPE."}。在腿部和鞋子附近添加额外的微小可爱怪兽贴纸以保持视觉平衡，但要确保主要涂鸦元素清晰且不杂乱。采用高细节的玩具质感 3D 渲染，柔和的圆润形态、光滑的皮肤、耳罩上的毛绒织物纹理、逼真的棉质服装褶皱、柔和的阴影、柔和的色彩以及干净的杂志封面构图。故意将孩子们的脸部留白或柔和遮盖作为中性占位符，同时保留头发、服装和身体姿势。无水印，无额外标志，除标题、衬衫文字和对话气泡外，无其他可读文本。

templates.title: Luxury Caramel Frappuccino Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华焦糖星冰乐海报

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="product name" default="Starbucks Caramel Frappuccino"} Create a sleek and luxurious beverage promotional poster designed for viral spread on Instagram and Pinterest, evoking an urban café atmosphere and contemporary high-end branding. Canvas: Vertical portrait poster, 2:3 aspect ratio, high-resolution ad typography. Use a deep espresso brown and black background, complemented by warm amber bokeh lighting, caramel sheen, luminous reflections, floating coffee beans, ice cubes, and dynamic caramel splatter effects around the beverage. Main Visual: Place a large Starbucks-style Caramel Frappuccino as the main focus on the right. The clear plastic cup is filled with a blend of caramel coffee, condensation on the sides, caramel drips inside and out, and features a domed transparent lid, an upward-sloping green straw, and a towering swirl of cream topped with glossy caramel drizzle. A green circular siren logo is printed on the cup. Make the drink look rich, silky, icy, luxurious, and irresistible. Top Typography: Add the text "STARBUCKS" in small capital letters in the upper left corner, with a miniature star separator below. Below, enlarge the word "Caramel" in an elegant gold serif font. Below that, write "Frappuccino" in oversized white handwriting. Add the tagline: "smooth • chilled • iconic." Use sophisticated gold and white typography and maintain high-end spacing. Luxury Stamp: Add a circular stamp near the upper right corner with a gold star in the center, surrounded by the text "MADE TO INDULGE" and "MADE FOR YOU." Premium Ingredients Panel: Create a rounded rectangular dark glass panel in the center on the left, titled "PREMIUM INGREDIENTS." The panel displays six ingredient blocks in a 2-column, 3-row grid. Each ingredient block includes a realistic small product image, a simple white icon, and a label: 1) ESPRESSO, shown as a small cup of espresso; 2) CARAMEL SAUCE, shown as a bowl of caramel and caramel cubes; 3) MILK, shown as a glass bottle and a small cup of milk; 4) WHIPPED CREAM, shown as a swirl of white cream in a bowl; 5) ICE, shown as clear ice cubes in a bowl; 6) COFFEE BEANS, shown as roasted coffee beans in a bowl. The preparation steps section includes a horizontal flowchart titled "CRAFTED TO PERFECTION" at the bottom center. It contains five numbered step cards connected by small arrows and dotted lines. Each card features a photo-realistic miniature scene and labels: 1) "BREW RICH ESPRESSO SHOT," showing espresso being poured into a glass; 2) "BLEND COFFEE WITH ICE & MILK," showing ice and milk in a mixing cup; 3) "ADD CARAMEL FOR SWEETNESS," showing caramel drizzled on ice; 4) "TOP WITH WHIPPED CREAM," showing a whipped cream swirl; 5) "FINISH WITH CARAMEL DRIZZLE," showing the finished Frappuccino. Matching icons are added below the cards. Bottom information boxes: Two rounded rectangle labels are added. The bottom left box title is "BARISTA TIP," with a whisk icon and the text: "Blend with extra ice for a thicker café-style texture." The bottom right box title is "MAKE IT YOURS," with the text: "Customize your sweetness" and the options "Light • Regular • Extra," along with a separator line and the text: "Add an extra shot for a bolder kick." Between the two boxes, place a small close-up image of the top of the caramel cream. Footer: At the bottom center, add evenly spaced capital text “CHILLED. CREAMY. ICONIC.” followed by a handwritten line: “Made for caramel lovers.”, followed by a small heart. Visual Style: High-end, cinematic beverage advertising; deep, luxurious coffee tones; caramel gold highlights; creamy white; a combination of realistic product photography and clean infographic typography; clear, legible labels; glossy surfaces; dramatic lighting; shallow depth of field; high contrast; and elegant editorial composition. Constraints: Use 6 ingredient blocks, 5 preparation steps, 2 bottom label boxes, and 1 round luxury stamp. Keep all visible text clear and correctly spelled. Do not add extra logos, ingredient blocks, flowchart cards, watermarks, QR codes, or irrelevant products.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="product name" default="Starbucks Caramel Frappuccino"} 创建一张时尚奢华的饮品宣传海报，专为 Instagram 和 Pinterest 的病毒式传播而设计，营造都市咖啡馆氛围及当代高端品牌感。

画布：垂直肖像海报，2:3 纵横比，高分辨率广告排版。使用深浓缩咖啡棕色和黑色背景，搭配温暖的琥珀色焦外成像灯光、焦糖光泽、光亮反射、漂浮的咖啡豆、冰块以及饮料周围动态的焦糖溅射效果。

主视觉：将一杯大型 Starbucks 风格的焦糖星冰乐置于右侧作为主体。透明塑料杯中装满混合焦糖咖啡，杯壁带有冷凝水珠，内外侧有焦糖流挂，配有圆顶透明盖、向上倾斜的绿色吸管，以及顶部覆盖着光亮焦糖淋酱的高耸奶油漩涡。杯身上印有绿色圆形海妖标志。让这款饮品看起来浓郁、丝滑、冰爽、奢华且令人无法抗拒。

顶部排版：在左上方添加小号大写文本“STARBUCKS”，下方配有一个微型星形分隔符。下方将“Caramel”一词放大，采用优雅的金色衬线字体。在其下方，用超大号白色手写体书写“Frappuccino”。添加标语：“smooth • chilled • iconic”。使用精致的金色和白色排版，并保持高级的间距。

奢华印章：在右上角附近添加 1 个圆形印章，中央为金色星星，周围环绕文字“MADE TO INDULGE”和“MADE FOR YOU”。

高端配料面板：在左侧中心位置，创建一个圆角矩形深色玻璃面板，标题为“PREMIUM INGREDIENTS”。面板内以 2 列 3 行的网格形式展示 6 个配料块，每个配料块包含一张写实的小型产品图、一个简洁的白色图标及标签：1) ESPRESSO，展示为一小杯浓缩咖啡；2) CARAMEL SAUCE，展示为一碗焦糖及焦糖块；3) MILK，展示为玻璃瓶和小杯牛奶；4) WHIPPED CREAM，展示为碗中的白色奶油漩涡；5) ICE，展示为碗中的透明冰块；6) COFFEE BEANS，展示为碗中的烘焙咖啡豆。

制作步骤部分：在下方中部横向添加一个标题为“CRAFTED TO PERFECTION”的流程条。包含 5 张带编号的步骤卡片，由小箭头和虚线引导线连接。每张卡片包含一张照片级微缩场景及标签：1) “BREW RICH ESPRESSO SHOT”，展示浓缩咖啡倒入玻璃杯；2) “BLEND COFFEE WITH ICE & MILK”，展示搅拌杯中的冰块和牛奶；3) “ADD CARAMEL FOR SWEETNESS”，展示焦糖淋在冰上；4) “TOP WITH WHIPPED CREAM”，展示添加奶油漩涡；5) “FINISH WITH CARAMEL DRIZZLE”，展示成品星冰乐。在卡片下方添加配套的小图标。

底部信息框：添加 2 个圆角矩形标注框。左下角框标题：“BARISTA TIP”，配有打蛋器图标及文字：“Blend with extra ice for a thicker café-style texture”。右下角框标题：“MAKE IT YOURS”，配有文字：“Customize your sweetness”及选项“Light • Regular • Extra”，并附有一条分隔线和文字：“Add an extra shot for a bolder kick”。在两个框之间，放置一张焦糖奶油顶部的特写小图。

页脚：在底部中心，添加间距均匀的大写文本“CHILLED. CREAMY. ICONIC.”以及一行手写文字：“Made for caramel lovers.”，后跟一颗小爱心。

视觉风格：高端电影级饮品广告，深色奢华咖啡色调，焦糖金色高光，奶油白色，写实产品摄影与简洁信息图表排版相结合，清晰易读的标签，光亮表面，戏剧性灯光，浅景深，高对比度，优雅的编辑式构图。

限制：使用 6 个配料块，5 个制作步骤，2 个底部标注框，以及 1 个圆形奢华印章。保持所有可见文字清晰且拼写正确。不要添加额外的标志、配料块、流程卡、水印、二维码或不相关的产品。

templates.title: Photo to pixel portrait collage

titleLocalized.zh: 照片转像素头像拼贴画

templates.prompt: Create a vibrant pixel art collage showcasing the transformation of a real portrait into a game-style pixel avatar. Canvas: Widescreen 16:9 landscape banner, approximately 1200 x 675 pixels. Visual Style: A clean, retro 16-bit pixel art style combined with a realistic photo panel featuring bold black outlines, white sticker borders, halftone cartoon dots, and a cyan and coral radiating background, creating a playful creator's studio atmosphere. Subject: A large pixel art bust at the center, depicting a character {argument name="character name" default="A young man"} ,have{argument name="hair color" default="Messy black hair"} The subject, wearing an olive green jacket over a dark navy blue hoodie, faces forward; the face area remains a soft, anonymous placeholder or a simplified, blurred block of color, without specific identity details. On the left: a large computer/photo window with rounded corners, featuring three small circular window buttons in the upper left corner containing a realistic portrait of the same person wearing the same hoodie and jacket, framed with a thick mint green border. Between the photo window and the central portrait, a bold white arrow pointing to the right illustrates the conversion process. The exact number of visible generated portrait outputs is calculated: a total of 5—1 large central pixel portrait, 1 yellow cartoon-style square portrait (with a flashing icon) near the upper left, 1 green cartoon-style square portrait (with a white bubble) in the upper right, 1 blue cartoon-style square portrait (with lively motion markers) in the center right, and 1 small portrait displayed on a drawing board in the lower left. Desktop and Studio Details: Includes 10 prominent props—a black desk lamp emitting a warm yellow glow on the far left, a potted plant on the table, a drawing board with a colored toolbar, a stylus placed in front of the drawing board, a red mug with a white heart and steam, two small pixel figurines in the lower left, a miniature green pixel creature, a wall shelf with small pixel character figurines, and a framed pixel heart painting on the wall. Background: A warm, dark room with shelves and brick walls on the far left, transitioning to a bright, cartoonish halftone beam of light behind the central avatar. Color Palette: Saturated cyan, mint, coral, yellow, navy, olive green, and black. Composition: Dynamic, rich, yet easy to read, with the central avatar occupying the right half and the source photo occupying the left half. Limitations: No legible text or logo, no watermark, no extra panels besides the 5 avatar outputs, maintaining the cheerful "before and after" theme suitable for free photo-to-pixel avatar generator ads.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张充满活力的像素艺术宣传拼贴画，展示真实肖像转换为游戏风格像素头像的过程。画布：宽屏 16:9 横向横幅，尺寸约为 1200×675。视觉风格：清晰的复古 16-bit 像素艺术与一张写实照片面板相结合，粗黑色轮廓，白色贴纸边框，半色调漫画圆点，青色与珊瑚色放射状背景，营造出俏皮的创作者工作室氛围。主体：中心位置是一个巨大的像素艺术半身像，角色为 {argument name="character name" default="一名年轻男子"}，拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="凌乱的黑发"}，身穿橄榄绿夹克，内搭深海军蓝连帽衫，面向前方；面部区域保持为柔和的匿名占位符或简化的模糊色块，无需具体的身份细节。左侧：一个带有圆角的大型电脑/照片窗口，左上角有三个小圆形窗口按钮，其中包含同一人物穿着相同连帽衫和夹克的写实肖像，并配有粗厚的薄荷绿边框。在照片窗口和中心头像之间，放置一个指向右侧的粗体白色箭头，以展示转换过程。准确计算可见的生成头像输出数量：总共 5 个 — 1 个大型中心像素头像，1 个位于左上方附近的黄色漫画风格方形肖像（带闪光图标），1 个位于右上方的绿色漫画风格方形肖像（带白色气泡），1 个位于右侧中部的蓝色漫画风格方形肖像（带生动的动作标记），以及 1 个显示在左下方绘图板上的小型肖像。桌面和工作室细节：包含 10 个显著道具 — 最左侧一盏发出暖黄色光芒的黑色台灯，桌上一盆绿植，一个带有彩色工具栏的绘图板，一支放在绘图板前的触控笔，一个带有白色爱心和蒸汽的红色马克杯，左下方 2 个小型像素手办，1 个微型绿色像素生物，一个放有小型像素角色人偶的墙面搁板，以及墙上一个带框的像素爱心画。背景：最左侧是带有搁板和砖墙的温馨暗色房间，过渡到中心头像后方明亮的漫画半色调光束。调色板：饱和的青色、薄荷色、珊瑚色、黄色、海军蓝、橄榄绿和黑色。构图：动态、丰富但易于阅读，中心头像占据右半部分，源照片占据左半部分。限制：无易读文本或徽标，无水印，除 5 个头像输出外无额外面板，保持适合免费照片转像素头像生成器广告的欢快“前后对比”主题。

templates.title: Noir Detective Portrait in the Rain Alley

titleLocalized.zh: 黑色电影侦探雨巷肖像

templates.prompt: Create a dramatic black-and-white noir comic book illustration, in which {argument name="character type" default="A mysterious detective"} Standing in a city alley on a rainy night, close to the camera. The figure occupies the right half of the wide horizontal composition, wearing a dark fedora, high-necked trench coat, shirt, and tie, with sharp ink highlights and heavy cross-hatching; a large, pure dark gray rectangular placeholder is left in the face area for future portrait uploads, extending down from the brim of the hat to the upper chest. The left half shows a tall, glowing Victorian street lamp, the wet, reflective cobblestone pavement, the thick fog or steam floating on the ground, distant skyscrapers and fire escape staircases, and vertical rain streaks. Employing a rough, monochrome picture book style, it features high contrast, rough pen-ink textures, dramatic rim lighting, deep shadows, detailed brick wall perspective behind the detective, raindrops on the coat, and a 16:9 cinematic composition. No visible text, no watermark, and no color other than grayscale.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张戏剧性的黑白黑色电影风格漫画插图，画面中 {argument name="character type" default="一位神秘侦探"} 站在雨夜的城市小巷中，靠近镜头。人物占据宽幅横向构图的右半部分，身穿深色软呢帽、高领风衣、衬衫和领带，带有锐利的墨水高光和厚重的交叉排线；在面部区域留出一个大的纯深灰色矩形占位符，以便未来上传肖像，位置从帽檐向下延伸至上胸部。左半部分展示了一盏高大的发光维多利亚式路灯、湿润反光的鹅卵石路面、地面上漂浮的浓雾或蒸汽、远处的摩天大楼和消防梯，以及垂直的雨丝。采用粗犷的单色绘本风格，具有高对比度、粗糙的钢笔墨水纹理、戏剧性的轮廓光、深邃的阴影、侦探身后详细的砖墙透视、外套上的雨滴，以及 16:9 的电影级构图。无可见文字，无水印，除灰度外无任何颜色。

templates.title: From comic sketches to finished hero pages

titleLocalized.zh: 从漫画草图到成品英雄页面

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic desktop scene showcasing a comic book illustration in progress, shot from a slightly overhead angle on a dark wooden desktop. The main subject is a large sheet of comic paper, diagonally divided by a jagged, glowing transition line: the left half is a rough graphite pencil sketch, while the right half is a fully inked and colored comic page. The left side features a loose composition of a futuristic city skyline and the silhouette of a lone cloaked hero, rendered with gray pencil strokes, smudges, eraser shavings, and sketch markings. The right side renders the finished version in dramatic deep blue and gold tones: the same hero stands on the edge of a rooftop, his back to the camera, possessing…{argument name="hair style" default="Black spiky hairstyle"} long{argument name="cape color" default="Dark blue cloak"} Blowing in the wind, dressed in dark clothing and boots, fists clenched, overlooking the dense, futuristic metropolis of the night. A huge, warm-colored full moon shines behind the clouds, below which countless skyscrapers and bright windows rise. The far right edge contains three narrow, vertical comic panel panels: the top panel shows dark skyscrapers and glowing windows, the middle panel a silhouette of a water tower on a rooftop, and the bottom panel a golden cityscape and power lines. The diagonal boundary between the sketch and the finished artwork should shimmer like burning golden embers, as if the drawing is transforming from a pencil sketch into complete comic art. Place realistic drawing tools around the paper: a wooden pencil in the lower left corner, two metal pens or markers in the lower right corner, a metal cup faintly visible in the upper right corner, and blurred paper or drawing paper in the background in the upper left corner. Use high-detail ink lines, halftone comic textures, deep shadows, warm moonlight, cool blue night colors, and realistic desktop lighting. Do not include speech bubbles, titles, readable text, logos, or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个电影质感的桌面场景，展示一幅正在创作中的漫画插画，拍摄角度为略微俯视的深色木质桌面。画面主体是一张巨大的漫画纸，被一道锯齿状的发光过渡线对角分割：左半部分是粗糙的石墨铅笔草图，右半部分是完全上墨并着色的漫画页面。左侧展示未来城市天际线和一名孤独披风英雄背影的松散构图线条，呈现灰色铅笔笔触、涂抹痕迹、橡皮屑和草图标记。右侧渲染成品版本，采用戏剧性的深蓝色和金色调：同一位英雄站在屋顶边缘，背对镜头，拥有 {argument name="hair style" default="黑色尖刺发型"}，长长的 {argument name="cape color" default="深蓝色披风"} 在风中飘动，身着深色服装，穿着靴子，紧握双拳，俯瞰着夜晚密集的未来大都市。一轮巨大的暖色满月在云层后发光，下方是无数摩天大楼和明亮的窗户。在最右侧边缘包含 3 个狭窄的垂直漫画分镜：顶部面板是黑暗的高层建筑和发光的窗户，中间面板是屋顶上的水塔剪影，底部面板是金色的城市透视和电线。草图与成品艺术之间的对角边界应像燃烧的金色余烬一样闪烁，仿佛画作正在从铅笔草稿转变为完整的漫画艺术。在纸张周围放置真实的绘图工具：左下角有一支木铅笔，右下角有两支金属笔或马克笔，右上角隐约可见一个金属杯，左上角背景中有模糊的纸张或绘图纸。使用高细节的墨水排线、半色调漫画纹理、深邃的阴影、温暖的月光、冷蓝色的夜色以及写实的桌面光影。不要包含对话气泡、标题、可读文字、标志或水印。

templates.title: Gojo Satoru Anime Promotional Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 五条悟动漫宣传海报

templates.prompt: Create a vertical Japanese anime promotional poster featuring a character from "Jujutsu Kaisen".{argument name="character name" default="Gojo Satoru"} The poster employs a unified, hierarchical main visual composition and a dramatic ink collage style. The canvas is a 3:4 vertical poster, using a warm, off-white, aged paper texture with fine grains, dust spots, slight scratches, and scattered ink marks. Visual hierarchy: The upper half is dominated by a large close-up of Gojo Satoru's right side, wearing a black eyepatch, a slight smile, and his spiky white hair bursting upwards, transforming into translucent feather-like fragments and blue-purple energy streams. In the center foreground, a full-body Gojo Satoru is placed, walking towards the viewer. Tall and slender, he wears a high-necked black uniform, an eyepatch, one hand in his pocket, the other raised with two fingers extended; red cursed lightning coils around his torso and legs. Deep indigo, violet, blue, black, white, and crimson are used as accents, combined with freehand ink splashes and sharp manga lines. Composition Details: Six smaller character/story figures are incorporated into the ink clouds surrounding the main figure: 1) A blue-haired male silhouette in the upper left hair/energy cluster; 2) A small profile of Gojo Satoru with white hair and an eyepatch in the upper left; 3) A dark-colored standing figure facing the central energy in the middle right; 4) A lonely small silhouette in the mist in the lower left corner; 5) Three walking figures in the center of the lower background; 6) A red-haired/pink-haired male wearing a black eyepatch or patterned hair in the ink blot in the lower right corner. Add four environmental elements: 1) A traditional Japanese temple building in the middle right; 2) A modern city skyline in the bottom center; 3) A red torii gate in the foreground behind the central figure's legs; 4) Small bird silhouettes in the white space. Keep all secondary elements partially dissolved in the blue-purple watercolor mist. Typography: A large vertical Japanese calligraphy piece is placed on the left, containing the following text.{argument name="large Japanese title" default="Gojo Satoru"} Written in deep navy blue ink. Next to it are the small vertical Roman letters "SATORU GOJO" and a small red stamp with Japanese characters. On the right side are neat vertical Japanese characters, the content of which is {argument name="right side slogan" default="The strongest sorcerer — Gojo Satoru"} Below this is a small circular badge and the Japanese series title. Smaller vertical Japanese text is added to the lower left, containing the following:{argument name="lower left quote" default="It's okay, I'm the strongest."} The text is a mix of black and dark red. The overall atmosphere is heroic, mythological, and has the tension of a national propaganda poster (without touching on real politics). It features an elegant comic book poster design, high detail, a strong central silhouette, layered ink splashes, glowing magical energy, and clear facial contours. There is no English title other than the small "SATORU GOJO," no watermark, and no extra characters except for the listed details.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张竖版日式动漫宣传海报，主角为《咒术回战》中的 {argument name="character name" default="五条悟"}，采用统一的层级化主视觉构图和戏剧性的水墨拼贴风格。画布：3:4 竖向海报，采用带有细微颗粒、灰尘斑点、轻微划痕和零星墨迹的暖色调米白色旧纸质感。视觉层级：上半部分由一个巨大的五条悟右侧面特写占据，他戴着黑色眼罩，嘴角微扬，刺猬般的白发向上炸开，化作半透明的羽毛状碎片和蓝紫色能量流。画面中央前景放置一个全身五条悟，正向观众走来，身形高挑纤细，穿着高领黑色制服，戴着眼罩，一只手插在口袋里，另一只手抬起并伸出两根手指；红色的咒力闪电缠绕在他的躯干和双腿周围。使用深靛蓝、紫罗兰、蓝、黑、白和深红作为点缀，结合写意的水墨飞溅和锐利的漫画线条。

构图细节：在主人物周围的墨云中融入 6 个较小的角色/故事小图：1) 左上方发丝/能量团中有一个蓝发男性剪影，2) 左上方有一个白发戴眼罩的小型五条悟侧影，3) 中右侧有一个面对中央能量的深色站立身影，4) 左下角迷雾中有一个孤独的小剪影，5) 下方背景中央有三个行走的小人，6) 右下角墨迹中有一个红发/粉发男性，戴着黑色眼罩或带有纹路。添加 4 个环境元素：1) 中右侧的一座传统日式寺庙建筑，2) 底部中央的现代城市天际线，3) 中央人物腿部后方前景处的一座红色鸟居，4) 白色留白处微小的鸟群剪影。保持所有次要元素部分溶解在蓝紫色的水彩烟雾中。

文字排版：左侧放置巨大的竖排日式毛笔书法，内容为 {argument name="large Japanese title" default="五条悟"}，用深海军蓝墨水书写。旁边添加小号竖排罗马字母“SATORU GOJO”以及一枚带有日文的小红印章。右侧添加整洁的竖排日文，内容为 {argument name="right side slogan" default="最強の呪術師 — 五条悟"}，下方配有一个小圆形徽章和日文系列标题。左下方添加较小的竖排日文，内容为 {argument name="lower left quote" default="大丈夫 僕 最強だから"}，混合黑色和暗红色文字。整体氛围：英雄主义、神话感、具有国家宣传海报般的张力（不涉及现实政治）、优雅的漫画海报设计、高细节、强有力的中心剪影、分层水墨飞溅、发光的咒力、清晰的面部轮廓，除小号“SATORU GOJO”外无其他英文标题，无水印，除列出的细节外无多余角色。

templates.title: Watercolor Transforms Reality: Beijing CBD Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 水彩幻化现实：北京 CBD 海报

templates.prompt: Create a vertical city poster to showcase{argument name="city district" default="Beijing CBD"} The process of transforming a watercolor painting into realistic photography. The canvas is vertically composed, with an approximate 4:5 aspect ratio, presenting a seamless transition from left to right: the left half is an impressionistic watercolor illustration, retaining the distinct texture of the paper and the edges of paint splatters, using soft tones of blue, pale purple, peach, yellow, and cyan; the right half gradually transitions into a clear and realistic aerial photograph of the city against a bright blue sky and sparse clouds. The skyline must include landmarks of Beijing's CBD: the towering China Zun Tower on the right, the CCTV Headquarters Building (the "Big Pants") on the middle right, and several glass skyscrapers in the middle left, with wide roads, driveways, trees, low-rise buildings, and city avenues visible below. An elegant Chinese font title is added to the upper left.{argument name="headline text" default="Guomao CBD"} Below it is a thin horizontal dividing line and a smaller subtitle.{argument name="subtitle text" default="From Watercolor to Reality"} Using warm afternoon sunlight, the realistic side is rich in detail, while the painted side presents a dreamlike, semi-transparent watercolor effect, filling the boundary between painting and reality with a poetic and fluid quality, as if the city is awakening from a painting. The painting does not contain any figures, has no watermark, and no additional tags.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖版城市海报，展示 {argument name="city district" default="北京国贸 CBD"} 从水彩画转变为写实摄影的过程。画布为竖构图，比例约为 4:5，呈现从左到右的无缝过渡：左半部分为写意水彩插画，保留明显的纸张纹理和颜料喷溅边缘，采用蓝色、淡紫色、桃色、黄色和青色的柔和色调；右半部分逐渐过渡为在明亮蓝天和稀疏云层下，清晰写实的城市航拍照片。天际线必须包含北京 CBD 的地标建筑：右侧高耸的中国尊大厦，中右侧 CCTV 总部大楼（大裤衩），以及左中部的多座玻璃摩天大楼，下方可见宽阔的道路、车道、树木、低层建筑和城市大道。在左上方添加优雅的中文字体标题 {argument name="headline text" default="国贸CBD"}，下方配有一条细横分割线，以及较小的副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="从水彩到现实"}。采用温暖的午后阳光，写实侧细节丰富，绘画侧呈现梦幻般的半透明水彩晕染效果，使绘画与现实之间的界限充满诗意与流动感，仿佛城市正从画卷中苏醒。画面中不包含人物，无水印，无额外标签。

templates.title: Comparison of tilt-shift palace corridors

titleLocalized.zh: 移轴宫殿长廊对比

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a dark-toned editing benchmark contrast card for use in {argument name="headline text" default="A tilt-shift palace gallery—avant-garde style"} Compare two fashion images generated within a palace corridor. Canvas: 1024×1024 square social media graphic with a near-black warm brown background, thin dividing lines, and a sophisticated fashion/tech commentary aesthetic. Layout: Uses two vertically stacked, horizontally centered image panels, each displaying a fashion rendering of the palace corridor. The top panel is larger, starting near the top third; the bottom panel follows closely, separated by a thin horizontal dividing line. A subheading is added in the upper left corner: “FASHION EDITORIAL · TECHNICAL LIGHTING”. A title bar is added at the bottom, containing the title, a rating difference capsule, a brief note, and a subtle brand logo. Panel 1: A high-quality fashion editorial rendering, labeled “GPT IMAGE · HIGH” in the upper left corner and marked with a coral-colored rounded “WINNER” badge in the upper right corner. Showcase a full-body avant-garde model standing in the center of a magnificent arched palace gallery, featuring perfect one-point perspective, towering columns, classical sculptures, bright window lighting, and a strong tilt-shift depth-of-field blur extending into the distance. The model wears a geometrically structured black, beige, and gray dress with sharp diagonal stripes, symmetrical shoulders, a fitted waist, and a wide skirt with a black diamond pattern. She carries a small, architecturally-inspired round handbag on her right hand. The face should be deliberately blurred/obscured. Add a large white rating in the lower right corner of the panel.{argument name="top score" default="3.7"} Panel 2: A low-quality competitor render, labeled "NANO BANANA PRO" in the top left corner. It showcases a similar concept but with lower accuracy: the model is positioned in the center of an arched palace corridor bathed in sunlight, but the lighting is warmer and more golden, with a strong blurring effect, imperfect geometric structure, and clothing that appears flat and poorly rendered. The model is holding a circular, architectural-looking object in front of her, and her face is also blurred/obscured. A semi-transparent gray rating icon is added to the bottom right corner of this panel.{argument name="bottom score" default="2.8"} Bottom text content: In the bottom bar, the title "" is displayed in bold white.{argument name="headline text" default="A tilt-shift palace gallery—avant-garde style"} Below is a coral-colored capsule with the text "".{argument name="score delta" default="GPT +0.9"} The text is followed by the note "Perfect single-point perspective, high geometric clothing reproduction." A small orange V-shaped logo and the word "vibedex" are placed in the lower left corner, and a light-colored " @vibedex " is placed in the lower right corner. Visual style: Advanced dark UI, soft beige and black tones, coral accents, clean sans-serif fonts, crisp alignment, cinematic shadows, shallow depth of field, editorial-grade fashion lighting, and subtle graininess. Constraints: Includes 2 image panels, 2 rating numbers, 2 model images, 1 winning badge, 1 title, 1 rating difference capsule, and 2 brand logos. Maintain a split-screen baseline layout and avoid adding extra charts, buttons, or decorative icons.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个深色调的编辑基准对比卡片，用于 {argument name="headline text" default="移轴宫殿长廊 — 先锋风格"}，对比两张在宫殿长廊中生成的时尚图像。

画布：1024×1024 正方形社交媒体图形，采用近乎黑色的暖棕色背景、细分割线，以及精致的时尚/科技评论美学。

布局：使用 2 个垂直堆叠且水平居中的图像面板，每个面板展示一张宫殿长廊时尚渲染图。顶部面板较大，起始位置靠近上方三分之一处；底部面板紧随其后，中间由一条细水平分割线隔开。在左上角添加一个小标题，文字为“FASHION EDITORIAL · TECHNICAL LIGHTING”。在底部添加一个标题栏，包含标题、评分差值胶囊、简短注释以及微妙的品牌标识。

面板 1：一张高质量时尚编辑渲染图，左上角标注“GPT IMAGE · HIGH”，右上角标记一个珊瑚色圆角“WINNER”徽章。展示一位全身先锋模特站在宏伟的拱形宫殿长廊中央，具有完美的单点透视、高大的柱子、古典雕像、明亮的窗光，以及向远处延伸的强烈移轴景深模糊。模特身着几何形状的黑、米、灰结构化连衣裙，带有锐利的对角条纹、对称肩部设计、收腰剪裁、带有黑色菱形图案的宽裙摆，右侧手持一个小巧的建筑感圆形手袋。面部应刻意模糊/遮挡。在面板右下角添加一个白色大字评分“{argument name="top score" default="3.7"}”。

面板 2：一张质量较低的竞品渲染图，左上角标注“NANO BANANA PRO”。展示相同概念但准确度较低的画面：模特位于同样的阳光照射拱形宫殿长廊中央，光线更偏暖金，模糊效果强烈，几何结构不够完美，服装还原度较低且显得扁平。模特胸前抱着一个建筑感圆形物体，面部同样模糊/遮挡。在此面板右下角添加一个半透明灰色大字评分“{argument name="bottom score" default="2.8"}”。

底部文本内容：在底部栏中，以粗体白色显示标题“{argument name="headline text" default="移轴宫殿长廊 — 先锋风格"}”。下方放置一个珊瑚色胶囊，文字为“{argument name="score delta" default="GPT +0.9"}”，随后附注“完美的单点透视，几何服装还原度高”。左下角放置一个小型橙色 V 形标志和“vibedex”字样，右下角放置淡色的“@vibedex”。

视觉风格：高级深色 UI，柔和的米色与黑色调，珊瑚色点缀，简洁的无衬线字体，清晰的对齐，电影级阴影，浅景深，编辑级时尚灯光，以及微妙的颗粒感。

约束：包含 2 个图像面板，2 个评分数字，2 个模特形象，1 个获胜徽章，1 个标题，1 个评分差值胶囊，以及 2 个品牌标识。保持分屏基准布局，避免添加额外的图表、按钮或装饰性图标。
