templates.title: Harajuku Kawaii Graffiti Murals

titleLocalized.zh: 原宿 Kawaii 涂鸦壁画

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a photorealistic image of a street scene at dusk, showcasing a pop art mural in the style of Harajuku Takeshita Street. The mural would be painted directly on the walls of a narrow concrete alleyway, featuring a character named {argument name="character name" default="NOZOMU"} An original anime girl mural. Canvas: 1:1 square image, wide-angle street view, extending diagonally along a narrow city alley. The mural covers the entire left wall and extends into the distance. The background features a wet, dark asphalt pavement, kerbstones at the base, dense power lines and building facades, and a deep blue twilight sky. Subject: A large mural of a Kawaii anime girl, positioned slightly to the left. She possesses {argument name="hair color" default="Silver Gold"} She has long, wavy twin tails with soft bangs, large, sparkling blue eyes, rosy cheeks, and a slightly parted mouth, giving her a shy and adorable expression. She wears a light blue Harajuku-style ruffled outfit, adorned with lace, bows, heart-shaped accessories, butterfly decorations, and a headband with a blue bow. Her pose is slightly forward, with her hands close to the hem of her skirt, presenting a delicate anime illustration quality that blends realistically into the rough wall texture. Graffiti Layout and Text: Contains 5 clearly readable text areas: 1) Cloud-shaped bubble text "HARAJUKU DREAM" in the upper left corner, 2) Large Japanese bubble text "のぞむ" below, 3) Large Roman letters "NOZOMU" below it, 4) A small bubble text saying "TAKESHITA POP", 5) Bubble text saying "KAWAII STREET" in the lower left corner. The text uses pink, light purple, cyan, and white, with bold outlines, a spray-paint texture, a flowing paint effect, and highlights. Mural Decorative Elements: Eight striking Kawaii-themed motifs surround the character: 1) A large blue heart-shaped balloon with a pink star on the left; 2) A smiling blue heart-shaped balloon in the upper right; 3) A pinkish-red heart-shaped balloon in the center of the right; 4) A small, fluffy white cloud mascot in the lower right; 5) A round, pink seal-shaped mascot in the lower right corner; 6) A teddy bear graffiti near the center of the lower left; 7) A cloud-shaped title bubble in the upper left corner; 8) A cluster of pastel hearts and glitter graffiti around the name. Smaller hearts, stars, bubbles, paint drops, and pop art outlines are added to ensure the eight large motifs remain clearly identifiable. Lighting and Ambient: Rectangular warm-toned wall lamps mounted above the mural cast golden spots and luster on the wall, contrasting with the cool, dusky blue ambient light. The wall texture, the seams between concrete blocks, paint particles, and weathering marks are showcased, and several spray paint cans are placed on the curb in front of the mural. Visual Style: Combining realistic Japanese back alley photography with adorable pastel anime street art. Color Scheme:{argument name="color palette" default="Marshmallow powder, sky blue, light purple, cream, and neon cyan"} High detail, vibrant saturation, cinematic twilight lighting, authentic Harajuku alleyway atmosphere, no one walking in front of the mural, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张照片级逼真的黄昏街景图像，展示原宿竹下通风格的波普涂鸦壁画，壁画直接绘制在狭长的混凝土巷道墙面上，主角是一位名为 {argument name="character name" default="NOZOMU"} 的原创动漫少女。

画布：1:1 正方形图像，广角街拍视角，沿狭窄的城市巷道斜向延伸。壁画覆盖整个左侧墙面并向远处延伸。潮湿的深色沥青路面，墙基处有路缘石，背景为密集的电线和建筑立面，天空呈现深蓝色黄昏色调。

主体：一幅巨大的 Kawaii 动漫少女壁画，位置略微偏左。她拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="银金色"} 的长波浪双马尾，配有柔软的刘海，大而闪烁的蓝色眼睛，红润的双颊，微张的小嘴，表情羞涩可爱。她身穿淡蓝色原宿风荷叶边服饰，点缀着蕾丝、蝴蝶结、心形配饰、蝴蝶状装饰以及带有蓝色蝴蝶结的发带。她的姿势略微前倾，双手靠近裙摆，呈现出精致的动漫插画质感，并真实地融入粗糙的墙面纹理中。

涂鸦布局与文字：包含 5 个清晰可读的文字区域：1) 左上方云朵气泡文字“HARAJUKU DREAM”，2) 下方巨大的日式气泡字体“のぞむ”，3) 其下方的大号罗马字母“NOZOMU”，4) 一个写着“TAKESHITA POP”的小气泡，5) 左下角写着“KAWAII STREET”的气泡字体。文字采用粉色、淡紫色、青色和白色，带有粗轮廓、喷漆质感、流漆效果和高光。

壁画装饰元素：在角色周围包含 8 个醒目的 Kawaii 主题图案：1) 左侧一个带有粉色星星的大号蓝色心形气球，2) 右上方一个微笑的蓝色心形气球，3) 右侧中部一个红粉色心形气球，4) 右下方一个小巧蓬松的白色云朵吉祥物，5) 右下角一个圆形的粉色海豹状吉祥物，6) 左下中心附近的一个泰迪熊涂鸦，7) 左上角的云朵标题气泡，8) 名字周围的一簇粉彩心形和闪光涂鸦。添加较小的心形、星星、气泡、油漆滴和波普涂鸦轮廓，确保 8 个大型图案清晰可辨。

光影与环境：壁画上方安装的矩形暖色壁灯在墙面上投射出金色的光斑和光泽，与清冷的黄昏蓝色环境光形成对比。展现墙面纹理、混凝土块之间的接缝、喷漆颗粒、风化痕迹，并在壁画前的路缘石上放置几个喷漆罐。

视觉风格：将写实的日本后巷摄影与超可爱的粉彩动漫街头艺术相结合。配色方案：{argument name="color palette" default="棉花糖粉、天蓝、淡紫、奶油色和霓虹青色"}。高细节、鲜艳饱和度、电影级黄昏光影、地道的原宿巷道氛围，壁画前无人走动，无水印。

templates.title: Solara Art Nouveau style sun goddess poster

titleLocalized.zh: Solara 新艺术运动风格太阳女神海报

templates.prompt: Create an elegant vertical Art Nouveau poster, with the main character being {argument name="goddess name" default="SOLARA"} A radiant sun goddess stands facing forward in an elegant and symmetrical pose. She possesses long, flowing, reddish-brown hair, adorned with a luxurious wreath and gold ornaments, and a luminous circular sun halo behind her head, with enormous, stylized golden sunbeams filling the upper background. Her face is deliberately obscured by a solid, warm brown vertical rectangle at the center of her facial area. She wears a deep crimson and burgundy Greco-Roman style draped dress, decorated with gold floral patterns, thin straps, and ornate gold chains; a large sun medallion hangs on her chest, adorned with delicate pendant chains. Gold jewelry is added, including bracelets, armlets, necklaces, and small decorative medallions. Her arms extend outwards, gently lifting the long dress and scarf-like sleeves. The background is a rich deep red and burnt orange, embellished with luxurious antique gold lines, swirling decorative curves, vines, and floral patterns. Large sunflowers are placed in the upper left and upper right corners, and a sunflower motif is placed near the lower right corner, with smaller leaf and vine details scattered throughout. The entire poster is decorated with a thin, decorative gold border and rounded Art Nouveau-style corners. A deep red title plaque with an ornate gold border is placed at the bottom. The text on the title plaque reads: "Large Serif Title".{argument name="headline text" default="SOLARA"} Below is a smaller French subtitle.{argument name="subtitle text" default="DÉESSE DU SOLEIL"} Below that are two lines of centered small gold capital letters: "SOURCE DE VIE • LUMIÈRE ÉTERNELLE" and "FLAMME DU JOUR • CHALEUR SACRÉE"; at the very bottom center is "PARIS" with a tiny gold floral separator. Inspired by Alphonse Mucha, this elegant European vintage poster style uses flat decorative illustrations, intricate gold details, aged paper textures, and soft shades of crimson, ochre, amber, and antique gold to create a slightly worn print texture, devoid of any modern elements.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张优雅的竖版新艺术运动风格海报，主角是 {argument name="goddess name" default="SOLARA"}，一位光芒四射的太阳女神，以优雅对称的姿态正面站立。她拥有一头向外飘逸的长红棕色秀发，头戴奢华的花环和金色饰品，脑后有一个发光的圆形太阳光环，巨大的程式化金色太阳光束填满了背景上方。她的面部被一个位于脸部区域中心的暖棕色纯色竖长方形刻意遮挡。她身穿深绯红色和酒红色的希腊罗马式垂褶长裙，饰有金色花卉图案、细肩带和华丽的金链；胸前佩戴一枚巨大的太阳奖章，并挂有精致的垂坠链条。添加金色首饰，包括手镯、臂环、项链和小型装饰奖章。她的双臂向外伸展，轻轻托起长裙和围巾般的袖子。背景为浓郁的深红色和焦橙色，配以奢华的古金色线条、旋转的装饰曲线、藤蔓和花卉图案。在左上角和右上角各放置一束大型向日葵，右下角附近放置一个向日葵图案，并在各处点缀较小的叶子和藤蔓细节。用细窄的装饰性金边和圆润的新艺术风格边角装饰整个海报。在底部放置一个带有华丽金边的深红色标题牌。标题牌上的文字：大号衬线标题 "{argument name="headline text" default="SOLARA"}"；下方是较小的法文副标题 "{argument name="subtitle text" default="DÉESSE DU SOLEIL"}"；再下方是两行居中的小号金色大写字母："SOURCE DE VIE • LUMIÈRE ÉTERNELLE" 和 "FLAMME DU JOUR • CHALEUR SACRÉE"；最底部中心写上 "PARIS"，并配有一个微小的金色花卉分隔符。采用受 Alphonse Mucha 启发的高雅欧洲复古海报风格，运用扁平装饰插画、复杂的金色细节、陈旧纸张纹理、柔和的绯红、赭石、琥珀和古金配色，呈现轻微磨损的印刷质感，且不包含任何现代元素。

templates.title: Future City Singularity

titleLocalized.zh: 未来城市奇点

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic, sci-fi cityscape with a vertical composition, showcasing a vast, futuristic metropolis at night, using a monochromatic color scheme.{argument name="color palette" default="Black, white, cool silver-gray"} The perspective is a high-altitude overview, overlooking an endless and dense city skyline, with countless narrow skyscrapers, towers, and luminous urban grids stretching to the hazy horizon. In the right foreground, a massive circular black void or artificial singularity is placed, embedded in the city like a perfectly dark bottomless pit, surrounded by bright concentric halos that rotate around it like an accretion disk. The luminous halo should be composed of many fine white and silver lines, suggesting extremely high speeds, rail traffic, data streams, or gravitational distortion. Tall buildings cluster tightly around and below the vortex, with some needle-like spires rising above the halo; emphasizing intricate architectural details, luminous windows, reflective metallic surfaces, and grand scale. The atmosphere should create an ominous, awe-inspiring, and futuristic feel, accompanied by mist, fog, halos, and a softly bright horizon against a dark sky. It employs an ultra-refined, realistic digital matte style with high contrast, deep blacks, volumetric fog, sharp skyscraper silhouettes, and cinematic lighting. The image should not contain people, vehicles, signs, logos, or readable text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张垂直构图的电影级科幻城市景观，展现夜晚一座广阔的未来大都市，采用单色调 {argument name="color palette" default="黑、白、冷银灰色"}。视角为高空俯瞰，俯视着无尽且密集的城市天际线，无数狭窄的摩天大楼、塔楼和发光的城市网格延伸至朦胧的地平线。在画面中右侧前景处，放置一个巨大的圆形黑色虚空或人工奇点，嵌入城市之中，如同一个完美黑暗的无底洞，周围环绕着明亮的同心光环，像吸积盘一样围绕其旋转。发光环应由许多细密的白色和银色线条组成，暗示极高的速度、轨道交通、数据流或引力畸变。高大的建筑在漩涡周围和下方紧密聚集，一些针状尖塔耸立在光环之上；强调复杂的建筑细节、发光的窗户、反光的金属表面以及宏大的规模。氛围应营造出不祥、令人敬畏且充满未来感的感觉，在黑暗的天空下伴有薄雾、雾气、光晕和柔和明亮的地平线带。采用超精细的写实数字绘景风格，高对比度，深黑色，体积雾，锐利的摩天大楼剪影和电影级布光。画面中不应出现人物、车辆、标志、Logo 或可读文字。

templates.title: Neon Kawaii Punk Graffiti Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹卡哇伊朋克涂鸦肖像

templates.prompt: Create a vertical portrait of a cyberpunk girl in a dimly lit, neon-graffiti alleyway, with a high-contrast, fashion magazine-like photographic feel and black lighting effects. A young woman kneels in the center of the foreground, her face deliberately obscured by a matte purple rectangle. She has long, dark hair with vibrant purple highlights at the top of her high ponytail. She wears an oversized black jacket splattered with paint, a black cropped top with a glowing cat pattern, dark denim shorts, multiple collars and necklaces, leg straps, black platform combat boots, and black nail polish. Her clothes and legs are splattered with bright pink, cyan, and purple paint. She holds two spray paint cans: her left hand extends towards the viewer, and her right hand holds them vertically. To her lower right sits a black cat with green eyes, a collar, neon paint splattered on its fur, and a glowing pink crown graffiti symbol above its head. The background is a dense black wall covered with dripping neon graffiti, arcade game graffiti, hearts, cats, and magenta, cyan, and purple text. It contains eight clearly visible graffiti text elements:{argument name="large left graffiti" default="KAWAIIII"} Located in the upper left corner, it uses bright pink droplet font; "NO O" is below it; "NEE-CHAN" is located in the center on the left;{argument name="upper right graffiti" default="DAIISUKKI"} Located in the upper right corner, it is bright pink;{argument name="blue name graffiti" default="KAWASHO-CHAN"} Located in the center right, in cyan; "GAME OVER" on the left; "LEVEL UP!" in the bottom right corner; and "LOVE UP!" on a small sign near the cat. Includes 6 main icons: a purple cat face graffiti on the left wall, a neon cat head near the top center, a heart-eyed skull near the top right corner, an HP bar with 7 heart icons, repeating cyan xoxo marks, and several dripping heart outlines. Uses wet paint drips, splatters, halos, saturated magenta/cyan rim lighting, graininess, and shallow depth of field to create a strong, rebellious, kawaii gothic atmosphere. No other people, watermarks, or any additional readable text besides the designated graffiti are allowed in the image.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖版赛博朋克朋克女孩肖像，场景设定在昏暗的霓虹涂鸦小巷中，呈现出高对比度时尚杂志的摄影质感，并带有黑光照明效果。一位年轻女性在画面前景中央低姿跪坐，她的脸部被一个哑光紫色的矩形色块刻意遮挡，留着长长的深色头发，高马尾处有鲜艳的紫色挑染。她身穿一件沾满油漆的黑色超大号夹克、带有发光猫咪图案的黑色短款上衣、深色牛仔短裤，佩戴着多层项圈和项链，腿部绑带，穿着黑色厚底战斗靴，涂着黑色指甲油，衣服和腿上溅有亮粉色、青色和紫色的油漆。她手中正好拿着两个喷漆罐：左手向观众方向伸出，右手垂直握住。她右下侧坐着一只黑猫，有着绿色的眼睛、项圈挂饰，皮毛上溅有霓虹油漆，头顶上方有一个发光的粉色皇冠涂鸦标志。背景是一面密集的黑色墙壁，覆盖着滴落的霓虹涂鸦、街机游戏涂鸦、爱心、猫咪以及洋红色、青色和紫色的文字。包含 8 个清晰可见的涂鸦文字元素：“{argument name="large left graffiti" default="KAWAIIII"}”位于左上方，采用亮粉色滴落字体；“NO O”位于其下方；“NEE-CHAN”位于左侧中央；“{argument name="upper right graffiti" default="DAIISUKKI"}”位于右上方，采用亮粉色；“{argument name="blue name graffiti" default="KAWASHO-CHAN"}”位于右侧中央，采用青色；“GAME OVER”位于左侧；“LEVEL UP!”位于右下角；以及“LOVE UP!”位于猫咪附近的一个小标志上。包含 6 组主要图标：左侧墙上的紫色猫脸涂鸦、顶部中央附近的霓虹猫头、右上角附近的爱心眼骷髅、带有 7 个心形图标的 HP 血条、重复的青色 xoxo 标记以及几个滴落的爱心轮廓。使用湿漆滴落、喷溅、光晕、饱和的洋红色/青色轮廓光、颗粒质感、浅景深，营造出强烈的叛逆卡哇伊哥特氛围。画面中不得出现其他人、水印，也不得包含除指定涂鸦之外的任何额外可读文字。

templates.title: Neon punk graffiti girl and cat

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹朋克涂鸦少女与猫

templates.prompt: Create a 3:4 vertical portrait of a cyberpunk street style character, depicting a rebellious anime-style girl crouching in a dark, damp alleyway covered in neon graffiti, her body splattered with shiny black paint. The subject has a high, messy ponytail and hair color of {argument name="hair color" default="Black hair with bright magenta and violet highlights"} Her makeup has a punk vibe, but her face is deliberately hidden by a centrally located, deep purple gradient opaque rectangle. She wears an oversized black patent leather jacket covered in stickers and paint stains, over which is a black crop top with a pixelated cat face print, layered silver necklaces, denim shorts, leggings, fingerless gloves, and thick-soled black functional boots. She holds a can of spray paint in each hand: a blue one in her left hand and a pink one near the ground in her right, both with fresh paint dripping from them. In the lower right corner is a black cat with purple eyes, its wet fur speckled with neon cyan and magenta paint, and a simple neon crown painted on its head. The background is a deep black wall covered with dripping fluorescent graffiti and pixel art: containing 10 striking elements, including the pink text "kawaii no nee-chan" in the upper left corner and pink text in the upper right corner.{argument name="main graffiti text" default="daiiisukki"} The top right features three pink pixel hearts, below which is a pink pixel progress bar shape, on the left is a large pink pixel skull, on the top left are two cyan arrows/V-shaped symbols, and on the right is green text.{argument name="name graffiti" default="Kawasho-chan"} On the right, there's a cyan cat face outline and small Japanese-style pink handwriting near the green text. Use highly saturated neon magenta, electric cyan, acid green, deep purple, and glossy black; the walls and floors should have a damp, reflective, rough, chaotic, and high-contrast texture, with paint drips, splatters, and UV fluorescent effects everywhere. The composition should present a dramatic fusion of fashion photography and Japanese street graffiti, shot from a low angle, with sharp details, cinematic rim lighting, no watermark, and no other people.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 3:4 竖构图的赛博朋克街头时尚肖像，描绘一位叛逆的动漫风格少女，蹲在布满霓虹涂鸦的阴暗潮湿小巷中，身上溅满了光亮的黑光漆点。主体扎着高高的凌乱马尾，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="带有鲜艳洋红色和紫罗兰色挑染的黑发"}，妆容带有朋克感，但面部被一个居中的深紫色渐变不透明矩形遮挡块刻意隐藏。她身穿一件贴满贴纸和油漆痕迹的黑色超大号漆皮夹克，内搭印有像素猫脸的黑色露脐上衣，佩戴叠层银色项链，下身穿着牛仔短裤、腿带、露指手套和厚底黑色机能靴。她双手各持一罐喷漆：左手拿着蓝色喷漆罐，右手靠近地面处拿着粉色喷漆罐，两罐均有新鲜油漆滴落。右下角有一只黑猫，双眼散发着紫色光芒，湿润的皮毛上点缀着霓虹青色和洋红色的油漆，头顶上方画着一个简单的霓虹皇冠。背景是一面布满滴落荧光涂鸦和像素艺术的深黑色墙壁：包含 10 个醒目的元素，包括左上角的粉色文字“kawaii no nee-chan”，右上角的粉色文字 {argument name="main graffiti text" default="daiiisukki"}，右上方的三个粉色像素爱心，爱心下方的一个粉色像素进度条形状，左侧的一个大型粉色像素骷髅头，中上方左侧的两个青色箭头/人字形符号，中右侧的绿色文字 {argument name="name graffiti" default="Kawasho-chan"}，右侧的一个青色猫脸轮廓，以及绿色文字附近的小型日式粉色书写。使用高饱和度的霓虹洋红、电光青、酸性绿、深紫和亮黑色；墙面和地面需呈现潮湿、反光、粗粝、混乱且高对比度的质感，到处都是油漆滴落、飞溅和紫外线荧光效果。构图应呈现出戏剧性的时尚摄影与日式街头涂鸦的结合感，低机位拍摄，细节锐利，电影级轮廓光，无水印，无其他人物。

templates.title: Retro advertising posters from the 1960s

titleLocalized.zh: 20 世纪 60 年代复古广告海报

templates.prompt: A classic American advertising poster from the 1960s, featuring a brand {argument name="brand" default="[BREW]"} Retro medieval commercial illustrations{argument name="character description" default="[PERSON DESCRIPTION]"} Holding a bottle of ice-cold{argument name="product" default="[BREW]"} Bright and optimistic living scenes, nostalgic American style, bold{argument name="color scheme" default="[COLOR 1] and [COLOR 2]"} Color scheme, elegant retro typography, text "{argument name="brand" default="[BREW]"} "Strikingly integrated into the poster design, the realistic silkscreen printing texture, delicate paper grain, hand-drawn illustration style, retro Madison Avenue advertising aesthetics, simple composition, rich details, warm cinematic lighting, high-end poster design, authentic printing imperfections from the 1960s, realistic painting style, soft brushstrokes, and a 4:5 vertical composition."

promptLocalized.zh: 地道的 20 世纪 60 年代美式广告海报，品牌为 {argument name="brand" default="[BREW]"}，复古中世纪商业插画，{argument name="character description" default="[PERSON DESCRIPTION]"} 手持一瓶冰镇的 {argument name="product" default="[BREW]"}，明亮乐观的生活场景，怀旧的美国风情，大胆的 {argument name="color scheme" default="[COLOR 1] and [COLOR 2]"} 配色方案，优雅的复古排版，文字 “{argument name="brand" default="[BREW]"}” 醒目地融入海报设计中，真实的丝网印刷质感，细腻的纸张纹理，手绘插画风格，复古麦迪逊大道广告美学，构图简洁，细节丰富，温暖的电影级光影，高级海报设计，20 世纪 60 年代真实的印刷瑕疵，绘画写实风格，柔和的笔触，垂直构图 4:5

templates.title: Die-cut sticker illustrations

titleLocalized.zh: 模切贴纸插画

templates.prompt: Convert uploaded images into high-quality die-cut sticker illustrations, while ensuring {argument name="subject" default="main body"} Fully recognizable. Remove or simplify the original background and clearly separate the subject. Add a thick layer around the entire outline.{argument name="border color" default="Soft cream or beige"} The sticker borders feature subtle, realistic shadows to create a floating sticker effect. Important textures and details are preserved while the image is subtly stylized through enhanced color, cinematic contrast, and a refined edit look. Edges are optimized to create smooth, crisp sticker outlines while maintaining realistic proportions and perspective. The final sticker composition is then placed {argument name="background color" default="Clean and soft background"} Center the image and leave ample negative space to make it look like a high-quality, collector's edition vinyl sticker. The final image should have a minimalist, modern, slightly retro, and professionally designed style, without any added text or extra objects.

templates.title: Winter Anime Realistic Sequence

templates.prompt: A cinematic, cozy winter anime-style sequence: A fluffy Ragdoll cat strolls through a snowy Japanese town at night, wearing a knitted scarf and warm winter clothes. Snowflakes fall gently, illuminated by red lanterns, and the cold streets reflect the warm glow of shop lights. The cat slowly walks past a small ramen shop, steaming food stalls, and snow-covered bicycles parked beside wooden buildings. The gentle snowfall and the chilly winter wind create a tranquil atmosphere. The cat enters a cozy fish market hidden beneath lanterns and snow-covered roofs. Cinematic close-ups show fresh salmon and tuna on crushed ice, steam rising from nearby soup stalls, and snowflakes melting on wooden counters. Friendly seafood vendors pack fresh fish while the cat carefully selects ingredients for its dinner. The cozy winter atmosphere is punctuated by soft conversations and the distant sound of a train. Next, the cat stops at a small roasted sweet potato and roasted chestnut stall in a snowy alley. Slow-motion shots capture the steam rising from hot snacks, the glowing charcoal fire, and the moment warm hands exchange food. A cat places roasted chestnuts into a small canvas bag as snowflakes continue to gently fall on the brightly lit streets. A cat walks home through a quiet, snow-covered Japanese back alley in the blue hour of dusk. Cinematic wide-angle shots show snow-covered rooftops, glowing vending machines, distant temple bells, and warm apartment windows. A cat leaves a trail of paw prints in the fresh snow as a gentle breeze carries snowflakes through narrow alleyways. In a small wooden apartment, a cat relaxes by the heater and takes a steaming bubble bath. Comfortable close-ups show fluffy fur drying beside a glowing lamp and a knitted blanket. Outside the window, snowflakes continue to fall. The final cooking sequence features cinematic close-ups: fish sizzles and steams in a pan of butter, warm golden light filling the kitchen. The cat prepares hot soup and roasted chestnuts, while snowflakes fall softly outside the window, shimmering gently under the lamplight. The final emotional scene depicts the cat peacefully enjoying dinner by the snow-covered window, the warm lantern light illuminating the cold night street. The film boasts an incredibly detailed winter atmosphere, a Studio Ghibli-esque realism, cinematic camerawork, shallow depth of field, lifelike snow and steam physics, a comfortably emotionally rich narrative, and 4K animated film quality.

promptLocalized.zh:
电影级舒适冬季动漫写实序列：一只毛茸茸的布偶猫在夜晚的雪中日本小镇漫步，戴着针织围巾，穿着温暖的冬装。在红灯笼的映照下，雪花轻轻飘落，冰冷的街道反射着温暖的店铺灯光。猫咪缓缓走过小巧的拉面店、冒着热气的食品摊位，以及停在木质建筑旁的积雪自行车。柔和的降雪环境和寒冷的冬风营造出宁静的情感氛围。
猫咪走进了一个隐藏在灯笼和雪顶下的舒适鱼市场。电影级特写镜头展示了放在碎冰上的新鲜三文鱼和金枪鱼，附近汤摊冒出的热气，以及在木质柜台上融化的雪花。友好的海鲜摊贩正在包装鲜鱼，而猫咪则在仔细挑选晚餐食材。舒适的冬季氛围中夹杂着轻柔的交谈声和远处的火车声。
接着，猫咪停在雪中巷子旁的一个小型烤红薯和糖炒栗子摊位前。慢动作镜头捕捉着热腾腾小吃冒出的蒸汽、发光的木炭火，以及温暖的手交换食物的瞬间。猫咪将烤栗子放入一个小帆布袋中，雪花继续在灯火通明的街道上轻轻飘落。
猫咪在蓝色时刻的黄昏中，穿过安静且积雪的日本后巷回家。电影级广角镜头展示了积雪的屋顶、发光的自动贩卖机、远处的寺庙钟声以及温暖的公寓窗户。猫咪在新鲜的雪地上留下一串脚印，柔和的风带着雪花穿过狭窄的小巷。
在一间小巧的木质公寓里，猫咪在暖气旁放松，并泡了一个热气腾腾的泡泡浴。舒适的特写镜头展示了毛茸茸的皮毛在发光的台灯和针织毯子旁晾干。窗外，雪花依然在持续飘落。
最后的烹饪序列展示了电影级的特写镜头：鱼在平底锅中用黄油煎炸，发出滋滋声并冒着热气，温暖的金色灯光充满了厨房。猫咪准备了热汤和烤栗子，窗外飘落的雪花在灯光下柔和地闪烁。最终的情感场景是猫咪坐在雪窗旁平静地享用晚餐，温暖的灯笼光映照在冰冷的夜街上，超细节的冬季氛围，吉卜力工作室风格的写实感，电影级运镜，浅景深，逼真的雪和蒸汽物理效果，情感丰富的舒适叙事，4K 动画电影画质。

明亮的自然光透过教室窗户射入，在室内营造出柔和的电影级高光和逼真的阴影。真实的韩国教室内部环境，配有木制课桌、黑色椅子、绿色黑板、墙上的韩国国旗、整洁的中性色墙壁、抛光的地面，窗外可见树木。

宁静的生活化氛围，极简的韩国校园美学，自然的模特姿态，柔和的日光摄影，浅景深，电影级构图，高度细节化，逼真的教室环境，奢华生活方式的编辑感，柔光效果，真实的单反摄影，宁静的现代氛围。

templates.title: Medical Anatomy Visualization Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 医学解剖可视化海报

templates.prompt: Create a high-quality educational "scientific anatomy visualization poster" with the theme focusing on{argument name="subject" default="Human circulatory system"} The design style leans more towards modern medical museum displays and biological atlas pages, rather than traditional infographics. The composition should combine elegance, immersion, and medical artistry, blending anatomical realism, scientific illustration, and cinematic educational design. Visual Direction: • Vertical poster composition or a clean square format • Soft, medical-grade background with delicate paper textures, overlays of anatomical sketches, and subtle scientific grid lines • Refined medical color scheme using ivory, deep crimson, arterial blue, soft pink tissue tones, soft gray, and subtle gold accents • Clean typography with elegant anatomical annotations • Minimalist UI-style information panel – emphasizing visual narrative and anatomical beauty • Fine, precise annotation lines with museum-style labels • Soft, realistic lighting and high-quality biological rendering • Highly detailed, translucent human illustrations showcasing the circulatory network beneath the skin • Realistic vascular textures, with arteries and veins flowing throughout the body and emitting a soft glow • A sophisticated educational aesthetic inspired by high-end medical textbooks and anatomy exhibitions: A stunning, ultra-detailed anatomical rendering of the human circulatory system, placed at the center, including: • Translucent human anatomical structures • Ultra-detailed arteries and veins • Visible heart chambers and aorta • Capillary branching network • Realistic blood flow colors • Glowing oxygenated and hypoxic circulation pathways • Anatomically accurate blood vessel locations • Organs faintly visible beneath the vascular system • High-quality medical illustrations. A realistic feel is complemented by elegant educational visualization modules surrounding the anatomical subject, such as: • Enlarged realistic cardiac anatomy • Pulmonary circulation diagram • Systemic blood flow visualization • Artery and vein comparison • Capillary exchange illustration • Heartbeat cycle sequence • Microscopic blood cell close-ups • Blood component visualization • Major blood vessel identification diagrams • Oxygen transport instructions. Added sophisticated scientific visual elements, such as: • Blood flow direction arrows • Blood vessel cross-section diagrams • Anatomical side annotations • Circulation path diagrams • Microscopic tissue exchange visual effects • Transparent organ overlays • ECG/heartbeat waveform embellishments • Subtle medical chart graphics • Bio-texture overlays • Anatomical scale contrast. Style keywords: "Museum-quality anatomy poster" "Scientific medical atlas page" "High-quality biological visualization" "High-end anatomy illustration" "Medical education artwork" "Editable anatomy design" "Cinematic biological rendering" "Ultra-detailed circulatory system anatomy" "Luxury Medical Textbook Aesthetics"

promptLocalized.zh:
创建一个优质的教育类“科学解剖可视化海报”，主题聚焦于 {argument name="subject" default="人体循环系统"}，设计风格更偏向于现代医学博物馆展示和生物图谱页面，而非传统的资讯图表。

构图应兼具优雅感、沉浸感与医学艺术性，融合解剖写实主义、科学插画及电影级教育设计。

视觉方向：

• 竖版海报构图或简洁的正方形格式
• 柔和的医疗级背景，带有细腻的纸张纹理、解剖草图叠加层以及淡淡的科学网格线
• 精致的医学配色方案，使用象牙白、深绯红、动脉蓝、柔粉色组织色调、柔和灰以及微妙的金色点缀
• 简洁的编辑排版，配以优雅的解剖标注
• 极简的 UI 风格信息面板——重点在于视觉叙事与解剖之美
• 纤细精准的注释线，配以博物馆风格的标签
• 柔和的写实光影与优质的生物渲染
• 高度精细的半透明人体插画，展现皮肤下的循环网络
• 逼真的血管纹理，动脉与静脉在全身流转并发出微光
• 受高端医学教科书和解剖展览启发的精致教育美学

主体呈现：

一张令人惊叹的超精细人体循环系统解剖渲染图，置于中心位置，包含：

• 半透明人体解剖结构
• 超精细的动脉与静脉
• 可见的心脏腔室与主动脉
• 毛细血管分支网络
• 逼真的血流色彩
• 发光的含氧与缺氧循环路径
• 解剖学上准确的血管位置
• 血管系统下隐约可见的器官
• 优质医学插画写实感

在解剖主体周围环绕优雅的教育可视化模块，例如：

• 放大的写实心脏解剖结构
• 肺循环图解
• 体循环血流可视化
• 动脉与静脉对比
• 毛细血管交换插图
• 心跳周期序列

• 血液成分可视化

添加精致的科学视觉元素，如：

• 血流方向箭头
• 血管横截面图
• 解剖侧边标注
• 循环路径图
• 微观组织交换视觉效果

templates.title: Rainy Day Kitchen Life Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 雨天厨房生活肖像

templates.prompt: A medium-range photograph capturing a candid moment of everyday life, showing a person {argument name="subject" default="East Asian young women"} Standing by the kitchen window on a rainy afternoon. 85mm lens, composition from waist up, shallow depth of field. Background: dark wood kitchen countertop, an upside-down porcelain bowl drying, the windowpane blurred by the diffused light from the rain outside. A young East Asian woman, early twenties. Almond-shaped eyes gazing out the window, quiet and unfocused, the expression of utter despair as she watches the rain. A straight, delicate nose. Fair, beige skin; the overcast light eliminates all shadows, giving her skin an almost porcelain-like quality. Under directional light, the skin's subsurface scattering is visible, with faint, mirror-like highlights on her cheekbones and nose, revealing fine foundation particles. She wears a {argument name="clothing" default="Moss Green Silk Cheongsam"} Embroidered with gray-green and dark earth-toned bamboo stems—the pattern is simple and similar to the fabric's color, the green carrying a sense of ancient vegetation's weight. Stand-up collar, short sleeves. She stands by the windowsill, her hands lightly resting on it, gazing at the gray expanse outside. An overturned bowl, a folded cloth—that's all. A few strands of hair are ruffled by the breeze, presenting natural, unintentional imperfections rather than geometric symmetry. The somber light of a rainy day—flat, cool-toned, without shadows—fills the kitchen without warmth. The moss green absorbs the light like lichen absorbs shadows. No contrast, no drama. Atmosphere: the unique tranquility that rain brings, allowing one to do nothing. The shadow areas have a subtle ISO 400 film grain, presenting photographic noise textures rather than the smoothness of CG rendering. Aspect ratio 9:16. No watermark, no text overlay, not cartoon, not digital painting, not illustration, not animation.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张中景真实日常生活摄影，捕捉自然的抓拍瞬间，画面中是一位 {argument name="subject" default="东亚年轻女性"} 站在雨天午后的厨房窗前。85mm 镜头，腰部以上构图，浅景深。背景：深色木质厨房台面，一个倒扣晾干的瓷碗，窗玻璃上模糊着窗外雨水漫射的光线。东亚年轻女性，20 岁出头。杏仁眼望向窗外，安静且失焦，那是看着雨水时毫无期待的神情。鼻梁挺直秀气。肤色白皙偏米色，阴天光线消除了所有阴影，使她的肤色呈现出近乎瓷器的质感。在定向光线下可见皮肤的次表面散射，颧骨和鼻梁上有微弱的镜面高光，可以察觉到细腻的粉底颗粒。她身穿一件 {argument name="clothing" default="苔藓绿丝绸旗袍"}，上面绣有灰绿色和深土色的竹茎刺绣——图案素雅且与面料颜色相近，绿色带有古老植被的厚重感。立领，短袖。她站在窗台边，双手轻搭在窗台上，望着灰蒙蒙的窗外。一个倒扣的碗，一块折叠的布——仅此而已。两三缕发丝被微风吹乱，呈现出自然的、非刻意的瑕疵，而非几何对称。雨天阴沉的光线——平淡、冷色调、无阴影——毫无暖意地充盈着厨房。苔藓绿像地衣吸收阴影一样吸收了光线。没有对比，没有戏剧性。氛围：雨天带来的那种允许自己什么都不做的独特宁静。阴影区域有细微的 ISO 400 胶片颗粒感，呈现摄影噪点纹理，而非 CG 渲染的平滑感。长宽比 9:16。无水印，无文字叠加，非卡通，非数字绘画，非插画，非动漫。

templates.title: Golden Moment: Portraits of Korean Classrooms

titleLocalized.zh: 黄金时刻韩国教室肖像

templates.prompt: Hyper-realistic film portrait{argument name="subject" default="Beautiful Korean woman"} ,{argument name="setting" default="Empty Korean classroom"} Golden hour in the afternoon. 35mm film, Kodak Portra 400, warm honey blush tone, soft greens and creams, shallow depth of field, blurred classroom background. Clothing:{argument name="outfit" default="Delicate pink structured floral mini skirt"} A delicate lace top with thin straps and intricate floral embroidery, adorned with a crystal rhinestone brooch at the center of the chest; a pearl-trimmed belt; a layered pink tulle and organza pleated mini skirt decorated with 3D white floral appliqués; white low-top sneakers; a delicate silver bracelet; a thin silver necklace; and a small canvas tote bag. Long, dark brown hair in natural waves. Dewy, glass-like skin; rosy cheeks; a subtle lip color; soft eye makeup; a natural Korean beauty. Scene: Rows of wooden desks, green items covered in chalk dust, a South Korean flag, an old wall clock, stacks of textbooks, and a worn, polished floor. templates.prompt: Asset Type: Social Media Post Portrait. Main Requirement: Create a photorealistic travel selfie portrait, using an uploaded portrait photo as a reference for the subject's appearance. Subject: A young woman, retaining the identifiable facial structure, eyes, hairline, and natural skin texture from the uploaded photo, wearing {argument name="jacket color" default="bright cyan"} Outdoor jacket, white hiking pants, and wearing a hat{argument name="hat" default="Mustard yellow knitted hat"} Sunglasses perched on a hat, backpack slung over the shoulder. Style/Media: Hyperrealistic mobile travel photography with a dynamic action camera feel, clear and natural details, a vibrant social media adventure portrait. Composition/Frame: Vertical 3:4 aspect ratio, ultra-wide-angle perspective, low-angle selfie composition, one hand reaching towards the lens in the foreground, creating a strong perspective magnification effect, face in the midground, prayer flags forming a colorful radial tunnel above the head, a vibrant candid smile. Light/Atmosphere: Brilliant high-altitude midday sun, lens flare visible in the upper left, shimmering backlight, bright and optimistic atmosphere, high definition, realistic shadows on the grass. Color Palette: Saturated cyan, mustard yellow, red, orange, green, white, and sky blue, clear contrast, a refreshing feeling of a sunny high-altitude mountain. Texture/Retouching: Realistic fabric texture, natural skin pores, lifelike hair strands, high optical clarity on the face, shallow depth-of-field blur on the foreground hand, a few falling snowflakes or petals in front of the lens. Constraints: Preserve the identifiable appearance of the person in the uploaded portrait photo; no watermark; no logo; no text; no title; no signature. Negative keywords: watermark, logo, text, title, signature, AI tag, brand logo, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused fingers, deformed hands, excessively large or deformed palms, asymmetrical eyes, cross-eyed, distorted face, plastic skin, waxy skin, overly smoothed beauty filter, blurred face, low detail, low resolution, severe compression artifacts, anatomical distortion, duplicate portraits, poor perspective, bent prayer flag ropes, distorted prayer flags, fake CGI look, overexposed face, muddy colors.

templates.title: Yeezy fashion advertising collage

templates.prompt: Create a dark, ultra-luxurious Yeezy fashion advertisement collage titled: "{argument name="title" default="After midnight"} The composition should evoke a sense of taboo luxury street fashion editorialism, presented through ripped underground posters, backstage fashion archives, and late-night urban photography. Avoid: bright commercial sneaker ads, athletic brand vibrancy, or sophisticated influencer aesthetics. Instead: the advertisement should convey a sensual, melancholic, minimalist, expensive, and emotionally detached atmosphere. The layout should resemble: a layered editorial wall collage composed of: - oversized fashion posters, - ripped paper textures, - simulated flash photography, - handwritten notes, - collaged magazine fragments, - blurred Polaroid photos, - worn-out printing marks, - fabric textures, - and a fragmented typographical system. The collage should include multiple interconnected fashion photographs showcasing the same male and female models in the same sleepless urban night. Clothing:{argument name="wardrobe style" default="The soft, luxurious minimalism of Yeezy style"} - Oversized washed hoodies, - Worn-out layered fabrics, - Monochrome silhouettes, - Heavy boots, - Soft oversized coats, - Minimalist jewelry, - Textured knitwear, - Loose, unisex cuts. The styling should convey sensuality through atmosphere and body language, not exposed skin. Models should project: Emotional detachment, intimacy without smiling, physical proximity but psychological distance. Examples: - Silently sitting in the back seat of a limousine, - Standing under fluorescent motel lights, - Leaning against a concrete wall after rain, - Lying on wrinkled hotel sheets in oversized clothing, - Walking through an empty parking lot structure at 3 AM, - Elevator mirror reflections, - Subtle finger touches, - Soft eye contact in smoke and shadow. No explicit nudity. No exaggerated sexual innuendo. Sensuality should stem from: - Tension, - Lighting, - Intimacy, - Silence, - Fashionable styling and realism. Visual Style: Fusion: - Luxury fashion editorials, - Simulated nightlife photography, - Berlin underground fashion magazines, - Yeezy Season advertising energy, - Cinematic urban loneliness, - and a tactile typographic design aesthetic. Typography should feel fragmented and emotionally cold: - Oversized serif fonts, - Handwritten notes, - Fragments of barcodes, - Faded timestamps, - Broken phrases, - Fashion-making markers. Examples: "No signal." "2:17 AM." "Too late to leave." "Static." "After get off work." No motivational slogans. Lighting: Low-light cinematic realism only: - Sodium streetlights, - Fluorescent elevator lights, - Parking lot shadows, - Passing headlights, - Warm hotel lamps, - Reflections in the rain, - Strong simulated flashes. Uses: - Realistic film grain, - Slight blur, - Lens imperfections, - Heavy shadows, - Imperfect composition, - Realistic skin texture, - Soft contrast, - Dark atmosphere. Palette:{argument name="colors" default="Washed black, charcoal gray, warm tobacco brown, faded cream, industrial silver, dark amber"}

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一张暗黑极致奢华的 Yeezy 时尚广告拼贴画，标题为：

“{argument name="title" default="午夜之后"}”。

构图应呈现出：
一种通过撕裂的地下海报、后台时尚档案和深夜城市摄影所展现的禁忌奢华街头时尚社论感。

避免：
明亮的商业运动鞋广告、
运动品牌活力、
或精致的网红美学。

相反：
该广告应呈现出感性、
忧郁、
极简、
昂贵且情感疏离的氛围。

布局应类似于：
一面由以下元素构成的分层社论墙拼贴画：

- 超大时尚海报、
- 撕裂的纸张纹理、
- 模拟闪光摄影、
- 手写笔记、
- 拼接的杂志碎片、
- 模糊的宝丽来照片、
- 磨损的印刷痕迹、
- 布料纹理、
- 以及碎片化的排版系统。

拼贴画应包含多张相互关联的时尚摄影，展示同一对男女模特在同一个不眠都市之夜的场景。

服装：

{argument name="wardrobe style" default="柔和的 Yeezy 风格奢华极简主义"}：

- 超大水洗连帽衫、
- 磨损的叠穿面料、
- 单色剪影、
- 厚重靴子、
- 柔软的超大外套、
- 极简首饰、
- 纹理针织衫、
- 宽松的中性剪裁。

造型应呈现出：
通过氛围和肢体语言展现感性，而非裸露肌肤。

模特应表现出：
情感疏离、
亲密但不微笑、
身体靠近但心理距离遥远。

示例：

- 沉默地坐在豪华轿车后座、
- 站在荧光汽车旅馆灯光下、
- 雨后倚靠在混凝土墙边、
- 穿着超大号衣服躺在褶皱的酒店床单上、
- 凌晨 3 点走在空旷的停车场结构中、
- 电梯镜面反射、
- 手指微妙地触碰、
- 在烟雾和阴影中进行柔和的眼神交流。

无露骨裸露。
无夸张的性暗示。

感性应源于：

- 张力、
- 灯光、
- 亲密度、
- 沉默、
- 时尚造型与写实感。

视觉风格：

融合：

- 奢华时尚社论、
- 模拟夜生活摄影、
- 柏林地下时尚杂志、
- Yeezy Season 广告能量、
- 电影般的都市孤独感、
- 以及触感十足的印刷设计美学。

排版应感觉碎片化且情感冰冷：

- 超大衬线字体、
- 手写笔记、
- 条形码碎片、
- 褪色的时间戳、
- 断开的短语、
- 时尚制作标记。

示例：
“无信号。”
“凌晨 2:17。”
“离开已太迟。”
“静态。”
“下班后。”

无励志口号。

灯光：

仅限低光电影写实风格：

- 钠灯路灯、
- 荧光电梯灯光、
- 停车场阴影、
- 经过的车头灯、
- 温暖的酒店台灯、
- 雨中倒影、
- 强烈的模拟闪光灯。

使用：

- 真实的胶片颗粒感、
- 轻微模糊、
- 镜头瑕疵、
- 质感厚重的阴影、
- 不完美的构图、
- 真实的皮肤纹理、
- 柔和的对比度、
- 氛围感黑暗。

调色板：

{argument name="colors" default="水洗黑、炭灰、暖烟草棕、褪色奶油色、工业银、暗琥珀色"}

templates.prompt: Using my reference photographs to maintain a high degree of identity consistency, including precise facial features, hairstyle, bangs, facial proportions, skin tone, body posture, and overall silhouette. A cinematic portrait of a woman standing alone in a dark exhibition room. She wears a vintage white shirt, layered with a {argument name="jacket color" default="Soft pink"} She wears a coat and a black vintage-style midi skirt. She has light makeup. Posing directly at the camera, her posture is relaxed, one shoulder slightly drooping, and her hands gently adjusting her hair. Her expression is calm and mysterious, exuding an intellectual and elegant aura. She is positioned in the lower center of the frame, surrounded by darkness. A dramatic, angled spotlight shines from the upper right to the lower left, illuminating only half of her body, while the rest remains in shadow. Behind her is a {argument name="mural style" default="Colorful retro Japanese mural wall"} The image is adorned with retro cartoon illustrations and traditional art details. The foreground shadows, like torn darkness, naturally frame the scene, creating a museum atmosphere reminiscent of solitary art and contemplative cinematic settings. Realistic photography with delicate film grain, simulated textures, soft black tones, and vibrant mural accents. Camera angle: eye-level, mid-range portrait composition, subject presented at approximately a 70-degree side angle, maintaining a certain distance to allow for environmental narrative, centered cinematic composition. Camera settings: cinematic low-light photography, shallow depth of field, realistic shadow attenuation, Kodak Portra film grading. Lighting:{argument name="lighting source" default="A strong spotlight from the top right corner"} This creates strong diagonal beams of light and high-contrast, deep shadows, minimal ambient light, rich black tones, and soft, warm highlights on the face and eye rims. Atmosphere: Mysterious, artistic, museum aesthetics, intellectual tranquility, melancholic cinematic atmosphere, independent film stills, luxury fashion photography, a lonely night mood, understated elegance. Style: Hyperrealistic cinematic photography, simulated graininess, fashion editor portraits, natural skin texture, subtle imperfections, true color science, master-level quality. Negative keywords: Anime-like, smiles, overexposure, superfluous limbs, anatomical errors, overly vibrant clothing colors, cyberpunk neon, blurred faces, low quality, distorted hands, unrealistic skin, excessive HDR, exaggerated makeup, cluttered composition, repetitive subjects.

promptLocalized.zh:
使用我的参考照片，以保持高度的身份一致性，包括精准的面部特征、发型、刘海、面部比例、肤色、身体姿态以及整体轮廓。

一位女性独自站在黑暗展览室内的电影感肖像。她身穿一件复古白衬衫，外搭一件 {argument name="jacket color" default="柔粉色"} 外套，下身穿着黑色复古质感半身裙。淡妆。正面姿态，身体朝向镜头，姿势放松，一侧肩膀微垂，双手轻轻整理头发。表情平静而神秘，散发着知性与优雅的气质。

她位于画面下方中央，被黑暗包围。一道戏剧性的斜向聚光灯从右上角投射至左下角，仅照亮她半边身体，其余部分隐入阴影中。她身后是一面 {argument name="mural style" default="色彩丰富的复古日式壁画墙"}，上面绘有复古卡通插画和传统艺术细节。

前景的阴影如撕裂的黑暗般自然地构成了画框，营造出一种孤独艺术气息与沉思电影氛围的博物馆氛围。写实摄影，带有细腻的胶片颗粒感、模拟质感、柔和的黑色调以及鲜艳的壁画点缀。

相机角度：平视拍摄，中景肖像构图，主体以约 70 度的侧面角度呈现，与主体保持一定距离以进行环境叙事，居中电影感构图。

相机设置：电影感弱光摄影，浅景深，逼真的阴影衰减，Kodak Portra 胶片调色。

光线：{argument name="lighting source" default="来自右上角的强烈聚光灯"}，营造出强烈的对角线光束和高对比度的深邃阴影，极少的环境光，浓郁的黑色调，脸部和眼镜边缘带有柔和的暖色高光。

氛围：神秘、艺术、博物馆美学、知性静谧、忧郁的电影感氛围、独立电影剧照、奢华时尚摄影、孤独的夜晚情绪、低调的优雅。

风格：超写实电影摄影、模拟颗粒感、时尚编辑肖像、自然的皮肤质感、细微的瑕疵、真实的色彩科学、大师级品质。

负面提示词：动漫、微笑、过度曝光、多余的肢体、解剖结构错误、服装色彩过于鲜艳、赛博朋克霓虹灯、脸部模糊、低质量、手部扭曲、不真实的皮肤、HDR 过度、妆容夸张、构图杂乱、人物重复。

promptLocalized.zh:

templates.title: Urban Life Mixed Media Collage

titleLocalized.zh: 都市生活混合媒介拼贴画

templates.prompt: To create a cinematic, mixed-media fashion editorial collage, the composition should present a fragmented visual diary feel, recording {argument name="subject" default="young man"} The process of gradually dissolving into the rhythm of modern urban life. Instead of a neat magazine layout, construct the images as a wall layered from memories, screenshots, late-night photography, and torn printed posters, as if painstakingly pieced together by hand over a long period. The collage should include multiple interconnected scenes of the same male character during long, sleepless nights: the loneliness of a rooftop, a mirrored selfie in an elevator, an empty subway platform, a neon-lit convenience store, smoke drifting through an alley, a blurred taxi reflection, the desolation by an apartment window, headphones worn during a late-night walk, and moments of quiet exhaustion. The same person should remain consistent throughout the collage, but should convey different emotional states, not just changes in posture. Art Direction: Incorporate: Luxury streetwear editorial photography, film-like textures, layered paper collage aesthetics, distressed printed graphics, underground fashion magazine style, and a melancholic feel of modern urban life. Avoid: Mediocre "cool guy" influencer aesthetics, symmetrical layouts, or overly polished AI perfection. The composition should present a deliberate sense of disorder. Integration: torn paper edges, tape marks, handwritten notes, distorted timestamps, subway tickets, blurred chat notifications, weather widgets, music player overlays, barcode fragments, scratched textures, scanned notebook pages, and partially torn typography. The typography should appear fragmented and emotionally detached, rather than inspirational. Examples: “2:17 AM,” “Offline,” “Recently Visible,” “Hesitating Between Leaving and Staying,” “Low Battery,” “City Noise.” Avoid inspirational quotes. Clothing: Dark layered streetwear, realistic style: oversized hoodies, washed leather jackets, silver chains, cargo pants, worn sneakers, heavy headphones, slightly messy hair, realistic fabric wrinkles and textures. Clothing should convey an expensive yet down-to-earth feel. Light and Shadow: Each part of the collage should utilize realistic urban nighttime light and shadow: sodium streetlights, convenience store fluorescent lights, elevator LED lights, rainy night reflections, warm apartment lamps, passing car headlights, and the city's afterglow on a rooftop. Employ realistic low-light representation: soft light grain, slight blur, color aberration, imperfect exposure, flash reflections, and a realistic digital camera texture. Color Palette: Charcoal black, washed amber, cool cyan, silver reflections, soft cream paper, faded neon colors, and deep urban browns. The final image should present: a visual archive that attempts to maintain emotional visibility in a city designed to make people disappear.

promptLocalized.zh:
创作一幅电影质感的混合媒介时尚编辑拼贴画

构图应呈现出一种碎片化的视觉日记感，记录下 {argument name="subject" default="年轻男子"} 逐渐消融在现代都市生活节奏中的过程。

不要采用整洁的杂志排版，而是将图像构建成一堵由记忆、截图、深夜摄影和撕裂的印刷海报层叠而成的墙，仿佛是经过长时间手工拼凑而成。

拼贴画应包含同一男性角色在漫长不眠之夜中多个相互关联的场景：

天台的孤独，

电梯里的镜面自拍，

空荡的地铁站台，

霓虹闪烁的便利店，

穿过小巷的烟雾，

模糊的出租车倒影，

公寓窗前的落寞，

深夜漫步时佩戴的耳机，

以及情绪疲惫的静谧时刻。

同一个人应在整幅拼贴画中保持一致，但要展现出不同的情绪状态，而非仅仅是姿势的变化。

艺术指导：

融合：

奢华街头服饰编辑摄影，

胶片质感，

层叠纸张拼贴美学，

做旧印刷图形，

地下时尚杂志风格，

以及现代都市的忧郁感。

避免：平庸的“酷男”网红审美、对称式布局或过度修饰的 AI 完美感。

构图应呈现：一种刻意为之的凌乱感。

整合：

撕裂的纸张边缘，

胶带痕迹，

手写笔记，

扭曲的时间戳，

地铁票，

模糊的聊天通知，

天气小组件，

音乐播放器叠加层，

条形码碎片，

划痕纹理，

扫描的笔记本页面，

以及部分撕裂的排版设计。

排版应显得碎片化且情感疏离，而非励志风格。

示例：“2:17 AM”、“离线”、“最近可见”、“徘徊在离开与留下之间”、“电量低”、“城市噪音”。

不要使用励志名言。

服装：

深色叠穿街头服饰，风格写实：

廓形连帽衫，

水洗皮夹克，

银色链条，

工装裤，

磨损的运动鞋，

厚重的耳机，

略显凌乱的头发，

写实的织物褶皱与纹理。

服装应呈现：昂贵但充满生活气息的质感。

光影：

templates.prompt: Create a vertical, cinematic, realistic luxury product advertisement: a transparent glass capsule lying horizontally on a rain-soaked city street, with a miniature version displayed on the left side.{argument name="car model" default="Black Bentley SUV"} The capsule consists of two main parts: the left side is a transparent dome-shaped glass covered with water droplets, and the right side is a glossy metallic material with a purple-magenta-blue gradient effect. On the right half, there is a gold Bentley-style winged logo, with a circular "B" above it and prominent white lettering below.{argument name="brand text" default="BENTLEY"} The road surface is black, wet, and reflective, reflecting the capsules, cars, logos, and brand text; the foreground includes scattered raindrops and puddles. A dramatic shallow depth of field effect is used, with a blurred nighttime city in the background, warm-toned streetlights on the left, and cool-toned blue-purple neon lights on the right, creating a hazy rainy atmosphere. High contrast is achieved using high-end automotive advertising lighting techniques, presenting ultra-fine glass refraction, clear water droplets, glossy reflections, and a cinematic realism. The vertical composition, close-up low-angle macro product photography, includes no people, no extraneous objects, and no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个竖屏电影级写实奢华产品广告：一个横卧在雨后城市街道上的透明玻璃胶囊，左侧透明部分展示着微缩的 {argument name="car model" default="黑色 Bentley SUV"}。胶囊由 2 个主要部分组成：左侧是覆盖着水珠的透明圆顶玻璃，右侧是具有紫-洋红-蓝渐变效果的亮面金属材质。在右半部分，放置一个金色的 Bentley 风格飞翼徽标，徽标上方是一个圆形的“B”字样，徽标下方是醒目的白色大字 {argument name="brand text" default="BENTLEY"}。路面为黑色，湿润且具有反光效果，倒映出胶囊、汽车、徽标和品牌文字；前景包含零星的雨滴和小水洼。采用戏剧性的浅景深效果，背景为模糊的夜间城市，左侧为暖色路灯光斑，右侧为冷色调蓝紫色霓虹光斑，营造朦胧雨景氛围，高对比度，采用高端汽车广告布光，呈现超精细玻璃折射、清晰的水珠、亮面反射以及电影级的写实感。竖屏构图，近距离低角度微距产品拍摄，无人物，无额外物体，无水印。

templates.title: Portrait of Rose Garden in the Wind

titleLocalized.zh: 风中玫瑰花园肖像

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic, low-angle fashion photograph, with the subject being {argument name="subject" default="A young woman"} She stood in a lush garden of red roses, the photo taken during the golden hour. The angle was low, as if the camera were positioned within the flowers. She wore a flowing, semi-transparent dress.{argument name="dress color" default="Ivory White"} A vintage lace maxi dress with long, semi-sheer sleeves, a ruffled high neck, delicate embroidery, and soft, layered fabric. Her long {argument name="hairstyle" default="Brown double braids"} Her hair billowed wildly in the wind, strands dancing in the air. Her face was obscured by a centered matte tan square. Blooming red roses surrounded her, with blurred rose bushes in the lower right and directly below to increase depth of field. Red rose petals drifted through the air, scattered across the sky and foreground, some clearly visible, others with motion blur. The background was a bright blue sky with scattered white clouds, and strong, warm sunlight streamed in from the lower left, creating a halo around her skirt and hair. The overall atmosphere was romantic, surreal, and sophisticatedly stylish, employing shallow depth of field, dynamic wind effects, warm orange highlights, rich red petals, and natural film grain to present a hyper-realistic editing and photography style. (Vertical...){argument name="aspect ratio" default="3:4"} The composition and perspective are strong; there is no text or watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影感低角度时尚摄影作品，主体为 {argument name="subject" default="一位年轻女性"}，她站在郁郁葱葱的红玫瑰花园中，拍摄时间为黄金时刻。视角采用低角度，仿佛相机置身于花丛之中。她身穿一件飘逸的半透明 {argument name="dress color" default="象牙白"} 复古蕾丝长裙，配有长款半透明袖子、荷叶边高领、精致刺绣及柔软的层叠面料。她长长的 {argument name="hairstyle" default="棕色双麻花辫"} 在风中剧烈飘动，发丝在天空中飞舞。面部被一个居中的哑光棕褐色方块遮挡。周围布满盛开的红玫瑰，右下方和正下方的镜头近处有模糊的玫瑰花丛以增加景深。空气中弥漫着飞舞的红玫瑰花瓣，分布在天空和前景中，部分清晰可见，部分带有动态模糊。背景为明亮的蓝天和零星白云，强烈的暖色阳光从左下方射入，为裙摆和发丝勾勒出光晕。整体氛围浪漫、超现实且具有高级时尚感，采用浅景深、动态风效、暖橙色高光、浓郁的红色花瓣、自然胶片颗粒感，呈现超写实的编辑摄影风格。采用垂直 {argument name="aspect ratio" default="3:4"} 构图，透视感强烈，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Realistic portraits of Korean school classrooms

titleLocalized.zh: 写实的韩国学校教室肖像

templates.prompt: A hyper-realistic portrait depicts a beautiful Korean woman standing in an empty classroom during the golden afternoon hours, shot with a cinematic, film-like style. She is slightly turned to the side, her gaze directed at the camera, her expression soft and restrained—her lips slightly parted, her eyes calm and bright. Her hands casually grip the strap of a canvas tote bag slung over her shoulder, her posture relaxed and natural. She wears a slightly off-the-shoulder vintage beige oversized knit sweater, paired with a high-waisted dark navy blue pleated skirt and white low-top sneakers. She wears simple layered gold necklaces, her jewelry minimalist, showcasing understated Korean street style aesthetics. Her long, dark brown hair, with subtle highlights, is half-tucked behind her ears, displaying a natural, slightly wavy texture. Her skin is dewy, her cheeks slightly flushed, her lips a light color, and her eye makeup clear—showcasing a natural Korean beauty. Warm amber light streams in from the tall classroom windows at a low angle, casting long, dramatic shadows on the wooden desks and floor. Tiny dust particles are faintly visible within the beams of light. A realistic Korean classroom scene—rows of wooden desks, a retro chalkboard with Korean writing (project), the Korean flag, an old wall clock, stacks of textbooks, and a worn, polished floor. 35mm simulated film grain texture, Kodak Portra 400 color palette—warm honey, soft green, and cream. Shallow depth of field, blurring the background around the classroom furniture. A nostalgic Korean drama coming-of-age visual tone, a quiet emotional narrative atmosphere, editorial lifestyle photography, film stills, hyper-realistic skin and fabric textures, the hazy feel of prime time, a tranquil and solitary ambiance.

promptLocalized.zh: 一张超写实的肖像，描绘了一位美丽的韩国女性站在午后黄金时段空无一人的韩国教室里，采用电影级胶片摄影风格拍摄。她微微侧身，目光转向镜头，表情柔和而内敛——双唇微启，眼神平静而明亮。双手随意地抓着挂在肩上的帆布托特包肩带，姿态随性自然。身穿一件略微露肩的复古米色大廓形针织毛衣，搭配高腰深海军蓝百褶短裙和白色低帮运动鞋。佩戴简约的叠戴金项链，饰品极简，呈现低调的韩式街头时尚美学。深棕色长发带有细微挑染，半别在耳后，呈现自然的微卷质感。水光肌，脸颊微红，淡淡的唇色，清透的眼妆——展现自然的韩式美感。温暖的琥珀色金光从高大的教室窗户低角度射入，在木质课桌和地板上投下长长的戏剧性阴影。光束中隐约可见细小的尘埃。真实的韩国教室场景——成排的木质课桌、带有韩文书写的复古粉笔绿板（项目）、韩国国旗、旧挂钟、堆叠的教科书、磨损的抛光地板。35mm 模拟胶片颗粒质感，Kodak Portra 400 色调——温暖的蜂蜜色、柔和的绿色、奶油色。浅景深，教室家具呈现背景虚化效果。怀旧的韩剧成长叙事视觉基调，安静的情感叙事氛围，编辑类生活方式摄影，电影剧照，超写实的皮肤和织物纹理，黄金时段的朦胧感，宁静孤独的意境。

templates.title: Calamari Cone Model Comparison

titleLocalized.zh: Calamari Cone 模型对比

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a vertical comparison image that presents the same tempting fried squid ring tube in two stacked panels, similar to a side-by-side model comparison, but arranged vertically. Canvas: 1:1 square image, 768 x 768 composition style, horizontally divided into two perfectly equal panels. Use clean and bright colors.{argument name="background color" default="vivid ocean blue"} The studio background features a subtle gradient effect; the top panel is slightly darker, and the bottom panel is slightly lighter. Layout: The top panel contains a suspended cardboard tube of fried squid rings, positioned slightly to the left of center, tilted upright, surrounded by flying crumbs and squid rings. The bottom panel contains the same cardboard tube, but larger and closer to the lens, also positioned slightly to the left of center, with a few flying squid rings and a slice of lemon. A white italic serif label is added near the bottom right corner of the top panel, with the text {argument name="top label" default="GPT image 2"} Add another white italic serif label to the bottom right corner of the bottom panel, with the text:{argument name="bottom label" default="Nano Banana 2"} Main details: The food is golden, crispy fried squid rings with a rough, crunchy surface, presented in a high-speed food advertising photography style. A total of 2 lemon slices are used: one is tucked into the upper right corner of the top tube, and the other is suspended near the upper right corner of the bottom panel. A total of 34 distinct squid rings are used: 18 on the top panel, with 10 stacked inside the tube and 8 floating around; 16 on the bottom panel, with 13 stacked inside the tube and 3 floating on the outside. Numerous small orange breadcrumb particles and a small amount of suspended batter crumbs are added, especially densely around the top tube. Packaging: Each tube is made of off-white imitation newspaper paper printed with blue ink. The main circular logo text on the tube is {argument name="brand logo text" default="FISH & LOVE"} There's a small fish illustration above it. The large blue newspaper headline on the wrapping paper reads:{argument name="wrapper headline" default="From the sea to love."} It features smaller, decorative seafood newspaper details, thin blue ruler lines, small filled text columns, simple illustrations of fish and lemons, and the phrase "Simple ingredients, unforgettable taste" on the packaging. The top tube is slightly smaller, with a more dramatic crumb splatter effect; the bottom tube is larger and more refined, with clearer text on the packaging. Visual style: Hyperrealistic commercial food photography, with crisp textures, sharp focus on the squid rings, high-speed still motion, bright natural highlights, enticing warm orange-gold food against a saturated blue background, shallow depth of field, clean advertising composition, no portraits, no plates, no superfluous items, and no watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一张垂直对比图，将同一个诱人的炸鱿鱼圈纸筒以两个堆叠面板的形式呈现，类似于并排模型对比，但采用上下排列方式。

画布：1:1 正方形图片，768 x 768 构图风格，水平分割为 2 个完全相等的面板。使用干净明亮的 {argument name="background color" default="vivid ocean blue"} 摄影棚背景，并带有微妙的渐变效果；顶部面板颜色略深，底部面板颜色略浅。

布局：顶部面板包含一个悬浮的炸鱿鱼圈纸筒，位于中心偏左位置，直立倾斜，周围环绕着飞舞的碎屑和鱿鱼圈。底部面板包含同样的纸筒，但尺寸更大且更靠近镜头，位于中心偏左位置，配有少量飞舞的鱿鱼圈和一片柠檬。在顶部面板右下角附近添加一个白色的斜体衬线标签，文字为 {argument name="top label" default="GPT image 2"}；在底部面板右下角添加另一个白色的斜体衬线标签，文字为 {argument name="bottom label" default="Nano Banana 2"}。

主体细节：食物为金黄酥脆的炸鱿鱼圈，表面有粗糙的脆皮，采用高速食品广告摄影风格。总共使用 2 片柠檬：1 片塞在顶部纸筒的右上角，1 片悬浮在底部面板的右上角附近。总共使用 34 个明显的鱿鱼圈：顶部面板 18 个，其中 10 个堆叠在纸筒内，8 个在周围飞舞；底部面板 16 个，其中 13 个堆叠在纸筒内，3 个在外部飞舞。添加许多细小的橙色面包屑颗粒和少量悬浮在空中的碎面糊，顶部纸筒周围尤为密集。

包装：每个纸筒均由印有蓝色油墨的米白色仿报纸纸张制成。纸筒上的主圆形徽标文字为 {argument name="brand logo text" default="FISH & LOVE"}，上方有一个小鱼插图。包装纸上的大型蓝色报纸标题文字为 {argument name="wrapper headline" default="From the sea to love."}。包含较小的装饰性海鲜报纸细节、细蓝色标尺线、细小的填充文本列、简单的鱼和柠檬插图，以及包装上的短语“Simple ingredients, unforgettable taste.”。顶部纸筒略小，碎屑飞溅效果更具戏剧性；底部纸筒更大、更精致，包装上的文字更清晰。

视觉风格：超写实商业食品摄影，质感清晰，鱿鱼圈焦点锐利，高速定格动作，明亮的自然高光，饱和蓝色背景下的诱人暖橙金色食物，浅景深，干净的广告构图，无人像，无餐盘，无多余物品，无水印。

templates.title: Necromancer Pixel Art Comparison

titleLocalized.zh: 死灵法师像素艺术对比

templates.prompt: Create a dark fantasy pixel art character comparison on a wide horizontal canvas with a charcoal black background and a subtle dark gray border. Show two complete full-body necromancer portraits side-by-side: the left is a softer, pixelated/blended pixel version, while the right is a pixelated version with sharper outlines, stronger black borders, and more pronounced blocky edges. Both characters depict the same necromancer: a skeletal necromancer wearing tattered robes and a hood, wielding a twisted wooden staff tipped with blue ghostly flames. The left character's face is blurred and dark beneath the hood, while the right character reveals a skeletal face with hollow eye sockets and exposed teeth. The characters are dressed in dark {argument name="robe color" default="Midnight Blue and Soft Purple"} The characters wear hooded robes with tattered hems, layered sleeves, torn and trailing strips of fabric, bone breastplates, rope and leather belts, hanging gold ornaments, a central oval blue gem, small pouches, and bare skeletal hands and feet. Each character holds a twisted staff in their left hand; each staff is topped with a blue flame surrounded by twisted branches and adorned with hanging pendants and beaded decorations. Each character's right hand is raised in a casting gesture, fingers spread. The design utilizes a limited pixel art palette, high-contrast edge shadows, soft brown wood, ivory white bone details, deep navy blue folds, and luminous electric blue flame highlights. The two characters are kept in almost identical poses, vertically centered, with the left character slightly softer and more painterly, while the right character has a sharper pixelated look. There is no text, labels, watermarks, or additional characters; there is no background landscape except for a solid dark background.

promptLocalized.zh: 在宽幅横向画布上创建一个暗黑奇幻像素艺术角色对比图，背景为炭黑色，并带有微妙的深灰色边框。并排展示 2 个完整的死灵法师全身像：左侧为柔和的类像素/混合像素版本，右侧为轮廓更清晰、黑色边框更强、块状边缘更明显的像素化版本。两个角色均描绘同一位亡灵巫师：一位身穿层叠破烂长袍、戴着兜帽的骷髅死灵法师，手持一根顶端带有蓝色幽灵火焰的扭曲木杖。左侧角色的兜帽下是模糊阴暗的空白面部，右侧角色则露出带有空洞眼眶和裸露牙齿的骷髅脸。角色穿着深色 {argument name="robe color" default="午夜蓝和柔和紫"} 连帽长袍，配有破烂的下摆、层叠的袖子、撕裂的拖曳布条、骨质胸甲、绳索与皮革腰带、悬挂的金色饰品、中央椭圆形蓝色宝石、小袋子，以及裸露的骷髅手脚。每个角色左手各持 1 根扭曲的法杖；每根法杖顶端有 1 团被扭曲树枝环绕的蓝色火焰，并带有悬挂的小挂件和珠状装饰。每个角色的右手均抬起，呈施法姿势，手指张开。使用有限的像素艺术调色板、高对比度的边缘阴影、柔和的棕色木材、象牙白骨骼细节、深海军蓝褶皱以及发光的电蓝色火焰高光。保持 2 个角色的姿势几乎一致，垂直居中，左侧角色略显柔和且具有绘画感，右侧角色则更具锐利的像素感。无文字、无标签、无水印、无额外字符，除纯色深色背景外无任何背景景观。

templates.title: Neon rooftop pool selfie

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹屋顶泳池自拍

templates.prompt: Create a realistic nighttime poolside selfie taken at a modern urban luxury rooftop resort. Showcase [something] in the foreground.{argument name="subject" default="A young woman"} Standing in the glowing pool, waist-deep, her arms outstretched to the sides, she appears to be taking a vibrant vacation selfie. Her face is partially obscured by a soft, opaque, square privacy panel in the center. She has tousled, dark brown hair, revealing her shoulders and collarbone, and wears a bright red one-piece swimsuit printed with an all-over watermelon pattern: red flesh, green rind curves, and small black seeds. A small white logo on the chest reads…{argument name="swimsuit logo" default="MAD WAVE"} The swimsuit features athletic straps, a round neck, and a high-slit cut. The pool water is a bright turquoise with clear ripples and reflections, and the scene is illuminated by magenta, purple, and blue neon lights. Behind her, three clearly visible resort elements are visible: a deckchair on the left deck, a palm tree with warm-toned uplighting, and a modern long pavilion or poolside building with pink neon strips on the right. In the distance, a dense skyline of nighttime high-rise office buildings is displayed, with many bright windows and red aviation obstruction lights on the rooftops. Using a wide-angle selfie perspective with slight lens distortion, the subject is centered and close to the camera, with the arms cropped at the left and right edges. The background details are clear but the depth of field is shallow, with shimmering reflections on the water, highly realistic, and a vibrant nightlife atmosphere, with no other people in the foreground. The scene atmosphere is set to {argument name="city resort mood" default="Enchanting City Rooftop Pool Party"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张在现代城市豪华屋顶度假村拍摄的写实风格夜间手机泳池自拍。在前景中，展示 {argument name="subject" default="一位年轻女性"} 站在发光的泳池中，水深及腰，双臂向画面两侧伸展，仿佛正在拍摄一张充满活力的度假自拍。她的脸部被一个位于中心位置、呈柔和紫褐色的不透明方形隐私遮挡块遮住。她留着凌乱的深棕色短发，露出肩膀和锁骨，身穿一件鲜红色的连体泳衣，上面印有满版西瓜图案：红色果肉、绿色果皮曲线和黑色小籽形状，胸前有一个白色小标志，写着 {argument name="swimsuit logo" default="MAD WAVE"}。泳衣采用运动肩带、圆领设计和高开叉剪裁。泳池水呈明亮的绿松石色，带有清晰的涟漪和倒影，场景被洋红色、紫色和蓝色的霓虹灯照亮。在她身后，包含三个清晰可见的度假村元素：左侧甲板上的躺椅、带有暖色上照灯的棕榈树，以及右侧带有粉色霓虹灯条的现代长形凉亭或池畔建筑。在远景中，展示一片密集的夜间高层办公楼天际线，有许多明亮的窗户和屋顶上的红色航空障碍灯。使用带有轻微镜头畸变的广角自拍视角，主体居中且靠近相机，双臂被左右边缘部分裁切，背景细节清晰但景深较浅，水面光泽倒影，高度写实，色彩鲜艳的夜生活氛围，前景中没有其他人。将场景氛围设置为 {argument name="city resort mood" default="迷人的城市屋顶泳池派对"}。

templates.title: Pet portraits on golden grass

titleLocalized.zh: 金黄草地上的宠物肖像

templates.prompt: Create a warm, natural outdoor vertical portrait with the golden hour sunlight in the background:{argument name="subject" default="A young woman with two long brown braids"} She sits barefoot on a meadow overgrown with wildflowers, a dense canopy of green leaves overhead, wearing a cream-colored sleeveless summer dress. She is centered in the frame, knees facing the camera, gently cradling a tabby cat in her arms; the cat faces forward, its striped fur clearly defined, its eyes alert. The frame must include two large dogs close to her: a dark brown long-haired dog on the left, and a golden retriever with its tongue lolling out on the right. Add three opaque, warm brown squares to the faces of the woman and the two dogs, keeping the cat's face clear. Use soft backlighting from the upper left, a halo effect, dappled tree shadows, shallow depth of field, and blurred foreground daisies and grass to create a dreamy, film-like quality with realistic skin and fur textures, natural warm tones, a 9:16 vertical composition, low-angle shooting, no text, and no watermark.

templates.title: Luxury Facial Harmony Analysis Report

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华面部和谐度分析报告

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="subject gender" default="woman"} Create a luxurious "Facial Aesthetic Analysis" symmetry report, employing a high-end beauty lab scanning style, overlaying gold measurement baselines onto a grayscale portrait. Canvas: 4:3 horizontal report layout, clean white background with subtle paper texture, thin gold dividing lines, and a luxurious black and gold brand style. Add a tall black rounded-corner sidebar on the left, a large portrait analysis area in the center, and a results column on the right. Layout: Use three main vertical areas. The left sidebar occupies approximately 22% of the width, the central portrait report area occupies approximately 48% of the width, and the right analysis column occupies approximately 30% of the width. Add a black footer bar spanning the entire screen at the bottom, with gold text. Left sidebar content: Large stacked gold serif title "FACIAL BEAUTY ANALYSIS". Smaller subtitle "SCIENCE. SYMMETRY. HARMONY." An "OVERVIEW" section uses brief paragraphs to explain that the report analyzes facial features based on symmetry, proportion, and harmony. A "YOUR MODEL" section contains five lines: ID "FB-2024-05-18", GENDER "Female", AGE RANGE "20-30", FACE SHAPE "Oval", SKIN TONE "Light". At the bottom is an elegant "FB" monogram logo and a "FACIAL BEAUTY LAB" label. The central content: top title "YOUR FACIAL HARMONY REPORT". It presents a frontal grayscale portrait of the model with dark, slicked-back hair, a neutral expression, and soft studio lighting, conveying a high-fashion clinical feel. A medium gray rectangular mask covers the central area of ​​the face, revealing only the hairline, ears, neck, and shoulders. Fine gold facial analysis guide lines are overlaid around the visible head: a vertical center line, horizontal trisections (precisely marked 3 times "1/3"), lower neck/shoulder proportion scales (precisely marked 5 times "1/5"), tiny gold reference points, and delicate dashed measurement rulers. Below the portrait is a "FACIAL PROPORTIONS" section containing five compact indicator cards: FACE LENGTH 1.00, FOREHEAD 1.03, MIDFACE 1.00, LOWER FACE 0.97, and FACE WIDTH 1.01. It includes the note "Ideal proportion value: 1.00". The right-hand column contains a top card titled "HARMONY SCORE" accompanied by a gold semi-circular dashboard ranging from 0 to 100.{argument name="harmony score" default="91.2"} The large score indicates a harmonious and well-proportioned facial structure. Below it is "OUTSTANDING," accompanied by a short sentence explaining the high degree of harmony and balance in facial features. The middle card, titled "KEY METRICS," contains seven lines, each with a small gold line icon, label, and score: Facial Symmetry 94, Proportions 90, Eye Position 92, Nose Proportion 90, Lips Symmetry 88, Chin & Jawline 89, Overall Harmony 91. The bottom card, titled "ANALYSIS INSIGHTS," includes a concise paragraph about excellent balance and proportion, along with three small icons: Balanced Symmetry, Well-Proportioned Features, High Aesthetic Potential. The footer features a full-width black stripe with the centered gold-serif quote "BEAUTY IS MEASURED IN HARMONY, NOT PERFECTION," accompanied by a small decorative asterisk. Visual Style: Luxurious beauty technology report, refined serif fonts, minimalist sans-serif labels, monochrome portraits, metallic gold accents, thin lines, clean margins, editorial medical aesthetic design. Lines, icons, dashboards, and headings utilize {argument name="accent color" default="Metallic gold"} Keep the text clear and legible, no extra parts required, and no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="subject gender" default="女性"} 创建一份奢华的“面部美学分析”对称性报告，采用高端美容实验室扫描风格，在灰度肖像上叠加金色测量基准线。

画布：横向 4:3 报告布局，简洁的白色背景，带有细微的纸张纹理，细金色的分隔线，黑金配色的奢华品牌风格。左侧添加一个高大的黑色圆角侧边栏，中央为大型肖像分析区，右侧为结果列。

布局：使用三个主要的垂直区域。左侧边栏约占 22% 的宽度，中央肖像报告区约占 48% 的宽度，右侧分析列约占 30% 的宽度。底部添加一条横跨全屏的黑色页脚栏，配以金色文字。

左侧边栏内容：大型堆叠式金色衬线标题“FACIAL BEAUTY ANALYSIS”。小字副标题“SCIENCE. SYMMETRY. HARMONY.”。一个“OVERVIEW”部分，用简短的段落解释该报告基于对称性、比例和和谐度研究分析面部特征。一个“YOUR MODEL”部分，包含 5 行内容：ID “FB-2024-05-18”，GENDER “Female”，AGE RANGE “20-30”，FACE SHAPE “Oval”，SKIN TONE “Light”。底部放置一个优雅的“FB”字母组合标志和“FACIAL BEAUTY LAB”标签。

中央内容：顶部标题“YOUR FACIAL HARMONY REPORT”。展示一张正面灰度肖像，模特为深色头发后梳，表情中性，柔和的摄影棚灯光，呈现高级时尚临床感。用一个中灰色矩形遮罩覆盖面部中央区域，仅露出头发轮廓、耳朵、颈部和肩膀。在可见的头部周围叠加精细的金色面部分析引导线：一条垂直中心线，水平三等分线（精确标注 3 次“1/3”），下颈部/肩部比例刻度（精确标注 5 次“1/5”），微小的金色基准点，以及精致的虚线测量标尺。肖像下方添加“FACIAL PROPORTIONS”部分，包含 5 张紧凑的指标卡片：FACE LENGTH 1.00, FOREHEAD 1.03, MIDFACE 1.00, LOWER FACE 0.97, FACE WIDTH 1.01。包含注释“Ideal proportion value: 1.00”。

右侧列内容：顶部卡片标题为“HARMONY SCORE”，配有一个 0 到 100 的金色半圆仪表盘和 {argument name="harmony score" default="91.2"} 的大号分数；下方显示“OUTSTANDING”，并配有一句简短的句子，说明面部特征高度和谐且比例均衡。中间卡片标题为“KEY METRICS”，包含 7 行内容，每行配有一个小型金色线条图标、标签和分数：Facial Symmetry 94, Proportions 90, Eye Position 92, Nose Proportion 90, Lips Symmetry 88, Chin & Jawline 89, Overall Harmony 91。底部卡片标题为“ANALYSIS INSIGHTS”，包含一段关于卓越平衡与比例的简洁段落，以及 3 个小型图标说明：Balanced Symmetry, Well-Proportioned Features, High Aesthetic Potential。

页脚：全宽黑色条带，居中显示金色衬线引言“BEAUTY IS MEASURED IN HARMONY, NOT PERFECTION.”，并配有小型装饰性星号。

视觉风格：奢华美容科技报告，精致的衬线字体，极简的无衬线标签，单色肖像，金属金色点缀，细线条，简洁的页边距，编辑类医学美学设计。线条、图标、仪表盘和标题使用 {argument name="accent color" default="金属金色"}。保持文字清晰易读，无需额外部分，无水印。

templates.title: FN SCAR-L Tactical Specifications

titleLocalized.zh: FN SCAR-L 战术规格表

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="rifle model" default="FN SCAR-L"} Create a dark tactical firearms character sheet style technical poster, presented as a clean military product infographic. Canvas: Vertical 2:3 poster with a matte charcoal black textured background, paired with a worn tan template font and thin, soft gray grid lines. Use a realistic studio-rendered firearm illustration with a head-up side profile in coyote brown and black, featuring subtle scratches, edge wear, and soft shadows. Header: Place a large, distressed template title in the upper left corner that reads "FN SCAR-L". Below it, add three lines of smaller text: "[SPECIAL OPERATIONS FORCES COMBAT ASSAULT RIFLE – LIGHT]",  {argument name="caliber line" default="5.56x45mm NATO / 7.62x51mm NATO"} "as well as"{argument name="tagline" default="THE MODULAR BATTLE RIFLE FOR THE MODERN WARRIOR"} In the upper right corner, there is a circular FN monogram style logo and the text "FN HERSTAL". Main visual layout: Showing 4 gun views/components. 1) The upper half is a large, full-length left-side profile of the rifle, dominant and richly detailed. 2) To its lower right is a smaller, full-length rifle side profile for numbered feature annotations. 3) The lower middle section is a partially disassembled upper receiver and barrel assembly, with the barrel components horizontally separated. 4) Below this is a lower receiver/stock assembly, with the magazine removed and a small loose pin or screw nearby. A cropped close-up of the rifle detail is added within the caliber conversion box in the lower right corner. Feature annotations: Contains 6 numbered labels with small square tags, pointed to by thin guide lines. The numbered list on the left must be: 1 "MIL-STD-1913 TOP RAIL", subtitle "For Optical Sights and Accessories"; 2 "SIDE FOLDING STOCK", subtitle "Adjustable Pull"; 3 "AMBIDEXTROUS" 4. "CONTROLS", subtitle "Selector switch, magazine release button, and slide stop"; 5. "FREE-FLOATING HANDGUARD", subtitle "Accessory rails with 3, 6, and 9 o'clock positions"; 6. "QUICK-CHANGE BARREL", subtitle "Caliber conversion in minutes"; 7. "SHORT-STROKE GAS PISTON", subtitle "Reliable operation in harsh environments". Specifications: A framed table in the lower left corner is titled "SPECIFICATIONS [5.56x45mm]". It contains 10 lines: Caliber: 5.56x45mm NATO; Operation: Gas-operated, short-stroke piston; Magazine capacity: 30 rounds (STANAG); Overall length: 35.25 inches (895 mm); Barrel length: 16.25 inches (413 mm); Weight (empty): 7.50 lbs (3.40 lbs). (kg); Rate of fire: 625–650 rounds/min; Muzzle velocity: ~2,750 ft/s (838 m/s); Effective range: 500 m; Sights: Iron sights, folding (front and rear), with support for optical sights (MIL-STD-1913 rail). Bottom information panel: Two framed text panels are added to the bottom. Left panel: A short paragraph explaining that the FN SCAR-L is a modular assault rifle designed for the U.S. Special Operations Command, chambered in 5.56x45mm NATO, emphasizing its reliability, accuracy, adaptability, and lightweight performance in combat. Right panel title: “CALIBER CONVERSION”, followed by text explaining the rapid conversion using the FN quick-change barrel system, and the two ammunition calibers: “5.56x45mm NATO (SCAR-L)” and “7.62x51mm NATO (SCAR-H)”. Visual constraints: Keep all text in English for clear and legible readability; adopt professional weapon manual/defense catalog aesthetics; avoid figures, hands, shooting effects, flags, or cluttered elements; maintain accurate orthographic side views and soft black, sepia, and gray tones.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="rifle model" default="FN SCAR-L"} 创建一张深色战术枪械角色表风格的技术海报，呈现为简洁的军事产品信息图。

画布：垂直 2:3 海报，采用磨砂炭黑色纹理背景，搭配磨损的棕褐色模板字体和纤细的柔和灰色网格线。使用写实的摄影棚渲染枪械插图，采用平视侧面轮廓，颜色为郊狼棕色和黑色，带有细微划痕、边缘磨损和柔和阴影。

页眉：在左上角放置一个巨大的做旧模板标题，写着“FN SCAR-L”。在其下方，添加三行较小的文字：“[SPECIAL OPERATIONS FORCES COMBAT ASSAULT RIFLE – LIGHT]”、“{argument name="caliber line" default="5.56x45mm NATO / 7.62x51mm NATO"}”以及“{argument name="tagline" default="THE MODULAR BATTLE RIFLE FOR THE MODERN WARRIOR"}”。在右上角，包含一个圆形的 FN 字母组合风格标志和文字“FN HERSTAL”。

主要视觉布局：展示 4 个枪械视图/组件。1) 上半部分是一个大型的左侧全长步枪侧面轮廓，占据主导地位且细节丰富。2) 其右下方是一个较小的完整步枪侧面轮廓，用于编号特征标注。3) 中下部是一个部分拆解的上机匣和枪管组件，枪管部件水平分离。4) 其下方是一个下机匣/枪托组件，弹匣已移除，附近有一个松脱的小销钉或螺丝。在右下角的口径转换框内添加一个裁剪后的步枪细节特写。

特征标注：包含 6 个带小方块标签的编号标注，并用细引导线指向步枪部件。左侧的编号列表必须为：1 “MIL-STD-1913 TOP RAIL”，副标题“用于光学瞄具和配件”；2 “SIDE FOLDING STOCK”，副标题“可调节拉距”；3 “AMBIDEXTROUS CONTROLS”，副标题“快慢机、弹匣释放钮和空仓挂机”；4 “FREE-FLOATING HANDGUARD”，副标题“带有 3、6 和 9 点钟方向的配件导轨”；5 “QUICK-CHANGE BARREL”，副标题“可在几分钟内完成口径转换”；6 “SHORT-STROKE GAS PISTON”，副标题“在恶劣环境下可靠运行”。

规格表：在左下角放置一个带框表格，标题为“SPECIFICATIONS [5.56x45mm]”。包含 10 行：口径：5.56x45mm NATO；操作方式：导气式，短行程活塞；弹匣容量：30 发 (STANAG)；全长：35.25 英寸 (895 毫米)；枪管长度：16.25 英寸 (413 毫米)；重量 (空枪)：7.50 磅 (3.40 千克)；射速：625–650 发/分钟；枪口初速：~2,750 英尺/秒 (838 米/秒)；有效射程：500 米；瞄具：机械瞄具，可折叠 (前部和后部)，支持光学瞄具 (MIL-STD-1913 导轨)。

底部信息面板：在底部添加两个带框文本面板。左侧面板：一段简短的段落，解释 FN SCAR-L 是一款为美国特种作战司令部设计的模块化突击步枪，口径为 5.56x45mm NATO，强调其可靠性、精度、适应性和轻量化的实战表现。右侧面板标题：“CALIBER CONVERSION”，随后是解释使用 FN 快速更换枪管系统进行快速转换的文字，以及 2 种弹药口径：“5.56x45mm NATO (SCAR-L)”和“7.62x51mm NATO (SCAR-H)”。

视觉约束：保持所有文字为英文，清晰易读；采用专业的武器手册/国防目录美学；避免出现人物、手部、射击效果、旗帜或杂乱元素；保持精确的正投影侧视图以及柔和的黑色、棕褐色和灰色调。

templates.title: M2010 ESR Tactical Specifications

titleLocalized.zh: M2010 ESR 战术规格说明书

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="rifle model" default="M2010 ESR"} Create a realistic military technical manual-style infographic showcasing a tan-toned enhanced sniper rifle, complete with component labels, specifications, measurement guidelines, and detailed close-ups. Canvas: Vertical 2:3 poster with a dark charcoal gray textured background, high resolution, realistic 3D product rendering, soft tactical color scheme, tan and black rifle parts, and beige military template font. Layout: A large heading in the top left corner {argument name="headline text" default="M2010 ESR"} The subtitle below reads "ENHANCED SNIPER RIFLE". Below that, a brief description is added: "The M2010 Enhanced Sniper Rifle (ESR) is a 7.62×51mm NATO caliber precision bolt-action rifle adopted by the U.S. Army in 2010 as an upgrade to the M24 Sniper Weapon System." The upper section is a two-thirds side view of the rifle, tilted from the lower left to the upper right, clearly showing the scope, bipod, long barrel, muzzle brake, adjustable stock, grip, magazine, and free-floating handguard. Labels and text: Three component labels are included around the rifle: “MIL-STD-1913 accessory rail,” “5-round or 10-round detachable magazine,” and “Adjustable stock (pull distance and cheek rest height).” A “FEATURES” section with six key points is added: “Improved accuracy and effective range compared to the M24,” “Modular design for easy maintenance and upgrades,” “Adjustable stock to accommodate pull distance and cheek rest,” “Competition-grade barrel for improved accuracy,” “Free-floating handguard with accessory rail,” and “Suppressor compatible.” Specification panel: On the upper right of the rifle, there is a table titled “SPECIFICATIONS,” with nine rows: Caliber: 7.62×51mm NATO; Bolt-action; Overall length: 48.5 inches (1,230 mm); Barrel length: 24 inches (610 mm); Weight: 14.8 lbs (6.7 kg, including scope and bipod); Magazine capacity: 5 or 10 rounds; Effective range: 800–1,000 m; Maximum range: over 1,500 m; Sights: Leupold Mark 4 6.5–20×50 mm. Center View: Add a second full side view of the rifle in the center position, keeping it horizontal and smaller than the top rendering. Add measuring lines, labeling "48.5 inches (1,230 mm)" above the rifle and "8.6 inches (218 mm)" vertically near the stock. Details: Create a grid at the bottom titled "DETAIL VIEWS," divided into two rows of three, for a total of six close-up panels. Panel content: 1) 1) Muzzle Brake, subtitle "Reduces Recoil and Muzzle Rise"; 2) Free-Floating Handguard, subtitle "Improves Accuracy by Reducing Barrel Contact"; 3) Bolt-Action Bolt, subtitle "Smooth, Reliable, and Proven Design"; 4) Adjustable Stock, subtitle "Customizable to Shooter Needs for Enhanced Fit and Comfort"; 5) Detachable Magazine, subtitle "5- or 10-round Options for Increased Operational Flexibility"; 6) Leupold Mark 4 Scope, subtitle "6.5–20x Magnification for Accurate Long-Range Shooting". Visual Style: Photorealistic tactical catalog rendering, subtle contour lighting, clear labels and fine indicator lines, slight vignetting, professional defense industry specification aesthetics. Ensure all text is clearly legible, using only listed text, and avoid adding people, symbols, flags, watermarks, or additional weapons.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="rifle model" default="M2010 ESR"} 创建一张逼真的军事技术说明书风格信息图，展示一把棕褐色的增强型狙击步枪，并附带组件标注、规格参数、测量指南和细节特写。

画布：垂直 2:3 海报，采用深炭灰色纹理背景，高分辨率，逼真的 3D 产品渲染效果，柔和的战术配色，棕褐色与黑色步枪部件，米色军事模板字体。

布局：左上角放置一个大标题“{argument name="headline text" default="M2010 ESR"}”，下方副标题为“ENHANCED SNIPER RIFLE”。在其下方添加简短描述：“M2010 增强型狙击步枪 (ESR) 是一款 7.62×51mm NATO 口径精密栓动步枪，于 2010 年被美国陆军采用，作为 M24 狙击武器系统的升级版。” 上半部分主体为步枪的三分之二侧视图，从左下角向右上角倾斜，清晰可见瞄准镜、两脚架、长枪管、枪口制退器、可调枪托、握把、弹匣和自由浮动护木。

标注与文字：在步枪周围包含 3 个组件标注：“MIL-STD-1913 附件导轨”、“5 发或 10 发可拆卸弹匣”以及“可调枪托（拉距与贴腮高度）”。添加一个包含 6 个要点的“FEATURES”板块：“精度和有效射程较 M24 有所提升”、“模块化设计便于维护和升级”、“可调节枪托以适应拉距和贴腮”、“竞赛级枪管以提高精度”、“带附件导轨的自由浮动护木”以及“兼容消音器”。

规格面板：在步枪右上侧，包含一个标题为“SPECIFICATIONS”的表格，共 9 行：口径：7.62×51mm NATO；枪机：栓动式；全长：48.5 英寸 (1,230 毫米)；枪管长度：24 英寸 (610 毫米)；重量：14.8 磅 (6.7 公斤，含瞄准镜及两脚架)；弹匣容量：5 发或 10 发；有效射程：800–1,000 米；最大射程：1,500 米以上；瞄准具：Leupold Mark 4 6.5–20×50mm。

中间图示：在中心位置添加该步枪的第二个完整侧视图，保持水平，尺寸小于顶部渲染图。添加测量线，在步枪上方标注“48.5 英寸 (1,230 毫米)”，在枪托附近垂直标注“8.6 英寸 (218 毫米)”。

细节部分：在底部创建一个标题为“DETAIL VIEWS”的网格，分为两行，每行三个，共 6 个特写面板。面板内容为：1) “枪口制退器”，副标题“减少后坐力和枪口上跳”；2) “自由浮动护木”，副标题“通过减少枪管接触提高精度”；3) “栓动枪机”，副标题“平滑、可靠且经过验证的设计”；4) “可调枪托”，副标题“可根据射手需求定制，提升贴合度与舒适度”；5) “可拆卸弹匣”，副标题“5 发或 10 发选项，提升作战灵活性”；6) “Leupold Mark 4 瞄准镜”，副标题“6.5–20 倍放大倍率，实现远程精准射击”。

视觉风格：照片级战术目录渲染，微妙的轮廓光，清晰的标签和细指示线，轻微暗角，专业的国防工业规格说明书美学。确保所有文字清晰可读，仅使用列出的文字，不要添加人物、标志、旗帜、水印或额外的武器。
