templates.title: Cute Cat Donut Personality Diagnosis Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱猫咪甜甜圈性格诊断海报

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a cute, soft, Japanese-style "Animal Character Donut Diagnosis" infographic, evoking a dreamy dessert café atmosphere and presenting a cat-themed diagnosis. Canvas: Vertical 3:4 poster, using soft pink and light purple tones, a glossy and cute style, with a dreamy background of blurred donuts and macarons, adorned with glitter, small flowers, ribbons, a moon, stars, and pearl-like sparkles. Main Title Area: The top uses a large, rounded speech bubble font with a white outline and a pink-purple gradient, displaying {argument name="headline text" default="Animal Character Donut Diagnosis"} Below, in small, warm yellow text, is written "あなたには", followed by a large central result word.{argument name="result animal" default="ネコ"} This is followed by the smaller text "の気配が漂っています". The title is decorated with six eye-catching small icons: two pink flowers, two small stars, one butterfly, and one ribbon. Layout: The layout uses a left-right split composition, with text cards on the left and the core visual elements on the right. The left column contains five semi-transparent white cards with rounded corners, decorated with soft pink borders and miniature icons. The right side contains two core visual elements: a circular anime portrait frame at the top and a cat-shaped donut on a plate at the bottom. Left column text cards: Card 1, titled "道理は" (reason wa), briefly describes the personality as having a mysterious and elegant temperament, both cool and sweet, with cat-like qualities. Card 2, titled "ネコの特徴" (neko no tezu), lists five key points: free-spirited and capricious; cautious yet loving; aesthetically pleasing and elegant; only showing a sweet side to trusted people; observant and intelligent. Card 3, titled "Auspicious Animals," features two compatible animals and simple line drawings: "Ookami" (wolf), with the note "respects independence and builds strong bonds"; and "Usagi" (rabbit), with the note "gentle and healing personality." Card 4, titled "Fortune," lists five aspects of fortune: overall fortune, love fortune, work fortune, lucky item, and lucky color. Card 5, titled "Nekodonatsu ni Tsuite," describes this donut as being coated in cocoa and white chocolate, topped with shimmering purple frosting, and featuring fluffy ears and a tail—a special donut brimming with feline charm. The right-hand circular portrait creates a gorgeous circular border filled with glitter, pearls, flowers, a crescent moon ornament, and a small ribbon. Inside the frame is a mysterious anime-style cat-like girl {argument name="hair color" default="Silver-purple hair"} Dark gothic clothing, purple gemstone accessories, bright lighting, and a dreamy night sky glow. Obscure the center of her face with a solid, opaque gray cube, maintaining consistency with the generated composition. Cat Donut Main Body: In the lower right foreground, a large cat-shaped donut is displayed on an elegant white plate with a gold rim. The donut is decorated with cream and pale purple frosting, with purple syrup dripping from the bottom and sprinkled with glittery powder. It has two upright cat ears, a curled purple tail on the right side, a purple bow above the right ear, two large, glossy purple eyes, three whisker lines on each cheek, a tiny smiling mouth, pink blush, and scattered edible pearls. A small gold fork is placed in the lower right corner of the plate. Visual Style: Super cute dessert illustrations, glossy 3D anime-inspired style, high detail, soft halo, soft pink background, dreamy shimmer, clear and easy-to-read infographic layout, rounded Japanese font, white text boxes, delicate decorative borders, feminine and sweet.{argument name="main color palette" default="Soft pink, light purple, cream and gold"} Constraints: Keep all Japanese text legible, do not add extra cards or main characters, strictly adhere to 5 left-side cards, 2 compatible animals, 1 cat donut, and present a sophisticated social media diagnostic results poster look.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张可爱的柔和日系“动物角色甜甜圈诊断”结果信息图，营造梦幻甜点咖啡馆氛围，并呈现猫咪主题的诊断结果。

画布：垂直 3:4 海报，采用柔粉色与淡紫色调，光泽感可爱风格，背景为梦幻的甜甜圈与马卡龙虚化效果，点缀着闪光、小花、丝带、月亮、星星以及珍珠般的亮光。

主标题区域：顶部使用带有白色描边和粉紫色渐变的圆润大号气泡字体，显示 {argument name="headline text" default="どうぶつキャラドーナツ診断"}。下方用较小的暖黄色文字写着“あなたには”，接着是巨大的中心结果词 {argument name="result animal" default="ネコ"}，随后是较小的文字“の気配が漂っています”。用 6 个醒目的小图案装饰标题：2 朵粉色小花、2 颗小星星、1 只蝴蝶和 1 条丝带。

布局：采用左右分割构图，左侧为文字卡片，右侧为核心视觉元素。左侧栏包含 5 张半透明圆角白色卡片，配有柔粉色边框和微型图标装饰。右侧包含 2 个核心视觉元素：上方为一个圆形动漫肖像框，下方为一个放在盘子里的猫咪造型甜甜圈。

左侧栏文字卡片：卡片 1 标题为“理由は”，简要说明该性格具有神秘而高雅的气质，既冷酷又甜美，且带有猫咪般的特质。卡片 2 标题为“ネコの特徴”，列出 5 个要点：自由奔放、随心所欲；谨慎但充满爱意；审美敏锐且优雅；只对信任的人展现甜美一面；观察力强且聪明。卡片 3 标题为“相性が良い動物”，包含 2 种相性良好的动物及简单的线条图标：“オオカミ”（狼），备注尊重独立性并建立深厚纽带；“ウサギ”（兔子），备注性格温柔治愈。卡片 4 标题为“運勢”，列出 5 项运势：综合运、恋爱运、工作运、幸运物品和幸运色。卡片 5 标题为“ネコドーナツについて”，说明该甜甜圈涂有可可和白巧克力，配有闪亮的紫色糖霜，拥有毛茸茸的耳朵和尾巴，是一款充满猫咪魅力的特别甜甜圈。

右侧圆形肖像：创建一个华丽的圆形边框，填满闪光、珍珠、花朵、新月挂饰和一条小丝带。框内是一位神秘的动漫风格猫系少女，拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="银紫色头发"}、深色哥特式服装、紫色宝石配饰、明亮的强光以及梦幻的夜空光泽。用一个纯色不透明的灰色方块遮挡她脸部中心，与生成的构图保持一致。

猫咪甜甜圈主体：在右下方前景中，展示一个放在精致金边白盘上的大型猫咪造型甜甜圈。甜甜圈采用奶油与淡紫色糖霜设计，底部滴落紫色糖浆，撒有闪光糖粉，拥有 2 只竖起的猫耳、右侧 1 条卷曲的紫色尾巴、右耳上方 1 个紫色蝴蝶结、2 只硕大且有光泽的紫色眼睛、脸颊两侧各有 3 条胡须线、微小的微笑嘴型、粉嫩的腮红以及散落的食用珍珠。在盘子右下方放置一把金色小叉子。

视觉风格：超可爱甜点插画，光泽感 3D 动漫混合风格，高细节，柔和光晕，柔粉色背景，梦幻闪光，清晰易读的信息图排版，圆润的日文字体，白色文本框，精致的装饰边框，女性化且甜美。使用 {argument name="main color palette" default="柔粉色、淡紫色、奶油色和金色"}。

限制：保持所有日文文字清晰可辨，不要增加额外的卡片或主要角色，严格保持 5 张左侧卡片、2 种相性动物、1 个猫咪甜甜圈，并呈现出精致的社交媒体诊断结果海报外观。

templates.title: Cyberpunk high school girl flying motorcycle

titleLocalized.zh: 赛博朋克女高中生飞行摩托

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed, cinematic-quality cyberpunk anime illustration, depicting {argument name="vehicle type" default="A giant retro-futuristic flying motorcycle"} Weaving through a dense, vertical metropolis at night, the scene clearly shows two riders sitting side-by-side atop the machine: Rider 1 is a shorter high school girl with short, dark purple hair, wearing a nautical-style uniform, a red scarf, white knee-high socks, and dark shoes, gripping the handlebars; Rider 2 is a taller high school girl with long, straight black hair, wearing a dark school uniform with a red bow, a plaid skirt, black knee-high socks, and dark shoes, sitting close behind or beside her. Their faces are softened or out of focus, while their clothing, hair, and vehicles are sharply defined. The flying motorcycle is massive and horizontal, covered with exposed brass and gunmetal gray mechanical structures: pipes, rivets, pressure tanks, antennas, cables, instruments, vents, robotic arms, small panels, stickers, and illuminated displays. The image must include four clearly visible purple-blue glowing floating/engine rings: a large circular thruster on the left front nose, a large ring below the center of the front, a ring below the middle rear, and a large circular thruster on the right rear. Add bright arcs around the floating rings and let magenta/cyan light shine on the metal. The front of the vehicle features round, warm-colored headlights, red indicator lights, a weathered rectangular cockpit shell, and a disc-shaped antenna mount above. The background uses a dark, futuristic Japanese city, with towering skyscrapers, deep perspective, a misty atmosphere, and numerous pink, purple, cyan, and blue neon signs; the signs may include stylized Japanese kana/kanji, including a prominent large pink sign in the upper right and smaller vertical signs scattered throughout. Overall atmosphere: dense, rugged, gorgeous, maximalist, a fusion of steampunk and cyberpunk, a nighttime feel, a dramatic low-angle three-quarter view, with the vehicle dominating the image and suspended above the city. Color scheme: Black metallic, bronze, deep navy blue, magenta neon, purple plasma, cyan highlights, and warm amber lighting. Rendered in an ultra-refined anime-inspired art style, with clean lines, cinematic lighting and shadows, volumetric fog effects, and no watermark. Customizable main neon sign text.{argument name="main neon sign text" default="Yatagarasu"} Rider uniform is{argument name="school uniform style" default="Dark Japanese school uniform with red accents"} The urban atmosphere is{argument name="city atmosphere" default="Rainy Night in a Neon Metropolis"} The lighting emphasizes the color as{argument name="plasma glow color" default="purple-blue"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张细节极其丰富的电影级赛博朋克动漫插画，描绘 {argument name="vehicle type" default="一辆巨大的复古未来风飞行摩托"} 在夜晚穿梭于密集的垂直大都市。场景中清晰可见两名骑手并排坐在机器上方：骑手 1 是一名个子较矮的女高中生，留着深紫色短发，身穿海军风水手服，系着红色围巾，穿着白色过膝袜和深色鞋子，手握车把；骑手 2 是一名个子较高的女高中生，留着黑色直长发，身穿深色西装校服，系着红色蝴蝶结，穿着格子裙、黑色过膝袜和深色鞋子，紧贴坐在她身后或身侧。她们的面部柔化处理或处于失焦状态，而服装、头发和载具则清晰锐利。飞行摩托体型庞大且呈水平状，布满了外露的黄铜和枪灰色机械结构：管道、铆钉、压力罐、天线、电缆、仪表、通风口、机械臂、小型面板、贴纸和发光显示屏。画面中需包含四个清晰可见的紫蓝色发光悬浮/引擎环：左前鼻处有一个大型圆形推进器，前部中心下方有一个大型环，中后部下方有一个环，右后方有一个大型圆形推进器。在悬浮环周围添加明亮的电弧，并让洋红色/青色的光洒在金属上。车头配有圆形的暖色前灯、红色指示灯、风化的长方形驾驶舱外壳，以及上方类似碟形天线架的装置。背景使用黑暗的未来主义日本城市，高耸入云的摩天大楼、深邃的透视感、雨雾弥漫的氛围，以及许多粉色、紫色、青色和蓝色的霓虹灯招牌；招牌上可包含风格化的日文假名/汉字，包括右上方一个显眼的大型粉色招牌和散布在各处的小型垂直招牌。整体氛围：密集、粗犷、华丽、极繁主义、蒸汽朋克与赛博朋克的融合、夜间感、戏剧性的低角度四分之三视角，载具占据画面主体并悬浮于城市之上。配色方案：黑化金属、青铜色、深海军蓝、洋红色霓虹、紫色等离子、青色高光和暖琥珀色灯光。以超精细的动漫概念艺术风格渲染，线条清晰，光影电影化，体积雾效果，且无水印。自定义主要霓虹招牌文字为 {argument name="main neon sign text" default="八咫烏"}，骑手制服为 {argument name="school uniform style" default="带有红色点缀的深色日本校服"}，城市氛围为 {argument name="city atmosphere" default="雨夜霓虹大都市"}，灯光强调色为 {argument name="plasma glow color" default="紫蓝色"}。

templates.title: Nighttime baseball pitching scene

titleLocalized.zh: 夜间棒球场投球场景

templates.prompt: Create a highly realistic, cinematic sports photograph depicting a nighttime professional baseball game in a full stadium, shot from a low, wide-angle perspective behind home plate on the third base side. The image must clearly show seven players on the field: a right-handed batter in a grey away jersey and black helmet, holding a bat; a catcher in navy blue protective gear crouching behind home plate; a home plate umpire in a black jersey crouching behind the catcher; a pitcher in a navy blue jersey and white shorts throwing the ball; and three defensive players in the infield and outfield.{argument name="team colors" default="Grey away kit vs. navy blue home kit"} The baseball should be positioned in the flight path between the pitcher and batter. The image should include the dirt batter's box, white chalk lines, green grass, the pitcher's mound, the outfield wall, and the stands filled with spectators under bright stadium floodlights. Place a large electronic scoreboard in the upper right corner, displaying the innings, score, and dense Japanese team/player text with realistic glowing effects, though not necessarily perfectly legible. Atmosphere: A dramatic, tense, and heartwarming atmosphere reminiscent of a game-winning pitch. Use natural stadium lighting, a deep night sky, photorealistic detail, subtle dynamism, a sharp foreground, and a 16:9 wide-angle composition. Customize the batter as {argument name="main batter description" default="A powerful right-handed hitter wearing a grey jersey with black sleeves"} The stadium is{argument name="stadium location" default="A large Japanese baseball stadium"} The scoreboard score is{argument name="scoreboard score" default="1 to 5"} Camera style is{argument name="camera style" default="Professional sports news photography with cinematic realism"} Avoid using trademarks, watermarks, recognizable brand names, extra players besides the designated 7, cartoon styles, or empty seats.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高度写实的电影级体育摄影作品，展现一场在满座球场内进行的夜间职业棒球比赛，拍摄视角位于三垒侧本垒板后方的低位广角。画面中需清晰呈现 7 名场上人物：1 名身穿灰色客场队服、头戴黑色头盔并举起木棒的右打者，1 名蹲在本垒板后的海军蓝护具捕手，1 名蹲在捕手后方的黑色队服本垒裁判，1 名身穿海军蓝球衣、白色球裤正在投球的投手，以及 3 名分布在内/外野的远景防守队员。使用 {argument name="team colors" default="灰色客场队服对阵海军蓝主场队服"}。棒球应处于投手与打者之间的飞行轨迹中。画面需包含泥土打者区、白色粉笔线、绿草地、投手丘、外野围墙，以及在明亮球场泛光灯下坐满观众的看台。在右上角放置一个大型电子记分牌，显示局数、比分以及密集的日式球队/球员文字，呈现逼真的发光效果，无需完全清晰可辨。氛围：戏剧性、紧张、暖心的现场比赛氛围，如同决定胜负的局末投球。使用自然的球场灯光、深邃的夜空、照片级的细节、轻微的动态感、清晰的前景以及 16:9 的广角构图。自定义打者为 {argument name="main batter description" default="一名身穿灰色球衣、黑色袖子的强力右打者"}，球场为 {argument name="stadium location" default="一座大型日本棒球场"}，记分牌比分为 {argument name="scoreboard score" default="1 比 5"}，相机风格为 {argument name="camera style" default="具备电影级写实感的专业体育新闻摄影"}。避免出现商标、水印、可辨认的品牌名称、除指定 7 人外的多余球员、卡通风格或空座位。

templates.prompt: Create a vibrant, single-panel anime-style travel meme postcard set in Kyoto. Canvas: 4:3 horizontal composition with a thin black rounded border, similar to the first panel of a four-panel comic. Place a small white rounded square label containing the black number "1" in the upper left corner. Background: A bright spring street scene in Kyoto, featuring traditional wooden townhouses, a cobblestone street stretching into the distance, a large multi-story pagoda on the right-center, and the Kyoto Tower visible in the distance. Blue sky, mountains, and pink cherry blossoms falling overhead. Foreground: The right half depicts an elegant, anime-style young woman wearing a pale yellow floral kimono and a dark blue obi, posing like a tour guide welcoming tourists, one hand outstretched towards the city. She possesses a lively {argument name="hair color" default="blue"} She has shoulder-length wavy hair and wears a decorative flower hair accessory with gold tassels. Her face is deliberately obscured by a large, opaque square veil, a vertical gradient from blue-gray to beige, positioned at the center of her face and covering all facial features. Text: Large, handwritten-style Japanese calligraphy is added in the upper left and center left positions, containing the following text:{argument name="headline text" default="Welcome to Kyoto"} The text is in various colors, including "Kyoto e" in dark red and "Okoshiyasu" in dark blue, along with red underlines and two small flower icons. The style is described as refined GPT-image anime illustration with clean lines, saturated spring colors, soft sunlight, and rich details in architectural and kimono patterns, creating a cheerful travel poster atmosphere. Constraints include only one numbered panel label, only one foreground character, only one face-covering square, and no additional titles, watermarks, speech bubbles, or extra characters.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张色彩鲜艳的单格动漫旅游梗图明信片，背景设在京都。画布：4:3 横向构图，带有细黑色圆角边框，类似于四格漫画的第一格。在左上角放置一个白色小圆角方块标签，内含黑色数字“1”。背景：明亮的京都春日街景，有传统的木造町屋、向远处延伸的石板路，中右侧有一座大型多层宝塔，远处可见京都塔，蓝天、群山，头顶上方有粉色的樱花，花瓣在空中飘落。前景：右半部分绘制一位优雅的动漫风格年轻女性，身穿淡黄色花卉和服，系深蓝色腰带，姿势如同欢迎游客的导游，一只手向城市方向伸出。她拥有生动的 {argument name="hair color" default="蓝色"} 肩长波浪卷发，并佩戴带有金色流苏的装饰性花朵发饰。她的脸部被一个巨大的不透明方形遮挡块刻意遮住，遮挡块呈蓝灰色到米色的垂直渐变，位于脸部中心，遮盖了所有面部特征。文字：在左上角和左中位置，添加大型手写风格的日本书法，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="京都へ おこしやす"}，其中“京都へ”为深红色，“おこしやす”为深蓝色，并配有红色弧形下划线和两个小花图标。风格：精致的 GPT-image 动漫插画，干净的线条，饱和的春日色彩，柔和的阳光，建筑和和服图案细节丰富，充满欢快的旅游海报氛围。约束条件：仅包含一个带编号的面板标签，仅包含一个前景角色，仅包含一个遮盖面部的方块，不要添加额外的标题、水印、对话气泡或额外角色。

She keeps {argument name="hair color" default="Long, rose gold-pink wavy hair, with darker roots."} Wearing{argument name="outfit" default="A fitted white ribbed turtleneck long-sleeved mini sweater dress"} Her face is deliberately obscured by a centrally located, soft, rounded, grayish-brown blurred mask, concealing all facial features but retaining her hairstyle. She stands slightly to the right of center, showcasing her full body from head to mid-thigh, her left arm hanging naturally, her right arm outstretched, fingertips lightly touching the tiled wall. The corridor is deep and cool-toned, with glossy, damp gray tiles on the floor, white rectangular wall tiles on the right, and fluorescent lights extending into the distance from the ceiling, above which hangs a blurred station sign. Several commuters are silhouetted in dark shadows in the background. A shallow depth of field is used to keep the subject sharply in focus while the background is softly blurred, creating a cinematic, realistic lighting effect, a cool blue-green subway atmosphere, subtle reflections on the floor, natural body proportions, highly detailed fabric textures, and a casual street-style fashion sense. A small four-pointed star watermark is added to the lower right corner. The image should not contain any legible text, there should be no other figures in the foreground, and exaggerated poses should be avoided.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张照片级逼真的竖构图人像，展现一位年轻女性在早晨站在地下火车站走廊里的场景。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="长款玫瑰金粉色波浪卷发，发根颜色较深"}，身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="一件修身白色罗纹高领长袖迷你毛衣连衣裙"}。她的面部被一个位于中心、柔和灰褐色调的圆角方形模糊遮罩刻意遮挡，遮住了所有五官但保留了发型。她站在画面中心偏右侧，展示从头部到大腿中部的全身效果，左臂自然下垂，右臂伸展，指尖轻触瓷砖墙面。走廊深邃且呈现冷色调，地面铺设着光亮湿润的灰色瓷砖，右侧是白色长方形墙砖，天花板上的日光灯向远处延伸，上方悬挂着模糊的车站指示牌，背景中有几位通勤者呈现为深色剪影。采用浅景深效果，使人物主体清晰对焦，背景柔和虚化，呈现电影级写实光影、冷蓝绿色调的地铁氛围、地面细微的倒影、自然的身体比例、高细节的织物纹理，以及随性的街拍时尚感。在右下角添加一个小型的四角星形水印符号。画面中不应包含可辨认的文字，前景中不应有其他人物，避免夸张的姿势。

templates.title: "Overtime Zone" Pachislot Slot Machine

titleLocalized.zh: “加班地带” Pachislot 老虎机

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a highly detailed, photorealistic Japanese Pachislot screen with an overtime theme. The rendering should capture the texture of a high-energy casino arcade machine, featuring glossy chrome alloy, black glass, purple lightning, red flames, gold accents, and dramatic glowing lettering. Canvas: 4:3 landscape image, front view of the machine, filling the entire screen. Use a dark arcade environment with reflections, neon highlights, and strong contrasts. No characters should appear off-screen; the only human figure appears on the top display. Top Main Display: Showcase a dramatic game bonus screen featuring a weary Japanese office worker in a white shirt and tie, hunched over a laptop late at night, face deliberately blurred, against a backdrop of city office windows and clocks. The central title must be a large, metallic Japanese "残业" (Zangyo), below which is a purple English subtitle "ZONE," surrounded by chains, purple electricity, sparks, and swirling red and black effects. Add a striking white and yellow bold Japanese slogan, "毎ゲーム残業時間を上乗せ," to the center below the top display. In the upper left corner, add a bordered counter with "残り" above and a large "5G" below. On the right, add a red and gold bonus time panel displaying "残業時間+245分." All text should have an embossed, vibrant, glossy, and arcade-style texture. Machine Frame and Side Decorations: Create a luxurious Pachislot machine frame using transparent molded plastic, chrome alloy edges, gold decorative accents, black paint, and bright purple LED lightning. Add two large vertical side title panels: the left panel displays the gold Japanese characters "残業," and the right panel displays the gold characters "4スロ." Add purple lightning effects behind both side panels. Reels: Contain three vertical slot reels in the lower center area, each displaying three visible symbols, for a total of nine visible reel symbols. The left rotary dial, from top to bottom, features: a blue "REPLAY" badge, a gold bell, and a black plaque with the word "Re-employment" printed on it. The middle rotary dial, from top to bottom, features: a red cherry, a red number 7, and a blue "REPLAY" badge. The right rotary dial, from top to bottom, features: a black plaque with the word "Re-employment" printed on it, a blue "REPLAY" badge, and a green gift box with a red ribbon. The rotary dials should have a glossy finish, a slight reflection, and clear illumination. Bottom banner: Add a glowing purple-black banner below the rotary dials, displaying the large Japanese characters "リプレイ・レア役でチャンス!" (Re-employment Challenge!), with the last word "チャンス!" in bright yellow and the preceding text in white. Add subtly visible small chrome buttons and machine hardware along the bottom edge. Visual Style: A fusion of hyper-realistic Pachislot photography and exaggerated game UI art, featuring intense neon purple and red tones, gold beveled lettering, lightning, sparks, chains, reflections, and high dynamic range arcade lighting. It looks like a direct shot of a real, high-end Japanese slot machine. Customizable Details: The main Japanese title is {argument name="main Japanese title" default="Disability"} The English subtitle is{argument name="English subtitle" default="ZONE"} Remaining game attempts:{argument name="remaining game count" default="5G"} The reward time value is{argument name="bonus time value" default="+245 points"} The text on the bottom banner is:{argument name="bottom banner text" default="A replay with a rare role gives you a chance!"} Constraints: Maintain the exact visible number of 3 reels, 9 reel symbols, 2 side title panels, 1 top-left counter, 1 right-side bonus time panel, and 1 bottom banner. Accurately preserve the Japanese text. Do not add any additional logos, watermarks, subtitles, or other characters.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一台超精细、照片级写实的日式 Pachislot 老虎机屏幕，以加班为主题。渲染效果需呈现出高能赌场街机机台的质感，包含光泽铬合金、黑色玻璃、紫色闪电、红色火焰、金色装饰以及极具戏剧性的发光字体。

画布：4:3 横向图像，机台正面视图，填满整个画面。使用带有反射、霓虹高光和强烈对比的暗色街机环境。屏幕外不出现人物；唯一的人像出现在顶部显示屏内。

顶部主显示屏：展示一个戏剧性的游戏奖励画面，画面中一名疲惫的日本上班族身穿白衬衫打着领带，深夜伏在笔记本电脑前，面部刻意模糊，背景为城市办公室窗户和挂钟。中央大标题必须是巨大的金属质感日文“残业”，下方配有紫色英文副标题“ZONE”，周围环绕着锁链、紫色电流、火花以及烟雾缭绕的红黑色特效。在顶部显示屏下方的中央位置，添加醒目的白色和黄色粗体日文标语“毎ゲーム 残業時間を上乗せ”。在左上角，添加一个带边框的计数器，上方写有“残り”，下方为巨大的“5G”。在右侧，添加一个红金配色的奖励时间面板，写有“残業時間 +245分”。所有文字需呈现出浮雕、火热、光泽且具有街机风格的质感。

机台框架及侧面装饰：打造一个奢华的 Pachislot 机台框架，采用透明模塑塑料、铬合金边缘、金色装饰性点缀、黑色漆面以及明亮的紫色 LED 闪电。添加 2 个巨大的垂直侧面标题面板：左侧面板写有金色日文“残业”，右侧面板写有金色字符“4スロ”。在两个侧面板后方加入紫色闪电特效。

转轮部分：在中间偏下区域包含 3 个垂直老虎机转轮，每个转轮显示 3 个可见符号，总计 9 个可见转轮符号。左侧转轮从上到下符号：蓝色“REPLAY”徽章、金色铃铛、印有“残业”的黑色牌匾。中间转轮从上到下符号：红色樱桃、红色数字 7、蓝色“REPLAY”徽章。右侧转轮从上到下符号：印有“残业”的黑色牌匾、蓝色“REPLAY”徽章、带有红色丝带的绿色礼盒。转轮应具有光泽感、轻微反射且光照清晰。

底部横幅：在转轮下方添加一个发光的紫黑色横幅，写有巨大的日文“リプレイ・レア役でチャンス!”，其中最后一个词“チャンス!”为亮黄色，前面的文字为白色。在最底边缘添加隐约可见的小型铬合金按钮和机台硬件。

视觉风格：超写实 Pachislot 摄影与夸张游戏 UI 艺术的结合，强烈的霓虹紫与红色调，金色斜面字体，闪电，火花，锁链，反射以及高动态范围的街机灯光。使其看起来像是一台真实的高端日式老虎机机台的正拍照片。

可自定义细节：主日文标题为 {argument name="main Japanese title" default="残业"}；英文副标题为 {argument name="English subtitle" default="ZONE"}；剩余游戏次数为 {argument name="remaining game count" default="5G"}；奖励时间数值为 {argument name="bonus time value" default="+245分"}；底部横幅文字为 {argument name="bottom banner text" default="リプレイ・レア役でチャンス!"}。

约束条件：保持 3 个转轮、9 个转轮符号、2 个侧面标题面板、1 个左上角计数器、1 个右侧奖励时间面板和 1 个底部横幅的精确可见数量。准确保留日文文本。不要添加额外的标志、水印、字幕或其他字符。

templates.title: Night baseball game scene

titleLocalized.zh: 夜间棒球场比赛场景

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic wide-angle nighttime baseball game scene, shot from a low angle behind home plate, as if filmed with a professional sports camera. The main subject is a right-handed batter wearing {argument name="batting team uniform" default="Black helmets, white and gray away jerseys"} He stands to the left foreground, bat raised, ready to swing. Behind him are two figures crouching: a catcher in dark navy blue protective gear and a umpire in a black uniform, leaning forward. Four other players should be clearly visible on the field: the pitcher on the mound in the act of throwing, wearing {argument name="pitching team uniform" default="Dark navy blue jersey and white shorts"} An infielder near second base, a fielder on the far right, and an outfielder in the distance. The baseball should be clearly visible, flying towards home plate from the pitcher's direction. The scene is set in a stadium packed with spectators at night, complete with bright floodlights, green outfield walls, brown dirt infields, crisp white chalk batting box lines, and lush green grass. In the upper right background, there is a large, glowing Japanese-style project filled with innings, team lines, color statistics, and dense small Japanese text, without requiring the characters to be fully legible. The stands should be filled with thousands of spectators in light-colored clothing to create a realistic texture. The composition utilizes dramatic stadium lighting, deep shadows, the realism of high-ISO sports photography, natural dynamism, sharp foreground details, slightly softened background crowds, and a cinematic 16:9 aspect ratio. No watermarks or added captions.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个照片级真实的广角夜间棒球比赛场景，视角位于本垒后方的低机位，如同使用专业体育相机拍摄。主体是一位右撇子击球手，身穿 {argument name="batting team uniform" default="黑头盔、白灰配色客场队服"}，站在左侧前景，举起球棒准备挥击。在他正后方有 2 位蹲姿人物：身穿深海军蓝护具的捕手和身穿黑色制服、身体前倾的裁判。场上需清晰可见另外 4 名球员：位于投手丘上正处于投球动作中的投手，身穿 {argument name="pitching team uniform" default="深海军蓝球衣和白色球裤"}，一名二垒附近的内野手，一名远右侧的守备员，以及一名远处的 outfield 守备员。棒球应清晰可见，正从投手方向飞向本垒板。场景设定在夜间挤满观众的体育场，配有明亮的泛光灯、绿色外野墙、棕色泥土内野、清晰的白色粉笔击球区线条以及郁郁葱葱的绿色草坪。在右上角背景中，包含一个巨大的发光日式项目，上面填满了局数、队伍行、彩色统计数据和密集的日文小字，无需字符完全可读。看台上应挤满成千上万身着浅色服装的观众，营造出真实的纹理感。使用戏剧性的体育场灯光、深邃的阴影、高 ISO 体育摄影的真实感、自然的运动张力、锐利的前景细节、略显柔和的远景人群、电影级 16:9 构图，无水印，无添加字幕。

templates.title: Comparison thumbnails of Japanese AI tools

titleLocalized.zh: 日本 AI 工具对比缩略图

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a wide-format comparison thumbnail of Japanese social media, showcasing how to use three image-generating AI tools in a clean, tech infographic style, including a presenter holding a sample phone screen. Canvas: 16:9 horizontal banner with a deep navy blue background featuring subtle polka dots and tiny glitter accents. Use a large, rounded white title panel in the top left and center, leaving the right side for the presenter. Bright, high-contrast, sophisticated YouTube/X thumbnail style with crisp vector text, soft shadows, rounded cards, and glossy 3D icons. Main title area: Place prominent Japanese title text within a large, rounded white rectangle.{argument name="headline text" default="How to choose between 3 AI image generation tools?"} (How to differentiate and use the 3 AI tools for image generation?) Enlarge the "3 tools" and set it to dark blue, while setting the rest to bold black. Below it, add a light gray rounded subframe containing two lines of text: "All the strongest!!" and "In the era divided by purpose, organize the strengths of each." Top decorative icons: Near the upper right corner of the title panel, include two floating 3D icons: a white palette with 5 colored pigment dots and a rounded square AI application icon with the purple-blue neon "AI" letters. Comparison section: Place 3 rounded white tool cards horizontally in the lower left/center, each card with a colored border, icon, title, and two lines of labels. Card 1 features a green border and a chat bubble icon, titled "GPT image 2". The tag "强み" (advantage) corresponds to the text "Conversational fine-tuning" (detailed modification through conversation), and the tag "用用" (purpose) corresponds to the text "Text-image illustration/dialogue". Card 2 features a yellow border and a star icon, titled "Nanobanana 2". The tag "强み" corresponds to the text "Japanese language thumbnail creation" (one-click Japanese thumbnail creation), and the tag "用用サムネ・一贯キャラ" (SNS thumbnail/consistent character). Card 3 features a purple border and a simple sailboat line icon, titled "Midjourney." The tag "强み" corresponds to the text "氛囲気重重のビジュアル" (emphasizing visual atmosphere), and the tag "使用" corresponds to the text "アート系・写実的ドラマ" (art-related/realistic drama). The tags use green/yellow/purple capsule badges, and all Japanese text remains bold and legible. Presenter and Phones: On the right, a muscular male presenter, dressed casually in a fitted white T-shirt and black trousers, is shown, cropped from head to thigh, standing against a navy blue background. His face should be deliberately obscured with a solid skin-toned rectangular blur/mask. He holds three smartphones in a fan-shaped outstretched hand. Phone 1, labeled "GPT image 2," displays an investment introductory infographic with charts and Japanese text; Phone 2, labeled "Nanobanana 2," displays a thumbnail of a Japanese morning routine with people and striking yellow text; Phone 3, labeled "Midjourney," displays a cinematic fantasy landscape with mountains and dramatic lighting. The phones should be slightly overlapping and have a glossy black border. Bottom Banner: Add a light yellow banner with rounded corners at the bottom, featuring a lightbulb icon on the left and striking Japanese text.{argument name="bottom message" default="You don't have to stick to just one. Get all three and create a professional workspace."} (Don't just choose one. Collect all three to create a professional work environment.) Set "3つ揃えて" to dark blue with a yellow underline for emphasis. Visual style: Japanese creator thumbnails, modern infographics, clean rounded rectangles, bold typography, high readability, dark blue/white/yellow/green/purple color scheme, subtle glow around the cards—professional yet friendly. Avoid using unnecessary cards, unnecessary phone print, watermarks, or small, hard-to-read text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：制作一张宽幅的日本社交媒体对比缩略图，介绍如何使用三款图像生成 AI 工具，采用简洁的科技信息图风格，并包含一位手持手机示例屏幕的演示者。

画布：16:9 横向横幅，深海军蓝背景，带有微妙的圆点图案和细小的闪光点缀。在左上角和中心使用一个巨大的圆角白色标题面板，右侧留给演示者。明亮、高对比度、精致的 YouTube/X 缩略图风格，配有清晰的矢量文字、柔和的阴影、圆角卡片和光泽感的 3D 图标。

主标题区域：在巨大的白色圆角矩形中，放置醒目的日语标题文本：{argument name="headline text" default="画像生成AI 3ツール\nどう使い分ける？"}（图像生成 AI 3 款工具，如何区分使用？）。将“3ツール”放大并设为深蓝色，其余部分设为粗体黑色。在其下方，添加一个浅灰色圆角子框，包含两行文字：“全部最強！！”（全部最强！！）和“用途で分かれる時代に、それぞれの強みを整理。”（在按用途划分的时代，整理各自的优势。）

顶部装饰图标：在标题面板右上角附近包含 2 个浮动的 3D 图标：1 个带有 5 个彩色颜料点的白色调色板，以及 1 个带有紫色-蓝色霓虹灯“AI”字母的圆角方形 AI 应用图标。

对比部分：在左下/中部水平放置 3 张圆角白色工具卡片，每张卡片带有彩色边框、图标、标题和两行标签行。卡片 1 带有绿色边框和聊天气泡图标，标题为“GPT image 2”，标签“強み”（优势）对应文本“会話で細かく修正”（通过对话精细修改），标签“用途”对应文本“文字入り画像・図解”（带文字图像/图解）。卡片 2 带有黄色边框和星星图标，标题为“Nanobanana 2”，标签“強み”对应文本“日本語サムネ一発仕上げ”（日语缩略图一键完成），标签“用途”对应文本“SNS用サムネ・一貫キャラ”（SNS 缩略图/一致性角色）。卡片 3 带有紫色边框和简单的帆船线条图标，标题为“Midjourney”，标签“強み”对应文本“雰囲気重視のビジュアル”（注重氛围的视觉效果），标签“用途”对应文本“アート系・写実的ドラマ”（艺术系/写实戏剧）。标签使用绿色/黄色/紫色胶囊徽章，并保持所有日语文本粗体且易读。

演示者和手机：在右侧，展示一位穿着修身白色 T 恤和黑色长裤、休闲装扮的肌肉型男性演示者，从头部到大腿进行裁剪，站在海军蓝背景前。他的脸部应刻意用一个纯肤色的矩形模糊/遮挡块遮住。他手中扇形展开拿着 3 部智能手机。手机 1 标注为“GPT image 2”，显示一张带有图表和日语文本的投资入门信息图；手机 2 标注为“Nanobanana 2”，显示一张带有人物和醒目黄色文本的日语晨间例行缩略图；手机 3 标注为“Midjourney”，显示一张带有山脉和戏剧性光影的电影感奇幻风景图。手机应略微重叠，并带有光泽感的黑色边框。

底部横幅：在底部添加一个长圆角浅黄色横幅，左侧带有灯泡图标，并配有醒目的日语文本：{argument name="bottom message" default="1つに絞らんでええ。3つ揃えて、プロの作業環境に。"}（不必只选一个。集齐 3 个，打造专业工作环境。）。将“3つ揃えて”设为深蓝色并带有黄色下划线以示强调。

视觉风格：日本创作者缩略图、现代信息图、简洁的圆角矩形、粗体排版、高可读性、深蓝/白/黄/绿/紫配色、卡片周围有微妙的发光效果，专业且友好。避免使用多余的卡片、多余的手机、水印或难以阅读的小字。

templates.title: ASCII cat emojis converted into comic illustrations

titleLocalized.zh: ASCII 猫咪表情包转漫画插画

templates.prompt: Based on the concept of REFERENCE_0 for layout and reference, this project transforms an ASCII art scene into a refined full-color Japanese manga/cartoon illustration. Maintaining the same basic composition: a cat sits on a cardboard box of Ehime mandarin oranges, tapping a ramen bowl with chopsticks, accompanied by onomatopoeia on the left and speech bubbles on the right. Style: The monochrome text art is transformed into a vibrant hand-drawn anime illustration, using clean ink lines, warm colors, expressive motion lines, manga-style impact, and a white background. The cat appears both cute and angry/frustrated, with flushed cheeks, an open mouth, and an orange on its head. Adding content and details: A large ramen bowl is added in front of the cat, with two chopsticks held like drumsticks, creating yellow impact sparks where the chopsticks tap the bowl, and a realistic cardboard box texture is added. Five complete oranges are precisely added around the scene: one on the cat's head, one near the center of the front of the box, one in the lower left corner, one in the center of the bottom, and one in the lower right corner. Two more orange patterns are printed on the front of the box. Add content for the legal complaint theme: Add piles of documents and complaint papers around the box, including a large stack of documents stamped in red and labeled "Complaint" in the lower left corner, loose pages stamped with "Submitted" in the foreground, and a thick, dark blue law book in the lower right corner labeled "Civil Procedure Law" with a note that reads "Is there any feeling I'm waiting for?". Add scattered papers, labels, envelopes, and crumpled papers to make the scene appear cluttered. Text to retain or reproduce: Keep the box label as {argument name="box label" default="Aihime Mandarin Oranges"} Retain the two star-shaped onomatopoeic words "チン" on the left. Retain the chanting text in the upper right corner.{argument name="chant text" default="マチクタビレタ〜\nマチクタビレタ〜"} Keep the text in the right-hand chat bubble.{argument name="speech bubble text" default="Grok group lawsuit\nNot yet~"} Use bold, clear Japanese fonts instead of ASCII characters. Constraints: Do not retain the ASCII artistic look; completely reinterpret it as a colorful manga illustration while preserving the original jokes, layout, and main Japanese text.

promptLocalized.zh:
以 REFERENCE_0 为布局和梗的概念基础，将 ASCII 艺术场景转换为精致的全彩日本漫画/卡通插画。保持相同的基本构图：一只猫坐在爱媛蜜柑纸箱上，用筷子敲击拉面碗，左侧带有拟声词，右侧带有对话气泡。

风格：将单色文本艺术转换为生动的手绘动漫插画，使用干净的墨线、暖色调、富有表现力的动态线、漫画冲击效果和白色背景。让猫看起来既可爱又愤怒/沮丧，脸颊泛红，张嘴大喊，头上顶着一个橘子。

添加内容与细节：在猫面前添加一个大拉面碗，两根筷子像鼓槌一样握着，筷子敲击碗的地方有黄色冲击火花，并添加逼真的纸箱纹理。在场景周围精确添加 5 个散落的完整橘子：1 个在猫头上，1 个在箱子前方中心附近，1 个在左下角，1 个在底部中心，1 个在右下角。另外在纸箱正面印上 2 个橘子图案。

法律投诉主题添加内容：在箱子周围添加成堆的文件和投诉文书，包括左下角贴有红色印章并标有「诉状」的大堆文件，前景中盖有「提出济」印章的散页，以及右下角一本厚厚的深蓝色法律书籍，上面标有「民事诉讼法」，并贴有一张写着「いつまで待たせる気なの？」的便签。加入散落的纸张、标签、信封和揉皱的纸团，使场景显得杂乱无章。

需要保留或重现的文字：保持箱子标签为 {argument name="box label" default="爱媛みかん"}。保留左侧两个星形拟声词「チン」。保留右上角的吟唱文字为 {argument name="chant text" default="マチクタビレタ〜\nマチクタビレタ〜"}。保留右侧对话气泡文字为 {argument name="speech bubble text" default="Grok集団诉讼\nマダ〜"}。使用加粗、清晰的日语字体，而非 ASCII 字符。

约束条件：不要保留 ASCII 艺术外观；将其完全重新诠释为色彩丰富的漫画插画，同时保留原始笑话、布局和主要的日语文本。

templates.title: Anime-style male escort portrait (face obscured)

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫风格男公关肖像（面部遮挡）

templates.prompt: Create a refined anime-style half-length portrait depicting an extremely handsome adult man standing in a high-end upscale bar at night, with a spectacular city skyline visible through the huge floor-to-ceiling windows behind him. He has {argument name="hair color" default="Platinum"} His layered, tousled medium-length hair, with long side bangs and bright, sharp highlights, complements his elegant neck and broad shoulders, exuding a confident and stylish aura. His face is mostly obscured by a centrally located square privacy panel, featuring a vertical gradient from warm beige to dark gray, covering his eyes, nose, and mouth, but leaving his hair, ears, jawline, neck, and upper body exposed. He wears a beige custom-made suit jacket over an unbuttoned black shirt, revealing three clearly visible gold buttons; the collar is low enough to expose his muscular chest and collarbone. The background should showcase two main environmental areas: on the left, a nighttime cityscape of skyscrapers with numerous blue-white window lights and red antenna dots; on the right, a warm, luxurious bar area with dark wood, gold lighting, bottles, and illuminated rectangular wall lamps. The design employs a cinematic interplay of warm indoor lighting and cool-toned city lights, with clean, crisp lines, soft celluloid shadows, and glossy highlights to create a slightly romantic host club atmosphere. The composition is a vertical portrait, cropped to the middle of the torso, with no text, watermark, or additional characters.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张精致的动漫风格半身肖像，描绘一位极其英俊的成年男子，他站在夜晚的高档高层酒吧中，身后巨大的落地窗外可见壮观的城市天际线。他留着 {argument name="hair color" default="铂金色"} 的层次感凌乱中长发，带有长长的侧刘海和明亮的锐利高光，拥有优雅的颈部和宽阔的肩膀，展现出自信且时尚的气质。他的面部大部分被一个居中的方形隐私遮挡块遮住，遮挡块呈现从暖米色到深灰色的垂直渐变，覆盖了眼睛、鼻子和嘴巴，但保留了头发、耳朵、下颌边缘、颈部和上半身。他身穿米白色定制西装外套，内搭一件解开扣子的黑色衬衫，露出 3 颗清晰可见的金色纽扣，领口开得足够低，露出结实的胸肌和锁骨。背景应展示 2 个主要环境区域：左侧是带有许多蓝白色窗户灯光和红色天线点的夜间摩天大楼城市景观；右侧是温暖的豪华酒吧货架区，配有深色木材、金色灯光、酒瓶和发光的矩形壁灯。采用电影感的室内暖光与冷色调城市灯光交织，线条清晰利落，柔和的赛璐珞阴影，光泽感高光，营造出略带浪漫的男公关俱乐部氛围，构图为垂直肖像，裁剪至躯干中部，无文字，无水印，无额外角色。

templates.title: Retro Polaroid Corkboard Collage

titleLocalized.zh: 怀旧宝丽来软木板拼贴画

templates.prompt: Create a vintage-style corkboard collage featuring 10 Polaroid-style photographs pinned to a surface with thumbtacks, the main subject being {argument name="character name" default="Kurage-chan"} This is a dreamy, faceless anime-style girl or ball-jointed doll, keep it.{argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} A bob haircut, a soft white beret, fair skin, and an ethereal jellyfish-themed white outfit with puffy, semi-transparent sleeves, lace, pearls, ribbons, and trailing tentacle-like fabric. The overall atmosphere should be cinematic, soft, sensual, and slightly melancholic, like faded film photography. Arrange 10 Polaroid photos on a warm brown corkboard, each with a thick white Polaroid border and secured with small, transparent round-headed tacks; slight overlap and tilting are permissible. The 10 photos contain the following: 1) Top left: A close-up portrait of a girl indoors in white, with her face softly obscured and the moody window lighting; 2) Top center: A full-body shot taken on a seaside promenade, with hazy boats in the distance; 3) Top right: A silhouette from behind on a rooftop or balcony, overlooking the blurred city skyline at sunset; 4) Middle left: A still life by a window, with vases, teacups, and berries on a plate; 5) Middle: A private bedroom photo of a girl lying on white sheets, bathed in soft morning light; 6) Middle right: A girl sitting at a desk or cafe table reading an open book, with an iced drink beside her; 7) Middle right edge: A girl standing in a sun-drenched garden, her silhouette against a field of white flowers; 8) Bottom left: A girl reaching upwards in a dimly lit convenience store or shop aisle; 9) Bottom center: A close-up portrait at night, with blurred city lights and dappled light in the background; 10) In the bottom right corner, a girl's silhouette against the distance on a grey beach, with birds and waves in the background.{argument name="photo style" default="Simulated Polaroid film"} Aesthetics: Soft focus, shallow depth of field, slight blur, soft grays and creams, warm shadows, subtle graininess, imperfect exposure, and no visible text. Ensure the character remains consistent across all photos, with the face left blank or softly occluded, and make the collage look like a physical photograph pinned to a real corkboard.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张怀旧风格的软木板拼贴画，包含 10 张用图钉固定的宝丽来风格照片，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="Kurage-chan"}，这是一个梦幻般的无面动漫风格女孩或球体关节人偶，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色"} 波波头，戴着柔软的白色贝雷帽，皮肤白皙，身着空灵的水母主题白色服装，配有蓬松的半透明袖子、蕾丝、珍珠、丝带和拖曳的触手状织物。整体氛围应具有电影感、柔和、感性且略带忧郁，如同褪色的胶片摄影。将 10 张宝丽来照片排列在温暖的棕色软木板上，每张照片都有厚实的白色拍立得边框，并用透明的小圆头图钉固定；允许轻微的重叠和倾斜角度。这 10 张照片的具体内容为：1) 左上角，女孩的室内白色系特写肖像，面部柔和遮挡，带有情绪感的窗光；2) 上方中央，在海滨长廊拍摄的全身照，远处有朦胧的船只；3) 右上角，在屋顶或阳台上的背影，俯瞰日落时分模糊的城市天际线；4) 中左侧，窗边的静物，摆放着花瓶、茶杯和盘子里的浆果；5) 中间，女孩躺在白色床单上的私密卧室照，沐浴在柔和的晨光中；6) 中右侧，女孩坐在书桌或咖啡馆桌旁阅读一本打开的书，旁边放着冰饮；7) 中右侧边缘，女孩站在洒满阳光的花园中，身处白花丛中的背影；8) 左下角，女孩在昏暗的便利店或商店过道中向上伸手；9) 下方中央，夜间特写肖像，背景是模糊的城市灯光和光斑；10) 右下角，女孩在灰色海滩上的远景背影，有飞鸟和海浪。使用 {argument name="photo style" default="模拟宝丽来胶片"} 美学：柔焦、浅景深、轻微模糊、柔和的灰色和奶油色、温暖的阴影、细腻的颗粒感、不完美的曝光，且无可见文字。确保角色在所有照片中保持一致，面部保持空白或柔和遮挡，并使拼贴画看起来像是钉在真实软木板上的实体照片。

templates.title: Taisho Romantic Cafe Trio

titleLocalized.zh: 大正浪漫咖啡馆三人组

templates.prompt: Create a vertical anime illustration depicting three elegant young women in a Taisho-style romantic café. The interior features a refined eclectic Japanese-Western design, filled with warm lantern lighting, dark carved wood trim, stained glass windows, lace curtains, antique furniture, decorative paintings, and vases. The three women are dressed in gorgeous Japanese-style Lolita maid outfits, incorporating kimono sleeves, floral haori, white ruffled aprons, black lace trim, bows, and ruffled maid headdresses. Character 1 sits on the left, with very long black hair, wearing a deep red floral kimono-style outfit; Character 2 stands in the center at the back, with short hair {argument name="hair color" default="lavender"} The first character, with a bob haircut, wears a purple floral kimono jacket, a white ruffled blouse, and black gloves, with a gentle smile. The second character, seated in the lower right, has very long black hair and wears a blue-green floral kimono-style outfit. They are arranged compactly, like formal café portraits, with elegant postures and exquisite hand details. A high-detail modern anime style is employed, complemented by soft painterly shadows, intricate lines, soft jewel tones, cream lace, and gold accents, creating a nostalgic early 20th-century Japanese romantic atmosphere. A gorgeous decorative border is added around the image, adorned with large cream and red peonies, flowing gold vines, blue and burgundy patterned panels, and Art Nouveau curves. Facial features are ensured to be beautiful and expressive, without blurring or censorship, text, watermarks, or superfluous characters.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖版动漫插画，描绘 3 位优雅的年轻女性，场景设定在大正浪漫风格的咖啡馆内。室内采用精致的和洋折衷设计，充满温暖的灯笼光影、深色雕花木饰、彩色玻璃窗、蕾丝窗帘、古董家具、装饰画和花瓶。这三位女性身着华丽的和风洛丽塔女仆装，融合了和服袖、花卉图案羽织、白色荷叶边围裙、黑色蕾丝饰边、蝴蝶结和褶边女仆头饰。角色 1 坐在左侧，留着超长黑发，身穿深红色花卉和服风格服装；角色 2 站在后方中央，留着短款 {argument name="hair color" default="薰衣草色"} 波波头，身穿紫色花卉和服外套、白色荷叶边衬衫，佩戴黑色手套，面带温柔微笑；角色 3 坐在右下方，留着超长黑发，身穿蓝绿色花卉和服风格服装。将她们紧凑地构图，如同正式的咖啡馆肖像，姿态优雅，手部细节精致。采用高细节的现代动漫风格，辅以柔和的绘画式阴影、复杂的线条、柔和的宝石色调、奶油色蕾丝、金色点缀，营造出怀旧的 20 世纪初日本浪漫氛围。在图像周围添加华丽的装饰边框，配以大型奶油色和红色牡丹、流动的金色藤蔓、青色与酒红色的图案面板以及新艺术风格的曲线。确保面部美丽且富有表现力，无模糊或审查，无文字，无水印，无多余角色。

templates.title: Japanese AI Report Polishing Application Interface Design Draft

titleLocalized.zh: 日语 AI 报告润色应用界面设计稿

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a clean and realistic mobile AI report checking application design, presented as a rounded white modal on a light gray background, suitable for requirements testing on social media. The application name should be:{argument name="app title" default="AI for Report Correction"} The interface should have a finished UI quality. Canvas: Wide horizontal image, approximately 16:7 aspect ratio. Place a large, rounded rectangular application window with soft shadows, a thin light gray border, and a bright white background in the center. Add subtle vertical dividing lines and a very light gradient to give it a sophisticated SaaS/mobile webpage interface feel. Layout: The application window should contain two main content panels. The left panel is the report input area, and the right panel is the AI ​​polishing results area. Place a dark circular close button with a white "×" in the upper right corner of the modal. Add two floating, dark capsule-shaped buttons in the lower left corner of the modal, labeled "+ALT" and "Edit" respectively. A dark, rounded strip cropped from the screen is visible at the lower right edge. Left panel details: The title "Report Enhancement AI" and a smaller subtitle "AI ga anata no Report wo Improvement" are displayed centered at the top. Below, add the section label "レポートを入力してください" (Please put your effort into this section). Display a large text input box containing a sample Japanese report about young people using social networking services; a small character counter "128/3000" is included in the lower right corner of the text box. Below the text box, place a prominent purple rounded-corner button labeled "添削する" (Add and trim). Below the button, add a small explanatory text "AIによる添削开始" (AI ni yoru tianxiao shi) (Add and trim starting). Right panel details: Add the title "AIによる添削结果" (AI ni yoru tianxiao ji) (Add and trim results). Display a rating line labeled "総合评価" (Comprehensive Evaluation), with a small green rounded-corner badge labeled "B+" on the right. Then create an "Improvement" section with 3 checklist items, each preceded by a green round check icon: 1) "Specific examples of how to improve the performance of the project", 2) "えるとより好くなります", 3) "The conclusion is clear and the reason is good". Below this, add an "Improvement Example" section containing a polished Japanese text that begins, "近年、SNSの使用者数は増加しており、2023年の総务省の调查によると、10代の约90%がSNSを利用している。" The following content is in easily readable small-format Japanese text. Visual Style: Minimalist Japanese product UI, Apple-style rounded corners, clear sans-serif Japanese font, black and dark gray text, green hue, a slightly gradient purple main CTA button, ample white space, realistic soft shadows, and high-resolution screenshot quality. Constraints: UI text must strictly adhere to the specified Japanese language; no additional panels may be added besides the two main panels; checklist items must be exactly three; and no figures, illustrations, watermarks, browser borders, or phone cases may appear on the screen.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：制作一个简洁、逼真的移动端 AI 报告检查应用设计稿，以浅灰色背景上的圆角白色模态框形式呈现，适用于在社交媒体上进行需求测试。应用名称应为 {argument name="app title" default="レポート添削AI"}，界面需呈现出成品级 UI 的质感。

画布：宽幅横向图片，比例约为 16:7。在中心放置一个带有柔和阴影、细浅灰色边框和亮白色背景的大型圆角矩形应用窗口。添加细微的垂直分隔线和极浅的渐变，使其呈现出精致的 SaaS/移动端网页界面感。

布局：应用窗口内需包含 2 个主要内容面板。左侧面板为报告输入区，右侧面板为 AI 润色结果区。在模态框右上角放置一个带有白色“×”的深色圆形关闭按钮。在模态框左下角添加两个悬浮的深色胶囊状按钮，分别标注为“＋ ALT”和“編集”。右下角边缘处可见一个被画面裁剪的深色圆角条状物。

左侧面板细节：顶部居中显示标题“レポート添削AI”及较小的副标题“AIがあなたのレポートを改善します”。下方添加分区标签“レポートを入力してください”。展示一个大型文本输入框，内含一段关于年轻人使用 SNS 的日语报告示例；在文本框右下角包含一个小型字符计数器“128/3000”。在文本框下方放置一个醒目的紫色圆角按钮，标注为“添削する”。按钮下方添加一行微型说明文字“AIによる添削開始”。

右侧面板细节：添加标题“AIによる添削結果”。显示一行评分，标签为“総合評価”，右侧配有一个标注为“B+”的绿色小圆角徽章。随后创建一个“改善ポイント”部分，包含 3 个检查清单项，每项前均带有绿色圆形勾选图标：1) “具体例があると説得力が増します”，2) “データや根拠を加えるとより良くなります”，3) “結論を明確にすると締まりが良くなります”。在此下方添加“改善例”部分，包含一段日语润色后的文本，开头为“近年、SNSの利用者数は増加しており、2023年の総務省の調査によると、10代の約90%がSNSを利用している。”，后续内容为易读的小号日语正文。

视觉风格：极简主义日语产品 UI，Apple 风格圆角，清晰的无衬线日语字体，黑色及深灰色文字，绿色成功色调，带有轻微渐变的紫色主 CTA 按钮，充足的留白，逼真的柔和阴影，高分辨率截图质感。

约束条件：UI 文字必须严格按照指定使用日语，除 2 个主面板外不得添加额外面板，检查清单项必须正好 3 个，画面中不得出现人物、插画、水印、浏览器边框或手机外壳。

templates.title: Space Asset Library UI

titleLocalized.zh: 空间资产库 UI

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a clean and simple website UI asset management panel, titled as follows.{argument name="headline text" default="Your Assets"} This displays a grid of uploaded space images. Canvas: A square web template with a very light background featuring a subtle dotted grid pattern and a faintly curved decorative line along the right edge. It adopts a modern SaaS style with soft shadows, rounded corners, and soft blue-gray text. Layout: A small, round, pink square icon is placed in the upper left corner, containing a simple outline of an image/photo symbol, followed by a title. Below this, a large white, rounded rectangle card with a thin, light gray border is created. Inside the card, six image thumbnails are placed in a 2-column, 3-row grid, each with rounded corners. Each thumbnail has a floating, round delete button in the upper right corner; there are six delete buttons in total, all white with a gray X icon. At the bottom of the card, a row of upload actions is placed in the center, containing a plus sign and text.{argument name="upload text" default="Upload more"} The thumbnails contain six images: 1) Top left: A towering rocket stands on a launch pad at sunset, against an orange cloud background; 2) Top right: The same rocket launch pad scene, with bright explosion/flame and glowing circular shockwave effects; 3) Middle left: A rocket ascends vertically against a sunset sky, accompanied by a huge, bright column of smoke; 4) Middle right: A rocket pierces through thick orange clouds, rising into the deep blue upper atmosphere; 5) Bottom left: A view of Earth from low Earth orbit, with a small spacecraft above the horizon arc; 6) Bottom right: A starlit deep-space panorama, showing the Milky Way, with Earth visible in the upper left. Visual style: Exquisite web component screenshots, realistic cinematic space thumbnails, clean UI edges, ample spacing, 16px rounded corner thumbnails, subtle shadows, and soft neutral tones. Small icon backgrounds use {argument name="accent color" default="soft pink"} Title and uploaded text use{argument name="text color" default="slate blue-gray"} Constraints: All text must be in English and contain no extra tags, watermarks, browser borders, or cursors. Strictly adhere to the following quantities: 1 title, 1 icon, 1 bordered card, 6 thumbnails, 6 circular X-shaped delete buttons, and 1 bottom upload button.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个简洁的网站 UI 资产管理面板，标题为 {argument name="headline text" default="Your Assets"}，展示一个已上传航天图像的网格。

画布：正方形的网页模型，背景为极浅的颜色，带有微妙的点状网格图案，右侧边缘有淡淡的弧形装饰线。采用现代 SaaS 风格，配以柔和的阴影、圆角和柔和的蓝灰色文本。

布局：在左上角放置一个小的圆形粉色方形图标，内含简单的轮廓图像/照片符号，后跟标题。在其下方，创建一个大的白色圆角矩形卡片，带有细浅灰色边框。在卡片内部，放置 6 个图像缩略图，排列为 2 列 3 行的网格，每个缩略图均带有圆角。每个缩略图的右上角都有一个悬浮的圆形删除按钮；共有 6 个删除按钮，均为白色，带有灰色 X 图标。在卡片底部，居中放置一行上传操作，包含一个加号和文本 {argument name="upload text" default="Upload more"}。

缩略图内容，共 6 个：1) 左上：一枚高耸的火箭矗立在日落时的发射台上，背景是橙色的云；2) 右上：同样的火箭发射台场景，带有明亮的爆炸/火焰和发光的圆形冲击波效果；3) 中左：一枚火箭在日落天空的背景下垂直升空，带有巨大的明亮烟柱；4) 中右：一枚火箭穿过厚厚的橙色云层，上升到深蓝色的高层大气中；5) 下左：从低轨道俯瞰地球，地平线弧线上方有一艘小型航天器；6) 下右：星光熠熠的深空全景，可见银河带，左上方可见地球。

视觉风格：精致的网页组件截图，逼真的电影级空间缩略图，清晰的 UI 边缘，宽敞的间距，16px 圆角缩略图，微妙的阴影，柔和的中性色调。小图标背景使用 {argument name="accent color" default="soft pink"}，标题和上传文本使用 {argument name="text color" default="slate blue-gray"}。

约束：保持所有文本为英文，不包含额外标签、水印、浏览器边框或光标。严格保持数量：1 个标题，1 个图标，1 个带边框卡片，6 个缩略图，6 个圆形 X 删除按钮，以及 1 个底部上传操作。

templates.title: FC Barcelona Lewandowski poster

titleLocalized.zh: FC Barcelona Lewandowski 海报

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a high-quality official FC Barcelona football poster.{argument name="player name" default="Robert Lewandowski"} The poster, featuring a star player, employs a rugged, editorial sports design style. Canvas: Vertical poster, 3:4 aspect ratio, distressed off-white paper texture with subtle circular lines, slight junk-style speckles, and refined premium editorial typography. Layout: The FC Barcelona crest is placed at the top center. "MAY 17, 26" is written in the upper left corner, preceded by a short, thin gold line. "FC BARCELONA" is written in the upper right corner with a white "Pollo.ai" watermark. The main background comprises three tall, vertical black-and-white portrait panels: the left panel shows the player's profile from above the chest, slightly to the right; the central panel displays a close-up portrait; and the right panel shows the player holding or pulling at their jersey. All three background faces are covered with a soft, rectangular gray blur mask. In front of the panels is a full-body color silhouette of a player standing confidently, their face also covered with a vertical, soft gray blur mask. Main details: The player in the foreground wears a modern FC Barcelona home kit with navy blue and dark red vertical stripes, a yellow Nike swoosh, the Barcelona crest, the Spotify sponsor logo, blue shorts with the number 9, blue socks, and light-colored football boots. He stands upright, one hand on his hip, the other holding a Champions League-style football at his side. A thin red outline light is used around the player silhouette to distinguish him from the monochrome background. Text: At the bottom center, a large, bold, compressed capital font is used. First line: "ROBERT", dark navy blue. Second line: "LEWANDOWSKI", dark red. A gold signature graphic with a small number "9" is added in the lower left corner. At the very bottom, add a short, all-caps biographical text: “ROBERT LEWANDOWSKI IS A POLISH PROFESSIONAL FOOTBALLER WHO PLAYS AS A STRIKER FOR LA LIGA CLUB FC BARCELONA AND CAPTAINS THE POLAND NATIONAL TEAM.” Add two small vertical emphasis bars near the bottom corner, using a Barcelona color scheme. Visual Style: High-contrast sports poster, combining realistic photography with graphic design, dramatic graininess, warm gold dust highlights around the black and white panels, sharp typography, and a premium matchday collector's poster aesthetic. Constraints: Include a total of 4 player images: 3 portraits against monochrome backgrounds and 1 full-body color foreground figure. Keep visible facial areas anonymized using gray blurred rectangles. Do not add additional players, trophies, stadium spectators, or irrelevant logos.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张优质的 FC Barcelona 足球官宣海报，以 {argument name="player name" default="Robert Lewandowski"} 为核心明星，采用粗犷的编辑体育设计风格。

画布：竖版海报，3:4 纵横比，做旧的米白色纸张纹理，带有微妙的圆形线条图案、轻微的垃圾风格斑点，以及精致的优质编辑排版。

布局：顶部中央放置 FC Barcelona 队徽。左上角书写“MAY 17, 26”，前方加一条短细的金线。右上角书写“FC BARCELONA”并添加白色的“Pollo.ai”水印。主背景包含 3 个高大的垂直黑白肖像面板：左侧面板展示球员胸部以上、略微向右的侧脸；中央面板展示正面特写肖像；右侧面板展示球员手持或拉扯胸前球衣的动作。所有 3 个背景人脸均被柔和的矩形灰色模糊遮罩覆盖。在面板前方，放置 1 个球员自信站立的全身彩色剪影，其面部同样被垂直的柔和灰色模糊遮罩覆盖。

主体细节：前景中的球员身穿现代 FC Barcelona 主场球衣，采用海军蓝和深红色垂直条纹，配有黄色 Nike 对勾标志、Barcelona 队徽、Spotify 赞助商标志、带有数字 9 的蓝色短裤、蓝色长袜和浅色足球鞋。他直立站立，一只手叉腰，另一只手在身侧拿着一个欧冠风格的足球。在球员剪影周围使用细红色的轮廓光，将其与单色背景区分开来。

文字内容：在底部中央，使用巨大的粗体压缩大写字体。第一行：“ROBERT”，深海军蓝色。第二行：“LEWANDOWSKI”，深红色。在左下角添加一个带有小数字“9”的金色签名图形。在最底部，添加简短的大写传记文字：“ROBERT LEWANDOWSKI IS A POLISH PROFESSIONAL FOOTBALLER WHO PLAYS AS A STRIKER FOR LA LIGA CLUB FC BARCELONA AND CAPTAINS THE POLAND NATIONAL TEAM.” 在底部角落附近添加两个微小的垂直强调条，采用 Barcelona 的配色。

视觉风格：高对比度体育海报，写实摄影与平面设计相结合，富有戏剧性的颗粒感，黑白面板周围有温暖的金色粉尘高光，锐利的排版，优质的比赛日收藏海报美学。

约束条件：总共包含 4 个球员形象：3 个单色背景肖像和 1 个全身彩色前景人物。保持可见的面部区域用灰色模糊矩形进行匿名化处理。不要添加额外的球员、奖杯、体育场观众或无关的标志。

templates.title: Manchester City Haaland Poster

Add small-spaced capital letters “MAY 17, 26” in the upper left corner and “MAN CITY” in the upper right corner. Include a small white “Pollo ai” watermark in the upper right corner. The main image area comprises three side-by-side, slender vertical rectangular panels separated by a narrow white line: the left panel shows a grayscale side-by-side close-up of the player wearing a Manchester City jersey; the middle panel shows a grayscale portrait close-up behind the main figure; the right panel shows a grayscale close-up of the player kissing or holding the jersey crest. The panels have a deep navy blue, high-contrast, grainy photo-processed effect. Main details: In front of the three panels, place a full-body silhouette of the player, standing confidently, centered, and overlaying the title. Visual Style: Modern football transfer announcement poster, realistic photographic collage, Manchester City's navy and sky blue color scheme, aged print texture, elegant spacing, high-end magazine cover quality. Restrictions: Use 3 background portrait panels, 1 foreground full-body player, 1 club crest, 1 signature mark, and 1 football. Keep the poster clean and centered, and do not include any additional players, logos, or irrelevant text other than the team crest and watermark.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为曼城前锋 {argument name="player name" default="Erling Haaland"} 创作一张优质足球海报，呈现戏剧性的编辑体育设计风格。

画布：竖版肖像海报，比例约为 4:5，采用带有细微颗粒感、磨损痕迹和淡淡圆形球场地图线条的米白色旧纸背景，构图居中。

布局：在顶部正中央放置曼城队徽。在左上角添加小号间距的大写文字“MAY 17, 26”，右上角添加“MAN CITY”。在右上角包含一个白色的小型“Pollo ai”水印。主体图像区域包含 3 个并排的细长竖向矩形面板，中间由窄白色线条分隔：左侧面板展示球员身穿曼城球衣的灰度侧面特写；中间面板展示主人物身后的灰度肖像特写；右侧面板展示球员亲吻或手持球衣队徽的灰度特写。面板采用深海军蓝、高对比度、颗粒感的照片处理效果。

主体细节：在 3 个面板前方，放置一个球员全身剪影，自信站立，居中并覆盖在标题上方。他身穿 {argument name="team kit" default="曼城天蓝色主场球衣"}，带有阿提哈德航空赞助商标志、白色短裤、天蓝色球袜、蓝色足球鞋，短裤上有数字 9。他左臂夹着一个英超联赛足球，右手叉腰。使用逼真的体育摄影灯光、清晰的剪影边缘和微妙的阴影。

排版与文字：在下三分之一处，创建巨大的粗体大写球员姓名标题，分为两行堆叠：“ERLING”为深海军蓝，“HAALAND”为亮天蓝色，部分位于球员腿部后方。在左下角添加一个浅蓝色的签名式笔迹，并附带一个小数字 9。在标题下方，添加一行居中的小号大写传记文字：“ERLING BRAUT HAALAND IS A NORWEGIAN PROFESSIONAL FOOTBALLER WHO PLAYS AS A STRIKER FOR PREMIER LEAGUE CLUB MANCHESTER CITY AND CAPTAINS THE NORWAY NATIONAL TEAM”。在底部正中央，放置一条带有数字“9”的装饰线。

视觉风格：现代足球转会官宣海报，逼真的摄影拼贴画，海军蓝与天蓝色的曼城配色，做旧印刷质感，优雅的间距，高端杂志封面品质。

限制：使用 3 个背景肖像面板，1 个前景全身球员，1 个俱乐部徽章，1 个签名标记，以及 1 个足球。保持海报简洁居中，除队徽和水印外，不得包含额外球员、额外标志或无关文字。

templates.prompt: Create a serene, anime-style vertical portrait, with the main character being {argument name="character name" default="Ami"} The scene is shown from the upper two-thirds of the chest down. The character stands outdoors against a backdrop of a clear blue summer sky dotted with large, soft white cumulus clouds. The character has messy, short hair.{argument name="hair color" default="Light gold"} The character sports a bob haircut, with strands flowing in the wind, rich in detail, featuring highlights and a soft, contoured glow reminiscent of sunlight. The face is deliberately concealed by a centrally located opaque beige square mask, obscuring the entire facial area while leaving the hair, ears, neck, and outline visible. The character wears an oversized {argument name="shirt color" default="Light sky blue"} The T-shirt features loose pleats and a white butterfly wing print on the upper back, resembling delicate angel or butterfly wings. It employs a clean, high-quality Japanese anime illustration style with clear lines, soft cel-shaded shadows, bright and translucent lighting, and soft colors. The realistic fabric folds create a tranquil and dreamlike atmosphere. The composition is vertical, a close-up, with the character slightly tilted to the left of the frame and facing the right. There is no text, no watermark, and no extraneous characters.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张宁静的动漫风格竖版肖像，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="Ami"}，采用胸部以上的三分之二背影视角。角色站在户外，背景是湛蓝的夏日天空，点缀着巨大的柔和白色积云。角色留着凌乱的短款 {argument name="hair color" default="浅金色"} 波波头，发丝随风飘动，细节丰富，带有高光，并呈现出太阳照射下的柔和轮廓光。角色的面部被一个位于中心位置的不透明米色方形遮挡块刻意隐藏，遮盖了整个面部区域，但保留了头发、耳朵、颈部和轮廓可见。角色身穿一件超大号的 {argument name="shirt color" default="浅天蓝色"} T 恤，衣褶宽松，上背部印有白色蝴蝶翅膀图案，宛如精致的天使或蝴蝶翅膀。采用干净、高质量的日本动漫插画风格，线条清晰，赛璐珞风格柔和阴影，光线明亮通透，色调柔和，织物褶皱真实，营造出宁静梦幻的氛围。构图采用竖向，近景特写，角色略微偏向画面左侧，面向画面右侧，无文字，无水印，无多余角色。

templates.title: Hermes Agent Hand-drawn Shorthand Infographic

titleLocalized.zh: Hermes Agent 手绘速记信息图

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a vertical, hand-drawn Japanese infographic with the theme of {argument name="main topic" default="A complete overview of Hermes Agent running on VPS @ Hetzner"} The poster adopts a friendly "Kingdom of Automation" theme, featuring a central robot as its mascot. Canvas: 2:3 vertical poster with a warm beige paper background, watercolor marker texture, dark blue handwritten font, casual sketch lines, soft accent colors, and embellishments of small stars, arrows, doodles, and irregular hand-drawn squares. Header: At the top, a sunrise/cloud doodle is drawn on the left, and a small castle on a hill is drawn on the right. The main title reads "A Complete View of Hermes Agent Running on VPS @ Hetzner". Below is the subtitle "— Mr. Sato's Kingdom of Automation," accompanied by a small crown icon. Central Body: A cute Hermes-themed robot mascot is drawn in the center, wearing a winged helmet, headphones, white rounded armor, boots decorated with small wings, and a cyan cape. The robot smiles through a dark glass mask, holding a clipboard with the word "TASK" written on it. Place a circular time arrow around the mascot, labeled "0:00", "6:00", "12:00", and "18:00". Below the bot, add a nameplate that reads "Hermes Agent ⚚" and a dark cyan data panel that reads "265 Skills / 50 Missions / 24/7 Running on Hetzner VPS". Main schedule layout: Use three large schedule panels around the mascot. The left panel is orange and titled "Morning (JST)"; it contains four rows of tasks, each with an icon: 1) Newspaper icon, "16:30 — ai-news-morning / News → Slack #Experiment"; 2) Clipboard icon, "17:00 — meeting-briefing / Meeting preparation (Weekdays only) → Slack"; 3) Uptrend chart icon, "17:07 — market-intel-morning / Stock chart → Slack"; 4) Bluebird icon, "18:07 — x-engagement-daily / X Hot Analysis → Slack". The upper right panel is green and titled "Midday (JST)"; it contains one task card with a checkbox icon: "9–21:00 / 2 hours — Slack-task-detector / Slack → Linear automated tasking (Weekdays)". The right panel is blue and titled "Evening JST"; it contains 6 rows of tasks, each with an icon: 1) Moon and chart, "03:00 — market-intel-evening / Market Night Report"; 2) Pink brain, "03:00 — metacognition-daily / Metacognition Review"; 3) Envelope reminder, "04:07 — slack-unanswered / Unanswered Slack reminder"; 4) K-line chart, "06:00 — kaichi-trader-daily / US Stock Simulation Trading / ← Today's Additions!! (Weekday)"; 5) Calendar, "06:07 — calendar-preview / Today's Schedule Preview"; 6) Bar chart, "Sunday 05:07 — x-weekly-growth / X Weekly Growth Report". The background services section: In the bottom third, a ribbon title "Background Services (Permanent 24/7)" is added, accompanied by a cross tool icon and a star. Create 5 vertical service cards below. Each card contains a logo-style icon, a service list, a down arrow, and a target box. Card 1: "Slack:" features multicolored Slack-style dots, service "Conversation Hub / Bridge / MCP Server / Approval Listener," target "→Slack DM / Daily News for Sato," and includes a small face doodle. Card 2: "Discord:" features a purple game controller logo, service "Rate Limit / Reaction Listener," target "→Discord / Channels." Card 3: "LINE:" features a green LINE icon and a bear/family doodle, service "Log Bot / Webhook Relay / Cloudflare Tunnel," target "→LINE / Group Logs." Card 4: "X/Twitter:" features a yellow X badge and a bluebird holding a pencil, service "Draftflow," target "→GitHub / Private Repository," and includes a lock icon. Card 5: "Business:" with a red target icon, service content "AIFluence / RepoSwipe / AI Office Worker / OwnTracks / ngrok / SSH Portfolio TUI", target "→Linear / Auto-registration of Tasks" with a checkbox icon. Visual Style: Japanese shorthand style, simulating the texture of markers and colored pencils, vivid and information-dense, clear and easy to read, with an attractive imperfect font, beige background, dark blue ink, orange/green/blue/purple/red outlines, decorative small arrows and stars. All visible text maintains a handwritten feel and strictly retains the specified Japanese/English mixed labeling. Constraints: Use 3 main schedule panels, a total of 11 lines of scheduled tasks, 5 background service cards, and 5 target boxes. Do not add additional branding, watermarks, QR codes, photorealistic or typewriter-style UI designs.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张竖版手绘风格的日文信息图，主题为 {argument name="main topic" default="VPS @ Hetzner 上运行的 Hermes Agent 全貌"}，采用友好的“自动化王国”主题，并以一个中心机器人作为吉祥物。

画布：2:3 比例竖版海报，暖色米色纸张背景，水彩马克笔质感，深蓝色手写字体，随性的草图线条，柔和的强调色，点缀小星星、箭头、涂鸦以及不规则的手绘方框。

页眉：在最上方，左侧绘制日出/云朵涂鸦，右侧绘制山丘上的小城堡。大标题文字为“VPS @ Hetzner 上运行的 Hermes Agent 全貌”。下方添加副标题“— 佐藤先生的自动化王国”，并配有一个小皇冠图标。

中心主体：在中间绘制一个可爱的 Hermes 主题机器人吉祥物，戴着带翅膀的头盔、耳机、白色圆润盔甲，靴子上有小翅膀装饰，披着青色斗篷。机器人通过深色玻璃面罩微笑，手中拿着写有“TASK”字样的剪贴板。周围放置环形时间箭头，并标注“0:00”、“6:00”、“12:00”和“18:00”。在机器人下方，添加一个写有“Hermes Agent ⚚”的铭牌，以及一个深青色的数据牌，上面写着“265 技能 / 50 个任务 / 24/7 运行于 Hetzner VPS”。

主要日程布局：在吉祥物周围使用 3 个大型日程面板。左侧面板为橙色，标题为“朝（早朝・午前）JST”；包含 4 行任务，每行配有图标：1) 报纸图标，“16:30 — ai-news-morning / 新闻 → Slack #实验”；2) 剪贴板图标，“17:00 — meeting-briefing / 会议准备（仅限工作日）→ Slack”；3) 上升趋势图图标，“17:07 — market-intel-morning / 股价图表 → Slack”；4) 蓝鸟图标，“18:07 — x-engagement-daily / X 热门分析 → Slack”。右上角面板为绿色，标题为“日中 JST”；包含 1 个带有复选框图标的任务卡片：“9–21 时 / 2 小时 — Slack-task-detector / Slack→Linear 自动任务化（工作日）”。右侧面板为蓝色，标题为“夕方・夜 JST”；包含 6 行任务，每行配有图标：1) 月亮与图表，“03:00 — market-intel-evening / 市场夜间报告”；2) 粉色大脑，“03:00 — metacognition-daily / 元认知回顾”；3) 信封提醒，“04:07 — slack-unanswered / 未回复 Slack 催办”；4) K 线图，“06:00 — kaichi-trader-daily / 美股模拟交易 / ← 今日新增!!（工作日）”；5) 日历，“06:07 — calendar-preview / 今日日程预览”；6) 条形图，“周日 05:07 — x-weekly-growth / X 周度增长报告”。

后台服务部分：在下三分之一处，添加一个丝带标题“Background Services（常驻 24/7）”，配有交叉工具图标和星星。在下方创建 5 个垂直服务卡片，每张卡片包含一个 Logo 风格图标、服务列表、向下箭头和目标框。卡片 1：“Slack：”配有多色 Slack 风格圆点，服务内容“Conversation Hub / Bridge / MCP Server / Approval Listener”，目标“→Slack DM / 给佐藤的日报”，配有一个小脸涂鸦。卡片 2：“Discord：”配有紫色游戏手柄 Logo，服务内容“Rate Limit / Reaction Listener”，目标“→Discord / 频道”。卡片 3：“LINE：”配有绿色 LINE 图标和小熊/家庭涂鸦，服务内容“Log Bot / Webhook Relay / Cloudflare Tunnel”，目标“→LINE / 群组日志”。卡片 4：“X/Twitter：”配有黄色 X 徽章，拿着铅笔的蓝鸟，服务内容“Draftflow”，目标“→GitHub / 私有仓库”，配有一个锁图标。卡片 5：“商务：”配有红色目标图标，服务内容“AIFluence / RepoSwipe / AI Office Worker / OwnTracks / ngrok / SSH Portfolio TUI”，目标“→Linear / 任务自动注册”，配有复选框图标。

视觉风格：日式速记风格，模拟马克笔和彩色铅笔质感，生动且信息密度高，清晰易读，具有迷人的不完美字体，米色背景，深蓝色墨水，橙/绿/蓝/紫/红色的轮廓框，装饰性的小箭头和星星。所有可见文字保持手写感，并严格保留指定的日文/英文混合标签。

约束条件：使用 3 个主要日程面板，总计 11 行定时任务，5 个后台服务卡片，以及 5 个目标框。不要添加额外的品牌、水印、二维码、照片级真实感或打字机风格的 UI 设计。

templates.title: Anime sports girl illustrations

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫运动风少女插画

templates.prompt: Create a simple, full-body anime-style fashion illustration depicting a young woman standing in three-quarter profile against a pure white background. She has a slender and athletic figure, fair skin, and glossy short hair.{argument name="hair color" default="black"} She had a bob haircut, with thick, layered strands that reached her chin. Her face was deliberately obscured by a softly blurred rectangular smudge in the center. She wore two distinct pieces of clothing: a loose-fitting white cropped sports vest with wide straps, delicate fabric pleats, and seams, and large, light blue lettering printed on the chest.{argument name="shirt text" default="AMES"} And a pair of white elastic-waisted athletic shorts with soft pleats, seams, and slightly flared cuffs. She's depicted with one hand on her hip, the other hanging naturally, her torso tilted to the left, and her head slightly turned to the left, exuding a confident and relaxed summer sportswear pose. The image employs a refined Japanese anime rendering style, with clear lines, realistic and glossy hair highlights, soft skin shadows, detailed human anatomy, minimalist shadows, no background objects, no watermark, and a vertically elongated canvas composition.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张简洁的全身动漫风格时尚插画，描绘一位年轻女性以四分之三侧面站立在纯白色背景前。她身材苗条且富有运动感，皮肤白皙，留着光泽感十足的短发 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"} 波波头，发丝层次厚重，发梢齐下巴。她的面部被一个位于正中央的矩形柔和模糊遮挡块刻意遮盖。她穿着两件明显的服饰：一件宽松的白色短款运动背心，带有宽肩带、细腻的布料褶皱、缝合线，胸前印有淡蓝色大号字母 {argument name="shirt text" default="AMES"}；以及一条白色松紧腰运动短裤，带有柔和的褶皱、接缝线和微喇裤脚。让她一只手叉腰，另一只手臂自然下垂，躯干向左倾斜，头部微向左转，呈现出自信随性的夏季运动装姿态。采用精致的日系动漫渲染风格，线条清晰，头发高光真实且富有光泽，皮肤阴影柔和，人体结构细腻，阴影极简，无背景物体，无水印，构图为竖向长画布。

templates.title: Anime-style Winter Forest Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫风格冬日森林肖像

templates.prompt: Create a quiet, anime-style winter portrait, depicting only a young woman standing outdoors in a snow-covered, leaf-covered forest. Leave the main subject untouched.{argument name="hair color" default="Glossy Black"} Shoulder-length straight bob, parted in the middle with subtle highlights, wearing an oversized top.{argument name="sweater color" default="Light gray"} A ribbed turtleneck sweater with loose cuffs and a delicate knit texture. The composition is a half-body portrait, the subject slightly to the right, facing the camera. The face is deliberately hidden by a softly edged rectangular blurred/occluded block. The color tone is soft beige and gray. The background is a tranquil winter park, the ground covered in snow, with many evenly spaced bare trees extending into the distance in perspective; including slender tree trunks, subtle bark textures, faint shadows on the snow, and a cool blue-gray atmospheric mist in the distance. Rendered with clean Japanese anime illustration style, the lines are delicate, the natural light is soft, the winter color palette is calm, the fabric folds are realistic, and the hair shine is richly detailed. No text, no watermark, no additional figures, no animals.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张安静的动漫风格冬日肖像，画面中仅有 1 位年轻女性站在白雪皑皑的落叶森林户外。主体留着 {argument name="hair color" default="亮黑色"} 及肩直发波波头，中分发型并带有细腻的高光，身穿 1 件超大号 {argument name="sweater color" default="浅灰色"} 罗纹高领毛衣，袖口宽松，针织纹理细腻。构图取半身像，主体略微偏右，正对镜头，面部被一个柔边矩形模糊/遮挡块刻意隐藏，色调为柔和的米色和灰色。背景为宁静的冬日公园，地面覆盖着白雪，许多间距均匀的枯树在透视中向远方延伸；包含细长的树干、微妙的树皮纹理、雪地上淡淡的阴影，以及远方冷蓝灰色的空气感薄雾。采用干净的日式动漫插画渲染，线条细腻，自然光柔和，冬日色调沉稳，织物褶皱真实，头发光泽细节丰富。无文字，无水印，无额外人物，无动物。

templates.title: An anime-style portrait of a person wearing a yukata (with a red round sun background).

titleLocalized.zh: 身着浴衣的动漫风格肖像（配红色圆日背景）

templates.prompt: Create a delicate anime-style portrait illustration, the main character is {argument name="character name" default="Ami"} The image is framed from mid-thigh to above the head, against a warm, traditional Japanese interior background. She has glossy hair.{argument name="hair color" default="black"} Her hair was styled in a bob, parted in the middle with slightly messy ends, but her face was deliberately concealed by a centrally located, opaque square veil, the veil a soft brown-skin gradient covering her eyes, nose, and mouth. She wore a cream-white yukata with 11 clearly visible red flower patterns: one above the right breast, one near the overlapping neckline on the left breast, one on the right sleeve, one at the very edge of the left sleeve, one below the right cuff, a small flower on the right sleeve, one below the left sleeve, one on the left side of the skirt hem, one in the center of the skirt hem, one on the right side of the skirt hem, and a fragmented flower near her left shoulder. The yukata had wide sleeves with realistic pleats and an overlapping neckline. A bright red ribbon was tied around her waist.{argument name="obi color" default="red"} A belt, tied in the center of the front with a light-colored braided rope bow. A large, flat {argument name="background circle color" default="red"} A circular image, resembling a sun wheel, occupies most of the upper background. The interior background should be dark wood, with softly blurred shelves and warm amber lighting to create a cinematic depth-of-field effect. High-quality gpt-image-2 anime rendering was used, resulting in clean lines, rich details in fabric shadows, strong hair shine, and warm skin tones on the neck and hands. A vertical portrait composition was employed, with no text or watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张精致的动漫风格肖像插画，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="Ami"}，画面呈现从大腿中部到头顶上方的构图，背景为温馨的日式传统室内。她留着一头光泽感十足的 {argument name="hair color" default="black"} 波波头，中分且发梢微乱，但她的面部被一个居中的不透明方形遮挡块刻意隐藏，遮挡块采用柔和的棕色肤色渐变，覆盖了眼睛、鼻子和嘴巴。她身穿一件奶油白色浴衣，上面有 11 朵清晰可见的红色花卉图案：右胸上方 1 朵，左胸领口交叠处附近 1 朵，右袖 1 朵，左袖最边缘 1 朵，右袖口下方 1 朵，右袖上一朵小花，左袖下方 1 朵，下裙摆左侧 1 朵，下裙摆中央 1 朵，下裙摆右侧 1 朵，以及左肩区域附近 1 朵残缺的花。浴衣袖口宽大，褶皱真实，领口交叠。腰间系一条鲜艳的 {argument name="obi color" default="red"} 腰带，前面正中系着一个浅色的编织绳蝴蝶结。在她脑后放置一个巨大的扁平 {argument name="background circle color" default="red"} 圆形，如同日轮一般，占据了大部分上方背景。室内背景应为深色木质，带有柔和模糊的架子和温暖的琥珀色灯光，营造出电影般的景深效果。使用高质量的 gpt-image-2 动漫渲染，线条干净，织物阴影细节丰富，头发光泽感强，颈部和手部有温暖的肤色光影，采用竖向肖像构图，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Storybook Watercolor Alchemist

titleLocalized.zh: 故事书水彩炼金术士

templates.prompt: Create a whimsical, storybook-style watercolor illustration depicting a character named{argument name="character name" default="Luna"} A young female alchemist works at a wooden table against a night sky-themed backdrop. The character has long {argument name="hair color" default="Long black hair with a purple gradient"} She was dressed in a magnificent black, white, and purple fantasy alchemist's outfit, adorned with gold trim, a purple ribbon brooch at the collar, a multi-layered cloak, a belt, a small pouch, and star decorations; her face was deliberately obscured by a soft, vertical, blurred gray rectangle, leaving no visible features. In her left hand she held a test tube of purple liquid, and in her right hand she rested on a golden armillary sphere. On the table were 14 clearly visible alchemical and learning items: a golden armillary sphere with a star pattern, an open botany book, a closed blue book below, a purple potion bottle, a wooden test tube rack containing five test tubes of clear, purple, blue, yellow, and pale liquids respectively, a small glass container beside the rack, a pale purple triangular table runner with gold stars and tassels, a small star ornament, and a wooden tabletop. The left shelf area displays seven glass laboratory containers: three tall stoppered flasks, one round-bottomed flask containing pink liquid, one small bottle containing purple liquid, one lidded jar, and one slender bottle. In the lower left foreground, a cream-colored ceramic jug filled with wildflowers—lavender sprigs, purple pansies, peach blossoms, white flowers, green leaves, and creeping vines—is displayed. The background features a crescent moon, eight small golden stars, and a cluster of soft, pale purple clouds. The use of delicate ink outlines, a light white background, transparent watercolor washes, touches of pale purple and gold, a hand-drawn children's book fantasy feel, and subtle paper textures creates a comfortable, magical laboratory atmosphere. The overall color scheme should emphasize…{argument name="accent color" default="Lavender Purple"} Warm gold, cream, and soft brown wood tones. Vertical composition, character and desk centered, no hard shadows, non-realistic style, no extra text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅异想天开的故事书风格水彩插画，描绘一位名叫 {argument name="character name" default="Luna"} 的年轻女性炼金术士，在夜空主题背景下的木桌旁工作。角色留着长长的 {argument name="hair color" default="带有紫色渐变的黑色长发"}，身穿华丽的黑、白、紫三色奇幻炼金术士服装，配有金色镶边、领口的紫色丝带胸针、多层披风、腰带、小袋和星星装饰；她的面部被一个柔和的垂直灰色模糊矩形刻意遮挡，没有可见的五官。她的左手拿着一支紫色液体试管，右手扶着一个金色浑天仪。桌上包含 14 件清晰可见的炼金与学习物品：1 个带有星形图案的金色浑天仪、1 本打开的植物学书籍、下方 1 本合上的蓝色书籍、桌上 1 个紫色药水瓶、1 个木制试管架、架中 5 支分别装有透明、紫色、蓝色、黄色和淡色液体的试管、架子旁 1 个小型玻璃容器、1 条带有金星和流苏的淡紫色三角形桌旗、1 个小星星挂饰以及 1 张木制桌面。左侧架子区域展示 7 个玻璃实验室容器：3 个高大的塞口瓶、1 个装有粉色液体的圆底烧瓶、1 个装有紫色液体的小瓶、1 个带盖罐子和 1 个细长小瓶。左下角前景展示 1 个装满野花的奶油色陶瓷水罐，花卉包括薰衣草枝、紫色三色堇、桃色花朵、白色花朵、绿叶和蔓生藤蔓。背景展示 1 轮新月、8 颗金色小星星和 1 簇柔和的淡紫色云朵。使用细腻的墨线轮廓、轻盈的白色背景、透明的水彩渲染、淡紫色和金色的点缀、手绘儿童绘本奇幻质感、轻微的纸张纹理，营造出舒适的魔法实验室氛围。整体色调应强调 {argument name="accent color" default="薰衣草紫"}、暖金色、奶油色和柔和的棕色木质感。垂直构图，角色和书桌居中，无硬阴影，非写实风格，无额外文字，无水印。

templates.title: To have an audience with the King

titleLocalized.zh: 觐见国王

templates.prompt: Create a name{argument name="scene title" default="To have an audience with the King"} A cinematic, photographically realistic medieval fantasy scene: In a magnificent Gothic throne room, the back of a king can be seen in the lower right foreground, facing two distinguished petitioners. The two central figures are: a female knight in exquisitely carved, polished silver plate armor, complete with chainmail details, gauntlets, boots, a sword at her waist, and a pale white cloak; and a tall prince or nobleman in a pure white military-style uniform adorned with gold embroidery, gold buttons, epaulettes, woven chains, a belt, and a white cloak. The nobleman has long, dark, wavy hair; the female knight has her blonde hair styled in an updo. The foreground precisely includes three main characters: the king, the armored female knight, and the nobleman in white. In the background, eight guards or courtiers are precisely positioned symmetrically behind the two central figures, dressed in dark armor and formal medieval attire, holding spears or standing at attention. The king, dressed in a deep navy blue and gold brocade robe and wearing a magnificent gold crown, sits regally on a black and gold carved throne adorned with gilded spires and scroll decorations. The hall features soaring pointed arches, a bright stained-glass window with foliage in the center of the background, a deep blue banner with gold coat of arms hanging high, flickering candlesticks, swirling ambient light beams, marble columns, and a black and white patterned polished stone floor reflecting the figures. The dramatic backlighting from the windows, warm candlelight highlights, deep shadows, a cinematic shallow depth of field, ultra-fine clothing details, realistic fabric textures, and metallic reflections create a solemn and dignified atmosphere for the royal audience. The composition should be a 4:5 vertical screen, with the perspective slightly lower and behind the king, and the two petitioners centered and fully visible. There is no text, no watermark, and no modern objects.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个名为 {argument name="scene title" default="觐见国王"} 的电影级照片写实中世纪奇幻场景：在宏伟的哥特式王座大厅内，右下角前景处可以看到一位国王的背影，他正面对着站在面前的两位尊贵的请愿者。两位中心人物分别是：一位身穿精致雕花全套抛光银色板甲的女性骑士，配有锁子甲细节、护手、长靴、腰间佩剑及一件苍白色披风；以及一位高大的王子或贵族，身穿一袭纯白色的军装风格礼服，饰有金色刺绣、金扣、肩章、编织链条、腰带及白色斗篷。贵族留着深色波浪长发；女骑士留着盘起的金发。前景中精确包含 3 位主要角色：国王、身穿盔甲的女骑士和身着白衣的贵族。背景中精确布置 8 位守卫或朝臣，对称排列在中央二人身后，身着深色盔甲和正式中世纪服饰，手持长矛或肃立。国王身穿深海军蓝配金色的锦缎长袍，头戴华丽的金冠，端坐在饰有镀金尖顶和卷轴装饰的黑金雕花王座上。大厅拥有高耸的尖拱、背景中央明亮的彩色玻璃柳叶窗、饰有金色纹章的深蓝色高挂旗帜、烛光摇曳的烛台、烟雾缭绕的氛围光束、大理石柱，以及反射着人物影像的黑白图案光面石地板。利用来自窗户的戏剧性逆光、温暖的烛光高光、深邃的阴影、浅景深的电影感、超精细的服装细节、逼真的织物纹理、金属反射效果，营造出庄严肃穆的皇家觐见氛围。构图应为 4:5 竖屏，视角位于国王后方稍低处，两位请愿者居中且全身可见。无文字，无水印，无现代物品。

templates.title: Seaside Rock Music Festival Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 海滨摇滚音乐节海报

templates.prompt: Create a 2:3 aspect ratio vertical poster for a summer rock music festival artist, evoking a dreamy Japanese seaside festival atmosphere. Use a bright, overexposed, realistic "follow me" composition: In the foreground, a young woman appears from behind and to the side, extending her arm towards the camera as if holding the audience's hand, creating a strong sense of depth. She has long, dark hair blown to the right by the sea breeze, wearing a loose white off-the-shoulder sheer top over a white tank top, and light blue jeans. Her face is partially obscured by a centered, soft gray square privacy panel. The background features an outdoor music stage located on a beach or by the water, showing the trusses, speakers, illuminated stage lights, a small band performing, and audience members dressed in white facing the stage; showcasing the blue ocean and sky, dotted with soft clouds. The overall color scheme uses light cyan and white, high-key sunlight with a soft lens flare, presenting a nostalgic summer film texture with shallow depth of field and no strong contrast. Add 5 handwritten white text elements: 1) The large heading at the top "{argument name="festival title" default="ROCKFEST2026"} 1) The font used is a delicate and casual handwritten font; 2) The smaller subheading below "{argument name="subtitle" default="The Summer Camp"} 3) Handwritten Japanese quotation in the middle left position{argument name="quote" default="Let's go together towards the sound of heaven."} 4) The artist's name centered at the bottom.{argument name="artist name" default="ai honobono"} "; and 5) the date line at the bottom"{argument name="date line" default="DAY 1   7/25 SAT"} Keep the layout light, imperfect, and chalk/marker-like, allowing it to blend naturally into the sky and foreground below. Avoid adding extra logos, watermarks, borders, or other text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 2:3 比例的竖版夏季摇滚音乐节艺术家宣传海报，营造出梦幻般的日式海滨音乐节氛围。采用明亮、过曝的写实风格“跟我来”构图：前景中，一位年轻女性从后方及侧面出镜，她向镜头伸出手臂，仿佛正牵着观众的手，具有强烈的景深感。她留着深色长发，被海风吹向右侧，身穿宽松的白色露肩透视衫，内搭白色吊带背心，下身穿着浅蓝色牛仔裤。她的脸部被一个居中的柔灰色方形隐私遮挡块遮住。背景处设置一个位于海滩或水边的户外音乐舞台，可见桁架、扬声器、发光的舞台灯光、正在表演的小型乐队，以及面向舞台、身着白色服装的观众；展现蓝色的海洋与天空，点缀着柔和的云朵。整体色调采用轻盈的青蓝色与白色，高调阳光，带有柔和的镜头光晕，呈现出夏季怀旧的胶片质感，浅景深，无强烈对比。添加 5 个手写白色文本元素：1) 顶部的大标题“{argument name="festival title" default="天 ROCKFEST2026"}”，采用纤细随性的手写字体；2) 下方较小的副标题“{argument name="subtitle" default="The Summer Camp"}”；3) 左中位置的手写日文引语“{argument name="quote" default="天の音がするほうへ、一緒に"}”，并带有两条简单的下划线；4) 底部居中的艺术家名称“{argument name="artist name" default="ai honobono"}”；以及 5) 底部的日期行“{argument name="date line" default="DAY 1   7/25 SAT"}”。保持排版轻盈、不完美且具有粉笔/记号笔质感，使其自然融入天空和下方前景中。避免添加额外的标志、水印、边框或其他文字。
