templates.title: Rainbow Magic Stone Project Promotional Flyer

titleLocalized.zh: Rainbow Magic Stone 项目宣传单

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a beautiful anime-style flyer image for promoting a product called [Product Name].{argument name="game title" default="Rainbow Magic Stone"} This is a fantasy puzzle project, creating the atmosphere of a dark medieval magic tavern, and includes clear and easy-to-read Japanese project information. Canvas: 16:9 widescreen, approximately 1200×675 pixels. It uses a gorgeous dark brown and gold fantasy UI border, parchment panels, glowing candlelight, gem highlights, and a premium project advertising style. Layout: The screen is divided into three main vertical areas and a bottom information bar. The left area occupies about one-third of the canvas and displays narrative illustrations. The central area contains a title bar and two explanatory parchment panels. The right area contains a numbered project flow panel with four steps. The bottom bar spans the entire width and includes the number of players, game duration, age, price, publisher, and booth information. Left illustration: Inside a cozy medieval tavern or wizard's workshop, four anime adventurers sit around a wooden table covered with many colorful small rainbow gems or hexagonal tiles. The four visible characters are: 1) a knight or soldier in blue armor on the far left; 2) a wizard in a dark robe in the rear left; 3) a pale-faced nobleman or mage seated in the center; and 4) an adventurer in an orange hooded cloak on the right. The background is filled with warm candlelight, hanging lanterns, shelves, bottles, magical tools, wooden beams, and deep shadows. Red, green, blue, yellow, purple, and clear gem fragments are scattered on the table, emitting a soft glow. Character faces can be simplified, but the scene should have detail and a cinematic feel. Top title: A circular rainbow gem badge is placed in the upper left corner of the text area. Next to it is a large gold and rainbow-colored Japanese title:{argument name="game title" default="Rainbow Magic Stone"} Below the title, add a subtitle: "Rainbow Magic Stone / Time Configuration Game". Add subtle shimmering effects around the title and the gem. Center parchment panel: Add a large Japanese slogan:{argument name="tagline" default="Repair the shattered magic stone. Only one person can cross the rainbow bridge."} Below this, create two panels labeled with red ribbons: 1) "Arashiji" and 2) "Game Summary". Under "Arashiji", there is a short Japanese fantasy story about repairing the broken Rainbow Magic Stone to build a rainbow bridge to the Valley of the Dragon King, which only one hero can reach. Under "Game Summary", there is a Japanese explanation of how players place rainbow fragments (hexagonal panels) on the items, scoring points by connecting red, green, blue, and circular/star markers in straight lines, and striving for instant victory after reaching a certain number of connections. The right-hand parchment panel: the title ribbon displays "Game Flow". It contains four numbered steps, each in a separate parchment line, accompanied by a colored shield badge number. The 4 steps are: 1) Red shield, label "[Preparation]", text "ボードを和べ, respective no rainbow の owed piece を山札にする"; 2) Green shield, label "[Configuration]", text "hand fan プレイヤーが红の无码を1 piece ボードにSETく"; 3) Blue shield, label "[Get Points]", text "カラー・マーク・无printが Straight Lineに揃うとGet Points"; 4) Red shield, label "[Victory]", text "Every member of the team has the most points to win the victory". A small note is added at the bottom: "※Win instantly by matching a certain number of colors and marks!" The bottom bar uses icons and text blocks separated by a thin gold dividing line. The left side contains four specifications: 1) Number of people icon and "3-4 people", 2) Clock icon and "60 minutes", 3) Calendar or age icon and "8 years and older", 4) Japanese yen coin icon and "¥1,000". The publisher's name is displayed in the middle.{argument name="publisher name" default="まほろば"} The right side displays exhibition information.{argument name="event booth text" default="Game Market 2026 Spring F-18"} Visual Style: The design combines highly detailed Japanese anime fantasy illustrations with exquisite project flyer design, featuring ornate gold borders, deep walnut wood tones, parchment textures, red ribbon labels, embossed fonts, glowing magical rainbow gems, dramatic warm lighting, and dense decorative details. All panels remain clear and balanced. Avoid modern flat design, blank spaces, unnecessary characters, and added numbering steps, and strictly adhere to specified quantities.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：制作一张精美的动漫风格单页宣传图，用于推广名为 {argument name="game title" default="虹の魔法石"} 的奇幻拼图类项目，营造黑暗中世纪魔法酒馆的氛围，并包含清晰易读的日文项目信息。

画布：宽屏 16:9 比例，约 1200×675 像素。使用华丽的深棕色与金色奇幻 UI 边框、羊皮纸面板、发光的烛光、宝石高光，以及高级项目广告风格。

布局：将画面分为三个主要垂直区域及一个底部信息栏。左侧区域约占画布的三分之一，展示叙事插图。中心区域包含标题栏和两个说明性羊皮纸板块。右侧区域包含一个带有 4 个步骤的编号项目流程面板。底部栏横跨整个宽度，包含玩家人数、游戏时长、年龄、价格、发行商及展位信息。

左侧插图：在温馨的中世纪酒馆或巫师工作室内部，展示 4 名动漫冒险者围坐在木桌旁，桌上铺满了许多彩色的小型彩虹宝石或六边形板块。四名可见的角色为：1) 最左侧身穿蓝色盔甲的骑士或士兵；2) 左后方身穿深色长袍的巫师形象；3) 坐在中心、面色苍白的贵族或法师；4) 右侧身穿橙色连帽斗篷的冒险者。背景充满温暖的蜡烛、悬挂的灯笼、架子、瓶子、魔法工具、木梁和深邃的阴影。桌面上散落着红色、绿色、蓝色、黄色、紫色和透明的宝石碎片，发出微光。人物面部可适当简化，但场景应具有细节感和电影质感。

顶部标题：在文本区域的左上方放置一个圆形彩虹宝石徽章。旁边是巨大的金色与彩虹色日文标题：{argument name="game title" default="虹の魔法石"}。在标题下方，添加副标题：“Rainbow Magic Stone / タイル配置ゲーム”。在标题和宝石周围添加细微的闪光效果。

中心羊皮纸面板：添加日文大标语：{argument name="tagline" default="砕かれた魔法石を修復せよ。虹の橋を渡るのは、ただひとり。"}。在其下方，创建 2 个带红色丝带标签的板块：1) “あらすじ” 和 2) “ゲーム概要”。在“あらすじ”下，包含一段简短的日文奇幻故事，讲述修复破碎的彩虹魔法石以搭建通往龙王之谷的彩虹桥，且只有一名英雄能抵达。在“ゲーム概要”下，用日文解释玩家如何在项目上放置彩虹碎片（六边形板块），通过将红色、绿色、蓝色及圆形/星形标记连成直线来得分，并可在排列达到规定数量后争取即时胜利。

右侧羊皮纸面板：标题丝带显示“ゲームの流れ”。包含 4 个编号步骤，每个步骤位于独立的羊皮纸行中，并配有彩色盾牌徽章数字。4 个步骤为：1) 红色盾牌，标签“【準備】”，文本“ボードを並べ、各自の虹の欠片を山札にする”；2) 绿色盾牌，标签“【配置】”，文本“手番プレイヤーが虹の欠片を1枚ボードに置く”；3) 蓝色盾牌，标签“【得点】”，文本“カラー・マーク・無印が直線に揃うと得点獲得”；4) 红色盾牌，标签“【勝利】”，文本“全員の欠片がなくなったら最多得点のプレイヤーが勝利”。底部添加小注：“※カラーやマークを一定数以上並べると即時勝利！”。

底部栏：使用由细金色分隔线隔开的图标与文本块。左侧包含 4 个规格项：1) 人数图标及“3〜4人”，2) 时钟图标及“60分”，3) 日历或年龄图标及“8歳以上”，4) 日元硬币图标及“¥1,000”。中间显示发行商名称 {argument name="publisher name" default="まほろば"}。右侧显示展会信息 {argument name="event booth text" default="ゲームマーケット2026春　F-18"}。

视觉风格：高细节的日本动漫奇幻插图与精致的项目宣传单设计相结合，采用华丽的金色边框、深胡桃木色、羊皮纸纹理、红色丝带标签、浮雕字体、发光的魔法彩虹宝石、戏剧性的暖色灯光及密集的装饰细节。保持所有面板清晰且平衡。避免现代扁平化设计，避免空白，避免多余字符，避免增加编号步骤，并严格遵守指定的数量。

templates.title: Japanese-style self-care flower ball card

titleLocalized.zh: 日式自我关怀花丸卡片

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a warm, Japanese-style self-affirmation card about a lucky charm for those who miss bedtime, encouraging them to reward themselves with a large flower ball from their calendar. Canvas: 16:9 horizontal illustration, soft off-white textured paper background, watercolor and colored pencil textures to create a gentle bedtime atmosphere. Use soft cream, beige, gray-gold, sage gray, soft brown, faded denim blue, and coral red as accents. Layout: Place the main Japanese text in the left two-thirds, and the cute children's illustration in the right third. Text in 6 lines: 1) Large handwritten title with a pink shimmering heart in the upper left corner, 2) A smaller line of text below, 3) A very large gold phrase in the center, 4) A smaller line of text below, 5) Medium-sized text overlaid on sage gray horizontal strokes, one character with a red circle stamp, 6) The bottom last line, one word in coral red. Add a gold arc as an underline below the last line. Text content: Use precise Japanese text:{argument name="title text" default="ひつじのおまじない💕"} Second line:{argument name="encouragement line" default="To myself for doing my best"} ; Central large row:{argument name="main reward phrase" default="Big flower"} Next line: "をあげるつもりで"; Stroke line: "カレンダーに印つけて", where the character "印" is circled in coral red; Last line: "自己定定感アップするよ", where "アップ" is coral red, and the rest is dark brown. Main details: On the right, a cute young girl is depicted in a soft, watercolor style. She has light brown, wavy, shoulder-length hair, rosy cheeks, and a calm, happy expression. She wears a fluffy white sheep's hat with small ears, a pale yellow short-sleeved shirt, loose-fitting denim blue overalls with rolled-up cuffs, white socks, and white sneakers. She is walking briskly to the right, one leg raised, her arms outstretched above her head, making a large circle like a flower ball. She carries a cream-colored shoulder bag with a small sheep-face badge. Decorative elements include a small red ball near her feet, a spiral-bound desktop calendar with a coral flower ball on the far right, two coral flower ball doodles, a coral circle stamp around the word "seal," a pink shimmering heart near the title, and many small gold stars scattered throughout. Behind the girl, approximately five irregular metallic gold concentric circles are placed, like a halo. Loose gold brushstrokes are added to the upper right and lower left corners, and subtle gray-blue watercolor washes are added to the upper left and lower left corners. Visual style: Soft, cute Japanese watercolor postcard with soft edges, hand-drawn irregular lines, a blend of elegant brush calligraphy and neat handwritten text, a transparent composition, a warm nighttime encouragement, no harsh outlines, and a non-realistic style. Constraints: Keep all text clear and legible and positioned as described. Do not add extra characters, extra calendars, or extra large objects. No watermark, no logo, no English characters.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张温暖的日式自我关怀肯定卡片，内容是关于给错过睡眠时间的人准备的幸运符，鼓励他们奖励自己一个日历上的大花丸。

画布：横向 16:9 插画，柔和的米白色纹理纸背景，水彩和彩色铅笔质感，营造温和的睡前氛围。使用柔和的奶油色、米色、灰金色、鼠尾草灰、柔棕色、褪色牛仔蓝以及珊瑚红作为点缀。

布局：将主要的日文排版置于左侧三分之二处，可爱的儿童插画置于右侧三分之一处。文字共分 6 行：1) 左上角带有粉色闪烁爱心的大号手写标题，2) 下方较小的一行文字，3) 中心位置非常大的金色短语，4) 下方较小的一行文字，5) 覆盖在鼠尾草灰色横向笔触上的中号文字，其中一个字符带有红色圆圈印章，6) 底部最后一行，其中一个词为珊瑚红色。在最后一行下方添加一条金色弧线作为下划线。

文字内容：使用精确的日文文本：{argument name="title text" default="ひつじのおまじない💕"}；第二行：{argument name="encouragement line" default="がんばった自分に"}；中心大号行：{argument name="main reward phrase" default="大きな花丸"}；下一行："をあげるつもりで"；笔触行："カレンダーに印つけて"，其中字符 "印" 用珊瑚红色圆圈圈出；最后一行："自己肯定感アップするよ"，其中 "アップ" 为珊瑚红色，其余为深棕色。

主体细节：在右侧，绘制 1 名可爱的年轻女孩，采用柔和的绘本水彩风格。她留着浅棕色波浪形齐肩发，脸颊红润，表情平静快乐。她戴着一顶毛茸茸的白色羊帽，上面有小耳朵，穿着淡黄色短袖衬衫、卷边的宽松牛仔蓝背带裤、白袜子和白色运动鞋。她正轻快地向右走，一条腿抬起，双臂举过头顶比出一个像花丸一样的大圆圈。她背着 1 个奶油色单肩包，上面有一个小羊脸徽章。

装饰元素：包含 1 个靠近她脚边的小红球，右侧远端有 1 个螺旋装订的桌面日历，上面画着一个珊瑚色花丸，总共 2 个珊瑚色花丸涂鸦，1 个围绕 "印" 字的珊瑚色圆圈印章，1 个靠近标题的粉色闪烁爱心，以及散落在各处的许多金色小星星。在女孩身后，放置约 5 个不规则的金属金色同心圆笔触，如同光环一般。在右上角和左下角添加松散的金色笔触弧线，并在左上角和左下角添加微妙的灰蓝色水彩晕染。

视觉风格：柔和的日式可爱水彩明信片，边缘柔和，手绘不规则线条，优雅的毛笔书法字体与整洁的手写文字混合，构图通透，温馨的夜间鼓励，无生硬轮廓，非写实风格。

约束：保持所有文字清晰易读并按描述定位。不要添加额外的角色、额外的日历或额外的重大物体。无水印，无 Logo，无英文字符。

templates.title: Crystal Cat Spirit

titleLocalized.zh: 水晶猫灵

templates.prompt: Create a dreamy anime-style illustration, the main character is {argument name="character name" default="Nico"} An elegant, small crystal cat spirit stands in a magnificent church constructed of glass and gemstones. This cat possesses a petite, fox-like feline body, oversized pointed ears, a delicate smiling face, long white whiskers, and large, sparkling eyes; its color is {argument name="eye color" default="purple-blue"} Its entire body appears to be composed of translucent faceted crystal, with its main color being {argument name="crystal body color" default="Ice blue and lavender"} The face, torso, legs, paws, and ears reflect iridescent prisms. A rhombus-shaped gemstone is embedded in the forehead, adorned with a faceted jeweled collar or chest ornament. The cat stands in an elegant three-quarter profile, its forelegs straight, back slightly arched, head turned towards the viewer, its expression magical, confident, and gentle. Behind it are two long, flowing tails curling upwards, each tipped with a bright crystal flame or gemstone tip: one glowing with pinkish-magenta light, the other with cyan light, surrounded by tiny starlight. The background is the interior of an ethereal crystal palace, flanked by tall arched columns, with stained glass windows softly glowing, a mirror-like floor, and gemstone structures visible in the distance. Soft hues of blue, lavender, pink, cyan, and pearl white are used, combined with soft volumetric backlighting, rainbow caustics, shimmering particles, lens flanks, and a dreamlike, high-detail gpt-image-2 fantasy art style. Keep the composition centered, full-body portrait, square format, no text, no watermark, and no other animals.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张梦幻动漫风格的插画，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="Nico"}，一只优雅的小型水晶猫灵，正站在一座由玻璃和宝石构成的宏伟教堂中。这只猫拥有娇小的狐狸般猫科身体、超大的尖耳朵、精致的笑脸、长长的白胡须，以及闪烁着光泽的大眼睛，颜色为 {argument name="eye color" default="紫蓝色"}。它的全身仿佛由半透明的刻面水晶构成，主体颜色为 {argument name="crystal body color" default="冰蓝色和薰衣草色"}，在脸部、躯干、腿部、爪子和耳朵上折射出彩虹般的棱镜色彩。额头嵌入一颗菱形宝石，并配有刻面珠宝项圈或胸饰。猫以优雅的四分之三侧身姿态站立，前腿笔直，背部微拱，头部转向观众，表情充满魔力、自信且温柔。身后有两条长而飘逸的尾巴向上卷曲，每条尾巴末端都带着明亮的水晶火焰或宝石尖：一条发出粉红洋红色光芒，另一条发出青蓝色光芒，周围环绕着细小的星光。背景是空灵的水晶宫殿内部，两侧有高大的拱形立柱，背景中彩色玻璃窗柔和地发光，地面光洁如镜，远处可见宝石构造。使用蓝色、薰衣草色、粉色、青色和珍珠白的柔和色调，配合柔和的体积背光、彩虹焦散、闪烁粒子、镜头星芒，以及梦幻般的高细节 gpt-image-2 奇幻艺术风格。保持构图居中，全身像，方形画幅，无文字，无水印，无其他动物。

templates.title: Japanese ES Editing App Mockup Design

titleLocalized.zh: 日语 ES 润色 App 样机设计

templates.prompt: Objective: To provide a product called{argument name="app name" default="ES添削AI"} Create a beautiful marketing mockup for a Japanese mobile app. This app is an AI-powered job application form (ES)/resume editing tool for students. The mockup should display three iPhone screens side-by-side on a clean white background. Canvas: Wide landscape image, approximately 16:9 aspect ratio. Three modern iPhones with black borders, rounded corners, a Dynamic Island at the top, a 9:41 time display in the status bar, and a home screen indicator at the bottom are displayed. The UI design uses bright white cards, soft shadows, rounded corners, and a purple-to-blue gradient accent. The overall style should present a realistic App Store/social media concept mockup, simple and trustworthy. Phone 1, Home Screen: Top left corner title text "ES AI Editing," top right corner circular user/profile icon. The first screen area contains a small purple label "AIがあなたのESをプロViewpointでCompletely Addedします" and a bold main title "あなたの强みが、もっと伝わるESへ" .", supporting copy "Pass rate を上げるESを一丝に作りましょう.", and a vignette of a student working in front of a laptop with a purple AI/chat icon. The section title is "Additional Cutting". Add a large gradient call-to-action (CTA) card with a document icon and the text "ESを新しくadd Cutする" below The small print reads "ESを入力またはファイルをアップロードして, AIがadditchします" and is accompanied by an arrow pointing to the right. Section title "Function List". Displays 4 function list cards: 1) Clock icon, "Add Cutting Guide", "Past Add Cutting Details"; 2) Chat icon, "face-to-face questioningをprediction", "あなたのESからface-to-face communicationででれそうなquestioningをgeneratedします"; 3) Portrait icons, "Analyze it by yourself", "Strong みやガクチカをorganize するお手伝いをします"; 4) Building icon, "Company-specific app proposal", "Proposal for companies with aspirations". The bottom navigation bar contains 5 items: "Home" (selected), "Revision History", "Interview Questions", "Self-Analysis", and "Company-specific Proposal". Phone 2, Results Overview Screen: The top bar has a back arrow and a centered title "Revision Results". Below are 4 tabs: "Comprehensive Evaluation" (selected, with a purple underline), "Item-specific Evaluation", "Revision Comment", and "Improvement Examples". The main white card title is "Comprehensive Evaluation". A circular score ring is displayed on the left, showing {argument name="score" default="87"} And "/100". The text on the right displays "rating rating", large rating.{argument name="grade" default="A"} , "Suharu らしいESです!" and "この声子で世上げましょう.". The next card has the title "Pass Rate Prediction", the text "このESの高いと Prediction されます", a green badge "High", a horizontal progress bar, and "More than 80%". The next card title "strongみ" contains 3 There are green check items: "Specific なエピソードが书けている", "あなたの価䀤観が伝わっている", "Enterprise とのマッチdegree が高い". The next card, titled "Improvement Point (Priority Order)," contains three numbered lines: 1 "Let's write the conclusion clearly" (with a red badge indicating "High"); 2 "The results are shown in numbers and the ability to explain them increases" (with an orange badge indicating "Medium"); 3 "The background of the game is less detailed" (with a gray badge indicating "Low"). At the bottom is a large purple-blue gradient button with the text "See the example of improvement." On phone 3, the detailed comment screen has a back arrow in the top bar and a centered title "Additions and Reductions Results." Repeat the four tabs: "Overall Evaluation," "Item-Specific Evaluation," "Additional Comments" (selected, underlined in purple), and "Improvement Examples." Display two visible polishing sections within the stacked white cards. Section 1 is titled "Question 1: What Did You Achieve During Your Student Days?" (with a red badge reading "High"), subtitled "Comment." The commentary explains that the conclusion should be written last, conveying what the student accomplished and highlighting how quantifiable results enhance persuasiveness. Following this is the subtitle "Improvement Examples," accompanied by a light purple suggestion box labeled "AI-Suggested Case Study," containing rewritten Japanese text about increasing coffee shop sales, serving as a part-time team leader, and increasing sales by 20% within three months. Part 2 is titled "Question 2: Your Strengths" (with an orange "中" badge), subtitled "Comment." The commentary suggests supporting the demonstration of strengths with concrete examples and concludes with how to leverage those strengths within a company. The content includes a rewritten example beginning with "私の强みは『问题解决力』です。" and mentioning coffee shop congestion and operational improvements. promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为一款名为 {argument name="app name" default="ES添削AI"} 的日语移动端 App 创建精美的营销样机。该 App 是一款面向学生的 AI 入职申请表（ES）/简历润色工具。样机需展示三部 iPhone 屏幕并排陈列在纯净的白色背景上。

画布：宽幅横向图像，比例约为 16:9。放置 3 部黑色边框的现代 iPhone，圆角设计，顶部带有灵动岛（Dynamic Island），状态栏时间显示 9:41，底部带有主屏幕指示条。UI 设计采用明亮的白色卡片、柔和阴影、圆角设计以及紫到蓝的渐变色点缀。整体风格应呈现出逼真的 App Store/社交媒体概念样机效果，简洁且值得信赖。

手机 1，主屏幕：左上角标题文字为「ES添削AI」，右上角为圆形用户/个人资料图标。首屏区域包含一个紫色小标签「AIがあなたのESをプロ視点で徹底添削します」，粗体主标题「あなたの強みが、もっと伝わるESへ。」，辅助文案「通過率を上げるESを一緒に作りましょう。」，以及一张学生在笔记本电脑前工作并配有紫色 AI/聊天图标的小插图。分区标题「添削を始める」。添加一个带有文档图标的大型渐变色行动号召（CTA）卡片，文字为「ESを新しく添削する」，下方小字为「ESを入力またはファイルをアップロードして、AIが添削します」，并配有一个向右的箭头。分区标题「機能一覧」。展示 4 张功能列表卡片：1) 时钟图标，「添削履歴」，「過去に添削したESを確認できます」；2) 聊天图标，「面接質問を予測」，「あなたのESから面接で聞かれそうな質問を生成します」；3) 人像图标，「自己分析サポート」，「強みやガクチカを整理するお手伝いをします」；4) 建筑图标，「企業別アピール提案」，「志望企業に合わせたアピールポイントを提案します」。底部导航栏包含 5 个项目：「ホーム」（选中状态）、「添削履歴」、「面接質問」、「自己分析」、「企業別提案」。

手机 2，结果概览屏幕：顶部栏有一个返回箭头和居中标题「添削結果」。下方展示 4 个选项卡：「総合評価」（选中状态，带紫色下划线）、「項目別評価」、「添削コメント」、「改善例」。主白色卡片标题「総合評価」。左侧显示一个圆形分数环，显示 {argument name="score" default="87"} 和「/100」。右侧文字显示「評価ランク」，大号等级 {argument name="grade" default="A"}，「素晴らしいESです！」以及「この調子で仕上げましょう。」。下一张卡片标题「通過率予測」，文字「このESの通過率は高いと予測されます」，绿色徽章「高」，水平进度条，以及「80%以上」。下一张卡片标题「強み」，包含 3 个绿色勾选项目：「具体的なエピソードが書けている」、「あなたの価値観が伝わっている」、「企業とのマッチ度が高い」。下一张卡片标题「改善ポイント（優先度順）」，包含 3 个带编号的行：1「結論をより明確に書きましょう」（带红色徽章「高」）；2「成果を数字で示すと説得力が増します」（带橙色徽章「中」）；3「ガクチカの背景をもう少し詳しく」（带灰色徽章「低」）。底部是一个大型紫蓝色渐变按钮，文字为「改善例を見る」。

手机 3，详细评论屏幕：顶部栏有一个返回箭头和居中标题「添削結果」。重复 4 个选项卡：「総合評価」、「項目別評価」、「添削コメント」（选中状态，带紫色下划线）、「改善例」。在堆叠的白色卡片中展示 2 个可见的润色部分。第 1 部分标题「設問1：学生時代に力を入れたこと」（带红色徽章「高」），副标题「コメント」，评论文字解释结论写在最后，应先传达学生完成了什么，并指出数字化的成果能提高说服力。随后是副标题「改善例」，配有一个浅紫色建议框，标注为「AI提案例」，内容包含关于增加咖啡店销售额、担任兼职组长以及在 3 个月内将销售额提高 20% 的重写日语文本。第 2 部分标题「設問2：あなたの強み」（带橙色徽章「中」），副标题「コメント」，评论文字建议通过具体事例来支撑强项的展示，并以如何在公司中发挥该强项作为结尾。随后是副标题「改善例」，配有一个浅紫色建议框，标注为「AI提案例」，内容包含以「私の強みは『課題解決力』です。」开头并提及咖啡店拥挤和运营改善的重写示例，底部略微裁剪，呈现出可滚动效果。

视觉风格：日语 iOS App UI，San Francisco/Noto Sans 字体，紫色和靛蓝色渐变，微妙的淡紫色高光，蓝色强调图标，柔和的卡片阴影，清晰的对齐，充足的留白。使用逼真的手机硬件阴影和间距。保持文字清晰易读，并与指定的日语标签基本一致。

约束条件：展示 3 部手机，第一部手机上正好 4 张功能卡片和 5 个底部导航项目，每个结果屏幕上正好 4 个选项卡，正好 3 个强项，正好 3 个改进点，以及正好 2 个可见的评论部分。不要添加额外的屏幕、水印、Logo 或装饰性杂物。

templates.title: Napoleon portrait in minimalist geometric style

titleLocalized.zh: 极简几何风格拿破仑肖像

templates.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the source image, the painting is transformed into a minimalist geometric poster portrait. The rider's upright posture, overall composition, iconic red cloak, uniform, horse orientation, mountainous battlefield background, and deliberately blurred facial areas are preserved. The classical oil painting texture is replaced with clean, solid-color vector shapes, sharp geometric facets, simplified shadows, and a limited palette of deep navy blue, slate blue, cream white, tan, black, and bright red. Mountains, clouds, horse structure, cloak folds, and ground are treated as sharply edged, high-contrast graphic-like faceted polygons. All soldiers and battlefield details in the background are simplified to small, abstract silhouettes; five small visible soldier figures and a cannon wheel are retained on the lower left slope. The foreground text carved into the rocks is removed, and no new text is added. The vertical and heroic composition is maintained, presenting a dynamic diagonal sense of movement and a modern editorial illustration style.

promptLocalized.zh: 以 REFERENCE_0 作为构图来源，将画作转化为极简风格的几何海报肖像。保留骑手骑在直立马匹上的姿态、整体构图、标志性的红色斗篷、军装、马匹朝向、山地战场背景以及刻意模糊的面部区域。将古典油画质感替换为简洁的纯色矢量形状、锐利的几何切面、简化的阴影，并使用深海军蓝、板岩蓝、奶油白、棕褐色、黑色和鲜红色组成的有限调色板。将山脉、云朵、马匹结构、斗篷褶皱和地面处理为边缘清晰、具有高对比度图形光影的切面多边形。将背景中的所有士兵和战场细节简化为小型抽象剪影；在左下坡处保留 5 个可见的小型士兵人影和一个炮轮。移除岩石上雕刻的前景文字，且不要添加任何新文字。保持垂直且具有英雄气概的构图，呈现出动态的对角线运动感和现代编辑插画风格。

templates.title: Minimalist Cormorant Fishing Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 极简主义鸬鹚捕鱼海报

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, transform its scene into {argument name="art style" default="Minimalist flat vector illustration"} While preserving the original cormorant fishing composition, subject position, bamboo rafts, landscape background, and overall atmosphere, the photographs are simplified into bold geometric shapes, clean outlines, minimal detail, and layered poster-like forms, devoid of photorealistic textures. Soft cyan, deep blue, olive green, and warm cream tones are used, paired with angular, stylized clouds and mountains, calm reflecting water, and simplified rocky foregrounds. The image retains exactly three fishermen on three bamboo rafts, exactly four black cormorants, and exactly two lanterns. The fishermen's straw hats and dark traditional clothing are preserved, but all figures are rendered as simplified, graphic figures with blurred/featureless faces. The final result is then processed into…{argument name="aspect ratio" default="3:4"} The vertical poster composition requires clear edges and a strong sense of atmosphere, making it suitable as a minimalist travel illustration.

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图像，将其场景转换为 {argument name="art style" default="极简风格扁平矢量插画"}，同时保留原始的鸬鹚捕鱼构图、主体位置、竹筏、山水背景以及整体氛围。将照片简化为大胆的几何形状、干净的轮廓、极少的细节以及层叠的海报式形态，且不含照片级真实纹理。使用柔和的青色、深蓝色、橄榄绿和暖奶油色调，搭配棱角分明的风格化云朵和山脉、平静的倒影水面以及简化的岩石前景。保持画面中正好有 3 名渔夫在 3 只竹筏上、正好 4 只黑鸬鹚以及正好 2 盏灯笼。保留渔夫的斗笠和深色传统服饰，但将所有人物渲染为简化的图形化形象，且面部模糊/无特征。将最终结果制作成 {argument name="aspect ratio" default="3:4"} 的垂直海报构图，要求边缘清晰、富有氛围感，适合作为极简主义旅行插画。

templates.title: Pombero Folklore Character Design Collection

titleLocalized.zh: Pombero 民间传说角色设定集

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="character name" default="Pombero"} (Alternative name:{argument name="alias" default="Shadow of the Monte"} Create a dark fantasy-style creature character design collection, presented in a professional concept design three-view format with a clean gray-white background. Canvas: 16:9 widescreen landscape format, museum-quality white paper texture, realistic high-detail digital painting, using soft earth tones, paired with exquisite ink-style labels, fine dividing lines, and meticulous production design layout. Subject: A short, muscular nocturnal forest spirit, inspired by Paraguayan rural folklore. He has rough, bark-like scarred skin, dirty bare feet, long, sharp fingers, a hunched, primitive posture, and a head blurred or obscured by shadows, hidden under a tattered straw hat. His clothing consists of layers of withered leaves, bark strips, vines, feathers, scraps of cloth, knots, shawls, tattered skirt-like wraps, ankle straps, and a round tobacco pouch at his waist. The atmosphere is tranquil, elusive, territorial, cunning, and wild, rather than heroic. Layout: A large, full-body hero figure is placed on the left, occupying about one-third of the canvas. He stands barefoot, one arm outstretched, the other hanging down, his body covered in tattered leaves and bark camouflage. A large title is added to the top left corner.{argument name="title text" default="POMBERO"} Below this is the subtitle "Alias: Shadow of the Monte". The upper center displays four labeled three-view poses: "NEUTRAL FRONT VIEW", "BACK VIEW", "SIDE PROFILE", and "SECONDARY ATTITUDE". The secondary pose should show him kneeling on one knee, holding a hand-rolled tobacco. Facial/Expression Study: Below the three-view rows are six square portrait study panels, labeled from left to right: "SLY MENACE", "EERIE CALM", "PREDATORY FOCUS", "CUNNING AMUSEMENT", "WATCHFUL SILENCE", and "WRATH". Each portrait is mostly hidden in the shadow of a straw hat, emphasizing a silent gaze rather than clearly defined human features. Detail Row: In the lower center are six close-up detail panels, labeled from left to right: "HAND & TOBACCO". ROLL (hands and cigarette), TOBACCO POUCH (tobacco pouch), SHOULDER WRAP DETAIL (shoulder wrap detail), WAIST DETAILS (waist detail), FOOT & ANKLE (feet and ankles), and SKIN & SCAR DETAIL (skin and scar detail). Showcases rough fingers gripping tobacco, a round leather pouch, wrapped leaves, knots, cracked and dirty feet, and bark-like, scarred skin texture. Right-side notes and props: On the right, add an "IDENTITY NOTES" text block containing the following readable content: Character: Night-walking forest spirit. Characteristics: Silent, cunning, territorial, primitive, elusive, and fearsome. Core themes: Paraguayan rural folklore, night, superstition, nature, fear, and awe. Signature features: Silent footsteps and a soul-piercing gaze. Below the secondary poses, add a "KEY PROP – RITUAL" text block. The section on "TOBACCO" (a key prop – ritual tobacco) displays a large bundle of hand-rolled tobacco bound with fibers, accompanied by withered leaves and an explanation that the hand-rolled tobacco is his offering, companion, and a symbol of his existence. The bottom right corner contains four black silhouette thumbnails titled "SILHOUETTE STUDY," showcasing different readable poses of the tattered straw-hatted creature. Seven vertical color blocks, titled "COLOR PALETTE," are labeled from left to right: "BARK GRAY," "MONTE GREEN," "TOBACCO BROWN," "EARTH UMBER," "DRY LEAF BEIGE," "NIGHT CHARCOAL," and "BLACK." Visual style: Ultra-high detail, cinematic-quality biological concept art, earth tones (brown, gray, green), realistic anatomical structures combined with folk monster designs, weathered textures, subtle shadows under each graphic, clear labels, thin black lines, and typography reminiscent of a studio character design project.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="Pombero"}（别名：{argument name="alias" default="Shadow of the Monte"}）创作一张暗黑奇幻风格的生物设计角色设定集，以专业的概念设计三视图形式呈现，背景为干净的灰白色。

画布：宽屏 16:9 横向展示页，博物馆级白色纸张纹理，写实的高细节数字绘画，采用柔和的大地色系，搭配精致的墨水风格标签、细分割线以及考究的制作设计排版。

主体：一个身材矮小、肌肉发达的夜行森林精灵，灵感源自巴拉圭乡村民间传说。他拥有粗糙如树皮般的伤痕皮肤、肮脏的赤脚、长而尖锐的手指、佝偻的原始姿态，以及隐藏在破旧草帽下模糊或被阴影遮蔽的头部。他的服装由层叠的枯叶、树皮条、藤蔓、羽毛、碎布、绳结、肩披、破烂的裙状裹布、脚踝绑带以及腰间的圆形烟草袋组成。氛围宁静、难以捉摸、具有领地意识、狡黠且野性，而非英雄主义。

排版：左侧放置一个大型全身英雄形象，占据约三分之一的画布，赤脚站立，一只手臂伸展，另一只手臂下垂，身上覆盖着破烂的叶片和树皮伪装。左上角添加大标题“{argument name="title text" default="POMBERO"}”，下方添加副标题“Alias: Shadow of the Monte”。上方中部展示 4 个带标签的三视图姿态：“NEUTRAL FRONT VIEW”（中性正面）、“BACK VIEW”（背面）、“SIDE PROFILE”（侧面轮廓）和“SECONDARY ATTITUDE”（次要姿态）。次要姿态应展示他单膝跪地，手持一支手卷烟草。

面部/表情研究：在三视图行下方，包含 6 个方形肖像研究面板，从左至右依次标注：“SLY MENACE”（狡黠威胁）、“EERIE CALM”（诡异平静）、“PREDATORY FOCUS”（捕食专注）、“CUNNING AMUSEMENT”（狡诈戏谑）、“WATCHFUL SILENCE”（警觉沉默）和“WRATH”（愤怒）。每张肖像大多隐藏在草帽的阴影中，强调沉默的凝视而非清晰的人类特征。

细节行：在下方中部，包含 6 个特写细节面板，从左至右依次标注：“HAND & TOBACCO ROLL”（手部与烟卷）、“TOBACCO POUCH”（烟草袋）、“SHOULDER WRAP DETAIL”（肩部裹布细节）、“WAIST DETAILS”（腰部细节）、“FOOT & ANKLE”（足部与脚踝）和“SKIN & SCAR DETAIL”（皮肤与伤痕细节）。展示抓握烟草的粗糙手指、圆形皮袋、缠绕的叶片裹布、绳结、开裂肮脏的双脚以及如树皮般伤痕累累的皮肤纹理。

右侧备注与道具：在右侧，添加一个“IDENTITY NOTES”（身份备注）文本块，包含以下可读内容：角色：夜行森林精灵。特征：沉默、狡黠、领地意识强、原始、难以捉摸、令人畏惧。核心主题：巴拉圭乡村民间传说、夜晚、迷信、自然、恐惧、敬畏。标志性特征：无声的脚步和刺穿灵魂的凝视。在次要姿态下方，添加 1 个名为“KEY PROP – RITUAL TOBACCO”（关键道具 – 仪式烟草）的部分，展示一捆用纤维捆绑的大型手卷烟草，旁边配有枯叶，并附有说明，解释手卷烟草是他的供品、伴侣以及他存在的标志。

右下角研究：包含 4 个黑色剪影缩略图，标题为“SILHOUETTE STUDY”（剪影研究），展示该破烂草帽生物的不同可读姿态。包含 7 个垂直色块，标题为“COLOR PALETTE”（调色板），从左至右标注：“BARK GRAY”（树皮灰）、“MONTE GREEN”（山林绿）、“TOBACCO BROWN”（烟草褐）、“EARTH UMBER”（大地赭）、“DRY LEAF BEIGE”（枯叶米）、“NIGHT CHARCOAL”（夜炭黑）和“BLACK”（纯黑）。

视觉风格：超高细节的电影级生物概念艺术，大地色系（棕、灰、绿），写实解剖结构与民间传说怪物设计相结合，风化纹理，每个图形下方有微妙的阴影，清晰的标签，细黑线，排版如同工作室的角色设计项目。

templates.title: Axiom Cat's Eye Fashion Cover

titleLocalized.zh: Axiom 猫眼时尚封面

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a vertical, avant-garde fashion magazine cover, with {argument name="character name" default="A mysterious cat-themed intelligent female protagonist"} Centered around a minimalist high-fashion editor portrait, the energy of retro Japanese anime posters, and the main visual design of an independent art project. Canvas: Vertical magazine cover, 4:5 aspect ratio, full bleed. Deep cyan-blue sky background with warm orange clouds at the lower left and right edges. Employing strong cyan-orange tones, dramatic rim lighting, hard graphic shadows, and a retro print poster texture. Subject: An anime-style female character, using an extremely low-angle perspective to make her appear grand and as if she's about to leap out of the page. She strikes a tense, chic JoJo-like pose, one hand in her pocket, torso slightly leaning back, shoulders tilted, head looking down at the viewer. Her face is deliberately obscured by soft rectangular blurs or shadow blocks, maintaining an air of mystery. She has a short black bob with orange rim highlights, wears earrings, and exudes a calm, intelligent, and slightly dangerous aura. Clothing and Symbolism: Includes 5 core clothing items: a beige oversized trench coat with an exaggerated lapel, a black fitted top, high-waisted beige trousers, a black belt with a rectangular buckle, and a pair of small dark earrings. Add a signature accessory system: a cat-eye bracelet on the wrist, designed as a visually recognizable symbol of the character rather than simple jewelry. The bracelet should have two clearly visible pendants: an orange cat-eye amulet pendant and a small dark spherical pendant connected by a gold chain. Cover Typography: A large, elegant serif masthead spans the top, with text {argument name="magazine title" default="AXIOM"} The color is a warm orange, partially positioned behind the character's head and hair. The layout is sparse, refined, and has a fashion magazine feel, with ample negative space. The character should overlap with the masthead to reinforce the cover's logic. Visible text content: The cover contains 8 sets of text: 1) Micro text in the upper left corner: "Aesthetics・Rebellion・Future"; 2) Micro text in the upper right corner: "VOL.09 / AUTUMN 2025"; 3) Giant masthead: "AXIOM"; 4) Large Japanese text in the center left: "Cat"; 5) Small English/Japanese text in the center left: "WIT. INSTINCT. REVOLUTION." and "本能は、真実を見抜く."; 6) Small English/Japanese text in the center right: "INTELLIGENCE IS THE ULTIMATE WEAPON." and "知性こそ、最強の武器."; 7) Issue number block in the lower left corner: "THE CLEVER ISSUE" and "妙案は、静かに仕掛ける."; 8) Large issue number and explanation in the lower right corner:{argument name="issue number" default="09"} Includes "SHADOW GAME" and "BRIGHT MIND". Visual Style: Vintage Japanese anime-style character design, fashion editor's cover composition, cinematic low-angle lighting, sharp ink-line outlines, painterly cel folds, warm orange highlights, deep cyan shadows, elegant serif fonts, minimalist luxury magazine spacing, and retro poster graininess. Constraints: Use only one central character, only one cat's-eye bracelet, only two bracelet charms, and only eight sets of visible text. Do not add extra cover lines, logos, barcodes, watermarks, or other characters. Maintain the image's fashion sense and symbolism, avoiding excessive detail or realism.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张竖版先锋时尚杂志封面，以 {argument name="character name" default="一位神秘的猫主题智能女主角"} 为核心主体，融合极简主义高级时装编辑人像、复古日本动漫海报能量以及独立艺术项目主视觉设计。

画布：竖版杂志封面，4:5 比例，全出血设计。深青蓝色天空背景，左下角和右下角边缘带有温暖的橙色云彩。采用强烈的青橙色调、戏剧性的轮廓光、硬朗的图形阴影以及复古印刷海报质感。

主体：一位动漫风格女性角色，采用极端的低角度透视，使其显得宏大并仿佛要从页面中冲出。她摆出紧张、时髦的 JoJo 式时尚姿势，一只手插在裤兜里，躯干微微后倾，双肩倾斜，头部向下俯视观众。她的面部被柔和的矩形模糊或阴影块刻意遮挡，保持身份的神秘感。她留着黑色短波波头，带有橙色轮廓高光，佩戴着耳环，散发出冷静、睿智且略带危险的气息。

服装与符号：包含 5 件核心服装单品：一件带有夸张翻领的米色超大款风衣、一件黑色修身上衣、高腰米色长裤、一条带有矩形扣的黑色腰带，以及一对小型深色耳环。添加 1 套标志性配饰系统：手腕上佩戴猫眼手链，将其设计为角色的识别视觉符号，而非简单的珠宝。手链应有 2 个清晰可见的垂坠挂件：一个橙色猫眼护身符挂件和一个小型深色球形挂件，由金链连接。

封面排版：在顶部横跨一行巨大的优雅衬线字体刊头，文字为 {argument name="magazine title" default="AXIOM"}，颜色为暖橙色，部分位于角色头部和头发后方。排版保持稀疏、精致且具有时尚杂志感，留出充足的负空间。角色应与刊头重叠，以强化封面逻辑。

可见文字内容：封面上包含 8 组文字：1) 左上角微型文字：“美学・反逆・未来”；2) 右上角微型文字：“VOL.09 / AUTUMN 2025”；3) 巨型刊头：“AXIOM”；4) 左侧中部大型日文：“猫”；5) 左侧中部小型英/日文行：“WIT. INSTINCT. REVOLUTION.” 和 “本能は、真実を見抜く。”；6) 右侧中部小型英/日文行：“INTELLIGENCE IS THE ULTIMATE WEAPON.” 和 “知性こそ、最強の武器。”；7) 左下角刊号块：“THE CLEVER ISSUE” 和 “妙案は、静かに仕掛ける。”；8) 右下角大型刊号及说明：{argument name="issue number" default="09"}，附带 “SHADOW GAME” 和 “BRIGHT MIND”。

视觉风格：日本老式动漫风格角色设计、时尚编辑封面构图、电影级低角度光效、锐利的墨线轮廓、绘画感赛璐珞褶皱、暖橙色高光、深青色阴影、优雅的衬线字体、简洁的奢侈杂志间距、复古海报颗粒感。

约束：仅使用一个中心角色，仅使用一条猫眼手链，仅使用两个手链挂件，且仅包含八组可见文字。不要添加额外的封面行、Logo、条形码、水印或其他角色。保持图像的时尚感和象征意义，避免过度细节化或写实。

templates.title: Horror Ghost character design illustrations

titleLocalized.zh: 恐怖幽灵角色设定图

templates.prompt: Objective: For the name{argument name="character name" default="unnamed wraith"} Concept art for a female ghostly creature, designed specifically for film or game production. Canvas: Wide horizontal three-view drawing of the character (including close-ups), using a gray-white studio background, realistic dark fantasy concept art, high-detail texture study, even lighting with soft shadows, no environmental background. Layout: Showing four labeled views from left to right: 1) Front full-body view, 2) Side full-body silhouette view, 3) Back full-body view, 4) Close-up portrait view occupying one-third of the right side of the canvas. Small uppercase serif labels above each view: "FRONT", "SIDE", "BACK", and "CLOSE-UP". Main details: The character is a tall, emaciated, corpse-like female ghost with extremely long, messy hair.{argument name="hair color" default="wet black hair"} Her hair fell past her chest and down her back. Her skin was gray, lifeless, and dirty, with thin, dark hands and bare feet. She wore a tattered garment that reached the ground.{argument name="garment color" default="ash-gray"} The shroud, made of rotting gauze, torn lace, and tattered strips of cloth, is riddled with holes, worn edges, hanging fibers, dirt, stains, and smoky threads. The silhouette should convey a fragile, decaying, damp, and supernatural texture. Face Treatment: In each visible view, the face is obscured by a solid, dark rectangle, creating an anonymous and unsettling visual effect. Close-up views should showcase the head, hair, neck, and shoulders in extremely high detail, with the face covered by a large, dark rectangle. Visual Style: Photorealistic cinematic creature design, a monochrome gray-black palette, high-resolution depiction of decaying fabrics, damp hair, delicate scratch lines, and a subtle mistiness at the edges of the tattered robe, presenting an eerie yet clean art-house style. Constraints: Must contain 4 views and 4 labels. Keep the background blank and neutral. Do not add any additional props, weapons, scenes, logos, watermarks, or any other text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为名为 {argument name="character name" default="unnamed wraith"} 的女性幽灵生物创建恐怖角色概念设定图，专为电影或游戏制作设计。

画布：宽幅横向角色三视图（含特写），采用灰白色摄影棚背景，写实黑暗奇幻概念艺术，高细节纹理研究，光照均匀，带有柔和阴影，无环境背景。

布局：从左至右展示 4 个带标签的视图：1) 正面全身视图，2) 侧面全身侧影视图，3) 背面全身视图，4) 占据画布右侧三分之一的特写肖像视图。在每个视图上方放置小型大写衬线字体标签：“FRONT”、“SIDE”、“BACK” 和 “CLOSE-UP”。

主体细节：该角色是一个高大、消瘦、如尸体般的女性幽灵，留着极长的凌乱 {argument name="hair color" default="wet black hair"}，头发垂过胸部并延伸至背部。她的皮肤呈灰色，死气沉沉且肮脏，有着纤细发黑的手和赤脚。她穿着一件及地的破烂 {argument name="garment color" default="ash-gray"} 寿衣，由腐烂的纱布、撕裂的蕾丝和褴褛的布条制成，布满孔洞、磨损的边缘、悬垂的纤维、污垢、污渍和烟雾状的丝缕。轮廓应呈现出脆弱、腐朽、潮湿和超自然的质感。

面部处理：在每个可见视图中，用一个纯色深色矩形遮挡块遮住面部，营造出一种匿名且令人不安的视觉效果。特写视图应以极高的细节展示头部、头发、颈部和肩部，并用一个大的深色矩形覆盖面部。

视觉风格：照片级写实电影生物设计图，单色灰黑调色板，高分辨率织物腐朽感，湿润的发丝，细腻的划痕线条，破烂长袍边缘带有微妙的雾气，呈现出诡异但整洁的制作艺术风格。

约束条件：必须包含 4 个视图和 4 个标签。保持背景空白且中性。不要添加额外的道具、武器、场景、标志、水印或任何其他文字。

templates.title: Mythic Yerba Mate Product Photography

titleLocalized.zh: Mythic Yerba Mate 产品拍摄

templates.prompt: for{argument name="brand name" default="MyThos"} Create a cinematic, high-end product ad image for a luxurious yerba mate packaging design inspired by Paraguayan forest legends. Scene: A dark, rustic wooden tabletop against a smoky, warm brown studio backdrop, with dramatic, low-key lighting, soft shadows, amber highlights, and hyper-realistic commercial photography. Seven visible product objects are precisely arranged from left to right: a front-facing matte black yerba mate bag, a side-facing black bag (showing side branding), a back-facing black bag (showing nutrition facts and barcode), a three-quarter-angle black bag (showing the front and right side), and on the far right, a green Stanley-style insulated mug with a stainless steel lid. In front of the mug is a dark, worn yerba mate gourd filled with loose yerba mate, and a curved metal straw (bombilla) extending from the gourd. Packaging Details: All packaging bags are glossy, pleated black kraft paper bags featuring gold foil lettering, an ornate botanical border, a small tree logo at the top, a delicate forest leaf pattern at the bottom, and artwork of the mythical guardian character. The main packaging bag should prominently display "..." in large, elegant serif gold lettering on the front.{argument name="product name" default="MyThos"} The sign was accompanied by the Spanish words "YERBA MATE," "ELABORADA CON PALO," and a slogan.{argument name="slogan" default="LEYENDAS QUE VIVEN"} The front artwork depicts two legendary forest guardians: a Pombero-like character covered in straw and a Pora-like character with long, pale hair, against a dark jungle backdrop. Near the bottom is a circular gold stamp and the labels "POMBERO & PÓRA" and "GUARDIANES DEL MONTE". The back of the packaging features a centered nutrition information panel, three circular statement icons above, paragraph text, a barcode at the bottom, and a gold decorative border. The side of the packaging includes vertically arranged brand information, a small tree icon, brief Spanish descriptions, and "POMBERO & PÓRA" at the bottom. Color palette: black, deep forest green, aged bronze, antique gold, warm brown wood, and soft cream text. Style: ultra-detailed, photorealistic, high-end beverage packaging mockup, clear product focus, shallow depth of field, no human figures, no hands, no extra props, no watermark. Used in the lower left corner of the front.{argument name="package weight" default="1kg"} And set the thermos label to{argument name="thermos label" default="STANLEY SINCE 1913"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 为 {argument name="brand name" default="MyThos"} 创建一张电影级高端产品广告图，这是一款受巴拉圭森林传说启发的奢华马黛茶包装设计。场景：深色质朴木质桌面，背景为烟雾缭绕的暖棕色摄影棚背景，戏剧性的低调照明，柔和阴影，琥珀色高光，超写实商业摄影。从左到右精确排列 7 个可见产品对象：1 个正面朝向的黑色哑光马黛茶包装袋，1 个侧面朝向的黑色包装袋（展示侧面品牌信息），1 个背面朝向的黑色包装袋（展示营养成分表和条形码），1 个四分之三角度的黑色包装袋（展示正面和右侧），最右侧放置 1 个带不锈钢盖的绿色 Stanley 风格高保温杯，保温杯前方放置 1 个装满散装马黛茶的深色磨损马黛茶葫芦，以及 1 根从葫芦中伸出的弯曲金属吸管（bombilla）。包装细节：所有包装袋均为带有烫金字体、华丽植物边框、顶部小树徽标、底部细微森林叶片图案以及神话守护者角色艺术的亮面褶皱黑色牛皮纸袋。主包装袋正面应以醒目的大号优雅衬线金字突出显示 "{argument name="product name" default="MyThos"}"，并配有西班牙语文字 "YERBA MATE"、"ELABORADA CON PALO" 以及标语 "{argument name="slogan" default="LEYENDAS QUE VIVEN"}"。正面艺术图展示了 2 位传奇森林守护者形象，一位是覆盖着稻草的 Pombero 类角色，另一位是长发苍白的 Pora 类角色，背景为黑暗丛林场景；底部附近包含一个圆形金印，以及标签 "POMBERO & PÓRA" 和 "GUARDIANES DEL MONTE"。背面包装袋包含一个居中的营养信息面板、上方 3 个圆形声明图标、段落文字、底部的条形码以及金色装饰边框。侧面包装袋包含垂直布局的品牌信息、一个小树图标、简短的西班牙语描述文案以及底部的 "POMBERO & PÓRA"。调色板：黑色、深森林绿、陈年青铜色、古金色、暖棕色木材、柔和的奶油色文字。风格：超细节、照片级真实感、高端饮料包装样机、产品焦点清晰、浅景深、无人像、无手部、无额外道具、无水印。在正面左下角使用 {argument name="package weight" default="1kg"}，并将保温杯标签设置为 {argument name="thermos label" default="STANLEY SINCE 1913"}。

templates.title: Folk art window views full of whimsy

titleLocalized.zh: 充满奇趣的民间艺术窗景

templates.prompt: Create a whimsical, hand-drawn folk art illustration, showcasing the textures of crayon, marker, and gouache. Depict an interior wall scene, full of decorative floral graffiti and bright, handcrafted charm. In the foreground, place an adult female speaker whose face is {argument name="face style" default="A simple, featureless brown square covering the face"} She has dark, center-parted hair, wears a black coat and a bright red dress with a round neck, black buttons, and drawstring details; she stands on the right side of the canvas, her left arm outstretched towards a large window display area. On the left, a large cream-colored double window is painted, with two tall panes and black hinges, decorated with tiny hearts, polka dots, and blue leaf-shaped borders. Behind the left window, the only seated trumpeter is shown: wearing blue trousers and a dark coat, with gray curly hair, rosy cheeks, holding a yellow trumpet, surrounded by floating black musical notes; behind him, a pink background includes foliage, white polka dots, yellow starbursts, and a handwritten, vertically dated note that reads {argument name="window note" default="Feb / 13"} On the far right, depict a second window with a gold frame, cyan curtains, light lace trim, and a green garden landscape filled with flowers and vines. Between the woman and the left window, add a small wall poster with the words:{argument name="poster text" default="ACQUA PER LA VITA – WATER FOR LIFE"} The image must include exactly two windows, a speaker, a trumpeter, a poster, and two visible black musical notes. It is surrounded by playful decorative motifs: red hearts, blue foliage, pink and red flowers, yellow starbursts, green vines, colorful polka dots, and tiny white speckled textures. Use a creamy white background, naive proportions, rough black sketch outlines, and visible paper texture to create a cheerful Italian folk art atmosphere. Avoid realism, shading, or digital sophistication; make it appear handmade and slightly imperfect.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅充满奇趣的手绘民间艺术插画，呈现蜡笔、马克笔和水粉画的质感。描绘一个室内墙面场景，充满装饰性的花卉涂鸦和明亮的手工魅力。在前景中，放置一位成年女性演讲者，其面部为 {argument name="face style" default="一个覆盖面部的简洁无特征棕色正方形"}，留着深色中分发型，身穿黑色外套和一件鲜红色的连衣裙，配有圆领、黑色纽扣和抽绳细节；她站在画布右侧，左臂向一扇大型窗户展示区伸展。在左侧，绘制一扇大型奶油色双开窗，带有两块高大的窗板和黑色铰链，装饰着微小的爱心、圆点和蓝色叶状边框。在左侧窗户后方，展示唯一一位坐着的小号手：穿着蓝色裤子、深色外套，留着灰色卷发，脸颊红润，手持黄色小号，周围漂浮着黑色音符；他身后的粉色背景中包含叶枝、白色圆点、黄色星芒，以及一张手写的垂直日期状便签，写着 {argument name="window note" default="Feb / 13"}。在最右侧，绘制第二扇窗户，带有金黄色边框、青色窗帘、浅色蕾丝饰边，以及充满花朵和藤蔓的绿色花园景观。在女性和左侧窗户之间，加入一张小型墙面海报，上面写着 {argument name="poster text" default="ACQUA PER LA VITA – WATER FOR LIFE"}，并配有蓝色波浪线。画面中必须包含且仅包含两扇窗户、一位演讲者、一位小号手、一张海报和两个可见的黑色音符。周围环绕着俏皮的装饰图案：红色爱心、蓝色叶枝、粉色和红色花朵、黄色星芒、绿色藤蔓、彩色圆点以及细小的白色斑点纹理。使用米白色背景、稚拙的比例、粗犷的黑色素描轮廓、可见的纸张纹理，营造出欢快的意大利民间艺术氛围。避免写实主义、阴影或数字化的精致感；使其看起来像是手工制作且略带瑕疵。

templates.title: Organic modern interior design collage

titleLocalized.zh: 有机现代室内设计拼贴图

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a series of warm, minimalist interior design collages showcasing clean design, flowing lines, natural textures, and functional elegance, creating a tranquil, organic luxury atmosphere. Canvas: A 4:3 landscape image divided into four equal-sized rectangular panels in a 2x2 grid by thin white borders. Soft, natural daylight is used, employing beige stucco walls, warm wood tones, cream-colored soft furnishings, woven rugs, and olive greenery, presenting a serene magazine photography style. Visual Style: Realistic high-end interior photography, neutral earth tones, influenced by Japandi and organic modern styles, featuring rounded shapes, textured materials, matte finishes, subtle shadows, no people, no visible branding, and no text. Panel 1 (Top Left, Living Room): Showcases a comfortable living room with a curved cream-colored fleece sofa, a low round wooden coffee table, a large potted olive tree on the left, a beige abstract art painting hanging centrally above the sofa, an arched brass floor lamp with a woven lampshade on the right, a small ceramic vase with greenery on the coffee table, a shallow wooden bowl on a stack of books, and a natural woven rug. An arched doorway is located to the right rear, behind which a partially obscured shelf is visible. Panel 2 (Top Right, Kitchen): Showcases a sophisticated kitchen with a light-colored stone island with vertical flute-patterned wood veneer, three wooden bar stools, two dome pendant lights hanging above, a tall window or glass door on the left offering views of greenery, a white vase with branches on the island, a bowl of green fruit, a black faucet and stove, and a thin floating shelf on the back wall displaying minimalist ceramics and a small framed landscape painting. Panel 3 (bottom left, bedroom): Showcases a tranquil bedroom with a low wooden bed frame, cream-colored bedding, four visible pillows, an olive green blanket draped at the foot of the bed, a wooden bedside table on the left, a round beige table lamp, a delicate botanical artwork above the bed, a small vase with green leaves by the window, a large floor-to-ceiling window on the right, and a woven rug under the bed. Panel 4 (bottom right, bathroom): Showcases a spa-style bathroom with a freestanding oval cream-colored stone bathtub, a white towel draped over the rim, minimalist jars, bowls, and plants in a recessed wall-mounted niche with lighting, a black wall-mounted faucet with two knobs, a small round wooden table with ceramic pieces, a large potted olive tree by the window on the right, and a round woven rug in the foreground. Custom Orientation: Maintain the overall aesthetic.{argument name="design style" default="Warm, organic, modern Japan minimalism"} ,use{argument name="main color palette" default="Cream, beige, warm oak, olive green, and soft taupe"} Set the lighting to{argument name="lighting mood" default="Soft natural morning light"} The focus of materials remains on{argument name="material focus" default="Lambswool, stucco, oak, stone, linen, ceramics and woven fibers"} and to create a spatial atmosphere{argument name="emotional tone" default="Tranquil, warm, elegant and understatedly luxurious"} Constraints: Strictly use 4 panels and adhere to the specified number of objects; keep the composition simple and clean; avoid saturated colors and strong contrasts; and do not include people, pets, logos, titles, or unnecessary decorative items in the image.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一组温暖的极简主义室内设计拼贴图，展现简洁的设计、流畅的线条、自然的纹理和功能性的优雅，营造宁静的有机奢华氛围。

画布：一张 4:3 的横向图像，被细白边框分割为 2x2 网格的 4 个等大矩形面板。采用柔和的自然日光，使用米色灰泥墙面、暖色木材、奶油色软装、编织地毯、橄榄绿植，并呈现宁静的杂志摄影风格。

视觉风格：写实的高端室内摄影，中性大地色调，受 Japandi 和有机现代风格影响，圆润的造型、富有质感的材料、哑光饰面、微妙的阴影，画面中无人，无可见品牌标识，无文字。

面板 1（左上，客厅）：展示一个舒适的客厅，包含 1 张弧形奶油色羊羔绒沙发、1 张圆形低矮木质咖啡桌、左侧 1 棵大型盆栽橄榄树、沙发上方居中挂有 1 幅米色抽象艺术画、右侧 1 盏带编织灯罩的拱形黄铜落地灯、咖啡桌上 1 个插有绿植的小陶瓷花瓶、一叠书上放着 1 个浅木碗，以及 1 张天然编织地毯。右后方设有一个拱形门洞，门后可见模糊的搁架。

面板 2（右上，厨房）：展示一个精致的厨房，包含 1 个带有垂直长笛纹木饰面的浅色石材岛台、3 张木质吧台椅、上方悬挂 2 盏圆顶吊灯、左侧 1 扇高大的窗户或玻璃门，可见窗外绿植、岛台上 1 个插有树枝的白色花瓶、1 碗绿色水果、1 个黑色水龙头和灶台，后墙设有一块纤薄的悬浮搁板，摆放着极简陶瓷和 1 幅小型风景画框。

面板 3（左下，卧室）：展示一个宁静的卧室，包含 1 张低矮木质床架、奶油色寝具、4 个可见的枕头、床尾搭着 1 条橄榄绿毯子、左侧 1 个木质床头柜、1 盏圆润的米色台灯、床上方 1 幅精致的植物艺术画、窗边 1 个插有绿叶茎的小花瓶、右侧 1 扇落地大窗，以及床下 1 张编织地毯。

面板 4（右下，浴室）：展示一个水疗风格的浴室，包含 1 个独立式椭圆形奶油色石材浴缸、浴缸边缘搭着 1 条白毛巾、墙面嵌入式照明壁龛内摆放着极简瓶罐、碗和植物、1 个带两个旋钮的壁挂式黑色水龙头、1 张放有陶瓷的小圆木桌、右侧窗边 1 棵大型盆栽橄榄树，以及前景 1 张圆形编织地毯。

自定义方向：保持整体美学为 {argument name="design style" default="温暖的有机现代 Japandi 极简主义"}，使用 {argument name="main color palette" default="奶油色、米色、暖橡木色、橄榄绿和柔和的灰褐色"}，将光照设置为 {argument name="lighting mood" default="柔和的自然晨光"}，材料重点保持为 {argument name="material focus" default="羊羔绒、灰泥、橡木、石材、亚麻、陶瓷和编织纤维"}，并使空间氛围呈现 {argument name="emotional tone" default="宁静、温暖、优雅且低调奢华"}。

约束条件：严格使用 4 个面板并遵循指定的物体数量，保持构图简洁整洁，避免使用饱和色，避免强烈的对比，画面中不得出现人物、宠物、Logo、标题及多余的装饰杂物。

templates.title: Street style photos of events on rainy nights

titleLocalized.zh: 雨夜活动街拍时尚

templates.prompt: Create a panoramic snapshot of nighttime street activity, featuring a stylish person.{argument name="character description" default="Young East Asian women"} She is walking past a registration or security checkpoint outside a modern glass building. She is shown in profile, her body leaning to the right, her head turned back to look at the camera, her expression slightly surprised yet natural. She has long, dark hair, loosely tied in a low ponytail, with a few stray strands framing her face; her makeup is natural, and she has a slender figure. Clothing: Fitted.{argument name="outfit color" default="White"} A suit jacket paired with a matching pencil skirt, light-colored sheer tights, and shiny white pointed-toe stilettos; a small shoulder bag with a chain strap is faintly visible from the side. Environment: A rainy night in the city, a wet, reflective cobblestone street, metal crowd control barriers, a black registration table on the right, staff in dark clothing and blue lanyards processing wristbands, and a blue screen/signage displaying an AI company logo and text in the background.{argument name="screen text" default="AnionAI"} The background includes a crowd waiting in dim lighting, blurred city lights and signs, a strong on-camera flash effect on the woman, a high ISO documentary style, vertical composition (similar to smartphone shooting), 2:3 aspect ratio, a slightly casual candid composition, realistic skin texture, lifelike clothing wrinkles, no beauty filters or retouching, no studio lighting, and not an illustration style.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张夜间街头活动的全景抓拍照片，主角是一位时尚的 {argument name="character description" default="年轻东亚女性"}，她正走过现代玻璃建筑外的一个注册或安检台。她以侧面形象出镜，身体向右移动，头部回头看向镜头，表情略带惊讶且自然。她留着深色长发，松散地扎成低马尾，脸颊旁有几缕碎发，妆容自然，身形苗条。服装：修身的 {argument name="outfit color" default="白色"} 西装外套，搭配同色系铅笔短裙，穿着浅色透明连裤袜，脚踩亮面白色尖头细高跟鞋；侧身隐约可见一个带有链条肩带的小巧单肩包。环境：雨夜城市，湿润且带有倒影的石板路，金属人群隔离栏，右侧摆放着一张黑色签到处桌子，身穿深色服装并佩戴蓝色挂绳的工作人员正在处理腕带，背景中的蓝色屏幕/标牌显示着 AI 公司风格的 Logo 以及文字 {argument name="screen text" default="AnionAI"}。背景中加入在昏暗灯光下等待的人群，模糊的城市灯光和标识，女性身上有强烈的机顶闪光灯效果，高 ISO 纪实风格，竖构图（类似智能手机拍摄），2:3 纵横比，略显随意的抓拍构图，真实的皮肤纹理，逼真的衣物褶皱，无美颜修图，无影棚灯光，非插画风格。

templates.title: Thumbnail of a selfie taken on a sleeper train at night

titleLocalized.zh: 夜间卧铺火车自拍缩略图

templates.prompt: Create a 16:9 YouTube thumbnail-style photorealistic wide-angle selfie, set in a sleeper train car at night. In the foreground on the right, show a young man with {argument name="hair color" default="Light golden brown"} With disheveled hair, wearing a plain black T-shirt and a black smartwatch, his hand rests on his head, conveying an anxious or surprised posture; his face is obscured by a large, opaque vertical rectangle in a warm, medium brown, covering the entire facial area from forehead to chin. The left half of the image shows the open porch and windows of a compact sleeper car, complete with beige wood paneling, metal door frames, bright white interior lighting, red/orange bedding or blankets, white pillows, and small travel essentials on the berths. Further to the left of the train, on parallel tracks, a red ÖBB passenger train speeds by with a motion blur effect, its windows illuminated, clearly showing the white "ÖBB" logo against a dark mountain background and a bright full moon hanging in a deep blue night sky. The dramatic ultra-wide-angle perspective creates a strong contrast between the warm light of the carriage and the cool tones of the exterior, with realistic lens distortion, clear details in the interior and on the figures, and motion blur applied only to the passing train and tracks. No text overlays or watermarks are added to the image.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 16:9 的 YouTube 缩略图风格照片级写实广角自拍，场景设定在夜间的卧铺火车车厢内。在右侧前景中，展示一名年轻男性，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="浅金棕色"} 的凌乱头发，身穿纯黑色 T 恤，佩戴一只黑色智能手表，手放在头顶，呈现出焦虑或惊讶的姿势；他的脸部被一个巨大的不透明垂直矩形遮挡，矩形呈温暖的中棕色，覆盖了从额头到下巴的整个面部区域。图像左半部分展示了一个紧凑型卧铺车厢的开放式门廊和窗户，配有米色木镶板、金属门框、明亮的白色室内照明、红色/橙色床铺或毯子、白色枕头以及铺位上的小型旅行用品。在火车左侧远处的平行轨道上，展示一列正在疾驰的红色 ÖBB 客运列车，带有动态模糊效果，车厢窗户发出亮光，清晰可见白色的“ÖBB”标志，背景为深色山脉，深蓝色夜空中挂着一轮明亮的满月。采用戏剧性的超广角透视，形成车厢暖光与室外冷色调的强烈对比，具有真实的镜头畸变，室内和人物细节清晰，仅在经过的列车和轨道上使用动态模糊，画面中不添加任何文字叠加，无水印。

templates.title: Nighttime Street Fashion Selfies

titleLocalized.zh: 夜间街头时尚自拍

templates.prompt: Create a realistic nighttime selfie featuring an adult woman leaning against a red brick wall on a city sidewalk in autumn. She has long, wavy black hair, fair skin, and a slender figure. Her face is deliberately obscured by a dark brown, opaque square privacy mask in the center. She wears a dark charcoal gray ribbed sleeveless cropped top paired with high-waisted black denim shorts, and carries a shiny black shoulder bag. Position her at a slightly tilted angle, one arm outstretched as if taking a selfie, the other hand near her shorts pocket. The frame should crop from above her head to mid-thigh. The background showcases a nighttime city street with tall trees, yellow leaves scattered on the sidewalk, warm streetlights, blurred car headlights, and distant, shallowly focused city lights. Use realistic phone flash lighting, natural shadows, and detailed brick textures to create a candid street style atmosphere. Use a 2:3 vertical composition, no text, and no watermark. The top color can be customized.{argument name="top color" default="dark charcoal"} Hairstyle is{argument name="hair style" default="long wavy black hair"} The scene is{argument name="street setting" default="autumn nighttime city sidewalk"} and the privacy occlusion block color is{argument name="face block color" default="dark brown skin-tone"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张逼真的夜间手机自拍照片，画面中一位成年女性靠在城市人行道的红砖墙上，正值秋季。她留着黑色长波浪卷发，肤色中等偏白，身材苗条，面部被一个位于正中央的深棕色不透明方形隐私遮挡块刻意遮盖。她身穿深炭灰色罗纹无袖短款背心，搭配黑色高腰牛仔短裤，单肩背着一个亮面黑色单肩包。让她以略微倾斜的角度站立，一只手臂伸向镜头，仿佛正在自拍，另一只手放在短裤口袋附近，画面截取范围从头部上方到大腿中部。背景展现了夜间的城市街道，有高大的树木、人行道上散落的黄色落叶、温暖的路灯、模糊的车前灯以及远处景深较浅的城市灯光。使用逼真的手机闪光灯照明、自然的阴影、细腻的砖块纹理，营造出抓拍的街头时尚氛围，采用 2:3 竖版构图，无文字，无水印。可自定义上衣颜色为 {argument name="top color" default="dark charcoal"}，发型为 {argument name="hair style" default="long wavy black hair"}，场景为 {argument name="street setting" default="autumn nighttime city sidewalk"}，以及隐私遮挡块颜色为 {argument name="face block color" default="dark brown skin-tone"}。

templates.title: Fashionable portraits on glass in the rain

titleLocalized.zh: 雨中玻璃时尚人像

templates.prompt: Create an emotionally resonant, artistic portrait of an adult woman viewed through rain-streaked glass against a soft gray concrete wall, evoking an atmosphere enveloped by rain, glass, and the passage of time. The subject possesses {argument name="hair color" default="Moist black hair"} Her hair hung loosely over her face and shoulders, and she sat in a centered position, her shoulders bare, wearing {argument name="top color" default="black"} A deep V-neck tank top, loose white trousers, and an oversized top that slipped off her shoulders and bunched up on her arms.{argument name="shirt color" default="White"} A shirt. Her face is deliberately obscured by soft, rectangular blurs/masks, while her body and clothing remain clearly visible. The image employs a realistic fashion photography style with a vertical composition, low-saturation monochromatic tones, cool grays and whites, soft diffused sunlight on the left, and high contrast between her wet, dark hair and light-colored walls. Translucent water droplets and ripples flow on the glass in front of the lens, creating delicate reflections, a hazy atmosphere, refined skin highlights, and a quiet, melancholic mood—like a photograph gradually becoming a memory. The image uses a 4:5 portrait composition, with the subject centered, the frame extending from the thighs to the head, a minimalist background, no text, no watermark, and no other figures.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张充满情绪感的艺术时尚人像，拍摄一位隔着雨痕玻璃的成年女性，背景为柔和的灰色混凝土墙，营造出被雨水、玻璃和时间包围的氛围。主体拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="湿润的黑色长发"}，凌乱地垂在脸庞和肩头，采用居中坐姿，裸露双肩，穿着 {argument name="top color" default="黑色"} 深 V 吊带衫、宽松的白色长裤，以及一件从双肩滑落并堆叠在手臂上的超大号 {argument name="shirt color" default="白色"} 衬衫。她的面部被柔和的矩形模糊/遮挡块刻意遮盖，而身体和服装保持清晰可见。采用写实的时尚摄影风格进行竖构图，低饱和度的单色调，冷灰色和白色调，左侧柔和的漫射日光，湿润深色头发与浅色墙壁形成高对比度，镜头前的玻璃上流淌着半透明的水迹和水滴，带有细腻的反光，朦胧的氛围，精致的皮肤高光，安静忧郁的情绪，仿佛一张正在逐渐变成记忆的照片。使用 4:5 的人像构图，主体居中，取景范围从大腿到头部，极简背景，无文字，无水印，无其他人物。

templates.title: Cyber ​​women in cryogenic chambers

titleLocalized.zh: 冷冻舱中的赛博女性

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic, vertical-screen sci-fi scene, with the protagonist being {argument name="character name" default="LATVIA-01"} A female humanoid bio-engineered android floats in a transparent cylindrical cryogenic chamber filled with a luminous, aquamarine liquid. She floats in a fetal-like position, legs bent, one hand pressed against the glass, the other arm crossed over her chest, her long, pale blonde hair bobbing weightlessly in the liquid. Her body is mostly humanoid, but partially exhibits biomechanical features: visible synthetic muscles, exposed cybernetic shoulder joints, a metallic chest structure, cables, and translucent skin details; the anatomy is elegant, without any explicit details. The chamber is covered in condensation, bubbles, scratches, and refracted light, its top and bottom sealed by heavy black metal rings connected to hoses and connectors. Bright cyan energy bands swirl and rise around her body within the chamber, projecting blue-green highlights. The chamber is placed in a dark, futuristic laboratory: mechanical arms on both sides, suspended cables, control consoles, and glowing displays; a holographic status screen on the left displays…{argument name="status label" default="LATVIA-01 // BIO SYNTHESIS // STATUS: ACTIVE"} The image employs a high-contrast cyberpunk color palette of black, steel gray, turquoise, and cyan; ultra-refined realistic digital art with dramatic rim lighting, volumetric lighting, water caustics, cinematic depth of field, and sharp focus on the glass capsule, using a 9:16 portrait composition. The subject's face should be hidden or blurred by neutral rectangular occlusions while maintaining high detail in the rest of the image. Avoid gore, extra characters, logos, or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个电影级的竖屏科幻场景，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="LATVIA-01"}，一位女性人形生物合成仿生人，悬浮在装满发光水蓝色液体的透明圆柱形冷冻舱中。她以类似胎儿的姿势蜷缩漂浮，双腿弯曲，一只手贴在玻璃上，另一只手臂交叉在胸前，苍白的长金发在液体中无重力飘动。她的身体大部分是人类形态，但部分呈现生物机械特征：可见的合成肌肉、裸露的赛博肩关节、金属胸部结构、线缆以及半透明的皮肤细节，解剖结构优雅，无任何露骨内容。舱体覆盖着冷凝水、气泡、划痕和折射光，顶部和底部由厚重的黑色金属环密封，并连接着软管和接头。明亮的青色能量带在舱内围绕她的身体盘旋上升，投射出蓝绿色的高光。将舱体置于黑暗的未来主义实验室中：两侧配有机械臂、悬挂的线缆、控制台、发光的显示器，左侧设有一个全息状态屏幕，显示“{argument name="status label" default="LATVIA-01 // BIO SYNTHESIS // STATUS: ACTIVE"}”。采用黑色、钢灰色、绿松石色和青色的高对比度赛博朋克色调；超精细的写实数字艺术，戏剧性的轮廓光，体积光，水体焦散，电影级景深，焦点清晰地聚焦在玻璃舱上，采用 9:16 竖屏构图。主体的面部应被隐藏或由中性的矩形遮挡模糊处理，同时保持图像其余部分的高细节度。避免血腥内容，避免出现额外角色，避免出现标志或水印。

templates.title: Mohe Fairy Tale 3D Model

titleLocalized.zh: 墨河童话立体模型

templates.prompt: Create a warm, cinematic macro still life, bringing an old fairytale illustration to life on a rough, handmade parchment on a dark wooden table. A hand holds an antique fountain pen in the upper right corner; the nib touches the paper, flowing with bright, deep blue ink that transforms into a winding, miniature river across the surface. The river meanders from the nib through the center and foreground, shimmering with tiny starlight, its edges surrounded by raised pebbles, moss, miniature flowers, and rocky banks, as if the painting has become a 3D model. Include six core story elements: an antique fountain pen held in a finger, a winding river of ink, a little boy in dark clothes walking along the riverbank, accompanied by a light-colored dog, a twisted ancient tree with sparse, dark blue leaves on the left, and a glass bell jar containing a red rose on the right. Add a small wooden toy airplane near the riverbank in the lower right corner. In the upper left corner of the parchment, two lines of elegant cursive script are written: the first line, "{argument name="first handwritten line" default="draw me a dream..."} ; Line 2, "{argument name="second handwritten line" default="It is only with the heart..."} The scene should evoke the miniature world of an old storybook, inspired by poetic childhood adventures, pen-and-ink illustrations, and magical realism. Use shallow depth of field, warm amber lighting, and dark, vignetted backgrounds to showcase the highly detailed paper fibers, the reflection of wet ink, realistic macro photography quality, and picturesque handcrafted details. Maintain a vertical composition, with parchment filling most of the frame, a pen cut in from the upper right corner, handwritten text in the upper left, and the boy and dog positioned on the riverbank from the lower left to the center. Do not add any additional characters, animals, modern objects, logos, or other readable text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张温暖的电影感微距静物照，展现一幅古老的童话插画在深色木桌上一张粗糙的手工羊皮纸上活灵活现的场景。一只人手在右上角握着一支古董钢笔，笔尖触碰纸面，流淌出光亮的深蓝色墨水，化作一条蜿蜒的微型河流横跨纸面。河流从笔尖蜿蜒穿过中心和前景，闪烁着细小的星光，边缘环绕着凸起的鹅卵石、苔藓、微型花朵和岩石河岸，仿佛画作变成了一个 3D 立体模型。包含 6 个核心故事元素：1 支被手指握住的古董钢笔，1 条蜿蜒的墨水河，1 个身穿深色衣服的小男孩走在河边，1 只浅色小狗与他同行，左侧 1 棵长着稀疏蓝黑色叶片的扭曲古树，右侧 1 个装有一朵红玫瑰的玻璃钟罩。在右下河岸附近添加 1 架小型木制玩具飞机。在羊皮纸左上角，书写 2 行优雅的草书墨迹文字：第 1 行，“{argument name="first handwritten line" default="draw me a dream..."}”；第 2 行，“{argument name="second handwritten line" default="It is only with the heart..."}”。场景应呈现出古老故事书中的微型世界感，灵感源自诗意的童年冒险、钢笔画插图和魔幻现实主义。使用浅景深、温暖的琥珀色灯光、深色暗角背景，展现高细节的纸张纤维、湿润的墨水反光、逼真的微距摄影质感以及如画般的手工细节。保持竖构图，羊皮纸填满大部分画面，钢笔从右上角切入，手写文字位于左上角，男孩和狗位于左下至中部的河边。请勿添加额外角色、额外动物、现代物品、徽标或其他可读文本。

templates.prompt: A photorealistic sunset street scene was created in a narrow back alley in Harajuku, showcasing a long concrete wall transformed into a giant kawaii anime graffiti mural. The mural's central figure is {argument name="character name" default="Nozomu"} Original anime girl: She is a pastel Harajuku style girl with {argument name="hair color" default="Silver Gold"} She has long, wavy pigtails, large, sparkling blue eyes, flushed cheeks, and a slightly open mouth revealing a surprised expression. She wears a blue bow headband and heart-shaped hair clips, and a light blue and white ruffled dress with ribbon details. Her image is to be painted as if it were spray-painted on a wall, showing visible concrete seams, paint drips, marker outlines, spray paint overflows, and slight weathering textures, while the surrounding alleyways maintain a realistic style. The wall must contain nine main graffiti/text elements: one rounded Japanese name logo, which reads {argument name="Japanese name logo" default="のぞむ"} ; 1 English name logo, with the following text{argument name="English name logo" default="NOZOMU"} ; 1 cloud-shaped speech bubble logo with "HARAJUKU DREAM"; 1 small speech bubble with "TAKESHITA POP"; 1 speech bubble with "KAWAII STREET" in the lower left corner; 1 large blue heart-shaped balloon with a pink star on the left; 1 cute blue smiling heart-shaped balloon in the upper right corner; 1 pink heart-shaped balloon on the right; and 1 cute round pastel mascot near the lower right corner. Fill the walls with pink, cyan, lavender, cream, and bubblegum-colored hearts, glitter, bows, clouds, and pastel graffiti, but ensure these 9 main graffiti/text elements are clearly legible. The alleyway should include 5 rectangular warm-colored wall lamps that project golden light onto the mural; the background should include city buildings and balconies resembling fire exits, overhead power lines, a seemingly damp asphalt surface, and 6 cans of spray paint placed against the wall in front of the character. The shot employs a wide-angle vertical composition taken from the street, with the walls extending into the distance to create a sense of depth; it utilizes cinematic blue-toned lighting, warm-toned highlights, vibrant neon pastel hues, realistic shadows, and highly detailed textures. The alleyway is deserted, without vehicles, watermarks, or any other readable text except for designated graffiti.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张照片级写实的黄昏街景，地点位于原宿的一条狭窄后巷，展示一面长长的混凝土墙被改造成巨大的卡哇伊动漫涂鸦壁画。壁画中心是一位名为 {argument name="character name" default="Nozomu"} 的原创动漫少女：她是一位粉彩原宿风女孩，拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="银金色"} 的长波浪双马尾，闪烁着大大的蓝色眼睛，脸颊泛红，小嘴微张露出惊讶的表情，戴着蓝色蝴蝶结发带和心形小发夹，身穿饰有丝带细节的浅蓝白色荷叶边连衣裙。将她绘制成仿佛喷绘在墙上的效果，呈现出可见的混凝土块接缝、油漆滴落、记号笔轮廓、喷漆溢出和轻微的风化纹理，而周围的小巷则保持写实风格。墙上必须包含 9 个主要的涂鸦/文字元素：1 个圆润的日语名字 Logo，写着 {argument name="Japanese name logo" default="のぞむ"}；1 个英语名字 Logo，写着 {argument name="English name logo" default="NOZOMU"}；1 个云朵状对话气泡 Logo，写着“HARAJUKU DREAM”；1 个写着“TAKESHITA POP”的小气泡；1 个左下角写着“KAWAII STREET”的气泡；1 个左侧带有粉色星星的大型蓝色心形气球；1 个右上角可爱的蓝色微笑心形气球；1 个右侧的粉色心形气球；以及 1 个右下角附近可爱的圆形粉彩吉祥物。用粉色、青色、薰衣草色、奶油色和泡泡糖色的心形、闪光、蝴蝶结、云朵和粉彩涂鸦填满墙面，但要确保这 9 个主要涂鸦/文字元素清晰可辨。小巷中应包含 5 盏长方形暖色壁灯，将金色的光芒投射在壁画上；背景中可见城市建筑和类似消防通道的阳台、头顶的电线、看起来潮湿的沥青路面，以及角色前方墙根处摆放的 6 罐喷漆罐。采用从街面拍摄的广角垂直构图，墙面延伸至远处以营造深度感；采用电影感的蓝调时刻光影、暖色灯光高光、鲜艳的霓虹粉彩调色、逼真的阴影和高细节纹理。小巷中无人、无车，无水印，除指定的涂鸦外无其他可读文字。

A quiet young man {argument name="hair color" default="Messy dark brown hair"} He sits sideways on a large wooden windowsill in a dimly lit room, wearing a loose dark hoodie and trousers, holding a warm mug in his hands, gazing out through the open window. His face is in soft shadow, requiring no detail. Near him on the windowsill, there are only three visible objects: an open book lying flat in the foreground, a small lantern emitting a faint glow to his left, and the mug he holds. Outside the window, a hillside town at night unfolds, with its old stone houses and red-tiled roofs, windows glowing with warm light, low courtyard walls, trees, and a damp, winding road that begins near the foreground, meandering through the town towards a distant harbor or lake, against a backdrop of dark mountains. The scene includes five prominent streetlights: a tall, brightly lit streetlight in the far right foreground, three smaller streetlights along the road in the middle ground, and a faint streetlight in the distance. The sky is a deep navy blue, dotted with stars, with layers of clouds and the faint orange glow of sunset lingering on the horizon. Rich contrasts of warm and cool colors are employed: golden lamplight and windowpane reflections on rain-soaked roads and polished wood contrast sharply with the cool blue moonlit mountains and sky. The highly detailed anime-style background art creates a warm yet melancholic atmosphere, with realistic perspective depth, soft halos around the lights, and no text, watermarks, modern vehicles, or crowds.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个电影质感的动漫风格夜景，采用 3:2 横向构图。一位安静的少年，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="凌乱的深棕色头发"}，侧身坐在昏暗房间内宽大的木质窗台上，身穿宽松的深色连帽衫和长裤，双手捧着一个暖意融融的马克杯，透过敞开的木窗向外望去。他的面部处于柔和的阴影中，无需细节刻画。窗台上靠近他的位置有且仅有 3 个可见物体：前景中平放着一本打开的书，左侧有一个发出微光的小灯笼，以及他手中捧着的马克杯。窗外展示一个夜晚的山坡小镇，错落有致的古老石屋和红瓦屋顶，透出温暖灯光的窗户，低矮的庭院围墙，树木，以及一条湿润蜿蜒的道路，从前景附近开始，穿过小镇蜿蜒延伸向远处的港湾或湖泊，背景是深色的山脉。画面中包含 5 盏显眼的街灯：最右侧前景有一盏高大的发光路灯，中景处有三盏沿路分布的小路灯，远处还有一盏微弱的路灯。天空呈现深海军蓝色，点缀着繁星，云层叠嶂，地平线上残留着日落后的淡淡橙色余晖。运用丰富的冷暖对比：金色的灯光和窗户光影反射在雨后湿润的道路和抛光的木材上，与清冷的蓝色月光山脉及天空形成鲜明对比。高细节的绘画风格动漫背景艺术，温馨而忧郁的氛围，真实的透视深度，灯光周围有柔和的光晕，无文字，无水印，无现代交通工具或人群。

templates.title: Origami-style global infographic

titleLocalized.zh: 折纸风格全球信息图

templates.prompt: (Research{argument name="dataset type" default="Geopolitics or global datasets"} ×{argument name="map style" default="Elegant origami map making"} () + (Origami Sculpture^ Editing Infographics^ Soft Touch Shadows) - (Flat, Dull Maps + Fake Country Data + Corporate Dashboard Aesthetics) = Viral Origami World Infographic Input:{argument name="topic" default="The country with the fastest internet speed"} System: Research the input topic and create an advanced infographic around a stylized world or regional map constructed from layered origami. Research Requirements: - Research accurate ranking or comparative data for the topic. - Verify country names, values, and years/dates. - Use authoritative international or official sources whenever possible. - Do not fabricate values, rankings, or map classifications. - Ensure that indicator definitions are consistent across countries. Visual Concept: Transform the data into an elegant origami map or collection of origami country tiles. Utilize creases, shading, labels, and layered paper shapes to encode hierarchies, rankings, or magnitudes. Style: Origami-style infographic, layered paper map, tactile creases, high-end magazine design, understated luxury information art composition: - Prominent title at the top - World or regional map as the main visual element - Highlight top-ranked countries with larger folds - Small label cards with the following: Country name, numerical ranking, year - Simple legends added where necessary - Visual hierarchy conveyed through size, creases, and height differences - Simple and legible labels Material: Matte paper, embossed cardstock, soft frayed edges, cream and soft tones, delicate projection Output: Research the topic, verify the dataset, and then generate an exquisite origami-style global infographic that is tactile, elegant, and highly communicative.

promptLocalized.zh: (研究 {argument name="dataset type" default="地缘政治或全球数据集"} × {argument name="map style" default="优雅的折纸地图制图"}) + (折纸雕塑 ^ 编辑信息设计 ^ 柔和的触感阴影) - (平面枯燥的地图 + 虚假国家数据 + 企业仪表盘美学) = 病毒式传播的折纸世界信息图  输入：{argument name="topic" default="网速最快的国家"}   系统：研究输入的主题，并围绕由层叠折纸形式构成的风格化世界地图或区域地图，创作一张高级信息图。  研究要求： - 研究该主题准确的排名或对比数据。 - 核实国家名称、数值以及年份/日期。 - 尽可能使用权威的国际或官方来源。 - 请勿虚构数值、排名或地图分类。 - 确保各国的指标定义保持一致。  视觉概念：将数据转化为优雅的折纸地图或折纸国家板块集合。利用折痕、阴影、标签和层叠的纸张形状来编码层级、排名或量级。  风格：折纸编辑信息图、层叠纸质地图、触感折痕、高级杂志设计、静奢风信息艺术  构图： - 顶部设有醒目的标题 - 以世界地图或区域地图作为主要视觉元素 - 突出显示排名靠前的国家，并使用更大的折叠结构 - 带有以下内容的小型标注卡片：   国家名称   数值   排名   年份 - 必要时添加简洁的图例 - 通过尺寸、折痕和高度差体现视觉层级 - 标签简洁且易读  材质：哑光纸、压纹卡纸、柔和的毛边、奶油色与柔和的色调、细腻的投影  输出：研究主题，核实数据集，然后生成一张精致的折纸风格全球信息图，使其具有触感、优雅且极具传播价值。

templates.prompt: Using the uploaded character as the sole identity reference, maintain facial features, proportions, long black hair, thin-rimmed silver glasses, a cool demeanor, and a natural expression. Create a high-quality vertical sci-fi mecha poster with a 4:5 aspect ratio. The visual style is high-end cyberpunk x mecha warrior x Japanese anime promotional poster x futuristic street fashion blockbuster. The main subject is a young Asian woman sitting on the edge of a city ruin or an industrial rooftop, with a giant mechanical beast/mechanical lion/mecha Liger behind her. It possesses a massive body, black and white metal armor, glowing red eyes, sharp mechanical teeth, complex armor structure, hydraulic joints, a mechanical spine, red energy lines, exposed cables, and details of combat damage. The character wears futuristic functional street combat attire: a red functional jacket/white functional hoodie/black tactical bodysuit (optional); paired with black cargo pants, a tactical skirt, functional suspenders, red ribbons, metal buckles, half-finger gloves, and platform functional sneakers. The overall color scheme is black, white, and red, featuring tactical markings, numbers, a mecha pilot feel, and street fashion. The poses are natural and powerful: seated/squatting/one-knee support/leaning against the edge of a rooftop, eyes looking directly at the camera. Expressions can be calm, resolute, smiling, slightly tipsy, confident, or in a combat-ready state. Facial expressions should not be stiff; skin should be realistic, features refined but not artificial, and hair should have a slight wind-blown effect. The background is a futuristic city rooftop with skyscrapers, antennas, and industrial structures, with a cloudy sky or blue-gray clouds in the distance. The foreground includes worn concrete walls, graffiti, red spray paint, scratches, metal fragments, dust, and signs of battle. The overall atmosphere is grand, dangerous, stylish, and cinematic. It incorporates numerous high-end poster layout elements: the large "NEXORA" title in the upper left corner uses bold white graffiti font with a red X scratch on the back; it includes vertically arranged Japanese and English mecha serial numbers, HUD parameters, warning labels, barcodes, industrial markings, combat data panels, red and white thin-line decorations, scanning frames, brand logos, and a futuristic typography system. The layout combines the styles of Japanese mecha anime posters and high-end game character design posters, dense yet orderly. Each panel should have a title label in dark blue or cool blue. Minimalist decoration, prioritizing information clarity. [Required Panel Configurations] 1. Full Body (Front) 2. Full Body (Side) 3. Full Body (Back) 4. Close-up of Face (Front) 5. Close-up of Face (45-degree angle) 6. Close-up of Face (Side) 7. Close-up of Upper Body (Front) [Panel Contents] - Full Body (Front): Natural standing pose. Ensure the face, hair, entire outfit, skirt length, black stockings, and shoes are clearly visible. - Full Body (Side): Side-view standing pose. Ensure the side profile of the face, chest, waist, hips, leg lines, hair drape, and twin tail position are clearly visible. - Full Body (Back): Back view. Show the hair parting, the back effect of the twin tails, the back of the jacket, the back of the skirt, and leg lines. - Close-up of Face (Front): Facial reference image. Clearly showcasing the eyes, nose, mouth, facial contours, bangs, and ribbon placement. - Facial close-up (45-degree angle): Showcasing the facial contours, cheek appearance, bangs fall, and twin ponytails on one side, viewed from the side. - Facial close-up (side profile): Clearly showing the forehead, bridge of the nose, mouth, chin, ear placement, neck connection, and side profile. - Upper body close-up (front view): Showcasing the jacket collar, shirt collar, shoulder shape, and the silhouette from the chest to the upper waist, in addition to the face. [Style/Texture] A high-quality portrait style leaning towards realism. Avoiding excessive AI-style skin retouching; maintaining {argument name="subject" default="young people"} A natural skin texture. The skin should be clean and smooth, but not like a wax figure.{argument name="hair" default="black hair"} It should have a natural luster.{argument name="outfit" default="Suit"} It should have a clean, high-quality fabric feel. The overall effect should be bright, clear, and information-rich. [Exclusions] No tiny clothing detail windows. No color swatches. No lengthy personal profile sections. No excessive explanatory text. No scene, background, or prop arrangement. [Prohibited Items] Changing the character, making them look younger, mass-produced anime faces, large eyes, unstable nose or chin shapes, broken profile contours, changing the position of twin tails, changing the shape of ribbons, changing hairstyles, changing suit colors, unnecessary accessories, excessive beautification, excessive shading, or cluttered layout.

promptLocalized.zh:
[布局]
配置为单一、有组织的设定表。白色或极浅灰色的背景。布局整洁，留白易读。每个面板应带有深蓝色或冷静蓝色的标题标签。装饰极简，优先考虑信息清晰度。

[必需的面板配置]
1. 全身（正面）
2. 全身（侧面）
3. 全身（背面）
4. 面部特写（正面）
5. 面部特写（45 度角）
6. 面部特写（侧脸）
7. 上半身特写（正面）

[各面板内容]
- 全身（正面）：自然的站立姿势。确保面部、头发、整套服装、裙长、黑色长筒袜和鞋子清晰可见。
- 全身（侧面）：侧身站立姿势。确保面部侧影、胸部、腰部、臀部、腿部线条、头发垂落感及双马尾位置清晰可见。
- 全身（背面）：背面视图。展示发缝、双马尾的背面效果、夹克背面、裙子背面及腿部线条。
- 面部特写（正面）：面部参考图。清晰展示眼睛、鼻子、嘴巴、轮廓、刘海及丝带位置。
- 面部特写（45 度角）：展示从侧角观察的面部立体感、脸颊外观、刘海垂落感及一侧双马尾。
- 面部特写（侧脸）：清晰展示额头、鼻梁、嘴巴、下巴、耳朵位置、颈部连接处及侧面轮廓。
- 上半身特写（正面）：除面部外，展示夹克领口、衬衫领口、肩部形状以及从胸部到上腰部的轮廓。

[风格/质感]
偏向写实的高质量肖像表现。避免过度 AI 风格的皮肤处理；保持 {argument name="subject" default="年轻人"} 自然的皮肤质感。皮肤应干净光滑，但不能像蜡像。{argument name="hair" default="黑发"} 应具有自然光泽。{argument name="outfit" default="西装"} 应具有干净、高质量的织物感。整体呈现明亮、清晰且信息量丰富的效果。

[排除项]
无微小的服装细节窗口。无色板栏。无长篇个人资料部分。无过多的说明性文字。无场景、背景或道具布置。

[禁止事项]
更换人物、使其看起来更年轻、量产型动漫脸、大眼睛、不稳定的鼻子或下巴形状、破碎的侧脸轮廓、改变双马尾位置、改变丝带形状、更改发型、改变西装颜色、不必要的配饰、过度美颜、过度阴影或杂乱的布局。
