templates.title: Global Traditional Costume Collage

titleLocalized.zh: 全球传统服饰拼贴画

templates.prompt: [Style] High-quality realistic photography. Theme: "Ten-Nation Traditional Costume Fashion Collage". Magazine/social media-quality visuals suitable for people/characters. Natural textures, cinematic tones, modern and elegant commercial photography. Avoid AI compositing. [Composition] 16:9 widescreen aspect ratio. 2 rows x 5 columns fashion collage layout. Arranged so that all ten figures look like the same person wearing different outfits. Do not crop out important parts of the face, hands, hairstyle, headdress, or clothing. Clean background with negative space, slightly highlighting the central figure. [Subject] A fictional Japanese woman around 20 years old. Maintain the same facial features, eyes, nose, lips, contours, skin tone, and body shape. Only change the clothing, hairstyle, hair accessories, makeup, and pose for each country. Presented as ten variations of the same woman, not ten different people. [Clothing/Hairstyle/Makeup/Action/Tags] Japan: Kimono, low bun, hairpin, translucent white base makeup, red lips. Slightly lifting the sleeves, slightly turning her head. Tag "Japan". China: Hanfu or cheongsam style, elegant updo, hair accessories, thin eyeliner, soft blush. Holding a round fan or adjusting the collar. Tag "China". Korea: Hanbok, center-parted low bun, natural dewy skin, light pink lips. Standing with hands lightly folded. Tag "Korea". India: Sari, side-parted or low bun, forehead ornament (bindi), earrings, warm-toned eyeshadow and gold highlighter. Gently pinching the edge of the sari. Tag "India". Vietnam: Ao Dai, long straight hair or half-updo, natural and clear makeup. Holding a conical hat or slightly tilting the head. Tag "Vietnam". Thailand: Traditional Thai dress, high bun, gold hair accessories, elegant golden-brown makeup. Gracefully clasping hands (wai). Tag "Thailand". Mongolia: Deel, long braid or double braids, traditional hat or forehead ornament, healthy and natural makeup. Gently holding the belt or shawl. Tag "Mongolia". Morocco: Kaftan robe, long wavy hair or low bun, metallic embellishments, sophisticated smoky eye makeup. Lightly touch the embroidered cuffs. Tag "Morocco". Mexico: Traditional embroidered dress, braided or low bun, floral hair accessories, vibrant yet elegant lip color. Lightly lift the skirt to showcase the embroidery. Tag "Mexico". Scotland: Traditional tartan clothing or shawl, natural wavy hair or half-up hairstyle, soft, natural makeup. Lightly hold the tartan fabric. Tag "Scotland". [Scene] High-end studio dominated by light gray and cream white. Depth is created through translucent glass, acrylic layers, low display stands, and soft shadows. Clearly legible Japanese labels are placed near each subject. No English, logos, watermarks, or meaningless symbols. [Lighting] Soft natural light from the left front. Subtle rim light from the right. Cinematic ambient lighting. Avoid overexposed highlights, preserve shadow details. Unified color temperature and toning. [Details] High-definition rendering of fabric textures, embroidery, silk sheen, cotton and linen textures, metallic accessories, hair strands, skin textures, makeup, and clothing folds. Label text is clear and legible. [Quality Keywords] High-definition, realistic textures, clear subjects, stable composition, unified colors, professional post-processing, clear outlines, natural body proportions, magazine cover quality. [Avoid] Faces that look like different people, age variations, cultural confusion, excessive makeup, low resolution, deformed hands, excessive limbs, facial distortion, perspective errors, plastic-looking skin, excessive skin smoothing, garbled text, English characters, long text, watermarks, logos, brand displays, meaningless symbols, incorrect flags, rough compositing, and crowded compositions.

promptLocalized.zh: [风格] 高质量写实摄影。主题：“十国传统服饰时尚拼贴画”。适用于人物/角色的杂志/社交媒体级视觉效果。自然的纹理，电影般的色调，现代且优雅的商业摄影。避免 AI 合成感。[构图] 16:9 宽屏比例。2 行 x 5 列的时尚拼贴布局。排列方式使所有十个人物看起来像是穿着不同服装的同一个人。不要裁剪掉面部、手部、发型、头饰或服装的重要部分。背景干净并留有负空间，略微突出中心人物。[主体] 一位 20 岁左右的虚构日本女性。保持相同的面部特征、眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇、轮廓、肤色和体型。仅改变每个国家的服装、发型、发饰、妆容和姿势。表现为同一个女性的十种变体，而非十个不同的人。[服装/发型/妆容/动作/标签] 日本：和服，低发髻，簪子，透明白皙底妆，红唇。轻提袖口，微微回眸。标签“日本”。中国：汉服或旗袍风格，优雅发髻，发饰，细眼线，柔和胭脂。手持团扇或整理领口。标签“中国”。韩国：韩服，中分低发髻，自然水光肌，淡粉色嘴唇。双手轻叠站立。标签“韩国”。印度：纱丽，侧分或低发髻，额饰 (bindi)，耳环，暖色眼影和金色高光。轻捏纱丽边缘。标签“印度”。越南：奥黛，长直发或半扎发，自然清透妆容。手持斗笠或微微侧头。标签“越南”。泰国：传统泰式礼服，高发髻，金色发饰，优雅金棕色妆容。优雅地双手合十 (wai)。标签“泰国”。蒙古：德勒 (Deel)，长辫或双辫，传统帽子或额饰，健康自然的妆容。轻扶腰带或披肩。标签“蒙古”。摩洛哥：卡夫坦长袍，波浪长发或低发髻，金属装饰，精致烟熏妆。轻触袖口刺绣。标签“摩洛哥”。墨西哥：传统刺绣连衣裙，编发或低发髻，花朵发饰，鲜艳而优雅的唇色。轻提裙摆以展示刺绣。标签“墨西哥”。苏格兰：格子呢传统服饰或披肩，自然波浪发或半扎发，柔和自然妆容。轻握格子呢布料。标签“苏格兰”。[场景] 以浅灰色和奶油白为主的高端摄影棚。通过半透明玻璃、亚克力层、低展示台和柔和阴影营造深度。在每个人物附近放置清晰可辨的日语标签。无英文、标志、水印或无意义符号。[光影] 左前方柔和自然光。右侧微弱轮廓光。电影级环境光。避免高光过曝，保留阴影细节。统一色温和调色。[细节] 高清呈现织物纹理、刺绣、丝绸光泽、棉麻质感、金属配饰、发丝、皮肤纹理、妆容和衣物褶皱。标签文字清晰易读。[质量关键词] 高清，写实纹理，主体清晰，构图稳定，色彩统一，专业后期处理，轮廓清晰，自然身体比例，杂志封面级。[避免] 看起来像不同人的脸、年龄变化、文化混淆、妆容过度、低分辨率、手部畸形、肢体过多、面部崩坏、透视错误、塑料感皮肤、过度磨皮、乱码、英文字符、长文本、水印、标志、品牌展示、无意义符号、国旗错误、合成粗糙、构图拥挤。

服装：{argument name="outfit color" default="黑色"} 高腰紧身运动短裤，内搭黑色抹胸，浅灰色宽松短款皮夹克。夹克的肩线自然垂落，露出肩部与锁骨。

场景：高度细节化的 {argument name="scene" default="废弃的旧音乐室"}。背景中有一架大型复古立式钢琴。散落的乐谱架和乐谱。光线透过破损的窗户射入。细小的尘埃在空气中飞舞。老旧的木地板。昏暗的电影感室内光线。冷暖光交织，形成强烈的电影感对比。尘埃在光束中漂浮，整个空间细节丰富。

构图：全身构图。平视视角。右侧侧面角度。人物与背景空间清晰可见。50mm 镜头。自然的景深。柔和的前景虚化。轻微的前景遮挡。背景环境锐利且具有立体感。

质量/美学：Fujifilm Classic Chrome 色彩。柔和的电影感色调。低对比度。如同纪录片般的写实氛围。低饱和度的蓝红色调。旅行胶片质感。自然光细节。织物纹理清晰可见。精致的面部细节。真实的立体空间感。超高清。电影级布光。

templates.title: Character/Spirit Beast Selection Logic

titleLocalized.zh: 角色灵兽选择逻辑

templates.prompt: Based on the figures, clothing, facial expressions, personal belongings, lighting, setting, and atmosphere in the reference image, infer the spirit beast that the character is most likely to choose. The goal is to create a sense of certainty that "this child will indeed choose this spirit beast." However, please avoid simplistic and stereotypical associations. Even in similar atmospheres, compare similar animals, related ideas, products from competitors, and similar cultures from other countries to select the spirit beast that will most resonate with the character. I hope the choice of spirit beast is based on this fundamental principle. The spirit beast is not limited to {argument name="familiar type" default="Living things (animals, birds, insects, plants)"} This includes various fictional creatures such as elves, gods, demons, and ghosts. Chappy encourages imagination. Using a realistic style taken with a smartphone, adjust clothing and background to visually demonstrate the relationship between the subject and the mythical creature, and capture the best possible photo of both. The mythical creature should maintain a consistent style with the reference image to ensure a harmonious look. Please include the name and characteristics of the mythical creature in the photo. Also, ensure the overall atmosphere of the photo is unified according to its theme.

promptLocalized.zh: 请根据参考图像中的人物、服饰、面部表情、随身物品、光影、场景及氛围，推断出该角色最可能选择的灵兽。目标是营造出一种“这孩子确实会选择这只灵兽”的必然感。但请避免简单、刻板的联想。即使在氛围相似的情况下，也应对比相似的动物、相近的理念、竞争对手的产物以及其他国家的类似文化，从中选出最能触动该角色的灵兽。我希望基于这一基本理念来选择灵兽。灵兽不仅限于 {argument name="familiar type" default="生物（动物、鸟类、昆虫、植物）"}，还包括精灵、神明、恶魔、鬼怪等各种虚构生物。Chappy 可以发挥想象力。请以智能手机拍摄的写实风格，通过调整服饰和背景，直观地展现主体与灵兽之间的关系，并为两者拍摄一张最佳照片。灵兽应与参考图像的风格保持一致，确保毫无违和感。请在照片中写明灵兽的名称及其特征。并根据照片的主题，统一整张照片的氛围。

templates.title: QR code business card designer

titleLocalized.zh: 二维码名片设计师

templates.prompt: Please design a business card with a scannable QR code based on the SNS (X) profile information. [Purpose] To summarize the profile information of account X into a visually appealing horizontal business card. The design, color scheme, layout, white space, and font style should be automatically suggested by AI to ensure optimal overall visual appeal. [Information to be displayed] - Name:{argument name="name" default="XXXX"} - Position:{argument name="title" default="XXXX"} - Account X: @{argument name="account name" default="XXXX"} - Personal Profile: XXXX - Achievements/Characteristics: XXXX - One-line Slogan: XXXX - QR Code Link: https://t.co/OQINcuK6wHXXXX [About QR Codes] - QR codes should not be merely decorative; they must be scannable by smartphones. - Accurately embed the link. - The QR code size must be large enough, prioritizing scanning accuracy. - Ensure sufficient white space around the QR code. - Do not overlay text or decorations on the QR code. - Do not distort or over-process the QR code. - Prioritize high contrast with the background to ensure readability. [Design Requirements] - Horizontal business card design. - Convey a sense of luxury, sophistication, trust, and professionalism. - Simple and aesthetically pleasing layout, making full use of white space. - All text should be in Japanese, clear and easy to read. - Information priority should be clear, with name and title prominently displayed. - AI should automatically determine the optimal background color, accent color, and font balance. - Avoid a cheap, template-like feel. - Present an elegant finished product suitable for actual printing. [Important Notes] - AI should provide aesthetically pleasing and natural suggestions, not fixed layouts. - The usability of the QR code must be prioritized. - Avoid garbled text and ensure all text is clearly legible. - Organize information logically for optimal readability. Aspect ratio 16:9. Please create at high resolution.

promptLocalized.zh:
请根据 SNS (X) 个人资料信息，设计一张带有可扫描二维码的名片。

[目的]
将 X 账号的个人资料信息汇总到一张精致的横版名片中。名片的设计、配色方案、布局、留白设计及字体风格应由 AI 自动建议，以确保整体视觉效果达到最佳。

[需展示的信息]
- 姓名: {argument name="name" default="XXXX"}
- 职位: {argument name="title" default="XXXX"}
- X 账号: @{argument name="account name" default="XXXX"}
- 个人简介: XXXX
- 成就/特点: XXXX
- 一句话标语: XXXX
- 二维码链接地址: https://t.co/OQINcuK6wHXXXX

[关于二维码]
- 二维码不应仅作为装饰，必须确保能用智能手机扫描。
- 准确嵌入链接。
- 二维码尺寸需足够大，优先保证扫描准确性。
- 确保二维码周围有足够的留白。
- 请勿在二维码上叠加文字或装饰。
- 请勿扭曲或过度处理二维码。
- 优先考虑与背景的高对比度，以确保易读性。

[设计要求]
- 横版名片设计。
- 传达奢华感、精致感、信任感及专业感。
- 简约美观的布局，充分利用留白。
- 所有文字均为日语，清晰易读。
- 信息优先级明确，姓名和职位应最为突出。
- 由 AI 自动决定最佳背景色、强调色及字体平衡。
- 避免廉价的模板感。
- 呈现适合实际印刷的优雅成品。

[重要事项]
- AI 应提供美观且自然的建议，而非固定的布局。
- 同时，必须优先考虑二维码的实用性。
- 避免乱码，确保所有文字清晰可辨。
- 合理组织信息，实现最佳可读性。

宽高比 16:9。
请以高分辨率创建。

templates.title: The woman's reflection in the convex mirror

titleLocalized.zh: 凸面镜中的女子倒影

templates.prompt: Subject: A realistic portrait of a Japanese woman.{argument name="reflection object" default="Reflected in a circular convex mirror"} The background is a quiet Japanese alleyway. Character/Expression: A Japanese woman in her early twenties.{argument name="hair style" default="Long black hair"} She has thin bangs, natural makeup, clear skin, and a calm expression, gazing quietly at the camera. Clothing/Pose:{argument name="outfit" default="White dress with light blue flowers"} A shoulder bag, a natural pose, as if taking a selfie with one hand outstretched. Background/Light: A Japanese residential area with old wooden fences and stone walls, sunlight filtering through the green trees, soft natural light in an early summer afternoon, with a significantly blurred background. Composition/Camera: Composition using a circular convex mirror, wide-angle, slightly downward angle, centered, shallow depth of field, with circular bokeh and vignetting at the edges. Texture/Style: Soft colors, low contrast, soft film tones, natural skin texture, transparent Japanese portrait, realistic AI photo. Negative keywords: low quality, unnatural hand, distorted face, extra fingers, over-processing, text, logos, watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh:
主体：一位日本女性的写实肖像，{argument name="reflection object" default="倒映在圆形凸面镜中"}，背景为安静的日本巷弄。

人物/表情：20 岁出头的日本女性，{argument name="hair style" default="黑色长发"}，薄刘海，自然妆容，通透的皮肤，表情平静，静静地注视着镜头。

服装/姿势：{argument name="outfit" default="带有浅蓝色花朵的白色连衣裙"}，单肩包，自然姿势，如同单手伸出拍摄自拍。

背景/光线：带有古老木栅栏和石墙的日本住宅区，透过树木的绿色阳光，初夏午后，柔和的自然光，背景大幅虚化。

构图/相机：利用圆形凸面镜反射的构图，广角，略微俯视角度，居中，浅景深，边缘有圆形光斑和暗角。

质感/风格：淡雅色彩，低对比度，柔和胶片色调，自然的皮肤质感，通透的日系肖像，写实 AI 照片。

负面提示词：低质量，不自然的手，扭曲的脸，多余的手指，过度处理，文字，标志，水印。

templates.title: Retro-style city flag poster

titleLocalized.zh: 复古笔触风格城市旗帜海报

templates.prompt: A textured and decadent graphic illustration against the backdrop of the Australian flag, rendered with heavy brushstrokes, paint splatter effects, and a vintage, old paper texture. The foreground features a clear black silhouette of Sydney's skyline. The Sydney Opera House and Sydney Harbour Bridge are prominently displayed on the left side of the silhouette, alongside various city skyscrapers and the Sydney Tower. The Union Jack and Southern Cross in the upper left corner of the flag are clearly visible and blend seamlessly with the distressed paint texture on the flag. High contrast, artistic, patriotic theme. Create a minimalist silhouette of the Tokyo skyline, including the Tokyo Skytree, Tokyo Tower, the Ferris wheel, and a torii gate on the far left. Snow-capped Mount Fuji is visible in the center of the background. A large, vibrant red sun rises behind the entire skyline, rendered with bold and textured Japanese ink wash brushstrokes (sumi-e). The background features an aged, vintage beige parchment texture with artistic paint splatters and rough edges. The overall aesthetic blends modern cityscapes with traditional Japanese decadent art, featuring a high-contrast black silhouette against a red and cream background.

promptLocalized.zh: 一幅具有纹理和颓废风格的图形插画，以澳大利亚国旗为背景，采用厚重的笔触、油漆飞溅效果以及复古的旧纸张纹理呈现。前景底部是澳大利亚悉尼清晰的黑色剪影天际线。剪影左侧突出展示了悉尼歌剧院和悉尼海港大桥，并伴有各类城市摩天大楼和悉尼塔。国旗左上角的米字旗和南十字星清晰可见，并与旗帜上做旧的油漆纹理完美融合。高对比度，艺术感，爱国主题。创作一幅极简主义的东京剪影天际线，包含东京晴空塔、东京塔、摩天轮，以及最左侧的一座鸟居。背景中央可见白雪皑皑的富士山。整个天际线后方是一轮巨大的、充满活力的红色太阳，以大胆且富有纹理的日式水墨笔触（sumi-e）呈现。背景为做旧的复古米色羊皮纸纹理，带有艺术性的油漆飞溅和粗糙的边缘。整体美学融合了现代城市景观与传统的日式颓废艺术，高对比度，红色与奶油色背景下的黑色剪影。

templates.title: Pop Art Style Vector Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 波普艺术风格矢量肖像

templates.prompt: Subject and Composition: A stylized low-angle portrait, with the subject being {argument name="subject" default="A young man looking up"} His expression was serene. He wore large headphones and a textured red knit hat. The composition was a close-up, focusing on his profile and neck, shot from a cinematic perspective. Art style: A{argument name="artistic style" default="The fusion of modern pop art and digital vector illustration"} The image employs bold, high-contrast shadows and clean lines. The shadows are rendered in a "celluloid" or poster-like style, using distinct blocks of color rather than smooth gradients. Color palette: A striking, limited color scheme containing {argument name="color palette" default="Deep black, soft gray, vibrant red, and specific cyan/mint green accents."} The background is a flat, neutral gray-white with subtle geometric sketch lines. Details and textures: the jacket and knit hat feature expressive red and cyan brushstrokes. The headphones have a glossy metallic finish with realistic reflections. Skin is rendered in gray tones with cyan highlights to emphasize dramatic light and shadow from above. Atmosphere: Urban, artistic, and slightly melancholic, reminiscent of high-end graphic novel covers or modern street art murals. Aspect ratio: 9:16.

promptLocalized.zh: 主体与构图：一张风格化的低角度肖像，主体为 {argument name="subject" default="一位抬头仰望的年轻人"}，表情宁静。他戴着一副大型头戴式耳机和一顶有质感的红色针织帽。构图为特写，聚焦于侧脸和颈部，采用电影级视角拍摄。艺术风格：一种 {argument name="artistic style" default="现代波普艺术与数字矢量插画的融合"}。图像运用了大胆的高对比度阴影和清晰的线条。阴影呈现为“赛璐璐”或海报化风格，使用明显的色块而非平滑的渐变。调色板：引人注目的有限配色方案，包含 {argument name="color palette" default="深黑色、柔和的灰色、鲜艳的红色以及特定的青色/薄荷绿点缀"}。背景为平坦的中性灰白色，带有细微的几何草图线条。细节与质感：夹克和针织帽呈现出富有表现力的红色和青色笔触。耳机具有光泽的金属质感，并带有逼真的反射效果。皮肤以灰色调和青色高光渲染，以强调来自上方的戏剧性光影。氛围：城市感、艺术感且略带忧郁，让人联想到高端图形小说封面或现代街头艺术壁画。纵横比为 9:16

templates.title: Anime Character Pharmacist Reconstruction

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫角色药剂师重构

templates.prompt: Use the uploaded roles as precise identity references. Reconstruct them as {argument name="profession" default="pharmacist"} The scene is set in{argument name="setting" default="Modern Japanese pharmacy"} The core objective is to create a humorous yet realistic anime screenshot that perfectly matches the drug consultation content with the character's personality, archetype, type, speaking style, abilities, worldview, atmosphere, hidden quirks, emotional tone, and aesthetic characteristics. These absurd drug explanations must sound "natural" when delivered by the character. The process begins with internal analysis: personality, type, role positioning, energy level, speaking style, theme, intelligence type, emotional tone, abilities, hidden quirks, and whether they are lazy, arrogant, holy, chaotic, elegant, mysterious, evil, immature, shy, or aloof, etc. Then, the most fitting absurd drug explanation for the character's traits is generated. Examples: Cat → Cat-talking medicine for chuunibyou (middle school syndrome) → Parallel world stabilizer for angel → Divine resonance inhibitor for vampire → Sunlight tolerance tablet for magical girl → Transformation stabilizer for working woman → Anti-overtime hallucination drug for idol → Popularity and charm stabilizer for nun → Miracle inhibitor for yandere → Emotion limiter for fox girl → Illusion leak inhibitor for cyberpunk → Firmware stabilizer for delinquent → Battle aura inhibitor for sleepy girl → Anti-dream overflow tablet, etc. Includes visible Japanese dialogue: speech bubbles, medicine bottle labels, prescription bag text, monitor text, sticky notes, subtitles. Prohibited: Medication instructions memos, suggestions, large information sheets, posters, counter documents. Dialogue must match the character's speaking style. Example: "The side effects are very slight... The sense of time is broken." (The side effects are very slight... It's just that the sense of time is broken occasionally) "The dream is weak..." (The final boss in the dream) The battle will be a little weaker~) "The possibility of connecting to the other world side...気をつけろ" (It may be connected to the other world side...be careful) "Miracle 酔いを氪えるお薬です" (This is the medicine that suppresses Miracle's dizziness) Environment: Realistic Japanese pharmacy, Medicine shelves, dispensing machines, medicine boxes, fluorescent lighting, pharmacy counters, waiting chairs, Medicine bag, monitor screen, natural clutter, realistic depth of field. Character actions: holding medicine, pointing at pills, explaining bizarre side effects, handing out the medicine bag; despite the absurd explanations, the attitude must be serious and professional. Patients are visible from behind or to the side. Dialogue bubbles: rounded, cartoonish style, clear and easy-to-read large Japanese characters, few lines, not crowded. Style:{argument name="visual style" default="Hand-drawn anime illustrations"} Soft sketch lines, watercolor paper texture, visible lines, warm handmade feel, anime screenshot atmosphere, everyday comedy vibe, cinematic composition, soft indoor lighting.

promptLocalized.zh:
将上传的角色作为精确的身份参考。

将他们重构为 {argument name="profession" default="药剂师"}，场景设定在 {argument name="setting" default="现代日本调剂药房"} 中。

核心：
创作一张既幽默又真实的动漫截图，使药物咨询内容与角色的性格、原型、类型、说话风格、能力、世界观、氛围、隐藏怪癖、情感基调及审美特征完美契合。

这些荒诞的药物解释必须让该角色说出来显得“自然”。

首先进行内部分析：
性格、类型、角色定位、能量、说话风格、主题、智力类型、情感基调、能力、隐藏怪癖，以及他们是慵懒、自负、圣洁、混乱、优雅、神秘、邪恶、中二、害羞还是高冷等。

然后生成最符合该角色特征的荒诞药物解释。

示例：
猫 → 猫语药
中二病 → 平行世界稳定剂
天使 → 神圣共鸣抑制剂
吸血鬼 → 日光耐受片
魔法少女 → 变身稳定剂
职场女性 → 抗加班幻觉药
偶像 → 人气魅力稳定剂
修女 → 奇迹抑制药
病娇 → 情感限制器
狐娘 → 幻术泄露抑制剂
赛博朋克 → 固件稳定剂
不良少年 → 战斗气场抑制剂
嗜睡少女 → 抗梦境溢出片
等等。

包含可见的日语对话：
对话气泡、药瓶标签、处方袋文字、显示器文字、便利贴、字幕。

禁止：
用药说明备忘录、
一点建议、
大型信息表、
海报、
柜台文件。

对话必须符合角色的说话风格。

示例：
「副作用は軽微。……たまに時間感覚が崩れるだけ」（副作用很轻微……只是偶尔时间感会崩坏而已）
「夢のラスボス戦が少し弱くなります〜」（梦里的最终 Boss 战会变弱一点哦～）
「裏世界側と接続される可能性がある……気をつけろ」（可能会连接到里世界侧……小心点）
「奇跡酔いを抑えるお薬です」（这是抑制奇迹晕眩的药）

环境：
写实的日本药房、
药架、
分包机、
药盒、
荧光照明、
药房柜台、
候诊椅、
药袋、
显示器画面、
自然的杂乱感、
真实的景深。

角色动作：
拿着药、
指着药片、
解释离奇的副作用、
递出药袋、
尽管解释内容荒诞，但态度要严肃专业。

患者从背后或侧面可见。

对话气泡：
圆润的漫画风格、
清晰易读的日语大字、
行数少、
不拥挤。

风格：
{argument name="visual style" default="手绘动漫插画"}、

The sky should be a deep, intense red and black, filled with layered storm clouds, faint starlight, and a fiery red-orange glow on the horizon. Use a limited palette.{argument name="main color palette" default="Crimson, black, scarlet, and ember orange"} High contrast, dramatic contour lighting, ultra-fine textures, epic scale, realistic fantasy concept art, no figures, no architecture, no text, no watermark. promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个电影级、写实风格的都市奇幻场景，背景为日落时分的粗犷巷弄，展示一条巨大的 {argument name="dragon color" default="炭黑与余烬橙色"} 巨龙，它仿佛是从一栋古老砖墙上活过来的巨幅壁画。巨龙拥有细长的蛇颈、带角的头部、闪烁的琥珀色眼睛、锋利的牙齿、许多参差不齐的脊刺、层叠如盔甲般的鳞片，以及横跨墙面的两扇巨大蝙蝠状翅膀；它的身体和翅膀与砖墙纹理融为一体，如同街头艺术，但具备 3D 真实感，橙色的火光透过翼膜和鳞片缝隙透射出来。场景设定在一个狭窄废弃的 {argument name="city setting" default="纽约风格工业巷弄"}，两侧是高耸的砖墙，左侧有金属防火梯、深色的窗户，墙根处有涂鸦、杂草和碎屑，湿润开裂的地面上布满水洼，倒映着巨龙和日落。将低垂的太阳置于巷弄远端，投射出强烈的金色背光、长长的阴影和橙色高光，与深色砖墙形成戏剧性的对比。使用地面视角的广角镜头，高耸的墙壁向上延伸，巨龙占据构图右侧的三分之二，巷弄向左侧发光的地平线延伸。风格应为超细节、写实、高动态范围、电影级奇幻概念艺术、忧郁的城市衰败感、清晰的鳞片纹理、潮湿的反光地面、温暖的橙黑配色，画面中无人、无易读文字、无标志、无水印。可选问候语：{argument name="holiday mood" default="龙年快乐，精彩而令人敬畏"}。

templates.title: Retro Indonesian travel collage poster

titleLocalized.zh: 复古印度尼西亚旅行拼贴海报

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a retro travel poster collage for promotional purposes.{argument name="destination country" default="Indonesia"} The design evokes the aesthetics of a scrapbook postcard and a travel-ready atmosphere full of adventure. Canvas: Vertical 3:4 poster with an aged beige paper background featuring torn edges, worn ink, spots, layered paper scraps, postmarks, tape, and weathered print textures. Warm earthy tones are used: red, cyan, ochre, tan, brown, faded black, and sun-kissed cream. Subject: The foreground centers on a young female traveler, a half-length portrait, holding a DSLR camera in one hand and an unfolded paper map in the other. She wears a loose white cardigan over a white cropped top, a printed batik-style skirt, a backpack strap, and small pieces of jewelry; her hair is casually tied up. Her face is softened with a rectangular blur, while the rest of her body remains sharp and photorealistic. Text: A large, aged red title at the top reads, "{argument name="headline text" default="INDONESIA"} Below it, add a line of blue capital letters:{argument name="tagline" default="THOUSANDS OF ISLANDS, ENDLESS ADVENTURES"} Below that, add a line of red handwritten quote:{argument name="script quote" default="Where culture, nature and smiles come together"} At the bottom is a long, dark cyan strip with the words "NOT JUST A DESTINATION, IT'S AN EXPERIENCE" printed in large white letters. Layout and collage elements: Twelve clearly visible travel elements surround the traveler: 1) A multi-tiered Balinese pagoda on the left, 2) A Borobudur-style stone tower on the right, 3) A volcano shrouded in mist in the upper-middle background, 4) A busy Indonesian city street with motorcycles and traffic in the lower-middle, 5) A turquoise bus in the lower right corner, 6) A palm leaf in the upper right corner, 7) A plate of Indonesian satay or grilled meat with rice in the lower left corner, 8) A white frangipani flower near the food, 9) A yellow "WELCOME TO INDONESIA" label in the upper left corner, 10) An Indonesian stamp with a volcano illustration in the upper right corner, 11) A circular Balinese postmark near the upper right corner, and 12) ... The bottom left corner features a passport-shaped ticket with Jakarta, CGK, Indonesia, and the Garuda logo. Destination signage: On the right, five wooden arrow signs are stacked vertically, all pointing to the right, labeled "BALI," "YOGYAKARTA," "LABUAN BAJO," "RAJA AMPAT," and "LOMBOK." Branding: The bottom right corner includes a circular sticker logo that reads "wonderful Indonesia," accompanied by a brightly colored, streamlined bird badge. Style constraints: Combine photorealistic travel photography with illustrated paper collages, retro travel poster typography, torn paper layering, halftone grain, scratches, postmarks, and soft, cinematic contrast. Keep all text clear and legible; avoid adding additional destination names beyond the listed names, and refrain from adding watermarks or modern UI elements.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张复古旅行海报拼贴画，用于宣传 {argument name="destination country" default="印度尼西亚"}，营造剪贴簿明信片的美感和充满冒险气息的旅游氛围。

画布：竖版 3:4 海报，采用做旧的米色纸张背景，带有撕裂边缘、磨损的墨迹、斑点、分层纸屑、邮戳、胶带和风化印刷纹理。使用温暖的土色调：红色、青色、赭色、棕褐色、棕色、褪色的黑色和阳光暴晒后的奶油色。

主体：前景中心展示一位年轻女性旅行者，半身像，一只手拿着单反相机，另一只手拿着一张展开的纸质地图。她穿着一件宽松的白色开衫，内搭白色短款上衣，下身穿着印花蜡染风格裙子，背着背包带，佩戴小巧首饰，头发随意扎起。她的脸部被柔和的矩形模糊处理，而身体其余部分保持清晰且具有照片级的真实感。

文字内容：顶部使用巨大的做旧红色标题，内容为“{argument name="headline text" default="INDONESIA"}”。在其下方，添加一行蓝色大写标语：“{argument name="tagline" default="THOUSANDS OF ISLANDS, ENDLESS ADVENTURES"}”。再下方，添加一行红色手写体引语：“{argument name="script quote" default="Where culture, nature and smiles come together"}”。底部放置一条深青色长条，上面印有白色大写文字：“NOT JUST A DESTINATION, IT’S AN EXPERIENCE”。

布局与拼贴元素：在旅行者周围包含 12 个清晰可见的旅行元素：1) 左侧的巴厘岛多层宝塔，2) 右侧的婆罗浮屠风格石塔，3) 上中背景中云雾缭绕的火山，4) 下中繁忙的印度尼西亚城市街道，有摩托车和交通流，5) 右下角的一辆绿松石色公共汽车，6) 右上角的棕榈叶，7) 左下角的一盘印尼沙爹或烤肉配米饭，8) 食物附近的一朵白色鸡蛋花，9) 左上角一个黄色的“WELCOME TO INDONESIA”标签，10) 右上角一张印有火山插图的“REPUBLIK INDONESIA”印尼邮票，11) 右上角附近的圆形巴厘岛邮戳，以及 12) 左下角印有雅加达、CGK、印度尼西亚字样及 Garuda 标志的护照机票票据。

目的地路标：在右侧，垂直堆叠 5 个木制箭头路标，均指向右侧，分别标注：“BALI”、“YOGYAKARTA”、“LABUAN BAJO”、“RAJA AMPAT”和“LOMBOK”。

品牌标识：右下角包含一个圆形贴纸标志，写着“wonderful indonesia”，并配有色彩鲜艳的流线型鸟类徽章。

风格限制：将照片级真实感的旅行摄影与插画纸质拼贴、复古旅游海报排版、撕纸分层、半色调颗粒、划痕、邮戳和柔和的电影感对比度相结合。保持所有文字清晰易读，除列出的名称外，避免添加额外的目的地名称，且不要添加水印或现代 UI 元素。

The woman possesses exceptionally long, flowing hair {argument name="hair color" default="Bright pink hair with blue-green highlights on the inner layers."} She wears a shiny black off-the-shoulder tech jacket covered in neon circuit patterns, revealing one shoulder and adorned with dangling earrings; her transparent iridescent skirt and shoulder straps shimmer with blue-pink light. Add exactly one visible flying drone or hovercraft to the sky. The skyline is extremely dense, filled with countless skyscrapers, holographic screens, vertical neon signs, and wet rooftops; the image must contain exactly three clearly visible Japanese elements: the largest magenta tower billboard reads "Future City," the smaller sign on the right reads "Hotel," and the woman's sleeve reads "Future." The composition must include exactly two opaque privacy/occlusion blocks: a deep plum-colored square obscuring the woman's face, and a pink vertical rectangle obscuring the center of the giant billboard on the right.{argument name="art style" default="Exquisite watercolor cyberpunk anime concept art"} Dramatic backlighting, high detail, romantic rain scene, non-realistic style, non-clean vector look, no extra characters, and no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅竖构图的赛博朋克水彩插画，画面中一位年轻女性背对着观众站在高处屋顶阳台上，俯瞰着夜晚广阔且阴雨连绵的未来城市。尽管背景设定为反乌托邦，但整体氛围柔和且充满吸引力，运用了明亮的霓虹洋红色、青色、紫色和深靛蓝色的水彩渲染，呈现出可见的水彩纸纹理、墨迹边缘、雨痕、喷溅效果以及发光的倒影。这位女性拥有极长的随风飘逸的 {argument name="hair color" default="亮粉色头发，内层带有青蓝色挑染"}，露出单侧肩膀，佩戴着垂坠耳环，身穿一件覆盖着霓虹电路图案的亮面黑色露肩科技夹克；她透明的虹彩裙摆和肩带散发着蓝粉色的光芒。在天空中添加正好一个可见的飞行无人机或气垫船。天际线极其密集，布满了无数摩天大楼、全息屏幕、垂直霓虹灯牌和湿漉漉的屋顶；画面中需包含正好三个清晰可见的日文元素：最大的洋红色塔楼广告牌上写着「未来都市」，右侧较小的招牌上写着「ホテル」，女性袖子上写着「未来」。构图中需包含正好两个不透明的隐私/遮挡块：一个深李子色的正方形遮住女性面部区域，以及一个粉色垂直长方形遮住右侧巨型广告牌的中心。使用 {argument name="art style" default="精致的水彩赛博朋克动漫概念艺术"}，戏剧性的背光，高细节，浪漫的雨景，非写实风格，非干净的矢量外观，无额外角色，且无水印。

templates.title: Pi presentation template collage

titleLocalized.zh: Pi 演示文稿模板拼贴画

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="product name" default="Pi"} Create a sophisticated promotional collage showcasing how presentation visuals can be both beautiful and versatile by default. Canvas: Square 1:1 image, approximately 768 x 768 pixels, white background, a compact mosaic of rounded rectangular presentation slide thumbnails separated by thin white lines. Employs soft shadows, subtle bevel effects, and an aesthetic style reminiscent of modern SaaS launch ads. Layout: 17 visible slide tiles are precisely arranged in an irregular grid around a central main banner. The central banner occupies most of the width, featuring a dark, rounded square app icon on the left with a striking light blue "Pi" logo and a small diamond decoration, and a bold black slogan on the right.{argument name="main slogan" default="Beautiful by default. Limitless by design."} It is surrounded by various presentation templates, blending styles of editing, history, abstraction, photography, and product design. Visible Tile Quantity and Content: Contains 17 individual tiles: 1) A fantasy landscape in a painterly style in the top left corner, with a glowing ring above the water and mountains; 2) A dark "Standards" slide in the top center, with a belt photo, mustard-colored title text, and a row of small icons on the left; 3) A wide purple and white "Design" slide in the top right corner, with an illustration of a seated laptop and geometric UI decorations; 4) A "Design" title slide in a soft gradient in the far right corner; 5) A black and white "Legacy" slide in the middle left, with the words cropped and a grayscale portrait of a person holding an object, their face blurred in gray; 6) A "Suzhou" slide in the center, with a serif title, light-colored mountains, and a black and white photo of a classical Chinese garden; 7) A retro storybook-style "Prince:" slide in the middle right, with the Little Prince sitting on a planet under the stars; 8) An antique mural/fresco slide in the middle left, with only the end of the words visible; 9) A centrally dominant {argument name="product name" default="Pi"} 10) The dark lecture slide on the far right, titled “3. Masterworks: Iconic Re…”, features dense bulleted text and small icons; 11) The “Solstice” slide in the lower left corner features soft watercolor greenery, sun, lakes, and sunflowers; 12) The “Craftsmanship” slide in the center below features a serif title, small circular icons, photos of folded fabric, and signature tags; 13) The map slide in the lower right corner features a stylized topographic map and orange route lines; 14) The small “Route” card on the far right features four colored square legend markers; 15) The hazy karst landscape photo tile in the lower left corner; 16) The “3. User Experience Design” slide in the center below features paragraphs, bulleted cards, and smartphone mockups on a light iridescent background; 17) The beige “Morandi Color System: Definition, History, and Professional Applications” slide in the lower right corner features soft vase and plant decorations, and a partially visible blue-purple technology slide titled “Apple Liquid G…” "Next-Generation Interface Design". Visual Style: The collage should present the high-end main image quality of an AI-generated product launch presentation: clear typography, high visual diversity, 12–18 pixel rounded corners, clean white dividing lines, subtle depth, and a balanced combination of neutral tones, soft purples, sage greens, soft blues, charcoal grays, cream, and watercolor textures. Text Restrictions: Keep the central tagline prominent and fully legible. Other slide titles can be smaller but should look like real presentation text. Use only English text. Do not add people outside the slide thumbnails for descriptions, do not add browser borders, and do not include any watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="product name" default="Pi"} 创建一张精致的宣传拼贴画，展示演示文稿的视觉效果在默认情况下也能既美观又多样。

画布：方形 1:1 图像，约 768×768 像素，白色背景，由圆角矩形演示文稿 Slides 缩略图组成的紧凑马赛克，中间由细白线隔开。采用柔和阴影、微妙的斜面效果以及现代 SaaS 发布广告的美学风格。

布局：在中心主横幅周围的不规则网格中精确排列 17 个可见的幻灯片磁贴。中心横幅占据大部分宽度，左侧包含一个深色圆角方形应用图标，带有醒目的浅蓝色“Pi”标志和一个小钻石装饰，右侧为加粗的黑色标语 {argument name="main slogan" default="Beautiful by default. Limitless by design."}。周围环绕着各种演示文稿模板，融合了编辑、历史、抽象、摄影和产品设计风格。

可见磁贴数量及内容：包含 17 个独立的磁贴：1) 左上角绘画风格的奇幻景观，水面和山脉上方有一个发光的圆环；2) 上方中央深色“Standards”幻灯片，左侧有皮带照片，芥末色标题文本，以及小图标行；3) 右上角宽幅紫色和白色“Design”幻灯片，带有坐着的笔记本电脑插图和几何 UI 装饰；4) 最右上角柔和渐变色的“Design”标题幻灯片；5) 左侧中间黑白“Legacy”幻灯片，单词部分被裁剪，灰度肖像中人物手持物体，面部被灰色模糊遮挡；6) 中央中间“Suzhou”幻灯片，带有衬线标题、浅色山脉以及黑白古典中国园林照片；7) 右侧中间复古故事书风格“Prince:”幻灯片，一个小王子形象坐在星空下的星球上；8) 最左侧中间部分被裁剪的古董壁画/湿壁画幻灯片，仅可见单词的结尾；9) 中央主导的 {argument name="product name" default="Pi"} 标志和标语横幅；10) 最右侧深色讲座幻灯片，标题为“3. Masterworks: Iconic Re…”，带有密集的项目符号文本和小图标；11) 左下角“Solstice”幻灯片，带有柔和的水彩绿植、太阳、湖泊和向日葵；12) 下方中央“Craftsmanship”幻灯片，带有衬线标题、小圆形图标、折叠织物照片和签名标签；13) 右下角地图幻灯片，带有风格化的地形图和橙色路线线；14) 最右侧小型“Route”卡片，带有四个彩色方形图例标记；15) 左下角朦胧的喀斯特山河照片磁贴；16) 下方中央“3. User Experience Design”幻灯片，在浅色虹彩背景上包含段落、项目符号卡片和智能手机模型；17) 右下角米色“Morandi Color System: Definition, History, and Professional Applications”幻灯片，带有柔和的花瓶和植物装饰，以及一张部分可见的蓝紫色科技幻灯片，标题为“Apple Liquid G… Next-Generation Interface Design”。

视觉风格：拼贴画应呈现出 AI 演示文稿生成产品发布的高级主图质感：清晰的排版、高度的视觉多样性、12–18 像素的圆角、干净的白色分隔线、微妙的深度感，以及中性色调、柔和紫、鼠尾草绿、柔和蓝、炭灰、奶油色和水彩纹理的平衡组合。

文本限制：保持中心标语醒目且完全清晰可辨。其他幻灯片标题可以较小，但应看起来像真实的演示文稿文本。仅使用英文文本。不要在描述的幻灯片缩略图之外添加人物，不要添加浏览器边框，也不要包含任何水印。

templates.prompt: Create a hyperrealistic vertical portrait photograph, with the subject being {argument name="subject" default="An elegant adult woman"} The scene is set in a softly lit, luxurious bathroom or spa. The subject is framed from the chest up to the top of the head, slightly turned to the viewer's right, with long, dark brown, wavy hair loosely tucked behind the ears and falling over the left shoulder. She wears a cream-colored satin robe or blouse with a deep V-neck that reveals her natural collarbone, neck texture, subtle freckles and moles, warm tan skin, realistic pores, fine body hair, and natural highlights from the sunlight. A large, opaque square mask covers the entire face, extending from the forehead to below the mouth, filled with a smooth brown skin gradient, obscuring all facial features while leaving the hair, ears, neck, shoulders, and clothing visible.{argument name="lighting" default="warm afternoon sunlight"} Creates soft shadows and luminous skin highlights. Background: Light-depth marble wall panels, soft beige-grey stone, a vertical brass or gold decorative line on the right, and blurred white flowers on the left, creating an overall high-end and tranquil interior atmosphere. Photography style: Realistic editorial beauty portrait, 4:5 vertical crop, 768x1024 composition, retaining natural imperfections, no text, no watermark, no jewelry, and no other people.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超写实的竖版肖像照片，主体为 {argument name="subject" default="一位优雅的成年女性"}，场景设定在光线柔和的奢华浴室或水疗中心内。主体取景范围从胸部以上至头顶，身体略微朝向观众右侧，留着深棕色长波浪卷发，头发松散地别在耳后并垂落在左肩。她身穿奶油色缎面长袍或衬衫，深 V 领口展现出自然的锁骨、颈部纹理、细微的雀斑和痣、温暖的棕褐色皮肤、真实的毛孔、细小的体毛以及阳光带来的自然高光。在整个面部覆盖一个巨大的不透明方形遮挡块，中心位置从额头延伸至嘴部下方，填充平滑的棕色肤色渐变，遮住所有面部特征，同时保留头发、耳朵、颈部、肩膀和衣物可见。使用 {argument name="lighting" default="温暖的午后自然阳光"}，营造柔和的阴影和亮泽的皮肤高光。背景：浅景深大理石墙板、柔和的米灰色石材、右侧有一条垂直的黄铜或金色装饰线条、左侧有模糊的白色花朵，整体呈现高端宁静的室内氛围。摄影风格：写实编辑类美妆肖像，4:5 竖版裁剪，768x1024 构图，保留自然瑕疵，无文字，无水印，无首饰，无其他人物。

templates.title: Rusty and dilapidated clockwork remnants

titleLocalized.zh: 锈迹斑驳的颓废发条遗迹

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic, ultra-detailed wide-angle scene to showcase a landscape eroded by nature.{argument name="setting" default="Abandoned Victorian-era industrial greenhouse power station"} The image includes rusty iron beams, broken glass walls, a soaring arched fiberglass ceiling, hanging ivy, moss, stagnant water, corroded pipes, turbine-like machinery, and a dark feldspar corridor leading to a bright, round window in the distance. In the left foreground, a decaying metal console covered in rust and moss sits atop an ornate antique fireplace clock with yellowed Roman numerals and delicate gold-brown filigree. Seven visible analog time and pressure gauges are precisely displayed in the foreground: one ornate fireplace clock at the top, five small round gauges embedded in the sloping surface of the console, and one round gauge hanging below near the central lever mechanism. Added are old brass levers, valves, empty round ports, cracked glass, verdigris, and a heavy patina. The atmosphere is {argument name="mood" default="Rusty decay, melancholic beauty, time reshaping industry"} Utilizing the warm, golden hour sunlight streaming through broken rooftops and high windows, the composition creates dramatic volumetric light, floating dust, deep green shadows, amber highlights, damp, reflective stones, and high contrast. The composition must be highly immersive and photorealistic, showcasing a dystopian steampunk ruin abandoned decades ago, with no people, no modern objects, no clear text, and no watermarks. A 16:9 aspect ratio is used, with sharp foreground details, rich textures, cinematic color grading, and a profound atmosphere.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个电影级、超精细的广角场景，展现一个被自然侵蚀的 {argument name="setting" default="废弃的维多利亚时代工业温室发电站"}，画面中包含锈迹斑斑的铁梁、破碎的玻璃墙、高耸的拱形玻璃钢结构天花板、悬垂的常春藤、苔藓、积水、腐蚀的管道、涡轮状机械，以及一条通向远端明亮圆形窗户的深色长石走廊。在左侧前景处，放置一个覆盖着铁锈和苔藓的腐朽金属控制台，上方摆放着一个华丽的古董壁炉钟，钟面为泛黄的罗马数字，并带有精致的金棕色花丝装饰。在前景中精确展示 7 个可见的模拟时间和压力仪表：顶部 1 个华丽的壁炉钟，控制台斜面上嵌入 5 个小型圆形仪表，中央杠杆机构附近悬挂 1 个下方的圆形仪表。添加旧黄铜杠杆、阀门、空的圆形端口、裂纹玻璃、铜绿和厚重的包浆。氛围为 {argument name="mood" default="锈迹颓废、忧郁之美、时间重塑工业"}。利用透过破碎屋顶和高窗射入的温暖黄金时刻阳光，营造出戏剧性的体积光、漂浮的尘埃、深绿色的阴影、琥珀色的高光、湿润反光的地面石块以及高对比度。构图需极具沉浸感且呈现照片级真实感，展现出废弃数十年后的反乌托邦蒸汽朋克遗迹，画面中无人、无现代物品、无清晰文字、无水印。使用 16:9 横向比例，前景细节锐利，纹理丰富，采用电影级调色，并具备深邃的氛围感。

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高级时装杂志风格的摄影棚肖像，主角为 {argument name="model description" default="一位皮肤白皙、梳着背头的金发女性"}，以四分之三侧身姿态站立在极具戏剧性的抽象厚涂画背景前。模特取景范围从大腿上部至头部，略微偏向画面左侧，双肩裸露，双臂自然下垂，其中一只手显露在裙子前方。用柔和的米灰色垂直矩形模糊效果遮盖面部，使肖像呈现出匿名感与概念感。为她穿上 {argument name="outfit" default="一件具有雕塑感的抹胸金属银色缎面礼服"}，礼服带有夸张的折纸式褶皱，胸部和臀部有锐利的建筑感荷叶边，并散发着冷冽的反射光泽。背景应为厚重的表现主义油画墙面，带有大面积的调色刀笔触和浓郁的纹理；使用 5 种主导色调：深海军蓝、钴蓝、青色、炭黑以及金属银白色。灯光采用情绪化且具有方向性的左上方侧光，强调光泽感皮肤、缎面高光以及凸起的颜料纹理，右侧留有深邃阴影。风格：奢华时尚杂志封面美学、先锋高定、绘画式抽象表现主义、电影级对比度、写实摄影与艺术背景的融合，垂直 4:5 构图，无文字，无 Logo，无水印。

templates.title: Vintage North American stamp grid

titleLocalized.zh: 复古北美邮票网格

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a clean, retro-illustrated stamp gallery for a North American city map series, serving as a collectible UI or exportable resource. Canvas: Landscape canvas, approximately 870 x 653 pixels, off-white background, with ample margins and even spacing. Arrange the stamps precisely in a 3x6 grid, totaling 18 stamps. Each city appears in a pair: the first is a sepia monochrome stamp, and the second is a soft full-color version. Layout: Use three horizontal rows, six stamps per row. Leave ample white space between stamp pairs and rows. Add a light gray export filename label to the lower left of each stamp pair, such as “stamp-export-atlas-north-america-46”, “stamp-export-atlas-north-america-47”, “stamp-export-atlas-north-america-48”, and so on to all visible groups. Stamp Design: Each stamp is vertical, featuring cream-colored perforated edges, an aged paper texture, delicate decorative borders, and an oval or arched central illustrated window. "SOL" is marked in the upper left corner and "100" in the upper right. At the bottom of each stamp is a ribbon banner indicating the city or neighborhood name, with stacked location text below. The design utilizes engraved lines, vintage travel poster compositions, soft shadows, and slightly worn ink. Precise stamp count and label: Contains 18 individual stamps in left-to-right, top-to-bottom order: 1. Tan Boston, Massachusetts, USA (Narrow historic street scene); 2. Color Boston, Massachusetts, USA (Red brick buildings and streetlights); 3. Tan Charlotte, North Carolina, USA (Comfortable storefront street and "Noda" sign); 4. Color Charlotte, North Carolina, USA (Colorful buildings, plants, and blue sky); 5. Tan Chicago, Illinois, USA (Vertical "Chicago" theater sign and city buildings); 6. Color Chicago, Illinois, USA (Same theater sign with warm gold and cyan hues); 7. Tan Wake Park, Chicago, Illinois, USA (Storefront); 8. Use customizable collection markers.{argument name="stamp currency text" default="SOL"} ,face value{argument name="stamp value" default="100"} and the file extension for exported files{argument name="export filename prefix" default="stamp-export-atlas-north-america"} City labels are retained in readable English, but the overall series theme is allowed.{argument name="atlas region" default="North America"} The visual effect is{argument name="stamp finish" default="alternating sepia engraving and muted full color"} Visual Style: Antique engraved postal prints, travel stamp forms, cream paper, fan-shaped perforations, subtle shadows, fine shading, warm sepia, faded inks, soft cyan, rust, ochre, brick red, and sky blue. Make the color stamps look like they were hand-colored, not modern digitally printed. Keep all stamps consistent in size and frame. promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一张整洁的复古插画风格邮票画廊，用于北美城市地图系列，作为可收藏的 UI 或导出素材呈现。

画布：横向画布，尺寸约为 870×653 像素，米白色背景，留有宽裕的边距和均匀的间距。将邮票精确排列为 3 行 6 列的网格，总计 18 枚邮票。每个城市以一对形式出现：第一枚为棕褐色单色邮票，第二枚为柔和的全彩版本。

布局：使用三行横向排列，每行六枚邮票。在邮票对和行之间留出宽阔的留白。在每对邮票组的左下方添加淡淡的灰色导出文件名标注，例如“stamp-export-atlas-north-america-46”、“stamp-export-atlas-north-america-47”、“stamp-export-atlas-north-america-48”，并以此类推至所有可见组。

邮票设计：每枚邮票均为竖向，带有奶油色齿孔边缘、陈旧纸张纹理、精致的装饰边框以及椭圆形或拱形的中央插画窗口。每枚邮票的左上角标注“SOL”，右上角标注“100”。在每枚邮票底部，包含一个丝带横幅，标注城市或街区名称，下方堆叠位置文本。使用雕刻线条、复古旅行海报构图、柔和阴影和略显磨损的墨迹。

精确的邮票数量与标签：按从左到右、从上到下的顺序包含 18 枚独立邮票：1 棕褐色波士顿，马萨诸塞州，美国（狭窄的历史街道场景）；2 彩色波士顿，马萨诸塞州，美国（红砖建筑和路灯）；3 棕褐色夏洛特，北卡罗来纳州，美国（舒适的店面街道和“Noda”标志）；4 彩色夏洛特，北卡罗来纳州，美国（色彩丰富的建筑、植物和蓝天）；5 棕褐色芝加哥，伊利诺伊州，美国（垂直的“Chicago”剧院标志和城市建筑）；6 彩色芝加哥，伊利诺伊州，美国（带有暖金色和青色调的相同剧院标志）；7 棕褐色威克公园，芝加哥，伊利诺伊州，美国（店面外观）；8 彩色威克公园，芝加哥，伊利诺伊州，美国（橙砖店面和青色标志）；9 棕褐色辛辛那提，俄亥俄州，美国（历史悠久的市场建筑）；10 彩色辛辛那提，俄亥俄州，美国（砖橙色、绿色装饰和天蓝色背景的相同市场）；11 棕褐色克利夫兰，俄亥俄州，美国（宏伟的拱形拱廊内部）；12 彩色克利夫兰，俄亥俄州，美国（青色玻璃天花板和温暖的室内透视）；13 棕褐色达拉斯，得克萨斯州，美国（天际线和“Deep Ellum”标志）；14 彩色达拉斯，得克萨斯州，美国（生动的街道色彩、青色天空和 Deep Ellum 标志）；15 棕褐色丹佛，科罗拉多州，美国（玻璃建筑前的蓝色熊雕像）；16 彩色丹佛，科罗拉多州，美国（明亮的蓝色熊和绿色玻璃幕墙）；17 棕褐色得梅因，艾奥瓦州，美国（都铎风格房屋）；18 彩色得梅因，艾奥瓦州，美国（红屋顶、奶油色墙壁、绿色草坪和蓝天）。

文本内容：邮票排版保持大写和复古衬线字体。使用可自定义的集合标记 {argument name="stamp currency text" default="SOL"}、面值 {argument name="stamp value" default="100"} 以及导出文件名后缀 {argument name="export filename prefix" default="stamp-export-atlas-north-america"}。城市标签保留为可读的英文，但允许整体系列主题为 {argument name="atlas region" default="North America"}，视觉效果为 {argument name="stamp finish" default="alternating sepia engraving and muted full color"}。

视觉风格：古董雕刻邮政印刷品、旅行邮票单、奶油色纸张、扇形齿孔、细微的投影、精细的阴影排线、暖棕色、褪色的墨水、柔和的青色、铁锈色、赭石色、砖红色和天蓝色。让彩色邮票看起来像是手工上色，而非现代数字印刷。保持所有邮票的尺寸和框架一致。

约束：不要添加人物、徽标、水印或额外的邮票。核心要求是 3×6 网格中正好 18 枚邮票，9 个列出地点均有棕褐色/彩色配对变体，清晰的城市/州/国家标签，每枚邮票上均有“SOL”和“100”，且组下方有淡淡的灰色导出文件名。

templates.title: Emerald Couture Seasonal Portraits

templates.prompt: Create a haute couture portrait with the texture of an oil painting, depicting an elegant woman and showcasing {argument name="season vibe" default="Winter Emerald Atmosphere"} The color palette is vibrant. A 3:4 vertical composition is used, with a waist-to-knee cut and dramatic studio lighting. The woman stands in an elegant, weight-shifted pose, one hand on her hip, wearing a flowing, deep {argument name="dress color" default="Emerald"} The haute couture gown featured a deep V-neck, a wrap-around bodice, multi-layered pleats, and long, semi-sheer chiffon sleeves with subtle gold highlights at the pleats. Her{argument name="hair color" default="Dark blue-black"} The hair is shoulder-length, glossy, and gently sways to one side in a breeze. The background is an abstract, impasto oil painting style, composed of broad palette knife brushstrokes in shades of cyan, forest green, deep blue, olive green, charcoal gray, and a touch of ochre. The overall atmosphere should be emotional, luxurious, artistic, and editorial, blending photorealistic fashion photography with a visible oil painting texture. Only a single portrait is included in the image; there is no text, no logos, no emphasis on jewelry, no additional props, and the face remains softly blurred or featureless to ensure the visual focus is on the contours, clothing, tone, and brushstrokes.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张具有油画质感的高级时装肖像，描绘一位优雅的女性，展现 {argument name="season vibe" default="冬季祖母绿氛围"} 的色调。采用 3:4 竖构图，腰部至膝盖的剪裁，戏剧性的影棚灯光。女性以优雅的重心偏移姿势站立，一只手放在腰间，身着飘逸的深 {argument name="dress color" default="祖母绿"} 高定礼服，礼服采用深 V 领口、包裹式上衣、多层褶皱设计、长款半透明雪纺袖，褶皱处带有微妙的金色高光。她的 {argument name="hair color" default="深青黑色"} 头发齐肩，富有光泽，并向一侧微风拂动。背景为抽象的厚涂油画风格，由青色、森林绿、深蓝、橄榄绿、炭灰色和少量赭石色调的宽大调色刀笔触组成。整体氛围应充满情绪感、奢华、艺术且具有编辑感，将照片级真实的时尚摄影与可见的油画质感融为一体。画面中仅保留一个人像，无文字，无标志，不强调珠宝，无额外道具，面部保持柔和模糊或无特征，以确保视觉焦点集中在轮廓、服装、色调和笔触上。

titleLocalized.zh: 迷人露背礼服肖像

templates.prompt: Create a portrait of a high-fashion editor with a vertical composition, featuring a glamorous woman who possesses {argument name="hair color" default="Flowing reddish-brown long hair"} She stood with three-quarters of her back to the camera, glancing back, her face deliberately obscured by a warm brown, opaque square veil that matched her skin tone. She wore a highly dramatic outfit.{argument name="dress color" default="black"} The backless evening gown features a halter neckline, pleated drapes at the waist and hips, and a metallic finish.{argument name="metallic accent color" default="gold"} Fabric embellishments wrap around her chest and waist. Her hair flows to the left as if caressed by a gentle breeze, adorned with elegant jewelry, including a dangling earring and a ring. She is placed against a backdrop of a large, abstract textured painting, featuring thick, impasto brushstrokes, palette knife relief effects, and warm autumnal hues: ochre, bronze, gold, rust red, burnt orange, cream, taupe, and smoky brown. Warm, directional studio lighting from the upper left creates soft shadows, realistic skin texture, glossy fabric highlights, and a luxurious gallery atmosphere. The framing extends from mid-thigh upwards, with a slightly right-leaning composition emphasizing the open back and silhouette. Photorealistic fashion photography, 4:5 vertical aspect ratio, rich contrast, painterly background, no visible text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张垂直构图的高级时尚编辑肖像，主角是一位迷人的女性，拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="飘逸的红棕色长发"}，以四分之三背影姿态站立，回眸凝视，脸部被一个与肤色相近的暖棕色不透明方形遮挡块刻意遮盖。她身着一件极具戏剧性的 {argument name="dress color" default="黑色"} 露背晚礼服，采用挂脖式领口，腰部和臀部有褶皱垂坠设计，金属质感的 {argument name="metallic accent color" default="金色"} 面料装饰环绕胸前与腰间。她的秀发向左飘动，仿佛被微风拂过，佩戴着优雅的珠宝，包括一只垂坠耳环和一枚戒指。将她置于一幅巨大的抽象纹理画背景前，画作呈现厚重的厚涂笔触、调色刀浮雕效果，以及温暖的秋季色调：赭石色、青铜色、金色、铁锈红、焦橙色、奶油色、灰褐色和烟棕色。使用来自左上方的温暖定向影棚灯光，营造柔和阴影、逼真的皮肤质感、光泽面料高光以及奢华的画廊氛围。取景范围从大腿中部向上，构图略微偏右，强调露背设计与轮廓。照片级逼真的时尚摄影，4:5 垂直比例，丰富的对比度，绘画感背景，无可见文字，无水印。

The color palette is predominantly {argument name="main color palette" default="Deep crimson, burgundy, black, soft brown, and accented with antique gold"} Mainly. The model has short, shiny hair.{argument name="hair color" default="black"} Her hair was styled to expose her shoulders, and she wore a highly sculpted outfit.{argument name="garment" default="A fluffy, off-the-shoulder red satin dress"} Featuring oversized folded cuffs and heavy, draped fabric, the gown presents deep shadows and a haute couture sheen. The pose is a three-quarter profile, revealing one shoulder, with one arm folded across the chest as if clutching the fabric. The gown stretches diagonally across the frame. The face is deliberately anonymized by a large, centrally located, blurred/solid-color gradient mask, obscuring features and transitioning from a darker shade near the hairline to a warmer skin tone below, while retaining some ear and hair visible. Background: Heavy palette knife brushstrokes and layered pigment textures, including reds, burgundy, ochre, black, and metallic gold, possess an expressiveness and tactile quality reminiscent of an abstract expressionist canvas. Dramatic studio lighting from the upper left emphasizes the satin highlights, skin texture, and deep fabric folds. The composition is compact, luxurious, and painterly; there is no text, watermark, jewelry, or other figures in the image.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖版的高级时装编辑风格肖像，主体为 {argument name="subject" default="一位优雅的中性风模特"}，半身姿态，背景为质感丰富的抽象厚涂油画。色调以 {argument name="main color palette" default="深绯红、酒红、黑色、柔和棕色以及点缀的古董金"} 为主。模特留着短而有光泽的 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"} 头发，露出双肩，身着一件极具雕塑感的 {argument name="garment" default="蓬松的露肩红色缎面礼服"}，配有超大折叠袖口、厚重的垂坠面料，呈现出深邃的阴影和高级定制的光泽感。姿态为四分之三侧身，露出一侧肩膀，一只手臂收拢在胸前，仿佛在抓紧布料，礼服斜向横跨画面。面部通过一个位于中央的大型方形模糊/纯色渐变遮罩进行刻意匿名处理，遮盖了五官，从发际线附近的深色过渡到下方的暖肤色，同时保留部分耳朵和头发可见。背景：厚重的调色刀笔触和层叠的颜料纹理，包含红色、酒红色、赭石色、黑色和金属金色，具有抽象表现主义画布般的表现力和触感。灯光采用左上方的戏剧性影棚光，强调缎面的高光、皮肤的质感以及深邃的布料褶皱。构图紧凑、奢华且具有绘画感，画面中无文字、无水印、无首饰，且无其他人物。

templates.title: Cloudflare Catch-All Email Routing Infographic

titleLocalized.zh: Cloudflare Catch-All 邮件路由信息图

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a landscape-style, hand-drawn notebook-style Chinese infographic explaining how to register multiple ChatGPT accounts using Catch-all email aliases created through Cloudflare Email Routing. Canvas: A widescreen 16:9 whiteboard page with a clean off-white background surrounded by a thick black dotted rounded border. Use a casual marker-style hand-drawn style with slightly imperfect lines, incorporating doodle arrows, stars, question marks, thumbtacks, and small emoji icons. Title and Description: A bold title centered at the top.{argument name="headline text" default="Registering my Nth ChatGPT account: Creating an email address using Cloudflare (hand-drawn notes)"} Underline "Cloudflare" in blue. Below it on the left, write the pain point text: "Pain Point: Only one account can be registered with the same email address; changing emails is inconvenient." Add a small curved arrow doodle and a star near the title. Overall Layout: Use 7 main content boxes/cards, supplemented with decorative doodles. Arrange them from left to right, connecting the parts with thick black arrows. These 7 cards are: 1 pain point card, 1 solution card, 1 core principle card, and 4 numbered step cards. Card 1 (Pain Point Card): A red-outlined sticky note box in the upper left corner with a sad red emoji icon. Text: "Want to register a new account? No new email address!" making it look like a folded sticky note. Card 2 (Solution Card): A blue rounded rectangle in the upper center with a blue cloud icon. Text: "Solution: Cloudflare Email Routing." Draw a blue arrow pointing to the core principle box. Card 3 (Core Principle Card): A large rounded rectangle with a black outline in the upper right corner. The title text reads: "Core Principle: Catch-all (Wildcard/Catch All)". It includes a funnel icon. The left side shows four example input aliases: "chatgpt@", "netflix@", "test1@", and "any prefix @". Arrows are drawn from these four aliases to a large "@" symbol and "@yourdomain.com", followed by a thick black arrow pointing to an email icon labeled "Real Email (e.g., Gmail)". The bottom text, with a green checkmark icon, reads: "All automatically forwarded, unified aggregation! No need to create in advance." The bottom step cards use four numbered boxes. Step 1 card (bottom left): Title "Step 1: Preparation". It includes three numbered requirements: "1. Cloudflare account (free registration)", "2. Your domain (DNS hosted on CF)", and "3. Real email (to receive forwards)". A globe icon, a green checkmark, and a yellow key icon are added. Small text below reads: "Recommended domains: High cost-performance ratio (e.g., .top domains)". Step 2 Card (bottom left): Title "Step Two: Activate and Verify the Target Email". Includes a small computer icon labeled "CF Console". Flow text: "Add Domain → Resolution → Activation". Draw an arrow pointing to a small DNS name server panel below, divided into two columns: "Aliyun (Modify NS)" on the left and "Cloudflare (Waiting for Activation, Status: Active)" on the right. Below the card, draw a name server list circled in red, containing two entries: "gene.ns.cloudflare.com" and "peyton.ns.cloudflare.com". Add a small alarm clock icon and the text "Approximately 30 minutes". Step 3 Card (bottom right): Title "Step Three: Set Up Email Routing". Shows a small Cloudflare UI mockup, containing two top tabs/boxes: "Email" and "Email Routing". Includes a small "Get Started" button pointing to "Binding Destination Address". Add an envelope icon at the bottom and the text: "Verify Email → Click Confirm". Below this card, place a blue status note titled "Test Forward Successful," and use two arrows to show the process of forwarding the alias to the Gmail address. Step 4 Card (bottom right): Titled "Step Four: Setting Routing Rules (Core Step)." Display a UI panel titled "Catch-all Rule Settings." Includes a blue switch labeled "Active." Contains a two-row table with headers and values: the first row, "Action," corresponds to "Send to"; the second row, "Destination," corresponds to "Your Real Email Address." Add a red star in the corner. Final Result Box: Below Step 4 in the bottom right corner, add a green rounded rectangle with a smiley face icon. Text: "Effect: Emails with any fabricated prefix during registration (e.g., chatgpt@yourdomain.com) will all be uniformly aggregated to your real email address, achieving 'email freedom'! Completely free!" Visual Style: Handwritten Chinese typography, bold black marker outlines, simple vector doodles, blue/red/green/yellow accent colors, informal classroom note feel. Keep all arrows bold and directional, with a slight hand-drawn imperfection. Constraints: The entire infographic must use Chinese as required, no photorealistic rendering, no 3D rendering, no watermarks, and must not exceed the scope of 7 cards and the final result box, ensuring the text is clear and legible.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：制作一张横版手绘笔记本风格的中文信息图，解释如何通过使用 Cloudflare Email Routing 创建 Catch-all 邮箱别名来注册多个 ChatGPT 账号。

画布：宽屏 16:9 白板页面，干净的米白色背景，周围环绕着粗黑色的虚线圆角边框。使用随意的马克笔手绘风格，线条略显不完美，配有涂鸦箭头、星星、问号、图钉和小型表情图标。

标题与简介：在顶部居中位置，书写加粗标题 {argument name="headline text" default="注册 ChatGPT 第 N 个账号：用 Cloudflare 造邮箱（手绘笔记）"}。用蓝色下划线标注“Cloudflare”。在其下方左侧，书写痛点文案：“痛点：同个邮箱只能注册一个账号，换邮箱麻烦。”在标题附近添加一个小巧的弯曲箭头涂鸦和星星。

整体布局：使用 7 个主要内容框/卡片，并辅以装饰性涂鸦。按从左到右的流程排列，并用粗黑色箭头连接各部分。这 7 个卡片分别是：1 个痛点卡片、1 个解决方案卡片、1 个核心原理卡片以及 4 个带编号的步骤卡片。

卡片 1（痛点卡片）：左上角一个红色轮廓的便利贴框，配有一个悲伤的红色表情图标。文字：“想注册新号？没新邮箱！”使其看起来像一张折角的便签。

卡片 2（解决方案卡片）：中上方一个蓝色圆角矩形，配有一个蓝色云朵图标。文字：“解决方案：Cloudflare Email Routing（邮箱路由）”。画一个蓝色箭头指向核心原理框。

卡片 3（核心原理卡片）：右上角一个黑色轮廓的大型圆角矩形。标题文字：“核心原理：Catch-all（通配符 / 捕获所有）”。包含一个漏斗图标。左侧展示 4 个示例传入别名：“chatgpt@”、“netflix@”、“test1@”以及“任意前缀@”。画出箭头从这四个别名指向一个巨大的“@”符号和“@你的域名.com”，然后画一条粗黑色箭头指向一个标注为“真实邮箱（如 Gmail）”的邮箱图标。底部配有绿色对勾图标的文案：“全部自动转发，统一汇总！无需提前创建。”

底部步骤卡片：使用 4 个带编号的方框。

步骤 1 卡片（左下）：标题“第一步：准备工作”。包含 3 个带编号的要求：“1. Cloudflare 账号（免费注册）”、“2. 你的域名（DNS 托管在 CF）”、“3. 真实邮箱（接收转发）”。添加一个地球图标、一个绿色对勾和一个黄色钥匙图标。下方添加小字：“域名推荐：性价比高（如 top 域名）”。

步骤 2 卡片（中左下）：标题“第二步：启用并验证目标邮箱”。包含一个标注为“CF 控制台”的小型电脑图标。流程文字：“添加域名 → 解析 → 激活”。画一个箭头指向下方的一个小型 DNS 名称服务器面板，分为两列：左侧“阿里云（修改 NS）”，右侧“Cloudflare（等待生效，状态：活动）”。在卡片下方，画一个红色圈出的名称服务器列表，包含 2 个条目：“gene.ns.cloudflare.com”和“peyton.ns.cloudflare.com”。添加一个小闹钟图标和文字“约 30 分钟”。

步骤 3 卡片（中右下）：标题“第三步：设置邮件路由”。展示一个小型 Cloudflare UI 模拟图，包含 2 个顶部标签/方框：“Email（电子邮件）”和“Email Routing（路由）”。包含一个指向“绑定目标地址（Destination address）”的小型“Get Started”按钮。底部添加一个信封图标和文字：“验证邮件 → 点击确认”。在此卡片下方放置一个蓝色状态备注，标题为“测试转发成功”，并用两条箭头线展示别名转发到 Gmail 地址的过程。

步骤 4 卡片（右下）：标题“第四步：设置路由规则（核心步骤）”。展示一个标题为“Catch-all 规则设置”的 UI 面板。包含一个标注为“Active（启用）”的蓝色开关。包含一个两行表格，带有表头和值：第一行“Action（操作）”对应“Send to（发送至）”；第二行“Destination（目标）”对应“你的真实邮箱”。在角落处添加一颗红星。

最终结果框：在右下角步骤 4 的下方，添加一个带有笑脸图标的绿色圆角矩形。文字：“效果：注册时随意编造前缀（例如 chatgpt@yourdomain.com）邮件全部统一汇总到真实邮箱，实现「邮箱自由」！全程免费！”

视觉风格：手写中文排版，粗黑色马克笔轮廓，简单的矢量涂鸦，蓝/红/绿/黄强调色，非正式的课堂笔记感。保持所有箭头加粗且具有指向性，带有轻微的手绘不完美感。

约束：整张信息图必须按要求使用中文，不使用照片级真实感，不使用 3D 渲染，不添加水印，不超出 7 个卡片和最终结果框的范畴，并确保文字清晰易读。

templates.title: Luxury skincare product advertising

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华护肤品广告宣传

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="brand name" default="popcraft.ai"} Create a luxurious vertical beauty ad, styled like a high-end skincare magazine spread. Canvas: 3:4 vertical composition, warm cream and blush pink tones, soft diffused sunlight, glossy reflections on the tabletop, elegant fashion magazine lighting. Layout: Place a captivating young woman on the left, seated at a dressing table in front of a cream-colored sheer curtain. Her face is partially obscured by a centrally located opaque soft brown square, but her long, wavy brown hair, bare shoulders, pearl and gold necklace, dangling flower earrings, and champagne-pink satin robe are clearly visible. Display the product line on a transparent acrylic display stand on the right and below. Place the main title and brand logo in the upper right corner. Text content: Small orange icon and brand text in the upper right corner:{argument name="brand name" default="popcraft.ai"} The main title is in an elegant, large, dusty pink serif font in the upper right corner.{argument name="headline text" default="RADIANCE REFINED. BEAUTY DEFINED."} A small floral divider icon is placed below. The subtitle uses spaced-out serif capital letters.{argument name="subheadline text" default="LUXURY SKINCARE, CRAFTED FOR YOU."} Below is very small supplementary text:{argument name="supporting copy" default="Advanced Care. Timeless Glow. Unveil Your Most Radiant Skin."} Product Details: Six clearly visible skincare products are displayed, each featuring the minimalist popcraft.ai brand logo and a small orange logo: 1. A short, round, gold-capped cream jar on the front left, labeled "LA CRÈME"; 2. A tall, white squeeze tube with a gold cap near the center, labeled "LA MOUSSE DOUCE NETTOYANTE"; 3. A tall, frosted ivory lotion bottle with a rounded, reflective gold cap, labeled "LA LOTION"; 4. A short, round, gold-capped jar in the center front, labeled "LE BAUME"; 5. A tall, reflective metallic gold serum bottle on the right center, labeled "SÉRUM"; 6. An oval, transparent gold-capped bottle on the far right, labeled "L'ESSENCE DE BEAUTÉ". A small gold and white makeup spatula or applicator is placed in front. Scene Setup: The lower left corner is adorned with blush-pink roses and cream-colored flowers, while the right background features a soft, blurred floral effect. A string of pearls is scattered on the table, and a multi-faceted crystal glass is placed in the lower left corner, displayed using a transparent acrylic block that reflects a warm golden light. Visual Style: An exquisitely realistic luxury skincare advertisement with shallow depth of field, cream-colored highlights, soft bokeh, rose gold accents, and a refined, feminine atmosphere, reflecting the aesthetics of high-end magazine beauty advertising. Constraints: Maintain a clean and sophisticated composition, strictly retain 6 main products, maintain a clear heading hierarchy, avoid adding extra products or redundant text, avoid harsh shadows, and keep the image clean.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="brand name" default="popcraft.ai"} 创建一则奢华的竖版美妆广告，风格对标高端护肤品杂志大片。

画布：3:4 竖构图，暖奶油色与腮红粉色调，柔和的漫射日光，光泽感反射桌面，优雅的时尚杂志布光。

布局：将一位迷人的年轻女性置于左侧，坐在奶油色薄纱窗帘前的梳妆台旁。她的面部被居中的不透明柔棕色方块遮挡，但她长长的棕色波浪卷发、裸露的肩部、珍珠金饰项链、垂坠花朵耳环以及香槟粉色缎面长袍清晰可见。将产品系列陈列在右侧及下方的透明亚克力展示台上。主标题和品牌标识置于右上角。

文本内容：右上角为小型橙色图标及品牌文字：{argument name="brand name" default="popcraft.ai"}。右上角使用优雅的烟粉色大号衬线字体作为主标题：{argument name="headline text" default="RADIANCE REFINED. BEAUTY DEFINED."}。下方配有一个小型花卉分割图标。副标题采用字间距拉开的衬线大写字母：{argument name="subheadline text" default="LUXURY SKINCARE, CRAFTED FOR YOU."}。下方配有极小的辅助文案：{argument name="supporting copy" default="Advanced Care. Timeless Glow. Unveil Your Most Radiant Skin."}。

产品细节：展示 6 款清晰可见的护肤品，每款均带有极简的 popcraft.ai 品牌标识及小型橙色 Logo：1. 左前方一个矮圆金盖面霜罐，标签为“LA CRÈME”；2. 中心附近一支高挑白色挤压管，配金色瓶盖，标签为“LA MOUSSE DOUCE NETTOYANTE”；3. 一支高挑磨砂象牙白乳液瓶，配圆润反光金盖，标签为“LA LOTION”；4. 前方中心一个矮圆金盖小罐，标签为“LE BAUME”；5. 中右侧一支高挑反光金属金精华液瓶，标签为“SÉRUM”；6. 最右侧一个椭圆形透明金盖瓶，标签为“L’ESSENCE DE BEAUTÉ”。在前方放置一个小型金白相间的化妆抹刀或涂抹棒。

场景布置：左下方点缀腮红粉色玫瑰与奶油色花卉，右侧背景呈现柔和的花卉虚化效果，桌面上散落着一串珍珠，左下方放置一个多面切割水晶杯，使用透明亚克力展示块，并呈现温暖的金色反射光。

视觉风格：极致精美的写实风奢华护肤品广告，浅景深，奶油色高光，柔和的焦外成像，玫瑰金点缀，精致的女性化氛围，高端杂志美妆宣传美学。

约束条件：保持构图简洁高端，严格保留 6 款主要产品，维持清晰的标题层级，避免添加额外产品或多余文字，无生硬阴影，画面整洁。

templates.title: AI Cosplay Expo Logo Design Guide

titleLocalized.zh: AI Cosplay Expo 标志设计指南

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="event name" default="AI COSPLAY EXPO 2026"} Create a concise black and white logo guide and user manual, presented in a professional brand identity document format. Canvas: Portrait A4 page, white background, thin light gray dividing lines, ample margins, presenting a clear monochrome vector style. Use a bold, futuristic sans-serif font, all caps, high-contrast black ink. Header: The top left corner title is "AI COSPLAY EXPO 2026," with a smaller subtitle below, "INTERNATIONAL EVENT." The top right corner label reads "LOGO GUIDE & USAGE SHEET." A thin horizontal line separates the header from the main content. Core Logo Design: The logo features a cute anime-style twin-tailed cosplay girl silhouette in black, placed within four broken right-angle brackets, with a small diamond-shaped glitter below. Combine this with the bold text "AI COSPLAY EXPO" and the large, stacked numbers "2026," along with the tagline "- INTERNATIONAL EVENT -" and the production attribution "produced by{argument name="producer name" default="AI lady collection"} Layout: The page is divided into 7 numbered brand guide sections using small black square numbers and thin gray lines. Sections: 1. “PRIMARY LOGO – HORIZONTAL”: A large horizontal combination. The symbol is on the left, and the text is on the right: “AI COSPLAY EXPO” is above a huge “2026”, the tagline “- INTERNATIONAL EVENT -”, and the production signature “produced by AI lady collection”. 2. “STACKED LOGO”: A vertically centered combination. The symbol is at the top, “AI COSPLAY EXPO” is stacked in three rows, and below is a huge “2026”, the tagline, and the production signature. 3. “SYMBOL MARK”: A standalone display containing only a large silhouette symbol. 4. “MONOCHROME VARIATIONS”: Showcases 4 logo variations: a black horizontal logo, a gray/outline horizontal logo, a black stacked logo, and a gray/outline stacked logo. 5. “INVERTED (WHITE ON BLACK)”: A black rectangle containing 2 6. "CLEAR SPACE / MINIMUM SIZE": The left side displays a horizontal logo within a dotted white box, with "A" spacing markers at the top, left, right, and bottom; the right side displays two minimum size examples: "MINIMUM SIZE (PRINT)" with a width of "25mm / 0.98 in", and "MINIMUM SIZE (DIGITAL)" with a width of "32px". 7. "USAGE EXAMPLES": Displays four simple outline icons with labels: a globe icon labeled "INTERNATIONAL APPAREL", a ticket icon labeled "EVENTS & TICKETING", an open book icon labeled "MAGAZINE & EDITORIAL", and a medal icon labeled "STAFF & EXHIBITOR". Footer: The bottom strip is divided into three columns. The left column title is "ORGANIZER TEXT EXAMPLES", containing two lines of Japanese text: "Organizer: AI lady collection" and "Official SNS: AI lady". "Collection". The middle column contains a small stacked version of the logo. The right column is titled "CREDIT LINE" and includes the text "produced by AI lady collection". Visual style: A combination of minimalist Swiss grid and Japanese event brochure style, with precise alignment, thin gray dividing lines, and no other colors besides black, white, and light gray. Ensure all text is clear, sharp, and print-ready. Avoid adding extra sections, extra icons, watermarks, gradients, shadows, or decorative backgrounds.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="event name" default="AI COSPLAY EXPO 2026"} 创建一份简洁的黑白标志指南及使用手册，并以专业的品牌识别文档形式呈现。

画布：纵向 A4 页面，白色背景，细浅灰色分隔线，宽裕的页边距，呈现清晰的单色矢量风格。使用粗体未来感科技无衬线字体，全大写，高对比度黑色油墨。

页眉：左上角标题为“AI COSPLAY EXPO 2026”，下方附带小字副标题“INTERNATIONAL EVENT”。右上角小标签为“LOGO GUIDE & USAGE SHEET”。一条细水平线将页眉与主要内容分隔开。

核心标志设计：标志主体为一个可爱的动漫风格双马尾 Cosplay 女孩黑色剪影，置于四个断开的直角括号内，下方有一个小菱形闪光点。将其与粗体文字“AI COSPLAY EXPO”及巨大的堆叠数字“2026”组合，并加上小标语“- INTERNATIONAL EVENT -”和制作署名“produced by {argument name="producer name" default="AI lady collection"}”。

布局：使用黑色小方块数字标号和细灰色线条，将页面划分为 7 个编号的品牌指南板块。

板块：
1. “PRIMARY LOGO – HORIZONTAL”：大型水平组合。符号在左，文字在右：“AI COSPLAY EXPO”位于巨大的“2026”上方，标语“- INTERNATIONAL EVENT -”，以及制作署名“produced by AI lady collection”。
2. “STACKED LOGO”：垂直居中组合。符号在顶部，“AI COSPLAY EXPO”分三行堆叠，下方为巨大的“2026”、标语及制作署名。
3. “SYMBOL MARK”：仅包含大型剪影符号的独立展示。
4. “MONOCHROME VARIATIONS”：展示 4 种标志变体：黑色水平标志、灰色/轮廓水平标志、黑色堆叠标志、灰色/轮廓堆叠标志。
5. “INVERTED (WHITE ON BLACK)”：黑色矩形内包含 2 个白色反转标志：顶部为水平标志，下方为堆叠标志。
6. “CLEAR SPACE / MINIMUM SIZE”：左侧展示位于虚线留白框内的水平标志，顶部、左侧、右侧和底部带有“A”间距标记；右侧展示 2 个最小尺寸示例：“MINIMUM SIZE (PRINT)”标注宽度“25mm / 0.98 in”，以及“MINIMUM SIZE (DIGITAL)”标注宽度“32px”。
7. “USAGE EXAMPLES”：展示 4 个带标签的简单轮廓图标：地球图标标注“INTERNATIONAL APPAREL”，票据图标标注“EVENTS & TICKETING”，打开的书本图标标注“MAGAZINE & EDITORIAL”，奖章图标标注“STAFF & EXHIBITOR”。

页脚：底部条带分为三列。左列标题“ORGANIZER TEXT EXAMPLES”，包含两行日式文本：“主催: AI lady collection”和“公式 SNS: AI lady collection”。中列包含标志的小型堆叠版本。右列标题“CREDIT LINE”，包含文字“produced by AI lady collection”。

视觉风格：极简瑞士网格与日式活动品牌手册风格相结合，精确对齐，细灰色分隔线，除黑、白、浅灰外无其他颜色。确保所有文字清晰、锐利且适合印刷。避免添加额外板块、额外图标、水印、渐变、阴影或装饰性背景。

templates.title: Blurry shot of the esports stands

titleLocalized.zh: 电竞观众席模糊镜头

templates.prompt: Create a realistic snapshot of an event, taken from a dark indoor location.{argument name="event type" default="esports game tournament"} In the audience seating area. Using a 16:9 widescreen composition, employing cool blue and purple stage lighting to create a shallow depth of field and high ISO concert photography atmosphere, with a large, blurred, glowing LED screen in the background. In the foreground are three main audience members: on the left, a young man in a pure white long-sleeved shirt with black lanyards, relaxed with his hands at the bottom of the frame; in the middle, a young woman with long, dark wavy hair, wearing a light pink ribbed wrap-around cardigan, her hands folded on her knees; and on the right, a young man in a light gray sweatshirt, slightly turned towards the stage, holding a smartphone or small camera. Behind them is a dense crowd of audience members, some standing, some cheering. The frame must include three clearly visible inflatable light sticks: two long white sticks with red tips held vertically in the back left, and a blue and white light stick visible behind the audience member on the right. Added privacy anonymization: Eight softly edged purple rectangular blur blocks of varying sizes and opacities were placed over the visible faces, respectively covering the man in the left foreground, the person in the upper left rear, a small face in the center of the left rear, the person in the red plaid shirt in the center of the rear, the woman in the middle, a small face in the center of the right rear, a bald person in the center of the right rear, and the man in the right foreground. This gave the image the quality of a candid shot from a televised tournament, with natural movements, no visible text, logos, or watermarks, and realistic lighting effects.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实的活动抓拍照片，拍摄视角位于黑暗室内 {argument name="event type" default="电竞游戏锦标赛"} 的观众席中。采用 16:9 宽屏构图，运用冷蓝色和紫色的舞台灯光，营造浅景深和高 ISO 的演唱会摄影氛围，背景中有一个发光的巨大模糊 LED 屏幕。前景中有三位主要观众：左侧是一位身穿纯白色长袖衬衫、佩戴黑色挂绳的年轻男子，姿态放松，双手位于画面下方；中间是一位留着深色长波浪卷发的年轻女子，身穿淡粉色罗纹裹身针织衫，双手交叠放在膝盖上；右侧是一位身穿浅灰色卫衣的年轻男子，身体微微转向舞台，手持智能手机或小型相机。他们身后是密集的观众群，有的站立，有的在欢呼。画面中需包含 3 根清晰可见的充气应援棒：左后方竖直拿着两根顶端为红色的白色长棒，右侧观众身后部分可见一根蓝白相间的应援棒。添加隐私匿名处理：在可见的面部上放置 8 个边缘柔和的紫色矩形模糊块，大小和不透明度各异，分别覆盖左前景男子、左后方上方人物、左后方中心的一张小脸、后方中心穿红格子衫的人、中间的女子、右后方中心的一张小脸、右后方中心的一位秃头人物，以及右前景男子。使图像呈现出电视转播中锦标赛现场抓拍的质感，动作自然，无可见文字、无 Logo、无水印，光影效果真实。

templates.title: Extreme close-up portrait of a couple laughing heartily

titleLocalized.zh: 情侣开怀大笑的极致特写肖像

templates.prompt: Create an extreme close-up square macro portrait of a young couple laughing heartily, the image including both people: on the left is a person with messy hair{argument name="hair color" default="Light brown gold"} A young woman with wind-blown hair stands to her right, next to a young man with short, dark, tousled hair and a light stubble. Their faces are very close together, the composition compact, filling the entire frame; only parts of hair, cheeks, mouth, jawline, and the top edge of a dark chunky knit sweater are shown. Employing a candid, hyper-realistic editorial style, the photograph presents high-fidelity skin texture, natural pores, tiny freckles, a faint blush on the cheeks, realistic teeth and gums, and eyes squinting from intense laughter, revealing a genuine, imperfect expression. A dark, minimalist background and emotional, cinematic color grading are used, with deep, low-saturation tones that preserve the original warm skin tones. High contrast is achieved through soft, dramatic directional lighting that captures individual strands of hair, outlining the nose, eyebrows, lips, and cheeks. The effect is reminiscent of using…{argument name="camera look" default="35mm film"} With a shallow depth of field, the focus is clearly on the center where the two faces meet, and dark textured knitwear surrounds their necks, creating a raw and intimate atmosphere, presenting an award-winning fashion editorial realism. A 1:1 square ratio is used, and text, logos, extraneous figures, or excessively retouched beauty filters are avoided.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张年轻情侣开怀大笑的极致特写方形微距肖像，画面包含两人：左侧是一位留着凌乱 {argument name="hair color" default="浅棕金色"} 被风吹乱头发的年轻女性，右侧是一位留着深色蓬乱短发并带有浅浅胡茬的年轻男性。他们的脸贴得非常近，构图紧凑，填满整个画面；仅展示部分头发、脸颊、嘴巴、下颌线以及深色粗棒针织毛衣的上边缘。采用抓拍风格的超写实社论摄影手法，呈现高保真的皮肤纹理、自然毛孔、微小雀斑、淡淡的脸颊红晕、逼真的牙齿和牙龈，以及因剧烈欢笑而眯起的双眼和真实而不完美的表情。使用深色极简背景和情绪化的电影级调色，色调深沉且饱和度较低，保留原始的暖色调肤色，高对比度，并利用柔和且富有戏剧性的定向主光捕捉发丝，勾勒出鼻子、眉毛、嘴唇和脸颊的轮廓。拍摄效果如同使用 {argument name="camera look" default="35mm 胶片"}，浅景深，焦点清晰地落在两人脸部交汇的中心，颈部周围环绕着深色纹理针织衫，营造出原始而亲密的氛围，呈现获奖级的时尚社论写实感。使用 1:1 的方形比例，并避免出现文字、Logo、多余人物或过度修饰的美容磨皮效果。

templates.title: Rookie Veteran Character Setting Collection

titleLocalized.zh: 新手老兵角色设定集

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a fantasy anime character design collection, featuring a young "novice-veteran" adventurer, combining modern streetwear with magical blue flame effects. Canvas: A wide, horizontal character reference design collection with a white parchment background, subtle decorative patterns, fine gold trim, and ornate corner designs, presenting a simple concept art style. Main Title and Text: The top left title is "✦ Novice Veteran ✦", and the subtitle below is "Novices-Veteran". A brief Chinese background description is added to the left, telling the story of an adventurer from another world who can control ice and flame and become a trustworthy companion. Chinese labels "Front," "Side," and "Back" are added above the three full-body views. Small Chinese labels are used to annotate details. Character: Showcase{argument name="character name" default="Novice Veteran"} A young male fantasy swordsman, possessing{argument name="hair color" default="White short spiky hair with light blue highlights"} He was lean and muscular, with pale skin, a confident and relaxed demeanor, and his face was deliberately blurred or obscured. His clothing was {argument name="jacket color" default="Bright cobalt blue bomber jacket"} The character is dressed in a garment featuring delicate floral patterns, a high collar, ribbed cuffs and hem, a black shirt underneath, a black belt, slim-fitting black trousers, and shiny black combat boots. The character is surrounded by {argument name="flame effect color" default="Ice Blue Magic Flame"} And rising behind. Layout: Use 3 full-body character views: left center is the front view, one hand holding a blue crystal sword downwards, the other hand in the pocket; middle right is the side view, one hand in the pocket; far right is the back view, showing the jacket pattern and flame halo. Add a separate sword illustration on the far left, placed vertically, labeled "Knight's Sword". Add 5 circular color blocks below the color scheme label: white, light sky blue, bright blue, dark navy blue, and charcoal black. Detail description: Place 6 circular detail illustrations in the middle column: 1 hairstyle detail at the back of the head labeled "Hairstyle Detail", 1 head/back collar detail labeled "Head Detail", 1 collar detail labeled "Collar Detail", 1 jacket floral texture close-up labeled "Jacket Texture Detail", and 2 boot/leg design circles at the bottom, titled "Pants Design (same on both sides)". Weapon: The sword is a long-handled knight's crystal sword, equipped with a silver guard, blue gemstone decorations, and a glowing translucent blue blade; it is shown in two forms: one as an independent weapon and the other as the sword held by the character in a frontal view. Visual Style: High-quality anime concept art with clean lines, exquisite cel shadows, glowing blue gradients, meticulously designed fantasy game character aesthetics, elegant and legible typography, no superfluous characters, and no watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一份动漫奇幻角色设计设定集，主角为一位年轻的“新手老兵”冒险者，将现代街头服饰与魔法蓝焰效果相结合。

画布：宽幅横向角色参考设定集，羊皮纸白背景，带有淡淡的装饰图案，细金边装饰及华丽的边角花纹，呈现简洁的概念艺术风格。

主标题与文本：左上角标题为“✦ Novice Veteran ✦”，下方副标题为“新手老兵”。在左侧加入一段简短的中文背景描述，讲述一位来自异世界的冒险者，他能够掌控冰焰并成为值得信赖的伙伴。在三个全身视图上方添加中文标签“正面”、“側面”和“背面”。使用小型中文标签标注细节说明。

角色：展示 {argument name="character name" default="Novice Veteran"}，一位年轻的男性奇幻剑士，拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="带有浅蓝色挑染的白色短刺头"}，身材精瘦健壮，肤色苍白，姿态自信放松，面部刻意模糊或遮挡。服装为 {argument name="jacket color" default="亮钴蓝色飞行员夹克"}，带有精致的花卉图案、高领、罗纹袖口和下摆，内搭黑色衬衫，系黑色腰带，穿着修身黑色长裤及亮面黑色战靴。角色周围环绕着 {argument name="flame effect color" default="冰蓝色魔法火焰"}，并在身后升腾。

布局：使用 3 个全身角色视图：左中为正面视图，一手向下持蓝色水晶剑，另一手插在口袋里；中右为侧面视图，一手插在口袋里；最右为背面视图，展示夹克图案和火焰光环。在最左侧添加 1 个独立的剑身插图，垂直放置，标注为“騎士劍”。在配色方案标签下方添加 5 个圆形色块：白色、浅天蓝色、亮蓝色、深海军蓝和炭黑色。

细节说明：在中间列放置 6 个圆形细节插图：1 个后脑勺发型细节标注为“髮型細節”，1 个头部/后领细节标注为“頭部細節”，1 个领口细节标注为“領口細節”，1 个夹克花卉纹理特写标注为“夾克紋理細節”，以及底部的 2 个靴子/腿部设计圆圈，标题为“褲子設計（左右相同）”。

武器：剑为长柄骑士水晶剑，配有银色护手、蓝色宝石装饰及发光的半透明蓝色剑刃；分别展示一次独立武器形态，以及一次由正面视图角色持有的形态。

视觉风格：高质量动漫概念艺术，线条清晰，精致的赛璐珞阴影，发光的蓝色渐变，考究的奇幻游戏角色设定集美学，优雅且易读的排版，无多余角色，无水印。

templates.title: Neon Dream City

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹梦幻之城

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed fantasy cyberpunk city nightscape, titled{argument name="scene concept" default="Neon Dream City"} A romantic canal city, perfectly blending Venetian architecture with futuristic glass towers, adorned with magenta and cyan illuminated lights, and a bright full moon hanging under a deep blue starry sky. Using a 1:1 square canvas, capture a cinematic wide-angle shot from a water-based perspective. At the center of the frame is a magnificent arched stone bridge covered in lush pink vines. Four boats must be precisely visible in the image: a gondola moored at the building entrance in the lower left, a smaller gondola near the center under the bridge, a large gondola carrying a silhouette of figures with a bright cyan background in the lower right foreground, and a dark-colored boat moored at the far right edge. Include five prominent glowing jellyfish holograms or aquarium-style displays: a tall jellyfish inside a capsule in the left skyline tower, a jellyfish inside a pink dome in the middle left skyline, a floating jellyfish sign high in the mid-far distance, a large jellyfish display inside an arched window on the right, and a small jellyfish display near a lower window on the far right. The city should include ornate balconies, domed greenhouses, spires, skyscrapers, and streetlights; bridges should have tiny silhouettes of pedestrians, with pink flowers hanging down on either side. The canals must be calm yet rippling, reflecting the intense neon lights.{argument name="primary neon color" default="blue"} ,{argument name="secondary neon color" default="Magenta"} Purple and warm orange lights create long, vertical beams of light. Atmosphere: dreamy, romantic, magical, futuristic, ultra-detailed digital painting, sharp architectural details, volumetric moonlight, luminous mist, rich contrast, no text, no logo, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅高度细节化的奇幻赛博朋克夜景城市图，标题为 {argument name="scene concept" default="霓虹梦幻之城"}：一座浪漫的运河城市，将威尼斯建筑与未来派玻璃塔完美融合，点缀着洋红色和青色的发光灯饰，深蓝色的星空下悬挂着一轮明亮的满月。使用 1:1 正方形画布，从水面视角进行电影级广角拍摄，画面中央是一座宏伟的拱形石桥，桥上覆盖着茂密的粉色藤蔓花卉。画面中需精确显示 4 艘船：左下方建筑入口处停靠着一艘贡多拉，桥下中心附近有一艘小贡多拉，右下方前景处有一艘载着带有明亮青色底光剪影人物的大型贡多拉，最右侧边缘停泊着一艘深色船只。包含 5 个显眼的发光水母全息图或水族馆式展示：左侧天际线塔楼胶囊内的一只高大水母，中左侧天际线粉色圆顶内的一只水母，中远景高处的一块漂浮水母招牌，右侧拱形窗内的一个大型水母展示，以及最右侧下层窗户附近的一个小型水母展示。城市应包含华丽的阳台、圆顶温室、尖塔、摩天大楼、路灯，桥上有微小的行人剪影，两侧垂下粉色的花朵。运河水面必须平静但带有涟漪，倒映出强烈的霓虹 {argument name="primary neon color" default="青色"}、{argument name="secondary neon color" default="洋红色"}、紫色和暖橙色灯光，形成长长的垂直光斑。氛围：梦幻、浪漫、神奇、未来感、超细节数字绘画、锐利的建筑细节、体积感月光、发光薄雾、丰富的对比度，无文字，无 Logo，无水印。

templates.title: Comparison of glare removal effects on glasses

titleLocalized.zh: 眼镜反光去除效果对比

templates.prompt: Create a realistic side-by-side comparison of portraits in the style of an outdoor café, divided into two vertical panels. The canvas is 16:9 widescreen. Layout: Two perfectly equal panels, separated by a thin vertical white line. Each panel displays a half-length portrait of the same young woman against a backdrop of warm afternoon sunlight with a shallow depth of field, featuring greenery, modern glass architecture, and soft bokeh. She has long, sun-kissed light brown/gold hair, wears a comfortable beige knit sweater, and holds a slim gray laptop or notebook in her arms. Her head is slightly turned towards the camera, but her entire face is obscured by two opaque rectangular blocks of warm gray-brown color (one in each panel), covering from her forehead to her chin. Thin, round glasses are visible on either side of the obscured face; the left panel shows a noticeable pale blue-white reflection on the lenses, while the right panel sharpens the glasses, removing most of the reflection, while maintaining the same face shape, hairstyle, pose, clothing, lighting, and background. Photo-quality DSLR portrait with natural color grading, highlighting hair silhouettes in sunlight, sharp subject, blurred background, no text, no tags, and no watermark. Customizable details: Subject is {argument name="subject description" default="A young woman with long, light brown-gold hair"} Clothing is{argument name="clothing" default="A beige knit sweater"} The item being held is{argument name="held object" default="A slim gray laptop"} The color of the masked block is{argument name="face block color" default="warm grayish brown"} The scene is{argument name="setting" default="Outdoor café courtyard with greenery and modern glass architecture"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一张逼真的并排对比图，展示同一个户外咖啡馆风格的肖像，分为两个垂直面板。画布为 16:9 宽屏。布局：左右两个完全相等的面板，中间由 1 条细垂直白线隔开。每个面板都显示同一位年轻女性的半身像，背景是户外温暖的午后阳光，具有浅景深效果，背景为绿植、现代玻璃建筑和柔和的虚化效果。她留着被阳光照亮的浅棕色/金色长发，穿着舒适的米色针织毛衣，双臂抱着 1 台纤薄的灰色笔记本电脑或笔记本。她的头部略微转向镜头，但整个面部区域被 2 个不透明的矩形色块遮挡（每个面板一个），颜色为暖灰褐色，覆盖范围从前额到下巴。在遮挡的面部两侧可见细圆眼镜框；左侧面板显示眼镜镜片上有明显的淡蓝白色反光，右侧面板则使眼镜更清晰，去除了大部分反光，同时保持相同的脸型、发型、姿势、服装、光照和背景。照片级 DSLR 肖像，自然调色，阳光下的发丝轮廓光，主体清晰，背景虚化，无文字，无标签，无水印。可自定义细节：主体为 {argument name="subject description" default="一位留着浅棕金色长发的年轻女性"}，服装为 {argument name="clothing" default="一件米色针织毛衣"}，手持物品为 {argument name="held object" default="一台纤薄的灰色笔记本电脑"}，遮挡色块颜色为 {argument name="face block color" default="暖灰褐色"}，场景为 {argument name="setting" default="带有绿植和现代玻璃建筑的户外咖啡馆庭院"}。
