templates.title: Comparison of eyeglass reflection removal

titleLocalized.zh: 眼镜反光去除对比

templates.prompt: Create a realistic left-right comparison image showing the same outdoor portrait, divided into two vertical panels by thin white lines. The main subject is {argument name="subject description" default="A woman with long, dark, curly hair, wearing a loose white linen beach shirt, small gold hoop earrings, and light-rimmed glasses."} Shot on a sunny beach boardwalk, framing the subject from the shoulders up in a three-quarter profile. The background should include waves, a pale blue sky, wooden railings, and softly blurred palm trees on the left, creating a shallow depth of field and natural warm sunlight. Use two panels: the left panel shows the original portrait with noticeable reflections/shadows obscuring the eyes; the right panel shows the edited version, removing the reflections and making the eyes look natural, while maintaining the face shape, pose, hairstyle, clothing, lighting, and background. Do not add any labels or descriptive text. Preserve the photorealistic quality of the curls, translucent white fabric, skin tone, and beach environment. Use a horizontal crop similar to social media comparison images, centering the subject across both panels. The editing should be subtle yet realistic, suitable for a profile picture.{argument name="image ratio" default="16:9 Landscape"} ,{argument name="setting" default="Sunny beach boardwalk"} as well as{argument name="edit goal" default="Remove eyeglass reflections without altering facial features."} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一张逼真的左右对比图，展示同一张户外人像，通过细白线分隔为两个垂直面板。主体为 {argument name="subject description" default="一位留着深色长卷发、身穿宽松白色亚麻沙滩衬衫、佩戴小金圈耳环和浅框眼镜的女性"}，在阳光明媚的沙滩木栈道上拍摄，取景范围为肩部以上，呈四分之三侧面。背景左侧可见海浪、淡蓝色天空、木质栏杆以及柔和模糊的棕榈树，具有浅景深和自然的暖色调日光。使用 2 个面板：左侧面板为原始人像，眼镜上有明显的反光/倒影遮挡眼睛；右侧面板为编辑后的版本，去除了反光，眼睛看起来自然，同时脸型、姿势、发型、服装、光影和背景保持不变。不要添加任何标签或说明文字。保留卷发、半透明白色织物、肤色和沙滩环境的照片级逼真质感。构图采用类似社交媒体对比图的横向裁剪，主体居中横跨两个面板，编辑效果应微妙且真实，适合作为头像。使用 {argument name="image ratio" default="16:9 横屏"}、{argument name="setting" default="阳光明媚的沙滩木栈道"} 以及 {argument name="edit goal" default="在不改变面部特征的前提下去除眼镜反光"}。

templates.title: Coffee shop portrait reflection removal comparison

titleLocalized.zh: 咖啡馆肖像反光去除对比

templates.prompt: Create a realistic side-by-side comparison image, replicating the same café portrait in two equally sized vertical panels, similar to the "before and after" effect shown on social media where glasses glare is removed while individual features are preserved. The canvas is a wide 16:9 image (approximately 1200 x 675 pixels), precisely bisected by a thin white vertical dividing line. Both panels depict an adult male seated at a café table, wearing a dark blue suit jacket over a plain white crew-neck T-shirt, arms outstretched, with neatly trimmed short black hair and a warm-toned medium skin tone. In both panels, a large opaque tan occlusion is placed at the center of the face, obscuring the eyes, nose, and mouth, while revealing the hair, ears, jawline, neck, and clothing; using {argument name="face block color" default="muted tan brown"} The left panel should subtly suggest the original portrait, with visible eyeglass frames and reflections at the edges of the occlusion block; the right panel should show the processed version, with no visible eyeglass reflections and maintaining the same face shape, pose, hairstyle, clothing, lighting, and background. Includes two portrait panels: the left with the original image and the right with the edited image. Includes two identical cream-colored ceramic coffee cups, centered at the bottom of each panel, filled with coffee. Includes two identical small potted green plants, located in the lower left corner of each panel. Background: A bright café interior with black window frames, sunlight streaming through the glass, soft green plants outside, blurred street and building outlines, shallow depth of field, natural sunlight, and a realistic photographic style. The style should be a high-quality, candid portrait with clear subject details, a softly blurred background, no text labels, no watermarks, no extraneous figures, and no changes between the two panels except for the suggested removal of eyeglass reflections on the right.{argument name="subject outfit" default="dark navy blazer over a white T-shirt"} ,{argument name="setting" default="sunlit cafe by large windows"} as well as{argument name="comparison theme" default="glasses glare removal before and after"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一张逼真的并排对比图，将同一张咖啡馆肖像复制在两个等大的垂直面板中，类似于社交媒体上展示去除眼镜反光同时保留个人特征的“前后对比”效果。画布为 16:9 的宽幅图像（约 1200×675），中间由一条细长的白色垂直分隔线精准平分。两个面板均展示一名坐在咖啡馆桌旁的成年男子，他身穿深蓝色西装外套，内搭纯白色圆领 T 恤，双臂前伸，留着整齐的黑色短发，肤色为暖色调中等肤色。在两个面板中，在面部中心放置一个巨大的不透明棕褐色遮挡块，遮住眼睛、鼻子和嘴巴，同时露出头发、耳朵、下颌线、颈部和衣物；使用 {argument name="face block color" default="muted tan brown"}。左侧面板应隐约暗示原始肖像，在遮挡块边缘部分可见眼镜框和反光；右侧面板应显示处理后的版本，即无可见眼镜反光，且保持相同的脸型、姿势、发型、服装、光照和背景。包含 2 个肖像面板：左侧为原始图，右侧为编辑图。包含 2 个完全相同的咖啡杯，分别位于每个面板的底部中心，为奶油色陶瓷杯，内盛咖啡。包含 2 盆相同的小型绿色盆栽，分别位于每个面板的左下角。背景：明亮的咖啡馆内部，配有黑色窗框、阳光照射的玻璃、窗外柔和的绿色植物、模糊的街道和建筑轮廓，浅景深，自然日光，写实摄影风格。风格应为高质量的抓拍肖像写实感，主体细节清晰，背景虚化柔和，无文字标签，无水印，无多余人物，除右侧建议的眼镜反光去除外，两个面板之间无其他变化。使用 {argument name="subject outfit" default="dark navy blazer over a white T-shirt"}、{argument name="setting" default="sunlit cafe by large windows"} 以及 {argument name="comparison theme" default="glasses glare removal before and after"}。

templates.title: Glasses Reflection Removal Portrait Collage

titleLocalized.zh: 眼镜反光去除人像拼图

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a clear contrast mosaic showcasing four portrait photo examples with glare removed. Each example is presented as a left-right comparison, maintaining consistency in the subject, pose, clothing, lighting, and background. Canvas: Widescreen 16:9 image, approximately 1200×675 pixels, white background with thin white gaps between panels, rounded corners for a realistic portrait photography effect. Layout: Arrange the four sets of comparison images in a 2×2 grid. Each set contains two nearly identical portrait photos (left and right), for a total of eight portrait panels. The four sets are: 1) Top left: An East Asian woman in a gray suit jacket against an office environment with bookshelves and a monitor; 2) Top right: A young Black man in an olive-green jacket over a white T-shirt in a green park; 3) Bottom left: An older Caucasian man with gray hair in a light blue sweater against a cozy family library with bookshelves and a warm-toned lamp; 4) Bottom right: A woman with dark curly hair in a navy blue polka-dot shirt, sitting by a window and among greenery, her hand supporting her chin. Subject details: The left image in each set must show slight glare or reflections from glasses in the eye area; the right image must be deglazed to make the eyes look natural and clear, and facial features, expressions, head position, skin tone, hairstyle, clothing, shooting angle, or background must not be altered. Use realistic shallow depth of field, natural color gradation, soft professional portrait lighting, and head-to-head composition with the subject at chest or above the shoulders. Privacy Handling: Use a solid-color, opaque rectangular masking block matching the subject's skin tone to cover the central facial area of ​​each portrait to conceal facial features. Use a total of 8 masking rectangles, one for each portrait panel, centered and covering the facial area from the forehead to the jawline. The masking blocks should be a solid color, without any blurred textures or text. Constraints: No explanatory text, no arrows, no logos, no watermarks, no UI elements, no additional figures, and no decorative graphics. Maintain alignment and visual consistency for contrasting groups, as if used for {argument name="editing task" default="remove glasses glare"} Social media demo images. (Using...){argument name="image style" default="realistic professional portrait photography"} ,{argument name="collage layout" default="four side-by-side before-and-after portrait pairs"} ,{argument name="background color" default="white"} as well as{argument name="privacy treatment" default="solid skin-tone face censor blocks"} .

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个清晰的对比拼图，展示 4 个眼镜反光去除的人像照片示例。每个示例均以左右对比的形式呈现，并保持人物、姿势、服装、光照和背景的一致性。

画布：宽屏 16:9 图像，尺寸约为 1200×675 像素，白色背景，面板间设有细白色间隙，照片圆角，呈现逼真的头像摄影效果。

布局：将 4 组对比图排列成 2×2 的网格。每组包含 2 张近乎相同的人像照片（左侧和右侧），总计 8 个头像面板。这 4 组分别为：1) 左上：一位身穿灰色西装外套的东亚女性，背景为带有书架和显示器的办公环境；2) 右上：一位在绿色公园户外的年轻黑人男性，身穿橄榄色外套内搭白色 T 恤；3) 左下：一位留着灰发、身穿浅蓝色毛衣的年长白人男性，背景为带有书架和暖色台灯的温馨家庭图书馆；4) 右下：一位扎着深色卷发的女性，身穿海军蓝圆点衬衫，坐在窗边和绿植旁，手托下巴。

主体细节：每组的左侧图像需显示眼部区域轻微的眼镜反光或眩光；右侧图像需去除反光，使眼睛看起来自然清晰，且不得改变面部特征、表情、头部位置、肤色、发型、服装、拍摄角度或背景。使用逼真的浅景深、自然的色彩分级、柔和的专业人像光效，以及胸部或肩部以上的头像构图。

隐私处理：用与主体肤色一致的纯色不透明矩形遮挡块覆盖每张人像的中央面部区域，以隐藏面部特征。共使用 8 个遮挡矩形，每个头像面板一个，居中覆盖从额头到下颌的面部区域。遮挡块应为纯色，不带模糊纹理或文字。

约束条件：无说明文字、无箭头、无 Logo、无水印、无 UI 元素、无额外人物、无装饰性图形。保持对比组对齐且视觉统一，如同用于 {argument name="editing task" default="remove glasses glare"} 的社交媒体演示图。使用 {argument name="image style" default="realistic professional portrait photography"}、{argument name="collage layout" default="four side-by-side before-and-after portrait pairs"}、{argument name="background color" default="white"} 以及 {argument name="privacy treatment" default="solid skin-tone face censor blocks"}。

templates.title: Office signage size rendering

titleLocalized.zh: 办公室标识尺寸效果图

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a realistic rendering of an interior wall signage layout, providing metrical annotations for the reception/office entrance and showcasing recommended dimensions and spacing for the company signage. Canvas: Square 1:1 image, photorealistic architectural visualization, frontal view with a slight natural perspective. Warm modern color palette: light beige wall panels, light-colored wooden cabinets, black signage, black metal door grilles, and a wooden slat ceiling. Scene Layout: The composition centers on a beige background wall with the installed signage. To the right is a tall, black, vertically slatted door or fence occupying approximately a quarter of the image width. In the upper right corner of the wall, add a small, downward-sloping white CCTV camera. At the top center, add a rectangular wall-mounted light fixture with a warm, downward-facing spotlight. At the bottom center, place a light-colored wooden cabinet with two doors and two round black knobs. The lower part of the wall behind the signage includes a narrow, horizontal strip of vertical rectangular tiles. The topmost ceiling should display warm brown wooden slats arranged diagonally. Main Signage Content: Raised matte black 3D lettering on the wall. The largest line of text is{argument name="company logo text" default="Ryplix"} Smaller text is displayed centered directly below.{argument name="company legal text" default="Infotech Pvt. Ltd."} A large number is displayed centered below it.{argument name="unit number" default="1210"} A thin horizontal line runs above and below the numbers. Keep all signage elements black with soft, realistic shadows. Measurement Labels: Add fine black dimension arrows, dashed guide lines, and small technical labels around the signage. Include exactly 10 visible measurement labels on the main wall area: “3.5 - 4 in” for the distance from the bottom of the light fixture to the logo, “7 - 7.5 in” for the logo height, “1.5 in” for the spacing between the logo and the legal text, “2.5 - 3 in” for the spacing between the legal text and the numbers, “4 - 4.5 in” for the number height, “4 - 5 in” for the distance from the number to the top tile area of ​​the cabinet, and “34 in” for the long horizontal width guide above the cabinet, plus two side spacing labels, “5 - 6 in” on the left and “5 - 6 in” on the right. Left Information Panel: Three rounded white cards are stacked vertically to the left of the image. Card 1 Title: “SIGNAGE SIZE (RECOMMENDED)”. It contains three item groups separated by thin horizontal lines: "Ryplix" corresponds to "Width: 19-20 in" and "Height: 7-7.5 in"; "Infotech Pvt. Ltd." corresponds to "Width: 14 in" and "Height: 1.75 in"; "1210" corresponds to "Width: 8.5-9 in" and "Height: 4-4.5 in"; and "Lines (Both)" corresponds to "Width: 10-11 in" and "Thickness: 6 mm". Card 2 title: "SPACING (RECOMMENDED)". The document contains four project groups separated by thin lines: "Light bottom to logo top" corresponds to "3.5 - 4 in"; "Logo to Infotech text" corresponds to "1.5 in"; "Infotech text to 1210" corresponds to "2.5 - 3 in"; and "1210 to bottom (cabinet top)" corresponds to "4 - 5 in". Card 3 is a small note card: "Note: All dimensions are approximate. Visual spacing may vary slightly on site." Visual style: Clean, modern office design, natural lighting, realistic materials, subtle shadows, clear and legible typography, and professional signage installation guide aesthetics. All labels and cards use a black sans-serif font. Measurement lines should be presented as an overlay of design specifications, not in a handwritten style. Constraints: Keep images free of portraits and clutter. Do not add extra logos, extra cards, extra measurement labels, or extra decorative objects. Maintain precise alignment: Logos, legal text, unit numbers, light fixtures, and cabinets should all be centered on the same vertical axis.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个逼真的室内墙面标识效果图，为接待处/办公室入口提供测量标注，展示公司标识的推荐尺寸和间距。

画布：方形 1:1 图像，照片级建筑可视化，正面视角，带有轻微的自然透视感。采用温暖的现代色调：浅米色墙板、浅色木柜、黑色标识、黑色金属门格栅以及木条吊顶。

场景布局：构图中心为一面带有安装标识的米色背景墙。右侧包含一扇占据图像宽度约四分之一的黑色高竖条门或栅栏。在墙面右上角，添加一个向下倾斜的小型白色闭路电视监控摄像头。在顶部中央，添加一个矩形壁挂式灯具，带有一个温暖的向下射灯。在底部中央，放置一个浅色木柜，带有两扇门和两个圆形的黑色旋钮。在标识后方的墙面下部，包含一条横向的窄竖矩形瓷砖带。最顶部的天花板应显示呈对角线排列的暖棕色木条。

主要标识内容：墙面使用凸起的哑光黑色 3D 字母。最大的一行文字为 {argument name="company logo text" default="Ryplix"}。正下方居中显示较小的文字 {argument name="company legal text" default="Infotech Pvt. Ltd."}。在其下方居中显示大号数字 {argument name="unit number" default="1210"}，数字上下方各有一条细横线。保持所有标识元素为黑色，并带有柔和逼真的阴影。

测量标注：在标识周围添加精细的黑色尺寸箭头、虚线引导线和小型技术标签。在主墙面区域包含正好 10 个可见的测量标签：“3.5 - 4 in”为灯具底部到 Logo 的距离，“7 - 7.5 in”为 Logo 高度，“1.5 in”为 Logo 与法律文本之间的间距，“2.5 - 3 in”为法律文本与数字之间的间距，“4 - 4.5 in”为数字高度，“4 - 5 in”为数字到柜顶瓷砖区域的距离，“34 in”为柜子上方长横向宽度指南，外加两个侧边间距标签，左侧“5 - 6 in”和右侧“5 - 6 in”。

左侧信息面板：在图像左侧垂直堆叠三个圆角白色卡片。卡片 1 标题：“SIGNAGE SIZE (RECOMMENDED)”。包含三个由细横线分隔的项目组：“Ryplix”对应“Width: 19-20 in”和“Height: 7-7.5 in”；“Infotech Pvt. Ltd.”对应“Width: 14 in”和“Height: 1.75 in”；“1210”对应“Width: 8.5-9 in”和“Height: 4-4.5 in”；以及“Lines (Both)”对应“Width: 10-11 in”和“Thickness: 6 mm”。卡片 2 标题：“SPACING (RECOMMENDED)”。包含四个由细线分隔的项目组：“Light bottom to logo top”对应“3.5 - 4 in”；“Logo to Infotech text”对应“1.5 in”；“Infotech text to 1210”对应“2.5 - 3 in”；“1210 to bottom (cabinet top)”对应“4 - 5 in”。卡片 3 为一张小注释卡，内容为：“Note: All dimensions are approximate. Visual spacing may vary slightly on site.”

视觉风格：简洁的现代办公室设计，自然采光，逼真的材质，微妙的阴影，清晰易读的排版，专业的标识安装指南美学。所有标签和卡片均使用黑色无衬线字体。测量线应呈现为设计规格叠加层，而非手写风格。

约束条件：保持图像中没有人像和杂物。不要添加额外的 Logo、额外的卡片、额外的测量标签或额外的装饰性物体。保持精确对齐：Logo、法律文本、单元号、灯具和柜子都应在同一垂直轴线上居中。

templates.title: AI Model Architecture Comparison Poster

titleLocalized.zh: AI 模型架构对比海报

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a vertically side-by-side comparison poster showcasing identical photorealistic architectural scenes generated by two AI image models. Canvas: 3:4 portrait orientation, approximately 768×1024 pixels, horizontally divided into two perfectly stacked panels with no visible borders between them. Layout: Top panel, top left corner labeled {argument name="top label" default="Banana pro"} The bottom panel is marked in the upper left corner.{argument name="bottom label" default="GPT image 2"} The text is displayed using a very large white block template style with a thin, dark outline and subtle vertical stripes/carved textures inside the letters. The text should be positioned above the sky and tree areas, left-aligned, and with ample spacing. The scene in the two panels: a tranquil, photorealistic modern luxury residence situated in a forest clearing beside a calm pond. The residence is a low, minimalist, linear villa with white and light-colored concrete blocks, a flat roof, large windows, and warm wood-toned interiors. The left wing is a single-story structure with a covered terrace and slender columns, the middle is a solid rectangular tower-like volume, and the right wing is a double-story structure with large windows. The building is horizontally centered, facing the water in the mid-ground, surrounded by green grass, reeds, and dense woodland. Top panel details: The residence appears smaller and farther away, with more open, pale blue sky visible above. The pond occupies the lower third, clearly reflecting the residence and trees. Forest trees frame the left and right edges, including leafy branches hanging from the top corners. The light is soft daylight, calm and slightly translucent. Bottom panel details: Shows a closer, larger version of the same house and pond, with stronger contrast and richer green vegetation. Tall tree trunks frame the sides, dense forest covers the background, and water dominates the lower section with ripples and reflections. The lighting is bright yet natural, resulting in a more refined architectural visualization. Visual style: High-end photorealistic architectural rendering, realistic reflections, natural sunlight, clean modern design, lush summer forest, calm water, no people, no vehicles, and no additional logos or UI elements. Constraints: Includes 2 stacked panels and 2 visible text labels. Maintain text readability and spelling identical to the provided content. Ensure both panels depict the same elements while maintaining a contrasting poster look.{argument name="architecture subject" default="modern white concrete villa by a forest pond"} .

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一张垂直并排对比海报，展示由两个 AI 图像模型生成的相同照片级真实感建筑场景。

画布：3:4 纵向构图，尺寸约为 768×1024 像素，水平分割为 2 个完全相等的堆叠面板，面板间无可见边框。

布局：顶部面板左上角标注 {argument name="top label" default="Banana pro"}。底部面板左上角标注 {argument name="bottom label" default="GPT image 2"}。使用非常大的白色块状模板风格显示字体，带有细深色轮廓，字母内部有微妙的垂直条纹/雕刻纹理。文字应位于天空和树木区域上方，左对齐，并留有充足的间距。

两个面板中的场景：宁静、照片级真实感的现代豪华住宅，位于平静池塘旁的森林空地上。住宅为低矮、极简的直线型别墅，采用白色和浅色混凝土体块、平屋顶、宽大的玻璃窗以及温暖的木质调室内装饰。左侧为单层侧翼，带有带顶棚的露台和细柱，中间为坚固的矩形塔状体块，右侧为带大窗户的双层侧翼。建筑位于中景的水面对面，水平居中，周围环绕着绿草、芦苇和茂密的林地。

顶部面板细节：住宅看起来更小、更远，上方可见更多开阔的淡蓝色天空。池塘占据下三分之一，清晰地倒映着住宅和树木。森林树木框住左右边缘，包括从顶部角落垂下的叶片枝条。光线为柔和的日光，平静且略显通透。

底部面板细节：展示了更近、更大的相同住宅和池塘，对比度更强，绿色植被更丰富。高大的树干框住两侧，茂密的森林覆盖背景，水面占据下部，带有涟漪和倒影。光线明亮但自然，呈现出更精致的建筑可视化效果。

视觉风格：高端照片级真实感建筑渲染，真实的倒影，自然日光，简洁的现代设计，郁郁葱葱的夏季森林，平静的水面，无人物，无车辆，无额外的 Logo 或 UI 元素。

约束：包含 2 个堆叠面板和 2 个可见文字标签。保持文字可读且拼写与提供的内容完全一致。在保持对比海报外观的同时，确保两个面板都描绘相同的 {argument name="architecture subject" default="modern white concrete villa by a forest pond"}。

templates.title: Comparison of double-panel snow scene wooden house models

titleLocalized.zh: 双面板雪景木屋模型对比

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a vertically arranged contrasting poster showcasing the same modern snow-covered mountain cabin scene presented in two stacked panels, with each model prominently labeled. Canvas: 3:4 portrait image, approximately 768 x 1024 pixels. Divide the canvas horizontally into two perfectly equal photographic panels with no thick border in the middle. Layout: - Panel 1 (Upper Half): Snow-covered mountain landscape with a modern dark wood A-frame cabin on a hillside surrounded by evergreen trees, against a soft winter sky background. A hiker walks along a footprint path towards the cabin. Add a large label in the upper left corner with the following text:{argument name="top label" default="Banana pro"} - Panel 2 (lower half): A slightly lower and closer view of a snow-covered mountain cabin scene, with a warmer sunset color tone. The foreground trees are denser, and there is a hiker on the snowy path. A large label has been added to the upper left corner with the following content:{argument name="bottom label" default="GPT image 2"} Visible elements: - Exactly two stacked contrast panels. - Exactly two large text labels: "Banana pro" for the top panel and "GPT image 2" for the bottom panel. - Exactly two modern cabins, one per panel. - Exactly two figures, one per panel, both small hikers with their backs to the observer. - Each panel should include many snow-covered evergreen trees, but the composition should focus on the cabins and the path. Scene details: Both panels depict a winter evening in a snowy coniferous forest. The cabins are modern, tall, angular, and steeply roofed with dark vertical timber facades, warmly glowing rectangular windows, concrete or stone bases, and roofs with dark solar panel-like sections or skylights. The snow should have soft, wind-eroded textures, and a clearly marked footprint path extends from the foreground to the hikers and cabins. The sky should be a soft lilac, pink, and light blue, suggesting dusk. Typography: Use a large, decorative, blocky, compressed serif font or a Western-style display font with white fill, dark outlines, and subtle internal stripes. Place text near the top left corner of each panel, large enough to occupy the corner without obscuring the cabin. Visual Style: Photorealistic architectural visualizations with crisp winter details, high dynamic range, contrasting warm window light with cold snow, and cinematic twilight lighting. The top panel should feel cleaner and more minimalist, with a pale purple sky; the bottom panel should feel more dramatic and sophisticated, with stronger pink sunset clouds and richer contrast. Constraints: Do not add logos, watermarks, extra descriptive text, UI frames, or extra characters. Maintain a clear two-panel contrast structure and retain precise label wording (unless customized).

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个垂直排列的对比海报，展示在两个堆叠面板中呈现的相同现代雪景山间木屋场景，并使用醒目的标签标注每个模型。

画布：3:4 纵向图像，约 768×1024 像素。将画布水平分割为 2 个完全相等的摄影面板，中间无粗边框。

布局：
- 面板 1（上半部分）：雪山景观，山坡上有一座现代深色木质 A 型木屋，周围有常青树，背景为柔和的冬日天空，一名徒步者沿着脚印小径走向木屋。在左上角添加一个大标签，内容为 {argument name="top label" default="Banana pro"}。
- 面板 2（下半部分）：视角略低且更近的类似雪山木屋场景，色调为更温暖的日落色，前景树木更密集，有一名徒步者在雪路上，左上角添加一个大标签，内容为 {argument name="bottom label" default="GPT image 2"}。

可见元素统计：
- 恰好 2 个堆叠的对比面板。
- 恰好 2 个大文本标签：顶部面板为“Banana pro”，底部面板为“GPT image 2”。
- 恰好 2 座现代木屋，每个面板一座。
- 恰好 2 个人物，每个面板一个，均为背对观察者的小型徒步者。
- 每个面板应包含许多积雪的常青树，但构图需聚焦于木屋和小径。

场景细节：两个面板均描绘了雪地针叶林中的冬日傍晚。木屋为现代风格，高大、棱角分明且屋顶陡峭，采用深色垂直木质外墙，带有温暖发光的长方形窗户、混凝土或石材底层，以及带有深色太阳能板状部分或天窗的屋顶。积雪应呈现出柔和的风蚀纹理，并有一条清晰的脚印小径从前景延伸至徒步者和木屋。天空应呈现柔和的淡紫色、粉色和浅蓝色，暗示黄昏时刻。

排版：使用大型装饰性块状压缩衬线字体或西式展示字体，白色填充，带有深色轮廓和微妙的内部条纹。将文本放置在每个面板左上角附近，大小需足以占据角落，且不遮挡木屋。

视觉风格：照片级真实感的建筑可视化，清晰的冬季细节，高动态范围，温暖的窗光与寒冷的积雪形成对比，电影般的黄昏光影。顶部面板应感觉更简洁、更极简，天空呈淡紫色；底部面板应感觉更具戏剧性和精致感，带有更强烈的粉色日落云彩和更丰富的对比度。

约束：不要添加徽标、水印、额外说明文字、UI 框架或额外人物。保持双面板对比结构清晰，并保留确切的标签措辞（除非已自定义）。

templates.title: Night Skyscraper AI Model Comparison

titleLocalized.zh: Night Skyscraper AI 模型对比

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a vertical, two-panel comparison image showcasing two different image models rendered at night, representing the same futuristic skyscraper concept. Canvas: 3:4 aspect ratio, 768 x 1024 visual size, horizontally divided into two perfectly stacked panels with no visible borders. Both panels display a deep blue nighttime cityscape, complete with starry skies and twinkling city lights. Panel 1: The upper half is labeled in the top left corner.{argument name="top label" default="Banana pro"} The presentation uses large white block templates/Gothic fonts. It showcases a futuristic, illuminated skyscraper in the heart of a dense urban area, surrounded by mid-rise apartment buildings, roads, trees, and plazas. The building features a soaring, twin-structure design with vertically ribbed glass, bright white outline lighting, warm window lighting, sharply angled cuts, and an illuminated geometric base/plaza. The camera angle is a high-altitude, slightly downward view, highlighting the clear, cinematic nighttime lighting. Panel 2: The lower half is labeled in the upper left corner.{argument name="bottom label" default="GPT image 2"} The same large, white, blocky font is used. A similar but more refined futuristic skyscraper is showcased, situated at the heart of a nighttime cityscape. Taller and more streamlined, it features stacked, faceted glass sections, luminous vertical lines, bright white edge lighting, warm interior floors, and a glowing multi-story podium. It is surrounded by high-rise residential buildings, tree-lined boulevards, intersections, and distant city lights. The camera angle is a high-altitude, bird's-eye view, creating a cinematic and realistic effect. Visual Style: Photorealistic architectural visualization, dramatic blue-black nighttime tones, crisp high contrast, cool white neon accents, realistic urban depth, subtle starlight, polished glass reflections, high detail, and no human presence in the frame. Text Content: Uses 2 visible text tags:{argument name="top label" default="Banana pro"} and{argument name="bottom label" default="GPT image 2"} The font should be large, white, angular, and slightly retro-futuristic. Constraints: Include 2 contrast panels, 2 central skyscraper elements, and 2 large labels. Do not add any logos, watermarks, headings, UI elements, arrows, or other explanatory text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个垂直的双面板对比图，展示两个不同的图像模型在夜间渲染出的相同未来感摩天大楼概念。

画布：纵向 3:4 比例，768×1024 视觉感，水平平分为两个完全相等的堆叠面板，无可见边框线。两个面板均展示深蓝色的夜间城市景观，配有星空和闪烁的城市灯光。

面板 1：上半部分在左上角标注 {argument name="top label" default="Banana pro"}，采用大型白色块状模板/哥特式展示字体。展示一座位于密集城市区域中心的未来感发光摩天大楼，周围环绕着中层公寓楼、道路、树木和广场。大楼呈高耸的双体结构，带有垂直肋状玻璃、明亮的白色轮廓灯、温暖的窗户灯光、棱角分明的切口以及发光的几何底座/广场。摄像机角度为高空俯视，略微向下，呈现清晰的电影级夜间照明。

面板 2：下半部分在左上角标注 {argument name="bottom label" default="GPT image 2"}，采用同样的大型白色块状展示字体。展示一座相似但更精致的未来感摩天大楼，位于夜间城市景观中心，更高、更流畅，具有堆叠的切面玻璃部分、发光的垂直线条、明亮的白色边缘灯光、温暖的室内楼层以及发光的多层裙楼。周围环绕着高层住宅楼、林荫大道、交叉路口和远处的城市灯光。摄像机角度为高空俯视，具有电影感和真实感。

视觉风格：照片级真实感的建筑可视化，戏剧性的蓝黑色夜间色调，清晰的高对比度，冷白色霓虹灯点缀，真实的城市深度，微妙的星光，抛光玻璃反射，高细节，画面中无人。

文本内容：使用 2 个可见的文本标签：{argument name="top label" default="Banana pro"} 和 {argument name="bottom label" default="GPT image 2"}。字体保持大型、白色、棱角分明且略带复古未来感。

约束：包含 2 个对比面板，2 个中心摩天大楼主体，以及 2 个大标签。不要添加任何徽标、水印、标题、UI 元素、箭头或其他解释性文字。

templates.title: AI City Rendering Comparison Poster

titleLocalized.zh: AI 城市渲染对比海报

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a vertically side-by-side comparison poster showcasing two AI-generated aerial city renderings, arranged vertically, for use in [the context of the poster].{argument name="top model label" default="Banana pro"} and{argument name="bottom model label" default="GPT image 2"} Visual model comparison. Canvas: 3:4 portrait image, approximately 768 × 1024 pixels. The canvas is precisely divided into two equal horizontal panels with no borders or spacing between them. Layout: The top panel fills the upper half, and the bottom panel fills the lower half. Each panel presents a similar futuristic waterfront commercial district from a high, angled, bird's-eye view, set at a blues twilight. Two prominent large text labels are placed: the top label is located in the upper left corner and reads "Banana pro"; the bottom label is located in the upper left area of ​​the lower panel and reads "GPT image 2". Tall, square, compact white fonts with dark shadows or outlines are used, resembling retro templates or game typography. Top panel scene: A sophisticated architectural visualization of a modern urban development along a river or bay. It includes approximately 12 prominent glass office towers and mid-rise buildings arranged within a gridded park, featuring illuminated roof edges, landscaped green roofs, tree-lined roads, and warm streetlights. The top and lower right edges show water features, beyond which distant city buildings are visible. Orange and white light trails along the roads create a vibrant nighttime city effect. Bottom panel scene: A second version of the same waterfront area, slightly darker and more dramatic, featuring approximately 14 prominent glass towers and mid-rise buildings. Use cooler blue glass reflections, brighter window lighting, stronger road light trails, green rooftop gardens, and a river or bay curving along the top and bottom right edges. The composition should be distinctly similar to, but not identical to, the top panel to reflect two different AI model outputs from the same cue word. Visual style: Ultra-detailed aerial architectural rendering, realistic yet slightly idealized, cinematic twilight lighting, blue and cyan shadows, warm golden streetlights, crisp glass curtain walls, dense urban planning, dock/waterfront atmosphere, high contrast, sharp perspective, and no human presence. Constraints: Use two precise stacked contrast panels and two visible text labels. Labels should be large and clear, with white font and dark outlines/shadows. Do not add any logos, UI elements, watermarks, titles, or additional text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一张垂直并排对比海报，展示两张 AI 生成的空中城市渲染图，上下排列，用于 {argument name="top model label" default="Banana pro"} 和 {argument name="bottom model label" default="GPT image 2"} 之间的视觉模型对比。

画布：3:4 纵向图像，约 768×1024 像素。将画布精确分割为 2 个相等的水平面板，面板之间无边框或间距。

布局：顶部面板填充上半部分，底部面板填充下半部分。每个面板均从高处斜向俯视视角，展示相似的未来派水岸商业区，时间设定为蓝调黄昏。放置 2 个醒目的大型文本标签：顶部标签位于左上角，内容为“Banana pro”；底部标签位于下方面板的左上区域，内容为“GPT image 2”。使用高大、方正、紧凑的白色显示字体，并带有深色阴影或描边，类似于复古模板或游戏排版。

顶部面板场景：河流或海湾旁现代城市开发的精致建筑可视化效果。包含约 12 座显眼的玻璃办公塔楼和中层建筑，排列在网格化园区内，具有发光的屋顶边缘、景观绿化屋顶、林荫道路和温暖的街灯。顶部边缘和右下边缘展示水域，水域外可见远处的城市建筑。道路上有橙色和白色的光轨，营造出活跃的夜城效果。

底部面板场景：同一水岸区域的第二个版本，色调稍暗且更具戏剧性，包含约 14 座显眼的玻璃塔楼和中层建筑。使用更冷冽的蓝色玻璃反射、更明亮的窗户照明、更强烈的道路光轨、绿色屋顶花园，以及沿顶部和右下边缘弯曲的河流或海湾。构图需与顶部面板明显相似但不完全相同，以体现来自同一提示词的两个不同 AI 模型输出。

视觉风格：超精细空中建筑渲染，写实但略带理想化，电影级黄昏光影，蓝色和青色阴影，温暖的金色街灯，清晰的玻璃幕墙，密集的城市规划，码头/水岸氛围，高对比度，锐利的透视，画面中无人。

约束：使用精确的 2 个堆叠对比面板和 2 个可见文本标签。标签需保持大而清晰，白色字体并带有深色描边/阴影。请勿添加任何徽标、UI 元素、水印、标题或额外文本。

templates.title: Imperial Marshal Anime Commander

titleLocalized.zh: 帝国元帅动漫指挥官

templates.prompt: Create a vertical anime-style fantasy military illustration with dramatic tension, featuring a protagonist who is {argument name="character name" default="Marshal Berg"} A commanding adult male commander, presented from a low-angle hero's perspective. He keeps {argument name="hair color" default="Messy long blonde hair"} His figure, fluttering in the wind, possessed a stern and aristocratic air, his face clearly visible without any obstruction. He was dressed in a black Imperial Marshal's uniform, complete with a high collar, a fitted black jacket, gold piping, ornate epaulettes with heavy tassels, medals, jeweled brooches, layered gold chains, tassels, leather gloves, a wide black belt with decorative gold buckles, and a deep red cloak lined with shadows. His right hand, in the foreground, held a slanted, ornate black pistol; his other hand hung confidently at his side. The background was set in a magnificent, dark steampunk fantasy empire at dusk, with storm-like glowing clouds, embers, Gothic towers, iron railings, and red flags. To the left hung a giant military banner bearing a gold winged emblem and a crown. Five flying war machines were clearly visible in the sky: two large zeppelins and the silhouettes of three smaller aircraft. Utilizing cinematic backlighting effects from a cloudy sunset, the hair and shoulders feature strong contour lighting, high-contrast shadows, exquisite gold details, dynamic wind effects, epic proportions, ultra-refined anime-style artwork, sharp composition, and is free of text, watermarks, facial occlusion, and blur.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张具有戏剧张力的竖版动漫奇幻军事插画，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="伯格元帅 (Marshal Berg)"}，一位气势磅礴的成年男性指挥官，采用低角度英雄视角。他留着 {argument name="hair color" default="凌乱的长金发"}，随风飘动，神情严峻且具有贵族气质，面部清晰可见，无任何遮挡。为他穿上黑色帝国元帅制服，配有高立领、修身黑色夹克、金色滚边、带有厚重流苏的华丽肩章、勋章、宝石胸针、层叠的金链、流苏、皮手套、带有装饰性金扣的宽大黑色腰带，以及内衬阴影的深红色披风。他的右手在前景中持有一把向下倾斜的华丽黑色手枪；另一只手以自信的姿态垂在身侧。背景设定在黄昏时分宏伟的暗黑蒸汽朋克奇幻帝国，伴有风暴般的发光云层、余烬火花、哥特式塔楼、铁栏杆、红色旗帜，左侧悬挂着一面印有金色带翼徽章和皇冠的巨型军旗。天空中清晰可见 5 架飞行战争机器：2 艘大型齐柏林飞艇和 3 架小型飞行器剪影。运用多云日落的电影级逆光效果，头发和肩部有强烈的轮廓光，高对比度阴影，精致的金色细节，动态风感，史诗级比例，超精细动漫绘画风格，构图锐利，无文字，无水印，无面部遮挡，无模糊。

templates.title: Japanese female student's cell phone recording on train

titleLocalized.zh: 日本电车女学生手机录像画面

templates.prompt: Create a realistic portrait-style snapshot taken inside a busy Japanese commuter train, using a wide-angle lens on your phone at the height of a standing passenger. The subject is {argument name="character description" default="A Japanese high school girl with long, straight black hair"} She stood in the aisle, dressed in the classic blue and white sailor uniform: a short-sleeved white sailor shirt with a navy blue collar and double white stripes, a navy blue handkerchief, a navy blue pleated skirt, white mid-calf socks, and brown loafers. Her face was obscured by a centered, soft-edged square pixelated mosaic. She raised her left hand to grasp a gray triangular trolley handrail, looking down at the dark smartphone in her right hand. A sling was slung over her shoulder.{argument name="bag description" default="A navy blue rectangular student shoulder bag"} The bag is adorned with five clearly visible charms: a pink rabbit plush toy, a small red mushroom mascot, a blonde anime girl doll, a black-haired anime boy doll, and a soft pink and blue plush charm on the far right. Surrounding the bag are other commuters in white shirts and school uniforms, some standing, some sitting, their faces blurred; the image includes tram windows displaying the cityscape, metal pillars, fluorescent ceiling lights, Japanese advertising posters above the windows, and numerous gray triangular rings extending into the background. A realistic mobile phone video recording overlay has been added: white corner frames, a red dot and the word "REC" at the top center, and timer text.{argument name="recording time" default="03:12"} The image features a small phone status icon in the top corner and a small flash icon in the bottom right corner. The lighting is a mixture of natural sunlight and fluorescent lights inside the tram, highly realistic, presenting a slightly compressed social media photo quality with a documentary-style atmosphere, without any posed feel or watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张逼真的竖屏手机抓拍照片，场景位于繁忙的日本通勤电车内，以站立乘客的高度使用手机广角镜头拍摄。主体是 {argument name="character description" default="一位留着黑色长直发的日本女高中生"}，她站在过道中，身穿经典的蓝白水手校服：短袖白色短款水手衫，配有海军蓝领子和双白条纹、海军蓝领巾、海军蓝百褶裙、白色中筒袜以及棕色乐福鞋。她的脸部被一个居中的柔边方形像素马赛克遮挡。她抬起左手抓着一个灰色的三角形电车吊环，低头看着右手拿着的深色智能手机。她的肩上背着 {argument name="bag description" default="一个海军蓝长方形学生单肩包"}，包上挂着 5 个清晰可见的挂件：一个粉色兔子毛绒玩具、一个小红蘑菇吉祥物、一个金发动漫女孩玩偶、一个黑发动漫男孩玩偶，以及最右侧的一个粉蓝配色柔和色调毛绒挂件。周围环绕着其他身穿白衬衫和校服的通勤者，部分站立，部分就座，他们的脸部均已模糊处理；画面包含显示城市景观的电车窗户、金属立柱、天花板荧光灯、窗上方的日本广告海报，以及向背景延伸的许多灰色三角形吊环。添加逼真的手机视频录制叠加层：白色边角框、顶部中央的红点和“REC”字样、计时器文本 {argument name="recording time" default="03:12"}、顶部角落的小型手机状态图标，以及右下角的一个小闪光图标。光线应为自然日光与电车内部荧光灯的混合，高度逼真，呈现轻微压缩的社交媒体照片质感，具有纪实抓拍氛围，无摆拍感，无水印。

templates.title: Moon Palace Dancers Showdown

titleLocalized.zh: 月宫舞者对决

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed vertical anime-style fantasy action illustration featuring two masked female dancers/martial artists performing dramatic, synchronized movements in a moonlit palace courtyard. The first character {argument name="upper dancer hair color" default="Long, flowing light pink hair"} The first character is located in the upper half of the image, positioned diagonally, with one leg extended high to the upper left corner. She wears a semi-transparent white costume typical of a palace dancer, adorned with a sheer veil, gold chains, jeweled anklets, bare feet, layers of light-colored fabric, and an exquisite veil; her expression is calm and confident, and she possesses bright green eyes. The second character {argument name="lower dancer hair color" default="Black and white hair with red highlights in double buns"} In the foreground, she crouches in a dynamic, hand-supported fighting stance, clad in a semi-transparent crimson and black harem outfit, adorned with gold jewelry, armlets, anklets, bare feet, and a matching veil; she possesses sharp green eyes and a powerful gaze. The background is set in a magnificent domed palace at night, with a bright full moon hanging in the upper right sky, warm light streaming through the windows, and arched architecture and a glossy, damp stone floor. Swirling bands of light, sheer silk trails, shimmering particles, fragments of rose petals, and a circular magical calligraphy spell effect containing black brushstrokes surround the character on the right. A cinematic low-angle composition is employed, emphasizing strong diagonal movement, flowing hair and fabric, highly detailed jewelry, dramatic rim lighting, soft moonlight, warm palace highlights, reflections on the ground, shallow depth of field, and an exquisitely refined Japanese anime illustration style. The image should convey an elegant, sensual atmosphere, full of magic and dynamic tension, and is prohibited from featuring any modern objects, watermarks, or recognizable English characters.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅细节极其丰富的竖版动漫奇幻动作插画，画面中正好有两位戴着面具的女性舞者/武术家，在月光下的宫殿庭院中进行充满戏剧性的同步动作。第一位角色，{argument name="upper dancer hair color" default="长发飘飘的淡粉色头发"}，位于画面上半部分，呈对角线姿态，一条腿向左上角高高伸展，身穿半透明的白色后宫舞者服装，配有薄纱面纱、金链、珠宝脚链、赤足、浅色布料层叠以及精致的面纱；她表情冷静自信，拥有一双明亮的绿色眼睛。第二位角色，{argument name="lower dancer hair color" default="黑白双色头发，带有红色挑染的双丸子头"}，在前景中以动态的手撑地战斗姿态低蹲，身穿深红色和黑色的半透明后宫服装，配有金饰、臂环、脚踝装饰、赤足以及配套的面纱；她有着锐利的绿色眼睛和强烈的凝视感。背景设定在夜晚一座华丽的圆顶宫殿中，右上方的天空中挂着一轮明亮的满月，窗户透出温暖的光芒，配有拱形建筑和光泽感十足的湿润石质地面。在角色周围环绕着旋转的光带、透明的丝绸拖尾、闪烁的微粒、玫瑰花瓣碎片，以及右侧一个包含黑色毛笔字迹的圆形魔法书法咒语效果。采用电影感的低角度构图，强调强烈的对角线运动感、飘逸的头发和布料、高细节的珠宝、戏剧性的轮廓光、柔和的月光、温暖的宫殿高光、地面的倒影、浅景深，以及极其精致的日式动漫插画风格。画面应呈现出优雅、感性、充满魔法和动作张力的氛围，禁止出现任何现代物品、水印或可辨认的英文字符。

templates.title: Abstract watercolor anime poster

titleLocalized.zh: 抽象水色动漫海报

templates.prompt: Create a 2:3 vertical abstract anime illustration with a near-pure white background and ample negative space. The image depicts a dynamic, partially cropped fragment of a futuristic anime girl or character, outlined using translucent aquamarine and cyan lines that slant from the upper left to the lower right. The left side features flowing, cyan, hair-like lines, while the right side extends into a glossy, turquoise-colored, glass-like triangle. A small, white, angular collar or clothing shape is located at the bottom center. Add bright yellow ink splatters and free-flowing calligraphic brushstrokes to the upper left of the head, with slender cyan arcs encircling the top and left edges. Place a large, centrally located rectangular overlay in front of the character, obscuring the face and torso; this square should exhibit a soft gradient from pale yellow-green in the upper left to mint and light cyan in the lower right, with sharp, clean edges and no text. Use a light, high-key color scheme, including…{argument name="main color" default="aqua teal"} ,{argument name="accent color" default="bright yellow"} The colors are white and light mint, combined with glossy highlights, sketch-like anime lines, watercolor-like transparency, and vibrant modern composition. The image is kept without text or borders, presenting a poster-like quality.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 2:3 的竖版抽象动漫插画，背景接近纯白，留有大量负空间。画面展示一个动态的、局部裁剪的未来感动漫少女或角色碎片，采用半透明的水绿色和青色线条勾勒，从左上角向右下角倾斜。左侧带有流动的青色发丝状线条，右侧延伸出一个光泽感十足的三角形绿松石色玻璃状形态，下方中央有一个白色的小型棱角领口或服饰形状。在头部左上方添加亮黄色泼墨和随性的书法笔触，顶部和左侧边缘环绕着细长的青色弧线。在角色前方放置一个居中的大方形叠加层，遮盖面部和躯干；该方形应呈现从左上角的淡黄绿色到右下角的薄荷色及浅青色的柔和渐变，边缘清晰锐利，且不含任何文字。采用轻盈的高调配色方案，包含 {argument name="main color" default="aqua teal"}、{argument name="accent color" default="bright yellow"}、白色和淡薄荷色，并结合光泽高光、素描感动漫线条、水彩般的透明感以及充满活力的现代构图。保持图像无文字、无边框，呈现海报质感。

templates.title: Voxel Goblin Warrior

titleLocalized.zh: 体素哥布林战士

templates.prompt: Create a high-quality voxel art 3D rendering showcasing a fantasy goblin warrior character, centered against a clean, off-white studio background. The character is entirely composed of visible cube blocks, employing a Minecraft-like voxel style with clean, mesh-aligned geometry, soft ambient occlusion, and subtle studio shadows at its feet. Present the goblin from a three-quarter frontal perspective, maintaining an upright posture, slightly hunched, with a mischievous expression. The goblin possesses…{argument name="skin color" default="Olive Green"} Its skin, massive square head, horizontally protruding pointed ears, heavy dark brow bones, narrow yellow eyes, prominent brown blocky nose, two lower fangs, and a serious and irritable expression. Clothing details: a dark brown sleeveless vest, a tattered brown corset, a simple belt with brown hanging straps, wristbands, ankle straps, and a necklace with small bone or tooth pendants. Its left hand holds a rough wooden stick made of stacked brown voxel blocks, held vertically at its side; its right hand hangs naturally, in a curled, blocky claw shape. Using earth tones, realistic voxel lighting, a cube-like shape without bevels, and a finely layered blocky structure, it presents a refined game character collectible rendering effect. No text, no watermark, no extra characters, and no environmental props except for ground shadows.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高质量的体素艺术 3D 渲染图，展示一个奇幻哥布林战士角色，主体置于干净的灰白色摄影棚背景中心。角色完全由可见的立方体块构成，呈现类似 Minecraft 的体素风格，具有清晰的网格对齐几何结构、柔和的环境光遮蔽，以及脚下微妙的摄影棚阴影。以四分之三正面视角展示哥布林，保持直立姿态，略微驼背，神情顽皮。哥布林拥有 {argument name="skin color" default="橄榄绿"} 的皮肤、巨大的方形头部、水平伸出的长尖耳、浓重的深色眉骨、狭长的黄色眼睛、突出的棕褐色块状鼻子、两颗下獠牙，以及严肃而暴躁的表情。服装细节：深棕色无袖背心、棕色破旧缠腰裙、带有棕褐色垂挂带的简单腰带、腕带、踝带，以及一条带有小骨头或牙齿吊坠的项链。左手握着一根由堆叠的棕色体素块制成的粗糙木棒，竖直握在身体一侧；右手自然下垂，呈蜷曲的块状爪形。使用大地色系、逼真的体素光影、无倒角的立方体形态、精细的层叠块状结构，呈现出精致的游戏角色收藏品渲染效果。无文字，无水印，无额外字符，除地面阴影外不包含任何环境道具。

templates.title: Reference images of male hairstyles in comics

titleLocalized.zh: 漫画男性发型参考图

templates.prompt: Create a black and white anime hairstyle reference image for a male character, using a simple and clean comic line style with a pure white background. Arrange six half-body head drawings into a grid of 3 columns and 2 rows with even spacing. All characters wear the same turtleneck jacket. The character's hairstyle is {argument name="hair style" default="Short, messy, layered hairstyle with a center parting and soft, outward-curling strands."} In the first five views, the face area should be deliberately hidden using light gray rectangular masking blocks. The sixth view shows the back of the head, but not the face. It includes the following six independent views: 1) Front view: symmetrical bangs, ears partially visible; 2) Left 45-degree front view: one ear visible, and layered hair on the side; 3) Right side view: long bangs covering the forehead, one ear visible; 4) Slightly overhead front view: collar open, hair framing the sides; 5) Right 45-degree front view: messy bangs, one ear visible; 6) Back view: showing the outline of the back of the head, neck layers, and hair flow on the top of the head. Using thin, expressive black sketch lines, minimalist shading, no color, no labels, no text, no decorative background, and no facial features, this diagram is highly practical as a simple drawing exercise reference.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张黑白动漫发型参考图，用于男性角色，采用简洁明快的漫画线条风格，背景为纯白色。将 6 个半身头部绘图排列成 3 列 2 行的网格，间距均匀，所有角色均穿着相同的高领夹克。角色发型为 {argument name="hair style" default="短款凌乱层次感发型，中分刘海，带有柔和的外翘发束"}；前 5 个视图中，脸部区域需用浅灰色矩形遮挡块刻意隐藏，第 6 个视图展示后脑勺，不显示脸部。包含以下 6 个独立视图：1) 正面视图，刘海对称，双耳部分可见；2) 左侧 45 度正面视图，可见一只耳朵及侧面层次感发丝；3) 右侧侧面视图，长刘海遮住额头，可见一只耳朵；4) 略微俯视的正面视图，衣领敞开，头发修饰两侧；5) 右侧 45 度正面视图，凌乱刘海，可见一只耳朵；6) 背面视图，展示后脑轮廓、颈部层次及头顶发流。使用纤细且富有表现力的黑色草图线条，极简阴影，无颜色，无标签，无文字，无装饰性背景，不显示面部特征，确保该图表作为简单的绘画练习参考非常实用。

templates.title: Promotional leaflet for physical education courses in Japanese elementary schools

titleLocalized.zh: 日本小学生体育课程宣传单

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a bright and professional Japanese flyer for a sponsored elementary school physical education program, featuring a lively children's sports camp theme. Canvas: Vertical A4 flyer, 3:4 aspect ratio, white background with rounded colored decorative stripes in blue, orange, and green. Add playful confetti, stars, dots, circles, movement lines, and small sports icons to the image. Keep the design simple, printable, and family-friendly. Main Branding: A circular physical education program logo at the top center, incorporating silhouettes of running and jumping children, soccer and basketball icons, and the Japanese logo text.{argument name="event logo text" default="Sports classes for elementary school students"} Below it, add the smaller text "supported by" and the blue-green Lovart logo. Use the Lovart logo again near the bottom right corner, with "supported by" above it. Title area: Place a prominent, large Japanese title in the upper center.{argument name="main headline text" default="Sports classes for elementary school students"} Use a bold, rounded font with a white outline and soft shadow; the text colors are blue, orange, and green. Add a subheading below.{argument name="subheadline text" default="Checked by a physical therapist!"} The color is blue with small green decorative lines. Main layout: The central area is divided into a 2x2 dotted grid containing 4 children's activity check panels: 1. Posture check (top left): A boy in a blue tracksuit stands sideways with a green label.{argument name="posture label" default="Posture check"} 1. **Strength Check (Top Right):** A smiling boy in an orange shirt and shorts is doing squats or stretches, labeled "筋力チェック" (Jinli Check) and accompanied by the text "力強く動けるかな?" (Li Qiang Ku Dong Ke Ru Kana?). 2. **Flexibility Check (Bottom Left):** A smiling girl in a green shirt is sitting and stretching forward, labeled "柔軟性チェック" (Rou Rou Xing Check) and accompanied by the text "体はやわらかいかな?" (Ti wa Yawara kaikana?). 4. Balance Check (Bottom Right): A smiling boy in a blue shirt stands on one leg with his arms outstretched, accompanied by a blue label “バランスチェック” and the text “バランスはしっかりとれているかな?”. A soft, light-colored oval background is used behind each child figure, employing a brightly colored flat vector illustration style. Bottom Information Cards: Below the active grid, four rounded rectangular summary cards are arranged horizontally, each with a colored checkmark icon and a bold Japanese title: 1. Green Card: “姿勢” (posture), small print “正しい姿勢をチェック” (correct posture check). 2. Orange Card: “筋力” (strength), small print “体の筋力をチェック” (body strength check). 3. Green card: “Softness”, small print “Check the softness of the body”. 4. Blue card: “Balance”, small print “Check the senses of balance”. Activity Information Line: Add 3 rounded information boxes below the summary card: 1. Blue character icon, labeled “Target”, content “Elementary school students, lower to upper grades”. 2. Orange calendar icon, labeled “Daytime”, followed by 4 hollow circle placeholders. 3. Green map location icon, labeled “Location”, followed by 4 hollow circle placeholders. Bottom Call to Action (CTA): Add a wide blue ribbon banner with a yellow star on the left and a Japanese slogan.{argument name="bottom slogan text" default="Let's improve our athletic performance!"} The word "Upward" is emphasized in yellow. A blue, rounded-corner contact button with a white phone icon and the words "お問い合わせ" (I'll ask) is added to the bottom left corner, followed by four hollow circle placeholders. Visual style: Modern Japanese children's activity flyer, high-quality vector graphics, vibrant blue/orange/green color scheme, rounded font, clear spacing, subtle shadows, lively yet orderly. Avoid photorealism and clutter; do not add extra characters besides the four children in the activity grid, and do not add more cards than specified.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：制作一张明亮、专业的日本宣传单，用于赞助商支持的小学体育课程，采用活泼的儿童体育训练营主题。

画布：竖版 A4 宣传单，3:4 宽高比，白色背景，配有蓝色、橙色和绿色的圆角彩色装饰条。在画面中添加俏皮的五彩纸屑、星星、圆点、圆圈、运动线条和小型运动图标。保持设计简洁、适合打印且适合家庭阅读。

主要品牌标识：在顶部中心放置一个圆形体育课程 Logo，包含奔跑和跳跃的儿童剪影、足球和篮球图标，以及日语 Logo 文字 {argument name="event logo text" default="小学生のスポーツ教室"}。在其下方添加小字“supported by”以及蓝绿色的 Lovart Logo。在右下角附近再次使用 Lovart Logo，上方标注“supported by”。

标题区域：中部上方放置醒目的大号日语标题：{argument name="main headline text" default="小学生のスポーツ教室"}。使用带有白色描边和柔和阴影的粗体圆角字体；文字颜色采用蓝色、橙色和绿色。下方添加副标题 {argument name="subheadline text" default="理学療法士がチェック！"}，颜色为蓝色，并配有绿色小装饰线。

主要布局：将中心区域划分为 2x2 的虚线网格，包含 4 个儿童活动检查板块：
1. 姿势检查（左上）：一名身穿蓝色运动服的男孩侧身站立，配有绿色标签 {argument name="posture label" default="姿勢チェック"} 和文字“まっすぐ立てているかな?”。旁边添加一条垂直的绿色虚线测量线。
2. 力量检查（右上）：一名身穿橙色上衣和短裤的微笑男孩在做深蹲或伸展动作，配有橙色标签“筋力チェック”和文字“力強く動けるかな?”。
3. 柔韧性检查（左下）：一名身穿绿色上衣的微笑女孩坐着向前伸展，配有绿色标签“柔軟性チェック”和文字“体はやわらかいかな?”。
4. 平衡检查（右下）：一名身穿蓝色上衣的微笑男孩单脚站立并张开双臂，配有蓝色标签“バランスチェック”和文字“バランスはしっかりとれているかな?”。
在每个儿童形象后使用柔和的淡色椭圆形背景，采用色彩鲜艳的扁平矢量插画风格。

底部信息卡片：在活动网格下方，横向排列 4 张圆角矩形摘要卡片，每张卡片配有一个彩色对勾图标和粗体日语标题：
1. 绿色卡片：“姿勢”，小字“正しい姿勢をチェック”。
2. 橙色卡片：“筋力”，小字“体の筋力をチェック”。
3. 绿色卡片：“柔軟性”，小字“体の柔らかさをチェック”。
4. 蓝色卡片：“バランス”，小字“バランス感覚をチェック”。

活动信息行：在摘要卡片下方添加 3 个圆角信息框：
1. 蓝色人物图标，标签“対象”，内容“小学生低学年〜高学年”。
2. 橙色日历图标，标签“日時”，后跟 4 个空心圆占位符。
3. 绿色地图定位图标，标签“場所”，后跟 4 个空心圆占位符。

底部行动号召（CTA）：添加一条宽大的蓝色丝带横幅，左侧带有一颗黄色星星，并写有日语口号 {argument name="bottom slogan text" default="運動パフォーマンスを向上させよう！"}；将“向上”二字用黄色强调。在最左下角添加一个蓝色圆角联系按钮，配有白色电话图标和“お問い合わせ”，后跟 4 个空心圆占位符。

视觉风格：现代日本儿童活动宣传单，高质量矢量图形，充满活力的蓝/橙/绿配色，圆角字体，间距清晰，轻微阴影，活泼且井然有序。避免照片级写实，避免杂乱，除活动网格中的 4 名儿童外不添加额外人物，不添加超出指定数量的卡片。

templates.title: Photo of a promotional flyer for a Japanese sports school

titleLocalized.zh: 日本体育学校宣传单照片

templates.prompt: Create a 3:4 vertical, photorealistic Japanese promotional image with a clean, editorial, and fashionable advertising feel. The image features a young Japanese woman in her early twenties, wearing a pure white short-sleeved T-shirt tucked into high-waisted off-white linen trousers, a belt cinched at the waist. She stands in front of a warm, light cream-colored wall, bathed in soft, direct sunlight. The composition extends from her upper thighs to her head, positioning her slightly to the right of center. She looks down confidently at the camera, her expression relaxed, her skin naturally radiant, her makeup light, her long, dark hair tied up with a few wisps framing her face. She holds a white brochure vertically across her chest; a delicate ring adorns her finger. On the left side of the image is the title, "理学疗疗士がサポート" (Rigoku Soyaku Shi ga Sapoto), in an elegant Japanese Meicho serif font, with "理学疗疗士" in blue, "が" in green, and "サポート" in orange. The handbook cover should feature a vibrant sports school logo design. The main title, "High School Student's Sports Classroom," should be in a playful rounded font, using a blue, orange, and green color scheme, with the Lovart branding at the bottom. The handbook should include five striking sports-themed graphic elements: a blue running silhouette on the left, an orange running silhouette on the right, a blue and white soccer ball in the lower left, an orange basketball in the lower right, and a circular arc surrounding the title. A few decorative stars and dots should be added around the logo, but kept secondary. Use bright, clear colors, realistic shadows cast on walls, a shallow depth of field effect, and a high-end commercial photography feel. The handbook should be clearly printed, watermark-free, and contain no additional text besides the designated Japanese text and the Lovart branding. A custom visible sponsor branding is allowed.{argument name="sponsor brand" default="Lovart"} The manual is titled{argument name="booklet title" default="High school sports classes"} The title on the left is{argument name="headline text" default="Physical therapists provide support."} The target audience is{argument name="target audience" default="high school students"} The model's clothing color is{argument name="model outfit color" default="white and off-white"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 3:4 竖版、照片级真实感的日本宣传单图像，呈现干净的编辑时尚广告质感。画面中是一位 20 岁左右的年轻日本女性，身穿纯白色短袖 T 恤，下摆束进高腰米白色亚麻长裤中，腰间系有腰带，站在温暖的淡奶油色墙面前，沐浴在柔和的直射阳光下。构图从大腿上部到头部，她位于画面中心偏右，神情从容自信地向下看向镜头，表情放松，皮肤自然有光泽，妆容清淡，深色长发扎起，脸颊两侧留有几缕碎发。她双手将一本白色手册垂直抱在胸前；手指上戴着一枚细戒指。在图像左侧，放置标题文字「理学療法士がサポート」，使用优雅的日本明朝体衬线字体，其中「理学療法士」为蓝色，「が」为绿色，「サポート」为橙色。手册封面应包含一个活泼的体育学校标志设计，主标题文字「高校生のスポーツ教室」采用俏皮的圆体字，配色为蓝、橙、绿色，底部印有 Lovart 品牌文字。手册上需包含 5 个醒目的体育主题图形元素：左侧 1 个蓝色跑步剪影，右侧 1 个橙色跑步剪影，左下方 1 个蓝白相间的足球，右下方 1 个橙色篮球，以及环绕标题的 1 个圆形弧线。在标志周围添加少量装饰性星星和圆点，但保持其次要地位。使用明亮通透的色调，墙面投射出真实的阴影，浅景深效果，高端商业摄影质感，手册印刷清晰，无水印，除指定的日文文案和 Lovart 品牌外，不包含任何额外文字。自定义可见赞助商品牌为 {argument name="sponsor brand" default="Lovart"}，手册标题为 {argument name="booklet title" default="高校生のスポーツ教室"}，左侧标题为 {argument name="headline text" default="理学療法士がサポート"}，目标受众为 {argument name="target audience" default="high school students"}，模特服装颜色为 {argument name="model outfit color" default="white and off-white"}。

templates.title: Museum Paper Art Anime Portraits

titleLocalized.zh: 博物馆纸艺动漫肖像

templates.prompt: Create a vertical museum gallery scene to showcase{argument name="character name" default="An original anime-style girl"} As an ultra-detailed three-dimensional paper art piece, it bursts forth from a large, white, shadowy frame hanging on the wall. The artwork is an oversized portrait: it contains the image of a young girl, a deep rectangular white frame, a small museum visitor standing in the lower right corner for contrast, and a solid-color square privacy occlusion obscuring the central area of ​​the girl's face. The girl possesses {argument name="hair color" default="Soft gray-brown"} Her long, wavy hair, composed of layered paper-cut strips, boasts exquisite anime proportions. She wears a sleeveless cream-colored dress with numerous folded paper ruffles, a pale blue silk bow tie, and a small bracelet. Surrounding her are intricate paper flowers, translucent petals, pale blue leaves, curled ribbons, and layered floral paper cutouts extending from the frame, creating the feeling that the paper art has come alive and overflows the room. The color palette, dominated by ivory, beige, cream, and light blush, utilizes {argument name="accent color" default="light sky blue"} As an embellishment. The scene is set in a quiet contemporary art museum, featuring high walls, wooden floors, soft natural light from a skylight in the upper right corner, long shadows, and a solitary visitor in a black coat gazing up at the artwork. Visual style: A combination of realistic museum installations and exquisite anime illustrations; extremely precise paper-cut textures, visible folded edges, the depth of layered cardstock, delicate shadows, a translucent parchment texture, elegant soft tones, cinematic lighting, and high detail, both fantastical and realistic. Composition: A giant paper portrait centered occupies most of the image space, with the visitor in the lower right corner. The frame slightly protrudes from the wall, and flowers and ribbons extend outwards in bas-relief. Constraints: No text, no watermarks, no additional figures, keep the face obscured in a solid color and centered, and maintain a 4:5 aspect ratio.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个垂直的博物馆画廊场景，展示 {argument name="character name" default="一位原创动漫风格女孩"} 作为超精细的三维纸艺作品，从墙上悬挂的大型白色阴影画框中破框而出。该艺术品是一幅超大尺寸的肖像画：包含 1 个年轻女孩形象、1 个深邃的矩形白色画框、1 位站在右下角用于对比比例的小型博物馆参观者，以及 1 个遮挡女孩面部中心区域的纯色正方形隐私遮挡块。女孩拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="柔和灰棕色"} 的长波浪卷发，由层叠的剪纸条构成，具有精致的动漫比例，身穿无袖奶油色连衣裙，带有许多折叠纸质褶边、淡蓝色丝带领结和一个小手镯。周围环绕着复杂的纸花、半透明花瓣、淡蓝色叶片、卷曲的丝带条以及延伸出画框的层叠花卉剪纸，营造出纸艺作品仿佛活过来并溢出到房间里的感觉。在以象牙白、米色、奶油色和淡腮红为主的色调中，使用 {argument name="accent color" default="淡天蓝色"} 作为点缀。场景设定在一个安静的当代艺术博物馆内，拥有高墙、木地板、来自右上角天窗的柔和自然光、长长的阴影，以及一位身穿黑色外套、抬头仰望作品的孤独参观者。视觉风格：写实的博物馆装置与精致动漫插画的结合，极度精准的剪纸纹理，可见的折叠边缘，层叠卡纸的深度感，细腻的阴影，半透明的羊皮纸质感，优雅的柔和色调，电影级布光，高细节，既奇幻又写实。构图：居中的巨型纸艺肖像占据画面大部分空间，参观者位于右下角，画框略微凸出墙面，花朵和丝带以浅浮雕形式向外延伸。约束条件：无文字，无水印，无额外人物，保持面部遮挡块为纯色且居中，保持 4:5 的垂直纵横比。

templates.title: Textile Collage Fairy Girl

titleLocalized.zh: 纺织拼贴精灵少女

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed vertical mixed-media textile collage portrait, with the subject being {argument name="character type" default="A delicate elf girl"} The design is composed of realistic lace, dried flowers, leaves, ribbons, and layered fabric fragments. The composition features a central, full-body elf figure in a soft profile, with two long, pointed ears, extremely long, wavy, grey-gold hair, and a simple matte beige rectangular mask covering her face as a deliberately negative placeholder. Five visible clothing components are designed for this figure: a distressed grey-white lace dress, a layered lace shawl, a large lace flower headdress, a trailing gauze ribbon, and a small bouquet of wildflowers held at her chest. The figure is surrounded by a lush border of cream and sage green plants, featuring four striking anchor points: a large olive-green ribbon bow in the upper left, a diagonal white lace ribbon in the upper right, a large cream-colored rose in the lower right, and a vertical clump of beige hay on the left.{argument name="color palette" default="Ivory, Antique Cream, Beige, Sage Green, Soft Olive, Light Gold"} Containing no vibrant colors, this piece emphasizes the authenticity of tactile materials: crocheted lace holes, worn fabric edges, translucent tulle, embossed leaves, tiny white flowers, dried stems, embroidered mesh, paper petals, and subtle shadows between layers. The background is a magnificent wall, handcrafted from overlapping lace fragments, botanical cuts, and vintage fabrics, filling the entire canvas without leaving any blank spaces. The lighting is soft, diffused natural light, creating a warm, vintage hue with a bas-relief-like three-dimensional effect, a romantic elfin aesthetic, extremely intricate textures, high resolution, and is free of text and watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅高度精细的竖构图混合媒介纺织拼贴肖像，主体为 {argument name="character type" default="一位精致的精灵少女"}，由逼真的蕾丝、干花、叶片、丝带和分层布料碎片构成。构图包含 1 个位于中央的全身精灵形象，呈柔和的侧身姿态，拥有 2 只长尖耳、极长的波浪状灰金色长发，面部覆盖着一个简约的哑光米色长方形面具，作为刻意留白的占位符。为该形象设计 5 个可见的服饰组件：一件破旧的灰白色蕾丝长裙、一条分层蕾丝披肩、一个大型蕾丝花朵头饰、拖曳的纱质丝带，以及胸前捧着的一束小野花。在人物周围环绕着茂密的奶油色与鼠尾草绿植物边框，包含 4 个醒目的锚点装饰：左上方 1 个大型橄榄色缎带蝴蝶结，右上角 1 条斜向的白色蕾丝丝带，右下方 1 朵大型奶油色玫瑰，以及左侧 1 簇垂直的米色干草。使用 {argument name="color palette" default="象牙白、古董奶油色、米色、鼠尾草绿、柔和橄榄色、浅金色"}，不含鲜艳色彩。强调触感材质的真实性：钩针蕾丝孔洞、磨损的布料边缘、半透明薄纱、压花叶片、细小的白色花朵、干枯的茎秆、刺绣网眼、纸质花瓣，以及层叠间的微妙阴影。背景是一面由重叠的蕾丝碎片、植物剪枝和复古布料手工拼贴而成的华丽墙面，填满整个画面，不留空白。光线为柔和的漫射自然光，呈现温暖的复古色调，具有浅浮雕般的立体感，浪漫的精灵风美学，极其复杂的纹理，高分辨率，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Anime Girl at Central Station

titleLocalized.zh: 中央车站的动漫少女

templates.prompt: Create a vertical, anime-style street scene at the entrance of a Japanese train station, with a girl standing sideways under the dimly lit station roof in the foreground. The character possesses {argument name="hair color" default="black"} Her high ponytail, tied with a red ribbon, and straight bangs framed her face. She had fair skin and a striking appearance.{argument name="eye color" default="red"} Her eyes; she wore a crisp white short-sleeved school uniform shirt with a dark bow tie at the collar, and a high-waisted dark pleated skirt. Her posture was calm yet slightly melancholic, her arms hanging naturally at her sides, gazing towards the brightly lit city street to her right. The scene is set in…{argument name="station name" default="Central Station"} Bilingual station signage is visible, including "Chuo Sta," "East Exit," "Bus Terminal," "Taxi Waiting Area," and "Coin Lockers." A hanging sign and analog clock are also present on the right. The background showcases a sunlit city pedestrian crossing, pedestrians, cars, mid-rise commercial buildings, shop signs, tiled pavement, glass doors, pillars, and strong perspective lines extending from the dark interior of the station. Dramatic high-contrast lighting is used: deep black shadows inside the station, bright white sunlight outside, long geometric shadows on the ground, and limited monochromatic tones with only red accents for the eyes and hairband. The style should blend delicate comic book lines with cinematic noir photography, featuring subtle film grain, slight color variations, sharp ink lines, realistic architectural details, and a melancholic urban atmosphere. No additional characters, smiling poses, fantastical elements, or exaggerated accessories should appear in the foreground; the composition should focus on and contain only this one girl.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖构图的动漫风格日本火车站入口街景，前景中一位少女侧身站在阴暗的车站顶棚下。角色拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"} 的高马尾发型，系着红色丝带，直刘海修饰脸庞，皮肤白皙，有着引人注目的 {argument name="eye color" default="红色"} 双眼；她身穿挺括的白色短袖校服衬衫，领口系着深色小蝴蝶结，下身穿着高腰深色百褶裙。她的姿态平静而略带忧郁，双臂自然垂在身侧，望向右侧明亮的城市街道。场景设定为 {argument name="station name" default="中央车站"}，可见双语车站标识，包括“Chuo Sta”、“东出口”、“巴士总站”、“出租车候车点”和“投币储物柜”，右侧还有悬挂的指示牌和模拟时钟。背景展示了阳光明媚的城市人行横道、行人、汽车、中层商业建筑、店面招牌、瓷砖路面、玻璃门、立柱，以及从阴暗车站内部延伸出的强烈透视线条。使用戏剧性的高对比度光影：车站内部深邃的黑色阴影，外部明亮的白色日光，地面上长长的几何阴影，以及仅在眼睛和发带处保留红色点缀的有限单色调。风格应融合细腻的漫画线条与电影感黑色摄影，带有细微的胶片颗粒感、轻微的色差、锐利的墨线、写实的建筑细节以及忧郁的城市氛围。前景中不要出现额外角色，不要有微笑姿态，不要有奇幻元素，不要有夸张的配饰，构图需聚焦于且仅包含这一位少女。

templates.title: Three-panel rooftop comic in the style of shoujo manga

titleLocalized.zh: 三格少女漫风格天台漫画

templates.prompt: Objective: Based on a simple single-page scene, create a refined black-and-white double-page spread comic, drawn in a clean shoujo manga style, using delicate hatching, ink lines on non-half-dot paper, a warm off-white paper texture, and thin black panel borders. Canvas: Vertical page, approximately 3:4 aspect ratio, with three wide horizontal panels stacked from top to bottom. Each panel is surrounded by a hand-drawn manga border with a slight paper grain texture. The overall atmosphere is romantic, sensual, and subtly dramatic. Character: A cute high school girl.{argument name="character name" default="Unnamed female student"} She has light-colored hair styled in two braids with bangs, a wide headband, and small bows tied to her braids. She has large, shoujo manga-style eyes, slightly flushed cheeks, and wears a sailor-style school uniform. She wears small cross earrings and carries a rectangular backpack with a cross ornament. Her expression shifts from worry and hesitation to firm resolve, finally revealing a confident and gentle smile. Layout and number of shots: 3 shots. 1. Top: A school rooftop or high terrace at sunset, with city buildings in the distance, metal railings, falling petals, soft clouds, and a gentle breeze. The girl leans against the railing in a three-quarter profile, one hand to her mouth, looking hesitant. Add a vertical oval Japanese speech bubble on the right side, containing: "...Sakki, I can't say...". Place a soft gray rectangular blur mask in the center of her face to obscure facial features in this shot. 2. Middle: The same girl suddenly stands up, strides forward with a determined expression, holding or pulling her backpack to the side. Use strong cartoon speed lines radiating from the background to depict the moment of decision. Add a vertical oval Japanese speech bubble on the right with the text: "大丈夫。明日ちゃんと伝えよう。" Place a soft gray rectangular blur mask in the center of her face to obscure facial features in this shot. 3. Bottom: A close-up of the girl's face, now without the mask, her features are clearly visible, her eyes are sparkling, her cheeks are flushed, and there are tiny heart-shaped highlights around her hair and cheeks. She touches or holds her cross earring, revealing a confident smile. Add a vertical oval Japanese speech bubble on the right with the text: "私のやり方で、もう一ク。" Visual Style: Fine black and white manga ink lines, expressive shoujo manga-style large eyes, delicate hatching, clean outlines, and natural hand-drawn imperfections. A subtle sunset atmosphere is conveyed solely through lines. No colors are used except for the off-white paper background and the gray face masks in the first two panels. Constraints: Maintain 3 panels, 3 speech bubbles, and 2 gray face mask rectangles. Do not add extra characters, extra titles, logos, watermarks, or modern UI elements. Please retain all written Japanese text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：基于简单的单页场景，创作一页精致的黑白漫画双页跨页风格漫画，绘制成干净的少女漫画原稿，采用细腻的排线、无网点纸的墨水线条、温暖的米白色纸张纹理以及细黑色的分镜框。

画布：竖版页面，比例约为 3:4，从上到下堆叠三个宽横向分镜。每个分镜周围使用手绘漫画边框，并带有轻微的纸张颗粒感。整体氛围浪漫、感性且带有柔和的戏剧性。

角色：一位可爱的少女高中生，{argument name="character name" default="未命名女学生"}，浅色头发扎成双麻花辫，留着齐刘海，戴着宽发带，辫子上系着小蝴蝶结，拥有少女漫标志性的大眼睛，脸颊微红，身穿水手服风格校服。她戴着小十字架耳环，背着一个带有十字架挂饰的长方形书包。她的表情从担忧犹豫转变为坚定决心，最后露出自信而温柔的微笑。

布局与分镜数量：使用 3 个分镜。
1. 顶部：日落时的学校天台或高处露台，远处是城市建筑，有金属栏杆、飘落的花瓣、柔和的云朵和微风。女孩以四分之三侧面倚靠在栏杆上，一只手放在嘴边，神情犹豫。在右侧添加一个竖向椭圆形日文对话气泡，内容为： 「…さっき、言いすぎたかな…」。在她的面部中心放置一个柔和的灰色矩形模糊遮罩，遮住此分镜中的面部特征。
2. 中间：同一个女孩突然站起身，神情坚定地向前迈进，手持或拉起侧面的书包。使用从背景放射出的强烈漫画速度线来表现决定的瞬间。在右侧添加一个竖向椭圆形日文对话气泡，内容为： 「大丈夫。明日ちゃんと伝えよう。」。在她的面部中心放置一个柔和的灰色矩形模糊遮罩，遮住此分镜中的面部特征。
3. 底部：女孩面部的特写，此时不再有遮罩，面容清晰可见，眼睛闪闪发光，脸颊带有红晕，头发和脸颊周围有微小的爱心高光，她轻触或握住十字架耳环，露出自信的微笑。在右侧添加一个竖向椭圆形日文对话气泡，内容为： 「私のやり方で、もう一度。」。

视觉风格：精细的黑白漫画墨水线条，富有表现力的少女漫大眼睛，细腻的排线，干净的轮廓线，自然的手绘瑕疵，仅通过线条呈现微妙的日落氛围，除了米白色纸张背景和前两个分镜中的灰色面部遮罩外，不使用任何颜色。

约束条件：保持 3 个分镜，3 个对话气泡，以及 2 个灰色面部遮罩矩形。不要添加额外角色、额外标题、标志、水印或现代 UI 元素。请务必保留所写的日文文本。

templates.title: GPT Image 2 Cute Sticker Collection

titleLocalized.zh: GPT Image 2 可爱贴纸合集

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a cute sticker collection for social media model comparisons, featuring 12 identical faceless character variations, with a prominent title at the top.{argument name="headline text" default="GPT Image 2"} Canvas: Vertical 9:16, mobile format, white background with thin dark borders, layout resembling a printable sticker sheet. Ample white space is maintained between stickers, employing a playful and cute scrapbook aesthetic. Main character: A {argument name="hair color" default="Bright golden orange"} A young person with a messy, chin-length bob, soft and bouncy hair, wearing an oversized white shirt or hoodie. The face area should be deliberately blurred or left blank, presented as a smooth beige oval to indicate anonymity. A soft, semi-realistic anime illustration style is used, with glossy highlights and sharp, sticker-like cutout edges. Layout: The large title is placed at the top, using rounded, bold speech bubbles filled in white, with a thick light blue outline and subtle shadows. Below are 12 character stickers arranged in a loose grid layout of 3 columns and 4 rows: 1. Top left: Head slightly tilted, messy hair swept outwards, with a small pink heart next to it. 2. Top center: Frontal half-body portrait, with a speech bubble with a pink heart above. 3. Top right: Playful pose with hands near the head, with a small yellow crown doodle above. 4. Second row left: Sleeping on its side, eyes blurred, surrounded by tiny Z characters and the words "Too Cute". 5. Second row, middle: Frontal half-body portrait with the words "Good Vibes" and a small star. 6. Second row, right: Half-body portrait slightly tilted, surrounded by sparkles and a black heart. 7. Third row, left: Frontal half-body portrait with "You Got This" in the lower left corner. 8. Third row, middle: Half-body portrait holding or wearing a small black tag that says "COFFEE FIRST". 9. Third row, right: A gesture suggesting a smile, with hands near the cheeks, accompanied by the words "Be You" and a heart-shaped speech bubble. 10. Lower left: A playful salute or hand-on-head pose, with messy hair swept to the left. 11. Lower right: A simple, centered half-body portrait with pink heart markings around the head. 12. Lower right: A cheerful half-body portrait with one hand near the hair and a heart-shaped speech bubble next to it. Doodles and Text: Scatter 24 decorative stickers around the page: 6 pink hearts, 4 black hearts, 4 yellow stars, 3 pink flowers, 2 small crowns, 2 smiley faces, 1 "LOL" speech bubble, 1 "XOXO" text doodle, and 1 "Too Cute" text doodle. Includes casual handwritten fonts such as "Good Vibes," "You Got This," "COFFEE FIRST," and "Be You."{argument name="accent color" default="pink"} Yellow is the primary accent color. Visual style: Bright, cute, high-key lighting; a combination of soft watercolor marker textures and delicate digital illustrations; rounded sticker outlines; hand-drawn doodles; and a playful Gen Z diary aesthetic. Keep the visuals clean, cheerful, and the content rich and easy to read. Constraints: No realistic facial features; keep all 12 faces anonymous or softly blurred. Do not add more than 12 character variations. Do not add watermarks, applied UI, or model contrast panels other than the top title.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为社交媒体模型对比制作一张可爱的贴纸合集，包含 12 个相同的无脸角色变体，并在顶部放置醒目的标题 {argument name="headline text" default="GPT Image 2"}。

画布：垂直 9:16 移动端格式，白色背景，带有细深色边框，布局如同可打印的贴纸页。贴纸之间保持充足的留白，采用俏皮的可爱剪贴簿美学。

主角：一个留着 {argument name="hair color" default="明亮金橙色"} 凌乱下巴长度波波头的年轻人，发丝柔软蓬松，身穿超大号白色衬衫或连帽衫。脸部区域应刻意模糊或留白，呈现为平滑的米色椭圆形，以示匿名。采用柔和的半写实动漫插画风格，带有光泽高光和清晰的贴纸式剪裁边缘。

布局：将大标题置于最上方，使用圆润的粗体气泡字，白色填充，配以厚实的浅蓝色轮廓和微妙的投影。下方排列 12 个角色贴纸，采用 3 列 4 行的松散网格布局：
1. 左上：头部微倾，凌乱的头发向外扫，旁边有粉色小爱心。
2. 中上：正面半身像，上方有带粉色爱心的对话气泡。
3. 右上：双手靠近头部的俏皮姿势，上方有黄色小皇冠涂鸦。
4. 第二行左：侧卧睡姿，眼睛被模糊处理，周围有微小的 Z 字符和“Too Cute”字样。
5. 第二行中：正面半身像，带有“Good Vibes”文字和一颗小星星。
6. 第二行右：半身像略微倾斜，周围环绕着闪光和一颗黑色爱心。
7. 第三行左：正面半身像，左下方有“You Got This”字样。
8. 第三行中：半身像手持或佩戴写有“COFFEE FIRST”的黑色小标签。
9. 第三行右：暗示微笑的姿势，双手靠近脸颊，带有“Be You”文字和心形对话气泡。
10. 左下：俏皮的敬礼或手扶头部姿势，凌乱的头发向左扫。
11. 右下：简单的居中半身像，头部周围有粉色爱心标记。
12. 右下：欢快的半身像，一只手靠近头发，旁边有心形对话气泡。

涂鸦与文字：在页面周围散布 24 个装饰性小贴纸：6 个粉色爱心、4 个黑色爱心、4 个黄色星星、3 朵粉色花朵、2 个小皇冠、2 个笑脸、1 个“LOL”对话气泡、1 个“XOXO”文字涂鸦和 1 个“Too Cute”文字涂鸦。包含“Good Vibes”、“You Got This”、“COFFEE FIRST”和“Be You”等休闲手写字体。使用 {argument name="accent color" default="粉色"} 和黄色作为主要强调色。

视觉风格：明亮、可爱、高调照明，柔和的水彩马克笔质感与精致的数字插画相结合，圆润的贴纸轮廓，手绘涂鸦，俏皮的 Z 世代日记美学。保持画面整洁、欢快，内容丰富且易于阅读。

约束：禁止出现写实的五官；保持所有 12 个面部匿名或柔和模糊。不要添加超过 12 个的角色变体。不要添加水印、应用 UI 或除顶部标题以外的模型对比面板。

templates.title: Neon Anime DJ Girl

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹动漫 DJ 女孩

templates.prompt: Create a 9:16 vertical anime-style music illustration depicting a young woman amidst a neon cyberpunk nightscape. The main subject is a stylish anime girl with {argument name="hair color" default="Long, deep purple-black hair with pink and blue highlights"} The image is shown in a dynamic, three-quarter profile, displaying her upper body with her hair flowing in the wind. She wears large, glossy DJ headphones with luminous cyan and magenta halos, a black choker, a delicate necklace, a loose white tank top, and an oversized dark jacket that slips off one shoulder. Her right hand lightly touches the headphones. An opaque square mask, in a soft magenta color, covers her eyes, nose, and mouth in the center of her face. Around her, a vibrant audiovisual vortex surrounds her: eight striking glowing musical notes are precisely positioned, including three bright pink notes near the top left and right corners, two cyan notes on the left, one cyan-pink bicolor note on the right edge, and two pink notes near the lower foreground. Glowing curved light trails, shimmering particles, star-shaped light spots, and a digital equalizer bar at the bottom are added.{argument name="color palette" default="Electric blue, violet, magenta, bright pink, and deep black"} High-contrast glossy lighting, delicate anime rendering, dramatic contour lighting, a vibrant concert atmosphere, clearly defined hair strands, reflective headphone surfaces, and a rich, magical musical aura. No visible text, no watermark, no extraneous characters.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 9:16 竖屏动漫风格的音乐插画，呈现一位身处霓虹赛博朋克夜景中的年轻女性。主体是一位时尚的动漫女孩，拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="带有粉色和蓝色边缘高光的长款深紫黑色头发"}，以动态的三分之四侧身姿势展示腰部以上画面，头发在画面中随风飘动。她戴着大型光泽感头戴式 DJ 耳机，耳机上有发光的青色和洋红色光环，佩戴黑色颈圈、精致项链，身穿宽松的白色吊带背心，以及一件从一侧肩膀滑落的超大款深色夹克。她的右手轻轻触碰耳边的耳机。在面部正中央放置一个不透明的方形遮挡块，覆盖眼睛、鼻子和嘴巴，颜色为柔和的紫红色。在她的周围环绕充满活力的视听漩涡：精确布置 8 个醒目的发光音符，包括左上角和右上角附近的 3 个亮粉色音符、左侧的 2 个青色音符、右边缘的 1 个青粉双色音符，以及前景下方附近的 2 个粉色音符。添加环绕她身体的发光曲线光轨、闪烁的微粒、星状光斑，以及底部的数字均衡器条。使用 {argument name="color palette" default="电光蓝、紫罗兰色、洋红色、亮粉色和深黑色"}，高对比度光泽照明，细腻的动漫渲染，戏剧性的轮廓光，充满活力的音乐会氛围，清晰的发丝，反光的耳机表面，以及浓郁的魔法音乐光环。无可见文字，无水印，无多余字符。

templates.title: Dusk Maid by the Campfire

titleLocalized.zh: 篝火旁的黄昏女仆

templates.prompt: Create a vertical, cinematic anime-style illustration featuring two maids dressed in glamorous gothic Lolita outfits resting beside a bright campfire on a ruined, post-apocalyptic city street at dusk. The maid on the left possesses {argument name="left maid hair color" default="Short orange bob haircut"} She wears a lace-trimmed maid headdress with a pink bow, a pink satin puff-sleeved maid dress with layered white ruffles, bows, lace trim, white fingerless gloves, a heart-shaped choker, and knee-high socks; she holds a black metal mug with a white emblem. The maid on the right possesses {argument name="right maid hair color" default="Long pink hair"} The maid wears a white lace maid headdress with black lace and a black ribbon bow, a black shiny gothic maid dress with white ruffles, a low neckline, black gloves and wristbands, black stockings, and delicate earrings; she sits with her chin resting on her hand, knees bent. Their faces are deliberately obscured by two solid brown squares, one for each face, to recreate the original occlusion effect. The foreground includes exactly one large orange campfire and glowing embers, exactly one metal teapot near the bottom center, exactly one small metal cup beside the fire, and a black mug held by the maid on the left. The background should show ruined high-rises, broken balconies, dark rubble, smoke, and narrow streets stretching into the distance under a soft pinkish-purple sunset. Utilizing dramatic warm firelight from below and soft sunset contour lighting from behind, the artwork showcases highly detailed fabric textures, lace, ribbons, glossy satin, realistic anime rendering, shallow depth of field, and atmospheric sparks floating in the air, creating a melancholic yet warm contrast between adorable maid fashion and a desolate cityscape. Aside from the small emblem on the mug, there should be no readable text in the image, no watermarks, and no additional characters.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖构图的电影感动漫风格插画，画面中恰好有两名身着华丽哥特萝莉装的女仆，在黄昏时分废墟般的末日城市街道上，紧挨着明亮的篝火休息。左侧女仆拥有 {argument name="left maid hair color" default="短款橙色波波头"}，佩戴带有粉色蝴蝶结的蕾丝花边女仆头饰，身穿粉色缎面泡泡袖女仆裙，配有层叠的白色荷叶边、蝴蝶结、蕾丝饰边、白色露指手套、心形项圈和过膝袜；她手中拿着一个带有白色纹章的黑色金属马克杯。右侧女仆拥有 {argument name="right maid hair color" default="长款粉色头发"}，佩戴带有黑色蕾丝和黑色丝带蝴蝶结的白色蕾丝女仆头饰，身穿带有白色荷叶边饰的黑色亮面哥特女仆裙，低领设计，佩戴黑色手套和腕带、黑色长筒袜以及精致的耳环；她单手托腮，屈膝而坐。她们的面部特意用两个纯棕色实心正方形遮挡，每个面部各一个，以还原原始的遮挡效果。前景包含恰好一个大型橙色篝火及发光的余烬、底部中心附近恰好一个金属茶壶、火堆旁恰好一个小金属杯，以及左侧女仆手中持有的黑色马克杯。背景应展现废墟高楼、破碎的阳台、深色瓦砾、烟雾，以及在柔和的粉紫色夕阳下向深处延伸的狭窄街道。运用来自下方的戏剧性暖色火光和来自后方的柔和夕阳轮廓光，展现高细节的布料纹理、蕾丝、丝带、光泽缎面、写实动漫渲染、浅景深效果，以及空气中漂浮的氛围感火星，营造出可爱的女仆时尚与荒凉城市景观之间忧郁而温馨的对比。除马克杯上的小纹章外，画面中不应出现任何可读文字，无水印，无额外角色。

templates.title: Pocari Sweat advertisement featuring a high school girl by the sea

titleLocalized.zh: 海边宝矿力水特女高中生广告

templates.prompt: Create a bright Japanese summer beverage advertisement poster, for the brand {argument name="brand name" default="POCARI SWEAT"} The style references the key visual of a 2009 seaside TV commercial. It employs a full vertical poster composition, photorealistic, with bright sunlight, a clear blue sky, white clouds, and a backdrop of ocean and distant mountains. A sun-drenched seaside promenade with railings is depicted, with the side of a white building on the right. A full-body image of a Japanese high school girl is positioned slightly to the right of the center of the frame, shot from a low angle. She wears a white sailor-style school uniform top with a navy blue collar and tie, a navy blue pleated skirt, white knee-high socks, and black loafers. Her face is blurred with a smooth rectangular blur to conceal her identity, but her long black hair and natural pose are preserved. She holds a blue and white bottle of beverage close to her lips, as if drinking, appearing refreshing and hydrating. Add three clear brand text areas: The top left corner features a small Otsuka logo with the Japanese company name; the center left corner prominently displays the Japanese text "あついカラダに、おいしい水濠。"; above this is a large, bold white stacked text "POCARI SWEAT" with a white wavy mark; the bottom right corner features small blue Japanese text "汗のあとに、ポカリスエット。" along with a small legal notice/footer and website address. Add two product bottle elements: a girl holding a bottle, and a large, tilted bottle with condensation visible in the lower left foreground, in blue.{argument name="bottle label" default="POCARI SWEAT"} The label should face the viewer. Add a small, round blue badge next to the bottle in the foreground that reads "ION SUPPLY DRINK". Indicate the year in small white lettering in the upper right corner.{argument name="year" default="2009"} Use clean, business-style typography, a strong blue and white brand color scheme, a glossy, condensation-like effect, a summery freshness, realistic shadows, a slight wide-angle perspective, and poster-quality clarity. Avoid unnecessary figures, bottles, cluttered text, or any watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张明亮的日本夏季饮料广告海报，品牌为 {argument name="brand name" default="POCARI SWEAT"}，风格参考 2009 年海边电视广告的主视觉图。采用完整的竖版海报构图，照片级写实，高调日光，湛蓝天空，白云，背景为海洋和远山，阳光明媚的海滨长廊配有栏杆，右侧为白色建筑侧面。一位日本女高中生全身像位于画面中心偏右，低角度拍摄，身穿白色水手服风格校服上衣，配有海军蓝领子和蓝色领带，海军蓝百褶裙，白色及膝袜和黑色乐福鞋。她的面部经过平滑的矩形模糊处理以隐去身份，但保留了长长的黑发和自然的姿态。她手持一瓶蓝白相间的饮料靠近嘴边，仿佛正在饮用，显得清爽且补水。添加 3 处清晰的品牌文字区域：左上角为带有日本公司名称的小型 Otsuka 标志，左侧中央为醒目的日语文案「あついカラダに、おいしい水分。」，上方为巨大的粗体白色堆叠文字 "POCARI SWEAT" 及白色波浪标记，右下角为蓝色小字日语文案「汗のあとに、ポカリスエット。」，并附带微小的法律声明/页脚文字及网址。添加 2 个产品瓶身元素：女孩手中握着一瓶，左下角前景处有一瓶带有冷凝水的倾斜大瓶身，蓝色的 {argument name="bottle label" default="POCARI SWEAT"} 标签面向观众。在前景瓶身旁添加一个蓝色的圆形小徽章，上面写着 "ION SUPPLY DRINK"。在右上角以白色小字标注年份 {argument name="year" default="2009"}。使用简洁的商业排版，强烈的蓝白品牌色调，光泽感的冷凝水效果，夏日清新感，真实的阴影，轻微的广角镜头透视，以及海报级的清晰细节。避免出现多余的人物、多余的瓶子、杂乱的文字或任何水印。

templates.title: A blonde woman wearing pink satin pajamas

titleLocalized.zh: 身穿粉色缎面睡衣的金发女性

templates.prompt: Create a vertically composed, realistic fashion photography style image featuring a person with {argument name="hair color" default="messy long blonde hair"} An adult woman stands beside a white sink in a modern marble bathroom. She wears a two-piece satin nightgown: a light-colored {argument name="pajama color" default="light pink"} A short-sleeved button-down shirt with piping, a chest pocket, and glossy fabric pleats, paired with matching drawstring shorts. Her face is deliberately obscured by a solid, opaque square veil in the center, its warm brown color covering the entire face but revealing her hair. She holds a creatively designed toothbrush close to her mouth; the toothbrush is {argument name="toothbrush style" default="Pink flamingo-shaped toothbrush"} On the left-hand sink, four toiletries bottles are placed: a white pump bottle, a small light pink bottle, a tall pink and black bottle, and a second white pump bottle. The background is a marble wall with gray textures, with a bright vertical vanity light on the far left, equipped with a chrome faucet. The lighting is a soft, warm-toned bathroom light with a shallow depth of field effect. The right-hand background is a darker doorway or bedroom area. She is casually leaning against the sink with one hip tilted, her hands relaxed and natural, showcasing the sheen of her satin pajamas. The composition has a cinematic realism, with rich details in skin and fabric texture, using a 2:3 portrait composition.{argument name="lighting mood" default="Soft, warm-toned morning bathroom light"} The image contains no text, no watermark, and no additional figures.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖构图的写实时尚摄影风格图像，画面中是一位留着 {argument name="hair color" default="凌乱长金发"} 的成年女性，站在现代大理石浴室的白色洗手台旁。她穿着两件套缎面睡衣：一件浅 {argument name="pajama color" default="淡粉色"} 短袖纽扣衬衫，带有滚边、胸袋、光泽面料褶皱，以及配套的抽绳短裤。她的面部被一个位于正中央的实心不透明方形遮挡块刻意遮住，遮挡块呈暖棕褐色，覆盖了整个面部区域，但露出了头发。她手持 1 把创意牙刷靠近嘴边，牙刷款式为 {argument name="toothbrush style" default="粉色火烈鸟造型牙刷"}。在左侧洗手台面上，放置 4 个洗漱用品瓶：一个白色按压瓶、一个小号淡粉色瓶、一个高大的粉黑配色瓶，以及第二个白色按压瓶。场景背景为带有灰色纹理的大理石墙面，最左侧有一盏明亮的竖条镜前灯，配有镀铬水龙头，光线为柔和的暖色调浴室光，具有浅景深效果，右侧背景为较暗的门口或卧室区域。让她以一侧髋部倾斜的姿势随意倚靠在洗手台上，手部姿势自然放松，展现缎面睡衣的光泽感，具有电影级写实感，皮肤和织物纹理细节丰富，采用 2:3 人像构图。使用 {argument name="lighting mood" default="柔和的暖色调清晨浴室光"}；画面中无文字、无水印、无额外人物。
