templates.title: Female android versus mechanical scorpion

titleLocalized.zh: 女性仿生人对战机械蝎

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic, vertical sci-fi action illustration depicting {argument name="character concept" default="A female android warrior on a spaceship"} A battle scene unfolds in the ruined corridors of a damaged spaceship. The main figure is a female android clad in glossy white segmented biomechanical armor, her lithe figure graceful, kneeling and twisting in a dynamic combat pose, her extremely long {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} Her hair flew wildly in zero gravity; her face was deliberately obscured by a soft, square blur effect or a mask-like neutral veil, making her features indistinct. She held a glowing weapon.{argument name="weapon color" default="blue and white"} An energy blade or plasma sword, positioned diagonally in the foreground, violently strikes a massive black mechanical scorpion enemy. The enemy is a gigantic mechanical scorpion with two enormous pincers, a heavily armored body, multiple jointed legs, and an arched, segmented tail tipped with glowing red spikes; its head and tail are equipped with red sensor lights. Show the bright sparks that erupt when the blade strikes the scorpion's pincers; the scene is filled with flying shrapnel, metal fragments, shattered glass, arcs of electricity, and starlight-like particles. The background is the interior of a futuristic spaceship, showing exposed panels, cables, a metal grating floor, warning screens, and a massive tear leading to outer space behind it; through the tear, the blue arc of Earth and the starry sky can be seen. The left wall should include two clearly visible warning displays showing legible red text, such as {argument name="warning text" default="HULL BREACH / SECTOR 7-A / WARNING"} Employing a dramatic wide-angle perspective, it emphasizes strong dynamism, high contrast, cool blue outline lighting reminiscent of space, red emergency warning highlights, volumetric particle effects, and ultra-refined hard-surface mecha design. The style is realistic anime-inspired sci-fi concept art, featuring highly detailed metallic scratches and reflections, cinematic depth of field, no other characters in the image, no watermark, and no text descriptions other than the warning display screen.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影级的竖版科幻动作插画，描绘 {argument name="character concept" default="一位身处宇宙飞船的女性仿生人战士"} 在飞船船体破损后的废墟走廊中战斗的场景。主体是一位身着光泽感白色分段式生物机械装甲的女性仿生人，体态矫健，正以动态战斗姿势跪地扭转，其极长的 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色"} 秀发在零重力下狂野飘散；她的面部被柔和的方形模糊效果或类似面罩的中性遮挡物刻意遮盖，无法看清五官。她手持一把发光的 {argument name="weapon color" default="蓝白色"} 能量刃或等离子剑，斜置于前景，正猛烈撞击一只巨大的黑色机械蝎敌人。敌人是一只巨大的机械蝎，拥有两只巨大的钳臂、厚重的装甲躯体、多条关节腿，以及一条末端带有红色发光尖刺的拱形分段尾巴；其头部和尾部带有红色传感器灯光。展示刀刃击中蝎钳时迸发的明亮火花，画面中充斥着飞溅的弹片、金属碎片、破碎的玻璃、电弧以及星光般的粒子。背景是充满未来感的宇宙飞船内部，可见裸露的面板、电缆、金属格栅地板、警示屏幕，以及身后通往外太空的巨大撕裂缺口；透过缺口，可以看到地球的蓝色弧线和星空。左侧墙壁上需包含两个清晰可见的警示显示屏，显示可读的红色文字，例如 {argument name="warning text" default="HULL BREACH / SECTOR 7-A / WARNING"}。采用戏剧性的广角透视，强调强烈的动感、高对比度、来自太空的冷蓝色轮廓光、红色紧急警示高光、体积粒子效果，以及超精细的硬表面机甲设计。风格为写实动漫风科幻概念艺术，具有极高细节的金属划痕与反射效果，以及电影级的景深，画面中不包含其他角色，无水印，除警示显示屏外无任何文字说明。

templates.title: Japanese-style mecha fast food storyboard

titleLocalized.zh: 日式机甲快餐分镜脚本

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a brightly colored 15-second Japanese TV commercial storyboard for a fictional McDonald's-style superhero robot promotional campaign, titled "..."{argument name="headline text" default="15-second commercial storyboard"} It was accompanied by a red subtitle.{argument name="subheadline text" default="Macro Robo, deploy!"} Canvas: A 16:9 landscape slides project on a white background, divided into 8 bordered panel panels arranged in 4 columns and 2 rows. Each panel has a red square number label in the upper left corner, a vibrant illustration area in the center, and a white explanatory text area below containing red timecode and black Japanese descriptive text. A tiny black disclaimer is added to the bottom edge. Visual Style: High-energy Japanese anime advertising paneling, the dynamism of toy ads, saturated red/yellow/blue tones, dramatic speed lines, sparks, explosions, urban action scenes, glossy mecha rendering, McDonald's-like golden arches branding elements, bold comic book outlines, and cinematic lighting. A refined generated image look is used, rather than flat vector art. Main Characters and Theme: A family of four is eating fast food; for privacy, their faces are deliberately blurred or obscured. A team of four transforming robots themed around food: a red hamburger hero robot with wings, a blue dinosaur/Tyrannosaurus robot, a golden lion robot, and a golden phoenix/eagle robot. Hamburgers, fries, chicken nuggets, soft drinks, and a giant spaghetti/noodle monster made of curly noodles are also featured. Number and content of storyboards: 8 storyboards are used. 1. Storyboard 1, timecode "0-2 seconds": A family of four sits at a McDonald's-like table, which is piled high with hamburgers, fries, chicken nuggets, drinks, and small toy robots. Caption: "Family members, makdnard! Good! Good!" 2. Storyboard 2, timecode "2-4 seconds": The fast food bursts with transforming energy, transforming into four robots: a red hamburger robot, a blue dinosaur robot, a golden lion robot, and a golden phoenix robot. Caption: "Eating べものが光って...ロボに変shaped! マックロボ, born!" 3. Storyboard 3, time code "4-6 seconds": The storyboard contains a character introduction grid, divided into 4 A smaller portrait frame, labeled: "パパ：バーガーロボ", "ママ：フェニックスロボ", "Brother: ティーレックスロボ", "Sister: ライオンロボ". Caption: "To the robot you're looking for! Come on, let's go!" 4. Shot 4, timecode "6-8 seconds": The robot team moves out on a city street under a blue sky, with the McDonald's logo in the background; a red winged robot flies forward, while the other three robots run below. Caption: "Let's go, Macro, let's go!" 5. Shot 5, timecode "8-10 seconds": A giant, angry spaghetti monster stands above city traffic, surrounded by forks and flying noodles. Caption: "The city is in danger!" 6. Shot 6, timecode "10-12 seconds": Four robots work together in the city to fight the spaghetti monster, accompanied by explosions, energy blasts, and dramatic action. Caption: "I'll make you stronger, right! Tokan!" 7. Scene 7, timecode "12-14 seconds": Four robots in victory poses in the city, with the red robot in the center and wings outstretched, the image overlaid with celebratory red and white Japanese shock text:{argument name="impact slogan" default="I'm feeling 100 times more energized today thanks to McDonald's."} Caption: "Make today's action 100 times more energetic! Make Macro's victory!" 8. Storyboard 8, timecode "14-15 seconds": Final brand end credits: Bright red background with a huge yellow McDonald's-style gold arches logo, a family of four and four robots posing together, plus white/yellow slogan text.{argument name="end card slogan" default="ワクワクを、いっしょに。 I'm lovin' it"} Description: "Wakuwaku wo, itsho ni. Macdonald" Text and Layout Restrictions: Keep all visible titles, timecodes, storyboard numbers, and descriptions in the specified Japanese. Place a bold red timecode centered below each image. Ensure the 8 storyboard panels are clearly separated by thin black borders. Do not add any additional storyboard panels, extra robots, QR codes, watermarks, or irrelevant logos, except for the McDonald's-style gold arches visual language.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为虚构的麦当劳风格超级英雄机器人宣传活动创建一个色彩鲜艳的 15 秒日本电视广告分镜脚本，标题为 {argument name="headline text" default="15秒CM ストーリーボード"}，并配有红色副标题 {argument name="subheadline text" default="マックロボ、出動！"}。

画布：白色背景上的 16:9 横向 Slides 项目，划分为 8 个带边框的分镜格，排列为 4 列 2 行。每个分镜格左上角有一个红色方形数字标签，中间是生动的插图区域，下方是白色说明文字区域，包含红色时间码和黑色日文描述文字。底部边缘添加一行极小的黑色免责声明。

视觉风格：高能量的日本动漫广告分镜，玩具广告的动态感，饱和的红/黄/蓝色调，戏剧性的速度线、火花、爆炸、城市动作场面、光泽感机甲渲染、类似麦当劳的金色拱门品牌元素、粗线条漫画轮廓、电影级光影。使用精致的生成图像外观，而非扁平的矢量艺术。

主要角色与主题：一家四口正在吃快餐；为了隐私，他们的脸应刻意模糊或遮挡。一支由 4 个以餐点为主题的变形机器人组成的团队：1 个带翅膀的红色汉堡英雄机器人，1 个蓝色恐龙/霸王龙机器人，1 个金色狮子机器人，以及 1 个金色凤凰/老鹰机器人。同时展示汉堡、薯条、鸡块、软饮以及一个由卷曲面条组成的巨大意大利面/面条怪兽。

分镜格数量与内容：使用 8 个分镜格。
1. 分镜 1，时间码 "0-2秒"：一家四口坐在类似麦当劳的餐厅桌前，桌上摆满了汉堡、薯条、鸡块、饮料和小型玩具机器人。说明文字："家族みんなでマクドナルド！ おいしい！たのしい！"
2. 分镜 2，时间码 "2-4秒"：快餐食品迸发出变形能量，变成了 4 个机器人：红色汉堡机器人、蓝色恐龙机器人、金色狮子机器人、金色凤凰机器人。说明文字："食べものが光って…ロボに変形！ マックロボ、誕生！"
3. 分镜 3，时间码 "4-6秒"：分镜格内包含一个角色介绍网格，分为 4 个较小的肖像框，标注为："パパ：バーガーロボ"、"ママ：フェニックスロボ"、"お兄ちゃん：ティーレックスロボ"、"妹：ライオンロボ"。说明文字："それぞれのロボットへ！ いくよ、出動！"
4. 分镜 4，时间码 "6-8秒"：机器人团队在蓝天下的城市街道上出动，背景有麦当劳标志；红色带翅膀机器人向前飞行，其他 3 个机器人在下方奔跑。说明文字："街をかけぬけ、 マックロボ、出動！"
5. 分镜 5，时间码 "8-10秒"：一个巨大的愤怒意大利面/面条怪兽耸立在城市交通之上，周围环绕着叉子和飞舞的面条。说明文字："街が危ないぞ！"
6. 分镜 6，时间码 "10-12秒"：4 个机器人在城市中共同对抗面条怪兽，伴随着爆炸、能量冲击和戏剧性的动作。说明文字："チームで力をあわせて、 えいっ！ とかーん！"
7. 分镜 7，时间码 "12-14秒"：4 个机器人在城市中的胜利姿势，红色机器人居中且张开翅膀，图像上覆盖着庆祝性的红白相间日文冲击文字：{argument name="impact slogan" default="今日もマックで元気100倍"}。说明文字："今日もマックで元気100倍！ マックロボの勝利だ！"
8. 分镜 8，时间码 "14-15秒"：最终品牌片尾：亮红色背景，带有巨大的黄色麦当劳风格金色拱门标志，一家四口和 4 个机器人共同摆出姿势，加上白色/黄色标语文字 {argument name="end card slogan" default="ワクワクを、いっしょに。 I'm lovin' it"}。说明文字："ワクワクを、いっしょに。 マクドナルド"

文本与布局限制：保持所有可见标题、时间码、分镜编号和说明文字为指定的日文。在每张图片下方居中放置加粗的红色时间码。确保 8 个分镜格由细黑边框清晰分隔。除麦当劳风格的金色拱门视觉语言外，请勿添加额外的分镜格、额外的机器人、二维码、水印或不相关的标志。

templates.title: Seal Adventure Movie Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 海豹冒险电影海报

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a whimsical, hand-drawn animated movie poster telling a heartwarming seafaring adventure of three mischievous spotted seal pups sailing to a legendary island. Canvas: Vertical poster, 3:4 aspect ratio, soft watercolor and ink illustration style, with warm cream highlights, cyan ocean tones, misty blue skies, and soft picture book-style shadows. Layout: The prominent Japanese movie title is at the top center, the sailboat occupies the right and lower half, the left side features an ocean and island background, and the bottom contains the tagline text. The overall composition should convey the feel of a family adventure movie poster. Text content: The small text at the very top is {argument name="small top label" default="movie"} The main title uses a large, rounded cream font with a dark brown outline, and the content is {argument name="main title" default="Yawarakasan and the Phantom Island"} The bow of the wooden boat is painted with text.{argument name="boat name" default="Soft and round"} The bottom title uses bold white Japanese characters with a dark outline, and the content is:{argument name="bottom tagline" default="A mischievous seal sets sail for "Hy-Brazil," a legendary island spoken of by sailors!"} The small credits below are for production staff.{argument name="director credit" default="Director General: Peko-chan"} Main Details: The ship must accurately display three small white-spotted seals: 1) A seal on the left bow, squinting and smiling while holding brass binoculars; 2) A larger seal in the center of the wooden rudder, laughing happily, its flippers resting on the rudder; 3) A seal on the right, joyfully waving one flipper. All three seals have rounded bodies, gray spots, small whiskers, black eyes, and adorable open-mouthed smiles. Ship and Props: A rustic wooden sailboat with clear wood grain, a curved bow, mast, ropes, rigging, brown sails, barrels, coiled ropes, a small lantern, a compass on a box, pulleys, railings, and a prow mast extending towards the audience. The props visible on the deck must be precisely counted as six items: brass binoculars, barrels, compass, lanterns, coiled ropes, and rope pulleys and rigging. Background: A legendary island shrouded in mist is displayed on the left horizon, featuring cliffs, a towering lighthouse, a small coastal town, green hills, and distant mountains partially obscured by the fog. Ships sail amidst vibrant turquoise waves and white spray, with a dreamlike sky filled with clouds above. Visual Style: Japanese children's adventure movie illustration poster, watercolor rendering, delicate brown ink outlines, soft gradients, possessing a nostalgic warmth similar to Studio Ghibli (not a direct imitation of a specific film), lively expressions, cinematic composition, rich detail, and a warm and comfortable feel. Constraints: Keep the title clear and dominant, use only specified visible text, maintain the number of seals (three), no humans, no modern technology, no logo, and no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张充满奇趣的手绘动画电影海报，讲述三只调皮的斑点小海豹航向传说之岛的温馨航海冒险故事。

画布：竖版海报，3:4 比例，柔和的水彩与墨水插画风格，带有温暖的奶油色高光、青色海洋色调、雾蓝色天空以及柔和的绘本式阴影。

布局：顶部中央为醒目的日文电影标题，帆船占据右侧及下半部分，左侧为海洋与岛屿背景，底部为标语文字。整体构图应呈现出家庭冒险电影海报的质感。

文字内容：最顶部的小字为 {argument name="small top label" default="映画"}。主标题采用大号圆润奶油色字体，配有深棕色描边，内容为 {argument name="main title" default="やわらかさんと幻の島"}。木船船头绘有文字 {argument name="boat name" default="やわらか丸"}。底部标题采用加粗白色日文字体，配有深色描边，内容为 {argument name="bottom tagline" default="いたずらアザラシが、船乗りに語り継がれる伝説の島「ハイブラジル」へ向かって出航！"}。下方微小的制作人员名单为 {argument name="director credit" default="総監督：ペコちゃん"}。

主体细节：船上需准确展示三只白色斑点小海豹：1) 左侧船头的一只小海豹，正拿着黄铜望远镜眯眼微笑；2) 位于木制舵轮中央的一只较大海豹，正开心地大笑，鳍状肢扶着舵轮；3) 右侧的一只小海豹，正欢快地挥动一只鳍状肢。三只海豹均拥有圆润的身体、灰色斑点、细小的胡须、黑色的眼睛以及可爱的张嘴微笑表情。

船只与道具：一艘质朴的木制帆船，具有清晰的木板纹理、弯曲的船头、桅杆、绳索、索具、棕褐色船帆、木桶、盘绕的绳索、小灯笼、盒子上的指南针、滑轮、栏杆以及向观众延伸的船首斜桅。甲板上可见的道具需精确统计为六件：黄铜望远镜、木桶、指南针、灯笼、盘绕的绳索以及绳索滑轮索具。

背景：左侧地平线上展示一座雾气缭绕的传说之岛，岛上有悬崖、高耸的灯塔、小型沿海城镇、绿色山丘以及部分隐没在雾中的远山。船只航行在生动的蓝绿色波浪与白色浪花之间，上方是梦幻般的云层天空。

视觉风格：日式儿童冒险电影插画海报，水彩渲染，精细的棕色墨水勾线，柔和的渐变，具有类似 Studio Ghibli 的怀旧温暖感（非直接模仿特定电影），表情生动，电影级构图，细节丰富且温馨舒适。

约束条件：保持标题清晰且占据主导地位，仅使用指定的可见文字，保持三只海豹的数量，不出现人类，不出现现代科技，无 Logo，无水印。

templates.title: AI-generated project report slides

titleLocalized.zh: AI 生成的项目报告 Slides

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="company name" default="GROWTH DRIVER"} Create a clean, Japanese-style corporate presentation slide showcasing how AI tools can transform analytics into project/execution-level PowerPoint material through a single conversation. Canvas: 16:9 widescreen slides with a white background, a sophisticated consulting style accented with navy and light blue, featuring soft shadows, precise grid alignment, crisp vector charts, and realistic miniature slide thumbnails. Header: The top left corner includes a simple red and blue logo, the brand text "GROWTH DRIVER," and a small Japanese subtitle "グロースドライバー." The top right corner displays the page number "11 / 21." A prominent navy blue Japanese title is on the left.{argument name="headline text" default="It doesn't end with just analysis: Presentation materials also come up in the same conversation."} Below is a smaller gray subheading:{argument name="subheading text" default="The result of asking, "Please turn this into a PowerPoint presentation for executives" (12 fictional sample slides)"} Layout: A blue vertical label on the left reads "Claude's generated personnel report data". The main area contains 12 neatly arranged white slide cards (4 columns and 3 rows). Each card has a navy blue numbered square, a Japanese title, chart content, and a light gray shadow in the upper left corner. A uniform blue chart style is used to present a dense yet easy-to-read project report visual effect. The 12 slide cards are precisely counted and labeled as follows: 1. "Egzectissus" — a checklist-style execution summary, containing four checkmarks and a small bar chart displaying FY2021–FY2024 values ​​(120, 147, 176, 209). 2. “High Performance” — Four KPI tiles: Sales High 20.9 Billion Yen +18.7%, Operating Profit 2.63 Billion Yen +28.1%, Crude Margin 31.5% +2.3pt, EBITDA 3.38 Billion Yen +24.6%. 3. “Sales Growth Trend” — Blue vertical bar chart, FY2021 120, FY2022 147, FY2023 176, FY2024 209, with the label “CAGR +20.3%”. 4. "Composition of sales (FY2024)" - a donut chart with "20.9 billion yen" displayed in the center. Legend: sales of products 45%, sales 30%, sales 20%, sales 5%. 5. “Customer Customer Service (FY2024)” — Horizontal bar chart: ESTA 98 (47%), medium-sized enterprises 63 (30%), SMB 31 (15%), and NANOTA 17 (8%). 6. “Decomposition of Growth Drivers” — Waterfall chart, from FY2023 sales of 176, through increments of +14, +12, +5, +2, reaching FY2024 sales of 209. 7. “Shift in Crude Interest Rates” — Line chart, from FY2021 25.4%, FY2022 27.8%, FY2023 29.2%, FY2024 31.5%. 8. “Changes in Cost Structure (Sales Ratio)” — Stacked bar chart of FY2022, FY2023, FY2024, legend: Other Costs, Sales Control Fees, Research and Development Fees, Sales Base Price. 9. “Regional Sales (FY2024)” — A pie chart showing “20.9 billion yen” at the center. Legend: Japan 60%, North America 25%, Europe 10%, Asia 5%. 10. “Purchase Status” — A funnel chart with text: Purchases (for the next 12 months) 31.2 billion yen (22% year-on-year increase). Stages include: Lead 112 billion yen, Negotiations 51.2 billion yen, Proposals 31.2 billion yen, High Purchase Confirmation 18.4 billion yen. 11. “Future Investment Areas” — Three blue circular icons with brief Japanese strategic explanations: Project Strengthening, Market Expansion, Profitability Improvement. 12. “Matome” — A list with five blue checkmarks summarizing growth, new customers, improved margins, a strong pipeline, and strategic investments. Bottom label: A large, rounded light blue banner spans the bottom of the slides. To the left of the banner is a small, round, blue icon resembling an AI agent/robot face. The prominent blue Japanese text reads:{argument name="bottom message" default="Analysis and documentation are completed in a single conversation. No rework required."} Visual style: Executive-grade SaaS/consulting presentation aesthetics – minimalist, high information density, strong hierarchy, navy blue typography, white cards, blue charts, subtle gray borders and shadows. All 12 cards remain visible and evenly spaced. No people, no photos, no decorative clutter, and no watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="company name" default="GROWTH DRIVER"} 创建一张简洁的日式企业演示 Slides，展示 AI 工具如何通过一次对话将分析结果转化为项目/执行层 PowerPoint 材料。

画布：16:9 宽屏 Slides，白色背景，精致的咨询风格，配有海军蓝和亮蓝色点缀，带有柔和阴影、精确的网格对齐、清晰的矢量图表以及逼真的微缩 Slides 缩略图。

页眉：左上角包含一个简单的红蓝角标 Logo，品牌文字“GROWTH DRIVER”及小型日文副标题“グロースドライバー”。右上角显示页码“11 / 21”。左侧为醒目的海军蓝日文大标题：{argument name="headline text" default="分析だけで終わらない：プレゼン資料も同じ会話で出る"}。下方为较小的灰色副标题：{argument name="subheading text" default="「これを役員説明用の PowerPoint にして」と頼んだ結果（架空サンプル12枚）"}。

布局：左侧有一条蓝色竖向标注，写着“Claude が生成した 役員報告資料”。主要区域包含 12 张排列整齐的白色 Slides 卡片（4 列 3 行），每张卡片的左上角都有一个海军蓝色的数字方块、日文标题、图表内容及浅灰色投影。使用统一的蓝色图表样式，呈现密集但易读的项目报告视觉效果。

12 张 Slides 卡片，精确计数并标注如下：
1. “エグゼクティブサマリー” — 清单式执行摘要，包含四个勾选标记，以及一个显示 FY2021–FY2024 数值（120, 147, 176, 209）的小型柱状图。
2. “業績ハイライト” — 四个 KPI 磁贴：売上高 209 億円 +18.7%, 営業利益 26.3 億円 +28.1%, 粗利率 31.5% +2.3pt, EBITDA 33.8 億円 +24.6%。
3. “売上高の推移” — 蓝色垂直柱状图，FY2021 120, FY2022 147, FY2023 176, FY2024 209，并附有标注“CAGR +20.3%”。
4. “売上の構成（FY2024）” — 环形图，中心显示“209 億円”，图例：製品販売 45%, サブスクリプション 30%, サービス 20%, その他 5%。
5. “顧客セグメント別売上（FY2024）” — 水平柱状图：エンタープライズ 98 (47%), 中堅企業 63 (30%), SMB 31 (15%), その他 17 (8%)。
6. “成長ドライバーの分解” — 瀑布图，从 FY2023 売上 176 经过 +14, +12, +5, +2 的增量，达到 FY2024 売上 209。
7. “粗利率の推移” — 折线图，从 FY2021 25.4%, FY2022 27.8%, FY2023 29.2%, FY2024 31.5%。
8. “費用構造の変化（売上比）” — FY2022, FY2023, FY2024 的堆叠柱状图，图例：その他費用, 販管費, 研究開発費, 売上原価。
9. “地域別売上（FY2024）” — 环形图，中心显示“209 億円”，图例：日本 60%, 北米 25%, 欧州 10%, アジア 5%。
10. “パイプライン状況” — 漏斗图及文字：受注パイプライン（今後12カ月）312 億円（前年比 +22%），阶段包括：リード 1,120 億円, 商談 512 億円, 提案 312 億円, 受注確度高 184 億円。
11. “今後の注力領域” — 三个蓝色圆形图标，配有简短的日文战略说明：プロダクト強化, 市場拡大, 収益性向上。
12. “まとめ” — 带有五个蓝色勾选图标的清单，总结了增长、新客户、利润率提升、强劲的管道及战略投资。

底部标注：一个宽大的圆角浅蓝色横幅横跨 Slides 底部。横幅左侧是一个类似 AI Agent/机器人脸部的小型圆形蓝色图标。醒目的蓝色日文大字写着：{argument name="bottom message" default="分析 → 資料化 までを 1 つの会話で完結。手戻りなし"}。

视觉风格：执行级 SaaS/咨询演示美学，极简，高信息密度，强层级感，海军蓝排版，白色卡片，蓝色图表，细微的灰色边框和阴影。保持所有 12 张卡片可见且间距均匀。无人物，无照片，无装饰性杂乱元素，无水印。

templates.title: Cyberpunk alleyway sword fight in the rain

titleLocalized.zh: 雨中赛博朋克巷战剑斗

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic, dark anime-style battle scene with a wet cyberpunk alleyway in the rainy night. Use a 16:9 widescreen composition and a low-angle shot close to the damp ground to create a highly dynamic perspective. (Left foreground shown){argument name="male fighter" default="A tough-guy swordsman with short dark hair, wearing a tattered black tactical uniform and a long, ragged trench coat."} Most of its body is in shadow, charging forward in a broad, offensive stance, thrusting its katana horizontally at its opponent. (Medium shot on the right){argument name="female fighter" default="A petite, elfin girl with long, light blue hair and pointed ears."} Clad in a magnificent, layered white, ruffled combat suit with armor details and leg straps, and white boots, she defensively wields a small, fantastical spear or halberd; she faces the swordsman in a tense, prepared stance. The two weapons should form a strong diagonal intersection in the center of the frame, emphasizing the impending clash without direct contact. The scene is set in a narrow, dystopian city alleyway, with a background featuring towering, dark buildings, metal shutters, pipes, cables, fire escape ladders, vents, scattered crates, distant windows, mist, smoke, and glowing streetlights; the ground is puddled with puddles reflecting orange and blue light. Employing emotional, cinematic lighting, heavy shadows, rim lighting on the two warriors, rain, water splashes, subtle sparks or glowing particles, a refined anime illustration style, high contrast, a rough texture, dynamic action composition, no text, no watermarks, avoiding superfluous limbs or deformed hands, and strictly maintaining the two warriors and their two main weapons.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影级的暗黑动漫战斗场景，背景为雨夜中潮湿的赛博朋克巷道，采用 16:9 宽屏构图，低角度镜头贴近湿润的地面，呈现出极具张力的透视感。左侧前景展示 {argument name="male fighter" default="一名留着深色短发、身穿破损黑色战术服和长款褴褛风衣的硬汉剑客"}，身体大部处于阴影中，正以宽大的进攻姿态向前冲刺，双手持武士刀向对手水平刺出。右侧中景展示 {argument name="female fighter" default="一名留着淡蓝色长发、尖耳朵的娇小精灵少女"}，身穿华丽的层叠白色荷叶边战斗服，带有盔甲细节和腿带，脚蹬白色长靴，防御性地持有一柄小型奇幻长矛或戟；她正以紧张的准备姿态面对剑客。两件武器应在画面中心形成一条强有力的对角交叉线，在不接触的情况下强调即将到来的碰撞。场景设定为狭窄的反乌托邦城市巷道，背景包括高耸的深色建筑、金属百叶窗、管道、电缆、消防梯、通风口、散落的板条箱、远处的窗户、薄雾、烟雾和发光的路灯；地面布满水坑，反射着橙色和蓝色的光芒。运用情绪化的电影级布光、浓重的阴影、两名战士身上的轮廓光、雨雾、水花、细微的火花或发光粒子，采用精细的动漫插画风格，高对比度，粗粝的质感，动态的动作构图，无文字，无水印，避免多余的肢体或畸形的手部，严格保持两名战士和两件主要武器。

templates.title: Anime-style Fairy Demon Office Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫风妖精恶魔办公室海报

templates.prompt: Create a beautiful anime-style full-body character illustration with a pure white background: a captivating adult fairy/demon woman named {argument name="character name" default="Patarin"} She floats in a playful poster pose, one leg bent backward, one hand raised near her head, and the other outstretched. She has a short bob haircut, and her hair color is {argument name="hair color" default="Mint Green"} She has soft bangs, pointed elf ears, two glossy, curved black devil horns, a small blue butterfly hair accessory, and a long, thin black devil tail ending in a spade shape. Her face should be softly obscured or left featureless, with a semi-transparent square blur effect covering the center of her face. She should wear a fitted navy blue business suit jacket over a white shirt with a blue bow at the collar, paired with a tight black pencil mini skirt, dark brown sheer tights, and black patent leather high heels. This gives her a mature, curvaceous figure and a confident magical girl aura, while maintaining an elegant and highly detailed rendering. Behind her, draw two large, semi-transparent butterfly wings, one on each side, emitting cyan, pale purple, pink, and electric blue light. The wings are composed of multiple petal-like parts, filled with faint magical runes and shimmering lines. Add swirling, glowing ribbon trails and tiny blue-white sparkles around her body and legs, and scatter four small, glowing butterfly silhouettes near the wings. Add pink Japanese handwritten text near the bottom right corner.{argument name="signature text" default="ぱたりん♡"} The design employs glossy highlights, soft diffused lighting effects, clear cel animation rendering, and painterly gradients, combined with delicate magical particles and a soft, luminous fantasy effect. A vertical composition centered on the character is used. Extra characters and complex backgrounds are avoided, maintaining an overall atmosphere that is cute, stylish, and full of magic.

Layout: The top contains four interface elements: a circular hamburger menu button on the left, a rounded capsule button with blue text reading "Thinking," a rounded button with an edit pencil icon on the right, and a three-dot menu icon. Below is a right-aligned, dark reddish-brown rounded user message bubble containing three lines of text: "PROMPT:{argument name="prompt text" default="Apple on the table"} "size={argument name="image size" default="1024×1024"} "and "seed={argument name="seed value" default="1234"} Below it, the grayed-out text "Thought for" is displayed.{argument name="thinking time" default="33s"} The generated image card: Below the status text, a large, rounded square image card is displayed, featuring a realistic red apple on a wooden tabletop at its center. The apple has a glossy skin with yellow-green highlights in the indentation at the top, subtle vertical textures, a small brown stem, and is illuminated by soft studio lighting. The background is a flat, slightly blurred light gray wall above a wooden table. The card has large rounded corners and occupies most of the screen width. Overlay and bottom UI: A brown, rounded button labeled "编集する" (Editing) is added to the bottom left corner of the image card. A circular, brown share button with a white upload/share arrow icon is added to the bottom right corner. Below the image card, a separate ellipsis line is added: "…". A ChatGPT input bar is displayed at the bottom, containing five visible elements: a plus icon button, placeholder text "ChatGPT に质问する" (ChatGPT に质问する), a small microphone icon, an orange circular voice waveform button, and a rounded, dark text box container. Visual style: A true iOS ChatGPT app. Screenshot, dark theme, clear interface, realistic spacing, simple sans-serif font, no extra messages, no watermark, no browser border.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个逼真的 ChatGPT 移动端 App 竖屏截图（深色模式），展示关于苹果的图像生成对话。

画布：高长宽比手机截图，9:16 比例，黑色背景，顶部带有 iPhone 风格的状态栏。时间显示为 19:44，包含信号格、4G 图标以及 67% 的电量。

布局：顶部包含 4 个界面元素：左侧的圆形汉堡菜单按钮、蓝色文字的“Thinking”圆角胶囊按钮、右侧带有编辑铅笔图标的圆角按钮，以及一个三点菜单图标。下方放置一个右对齐的深红褐色圆角用户消息气泡，包含 3 行文字：“PROMPT: {argument name="prompt text" default="机上のリンゴ"}”、“size={argument name="image size" default="1024×1024"}”以及“seed={argument name="seed value" default="1234"}”。在其下方，显示灰色状态文本“Thought for {argument name="thinking time" default="33s"}”。

生成的图像卡片：在状态文本下方，展示一张大型圆角方形图像卡片，中心为木质桌面上的逼真红苹果。苹果表皮光亮，顶部凹陷处带有黄绿色高光，有细微的垂直纹理，带有一个小棕色果梗，并采用柔和的摄影棚灯光。照片背景为木桌上方平淡的浅灰色墙壁，略微模糊。卡片具有大圆角，占据屏幕大部分宽度。

叠加层与底部 UI：在图像卡片左下角，添加一个标注为“編集する”的棕色圆角按钮。在右下角，添加一个带有白色上传/分享箭头图标的圆形棕色分享按钮。在图像卡片下方，添加一个独立的省略号行：“…”。底部显示一个 ChatGPT 输入栏，包含 5 个可见元素：加号图标按钮、占位符文字“ChatGPT に質問する”、一个小麦克风图标、一个橙色圆形语音波形按钮，以及圆角深色文本框容器。

视觉风格：真实的 iOS ChatGPT App 截图，深色主题，界面清晰，间距真实，简洁的无衬线字体，无额外消息，无水印，无浏览器边框。

templates.title: Dynamic Animated Rooftop Action Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 动态动漫天台动作场景

templates.prompt: Based on REFERENCE_0, transform the standing full-body portrait into a highly dramatic anime action scene. Maintain the same school uniform design, blue twin-tail hairstyle, socks, shoes, and overall character features, but redraw the face clearly in a refined 2D anime style, presenting sharp eyes and a confident expression. Change the pose and composition: have the character dash or pounce towards the viewer, one hand extended forward towards the camera, the other arm outstretched, hair and skirt flowing with the movement. Use strong low-angle/wide-angle perspective to showcase exaggerated perspective effects and a sense of dynamism. Add a new scene: a school rooftop or fence walkway at sunset, with a warm orange sky, dramatic clouds, reflective ground, and barbed wire fence as the background. Add a distant silhouette near the glowing sunset background. Add blurred fence bars in the very foreground to create depth and a cinematic chase/fight scene atmosphere. Style: High-quality Japanese anime key visuals, cinematic lighting effects, warm sunset contour lighting, dramatic shadows, delicate hair, vivid expressions, vibrant composition, no text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh:
以 REFERENCE_0 为角色基础，将站立的全身肖像转换为极具戏剧性的动漫动作场景。保持相同的校服设计、蓝色双马尾发型、袜子、鞋子以及整体角色特征，但需以精致的 2D 动漫风格清晰地重绘面部，呈现锐利的眼神和自信的表情。

更改姿势和构图：让角色向观众冲刺或猛扑，一只手向前伸向镜头近处，另一只手臂向后伸展，头发和裙摆随动作飘动。采用强烈的低角度/广角透视，展现夸张的近大远小效果和动态感。

添加新场景：日落时分的学校天台或围栏走道，背景为温暖的橙色天空、戏剧性的云层、反光地面和铁丝网围栏。在背景发光的日落附近添加 1 个远处的剪影。在极近的前景中加入模糊的围栏杆，以营造深度感和电影般的追逐/战斗场景氛围。

风格：高质量日本动漫关键视觉图，电影级光效，温暖的日落轮廓光，戏剧性阴影，细腻的发丝，生动的表情，充满活力的构图，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Retro "Temperance" Tarot Combination

titleLocalized.zh: 复古“节制”塔罗牌组合

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a vintage tarot deck design that precisely displays two cards side-by-side: the left card is the front, and the right card is the back. Canvas: Horizontal composition with a transparent checkerboard background. Both cards are vertically oriented, evenly spaced, and centered. The design utilizes aged beige paper, soft ink, weathered edges, and a hand-drawn antique tarot aesthetic. Left card, front design: A classic tarot deck with a small plaque at the top indicating {argument name="card title" default="TEMPERANCE"} and Roman numerals{argument name="roman numeral" default="XIV"} The card features an ornate botanical border, decorated with vines, small flowers, stars, and corner lines. At the center stands a serene female figure, dressed in flowing robes.{argument name="dress color" default="pale blue"} A Greco-Roman style long dress with a slit in the skirt, she stands barefoot in shallow water, pouring liquid from one golden cup to another. Her face has a soft, blurred, oil painting-like quality rather than detailed depiction. Behind her are radiating halos, scattered stars, a crescent moon, distant mountains, rivers, and flowers; a cute little stone cat statue sits on the right pedestal. The title bar at the bottom features a large serif font that reads "TEMPERANCE." The right-hand card, the reverse design: a matching ornate tarot card reverse with no title text. It uses the same aged parchment hue and a thin, dark green-gold border. At the center is a large circular compass star emblem: an eight-pointed star within concentric circles, decorated with small gold dots on a dark cyan ring. Symmetrical sun rays are added around it, composed of many outward-extending fine rays. Vertical decorative dots and diamond-shaped markers are added above and below the circle, along with geometric corner supports and square corner ornaments. Visual Style: Antique occult illustrations, Art Nouveau-inspired tarot card engravings, soft cyan, sage green, ochre gold, cream parchment, fine ink lines, slightly faded print texture, subtle stains, realistic paper texture, and handcrafted line art. Limitations: Only two cards can be displayed: one face-up and one face-down. Both cards must be the same size and orientation. Readable text must be retained.{argument name="bottom title text" default="TEMPERANCE"} And XIV. Do not add extra cards, hands, mockup shadows, modern UI, or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一张复古塔罗牌设计图，精确展示并排的 2 张牌：左侧为塔罗牌正面，右侧为配套的牌背。

画布：横向构图，背景为透明棋盘格预览，两张牌均为垂直方向，间距均匀且居中。采用陈旧的米色纸张、柔和的墨色、风化的边缘以及手绘风格的古董塔罗牌美学。

左侧牌，正面设计：一张经典的塔罗牌，顶部小牌匾上标有 {argument name="card title" default="TEMPERANCE"} 和罗马数字 {argument name="roman numeral" default="XIV"}。牌面带有华丽的植物边框，装饰有藤蔓、小花、星星和角落线条。中心站立着一位宁静的女性形象，身穿飘逸的 {argument name="dress color" default="淡青色"} 希腊罗马风格长裙，裙摆开叉，赤脚站在浅水中，正将液体从一个金杯倒入另一个金杯。面部呈现柔和模糊的油画质感，而非细节刻画。她身后有放射状光环、散落的星星、新月、远山、河流、花草，右侧基座上有一尊可爱的小石猫雕像。底部的标题栏包含大号衬线字体，书写着 TEMPERANCE。

右侧牌，背面设计：一张配套的华丽塔罗牌背面，无标题文字。使用相同的陈旧羊皮纸色调和深绿金色细边框。中心包含一个巨大的圆形罗盘星徽章：同心圆内有一个 8 角星，深青色圆环上装饰着金色小点。周围添加对称的太阳光芒，由许多向外延伸的细射线组成。在圆圈上下方加入垂直装饰点和菱形标记，以及几何角落支架和方形角落装饰。

视觉风格：古董神秘学插画、受新艺术运动启发的塔罗牌雕刻、柔和青色、鼠尾草绿、赭石金、奶油色羊皮纸、精细墨水排线、略微褪色的印刷质感、细微污渍、逼真的纸张纹理、手工线条艺术。

限制：仅展示 2 张牌：1 张正面和 1 张背面。保持两张牌的大小和方向一致。保留可读文字 {argument name="bottom title text" default="TEMPERANCE"} 和 XIV。不要添加额外的牌、手部、样机阴影、现代 UI 或水印。

templates.title: Rose Garden Travel Postcard Flat Lay Photography

titleLocalized.zh: 玫瑰花园旅行明信片平铺摄影

templates.prompt: Create a nostalgic travel postcard-style flat lay on soft beige linen, depicting a romantic rose garden bathed in warm morning light and soft shadows. The main subject is a square Polaroid photograph with a thick white border, slightly tilted to the left. The photograph shows an outdoor breakfast table in a lush rose garden, with pink rose bushes, distant green mountains, and a soft-focus, dreamy bokeh effect in the background. The breakfast scene includes seven clearly visible food/table elements: a red patterned teacup with black coffee and a matching saucer, a white plate, two slices of toast, half a peeled banana, a round bread or macaron-shaped roll, a small pile of nuts or grains, and a glass bowl containing light-colored fruit, topped with dark jam and a sprig of green herb. Travel souvenirs are scattered around the main photograph: in the upper right corner is a partially visible wicker basket filled with large pink roses and dark green leaves, tied with a gray-pink ribbon; in the center right is a vintage postcard beneath the main photograph, showcasing a European mountain village, titled…{argument name="postcard title" default="Jardin de la Rose"} It bears the words "SAINT-CIRQ-LAPOPIE" and "FRANCE" and a circular postmark; in the lower left corner is a torn-off handmade notebook card with pink handwritten Japanese text.{argument name="note text" default="Let's go in search of unseen scenery and heart-pounding moments. ♡"} A semi-transparent rose-pink ballpoint pen rests diagonally at the bottom; near the center of the bottom is a small gold keychain shaped like a pink rose, decorated with green leaves; in the lower right corner is a partially cropped pink ticket with "ROSERAIE DE L'HAY" and "ENTREE" written on it. Three scattered light-colored rose petals are added to the linen. Using soft pastel tones, realistic paper texture, slight film grain, shallow depth of field, and delicate highlights are rendered to create a warm, handwritten postcard atmosphere. There are no people, no modern electronic devices, and no watermarks in the image. The overall composition should evoke a sense of {argument name="travel destination" default="France"} Memories of my trip to the rose garden.

promptLocalized.zh: 在柔软的米色亚麻布上创作一张怀旧旅行明信片风格的平铺图，画面呈现温暖的晨光与柔和的阴影，主题为浪漫的玫瑰花园。主体是一张带有厚白边的方形拍立得照片，略微倾斜地放置在左侧；照片内容为郁郁葱葱的玫瑰花园中的户外早餐桌，背景有粉色玫瑰丛、远处的青山以及柔焦梦幻的虚化效果。早餐场景包含 7 个清晰可见的食物/餐桌元素：一个盛有黑咖啡的红色花纹茶杯及配套茶托、一个白盘子、两片吐司、半根剥皮香蕉、一个圆形面包或马卡龙状小圆面包、一小堆坚果或谷物，以及一个装有浅色水果、顶部点缀深色果酱和一小枝绿色香草的玻璃碗。主照片周围散落着旅行纪念品：右上角是一个部分可见的柳条篮，里面装着大朵粉色玫瑰和深绿色叶子，并系着一条灰粉色缎带；右侧中心是一张压在主照片下方的复古明信片，展示了一个欧洲山村，标题为 {argument name="postcard title" default="Jardin de la Rose"}，印有“SAINT-CIRQ-LAPOPIE”和“FRANCE”字样以及一个圆形邮戳；左下角是一张撕下的手工笔记卡片，上面有粉色的日文手写文字 {argument name="note text" default="まだ見ぬ景色と、心ときめく瞬間を探しにいこう。♡"}；底部斜放着一支半透明的玫瑰粉色中性笔；底部中心附近有一个粉色玫瑰造型的金色小钥匙扣，带有绿叶装饰；右下角是一张被部分裁剪的粉色门票，上面写着“ROSERAIE DE L'HAY”和“ENTREE”。在亚麻布上添加 3 片散落的浅色玫瑰花瓣。使用柔和的粉彩色调，呈现真实的纸张纹理、轻微的胶片颗粒感、浅景深、细腻的高光，营造出温馨的手写明信片氛围。画面中无人，无现代电子产品，无水印。整体构图应呈现出一段来自 {argument name="travel destination" default="法国"} 的玫瑰花园旅行回忆。

templates.title: Medieval Castle Simulated Duel

titleLocalized.zh: 中世纪城堡模拟决斗

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic medieval fantasy simulation duel scene located in the courtyard of a stone castle, and name it according to the atmosphere.{argument name="scene theme" default="Simulated Battle"} The composition uses a 4:5 vertical aspect ratio and a realistic, high-detail photographic style to depict the intense midday sun, the dusty air, and the flying sand and sparks from clashing weapons. Eight figures must be clearly visible in the image: two foreground duelists, one noble armored observer, and five background guards. In the center of the foreground, a rugged swordsman {argument name="hero hair" default="Dark long curly hair"} He wears a loose-fitting off-white linen shirt, dark trousers, a belt, a dagger at his waist, and worn brown boots; he leans forward, gripping his longsword tightly, parrying an attack. In the foreground on the right, an opponent in dark blue-black plate armor with ornate gold trim, wearing a closed helmet, layered belts, and high boots, is launching a fierce attack with crossed blades, his back partially facing the viewer. In the middle ground on the left, a dignified knight commander {argument name="commander armor" default="Polished silver plate armor and white cloak"} They stood with arms crossed, calmly watching the duel. Behind them, five guards in dark armor stood in a loose row, spears in hand, slightly out of focus. The background was an ancient gray stone fortress wall with arched gates, narrow windows, details of wooden fences, and a large, dark blue banner with a gold lion emblem. All clearly visible faces were anonymized using simple, flat brown rectangles to conform to censorship standards. The image was to have a rugged medieval realism, emphasizing the texture of armor, scratches, dust, leather, cobblestone floors, dramatic movement, and shallow depth of field. No modern objects, text, or watermarks were permitted.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个电影级中世纪奇幻模拟决斗场景，地点位于石砌城堡庭院中，根据氛围命名为 {argument name="scene theme" default="模拟战斗"}。使用 4:5 竖构图，采用写实的高细节摄影风格，表现正午强烈的阳光、尘土飞扬的空气，以及武器碰撞时飞溅的沙砾和细小火花。画面中需清晰可见 8 个人物：2 名前景决斗者、1 名高贵的装甲观察者，以及 5 名背景守卫。前景中央，一名粗犷的剑客留着 {argument name="hero hair" default="深色长卷发"}，身穿米白色宽松亚麻衬衫、深色长裤、皮带，腰间佩戴匕首，脚蹬高筒磨损的棕色靴子；他向前俯身，双手紧握长剑，正在格挡攻击。右侧前景中，一名身穿深蓝黑色板甲的对手，盔甲带有华丽的金色饰边，佩戴封闭式头盔，配有分层皮带和高筒靴，正交叉双刃发起猛攻，背部部分朝向观众。左侧中景处，一名威严的骑士指挥官身穿 {argument name="commander armor" default="抛光银色板甲和白色披风"}，双臂交叉冷静地注视着决斗。在他们身后，放置 5 名身穿深色盔甲的守卫，手持长矛站成松散的一排，处于轻微失焦状态。背景是一座古老的灰色石砌堡垒墙，带有拱形大门、狭窄的窗户、木制栅栏细节，以及一面悬挂的深蓝色大旗，旗帜上绘有金色的狮形纹章。所有清晰可见人物的面部均需进行匿名化处理，使用简单的平整棕色矩形遮挡，以符合图像的审查风格。强调粗犷的中世纪写实感，突出盔甲质感、划痕、灰尘、皮革、鹅卵石地面、戏剧性的动作感以及浅景深效果，画面中不得出现任何现代物品、文字或水印。

templates.title: Bold Gold fashion magazine cover

titleLocalized.zh: Bold Gold 时尚杂志封面

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a bold fashion magazine cover, with the main subject being {argument name="model description" default="A young woman with long light brown hair, wearing a white baseball cap and a black ribbed halter top."} The composition uses a composition from the chest up, against a background of glossy gold satin fabric. The model is centered, cropped in close-up, with a large, opaque square obscuring her face (from forehead to chin); this square should be a warm beige-brown color matching the cover's tone. Canvas: Vertical portrait magazine cover, 3:4 aspect ratio, high-resolution editorial print design. Use a saturated gold background with a dark chocolate brown font. The overall style should combine luxury, sportiness, femininity, and a striking graphic feel. Layout: Oversized, compact serif masthead text fills the top and extends behind the model, containing {argument name="masthead text" default="HER19845"} The letters are extremely tall and tightly spaced, partially obscured by the hat and hair. An additional large, cropped numerical font is placed in the center to the left of the model. The model is kept centered in the foreground, with the hat brim extending to the left. A strong magazine cover layering effect is employed: background fabric, a large masthead, the model, obscuring squares, and smaller cover text. Visible text elements include 8 unique text/graphic labels: 1) A large masthead at the top “HER19845”; 2) A small label on the left “SPRING / SUMMER 2024”; 3) A large stacked cover text on the left.{argument name="left cover line" default="OWN EVERY FRAME"} ; 4) The small banner on the right reads “BOLD FEMININE UNAPOLOGETIC”; 5) The label on the right reads “EST. 19845” and the horizontal line below it; 6) The main title in the lower right corner.{argument name="main cover word" default="HER"} 7) Small caption in the lower right corner: “POWER IN FOCUS. STYLE IN MOTION.” 8) Miniature copyright notice at the bottom: “© HER19845 ALL RIGHTS RESERVED.” and a small globe icon next to it. Main details: The white baseball cap should have a slightly wrinkled look, with dark navy blue cursive embroidery on the front. Hair falls on either side of the obscuring square. The black halter top has a distinct ribbed texture and a deep neckline. Skin has a warm glow under editorial studio lighting. Visual style: High-fashion magazine cover, combining sharp commercial photography with bold graphic design, high contrast, warm gold tones, glossy satin wrinkles, dramatic typography, clean print quality, and no borders. Constraints: All text should be dark brown or close to black. Do not add any additional headings beyond the above 8 sets. The obscuring square must remain a perfect rectangle, centered over the face, and opaque. The composition should resemble a finished luxury sports fashion magazine cover, not a poster mockup.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张大胆的时尚杂志封面，主体为 {argument name="model description" default="一位留着浅棕色长发、戴着白色棒球帽并身穿黑色罗纹挂脖上衣的年轻女性"}，采用胸部以上构图，背景为光泽感金色缎面织物。模特居中，近景裁剪，面部区域（从额头到下巴）覆盖有一个大型不透明方形遮挡块；该方形应为与封面色调相符的暖米棕色。

画布：竖版肖像杂志封面，3:4 纵横比，高分辨率编辑类印刷设计。使用饱和的金色背景搭配深巧克力棕色字体。整体风格应兼具奢华、运动、女性化与鲜明的图形感。

布局：超大紧凑型衬线刊头文字填满顶部并延伸至模特身后，内容为 {argument name="masthead text" default="HER19845"}。字母极高，间距紧凑，部分被帽子和头发遮挡。在模特左侧中心放置额外的巨大裁剪数字类字体。保持模特位于前景中心，帽檐向左延伸。运用强烈的杂志封面分层效果：背景织物、巨大刊头、模特、遮挡方块，以及较小的封面文案。

可见文本元素：包含 8 组独特的文本/图形标签：1) 顶部巨大刊头“HER19845”；2) 左侧小标签“SPRING / SUMMER 2024”；3) 左侧大型堆叠封面文案 {argument name="left cover line" default="OWN EVERY FRAME"}；4) 右侧小标语“BOLD FEMININE UNAPOLOGETIC”；5) 右侧标签“EST. 19845”及其下方的水平线；6) 右下角大标题 {argument name="main cover word" default="HER"}；7) 右下角小说明文字“POWER IN FOCUS. STYLE IN MOTION.”；8) 底部微型版权声明“© HER19845 ALL RIGHTS RESERVED.”及旁边的一个小地球图标。

主体细节：白色棒球帽应呈现出轻微的褶皱感，正面带有深海军蓝色的草书刺绣。头发垂落在遮挡方块的两侧。黑色挂脖上衣具有明显的罗纹质感和深领口。皮肤在编辑类摄影棚灯光下呈现出温暖的光泽。

视觉风格：高级时尚杂志封面，锐利的商业摄影与大胆的平面设计相结合，高对比度，暖金色调，光泽缎面褶皱，戏剧性字体，干净的印刷质感，无边框。

约束条件：所有文字保持深棕色或接近黑色。除上述 8 组外，请勿添加额外的标题。遮挡方块必须保持完美的矩形，居中覆盖面部，且不透明。构图应呈现为成品奢华运动时尚杂志封面，而非海报样机。

A vibrant orange handwritten signature/graffiti overlay is added to the center right area, partially penetrating the model and the oversized numerical shape. She wears a white cropped ribbed vest, layered necklaces, an oversized black zip-up hoodie with a white lining and colorful paint splatter patterns, loose black drawstring streetwear trousers with orange, pink, and purple graffiti marks, and chunky black, white, and orange sneakers. The pose is relaxed, confident, and rebellious, presenting a high-fashion advertising campaign style. The visible text content contains nine distinct text elements: 1) A large background title: “HER19845”; 2) A bold slogan on the left: “REBEL. UNFILTERED. ICON IN PROGRESS.”; 3) A paragraph on the left: “Built on raw energy and real ambition. This is not for everyone. This is for HER.”; 4) The issue number in the lower left corner: “VOL. 08 / MMXXV”; 5) Pink slogans arranged in three lines in the lower left corner: “THE CULTURE / THE VISION / THE FUTURE”; 6) A bracket label on the right: “[HER19845]”; 7) A small pink slogan on the right: “NOT YOURS. NEVER WAS.”; 8) A black and white label in the lower left corner: “PARENTAL ADVISORY EXPLICIT CONTENT”; 9) A handwritten orange mark containing the following content.{argument name="signature text" default="After19845"} Additionally, two tiny graphic icons are included below the slogan on the right: a simple globe icon and a small barcode. templates.prompt: Objective: Create a bold, vertical streetwear magazine cover poster featuring a full-body urban fashion model standing in front of a large, distressed font. Canvas: Vertical 2:3 poster with a cream-colored paper background featuring subtle grain, wear and tear, and a vintage print texture. Use bright daylight projection onto the ground, combined with low-angle fashion photography and graphic design magazine typography. Subject: A young female streetwear model, centered and overlapping the font, legs apart, hands in pockets, exuding confidence and relaxation. Her face is softly blurred with a rectangular overlay. She has long blonde hair, wears a dark baseball cap, a black oversized bomber jacket, a white cropped graphic tee with a teddy bear print and the word "Rebel," a chunky gold chain necklace, dark gray oversized cargo pants with large side pockets and worn paint marks, and black, white, and blue high-top sneakers. The clothing should be realistic, relaxed, textured, and slightly worn. Background Typography: Place a large word/number combination spanning almost the entire height behind the subject: "HER19845". Use a highly compressed block font with an aged ink-wash texture. Color scheme: 3 large color blocks – “HER” in bright pink, “19” in orange-red, and “845” in dark blue. The main body should cover the center of the letters, but the text must still remain legible. Visible text blocks: The poster must contain 9 precise graphic text elements: 1) Top left corner blue text: “ISSUE No.19845 / CONFIDENCE IS SILENT / INSECURITIES ARE LOUD”; 2) Top center blue text: “WORLDWIDE EDITION / MUSIC. FASHION. CULTURE.”; 3) Top right corner blue text: “COPYRIGHT © 2024 / ALL RIGHTS RESERVED / THIS IS AN ORIGINAL ARTWORK” and a small globe icon; 4) Left center blue slogan: “NOT FOR EVERYONE / MADE FOR ME.”, with a small globe/eye icon below; 5) Bottom left corner large bright pink handwritten signature: “Rebel”, with a simple crown doodle above; 6) Right center blue handwritten phrase: “Since / Day One”, with bright pink underline and paint drip effect; 7) Bottom left corner blue text: “LOUD HEART. / CLEAR”. VISION.”; 8) Barcode in the lower left corner, the number is “19845”; 9) Blue parental guidance label in the lower right corner, the content is “PARENTAL / ADVISORY / EXPLICIT CONTENT.”. Visual style: High-impact editorial style street fashion poster, Y2K hip-hop magazine cover texture, screen-printed ink, distressed halftone texture, rough paper grain, bold pink/orange/blue color scheme, realistic silhouette of the main subject superimposed on flat graphic font, clear details of sneakers with soft shadows. Customizable parameters: Use a huge background title.{argument name="background title" default="HER19845"} Handwritten signature{argument name="signature text" default="Rebel"} Handwritten slogans{argument name="slogan text" default="Since Day One"} Model Clothing Theme{argument name="outfit theme" default="oversized black bomber, cropped white graphic tee, dark gray cargo sweatpants, black-white-blue high-top sneakers"} and issue number{argument name="issue number" default="19845"} Constraints: Maintain the poster composition and vertical centering; do not add extra figures; keep only one full-body model; retain 9 small text elements; keep faces blurred; and avoid any watermarks or real-world brand logos.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张大胆的竖版街头潮流杂志封面海报，展示一位全身都市时尚模特站在巨大的做旧字体前。

画布：竖版 2:3 海报，米白色纸张背景，带有细微的颗粒感、磨损痕迹和复古印刷质感。使用明亮的日光投影在地面上，结合低角度时尚摄影与平面设计杂志排版。

主体：一位年轻的女性街头潮流模特，居中且与字体部分重叠，双腿分开，双手插兜，姿态自信放松。她的面部被柔和的矩形模糊处理。她留着金色长发，戴着深色棒球帽，身穿黑色超大款飞行员夹克、带有泰迪熊印花和“Rebel”字样的白色短款图形 T 恤、粗金链项链、带有大侧袋和磨损油漆痕迹的深灰色超大款工装运动裤，以及黑白蓝配色高帮运动鞋。服装需呈现出写实、宽松、有质感且略带磨损的效果。

背景排版：在主体后方放置一个跨越几乎整个高度的巨大单词/数字组合：“HER19845”。使用极高的压缩块状字体，并带有做旧墨迹质感。颜色方案：3 个大色块区域 —— “HER”为亮粉色，“19”为橙红色，“845”为深蓝色。主体应覆盖字母中心，但文字仍需保持可读性。

可见文本块：海报周围需包含 9 个精确的图形化文本元素：1) 左上角蓝色小字：“ISSUE No.19845 / CONFIDENCE IS SILENT / INSECURITIES ARE LOUD”；2) 顶部中心蓝色小字：“WORLDWIDE EDITION / MUSIC. FASHION. CULTURE.”；3) 右上角蓝色小字：“COPYRIGHT © 2024 / ALL RIGHTS RESERVED / THIS IS AN ORIGINAL ARTWORK”及一个小地球图标；4) 左侧中部蓝色标语：“NOT FOR EVERYONE / MADE FOR ME.”，下方带有一个小地球/眼睛图标；5) 左下角巨大的亮粉色手写签名：“Rebel”，上方有一个简单的皇冠涂鸦；6) 右侧中部蓝色手写短语：“Since / Day One”，带有亮粉色下划线和油漆滴落效果；7) 左下角蓝色小字：“LOUD HEART. / CLEAR VISION.”；8) 左下角条形码，数字为“19845”；9) 右下角蓝色家长指引标签，内容为“PARENTAL / ADVISORY / EXPLICIT CONTENT.”。

视觉风格：高冲击力的编辑风格街头潮流海报，Y2K 嘻哈杂志封面质感，丝网印刷墨迹，做旧半色调纹理，粗糙纸张颗粒，大胆的粉/橙/蓝配色，写实主体剪影叠加在平面图形字体之上，运动鞋细节清晰，带有柔和的投影。

可自定义参数：使用巨大的背景标题 {argument name="background title" default="HER19845"}、手写签名 {argument name="signature text" default="Rebel"}、手写标语 {argument name="slogan text" default="Since Day One"}、模特服装主题 {argument name="outfit theme" default="oversized black bomber, cropped white graphic tee, dark gray cargo sweatpants, black-white-blue high-top sneakers"} 以及期号 {argument name="issue number" default="19845"}。

约束条件：保持海报构图并垂直居中，不要添加额外人物，保持仅有一位全身模特，保留 9 个小文本元素，保持面部模糊，避免任何水印或现实中的品牌 Logo。

templates.title: Golden Hour Privacy Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 黄金时刻隐私肖像

templates.prompt: Create a vertical portrait photograph capturing the golden hour, with the subject being {argument name="subject" default="A young woman"} The background is set in a lush forest or garden. The image shows her profile from the shoulders up, to the left, with her face deliberately obscured by an opaque, dark brown square privacy occlusion. She has {argument name="hair color" default="Light brown"} Her hair was loosely and messily tied up at the back of her head, many fine strands shimmering in the strong backlight. She wore a simple {argument name="top color" default="White"} A spaghetti-strap tank top exposes her shoulders and upper back. The scene is illuminated by low-angle sunlight behind her head, creating bright rim lighting, warm amber highlights, lens flare, and circular light spots against a softly blurred green background. A realistic DSLR-like visual effect is employed, featuring shallow depth of field, visible natural skin texture on the neck and shoulders, warm cinematic color grading, and a genuinely intimate atmosphere. Composition: Vertical composition, with the subject slightly to the right, the head positioned in the upper third, and the shoulders and torso filling the lower half. A subtle signature-style watermark is added near the lower right corner, with a small circular social media-style icon below it. Avoid including additional people, text, or props.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖构图的黄金时刻肖像摄影作品，拍摄对象为 {argument name="subject" default="一位年轻女性"}，背景位于郁郁葱葱的森林或花园中。画面展示其肩部以上、向左侧的侧面轮廓，面部被一个不透明的深棕色方形隐私遮挡块刻意遮盖。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="浅棕色"} 头发，在脑后盘成一个松散凌乱的发髻，许多细碎的发丝在强烈的背光下闪闪发光。她穿着一件简单的 {argument name="top color" default="白色"} 细肩带背心，露出肩膀和上背部。场景由她脑后的低角度阳光照亮，营造出明亮的轮廓光、温暖的琥珀色高光、镜头光晕，以及在柔和模糊的绿色背景中呈现的圆形光斑。采用写实的单反相机视觉效果，具有浅景深、可见颈部和肩部的自然皮肤纹理、温暖的电影级调色以及真实亲密的氛围。构图：竖向构图，主体略微偏右，头部位于上方三分之一处，肩部和躯干填充下半部分。在右下角附近添加一个细微的签名式水印，并在其下方添加一个小的圆形社交媒体风格图标。避免出现额外的人员、文字或道具。

templates.title: Japanese sunscreen beauty advertisement banner

titleLocalized.zh: 日系防晒霜美妆广告横幅

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a bright, Japanese-style skincare advertising banner for an everyday sunscreen, evoking a light, luxurious cosmetic atmosphere and a soft, morning-light feel. Canvas: Wide horizontal web banner, 1200×675 pixels, 16:9 aspect ratio. Use very pale blue and white tones, high-key lighting, soft shadows, and a clean, minimalist Japanese beauty advertising aesthetic. Layout: Divide the composition into three main areas: the product itself on the left, the central typography and functional icons, and a lifestyle model on the right. A tall, transparent cylindrical pump bottle is placed on the left, positioned on a bright, reflective surface, occupying approximately 25% of the width. A large, soft blue, handwritten Japanese headline is placed in the center. On the right, a young woman wearing a white tank top is shown near a bright window, framed from the chest up, her body slightly turned towards the camera; her face is covered by a large, opaque beige square obscuring her face, but her hair, ears, neck, shoulders, and upper chest remain visible. The background should be a sunny white room with blurred window frames, and a green plant faintly visible on the far right. Product Details: The bottle is made of transparent glass/plastic, containing a frosted white sunscreen lotion. It features a shiny silver cylindrical cap and a label with elegant blue lettering. The label should include: "SPF 50+", "PA++++", "UV PROTECTION SUNSCREEN", "Daily Use UV Protector", and "50mL / 1.69 FL.OZ." A small sun icon should be added above the SPF text. Text Content: The upper left corner should contain the short Japanese text "UV rays make your skin beautiful.", followed by the English subtitle "Daily use sunscreen." Central Title:{argument name="headline text" default="やさしく、つよく。"} The SPF label at the bottom center reads "SPF 50+ PA++++" in large blue lettering, surrounded by a thin-bordered rectangular label that reads "Highest domestic standard value*". Below this is a very small, light blue footnote, visually visible but not overly clear. Function icons: Below the title are three small, evenly spaced line icons separated by a thin vertical line: 1) a sun icon with the word "UV" and the Japanese label "Powerful UV Cut", 2) a water droplet icon with the label "Uruoi Moisturizing Care", and 3) a glitter icon with the label "Transparent Toning Up". Simple blue line art is used. Model details: The model possesses {argument name="hair color" default="Soft brown"} Her hair was loosely styled in a bun, with a few wisps of hair around her ears and neck. Her skin was fair and radiant, her shoulders delicately defined, and she wore a white tank top. Her face had to be covered by a perfectly rectangular solid beige mask, roughly from her forehead to her chin, covering most of her face; the color was close to a warm gray-beige. Visual style: Photorealistic product ad composite, soft lighting, slight lens flare, cool blue shadows, natural sunlight, glossy reflections on the bottle bottom, ample negative space, a sophisticated Japanese cosmetics brand feel. All fonts should be light blue, slender, elegant, and simple. Avoid clutter, unnecessary products, extra people, logos, watermarks, or strong contrasts.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为一款日常防晒霜制作明亮的日系护肤广告横幅，营造轻盈奢华的化妆品氛围和柔和的晨光感。

画布：宽幅横向网页横幅，1200×675 像素，16:9 纵横比。使用极淡的蓝白色调、高调照明、柔和阴影，以及简洁的日系极简美妆广告美学。

布局：将构图分为三个主要区域：左侧产品主体、中央排版与功能图标、右侧生活方式模特。左侧放置一个高大的透明圆柱形按压瓶，立于光亮的反射面上，占据约 25% 的宽度。中央放置柔和蓝色的手写体日文大标题。右侧展示一名身穿白色吊带背心的年轻女性，靠近明亮的窗户，胸部以上构图，身体略微转向镜头；她的面部被一个巨大的不透明米色方形遮挡块覆盖，但头发、耳朵、颈部、肩膀和上胸部保持可见。背景应为阳光明媚的白色房间，带有模糊的窗框，最右侧隐约可见一株绿植。

产品细节：瓶身为透明玻璃/塑料材质，内部装有磨砂白色防晒乳液，配有闪亮的银色圆柱形瓶盖，瓶身标签采用精致的蓝色字体。瓶身标签应包含：“SPF 50+”、“PA++++”、“UV PROTECTION SUNSCREEN”、“Daily Use UV Protector”以及“50mL / 1.69 FL.OZ.”。在 SPF 文字上方添加一个小太阳图标。

文字内容：左上角添加简短日文文案“紫外線から、肌をもっと美しく。”，下方配有英文副标题“Daily use sunscreen”。中央标题：{argument name="headline text" default="やさしく、つよく。"}。底部中央 SPF 说明：“SPF 50+ PA++++”采用蓝色大字，外加一个细边框矩形标签，写着“国内最高基準値*”。在下方添加一行极小的淡蓝色脚注，视觉上可见但不过分清晰。

功能图标：在标题下方包含 3 个等间距排列的小型线条图标，中间用细垂直线分隔：1) 带有“UV”字样和日文标签“強力UVカット”的太阳图标，2) 带有标签“うるおい 保湿ケア”的水滴图标，3) 带有标签“透明感 トーンアップ”的闪光图标。使用简洁的蓝色线条艺术。

模特细节：模特拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="柔和棕色"} 的头发，松散地盘起，耳边和颈部有几缕碎发，皮肤白皙透亮，肩部线条精致，穿着白色吊带背心。她的面部必须被一个完美的矩形实心米色遮罩覆盖，大致从额头到下巴，覆盖大部分面部区域，颜色接近暖灰米色。

视觉风格：照片级真实感产品广告合成，柔光效果，轻微的镜头光晕，冷蓝色阴影，自然日光，瓶底有光泽反射，留有大量负空间，精致的日系化妆品品牌感。所有字体保持浅蓝色、纤细、优雅且简洁。避免杂乱、多余产品、额外人物、标志、水印或强烈的对比。

templates.title: Pastel Pop Star style bus body advertisement

titleLocalized.zh: Pastel Pop Star 风格巴士车身广告

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic wide-angle street shot showcasing a modern long-distance bus traveling through a brightly lit downtown business district, taken from a full side view on the left, with a slight motion blur on the road and background. The bus is covered in a glossy, fully-encased advertisement in a Pastel Pop Star fan-support style: pink at the rear, transitioning to turquoise at the front; featuring black windows, turquoise side mirrors, and a pink roofline. A large portrait of a female celebrity with long black hair, wearing a white sleeveless top, is printed in the center of the side of the bus; her face is subtly blurred in a rectangular shape to protect her privacy. Two large, handwritten-style white text elements are added to the bus: one in the pink area at the rear reads "..."{argument name="left slogan" default="Welcome Back"} The turquoise area at the front is "{argument name="right name" default="CHAse"} Add two small heart-shaped patterns: a small pink heart above the slogan on the left, and a small pink outline heart next to the name on the right. The bus should be traveling on a multi-lane city road, with a background including white lane lines, glass office buildings, trees, pedestrians, and city signs, all slightly blurred due to the speed. Use realistic sunlight effects, clear reflections, and natural shadows to achieve the texture of Korean-style bus advertisement photos commonly seen on social media. Avoid unnecessary text, logos, watermarks, or other vehicles obscuring the bus.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张照片级真实的广角街拍，展示一辆现代长途巴士行驶在明亮的市中心商业区，从左侧全侧面视角拍摄，路面和背景带有轻微的动态模糊。巴士车身采用光面全包裹广告，呈现 Pastel Pop Star 粉丝应援风格：后半部分为粉色，过渡到前半部分为绿松石色；配备黑色车窗、绿松石色前视镜和粉色车顶线。车身侧面中心位置印有 1 张大型女性明星肖像，留着长黑发，身穿白色无袖上衣，面部为保护隐私特意添加了柔和的矩形模糊处理。在巴士上添加 2 处大型手写风格白色文字：后部粉色区域为“{argument name="left slogan" default="Welcome Back"}”，前部绿松石色区域为“{argument name="right name" default="CHAse"}”。添加 2 个小型心形图案：左侧标语上方有一个粉色小爱心，右侧名字旁边有一个粉色轮廓小爱心。巴士应行驶在多车道的城市道路上，背景包含白色车道线、玻璃办公大楼、树木、行人和城市标识，均因速度而略显模糊。采用真实的日光效果、清晰的反射、自然的阴影，呈现出社交媒体上常见的韩式巴士车身广告照片质感。避免出现多余的文字、Logo、水印或遮挡巴士的其他车辆。

templates.title: Photorealistic 8K image restoration

titleLocalized.zh: 照片级真实感 8K 图像修复

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image, restore and enlarge it to an ultra-high-definition 8K photorealistic image. 100% preserve the original features, pose, framing, perspective, and composition; no alterations are permitted: the dog remains centered in the shot, holding the same flower in its mouth, and the background retains the same courtyard and houses. Remove severe blur and pixelation, restoring natural micro-details such as sharp eyes, realistic nose texture, individual whiskers, soft fur, petals, grass, house edges, and tree details. The final result should possess a high-quality, cinematic photographic quality, with natural sunlight, high contrast, rich and realistic colors, sharp focus, and no artificial reconstruction artifacts. Do not change the subject, add new objects, alter expressions, or stylize it like an illustration or CGI. Enhancement Strength:{argument name="enhancement strength" default="Ultra HD 8K cinematic restoration"} Prioritization of details:{argument name="detail priority" default="Clear eyes, realistic pores, beard, hair, and flower textures"} Color grading:{argument name="color grade" default="Natural, sunny daytime high-contrast photorealism"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 使用提供的参考图像，将其修复并放大为超高清的 8K 照片级真实感图像。100% 保留原始特征、姿势、取景、视角和构图，不得有任何改变：狗保持在镜头中心位置，嘴里衔着相同的花朵，背景依然是相同的庭院和房屋。去除严重的模糊和像素化，恢复自然的微观细节，如清晰的眼睛、逼真的鼻部纹理、独立的胡须、柔软的毛发、花瓣、草地、房屋边缘和树木细节。使最终结果呈现出高质量的电影级摄影质感，具备自然日光、高对比度、丰富且真实的色彩、清晰的对焦，且无人工重建痕迹。请勿更换主体、添加新物体、改变表情，也不要将其风格化为插画或 CGI。增强强度：{argument name="enhancement strength" default="超高清 8K 电影级修复"}。细节优先级：{argument name="detail priority" default="清晰的眼睛、逼真的毛孔、胡须、毛发和花朵纹理"}。色彩分级：{argument name="color grade" default="自然晴朗的高对比度照片级真实感"}。

templates.title: Gladiators in the Roman Colosseum

titleLocalized.zh: 罗马竞技场中的女角斗士

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic, realistic, vertical full-body portrait, with the subject being {argument name="character name" default="A fierce female gladiator"} She strides confidently through the dusty Colosseum of ancient Rome. She is positioned at the center of the image, tall and athletic, her long, dark hair styled in a messy high bun, a few strands fluttering in the wind; to maintain anonymity, her face is deliberately obscured by a soft, rectangular blur effect. She is dressed in magnificent attire bearing the marks of battle.{argument name="armor material" default="Bronze and dark leather"} Gladiator armor: an engraved breastplate, asymmetrical decorative shoulder armor on one side, a leather strap across the torso, multiple layers of skirt armor, bracers, a patterned high greaves, lace-up gladiator sandals, and a worn-out jacket hanging from one shoulder.{argument name="cape color" default="Claret"} A cloak. She holds a downward-sloping short sword in her right hand, and a round shield is strapped to her left arm. The arena floor is covered in gravel, the scene chaotic, with six key props clearly visible in the foreground: two fallen helmets, a rolled-up net, a discarded round shield, and two cylindrical scroll-like or weapon-handle-like objects located next to a tattered red cloth. The background showcases a magnificent stone amphitheater with arched openings, red flags, metal gates, and three large burning braziers placed on supports. Two fully armed male gladiators stand guard on the left side of the background, and a lion is near the gate on the right. The lighting employs a dramatic golden hour, with sunlight and firelight intertwining, dust filling the air, creating a strong rim lighting, high detail, a rough texture, shallow depth of field, an epic historical fantasy atmosphere, realistic proportions, and cinematic color grading. There are no modern objects, text, or watermarks in the image.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影级写实风格的竖版全身肖像，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="一名凶猛的女角斗士"}，她正大步穿行在尘土飞扬的古罗马竞技场中。她位于画面中心，身材高挑健美，深色长发扎成凌乱的高发髻，几缕发丝在风中飘动；为了保持匿名，她的面部被柔和的矩形模糊效果刻意遮挡。她身着华丽且带有战斗痕迹的 {argument name="armor material" default="青铜与深色皮革"} 角斗士盔甲：雕花胸甲、单侧不对称装饰肩甲、横跨躯干的皮带束带、多层裙甲、护腕、一只刻有花纹的高护胫、系带角斗士凉鞋，以及一件从单肩垂下的破旧 {argument name="cape color" default="酒红色"} 斗篷。她右手持一把向下倾斜的短剑，左臂绑着一面圆盾。竞技场地面布满沙砾，场面混乱，前景中清晰可见 6 个关键道具：2 顶掉落的头盔、1 张卷起的网、1 面丢弃的圆盾，以及 2 个位于破损红布旁的圆柱形卷轴状或武器柄状物体。背景展示了一座宏伟的石砌圆形剧场，带有拱形开口、红色旗帜、金属大门，以及 3 个放置在支架上的大型燃烧火盆。背景左侧站着 2 名全副武装的男性角斗士守卫，右侧大门附近有 1 只狮子。光影采用戏剧性的黄金时刻阳光与火光交织，空气中弥漫着尘埃，具有强烈的轮廓光、高细节、粗粝的质感、浅景深、史诗般的历史奇幻氛围、真实的比例、电影级调色，画面中无现代物品、无文字、无水印。

templates.title: Portrait of a Purple Shadow Assassin in the Rain

titleLocalized.zh: 雨中紫影刺客肖像

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic, full-body fantasy fashion portrait, depicting {argument name="character name" default="A mysterious female assassin"} She walked towards the onlookers through the rainy night streets of a dark, cyberpunk fantasy city in the East. She wore an exquisitely crafted, asymmetrical, layered black and deep purple kimono-style combat outfit, complete with transparent sleeves, leather straps, a high slit revealing one leg, a fitted waist belt, hanging purple crystal ornaments, black fingerless gloves, and shiny over-the-knee open-toe boots.{argument name="hair color" default="Black hair with purple highlights"} Her hair is styled in a messy half-bun, long strands swaying slightly. Her face should be deliberately obscured by a soft, square blur effect, while the rest of her body remains clear. In her left hand, she holds a folding black fan decorated with fragments of purple crystal. The setting is a damp cobblestone alleyway with strong reflections, rain and mist, and purple lanterns extending into the background; on one side are towering, pale, and cracked concrete walls, and on the other, a shadowy, vertically dense city with pagoda-like balconies, suspended structures, lantern towers, and distant purple light. Add two clearly visible crystal clusters: a large, jagged cluster of purple crystals emerging from the ground in the lower left corner, and a small, scattered crystal fragment at her feet. Use dramatic, low-key lighting, purple and amber highlights, a glossy, rain-soaked pavement, shallow depth of field, realistic fabric textures, a lavish dark fantasy style, and a 2:3 vertical composition. No visible text, no watermarks, no extraneous characters.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅电影质感的全身奇幻时尚肖像，描绘 {argument name="character name" default="一位神秘的女刺客"} 走在暗黑东方赛博朋克奇幻城市的雨夜街道上，正向观看者走来。她身穿精致的非对称黑色与深紫色层叠和服风格战斗服，配有透明袖子、皮革绑带、露出单腿的高开叉设计、修身腰封、悬挂的紫色水晶饰品、黑色露指手套以及亮面过膝露趾靴。她的 {argument name="hair color" default="带有紫色挑染的黑发"} 梳成凌乱的半丸子头，长发丝微微飘动。她的面部应被柔和的方形模糊效果刻意遮挡，而身体其余部分保持清晰。她左手拿着一把装饰着紫色水晶碎片的折叠黑扇。环境是一条带有强烈反射、雨雾和向背景延伸的紫光灯笼的湿润石板巷；一侧是高耸、苍白且布满裂纹的混凝土墙，另一侧通向阴影重重、垂直密集的城市，那里有宝塔般的阳台、悬挂结构、灯笼塔和远处的紫光。添加 2 个清晰可见的水晶簇：左下角地面长出一簇巨大的锯齿状紫色水晶，脚边有一块小的散落水晶碎片。采用戏剧性的低调照明，紫色与琥珀色高光，亮面雨湿路面，浅景深，逼真的织物纹理，华丽的暗黑奇幻风格，以及 2:3 的竖构图。无可见文字，无水印，无多余字符。

templates.title: Dark Fantasy Female Swordsman in the Rain

titleLocalized.zh: 雨中暗黑奇幻女剑客

templates.prompt: Create a vertical, cinematic, dark fantasy portrait, with the subject being {argument name="character name" default="A lone female martial arts swordsman"} She stands at the center of the entrance to an ancient East Asian dojo at night. She wears a tattered, layered black and dark purple samurai robe with high slits, ragged, gauze sleeves, leather arm guards, a wide belt, and simple sandals; her long black hair is half-tied into a messy bun, adorned with a small ornament, and damp stray strands drift over her shoulders. Her face is deliberately blurred with a soft, rectangular effect, while the rest of the image remains sharp and rich in detail. She holds a sheathed katana diagonally downwards in her right hand, the hilt and guard at her waist. The environment is {argument name="setting" default="The wooden dojo courtyard soaked by rain"} Behind her were heavy, open wooden double doors, letting in warm lantern light. Dark beams and paneling were visible, along with a thin mist, drifting sparks, and puddles and reflections on the damp flagstones. Nine prominent props were included: a woman holding a samurai sword, and a tattered, vertical cloth flag to her right bearing the inscription {argument name="banner text" default="Unrivaled in martial arts"} Seven fallen bamboo practice sticks lay scattered on the ground and edges. (Use){argument name="lighting style" default="The emotional, understated lighting, combined with warm lantern backlighting and a cool blue-gray rainy-day atmosphere, creates a mood that evokes a sense of being on a rainy day."} Hyper-realistic fantasy photography style, highly detailed clothing textures, wet fabric feel, cinematic contrast, shallow depth of field, dramatic atmosphere, no watermark, and no additional text except for the flag.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖构图的电影感暗黑奇幻肖像，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="一位孤独的女性武术剑客"}，全身站立在夜晚古老东亚道场的入口中央。她身穿一件破损的黑色与深紫色叠层武士长袍，带有高开叉、破烂的纱状袖子、皮革护臂、宽腰带和简约凉鞋；她的一头长黑发半扎成凌乱的发髻，戴着一个小饰品，湿润的碎发在肩头飘动。她的面部被刻意处理成柔和的矩形模糊效果，而图像的其他部分则保持清晰且细节丰富。她右手向下斜持一把带鞘武士刀，刀柄和护手位于腰间。环境为 {argument name="setting" default="雨水浸湿的木制道场庭院"}：身后是敞开的沉重木质双开门，室内透出温暖的灯笼光，可见深色的梁柱和镶板、薄雾、飘散的火星，以及湿润石板路上的水洼与倒影。包含九个显著道具：女性手中持有一把武士刀，右侧有一面破旧的竖直布旗，上面写有 {argument name="banner text" default="武道無双"}，地面和边缘散落着七根倒下的竹制练习棍。使用 {argument name="lighting style" default="情绪化的低调照明，结合温暖的灯笼背光和冷蓝灰色的雨天氛围"}，超写实奇幻摄影风格，高细节服装纹理，湿润的织物感，电影级对比度，浅景深，戏剧性氛围，无水印，除旗帜外无任何额外文字。

templates.title: Lian Zhi Dark Fantasy Character Design

titleLocalized.zh: Lian Zhi 暗黑奇幻角色设计图

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="character name" default="LIAN ZHI"} Create a stunning, cinematic character design. She is an elegant, East Asian dark fantasy-style female pioneer strategist and signal commander, codenamed {argument name="alias" default="The Silent Bloom"} Canvas: A wide-format, horizontal conceptual art project with a cream-colored paper background and a clean, museum-catalog-style layout, presenting a high-end game character art effect. It utilizes delicate serif fonts, tiny red stamps, sparse annotation text, and a subtle ink-wash aesthetic. Subject: The central image features a full-body hero pose: a tall, composed woman clad in magnificent black lacquered armor, layered with multiple robes. The clothing color scheme is black silk, deep oxblood red, bronze gold, lotus root gray, and pearl white. She wears a high, elaborate updo adorned with hairpins, pendants, red ribbons, and loose strands of hair. The face should be slightly blurred or de-personalized. She holds an unfolded folding war fan in one hand and a slender longsword at an angle in the other. The clothing includes shoulder armor, a fitted bodice, multiple belts with tassels, an asymmetrical skirt, floral ink-wash fabric, black high-heeled boots, and subtle battle-damaged metal details. Left Information Panel: The upper left corner features a large title text…{argument name="character name" default="LIAN ZHI"} "and a small red stamp. Below is a clear character description: "Alias:{argument name="alias" default="The Silent Bloom"} "Role: Vanguard, Strategist, Signal Commander", "Core Theme: Elegant Command. Precise and Silent. Her battles are poetic—calm, deadly, and unforgettable." This is followed by a "Personality" list with four key points: calm and observant; taciturn yet insightful; extremely loyal, difficult to trust; and a firm belief in controlling situations through clarity rather than force. Next is the "Signature" section, describing the battle fan, which serves as both a folding signal fan and conceals a hidden blade and her mother's last message. Vertical Chinese calligraphy is added to the lower left corner, accompanied by an ink lotus illustration. Layout and Quantity Requirements: Include one large full-body hero illustration. In the upper center, include three smaller full-body multi-angle views, labeled "+ FRONT," "BACK," and "PROFILE," respectively. Below the "+ EXPRESSIONS" in the upper right corner are six head and shoulder portraits arranged in two rows of three, each portrait with a blurred/depersonalized face, varying in angle or emotion. Below the center are four rectangular detail close-ups, labeled "+ DETAILS": breastplate and collar, belt with ornaments and red rope, floral robe fabric, and armored high-heeled boots. In the lower right corner is one... A signature prop is displayed, labeled "+ SIGNATURE PROP": a black and gold folding fan with red tassels and a hidden blade. The lower left corner contains five black silhouette thumbnails, labeled "+ SILHOUETTE STUDY," showcasing different cloak and fan poses. The bottom includes six color blocks labeled "COLOR PALETTE": ink black, floral red, bronze gold, lotus root gray, pearl white, and warm beige. Visual Style: High-detail AAA game concept art, fashion costume design sketches, realistic painting renderings, exquisite ink-wash floral patterns, ancient bronze ornaments, red rope, delicate translucent fabrics, precise lines, soft studio lighting, neutral shadows, balanced white space, and elegant typography. Constraints: The entire image is maintained as a coherent character design sketch, rather than a standalone poster. No modern UI. Elements, no watermarks, no realistic facial features, no extra characters, and no additional panels added except for a specified number. Clearly preserve font hierarchy and labels, while ensuring small-text descriptions are elegant and secondary content.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="LIAN ZHI"} 创建一张精致的电影级角色设计图，她是一位优雅的东亚暗黑奇幻风格女性先锋战略家兼信号指挥官，代号为 {argument name="alias" default="The Silent Bloom"}。

画布：宽幅横向概念艺术项目，米白色纸张背景，整洁的博物馆目录式排版，呈现高端游戏角色艺术效果。使用精致的衬线字体、微小的红色印章、稀疏的注释文字以及淡雅的水墨美学。

主体：画面中央为全身英雄姿态，一位高挑从容的女性，身着华丽的黑色漆面盔甲，内搭多层长袍。服装配色为黑丝绸、深牛血红、青铜金、莲藕灰和珍珠白。她梳着高耸精致的发髻，配有发簪、垂饰、红丝带和散落的发丝。面部应略微模糊或去个性化。她一手持展开的折叠战扇，另一手斜持一把纤细的长剑。服装包括肩甲、修身胸衣、多层腰带与流苏、不对称裙摆、花卉水墨面料、黑色高跟靴以及细微的战损金属细节。

左侧信息栏：左上角为大号标题文字“{argument name="character name" default="LIAN ZHI"}”及一枚红色小印章。下方包含清晰的角色说明文字：“Alias: {argument name="alias" default="The Silent Bloom"}”、“Role: 先锋 • 战略家 • 信号指挥官”、“Core Theme”、“优雅指挥。精准无声。她的战斗如诗一般——从容、致命且令人难忘。”随后是一个“Personality”列表，包含 4 个要点：冷静且善于观察；言语极少，洞察一切；极其忠诚，难以建立信任；坚信通过清晰而非武力来掌控局势。接着是“Signature”部分，描述那把战扇，它既是可折叠的信号扇，也藏有暗刃和她母亲留下的最后讯息。左下角添加竖排中文书法，并配以水墨莲花插图。

布局与数量要求：包含 1 张大型全身英雄插图。在上方中部包含 3 张较小的全身多角度视图，分别标注“+ FRONT”、“BACK”和“PROFILE”。在右上角“+ EXPRESSIONS”下方包含 6 张头部及肩部表情肖像，排列为两行三列，每张肖像面部均保持模糊/去个性化，且角度或情绪各异。在下方中部包含 4 张矩形细节特写，标注“+ DETAILS”：胸甲与领口、带有饰品和红绳的腰带、花卉长袍面料、以及带盔甲的高跟靴。在右下角包含 1 个标志性道具展示，标注“+ SIGNATURE PROP”：带有红流苏和隐藏刀刃的黑金折叠战扇。在左下角包含 5 个黑色剪影缩略图，标注“+ SILHOUETTE STUDY”，展示不同的斗篷与折扇姿态。在底部包含 6 个色块，标注“COLOR PALETTE”：水墨黑、花卉红、青铜金、莲藕灰、珍珠白和暖米白。

视觉风格：高细节 AAA 游戏概念艺术，时尚服装设计图，写实绘画渲染，精致的水墨花卉图案，古青铜饰品，红绳，细腻的织物半透明感，精准的线条，柔和的摄影棚灯光，中性阴影，平衡的留白，优雅的编辑排版。

约束：将整张图保持为一个连贯的角色设计图，而非独立的海报。无现代 UI 元素，无水印，无写实面部特征，无额外角色，除指定数量外不添加额外面板。清晰保留字体层级和标签，同时确保小字描述文字雅致且作为次要内容。

templates.title: A cinematic female pirate captain

titleLocalized.zh: 电影感女性海盗船长

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic, hyper-realistic full-body portrait, with the subject being {argument name="character name" default="A female pirate captain"} She stands confidently on the wet wooden deck of a 17th-century sailing ship at sea, centered and facing the viewer, her face softened with a rectangular blur to maintain anonymity. She keeps {argument name="hair color" default="Long, dark purple-black hair"} Her hair was styled in a messy high bun with a few strands hanging down. She wore a magnificent, layered pirate outfit: a long black embroidered coat with gold trim, a fitted dark belt, cream-colored ruffled shirt cuffs, an asymmetrical distressed lace skirt, burgundy fabric trim, multiple belts, small bags, buckles, hanging ornaments, a small pocket watch, a thigh-high slit revealing one leg, and brown high-top gladiator-style leather boots. In her right hand, she held a long-handled flintlock pistol, muzzle pointing downwards. The scene is set on the deck of a dramatic pirate ship under bright sunlight: blue horizon, white clouds, rigging, sails, mast hardware, wooden railings, coiled ropes, barrels, crates, and rain-soaked planks reflecting the sunlight. The image must include four background crew members: a sailor crouching or leaning on the left, lighting a smoking cannon; a sailor standing at a distance near the rigging behind the captain; a sailor operating a rope next to a barrel on the right; and a sleeveless crew member whose upper body is visible but whose face is blurred on the far right. The image must also include a cannon emitting thick white smoke on the left, two prominently coiled ropes on the right, and two barrels in the center right background.{argument name="visual style" default="Ultra-detailed, cinematic, hyper-realistic style"} Natural sunlight in the upper left corner, high contrast, shallow depth of field, realistic fabric texture, weathered wood, brass and leather details, sea fog, and an adventurous swordsman atmosphere. 1:1 square composition, full-body subject, low eye-level perspective, no text, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影感超写实全身肖像，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="一位女性海盗船长"}，她自信地站在海上 17 世纪帆船湿漉漉的木质甲板上，画面居中并面向观众，其面部为了保持匿名而被柔和的矩形模糊处理。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="长长的深紫黑色头发"}，扎成凌乱的高发髻并垂下几缕发丝，身着华丽的叠层海盗装束：黑色刺绣长外套配金色镶边、合身深色束腰、奶油色荷叶边衬衫袖口、不对称破旧蕾丝裙、酒红色布料镶片、多条腰带、小袋、带扣、悬挂的饰品、一块小怀表、开叉至大腿露出一条腿，以及棕色高筒角斗士风格皮靴。她右手持一把长柄燧发枪，枪口向下。场景设定在明亮日光下的戏剧性海盗船甲板：蓝色海平线、白云、索具、船帆、桅杆五金件、木质栏杆、盘绕的绳索、木桶、板条箱以及反射着阳光的雨后湿滑木板。画面中必须包含 4 名背景船员：左侧一名蹲着或倚靠着正在点燃冒烟大炮的水手，船长身后索具附近一名远处的站立水手，右侧木桶旁一名正在操作绳索的水手，以及最右侧一名半身可见且面部模糊的无袖船员。画面中必须包含左侧 1 门正在喷出浓厚白烟的大炮、右侧 2 处显眼的盘绕绳索，以及右中背景处 2 个木桶。使用 {argument name="visual style" default="超细节电影感超写实风格"}，左上方自然日光，高对比度，浅景深，逼真的布料质感，风化的木材，黄铜与皮革细节，海雾，以及充满冒险色彩的剑客氛围。1:1 正方形构图，全身主体，低平视视角，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Anime Street Fashion Women

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫街头时尚女性

templates.prompt: Create a vertical full-body anime illustration depicting {argument name="character name" default="A fashionable young woman"} She stood casually on a sunlit city sidewalk, the backdrop a modern glass and metal building entrance with a shallow depth of field. She had wavy hair {argument name="hair color" default="light blue"} A bob haircut, paired with large retro headphones in pink, tan, and gold; her face is deliberately obscured by a plain beige rectangular visor. A thin white line is added near her head, suggesting smoke, steam, or breath. Clothing: an oversized, loose pink haori-style cardigan with wide sleeves; a faded blue printed T-shirt that reads "Visit Palm Spring" with illustrations of vintage motels, roads, palm trees, and sunsets; high-waisted tan pleated trousers with rolled-up cuffs; a brown woven belt; off-white socks; and burgundy leather tassel loafers. In her left hand, she carries a cream-colored canvas tote bag with a red circular "STRAND" logo and small website text near the bottom. The pose is relaxed and forward-facing, one arm hanging down holding the tote bag, the other mostly hidden by the cardigan, the garment's folds natural and the shadows soft. Utilizing cinematic-quality anime rendering, the image features sharp lines, soft pastel tones, realistic proportions, and subtle film-like lighting and shadows, reminiscent of a modern street fashion magazine. It is a vertical composition, with the entire figure centered, no additional characters, and no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张竖版全身动漫插画，描绘 {argument name="character name" default="一位时尚年轻女性"} 随意地站在阳光明媚的城市人行道上，背景是现代玻璃金属建筑入口，并带有浅景深的城市背景。她留着波浪状的 {argument name="hair color" default="淡水蓝色"} 波波头，戴着粉色、棕褐色和金色相间的大型复古头戴式耳机；她的脸部被一个朴素的米色矩形遮挡块刻意遮住。在她的头部附近添加一缕细小的白色线条，暗示烟雾、蒸汽或呼吸。服装：超大宽松的粉色羽织风格开衫，袖口宽大；褪色的蓝色印花 T 恤，上面写着“Visit Palm Spring”，并配有复古汽车旅馆、道路、棕榈树和日落插图；高腰棕褐色褶皱长裤，裤脚卷起；棕色编织腰带；米白色袜子；以及酒红色皮革流苏乐福鞋。她左手拿着一个奶油色帆布托特包，上面印有红色的圆形标志“STRAND”，底部附近有小的网站文字。姿势放松且面向前方，一只手臂下垂拿着托特包，另一只手臂大部分被开衫遮住，衣物褶皱自然，阴影柔和。采用电影级动漫渲染，线条清晰，柔和的粉彩色调，比例写实，具有微妙的胶片感光影和现代街头时尚杂志的质感。竖构图，全身居中，无额外人物，无水印。

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超电影质感的鱼眼低角度时尚摄影作品，场景位于超现实的未来主义全白建筑室内。一位 {argument name="model gender" default="男性"} 时尚模特从巨大的悬浮旋转楼梯边缘直接向镜头俯身，双手紧握透明玻璃栏杆，面部被一个简约的长方形面具刻意遮挡。他留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深蓝黑色"} 的后梳发型，身穿一件华丽的奢侈锦缎西装外套，颜色为 {argument name="jacket colors" default="酒红色和橄榄绿色"}，饰有密集的金色花卉刺绣，内搭深黑色衬衫，下身穿着修身长裤和深色抛光皮鞋。相机位于他下方略靠前的位置，营造出极端的垂直鱼眼透视效果：他的上半身占据顶部中心，而旋转楼梯向下延伸，形成一个由白色拱门和玻璃栏杆组成的无限重复隧道。环境极简、光洁且充满未来感，拥有巨大的光滑弧形白墙、圆形切口、柔和的蓝灰色阴影，以及沿着楼梯边缘、天花板曲线和圆形建筑线条延伸的连续发光白色 LED 灯带。运用戏剧性的广角畸变、华丽服装与纯净白色空间之间的高对比度、冷色调电影光效、清晰的建筑细节、写实的时尚摄影风格、对称构图、深邃的景深以及令人眩晕的高度感。无文字，无水印，无其他人物。
