templates.title: Miniature workers clean giant iPhone

titleLocalized.zh: 迷你工人清洗巨型 iPhone

templates.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic, cinematic macro photograph, featuring a giant black {argument name="phone model" default="iPhone"} Standing vertically in the rainy night, its glossy back faces the viewer, the Apple logo is in the center, and the dual rear cameras are in the upper left corner. A powerful stream of water cascades down from above, splashing, dripping, and forming vertical water streaks on the surface; the entire scene is wet, reflective, and dramatic. The image needs to precisely depict six people dressed in bright {argument name="worker uniform color" default="pink"} Miniature repairmen in yellow overalls and blue hard hats are cleaning an oversized phone with yellow sponges: one worker is on a slanted ladder in the upper left corner, wiping near the camera module; another worker stands on the lower left, holding the ladder and spraying or wiping upwards; a worker is in the center below, standing on a small support to wipe the back of the phone; a worker is on a tall ladder in the upper right corner, wiping below the water droplets; a worker stands near the bottom of the tall ladder, cleaning the lower right side; and another worker is on the far right, holding a sponge to wipe the edges of the phone. The scene must include two clearly visible ladders: a slanted ladder on the left and a nearly vertical tall ladder on the right. The phone should appear enormous relative to the workers, with rounded black edges, clearly visible side buttons, bright reflections, tiny water droplets, and the faintly visible "iPhone" logo on the lower back. The scene is set on a black ground soaked by rain, reflecting the workers, ladders, phone, water splashes, and dim, warm-toned city lights in the background. It features shallow depth of field, high contrast, sharp and delicate water droplet details, melancholic film noir lighting, realistic proportions, 3:4 vertical composition, no extra text, and no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张超写实的电影级微距摄影作品，画面中一台巨大的黑色 {argument name="phone model" default="iPhone"} 在雨夜中垂直矗立，其光亮的背面朝向观众，Apple 标志位于中心，双后置摄像头位于左上角。一股强劲的水流从上方倾泻在手机顶部边缘，在手机表面激起水花、水滴并形成垂直流下的水痕；整个场景湿润、反光且充满戏剧性。画面中需精确展示 6 名身着亮 {argument name="worker uniform color" default="pink"} 色连体工作服和蓝色安全帽的微型维修工，正用黄色海绵清洗这台超大手机：一名工人位于左上角倾斜的梯子上，在摄像头模组附近擦拭；一名工人站在左下方扶着梯子，向上喷水或擦拭；一名工人位于下方中央，站在小型支撑物上擦拭手机背面；一名工人位于右上角的高梯上，在落水处下方擦拭；一名工人站在该高梯底部附近，清洁右下侧；还有一名工人位于最右侧，举着海绵擦拭手机边缘。画面中必须包含两架清晰可见的梯子：左侧一架倾斜的梯子，右侧一架近乎垂直的高梯。手机相对于工人而言应显得巨大，具有圆润的黑色边缘、清晰的侧边按钮、光亮的反射、细小的水珠，以及背面下方隐约可见的“iPhone”字样。场景设在被雨水浸湿的黑色地面上，地面映照出工人、梯子、手机、水花以及背景中暗淡的城市暖色光斑。采用浅景深、高对比度、锐利细腻的水滴细节、忧郁的黑色电影风格布光、逼真的比例模型摄影效果，3:4 竖构图，无额外文字，无水印。

templates.title: Digital Oil Painting Living Room Practice Page

titleLocalized.zh: 数字油画客厅练习页

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a printable digital painting practice page depicting a cartoon living room scene. A childlike character stands in the center, designed as a simple black and white line drawing with numbered areas and color guides. Canvas: A4 portrait page, 300 DPI, white background, thin black border, clear vector-style outline, no shadows except for small color blocks in the guide. The main illustration occupies approximately 70% of the page at the top, and the instructions/color key panel occupies approximately 30% at the bottom. Main Illustration Layout: Draw a cozy living room in a simple, rounded cartoon style. Center: A standing cartoon character with large round eyes, a small dotted nose, a worried wavy mouth, hooded or helmet-like hair, a short-sleeved shirt, thin arms, trousers, and bare feet. Left Side: A sofa with two seat cushions/backrests, a visible armrest on each side, and a small throw pillow. Above the sofa: A framed wall painting containing a small landscape with hills, sky, and a tree. To the right of the character: A side table with a lamp and a drawer; behind/to the right is a tall potted plant with exactly 10 visible leaves. Far right: A camera on a tripod, pointed at the character, with a screen/body, lens/buttons, and exactly three tripod legs. The background includes a wall, a large window with vertical panes on the right, a floor with wooden trim, and a large rectangular rug in the foreground. Numbered areas: Place black numbers from 1 to 14 within the lined areas of the scene. Repeat the same numbers on matching surfaces. Keep the numbers sharp and centered within the shapes. Match the specified assignments: 1 for beige wall area, 2 for light gray head/hood area, 3 for yellow skin/limbs, 4 for black camera/tripod details, 5 for white shirt and camera screen, 6 for blue sofa, 7 for tan cushions, 8 for brown picture frame, 9 for sky blue window/sky in the painting, 10 for green plants/leaves, 11 for cream-colored lamps/carpet interior, 12 for cyan carpet border, 13 for wood-brown floor/table/plank area, 14 for beige flower pot. Bottom caption panel: Add a horizontal dividing line above the legend. Center a bold title with the following content:{argument name="instruction title" default="illustrate"} Below it, add smaller text with the following content:{argument name="instruction subtitle" default="Fill in the area with the corresponding color."} Below are 14 color chart entries, arranged in three columns. Each entry contains a number, a small fill color swatch, and an English color label. The 14 entries must be: 1 Beige, 2 Light Gray, 3 Yellow, 4 Black, 5 White, 6 Blue, 7 Tan, 8 Brown, 9 Sky Blue, 10 Green, 11 Cream, 12 Teal, 13 Wood Brown, 14 Beige (Pot). Style restrictions: Make it look like a refined printable worksheet for children, with a smooth, uniform black outline, rounded, friendly shapes, plenty of closed areas suitable for coloring, no gradients, no realistic textures, no extra text, and no watermark. The main body can be customized.{argument name="central character" default="A worried cartoon child character"} The scene is{argument name="room setting" default="Cozy living room"} The color palette is{argument name="color palette" default="14-color paint-by-number palette"} .

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一张可打印的数字油画练习页，展示一个卡通客厅场景，中心站着一个类似儿童的角色，设计为简洁的黑白线条画，带有编号区域和颜色图例。

画布：A4 纵向页面，300 DPI，白色背景，细黑色外边框，清晰的矢量风格轮廓，除图例中的微小色块外无阴影。主插图占据页面上方约 70% 的空间，说明/颜色键面板占据下方约 30% 的空间。

主插图布局：绘制一个采用简洁圆润卡通风格的温馨客厅。中心：一个站立的卡通角色，有着大圆眼、小点鼻、担忧的波浪嘴、兜帽或头盔状头发、短袖衬衫、细手臂、长裤和赤脚。左侧：一张沙发，有两个座垫/靠垫，两侧各有一个可见的扶手，以及一个小靠枕。沙发上方：一幅带框的墙面画，包含一个小风景，有山丘、天空和一棵树。角色右侧：一张侧桌，上面有一盏灯和一个抽屉；后方/右侧有一盆高大的盆栽，正好有 10 片可见叶子。最右侧：一台三脚架上的相机，对准角色，带有屏幕/机身、镜头/按钮，以及正好三条三脚架腿。背景包括一面墙、右侧一扇带有垂直窗格的大窗户、带有木板线条的地板，以及前景中一块大的长方形地毯。

数字涂色区域：在场景的线条区域内放置黑色数字，使用 1 到 14 的数字。在匹配的表面上重复使用相同的数字。保持数字清晰并居中于形状内。匹配指定的分配：1 为米色墙面区域，2 为浅灰色头部/兜帽区域，3 为黄色皮肤/四肢，4 为黑色相机/三脚架细节，5 为白色衬衫和相机屏幕，6 为蓝色沙发，7 为棕褐色靠枕，8 为棕色画框，9 为天蓝色窗户/画中天空，10 为绿色植物/树叶，11 为奶油色灯具/地毯内部，12 为青色地毯边框，13 为木棕色地板/桌子/木板区域，14 为米色花盆。

底部说明面板：在图例上方添加一条水平分隔线。居中放置一个粗体标题，内容为 {argument name="instruction title" default="说明"}。在其下方，添加较小的文字，内容为 {argument name="instruction subtitle" default="用对应的颜色涂满区域。"}。下方排列 14 个颜色图例条目，分为三列。每个条目包含一个数字、一个小填充色块和一个英文颜色标签。14 个条目必须为：1 Beige (米色), 2 Light Gray (浅灰色), 3 Yellow (黄色), 4 Black (黑色), 5 White (白色), 6 Blue (蓝色), 7 Tan (棕褐色), 8 Brown (棕色), 9 Sky Blue (天蓝色), 10 Green (绿色), 11 Cream (奶油色), 12 Teal (青色), 13 Wood Brown (木棕色), 14 Beige (Pot) (米色花盆)。

风格限制：使其看起来像一张精致的儿童可打印练习页，具有平滑统一的黑色轮廓、圆润友好的形状、大量适合涂色的封闭区域，无渐变，无逼真纹理，无额外文字，无水印。主体可自定义为 {argument name="central character" default="一个担忧的卡通儿童形象"}，场景为 {argument name="room setting" default="温馨客厅"}，调色板为 {argument name="color palette" default="14 色数字油画调色板"}。

templates.title: Parrot Digital Oil Painting Worksheet

titleLocalized.zh: 鹦鹉数字油画工作表

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a printable digital painting worksheet with the theme "[Title of worksheet]".{argument name="subject" default="A tropical parrot perched among the leaves of a large Monstera deliciosa plant."} Canvas: A4 portrait page, pure white background, black and white line art, designed for 300 DPI printing. Add a thin rectangular border around the main image and leave an explanatory area at the bottom. Main Image: Within the border, draw a simple coloring book style parrot, facing left, perched diagonally on a branch. The parrot has a curved beak, round eyes, layered wing feathers, long tail feathers, and feet gripping the branch. Surround large tropical Monstera leaves in the background and foreground, the leaves broad and lobed with simple vein lines. Use smooth, uniform black outlines, without shading or grayscale fill. Numbered Areas: Divide the illustration into several closed coloring areas, placing a black number in the center of each area. Use 10 numbered labels from 1 to 10 throughout the work, with repeated numbers appearing in multiple areas. Labels should be small, clear, and easy to read, conforming to printable worksheet standards. Bottom Instructions Area: Below the illustrations, add a left-aligned, bold title “Instructions,” followed by the sentence “Paint the areas with the matching colors.” Below this sentence, include a horizontal color chart with eight numbered color swatches: 1 Prussian Blue, 2 Beige, 3 Coral, 4 Yellow, 5 Green, 6 Sky Blue, 7 Brown, 8 Red. Each chart item should display a small color swatch with the number inside or next to it, followed by the color name. Visual Style: Minimalist vector worksheet aesthetics, clean black outlines, white filled areas, no textures, no shadows, no watermarks, and no unnecessary decorative elements. The final image should look like a printable children's coloring page for digital painting.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一张可打印的数字油画工作表，主题为 {argument name="subject" default="一只栖息在大型龟背竹叶丛中的热带鹦鹉"}。

画布：A4 纵向页面，纯白背景，黑白线条艺术，专为 300 DPI 打印设计。在主图周围添加细矩形边框，并在底部留出说明区域。

主图：在边框内，绘制一只简单的涂色书风格鹦鹉，面向左侧，斜向栖息在树枝上。鹦鹉具有弯曲的喙、圆形的眼睛、层叠的翅膀羽毛、长尾羽以及抓握树枝的脚。在背景和前景中环绕大型热带龟背竹叶，叶片宽大且有裂纹，并带有简单的叶脉线条。使用平滑、粗细一致的黑色轮廓线，无阴影或灰度填充。

数字编号区域：将插图划分为多个封闭的涂色区域，并在区域中心放置黑色数字。在整幅作品中使用 1 到 10 共 10 个编号标签，重复的数字出现在多个区域。标签应小巧、清晰且易于阅读，符合可打印工作表的标准。

底部说明区域：在插图下方，添加左对齐的粗体标题“Instructions”（说明），随后是句子“Paint the areas with the matching colors.”（用对应的颜色涂色）。在句子下方，包含一个水平颜色图例，包含 8 个编号色块：1 普鲁士蓝、2 米色、3 珊瑚红、4 黄色、5 绿色、6 天蓝色、7 棕色、8 红色。每个图例项应显示一个小色块，数字位于色块内或旁边，后跟颜色名称。

视觉风格：极简矢量工作表美学，清晰的黑色轮廓，白色填充区域，无纹理，无阴影，无水印，无多余装饰元素。最终图像应看起来像一张可直接打印的儿童数字油画涂色页。

templates.prompt: A lifelike hand holds a rounded-corner miniature sketchbook, opened like a miniature paper art theater, the upright back page and the horizontal front page forming a continuous hand-drawn scene. The scene is {argument name="coastal setting" default="At sunset, the rugged lighthouse cliff path in New England overlooks the turbulent sea."} A pebble path stretches from the foreground, across the folds, and up to the white lighthouse and keeper's hut on the rocky headland, accompanied by foamy waves, dark cliffs, wooden railings, a warm sunset on the horizon, and a dramatic blue-purple cloud-covered sky. Two living figures are included in the hand-drawn scene:{argument name="main character" default="A solitary tower keeper wearing a long, dark raincoat, a wide-brimmed hat, and carrying a glowing lantern."} Standing on the path, and{argument name="animal companion" default="A seagull on the foreground path"} Using the forced perspective technique of trompe-l'oeil, the hand-drawn paths, shadows, fences, and cliffs seamlessly connect between vertical and horizontal pages. Rendered in an opaque watercolor acrylic folk illustration style, showcasing the matte paper texture, clear and expressive brushstrokes, simplified geometric forms, and rich painting details. Demonstrate the heavy shadows across the foreground pages, the visible edges of the overlapping paper on the spine and bottom of the sketchbook, and the convincing physical thickness of the rounded pages. Hands must appear photorealistic, with natural skin texture, veins, knuckles, and fingertips gripping the sketchbook. Place all objects against a neutral warm beige studio background, photographed macro from a three-quarter overhead angle with a shallow depth of field of f/2.8. The lighting should be soft, diffused ambient light from the upper left, with subtle touch shadows below the sketchbook and subtle color variations near the edges of the image. Use a 3:4 vertical composition and avoid any text, logos, or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 一只逼真的人手拿着一本圆角袖珍速写本，像微型纸艺剧场一样打开，直立的后页与水平的前页构成一幅连续的手绘场景。场景为 {argument name="coastal setting" default="日落时分新英格兰崎岖的灯塔悬崖小径，旁临波涛汹涌的大海"}：一条石子路从前景延伸，跨过折页，向上通往岩石岬角上的白色灯塔和守塔人小屋，伴有泡沫翻涌的海浪、深色悬崖、木质护栏、地平线上的温暖夕阳以及戏剧性的蓝紫色云层天空。在手绘场景中包含两个活体人物：{argument name="main character" default="一位身穿长款深色雨衣、戴着宽檐帽并提着发光灯笼的孤独守塔人"} 站在小径上，以及 {argument name="animal companion" default="前景小径上的一只海鸥"}。使用强制透视的视觉陷阱（trompe-l’oeil）手法，使手绘的小径、阴影、栅栏和悬崖在垂直和水平页面间无缝衔接。以不透明水粉丙烯民间插画风格渲染，呈现哑光纸张质感、清晰且富有表现力的笔触、简化的几何形态以及丰富的绘画细节。展示横跨前景页面的浓重投影、书脊和速写本底部可见的层叠纸张边缘，以及圆角页面令人信服的物理厚度。手部必须看起来照片级逼真，具有自然的皮肤纹理、静脉、指关节和抓握速写本的指尖。将所有物体置于中性暖米色摄影棚背景中，以四分之三俯视角度进行微距实物拍摄，并采用 f/2.8 的浅景深。光线应为来自左上方的柔和漫射环境光，速写本下方带有细腻的接触阴影，图像边缘附近有微妙的色差。使用 3:4 竖构图，避免出现任何文字、标志或水印。

templates.title: Peacock Digital Oil Painting Practice Sheet

titleLocalized.zh: 孔雀数字油画练习表

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a printable paint-by-number worksheet featuring a stylized peacock, designed for children or beginners. Canvas: A4 portrait page, 300 DPI, pure white background. The main practice area consists only of black lines, with a thin rectangular border around the drawing. Leave space below the border for instructions and color stops. Main Drawing: Draw a simple frontal peacock in the center, with a large, semi-circular fan-shaped tail. Use thick, smooth black outlines to delineate large, enclosed areas for easy coloring. The peacock has a rounded body, two slender legs, small feet on the ground, a long neck, a pointed beak, rounded facial markings, a small crest, and folded wings on either side of the body. Behind it, draw a fan-shaped tail divided into 7 large radiating feather panels, labeled 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, and 12 from left to right. Add 7 smaller polygonal feather eye-shaped patterns inside the fan, one in each panel, also labeled 6 to 12. Add additional labels to the bird: use 2 for the body and lower wing, 3 for the right wing, 4 for the face, and 5 for the crest feathers. Fill the blank background area within the border with the number 1 in the top left, top right, bottom left, and bottom right positions. Numbering and Areas: Use 12 painting colors, indicated only by black number labels within enclosed areas. All numbers should be large, centered, and easy to read. Avoid using shadows, textures, gradients, or fill colors within the drawing area. Bottom Text: Below the drawing border, add a bold title “Instructions,” followed by the sentence “Please fill the area with the corresponding color.” Color Statues: At the very bottom, arrange 12 horizontally arranged square color blocks, each with a white or black number in the center, and two lines of color names below. The color blocks are as follows: 1 Prussian Blue, 2 Golden Ochre, 3 Turquoise, 4 Coral Red, 5 Lemon Green, 6 Violet, 7 Magenta, 8 Sapphire Blue, 9 Sun Yellow, 10 Forest Green, 11 Cyan, 12 Blue-violet. Style restrictions: Clear vector-style exercise sheet, high-contrast black outline, no grayscale fill within the drawing, no extra decoration, no watermark, maintain a layout suitable for printing and easy to color.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张可打印的数字油画练习表，主体为风格化的孔雀，专为儿童或初学者设计。

画布：A4 纵向页面，300 DPI，纯白背景。主要练习区域仅包含黑色线条，绘图周围带有细矩形边框。在边框下方的区域留出说明和色标位置。

主体绘图：在中心绘制一只简单的正面孔雀，带有巨大的半圆形扇形尾巴。使用粗而平滑的黑色轮廓线，并划分出便于涂色的大块封闭区域。孔雀拥有圆润的身体、两条细腿、水平地面线上的小脚、细长的脖子、尖尖的喙、圆形的侧脸斑块、小冠羽以及身体两侧折叠的翅膀形状。在身后，绘制一个扇形尾巴，分为 7 个大的放射状羽毛面板，从左到右依次标记为 6、7、8、9、10、11 和 12。在扇形内部添加 7 个较小的多边形羽毛眼状图案，每个面板内一个，同样标记为 6 到 12。在鸟身上添加额外标签：身体和下翅膀使用 2，右翅膀使用 3，脸部使用 4，冠羽使用 5。在边框内的空白背景区域，于左上、右上、左下和右下四个位置填充数字 1。

编号与区域：使用 12 种绘画颜色，仅通过封闭区域内的黑色数字标签表示。所有数字需保持大号、居中且易于阅读。绘图区域内避免使用阴影、纹理、渐变或填充颜色。

底部文字：在绘图边框下方，添加粗体标题“说明”，随后附上句子“请用对应的颜色涂满区域”。

色标：在最底部，横向排列 12 个正方形色块，每个色块中心标有白色或黑色数字，下方附有两行颜色名称。色块颜色如下：1 普鲁士蓝，2 金赭色，3 青绿色，4 珊瑚红，5 柠檬绿，6 紫罗兰色，7 品红色，8 宝石蓝，9 太阳黄，10 森林绿，11 青蓝色，12 兰紫色。

风格限制：清晰的矢量风格练习表，高对比度黑色轮廓，绘图内无灰度填充，无额外装饰，无水印，保持布局适合打印且易于涂色。

Use a simple black and white line drawing, inspired by the powerful waves of Japanese Ukiyo-e prints, featuring large, rolling waves, irregular, foamy edges, a small hill on the right horizon, and abstract cloud or sky shapes in the background. Keep the drawing within a thin rectangular border and leave wide white margins. Divide the illustration into clearly defined coloring areas, using smooth black outlines, and center the number label in each area. Use 10 coloring numbers throughout the work, repeating the area labels where appropriate: 1 represents the large wave foam/white area, 2 represents the cream-colored wave crest, 3 represents the sky-blue wave area, 4 represents the slate-grey wave/background area, 5 represents the coral-red small wave area, 6 represents the light gray lower foam area, 7 represents the red lower wave band, 8 represents the dark cyan lower right wave band, 9 represents the parchment-brown wave band, and 10 represents the foam white horizon/sky band. Add a bold title at the bottom below the border artwork.{argument name="headline text" default="illustrate"} The sentence that follows{argument name="instruction text" default="Please fill in the area with the corresponding color."} Below the description is a two-line color chart with 10 numbered square color blocks and labels: 1 Prussian Blue, 2 Cream, 3 Sky Blue, 4 Slate Grey, 5 Coral Red, 6 Light Grey, 7 Red, 8 Dark Cyan, 9 Parchment Brown, 10 Foam White. Make the color blocks small and horizontally aligned on the page, with each colored square labeled in black and accompanied by its color name. The overall style should be simple, clear, and printable; illustrations should have no shadows, no extra decorations, no watermarks, and all text should use a simple sans-serif font.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一张 300 DPI 的 A4 纵向可打印数字油画练习页。使用简洁的黑白线条插图，灵感源自日本浮世绘风格的震撼海浪，包含巨大的卷浪、泡沫状的不规则边缘、右侧地平线上的一座小山，以及背景中抽象的云朵或天空形状。将绘图保持在细矩形边框内，并留出宽阔的白色页边距。将插图划分为界限清晰的涂色区域，使用平滑的黑色轮廓线，并在每个区域内居中放置数字标签。整幅作品使用 10 个涂色数字，并在适当位置重复使用区域标签：1 代表大浪泡沫/白色区域，2 代表奶油色浪尖部分，3 代表天蓝色浪花区域，4 代表板岩灰海浪/背景区域，5 代表珊瑚红小浪区域，6 代表浅灰色下部泡沫区域，7 代表红色下部浪带，8 代表深青色右下浪带，9 代表羊皮纸棕色浪带，10 代表泡沫白地平线/天空带。在边框艺术作品下方的底部，添加一个粗体标题 {argument name="headline text" default="说明"}，后跟句子 {argument name="instruction text" default="请用对应的颜色涂满区域。"}。在说明下方，包含一个两行的颜色图例，其中有 10 个带编号的方形色块和标签：1 普鲁士蓝，2 奶油色，3 天蓝色，4 板岩灰，5 珊瑚红，6 浅灰色，7 红色，8 深青色，9 羊皮纸棕色，10 泡沫白。使图例色块较小，在页面上水平对齐，每个彩色方块内标有黑色数字，旁边附有颜色名称。整体风格应简洁、清晰、适合打印，插图内无阴影，无额外装饰，无水印，所有文字均使用简单的无衬线字体。

templates.title: Dark Mode Chat Interface Anime Transformation Screenshot

titleLocalized.zh: 深色模式聊天界面动漫转换截图

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a dark-mode screenshot of a chat interface showcasing an AI-generated dialogue about transforming photos into anime-style animated characters. Canvas: 768×768 square image, dark charcoal gray background, cropped to a desktop chat app style. Use delicate rounded rectangles, soft shadows, and soft gray dividing lines. Layout: In the upper left corner, display three horizontally arranged square thumbnail cards, each containing a circular portrait: 1) a brown-haired woman with shoulder-length wavy hair, 2) a blonde woman with long light-colored hair, and 3) a woman with long, straight black hair. Each face should be deliberately blurred or overlaid with a soft rectangular privacy blur mask. Below the thumbnails on the right, place a rounded dark chat bubble containing a Japanese message.{argument name="first message" default="Oh, and I might want to make an anime-style Ping?"} A small gray status bar is displayed on the lower left, with the text "..."{argument name="status text" default="I worked for 2 minutes and 38 seconds."} This is followed by a thin horizontal dividing line. Image Preview: To the left of the dividing line, place a rounded rectangle preview image showing the three women transformed into delicate anime/semi-realistic character art, standing side-by-side against a warm gray-white background. Accurate Character Count: 3 women—a brown-haired woman wearing a light blue shirt with a beige cardigan, a blonde woman wearing a white top and layered necklaces, and a dark-haired woman wearing a black leather jacket. All faces should be blurred using a soft rectangular mask for privacy. Chat Bubbles: A total of 4 visible message bubbles are included: 1 top hint bubble, 2 lower-middle bubbles, and 1 lower-right bubble. The first lower-middle bubble should be visible.{argument name="reaction message" default="Oh, that's really great!! It's like making one by one for each person."} The second, wider bubble in the lower middle section should show {argument name="instruction message" default="And then, please make it so that it continues moving until the end, with narration included."} The bubble in the bottom right corner should display {argument name="final message" default="I want you to make it."} Add a small, circular down arrow button in the center below the chat bubbles. Visual style: Realistic UI screenshots, Japanese chat app aesthetics, minimalist and modern, dark theme, rounded corners, graphite message bubbles, light gray text, clean spacing. The character art preview should present a high-quality anime photo transformation effect, not flat cartoon art. Constraints: Use 3 portrait thumbnails at the top to generate 1 preview image containing 3 anime-style female characters, 4 chat bubbles in total, and 1 down arrow button. Do not add any app icons, watermarks, extra buttons, extra text, or extra characters.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个深色模式的聊天界面截图，展示关于将照片转换为动漫风格动画角色的 AI 图像生成对话。

画布：768×768 正方形图像，深炭灰色背景，裁剪为桌面聊天应用样式。使用精致的圆角矩形、柔和的阴影和柔和的灰色分隔线。

布局：在左上方，横向排列显示 3 张正方形缩略图卡片，每张卡片内含一个圆形肖像：1) 一位留着齐肩波浪卷发的棕发女性，2) 一位留着长浅色头发的金发女性，3) 一位留着直长黑发的女性。每张脸部都应刻意模糊，或覆盖一层柔和的矩形隐私模糊遮罩。在缩略图下方的右侧，放置一个圆角深色聊天气泡，其中包含日语消息 {argument name="first message" default="あー、あとアニメ風の Ping を作りたいかも？？"}。下方左侧显示一行小巧的灰色状态栏，文字为 {argument name="status text" default="2m 38s作業しました ›"}，随后是一条细水平分隔线。

生成图像预览：在分隔线下方的左侧，放置 1 张圆角矩形预览图，展示这 3 位女性被转换为精致的动漫/半写实角色艺术，她们在温暖的灰白色背景下肩并肩站立。准确计算角色数量：3 位女性——棕发女性穿着浅蓝色衬衫外搭米色开衫，金发女性穿着白色上衣并佩戴叠层项链，黑发女性穿着黑色皮夹克。所有脸部均需使用柔和的矩形模糊遮罩进行隐私处理。

聊天气泡：总共包含 4 个可见的发出消息气泡：1 个顶部提示气泡，2 个中下部气泡，以及 1 个右下角气泡。中下部的第一个气泡应显示 {argument name="reaction message" default="おー超いい感じ！！\n一人一人、一枚ずつ、作る感じで"}。中下部的第二个较宽气泡应显示 {argument name="instruction message" default="その上で、そのまま、最後まで動く、ナレーション込みのやつでお願い"}。右下角的气泡应显示 {argument name="final message" default="作って欲しい"}。在气泡之间的下方中间位置，添加一个小的圆形向下箭头按钮。

视觉风格：写实的 UI 截图，日语聊天应用美学，极简且现代，深色主题，圆角，石墨色消息气泡，浅灰色文字，整洁的间距。角色艺术预览应呈现出高质量的动漫照片转换效果，而非扁平的卡通画。

约束条件：顶部使用 3 张肖像缩略图，生成 1 张预览图，预览图中包含 3 位动漫风格女性，共 4 个聊天气泡，以及 1 个向下箭头按钮。请勿添加任何应用图标、水印、额外按钮、额外文字或额外人物。

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张柔和、照片级写实的生活方式肖像，场景设定在清晨阳光明媚的极简主义客厅中。一位留着长波浪卷发（发色：{argument name="hair color" default="玫瑰粉"}）的年轻女性侧身坐在米色沙发上，微微转向镜头，隐约流露出温柔甜美的微笑。她的面部被一个位于正中央的灰褐色肤色方形隐私遮挡块刻意遮盖，无法辨认任何面部特征。她穿着两件清晰可见的服饰：一件从单肩滑落的超大号白色毛绒针织开衫，以及一件淡薄荷绿色的吊带背心或吊带裙。构图为 3:4 竖构图，取景范围从腰部以上至坐姿全身，长发垂落在肩头，捕捉着温暖的逆光。房间内包含 5 个关键背景元素：右侧带有大靠垫的米色沙发、右侧带有木质格栅框架的高大落地窗、左侧的低矮木质咖啡桌、桌上摆放着精致枝条的玻璃花瓶，以及后方带有浅层台阶的素色墙壁。采用日韩公寓的轻盈美学，柔和的自然光，柔和的色调，微妙的电影感写实风格，浅景深，细腻的发丝，舒适的清晨氛围，无文字，无水印，无其他人物。

Canvas: Vertical 3:4 poster, 768×1024 style, cinematic editing and photography, warm dark tones, shallow depth of field, soft window lighting, delicate film grain, high-end SaaS advertising aesthetics. Key visual: A realistic office scene in a modern café or studio. On the right, a Japanese adult male wearing a dark knit sweater sits at a wooden table, leaning forward, one hand supporting his chin; his face is covered by a minimalist, opaque, warm brown rectangular privacy mask. Messy black hair is visible above the mask. In the left foreground, an open laptop displays a dark terminal window, showing command-line output, checkmarks, generated files, and project completion information similar to Claude Code. On the table are a ceramic coffee mug, a notebook with a pen, and two stacked programming books; one of the books has "Clean Code" written on its spine. The background features blurred plants and interior glass, using soft green and brown tones. Top Title Area: An elegant, large Japanese serif font is placed in the upper left corner, displaying the text "考える力を、コードに変える。" (Transforming the power of thought into code.) The generous line spacing gives it a sophisticated magazine-like feel. Below this is a smaller subtitle: "Claude Codeと、AI時代の開発をスマートに。" (Making AI-era development smarter with Claude Code.) This is followed by a brief Japanese body text explaining that Claude Code understands thought and supports design, implementation, and improvement as an AI coding partner. Function Panel: A semi-transparent, frosted glass-like card with a thin white border and a soft blur effect is placed in the lower right corner. The card title is: "開発を加速する、Claude Codeの主な機能" (Accelerating development, the core function of Claude Code.) It contains a 5-line function list, each with a simple outline icon on the left and a bold Japanese function label and a smaller Japanese description on the right. The 5 lines are: 1) Bubble icon, "Natural Language Encoding Support"; 2) Gear icon, "Understanding the entire project"; 3) Pencil icon, "One-click Refactoring"; 4) Document icon, "Automatically generating tests and documentation"; 5) Terminal window icon, "Seamless Integration via CLI". The card ends with "あなたの開発体験を、よりスマートに、より创造的に." (Make your development experience smarter and more creative.) Data Metrics: In the lower left corner, two prominent white serif font numbers are displayed: the first metric label, "開発時間" (Development Time), shows a value of "Maximum 55% Reduction," accompanied by a small footnote; the second metric label, "バグの早発見率" (Early Bug Discovery Rate), shows a value of "2.3x Up*." Footer: A full-width, dark, semi-transparent footer is added to the bottom. The text on the left reads: "Claude Code Insight," followed by a separator and "ハウツー" (Houtsu). The text on the right reads: "AI Coding no Real-World Knowledge and Tips for Nowaha wo Hatsune" (Publishing practical knowledge and tips for AI coding). Visual style: A sophisticated Japanese tech magazine advertisement, photorealistic yet with elegant typographic overlays, creamy white font, thin lines, restrained contrast, warm shadows, and no bright neon colors. Constraints: Keep the text rich yet clean and legible. Use only 1 person, 1 laptop, 1 coffee cup, 1 notebook, 1 pen, 2 stacked books, 1 function card, 5 lines of function lists, and 2 data indicator blocks. Do not add any logos except for the product name. Strictly retain the specified Japanese text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="product name" default="Claude Code"} 创建一张高级的竖版日本营销海报，推广 AI 编码自动化与更智能的开发体验。

画布：竖版 3:4 海报，768×1024 风格，电影级编辑摄影，暖色调暗色系，浅景深，柔和的窗光，细腻的胶片颗粒感，高端 SaaS 广告美学。

主视觉：现代咖啡馆或工作室中真实的办公场景。右侧，一名穿着深色针织衫的日本成年男性坐在木桌前，身体前倾，一只手托着下巴；他的脸部被一个简约的不透明暖棕色矩形隐私遮挡块覆盖。遮挡块上方可见凌乱的黑发。左侧前景中，一台打开的笔记本电脑显示着深色终端窗口，呈现出类似 Claude Code 的命令行输出、勾选标记、生成的文件以及项目完成信息。桌上放置一个陶瓷咖啡杯、一本带有笔的笔记本以及两本叠放的编程书籍；其中一本书的书脊上写着“Clean Code”。背景为模糊的植物和室内玻璃，采用柔和的绿色和棕色调。

顶部标题区：左上方放置优雅的大号日文衬线字体，内容为「考える力を、コードに変える。」（将思考之力，转化为代码。），行间距宽裕，具有精致的杂志广告感。下方添加较小的副标题：「Claude Codeと、AI時代の開発をスマートに。」（与 Claude Code 一起，让 AI 时代的开发更智能。）。随后添加一段简短的日文正文，说明 Claude Code 能够理解思考，并作为 AI 编码伙伴支持设计、实现和改进。

功能面板：在右下侧放置一张半透明的磨砂玻璃质感卡片，带有细白边框和柔和模糊效果。卡片标题：「開発を加速する、Claude Codeの主な機能」（加速开发，Claude Code 的核心功能）。包含 5 行功能列表，每行左侧配有一个简单的轮廓图标，右侧为加粗的日文功能标签和较小的日文描述。5 行内容为：1) 气泡图标，「自然言語でのコーディング支援」（自然语言编码支持）；2) 齿轮图标，「プロジェクト全体を理解」（理解整个项目）；3) 铅笔图标，「リファクタリングもワンクリック」（一键重构）；4) 文档图标，「テスト・ドキュメントも自動生成」（自动生成测试与文档）；5) 终端窗口图标，「CLIでシームレスに統合」（通过 CLI 无缝集成）。卡片底部以「あなたの開発体験を、よりスマートに、より創造的に。」（让你的开发体验更智能、更具创造力。）结尾。

数据指标：在左下角区域，展示 2 个醒目的白色衬线字体数字证明点：第一个指标标签「開発時間」（开发时间），数值为「最大 55% 削減」（最高缩减 55%），并附带微小脚注；第二个指标标签「バグの早期発見率」（Bug 早期发现率），数值为「2.3倍 向上*」（提升 2.3 倍*）。

页脚：底部添加一个全宽的深色半透明页脚栏。左侧文字：「Claude Code Insight」后接分隔符及「ハウツー」（操作指南）。右侧文字：「AIコーディングの実践知とノウハウを発信中 ▶」（发布 AI 编码的实践知识与诀窍 ▶）。

视觉风格：精致的日本科技杂志广告，照片级真实感但带有精美的排版叠加层，奶油白字体，细线条，克制的对比度，温暖的阴影，无明亮的霓虹色。

约束条件：保持构图文字丰富但整洁易读。仅使用 1 个人物、1 台笔记本电脑、1 个咖啡杯、1 本笔记本、1 支笔、2 本叠放的书籍、1 张功能卡片、5 行功能列表和 2 个数据指标块。除产品名称外，不要添加任何 Logo。严格保留指定的日文文本。

templates.title: Anime Winter Fashion Series

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫冬季时尚系列

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a simple anime fashion series showcasing a tall, slender young woman wearing five completely different winter streetwear outfits, standing side-by-side against a pure white background. The character possesses {argument name="hair color" default="Long orange hair"} The character has fair skin, a slender model figure, and a soft, blurred face with no specific facial features. Using exquisite Japanese anime illustration lines, the artist showcases highly detailed clothing folds, layered fabrics, and realistic accessories, presenting a beautifully designed character illustration style. Canvas: 4:3 horizontal composition, the entire figure is visible from head to toe, evenly distributed within the width of the canvas, with no background props, text, logos, or watermarks. Main details: The same character appears 5 times, maintaining consistent height, body proportions, and hair color, but each pose and hairstyle is slightly different. Please draw and present 5 specific clothing variations: 1. Left side clothing: Long orange hair tied in a loose side ponytail, a light gray short bomber jacket over a dark navy blue ribbed turtleneck sweater, dark high-waisted cargo pants with a belt and straps, thick-soled gray sneakers, a small gray crossbody bag, one hand near the collar, a casual and confident pose. 2. Second Outfit: Orange hair loosely braided into a side braid, off-white oversized cable-knit one-shoulder sweater layered over a light blue-grey turtleneck, charcoal gray wide-leg cropped trousers with a draped belt, black ankle boots with cream-colored fur cuffs—an elegant and casual winter look. 3. Central Outfit: High orange ponytail flowing to one side, bright cobalt blue short down cape/jacket layered over a fluorescent yellow fitted long-sleeved top, high-waisted dark plum wide-leg culottes or cropped trousers, black leggings, navy blue and white patterned socks, platform white sneakers, a furry white crossbody bag, a playful gait with one leg raised. 4. Fourth Outfit: Long, straight orange hair, black layered avant-garde jacket layered over a quilted black vest and black shirt, a white turtleneck, a long asymmetrical pleated black skirt, grey tights, black platform lace-up shoes, a small black handbag, a composed and dignified posture—a gothic minimalist style. 5. Right-side outfit: Orange hair styled in small double buns with long, wispy strands; light blue-green turtleneck sweater; white and light gray functional hooded jacket (with pockets); gray belted shorts or skirt paired with black leggings; mint green leg warmers; white platform sneakers; gray small functional bag; one leg bent upwards, a lively pose. Visual style: High-resolution anime concept art, clean and crisp outlines, subtle watercolor-like shadows, fashionable Japanese idol/streetwear design, detailed textile textures such as knitwear, down nylon, quilting, pleats, straps, belts, bags, socks, and sneakers. The color scheme maintains a wintery feel, accented with navy blue, cream, cobalt blue, fluorescent yellow, black, gray, mint green, and plum. Constraints: Must be 5 full-body images, all of the same character, no additional characters, no descriptive text, no background scene, feet must not be cropped, no visible facial details, not photorealistic style, not chibi proportions.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一份简洁的动漫时尚系列图，展示一名身材高挑纤细的年轻女性，身穿 5 种完全不同的冬季街头服饰，在纯白背景下并排站立。角色拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="长橘色头发"}、白皙皮肤、纤细的模特身材，面部柔和模糊，无具体五官细节。采用精致的日本动漫插画线条，展现高细节的衣物褶皱、叠穿面料、写实配饰，呈现出精美的角色设计图风格。

画布：横向 4:3 构图，全身形象从头到脚可见，在画面宽度内均匀分布，无背景道具，无文字，无 Logo，无水印。

主体细节：同一角色出现 5 次，保持身高、身体比例和发色一致，但每个姿势和发型略有不同。请绘制并呈现 5 种具体的服饰变体：

1. 左侧服饰：长橘色头发扎成松散的侧马尾，浅灰色短款飞行员夹克内搭深海军蓝罗纹高领毛衣，深色高腰工装裤配有腰带和绑带，厚底灰色运动鞋，灰色小号斜挎包，一只手靠近领口，姿态休闲自信。

2. 第二套服饰：橘色头发编成松散的侧辫，米白色大廓形麻花针织单肩毛衣内搭浅蓝灰色高领衫，炭灰色阔腿七分裤配有垂坠腰带，黑色踝靴配奶油色毛绒袖口，优雅休闲的冬季造型。

3. 中央服饰：高橘色马尾向一侧飘动，亮钴蓝色短款羽绒斗篷/夹克内搭荧光黄修身长袖上衣，高腰深李子色阔腿裙裤或七分裤，黑色打底裤，海军蓝白相间图案袜，厚底白色运动鞋，毛绒白色斜挎包，俏皮的迈步姿势，一只脚抬起。

4. 第四套服饰：长直橘色头发，黑色叠穿先锋派外套，内搭绗缝黑色马甲和黑色衬衫，白色高领内搭，长款不对称褶皱黑裙，灰色连裤袜，黑色厚底系带鞋，手提黑色小包，姿态沉稳端庄，哥特极简风格。

5. 右侧服饰：橘色头发扎成小双丸子头，留有长碎发，浅蓝绿色高领毛衣，白色与浅灰色机能连帽夹克（带口袋），灰色系带短裤或短裙搭配黑色打底裤，薄荷绿腿套，白色厚底运动鞋，灰色小号机能包，一只腿向上弯曲，姿态活泼。

视觉风格：高分辨率动漫概念艺术，清晰利落的轮廓线，微妙的水彩感阴影，时尚的日本偶像/街头服饰设计，细致的纺织品纹理，如针织、羽绒尼龙、绗缝、褶皱、绑带、腰带、包袋、袜子和运动鞋。色调保持冬季感，点缀海军蓝、奶油色、钴蓝色、荧光黄、黑色、灰色、薄荷绿和李子色。

约束条件：必须是 5 个全身形象，均为同一角色，无额外人物，无说明文字，无背景场景，脚部不得被裁切，无可见的面部细节，非照片写实风格，非 Q 版比例。

templates.title: Gothic Lolita Cathedral Fashion

titleLocalized.zh: 哥特萝莉大教堂时尚

templates.prompt: Create a full-body anime-style fashion illustration, the protagonist being a {argument name="character name" default="Momoka"} A young woman stood confidently in the center of the magnificent Gothic cathedral's aisle. She had long, flowing hair.{argument name="hair color" default="Soft pink"} She wears twin ponytails with curled ends, adorned with black ribbon bows, and a small, tilted black top hat decorated with pink roses. Her face is deliberately obscured by soft, square blurs/skin-toned blouses, while the rest of the image is highly detailed. She is dressed in an exquisite dark Gothic Lolita outfit: a black and charcoal gray ruffled mini-skirt with a shorter front and longer back, layered ruffles, and a hem embroidered with pink roses; a black, shiny corset with multiple belts and silver buckles; a black choker adorned with pink roses; lace sleeves; ruffled wristbands; fishnet stockings; black thigh-high suspenders with buckles; and thick-soled black boots with pink soles and pink crisscross laces. A dramatic low-angle perspective makes the character appear tall and powerful, with the composition centered from the boots to the hair. The background is the dimly lit interior of a cathedral, featuring soaring ribbed vaults. To the right are tall stained-glass windows, dark wood paneling, candlesticks, and reflections of polished stone floors. To the left, a small vase of pink roses sits on a side table. The lighting should be cinematic and emotional, with pale beams of sunlight streaming through the windows, deep shadows in the vaulted ceiling, glossy highlights on leather and clasps, and a subtle red glow in the background. Overall atmosphere:{argument name="mood" default="Romantic Dark Gothic Elegance"} It features exquisite, high-detail anime-style rendering, presenting realistic fabric textures, intricate lace, and clear accessories, with no visible text or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张全身动漫风格的时尚插画，主角是一位名为 {argument name="character name" default="Momoka"} 的年轻女性，她自信地站在宏伟的哥特式大教堂走廊中央。她留着长而蓬松的 {argument name="hair color" default="柔粉色"} 双马尾，发梢卷曲，配有黑色丝带蝴蝶结，并戴着一顶装饰有粉色玫瑰的小巧倾斜黑色礼帽。她的面部特意用柔和的方形模糊/肤色遮挡块隐藏，而图像的其余部分则高度精细。为她穿上一套精致的深色哥特萝莉装：一件黑色与炭灰色相间的荷叶边迷你裙，采用前短后长的裙摆设计，层叠的褶边，下摆饰有粉色玫瑰刺绣，黑色亮面紧身胸衣配有多条腰带和银色搭扣，黑色颈圈饰有粉色玫瑰，蕾丝袖子，荷叶边腕饰，渔网袜，带有搭扣的黑色大腿吊带，以及带有粉色鞋底和粉色交叉鞋带的厚底黑色靴子。采用戏剧性的低角度视角，使角色看起来高大且充满力量，构图从靴子到头发居中。背景是昏暗的大教堂内部，有着高耸的肋架拱顶，右侧是高大的彩色玻璃窗，深色木质墙板，烛台，抛光石地板的倒影，左侧边桌上放着一小瓶粉色玫瑰。灯光应具有电影感和情绪化，窗户射入苍白的日光光束，拱形天花板处有深邃的阴影，皮革和搭扣上有光泽的高光，背景深处有淡淡的红光。整体氛围：{argument name="mood" default="浪漫的暗黑哥特优雅"}。以精致的高细节动漫艺术渲染，呈现逼真的织物纹理、复杂的蕾丝、清晰的配饰，且无可见文字或水印。

templates.title: cinematic close-up of anime girl

titleLocalized.zh: 电影感动漫少女特写

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic close-up illustration of anime, in which {argument name="character name" default="A shy female student"} She's leaning very close to the viewer, as if peeking out from beside the bed, employing an extreme wide-angle perspective and shallow depth of field. She has long, straight hair.{argument name="hair color" default="Black hair"} Her messy bangs hung down her face, and were very large and shiny.{argument name="eye color" default="Golden brown eyes"} Her mouth was slightly open in surprise, her cheeks flushed, and her expression was curious and innocent. She wore a Japanese school uniform: a white short-sleeved shirt, a light yellow knitted vest with thin red trim, and a subtly visible green pleated skirt, with a large light blue bow tied at the neckline. The camera angle was low and intimate, her face occupying the right half of the frame, strands of hair brushing against the lens, and her shoulders and torso appearing shortened by perspective. Background:{argument name="time of day" default="dusk"} The room is a cozy, dimly lit girl's bedroom with a dark wood ceiling and walls. To the left is a window with purple curtains, offering views of the twilight sky. In the foreground is a bed with blurred bedding, a cat-shaped plush pillow on the left, and a desk area on the right with books, a pink desk and chair, and a small wall sticker. The image is rendered with exquisite modern anime cinematic detail, featuring richly detailed eyes with bright white highlights, clean lines, soft painterly shadows, warm dark areas, and slight vignetting. It boasts a cinematic 16:9 aspect ratio, high detail, and is free of text and watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影感的动漫特写插画，画面中 {argument name="character name" default="一位害羞的女学生"} 正非常靠近地探向观众，仿佛从床边探出头来，采用极端的广角透视和浅景深效果。她留着长直的 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色头发"}，凌乱的刘海垂在脸上，有着非常大且有光泽的 {argument name="eye color" default="金棕色眼睛"}，小嘴微张显得有些惊讶，脸颊微红，表情好奇而天真。她身穿日本校服：白色短袖衬衫、浅黄色针织背心配红色细边、隐约可见的绿色百褶裙，领口系着一个大大的青色蝴蝶结。摄像机视角低且亲密，她的脸占据了画面的右半部分，发丝掠过镜头，肩膀和躯干呈现出透视缩短效果。背景：{argument name="time of day" default="黄昏"} 时分舒适的少女卧室，室内光线温暖昏暗，深色木质天花板和墙壁，左侧有一扇挂着紫色窗帘的窗户，窗外是暮色天空，前景是一张铺着模糊床品的床，床上左侧有一个猫形毛绒枕头，右侧是书桌区域，摆放着书籍、一把粉色书桌椅和一张小墙贴。采用精致的现代动漫电影渲染，细节丰富的眼睛带有明亮的白色高光，线条干净利落，柔和的绘画式阴影，温暖的暗部，轻微的暗角，电影级 16:9 构图，高细节，无文字，无水印。

templates.title: Four-panel commemorative gray sweater selfie collage

titleLocalized.zh: 四格舒适灰色毛衣自拍拼图

templates.prompt: Create a realistic 2x2 four-panel puzzle to show the same person who owns{argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown long hair"} Four soft, indoor self-portraits of a young woman sitting on a bed or sofa in a cozy, minimalist bedroom. She wears a grey cable-knit oversized sweater that slips slightly off one shoulder, paired with a grey pleated skirt or flowing mini-skirt, revealing her legs and showcasing a refined femininity. In each frame, her face is partially obscured by a soft, square blur, while maintaining clarity and naturalness in her pose, hairstyle, clothing, and the room itself. Subtle decorative elements include warm beige walls, white bedding, light-colored sofa cushions, sheer curtains, and a vase with white flowers in the background. These four frames should accurately depict four different selfie compositions: Top left, arm extending towards the camera, sweater sleeves dominating the foreground, one hand near the face; Top right, sitting with knees raised, one hand near the chin, sweater slipping from one shoulder; Bottom left, sitting sideways on the bed, one leg bent, hand partially obscuring the face, white curtains and flowers behind; Bottom right, a wider selfie perspective, extended sleeves in the foreground, skirt draped over the knees, one hand touching hair, legs tilted to the side. Maintain a soft color palette of gray, cream, beige, and light brown, using natural window lighting, shallow depth of field, the realism of a smartphone selfie, soft shadows, and no text or watermarks in the images.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个逼真的 2x2 四格拼图，展示同一位拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色长发"} 的年轻女性在温馨简约的卧室里，坐在床或沙发上的四张柔和室内自拍风格肖像。她穿着一件稍微滑落至一侧肩头的灰色麻花针织大码毛衣，搭配灰色百褶裙或飘逸短裙，露出双腿，展现出精致的女性风格。在每一格画面中，她的面部都应通过柔和的方形模糊处理进行遮挡，同时保持姿势、发型、服装和房间的清晰与自然。使用暖米色墙壁、白色床品、浅色沙发靠垫、透光窗帘以及背景中放有白色花朵的花瓶等细微装饰。这四格画面应准确呈现 4 种不同的自拍构图：左上角，手臂向相机方向延伸，毛衣袖子占据前景，她的一只手靠近脸部；右上角，双膝抬起坐着，一只手靠近下巴，毛衣从一侧肩头滑落；左下角，侧身坐在床上，一条腿弯曲，手遮挡住部分模糊的面部，身后是白色窗帘和花朵；右下角，较宽的自拍视角，前景中有延伸的袖子，裙子铺在膝盖上，一只手触碰头发，双腿向侧面倾斜。保持色调为柔和的灰色、奶油色、米色和浅棕色，采用自然窗光、浅景深、智能手机自拍的真实感、柔和的阴影，且画面中不含任何文字或水印。

templates.title: Retro Hot Spring Membership Card

titleLocalized.zh: 复古温泉会员卡

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="character name" default="tabo"} Design a whimsical Japanese-style hot spring membership card profile picture, using a retro printed certificate style and featuring adorable animal illustrations. Canvas: Landscape membership card, widescreen 16:9 aspect ratio, background of warm, aged cream-colored paper with subtle grain, stains, and slightly worn edges. Use double-lined gold trim, cropped decorative corners, and soft gold small Japanese cloud patterns. Layout: The top title uses a Western retro serif font to write "ONSEN MEMBER CARD" in dark brown with gold shading and engraved texture. Place a small red hot spring steam icon above or centered above the words. Add the Japanese phrase "Hot Spring Membership Card" below the title, flanked by symmetrical gold patterns. The main illustration fills the central area: a smiling capybara bathing in an orange-red hot spring, a folded white towel on its head, cheeks slightly flushed, one eye closed happily. The background features a rocky volcanic hot spring landscape, wisps of steam, and two volcanoes: a smaller, smoking volcano on the left and a larger, erupting volcano with orange lava on the right. In the bathwater, a small capybara head is added to the background in the center left. The water surface is rendered with swirling orange and red crayon strokes. Visible labeling elements include five main text/marking areas: a large English title “ONSEN MEMBER CARD”; a Japanese subtitle “热泉会员证” (Hot Spring Membership Certificate); a vertical red plaque on the left with the white Japanese characters “极楽汤めぐり” (Gyokurakuyu Meguri); a circular red stamp in the lower right corner with the Japanese characters “入浴済” (Iruyuji) and a small steam icon; the bottom information bar is divided into two square areas. The lower left square displays a small label “お名前” (Oname-mae) and the handwritten Japanese name.{argument name="display name" default="たぼ"} The bottom right corner displays a small label "Member Number" and a member ID.{argument name="membership number" default="26-0410-2680-26"} Visual Style: Hand-drawn colored pencil and crayon textures, a nostalgic Showa-era Japanese travel document aesthetic, with a color palette of warm browns, reds, oranges, creams, and soft golds. Lines retain a slightly imperfect and tactile feel, as if printed on thick washi paper. Small gold and red plum blossom decorative icons are added near the bottom corner. Constraints: Maintain readability as a card; avoid photorealistic designs; do not use modern UI elements; do not add extra logos; and do not include any text other than the designated 5 text/marker areas.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="tabo"} 设计一张充满奇趣的日式温泉会员卡个人资料图，采用复古印刷证书风格，并配有可爱的动物插画。

画布：横向会员卡，宽屏 16:9 比例，背景为温暖的陈旧奶油色纸张，带有细微的颗粒感、污渍和略显磨损的边缘。使用双线装饰金边，配以裁剪式的装饰角，以及柔和金色的小型日式云纹。

布局：顶部大标题使用西方复古衬线字体书写“ONSEN MEMBER CARD”，深棕色配金色阴影和雕刻纹理。在单词上方或中间居中放置一个红色的小型温泉蒸汽图标。标题下方添加日文“温泉会員証”，两侧配有对称的金色花纹。主体插画填充中间区域：一只微笑着的水豚正在橙红色的温泉中泡澡，头上顶着一条折叠的白毛巾，脸颊微红，一只眼睛幸福地闭着。背景是岩石嶙峋的火山温泉景观、缕缕蒸汽以及两座火山：左侧是一座较小的冒烟火山，右侧是一座较大的喷发火山，带有橙色熔岩。在浴池水中，左中背景处加入一个小型水豚头部。水面呈现为漩涡状的橙色和红色蜡笔笔触。

可见标注元素：包含 5 个主要的文字/标记区域：1 个大型英文标题“ONSEN MEMBER CARD”；1 个日文副标题“温泉会員証”；左侧一个垂直的红色牌匾，上面有白色日文“極楽湯めぐり”；右下角一个圆形红色印章，上面有日文“入浴済”和一个小型蒸汽图标；底部信息条分为两个方框区域。左下角方框显示小标签“お名前”和手写体日文名字 {argument name="display name" default="たぼ"}。右下角方框显示小标签“会員番号”和会员编号 {argument name="membership number" default="26-0410-2680-26"}。

视觉风格：手绘彩色铅笔和蜡笔质感，怀旧的昭和时代日本旅行票据美学，色调为暖棕色、红色、橙色、奶油色和柔和的金色。线条保持略微的不完美和触感，如同印在厚实的和纸上。在下角附近添加金色和红色的小型梅花装饰图标。

约束：保持设计作为一张卡片的可读性，拒绝照片级真实感，不使用现代 UI 元素，不添加额外标志，除指定的 5 个文字/标记区域外，不得包含任何其他文字。

templates.title: Anime characters in real-life rooftop scenes

titleLocalized.zh: 现实屋顶场景中的动漫角色

templates.prompt: Using the provided reference image as a base, place the same anime character in a realistic outdoor rooftop or parking lot scene. Maintain the character's pose, clothing, hairstyle, accessories, colors, and cel animation rendering effects, while seamlessly integrating them into the realistic scene with realistic sunlight, perspective, and atmospheric lighting. Add a realistic hand reaching out towards the character in the lower left foreground, with a slight motion blur and out-of-focus effect, as if someone is about to touch or stop her. The hand should clearly overlap in front of the character without altering the character's design. Background: Replace the solid color background with a realistic concrete roof surface, railings, a distant city skyline, and a blue sky with scattered clouds. Use a shallow depth of field effect to blur the foreground hand and softly blur the distant buildings, while ensuring the anime character remains the clear subject. Style Constraints: Preserve the appearance of the 2D anime character against a live-action photographic background to create a convincing composite image of anime and realistic photography. Do not redesign the character, add additional characters, or add any text or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh:
以提供的参考图作为角色基础，将同一个动漫角色置于写实风格的户外屋顶或停车场场景中。保持角色的姿势、服装、发型、配饰、颜色和赛璐珞动漫渲染效果不变，同时将其自然地融入具有真实日光、透视和大气光影的现实场景中。

在前景左下方添加一只真实的真人手部，向角色伸出，带有轻微的动态模糊和失焦效果，仿佛有人正要触碰或阻止她。手部应在角色前方明显重叠，且不改变角色本身的设计。

背景：将纯色背景替换为写实的混凝土屋顶表面、栏杆、远处的城市天际线以及带有零星云朵的蓝天。使用浅景深效果，使前景的手部模糊，远处的建筑柔和虚化，同时确保动漫角色保持清晰的主体地位。

风格限制：在真人摄影背景下保留 2D 动漫角色的外观，创作出令人信服的动漫与写实照片合成图像。请勿重新设计角色，请勿添加额外角色，也请勿添加任何文字或水印。

templates.title: Anime characters set in real Tokyo streets

titleLocalized.zh: 置身于真实东京街头的动漫角色

templates.prompt: Based on REFERENCE_0, the anime illustration with a transparent background was transformed into a composite image of an "anime character placed in the real world." Objective: To retain the character design of the blue angel-style streetwear, and redraw her as a full-body anime girl facing the camera, sitting on the ground of a busy real city street, as if she had descended into the real world. Poses and Character Adjustments: The side profile was changed to a sitting pose, facing the camera, with one knee raised and the other folded outwards. Oversized blue and white platform boots, visible legs, a long ribbon extending to the side, and a small white plush accessory next to the raised knee were added. A thin white halo was added above her head, while retaining the overall angel blue theme of the reference image. New Environment: She was placed in a setting similar to {argument name="city location" default="Shibuya, Tokyo"} This is a realistic depiction of a Japanese urban commercial district, shot from a low-angle street perspective with sunlight shining through the brick pavement in the background. It includes tall glass buildings, shop signs, billboards, and a clearly visible sign that reads {argument name="store sign text" default="TSUTAYA"} Large store signs. Utilizing realistic sunlight, lens depth of field, and street lighting. Real-world interaction: Perfectly positioned to surround anime characters.{argument name="number of pedestrians" default="10"} A loose circle of realistic pedestrians. Some pedestrians should be holding smartphones, appearing to be taking pictures or looking at her. To protect privacy, the pedestrians' faces should be blurred or obscured, but their bodies, clothing, phones, and shadows should maintain realism. Style: The characters maintain a clean 2D anime style with clean lines and cel-shaded shadows, while the background and pedestrians are realistic. Match the direction of light, shadows, and ground contact to give the anime characters a physical presence in a realistic scene.{argument name="aspect ratio" default="3:4"} The composition is vertical, with the character centered and slightly lower. Constraints: Do not redraw her as a realistic figure; the anime look must be preserved. Do not add titles, watermarks, or UI elements. Ensure the composite effect is realistic, with accurate proportions, contact shadows, and perspective of the crowd.

promptLocalized.zh:
以 REFERENCE_0 为角色基础，将透明背景的动漫插画转化为“动漫角色置身现实世界”的合成图像。

目标：保留蓝色天使风街头服饰的角色设计，将其重绘为全身正面朝向镜头的动漫少女，坐在繁忙的真实城市街道地面上，仿佛她降临到了现实世界。

姿态与角色调整：将侧面半身像改为坐在地上的姿态，面向镜头，一条腿膝盖抬起，另一条腿向外折叠。增加超大号蓝白相间的厚底靴、可见的双腿、向侧面延伸的长丝带，并在抬起的膝盖旁增加一个白色小毛绒配饰。在头顶上方添加一个细细的白色光环，同时保留参考图中整体的天使蓝主题。

新环境：将她置于类似于 {argument name="city location" default="东京涩谷"} 的写实日本城市商业区，采用低角度街拍视角，背景为阳光照射下的砖块路面。包含高大的玻璃建筑、店面招牌、广告牌，以及一个清晰可见的写有 {argument name="store sign text" default="TSUTAYA"} 的大型商店招牌。使用真实的日光、镜头景深和街拍光影。

现实互动：在动漫角色周围环绕正好 {argument name="number of pedestrians" default="10"} 名写实的真实行人，形成一个松散的圆圈。部分行人应手持智能手机，看起来正在拍摄或注视着她。为保护隐私，行人的面部应模糊或遮挡，但他们的身体、服装、手机和阴影需保持真实感。

风格：角色保持清晰的 2D 动漫风格，具有干净的线条和赛璐珞阴影，而背景和行人则为写实风格。匹配光照方向、阴影和地面接触感，使动漫角色在真实场景中具有物理存在感。使用 {argument name="aspect ratio" default="3:4"} 的竖构图，角色居中且位置略偏下。

约束：不要将她重绘为写实人物；必须保留动漫外观。不要添加标题、水印或 UI。确保合成效果逼真，具备真实的比例、接触阴影和人群透视关系。

templates.title: Steampunk Trio Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 蒸汽朋克三人肖像

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed, vertical, anime-style steampunk group portrait depicting three figures seated on a dilapidated wooden bench in a densely packed, retro-futuristic urban alleyway. The trio consists of a man on the left, a woman in the middle, and a man on the right, all facing forward with deliberately blurred, featureless faces. The figure on the left is a slender young man wearing a black wide-brimmed hat, a dark pinstripe three-piece suit, a white shirt, a narrow black tie, small lapel pins and medals, revealing tattooed hands, and wearing cropped socks and brown lace-up boots. The figure in the middle is a petite young woman with {argument name="hair color" default="Short platinum gold bob haircut"} The character on the right is a slender young man in a navy blue tailored suit jacket, cream-colored vest, white shirt, and red patterned bow tie adorned with pins and brass buttons. A small red mechanical bird or toy perches in his hair. He wears a short skirt, cream-colored over-the-knee socks with intricate mechanical patterns, red ankle straps, and shiny black platform Mary Jane shoes. His hands are neatly placed on his knees. The character on the right is also a slender young man in a navy blue tailored suit jacket, cream-colored vest, white shirt, and patterned tie, adorned with numerous pins and medals. He wears cropped trousers, cream-colored socks, and dark brown leather shoes, and sits with his hands folded. The background should be filled with numerous retro mechanical details: large clocks, turbine-shaped round vents, instruments, pipes, gears, metal boxes, signs, wires, dials, old advertisements, and layered industrial panels, creating a cluttered and fantastical steampunk market exterior. Soft cinematic tones of oxidized cyan, rust red, brass, charcoal gray, cream, and weathered brown should be used. The lighting is soft, overcast daylight, featuring sharp illustration details, intricate lines, realistic fabric textures, antique metallic sheen, symmetrical central composition, full-body views from head to toe, cobblestone floors, no modern objects, no visible real-world brands, and no extra characters. The overall atmosphere is quirky, stylish, mysterious, and nostalgic, like…{argument name="style influence" default="Exquisite Japanese AI illustrations that blend Victorian steampunk with retro street fashion"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张细节高度丰富的竖版动漫风格蒸汽朋克群像，描绘 3 位坐在密集复古未来主义城市小巷中破旧木长椅上的角色。这三人组包括左侧 1 位男性、中间 1 位女性和右侧 1 位男性，他们都面向前方，面部刻意处理为模糊且无五官。左侧角色是一位身材苗条的年轻人，戴着黑色宽檐帽，身穿深色细条纹三件套西装、白衬衫、窄版黑领带，佩戴小型翻领别针和勋章，露出有纹身的手部，穿着九分袜和棕色系带靴。中间角色是一位娇小的年轻女性，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="短款铂金色波波头"}，身穿深色华丽的双排扣校服风格外套、白衬衫、红色花纹领结，装饰有别针和黄铜纽扣，发间栖息着一只红色小机械鸟或玩具，穿着短裙、带有复杂机械图案的奶油色过膝袜、红色脚踝绑带以及亮面黑色厚底玛丽珍鞋；双手整齐地放在膝盖上。右侧角色是一位身材苗条的年轻人，身穿海军蓝定制西装外套、奶油色马甲、白衬衫、花纹领带，佩戴许多别针和勋章，穿着九分裤、奶油色袜子和深棕色皮鞋，双手交叠而坐。背景应塞满无数复古机械细节：大型时钟、涡轮状圆形通风口、仪表、管道、齿轮、金属盒、标志、电线、刻度盘、旧广告和层叠的工业面板，营造出杂乱而奇幻的蒸汽朋克市场外墙。使用氧化青色、铁锈红、黄铜色、炭灰色、奶油色和风化棕色的柔和电影色调。光线为柔和的阴天日光，具备锐利的插画细节、复杂的线条、逼真的织物纹理、古董金属光泽、对称的中心构图、从头到鞋的全身视图、鹅卵石地面，无现代物品，无可见的现实品牌，无额外角色。整体氛围：古怪、时尚、神秘且怀旧，如同 {argument name="style influence" default="融合了维多利亚蒸汽朋克与复古街头时尚的精致日本 AI 插画"}。

templates.title: Nordic skincare brand marketing project

titleLocalized.zh: 北欧护肤品牌营销项目

templates.prompt: Objective: To achieve a goal called{argument name="brand name" default="FJÄLL"} The minimalist Nordic skincare brand created a comprehensive brand identity and advertising creative overview, showcasing its complete marketing system against a clean white studio backdrop. Canvas: A horizontal 16:9 aspect ratio with ample negative space, using a soft, warm beige-white background with a centered composition. Soft Scandinavian tones were used: stone gray, cream, beige, sage green, charcoal blue-gray, and natural skin tones. Soft, diffused lighting created a high-end editorial style. Layout: Eleven independent sections were precisely arranged within a sophisticated grid. The top row contained three major brand assets: 1) A minimalist circular mountain-line logo with the word "FJÄLL" and a small subtitle; 2) An alternative logo with an abstract mountain/stone icon above "FJÄLL" and the tagline "NORDIC SKINCARE"; 3) A square product still life showing a dark gray skincare tube standing upright on a light-colored stone surface, accompanied by rock props. The bottom row contains eight precisely arranged and evenly spaced marketing mockups: 1) A square lifestyle product photo showing two hands holding the tube, next to a cream-colored product information card; 2) A square close-up showing gray mud/mineral cream on stone with tiny "MINERAL TEXTURE" text; 3) A vertical application tutorial section showing the process of applying the cream with fingers, with a simple title; 4) A vertical dew/moisturizing hand care section showing the effect of applying the cream to the back of the hand; 5) A square core ingredient section showing the tube standing between a stone, leaves, and three circular ingredient labels; 6) A vertical social media video interface mockup showing the product in hand, with visible play/interactive UI icons on the side and bottom; 7) A vertical advertising poster showing the product tube, plant twigs, and rock props, with a title near the bottom; 8) A vertical mobile website or landing page mockup with a simple navigation bar, product details section, and application demonstration photos. Main details: The product is a tube labeled {argument name="product label" default="FJÄLL"} The squeeze tube packaging features a matte deep blue-grey finish with a minimalist white typography and a small circular logo, befitting a high-end cosmetic. The skincare texture is rich, mineral-rich, and a light gray-beige. Hands should appear natural, softly lit, and elegant. Props include smooth stones, mineral rocks, small green leaves, neutral linen or plaster surfaces, and subtle shadows. Text: Include the legible brand name "FJÄLL" on the logo and packaging; use the slogan "NORDIC SKINCARE"; marketing/product text is recommended to use {argument name="product name" default="Midnight Solstice"} ,{argument name="benefit phrase" default="Performance in every touch."} Mineral composition, application instructions, dew-like moisturizing properties, and ingredient labeling. Keep the small print body text primarily decorative but logical, neat, and aligned. Visual style: Luxurious skincare art direction, minimalist Swiss editorial layout, soft product photography, ample white space, soft natural tones, understated typography, and a commercial creative portfolio style. Make the entire project look like a beautifully generated preview of advertising materials, rather than a single advertisement. Constraints: Use a total of 11 visible panels, 3 in the top row and 8 in the bottom row. Do not add any additional products besides this tube design. Avoid using bright colors, cluttered elements, heavy shadows, glossy plastic, cartoon styles, or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为一个名为 {argument name="brand name" default="FJÄLL"} 的极简主义北欧护肤品牌创建全面的品牌标识和广告创意概览，在干净的白色摄影棚背景下展示完整的营销系统。

画布：横向 16:9 的展示项目，留有大量负空间，采用柔和的暖米白色背景，构图居中。使用柔和的斯堪的纳维亚色调：石灰色、奶油色、米色、鼠尾草绿、炭蓝灰色以及自然的肤色。光线柔和、漫射，呈现出高端的编辑风格。

布局：在精致的网格中精确排列 11 个独立的板块。顶行包含 3 个较大的品牌资产：1) 一个极简的圆形山脉线条 Logo，带有“FJÄLL”字样及小型副标题；2) 一个备选 Logo，在“FJÄLL”字样上方有一个抽象的山脉/石头图标，并配有“NORDIC SKINCARE”标语；3) 一张方形产品静物照，展示一支深灰色护肤软管直立在浅色石材表面上，配有岩石道具。底行包含 8 个精确排列且间距均匀的营销样机：1) 方形生活方式产品照，展示双手持软管，旁边放置一张奶油色产品信息卡；2) 方形特写，展示石材上的灰色泥浆/矿物霜，并带有微小的“MINERAL TEXTURE”文字；3) 垂直应用教程板块，展示手指涂抹面霜的过程，配有简单的标题；4) 垂直露珠/润肤手部护理板块，展示面霜涂抹在手背上的效果；5) 方形核心成分板块，展示软管矗立在石头、叶片和三个圆形成分标注之间；6) 垂直社交媒体视频界面样机，展示手持产品，侧面和底部带有可见的播放/互动 UI 图标；7) 垂直广告海报，展示产品软管、植物嫩枝、岩石道具，底部附近配有标题文字；8) 纵向移动端网站或落地页样机，带有简洁的导航栏、产品详情区块以及应用展示照片。

主体细节：产品为一支标签为 {argument name="product label" default="FJÄLL"} 的挤压式软管，采用哑光深蓝灰色包装，白色极简排版，带有小型圆形徽标，符合高端化妆品比例。护肤质地浓稠、矿物感强，呈浅灰米色。手部应看起来自然、光线柔和且优雅。道具包括光滑的石头、矿物岩石、小绿叶、中性亚麻或石膏表面，以及浅淡的阴影。

文字内容：在 Logo 和包装上包含可读的品牌文字“FJÄLL”，标语使用“NORDIC SKINCARE”，营销/产品文字建议使用 {argument name="product name" default="Midnight Solstice"}、{argument name="benefit phrase" default="Performance in every touch."}、矿物质地、应用说明、露珠润肤及成分标注。保持小字正文主要为装饰性但需合理、整洁且对齐。

视觉风格：奢华护肤艺术指导，极简瑞士编辑布局，柔和的产品摄影，通透的留白，柔和的自然色调，低调的排版，商业创意作品集风格。使整个项目看起来像是一组精美的生成式广告素材预览，而非单一广告。

约束条件：总共使用 11 个可见板块，顶行 3 个，底行 8 个。除该软管设计外，请勿添加额外产品。避免使用鲜艳色彩、杂乱元素、浓重阴影、光面塑料、卡通风格或水印。

templates.title: Dual-panel AI portrait comparison

titleLocalized.zh: 双面板 AI 人像对比

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a side-by-side comparison image showcasing two AI-generated close-up portraits of the same young East Asian woman, highlighting subtle facial differences between the two versions. Canvas: Wide horizontal 2-panel layout, approximately 1200×525 pixels, with a thin vertical dividing line in the center. No border, no title, no watermark. Layout: Uses two completely equal panels. Left panel: The first portrait, labeled in small white text near the bottom right corner.{argument name="left label" default="1st time"} Right panel: The second portrait, marked in small white text near the bottom right corner.{argument name="right label" default="second time"} Labels should use a clean sans-serif font, white text with a subtle dark shading to ensure readability. Main details: Each panel displays a compactly cropped frontal portrait of the head and face, with the main subject being {argument name="subject" default="A young East Asian woman"} She had long, fluffy hair.{argument name="hair color" default="Black hair"} The portraits should complement the face shape, featuring a smooth forehead, naturally dark eyebrows, almond-shaped dark eyes looking directly at the camera, a small, straight nose, softly closed lips, and a calm, natural expression. The face should occupy most of the space on each panel, cropped close to the top of the forehead and around the chin, with hair extending to the sides. The two portraits should look very similar but not identical: eye shape, cheek fullness, nose bridge, mouth shape, and facial proportions should differ slightly. Visual style: Realistic AI portrait photography, using soft, cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, smooth skin texture, soft warm skin tones, a dark blurred background, and a slightly soft-focus effect. The overall atmosphere should be quiet and serious. The left portrait should remain slightly soft and understated, while the right portrait should be slightly more refined, warmer, and more symmetrical. Constraints: Include 2 portraits and 2 text labels. Do not add additional descriptive text, UI elements, logos, or decorative graphics. Maintain direct facial contrast in the composition, with both faces centered and proportionally similar.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一张并排对比图，展示同一位年轻东亚女性的两张 AI 生成近景人像，强调两代版本之间细微的面部差异。

画布：宽幅水平 2 面板布局，尺寸约为 1200×525 像素，中心处有一条细垂直分割线。无外边框，无标题，无水印。

布局：使用 2 个完全相等的面板。左侧面板：第一张人像，在右下角附近用小号白色文字标注 {argument name="left label" default="1回目"}。右侧面板：第二张人像，在右下角附近用小号白色文字标注 {argument name="right label" default="2回目"}。标签应使用简洁的无衬线字体，白色文字并带有淡淡的深色阴影以确保可读性。

主体细节：每个面板展示一张紧凑裁剪的正面头部和面部肖像，主体为 {argument name="subject" default="一位年轻东亚女性"}。她留着长而蓬松的 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色头发"} 衬托脸型，额头光滑，眉毛自然呈深色，杏仁状的深色眼睛直视镜头，鼻梁小巧笔直，双唇柔和闭合，表情平静自然。面部占据每个面板的大部分空间，裁剪位置靠近额头顶部和下巴周围，头发延伸至两侧。两张人像应看起来非常相似但不完全相同：眼形、脸颊丰满度、鼻梁、嘴型和面部比例应略有不同。

视觉风格：写实 AI 人像摄影，采用柔和的电影级布光、浅景深、光滑的皮肤质感、柔和的暖色调肤色、深色模糊背景以及略带柔焦的效果。整体氛围安静且严肃。左侧人像保持稍显柔和和平淡，右侧人像则稍微更精致、更温暖且更对称。

约束条件：包含 2 张人像和 2 个文本标签。不要添加额外的说明文字、UI 元素、徽标或装饰性图形。保持直接的面部对比构图，两张脸均居中且比例相似。

templates.title: Anime Cafe Two-Image Comparison

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫咖啡馆双图对比

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a vertical comparison image showcasing the creation process of an anime cafe illustration, stacking two wide panels on a dark charcoal gray background. The top panel is a pre-/partially generated view: the left half retains a rough sketch, while the right half presents a refined anime-style cafe scene. The bottom panel is the complete, refined illustration. Canvas: A 4:5 aspect ratio vertical image with a thick dark charcoal gray border around the artwork. Two horizontal rectangular panels are placed inside, vertically aligned and separated by a small gap. Layout: Top panel: Visually divided in the middle. The left side should appear unfinished, resembling a rough smear or masked area: dark black cafe walls, loose brown sketch lines on the wall frames, two rough brown chair/table shapes, a flat gray floor, and large areas of pale sunlight. The right side should be fully rendered: a blonde anime girl leaning towards a towering strawberry sundae on a round table. Bottom panel: The same cafe environment is fully rendered, now including two anime girls sitting opposite each other at the table, with a dessert between them. Main details: The protagonist is {argument name="main character" default="A cheerful blonde anime girl student"} She is shown on the right side of both panels. She has flowing long blonde hair, tied in a messy bun on one side with loose curls, wearing a light blue oversized shirt, a yellow cardigan tied around her waist, and a dark plaid skirt. Her hands are excitedly clasped in front of her chest, and her body leans towards the dessert. In both panels, her face is deliberately obscured by a simple beige square mask; please do not draw facial features inside the square. Secondary characters only appear in the bottom panel:{argument name="second character" default="A pink-haired anime girl with green eyes"} She sits on the left, wearing a navy blue school uniform suit with white trim, a white shirt, and a large red bow. She has double braids, soft pink hair, and a small crescent-shaped hair clip. Her expression is calm and shy. Visible element count: 2 stacked panels in total; 2 completed anime girls in the lower panel; 1 completed anime girl in the upper panel; 2 beige square face-covering blocks, one for the blonde girl on each panel; 2 towering strawberry sundaes, one for each panel; 4 small white plates in total, 1 on the upper panel and 3 on the lower panel; 3 visible cutlery pieces, 1 near the upper plate and 2 on the lower plate; 3 black menu items on the wall of the lower panel, labeled Coffee, Dessert, and Drink; a circular blackboard sign with "Cafe Coffee" written on it behind the blonde girl. Cafe ambiance: The warm, sunlit interior features dark charcoal gray walls, wooden chairs, and small round wooden tables. Large windows let in light from the right, casting soft diagonal sunlight on the floor and tabletops. A blackboard menu is displayed in the background. Desserts are {argument name="dessert" default="A towering strawberry sundae topped with whipped cream, strawberries, wafers, kiwi slices, a layer of brown sugar syrup, and vanilla cream."} The image is placed in a clear glass in the center of the foreground. Visual style: Refined modern Japanese anime illustration, clean lines, a pink-haired girl with bright eyes, soft painterly shadows, warm sunlight, rich details in the hair and desserts, and a cozy café atmosphere. The rough area in the upper left corner should contrast sharply with the finished artwork: blurry, flat, sketch-like, dark, and incomplete. Text content: Use clear and legible English chalkboard font in visible areas: "Coffee," "Dessert," "Drink," and "Cafe Coffee." Other menu items can be small decorative doodles. Constraints: Maintain a double-panel contrast composition. Do not add extra characters, extra desserts, titles, logos, watermarks, or cartoon speech bubbles. Retain the beige shading on the blonde character's face.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一张垂直对比图，展示动漫咖啡馆插画的制作过程，在深炭灰色背景上堆叠两个宽幅面板。上方面板为生成前/部分生成视图：左半部分保留为粗略的草图，右半部分为精致的动漫风格咖啡馆场景。下方面板为完整的精修插画。

画布：4:5 比例的竖向图像，艺术作品周围有厚实的深炭灰色边框。在内部放置 2 个水平矩形面板，上下排列，垂直对齐，中间留有细小间隙。

布局：上方面板：视觉上从中间分割。左侧应看起来未完成，类似于粗略的涂抹或遮罩区域：深黑色咖啡馆墙壁、墙上画框的松散棕色草图线条、两个粗略的棕色椅子/桌子形状、平坦的灰色地板以及大片苍白的阳光。右侧应完全渲染：一位金发动漫少女正倾身靠近圆桌上的一杯高耸草莓圣代。下方面板：相同的咖啡馆环境完全渲染，现在包括 2 位动漫少女坐在桌子对面，甜点位于她们中间。

主体细节：主角为 {argument name="main character" default="一位开朗的金发动漫女学生"}，在两个面板的右侧均有展示。她留着飘逸的长金发，一侧扎着凌乱的发髻，有松散的卷发丝，穿着浅蓝色超大号衬衫，腰间系着黄色开衫，穿着深色格子裙。她双手兴奋地紧握在胸前，身体倾向甜点。在两个面板中，她的脸部都被一个简单的米色方形遮挡块刻意遮住；请勿在方块内绘制面部特征。次要角色仅出现在下方面板：{argument name="second character" default="一位有着绿色眼睛的粉发动漫女学生"}，坐在左侧，穿着带有白色饰边的海军蓝校服西装、白衬衫，系着大红蝴蝶结。她留着双麻花辫，有着柔和的粉色头发、一个小月牙发夹，表情平静而害羞。

可见元素计数：总共 2 个堆叠面板；下方面板中总共 2 位完成的动漫少女；上方面板中总共 1 位完成的动漫少女；总共 2 个米色方形面部遮挡块，金发少女每个面板各一个；总共 2 杯高耸草莓圣代，每个面板各一个；总共 4 个小白色盘子，上方面板 1 个，下方面板 3 个；总共 3 件可见餐具，上方盘子附近 1 件，下方盘子上 2 件；下方面板墙上有 3 个黑色菜单项目，分别标注为 Coffee、Dessert 和 Drink；金发少女身后有 1 个写着“Cafe Coffee”的圆形黑板标志。

咖啡馆环境：温暖的阳光咖啡馆室内，深炭灰色墙壁、木制椅子、小型圆形木桌，大型窗户光线从右侧射入，柔和的对角线阳光洒在地板和桌面上，背景中有黑板菜单。甜点为 {argument name="dessert" default="一杯高耸的草莓圣代，配有鲜奶油、草莓、威化饼、猕猴桃片、红糖浆层和香草奶油"}，放置在前景中央的透明玻璃杯中。

视觉风格：精致的现代日本动漫插画，干净的线条，粉发少女拥有明亮的眼睛，柔和的绘画式阴影，温暖的日光，头发和甜点细节丰富，温馨的咖啡馆氛围。左上角的粗略区域应与完成后的艺术作品形成鲜明对比：模糊、平坦、草图感、暗淡且不完整。

文本内容：在可见处使用清晰易读的英文黑板字体：“Coffee”、“Dessert”、“Drink”和“Cafe Coffee”。其他菜单项可以是微小的装饰性涂鸦。

约束：保持双面板对比构图。不要添加额外角色、额外甜点、标题、Logo、水印或漫画对话气泡。保留金发角色脸上的米色遮挡块。

templates.title: Rainy Day Anime Vocabulary List

titleLocalized.zh: 雨天动漫词汇表

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a detailed Japanese-style illustration reference chart infographic, titled "..."{argument name="headline text" default="Glossary of terms related to rainy day situations"} This section explains practical rainy day scene vocabulary for AI illustration prompts. Canvas: Vertical 3:4 poster, worn cream-colored watercolor paper with ink smudges, decorated with washi tape, paperclips, torn memo scraps, small stars, raindrop doodles, umbrella doodles, and a purple hydrangea in the corner. It adopts a handmade scrapbook notebook aesthetic, with thin dark blue dividers and slightly worn edges. Overall visual style: soft anime watercolor and ink painting, a melancholic rainy day atmosphere, using soft dark blue, gray, lavender, and beige tones. A recurring theme is {argument name="main character" default="A black-haired anime girl wearing a dark raincoat"} Usually soaked by rain, whether held or standing{argument name="umbrella color" default="Transparent or black umbrellas"} Next. Add reflective, wet streets, mist, puddles, raindrops on glass, and blurred city lights. Keep the text dense but neatly arranged, like a cue word reference table. Header: A large, centered Japanese calligraphy title using heading text. Add a smaller Japanese subheading below explaining that the table compiles words such as rain, rainy season, puddles, and road reflections to support AI-illustrated cue words. Place a large, decorative character portrait with hydrangeas in the upper left corner; the face is softly blurred with a square to match the generated visual effect. Add pasted small memo pads and a decorative umbrella sketch in the upper right corner. Main layout: A grid of 24 numbered vocabulary cards arranged in 4 columns and 6 rows. Each card has a dark blue circular number badge, a bold Japanese term title, two to three lines of brief Japanese explanatory text, and a small anime rain scene thumbnail. Use a thin dark blue border and off-white card background. The 24 cards are numbered and labeled, representing the following concepts: 1. Umbrella, 2. Shared Umbrella, 3. Transparent Umbrella, 4. Wet Hair, 5. Soaked School Uniform, 6. Staying Overnight or Seeking Shelter from the Rain, 7. Under the Eaves, 8. Bus Stop, 9. Rain in Front of the Station, 10. Shower, 11. Rain Inside a Train Carriage, 12. Window Glass, 13. Puddles, 14. Road Reflection, 15. Raindrops, 16. Drizzle, 17. Muddy Ground, 18. Cloudy Sky, 19. Gray Sky, 20. After the Rain, 21. Night Rain, 22. Neon Light Reflection, 23. The Dampness of the Rainy Season, 24. Afterglow of the Rain. Thumbnail Details: While maintaining the same rainy-day anime atmosphere, each card features a unique image. These include close-up portraits, walking scenes, umbrellas, wet clothes, bus stops, crowds at stations, train windows, puddle reflections, neon city streets, hydrangeas after the rain, and rooms or alleys after the rain. Cards 10 and 11 should include soft gray square blurs in certain areas of the character's face, echoing the original masking effect. Bottom area: Add a note panel with a wide border, titled "Usage Guide in Japanese," containing 5 short Japanese bullet points explaining how to use this glossary as AI illustration prompts. Decorate the bottom with washi tape, pen ink bottles, scattered paperclips, fragments of handwritten memos, small flowers, and tiny raindrop icons. Constraints: The final image must have the feel of an information-dense, printable reference sheet, not a single illustration. Use 24 numbered cards and 5 bottom bullet points. Keep the Japanese calligraphy titles prominent, maintain a clear grid structure, and avoid adding any logos or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一份详细的日式插画参考表信息图，标题为 {argument name="headline text" default="雨の日シチュの用語表"}，解释用于 AI 插画提示词的实用雨天场景词汇。

画布：竖向 3:4 海报，带有墨迹的陈旧奶油色水彩纸，配有胶带、回形针、撕下的备忘录碎片、小星星、雨滴涂鸦、雨伞涂鸦以及角落里的紫色绣球花装饰。采用手工剪贴簿笔记本美学，配有细深蓝色分隔线和略显磨损的边缘。

整体视觉风格：柔和的动漫水彩和水墨画，忧郁的雨天氛围，采用柔和的深蓝色、灰色、薰衣草色和米色调。反复出现的主题是 {argument name="main character" default="一个穿着深色雨衣的黑发动漫女孩"}，通常被雨淋湿，拿着或站在 {argument name="umbrella color" default="透明或黑色雨伞"} 下。添加反光的湿润街道、薄雾、水坑、玻璃上的雨滴以及模糊的城市灯光。保持文字密集但排列整齐，如同提示词编写速查表。

页眉：居中的大型日式毛笔书法标题，使用标题文本。下方添加一行较小的日语副标题，说明该表格整理了雨、雨季、水坑和道路反射等词汇，以支持 AI 插画提示词。在左上角放置一个带有绣球花的大型装饰性角色肖像；面部区域被柔和的方形模糊遮盖，与生成的视觉效果相匹配。在右上角添加贴好的小备忘录纸和装饰性雨伞草图。

主要布局：一个由 24 张编号词汇卡组成的网格，排列为 4 列 6 行。每张卡片都有一个深蓝色圆形数字徽章、一个粗体日语术语标题、两到三行简短的日语说明文字，以及一张小型动漫雨景缩略图。使用细深蓝色边框和米白色卡片背景。对 24 张卡片进行编号和标注，包含以下概念：1 雨伞，2 共用雨伞，3 透明雨伞，4 湿发，5 湿透的校服，6 雨中留宿或避雨，7 屋檐下，8 公交车站，9 车站前的雨，10 阵雨，11 火车车厢内的雨，12 窗户玻璃，13 水坑，14 路面反射，15 雨滴，16 细雨，17 泥泞的地面，18 多云的天空，19 灰色的天空，20 雨后，21 夜雨，22 霓虹灯反射，23 雨季的潮湿，24 雨后余韵。

缩略图细节：在保持相同雨天动漫氛围的同时，使每张卡片的图像各不相同。包括特写肖像、行走场景、雨伞、湿衣服、公交车站、车站人群、火车窗户、水坑反射、霓虹城市街道、雨后绣球花以及雨后的房间或小巷。第 10 张和第 11 张卡片应在角色面部区域的部分位置包含柔和的灰色方形模糊，呼应原始的遮盖效果。

底部区域：添加一个带有宽边框的注释面板，标题为日语的使用指南，包含 5 个简短的日语项目符号，解释如何将该词汇表用于 AI 插画提示词。底部装饰有和纸胶带、钢笔墨水瓶、散落的回形针、手写备忘录碎片、小花和微小的雨滴图标。

约束条件：最终图像必须呈现出信息密集的可打印参考表的感觉，而不是单幅插画。使用 24 张编号卡片和 5 个底部项目符号。保持日式书法标题突出，维持清晰的网格结构，并避免添加任何徽标或水印。

templates.title: Blue hydrangea kimono fantasy

titleLocalized.zh: 蓝色绣球花和服幻想

templates.prompt: Create a 2:3 vertical anime-style fantasy illustration, featuring a character named {argument name="character name" default="Aoi"} A young Japanese woman stands on a steep stone staircase flanked by blooming blue hydrangeas. She wears a magnificent short kimono-style outfit in deep navy and black, featuring wide, flowing sleeves, gold embroidery, blue floral appliqués, layered lace trim, a red and gold obi with dangling tassels, blue ribbons, black knee-high stockings with gold patterns, and decorative clogs. She has long, dark hair adorned with a large black and blue bow and blue floral hair ornaments; her face remains unobstructed and delicate. She stands gracefully, one hand slightly raised, looking at the audience. The scene is set in a shimmering seaside mountain town under a golden-blue sunset, overlooking a bright bay, distant mountains, rooftops, telephone poles, and sparkling water. Glowing blue petals, tiny orbs of light, falling white feathers, sunlight streaming in from the upper left, and dreamlike, blurred light spots surround the scene. To the right, beside a metal railing, a small dark sign bears Japanese writing.{argument name="sign text" default="Kozukushi"} Employing a highly refined and exquisite anime illustration style, it blends realistic lighting and shadows with a painterly fantasy art aesthetic. Using deep blue and indigo hues, it showcases delicate fabric textures, cinematic depth of field, dazzling rim lighting, and a dreamlike, romantic atmosphere. It features no watermarks, no blurred faces, no superfluous characters, and no modern UI elements.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 2:3 纵向的动漫风格幻想插画，画面中一位名叫 {argument name="character name" default="Aoi"} 的日本年轻女性全身站立在一条陡峭的石阶上，石阶两旁开满了蓝色的绣球花。她身穿一套华丽的深海军蓝与黑色短款和服风格服装，配有宽大的飘逸袖子、金色刺绣、蓝色花朵贴花、层叠蕾丝边、带有垂坠流苏的红金配色腰带、蓝色丝带、带有金色图案的黑色过膝袜以及装饰性木屐。她留着深色长发，发间装饰着巨大的黑蓝色蝴蝶结和蓝色花朵发饰；保持面部柔美且无遮挡。她姿态优雅，一只手微微抬起，看向观众。场景设定在金蓝色黄昏下的闪耀海滨山城，俯瞰着明亮的海湾、远处的山脉、屋顶、电线杆和波光粼粼的水面。周围环绕着发光的蓝色花瓣、微小的光球、飘落的白色羽毛、从左上方射入的阳光以及梦幻般的虚化光斑。在右侧，金属栏杆旁设置一块深色小招牌，上面写有日文 {argument name="sign text" default="小筑紫"}。采用高度精细的精致动漫插画风格，将写实光影融入绘画感幻想艺术中，运用深蓝与靛青色调，展现细腻的布料质感、电影级的景深、璀璨的轮廓光以及梦幻浪漫的氛围。无水印，无模糊面部，无多余角色，无现代 UI 元素。

templates.title: Q-version catgirl sticker pack preview

titleLocalized.zh: Q 版猫娘贴纸包预览

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a 3x3 preview screenshot containing 9 Japanese LINE-style chibi stickers on a large white rounded rectangle canvas. The right side features a vertical thumbnail bar similar to an app, and the bottom corner has a semi-transparent circular edit/share button. Canvas: 1:1 square image with a clean white background. A large, rounded white sticker panel occupies most of the image. Add subtle light gray shading and rounded corners. The far right displays 4 identical sticker pages in miniature stacked thumbnails; the bottom thumbnail has a black border indicating it's selected. The bottom left corner has a semi-transparent gray circular edit button with a Japanese label, and the bottom right corner has a semi-transparent gray circular share/upload icon. Main Characters: A pastel anime chibi catgirl and a small penguin mascot. The catgirl possesses {argument name="hair color" default="Long, very light pinkish-white hair with soft pink ends."} The penguin has fluffy cat ears, blue eyes when open, a large blue hoodie, a skirt or shorts, yellow leg warmers, white sneakers, and a small yellow hair clip. It's round and chubby, dark blue and white, wearing a matching blue hoodie with a small tag on the front. Use soft watercolor shading, thick and clear sticker outlines, rounded and cute proportions, and lively expressions to avoid a stiff realism. Sticker layout: Arrange the 9 individual sticker illustrations in a 3-column, 3-row grid, with prominent colored handwritten Japanese subtitles above or near each sticker. Use a complete subtitle set.{argument name="sticker captions" default="Hungry..., Munch munch, Taking a break~, Glance, Run away!, Getting ready..., Arrived!, Exhausted, Bow"} The nine stickers are: 1) Top left, Hunger: The catgirl sits with her eyes closed, her hand on her stomach, and the penguin is next to her with an empty plate and spoon, brown caption; 2) Top center, Eating: The catgirl happily eats a hamburger, the penguin eats popcorn, and there are pink hearts around, orange caption; 3) Top right, Resting: The catgirl sits relaxed drinking a beverage in a cup, and the penguin is also drinking, with musical notes and bubbles, green caption; 4) Center left, Peeking: The catgirl peeks out from behind a wall or sign on the left edge, and the penguin peeks out from below, gray caption; 5) Center center, Running away: The catgirl runs away with motion blur and a cloud of dust, and the penguin chases after her with popcorn, bright blue caption; 6) Center right, Getting ready: The catgirl stands next to a full-length mirror combing her hair, and the penguin is holding a comb, with yellow flashes, yellow-orange caption; 7) Bottom left, Arriving: The catgirl sits on a suitcase happily pointing upwards, the penguin is holding a travel map, and there are hill scenery and flashes in the background, red caption; 8) Bottom center, Exhausted: The catgirl sits dejectedly, looking tired, while the penguin lies down wearing an ice pack. A wavy blue fatigue line appears above, with blue subtitles. 9) Bottom right, Bowing: The catgirl bows politely, her eyes covered, while the penguin bows/raises its fins beside her, with dark gray subtitles. Style Constraints: Make it look like a preview of the completed sticker pack in the mobile app, with a clean, transparent sticker-like art effect on a white background, featuring soft shadows, pastel colors, and a playful handwritten font. Ensure the character designs for all 9 stickers are consistent. Avoid adding extra stickers, characters, watermarks, or irrelevant UI text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：在大型白色圆角矩形画布上，创建一个包含 9 个日式 LINE 风格 Q 版贴纸的 3x3 预览截图，右侧带有类似 App 的垂直缩略图条，底部角落设有半透明的圆形编辑/分享按钮。

画布：1:1 正方形图像，干净的白色背景，大型圆角白色贴纸面板占据大部分画面。添加微妙的浅灰色阴影和圆角。最右侧显示 4 个相同的贴纸页微型堆叠缩略图，最下方的缩略图有黑色边框，表示已被选中。左下角有一个带有日文标签的半透明灰色圆形编辑按钮，右下角有一个半透明的灰色圆形分享/上传图标。

主要角色：一个淡彩动漫 Q 版猫娘和一个小企鹅吉祥物。猫娘拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="极浅粉白色长发，发梢呈柔和的粉色"}、毛茸茸的猫耳、睁开时为蓝色的眼睛、蓝色大号连帽衫、短裙或短裤、黄色腿套、白色运动鞋和一个黄色小发夹。企鹅圆滚滚的，呈深蓝色和白色，穿着配套的蓝色连帽衫，前面有一个小标签。使用柔和的水彩阴影、厚实清晰的贴纸轮廓、圆润可爱的比例、生动的表情，避免生硬的写实感。

贴纸布局：将 9 个独立的贴纸插图排列成 3 列 3 行的网格，每个贴纸上方或附近都有醒目的彩色手写日文字幕。使用完整的字幕集 {argument name="sticker captions" default="はらぺこ..., もぐもぐ, 休憩中〜, チラッ, 逃げろー!, 準備中..., 到着っ!, ぐったり, ぺこり"}。9 个贴纸分别是：1) 左上，饥饿：猫娘闭眼坐着，手放在肚子上，企鹅在旁边拿着空盘子和勺子，棕色字幕；2) 上中，进食：猫娘开心地吃汉堡，企鹅吃爆米花，周围有粉色小爱心，橙色字幕；3) 右上，休息：猫娘放松地坐着喝杯子里的饮料，企鹅也在喝，有音符和气泡，绿色字幕；4) 中左，偷看：猫娘从左侧边缘的墙或标志后探出头，企鹅从下方探出头，灰色字幕；5) 中中，逃跑：猫娘带着动态模糊和灰尘云冲走，企鹅拿着爆米花在后面追，亮蓝色字幕；6) 中右，准备中：猫娘站在全身镜旁梳头，企鹅拿着梳子，有黄色闪光，黄橙色字幕；7) 左下，到达：猫娘坐在行李箱上开心地指着上方，企鹅拿着旅行地图，背后有小山风景和闪光，红色字幕；8) 下中，疲惫：猫娘垂头丧气地坐着，表情疲惫，企鹅趴着并戴着冰袋，上方有波浪状的蓝色疲劳线，蓝色字幕；9) 右下，鞠躬：猫娘礼貌地鞠躬，眼睛被遮住，企鹅在旁边鞠躬/举起鳍，深灰色字幕。

风格限制：使其看起来像移动 App 中完成的贴纸包预览，在白色背景上呈现清晰的透明贴纸式艺术效果，带有柔和的阴影、淡彩配色、俏皮的手写字体，并确保所有 9 个贴纸的角色设计保持一致。避免添加额外的贴纸、角色、水印或不相关的 UI 文字。
