templates.title: Q-version comic of a sports meet on a rainy day

titleLocalized.zh: 雨天的运动会 Q 版漫画

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a vertical Japanese four-panel comic strip telling the story of a cute chibi-style girl who becomes even more excited after a rainy sports meet is postponed. Canvas: Full-color vertical comic strip page, approximately 9:16 aspect ratio, with white margins and thick black panel borders. Use four stacked horizontal panels of equal width, employing a comic-style composition, and showcasing vibrant expressions, glossy digital coloring, bold outlines, dramatic speed lines, shimmering effects, and onomatopoeia. Main Character: A girl named {argument name="character name" default="Purple-haired girl"} A chibi-style elementary school student. She has long, wavy lavender hair, fair skin, and round, gray eyes that sparkle with excitement. Her cheeks are rosy, and her mouth is slightly open. She wears a light pink short-sleeved shirt with buttons, paired with a light beige skirt, white socks, and simple shoes. Her pose is usually with her hands clenched into fists in front of her chest, expressing excitement or surprise. Scene 1: School sports meet scene under dark clouds. Show the girl standing in the center of the school playground, smiling with clenched fists, surrounded by flashing lights. The background includes the school building, the Japanese flag, flags of all nations, a clock, a sports meet arch decorated with flowers and labeled "Sports Meet," tents, cone-shaped road signs, bags, and lunchboxes. Add a large vertical speech bubble on the right side that reads "Today is the sports meet!" Add a title to the top outside or above the first scene:{argument name="headline text" default="Even if the rain turns the sky into a swimming pool, the fun will increase tenfold!"} Storyboard 2: Indoor Broadcast Scene. A gray speaker is shown on the left wall, with a white notice below reading "Postponed due to rain." A close-up of a girl on the right shows her looking shocked, sweating, clenching her fists, and mouth agape. Add a speech bubble on the right that reads "Postponed!?" Use a beige interior wall color scheme and radiate comic-book-style lines from her face. Storyboard 3: Torrential Rain on the Sports Field. The sports field is shown transformed into a shallow pool amidst torrential rain, lightning, dark clouds, and dramatic splashes. A girl stands in the foreground, her eyes sparkling, her mouth agape in surprise, holding a spiral-bound calendar that reads "Sports Meet (New Day)," with a large red circle around the number "7" and the words "Afterwards!". Add two onomatopoeic words: a blue "za" on the left for heavy rain and an orange "gorogoro" in the upper right for thunder. Add a vertical speech bubble on the right that reads "Ato 7 Days!?". Scene 4: An extremely close-up of the celebration. Fill the entire scene with the girl's happy facial expression, including sparkling starry eyes, an open smile, and a clenched fist. Use a radiating burst background of bright pink and red, filled with yellow glitter. Add a jagged speech bubble on the left that reads "100x!!" in red and "Rakushimi" in black, signifying doubled excitement. Text Quantity and Placement: Includes 1 title, 4 comic panels, 4 speech bubbles, 1 sticker notification, 1 calendar page, 2 comic onomatopoeia, and 1 sports day arch sign. Please retain all Japanese text. Avoid adding extra dialogue, explanatory text, logos, watermarks, or other characters. Visual Style: Cute Japanese chibi manga, bright and saturated colors, clean black lines, vivid expressions, playful dramatic exaggeration, refined webcomic quality, and all Japanese text must be highly readable.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一幅竖版日本四格漫画，讲述一位可爱的 Q 版女孩在雨天运动会延期后变得更加兴奋的故事。

画布：全彩竖版长条漫画页面，比例约为 9:16，带有白色外边距和粗黑色的分镜边框。使用 4 个等宽的堆叠横向分镜，采用漫画风格构图，表现充满活力的表情、光泽感的数字上色、粗轮廓线、戏剧性的速度线、闪光效果和拟声词。

主角：一位名叫 {argument name="character name" default="紫发女孩"} 的 Q 版小学生。她留着长长的波浪状薰衣草紫发，皮肤白皙，圆圆的灰色眼睛在兴奋时会变成闪烁的星星眼，脸颊红润，小嘴微张。她穿着一件浅粉色的短袖衬衫，带有纽扣，搭配浅米色裙子、白袜子和简单的鞋子。她的姿势通常是双手握拳放在胸前，表现出兴奋或惊讶。

分镜 1：乌云笼罩下的学校运动会场景。展示女孩站在学校操场中央，握紧拳头微笑，周围环绕着闪光。背景包括教学楼、日本国旗、万国旗、时钟、装饰着花朵并标有「運動会」字样的运动会拱门、帐篷、锥形路标、包和午餐盒。在右侧添加一个大的竖向对话气泡，写着「今日は運動会！」。在第一个分镜的顶部外侧或上方，添加标题：{argument name="headline text" default="雨が空ごとプールに変わっても、楽しみは10倍に跳ね上がる！"}。

分镜 2：室内广播场景。左侧展示一个挂在墙上的灰色扬声器，下方贴着一张写有「雨で延期」的白色通知，右侧是女孩的特写，她看起来很震惊，带着汗滴，握紧拳头，嘴巴大张。在右侧添加一个对话气泡，写着「延期!?」。使用米色的室内墙壁色调，并从她的脸部向外辐射出漫画爆发线。

分镜 3：运动场上的倾盆大雨。展示操场在暴雨、闪电、乌云和戏剧性的水花中变成了一个浅浅的积水池。女孩站在前景中，眼睛变成星星状，嘴巴惊讶地张开，手里拿着一本螺旋装订的日历，上面写着「運動会（新しい日）」，下方有一个用红色大圆圈圈出的「7」和「日後！」。添加两个拟声词：左侧蓝色的「ザーッ」表示大雨，右上角橙色的「ゴロゴロ」表示雷声。在右侧添加一个竖向对话气泡，写着「あと7日!?」。

分镜 4：极度特写的庆祝画面。用女孩开心的脸部表情填满整个分镜，包括闪烁的星星眼、张开的笑嘴和紧握的拳头。使用亮粉色和红色的放射状爆发背景，并填满黄色闪光。在左侧添加一个锯齿状对话气泡，里面用红色写着「100倍!!」，黑色写着「楽しみ」，意为兴奋感倍增。

文字数量与位置：包含 1 个标题、4 个漫画分镜、4 个对话气泡、1 张贴纸通知、1 页日历、2 个漫画拟声词和 1 个运动会拱门标签。请完全保留所有日语文本。避免添加额外的对话、说明文字、Logo、水印或其他角色。

视觉风格：可爱的日本 Q 版漫画，明亮饱和的色彩，干净的黑色线条，生动的表情，俏皮的戏剧性夸张，精致的网络漫画质感，所有日语文本均需具备高可读性。

templates.title: Trading Card Battle Animation Storyboard

titleLocalized.zh: 集换式卡牌对战动画分镜

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a sophisticated storyboard for a 10-second sequence of fictional collectible card battle animations, inspired by a film commercial storyboard composed of five horizontal panels. Canvas: 16:10 horizontal white storyboard with thin gray table borders, and a Japanese title centered at the top.{argument name="headline text" default="10-Second Trading Card Battle Anime Storyboard"} A thin red line decorates the upper left corner, and a small, angular red marker is located in the upper right corner. Layout: A three-column grid is used. The left column is narrower and contains red shot labels and timestamps; the middle column is wider and contains cinematic animated stills; the right column is a white notes column used to record camera direction and action descriptions. There are 5 horizontal rows, separated by light gray lines. Visible shot list: 1) Cut 1, 0.0s-2.0s: Panoramic view of the arena. 2) Cut 2, 2.0s-4.0s: Medium close-up of the protagonist activating the card device. 3) Cut 3, 4.0s-6.2s: Close-up of the card being pushed closer to the viewer. 4) Cut 4, 6.2s-8.5s: A fast panning summoning scene where the dragon hologram appears. 5) Cut 5, 8.5s-10.0s: Low-angle shot of the final hero and the dragon. Main details: The protagonist is {argument name="protagonist description" default="A boy with fiery red hair, wearing a red and black combat jacket, fingerless gloves, and glowing mechanical card dueling devices on his arms."} The summoned monster is{argument name="dragon description" default="A crimson armored dragon with enormous wings, serrated horns, a glowing red crystal chest core, and an ember-like sheen."} The arena is{argument name="arena description" default="A futuristic, crowded stadium at night, complete with blue neon spotlights, a glowing arena, massive seating, and a giant VS screen."} The main card design features the emblem of a red demon dragon and fiery energy. The central panel image: Cut 1 shows the complete arena, with the red-haired protagonist on the left and his white-clad opponent in the distance on the right, against a backdrop of a giant red and blue card banner and a huge glowing "VS" display. Cut 2 shows the protagonist grinning confidently, holding up a red dragon card, with red energy swirling around his wrist-mounted dueling device; the facial area is deliberately blurred or softened to create a motion blur/occlusion effect. Cut 3 shows a close-up of a sharp red eye and the raised dragon card with a focus-shifting depth-of-field effect, with explosive red particle streaks behind him. Cut 4 shows a red magic circle covering the arena floor, with the dragon appearing beside the protagonist as holographic flames. Cut 5 shows the protagonist standing heroically beside the fully formed dragon, both illuminated by red embers and dramatic battle rays from below. The right-hand column text notes: Cut 1 is filled with "wide shot/pull-in/audience cheers, introducing the protagonist." Cut 2 includes a red Japanese quote.{argument name="summon quote" default=""Come forth, Crimson King Draglazer!""} Followed by "Medium close-up/Fearless smile/Device activation". Cut 3: "Close-up/Focus pan/Card pushes into the camera". Cut 4: "Fast pan/Holographic summoning/Dragon appears". Cut 5: "Low angle/Surround shot/Decisive shot". Visual style: High-energy modern teen animation, glossy digital painting, cinematic lighting, red and blue color contrast, strong lens flare, speed lines, sparks, holographic particles, dramatic perspective, clear storyboard presentation, professional production board clarity. Constraints: Maintain exactly 5 rows of storyboards, exactly 3 columns, and retain time tags. Do not add extra shots, extra characters, watermarks, or irrelevant UI elements.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为一段 10 秒的虚构集换式卡牌对战动画序列创建一个精致的动画分镜页，设计风格参考由五个横向画格组成的电影广告分镜。

画布：16:10 横向白色分镜页面，带有细灰色表格边框，顶部居中显示日语标题 {argument name="headline text" default="10秒トレーディングカードバトルアニメ 絵コンテ"}，左上角附近有一条细红线装饰，右上角有一个小的棱角分明的红色标志状标记。

布局：使用三列分镜网格。左列较窄，包含红色镜头标签和时间；中列较宽，包含电影感动画剧照；右列为白色备注栏，用于记录摄像机方向和动作说明。共有 5 个横向行，由浅灰色线条分隔。

可见镜头列表：1) Cut 1, 0.0s-2.0s：竞技场全景建立镜头。 2) Cut 2, 2.0s-4.0s：主角激活卡牌装置的中近景。 3) Cut 3, 4.0s-6.2s：卡牌向观众推近的特写镜头。 4) Cut 4, 6.2s-8.5s：龙形全息图出现的快速平移召唤场景。 5) Cut 5, 8.5s-10.0s：最终英雄与龙的低角度镜头。

主体细节：主角为 {argument name="protagonist description" default="一位留着火红色头发的少年，身穿红黑相间的战斗夹克，戴着露指手套，手臂上佩戴着发光的机械卡牌决斗装置"}。被召唤的怪兽为 {argument name="dragon description" default="一只深红色装甲龙，拥有巨大的翅膀、锯齿状的角、发光的红色水晶胸核以及余烬般的亮光"}。竞技场为 {argument name="arena description" default="一个夜晚充满未来感的拥挤体育场，配有蓝色霓虹聚光灯、发光的决斗场、巨大的观众席和巨大的 VS 屏幕"}。主卡牌图案展示了红色恶魔龙徽章和火焰能量。

中心画格图像：Cut 1 展示了完整的体育场决斗场，左侧是红发主角，右侧远处是身穿白衣的对手，背景中有巨大的红蓝卡牌横幅和巨大的发光“VS”显示屏。Cut 2 展示了主角自信地咧嘴一笑，举起一张红龙卡牌，红色能量环绕在腕式决斗装置周围；刻意模糊或柔化面部区域，营造出动态模糊/遮挡感。Cut 3 展示了一只锐利的红色眼睛和举起的龙卡牌的特写，具有焦点平移景深效果，身后有爆炸性的红色粒子条纹。Cut 4 展示了红色魔法阵覆盖竞技场地面，龙以全息火焰的形式在主角身边显现。Cut 5 展示了主角英勇地站在完全成形的龙身边，两者都被来自下方的红色余烬和戏剧性的战斗光线照亮。

右列文字备注：Cut 1 填写“全景 / 推镜头 / 观众欢呼，介绍主角”。Cut 2 包含红色日语引语 {argument name="summon quote" default="「来い、紅蓮王ドラグレイザー！」"}，后接“中近景 / 无畏微笑 / 装置激活”。Cut 3 填写“特写 / 焦点平移 / 卡牌向镜头推近”。Cut 4 填写“快速平移 / 全息召唤 / 龙出现”。Cut 5 填写“低角度 / 环绕镜头 / 决定性镜头”。

视觉风格：高能量现代少年动画，光泽感数字绘画，电影级灯光，红蓝色彩对比，强烈的镜头光晕，速度线，火花，全息粒子，戏剧性透视，清晰的分镜呈现，专业的制作板清晰度。

约束：保持正好 5 行分镜，正好 3 列，并保留时间标签。不要添加额外的镜头、额外角色、水印或不相关的 UI 元素。

templates.title: Anime Girl in the Emergency Staircase

titleLocalized.zh: 紧急楼梯间的动漫少女

templates.prompt: Create a 9:16 vertical anime-style illustration set in a dimly lit, industrial-style emergency stairwell at night. The camera uses a high-angle, first-person perspective, looking down at a girl standing on a metal-patterned steel staircase platform. She is reaching out to the viewer and holding their hand in the foreground. She wears a short-sleeved white school uniform shirt paired with a dark olive-black layered ruffled skirt, with a loose blue-gray ribbon tied around her waist.{argument name="hair color" default="Olive brown with gold highlights and green and purple stripes."} Her hair, shoulder-length with bangs and side styling, is slightly messy, reflecting the cool-toned lighting above. A large, opaque square mosaic block, filled with a soft brown-to-pink gradient, obscures all facial features, adding a central element to her face. The scene contains four main stairwell elements: gray concrete walls, silver metal safety railings, textured steel floors, and an emergency wall lamp emitting a warm yellow glow in the lower left corner. Dramatic, cinematic anime-style lighting is used, presenting cool blue-gray shadows and warm light, with delicate line art and subtle film grain texture, creating an intimate emotional atmosphere as if she is guiding the viewer up and down the emergency stairs. The composition is compact, with her upper body and skirt as the main focus, one of her hands reaching towards the viewer, whose hand appears at the bottom center. The image contains no text or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 9:16 竖构图的动漫风格插画，场景设定在夜晚昏暗的工业风紧急楼梯间。镜头采用高角度第一人称视角，俯瞰站在金属花纹钢板楼梯平台上的少女，她正向观众伸出手，并在前景中牵着观众的手。她身穿短袖白色衬衫校服，搭配深橄榄黑色层叠荷叶边短裙，腰间系着一条宽松的蓝灰色丝带。她的 {argument name="hair color" default="橄榄棕色，带有金色挑染以及绿色和紫色染发条纹"} 头发为齐肩长度，留有刘海和侧发，略显凌乱，映衬着上方冷色调的光线。在她的脸部中心添加一个大型不透明方形马赛克遮挡块，填充柔和的棕色至粉色渐变，遮住所有面部特征。场景包含 4 个主要的楼梯间元素：灰色混凝土墙壁、银色金属安全护栏、纹理钢地板，以及左下方一盏散发着温暖黄光的紧急壁灯。采用富有戏剧性的电影感动漫光影，呈现冷蓝灰色的阴影与温暖的灯光，具备细腻的线条艺术、微妙的胶片颗粒质感，营造出一种仿佛她正引导观众上下紧急楼梯的亲密情绪氛围。构图紧凑，画面主体为她的上半身和裙子，她的一只手伸向观众，观众的手出现在底部中心，画面中不包含任何文字或水印。

titleLocalized.zh: 虚构动画电影评论页面

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a book called{argument name="movie title" default="ノヴァ・リフレイン"} Subtitle{argument name="subtitle" default="Endless Memories"} Create a fictional Japanese film information page and poster for an animated sci-fi thriller. The design should resemble a sophisticated screenshot from a streaming/movie review website, accompanied by the theatrical version's main visual. Canvas: Vertical 3:4 composition, dark blue interface, approximately 768×1024 pixels. A double-column layout at the top, with a full-width comment stream below. The overall atmosphere should be futuristic, rainy, emotionally charged, and cinematic. Top left poster: A vertical theatrical animation poster with rounded corners and a thin blue border. It depicts a cyberpunk city on a rainy night, against a backdrop of a shimmering purple-blue galaxy. In the foreground is a young girl wearing a black hooded jacket, glowing cyan cat-ear headphones, and dark twin tails, with a small patch on her cuff that reads "S-07". Her face is deliberately obscured by a soft, square, gray blur. A blurred figure stands in the distance behind the rainy street. The top left corner features the Japanese tagline: “Memory wa, vanished; thoughts wa, lingering.” The bottom of the poster displays the main title “NOVA: REFRAIN,” followed by “— NOVA: REFRAIN —,” then “— Unforgettable Memories—,” and at the very bottom, “2025.07.18 (FRI) ROADSHOW” in purple-blue font. The top right corner features a movie details panel: a dark card with a subtle border and a clean Japanese UI layout. The top includes four category tags: “SF,” “Hypermanentama,” “Youth,” and “Mistreary.” Below, the title “NOVA: REFRAIN” and the subtitle “— Unforgettable Memories—” are displayed. Add the release information line "Released July 18, 2025 / Release time 126 minutes". Display the overall rating, including 5 gold star icons (the last star is half full), and the numerical rating "4.4". Includes 3 operation buttons: a purple play button labeled "See Preview", a bordered bookmark button labeled "See Now", and a bordered share button labeled "Sher". Synopsis section: Add the title "Arashi" and a short Japanese synopsis, telling the story of a high school girl named Reticia in a near-future world where memory data has become commonplace. After an accident, she tries to recover her friend's lost memories and discovers a hidden "truth" that may change the fate of the world. Cast and crew section: Use a two-column layout. The credits column title "スタッフ" contains 8 Fictitious staff information: "Supervision: ソフト・レイン", "Script: ミサセ・ユウリ", "Music: ハルカ・ミサキ", "Photography: フジサキ・レン" , "Art: カガリ・トウマ", "Editor: ナギサ・コトネ", "VFX: アイオ・シュウ", "Production: エクリプス・ピクチャーズ". The actor column title "キャスト" contains 6 Line fictional actor information: "レティシア：ユイナ・カナメ", "アイオ： "カガミ・リク", "カイト: ハヤセ・ソウタ", "Doctor: レイジ・"クロサワ", "ナビAI「ノヴァ」：ミユ・シラカワ", if necessary, add a short fictional name to fill the gap. Please do not use real celebrity names. Comment Flow: Below the top panel, create a section titled "みんなのレビュー" with a small button on the right with the text "すべてのレビューを见る" stacked vertically 5. The comment cards each contain a circular avatar, the commenter's display name, account ID, gold star rating, bold Japanese comment title/text, timestamp, and purple likes. The comment content is as follows: 1. Avatar: Portrait of an anime girl. Name: "Hoshino Sora", Account: " @sora_hoshino_23 ", Rating: "5.0" (5 gold stars), Title: "This year's number one feeling of immersion. Last 10 points, tears didn't stop.", Timestamp: "2025/7/18 23:41", Likes: "324". 2. Avatar: Profile of a dark-haired anime boy. Name: "Kirishima Len", Account: " @lenscape_07 ", Rating: "4.5", Title: "I love SF so much. The setting and the performance are top-notch." ", timestamp "2025/7/19 10:12", likes "198". 3. Avatar: Cute cat photo. Name "もちまる", account " @mochimaru_33 ", Rating "3.5", Title "Crying けるけど、ちょっと倗かったかも? ", timestamp "2025/7/19 14:56", likes "87". 4. Avatar: Photo of blue sky and white clouds. Name "Aoi ナツメ", account " @natsume_aoi ", rating "4.0", title "音楽がとにかく好い." Satoru never buys it. 5. Avatar: An animated portrait with a softly blurred face. Name: "Takato Yuuki", Account: " @yuki_t_movie ", Rating: "2.5", Title: "Setting is not white, the second half of the development is not yet complete.", Timestamp: "2025/7/20 00:05", Likes: "51". Visual Style: High-quality animated key visual combined with a modern dark mode Japanese film database UI. It uses neon cyan and purple accents, soft halos, rain reflections, fine dividing lines, rounded cards, clear and legible Japanese text, Venus icons, and an atmosphere reminiscent of a high-end science fiction drama. promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为一部名为 {argument name="movie title" default="ノヴァ・リフレイン"}、副标题为 {argument name="subtitle" default="終わらない記憶"} 的动画科幻悬疑电影，创建一个虚构的日本电影信息页面和海报。设计应呈现为精致的流媒体/电影评论网站截图，并配以剧场版主视觉图。

画布：垂直 3:4 构图，深蓝色界面，尺寸约为 768×1024。采用顶部双栏布局，下方为全宽评论流。整体氛围充满未来感、雨景、情感色彩和电影质感。

左上角海报：一张带有圆角和细蓝色边框的竖版剧场动画海报。展示一个雨夜的赛博朋克城市，背景是星光璀璨的紫蓝色银河。前景是一位少女，身穿黑色连帽夹克，戴着发光的青色猫耳耳机，留着深色双马尾，袖口有一个写着“S-07”的小补丁。她的面部被一个柔和的方形灰色模糊遮挡块刻意遮盖。在雨中的街道后方站着一个模糊的远景人物。左上角添加日文标语：“記憶は、消えても、想いは、残る。” 海报底部显示大标题“ノヴァ・リフレイン”，下方为“— NOVA: REFRAIN —”，接着是“— 終わらない記憶 —”，最底部以紫蓝色字体显示“2025.07.18 (FRI) ROADSHOW”。

右上角电影详情面板：使用带有细微边框和简洁日文 UI 排版的深色卡片。顶部包含 4 个类型标签：“SF”、“ヒューマンドラマ”、“青春”、“ミステリー”。下方显示标题“ノヴァ・リフレイン”和副标题“— 終わらない記憶 —”。添加上映信息行“2025年7月18日公開 / 上映時間 126分”。显示综合评分，包含 5 个金星图标（最后一颗星半满），以及数字评分“4.4”。包含 3 个操作按钮：紫色播放按钮标注“予告編を見る”，带边框的书签按钮标注“あとで観る”，以及带边框的分享按钮标注“シェア”。

剧情简介部分：添加标题“あらすじ”，并附上一段简短的日文剧情简介，讲述在一个记忆数据已成为常态的近未来世界中，一名叫作レティシア的高中女生在事故后试图恢复朋友丢失的记忆，并发现了可能改变世界命运的隐藏“真相”。

演职员部分：使用两栏布局。演职员栏标题“スタッフ”，包含 8 行虚构职员信息：“監督：ソフト・レイン”、“脚本：ミサセ・ユウリ”、“音楽：ハルカ・ミサキ”、“撮影：フジサキ・レン”、“美術：カガリ・トウマ”、“編集：ナギサ・コトネ”、“VFX：アイオ・シュウ”、“制作：エクリプス・ピクチャーズ”。演员栏标题“キャスト”，包含 6 行虚构演员信息：“レティシア：ユイナ・カナメ”、“アイオ：カガミ・リク”、“カイト：ハヤセ・ソウタ”、“博士：レイジ・クロサワ”、“ナビAI「ノヴァ」：ミユ・シラカワ”，如有需要可增加一个简短的虚构名字以填补间距。请勿使用真实名人姓名。

评论流：在顶部面板下方，创建一个标题为“みんなのレビュー”的部分，右侧设有一个小按钮，文字为“すべてのレビューを見る”。垂直堆叠 5 张评论卡片，每张卡片包含圆形头像、评论者显示名、账号 ID、金星评分、加粗的日文评论标题/正文、时间戳以及紫色的点赞数。评论内容如下：
1. 头像：动画少女肖像。名称“星乃そら”，账号“@sora_hoshino_23”，评分“5.0”（5 颗金星），标题“今年一番の没入感。ラスト10分、涙が止まらなかった。”，时间戳“2025/7/18 23:41”，点赞“324”。
2. 头像：深色头发动画少年侧脸。名称“霧島レン”，账号“@lenscape_07”，评分“4.5”，标题“SF好きなら絶対ハマる。設定も演出も一級品。”，时间戳“2025/7/19 10:12”，点赞“198”。
3. 头像：可爱的猫咪照片。名称“もちまる”，账号“@mochimaru_33”，评分“3.5”，标题“泣けるけど、ちょっと難しかったかも？”，时间戳“2025/7/19 14:56”，点赞“87”。
4. 头像：蓝天白云照片。名称“蒼井ナツメ”，账号“@natsume_aoi”，评分“4.0”，标题“音楽がとにかく良い。サントラ絶対買う。”，时间戳“2025/7/19 18:30”，点赞“142”。
5. 头像：面部被柔和模糊处理的动画肖像。名称“タカト・ユウキ”，账号“@yuki_t_movie”，评分“2.5”，标题“設定は面白いけど、後半の展開が駆け足すぎたかな。”，时间戳“2025/7/20 00:05”，点赞“51”。

视觉风格：高质量动画主视觉图结合现代深色模式日本电影数据库 UI。使用霓虹青色和紫色点缀，柔和的光晕，雨景反射，细分割线，圆角卡片，清晰易读的日文文本，金星图标，以及高级科幻剧情片的氛围。所有姓名均保持虚构，避免使用真实的演职员。

templates.title: Anime-style Met Gala trio

titleLocalized.zh: 动漫风格 Met Gala 三人组

templates.prompt: Create a captivating vertical high-fashion red carpet photograph set at the Met Gala, featuring three elegant, anime-style female celebrities posing on wide, midnight-blue steps against a backdrop of throngs of paparazzi. The scene should be cinematic, hyper-detailed, realistic, and editorially styled, incorporating bright camera flashes, soft bokeh, white floral hedges, a deep starry sky, and dramatic, lavish event lighting. The three subjects should have smooth, anonymized/blurred faces with no visible features, but their hair, jewelry, bodies, and gowns must be highly detailed. Left Subject: Petite figure, slightly leaning to the left, with deep black hair styled in an elegant low bun, wearing a strapless silver crystal corset paired with a deep navy satin fishtail skirt adorned with opulent gold and silver embroidery on the sides, and navy blue pleated fabric at the hips, embellished with draped tassels, a choker necklace, bracelets, and a small skirt. The central figure: The tallest and most slender, standing confidently with one hand on her hip, her lavender-purple hair styled into a large, sculptural braided updo. She wears a strapless silver beaded fitted gown with a deep navy velvet ribbon slung diagonally across her shoulder, a silver satin pleated skirt with a high slit, deep navy embroidered side panels, and a long, flowing silver hem. She is adorned with a sparkling brooch on her shoulder, layered necklaces, rings, and strappy high heels. The right-side figure: Elegantly poised, with extremely long, straight, rose-pink high ponytail flowing to the right, she wears a black velvet strapless haute couture gown embellished with dense silver pearls and crystal chains, black opera gloves, a magnificent choker, a fitted bodice, and a large deep navy rose-shaped fabric sculpture on her hips. She wears a long, black and blue velvet skirt and one hand on her hip. The gown utilizes a rich palette of colors.{argument name="main dress colors" default="Midnight navy blue, silver, black velvet and rose pink"} Exquisite haute couture beading, pearl dangling, embroidered floral appliqués, lustrous satin, velvet textures, and dramatic Met Gala styling. The composition should be a full-body shot in a 2:3 vertical ratio, with three figures centered and filling the frame, shot from a slightly upward angle to emphasize grandeur. The image should resemble a realistic luxury fashion photograph rather than a cartoon, while retaining subtle anime-style silhouettes and hair colors. Avoid logos, readable text, watermarks, extra people in the foreground, distorted hands, or additional subjects.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张迷人的竖版高级时尚红毯照片，背景设在 Met Gala，画面中恰好有三位优雅的动漫风格女性名人，在拥挤的狗仔队背景前，站在宽阔的午夜蓝台阶上摆姿势。场景具有电影感、超细节、写实且具编辑风格，伴有明亮的相机闪光灯、柔和的焦外成像光斑、白色花篱、深邃的星空以及戏剧性的奢华活动灯光。三位主体应拥有平滑且经过匿名/模糊处理的面部，无可见五官，但头发、珠宝、身体和礼服需高度精细。左侧主体：娇小身材，身体微向左倾，深黑色头发梳成精致的低发髻，身穿无肩带银色水晶束身胸衣，搭配深海军蓝缎面鱼尾裙，侧面饰有华丽的金银刺绣，臀部有海军蓝褶皱面料，配有垂坠流苏装饰、颈圈项链、手镯和小型裙摆。中间主体：最高挑的身材，自信站立，单手叉腰，薰衣草紫发型梳成大型雕塑感编织盘发，身穿无肩带银色珠饰束身礼服，肩部斜跨深海军蓝丝绒饰带，银色缎面褶皱裙，高开叉，深海军蓝刺绣侧板，长款飘逸银色裙摆，肩部饰有闪亮胸针，叠戴项链，戒指和系带高跟鞋。右侧主体：姿态优雅，留着极长的直发玫瑰粉色高马尾，向右飘逸，身穿黑色丝绒无肩带高级定制礼服，饰有密集的银色珍珠和水晶链，佩戴黑色歌剧手套、华丽颈圈，修身胸衣，臀部饰有大型深海军蓝玫瑰状面料雕塑，长款黑蓝丝绒裙摆，单手叉腰。使用丰富的色调 {argument name="main dress colors" default="午夜海军蓝、银色、黑色丝绒和玫瑰粉色"}，精美的高定串珠工艺、珍珠垂坠、刺绣花卉贴花、光泽缎面、丝绒质感以及戏剧性的 Met Gala 造型。构图应为全身照，2:3 竖向比例，三个人物居中并填满画面，从略微仰视的角度拍摄以强调宏伟感。使图像看起来像真实的奢华时尚照片而非卡通，同时保留微妙的动漫角色风格轮廓和发色。避免出现标志、可读文字、水印、前景中多余的人、扭曲的手部或额外的主体。

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张全身垂直的时尚编辑风格摄影作品，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="一位迷人的动漫风格女性"}，她正摆姿势站在 Met Gala 的楼梯上，居中且身体微侧，一只手提起裙摆。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="鲜艳的紫色"} 头发，梳成高耸的编织皇冠发髻，佩戴优雅的耳环，展现出自信的红毯姿态；保持面部柔和虚化，呈现平滑的肤色，不显示具体的五官特征。背景是拥挤的奢华晚宴入口，背景中有身着深色西装的摄影师、明亮的相机闪光灯、带有小星星图案的奶油色与蓝色地毯楼梯，以及楼梯旁茂密的奶油色花丛。服装包含 6 个主要可见部分：1) 雕塑感象牙白紧身胸衣，配心形领口；2) 垂坠感象牙白缎面裙，带有长长的褶皱裙摆；3) 深午夜蓝丝绒外裙片；4) 长款午夜蓝丝绒开襟外套/斗篷，带有扫地裙摆；5) 华丽的银色水晶花卉刺绣和珠饰贴花，点缀在胸衣、臀部、袖子和下摆上；6) 一条带有小吊坠的黑色颈圈。使用 {argument name="gown color palette" default="象牙白缎面、午夜蓝丝绒、银色水晶装饰"}，展现极致奢华的高定细节、逼真的面料质感、电影级闪光灯摄影效果、浅景深、高对比度、光面杂志质感，采用 3:4 垂直构图，无 Logo，无文字，无水印。

Employing a realistic celebrity street style, the image features shallow depth of field, cinematic flash lighting, natural skin tones, sharp fabric details, luxurious contrast, and a 2:3 vertical composition, creating a glamorous atmosphere reminiscent of a fashion extravaganza. Avoid text, logos, watermarks, unnecessary figures in the foreground, distorted anatomy, and cartoonish elements.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 2026 年 Met Gala 红毯高级时装大片，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="一位优雅的年轻女性"}，她正站在宏伟的蓝色地毯楼梯上摆姿势。画面采用背影视角，她优雅地转过四分之三身位，一只手轻放在腰间，头部微微回眸。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 的发色，梳着精致浪漫的盘发，身形纤细白皙，露出双肩，面部轮廓刻意处理得柔和模糊，以确保视觉焦点集中在高级定制礼服上。礼服需包含 4 个核心部件：抹胸银色水晶刺绣紧身胸衣、背部垂下的长款象牙白缎面中片、深邃午夜蓝天鹅绒外裙（带有蓬松的褶皱臀部设计），以及拖地的超长裙摆，裙摆上覆盖着华丽的银色花卉刺绣和珠饰。礼服应呈现出奢华、雕塑感且具有博物馆收藏级别的质感，融合闪亮的蕾丝贴花、植物图案以及厚重的缎面与天鹅绒纹理。场景设定在 {argument name="event setting" default="Met Gala 楼梯"}，深青蓝色的楼梯上装饰着小雏菊图案，两侧是茂密的奶油色与绿色花墙，背景中是一群身着黑色礼服的摄影师，他们手持相机，闪光灯明亮。采用写实的明星街拍风格，浅景深，电影级闪光灯照明，自然的肤色，清晰的织物细节，奢华的对比度，2:3 竖构图，营造出迷人的时尚盛典氛围。避免出现文字、Logo、水印、前景中多余的人物、扭曲的解剖结构以及卡通风格。

templates.prompt: Create a bright and highly detailed anime illustration depicting {argument name="character description" default="Twin girls with light silver-white bob haircuts"} They walk side-by-side along a sun-drenched resort path in Tomamu, Hokkaido. They wear matching, light white layered dresses, complemented by pale blue-gray ribbons, oversized light-colored cardigans, delicate beaded necklaces, pom-pom charms, small crossbody bags, white socks, and platform white sneakers. There must be exactly two girls in the frame: the twin on the left points outwards with her left hand, adorned with feather-like bird wing accessories and a fluffy pom-pom bag at her side; the twin on the right has one hand close to her collar, carrying a small, iridescent, transparent shoulder bag. A fluffy white long-tailed tit hair ornament with tiny black eyes and soft black and white feather texture is added beside each twin's head. Nine visible, translucent soap bubbles, creating a rainbow-like iridescence, are distributed throughout the foreground, midground, and sky. The background depicts a realistic anime-style resort landscape: paved garden paths, lush lawns, shrubs, birch trees, hillsides, and a blue sky dotted with soft clouds. On the right is a cabin-style building with parasols; on the left are two tall, turquoise apartment towers; and on the right is a dark rectangular high-rise tower. A black resort sign is placed in the foreground on the left, bearing the words:{argument name="sign text" default="TOMAMU HOKKAIDO Hoshino Resorts"} The work utilizes soft summer sunlight, shimmering highlights, pale blue and white tonal gradations, delicate lines, dreamlike iridescent effects, shallow depth of field, and refined Japanese AI art aesthetics. Overall atmosphere:{argument name="mood" default="A whimsical, refreshing, and luxurious resort fantasy"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一幅明亮且高度精细的动漫插画，描绘 {argument name="character description" default="留着淡银白色波波头的双胞胎少女"} 在北海道 Tomamu 阳光明媚的度假村小径上并肩行走。两个角色的脸部均被平滑的浅灰色方块遮挡，没有任何五官。她们穿着相配的轻盈白色叠层连衣裙，配有淡蓝灰色丝带、超大号浅色开衫、精致的珠链、毛球挂饰、小型斜挎包、白色短袜和厚底小白鞋。画面中必须正好有两名女孩：左侧的双胞胎左手向外指，身侧带有羽毛状的鸟翼配饰和毛茸茸的毛球包；右侧的双胞胎一只手靠近衣领，背着一个小巧的虹彩透明单肩包。在每位双胞胎的头部旁各添加一只毛茸茸的白色长尾山雀发饰，拥有细小的黑眼睛和柔软的黑白羽毛纹理。在前景、中景和天空中分布正好九个可见的半透明肥皂泡，呈现出彩虹般的虹彩。背景为写实的动漫度假村景观：铺设好的花园小径、翠绿的草坪、灌木丛、白桦树、山坡、带有柔和云朵的蓝天，右侧有一座小木屋风格的建筑和遮阳伞，左侧背景有两座高大的青绿色公寓塔楼，右侧背景有一座深色长方形高层塔楼。在左侧前景放置一个黑色的度假村指示牌，上面写着 {argument name="sign text" default="TOMAMU HOKKAIDO 星野リゾート"}。使用柔和的夏季日光、闪烁的高光、淡蓝白色的色调分级、细腻的线条、梦幻般的虹彩效果、浅景深以及精致的日本 AI 艺术美学。整体氛围：{argument name="mood" default="异想天开、清新、奢华的度假村幻想"}。

templates.prompt: Create a highly detailed and textured anime/fantasy illustration depicting a serene underwater angel girl leaning against an ancient, curved stone structure. The image features a young female angel {argument name="hair color" default="Flowing long golden hair"} Soft amber eyes, delicate and fair skin, a calm yet melancholic expression, dressed in a semi-transparent layered style{argument name="dress style" default="White lace dress with ruffled organza and floral details"} Two enormous white wings spread behind her, illuminated by sunlight from the water above. Her body floats diagonally from the lower left to the upper right, legs outstretched, one arm gently embracing a moss-covered stone arch. The background is a bright, deep blue underwater ruin, the water clear, punctuated by bubbles, caustic beams of light, floating fabric, and small marine life. The image includes a large, curved ancient stone arch or boat-shaped ruin, covered in deep blue moss, coral, small white flowers, and ornate spiral carvings. Numerous floating white feathers of varying sizes are added around her, with three distinct, blurred foreground feathers near the lower right corner and right edge, and smaller, clearer feathers near the wings. The composition should be vertical, cinematic, and immersive, with a bright beam of sunlight at the top center, above shimmering water, and a rich turquoise to cobalt blue background with soft volumetric lighting. The rendering employs fine feather detailing, realistic underwater lighting, shimmering highlights, and clear details, free of noise, ink blots, text, watermarks, and borders. Style: High-end Japanese anime key visual, ethereal and fantastical, with a painterly feel yet clear lines, delicate facial features, and highly refined fabric transparency, creating a romantic and dreamlike atmosphere.{argument name="aspect ratio" default="3:4 vertical composition"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张高度精细、质感出众的动漫奇幻插画，描绘一位宁静的水下天使少女倚靠在古老弯曲石结构上的场景。画面中有一位年轻女性天使，拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="飘逸的长金发"}、柔和的琥珀色双眸、细腻白皙的皮肤，神情平静而忧郁，身着半透明的层叠式 {argument name="dress style" default="带有荷叶边欧根纱和花卉细节的白色蕾丝裙"}。她背后展开着两只巨大的白色羽翼，被来自上方水面的阳光照亮。她的身体从左下向右上斜向漂浮，双腿伸展，一只手臂轻轻环抱着长满苔藓的石拱。背景是明亮的深蓝色水下废墟，水质清澈，伴有气泡、焦散光束、漂浮的织物和小规模海洋生物。画面中包含一个巨大的弯曲古石拱或船形废墟，上面覆盖着深青色苔藓、珊瑚、小白花和华丽的螺旋雕刻。在她周围添加许多大小不一的漂浮白色羽毛，右下角和右边缘附近有三根明显的模糊前景羽毛，翅膀附近则有较小的清晰羽毛。构图应为竖构图，具有电影感和沉浸感，明亮的太阳光束位于顶部中心，上方有波光粼粼的水面，背景为浓郁的绿松石色至钴蓝色，并带有柔和的体积光。采用精细的羽毛渲染、逼真的水下光影、闪烁的高光，细节清晰，无噪点，无墨迹，无文字，无水印，无边框。风格：高级日本动漫主视觉图，空灵奇幻，具有绘画感但线条清晰，面部特征精致，织物透明度高度精炼，充满浪漫与梦幻氛围。使用 {argument name="aspect ratio" default="3:4 竖构图"}。

templates.title: Blue Mary fighting game poster

titleLocalized.zh: Blue Mary 格斗游戏海报

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="character name" default="Blue Mary"} Create a highly dramatic, cinematic fighting game character poster, inspired by the dark cyberpunk style of arcade character selection screens. Canvas: 16:9 widescreen banner, high-detail semi-realistic anime/game main visual, deep navy blue and black tones, accented with electric blue highlights, featuring graininess, glass shards, raindrop-like spots, and strong rim lighting. Layout: Divide the composition into 3 main visual areas: the seated character on the left, the central title typography, and the action character on the right. Add slender, futuristic HUD interface graphics to the edges. Main details: Accurately display the full-body/half-body images of two identical blonde female fighters. Left image 1: She leans lazily against a rough wooden stool in a dark, industrial-style room, with a tall windowpane beside her. One knee is raised, and she wears a red halter-neck crop top, loose blue trousers (with white circular star badges on the thighs), a brown belt, black fingerless gloves, brown boots, and an olive green jacket slipping from her shoulder. Right-side image 2: She is in a dynamic, forward-charging fighting pose, torso facing the camera, one gloved fist thrown at the viewer. She wears the same red halter-neck crop top, loose blue trousers, brown belt, and black fingerless gloves, with short blonde hair illuminated by blue contour lighting. For a blur/anonymity effect, the face can be obscured with a soft rectangular blur block. Central typography: Place a large, distressed headline in the center.{argument name="main title text" default="BLUE MARY"} "BLUE" is a bright, electric blue, positioned above the weathered white "MARY". Add a quote below the title.{argument name="subtitle quote" default="フッ…… Let's fight!"} The text uses a white italic serif/handwritten style with a thin blue underline. The HUD and text elements include six visible interface text groups: 1) Top left group, containing "BLUE MARY", a small bar, "CODE: BM-01", "TARGET: YOU", "STATUS: LOCKED ON", "SYSTEM: OVERWRITE", and "> READY TO FIGHT"; 2) Center left ID block with boxes for "BM" and "BLUE MARY"; 3) Bottom left small text "EST. 1994" and a barcode; 4) Top right group, containing "BLUE MARY", a globe icon, "I WON'T LOSE." and "NOT TO ANYONE."; 5) Right vertical label "BM-01"; 6) Bottom right group, containing "TARGET: YOU", "STATUS: LOCKED ON", and a minimalist crosshair/slider marker. Visual Style: High-contrast glossy digital painting, realistic cloth and skin shadows, clear muscle anatomy, dramatic blue explosion and shattered glass effects behind the character on the right, melancholic warehouse lighting on the left, exquisite fighting game promotional art, strong cinematic depth and dynamic effects. Constraints: Use 2 character models, 6 HUD text groups, no additional characters, no watermarks, maintain clear and legible typography, and preserve the atmosphere of the deep blue battle interface.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="Blue Mary"} 创建一张极具戏剧性的电影感格斗游戏角色海报，灵感来源于黑暗赛博朋克风格的街机角色选择界面。

画布：16:9 宽屏横幅，高细节半写实动漫/游戏主视觉图，深海军蓝与黑色调，点缀电光蓝高光，带有颗粒感、玻璃碎片、雨滴状斑点以及强烈的轮廓光。

布局：将构图分为 3 个主要视觉区域：左侧坐姿角色、中央标题排版、右侧动作角色。在边缘添加纤细的未来感 HUD 界面图形。

主体细节：准确展示 2 个相同金发女性格斗家的全身/半身形象。左侧形象 1：她慵懒地靠在阴暗工业风房间里的粗糙木凳上，身旁是高大的窗格，单膝抬起，身穿红色挂脖露脐上衣，宽松的蓝色长裤（大腿处有白色圆圈星形徽章），棕色腰带，黑色露指手套，棕色靴子，橄榄绿夹克从肩头滑落。右侧形象 2：她处于动态的前冲格斗姿势，躯干朝向镜头，一只戴手套的拳头向观众挥出，身穿同样的红色挂脖露脐上衣、宽松蓝色长裤、棕色腰带和黑色露指手套，短金发被蓝色轮廓光照亮。若需要模糊/匿名效果，脸部可用柔和的矩形模糊块遮盖。

中央排版：在中间放置一个巨大的做旧标题 {argument name="main title text" default="BLUE MARY"}，“BLUE”为明亮的电光蓝色，位于风化的白色“MARY”上方。在标题下方，添加引语 {argument name="subtitle quote" default="フッ…… Let's fight!"}，采用白色斜体衬线/手写风格，并带有纤细的蓝色下划线。

HUD 与文本元素：包含 6 个可见的界面文本组：1) 左上角组，包含“BLUE MARY”、小条形图、“CODE: BM-01”、“TARGET: YOU”、“STATUS: LOCKED ON”、“SYSTEM: OVERWRITE”以及“> READY TO FIGHT”；2) 左中 ID 块，带有方框“BM”和“BLUE MARY”；3) 左下角小字“EST. 1994”及条形码；4) 右上角组，包含“BLUE MARY”、地球图标、“I WON'T LOSE.”和“NOT TO ANYONE.”；5) 右侧垂直标签“BM-01”；6) 右下角组，包含“TARGET: YOU”、“STATUS: LOCKED ON”以及极简十字准星/滑块标记。

视觉风格：高对比度光泽数字绘画，写实的布料与皮肤阴影，清晰的肌肉解剖结构，右侧人物身后有戏剧性的蓝色爆炸与破碎玻璃效果，左侧为忧郁的仓库灯光，精致的格斗游戏宣传艺术，强烈的电影感深度与动态效果。

约束：使用 2 个角色形象，6 个 HUD 文本组，不添加额外角色，无水印，保持所有排版清晰易读，保留深蓝色战斗界面的氛围。

templates.title: Super cute three kittens poster

titleLocalized.zh: 超可爱三只小猫海报

templates.prompt: Create a 1:1 square, high-energy, adorable superhero comic poster with a shimmering rose gold background and a thin, light pink rectangular border. In the center, place a chibi-style superhero child/mascot figure wearing shimmering blue armor and red gloves, one fist raised in a punching pose, dark brown hair styled in a high bun, and a medium brown solid-color square placeholder covering the face. Surround the hero are three fluffy, adorable kittens in dynamic flying poses: a large white-brown kitten with sparkling eyes and a wide-open smiling face in the lower left; a cream-colored Ragdoll-style kitten leaping forward with a fluffy tail in the upper right; and a brown tabby white cat smiling next to a yellow comic-style exclamation mark in the lower right. Add comic-style action graphics: a yellow explosion effect in the upper left containing the bold pink letters "KAPOW," along with multiple yellow stars, black speed lines, colorful rectangular confetti, glitter, and pop art outlines. Add a large speech bubble at the bottom with the following text:{argument name="title text" default="Super Kawaii Three Kittens"} Use bright pink fill, deep navy blue shading, white outline, and cyan outer glow, arranged in two rows. The overall style should be a glossy, Japanese-style cute aesthetic, featuring chibi superheroes, bold black outlines like stickers, vibrant and saturated colors, adorable and lively animal expressions, celebratory glitter effects, and crisp digital illustrations suitable for social media announcements. Ensure there are exactly three kittens, one central superhero, and only one visible "KAPOW" explosion effect; do not add any additional characters or text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 1:1 方形的高能可爱超级英雄漫画海报，背景为闪亮的玫瑰金亮片，并带有细淡粉色矩形边框。在中心位置，放置一个 Q 版超级英雄儿童/吉祥物形象，身穿闪亮的蓝色盔甲，戴着红色手套，一只拳头举起呈出拳姿势，深棕色头发梳成高耸的大发髻，面部覆盖着一个中等棕色的纯色方形占位符。在英雄周围环绕整整三只毛茸茸的可爱小猫，呈现动态飞翔姿势：左下方是一只大大的白棕色小猫，有着闪闪发光的大眼睛和张开的笑脸；右上方是一只奶油色布偶猫风格的小猫，正向前跃起，尾巴毛茸茸的；右下方是一只棕色虎斑白猫，在黄色漫画感感叹号旁微笑。添加漫画动作图形：左上方有一个黄色爆炸效果，内有粗体粉色字母“KAPOW”，以及多个黄色星星、黑色速度线、彩色矩形纸屑、闪光和波普艺术轮廓。在底部添加巨大的气泡标题文字，内容为 {argument name="title text" default="Super Kawaii Three Kittens"}，使用亮粉色填充、深海军蓝阴影、白色描边和青色外发光，分两行排列。整体风格应为光泽感日系可爱风、Q 版超级英雄、贴纸般的粗黑轮廓、鲜艳饱和的色彩、可爱生动的动物表情、庆祝般的闪光效果，以及适合社交媒体公告图的清晰数字插画。请确保小猫数量正好为三只，中心超级英雄形象为一个，且仅有一个可见的“KAPOW”爆炸效果；请勿添加额外的角色或文字。

templates.title: Cute Wolf-themed Donut Personality Diagnosis Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 可爱风狼系甜甜圈性格诊断海报

templates.prompt: Objective: To create an adorable Japanese-style infographic poster featuring "Animal Character Donut Diagnosis," with the theme of {argument name="diagnosis animal" default="Wolf"} The poster adopts a soft and cute dessert style, presenting an effect similar to plain text generation. Canvas: Vertical 2:3 poster, with a soft pink bakery/café background, adorned with pearls, lace, glitter, hearts, stars, flowers, ribbons, and glossy candy decorations. Warm cream and pink tones are used, complemented by lavender purple, sky blue, mint green, and gold accents. The overall atmosphere should be magical, sweet, and highly decorative. Main title area: The top uses a large, rounded bubble font to write the Japanese title "どうぶつキャラドーナツ诊" (Doubutsu Charter Natsu Diagnosis), filled in pink, outlined in white, and with a shadow. Below is the smaller text "あなたには" (Anata ni wa), followed by the large gold-orange outlined text "オオカミ" (Ookami), and then "の気配が漂っています" (Noki-e ga watteimasu). Add tiny paw prints, stars, flower stickers, and soft ribbon decorations around the title. Right-side main visual: Place a round, ornate gold-framed portrait in the upper right corner, decorated with cream flowers and pink ribbons. Inside the frame is a handsome anime male, half-length, wearing a dark suit, white shirt, and tie. His dark wavy hair is highlighted in neon magenta and electric blue against a dark starry background. Obscure the center of his face with a soft-edged, pale purple rectangle to create an anonymity. Lower right-side dessert: In front of the portrait, place a decorative plate with a realistic and adorable animal donut. The donut is shaped like a gray wolf/cat face: round, purplish-gray frosting, two pointed ears, bright black eyes, pink cheeks, a white muzzle, a small black nose and smiling mouth, white frosted whiskers, and a fluffy, tail-shaped crescent block in the lower right corner. Decorate the donut with three clusters of deep blue blue berries (like blueberries) and small purple sugar flowers, and sprinkle with pearl sugar granules and white frosting sauce. A small round cookie label sits on the plate, reading "You are Special." Left sidebar: Create 5 stacked rounded corner information cards, each with a semi-transparent glossy border, soft gradient fill, small icon, and Japanese text. The five cards contain the following: 1. Pink card with a donut icon, titled "Reason," text: "鋭さとやさしさが同居する氛囲気、静かだけど芯が强くて少し近寄りがたい存在感が强いからです(｡•ᴗ•｡)". 2. The purple card, with a crescent moon icon, is titled "オオカミの特徴", and contains 4 key points: "Judgment of Hayashi", "Nakama Thoughts", "ミステリアス", and "One Degree of Decision". 3. Light blue card, with sun icon, title "Animals that are good in nature", including 2 animal icons and 2 Key points: the fox icon is paired with "キツネ：机転がきいてconversationのテンポが合う", and the cat icon is paired with "ネコ: sense of distance and heartland, natural body". 4. Mint green card, with a clover icon, the title is "Fortune", and the text is "Today's charm is quiet and the timing is good. The letter is the best. The letter is the best. The letter is the best and the best is the best." 5. Pink card with donut and blueberry icon and title "オオカミドーナツについ" "ビターなコーティングにホワイトチョコのライン, ブThe performance of ルーベリーのきらめきで濨したganさを香ばしい生地と精品. "な世上げで食べやすく、Special feeling 一品です(๑·᎑·๑)". Visual Style: Ultra-detailed, adorable Japanese-style social media diagnostic cards, featuring glossy stickers, soft lighting effects, gentle gradients, rounded fonts, and a realistic 3D donut texture combined with anime illustrations. The composition remains compact yet easy to read, with cards neatly arranged on the left and a portrait and donut as the visual center on the right. Constraints: 5 information cards must be used. Feature cards must contain 4 key points, and compatibility cards must include 2 animals, with only one main animal, the donut, allowed. Please retain the complete Japanese text. No additional logos or watermarks are allowed.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张可爱的日系“动物角色甜甜圈诊断”信息图海报，主题为 {argument name="diagnosis animal" default="狼"}，采用柔和的可爱甜点风格，呈现出如同纯文本生成的效果。

画布：垂直 2:3 海报，背景为柔粉色烘焙店/咖啡馆，点缀珍珠、蕾丝、闪光、爱心、星星、花朵、丝带及光泽感糖果装饰。使用暖奶油色与粉色调，辅以薰衣草紫、天蓝、薄荷绿和金色点缀。整体氛围应充满魔法感、甜美且极具装饰性。

主标题区域：顶部使用大型圆润气泡字体，书写日文标题「どうぶつキャラドーナツ診断」，粉色填充，白色描边并带有投影。下方为较小的文字「あなたには」，接着是极大的金橙色描边文字「オオカミ」，随后是「の気配が漂っています」。在标题周围添加微小的爪印、星星、花朵贴纸和柔和的丝带装饰。

右侧主视觉：右上角放置一个圆形华丽金框肖像，装饰有奶油小花和粉色丝带。框内是一位帅气的动漫男性，半身像，身穿深色西装、白衬衫并系领带，深色波浪卷发在暗色星空背景下被霓虹洋红色和电蓝色高光照亮。用一个柔和边缘的淡紫色长方形模糊块遮住他脸部中心，营造匿名感。

右下角甜点主体：在肖像前方，放置一个装饰盘，上面有一个写实且可爱的动物甜甜圈。甜甜圈造型为灰狼/猫脸：圆形的紫灰色糖霜，两只尖耳朵，亮黑色眼睛，粉色小脸颊，白色口鼻部，黑色小鼻子和微笑嘴，白色糖霜胡须线条，右下角有一个蓬松的尾巴状月牙块。用 3 簇蓝莓般的深蓝色浆果和紫色小糖花装饰甜甜圈，并撒上珍珠糖粒和白色糖霜淋酱。盘子上放一个小圆饼干标签，写着“You are Special.”。

左侧栏：创建 5 张堆叠的圆角信息卡片，每张卡片带有半透明光泽边框、柔和渐变填充、小图标和日文文本。五张卡片内容如下：
1. 粉色卡片，配甜甜圈图标，标题「理由は」，正文「鋭さとやさしさが同居する雰囲気、静かだけど芯が強くて少し近寄りがたい存在感が強いからです(｡•ᴗ•｡)」。
2. 紫色卡片，配新月图标，标题「オオカミの特徴」，包含 4 个要点：「判断が早い」、「仲間思い」、「ミステリアス」、「一度決めたらぶれにくい」。
3. 浅蓝色卡片，配太阳图标，标题「相性が良い動物」，包含 2 个动物图标和 2 个要点：狐狸图标配「キツネ：機転がきいて会話のテンポが合う」，猫图标配「ネコ：距離感が心地よく、自然体でいられる」。
4. 薄荷绿卡片，配三叶草图标，标题「運勢」，正文「今は魅力が静かに伝わる好調期。信頼が積み上がり、じわじわ注目が集まります(≧▽≦)」。
5. 粉色卡片，配甜甜圈和蓝莓图标，标题「オオカミドーナツについて」，正文「ビターなコーティングにホワイトチョコのライン、ブルーベリーのきらめきで凛とした甘さを表現。香ばしい生地と上品な仕上げで食べやすく、特別感のある一品です(๑•᎑•๑)」。

视觉风格：超精细的日系可爱社交媒体诊断卡，光泽贴纸，柔光效果，柔和渐变，圆润字体，逼真的 3D 甜甜圈质感与动漫插画结合。构图保持紧凑但易读，左侧卡片整齐排列，右侧以肖像和甜甜圈为视觉中心。

约束条件：必须使用 5 张信息卡片，特征卡片必须包含 4 个要点，相性卡片必须包含 2 种动物，且仅限一个主动物甜甜圈。请完整保留日文文本。不得添加额外的标志或水印。

templates.title: Seamless Watercolor Stone Path Tile Texture

titleLocalized.zh: 无缝水彩石径瓷砖纹理

templates.prompt: Create a seamless, repeating tiling pattern of an old garden stone path viewed from directly above. Irregularly shaped polygonal paving stones fill the composition from edge to edge, separated by dark, earth-filled cracks. The design ensures all edges meet perfectly for tiling. Employ a delicate watercolor and ink illustration style on warm off-white paper: soft, translucent washes, hand-drawn graphite/tan outlines, subtle graininess, uneven pigment blending, and natural textures. The stones are light cream, light gray, beige, and soft pale pink, with moss-green stains and lichen patches; the cracks contain dark brown earth, dotted with tiny clumps of grass, weeds, and small buds. Maintain a moderate pattern density, with stones varying in size and orientation, creating an organic, random feel. There is no obvious central focal point, no shadows, no text, no borders, and no watermarks. Color scheme: Sage green moss, olive lichen, warm ivory stones, gray-beige, soft gray, and earthy brown.

promptLocalized.zh: 创建一个从正上方俯视的古老花园石径无缝重复平铺图案。构图边缘到边缘均填满不规则的多边形铺路石，石块间由充满泥土的深色裂缝隔开，设计确保所有边缘完美衔接以实现平铺。采用温暖的米白色纸张上的精致水彩和墨水插画风格：柔和的半透明渲染、手绘石墨/棕褐色轮廓、细腻的颗粒感、不均匀的颜料晕染以及自然纹理。石块呈浅奶油色、浅灰色、米色和柔和的淡粉色，带有苔藓绿色的污渍和地衣斑块；裂缝中包含深棕色的泥土，点缀着细小的草丛、杂草和微小的叶芽。保持图案密度适中，石块大小和方向各异，呈现有机随机感，没有明显的中心焦点，无物体阴影，无文字，无边框，无水印。配色方案：鼠尾草绿苔藓、橄榄色地衣、暖象牙色石块、灰米色、柔和灰、大地棕。

templates.title: Fisheye lens anime schoolgirl selfie

titleLocalized.zh: 鱼眼镜头动漫女学生自拍

templates.prompt: Create a fisheye lens close-up selfie. The image shows a cute anime-style female student sitting at a desk in a classroom, one arm outstretched towards the camera, as if taking a selfie. The character has an oversized 3D anime doll-like head with glossy skin, a slightly open mouth, one blinking eye, and the other wide open, displaying a vibrant purple-blue starry iris and a bright catchlight. She has {argument name="hair color" default="Bubbleg gum pink hair with subtle light blue highlights."} She sported a short, wavy bob with long bangs partially obscuring her eyes, a small side braid on top of her head, and wore sparkling black star-shaped hair clips. Black star-shaped earrings adorned her visible ears. She wore {argument name="school uniform" default="White short-sleeved shirt, beige and black plaid vest, and dark red silk bow tie."} Her left hand was holding a black fountain pen, writing on an open, lined notebook on the table, next to which was a book labeled {argument name="textbook title" default="BIOCHEMISTRY"} The image features a black textbook with a brightly colored periodic table graphic on the cover. The background is a realistic Japanese classroom, complete with desks, paper, blinds, fluorescent ceiling lights, and warm indoor lighting, with several blurry students in the distance; the face of one background figure is deliberately obscured. Extreme wide-angle fisheye distortion is used, with dark, rounded vignetting at the edges, emphasizing the perspective shortening effect of the foreground arms. A shallow depth of field is employed, combining glossy, high-detail anime rendering with realistic classroom photography, resulting in vibrant colors with soft blush and cinematic highlights. The composition remains vertical, intimate, playful, and slightly surreal; aside from the textbook cover, no additional text is included in the image.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张鱼眼镜头特写自拍，画面中一位可爱的动漫女学生坐在教室课桌前，一只手臂伸向镜头，仿佛正在自拍。角色拥有超大的 3D 动漫玩偶式头部，皮肤具有光泽感，小嘴微张，一只眼睛眨眼，另一只眼睛睁大，呈现出鲜艳的紫蓝色星空虹膜和明亮的眼神光。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="泡泡糖粉色头发，带有细微的浅蓝色挑染"}，发型为短波浪波波头，长刘海遮住部分眼睛，头顶有一条小侧辫，并佩戴闪亮的黑色星形发夹。在可见的耳朵上添加黑色星形耳环。她穿着 {argument name="school uniform" default="白色短袖衬衫、米色与黑色格纹背心，以及深红色丝带领结"}。她的左手正拿着一支黑色钢笔在桌上打开的横线笔记本上书写，旁边放着一本标有 {argument name="textbook title" default="BIOCHEMISTRY"} 的黑色教科书，封面上印有色彩鲜艳的元素周期表图形。背景是逼真的日本教室，有课桌、纸张、百叶窗、天花板荧光灯、温暖的室内光线，远处有几个模糊的学生；其中一个背景人物面部被刻意遮挡。使用极端的广角鱼眼畸变效果，边缘带有深色圆形暗角，强调前景手臂的透视缩短效果，采用浅景深，将光泽感高细节动漫渲染与逼真的教室摄影相结合，色彩鲜艳，带有柔和的腮红和电影级高光。保持构图为竖屏，亲密、俏皮且略带超现实感；除教科书封面外，画面中不包含任何额外文字。

templates.title: HER19845 Streetwear Collection Launch Poster

titleLocalized.zh: HER19845 街头服饰系列发布海报

templates.prompt: Objective: Create a high-end streetwear promotional poster for a limited-edition release, featuring a full-body model wearing an oversized black printed hoodie and black sweatpants with a bright pink graffiti brand logo. Canvas: Vertical portrait poster, approximately 2:3 aspect ratio, off-white studio background with subtle paper texture, slight shadows on the floor and walls, and editorial-grade fashion lighting. Layout: A large, compressed bright pink title text fills the entire top background, containing the following content:{argument name="main headline" default="HER19845"} Position the model in the center of the foreground, overlapping the title so that the text appears behind the head and torso. Keep the composition bold, poster-like, and with a slightly decadent style. Main details: A young streetwear model with legs apart, hands in pockets, relaxed pose, long brown hair falling over her shoulders, face softly obscured or blurred, wearing layered silver necklaces, a white printed T-shirt, an oversized black zip-up hoodie (with white and bright pink punk patterns), loose black sweatpants (with large pink and white graffiti text), and pink and white sneakers. There are six main visible clothing elements: black hoodie, white printed T-shirt, black sweatpants, pink and white sneakers, layered silver necklaces, and long hair. Text and Graphics: Seven sets of auxiliary text/graphics surround the model: 1) In the center left area, the text reads "LIMITED EDITION / WORLDWIDE DROP," accompanied by three small stars and the slogan "SHE'S NOT HERE / TO FIT IN / SHE'S HERE / TO TAKE OVER." (pink); 2) A vertical stack of icons on the left, including a globe icon, a circled H icon, an outlined star icon, tiny abstract symbols, a barcode, and the small print "HER19845™"; 3) A circular bright pink globe stamp in the lower left corner, surrounded by microtext about global release and rebellious/hacker energy; 4) A large black handwritten signature spanning the right side, containing the following text.{argument name="signature text" default="Her 19845"} 5) A small pink outline label box in the middle right corner, containing a globe icon and "19845"; 6) A manifesto block in the lower right corner, containing "BUILT DIFFERENT. / BREAKS RULES. / MAKES HISTORY.", with three stars, below which are pink "REBEL. RARE. REAL." and "THIS ISN'T FASHION. / THIS IS FREEDOM.", and a small signature line; 7) A row of four small symbols in the lower right corner: a black twinkling star, a black globe, a black vertical stripe, and a pink star in a black square. templates.title: Urban Viking magazine cover

titleLocalized.zh: Urban Viking 杂志封面

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a rough, editorial-style magazine cover collage, titled {argument name="magazine title" default="URBAN VIKING"} This work blends Scandinavian runic heritage, street culture, and winter travel photography. Canvas: Vertical poster cover, 2:3 aspect ratio, distressed sepia and black tones, aged paper texture, scratched ink, worn edges, vintage magazine layout. A dark brown/black grunge background is used, paired with warm sepia font and torn paper-effect photo borders. Main image: A full-body street fashion portrait, the subject being {argument name="subject" default="A blonde woman wearing a black knitted beanie, a black ribbed turtleneck sweater, and light beige high-waisted jeans."} Standing slightly to the right on an old European cobblestone street, with tall Gothic stone buildings in the background, her pose is relaxed, one arm crossed in front of her, long blonde hair peeking out from under her beanie, evoking an urban winter atmosphere. Pedestrians in the background are small and slightly blurred. Her face is deliberately obscured with simple square mosaics to match the generated edited anonymized look. Typography: A large vertical title “URBAN VIKING” is placed along the entire left edge in distressed Gothic/bold capital letters against a creamy ink background. Small technical annotation graphics, thin lines, crosshairs, and archival printing marks are added around the portrait. Visible text blocks and labels: In the upper left corner, there is a compact data block containing: “NORDIC: 55.6761° N, 12.5683° E / FOUNDATION: STRENGTH / ELEMENT: EARTH / SYMBOL: ᚷ (ALGIZ) / MEANING: PROTECTION, CONNECTION, INSTINCT”. In the top right corner, add a barcode labeled "URBAN VIKING MAGAZINE" with the number "5 012345 678900 07". In the bottom left corner, add a small globe icon with the text "STREET CULTURE / NORDIC SOUL / VIKING SPIRIT / ISSUE NO. 07 / WINTER SEASON" above it, along with a small box label "N°07" and the vertical date text "MMXXV / 2025". In the bottom center, add typewriter-style text: "MADE BY THE STREETS / WORN BY THE FEW" and "BUILT ON INSTINCT / DRIVEN BY PURPOSE". In the bottom right corner, add handwritten text written on torn brown paper: "keep your roots strong and your spirit wild x". Graphic element count: Includes exactly two torn-edge illustration photos overlapping in the lower third. Illustration 1, located near the bottom left, slightly tilted counter-clockwise, shows the same subject walking on a cobblestone street with brightly colored shops behind him, wearing the same black top and beige trousers, plus a tan scarf; his face is obscured by small square mosaics. Illustration 2, located near the bottom right, slightly tilted clockwise, shows the same subject by a river or canal, with ancient stone buildings and grass in the background, wearing a black beanie and a black top; his face is obscured by small square mosaics. Contains exactly two circular Nordic rune stamps: one in the center right of the subject, and the other in the lower left/bottom center, labeled "VIKING HERITAGE / SCANDINAVIAN ROOTS". Contains exactly one barcode, one globe icon, one box issue number, and one small triangular rune badge located near the bottom center. Visual Style: A fusion of high-contrast urban documentary photography and print magazine print media, featuring soft amber highlights, deep blacks, beige paper whites, rough halftone grain, dust, scratches, torn tape edges, medieval typography, runic symbols, and a melancholic Scandinavian street fashion aesthetic. Limitations: Retain the precise number of elements: 1 main portrait, 2 illustrated photographs, 2 circular runic stamps, 1 barcode, 1 globe icon, 1 box issue number, and 1 triangular badge. Avoid simplistic modern minimalism; make it look weathered, layered, textured, and collectible.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张粗犷的编辑风格杂志封面拼贴画，标题为 {argument name="magazine title" default="URBAN VIKING"}，融合斯堪的纳维亚符文传承、街头文化和冬季旅行摄影。

画布：竖版海报封面，2:3 长宽比，做旧棕褐色与黑色调，陈旧纸张纹理，划痕墨迹，磨损边缘，复古杂志排版。使用深棕色/黑色颓废风背景，搭配暖棕褐色字体和撕纸效果的照片边框。

主体图像：一张全身街头时尚肖像，主体为 {argument name="subject" default="一位戴着黑色针织冷帽、身穿黑色罗纹高领毛衣和浅米色高腰牛仔裤的金发女性"}，站在欧洲古老鹅卵石街道上，位置略偏右，背景是高大的哥特式石建筑。她的姿势放松，一只手臂横在身前，冷帽下露出长长的金发，呈现出都市冬季氛围。背景中的行人较小且略显模糊。面部刻意用简单的方形马赛克遮挡，以符合生成的编辑匿名化外观。

排版：将巨大的竖排标题“URBAN VIKING”沿整个左边缘放置，采用做旧的哥特式/黑体大写字母，深色背景上的奶油色墨迹。在肖像周围添加小型技术注释图形、细线、十字准星标记和档案印刷痕迹。

可见文本块和标签：在左上角，包含一个紧凑的数据块，内容为：“NORDIC: 55.6761° N, 12.5683° E / FOUNDATION: STRENGTH / ELEMENT: EARTH / SYMBOL: ᚷ (ALGIZ) / MEANING: PROTECTION, CONNECTION, INSTINCT”。在右上角，添加一个标注为“URBAN VIKING MAGAZINE”的条形码，数字为“5 012345 678900 07”。在左下角，添加一个小地球仪图标，上方文字为“STREET CULTURE / NORDIC SOUL / VIKING SPIRIT / ISSUE NO. 07 / WINTER SEASON”，外加一个小的盒装标签“N°07”和竖排日期文字“MMXXV / 2025”。在底部中心，添加打字机风格文字：“MADE BY THE STREETS / WORN BY THE FEW”以及“BUILT ON INSTINCT / DRIVEN BY PURPOSE”。在右下角，添加写在撕裂棕色纸张上的手写文字：“keep your roots strong and your spirit wild x”。

图形元素计数：包含正好 2 张重叠在下三分之一处的撕边插图照片。插图照片 1 位于底部中左侧附近，略微逆时针倾斜，显示同一主体走在鹅卵石街道上，身后是色彩鲜艳的店面，穿着同样的黑色上衣和米色裤子，外加一条棕褐色围巾；用小方形马赛克遮住面部。插图照片 2 位于底部右侧附近，略微顺时针倾斜，显示同一主体在河流或运河边，背景是古老的石建筑和草地，戴着黑色冷帽，穿着黑色上衣；用小方形马赛克遮住面部。包含正好 2 个圆形北欧符文印章图形：一个在主体右侧中部，另一个在左下/底部中心，标注为“VIKING HERITAGE / SCANDINAVIAN ROOTS”。包含正好 1 个条形码、1 个地球仪图标、1 个盒装期号和 1 个位于底部中心附近的小型三角形符文徽章。

视觉风格：高对比度都市纪实摄影与印刷杂志纸媒的融合，柔和的琥珀色高光、深黑色、米色纸张白、粗糙的半色调颗粒、灰尘、划痕、撕裂的胶带边缘、中世纪排版、符文符号以及忧郁的斯堪的纳维亚街头服饰美学。

限制：保留 1 张主体肖像、2 张插图照片、2 个圆形符文印章、1 个条形码、1 个地球仪图标、1 个盒装期号和 1 个三角形徽章的精确数量。避免简洁的现代极简主义；使其看起来饱经风霜、层次丰富、具有质感且值得收藏。

templates.title: Retro Goa travel poster

titleLocalized.zh: 复古果阿旅行海报

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="destination" default="GOA"} ,{argument name="country" default="INDIA"} Create a retro travel poster, evoking a warm colonial coastal atmosphere and a dynamic typography. Canvas: Vertical poster format, approximately 2:3 aspect ratio, background of aged brown parchment with a delicate paper texture, using dark brown and gold sunset tones, with a thin double-lined dark brown border on the inner edge. Layout: The upper half is dominated by a large, dark cyan serif title text "GOA," almost spanning the entire width. Directly below and to the left is the moderately spaced capital "INDIA" in a soft brick red color. Below this is a small palm leaf illustration, followed by a line of italic script tagline "{argument name="tagline" default="Sun, Sand & Susegad."} ", and a decorative separator consisting of short lines, dots, and short lines, ending with a line of coordinate text "{argument name="coordinates" default="15.2993° N, 74.1240° E"} The main scene: On the right and lower half, a richly detailed Baroque Portuguese-style Goa church facade is displayed, constructed of golden-brown stone, featuring ornate columns, arched porticoes, round windows, statues, spires, and a cross at the top. The church occupies two-thirds of the right side of the poster, extending upwards to the center, partially below the title. Parts of an adjacent ancient building are visible along the far right edge. Foreground and background: In the lower left foreground, a classic motorcycle is placed {argument name="vehicle" default="A retro Royal Enfield style motorcycle"} Parked on a cobblestone plaza, slightly tilted to the right, it features chrome details, black tires, brown leather seats, and warm reflections. Behind it unfolds a tropical coastal sunset, the sun low near the horizon, accompanied by waves, rocks, and five clearly visible palm trees: two tall, prominent palm trees on the left, one medium-sized palm tree behind, and two smaller palm trees further along the coastline. Visual style: a vintage lithograph travel advertisement style, combining painterly realism with engraved details, warm amber and burnt orange lighting, deep shadows, a nostalgic Indian coastal travel aesthetic, clear and legible typography, slightly weathered ink texture, no modern signs, no figures, and no additional text beyond the designated text.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="destination" default="GOA"}，{argument name="country" default="INDIA"} 创作一张复古旅行海报，营造温暖的殖民地沿海氛围和极具张力的排版。

画布：竖版海报格式，比例约为 2:3，背景为带有细腻纸张纹理的陈旧棕褐色羊皮纸，采用深褐色与金色的日落色调，边缘内侧配有细双线深棕色边框。

布局：上半部分由巨大的深青色衬线标题文字“GOA”占据，几乎横跨整个宽度。其正下方左侧是间距适中的大写文字“INDIA”，颜色为柔和的砖红色。下方放置一片小型棕榈叶插画，接着是一行斜体脚本标语“{argument name="tagline" default="Sun, Sand & Susegad."}”，以及一个由短线、圆点和短线组成的装饰性分隔符，最后是一行坐标文字“{argument name="coordinates" default="15.2993° N, 74.1240° E"}”。

主体场景：在右侧和下半部分，展示一座细节丰富的巴洛克式葡萄牙风格果阿教堂立面，采用金棕色石材，配有华丽的圆柱、拱形门廊、圆形窗户、雕像、尖顶饰以及顶部的十字架。教堂占据海报右侧三分之二的区域，向上延伸至中部，部分位于标题下方。远右侧边缘可见部分相邻的古老建筑。

前景与背景：在左下角前景处，放置 1 辆经典摩托车，即 {argument name="vehicle" default="一辆复古皇家恩菲尔德风格摩托车"}，停在鹅卵石广场上，略微向右倾斜，带有镀铬细节、黑色轮胎、棕色皮革座椅和温暖的反光。其后方展示热带海岸的日落景象，太阳低垂在地平线附近，伴有海浪、岩石和 5 棵清晰可见的棕榈树：左侧有 2 棵高大显眼的棕榈树，后方有 1 棵中等高度的棕榈树，更远处的海岸线附近还有 2 棵较小的棕榈树。

视觉风格：复古石版画旅行广告风格，绘画写实主义与雕刻细节相结合，温暖的琥珀色和焦橙色光影，深邃的阴影，怀旧的印度沿海旅游美学，清晰易读的排版，略带风化的油墨质感，无现代标志，无人物，除指定的文字外无额外文字。

templates.prompt: Objective: For{argument name="character name" default="HER19845"} Create a bold, vertical streetwear magazine cover poster showcasing the rebellious attitude of 1980s/90s hip-hop fashion. Canvas: Portrait poster, 2:3 aspect ratio, off-white paper background with subtle grain, scratches, dust spots, worn print texture, and a slight vintage magazine distressing effect. Subject: A young woman stands confidently in front of oversized text, legs apart, hands in her pockets. Her face is deliberately obscured by a simple square blur/mask. Her long, wavy, brown-blonde hair is visible around the blurred area. Outfit List: 5 visible main garments/accessories—an oversized white printed T-shirt with pink graffiti-style art and the number "19845" on the chest, a loose purple windbreaker with cyan and bright pink accents, loose black cargo/parachute pants, a pair of platform white sneakers with pink and cyan details, and a black heart-shaped pendant necklace. The pose should appear casual, provocative, and have a fashion editor's touch. Layout: Place a large, compressed, all-caps background text behind the model.{argument name="large background text" default="HER19845"} The lettering should almost cover the entire height of the poster. It should be extremely tall and prominent, partially obscured by the figure. Use a gradient from bright pink to purple from left to right, with worn scratches and printing defects inside the lettering. Keep the main subject at the forefront of the layout. Visible text elements: The poster must contain 9 independent text elements: 1) The bracketed label “[HER19845]” in the upper left corner; 2) The very small all-caps slogan “BUILT DIFFERENT. MADE TO BREAK RULES.” in the top center; 3) The large background word “HER19845”; 4) The handwritten black phrase “Not your average.” with a pink underline on the left; 5) The stacked all-caps text “CONFIDENCE IS MY FAVORITE OUTFIT.” in the lower left corner; 6) The stacked purple bracketed text “[REBELLION LOOKS GOOD ON ME]” in the lower left corner; 7) The stacked all-caps text “NO APOLOGIES. JUST ENERGY. ALL DAY.” in the lower left corner; 8) The red and orange handwritten signature text on the right.{argument name="signature text" default="Her 19845"} It features an underlined decoration; 9) a bright pink bracket label “[HER19845]” in the center of the bottom. Additionally, add two decorative typographic marks: a small barcode in the lower left corner and a black and white “PARENTAL ADVISORY EXPLICIT CONTENT” label in the lower right corner. Typography and Style: Combining a large, compressed sans-serif font, small, practical editorial notes, handwritten brush-style annotations, and punk magazine details. Color Scheme: Off-white paper, bright pink, violet, cyan accents, black ink, and red-orange markers. Use high contrast, stylish poster lighting, a sharp cutout of the subject, subtle ground shadows, and a rough editorial print texture. Constraints: No additional characters or text may be added beyond the specified 9 text elements and two decorative labels; keep the model full-body and centered; retain the square face-blurring effect; ensure the final image presents a sophisticated rebellious streetwear cover effect.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="HER19845"} 创建一张大胆的竖版街头风尚杂志封面海报，展现 20 世纪 80 年代/90 年代嘻哈时尚的叛逆态度。

画布：人像海报，2:3 比例，米白色纸张背景，带有细微的颗粒感、划痕、灰尘斑点、磨损的印刷纹理以及轻微的复古杂志做旧效果。

主体：一位全身年轻女性居中站立在超大字体前，姿态自信，双腿分开，双手插在裤兜里。她的脸部被一个简单的方形模糊/遮挡块刻意遮盖。模糊区域周围可见她长长的波浪形棕金色头发。服装清单：5 件可见的主要服饰/配饰 — 1 件胸前印有粉色涂鸦风格艺术图案及“19845”字样的超大白色印花 T 恤，1 件带有青色和亮粉色装饰的宽松紫色防风外套，1 条宽松的黑色工装/降落伞裤，1 双带有粉色和青色细节的厚底白色运动鞋，以及 1 条黑色心形吊坠项链。姿势应显得随意、挑衅且具有时尚编辑感。

布局：在模特身后放置巨大的压缩大写背景文字 {argument name="large background text" default="HER19845"}，几乎覆盖海报的整个高度。字母应极其高大、醒目，并被人物部分遮挡。使用从左到右的亮粉色到紫色的渐变，字母内部带有磨损的擦痕和印刷损耗。保持主体位于排版的前层。

可见文字元素：海报上需包含 9 个独立的文字元素：1) 左上角的小括号标签“[HER19845]”；2) 顶部中央极小的全大写标语“BUILT DIFFERENT. MADE TO BREAK RULES.”；3) 巨大的背景单词“HER19845”；4) 左侧手写黑色短语“Not your average.”并带有粉色下划线；5) 左下角堆叠的全大写文字“CONFIDENCE IS MY FAVORITE OUTFIT.”；6) 左下角紫色括号堆叠文字“[REBELLION LOOKS GOOD ON ME]”；7) 左下角堆叠的全大写文字“NO APOLOGIES. JUST ENERGY. ALL DAY.”；8) 右侧红橙色手写签名文字 {argument name="signature text" default="Her 19845"} 并带有下划线装饰；9) 底部中央的亮粉色括号标签“[HER19845]”。此外，添加两个装饰性印刷标记：左下角的一个小条形码和右下角的一个黑白“PARENTAL ADVISORY EXPLICIT CONTENT”标签。

排版与风格：结合巨大的压缩无衬线字体、小型实用编辑说明文字、手写笔刷体注释以及朋克杂志细节。配色方案：米白色纸张、亮粉色、紫罗兰色、青色点缀、黑色墨水和红橙色记号笔。使用高对比度、时尚海报灯光、清晰的抠图主体、细微的地面阴影以及粗糙的编辑印刷纹理。

约束：除指定的 9 个文字元素和两个装饰标签外，不得添加额外字符或文字；保持模特全身且居中；保留方形遮脸模糊效果；确保最终图像呈现出精致的叛逆街头风尚封面效果。

templates.title: Retro Delhi tourist poster

titleLocalized.zh: 复古德里旅游海报

templates.prompt: Create a{argument name="destination" default="Delhi"} A retro Art Deco style travel poster from India, in a 2:3 vertical aspect ratio. It uses warm, aged paper tones of saffron, ochre, dark brown, burnt orange, and deep cyan, adding subtle film grain, distressed printing textures, and double-thin borders. A large, bold serif title line should be placed at the top of the image, with the text "..."{argument name="headline text" default="DELHI"} (Dark cyan), below which is the widely spaced red-orange text "INDIA". In the lower left corner of the title is a simple lotus icon within an arched outline, followed by the italicized slogan "{argument name="tagline" default="Where Empires Meet."} A decorative separator with a center point, and coordinates.{argument name="coordinates" default="28.6139° N, 77.2090° E"} The right half and lower center should showcase the India Gate at its golden hour, rendered realistically yet in a poster-like style, using perspective to convey its grandeur, including detailed stone textures, arch shadows, and the word "INDIA" inscribed near the top. Against a hazy left-hand background, display Humayun's Tomb or a Mughal-style domed monument nestled among trees, softened by a sunset atmosphere. The foreground should include a rickshaw with two people on it: a rider and a passenger, presented as dark silhouettes against a glowing road. Include a few small birds in the sky, depicting long, warm shadows and a hazy, sunlit scene behind the arch. Maintain an elegant, nostalgic feel while focusing on the tourism theme; no modern cars, additional landmarks, or any text other than the designated poster text are permitted.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 {argument name="destination" default="德里"}（印度）的复古装饰艺术风格旅游海报，采用 2:3 竖版比例。使用藏红花色、赭石色、深褐色、焦橙色和深青色的温暖旧纸色调，并添加细微的胶片颗粒感、做旧印刷纹理以及边缘的双细线边框。构图顶部需有一行巨大的粗体衬线标题，文字为“{argument name="headline text" default="DELHI"}”（深青色），下方是间距宽阔的红橙色文字“INDIA”。在标题左下方，放置一个拱形轮廓内的简单莲花图标，随后是斜体标语“{argument name="tagline" default="Where Empires Meet."}”、一个带有中心点的装饰性分隔符，以及坐标“{argument name="coordinates" default="28.6139° N, 77.2090° E"}”。右半部分及下方中心应展示黄金时刻的印度门（India Gate），采用写实但海报化的处理方式，以透视感呈现其宏伟气势，包含细致的石块纹理、拱门阴影，并在顶部附近刻有“INDIA”字样。在朦胧的左侧背景中，展示胡马雍陵或树丛中莫卧儿风格的圆顶纪念碑，并由日落氛围进行柔化处理。前景中需包含一辆人力三轮车，车上正好有两人：一名骑行者和一名乘客，以发光道路上的深色剪影呈现。天空中加入几只小鸟，并表现出长长的暖色阴影以及拱门后方的阳光薄雾。保持设计优雅、怀旧且聚焦于旅游主题，画面中不得出现现代汽车、额外的地标建筑，也不得包含除指定海报文字之外的任何其他文字。

templates.title: Mumbai Retro Travel Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 孟买复古旅行海报

templates.prompt: Create a travel poster in the style of retro Art Deco, with the theme of{argument name="city name" default="Mumbai"} ,{argument name="country name" default="India"} The poster uses a 2:3 vertical canvas with a thin double-lined border and a warm ochre, dark brown, and sunset gold old paper texture. At the very top, a large, bold, compressed serif font reads "MUMBAI" in a deep cyan color, spanning almost the entire width. Directly below and to the left, wide-spaced capital red letters read "INDIA." Below this is a simple line drawing of a sunrise icon, followed by an italicized slogan "The City That Never Sleeps.", and a small decorative separator with a centered dot. Below the separator, coordinate text is added.{argument name="coordinates" default="19.0760° N, 72.8777° E"} The lower two-thirds should showcase a cinematic sunset view of India Gate by the waterfront, presented in a realistic retro poster style: the monument, located on the right-center, is massive, with its arches and towers clearly visible; the background features an orange-glowing sky and clouds, the sun low near the horizon, and several small boats on the shimmering water; the foreground shows the coastal highway winding along Marine Drive. Below the foreground, a black and yellow vintage taxi is included on the road, while the left background includes small city skyline buildings, palm trees, streetlights, stone seawalls, and a few scattered pedestrians near the monument. Keep the typography clear and legible, with a nostalgic grain, slightly faded ink, and subtle halftone texture; avoid including any modern objects, logos, or unnecessary text.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张复古装饰艺术风格的旅行海报，主题为 {argument name="city name" default="孟买"}，{argument name="country name" default="印度"}。使用 2:3 的竖向海报画布，带有细双线边框，并呈现出暖赭色、深褐色和日落金色的旧纸质感。在最上方，放置巨大的粗体压缩衬线字体，写着“MUMBAI”，颜色为深青色，几乎横跨整个宽度。在其正下方左侧，添加间距宽阔的大写红色字母，写着“INDIA”。下方加入一个简单的线稿日出图标，接着是一行斜体标语“The City That Never Sleeps.”，以及一个带有居中圆点的小型装饰分隔符。在分隔符下方，添加坐标文本 {argument name="coordinates" default="19.0760° N, 72.8777° E"}。下三分之二处应展示海滨印度门的电影感日落景观，以写实的复古海报风格呈现：纪念碑位于中右侧，体量宏大，拱门和塔楼清晰可见；背景是橙色发光的天空和云朵，太阳低悬于地平线附近，波光粼粼的水面上有几艘小船，前景是沿海滨大道（Marine Drive）蜿蜒的滨海公路。在前景下方的道路上包含一辆黑黄相间的复古出租车，左侧背景有小型城市天际线建筑、棕榈树、路灯、石质海堤，以及纪念碑附近零星的微小行人。保持排版清晰易读，带有怀旧颗粒感、轻微褪色的墨迹和细腻的半色调纹理，不要包含任何现代物体、Logo 或多余的文字。

templates.title: Retro Chennai travel poster

titleLocalized.zh: 复古钦奈旅行海报

templates.prompt: Goal: To create a{argument name="city name" default="CHENNAI"} (Chennai){argument name="country label" default="INDIA"} A vintage travel poster (from India) evoking the atmosphere of early 20th-century railway travel advertisements. Canvas: Vertical poster, 2:3 aspect ratio, warm, aged paper background in shades of ochre, dark brown, and sunset orange. A thin double-lined rectangular border is added near the edges, printed in a soft reddish-brown. Layout: A large, capitalized headline spans the top.{argument name="city name" default="CHENNAI"} The font, a tall, compressed serif typeface in dark cyan ink, occupies approximately one-quarter of the top of the poster. Below it on the lower left, a smaller, wide-spaced capitalized country label is placed.{argument name="country label" default="INDIA"} The color is burnt red. A small line drawing of a temple gate is placed in the center below, and below the icon is a slogan in italic serif font.{argument name="tagline" default="Gateway to the South."} Add a small decorative separator below the slogan, consisting of two short horizontal lines and a centered dot, followed by the coordinates of a small, monospaced font.{argument name="coordinates" default="13.0827° N, 80.2707° E"} Main Scene: The lower two-thirds showcase Chennai's golden sunset beach, with the sea to the left, the low-hanging sun near the horizon, gentle waves reflecting off the wet sand, and a magnificent South Indian temple tower gate to the right. The temple is rendered as an extremely detailed Dravidian-style carved tower, rendered in deep amber and bronze shadows, rising from the shoreline wall; two smaller distant temple towers are added in the left-center background. Palm tree silhouettes and low-lying coastal promenade walls are added. Foreground Details: Includes exactly three prominent fishing boats: a large wooden boat spanning the bottom foreground, a narrow boat moored on the right-center beach, and another boat near the right waterline. Includes exactly six visible figures: two fisherman silhouettes beside the large boats on the left and center foreground, a fisherman standing in the right foreground, and three smaller figures beside the boats in the midground. Add exactly five small birds to the sky above the sea. Visual Style: Retro travel poster illustrations in a lithograph style, with soft grain, subtle paper texture, and a limited ink palette of cyan, burnt ochre, ochre, and dark brown. Strong sense of atmospheric perspective, dramatic warm sunset lighting, clear poster layout, no modern objects, no photorealistic feel, and no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张 {argument name="city name" default="CHENNAI"}（钦奈），{argument name="country label" default="INDIA"}（印度）的复古旅行海报，营造出 20 世纪初铁路旅游广告的氛围。

画布：竖版海报，2:3 纵横比，温暖的陈旧纸张背景，色调为赭石色、深褐色和日落橙。在边缘附近添加一个细的双线矩形边框，以柔和的红褐色印刷。

布局：顶部横跨巨大的大写标题 {argument name="city name" default="CHENNAI"}，采用高挑的压缩板衬线字体，深青色油墨，占据海报顶部约四分之一的位置。在其下方左侧，放置较小的宽间距大写国家标签 {argument name="country label" default="INDIA"}，颜色为焦红色。下方居中放置一个小型的线稿寺庙塔门图标，图标下方是斜体衬线字体的标语 {argument name="tagline" default="Gateway to the South."}。在标语下方添加一个微小的装饰性分隔符，包含两条短横线和一个居中的圆点，随后是小号等宽字体的坐标 {argument name="coordinates" default="13.0827° N, 80.2707° E"}。

主体场景：下三分之二展示了钦奈金色日落海滩，左侧为大海，低垂的太阳靠近地平线，波浪轻柔，湿润的沙滩呈现倒影，右侧是一座宏伟的南印度寺庙塔门。将寺庙渲染为极其精细的达罗毗荼风格雕刻塔楼，呈现深琥珀色和青铜色阴影，从海岸线墙上升起；在左中背景处增加两座较小的远景寺庙塔楼。添加棕榈树剪影和低矮的海岸长廊墙。

前景细节：包含确切 3 艘显眼的渔船：一艘横跨底部前景的大型木船，一艘停靠在中右侧沙滩上的窄船，以及另一艘位于右侧水线附近的船。包含确切 6 个可见的人物：左侧和中心前景大船旁有两个渔民剪影，右侧前景站立着一名渔民，中景处船只旁有三个较小的人物。在海上方的天空中添加确切 5 只小鸟。

视觉风格：石版画风格的复古旅行海报插画，柔和的颗粒感，微妙的纸张纹理，青色、焦赭色、赭石色和深褐色的有限油墨调色板。强烈的空气透视感，戏剧性的温暖日落光影，清晰的海报排版，无现代物体，无照片级写实感，无水印。

templates.title: Pistachio Rose Latte Scrapbook Poster

titleLocalized.zh: 开心果玫瑰拿铁剪贴簿海报

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a dreamy, retro scrapbook poster for a Korean-style cafe drink, featuring layered ice.{argument name="drink name" default="Pistachio Rose Latte"} Centered around a romantic pink and pistachio green color scheme, the design presents a Pinterest-style café diary aesthetic with handwritten annotations. Canvas: 2:3 vertical poster, warm natural light from a window, a cozy wooden café table backdrop, soft bokeh, creamy paper texture, torn edges, washi tape, paper clips, a Polaroid frame, doodles, stickers, rose petals, pistachio crumbs, and delicate gold glitter accents. Main element: A tall, clear latte glass sits in the center of a beige ceramic coaster. The drink is clearly visible in four layers: pale rose-pink rose syrup, white milk, matte pistachio green sauce with ice cubes and condensation on the glass, and fluffy pale pink rose cream foam. Five toppings adorn the top of the foam: dried rosebuds, pistachio crumbs, dried rose petals, tiny pink shavings, and scattered green nut powder. Add white hand-drawn arrows to label the four-layer drink: “Rose Cream (so fluffy!)”, “Pistachio Sauce”, “Fresh Milk”, and “Rose Syrup”. Add small handwritten text near the bottom of the cup: “stir & enjoy!♡”. Top title collage: Create a large, torn-edge cream-colored title card in the upper left corner, secured with pink patterned washi tape and green tape. The card text reads “Creamy & Dreamy♡”, above which is the large handwritten title “Pistachio Rose Latte”, where “Pistachio” is olive green and “Rose Latte” is greyish-rose red. Add a green pen-stroke label below containing the Korean phrase “피스타치오로즈라떼”. Decorate with pink bow stickers, small rose doodles, hearts, and glitter. Attach a narrow pink sticky note to the right edge, containing five lines of text: “soft,” “sweet,” “nutty,” “floral,” and “♡,” stamped with a round seal that reads “CAFE DIARY” and the handwritten “love this!” Left Ingredient Card: Add a torn-edge notebook card to the left, labeled “Ingredients.” It must list six ingredients with miniature icons: “Pistachio Sauce,” “Rose Cream,” “Fresh Milk,” “Rose Syrup,” “Ice,” and “Dried Rose & Pistachio.” Right Recipe Card: Add a small beige card secured with tape to the right, labeled “How to make ♡.” It must show seven numbered steps: “Add ice to the glass,” “Pour rose syrup,” “Add fresh milk,” “Add pistachio sauce,” “Top with rose cream,” “Sprinkle pistachio & dried rose,” and “Stir and enjoy.” Add a small pink bow doodle at the bottom. Photo and Memo Elements: Includes 2 Polaroid-style photos: one in the top right corner showing a window, pink roses in a glass bottle, and a cup of pink coffee, captioned "Sunday mood ♡"; and one in the bottom left corner showing baby's breath, pink roses, and pistachios, captioned "little things make big days ♡". Includes 3 small sticky note-style slips of paper: a pink heart tag on the right side that reads "Treat yourself Today! ☺"; a small note near the bottom left center that reads "it's giving..." followed by 3 lines of bullet points "soft girl", "cafe vibes", and "happy" with a bear face; and an illustration-style cafe diary card at the bottom center with Korean text, a cute bear, a latte illustration, and the tags "my favorite color combo!", "Pistachio", "Rose", and "#cafevibes #pistachiolover #roselatte". Includes a "DAILY MEMO" list secured in the lower right corner with a gold binder clip, featuring five checked items: "good coffee," "pretty flowers," "favorite song," "sweet treat," and "me time," ending with "= perfect day ♡." Peripheral props include: cookies on a plate in the lower left, a gold spoon with a pink gemstone handle near the bottom center, scattered dried rose petals and pistachios, a lace-textured base for the glass, and a small bowl or cup for pistachios in the lower right. The overall color scheme uses soft blush pink, sage green, cream, warm brown, and matte gold. Visual style: a photorealistic main drink image blended with hand-drawn scrapbook graphics, a Korean-style cafe mood board, simulated paper collage, watercolor graffiti, textured stationery, soft film grain, warm highlights, shallow depth of field, and a warm, comforting atmosphere. Constraints: Keep all text clear and handwritten; retain precisely counted cards, lists, labels, Polaroid photos, and sticky notes; avoid modern UI elements; avoid unnecessary drinking cups; no watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为一款韩式咖啡馆饮品创作一张梦幻复古的剪贴簿海报，以分层冰 {argument name="drink name" default="开心果玫瑰拿铁"} 为中心，采用浪漫的粉色与开心果绿配色，呈现 Pinterest 风格的咖啡馆日记美学及手写注释。

画布：2:3 竖版海报，温暖的窗边自然光，温馨的木质咖啡桌背景，柔和的焦外成像，奶油色纸张纹理，撕边效果，纸胶带，回形针，拍立得相框，涂鸦，贴纸，玫瑰花瓣，开心果碎，以及精致的金色闪光点缀。

主体：在米色陶瓷杯垫中央放置一杯高大的透明拿铁玻璃杯。饮品从下到上清晰可见 4 层：淡玫瑰粉色玫瑰糖浆、白色鲜奶、带有冰块和杯壁凝珠的哑光开心果绿酱，以及蓬松的淡粉色玫瑰奶油泡沫。在泡沫顶部装饰 5 种配料：干玫瑰花蕾、开心果碎、干玫瑰花瓣、细小粉色碎屑和零星的绿色坚果粉。添加白色手绘箭头标注 4 层饮品：“Rose Cream (so fluffy!)”、“Pistachio Sauce”、“Fresh Milk” 和 “Rose Syrup”。在杯底附近添加细小的手写文字：“stir & enjoy!♡”。

顶部标题拼贴：左上方制作一张大型撕边奶油色标题卡，用粉色花纹纸胶带和绿色胶带固定。卡片文字：“Creamy & Dreamy♡”，上方是手写体大标题“Pistachio Rose Latte”，其中“Pistachio”为橄榄绿色，“Rose Latte”为灰玫瑰红色。下方添加一个绿色笔触标签，包含韩文“피스타치오 로즈 라떼”。用粉色蝴蝶结贴纸、小玫瑰涂鸦、爱心和闪光点缀。在右侧边缘附上一张窄粉色便签，包含 5 行文字：“soft”、“sweet”、“nutty”、“floral”、“♡”，并盖有一个写着“CAFE DIARY”的圆形印章及手写体“love this!”。

左侧配料卡：在左侧添加一张撕边笔记本纸卡，标注为“Ingredients”。必须列出 6 种配料并配有微型图标：“Pistachio Sauce”、“Rose Cream”、“Fresh Milk”、“Rose Syrup”、“Ice” 和 “Dried Rose & Pistachio”。

右侧食谱卡：在右侧添加一张用胶带固定的米色小纸卡，标注为“How to make ♡”。必须显示 7 个编号步骤：“Add ice to the glass”、“Pour rose syrup”、“Add fresh milk”、“Add pistachio sauce”、“Top with rose cream”、“Sprinkle pistachio & dried rose” 和 “Stir and enjoy”。底部添加一个粉色蝴蝶结小涂鸦。

照片与备忘录元素：包含 2 张拍立得风格照片：右上角一张展示窗户、玻璃瓶中的粉色玫瑰和一杯粉色咖啡，配文“Sunday mood ♡”；左下角一张展示满天星、粉色玫瑰和开心果，配文“little things make big days ♡”。包含 3 张小型便利贴风格纸片：中右侧一张粉色爱心标签，写着“Treat yourself Today! ☺”；左下中心附近一张小纸条，写着“it’s giving...”后跟 3 行项目符号“soft girl”、“cafe vibes”、“happy”并配有一个小熊脸；底部中心一张插画风格咖啡馆日记卡，带有韩文、可爱小熊、拿铁绘图、标签“my favorite color combo!”、“Pistachio”、“Rose” 以及标签“#cafevibes #pistachiolover #roselatte”。包含一张右下角用金色长尾夹固定的“DAILY MEMO”清单，包含 5 个已勾选项目：“good coffee”、“pretty flowers”、“favorite song”、“sweet treat”、“me time”，结尾为“= perfect day ♡”。

周边道具：左下方盘子里放着饼干，底部中心附近有一把带有粉色宝石手柄的金色勺子，散落的干玫瑰花瓣和开心果，玻璃杯下有蕾丝垫片纹理，右下方有一个装开心果的小碗或小杯子。整体使用柔和的腮红粉、鼠尾草绿、奶油色、暖棕色和哑光金色。

视觉风格：照片级真实感的主体饮品与手绘剪贴簿图形融合，韩式咖啡馆 mood board，模拟纸张拼贴，水彩涂鸦，纹理文具，柔和胶片颗粒，暖色高光，浅景深，温馨治愈的氛围。

约束：保持所有文字清晰且为手写体，保留精确计数的卡片、列表、标签、拍立得和便利贴，避免现代 UI 元素，避免出现多余的饮用杯，无水印。
