templates.title: Elf Idol Subway Poster Scene

titleLocalized.zh: 精灵偶像地铁海报场景

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a cinematic, anime-style realistic scene inside a modern South Korean subway station, showcasing a life-size fantasy elf idol character standing next to a giant, backlit character design advertisement poster. The poster's protagonist is {argument name="character name" default="SERIO"} Canvas: Vertical 3:4 composition, eye-level perspective, realistic station perspective, warm indoor fluorescent lighting, smooth floor reflection, and shallow depth of field effect for the commuters in the background. Subject: A tall, elegant female sprite with a very graceful {argument name="hair color" default="orange"} Long hair, bright blue eyes, pointed ears, and a delicate anime face; her expression is calm and slightly serious. She stands on the left side of the image, facing forward, one hand gently touching or pointing at the poster. She wears a luxurious ivory-white fantasy concert gown: draped satin fabric, a high slit, semi-transparent shawl sleeves, orange ribbon embellishments, gold jewelry details, a cinched waist, anklets, and white strappy high-heeled sandals. Her design should evoke the feeling of bringing a high-end virtual idol into the real world, blending anime style with photorealistic lighting and fabric textures. Environment: A Korean subway platform corridor with tiled walls, dark ceiling panels, metal pillars, and blurred pedestrians in the background. Includes two overhead directional signs: a large yellow sign with a left arrow, the number "3," and the Korean word for "exit"; below it is a smaller dark sign with Korean transfer information. The background should have a candid urban feel, like a mobile phone photo taken at a busy station or a street fashion shot. Poster Layout: Create a large, black-bordered, backlit white poster on the right wall. This is a detailed anime character design chart and concert advertisement. The poster has a prominent orange serif title in the upper left corner: "{argument name="headline text" default="SERIO CONCERT"} Below this is a smaller date text "2026.5.21" and a brief Korean description of the concert/event. The poster should contain 9 main visual areas: a large half-body portrait of an elf, a full-body character rendering, a Korean profile text block, a design highlight area including ear and clothing sketches, a color palette/expression area, a fabric flow sketch area, a dynamic pose area, a key proportion weapon/accessory area, and a makeup detail/notes area. Poster detail count: The color palette/expression area must show 8 small portraits of the same elf, arranged in two rows of 4, each with a slightly different expression or angle. The dynamic pose area must show 2 small poses of the elf. The makeup detail/notes area must show 2 close-up drawings of blue eyes. The key proportion area must show 2 crystal-like accessory or weapon drawings. The design highlight area must include 3 sketches: pointed ear jewelry, upper body/clothing details, and leg or shoe details. Visual Style: A blend of high-end anime illustration and realistic subway photography, featuring soft orange-white tones, a glowing poster effect, crisp, fine-line conceptual art on the posters, elegant serif fonts, tiny Korean annotations, subtle shimmering icons around character design elements, and ultra-fine hair strands and silk folds. Constraints: Keep the images as single scenes, not collages. Do not add extra main characters. Avoid using logos, watermarks, or recognizable brand names. Make the Korean microtext look like realistic design notes, while limiting the main readable text to titles, dates, station signs, and short section labels such as PROFILE, DESIGN POINT, DYNAMIC POSE, KEY SCALE, MAKEUP DETAIL, and NOTES.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创建一个位于现代韩国地铁站内的电影级动漫写实场景，展示一位真人大小的奇幻精灵偶像角色，站在一张巨大的背光角色设计广告海报旁，海报主角为 {argument name="character name" default="SERIO"}。

画布：垂直 3:4 构图，平视视角，写实的车站透视，温暖的室内荧光灯照明，光洁的地板反射，背景通勤者采用浅景深效果。

主体：一位高挑优雅的女性精灵，拥有非常飘逸的 {argument name="hair color" default="orange"} 长发、明亮的蓝色眼睛、长尖耳、精致的动漫面孔，表情冷静且略显严肃。她站在画面左侧，面向前方，一只手轻轻触碰或指向海报。她身穿奢华的象牙白奇幻演唱会礼服：垂坠感缎面布料、高开叉设计、半透明披肩袖、橙色丝带装饰、金色珠宝细节、细腰饰、脚链以及白色绑带高跟凉鞋。她的设计应呈现出一种将高端虚拟偶像带入现实世界的感觉，融合动漫风格与照片级的灯光和布料质感。

环境：韩国地铁站台走廊，带有瓷砖墙壁、深色天花板面板、金属立柱，背景中有模糊的行人。包含 2 个头顶导向标志：一个大型黄色标志，带有左箭头、数字“3”以及韩文“出口”字样；下方是一个较小的深色标志，带有韩文换乘信息。背景应呈现出一种抓拍的城市感，如同在繁忙车站拍摄的手机照片或街拍时尚照。

海报布局：在右侧墙壁上，创建一张巨大的黑色边框背光白色海报。这是一张详细的动漫角色设定表和演唱会广告。海报左上方有醒目的橙色衬线标题文字“{argument name="headline text" default="SERIO CONCERT"}”，下方配有较小的日期文字“2026.5.21”以及简短的韩文演唱会/活动说明。海报应包含 9 个主要视觉区域：1 个精灵的大型半身肖像、1 个全身角色渲染图、1 个韩文个人资料文本块、1 个包含耳朵和服装草图的设计要点区、1 个调色板/表情区、1 个布料流动草图区、1 个动态姿势区、1 个关键比例武器/配饰区以及 1 个妆容细节/备注区。

海报细节计数：调色板/表情区必须展示 8 个相同精灵的小头像，排列为上下两行，每行 4 个，每个表情或角度略有不同。动态姿势区必须展示 2 个精灵的小型动作姿势。妆容细节/备注区必须展示 2 个蓝眼睛的特写绘图。关键比例区必须展示 2 个水晶般的配饰或武器绘图。设计要点区必须包含 3 个草图标注：尖耳珠宝、上半身/服装细节以及腿部或鞋子细节。

视觉风格：高级动漫插画与写实地铁摄影相结合，柔和的橙白色调，发光的海报效果，海报上清晰的细线条概念艺术，优雅的衬线字体，微小的韩文注释，角色设定元素周围有细微的闪光图标，超精细的发丝和丝绸褶皱。

约束：保持图像为单一场景，而非拼贴画。不要添加额外的主角。避免使用徽标、水印或可识别的品牌名称。使韩文微型文字看起来像真实的各种设计备注，同时将主要可读文本限制在标题、日期、车站标志以及简短的章节标签，如 PROFILE（个人资料）、DESIGN POINT（设计要点）、DYNAMIC POSE（动态姿势）、KEY SCALE（关键比例）、MAKEUP DETAIL（妆容细节）和 NOTES（备注）。

templates.title: Dream Garden Hanfu Selfie

titleLocalized.zh: 梦幻花园汉服自拍

templates.prompt: Create a photorealistic vertical mobile phone selfie featuring an adult woman dressed in a gorgeous, dreamlike fantasy-style outfit against a backdrop of a lush classical garden. The camera is positioned high, slightly overhead, shooting close-up at the outstretched arms, creating a strong sense of perspective and composition for the upper body. She wears a long Hanfu-style dress in a blend of pale pink and semi-transparent white, with embroidered sheer cuffs, floral appliqués, delicate gold trim, and a low neckline. She wears a multi-layered gold necklace, a gold floral choker, dangling gold-pink hair accessories, and a crystal bead chain. Her hair is styled in an elegant updo, with long, wet, dark hair cascading down either side of her face. Completely cover her face with a solid-color, opaque square mask in the center of the frame, similar to her skin tone, while preserving details of her hair, jewelry, neck, shoulders, and clothing. The background is a brightly lit garden with lush green trees, neatly trimmed shrubs, a pond or stream behind her, pink and purple flowerbeds, rocks, and a light-colored stone arch bridge in the distance. Utilizing realistic sunlight effects, natural skin textures, glossy fabric highlights, shallow depth of field, and the realism of mobile phone photography, this work emphasizes luxurious clothing details, a garden atmosphere, and intimate selfie compositions. There is no text, no watermark, and no other people present.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张照片级逼真的竖屏手机自拍，画面主体为一名身着华丽梦幻仙侠风格服饰的成年女性，背景为葱郁的古典花园。相机以高位略微俯视的角度在手臂伸展处近距离拍摄，双臂向观众方向延伸，营造出强烈的自拍透视感和上半身构图。她身穿淡粉色与半透明白色交织的汉服风格长裙，配有薄纱刺绣袖口、花卉贴花、精致金边及低领设计；佩戴多层金项链、金色花卉颈圈、垂坠的金粉色发饰、水晶珠链，并梳着精致的发髻，长而湿润的深色发丝垂落在脸庞两侧。用一个位于画面中心、与肤色相近的纯色不透明方形遮挡块完全覆盖面部，同时保留头发、珠宝、颈部、肩部和服饰细节。背景为明亮阳光下的花园，有茂密的绿树、修剪整齐的灌木、身后的池塘或溪流、粉紫色花坛、岩石以及远处的浅色石拱桥。采用真实的日光效果、自然的皮肤纹理、光泽面料高光、浅景深以及手机摄影的真实感。强调华丽的服饰细节、花园氛围和亲密的自拍构图。无文字，无水印，无其他人物。

templates.title: Cinematic-quality astronaut cockpit scene

titleLocalized.zh: 电影级宇航员驾驶舱场景

templates.prompt: Create a dark, cinematic-quality sci-fi cockpit scene with a hardcore, realistic style: an astronaut pilot.{argument name="pilot type" default="Armored astronaut pilot"} Seated slightly to the left in the cockpit of an old-fashioned military spacecraft or aircraft, the pilot sits in a worn brown leather command chair. He wears a heavy black tactical pressurized suit with straps, a breastplate, gloves, and a glossy black helmet with segmented metal details. The helmet visor area is deliberately obscured by a solid, dark square visor, obscuring both the face and the front visor. The pilot grips a pale green joystick in each hand, arms outstretched. He is surrounded by a dense array of analog control panels, switches, knobs, cables, worn metal walls, and dim green instrument displays. To the right, a large rectangular cockpit window displays a hazy aerial view of a pale sky over a desert plain and low hills, covered by a thin green HUD overlay with barely discernible small data markers along the top edge. Below the window are two smaller console screens, emitting a soft green glow between buttons and dials. Employ understated, emotional lighting with bluish-green shadows, a dusty, voluminous atmosphere, high contrast, realistic textures, worn metal, black leather, and cinematic heavy lighting effects. The composition should evoke the feel of a dystopian space movie still, with a 4:3 aspect ratio, medium to close-up indoor shots, and no visible text, extra characters, logos, or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一个昏暗的电影级科幻驾驶舱场景，风格硬核写实：一名宇航员飞行员，{argument name="pilot type" default="装甲宇航员飞行员"}，坐在旧式军用航天器或飞行器驾驶舱内，位置偏左，坐在一张磨损的棕色皮革指挥椅上。飞行员身穿厚重的黑色战术增压服，配有绑带、胸甲、手套，以及带有金属分段细节的亮黑色头盔。头盔面罩区域被一个实心的深色方形遮挡块故意遮盖，挡住了脸部和前部面罩。飞行员双手各握住一个淡绿色操纵杆，双臂向前伸展。飞行员周围环绕着密集的模拟控制面板、开关、旋钮、线缆、磨损的金属墙壁以及昏暗的绿色仪表显示屏。在右侧，包含一个大型矩形驾驶舱窗户，展示出淡色天空下荒漠平原和低矮丘陵的朦胧航拍景观，窗户上覆盖着一层薄薄的绿色 HUD 叠加层，顶部边缘带有难以辨认的小型数据标记。窗户下方设有两块较小的控制台屏幕，在按钮和表盘间发出柔和的绿光。采用低调的情绪化照明，带有青蓝色阴影、尘土飞扬的体积感氛围、高对比度、写实纹理、磨损的金属、黑色皮革以及电影级的重打光效果。构图应呈现出反乌托邦太空电影剧照的质感，4:3 纵横比，中近景室内镜头，无可见文字，无额外角色，无 Logo，无水印。

templates.title: Mechanical Lotus Android Bionic Portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 机械莲花安卓仿生人肖像

templates.prompt: Create a surreal sci-fi portrait with a dark cinematic feel, set against a backdrop of a ruined artificial garden. The main subject is a half-body of the android, a cracked white porcelain humanoid figure, above the chest, slightly turned to the left. Brass and steel mechanical structures are visible at the neck and skull. A realistic human ear is visible on the left. The entire face is covered by a smooth, vertically rectangular, featureless gray mask. From the open head grows an exquisite crown composed of 11 mechanical lotus flowers and seed pods, with slender, articulated metal rods as stems. The crown includes five blooming flowers with layered ivory-white metal petals, five closed circular seed pods, and one half-open flower. All the flowers exhibit a rusty, jointed, biomechanical texture. The android's body is constructed from aged ceramic armor plates, riddled with fine cracks, gaps, seams, rivets, and exposed dark cables. Background: Under a somber, gray sky, a dystopian cemetery or museum city comprised of man-made sculptures and skeletal towers, with a shallow depth of field; a stone plaque stands to the right, clearly engraved with five lines of black serif capital letters, centered: "ARTIFICIAL ART WILL LEAD TO ARTIFICIAL THOUGHTS". Using soft ivory, gunmetal, brass, charcoal, and cool gray tones, dramatic overcast lighting, a highly detailed realistic style, Baroque mechanical ornamentation, a melancholic atmosphere, a vertical 2:3 composition, no watermark, and no additional text besides the stone plaque. Custom scene, with the portrait subject set as {argument name="android subject" default="A cracked white porcelain humanoid Android android"} The head growth is{argument name="head growth" default="Mechanical lotus and seed pod"} Background set to{argument name="background setting" default="artificial garden cemetery resembling ruins"} The inscription on the stone tablet is{argument name="sign text" default="ARTIFICIAL ART WILL LEAD TO ARTIFICIAL THOUGHTS"} Color scheme used{argument name="color palette" default="Soft ivory white, gunmetal gray, brass, charcoal black, and cool gray"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张黑暗电影感超现实科幻肖像，背景为废墟般的人造花园：画面主体为胸部以上的裂纹白瓷人形安卓仿生人半身像，身体略微向左转，颈部和颅骨处露出黄铜与钢制机械结构，左侧可见一只写实的人类耳朵，整个面部被一个光滑的垂直长方形灰色无特征面具覆盖。从敞开的头部生长出一顶精致的冠冕，由 11 朵机械莲花和种子荚组成，花茎为纤细的铰接金属杆：包括 5 朵层叠象牙白金属花瓣的盛开花朵、5 个闭合的圆形花荚以及 1 朵半开的小花，所有花朵均呈现出锈迹斑斑、带有关节的生物机械质感。安卓身体由老化的陶瓷装甲板构成，布满细微裂纹、缺口、接缝、铆钉及裸露的深色线缆。背景：在阴沉灰暗的天空下，一座由人造雕像和骨架塔构成的反乌托邦墓地或博物馆城市，浅景深效果；右侧立有一块石牌，上面清晰地刻着黑色的衬线体大写字母，分为五行居中排列：“ARTIFICIAL ART WILL LEAD TO ARTIFICIAL THOUGHTS”。使用柔和的象牙白、枪灰色、黄铜色、炭黑色和冷灰色调，戏剧性的阴天光照，高细节写实风格，巴洛克式机械装饰，忧郁氛围，垂直 2:3 构图，无水印，除石牌外无额外文字。自定义场景，将肖像主体设为 {argument name="android subject" default="一个裂纹白瓷人形安卓仿生人"}，头部生长物为 {argument name="head growth" default="机械莲花和种子荚"}，背景设为 {argument name="background setting" default="废墟般的人造花园墓地"}，石牌文字为 {argument name="sign text" default="ARTIFICIAL ART WILL LEAD TO ARTIFICIAL THOUGHTS"}，配色方案使用 {argument name="color palette" default="柔和象牙白、枪灰色、黄铜色、炭黑色和冷灰色"}。

templates.title: "Sunset Rendezvous" Animation Storyboard

titleLocalized.zh: “日落之约” 动画分镜卡

templates.prompt: Objective: To create cinematic storyboard graphics for animated cues, designed as a comic book-style scene layout incorporating dialogue and a timeline. Canvas: 16:9 widescreen landscape canvas, approximately 1152×768 pixels. The top third is a black script title bar, and the bottom two-thirds are a 10-grid storyboard grid. Panels are separated by thin white lines, creating a clean layout and a professional project style. Title Bar: Black background with clear white sans-serif font. Top line text: Scene Title:{argument name="scene title" default="Sunset Rendezvous"} Duration:{argument name="duration" default="~10 seconds"} | Type/Atmosphere:{argument name="genre and mood" default="Touching, bittersweet"} Below are 10 numbered shot descriptions, accompanied by yellow timecodes and white descriptions: 1. 0:00 - 0:01 Long shot. Rooftop at sunset. Boy and girl stand separately, facing each other. The wind is blowing. 2. 0:01 - 0:02 Medium close-up of the boy. He takes a deep breath, hesitant. Boy: "I have something to tell you..." 3. 0:02 - 0:03 Medium close-up of the girl. She turns to him, full of curiosity. 4. 0:03 - 0:04 Close-up of the boy. He says affectionately. Boy: "Thank you... for everything you've done for me." 5. 0:04 - 0:05 Close-up of the girl. She is surprised, her eyes are moist. 6. 0:05 - 0:06 Close-up of the boy. He gives a warm smile. Boy:{argument name="farewell line" default="I will never forget you."} 7. 0:06 - 0:07 Close-up of the girl. Tears well up, she tries hard to hold them back. 8. 0:07 - 0:08 Long shot. A moment of silence between them. The wind and the sunset fill this instant. 9. 0:08 - 0:09 The boy turns and slowly walks away. The girl watches, but cannot call out. 10. 0:09 - 0:10 Close-up of the girl, reaching out to stop him. Tears fall. Fade out. (No dialogue) Storyboard: 10 frames in total, arranged in two rows and five columns. Each frame has a small white square number label in the upper left corner and a small white time code in the upper right corner. The frame labels are: Top row 1, 2, 3, 4, 5; Bottom row 6, 7, 8, 9, 10. The timecodes are: 0:00 - 0:01, 0:01 - 0:02, 0:02 - 0:03, 0:03 - 0:04, 0:04 - 0:05, 0:05 - 0:06, 0:06 - 0:07, 0:07 - 0:08, 0:08 - 0:09, 0:09 - 0:10. Visuals: Employing a dramatic Japanese animated film style, the visuals feature warm orange-pink sunset lighting, rooftop railings, a damp, reflective rooftop surface, a distant city skyline, a blazing sun near the horizon, and hair blowing in the wind. The characters are a boy in a dark Japanese school uniform and a girl in a sailor uniform with long brown hair. In close-up shots, opaque brown rectangular masking blocks are used to cover the characters' faces to match the generated visual effects. Frame-by-frame description: 1) Rooftop distant view: Boy and girl stand separately, facing each other, with the sunset between them. 2) Boy medium close-up: Chest up, wearing a dark school uniform, sunset skyline in the background, face obscured by a brown rectangle. 3) Girl medium close-up: Turning towards the boy, long hair flowing, wearing a sailor uniform, face obscured by a brown rectangle. 4) Boy side close-up: Speaking, sunset in the background, most of his face obscured by a brown rectangle. 5) Girl's reaction close-up: Hair sweeping across the frame, face obscured by a brown rectangle. 6) Boy close-up: With a subtle, warm smile, face obscured by a brown rectangle. 7) Girl close-up: Holding back tears, hair blowing in the wind, face obscured by a brown rectangle. 8) Rooftop distant view: Silent shot of the two maintaining distance against the sunset background. 9) Boy's back view: Walking away, girl remaining by the railing, orange sky in the background. 10) Girl close-up: One hand reaching towards the camera, hinting at tears, face obscured by a brown rectangle. Visual style: High-detail animation keyframes, cinematic lighting, a touching and slightly bittersweet atmosphere, soft film grain, saturated sunset clouds, reflective puddles, simple white panel borders, clear typography, and no logos or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为动画提示词创建一个电影感的动画分镜图像卡，设计为包含台词和时间轴的漫画式场景规划。

画布：宽屏 16:9 横向画布，尺寸约为 1152×768，顶部三分之一为黑色脚本标题栏，底部三分之二为 10 宫格分镜网格。面板之间使用细白线分隔，布局简洁，呈现专业项目风格。

标题栏：黑色背景，配以清晰的白色无衬线字体。顶行文字：场景标题：{argument name="scene title" default="日落之约"} | 时长：{argument name="duration" default="~10 秒"} | 类型 / 氛围：{argument name="genre and mood" default="感人，苦涩"}。下方包含 10 个带编号的镜头说明，配有黄色时间码和白色描述：
1. 0:00 - 0:01 远景。日落时的天台。男孩和女孩分开站立，面对面。风在吹。
2. 0:01 - 0:02 男孩中近景。他深吸一口气，有些犹豫。男孩：“我有话要对你说……”
3. 0:02 - 0:03 女孩中近景。她转向他，充满好奇。
4. 0:03 - 0:04 男孩特写。他深情地说道。男孩：“谢谢你……为我做的一切。”
5. 0:04 - 0:05 女孩特写。她感到惊讶，眼眶湿润。
6. 0:05 - 0:06 男孩特写。他露出一抹温暖的微笑。男孩：{argument name="farewell line" default="我不会忘记你的。"}
7. 0:06 - 0:07 女孩特写。泪水涌出，她努力忍住不让泪水落下。
8. 0:07 - 0:08 远景。两人之间沉默片刻。风和日落填满了这一瞬间。
9. 0:08 - 0:09 男孩转身缓慢走开。女孩注视着，却无法呼喊出声。
10. 0:09 - 0:10 女孩特写，伸手挽留。泪水滑落。淡出。（无对白）

分镜网格：共 10 个画面，排列为两行五列。每个画面左上角有一个白色小方块编号标签，右上角有一个白色小时间码。画面标签为：顶行 1、2、3、4、5；底行 6、7、8、9、10。时间码分别为：0:00 - 0:01, 0:01 - 0:02, 0:02 - 0:03, 0:03 - 0:04, 0:04 - 0:05, 0:05 - 0:06, 0:06 - 0:07, 0:07 - 0:08, 0:08 - 0:09, 0:09 - 0:10。

逐格画面描述：1) 天台远景，男孩和女孩分开站立，面对面，日落位于两人中间。2) 男孩中近景，胸部以上，深色校服，背景为日落天际线，面部被棕色矩形遮挡。3) 女孩中近景，转向男孩，长发飘动，水手服，面部被棕色矩形遮挡。4) 男孩侧面特写，正在说话，背景为日落，面部大部分被棕色矩形遮挡。5) 女孩反应特写，头发掠过画面，面部被棕色矩形遮挡。6) 男孩特写，带着微妙的温暖微笑，面部被棕色矩形遮挡。7) 女孩特写，忍住泪水，头发被风吹起，面部被棕色矩形遮挡。8) 天台远景，两人在日落背景下保持距离的沉默镜头。9) 男孩背影，正在走开，女孩留在护栏旁，背景为橙色天空。10) 女孩特写，一只手伸向镜头，暗示泪水，面部被棕色矩形遮挡。

templates.title: Flash photography on the Bund in Shanghai

titleLocalized.zh: 上海外滩闪光灯抓拍

templates.prompt: Create a realistic snapshot of a Shanghai street late at night, showcasing Japanese negative film aesthetics, using a direct flash photography style with a Ricoh GR III or disposable film camera. The subject is a young urban woman standing very close to the lens on the Bund riverside. The composition is a slightly casual handheld vertical shot, with the frame extending from mid-thigh to above her head. She has {argument name="hair color" default="Messy light pink hair"} Her hair was tousled by the wind, partially obscuring her head, and her hands were raised high above her head in a natural and casual pose. Her face was deliberately obscured by a soft, pinkish-white square occlusion. She wore an oversized black T-shirt with a large, distressed, horror-style graphic on the front, and a thin necklace. Two accessories were clearly visible on her raised right wrist: a colorful beaded bracelet and a dangling silver pendant bracelet. The background featured brightly lit historical buildings and a clock tower in Shanghai on the left, and a deep, modern skyline on the right. The ground was wet, with railings and a dimly lit riverside promenade. The image needed to convey strong highlights on the skin and shirt, deep shadows with low contrast, visible film grain, slight motion blur in the hair and hands, an imperfect, tilted handheld feel, a casual, diary-like urban girl atmosphere, random natural imperfections, realistic skin texture, and warm architectural lights under a black night sky, avoiding any overly polished studio feel.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张深夜上海街头的写实抓拍，呈现日本负片美学，采用 Ricoh GR III 或一次性胶片相机的直闪摄影风格。主体是一位年轻的都市女性，她站在外滩江边，距离镜头非常近，构图采用略显随意的手持竖构图，取景范围从大腿中部到头部上方。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="凌乱的淡粉色头发"}，发丝被风吹乱并遮住部分头部，双手高举过头顶，姿态自然随性；她的面部被一个柔和肤粉色的正方形遮挡块刻意遮住。她身穿一件超大号黑色 T 恤，正面印有大型做旧恐怖风格图案，佩戴一条细项链，高举的右腕上清晰可见两件配饰：一条彩色串珠手链和一条垂坠的银色吊坠手链。背景左侧是灯火通明的上海历史建筑和钟楼，右侧是深邃的现代天际线灯光，地面湿润，配有栏杆和昏暗的江滨步道。画面需体现皮肤和衬衫上的强闪光高光、低对比度的深邃阴影、可见的胶片颗粒、头发和手部的轻微动态模糊、不完美的手持倾斜感、随性的日记风都市女孩氛围、随机的自然瑕疵、真实的皮肤质感，以及黑色夜空下温暖的建筑灯光，避免任何精致的影棚感。

templates.title: Luxury Purple Anime Acrylic Brick

titleLocalized.zh: 奢华紫色动漫亚克力砖

templates.prompt: Objective: To create a high-end product photograph showcasing a thick, transparent, multi-layered acrylic tile containing richly detailed 2D anime collage artwork, resembling a luxurious acrylic collectible crafted from illustrations. Visuals: A 2:3 aspect ratio product photograph, a slightly overhead, three-quarters close-up view of the acrylic tile standing upright on a lace-covered table. A shallow depth-of-field effect is used, with a deep purple studio background featuring purple highlights, crystal beads, pearls, faceted gemstones, and softly glowing candles in the distance. Subject: A large, rectangular, transparent acrylic tile, approximately 5–7 cm thick, with polished and chamfered edges, revealing stacked transparent layers, refractive sidewalls, internal reflections, caustic effects, and glossy highlights. The front is covered with delicate gold-white foil-like printed decorations, making the anime artwork appear to float within the multiple acrylic layers, creating a deep 3D collage effect. Core Artwork: Inside the tile, showcasing…{argument name="character name" default="An elegant faceless anime heroine"} She wears a deep purple and black fantasy kimono-style long dress with flowing, semi-transparent sleeves, ribbon-like fabric, lavender floral embellishments, and long, dark purple hair that spreads out in the image. Her face is obscured by a small, softly edged purple square located at the center of her head. She holds or is surrounded by glowing paper lanterns. Behind her are radiating violet moons or circular magical halos, starry night textures, shimmering mist, and silhouettes of umbrella-shaped fans. Overall atmosphere: mysterious, romantic, luxurious, and nighttime. Colors and lighting: The main colors are deep purple, amethyst, indigo, black, lavender purple, clear crystal, and metallic gold. There is a strong internal purple glow behind the character, with outline lighting on the acrylic edges, featuring glitter particles, prism refraction, and highly realistic product photography reflection effects. Printed Decorative Elements: Seven striking decorative patterns are used on the acrylic surface: 1) Gold and white butterflies scattered at the top and lower left; 2) Wreaths and flowers along the left and bottom; 3) Ornate openwork borders and corner decorations; 4) Tiny stars and sparkles scattered throughout; 5) A hanging lantern illustration integrated with the character; 6) A pink heart-shaped gem sticker on the right; 7) A crescent moon and chain decoration in the lower left corner. Suspended Creatures: Three red goldfish are added to the acrylic scene: one near the character's sleeve on the left, one near the character's hand on the right, and a larger goldfish in the lower right foreground. They appear to float in acrylic layers of different depths, creating different refraction effects. Printed Text on Objects: As part of the high-end packaging design, an ornate gold handwritten font and small serif font are added. The upper left corner contains {argument name="main title text" default="Eternal Night"} The left side contains vertical Chinese text.{argument name="vertical label text" default="Eternal Night"} The word is written in large gold cursive script in the lower left corner.{argument name="decorative script text" default="Beautiful"} There is a small serial number label in the upper right corner that reads "No. 5201314", and a small reference plaque in the lower right corner that contains the following information:{argument name="quote text" default="You are The one Makes me Smile"} Minor decorative text may be present, but should be secondary and not overshadow the main subject. Surface setup: Place the acrylic tile on luxurious white lace fabric, with purple crystals, pink rhinestones, pearl strands, and shimmering beads scattered in the foreground. The environment should evoke the feel of a luxury collectible photograph, not a flat illustration. Style and quality: Combine hyper-realistic macro product photography with anime illustrations encased in acrylic; extremely sharp front details, realistic transparency, layered parallax, high-contrast purple lighting, high-end handcrafted aesthetics, no watermarks, no extra characters, no packaging box, and no hands.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：创作一张超高端产品摄影照片，展示一块厚实的透明多层亚克力砖，内部包含细节丰富的 2D 动漫拼贴画，仿佛一件由插画制作而成的奢华亚克力收藏品。

画面：垂直 2:3 比例的产品摄影，从上方略微俯视的三分之四侧面特写，亚克力砖直立在铺有蕾丝的桌面上。使用浅景深效果，背景为深紫色的摄影棚，带有紫色光斑、水晶珠、珍珠、切面宝石和远处柔和发光的蜡烛。

主体：一块大型长方形透明亚克力砖，厚度约 5–7 厘米，边缘经过抛光倒角处理，可见堆叠的透明层、折射侧壁、内部反射、焦散效果和光泽高光。正面覆盖着精致的金白色箔片状印刷装饰，动漫艺术作品仿佛悬浮在多个亚克力层中，呈现出深邃的 3D 拼贴效果。

核心艺术：在砖块内部，展示 {argument name="character name" default="一位优雅的无脸动漫女主角"}，身穿深紫色和黑色奇幻和服风格长裙，带有飘逸的半透明袖子、丝带状织物、薰衣草花卉装饰，以及在画面中散开的长长的黑紫色头发。她的脸部被一个位于头顶中心、边缘柔和的小紫色方块遮挡。她手持或被发光的纸灯笼环绕。在她身后，加入放射状的紫罗兰色月亮或圆形魔法光环、星夜纹理、闪烁的雾气以及伞状扇子剪影。整体氛围：神秘、浪漫、奢华、夜色。

色彩与灯光：主色调为深紫、紫水晶、靛蓝、黑、薰衣草紫、透明水晶和金属金。角色后方有强烈的内部紫色光芒，亚克力边缘有轮廓光，带有闪光颗粒、棱镜折射以及高度逼真的产品摄影反射效果。

印刷装饰元素：在亚克力表面使用 7 组醒目的装饰图案：1) 散布在顶部和左下方的金白色蝴蝶，2) 沿左侧和底部的花环与花朵，3) 华丽的镂空花纹边框和角落装饰，4) 遍布各处的微小星星和闪光，5) 与角色融为一体的悬挂灯笼插画，6) 右侧的一个粉色心形宝石贴纸，7) 左下角的月牙和链条装饰。

悬浮生物：在亚克力场景内加入 3 条红色金鱼：一条在左侧角色袖子附近，一条在右侧角色手部附近，一条较大的金鱼在右下角前景。让它们看起来悬浮在不同深度的亚克力层中，并呈现出不同的折射效果。

印刷在物体上的文字：作为高端包装设计的一部分，添加华丽的金色手写体和小型衬线字体。在左上角包含 {argument name="main title text" default="Eternal Night"}，左侧包含中文竖排文字 {argument name="vertical label text" default="永恒的夜"}，左下角用大型金色草书书写单词 {argument name="decorative script text" default="Beautiful"}，右上角有一个小型序列号标签“No. 5201314”，右下角有一个小型引用铭牌，内容为 {argument name="quote text" default="You are The one Makes me Smile"}。可以存在额外的微小装饰性文字，但应作为次要元素，不应喧宾夺主。

表面设置：将亚克力砖放置在华丽的白色蕾丝织物上，前景散布着紫色水晶、粉色水钻、珍珠串和光泽珠子。环境应营造出奢华收藏品拍摄的质感，而非平面插画。

风格与质量：超写实微距产品摄影与封存在亚克力中的动漫插画相结合；正面细节极其锐利，真实的透明材质，分层视差，高对比度紫色灯光，高端手工周边美学，无水印，无额外角色，无包装盒，无手部。

templates.title: Bioluminescent plush biodesign diagram

titleLocalized.zh: 生物发光毛绒生物设计图

templates.prompt: Objective: For the name{argument name="character name" default="Bioluminescent Cream Forest Baby"} This adorable plush creature was used to create realistic 3D character references, aiming for consistent video generation results. Canvas: Vertical 4:5. Character design using a matte mid-gray studio background, soft diffused lighting, subtle ground shadows, and high-resolution photorealistic fur rendering. Main details: The character is a chubby little teddy bear/cat hybrid, with a round head, short, round body, thin arms, short, stubby legs, thick cream-colored plush fur, glossy dark olive-brown eyes with bright highlights, a small, dark brown nose and mouth, pale pink cheeks, a single, fine, curly hair on the top of the head, small, rounded ears emitting a bioluminescent green glow inside, and a short tail with a glowing green tip. The overall atmosphere is cute, soft, and toy-like, with realistic fibrous textures and a soft, translucent quality in the glowing green areas.{argument name="fur color" default="Warm cream color"} ,{argument name="glow color" default="Bioluminescent green"} and{argument name="cheek color" default="Soft pink blush"} Layout: The design is divided into two rows. The top row contains three full-body three-view drawings, evenly distributed and labeled with small white capital letters: 1) "01 FRONT" shows the character's front view, 2) "02 3/4 LEFT" shows the left 3/4 view, revealing the tail, and 3) "03 BACK" shows the rear view, including the round head, back fur, forearms, legs, and glowing tail tip. The bottom left corner contains an expression image with three vertically arranged border panels, labeled "EXPRESSION SHEET" above and accompanied by explanatory text below: 1) "01 NEUTRAL" shows a calm frontal gaze and slightly closed mouth, 2) "02 BATTLE FURY" shows the face obscured by a centered opaque beige square, and 3) "03 SHOCK" shows a surprised expression with perked-up ears, wide eyes, and an open mouth. The bottom right corner contains a color palette column called "COLOR PALETTE," with 5 rectangular color blocks and labels: 1) "CREAM FUR" (beige fur texture), 2) "BIOLUMINESCENT GREEN" (glowing green gradient), 3) "PINK CHEEK" (rose pink texture), 4) "DARK BROWN OUTLINE / NOSE" (dark brown color block), and 5) "WHITE HIGHLIGHT" (white color block). Text style: Small, simple sans-serif uppercase white labels, using minimalist character design typography, with precise alignment and no jarring elements. Constraints: Maintain 3 three-view charts, 3 expression panels, and 5 color blocks. Do not add additional characters, props, logos, watermarks, or decorative background elements. Maintain consistent proportions, fur texture, glowing ears and tail, and facial design across all views.

promptLocalized.zh:
目标：为名为 {argument name="character name" default="生物发光奶油森林幼崽"} 的可爱毛绒生物创建逼真的 3D 角色参考图，旨在实现一致的视频生成效果。

画布：垂直 4:5 角色设计图，采用哑光中灰色摄影棚背景，柔和的漫射光，细微的地面阴影，高分辨率照片级毛发渲染。

主体细节：该角色是一个圆滚滚的小型泰迪熊与猫的混合体，拥有圆圆的大脑袋、短圆的身体、细小的手臂、粗短的腿、奶油色浓密的毛绒皮毛、深橄榄棕色的光泽眼睛并带有明亮的高光、小巧的深棕色鼻子和嘴巴、淡淡的粉色脸颊、头顶有一根细细卷曲的毛发、小巧圆润的耳朵内部发出生物发光绿光，以及带有发光绿尖的短尾巴。整体氛围可爱、柔软且具有玩具感，具有逼真的纤维质感和发光绿色区域的柔和半透明感。使用 {argument name="fur color" default="暖奶油色"}、{argument name="glow color" default="生物发光绿色"} 和 {argument name="cheek color" default="柔和粉色腮红"}。

布局：将设计图分为两行。顶行包含 3 个全身三视图，均匀分布并带有小型白色大写字母标签：1) “01 FRONT”展示角色正面，2) “02 3/4 LEFT”展示左侧 3/4 视角，可见背后的尾巴，3) “03 BACK”展示背面视角，包括圆头、背部毛发、小手臂、腿部和发光的尾尖。左下角包含一个表情图，带有 3 个垂直排列的边框面板，上方标注“EXPRESSION SHEET”，下方带有说明文字：1) “01 NEUTRAL”表现平静的正面注视和微闭的小嘴，2) “02 BATTLE FURY”表现面部被居中的不透明米色方块遮挡，3) “03 SHOCK”表现耳朵竖起、瞪大眼睛、嘴巴张开的惊讶表情。右下角包含一个名为“COLOR PALETTE”的调色板列，带有 5 个矩形色块及标签：1) “CREAM FUR”米色毛发质感，2) “BIOLUMINESCENT GREEN”发光绿色渐变，3) “PINK CHEEK”玫瑰粉色质感，4) “DARK BROWN OUTLINE / NOSE”深棕色色块，5) “WHITE HIGHLIGHT”白色色块。

文字风格：小型、简洁的无衬线大写白色标签，采用极简的角色设计图排版，对齐精准且不显突兀。

约束：保持 3 个三视图、3 个表情面板和 5 个色块。不要添加额外的角色、道具、标志、水印或装饰性背景元素。在所有视图中保持一致的比例、毛发质感、发光的耳朵和尾巴以及面部设计。

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张写实的竖屏手机摄影作品，场景设定在夜晚现代体育竞技场的大厅内。地面为光亮的灰色抛光材质，反射着蓝色和紫色的灯光；背景中可见排队护栏、餐饮指示牌以及远处的入口标志，左侧墙面有巨大的红色 “STAPLES” 图形，右侧有蓝色的 “crypto.com” 标志。在前景中，展示 {argument name="subject" default="一位年轻女性"}，镜头从大腿上部到头部进行构图，她穿着 {argument name="outfit" default="一件黑色缎面吊带裙"}，留着齐肩波浪卷深色头发，背着黑色单肩包。她的脸部被一个居中的纯棕色方块完全遮挡以保护隐私。她手中拿着两样食品和饮料：左手拿着一个透明大塑料杯，装有深红色冰饮，配有圆顶盖和一根黑色吸管；右臂抱着一个白色纸板托盘，托盘内清晰可见四种零食：一个装满黄白相间奶油爆米花的大白桶、一堆淋有亮橙色芝士酱的玉米片、一个小透明杯装的墨西哥辣椒片，以及一个小透明杯装的红色莎莎酱。采用抓拍广角视角，略微俯拍，前景细节锐利，呈现自然的室内竞技场光影，色彩真实，具有休闲社交媒体快照的审美风格，前景中无其他人物，除场地标识外无任何额外添加的文字。

The doll is {argument name="character name" default="A young female moviegoer"} She has medium brown wool skin, long dark brown micro-knit/twisted crochet hair parted in the middle, and her face is covered by a matching dark brown solid-color square veil. She carries five movie snacks: a red iced drink with a clear lid and black straw in her left hand, and a cream-colored crochet tray in her right arm with a cream-colored crochet popcorn bucket piled high with yellow and white popcorn, a pile of orange crochet tortilla chips, a small cup of green jalapeño slices, and a small cup of red salsa. The background is an indoor multiplex cinema lobby with a smooth, polished stone floor reflecting blue-purple light, blurred crowds and queue barriers in the background, a red storefront sign that reads "STAPLES" on the left, and a blue glowing storefront sign that reads "crypto.com" on the right. Using warm indoor lighting, the film showcases the delicate texture of the yarn, with realistic proportions and a documentary-style mobile photography aesthetic. The background is blurred, and there are no extraneous figures in the foreground. There is no watermark; except for the transparent plastic cup lid and sauce cup, all objects are crocheted. The doll's hair color can be customized.{argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown"} The color of the top is{argument name="top color" default="Mustard Yellow"} The color of the skirt is{argument name="dress color" default="black"} and the lobby scene are{argument name="location" default="Modern Cinema Lobby"} .

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张逼真的特写照片，展示一个手工钩针编织的阿米古鲁米玩偶，置身于现代电影院大厅中，采用略微俯视的视角，并带有浅景深效果。玩偶是 {argument name="character name" default="一位年轻的女性电影观众"}，拥有中棕色毛线皮肤，长长的深棕色微型编织/扭转钩针发型，中分，脸部覆盖着一块匹配的深棕色纯色方形遮挡物。她穿着两件明显的服饰：一件芥末黄罗纹钩针长袖上衣和一件黑色钩针背带裙，带有细黑色肩带。她手里拿着 5 种电影零食：左手拿着一杯带黑色吸管的透明盖红色冰饮，右臂抱着一个奶油色钩针托盘，托盘上有一个堆满黄白色爆米花的奶油色钩针爆米花桶、一堆橙色钩针玉米片、一小杯绿色墨西哥辣椒切片以及一小杯红色莎莎酱。背景是室内多厅影院大厅，地面是反射着蓝紫色灯光的光滑抛光石材，背景中有模糊的人群、排队护栏，左侧有一个写着“STAPLES”的红色店面招牌，右侧有一个写着“crypto.com”的蓝色发光店面招牌。使用温暖的室内灯光，展现细腻的毛线质感，比例真实，呈现纪录片式的手机摄影风格，背景虚化，前景中没有多余的人物，无水印，除透明塑料质感的杯盖和酱料杯外，所有物体均由钩针编织而成。可自定义玩偶的头发颜色为 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"}，上衣颜色为 {argument name="top color" default="芥末黄"}，裙子颜色为 {argument name="dress color" default="黑色"}，以及大厅场景为 {argument name="location" default="现代电影院大厅"}。

templates.title: Pink floral holiday cafe portrait

titleLocalized.zh: 粉色花卉度假咖啡馆人像

templates.prompt: Create a stylish editorial capturing the Mediterranean café lifestyle in the sunshine, using a 4:5 vertical composition. A fashionable young woman {argument name="hair color" default="Sun-kissed golden hair"} She sat in a wicker chair, against a backdrop of a cream-colored stucco wall with pale blue decorative borders. She was dressed in a romantic {argument name="dress description" default="Pink floral ruffled strapless summer dress, adorned with a jeweled brooch at the chest."} And paired with the same style{argument name="headscarf description" default="A pink floral silk headscarf, tied at the chin, with long ribbons hanging down naturally."} Her face is obscured by a centrally centered, warm brown rectangular privacy screen. In her left hand, she holds a large, cloudy, pale yellow drink to her lips, while her right hand rests on her lap with an open travel guide. Visible accessories include neatly manicured light-colored nails and several rings. The image is bathed in warm, golden hour sunlight, with glossy bronze highlights and soft shadows. A portion of a white coffee table is visible in the lower left corner, along with the edge of a glass door on the left, and a white handbag is faintly visible in the lower right corner. The overall atmosphere is elegant and glamorous, both casual and sophisticated, reminiscent of high-end Instagram film photography with natural grain, realistic textures, soft pink tones, bright summer light, and shallow depth of field, all without any additional text or watermarks.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张充满阳光的地中海咖啡馆生活方式时尚大片，采用 4:5 竖构图。一位时尚的年轻女性，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="阳光亲吻般的金色长发"}，坐在藤椅上，背景是带有淡蓝色装饰边框的奶油色灰泥墙。她身穿浪漫的 {argument name="dress description" default="粉色花卉荷叶边抹胸夏装，胸前饰有珠宝胸针"}，并搭配同款 {argument name="headscarf description" default="粉色花卉丝绸头巾，在下巴处系结，长长的丝带自然垂落"}。她的面部被一个居中的暖棕色肤色矩形隐私遮挡块遮住。她左手拿着一杯大口径杯装的浑浊淡黄色饮品靠近嘴边，右手在膝盖上拿着一本打开的旅行指南；可见的配饰包括修剪整齐的浅色指甲和几枚戒指。画面呈现温暖的黄金时刻阳光、光泽感的古铜色肌肤高光、柔和的阴影，左下角可见部分白色咖啡桌，左侧有玻璃门边缘，右下角隐约可见一个白色手提包。整体氛围优雅、充满度假魅力，既随性又精致，如同高端时尚 Instagram 胶片摄影风格，带有自然颗粒感、逼真的质感、柔和的粉色调、明亮的夏日光线、浅景深，且无任何额外文字或水印。

templates.title: Neon City Superbike Stunts

titleLocalized.zh: 霓虹都市超级摩托车特技

templates.prompt: Create a 9:16 vertical hyperrealistic 35mm cinematic action photograph, set at night: a strong male rider, his face {argument name="facial reference" default="Blurred square placeholders that match the uploaded accurate facial reference"} The balancing stand is on a moving vehicle{argument name="motorcycle color and type" default="Black and red color scheme superbike"} On the other side, a dangerous rolling stunt is performed in the center of a futuristic city intersection. A full-body shot, centered, shows the rider straddling a motorcycle, fists clenched, body leaning forward, exuding confidence. He wears a black leather motorcycle jacket, a white vest, ripped black skinny jeans with a silver chain, black boots, and a necklace. The superbike faces the audience, featuring a bright headlight, a glossy red fairing, and black trim; metal scrapes against the wet asphalt, sparks flying in the lower right corner. Three motorcycles in motion surround the main rider: a blurry dark motorcycle passes by in the foreground to the left, a rider with a headlight is behind the main rider to the right, and a red motorcycle is further to the right. The scene is set in a neon-lit, futuristic Times Square-style downtown canyon, with towering skyscrapers, glowing cyan and magenta billboards, vertical digital advertisements, traffic lights, road markings, and reflections of the rain-soaked pavement in the background. The film employs dramatic pinkish-green lighting, high contrast, shallow depth of field, background riders with motion blur, and sharp focus on the main stunt rider and motorcycle. Low-angle perspective creates a strong sense of speed, with realistic lens flare, reflections of wet streets, and splashing orange sparks. Facial areas are kept as intended reference faces or placeholders; there are no extra figures in the foreground, no clearly visible brand logos, no watermarks, and no text overlays except for blurred billboard graphics.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 9:16 垂直超写实 35mm 电影感动作照片，场景设于夜间：一位强壮的男性骑手，面部为 {argument name="facial reference" default="与上传的精确面部参考相匹配的模糊方形占位符"}，正平衡站在一辆行驶中的 {argument name="motorcycle color and type" default="黑红配色超级摩托车"} 上，在未来派城市十字路口中心表演危险的滚动特技。全身镜头，居中构图，双腿跨在摩托车上，双拳紧握，身体前倾，神情充满自信，身穿黑色皮质机车夹克、白色背心、破洞黑色紧身牛仔裤配银色链条、黑色靴子及项链。超级摩托车车头朝向观众，配有明亮的前灯、光泽的红色整流罩、黑色饰件，金属刮擦湿润的沥青路面，右下角火花四溅。主骑手周围环绕着 3 辆处于运动状态的摩托车：左侧前景有一辆模糊的深色摩托车经过，主车右后方有一位带前灯的骑手，更右侧还有一辆红色摩托车。场景设定在霓虹闪烁的未来派时代广场风格市中心峡谷，背景是高耸的摩天大楼、发光的青色和洋红色广告牌、垂直数字广告、交通信号灯、道路标线以及雨后路面的倒影。采用戏剧性的青粉色调灯光，高对比度，浅景深，背景骑手带有动态模糊，主特技骑手和摩托车焦点清晰，低角度透视，强烈的速度感，逼真的镜头光晕，湿润街道的倒影，以及飞溅的橙色火花。保持面部区域为预期的参考面部或占位符，前景中无额外人物，无清晰可见的品牌标志，无水印，除模糊的广告牌图形外无任何文字覆盖。

templates.title: Street photos of sport motorcycles with wheelies

titleLocalized.zh: 运动摩托车翘头街拍照片

templates.prompt: Create a cinematic, vertical 35mm street photography image, in which {argument name="rider description" default="A young man"} In the middle of a busy city street, a red and black sports motorcycle performs a dynamic wheelie. The motorcycle is the focus of the image, shot from a low angle with the front wheel raised high towards the camera while the rear wheel remains on the asphalt. The rider is wearing {argument name="outfit" default="He wore a black leather jacket over a white T-shirt, a gold necklace, ripped black jeans, and black boots."} He grips the handlebars with confidence. This sport motorcycle boasts an aggressive red fairing with black accents, a bright headlight, a dark windshield, sharply angled mirrors, a robust front tire, exposed brake discs, and a glossy finish. Tiny sparks from the friction against the pavement are added to the lower right corner near the rear wheel or footpegs. The scene is set on a city street lined with mid-rise buildings and shops, with pedestrians gathered on the sidewalk, and the vehicles in the background rendered with a soft, shallow depth-of-field blur. Warm afternoon natural light is used, employing a cinematic color gradation with shades of cyan and orange to showcase realistic dynamic energy, revealing delicate asphalt textures, subtle film grain, and professional 35mm lens quality. The composition is vertical, centered on the motorcycle and rider, and should not contain any identifiable text, signs, or other vehicles obstructing the main subject.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张电影感竖版 35mm 街拍图像，画面中 {argument name="rider description" default="一名年轻男子"} 正在繁忙的城市街道中央，驾驶一辆红黑相间的运动摩托车进行极具张力的翘头表演。摩托车是画面的核心，采用低角度正面拍摄，前轮高高抬起朝向镜头，后轮仍着地于沥青路面。骑手身着 {argument name="outfit" default="黑色皮夹克内搭白色 T 恤，佩戴金项链，穿着破洞黑色牛仔裤和黑色靴子"}，姿态自信地握住车把。这辆运动摩托车拥有激进的红色整流罩及黑色点缀、明亮的前大灯、深色挡风玻璃、棱角分明的后视镜、粗壮的前轮胎、外露的刹车盘以及光泽感十足的车身。在右下方靠近后轮或脚踏板处添加因摩擦路面而溅出的细小火花。场景设定在街道两旁林立着中层建筑和店面的城市街道，人行道上聚集着行人，背景中的车辆呈现出柔和的浅景深模糊效果。使用温暖的午后自然光，采用青橙色调的电影级色彩分级，展现真实的动态能量，呈现细腻的沥青纹理、微妙的胶片颗粒感以及专业的 35mm 镜头质感。构图采用竖屏方向，以摩托车和骑手为中心，画面中不应包含可辨认的文字、标志，也不应有其他车辆遮挡主体。

templates.title: Tokyo Neon Motorcycle Drift

titleLocalized.zh: 东京霓虹摩托车漂移

templates.prompt: Create a 9:16 vertical hyperrealistic 35mm street photography action shot, set in a crowded neon-lit alleyway reminiscent of Tokyo at night. The subject is a stylish male rider, his face {argument name="rider face" default="A naturally blended but anonymized face"} He was riding a matte black sports motorcycle, and this close-up shot from the left front, taken at a low angle, captured the moment he was performing a side drift on the wet asphalt. He was wearing {argument name="rider outfit" default="A white T-shirt layered under a black sleeveless leather biker vest, paired with grey cargo pants, black boots, a bracelet, and a ring."} A boot scrapes across the pavement, sending up a trail of bright orange sparks, and the motorcycle leans sharply. The motorcycle features a black fairing, dark windshield, dual headlights, gold forks, exposed disc brakes, and a glossy, wet reflection. The surrounding area is filled with smoke, mist, dynamic blurring, and a cinematic atmosphere. The alley is narrow and dimly lit, crowded with blurry onlookers on both sides; the frame must include exactly 10 visible bystanders, all minor and blurred. The background must contain exactly 8 prominent vertical neon signs with Japanese-style characters: 4 on the left, 3 on the right, and 1 in the far center, using red, cyan, white, and pink lighting effects. The wet pavement should show lane lines, puddles, and vibrant neon reflections extending towards the camera.{argument name="lighting style" default="A melancholic cyberpunk neon style, accompanied by cool blue smoke and warm orange sparks."} Shallow depth of field, high contrast, realistic skin and fabric textures, clear motorcycle details, wet roads after rain, dynamic motion blur, no cartoon style, no extra text overlay, no watermark.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 9:16 竖屏超写实 35mm 街头摄影动作照，场景设定在夜晚东京风格的拥挤霓虹小巷中。一位时尚的男性骑手，面部为 {argument name="rider face" default="自然融合但经过匿名化处理的面孔"}，正驾驶着一辆哑光黑运动摩托车，从左前方低角度近距离捕捉他正在湿沥青路面上进行侧向漂移的瞬间。他身着 {argument name="rider outfit" default="白色 T 恤外搭黑色无袖皮质机车马甲，配灰色工装裤、黑色靴子、手链和戒指"}；一只靴子擦过路面，溅起一串明亮的橙色火花，摩托车车身剧烈倾斜。摩托车配有黑色整流罩、深色挡风玻璃、双前大灯、金色前叉、外露盘式制动器，并带有光亮的湿润反射。周围环绕着烟雾、薄雾、动态拖影和极具电影感的氛围。小巷狭窄昏暗，两侧挤满了模糊的围观人群；画面中需包含恰好 10 位可见的旁观者，所有人物均为次要角色且虚化处理。背景中需包含恰好 8 个醒目的垂直霓虹灯牌，带有日式风格字符：左侧 4 个，右侧 3 个，中心远处 1 个，使用红色、青色、白色和粉色光效。湿润的路面应呈现出车道线、水洼以及向镜头延伸的绚丽霓虹倒影。使用 {argument name="lighting style" default="忧郁的赛博朋克霓虹风格，伴有冷蓝色烟雾和暖橙色火花"}，浅景深，高对比度，真实的皮肤和织物纹理，清晰的摩托车细节，雨后湿滑的路面，动态运动模糊，拒绝卡通风格，无额外文字叠加，无水印。

templates.title: Cinematic Motorcycle Powder Explosion

titleLocalized.zh: 电影感机车彩粉爆炸

templates.prompt: Create a 9:16 vertical cinematic 35mm action portrait, with the subject being {argument name="character name" default="A strong male motorcyclist"} He's riding a modern black street bike straight toward the camera through a dark industrial tunnel. The rider is centered and symmetrically positioned, leaning forward aggressively, his gloved hands gripping the handlebars. He wears a slim-fitting black racing jacket with small racing patches, black trousers, protective gloves, and two gold chains. His short, black hair is combed back; a smooth, rectangular blur over his face is used for anonymization. The motorcycle features a large, round, illuminated headlight, amber turn signals, a thick front tire, visible forks, glossy black fenders, and sharp, realistic mechanical details. Behind him, a massive explosion of colored powder is created, composed of clouds of four primary colors: a bright cyan on the left, a vibrant red from the middle left to the right, a fiery yellow on the right, and a small amount of pink/magenta mixed in near the top center. Orange flames, accompanied by sparks and embers, are added around the front wheel and beneath the motorcycle. The film uses a strong tunnel motion blur effect that radiates backward, with turquoise fluorescent lights on both sides of the tunnel and wet reflective stripes on the ground. It emphasizes dramatic contrast, shallow depth of field, a sense of high-speed energy, ultra-fine photorealistic feel, and cinematic turquoise tones. It was shot from a low angle, with no other vehicles, visible text, or watermarks in the frame.

promptLocalized.zh: 创作一张 9:16 竖屏电影感 35mm 动作肖像，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="一位强壮的男性机车手"}，他正骑着一辆现代黑色街车在黑暗的工业隧道中径直冲向镜头。车手位于画面中心且呈对称构图，身体前倾，姿态激进，戴着手套的双手紧握车把，身穿修身黑色赛车夹克，带有小型赛车补丁，穿着黑色长裤、防护手套，佩戴两条金项链。他的头发短而黑，向后梳理；在面部位置覆盖一个平滑的矩形模糊区域，以实现匿名化效果。摩托车配有巨大的圆形发光前大灯、琥珀色转向灯、厚实的前轮胎、可见的前叉、亮黑色挡泥板，并具有锐利逼真的机械细节。在他身后，创造一场巨大的彩色粉末爆炸，由四种主色调云团组成：左侧为明亮的青蓝色，中左至右侧为鲜艳的红色，右侧为热烈的黄色，顶部中心附近混合有少量粉色/洋红色点缀。在前轮两侧及摩托车下方添加环绕的橙色火焰，并伴有火花和余烬。使用强烈的隧道运动模糊效果向后辐射，隧道两侧设有青绿色荧光灯，地面有湿润的反光条纹，强调戏剧性对比、浅景深、高速能量感、超精细照片级真实感、电影级青橙色调，采用低机位拍摄，画面中无其他车辆，无可见文字，无水印。
